english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?
translation: 啊，祝你有美好的一天[milady/sirrah]！你的脸很陌生，你是不是和我们一起登上了月岛的船？ [a ， zhu ni you mei hao de yi tian [milady/sirrah]！ ni de lian hen mo sheng ， ni shi bu shi he wo men yi qi deng shang le yue dao de chuan ？]

english: No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.
translation: 不，洛卡实际上让我在雷莱卡搭车。 [bu ， luo ka shi ji shang rang wo zai lei lai ka da che 。]

english: Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!
translation: 哦真的吗？在我看来你不像弗雷曼尼克人！ [o zhen de ma ？ zai wo kan lai ni bu xiang fu lei man ni ke ren ！]

english: Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
translation: 嗯……我有点是，又有点不是。这是一个很长的故事。 [n …… wo you dian shi ， you you dian bu shi 。 zhe shi yi ge hen zhang de gu shi 。]

english: Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a-fremennik!
translation: 抱歉我没时间听！再见，年轻的弗雷曼尼克，他不是真正的弗雷曼尼克！ [bao qian wo mei shi jian ting ！ zai jian ， nian qing de fu lei man ni ke ， ta bu shi zhen zheng de fu lei man ni ke ！]

english: 'Bye.
translation: '再见。 [' zai jian 。]

english: Aren't you a little short for a pirate?
translation: 你对于海盗来说是不是有点矮了？ [ni dui yu hai dao lai shuo shi bu shi you dian ai le ？]

english: My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.
translation: 我的母亲是一个侏儒。显然这是一次非常痛苦的分娩。 [wo de mu qin shi yi ge zhu ru 。 xian ran zhe shi yi ci fei chang tong ku de fen mian 。]

english: More info than I wanted, thanks!
translation: 比我想要的更多信息，谢谢！ [bi wo xiang yao de geng duo xin xi ， xie xie ！]

english: ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!
translation: 啊啊！拉响警报！船上偷渡者！船上偷渡者！ [a a ！ la xiang jing bao ！ chuan shang tou du zhe ！ chuan shang tou du zhe ！]

english: No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
translation: 不！我不是偷渡者！诚实的！我被邀请来到这里！ [bu ！ wo bu shi tou du zhe ！ cheng shi de ！ wo bei yao qing lai dao zhe li ！]

english: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
translation: 哦，抱歉，那是我的错误。 [o ， bao qian ， na shi wo de cuo wu 。]

english: You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.
translation: 但你必须承认你看起来确实很像一个偷渡者。 [dan ni bi xu cheng ren ni kan qi lai que shi hen xiang yi ge tou du zhe 。]

english: Why, what do they usually look like?
translation: 为什么，他们通常是什么样子？ [wei shen me ， ta men tong chang shi shen me yang zi ？]

english: Erm... I've never actually met one...
translation: 呃……我从来没有真正见过一个…… [e …… wo cong lai mei you zhen zheng jian guo yi ge ……]

english: Okay then...
translation: 好吧，那么... [hao ba ， na me ...]

english: Brrrr! Its cold up here!
translation: 呜呜！这里很冷！ [wu wu ！ zhe li hen leng ！]

english: You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!
translation: 你觉得这很冷吗？到了 Acheron 那里，天气变得非常寒冷，当你说话时，你会看到话语冻结在你面前的空气中！ [ni jue de zhe hen leng ma ？ dao le  Acheron  na li ， tian qi bian de fei chang han leng ， dang ni shuo hua shi ， ni hui kan dao hua yu dong jie zai ni mian qian de kong qi zhong ！]

english: REALLY?
translation: 真的吗？ [zhen de ma ？]

english: Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!
translation: 不，不是真的。我为了达到幽默效果而夸张了。不过天气非常非常冷！ [bu ， bu shi zhen de 。 wo wei le da dao you mo xiao guo er kua zhang le 。 bu guo tian qi fei chang fei chang leng ！]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: So... You're a pirate, huh?
translation: 那么...你是海盗，是吧？ [na me ... ni shi hai dao ， shi ba ？]

english: It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.
translation: 月底我的工资单上就是这么写的。 [yue di wo de gong zi dan shang jiu shi zhe me xie de 。]

english: How's that working out for you?
translation: 你感觉怎么样？ [ni gan jue zen me yang ？]

english: Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.
translation: 到目前为止还不错。我们可以掠夺的所有烈酒和战利品，再加上包括牙科在内的全套医疗服务。 [dao mu qian wei zhi hai bu cuo 。 wo men ke yi lve duo de suo you lie jiu he zhan li pin ， zai jia shang bao kuo ya ke zai nei de quan tao yi liao fu wu 。]

english: You mean you have insurance?
translation: 你是说你有保险？ [ni shi shuo ni you bao xian ？]

english: Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.
translation: 不是这样的。如果我们中的任何一个人生病了，我们就会绑架一名医生，直到我们病情好转之前不让他走。 [bu shi zhe yang de 。 ru guo wo men zhong de ren he yi ge ren sheng bing le ， wo men jiu hui bang jia yi ming yi sheng ， zhi dao wo men bing qing hao zhuan zhi qian bu rang ta zou 。]

english: You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.
translation: 您会惊讶地发现，这对于专家医疗保健来说是多么大的激励。 [nin hui jing ya di fa xian ， zhe dui yu zhuan jia yi liao bao jian lai shuo shi duo me da de ji li 。]

english: I can imagine.
translation: 我可以想象。 [wo ke yi xiang xiang 。]

english: Hello there. So what brings you aboard the Lady Zay?
translation: 你好呀。那么是什么让您登上了 Lady Zay 号呢？ [ni hao ya 。 na me shi shen me rang nin deng shang le  Lady Zay  hao ne ？]

english: Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.
translation: 嗯，我原本打算去拜访月族，但我不得不说你们的船非常令人印象深刻。 [n ， wo yuan ben da suan qu bai fang yue zu ， dan wo bu de bu shuo ni men de chuan fei chang ling ren yin xiang shen ke 。]

english: Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!
translation: 是啊，果然是个美女啊！扎伊女士酒店一直是我的家，度过了许多艰难的几个月，经历了暴风雨和阳光，她总是带我们到达我们要去的地方！ [shi a ， guo ran shi ge mei nv a ！ zha yi nv shi jiu dian yi zhi shi wo de jia ， du guo le xu duo jian nan de ji ge yue ， jing li le bao feng yu he yang guang ， ta zong shi dai wo men dao da wo men yao qu de di fang ！]

english: Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!
translation: 是的，她确实是我旅行中见过的最好的船之一！ [shi de ， ta que shi shi wo lv xing zhong jian guo de zui hao de chuan zhi yi ！]

english: That she is [lad/lass], that she is.
translation: 她是[小伙子/姑娘]，她就是。 [ta shi [ xiao huo zi / gu niang ]， ta jiu shi 。]

english: Hello to you too.
translation: 也向你问好。 [ye xiang ni wen hao 。]

english: Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
translation: 呀！我们是海盗，耶！阿瓦斯特，你们这些坏血病的陆生荔枝！ [ya ！ wo men shi hai dao ， ye ！ a wa si te ， ni men zhe xie huai xue bing de lu sheng li zhi ！]

english: Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
translation: 请不要这样说话，这太令人恼火了。 [qing bu yao zhe yang shuo hua ， zhe tai ling ren nao huo le 。]

english: Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
translation: 另外，请不要叫我荔枝，不管那是什么。 [ling wai ， qing bu yao jiao wo li zhi ， bu guan na shi shen me 。]

english: Oh. Okay. Sorry.
translation: 哦。好的。对不起。 [o 。 hao de 。 dui bu qi 。]

english: So how's life as a pirate?
translation: 那么海贼的生活是怎样的呢？ [na me hai zei de sheng huo shi zen yang de ne ？]

english: What kind of question is that? How's life as a... I dunno. Whatever it is that you do for a living.
translation: 这是什么问题？生活怎么样……我不知道。无论你以什么为生。 [zhe shi shen me wen ti ？ sheng huo zen me yang …… wo bu zhi dao 。 wu lun ni yi shen me wei sheng 。]

english: I'm a freelance troubleshooter.
translation: 我是一名自由疑难解答者。 [wo shi yi ming zi you yi nan jie da zhe 。]

english: What does that entail then?
translation: 那么这意味着什么呢？ [na me zhe yi wei zhe shen me ne ？]

english: Mostly killing things for money and delivering items around the planet for people.
translation: 主要是为了钱而杀人，并为人们在地球各地运送物品。 [zhu yao shi wei le qian er sha ren ， bing wei ren men zai di qiu ge di yun song wu pin 。]

english: I collect stuff.
translation: 我收集东西。 [wo shou ji dong xi 。]

english: So how's that life?
translation: 那么这样的生活怎么样呢？ [na me zhe yang de sheng huo zen me yang ne ？]

english: Can't complain, can't complain...
translation: 不能抱怨，不能抱怨…… [bu neng bao yuan ， bu neng bao yuan ……]

english: Well, there you go.
translation: 好吧，就这样吧。 [hao ba ， jiu zhe yang ba 。]

english: Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.
translation: 抱歉，不能停下来，如果船长发现我偷懒地跟偷渡者说话，我的胆子会被吊袜带的。 [bao qian ， bu neng ting xia lai ， ru guo chuan zhang fa xian wo tou lan di gen tou du zhe shuo hua ， wo de dan zi hui bei diao wa dai de 。]

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard!
translation: 我不是偷渡者！我被邀请上船了！ [wo bu shi tou du zhe ！ wo bei yao qing shang chuan le ！]

english: Yeah, whatever [guy/lady], it doesn't really matter who you are I'll get in trouble!
translation: 是的，无论[男人/女人]，无论你是谁，我都会遇到麻烦！ [shi de ， wu lun [ nan ren / nv ren ]， wu lun ni shi shui ， wo du hui yu dao ma fan ！]

english: You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.
translation: 你知道，我一直想知道海盗的生活究竟意味着什么。 [ni zhi dao ， wo yi zhi xiang zhi dao hai dao de sheng huo jiu jing yi wei zhe shen me 。]

english: Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.
translation: 嗯，目前主要涉及偷渡者随机询问问题。 [n ， mu qian zhu yao she ji tou du zhe sui ji xun wen wen ti 。]

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard! By Lokar! Ask him!
translation: 我不是偷渡者！我被邀请上船了！洛卡写的！问他吧！ [wo bu shi tou du zhe ！ wo bei yao qing shang chuan le ！ luo ka xie de ！ wen ta ba ！]

english: Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.
translation: 嘿，无论如何[爱人/朋友]。只要确保船长没有抓住你，海盗不太喜欢偷渡者。 [hei ， wu lun ru he [ ai ren / peng you ]。 zhi yao que bao chuan zhang mei you zhua zhu ni ， hai dao bu tai xi huan tou du zhe 。]

english: What are you cooking?
translation: 你在煮什么？ [ni zai zhu shen me ？]

english: My speciality! What else could I be cooking?
translation: 我的专长！我还能煮什么？ [wo de zhuan chang ！ wo hai neng zhu shen me ？]

english: Ok, and your speciality is...?
translation: 好吧，你的专长是……？ [hao ba ， ni de zhuan chang shi ……？]

english: Boiled shark guts with a hint of rosemary and a dash of squid ink.
translation: 煮鲨鱼内脏，加入少许迷迭香和少许墨鱼汁。 [zhu sha yu nei zang ， jia ru shao xu mi die xiang he shao xu mo yu zhi 。]

english: I think I'll stick to making my own food.
translation: 我想我会坚持自己做饭。 [wo xiang wo hui jian chi zi ji zuo fan 。]

english: Your loss!
translation: 你的损失！ [ni de sun shi ！]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

translation: 那么这意味着什么呢？ [na me zhe yi wei zhe shen me ne ？]

english: Mostly killing things for money and delivering items around the planet for people.
translation: 主要是为了钱而杀人，并为人们在地球各地运送物品。 [zhu yao shi wei le qian er sha ren ， bing wei ren men zai di qiu ge di yun song wu pin 。]

english: So how's that life?
translation: 那么这样的生活怎么样呢？ [na me zhe yang de sheng huo zen me yang ne ？]

english: Can't complain, can't complain...
translation: 不能抱怨，不能抱怨…… [bu neng bao yuan ， bu neng bao yuan ……]

english: Well, there you go.
translation: 好吧，就这样吧。 [hao ba ， jiu zhe yang ba 。]

english: Aren't you a little short for a pirate?
translation: 你对于海盗来说是不是有点矮了？ [ni dui yu hai dao lai shuo shi bu shi you dian ai le ？]

english: My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.
translation: 我的母亲是一个侏儒。显然这是一次非常痛苦的分娩。 [wo de mu qin shi yi ge zhu ru 。 xian ran zhe shi yi ci fei chang tong ku de fen mian 。]

english: More info than I wanted, thanks!
translation: 比我想要的更多信息，谢谢！ [bi wo xiang yao de geng duo xin xi ， xie xie ！]

english: ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!
translation: 啊啊！拉响警报！船上偷渡者！船上偷渡者！ [a a ！ la xiang jing bao ！ chuan shang tou du zhe ！ chuan shang tou du zhe ！]

english: No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
translation: 不！我不是偷渡者！诚实的！我被邀请来到这里！ [bu ！ wo bu shi tou du zhe ！ cheng shi de ！ wo bei yao qing lai dao zhe li ！]

english: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
translation: 哦，抱歉，那是我的错误。 [o ， bao qian ， na shi wo de cuo wu 。]

english: Why, what do they usually look like?
translation: 为什么，他们通常是什么样子？ [wei shen me ， ta men tong chang shi shen me yang zi ？]

english: Erm... I've never actually met one...
translation: 呃……我从来没有真正见过一个…… [e …… wo cong lai mei you zhen zheng jian guo yi ge ……]

english: Okay then...
translation: 好吧，那么... [hao ba ， na me ...]

english: Hello to you too.
translation: 也向你问好。 [ye xiang ni wen hao 。]

english: Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
translation: 呀！我们是海盗，耶！阿瓦斯特，你们这些坏血病的陆生荔枝！ [ya ！ wo men shi hai dao ， ye ！ a wa si te ， ni men zhe xie huai xue bing de lu sheng li zhi ！]

english: Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
translation: 请不要这样说话，这太令人恼火了。 [qing bu yao zhe yang shuo hua ， zhe tai ling ren nao huo le 。]

english: Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
translation: 另外，请不要叫我荔枝，不管那是什么。 [ling wai ， qing bu yao jiao wo li zhi ， bu guan na shi shen me 。]

english: Oh. Okay. Sorry.
translation: 哦。好的。对不起。 [o 。 hao de 。 dui bu qi 。]

english: I feel a little sea-sick from this travelling.
translation: 这次旅行我感觉有点晕船。 [zhe ci lv xing wo gan jue you dian yun chuan 。]

english: Well there's a good remedy for that.
translation: 嗯，有一个很好的补救措施。 [n ， you yi ge hen hao de bu jiu cuo shi 。]

english: There is?
translation: 有？ [you ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: Swim.
translation: 游泳。 [you yong 。]

english: Oh HA HA. Thanks for the help!
translation: 哦哈哈。感谢您的帮助！ [o ha ha 。 gan xie nin de bang zhu ！]

english: My pleasure.
translation: 我的荣幸。 [wo de rong xing 。]

english: I was being sarcastic.
translation: 我是在讽刺。 [wo shi zai feng ci 。]

english: I know. So was I.
translation: 我知道。我也是。 [wo zhi dao 。 wo ye shi 。]

translation: 我想收集物品。 [wo xiang shou ji wu pin 。]

translation: 我想检查我的 PIN 设置。 [wo xiang jian cha wo de  PIN  she zhi 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This is a branch of the Bank of Gielinor. We have branches in many towns.
translation: 这是吉林诺银行的一个分行。我们在很多城镇都有分店。 [zhe shi ji lin nuo yin hang de yi ge fen hang 。 wo men zai hen duo cheng zhen dou you fen dian 。]

english: And what do you do?
translation: 你做什么？ [ni zuo shen me ？]

english: We will look after your items and money for you. Leave your valuables with us if you want to keep them safe.
translation: 我们将为您保管您的物品和金钱。如果您想保证贵重物品的安全，请将其交给我们。 [wo men jiang wei nin bao guan nin de wu pin he jin qian 。 ru guo nin xiang bao zheng gui zhong wu pin de an quan ， qing jiang qi jiao gei wo men 。]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: How's Cyrisus? Where is he?
translation: 赛里苏斯怎么样？他在哪儿？ [sai li su si zen me yang ？ ta zai na er ？]

english: He's fine now. Back to full health.
translation: 他现在很好。恢复完全健康。 [ta xian zai hen hao 。 hui fu wan quan jian kang 。]

english: Good, I'm pleased.
translation: 很好，我很高兴。 [hen hao ， wo hen gao xing 。]

english: No problem.
translation: 没问题。 [mei wen ti 。]

english: Don't think that this means I like you now!
translation: 别以为这代表我现在喜欢你了！ [bie yi wei zhe dai biao wo xian zai xi huan ni le ！]

english: Look at my face.
translation: 看看我的脸。 [kan kan wo de lian 。]

english: Yes? What about it.
translation: 是的？那又怎样呢。 [shi de ？ na you zen yang ne 。]

english: Does it look like I care?
translation: 看起来我很关心吗？ [kan qi lai wo hen guan xin ma ？]

english: Not really.
translation: 并不真地。 [bing bu zhen di 。]

english: Well, there you go.
translation: 好吧，就这样吧。 [hao ba ， jiu zhe yang ba 。]

english: Using the bank
translation: 使用银行 [shi yong yin hang]

english: I'd like to access my bank account, please.
translation: 我想访问我的银行帐户。 [wo xiang fang wen wo de yin hang zhang hu 。]

english: I'd like to collect items.
translation: 我想收集物品。 [wo xiang shou ji wu pin 。]

english: I'd like to check my PIN settings.
translation: 我想检查我的 PIN 设置。 [wo xiang jian cha wo de  PIN  she zhi 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Cyrisus in the mine
translation: 赛里苏斯在矿井中 [sai li su si zai kuang jing zhong]

english: What's going on?
translation: 这是怎么回事？ [zhe shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: Ah, we be building this 'ere tower. Lookin' good ain't it?
translation: 啊，我们正在建造这座塔。看起来不错不是吗？ [a ， wo men zheng zai jian zao zhe zuo ta 。 kan qi lai bu cuo bu shi ma ？]

english: It does look pretty impressive, but what are you doing hanging around?
translation: 它看起来确实令人印象深刻，但你在闲逛做什么？ [ta kan qi lai que shi ling ren yin xiang shen ke ， dan ni zai xian guang zuo shen me ？]

english: Tea break, naturally.
translation: 自然是茶歇。 [zi ran shi cha xie 。]

english: Naturally. Not sure why I asked.
translation: 自然。不知道我为什么问。 [zi ran 。 bu zhi dao wo wei shen me wen 。]

english: Fancy some?
translation: 想要一些吗？ [xiang yao yi xie ma ？]

english: Tea? Sure.
translation: 茶？当然。 [cha ？ dang ran 。]

english: You'll find a kettle in the box to the-
translation: 你会在盒子里找到一个水壶—— [ni hui zai he zi li zhao dao yi ge shui hu ——]

english: Erm...yeah...no...sorry...gotta go.
translation: 呃...是的...不...抱歉...该走了。 [e ... shi de ... bu ... bao qian ... gai zou le 。]

english: Say, that's a nice helmet.
translation: 说吧，这个头盔不错。 [shuo ba ， zhe ge tou kui bu cuo 。]

english: Thank you - just as nice as the one in your bank!
translation: 谢谢你——就像你银行里的一样好！ [xie xie ni —— jiu xiang ni yin hang li de yi yang hao ！]

english: This is quite the tower.
translation: 这真是一座塔。 [zhe zhen shi yi zuo ta 。]

english: Yeah, it cost a fair bit.
translation: 是的，花了相当多的钱。 [shi de ， hua le xiang dang duo de qian 。]

english: How much?
translation: 多少？ [duo shao ？]

english: Well, I had to 'alch' a fair few belongings of my fellow alchemists to afford it.
translation: 好吧，我必须“炼金”我的炼金术士同伴的一些财产才能负担得起。 [hao ba ， wo bi xu “ lian jin ” wo de lian jin shu shi tong ban de yi xie cai chan cai neng fu dan de qi 。]

english: I bet they love you for that.
translation: 我敢打赌他们因此而爱你。 [wo gan da du ta men yin ci er ai ni 。]

english: Everyone loves someone that can create money.
translation: 每个人都喜欢能创造金钱的人。 [mei ge ren dou xi huan neng chuang zao jin qian de ren 。]

english: I don't.
translation: 我不知道。 [wo bu zhi dao 。]

english: What do you do for fun on this ship? You know, when you're not doing pirate stuff.
translation: 你在这艘船上做什么好玩的？你知道，当你不做海盗的事情时。 [ni zai zhe sou chuan shang zuo shen me hao wan de ？ ni zhi dao ， dang ni bu zuo hai dao de shi qing shi 。]

english: All sorts! Hide and seek, pin the patch on the pirate, walk the plank!
translation: 各种各样！捉迷藏，把补丁别在海盗身上，走木板！ [ge zhong ge yang ！ zhuo mi cang ， ba bu ding bie zai hai dao shen shang ， zou mu ban ！]

english: What a life! Wait a minute. 'Walk the plank'? Surely that's a bit dangerous?
translation: 多么美好的生活啊！等一下。 ‘走木板’？这肯定有点危险吧？ [duo me mei hao de sheng huo a ！ deng yi xia 。 ‘ zou mu ban ’？ zhe ken ding you dian wei xian ba ？]

english: Well of course, but where's the fun without a few deaths?
translation: 当然可以，但是如果没有一些死亡，那还有什么乐趣呢？ [dang ran ke yi ， dan shi ru guo mei you yi xie si wang ， na hai you shen me le qu ne ？]

english: I think I'll stick to Runelink.
translation: 我想我会坚持使用符文链接。 [wo xiang wo hui jian chi shi yong fu wen lian jie 。]

english: What are you up to?
translation: 你要做什么？ [ni yao zuo shen me ？]

english: Rock, Paper, Scissors. Can't you tell?
translation: 石头、剪刀、布。你看不出来吗？ [shi tou 、 jian dao 、 bu 。 ni kan bu chu lai ma ？]

english: It was more of a rhetorical question.
translation: 这更像是一个反问句。 [zhe geng xiang shi yi ge fan wen ju 。]

english: Rhetora-what?
translation: 修辞-什么？ [xiu ci - shen me ？]

english: Shouldn't you be working?
translation: 你不应该工作吗？ [ni bu ying gai gong zuo ma ？]

english: We are. It's team building.
translation: 我们是。这是团队建设。 [wo men shi 。 zhe shi tuan dui jian she 。]

english: Why, hello there!
translation: 为什么，你好！ [wei shen me ， ni hao ！]

english: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？ [ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Clothing.
translation: 衣服。 [yi fu 。]

english: Nope. Need mine.
translation: 没有。需要我的。 [mei you 。 xu yao wo de 。]

english: Ah, come on. You know you want to give me free stuff.
translation: 啊，来吧。你知道你想给我免费的东西。 [a ， lai ba 。 ni zhi dao ni xiang gei wo mian fei de dong xi 。]

english: Stop bothering me, can't you see I'm busy!
translation: 别再打扰我了，你没看到我很忙吗！ [bie zai da rao wo le ， ni mei kan dao wo hen mang ma ！]

english: Yes, VERY busy I'm sure.
translation: 是的，我确信非常忙。 [shi de ， wo que xin fei chang mang 。]

english: Okay, okay.
translation: 好吧，好吧。 [hao ba ， hao ba 。]

english: The other day I was drying my clothes on a line down by the shore. A storm hit and some of my clothing went missing.
translation: 有一天，我在海边的绳子上晾衣服。暴风雨袭来，我的一些衣服不见了。 [you yi tian ， wo zai hai bian de sheng zi shang liang yi fu 。 bao feng yu xi lai ， wo de yi xie yi fu bu jian le 。]

english: Likely story. Sure you weren't skinny dipping?
translation: 可能的故事。你确定不是裸泳吗？ [ke neng de gu shi 。 ni que ding bu shi luo yong ma ？]

english: Just go look and leave me be! Search around the tower and you may find them.
translation: 去看看吧，别管我了！在塔周围搜索一下，你可能会找到它们。 [qu kan kan ba ， bie guan wo le ！ zai ta zhou wei sou suo yi xia ， ni ke neng hui zhao dao ta men 。]

english: You winning?
translation: 你赢了？ [ni ying le ？]

english: It's a draw at the moment. First it was best of three, then it was best of five.
translation: 目前是平局。首先是三局两胜，然后是五局三胜。 [mu qian shi ping ju 。 shou xian shi san ju liang sheng ， ran hou shi wu ju san sheng 。]

english: And now?
translation: 现在呢？ [xian zai ne ？]

english: Best of a hundred and one.
translation: 一百零一个中最好的。 [yi bai ling yi ge zhong zui hao de 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: So how's life as a pirate?
translation: 那么海贼的生活是怎样的呢？ [na me hai zei de sheng huo shi zen yang de ne ？]

english: What kind of question is that? How's life as a... I dunno. Whatever it is that you do for a living.
translation: 这是什么问题？生活怎么样……我不知道。无论你以什么为生。 [zhe shi shen me wen ti ？ sheng huo zen me yang …… wo bu zhi dao 。 wu lun ni yi shen me wei sheng 。]

english: I'm a freelance troubleshooter.
translation: 我是一名自由疑难解答者。 [wo shi yi ming zi you yi nan jie da zhe 。]

english: What does that entail then?
translation: 那么这意味着什么呢？ [na me zhe yi wei zhe shen me ne ？]

english: Mostly killing things for money and delivering items around the planet for people.
translation: 主要是为了钱而杀人，并为人们在地球各地运送物品。 [zhu yao shi wei le qian er sha ren ， bing wei ren men zai di qiu ge di yun song wu pin 。]

english: I collect stuff.
translation: 我收集东西。 [wo shou ji dong xi 。]

english: So how's that life?
translation: 那么这样的生活怎么样呢？ [na me zhe yang de sheng huo zen me yang ne ？]

english: Can't complain, can't complain...
translation: 不能抱怨，不能抱怨…… [bu neng bao yuan ， bu neng bao yuan ……]

english: Well, there you go.
translation: 好吧，就这样吧。 [hao ba ， jiu zhe yang ba 。]

english: Aren't you a little short for a pirate?
translation: 你对于海盗来说是不是有点矮了？ [ni dui yu hai dao lai shuo shi bu shi you dian ai le ？]

english: My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.
translation: 我的母亲是一个侏儒。显然这是一次非常痛苦的分娩。 [wo de mu qin shi yi ge zhu ru 。 xian ran zhe shi yi ci fei chang tong ku de fen mian 。]

english: More info than I wanted, thanks!
translation: 比我想要的更多信息，谢谢！ [bi wo xiang yao de geng duo xin xi ， xie xie ！]

english: Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.
translation: 抱歉，不能停下来，如果船长发现我偷懒地跟偷渡者说话，我的胆子会被吊袜带的。 [bao qian ， bu neng ting xia lai ， ru guo chuan zhang fa xian wo tou lan di gen tou du zhe shuo hua ， wo de dan zi hui bei diao wa dai de 。]

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard!
translation: 我不是偷渡者！我被邀请上船了！ [wo bu shi tou du zhe ！ wo bei yao qing shang chuan le ！]

english: Yeah, whatever [guy/lady], it doesn't really matter who you are I'll get in trouble!
translation: 是的，无论[男人/女人]，无论你是谁，我都会遇到麻烦！ [shi de ， wu lun [ nan ren / nv ren ]， wu lun ni shi shui ， wo du hui yu dao ma fan ！]

english: You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.
translation: 你知道，我一直想知道海盗的生活究竟意味着什么。 [ni zhi dao ， wo yi zhi xiang zhi dao hai dao de sheng huo jiu jing yi wei zhe shen me 。]

english: Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.
translation: 嗯，目前主要涉及偷渡者随机询问问题。 [n ， mu qian zhu yao she ji tou du zhe sui ji xun wen wen ti 。]

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard! By Lokar! Ask him!
translation: 我不是偷渡者！我被邀请上船了！洛卡写的！问他吧！ [wo bu shi tou du zhe ！ wo bei yao qing shang chuan le ！ luo ka xie de ！ wen ta ba ！]

english: Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.
translation: 嘿，无论如何[爱人/朋友]。只要确保船长没有抓住你，海盗不太喜欢偷渡者。 [hei ， wu lun ru he [ ai ren / peng you ]。 zhi yao que bao chuan zhang mei you zhua zhu ni ， hai dao bu tai xi huan tou du zhe 。]

english: Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?
translation: 啊，祝你有美好的一天[milady/sirrah]！你的脸很陌生，你是不是和我们一起登上了月岛的船？ [a ， zhu ni you mei hao de yi tian [milady/sirrah]！ ni de lian hen mo sheng ， ni shi bu shi he wo men yi qi deng shang le yue dao de chuan ？]

english: No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.
translation: 不，洛卡实际上让我在雷莱卡搭车。 [bu ， luo ka shi ji shang rang wo zai lei lai ka da che 。]

english: Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!
translation: 哦真的吗？在我看来你不像弗雷曼尼克人！ [o zhen de ma ？ zai wo kan lai ni bu xiang fu lei man ni ke ren ！]

english: Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
translation: 嗯……我有点是，又有点不是。这是一个很长的故事。 [n …… wo you dian shi ， you you dian bu shi 。 zhe shi yi ge hen zhang de gu shi 。]

english: Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a- fremennik!
translation: 抱歉我没时间听！再见，年轻的弗莱曼尼克，他不是真正的弗莱曼尼克！ [bao qian wo mei shi jian ting ！ zai jian ， nian qing de fu lai man ni ke ， ta bu shi zhen zheng de fu lai man ni ke ！]

english: 'Bye.
translation: '再见。 [' zai jian 。]

english: Brrrr! Its cold up here!
translation: 呜呜！这里很冷！ [wu wu ！ zhe li hen leng ！]

english: You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!
translation: 你觉得这很冷吗？到了 Acheron 那里，天气变得非常寒冷，当你说话时，你会看到话语冻结在你面前的空气中！ [ni jue de zhe hen leng ma ？ dao le  Acheron  na li ， tian qi bian de fei chang han leng ， dang ni shuo hua shi ， ni hui kan dao hua yu dong jie zai ni mian qian de kong qi zhong ！]

english: REALLY?
translation: 真的吗？ [zhen de ma ？]

english: Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!
translation: 不，不是真的。我为了达到幽默效果而夸张了。不过天气非常非常冷！ [bu ， bu shi zhen de 。 wo wei le da dao you mo xiao guo er kua zhang le 。 bu guo tian qi fei chang fei chang leng ！]

english: Hello to you too.
translation: 也向你问好。 [ye xiang ni wen hao 。]

english: Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
translation: 呀！我们是海盗，耶！阿瓦斯特，你们这些坏血病的陆生荔枝！ [ya ！ wo men shi hai dao ， ye ！ a wa si te ， ni men zhe xie huai xue bing de lu sheng li zhi ！]

english: Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
translation: 请不要这样说话，这太令人恼火了。 [qing bu yao zhe yang shuo hua ， zhe tai ling ren nao huo le 。]

english: Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
translation: 另外，请不要叫我荔枝，不管那是什么。 [ling wai ， qing bu yao jiao wo li zhi ， bu guan na shi shen me 。]

english: Oh. Okay. Sorry.
translation: 哦。好的。对不起。 [o 。 hao de 。 dui bu qi 。]

english: No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
translation: 不！我不是偷渡者！诚实的！我被邀请来到这里！ [bu ！ wo bu shi tou du zhe ！ cheng shi de ！ wo bei yao qing lai dao zhe li ！]

english: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
translation: 哦，抱歉，那是我的错误。 [o ， bao qian ， na shi wo de cuo wu 。]

english: You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.
translation: 但你必须承认你看起来确实很像一个偷渡者。 [dan ni bi xu cheng ren ni kan qi lai que shi hen xiang yi ge tou du zhe 。]

english: Why, what do they usually look like?
translation: 为什么，他们通常是什么样子？ [wei shen me ， ta men tong chang shi shen me yang zi ？]

english: Erm... I've never actually met one...
translation: 呃……我从来没有真正见过一个…… [e …… wo cong lai mei you zhen zheng jian guo yi ge ……]

english: Okay then...
translation: 好吧，那么... [hao ba ， na me ...]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: So... You're a pirate, huh?
translation: 那么...你是海盗，是吧？ [na me ... ni shi hai dao ， shi ba ？]

english: It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.
translation: 月底我的工资单上就是这么写的。 [yue di wo de gong zi dan shang jiu shi zhe me xie de 。]

english: How's that working out for you?
translation: 你感觉怎么样？ [ni gan jue zen me yang ？]

english: Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.
translation: 到目前为止还不错。我们可以掠夺的所有烈酒和战利品，再加上包括牙科在内的全套医疗服务。 [dao mu qian wei zhi hai bu cuo 。 wo men ke yi lve duo de suo you lie jiu he zhan li pin ， zai jia shang bao kuo ya ke zai nei de quan tao yi liao fu wu 。]

english: You mean you have insurance?
translation: 你是说你有保险？ [ni shi shuo ni you bao xian ？]

english: Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.
translation: 不是这样的。如果我们中的任何一个人生病了，我们就会绑架一名医生，直到我们病情好转之前不让他走。 [bu shi zhe yang de 。 ru guo wo men zhong de ren he yi ge ren sheng bing le ， wo men jiu hui bang jia yi ming yi sheng ， zhi dao wo men bing qing hao zhuan zhi qian bu rang ta zou 。]

english: I can imagine.
translation: 我可以想象。 [wo ke yi xiang xiang 。]

english: Hello there. So what brings you aboard the Lady Zay?
translation: 你好呀。那么是什么让您登上了 Lady Zay 号呢？ [ni hao ya 。 na me shi shen me rang nin deng shang le  Lady Zay  hao ne ？]

english: Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.
translation: 嗯，我原本打算去拜访月族，但我不得不说你们的船非常令人印象深刻。 [n ， wo yuan ben da suan qu bai fang yue zu ， dan wo bu de bu shuo ni men de chuan fei chang ling ren yin xiang shen ke 。]

english: Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!
translation: 是的，她确实是我旅行中见过的最好的船之一！ [shi de ， ta que shi shi wo lv xing zhong jian guo de zui hao de chuan zhi yi ！]

english: That she is [lad/lass], that she is.
translation: 她是[小伙子/姑娘]，她就是。 [ta shi [ xiao huo zi / gu niang ]， ta jiu shi 。]

english: You seem to like playing with danger, there.
translation: 看来你很喜欢玩危险。 [kan lai ni hen xi huan wan wei xian 。]

english: They don't call me 'No-fingers' for nothing!

english: Well, correct me if I'm wrong, but you seem to have all your fingers.
translation: 好吧，如果我错了，请纠正我，但你似乎有所有的手指。 [hao ba ， ru guo wo cuo le ， qing jiu zheng wo ， dan ni si hu you suo you de shou zhi 。]

translation: 可能看起来是这样，伙计，但我想你会发现我没有。 [ke neng kan qi lai shi zhe yang ， huo ji ， dan wo xiang ni hui fa xian wo mei you 。]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: These not be fingers. These 'ere be wooden fingers.
translation: 这些不是手指。这些是木手指。 [zhe xie bu shi shou zhi 。 zhe xie shi mu shou zhi 。]

english: Wooden fingers?
translation: 木手指？ [mu shou zhi ？]

english: Yep.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: That's not possible, how could you move them?
translation: 这不可能，怎么能动呢？ [zhe bu ke neng ， zen me neng dong ne ？]

english: Magic wood.
translation: 魔法木。 [mo fa mu 。]

english: Yes, well I think I'd better be going now.
translation: 是的，我想我最好现在就走。 [shi de ， wo xiang wo zui hao xian zai jiu zou 。]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Don't suppose you've seen any boots around here? Size nine, steel toed, brown leather...
translation: 你不认为你在这里见过靴子吗？九号，钢头，棕色皮革...... [ni bu ren wei ni zai zhe li jian guo xue zi ma ？ jiu hao ， gang tou ， zong se pi ge ......]

english: Nope, not at all. I'd best be going. Have a nice day. Bye!
translation: 不，一点也不。我最好还是走吧祝你今天过得愉快。再见！ [bu ， yi dian ye bu 。 wo zui hao hai shi zou ba zhu ni jin tian guo de yu kuai 。 zai jian ！]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: So how's life as a pirate?
translation: 那么海贼的生活是怎样的呢？ [na me hai zei de sheng huo shi zen yang de ne ？]

english: What kind of question is that? How's life as a... I dunno. Whatever it is that you do for a living.

english: I'm a freelance troubleshooter.
translation: 我是一名自由疑难解答者。 [wo shi yi ming zi you yi nan jie da zhe 。]

english: What does that entail then?
translation: 那么这意味着什么呢？ [na me zhe yi wei zhe shen me ne ？]

english: Mostly killing things for money and delivering items around the planet for people.

english: I collect stuff.
translation: 我收集东西。 [wo shou ji dong xi 。]

english: So how's that life?
translation: 那么这样的生活怎么样呢？ [na me zhe yang de sheng huo zen me yang ne ？]

english: Can't complain, can't complain...

english: Well, there you go.

english: Aren't you a little short for a pirate?

english: My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.

english: More info than I wanted, thanks!
translation: 比我想要的更多信息，谢谢！ [bi wo xiang yao de geng duo xin xi ， xie xie ！]

english: Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard!
translation: 我不是偷渡者！我被邀请上船了！ [wo bu shi tou du zhe ！ wo bei yao qing shang chuan le ！]

english: Yeah, whatever [guy/lady], it doesn't really matter who you are I'll get in trouble!
translation: 是的，无论[男人/女人]，无论你是谁，我都会遇到麻烦！ [shi de ， wu lun [ nan ren / nv ren ]， wu lun ni shi shui ， wo du hui yu dao ma fan ！]

english: You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.
translation: 你知道，我一直想知道海盗的生活究竟意味着什么。 [ni zhi dao ， wo yi zhi xiang zhi dao hai dao de sheng huo jiu jing yi wei zhe shen me 。]

english: Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.

english: Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.
translation: 嘿，无论如何[爱人/朋友]。只要确保船长没有抓住你，海盗不太喜欢偷渡者。 [hei ， wu lun ru he [ ai ren / peng you ]。 zhi yao que bao chuan zhang mei you zhua zhu ni ， hai dao bu tai xi huan tou du zhe 。]

english: Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?

english: 'Bye.
translation: '再见。 [' zai jian 。]

english: REALLY?
translation: 真的吗？ [zhen de ma ？]

translation: 我的母亲是一个侏儒。显然这是一次非常痛苦的分娩。 [wo de mu qin shi yi ge zhu ru 。 xian ran zhe shi yi ci fei chang tong ku de fen mian 。]

english: More info than I wanted, thanks!
translation: 比我想要的更多信息，谢谢！ [bi wo xiang yao de geng duo xin xi ， xie xie ！]

english: Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.

translation: 我不是偷渡者！我被邀请上船了！ [wo bu shi tou du zhe ！ wo bei yao qing shang chuan le ！]

english: Yeah, whatever [guy/lady], it doesn't really matter who you are I'll get in trouble!
translation: 是的，无论[男人/女人]，无论你是谁，我都会遇到麻烦！ [shi de ， wu lun [ nan ren / nv ren ]， wu lun ni shi shui ， wo du hui yu dao ma fan ！]

english: You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.

english: Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.
translation: 嗯，目前主要涉及偷渡者随机询问问题。 [n ， mu qian zhu yao she ji tou du zhe sui ji xun wen wen ti 。]

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard! By Lokar! Ask him!

english: Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.
translation: 嘿，无论如何[爱人/朋友]。只要确保船长没有抓住你，海盗不太喜欢偷渡者。 [hei ， wu lun ru he [ ai ren / peng you ]。 zhi yao que bao chuan zhang mei you zhua zhu ni ， hai dao bu tai xi huan tou du zhe 。]

english: Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?

english: Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!

english: Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.

english: Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a-fremennik!

english: Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.
translation: 到目前为止还不错。我们可以掠夺的所有烈酒和战利品，再加上包括牙科在内的全套医疗服务。 [dao mu qian wei zhi hai bu cuo 。 wo men ke yi lve duo de suo you lie jiu he zhan li pin ， zai jia shang bao kuo ya ke zai nei de quan tao yi liao fu wu 。]

english: You mean you have insurance?
translation: 你是说你有保险？ [ni shi shuo ni you bao xian ？]

english: Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.
translation: 不是这样的。如果我们中的任何一个人生病了，我们就会绑架一名医生，直到我们病情好转之前不让他走。 [bu shi zhe yang de 。 ru guo wo men zhong de ren he yi ge ren sheng bing le ， wo men jiu hui bang jia yi ming yi sheng ， zhi dao wo men bing qing hao zhuan zhi qian bu rang ta zou 。]

english: You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.
translation: 您会惊讶地发现，这对于专家医疗保健来说是多么大的激励。 [nin hui jing ya di fa xian ， zhe dui yu zhuan jia yi liao bao jian lai shuo shi duo me da de ji li 。]

english: I can imagine.

english: Hello there. So what brings you aboard the Lady Zay?
translation: 你好呀。那么是什么让您登上了 Lady Zay 号呢？ [ni hao ya 。 na me shi shen me rang nin deng shang le  Lady Zay  hao ne ？]

english: Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.
translation: 嗯，我原本打算去拜访月族，但我不得不说你们的船非常令人印象深刻。 [n ， wo yuan ben da suan qu bai fang yue zu ， dan wo bu de bu shuo ni men de chuan fei chang ling ren yin xiang shen ke 。]

english: Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!
translation: 是啊，果然是个美女啊！扎伊女士酒店一直是我的家，度过了许多艰难的几个月，经历了暴风雨和阳光，她总是带我们到达我们要去的地方！ [shi a ， guo ran shi ge mei nv a ！ zha yi nv shi jiu dian yi zhi shi wo de jia ， du guo le xu duo jian nan de ji ge yue ， jing li le bao feng yu he yang guang ， ta zong shi dai wo men dao da wo men yao qu de di fang ！]

english: Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!
translation: 是的，她确实是我旅行中见过的最好的船之一！ [shi de ， ta que shi shi wo lv xing zhong jian guo de zui hao de chuan zhi yi ！]

translation: 嗯！是的，伙计...argghh...这是...umpf...辛苦工作... [n ！ shi de ， huo ji ...argghh... zhe shi ...umpf... xin ku gong zuo ...]

translation: 停止！停止！哼……我会打败你……呃……一坨肉！ [ting zhi ！ ting zhi ！ heng …… wo hui da bai ni …… e …… yi tuo rou ！]

english: Okay, okay! Don't cry!
translation: 好吧好吧！别哭！ [hao ba hao ba ！ bie ku ！]

english: Why, I oughta...

translation: 当你不把木头举过头顶时你会做什么？ [dang ni bu ba mu tou ju guo tou ding shi ni hui zuo shen me ？]

english: In my free time?
translation: 在我的空闲时间？ [zai wo de kong xian shi jian ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: All sorts. I like...hummff...a good kebab and a cold beer down...urrghh...the pub. And for those quiet evenings...hurrr...
translation: 各种各样。我喜欢...嗯...一个美味的烤肉串和一杯冰镇啤酒...呃呃...酒吧。对于那些安静的夜晚...呃... [ge zhong ge yang 。 wo xi huan ... n ... yi ge mei wei de kao rou chuan he yi bei bing zhen pi jiu ... e e ... jiu ba 。 dui yu na xie an jing de ye wan ... e ...]

english: A bit of needlepoint is always welcome.
translation: 一点针线总是受欢迎的。 [yi dian zhen xian zong shi shou huan ying de 。]

english: I can honestly say you're a very original guy.
translation: 我可以诚实地说你是一个非常有创意的人。 [wo ke yi cheng shi di shuo ni shi yi ge fei chang you chuang yi de ren 。]

english: Ah, this be the Tower of Life! Beautiful, isn't it?
translation: 啊，这就是生命之塔！很漂亮，不是吗？ [a ， zhe jiu shi sheng ming zhi ta ！ hen piao liang ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Welcome to the Emir's Arena! Are you interested in 1v1 Tournaments? We organise ranked Tournaments here, or alternatively you can organise your own unranked Tournaments.
translation: 欢迎来到埃米尔竞技场！您对 1v1 锦标赛感兴趣吗？我们在这里组织排名锦标赛，或者您也可以组织自己的非排名锦标赛。 [huan ying lai dao ai mi er jing ji chang ！ nin dui  1v1  jin biao sai gan xing qu ma ？ wo men zai zhe li zu zhi pai ming jin biao sai ， huo zhe nin ye ke yi zu zhi zi ji de fei pai ming jin biao sai 。]

english: What's a 1v1 Tournament?
translation: 什么是 1v1 锦标赛？ [shen me shi  1v1  jin biao sai ？]

english: A group of fighters is divided into pairs of opponents, and they all fight their opponent. The winners of those fights proceed to the next round, where they're divided into pairs, and they each fight their new opponent.
translation: 一群战士被分成两对对手，他们都与对手进行战斗。这些比赛的获胜者进入下一轮，他们被分成两人一组，每人与他们的新对手战斗。 [yi qun zhan shi bei fen cheng liang dui dui shou ， ta men dou yu dui shou jin xing zhan dou 。 zhe xie bi sai de huo sheng zhe jin ru xia yi lun ， ta men bei fen cheng liang ren yi zu ， mei ren yu ta men de xin dui shou zhan dou 。]

english: The number of surviving fighters is halved each time, until eventually only one person is left standing. They're the winner of the Tournament.
translation: 每次幸存的战士数量都会减少一半，直到最后只剩下一个人。他们是锦标赛的获胜者。 [mei ci xing cun de zhan shi shu liang du hui jian shao yi ban ， zhi dao zui hou zhi sheng xia yi ge ren 。 ta men shi jin biao sai de huo sheng zhe 。]

english: Ranked or unranked? What does that mean?
translation: 有排名还是无排名？这意味着什么？ [you pai ming hai shi wu pai ming ？ zhe yi wei zhe shen me ？]

english: Everyone has a rank. It's meant to indicate how good they are at fighting, compared to other people.
translation: 每个人都有一个等级。这是为了表明与其他人相比，他们的战斗能力如何。 [mei ge ren dou you yi ge deng ji 。 zhe shi wei le biao ming yu qi ta ren xiang bi ， ta men de zhan dou neng li ru he 。]

english: In ranked fights, the winners gain rank and the losers lose rank. The Arena staff will decide who'll be fighting in each ranked Tournament, and send the invitations.
translation: 在排名战中，胜利者获得排名，失败者失去排名。竞技场工作人员将决定谁将参加每场排名赛，并发送邀请。 [zai pai ming zhan zhong ， sheng li zhe huo de pai ming ， shi bai zhe shi qu pai ming 。 jing ji chang gong zuo ren yuan jiang jue ding shui jiang can jia mei chang pai ming sai ， bing fa song yao qing 。]

english: But if you just want some casual fun, you can have an unranked Tournament, where no-one gains or loses rank. You can organise your own unranked Tournament, and decide for yourself who'll fight in it.
translation: 但如果您只是想要一些休闲乐趣，您可以举办一场不排名的锦标赛，没有人获得或失去排名。您可以组织自己的非排名锦标赛，并自行决定谁将参加比赛。 [dan ru guo nin zhi shi xiang yao yi xie xiu xian le qu ， nin ke yi ju ban yi chang bu pai ming de jin biao sai ， mei you ren huo de huo shi qu pai ming 。 nin ke yi zu zhi zi ji de fei pai ming jin biao sai ， bing zi xing jue ding shui jiang can jia bi sai 。]

english: Only the ranked fights offer access to the other rewards of the Arena.
translation: 只有排名战斗才能获得竞技场的其他奖励。 [zhi you pai ming zhan dou cai neng huo de jing ji chang de qi ta jiang li 。]

english: How do I get invited into a Tournament?
translation: 我如何获得邀请参加锦标赛？ [wo ru he huo de yao qing can jia jin biao sai ？]

english: You'll need to sign up to a recruitment group...
translation: 您需要注册加入招聘小组... [nin xu yao zhu ce jia ru zhao pin xiao zu ...]

english: You can carry on with your adventures while you're waiting for a Tournament to begin, since it may be a while before suitable fighters are available.
translation: 在等待锦标赛开始的同时，您可以继续冒险，因为可能需要一段时间才能找到合适的战士。 [zai deng dai jin biao sai kai shi de tong shi ， nin ke yi ji xu mao xian ， yin wei ke neng xu yao yi duan shi jian cai neng zhao dao he shi de zhan shi 。]

english: I want to organise my own Tournament.
translation: 我想组织自己的锦标赛。 [wo xiang zu zhi zi ji de jin biao sai 。]

english: Just use my Recruitment Board here to form your own recruitment group. Once you've got one, wait for other fighters to join it.
translation: 只需使用我的招聘委员会来组建您自己的招聘小组即可。一旦你拥有了一个，等待其他战士加入。 [zhi xu shi yong wo de zhao pin wei yuan hui lai zu jian nin zi ji de zhao pin xiao zu ji ke 。 yi dan ni yong you le yi ge ， deng dai qi ta zhan shi jia ru 。]

translation: 那不是弯刀。 [na bu shi wan dao 。]

english: I think it's a twig.
translation: 我认为这是一根树枝。 [wo ren wei zhe shi yi gen shu zhi 。]

english: Ye cheeky begger! I was wavin' my finger at ye!
translation: 你这个无耻的乞丐！我正在向你们挥动手指！ [ni zhe ge wu chi de qi gai ！ wo zheng zai xiang ni men hui dong shou zhi ！]

english: All right...
translation: 好的... [hao de ...]

english: Arrr... just 'cos me body happens to be 50% wood does not mean I'm heartless.
translation: 呃……虽然我的身体恰好有 50% 是木头，但这并不意味着我是无情的。 [e …… sui ran wo de shen ti qia hao you  50%  shi mu tou ， dan zhe bing bu yi wei zhe wo shi wu qing de 。]

english: I got a bag of 'em here. Wanna see?
translation: 我这里有一袋。想看吗？ [wo zhe li you yi dai 。 xiang kan ma ？]

english: I think I'll pass.
translation: 我想我会通过的。 [wo xiang wo hui tong guo de 。]

english: What happened to you?
translation: 你怎么了？ [ni zen me le ？]

english: That be a tale so heart-wrenchin' that it has so far wrenched the hearts from over a dozen sturdier men than thee!
translation: 这是一个如此令人心痛的故事，迄今为止它已经让十几个比你更坚强的人心碎了！ [zhe shi yi ge ru ci ling ren xin tong de gu shi ， qi jin wei zhi ta yi jing rang shi ji ge bi ni geng jian qiang de ren xin sui le ！]

english: A tale of such woe that none but the stoniest hearts can hear it without sheddin' a single, poignant tear...
translation: 这是一个如此悲惨的故事，除了最铁石心肠的人之外，没有人听到它而不流下一滴辛酸的眼泪…… [zhe shi yi ge ru ci bei can de gu shi ， chu le zui tie shi xin chang de ren zhi wai ， mei you ren ting dao ta er bu liu xia yi di xin suan de yan lei ……]

english: And I'll never tell ye, not even if ye wore an item, such as a ring, with powers of mind control!
translation: 我永远不会告诉你，即使你戴着一件具有精神控制能力的物品，比如戒指！ [wo yong yuan bu hui gao su ni ， ji shi ni dai zhe yi jian ju you jing shen kong zhi neng li de wu pin ， bi ru jie zhi ！]

english: What if I said please?
translation: 如果我说请怎么办？ [ru guo wo shuo qing zen me ban ？]

english: Hmmmm...well alright...
translation: 嗯嗯……好吧好吧…… [n n …… hao ba hao ba ……]

english: Wait, no!
translation: 等等，不！ [deng deng ， bu ！]

english: Get goin' landlubber before I take my splintery foot to yer behind!
translation: 在我把我那支破烂的脚拖到你身后之前，快去旱鸭子吧！ [zai wo ba wo na zhi po lan de jiao tuo dao ni shen hou zhi qian ， kuai qu han ya zi ba ！]

english: Well ye seem like a [lad/lass] that can handle such a tale...so I'll tell ye...
translation: 好吧，你们看起来像一个可以处理这样的故事的[小伙子/姑娘]……所以我会告诉你们…… [hao ba ， ni men kan qi lai xiang yi ge ke yi chu li zhe yang de gu shi de [ xiao huo zi / gu niang ]…… suo yi wo hui gao su ni men ……]

english: Well, it all starts with this albatross...
translation: 好吧，这一切都要从这只信天翁开始…… [hao ba ， zhe yi qie dou yao cong zhe zhi xin tian weng kai shi ……]

english: Wait, never mind, I'll skip forward a bit.
translation: 等等，没关系，我会向前跳一点。 [deng deng ， mei guan xi ， wo hui xiang qian tiao yi dian 。]

english: Are you sure?
translation: 你确定吗？ [ni que ding ma ？]

english: I have to [lad/lass], Cap'n Donnie will flay what little is left of me if I told ye.
translation: 我必须[小伙子/姑娘]，如果我告诉你们，唐尼船长就会剥掉我仅存的一点皮。 [wo bi xu [ xiao huo zi / gu niang ]， ru guo wo gao su ni men ， tang ni chuan zhang jiu hui bo diao wo jin cun de yi dian pi 。]

english: But anyway, I got recruited to the zombie pirates along with the rest of the crew in an unspecified incident involvin this albatross.
translation: 但无论如何，我和其他船员一起在一次涉及这只信天翁的不明事件中被招募到僵尸海盗中。 [dan wu lun ru he ， wo he qi ta chuan yuan yi qi zai yi ci she ji zhe zhi xin tian weng de bu ming shi jian zhong bei zhao mu dao jiang shi hai dao zhong 。]

english: We was sailin' along happily, and I was partakin' of a little 'rum' in the crows nest.
translation: 我们愉快地航行，我在乌鸦巢里喝了一点“朗姆酒”。 [wo men yu kuai di hang xing ， wo zai wu ya chao li he le yi dian “ lang mu jiu ”。]

english: Well, we hit either a really rough wave or some rocks.
translation: 好吧，我们要么遇到了非常汹涌的波浪，要么遇到了一些岩石。 [hao ba ， wo men yao me yu dao le fei chang xiong yong de bo lang ， yao me yu dao le yi xie yan shi 。]

english: Twas kind of hard for me to tell which, as I was well out of it by then!
translation: 我很难判断是哪一个，因为那时我已经摆脱了它！ [wo hen nan pan duan shi na yi ge ， yin wei na shi wo yi jing bai tuo le ta ！]

english: Regardless I toppled from the crows nest into the water.
translation: 不管怎样，我从乌鸦巢里掉进了水里。 [bu guan zen yang ， wo cong wu ya chao li diao jin le shui li 。]

english: Is that how you got so badly injured?
translation: 难道你就这么受了这么重的伤吗？ [nan dao ni jiu zhe me shou le zhe me zhong de shang ma ？]

english: No [lad/lass]!
translation: 不[小伙子/姑娘]！ [bu [ xiao huo zi / gu niang ]！]

english: What happened next was that I discovered a new, previously uncharted reef of hard, spiky coral.
translation: 接下来发生的事情是我发现了一个新的、以前未知的硬质尖刺珊瑚礁。 [jie xia lai fa sheng de shi qing shi wo fa xian le yi ge xin de 、 yi qian wei zhi de ying zhi jian ci shan hu jiao 。]

english: I made a mental note of its location, and to this day it is still marked on our fleet's charts as Lukes Reef.
translation: 我在心里记下了它的位置，直到今天，它仍然在我们舰队的海图上标记为卢克斯礁。 [wo zai xin li ji xia le ta de wei zhi ， zhi dao jin tian ， ta reng ran zai wo men jian dui de hai tu shang biao ji wei lu ke si jiao 。]

english: I managed to grab a hold of our ship, the Inebriated, as it passed overhead.
translation: 当我们的船“醉酒号”从头顶掠过时，我设法抓住了它。 [dang wo men de chuan “ zui jiu hao ” cong tou ding lve guo shi ， wo she fa zhua zhu le ta 。]

english: And then I discovered another, taller, spikier reef of even sharper and more painful coral.
translation: 然后我发现了另一个更高、更尖的珊瑚礁，里面有更锋利、更痛苦的珊瑚。 [ran hou wo fa xian le ling yi ge geng gao 、 geng jian de shan hu jiao ， li mian you geng feng li 、 geng tong ku de shan hu 。]

english: To this day it is still marked on our fleet's charts as The Other 50% Reef.
translation: 直到今天，它仍然在我们船队的图表上标记为“其他 50% 的珊瑚礁”。 [zhi dao jin tian ， ta reng ran zai wo men chuan dui de tu biao shang biao ji wei “ qi ta  50%  de shan hu jiao ”。]

english: Owwwwwwwww...
translation: 呜呜呜…… [wu wu wu ……]

english: It gets worse...
translation: 情况变得更糟... [qing kuang bian de geng zao ...]

english: When they hauled what was left of me on deck, they dropped me onto the floor while they decided what to do with me.
translation: 当他们把我剩下的东西拖到甲板上时，他们把我扔到地板上，同时决定如何处理我。 [dang ta men ba wo sheng xia de dong xi tuo dao jia ban shang shi ， ta men ba wo reng dao di ban shang ， tong shi jue ding ru he chu li wo 。]

english: Bear in mind this would be on a ghost ship, the planks of which sweat a thick mixture of stagnant water...and pure salt crystals.
translation: 请记住，这将是在一艘幽灵船上，船上的木板流淌着浓稠的死水……和纯盐晶体的混合物。 [qing ji zhu ， zhe jiang shi zai yi sou you ling chuan shang ， chuan shang de mu ban liu tang zhe nong chou de si shui …… he chun yan jing ti de hun he wu 。]

english: Oh...my...god...
translation: 我的天啊... [wo de tian a ...]

english: But on the good side, all my thrashin' and pained squealin' settled the matter in the Captain's mind, and he had the shipwright carve me half a body out of his Witchwood Planks.
translation: 但好的一面是，我所有的殴打和痛苦的尖叫在船长的脑海中解决了这个问题，他让造船匠用他的巫林木板雕刻了我的半个身体。 [dan hao de yi mian shi ， wo suo you de ou da he tong ku de jian jiao zai chuan zhang de nao hai zhong jie jue le zhe ge wen ti ， ta rang zao chuan jiang yong ta de wu lin mu ban diao ke le wo de ban ge shen ti 。]

english: Witchwood? What's that?
translation: 巫林？那是什么？ [wu lin ？ na shi shen me ？]

english: Tis a special, magical wood from a now extinct tree.
translation: 这是一种来自现已灭绝的树的特殊而神奇的木材。 [zhe shi yi zhong lai zi xian yi mie jue de shu de te shu er shen qi de mu cai 。]

english: Once they nailed it all in place the stuff moves like it is part of me body.
translation: 一旦他们把它们全部固定到位，这些东西就会移动，就像它是我身体的一部分一样。 [yi dan ta men ba ta men quan bu gu ding dao wei ， zhe xie dong xi jiu hui yi dong ， jiu xiang ta shi wo shen ti de yi bu fen yi yang 。]

english: The stuff will also grow back if it breaks, which is dead handy!
translation: 如果东西坏了，它也会重新长出来，这非常方便！ [ru guo dong xi huai le ， ta ye hui chong xin zhang chu lai ， zhe fei chang fang bian ！]

english: Wow, that stuff must be very valuable!
translation: 哇，那东西一定很值钱吧！ [wa ， na dong xi yi ding hen zhi qian ba ！]

english: Arr! That it be!
translation: 啊！就这样吧！ [a ！ jiu zhe yang ba ！]

english: So, that be the tale of how I managed to lose precisely 50% of my body.
translation: 这就是我如何成功失去身体 50% 的故事。 [zhe jiu shi wo ru he cheng gong shi qu shen ti  50%  de gu shi 。]

english: There there.
translation: 那里那里。 [na li na li 。]

english: So how flammable are you?
translation: 那么你有多易燃呢？ [na me ni you duo yi ran ne ？]

english: What kind of a question is that?
translation: 这是一个什么样的问题？ [zhe shi yi ge shen me yang de wen ti ？]

english: A rather rude, personal one?
translation: 一个相当粗鲁的、私人的？ [yi ge xiang dang cu lu de 、 si ren de ？]

english: Ye've got that right!
translation: 你说得对！ [ni shuo de dui ！]

english: I'll soon have you out of the way! Burn!
translation: 我很快就会让你离开！烧伤！ [wo hen kuai jiu hui rang ni li kai ！ shao shang ！]

english: Don't make me angry! Ye'll not like me when I'm angry!
translation: 别惹我生气！我生气的时候你们就不会喜欢我了！ [bie re wo sheng qi ！ wo sheng qi de shi hou ni men jiu bu hui xi huan wo le ！]

english: Let that be a lesson to ye!
translation: 让这成为你们的一个教训吧！ [rang zhe cheng wei ni men de yi ge jiao xun ba ！]

english: My world is an ocean of paaaain!
translation: 我的世界是一片痛苦的海洋！ [wo de shi jie shi yi pian tong ku de hai yang ！]

english: So what is going on here anyway?
translation: 那么这里究竟发生了什么？ [na me zhe li jiu jing fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: Ye expect me to talk?
translation: 你们期待我说话吗？ [ni men qi dai wo shuo hua ma ？]

english: No Mr. Luke, I expect you to die!
translation: 不，卢克先生，我希望你去死！ [bu ， lu ke xian sheng ， wo xi wang ni qu si ！]

english: Hah! I'm one step ahead of ye!
translation: 哈！我比你们领先一步！ [ha ！ wo bi ni men ling xian yi bu ！]

english: Egad, outsmarted by the man with the wooden brain.
translation: 埃加德，被那个木头人智胜了。 [ai jia de ， bei na ge mu tou ren zhi sheng le 。]

english: But seriously, what is going on here?
translation: 但说真的，这里发生了什么？ [dan shuo zhen de ， zhe li fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: I can't tell ye [lad/lass].
translation: 我不能告诉你们[小伙子/姑娘]。 [wo bu neng gao su ni men [ xiao huo zi / gu niang ]。]

english: The Cap'n would have me whittled down to toothpicks if I did.
translation: 如果我这样做的话，船长会把我削成牙签。 [ru guo wo zhe yang zuo de hua ， chuan zhang hui ba wo xue cheng ya qian 。]

english: Well if you can't tell me, perhaps you could show me through the medium of Interpretive Dance?
translation: 好吧，如果你不能告诉我，也许你可以通过诠释舞蹈的媒介向我展示？ [hao ba ， ru guo ni bu neng gao su wo ， ye xu ni ke yi tong guo quan shi wu dao de mei jie xiang wo zhan shi ？]

english: No. Just...no.
translation: 不，只是……不。 [bu ， zhi shi …… bu 。]

english: Mime?
translation: 哑剧？ [ya ju ？]

english: Look, [lad/lass] I'm not tellin' ye a thing! So clear out while ye still can!
translation: 听着，[小伙子/姑娘]我什么也没告诉你们！趁你们还可以，赶紧清除吧！ [ting zhe ，[ xiao huo zi / gu niang ] wo shen me ye mei gao su ni men ！ chen ni men hai ke yi ， gan jin qing chu ba ！]

english: Arr! Tryin' ter get away eh? Well ye'll never sneak past me, I'm the best lookout this crew has ever seen!
translation: 啊！试着逃跑吧？好吧，你们永远不会偷偷溜过我身边，我是这支队伍见过的最好的了望者！ [a ！ shi zhe tao pao ba ？ hao ba ， ni men yong yuan bu hui tou tou liu guo wo shen bian ， wo shi zhe zhi dui wu jian guo de zui hao de le wang zhe ！]

english: Who's that making faces behind you?
translation: 在你身后做鬼脸的是谁？ [zai ni shen hou zuo gui lian de shi shui ？]

english: That is the most amazing thing I have ever seen!
translation: 这是我见过的最奇妙的事情！ [zhe shi wo jian guo de zui qi miao de shi qing ！]

english: Is that your distraction?
translation: 这是你的分心吗？ [zhe shi ni de fen xin ma ？]

english: Who is that behind you?
translation: 你身后那个人是谁？ [ni shen hou na ge ren shi shui ？]

english: Hey you! Look over there!
translation: 嘿，你！看看那边！ [hei ， ni ！ kan kan na bian ！]

english: Oh my! Is that a genuine 3rd Age Diversion?
translation: 天啊！这是真正的第三纪元游戏吗？ [tian a ！ zhe shi zhen zheng de di san ji yuan you xi ma ？]

english: Where?
translation: 在哪里？ [zai na li ？]

english: Hey! What are you doing out there?
translation: 嘿！你在外面做什么？ [hei ！ ni zai wai mian zuo shen me ？]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: Well Cap'n Donnie said no livin' landlubbers were allowed out of the compound.
translation: 嗯，唐尼船长说过，活生生的旱鸭子不准走出院落。 [n ， tang ni chuan zhang shuo guo ， huo sheng sheng de han ya zi bu zhun zou chu yuan luo 。]

english: So get yerself back in here, or yer for it!
translation: 所以，让你自己回到这里，否则你就得死！ [suo yi ， rang ni zi ji hui dao zhe li ， fou ze ni jiu de si ！]

english: What happened to you?
translation: 你怎么了？ [ni zen me le ？]

english: How flammable are you?
translation: 你有多易燃？ [ni you duo yi ran ？]

english: So what is going on here anyway?
translation: 那么这里究竟发生了什么？ [na me zhe li jiu jing fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: Hi!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Hi. How can I help?
translation: 你好。我能提供什么帮助吗？ [ni hao 。 wo neng ti gong shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: Can you heal me?
translation: 你能治愈我吗？ [ni neng zhi yu wo ma ？]

english: Sorry, I'm not on duty.
translation: 抱歉，我没有值班。 [bao qian ， wo mei you zhi ban 。]

english: PLEASE DON'T KILL ME!
translation: 请不要杀我！ [qing bu yao sha wo ！]

english: I was... looking to be healed.
translation: 我……希望得到治愈。 [wo …… xi wang de dao zhi yu 。]

english: No way, I'm out of here just as soon as I've packed up my stuff!
translation: 没办法，我收拾好东西就走了！ [mei ban fa ， wo shou shi hao dong xi jiu zou le ！]

english: You look healthy to me!
translation: 在我看来你很健康！ [zai wo kan lai ni hen jian kang ！]

english: Of course!
translation: 当然！ [dang ran ！]

english: Do you see a lot of injured fighters?
translation: 你看到很多受伤的战士吗？ [ni kan dao hen duo shou shang de zhan shi ma ？]

english: Yes I do. Thankfully we can cope with almost anything. Jaraah really is a wonderful surgeon, his methods are a little unorthodox but he gets the job done.
translation: 是的，我愿意。值得庆幸的是，我们几乎可以应对任何事情。 Jaraah 确实是一位出色的外科医生，他的方法有点非正统，但他完成了工作。 [shi de ， wo yuan yi 。 zhi de qing xing de shi ， wo men ji hu ke yi ying dui ren he shi qing 。 Jaraah  que shi shi yi wei chu se de wai ke yi sheng ， ta de fang fa you dian fei zheng tong ， dan ta wan cheng le gong zuo 。]

english: I shouldn't tell you this but his nickname is 'The Butcher'.
translation: 我不应该告诉你这个，但他的绰号是“屠夫”。 [wo bu ying gai gao su ni zhe ge ， dan ta de chuo hao shi “ tu fu ”。]

english: That's reassuring.
translation: 这让人放心。 [zhe rang ren fang xin 。]

english: Do you come here often?
translation: 你经常来这里吗？ [ni jing chang lai zhe li ma ？]

english: I work here, so yes!
translation: 我在这里工作，所以是的！ [wo zai zhe li gong zuo ， suo yi shi de ！]

english: You're silly!
translation: 你真傻！ [ni zhen sha ！]

english: Can you heal me?
translation: 你能治愈我吗？ [ni neng zhi yu wo ma ？]

english: Do you see a lot of injured fighters?
translation: 你看到很多受伤的战士吗？ [ni kan dao hen duo shou shang de zhan shi ma ？]

english: Do you come here often?
translation: 你经常来这里吗？ [ni jing chang lai zhe li ma ？]

english: Greetings traveller.
translation: 问候旅行者。 [wen hou lv xing zhe 。]

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
translation: 你能治愈我吗？我受伤了。 [ni neng zhi yu wo ma ？ wo shou shang le 。]

english: Ok.
translation: 好的。 [hao de 。]

english: Abbot Langley places his hands on your head. You feel a little better.
translation: 兰利方丈将双手放在你的头上。你感觉好一点了。 [lan li fang zhang jiang shuang shou fang zai ni de tou shang 。 ni gan jue hao yi dian le 。]

english: Isn't this place built a bit out of the way?
translation: 这个地方是不是建得有点偏僻？ [zhe ge di fang shi bu shi jian de you dian pian pi ？]

english: We like it that way actually! We get disturbed less. We still get rather a large amount of travellers looking for sanctuary and healing here as it is!
translation: 我们实际上喜欢这样！我们受到的干扰更少。我们仍然有相当多的游客在这里寻求庇护和疗愈！ [wo men shi ji shang xi huan zhe yang ！ wo men shou dao de gan rao geng shao 。 wo men reng ran you xiang dang duo de you ke zai zhe li xun qiu bi hu he liao yu ！]

english: How do I get further into the monastery?
translation: 怎样才能进一步进入修道院呢？ [zen yang cai neng jin yi bu jin ru xiu dao yuan ne ？]

english: I'm sorry but only members of our order are allowed in the second level of the monastery.
translation: 抱歉，只有我们修会的成员才可以进入修道院的第二层。 [bao qian ， zhi you wo men xiu hui de cheng yuan cai ke yi jin ru xiu dao yuan de di er ceng 。]

english: Well can I join your order?
translation: 那么我可以加入你们的订单吗？ [na me wo ke yi jia ru ni men de ding dan ma ？]

english: No. I am sorry, but I feel you are not devout enough.
translation: 不，对不起，我觉得你不够虔诚。 [bu ， dui bu qi ， wo jue de ni bu gou qian cheng 。]

english: You need a prayer level of 31 to join the order.
translation: 您的祈祷等级需要达到 31 级才能加入该命令。 [nin de qi dao deng ji xu yao da dao  31  ji cai neng jia ru gai ming ling 。]

english: Ok, I see you are someone suitable for our order. You may join.
translation: 好的，我发现你是适合我们订单的人。你可以加入。 [hao de ， wo fa xian ni shi shi he wo men ding dan de ren 。 ni ke yi jia ru 。]

english: Oh, sorry.
translation: 哦，抱歉。 [o ， bao qian 。]

english: I might be able to... What did you have in mind?
translation: 我也许可以... 你有什么想法？ [wo ye xu ke yi ...  ni you shen me xiang fa ？]

english: Can you remove the sigils from my spirit shields?
translation: 你能把我的精神护盾上的印记去掉吗？ [ni neng ba wo de jing shen hu dun shang de yin ji qu diao ma ？]

english: I think I shoud be able to manage that. However in doing so, I'm afraid I'll have to destroy the blessed shield itself. You'll only get the sigil back.
translation: 我想我应该能够做到这一点。然而这样做的话，我恐怕就得毁掉祝福之盾本身了。你只会拿回印记。 [wo xiang wo ying gai neng gou zuo dao zhe yi dian 。 ran er zhe yang zuo de hua ， wo kong pa jiu de hui diao zhu fu zhi dun ben shen le 。 ni zhi hui na hui yin ji 。]

english: I can go ahead and break down all of the shields in your inventory now if you'd like?.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，我现在可以继续分解你库存中的所有护盾？ [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo xian zai ke yi ji xu fen jie ni ku cun zhong de suo you hu dun ？]

english: Not right now.
translation: 现在不行。 [xian zai bu xing 。]

english: Only members of our order can go up there.
translation: 只有我们教团的成员才能上去。 [zhi you wo men jiao tuan de cheng yuan cai neng shang qu 。]

english: Oh, sorry.
translation: 哦，抱歉。 [o ， bao qian 。]

english: Ah, I was told to expect you, please take this as thanks!
translation: 啊，听说要等你，就当是谢谢吧！ [a ， ting shuo yao deng ni ， jiu dang shi xie xie ba ！]

english: Congratulations, traveller!
translation: 恭喜你，旅行者！ [gong xi ni ， lv xing zhe ！]

english: Hey, I have something for you but you don't have any space for it!
translation: 嘿，我有东西给你，但你没有地方放！ [hei ， wo you dong xi gei ni ， dan ni mei you di fang fang ！]

english: Here you go.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.
translation: 你会收到线索卷轴的撕破部分。 [ni hui shou dao xian suo juan zhou de si po bu fen 。]

english: I must say, I despise the equipment you have chosen to wear.
translation: 我必须说，我鄙视你选择佩戴的装备。 [wo bi xu shuo ， wo bi shi ni xuan ze pei dai de zhuang bei 。]

english: I've got a message for you from your friend in Draynor Village.
translation: 我收到了你在德雷诺村的朋友给你的消息。 [wo shou dao le ni zai de lei nuo cun de peng you gei ni de xiao xi 。]

english: Gosh, you are very kind to bring a message to my remote monastery!
translation: 天哪，你真是太好了，给我偏远的修道院带来了消息！ [tian na ， ni zhen shi tai hao le ， gei wo pian yuan de xiu dao yuan dai lai le xiao xi ！]

english: I'd give you a reward, but you don't seem to have any space for it. Come back when you do.
translation: 我想给你奖励，但你似乎没有任何空间。当你回来的时候就回来吧。 [wo xiang gei ni jiang li ， dan ni si hu mei you ren he kong jian 。 dang ni hui lai de shi hou jiu hui lai ba 。]

english: I grow a few herbs in my little cabbage patch; please take some as a sign of my gratitude.
translation: 我在我的小卷心菜地里种了一些草药；请收一些作为我的谢意。 [wo zai wo de xiao juan xin cai di li zhong le yi xie cao yao ； qing shou yi xie zuo wei wo de xie yi 。]

english: Allow me to bestow on you Saradomin's blessings...
translation: 请允许我给予你萨拉多明的祝福...... [qing yun xu wo ji yu ni sa la duo ming de zhu fu ......]

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
translation: 你能治愈我吗？我受伤了。 [ni neng zhi yu wo ma ？ wo shou shang le 。]

english: Isn't this place built a bit out of the way?
translation: 这个地方是不是建得有点偏僻？ [zhe ge di fang shi bu shi jian de you dian pian pi ？]

english: How do I get further into the monastery?
translation: 怎样才能进一步进入修道院呢？ [zen yang cai neng jin yi bu jin ru xiu dao yuan ne ？]

english: Well can I join your order?
translation: 那么我可以加入你们的订单吗？ [na me wo ke yi jia ru ni men de ding dan ma ？]

english: Can you help with spirit shields?
translation: 你能帮忙做精神盾吗？ [ni neng bang mang zuo jing shen dun ma ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Herbs
translation: 香草 [xiang cao]

english: Coins
translation: 硬币 [ying bi]

english: Runes
translation: 符文 [fu wen]

english: Seeds
translation: 种子 [zhong zi]

english: Prayer experience
translation: 祷告经历 [dao gao jing li]

english: Grr ... Get out of my way...
translation: 呃……别挡我的路…… [e …… bie dang wo de lu ……]

english: What can I help you with, dear?
translation: 亲爱的，我能帮你什么忙？ [qin ai de ， wo neng bang ni shen me mang ？]

english: Who are you and what are you doing?
translation: 你是谁，你在做什么？ [ni shi shui ， ni zai zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm Abigaila, from Morytania. It's a terrible place, run by the vampyres. They visit the towns and collect everyone's blood for food!
translation: 我是阿比盖拉，来自莫里塔尼亚。这是一个由吸血鬼统治的可怕地方。他们拜访城镇并收集每个人的血液作为食物！ [wo shi a bi gai la ， lai zi mo li ta ni ya 。 zhe shi yi ge you xi xue gui tong zhi de ke pa di fang 。 ta men bai fang cheng zhen bing shou ji mei ge ren de xue ye zuo wei shi wu ！]

english: I tried for years to escape, with my son, Suro, to make a better life for ourselves in Misthalin. I scraped together enough money to bribe a boatman to get us out.
translation: 多年来，我一直试图和我的儿子苏罗一起逃离，以便在米沙林为我们自己创造更好的生活。我凑了足够的钱贿赂一个船夫让我们出去。 [duo nian lai ， wo yi zhi shi tu he wo de er zi su luo yi qi tao li ， yi bian zai mi sha lin wei wo men zi ji chuang zao geng hao de sheng huo 。 wo cou le zu gou de qian hui lu yi ge chuan fu rang wo men chu qu 。]

english: The journey was tough. Some men in pink hoods attacked our boat, shouting at us to go back where we belonged, and to keep out of their country. In the struggle, the boat overturned.
translation: 旅程很艰难。一些戴着粉红色头巾的人袭击了我们的船，对我们大喊大叫，让我们滚回我们所属的地方，不要进入他们的国家。挣扎中，船翻了。 [lv cheng hen jian nan 。 yi xie dai zhe fen hong se tou jin de ren xi ji le wo men de chuan ， dui wo men da han da jiao ， rang wo men gun hui wo men suo shu de di fang ， bu yao jin ru ta men de guo jia 。 zheng zha zhong ， chuan fan le 。]

english: It was dark, and I couldn't find Suro in the water. I swam as deep as I could, until my lungs screamed, but I couldn't find him. He wasn't good at swimming.
translation: 天黑了，我在水里找不到苏罗。我尽我所能地游得很深，直到我的肺部发出尖叫声，但我找不到他。他不擅长游泳。 [tian hei le ， wo zai shui li zhao bu dao su luo 。 wo jin wo suo neng di you de hen shen ， zhi dao wo de fei bu fa chu jian jiao sheng ， dan wo zhao bu dao ta 。 ta bu shan chang you yong 。]

english: Eventually I got myself to the shore. The sun was rising, and I found Suro there. On the shore, where the water had dumped his... body.
translation: 最终我终于到了岸边。太阳正在升起，我在那里找到了苏罗。在岸边，海水把他的……尸体抛到了那里。 [zui zhong wo zhong yu dao le an bian 。 tai yang zheng zai sheng qi ， wo zai na li zhao dao le su luo 。 zai an bian ， hai shui ba ta de …… shi ti pao dao le na li 。]

english: *sob*
translation: *哭泣* [* ku qi *]

english: I've done alright in Misthalin, I guess. I know a bit of magic, and the local gentry pay me well for my scrying skills. I'm good at turning a profit on Grand Exchange trades too.
translation: 我想我在米沙林过得还不错。我懂得一点魔法，当地的绅士们因为我的占卜技巧而给了我丰厚的报酬。我也擅长在 Grand Exchange 交易中获利。 [wo xiang wo zai mi sha lin guo de hai bu cuo 。 wo dong de yi dian mo fa ， dang di de shen shi men yin wei wo de zhan bu ji qiao er gei le wo feng hou de bao chou 。 wo ye shan chang zai  Grand Exchange  jiao yi zhong huo li 。]

english: Anyway, I'm able to rent a room in Lumbridge, and to buy food. I'm not being a burden on anyone, and there are no vampyres coming for my blood.
translation: 无论如何，我可以在伦布里奇租个房间，买食物。我不会成为任何人的负担，也没有吸血鬼来吸食我的血。 [wu lun ru he ， wo ke yi zai lun bu li qi zu ge fang jian ， mai shi wu 。 wo bu hui cheng wei ren he ren de fu dan ， ye mei you xi xue gui lai xi shi wo de xue 。]

english: I am free!
translation: 我自由了！ [wo zi you le ！]

english: But I haven't forgotten my people in the east. There's one vampyre there who runs a place she calls the Theatre of Blood, challenging humans to face monsters in her arena.
translation: 但我没有忘记我东部的人民。那里有一个吸血鬼，她经营着一个她称之为“血剧场”的地方，在她的竞技场上挑战人类面对怪物。 [dan wo mei you wang ji wo dong bu de ren min 。 na li you yi ge xi xue gui ， ta jing ying zhe yi ge ta cheng zhi wei “ xue ju chang ” de di fang ， zai ta de jing ji chang shang tiao zhan ren lei mian dui guai wu 。]

english: My husband went there, trying to win freedom from the blood-gatherers by surviving her arena, but he never returned. No-one does.
translation: 我的丈夫去了那里，试图通过在她的竞技场中生存下来从采血者手中赢得自由，但他再也没有回来。没有人这样做。 [wo de zhang fu qu le na li ， shi tu tong guo zai ta de jing ji chang zhong sheng cun xia lai cong cai xie zhe shou zhong ying de zi you ， dan ta zai ye mei you hui lai 。 mei you ren zhe yang zuo 。]

english: So now I pass my spare time scrying on the Theatre of Blood, watching other adventurers there. You can have a look, if you like.
translation: 所以现在我把业余时间花在了血色剧场的探查上，观察那里的其他冒险家。如果你喜欢的话，你可以看一下。 [suo yi xian zai wo ba ye yu shi jian hua zai le xue se ju chang de tan cha shang ， guan cha na li de qi ta mao xian jia 。 ru guo ni xi huan de hua ， ni ke yi kan yi xia 。]

english: I'd like to look in your scrying ball.
translation: 我想看看你的占卜球。 [wo xiang kan kan ni de zhan bu qiu 。]

english: I'm afraid I can't let you use my scrying ball now, dear. Clear out everything you're carrying, and make sure you're not sick or poisoned.
translation: 恐怕我现在不能让你使用我的占卜球，亲爱的。清理掉你携带的所有东西，并确保你没有生病或中毒。 [kong pa wo xian zai bu neng rang ni shi yong wo de zhan bu qiu ， qin ai de 。 qing li diao ni xie dai de suo you dong xi ， bing que bao ni mei you sheng bing huo zhong du 。]

english: I'll leave you be.
translation: 我就不打扰你了。 [wo jiu bu da rao ni le 。]

english: Who are you and what are you doing?
translation: 你是谁，你在做什么？ [ni shi shui ， ni zai zuo shen me ？]

english: I'd like to look in your scrying ball.
translation: 我想看看你的占卜球。 [wo xiang kan kan ni de zhan bu qiu 。]

english: Observe a specific party
translation: 观察特定一方 [guan cha te ding yi fang]

english: Observe recent party
translation: 观察最近的聚会 [guan cha zui jin de ju hui]

english: Cancel
translation: 取消 [qu xiao]

english: I'll leave you be.
translation: 我就不打扰你了。 [wo jiu bu da rao ni le 。]

english: Help! Help!
translation: 帮助！帮助！ [bang zhu ！ bang zhu ！]

english: What has happened here?
translation: 这里发生了什么？ [zhe li fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: We were invited to a house party on an island not far from here... Something felt wrong about the whole thing but we went anyway...
translation: 我们被邀请参加离这里不远的一个岛上的家庭聚会...整个事情感觉有些不对劲，但我们还是去了... [wo men bei yao qing can jia li zhe li bu yuan de yi ge dao shang de jia ting ju hui ... zheng ge shi qing gan jue you xie bu dui jin ， dan wo men hai shi qu le ...]

english: The house seemed pretty creepy, but everything was going fine, we were all having a good time...
translation: 房子看起来很令人毛骨悚然，但一切都很顺利，我们都玩得很开心...... [fang zi kan qi lai hen ling ren mao gu song ran ， dan yi qie dou hen shun li ， wo men dou wan de hen kai xin ......]

english: ...and that's when we got attacked...
translation: ……就在那时我们遭到了袭击…… […… jiu zai na shi wo men zao dao le xi ji ……]

english: I... I tried to save her...
translation: 我……我试图拯救她…… [wo …… wo shi tu zheng jiu ta ……]

english: Hewey bought me enough time to find an old boat. I went back to get him but it was too late. I'm scared that he won't make it.
translation: 休伊为我争取了足够的时间去寻找一艘旧船。我回去接他，但为时已晚。我怕他熬不过去 [xiu yi wei wo zheng qu le zu gou de shi jian qu xun zhao yi sou jiu chuan 。 wo hui qu jie ta ， dan wei shi yi wan 。 wo pa ta ao bu guo qu]

english: You have to do something... they can't get away with this!
translation: 你必须做点什么……他们逃不掉的！ [ni bi xu zuo dian shen me …… ta men tao bu diao de ！]

english: What do you want me to do?
translation: 你想让我做什么？ [ni xiang rang wo zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm not getting involved in this!
translation: 我不参与这件事！ [wo bu can yu zhe jian shi ！]

english: That psycho is still out there, you have to bring them to justice.
translation: 那个神经病仍然在那里，你必须将他们绳之以法。 [na ge shen jing bing reng ran zai na li ， ni bi xu jiang ta men sheng zhi yi fa 。]

english: The boat we escaped on is just over there, you can use it to get to the island.
translation: 我们逃亡的船就在那边，你可以乘它去岛上。 [wo men tao wang de chuan jiu zai na bian ， ni ke yi cheng ta qu dao shang 。]

english: Okay, I'll see what I can do.
translation: 好吧，我看看能做什么。 [hao ba ， wo kan kan neng zuo shen me 。]

english: Please, you need to make sure they don't get away with this! You can use the boat over there to get to the island we escaped from.
translation: 拜托，你需要确保他们不会得逞！你可以乘那边的船去我们逃离的那个岛。 [bai tuo ， ni xu yao que bao ta men bu hui de cheng ！ ni ke yi cheng na bian de chuan qu wo men tao li de na ge dao 。]

english: Urgh...I think I may have underestimated you.
translation: 呃……我想我可能低估了你。 [e …… wo xiang wo ke neng di gu le ni 。]

english: You've lost at your own game. And now it is time to see who you really are under that mask!
translation: 你已经输掉了自己的游戏。现在是时候看看面具下的你到底是谁了！ [ni yi jing shu diao le zi ji de you xi 。 xian zai shi shi hou kan kan mian ju xia de ni dao di shi shui le ！]

english: The player unmasks the killer, revealing Abigale as the culprit.
translation: 玩家揭开了凶手的面纱，揭露了阿比盖尔就是罪魁祸首。 [wan jia jie kai le xiong shou de mian sha ， jie lu le a bi gai er jiu shi zui kui huo shou 。]

english: No! You!? But why!? Why on earth would you kill all your friends!? Why beg me to come here to help them!?
translation: 不！你！？但为什么！？你到底为什么要杀死你所有的朋友！？为什么求我来这里帮助他们！？ [bu ！ ni ！？ dan wei shen me ！？ ni dao di wei shen me yao sha si ni suo you de peng you ！？ wei shen me qiu wo lai zhe li bang zhu ta men ！？]

english: You just don't get it do you?
translation: 你只是不明白，是吗？ [ni zhi shi bu ming bai ， shi ma ？]

english: So big headed. So used to it all being about you. About you saving the day.
translation: 头好大啊So used to it all being about you. About you saving the day. [tou hao da a So used to it all being about you. About you saving the day.]

english: Well I'm sick of it!
translation: 好吧，我厌倦了！ [hao ba ， wo yan juan le ！]

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你是什​​么意思？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: Adventurers! You're all the same. Everything always has to be about you.
translation: 冒险家们！你们都一样。一切都必须以你为中心。 [mao xian jia men ！ ni men dou yi yang 。 yi qie dou bi xu yi ni wei zhong xin 。]

english: I don't understand?
translation: 我不明白？ [wo bu ming bai ？]

english: Of course you wouldn't! Because you can't see past yourself!
translation: 你当然不会！因为你看不到过去的自己！ [ni dang ran bu hui ！ yin wei ni kan bu dao guo qu de zi ji ！]

english: Believe it or not... I used to be like you.
translation: 不管你信不信……我以前也和你一样。 [bu guan ni xin bu xin …… wo yi qian ye he ni yi yang 。]

english: I'd hear about some damsel in distress and go to help. To have my moment. For me to be the hero, just for once.
translation: 我会听说某个女孩遇险并去帮忙。拥有我的时刻。对我来说，成为英雄，就一次。 [wo hui ting shuo mou ge nv hai yu xian bing qu bang mang 。 yong you wo de shi ke 。 dui wo lai shuo ， cheng wei ying xiong ， jiu yi ci 。]

english: But YOU! You and every other darned adventurer! Every time I get there to help, it's too late. Crisis solved. Disaster averted. Reward claimed. Every time you and those other adventurers steal my moment!
translation: 但是你！你和其他所有该死的冒险家！每次我去那里帮忙时，都为时已晚。危机解决了。灾难得以避免。奖励已领取。 Every time you and those other adventurers steal my moment! [dan shi ni ！ ni he qi ta suo you gai si de mao xian jia ！ mei ci wo qu na li bang mang shi ， dou wei shi yi wan 。 wei ji jie jue le 。 zai nan de yi bi mian 。 jiang li yi ling qu 。 Every time you and those other adventurers steal my moment!]

english: But not this time!
translation: 但这次不是！ [dan zhe ci bu shi ！]

english: This time, it is all about me! I'm the star of the show! ME ME ME ME ME!
translation: 这一次，一切都是为了我！我是节目的明星！我我我我我我！ [zhe yi ci ， yi qie dou shi wei le wo ！ wo shi jie mu de ming xing ！ wo wo wo wo wo wo ！]

english: Well not any longer. The show is over, and there will be no curtain call.
translation: 好吧，不再是了。演出结束了，不会有谢幕。 [hao ba ， bu zai shi le 。 yan chu jie shu le ， bu hui you xie mu 。]

english: Oh, but there is always a curtain call.
translation: 哦，但谢幕总是有的。 [o ， dan xie mu zong shi you de 。]

english: Another killer comes out of the closest near the door.
translation: 另一个杀手从最靠近门的地方出现。 [ling yi ge sha shou cong zui kao jin men de di fang chu xian 。]

english: What!? How!? There was another killer!?
translation: 什么！？如何！？还有一个杀手！？ [shen me ！？ ru he ！？ hai you yi ge sha shou ！？]

english: Of course. Every good show needs a good supporting actor. Now, take off your mask darling. Take a bow. You have earned it.
translation: 当然。每一部好剧都需要一个好的配角。现在，摘下你的面具吧，亲爱的。谢幕。你已经赢得了它。 [dang ran 。 mei yi bu hao ju dou xu yao yi ge hao de pei jue 。 xian zai ， zhai xia ni de mian ju ba ， qin ai de 。 xie mu 。 ni yi jing ying de le ta 。]

english: Of course, my love.
translation: 当然，我的爱人。 [dang ran ， wo de ai ren 。]

english: The killer unmasks himself, revealing Hewey as the culprit.
translation: 凶手揭开了自己的面纱，揭露了休伊的真凶。 [xiong shou jie kai le zi ji de mian sha ， jie lu le xiu yi de zhen xiong 。]

english: You!? But how!? You were almost dead when I saw you! I saw your wounds!
translation: 你！？但如何！？当我看到你的时候你就快死了！我看到你的伤口了！ [ni ！？ dan ru he ！？ dang wo kan dao ni de shi hou ni jiu kuai si le ！ wo kan dao ni de shang kou le ！]

english: No, what you watched was what we wanted you to watch. A masterful performance if I do say myself.
translation: 不，你看的就是我们想让你看的。如果我自己说的话，这是一场精湛的表演。 [bu ， ni kan de jiu shi wo men xiang rang ni kan de 。 ru guo wo zi ji shuo de hua ， zhe shi yi chang jing zhan de biao yan 。]

english: But what is in this for you?
translation: 但这对你来说有什么好处呢？ [dan zhe dui ni lai shuo you shen me hao chu ne ？]

english: Everyone loves the limelight, and who better to share it with than my beloved Abigale.
translation: 每个人都喜欢成为众人瞩目的焦点，还有谁比我心爱的阿比盖尔更适合与之分享。 [mei ge ren dou xi huan cheng wei zhong ren zhu mu di jiao dian ， hai you shui bi wo xin ai de a bi gai er geng shi he yu zhi fen xiang 。]

english: But your friends?
translation: 但你的朋友呢？ [dan ni de peng you ne ？]

english: They didn't deserve to die!
translation: 他们不该死！ [ta men bu gai si ！]

translation: 右位心。这意味着我的心脏位于胸部的右侧，而不是像大多数人那样位于左侧。 [you wei xin 。 zhe yi wei zhe wo de xin zang wei yu xiong bu de you ce ， er bu shi xiang da duo shu ren na yang wei yu zuo ce 。]

english: I'm the Account Guide. I'm here to tell you about your account.
translation: 我是账户指南。我来这里是为了告诉你有关你的帐户的信息。 [wo shi zhang hu zhi nan 。 wo lai zhe li shi wei le gao su ni you guan ni de zhang hu de xin xi 。]

english: What's an account?
translation: 什么是账户？ [shen me shi zhang hu ？]

english: Your character IS your account! It's what you are using to play the game right now. Everyone here has one and some people even have multiple!
translation: 你的角色就是你的账户！这就是您现在用来玩游戏的东西。这里每个人都有一个，有些人甚至有多个！ [ni de jue se jiu shi ni de zhang hu ！ zhe jiu shi nin xian zai yong lai wan you xi de dong xi 。 zhe li mei ge ren dou you yi ge ， you xie ren shen zhi you duo ge ！]

english: There’s various things you can do with your account which is where the Account Management menu comes into play. Let’s take a look at it now.
translation: 您可以使用您的帐户执行多种操作，这就是“帐户管理”菜单发挥作用的地方。现在我们就来看看吧。 [nin ke yi shi yong nin de zhang hu zhi xing duo zhong cao zuo ， zhe jiu shi “ zhang hu guan li ” cai dan fa hui zuo yong de di fang 。 xian zai wo men jiu lai kan kan ba 。]

english: As you can see, there's a few things you can do with your account.

english: First, you have membership. All accounts are free to play by default but if you desire, you can buy membership to unlock members' worlds. These worlds give you access to extra skills, areas, quests, and more!
translation: 首先，你有会员资格。默认情况下，所有帐户都是免费的，但如果您愿意，您可以购买会员资格来解锁会员的世界。这些世界让您能够获得额外的技能、区域、任务等等！ [shou xian ， ni you hui yuan zi ge 。 mo ren qing kuang xia ， suo you zhang hu dou shi mian fei de ， dan ru guo nin yuan yi ， nin ke yi gou mai hui yuan zi ge lai jie suo hui yuan de shi jie 。 zhe xie shi jie rang nin neng gou huo de e wai de ji neng 、 qu yu 、 ren wu deng deng ！]
