english: A world is what you play the game on. Most worlds can hold up to 2000 players. They are split into two main types: free worlds and members' worlds. You can swap worlds with the World Switcher in the Logout menu.
translation: 世界就是你玩游戏的地方。大多数世界最多可容纳 2000 名玩家。它们分为两种主要类型：自由世界和会员世界。您可以使用注销菜单中的世界切换器交换世界。 [shi jie jiu shi ni wan you xi de di fang 。 da duo shu shi jie zui duo ke rong na  2000  ming wan jia 。 ta men fen wei liang zhong zhu yao lei xing ： zi you shi jie he hui yuan shi jie 。 nin ke yi shi yong zhu xiao cai dan zhong de shi jie qie huan qi jiao huan shi jie 。]

english: You are currently on a free world. If you want to switch to a members’ world and enjoy all of the benefits, you’ll need to purchase membership. You can do so using the store in the Account Management menu.
translation: 你目前处于一个自由的世界。如果您想切换到会员世界并享受所有福利，您需要购买会员资格。您可以使用“帐户管理”菜单中的商店来执行此操作。 [ni mu qian chu yu yi ge zi you de shi jie 。 ru guo nin xiang qie huan dao hui yuan shi jie bing xiang shou suo you fu li ， nin xu yao gou mai hui yuan zi ge 。 nin ke yi shi yong “ zhang hu guan li ” cai dan zhong de shang dian lai zhi xing ci cao zuo 。]

english: You are currently on a members' world so you already have access to everything that being a member has to offer. Enjoy!
translation: 您目前处于会员世界，因此您已经可以访问会员所提供的一切。享受！ [nin mu qian chu yu hui yuan shi jie ， yin ci nin yi jing ke yi fang wen hui yuan suo ti gong de yi qie 。 xiang shou ！]

english: Bonds are another thing that you should know about. You can purchase Bonds from the store in the Account Management menu. Once you have some Bonds, you can redeem them for membership!
translation: 债券是您应该了解的另一件事。您可以在“账户管理”菜单中从商店购买债券。一旦您拥有一些债券，您就可以将它们兑换为会员！ [zhai quan shi nin ying gai liao jie de ling yi jian shi 。 nin ke yi zai “ zhang hu guan li ” cai dan zhong cong shang dian gou mai zhai quan 。 yi dan nin yong you yi xie zhai quan ， nin jiu ke yi jiang ta men dui huan wei hui yuan ！]

english: But why would I use a Bond instead of just buying membership normally?
translation: 但为什么我要使用债券而不是通常购买会员资格呢？ [dan wei shen me wo yao shi yong zhai quan er bu shi tong chang gou mai hui yuan zi ge ne ？]

english: Unlike membership, Bonds can be traded with other players. You could purchase a Bond and then sell it to another player for some gold. Alternatively, you could use your gold to buy a Bond from another player!
translation: 与会员资格不同，债券可以与其他玩家进行交易。您可以购买债券，然后将其出售给其他玩家以获得一些金币。或者，您可以使用您的黄金从其他玩家那里购买债券！ [yu hui yuan zi ge bu tong ， zhai quan ke yi yu qi ta wan jia jin xing jiao yi 。 nin ke yi gou mai zhai quan ， ran hou jiang qi chu shou gei qi ta wan jia yi huo de yi xie jin bi 。 huo zhe ， nin ke yi shi yong nin de huang jin cong qi ta wan jia na li gou mai zhai quan ！]

english: So if I used my gold to buy a Bond from another player, I could get membership without spending any real money?
translation: 那么如果我用我的金币从其他玩家那里购买邦德，我就可以在不花任何真钱的情况下获得会员资格吗？ [na me ru guo wo yong wo de jin bi cong qi ta wan jia na li gou mai bang de ， wo jiu ke yi zai bu hua ren he zhen qian de qing kuang xia huo de hui yuan zi ge ma ？]

english: Exactly!
translation: 确切地！ [que qie di ！]

english: Next up, you have your inbox and name changer. The inbox is where you’ll receive important information related to your account and the game. Be sure to keep an eye on it.
translation: 接下来，您将看到收件箱和姓名更改器。您将在收件箱中收到与您的帐户和游戏相关的重要信息。请务必留意。 [jie xia lai ， nin jiang kan dao shou jian xiang he xing ming geng gai qi 。 nin jiang zai shou jian xiang zhong shou dao yu nin de zhang hu he you xi xiang guan de zhong yao xin xi 。 qing wu bi liu yi 。]

english: The name changer allows you to change your display name if you don't like your current one. Be aware though that this is only available to accounts with membership.
translation: 如果您不喜欢当前的显示名称，则可以使用名称更改器更改您的显示名称。但请注意，这仅适用于具有会员资格的帐户。 [ru guo nin bu xi huan dang qian de xian shi ming cheng ， ze ke yi shi yong ming cheng geng gai qi geng gai nin de xian shi ming cheng 。 dan qing zhu yi ， zhe jin shi yong yu ju you hui yuan zi ge de zhang hu 。]

english: Finally, the bottom of the menu has some links which you might find useful. Make sure you check them out at some point.
translation: 最后，菜单底部有一些您可能会觉得有用的链接。确保您在某个时候检查它们。 [zui hou ， cai dan di bu you yi xie nin ke neng hui jue de you yong de lian jie 。 que bao nin zai mou ge shi hou jian cha ta men 。]

english: Awesome. Is there anything else I should know about accounts?
translation: 惊人的。关于账户还有什么我应该知道的吗？ [jing ren de 。 guan yu zhang hu hai you shen me wo ying gai zhi dao de ma ？]

english: Your account is very valuable and it's important you look after it. Various tools can help with this, such as Bank PINs and two-factor authentication options.
translation: 您的帐户非常有价值，妥善保管它非常重要。各种工具可以帮助实现这一点，例如银行 PIN 码和双因素身份验证选项。 [nin de zhang hu fei chang you jia zhi ， tuo shan bao guan ta fei chang zhong yao 。 ge zhong gong ju ke yi bang zhu shi xian zhe yi dian ， li ru yin hang  PIN  ma he shuang yin su shen fen yan zheng xuan xiang 。]

english: You'll find more information on account security on the Customer Support webpage. You can use the Useful Links section of the Account Management menu to get there.
translation: 您可以在客户支持网页上找到有关帐户安全的更多信息。您可以使用“帐户管理”菜单的“有用链接”部分到达那里。 [nin ke yi zai ke hu zhi chi wang ye shang zhao dao you guan zhang hu an quan de geng duo xin xi 。 nin ke yi shi yong “ zhang hu guan li ” cai dan de “ you yong lian jie ” bu fen dao da na li 。]

english: Anyway, that's everything I have to tell you about accounts. Let me know if you need a recap, otherwise head on to your next instructor.
translation: 不管怎样，这就是我要告诉你的关于账户的一切。如果您需要回顾，请告诉我，否则请前往您的下一位教练。 [bu guan zen yang ， zhe jiu shi wo yao gao su ni de guan yu zhang hu de yi qie 。 ru guo nin xu yao hui gu ， qing gao su wo ， fou ze qing qian wang nin de xia yi wei jiao lian 。]

english: Hello. Would you like to hear about your account again?
translation: 你好。您想再次了解您的帐户吗？ [ni hao 。 nin xiang zai ci liao jie nin de zhang hu ma ？]

english: Yes!
translation: 是的！ [shi de ！]

english: Excellent. Well there's a few things you can do with your account.
translation: 出色的。您可以使用您的帐户执行一些操作。 [chu se de 。 nin ke yi shi yong nin de zhang hu zhi xing yi xie cao zuo 。]

english: You are currently on a free world. If you want to switch to a members' world and enjoy all of the benefits, you'll need to purchase membership. You can do so using the store in the Account Management menu.
translation: 你目前处于一个自由的世界。如果您想切换到会员世界并享受所有福利，您需要购买会员资格。您可以使用“帐户管理”菜单中的商店来执行此操作。 [ni mu qian chu yu yi ge zi you de shi jie 。 ru guo nin xiang qie huan dao hui yuan shi jie bing xiang shou suo you fu li ， nin xu yao gou mai hui yuan zi ge 。 nin ke yi shi yong “ zhang hu guan li ” cai dan zhong de shang dian lai zhi xing ci cao zuo 。]

english: Next up, you have your inbox. The inbox is where you'll receive important information related to your account and the game. Be sure to keep an eye on it.
translation: 接下来，您将看到收件箱。您将在收件箱中收到与您的帐户和游戏相关的重要信息。请务必留意。 [jie xia lai ， nin jiang kan dao shou jian xiang 。 nin jiang zai shou jian xiang zhong shou dao yu nin de zhang hu he you xi xiang guan de zhong yao xin xi 。 qing wu bi liu yi 。]

english: Finally, you have your display name. Every account has a unique display name. If you don't like your current one, you can change it with the name changer.
translation: 最后，您就有了您的显示名称。每个帐户都有一个唯一的显示名称。如果您不喜欢当前的名称，可以使用名称更改器进行更改。 [zui hou ， nin jiu you le nin de xian shi ming cheng 。 mei ge zhang hu dou you yi ge wei yi de xian shi ming cheng 。 ru guo nin bu xi huan dang qian de ming cheng ， ke yi shi yong ming cheng geng gai qi jin xing geng gai 。]

english: Anyway, that's everything. I hope that has helped you out.
translation: 无论如何，这就是一切。我希望这对你有所帮助。 [wu lun ru he ， zhe jiu shi yi qie 。 wo xi wang zhe dui ni you suo bang zhu 。]

english: Yes!
translation: 是的！ [shi de ！]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Hey there adventurer. I am Gordon, the Account security tutor. I can help you with anything account security related, would you like to know anything?
translation: 嘿，冒险家。我是戈登，账户安全导师。我可以为您提供任何与帐户安全相关的帮助，您想了解什么吗？ [hei ， mao xian jia 。 wo shi ge deng ， zhang hu an quan dao shi 。 wo ke yi wei nin ti gong ren he yu zhang hu an quan xiang guan de bang zhu ， nin xiang liao jie shen me ma ？]

english: How can I keep my account secure?
translation: 我如何保证我的帐户安全？ [wo ru he bao zheng wo de zhang hu an quan ？]

english: There are many ways you can strengthen your account security, which would you like to hear more about?
translation: 有很多方法可以增强您的帐户安全性，您想了解更多关于哪些方法？ [you hen duo fang fa ke yi zeng qiang nin de zhang hu an quan xing ， nin xiang liao jie geng duo guan yu na xie fang fa ？]

english: Tell me about passwords.
translation: 告诉我有关密码的事情。 [gao su wo you guan mi ma de shi qing 。]

english: Your password is the first line of defence in keeping your account secure.
translation: 您的密码是确保您的帐户安全的第一道防线。 [nin de mi ma shi que bao nin de zhang hu an quan de di yi dao fang xian 。]

english: When choosing a password, make sure to keep it unique. You can do this by using a mix of letters and numbers. You could even use numbers in the middle of your password.
translation: 选择密码时，请确保保持其唯一性。您可以通过混合使用字母和数字来做到这一点。您甚至可以在密码中间使用数字。 [xuan ze mi ma shi ， qing que bao bao chi qi wei yi xing 。 nin ke yi tong guo hun he shi yong zi mu he shu zi lai zuo dao zhe yi dian 。 nin shen zhi ke yi zai mi ma zhong jian shi yong shu zi 。]

english: For extra security, you should make sure you use a different password for your account and email.
translation: 为了额外的安全性，您应该确保您的帐户和电子邮件使用不同的密码。 [wei le e wai de an quan xing ， nin ying gai que bao nin de zhang hu he dian zi you jian shi yong bu tong de mi ma 。]

english: You should keep your password safe and tell no one. Not even your friends or family.
translation: 您应该妥善保管您的密码，不要告诉任何人。甚至你的朋友或家人也不行。 [nin ying gai tuo shan bao guan nin de mi ma ， bu yao gao su ren he ren 。 shen zhi ni de peng you huo jia ren ye bu xing 。]

english: Is there anything else you would like to know?
translation: 您还有什么想知道的吗？ [nin hai you shen me xiang zhi dao de ma ？]

english: Tell me about securing my email.
translation: 告诉我有关保护我的电子邮件的信息。 [gao su wo you guan bao hu wo de dian zi you jian de xin xi 。]

english: Make sure you use a separate password for your email account. This will help boost your security and make it less likely for hijackers to steal your account.
translation: 确保您的电子邮件帐户使用单独的密码。这将有助于提高您的安全性并降低劫持者窃取您帐户的可能性。 [que bao nin de dian zi you jian zhang hu shi yong dan du de mi ma 。 zhe jiang you zhu yu ti gao nin de an quan xing bing jiang di jie chi zhe qie qu nin zhang hu de ke neng xing 。]

english: You should also enable two-step authentication on your email account, if your email supports it.
translation: 如果您的电子邮件支持，您还应该在您的电子邮件帐户上启用两步身份验证。 [ru guo nin de dian zi you jian zhi chi ， nin hai ying gai zai nin de dian zi you jian zhang hu shang qi yong liang bu shen fen yan zheng 。]

english: This could be done through an authenticator app supplied by your email provider, or it could be done using your mobile phone number.
translation: 这可以通过您的电子邮件提供商提供的身份验证器应用程序来完成，也可以使用您的手机号码来完成。 [zhe ke yi tong guo nin de dian zi you jian ti gong shang ti gong de shen fen yan zheng qi ying yong cheng xu lai wan cheng ， ye ke yi shi yong nin de shou ji hao ma lai wan cheng 。]

english: The type of authenticator changes based on provider, but when active, hijackers will find it hard to access your account. Also, if you get any backup codes, keep them safe.
translation: 身份验证器的类型根据提供商的不同而变化，但是当身份验证器处于活动状态时，劫持者会发现很难访问您的帐户。另外，如果您获得任何备份代码，请妥善保管。 [shen fen yan zheng qi de lei xing gen ju ti gong shang de bu tong er bian hua ， dan shi dang shen fen yan zheng qi chu yu huo dong zhuang tai shi ， jie chi zhe hui fa xian hen nan fang wen nin de zhang hu 。 ling wai ， ru guo nin huo de ren he bei fen dai ma ， qing tuo shan bao guan 。]

english: Tell me about the authenticator.
translation: 告诉我有关验证器的信息。 [gao su wo you guan yan zheng qi de xin xi 。]

english: The RuneScape authenticator will provide your account with another layer of security against hijackers who might want to steal your account.
translation: RuneScape 身份验证器将为您的帐户提供另一层安全保护，防止劫持者可能想要窃取您的帐户。 [RuneScape  shen fen yan zheng qi jiang wei nin de zhang hu ti gong ling yi ceng an quan bao hu ， fang zhi jie chi zhe ke neng xiang yao qie qu nin de zhang hu 。]

english: As well as requiring a password to enter your account, you will also need a randomly generated number from the authenticator app to login.
translation: 除了需要密码才能进入您的帐户之外，您还需要从身份验证器应用程序随机生成的号码才能登录。 [chu le xu yao mi ma cai neng jin ru nin de zhang hu zhi wai ， nin hai xu yao cong shen fen yan zheng qi ying yong cheng xu sui ji sheng cheng de hao ma cai neng deng lu 。]

english: You can enable the authenticator by checking your account page on the official RuneScape website.
translation: 您可以通过在 RuneScape 官方网站上查看您的帐户页面来启用身份验证器。 [nin ke yi tong guo zai  RuneScape  guan fang wang zhan shang cha kan nin de zhang hu ye mian lai qi yong shen fen yan zheng qi 。]

english: If you like, I can take you to a useful web page about the RuneScape authenticator.
translation: 如果您愿意，我可以带您访问有关 RuneScape 验证器的有用网页。 [ru guo nin yuan yi ， wo ke yi dai nin fang wen you guan  RuneScape  yan zheng qi de you yong wang ye 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Tell me about securing my bank.
translation: 告诉我有关保护我的银行的信息。 [gao su wo you guan bao hu wo de yin hang de xin xi 。]

english: If someone does get into your account, you should make sure your bank is secure.
translation: 如果有人确实进入了您的帐户，您应该确保您的银行是安全的。 [ru guo you ren que shi jin ru le nin de zhang hu ， nin ying gai que bao nin de yin hang shi an quan de 。]

english: To keep your bank secure, you should make sure to set a bank pin. A bank pin is a 4 digit code you will need to put in to access your bank.
translation: 为了确保您的银行安全，您应该确保设置银行密码。银行密码是一个 4 位数的代码，您需要输入该代码才能访问您的银行。 [wei le que bao nin de yin hang an quan ， nin ying gai que bao she zhi yin hang mi ma 。 yin hang mi ma shi yi ge  4  wei shu de dai ma ， nin xu yao shu ru gai dai ma cai neng fang wen nin de yin hang 。]

english: It seems I don't have one setup. How do I gotabout setting up a bank pin?
translation: 看来我没有任何设置。如何设置银行密码？ [kan lai wo mei you ren he she zhi 。 ru he she zhi yin hang mi ma ？]

english: To setup a bank pin you will need to visit any bank where you can find a banker. You should then speak to the banker and ask them about setting up a bank pin.
translation: 要设置银行密码，您需要前往任何可以找到银行工作人员的银行。然后，您应该与银行工作人员交谈并询问他们有关设置银行密码的信息。 [yao she zhi yin hang mi ma ， nin xu yao qian wang ren he ke yi zhao dao yin hang gong zuo ren yuan de yin hang 。 ran hou ， nin ying gai yu yin hang gong zuo ren yuan jiao tan bing xun wen ta men you guan she zhi yin hang mi ma de xin xi 。]

english: After the bank pin has been set, you will need to wait a few days for the pin to take effect.
translation: 设置银行密码后，您需要等待几天才能生效。 [she zhi yin hang mi ma hou ， nin xu yao deng dai ji tian cai neng sheng xiao 。]

english: Thanks, I should go speak to a banker right away.
translation: 谢谢，我应该立即去和银行家谈谈。 [xie xie ， wo ying gai li ji qu he yin hang jia tan tan 。]

english: Good thing I already have one set.
translation: 还好我已经有一套了。 [hai hao wo yi jing you yi tao le 。]

english: Good on you [lad/lass]! Great work.
translation: 干得好[小伙子/姑娘]！很棒的工作。 [gan de hao [ xiao huo zi / gu niang ]！ hen bang de gong zuo 。]

english: Tell me about the Stronghold of Security.
translation: 告诉我有关安全要塞的事。 [gao su wo you guan an quan yao sai de shi 。]

english: The Stronghold of Security can be found in the Barbarian Village, west of Varrock.
translation: 安全要塞位于瓦罗克以西的野蛮人村庄。 [an quan yao sai wei yu wa luo ke yi xi de ye man ren cun zhuang 。]

english: Here you will be tested on your knowledge of account security. You will need to make your way to the bottom floor while answering question on account security and fighting monsters.
translation: 在这里，您将测试您的帐户安全知识。您需要到达底层，同时回答有关帐户安全的问题并与怪物战斗。 [zai zhe li ， nin jiang ce shi nin de zhang hu an quan zhi shi 。 nin xu yao dao da di ceng ， tong shi hui da you guan zhang hu an quan de wen ti bing yu guai wu zhan dou 。]

english: Be aware, the deeper into the stronghold you go, the tougher the monster will be. So make sure you bring your best equipment and some food.
translation: 请注意，你越深入要塞，怪物就越难对付。因此，请务必带上最好的设备和一些食物。 [qing zhu yi ， ni yue shen ru yao sai ， guai wu jiu yue nan dui fu 。 yin ci ， qing wu bi dai shang zui hao de she bei he yi xie shi wu 。]

english: If you do manage to make it to the end of each floor, you will be able to loot the chest for some loot. But only once per floor.
translation: 如果你确实成功到达每一层的尽头，你将能够掠夺箱子以获得一些战利品。但每层楼只能一次。 [ru guo ni que shi cheng gong dao da mei yi ceng de jin tou ， ni jiang neng gou lve duo xiang zi yi huo de yi xie zhan li pin 。 dan mei ceng lou zhi neng yi ci 。]

english: If you decide to kill the monsters, you might find they drop some skull sceptre pieces.
translation: 如果你决定杀死怪物，你可能会发现它们会掉落一些骷髅权杖碎片。 [ru guo ni jue ding sha si guai wu ， ni ke neng hui fa xian ta men hui diao luo yi xie ku lou quan zhang sui pian 。]

english: Interesting, thanks for the information.
translation: 有趣，谢谢您的信息。 [you qu ， xie xie nin de xin xi 。]

english: Can I have a Security book?
translation: 我可以有一本安全手册吗？ [wo ke yi you yi ben an quan shou ce ma ？]

english: Sure thing, here you go.
translation: 当然可以，给你。 [dang ran ke yi ， gei ni 。]

english: The Account security tutor hands you a Security book.
translation: 帐户安全导师会给您一本安全书。 [zhang hu an quan dao shi hui gei nin yi ben an quan shu 。]

english: Use it well.
translation: 好好利用它。 [hao hao li yong ta 。]

english: You already have one, maybe you should read that one instead.
translation: 您已经有了一本，也许您应该阅读那一本。 [nin yi jing you le yi ben ， ye xu nin ying gai yue du na yi ben 。]

english: Don't I know you from somewhere?
translation: 我不认识你吗？ [wo bu ren shi ni ma ？]

english: Ah, you're probably talking about my twin brother who works at the Port Sarim prison.

english: No, thank you.

english: Come back any time you need any more information on account security.
translation: 当您需要有关帐户安全的更多信息时，请随时回来。 [dang nin xu yao you guan zhang hu an quan de geng duo xin xi shi ， qing sui shi hui lai 。]

english: Tell me about the authenticator.

english: Take me to the web page.
translation: 带我到网页。 [dai wo dao wang ye 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Tell me about securing my bank.
translation: 告诉我有关保护我的银行的信息。 [gao su wo you guan bao hu wo de yin hang de xin xi 。]

english: Tell me about the Stronghold of Security.
translation: 告诉我有关安全要塞的事。 [gao su wo you guan an quan yao sai de shi 。]

english: Can I have a Security book?
translation: 我可以有一本安全手册吗？ [wo ke yi you yi ben an quan shou ce ma ？]

english: Don't I know you from somewhere?
translation: 我不认识你吗？ [wo bu ren shi ni ma ？]

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Greetings. Welcome to the Heroes' Guild.
translation: 问候。欢迎来到英雄公会。 [wen hou 。 huan ying lai dao ying xiong gong hui 。]

english: Only the greatest heroes of this land may gain entrance to this guild.
translation: 只有这片土地上最伟大的英雄才能进入这个公会。 [zhi you zhe pian tu di shang zui wei da de ying xiong cai neng jin ru zhe ge gong hui 。]

english: I'm a hero - may I apply to join?
translation: 我是英雄 - 我可以申请加入吗？ [wo shi ying xiong  -  wo ke yi shen qing jia ru ma ？]

english: You're a hero? I've never heard of YOU. You are required to possess at least 55 quest points to file an application.
translation: 你是英雄吗？我从来没有听说过你。您需要拥有至少 55 个任务点才能提交申请。 [ni shi ying xiong ma ？ wo cong lai mei you ting shuo guo ni 。 nin xu yao yong you zhi shao  55  ge ren wu dian cai neng ti jiao shen qing 。]

english: Additionally you must have completed the Shield of Arrav, Lost City, Merlin's Crystal and Dragon Slayer I quests.
translation: 此外，您还必须完成阿拉夫之盾、失落之城、梅林的水晶和屠龙者 I 任务。 [ci wai ， nin hai bi xu wan cheng a la fu zhi dun 、 shi luo zhi cheng 、 mei lin de shui jing he tu long zhe  I  ren wu 。]

english: Good for the foremost heroes of the land.
translation: 对于这片土地上最重要的英雄来说有好处。 [dui yu zhe pian tu di shang zui zhong yao de ying xiong lai shuo you hao chu 。]

english: Yes. Yes it is.
translation: 是的。是的。 [shi de 。 shi de 。]

english: How goes thy quest adventurer?

english: I have all the required items.
translation: 我有所有需要的物品。 [wo you suo you xu yao de wu pin 。]

english: I see that you have. Well done; Now, to complete the quest, and gain entry to the Heroes' Guild in your final task all that you have to do is...
translation: 我看到你有。干得好；现在，要完成任务并在最终任务中进入英雄公会，您所要做的就是...... [wo kan dao ni you 。 gan de hao ； xian zai ， yao wan cheng ren wu bing zai zui zhong ren wu zhong jin ru ying xiong gong hui ， nin suo yao zuo de jiu shi ......]

english: W-what? What do you mean? There's MORE???

english: I'm sorry, I was just having a little fun with you. Just a little Heroes' Guild humour there. What I really meant was
translation: 对不起，我只是和你玩得开心而已。只是有一点英雄公会的幽默。我真正的意思是 [dui bu qi ， wo zhi shi he ni wan de kai xin er yi 。 zhi shi you yi dian ying xiong gong hui de you mo 。 wo zhen zheng de yi si shi]

english: Congratulations! You have completed the Heroes' Guild entry requirements! You will find the door now open for you! Enter, Hero! And take this reward!
translation: 恭喜！您已完成英雄公会的入职要求！你会发现大门现在为你敞开！输入，英雄！并接受这个奖励！ [gong xi ！ nin yi wan cheng ying xiong gong hui de ru zhi yao qiu ！ ni hui fa xian da men xian zai wei ni chang kai ！ shu ru ， ying xiong ！ bing jie shou zhe ge jiang li ！]

english: I'm a hero, may I apply to join?
translation: 我是英雄，我可以申请加入吗？ [wo shi ying xiong ， wo ke yi shen qing jia ru ma ？]

english: Good for the foremost heroes of the land.

english: 'Ello, and what are you after then?
translation: '艾洛，那你在追什么？ [' ai luo ， na ni zai zhui shen me ？]

english: I need another assignment.
translation: 我需要另一项任务。 [wo xu yao ling yi xiang ren wu 。]

english: You're actually very strong, are you sure you don't want Vannaka under Edgeville to assign you a task?
translation: 你其实很强，你确定不想让Edgeville旗下的Vannaka给你布置任务吗？ [ni qi shi hen qiang ， ni que ding bu xiang rang Edgeville qi xia de Vannaka gei ni bu zhi ren wu ma ？]

english: No that's okay, I'll take a task from you.
translation: 不，没关系，我会接受你的任务。 [bu ， mei guan xi ， wo hui jie shou ni de ren wu 。]

english: Oh okay then, I'll go talk to Vannaka.
translation: 哦，好吧，那我去跟瓦纳卡谈谈。 [o ， hao ba ， na wo qu gen wa na ka tan tan 。]

english: Excellent, you're doing great. Your new task is to kill [amount] [task monster].
translation: 太棒了，你做得很好。你的新任务是杀死[数量][任务怪物]。 [tai bang le ， ni zuo de hen hao 。 ni de xin ren wu shi sha si [ shu liang ][ ren wu guai wu ]。]

english: Got any tips for me?
translation: 有什么建议给我吗？ [you shen me jian yi gei wo ma ？]

english: Great, thanks!
translation: 太好了，谢谢！ [tai hao le ， xie xie ！]

english: Okay, great!
translation: 好的，太好了！ [hao de ， tai hao le ！]

english: Good luck! Don't forget to come back when you need a new assignment.
translation: 祝你好运！当您需要新的任务时，请不要忘记回来。 [zhu ni hao yun ！ dang nin xu yao xin de ren wu shi ， qing bu yao wang ji hui lai 。]

english: You're still hunting [task monster], you have [amount] to go. Come back when you've finished your task.
translation: 你仍在寻找[任务怪物]，你还有[数量]要做。完成任务后就回来。 [ni reng zai xun zhao [ ren wu guai wu ]， ni hai you [ shu liang ] yao zuo 。 wan cheng ren wu hou jiu hui lai 。]

english: You're still hunting [monster], with [amount] to go.
translation: 你仍在狩猎[怪物]，还有[数量]。 [ni reng zai shou lie [ guai wu ]， hai you [ shu liang ]。]

english: I don't think that's a suitable task for you. Shall I cancel it? This will not wipe your task streaks.
translation: 我认为这不适合你。我要取消它吗？这不会消除您的任务连续记录。 [wo ren wei zhe bu shi he ni 。 wo yao qu xiao ta ma ？ zhe bu hui xiao chu nin de ren wu lian xu ji lu 。]

english: Yes, please cancel it.
translation: 是的，请取消。 [shi de ， qing qu xiao 。]

english: Alright, consider the task cancelled. You can now get a new assignment when you want one.
translation: 好吧，考虑任务被取消了。现在，您可以在需要时获得新的任务。 [hao ba ， kao lv ren wu bei qu xiao le 。 xian zai ， nin ke yi zai xu yao shi huo de xin de ren wu 。]

english: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
translation: 不，谢谢，我想尝试一下。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo xiang chang shi yi xia 。]

english: Good luck with that.
translation: 祝你好运。 [zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: 你有什么奖励给我，或者有什么可以交易的吗？ [ni you shen me jiang li gei wo ， huo zhe you shen me ke yi jiao yi de ma ？]

english: I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.
translation: 我有很多你可以获得的奖励，还有各种各样的杀手装备可供出售。 [wo you hen duo ni ke yi huo de de jiang li ， hai you ge zhong ge yang de sha shou zhuang bei ke gong chu shou 。]

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: 说说我的作业的难度吧。 [shuo shuo wo de zuo ye de nan du ba 。]

english: The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 目前，杀戮大师可以为您分配我们列表中的任何任务，无论您的战斗水平如何。 [mu qian ， sha lu da shi ke yi wei nin fen pei wo men lie biao zhong de ren he ren wu ， wu lun nin de zhan dou shui ping ru he 。]

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
translation: 没关系——我可以处理任何任务。 [mei guan xi —— wo ke yi chu li ren he ren wu 。]

english: That's the spirit.
translation: 这就是精神。 [zhe jiu shi jing shen 。]

english: In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: 以后，请不要给任何太艰难的事情。 [yi hou ， qing bu yao gei ren he tai jian nan de shi qing 。]

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: 好吧，从现在开始，所有屠戮大师在为你选择任务时都会考虑你的战斗水平，所以你不要做太难的事情。 [hao ba ， cong xian zai kai shi ， suo you tu lu da shi zai wei ni xuan ze ren wu shi du hui kao lv ni de zhan dou shui ping ， suo yi ni bu yao zuo tai nan de shi qing 。]

english: The Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: 杀手大师在为你选择任务时会考虑你的战斗水平，所以你不应该遇到太难的任务。 [sha shou da shi zai wei ni xuan ze ren wu shi hui kao lv ni de zhan dou shui ping ， suo yi ni bu ying gai yu dao tai nan de ren wu 。]

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: 没关系——我不想要太难的东西。 [mei guan xi —— wo bu xiang yao tai nan de dong xi 。]

english: Okay, we'll keep checking your combat level.
translation: 好的，我们会继续检查你的战斗水平。 [hao de ， wo men hui ji xu jian cha ni de zhan dou shui ping 。]

english: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: 别再检查我的战斗水平了——我可以承受任何事情！ [bie zai jian cha wo de zhan dou shui ping le —— wo ke yi cheng shou ren he shi qing ！]

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will assign you anything from their lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 好吧，从现在开始，所有的杀手大师都会从他们的列表中为你分配任何东西，无论你的战斗水平如何。 [hao ba ， cong xian zai kai shi ， suo you de sha shou da shi du hui cong ta men de lie biao zhong wei ni fen pei ren he dong xi ， wu lun ni de zhan dou shui ping ru he 。]

english: So you're filling in for Mazchna?
translation: 所以你要代替 Mazchna 吗？ [suo yi ni yao dai ti  Mazchna  ma ？]

english: Indeed I am. It's been a while since he last asked me to step in, but it's good to get out and see the sights, to meet mortals and to generally socialise.
translation: 确实我是。自从他上次邀请我进来已经有一段时间了，但出去看看风景、认识凡人并进行社交活动还是很好的。 [que shi wo shi 。 zi cong ta shang ci yao qing wo jin lai yi jing you yi duan shi jian le ， dan chu qu kan kan feng jing 、 ren shi fan ren bing jin xing she jiao huo dong hai shi hen hao de 。]

english: So do you know Mazchna well?
translation: 那么你了解Mazchna吗？ [na me ni liao jie Mazchna ma ？]

english: Oh, yes, he's such a mine of information. He hears what's going on at the pub, listens to the gossip of passing adventurers, and now he's off on a great adventure himself.
translation: 哦，是的，他真是个信息宝库。他听到了酒吧里发生的事情，听到了路过的冒险家的闲言碎语，现在他自己也开始了一场伟大的冒险。 [o ， shi de ， ta zhen shi ge xin xi bao ku 。 ta ting dao le jiu ba li fa sheng de shi qing ， ting dao le lu guo de mao xian jia de xian yan sui yu ， xian zai ta zi ji ye kai shi le yi chang wei da de mao xian 。]

english: Though, of course, you know that already. Sorry to babble on. I'm sure you have plenty of other things to be doing.
translation: 当然，你已经知道了。抱歉胡言乱语。我确信您还有很多其他事情要做。 [dang ran ， ni yi jing zhi dao le 。 bao qian hu yan luan yu 。 wo que xin nin hai you hen duo qi ta shi qing yao zuo 。]

translation: 呃……没什么…… [e …… mei shen me ……]

english: Don't mind me, but if you're looking for something to do, this man here needs a hand.
translation: 别介意我，但如果你想找点事做，这里的这个人需要帮助。 [bie jie yi wo ， dan ru guo ni xiang zhao dian shi zuo ， zhe li de zhe ge ren xu yao bang zhu 。]

english: You! Time for some questions.
translation: 你！是时候问一些问题了。 [ni ！ shi shi hou wen yi xie wen ti le 。]

english: Why did you join the Emissaries?
translation: 你为什么加入使者？ [ni wei shen me jia ru shi zhe ？]

english: To be honest, I wasn't too sure about joining at first. My friend convinced me though. Here we're part of something bigger than ourselves.
translation: 说实话，一开始我并不太确定要不要加入。不过我的朋友说服了我。在这里，我们是比我们自己更伟大的事业的一部分。 [shuo shi hua ， yi kai shi wo bing bu tai que ding yao bu yao jia ru 。 bu guo wo de peng you shuo fu le wo 。 zai zhe li ， wo men shi bi wo men zi ji geng wei da de shi ye de yi bu fen 。]

english: Who do you worship?
translation: 你崇拜谁？ [ni chong bai shui ？]

english: I've never been one for proper worship, but I believe in the teachings of Ralos and Ranul. I hope those teachings guide me through whatever is to come.
translation: 我从来都不是一个真正崇拜的人，但我相信拉洛斯和拉努尔的教义。我希望这些教导能够指导我度过接下来的一切。 [wo cong lai dou bu shi yi ge zhen zheng chong bai de ren ， dan wo xiang xin la luo si he la nu er de jiao yi 。 wo xi wang zhe xie jiao dao neng gou zhi dao wo du guo jie xia lai de yi qie 。]

english: Tell me about the Final Dawn.
translation: 跟我讲讲《最后的黎明》吧。 [gen wo jiang jiang 《 zui hou de li ming 》 ba 。]

english: They say the Final Dawn is inevitable. It's the end that we can't escape from. It's a scary thought, but the Twilight Emissaries have embraced it, so I have as well.
translation: 他们说最终黎明是不可避免的。这是我们无法逃避的结局。这是一个可怕的想法，但暮光使者已经接受了它，所以我也接受了。 [ta men shuo zui zhong li ming shi bu ke bi mian de 。 zhe shi wo men wu fa tao bi de jie ju 。 zhe shi yi ge ke pa de xiang fa ， dan mu guang shi zhe yi jing jie shou le ta ， suo yi wo ye jie shou le 。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Hello friend. I wish to slay evil and avail them of their loot! Take me to Burgh de Rott!
translation: 朋友你好。我希望消灭邪恶并利用他们的战利品！带我去德罗特堡！ [peng you ni hao 。 wo xi wang xiao mie xie e bing li yong ta men de zhan li pin ！ dai wo qu de luo te bao ！]

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: 你准备好与那里的邪恶作斗争了吗？ [ni zhun bei hao yu na li de xie e zuo dou zheng le ma ？]

english: I think so? At least my heart knows courage and that should be sufficient for the meantime. I expect that when we get to Burgh de Rott, we'll be able to purchase suitable provisions.
translation: 我想是这样吗？至少我的心知道勇气，这应该足够了。我预计当我们到达罗特堡时，我们就能购买到合适的食物。 [wo xiang shi zhe yang ma ？ zhi shao wo de xin zhi dao yong qi ， zhe ying gai zu gou le 。 wo yu ji dang wo men dao da luo te bao shi ， wo men jiu neng gou mai dao he shi de shi wu 。]

english: But you do realise that the vampyres in Morytania are immune to everything except silver?
translation: 但你确实意识到莫里塔尼亚的吸血鬼对除了银以外的一切都免疫吗？ [dan ni que shi yi shi dao mo li ta ni ya de xi xue gui dui chu le yin yi wai de yi qie dou mian yi ma ？]

english: Er...well, I've not heard mention of that fact, but I have faith that Saradomin will provide the means to furnish me with suitable weapons when I reach Burgh de Rott.
translation: 呃……好吧，我没有听说过这个事实，但我相信萨拉多明会在我到达罗特堡时为我提供合适的武器。 [e …… hao ba ， wo mei you ting shuo guo zhe ge shi shi ， dan wo xiang xin sa la duo ming hui zai wo dao da luo te bao shi wei wo ti gong he shi de wu qi 。]

english: And if we happen to run into some vampyres on the journey down there?
translation: 如果我们在那儿的旅途中碰巧遇到吸血鬼怎么办？ [ru guo wo men zai na er de lv tu zhong peng qiao yu dao xi xue gui zen me ban ？]

english: I trust that you will help us to avoid them. You are a guide after all, aren't you? Anyway, you look like you can handle yourself. I presume you've fought such creatures before and won? How hard can it be?
translation: 我相信你会帮助我们避免它们。毕竟你是一个向导，不是吗？无论如何，你看上去能应付自如。我想你以前曾与这些生物战斗过并获胜吧？这有多难？ [wo xiang xin ni hui bang zhu wo men bi mian ta men 。 bi jing ni shi yi ge xiang dao ， bu shi ma ？ wu lun ru he ， ni kan shang qu neng ying fu zi ru 。 wo xiang ni yi qian ceng yu zhe xie sheng wu zhan dou guo bing huo sheng ba ？ zhe you duo nan ？]

english: It can be pretty difficult, actually. But you're right, I'll be your guide so I should be able to handle the situation.
translation: 实际上，这可能相当困难。但你是对的，我会成为你的向导，所以我应该能够处理这种情况。 [shi ji shang ， zhe ke neng xiang dang kun nan 。 dan ni shi dui de ， wo hui cheng wei ni de xiang dao ， suo yi wo ying gai neng gou chu li zhe zhong qing kuang 。]

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 你为什么想去 Burgh de Rott？ [ni wei shen me xiang qu  Burgh de Rott？]

english: I'm going down there to teach those vampyres a lesson or two. I've heard about the terrible conditions down there and I intend to put a stop to it.
translation: 我要去那里给那些吸血鬼一两个教训。我听说那里的情况很糟糕，我打算阻止它。 [wo yao qu na li gei na xie xi xue gui yi liang ge jiao xun 。 wo ting shuo na li de qing kuang hen zao gao ， wo da suan zu zhi ta 。]

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 如果我们在去罗特城堡的路上遇到敌人，你能保护自己吗？ [ru guo wo men zai qu luo te cheng bao de lu shang yu dao di ren ， ni neng bao hu zi ji ma ？]

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of enemies. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: 这么说吧，我有点经验，而且我很乐意对抗我的敌人。你不需要担心这个。 [zhe me shuo ba ， wo you dian jing yan ， er qie wo hen le yi dui kang wo de di ren 。 ni bu xu yao dan xin zhe ge 。]

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 我可以带你去伯格德罗特。 [wo ke yi dai ni qu bo ge de luo te 。]

english: Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: 嗯嗯，看来你有追随者了。我想如果让它独自徘徊的话，它可能会在这段旅程中迷路。等你的追随者安全了我们就离开吧。 [n n ， kan lai ni you zhui sui zhe le 。 wo xiang ru guo rang ta du zi pai huai de hua ， ta ke neng hui zai zhe duan lv cheng zhong mi lu 。 deng ni de zhui sui zhe an quan le wo men jiu li kai ba 。]

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: 哦真的吗？那太好了！到达目的地后我会给你一个小奖励。 [o zhen de ma ？ na tai hao le ！ dao da mu di di hou wo hui gei ni yi ge xiao jiang li 。]

english: Burgh de Rott Ramble begins
translation: Burgh de Rott 漫步开始 [Burgh de Rott  man bu kai shi]

english: Ok, which route should we take?
translation: 好的，我们应该走哪条路？ [hao de ， wo men ying gai zou na tiao lu ？]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: 啊，所以你想给我一些物资，嗯？让我打开背包。 [a ， suo yi ni xiang gei wo yi xie wu zi ， n ？ rang wo da kai bei bao 。]

english: This place is a bit grim. How can people live here?
translation: 这个地方有点严峻。人们怎么能住在这里？ [zhe ge di fang you dian yan jun 。 ren men zen me neng zhu zai zhe li ？]

english: Do you visit Burgh de Rott often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: 您经常访问 Burgh de Rott 吗？看来你很熟悉这条路。 [nin jing chang fang wen  Burgh de Rott  ma ？ kan lai ni hen shu xi zhe tiao lu 。]

english: When are we going to get to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 我们什么时候去 Burgh de Rott？ [wo men shen me shi hou qu  Burgh de Rott？]

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on. I have loot to get.
translation: 我们没有一整天的时间站着聊天；让我们继续努力吧。我有战利品要拿。 [wo men mei you yi zheng tian de shi jian zhan zhe liao tian ； rang wo men ji xu nu li ba 。 wo you zhan li pin yao na 。]

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than the opulet life styles forced on us adventurer types. I'd much rather be up to my eyes in mud and having a good fight!
translation: 哦，我讨厌这次旅行，但它比强加给我们冒险家类型的奥普莱特生活方式要好。我宁愿在泥里睁大眼睛，痛痛快快地打一场！ [o ， wo tao yan zhe ci lv xing ， dan ta bi qiang jia gei wo men mao xian jia lei xing de ao pu lai te sheng huo fang shi yao hao 。 wo ning yuan zai ni li zheng da yan jing ， tong tong kuai kuai di da yi chang ！]

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...
translation: 你没看到我正在被攻击吗... [ni mei kan dao wo zheng zai bei gong ji ma ...]

english: Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
translation: 谢谢，我会把这个放在脖子上。 [xie xie ， wo hui ba zhe ge fang zai bo zi shang 。]

english: Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Paterdomus. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: 天啊！看来我们得回帕特多莫斯了。我们过不了那座桥！ [tian a ！ kan lai wo men de hui pa te duo mo si le 。 wo men guo bu liao na zuo qiao ！]

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
translation: 哦，我相信我们能找到办法！ [o ， wo xiang xin wo men neng zhao dao ban fa ！]

english: Player completes the bridge event
translation: 玩家完成桥牌事件 [wan jia wan cheng qiao pai shi jian]

english: Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Paterdomus.
translation: 好吧，这已经被撕裂了……看起来我们无法越过这个沼泽。我们必须回到帕特多莫斯。 [hao ba ， zhe yi jing bei si lie le …… kan qi lai wo men wu fa yue guo zhe ge zhao ze 。 wo men bi xu hui dao pa te duo mo si 。]

english: Player completes the bog event
translation: 玩家完成沼泽事件 [wan jia wan cheng zhao ze shi jian]

english: Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: 嘿……太好了……你做得很好……我会关注你的。 [hei …… tai hao le …… ni zuo de hen hao …… wo hui guan zhu ni de 。]

english: Whahay...that was great!
translation: 哇……那太好了！ [wa …… na tai hao le ！]

english: But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 但我们现在真的应该出发了。 [dan wo men xian zai zhen de ying gai chu fa le 。]

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
translation: 哦，我相信我们能找到办法！ [o ， wo xiang xin wo men neng zhao dao ban fa ！]

english: Player completes the river event
translation: 玩家完成河牌事件 [wan jia wan cheng he pai shi jian]

english: That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: 太棒了！我也必须这样做。 [tai bang le ！ wo ye bi xu zhe yang zuo 。]

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 哇哈！那很棒！但我们现在真的应该出发了。 [wa ha ！ na hen bang ！ dan wo men xian zai zhen de ying gai chu fa le 。]

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
translation: 呃……那些气泡是什么？ [e …… na xie qi pao shi shen me ？]

english: This is scary!
translation: 这太可怕了！ [zhe tai ke pa le ！]

english: Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
translation: 啊啊啊，那应该是触手吧…… [a a a ， na ying gai shi chu shou ba ……]

english: Ahhh, two tentacles!
translation: 啊啊啊，两条触手！ [a a a ， liang tiao chu shou ！]

english: ...three tentacles!
translation: ……三根触手！ […… san gen chu shou ！]

english: I think I'm going to faint!
translation: 我想我要晕倒了！ [wo xiang wo yao yun dao le ！]

english: Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: 天啊！看看那只野兽！你得自己解决这件事！ [tian a ！ kan kan na zhi ye shou ！ ni de zi ji jie jue zhe jian shi ！]

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the Burgh de Rott. Here's your reward.
translation: 非常感谢您让我安全抵达 Burgh de Rott。这是你的奖励。 [fei chang gan xie nin rang wo an quan di da  Burgh de Rott。 zhe shi ni de jiang li 。]

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: 你准备好与那里的邪恶作斗争了吗？ [ni zhun bei hao yu na li de xie e zuo dou zheng le ma ？]

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 你为什么想去 Burgh de Rott？ [ni wei shen me xiang qu  Burgh de Rott？]

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
translation: 如果我们遇到敌人，你能保护自己吗……？ [ru guo wo men yu dao di ren ， ni neng bao hu zi ji ma ……？]

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 我可以带你去伯格德罗特。 [wo ke yi dai ni qu bo ge de luo te 。]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello [player name], what can I do for you?
translation: 您好[玩家姓名]，有什么可以为您效劳的吗？ [nin hao [ wan jia xing ming ]， you shen me ke yi wei nin xiao lao de ma ？]

english: What are Adventure Paths?
translation: 什么是冒险之路？ [shen me shi mao xian zhi lu ？]

english: A long time ago, I was a newbie just like you who didn't know what to do and I would be more than happy to pass on my experience.
translation: 很久以前，我和你一样是个新手，不知道该怎么做，我很乐意传授我的经验。 [hen jiu yi qian ， wo he ni yi yang shi ge xin shou ， bu zhi dao gai zen me zuo ， wo hen le yi chuan shou wo de jing yan 。]

english: I've created some Adventure Paths which I recommend you to start off with. An Adventure Path is a list of tasks which you can complete in any order.
translation: 我创建了一些冒险路径，建议您从它们开始。冒险路径是您可以按任何顺序完成的任务列表。 [wo chuang jian le yi xie mao xian lu jing ， jian yi nin cong ta men kai shi 。 mao xian lu jing shi nin ke yi an ren he shun xu wan cheng de ren wu lie biao 。]

english: To help you get started on your Adventure Path, I'll also give you a starter kit with some useful items.
translation: 为了帮助您开始冒险之路，我还将为您提供包含一些有用物品的入门套件。 [wei le bang zhu nin kai shi mao xian zhi lu ， wo hai jiang wei nin ti gong bao han yi xie you yong wu pin de ru men tao jian 。]

english: Once you've completed an Adventure Path task, come back to me and I'll give you a reward.
translation: 完成冒险之路任务后，回到我身边，我会给你奖励。 [wan cheng mao xian zhi lu ren wu hou ， hui dao wo shen bian ， wo hui gei ni jiang li 。]

english: Do you have any Adventure Path starter kits for me?
translation: 你们有给我任何冒险之路入门套件吗？ [ni men you gei wo ren he mao xian zhi lu ru men tao jian ma ？]

english: Adventurer Jon gives you a Combat path starter kit
translation: 冒险家乔恩为您提供战斗路径入门套件 [mao xian jia qiao en wei nin ti gong zhan dou lu jing ru men tao jian]

english: Here are all of the starter kits you have left to claim.
translation: 以下是您尚未领取的所有入门套件。 [yi xia shi nin shang wei ling qu de suo you ru men tao jian 。]

english: You seem to have already claimed all of your starter kits.
translation: 您似乎已经领取了所有入门套件。 [nin si hu yi jing ling qu le suo you ru men tao jian 。]

english: I'd like to claim my Adventure Path rewards.
translation: 我想领取我的冒险之路奖励。 [wo xiang ling qu wo de mao xian zhi lu jiang li 。]

english: I have no rewards to give you at the moment.
translation: 我现在没有奖励可以给你。 [wo xian zai mei you jiang li ke yi gei ni 。]

english: I have no rewards to give you at the moment. But I do have some members rewards left to give you, visit me on a members world to receive them.
translation: 我现在没有奖励可以给你。但我确实还有一些会员奖励可以给您，请访问会员世界来领取它们。 [wo xian zai mei you jiang li ke yi gei ni 。 dan wo que shi hai you yi xie hui yuan jiang li ke yi gei nin ， qing fang wen hui yuan shi jie lai ling qu ta men 。]

english: You should make sure you have space before asking for rewards.
translation: 在要求奖励之前，您应该确保有空间。 [zai yao qiu jiang li zhi qian ， nin ying gai que bao you kong jian 。]

english: That is the last of the rewards you have currently earned. But I do have some members rewards left to give you, visit me on a members world to receive them.
translation: 这是您当前获得的最后一个奖励。但我确实还有一些会员奖励可以给您，请访问会员世界来领取它们。 [zhe shi nin dang qian huo de de zui hou yi ge jiang li 。 dan wo que shi hai you yi xie hui yuan jiang li ke yi gei nin ， qing fang wen hui yuan shi jie lai ling qu ta men 。]

english: That is the last of your rewards which you have earned.
translation: 这是你获得的最后一个奖励。 [zhe shi ni huo de de zui hou yi ge jiang li 。]

english: I can't give you any more rewards until you come back with more inventory space.
translation: 在您带着更多库存空间回来之前，我无法再给您任何奖励。 [zai nin dai zhe geng duo ku cun kong jian hui lai zhi qian ， wo wu fa zai gei nin ren he jiang li 。]

english: Can you show me some Adventure Paths?
translation: 你能给我展示一些冒险路径吗？ [ni neng gei wo zhan shi yi xie mao xian lu jing ma ？]

english: Of course, here you go.
translation: 当然，给你。 [dang ran ， gei ni 。]

english: Opting out of Adventure Paths will hide the interface and you will no longer receive task and path notifications. You can talk to Adventurer Jon to opt back into Adventure Paths
translation: 选择退出冒险路径将隐藏界面，您将不再收到任务和路径通知。您可以与冒险家乔恩交谈以选择重新加入冒险之路 [xuan ze tui chu mao xian lu jing jiang yin cang jie mian ， nin jiang bu zai shou dao ren wu he lu jing tong zhi 。 nin ke yi yu mao xian jia qiao en jiao tan yi xuan ze chong xin jia ru mao xian zhi lu]

english: You have now opted out of Adventure Paths.
translation: 您现在已选择退出冒险之路。 [nin xian zai yi xuan ze tui chu mao xian zhi lu 。]

english: You are currently not participating in Adventure Paths. Would you like to join back in?
translation: 您目前没有参与冒险之路。您想重新加入吗？ [nin mu qian mei you can yu mao xian zhi lu 。 nin xiang chong xin jia ru ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Opting into Adventure Paths will allow you to see the interface and you will be able to receive task and path notifications. You can talk to Adventurer Jon to opt back out of Adventure Paths
translation: 选择加入冒险路径将允许您看到界面，并且您将能够接收任务和路径通知。您可以与冒险家乔恩交谈以选择退出冒险之路 [xuan ze jia ru mao xian lu jing jiang yun xu nin kan dao jie mian ， bing qie nin jiang neng gou jie shou ren wu he lu jing tong zhi 。 nin ke yi yu mao xian jia qiao en jiao tan yi xuan ze tui chu mao xian zhi lu]

english: You have opted back into Adventure Paths.
translation: 您已选择重新加入冒险之路。 [nin yi xuan ze chong xin jia ru mao xian zhi lu 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I am simply an adventurer like yourself taking a break on my journey.
translation: 我只是一个和你一样的冒险家，在旅途中休息一下。 [wo zhi shi yi ge he ni yi yang de mao xian jia ， zai lv tu zhong xiu xi yi xia 。]

english: I wish you luck on your next adventure.
translation: 祝你下次冒险好运。 [zhu ni xia ci mao xian hao yun 。]

english: And I to you.
translation: 还有我对你。 [hai you wo dui ni 。]

english: Hey [player name]! Come over here.
translation: 嘿[玩家姓名]！过来吧。 [hei [ wan jia xing ming ]！ guo lai ba 。]

english: You look new around here, welcome to the world of Gielinor!
translation: 你在这里看起来很新，欢迎来到 Gielinor 的世界！ [ni zai zhe li kan qi lai hen xin ， huan ying lai dao  Gielinor  de shi jie ！]

english: Thanks, it's my first time here and I'm not sure where to start.
translation: 谢谢，这是我第一次来这里，我不知道从哪里开始。 [xie xie ， zhe shi wo di yi ci lai zhe li ， wo bu zhi dao cong na li kai shi 。]

english: Well, lucky for you, that is exactly why I am here.
translation: 好吧，你很幸运，这就是我来这里的原因。 [hao ba ， ni hen xing yun ， zhe jiu shi wo lai zhe li de yuan yin 。]

english: Start by opening your quest panel and then selecting the flashing yellow star.
translation: 首先打开任务面板，然后选择闪烁的黄色星星。 [shou xian da kai ren wu mian ban ， ran hou xuan ze shan shuo de huang se xing xing 。]

english: What are Adventure Paths?
translation: 什么是冒险之路？ [shen me shi mao xian zhi lu ？]

english: Do you have any Adventure Path starter kits for me?
translation: 你们有给我任何冒险之路入门套件吗？ [ni men you gei wo ren he mao xian zhi lu ru men tao jian ma ？]

english: I'd like to claim my Adventure Path rewards.
translation: 我想领取我的冒险之路奖励。 [wo xiang ling qu wo de mao xian zhi lu jiang li 。]

english: Can you show me some Adventure Paths?
translation: 你能给我展示一些冒险路径吗？ [ni neng gei wo zhan shi yi xie mao xian lu jing ma ？]

english: Disable Adventure Paths.
translation: 禁用冒险路径。 [jin yong mao xian lu jing 。]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Greetings, [Sir/Madam].
translation: 您好，[先生/女士]。 [nin hao ，[ xian sheng / nv shi ]。]

english: The King needs someone to take over the rule of the Kingdom. If I were you, I should consider the position.
translation: 国王需要有人来接管王国的统治。如果我是你，我应该考虑这个职位。 [guo wang xu yao you ren lai jie guan wang guo de tong zhi 。 ru guo wo shi ni ， wo ying gai kao lv zhe ge zhi wei 。]

english: Greetings, Your Royal Highness.
translation: 您好，殿下。 [nin hao ， dian xia 。]

english: Your Royal Highness, I should tell you right away that killing the people of this Kingdom will not make you popular with anyone.
translation: 殿下，我应该立刻告诉你，杀掉这个王国的人民不会让你受到任何人的欢迎。 [dian xia ， wo ying gai li ke gao su ni ， sha diao zhe ge wang guo de ren min bu hui rang ni shou dao ren he ren de huan ying 。]

english: How is the Kingdom faring?
translation: 王国的情况如何？ [wang guo de qing kuang ru he ？]

english: Your subjects are worried about the possibility of war, but they are still happy to work for you.
translation: 你的臣民担心战争的可能性，但他们仍然很乐意为你工作。 [ni de chen min dan xin zhan zheng de ke neng xing ， dan ta men reng ran hen le yi wei ni gong zuo 。]

english: What am I meant to be doing again?
