translation: 我现在该怎么办？ [wo xian zai gai zen me ban ？]

english: Just go through the gate in the fence and use the same door you came out of. You can come back whenever you like to tone up your body.
translation: 只需穿过栅栏上的门，然后使用您出来的那扇门即可。您可以随时回来锻炼身体。 [zhi xu chuan guo zha lan shang de men ， ran hou shi yong nin chu lai de na shan men ji ke 。 nin ke yi sui shi hui lai duan lian shen ti 。]

english: He doesn't look like he wants to talk right now.
translation: 他现在看起来不想说话。 [ta xian zai kan qi lai bu xiang shuo hua 。]

english: Have you brought the stick yet?
translation: 你把棍子带来了吗？ [ni ba gun zi dai lai le ma ？]

english: What stick?
translation: 什么棍子？ [shen me gun zi ？]

english: Come on, get round that course - I need something to chew!
translation: 来吧，绕过那门课——我需要一些东西来咀嚼！ [lai ba ， rao guo na men ke —— wo xu yao yi xie dong xi lai ju jue ！]

english: You need to take your headgear off before you try the Deathslide, otherwise you won't be able to get a good enough grip with your teeth.
translation: 在尝试死亡滑梯之前，你需要摘下头套，否则你的牙齿将无法获得足够的抓地力。 [zai chang shi si wang hua ti zhi qian ， ni xu yao zhai xia tou tao ， fou ze ni de ya chi jiang wu fa huo de zu gou de zhua di li 。]

english: Grrr - you don't belong in here, human!
translation: Grrr - 你不属于这里，人类！ [Grrr -  ni bu shu yu zhe li ， ren lei ！]

english: That headgear won't help you here, human! Take it off!
translation: 那个头盔在这里对你没有帮助，人类！把它脱下来！ [na ge tou kui zai zhe li dui ni mei you bang zhu ， ren lei ！ ba ta tuo xia lai ！]

english: Remember - a slow wolf is a hungry wolf!!
translation: 记住——慢狼是饿狼！ [ji zhu —— man lang shi e lang ！]

english: Get on with it - you need your whiskers perking!!!!
translation: 继续吧 - 你需要让你的胡须振作起来！！！！ [ji xu ba  -  ni xu yao rang ni de hu xu zhen zuo qi lai ！！！！]

english: Claws first - think later.
translation: 先用爪子——然后再想。 [xian yong zhua zi —— ran hou zai xiang 。]

english: Imagine the smell of blood in your nostrils!!!
translation: 想象一下你鼻孔里的血腥味！！！ [xiang xiang yi xia ni bi kong li de xue xing wei ！！！]

english: I never really wanted to be an agility trainer...
translation: 我从来没有真正想成为一名敏捷教练...... [wo cong lai mei you zhen zheng xiang cheng wei yi ming min jie jiao lian ......]

english: It'll be worth it when you hunt!!
translation: 当你狩猎时，这是值得的！ [dang ni shou lie shi ， zhe shi zhi de de ！]

english: Let's see those powerful backlegs at work!!
translation: 让我们看看那些强大的后腿在工作！ [rang wo men kan kan na xie qiang da de hou tui zai gong zuo ！]

english: Let the bloodlust take you!!
translation: 让嗜血的欲望带你走！！ [rang shi xue de yu wang dai ni zou ！！]

english: You're the slowest wolf I've ever had the misfortune to witness!!
translation: 你是我不幸见过的跑得最慢的狼！！ [ni shi wo bu xing jian guo de pao de zui man de lang ！！]

english: When you're done there's a human with your name on it!!
translation: 当你完成后，就会出现一个写有你名字的人！ [dang ni wan cheng hou ， jiu hui chu xian yi ge xie you ni ming zi de ren ！]

english: You idiot - you've forgotten the stick!!!!
translation: 你这个白痴——你忘了拿棍子！！！ [ni zhe ge bai chi —— ni wang le na gun zi ！！！]

english: Give my regards to the ground...
translation: 请代我向大地问好…… [qing dai wo xiang da di wen hao ……]

english: WAAAAAARRRGGGHHHH!!!!!!
translation: 哇啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！ [wa a a a a a a ！！！！！！]

english: Don't let the spikes or the blood put you off...
translation: 不要让尖刺或鲜血让你失望...... [bu yao rang jian ci huo xian xue rang ni shi wang ......]

english: Now for a true test of teeth...
translation: 现在进行真正的牙齿测试...... [xian zai jin xing zhen zheng de ya chi ce shi ......]

english: You shouldn't even be here, human!
translation: 你根本不应该在这里，人类！ [ni gen ben bu ying gai zai zhe li ， ren lei ！]

english: Let's see how strong human teeth are...
translation: 让我们看看人类的牙齿有多坚固…… [rang wo men kan kan ren lei de ya chi you duo jian gu ……]

english: Remember - no stick, no agility bonus!
translation: 请记住——没有棍棒，就没有敏捷加成！ [qing ji zhu —— mei you gun bang ， jiu mei you min jie jia cheng ！]

english: Bring me the stick when you've finished the course!
translation: 当你完成课程后，把棍子给我拿来！ [dang ni wan cheng ke cheng hou ， ba gun zi gei wo na lai ！]

english: Don't forget to give me the stick when you're done!
translation: 完成后别忘了把棍子给我！ [wan cheng hou bie wang le ba gun zi gei wo ！]

english: Oh no, not another human... what do you want then?
translation: 哦不，不是另一个人……那你想要什么？ [o bu ， bu shi ling yi ge ren …… na ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Oh, do you get humans here often?
translation: 哦，你们经常带人来这里吗？ [o ， ni men jing chang dai ren lai zhe li ma ？]

english: Not that often, no, but sometimes.
translation: 不经常，不，但有时。 [bu jing chang ， bu ， dan you shi 。]

english: Of course, since you people are too big for dwarven clothes, they typically don't stay very long.
translation: 当然，由于你们对于矮人的衣服来说太大了，所以他们通常不会停留很长时间。 [dang ran ， you yu ni men dui yu ai ren de yi fu lai shuo tai da le ， suo yi ta men tong chang bu hui ting liu hen zhang shi jian 。]

english: Why don't you make bigger clothes then?
translation: 那你为什么不做大一点的衣服呢？ [na ni wei shen me bu zuo da yi dian de yi fu ne ？]

english: What'd be the point? Besides, I don't make these clothes myself.
translation: 有什么意义呢？而且，这些衣服不是我自己做的。 [you shen me yi yi ne ？ er qie ， zhe xie yi fu bu shi wo zi ji zuo de 。]

english: Who makes these clothes then?
translation: 那么这些衣服是谁做的呢？ [na me zhe xie yi fu shi shui zuo de ne ？]

english: Oh, my sister, she lives in Keldagrim-East. Has a little stall on the other side of the Kelda.
translation: Oh, my sister, she lives in Keldagrim-East.在凯尔达河的另一边有一个小摊位。 [Oh, my sister, she lives in Keldagrim-East. zai kai er da he de ling yi bian you yi ge xiao tan wei 。]

english: If she only worked a little harder, like me, she wouldn't have to live in the sewers of the city. Shame really.
translation: 如果她像我一样努力一点，就不用住在城市的下水道里了。真是耻辱。 [ru guo ta xiang wo yi yang nu li yi dian ， jiu bu yong zhu zai cheng shi de xia shui dao li le 。 zhen shi chi ru 。]

english: The sewers? Your sister lives in the sewers?
translation: 下水道？你姐姐住在下水道里？ [xia shui dao ？ ni jie jie zhu zai xia shui dao li ？]

english: Keldagrim-East, such a ghastly place. Not civil, polite and clean like we are in the West.
translation: 凯尔达格林东，真是一个可怕的地方。不像我们西方人那样文明、礼貌和干净。 [kai er da ge lin dong ， zhen shi yi ge ke pa de di fang 。 bu xiang wo men xi fang ren na yang wen ming 、 li mao he gan jing 。]

english: Uh-huh.
translation: 嗯嗯。 [n n 。]

english: So do you have any quests for me?
translation: 那么你有什么任务要找我吗？ [na me ni you shen me ren wu yao zhao wo ma ？]

english: Quests? Why would I have any quests?
translation: 任务？为什么我会有任务？ [ren wu ？ wei shen me wo hui you ren wu ？]

english: Oh, just anything to do would be fine.
translation: 哦，只要做点什么就可以了。 [o ， zhi yao zuo dian shen me jiu ke yi le 。]

english: No, not right now... maybe I'll have something for you to do later, but nothing at the moment.
translation: 不，不是现在……也许我稍后会给你做点什么，但现在什么也没有。 [bu ， bu shi xian zai …… ye xu wo shao hou hui gei ni zuo dian shen me ， dan xian zai shen me ye mei you 。]

english: Who makes these clothes then?
translation: 那么这些衣服是谁做的呢？ [na me zhe xie yi fu shi shui zuo de ne ？]

english: I still want to buy your clothes.
translation: 我还想买你的衣服。 [wo hai xiang mai ni de yi fu 。]

english: So do you have any quests for me?
translation: 那么你有什么任务要找我吗？ [na me ni you shen me ren wu yao zhao wo ma ？]

english: I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: 我不能和你这个外地人说话！与酋长布伦特交谈！ [wo bu neng he ni zhe ge wai di ren shuo hua ！ yu qiu zhang bu lun te jiao tan ！]

english: You stay away from me outerlander!
translation: 你这个外地人离我远点！ [ni zhe ge wai di ren li wo yuan dian ！]

english: They are too suspicious of you for you to get close enough to steal from them.
translation: 他们对你太怀疑了，你无法靠近他们去偷东西。 [ta men dui ni tai huai yi le ， ni wu fa kao jin ta men qu tou dong xi 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: 再次你好[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]。今天你需要我做什么？您永远可以信赖我的帮助！ [zai ci ni hao [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 jin tian ni xu yao wo zuo shen me ？ nin yong yuan ke yi xin lai wo de bang zhu ！]

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。我只是想聊聊。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。 wo zhi shi xiang liao liao 。]

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: 如果您需要我的帮助[弗雷曼尼克名字]，我的门永远敞开。 [ru guo nin xu yao wo de bang zhu [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]， wo de men yong yuan chang kai 。]

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: [弗雷曼尼克名字]...我们已经很久没有见面了！ [[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]... wo men yi jing hen jiu mei you jian mian le ！]

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: 欢迎回来[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]。很高兴在这里见到您！ [huan ying hui lai [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 hen gao xing zai zhe li jian dao nin ！]

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: 我很抱歉[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]！我没时间陪你在这里！ [wo hen bao qian [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！ wo mei shi jian pei ni zai zhe li ！]

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
translation: 没关系，我其实什么都不想要。 [mei guan xi ， wo qi shi shen me dou bu xiang yao 。]

english: How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: 你[弗雷曼尼克名字]怎么样？我希望您这一天一切顺利！ [ni [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ] zen me yang ？ wo xi wang nin zhe yi tian yi qie shun li ！]

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
translation: 我很好，谢谢，你好吗？ [wo hen hao ， xie xie ， ni hao ma ？]

english: All is well with me also!
translation: 我也一切都好！ [wo ye yi qie dou hao ！]

english: Hello to you, too!
translation: 也向你问好！ [ye xiang ni wen hao ！]

english: Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你好。你想要什么东西[弗雷曼尼克名字]吗？ [ni hao 。 ni xiang yao shen me dong xi [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ] ma ？]

english: No, not really.
translation: 不，不是真的。 [bu ， bu shi zhen de 。]

english: Well... okay then!
translation: 嗯……那好吧！ [n …… na hao ba ！]

english: Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
translation: 很高兴见到你[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]。 [hen gao xing jian dao ni [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。]

english: You shame us, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你让我们感到羞耻，[弗雷曼尼克名字]！ [ni rang wo men gan dao xiu chi ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！]

english: How can you steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你怎么能偷我的东西，[弗雷曼尼克名字]？ [ni zen me neng tou wo de dong xi ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]？]

english: You have betrayed your heritage, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你背叛了你的传统，[弗雷曼尼克名字]！ [ni bei pan le ni de chuan tong ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！]

english: Why would you try to steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你为什么要偷我的东西，[弗雷曼尼克名字]？ [ni wei shen me yao tou wo de dong xi ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]？]

english: Arrr, matey!
translation: 啊，伙计！ [a ， huo ji ！]

english: I'm looking for Redbeard Frank.
translation: 我正在寻找红胡子弗兰克。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao hong hu zi fu lan ke 。]

english: Redbeard Frank ye say? He be outside. Says he likes the feel of the wind on his cheeks.
translation: 红胡子弗兰克你说呢？他在外面。说他喜欢风拂过脸颊的感觉。 [hong hu zi fu lan ke ni shuo ne ？ ta zai wai mian 。 shuo ta xi huan feng fu guo lian jia de gan jue 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Arrr!
Are you going to sit there all day?
translation: 你要坐在那里一整天吗？ [ni yao zuo zai na li yi zheng tian ma ？]

english: Aye, I am. I canna walk, ye see.
translation: 是的，我是。我不能走路，你瞧。 [shi de ， wo shi 。 wo bu neng zou lu ， ni qiao 。]

english: What's stopping you from walking?
translation: 是什么阻止你行走？ [shi shen me zu zhi ni xing zou ？]

english: Arrr, I 'ave only the one leg! I lost its twin when my last ship went down.
translation: 哎呀，我只有一条腿了！当我的最后一艘船沉没时，我失去了它的双胞胎。 [ai ya ， wo zhi you yi tiao tui le ！ dang wo de zui hou yi sou chuan chen mo shi ， wo shi qu le ta de shuang bao tai 。]

english: But I can see both your legs!
translation: 但我可以看到你的双腿！ [dan wo ke yi kan dao ni de shuang tui ！]

english: Nay, young [laddie/lassie], this be a false leg. For years I had me a sturdy wooden peg-leg, but now I wear this dainty little feller.
translation: 不，年轻的[小伙子/小姑娘]，这是一条假腿。多年来，我一直拥有一条坚固的木制假腿，但现在我戴着这个精致的小家伙。 [bu ， nian qing de [ xiao huo zi / xiao gu niang ]， zhe shi yi tiao jia tui 。 duo nian lai ， wo yi zhi yong you yi tiao jian gu de mu zhi jia tui ， dan xian zai wo dai zhe zhe ge jing zhi de xiao jia huo 。]

english: Yon peg-leg kept getting stuck in the floorboards.
translation: 你的木腿老是卡在地板里。 [ni de mu tui lao shi ka zai di ban li 。]

english: Right...
translation: 正确的... [zheng que de ...]

english: Perhaps a [bright young laddie/bonnie young lassie] like yerself would like to help me? I be needing another ship to go a-hunting my enemy.
translation: 也许像你这样的[聪明的年轻小伙子/邦妮年轻的小伙子]愿意帮助我？我需要另一艘船去追捕我的敌人。 [ye xu xiang ni zhe yang de [ cong ming de nian qing xiao huo zi / bang ni nian qing de xiao huo zi ] yuan yi bang zhu wo ？ wo xu yao ling yi sou chuan qu zhui bu wo de di ren 。]

english: Well, I do have a ship that I'm not using. It's the Lady Lumbridge.
translation: 好吧，我确实有一艘我没有使用的船。这是伦布里奇夫人。 [hao ba ， wo que shi you yi sou wo mei you shi yong de chuan 。 zhe shi lun bu li qi fu ren 。]

english: Arrr! That ship be known to me, and a fine lass she is.
translation: 啊！我认识那艘船，她是一位漂亮的姑娘。 [a ！ wo ren shi na sou chuan ， ta shi yi wei piao liang de gu niang 。]

english: I suppose she might be...
translation: 我想她可能是... [wo xiang ta ke neng shi ...]

english: So would ye be kind enough to let me take her out to sea?
translation: 那么你能好心让我带她出海吗？ [na me ni neng hao xin rang wo dai ta chu hai ma ？]

english: I had to pay 2000 gp for that ship. Have you got that much?
translation: 我必须为那艘船支付 2000 gp。你有这么多吗？ [wo bi xu wei na sou chuan zhi fu  2000 gp。 ni you zhe me duo ma ？]

english: Hmmm. And can you afford another ship?
translation: 嗯。你能买得起另一艘船吗？ [n 。 ni neng mai de qi ling yi sou chuan ma ？]

english: Nay, I have nary a penny to my name. All my worldly goods went down with me old ship.
translation: 不，我名下一分钱都没有。我所有的世俗物品都随着我的旧船一起沉没了。 [bu ， wo ming xia yi fen qian dou mei you 。 wo suo you de shi su wu pin dou sui zhe wo de jiu chuan yi qi chen mo le 。]

english: So you're actually asking me to give you a free ship.
translation: 所以你实际上是在要求我免费给你一艘船。 [suo yi ni shi ji shang shi zai yao qiu wo mian fei gei ni yi sou chuan 。]

english: Arrr! Would ye be so kind?
translation: 啊！你们会这么好心吗？ [a ！ ni men hui zhe me hao xin ma ？]

english: No I jolly well wouldn't!
translation: 不，我非常不会！ [bu ， wo fei chang bu hui ！]

english: Arrr.
translation: 排列。 [pai lie 。]

english: Do you have anything for trade?
translation: 你有什么东西可以交易吗？ [ni you shen me dong xi ke yi jiao yi ma ？]

english: Nothin' at the moment, but then again the Customs Agents are on the warpath right now.
translation: 目前还没有什么事情，但海关人员现在又陷入了战争状态。 [mu qian hai mei you shen me shi qing ， dan hai guan ren yuan xian zai you xian ru le zhan zheng zhuang tai 。]

english: Oi matey, leave my beer alone!
translation: 哎呀，伙计，别管我的啤酒！ [ai ya ， huo ji ， bie guan wo de pi jiu ！]

english: Sorry!
translation: 对不起！ [dui bu qi ！]

english: Oi matey, no casting spells on my beer!
translation: 哎呀伙计，别对我的啤酒施咒！ [ai ya huo ji ， bie dui wo de pi jiu shi zhou ！]

english: I'm looking for Redbeard Frank.
translation: 我正在寻找红胡子弗兰克。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao hong hu zi fu lan ke 。]

english: Arrr!
Are you going to sit there all day?
translation: 你要坐在那里一整天吗？ [ni yao zuo zai na li yi zheng tian ma ？]

english: Do you want to trade?
translation: 你想交易吗？ [ni xiang jiao yi ma ？]

english: You dare disturb my rest!
translation: 你居然敢打扰我休息！ [ni ju ran gan da rao wo xiu xi ！]

english: You dare steal from us!
translation: 你竟然敢偷我们的东西！ [ni jing ran gan tou wo men de dong xi ！]

english: Gratias tibi ago!
translation: 谢谢你！ [xie xie ni ！]

english: Hello. Do you wish me to exchange banknotes for you? I charge only 5 coins for each banknote.
translation: 你好。您需要我为您兑换钞票吗？我每张钞票只收取 5 个硬币。 [ni hao 。 nin xu yao wo wei nin dui huan chao piao ma ？ wo mei zhang chao piao zhi shou qu  5  ge ying bi 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Hand me the banknotes you wish me to exchange.
translation: 把你要我兑换的钞票递给我。 [ba ni yao wo dui huan de chao piao di gei wo 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I am Aisles. I can exchange banknotes for real items. Do you want any banknotes converted?
translation: 我是艾尔斯。我可以用纸币兑换实物。您想要兑换任何纸币吗？ [wo shi ai er si 。 wo ke yi yong zhi bi dui huan shi wu 。 nin xiang yao dui huan ren he zhi bi ma ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: I exchange banknotes for real items. That's not a banknote.
translation: I exchange banknotes for real items.那不是钞票。 [I exchange banknotes for real items. na bu shi chao piao 。]

english: I charge 5 coins for exchanging each banknote.
translation: 兑换每张钞票我收取5个硬币。 [dui huan mei zhang chao piao wo shou qu 5 ge ying bi 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Exchange [item name]: 5 coins
translation: 兑换【物品名称】：5币 [dui huan 【 wu pin ming cheng 】：5 bi]

english: Exchange All: [number of banknotes x 5] coins
translation: 全部兑换：[纸币数量 x 5] 枚硬币 [quan bu dui huan ：[ zhi bi shu liang  x 5]  mei ying bi]

english: Cancel
translation: 取消 [qu xiao]

english: Greetings, fellow warrior. I am Ajjat, former black knight and now training officer here in the warrior guild.
translation: 问候，战友。我是阿贾特，前黑骑士，现在是战士公会的训练官。 [wen hou ， zhan you 。 wo shi a jia te ， qian hei qi shi ， xian zai shi zhan shi gong hui de xun lian guan 。]

english: Can you tell me about skillcapes, please?
translation: 请告诉我有关技能的信息好吗？ [qing gao su wo you guan ji neng de xin xi hao ma ？]

english: Skillcapes, also known as Capes of Accomplishment, are reserved for the elite of the elite. Only a person who has truly mastered a skill can buy one, and even then a skillcape can only be bought from one who is
translation: 技能斗篷，也称为成就斗篷，是为精英中的精英保留的。只有真正掌握了某项技能的人才能购买，即使如此，技能斗篷也只能从真正掌握了某项技能的人那里购买。 [ji neng dou peng ， ye cheng wei cheng jiu dou peng ， shi wei jing ying zhong de jing ying bao liu de 。 zhi you zhen zheng zhang wo le mou xiang ji neng de ren cai neng gou mai ， ji shi ru ci ， ji neng dou peng ye zhi neng cong zhen zheng zhang wo le mou xiang ji neng de ren na li gou mai 。]

english: recognised as the highest skilled in the land at any particular skill.
translation: 被公认为该国任何特定技能方面的最高技能。 [bei gong ren wei gai guo ren he te ding ji neng fang mian de zui gao ji neng 。]

english: I have the privilege of being the person that controls access to the Skillcape of Attack, which Kamfreena will recognize and allow you to access her Cyclopes without the need for guild tokens.
translation: 我有幸成为控制攻击技能的人，Kamfreena 会识别并允许你访问她的独眼巨人而无需公会令牌。 [wo you xing cheng wei kong zhi gong ji ji neng de ren ，Kamfreena  hui shi bie bing yun xu ni fang wen ta de du yan ju ren er wu xu gong hui ling pai 。]

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 还有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [hai you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

english: Black Knight? Why are you here?
translation: 黑骑士？你为什么在这里？ [hei qi shi ？ ni wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: Indeed I was, however their... methods... did not match with my ideals.. so I left. Harrallak, recognising my talent as a warrior, took me in and offered me a job here.
translation: 确实我是，但是他们的...方法...与我的理想不符..所以我离开了。哈拉拉克认识到我作为战士的天赋，于是收留了我，并为我提供了一份工作。 [que shi wo shi ， dan shi ta men de ... fang fa ... yu wo de li xiang bu fu .. suo yi wo li kai le 。 ha la la ke ren shi dao wo zuo wei zhan shi de tian fu ， yu shi shou liu le wo ， bing wei wo ti gong le yi fen gong zuo 。]

english: Hmm... well if Harrallak trusts you, I guess I can.
translation: 嗯……好吧，如果哈拉拉克信任你，我想我可以。 [n …… hao ba ， ru guo ha la la ke xin ren ni ， wo xiang wo ke yi 。]

english: What's the Dummy Room all about?
translation: 虚拟房间是做什么的？ [xu ni fang jian shi zuo shen me de ？]

english: Ahh yes, the dummies. Another ingenious invention of the noble Dwarf Gamfred. They're mechanical you see and pop up out of the floor. You have to hit them with the correct attack mode before they disappear again.
translation: 啊，是的，假人。高贵的矮人甘弗雷德的另一项巧妙发明。你看，它们是机械的，从地板上弹出。在它们再次消失之前，你必须用正确的攻击模式击中它们。 [a ， shi de ， jia ren 。 gao gui de ai ren gan fu lei de de ling yi xiang qiao miao fa ming 。 ni kan ， ta men shi ji xie de ， cong di ban shang dan chu 。 zai ta men zai ci xiao shi zhi qian ， ni bi xu yong zheng que de gong ji mo shi ji zhong ta men 。]

english: So how do I tell which one is which?
translation: 那么我如何辨别哪个是哪个呢？ [na me wo ru he bian bie na ge shi na ge ne ？]

english: There are two different ways. One indication is their colour, the other is the pose and weapons they are holding, for instance, the one holding daggers you will need to hit with a piercing attack.
translation: 有两种不同的方法。一个指示是他们的颜色，另一个指示是他们所持有的姿势和武器，例如，你需要用穿刺攻击来击中持有匕首的人。 [you liang zhong bu tong de fang fa 。 yi ge zhi shi shi ta men de yan se ， ling yi ge zhi shi shi ta men suo chi you de zi shi he wu qi ， li ru ， ni xu yao yong chuan ci gong ji lai ji zhong chi you bi shou de ren 。]

english: In the room you will find a poster on the wall which can help you recognise each different dummy.
translation: 在房间里，您会在墙上找到一张海报，可以帮助您识别每个不同的假人。 [zai fang jian li ， nin hui zai qiang shang zhao dao yi zhang hai bao ， ke yi bang zhu nin shi bie mei ge bu tong de jia ren 。]

english: That sounds ingenious!
translation: 听起来很巧妙！ [ting qi lai hen qiao miao ！]

english: Indeed, you may find that you need several weapons to be successful 100% of the time, but keep trying. The weapons shop upstairs may help you there.
translation: 事实上，您可能会发现需要多种武器才能 100% 成功，但请继续尝试。楼上的武器店可能会帮助你。 [shi shi shang ， nin ke neng hui fa xian xu yao duo zhong wu qi cai neng  100%  cheng gong ， dan qing ji xu chang shi 。 lou shang de wu qi dian ke neng hui bang zhu ni 。]

english: May I claim my tokens please?
translation: 我可以领取我的代币吗？ [wo ke yi ling qu wo de dai bi ma ？]

english: Of course! Here you go, you've earned [amount] tokens!
translation: 当然！在这里，您已经获得了[数量]个代币！ [dang ran ！ zai zhe li ， nin yi jing huo de le [ shu liang ] ge dai bi ！]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: I'm afraid you have not earned any tokens yet. Try some of the activities around the guild to earn some.
translation: 恐怕您还没有获得任何代币。尝试公会周围的一些活动来赚取一些钱。 [kong pa nin hai mei you huo de ren he dai bi 。 chang shi gong hui zhou wei de yi xie huo dong lai zhuan qu yi xie qian 。]

english: Ok, I'll go see what I can find.
translation: 好吧，我去看看我能找到什么。 [hao ba ， wo qu kan kan wo neng zhao dao shen me 。]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Farewell warrior. Stay away from the dark side.
translation: 告别战士。远离黑暗面。 [gao bie zhan shi 。 yuan li hei an mian 。]

english: Ah, but I can see you are already a master in the fine art of attacking, perhaps you have come to me to purchase a Cape of Attack, and thus join the elite few who have mastered this exacting skill?
translation: 啊，但我看你已经是攻击艺术的大师了，也许你来找我购买攻击斗篷，从而加入掌握这种严格技能的精英行列？ [a ， dan wo kan ni yi jing shi gong ji yi shu de da shi le ， ye xu ni lai zhao wo gou mai gong ji dou peng ， cong er jia ru zhang wo zhe zhong yan ge ji neng de jing ying hang lie ？]

english: When wearing this cape, Kamfreena will recognize your ability and allow you to access her Cyclopes without the need for guild tokens.
translation: 当穿上这件斗篷时，卡姆弗利娜会识别你的能力，并允许你在不需要公会令牌的情况下使用她的独眼巨人。 [dang chuan shang zhe jian dou peng shi ， ka mu fu li na hui shi bie ni de neng li ， bing yun xu ni zai bu xu yao gong hui ling pai de qing kuang xia shi yong ta de du yan ju ren 。]

english: May I buy a Skillcape of Attack, please?
translation: 请问可以购买攻击技能斗篷吗？ [qing wen ke yi gou mai gong ji ji neng dou peng ma ？]

english: Most certainly; unfortunately being such a prestigious item, they are appropriately expensive. I'm afraid I must ask you for the princely sum of 99000 gold!
translation: 最肯定的是；不幸的是，作为如此享有盛誉的物品，它们的价格相当昂贵。恐怕我得向你要九万九千金的大笔钱了！ [zui ken ding de shi ； bu xing de shi ， zuo wei ru ci xiang you sheng yu de wu pin ， ta men de jia ge xiang dang ang gui 。 kong pa wo de xiang ni yao jiu wan jiu qian jin de da bi qian le ！]

english: 99000! Are you mad?
translation: 99000！你疯了？ [99000！ ni feng le ？]

english: Not at all; there are many other adventurers who would love the opportunity to purchase such a prestigious item! You can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: 一点也不;还有许多其他冒险家希望有机会购买如此享有盛誉的物品！如果你改变主意，可以在这里找到我。 [yi dian ye bu ; hai you xu duo qi ta mao xian jia xi wang you ji hui gou mai ru ci xiang you sheng yu de wu pin ！ ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， ke yi zai zhe li zhao dao wo 。]

english: I would gladly pay such a paltry sum for a splendid cape.
translation: 我很乐意花这么少的钱买一件漂亮的斗篷。 [wo hen le yi hua zhe me shao de qian mai yi jian piao liang de dou peng 。]

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 但不幸的是，我身上没有足够的钱。 [dan bu xing de shi ， wo shen shang mei you zu gou de qian 。]

english: Well come back and see me when you do.
translation: 等你回来了就回来见我吧。 [deng ni hui lai le jiu hui lai jian wo ba 。]

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 不幸的是，所有技能斗篷都只提供免费兜帽，这是技能升级交易的一部分；买一送一，你懂的。因此，在我向您出售一件之前，您需要释放一些库存空间。 [bu xing de shi ， suo you ji neng dou peng dou zhi ti gong mian fei dou mao ， zhe shi ji neng sheng ji jiao yi de yi bu fen ； mai yi song yi ， ni dong de 。 yin ci ， zai wo xiang nin chu shou yi jian zhi qian ， nin xu yao shi fang yi xie ku cun kong jian 。]

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: 出色的！我的朋友，自豪地穿上那件斗篷。 [chu se de ！ wo de peng you ， zi hao di chuan shang na jian dou peng 。]

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: 请问我可以再给我的披风戴上兜帽吗？ [qing wen wo ke yi zai gei wo de pi feng dai shang dou mao ma ？]

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
translation: 毫无疑问，而且免费！ [hao wu yi wen ， er qie mian fei ！]

english: Ajjat hands you another hood for your skillcape.
translation: 阿贾特为你的技能斗篷提供了另一顶兜帽。 [a jia te wei ni de ji neng dou peng ti gong le ling yi ding dou mao 。]

english: Can you tell me about skillcapes, please?
translation: 请告诉我有关技能的信息好吗？ [qing gao su wo you guan ji neng de xin xi hao ma ？]

english: Black Knight? Why are you here?
translation: 黑骑士？你为什么在这里？ [hei qi shi ？ ni wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: What's the Dummy Room all about?
translation: 虚拟房间是做什么的？ [xu ni fang jian shi zuo shen me de ？]

english: May I claim my tokens please?
translation: 我可以领取我的代币吗？ [wo ke yi ling qu wo de dai bi ma ？]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: May I buy a Skillcape of Attack, please?
translation: 请问可以购买攻击技能斗篷吗？ [qing wen ke yi gou mai gong ji ji neng dou peng ma ？]

english: 99000 gold! Are you mad?
translation: 99000金币！你疯了？ [99000 jin bi ！ ni feng le ？]

english: I would gladly pay such a paltry sum for a splendid cape.
translation: 我很乐意花这么少的钱买一件漂亮的斗篷。 [wo hen le yi hua zhe me shao de qian mai yi jian piao liang de dou peng 。]

english: Skillcape
translation: 技能角 [ji neng jiao]

english: Hood
translation: 兜帽 [dou mao]

english: Thank you for the translation manual, Ak-Haranu - it may save many souls before long.
translation: 谢谢你的翻译手册，Ak-Haranu - 它很快就会拯救许多灵魂。 [xie xie ni de fan yi shou ce ，Ak-Haranu -  ta hen kuai jiu hui zheng jiu xu duo ling hun 。]

english: And Ak-Haranu thanks you for kind gift of longbow.
translation: 阿克-哈拉努感谢您赠送的长弓礼物。 [a ke - ha la nu gan xie nin zeng song de zhang gong li wu 。]

english: Hi there!
translation: 你好呀！ [ni hao ya ！]

english: Why, helloooo!
translation: 为什么，你好！ [wei shen me ， ni hao ！]

english: A camel?
translation: 骆驼？ [luo tuo ？]

english: Well this is grand darling. How nice it is to make your acquaintance!
translation: 嗯，这是亲爱的。能认识你真是太好了！ [n ， zhe shi qin ai de 。 neng ren shi ni zhen shi tai hao le ！]

english: Thank you. Nice to meet you too.
translation: 谢谢。我也很高兴见到你。 [xie xie 。 wo ye hen gao xing jian dao ni 。]

english: Wait a minute. How am I talking to you without a Camulet?
translation: 等一下。没有卡姆莱特我怎么跟你说话呢？ [deng yi xia 。 mei you ka mu lai te wo zen me gen ni shuo hua ne ？]

english: My dear, I'm a camel, how should I know?
translation: 亲爱的，我是一头骆驼，我怎么知道？ [qin ai de ， wo shi yi tou luo tuo ， wo zen me zhi dao ？]

english: Hmmm. I suppose this spell must tap directly into your mind. So, there's no need for language to get in the way.
translation: 嗯。我想这个咒语一定会直接进入你的脑海。所以，没有必要用语言来妨碍。 [n 。 wo xiang zhe ge zhou yu yi ding hui zhi jie jin ru ni de nao hai 。 suo yi ， mei you bi yao yong yu yan lai fang ai 。]

english: I think I am somewhat confused.
translation: 我想我有些困惑。 [wo xiang wo you xie kun huo 。]

english: May one ask how you contacted me?
translation: 请问你是怎么联系我的？ [qing wen ni shi zen me lian xi wo de ？]

english: I'm just using one of the Lunar spells.
translation: 我只是使用了月球法术之一。 [wo zhi shi shi yong le yue qiu fa shu zhi yi 。]

english: Oh my, oh my. These youngsters today and their new-fangled gadgets!
translation: 天哪，天哪。今天的这些年轻人和他们的新奇玩意！ [tian na ， tian na 。 jin tian de zhe xie nian qing ren he ta men de xin qi wan yi ！]

english: Hello Effendi!
translation: 你好，阿芬迪！ [ni hao ， a fen di ！]

english: I am Al Shabim, greetings on behalf of the Bedabin nomads.
translation: 我是 Al Shabim，代表贝达宾游牧民族向您致以问候。 [wo shi  Al Shabim， dai biao bei da bin you mu min zu xiang nin zhi yi wen hou 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I am Al Shabim Effendi! I am the leader of the Bedabin peoples!
translation: 我是阿尔·沙比姆·阿芬迪！我是贝达宾人民的领袖！ [wo shi a er · sha bi mu · a fen di ！ wo shi bei da bin ren min de ling xiu ！]

english: Okay Thanks!
translation: 好的，谢谢！ [hao de ， xie xie ！]

english: Good day Effendi!
translation: 美好的一天，阿芬迪！ [mei hao de yi tian ， a fen di ！]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: Well, we are all very busy most of the time, tending to the pineapples. They are grown in a secret location, to stop thieves from raiding our most precious prize.
translation: 嗯，大部分时间我们都很忙，照顾菠萝。它们生长在一个秘密地点，以防止窃贼袭击我们最珍贵的战利品。 [n ， da bu fen shi jian wo men dou hen mang ， zhao gu bo luo 。 ta men sheng zhang zai yi ge mi mi di dian ， yi fang zhi qie zei xi ji wo men zui zhen gui de zhan li pin 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This is the home of the Bedabin. We're a peaceful tribe of desert dwellers. Some idiots call us 'Tenti's', a childish name borne of ignorance.
translation: 这是贝达宾人的家。我们是一个和平的沙漠居民部落。有些白痴称我们为“Tenti's”，这是一个出于无知而产生的幼稚名字。 [zhe shi bei da bin ren de jia 。 wo men shi yi ge he ping de sha mo ju min bu luo 。 you xie bai chi cheng wo men wei “Tenti's”， zhe shi yi ge chu yu wu zhi er chan sheng de you zhi ming zi 。]

english: We're renowned for surviving in the harshest desert climate. We also grow the 'Bedabin ambrosia.'... A pineapple of such delicious sumptiousness that it defies description.
translation: 我们以能在最恶劣的沙漠气候中生存而闻名。我们还种植“Bedabin ambrosia”……一种美味无比的菠萝，难以用语言来形容。 [wo men yi neng zai zui e lie de sha mo qi hou zhong sheng cun er wen ming 。 wo men hai zhong zhi “Bedabin ambrosia”…… yi zhong mei wei wu bi de bo luo ， nan yi yong yu yan lai xing rong 。]

english: Take a look around our camp if you like!
translation: 如果您愿意，请参观我们的营地！ [ru guo nin yuan yi ， qing can guan wo men de ying di ！]

english: I am Al Shabim, greetings on behalf of the Bedabin nomads. Now... what can I do for you?
translation: 我是 Al Shabim，代表贝达宾游牧民族向您致以问候。现在...我能为你做什么？ [wo shi  Al Shabim， dai biao bei da bin you mu min zu xiang nin zhi yi wen hou 。 xian zai ... wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: I am looking for a pineapple.
translation: 我在找菠萝。 [wo zai zhao bo luo 。]

english: Oh yes, well that is interesting. Our sweet pineapples are renowned throughout the whole of Kharid ! And I'll give you one if you do me a favour?
translation: 哦，是的，这很有趣。我们的甜菠萝在整个卡里德享有盛誉！如果你帮我一个忙，我就给你一个？ [o ， shi de ， zhe hen you qu 。 wo men de tian bo luo zai zheng ge ka li de xiang you sheng yu ！ ru guo ni bang wo yi ge mang ， wo jiu gei ni yi ge ？]

english: Oh yes?
translation: 哦是的？ [o shi de ？]

english: Captain Siad at the mining camp is holding some secret information. It is very important to us and we would like you to get it for us. It gives details of an interesting, yet ancient weapon.
translation: 采矿营地的西亚德队长掌握着一些秘密信息。这对我们非常重要，我们希望您为我们获取它。它提供了一种有趣但古老的武器的细节。 [cai kuang ying di de xi ya de dui zhang zhang wo zhe yi xie mi mi xin xi 。 zhe dui wo men fei chang zhong yao ， wo men xi wang nin wei wo men huo qu ta 。 ta ti gong le yi zhong you qu dan gu lao de wu qi de xi jie 。]

english: We would gladly share this information with you. All you have to do is gain access to his private room upstairs. We have a key for the chest that contains this information. Are you interested in our deal?
translation: 我们很乐意与您分享此信息。您所要做的就是进入他楼上的私人房间。我们有一把包含这些信息的箱子钥匙。您对我们的交易感兴趣吗？ [wo men hen le yi yu nin fen xiang ci xin xi 。 nin suo yao zuo de jiu shi jin ru ta lou shang de si ren fang jian 。 wo men you yi ba bao han zhe xie xin xi de xiang zi yao shi 。 nin dui wo men de jiao yi gan xing qu ma ？]

english: Yes, I'm interested.
translation: 是的，我有兴趣。 [shi de ， wo you xing qu 。]

english: That's great Effendi!
translation: 太棒了，阿芬迪！ [tai bang le ， a fen di ！]

english: Here is a copy of the key that should give you access to the chest.
translation: 这是可以让你打开宝箱的钥匙的副本。 [zhe shi ke yi rang ni da kai bao xiang de yao shi de fu ben 。]

english: Bring us back the plans inside the chest, they should be sealed. All haste to you Effendi!
translation: 把箱子里的图纸带回来，应该是密封的。阿芬迪，大家快点！ [ba xiang zi li de tu zhi dai hui lai ， ying gai shi mi feng de 。 a fen di ， da jia kuai dian ！]

english: Not at the moment.
translation: 目前还没有。 [mu qian hai mei you 。]

english: Very well Effendi!
translation: 很好，阿芬迪！ [hen hao ， a fen di ！]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: How are things going Effendi?
translation: 阿芬迪 进展如何？ [a fen di   jin zhan ru he ？]

english: I've lost the key!
translation: 我丢了钥匙！ [wo diu le yao shi ！]

english: How very careless of you! Here is another key, don't lose it this time !
translation: 你真是太不小心了！这是另一把钥匙，这次别弄丢了！ [ni zhen shi tai bu xiao xin le ！ zhe shi ling yi ba yao shi ， zhe ci bie nong diu le ！]

english: Goodbye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Very well, good day Effendi!
translation: 很好，美好的一天，阿芬迪！ [hen hao ， mei hao de yi tian ， a fen di ！]

english: Aha! I see you have the plans. This is great! However, these plans do indeed look very technical. My people have further need of your skills.
translation: 啊哈！我看你已经有计划了。这太棒了！不过，这些计划看起来确实非常技术性。我的人民更需要你的技能。 [a ha ！ wo kan ni yi jing you ji hua le 。 zhe tai bang le ！ bu guo ， zhe xie ji hua kan qi lai que shi fei chang ji shu xing 。 wo de ren min geng xu yao ni de ji neng 。]

english: If you can help us to manufacture this item, we will share its secret with you. Does this deal interest you effendi?
translation: 如果您能帮助我们制造该产品，我们将与您分享其秘密。您对这笔交易感兴趣吗？ [ru guo nin neng bang zhu wo men zhi zao gai chan pin ， wo men jiang yu nin fen xiang qi mi mi 。 nin dui zhe bi jiao yi gan xing qu ma ？]

english: Yes, I'm very interested.
translation: 是的，我很感兴趣。 [shi de ， wo hen gan xing qu 。]

english: Great, we need the following items: a bar of pure bronze, 10 feathers and a hammer. Bring them to me and we'll continue to make the item.
translation: 太好了，我们需要以下物品：一根纯青铜棒、10 根羽毛和一把锤子。把它们带给我，我们将继续制作该物品。 [tai hao le ， wo men xu yao yi xia wu pin ： yi gen chun qing tong bang 、10  gen yu mao he yi ba chui zi 。 ba ta men dai gei wo ， wo men jiang ji xu zhi zuo gai wu pin 。]

english: Great, we need the following items: a bar of pure bronze and 10 feathers. Bring them to me and we'll continue to make the item.
translation: 太好了，我们需要以下物品：一根纯青铜棒和 10 根羽毛。把它们带给我，我们将继续制作该物品。 [tai hao le ， wo men xu yao yi xia wu pin ： yi gen chun qing tong bang he  10  gen yu mao 。 ba ta men dai gei wo ， wo men jiang ji xu zhi zuo gai wu pin 。]

english: Great, I can see that you have a bar of bronze. Now we just need some feathers and a hammer before we can continue.
translation: 太好了，我看到你有一块青铜锭。现在我们只需要一些羽毛和一把锤子就可以继续。 [tai hao le ， wo kan dao ni you yi kuai qing tong ding 。 xian zai wo men zhi xu yao yi xie yu mao he yi ba chui zi jiu ke yi ji xu 。]

english: Great, I can see that you have some feathers. Now we just need a bar of bronze and a hammer before we can continue.
translation: 太好了，我看到你有一些羽毛。现在我们只需要一根青铜棒和一把锤子就可以继续。 [tai hao le ， wo kan dao ni you yi xie yu mao 。 xian zai wo men zhi xu yao yi gen qing tong bang he yi ba chui zi jiu ke yi ji xu 。]

english: Great, I can see that you have a bar of bronze. Now we just need some feathers before we can continue.
translation: 太好了，我看到你有一块青铜锭。现在我们只需要一些羽毛就可以继续。 [tai hao le ， wo kan dao ni you yi kuai qing tong ding 。 xian zai wo men zhi xu yao yi xie yu mao jiu ke yi ji xu 。]

english: Great, I can see that you have some feathers. Now we just need a bar of bronze before we can continue.
translation: 太好了，我看到你有一些羽毛。现在我们只需要一块青铜锭就可以继续。 [tai hao le ， wo kan dao ni you yi xie yu mao 。 xian zai wo men zhi xu yao yi kuai qing tong ding jiu ke yi ji xu 。]

english: Great, I can see that you have some feathers and a bar of Bronze, but you just need a hammer now.
translation: 太好了，我看到你有一些羽毛和一根青铜条，但你现在只需要一把锤子。 [tai hao le ， wo kan dao ni you yi xie yu mao he yi gen qing tong tiao ， dan ni xian zai zhi xu yao yi ba chui zi 。]

english: Great, I can see that you have some feathers, a bar of Bronze and a hammer. Are you still willing to help make the weapon?
translation: 太好了，我看到你有一些羽毛、一根青铜条和一把锤子。你还愿意帮忙制造武器吗？ [tai hao le ， wo kan dao ni you yi xie yu mao 、 yi gen qing tong tiao he yi ba chui zi 。 ni huan yuan yi bang mang zhi zao wu qi ma ？]

english: Yes, I'm kind of curious.
translation: 是的，我有点好奇。 [shi de ， wo you dian hao qi 。]

english: Okay Effendi, you need to follow the plans. You will need some special tools for this...  There is an anvil in the other tent. You have my permission to use it, but show the plans to the guard.
translation: 好吧，阿芬迪，你需要遵循计划。为此，您需要一些特殊的工具...另一个帐篷里有一个铁砧。我允许你使用它，但请向警卫出示计划。 [hao ba ， a fen di ， ni xu yao zun xun ji hua 。 wei ci ， nin xu yao yi xie te shu de gong ju ... ling yi ge zhang peng li you yi ge tie zhen 。 wo yun xu ni shi yong ta ， dan qing xiang jing wei chu shi ji hua 。]

english: You have the plans and all the items needed. You should be able to complete the item on your own. Please bring me the item when it is finished.
translation: 您有计划和所需的所有物品。您应该能够自己完成该项目。完成后请把物品带给我。 [nin you ji hua he suo xu de suo you wu pin 。 nin ying gai neng gou zi ji wan cheng gai xiang mu 。 wan cheng hou qing ba wu pin dai gei wo 。]

english: No, sorry.
translation: 不，抱歉。 [bu ， bao qian 。]

english: As you wish Effendi!
translation: 如你所愿，阿芬迪！ [ru ni suo yuan ， a fen di ！]

english: Come back if you change your mind!
translation: 如果你改变主意就回来吧！ [ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi jiu hui lai ba ！]

english: Wonderful, I see you have made the new weapon!
translation: 太棒了，我看到你已经制作了新武器！ [tai bang le ， wo kan dao ni yi jing zhi zuo le xin wu qi ！]

english: This is truly fantastic Effendi!
translation: 这真是太棒了阿芬迪！ [zhe zhen shi tai bang le a fen di ！]

english: But we will need the technical plans from you Effendi. If we are going to perfect this weapon.
translation: 但我们需要你埃芬迪提供技术计划。如果我们要完善这把武器的话。 [dan wo men xu yao ni ai fen di ti gong ji shu ji hua 。 ru guo wo men yao wan shan zhe ba wu qi de hua 。]

english: We will take the technical plans for the weapon as well.
translation: 我们还将制定该武器的技术计划。 [wo men hai jiang zhi ding gai wu qi de ji shu ji hua 。]

english: We are forever grateful for this gift. My advisors have discovered some secrets which we will share with you.
translation: 我们永远感激这份礼物。我的顾问发现了一些秘密，我们将与您分享。 [wo men yong yuan gan ji zhe fen li wu 。 wo de gu wen fa xian le yi xie mi mi ， wo men jiang yu nin fen xiang 。]

english: Al Shabim's advisors show you some advanced techniques for making the new weapon.
translation: Al Shabim 的顾问向您展示了一些制造新武器的先进技术。 [Al Shabim  de gu wen xiang nin zhan shi le yi xie zhi zao xin wu qi de xian jin ji shu 。]

english: Please accept this selection of six bronze throwing darts as a token of our appreciation.
translation: 请收下这六枚青铜飞镖的精选作品，以表达我们的谢意。 [qing shou xia zhe liu mei qing tong fei biao de jing xuan zuo pin ， yi biao da wo men de xie yi 。]

english: I'll take that key off your hands as well effendi! Many thanks!
translation: 我也会把你手上的钥匙夺走，阿芬迪！非常感谢！ [wo ye hui ba ni shou shang de yao shi duo zou ， a fen di ！ fei chang gan xie ！]

english: Oh, and here is your pineapple!
translation: 哦，这是你的菠萝！ [o ， zhe shi ni de bo luo ！]

english: Many thanks with your help previously Effendi!
translation: 非常感谢您之前的帮助，Effendi！ [fei chang gan xie nin zhi qian de bang zhu ，Effendi！]

english: I am looking for a pineapple.
translation: 我在找菠萝。 [wo zai zhao bo luo 。]

english: Here is another pineapple, try not to lose this one.
translation: 这是另一个菠萝，尽量不要失去这个。 [zhe shi ling yi ge bo luo ， jin liang bu yao shi qu zhe ge 。]

english: Okay thanks!
translation: 好的，谢谢！ [hao de ， xie xie ！]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: Okay Thanks!
translation: 好的，谢谢！ [hao de ， xie xie ！]

english: Yes, I'm interested.
translation: 是的，我有兴趣。 [shi de ， wo you xing qu 。]

english: Not at the moment.
translation: 目前还没有。 [mu qian hai mei you 。]

english: I've lost the key!
translation: 我丢了钥匙！ [wo diu le yao shi ！]

english: Goodbye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Yes, I'm very interested.
translation: 是的，我很感兴趣。 [shi de ， wo hen gan xing qu 。]

english: Yes, I'm kind of curious.
translation: 是的，我有点好奇。 [shi de ， wo you dian hao qi 。]

english: No, sorry.
translation: 不，抱歉。 [bu ， bao qian 。]

english: I'm sorry to bother you, but could you spare me a little dung?
translation: 很抱歉打扰你，但是你能给我一点粪便吗？ [hen bao qian da rao ni ， dan shi ni neng gei wo yi dian fen bian ma ？]

english: The camel didn't seem to appreciate that question.
translation: 骆驼似乎不喜欢这个问题。 [luo tuo si hu bu xi huan zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: If I go near that camel, it'll probably bite my hand off.
translation: 如果我靠近那头骆驼，它可能会咬掉我的手。 [ru guo wo kao jin na tou luo tuo ， ta ke neng hui yao diao wo de shou 。]

english: Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab.
translation: 嗯……看起来那只骆驼可以做一顿美味的烤肉串。 [n …… kan qi lai na zhi luo tuo ke yi zuo yi dun mei wei de kao rou chuan 。]

english: I wonder if that camel has fleas...
translation: 我想知道那只骆驼有没有跳蚤... [wo xiang zhi dao na zhi luo tuo you mei you tiao zao ...]

english: Are you serious?
translation: 你是认真的？ [ni shi ren zhen de ？]

english: Oh yes. If you'd be so kind...
translation: 哦是的。如果你能这么善良的话... [o shi de 。 ru guo ni neng zhe me shan liang de hua ...]

english: Well, just you close your eyes first. I'm not doing it while you're watching me!
translation: 好吧，你先闭上眼睛。当你看着我的时候我不会这么做！ [hao ba ， ni xian bi shang yan jing 。 dang ni kan zhe wo de shi hou wo bu hui zhe me zuo ！]

english: I hope that's what you wanted!
translation: 我希望这就是你想要的！ [wo xi wang zhe jiu shi ni xiang yao de ！]

english: Ohhh yes. Lovely.
translation: 噢，是的。迷人的。 [o ， shi de 。 mi ren de 。]

english: Sorry, were you saying something to me?
translation: 抱歉，你是在对我说什么吗？ [bao qian ， ni shi zai dui wo shuo shen me ma ？]

english: No, er, nothing important.
translation: 不，呃，没什么重要的。 [bu ， e ， mei shen me zhong yao de 。]

english: Never mind, it is unimportant when I have such important matters weighing on my soul.
translation: 没关系，当我有如此重要的事情压在我的灵魂上时，这并不重要。 [mei guan xi ， dang wo you ru ci zhong yao de shi qing ya zai wo de ling hun shang shi ， zhe bing bu zhong yao 。]

english: How important can a camel's problems be?
translation: 骆驼的问题有多重要？ [luo tuo de wen ti you duo zhong yao ？]

english: Well, you see, there is a camel called Elly. A beautiful, wondrous camel, with hide like spun gold and teeth that shine like an oasis.
translation: 嗯，你看，有一只骆驼叫艾莉。一头美丽而奇妙的骆驼，有着金丝般的皮毛和绿洲般闪亮的牙齿。 [n ， ni kan ， you yi zhi luo tuo jiao ai li 。 yi tou mei li er qi miao de luo tuo ， you zhe jin si ban de pi mao he lv zhou ban shan liang de ya chi 。]

english: ...I see.
translation: ...我懂了。 [... wo dong le 。]

english: I've written many poems describing her beauty. Would you like to hear one?
translation: 我写过很多诗来描述她的美丽。您想听一听吗？ [wo xie guo hen duo shi lai miao shu ta de mei li 。 nin xiang ting yi ting ma ？]

english: It's all right, I'm...
translation: 没关系，我... [mei guan xi ， wo ...]

english: Shall I compare thee to a desert's day? Thou art drier and more rough-skinned.
translation: 我可以将你比作沙漠之日吗？你比较干燥，皮肤也比较粗糙。 [wo ke yi jiang ni bi zuo sha mo zhi ri ma ？ ni bi jiao gan zao ， pi fu ye bi jiao cu cao 。]

english: Rough sandstorms shake the cactuses away And summer's heat defers to autumn wind.
translation: 粗暴的沙尘暴将仙人掌摇走，夏天的炎热推迟到秋天的风。 [cu bao de sha chen bao jiang xian ren zhang yao zou ， xia tian de yan re tui chi dao qiu tian de feng 。]

english: Look, I don't really have the time to...
translation: 听着，我实在没有时间... [ting zhe ， wo shi zai mei you shi jian ...]

english: Sometimes too hot the eye of heaven shines, With Guthix' gold complexion often dimmed;
translation: 有时，天眼的光芒过于炽热，古提克斯的金色肤色时常暗淡； [you shi ， tian yan de guang mang guo yu chi re ， gu ti ke si de jin se fu se shi chang an dan ；]

english: And every fair from fair sometime declines, By chance or desert's changing course untrimmed...
translation: 每个展会有时都会衰落，偶然或沙漠未修剪的变化轨迹...... [mei ge zhan hui you shi du hui shuai luo ， ou ran huo sha mo wei xiu jian de bian hua gui ji ......]

english: Please, stop.
translation: 请停下来。 [qing ting xia lai 。]

english: But I've only got six lines left!
translation: 但我只剩下六行了！ [dan wo zhi sheng xia liu xing le ！]

english: That's six too many. If I really want to hear your poetry, I'll tell you, okay?
translation: 这六个太多了。如果我真的想听你的诗，我会告诉你，好吗？ [zhe liu ge tai duo le 。 ru guo wo zhen de xiang ting ni de shi ， wo hui gao su ni ， hao ma ？]

english: Very well. Come back and talk to me if you want to hear more.
translation: 很好。如果您想了解更多信息，请回来与我交谈。 [hen hao 。 ru guo nin xiang liao jie geng duo xin xi ， qing hui lai yu wo jiao tan 。]

english: Oh, it's you again. Have you come back to listen to my poems?
translation: 噢，又是你。你回来听我的诗了吗？ [o ， you shi ni 。 ni hui lai ting wo de shi le ma ？]

english: I'd love to!
translation: 我喜欢！ [wo xi huan ！]

english: That's so kind of you. Which one would you like to hear?
translation: 你真是太好了。您想听哪一首？ [ni zhen shi tai hao le 。 nin xiang ting na yi shou ？]

english: 'Shall I compare thee to a desert's day' is my finest yet, but I've also composed others.
translation: “我可以将你比作沙漠的一天吗”是我迄今为止最好的作品，但我也创作过其他作品。 [“ wo ke yi jiang ni bi zuo sha mo de yi tian ma ” shi wo qi jin wei zhi zui hao de zuo pin ， dan wo ye chuang zuo guo qi ta zuo pin 。]

english: That's my favourite poem. Ahem...
translation: 这是我最喜欢的诗。咳咳…… [zhe shi wo zui xi huan de shi 。 hai hai ……]

english: But thine eternal desert shall not fade Nor lose possession of that sand thou owest;
translation: 但你永恒的沙漠不会褪色，也不会失去你所欠的沙子的所有权； [dan ni yong heng de sha mo bu hui tui shai ， ye bu hui shi qu ni suo qian de sha zi de suo you quan ；]

english: Nor Zamorak brag thou art in his shades, When in eternal lines to sand thou growest,
translation: 萨莫拉克也不会吹嘘你在他的阴影中，当你在永恒的线条中成长时， [sa mo la ke ye bu hui chui xu ni zai ta de yin ying zhong ， dang ni zai yong heng de xian tiao zhong cheng zhang shi ，]

english: So long as camels breathe or eyes can see, So long lives this, and this gives life to thee.
translation: 只要骆驼还能呼吸，眼睛还能看见，它就长寿，它就给你生命。 [zhi yao luo tuo hai neng hu xi ， yan jing hai neng kan jian ， ta jiu chang shou ， ta jiu gei ni sheng ming 。]

english: Ah, Elly, how beautiful you are.
translation: 啊，艾莉，你多么美丽。 [a ， ai li ， ni duo me mei li 。]

english: What does Elly think of your poems?
translation: 艾莉觉得你的诗怎么样？ [ai li jue de ni de shi zen me yang ？]

english: She's never heard them.
translation: 她从来没有听过他们。 [ta cong lai mei you ting guo ta men 。]

english: Why not?
translation: 为什么不呢？ [wei shen me bu ne ？]

english: I suspect she loves another - Ollie, another camel who roams with her to the north.
translation: 我怀疑她爱上了另一只骆驼——奥利，另一只和她一起向北漫游的骆驼。 [wo huai yi ta ai shang le ling yi zhi luo tuo —— ao li ， ling yi zhi he ta yi qi xiang bei man you de luo tuo 。]

english: So I shall stay here and compose poems for her.
translation: 所以我就留在这里为她写诗。 [suo yi wo jiu liu zai zhe li wei ta xie shi 。]

english: Why not tell her how you feel?
translation: 为什么不告诉她你的感受呢？ [wei shen me bu gao su ta ni de gan shou ne ？]

english: She seems happy enough as she is, and I have my poems to comfort me.
translation: 她看上去很幸福，我也有诗来安慰我。 [ta kan shang qu hen xing fu ， wo ye you shi lai an wei wo 。]

english: Well, best of luck with that.
translation: 好吧，祝你好运。 [hao ba ， zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: If you want to hear my poems once more, please come back again.
translation: 如果你想再听我的诗，请再回来。 [ru guo ni xiang zai ting wo de shi ， qing zai hui lai 。]

english: I wrote this poem when I went to the oasis to nibble at a tree, then discovered I'd left nothing for Elly to nibble. I was distraught.
translation: 当我去绿洲啃树时，我写下了这首诗，然后发现我没有留下任何东西让艾莉啃。我心烦意乱。 [dang wo qu lv zhou ken shu shi ， wo xie xia le zhe shou shi ， ran hou fa xian wo mei you liu xia ren he dong xi rang ai li ken 。 wo xin fan yi luan 。]

english: This Is Just To Say
translation: 这只是说说而已 [zhe zhi shi shuo shuo er yi]

english: I have nibbled the cacti that were by the oasis,
translation: 我啃过绿洲边的仙人掌， [wo ken guo lv zhou bian de xian ren zhang ，]

english: and which you were probably saving for lunch.
translation: 你可能会留着吃午饭。 [ni ke neng hui liu zhe chi wu fan 。]

english: Forgive me, they were delicious, so crunchy and so cold.
translation: 请原谅我，它们很好吃，又脆又冷。 [qing yuan liang wo ， ta men hen hao chi ， you cui you leng 。]

english: I wonder if she's forgiven me for eating her snack.
translation: 我想知道她是否原谅我吃了她的零食。 [wo xiang zhi dao ta shi fou yuan liang wo chi le ta de ling shi 。]

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Ah, well. I shall return to writing poems to Elly's beauty.
translation: 啊，好吧。我将继续为艾莉的美丽写诗。 [a ， hao ba 。 wo jiang ji xu wei ai li de mei li xie shi 。]

english: Ask the camel about its dung.
translation: 向骆驼询问它的粪便。 [xiang luo tuo xun wen ta de fen bian 。]

english: Say something unpleasant.
translation: 说一些不愉快的话。 [shuo yi xie bu yu kuai de hua 。]

english: Neither - I'm a polite person.
translation: 都不是——我是一个有礼貌的人。 [dou bu shi —— wo shi yi ge you li mao de ren 。]

english: I'd love to!
translation: 我喜欢！ [wo xi huan ！]

english: Listen to 'Shall I compare thee to a desert's day'.
translation: 听听“我可以将你比作沙漠之日吗”。 [ting ting “ wo ke yi jiang ni bi zuo sha mo zhi ri ma ”。]

english: Why not tell her how you feel?
translation: 为什么不告诉她你的感受呢？ [wei shen me bu gao su ta ni de gan shou ne ？]

english: Well, best of luck with that.
translation: 好吧，祝你好运。 [hao ba ， zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Listen to 'This Is Just To Say'.
translation: 听听《这只是说说而已》。 [ting ting 《 zhe zhi shi shuo shuo er yi 》。]

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
translation: 你愿意帮我照料我的庄稼吗？ [ni yuan yi bang wo zhao liao wo de zhuang jia ma ？]

english: I might - which patch were you thinking of?
translation: 我可能 - 你想到的是哪个补丁？ [wo ke neng  -  ni xiang dao de shi na ge bu ding ？]

english: You don't have any seeds planted in that patch. Plant some and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: 你在那块土地上没有种下任何种子。种一些，我可能会同意帮你照顾它。 [ni zai na kuai tu di shang mei you zhong xia ren he zhong zi 。 zhong yi xie ， wo ke neng hui tong yi bang ni zhao gu ta 。]

english: That patch is diseased - you should cure it before asking me to be responsible for it!
translation: 那个补丁有病——你应该先治愈它，然后再要求我负责！ [na ge bu ding you bing —— ni ying gai xian zhi yu ta ， ran hou zai yao qiu wo fu ze ！]

english: That patch is dead - it's too late for me to do anything about it now.
translation: 那个补丁已经死了——现在对我来说做任何事情都太晚了。 [na ge bu ding yi jing si le —— xian zai dui wo lai shuo zuo ren he shi qing dou tai wan le 。]

english: That patch is already fully grown! I don't know what you want me to do with it!
translation: 那块补丁已经完全长大了！我不知道你想让我用它做什么！ [na kuai bu ding yi jing wan quan zhang da le ！ wo bu zhi dao ni xiang rang wo yong ta zuo shen me ！]

english: I'm already looking after that patch for you.
translation: 我已经在为你处理那个补丁了。 [wo yi jing zai wei ni chu li na ge bu ding le 。]

english: If you like, but I want [payment] for that.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，但我想要[付款]。 [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， dan wo xiang yao [ fu kuan ]。]

english: I'm afraid I don't have any of those at the moment.
translation: 恐怕我现在没有这些。 [kong pa wo xian zai mei you zhe xie 。]

english: Well, I'm not wasting my time for free.
translation: 好吧，我不会免费浪费时间。 [hao ba ， wo bu hui mian fei lang fei shi jian 。]

english: Okay, it's a deal.
translation: “好吧，成交。” [“ hao ba ， cheng jiao 。”]

english: That'll do nicely, [sir/madam]. Leave it with me - I'll make sure that patch grows for you.
translation: 那就太好了，[先生/女士]。把它留给我吧——我会确保这个补丁适合你。 [na jiu tai hao le ，[ xian sheng / nv shi ]。 ba ta liu gei wo ba —— wo hui que bao zhe ge bu ding shi he ni 。]

english: No, that's too much.
translation: 不，那太多了。 [bu ， na tai duo le 。]

english: Poison ivy bushes don't get diseased, so you needn't worry about having it protected.
translation: 毒藤灌木不会生病，因此您不必担心它的保护。 [du teng guan mu bu hui sheng bing ， yin ci nin bu bi dan xin ta de bao hu 。]

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 你能给我一些农业建议吗？ [ni neng gei wo yi xie nong ye jian yi ma ？]

english: You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
translation: 您最多可以在蔬菜袋中放入十个土豆、卷心菜或洋葱，但不能将它们混合放在同一个袋子中。 [nin zui duo ke yi zai shu cai dai zhong fang ru shi ge tu dou 、 juan xin cai huo yang cong ， dan bu neng jiang ta men hun he fang zai tong yi ge dai zi zhong 。]

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: 您最多可以将五个西红柿、草莓、苹果、香蕉或橙子放入一个水果篮中，但不能将它们混合放在同一个篮子中。 [nin zui duo ke yi jiang wu ge xi hong shi 、 cao mei 、 ping guo 、 xiang jiao huo cheng zi fang ru yi ge shui guo lan zhong ， dan bu neng jiang ta men hun he fang zai tong yi ge lan zi zhong 。]

english: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
translation: 您可以从农田商店购买所有农具，农田商店位于耕地附近。 [nin ke yi cong nong tian shang dian gou mai suo you nong ju ， nong tian shang dian wei yu geng di fu jin 。]

english: You can fill plantpots with soil from any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.
translation: 如果你有园艺抹子，你可以用任何空地的土壤填满花盆。 [ru guo ni you yuan yi mo zi ， ni ke yi yong ren he kong di de tu rang tian man hua pen 。]

english: Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
translation: 树木种子必须在土壤花盆中长成树苗，然后转移到树丛中继续生长直至成年。 [shu mu zhong zi bi xu zai tu rang hua pen zhong chang cheng shu miao ， ran hou zhuan yi dao shu cong zhong ji xu sheng zhang zhi zhi cheng nian 。]

english: If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're a good enough [craftswoman/craftsman], that is.
translation: 如果您想自己制作麻袋和篮子，则需要使用法拉多农业商店附近的织布机。如果你是一个足够好的[工匠/工匠]，那就是。 [ru guo nin xiang zi ji zhi zuo ma dai he lan zi ， ze xu yao shi yong fa la duo nong ye shang dian fu jin de zhi bu ji 。 ru guo ni shi yi ge zu gou hao de [ gong jiang / gong jiang ]， na jiu shi 。]

english: You don't have to buy all your plantpots you know, you can make them yourself on a pottery wheel. If you're a good enough [craftswoman/craftsman], that is.
translation: 您不必购买所有您知道的花盆，您可以自己在陶轮上制作它们。如果你是一个足够好的[工匠/工匠]，那就是。 [nin bu bi gou mai suo you nin zhi dao de hua pen ， nin ke yi zi ji zai tao lun shang zhi zuo ta men 。 ru guo ni shi yi ge zu gou hao de [ gong jiang / gong jiang ]， na jiu shi 。]

english: Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
translation: 耙完一块杂草后，不要只是扔掉杂草 - 将它们放入堆肥箱中并制作一些堆肥。 [ba wan yi kuai za cao hou ， bu yao zhi shi reng diao za cao  -  jiang ta men fang ru dui fei xiang zhong bing zhi zuo yi xie dui fei 。]

english: Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
translation: 在一块土地上施用堆肥不仅可以减少农作物患病的机会，而且还可以种植更多的农作物来收获。 [zai yi kuai tu di shang shi yong dui fei bu jin ke yi jian shao nong zuo wu huan bing de ji hui ， er qie hai ke yi zhong zhi geng duo de nong zuo wu lai shou huo 。]

english: Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
translation: 超级堆肥比普通堆肥好得多，但制造成本更高。你需要腐烂正确类型的物品；给我看一个物品，我会告诉你它是否超级可堆肥。 [chao ji dui fei bi pu tong dui fei hao de duo ， dan zhi zao cheng ben geng gao 。 ni xu yao fu lan zheng que lei xing de wu pin ； gei wo kan yi ge wu pin ， wo hui gao su ni ta shi fou chao ji ke dui fei 。]

english: Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
translation: 蔬菜、啤酒花和花卉需要不断浇水——如果你忽视我的建议，你迟早会发现自己拥有一片枯死的农田。 [shu cai 、 pi jiu hua he hua hui xu yao bu duan jiao shui —— ru guo ni hu shi wo de jian yi ， ni chi zao hui fa xian zi ji yong you yi pian ku si de nong tian 。]

english: The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
translation: 治愈灌木或树木疾病的唯一方法是用剪刀剪掉患病的叶子。对于所有其他作物，我只会使用一些植物疗法。 [zhi yu guan mu huo shu mu ji bing de wei yi fang fa shi yong jian dao jian diao huan bing de ye zi 。 dui yu suo you qi ta zuo wu ， wo zhi hui shi yong yi xie zhi wu liao fa 。]

english: There are five other Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Kragen's area near Ardougne, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius and Oswallt's area
translation: 还有其他五个与此类似的农业区域 - 法拉多附近的埃尔斯坦区域、凯瑟比附近的丹塔拉区域、阿杜涅附近的克拉根区域、莫里塔尼亚的莱拉区域、霍西迪乌斯的马里西区域和奥斯瓦尔特区域 [hai you qi ta wu ge yu ci lei si de nong ye qu yu  -  fa la duo fu jin de ai er si tan qu yu 、 kai se bi fu jin de dan ta la qu yu 、 a du nie fu jin de ke la gen qu yu 、 mo li ta ni ya de lai la qu yu 、 huo xi di wu si de ma li xi qu yu he ao si wa er te qu yu]

english: in Prifddinas.
translation: 在普里夫迪纳斯。 [zai pu li fu di na si 。]

english: If you want to grow fruit trees you could try a few places: Catherby, Brimhaven, Gnome Stronghold and the Farming Guild all have fruit tree patches.
translation: 如果你想种植果树，你可以尝试几个地方：Catherby、Brimhaven、Gnome Stronghold 和 Farming Guild 都有果树。 [ru guo ni xiang zhong zhi guo shu ， ni ke yi chang shi ji ge di fang ：Catherby、Brimhaven、Gnome Stronghold  he  Farming Guild  dou you guo shu 。]

english: Hops are good for brewing ales. I believe there's a brewery up in Keldagrim somewhere, and I've heard rumours that a place called Phasmatys used to be good for that type of thing. 'Fore they all died, of course.
translation: 啤酒花适合酿造啤酒。我相信凯尔达格里姆的某个地方有一家啤酒厂，而且我听说过一个叫做 Phasmatys 的地方曾经适合做这种事情。 “当然，他们都死了。 [pi jiu hua shi he niang zao pi jiu 。 wo xiang xin kai er da ge li mu de mou ge di fang you yi jia pi jiu chang ， er qie wo ting shuo guo yi ge jiao zuo  Phasmatys  de di fang ceng jing shi he zuo zhe zhong shi qing 。 “ dang ran ， ta men dou si le 。]

english: Bittercap mushrooms can only be grown in a special patch in Morytania, near the Mort Myre swamp. There the ground is especially dank and suited to growing poisonous fungii.
translation: 苦蘑菇只能生长在莫里塔尼亚莫特迈尔沼泽附近的一块特殊土地上。那里的地面特别潮湿，适合有毒真菌的生长。 [ku mo gu zhi neng sheng zhang zai mo li ta ni ya mo te mai er zhao ze fu jin de yi kuai te shu tu di shang 。 na li de di mian te bie chao shi ， shi he you du zhen jun de sheng zhang 。]

english: There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
translation: 有一块专门种植颠茄的土地——我相信它就在德雷诺庄园附近的某个地方，那里的土地有点“不被祝福”。 [you yi kuai zhuan men zhong zhi dian jia de tu di —— wo xiang xin ta jiu zai de lei nuo zhuang yuan fu jin de mou ge di fang ， na li de tu di you dian “ bu bei zhu fu ”。]

english: Can you sell me something?
translation: 你能卖给我东西吗？ [ni neng mai gei wo dong xi ma ？]

english: That depends on whether I have it to sell. What is it that you're looking for?
translation: 这取决于我是否有它可以卖。您在寻找什么？ [zhe qu jue yu wo shi fou you ta ke yi mai 。 nin zai xun zhao shen me ？]

english: Some plant cure.
translation: 一些植物治疗。 [yi xie zhi wu zhi liao 。]

english: Plant cure, eh? I might have some put aside for myself. Tell you what, I'll sell you some plant cure for 25 coins if you like.
translation: 植物疗法，嗯？我可能会留一些给自己。告诉你吧，如果你愿意的话，我可以花 25 个硬币卖给你一些植物疗法。 [zhi wu liao fa ， n ？ wo ke neng hui liu yi xie gei zi ji 。 gao su ni ba ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi hua  25  ge ying bi mai gei ni yi xie zhi wu liao fa 。]

english: Yes, that sounds like a fair price.
translation: 是的，这听起来像是一个公平的价格。 [shi de ， zhe ting qi lai xiang shi yi ge gong ping de jia ge 。]

english: No thanks, I can get that much cheaper elsewhere.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我在其他地方可以买到便宜得多的东西。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo zai qi ta di fang ke yi mai dao pian yi de duo de dong xi 。]

english: A bucket of compost.
translation: 一桶堆肥。 [yi tong dui fei 。]

english: A bucket of compost, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 35 coins if you like.
translation: 一桶堆肥，是吗？我可能还有一个备用的……告诉你吧，如果你愿意的话，我可以以 35 个硬币的价格卖给你。 [yi tong dui fei ， shi ma ？ wo ke neng hai you yi ge bei yong de …… gao su ni ba ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi yi  35  ge ying bi de jia ge mai gei ni 。]

english: A rake.
translation: 一把耙子。 [yi ba pa zi 。]

english: A rake, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: 耙子，嗯？我可能还有一个备用的……告诉你吧，如果你愿意的话，我可以以 15 个硬币的价格卖给你。 [pa zi ， n ？ wo ke neng hai you yi ge bei yong de …… gao su ni ba ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi yi  15  ge ying bi de jia ge mai gei ni 。]

english: A plant pot.
translation: 一个花盆。 [yi ge hua pen 。]

english: Eh, I suppose I can spare you a plant pot, but I'll want 40 coins for it.
translation: 呃，我想我可以给你一个花盆，但我要 40 个硬币。 [e ， wo xiang wo ke yi gei ni yi ge hua pen ， dan wo yao  40  ge ying bi 。]

english: A watering can.
translation: 一个喷壶。 [yi ge pen hu 。]

english: A watering can, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 25 coins if you like.
translation: 喷壶，嗯？我可能还有一个备用的……告诉你吧，如果你愿意的话，我可以以 25 个硬币的价格卖给你。 [pen hu ， n ？ wo ke neng hai you yi ge bei yong de …… gao su ni ba ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi yi  25  ge ying bi de jia ge mai gei ni 。]

english: A gardening trowel.
translation: 园艺抹子。 [yuan yi mo zi 。]

english: A gardening trowel, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: 园艺抹子，是吗？我可能还有一个备用的……告诉你吧，如果你愿意的话，我可以以 15 个硬币的价格卖给你。 [yuan yi mo zi ， shi ma ？ wo ke neng hai you yi ge bei yong de …… gao su ni ba ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi yi  15  ge ying bi de jia ge mai gei ni 。]

english: A seed dibber.
translation: 播种机。 [bo zhong ji 。]

english: A seed dibber, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: 种子播种者，是吗？我可能还有一个备用的……告诉你吧，如果你愿意的话，我可以以 15 个硬币的价格卖给你。 [zhong zi bo zhong zhe ， shi ma ？ wo ke neng hai you yi ge bei yong de …… gao su ni ba ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi yi  15  ge ying bi de jia ge mai gei ni 。]

english: Forget it, you don't have anything I need.
translation: 算了，你没有我需要的东西。 [suan le ， ni mei you wo xu yao de dong xi 。]

english: I'll come back another time.
translation: 我下次再来。 [wo xia ci zai lai 。]

english: Which patch would you like to pay protection for?
translation: 您想为哪个补丁付费保护？ [nin xiang wei na ge bu ding fu fei bao hu ？]

english: I want [payment] for that.
translation: 我想要为此[付款]。 [wo xiang yao wei ci [ fu kuan ]。]

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
translation: 你愿意帮我照料我的庄稼吗？ [ni yuan yi bang wo zhao liao wo de zhuang jia ma ？]

english: The Cactus Patch
translation: 仙人掌补丁 [xian ren zhang bu ding]

english: Okay, it's a deal.
translation: “好吧，成交。” [“ hao ba ， cheng jiao 。”]

english: No, that's too much.
translation: 不，那太多了。 [bu ， na tai duo le 。]

english: Okay, it's a deal and don't ask again.
translation: 好吧，就这么说定了，不要再问了。 [hao ba ， jiu zhe me shuo ding le ， bu yao zai wen le 。]

english: The Northern Allotment Patch
translation: 北部分配补丁 [bei bu fen pei bu ding]

english: The Southern Allotment Patch
translation: 南部分配补丁 [nan bu fen pei bu ding]

english: The Bush Patch
translation: 布什补丁 [bu shen bu ding]

translation: 你能给我一些农业建议吗？ [ni neng gei wo yi xie nong ye jian yi ma ？]

translation: 你能卖给我东西吗？ [ni neng mai gei wo dong xi ma ？]

translation: 是的，这听起来像是一个公平的价格。 [shi de ， zhe ting qi lai xiang shi yi ge gong ping de jia ge 。]

english: No thanks, I can get that much cheaper elsewhere.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我在其他地方可以买到便宜得多的东西。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo zai qi ta di fang ke yi mai dao pian yi de duo de dong xi 。]

translation: （查看更多项目） [（ cha kan geng duo xiang mu ）]

translation: 一个喷壶。 [yi ge pen hu 。]

translation: 播种机。 [bo zhong ji 。]

english: (See previous items)
translation: （参见之前的项目） [（ can jian zhi qian de xiang mu ）]

english: Forget it.
translation: 忘了它。 [wang le ta 。]

english: I'll come back another time.
translation: 我下次再来。 [wo xia ci zai lai 。]

english: Nilsal, iknami! Do you need help with anything?
translation: 尼尔萨尔，我的名字！您需要什么帮助吗？ [ni er sa er ， wo de ming zi ！ nin xu yao shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这附近做什么？ [ni zai zhe fu jin zuo shen me ？]

english: I spend a lot of my time researching new product formulas for the lab. Just over here we have a batch of something new that I've dubbed 'Earworm'.
translation: 我花了很多时间研究实验室的新产品配方。就在这里，我们有一批新东西，我称之为“耳虫”。 [wo hua le hen duo shi jian yan jiu shi yan shi de xin chan pin pei fang 。 jiu zai zhe li ， wo men you yi pi xin dong xi ， wo cheng zhi wei “ er chong ”。]

english: Ear... Worm...?
translation: 耳朵……虫子……？ [er duo …… chong zi ……？]

english: Indeed! Its effects produce musical auditory hallucinations! Soon, people will be able to listen to music while on the go. It'll sell like hotcakes!
translation: 的确！其效果会产生音乐幻听！很快，人们将能够在旅途中听音乐。它会像热蛋糕一样卖得很好！ [di que ！ qi xiao guo hui chan sheng yin yue huan ting ！ hen kuai ， ren men jiang neng gou zai lv tu zhong ting yin yue 。 ta hui xiang re dan gao yi yang mai de hen hao ！]

english: Thanks! I'd better be going now.
translation: 谢谢！我最好现在就走。 [xie xie ！ wo zui hao xian zai jiu zou 。]

english: Our main focus is the advancement of Herblore through scientific study.
translation: 我们的主要重点是通过科学研究来推动 Herblore 的发展。 [wo men de zhu yao zhong dian shi tong guo ke xue yan jiu lai tui dong  Herblore  de fa zhan 。]

english: As for an end goal... that information is only for senior members.
