translation: 前往穆萨角 (Musa Point) 品尝 Karamja 葡萄酒、烈酒和啤酒。在那里你会找到达拉斯·琼斯。我们听说他正在调查克兰多的毁灭事件。这似乎是一个很好的起点。 [qian wang mu sa jiao  (Musa Point)  pin chang  Karamja  pu tao jiu 、 lie jiu he pi jiu 。 zai na li ni hui zhao dao da la si · qiong si 。 wo men ting shuo ta zheng zai diao cha ke lan duo de hui mie shi jian 。 zhe si hu shi yi ge hen hao de qi dian 。]

english: Not yet. However, you are on the right path. Complete the task we've assigned you and we will allow you entry into the Guild.
translation: 还没有。然而，你走在正确的道路上。完成我们分配给您的任务，我们将允许您进入公会。 [hai mei you 。 ran er ， ni zou zai zheng que de dao lu shang 。 wan cheng wo men fen pei gei nin de ren wu ， wo men jiang yun xu nin jin ru gong hui 。]

english: I'm afraid the Guild is not currently accepting new members. However, we will soon be opening our doors again.
translation: 恐怕公会目前不接受新成员。然而，我们很快就会再次敞开大门。 [kong pa gong hui mu qian bu jie shou xin cheng yuan 。 ran er ， wo men hen kuai jiu hui zai ci chang kai da men 。]

english: When we do, you should return here. We may well have a place for you.
translation: 当我们这样做时，你应该返回这里。我们很可能为您提供一席之地。 [dang wo men zhe yang zuo shi ， ni ying gai fan hui zhe li 。 wo men hen ke neng wei nin ti gong yi xi zhi di 。]

english: How can I gain access to the Guild?
translation: 我怎样才能进入公会？ [wo zen yang cai neng jin ru gong hui ？]

english: Only the most worthy may access our Guild and I'm afraid you are not quite there yet. Go out and hone your skills then return to us.
translation: 只有最有价值的人才能进入我们的公会，但恐怕你还没有完全达到目的。出去磨练你的技能，然后回到我们身边。 [zhi you zui you jia zhi de ren cai neng jin ru wo men de gong hui ， dan kong pa ni hai mei you wan quan da dao mu di 。 chu qu mo lian ni de ji neng ， ran hou hui dao wo men shen bian 。]

english: You do not meet all the requirements to start the Dragon Slayer II quest.
translation: 您不满足开始屠龙者 II 任务的所有要求。 [nin bu man zu kai shi tu long zhe  II  ren wu de suo you yao qiu 。]

english: Only the most worthy are allowed access into the Myths' Guild. If you want entry, you'll need to prove yourself.
translation: 只有最有价值的人才被允许进入神话公会。如果你想进入，你需要证明自己。 [zhi you zui you jia zhi de ren cai bei yun xu jin ru shen hua gong hui 。 ru guo ni xiang jin ru ， ni xu yao zheng ming zi ji 。]

english: Well return to us once you do. If you help us fill our Library of Knowledge, we shall grant you access to the Guild.
translation: 一旦你这样做了，我们就会回来。如果您帮助我们充实我们的知识图书馆，我们将授予您进入公会的权限。 [yi dan ni zhe yang zuo le ， wo men jiu hui hui lai 。 ru guo nin bang zhu wo men chong shi wo men de zhi shi tu shu guan ， wo men jiang shou yu nin jin ru gong hui de quan xian 。]

english: Farewell adventurer.
translation: 再见冒险家。 [zai jian mao xian jia 。]

english: Tell me about the guild.
translation: 说说公会的事吧 [shuo shuo gong hui de shi ba]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: How can I gain access to the guild?
translation: 我怎样才能进入公会？ [wo zen yang cai neng jin ru gong hui ？]

english: Let's talk about my quest.
translation: 让我们谈谈我的追求。 [rang wo men tan tan wo de zhui qiu 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Tell me about the Guild.
translation: 告诉我关于公会的事。 [gao su wo guan yu gong hui de shi 。]

english: How can I gain access to the Guild?
translation: 我怎样才能进入公会？ [wo zen yang cai neng jin ru gong hui ？]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello, hello, and a most warm welcome to my Hunter Emporium. We have everything the discerning Hunter could need.
translation: 你好，你好，热烈欢迎来到我的猎人商场。我们拥有挑剔的猎人所需的一切。 [ni hao ， ni hao ， re lie huan ying lai dao wo de lie ren shang chang 。 wo men yong you tiao ti de lie ren suo xu de yi qie 。]

english: Would you like me to show you our range of equipment? Or was there something specific you were after?
translation: 您想让我向您展示我们的设备系列吗？或者你有什么具体的追求吗？ [nin xiang rang wo xiang nin zhan shi wo men de she bei xi lie ma ？ huo zhe ni you shen me ju ti de zhui qiu ma ？]

english: Ok, let's see what you've got!
translation: 好吧，让我们看看你有什么！ [hao ba ， rang wo men kan kan ni you shen me ！]

english: I'm not interested, thanks.
translation: 我不感兴趣，谢谢。 [wo bu gan xing qu ， xie xie 。]

english: Well, if you do ever find yourself in need of the finest Hunter equipment available, then you know where to come.
translation: 好吧，如果您确实发现自己需要最好的猎人装备，那么您知道该去哪里。 [hao ba ， ru guo nin que shi fa xian zi ji xu yao zui hao de lie ren zhuang bei ， na me nin zhi dao gai qu na li 。]

english: Who's that guy over there?
translation: 那边那个人是谁？ [na bian na ge ren shi shui ？]

english: Him? I think he might be crazy. Either that or he's seeking attention.
translation: 他？我想他可能疯了。要么是他在寻求关注。 [ta ？ wo xiang ta ke neng feng le 。 yao me shi ta zai xun qiu guan zhu 。]

english: He keeps trying to sell me these barmy looking weapons he's invented. I can't see them working, personally.
translation: 他一直试图向我推销他发明的这些看起来很疯狂的武器。就我个人而言，我看不到他们在工作。 [ta yi zhi shi tu xiang wo tui xiao ta fa ming de zhe xie kan qi lai hen feng kuang de wu qi 。 jiu wo ge ren er yan ， wo kan bu dao ta men zai gong zuo 。]

english: Ok, let's see what you've got!
translation: 好吧，让我们看看你有什么！ [hao ba ， rang wo men kan kan ni you shen me ！]

english: I'm not interested, thanks.
translation: 我不感兴趣，谢谢。 [wo bu gan xing qu ， xie xie 。]

english: Who's that guy over there?
translation: 那边那个人是谁？ [na bian na ge ren shi shui ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: [Vampyre name].
translation: [吸血鬼名字]。 [[ xi xue gui ming zi ]。]

english: Not the one I'm expecting. Move along.
translation: 不是我期待的那个。继续前进。 [bu shi wo qi dai de na ge 。 ji xu qian jin 。]

english: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 人类！在我叫守卫之前回到奴隶围栏！ [ren lei ！ zai wo jiao shou wei zhi qian hui dao nu li wei lan ！]

english: I can't believe we've finally arrived, I can't wait to explore!
translation: 我不敢相信我们终于到达了，我迫不及待地想探索！ [wo bu gan xiang xin wo men zhong yu dao da le ， wo po bu ji dai di xiang tan suo ！]

english: So much to see, I don't know where to start!
translation: 太多东西要看，我不知道从哪里开始！ [tai duo dong xi yao kan ， wo bu zhi dao cong na li kai shi ！]

english: A whole new continent to explore... what a time to be
translation: 等待探索的全新大陆……美好时光 [deng dai tan suo de quan xin da lu …… mei hao shi guang]

english: Are you the tour guide?
translation: 你是导游吗？ [ni shi dao you ma ？]

english: Nope, I'm just as lost as you.
translation: 不，我和你一样迷失。 [bu ， wo he ni yi yang mi shi 。]

english: I overheard someone mention there are pirates and thieves here, be careful!
translation: 我无意中听到有人说这里有海盗和小偷，要小心！ [wo wu yi zhong ting dao you ren shuo zhe li you hai dao he xiao tou ， yao xiao xin ！]

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
translation: 你愿意帮我照料我的庄稼吗？ [ni yuan yi bang wo zhao liao wo de zhuang jia ma ？]

english: You don't have a sapling planted in that patch. Plant one and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: 你那块地里没有种树苗。种一棵，我可能会同意帮你照顾它。 [ni na kuai di li mei you zhong shu miao 。 zhong yi ke ， wo ke neng hui tong yi bang ni zhao gu ta 。]

english: If you like, but I want 6 dragonfruit for that.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，但我想要 6 个火龙果。 [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， dan wo xiang yao  6  ge huo long guo 。]

english: Okay, it's a deal.
translation: “好吧，成交。” [“ hao ba ， cheng jiao 。”]

english: That'll do nicely, sir. Leave it with me - I'll make sure that patch grows for you.
translation: 那就太好了，先生。把它留给我吧——我会确保这个补丁适合你。 [na jiu tai hao le ， xian sheng 。 ba ta liu gei wo ba —— wo hui que bao zhe ge bu ding shi he ni 。]

english: No, that's too much.
translation: 不，那太多了。 [bu ， na tai duo le 。]

english: Well, I'm not wasting my time for free.
translation: 好吧，我不会免费浪费时间。 [hao ba ， wo bu hui mian fei lang fei shi jian 。]

english: I'm afraid I don't have any of those at the moment.
translation: 恐怕我现在没有这些。 [kong pa wo xian zai mei you zhe xie 。]

english: That patch is already fully grown! I don't know what you want me to do with it!
translation: 那块补丁已经完全长大了！我不知道你想让我用它做什么！ [na kuai bu ding yi jing wan quan zhang da le ！ wo bu zhi dao ni xiang rang wo yong ta zuo shen me ！]

english: These take ages to clear! If you pay me 2000 Coins I'll chop it down for you.
translation: 这些需要很长时间才能清除！如果你付给我2000金币我就给你砍下来。 [zhe xie xu yao hen zhang shi jian cai neng qing chu ！ ru guo ni fu gei wo 2000 jin bi wo jiu gei ni kan xia lai 。]

english: Here's 2000 Coins - chop my tree down please.
translation: 这是 2000 枚硬币 - 请砍倒我的树。 [zhe shi  2000  mei ying bi  -  qing kan dao wo de shu 。]

english: Alexandra sets to work...
translation: 亚历山德拉开始工作…… [ya li shan de la kai shi gong zuo ……]

english: I don't want to pay that much, sorry.
translation: 我不想付那么多钱，对不起。 [wo bu xiang fu na me duo qian ， dui bu qi 。]

english: I don't have 2000 Coins I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕我没有2000金币。 [kong pa wo mei you 2000 jin bi 。]

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 你能给我一些农业建议吗？ [ni neng gei wo yi xie nong ye jian yi ma ？]

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: 您最多可以将五个西红柿、草莓、苹果、香蕉或橙子放入一个水果篮中，但不能将它们混合放在同一个篮子中。 [nin zui duo ke yi jiang wu ge xi hong shi 、 cao mei 、 ping guo 、 xiang jiao huo cheng zi fang ru yi ge shui guo lan zhong ， dan bu neng jiang ta men hun he fang zai tong yi ge lan zi zhong 。]

english: There are seven main Farming areas - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Kragen's area near Ardougne, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius, Alan's area in the Farming Guild and
translation: 有七个主要的农业区域 - 法拉多附近的埃尔斯坦区域、凯瑟比附近的丹塔拉区域、阿杜涅附近的克拉根区域、莫里塔尼亚的莱拉区域、霍西迪乌斯的马里西区域、农业公会的艾伦区域和 [you qi ge zhu yao de nong ye qu yu  -  fa la duo fu jin de ai er si tan qu yu 、 kai se bi fu jin de dan ta la qu yu 、 a du nie fu jin de ke la gen qu yu 、 mo li ta ni ya de lai la qu yu 、 huo xi di wu si de ma li xi qu yu 、 nong ye gong hui de ai lun qu yu he]

english: Oswallt's area in Prifddinas.
translation: 普里夫迪纳斯的奥斯瓦尔特地区。 [pu li fu di na si de ao si wa er te di qu 。]

english: Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
translation: 超级堆肥比普通堆肥好得多，但制造成本更高。你需要腐烂正确类型的物品；给我看一个物品，我会告诉你它是否超级可堆肥。 [chao ji dui fei bi pu tong dui fei hao de duo ， dan zhi zao cheng ben geng gao 。 ni xu yao fu lan zheng que lei xing de wu pin ； gei wo kan yi ge wu pin ， wo hui gao su ni ta shi fou chao ji ke dui fei 。]

english: Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
translation: 蔬菜、啤酒花和花卉需要不断浇水——如果你忽视我的建议，你迟早会发现自己拥有一片枯死的农田。 [shu cai 、 pi jiu hua he hua hui xu yao bu duan jiao shui —— ru guo ni hu shi wo de jian yi ， ni chi zao hui fa xian zi ji yong you yi pian ku si de nong tian 。]

english: There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
translation: 有一块专门种植颠茄的土地——我相信它就在德雷诺庄园附近的某个地方，那里的土地有点“不被祝福”。 [you yi kuai zhuan men zhong zhi dian jia de tu di —— wo xiang xin ta jiu zai de lei nuo zhuang yuan fu jin de mou ge di fang ， na li de tu di you dian “ bu bei zhu fu ”。]

english: Hops are good for brewing ales. I believe there's a brewery up in Keldagrim somewhere, and I've heard rumours that a place called Phasmatys used to be good for that type of thing. 'Fore they all died, of course.
translation: 啤酒花适合酿造啤酒。我相信凯尔达格里姆的某个地方有一家啤酒厂，而且我听说过一个叫做 Phasmatys 的地方曾经适合做这种事情。 “当然，他们都死了。 [pi jiu hua shi he niang zao pi jiu 。 wo xiang xin kai er da ge li mu de mou ge di fang you yi jia pi jiu chang ， er qie wo ting shuo guo yi ge jiao zuo  Phasmatys  de di fang ceng jing shi he zuo zhe zhong shi qing 。 “ dang ran ， ta men dou si le 。]

english: Bittercap mushrooms can only be grown in a special patch in Morytania, near the Mort Myre swamp. There the ground is especially dank and suited to growing poisonous fungii.
translation: 苦蘑菇只能生长在莫里塔尼亚莫特迈尔沼泽附近的一块特殊土地上。那里的地面特别潮湿，适合有毒真菌的生长。 [ku mo gu zhi neng sheng zhang zai mo li ta ni ya mo te mai er zhao ze fu jin de yi kuai te shu tu di shang 。 na li de di mian te bie chao shi ， shi he you du zhen jun de sheng zhang 。]

english: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
translation: 您可以从农田商店购买所有农具，农田商店位于耕地附近。 [nin ke yi cong nong tian shang dian gou mai suo you nong ju ， nong tian shang dian wei yu geng di fu jin 。]

english: Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
translation: 树木种子必须在土壤花盆中长成树苗，然后转移到树丛中继续生长直至成年。 [shu mu zhong zi bi xu zai tu rang hua pen zhong chang cheng shu miao ， ran hou zhuan yi dao shu cong zhong ji xu sheng zhang zhi zhi cheng nian 。]

english: The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
translation: 治愈灌木或树木疾病的唯一方法是用剪刀剪掉患病的叶子。对于所有其他作物，我只会使用一些植物疗法。 [zhi yu guan mu huo shu mu ji bing de wei yi fang fa shi yong jian dao jian diao huan bing de ye zi 。 dui yu suo you qi ta zuo wu ， wo zhi hui shi yong yi xie zhi wu liao fa 。]

english: You can fill plantpots with soil from any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.
translation: 如果你有园艺抹子，你可以用任何空地的土壤填满花盆。 [ru guo ni you yuan yi mo zi ， ni ke yi yong ren he kong di de tu rang tian man hua pen 。]

english: If you need to be rid of your fruit trees for any reason, all you have to do is chop them down and then dig up the stump.
translation: 如果您因任何原因需要清除果树，您只需将它们砍倒，然后挖出树桩即可。 [ru guo nin yin ren he yuan yin xu yao qing chu guo shu ， nin zhi xu jiang ta men kan dao ， ran hou wa chu shu zhuang ji ke 。]

english: Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
translation: 耙完一块杂草后，不要只是扔掉杂草 - 将它们放入堆肥箱中并制作一些堆肥。 [ba wan yi kuai za cao hou ， bu yao zhi shi reng diao za cao  -  jiang ta men fang ru dui fei xiang zhong bing zhi zuo yi xie dui fei 。]

english: Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
translation: 在一块土地上施用堆肥不仅可以减少农作物患病的机会，而且还可以种植更多的农作物来收获。 [zai yi kuai tu di shang shi yong dui fei bu jin ke yi jian shao nong zuo wu huan bing de ji hui ， er qie hai ke yi zhong zhi geng duo de nong zuo wu lai shou huo 。]

english: If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're a good enough craftsman, that is.
translation: 如果您想自己制作麻袋和篮子，则需要使用法拉多农业商店附近的织布机。如果你是一个足够好的工匠，那就是。 [ru guo nin xiang zi ji zhi zuo ma dai he lan zi ， ze xu yao shi yong fa la duo nong ye shang dian fu jin de zhi bu ji 。 ru guo ni shi yi ge zu gou hao de gong jiang ， na jiu shi 。]

english: You don't have to buy all your plantpots you know, you can make them yourself on a pottery wheel. If you're a good enough craftsman, that is.
translation: 您不必购买所有您知道的花盆，您可以自己在陶轮上制作它们。如果你是一个足够好的工匠，那就是。 [nin bu bi gou mai suo you nin zhi dao de hua pen ， nin ke yi zi ji zai tao lun shang zhi zuo ta men 。 ru guo ni shi yi ge zu gou hao de gong jiang ， na jiu shi 。]

english: You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
translation: 您最多可以在蔬菜袋中放入十个土豆、卷心菜或洋葱，但不能将它们混合放在同一个袋子中。 [nin zui duo ke yi zai shu cai dai zhong fang ru shi ge tu dou 、 juan xin cai huo yang cong ， dan bu neng jiang ta men hun he fang zai tong yi ge dai zi zhong 。]

english: Can you sell me something?
translation: 你能卖给我东西吗？ [ni neng mai gei wo dong xi ma ？]

english: That depends on whether I have it to sell. What is it that you're looking for?
translation: 这取决于我是否有它可以卖。您在寻找什么？ [zhe qu jue yu wo shi fou you ta ke yi mai 。 nin zai xun zhao shen me ？]

english: I'll come back another time.
translation: 我下次再来。 [wo xia ci zai lai 。]

english: I want 6 dragonfruit for that.
translation: 我想要6个火龙果。 [wo xiang yao 6 ge huo long guo 。]

english: I'm already looking after that patch for you.
translation: 我已经在为你处理那个补丁了。 [wo yi jing zai wei ni chu li na ge bu ding le 。]

english: I'll want 2000 Coins to chop down your redwood. These take ages!
translation: 我需要 2000 枚金币来砍伐你的红杉。这些需要很长时间！ [wo xu yao  2000  mei jin bi lai kan fa ni de hong shan 。 zhe xie xu yao hen zhang shi jian ！]

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
translation: 你愿意帮我照料我的庄稼吗？ [ni yuan yi bang wo zhao liao wo de zhuang jia ma ？]

english: Okay, it's a deal.
translation: “好吧，成交。” [“ hao ba ， cheng jiao 。”]

english: No, that's too much.
translation: 不，那太多了。 [bu ， na tai duo le 。]

english: Okay, it's a deal and don't ask again.
translation: 好吧，就这么说定了，不要再问了。 [hao ba ， jiu zhe me shuo ding le ， bu yao zai wen le 。]

english: Would you chop my redwood tree down for me?
translation: 你愿意帮我砍倒我的红杉树吗？ [ni yuan yi bang wo kan dao wo de hong shan shu ma ？]

english: Here's 2000 Coins - chop my tree down please.
translation: 这是 2000 枚硬币 - 请砍倒我的树。 [zhe shi  2000  mei ying bi  -  qing kan dao wo de shu 。]

english: I don't want to pay that much, sorry.
translation: 我不想付那么多钱，对不起。 [wo bu xiang fu na me duo qian ， dui bu qi 。]

english: Can you give me any farming advice?

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.

translation: 如果你抓到任何人，答应我你会分享。 [ru guo ni zhua dao ren he ren ， da ying wo ni hui fen xiang 。]

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...

english: You smell familiar...
translation: 你闻起来很熟悉... [ni wen qi lai hen shu xi ...]

translation: 我们直接从当地渔民卢布福那里购买。他似乎垄断了 Karambwan 的销售。 [wo men zhi jie cong dang di yu min lu bu fu na li gou mai 。 ta si hu long duan le  Karambwan  de xiao shou 。]

translation: 他通常在镇南边工作。 [ta tong chang zai zhen nan bian gong zuo 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Simple - nobody else knows how to catch Karambwan. It is a closely guarded secret.
translation: 很简单——没有人知道如何抓住 Karambwan。这是一个严密保守的秘密。 [hen jian dan —— mei you ren zhi dao ru he zhua zhu  Karambwan。 zhe shi yi ge yan mi bao shou de mi mi 。]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: How does he manage a monopoly?

english: Hello [player name]. How's the adventuring going?
translation: 你好[玩家姓名]。冒险进行得怎么样了？ [ni hao [ wan jia xing ming ]。 mao xian jin xing de zen me yang le ？]

english: Hi Ali. Not bad. How are you?
translation: 嗨阿里。不错。你好吗？ [hai a li 。 bu cuo 。 ni hao ma ？]

english: Still selling.
translation: 还在卖。 [hai zai mai 。]

english: Hang on a second while I get my stock of blackjacks out.
translation: 稍等一下，我把我的二十一点库存拿出来。 [shao deng yi xia ， wo ba wo de er shi yi dian ku cun na chu lai 。]

english: Hang on a second while I get the garments.
translation: 请稍等，我去拿衣服。 [qing shao deng ， wo qu na yi fu 。]

english: Hang on a second.
translation: 等一下。 [deng yi xia 。]

english: Well at the moment I don't exactly have a selection of runes.
translation: 好吧，目前我还没有可供选择的符文。 [hao ba ， mu qian wo hai mei you ke gong xuan ze de fu wen 。]

english: You don't?
translation: 你不这么认为吗？ [ni bu zhe me ren wei ma ？]

english: Those boxes from your friend Aubury have a very odd locking mechanism.
translation: 你朋友奥伯里的那些盒子有一个非常奇怪的锁定机制。 [ni peng you ao bo li de na xie he zi you yi ge fei chang qi guai de suo ding ji zhi 。]

english: You have managed to get them off?
translation: 你成功把他们弄下来了吗？ [ni cheng gong ba ta men nong xia lai le ma ？]

english: Not exactly.
translation: 不完全是。 [bu wan quan shi 。]

english: What do you mean by 'not exactly'?
translation: 你所说的“不完全”是什么意思？ [ni suo shuo de “ bu wan quan ” shi shen me yi si ？]

english: What I mean by 'not exactly' is 'no, I haven't managed to get the lock off'.
translation: 我所说的“不完全”是指“不，我还没能把锁打开”。 [wo suo shuo de “ bu wan quan ” shi zhi “ bu ， wo hai mei neng ba suo da kai ”。]

english: Oh.

I was kind of hoping that you would have a look at them. There are two distinctive types of caskets one with a simple locking mechanism and another, which ummm... looks a little tricky to say the least.
translation: 我有点希望你能看看它们。有两种独特类型的棺材，一种具有简单的锁定机制，另一种则嗯......至少可以说看起来有点棘手。 [wo you dian xi wang ni neng kan kan ta men 。 you liang zhong du te lei xing de guan cai ， yi zhong ju you jian dan de suo ding ji zhi ， ling yi zhong ze n ...... zhi shao ke yi shuo kan qi lai you dian ji shou 。]

english: I think I'll have a go at opening a small casket of runes.
translation: 我想我会尝试打开一小盒符文。 [wo xiang wo hui chang shi da kai yi xiao he fu wen 。]

english: Your arms tire from the exertions of trying to open the casket...
translation: 你的手臂因为试图打开棺材而疲惫不堪...... [ni de shou bi yin wei shi tu da kai guan cai er pi bei bu kan ......]

english: You fail to open the chest.
translation: 你没能打开宝箱。 [ni mei neng da kai bao xiang 。]

english: You fail to pick the lock - your fingers get numb from fumbling with the lock.
translation: 你没能撬开锁——你的手指因为摸索着锁而变得麻木。 [ni mei neng qiao kai suo —— ni de shou zhi yin wei mo suo zhe suo er bian de ma mu 。]

english: I'm feeling lucky, let's have a look at opening one of those large caskets.
translation: 我感觉很幸运，让我们来看看打开其中一个大棺材吧。 [wo gan jue hen xing yun ， rang wo men lai kan kan da kai qi zhong yi ge da guan cai ba 。]

english: Hmmm... This lock looks like it may be impossible to prise open.
translation: 嗯……这锁看起来不可能撬开。 [n …… zhe suo kan qi lai bu ke neng qiao kai 。]

english: Hmmm... This lock looks like it may be impossible to pick open.
translation: 嗯……这锁看起来不可能撬开。 [n …… zhe suo kan qi lai bu ke neng qiao kai 。]

english: On second thoughts I don't really need any runes.
translation: 转念一想，我真的不需要任何符文。 [zhuan nian yi xiang ， wo zhen de bu xu yao ren he fu wen 。]

english: Hi! I have this money off voucher!
translation: 你好！我有这张优惠券！ [ni hao ！ wo you zhe zhang you hui quan ！]

english: Oh! Unfortunately it seems to have expired yesterday!
translation: 哦！不幸的是昨天好像已经过期了！ [o ！ bu xing de shi zuo tian hao xiang yi jing guo qi le ！]

english: But I only just got it from Ali the Leaflet dropper!
translation: 但我刚刚从传单投放者阿里那里得到了它！ [dan wo gang gang cong chuan dan tou fang zhe a li na li de dao le ta ！]

english: I'm sorry, there's nothing I can do.
translation: 对不起，我无能为力。 [dui bu qi ， wo wu neng wei li 。]

english: But you're the one that had them printed!
translation: 但你是打印它们的人！ [dan ni shi da yin ta men de ren ！]

english: Look, I had those printed to win over the local traders. They weren't too pleased with the money off voucher, but I promised them I would repay their losses.
translation: 看，我把这些印出来是为了赢得当地商人的支持。他们对优惠券的钱不太满意，但我向他们保证我会弥补他们的损失。 [kan ， wo ba zhe xie yin chu lai shi wei le ying de dang di shang ren de zhi chi 。 ta men dui you hui quan de qian bu tai man yi ， dan wo xiang ta men bao zheng wo hui mi bu ta men de sun shi 。]

english: So that would be why they're all out of date then?
translation: 那么这就是为什么它们都过时了？ [na me zhe jiu shi wei shen me ta men dou guo shi le ？]

english: I don't know what you mean...
translation: 我不知道你的意思... [wo bu zhi dao ni de yi si ...]

english: Anyway, it would be a shame for you to leave without looking at my wares.
translation: 无论如何，如果你不看我的商品就走，那就太可惜了。 [wu lun ru he ， ru guo ni bu kan wo de shang pin jiu zou ， na jiu tai ke xi le 。]

english: Anything interesting?
translation: 有什么有趣的吗？ [you shen me you qu de ma ？]

english: For you, always. As a matter of fact I have just acquired a fleet of magic carpets, which operate throughout the Kharidian desert.
translation: 为了你，永远。事实上，我刚刚获得了一支魔毯舰队，它们在整个卡里迪沙漠中运作。 [wei le ni ， yong yuan 。 shi shi shang ， wo gang gang huo de le yi zhi mo tan jian dui ， ta men zai zheng ge ka li di sha mo zhong yun zuo 。]

english: Wow that sounds great, how about your stall?
translation: 哇，听起来不错，你的摊位怎么样？ [wa ， ting qi lai bu cuo ， ni de tan wei zen me yang ？]

english: Trade is good, but I would like to expand and diversify, but it's proving a little more difficult than I initially thought.
translation: 贸易很好，但我想扩大规模并实现多元化，但事实证明这比我最初想象的要困难一些。 [mao yi hen hao ， dan wo xiang kuo da gui mo bing shi xian duo yuan hua ， dan shi shi zheng ming zhe bi wo zui chu xiang xiang de yao kun nan yi xie 。]

english: How so?
translation: 为何如此？ [wei he ru ci ？]

english: I think the other merchants are conspiring against me.
translation: 我认为其他商人正在密谋反对我。 [wo ren wei qi ta shang ren zheng zai mi mou fan dui wo 。]

english: Oh come on! You're just being paranoid now.
translation: 哦来吧！你现在只是偏执而已。 [o lai ba ！ ni xian zai zhi shi pian zhi er yi 。]

english: Well maybe I can't get any new suppliers then because I'm Pollnivnian.
translation: 好吧，也许我无法找到任何新的供应商，因为我是 Pollnivnian。 [hao ba ， ye xu wo wu fa zhao dao ren he xin de gong ying shang ， yin wei wo shi  Pollnivnian。]

english: You're what?
translation: 你是什​​么？ [ni shi shen ​​ me ？]

english: From Pollnivneach.
translation: 来自 Pollnivneach。 [lai zi  Pollnivneach。]

english: Maybe I could help you then?
translation: 也许我可以帮助你？ [ye xu wo ke yi bang zhu ni ？]

english: Perhaps you could.
translation: 也许你可以。 [ye xu ni ke yi 。]

english: My friend in Sophanem... Ahh never mind him, maybe we might have a look at him another time.
translation: 我在索法内姆的朋友……啊，别介意他，也许我们可以下次再看看他。 [wo zai suo fa nei mu de peng you …… a ， bie jie yi ta ， ye xu wo men ke yi xia ci zai kan kan ta 。]

english: Is there anyone else you want me to talk to on your behalf?
translation: 您还想让我代表您与其他人交谈吗？ [nin hai xiang rang wo dai biao nin yu qi ta ren jiao tan ma ？]

english: There's a blackjack seller in Pollnivneach, a cautious type of guy, not the usual entrepreneurial sort that I would normally deal with, but...
translation: Pollnivneach 有一个二十一点卖家，他是一个谨慎的人，不是我通常会遇到的那种典型的企业家类型，但是...... [Pollnivneach  you yi ge er shi yi dian mai jia ， ta shi yi ge jin shen de ren ， bu shi wo tong chang hui yu dao de na zhong dian xing de qi ye jia lei xing ， dan shi ......]

english: I think that he has a product with real potential...
translation: 我认为他的产品具有真正的潜力...... [wo ren wei ta de chan pin ju you zhen zheng de qian li ......]

english: What? .... Blackjacks?
translation: 什么？ ....二十一点？ [shen me ？ .... er shi yi dian ？]

english: Yes, but at the moment the product isn't polished enough, if you could convince him to create a larger variety of weapon I would gladly stock his products.
translation: 是的，但目前产品还不够完善，如果你能说服他制造更多种类的武器，我很乐意库存他的产品。 [shi de ， dan mu qian chan pin hai bu gou wan shan ， ru guo ni neng shuo fu ta zhi zao geng duo zhong lei de wu qi ， wo hen le yi ku cun ta de chan pin 。]

english: What's in this for me?
translation: 这对我来说有什么好处？ [zhe dui wo lai shuo you shen me hao chu ？]

english: I thought you wanted to help.
translation: 我以为你想帮忙。 [wo yi wei ni xiang bang mang 。]

english: Of course, but everyone seems to be benefiting here but me.
translation: 当然，但除了我之外，每个人似乎都受益于此。 [dang ran ， dan chu le wo zhi wai ， mei ge ren si hu dou shou yi yu ci 。]

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你是什​​么意思？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: Well the trader gets their product sold, you get your cut, but what do I get?
translation: 好吧，贸易商把他们的产品卖掉，你得到你的分成，但我能得到什么？ [hao ba ， mao yi shang ba ta men de chan pin mai diao ， ni de dao ni de fen cheng ， dan wo neng de dao shen me ？]

english: You get access to more products. Is that not reward enough?
translation: 您可以获得更多产品。这还不够奖励吗？ [nin ke yi huo de geng duo chan pin 。 zhe hai bu gou jiang li ma ？]

english: Hmmm... Perhaps not.
translation: 嗯...也许不是。 [n ... ye xu bu shi 。]

english: Didn't we also agree that you would get discounted travel on my magic carpet network?
translation: 我们不是还同意您在我的魔毯网络上享受旅行折扣吗？ [wo men bu shi hai tong yi nin zai wo de mo tan wang luo shang xiang shou lv xing zhe kou ma ？]

english: Oh ya, I forgot.
translation: 哦对了，我忘了。 [o dui le ， wo wang le 。]

english: So what's your problem then?
translation: 那么你的问题是什么？ [na me ni de wen ti shi shen me ？]

english: I don't have one I guess.
translation: 我猜我没有。 [wo cai wo mei you 。]

english: Good, that's what I like to hear. Now where were we?
translation: 很好，这就是我喜欢听的。现在我们在哪里？ [hen hao ， zhe jiu shi wo xi huan ting de 。 xian zai wo men zai na li ？]

english: Ok I'll get on to it.
translation: 好的，我会继续做下去。 [hao de ， wo hui ji xu zuo xia qu 。]

english: I have an old friend - a cloth merchant Siamun, who lives in Sophanem - Do you know the place?
translation: 我有一个老朋友 - 布商西阿蒙 (Siamun)，他住在索法内姆 (Sophanem) - 你知道那个地方吗？ [wo you yi ge lao peng you  -  bu shang xi a meng  (Siamun)， ta zhu zai suo fa nei mu  (Sophanem) -  ni zhi dao na ge di fang ma ？]

english: Umm..... Images of cats and priests come to mind. Ah yes! There we go, it's the city of the dead South of Pollnivneach isn't it?
translation: 嗯......猫和牧师的形象浮现在脑海中。啊，是的！瞧，这就是 Pollnivneach 以南的死亡之城，不是吗？ [n ...... mao he mu shi de xing xiang fu xian zai nao hai zhong 。 a ， shi de ！ qiao ， zhe jiu shi  Pollnivneach  yi nan de si wang zhi cheng ， bu shi ma ？]

english: That's the one, well if you could convince him to supply me with some of his merchandise, I would be more than willing to sell them to the masses ...... for a small percentage of course.
translation: 就是这样，如果你能说服他向我提供一些他的商品，我会非常愿意将它们卖给大众……当然只卖一小部分。 [jiu shi zhe yang ， ru guo ni neng shuo fu ta xiang wo ti gong yi xie ta de shang pin ， wo hui fei chang yuan yi jiang ta men mai gei da zhong …… dang ran zhi mai yi xiao bu fen 。]

english: Siamun's clothes seem to have really struck a chord with the locals in Al Kharid. Menaphite culture seems to be taking off here, rumour has it that one of Prince Ali's servants bought him one of Siamun's robes.
translation: Siamun 的服装似乎确实引起了 Al Kharid 当地人的共鸣。梅纳菲特文化似乎在这里蓬勃发展，有传言说阿里王子的一位仆人给他买了一件西亚蒙的长袍。 [Siamun  de fu zhuang si hu que shi yin qi le  Al Kharid  dang di ren de gong ming 。 mei na fei te wen hua si hu zai zhe li peng bo fa zhan ， you chuan yan shuo a li wang zi de yi wei pu ren gei ta mai le yi jian xi ya meng de chang pao 。]

english: Wow, that sounds positive.
translation: 哇，这听起来很积极。 [wa ， zhe ting qi lai hen ji ji 。]

english: Quite, if I don't say so myself. But in order to keep things fresh, the next time you're in Sophanem, could you ask that cranky old so-and-so Siamun to produce a new line of clothing?
translation: 确实，如果我自己不这么说的话。但为了保持新鲜感，下次你在索法奈姆时，你能请那个脾气暴躁的老某某西阿蒙生产一套新的服装吗？ [que shi ， ru guo wo zi ji bu zhe me shuo de hua 。 dan wei le bao chi xin xian gan ， xia ci ni zai suo fa nai mu shi ， ni neng qing na ge pi qi bao zao de lao mou mou xi a meng sheng chan yi tao xin de fu zhuang ma ？]

english: Sure, why not. The Sultan himself might even buy some of the new range.
translation: 当然，为什么不呢。苏丹本人甚至可能会购买一些新系列。 [dang ran ， wei shen me bu ne 。 su dan ben ren shen zhi ke neng hui gou mai yi xie xin xi lie 。]

english: That would be the day.
translation: 那一天就会到来。 [na yi tian jiu hui dao lai 。]

english: Who did you want me to talk to again?
translation: 你想让我再和谁说话？ [ni xiang rang wo zai he shui shuo hua ？]

english: Could you talk to your friend Aubury in Varrock about supplying me with runes?
translation: 你能和你在瓦罗克的朋友奥伯里谈谈为我提供符文的事吗？ [ni neng he ni zai wa luo ke de peng you ao bo li tan tan wei wo ti gong fu wen de shi ma ？]

english: Hmm, that could work out quite well. Varrock is always quite busy, so I might try to get a couple of other things done while I'm there.
translation: 嗯，这可能会很顺利。 Varrock 总是很忙，所以我在那里时可能会尝试完成一些其他事情。 [n ， zhe ke neng hui hen shun li 。 Varrock  zong shi hen mang ， suo yi wo zai na li shi ke neng hui chang shi wan cheng yi xie qi ta shi qing 。]

english: Don't tarry there too long, I'm quite anxious to get a rune store open before anyone else in this area.
translation: 不要在那里停留太久，我非常渴望在这个地区比其他人先开一家符文商店。 [bu yao zai na li ting liu tai jiu ， wo fei chang ke wang zai zhe ge di qu bi qi ta ren xian kai yi jia fu wen shang dian 。]

english: I'll get to it right away.
translation: 我马上去处理。 [wo ma shang qu chu li 。]

english: I'll tell you what then, how about I let you have discounted flights on my magic carpet rides?
translation: 那我告诉你，我让你乘坐我的魔毯可以享受折扣航班怎么样？ [na wo gao su ni ， wo rang ni cheng zuo wo de mo tan ke yi xiang shou zhe kou hang ban zen me yang ？]

english: Wow that would be great.
translation: 哇，那太好了。 [wa ， na tai hao le 。]

english: Fair enough, so we have a win, win, win situation on our hands then.
translation: 很公平，所以我们手上有一个双赢、双赢、双赢的局面。 [hen gong ping ， suo yi wo men shou shang you yi ge shuang ying 、 shuang ying 、 shuang ying de ju mian 。]

english: I think I need just one more product type, something, magical ... now what could I stock that's magical, has large demand and a pretty good profit margin...
translation: 我想我只需要一种产品类型，某种神奇的东西......现在我可以储存什么是神奇的，有很大的需求和相当好的利润率...... [wo xiang wo zhi xu yao yi zhong chan pin lei xing ， mou zhong shen qi de dong xi ...... xian zai wo ke yi chu cun shen me shi shen qi de ， you hen da de xu qiu he xiang dang hao de li run lv ......]

english: How about runes?
translation: 符文怎么样？ [fu wen zen me yang ？]

english: Yes, that would be perfect, but who could I get that would supply? There really seems to be a gap in the market in the desert but I don't know anyone in that line of business.
translation: 是的，那就完美了，但是我可以找谁来提供呢？沙漠中的市场似乎确实存在缺口，但我不认识从事这一行业的人。 [shi de ， na jiu wan mei le ， dan shi wo ke yi zhao shui lai ti gong ne ？ sha mo zhong de shi chang si hu que shi cun zai que kou ， dan wo bu ren shi cong shi zhe yi xing ye de ren 。]

english: Hang on, I know somebody called Aubury, decent fella. I helped him out a while back. Perhaps I could approach him about the idea.
translation: 等等，我认识一个叫奥伯里的人，正派的家伙。前段时间我帮过他。也许我可以向他提出这个想法。 [deng deng ， wo ren shi yi ge jiao ao bo li de ren ， zheng pai de jia huo 。 qian duan shi jian wo bang guo ta 。 ye xu wo ke yi xiang ta ti chu zhe ge xiang fa 。]

english: Oh yes, the rune seller from Varrock. That would be perfect. He's far enough away that he wouldn't end up competing with himself.
translation: 哦，是的，来自 Varrock 的符文卖家。那将是完美的。他已经足够远了，他不会最终与自己竞争。 [o ， shi de ， lai zi  Varrock  de fu wen mai jia 。 na jiang shi wan mei de 。 ta yi jing zu gou yuan le ， ta bu hui zui zhong yu zi ji jing zheng 。]

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你是什​​么意思？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: Well the rune market is a limited one, if I were to sell his runes from a location nearby his shop, then I would take part of his market share so he would in fact not benefit from me selling runes.
translation: 好吧，符文市场是有限的，如果我要在他商店附近的地方出售他的符文，那么我就会占据他的部分市场份额，这样他实际上就不会从我出售符文中受益。 [hao ba ， fu wen shi chang shi you xian de ， ru guo wo yao zai ta shang dian fu jin de di fang chu shou ta de fu wen ， na me wo jiu hui zhan ju ta de bu fen shi chang fen e ， zhe yang ta shi ji shang jiu bu hui cong wo chu shou fu wen zhong shou yi 。]

english: Ah ha, I think I know where this is going. So because you're located far enough away from him you will take up someone else's share in the market and Aubury will make more money as a result.
translation: 啊哈哈，我想我知道这是怎么回事了。因此，由于您距离他足够远，您将占据其他人在市场上的份额，而奥伯里将因此赚更多的钱。 [a ha ha ， wo xiang wo zhi dao zhe shi zen me hui shi le 。 yin ci ， you yu nin ju li ta zu gou yuan ， nin jiang zhan ju qi ta ren zai shi chang shang de fen e ， er ao bo li jiang yin ci zhuan geng duo de qian 。]

english: Very well anticipated.
translation: 非常值得期待。 [fei chang zhi de qi dai 。]

english: Well you had better get going, you've a fair bit of travelling ahead of you. Unless you want to make a small purchase from me first?
translation: 好吧，你最好出发了，你还有很长的路要走。除非你想先从我这里买点小东西？ [hao ba ， ni zui hao chu fa le ， ni hai you hen zhang de lu yao zou 。 chu fei ni xiang xian cong wo zhe li mai dian xiao dong xi ？]

english: No, I'm really too busy.
translation: 不，我真的太忙了。 [bu ， wo zhen de tai mang le 。]

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。 [hao de 。]

english: Good job on getting the rune stone shipments sorted. I'm just receiving the first of them. Though there seems to be a funny sort of locking mechanism on them, which I haven't completely figured out.
translation: 符文石运输的分类工作做得很好。我刚刚收到第一个。虽然它们上似乎有一种有趣的锁定机制，但我还没有完全弄清楚。 [fu wen shi yun shu de fen lei gong zuo zuo de hen hao 。 wo gang gang shou dao di yi ge 。 sui ran ta men shang si hu you yi zhong you qu de suo ding ji zhi ， dan wo hai mei you wan quan nong qing chu 。]

english: No problem. I might have a look at it later.
translation: 没问题。我稍后可能会看看。 [mei wen ti 。 wo shao hou ke neng hui kan kan 。]

english: [player name], I would like to commend you on all the selfless help you have given me.
translation: [玩家姓名]，我要赞扬你给予我的所有无私帮助。 [[ wan jia xing ming ]， wo yao zan yang ni ji yu wo de suo you wu si bang zhu 。]

english: It was nothing, really.
translation: 真的没什么。 [zhen de mei shen me 。]

english: I think you underestimate your efforts. Anyway, as a token of my gratitude I have told all my magic carpet attendants to allow you to travel on the carpets at a discounted rate.
translation: 我认为你低估了自己的努力。不管怎样，为了表达我的谢意，我已经告诉我所有的魔毯服务员，让你们以折扣价乘坐魔毯旅行。 [wo ren wei ni di gu le zi ji de nu li 。 bu guan zen yang ， wei le biao da wo de xie yi ， wo yi jing gao su wo suo you de mo tan fu wu yuan ， rang ni men yi zhe kou jia cheng zuo mo tan lv xing 。]

english: Really, Ali, there is no need.
translation: 真的，阿里，没必要。 [zhen de ， a li ， mei bi yao 。]

english: I insist.
translation: 我坚持。 [wo jian chi 。]

english: I hear you're planning to expand your business here...
translation: 我听说你打算在这里扩展你的业务...... [wo ting shuo ni da suan zai zhe li kuo zhan ni de ye wu ......]

english: Of course, my friend. Any good salesman ought to take the opportunities that present themselves.
translation: 当然，我的朋友。任何优秀的推销员都应该抓住出现的机会。 [dang ran ， wo de peng you 。 ren he you xiu de tui xiao yuan dou ying gai zhua zhu chu xian de ji hui 。]

english: But your men are threatening the other shopkeepers!
translation: 但你的手下正在威胁其他店主！ [dan ni de shou xia zheng zai wei xie qi ta dian zhu ！]

english: That is regrettable, I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕这是令人遗憾的。 [kong pa zhe shi ling ren yi han de 。]

english: And the gnomes don't sound very happy about your magic carpet business.
translation: 侏儒们听起来对你的魔毯生意不太高兴。 [zhu ru men ting qi lai dui ni de mo tan sheng yi bu tai gao xing 。]

english: A good businessman looks for all the opportunities he can.
translation: 一个好的商人会寻找一切他能找到的机会。 [yi ge hao de shang ren hui xun zhao yi qie ta neng zhao dao de ji hui 。]

english: Aren't you going to do anything about your men?
translation: 你就不打算对你的男人做点什么吗？ [ni jiu bu da suan dui ni de nan ren zuo dian shen me ma ？]

english: Well, these associates of my nephew can be somewhat... overenthusiastic.
translation: 嗯，我侄子的这些同事可能有点……过于热情。 [n ， wo zhi zi de zhe xie tong shi ke neng you dian …… guo yu re qing 。]

english: I'm sure they'll settle down soon.
translation: 我确信他们很快就会安定下来。 [wo que xin ta men hen kuai jiu hui an ding xia lai 。]

english: But they're threatening to hurt the shopkeepers if they don't cooperate!
translation: 但他们威胁说，如果店主不合作，他们就会受到伤害！ [dan ta men wei xie shuo ， ru guo dian zhu bu he zuo ， ta men jiu hui shou dao shang hai ！]

english: Well, there's a simple solution there, don't you agree?
translation: 嗯，有一个简单的解决方案，您同意吗？ [n ， you yi ge jian dan de jie jue fang an ， nin tong yi ma ？]

english: Are you planning to take over all of Al Kharid's shops?
translation: 您打算接管 Al Kharid 的所有商店吗？ [nin da suan jie guan  Al Kharid  de suo you shang dian ma ？]

english: It's a step in the right direction.
translation: 这是朝着正确方向迈出的一步。 [zhe shi chao zhe zheng que fang xiang mai chu de yi bu 。]

english: Now, would you like to have a look at my wares?
translation: 现在，您想看看我的商品吗？ [xian zai ， nin xiang kan kan wo de shang pin ma ？]

english: What will you do about the gnomes?
translation: 你会对侏儒做什么？ [ni hui dui zhu ru zuo shen me ？]

english: They can continue running their gliders into trees, and I'll keep my business going. Sooner or later it'll all work out in my favour.
translation: 他们可以继续用滑翔机撞树，而我会继续我的生意。迟早一切都会对我有利。 [ta men ke yi ji xu yong hua xiang ji zhuang shu ， er wo hui ji xu wo de sheng yi 。 chi zao yi qie du hui dui wo you li 。]

english: I suppose so...
translation: 我想是这样... [wo xiang shi zhe yang ...]

english: Anyway, before you go, take a look at my wares.
translation: 不管怎样，走之前先看看我的东西。 [bu guan zen yang ， zou zhi qian xian kan kan wo de dong xi 。]

english: Well, good luck with your business.
translation: 嗯，祝您生意兴隆。 [n ， zhu nin sheng yi xing long 。]

english: Before you go, have a look at my wares.
translation: 走之前，先看看我的商品。 [zou zhi qian ， xian kan kan wo de shang pin 。]

english: I would like to have a look at your selection of blackjacks.
translation: 我想看看你们选择的二十一点。 [wo xiang kan kan ni men xuan ze de er shi yi dian 。]

english: I would like to have a look at your selection of clothes.
translation: 我想看看你选的衣服。 [wo xiang kan kan ni xuan de yi fu 。]

english: I would like to have a look at your selection of runes.
translation: 我想看看你选择的符文。 [wo xiang kan kan ni xuan ze de fu wen 。]

english: Try opening a small casket of runes
translation: 尝试打开一小盒符文 [chang shi da kai yi xiao he fu wen]

english: Force box.
translation: 力盒。 [li he 。]

english: Buy all the runes for [amount].
translation: 以 [数量] 购买所有符文。 [yi  [ shu liang ]  gou mai suo you fu wen 。]

english: Find out what the runes are.
translation: 找出符文是什么。 [zhao chu fu wen shi shen me 。]

english: Pick lock.
translation: 开锁。 [kai suo 。]

english: Examine lock.
translation: 检查锁。 [jian cha suo 。]

english: Try opening a large casket of runes
translation: 尝试打开一大箱符文 [chang shi da kai yi da xiang fu wen]

english: On second thoughts I don't really need any runes.
translation: 转念一想，我真的不需要任何符文。 [zhuan nian yi xiang ， wo zhen de bu xu yao ren he fu wen 。]

english: I would like to have a look at your general stock.
translation: 我想看看你们的一般库存。 [wo xiang kan kan ni men de yi ban ku cun 。]

english: So what's in this for me?
translation: 那么这对我来说有什么好处呢？ [na me zhe dui wo lai shuo you shen me hao chu ne ？]

english: Ok I'll get on to it.
translation: 好的，我会继续做下去。 [hao de ， wo hui ji xu zuo xia qu 。]

english: Who did you want me to talk to again?
translation: 你想让我再和谁说话？ [ni xiang rang wo zai he shui shuo hua ？]

english: No I'm really too busy.
translation: 不，我真的太忙了。 [bu ， wo zhen de tai mang le 。]

english: Ok
translation: 好的 [hao de]

english: I hear you're planning to expand your business here...
translation: 我听说你打算在这里扩展你的业务...... [wo ting shuo ni da suan zai zhe li kuo zhan ni de ye wu ......]

english: Aren't you going to do anything about your men?
translation: 你就不打算对你的男人做点什么吗？ [ni jiu bu da suan dui ni de nan ren zuo dian shen me ma ？]

english: But they're threatening to hurt the shopkeepers if they don't cooperate!
translation: 但他们威胁说，如果店主不合作，他们就会受到伤害！ [dan ta men wei xie shuo ， ru guo dian zhu bu he zuo ， ta men jiu hui shou dao shang hai ！]

english: No, I'm really too busy.
translation: 不，我真的太忙了。 [bu ， wo zhen de tai mang le 。]

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。 [hao de 。]

english: Well, good luck with your business.
translation: 嗯，祝您生意兴隆。 [n ， zhu nin sheng yi xing long 。]

english: What will you do about the gnomes?
translation: 你会对侏儒做什么？ [ni hui dui zhu ru zuo shen me ？]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Good day. Can I help you with anything?
translation: 再会。我可以帮你什么忙吗？ [zai hui 。 wo ke yi bang ni shen me mang ma ？]

english: Yes, I'd like a drink please.
translation: 是的，我想喝一杯。 [shi de ， wo xiang he yi bei 。]

english: What's going on in town?
translation: 城里发生了什么事？ [cheng li fa sheng le shen me shi ？]

english: Nothing much really. About what you'd expect from a sleepy little town like ours.
translation: 真的没什么。关于我们这样一个沉睡的小镇的期望。 [zhen de mei shen me 。 guan yu wo men zhe yang yi ge chen shui de xiao zhen de qi wang 。]

english: What about those two gangs? That seems exciting.
translation: 那两个帮派呢？这看起来很令人兴奋。 [na liang ge bang pai ne ？ zhe kan qi lai hen ling ren xing fen 。]

english: They're paying customers, so I won't rock the boat if you don't mind.
translation: 他们是付费客户，所以如果你不介意的话我不会惹事生非。 [ta men shi fu fei ke hu ， suo yi ru guo ni bu jie yi de hua wo bu hui re shi sheng fei 。]

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 还有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [hai you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

english: No thanks, I'm ok. Thanks for your time.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我很好。感谢您抽出时间。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo hen hao 。 gan xie nin chou chu shi jian 。]

english: I'm looking for Traitorous Ali.
translation: 我正在寻找叛徒阿里。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao pan tu a li 。]

english: He was just here! Look, he's even left his drink on the table by those barrels. Must have nipped out to go to the toilet.
translation: 他刚刚就在这里！看，他甚至把饮料留在了桌子上的那些桶旁边。一定是出去上厕所了。 [ta gang gang jiu zai zhe li ！ kan ， ta shen zhi ba yin liao liu zai le zhuo zi shang de na xie tong pang bian 。 yi ding shi chu qu shang ce suo le 。]

english: He might be gone a while though. The nearest outhouse is all the way over on Fossil Island.
translation: 不过他可能会离开一段时间。最近的户外厕所就在化石岛上。 [bu guo ta ke neng hui li kai yi duan shi jian 。 zui jin de hu wai ce suo jiu zai hua shi dao shang 。]

english: I'm looking for Ali from Pollnivneach.
translation: 我正在寻找 Pollnivneach 的阿里。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao  Pollnivneach  de a li 。]

english: Well, I'm called Ali and I'm from here. Are you looking for me?
translation: 嗯，我叫阿里，我来自这里。你在找我吗？ [n ， wo jiao a li ， wo lai zi zhe li 。 ni zai zhao wo ma ？]

english: Do you have an uncle called Ali?
translation: 你有一个叔叔叫阿里吗？ [ni you yi ge shu shu jiao a li ma ？]

english: Yes! All my uncles are called Ali!
translation: 是的！我的叔叔们都叫阿里！ [shi de ！ wo de shu shu men dou jiao a li ！]

english: Oh dear. Well do any of your uncles have a stall in the Bazaar in Al Kharid?
translation: 哦亲爱的。那么，你的叔叔在阿尔卡里德的集市上有摊位吗？ [o qin ai de 。 na me ， ni de shu shu zai a er ka li de de ji shi shang you tan wei ma ？]

english: Um... no.
Well do you know if anyone here does?
translation: 那么你知道这里有人这样做吗？ [na me ni zhi dao zhe li you ren zhe yang zuo ma ？]

english: That's a difficult question to answer. I don't know anyone else's uncles.
translation: 这是一个很难回答的问题。我不认识别人的叔叔。 [zhe shi yi ge hen nan hui da de wen ti 。 wo bu ren shi bie ren de shu shu 。]

english: The 'Asp and Snake'? What a strange name for a bar.
translation: “阿斯与蛇”？酒吧的名字真是奇怪啊。 [“ a si yu she ”？ jiu ba de ming zi zhen shi qi guai a 。]

english: Maybe around these parts. Were you expecting it to have 'Ali' in the name?
translation: 也许围绕这些部分。你期待它的名字里有“阿里”吗？ [ye xu wei rao zhe xie bu fen 。 ni qi dai ta de ming zi li you “ a li ” ma ？]

english: I did think about calling it 'Ali's', but then it'd get confused with the Camel Shop, the Kebab House, the Mayor's residence...
translation: 我确实想过叫它“阿里”，但这样就会和骆驼店、烤肉店、市长官邸混淆…… [wo que shi xiang guo jiao ta “ a li ”， dan zhe yang jiu hui he luo tuo dian 、 kao rou dian 、 shi zhang guan di hun xiao ……]

english: Yes, I get your point. It's a perfectly fine name.
translation: 是的，我明白你的意思。这是一个非常好的名字。 [shi de ， wo ming bai ni de yi si 。 zhe shi yi ge fei chang hao de ming zi 。]

english: Yes, I'd like a drink please.
translation: 是的，我想喝一杯。 [shi de ， wo xiang he yi bei 。]

english: What's going on in town?
translation: 城里发生了什么事？ [cheng li fa sheng le shen me shi ？]

english: No thanks, I'm ok.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我很好。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo hen hao 。]

english: Yes, I'd like to talk about something else.
translation: 是的，我想谈谈别的事情。 [shi de ， wo xiang tan tan bie de shi qing 。]

english: I'm looking for Traitorous Ali.
translation: 我正在寻找叛徒阿里。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao pan tu a li 。]

english: I'm looking for Ali from Pollnivneach.
translation: 我正在寻找 Pollnivneach 的阿里。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao  Pollnivneach  de a li 。]

english: The 'Asp and Snake'? What a strange name for a bar.
translation: “阿斯与蛇”？酒吧的名字真是奇怪啊。 [“ a si yu she ”？ jiu ba de ming zi zhen shi qi guai a 。]

english: That beast would probably bite my fingers off if I tried to pet it.
translation: 如果我试图抚摸那只野兽，它可能会咬掉我的手指。 [ru guo wo shi tu fu mo na zhi ye shou ， ta ke neng hui yao diao wo de shou zhi 。]

english: If you want me to bite your fingers off, you're going the right way about it!
translation: 如果你想让我咬掉你的手指，那你就走对了！ [ru guo ni xiang rang wo yao diao ni de shou zhi ， na ni jiu zou dui le ！]

english: I'm not going to pet that! It will probably bite my hand off, that filthy beast.
translation: 我不会宠它！它可能会咬掉我的手，这只肮脏的野兽。 [wo bu hui chong ta ！ ta ke neng hui yao diao wo de shou ， zhe zhi ang zang de ye shou 。]

english: Watch who you're calling a filthy beast, human.
translation: 小心你说谁是肮脏的野兽，人类。 [xiao xin ni shuo shui shi ang zang de ye shou ， ren lei 。]

english: Mmmm... you'd make a tasty kebab.
translation: 嗯……你会做一个美味的烤肉串。 [n …… ni hui zuo yi ge mei wei de kao rou chuan 。]

english: And you'd make an excellent spit bucket! Pchoo!
translation: 你会成为一个很棒的吐桶！噗！ [ni hui cheng wei yi ge hen bang de tu tong ！ pu ！]

english: I'm not going to pet that nasty creature! I might get fleas... or worse!
translation: 我不会去抚摸那个讨厌的生物！我可能会感染跳蚤……或者更糟！ [wo bu hui qu fu mo na ge tao yan de sheng wu ！ wo ke neng hui gan ran tiao zao …… huo zhe geng zao ！]

english: You're fairly nasty yourself, human. When was the last time you took a shower?
translation: 你自己也够恶心的，人类。你最后一次洗澡是什么时候？ [ni zi ji ye gou e xin de ， ren lei 。 ni zui hou yi ci xi zao shi shen me shi hou ？]

english: Welcome to my discount camel store. Can I help you with anything?
translation: 欢迎来到我的骆驼折扣店。我可以帮你什么忙吗？ [huan ying lai dao wo de luo tuo zhe kou dian 。 wo ke yi bang ni shen me mang ma ？]

english: A discount camel store?
translation: 骆驼折扣店？ [luo tuo zhe kou dian ？]

english: Yes - it's my great idea - selling camels at discounted prices so that the common man can experience the joys of owning a camel of their very own! They're not just a source of kebab meat you know!
translation: 是的——这是我的好主意——以折扣价出售骆驼，让普通人能够体验拥有自己的骆驼的乐趣！你知道，它们不仅仅是烤肉串的来源！ [shi de —— zhe shi wo de hao zhu yi —— yi zhe kou jia chu shou luo tuo ， rang pu tong ren neng gou ti yan yong you zi ji de luo tuo de le qu ！ ni zhi dao ， ta men bu jin jin shi kao rou chuan de lai yuan ！]

english: So can I buy a camel then? I'm hungry!
translation: 那我可以买骆驼吗？我饿了！ [na wo ke yi mai luo tuo ma ？ wo e le ！]

english: I would never sell one to the likes of you! They are beautiful, majestic creatures, not food! Get out of my shop.
translation: 我绝对不会把一台卖给你这样的人！它们是美丽、雄伟的生物，而不是食物！滚出我的店。 [wo jue dui bu hui ba yi tai mai gei ni zhe yang de ren ！ ta men shi mei li 、 xiong wei de sheng wu ， er bu shi shi wu ！ gun chu wo de dian 。]

english: Yes, camels are beautiful creatures.
translation: 是的，骆驼是美丽的生物。 [shi de ， luo tuo shi mei li de sheng wu 。]

english: Ah, wondrous camels! Best of all Saradomin's creations. Ships of the desert, far more useful than any horse or donkey. Truly, they are a man's best friend.
translation: 啊，奇妙的骆驼！最棒的是萨拉多明的创作。沙漠中的船只，比任何马或驴都更有用。确实，它们是人类最好的朋友。 [a ， qi miao de luo tuo ！ zui bang de shi sa la duo ming de chuang zuo 。 sha mo zhong de chuan zhi ， bi ren he ma huo lv dou geng you yong 。 que shi ， ta men shi ren lei zui hao de peng you 。]

english: Perhaps you'd like a camel of your own? You're in the right place, if so...
translation: 也许您想要一头属于自己的骆驼？你来对地方了，如果是的话... [ye xu nin xiang yao yi tou shu yu zi ji de luo tuo ？ ni lai dui di fang le ， ru guo shi de hua ...]

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 还有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [hai you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

english: No but thanks for your time.
translation: 不，但感谢您抽出时间。 [bu ， dan gan xie nin chou chu shi jian 。]

english: Why would I want a camel? All they do is spit and...
translation: 我为什么想要一头骆驼？他们所做的就是吐口水，然后...... [wo wei shen me xiang yao yi tou luo tuo ？ ta men suo zuo de jiu shi tu kou shui ， ran hou ......]

english: Pah! I've seen mummies with more brains than you! If you treat camels badly then of course they're going to spit at you. May your robes never be clean again!
translation: 呸！我见过比你更有脑子的木乃伊！如果你虐待骆驼，它们当然会向你吐口水。愿你的袈裟永远不再干净！ [pei ！ wo jian guo bi ni geng you nao zi de mu nai yi ！ ru guo ni nve dai luo tuo ， ta men dang ran hui xiang ni tu kou shui 。 yuan ni de jia sha yong yuan bu zai gan jing ！]

english: Actually, I think I was a camel in a previous life.
translation: 其实我觉得我前世是一头骆驼。 [qi shi wo jue de wo qian shi shi yi tou luo tuo 。]

english: You're teasing me now! You rogue!
translation: 你现在在戏弄我！你这个流氓！ [ni xian zai zai xi nong wo ！ ni zhe ge liu mang ！]

english: Everyone laughs at the poor Discount Camel Seller.
translation: 每个人都嘲笑可怜的折扣骆驼卖家。 [mei ge ren dou chao xiao ke lian de zhe kou luo tuo mai jia 。]

english: So is the discount camel business good then?
translation: 那么折扣骆驼生意好不好呢？ [na me zhe kou luo tuo sheng yi hao bu hao ne ？]

english: Business is booming! Pollnivneach has never seen this number of visitors.
translation: 生意兴隆！ Pollnivneach 从未见过如此多的访客。 [sheng yi xing long ！ Pollnivneach  cong wei jian guo ru ci duo de fang ke 。]

english: In fact I'm thinking of expanding and trying to break into the camel hire market.
translation: 事实上，我正在考虑扩张并尝试打入骆驼租赁市场。 [shi shi shang ， wo zheng zai kao lv kuo zhang bing chang shi da ru luo tuo zu lin shi chang 。]

english: If only I could figure out how to get people to return the camels...
translation: 如果我能想出如何让人们归还骆驼就好了…… [ru guo wo neng xiang chu ru he rang ren men gui huan luo tuo jiu hao le ……]

english: Tell me about this town.
translation: 告诉我关于这个小镇的事。 [gao su wo guan yu zhe ge xiao zhen de shi 。]

english: Well, Pollnivneach is a funny little place. It's a small town and you'd think it'd be nice and quiet.
translation: 嗯，Polnivneach 是一个有趣的小地方。这是一个小镇，你会认为它美好而安静。 [n ，Polnivneach  shi yi ge you qu de xiao di fang 。 zhe shi yi ge xiao zhen ， ni hui ren wei ta mei hao er an jing 。]

english: But those Menaphites and bandits are making the place quite unbearable.
translation: 但那些梅纳菲特人和强盗却让这个地方变得难以忍受。 [dan na xie mei na fei te ren he qiang dao que rang zhe ge di fang bian de nan yi ren shou 。]

english: In what way?
translation: 以什么方式？ [yi shen me fang shi ？]

english: Well, one group is as bad as the other! They steal, they fight, they cause trouble with us locals. Just yesterday one of those bandits came looking for protection money!
translation: 好吧，一组和另一组一样糟糕！他们偷窃，他们打架，他们给我们当地人带来麻烦。就在昨天，其中一个强盗来索保护费！ [hao ba ， yi zu he ling yi zu yi yang zao gao ！ ta men tou qie ， ta men da jia ， ta men gei wo men dang di ren dai lai ma fan 。 jiu zai zuo tian ， qi zhong yi ge qiang dao lai suo bao hu fei ！]

english: Why don't the authorities stop this?
translation: 当局为何不制止这种行为？ [dang ju wei he bu zhi zhi zhe zhong xing wei ？]

english: We're a small town. We don't have the resources to keep the gangs off our backs! Menaphos and Al Kharid are no help either.
translation: 我们是一个小镇。我们没有资源来阻止这些帮派！梅纳福斯和阿尔卡里德也无济于事。 [wo men shi yi ge xiao zhen 。 wo men mei you zi yuan lai zu zhi zhe xie bang pai ！ mei na fu si he a er ka li de ye wu ji yu shi 。]

english: To tell the truth we live in hope that an outsider, someone with no ties to either group, could broker a deal to halt the hostilities between them.
translation: 说实话，我们希望有一个局外人，一个与任何一个组织都没有联系的人，能够达成一项协议，以停止他们之间的敌对行动。 [shuo shi hua ， wo men xi wang you yi ge ju wai ren ， yi ge yu ren he yi ge zu zhi dou mei you lian xi de ren ， neng gou da cheng yi xiang xie yi ， yi ting zhi ta men zhi jian de di dui xing dong 。]

english: Hmm...
Well the weak will always be trodden on. Why not stand up to them?
translation: 好吧，弱者永远会被践踏。为什么不站起来反抗他们呢？ [hao ba ， ruo zhe yong yuan hui bei jian ta 。 wei shen me bu zhan qi lai fan kang ta men ne ？]

english: That's a little unfair, my friend. We can't all be brave adventurers. If we were, where would you purchase quality camels at discounted prices?
translation: 这有点不公平，我的朋友。我们不可能都是勇敢的冒险家。如果是的话，您会在哪里以折扣价购买优质骆驼？ [zhe you dian bu gong ping ， wo de peng you 。 wo men bu ke neng dou shi yong gan de mao xian jia 。 ru guo shi de hua ， nin hui zai na li yi zhe kou jia gou mai you zhi luo tuo ？]

english: You might think about that. Anyway, isn't it the job of the brave adventurer to protect the weak and innocent from evil and harm?
translation: 你可能会想一想。不管怎样，保护弱者和无辜者免受邪恶和伤害，这不就是勇敢的冒险家的工作吗？ [ni ke neng hui xiang yi xiang 。 bu guan zen yang ， bao hu ruo zhe he wu gu zhe mian shou xie e he shang hai ， zhe bu jiu shi yong gan de mao xian jia de gong zuo ma ？]

english: Perhaps I could help.
translation: 也许我可以帮忙。 [ye xu wo ke yi bang mang 。]

english: Yes, perhaps you could.
translation: 是的，也许你可以。 [shi de ， ye xu ni ke yi 。]

english: You know the politics better than I do. What do you recommend?
translation: 你比我更了解政治。你有什么建议吗？ [ni bi wo geng liao jie zheng zhi 。 ni you shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: Me?! I am but a humble discount camel seller. You're the adventurer, don't you know what to do?
translation: 我？！我只是一个卑微的折扣骆驼卖家。你是冒险家，你不知道该怎么办吗？ [wo ？！ wo zhi shi yi ge bei wei de zhe kou luo tuo mai jia 。 ni shi mao xian jia ， ni bu zhi dao gai zen me ban ma ？]

english: Of course I know what to do! I was just testing you!
translation: 我当然知道该怎么做！我只是在考验你！ [wo dang ran zhi dao gai zen me zuo ！ wo zhi shi zai kao yan ni ！]

english: That is reassuring to hear. Too often one meets brainless adventurers whose solution to every problem is to hack, maim and murder.
translation: 听了这话真让人安心。人们常常会遇到无脑的冒险家，他们解决每一个问题的方法都是黑客攻击、残害和谋杀。 [ting le zhe hua zhen rang ren an xin 。 ren men chang chang hui yu dao wu nao de mao xian jia ， ta men jie jue mei yi ge wen ti de fang fa dou shi hei ke gong ji 、 can hai he mou sha 。]

english: I'm glad to know you're not of that ilk.
translation: 我很高兴知道你不是那样的人。 [wo hen gao xing zhi dao ni bu shi na yang de ren 。]

english: Perhaps I should know, but offered advice should never be shunned.
translation: 也许我应该知道，但所提供的建议永远不应该被回避。 [ye xu wo ying gai zhi dao ， dan suo ti gong de jian yi yong yuan bu ying gai bei hui bi 。]

english: The state of adventurers today. They need everything spelled out for them.
translation: 现在的冒险者的状态。他们需要为他们详细说明一切。 [xian zai de mao xian zhe de zhuang tai 。 ta men xu yao wei ta men xiang xi shuo ming yi qie 。]

english: What, you want me to put a little note in your quest journal?
translation: 什么，你想让我在你的任务日志里写点小纸条吗？ [shen me ， ni xiang rang wo zai ni de ren wu ri zhi li xie dian xiao zhi tiao ma ？]

english: But fine, I'll give you a hint. Try and see if you can get the gangs to agree to a truce by offering them each a token gift as an act of reconciliation.
translation: 不过好吧，我会给你一个提示。尝试看看是否可以通过向各帮派提供象征性的礼物作为和解行为，让他们同意停战。 [bu guo hao ba ， wo hui gei ni yi ge ti shi 。 chang shi kan kan shi fou ke yi tong guo xiang ge bang pai ti gong xiang zheng xing de li wu zuo wei he jie xing wei ， rang ta men tong yi ting zhan 。]

english: If that fails to work, you must consider trying to influence the gangs from within.
translation: 如果这不起作用，你必须考虑尝试从内部影响帮派。 [ru guo zhe bu qi zuo yong ， ni bi xu kao lv chang shi cong nei bu ying xiang bang pai 。]

english: Lovely day isn't it?
translation: 美好的一天不是吗？ [mei hao de yi tian bu shi ma ？]

english: It's a beautiful day today, but word has it that it will rain tomorrow.
translation: 今天天气很好，但有消息说明天会下雨。 [jin tian tian qi hen hao ， dan you xiao xi shuo ming tian hui xia yu 。]

english: Really?
translation: 真的吗？ [zhen de ma ？]

english: No! When have you ever known it to rain here in Gielinor?
translation: 不！你什么时候知道吉林诺下雨了？ [bu ！ ni shen me shi hou zhi dao ji lin nuo xia yu le ？]

english: Oh. Anyway...
translation: 哦。反正... [o 。 fan zheng ...]

english: Those two camels around the side are already sold.
translation: 旁边那两只骆驼已经卖了。 [pang bian na liang zhi luo tuo yi jing mai le 。]

english: But you are in luck - I have another two beautiful camels arriving in soon from the best stable in all of Al Kharid.
translation: 但你很幸运 - 我还有另外两匹美丽的骆驼很快从阿尔卡里德最好的马厩运来。 [dan ni hen xing yun  -  wo hai you ling wai liang pi mei li de luo tuo hen kuai cong a er ka li de zui hao de ma jiu yun lai 。]

english: Camels, beautiful? I worry about you.
translation: 骆驼，漂亮吗？我担心你。 [luo tuo ， piao liang ma ？ wo dan xin ni 。]

english: Can you tell me a little about them?
translation: 你能告诉我一些关于他们的事吗？ [ni neng gao su wo yi xie guan yu ta men de shi ma ？]

english: Well Sandy, the female camel is a placid beast, and is 20 years of age and comes from a prestigious family whose mother was the part of the Sultan's baggage train.
translation: 好吧，桑迪，这头母骆驼是一头性情温和的野兽，今年 20 岁，来自一个名门望族，其母亲是苏丹行李列车的成员。 [hao ba ， sang di ， zhe tou mu luo tuo shi yi tou xing qing wen he de ye shou ， jin nian  20  sui ， lai zi yi ge ming men wang zu ， qi mu qin shi su dan xing li lie che de cheng yuan 。]

english: Lumps, on the other hand is a 15 year old male, a bit surly and prone to bouts of stubbornness. However he more than makes up for this failing with his immense strength and stamina.
translation: 另一方面，肿块是一名15岁的男性，有点脾气暴躁，容易固执。然而，他用自己巨大的力量和耐力弥补了这一缺陷。 [ling yi fang mian ， zhong kuai shi yi ming 15 sui de nan xing ， you dian pi qi bao zao ， rong yi gu zhi 。 ran er ， ta yong zi ji ju da de li liang he nai li mi bu le zhe yi que xian 。]

english: Both of them are of the 'Camelus Horribleus' family, a breed peculiar only to this area of Gielinor. It is....
translation: 它们都属于“Camelus Horribleus”家族，这是吉利诺这个地区特有的品种。这是.... [ta men dou shu yu “Camelus Horribleus” jia zu ， zhe shi ji li nuo zhe ge di qu te you de pin zhong 。 zhe shi ....]

english: Ok, ok, that's enough! So they're camels then!
translation: 好吧好吧，够了！那么它们就是骆驼！ [hao ba hao ba ， gou le ！ na me ta men jiu shi luo tuo ！]

english: What price do you want for both of them?
translation: 您想要两者的价格是多少？ [nin xiang yao liang zhe de jia ge shi duo shao ？]

english: One cannot put a price on life, they are precious beyond the worth of the crass value of gold coins!
translation: 生命是无法估价的，它的珍贵程度远胜过粗俗的金币！ [sheng ming shi wu fa gu jia de ， ta de zhen gui cheng du yuan sheng guo cu su de jin bi ！]

english: So can I have them for free then?
translation: 那么我可以免费获得它们吗？ [na me wo ke yi mian fei huo de ta men ma ？]

english: Are you trying to be funny?
translation: 你想搞笑吗？ [ni xiang gao xiao ma ？]

english: Perhaps I could make another offer?
translation: 也许我可以提出另一个报价？ [ye xu wo ke yi ti chu ling yi ge bao jia ？]

english: Would 200 gold coins for the pair of them do?
translation: 两个人200金币可以吗？ [liang ge ren 200 jin bi ke yi ma ？]

english: Pah! That might buy you a mangy flea infested sheep if you're lucky. Don't insult me.
translation: 呸！如果你幸运的话，这可能会给你买一只长满疥癣的跳蚤的羊。别侮辱我。 [pei ！ ru guo ni xing yun de hua ， zhe ke neng hui gei ni mai yi zhi zhang man jie xuan de tiao zao de yang 。 bie wu ru wo 。]

english: Would 500 gold coins for the pair of them do?
translation: 两人500金币可以吗？ [liang ren 500 jin bi ke yi ma ？]

english: You don't even have that much money do you? Come back when you're able to make a proper offer and stop wasting my time.
translation: 你连那么多钱都没有吧？当你能够提出合适的报价时再回来，不要再浪费我的时间了。 [ni lian na me duo qian dou mei you ba ？ dang ni neng gou ti chu he shi de bao jia shi zai hui lai ， bu yao zai lang fei wo de shi jian le 。]

english: I would consider giving them to you if you were able to look after them. But it is abundantly clear that you've got your hands full at the moment.
translation: 如果你能照顾它们，我会考虑把它们送给你。但很明显，您目前正忙得不可开交。 [ru guo ni neng zhao gu ta men ， wo hui kao lv ba ta men song gei ni 。 dan hen ming xian ， nin mu qian zheng mang de bu ke kai jiao 。]

english: I suppose I can silence my moral objections for that.
translation: 我想我可以对此压制我的道德反对意见。 [wo xiang wo ke yi dui ci ya zhi wo de dao de fan dui yi jian 。]

english: Ali the discount camel seller gives you a receipt for the camels in return for 500 gold coins.
translation: 折扣骆驼卖家阿里会给你一张骆驼收据，换取 500 金币。 [zhe kou luo tuo mai jia a li hui gei ni yi zhang luo tuo shou ju ， huan qu  500  jin bi 。]

english: Here are the receipts for the camels so that you can pick them up as soon as I get them in.
translation: 这是骆驼的收据，以便我一进去你就可以去取它们。 [zhe shi luo tuo de shou ju ， yi bian wo yi jin qu ni jiu ke yi qu qu ta men 。]

english: Would 1000 gold coins for the pair of them do?
translation: 两人1000金币可以吗？ [liang ren 1000 jin bi ke yi ma ？]

english: You are too generous, I would have sold for half of that!
translation: 你太慷慨了，我一半就卖了！ [ni tai kang kai le ， wo yi ban jiu mai le ！]

english: Hello! Welcome back to my discount camel store. How are those camels getting along?
translation: 你好！欢迎回到我的骆驼折扣店。那些骆驼相处得怎么样？ [ni hao ！ huan ying hui dao wo de luo tuo zhe kou dian 。 na xie luo tuo xiang chu de zen me yang ？]

english: About those camels, I've lost the receipt can I have another?
translation: 关于那些骆驼，我把收据丢了，我可以再要一张吗？ [guan yu na xie luo tuo ， wo ba shou ju diu le ， wo ke yi zai yao yi zhang ma ？]

english: I think you're trying to con me into giving you an extra receipt.
translation: 我认为你想骗我给你一张额外的收据。 [wo ren wei ni xiang pian wo gei ni yi zhang e wai de shou ju 。]

english: No problem, There you go.
translation: 没问题，就这样吧。 [mei wen ti ， jiu zhe yang ba 。]

english: I decided to get rid of the camels.
translation: 我决定摆脱骆驼。 [wo jue ding bai tuo luo tuo 。]

english: Why? did they not please you?
translation: 为什么？他们不高兴吗？ [wei shen me ？ ta men bu gao xing ma ？]

english: No, they didn't so I sold them as Kebab meat!
translation: 不，他们没有，所以我把它们当作烤肉串卖！ [bu ， ta men mei you ， suo yi wo ba ta men dang zuo kao rou chuan mai ！]

english: Not Sandy and Lumps! You beast! Get out of my shop now!
translation: 不是桑迪和肿块！你这个禽兽！赶紧滚出我的店！ [bu shi sang di he zhong kuai ！ ni zhe ge qin shou ！ gan jin gun chu wo de dian ！]

english: I'm not really a camel person so I gave them to a better owner.
translation: 我不是一个真正喜欢骆驼的人，所以我把它们给了一个更好的主人。 [wo bu shi yi ge zhen zheng xi huan luo tuo de ren ， suo yi wo ba ta men gei le yi ge geng hao de zhu ren 。]

english: Didn't I warn you that a camel is not like a puppy or a kitten, fun for a few days and then a tasty snack? They're more than that, they're for life!
translation: 我不是警告过你吗，骆驼不像小狗或小猫，可以开心几天，然后就成为美味的零食？他们的意义远不止这些，他们是一生的！ [wo bu shi jing gao guo ni ma ， luo tuo bu xiang xiao gou huo xiao mao ， ke yi kai xin ji tian ， ran hou jiu cheng wei mei wei de ling shi ？ ta men de yi yi yuan bu zhi zhe xie ， ta men shi yi sheng de ！]

english: I decided to try use them to end the hostilities between the two gangs.
translation: 我决定尝试用它们来结束两个帮派之间的敌对行动。 [wo jue ding chang shi yong ta men lai jie shu liang ge bang pai zhi jian de di dui xing dong 。]

english: A noble purpose for two noble beasts! Did you succeed?
translation: 两只高贵的野兽的崇高目标！你成功了吗？ [liang zhi gao gui de ye shou de chong gao mu biao ！ ni cheng gong le ma ？]

english: Still working on that, I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕仍在努力。 [kong pa reng zai nu li 。]

english: Good luck with that.
translation: 祝你好运。 [zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Hey Ali!
translation: 嘿阿里！ [hei a li ！]

english: Hello adventurer.
translation: 你好冒险家。 [ni hao mao xian jia 。]

english: Any news?
translation: 任何新闻？ [ren he xin wen ？]

english: Not much really, I just want to thank you for what you have done for this village, I can now get on with business.
translation: 其实没什么，我只是想感谢你为这个村子所做的一切，我现在可以继续做生意了。 [qi shi mei shen me ， wo zhi shi xiang gan xie ni wei zhe ge cun zi suo zuo de yi qie ， wo xian zai ke yi ji xu zuo sheng yi le 。]

english: Any grand plans?
translation: 有什么宏伟的计划吗？ [you shen me hong wei de ji hua ma ？]

english: Well I've been debating whether I should diversify. I might move into camel rental although I do have all these cages lying around which I could put to some use.
translation: 好吧，我一直在争论是否应该多元化。我可能会搬去出租骆驼，尽管我周围确实有这些笼子可以派上用场。 [hao ba ， wo yi zhi zai zheng lun shi fou ying gai duo yuan hua 。 wo ke neng hui ban qu chu zu luo tuo ， jin guan wo zhou wei que shi you zhe xie long zi ke yi pai shang yong chang 。]

english: Well good luck to you in whatever venture you do decide to go ahead with.
translation: 祝您在决定继续进行的任何冒险中好运。 [zhu nin zai jue ding ji xu jin xing de ren he mao xian zhong hao yun 。]

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: A discount camel store?
translation: 骆驼折扣店？ [luo tuo zhe kou dian ？]

english: So can I buy a camel then? I'm hungry!
translation: 那我可以买骆驼吗？我饿了！ [na wo ke yi mai luo tuo ma ？ wo e le ！]

english: Yes, camels are beautiful creatures.
translation: 是的，骆驼是美丽的生物。 [shi de ， luo tuo shi mei li de sheng wu 。]

english: Well yes actually I'd like to ask about something else.
translation: 嗯，是的，实际上我想问一些别的事情。 [n ， shi de ， shi ji shang wo xiang wen yi xie bie de shi qing 。]

english: No but thanks for your time.
translation: 不，但感谢您抽出时间。 [bu ， dan gan xie nin chou chu shi jian 。]

english: Why would I want a camel? All they do is spit and...
translation: 我为什么想要一头骆驼？他们所做的就是吐口水，然后...... [wo wei shen me xiang yao yi tou luo tuo ？ ta men suo zuo de jiu shi tu kou shui ， ran hou ......]

english: Actually, I think I was a camel in a previous life.
translation: 其实我觉得我前世是一头骆驼。 [qi shi wo jue de wo qian shi shi yi tou luo tuo 。]

english: So is the discount camel business good then?
translation: 那么折扣骆驼生意好不好呢？ [na me zhe kou luo tuo sheng yi hao bu hao ne ？]

english: Tell me about this town.
translation: 告诉我关于这个小镇的事。 [gao su wo guan yu zhe ge xiao zhen de shi 。]

english: In what way?
translation: 以什么方式？ [yi shen me fang shi ？]

english: Well the weak will always be trodden on. Why not stand up to them?
translation: 好吧，弱者永远会被践踏。为什么不站起来反抗他们呢？ [hao ba ， ruo zhe yong yuan hui bei jian ta 。 wei shen me bu zhan qi lai fan kang ta men ne ？]

english: Perhaps I could help.
translation: 也许我可以帮忙。 [ye xu wo ke yi bang mang 。]

english: Indeed I should know, and indeed I do! I was just testing you!
translation: 我确实应该知道，而且我确实知道！我只是在考验你！ [wo que shi ying gai zhi dao ， er qie wo que shi zhi dao ！ wo zhi shi zai kao yan ni ！]

english: Perhaps I should know, but offered advice should never be shunned.
translation: 也许我应该知道，但所提供的建议永远不应该被回避。 [ye xu wo ying gai zhi dao ， dan suo ti gong de jian yi yong yuan bu ying gai bei hui bi 。]

english: Lovely day isn't it?
translation: 美好的一天不是吗？ [mei hao de yi tian bu shi ma ？]

english: Are those camels around the side for sale?
translation: 旁边那些骆驼有卖吗？ [pang bian na xie luo tuo you mai ma ？]

english: Can you tell me a little about them?
translation: 你能告诉我一些关于他们的事吗？ [ni neng gao su wo yi xie guan yu ta men de shi ma ？]

english: What price do you want for both of them?
translation: 您想要两者的价格是多少？ [nin xiang yao liang zhe de jia ge shi duo shao ？]

english: So can I have them for free then?
translation: 那么我可以免费获得它们吗？ [na me wo ke yi mian fei huo de ta men ma ？]

english: Would 200 gold coins for the pair of them do?
translation: 两个人200金币可以吗？ [liang ge ren 200 jin bi ke yi ma ？]

english: Would 500 gold coins for the pair of them do?
translation: 两人500金币可以吗？ [liang ren 500 jin bi ke yi ma ？]

english: Would 1000 gold coins for the pair of them do?
translation: 两人1000金币可以吗？ [liang ren 1000 jin bi ke yi ma ？]

english: About those camels, I've lost the receipt. Can I have another?
translation: 关于那些骆驼，我把收据丢了。我可以再要一个吗？ [guan yu na xie luo tuo ， wo ba shou ju diu le 。 wo ke yi zai yao yi ge ma ？]

english: I decided to get rid of the camels.
translation: 我决定摆脱骆驼。 [wo jue ding bai tuo luo tuo 。]

english: No, they didn't so I sold them as Kebab meat!
translation: 不，他们没有，所以我把它们当作烤肉串卖！ [bu ， ta men mei you ， suo yi wo ba ta men dang zuo kao rou chuan mai ！]

english: I'm not really a camel person so I gave them to a better owner.
translation: 我不是一个真正喜欢骆驼的人，所以我把它们给了一个更好的主人。 [wo bu shi yi ge zhen zheng xi huan luo tuo de ren ， suo yi wo ba ta men gei le yi ge geng hao de zhu ren 。]

english: I decided to try use them to end the hostilities between the two gangs.
translation: 我决定尝试用它们来结束两个帮派之间的敌对行动。 [wo jue ding chang shi yong ta men lai jie shu liang ge bang pai zhi jian de di dui xing dong 。]

english: I'm looking for Ali from Pollnivneach.
translation: 我正在寻找 Pollnivneach 的阿里。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao  Pollnivneach  de a li 。]

english: You look glum.
translation: 你看起来闷闷不乐。 [ni kan qi lai men men bu le 。]

english: Business here really seems to have dried up. I had a good thing going here and you spoiled it.
translation: 这里的生意似乎真的枯竭了。我来这里有一件好事，你破坏了它。 [zhe li de sheng yi si hu zhen de ku jie le 。 wo lai zhe li you yi jian hao shi ， ni po huai le ta 。]

english: Well it serves you right really. Taking advantage of people like that.
translation: 嗯，它真的很适合你。就这样利用人。 [n ， ta zhen de hen shi he ni 。 jiu zhe yang li yong ren 。]

english: So want to buy some water?
translation: 那么想买点水吗？ [na me xiang mai dian shui ma ？]

english: How much?
translation: 多少？ [duo shao ？]

english: To you 1000 coins for a waterskin!
translation: 送你1000金币一个水袋！ [song ni 1000 jin bi yi ge shui dai ！]

english: You don't have 1000 coins to buy the water with.
translation: 你没有 1000 个金币来买水。 [ni mei you  1000  ge jin bi lai mai shui 。]

english: You buy a full waterskin for 1000 coins!
translation: 你花 1000 个金币买一个完整的水袋！ [ni hua  1000  ge jin bi mai yi ge wan zheng de shui dai ！]

english: I think I'll give it a miss.
translation: 我想我会错过它。 [wo xiang wo hui cuo guo ta 。]

english: If you want water you need to buy it off me.
translation: 如果你想要水，你需要从我这里买。 [ru guo ni xiang yao shui ， ni xu yao cong wo zhe li mai 。]

english: Ok, I feel sorry for you.
translation: 好吧，我为你感到难过。 [hao ba ， wo wei ni gan dao nan guo 。]

english: I think I'll give it a miss.
translation: 我想我会错过它。 [wo xiang wo hui cuo guo ta 。]

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好呀！ [ni hao ya ！]

english: Oh, er, hello. What do you want?
translation: 哦，呃，你好。你想要什么？ [o ， e ， ni hao 。 ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
translation: 关于阿尔·卡里德，你能告诉我什么吗？ [guan yu a er · ka li de ， ni neng gao su wo shen me ma ？]

english: There's not much farming land around here. Only that little patch outside.
translation: 这附近没有多少耕地。只有外面那一小块地方。 [zhe fu jin mei you duo shao geng di 。 zhi you wai mian na yi xiao kuai di fang 。]

english: Can you give me any advice on farming here in the desert?
translation: 你能给我一些关于在沙漠耕种的建议吗？ [ni neng gei wo yi xie guan yu zai sha mo geng zhong de jian yi ma ？]

english: Like I said, I only know about cactuses...
translation: 就像我说的，我只知道仙人掌...... [jiu xiang wo shuo de ， wo zhi zhi dao xian ren zhang ......]

english: Just tell me about cactuses, then.
translation: 那么请告诉我有关仙人掌的事情。 [na me qing gao su wo you guan xian ren zhang de shi qing 。]

english: First you have to weed the patch using a rake.
translation: 首先，您必须使用耙子除草。 [shou xian ， nin bi xu shi yong pa zi chu cao 。]

english: Can you give me any other advice?
translation: 你能给我任何其他建议吗？ [ni neng gei wo ren he qi ta jian yi ma ？]

english: Not really. I've not done much farming recently.
translation: 并不真地。我最近没怎么干农活。 [bing bu zhen di 。 wo zui jin mei zen me gan nong huo 。]

english: Well, can you at least sell me any gardening tools or seeds?
translation: 好吧，你至少能卖给我一些园艺工具或种子吗？ [hao ba ， ni zhi shao neng mai gei wo yi xie yuan yi gong ju huo zhong zi ma ？]

english: Sorry. They haven't been delivered yet.
translation: 对不起。他们还没有交付。 [dui bu qi 。 ta men hai mei you jiao fu 。]

english: So, what do you do here?
translation: 那么，你在这里做什么？ [na me ， ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm going to set up a shop selling farming implements. That patch out there may be small, but it's all we've got.
translation: 我打算开一家卖农具的商店。那个补丁可能很小，但这就是我们所拥有的一切。 [wo da suan kai yi jia mai nong ju de shang dian 。 na ge bu ding ke neng hen xiao ， dan zhe jiu shi wo men suo yong you de yi qie 。]

english: I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
translation: 我听说你为 Ali Morrisane 工作... [wo ting shuo ni wei  Ali Morrisane  gong zuo ...]

english: Yes, he bought these tents and had them put up for us. He says he'll also get our goods in so we can start selling them soon.
translation: 是的，他买了这些帐篷并为我们搭建起来。他说他也会把我们的货物运进来，这样我们就可以很快开始销售。 [shi de ， ta mai le zhe xie zhang peng bing wei wo men da jian qi lai 。 ta shuo ta ye hui ba wo men de huo wu yun jin lai ， zhe yang wo men jiu ke yi hen kuai kai shi xiao shou 。]

english: I only know how to farm cactuses, so this spot is perfect.
translation: 我只知道如何种植仙人掌，所以这个地方很完美。 [wo zhi zhi dao ru he zhong zhi xian ren zhang ， suo yi zhe ge di fang hen wan mei 。]

english: Maybe I should talk to him...
translation: 也许我应该和他谈谈... [ye xu wo ying gai he ta tan tan ...]

english: Of course. He's always happy to talk to possible business partners.
translation: 当然。他总是很乐意与可能的商业伙伴交谈。 [dang ran 。 ta zong shi hen le yi yu ke neng de shang ye huo ban jiao tan 。]

english: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
translation: 我听说你一直在威胁其他店主。 [wo ting shuo ni yi zhi zai wei xie qi ta dian zhu 。]

english: Now why would you think that?
translation: 现在你为什么会这么想？ [xian zai ni wei shen me hui zhe me xiang ？]

english: One of the shopkeepers told they were threatened by a man with a rake...
translation: 一名店主告诉他们，他们受到一名拿着耙子的男子的威胁…… [yi ming dian zhu gao su ta men ， ta men shou dao yi ming na zhe pa zi de nan zi de wei xie ……]

english: Those people just don't want us to succeed. Don't listen to them!
translation: 那些人只是不想让我们成功。别听他们的！ [na xie ren zhi shi bu xiang rang wo men cheng gong 。 bie ting ta men de ！]

english: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
translation: 关于阿尔·卡里德，你能告诉我什么吗？ [guan yu a er · ka li de ， ni neng gao su wo shen me ma ？]

english: So, what do you do here?
translation: 那么，你在这里做什么？ [na me ， ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
translation: 我听说你为 Ali Morrisane 工作... [wo ting shuo ni wei  Ali Morrisane  gong zuo ...]

english: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
translation: 我听说你一直在威胁其他店主。 [wo ting shuo ni yi zhi zai wei xie qi ta dian zhu 。]

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好呀！ [ni hao ya ！]

english: I'm working. What do you have to say that's so urgent?
translation: 我在工作。这么紧急有什么话要说？ [wo zai gong zuo 。 zhe me jin ji you shen me hua yao shuo ？]

english: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
translation: 关于阿尔·卡里德，你能告诉我什么吗？ [guan yu a er · ka li de ， ni neng gao su wo shen me ma ？]

english: There's a lot of space here. More open space than back home.
translation: 这里有很大的空间。比家里有更多的开放空间。 [zhe li you hen da de kong jian 。 bi jia li you geng duo de kai fang kong jian 。]

english: So where is back home?
translation: 那么回家又在哪里呢？ [na me hui jia you zai na li ne ？]

english: Pollnivneach. It's a town to the south of the Shantay Pass.
translation: 轮询。这是尚泰山口以南的一个小镇。 [lun xun 。 zhe shi shang tai shan kou yi nan de yi ge xiao zhen 。]

english: So, what do you do here?
translation: 那么，你在这里做什么？ [na me ， ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm on guard duty. Making sure nobody tries to steal anything from the house and tents in the middle of town.
translation: 我正在值班。确保没有人试图从镇中心的房屋和帐篷里偷任何东西。 [wo zheng zai zhi ban 。 que bao mei you ren shi tu cong zhen zhong xin de fang wu he zhang peng li tou ren he dong xi 。]

english: Why are you only guarding those buildings?
translation: 为什么你只守卫那些建筑物？ [wei shen me ni zhi shou wei na xie jian zhu wu ？]

english: That's all I've been hired to guard.
translation: 这就是我被雇来守护的一切。 [zhe jiu shi wo bei gu lai shou hu de yi qie 。]

english: I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
translation: 我听说你为 Ali Morrisane 工作... [wo ting shuo ni wei  Ali Morrisane  gong zuo ...]

english: Yeah, he hired me. He owns this house and these two tents, too.
translation: 是的，他雇用了我。他也拥有这栋房子和这两顶帐篷。 [shi de ， ta gu yong le wo 。 ta ye yong you zhe dong fang zi he zhe liang ding zhang peng 。]

english: Is the work good?
translation: 工作好不好？ [gong zuo hao bu hao ？]

english: It pays better than back home.
translation: 比回国工资还高。 [bi hui guo gong zi hai gao 。]

english: Why, what did you do back home?
translation: 为什么，你回家做了什么？ [wei shen me ， ni hui jia zuo le shen me ？]

english: Never you mind.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: But Ali Morrisane pays us well, at least.
translation: 但至少阿里·莫里萨内给我们的报酬很高。 [dan zhi shao a li · mo li sa nei gei wo men de bao chou hen gao 。]

english: Maybe I should talk to him...
translation: 也许我应该和他谈谈... [ye xu wo ying gai he ta tan tan ...]

english: Why not? He always likes to meet potential business partners.
translation: 为什么不呢？他总是喜欢结识潜在的商业伙伴。 [wei shen me bu ne ？ ta zong shi xi huan jie shi qian zai de shang ye huo ban 。]

english: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
translation: 我听说你一直在威胁其他店主。 [wo ting shuo ni yi zhi zai wei xie qi ta dian zhu 。]

english: So? They talk too much.
translation: 所以？他们说得太多了。 [suo yi ？ ta men shuo de tai duo le 。]

english: You're not going to deny it?
translation: 你不打算否认吗？ [ni bu da suan fou ren ma ？]

english: Why bother? None of them can fight back, after all.
