translation: 何苦呢？毕竟，他们谁都无法反击。 [he ku ne ？ bi jing ， ta men shei dou wu fa fan ji 。]

english: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
translation: 关于阿尔·卡里德，你能告诉我什么吗？ [guan yu a er · ka li de ， ni neng gao su wo shen me ma ？]

english: So, what do you do here?
translation: 那么，你在这里做什么？ [na me ， ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
translation: 我听说你为 Ali Morrisane 工作... [wo ting shuo ni wei  Ali Morrisane  gong zuo ...]

english: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
translation: 我听说你一直在威胁其他店主。 [wo ting shuo ni yi zhi zai wei xie qi ta dian zhu 。]

english: Good day old hag.
translation: 美好的一天，老太婆。 [mei hao de yi tian ， lao tai po 。]

english: Old hag indeed! I have a name you know!
translation: 确实是老太婆了！我有一个你知道的名字！ [que shi shi lao tai po le ！ wo you yi ge ni zhi dao de ming zi ！]

english: Does it happen to be... Ali?
translation: 难道是……阿里？ [nan dao shi …… a li ？]

english: Oh, it's actually Alisha, but they let me move in anyway. Not many hags about these days, and beggars can't be choosers!
translation: 哦，实际上是艾丽莎，但他们还是让我搬进去了。现在的女巫不多了，乞丐也不能挑剔！ [o ， shi ji shang shi ai li sha ， dan ta men hai shi rang wo ban jin qu le 。 xian zai de nv wu bu duo le ， qi gai ye bu neng tiao ti ！]

english: So can I call you Al?
translation: 那我可以叫你阿尔吗？ [na wo ke yi jiao ni a er ma ？]

english: Only if I can call you Betty!
translation: 只要我能叫你贝蒂就好了！ [zhi yao wo neng jiao ni bei di jiu hao le ！]

english: Now what do you want from the old hag of Pollnivneach? Hexes? Curses? Eternal youth? Poisons? You name it, I can brew it.
translation: 现在你想从 Pollnivneach 老巫婆那里得到什么？六角形？诅咒？青春永驻？毒药？你能想到的，我都能酿造。 [xian zai ni xiang cong  Pollnivneach  lao wu po na li de dao shen me ？ liu jiao xing ？ zu zhou ？ qing chun yong zhu ？ du yao ？ ni neng xiang dao de ， wo dou neng niang zao 。]

english: Actually I don't want any of that stuff, I'm new in town and I wanted to get to know the locals.
translation: 事实上我不想要任何这些东西，我是新来的，我想了解当地人。 [shi shi shang wo bu xiang yao ren he zhe xie dong xi ， wo shi xin lai de ， wo xiang liao jie dang di ren 。]

english: I'm busy brewing potions, so if you disturb me again without reason, I will turn you into a frog!
translation: 我正忙着酿造药剂，如果你再无故打扰我，我就把你变成青蛙！ [wo zheng mang zhe niang zao yao ji ， ru guo ni zai wu gu da rao wo ， wo jiu ba ni bian cheng qing wa ！]

english: Sorry! I won't let it happen again.
translation: 对不起！我不会让这种事再次发生。 [dui bu qi ！ wo bu hui rang zhe zhong shi zai ci fa sheng 。]

english: Good day, Hag.
translation: 美好的一天，哈格。 [mei hao de yi tian ， ha ge 。]

english: Good day to you too, Blockhead.
translation: 也祝你有美好的一天，笨蛋。 [ye zhu ni you mei hao de yi tian ， ben dan 。]

english: Now what do you want from the old hag of Pollnivneach? Hexes? Curses? Eternal youth? Poisons? You name it, I can brew it.
translation: 现在你想从 Pollnivneach 老巫婆那里得到什么？六角形？诅咒？青春永驻？毒药？你能想到的，我都能酿造。 [xian zai ni xiang cong  Pollnivneach  lao wu po na li de dao shen me ？ liu jiao xing ？ zu zhou ？ qing chun yong zhu ？ du yao ？ ni neng xiang dao de ， wo dou neng niang zao 。]

english: I'm busy brewing potions, so if you disturb me again without reason, I will turn you into a frog!
translation: 我正忙着酿造药剂，如果你再无故打扰我，我就把你变成青蛙！ [wo zheng mang zhe niang zao yao ji ， ru guo ni zai wu gu da rao wo ， wo jiu ba ni bian cheng qing wa ！]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello. What can I do for you?
translation: 你好。我能为你做什么？ [ni hao 。 wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: I don't know, what can you do for me?
translation: 我不知道，你能为我做什么？ [wo bu zhi dao ， ni neng wei wo zuo shen me ？]

english: Well, that depends.
translation: 嗯，这要看情况。 [n ， zhe yao kan qing kuang 。]

english: Depends on what?
translation: 取决于什么？ [qu jue yu shen me ？]

english: It depends on whether you like kebabs or not.
translation: 这取决于你是否喜欢烤肉串。 [zhe qu jue yu ni shi fou xi huan kao rou chuan 。]

english: Why is that?
translation: 这是为什么？ [zhe shi wei shen me ？]

english: Seeing as I'm in the kebab construction industry, I mainly help people in need of a kebab.
translation: 由于我从事烤肉串建筑行业，所以我主要帮助需要烤肉串的人。 [you yu wo cong shi kao rou chuan jian zhu hang ye ， suo yi wo zhu yao bang zhu xu yao kao rou chuan de ren 。]

english: Well then, what kind of kebabs do you, er, construct?
translation: 那么，你会制作什么样的烤肉串呢？ [na me ， ni hui zhi zuo shen me yang de kao rou chuan ne ？]

english: I offer two different types of kebabs: the standard run- of-the-mill kebab seen throughout Gielinor and enjoyed by many an intoxicated dwarf, and my speciality, the extra-hot kebab. So which shall it be?
translation: 我提供两种不同类型的烤肉串：标准的普通烤肉串，在吉林诺随处可见，许多喝醉的矮人都喜欢吃；还有我的特色菜，超热烤肉串。那么应该是哪一个呢？ [wo ti gong liang zhong bu tong lei xing de kao rou chuan ： biao zhun de pu tong kao rou chuan ， zai ji lin nuo sui chu ke jian ， xu duo he zui de ai ren dou xi huan chi ； hai you wo de te se cai ， chao re kao rou chuan 。 na me ying gai shi na yi ge ne ？]

english: I want a standard kebab, please.
translation: 请给我一个标准的烤肉串。 [qing gei wo yi ge biao zhun de kao rou chuan 。]

english: That will be three gold coins.
translation: 那将是三枚金币。 [na jiang shi san mei jin bi 。]

english: Here you go.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: No thanks, I'm good.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我很好。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo hen hao 。]

english: Come back soon, I could do with a few more customers.
translation: 快点回来吧，我可以多接待几个顾客。 [kuai dian hui lai ba ， wo ke yi duo jie dai ji ge gu ke 。]

english: I seem to be short on coins. Sorry.
translation: 我好像缺金币了对不起。 [wo hao xiang que jin bi le dui bu qi 。]

english: Is there anything else I can do for you?
translation: 我还能为您做些什么吗？ [wo hai neng wei nin zuo xie shen me ma ？]

english: Could I have one of those crazy hot kebabs of yours?
translation: 我可以吃一份你的热烤肉串吗？ [wo ke yi chi yi fen ni de re kao rou chuan ma ？]

english: One super kebab coming up! Be careful, they really are as hot as they're made out to be.
translation: 一道超级烤肉串来了！小心，它们确实像传说中的那样很热。 [yi dao chao ji kao rou chuan lai le ！ xiao xin ， ta men que shi xiang chuan shuo zhong de na yang hen re 。]

english: Sure, sure.
translation: 当然，当然。 [dang ran ， dang ran 。]

english: Would you sell me that bottle of special kebab sauce?
translation: 你能卖给我那瓶特制的烤肉酱吗？ [ni neng mai gei wo na ping te zhi de kao rou jiang ma ？]

english: Well, that depends. What do you intend to do with it?
translation: 嗯，这要看情况。你打算用它做什么？ [n ， zhe yao kan qing kuang 。 ni da suan yong ta zuo shen me ？]

english: Don't worry, I've no intention of setting up a rival kebab shop.
translation: 别担心，我无意开设一家竞争对手的烤肉店。 [bie dan xin ， wo wu yi kai she yi jia jing zheng dui shou de kao rou dian 。]

english: But then what do you want it for?
translation: 但那你想要它做什么呢？ [dan na ni xiang yao ta zuo shen me ne ？]

english: I don't know, but I think I could have a little bit of fun with it.
translation: 我不知道，但我想我可以从中得到一点乐趣。 [wo bu zhi dao ， dan wo xiang wo ke yi cong zhong de dao yi dian le qu 。]

english: You're not going to put it in Drunken Ali's drink, are you? That's what happened the last time I gave someone the sauce.
translation: 你不会把它放进醉阿里的饮料里吧？这就是我上次给别人酱汁时发生的事情。 [ni bu hui ba ta fang jin zui a li de yin liao li ba ？ zhe jiu shi wo shang ci gei bie ren jiang zhi shi fa sheng de shi qing 。]

english: No, that would be a bit cliché. I think I'll come up with something more original.
translation: 不，这有点陈词滥调。我想我会想出一些更原创的东西。 [bu ， zhe you dian chen ci lan diao 。 wo xiang wo hui xiang chu yi xie geng yuan chuang de dong xi 。]

english: Actually, I might get back to you on the sauce. I'm a bit overburdened as it is.
translation: 事实上，我可能会回复你关于酱汁的问题。我有点负担过重了。 [shi shi shang ， wo ke neng hui hui fu ni guan yu jiang zhi de wen ti 。 wo you dian fu dan guo zhong le 。]

english: Just be careful with it, it's potent enough to give a camel the runs.
translation: 只是要小心，它的威力足以让骆驼逃跑。 [zhi shi yao xiao xin ， ta de wei li zu yi rang luo tuo tao pao 。]

english: Thank you very much.
translation: 非常感谢。 [fei chang gan xie 。]

english: What is the difference between the standard and the extra-hot kebab?
translation: 标准烤肉串和超热烤肉串有什么区别？ [biao zhun kao rou chuan he chao re kao rou chuan you shen me qu bie ？]

english: If I told you that I would have to kill you. Kebab construction is a cut-throat industry. The extra-hot kebab gives me my competitive edge and if I were to divulge my secrets to every passing adventurer, I'd
translation: 如果我告诉你我就必须杀了你。烤肉串建造是一个竞争激烈的行业。超热的烤肉串给了我竞争优势，如果我要向每一个路过的冒险家透露我的秘密，我会 [ru guo wo gao su ni wo jiu bi xu sha le ni 。 kao rou chuan jian zao shi yi ge jing zheng ji lie de hang ye 。 chao re de kao rou chuan gei le wo jing zheng you shi ， ru guo wo yao xiang mei yi ge lu guo de mao xian jia tou lu wo de mi mi ， wo hui]

english: soon be out of business.
translation: 很快就会破产。 [hen kuai jiu hui po chan 。]

english: So there's no difference except the sauce you use?
translation: 那么除了用的酱汁之外，没有什么区别吗？ [na me chu le yong de jiang zhi zhi wai ， mei you shen me qu bie ma ？]

english: Shh! Keep your voice down. You should have told me you were from the union.
translation: 嘘！请小声一点。你应该告诉我你是工会的。 [xu ！ qing xiao sheng yi dian 。 ni ying gai gao su wo ni shi gong hui de 。]

english: Listen, I've got to run. I'll catch you later.
translation: 听着，我得跑了。稍后我会抓住你的。 [ting zhe ， wo de pao le 。 shao hou wo hui zhua zhu ni de 。]

english: I need some information.
translation: 我需要一些信息。 [wo xu yao yi xie xin xi 。]

english: If information is what you need, there are many better people to ask than myself who could help you. One of the town's street urchins or perhaps the local drunk. I may be many things to many different people, but a
translation: 如果您需要信息，那么有很多比我更好的人可以帮助您。镇上的街头顽童之一，或者可能是当地的醉汉。对于很多不同的人来说，我可能有很多不同的含义，但是 [ru guo nin xu yao xin xi ， na me you hen duo bi wo geng hao de ren ke yi bang zhu nin 。 zhen shang de jie tou wan tong zhi yi ， huo zhe ke neng shi dang di de zui han 。 dui yu hen duo bu tong de ren lai shuo ， wo ke neng you hen duo bu tong de han yi ， dan shi]

english: gossip I am not.
translation: 我不是八卦。 [wo bu shi ba gua 。]

english: Ah! Here you go!
translation: 啊!干得好！ [a ! gan de hao ！]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: I need you to answer this for me.
translation: 我需要你帮我回答这个问题。 [wo xu yao ni bang wo hui da zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Ali the Kebab seller has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 烤肉串卖家阿里给了你一张挑战卷轴！ [kao rou chuan mai jia a li gei le ni yi zhang tiao zhan juan zhou ！]

english: Please give me your answer!
translation: 请给我你的答案！ [qing gei wo ni de da an ！]

english: Nope, not correct!
translation: 不，不正确！ [bu ， bu zheng que ！]

english: Spot on!
translation: 现货！ [xian huo ！]

english: Ali the Kebab seller has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
translation: 烤肉串卖家阿里给了你[另一条线索卷轴/一个棺材]！ [kao rou chuan mai jia a li gei le ni [ ling yi tiao xian suo juan zhou / yi ge guan cai ]！]

english: I want a standard kebab, please.
translation: 请给我一个标准的烤肉串。 [qing gei wo yi ge biao zhun de kao rou chuan 。]

english: Yes, actually.
translation: 是的，实际上。 [shi de ， shi ji shang 。]

english: Could I have an extra-hot kebab please?
translation: 能给我一份超热的烤肉串吗？ [neng gei wo yi fen chao re de kao rou chuan ma ？]

english: Would you sell me that bottle of special kebab sauce?
translation: 你能卖给我那瓶特制的烤肉酱吗？ [ni neng mai gei wo na ping te zhi de kao rou jiang ma ？]

english: What is the difference between the standard and the extra-hot kebab?
translation: 标准烤肉串和超热烤肉串有什么区别？ [biao zhun kao rou chuan he chao re kao rou chuan you shen me qu bie ？]

english: I want a kebab, please.
translation: 请给我一份烤肉串。 [qing gei wo yi fen kao rou chuan 。]

english: Listen I've got to run. I'll catch you later.
translation: 听着，我得跑了。稍后我会抓住你的。 [ting zhe ， wo de pao le 。 shao hou wo hui zhua zhu ni de 。]

english: I need some information.
translation: 我需要一些信息。 [wo xu yao yi xie xin xi 。]

english: I don't have time to talk right now! Ali Morrisane is paying me to hand out these flyers.
translation: 我现在没时间说话！阿里·莫里萨内付钱让我分发这些传单。 [wo xian zai mei shi jian shuo hua ！ a li · mo li sa nei fu qian rang wo fen fa zhe xie chuan dan 。]

english: Who is Ali Morrisane?
translation: 阿里·莫里森是谁？ [a li · mo li sen shi shui ？]

english: Ali Morrisane is the greatest merchant in the east!
translation: 阿里·莫里萨内是东方最伟大的商人！ [a li · mo li sa nei shi dong fang zui wei da de shang ren ！]

english: Were you paid to say that?
translation: 你是付钱才说这句话的吗？ [ni shi fu qian cai shuo zhe ju hua de ma ？]

english: Of course I was! You can find him on the north edge of town.
translation: 我当然是！你可以在城镇的北边找到他。 [wo dang ran shi ！ ni ke yi zai cheng zhen de bei bian zhao dao ta 。]

english: What are the flyers for?
translation: 传单有什么用？ [chuan dan you shen me yong ？]

english: Well, Ali Morrisane isn't too popular with the other traders in Al Kharid, mainly because he's from Pollnivneach and they feel he has no business trading in their town.
translation: 好吧，阿里·莫里萨内不太受阿尔卡里德其他商人的欢迎，主要是因为他来自波尔尼夫内奇，而他们觉得他在他们的城镇没有生意可做。 [hao ba ， a li · mo li sa nei bu tai shou a er ka li de qi ta shang ren de huan ying ， zhu yao shi yin wei ta lai zi bo er ni fu nei qi ， er ta men jue de ta zai ta men de cheng zhen mei you sheng yi ke zuo 。]

english: I think they're just sour because he's better at making money than them.
translation: 我认为他们只是因为他比他们更擅长赚钱。 [wo ren wei ta men zhi shi yin wei ta bi ta men geng shan chang zhuan qian 。]

english: The flyer advertises the different shops you can find in Al Kharid.
translation: 该传单上刊登了您在阿尔卡里德可以找到的不同商店的广告。 [gai chuan dan shang kan deng le nin zai a er ka li de ke yi zhao dao de bu tong shang dian de guang gao 。]

english: It also entitles you to money off your next purchase in any of the shops listed on it. It's Ali's way of getting on the good side of the traders.
translation: 您还可以在下次在上面列出的任何商店购物时享受折扣优惠。这是阿里为交易者争取利益的方式。 [nin hai ke yi zai xia ci zai shang mian lie chu de ren he shang dian gou wu shi xiang shou zhe kou you hui 。 zhe shi a li wei jiao yi zhe zheng qu li yi de fang shi 。]

english: Which shops?
translation: 哪些商店？ [na xie shang dian ？]

english: Here! Take one and let me get back to work.
translation: 这里！拿一张，让我回去工作。 [zhe li ！ na yi zhang ， rang wo hui qu gong zuo 。]

english: I still have hundreds of these flyers to hand out, I wonder if my boss would notice if I quietly dumped them somewhere?
translation: 我还有几百张这样的传单要发，不知道我悄悄把它们扔到什么地方，老板会注意到吗？ [wo hai you ji bai zhang zhe yang de chuan dan yao fa ， bu zhi dao wo qiao qiao ba ta men reng dao shen me di fang ， lao ban hui zhu yi dao ma ？]

english: Are you trying to be funny or has age turned your brain to mush? Look at the flyer you already have!
translation: 你是想搞笑还是年龄让你的大脑变得糊涂了？看看你已有的传单！ [ni shi xiang gao xiao hai shi nian ling rang ni de da nao bian de hu tu le ？ kan kan ni yi you de chuan dan ！]

english: I'd give you a flyer but it looks like your hands are full. Come back when you have space for my flyer.
translation: 我本来想给你一张传单，但看起来你的手已经满了。当你有空间放置我的传单时再来吧。 [wo ben lai xiang gei ni yi zhang chuan dan ， dan kan qi lai ni de shou yi jing man le 。 dang ni you kong jian fang zhi wo de chuan dan shi zai lai ba 。]

english: What is there to do round here, boy?
translation: 小伙子，这里有什么可玩的？ [xiao huo zi ， zhe li you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: I'm very busy, so listen carefully! I shall say this only once.
translation: 我很忙，所以请仔细听！我只会说一次。 [wo hen mang ， suo yi qing zi xi ting ！ wo zhi hui shuo yi ci 。]

english: Apart from a busy and wonderous market place in Al Kharid to the south, there is the Emir's Arena to the south-east where you can challenge other players to a fight.
translation: 除了南部的阿尔卡里德 (Al Kharid) 繁忙而精彩的市场外，东南部还有埃米尔竞技场 (Emir's Arena)，您可以在那里与其他玩家一较高下。 [chu le nan bu de a er ka li de  (Al Kharid)  fan mang er jing cai de shi chang wai ， dong nan bu hai you ai mi er jing ji chang  (Emir's Arena)， nin ke yi zai na li yu qi ta wan jia yi jiao gao xia 。]

english: If you're here to make money, there is a mine to the south.
translation: 如果你来这里是为了赚钱，南边有一个矿场。 [ru guo ni lai zhe li shi wei le zhuan qian ， nan bian you yi ge kuang chang 。]

english: Watch out for scorpions though, they'll take a pop at you if you go too near them. To avoid them just follow the western fence as you travel south.
translation: 不过要小心蝎子，如果你离它们太近，它们会攻击你。为了避开它们，只需在向南行驶时沿着西栅栏行驶即可。 [bu guo yao xiao xin xie zi ， ru guo ni li ta men tai jin ， ta men hui gong ji ni 。 wei le bi kai ta men ， zhi xu zai xiang nan xing shi shi yan zhe xi zha lan xing shi ji ke 。]

english: If you're in the mood for a little rest and relaxation, there are a couple of nice fishing spots south of the town.
translation: 如果您想休息放松，镇南有几个不错的钓鱼点。 [ru guo nin xiang xiu xi fang song ， zhen nan you ji ge bu cuo de diao yu dian 。]

english: Thanks for the help!
translation: 感谢您的帮助！ [gan xie nin de bang zhu ！]

english: I don't want this! It's out of date!
translation: 我不想要这个！已经过时了！ [wo bu xiang yao zhe ge ！ yi jing guo shi le ！]

english: Then why would I want it? Keep moving, I have to hand all these flyers out before I get paid.
translation: 那我为什么要它？继续前进，我必须在拿到工资之前把这些传单都分发出去。 [na wo wei shen me yao ta ？ ji xu qian jin ， wo bi xu zai na dao gong zi zhi qian ba zhe xie chuan dan dou fen fa chu qu 。]

english: Ali's Discount Wares...
translation: 阿里的折扣商品... [a li de zhe kou shang pin ...]

english: The finest store in the world!
translation: 世界上最好的商店！ [shi jie shang zui hao de shang dian ！]

english: Dommik's crafting store...
translation: 多米克的工艺品店... [duo mi ke de gong yi pin dian ...]

english: The place for all your crafting needs.
translation: 满足您所有手工需求的地方。 [man zu nin suo you shou gong xu qiu de di fang 。]

english: Ellis' Tannery...
translation: 埃利斯制革厂... [ai li si zhi ge chang ...]

english: The prices are better than the smell!
translation: 价格比味道还好！ [jia ge bi wei dao hai hao ！]

english: Run your enemies through in style...
translation: 以时尚的方式击败你的敌人...... [yi shi shang de fang shi ji bai ni de di ren ......]

english: with a Scimitar from Zeke's Superior Scimitars!
translation: 使用泽克的高级弯刀中的弯刀！ [shi yong ze ke de gao ji wan dao zhong de wan dao ！]

english: Visit Louie's Armoured Legs Bazaar...
translation: 参观路易的装甲腿集市...... [can guan lu yi de zhuang jia tui ji shi ......]

english: Number one for clanky trousers!
translation: 叮当作响的裤子第一名！ [ding dang zuo xiang de ku zi di yi ming ！]

english: Visit Ranael's Super Skirt Store ..
translation: 参观 Ranael 的超级裙子店 .. [can guan  Ranael  de chao ji qun zi dian  ..]

english: for the most stylish protection money can buy!
translation: 有钱能买到的最时尚的保护！ [you qian neng mai dao de zui shi shang de bao hu ！]

english: Keep west as you travel south ...
translation: 向南行驶时保持向西...... [xiang nan xing shi shi bao chi xiang xi ......]

english: to avoid the killer scorpions!
translation: 躲避杀手蝎子！ [duo bi sha shou xie zi ！]

english: Who is Ali Morrisane?
translation: 阿里·莫里森是谁？ [a li · mo li sen shi shui ？]

english: What are the flyers for?
translation: 传单有什么用？ [chuan dan you shen me yong ？]

english: What is there to do round here, boy?
translation: 小伙子，这里有什么可玩的？ [xiao huo zi ， zhe li you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: Welcome, adventurer, to the town of Pollnivneach, the gateway to Menaphos and Al Kharid. My name is Ali and I'm the mayor of this town. I hope you enjoy your stay here.
translation: 欢迎冒险家来到 Pollnivneach 镇，这里是通往梅纳福斯和阿尔卡里德的门户。我叫阿里，是这个镇的镇长。我希望您在这里过得愉快。 [huan ying mao xian jia lai dao  Pollnivneach  zhen ， zhe li shi tong wang mei na fu si he a er ka li de de men hu 。 wo jiao a li ， shi zhe ge zhen de zhen zhang 。 wo xi wang nin zai zhe li guo de yu kuai 。]

english: Thank you. That is one of the warmest welcomes I've ever had! People generally treat travelling adventurers with suspicion.
translation: 谢谢。这是我所受过的最热烈的欢迎之一！人们通常对旅行冒险家持怀疑态度。 [xie xie 。 zhe shi wo suo shou guo de zui re lie de huan ying zhi yi ！ ren men tong chang dui lv xing mao xian jia chi huai yi tai du 。]

english: All are welcome here. Now more than ever I suppose.
translation: 欢迎大家来到这里。我想现在比以往任何时候都更是如此。 [huan ying da jia lai dao zhe li 。 wo xiang xian zai bi yi wang ren he shi hou dou geng shi ru ci 。]

english: What do you mean by that?
translation: 你这是什么意思？ [ni zhe shi shen me yi si ？]

english: There's trouble in town, and a lot of villagers have left as a result. Things are looking dire.
translation: 镇上发生了麻烦，许多村民因此离开了。事情看起来很糟糕。 [zhen shang fa sheng le ma fan ， xu duo cun min yin ci li kai le 。 shi qing kan qi lai hen zao gao 。]

english: Hello good sir.
translation: 你好，好先生。 [ni hao ， hao xian sheng 。]

english: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？ [ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: I'm new in town and wanted to get to know the locals.
translation: 我是新来的，想认识当地人。 [wo shi xin lai de ， xiang ren shi dang di ren 。]

english: What do you want to know?
translation: 你想知道什么？ [ni xiang zhi dao shen me ？]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: That information is available on a need to know basis and right now, you don't need to know.
translation: 这些信息是在需要知道的基础上提供的，而现在，您不需要知道。 [zhe xie xin xi shi zai xu yao zhi dao de ji chu shang ti gong de ， er xian zai ， nin bu xu yao zhi dao 。]

english: Can I help you with anything else?
translation: 我还可以帮您做其他事吗？ [wo hai ke yi bang nin zuo qi ta shi ma ？]

english: Yes I'd like to ask you about something else.
translation: 是的，我想问你一些别的事情。 [shi de ， wo xiang wen ni yi xie bie de shi qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Tell me about the other people in the town.
translation: 告诉我镇上其他人的情况。 [gao su wo zhen shang qi ta ren de qing kuang 。]

english: Sheep, ready for the slau... hang on. I shouldn't be telling you that. Just forget I said anything.
translation: 羊们，准备好出发了……坚持住。我不应该告诉你这些。忘了我说过什么吧。 [yang men ， zhun bei hao chu fa le …… jian chi zhu 。 wo bu ying gai gao su ni zhe xie 。 wang le wo shuo guo shen me ba 。]

english: I'm looking for Ali.
translation: 我正在寻找阿里。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao a li 。]

english: You will have to be a lot more specific if you want help finding him. Everyone here is called Ali.
translation: 如果您需要帮助找到他，您必须说得更具体。这里的每个人都叫阿里。 [ru guo nin xu yao bang zhu zhao dao ta ， nin bi xu shuo de geng ju ti 。 zhe li de mei ge ren dou jiao a li 。]

english: I've discovered that. Well he has an uncle called Ali Morrisane, a market vendor in Al Kharid and that's all I really know about him.
translation: 我已经发现了。嗯，他有一个叔叔，名叫阿里·莫里萨内 (Ali Morrisane)，是阿尔·卡里德 (Al Kharid) 的一名市场小贩，这就是我对他的全部了解。 [wo yi jing fa xian le 。 n ， ta you yi ge shu shu ， ming jiao a li · mo li sa nei  (Ali Morrisane)， shi a er · ka li de  (Al Kharid)  de yi ming shi chang xiao fan ， zhe jiu shi wo dui ta de quan bu liao jie 。]

english: Say no more. I too am looking for him. The little tyke robbed me too, if we work together perhaps we can catch him and teach him a lesson.
translation: 不多说了。我也在找他。那小家伙也抢了我的东西，我们齐心协力说不定能抓住他教训他。 [bu duo shuo le 。 wo ye zai zhao ta 。 na xiao jia huo ye qiang le wo de dong xi ， wo men qi xin xie li shuo bu ding neng zhua zhu ta jiao xun ta 。]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: Yes I'd like to ask you about something else.
translation: 是的，我想问你一些别的事情。 [shi de ， wo xiang wen ni yi xie bie de shi qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Tell me about the other people in the town.
translation: 告诉我镇上其他人的情况。 [gao su wo zhen shang qi ta ren de qing kuang 。]

english: I'm looking for Ali.
translation: 我正在寻找阿里。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao a li 。]

english: Hello there! Who is this?
translation: 你好呀！这是谁？ [ni hao ya ！ zhe shi shui ？]

english: Ali.
translation: 阿里. [a li .]

english: Any particular Ali?
translation: 有什么特别的阿里吗？ [you shen me te bie de a li ma ？]

english: Only the best there is! I'm Ali the Sandsweeper.
translation: 只有最好的！我是扫沙工阿里。 [zhi you zui hao de ！ wo shi sao sha gong a li 。]

english: You sweep sand?
translation: 你扫沙子吗？ [ni sao sha zi ma ？]

english: Certainly do!  I'm the best darn sandsweeper this side of the Lum.
translation: 当然可以！  我是卢姆河这边最好的扫沙工。 [dang ran ke yi ！   wo shi lu mu he zhe bian zui hao de sao sha gong 。]

english: There's more of you?
translation: 你还有更多吗？ [ni hai you geng duo ma ？]

english: We have a union, mate! There's always sand to sweep.
translation: 我们有一个工会，伙计！总有沙子要扫。 [wo men you yi ge gong hui ， huo ji ！ zong you sha zi yao sao 。]

english: Indeed. Um, I have to go.
translation: 的确。嗯，我得走了。 [di que 。 n ， wo de zou le 。]

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好呀！ [ni hao ya ！]

english: You seem rather cheerful. Is there anything you're after?
translation: 看来你还挺开朗的。你有什么追求吗？ [kan lai ni hai ting kai lang de 。 ni you shen me zhui qiu ma ？]

english: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
translation: 关于阿尔·卡里德，你能告诉我什么吗？ [guan yu a er · ka li de ， ni neng gao su wo shen me ma ？]

english: Well, it's hot and full of sand.
translation: 嗯，天气很热，而且充满了沙子。 [n ， tian qi hen re ， er qie chong man le sha zi 。]

english: Anything else?
translation: 还要别的吗？ [hai yao bie de ma ？]

english: Don't ask me, I'm not from around here.
translation: 别问我，我不是这里的人。 [bie wen wo ， wo bu shi zhe li de ren 。]

english: So where are you from?
translation: 那么你来自哪里？ [na me ni lai zi na li ？]

english: A town to the south of the Shantay Pass, called Pollnivneach.
translation: 尚泰山口以南的一个小镇，名为 Pollnivneach。 [shang tai shan kou yi nan de yi ge xiao zhen ， ming wei  Pollnivneach。]

english: So, what do you do here?
translation: 那么，你在这里做什么？ [na me ， ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Not very much, at the moment. I came from further south to set up a smithy here...
translation: 目前还不是很多。我从更南边来到这里开个铁匠铺... [mu qian hai bu shi hen duo 。 wo cong geng nan bian lai dao zhe li kai ge tie jiang pu ...]

english: ...but we still haven't set up the shops, so we have no customers yet.
translation: ……但是我们还没有开店，所以还没有顾客。 […… dan shi wo men hai mei you kai dian ， suo yi huan mei you gu ke 。]

english: I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
translation: 我听说你为 Ali Morrisane 工作... [wo ting shuo ni wei  Ali Morrisane  gong zuo ...]

english: Yes, he's the one who persuaded us to come here.
translation: 是的，他就是说服我们来这里的人。 [shi de ， ta jiu shi shuo fu wo men lai zhe li de ren 。]

english: He said we'd have lots of customers once we set up our shops, and all he asks for is a cut of the profits.
translation: 他说我们开店后会有很多顾客，他要求的只是利润分成。 [ta shuo wo men kai dian hou hui you hen duo gu ke ， ta yao qiu de zhi shi li run fen cheng 。]

english: Maybe I should talk to him...
translation: 也许我应该和他谈谈... [ye xu wo ying gai he ta tan tan ...]

english: Of course. He's always happy to talk to possible business partners.
translation: 当然。他总是很乐意与可能的商业伙伴交谈。 [dang ran 。 ta zong shi hen le yi yu ke neng de shang ye huo ban jiao tan 。]

english: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
translation: 我听说你一直在威胁其他店主。 [wo ting shuo ni yi zhi zai wei xie qi ta dian zhu 。]

english: What? Who's spreading that rumour?
translation: 什么？谁在散布这个谣言？ [shen me ？ shui zai san bu zhe ge yao yan ？]

english: Well, one of the shopkeepers told me a man with a large hammer came to threaten them.
translation: 一位店主告诉我，一名拿着大锤子的男子来威胁他们。 [yi wei dian zhu gao su wo ， yi ming na zhe da chui zi de nan zi lai wei xie ta men 。]

english: Don't pay any attention to those people.
translation: 不要关注那些人。 [bu yao guan zhu na xie ren 。]

english: They're just worried that they'll lose money when we open our shops.
translation: 他们只是担心我们开店会赔钱。 [ta men zhi shi dan xin wo men kai dian hui pei qian 。]

english: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
translation: 关于阿尔·卡里德，你能告诉我什么吗？ [guan yu a er · ka li de ， ni neng gao su wo shen me ma ？]

english: So, what do you do here?
translation: 那么，你在这里做什么？ [na me ， ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
translation: 我听说你为 Ali Morrisane 工作... [wo ting shuo ni wei  Ali Morrisane  gong zuo ...]

english: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
translation: 我听说你一直在威胁其他店主。 [wo ting shuo ni yi zhi zai wei xie qi ta dian zhu 。]

english: Wow, a snake charmer! Can I have a go? Can I have a go? Please?
translation: 哇，耍蛇人！我可以尝试一下吗？我可以尝试一下吗？请？ [wa ， shua she ren ！ wo ke yi chang shi yi xia ma ？ wo ke yi chang shi yi xia ma ？ qing ？]

english: The snake charmer is focusing intently on his music and doesn't seem to notice you.
translation: 耍蛇人正专注于他的音乐，似乎没有注意到你。 [shua she ren zheng zhuan zhu yu ta de yin yue ， si hu mei you zhu yi dao ni 。]

english: The snake charmer snaps out of his trance and directs his full attention to you.
translation: 耍蛇人从恍惚状态中清醒过来，将全部注意力集中在你身上。 [shua she ren cong huang hu zhuang tai zhong qing xing guo lai ， jiang quan bu zhu yi li ji zhong zai ni shen shang 。]

english: If it means that you'll leave me alone, I will happily give you my snake charming super starter kit, complete with flute and basket. But you're clearly over burdened as it is.
translation: 如果这意味着你不会打扰我，我会很乐意给你我的迷人蛇超级入门套件，包括笛子和篮子。但你显然负担过重。 [ru guo zhe yi wei zhe ni bu hui da rao wo ， wo hui hen le yi gei ni wo de mi ren she chao ji ru men tao jian ， bao kuo di zi he lan zi 。 dan ni xian ran fu dan guo zhong 。]

english: Ah, I see you've lost your basket. Here you are, now leave me alone! You're ruining the show.
translation: 啊，我发现你的篮子丢了。你来了，现在别打扰我！你正在毁掉演出。 [a ， wo fa xian ni de lan zi diu le 。 ni lai le ， xian zai bie da rao wo ！ ni zheng zai hui diao yan chu 。]

english: Ah, I see you've lost your snake charming flute. Here you go, now leave me alone! You're distracting my punters... er, I mean, crowd.
translation: 啊，我发现你弄蛇笛了。给你，现在别管我了！你分散了我的投注者的注意力……呃，我是说，人群。 [a ， wo fa xian ni nong she di le 。 gei ni ， xian zai bie guan wo le ！ ni fen san le wo de tou zhu zhe de zhu yi li …… e ， wo shi shuo ， ren qun 。]

english: If you're that desperate to try, have my patented snake charming starter kit. It comes with a special snake charming flute and a basket to keep your charmed snakes in. Now, leave me alone!
translation: 如果您迫不及待地想尝试，请使用我的专利迷人蛇入门套件。它配有一个特殊的迷蛇笛子和一个篮子来存放你的迷蛇。现在，别管我了！ [ru guo nin po bu ji dai di xiang chang shi ， qing shi yong wo de zhuan li mi ren she ru men tao jian 。 ta pei you yi ge te shu de mi she di zi he yi ge lan zi lai cun fang ni de mi she 。 xian zai ， bie guan wo le ！]

english: The snake charmer gives you a snake charming flute and a basket.
translation: 耍蛇人会给你一个耍蛇笛子和一个篮子。 [shua she ren hui gei ni yi ge shua she di zi he yi ge lan zi 。]

english: I'm not stopping you! You have your own snake charming flute.
translation: 我不阻止你！你有自己的迷人蛇笛。 [wo bu zu zhi ni ！ ni you zi ji de mi ren she di 。]

english: I want to talk to you about animal charming.
translation: 我想和你谈谈动物魅力。 [wo xiang he ni tan tan dong wu mei li 。]

english: I've lost some of the gear you gave me.
translation: 我丢失了一些你给我的装备。 [wo diu shi le yi xie ni gei wo de zhuang bei 。]

english: What do you need?
translation: 你需要什么？ [ni xu yao shen me ？]

english: I've lost the music.
translation: 我已经失去了音乐。 [wo yi jing shi qu le yin yue 。]

english: There you go. Now if you don't mind I'm busy trying to charm this here snake.
translation: 就这样吧。现在如果你不介意的话我正忙着迷住这条蛇。 [jiu zhe yang ba 。 xian zai ru guo ni bu jie yi de hua wo zheng mang zhao mi zhu zhe tiao she 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Yes?
translation: 是的？ [shi de ？]

english: Can you teach me any more about animal charming.
translation: 你能教我更多关于动物魅力的知识吗？ [ni neng jiao wo geng duo guan yu dong wu mei li de zhi shi ma ？]

english: No, I doubt it. I believe your talents lie in other areas.
translation: 不，我对此表示怀疑。我相信你的才能还存在于其他领域。 [bu ， wo dui ci biao shi huai yi 。 wo xiang xin ni de cai neng hai cun zai yu qi ta ling yu 。]

english: Wow, a snake charmer! Can I have a go? Can I have a go? Please?
translation: 哇，耍蛇人！我可以尝试一下吗？我可以尝试一下吗？请？ [wa ， shua she ren ！ wo ke yi chang shi yi xia ma ？ wo ke yi chang shi yi xia ma ？ qing ？]

english: I want to talk to you about animal charming.
translation: 我想和你谈谈动物魅力。 [wo xiang he ni tan tan dong wu mei li 。]

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好呀！ [ni hao ya ！]

english: I'm a little busy at the moment. What is it?
translation: 我现在有点忙。它是什么？ [wo xian zai you dian mang 。 ta shi shen me ？]

english: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
translation: 关于阿尔·卡里德，你能告诉我什么吗？ [guan yu a er · ka li de ， ni neng gao su wo shen me ma ？]

english: Oh, it has wonderful weather.
translation: 哦，天气真好。 [o ， tian qi zhen hao 。]

english: Wonderful? It's hot and dry all the time!
translation: 精彩的？一直又热又干！ [jing cai de ？ yi zhi you re you gan ！]

english: Not quite as hot as back home.
translation: 不像家里那么热。 [bu xiang jia li na me re 。]

english: Where's home, then?
translation: 那么家在哪儿呢？ [na me jia zai na er ne ？]

english: Oh, it's a town to the south of the pass, called Pollnivneach.
translation: 哦，那是山口以南的一个小镇，叫Polnivneach。 [o ， na shi shan kou yi nan de yi ge xiao zhen ， jiao Polnivneach。]

english: So, what do you do here?
translation: 那么，你在这里做什么？ [na me ， ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: If I had cloth, patterns and customers, I'd be a tailor. As it is, I'm a tailor with nothing to do.
translation: 如果我有布料、图案和顾客，我就会成为一名裁缝。事实上，我是一个无所事事的裁缝。 [ru guo wo you bu liao 、 tu an he gu ke ， wo jiu hui cheng wei yi ming cai feng 。 shi shi shang ， wo shi yi ge wu suo shi shi de cai feng 。]

english: The silk merchant won't even sell me any silks, because he doesn't trust me!
translation: 丝绸商人连丝绸都不卖给我，因为他不信任我！ [si chou shang ren lian si chou dou bu mai gei wo ， yin wei ta bu xin ren wo ！]

english: Anything I can do to help?
translation: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang mang de ma ？]

english: No, no, it's all being dealt with.
translation: 不不不，一切都在处理中。 [bu bu bu ， yi qie dou zai chu li zhong 。]

english: I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
translation: 我听说你为 Ali Morrisane 工作... [wo ting shuo ni wei  Ali Morrisane  gong zuo ...]

english: Of course, he's the one who's going to obtain cloth and clothes patterns so I can set up shop here.
translation: 当然，他是要获得布料和衣服样板的人，这样我就可以在这里开店了。 [dang ran ， ta shi yao huo de bu liao he yi fu yang ban de ren ， zhe yang wo jiu ke yi zai zhe li kai dian le 。]

english: And in such a good location, too. Not out of the way like back home.
translation: 而且位置也这么好。不像回到家那样偏僻。 [er qie wei zhi ye zhe me hao 。 bu xiang hui dao jia na yang pian pi 。]

english: The customers will soon pour in!
translation: 很快顾客就会蜂拥而至！ [hen kuai gu ke jiu hui feng yong er zhi ！]

english: Maybe I should talk to him...
translation: 也许我应该和他谈谈... [ye xu wo ying gai he ta tan tan ...]

english: Why not? He's always happy to talk to potential business partners.
translation: 为什么不呢？他总是很乐意与潜在的商业伙伴交谈。 [wei shen me bu ne ？ ta zong shi hen le yi yu qian zai de shang ye huo ban jiao tan 。]

english: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
translation: 我听说你一直在威胁其他店主。 [wo ting shuo ni yi zhi zai wei xie qi ta dian zhu 。]

english: Me, threaten people?
translation: 我，威胁人？ [wo ， wei xie ren ？]

english: One of the shopkeepers did say they were threatened by a man with large scissors...
translation: 其中一位店主确实说他们受到了一名拿着大剪刀的男子的威胁...... [qi zhong yi wei dian zhu que shi shuo ta men shou dao le yi ming na zhe da jian dao de nan zi de wei xie ......]

english: Oh, them. Don't mind them. I think they're worried about what effect our shops will have.
translation: 哦，他们。别介意他们。我想他们是担心我们的店铺会产生什么影响。 [o ， ta men 。 bie jie yi ta men 。 wo xiang ta men shi dan xin wo men de dian pu hui chan sheng shen me ying xiang 。]

english: For all they know, when we open our shops their wares will look cheap and shabby by comparison!
translation: 据他们所知，当我们开店时，相比之下，他们的商品就显得便宜又破旧！ [ju ta men suo zhi ， dang wo men kai dian shi ， xiang bi zhi xia ， ta men de shang pin jiu xian de pian yi you po jiu ！]

english: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
translation: 关于阿尔·卡里德，你能告诉我什么吗？ [guan yu a er · ka li de ， ni neng gao su wo shen me ma ？]

english: So, what do you do here?
translation: 那么，你在这里做什么？ [na me ， ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
translation: 我听说你为 Ali Morrisane 工作... [wo ting shuo ni wei  Ali Morrisane  gong zuo ...]

english: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
translation: 我听说你一直在威胁其他店主。 [wo ting shuo ni yi zhi zai wei xie qi ta dian zhu 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Welcome! I'm Ali, and this is my tea shop! Is there anything I can do for you today?
translation: 欢迎！我是阿里，这是我的茶馆！今天有什么我能为您效劳的吗？ [huan ying ！ wo shi a li ， zhe shi wo de cha guan ！ jin tian you shen me wo neng wei nin xiao lao de ma ？]

english: Hmm... Could I get some tea?
translation: 嗯……我可以喝点茶吗？ [n …… wo ke yi he dian cha ma ？]

english: Of course! I'll get the water boiling at once. Is there anything else I can do for you while you wait?
translation: 当然！我马上把水烧开。在您等待期间，还有什么我可以为您做的吗？ [dang ran ！ wo ma shang ba shui shao kai 。 zai nin deng dai qi jian ， hai you shen me wo ke yi wei nin zuo de ma ？]

english: How's the tea coming along?
translation: 茶来得怎么样？ [cha lai de zen me yang ？]

english: Oh! Yes, the water is boiling. Just give me a minute!
translation: 哦！是的，水沸腾了。请给我一分钟！ [o ！ shi de ， shui fei teng le 。 qing gei wo yi fen zhong ！]

english: I'm so thirsty.
translation: 我好渴。 [wo hao ke 。]

english: I know, the desert is forever hot. Thirsty work here!
translation: 我知道，沙漠永远炎热。在这里干活！ [wo zhi dao ， sha mo yong yuan yan re 。 zai zhe li gan huo ！]

english: How's business here? Seems quite out the way.
translation: 这里生意怎么样？看起来很不合时宜。 [zhe li sheng yi zen me yang ？ kan qi lai hen bu he shi yi 。]

english: Hmm...
Not good?
translation: 不好？ [bu hao ？]

english: It's not that. It's just that I've been having issues with a few thieves lately. Four to be precise!
translation: 不是那样的。只是最近我和几个小偷发生了一些问题。准确来说是四个！ [bu shi na yang de 。 zhi shi zui jin wo he ji ge xiao tou fa sheng le yi xie wen ti 。 zhun que lai shuo shi si ge ！]

english: They've been stealing your tea?
translation: 他们偷了你的茶？ [ta men tou le ni de cha ？]

english: There have been a few break-ins. A recent shipment from Karamja has been taken! That was some of the finest stuff I've ever managed to get my hands on.
translation: 发生过几次入室盗窃事件。最近从 Karamja 发来的一批货物已被拿走！这是我曾经接触过的最好的东西。 [fa sheng guo ji ci ru shi dao qie shi jian 。 zui jin cong  Karamja  fa lai de yi pi huo wu yi bei na zou ！ zhe shi wo ceng jing jie chu guo de zui hao de dong xi 。]

english: That's awful. If I see any shifty characters, I'll be sure to teach them a lesson.
translation: 太糟糕了。如果我看到什么狡猾的人物，我一定会教训他们的。 [tai zao gao le 。 ru guo wo kan dao shen me jiao hua de ren wu ， wo yi ding hui jiao xun ta men de 。]

english: Ha! Very courageous, adventurer! These thieves are big and brutish. I wouldn't start something you may not be able to finish.
translation: 哈!非常勇敢，冒险家！这些盗贼体型庞大，而且凶残。我不会开始一些你可能无法完成的事情。 [ha ! fei chang yong gan ， mao xian jia ！ zhe xie dao zei ti xing pang da ， er qie xiong can 。 wo bu hui kai shi yi xie ni ke neng wu fa wan cheng de shi qing 。]

english: I'm pretty tough. I think I can handle them.
translation: 我还蛮强硬的我想我能应付他们。 [wo hai man qiang ying de wo xiang wo neng ying fu ta men 。]

english: If you say so.
translation: 如果你这么说的话。 [ru guo ni zhe me shuo de hua 。]

english: I'd best be heading off.
translation: 我最好还是出发吧。 [wo zui hao hai shi chu fa ba 。]

english: You're leaving? But the tea is almost done!
translation: 你要走了吗？但茶快煮好了！ [ni yao zou le ma ？ dan cha kuai zhu hao le ！]

english: I've been waiting quite a while. Perhaps another time.
translation: 我已经等了好久了。也许下次吧。 [wo yi jing deng le hao jiu le 。 ye xu xia ci ba 。]

english: Well you never actually made me that tea...
translation: 好吧，你从来没有给我泡过那杯茶...... [hao ba ， ni cong lai mei you gei wo pao guo na bei cha ......]

english: Ah yes! I'll get the water boiling at once. Is there anything else I can do for you while you wait?
translation: 啊，是的！我马上把水烧开。在您等待期间，还有什么我可以为您做的吗？ [a ， shi de ！ wo ma shang ba shui shao kai 。 zai nin deng dai qi jian ， hai you shen me wo ke yi wei nin zuo de ma ？]

english: How's the tea coming along?
translation: 茶来得怎么样？ [cha lai de zen me yang ？]

english: How's business here? Seems quite out the way.
translation: 这里生意怎么样？看起来很不合时宜。 [zhe li sheng yi zen me yang ？ kan qi lai hen bu he shi yi 。]

english: I'd best be heading off.
translation: 我最好还是出发吧。 [wo zui hao hai shi chu fa ba 。]

english: Wow! lookat this place, it's so colourful.
translation: 哇！看看这个地方，真是色彩缤纷。 [wa ！ kan kan zhe ge di fang ， zhen shi se cai bin fen 。]

english: Why thank you. Can I help you with anything?
translation: 为什么要谢谢你。我可以帮你什么忙吗？ [wei shen me yao xie xie ni 。 wo ke yi bang ni shen me mang ma ？]

english: I take it by the clothes you are wearing and this room that you are in the dye trade?
translation: 我看你穿的衣服和这个房间就知道你是从事染料行业的？ [wo kan ni chuan de yi fu he zhe ge fang jian jiu zhi dao ni shi cong shi ran liao hang ye de ？]

english: How observant of you.
translation: 你多么细心啊。 [ni duo me xi xin a 。]

english: Can you make dyes for me please?
translation: 你能为我做染料吗？ [ni neng wei wo zuo ran liao ma ？]

english: What colour dye do you want? I can make you blue, red or yellow dyes for you. If you bring me the correct raw materials.
translation: 您想要什么颜色的染料？我可以为你制作蓝色、红色或黄色染料。如果你给我带来正确的原材料。 [nin xiang yao shen me yan se de ran liao ？ wo ke yi wei ni zhi zuo lan se 、 hong se huo huang se ran liao 。 ru guo ni gei wo dai lai zheng que de yuan cai liao 。]

english: What do you need to make red dye?
translation: 制作红色染料需要什么？ [zhi zuo hong se ran liao xu yao shen me ？]

english: Hmm.... 3 lots of redberries should do the trick and 25 coins should cover any other costs.
translation: 嗯.... 3 批红莓就可以了，25 枚硬币就可以支付任何其他费用。 [n .... 3  pi hong mei jiu ke yi le ，25  mei ying bi jiu ke yi zhi fu ren he qi ta fei yong 。]

english: You don't have enough berries to make the red dye.
translation: 你没有足够的浆果来制作红色染料。 [ni mei you zu gou de jiang guo lai zhi zuo hong se ran liao 。]

english: You don't have enough coins to pay for the dye.
translation: 您没有足够的硬币来支付染料。 [nin mei you zu gou de ying bi lai zhi fu ran liao 。]

english: Ok make me some red dye please.
translation: 好的，请给我一些红色染料。 [hao de ， qing gei wo yi xie hong se ran liao 。]

english: You hand the redberries and some coins to Rana, who then rummages around some shelves, eventually finding a red bottle, which she then hands to you.
translation: 你把红莓和一些硬币交给拉娜，然后她在一些架子上翻找，最终找到一个红色瓶子，然后她把它递给你。 [ni ba hong mei he yi xie ying bi jiao gei la na ， ran hou ta zai yi xie jia zi shang fan zhao ， zui zhong zhao dao yi ge hong se ping zi ， ran hou ta ba ta di gei ni 。]

english: I don't think I have all the ingredients yet.
translation: 我想我还没有准备好所有的原料。 [wo xiang wo hai mei you zhun bei hao suo you de yuan liao 。]

english: You know what you need to get, now come back when you have them. Goodbye for now.
translation: 你知道你需要得到什么，现在当你拥有它们时再回来。暂时再见了。 [ni zhi dao ni xu yao de dao shen me ， xian zai dang ni yong you ta men shi zai hui lai 。 zan shi zai jian le 。]

english: I can do without dye at that price.
translation: 这个价格我可以不用染料。 [zhe ge jia ge wo ke yi bu yong ran liao 。]

english: Fair enough, I still think that the price is fairly reasonable considering that I'm the only source of dye this side of the Shantay pass.
translation: 公平地说，考虑到我是尚泰山口这一侧唯一的染料来源，我仍然认为价格相当合理。 [gong ping di shuo ， kao lv dao wo shi shang tai shan kou zhe yi ce wei yi de ran liao lai yuan ， wo reng ran ren wei jia ge xiang dang he li 。]

english: Where would I find a redberry bush?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到红莓丛？ [wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao hong mei cong ？]

english: Well you could try growing them. They shouldn't be too hard to grow.
translation: 那么你可以尝试种植它们。它们不应该太难生长。 [na me ni ke yi chang shi zhong zhi ta men 。 ta men bu ying gai tai nan sheng zhang 。]

english: If I didn't care to grow my own, where else could I get some?
translation: 如果我不想自己种植，我还能从哪里得到一些呢？ [ru guo wo bu xiang zi ji zhong zhi ， wo hai neng cong na li de dao yi xie ne ？]

english: Well I know for sure that the desert climate wouldn't suit them. I have mine picked for me in the woods south of Varrock.
translation: 我确信沙漠气候不适合他们。我在瓦罗克南部的树林里为我采摘了我的。 [wo que xin sha mo qi hou bu shi he ta men 。 wo zai wa luo ke nan bu de shu lin li wei wo cai zhai le wo de 。]

english: What do you need to make yellow dye?
translation: 制作黄色染料需要什么？ [zhi zuo huang se ran liao xu yao shen me ？]

english: Yellow is an awkward colour to recreate, I guess if you got me 2 onions I could use their skins to make a warm yellow dye for you. Oh yes and lest I forget I'll need 25 coins to cover the cost of the glass ware and
translation: 黄色是一种很难重现的颜色，我想如果你给我 2 个洋葱，我可以用它们的皮为你制作一种温暖的黄色染料。哦，是的，免得我忘记了，我需要 25 个硬币来支付玻璃器皿的费用， [huang se shi yi zhong hen nan chong xian de yan se ， wo xiang ru guo ni gei wo  2  ge yang cong ， wo ke yi yong ta men de pi wei ni zhi zuo yi zhong wen nuan de huang se ran liao 。 o ， shi de ， mian de wo wang ji le ， wo xu yao  25  ge ying bi lai zhi fu bo li qi min de fei yong ，]

english: my wages.
translation: 我的工资。 [wo de gong zi 。]

english: You don't have enough onions to make the yellow dye.
translation: 你没有足够的洋葱来制作黄色染料。 [ni mei you zu gou de yang cong lai zhi zuo huang se ran liao 。]

english: Ok make me some yellow dye please.
translation: 好的，请给我一些黄色染料。 [hao de ， qing gei wo yi xie huang se ran liao 。]

english: You hand two onions to Rana, who then rummages around some shelves, eventually finding a yellow bottle, which she then hands to you.
translation: 你把两个洋葱递给拉娜，然后她翻遍了一些架子，最终找到了一个黄色瓶子，然后她把它递给了你。 [ni ba liang ge yang cong di gei la na ， ran hou ta fan bian le yi xie jia zi ， zui zhong zhao dao le yi ge huang se ping zi ， ran hou ta ba ta di gei le ni 。]

english: Where could I find some onions?
translation: 哪里可以找到洋葱？ [na li ke yi zhao dao yang cong ？]

english: Generally you would find onions in vegetable gardens, silly.
translation: 一般来说，你会在菜园里找到洋葱，愚蠢的。 [yi ban lai shuo ， ni hui zai cai yuan li zhao dao yang cong ， yu chun de 。]

english: Ok you have me there but is there anywhere around here where I could get my hands on some onions?
translation: 好的，我在那里，但是这附近有什么地方可以买到洋葱吗？ [hao de ， wo zai na li ， dan shi zhe fu jin you shen me di fang ke yi mai dao yang cong ma ？]

english: I really don't know. A friend of mine grows hers on a farms near Draynor village. But that's a little far from here to be useful.
translation: 我真的不知道。我的一个朋友在德雷诺村附近的一个农场里种植了她的。但距离有用还有点远。 [wo zhen de bu zhi dao 。 wo de yi ge peng you zai de lei nuo cun fu jin de yi ge nong chang li zhong zhi le ta de 。 dan ju li you yong hai you dian yuan 。]

english: What do you need to make blue dye?
translation: 制作蓝色染料需要什么？ [zhi zuo lan se ran liao xu yao shen me ？]

english: To make a bottle of blue dye I'll need 2 woad leaves and 25 coins from you.
translation: 要制作一瓶蓝色染料，我需要你提供 2 片菘蓝叶和 25 个硬币。 [yao zhi zuo yi ping lan se ran liao ， wo xu yao ni ti gong  2  pian song lan ye he  25  ge ying bi 。]

english: You don't have enough woad leaves to make the blue dye.
translation: 你没有足够的菘蓝叶来制作蓝色染料。 [ni mei you zu gou de song lan ye lai zhi zuo lan se ran liao 。]

english: Ok make me some blue dye please.
translation: 好的，请给我一些蓝色染料。 [hao de ， qing gei wo yi xie lan se ran liao 。]

english: You hand the woad leaves and some coins to Rana, who then rummages around some shelves, eventually finding a blue bottle, which she then hands to you.
translation: 你把菘蓝叶和一些硬币交给拉娜，然后拉娜在一些架子上翻找，最终找到一个蓝色的瓶子，然后她把它递给你。 [ni ba song lan ye he yi xie ying bi jiao gei la na ， ran hou la na zai yi xie jia zi shang fan zhao ， zui zhong zhao dao yi ge lan se de ping zi ， ran hou ta ba ta di gei ni 。]

english: Where can I get some woad leaves?
translation: 哪里可以买到菘蓝叶？ [na li ke yi mai dao song lan ye ？]

english: Woad leaves are fairly rare. My other customers tell me there's a gardener in Falador who grows them.
translation: 菘蓝叶相当罕见。我的其他顾客告诉我法拉多有一位园丁种植它们。 [song lan ye xiang dang han jian 。 wo de qi ta gu ke gao su wo fa la duo you yi wei yuan ding zhong zhi ta men 。]

english: On second thoughts, I don't think that I need some dye right now.
translation: 再想一想，我认为我现在不需要一些染料。 [zai xiang yi xiang ， wo ren wei wo xian zai bu xu yao yi xie ran liao 。]

english: How did you get into the colour business?
translation: 您是如何进入色彩行业的？ [nin shi ru he jin ru se cai hang ye de ？]

english: Well, it's quite simple really my mother was a drysalter and I learnt the trade from her.
translation: 嗯，这很简单，我的母亲确实是一名干盐工，我从她那里学到了这门手艺。 [n ， zhe hen jian dan ， wo de mu qin que shi shi yi ming gan yan gong ， wo cong ta na li xue dao le zhe men shou yi 。]

english: Umm, what's a drysalter, it isn't a medical condition is it?
translation: 嗯，什么是干盐，这不是一种医疗状况，不是吗？ [n ， shen me shi gan yan ， zhe bu shi yi zhong yi liao zhuang kuang ， bu shi ma ？]

english: No silly, it's someone who deals with preservatives and dyes. I didn't really enjoy the preservative side of things so I've chosen to deal solely in dyeing.
translation: 不傻，这是一个处理防腐剂和染料的人。我不太喜欢防腐剂方面的东西，所以我选择只处理染色。 [bu sha ， zhe shi yi ge chu li fang fu ji he ran liao de ren 。 wo bu tai xi huan fang fu ji fang mian de dong xi ， suo yi wo xuan ze zhi chu li ran se 。]

english: So how's business then?
translation: 那么生意怎么样呢？ [na me sheng yi zen me yang ne ？]

english: It's a dyeing trade! Oh gosh, I'm sorry, that was a truly dreadful joke.
translation: 这是染色贸易！哦天哪，我很抱歉，这真是一个可怕的笑话。 [zhe shi ran se mao yi ！ o tian na ， wo hen bao qian ， zhe zhen shi yi ge ke pa de xiao hua 。]

english: Hmm yes, about the worst I've heard today at least.
translation: 嗯，是的，至少是我今天听到的最糟糕的情况。 [n ， shi de ， zhi shao shi wo jin tian ting dao de zui zao gao de qing kuang 。]

english: Thanks. But really, it's not the best around here, nearly everyone in this town wears only white, which means I don't exactly do a roaring trade. Now is there anything I can get you?
translation: 谢谢。但实际上，这并不是这里最好的，这个镇上几乎每个人都只穿白色的衣服，这意味着我并不是做一个轰轰烈烈的生意。现在有什么我可以给你的吗？ [xie xie 。 dan shi ji shang ， zhe bing bu shi zhe li zui hao de ， zhe ge zhen shang ji hu mei ge ren dou zhi chuan bai se de yi fu ， zhe yi wei zhe wo bing bu shi zuo yi ge hong hong lie lie de sheng yi 。 xian zai you shen me wo ke yi gei ni de ma ？]

english: No thanks, I'm just having a look around.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我只是四处看看。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo zhi shi si chu kan kan 。]

english: Could you make some dye for me please?
translation: 你能为我做一些染料吗？ [ni neng wei wo zuo yi xie ran liao ma ？]

english: What do you need to make red dye?
translation: 制作红色染料需要什么？ [zhi zuo hong se ran liao xu yao shen me ？]

english: Okay, make me some red dye please.
translation: 好的，请给我一些红色染料。 [hao de ， qing gei wo yi xie hong se ran liao 。]

english: I don't think I have all the ingredients yet.
translation: 我想我还没有准备好所有的原料。 [wo xiang wo hai mei you zhun bei hao suo you de yuan liao 。]

english: I can do without dye at that price.
translation: 这个价格我可以不用染料。 [zhe ge jia ge wo ke yi bu yong ran liao 。]

english: Where would I find a redberry bush?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到红莓丛？ [wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao hong mei cong ？]

english: What do you need to make yellow dye?
translation: 制作黄色染料需要什么？ [zhi zuo huang se ran liao xu yao shen me ？]

english: Okay, make me some yellow dye please.
translation: 好的，请给我一些黄色染料。 [hao de ， qing gei wo yi xie huang se ran liao 。]

english: Where could I find some onions?
translation: 哪里可以找到洋葱？ [na li ke yi zhao dao yang cong ？]

english: What do you need to make blue dye?
translation: 制作蓝色染料需要什么？ [zhi zuo lan se ran liao xu yao shen me ？]

english: Okay, make me some blue dye please.
translation: 好的，请给我一些蓝色染料。 [hao de ， qing gei wo yi xie lan se ran liao 。]

english: Where can I get some woad leaves?
translation: 哪里可以买到菘蓝叶？ [na li ke yi mai dao song lan ye ？]

english: On second thoughts I don't really need any dye.
translation: 转念一想，我真的不需要任何染料。 [zhuan nian yi xiang ， wo zhen de bu xu yao ren he ran liao 。]

english: How did you get into the colour business?
translation: 您是如何进入色彩行业的？ [nin shi ru he jin ru se cai hang ye de ？]

english: No thanks, I'm just having a look around.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我只是四处看看。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo zhi shi si chu kan kan 。]

english: Hello. How can I help you?
translation: 你好。我怎么帮你？ [ni hao 。 wo zen me bang ni ？]

english: Can you give me any Farming advice?
translation: 你能给我一些农业建议吗？ [ni neng gei wo yi xie nong ye jian yi ma ？]

english: Yes - ask a gardener.
translation: 是的 - 问问园丁。 [shi de  -  wen wen yuan ding 。]

english: I'm okay, thank you.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。 [wo mei shi ， xie xie 。]

english: What are you selling?
translation: 你卖什么？ [ni mai shen me ？]

english: Can you give me any Farming advice?
translation: 你能给我一些农业建议吗？ [ni neng gei wo yi xie nong ye jian yi ma ？]

english: I'm okay, thank you.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。 [wo mei shi ， xie xie 。]

english: I'm sorry to bother you, but could you spare me a little dung?
translation: 很抱歉打扰你，但是你能给我一点粪便吗？ [hen bao qian da rao ni ， dan shi ni neng gei wo yi dian fen bian ma ？]

english: The camel didn't seem to appreciate that question.
translation: 骆驼似乎不喜欢这个问题。 [luo tuo si hu bu xi huan zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: If I go near that camel, it'll probably bite my hand off.
translation: 如果我靠近那头骆驼，它可能会咬掉我的手。 [ru guo wo kao jin na tou luo tuo ， ta ke neng hui yao diao wo de shou 。]

english: Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab.
translation: 嗯……看起来那只骆驼可以做一顿美味的烤肉串。 [n …… kan qi lai na zhi luo tuo ke yi zuo yi dun mei wei de kao rou chuan 。]

english: I wonder if that camel has fleas...
translation: 我想知道那只骆驼有没有跳蚤... [wo xiang zhi dao na zhi luo tuo you mei you tiao zao ...]

english: Are you serious?
translation: 你是认真的？ [ni shi ren zhen de ？]

english: Oh yes. If you'd be so kind...
translation: 哦是的。如果你能这么善良的话... [o shi de 。 ru guo ni neng zhe me shan liang de hua ...]

english: Well, just you close your eyes first. I'm not doing it while you're watching me!
translation: 好吧，你先闭上眼睛。当你看着我的时候我不会这么做！ [hao ba ， ni xian bi shang yan jing 。 dang ni kan zhe wo de shi hou wo bu hui zhe me zuo ！]

english: I hope that's what you wanted!
translation: 我希望这就是你想要的！ [wo xi wang zhe jiu shi ni xiang yao de ！]

english: Ohhh yes. Lovely.
translation: 噢，是的。迷人的。 [o ， shi de 。 mi ren de 。]

english: What did you say?
translation: 你说什么？ [ni shuo shen me ？]

english: Nothing, nothing.
translation: 没什么，没什么。 [mei shen me ， mei shen me 。]

english: Well, don't interrupt me, I've got work to do.
translation: 好吧，别打扰我，我还有工作要做。 [hao ba ， bie da rao wo ， wo hai you gong zuo yao zuo 。]

english: Really? What sort of work?
translation: 真的吗？什么样的工作？ [zhen de ma ？ shen me yang de gong zuo ？]

english: I'm participating in the construction of a shopping and sales extravaganza!
translation: 我正在参与一场购物和销售盛会的建设！ [wo zheng zai can yu yi chang gou wu he xiao shou sheng hui de jian she ！]

english: ...What?
translation: ...什么？ [... shen me ？]

english: My masters have me hauling boxes around. There's not much to do at the moment, though.
translation: 我的主人让我拖着箱子四处走动。不过，目前没什么可做的。 [wo de zhu ren rang wo tuo zhe xiang zi si chu zou dong 。 bu guo ， mu qian mei shen me ke zuo de 。]

english: Are your masters those men called Ali?
translation: 你的主人是那些叫阿里的人吗？ [ni de zhu ren shi na xie jiao a li de ren ma ？]

english: Yes, that's them. They're traders working for Ali Morrisane.
translation: 是的，就是他们。他们是为 Ali Morrisane 工作的交易员。 [shi de ， jiu shi ta men 。 ta men shi wei  Ali Morrisane  gong zuo de jiao yi yuan 。]

english: So, what's it like working for your masters?
translation: 那么，为你的主人工作是什么感觉？ [na me ， wei ni de zhu ren gong zuo shi shen me gan jue ？]

english: It's hard work sometimes, but it could be worse.
translation: 有时工作很辛苦，但情况可能会更糟。 [you shi gong zuo hen xin ku ， dan qing kuang ke neng hui geng zao 。]

english: I heard about a pair of camels back in Pollnivneach who were poisoned!
translation: 我听说 Pollnivneach 的一对骆驼中毒了！ [wo ting shuo  Pollnivneach  de yi dui luo tuo zhong du le ！]

english: They say someone put spicy sauce in their food.
translation: 他们说有人在食物里放了辣酱。 [ta men shuo you ren zai shi wu li fang le la jiang 。]

english: Really? That's very cruel of whoever did it.
translation: 真的吗？无论是谁干的，都非常残忍。 [zhen de ma ？ wu lun shi shui gan de ， dou fei chang can ren 。]

english: I sincerely hope whoever did it was punished. Do they have no compassion for camels?
translation: 我真诚地希望无论是谁都受到惩罚。他们对骆驼没有同情心吗？ [wo zhen cheng di xi wang wu lun shi shei dou shou dao cheng fa 。 ta men dui luo tuo mei you tong qing xin ma ？]

english: Ask the camel about its dung.
translation: 向骆驼询问它的粪便。 [xiang luo tuo xun wen ta de fen bian 。]

english: Say something unpleasant.
translation: 说一些不愉快的话。 [shuo yi xie bu yu kuai de hua 。]

english: Neither - I'm a polite person.
translation: 都不是——我是一个有礼貌的人。 [dou bu shi —— wo shi yi ge you li mao de ren 。]

english: Greetings and welcome to my farming equipment shop. Would you like to buy some equipment?
translation: 问候并欢迎来到我的农业设备店。您想购买一些设备吗？ [wen hou bing huan ying lai dao wo de nong ye she bei dian 。 nin xiang gou mai yi xie she bei ma ？]

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Yes, please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Ah, hello there. Nice to see an outsider for a change. Are you busy? I have a problem.
translation: 啊，你好。很高兴看到一个局外人来改变。你忙吗？我有一个问题。 [a ， ni hao 。 hen gao xing kan dao yi ge ju wai ren lai gai bian 。 ni mang ma ？ wo you yi ge wen ti 。]

english: How can I help?
translation: 我能提供什么帮助吗？ [wo neng ti gong shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: It's my son Hudon, he's always getting into trouble. The boy's convinced there's hidden treasure in the river and I'm a bit worried about his safety, the poor lad can't even swim.
translation: 这是我的儿子休顿，他总是惹麻烦。这个男孩确信河里藏着宝藏，我有点担心他的安全，这个可怜的小伙子甚至不会游泳。 [zhe shi wo de er zi xiu dun ， ta zong shi re ma fan 。 zhe ge nan hai que xin he li cang zhe bao zang ， wo you dian dan xin ta de an quan ， zhe ge ke lian de xiao huo zi shen zhi bu hui you yong 。]

english: I could go and take a look for you if you like?
translation: 如果你愿意的话我可以去看看你吗？ [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua wo ke yi qu kan kan ni ma ？]

english: Would you? You are kind. You can use the small raft out back if you wish, do be careful, the current down stream is very strong.
translation: 你愿意吗？你很善良。如果你愿意的话，你可以使用后面的小木筏，一定要小心，下游的水流非常强大。 [ni yuan yi ma ？ ni hen shan liang 。 ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， ni ke yi shi yong hou mian de xiao mu fa ， yi ding yao xiao xin ， xia you de shui liu fei chang qiang da 。]

english: I'm afraid I'm in a rush.
translation: 恐怕我很着急。 [kong pa wo hen zhao ji 。]

english: Oh okay, never mind.
translation: 哦，好吧，没关系。 [o ， hao ba ， mei guan xi 。]

english: Hello Almera.
translation: 你好阿尔梅拉。 [ni hao a er mei la 。]

english: Hello adventurer, have you seen my boy yet?
translation: 你好冒险家，你看到我的孩子了吗？ [ni hao mao xian jia ， ni kan dao wo de hai zi le ma ？]

english: I'm afraid not, but I'm sure he hasn't gone far.
translation: 恐怕不会，但我确信他还没有走多远。 [kong pa bu hui ， dan wo que xin ta hai mei you zou duo yuan 。]

english: I do hope so, you can't be too careful these days.
translation: 我确实希望如此，这些天你不能太小心。 [wo que shi xi wang ru ci ， zhe xie tian ni bu neng tai xiao xin 。]

english: Hello again.
translation: 又好。 [you hao 。]

english: Well hello, you're still around then.
translation: 嗯，你好，那时你还在。 [n ， ni hao ， na shi ni hai zai 。]

english: I saw Hudon by the river but he refused to come back with me.
translation: 我在河边看到了Hudon，但他拒绝跟我一起回来。 [wo zai he bian kan dao le Hudon， dan ta ju jue gen wo yi qi hui lai 。]

english: Yes he told me, the foolish lad came in drenched to the bone, he had fallen into the waterfall, lucky he wasn't killed! Now he can spend the rest of the summer in his room.
translation: 是的，他告诉我，那个愚蠢的小伙子浑身湿透地进来了，他掉进了瀑布，幸运的是他没有死！现在他可以在自己的房间里度过剩下的夏天了。 [shi de ， ta gao su wo ， na ge yu chun de xiao huo zi hun shen shi tou di jin lai le ， ta diao jin le pu bu ， xing yun de shi ta mei you si ！ xian zai ta ke yi zai zi ji de fang jian li du guo sheng xia de xia tian le 。]

english: Any ideas what I could do while I'm here?
translation: 我在这里的时候有什么想法可以做吗？ [wo zai zhe li de shi hou you shen me xiang fa ke yi zuo ma ？]

english: Why don't you visit the tourist centre south of the waterfall?
translation: 何不去瀑布南面的游客中心参观一下呢？ [he bu qu pu bu nan mian de you ke zhong xin can guan yi xia ne ？]

english: Hello again Almera.
translation: 阿尔梅拉，你好。 [a er mei la ， ni hao 。]

english: Well hello again brave adventurer, are you enjoying the tranquil scenery of these parts?
translation: 好吧，勇敢的冒险家，你好，你喜欢这些地方的宁静风景吗？ [hao ba ， yong gan de mao xian jia ， ni hao ， ni xi huan zhe xie di fang de ning jing feng jing ma ？]

english: Yes, very relaxing.
translation: 是的，非常放松。 [shi de ， fei chang fang song 。]

english: Well I'm glad to hear itThe authorities wanted to dig up this whole area for a mine, but the few locals who lived here wouldn't budge and they gave up.
translation: 嗯，我很高兴听到这个消息。当局想在整个地区挖掘矿井，但居住在这里的少数当地人不肯让步，他们放弃了。 [n ， wo hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi 。 dang ju xiang zai zheng ge di qu wa jue kuang jing ， dan ju zhu zai zhe li de shao shu dang di ren bu ken rang bu ， ta men fang qi le 。]

english: Good for you.
translation: 对你有好处。 [dui ni you hao chu 。]

english: Good for all of us!
translation: 对我们大家都有好处！ [dui wo men da jia dou you hao chu ！]

english: Hello adventurer, how's your treasure hunt going?
translation: 你好，冒险家，你的寻宝活动进行得怎么样了？ [ni hao ， mao xian jia ， ni de xun bao huo dong jin xing de zen me yang le ？]

english: Oh, I'm just sight seeing.
translation: 哦，我只是来看看。 [o ， wo zhi shi lai kan kan 。]

english: No adventurer stays here this long just to sight see. But your business is yours alone, if you need to use the raft go ahead. But please try not to crash it this time!
translation: 没有哪个冒险家会为了观光而停留这么久。但你的事是你自己的事，如果你需要使用木筏，那就继续吧。但这次请尽量不要让它崩溃！ [mei you na ge mao xian jia hui wei le guan guang er ting liu zhe me jiu 。 dan ni de shi shi ni zi ji de shi ， ru guo ni xu yao shi yong mu fa ， na jiu ji xu ba 。 dan zhe ci qing jin liang bu yao rang ta beng kui ！]

english: Thank Almera.
translation: 谢谢阿尔梅拉。 [xie xie a er mei la 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Hello again.
translation: 又好。 [you hao 。]

english: You have crossed my path too many times intruder. Leave or face my wrath.
translation: 你闯入我的道路已经太多次了，入侵者。离开或面对我的愤怒。 [ni chuang ru wo de dao lu yi jing tai duo ci le ， ru qin zhe 。 li kai huo mian dui wo de fen nu 。]

english: Yeah, whatever.
translation: 是的，无论如何。 [shi de ， wu lun ru he 。]

english: Hello, Alomone.
translation: 你好，阿洛莫内。 [ni hao ， a luo mo nei 。]

english: Welcome, adventurer. Know that as a friend to Hazeel, you are always welcome here.
translation: 欢迎，冒险家。要知道，作为 Hazeel 的朋友，这里永远欢迎您。 [huan ying ， mao xian jia 。 yao zhi dao ， zuo wei  Hazeel  de peng you ， zhe li yong yuan huan ying nin 。]

english: Hello Madam.
translation: 你好女士。 [ni hao nv shi 。]

english: Oh, hello there.
translation: 哦，你好。 [o ， ni hao 。]

english: Are you ok?
translation: 你还好吗？ [ni hai hao ma ？]

english: Not too bad... I've just got some troubles on my mind...
translation: 还不错……我只是心里有些烦恼…… [hai bu cuo …… wo zhi shi xin li you xie fan nao ……]

english: Hello, Edmond has asked me to help find your daughter.
translation: 你好，埃德蒙让我帮忙寻找你的女儿。 [ni hao ， ai de meng rang wo bang mang xun zhao ni de nv er 。]

english: Yes he told me. I've begun making your special gas mask, but I need some dwellberries to finish it.
translation: 是的，他告诉我的。我已经开始制作你的特殊防毒面具，但我需要一些红莓来完成它。 [shi de ， ta gao su wo de 。 wo yi jing kai shi zhi zuo ni de te shu fang du mian ju ， dan wo xu yao yi xie hong mei lai wan cheng ta 。]

english: I'll try to get some.
translation: 我会尝试去拿一些。 [wo hui chang shi qu na yi xie 。]

english: The best place to look is in McGrubor's Wood, just west of Seers' Village.
translation: 最好的观赏地点是位于先知村西边的麦格鲁伯森林 (McGrubor's Wood)。 [zui hao de guan shang di dian shi wei yu xian zhi cun xi bian de mai ge lu bo sen lin  (McGrubor's Wood)。]

english: Yes I've got some here.
translation: 是的，我这里有一些。 [shi de ， wo zhe li you yi xie 。]

english: There we go, all done. While in West Ardougne you must wear this at all times, or you could catch the plague.
translation: 到这里，一切就完成了。在西阿杜涅期间，您必须始终佩戴它，否则您可能会感染瘟疫。 [dao zhe li ， yi qie jiu wan cheng le 。 zai xi a du nie qi jian ， nin bi xu shi zhong pei dai ta ， fou ze nin ke neng hui gan ran wen yi 。]

english: I'll make a spare mask for you in case you lose that one. I'll hide it in the cupboard in case the mourners come looking.
translation: 我会为你制作一个备用面具，以防万一你丢失了那个面具。我会把它藏在柜子里，以防哀悼者来看。 [wo hui wei ni zhi zuo yi ge bei yong mian ju ， yi fang wan yi ni diu shi le na ge mian ju 。 wo hui ba ta cang zai gui zi li ， yi fang ai dao zhe lai kan 。]

english: Hello darling, I think Edmond had a good idea of how to get into West Ardougne, you should hear his idea.
translation: 你好，亲爱的，我认为埃德蒙对如何进入西阿杜涅有一个好主意，你应该听听他的想法。 [ni hao ， qin ai de ， wo ren wei ai de meng dui ru he jin ru xi a du nie you yi ge hao zhu yi ， ni ying gai ting ting ta de xiang fa 。]

english: Alright, I'll go and see him now.
translation: 好吧，我现在就去见他。 [hao ba ， wo xian zai jiu qu jian ta 。]

english: Hello Alrena.
translation: 你好阿尔雷娜。 [ni hao a er lei na 。]

english: Hello darling, how's that tunnel coming along?
translation: 你好，亲爱的，那条隧道进展如何？ [ni hao ， qin ai de ， na tiao sui dao jin zhan ru he ？]

english: I just need to soften the soil and then we'll start digging.
translation: 我只需要软化土壤，然后我们就开始挖掘。 [wo zhi xu yao ruan hua tu rang ， ran hou wo men jiu kai shi wa jue 。]

english: Well I'm sure you're quicker than Edmond.
translation: 嗯，我确信你比埃德蒙更快。 [n ， wo que xin ni bi ai de meng geng kuai 。]

english: I just need to soften the soil a little more and then we'll start digging.
translation: 我只需要稍微软化土壤，然后我们就开始挖掘。 [wo zhi xu yao shao wei ruan hua tu rang ， ran hou wo men jiu kai shi wa jue 。]

english: Hello again Alrena.
translation: 阿尔雷娜，你好。 [a er lei na ， ni hao 。]

english: How's the tunnel going?
translation: 隧道进展如何？ [sui dao jin zhan ru he ？]

english: I'm getting there.
translation: 我快到了。 [wo kuai dao le 。]

english: One of the mourners has been sniffing around asking questions about you and Edmond, you should keep an eye out for him.
translation: 一位哀悼者一直在四处询问有关你和埃德蒙的问题，你应该留意他。 [yi wei ai dao zhe yi zhi zai si chu xun wen you guan ni he ai de meng de wen ti ， ni ying gai liu yi ta 。]

english: Also, don't forget about that spare gas mask if you need it. It's hidden in the cupboard.
translation: 另外，如果需要的话，不要忘记备用防毒面具。它藏在柜子里。 [ling wai ， ru guo xu yao de hua ， bu yao wang ji bei yong fang du mian ju 。 ta cang zai gui zi li 。]

english: Great, thanks Alrena!
translation: 太好了，谢谢阿尔雷娜！ [tai hao le ， xie xie a er lei na ！]

english: Okay, thanks for the warning.
translation: 好的，谢谢你的警告。 [hao de ， xie xie ni de jing gao 。]

english: Hello, any word on Elena?
translation: 你好，有关于埃琳娜的消息吗？ [ni hao ， you guan yu ai lin na de xiao xi ma ？]

english: Not yet I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕还没有。 [kong pa hai mei you 。]

english: Is there anything else I can do to help?
translation: 还有什么我可以帮忙的吗？ [hai you shen me wo ke yi bang mang de ma ？]

english: It's alright, I'll get her back soon.
translation: 没关系，我很快就会把她接回来。 [mei guan xi ， wo hen kuai jiu hui ba ta jie hui lai 。]

english: That's the spirit, dear. Don't forget that there's a spare gas mask in the cupboard if you need one.
translation: 这就是精神，亲爱的。不要忘记，如果您需要的话，柜子里还有一个备用防毒面具。 [zhe jiu shi jing shen ， qin ai de 。 bu yao wang ji ， ru guo nin xu yao de hua ， gui zi li hai you yi ge bei yong fang du mian ju 。]

english: That's the spirit, dear.
translation: 这就是精神，亲爱的。 [zhe jiu shi jing shen ， qin ai de 。]

english: Do you have a picture of Elena?
translation: 你有埃琳娜的照片吗？ [ni you ai lin na de zhao pian ma ？]

english: Yes. There should be one in the house somewhere. Let me know if you need anything else.
translation: 是的。房子里的某个地方应该有一个。如果您还需要什么，请告诉我。 [shi de 。 fang zi li de mou ge di fang ying gai you yi ge 。 ru guo nin hai xu yao shen me ， qing gao su wo 。]

english: Thank you for rescuing my daughter! Elena has told me of your bravery in entering a house that could have been plague infected. I can't thank you enough!
translation: 谢谢你救了我的女儿！埃琳娜告诉我你勇敢地进入了可能感染鼠疫的房子。我对你感激不尽！ [xie xie ni jiu le wo de nv er ！ ai lin na gao su wo ni yong gan di jin ru le ke neng gan ran shu yi de fang zi 。 wo dui ni gan ji bu jin ！]

english: They've taken her...
translation: 他们带走了她... [ta men dai zou le ta ...]

english: Who?
translation: WHO？ [WHO？]

english: Elena! They came and took her away!
translation: 埃琳娜！他们来了，把她带走了！ [ai lin na ！ ta men lai le ， ba ta dai zou le ！]

english: Oh no! Is there anything I can do?
translation: 哦不！有什么我可以做的吗？ [o bu ！ you shen me wo ke yi zuo de ma ？]

english: I'm not sure... Speak to Edmond, he was there when they took her.
translation: 我不确定...跟埃德蒙谈谈，他们带走她时他就在那里。 [wo bu que ding ... gen ai de meng tan tan ， ta men dai zou ta shi ta jiu zai na li 。]

english: Thank you so much for helping Elena. It means so much to Edmond and I.
translation: 非常感谢你帮助埃琳娜。这对埃德蒙和我来说意义重大。 [fei chang gan xie ni bang zhu ai lin na 。 zhe dui ai de meng he wo lai shuo yi yi zhong da 。]

english: I need another tabard.
translation: 我需要另一件战袍。 [wo xu yao ling yi jian zhan pao 。]

english: Not a problem. I still have enough materials to make another. Here you go.
translation: 不是问题。我还有足够的材料再做一个。干得好。 [bu shi wen ti 。 wo hai you zu gou de cai liao zai zuo yi ge 。 gan de hao 。]

english: It'a not a problem.
translation: 这不是问题。 [zhe bu shi wen ti 。]

english: I need another tabard.
translation: 我需要另一件战袍。 [wo xu yao ling yi jian zhan pao 。]

english: It's not a problem.
translation: 这不是问题。 [zhe bu shi wen ti 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Good day.
translation: 再会。 [zai hui 。]

english: Good day, Your Royal Highness.
translation: 美好的一天，殿下。 [mei hao de yi tian ， dian xia 。]

english: Oi!
translation: 哎呀！ [ai ya ！]

english: Rahr!
translation: 拉尔！ [la er ！]

english: No!
translation: 不！ [bu ！]

english: Grr!
translation: 咕噜！ [gu lu ！]

english: Aargh!
translation: 啊啊！ [a a ！]

english: I'm a gonner!
translation: 我是个大佬！ [wo shi ge da lao ！]

english: It's no use, I'm done for!
translation: 没用的，我已经完蛋了！ [mei yong de ， wo yi jing wan dan le ！]

english: Uggh!
translation: 哎呀！ [ai ya ！]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: What brings you to these parts, stranger?
translation: 陌生人，是什么让你来到这些地方？ [mo sheng ren ， shi shen me rang ni lai dao zhe xie di fang ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: I suppose it is a little different to the places your type are used to...
translation: 我想这与你的类型习惯的地方有点不同...... [wo xiang zhe yu ni de lei xing xi guan de di fang you dian bu tong ......]

english: This is my humble little hideaway! Plenty of fish around to sustain a man like me, with the help of my trusty cormorant.
translation: 这是我简陋的小隐居处！在我值得信赖的鸬鹚的帮助下，周围有很多鱼可以养活像我这样的人。 [zhe shi wo jian lou de xiao yin ju chu ！ zai wo zhi de xin lai de lu ci de bang zhu xia ， zhou wei you hen duo yu ke yi yang huo xiang wo zhe yang de ren 。]

english: A bird helps you to fish?
translation: 一只鸟帮你钓鱼？ [yi zhi niao bang ni diao yu ？]

english: Sure she does! I haven't used a rod in years, just send her out to the waters and she takes care of it for me!
translation: 她当然知道！我已经好几年没用鱼竿了，只要把她送到水里，她就会帮我照顾它！ [ta dang ran zhi dao ！ wo yi jing hao ji nian mei yong yu gan le ， zhi yao ba ta song dao shui li ， ta jiu hui bang wo zhao gu ta ！]

english: Could I have a go with your bird?
translation: 我可以和你的鸟一起玩吗？ [wo ke yi he ni de niao yi qi wan ma ？]

english: I don't know, I doubt that your type's up to the task...
translation: 我不知道，我怀疑你的类型是否能胜任这项任务...... [wo bu zhi dao ， wo huai yi ni de lei xing shi fou neng sheng ren zhe xiang ren wu ......]

english: But it would be quite the amusing sight. Go on!
translation: 但这将是非常有趣的景象。继续！ [dan zhe jiang shi fei chang you qu de jing xiang 。 ji xu ！]

english: I'll keep an eye on you and make sure you don't have too much trouble with her!
translation: 我会留意你的，确保你不会给她带来太多麻烦！ [wo hui liu yi ni de ， que bao ni bu hui gei ta dai lai tai duo ma fan ！]

english: You're going to need to free up your hands first, though. Nothing in or on your hands.
translation: 不过，您需要先解放双手。你手上或手上没有任何东西。 [bu guo ， nin xu yao xian jie fang shuang shou 。 ni shou shang huo shou shang mei you ren he dong xi 。]

english: I don't think that's for me... I'll leave that to you.
translation: 我认为这不适合我...我会把它留给你。 [wo ren wei zhe bu shi he wo ... wo hui ba ta liu gei ni 。]

english: No surprises there! Your type never have been cut out for it.
translation: 那里没有什么惊喜！你的类型从来都不是适合它的。 [na li mei you shen me jing xi ！ ni de lei xing cong lai dou bu shi shi he ta de 。]

english: What's in the sack?
translation: 麻袋里有什么？ [ma dai li you shen me ？]

english: Oh, this? This is my trusty old fish sack!
translation: 哦，这个？这是我值得信赖的旧鱼袋！ [o ， zhe ge ？ zhe shi wo zhi de xin lai de jiu yu dai ！]

english: Fish sack?
translation: 鱼袋？ [yu dai ？]

english: Yeah, fish sack! I might sell you one if you've found any of those pearls around here.
translation: 对啊，鱼袋！如果你在这附近发现了任何一颗珍珠，我可能会卖给你一颗。 [dui a ， yu dai ！ ru guo ni zai zhe fu jin fa xian le ren he yi ke zhen zhu ， wo ke neng hui mai gei ni yi ke 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: I found this big fish...
translation: 我发现了这条大鱼... [wo fa xian le zhe tiao da yu ...]

english: Now that is a biggun! How she managed to wrangle one like that I'll never know.
translation: 现在那是一把大枪！我永远不知道她是如何与这样的人争吵的。 [xian zai na shi yi ba da qiang ！ wo yong yuan bu zhi dao ta shi ru he yu zhe yang de ren zheng chao de 。]

english: If you don't want it, I could take it off your hands for a few of those pearls!
translation: 如果你不想要的话，我可以从你手上夺走它，换取几颗珍珠！ [ru guo ni bu xiang yao de hua ， wo ke yi cong ni shou shang duo zou ta ， huan qu ji ke zhen zhu ！]

english: I'm interested... How many pearls are we talking?
translation: 我感兴趣...我们谈论的是多少颗珍珠？ [wo gan xing qu ... wo men tan lun de shi duo shao ke zhen zhu ？]

english: I'll give you a hundred pearls for it. What do you say?
translation: 我将给你一百颗珍珠。你怎么说？ [wo jiang gei ni yi bai ke zhen zhu 。 ni zen me shuo ？]

english: On seconds thoughts, I'd rather keep it.
translation: 转念一想，我宁愿保留它。 [zhuan nian yi xiang ， wo ning yuan bao liu ta 。]

english: As you wish.
translation: 如你所愿。 [ru ni suo yuan 。]

english: It's a deal.
translation: 这是一笔交易。 [zhe shi yi bi jiao yi 。]

english: Pleasure doing business with you!
translation: 很高兴与您开展业务！ [hen gao xing yu nin kai zhan ye wu ！]

english: Well, let me know if you change your mind.
translation: 好吧，如果你改变主意，请告诉我。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， qing gao su wo 。]

english: Hello again.
translation: 又好。 [you hao 。]

english: Ah, it's you. How are you finding things?
translation: 啊，是你。你怎么找东西？ [a ， shi ni 。 ni zen me zhao dong xi ？]

english: It certainly is a challenge...
translation: 这当然是一个挑战... [zhe dang ran shi yi ge tiao zhan ...]

english: Yes, your type do often seem to underestimate it! Are you finished?
translation: 是的，你的类型似乎经常低估它！你完成了吗？ [shi de ， ni de lei xing si hu jing chang di gu ta ！ ni wan cheng le ma ？]

english: Not yet. I think I'll keep trying.
translation: 还没有。我想我会继续努力。 [hai mei you 。 wo xiang wo hui ji xu nu li 。]

english: Just come back and let me know when you get tired!
translation: 当你累了的时候回来告诉我！ [dang ni lei le de shi hou hui lai gao su wo ！]

english: I'll try again another time.
translation: 我下次再试一次。 [wo xia ci zai shi yi ci 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Could I have a go with your bird?
translation: 我可以和你的鸟一起玩吗？ [wo ke yi he ni de niao yi qi wan ma ？]

english: I don't think that's for me.
translation: 我不认为那适合我。 [wo bu ren wei na shi he wo 。]

english: What's in the sack?
translation: 麻袋里有什么？ [ma dai li you shen me ？]

english: Let's take a look.
translation: 我们来看一下。 [wo men lai kan yi xia 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: I found this big fish...
translation: 我发现了这条大鱼... [wo fa xian le zhe tiao da yu ...]

english: It's a deal.
translation: 这是一笔交易。 [zhe shi yi bi jiao yi 。]

english: No, keep the tench.
translation: 不，保留丁鳅。 [bu ， bao liu ding qiu 。]

english: Yes, exchange the golden tench.
translation: 是的，交换金丁鱼。 [shi de ， jiao huan jin ding yu 。]

english: Not yet. I think I'll keep trying.
translation: 还没有。我想我会继续努力。 [hai mei you 。 wo xiang wo hui ji xu nu li 。]

english: Yeah, I'll try again another time.
translation: 是的，我下次再试一次。 [shi de ， wo xia ci zai shi yi ci 。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: He seems to be in deep concentration.
translation: 他似乎全神贯注。 [ta si hu quan shen guan zhu 。]

english: ...I'll leave you to it.
translation: ……我就交给你了。 […… wo jiu jiao gei ni le 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Well hello there. Are you hungry? If so you've come to the right place. Eat green, eat gnome cuisine. My waiter will be glad to take your order.
translation: 嗯，你好。你饿了吗？如果是这样，您就来对地方了。吃绿色，吃侏儒美食。我的服务员会很高兴接受您的订单。 [n ， ni hao 。 ni e le ma ？ ru guo shi zhe yang ， nin jiu lai dui di fang le 。 chi lv se ， chi zhu ru mei shi 。 wo de fu wu yuan hui hen gao xing jie shou nin de ding dan 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: On the other hand, if you're looking for some gnome cooking training, this is also the place to be. My son Lufty is looking for staff at the moment.
translation: 另一方面，如果您正在寻找一些侏儒烹饪培训，这里也是您该去的地方。我的儿子 Lufty 目前正在寻找员工。 [ling yi fang mian ， ru guo nin zheng zai xun zhao yi xie zhu ru peng ren pei xun ， zhe li ye shi nin gai qu de di fang 。 wo de er zi  Lufty  mu qian zheng zai xun zhao yuan gong 。]

english: No thank, I'm no cook.
translation: 不，谢谢，我不是厨师。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo bu shi chu shi 。]

english: In that case, please eat and enjoy.
translation: 在这种情况下，请尽情享用吧。 [zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， qing jin qing xiang yong ba 。]

english: Ok, I'll give it a go.
translation: 好的，我会尝试一下。 [hao de ， wo hui chang shi yi xia 。]

english: Well that's great. I'm Aluft Gianne, owner of this restaurant, and you are...?
translation: 嗯，那太好了。我是 Aluft Gianne，这家餐厅的老板，而你是……？ [n ， na tai hao le 。 wo shi  Aluft Gianne， zhe jia can ting de lao ban ， er ni shi ……？]

english: Most people call me [player name].
translation: 大多数人都叫我[玩家名字]。 [da duo shu ren dou jiao wo [ wan jia ming zi ]。]

english: Really? Sorry, how rude of me. It just takes a little while to get used to the funny names you humans have.
translation: 真的吗？抱歉，我太无礼了。只需要一点时间就能习惯人类所拥有的有趣的名字。 [zhen de ma ？ bao qian ， wo tai wu li le 。 zhi xu yao yi dian shi jian jiu neng xi guan ren lei suo yong you de you qu de ming zi 。]

english: Of course if you're going to work for me I'll have to see what you're like first. Here, take a look at our menu.
translation: 当然，如果你要为我工作，我得先看看你是什么样的人。在这里，看看我们的菜单。 [dang ran ， ru guo ni yao wei wo gong zuo ， wo de xian kan kan ni shi shen me yang de ren 。 zai zhe li ， kan kan wo men de cai dan 。]

english: Aluft hands you a cook book.
translation: 阿鲁夫特递给你一本烹饪书。 [a lu fu te di gei ni yi ben peng ren shu 。]

english: When you've had a look at the book, come back here and I'll let you prepare a few dishes.
translation: 你看完书就回来，我让你准备几道菜。 [ni kan wan shu jiu hui lai ， wo rang ni zhun bei ji dao cai 。]

english: Ok then.
translation: 好吧。 [hao ba 。]

english: Hi Mr. Gianne.
translation: 你好，吉安娜先生。 [ni hao ， ji an na xian sheng 。]

english: Hello [player name]. So what did you think of the book?
translation: 你好[玩家姓名]。那么你觉得这本书怎么样？ [ni hao [ wan jia xing ming ]。 na me ni jue de zhe ben shu zen me yang ？]

english: I'm not too sure about toad's legs.
translation: 我不太确定蟾蜍的腿。 [wo bu tai que ding chan chu de tui 。]

english: They're a gnome delicacy, very tasty. Chicken tastes like toad's legs you know. You'll love them. If I give you what you need, can you make me some Toad Crunchies?
translation: 它们是侏儒的美味佳肴，非常美味。你知道，鸡肉尝起来像蟾蜍腿。你会喜欢他们的。如果我给你你需要的东西，你能给我做一些蟾蜍脆饼吗？ [ta men shi zhu ru de mei wei jia yao ， fei chang mei wei 。 ni zhi dao ， ji rou chang qi lai xiang chan chu tui 。 ni hui xi huan ta men de 。 ru guo wo gei ni ni xu yao de dong xi ， ni neng gei wo zuo yi xie chan chu cui bing ma ？]

english: I'll give it a go.
translation: 我会尝试一下。 [wo hui chang shi yi xia 。]

english: Aluft gives you two pairs of toad's legs, some gnome spice, some equa leaves, some dough and a crunchy tray.
