translation: Aluft 会给你两对蟾蜍腿、一些侏儒香料、一些水草叶、一些面团和一个松脆的托盘。 [Aluft  hui gei ni liang dui chan chu tui 、 yi xie zhu ru xiang liao 、 yi xie shui cao ye 、 yi xie mian tuan he yi ge song cui de tuo pan 。]

english: The dough is made according to a secret family recipe. If you need any more, I suggest you speak to Hudo the grocer. He's very reliable.
translation: 面团是根据家庭秘密配方制作的。如果您需要更多，我建议您与杂货商 Hudo 联系。他非常可靠。 [mian tuan shi gen ju jia ting mi mi pei fang zhi zuo de 。 ru guo nin xu yao geng duo ， wo jian yi nin yu za huo shang  Hudo  lian xi 。 ta fei chang ke kao 。]

english: Let me know how you get on.
translation: 让我知道你过得怎么样。 [rang wo zhi dao ni guo de zen me yang 。]

english: Hi Mr Gianne.
translation: 嗨吉安娜先生。 [hai ji an na xian sheng 。]

english: So how did you get on with the toad crunchies?
translation: 那么你对蟾蜍脆饼的态度如何呢？ [na me ni dui chan chu cui bing de tai du ru he ne ？]

english: I think I've got one.
translation: 我想我有一个。 [wo xiang wo you yi ge 。]

english: That looks identical to the crunchies I cooked not five minutes ago. You'll have to prove to me that you can make one yourself if you want my recommendation.
translation: 这看起来和我五分钟前做的脆饼一模一样。如果您想要我的推荐，您必须向我证明您可以自己制作一个。 [zhe kan qi lai he wo wu fen zhong qian zuo de cui bing yi mu yi yang 。 ru guo nin xiang yao wo de tui jian ， nin bi xu xiang wo zheng ming nin ke yi zi ji zhi zuo yi ge 。]

english: Erm, I've not quite finished it yet.
translation: 嗯，我还没完全完成。 [n ， wo hai mei wan quan wan cheng 。]

english: Ok, let me know when you have.
translation: 好的，有的话请告诉我。 [hao de ， you de hua qing gao su wo 。]

english: I'm afraid I've lost the crunchie tray you gave to me.
translation: 恐怕我把你给我的脆饼盘弄丢了。 [kong pa wo ba ni gei wo de cui bing pan nong diu le 。]

english: Ok, I'll give you another one. Obviously I can't expect you to cook without the proper utensils.
translation: 好的，我再给你一份。显然，我不能指望你在没有合适的器具的情况下做饭。 [hao de ， wo zai gei ni yi fen 。 xian ran ， wo bu neng zhi wang ni zai mei you he shi de qi ju de qing kuang xia zuo fan 。]

english: I've not finished yet.
translation: 我还没说完。 [wo hai mei shuo wan 。]

english: Ok, well let me know when you're done.
translation: 好的，完成后请告诉我。 [hao de ， wan cheng hou qing gao su wo 。]

english: Call me Aluft. So how did you get on with the toad crunchies?
translation: 叫我阿鲁夫特吧。那么你对蟾蜍脆饼的态度如何呢？ [jiao wo a lu fu te ba 。 na me ni dui chan chu cui bing de tai du ru he ne ？]

english: No problem, it was easy.
translation: 没问题，这很容易。 [mei wen ti ， zhe hen rong yi 。]

english: You give Aluft the toad crunchies. He takes a bite...
translation: 你给阿鲁夫特吃蟾蜍脆饼。他咬了一口…… [ni gei a lu fu te chi chan chu cui bing 。 ta yao le yi kou ……]

english: Not bad, not bad at all.
translation: 不错，一点也不差。 [bu cuo ， yi dian ye bu cha 。]

english: Ok, now for something you might prefer. Try making some chocolate chip crunchies for me. They're my favourite. Here's everything you need. You can re-use the spice from the last recipe - one tin goes a long way.
translation: 好的，现在来说说你可能更喜欢的东西。尝试为我做一些巧克力脆片。他们是我最喜欢的。这里有您需要的一切。您可以重复使用上一个食谱中的香料——一罐就可以用很长时间。 [hao de ， xian zai lai shuo shuo ni ke neng geng xi huan de dong xi 。 chang shi wei wo zuo yi xie qiao ke li cui pian 。 ta men shi wo zui xi huan de 。 zhe li you nin xu yao de yi qie 。 nin ke yi chong fu shi yong shang yi ge shi pu zhong de xiang liao —— yi guan jiu ke yi yong hen zhang shi jian 。]

english: Aluft gives you two bars of chocolate, some chocolate dust, and some dough.
translation: Aluft 给你两块巧克力、一些巧克力粉和一些面团。 [Aluft  gei ni liang kuai qiao ke li 、 yi xie qiao ke li fen he yi xie mian tuan 。]

english: Ok Aluft, I'll be back soon.
translation: 好的，阿鲁夫特，我很快就会回来。 [hao de ， a lu fu te ， wo hen kuai jiu hui hui lai 。]

english: Hello Aluft.
translation: 你好，阿鲁夫特。 [ni hao ， a lu fu te 。]

english: Hello there, how did you get on.
translation: 你好，请问你过得怎么样。 [ni hao ， qing wen ni guo de zen me yang 。]

english: I haven't made it yet.
translation: 我还没做到。 [wo hai mei zuo dao 。]

english: It's one trayful of chocolate chip crunchies that I need. Just follow the instructions carefully.
translation: 这是我需要的一盘巧克力脆片。只需仔细按照说明进行操作即可。 [zhe shi wo xu yao de yi pan qiao ke li cui pian 。 zhi xu zi xi an zhao shuo ming jin xing cao zuo ji ke 。]

english: Here you go.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: You give Aluft the chocolate crunchies. He takes a bite...
translation: 你给阿鲁夫特巧克力脆饼。他咬了一口…… [ni gei a lu fu te qiao ke li cui bing 。 ta yao le yi kou ……]

english: Yes, yes, yes, that's superb. I'm really impressed.
translation: 是啊是啊，太棒了。我真的很感动。 [shi a shi a ， tai bang le 。 wo zhen de hen gan dong 。]

english: Ok then, can you make me a toad batta?  Here's what you need.
translation: 好吧，你能给我做一份蟾蜍巴塔吗？  这就是您所需要的。 [hao ba ， ni neng gei wo zuo yi fen chan chu ba ta ma ？   zhe jiu shi nin suo xu yao de 。]

english: Aluft gives you some cheese, some dough, some equa leaves, a pair of toad's legs and some more gnome spice.
translation: 阿鲁夫特会给你一些奶酪、一些面团、一些等叶、一对蟾蜍腿和一些侏儒香料。 [a lu fu te hui gei ni yi xie nai lao 、 yi xie mian tuan 、 yi xie deng ye 、 yi dui chan chu tui he yi xie zhu ru xiang liao 。]

english: Let me know when the batta is ready.
translation: 巴塔准备好后请告诉我。 [ba ta zhun bei hao hou qing gao su wo 。]

english: Aluft.
translation: 阿鲁夫特。 [a lu fu te 。]

english: Sorry, Aluft.
translation: 对不起，阿鲁夫特。 [dui bu qi ， a lu fu te 。]

english: So where's my toad batta?
translation: 那么我的蟾蜍巴塔在哪里？ [na me wo de chan chu ba ta zai na li ？]

english: That looks identical to the toad batta I cooked not five minutes ago. You'll have to prove to me that you can make one yourself if you want my recommendation.
translation: 这看起来和我五分钟前煮的蟾蜍巴塔一模一样。如果您想要我的推荐，您必须向我证明您可以自己制作一个。 [zhe kan qi lai he wo wu fen zhong qian zhu de chan chu ba ta yi mu yi yang 。 ru guo nin xiang yao wo de tui jian ， nin bi xu xiang wo zheng ming nin ke yi zi ji zhi zuo yi ge 。]

english: I'm afraid I've lost the batta tin you gave to me.
translation: 恐怕我把你给我的巴塔罐弄丢了。 [kong pa wo ba ni gei wo de ba ta guan nong diu le 。]

english: I'm afraid I've lost the batta tin you gave to me.
translation: 恐怕我把你给我的巴塔罐弄丢了。 [kong pa wo ba ni gei wo de ba ta guan nong diu le 。]

english: Ok, be as quick as you can.
translation: 好的，尽可能快。 [hao de ， jin ke neng kuai 。]

english: Here you go, that was no problem.
translation: 给你，这没问题。 [gei ni ， zhe mei wen ti 。]

english: You give Aluft the toad batta. He takes a bite...
translation: 你给阿鲁夫特蟾蜍巴塔。他咬了一口…… [ni gei a lu fu te chan chu ba ta 。 ta yao le yi kou ……]

english: Ooh, that's some good toad. Very nice.
translation: 哦，那是一只好蟾蜍。很不错。 [o ， na shi yi zhi hao chan chu 。 hen bu cuo 。]

english: Let's see if you can make a cheese and tomato batta next.
translation: 接下来让我们看看你是否可以制作奶酪和番茄巴塔。 [jie xia lai rang wo men kan kan ni shi fou ke yi zhi zuo nai lao he fan qie ba ta 。]

english: Hello again Aluft.

translation: 如您所知，技能披风仅适用于技能大师。我一生都在建造房子，现在我把时间花在卖房子上！作为我能力的标志，我穿着这件建筑技能斗篷。 [ru nin suo zhi ， ji neng pi feng jin shi yong yu ji neng da shi 。 wo yi sheng dou zai jian zao fang zi ， xian zai wo ba shi jian hua zai mai fang zi shang ！ zuo wei wo neng li de biao zhi ， wo chuan zhe zhe jian jian zhu ji neng dou peng 。]

english: If you ever have enough skill to build a demonic throne, come and talk to me and I'll sell you a skillcape like mine.
translation: 如果你有足够的技能来建造恶魔王座，来跟我说话，我会卖给你一个像我一样的技能斗篷。 [ru guo ni you zu gou de ji neng lai jian zao e mo wang zuo ， lai gen wo shuo hua ， wo hui mai gei ni yi ge xiang wo yi yang de ji neng dou peng 。]

english: The Cape of Construction also provides you with as many teleports as you like to any of the house portals or even directly inside!
translation: 施工角还为您提供任意数量的传送到任何房屋门户，甚至直接进入内部！ [shi gong jiao hai wei nin ti gong ren yi shu liang de chuan song dao ren he fang wu men hu ， shen zhi zhi jie jin ru nei bu ！]

english: Can you sell me a Skillcape of Construction?
translation: 你能卖给我一个建筑技能吗？ [ni neng mai gei wo yi ge jian zhu ji neng ma ？]

english: Alright, that'll be 99000 coins, please. A small price to pay for such an illustrious cape that can teleport you to any of the house portals or even directly inside your house!
translation: 好的，那就是 99000 金币。花很少的钱就能买到这样一件著名的斗篷，它可以将你传送到任何房子的传送门，甚至直接传送到你的房子里！ [hao de ， na jiu shi  99000  jin bi 。 hua hen shao de qian jiu neng mai dao zhe yang yi jian zhu ming de dou peng ， ta ke yi jiang ni chuan song dao ren he fang zi de chuan song men ， shen zhi zhi jie chuan song dao ni de fang zi li ！]

english: I'm not paying that!
translation: 我不付那个钱！ [wo bu fu na ge qian ！]

english: Suit yourself. There are many other heroes who would love the opportunity to purchase one. You can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: 适合自己。还有许多其他英雄希望有机会购买一个。如果你改变主意，可以在这里找到我。 [shi he zi ji 。 hai you xu duo qi ta ying xiong xi wang you ji hui gou mai yi ge 。 ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， ke yi zai zhe li zhao dao wo 。]

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 但不幸的是，我身上没有足够的钱。 [dan bu xing de shi ， wo shen shang mei you zu gou de qian 。]

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 好吧，等你回来了就回来见我吧。 [hao ba ， deng ni hui lai le jiu hui lai jian wo ba 。]

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 不幸的是，所有技能斗篷都只提供免费兜帽，这是技能升级交易的一部分；买一送一，你懂的。因此，在我向您出售一件之前，您需要释放一些库存空间。 [bu xing de shi ， suo you ji neng dou peng dou zhi ti gong mian fei dou mao ， zhe shi ji neng sheng ji jiao yi de yi bu fen ； mai yi song yi ， ni dong de 。 yin ci ， zai wo xiang nin chu shou yi jian zhi qian ， nin xu yao shi fang yi xie ku cun kong jian 。]

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: 出色的！我的朋友，自豪地穿上那件斗篷。 [chu se de ！ wo de peng you ， zi hao di chuan shang na jian dou peng 。]

english: Can you move my house please?
translation: 请问你可以搬我的房子吗？ [qing wen ni ke yi ban wo de fang zi ma ？]

english: Rimmington
translation: 里明顿 [li ming dun]

english: Taverley
translation: 塔弗利 [ta fu li]

english: Pollnivneach
translation: 波尼夫内奇 [bo ni fu nei qi]

english: Hosidius
translation: 霍西迪乌斯 [huo xi di wu si]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Rellekka
translation: 雷莱卡 [lei lai ka]

english: Brimhaven
translation: 布里姆港 [bu li mu gang]

english: Yanille
translation: 亚尼尔 [ya ni er]

english: Prifddinas
translation: 普里夫迪纳斯 [pu li fu di na si]

english: Can you redecorate my house please?
translation: 请问你能重新装修一下我的房子吗？ [qing wen ni neng chong xin zhuang xiu yi xia wo de fang zi ma ？]

english: Basic stone
translation: 基石 [ji shi]

english: Whitewashed stone
translation: 粉刷过的石头 [fen shua guo de shi tou]

english: Fremennik-style wood
translation: 弗里曼尼克风格的木材 [fu li man ni ke feng ge de mu cai]

english: Tropical wood
translation: 热带木材 [re dai mu cai]

english: Fancy stone
translation: 花式石 [hua shi shi]

english: Deathly mansion
translation: 死亡大厦 [si wang da sha]

english: Twisted theme
translation: 扭曲的主题 [niu qu de zhu ti]

english: Hosidius house
translation: 霍西迪乌斯之家 [huo xi di wu si zhi jia]

english: Cosy cabin
translation: 舒适的小屋 [shu shi de xiao wu]

english: Cancel
translation: 取消 [qu xiao]

english: Could I have a Construction guide book?
translation: 能给我一本建筑指南吗？ [neng gei wo yi ben jian zhu zhi nan ma ？]

english: Tell me about houses!
translation: 说说房子吧！ [shuo shuo fang zi ba ！]

english: Tell me about that skillcape you're wearing.
translation: 告诉我你穿的那件技能斗篷。 [gao su wo ni chuan de na jian ji neng dou peng 。]

english: Can you sell me a Skillcape of Construction?
translation: 你能卖给我一个建筑技能吗？ [ni neng mai gei wo yi ge jian zhu ji neng ma ？]

english: I'm not paying that!
translation: 我不付那个钱！ [wo bu fu na ge qian ！]

english: Certainly, that sounds fair.
translation: 当然，这听起来很公平。 [dang ran ， zhe ting qi lai hen gong ping 。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Hello, if you've something important to tell me, be out with it! I'm a busy woman.
translation: 你好，如果你有重要的事情要告诉我，请说出来！我是一个忙碌的女人。 [ni hao ， ru guo ni you zhong yao de shi qing yao gao su wo ， qing shuo chu lai ！ wo shi yi ge mang lu de nv ren 。]

english: Just making small talk.
translation: 只是闲聊而已。 [zhi shi xian liao er yi 。]

english: How very nice of you. However, I'm sure there are less busy people who'd love to chat.
translation: 你真是太好了。然而，我确信有一些不太忙的人愿意聊天。 [ni zhen shi tai hao le 。 ran er ， wo que xin you yi xie bu tai mang de ren yuan yi liao tian 。]

english: Oh, okay.
translation: 哦好的。 [o hao de 。]

english: Chin up love and go adventure, that's what you lot do right?
translation: 勇敢去爱，去冒险，这就是你们所做的，对吗？ [yong gan qu ai ， qu mao xian ， zhe jiu shi ni men suo zuo de ， dui ma ？]

english: I suppose we do, bye!
translation: 我想我们会的，再见！ [wo xiang wo men hui de ， zai jian ！]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm Alyssa the housekeeper and this castle needs constant attention! I've enough trouble with the guards messing up my carpets without you adding to the problem.
translation: 我是管家艾莉莎，这座城堡需要持续关注！警卫弄乱我的地毯我已经受够了麻烦了，你别再增加问题了。 [wo shi guan jia ai li sha ， zhe zuo cheng bao xu yao chi xu guan zhu ！ jing wei nong luan wo de di tan wo yi jing shou gou le ma fan le ， ni bie zai zeng jia wen ti le 。]

english: Hmm, yeah sorry about that. Speaking of carpets, ever thought how strange that there are carpets beneath the stairs?
translation: 嗯，是的，对此感到抱歉。说到地毯，有没有想过楼梯下面铺着地毯有多奇怪？ [n ， shi de ， dui ci gan dao bao qian 。 shuo dao di tan ， you mei you xiang guo lou ti xia mian pu zhe di tan you duo qi guai ？]

english: It's cut to fit! If I had a gold piece for everytime I was asked that question!
translation: 已经剪得合身了！如果每次有人问我这个问题我都能得到一块金币就好了！ [yi jing jian de he shen le ！ ru guo mei ci you ren wen wo zhe ge wen ti wo dou neng de dao yi kuai jin bi jiu hao le ！]

english: Sure... Cut to fit... Not an oversight at all.
translation: 当然...剪裁合适...根本不是疏忽。 [dang ran ... jian cai he shi ... gen ben bu shi shu hu 。]

english: Alright, believe what you like. I've a castle to clean.
translation: 好吧，相信你喜欢的。我有一座城堡需要清理。 [hao ba ， xiang xin ni xi huan de 。 wo you yi zuo cheng bao xu yao qing li 。]

english: Bye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Are you the Alyssa this entry mentions?
translation: 您是这篇文章中提到的艾莉莎吗？ [nin shi zhe pian wen zhang zhong ti dao de ai li sha ma ？]

english: You show her 'A Dark Disposition'.
translation: 你向她展示了“黑暗性格”。 [ni xiang ta zhan shi le “ hei an xing ge ”。]

english: Ah, I suppose I am.
translation: 啊，我想我是。 [a ， wo xiang wo shi 。]

english: Got anything to say about it?
translation: 对此有什么要说的吗？ [dui ci you shen me yao shuo de ma ？]

english: Why should I tell you anything? There are private matters of a late royal family! It wouldn't be proper to divulge such information to an adventurer like you.
translation: 我为什么要告诉你什么？有已故皇室的私事！向你这样的冒险者透露这样的情报是不合适的。 [wo wei shen me yao gao su ni shen me ？ you yi gu huang shi de si shi ！ xiang ni zhe yang de mao xian zhe tou lu zhe yang de qing bao shi bu he shi de 。]

english: ...Most people don't know when to stop sharing. I guess you have a point though.
translation: ...大多数人不知道何时停止分享。我想你说得有道理。 [... da duo shu ren bu zhi dao he shi ting zhi fen xiang 。 wo xiang ni shuo de you dao li 。]

english: Yes, I do indeed. Off with you, I've had my fair share of nosy adventurers for one day.
translation: 是的，我确实这样做。离开你吧，我这一天也遇到了很多爱管闲事的冒险家。 [shi de ， wo que shi zhe yang zuo 。 li kai ni ba ， wo zhe yi tian ye yu dao le hen duo ai guan xian shi de mao xian jia 。]

english: Alright, sorry for disturbing you. Bye.
translation: 好的，抱歉打扰您了。再见。 [hao de ， bao qian da rao nin le 。 zai jian 。]

english: Bye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: ...Most people don't know when to stop sharing. It's probably worth mentioning that I've found all entries of this memoir.
translation: ...大多数人不知道何时停止分享。也许值得一提的是，我已经找到了这本回忆录的所有条目。 [... da duo shu ren bu zhi dao he shi ting zhi fen xiang 。 ye xu zhi de yi ti de shi ， wo yi jing zhao dao le zhe ben hui yi lu de suo you tiao mu 。]

english: Yes, how did you come across this? I'm fairly certain it was destroyed... At least, I recall seeing a man removing the pages...
translation: 是的，你是怎么发现这个的？我相当肯定它被毁了……至少，我记得看到一个人把书页拿走…… [shi de ， ni shi zen me fa xian zhe ge de ？ wo xiang dang ken ding ta bei hui le …… zhi shao ， wo ji de kan dao yi ge ren ba shu ye na zou ……]

english: Honestly, I've never really questioned it. I do things for people and they give me things.
translation: 老实说，我从来没有真正质疑过它。我为人们做事，他们也给我东西。 [lao shi shuo ， wo cong lai mei you zhen zheng zhi yi guo ta 。 wo wei ren men zuo shi ， ta men ye gei wo dong xi 。]

english: Well, I suppose if you've already nosily rifled through the princesses personal memoirs, I can tell you a little more.
translation: 好吧，我想如果您已经翻阅了公主的个人回忆录，我可以告诉您更多信息。 [hao ba ， wo xiang ru guo nin yi jing fan yue le gong zhu de ge ren hui yi lu ， wo ke yi gao su nin geng duo xin xi 。]

english: Fantastic! I've got to say, there's some great little gems in this old book. I think I'm unravelling a great mystery!
translation: 极好的！我不得不说，这本旧书中有一些很棒的小宝石。我想我正在解开一个巨大的谜团！ [ji hao de ！ wo bu de bu shuo ， zhe ben jiu shu zhong you yi xie hen bang de xiao bao shi 。 wo xiang wo zheng zai jie kai yi ge ju da de mi tuan ！]

english: Well, if I were you I'd keep shush on the whole matter.
translation: 好吧，如果我是你，我就会对整件事保持沉默。 [hao ba ， ru guo wo shi ni ， wo jiu hui dui zheng jian shi bao chi chen mo 。]

english: How come?
translation: 怎么会？ [zen me hui ？]

english: You must be new here. When the king died, everyone assumed the princess would take the throne when she came of age.
translation: 你一定是新来的。国王去世后，每个人都认为公主成年后会继承王位。 [ni yi ding shi xin lai de 。 guo wang qu shi hou ， mei ge ren dou ren wei gong zhu cheng nian hou hui ji cheng wang wei 。]

english: But the council kept control...
translation: 但议会仍然控制着...... [dan yi hui reng ran kong zhi zhe ......]

english: Indeed, and poor young Rose was shipped off and labelled as crazy.
translation: 确实，可怜的年轻罗斯被送走了，并被贴上了疯子的标签。 [que shi ， ke lian de nian qing luo si bei song zou le ， bing bei tie shang le feng zi de biao qian 。]

english: I do very much miss her, but one can't change the past.
translation: 我确实很想念她，但过去的事无法改变。 [wo que shi hen xiang nian ta ， dan guo qu de shi wu fa gai bian 。]

english: What if I were to say she's still out there! Read this entry that I found hidden within a secret part of the memoir.
translation: 如果我说她还在外面呢！阅读我发现隐藏在回忆录秘密部分中的这篇文章。 [ru guo wo shuo ta hai zai wai mian ne ！ yue du wo fa xian yin cang zai hui yi lu mi mi bu fen zhong de zhe pian wen zhang 。]

english: I'm sorry adventurer, but what does this prove exactly? For all you know someone else wrote this to mislead you.
translation: 对不起冒险家，但这到底证明了什么？据您所知，其他人写这篇文章是为了误导您。 [dui bu qi mao xian jia ， dan zhe dao di zheng ming liao shen me ？ ju nin suo zhi ， qi ta ren xie zhe pian wen zhang shi wei le wu dao nin 。]

english: Ah, you do make a good point...
translation: 啊，你说的确实很好…… [a ， ni shuo di que shi hen hao ……]

english: If she did write this I'm afraid to say she must be mad after all.
translation: 如果她真的写了这篇文章，我想说她一定是生气了。 [ru guo ta zhen de xie le zhe pian wen zhang ， wo xiang shuo ta yi ding shi sheng qi le 。]

english: What makes you say that?
translation: 是什么让你这么说？ [shi shen me rang ni zhe me shuo ？]

english: Are all adventurers as dense as you? If you were in danger, do you really think leaving a hidden message in an old lost book for any stranger to pick up is the best way to get help?
translation: 冒险者都和你一样笨吗？如果您遇到危险，您真的认为在一本丢失的旧书中留下隐藏的信息以供任何陌生人捡起是获得帮助的最佳方式吗？ [mao xian zhe dou he ni yi yang ben ma ？ ru guo nin yu dao wei xian ， nin zhen de ren wei zai yi ben diu shi de jiu shu zhong liu xia yin cang de xin xi yi gong ren he mo sheng ren jian qi shi huo de bang zhu de zui jia fang shi ma ？]

english: It's certainly peculiar, but it should be investigated regardless. Y'know, just in case...
translation: 这当然很奇怪，但无论如何都应该进行调查。你知道，以防万一... [zhe dang ran hen qi guai ， dan wu lun ru he dou ying gai jin xing diao cha 。 ni zhi dao ， yi fang wan yi ...]

english: Alright, spring the trap! Don't come crying to me when it all turns sour.
translation: 好吧，启动陷阱！当一切变得糟糕时，不要来找我哭泣。 [hao ba ， qi dong xian jing ！ dang yi qie bian de zao gao shi ， bu yao lai zhao wo ku qi 。]

english: Don't you worry! I'm a brave adventurer with a damsel in distress to rescue! This is my bread and butter.
translation: 别担心！我是一个勇敢的冒险家，要拯救一位落难的少女！这是我的面包和黄油。 [bie dan xin ！ wo shi yi ge yong gan de mao xian jia ， yao zheng jiu yi wei luo nan de shao nv ！ zhe shi wo de mian bao he huang you 。]

english: Yes, yes, of course. Well, I'd be glad to hear of her being safe but perhaps you should heed the warning.
translation: 是的，是的，当然。好吧，我很高兴听到她安全了，但也许你应该注意这个警告。 [shi de ， shi de ， dang ran 。 hao ba ， wo hen gao xing ting dao ta an quan le ， dan ye xu ni ying gai zhu yi zhe ge jing gao 。]

english: Which warning?
translation: 哪个警告？ [na ge jing gao ？]

english: Tread carefully.
translation: 小心行事。 [xiao xin xing shi 。]

english: Oh, of course! Thanks for chatting with me Alyssa, I'll see you around.
translation: 哦，当然！感谢您与我聊天，Alyssa，我们再见。 [o ， dang ran ！ gan xie nin yu wo liao tian ，Alyssa， wo men zai jian 。]

english: Farewell.
translation: 告别。 [gao bie 。]

english: I'm sorry, but I'm not paid to serve every lazy adventurer who walks their dirty feet through my halls!
translation: 抱歉，我没有报酬为每一个用肮脏的脚走过我的大厅的懒惰冒险家提供服务！ [bao qian ， wo mei you bao chou wei mei yi ge yong ang zang de jiao zou guo wo de da ting de lan duo mao xian jia ti gong fu wu ！]

english: Sorry, I'll be going.
translation: 抱歉，我这就去。 [bao qian ， wo zhe jiu qu 。]

english: Just making small talk.
translation: 只是闲聊而已。 [zhi shi xian liao er yi 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: You! I should have known this would be your doing!
translation: 你！我早该知道这是你干的！ [ni ！ wo zao gai zhi dao zhe shi ni gan de ！]

english: It's over, Amascut! Your plan has failed.
translation: 结束了，阿马斯卡特！你的计划失败了。 [jie shu le ， a ma si ka te ！ ni de ji hua shi bai le 。]

english: My plan has only just begun! Even with this setback, those pathetic fragments of my father have still given me ample power. My strength is absolute!
translation: 我的计划才刚刚开始！即使经历了这样的挫折，父亲那些可怜的片段仍然给了我充足的力量。我的实力是绝对的！ [wo de ji hua cai gang gang kai shi ！ ji shi jing li le zhe yang de cuo zhe ， fu qin na xie ke lian de pian duan reng ran gei le wo chong zu de li liang 。 wo de shi li shi jue dui de ！]

english: Maybe, but it doesn't matter. I've stopped every one of your schemes so far, and I'll stop the next one as well.
translation: 也许吧，但这并不重要。到目前为止我已经阻止了你的每一项计划，我也会阻止下一项计划。 [ye xu ba ， dan zhe bing bu zhong yao 。 dao mu qian wei zhi wo yi jing zu zhi le ni de mei yi xiang ji hua ， wo ye hui zu zhi xia yi xiang ji hua 。]

english: Really? You think you're leaving this place alive? I can promise you that won't be the case! My father's weapons have given me his power, and now they'll finally rid me of you!
translation: 真的吗？你认为你能活着离开这个地方吗？我可以向你保证，情况不会如此！我父亲的武器赋予了我他的力量，现在他们终于要让我摆脱你了！ [zhen de ma ？ ni ren wei ni neng huo zhe li kai zhe ge di fang ma ？ wo ke yi xiang ni bao zheng ， qing kuang bu hui ru ci ！ wo fu qin de wu qi fu yu le wo ta de li liang ， xian zai ta men zhong yu yao rang wo bai tuo ni le ！]

english: Amascut activates the obelisk and teleports away.
translation: 阿马斯卡特激活方尖碑并传送走。 [a ma si ka te ji huo fang jian bei bing chuan song zou 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Headman Ur-tag, I cannot stress enough how important it is that this train link be completed on time. The mining companies have taken out considerable loans...
translation: 校长乌尔塔格，我无法充分强调按时完成这条火车线路的重要性。矿业公司已经获得了大量贷款...... [xiao zhang wu er ta ge ， wo wu fa chong fen qiang diao an shi wan cheng zhe tiao huo che xian lu de zhong yao xing 。 kuang ye gong si yi jing huo de le da liang dai kuan ......]

english: I understand your concerns, Ambassador, but you must realise that the discoveries must change the whole schedule. To remove them too hurriedly would be a crime against knowledge.
translation: 大使，我理解您的担忧，但您必须意识到这些发现必须改变整个日程。太仓促地消除它们将是对知识的犯罪。 [da shi ， wo li jie nin de dan you ， dan nin bi xu yi shi dao zhe xie fa xian bi xu gai bian zheng ge ri cheng 。 tai cang cu di xiao chu ta men jiang shi dui zhi shi de fan zui 。]

english: What are you talking about?
translation: 你在说什么？ [ni zai shuo shen me ？]

english: It's the new underground train link being built between our city and the dwarven city of Keldagrim.
translation: 这是我们城市和矮人城市凯尔达格林之间正在修建的新地铁线路。 [zhe shi wo men cheng shi he ai ren cheng shi kai er da ge lin zhi jian zheng zai xiu jian de xin di tie xian lu 。]

english: It will be the pinnacle of dwarven engineering! A great leap forward from the old steam-powered minecarts! A monument to the power and ingenuity of the Consortium!
translation: 这将是矮人工程学的顶峰！与老式蒸汽动力矿车相比，这是一个巨大的飞跃！联盟力量和智慧的纪念碑！ [zhe jiang shi ai ren gong cheng xue de ding feng ！ yu lao shi zheng qi dong li kuang che xiang bi ， zhe shi yi ge ju da de fei yue ！ lian meng li liang he zhi hui de ji nian bei ！]

english: And it would be finished by now, except that they found some old goblin bones they want to dig up.
translation: 现在应该已经完成​​了，只是他们发现了一些他们想要挖掘的旧妖精骨头。 [xian zai ying gai yi jing wan cheng ​​ le ， zhi shi ta men fa xian le yi xie ta men xiang yao wa jue de jiu yao jing gu tou 。]

english: We've unearthed some very important artefacts that were buried during the Dorgeshuun Civil War. They could shed important light on our history.
translation: 我们发掘了多尔格舒恩内战期间埋藏的一些非常重要的文物。它们可以为我们的历史提供重要的启示。 [wo men fa jue le duo er ge shu en nei zhan qi jian mai cang de yi xie fei chang zhong yao de wen wu 。 ta men ke yi wei wo men de li shi ti gong zhong yao de qi shi 。]

english: [player name], do you have any experience with archaeology?
translation: [玩家姓名]，你有考古经验吗？ [[ wan jia xing ming ]， ni you kao gu jing yan ma ？]

english: I passed my archaeology exam at the Digsite!
translation: 我通过了挖掘场的考古学考试！ [wo tong guo le wa jue chang de kao gu xue kao shi ！]

english: Excellent! We have not had a major archaeological project for generations, so if you could give us some help we would appreciate it.
translation: 出色的！我们几代人都没有进行过重大的考古项目，所以如果您能给我们一些帮助，我们将不胜感激。 [chu se de ！ wo men ji dai ren dou mei you jin xing guo zhong da de kao gu xiang mu ， suo yi ru guo nin neng gei wo men yi xie bang zhu ， wo men jiang bu sheng gan ji 。]

english: I'd love to help!
translation: 我很乐意帮忙！ [wo hen le yi bang mang ！]

english: Splendid! The path to the train tunnel is in the south- west of the city.
translation: 灿烂！通往火车隧道的道路位于城市的西南部。 [can lan ！ tong wang huo che sui dao de dao lu wei yu cheng shi de xi nan bu 。]

english: Perhaps now we can get this finished quickly and get on with laying the tracks.
translation: 也许现在我们可以快速完成这件事并继续铺设铁轨。 [ye xu xian zai wo men ke yi kuai su wan cheng zhe jian shi bing ji xu pu she tie gui 。]

english: Do your own digging!
translation: 自己挖吧！ [zi ji wa ba ！]

english: Oh well. We will continue at our own pace.
translation: 那好吧。我们将继续按照自己的节奏进行。 [na hao ba 。 wo men jiang ji xu an zhao zi ji de jie zou jin xing 。]

english: What can I do in the city?
translation: 在城市里我能做什么？ [zai cheng shi li wo neng zuo shen me ？]

english: Why don't you visit the market? I hear there is quite a craze for surface foods at the moment, so you might be able to sell something there.
translation: 你为什么不去市场看看？我听说现在表面食品很受欢迎，所以你也许可以在那里卖点东西。 [ni wei shen me bu qu shi chang kan kan ？ wo ting shuo xian zai biao mian shi pin hen shou huan ying ， suo yi ni ye xu ke yi zai na li mai dian dong xi 。]

english: You might also want to visit the caves to the south of the city. There are many monsters to fight there, and Zanik apparently found ways to cross over their heads!
translation: 您可能还想参观城市南部的洞穴。那里有很多怪物需要战斗，扎尼克显然找到了越过它们的方法！ [nin ke neng hai xiang can guan cheng shi nan bu de dong xue 。 na li you hen duo guai wu xu yao zhan dou ， zha ni ke xian ran zhao dao le yue guo ta men de fang fa ！]

english: Why did you decide to open the city?
translation: 为什么决定开城？ [wei shen me jue ding kai cheng ？]

english: For trade, and for fostering goodwill between races! I am sure that it will benefit both our races.
translation: 为了贸易，为了促进种族之间的友好关系！我相信这将使我们两个种族受益。 [wei le mao yi ， wei le cu jin zhong zu zhi jian de you hao guan xi ！ wo xiang xin zhe jiang shi wo men liang ge zhong zu shou yi 。]

english: It's funny... whenever we dwarves have ventured onto the surface, we've found ourselves at war with the goblins there.
translation: 有趣的是……每当我们矮人冒险来到地表时，我们就会发现自己正在与那里的妖精交战。 [you qu de shi …… mei dang wo men ai ren mao xian lai dao di biao shi ， wo men jiu hui fa xian zi ji zheng zai yu na li de yao jing jiao zhan 。]

english: But now we meet these goblins underground, and they're no threat at all. Maybe this will herald a change in our relations with the surface goblins as well.
translation: 但现在我们在地下遇到了这些妖精，他们根本不构成威胁。也许这也预示着我们与地表地精关系的变化。 [dan xian zai wo men zai di xia yu dao le zhe xie yao jing ， ta men gen ben bu gou cheng wei xie 。 ye xu zhe ye yu shi zhe wo men yu di biao di jing guan xi de bian hua 。]

english: I can't stand these goblins sometimes! I come up with suggestions to make their city more efficient, and they just say it would spoil their precious way of life!
translation: 有时我实在受不了这些妖精！我提出了让他们的城市更有效率的建议，他们只是说这会破坏他们宝贵的生活方式！ [you shi wo shi zai shou bu liao zhe xie yao jing ！ wo ti chu le rang ta men de cheng shi geng you xiao lv de jian yi ， ta men zhi shi shuo zhe hui po huai ta men bao gui de sheng huo fang shi ！]

english: Trade with the goblins is going well at the moment. It's a pity they don't seem as interested in our beer as in your food, though!
translation: 目前与地精的贸易进展顺利。遗憾的是，他们似乎对我们的啤酒不像对你们的食物那么感兴趣！ [mu qian yu di jing de mao yi jin zhan shun li 。 yi han de shi ， ta men si hu dui wo men de pi jiu bu xiang dui ni men de shi wu na me gan xing qu ！]

english: Thank you again for helping us complete the train link. Further delays would have cost the Consortium a lot of money.
translation: 再次感谢您帮助我们完成火车线路。进一步的延误将使财团损失大量资金。 [zai ci gan xie nin bang zhu wo men wan cheng huo che xian lu 。 jin yi bu de yan wu jiang shi cai tuan sun shi da liang zi jin 。]

english: Oh, and I hear you saved someone's life as well. Well done on that count too.
translation: 哦，我听说你也救了某人的命。在这方面也做得很好。 [o ， wo ting shuo ni ye jiu le mou ren de ming 。 zai zhe fang mian ye zuo de hen hao 。]

english: I miss Keldagrim. This city is all very well, but no one makes an underground city like the dwarves!
translation: 我想念凯达格林。这座城市一切都很好，但没有人像矮人那样建造地下城！ [wo xiang nian kai da ge lin 。 zhe zuo cheng shi yi qie dou hen hao ， dan mei you ren xiang ai ren na yang jian zao di xia cheng ！]

english: Answer this, please.
translation: 请回答这个问题。 [qing hui da zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Well done.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: What are you arguing about?
translation: 你们在争论什么？ [ni men zai zheng lun shen me ？]

english: What can I do in the city?
translation: 在城市里我能做什么？ [zai cheng shi li wo neng zuo shen me ？]

english: Why did you decide to open the city?
translation: 为什么决定开城？ [wei shen me jue ding kai cheng ？]

english: Hello Ambassador. Are you here visiting King Roald?
translation: 大使您好。您来这里拜访罗尔德国王吗？ [da shi nin hao 。 nin lai zhe li bai fang luo er de guo wang ma ？]

english: Well, in theory, but he always seems to be busy.
translation: 嗯，理论上是这样，但他似乎总是很忙。 [n ， li lun shang shi zhe yang ， dan ta si hu zong shi hen mang 。]

english: You don't seem that upset by that, though...
translation: 不过，你看起来并没有因此感到沮丧…… [bu guo ， ni kan qi lai bing mei you yin ci gan dao ju sang ……]

english: Oh no, I like travelling, and if you become a diplomat patience is a vital skill.
translation: 哦不，我喜欢旅行，如果你成为一名外交官，耐心是一项至关重要的技能。 [o bu ， wo xi huan lv xing ， ru guo ni cheng wei yi ming wai jiao guan ， nai xin shi yi xiang zhi guan zhong yao de ji neng 。]

english: I'll try to remember that.
translation: 我会尽力记住这一点。 [wo hui jin li ji zhu zhe yi dian 。]

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 尽管您找到了顾客，但您似乎没有带来正确的食物！你需要[一个/一些][订购的侏儒食物/饮料]！ [jin guan nin zhao dao le gu ke ， dan nin si hu mei you dai lai zheng que de shi wu ！ ni xu yao [ yi ge / yi xie ][ ding gou de zhu ru shi wu / yin liao ]！]

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜肴不行。对于 Aluft Aloft 的顾客来说，只有手工制作的 Gnome Cuisine 才足够好。 [kong pa yu zhi cai yao bu xing 。 dui yu  Aluft Aloft  de gu ke lai shuo ， zhi you shou gong zhi zuo de  Gnome Cuisine  cai zu gou hao 。]

english: You hand over your delivery of [item] to Ambassador Ferrnook
translation: 您将[物品]交给费努克大使 [nin jiang [ wu pin ] jiao gei fei nu ke da shi]

english: Excellent. A taste of home.
translation: 出色的。家的味道。 [chu se de 。 jia de wei dao 。]

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 你一定是走了很远的路才把这个交给我的。这里有一些额外的东西作为提示。 [ni yi ding shi zou le hen yuan de lu cai ba zhe ge jiao gei wo de 。 zhe li you yi xie e wai de dong xi zuo wei ti shi 。]

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 您有 [number] 个积分用于免费送货令牌。您还没有资格获得侏儒食物。 [nin you  [number]  ge ji fen yong yu mian fei song huo ling pai 。 nin hai mei you zi ge huo de zhu ru shi wu 。]

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 您有 [number] 个积分用于免费送货令牌。您可能会收到 [number] 块侏儒食物。 [nin you  [number]  ge ji fen yong yu mian fei song huo ling pai 。 nin ke neng hui shou dao  [number]  kuai zhu ru shi wu 。]

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 不要忘记从 Aluft Gianne jnr 领取免费送货代币。 [bu yao wang ji cong  Aluft Gianne jnr  ling qu mian fei song huo dai bi 。]

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 你的交货太晚了！返回 Aluft jnr。以获得另一个订单。您丢弃了送货箱，因为您不再需要它了。 [ni de jiao huo tai wan le ！ fan hui  Aluft jnr。 yi huo de ling yi ge ding dan 。 nin diu qi le song huo xiang ， yin wei nin bu zai xu yao ta le 。]

english: I can't believe that I've been made to wait so long.
translation: 我不敢相信我竟然要等这么久。 [wo bu gan xiang xin wo jing ran yao deng zhe me jiu 。]

english: What are you waiting for?
translation: 你还在等什么？ [ni hai zai deng shen me ？]

english: I have been waiting for an audience with the King for days!
translation: 我等见国王已经好几天了！ [wo deng jian guo wang yi jing hao ji tian le ！]

english: Well, he's clearly a busy man.
translation: 嗯，他显然是个大忙人。 [n ， ta xian ran shi ge da mang ren 。]

english: Bah! I think he's just trying to insult the gnome nation, by making me wait. The cheek of these humans. Just because they're vertically challenged they think they can ignore us.
translation: 呸!我认为他只是想侮辱侏儒国家，让我等待。这些人类的脸颊。仅仅因为他们面临垂直挑战，他们就认为可以忽略我们。 [pei ! wo ren wei ta zhi shi xiang wu ru zhu ru guo jia ， rang wo deng dai 。 zhe xie ren lei de lian jia 。 jin jin yin wei ta men mian lin chui zhi tiao zhan ， ta men jiu ren wei ke yi hu lve wo men 。]

english: I'm not ignoring you.
translation: 我没有忽视你。 [wo mei you hu shi ni 。]

english: Hmm. I should be thankful for small mercies, I suppose.
translation: 唔。我想我应该对小小的仁慈表示感谢。 [wu 。 wo xiang wo ying gai dui xiao xiao de ren ci biao shi gan xie 。]

english: Many thanks. This will help wile away the time whilst I'm waiting for an audience.
translation: 非常感谢。这将有助于打发我等待观众的时间。 [fei chang gan xie 。 zhe jiang you zhu yu da fa wo deng dai guan zhong de shi jian 。]

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 你一定是走了很远的路才把这个交给我的。这里有一些额外的东西作为提示。 [ni yi ding shi zou le hen yuan de lu cai ba zhe ge jiao gei wo de 。 zhe li you yi xie e wai de dong xi zuo wei ti shi 。]

english: It's all very bright round here, isn't it?
translation: 这里周围都很明亮，不是吗？ [zhe li zhou wei dou hen ming liang ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Well, it is the White Knights' Castle.
translation: 嗯，那就是白骑士城堡。 [n ， na jiu shi bai qi shi cheng bao 。]

english: I think it would all look better in a nice dark green. At least then I wouldn't be squinting all the time.
translation: 我认为如果是深绿色的话看起来会更好。至少这样我就不会一直眯着眼睛了。 [wo ren wei ru guo shi shen lv se de hua kan qi lai hui geng hao 。 zhi shao zhe yang wo jiu bu hui yi zhi mi zhuo yan jing le 。]

english: Yes, but then they'd have to become the Dark Green Knights. Doesn't really have the same ring to it.
translation: 是的，但是他们必须成为深绿骑士团。确实没有相同的戒指。 [shi de ， dan shi ta men bi xu cheng wei shen lv qi shi tuan 。 que shi mei you xiang tong de jie zhi 。]

english: Bah, humans have no sense of style...
translation: 呸，人类没有时尚感…… [pei ， ren lei mei you shi shang gan ……]

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 尽管您找到了顾客，但您似乎没有带来正确的食物！你需要[一个/一些][订购的侏儒食物/饮料]！ [jin guan nin zhao dao le gu ke ， dan nin si hu mei you dai lai zheng que de shi wu ！ ni xu yao [ yi ge / yi xie ][ ding gou de zhu ru shi wu / yin liao ]！]

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜肴不行。对于 Aluft Aloft 的顾客来说，只有手工制作的 Gnome Cuisine 才足够好。 [kong pa yu zhi cai yao bu xing 。 dui yu  Aluft Aloft  de gu ke lai shuo ， zhi you shou gong zhi zuo de  Gnome Cuisine  cai zu gou hao 。]

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Ambassador Spanfipple
translation: 您将[一份/一些][订购的侏儒食品/饮料]交给斯潘菲普尔大使 [nin jiang [ yi fen / yi xie ][ ding gou de zhu ru shi pin / yin liao ] jiao gei si pan fei pu er da shi]

english: Thank you kindly. I haven't got used to this human food and drink yet.
translation: 谢谢您。我还没习惯这种人类的食物和饮料。 [xie xie nin 。 wo hai mei xi guan zhe zhong ren lei de shi wu he yin liao 。]

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 你一定是走了很远的路才把这个交给我的。这里有一些额外的东西作为提示。 [ni yi ding shi zou le hen yuan de lu cai ba zhe ge jiao gei wo de 。 zhe li you yi xie e wai de dong xi zuo wei ti shi 。]

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 您有 [number] 个积分用于免费送货令牌。您还没有资格获得侏儒食物。 [nin you  [number]  ge ji fen yong yu mian fei song huo ling pai 。 nin hai mei you zi ge huo de zhu ru shi wu 。]

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 您有 [number] 个积分用于免费送货令牌。您可能会收到 [number] 块侏儒食物。 [nin you  [number]  ge ji fen yong yu mian fei song huo ling pai 。 nin ke neng hui shou dao  [number]  kuai zhu ru shi wu 。]

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 不要忘记从 Aluft Gianne jnr 领取免费送货代币。 [bu yao wang ji cong  Aluft Gianne jnr  ling qu mian fei song huo dai bi 。]

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 你的交货太晚了！返回 Aluft jnr。以获得另一个订单。您丢弃了送货箱，因为您不再需要它了。 [ni de jiao huo tai wan le ！ fan hui  Aluft jnr。 yi huo de ling yi ge ding dan 。 nin diu qi le song huo xiang ， yin wei nin bu zai xu yao ta le 。]

english: It's all very white round here, isn't it?
translation: 这里的一切都很白，不是吗？ [zhe li de yi qie dou hen bai ， bu shi ma ？]

english: I think it would all look better in pink. At least then I wouldn't be squinting all the time.
translation: 我认为粉色会更好看。至少这样我就不会一直眯着眼睛了。 [wo ren wei fen se hui geng hao kan 。 zhi shao zhe yang wo jiu bu hui yi zhi mi zhuo yan jing le 。]

english: Yes, but then they'd have to become the Pink Knights. I think they'd have problems recruiting then.
translation: 是的，但是他们必须成为粉红骑士。我认为他们在招聘时会遇到问题。 [shi de ， dan shi ta men bi xu cheng wei fen hong qi shi 。 wo ren wei ta men zai zhao pin shi hui yu dao wen ti 。]

english: You're probably right. Maybe brown, then.
translation: 你可能是对的。那么也许是棕色的。 [ni ke neng shi dui de 。 na me ye xu shi zong se de 。]

english: I think that may be worse...
translation: 我想这可能会更糟... [wo xiang zhe ke neng hui geng zao ...]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Hello. Do you need something?
translation: 你好。你需要什么东西吗？ [ni hao 。 ni xu yao shen me dong xi ma ？]

english: Nope. Just thought I'd say hi.
translation: 没有。只是想我会打个招呼。 [mei you 。 zhi shi xiang wo hui da ge zhao hu 。]

english: Hello there. Have you heard of Camorra?
translation: 你好呀。你听说过卡莫拉吗？ [ni hao ya 。 ni ting shuo guo ka mo la ma ？]

english: Not that I remember.
translation: 我不记得了。 [wo bu ji de le 。]

english: Well she was a great hero during the Dragonkin Conflicts. I think she travelled to Kourend before the war ended. I'm trying to find out more about her.

translation: 恐怕是这样。数百年来，墓穴里一直挤满了死者。我们曾尝试清除它们，但它们又回来了。 [kong pa shi zhe yang 。 shu bai nian lai ， mu xue li yi zhi ji man le si zhe 。 wo men ceng chang shi qing chu ta men ， dan ta men you hui lai le 。]

translation: 抱歉，这一切都太令人困惑了。我需要一些时间来尝试和理解。 [bao qian ， zhe yi qie dou tai ling ren kun huo le 。 wo xu yao yi xie shi jian lai chang shi he li jie 。]

english: Well I hope it all works out for you. Good luck.
translation: 好吧，我希望一切顺利。祝你好运。 [hao ba ， wo xi wang yi qie shun li 。 zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Die puny chicken!
translation: 小鸡去死吧！ [xiao ji qu si ba ！]

english: What? I'm not a chicken.
translation: 什么？我不是鸡。 [shen me ？ wo bu shi ji 。]

english: You wear cunning disguise. I see though. You flappy chicken! You die in name of Big High War God.
translation: 你穿着狡猾的伪装。我明白了。你这只飞扬的小鸡！你以高大战神的名义而死。 [ni chuan zhe jiao hua de wei zhuang 。 wo ming bai le 。 ni zhe zhi fei yang de xiao ji ！ ni yi gao da zhan shen de ming yi er si 。]

english: There's no Big High War God here.
translation: 这里没有高大战神。 [zhe li mei you gao da zhan shen 。]

english: Lies! Big High War God use the shiny to kill the chickens! Now we clear up the rest!
translation: 谎言！大高战神用闪亮杀鸡！现在我们清理剩下的！ [huang yan ！ da gao zhan shen yong shan liang sha ji ！ xian zai wo men qing li sheng xia de ！]

english: Sorry to be the bearer of bad news, but I think this 'shiny' might have killed you as well.
translation: 很抱歉带来坏消息，但我认为这个“闪亮”可能也会杀了你。 [hen bao qian dai lai huai xiao xi ， dan wo ren wei zhe ge “ shan liang ” ke neng ye hui sha le ni 。]

english: Chicken play mind games, but I no fool. You die now!
translation: 鸡玩心理游戏，但我不是傻瓜。你现在就死吧！ [ji wan xin li you xi ， dan wo bu shi sha gua 。 ni xian zai jiu si ba ！]

english: You know there's normally not this much talking before dying.
translation: 你知道，临死前通常不会说这么多话。 [ni zhi dao ， lin si qian tong chang bu hui shuo zhe me duo hua 。]

english: Yes! No talking! Only die!
translation: 是的！不说话！只能死！ [shi de ！ bu shuo hua ！ zhi neng si ！]

english: I'm waiting.
translation: 我在等。 [wo zai deng 。]

english: Arghhh!
translation: 啊啊！ [a a ！]

english: I think I'll leave you to it.
translation: 我想我就让你自己解决吧。 [wo xiang wo jiu rang ni zi ji jie jue ba 。]

english: Die!
translation: 死！ [si ！]

english: For Zaros!
translation: 为了扎罗斯！ [wei le zha luo si ！]

english: Perish in agony!
translation: 在痛苦中灭亡！ [zai tong ku zhong mie wang ！]

english: I'm coming for you!
translation: 我来找你了！ [wo lai zhao ni le ！]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm helpin' ta protect the base camp. How about you, what are you doing here?
translation: 我正在帮助保护大本营。你呢，你在这里做什么？ [wo zheng zai bang zhu bao hu da ben ying 。 ni ne ， ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Oh, I'm trying to help out around here.
translation: 哦，我正在尽力帮忙。 [o ， wo zheng zai jin li bang mang 。]

english: Good, we can always use extra help. Just make sure you don't go getting into any trouble or you'll have me to deal with!
translation: 很好，我们随时可以寻求额外的帮助。只要确保你不会惹上任何麻烦，否则我就要对付你了！ [hen hao ， wo men sui shi ke yi xun qiu e wai de bang zhu 。 zhi yao que bao ni bu hui re shang ren he ma fan ， fou ze wo jiu yao dui fu ni le ！]

english: Hello there. Want to travel to Slepe? I charge 10,000 coins for the journey.
translation: 你好呀。想去斯莱佩旅行吗？我收取了 10,000 个硬币的旅程费用。 [ni hao ya 。 xiang qu si lai pei lv xing ma ？ wo shou qu le  10,000  ge ying bi de lv cheng fei yong 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Doesn't look like you have enough money. I charge 10,000 coins for the journey.
translation: 看来你钱不够啊我收取了 10,000 个硬币的旅程费用。 [kan lai ni qian bu gou a wo shou qu le  10,000  ge ying bi de lv cheng fei yong 。]

english: Where's Slepe?
translation: 斯莱佩在哪里？ [si lai pei zai na li ？]

english: It's a small village to the south of here. You can walk but the boat is safer and faster.
translation: 这是这里南面的一个小村庄。您可以步行，但乘船更安全、更快。 [zhe shi zhe li nan mian de yi ge xiao cun zhuang 。 nin ke yi bu xing ， dan cheng chuan geng an quan 、 geng kuai 。]

english: Is there anything to do there?
translation: 那里有什么可做的吗？ [na li you shen me ke zuo de ma ？]

english: I guess that depends what interests you. The place is pretty quiet, though there's been rumours recently of a great evil making its home beneath the village.
translation: 我想这取决于你的兴趣。这个地方相当安静，尽管最近有传言说有一个巨大的恶魔在村子下面安家落户。 [wo xiang zhe qu jue yu ni de xing qu 。 zhe ge di fang xiang dang an jing ， jin guan zui jin you chuan yan shuo you yi ge ju da de e mo zai cun zi xia mian an jia luo hu 。]

english: There's also Ver Sinhaza to the south, home to the Theatre of Blood. It's definitely worth having a look around, even if you don't intend to participate yourself.
translation: 南部还有 Ver Sinhaza，是血腥剧场的所在地。即使您不打算亲自参与，也绝对值得四处看看。 [nan bu hai you  Ver Sinhaza， shi xue xing ju chang de suo zai di 。 ji shi nin bu da suan qin zi can yu ， ye jue dui zhi de si chu kan kan 。]

english: So, do you want to go to Slepe?
translation: 那么，你想去斯莱佩吗？ [na me ， ni xiang qu si lai pei ma ？]

english: Why is it so expensive?
translation: 为什么这么贵？ [wei shen me zhe me gui ？]

english: Not many people want to visit this part of the world so I have to keep the price high. If I didn't I wouldn't be able to keep my boat maintained.
translation: 没有多少人想去世界的这个地方，所以我必须保持高价格。如果我不这样做，我将无法维护我的船。 [mei you duo shao ren xiang qu shi jie de zhe ge di fang ， suo yi wo bi xu bao chi gao jia ge 。 ru guo wo bu zhe yang zuo ， wo jiang wu fa wei hu wo de chuan 。]

english: I'll give you 1,000,000 coins for permanent access.
translation: 我会给你 1,000,000 个硬币来永久访问。 [wo hui gei ni  1,000,000  ge ying bi lai yong jiu fang wen 。]

english: 1,000,000 coins! Are you serious?
translation: 1,000,000枚金币！你是认真的？ [1,000,000 mei jin bi ！ ni shi ren zhen de ？]

english: No. I don't have that sort of money.
translation: 不，我没有那么多钱。 [bu ， wo mei you na me duo qian 。]

english: Oh, I see. So, do you want to go to Slepe?
translation: 我懂了。那么，你想去斯莱佩吗？ [wo dong le 。 na me ， ni xiang qu si lai pei ma ？]

english: Yes. Here's 1,000,000 coins.
translation: 是的。这是 1,000,000 个硬币。 [shi de 。 zhe shi  1,000,000  ge ying bi 。]

english: Thank you so much. Now, do you want to go to Slepe?
translation: 太感谢了。现在，你想去Slepe吗？ [tai gan xie le 。 xian zai ， ni xiang qu Slepe ma ？]

english: No. That's too much for me to spend.
translation: 不，这对我来说花费太多了。 [bu ， zhe dui wo lai shuo hua fei tai duo le 。]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello there. Want to travel to Slepe?
translation: 你好呀。想去斯莱佩旅行吗？ [ni hao ya 。 xiang qu si lai pei lv xing ma ？]

english: Hello there. Want to return to Port Phasmatys?
translation: 你好呀。想返回法斯马蒂斯港？ [ni hao ya 。 xiang fan hui fa si ma di si gang ？]

english: Andras transports the player to Port Phasmatys.
translation: 安德拉斯将玩家运送到法斯马蒂斯港。 [an de la si jiang wan jia yun song dao fa si ma di si gang 。]

english: Is there anything to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的吗？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ma ？]

english: Well you have Slepe just north of here. It's mostly a quiet place, though there's been rumours recently of a great evil making its home beneath the village.
translation: 嗯，Slepe 就在这儿北边。这里基本上是一个安静的地方，尽管最近有传言说有一个巨大的恶魔在村子下面安家落户。 [n ，Slepe  jiu zai zhe er bei bian 。 zhe li ji ben shang shi yi ge an jing de di fang ， jin guan zui jin you chuan yan shuo you yi ge ju da de e mo zai cun zi xia mian an jia luo hu 。]

english: There's also Ver Sinhaza. You can find it south of here. There's a gap in the northern wall that you can get through.
translation: 还有维尔·辛哈扎。你可以在这儿南边找到它。北墙上有一个缺口，可以通过。 [hai you wei er · xin ha zha 。 ni ke yi zai zhe er nan bian zhao dao ta 。 bei qiang shang you yi ge que kou ， ke yi tong guo 。]

english: What's Ver Sinhaza?
translation: 维尔·辛哈扎是什么？ [wei er · xin ha zha shi shen me ？]

english: It's a large vampyric castle, home to the Theatre of Blood. The vampyres claim that the Theatre is one of the greatest combat challenges around. Definitely worth a look even if you don't want to participate.
translation: 这是一座大型吸血鬼城堡，也是血剧场的所在地。吸血鬼声称剧院是周围最大的战斗挑战之一。即使您不想参加，也绝对值得一看。 [zhe shi yi zuo da xing xi xue gui cheng bao ， ye shi xue ju chang de suo zai di 。 xi xue gui sheng cheng ju yuan shi zhou wei zui da de zhan dou tiao zhan zhi yi 。 ji shi nin bu xiang can jia ， ye jue dui zhi de yi kan 。]

english: Anyway, did you want to return to Port Phasmatys?
translation: 不管怎样，你想回到法斯马蒂斯港吗？ [bu guan zen yang ， ni xiang hui dao fa si ma di si gang ma ？]

english: Andras transports the player to Slepe.
translation: 安德拉斯将玩家传送到睡眠。 [an de la si jiang wan jia chuan song dao shui mian 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Where's Slepe?
translation: 斯莱佩在哪里？ [si lai pei zai na li ？]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Why is it so expensive?
translation: 为什么这么贵？ [wei shen me zhe me gui ？]

english: I'll give you 1,000,000 coins for permanent access.
translation: 我会给你 1,000,000 个硬币来永久访问。 [wo hui gei ni  1,000,000  ge ying bi lai yong jiu fang wen 。]

english: Yes. Here's 1,000,000 coins.
translation: 是的。这是 1,000,000 个硬币。 [shi de 。 zhe shi  1,000,000  ge ying bi 。]

english: No. That's too much for me to spend.
translation: 不，这对我来说花费太多了。 [bu ， zhe dui wo lai shuo hua fei tai duo le 。]

english: Is there anything to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的吗？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ma ？]

english: I can't believe we've finally arrived, I can't wait to explore!
translation: 我不敢相信我们终于到达了，我迫不及待地想探索！ [wo bu gan xiang xin wo men zhong yu dao da le ， wo po bu ji dai di xiang tan suo ！]

english: So much to see, I don't know where to start!
translation: 太多东西要看，我不知道从哪里开始！ [tai duo dong xi yao kan ， wo bu zhi dao cong na li kai shi ！]

english: A whole new continent to explore... what a time to be
translation: 等待探索的全新大陆……美好时光 [deng dai tan suo de quan xin da lu …… mei hao shi guang]

english: Are you the tour guide?
translation: 你是导游吗？ [ni shi dao you ma ？]

english: Nope, I'm just as lost as you.
translation: 不，我和你一样迷失。 [bu ， wo he ni yi yang mi shi 。]

english: I overheard someone mention there are pirates and thieves here, be careful!
translation: 我无意中听到有人说这里有海盗和小偷，要小心！ [wo wu yi zhong ting dao you ren shuo zhe li you hai dao he xiao tou ， yao xiao xin ！]

english: Well met, fellow adventurer.
translation: 很高兴认识你，冒险家同伴。 [hen gao xing ren shi ni ， mao xian jia tong ban 。]

english: Adventurer? I am no mere Adventurer, I am Andros Mai, brother of the Holy Order of Saradomin. You would do well to greet me with respect.
translation: 冒险家？我不只是冒险者，我是安德罗斯·麦，萨拉多明骑士团的兄弟。你最好尊重地向我打招呼。 [mao xian jia ？ wo bu zhi shi mao xian zhe ， wo shi an de luo si · mai ， sa la duo ming qi shi tuan de xiong di 。 ni zui hao zun zhong di xiang wo da zhao hu 。]

english: Andros Mai? Sorry, but I can't say I've heard of you I'm afraid.
translation: 安德罗斯·迈？抱歉，恐怕我不能说我听说过你。 [an de luo si · mai ？ bao qian ， kong pa wo bu neng shuo wo ting shuo guo ni 。]

english: I wouldn't have expected someone of your... stature to know of me.
translation: 我没想到像你这样的人会认识我。 [wo mei xiang dao xiang ni zhe yang de ren hui ren shi wo 。]

english: Tell me, what do you know of the vile Vet'ion?
translation: 告诉我，你对邪恶的 Vet'ion 了解多少？ [gao su wo ， ni dui xie e de  Vet'ion  liao jie duo shao ？]

english: Nothing, but I have a feeling you're about to fill me in.
translation: 没什么，但我有一种感觉，你要让我知道了。 [mei shen me ， dan wo you yi zhong gan jue ， ni yao rang wo zhi dao le 。]

english: We've crossed swords in the past, I can't say I'm too keen to do it again though.
translation: 我们过去曾有过交锋，但我不能说我太愿意再这样做了。 [wo men guo qu ceng you guo jiao feng ， dan wo bu neng shuo wo tai yuan yi zai zhe yang zuo le 。]

english: You challenged him and came out unscathed? Impossible.
translation: 你挑战他却毫发无伤？不可能的。 [ni tiao zhan ta que hao fa wu shang ？ bu ke neng de 。]

english: I'm stronger than I look.
translation: 我比看起来更坚强。 [wo bi kan qi lai geng jian qiang 。]

english: But why do you ask? What do you want with Vet'ion?
translation: 但你为什么要问呢？您想要 Vet'ion 做什么？ [dan ni wei shen me yao wen ne ？ nin xiang yao  Vet'ion  zuo shen me ？]

english: Vet'ion was a devout follower of the heretical god Zamorak. It is the will of my order and my duty as a follower of the true god Saradomin to end his tyranny.
translation: 维特翁是异端之神萨莫拉克的虔诚追随者。结束他的暴政是我的命令的意志，也是我作为真神萨拉多明追随者的责任。 [wei te weng shi yi duan zhi shen sa mo la ke de qian cheng zhui sui zhe 。 jie shu ta de bao zheng shi wo de ming ling de yi zhi ， ye shi wo zuo wei zhen shen sa la duo ming zhui sui zhe de ze ren 。]

english: After many years in my order's libraries, I stumbled upon an old tome which mentioned Vet'ion's final resting place, which I believe to be his source of power.
translation: 在我的教团图书馆呆了很多年之后，我偶然发现了一本旧书，其中提到了维特伊恩的最后安息之地，我相信那是他的力量源泉。 [zai wo de jiao tuan tu shu guan dai le hen duo nian zhi hou ， wo ou ran fa xian le yi ben jiu shu ， qi zhong ti dao le wei te yi en de zui hou an xi zhi di ， wo xiang xin na shi ta de li liang yuan quan 。]

english: His very existence is an insult to my lord Saradomin and I will not suffer it to exist any longer.
translation: 他的存在本身就是对我的领主萨拉多明的侮辱，我不会再容忍它存在了。 [ta de cun zai ben shen jiu shi dui wo de ling zhu sa la duo ming de wu ru ， wo bu hui zai rong ren ta cun zai le 。]

english: Then why are you waiting here? Seems to me that you don't want to face Vet'ion.
translation: 那你为什么在这里等？在我看来你不想面对 Vet'ion。 [na ni wei shen me zai zhe li deng ？ zai wo kan lai ni bu xiang mian dui  Vet'ion。]

english: I have no fear of Vet'ion!
translation: 我不害怕 Vet'ion！ [wo bu hai pa  Vet'ion！]

english: I am merely meditating and preparing for the battle. I need to focus my mind before going out to find his resting place.
translation: 我只是在冥想并准备战斗。在出去寻找他的安息之地之前，我需要集中精神。 [wo zhi shi zai ming xiang bing zhun bei zhan dou 。 zai chu qu xun zhao ta de an xi zhi di zhi qian ， wo xu yao ji zhong jing shen 。]

english: It's okay, sometimes I pretend to be busy when there's something I don't want to do, too.
translation: 没关系，有时我也会假装很忙，当我不想做的事情时。 [mei guan xi ， you shi wo ye hui jia zhuang hen mang ， dang wo bu xiang zuo de shi qing shi 。]

english: This conversation is over! Leave me before I lose my temper.
translation: 这次谈话结束了！在我发脾气之前离开我。 [zhe ci tan hua jie shu le ！ zai wo fa pi qi zhi qian li kai wo 。]

english: Hey. Do you know anything about this?
translation: 嘿。你知道这件事吗？ [hei 。 ni zhi dao zhe jian shi ma ？]

english: By Saradomin! That's a Zamorakian made chainmace you have there!
translation: 萨拉多明！你那里有一把萨莫拉克制造的链锤！ [sa la duo ming ！ ni na li you yi ba sa mo la ke zhi zao de lian chui ！]

english: And? Do you know anything about it?
translation: 和？你知道吗？ [he ？ ni zhi dao ma ？]

english: I know melee weapons in general. Well enough to know most of them can be upgraded.
translation: 我大致了解近战武器。足以知道其中大多数都可以升级。 [wo da zhi liao jie jin zhan wu qi 。 zu yi zhi dao qi zhong da duo shu dou ke yi sheng ji 。]

english: Perhaps with something sharp to give it more impact as it swings around.
translation: 也许用一些锋利的东西来让它在摆动时产生更大的冲击力。 [ye xu yong yi xie feng li de dong xi lai rang ta zai bai dong shi chan sheng geng da de chong ji li 。]

english: Interesting! I'll be on the lookout for a powerful enhancement like that.
translation: 有趣的！我会寻找类似的强大增强功能。 [you qu de ！ wo hui xun zhao lei si de qiang da zeng qiang gong neng 。]

english: They look like powerful claws. You could probably attach them to a weapon to make the weapon stronger.
translation: 它们看起来像强大的爪子。你或许可以将它们附加到武器上以使武器更强大。 [ta men kan qi lai xiang qiang da de zhua zi 。 ni huo xu ke yi jiang ta men fu jia dao wu qi shang yi shi wu qi geng qiang da 。]

english: Interesting! I'll be on the lookout for that.
translation: 有趣的！我会留意这一点。 [you qu de ！ wo hui liu yi zhe yi dian 。]

english: Perhaps I could use this?
translation: 也许我可以用这个？ [ye xu wo ke yi yong zhe ge ？]

english: Yes. Those look like they could be attached to the weapon.
translation: 是的。这些看起来可以连接到武器上。 [shi de 。 zhe xie kan qi lai ke yi lian jie dao wu qi shang 。]

english: Could you combine them?
translation: 你能把它们结合起来吗？ [ni neng ba ta men jie he qi lai ma ？]

english: While I could, I'd really not like to.
translation: 虽然我可以，但我真的不愿意。 [sui ran wo ke yi ， dan wo zhen de bu yuan yi 。]

english: Surely you could consider it... For the right price?
translation: 您当然可以考虑...价格合适吗？ [nin dang ran ke yi kao lv ... jia ge he shi ma ？]

english: Money has been tight lately...
translation: 最近钱很紧... [zui jin qian hen jin ...]

english: And my supplies are running low...
translation: 而我的补给品已经所剩无几了…… [er wo de bu ji pin yi jing suo sheng wu ji le ……]

english: Fine. But I want 500,000 coins for that. No less.
translation: 美好的。但我想要 500,000 个硬币。不少。 [mei hao de 。 dan wo xiang yao  500,000  ge ying bi 。 bu shao 。]

english: I don't have the money for that.
translation: 我没有钱做那个。 [wo mei you qian zuo na ge 。]

english: Feel free to come back when you do.
translation: 回来后请随时回来。 [hui lai hou qing sui shi hui lai 。]

english: There we go! All done.
translation: 我们开始吧！全部完成。 [wo men kai shi ba ！ quan bu wan cheng 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: No. I'm afraid not. They just look like fangs.
translation: 不，恐怕不是。它们看起来就像尖牙。 [bu ， kong pa bu shi 。 ta men kan qi lai jiu xiang jian ya 。]

english: Fangs indeed. Rather useless it seems.
translation: 确实是獠牙。看起来比较没用。 [que shi shi liao ya 。 kan qi lai bi jiao mei yong 。]

translation: 但我知道的一件事是，这是一种快速赚钱和赔钱的方法。 [dan wo zhi dao de yi jian shi shi ， zhe shi yi zhong kuai su zhuan qian he pei qian de fang fa 。]

english: Is there a limit to how much you can bet?
translation: 您可以下注的金额有限制吗？ [nin ke yi xia zhu de jin e you xian zhi ma ？]

english: Hmmm... let me think. I don't think that's ever arisen but I think it's 20,000.
translation: 嗯……让我想想。我认为这种情况从未出现过，但我认为有 20,000 个。 [n …… rang wo xiang xiang 。 wo ren wei zhe zhong qing kuang cong wei chu xian guo ， dan wo ren wei you  20,000  ge 。]

english: Hmm, that sounds like a silly amount of money to bet on a cat fight.
translation: 嗯，这听起来像是在猫打架上押注的一大笔钱。 [n ， zhe ting qi lai xiang shi zai mao da jia shang ya zhu de yi da bi qian 。]

english: You'd be surprised what some people would be willing to bet.
translation: 你会对有些人愿意下注感到惊讶。 [ni hui dui you xie ren yuan yi xia zhu gan dao jing ya 。]

english: There is a minimum bet of 100 coins too.
translation: 最低赌注也为 100 个硬币。 [zui di du zhu ye wei  100  ge ying bi 。]

english: Can I challenge you and your cat?
translation: 我可以挑战你和你的猫吗？ [wo ke yi tiao zhan ni he ni de mao ma ？]

english: No, not now, we don't really bet with outsiders.
translation: 不，现在不行，我们真的不跟外人打赌。 [bu ， xian zai bu xing ， wo men zhen de bu gen wai ren da du 。]

english: But I'm not an outsider, am I not inside in the pits now?
translation: 但我不是外人，我现在不是在坑里吗？ [dan wo bu shi wai ren ， wo xian zai bu shi zai keng li ma ？]

english: I don't know, maybe once you've done something to win over my trust.
translation: 我不知道，也许一旦你做了一些事情来赢得我的信任。 [wo bu zhi dao ， ye xu yi dan ni zuo le yi xie shi qing lai ying de wo de xin ren 。]

english: Can it be bought?
translation: 可以买吗？ [ke yi mai ma ？]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: Your trust.
translation: 您的信任。 [nin de xin ren 。]

english: No. Regular townsfolk don't like us, which leads us to distrust them and anyone else.
translation: 不。普通城镇居民不喜欢我们，这导致我们不信任他们和其他任何人。 [bu 。 pu tong cheng zhen ju min bu xi huan wo men ， zhe dao zhi wo men bu xin ren ta men he qi ta ren he ren 。]

english: Thanks for your help.
translation: 感谢您的帮助。 [gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]

english: That sounds vile and cruel.
translation: 这听上去卑鄙又残忍。 [zhe ting shang qu bei bi you can ren 。]

english: One more thing...
translation: 还有一件事... [hai you yi jian shi ...]

english: Thanks for your help.
translation: 感谢您的帮助。 [gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]

english: It sounds a little dangerous for my cat.
translation: 听起来对我的猫来说有点危险。 [ting qi lai dui wo de mao lai shuo you dian wei xian 。]

english: Wow that sounds like fun.
translation: 哇，听起来很有趣。 [wa ， ting qi lai hen you qu 。]

english: Is there a limit to how much you can bet?
translation: 您可以下注的金额有限制吗？ [nin ke yi xia zhu de jin e you xian zhi ma ？]

english: Can I challenge you and your cat?
translation: 我可以挑战你和你的猫吗？ [wo ke yi tiao zhan ni he ni de mao ma ？]

english: Apparently you aren't as stupid as you look.
translation: 看来你并不像看上去那么愚蠢。 [kan lai ni bing bu xiang kan shang qu na me yu chun 。]

english: Ah. You must be [player name], right? I have a bronze pickaxe here for you!
translation: 啊。你一定是[玩家姓名]，对吧？我这里有一把青铜镐给你！ [a 。 ni yi ding shi [ wan jia xing ming ]， dui ba ？ wo zhe li you yi ba qing tong gao gei ni ！]

english: Thanks very much!
translation: 非常感谢！ [fei chang gan xie ！]

english: My employer, Surok Magis, sent word to me that you may come to use the tunnel. You will need something to help you get in there. The pickaxe I've given to you should help.
translation: 我的雇主苏洛克·马吉斯 (Surok Magis) 传话给我，你可以来使用隧道。你需要一些东西来帮助你进入那里。我给你的镐应该会有帮助。 [wo de gu zhu su luo ke · ma ji si  (Surok Magis)  chuan hua gei wo ， ni ke yi lai shi yong sui dao 。 ni xu yao yi xie dong xi lai bang zhu ni jin ru na li 。 wo gei ni de gao ying gai hui you bang zhu 。]

english: Uh, thanks.
translation: 呃，谢谢。 [e ， xie xie 。]

english: Okay, then. The tunnel awaits...
translation: 好吧，那么。隧道在等待…… [hao ba ， na me 。 sui dao zai deng dai ……]

english: What tunnel?
translation: 什么隧道？ [shen me sui dao ？]

english: Why, the Chaos Tunnel of course! I imagine Surok will have told you of it.
translation: 为什么，当然是混沌隧道！我想苏罗克会告诉你这件事。 [wei shen me ， dang ran shi hun dun sui dao ！ wo xiang su luo ke hui gao su ni zhe jian shi 。]

english: Oh, I see. Well, what can you tell me about it?
translation: 我懂了。嗯，你能告诉我什么吗？ [wo dong le 。 n ， ni neng gao su wo shen me ma ？]

english: Well, story and rumour has it that the Dagon'hai built a tunnel here under the statue of Saradomin that would allow them to visit the Chaos Altar without having to go through the Wilderness.
translation: 嗯，有故事和谣言说，达贡海人在萨拉多明雕像下修建了一条隧道，使他们无需穿过荒野就可以参观混沌祭坛。 [n ， you gu shi he yao yan shuo ， da gong hai ren zai sa la duo ming diao xiang xia xiu jian le yi tiao sui dao ， shi ta men wu xu chuan guo huang ye jiu ke yi can guan hun dun ji tan 。]

english: That's extremely handy!
translation: 这非常方便！ [zhe fei chang fang bian ！]

english: Yes, it is. Or, at least, it would be. Unfortunately, I haven't been able to get in there so far.
translation: 是的。或者，至少，会是这样。不幸的是，到目前为止我还没能进入那里。 [shi de 。 huo zhe ， zhi shao ， hui shi zhe yang 。 bu xing de shi ， dao mu qian wei zhi wo hai mei neng jin ru na li 。]

english: Why not?
translation: 为什么不呢？ [wei shen me bu ne ？]

english: The tunnel entrance needs to be cleared before anyone can get in there. However, my Mining skill isn't high enough at all to do it myself. Perhaps you could have a go?
translation: 隧道入口需要先清理干净，然后才能进入。然而，我的采矿技术还不够高，无法自己完成。也许你可以尝试一下？ [sui dao ru kou xu yao xian qing li gan jing ， ran hou cai neng jin ru 。 ran er ， wo de cai kuang ji shu hai bu gou gao ， wu fa zi ji wan cheng 。 ye xu ni ke yi chang shi yi xia ？]

english: Sorry, who are you?
translation: 抱歉，你是谁？ [bao qian ， ni shi shui ？]

english: My name is Louisiana Jones, although most people call me Anna. I'm an archaeologist.
translation: 我的名字是路易斯安那·琼斯，尽管大多数人都叫我安娜。我是一名考古学家。 [wo de ming zi shi lu yi si an na · qiong si ， jin guan da duo shu ren dou jiao wo an na 。 wo shi yi ming kao gu xue jia 。]

english: Pleased to meet you.
translation: 很高兴认识你。 [hen gao xing ren shi ni 。]

english: Likewise!
translation: 同样地！ [tong yang di ！]

english: Who does this statue represent?
translation: 这座雕像代表谁？ [zhe zuo diao xiang dai biao shui ？]

english: That, my dear, is the statue of the great god Saradomin himself. Stand and admire in awe for you are in the presence of greatness!
translation: 亲爱的，那是伟大的萨拉多明神本人的雕像。站立并惊叹，因为你在伟大的面前！ [qin ai de ， na shi wei da de sa la duo ming shen ben ren de diao xiang 。 zhan li bing jing tan ， yin wei ni zai wei da de mian qian ！]

english: Consider me awed!
translation: 想想我都敬畏吧！ [xiang xiang wo dou jing wei ba ！]

english: Indeed!
translation: 的确！ [di que ！]

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Well story and rumour has it that the Dagon'hai built a tunnel under this statue of Saradomin that would allow them to visit the Chaos Altar without having to go through the Wilderness.
translation: 有故事和谣言称，达贡海人在萨拉多明雕像下修建了一条隧道，使他们无需穿过荒野即可参观混沌祭坛。 [you gu shi he yao yan cheng ， da gong hai ren zai sa la duo ming diao xiang xia xiu jian le yi tiao sui dao ， shi ta men wu xu chuan guo huang ye ji ke can guan hun dun ji tan 。]

english: Yes, it is. Or, at least, it would be. I came to excavate the tunnel but, unfortunately,  I haven't been able to get in there so far.
translation: 是的。或者，至少，会是这样。我是来挖掘隧道的，可惜至今没能进去。 [shi de 。 huo zhe ， zhi shao ， hui shi zhe yang 。 wo shi lai wa jue sui dao de ， ke xi zhi jin mei neng jin qu 。]

english: The tunnel entrance needs to be cleared before anyone can get in there. However, my Mining skill just isn't what it used to be. Perhaps you could have a go?
translation: 隧道入口需要先清理干净，然后才能进入。然而，我的采矿技术已经不如以前了。也许你可以尝试一下？ [sui dao ru kou xu yao xian qing li gan jing ， ran hou cai neng jin ru 。 ran er ， wo de cai kuang ji shu yi jing bu ru yi qian le 。 ye xu ni ke yi chang shi yi xia ？]

english: Maybe. I might do.
translation: 或许。我可能会做。 [huo xu 。 wo ke neng hui zuo 。]

english: Okay, I'd better go.
translation: 好吧，我该走了。 [hao ba ， wo gai zou le 。]

english: Okay, then!
translation: 好吧，那么！ [hao ba ， na me ！]

english: You did it! Oh, well done! How exciting!
translation: 你做到了！哦，干得好！多么令人兴奋啊！ [ni zuo dao le ！ o ， gan de hao ！ duo me ling ren xing fen a ！]

english: Right, well, I better see what's down there, then.
translation: 好吧，那么我最好看看下面有什么。 [hao ba ， na me wo zui hao kan kan xia mian you shen me 。]

english: Aren't you going to go inside?
translation: 你不进去吗？ [ni bu jin qu ma ？]

english: I'd better not. My orders were to open up the entrance and wait for Surok to arrive. When he gets here, we'll go in together. He promised me a lot of gold for this job!
translation: 我最好不要。我的命令是打开入口并等待苏罗克到来。等他来了，我们就一起进去。他答应我做这份工作会得到很多金子！ [wo zui hao bu yao 。 wo de ming ling shi da kai ru kou bing deng dai su luo ke dao lai 。 deng ta lai le ， wo men jiu yi qi jin qu 。 ta da ying wo zuo zhe fen gong zuo hui de dao hen duo jin zi ！]

english: Okay, then. I'm going in to have a look!
translation: 好吧，那么。我要进去看看！ [hao ba ， na me 。 wo yao jin qu kan kan ！]

english: What tunnel?
translation: 什么隧道？ [shen me sui dao ？]

english: Sorry, who are you?
translation: 抱歉，你是谁？ [bao qian ， ni shi shui ？]

english: Who does this statue represent?
translation: 这座雕像代表谁？ [zhe zuo diao xiang dai biao shui ？]

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Okay, I'd better go.
translation: 好吧，我该走了。 [hao ba ， wo gai zou le 。]

english: Hello visitor, how are you?
translation: 访客您好，您好吗？ [fang ke nin hao ， nin hao ma ？]

english: Better than expected. It's a lot...nicer...here than I was expecting. Everyone seems pretty happy.
translation: 比预期的要好。这里比我想象的要好得多。每个人看起来都很高兴。 [bi yu qi de yao hao 。 zhe li bi wo xiang xiang de yao hao de duo 。 mei ge ren kan qi lai dou hen gao xing 。]

english: Of course, the Burgher is strong and wise, and looks after us well.
translation: 当然，市民很坚强，也很聪明，而且把我们照顾得很好。 [dang ran ， shi min hen jian qiang ， ye hen cong ming ， er qie ba wo men zhao gu de hen hao 。]

english: I think some of those Jatizso citizens have got the wrong idea about this place.
translation: 我认为 Jatizso 的一些公民对这个地方有错误的看法。 [wo ren wei  Jatizso  de yi xie gong min dui zhe ge di fang you cuo wu de kan fa 。]

english: Can I help you with drift net storage, human?
translation: 我可以帮你储存流网吗，人类？ [wo ke yi bang ni chu cun liu wang ma ， ren lei ？]

english: What do you do?
translation: 你做什么工作？ [ni zuo shen me gong zuo ？]

english: My aunt lets people come in here to catch the fish. Sometimes they have trouble carrying enough stuff, so I help by holding onto spare drift nets for them.
translation: 我姨妈让人来这里抓鱼。有时他们无法携带足够的东西，所以我会帮他们拿备用的流网。 [wo yi ma rang ren lai zhe li zhua yu 。 you shi ta men wu fa xie dai zu gou de dong xi ， suo yi wo hui bang ta men na bei yong de liu wang 。]

english: It's a free service to help more of you humans use Ceto's cave; she's paying me, so you don't have to. So can I help you with your drift nets?
translation: 这是一项免费服务，旨在帮助更多的人类使用塞托的洞穴；她付钱给我，所以你不用付钱。那么我可以帮你处理流网吗？ [zhe shi yi xiang mian fei fu wu ， zhi zai bang zhu geng duo de ren lei shi yong sai tuo de dong xue ； ta fu qian gei wo ， suo yi ni bu yong fu qian 。 na me wo ke yi bang ni chu li liu wang ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: What do you do?
translation: 你做什么工作？ [ni zuo shen me gong zuo ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Ha Ha Ha. Well if it isn't [player name], why do you dare enter my domain....
translation: 哈哈哈。好吧，如果不是【玩家名】，你为何敢进入我的领域…… [ha ha ha 。 hao ba ， ru guo bu shi 【 wan jia ming 】， ni wei he gan jin ru wo de ling yu ……]

english: Long time no see Anti-Santa, how's prison life been treating you?
translation: 好久不见反圣诞老人，你的监狱生活怎么样？ [hao jiu bu jian fan sheng dan lao ren ， ni de jian yu sheng huo zen me yang ？]

english: It has been glorious, you may have thought me to be rotting inside these walls, but I've been coming up with plot to end Christmas once and for all!
translation: 这是光荣的，你可能认为我正在这些墙内腐烂，但我一直在想出一个计划来一劳永逸地结束圣诞节！ [zhe shi guang rong de ， ni ke neng ren wei wo zheng zai zhe xie qiang nei fu lan ， dan wo yi zhi zai xiang chu yi ge ji hua lai yi lao yong yi di jie shu sheng dan jie ！]

english: You may ofstopped me all those years ago, but you didn't stop my mind.
translation: 那些年前你可能阻止了我，但你没有阻止我的想法。 [na xie nian qian ni ke neng zu zhi le wo ， dan ni mei you zu zhi wo de xiang fa 。]

english: Soon I'll escape these walls and there'll be naught to stop me.
translation: 很快我就会逃离这些墙壁，没有什么可以阻止我。 [hen kuai wo jiu hui tao li zhe xie qiang bi ， mei you shen me ke yi zu zhi wo 。]

english: This pathetic holiday will come to an end and I'll laugh as it burns.
translation: 这个可悲的假期即将结束，我会在它燃烧时大笑。 [zhe ge ke bei de jia qi ji jiang jie shu ， wo hui zai ta ran shao shi da xiao 。]

english: That red buffoon will not be able to stop me, nor you, nor that dumb cat!
translation: 那个红小丑阻止不了我，也阻止不了你，也阻止不了那只笨猫！ [na ge hong xiao chou zu zhi bu liao wo ， ye zu zhi bu liao ni ， ye zu zhi bu liao na zhi ben mao ！]

english: Anti-Santa, Santa told me all about you.
translation: 反圣诞老人，圣诞老人告诉了我关于你的一切。 [fan sheng dan lao ren ， sheng dan lao ren gao su le wo guan yu ni de yi qie 。]

english: Don't mention his name to me, he's everything I hate about this repulsive holiday, I have always dreamed about tearing down this revolting time of year.
translation: 别跟我提他的名字，他就是我讨厌这个令人厌恶的假期的一切，我一直梦想着摧毁一年中这个令人厌恶的时刻。 [bie gen wo ti ta de ming zi ， ta jiu shi wo tao yan zhe ge ling ren yan wu de jia qi de yi qie ， wo yi zhi meng xiang zhe cui hui yi nian zhong zhe ge ling ren yan wu de shi ke 。]

english: Years ago I almost succeeded, but I was thwarted by that red buffoon and some dumb cat!
translation: 几年前我差一点就成功了，却被那个红小丑和一只笨猫给挫败了！ [ji nian qian wo cha yi dian jiu cheng gong le ， que bei na ge hong xiao chou he yi zhi ben mao gei cuo bai le ！]

english: But in the years I've been locked away, I've been plotting and scheming. When I escape from this cell....
translation: 但我被关起来的这些年里，我一直在阴谋诡计。当我逃离这个牢房时...... [dan wo bei guan qi lai de zhe xie nian li ， wo yi zhi zai yin mou gui ji 。 dang wo tao li zhe ge lao fang shi ......]

english: Yes, Christmas will never be the same, children will be crying instead of laughing!
translation: 是的，圣诞节永远不会一样，孩子们会哭而不是笑！ [shi de ， sheng dan jie yong yuan bu hui yi yang ， hai zi men hui ku er bu shi xiao ！]

english: The streets will be cold and lifeless.
translation: 街道将变得冰冷、毫无生气。 [jie dao jiang bian de bing leng 、 hao wu sheng qi 。]

english: I will stop Christmas once and for all!
translation: 我将一劳永逸地停止圣诞节！ [wo jiang yi lao yong yi di ting zhi sheng dan jie ！]

english: And soon it will be the year of the Anti-Christmas!
translation: 很快，反圣诞节就到了！ [hen kuai ， fan sheng dan jie jiu dao le ！]

english: *Snores*
translation: *打鼾* [* da han *]

english: OI!
translation: 哎哟！ [ai yo ！]

english: *Wakes up* Oh sorry! You were going on for a bit, I thought it'd never end.
translation: *醒来*哦，对不起！你持续了一会儿，我以为它永远不会结束。 [* xing lai * o ， dui bu qi ！ ni chi xu le yi hui er ， wo yi wei ta yong yuan bu hui jie shu 。]

english: You've been moved to the top of my kill list [player name].
translation: 你已被移至我的击杀列表的顶部[玩家姓名]。 [ni yi bei yi zhi wo de ji sha lie biao de ding bu [ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Let's cut to the chase, I need your help Anti-Santa.
translation: 让我们切入正题吧，我需要你的帮助，反圣诞老人。 [rang wo men qie ru zheng ti ba ， wo xu yao ni de bang zhu ， fan sheng dan lao ren 。]

english: Oh, so you've come begging to me for help, what makes you think I would help you?
translation: 哦，既然你来向我求助，你凭什么认为我会帮助你？ [o ， ji ran ni lai xiang wo qiu zhu ， ni ping shen me ren wei wo hui bang zhu ni ？]

english: What other choice do you have? It looks incredibly boring in this cell.
translation: 你还有什么选择？这个牢房看起来非常无聊。 [ni hai you shen me xuan ze ？ zhe ge lao fang kan qi lai fei chang wu liao 。]

english: Well, that's true, but I'd rather that than help you.
translation: 嗯，确实如此，但我宁愿这样也不愿帮助你。 [n ， que shi ru ci ， dan wo ning yuan zhe yang ye bu yuan bang zhu ni 。]

english: You're so over dramatic. Santa said he'd consider freeing you only if you help us.
translation: 你太戏剧化了。圣诞老人说只有你帮助我们他才会考虑释放你。 [ni tai xi ju hua le 。 sheng dan lao ren shuo zhi you ni bang zhu wo men ta cai hui kao lv shi fang ni 。]

english: Oh did he... ...now might be my chance to escape this cell... you know what. I will help you.
translation: 哦，他是吗……现在可能是我逃离牢房的机会……你知道吗。我会帮助你。 [o ， ta shi ma …… xian zai ke neng shi wo tao li lao fang de ji hui …… ni zhi dao ma 。 wo hui bang zhu ni 。]

english: Finally, he needs you to deal with Jack Frost at a bakery in Varrock.
translation: 最后，他需要你去瓦罗克的一家面包店对付杰克·弗罗斯特。 [zui hou ， ta xu yao ni qu wa luo ke de yi jia mian bao dian dui fu jie ke · fu luo si te 。]

english: Is that it? Why can't he do it himself?
translation: 是这样吗？为什么他自己不能做呢？ [shi zhe yang ma ？ wei shen me ta zi ji bu neng zuo ne ？]

english: He's testing a new parenting technique.
translation: 他正在测试一种新的育儿技巧。 [ta zheng zai ce shi yi zhong xin de yu er ji qiao 。]

english: Really? How are we meant to get into this bakery?
translation: 真的吗？我们怎样才能进入这家面包店？ [zhen de ma ？ wo men zen yang cai neng jin ru zhe jia mian bao dian ？]

english: He gave me this teleport tablet, it will take us right inside of the bakery.
translation: 他给了我这个传送平板电脑，它将带我们直接进入面包店。 [ta gei le wo zhe ge chuan song ping ban dian nao ， ta jiang dai wo men zhi jie jin ru mian bao dian 。]

english: After all these years, he's still making adventurers do his dirty work. He's just as bad as me.
translation: 这么多年了，他仍然让冒险者做他的肮脏工作。他和我一样坏。 [zhe me duo nian le ， ta reng ran rang mao xian zhe zuo ta de ang zang gong zuo 。 ta he wo yi yang huai 。]

english: Trust me, I'm getting tired of it as well, we need to go before it's too late.
translation: 相信我，我也厌倦了，我们需要在为时已晚之前离开。 [xiang xin wo ， wo ye yan juan le ， wo men xu yao zai wei shi yi wan zhi qian li kai 。]

english: Ha Ha Ha If it isn't Jack Frost. You look smaller than last time I saw you.
translation: 哈哈哈如果不是杰克·弗罗斯特。你看上去比我上次见到你时要小一些。 [ha ha ha ru guo bu shi jie ke · fu luo si te 。 ni kan shang qu bi wo shang ci jian dao ni shi yao xiao yi xie 。]

english: A-A-Anti Santa!? What are you doing here?
translation: 啊啊啊反圣诞老人！？你在这里做什么？ [a a a fan sheng dan lao ren ！？ ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Your father sent me. Apparently, you've been rather naughty this year.
translation: 你父亲派我来的。看来你今年过得很调皮。 [ni fu qin pai wo lai de 。 kan lai ni jin nian guo de hen tiao pi 。]

english: I'm here to sort you out.
translation: 我是来给你安排的。 [wo shi lai gei ni an pai de 。]

english: What? My dad sent you? No way, he put me in charge of Christmas.
translation: 什么？我爸派你来的？没办法，他让我负责圣诞节。 [shen me ？ wo ba pai ni lai de ？ mei ban fa ， ta rang wo fu ze sheng dan jie 。]

english: He did and apparently you're doing such an awful job of it, you've ruined it for everyone...
translation: 他做到了，显然你做得太糟糕了，你毁了每个人的一切...... [ta zuo dao le ， xian ran ni zuo de tai zao gao le ， ni hui le mei ge ren de yi qie ......]

english: When you think about it, are you sure you're not my son?
translation: 你想一想，你确定你不是我儿子吗？ [ni xiang yi xiang ， ni que ding ni bu shi wo er zi ma ？]

english: You're not my father, you're just an ugly bag of bones.
translation: 你不是我的父亲，你只是一具丑陋的骨头。 [ni bu shi wo de fu qin ， ni zhi shi yi ju chou lou de gu tou 。]

english: I won't let you stop me. Take this!
translation: 我不会让你阻止我。拿着这个！ [wo bu hui rang ni zu zhi wo 。 na zhe zhe ge ！]

english: Ha Ha Ha. Is that all you've got, Jack?
translation: 哈哈哈。这就是你的全部了，杰克？ [ha ha ha 。 zhe jiu shi ni de quan bu le ， jie ke ？]

english: Oh come on! How did that not hurt you?
translation: 哦来吧！那怎么没有伤害你？ [o lai ba ！ na zen me mei you shang hai ni ？]

english: You're weak just like your father.
translation: 你和你父亲一样软弱。 [ni he ni fu qin yi yang ruan ruo 。]

english: I'm gonna slap you back to Lumbridge!
translation: 我要把你扇回朗布里奇！ [wo yao ba ni shan hui lang bu li qi ！]

english: Argh!
You're going to need a lot worse to defeat me.
translation: 你需要比我更糟糕才能打败我。 [ni xu yao bi wo geng zao gao cai neng da bai wo 。]

english: Good thing I'm not done yet.
translation: 还好我还没做完。 [hai hao wo hai mei zuo wan 。]

english: I learned this from an old friend of mine.
translation: 这是我从一位老朋友那里得知的。 [zhe shi wo cong yi wei lao peng you na li de zhi de 。]

english: Ouch!
translation: 哎哟! [ai yo !]

english: You cannot stop me Jack.
translation: 你无法阻止我，杰克。 [ni wu fa zu zhi wo ， jie ke 。]

english: I'm not finished yet.
translation: 我还没说完。 [wo hai mei shuo wan 。]

english: Mummy!
translation: 木乃伊！ [mu nai yi ！]

english: I'm getting out of here. This isn't worth it!
translation: 我要离开这里。这不值得！ [wo yao li kai zhe li 。 zhe bu zhi de ！]

english: Uhh...
That didn't go as planned.
translation: 但这并没有按计划进行。 [dan zhe bing mei you an ji hua jin xing 。]

english: Ha Ha Ha. He won't get away that easily!
translation: 哈哈哈。他不会那么轻易逃脱的！ [ha ha ha 。 ta bu hui na me qing yi tao tuo de ！]

english: I'll be back to deal with you soon [player name]....
translation: 我很快就会回来和你打交道[玩家姓名]...... [wo hen kuai jiu hui hui lai he ni da jiao dao [ wan jia xing ming ]......]

english: Ahhh, hello there. How can I help?
translation: 啊啊，你好。我能提供什么帮助吗？ [a a ， ni hao 。 wo neng ti gong shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: Looks like you have a good selection of weapons around here...
translation: 看来你这里有很多不错的武器可供选择...... [kan lai ni zhe li you hen duo bu cuo de wu qi ke gong xuan ze ......]

english: Indeed so, specially imported from the finest smiths around the lands, take a look at my wares.
