translation: 确实如此，专门从各地最好的铁匠那里进口的，看看我的商品。 [que shi ru ci ， zhuan men cong ge di zui hao de tie jiang na li jin kou de ， kan kan wo de shang pin 。]

english: A fine selection of blades for you to peruse, come take a look!
translation: 精选刀片供您细读，快来看看吧！ [jing xuan dao pian gong nin xi du ， kuai lai kan kan ba ！]

english: Armours and axes to suit your needs.
translation: 满足您需求的盔甲和斧头。 [man zu nin xu qiu de kui jia he fu tou 。]

english: Imported weapons from the finest smithys around the lands!
translation: 来自各地最好的铁匠铺的进口武器！ [lai zi ge di zui hao de tie jiang pu de jin kou wu qi ！]

english: Ow my toe! That armour is heavy.
translation: 哎哟我的脚趾！那铠甲很重。 [ai yo wo de jiao zhi ！ na kai jia hen zhong 。]

english: Hello there. Interested in sailing to the island of Aldarin? It's 20 coins for the journey.
translation: 你好呀。有兴趣航行到阿尔达林岛吗？路费是20个硬币。 [ni hao ya 。 you xing qu hang xing dao a er da lin dao ma ？ lu fei shi 20 ge ying bi 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Come back when you've got 20 coins for me.
translation: 等你给我20个金币就回来吧。 [deng ni gei wo 20 ge jin bi jiu hui lai ba 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Fair enough.
translation: 很公平。 [hen gong ping 。]

english: How about I pay you nothing at all...
translation: 我什么都不付给你怎么样... [wo shen me dou bu fu gei ni zen me yang ...]

english: Sounds good to me. Hop aboard!
translation: 对我来说听起来不错。跳上车吧！ [dui wo lai shuo ting qi lai bu cuo 。 tiao shang che ba ！]

english: Hello there. Interested in sailing to Sunset Coast? It's 20 coins for the journey.
translation: 你好呀。有兴趣航行到日落海岸吗？路费是20个硬币。 [ni hao ya 。 you xing qu hang xing dao ri luo hai an ma ？ lu fei shi 20 ge ying bi 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: [Charm] How about I pay you nothing at all...
translation: [魅力] 我什么都不付给你怎么样... [[ mei li ]  wo shen me dou bu fu gei ni zen me yang ...]

english: Welcome to the Moonrise Brewery and Winery, the oldest and largest producer of alcohol in all of Varlamore.
translation: 欢迎来到月出啤酒厂和酒庄，这是瓦拉莫尔最古老、最大的酒精生产商。 [huan ying lai dao yue chu pi jiu chang he jiu zhuang ， zhe shi wa la mo er zui gu lao 、 zui da de jiu jing sheng chan shang 。]

english: Could I buy some wine?
translation: 我可以买点酒吗？ [wo ke yi mai dian jiu ma ？]

english: Certainly!
translation: 当然！ [dang ran ！]

english: Could you tell me more about this place?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于这个地方的信息吗？ [ni neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu zhe ge di fang de xin xi ma ？]

english: Of course! The Moonrise Winery was originally opened over 400 years ago by Bracus Ramio.
translation: 当然！ Moonrise 酒庄最初由 Bracus Ramio 于 400 多年前开设。 [dang ran ！ Moonrise  jiu zhuang zui chu you  Bracus Ramio  yu  400  duo nian qian kai she 。]

english: While we originally started off as just a winery, the brewing side of the business was established by Bracus' grandson, Ludovic, when he created the now famous sunbeam ale!
translation: 虽然我们最初只是一家酿酒厂，但酿酒业务是由 Bracus 的孙子 Ludovic 创立的，当时他创造了现在著名的阳光啤酒！ [sui ran wo men zui chu zhi shi yi jia niang jiu chang ， dan niang jiu ye wu shi you  Bracus  de sun zi  Ludovic  chuang li de ， dang shi ta chuang zao le xian zai zhu ming de yang guang pi jiu ！]

english: So it was a family business? Do the family still own it today?
translation: 那么这是一个家族企业吗？该家族今天仍然拥有它吗？ [na me zhe shi yi ge jia zu qi ye ma ？ gai jia zu jin tian reng ran yong you ta ma ？]

english: Unfortunately not. Ludovic found himself in a tragic and unexpected wine-related incident before ever having children himself. After his death, the business was taken over by a collective.
translation: 不幸的是没有。卢多维奇在自己生孩子之前就发现自己陷入了一场与葡萄酒有关的悲惨且意想不到的事件。他去世后，公司由集体接管。 [bu xing de shi mei you 。 lu duo wei qi zai zi ji sheng hai zi zhi qian jiu fa xian zi ji xian ru le yi chang yu pu tao jiu you guan de bei can qie yi xiang bu dao de shi jian 。 ta qu shi hou ， gong si you ji ti jie guan 。]

english: A collective?
translation: 一个集体？ [yi ge ji ti ？]

english: That's right. Some of the most influential people all across Varlamore have a stake in the Moonrise Brewery and Winery these days, though most prefer to stay anonymous.
translation: 这是正确的。如今，瓦拉莫尔一些最有影响力的人都拥有月出啤酒厂和酒庄的股份，尽管大多数人更愿意保持匿名。 [zhe shi zheng que de 。 ru jin ， wa la mo er yi xie zui you ying xiang li de ren dou yong you yue chu pi jiu chang he jiu zhuang de gu fen ， jin guan da duo shu ren geng yuan yi bao chi ni ming 。]

english: Anonymous? How come?
translation: 匿名的？怎么会？ [ni ming de ？ zen me hui ？]

english: Ah, well their reasoning is something only they know.
translation: 啊，好吧，他们的推理只有他们自己知道。 [a ， hao ba ， ta men de tui li zhi you ta men zi ji zhi dao 。]

english: I see. Thanks for the information.
translation: 我懂了。感谢您提供信息。 [wo dong le 。 gan xie nin ti gong xin xi 。]

english: Not at all. Now, is there anything else I can do for you?
translation: 一点也不。现在，还有什么我可以为您做的吗？ [yi dian ye bu 。 xian zai ， hai you shen me wo ke yi wei nin zuo de ma ？]

english: I'd better be on my way.
translation: 我最好还是上路吧。 [wo zui hao hai shi shang lu ba 。]

english: Do come back soon!
translation: 一定要快点回来！ [yi ding yao kuai dian hui lai ！]

english: Could I buy some wine?
translation: 我可以买点酒吗？ [wo ke yi mai dian jiu ma ？]

english: Could you tell me more about this place?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于这个地方的信息吗？ [ni neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu zhe ge di fang de xin xi ma ？]

english: I'd better be on my way.
translation: 我最好还是上路吧。 [wo zui hao hai shi shang lu ba 。]

english: I buy silk. If you ever want to sell any silk, bring it here.
translation: 我买丝绸。如果你想卖任何丝绸，就把它带到这里来。 [wo mai si chou 。 ru guo ni xiang mai ren he si chou ， jiu ba ta dai dao zhe li lai 。]

english: Hello. I have some fine silk from far away to sell to you.
translation: 你好。我有一些远方的精美丝绸要卖给你。 [ni hao 。 wo you yi xie yuan fang de jing mei si chou yao mai gei ni 。]

english: Ah I may be interested in that. What sort of price were you looking at per piece of silk?
translation: 啊，我可能对此感兴趣。您考虑的每块丝绸的价格是多少？ [a ， wo ke neng dui ci gan xing qu 。 nin kao lv de mei kuai si chou de jia ge shi duo shao ？]

english: 20 coins.
translation: 20枚硬币。 [20 mei ying bi 。]

english: Ok suits me.
translation: 好的适合我。 [hao de shi he wo 。]

english: 80 coins.
translation: 80个硬币。 [80 ge ying bi 。]

english: 80 coins? That's a bit steep! How about 40 coins?
translation: 80金币？这有点陡啊！ 40金币怎么样？ [80 jin bi ？ zhe you dian dou a ！ 40 jin bi zen me yang ？]

english: Ok, 40 sounds good.
translation: 好吧，40 听起来不错。 [hao ba ，40  ting qi lai bu cuo 。]

english: 50, and that's my final price.
translation: 50，这就是我的最终价格。 [50， zhe jiu shi wo de zui zhong jia ge 。]

english: Done.
translation: 完毕。 [wan bi 。]

english: No, that is not enough.
translation: 不，这还不够。 [bu ， zhe hai bu gou 。]

english: 120 coins.
translation: 120个硬币。 [120 ge ying bi 。]

english: You'll never get that much for it. I'll be generous and give you 50 for it.
translation: 你永远不会得到那么多。我会很慷慨地给你50。 [ni yong yuan bu hui de dao na me duo 。 wo hui hen kang kai di gei ni 50。]

english: Ok, I guess 50 will do.
translation: 好吧，我想50个就够了。 [hao ba ， wo xiang 50 ge jiu gou le 。]

english: I'll give it to you for 60.
translation: 我给你60。 [wo gei ni 60。]

english: You drive a hard bargain, but I guess that will have to do.
translation: 你讨价还价很艰难，但我想那是必须的。 [ni tao jia huan jia hen jian nan ， dan wo xiang na shi bi xu de 。]

english: 200 coins.
translation: 200金币。 [200 jin bi 。]

english: Don't be ridiculous! That is far too much. You insult me with that price.
translation: 别开玩笑了！这太过分了。你用这个价格侮辱我。 [bie kai wan xiao le ！ zhe tai guo fen le 。 ni yong zhe ge jia ge wu ru wo 。]

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
translation: 嘿！把你的手拿开！ [hei ！ ba ni de shou na kai ！]

english: You're the one who stole something from me!
translation: 你就是偷了我东西的人！ [ni jiu shi tou le wo dong xi de ren ！]

english: Guards guards!
translation: 卫兵卫兵！ [wei bing wei bing ！]

english: 20 coins.
translation: 20枚硬币。 [20 mei ying bi 。]

english: 80 coins.
translation: 80个硬币。 [80 ge ying bi 。]

english: Ok, 40 sounds good.
translation: 好吧，40 听起来不错。 [hao ba ，40  ting qi lai bu cuo 。]

english: 50, and that's my final price.
translation: 50，这就是我的最终价格。 [50， zhe jiu shi wo de zui zhong jia ge 。]

english: No, that is not enough.
translation: 不，这还不够。 [bu ， zhe hai bu gou 。]

english: 120 coins.
translation: 120个硬币。 [120 ge ying bi 。]

english: Ok, I guess 50 will do.
translation: 好吧，我想50个就够了。 [hao ba ， wo xiang 50 ge jiu gou le 。]

english: I'll give it to you for 60.
translation: 我给你60。 [wo gei ni 60。]

english: 200 coins.
translation: 200金币。 [200 jin bi 。]

english: You did it! I wasn't sure I'd make it out of that one, but I'm glad you proved me wrong. Come, let's get out of here.
translation: 你做到了！我不确定我是否能成功，但我很高兴你证明我错了。来吧，我们离开这里吧。 [ni zuo dao le ！ wo bu que ding wo shi fou neng cheng gong ， dan wo hen gao xing ni zheng ming wo cuo le 。 lai ba ， wo men li kai zhe li ba 。]

english: Hi there. How are you doing?
translation: 你好呀。你好吗？ [ni hao ya 。 ni hao ma ？]

english: Oh, you know, just getting over years of being controlled by a deranged family member. All part of the fun in a family like ours, I guess.
translation: 哦，你知道，刚刚经历了多年被一个精神错乱的家庭成员控制的日子。我想，这都是像我们这样的家庭中的乐趣的一部分。 [o ， ni zhi dao ， gang gang jing li le duo nian bei yi ge jing shen cuo luan de jia ting cheng yuan kong zhi de ri zi 。 wo xiang ， zhe dou shi xiang wo men zhe yang de jia ting zhong de le qu de yi bu fen 。]

english: You seem quite jolly about it all.
translation: 你看起来对这一切都很高兴。 [ni kan qi lai dui zhe yi qie dou hen gao xing 。]

english: Well as I always say, 'the real winner is the one smiling.' What Amascut has done is horrific, but it's not too late to stop her. I won't let her get me down, not while there's still hope.
translation: 正如我常说的，“真正的赢家是微笑的人。”阿马斯卡特的所作所为非常可怕，但现在阻止她还为时不晚。我不会让她让我失望，只要还有希望。 [zheng ru wo chang shuo de ，“ zhen zheng de ying jia shi wei xiao de ren 。” a ma si ka te de suo zuo suo wei fei chang ke pa ， dan xian zai zu zhi ta hai wei shi bu wan 。 wo bu hui rang ta rang wo shi wang ， zhi yao hai you xi wang 。]

english: Anyway, I'm annoyingly a bit too weak to help you much down here. However, I reckon if you can free the others, we'll be able to open the way to the lower level for you.
translation: 无论如何，我有点太虚弱了，无法在这儿帮助你。不过，我想，如果你能释放其他人，我们就能为你打开通往下层的道路。 [wu lun ru he ， wo you dian tai xu ruo le ， wu fa zai zhe er bang zhu ni 。 bu guo ， wo xiang ， ru guo ni neng shi fang qi ta ren ， wo men jiu neng wei ni da kai tong wang xia ceng de dao lu 。]

english: We've been able to open the way for you! I wish we could help you down there, but we're still too weak. Don't worry though, I know you can do it!
translation: 我们已经为您开辟了道路！我希望我们能在那里帮助你，但我们还是太弱了。不过别担心，我知道你能做到！ [wo men yi jing wei nin kai pi le dao lu ！ wo xi wang wo men neng zai na li bang zhu ni ， dan wo men hai shi tai ruo le 。 bu guo bie dan xin ， wo zhi dao ni neng zuo dao ！]

english: Here he is!
translation: 他在这里！ [ta zai zhe li ！]

english: My friend, you managed what few have ever achieved. You overcame Amascut herself! I wish I could have been there to see it!
translation: 我的朋友，你取得了很少有人能取得的成就。你战胜了阿马斯库特本人！我希望我能去那里看到它！ [wo de peng you ， ni qu de le hen shao you ren neng qu de de cheng jiu 。 ni zhan sheng le a ma si ku te ben ren ！ wo xi wang wo neng qu na li kan dao ta ！]

english: Well I couldn't have done it alone. Speaking of which, where's Scabaras?
translation: 好吧，我一个人是做不到的。说到这里，斯卡巴拉斯在哪里？ [hao ba ， wo yi ge ren shi zuo bu dao de 。 shuo dao zhe li ， si ka ba la si zai na li ？]

english: Scabaras walks his own path. Do not consider his absence an insult. This is his way.
translation: 斯卡拉斯走自己的路。不要认为他的缺席是一种侮辱。这是他的方式。 [si ka la si zou zi ji de lu 。 bu yao ren wei ta de que xi shi yi zhong wu ru 。 zhe shi ta de fang shi 。]

english: Not to mention that he was under Amascut's control far longer than the rest of us. It will take him time to come to terms with his role in her plots.
translation: 更不用说他受阿马斯卡特控制的时间比我们其他人要长得多。他需要一段时间才能接受自己在她的情节中所扮演的角色。 [geng bu yong shuo ta shou a ma si ka te kong zhi de shi jian bi wo men qi ta ren yao zhang de duo 。 ta xu yao yi duan shi jian cai neng jie shou zi ji zai ta de qing jie zhong suo ban yan de jue se 。]

english: Don't worry, he'll be okay. He always is.
translation: 别担心，他会没事的。他总是这样。 [bie dan xin ， ta hui mei shi de 。 ta zong shi zhe yang 。]

english: Before we go any further... We didn't have much time for conversation back in the tomb. I'm sure you have some questions for us.
translation: 在我们继续之前……我们在坟墓里没有太多时间交谈。我确信您有一些问题想问我们。 [zai wo men ji xu zhi qian …… wo men zai fen mu li mei you tai duo shi jian jiao tan 。 wo que xin nin you yi xie wen ti xiang wen wo men 。]

english: If you do, now is the time to ask them.
translation: 如果您这样做，现在是时候询问他们了。 [ru guo nin zhe yang zuo ， xian zai shi shi hou xun wen ta men le 。]

english: I have a question for Apmeken.
translation: 我有一个问题要问阿普梅肯。 [wo you yi ge wen ti yao wen a pu mei ken 。]

english: What's your role in the Menaphite Pantheon?
translation: 你在梅纳菲特万神殿中的角色是什么？ [ni zai mei na fei te wan shen dian zhong de jue se shi shen me ？]

english: I'm Tumeken's avatar of companionship! Tumeken himself was always considered a bit cold, which is a tad ironic when you think about it.
translation: 我是图梅肯的陪伴化身！图梅肯本人一直被认为有点冷漠，想想就有点讽刺。 [wo shi tu mei ken de pei ban hua shen ！ tu mei ken ben ren yi zhi bei ren wei you dian leng mo ， xiang xiang jiu you dian feng ci 。]

english: A cold sun god?
translation: 寒冷的太阳神？ [han leng de tai yang shen ？]

english: Exactly! Bit odd, right? Still, although he wasn't exactly known for his social side, he still understood the importance of such things. That's why he made me!
translation: 确切地！有点奇怪，对吧？尽管如此，尽管他并不以其社交方面而闻名，但他仍然了解这些事情的重要性。这就是他创造我的原因！ [que qie di ！ you dian qi guai ， dui ba ？ jin guan ru ci ， jin guan ta bing bu yi qi she jiao fang mian er wen ming ， dan ta reng ran liao jie zhe xie shi qing de zhong yao xing 。 zhe jiu shi ta chuang zao wo de yuan yin ！]

english: My job is to make sure everyone remembers the importance of friendship. After all, we all need a friend or two, or ten, or maybe hundreds! Have as many as you want! I won't judge.
translation: 我的工作是确保每个人都记住友谊的重要性。毕竟，我们都需要一两个、十个、甚至数百个朋友！你想要多少就拥有多少！我不会评判。 [wo de gong zuo shi que bao mei ge ren dou ji zhu you yi de zhong yao xing 。 bi jing ， wo men dou xu yao yi liang ge 、 shi ge 、 shen zhi shu bai ge peng you ！ ni xiang yao duo shao jiu yong you duo shao ！ wo bu hui ping pan 。]

english: Why aren't there more monkeys or apes in the desert?
translation: 为什么沙漠里没有更多的猴子或猿类？ [wei shen me sha mo li mei you geng duo de hou zi huo yuan lei ？]

english: Ah, you can thank Amascut for that. The desert used to be home to thousands of apes and monkeys, but she targeted them to try and get to me.
translation: 啊，你可以为此感谢阿马斯卡特。沙漠曾经是数千只猿类和猴子的家园，但她却以它们为目标，试图接近我。 [a ， ni ke yi wei ci gan xie a ma si ka te 。 sha mo ceng jing shi shu qian zhi yuan lei he hou zi de jia yuan ， dan ta que yi ta men wei mu biao ， shi tu jie jin wo 。]

english: I'm sorry.
translation: 对不起。 [dui bu qi 。]

english: Don't be! Now that I'm back, I know we can turn things around!
translation: 别这样！现在我回来了，我知道我们可以扭转局面！ [bie zhe yang ！ xian zai wo hui lai le ， wo zhi dao wo men ke yi niu zhuan ju mian ！]

english: Actually, I've changed my mind.
translation: 事实上，我已经改变主意了。 [shi shi shang ， wo yi jing gai bian zhu yi le 。]

english: Fair enough.
translation: 很公平。 [hen gong ping 。]

english: I'll be back soon.
translation: 我很快就会回来。 [wo hen kuai jiu hui hui lai 。]

english: We'll be here when you're ready.
translation: 当您准备好时我们会在这里。 [dang nin zhun bei hao shi wo men hui zai zhe li 。]

english: I have a question for Crondis.
translation: 我有一个问题要问克朗迪斯。 [wo you yi ge wen ti yao wen ke lang di si 。]

english: I am Tumeken's avatar of resourcefulness.
translation: 我是图梅肯足智多谋的化身。 [wo shi tu mei ken zu zhi duo mou de hua shen 。]

english: Meaning?
translation: 意义？ [yi yi ？]

english: Meaning my job is to guide the people of the desert not to live lives of excess.
translation: 这意味着我的工作是引导沙漠人民不要过着奢侈的生活。 [zhe yi wei zhe wo de gong zuo shi yin dao sha mo ren min bu yao guo zhe she chi de sheng huo 。]

english: Guessing you're not a fan of Menaphos then?
translation: 猜猜你不是梅纳福斯的粉丝？ [cai cai ni bu shi mei na fu si de fen si ？]

english: Much of the desert has forgotten the importance of modesty in my absence, but the situation in Menaphos is definitely the most concerning. Let us hope it can soon be rectified.
translation: 在我不在的情况下，沙漠中的大部分人都忘记了谦虚的重要性，但米纳福斯的情况绝对是最令人担忧的。让我们希望它能够尽快得到纠正。 [zai wo bu zai de qing kuang xia ， sha mo zhong de da bu fen ren dou wang ji le qian xu de zhong yao xing ， dan mi na fu si de qing kuang jue dui shi zui ling ren dan you de 。 rang wo men xi wang ta neng gou jin kuai de dao jiu zheng 。]

english: Why are crocodiles so rude?
translation: 鳄鱼为何如此粗鲁？ [e yu wei he ru ci cu lu ？]

english: Rude? How so.
translation: 粗鲁的？为何如此。 [cu lu de ？ wei he ru ci 。]

english: Well they always try to eat me when I go near them.
translation: 好吧，当我靠近它们时，它们总是想吃掉我。 [hao ba ， dang wo kao jin ta men shi ， ta men zong shi xiang chi diao wo 。]

english: The life of a crocodile is not an easy one. They must seek food wherever it is available.
translation: 鳄鱼的生活并不轻松。他们必须在任何有食物的地方寻找食物。 [e yu de sheng huo bing bu qing song 。 ta men bi xu zai ren he you shi wu de di fang xun zhao shi wu 。]

english: Besides, I sense you do not speak the whole truth. Did you not befriend a crocodile yourself in times past?
translation: 此外，我感觉你没有说出全部真相。你过去没有和鳄鱼交过朋友吗？ [ci wai ， wo gan jue ni mei you shuo chu quan bu zhen xiang 。 ni guo qu mei you he e yu jiao guo peng you ma ？]

english: You mean Roger! I guess he was quite friendly.
translation: 你说的是罗杰！我猜他是相当友好的。 [ni shuo de shi luo jie ！ wo cai ta shi xiang dang you hao de 。]

english: Then perhaps crocodiles are not as rude as you think.
translation: 那么也许鳄鱼并不像你想象的那么粗鲁。 [na me ye xu e yu bing bu xiang ni xiang xiang de na me cu lu 。]

english: As you wish.
translation: 如你所愿。 [ru ni suo yuan 。]

english: We will be here.
translation: 我们会在这里。 [wo men hui zai zhe li 。]

english: I have a question for Het.
translation: 我有一个问题要问Het。 [wo you yi ge wen ti yao wen Het。]

english: I am Tumeken's avatar of health, both physical and mental.
translation: 我是图梅肯健康的化身，无论是身体上还是精神上。 [wo shi tu mei ken jian kang de hua shen ， wu lun shi shen ti shang hai shi jing shen shang 。]

english: You talk about strength and fighting a lot. Surely fighting isn't good for someone's health.
translation: 你经常谈论力量和战斗。打架肯定不利于某人的健康。 [ni jing chang tan lun li liang he zhan dou 。 da jia ken ding bu li yu mou ren de jian kang 。]

english: Well when it comes to health, is strength not the ultimate goal? The strongest individual is one who is healthy in both body and mind, and what better way to celebrate that strength than in combat!
translation: 那么说到健康，力量不就是终极目标吗？最坚强的人是身体和精神都健康的人，还有什么比战斗更好的方式来庆祝这种力量呢！ [na me shuo dao jian kang ， li liang bu jiu shi zhong ji mu biao ma ？ zui jian qiang de ren shi shen ti he jing shen dou jian kang de ren ， hai you shen me bi zhan dou geng hao de fang shi lai qing zhu zhe zhong li liang ne ！]

english: I guess, but what about those who aren't strong?
translation: 我想，但是那些实力不强的人呢？ [wo xiang ， dan shi na xie shi li bu qiang de ren ne ？]

english: Well health is not something to be hoarded, is it? Most weaknesses can be overcome, and it is the duty of the strong to help those less fortunate.
translation: 健康不是可以囤积的东西，不是吗？大多数弱点都是可以克服的，强者有责任帮助那些不幸的人。 [jian kang bu shi ke yi tun ji de dong xi ， bu shi ma ？ da duo shu ruo dian dou shi ke yi ke fu de ， qiang zhe you ze ren bang zhu na xie bu xing de ren 。]

english: So they can become strong and healthy themselves?
translation: 那么他们自己就能变得强壮和健康吗？ [na me ta men zi ji jiu neng bian de qiang zhuang he jian kang ma ？]

english: Exactly!
translation: 确切地！ [que qie di ！]

english: An interesting question. Why do you ask?
translation: 一个有趣的问题。你为什么问？ [yi ge you qu de wen ti 。 ni wei shen me wen ？]

english: Considering you have a human appearance, I wondered if that might resonate more with people.
translation: 考虑到你有人类的外表，我想知道这是否会更能引起人们的共鸣。 [kao lv dao ni you ren lei de wai biao ， wo xiang zhi dao zhe shi fou hui geng neng yin qi ren men de gong ming 。]

english: Not as much as you might think. Believe it or not, in some ways, I'm actually considered a bit boring! Why follow the human when you have a baboon god?
translation: 没有你想象的那么多。不管你信不信，在某些方面，我实际上被认为有点无聊！既然有狒狒神，为什么还要追随人类呢？ [mei you ni xiang xiang de na me duo 。 bu guan ni xin bu xin ， zai mou xie fang mian ， wo shi ji shang bei ren wei you dian wu liao ！ ji ran you fei fei shen ， wei shen me hai yao zhui sui ren lei ne ？]

english: Especially when the baboon god is so fun to be around!
translation: 尤其是当狒狒神在身边真是太有趣了！ [you qi shi dang fei fei shen zai shen bian zhen shi tai you qu le ！]

english: Of course, people just following one of us was never really the intention anyway. We're a pantheon, and we all have a part to play.
translation: 当然，人们只是跟踪我们中的一个人从来都不是真正的意图。我们是万神殿，我们都有自己的职责。 [dang ran ， ren men zhi shi gen zong wo men zhong de yi ge ren cong lai dou bu shi zhen zheng de yi tu 。 wo men shi wan shen dian ， wo men dou you zi ji de zhi ze 。]

english: Now that Amascut is running with her tail between her legs, perhaps we can remind people of that.
translation: 现在阿马斯卡特夹着尾巴奔跑，也许我们可以提醒人们这一点。 [xian zai a ma si ka te jia zhe wei ba ben pao ， ye xu wo men ke yi ti xing ren men zhe yi dian 。]

english: Very well.
translation: 很好。 [hen hao 。]

english: We'll wait for you to return.
translation: 我们会等你回来。 [wo men hui deng ni hui lai 。]

english: I have a question for all of you.
translation: 我有一个问题想问大家。 [wo you yi ge wen ti xiang wen da jia 。]

english: What will happen with Amascut?
translation: 阿马斯卡特会发生什么？ [a ma si ka te hui fa sheng shen me ？]

english: I'd say that's up to her. If she doesn't change her ways, her fate won't be pretty.
translation: 我想说这取决于她。如果她不改变自己的做法，她的命运就不会那么美好。 [wo xiang shuo zhe qu jue yu ta 。 ru guo ta bu gai bian zi ji de zuo fa ， ta de ming yun jiu bu hui na me mei hao 。]

english: But it's never too late for redemption. There might still be hope for her.
translation: 但救赎永远不会太晚。她或许还有希望。 [dan jiu shu yong yuan bu hui tai wan 。 ta huo xu hai you xi wang 。]

english: Whatever path she takes, we will be ready.
translation: 无论她走哪条路，我们都会做好准备。 [wu lun ta zou na tiao lu ， wo men du hui zuo hao zhun bei 。]

english: Do you really think she'd change her ways at this point?
translation: 你真的认为她现在会改变她的方式吗？ [ni zhen de ren wei ta xian zai hui gai bian ta de fang shi ma ？]

english: It seems unlikely, but there is one who might be able to change that.
translation: 这似乎不太可能，但有人可能能够改变这一状况。 [zhe si hu bu tai ke neng ， dan you ren ke neng neng gou gai bian zhe yi zhuang kuang 。]

english: Who?
translation: WHO？ [WHO？]

english: Icthlarin! If anyone can help Amascut find her way again, it's him!
translation: 异丙嗪！如果有人能帮助阿马斯卡特再次找到出路，那就是他了！ [yi bing qin ！ ru guo you ren neng bang zhu a ma si ka te zai ci zhao dao chu lu ， na jiu shi ta le ！]

english: He doesn't seem to have been doing much to help so far.
translation: 到目前为止，他似乎并没有提供太多帮助。 [dao mu qian wei zhi ， ta si hu bing mei you ti gong tai duo bang zhu 。]

english: Icthlarin is limited in what he can do. His duties to the dead require constant attention.
translation: Icthlarin 的能力有限。他对死者的职责需要持续关注。 [Icthlarin  de neng li you xian 。 ta dui si zhe de zhi ze xu yao chi xu guan zhu 。]

english: Not to mention the pact!
translation: 更不用说契约了！ [geng bu yong shuo qi yue le ！]

english: Pact?
translation: 协议？ [xie yi ？]

english: That is not for us to discuss.
translation: 这不是我们要讨论的。 [zhe bu shi wo men yao tao lun de 。]

english: Oh yes, sorry. Maybe we should talk about something else.
translation: 哦，是的，抱歉。也许我们应该谈谈别的事情。 [o ， shi de ， bao qian 。 ye xu wo men ying gai tan tan bie de shi qing 。]

english: Are you actually gods?
translation: 你们真的是神吗？ [ni men zhen de shi shen ma ？]

english: If you asked a citizen of these lands, I'm sure they'd probably say yes.
translation: 如果你问这些国家的公民，我相信他们可能会说是。 [ru guo ni wen zhe xie guo jia de gong min ， wo xiang xin ta men ke neng hui shuo shi 。]

english: Indeed, but they would not be truly correct.
translation: 确实如此，但他们并不是真正正确的。 [que shi ru ci ， dan ta men bing bu shi zhen zheng zheng que de 。]

english: How so?
translation: 为何如此？ [wei he ru ci ？]

english: Tumeken made us using his own divine essence! Each of us is a piece of him!
translation: 图梅肯用他自己的神性本质创造了我们！我们每个人都是他的一部分！ [tu mei ken yong ta zi ji de shen xing ben zhi chuang zao le wo men ！ wo men mei ge ren dou shi ta de yi bu fen ！]

english: But that does not make us gods. While great, our power is insignificant compared to a true god. That is why they are gone, and we remain.
translation: 但这并不能使我们成为神。我们的力量虽然伟大，但与真正的神相比，却显得微不足道。这就是为什么他们走了，而我们留下了。 [dan zhe bing bu neng shi wo men cheng wei shen 。 wo men de li liang sui ran wei da ， dan yu zhen zheng de shen xiang bi ， que xian de wei bu zu dao 。 zhe jiu shi wei shen me ta men zou le ， er wo men liu xia le 。]

english: So what are you really?
translation: 那么你到底是什么？ [na me ni dao di shi shen me ？]

english: You might hear some refer to us as the Avatars of Tumeken. We'd consider that a more fitting title.
translation: 您可能会听到有人将我们称为图梅肯的化身。我们认为这是一个更合适的标题。 [nin ke neng hui ting dao you ren jiang wo men cheng wei tu mei ken de hua shen 。 wo men ren wei zhe shi yi ge geng he shi de biao ti 。]

english: What about Icthlarin and Amascut?
translation: Icthlarin 和 Amascut 怎么样？ [Icthlarin  he  Amascut  zen me yang ？]

english: Tumeken made them too. Difference is, they also have some of Elidinis' divine essence, making them a lot more powerful!
translation: 图梅肯也制造了它们。不同的是，他们还拥有一些艾利迪尼斯的神性精华，让他们的实力更加强大！ [tu mei ken ye zhi zao le ta men 。 bu tong de shi ， ta men hai yong you yi xie ai li di ni si de shen xing jing hua ， rang ta men de shi li geng jia qiang da ！]

english: But again, they are not true gods.
translation: 但话又说回来，他们并不是真正的神。 [dan hua you shuo hui lai ， ta men bing bu shi zhen zheng de shen 。]

english: Amascut was hoping to change that today, but you showed her where to stick that plan!
translation: 阿马斯卡特今天希望改变这一点，但你向她展示了该计划的执行方向！ [a ma si ka te jin tian xi wang gai bian zhe yi dian ， dan ni xiang ta zhan shi le gai ji hua de zhi xing fang xiang ！]

english: So what happens now?
translation: 那么现在会发生什么呢？ [na me xian zai hui fa sheng shen me ne ？]

english: We are the Avatars of Tumeken, and the Kharidian Desert has been without guidance for too long. It is time we fixed that.
translation: 我们是图梅肯的化身，而哈里迪沙漠已经太久没有指引了。现在是我们解决这个问题的时候了。 [wo men shi tu mei ken de hua shen ， er ha li di sha mo yi jing tai jiu mei you zhi yin le 。 xian zai shi wo men jie jue zhe ge wen ti de shi hou le 。]

english: We're going to get started right away!
translation: 我们马上就开始吧！ [wo men ma shang jiu kai shi ba ！]

english: But don't worry, we don't intend to miss the fight against Amascut. I hope you'll stand alongside us when that day comes.
translation: 但别担心，我们不想错过与阿马斯卡特的战斗。我希望当那一天来临的时候，你能和我们站在一起。 [dan bie dan xin ， wo men bu xiang cuo guo yu a ma si ka te de zhan dou 。 wo xi wang dang na yi tian lai lin de shi hou ， ni neng he wo men zhan zai yi qi 。]

english: For now though, this is goodbye. We will meet again, human.
translation: 但现在，这是再见了。我们还会再见面的，人类。 [dan xian zai ， zhe shi zai jian le 。 wo men hai hui zai jian mian de ， ren lei 。]

english: It was great to meet you. Thank you for helping us!
translation: 很高兴见到你。感谢您帮助我们！ [hen gao xing jian dao ni 。 gan xie nin bang zhu wo men ！]

english: The avatars depart.
translation: 化身离开。 [hua shen li kai 。]

english: You're back!
translation: 你回来了！ [ni hui lai le ！]

english: If you have questions, now is the time to ask them.
translation: 如果您有疑问，现在是时候提问了。 [ru guo nin you yi wen ， xian zai shi shi hou ti wen le 。]

english: I have a question for Apmeken.
translation: 我有一个问题要问阿普梅肯。 [wo you yi ge wen ti yao wen a pu mei ken 。]

english: What's your role in the Menaphite Pantheon?
translation: 你在梅纳菲特万神殿中的角色是什么？ [ni zai mei na fei te wan shen dian zhong de jue se shi shen me ？]

english: Why aren't there more monkeys or apes in the desert?
translation: 为什么沙漠里没有更多的猴子或猿类？ [wei shen me sha mo li mei you geng duo de hou zi huo yuan lei ？]

english: Actually, I've changed my mind.
translation: 事实上，我已经改变主意了。 [shi shi shang ， wo yi jing gai bian zhu yi le 。]

english: I'll be back soon.
translation: 我很快就会回来。 [wo hen kuai jiu hui hui lai 。]

english: I have a question for Crondis.
translation: 我有一个问题要问克朗迪斯。 [wo you yi ge wen ti yao wen ke lang di si 。]

english: Why are crocodiles so rude?
translation: 鳄鱼为何如此粗鲁？ [e yu wei he ru ci cu lu ？]

english: I have a question for Het.
translation: 我有一个问题要问Het。 [wo you yi ge wen ti yao wen Het。]

english: Do you have more followers than the others?
translation: 你比其他人有更多的追随者吗？ [ni bi qi ta ren you geng duo de zhui sui zhe ma ？]

english: I have a question for all of you.
translation: 我有一个问题想问大家。 [wo you yi ge wen ti xiang wen da jia 。]

english: What will happen with Amascut?
translation: 阿马斯卡特会发生什么？ [a ma si ka te hui fa sheng shen me ？]

english: Are you actually gods?
translation: 你们真的是神吗？ [ni men zhen de shi shen ma ？]

english: So what happens now?
translation: 那么现在会发生什么呢？ [na me xian zai hui fa sheng shen me ne ？]

english: I am the Apothecary. I brew potions. Do you need anything specific?
translation: 我是药剂师。我酿造药剂。您需要什么具体的东西吗？ [wo shi yao ji shi 。 wo niang zao yao ji 。 nin xu yao shen me ju ti de dong xi ma ？]

english: I have this voucher for completing the combat Adventure Path, it says to come talk to you about claiming my Adventure Path reward.
translation: 我有这张完成战斗冒险之路的凭证，上面写着来和你谈谈领取我的冒险之路奖励的事情。 [wo you zhe zhang wan cheng zhan dou mao xian zhi lu de ping zheng ， shang mian xie zhe lai he ni tan tan ling qu wo de mao xian zhi lu jiang li de shi qing 。]

english: Why yes, here are some energy potions.
translation: 为什么是的，这里有一些能量药剂。 [wei shen me shi de ， zhe li you yi xie neng liang yao ji 。]

english: I do have more rewards for you, but you need to be on a members world for me to give you the reward. Maybe there is something else I can help you with.
translation: 我确实有更多的奖励给你，但是你需要在会​​员世界我才能给你奖励。或许还有其他事情我可以帮助你。 [wo que shi you geng duo de jiang li gei ni ， dan shi ni xu yao zai hui ​​ yuan shi jie wo cai neng gei ni jiang li 。 huo xu hai you qi ta shi qing wo ke yi bang zhu ni 。]

english: Can you make potions for me?
translation: 你能为我配制药剂吗？ [ni neng wei wo pei zhi yao ji ma ？]

english: <missing other dialogue during the quest>
translation: <任务期间缺少其他对话> [< ren wu qi jian que shao qi ta dui hua >]

english: Hello Apothecary, I've lost that hat you gave me.
translation: 你好药剂师，我把你给我的那顶帽子弄丢了。 [ni hao yao ji shi ， wo ba ni gei wo de na ding mao zi nong diu le 。]

english: No problem, I get plenty of these from Gielinor Hospital Supplies.
translation: 没问题，我从 Gielinor Hospital Supplies 那里得到了很多这些。 [mei wen ti ， wo cong  Gielinor Hospital Supplies  na li de dao le hen duo zhe xie 。]

english: The Apothecary has given you a Nurse's Hat.
translation: 药剂师给了你一顶护士帽。 [yao ji shi gei le ni yi ding hu shi mao 。]

english: The Apothecary has given you a Doctor's Hat.
translation: 药剂师给了你一顶医生帽。 [yao ji shi gei le ni yi ding yi sheng mao 。]

english: You wouldn't be able to make any other cat potions, would you?
translation: 你不可能制作其他猫药水，对吗？ [ni bu ke neng zhi zuo qi ta mao yao shui ， dui ma ？]

english: I have no plans to branch out into cat potions at the moment, but if there was sufficient demand for them I might change my mind.
translation: 我目前没有计划涉足猫药领域，但如果有足够的需求，我可能会改变主意。 [wo mu qian mei you ji hua she zu mao yao ling yu ， dan ru guo you zu gou de xu qiu ， wo ke neng hui gai bian zhu yi 。]

english: Have you got any decent gossip to share?
translation: 你有什么正经八卦可以分享吗？ [ni you shen me zheng jing ba gua ke yi fen xiang ma ？]

english: Well I hear young Romeo's having a little woman trouble but other than that all's quiet on the eastern front. Can I do something for you?
translation: 嗯，我听说年轻的罗密欧遇到了一些女人的麻烦，但除此之外，东线一切都很平静。我能为你做点什么吗？ [n ， wo ting shuo nian qing de luo mi ou yu dao le yi xie nv ren de ma fan ， dan chu ci zhi wai ， dong xian yi qie dou hen ping jing 。 wo neng wei ni zuo dian shen me ma ？]

english: Sad about that affair with young Romeo and Juliet...
translation: 为与年轻的罗密欧和朱丽叶的风流韵事感到难过...... [wei yu nian qing de luo mi ou he zhu li ye de feng liu yun shi gan dao nan guo ......]

english: I hear every time Romeo sees Juliet now he runs away screaming something about ghosts and Juliet's cousin?
translation: 我听说现在罗密欧每次见到朱丽叶他都会尖叫着有关鬼魂和朱丽叶表弟的事情而逃跑？ [wo ting shuo xian zai luo mi ou mei ci jian dao zhu li ye ta du hui jian jiao zhe you guan gui hun he zhu li ye biao di de shi qing er tao pao ？]

english: Always did think he was a bit of a strange one...
translation: 一直觉得他是个奇怪的人…… [yi zhi jue de ta shi ge qi guai de ren ……]

english: Anyway! Life goes on and so does business! Can I do something for you?
translation: 反正！生活还要继续，事业也要继续！我能为你做点什么吗？ [fan zheng ！ sheng huo hai yao ji xu ， shi ye ye yao ji xu ！ wo neng wei ni zuo dian shen me ma ？]

english: Do you know a potion to make hair fall out?
translation: 你知道有什么药可以让头发掉下来吗？ [ni zhi dao you shen me yao ke yi rang tou fa diao xia lai ma ？]

english: I do indeed. I gave it to my mother. That's why I now live alone.
translation: 我确实如此。我把它给了我妈妈。这就是为什么我现在独自生活。 [wo que shi ru ci 。 wo ba ta gei le wo ma ma 。 zhe jiu shi wei shen me wo xian zai du zi sheng huo 。]

english: But can I do something for you?
translation: 但我能为你做点什么吗？ [dan wo neng wei ni zuo dian shen me ma ？]

english: Have you got any good potions to give away?
translation: 你有什么好药水可以赠送吗？ [ni you shen me hao yao shui ke yi zeng song ma ？]

english: Sorry, charity is not my strong point. Do you need anything else?
translation: 抱歉，慈善不是我的强项。您还需要什么吗？ [bao qian ， ci shan bu shi wo de qiang xiang 。 nin hai xu yao shen me ma ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Apothecary, Father Lawrence sent me. I need a Cadava potion to help Romeo and Juliet.
translation: 药剂师，劳伦斯神父派我来的。我需要卡达瓦药水来帮助罗密欧与朱丽叶。 [yao ji shi ， lao lun si shen fu pai wo lai de 。 wo xu yao ka da wa yao shui lai bang zhu luo mi ou yu zhu li ye 。]

english: Cadava potion. It's pretty nasty. And hard to make.
translation: 卡达瓦药水。这真是太恶心了。而且很难制作。 [ka da wa yao shui 。 zhe zhen shi tai e xin le 。 er qie hen nan zhi zuo 。]

english: Wing of rat, tail of frog. Ear of snake and horn of dog.
translation: 老鼠的翅膀，青蛙的尾巴。蛇的耳朵和狗的角。 [lao shu de chi bang ， qing wa de wei ba 。 she de er duo he gou de jiao 。]

english: I have all that, but I need some Cadava berries.
translation: 这些我都有，但我需要一些卡达瓦浆果。 [zhe xie wo dou you ， dan wo xu yao yi xie ka da wa jiang guo 。]

english: You will have to find them while I get the rest ready. Bring them here when you have them. But be careful. They are nasty.
translation: 你必须找到他们，而我会准备好其余的东西。当你有它们的时候把它们带到这里来。但要小心。他们很讨厌。 [ni bi xu zhao dao ta men ， er wo hui zhun bei hao qi yu de dong xi 。 dang ni you ta men de shi hou ba ta men dai dao zhe li lai 。 dan yao xiao xin 。 ta men hen tao yan 。]

english: Conveniently, I have some here.
translation: 方便的话，我这里有一些。 [fang bian de hua ， wo zhe li you yi xie 。]

english: You hand over the berries, which the Apothecary shakes up in a vial of strange liquid.
translation: 你把浆果交给药剂师，将其放入一小瓶奇怪的液体中摇匀。 [ni ba jiang guo jiao gei yao ji shi ， jiang qi fang ru yi xiao ping qi guai de ye ti zhong yao yun 。]

english: Phew! Here is what you need.
translation: 唷！这就是您所需要的。 [yo ！ zhe jiu shi nin suo xu yao de 。]

english: The Apothecary gives you a Cadava potion.
translation: 药剂师给你一瓶卡达瓦药水。 [yao ji shi gei ni yi ping ka da wa yao shui 。]

english: What do these berries look like?
translation: 这些浆果是什么样子的？ [zhe xie jiang guo shi shen me yang zi de ？]

english: They're a nice bright pink colour, with green leaves, stalks are a pale brown colour...you can't miss them. They look pretty tasty, but I wouldn't advise eating them.
translation: 它们是漂亮的亮粉色，叶子是绿色的，茎是浅棕色的……你不能错过它们。它们看起来很好吃，但我不建议吃它们。 [ta men shi piao liang de liang fen se ， ye zi shi lv se de ， jing shi qian zong se de …… ni bu neng cuo guo ta men 。 ta men kan qi lai hen hao chi ， dan wo bu jian yi chi ta men 。]

english: Where can I get these berries?
translation: 我在哪里可以买到这些浆果？ [wo zai na li ke yi mai dao zhe xie jiang guo ？]

english: I think I saw some recently in the local vicinity. Oh yes, that's right! There was a little bit of commotion when some kids visited the south eastern Varrock mining pit. The trip was disrupted because some kids
translation: 我想我最近在当地附近看到了一些。哦，是的，没错！当一些孩子参观东南瓦罗克矿坑时，引起了一些骚动。由于一些孩子，行程被打乱 [wo xiang wo zui jin zai dang di fu jin kan dao le yi xie 。 o ， shi de ， mei cuo ！ dang yi xie hai zi can guan dong nan wa luo ke kuang keng shi ， yin qi le yi xie sao dong 。 you yu yi xie hai zi ， xing cheng bei da luan]

english: had found some cadavaberry bushes and they started picking them. They wrapped that trip up pretty quickly!
translation: 发现了一些尸果灌木丛，他们开始采摘它们。他们很快就结束了这次旅行！ [fa xian le yi xie shi guo guan mu cong ， ta men kai shi cai zhai ta men 。 ta men hen kuai jiu jie shu le zhe ci lv xing ！]

english: How are these berries dangerous?
translation: 这些浆果有什么危险？ [zhe xie jiang guo you shen me wei xian ？]

english: Hmm, they're generally okay, but if handled improperly they can be a bit nasty. And I certainly wouldn't advise drinking the potion!
translation: 嗯，一般来说它们都还好，但是如果处理不当的话，它们可能会有点令人讨厌。我当然不建议喝这种药水！ [n ， yi ban lai shuo ta men dou hai hao ， dan shi ru guo chu li bu dang de hua ， ta men ke neng hui you dian ling ren tao yan 。 wo dang ran bu jian yi he zhe zhong yao shui ！]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Keep searching for those Cadavaberries. They're needed for the potion.
translation: 继续寻找那些尸浆果。魔药需要它们。 [ji xu xun zhao na xie shi jiang guo 。 mo yao xu yao ta men 。]

english: Well done. You have the berries.
translation: 干得好。你有浆果。 [gan de hao 。 ni you jiang guo 。]

english: Thank you for the Cadava potion.
translation: 谢谢你的卡达瓦药水。 [xie xie ni de ka da wa yao shui 。]

english: You're welcome. I hope it helps that young couple find happiness.
translation: 不客气。希望能帮助年轻夫妇找到幸福。 [bu ke qi 。 xi wang neng bang zhu nian qing fu fu zhao dao xing fu 。]

english: I gave Juliet the Cadava potion.
translation: 我给了朱丽叶卡达瓦药水。 [wo gei le zhu li ye ka da wa yao shui 。]

english: Good, good. I hope it helps that young couple find happiness.
translation: 好，好。希望能帮助年轻夫妇找到幸福。 [hao ， hao 。 xi wang neng bang zhu nian qing fu fu zhao dao xing fu 。]

english: Urk!
translation: 乌尔克！ [wu er ke ！]

english: Screen shakes back and forth then blacks out
translation: 屏幕来回晃动然后黑屏 [ping mu lai hui huang dong ran hou hei ping]

english: Blimey... you've been out for hours! Are you ok? People were tripping over you as they walked into the shop.
translation: 天哪...你已经出去好几个小时了！你还好吗？当人们走进商店时，他们被你绊倒了。 [tian na ... ni yi jing chu qu hao ji ge xiao shi le ！ ni hai hao ma ？ dang ren men zou jin shang dian shi ， ta men bei ni ban dao le 。]

english: Do you want to trade the diary yet? I'd like to pass the information on to the scientific community in Varrock.
translation: 你还想交易日记吗？我想将这些信息传递给瓦罗克的科学界。 [ni hai xiang jiao yi ri ji ma ？ wo xiang jiang zhe xie xin xi chuan di gei wa luo ke de ke xue jie 。]

english: Yes, I'll trade it for herblore training.
translation: 是的，我会把它换成 Herblore 训练。 [shi de ， wo hui ba ta huan cheng  Herblore  xun lian 。]

english: Great...
translation: 伟大的... [wei da de ...]

english: The apothecary trains you in herblore.
translation: 药剂师会用 Herblore 来训练你。 [yao ji shi hui yong  Herblore  lai xun lian ni 。]

english: Ok, that's all I can teach you. Many thanks for the diary.
translation: 好吧，我能教你的就这么多了。非常感谢你的日记。 [hao ba ， wo neng jiao ni de jiu zhe me duo le 。 fei chang gan xie ni de ri ji 。]

english: No thanks, I want to keep hold ifit a bit longer.
translation: 不，谢谢，我想再坚持一会儿。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo xiang zai jian chi yi hui er 。]

english: Oh, that's a shame... Come back if you change your mind.
translation: 噢，真可惜……如果你改变主意就回来吧。 [o ， zhen ke xi …… ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi jiu hui lai ba 。]

english: Hmm, this is an interesting tome... But you've already sold me one, thanks!
translation: 嗯，这是一本有趣的书……但是你已经卖给我一本了，谢谢！ [n ， zhe shi yi ben you qu de shu …… dan shi ni yi jing mai gei wo yi ben le ， xie xie ！]

english: Well done.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: You've [found a new clue/obtained a casket]!
translation: 你[发现了新线索/获得了棺材]！ [ni [ fa xian le xin xian suo / huo de le guan cai ]！]

english: Can you make potions for me?
translation: 你能为我配制药剂吗？ [ni neng wei wo pei zhi yao ji ma ？]

english: Talk about A Tail of Two Cats.
translation: 谈论两只猫的尾巴。 [tan lun liang zhi mao de wei ba 。]

english: Nurse's Hat
translation: 护士帽 [hu shi mao]

english: Doctor's Hat
translation: 医生帽 [yi sheng mao]

english: Talk about something else.
translation: 说点别的吧。 [shuo dian bie de ba 。]

english: Talk about the Ratcatchers Quest.
translation: 谈论捕鼠者任务。 [tan lun bu shu zhe ren wu 。]

english: Talk about Romeo & Juliet.
translation: 谈论罗密欧与朱丽叶。 [tan lun luo mi ou yu zhu li ye 。]

english: Have you got any decent gossip to share?
translation: 你有什么正经八卦可以分享吗？ [ni you shen me zheng jing ba gua ke yi fen xiang ma ？]

english: Do you know a potion to make hair fall out?
translation: 你知道有什么药可以让头发掉下来吗？ [ni zhi dao you shen me yao ke yi rang tou fa diao xia lai ma ？]

english: Have you got any good potions to give away?
translation: 你有什么好药水可以赠送吗？ [ni you shen me hao yao shui ke yi zeng song ma ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: What do these berries look like?
translation: 这些浆果是什么样子的？ [zhe xie jiang guo shi shen me yang zi de ？]

english: Where can I get these berries?
translation: 我在哪里可以买到这些浆果？ [wo zai na li ke yi mai dao zhe xie jiang guo ？]

english: How are these berries dangerous?
translation: 这些浆果有什么危险？ [zhe xie jiang guo you shen me wei xian ？]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Yes, I'll drink it all down.
translation: 是的，我会把它全部喝掉。 [shi de ， wo hui ba ta quan bu he diao 。]

english: No, I'm having second thoughts now.
translation: 不，我现在正在重新考虑。 [bu ， wo xian zai zheng zai chong xin kao lv 。]

english: Yes, I'll trade it for herblore training.
translation: 是的，我会把它换成 Herblore 训练。 [shi de ， wo hui ba ta huan cheng  Herblore  xun lian 。]

english: No thanks, I want to keep hold if it a bit longer.
translation: 不，谢谢，我想再坚持一会儿。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo xiang zai jian chi yi hui er 。]

english: Hello. What are you doing?
translation: 你好。你在干什么？ [ni hao 。 ni zai gan shen me ？]

english: Cleaning, cleaning, always cleaning. This apprenticeship isn't all that it was cracked up to be.
translation: 清洁，清洁，始终清洁。这种学徒期并不像人们所吹捧的那样。 [qing jie ， qing jie ， shi zhong qing jie 。 zhe zhong xue tu qi bing bu xiang ren men suo chui peng de na yang 。]

english: Whose apprentice are you?
translation: 你是谁的徒弟？ [ni shi shei de tu di ？]

english: Oh, Aadeela, the sorceress upstairs, said she'd teach me magic, she did. And here I am scrubbing floors without a spell to help me.
translation: 哦，楼上的女巫阿黛拉说她会教我魔法，她做到了。我在这里擦地板，没有咒语的帮助。 [o ， lou shang de nv wu a dai la shuo ta hui jiao wo mo fa ， ta zuo dao le 。 wo zai zhe li ca di ban ， mei you zhou yu de bang zhu 。]

english: I could cast a Water Blast or a Wind Blast spell to hurry things along if you'd like?
translation: 如果你愿意的话，我可以施展水爆术或风爆术来加快进度？ [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi shi zhan shui bao shu huo feng bao shu lai jia kuai jin du ？]

english: No, no, she'd kill me or worse if she knew I was using Magic to do chores. Her last apprentice - well I'd rather not say.
translation: 不，不，如果她知道我用魔法做家务，她会杀了我，甚至更糟。 Her last apprentice - well I'd rather not say. [bu ， bu ， ru guo ta zhi dao wo yong mo fa zuo jia wu ， ta hui sha le wo ， shen zhi geng zao 。 Her last apprentice - well I'd rather not say.]

english: Oh go on, what happened to them?
translation: 哦，继续，他们怎么了？ [o ， ji xu ， ta men zen me le ？]

english: They say she turned them into little spiders.
translation: 他们说她把它们变成了小蜘蛛。 [ta men shuo ta ba ta men bian cheng le xiao zhi zhu 。]

english: Oh, that's too bad. I had better leave you to it.
translation: 哦，那太糟糕了。我最好还是让你自己去做吧。 [o ， na tai zao gao le 。 wo zui hao hai shi rang ni zi ji qu zuo ba 。]

english: Surely there must be upsides to the task?
translation: 这项任务肯定有好处吗？ [zhe xiang ren wu ken ding you hao chu ma ？]

english: Nope. Clean this, clean that. When I'm finished cleaning here I have to go help out in the garden.
translation: 没有。清理这个，清理那个。当我打扫完这里后，我必须去花园里帮忙。 [mei you 。 qing li zhe ge ， qing li na ge 。 dang wo da sao wan zhe li hou ， wo bi xu qu hua yuan li bang mang 。]

english: What garden?
translation: 什么花园？ [shen me hua yuan ？]

english: Oh, I shouldn't have told you.
translation: 哦，我不应该告诉你。 [o ， wo bu ying gai gao su ni 。]

english: You're right, you shouldn't have.
translation: 你说得对，你不应该这么做。 [ni shuo de dui ， ni bu ying gai zhe me zuo 。]

english: Well, if you don't mind then, I'm busy and have to get back to work.
translation: 好吧，如果你不介意的话，我很忙，得回去工作了。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni bu jie yi de hua ， wo hen mang ， de hui qu gong zuo le 。]

english: Don't let me keep you.
translation: 别让我留住你。 [bie rang wo liu zhu ni 。]

english: Oh, you can talk to me. I can see you're having a bad day.
translation: 噢，你可以和我谈谈。我看得出来你今天过得很糟糕。 [o ， ni ke yi he wo tan tan 。 wo kan de chu lai ni jin tian guo de hen zao gao 。]

english: You know you're right. Nobody listens to me.
translation: 你知道你是对的。没有人听我的。 [ni zhi dao ni shi dui de 。 mei you ren ting wo de 。]

english: I can't blame them, all you do is whine.
translation: 我不能责怪他们，你所做的只是抱怨。 [wo bu neng ze guai ta men ， ni suo zuo de zhi shi bao yuan 。]

english: The apprentice is clearly hurt and ignores you.
translation: 徒弟明显受伤了，不理你了。 [tu di ming xian shou shang le ， bu li ni le 。]

english: A sympathetic ear can do wonders.
translation: 富有同情心的耳朵可以创造奇迹。 [fu you tong qing xin de er duo ke yi chuang zao qi ji 。]

english: Yes, if I just let my frustrations out, I'd feel a lot better. Now what was I saying?
translation: 是的，如果我发泄出我的挫败感，我会感觉好很多。现在我在说什么？ [shi de ， ru guo wo fa xie chu wo de cuo bai gan ， wo hui gan jue hao hen duo 。 xian zai wo zai shuo shen me ？]

english: I don't know. You were whining about something or other. To tell you the truth, I wasn't really listening.
translation: 我不知道。你在抱怨某事或其他事。说实话，我并没有真正在听。 [wo bu zhi dao 。 ni zai bao yuan mou shi huo qi ta shi 。 shuo shi hua ， wo bing mei you zhen zheng zai ting 。]

english: To tell you the truth, I wasn't really listening.
translation: 说实话，我并没有真正在听。 [shuo shi hua ， wo bing mei you zhen zheng zai ting 。]

english: You mentioned something about the garden.
translation: 你提到了一些关于花园的事情。 [ni ti dao le yi xie guan yu hua yuan de shi qing 。]

english: Oh yeah, that dreadful garden of hers.
translation: 哦，是的，她那个可怕的花园。 [o ， shi de ， ta na ge ke pa de hua yuan 。]

english: Where is it?
translation: 它在哪里？ [ta zai na li ？]

english: Oh, it's nowhere.
translation: 噢，无处可去。 [o ， wu chu ke qu 。]

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你是什​​么意思？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: Well it's here, but not really. You see the sorceress is trying out some new type of compression magic.
translation: 嗯，它就在这里，但不是真的。你看女巫正在尝试某种新型的压缩魔法。 [n ， ta jiu zai zhe li ， dan bu shi zhen de 。 ni kan nv wu zheng zai chang shi mou zhong xin xing de ya suo mo fa 。]

english: Oh, that sounds interesting - so how does it work?
translation: 哦，这听起来很有趣——那么它是如何工作的呢？ [o ， zhe ting qi lai hen you qu —— na me ta shi ru he gong zuo de ne ？]

english: It would take too long to explain and, to be honest, I don't really understand how it works.
translation: 解释起来需要很长时间，而且说实话，我不太明白它是如何工作的。 [jie shi qi lai xu yao hen zhang shi jian ， er qie shuo shi hua ， wo bu tai ming bai ta shi ru he gong zuo de 。]

english: Fair enough, but tell me, how do you get to the garden?
translation: 很公平，但是告诉我，你怎么去花园？ [hen gong ping ， dan shi gao su wo ， ni zen me qu hua yuan ？]

english: By magic! The sorceress did teach me one spell.
translation: 通过魔法！女术士确实教了我一种咒语。 [tong guo mo fa ！ nv shu shi que shi jiao le wo yi zhong zhou yu 。]

english: Wow, cast the spell on me. It will be good Magic training for you.
translation: 哇哦，对我施展咒语吧。这对你来说将是一次很好的魔法训练。 [wa o ， dui wo shi zhan zhou yu ba 。 zhe dui ni lai shuo jiang shi yi ci hen hao de mo fa xun lian 。]

english: I can't do that now, I'm far too busy sweeping.
translation: 我现在不能这么做，我正忙着扫地。 [wo xian zai bu neng zhe me zuo ， wo zheng mang zhe sao di 。]

english: Oh you wouldn't mind?
translation: 哦，你不介意吗？ [o ， ni bu jie yi ma ？]

english: Of course not. I'd be glad to help.
translation: 当然不是。我很乐意提供帮助。 [dang ran bu shi 。 wo hen le yi ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: Okay, here goes! Remember, to return, just drink from the fountain.
translation: 好的，开始吧！请记住，返回时只需喝喷泉里的水即可。 [hao de ， kai shi ba ！ qing ji zhu ， fan hui shi zhi xu he pen quan li de shui ji ke 。]

english: Oh, that's nice. Well it's been great talking to you.
translation: 哦，那太好了。嗯，很高兴与你交谈。 [o ， na tai hao le 。 n ， hen gao xing yu ni jiao tan 。]

english: Hey apprentice, do you want to try out your teleport skills again?
translation: 嘿，徒弟，你想再试试你的瞬移技能吗？ [hei ， tu di ， ni xiang zai shi shi ni de shun yi ji neng ma ？]

english: Okay, here goes - and remember, to return just drink from the fountain.
translation: 好吧，就这样 - 请记住，返回时只需从喷泉中喝水即可。 [hao ba ， jiu zhe yang  -  qing ji zhu ， fan hui shi zhi xu cong pen quan zhong he shui ji ke 。]

english: Seventior Disthinte Molesko!
translation: 七岁的迪辛特·莫莱斯科！ [qi sui de di xin te · mo lai si ke ！]

english: Oh, I'm sorry, could you pick up your follower first? I'm really not sure that I could teleport the both of you.
translation: 哦，抱歉，您能先接一下您的关注者吗？我真的不确定我是否可以传送你们俩。 [o ， bao qian ， nin neng xian jie yi xia nin de guan zhu zhe ma ？ wo zhen de bu que ding wo shi fou ke yi chuan song ni men lia 。]

english: I could cast a Water Blast or a Wind Blast spell?
translation: 我可以施展水爆术或风爆术吗？ [wo ke yi shi zhan shui bao shu huo feng bao shu ma ？]

english: Surely there must be upsides to the task?
translation: 这项任务肯定有好处吗？ [zhe xiang ren wu ken ding you hao chu ma ？]

english: You're right, you shouldn't have.
translation: 你说得对，你不应该这么做。 [ni shuo de dui ， ni bu ying gai zhe me zuo 。]

english: Oh, you can talk to me. I can see you're having a bad day.
translation: 噢，你可以和我谈谈。我看得出来你今天过得很糟糕。 [o ， ni ke yi he wo tan tan 。 wo kan de chu lai ni jin tian guo de hen zao gao 。]

english: I can't blame them, all you do is whine.
translation: 我不能责怪他们，你所做的只是抱怨。 [wo bu neng ze guai ta men ， ni suo zuo de zhi shi bao yuan 。]

english: A sympathetic ear can do wonders.
translation: 富有同情心的耳朵可以创造奇迹。 [fu you tong qing xin de er duo ke yi chuang zao qi ji 。]

english: I don't know. You were whining about something or other.
translation: 我不知道。你在抱怨某事或其他事。 [wo bu zhi dao 。 ni zai bao yuan mou shi huo qi ta shi 。]

english: To tell you the truth, I wasn't really listening.
translation: 说实话，我并没有真正在听。 [shuo shi hua ， wo bing mei you zhen zheng zai ting 。]

english: You mentioned something about the garden.
translation: 你提到了一些关于花园的事情。 [ni ti dao le yi xie guan yu hua yuan de shi qing 。]

english: Wow, cast the spell on me. It will be good Magic training for you.
translation: 哇哦，对我施展咒语吧。这对你来说将是一次很好的魔法训练。 [wa o ， dui wo shi zhan zhou yu ba 。 zhe dui ni lai shuo jiang shi yi ci hen hao de mo fa xun lian 。]

english: Oh, that's nice. Well it's been great talking to you.
translation: 哦，那太好了。嗯，很高兴与你交谈。 [o ， na tai hao le 。 n ， hen gao xing yu ni jiao tan 。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Hello friend. I wish to slay evil and avail them of their loot! Take me to Burgh de Rott!
translation: 朋友你好。我希望消灭邪恶并利用他们的战利品！带我去德罗特堡！ [peng you ni hao 。 wo xi wang xiao mie xie e bing li yong ta men de zhan li pin ！ dai wo qu de luo te bao ！]

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: 你准备好与那里的邪恶作斗争了吗？ [ni zhun bei hao yu na li de xie e zuo dou zheng le ma ？]

english: I think so? At least my heart knows courage and that should be sufficient for the meantime. I expect that when we get to Burgh de Rott, we'll be able to purchase suitable provisions.
translation: 我想是这样吗？至少我的心知道勇气，这应该足够了。我预计当我们到达罗特堡时，我们就能购买到合适的食物。 [wo xiang shi zhe yang ma ？ zhi shao wo de xin zhi dao yong qi ， zhe ying gai zu gou le 。 wo yu ji dang wo men dao da luo te bao shi ， wo men jiu neng gou mai dao he shi de shi wu 。]

english: But you do realise that the vampyres in Morytania are immune to everything except silver?
translation: 但你确实意识到莫里塔尼亚的吸血鬼对除了银以外的一切都免疫吗？ [dan ni que shi yi shi dao mo li ta ni ya de xi xue gui dui chu le yin yi wai de yi qie dou mian yi ma ？]

english: Er...well, I've not heard mention of that fact, but I have faith that Saradomin will provide the means to furnish me with suitable weapons when I reach Burgh de Rott.
translation: 呃……好吧，我没有听说过这个事实，但我相信萨拉多明会在我到达罗特堡时为我提供合适的武器。 [e …… hao ba ， wo mei you ting shuo guo zhe ge shi shi ， dan wo xiang xin sa la duo ming hui zai wo dao da luo te bao shi wei wo ti gong he shi de wu qi 。]

english: And if we happen to run into some vampyres on the journey down there?
translation: 如果我们在那儿的旅途中碰巧遇到吸血鬼怎么办？ [ru guo wo men zai na er de lv tu zhong peng qiao yu dao xi xue gui zen me ban ？]

english: I trust that you will help us to avoid them. You are a guide after all, aren't you? Anyway, you look like you can handle yourself. I presume you've fought such creatures before and won? How hard can it be?
translation: 我相信你会帮助我们避免它们。毕竟你是一个向导，不是吗？无论如何，你看上去能应付自如。我想你以前曾与这些生物战斗过并获胜吧？这有多难？ [wo xiang xin ni hui bang zhu wo men bi mian ta men 。 bi jing ni shi yi ge xiang dao ， bu shi ma ？ wu lun ru he ， ni kan shang qu neng ying fu zi ru 。 wo xiang ni yi qian ceng yu zhe xie sheng wu zhan dou guo bing huo sheng ba ？ zhe you duo nan ？]

english: It can be pretty difficult, actually. But you're right, I'll be your guide so I should be able to handle the situation.
translation: 实际上，这可能相当困难。但你是对的，我会成为你的向导，所以我应该能够处理这种情况。 [shi ji shang ， zhe ke neng xiang dang kun nan 。 dan ni shi dui de ， wo hui cheng wei ni de xiang dao ， suo yi wo ying gai neng gou chu li zhe zhong qing kuang 。]

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 你为什么想去 Burgh de Rott？ [ni wei shen me xiang qu  Burgh de Rott？]

english: I'm going down there to teach those vampyres a lesson or two. I've heard about the terrible conditions down there and I intend to put a stop to it.
translation: 我要去那里给那些吸血鬼一两个教训。我听说那里的情况很糟糕，我打算阻止它。 [wo yao qu na li gei na xie xi xue gui yi liang ge jiao xun 。 wo ting shuo na li de qing kuang hen zao gao ， wo da suan zu zhi ta 。]

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 如果我们在去罗特城堡的路上遇到敌人，你能保护自己吗？ [ru guo wo men zai qu luo te cheng bao de lu shang yu dao di ren ， ni neng bao hu zi ji ma ？]

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of enemies. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: 这么说吧，我有点经验，而且我很乐意对抗我的敌人。你不需要担心这个。 [zhe me shuo ba ， wo you dian jing yan ， er qie wo hen le yi dui kang wo de di ren 。 ni bu xu yao dan xin zhe ge 。]

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 我可以带你去伯格德罗特。 [wo ke yi dai ni qu bo ge de luo te 。]

english: Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: 嗯嗯，看来你有追随者了。我想如果让它独自徘徊的话，它可能会在这段旅程中迷路。等你的追随者安全了我们就离开吧。 [n n ， kan lai ni you zhui sui zhe le 。 wo xiang ru guo rang ta du zi pai huai de hua ， ta ke neng hui zai zhe duan lv cheng zhong mi lu 。 deng ni de zhui sui zhe an quan le wo men jiu li kai ba 。]

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: 哦真的吗？那太好了！到达目的地后我会给你一个小奖励。 [o zhen de ma ？ na tai hao le ！ dao da mu di di hou wo hui gei ni yi ge xiao jiang li 。]

english: Burgh de Rott Ramble begins
translation: Burgh de Rott 漫步开始 [Burgh de Rott  man bu kai shi]

english: Ok, which route should we take?
translation: 好的，我们应该走哪条路？ [hao de ， wo men ying gai zou na tiao lu ？]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: 啊，所以你想给我一些物资，嗯？让我打开背包。 [a ， suo yi ni xiang gei wo yi xie wu zi ， n ？ rang wo da kai bei bao 。]

english: This place is a bit grim. How can people live here?
translation: 这个地方有点严峻。人们怎么能住在这里？ [zhe ge di fang you dian yan jun 。 ren men zen me neng zhu zai zhe li ？]

english: Do you visit Burgh de Rott often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: 您经常访问 Burgh de Rott 吗？看来你很熟悉这条路。 [nin jing chang fang wen  Burgh de Rott  ma ？ kan lai ni hen shu xi zhe tiao lu 。]

english: When are we going to get to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 我们什么时候去 Burgh de Rott？ [wo men shen me shi hou qu  Burgh de Rott？]

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on. I have loot to get.
translation: 我们没有一整天的时间站着聊天；让我们继续努力吧。我有战利品要拿。 [wo men mei you yi zheng tian de shi jian zhan zhe liao tian ； rang wo men ji xu nu li ba 。 wo you zhan li pin yao na 。]

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than the opulet life styles forced on us adventurer types. I'd much rather be up to my eyes in mud and having a good fight!
translation: 哦，我讨厌这次旅行，但它比强加给我们冒险家类型的奥普莱特生活方式要好。我宁愿在泥里睁大眼睛，痛痛快快地打一场！ [o ， wo tao yan zhe ci lv xing ， dan ta bi qiang jia gei wo men mao xian jia lei xing de ao pu lai te sheng huo fang shi yao hao 。 wo ning yuan zai ni li zheng da yan jing ， tong tong kuai kuai di da yi chang ！]

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...
translation: 你没看到我正在被攻击吗... [ni mei kan dao wo zheng zai bei gong ji ma ...]

english: Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
translation: 谢谢，我会把这个放在脖子上。 [xie xie ， wo hui ba zhe ge fang zai bo zi shang 。]

english: Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Paterdomus. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: 天啊！看来我们得回帕特多莫斯了。我们过不了那座桥！ [tian a ！ kan lai wo men de hui pa te duo mo si le 。 wo men guo bu liao na zuo qiao ！]

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
translation: 哦，我相信我们能找到办法！ [o ， wo xiang xin wo men neng zhao dao ban fa ！]

english: Player completes the bridge event
translation: 玩家完成桥牌事件 [wan jia wan cheng qiao pai shi jian]

english: Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Paterdomus.
translation: 好吧，这已经被撕裂了……看起来我们无法越过这个沼泽。我们必须回到帕特多莫斯。 [hao ba ， zhe yi jing bei si lie le …… kan qi lai wo men wu fa yue guo zhe ge zhao ze 。 wo men bi xu hui dao pa te duo mo si 。]

english: Player completes the bog event
translation: 玩家完成沼泽事件 [wan jia wan cheng zhao ze shi jian]

english: Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: 嘿……太好了……你做得很好……我会关注你的。 [hei …… tai hao le …… ni zuo de hen hao …… wo hui guan zhu ni de 。]

english: Whahay...that was great!
translation: 哇……那太好了！ [wa …… na tai hao le ！]

english: But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 但我们现在真的应该出发了。 [dan wo men xian zai zhen de ying gai chu fa le 。]

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
translation: 哦，我相信我们能找到办法！ [o ， wo xiang xin wo men neng zhao dao ban fa ！]

english: Player completes the river event
translation: 玩家完成河牌事件 [wan jia wan cheng he pai shi jian]

english: That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: 太棒了！我也必须这样做。 [tai bang le ！ wo ye bi xu zhe yang zuo 。]

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 哇哈！那很棒！但我们现在真的应该出发了。 [wa ha ！ na hen bang ！ dan wo men xian zai zhen de ying gai chu fa le 。]

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
translation: 呃……那些气泡是什么？ [e …… na xie qi pao shi shen me ？]

english: This is scary!
translation: 这太可怕了！ [zhe tai ke pa le ！]

english: Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
translation: 啊啊啊，那应该是触手吧…… [a a a ， na ying gai shi chu shou ba ……]

english: Ahhh, two tentacles!
translation: 啊啊啊，两条触手！ [a a a ， liang tiao chu shou ！]

english: ...three tentacles!
translation: ……三根触手！ […… san gen chu shou ！]

english: I think I'm going to faint!
translation: 我想我要晕倒了！ [wo xiang wo yao yun dao le ！]

english: Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: 天啊！看看那只野兽！你得自己解决这件事！ [tian a ！ kan kan na zhi ye shou ！ ni de zi ji jie jue zhe jian shi ！]

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the Burgh de Rott. Here's your reward.
translation: 非常感谢您让我安全抵达 Burgh de Rott。这是你的奖励。 [fei chang gan xie nin rang wo an quan di da  Burgh de Rott。 zhe shi ni de jiang li 。]

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: 你准备好与那里的邪恶作斗争了吗？ [ni zhun bei hao yu na li de xie e zuo dou zheng le ma ？]

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 你为什么想去 Burgh de Rott？ [ni wei shen me xiang qu  Burgh de Rott？]

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
translation: 如果我们遇到敌人，你能保护自己吗……？ [ru guo wo men yu dao di ren ， ni neng bao hu zi ji ma ……？]

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 我可以带你去伯格德罗特。 [wo ke yi dai ni qu bo ge de luo te 。]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: I was wondering if you could repair my pouches.
translation: 我想知道你能否修理我的袋子。 [wo xiang zhi dao ni neng fou xiu li wo de dai zi 。]

english: I need 25 abyssal pearls to unlock the contact with the mage who knows how to repair a pouch. After the contact has been unlocked, it will cost you 1 abyssal pearl each time to repair the pouches.
translation: 我需要 25 颗深渊珍珠才能解锁与懂得修理袋子的法师的联系。触点解锁后，每次修复袋子需要花费1颗深渊珍珠。 [wo xu yao  25  ke shen yuan zhen zhu cai neng jie suo yu dong de xiu li dai zi de fa shi de lian xi 。 chu dian jie suo hou ， mei ci xiu fu dai zi xu yao hua fei 1 ke shen yuan zhen zhu 。]

english: I don't have enough abyssal pearls for that, I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕我没有足够的深渊珍珠。 [kong pa wo mei you zu gou de shen yuan zhen zhu 。]

english: Yes, please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Now bear with me whilst I contact the mage.
translation: 现在请耐心等待我联系法师。 [xian zai qing nai xin deng dai wo lian xi fa shi 。]

english: Apprentice Cordelia casts the NPC Contact spell.
translation: 学徒科迪莉亚施展 NPC 接触法术。 [xue tu ke di li ya shi zhan  NPC  jie chu fa shu 。]

english: Hello, can you hear me?
translation: 你好，你能听到我说话吗？ [ni hao ， ni neng ting dao wo shuo hua ma ？]

english: Quiet! Why do you all try to break my concentration?
translation: 安静的！为什么你们都想破坏我的注意力？ [an jing de ！ wei shen me ni men dou xiang po huai wo de zhu yi li ？]

english: OK. The contact has been set up.
translation: 好的。联系方式已建立。 [hao de 。 lian xi fang shi yi jian li 。]

english: It will cost you 1 abyssal pearl to repair the pouches.
translation: 修复袋子需要花费 1 颗深渊珍珠。 [xiu fu dai zi xu yao hua fei  1  ke shen yuan zhen zhu 。]

english: Yes, that sounds fair.
translation: 是的，这听起来很公平。 [shi de ， zhe ting qi lai hen gong ping 。]

english: You don't seem to have any pouches in need of repair.
translation: 您似乎没有任何需要修理的袋子。 [nin si hu mei you ren he xu yao xiu li de dai zi 。]

english: Bear with me whilst I make the contact for repairing the pouches.
translation: 请耐心等待，我会联系修理袋子。 [qing nai xin deng dai ， wo hui lian xi xiu li dai zi 。]

english: Hi, it's me again.
translation: 嗨，又是我。 [hai ， you shi wo 。]

english: Hello, I know you can hear me.
translation: 你好，我知道你能听到我的声音。 [ni hao ， wo zhi dao ni neng ting dao wo de sheng yin 。]

english: Ding Dong, Ding Dong. You can't keep me waiting.
translation: 叮咚，叮咚。你不能让我等。 [ding dong ， ding dong 。 ni bu neng rang wo deng 。]

english: Fine. What do you want?
translation: 美好的。你想要什么？ [mei hao de 。 ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: I got someone here in need of a pouch repair.
translation: 我这里有人需要修理袋子。 [wo zhe li you ren xu yao xiu li dai zi 。]

english: OK...It's done.
translation: 好的……完成了。 [hao de …… wan cheng le 。]

english: Your pouches have been repaired.
translation: 你的袋子已经修好了。 [ni de dai zi yi jing xiu hao le 。]

english: We need to assemble rift guardian before those creatures arrive!
translation: 我们需要在这些生物到来之前集结裂痕守护者！ [wo men xu yao zai zhe xie sheng wu dao lai zhi qian ji jie lie hen shou hu zhe ！]

english: We need shield barriers up before anything comes through that rift!
translation: 在任何东西穿过裂缝之前我们需要建立护盾屏障！ [zai ren he dong xi chuan guo lie feng zhi qian wo men xu yao jian li hu dun ping zhang ！]

english: We need to protect the Great Guardian!
translation: 我们需要保护伟大的守护者！ [wo men xu yao bao hu wei da de shou hu zhe ！]

english: We need to power up the Great Guardian!
translation: 我们需要增强伟大守护者的力量！ [wo men xu yao zeng qiang wei da shou hu zhe de li liang ！]

english: We need more rift guardians!
translation: 我们需要更多的裂隙守护者！ [wo men xu yao geng duo de lie xi shou hu zhe ！]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: Yes, that sounds fair.
translation: 是的，这听起来很公平。 [shi de ， zhe ting qi lai hen gong ping 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Cancel
translation: 取消 [qu xiao]

english: Hey, [player name]. Got any abyssal pearls you want to trade?
translation: Hey, [player name].有想要交易的深渊珍珠吗？ [Hey, [player name]. you xiang yao jiao yi de shen yuan zhen zhu ma ？]

english: Let's see what you have.
translation: 让我们看看你有什么。 [rang wo men kan kan ni you shen me 。]

english: I have my general store, but I also have a small collection of lanterns available, if that interests you?
translation: 我有我的杂货店，但我也有一小部分灯笼可供选择，如果您感兴趣的话？ [wo you wo de za huo dian ， dan wo ye you yi xiao bu fen deng long ke gong xuan ze ， ru guo nin gan xing qu de hua ？]

english: Lanterns, you say?
translation: 你说灯笼？ [ni shuo deng long ？]

english: Yes, powerful artefacts of The Abyss. We have accumulated a small collection of them from all of the fighting.
translation: 是的，来自深渊的强大神器。我们从所有的战斗中收集了一小部分。 [shi de ， lai zi shen yuan de qiang da shen qi 。 wo men cong suo you de zhan dou zhong shou ji le yi xiao bu fen 。]

english: Do the wizards not use them in the fight against the abyss?
translation: 难道巫师们在对抗深渊的时候不使用它们吗？ [nan dao wu shi men zai dui kang shen yuan de shi hou bu shi yong ta men ma ？]

english: Absolutely not. We know how powerful they are, yet their magic is too unknown to us to risk using.
translation: 绝对不是。我们知道它们有多强大，但我们对它们的魔法却一无所知，无法冒险使用。 [jue dui bu shi 。 wo men zhi dao ta men you duo qiang da ， dan wo men dui ta men de mo fa que yi wu suo zhi ， wu fa mao xian shi yong 。]

english: Could I have one to aid in the fight?
translation: 我可以请一个人来协助战斗吗？ [wo ke yi qing yi ge ren lai xie zhu zhan dou ma ？]

english: I'm afraid I can't just give you one. We're under strict instructions to only provide lanterns to people who prove themselves as committed to the cause.
translation: 恐怕我不能只给你一个。我们收到严格指示，只能向那些证明自己致力于这项事业的人提供灯笼。 [kong pa wo bu neng zhi gei ni yi ge 。 wo men shou dao yan ge zhi shi ， zhi neng xiang na xie zheng ming zi ji zhi li yu zhe xiang shi ye de ren ti gong deng long 。]

english: How committed does one have to be?
translation: 一个人必须有多大的奉献精神？ [yi ge ren bi xu you duo da de feng xian jing shen ？]

english: If you've fought the abyss enough to amass 1,500 abyssal pearls, that would be enough.
translation: 如果你与深渊的战斗足够多，积累了 1,500 颗深渊珍珠，那就足够了。 [ru guo ni yu shen yuan de zhan dou zu gou duo ， ji lei le  1,500  ke shen yuan zhen zhu ， na jiu zu gou le 。]

english: Ah, I don't have enough on me right now.
translation: 啊，我现在身上的东西还不够。 [a ， wo xian zai shen shang de dong xi hai bu gou 。]

english: That's alright. Feel free to come back when you have more pearls on you.
translation: 没关系。当你身上有更多珍珠时，请随时回来。 [mei guan xi 。 dang ni shen shang you geng duo zhen zhu shi ， qing sui shi hui lai 。]

english: As long as you are aware of how powerful they are, and that I can trust you won't lost it.
translation: 只要你知道它们有多么强大，我相信你就不会失去它。 [zhi yao ni zhi dao ta men you duo me qiang da ， wo xiang xin ni jiu bu hui shi qu ta 。]

english: What's that rift guardian doing over there?
translation: 那个裂隙守护者在那儿做什么？ [na ge lie xi shou hu zhe zai na er zuo shen me ？]

english: They're great, aren't they? I don't know their name, if they even have one, so I just call them Rifty.
translation: 他们很棒，不是吗？我不知道他们的名字，如果他们有的话，所以我就叫他们 Rifty。 [ta men hen bang ， bu shi ma ？ wo bu zhi dao ta men de ming zi ， ru guo ta men you de hua ， suo yi wo jiu jiao ta men  Rifty。]

english: That rift they have is a folded-space storage rift, just like the ones Traiborn uses! Small on the outside, but big on the inside!
translation: 他们拥有的那个裂缝是一个折叠空间储存裂缝，就像Traiborn使用的那样！外面很小，里面却很大！ [ta men yong you de na ge lie feng shi yi ge zhe die kong jian chu cun lie feng ， jiu xiang Traiborn shi yong de na yang ！ wai mian hen xiao ， li mian que hen da ！]

english: But what's the rift for?
translation: 但裂痕是为了什么？ [dan lie hen shi wei le shen me ？]

english: The guardians use it to store things. If you help hold back the Abyss, they'll let you take things from the rift in return.
translation: 监护人用它来存放东西。如果你帮助阻止深渊，他们会让你从裂缝中拿走东西作为回报。 [jian hu ren yong ta lai cun fang dong xi 。 ru guo ni bang zhu zu zhi shen yuan ， ta men hui rang ni cong lie feng zhong na zou dong xi zuo wei hui bao 。]

english: Anyway, did you want to trade?
translation: 不管怎样，你想交易吗？ [bu guan zen yang ， ni xiang jiao yi ma ？]

english: Why are you selling things here?
translation: 你为什么在这里卖东西？ [ni wei shen me zai zhe li mai dong xi ？]

english: Sedridor told us to make sure there was plenty of incentive for people to help us. He also wants us to gather abyssal pearls for research purposes. I thought this would be a good way of doing both!
translation: 塞德里多告诉我们要确保人们有足够的动力来帮助我们。他还希望我们收集深海珍珠用于研究目的。我认为这是一个两全其美的好方法！ [sai de li duo gao su wo men yao que bao ren men you zu gou de dong li lai bang zhu wo men 。 ta hai xi wang wo men shou ji shen hai zhen zhu yong yu yan jiu mu di 。 wo ren wei zhe shi yi ge liang quan qi mei de hao fang fa ！]

english: So you sell things in exchange for abyssal pearls?
translation: 所以你卖东西来换取深渊珍珠？ [suo yi ni mai dong xi lai huan qu shen yuan zhen zhu ？]

english: Exactly! I've got some interesting things from the Wizards' Tower, along with some cool stuff the Guardians of the Rift gave us. Want to take a look?
translation: 确切地！我从巫师塔里得到了一些有趣的东西，还有裂谷守护者给我们的一些很酷的东西。想看一下吗？ [que qie di ！ wo cong wu shi ta li de dao le yi xie you qu de dong xi ， hai you lie gu shou hu zhe gei wo men de yi xie hen ku de dong xi 。 xiang kan yi xia ma ？]

english: Could you tell me more about this place.
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于这个地方的信息吗？ [ni neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu zhe ge di fang de xin xi ma ？]

english: Well, I only really know what the Great Guardian told us. This is the Temple of the Eye, or at least, what's left of it. It was built long ago to house the Eye, a powerful Saradominist artefact.
translation: 好吧，我只知道伟大守护者告诉我们的事情。这就是眼殿，或者至少是它剩下的部分。它是很久以前为了容纳“眼睛”而建造的，这是一种强大的萨拉多米主义神器。 [hao ba ， wo zhi zhi dao wei da shou hu zhe gao su wo men de shi qing 。 zhe jiu shi yan dian ， huo zhe zhi shao shi ta sheng xia de bu fen 。 ta shi hen jiu yi qian wei le rong na “ yan jing ” er jian zao de ， zhe shi yi zhong qiang da de sa la duo mi zhu yi shen qi 。]

english: Apparently, servants of some 'Fallen Empire' desired this artefact. However, in their attempt to steal it, they accidently opened a rift into a deadly area of the Abyss called the Scar.
translation: 显然，某个“堕落帝国”的仆人想要这件神器。然而，在他们试图窃取它的过程中，他们意外地打开了一条裂缝，通向深渊中一个名为伤痕的致命区域。 [xian ran ， mou ge “ duo luo di guo ” de pu ren xiang yao zhe jian shen qi 。 ran er ， zai ta men shi tu qie qu ta de guo cheng zhong ， ta men yi wai di da kai le yi tiao lie feng ， tong xiang shen yuan zhong yi ge ming wei shang hen de zhi ming qu yu 。]

english: Were it not for the Justiciar of the Lion, the rift would have endangered all of Gielinor. She used the Eye to close it and then created the Guardians of the Rift to protect this temple.
translation: 如果不是雄狮审判官的存在，这条裂缝就会危及整个吉林诺。她用眼睛关闭了它，然后创造了裂缝守护者来保护这座寺庙。 [ru guo bu shi xiong shi shen pan guan de cun zai ， zhe tiao lie feng jiu hui wei ji zheng ge ji lin nuo 。 ta yong yan jing guan bi le ta ， ran hou chuang zao le lie feng shou hu zhe lai bao hu zhe zuo si miao 。]

english: Of course, the rift is open again now, but with our help, the Guardians of the Rift are keeping it under control.
translation: 当然，裂痕现在再次打开，但在我们的帮助下，裂痕守护者正在控制它。 [dang ran ， lie hen xian zai zai ci da kai ， dan zai wo men de bang zhu xia ， lie hen shou hu zhe zheng zai kong zhi ta 。]

english: I found this dye in the rewards rift...
translation: 我在奖励裂缝中发现了这种染料...... [wo zai jiang li lie feng zhong fa xian le zhe zhong ran liao ......]

english: And you want me to change it to a different one?
translation: 你想让我把它换成另一张吗？ [ni xiang rang wo ba ta huan cheng ling yi zhang ma ？]

english: Well, yes, but how did you know?
translation: 嗯，是的，但是你怎么知道的？ [n ， shi de ， dan shi ni zen me zhi dao de ？]

english: You'd be surprised at how often this happens. Lots of adventurers have been pulling bottles of dye out of that rift, only to wish they'd got a different one. I've ended up with plenty of spares.
translation: 你会对这种情况发生的频率感到惊讶。许多冒险家一直从裂缝中取出一瓶染料，只是希望他们能得到另一瓶。我最终得到了很多备用品。 [ni hui dui zhe zhong qing kuang fa sheng de pin lv gan dao jing ya 。 xu duo mao xian jia yi zhi cong lie feng zhong qu chu yi ping ran liao ， zhi shi xi wang ta men neng de dao ling yi ping 。 wo zui zhong de dao le hen duo bei yong pin 。]

english: So on that note, would you like me to swap your dye for you?
translation: 那么，你愿意我为你交换你的染料吗？ [na me ， ni yuan yi wo wei ni jiao huan ni de ran liao ma ？]

english: I'd like to swap my abyssal red dye for some abyssal green dye.
translation: 我想把我的深渊红染料换成深渊绿染料。 [wo xiang ba wo de shen yuan hong ran liao huan cheng shen yuan lv ran liao 。]

english: Thanks, Felix.
translation: 谢谢，菲利克斯。 [xie xie ， fei li ke si 。]

english: Any time, [player name].
translation: 随时，[玩家姓名]。 [sui shi ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: I'd like to swap my abyssal red dye for some abyssal blue dye.
translation: 我想将深渊红染料换成深渊蓝染料。 [wo xiang jiang shen yuan hong ran liao huan cheng shen yuan lan ran liao 。]

english: I'd like to swap my abyssal green dye for some abyssal red dye.
translation: 我想将我的深渊绿色染料换成深渊红色染料。 [wo xiang jiang wo de shen yuan lv se ran liao huan cheng shen yuan hong se ran liao 。]

english: I'd like to swap my abyssal green dye for some abyssal blue dye.
translation: 我想将我的深渊绿色染料换成深渊蓝色染料。 [wo xiang jiang wo de shen yuan lv se ran liao huan cheng shen yuan lan se ran liao 。]

english: I'd like to swap my abyssal blue dye for some abyssal red dye.
translation: 我想将深渊蓝染料换成深渊红染料。 [wo xiang jiang shen yuan lan ran liao huan cheng shen yuan hong ran liao 。]

english: I'd like to swap my abyssal blue dye for some abyssal green dye.
translation: 我想将我的深渊蓝色染料换成深渊绿色染料。 [wo xiang jiang wo de shen yuan lan se ran liao huan cheng shen yuan lv se ran liao 。]

english: Actually, I've changed my mind.
translation: 事实上，我已经改变主意了。 [shi shi shang ， wo yi jing gai bian zhu yi le 。]

english: Not a problem. Feel free to come back if you change your mind.
translation: 不是问题。如果您改变主意，请随时回来。 [bu shi wen ti 。 ru guo nin gai bian zhu yi ， qing sui shi hui lai 。]

english: No, I'd like to sell it to you.
translation: 不，我想卖给你。 [bu ， wo xiang mai gei ni 。]

english: Oh? Usually I trade them for other dyes, I suppose I could buy one from you instead for my own research.
translation: 哦？通常我用它们换取其他染料，我想我可以从你那里购买一种用于我自己的研究。 [o ？ tong chang wo yong ta men huan qu qi ta ran liao ， wo xiang wo ke yi cong ni na li gou mai yi zhong yong yu wo zi ji de yan jiu 。]

english: Which dye did you want to sell?
translation: 您想出售哪种染料？ [nin xiang chu shou na zhong ran liao ？]

english: I lost an item from the rewards rift.
translation: 我从奖励裂缝中丢失了一件物品。 [wo cong jiang li lie feng zhong diu shi le yi jian wu pin 。]

english: What was the item?
translation: 那是什么物品？ [na shi shen me wu pin ？]

english: A locket.
translation: 一个挂坠盒。 [yi ge gua zhui he 。]

english: It's funny you should mention that. I actually found an old locket while rummaging through the rift myself.
translation: 有趣的是你应该提到这一点。事实上，我自己在裂缝中翻找时发现了一个旧挂坠盒。 [you qu de shi ni ying gai ti dao zhe yi dian 。 shi shi shang ， wo zi ji zai lie feng zhong fan zhao shi fa xian le yi ge jiu gua zhui he 。]

english: I'd happily give it to you, but you don't have space for it. Come back when you do.
translation: 我很乐意把它给你，但你没有空间。当你回来的时候就回来吧。 [wo hen le yi ba ta gei ni ， dan ni mei you kong jian 。 dang ni hui lai de shi hou jiu hui lai ba 。]

english: Thanks, Felix!
translation: 谢谢，菲利克斯！ [xie xie ， fei li ke si ！]

english: A bag.
translation: 一个袋子。 [yi ge dai zi 。]

english: It's funny you should mention that. I actually found a bag with strange markings on it while rummaging through the rift myself.
translation: 有趣的是你应该提到这一点。我自己在裂缝中翻找时发现了一个袋子，上面有奇怪的标记。 [you qu de shi ni ying gai ti dao zhe yi dian 。 wo zi ji zai lie feng zhong fan zhao shi fa xian le yi ge dai zi ， shang mian you qi guai de biao ji 。]

english: Actually, it doesn't matter.
translation: 其实，这并不重要。 [qi shi ， zhe bing bu zhong yao 。]

english: Fair enough.
translation: 很公平。 [hen gong ping 。]

english: I'd like to sell you something from the rewards rift.
translation: 我想从奖励裂缝中卖给你一些东西。 [wo xiang cong jiang li lie feng zhong mai gei ni yi xie dong xi 。]

english: Oh? Usually I sell items to you adventurers. What did you have in mind?
translation: 哦？通常我会向你们冒险者出售物品。你有什么想法？ [o ？ tong chang wo hui xiang ni men mao xian zhe chu shou wu pin 。 ni you shen me xiang fa ？]

english: An abyssal green dye? I can offer you 50 abyssal pearls for that.
translation: 深渊绿色染料？我可以给你 50 颗深渊珍珠。 [shen yuan lv se ran liao ？ wo ke yi gei ni  50  ke shen yuan zhen zhu 。]

english: Come back if you have any more items from the rift to sell.
translation: 如果您还有裂缝中的更多物品可以出售，请回来。 [ru guo nin hai you lie feng zhong de geng duo wu pin ke yi chu shou ， qing hui lai 。]

english: On second thoughts, I'll keep it for myself.
translation: 转念一想，我还是自己留着吧。 [zhuan nian yi xiang ， wo hai shi zi ji liu zhe ba 。]

english: Very well, come back if you change your mind.
translation: 很好，如果你改变主意就回来吧。 [hen hao ， ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi jiu hui lai ba 。]

english: An abyssal blue dye? I can offer you 50 abyssal pearls for that.
translation: 深渊蓝色染料？我可以给你 50 颗深渊珍珠。 [shen yuan lan se ran liao ？ wo ke yi gei ni  50  ke shen yuan zhen zhu 。]

english: An abyssal red dye? I can offer you 50 abyssal pearls for that.
translation: 深渊红色染料？我可以给你 50 颗深渊珍珠。 [shen yuan hong se ran liao ？ wo ke yi gei ni  50  ke shen yuan zhen zhu 。]

english: An abyssal lantern? I can offer you 100 abyssal pearls for that.
translation: 深渊灯笼？我可以为你提供 100 颗深渊珍珠。 [shen yuan deng long ？ wo ke yi wei ni ti gong  100  ke shen yuan zhen zhu 。]

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Alright. See you later.
translation: 好吧。稍后见。 [hao ba 。 shao hou jian 。]

english: Let's see what you have.
translation: 让我们看看你有什么。 [rang wo men kan kan ni you shen me 。]

english: Can I see your general items?
translation: 我可以看看你们的一般物品吗？ [wo ke yi kan kan ni men de yi ban wu pin ma ？]

english: Lanterns, you say?
translation: 你说灯笼？ [ni shuo deng long ？]

english: I understand how powerful these are, I'd like to buy one.
translation: 我知道这些有多强大，我想买一个。 [wo zhi dao zhe xie you duo qiang da ， wo xiang mai yi ge 。]

english: I'm not sure I'm ready to buy one yet.
translation: 我不确定我是否准备好购买一个。 [wo bu que ding wo shi fou zhun bei hao gou mai yi ge 。]

english: What's that rift guardian doing over there?
translation: 那个裂隙守护者在那儿做什么？ [na ge lie xi shou hu zhe zai na er zuo shen me ？]

english: Why are you selling things here?
translation: 你为什么在这里卖东西？ [ni wei shen me zai zhe li mai dong xi ？]

translation: 我是阿奇奥，图书馆历史档案馆的守护者。我授予访客和工作人员访问档案的权限。 [wo shi a qi ao ， tu shu guan li shi dang an guan de shou hu zhe 。 wo shou yu fang ke he gong zuo ren yuan fang wen dang an de quan xian 。]

translation: 呃...是的，对此感到抱歉。为什么你们都站在这里？ [e ... shi de ， dui ci gan dao bao qian 。 wei shen me ni men dou zhan zai zhe li ？]

translation: ……什、什么？你怎么..？ […… shen 、 shen me ？ ni zen me ..？]

translation: 不，你错了。现在走开。 [bu ， ni cuo le 。 xian zai zou kai 。]

translation: 别告诉我像你这样的新手已经找到了！ [bie gao su wo xiang ni zhe yang de xin shou yi jing zhao dao le ！]
