translation: 是的。也很容易找到它。 [shi de 。 ye hen rong yi zhao dao ta 。]

english: ...I cannot believe that someone like YOU could find the portal where experienced adventurers such as ourselves could not.
translation: ...我不敢相信像你这样的人能够找到像我们这样经验丰富的冒险家却找不到的门户。 [... wo bu gan xiang xin xiang ni zhe yang de ren neng gou zhao dao xiang wo men zhe yang jing yan feng fu de mao xian jia que zhao bu dao de men hu 。]

translation: 你能传送我到符文精华矿吗？ [ni neng chuan song wo dao fu wen jing hua kuang ma ？]

translation: 七岁的蔑视莫伦科！ [qi sui de mie shi mo lun ke ！]

english: I have news on Persten.
translation: 我有关于佩斯滕的消息。 [wo you guan yu pei si teng de xiao xi 。]

english: Yes?
translation: 是的？ [shi de ？]

english: I'm sorry, but she's gone.
translation: 对不起，但她已经走了。 [dui bu qi ， dan ta yi jing zou le 。]

english: I see. It was always unlikely that she'd survive the Abyss.
translation: 我懂了。她总是不太可能在深渊中幸存下来。 [wo dong le 。 ta zong shi bu tai ke neng zai shen yuan zhong xing cun xia lai 。]

english: It wasn't the Abyss. I think she might have been dead long before then. The Persten we spoke to was an imposter.
translation: 这不是深渊。我想她可能在那之前很久就已经死了。我们采访的佩尔斯滕是个冒名顶替者。 [zhe bu shi shen yuan 。 wo xiang ta ke neng zai na zhi qian hen jiu jiu yi jing si le 。 wo men cai fang de pei er si teng shi ge mao ming ding ti zhe 。]

english: An imposter? What do you mean?
translation: 冒名顶替者？你是什​​么意思？ [mao ming ding ti zhe ？ ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: A Mahjarrat called Sliske was disguised as her.
translation: 一位名叫斯利斯克（Sliske）的玛吉拉特（Mahjarrat）伪装成她。 [yi wei ming jiao si li si ke （Sliske） de ma ji la te （Mahjarrat） wei zhuang cheng ta 。]

english: I can't believe it. Persten and I had our differences, but this...
translation: 我简直不敢相信。佩斯滕和我有分歧，但这...... [wo jian zhi bu gan xiang xin 。 pei si teng he wo you fen qi ， dan zhe ......]

english: I'd better share this news with the others. Thank you for bringing it to me.
translation: 我最好与其他人分享这个消息。谢谢你把它带给我。 [wo zui hao yu qi ta ren fen xiang zhe ge xiao xi 。 xie xie ni ba ta dai gei wo 。]

english: How are things at the Temple of the Eye?
translation: 眼殿的情况怎么样？ [yan dian de qing kuang zen me yang ？]

english: Between the Guardians of the Rift and ourselves, we are managing to keep the Abyss at bay.
translation: 在裂隙守护者和我们自己的努力下，我们正在设法阻止深渊。 [zai lie xi shou hu zhe he wo men zi ji de nu li xia ， wo men zheng zai she fa zu zhi shen yuan 。]

english: However, despite all our research, we are no closer to working out how to close the rift permanently.
translation: 然而，尽管我们进行了所有的研究，但我们仍然距离找到永久弥合裂痕的方法还很远。 [ran er ， jin guan wo men jin xing le suo you de yan jiu ， dan wo men reng ran ju li zhao dao yong jiu mi he lie hen de fang fa hai hen yuan 。]

english: Gaining a better understanding of the artefact that was once there is key, but we have found little mention of this 'Eye'.
translation: 更好地了解曾经存在的文物是关键，但我们发现很少有人提到这个“眼睛”。 [geng hao di liao jie ceng jing cun zai de wen wu shi guan jian ， dan wo men fa xian hen shao you ren ti dao zhe ge “ yan jing ”。]

english: I'm sure the wizards of the first tower had plenty of research on it. After all, they knew enough about it to use its symbol as the symbol for our order.
translation: 我确信第一座塔的巫师对此进行了大量的研究。毕竟，他们对它了解得足够多，可以用它的符号作为我们秩序的符号。 [wo que xin di yi zuo ta de wu shi dui ci jin xing le da liang de yan jiu 。 bi jing ， ta men dui ta liao jie de zu gou duo ， ke yi yong ta de fu hao zuo wei wo men zhi xu de fu hao 。]

english: All that knowledge lost because of those accursed Zamorakians!
translation: 所有这些知识都因为那些该死的萨莫拉克人而消失了！ [suo you zhe xie zhi shi dou yin wei na xie gai si de sa mo la ke ren er xiao shi le ！]

english: I don't know if it will be much help, but I found out its real name. It's called the Stone of Jas.
translation: 我不知道这是否会有多大帮助，但我知道了它的真名。它被称为贾斯之石。 [wo bu zhi dao zhe shi fou hui you duo da bang zhu ， dan wo zhi dao le ta de zhen ming 。 ta bei cheng wei jia si zhi shi 。]

english: Hmm... That could be useful. I'll have a dig around and see if we can find any mention of it.
translation: 嗯...这可能有用。我会仔细研究一下，看看是否能找到任何提及它的内容。 [n ... zhe ke neng you yong 。 wo hui zi xi yan jiu yi xia ， kan kan shi fou neng zhao dao ren he ti ji ta de nei rong 。]

english: Anyway, if you wish to help defend the temple, just head through the portal.
translation: 不管怎样，如果你想帮助保卫神庙，就穿过传送门吧。 [bu guan zen yang ， ru guo ni xiang bang zhu bao wei shen miao ， jiu chuan guo chuan song men ba 。]

english: Were you able to find any information on the Stone of Jas?
translation: 您能找到有关贾斯之石的信息吗？ [nin neng zhao dao you guan jia si zhi shi de xin xi ma ？]

english: Not yet. So far we've still only been able to find a few small mentions of it, but they all call it the Eye.
translation: 还没有。到目前为止，我们仍然只能找到一些关于它的小提及，但他们都称它为“眼睛”。 [hai mei you 。 dao mu qian wei zhi ， wo men reng ran zhi neng zhao dao yi xie guan yu ta de xiao ti ji ， dan ta men dou cheng ta wei “ yan jing ”。]

english: I'm sure the wizards of the first tower had plenty of research that could have helped. All that knowledge lost because of those accursed Zamorakians!
translation: 我确信第一座塔的巫师们进行了大量的研究，可以有所帮助。所有这些知识都因为那些该死的萨莫拉克人而消失了！ [wo que xin di yi zuo ta de wu shi men jin xing le da liang de yan jiu ， ke yi you suo bang zhu 。 suo you zhe xie zhi shi dou yin wei na xie gai si de sa mo la ke ren er xiao shi le ！]

english: I might do that, thanks.
translation: 我可能会这样做，谢谢。 [wo ke neng hui zhe yang zuo ， xie xie 。]

english: Who else knows the teleport to the Rune Essence Mine?
translation: 还有谁知道符文精矿矿的传送？ [hai you shui zhi dao fu wen jing kuang kuang de chuan song ？]

english: Apart from myself, there's also Aubury in Varrock, Wizard Cromperty in East Ardougne, Brimstail in the Tree Gnome Stronghold and Wizard Distentor in Yanille's Wizards' Guild.
translation: 除了我自己之外，还有瓦罗克的奥伯里、东阿杜涅的巫师克朗珀蒂、树侏儒要塞的布里姆泰尔和雅尼尔巫师公会的巫师迪斯坦托。 [chu le wo zi ji zhi wai ， hai you wa luo ke de ao bo li 、 dong e du nie de wu shi ke lang po di 、 shu zhu ru yao sai de bu li mu tai er he ya ni er wu shi gong hui de wu shi di si tan tuo 。]

english: Thanks for the information.
translation: 感谢您提供信息。 [gan xie nin ti gong xin xi 。]

english: My pleasure.
translation: 我的荣幸。 [wo de rong xing 。]

english: Could you tell me about the old Wizards' Tower?
translation: 你能告诉我关于旧巫师塔的事吗？ [ni neng gao su wo guan yu jiu wu shi ta de shi ma ？]

english: Of course. The first Wizards' Tower was built at the same time the Order of Wizards was founded. It was at the dawn of the Fifth Age, when the secrets of runecrafting were rediscovered.
translation: 当然。第一座巫师塔是在巫师团成立的同时建造的。那是在第五纪元初期，符文制作的秘密被重新发现。 [dang ran 。 di yi zuo wu shi ta shi zai wu shi tuan cheng li de tong shi jian zao de 。 na shi zai di wu ji yuan chu qi ， fu wen zhi zuo de mi mi bei chong xin fa xian 。]

english: For years, the tower was a hub of magical research. Wizards of all races and religions were welcomed into our order.
translation: 多年来，这座塔一直是魔法研究的中心。所有种族和宗教的巫师都受到我们骑士团的欢迎。 [duo nian lai ， zhe zuo ta yi zhi shi mo fa yan jiu de zhong xin 。 suo you zhong zu he zong jiao de wu shi dou shou dao wo men qi shi tuan de huan ying 。]

english: Alas, that openness is what ultimately led to disaster. The wizards who served Zamorak, the evil god of chaos, tried to claim our magical discoveries in his name.
translation: 唉，这种开放性最终导致了灾难。侍奉混沌邪恶之神萨莫拉克的巫师们试图以他的名义夺取我们的魔法发现。 [ai ， zhe zhong kai fang xing zui zhong dao zhi le zai nan 。 shi feng hun dun xie e zhi shen sa mo la ke de wu shi men shi tu yi ta de ming yi duo qu wo men de mo fa fa xian 。]

english: They failed, but in retaliation, they burnt the entire tower to the ground. Years of work was destroyed.
translation: 他们失败了，但为了报复，他们把整座塔烧毁了。多年的心血被毁了。 [ta men shi bai le ， dan wei le bao fu ， ta men ba zheng zuo ta shao hui le 。 duo nian de xin xue bei hui le 。]

english: The tower was soon rebuilt of course, but even now we are still trying to regain knowledge that was lost.
translation: 当然，塔很快就被重建了，但即使现在我们仍在努力重新获得失去的知识。 [dang ran ， ta hen kuai jiu bei chong jian le ， dan ji shi xian zai wo men reng zai nu li chong xin huo de shi qu de zhi shi 。]

english: That's why I spend my time down here, in fact. This basement is all that is left of the old tower, and I believe there are still some secrets to discover here.
translation: 事实上，这就是我在这里度过时光的原因。这个地下室是旧塔仅存的部分，相信这里还有一些秘密有待发现。 [shi shi shang ， zhe jiu shi wo zai zhe li du guo shi guang de yuan yin 。 zhe ge di xia shi shi jiu ta jin cun de bu fen ， xiang xin zhe li hai you yi xie mi mi you dai fa xian 。]

english: Of course, one secret I am no longer looking for is the teleportation incantation to the Rune Essence Mine. We have you to thank for that.
translation: 当然，我不再寻找的一个秘密就是前往符文精矿矿的传送咒。为此我们要感谢你。 [dang ran ， wo bu zai xun zhao de yi ge mi mi jiu shi qian wang fu wen jing kuang kuang de chuan song zhou 。 wei ci wo men yao gan xie ni 。]

english: I've heard a different take on how the tower burnt down. Something about a ritual gone wrong?
translation: 对于这座塔是如何被烧毁的，我听到过不同的看法。是不是仪式出了问题？ [dui yu zhe zuo ta shi ru he bei shao hui de ， wo ting dao guo bu tong de kan fa 。 shi bu shi yi shi chu le wen ti ？]

english: Nothing more than Zamorakian hearsay! They burnt the tower down and are now too cowardly to even admit it!
translation: 只不过是萨莫拉克的传闻而已！他们烧毁了塔楼，现在却胆怯得连承认都不敢承认！ [zhi bu guo shi sa mo la ke de chuan wen er yi ！ ta men shao hui le ta lou ， xian zai que dan qie de lian cheng ren dou bu gan cheng ren ！]

english: Fair enough.
translation: 很公平。 [hen gong ping 。]

english: Nothing thanks, I'm just looking around.
translation: 没什么，谢谢，我只是四处看看。 [mei shen me ， xie xie ， wo zhi shi si chu kan kan 。]

english: Well, take care. You stand on the ruins of the old destroyed Wizards' Tower. Strange and powerful magicks lurk here.
translation: 嗯，保重。你站在古老的被毁坏的巫师塔的废墟上。这里潜伏着奇怪而强大的魔法。 [n ， bao zhong 。 ni zhan zai gu lao de bei hui huai de wu shi ta de fei xu shang 。 zhe li qian fu zhe qi guai er qiang da de mo fa 。]

english: Well done.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: You've obtained a [new clue/casket]!
translation: 你获得了[新线索/棺材]！ [ni huo de le [ xin xian suo / guan cai ]！]

english: Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence Mine?
translation: 你能传送我到符文精华矿吗？ [ni neng chuan song wo dao fu wen jing hua kuang ma ？]

english: I have news on Persten.
translation: 我有关于佩斯滕的消息。 [wo you guan yu pei si teng de xiao xi 。]

english: How are things at the Temple of the Eye?
translation: 眼殿的情况怎么样？ [yan dian de qing kuang zen me yang ？]

english: Could you tell me about the old Wizards' Tower?
translation: 你能告诉我关于旧巫师塔的事吗？ [ni neng gao su wo guan yu jiu wu shi ta de shi ma ？]

english: I might do that, thanks.
translation: 我可能会这样做，谢谢。 [wo ke neng hui zhe yang zuo ， xie xie 。]

english: Who else knows the teleport to the Rune Essence Mine?
translation: 还有谁知道符文精矿矿的传送？ [hai you shui zhi dao fu wen jing kuang kuang de chuan song ？]

english: Thanks for the information.
translation: 感谢您提供信息。 [gan xie nin ti gong xin xi 。]

english: Nothing thanks, I'm just looking around.
translation: 没什么，谢谢，我只是四处看看。 [mei shen me ， xie xie ， wo zhi shi si chu kan kan 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Woo wooo?
translation: 呜呜？ [wu wu ？]

english: Me? I am the Archpriest who was responsible for the running of this place! I am impressed that you managed to reach my resting place on the lowest level.
translation: 我？我是负责管理这里的大祭司！令我印象深刻的是，你成功地到达了我在最低层的安息之地。 [wo ？ wo shi fu ze guan li zhe li de da ji si ！ ling wo yin xiang shen ke de shi ， ni cheng gong di dao da le wo zai zui di ceng de an xi zhi di 。]

english: Well it wasn't easy for sure. You wouldn't believe how difficult it was to overcome some of those traps.
translation: 嗯，这确实不容易。你不会相信克服其中一些陷阱有多么困难。 [n ， zhe que shi bu rong yi 。 ni bu hui xiang xin ke fu qi zhong yi xie xian jing you duo me kun nan 。]

english: The intention was that they should've been impossible to pass. I should know. After all, it was I who was responsible for overseeing the safeguarding of this place.
translation: 其目的是让他们不可能通过。我应该知道。毕竟，负责守护这里的人是我。 [qi mu di shi rang ta men bu ke neng tong guo 。 wo ying gai zhi dao 。 bi jing ， fu ze shou hu zhe li de ren shi wo 。]

english: Why did you need the safeguards? Surely they made it more difficult to do your work down here?
translation: 为什么需要保障措施？他们肯定让你在这里工作变得更加困难了吧？ [wei shen me xu yao bao zhang cuo shi ？ ta men ken ding rang ni zai zhe li gong zuo bian de geng jia kun nan le ba ？]

english: I'm not sure if I should say... I wouldn't want to compromise the trust that the Justiciar of the Unicorn has in me. Afterall, we did what we did for the safety of Hallowvale.
translation: 我不确定我是否应该说……我不想损害独角兽审判官对我的信任。毕竟，我们所做的一切都是为了万圣节谷的安全。 [wo bu que ding wo shi fou ying gai shuo …… wo bu xiang sun hai du jiao shou shen pan guan dui wo de xin ren 。 bi jing ， wo men suo zuo de yi qie dou shi wei le wan sheng jie gu de an quan 。]

english: So... about that. Hallowvale no longer exists. The Hallowed Sepulchre is now beneath the vampyre capital of Darkmeyer within the lands of Morytania.
translation: 所以...关于那个。霍洛韦尔已不复存在。神圣墓穴现在位于莫里塔尼亚土地上的吸血鬼首都达克梅尔下方。 [suo yi ... guan yu na ge 。 huo luo wei er yi bu fu cun zai 。 shen sheng mu xue xian zai wei yu mo li ta ni ya tu di shang de xi xue gui shou du da ke mei er xia fang 。]

english: I see... So we lost then? In that case, I suppose it doesn't hurt to tell you after all.
translation: 原来如此……那么我们就输了？既然如此，我想告诉你也没什么坏处。 [yuan lai ru ci …… na me wo men jiu shu le ？ ji ran ru ci ， wo xiang gao su ni ye mei shen me huai chu 。]

english: One day the justiciar sent word to me that I should begin work on securing the Sepulchre. He feared an invasion from the followers of the Dark Lord.
translation: 有一天，法官传话给我，要我开始保护坟墓的工作。他担心黑魔王追随者的入侵。 [you yi tian ， fa guan chuan hua gei wo ， yao wo kai shi bao hu fen mu de gong zuo 。 ta dan xin hei mo wang zhui sui zhe de ru qin 。]

english: Do you mean Zamorak?
translation: 你是说萨莫拉克吗？ [ni shi shuo sa mo la ke ma ？]

english: Yes, I do. The justiciar said he was going to confront these forces but that I should stay to protect the secrets within this place. I wish I could have joined him on the battlefield. I carried out my duties though.
translation: 是的，我愿意。法官说他要对抗这些势力，但我应该留下来保护这里的秘密。我希望我能和他一起上战场。但我还是履行了我的职责。 [shi de ， wo yuan yi 。 fa guan shuo ta yao dui kang zhe xie shi li ， dan wo ying gai liu xia lai bao hu zhe li de mi mi 。 wo xi wang wo neng he ta yi qi shang zhan chang 。 dan wo hai shi lv xing le wo de zhi ze 。]

english: I never told the others what was really happening. Day by day we worked our way down to the final floor.
translation: 我从来没有告诉其他人到底发生了什么。日复一日，我们一直走到最后一层。 [wo cong lai mei you gao su qi ta ren dao di fa sheng le shen me 。 ri fu yi ri ， wo men yi zhi zou dao zui hou yi ceng 。]

english: As we progressed further, we became more experienced at creating the traps. Each one was more deadly than the last.
translation: 随着我们的进一步进步，我们在制造陷阱方面变得更加有经验。每一个都比上一个更致命。 [sui zhe wo men de jin yi bu jin bu ， wo men zai zhi zao xian jing fang mian bian de geng jia you jing yan 。 mei yi ge dou bi shang yi ge geng zhi ming 。]

english: Eventually, when our work was done, I performed the last rites for each of my followers and sealed them within the coffins on the final floor.
translation: 最终，当我们的工作完成后，我为每个追随者进行了最后的仪式，并将他们密封在最后一层的棺材里。 [zui zhong ， dang wo men de gong zuo wan cheng hou ， wo wei mei ge zhui sui zhe jin xing le zui hou de yi shi ， bing jiang ta men mi feng zai zui hou yi ceng de guan cai li 。]

english: Finally, I did the same for myself. The knowledge of how to disarm the traps died with us.
translation: 最后，我也为自己做了同样的事情。如何解除陷阱的知识随着我们的消失而消失了。 [zui hou ， wo ye wei zi ji zuo le tong yang de shi qing 。 ru he jie chu xian jing de zhi shi sui zhe wo men de xiao shi er xiao shi le 。]

english: You buried yourselves alive? That's... horrible!
translation: 你把自己活埋了？那真是……太可怕了！ [ni ba zi ji huo mai le ？ na zhen shi …… tai ke pa le ！]

english: No, I think at that point most of us were already dead. We died knowing that we sacrificed ourselves for the good of holy Saradomin and the justiciars who follow him.
translation: 不，我想那时我们大多数人都已经死了。我们死时知道，我们是为了神圣的萨拉多明和追随他的正义者的利益而牺牲自己的。 [bu ， wo xiang na shi wo men da duo shu ren dou yi jing si le 。 wo men si shi zhi dao ， wo men shi wei le shen sheng de sa la duo ming he zhui sui ta de zheng yi zhe de li yi er xi sheng zi ji de 。]

english: Well, at the very least you succeeded at keeping the vampyres out of the Sepulchre. From what I have seen, none of them have been able to enter.
translation: 好吧，至少你成功地将吸血鬼赶出了坟墓。据我所知，他们都没有能够进入。 [hao ba ， zhi shao ni cheng gong di jiang xi xue gui gan chu le fen mu 。 ju wo suo zhi ， ta men dou mei you neng gou jin ru 。]

english: I am glad adventurer. Perhaps that information will allow my spirit to pass on peacefully soon.
translation: 我很高兴成为冒险家。也许这些信息能让我的灵魂很快安息。 [wo hen gao xing cheng wei mao xian jia 。 ye xu zhe xie xin xi neng rang wo de ling hun hen kuai an xi 。]

english: Woo? Woo wooooooooo!
translation: 呜？呜呜呜！ [wu ？ wu wu wu ！]

english: What are you doing in my coffin? Leave this holy place at once!
translation: 你在我的棺材里做什么？赶紧离开这个圣地吧！ [ni zai wo de guan cai li zuo shen me ？ gan jin li kai zhe ge sheng di ba ！]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Greetings.
translation: 问候。 [wen hou 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I am an architect. I designed and built many of the buildings in Arceuus using magic.
translation: 我是一名建筑师。我使用魔法设计并建造了阿尔宙斯的许多建筑物。 [wo shi yi ming jian zhu shi 。 wo shi yong mo fa she ji bing jian zao le a er zhou si de xu duo jian zhu wu 。]

english: How exciting!
translation: 多么令人兴奋啊！ [duo me ling ren xing fen a ！]

english: It is an honour to serve my city in such a way. Now, I am very busy, please leave.
translation: 以这样的方式为我的城市服务是我的荣幸。现在我很忙，请你离开吧。 [yi zhe yang de fang shi wei wo de cheng shi fu wu shi wo de rong xing 。 xian zai wo hen mang ， qing ni li kai ba 。]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 你知道，打招呼的方式有很多种。你好，你好，你好…… [ni zhi dao ， da zhao hu de fang shi you hen duo zhong 。 ni hao ， ni hao ， ni hao ……]

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 那还是只能算一个！ [na hai shi zhi neng suan yi ge ！]

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。你今天怎么样？ [ni hao 。 ni jin tian zen me yang ？]

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很棒，谢谢你！ [wo hen bang ， xie xie ni ！]

english: Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 你好！水晶城里今天过得怎么样啊？ [ni hao ！ shui jing cheng li jin tian guo de zen me yang a ？]

english: Indeed.
translation: 的确。 [di que 。]

english: What can I do for ya?
translation: 我能为你做什么？ [wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 各种各样的事情！这些塔楼是一个美妙的景观。 [ge zhong ge yang de shi qing ！ zhe xie ta lou shi yi ge mei miao de jing guan 。]

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 在像今天这样的日子，我建议您参观市场。 [zai xiang jin tian zhe yang de ri zi ， wo jian yi nin can guan shi chang 。]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你认为你在做什么？ [ni ren wei ni zai zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: Can I help you, [sir/madam]?
translation: 我可以帮你吗，[先生/女士]？ [wo ke yi bang ni ma ，[ xian sheng / nv shi ]？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This is the Emir's Arena. Fighters come from far and wide to arrange fights against their friends and rivals. They can fight in 1v1 Tournaments or Duels.
translation: 这是埃米尔的竞技场。拳手们从四面八方赶来，安排与他们的朋友和对手的战斗。他们可以参加 1v1 锦标赛或决斗。 [zhe shi ai mi er de jing ji chang 。 quan shou men cong si mian ba fang gan lai ， an pai yu ta men de peng you he dui shou de zhan dou 。 ta men ke yi can jia  1v1  jin biao sai huo jue dou 。]

english: The Arena is open only on PvP Arena worlds. Switch to one of those game worlds to play in the Arena.
translation: 竞技场仅在 PvP 竞技场世界中开放。切换到这些游戏世界之一，在竞技场中玩。 [jing ji chang jin zai  PvP  jing ji chang shi jie zhong kai fang 。 qie huan dao zhe xie you xi shi jie zhi yi ， zai jing ji chang zhong wan 。]

english: Head over to the hospital north of the Arena, and speak to the Guides. They'll help you sign up to a fight. Now, can I help you with anything else?
translation: 前往竞技场以北的医院，并与向导交谈。他们会帮助你报名参加战斗。现在，我还能帮你什么忙吗？ [qian wang jing ji chang yi bei de yi yuan ， bing yu xiang dao jiao tan 。 ta men hui bang zhu ni bao ming can jia zhan dou 。 xian zai ， wo hai neng bang ni shen me mang ma ？]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: The Emir of Al-Kharid has decreed that his Arena should be guarded, to stop ruffians like the Calamity Coven from returning. But is there something I can do for you?
translation: 阿尔卡里德的埃米尔颁布法令，要求他的竞技场受到守卫，以阻止像灾难女巫会这样的恶棍卷土重来。但是有什么我可以为您做的吗？ [a er ka li de de ai mi er ban bu fa ling ， yao qiu ta de jing ji chang shou dao shou wei ， yi zu zhi xiang zai nan nv wu hui zhe yang de e gun juan tu chong lai 。 dan shi you shen me wo ke yi wei nin zuo de ma ？]

english: Tell me about the Calamity Coven.
translation: 告诉我关于灾难集会的事。 [gao su wo guan yu zai nan ji hui de shi 。]

english: The Calamity Coven were three brigands, followers of an ancient and derelict religion. Through their foul arts, they turned this Arena into a hotbed of corruption.
translation: 灾难女巫会由三个强盗组成，他们是一个古老而废弃的宗教的追随者。他们通过邪恶的手段，将这个竞技场变成了腐败的温床。 [zai nan nv wu hui you san ge qiang dao zu cheng ， ta men shi yi ge gu lao er fei qi de zong jiao de zhui sui zhe 。 ta men tong guo xie e de shou duan ， jiang zhe ge jing ji chang bian cheng le fu bai de wen chuang 。]

english: Maoma was a captain of the Emir's guard, but she abused her authority to rig fights so that the Coven would get rich at the people's expense.

translation: 阿尔卡里德的埃米尔颁布法令，要求他的竞技场受到守卫，以阻止像灾难女巫会这样的恶棍卷土重来。但是有什么我可以为您做的吗？ [a er ka li de de ai mi er ban bu fa ling ， yao qiu ta de jing ji chang shou dao shou wei ， yi zu zhi xiang zai nan nv wu hui zhe yang de e gun juan tu chong lai 。 dan shi you shen me wo ke yi wei nin zuo de ma ？]

english: Tell me about the Calamity Coven.
translation: 告诉我关于灾难集会的事。 [gao su wo guan yu zai nan ji hui de shi 。]

english: The Calamity Coven were three brigands, followers of an ancient and derelict religion. Through their foul arts, they turned this Arena into a hotbed of corruption.
translation: 灾难女巫会由三个强盗组成，他们是一个古老而废弃的宗教的追随者。他们通过邪恶的手段，将这个竞技场变成了腐败的温床。 [zai nan nv wu hui you san ge qiang dao zu cheng ， ta men shi yi ge gu lao er fei qi de zong jiao de zhui sui zhe 。 ta men tong guo xie e de shou duan ， jiang zhe ge jing ji chang bian cheng le fu bai de wen chuang 。]

english: Maoma was a captain of the Emir's guard, but she abused her authority to rig fights so that the Coven would get rich at the people's expense.
translation: 毛玛是埃米尔卫队的队长，但她滥用权力操纵斗殴，以便女巫会以牺牲人民的利益为代价致富。 [mao ma shi ai mi er wei dui de dui zhang ， dan ta lan yong quan li cao zong dou ou ， yi bian nv wu hui yi xi sheng ren min de li yi wei dai jia zhi fu 。]

english: Saika was the brains behind their operation, forging the Arena's accounts so that the Coven could keep all the profits, starving the Emir's public works of all funding.
translation: 塞卡是他们行动背后的大脑，伪造了竞技场的账目，以便女巫集会可以保留所有利润，使埃米尔的公共工程缺乏所有资金。 [sai ka shi ta men xing dong bei hou de da nao ， wei zao le jing ji chang de zhang mu ， yi bian nv wu ji hui ke yi bao liu suo you li run ， shi ai mi er de gong gong gong cheng que fa suo you zi jin 。]

english: Koriff used her charms to act as a gracious hostess, whipping up the crowds' excitement so that they'd gamble more and more unwisely, enriching the Coven.
translation: 科里夫利用自己的魅力充当了一位亲切的女主人，煽动人群的兴奋感，让他们越来越不明智地赌博，从而让巫会变得更加富有。 [ke li fu li yong zi ji de mei li chong dang le yi wei qin qie de nv zhu ren ， shan dong ren qun de xing fen gan ， rang ta men yue lai yue bu ming zhi di du bo ， cong er rang wu hui bian de geng jia fu you 。]

english: The Calamity Coven are long gone now; some of their old possessions are even being sold as rewards. Now, we are here to prevent a resurgence in such crime. But is there something I can do for you?

english: Do you work out a lot?
translation: 你经常锻炼吗？ [ni jing chang duan lian ma ？]

english: Gotta stay ahead of the fighters! Personally, I'm trying to get a bigger chest.
translation: 一定要走在战士的前面！就我个人而言，我正在努力获得更大的胸部。 [yi ding yao zou zai zhan shi de qian mian ！ jiu wo ge ren er yan ， wo zheng zai nu li huo de geng da de xiong bu 。]

english: The Arena is open only on PvP Arena worlds. Switch to one of those game worlds to play in the Arena.
translation: 竞技场仅在 PvP 竞技场世界中开放。切换到这些游戏世界之一，在竞技场中玩。 [jing ji chang jin zai  PvP  jing ji chang shi jie zhong kai fang 。 qie huan dao zhe xie you xi shi jie zhi yi ， zai jing ji chang zhong wan 。]

translation: 灾难女巫会由三个强盗组成，他们是一个古老而废弃的宗教的追随者。他们通过邪恶的手段，将这个竞技场变成了腐败的温床。 [zai nan nv wu hui you san ge qiang dao zu cheng ， ta men shi yi ge gu lao er fei qi de zong jiao de zhui sui zhe 。 ta men tong guo xie e de shou duan ， jiang zhe ge jing ji chang bian cheng le fu bai de wen chuang 。]

english: Maoma was a captain of the Emir's guard, but she abused her authority to rig fights so that the Coven would get rich at the people's expense.
translation: 毛玛是埃米尔卫队的队长，但她滥用权力操纵斗殴，以便女巫会以牺牲人民的利益为代价致富。 [mao ma shi ai mi er wei dui de dui zhang ， dan ta lan yong quan li cao zong dou ou ， yi bian nv wu hui yi xi sheng ren min de li yi wei dai jia zhi fu 。]

english: Saika was the brains behind their operation, forging the Arena's accounts so that the Coven could keep all the profits, starving the Emir's public works of all funding.
translation: 塞卡是他们行动背后的大脑，伪造了竞技场的账目，以便女巫集会可以保留所有利润，使埃米尔的公共工程缺乏所有资金。 [sai ka shi ta men xing dong bei hou de da nao ， wei zao le jing ji chang de zhang mu ， yi bian nv wu ji hui ke yi bao liu suo you li run ， shi ai mi er de gong gong gong cheng que fa suo you zi jin 。]

english: Koriff used her charms to act as a gracious hostess, whipping up the crowds' excitement so that they'd gamble more and more unwisely, enriching the Coven.
translation: 科里夫利用自己的魅力充当了一位亲切的女主人，煽动人群的兴奋感，让他们越来越不明智地赌博，从而让巫会变得更加富有。 [ke li fu li yong zi ji de mei li chong dang le yi wei qin qie de nv zhu ren ， shan dong ren qun de xing fen gan ， rang ta men yue lai yue bu ming zhi di du bo ， cong er rang wu hui bian de geng jia fu you 。]

english: The Calamity Coven are long gone now; some of their old possessions are even being sold as rewards. Now, we are here to prevent a resurgence in such crime. But is there something I can do for you?
translation: 灾难女巫会早已不复存在；他们的一些旧财产甚至被出售作为奖励。现在，我们来这里是为了防止此类犯罪的死灰复燃。但是有什么我可以为您做的吗？ [zai nan nv wu hui zao yi bu fu cun zai ； ta men de yi xie jiu cai chan shen zhi bei chu shou zuo wei jiang li 。 xian zai ， wo men lai zhe li shi wei le fang zhi ci lei fan zui de si hui fu ran 。 dan shi you shen me wo ke yi wei nin zuo de ma ？]

english: Could you give me some merching tips?
translation: 你能给我一些营销技巧吗？ [ni neng gei wo yi xie ying xiao ji qiao ma ？]

english: Buy high, sell low.
translation: 高买，低卖。 [gao mai ， di mai 。]

english: I... don't think that's right.
translation: 我……不认为这是正确的。 [wo …… bu ren wei zhe shi zheng que de 。]

english: That's why I became a guard...
translation: 这就是我成为一名警卫的原因... [zhe jiu shi wo cheng wei yi ming jing wei de yuan yin ...]

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Tell me about the Calamity Coven.
translation: 告诉我关于灾难集会的事。 [gao su wo guan yu zai nan ji hui de shi 。]

english: Tell me again about the Calamity Coven.
translation: 再给我讲讲灾难女巫会的事吧。 [zai gei wo jiang jiang zai nan nv wu hui de shi ba 。]

english: Could you give me some merching tips?
translation: 你能给我一些营销技巧吗？ [ni neng gei wo yi xie ying xiao ji qiao ma ？]

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Can I help you, [sir/madam]?
translation: 我可以帮你吗，[先生/女士]？ [wo ke yi bang ni ma ，[ xian sheng / nv shi ]？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This is the Emir's Arena. Fighters come from far and wide to arrange fights against their friends and rivals. They can fight in 1v1 Tournaments or Duels.
translation: 这是埃米尔的竞技场。拳手们从四面八方赶来，安排与他们的朋友和对手的战斗。他们可以参加 1v1 锦标赛或决斗。 [zhe shi ai mi er de jing ji chang 。 quan shou men cong si mian ba fang gan lai ， an pai yu ta men de peng you he dui shou de zhan dou 。 ta men ke yi can jia  1v1  jin biao sai huo jue dou 。]

english: The Arena is open only on PvP Arena worlds. Switch to one of those game worlds to play in the Arena.
translation: 竞技场仅在 PvP 竞技场世界中开放。切换到这些游戏世界之一，在竞技场中玩。 [jing ji chang jin zai  PvP  jing ji chang shi jie zhong kai fang 。 qie huan dao zhe xie you xi shi jie zhi yi ， zai jing ji chang zhong wan 。]

english: Head over to the hospital north of the Arena, and speak to the Guides. They'll help you sign up to a fight. Now, can I help you with anything else?
translation: 前往竞技场以北的医院，并与向导交谈。他们会帮助你报名参加战斗。现在，我还能帮你什么忙吗？ [qian wang jing ji chang yi bei de yi yuan ， bing yu xiang dao jiao tan 。 ta men hui bang zhu ni bao ming can jia zhan dou 。 xian zai ， wo hai neng bang ni shen me mang ma ？]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: The Emir of Al-Kharid has decreed that his Arena should be guarded, to stop ruffians like the Calamity Coven from returning. But is there something I can do for you?
translation: 阿尔卡里德的埃米尔颁布法令，要求他的竞技场受到守卫，以阻止像灾难女巫会这样的恶棍卷土重来。但是有什么我可以为您做的吗？ [a er ka li de de ai mi er ban bu fa ling ， yao qiu ta de jing ji chang shou dao shou wei ， yi zu zhi xiang zai nan nv wu hui zhe yang de e gun juan tu chong lai 。 dan shi you shen me wo ke yi wei nin zuo de ma ？]

english: Tell me about the Calamity Coven.
translation: 告诉我关于灾难集会的事。 [gao su wo guan yu zai nan ji hui de shi 。]

translation: 灾难女巫会早已不复存在；他们的一些旧财产甚至被出售作为奖励。现在，我们来这里是为了防止此类犯罪的死灰复燃。但是有什么我可以为您做的吗？ [zai nan nv wu hui zao yi bu fu cun zai ； ta men de yi xie jiu cai chan shen zhi bei chu shou zuo wei jiang li 。 xian zai ， wo men lai zhe li shi wei le fang zhi ci lei fan zui de si hui fu ran 。 dan shi you shen me wo ke yi wei nin zuo de ma ？]

english: Could you come and help me with something?
translation: 你能过来帮我做点什么吗？ [ni neng guo lai bang wo zuo dian shen me ma ？]

english: If the problem isn't in the Arena, it's not my problem.
translation: 如果问题不在竞技场，那就不是我的问题。 [ru guo wen ti bu zai jing ji chang ， na jiu bu shi wo de wen ti 。]

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Please stay within the Arena's boundaries.
translation: 请留在竞技场的边界内。 [qing liu zai jing ji chang de bian jie nei 。]

english: On PvP Arena worlds, you can only use the PvP Arena. Switch to another world to play on your normal profile.
translation: 在 PvP 竞技场世界中，您只能使用 PvP 竞技场。切换到另一个世界以您的正常个人资料进行游戏。 [zai  PvP  jing ji chang shi jie zhong ， nin zhi neng shi yong  PvP  jing ji chang 。 qie huan dao ling yi ge shi jie yi nin de zheng chang ge ren zi liao jin xing you xi 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Tell me about the Calamity Coven.
translation: 告诉我关于灾难集会的事。 [gao su wo guan yu zai nan ji hui de shi 。]

english: Tell me again about the Calamity Coven.
translation: 再给我讲讲灾难女巫会的事吧。 [zai gei wo jiang jiang zai nan nv wu hui de shi ba 。]

english: Could you come help me with something?
translation: 你能过来帮我做点什么吗？ [ni neng guo lai bang wo zuo dian shen me ma ？]

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Respect the souls, traveller.
translation: 尊重灵魂，旅行者。 [zun zhong ling hun ， lv xing zhe 。]

english: Why are all these souls here?
translation: 为什么所有这些灵魂都在这里？ [wei shen me suo you zhe xie ling hun dou zai zhe li ？]

english: A corporeal body is a mere flesh-temple in which the soul dwells. As the body fails, the soul loses its home. Without guidance, it would drift into oblivion.
translation: 肉体只不过是灵魂居住的肉体殿堂。当身体衰弱时，灵魂就失去了家园。如果没有引导，它就会被遗忘。 [rou ti zhi bu guo shi ling hun ju zhu de rou ti dian tang 。 dang shen ti shuai ruo shi ， ling hun jiu shi qu le jia yuan 。 ru guo mei you yin dao ， ta jiu hui bei yi wang 。]

english: However, the Soul Altar provides a beacon, drawing the souls to this place where they may join the River.
translation: 然而，灵魂祭坛提供了一座灯塔，将灵魂吸引到这个可以汇入河流的地方。 [ran er ， ling hun ji tan ti gong le yi zuo deng ta ， jiang ling hun xi yin dao zhe ge ke yi hui ru he liu de di fang 。]

english: The River leads the souls through unchartable realms, transcending the plane of the world as you see it, but the three-headed Guardian keeps them safe.
translation: 河流引导灵魂穿越未知的领域，超越你所看到的世界平面，但三头守护者保证他们的安全。 [he liu yin dao ling hun chuan yue wei zhi de ling yu ， chao yue ni suo kan dao de shi jie ping mian ， dan san tou shou hu zhe bao zheng ta men de an quan 。]

english: The souls are the dead of Kourend - ensure you respect the souls.
translation: 灵魂是库伦德的死者——确保你尊重灵魂。 [ling hun shi ku lun de de si zhe —— que bao ni zun zhong ling hun 。]

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？ [ni wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: I am here to salute the dead of Kourend whose souls are joining the River. Ensure you respect the souls.
translation: 我来这里是为了向库伦德的死者致敬，他们的灵魂正在汇入河流。确保你尊重灵魂。 [wo lai zhe li shi wei le xiang ku lun de de si zhe zhi jing ， ta men de ling hun zheng zai hui ru he liu 。 que bao ni zun zhong ling hun 。]

english: I've been reading your book: 'The Journey of Souls'
translation: 我一直在读你的书：《灵魂之旅》 [wo yi zhi zai du ni de shu ：《 ling hun zhi lv 》]

english: Let me guess, traveller... did you come to ask me where the soul bearer was buried? Every mortal who reads my book seems to want to get their hands on it.
translation: 让我猜猜，旅行者……你是来问我灵魂承载者埋在哪里的吗？每个读过我的书的人似乎都想得到它。 [rang wo cai cai ， lv xing zhe …… ni shi lai wen wo ling hun cheng zai zhe mai zai na li de ma ？ mei ge du guo wo de shu de ren si hu dou xiang de dao ta 。]

english: Mortals are so predictable. This is the kind of thinking that led that adventurer to break into the Guardian's cave and damage the soul bearer in the first place.
translation: 凡人是如此可预测的。正是这种想法导致冒险者闯入守护者的洞穴并首先伤害灵魂承载者。 [fan ren shi ru ci ke yu ce de 。 zheng shi zhe zhong xiang fa dao zhi mao xian zhe chuang ru shou hu zhe de dong xue bing shou xian shang hai ling hun cheng zai zhe 。]

english: It occurs to me, though, that even if you dig it up, the artefact is damaged. Although the Elders of Arceuus never had the knowledge to repair it, there is one who may be able to help.
translation: 但我突然想到，即使你把它挖出来，文物也会被损坏。尽管阿尔宙斯的长老们从来没有修复它的知识，但有人可能能够提供帮助。 [dan wo tu ran xiang dao ， ji shi ni ba ta wa chu lai ， wen wu ye hui bei sun huai 。 jin guan a er zhou si de zhang lao men cong lai mei you xiu fu ta de zhi shi ， dan you ren ke neng neng gou ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: I speak of the Key Master, he who watches over the cave of the three-headed Guardian of the River. He has been there for countless years, and will have absorbed power from the River in that time.
translation: 我说的是钥匙大师，他看守着河流三头守护者的洞穴。他已经在那里存在了无数年，到时候就会吸收河流的力量。 [wo shuo de shi yao shi da shi ， ta kan shou zhe he liu san tou shou hu zhe de dong xue 。 ta yi jing zai na li cun zai liao wu shu nian ， dao shi hou jiu hui xi shou he liu de li liang 。]

english: Now, we buried the artefact in the crypt of the Arceuus church. As I have revealed this secret to you, you will no longer be affected by the spells that prevent unwary explorers from stumbling across it.
translation: 现在，我们把这件文物埋在了阿尔修斯教堂的地下室里。当我向你透露这个秘密时，你将不再受到那些阻止粗心的探险家绊倒它的咒语的影响。 [xian zai ， wo men ba zhe jian wen wu mai zai le a er xiu si jiao tang de di xia shi li 。 dang wo xiang ni tou lu zhe ge mi mi shi ， ni jiang bu zai shou dao na xie zu zhi cu xin de tan xian jia ban dao ta de zhou yu de ying xiang 。]

english: Thanks! I'll be off now.
translation: 谢谢！我现在就走了。 [xie xie ！ wo xian zai jiu zou le 。]

english: No, I don't want your smelly soul bearer.
translation: 不，我不要你的臭灵魂承载者。 [bu ， wo bu yao ni de chou ling hun cheng zai zhe 。]

english: Hmmph! So what do you want? I trust you will respect the souls while you are in this hallowed place.
translation: 哼！那么你想要什么？我相信当你身处这个神圣的地方时，你会尊重灵魂。 [heng ！ na me ni xiang yao shen me ？ wo xiang xin dang ni shen chu zhe ge shen sheng de di fang shi ， ni hui zun zhong ling hun 。]

english: About the soul bearer again... I got it repaired by the Key Master. Thanks for your help.
translation: 又是关于灵魂承载者的事……我已经被钥匙大师修好了。感谢您的帮助。 [you shi guan yu ling hun cheng zai zhe de shi …… wo yi jing bei yao shi da shi xiu hao le 。 gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]

english: Use it carefully, traveller, and respect the souls.
translation: 旅行者，请小心使用它，并尊重灵魂。 [lv xing zhe ， qing xiao xin shi yong ta ， bing zun zhong ling hun 。]

english: Okay, I'm respecting the souls.
translation: 好吧，我尊重灵魂。 [hao ba ， wo zun zhong ling hun 。]

english: Why are all these souls here?
translation: 为什么所有这些灵魂都在这里？ [wei shen me suo you zhe xie ling hun dou zai zhe li ？]

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？ [ni wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: I've been reading your book...
translation: 我一直在读你的书... [wo yi zhi zai du ni de shu ...]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No, I don't want your smelly soul bearer.
translation: 不，我不要你的臭灵魂承载者。 [bu ， wo bu yao ni de chou ling hun cheng zai zhe 。]

english: About the soul bearer again...
translation: 又说到灵魂承载者了…… [you shuo dao ling hun cheng zai zhe le ……]

english: Okay, I'm respecting the souls.
translation: 好吧，我尊重灵魂。 [hao ba ， wo zun zhong ling hun 。]

english: Hello! Would you like to trade?
translation: 你好！您想交易吗？ [ni hao ！ nin xiang jiao yi ma ？]

english: Sure.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Is that your ship?
translation: 那是你的船吗？ [na shi ni de chuan ma ？]

english: Yes, I use it to make deliveries to my customers up and down the coast. These crates here are all ready for my next trip.
translation: 是的，我用它来向沿海地区的客户送货。这里的这些板条箱已经为我下次旅行做好了准备。 [shi de ， wo yong ta lai xiang yan hai di qu de ke hu song huo 。 zhe li de zhe xie ban tiao xiang yi jing wei wo xia ci lv xing zuo hao le zhun bei 。]

english: Where do you deliver to?
translation: 你们送货到哪里？ [ni men song huo dao na li ？]

english: Oh, various places up and down the coast. Mostly Karamja and Port Sarim.
translation: 哦，海岸上下的各个地方。主要是卡拉姆贾和萨里姆港。 [o ， hai an shang xia de ge ge di fang 。 zhu yao shi ka la mu jia he sa li mu gang 。]

english: I don't suppose I could get a lift anywhere?
translation: 我想我哪里都不能搭便车吧？ [wo xiang wo na li dou bu neng da bian che ba ？]

english: Sorry pal, but I'm afraid I'm not quite ready to sail yet.
translation: 抱歉，朋友，但恐怕我还没准备好启航。 [bao qian ， peng you ， dan kong pa wo hai mei zhun bei hao qi hang 。]

english: I'm waiting on a big delivery of candles which I need to deliver further along the coast.
translation: 我正在等待大量蜡烛的交付，我需要将它们运送到更远的海岸。 [wo zheng zai deng dai da liang la zhu de jiao fu ， wo xu yao jiang ta men yun song dao geng yuan de hai an 。]

english: Well, good luck with your business.
translation: 嗯，祝您生意兴隆。 [n ， zhu nin sheng yi xing long 。]

english: Thanks buddy!
translation: 谢谢哥们！ [xie xie ge men ！]

english: Are you rich then?
translation: 那你有钱吗？ [na ni you qian ma ？]

english: Business is going reasonably well... I wouldn't say I was the richest of merchants ever, but I'm doing fairly well all things considered.
translation: 生意进展得相当顺利……我不会说我是有史以来最富有的商人，但从各方面考虑，我都做得相当不错。 [sheng yi jin zhan de xiang dang shun li …… wo bu hui shuo wo shi you shi yi lai zui fu you de shang ren ， dan cong ge fang mian kao lv ， wo dou zuo de xiang dang bu cuo 。]

english: Hey buddy! Get away from my ship alright?
translation: 嘿伙计！离开我的船好吗？ [hei huo ji ！ li kai wo de chuan hao ma ？]

english: Yeah... uh... sorry...
translation: 是啊……呃……抱歉…… [shi a …… e …… bao qian ……]

english: Well done, matey!
translation: 干得好，伙计！ [gan de hao ， huo ji ！]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Is that your ship?
translation: 那是你的船吗？ [na shi ni de chuan ma ？]

english: Where do you deliver to?
translation: 你们送货到哪里？ [ni men song huo dao na li ？]

english: I don't suppose I could get a lift anywhere?
translation: 我想我哪里都不能搭便车吧？ [wo xiang wo na li dou bu neng da bian che ba ？]

english: Well, good luck with your business.
translation: 嗯，祝您生意兴隆。 [n ， zhu nin sheng yi xing long 。]

english: Are you rich then?
translation: 那你有钱吗？ [na ni you qian ma ？]

translation: 你是怎么进来的？你必须离开。 [ni shi zen me jin lai de ？ ni bi xu li kai 。]

translation: 你好，Arianwyn，最近怎么样？ [ni hao ，Arianwyn， zui jin zen me yang ？]

english: I am well [player name], yourself?
translation: 我[玩家姓名]还好吗？ [wo [ wan jia xing ming ] hai hao ma ？]

english: Not bad thanks, any news on Lord Iorwerth?
translation: 还不错，谢谢，请问有 Iorwerth 勋爵的消息吗？ [hai bu cuo ， xie xie ， qing wen you  Iorwerth  xun jue de xiao xi ma ？]

english: Not yet, I will try to send word if we find out anything new.
translation: 还没有，如果我们发现任何新情况，我会尝试发送消息。 [hai mei you ， ru guo wo men fa xian ren he xin qing kuang ， wo hui chang shi fa song xiao xi 。]

english: Oh okay, well see you then.
translation: 哦，好的，那么到时候见。 [o ， hao de ， na me dao shi hou jian 。]

english: Until next time, [player name].
translation: 下次再见，[玩家姓名]。 [xia ci zai jian ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Hello young one.
translation: 你好年轻人。 [ni hao nian qing ren 。]

english: Cross my palm with silver and the future will be revealed to you.
translation: 用银子交叉我的手掌，未来就会向你显现。 [yong yin zi jiao cha wo de shou zhang ， wei lai jiu hui xiang ni xian xian 。]

english: Okay, here you go.
translation: 好的，给你。 [hao de ， gei ni 。]

english: Come closer, and listen carefully to what the future holds for you, as I peer into the swirling mists of the crystal ball.
translation: 当我凝视水晶球的漩涡迷雾时，走近一些，仔细聆听你的未来。 [dang wo ning shi shui jing qiu de xuan wo mi wu shi ， zou jin yi xie ， zi xi ling ting ni de wei lai 。]

english: I can see images forming. I can see you.
translation: 我可以看到图像形成。我能看到你。 [wo ke yi kan dao tu xiang xing cheng 。 wo neng kan dao ni 。]

english: You are holding a very impressive looking sword. I'm sure I recognise that sword...

english: There is a big dark shadow appearing now.
translation: 现在，一道巨大的黑影出现了。 [xian zai ， yi dao ju da de hei ying chu xian le 。]

english: Aaargh!
translation: 啊啊！ [a a ！]

english: Are you all right?
translation: 你还好吗？ [ni hai hao ma ？]

english: It's Delrith! Delrith is coming!
translation: 是德里斯！德里斯来了！ [shi de li si ！ de li si lai le ！]

english: Who's Delrith?
translation: 德里斯是谁？ [de li si shi shui ？]

english: Delrith...
translation: 德里斯... [de li si ...]

english: Delrith is a powerful demon.
translation: 德尔里斯是一个强大的恶魔。 [de er li si shi yi ge qiang da de e mo 。]

english: Oh! I really hope he didn't see me looking at him through my crystal ball!
translation: 哦！我真希望他没有看到我透过水晶球看着他！ [o ！ wo zhen xi wang ta mei you kan dao wo tou guo shui jing qiu kan zhe ta ！]

english: He tried to destroy this city 150 years ago. He was stopped just in time by the great hero Wally.
translation: 150年前他曾试图摧毁这座城市。他被大英雄沃利及时阻止。 [150 nian qian ta ceng shi tu cui hui zhe zuo cheng shi 。 ta bei da ying xiong wo li ji shi zu zhi 。]

english: Using his magic sword Silverlight, Wally managed to trap the demon in the stone circle just south of this city.
translation: 沃利用他的魔剑银光成功地将恶魔困在了这座城市南边的石圈中。 [wo li yong ta de mo jian yin guang cheng gong di jiang e mo kun zai le zhe zuo cheng shi nan bian de shi quan zhong 。]

english: Ye gods! Silverlight was the sword you were holding in my vision! You are the one destined to stop the demon this time.
translation: 你们诸神啊！ Silverlight就是你在我的视野中握着的剑！这次你注定要阻止恶魔。 [ni men zhu shen a ！ Silverlight jiu shi ni zai wo de shi ye zhong wo zhe de jian ！ zhe ci ni zhu ding yao zu zhi e mo 。]

english: How am I meant to fight a demon who can destroy cities?!
translation: 我该如何对抗一个能够摧毁城市的恶魔？！ [wo gai ru he dui kang yi ge neng gou cui hui cheng shi de e mo ？！]

english: If you face Delrith while he is still weak from being summoned, and use the correct weapon, you will not find the task too arduous.
translation: 如果你在德里斯因被召唤而还很虚弱的时候面对他，并使用正确的武器，你不会觉得任务太艰巨。 [ru guo ni zai de li si yin bei zhao huan er hai hen xu ruo de shi hou mian dui ta ， bing shi yong zheng que de wu qi ， ni bu hui jue de ren wu tai jian ju 。]

english: Do not fear. If you follow the path of the great hero Wally, then you are sure to defeat the demon.
translation: 不要害怕。如果你追随伟大英雄沃利的道路，那么你一定会打败恶魔。 [bu yao hai pa 。 ru guo ni zhui sui wei da ying xiong wo li de dao lu ， na me ni yi ding hui da bai e mo 。]

english: Okay, where is he? I'll kill him for you!
translation: 好吧，他在哪儿？我会替你杀了他！ [hao ba ， ta zai na er ？ wo hui ti ni sha le ta ！]

english: Ah, the overconfidence of the young!
translation: 啊，年轻人的过度自信！ [a ， nian qing ren de guo du zi xin ！]

english: Delrith can't be harmed by ordinary weapons. You must face him using the same weapon that Wally used.
translation: 普通武器无法伤害德里斯。你必须使用沃利使用的相同武器面对他。 [pu tong wu qi wu fa shang hai de li si 。 ni bi xu shi yong wo li shi yong de xiang tong wu qi mian dui ta 。]

english: Wally doesn't sound a very heroic name.
translation: 沃利听起来并不是一个非常英雄的名字。 [wo li ting qi lai bing bu shi yi ge fei chang ying xiong de ming zi 。]

english: Yes I know. Maybe that is why history doesn't remember him. However he was a very great hero.
translation: 是的，我知道。也许这就是历史不记得他的原因。然而他却是一位非常伟大的英雄。 [shi de ， wo zhi dao 。 ye xu zhe jiu shi li shi bu ji de ta de yuan yin 。 ran er ta que shi yi wei fei chang wei da de ying xiong 。]

english: Who knows how much pain and suffering Delrith would have brought forth without Wally to stop him!

english: It looks like you are going to need to perform similar heroics.
translation: 看来你需要表现出类似的英雄气概。 [kan lai ni xu yao biao xian chu lei si de ying xiong qi gai 。]

english: So how did Wally kill Delrith?
translation: 那么沃利是如何杀死德里斯的呢？ [na me wo li shi ru he sha si de li si de ne ？]

english: Wally managed to arrive at the stone circle just as Delrith was summoned by a cult of chaos druids...
translation: 沃利设法到达石阵，正当德尔里斯被混沌德鲁伊邪教召唤时…… [wo li she fa dao da shi zhen ， zheng dang de er li si bei hun dun de lu yi xie jiao zhao huan shi ……]

translation: 沃利击败德里斯的过场动画 [wo li ji bai de li si de guo chang dong hua]

english: Die, foul demon!
translation: 去死吧，邪恶的恶魔！ [qu si ba ， xie e de e mo ！]

english: Now, what was that incantation again?
translation: 现在，那个咒语又是什么？ [xian zai ， na ge zhou yu you shi shen me ？]

english: in Word#1... Word#2... Word#3... Word#4... Word#5!
translation: 在Word#1...Word#2...Word#3...Word#4...Word#5！ [zai Word#1...Word#2...Word#3...Word#4...Word#5！]

english: I am the greatest demon slayer EVER!
translation: 我是有史以来最伟大的恶魔杀手！ [wo shi you shi yi lai zui wei da de e mo sha shou ！]

english: Cutscene over
translation: 过场动画结束 [guo chang dong hua jie shu]

english: By reciting the correct magical incantation, and thrusting Silverlight into Delrith while he was newly summoned, Wally was able to imprison Delrith in the stone block in the centre of the circle.
translation: 通过背诵正确的魔法咒语，并在德里斯刚刚被召唤时将银光刺入德里斯体内，沃利将德里斯囚禁在圆圈中心的石块中。 [tong guo bei song zheng que de mo fa zhou yu ， bing zai de li si gang gang bei zhao huan shi jiang yin guang ci ru de li si ti nei ， wo li jiang de li si qiu jin zai yuan quan zhong xin de shi kuai zhong 。]

english: Delrith will come forth from the stone circle again.
translation: 德里斯将再次从石阵中走出来。 [de li si jiang zai ci cong shi zhen zhong zou chu lai 。]

english: I would imagine an evil sorcerer is already starting on the rituals to summon Delrith as we speak.
translation: 我想象在我们说话的时候，一个邪恶的巫师已经开始举行召唤德里斯的仪式了。 [wo xiang xiang zai wo men shuo hua de shi hou ， yi ge xie e de wu shi yi jing kai shi ju xing zhao huan de li si de yi shi le 。]

english: What is the magical incantation?
translation: 到底有什么神奇的咒语呢？ [dao di you shen me shen qi de zhou yu ne ？]

english: Oh yes, let me think a second...
translation: 哦，是的，让我想一下...... [o ， shi de ， rang wo xiang yi xia ......]

english: Alright, I think I've got it now, it goes.... Word#1... Word#2... Word#3... Word#4... Word#5. Have you got that?
translation: 好吧，我想我现在已经明白了，它是...Word#1...Word#2...Word#3...Word#4...Word#5。你明白了吗？ [hao ba ， wo xiang wo xian zai yi jing ming bai le ， ta shi ...Word#1...Word#2...Word#3...Word#4...Word#5。 ni ming bai le ma ？]

english: I think so, yes.
translation: 我想是的，是的。 [wo xiang shi de ， shi de 。]

english: Where can I find Silverlight?
translation: 在哪里可以找到 Silverlight？ [zai na li ke yi zhao dao  Silverlight？]

english: Silverlight has been passed down through Wally's descendants. I believe it is currently in the care of one of the King's knights called Sir Prysin.
translation: Silverlight 已通过 Wally 的后代传承下来。我相信它目前由一位名叫普赖辛爵士的国王骑士保管。 [Silverlight  yi tong guo  Wally  de hou dai chuan cheng xia lai 。 wo xiang xin ta mu qian you yi wei ming jiao pu lai xin jue shi de guo wang qi shi bao guan 。]

english: He shouldn't be too hard to find. He lives in the royal palace in this city. Tell him Aris sent you.
translation: 他应该不难找到。他住在这座城市的皇宫里。告诉他是阿里斯派你来的。 [ta ying gai bu nan zhao dao 。 ta zhu zai zhe zuo cheng shi de huang gong li 。 gao su ta shi a li si pai ni lai de 。]

english: Ok thanks. I'll do my best to stop the demon.
translation: 好的，谢谢。我会尽全力阻止恶魔。 [hao de ， xie xie 。 wo hui jin quan li zu zhi e mo 。]

english: Good luck, and may Guthix be with you!
translation: 祝你好运，愿 Guthix 与你同在！ [zhu ni hao yun ， yuan  Guthix  yu ni tong zai ！]

english: No, I don't believe in that stuff
translation: 不，我不相信那些东西 [bu ， wo bu xiang xin na xie dong xi]

english: Ok suit yourself.
translation: 好吧，适合你自己。 [hao ba ， shi he ni zi ji 。]

english: Greetings. How goes thy quest?
translation: 问候。你的任务进展如何？ [wen hou 。 ni de ren wu jin zhan ru he ？]

english: I'm still working on it.
translation: 我还在努力。 [wo hai zai nu li 。]

english: Well if you need any advice I'm always here, young one.
translation: 好吧，如果你需要任何建议，我总是在这里，年轻人。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni xu yao ren he jian yi ， wo zong shi zai zhe li ， nian qing ren 。]

english: Where can I find the Silverlight?
translation: 在哪里可以找到 Silverlight？ [zai na li ke yi zhao dao  Silverlight？]

english: Stop calling me that!
translation: 别再这么叫我了！ [bie zai zhe me jiao wo le ！]

english: In the scheme of things you are very young.
translation: 就事情的计划而言，你还很年轻。 [jiu shi qing de ji hua er yan ， ni hai hen nian qing 。]

english: Ok, but how old are you?
translation: 好的，但是你多大了？ [hao de ， dan shi ni duo da le ？]

english: Count the number of legs on the stools in the Blue Moon inn, and multiply that number by seven.
translation: 数一下蓝月旅馆的凳子上有多少条腿，然后乘以七。 [shu yi xia lan yue lv guan de deng zi shang you duo shao tiao tui ， ran hou cheng yi qi 。]

english: Er, yeah, whatever.
translation: 呃，是的，无论如何。 [e ， shi de ， wu lun ru he 。]

english: Oh if it's in the scheme of things that's ok.
translation: 哦，如果这是在事情的计划中那没问题。 [o ， ru guo zhe shi zai shi qing de ji hua zhong na mei wen ti 。]

english: You show wisdom for one so young.
translation: 对于一个如此年轻的人来说，你表现出了智慧。 [dui yu yi ge ru ci nian qing de ren lai shuo ， ni biao xian chu le zhi hui 。]

english: Well I'd better press on with it.
translation: 好吧，我最好继续做下去。 [hao ba ， wo zui hao ji xu zuo xia qu 。]

english: See you anon.
translation: 一会儿见。 [yi hui er jian 。]

english: How goes the quest?
translation: 任务进展如何？ [ren wu jin zhan ru he ？]

english: I found Sir Prysin. Unfortunately I haven't got the sword yet. He's made it complicated for me.
translation: 我找到了普赖辛爵士。可惜我还没拿到剑。他让我的事情变得复杂了。 [wo zhao dao le pu lai xin jue shi 。 ke xi wo hai mei na dao jian 。 ta rang wo de shi qing bian de fu za le 。]

english: Ok, hurry, we haven't much time.
translation: 好吧，快点，我们时间不多了。 [hao ba ， kuai dian ， wo men shi jian bu duo le 。]

english: I have the sword now. I just need to kill the demon, I think.
translation: 我现在有剑了。我想我只需要杀死恶魔。 [wo xian zai you jian le 。 wo xiang wo zhi xu yao sha si e mo 。]

english: Yep, that's right.
translation: 是的，没错。 [shi de ， mei cuo 。]

english: Where can I find the demon?
translation: 哪里可以找到恶魔？ [na li ke yi zhao dao e mo ？]

english: Just head south and you should find the stone circle just outside the city gate.
translation: 一直往南走，你就会在城门外找到石圈。 [yi zhi wang nan zou ， ni jiu hui zai cheng men wai zhao dao shi quan 。]

english: Greetings young one.
translation: 问候年轻人。 [wen hou nian qing ren 。]

english: You're a hero now. That was a good bit of demonslaying.
translation: 你现在是英雄了。这真是一个很好的恶魔屠戮。 [ni xian zai shi ying xiong le 。 zhe zhen shi yi ge hen hao de e mo tu lu 。]

english: How do you know I killed it?
translation: 你怎么知道是我杀的？ [ni zen me zhi dao shi wo sha de ？]

english: You forget. I'm good at knowing things.
translation: 你忘了。我善于了解事物。 [ni wang le 。 wo shan yu liao jie shi wu 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Oh yes? What was that?
translation: 哦是的？那是什么？ [o shi de ？ na shi shen me ？]

english: Everything!
translation: 一切！ [yi qie ！]

english: I wouldn't worry about it too much if I were you. The world is safe once more thanks to your assistance.
translation: 如果我是你，我就不会太担心。感谢您的帮助，世界再次安全。 [ru guo wo shi ni ， wo jiu bu hui tai dan xin 。 gan xie nin de bang zhu ， shi jie zai ci an quan 。]

english: That's all that really matters.
translation: 这才是真正重要的。 [zhe cai shi zhen zheng zhong yao de 。]

english: Yeah, I guess... I just wish things made sense is all...
translation: 是的，我想...我只是希望一切都有意义...... [shi de ， wo xiang ... wo zhi shi xi wang yi qie dou you yi yi ......]

translation: 你好？ [ni hao ？]

translation: 因为我能预知未来。 [yin wei wo neng yu zhi wei lai 。]

That is the answer to your next question.

translation: 但你怎么知道我会问什么？ [dan ni zen me zhi dao wo hui wen shen me ？]

english: Ah, that's very clever.
translation: 啊，这很聪明。 [a ， zhe hen cong ming 。]

translation: 谢谢。哦，在荒野里要小心。今晚不是你的夜晚。 [xie xie 。 o ， zai huang ye li yao xiao xin 。 jin wan bu shi ni de ye wan 。]

translation: 哦，如果这是在事情的计划中那没问题。 [o ， ru guo zhe shi zai shi qing de ji hua zhong na mei wen ti 。]

english: Well I'd better press on with it.
translation: 好吧，我最好继续做下去。 [hao ba ， wo zui hao ji xu zuo xia qu 。]

translation: 好吧，我最好继续做下去 [hao ba ， wo zui hao ji xu zuo xia qu]

english: Where can I find the demon?
translation: 哪里可以找到恶魔？ [na li ke yi zhao dao e mo ？]

english: How do you know I killed it?
translation: 你怎么知道是我杀的？ [ni zen me zhi dao shi wo sha de ？]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: I'm sorry, but I'm currently doing some research. Could you talk to me later, please?
translation: 抱歉，我目前正在做一些研究。请稍后再跟我说话好吗？ [bao qian ， wo mu qian zheng zai zuo yi xie yan jiu 。 qing shao hou zai gen wo shuo hua hao ma ？]

english: Okay then.
translation: 那么好吧。 [na me hao ba 。]

english: Good day, [madam/sir]. Are you interested in the history of this area?
translation: 美好的一天，[女士/先生]。您对这个地区的历史感兴趣吗？ [mei hao de yi tian ，[ nv shi / xian sheng ]。 nin dui zhe ge di qu de li shi gan xing qu ma ？]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: I am a librarian from the great library of Menaphos. I left to travel the desert and learn more of its history.
translation: 我是梅纳福斯大图书馆的图书管理员。我离开去沙漠旅行并了解更多它的历史。 [wo shi mei na fu si da tu shu guan de tu shu guan li yuan 。 wo li kai qu sha mo lv xing bing liao jie geng duo ta de li shi 。]

english: I'd better be off.
translation: 我最好还是离开吧 [wo zui hao hai shi li kai ba]

english: Tell me about Enakhra.
translation: 告诉我关于埃纳克拉的事。 [gao su wo guan yu ai na ke la de shi 。]

english: Enakhra? I have read only a little about her. She was one of the Mahjarrat who arrived in Gielinor many thousands of years ago.
translation: 埃纳克拉？我只读过一点关于她的事。她是数千年前抵达吉林诺的马吉拉特人之一。 [ai na ke la ？ wo zhi du guo yi dian guan yu ta de shi 。 ta shi shu qian nian qian di da ji lin nuo de ma ji la te ren zhi yi 。]

english: She supported Zamorak when he tried to gain power, and she apparently built a great temple in his honour somewhere in the desert.
translation: 当萨莫拉克试图获得权力时，她支持他，并且她显然在沙漠的某个地方为他建造了一座伟大的寺庙。 [dang sa mo la ke shi tu huo de quan li shi ， ta zhi chi ta ， bing qie ta xian ran zai sha mo de mou ge di fang wei ta jian zao le yi zuo wei da de si miao 。]

english: However, it is said that when she showed it to him, he was not impressed, and told her that he would rather have a weapon that could slay gods.
translation: 然而，据说当她把它拿给他看时，他并没有留下深刻的印象，并告诉她，他宁愿拥有一件可以弑神的武器。 [ran er ， ju shuo dang ta ba ta na gei ta kan shi ， ta bing mei you liu xia shen ke de yin xiang ， bing gao su ta ， ta ning yuan yong you yi jian ke yi shi shen de wu qi 。]

english: That is the last anyone knows of what happened to her, and it took place several thousand years ago.
translation: 这是最后一个人知道她身上发生了什么，它发生在几千年前。 [zhe shi zui hou yi ge ren zhi dao ta shen shang fa sheng le shen me ， ta fa sheng zai ji qian nian qian 。]

english: Interesting. Thanks for the information.
translation: 有趣的。感谢您提供信息。 [you qu de 。 gan xie nin ti gong xin xi 。]

english: Tell me about Akthanakos.
translation: 告诉我关于阿克塔纳科斯的事。 [gao su wo guan yu a ke ta na ke si de shi 。]

english: An interesting choice of topic. Akthanakos is a Mahjarrat who was apparently worshipped as a god for a while in these parts. That was a long time ago, of course.
translation: 一个有趣的主题选择。阿克塔纳科斯（Akthanakos）是一位马哈拉特（Mahjarrat），显然在这些地区曾一度被当作神崇拜。当然，那是很久以前的事了。 [yi ge you qu de zhu ti xuan ze 。 a ke ta na ke si （Akthanakos） shi yi wei ma ha la te （Mahjarrat）， xian ran zai zhe xie di qu ceng yi du bei dang zuo shen chong bai 。 dang ran ， na shi hen jiu yi qian de shi le 。]

english: Unlike many of his kin, he was against Zamorak's rise to power. Perhaps that's why he ended up out here. Zamorak has little sway in the desert.
translation: 与他的许多亲属不同，他反对萨莫拉克掌权。也许这就是他最终来到这里的原因。萨莫拉克在沙漠中几乎没有影响力。 [yu ta de xu duo qin shu bu tong ， ta fan dui sa mo la ke zhang quan 。 ye xu zhe jiu shi ta zui zhong lai dao zhe li de yuan yin 。 sa mo la ke zai sha mo zhong ji hu mei you ying xiang li 。]

english: Whatever his reasons, he clearly took a liking to living here. He took on the head of a camel and even made an amulet that would allow him to understand their kind.
translation: 不管出于什么原因，他显然很喜欢住在这里。他取了骆驼的头，甚至制作了一个护身符，让他能够了解骆驼的种类。 [bu guan chu yu shen me yuan yin ， ta xian ran hen xi huan zhu zai zhe li 。 ta qu le luo tuo de tou ， shen zhi zhi zuo le yi ge hu shen fu ， rang ta neng gou liao jie luo tuo de zhong lei 。]

english: Using it, he even trained some of the native camels to fight for him. Their name, 'Ugthanki', is derived from his.
translation: 他甚至利用它训练了一些当地的骆驼为他战斗。他们的名字“Ugthanki”源自他的名字。 [ta shen zhi li yong ta xun lian le yi xie dang di de luo tuo wei ta zhan dou 。 ta men de ming zi “Ugthanki” yuan zi ta de ming zi 。]

english: Since he disappeared, however, it is said that the Ugthanki became more violent and started attacking travellers.
translation: 然而，自从他失踪后，据说乌格坦基人变得更加暴力并开始攻击旅行者。 [ran er ， zi cong ta shi zong hou ， ju shuo wu ge tan ji ren bian de geng jia bao li bing kai shi gong ji lv xing zhe 。]

english: I'm good.
translation: 我很好。 [wo hen hao 。]

english: Good day, [sir/madam]. Are you interested in the history of this area?
translation: 美好的一天，[先生/女士]。您对这个地区的历史感兴趣吗？ [mei hao de yi tian ，[ xian sheng / nv shi ]。 nin dui zhe ge di qu de li shi gan xing qu ma ？]

english: Yes, I want to know more about the desert!
translation: 是的，我想更多地了解沙漠！ [shi de ， wo xiang geng duo di liao jie sha mo ！]

english: It's good to meet someone so eager to learn.
translation: 很高兴遇到一个如此渴望学习的人。 [hen gao xing yu dao yi ge ru ci ke wang xue xi de ren 。]

english: Now, what would you like to hear about?
translation: 现在，您想听什么？ [xian zai ， nin xiang ting shen me ？]

english: Tell me about Enakhra the Mahjarrat.
translation: 告诉我有关马哈拉特·埃纳克拉 (Enakhra the Mahjarrat) 的事。 [gao su wo you guan ma ha la te · ai na ke la  (Enakhra the Mahjarrat)  de shi 。]

english: I have read only a little about her. She was one of the Mahjarrat who arrived in Gielinor many thousands of years ago.
translation: 我只读过一点关于她的事。她是数千年前抵达吉林诺的马吉拉特人之一。 [wo zhi du guo yi dian guan yu ta de shi 。 ta shi shu qian nian qian di da ji lin nuo de ma ji la te ren zhi yi 。]

english: She supported Zamorak when he tried to gain power, but her attempts to gain his favour failed, and she retreated to a temple she had built.
translation: 当萨莫拉克试图获得权力时，她支持他，但她试图获得他的青睐失败了，她撤退到了她建造的一座寺庙中。 [dang sa mo la ke shi tu huo de quan li shi ， ta zhi chi ta ， dan ta shi tu huo de ta de qing lai shi bai le ， ta che tui dao le ta jian zao de yi zuo si miao zhong 。]

english: Tell me about Akthanakos the Mahjarrat.
translation: 告诉我关于马哈拉特王阿克塔纳科斯的事。 [gao su wo guan yu ma ha la te wang a ke ta na ke si de shi 。]

english: Like Enakhra, his rival, Akthanakos came to Gielinor with the other Mahjarrat. He took on the aspect of one of the local gods, and is usually drawn with a camel's head.
translation: 和他的对手埃纳赫拉一样，阿克塔纳科斯也和另一个马哈拉特一起来到了吉林诺。他呈现出当地神的形象，通常被画成骆驼头。 [he ta de dui shou ai na he la yi yang ， a ke ta na ke si ye he ling yi ge ma ha la te yi qi lai dao le ji lin nuo 。 ta cheng xian chu dang di shen de xing xiang ， tong chang bei hua cheng luo tuo tou 。]

english: He was against Zamorak's rise to power, but the last anyone knows of him was that he and Enakhra were thinking of forgetting their rivalry.
translation: 他反对萨莫拉克掌权，但最后一个人知道他是他和埃纳赫拉正在考虑忘记他们的竞争。 [ta fan dui sa mo la ke zhang quan ， dan zui hou yi ge ren zhi dao ta shi ta he ai na he la zheng zai kao lv wang ji ta men de jing zheng 。]

english: Tell me about Enakhra's temple.
translation: 告诉我有关埃纳克拉神庙的事。 [gao su wo you guan ai na ke la shen miao de shi 。]

english: Well, my sources say that Enakhra tried to gain favour with Zamorak by building him a temple somewhere in the desert.
translation: 嗯，我的消息来源说，埃纳赫拉试图通过在沙漠某处为萨莫拉克建造一座寺庙来赢得他的青睐。 [n ， wo de xiao xi lai yuan shuo ， ai na he la shi tu tong guo zai sha mo mou chu wei sa mo la ke jian zao yi zuo si miao lai ying de ta de qing lai 。]

english: It is said that when she showed it to him, he was not impressed, and told her that he would rather have a weapon that could slay gods than a temple.
translation: 据说，当她把它拿给他看时，他并没有留下深刻的印象，并告诉她，他宁愿拥有一把可以弑神的武器，也不愿拥有一座寺庙。 [ju shuo ， dang ta ba ta na gei ta kan shi ， ta bing mei you liu xia shen ke de yin xiang ， bing gao su ta ， ta ning yuan yong you yi ba ke yi shi shen de wu qi ， ye bu yuan yong you yi zuo si miao 。]

english: After that, it seems that Enakhra retreated to that temple. If she hasn't died, she's been there ever since.
translation: 在那之后，伊纳克拉似乎隐退到了那座寺庙。如果她没有死的话，她从那时起就一直在那里。 [zai na zhi hou ， yi na ke la si hu yin tui dao le na zuo si miao 。 ru guo ta mei you si de hua ， ta cong na shi qi jiu yi zhi zai na li 。]

english: Tell me about the Camulet.
translation: 告诉我有关卡缪莱特的事。 [gao su wo you guan ka mou lai te de shi 。]

english: I'm afraid I've only heard rumours of it, but here's what I know.
translation: 恐怕我只是听说过这件事，但这是我所知道的。 [kong pa wo zhi shi ting shuo guo zhe jian shi ， dan zhe shi wo suo zhi dao de 。]

english: When Akthanakos came to Gielinor and took on the aspect of a man with a camel's head, he made an amulet that would allow him to understand camels.
translation: 当阿克塔纳科斯来到吉利诺并呈现出一个长着骆驼头的人的样子时，他制作了一个护身符，让他能够了解骆驼。 [dang a ke ta na ke si lai dao ji li nuo bing cheng xian chu yi ge zhang zhe luo tuo tou de ren de yang zi shi ， ta zhi zuo le yi ge hu shen fu ， rang ta neng gou liao jie luo tuo 。]

english: Why should I care about what happened thousands of years ago?
translation: 我何必去关心几千年前发生的事情呢？ [wo he bi qu guan xin ji qian nian qian fa sheng de shi qing ne ？]

english: Because those who cannot remember the past are condemned to repeat it.
translation: 因为那些不记得过去的人注定要重蹈覆辙。 [yin wei na xie bu ji de guo qu de ren zhu ding yao chong dao fu zhe 。]

english: Knowing something about history can prevent you from making mistakes that people have made before, you see.
translation: 了解一些历史可以防止你犯人们以前犯过的错误，你看。 [liao jie yi xie li shi ke yi fang zhi ni fan ren men yi qian fan guo de cuo wu ， ni kan 。]

translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Unfortunately, the plague in Sophanem prevents me from returning to the library.
translation: 不幸的是，索法奈姆的瘟疫使我无法返回图书馆。 [bu xing de shi ， suo fa nai mu de wen yi shi wo wu fa fan hui tu shu guan 。]

translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: Why should I care about what happened thousands of years ago?
translation: 我何必去关心几千年前发生的事情呢？ [wo he bi qu guan xin ji qian nian qian fa sheng de shi qing ne ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: No warning! Be gone!
translation: 没有警告！走吧！ [mei you jing gao ！ zou ba ！]

english: Good day to you.
translation: 祝你有美好的一天。 [zhu ni you mei hao de yi tian 。]

english: And to you. Can I help you?
translation: 还有你。我可以帮你吗？ [hai you ni 。 wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I am a supplier of leather armours and accessories. Ask and I will tell you what I know.
translation: 我是皮革盔甲和配件的供应商。询问，我会告诉你我所知道的。 [wo shi pi ge kui jia he pei jian de gong ying shang 。 xun wen ， wo hui gao su ni wo suo zhi dao de 。]

english: Tell me about your armours.
translation: 告诉我你的盔甲。 [gao su wo ni de kui jia 。]

english: I have normal, studded and hard types.
translation: 我有普通型、镶钉型和硬型。 [wo you pu tong xing 、 xiang ding xing he ying xing 。]

english: Tell me about normal leather.
translation: 告诉我关于普通皮革的情况。 [gao su wo guan yu pu tong pi ge de qing kuang 。]

english: Indeed, leather armour is excellent for archers. It's supple and not very heavy.
translation: 事实上，皮甲非常适合弓箭手。它很柔软而且不是很重。 [shi shi shang ， pi jia fei chang shi he gong jian shou 。 ta hen rou ruan er qie bu shi hen zhong 。]

english: What's studded leather?
translation: 什么是镶钉皮革？ [shen me shi xiang ding pi ge ？]

english: Ah, now that's leather covered with studs. It's more protective than ordinary leather.
translation: 啊，现在是皮革上覆盖着饰钉。它比普通皮革更具保护性。 [a ， xian zai shi pi ge shang fu gai zhe shi ding 。 ta bi pu tong pi ge geng ju bao hu xing 。]

english: What's hard leather?
translation: 什么是硬皮？ [shen me shi ying pi ？]

english: Hard leather is specially treated using oils and drying methods to create a hard-wearing armour.
translation: 硬质皮革经过油和干燥方法的特殊处理，打造出耐磨的盔甲。 [ying zhi pi ge jing guo you he gan zao fang fa de te shu chu li ， da zao chu nai mo de kui jia 。]

english: Enough about armour.
translation: 关于盔甲就够了。 [guan yu kui jia jiu gou le 。]

english: As you wish, traveller.
translation: 如你所愿，旅行者。 [ru ni suo yuan ， lv xing zhe 。]

english: Tell me about your accessories.
translation: 告诉我你的配件。 [gao su wo ni de pei jian 。]

english: Ah yes we have a new range of accessories in stock. Essential items for an archer like you.
translation: 啊，是的，我们有一系列新的配件库存。像您这样的弓箭手的必备物品。 [a ， shi de ， wo men you yi xi lie xin de pei jian ku cun 。 xiang nin zhe yang de gong jian shou de bi bei wu pin 。]

english: We have vambraces, chaps, cowls and coifs.
translation: 我们有臂甲、护腿、兜帽和头巾。 [wo men you bi jia 、 hu tui 、 dou mao he tou jin 。]

english: Tell me about vambraces.
translation: 告诉我关于臂甲的事情。 [gao su wo guan yu bi jia de shi qing 。]

english: Ah yes, vambraces. These useful items are for your arms.
translation: 啊，是的，臂甲。这些有用的物品适合您的手臂。 [a ， shi de ， bi jia 。 zhe xie you yong de wu pin shi he nin de shou bi 。]

english: A protective sheath that favours the bow and arrow. An essential purchase.
translation: 有利于弓箭的保护套。必不可少的购买。 [you li yu gong jian de bao hu tao 。 bi bu ke shao de gou mai 。]

english: Tell me about chaps.
translation: 告诉我有关小伙子的事情。 [gao su wo you guan xiao huo zi de shi qing 。]

english: Chaps have two functions: firstly to protect your legs, and secondly for ease of reloading arrows.
translation: 护腿有两个作用：一是保护双腿，二是方便装箭。 [hu tui you liang ge zuo yong ： yi shi bao hu shuang tui ， er shi fang bian zhuang jian 。]

english: I can highly recommend these to you for quick archery.
translation: 我强烈推荐这些给你快速射箭。 [wo qiang lie tui jian zhe xie gei ni kuai su she jian 。]

english: Tell me about cowls.
translation: 告诉我关于整流罩的事。 [gao su wo guan yu zheng liu zhao de shi 。]

english: The cowl is a soft leather hat, ideal for protection with maneuverability.
translation: 头罩是柔软的皮帽，非常适合提供保护且具有可操作性。 [tou zhao shi rou ruan de pi mao ， fei chang shi he ti gong bao hu qie ju you ke cao zuo xing 。]

english: These are highly favoured with our guards.
translation: 这些很受我们守卫的青睐。 [zhe xie hen shou wo men shou wei de qing lai 。]

english: Tell me about coifs.
translation: 告诉我关于头巾的事。 [gao su wo guan yu tou jin de shi 。]

english: The coif is a specialized cowl, that has extra chain protection to keep your neck and shoulders safe.
translation: 头巾是一种特殊的头罩，具有额外的链条保护，可确保您的颈部和肩部安全。 [tou jin shi yi zhong te shu de tou zhao ， ju you e wai de lian tiao bao hu ， ke que bao nin de jing bu he jian bu an quan 。]

english: An excellent addition to our range, traveller.
translation: 旅行者，我们的产品系列的绝佳补充。 [lv xing zhe ， wo men de chan pin xi lie de jue jia bu chong 。]

english: Enough about accessories.
translation: 关于配件就够了。 [guan yu pei jian jiu gou le 。]

english: As you wish.
translation: 如你所愿。 [ru ni suo yuan 。]

english: I've seen enough, thanks.
translation: 我已经看够了，谢谢。 [wo yi jing kan gou le ， xie xie 。]

english: Very good, adventurer.
translation: 很好，冒险家。 [hen hao ， mao xian jia 。]

english: I'd like to see what you sell.
translation: 我想看看你卖什么。 [wo xiang kan kan ni mai shen me 。]

english: Indeed, cast your eyes on my wares, adventurer.
translation: 确实，请把目光投向我的商品吧，冒险家。 [que shi ， qing ba mu guang tou xiang wo de shang pin ba ， mao xian jia 。]

english: Can you tell me about your cape?
translation: 你能告诉我你的斗篷吗？ [ni neng gao su wo ni de dou peng ma ？]

english: Oui...so eet eez. So perfect it almost makes me weep wiz joy! The grandiloquent strokes of ze brush convey a kind of mystic quality...eet iz almost as if 'e were 'ere with us.
translation: Oui...所以eeet eez。如此完美，几乎让我高兴得流泪！华丽的笔触传达出一种神秘的品质……几乎就好像“他就在我们身边”。 [Oui... suo yi eeet eez。 ru ci wan mei ， ji hu rang wo gao xing de liu lei ！ hua li de bi chu chuan da chu yi zhong shen mi de pin zhi …… ji hu jiu hao xiang “ ta jiu zai wo men shen bian ”。]
