translation: 啊，很好。这首诗取自最有才华的诗歌作家查尔斯·波德莱尔的一首诗。我父亲会把我放在膝盖上，像“zis”一样读给我听…… [a ， hen hao 。 zhe shou shi qu zi zui you cai hua de shi ge zuo jia cha er si · bo de lai er de yi shou shi 。 wo fu qin hui ba wo fang zai xi gai shang ， xiang “zis” yi yang du gei wo ting ……]

english: Je trône dans l'azur comme un sphinx incompris; J'unis un coeur de neige à la blancheur des cygnes; Je hais le mouvement qui déplace les lignes, Et jamais je ne pleure et jamais je ne ris.
translation: Je trône dans l'azur comme un sphinx incompris； J'unis un coeur de neige à la blancheur des cygnes；我的运动取代了利涅斯，我的运动也不再如此，我的运动也不再如此。 [Je trône dans l'azur comme un sphinx incompris； J'unis un coeur de neige à la blancheur des cygnes； wo de yun dong qu dai le li nie si ， wo de yun dong ye bu zai ru ci ， wo de yun dong ye bu zai ru ci 。]

english: That was nice, what did it mean?
translation: 那太好了，这是什么意思？ [na tai hao le ， zhe shi shen me yi si ？]

english: Ahh yes, I forget, open ze ears and I shall tell [madame/monsieur].
translation: 啊，是的，我忘了，请张开耳朵，我会告诉[女士/先生]。 [a ， shi de ， wo wang le ， qing zhang kai er duo ， wo hui gao su [ nv shi / xian sheng ]。]

english: Swan-white of heart, a sphinx no mortal knows, My throne is in the heaven's azure deep, I hate all movements that disturb my pose, I smile not ever, neither do I weep.
translation: 天鹅般洁白的心，凡人不知道的狮身人面像，我的王座在天堂蔚蓝的深处，我讨厌一切扰乱我姿势的动作，我从不微笑，也不哭泣。 [tian e ban jie bai de xin ， fan ren bu zhi dao de shi shen ren mian xiang ， wo de wang zuo zai tian tang wei lan de shen chu ， wo tao yan yi qie rao luan wo zi shi de dong zuo ， wo cong bu wei xiao ， ye bu ku qi 。]

english: Wow.
translation: 哇。 [wa 。]

english: That's powerful stuff...and yes, I see what you mean about the painting inspiring you to remember that poem...
translation: 那是很强大的东西……是的，我明白你的意思，这幅画激励你记住那首诗…… [na shi hen qiang da de dong xi …… shi de ， wo ming bai ni de yi si ， zhe fu hua ji li ni ji zhu na shou shi ……]

english: I am glad you enjoyed. Please, take ze time to appreciate ze Museum and ze wealth of information 'ere. Come visit me when I 'ave my own gallery!
translation: 我很高兴你喜欢。请花点时间欣赏这里的博物馆和丰富的信息。当我拥有自己的画廊时来拜访我吧！ [wo hen gao xing ni xi huan 。 qing hua dian shi jian xin shang zhe li de bo wu guan he feng fu de xin xi 。 dang wo yong you zi ji de hua lang shi lai bai fang wo ba ！]

english: I still didn't like it.
translation: 我还是不喜欢它。 [wo hai shi bu xi huan ta 。]

english: Eet iz such a shame, but you must 'ave your own opinion, no? Feel free to look around ze Museum some more.
translation: 虽然很遗憾，但你必须有自己的观点，不是吗？请随意参观 ze 博物馆。 [sui ran hen yi han ， dan ni bi xu you zi ji de guan dian ， bu shi ma ？ qing sui yi can guan  ze  bo wu guan 。]

english: Beautiful.
translation: 美丽的。 [mei li de 。]

english: Ahh yes, it eez. Feel free to look around ze Museum some more.
translation: 啊，是的，是的。请随意参观 ze 博物馆。 [a ， shi de ， shi de 。 qing sui yi can guan  ze  bo wu guan 。]

english: I didn't like it, but I still like the painting.
translation: 我不喜欢它，但我仍然喜欢这幅画。 [wo bu xi huan ta ， dan wo reng ran xi huan zhe fu hua 。]

english: Ahh well, eet iz not for everyone but I am glad you like ze painting.
translation: 啊，好吧，我并不适合所有人，但我很高兴你喜欢绘画。 [a ， hao ba ， wo bing bu shi he suo you ren ， dan wo hen gao xing ni xi huan hui hua 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Ahh well, eet iz not for everyone.
translation: 啊，好吧，并不适合所有人。 [a ， hao ba ， bing bu shi he suo you ren 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Umm...it's a painting.
translation: 嗯……这是一幅画。 [n …… zhe shi yi fu hua 。]

english: Yes, I see!
translation: 是的，我明白了！ [shi de ， wo ming bai le ！]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: That was nice, what did it mean?
translation: 那太好了，这是什么意思？ [na tai hao le ， zhe shi shen me yi si ？]

english: Wow!
translation: 哇！ [wa ！]

english: I still didn't like it.
translation: 我还是不喜欢它。 [wo hai shi bu xi huan ta 。]

english: Beautiful.
translation: 美丽的。 [mei li de 。]

english: I didn't like it, but I still like the painting.
translation: 我不喜欢它，但我仍然喜欢这幅画。 [wo bu xi huan ta ， dan wo reng ran xi huan zhe fu hua 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: What can I do for you?
translation: 我能为你做什么？ [wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: What are beginner clues?
translation: 什么是初学者线索？ [shen me shi chu xue zhe xian suo ？]

english: Arthur's eyes light up.
translation: 亚瑟的眼睛亮了起来。 [ya se de yan jing liang le qi lai 。]

english: Beginner clues are the lowest tier of clue scroll and as such only require a couple of steps to solve.
translation: 初学者线索是线索卷轴的最低层，因此只需要几个步骤即可解决。 [chu xue zhe xian suo shi xian suo juan zhou de zui di ceng ， yin ci zhi xu yao ji ge bu zhou ji ke jie jue 。]

english: Beginner clues are gained through various activities. Those activities are as follows.
translation: 初学者的线索是通过各种活动获得的。这些活动如下。 [chu xue zhe de xian suo shi tong guo ge zhong huo dong huo de de 。 zhe xie huo dong ru xia 。]

english: Slaying monsters for a chance at a clue being dropped. I hear goblins are sneaky, maybe they have some clue scrolls on them ripe for the taking.
translation: 杀死怪物以获得掉落线索的机会。我听说妖精很狡猾，也许他们身上有一些线索卷轴可以拿走。 [sha si guai wu yi huo de diao luo xian suo de ji hui 。 wo ting shuo yao jing hen jiao hua ， ye xu ta men shen shang you yi xie xian suo juan zhou ke yi na zou 。]

english: Maybe someone left one in the cow field, who knows where you could obtain them.
translation: 也许有人在牛场留下了一头，谁知道你能在哪里得到它们。 [ye xu you ren zai niu chang liu xia le yi tou ， shui zhi dao ni neng zai na li de dao ta men 。]

english: Beginner clues have also been known to be left in geodes while mining, as well as sometimes in bottles that you may fish up from time to time and from nests which fall out of trees.
translation: 据了解，初学者的线索也会留在采矿时的晶洞中，有时也会留在你不时捞起的瓶子里，以及从树上掉下来的巢穴里。 [ju liao jie ， chu xue zhe de xian suo ye hui liu zai cai kuang shi de jing dong zhong ， you shi ye hui liu zai ni bu shi lao qi de ping zi li ， yi ji cong shu shang diao xia lai de chao xue li 。]

english: Although this is a much rarer occurrence.
translation: 尽管这种情况比较罕见。 [jin guan zhe zhong qing kuang bi jiao han jian 。]

english: Unlike more advanced clues, you should not expect to get very valuable items from completing a beginner clue.
translation: 与更高级的线索不同，您不应期望通过完成初学者线索来获得非常有价值的物品。 [yu geng gao ji de xian suo bu tong ， nin bu ying qi wang tong guo wan cheng chu xue zhe xian suo lai huo de fei chang you jia zhi de wu pin 。]

english: What are more advanced clues?
translation: 更高级的线索是什么？ [geng gao ji de xian suo shi shen me ？]

english: Advanced clues have tiers between easy and master.
translation: 高级线索有简单和大师之间的等级。 [gao ji xian suo you jian dan he da shi zhi jian de deng ji 。]

english: You can gain advanced clues the same way you would get a beginner clue. But to get higher tier scrolls you will need to defeat more powerful foes.
translation: 您可以获得高级线索，就像获得初级线索一样。但要获得更高级别的卷轴，您需要击败更强大的敌人。 [nin ke yi huo de gao ji xian suo ， jiu xiang huo de chu ji xian suo yi yang 。 dan yao huo de geng gao ji bie de juan zhou ， nin xu yao ji bai geng qiang da de di ren 。]

english: The chance to get a higher tier clue from geodes, bottles and nests is lower the higher the tier. But if you chop down higher-level trees you will have a higher chance of receiving a nest which contains a clue. Same with fishing and mining.
translation: 等级越高，从晶洞、瓶子和巢穴中获得更高等级线索的机会就越低。但如果你砍倒更高级别的树木，你将有更高的机会获得包含线索的巢穴。捕鱼和采矿也是如此。 [deng ji yue gao ， cong jing dong 、 ping zi he chao xue zhong huo de geng gao deng ji xian suo de ji hui jiu yue di 。 dan ru guo ni kan dao geng gao ji bie de shu mu ， ni jiang you geng gao de ji hui huo de bao han xian suo de chao xue 。 bu yu he cai kuang ye shi ru ci 。]

english: The only exception to this is master clue scrolls.
translation: 唯一的例外是主线索卷轴。 [wei yi de li wai shi zhu xian suo juan zhou 。]

english: Master clues can only be obtained as a rare chance when opening your casket or by handing in one of every type of clue, apart from beginner, to Watson who resides in Hosidius.
translation: 大师线索只能在打开棺材时以难得的机会获得，或者将除初学者以外的各种线索交给居住在霍西迪乌斯的华生。 [da shi xian suo zhi neng zai da kai guan cai shi yi nan de de ji hui huo de ， huo zhe jiang chu chu xue zhe yi wai de ge zhong xian suo jiao gei ju zhu zai huo xi di wu si de hua sheng 。]

english: But with more advanced tiers of clue, come better loot.
translation: 但有了更高级的线索，就能获得更好的战利品。 [dan you le geng gao ji de xian suo ， jiu neng huo de geng hao de zhan li pin 。]

english: This type of clue has you talk to someone around Gielinor. Although the clue does not tell you exactly who to talk to.
translation: 此类线索让你与吉林诺周围的人交谈。尽管线索并没有告诉你具体该和谁交谈。 [ci lei xian suo rang ni yu ji lin nuo zhou wei de ren jiao tan 。 jin guan xian suo bing mei you gao su ni ju ti gai he shui jiao tan 。]

english: You will see a couple of words that may or may not make sense together. You will have to rearrange the letter to make the name of the person you need to talk to.
translation: 您会看到几个单词，它们组合在一起可能有意义也可能没有意义。您必须重新排列这封信以成为您需要交谈的人的名字。 [nin hui kan dao ji ge dan ci ， ta men zu he zai yi qi ke neng you yi yi ye ke neng mei you yi yi 。 nin bi xu chong xin pai lie zhe feng xin yi cheng wei nin xu yao jiao tan de ren de ming zi 。]

english: This type of clue has you work out a logical problem for the person you need to talk to. This type of challenge only appears in clue tiers medium, hard and elite.
translation: 这种类型的线索可以让你为你需要交谈的人解决一个逻辑问题。这种类型的挑战仅出现在中等、困难和精英线索等级中。 [zhe zhong lei xing de xian suo ke yi rang ni wei ni xu yao jiao tan de ren jie jue yi ge luo ji wen ti 。 zhe zhong lei xing de tiao zhan jin chu xian zai zhong deng 、 kun nan he jing ying xian suo deng ji zhong 。]

english: There are also challenges that will involve you gathering an item or crafting an item for a certain person.
translation: 还有一些挑战需要你收集物品或为某个人制作物品。 [hai you yi xie tiao zhan xu yao ni shou ji wu pin huo wei mou ge ren zhi zuo wu pin 。]

english: This type of clue has you talk to someone around Gielinor. Although the clue does not tell you exactly who to talk to. This type of challenge only appears in clue tiers medium, hard and elite.
translation: 此类线索让你与吉林诺周围的人交谈。尽管线索并没有告诉你具体该和谁交谈。这种类型的挑战仅出现在中等、困难和精英线索等级中。 [ci lei xian suo rang ni yu ji lin nuo zhou wei de ren jiao tan 。 jin guan xian suo bing mei you gao su ni ju ti gai he shui jiao tan 。 zhe zhong lei xing de tiao zhan jin chu xian zai zhong deng 、 kun nan he jing ying xian suo deng ji zhong 。]

english: A cipher is a string of letters that have been scrambled using the shift cipher method.
translation: 密码是使用移位密码方法加扰的一串字母。 [mi ma shi shi yong yi wei mi ma fang fa jia rao de yi chuan zi mu 。]

english: An example of this would be ZCZL which, shifted forward by one, would be Adam.
translation: 一个例子是 ZCZL，向前移动一位就是 Adam。 [yi ge li zi shi  ZCZL， xiang qian yi dong yi wei jiu shi  Adam。]

english: This type of clue will have you use a sextant, chart and a watch to find out the place you will need to dig. This type of challenge only appears in clue tiers medium and above.
translation: 这种类型的线索将要求您使用六分仪、海图和手表来找出您需要挖掘的地方。这种类型的挑战仅出现在中等及以上的线索层中。 [zhe zhong lei xing de xian suo jiang yao qiu nin shi yong liu fen yi 、 hai tu he shou biao lai zhao chu nin xu yao wa jue de di fang 。 zhe zhong lei xing de tiao zhan jin chu xian zai zhong deng ji yi shang de xian suo ceng zhong 。]

english: After you find the place you need to dig, you may find a casket or another scroll.
translation: 找到需要挖掘的地方后，您可能会发现一个棺材或另一个卷轴。 [zhao dao xu yao wa jue de di fang hou ， nin ke neng hui fa xian yi ge guan cai huo ling yi ge juan zhou 。]

english: This type of clue can be as simple as talk to the specified person or searching a crate in a specified location.
translation: 这种类型的线索可以像与指定的人交谈或在指定位置搜索板条箱一样简单。 [zhe zhong lei xing de xian suo ke yi xiang yu zhi ding de ren jiao tan huo zai zhi ding wei zhi sou suo ban tiao xiang yi yang jian dan 。]

english: But the higher the tier of clue, the more steps you will have to do beforehand. An example of this would be needing to find a key before opening a chest.
translation: 但线索的等级越高，您需要预先执行的步骤就越多。一个例子是在打开箱子之前需要找到一把钥匙。 [dan xian suo de deng ji yue gao ， nin xu yao yu xian zhi xing de bu zhou jiu yue duo 。 yi ge li zi shi zai da kai xiang zi zhi qian xu yao zhao dao yi ba yao shi 。]

english: This type of clue will give you a location that you will need to visit, along with some items you will need.
translation: 此类线索将为您提供需要访问的位置以及您需要的一些物品。 [ci lei xian suo jiang wei nin ti gong xu yao fang wen de wei zhi yi ji nin xu yao de yi xie wu pin 。]

english: At this location you will need to perform an emote, as well as wear the items that you had to bring along.
translation: 在此位置，您需要表演表情，并穿戴您必须携带的物品。 [zai ci wei zhi ， nin xu yao biao yan biao qing ， bing chuan dai nin bi xu xie dai de wu pin 。]

english: Some clues may have you wear nothing at all.
translation: 有些线索可能会让你什么都没穿。 [you xie xian suo ke neng hui rang ni shen me dou mei chuan 。]

english: But please don't do that in public!
translation: 但请不要在公共场合这样做！ [dan qing bu yao zai gong gong chang he zhe yang zuo ！]

english: This type of challenge only appears in clue tiers medium and above.
translation: 这种类型的挑战仅出现在中等及以上的线索层中。 [zhe zhong lei xing de tiao zhan jin chu xian zai zhong deng ji yi shang de xian suo ceng zhong 。]

english: Depending on the tier of clue, you will need to obtain a strange device from either Reldo, located in Varrock, or Jorral, located south of Tree Gnome Stronghold.
translation: 根据线索的级别，您需要从位于 Varrock 的 Reldo 或位于树侏儒要塞南部的 Jorral 处获得一个奇怪的装置。 [gen ju xian suo de ji bie ， nin xu yao cong wei yu  Varrock  de  Reldo  huo wei yu shu zhu ru yao sai nan bu de  Jorral  chu huo de yi ge qi guai de zhuang zhi 。]

english: You will then need to use this device to find the location you will need to dig.
translation: 然后，您将需要使用此设备来找到您需要挖掘的位置。 [ran hou ， nin jiang xu yao shi yong ci she bei lai zhao dao nin xu yao wa jue de wei zhi 。]

english: There are many different puzzles that you can come across while doing clues. These range from light boxes to puzzle boxes.
translation: 在做线索的过程中，你可能会遇到许多不同的谜题。这些范围从灯箱到拼图盒。 [zai zuo xian suo de guo cheng zhong ， ni ke neng hui yu dao xu duo bu tong de mi ti 。 zhe xie fan wei cong deng xiang dao pin tu he 。]

english: Puzzle boxes are puzzles that will have you complete a slider puzzle that, when complete, will look like an image in game.
translation: 拼图盒是让您完成滑块拼图的拼图，完成后，它看起来像游戏中的图像。 [pin tu he shi rang nin wan cheng hua kuai pin tu de pin tu ， wan cheng hou ， ta kan qi lai xiang you xi zhong de tu xiang 。]

english: Light boxes are a puzzle which contains a 5 by 5 grid of lights with some lights on and some lights off.
translation: 灯箱是一个拼图，包含 5 x 5 的灯网格，其中一些灯亮，一些灯关。 [deng xiang shi yi ge pin tu ， bao han  5 x 5  de deng wang ge ， qi zhong yi xie deng liang ， yi xie deng guan 。]

english: The puzzle will have you click the buttons below to turn on or off some of the lights with the end goal being, having all the lights turned on.
translation: 该谜题将要求您单击下面的按钮来打开或关闭一些灯，最终目标是打开所有灯。 [gai mi ti jiang yao qiu nin dan ji xia mian de an niu lai da kai huo guan bi yi xie deng ， zui zhong mu biao shi da kai suo you deng 。]

english: This type of clue will show you a map of an area.
translation: 此类线索将向您显示一个区域的地图。 [ci lei xian suo jiang xiang nin xian shi yi ge qu yu de di tu 。]

english: This map will show you where you will need to dig, or what you will need to search to get the next clue.
translation: 这张地图将告诉你需要在哪里挖掘，或者你需要搜索什么才能获得下一条线索。 [zhe zhang di tu jiang gao su ni xu yao zai na li wa jue ， huo zhe ni xu yao sou suo shen me cai neng huo de xia yi tiao xian suo 。]

english: This type of clue will show you which fairy ring code you will need to use to get to the right place to dig.
translation: 此类线索将向您显示需要使用哪个仙女戒指代码才能到达正确的挖掘地点。 [ci lei xian suo jiang xiang nin xian shi xu yao shi yong na ge xian nv jie zhi dai ma cai neng dao da zheng que de wa jue di dian 。]

english: You will then need to use the numbers to figure our where you will need to dig after arriving to your destination.
translation: 然后，您需要使用这些数字来确定到达目的地后需要挖掘的位置。 [ran hou ， nin xu yao shi yong zhe xie shu zi lai que ding dao da mu di di hou xu yao wa jue de wei zhi 。]

english: Hey Arthur, can I stop receiving clues from vessels? They're clogging up my backpack!
translation: 嘿亚瑟，我可以停止接收来自船只的线索吗？他们堵塞了我的背包！ [hei ya se ， wo ke yi ting zhi jie shou lai zi chuan zhi de xian suo ma ？ ta men du se le wo de bei bao ！]

english: Vessel containers include mining geodes, fishing bottles and clue nests. Are you sure you want to stop receiving them?
translation: 船只容器包括采矿晶洞、钓鱼瓶和线索巢。您确定要停止接收它们吗？ [chuan zhi rong qi bao kuo cai kuang jing dong 、 diao yu ping he xian suo chao 。 nin que ding yao ting zhi jie shou ta men ma ？]

english: Yes please, I want to stop receiving vesseled containers.
translation: 是的，我想停止接收容器。 [shi de ， wo xiang ting zhi jie shou rong qi 。]

english: Very well, you'll no longer find clues from mining, fishing and woodcutting.
translation: 很好，你将不再从采矿、捕鱼和伐木中找到线索。 [hen hao ， ni jiang bu zai cong cai kuang 、 bu yu he fa mu zhong zhao dao xian suo 。]

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 还有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [hai you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

english: Hey Arthur, can I start receiving clues from vessels?
translation: 嘿亚瑟，我可以开始接收来自船只的线索吗？ [hei ya se ， wo ke yi kai shi jie shou lai zi chuan zhi de xian suo ma ？]

english: Vessel containers include mining geodes, fishing bottles and clue nests. Are you sure you want to start receiving them, again?

translation: 尼尔萨尔。来这里做一些手工？如果是的话，我有一些用品可能会对你有所帮助。 [ni er sa er 。 lai zhe li zuo yi xie shou gong ？ ru guo shi de hua ， wo you yi xie yong pin ke neng hui dui ni you suo bang zhu 。]

english: Greetings, friend; my business here deals with Hunter related items. Is there anything in which I can interest you?
translation: 你好，朋友；我这里的业务涉及与猎人相关的物品。有什么我可以让您感兴趣的吗？ [ni hao ， peng you ； wo zhe li de ye wu she ji yu lie ren xiang guan de wu pin 。 you shen me wo ke yi rang nin gan xing qu de ma ？]

translation: 那么也许下次吧。 [na me ye xu xia ci ba 。]
