english: Hello again Artur.
translation: 你好，阿图尔。 [ni hao ， a tu er 。]

english: Hello [player name]. Thanks for your help in recovering the Accord.
translation: 你好[玩家姓名]。感谢您帮助恢复协议。 [ni hao [ wan jia xing ming ]。 gan xie nin bang zhu hui fu xie yi 。]

english: No problem.
translation: 没问题。 [mei wen ti 。]

english: Why is the Accord important?
translation: 协议为何重要？ [xie yi wei he zhong yao ？]

english: The signing of the Accord marked the start of a golden age. Once the Royal Lords replaced the Council of Elders, Kourend prospered like never before.
translation: 该协议的签署标志着黄金时代的开始。一旦皇家上议院取代了长老会，库伦德就获得了前所未有的繁荣。 [gai xie yi de qian shu biao zhi zhe huang jin shi dai de kai shi 。 yi dan huang jia shang yi yuan qu dai le zhang lao hui ， ku lun de jiu huo de le qian suo wei you de fan rong 。]

english: But that was a long time ago. Why does it matter now?
translation: 但那是很久以前的事了。为什么现在很重要？ [dan na shi hen jiu yi qian de shi le 。 wei shen me xian zai hen zhong yao ？]

english: Because I think it's time for another golden age. The Kourend Council, like the Council of Elders before them, have failed to do a good job in running this kingdom.
translation: 因为我认为现在是另一个黄金时代的时候了。库伦德议会和之前的长老议会一样，在管理这个王国方面没能做好。 [yin wei wo ren wei xian zai shi ling yi ge huang jin shi dai de shi hou le 。 ku lun de yi hui he zhi qian de zhang lao yi hui yi yang ， zai guan li zhe ge wang guo fang mian mei neng zuo hao 。]

english: And you think the five houses would do a better job?
translation: 你认为这五个房子会做得更好吗？ [ni ren wei zhe wu ge fang zi hui zuo de geng hao ma ？]

english: Exactly.
translation: 确切地。 [que qie di 。]

english: What makes you say the Council have done a bad job?
translation: 你凭什么说安理会做得不好？ [ni ping shen me shuo an li hui zuo de bu hao ？]

english: More crime. Fewer homes. More illness. Loss of jobs. The list goes on.
translation: 更多犯罪。房子少了。更多的疾病。失业。这样的例子还在继续。 [geng duo fan zui 。 fang zi shao le 。 geng duo de ji bing 。 shi ye 。 zhe yang de li zi hai zai ji xu 。]

english: But aren't the five houses partially to blame as well? They rule the cities.
translation: 但这五所房子不也有部分责任吗？他们统治着城市。 [dan zhe wu suo fang zi bu ye you bu fen ze ren ma ？ ta men tong zhi zhe cheng shi 。]

english: The Council sets the laws and the Council sets the budgets. We have to do as they say, just like everyone else.
translation: 理事会制定法律，理事会制定预算。我们必须按照他们说的去做，就像其他人一样。 [li shi hui zhi ding fa lv ， li shi hui zhi ding yu suan 。 wo men bi xu an zhao ta men shuo de qu zuo ， jiu xiang qi ta ren yi yang 。]

english: Hmmm, fair enough. Anyway, we'd better get off.
translation: 嗯，很公平。无论如何，我们最好还是下车吧。 [n ， hen gong ping 。 wu lun ru he ， wo men zui hao hai shi xia che ba 。]

english: Fair enough. See you later.
translation: 很公平。稍后见。 [hen gong ping 。 shao hou jian 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Hello there Artur. Actually... I guess I should say Your Majesty now.
translation: 你好，阿图尔。其实……我想我现在应该说陛下。 [ni hao ， a tu er 。 qi shi …… wo xiang wo xian zai ying gai shuo bi xia 。]

english: For you friend, Artur is fine.
translation: 对于你的朋友来说，阿图尔很好。 [dui yu ni de peng you lai shuo ， a tu er hen hao 。]

english: You should not dispense formalities Artur. A king should command respect.
translation: 你不应该办理手续阿图尔。国王应该受到尊重。 [ni bu ying gai ban li shou xu a tu er 。 guo wang ying gai shou dao zun zhong 。]

english: I can command respect without using fancy titles, mother.
translation: 妈妈，我不用花哨的头衔就能赢得尊重。 [ma ma ， wo bu yong hua shao de tou xian jiu neng ying de zun zhong 。]

english: So, how are you doing.
translation: 那么，你好吗？ [na me ， ni hao ma ？]

english: I have a lot of responsibility now. There's much to learn and not much time to learn it in. The loss of father still weighs heavily on me as well.
translation: 我现在有很多责任。有很多东西需要学习，但没有太多时间来学习。失去父亲仍然对我造成沉重的压力。 [wo xian zai you hen duo ze ren 。 you hen duo dong xi xu yao xue xi ， dan mei you tai duo shi jian lai xue xi 。 shi qu fu qin reng ran dui wo zao cheng chen zhong de ya li 。]

english: Still, I am well supported by those around me. I'm sure that with their help, I can be the ruler the people deserve.
translation: 尽管如此，我还是得到了周围人的大力支持。我确信在他们的帮助下，我能够成为人民应得的统治者。 [jin guan ru ci ， wo hai shi de dao le zhou wei ren de da li zhi chi 。 wo que xin zai ta men de bang zhu xia ， wo neng gou cheng wei ren min ying de de tong zhi zhe 。]

english: I'm sure you can as well. Anyway, I'll let you get on with you work.
translation: 我相信你也可以。无论如何，我会让你继续工作。 [wo xiang xin ni ye ke yi 。 wu lun ru he ， wo hui rang ni ji xu gong zuo 。]

english: Until next time
translation: 直到下次 [zhi dao xia ci]

english: Why is the Accord important?
translation: 协议为何重要？ [xie yi wei he zhong yao ？]

english: What makes you say the council have done a bad job?
translation: 是什么让你说理事会做得不好？ [shi shen me rang ni shuo li shi hui zuo de bu hao ？]

english: Fair enough. See you later.
translation: 很公平。稍后见。 [hen gong ping 。 shao hou jian 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Good day traveller. You are far from home, what brings you here?
translation: 美好的一天旅行者。你离家很远，是什么风把你吹到这里来的？ [mei hao de yi tian lv xing zhe 。 ni li jia hen yuan ， shi shen me feng ba ni chui dao zhe li lai de ？]

english: I am a wandering hero, I come here in search of adventure.
translation: 我是一个流浪英雄，我来这里寻找冒险。 [wo shi yi ge liu lang ying xiong ， wo lai zhe li xun zhao mao xian 。]

english: Sounds ghastly, I just want to live in peace.
translation: 听起来很可怕，我只想平静地生活。 [ting qi lai hen ke pa ， wo zhi xiang ping jing di sheng huo 。]

english: Unfortunately without people like me, peace doesn't last for long.
translation: 不幸的是，没有像我这样的人，和平不会持续太久。 [bu xing de shi ， mei you xiang wo zhe yang de ren ， he ping bu hui chi xu tai jiu 。]

english: True, but then again most adventurers cause as much trouble as they put right.
translation: 确实如此，但话又说回来，大多数冒险家造成的麻烦和他们纠正的麻烦一样多。 [que shi ru ci ， dan hua you shuo hui lai ， da duo shu mao xian jia zao cheng de ma fan he ta men jiu zheng de ma fan yi yang duo 。]

english: You've got a point there... Hmm...
translation: 你说得有道理……嗯…… [ni shuo de you dao li …… n ……]

english: Well, good day traveller. And always do the right thing.
translation: 好吧，美好的一天旅行者。并且始终做正确的事。 [hao ba ， mei hao de yi tian lv xing zhe 。 bing qie shi zhong zuo zheng que de shi 。]

english: Good day traveller.
translation: 美好的一天旅行者。 [mei hao de yi tian lv xing zhe 。]

english: Hi there, how's it going?
translation: 你好，怎么样？ [ni hao ， zen me yang ？]

english: Well we're still alive, after all that's happened, we should be thankful of that.
translation: 好吧，我们还活着，经历了这一切，我们应该庆幸。 [hao ba ， wo men hai huo zhe ， jing li le zhe yi qie ， wo men ying gai qing xing 。]

english: Hopefully this war is over soon.
translation: 希望这场战争尽快结束。 [xi wang zhe chang zhan zheng jin kuai jie shu 。]

english: Indeed, but how many more need to die before that happens?
translation: 确实如此，但在此之前还有多少人需要死去呢？ [que shi ru ci ， dan zai ci zhi qian hai you duo shao ren xu yao si qu ne ？]

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你认为你在做什么？ [ni ren wei ni zai zuo shen me ？]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: He seems to be lost in his own thoughts...
translation: 他似乎陷入了自己的思绪之中…… [ta si hu xian ru le zi ji de si xu zhi zhong ……]

english: Howdy stranger. What brings you out to these parts?
translation: 你好陌生人。是什么让您想到这些部分的？ [ni hao mo sheng ren 。 shi shen me rang nin xiang dao zhe xie bu fen de ？]

english: Nothing much - What are you doing here? It doesn't seem like there's much to do out here in the desert!
translation: 没什么——你在这里做什么？看来沙漠里没什么可玩的啊！ [mei shen me —— ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？ kan lai sha mo li mei shen me ke wan de a ！]

english: Well, that's where you'd be wrong. I work for the Archaeological Society of Varrock, and have been excavating around here recently.
translation: 嗯，这就是你错的地方。我在瓦罗克考古学会工作，最近一直在这附近进行挖掘。 [n ， zhe jiu shi ni cuo de di fang 。 wo zai wa luo ke kao gu xue hui gong zuo ， zui jin yi zhi zai zhe fu jin jin xing wa jue 。]

english: Was there something you specifically wanted?
translation: 有什么你特别想要的吗？ [you shen me ni te bie xiang yao de ma ？]

english: (shows other options)
translation: （显示其他选项） [（ xian shi qi ta xuan xiang ）]

english: Do you have any quests? Call it a hunch, but you look like the type of man who might...
translation: 你有什么任务吗？可以说这是一种预感，但你看起来像是那种可能... [ni you shen me ren wu ma ？ ke yi shuo zhe shi yi zhong yu gan ， dan ni kan qi lai xiang shi na zhong ke neng ...]

english: Well, it's funny you should say that. I'm not sure if I would really call it a quest as such, but I found this ancient stone tablet in one of my excavations, and it would really help me out if you
translation: 嗯，你这么说很有趣。我不确定我是否真的会把它称为这样的任务，但我在一次挖掘中发现了这块古老的石碑，如果你 [n ， ni zhe me shuo hen you qu 。 wo bu que ding wo shi fou zhen de hui ba ta cheng wei zhe yang de ren wu ， dan wo zai yi ci wa jue zhong fa xian le zhe kuai gu lao de shi bei ， ru guo ni]

english: could go and take it back to the digsite for me and get it examined.
translation: 可以帮我把它带回挖掘场并进行检查。 [ke yi bang wo ba ta dai hui wa jue chang bing jin xing jian cha 。]

english: It's very old, and I don't recognise any of the inscriptions on it.
translation: 它非常古老，我不认识上面的任何铭文。 [ta fei chang gu lao ， wo bu ren shi shang mian de ren he ming wen 。]

english: Sure, I was heading that way anyway. Any particular person at the digsite you want me to talk to?
translation: 当然，无论如何我都是往那个方向走的。您希望我与挖掘现场的任何特定人员交谈吗？ [dang ran ， wu lun ru he wo dou shi wang na ge fang xiang zou de 。 nin xi wang wo yu wa jue xian chang de ren he te ding ren yuan jiao tan ma ？]

english: His name's Terry Balando. Give it to nobody but him. I'm sorry, I can't entrust you with the actual tablet I found, it is far too valuable to give away, but I took these etchings - they should be enough for him to make
translation: 他的名字叫特里·巴兰多。给除了他以外的任何人。抱歉，我不能把我发现的那块平板电脑托付给你，它太贵重了，不能送人，但我拿走了这些蚀刻画——它们应该足够他制作了 [ta de ming zi jiao te li · ba lan duo 。 gei chu le ta yi wai de ren he ren 。 bao qian ， wo bu neng ba wo fa xian de na kuai ping ban dian nao tuo fu gei ni ， ta tai gui zhong le ， bu neng song ren ， dan wo na zou le zhe xie shi ke hua —— ta men ying gai zu gou ta zhi zuo le]

english: a preliminary translation on. Come back and let me know what he says, I would hate to waste my time excavating anything that isn't worth my time as a world famous archaeologist!
translation: 上的初步翻译。回来告诉我他说什么，我不想浪费时间去挖掘任何不值得我作为世界著名考古学家花时间的东西！ [shang de chu bu fan yi 。 hui lai gao su wo ta shuo shen me ， wo bu xiang lang fei shi jian qu wa jue ren he bu zhi de wo zuo wei shi jie zhu ming kao gu xue jia hua shi jian de dong xi ！]

english: No thanks. Playing delivery boy doesn't really sound much like fun to me.
translation: 不，谢谢。对我来说，扮演送货员听起来并不是很有趣。 [bu ， xie xie 。 dui wo lai shuo ， ban yan song huo yuan ting qi lai bing bu shi hen you qu 。]

english: Well, okay. Can't say as I blame you for thinking that. I'll go take it there myself later I guess.
translation: 好吧，好吧。不能说，因为我责怪你这么想。我想我稍后会亲自去那里。 [hao ba ， hao ba 。 bu neng shuo ， yin wei wo ze guai ni zhe me xiang 。 wo xiang wo shao hou hui qin zi qu na li 。]

english: Who are you, anyway?
translation: 到底你是谁？ [dao di ni shi shui ？]

english: You don't recognise me??? I am the world famous Asgarnia Smith, Archaeologist extraordinaire!
translation: 你不认识我了？？？我是举世闻名的阿斯加尼亚·史密斯，杰出的考古学家！ [ni bu ren shi wo le ？？？ wo shi ju shi wen ming de a si jia ni ya · shi mi si ， jie chu de kao gu xue jia ！]

english: I am the one who discovered the long forgotten Temple of Ikov! The one who unearthed the strange trap filled arena in Brimhaven!
translation: 我是发现早已被遗忘的伊科夫神庙的人！是那个在布里姆港发现了充满奇怪陷阱的竞技场的人！ [wo shi fa xian zao yi bei yi wang de yi ke fu shen miao de ren ！ shi na ge zai bu li mu gang fa xian le chong man qi guai xian jing de jing ji chang de ren ！]

english: I'm the leading archaeological expert of our time! I was voted archaeologist of the year four years running by the Varrock Herald! Are you REALLY sure you've never heard of me?
translation: 我是我们这个时代顶尖的考古专家！我连续四年被 Varrock Herald 评选为年度考古学家！你真的确定你从未听说过我吗？ [wo shi wo men zhe ge shi dai ding jian de kao gu zhuan jia ！ wo lian xu si nian bei  Varrock Herald  ping xuan wei nian du kao gu xue jia ！ ni zhen di que ding ni cong wei ting shuo guo wo ma ？]

english: No, I really haven't.
translation: 不，我真的没有。 [bu ， wo zhen de mei you 。]

english: Well then, I'm confused. Why did you come over and speak to me if you don't know who I am? What do you want?
translation: 那么，我很困惑。如果你不知道我是谁，为什么要过来跟我说话？你想要什么？ [na me ， wo hen kun huo 。 ru guo ni bu zhi dao wo shi shui ， wei shen me yao guo lai gen wo shuo hua ？ ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Nothing really. I'm just wandering around for no good reason.
translation: 真的没什么。我只是无缘无故地闲逛。 [zhen de mei shen me 。 wo zhi shi wu yuan wu gu di xian guang 。]

english: Uh-huh. Well, if you'll excuse me, I have a lot more work to do before I can bed down for the night.
translation: 嗯嗯。好吧，请原谅，在我晚上睡觉之前我还有很多工作要做。 [n n 。 hao ba ， qing yuan liang ， zai wo wan shang shui jiao zhi qian wo hai you hen duo gong zuo yao zuo 。]

english: So what did Terry Balando say about those etchings? Did he give you a translation for me?
translation: 那么特里·巴兰多 (Terry Balando) 对这些蚀刻画说了什么？他给我翻译了吗？ [na me te li · ba lan duo  (Terry Balando)  dui zhe xie shi ke hua shuo le shen me ？ ta gei wo fan yi le ma ？]

english: Um... yeah... about that... I kind of didn't go and speak to him yet...
translation: 嗯...是的...关于那个...我还没有去和他说话... [n ... shi de ... guan yu na ge ... wo hai mei you qu he ta shuo hua ...]

english: Well what are you waiting for? A written invitation? All I want you to do is take those etchings up to the digsite for me!
translation: 那你还在等什么？书面邀请？我想要你做的就是帮我把那些蚀刻画带到挖掘现场！ [na ni hai zai deng shen me ？ shu mian yao qing ？ wo xiang yao ni zuo de jiu shi bang wo ba na xie shi ke hua dai dao wa jue xian chang ！]

english: Okay, I'll do that then.
translation: 好吧，那我就这么做。 [hao ba ， na wo jiu zhe me zuo 。]

english: Um... yeah... about that... I kind of lost those etchings you gave me...
translation: 嗯...是的...关于那个...我有点丢失了你给我的那些蚀刻... [n ... shi de ... guan yu na ge ... wo you dian diu shi le ni gei wo de na xie shi ke ...]

english: Well how in the world did you do that? (sigh) Okay, I'll make another set, but try not to lose these ones this time!
translation: 那么你到底是怎么做到的呢？ （叹气）好吧，我会再做一套，但这次尽量不要失去这些！ [na me ni dao di shi zen me zuo dao de ne ？ （ tan qi ） hao ba ， wo hui zai zuo yi tao ， dan zhe ci jin liang bu yao shi qu zhe xie ！]

english: Yeah, he did. But I don't have it with me.
translation: 是的，他做到了。但我没有带它。 [shi de ， ta zuo dao le 。 dan wo mei you dai ta 。]

english: I see.
translation: 我懂了。 [wo dong le 。]

english: Well could you go and get me that translation? It could be vital!
translation: 那么你能帮我拿一份翻译吗？这可能至关重要！ [na me ni neng bang wo na yi fen fan yi ma ？ zhe ke neng zhi guan zhong yao ！]

english: Yeah, he did. I have it here in this book.
translation: 是的，他做到了。我在这本书里有它。 [shi de ， ta zuo dao le 。 wo zai zhe ben shu li you ta 。]

english: Did you take a read of this? It will do you good to understand how this profession works. Here, have a read.
translation: 你读过这篇文章吗？了解这个职业是如何运作的对你很有帮助。在这里，读一读。 [ni du guo zhe pian wen zhang ma ？ liao jie zhe ge zhi ye shi ru he yun zuo de dui ni hen you bang zhu 。 zai zhe li ， du yi du 。]

english: (the book opens up)
translation: （书本打开） [（ shu ben da kai ）]

english: Yeah, I did. Kind of boring really.
translation: 是的，我做到了。确实有点无聊。 [shi de ， wo zuo dao le 。 que shi you dian wu liao 。]

english: Excellent. Just give me a moment to read this, and talk to me again in a second.
translation: 出色的。请给我一点时间阅读本文，稍后再跟我说话。 [chu se de 。 qing gei wo yi dian shi jian yue du ben wen ， shao hou zai gen wo shuo hua 。]

english: Hmmm. Interesting. It seems to me like there's some kind of treasure hidden out in the desert.
translation: 嗯。有趣的。在我看来，沙漠里似乎藏着某种宝藏。 [n 。 you qu de 。 zai wo kan lai ， sha mo li si hu cang zhe mou zhong bao zang 。]

english: So what do you say? Fancy being a treasure hunter like me?
translation: 那你说呢？想像我一样成为一名宝藏猎人吗？ [na ni shuo ne ？ xiang xiang wo yi yang cheng wei yi ming bao zang lie ren ma ？]

english: Uh... don't you mean archaeologist?
translation: 呃……你不是说考古学家吗？ [e …… ni bu shi shuo kao gu xue jia ma ？]

english: Yeeees... An archaeologist...
translation: 是啊……考古学家…… [shi a …… kao gu xue jia ……]

english: It's all this hot sun getting to me I think.
translation: 我想，这一切都是炎热的阳光照在我身上。 [wo xiang ， zhe yi qie dou shi yan re de yang guang zhao zai wo shen shang 。]

english: Well anyway, let's just assume there is a treasure hidden in the desert somewhere, and let's just say for the sake of argument that maybe if I found a big stash of gold and treasure I wouldn't necessarily just hand it
translation: 好吧，无论如何，让我们假设沙漠中的某个地方藏着一个宝藏，为了便于论证，也许如果我发现了一大堆黄金和宝藏，我不一定会把它交给 [hao ba ， wu lun ru he ， rang wo men jia she sha mo zhong de mou ge di fang cang zhe yi ge bao zang ， wei le bian yu lun zheng ， ye xu ru guo wo fa xian le yi da dui huang jin he bao zang ， wo bu yi ding hui ba ta jiao gei]

english: all over to the Museum of Varrock.
translation: 一切都到了瓦罗克博物馆。 [yi qie dou dao le wa luo ke bo wu guan 。]

english: Let's also say, purely hypothetically, that if there were such a big stash of treasure and someone were to help me find it, then that hypothetical person might be entitled to, oh, let's say a purely for the sake of
translation: 我们还可以说，纯粹是假设，如果有这么一大堆宝藏，并且有人帮助我找到它，那么那个假设的人可能有权，哦，让我们说纯粹是为了 [wo men hai ke yi shuo ， chun cui shi jia she ， ru guo you zhe me yi da dui bao zang ， bing qie you ren bang zhu wo zhao dao ta ， na me na ge jia she de ren ke neng you quan ， o ， rang wo men shuo chun cui shi wei le]

english: argument thirty percent split...
translation: 争论百分之三十的分歧... [zheng lun bai fen zhi san shi de fen qi ...]

english: Fifty percent.
translation: 百分之五十。 [bai fen zhi wu shi 。]

english: That's right!
translation: 这是正确的！ [zhe shi zheng que de ！]

english: A purely for the sake of argument fifty-fifty split on this hypothetical treasure, should it exist...
translation: 纯粹为了争论，对这个假设的宝藏进行了五五十次分裂，如果它存在的话...... [chun cui wei le zheng lun ， dui zhe ge jia she de bao zang jin xing le wu wu shi ci fen lie ， ru guo ta cun zai de hua ......]

english: Do you see where I'm going with this?
translation: 你明白我要说什么了吗？ [ni ming bai wo yao shuo shen me le ma ？]

english: You want me to help you find some treasure for a fifty percent share, as long as I don't tell anybody, and your reputation as an esteemed archaeologist with the Museum of Varrock remains intact, and nobody
translation: 你想让我以百分之五十的份额帮你找到一些宝藏，只要我不告诉任何人，并且你作为瓦罗克博物馆受人尊敬的考古学家的声誉完好无损，没有人会这样做。 [ni xiang rang wo yi bai fen zhi wu shi de fen e bang ni zhao dao yi xie bao zang ， zhi yao wo bu gao su ren he ren ， bing qie ni zuo wei wa luo ke bo wu guan shou ren zun jing de kao gu xue jia de sheng yu wan hao wu sun ， mei you ren hui zhe yang zuo 。]

english: discovers you're actually just a treasure hunter?
translation: 发现自己其实只是一个寻宝者？ [fa xian zi ji qi shi zhi shi yi ge xun bao zhe ？]

english: Uh... yes, but the way you said it makes it sound like I'm doing something wrong...
translation: 呃...是的，但是你说的方式听起来像是我做错了什么... [e ... shi de ， dan shi ni shuo de fang shi ting qi lai xiang shi wo zuo cuo le shen me ...]

english: So what do you say? Partners?
translation: 那你说呢？合作伙伴？ [na ni shuo ne ？ he zuo huo ban ？]

english: Well... I guess nobody is really going to lose out on anything, and we don't even know if there is any treasure...
translation: 嗯...我想没有人会真正失去任何东西，而且我们甚至不知道是否有任何宝藏... [n ... wo xiang mei you ren hui zhen zheng shi qu ren he dong xi ， er qie wo men shen zhi bu zhi dao shi fou you ren he bao zang ...]

english: Aw, go on then. Count me in.
translation: 噢，那就继续吧。算我一个吧。 [o ， na jiu ji xu ba 。 suan wo yi ge ba 。]

english: That's what I like to hear! Now, if we split up we'll be able to find treasure quicker.
translation: 这就是我喜欢听的！现在，如果我们分开的话，我们就能更快地找到宝藏。 [zhe jiu shi wo xi huan ting de ！ xian zai ， ru guo wo men fen kai de hua ， wo men jiu neng geng kuai di zhao dao bao zang 。]

english: I'll continue searching around here in this Bedabin Camp, you head due South to the Bandit Village. If either of us find anything, we'll come find each other and say what, okay?
translation: 我将继续在这个贝达宾营地附近搜索，你向南前往强盗村。如果我们中的任何一个发现了什么，我们就会找到对方并说些什么，好吗？ [wo jiang ji xu zai zhe ge bei da bin ying di fu jin sou suo ， ni xiang nan qian wang qiang dao cun 。 ru guo wo men zhong de ren he yi ge fa xian le shen me ， wo men jiu hui zhao dao dui fang bing shuo xie shen me ， hao ma ？]

english: You head due South, see what you can find out about this tablet.
translation: 你向南走，看看你能找到关于这款平板电脑的信息。 [ni xiang nan zou ， kan kan ni neng zhao dao guan yu zhe kuan ping ban dian nao de xin xi 。]

english: This all sounds very immoral, and I don't want any part of your seedy little schemes.
translation: 这一切听起来都很不道德，我不想参与你们肮脏的小计划。 [zhe yi qie ting qi lai dou hen bu dao de ， wo bu xiang can yu ni men ang zang de xiao ji hua 。]

english: Aw, c'mon, cut me a break here! Look, nobody is really getting hurt, right? This treasure is either going to lie around in some underground ruin, or lie around in some museum for
translation: 噢，来吧，让我休息一下！看，没有人真正受伤，对吧？这个宝藏要么躺在某个地下废墟中，要么躺在某个博物馆里 [o ， lai ba ， rang wo xiu xi yi xia ！ kan ， mei you ren zhen zheng shou shang ， dui ba ？ zhe ge bao zang yao me tang zai mou ge di xia fei xu zhong ， yao me tang zai mou ge bo wu guan li]

english: people to look at!
translation: 人们来看看！ [ren men lai kan kan ！]

english: It makes sense for the people to go to all the risk to get a little payback for it, right? Besides, anything of real historical value we can hand over to the museum - we'll just keep the cash for
translation: 人们冒着所有的风险来获得一点回报是有道理的，对吗？此外，任何具有真正历史价值的东西我们都可以交给博物馆——我们只保留现金 [ren men mao zhe suo you de feng xian lai huo de yi dian hui bao shi you dao li de ， dui ma ？ ci wai ， ren he ju you zhen zheng li shi jia zhi de dong xi wo men dou ke yi jiao gei bo wu guan —— wo men zhi bao liu xian jin]

english: ourselves!
translation: 我们自己！ [wo men zi ji ！]

english: C'mon... what do you say? Partners?
translation: 来吧...你说什么？合作伙伴？ [lai ba ... ni shuo shen me ？ he zuo huo ban ？]

english: (presumably the same as the previous help him text)
translation: （大概和之前的帮助他的文字一样） [（ da gai he zhi qian de bang zhu ta de wen zi yi yang ）]

english: I don't trust anything about your little scheme, including you! I want nothing to do with this!
translation: 我不相信你的小阴谋，包括你！我不想和这件事有任何关系！ [wo bu xiang xin ni de xiao yin mou ， bao kuo ni ！ wo bu xiang he zhe jian shi you ren he guan xi ！]

english: Eh, you'll come running back when you realise just how much money we could be talking here.
translation: 呃，当你意识到我们在这里可以谈论多少钱时，你就会跑回来。 [e ， dang ni yi shi dao wo men zai zhe li ke yi tan lun duo shao qian shi ， ni jiu hui pao hui lai 。]

english: I'll see you again when you come crawling back, begging to be cut in on the deal.
translation: 当你爬回来乞求加入这笔交易时，我会再次见到你。 [dang ni pa hui lai qi qiu jia ru zhe bi jiao yi shi ， wo hui zai ci jian dao ni 。]

english: Hello again. You find any signs of that treasure yet?
translation: 又好。你找到那个宝藏的任何迹象了吗？ [you hao 。 ni zhao dao na ge bao zang de ren he ji xiang le ma ？]

english: Not yet...
translation: 还没有... [hai mei you ...]

english: Well, head south to that bandit camp. I bet if there's anything out here, they'll know about it.
translation: 好吧，向南前往那个强盗营地。我敢打赌，如果这里有什么事情，他们一定会知道的。 [hao ba ， xiang nan qian wang na ge qiang dao ying di 。 wo gan da du ， ru guo zhe li you shen me shi qing ， ta men yi ding hui zhi dao de 。]

english: Don't let on it might be valuable though! Those thieves will steal it as soon as look at you!
translation: 但不要让它可能很有价值！那些小偷一看你就偷了！ [dan bu yao rang ta ke neng hen you jia zhi ！ na xie xiao tou yi kan ni jiu tou le ！]

english: Well... not as such, but I unleashed a powerful demon from its tomb in return for unbelievable magical power.
translation: 嗯……不是这样的，但我从坟墓中释放了一个强大的恶魔，以换取令人难以置信的魔法力量。 [n …… bu shi zhe yang de ， dan wo cong fen mu zhong shi fang le yi ge qiang da de e mo ， yi huan qu ling ren nan yi zhi xin de mo fa li liang 。]

english: So... no gold then?
translation: 那么...没有金币了吗？ [na me ... mei you jin bi le ma ？]

english: Not as such, no. Sorry about that.
translation: 不是这样的，不。对此感到抱歉。 [bu shi zhe yang de ， bu 。 dui ci gan dao bao qian 。]

english: Aw... I was hoping to go abroad on holiday this year.
translation: 噢...我本来希望今年能出国度假。 [o ... wo ben lai xi wang jin nian neng chu guo du jia 。]

english: Maybe I'll go check out Karamja next, I hear there's treasure to be found there...
translation: 也许我接下来会去Karamja看看，我听说那里可以找到宝藏...... [ye xu wo jie xia lai hui qu Karamja kan kan ， wo ting shuo na li ke yi zhao dao bao zang ......]

english: I was wondering...
translation: 我想知道... [wo xiang zhi dao ...]

english: As you are a big famous archaeologist, maybe you could spare the time to tell me a couple of tales of your exploits?
translation: 您是一位著名的考古学家，也许您能抽出时间给我讲几个您的丰功伟绩的故事？ [nin shi yi wei zhu ming de kao gu xue jia ， ye xu nin neng chou chu shi jian gei wo jiang ji ge nin de feng gong wei ji de gu shi ？]

english: Hey, sure thing kid! Well, this one time I found this spooky old temple in the middle of the jungle.
translation: 嘿，当然啦，孩子！好吧，这一次我在丛林中发现了这座令人毛骨悚然的古老寺庙。 [hei ， dang ran la ， hai zi ！ hao ba ， zhe yi ci wo zai cong lin zhong fa xian le zhe zuo ling ren mao gu song ran de gu lao si miao 。]

english: The entrance was hidden from sight by all these vines and stuff, and it was full of zombies and crazy tribesmen and stuff.
translation: 入口被所有这些藤蔓之类的东西遮住了，而且里面充满了僵尸和疯狂的部落居民之类的东西。 [ru kou bei suo you zhe xie teng wan zhi lei de dong xi zhe zhu le ， er qie li mian chong man le jiang shi he feng kuang de bu luo ju min zhi lei de dong xi 。]

english: That wasn't the worst thing though! There were all these crazy traps that were hidden around the place too!
translation: 但这还不是最糟糕的事情！周围还隐藏着各种疯狂的陷阱！ [dan zhe hai bu shi zui zao gao de shi qing ！ zhou wei hai yin cang zhe ge zhong feng kuang de xian jing ！]

english: Well anyway, I found the secret entrance, fought my way in through the zombies and tribesmen, and came to a big pedestal with a statue of solid gold sat on top of it!
translation: 好吧，无论如何，我找到了秘密入口，从僵尸和部落成员中杀出一条血路，来到一个大基座前，上面坐着一尊纯金雕像！ [hao ba ， wu lun ru he ， wo zhao dao le mi mi ru kou ， cong jiang shi he bu luo cheng yuan zhong sha chu yi tiao xue lu ， lai dao yi ge da ji zuo qian ， shang mian zuo zhe yi zun chun jin diao xiang ！]

english: Solid gold, huh? Wow.
translation: 纯金吧？哇。 [chun jin ba ？ wa 。]

english: That's right! It was a cunning trap though! As soon as I picked up the statue, a trapdoor opened up underneath me, and I fell into a darkened room, full of
translation: 这是正确的！但这是一个狡猾的陷阱！当我拿起雕像时，我脚下的活板门打开了，我掉进了一个黑暗的房间，里面充满了 [zhe shi zheng que de ！ dan zhe shi yi ge jiao hua de xian jing ！ dang wo na qi diao xiang shi ， wo jiao xia de huo ban men da kai le ， wo diao jin le yi ge hei an de fang jian ， li mian chong man le]

english: bones, and the biggest meanest tribesman you ever did see!
translation: 骨头，还有你见过的最大最卑鄙的部落成员！ [gu tou ， hai you ni jian guo de zui da zui bei bi de bu luo cheng yuan ！]

english: Huge he was, and real ugly looking! He had this huge sword too, and he came running towards me screaming something in some language I didn't understand!
translation: 他个头很大，而且长得真的很丑！他也有这把巨大的剑，他向我跑来，用我听不懂的语言尖叫着什么！ [ta ge tou hen da ， er qie zhang de zhen de hen chou ！ ta ye you zhe ba ju da de jian ， ta xiang wo pao lai ， yong wo ting bu dong de yu yan jian jiao zhe shen me ！]

english: What did you do?
translation: 你做了什么？ [ni zuo le shen me ？]

english: Well, while he was screaming at me, and swinging his sword around in front of me, trying to intimidate me before attacking, I cooly and calmly...
translation: 好吧，当他对我大喊大叫，并在我面前挥舞着剑，试图在攻击前威吓我时，我却冷静而冷静…… [hao ba ， dang ta dui wo da han da jiao ， bing zai wo mian qian hui wu zhe jian ， shi tu zai gong ji qian wei he wo shi ， wo que leng jing er leng jing ……]

english: Yes?
translation: 是的？ [shi de ？]

english: All the while, knowing that if I died in this spot nobody would even know where I was...
translation: 一直以来，我都知道如果我死在这个地方，没有人会知道我在哪里...... [yi zhi yi lai ， wo dou zhi dao ru guo wo si zai zhe ge di fang ， mei you ren hui zhi dao wo zai na li ......]

english: What then?
translation: 然后呢？ [ran hou ne ？]

english: I knew, if this tribesman killed me, that would be the end of Asgarnia Smith, and all of his treasure hunting...
translation: 我知道，如果这个部落成员杀了我，阿斯加尼亚·史密斯以及他所有的寻宝活动就会结束…… [wo zhi dao ， ru guo zhe ge bu luo cheng yuan sha le wo ， a si jia ni ya · shi mi si yi ji ta suo you de xun bao huo dong jiu hui jie shu ……]

english: SO WHAT DID YOU DO?!?!
translation: 那么你做了什么？！？！ [na me ni zuo le shen me ？！？！]

english: Well, while he was screaming and waving his sword around, I stood behind a nearby stalactite, then shot him with my shortbow.
translation: 好吧，当他尖叫着挥舞着剑时，我站在附近的钟乳石后面，然后用我的短弓射杀了他。 [hao ba ， dang ta jian jiao zhe hui wu zhe jian shi ， wo zhan zai fu jin de zhong ru shi hou mian ， ran hou yong wo de duan gong she sha le ta 。]

english: And that was how I recovered the Golden Monkey of Tee-Ta-Toh.
translation: 这就是我恢复提达托金猴的方法。 [zhe jiu shi wo hui fu ti da tuo jin hou de fang fa 。]

english: So... How exactly did you get into this line of work anyway?
translation: 那么...您究竟是如何进入这一行的呢？ [na me ... nin jiu jing shi ru he jin ru zhe yi xing de ne ？]

english: It seems an odd choice of career for a man like yourself.
translation: 对于像你这样的人来说，这似乎是一个奇怪的职业选择。 [dui yu xiang ni zhe yang de ren lai shuo ， zhe si hu shi yi ge qi guai de zhi ye xuan ze 。]

english: Thinking of joining your pal Asgarnia in the wonderful world of treasure hun- um, archaeology, huh?
translation: 想和你的朋友阿斯加尼亚一起进入奇妙的宝藏世界、考古世界吗？ [xiang he ni de peng you a si jia ni ya yi qi jin ru qi miao de bao zang shi jie 、 kao gu shi jie ma ？]

english: Well, it all started the day I was fishing in catherby, funnily enough.
translation: 好吧，这一切都是从我在凯瑟比钓鱼的那天开始的，有趣的是。 [hao ba ， zhe yi qie dou shi cong wo zai kai se bi diao yu de na tian kai shi de ， you qu de shi 。]

english: Ah yes, I remember it well... I was just sat there, hoping to catch a bass or two, when I made the most amazing discovery!
translation: 啊，是的，我记得很清楚......我只是坐在那里，希望能钓到一两条鲈鱼，这时我有了最惊人的发现！ [a ， shi de ， wo ji de hen qing chu ...... wo zhi shi zuo zai na li ， xi wang neng diao dao yi liang tiao lu yu ， zhe shi wo you le zui jing ren de fa xian ！]

english: In my fishing nets, I had found an ancient casket, marred and worn by centuries underwater!
translation: 在我的渔网中，我发现了一个古老的棺材，在水下几个世纪的时间里已经被损坏和磨损了！ [zai wo de yu wang zhong ， wo fa xian le yi ge gu lao de guan cai ， zai shui xia ji ge shi ji de shi jian li yi jing bei sun huai he mo sun le ！]

english: With trembling hands, I slowly and cautiously opened it, wondering what ancient secret may have been kept inside...
translation: 我用颤抖的双手，慢慢地、小心翼翼地打开它，想知道里面到底藏着什么古老的秘密…… [wo yong chan dou de shuang shou ， man man di 、 xiao xin yi yi di da kai ta ， xiang zhi dao li mian dao di cang zhe shen me gu lao de mi mi ……]

english: What valuable heirloom may have been dredged up by my nets that had not decayed underwater long ago...
translation: 我的网早就在水下没腐烂了，可能挖出了什么珍贵的传家宝…… [wo de wang zao jiu zai shui xia mei fu lan le ， ke neng wa chu le shen me zhen gui de chuan jia bao ……]

english: And you know what I found inside?
translation: 你知道我在里面发现了什么吗？ [ni zhi dao wo zai li mian fa xian le shen me ma ？]

english: No, what?
translation: 不，什么？ [bu ， shen me ？]

english: I found 320 coins! Just like that! Just by fishing I had found 320 coins! 320 coins! Can you believe it?
translation: 我找到了320个金币！就这样！光是钓鱼我就发现了320枚金币！ 320金币！你能相信吗？ [wo zhao dao le 320 ge jin bi ！ jiu zhe yang ！ guang shi diao yu wo jiu fa xian le 320 mei jin bi ！ 320 jin bi ！ ni neng xiang xin ma ？]

english: Um... Yes, yes I can.
translation: 嗯...是的，是的，我可以。 [n ... shi de ， shi de ， wo ke yi 。]

english: Well, it might not seem much to us now kid, but back then, it was a revelation!
translation: 好吧，孩子，现在对我们来说可能没什么大不了的，但在当时，这是一个启示！ [hao ba ， hai zi ， xian zai dui wo men lai shuo ke neng mei shen me da bu liao de ， dan zai dang shi ， zhe shi yi ge qi shi ！]

english: Why waste my time fishing when there were secret treasures from long ago hidden around the world?
translation: 当世界各地都隐藏着很久以前的秘密宝藏时，为什么还要浪费时间去钓鱼呢？ [dang shi jie ge di dou yin cang zhe hen jiu yi qian de mi mi bao zang shi ， wei shen me hai yao lang fei shi jian qu diao yu ne ？]

english: I immediately applied to the Museum of Varrock as a field agent, and the rest is history!
translation: 我立即向瓦罗克博物馆申请担任外勤特工，剩下的就是历史了！ [wo li ji xiang wa luo ke bo wu guan shen qing dan ren wai qin te gong ， sheng xia de jiu shi li shi le ！]

english: Nice hat!
translation: 帽子不错！ [mao zi bu cuo ！]

english: Hey, thanks kid. Looking snazzy is an important part of being a treasure hunter!
translation: 嘿，谢谢孩子。看起来时髦是成为宝藏猎人的重要组成部分！ [hei ， xie xie hai zi 。 kan qi lai shi mao shi cheng wei bao zang lie ren de zhong yao zu cheng bu fen ！]

english: Well, I'll see you again sometime maybe. Sorry I couldn't get you any treasure...
translation: 好吧，也许有一天我会再次见到你。抱歉没能给你任何宝藏…… [hao ba ， ye xu you yi tian wo hui zai ci jian dao ni 。 bao qian mei neng gei ni ren he bao zang ……]

english: Ah, don't sweat it kid. I'll be honest with ya - I'm already rich many times over, and its more the kicks of being a treasure hunter I do it for than the actual cash!
translation: 啊，别担心孩子。老实说，我已经富有很多倍了，我这样做更多的是为了成为一名宝藏猎人，而不是为了真正的现金！ [a ， bie dan xin hai zi 。 lao shi shuo ， wo yi jing fu you hen duo bei le ， wo zhe yang zuo geng duo de shi wei le cheng wei yi ming bao zang lie ren ， er bu shi wei le zhen zheng de xian jin ！]

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Do you have any quests?
translation: 你有什么任务吗？ [ni you shen me ren wu ma ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Nothing really.
translation: 真的没什么。 [zhen de mei shen me 。]

english: Read book
translation: 看书 [kan shu]

english: Don't read book
translation: 不看书 [bu kan shu]

english: Help him
translation: 帮助他 [bang zhu ta]

english: Don't help him
translation: 别帮他 [bie bang ta]

english: Tell me of your adventures
translation: 告诉我你的冒险经历 [gao su wo ni de mao xian jing li]

english: Tell me how you became an Archaeologist
translation: 告诉我你是如何成为一名考古学家的 [gao su wo ni shi ru he cheng wei yi ming kao gu xue jia de]

english: Nice hat!
translation: 帽子不错！ [mao zi bu cuo ！]

english: See you later...
translation: 稍后见... [shao hou jian ...]

english: Dung cook human.
translation: 粪煮人。 [fen zhu ren 。]

english: Ash eat human.
translation: 灰吃人。 [hui chi ren 。]

english: Dung will fry human.
translation: 粪会煎人。 [fen hui jian ren 。]

english: Dung is wrong!
translation: 粪错了！ [fen cuo le ！]

english: My brother in stronghold best cook.
translation: 我哥哥在据点里最好的厨师。 [wo ge ge zai ju dian li zui hao de chu shi 。]

english: Ash will boil human 'till it tender.
translation: 灰烬会将人煮至变软。 [hui jin hui jiang ren zhu zhi bian ruan 。]

english: Much more tasty.
translation: 好吃多了。 [hao chi duo le 。]

english: Ash will not cook human!
translation: 灰烬不会煮人！ [hui jin bu hui zhu ren ！]

english: Ash will boil!
translation: 灰会沸腾！ [hui hui fei teng ！]

english: Dung will boil Ash's head!
translation: 粪便会煮阿什的头！ [fen bian hui zhu a shen de tou ！]

english: Boil better!
translation: 煮一下更好！ [zhu yi xia geng hao ！]

english: Fry better!
translation: 煎一下更好吃！ [jian yi xia geng hao chi ！]

english: Boil!
translation: 熬！ [ao ！]

english: Fry!
translation: 炒！ [chao ！]

english: Ow!
Ugh!
Dung not hit Ash!
translation: 粪不打灰！ [fen bu da hui ！]

english: Ow!
Ouch!
translation: 哎哟! [ai yo !]

english: Dung hate Ash!
translation: 粪讨厌阿什！ [fen tao yan a shen ！]

english: Ash hate Dung!
translation: 阿什讨厌阿粪！ [a shen tao yan a fen ！]

english: Excuse me...
translation: 打扰一下... [da rao yi xia ...]

english: What is it?
translation: 它是什么？ [ta shi shen me ？]

english: Thank you for finding my tools for me. Did you find everyone's belongings?
translation: 感谢您为我找到了工具。大家的财物都找到了吗？ [gan xie nin wei wo zhao dao le gong ju 。 da jia de cai wu dou zhao dao le ma ？]

english: I did! Thank you for the reward.
translation: 我做到了！谢谢你的奖励。 [wo zuo dao le ！ xie xie ni de jiang li 。]

english: You're more than welcome to it, for getting our belongings back.
translation: 非常欢迎你来取回我们的东西。 [fei chang huan ying ni lai qu hui wo men de dong xi 。]

english: Can you tell me how the kingdom approves of me?
translation: 你能告诉我王国对我的认可度如何吗？ [ni neng gao su wo wang guo dui wo de ren ke du ru he ma ？]

english: [amount]% of people approve of you.
translation: [数量]％的人赞同你。 [[ shu liang ]％ de ren zan tong ni 。]

english: Hello? Who are you? What is this place?
translation: 你好？你是谁？这是什么地方？ [ni hao ？ ni shi shui ？ zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: I'm... Ashuelot... Ashuelot Reis. But I don't understand... How are you here?
translation: 我是……阿舒洛特……阿舒洛特·雷斯。但我不明白...你怎么在这里？ [wo shi …… a shu luo te …… a shu luo te · lei si 。 dan wo bu ming bai ... ni zen me zai zhe li ？]

english: Oh... Well I'm [player name], and I'm here because I was told there was a great treasure to be found.
translation: 哦...好吧，我是[玩家名字]，我来这里是因为有人告诉我有一个伟大的宝藏有待发现。 [o ... hao ba ， wo shi [ wan jia ming zi ]， wo lai zhe li shi yin wei you ren gao su wo you yi ge wei da de bao zang you dai fa xian 。]

english: Treasure? I fear you have been misled. There is no treasure here, only our great mistake.
translation: 宝藏？我担心你被误导了。这里没有宝藏，只有我们的巨大错误。 [bao zang ？ wo dan xin ni bei wu dao le 。 zhe li mei you bao zang ， zhi you wo men de ju da cuo wu 。]

english: Mistake?
translation: 错误？ [cuo wu ？]

english: This place is a prison. Here, a being of incomprehensible power was sealed away. Things would have stayed that way, if not for our foolishness.
translation: 这个地方是监狱。这里，封印着一个有着难以理解的力量的存在。如果不是因为我们的愚蠢，事情就会一直这样下去。 [zhe ge di fang shi jian yu 。 zhe li ， feng yin zhe yi ge you zhe nan yi li jie de li liang de cun zai 。 ru guo bu shi yin wei wo men de yu chun ， shi qing jiu hui yi zhi zhe yang xia qu 。]

english: What happened?
translation: 发生了什么？ [fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: We thought we were doing good, but we were led astray. We opened the prison, and unleashed the horror within.
translation: 我们以为自己做得很好，但结果却误入歧途。我们打开了监狱，释放了里面的恐怖。 [wo men yi wei zi ji zuo de hen hao ， dan jie guo que wu ru qi tu 。 wo men da kai le jian yu ， shi fang le li mian de kong bu 。]

english: But the door was locked until I came along.
translation: 但直到我进来之前门都是锁着的。 [dan zhi dao wo jin lai zhi qian men dou shi suo zhe de 。]

english: Yes... After our great mistake, four opposing armies united to contain the evil again. They managed to reseal the prison, but they were unable to repair the original enchantments.
translation: 是的……在我们的大错之后，四支敌对的军队再次联合起来遏制邪恶。他们成功地重新封印了监狱，但却无法修复原本的结界。 [shi de …… zai wo men de da cuo zhi hou ， si zhi di dui de jun dui zai ci lian he qi lai e zhi xie e 。 ta men cheng gong di chong xin feng yin le jian yu ， dan que wu fa xiu fu yuan ben de jie jie 。]

english: This place has remained vulnerable ever since.
translation: 从那时起，这个地方就一直很脆弱。 [cong na shi qi ， zhe ge di fang jiu yi zhi hen cui ruo 。]

english: And now I've opened it again.
translation: 现在我又打开了它。 [xian zai wo you da kai le ta 。]

english: If what you've told me is true, you were fooled just as we were. But I suppose that means little now. With the prison now open again, there isn't much to prevent the evil escaping once more.
translation: 如果你告诉我的是真的，那你就和我们一样被愚弄了。但我想这现在意义不大了。随着监狱再次开放，没有什么可以阻止邪恶再次逃脱。 [ru guo ni gao su wo de shi zhen de ， na ni jiu he wo men yi yang bei yu nong le 。 dan wo xiang zhe xian zai yi yi bu da le 。 sui zhe jian yu zai ci kai fang ， mei you shen me ke yi zu zhi xie e zai ci tao tuo 。]

english: There must be something I can do to stop it.
translation: 我必须做点什么来阻止它。 [wo bi xu zuo dian shen me lai zu zhi ta 。]

english: There is only one thing you can do. You can fight.
translation: 您只能做一件事。你可以战斗。 [nin zhi neng zuo yi jian shi 。 ni ke yi zhan dou 。]

english: Then that is what I will do.
translation: 那么这就是我要做的。 [na me zhe jiu shi wo yao zuo de 。]

english: Though, now that I think about it, I'm still not overly clear what this evil is.
translation: 不过现在想想，我还是不太清楚这个恶到底是什么。 [bu guo xian zai xiang xiang ， wo hai shi bu tai qing chu zhe ge e dao di shi shen me 。]

english: She is a being of darkness. A servant of the Ruinous Powers. She is the Angel of Death. She is Nex.
translation: 她是黑暗的存在。毁灭之力的仆人。她是死亡天使。她是内克斯。 [ta shi hei an de cun zai 。 hui mie zhi li de pu ren 。 ta shi si wang tian shi 。 ta shi nei ke si 。]

english: I'll stop her.
translation: 我会阻止她。 [wo hui zu zhi ta 。]

english: I hope so. Nex can be found in the inner section of the prison. Join me there. But be warned, Nex was not imprisoned alone. You'll need to fight through her followers to reach her.
translation: 我希望如此。 Nex 可以在监狱的内部找到。和我一起去那里。但请注意，内克斯并不是单独被监禁的。你需要与她的追随者战斗才能接近她。 [wo xi wang ru ci 。 Nex  ke yi zai jian yu de nei bu zhao dao 。 he wo yi qi qu na li 。 dan qing zhu yi ， nei ke si bing bu shi dan du bei jian jin de 。 ni xu yao yu ta de zhui sui zhe zhan dou cai neng jie jin ta 。]

english: Good luck.
translation: 祝你好运。 [zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: You made it?
translation: 你做到了吗？ [ni zuo dao le ma ？]

english: You didn't think I would?
translation: 你以为我不会？ [ni yi wei wo bu hui ？]

english: Nex's followers are capable of bringing down even the strongest of warriors. I did fear you might not make it past them.
translation: 奈克斯的追随者甚至能够击倒最强大的战士。我确实担心你可能无法通过他们。 [nai ke si de zhui sui zhe shen zhi neng gou ji dao zui qiang da de zhan shi 。 wo que shi dan xin ni ke neng wu fa tong guo ta men 。]

english: Still, they are nothing compared to the Angel of Death herself.
translation: 然而，与死亡天使本人相比，他们根本算不了什么。 [ran er ， yu si wang tian shi ben ren xiang bi ， ta men gen ben suan bu liao shen me 。]

english: So how do I deal with her?
translation: 那我该怎么对付她呢？ [na wo gai zen me dui fu ta ne ？]

english: You will never be able to truly defeat her. The best you can do is to try and keep her contained. When you are ready to face her, just go through the barrier.
translation: 你永远无法真正打败她。你能做的最好的事情就是尽量控制住她。当你准备好面对她时，只要穿过屏障即可。 [ni yong yuan wu fa zhen zheng da bai ta 。 ni neng zuo de zui hao de shi qing jiu shi jin liang kong zhi zhu ta 。 dang ni zhun bei hao mian dui ta shi ， zhi yao chuan guo ping zhang ji ke 。]

english: If it helps, while my magic is limited here, I should still be able to transfer items in and out of the prison for you. Let me know if you'd like me to do this before you enter.
translation: 如果有帮助的话，虽然我的魔力在这里有限，但我应该还是可以为你将物品进出监狱的。如果您希望我在您进入之前执行此操作，请告诉我。 [ru guo you bang zhu de hua ， sui ran wo de mo li zai zhe li you xian ， dan wo ying gai hai shi ke yi wei ni jiang wu pin jin chu jian yu de 。 ru guo nin xi wang wo zai nin jin ru zhi qian zhi xing ci cao zuo ， qing gao su wo 。]

english: Tell me more about Nex.
translation: 告诉我更多关于 Nex 的信息。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu  Nex  de xin xi 。]

english: Long ago, these lands were dominated by a great empire, ruled over by an ancient god. The Empty Lord is what they often called him, but his true name was Zaros.
translation: 很久以前，这些土地由一个伟大的帝国统治，由一位古老的神统治。人们常称他为“空之主”，但他的真名是扎罗斯。 [hen jiu yi qian ， zhe xie tu di you yi ge wei da de di guo tong zhi ， you yi wei gu lao de shen tong zhi 。 ren men chang cheng ta wei “ kong zhi zhu ”， dan ta de zhen ming shi zha luo si 。]

english: Zaros? I've heard of him.
translation: 扎罗斯？我听说过他。 [zha luo si ？ wo ting shuo guo ta 。]

english: At the height of his power, Zaros seemed untouchable, but he was eventually defeated by those he trusted the most. With him gone, the empire collapsed. War broke out soon after.
translation: 在权力的鼎盛时期，扎罗斯看似不可撼动，但他最终还是被他最信任的人击败了。他一走，帝国就崩溃了。战争不久之后爆发。 [zai quan li de ding sheng shi qi ， zha luo si kan shi bu ke han dong ， dan ta zui zhong hai shi bei ta zui xin ren de ren ji bai le 。 ta yi zou ， di guo jiu beng kui le 。 zhan zheng bu jiu zhi hou bao fa 。]

english: Although their god was gone, many Zarosians fought to keep his empire alive. Among them was Nex. She was Zaros' most powerful weapon, and she led a great army to try and restore his empire.
translation: 尽管他们的神已经去世，但许多扎罗西亚人仍为维持他的帝国的生存而奋斗。其中就有内克斯。她是扎罗斯最强大的武器，她率领一支伟大的军队试图恢复他的帝国。 [jin guan ta men de shen yi jing qu shi ， dan xu duo zha luo xi ya ren reng wei wei chi ta de di guo de sheng cun er fen dou 。 qi zhong jiu you nei ke si 。 ta shi zha luo si zui qiang da de wu qi ， ta shuai ling yi zhi wei da de jun dui shi tu hui fu ta de di guo 。]

english: Not that she needed an army of course. Nex alone was powerful enough to hold back hundreds of lesser beings.
translation: 当然，她并不需要一支军队。仅奈克斯的力量就足以抵挡数百只低等生物。 [dang ran ， ta bing bu xu yao yi zhi jun dui 。 jin nai ke si de li liang jiu zu yi di dang shu bai zhi di deng sheng wu 。]

english: So how did she end up here?
translation: 那么她是怎么到这里的呢？ [na me ta shi zen me dao zhe li de ne ？]

english: The forces of Saradomin knew that Nex needed to be dealt with. They were able to lure her into these caverns.
translation: 萨拉多明的势力知道需要对付奈克斯。他们能够引诱她进入这些洞穴。 [sa la duo ming de shi li zhi dao xu yao dui fu nai ke si 。 ta men neng gou yin you ta jin ru zhe xie dong xue 。]

english: After great effort and sacrifice, they managed to place Nex and her followers into a frozen, enchanted sleep.
translation: 经过巨大的努力和牺牲，他们成功地让内克斯和她的追随者进入了冰冷、迷人的睡眠。 [jing guo ju da de nu li he xi sheng ， ta men cheng gong di rang nei ke si he ta de zhui sui zhe jin ru le bing leng 、 mi ren de shui mian 。]

english: Once Nex was no longer an immediate threat, they built the Temple of Lost Ancients around her. Most of the temple has since fallen to ruin, but you can still see some of the remains.
translation: 一旦奈克斯不再是直接威胁，他们就在她周围建造了失落古人神庙。寺庙的大部分已成为废墟，但您仍然可以看到一些遗迹。 [yi dan nai ke si bu zai shi zhi jie wei xie ， ta men jiu zai ta zhou wei jian zao le shi luo gu ren shen miao 。 si miao de da bu fen yi cheng wei fei xu ， dan nin reng ran ke yi kan dao yi xie yi ji 。]

english: But she wasn't frozen forever, was she? You said you were fooled into freeing her.
translation: 但她并没有永远被冻结，不是吗？你说你被愚弄了才释放了她。 [dan ta bing mei you yong yuan bei dong jie ， bu shi ma ？ ni shuo ni bei yu nong le cai shi fang le ta 。]

english: Yes. Later in the war, a great battle broke out in the Temple of Lost Ancients. I was a Saradominist soldier at the time, and I was among those who fought for him in that battle.
translation: 是的。战争后期，失落远古神殿爆发了一场大战。当时我是一名萨拉多米主义士兵，我也是在那场战斗中为他而战的人之一。 [shi de 。 zhan zheng hou qi ， shi luo yuan gu shen dian bao fa le yi chang da zhan 。 dang shi wo shi yi ming sa la duo mi zhu yi shi bing ， wo ye shi zai na chang zhan dou zhong wei ta er zhan de ren zhi yi 。]

english: By then, many of us had grown tired of war. One of our priests discovered this. He came to us and revealed that he felt the same way, and that he had secretly converted to Guthix. He encouraged us to join him.
translation: 那时，我们许多人已经厌倦了战争。我们的一位牧师发现了这一点。他来找我们并透露他也有同样的感觉，并且他已经秘密皈依了古蒂克斯。他鼓励我们加入他。 [na shi ， wo men xu duo ren yi jing yan juan le zhan zheng 。 wo men de yi wei mu shi fa xian le zhe yi dian 。 ta lai zhao wo men bing tou lu ta ye you tong yang de gan jue ， bing qie ta yi jing mi mi gui yi le gu di ke si 。 ta gu li wo men jia ru ta 。]

english: We abandoned the cause of Saradomin and became followers of Guthix. Our new leader taught us the ways of the druids, including an ancient ritual that had the power to awaken Guthix himself.
translation: 我们放弃了萨拉多明的事业，成为了古蒂克斯的追随者。我们的新领袖向我们传授了德鲁伊之道，其中包括一种能够唤醒古西克斯本人的古老仪式。 [wo men fang qi le sa la duo ming de shi ye ， cheng wei le gu di ke si de zhui sui zhe 。 wo men de xin ling xiu xiang wo men chuan shou le de lu yi zhi dao ， qi zhong bao kuo yi zhong neng gou huan xing gu xi ke si ben ren de gu lao yi shi 。]

english: We believed this ritual to be the only way to end the war.
translation: 我们相信这个仪式是结束战争的唯一方法。 [wo men xiang xin zhe ge yi shi shi jie shu zhan zheng de wei yi fang fa 。]

english: But I'm guessing that's not how things went?
translation: 但我猜事情并非如此？ [dan wo cai shi qing bing fei ru ci ？]

english: No... When our leader led us to perform the ritual, it was not Guthix we woke, but Nex and her forces. The ritual also destroyed the protective enchantments on their prison.
translation: 不……当我们的领袖带领我们进行仪式时，我们醒来的不是古蒂克斯，而是奈克斯和她的部队。该仪式还摧毁了监狱上的保护结界。 [bu …… dang wo men de ling xiu dai ling wo men jin xing yi shi shi ， wo men xing lai de bu shi gu di ke si ， er shi nai ke si he ta de bu dui 。 gai yi shi hai cui hui le jian yu shang de bao hu jie jie 。]

english: And that was exactly what your leader wanted?
translation: 这正是你们的领导想要的吗？ [zhe zheng shi ni men de ling dao xiang yao de ma ？]

english: It was. He had never been a follower of Guthix, or Saradomin. His real goal had always been to free Nex.
translation: 是的。他从来都不是古西克斯或萨拉多明的追随者。他真正的目标始终是释放内克斯。 [shi de 。 ta cong lai dou bu shi gu xi ke si huo sa la duo ming de zhui sui zhe 。 ta zhen zheng de mu biao shi zhong shi shi fang nei ke si 。]

english: The rest is as I already told you. Nex posed such a danger, that the four armies temorarily joined forces to drive her back into the prison. They resealed it, but were unable to fix the enchantments we destroyed.
translation: 其余的就如我已经告诉过你的那样。奈克斯的危险如此之大，四军暂时联手将她赶回监狱。他们重新密封了它，但无法修复我们摧毁的结界。 [qi yu de jiu ru wo yi jing gao su guo ni de na yang 。 nai ke si de wei xian ru ci zhi da ， si jun zan shi lian shou jiang ta gan hui jian yu 。 ta men chong xin mi feng le ta ， dan wu fa xiu fu wo men cui hui de jie jie 。]

english: As for me, I was one of the first to fall after Nex was freed, but I didn't truly die. Something about our ritual tied me to this place. I've been trapped here ever since. Not dead, but not really alive either.
translation: 至于我，我是Nex被释放后最先倒下的人之一，但我并没有真正死掉。我们的仪式中的某些东西将我与这个地方联系在一起。从那时起我就被困在这里了。没有死，但也不是真正活着。 [zhi yu wo ， wo shi Nex bei shi fang hou zui xian dao xia de ren zhi yi ， dan wo bing mei you zhen zheng si diao 。 wo men de yi shi zhong de mou xie dong xi jiang wo yu zhe ge di fang lian xi zai yi qi 。 cong na shi qi wo jiu bei kun zai zhe li le 。 mei you si ， dan ye bu shi zhen zheng huo zhe 。]

english: I'm sorry.
translation: 对不起。 [dui bu qi 。]

english: Don't be. This is the punishment for my sins.
translation: 别这样。这是对我罪孽的惩罚。 [bie zhe yang 。 zhe shi dui wo zui nie de cheng fa 。]

english: What of the one that led the ritual. What came of him?
translation: 主持仪式的人又如何呢？他怎么了？ [zhu chi yi shi de ren you ru he ne ？ ta zen me le ？]

english: He'd achieved his goal, so he left. I never saw him again.
translation: 他的目的已经达到了，所以他就离开了。我再也没有见过他。 [ta de mu di yi jing da dao le ， suo yi ta jiu li kai le 。 wo zai ye mei you jian guo ta 。]

english: But who was he really?
translation: 但他到底是谁？ [dan ta dao di shi shui ？]

english: He never gave us his true name, but as Nex was freed, she spoke to him.
translation: 他从未向我们透露过他的真实姓名，但当内克斯获释后，她和他说话了。 [ta cong wei xiang wo men tou lu guo ta de zhen shi xing ming ， dan dang nei ke si huo shi hou ， ta he ta shuo hua le 。]

english: She knew him?
translation: 她认识他？ [ta ren shi ta ？]

english: It seemed that way. I heard little of what they said, but I did hear what she called him.
translation: 看起来是这样。我很少听到他们说的话，但我确实听到了她对他的称呼。 [kan qi lai shi zhe yang 。 wo hen shao ting dao ta men shuo de hua ， dan wo que shi ting dao le ta dui ta de cheng hu 。]

english: What was it?
translation: 那是什么？ [na shi shen me ？]

english: Sliske.
translation: 斯利斯克。 [si li si ke 。]

english: Forgive me, but this conversation has brought back many memories. Let us speak no more of this.
translation: 请原谅我，但这次谈话勾起了我很多回忆。这个我们就不再多说了。 [qing yuan liang wo ， dan zhe ci tan hua gou qi le wo hen duo hui yi 。 zhe ge wo men jiu bu zai duo shuo le 。]

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: Can I access my bank?
translation: 我可以访问我的银行吗？ [wo ke yi fang wen wo de yin hang ma ？]

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: I'd like to collect some items.
translation: 我想收集一些物品。 [wo xiang shou ji yi xie wu pin 。]

english: I need to go.
translation: 我需要去。 [wo xu yao qu 。]

english: Good luck out there.
translation: 祝你好运。 [zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Tell me more about Nex.
translation: 告诉我更多关于 Nex 的信息。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu  Nex  de xin xi 。]

english: Can I access my bank?
translation: 我可以访问我的银行吗？ [wo ke yi fang wen wo de yin hang ma ？]

english: I'd like to collect some items.
translation: 我想收集一些物品。 [wo xiang shou ji yi xie wu pin 。]

english: I need to go.
translation: 我需要去。 [wo xu yao qu 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Hey there, buddy. You're an outerlander, huh? I'm not really supposed to talk to you.
translation: 嘿，伙计。你是外地人吧？我真的不应该和你说话。 [hei ， huo ji 。 ni shi wai di ren ba ？ wo zhen de bu ying gai he ni shuo hua 。]

english: Why not?
translation: 为什么不呢？ [wei shen me bu ne ？]

english: I dunno buddy. Some stupid tradition or other. We're always told not to talk to outerlanders unless the Chieftain has allowed it.
translation: 我不知道伙计。一些愚蠢的传统或其他。我们总是被告知不要与外地人交谈，除非酋长允许。 [wo bu zhi dao huo ji 。 yi xie yu chun de chuan tong huo qi ta 。 wo men zong shi bei gao zhi bu yao yu wai di ren jiao tan ， chu fei qiu zhang yun xu 。]

english: The Chieftain? Who is that?
translation: 酋长？那是谁？ [qiu zhang ？ na shi shui ？]

english: His names Brundt, buddy. He's a real boring guy. You can find him in the longhall there.
translation: 他的名字叫布伦特，伙计。他真是个无聊的家伙。你可以在那儿的长廊里找到他。 [ta de ming zi jiao bu lun te ， huo ji 。 ta zhen shi ge wu liao de jia huo 。 ni ke yi zai na er de chang lang li zhao dao ta 。]

english: Can you take me to see him?
translation: 你能带我去见他吗？ [ni neng dai wo qu jian ta ma ？]

english: Sorry buddy, I'm not allowed into the Longhall. Don't worry, he's easy to spot. He's the one in the fancy helmet. Oh, and he only has one eye.
translation: 抱歉，伙计，我不被允许进入朗厅。别担心，他很容易被发现。他就是那个戴着精美头盔的人。哦，他只有一只眼睛。 [bao qian ， huo ji ， wo bu bei yun xu jin ru lang ting 。 bie dan xin ， ta hen rong yi bei fa xian 。 ta jiu shi na ge dai zhe jing mei tou kui de ren 。 o ， ta zhi you yi zhi yan jing 。]

english: He's a cyclops?
translation: 他是独眼巨人？ [ta shi du yan ju ren ？]

english: Nah, nah, nah... He just wears an eyepatch! Well, see ya around buddy!
translation: 不，不，不……他只是戴着眼罩！好吧，伙计，再见！ [bu ， bu ， bu …… ta zhi shi dai zhuo yan zhao ！ hao ba ， huo ji ， zai jian ！]

english: Hey there, buddy. You're an outerlander, huh?
translation: 嘿，伙计。你是外地人吧？ [hei ， huo ji 。 ni shi wai di ren ba ？]

english: Didn't think old Jarvald would let an outerlander come kill dagger-mouths with him!
translation: 没想到老贾瓦尔德会让一个外地人来和他一起杀戮！ [mei xiang dao lao jia wa er de hui rang yi ge wai di ren lai he ta yi qi sha lu ！]

english: Well, obviously he did. So what are you doing up here?
translation: 嗯，显然他做到了。那么你在这里做什么？ [n ， xian ran ta zuo dao le 。 na me ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Well buddy, let me tell you, killing those dagger-mouths is sure thirsty work!
translation: 好吧，伙计，我告诉你，杀掉那些匕首可真是一件苦差事！ [hao ba ， huo ji ， wo gao su ni ， sha diao na xie bi shou ke zhen shi yi jian ku chai shi ！]

english: If you got a keg of beer on you I'll buy it off ya for 500 gold coins, buddy!
translation: 如果你身上有一桶啤酒，我就花 500 金币从你那里买下来，伙计！ [ru guo ni shen shang you yi tong pi jiu ， wo jiu hua  500  jin bi cong ni na li mai xia lai ， huo ji ！]

english: Or if you got any animal parts, I'll trade ya something for 'em!
translation: 或者如果你有任何动物器官，我会用一些东西换给你！ [huo zhe ru guo ni you ren he dong wu qi guan ， wo hui yong yi xie dong xi huan gei ni ！]

english: No... I don't have anything like that with me...
translation: 不……我身上没有那样的东西…… [bu …… wo shen shang mei you na yang de dong xi ……]

english: Well, I'm not going back down there until I get a drink buddy! Come see me if you find me a keg, I pay good money!
translation: 好吧，在我找到一个喝酒的伙伴之前我不会再回去了！如果你找到我一个桶，就来找我，我会付很多钱！ [hao ba ， zai wo zhao dao yi ge he jiu de huo ban zhi qian wo bu hui zai hui qu le ！ ru guo ni zhao dao wo yi ge tong ， jiu lai zhao wo ， wo hui fu hen duo qian ！]

english: Wanna sell me ya kegs of beer for 500 gold coins each outerlander?
translation: 想以每个外地人 500 金币的价格卖给我几桶啤酒吗？ [xiang yi mei ge wai di ren  500  jin bi de jia ge mai gei wo ji tong pi jiu ma ？]

english: I don't know... Seems a little off to sell alcohol to a child...
translation: 我不知道……向一个孩子卖酒似乎有点不妥…… [wo bu zhi dao …… xiang yi ge hai zi mai jiu si hu you dian bu tuo ……]

english: Hey, don't judge our customs outerlander! Now you want the cash or you want to bug me?
translation: 嘿，别评判我们的海关外地人！现在你想要现金还是想骚扰我？ [hei ， bie ping pan wo men de hai guan wai di ren ！ xian zai ni xiang yao xian jin hai shi xiang sao rao wo ？]

english: You wanna sell me the lot buddy, or one at a time?
translation: 你想卖给我很多吗伙计，还是一次卖一个？ [ni xiang mai gei wo hen duo ma huo ji ， hai shi yi ci mai yi ge ？]

english: You sell Askeladden your Kegs of Beer.
translation: 你把你的小桶啤酒卖给阿斯凯拉登。 [ni ba ni de xiao tong pi jiu mai gei a si kai la deng 。]

english: You sell Askeladden a Keg of Beer.
translation: 您向阿斯凯拉登出售一桶啤酒。 [nin xiang a si kai la deng chu shou yi tong pi jiu 。]

english: But I don't have any kegs of beer to sell...
translation: 但我没有桶啤酒可卖... [dan wo mei you tong pi jiu ke mai ...]

english: I'll trade ya animal parts for cooked tuna, ya interested outerlander?
translation: 我会用你的动物部位换熟金枪鱼，你感兴趣的外地人吗？ [wo hui yong ni de dong wu bu wei huan shu jin qiang yu ， ni gan xing qu de wai di ren ma ？]

english: You wanna trade me the lot buddy, or just one type?
translation: 你想跟我交易很多，还是只交易一种？ [ni xiang gen wo jiao yi hen duo ， hai shi zhi jiao yi yi zhong ？]

english: You trade Askeladden your animal parts for food.
translation: 你用阿斯凯拉登的动物器官换取食物。 [ni yong a si kai la deng de dong wu qi guan huan qu shi wu 。]

english: What ya selling buddy?
translation: 哥们儿卖什么？ [ge men er mai shen me ？]

english: You trade the parts for food.
translation: 你用零件换取食物。 [ni yong ling jian huan qu shi wu 。]

english: No offence Askeladden, and it's not that I don't trust you... Er, actually it is that I don't trust you.
translation: 无意冒犯阿斯凯拉登，并不是我不信任你……呃，实际上是我不信任你。 [wu yi mao fan a si kai la deng ， bing bu shi wo bu xin ren ni …… e ， shi ji shang shi wo bu xin ren ni 。]

english: Aw, buddy... What did I ever do to you?
translation: 噢，伙计……我对你做了什么？ [o ， huo ji …… wo dui ni zuo le shen me ？]

english: Well, if ya change your mind, I'm gonna be here waiting for a drink, buddy!
translation: 好吧，如果你改变主意，我会在这里等一杯酒，伙计！ [hao ba ， ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， wo hui zai zhe li deng yi bei jiu ， huo ji ！]

english: Hey buddy, I'll trade ya that for some food! Ya interested?
translation: 嘿，伙计，我用它来换一些食物！你有兴趣吗？ [hei ， huo ji ， wo yong ta lai huan yi xie shi wu ！ ni you xing qu ma ？]

english: Okay buddy, suit yerself!
translation: 好吧，哥们，随你便吧！ [hao ba ， ge men ， sui ni bian ba ！]

english: Hi. Are you a member of the council of elders?
translation: 你好。你是长老会的成员吗？ [ni hao 。 ni shi zhang lao hui de cheng yuan ma ？]

english: Me? On the council? Ha ha ha ha! Sorry buddy, I'm not a 'real' Fremennik yet! Let me guess, you're trying to get some council members to vote for you?
translation: 我？在理事会？哈哈哈哈！抱歉，伙计，我还不是“真正的”弗雷曼尼克！让我猜猜，你是想让一些理事会成员投票给你吗？ [wo ？ zai li shi hui ？ ha ha ha ha ！ bao qian ， huo ji ， wo hai bu shi “ zhen zheng de ” fu lei man ni ke ！ rang wo cai cai ， ni shi xiang rang yi xie li shi hui cheng yuan tou piao gei ni ma ？]

english: That's right, to become a Fremennik.
translation: 没错，就是成为一名弗雷曼尼克人。 [mei cuo ， jiu shi cheng wei yi ming fu lei man ni ke ren 。]

english: You and me both buddy! We're both doing the same trials! This is my trial of manhood! How you finding it so far? Pretty easy, huh buddy?
translation: 你和我都是朋友！我们都在做同样的试验！这是我对男子气概的考验！到目前为止你发现得怎么样了？很简单吧，伙计？ [ni he wo dou shi peng you ！ wo men dou zai zuo tong yang de shi yan ！ zhe shi wo dui nan zi qi gai de kao yan ！ dao mu qian wei zhi ni fa xian de zen me yang le ？ hen jian dan ba ， huo ji ？]

english: It's okay I guess...
translation: 我想应该没问题吧... [wo xiang ying gai mei wen ti ba ...]

english: Yeah, that's the spirit buddy! It's all real easy, I wouldn't worry yourself about it, you'll be quaffing beers in the longhall as a Fremennik in no time!
translation: 没错，这就是灵魂伙伴！这一切都非常简单，我不会为此担心，您很快就会作为弗雷曼尼克人在长厅里痛饮啤酒！ [mei cuo ， zhe jiu shi ling hun huo ban ！ zhe yi qie dou fei chang jian dan ， wo bu hui wei ci dan xin ， nin hen kuai jiu hui zuo wei fu lei man ni ke ren zai zhang ting li tong yin pi jiu ！]

english: Hello there. I understand you managed to get some golden wool from Lalli?
translation: 你好呀。我听说你从拉利那里得到了一些金羊毛？ [ni hao ya 。 wo ting shuo ni cong la li na li de dao le yi xie jin yang mao ？]

english: HAHAHA! Yeah, that Lalli... what a maroon!
translation: 哈哈哈！是啊，那个拉利……多么栗色啊！ [ha ha ha ！ shi a ， na ge la li …… duo me li se a ！]

english: So how did you manage to get the wool?
translation: 那么你是如何获得羊毛的呢？ [na me ni shi ru he huo de yang mao de ne ？]

english: Well, as you know, I am doing the same trials that you are as part of my test of manhood, and that troll is the only one who can get that wool.
translation: 好吧，如你所知，我正在做和你一样的考验，作为我男子气概测试的一部分，而那个巨魔是唯一能得到这些羊毛的人。 [hao ba ， ru ni suo zhi ， wo zheng zai zuo he ni yi yang de kao yan ， zuo wei wo nan zi qi gai ce shi de yi bu fen ， er na ge ju mo shi wei yi neng de dao zhe xie yang mao de ren 。]

english: You might have noticed he's kind of... messed in the head buddy! He's real paranoid about people stealing his golden apples, isn't he?
translation: 你可能已经注意到他有点……脑子一团乱，伙计！他真的很担心有人偷他的金苹果，不是吗？ [ni ke neng yi jing zhu yi dao ta you dian …… nao zi yi tuan luan ， huo ji ！ ta zhen de hen dan xin you ren tou ta de jin ping guo ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Indeed he is. So how did you manage to get some golden wool from him?
translation: 确实如此。那么你是怎么从他那里得到一些金羊毛的呢？ [que shi ru ci 。 na me ni shi zen me cong ta na li de dao yi xie jin yang mao de ne ？]

english: It was easy buddy! I persuaded him he needed a pet to help him guard his apples. A pet that would never sleep! A pet that would never need food, or exercise!
translation: 这很容易，伙计！我说服他需要一只宠物来帮助他看管苹果。永远不会睡觉的宠物！一只永远不需要食物或运动的宠物！ [zhe hen rong yi ， huo ji ！ wo shuo fu ta xu yao yi zhi chong wu lai bang zhu ta kan guan ping guo 。 yong yuan bu hui shui jiao de chong wu ！ yi zhi yong yuan bu xu yao shi wu huo yun dong de chong wu ！]

english: A pet that would never need him to clean up its... well, you know, buddy. A pet that would always be loyal to him! A faithful companion for life!
translation: 一只永远不需要他清理它的宠物……好吧，你知道，伙计。一只永远忠于他的宠物！一生忠实的伴侣！ [yi zhi yong yuan bu xu yao ta qing li ta de chong wu …… hao ba ， ni zhi dao ， huo ji 。 yi zhi yong yuan zhong yu ta de chong wu ！ yi sheng zhong shi de ban lv ！]

english: What pet is this then?
translation: 那这是什么宠物呢？ [na zhe shi shen me chong wu ne ？]

english: A pet ROCK!
translation: 宠物摇滚！ [chong wu yao gun ！]

english: Man, can you believe that stupid troll traded me some of his golden wool for a worthless ROCK?
translation: 伙计，你能相信那个愚蠢的巨魔用他的一些金羊毛换了我一块毫无价值的岩石吗？ [huo ji ， ni neng xiang xin na ge yu chun de ju mo yong ta de yi xie jin yang mao huan le wo yi kuai hao wu jia zhi de yan shi ma ？]

english: Buddy, I hafta say; if brains were explosives, that troll wouldn't have enough to blow his nose!
translation: 伙计，我不得不说；如果大脑是炸药，那巨魔就不足以擤鼻涕了！ [huo ji ， wo bu de bu shuo ； ru guo da nao shi zha yao ， na ju mo jiu bu zu yi xing bi ti le ！]

english: Do you have any spare rocks then?
