translation: 我是斯坦。奥古斯特雇我来照顾这个气球。我确保人们做好飞行准备。 [wo shi si tan 。 ao gu si te gu wo lai zhao gu zhe ge qi qiu 。 wo que bao ren men zuo hao fei xing zhun bei 。]

english: Do you want to use the balloon?
translation: 你想使用气球吗？ [ni xiang shi yong qi qiu ma ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Hello Asteros. What brings you to the castle?
translation: 你好阿斯特罗斯。是什么风带你来到城堡的？ [ni hao a si te luo si 。 shi shen me feng dai ni lai dao cheng bao de ？]

english: The King's late father asked for an advisor from Arceuus. He was keen for us to have a more central role than we did under the Council.
translation: 国王已故的父亲向阿尔宙斯寻求顾问。他热切希望我们能够发挥比安理会更核心的作用。 [guo wang yi gu de fu qin xiang a er zhou si xun qiu gu wen 。 ta re qie xi wang wo men neng gou fa hui bi an li hui geng he xin de zuo yong 。]

english: I see. I'm sure the King is glad to have you here.
translation: 我懂了。我确信国王很高兴你来到这里。 [wo dong le 。 wo que xin guo wang hen gao xing ni lai dao zhe li 。]

english: He does seem willing to take on my advice, which is very welcoming. I hope he remains humble. It is a trait many leaders lack.
translation: 他似乎确实愿意接受我的建议，这非常受欢迎。我希望他保持谦虚。这是许多领导者所缺乏的特质。 [ta si hu que shi yuan yi jie shou wo de jian yi ， zhe fei chang shou huan ying 。 wo xi wang ta bao chi qian xu 。 zhe shi xu duo ling dao zhe suo que fa de te zhi 。]

english: Now, is there something else I can do for you? If you're interested, I can offer you the ability to respawn at Kourend Castle upon death.
translation: 现在，我还能为您做点什么吗？如果你有兴趣，我可以为你提供死亡后在库伦德城堡重生的能力。 [xian zai ， wo hai neng wei nin zuo dian shen me ma ？ ru guo ni you xing qu ， wo ke yi wei ni ti gong si wang hou zai ku lun de cheng bao chong sheng de neng li 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Very well. From now on, you will respawn at Kourend Castle.
translation: 很好。从现在开始，你将在库伦德城堡重生。 [hen hao 。 cong xian zai kai shi ， ni jiang zai ku lun de cheng bao chong sheng 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Let me know if you change your mind.
translation: 如果您改变主意，请告诉我。 [ru guo nin gai bian zhu yi ， qing gao su wo 。]

english: Hello Asteros.
translation: 你好阿斯特罗斯。 [ni hao a si te luo si 。]

english: Hello there. Would you like me to change your respawn point to Kourend Castle?
translation: 你好呀。您希望我将您的重生点更改为库伦德城堡吗？ [ni hao ya 。 nin xi wang wo jiang nin de chong sheng dian geng gai wei ku lun de cheng bao ma ？]

english: Hello there. Would you like me to revert your respawn point to Lumbridge?
translation: 你好呀。您希望我将您的重生点恢复到朗布里奇吗？ [ni hao ya 。 nin xi wang wo jiang nin de chong sheng dian hui fu dao lang bu li qi ma ？]

english: Very well. From now on, you will respawn in Lumbridge.
translation: 很好。从现在开始，你将在伦布里奇重生。 [hen hao 。 cong xian zai kai shi ， ni jiang zai lun bu li qi chong sheng 。]

english: What brings you to the castle?
translation: 是什么风带你来到城堡的？ [shi shen me feng dai ni lai dao cheng bao de ？]

english: Now, is there something else I can do for you? If you're interested, I can change your respawn point to Kourend Castle.
translation: 现在，我还能为您做点什么吗？如果你有兴趣，我可以把你的重生点改为库伦德城堡。 [xian zai ， wo hai neng wei nin zuo dian shen me ma ？ ru guo ni you xing qu ， wo ke yi ba ni de chong sheng dian gai wei ku lun de cheng bao 。]

english: Now, is there something else I can do for you? If you want, I can revert your respawn point to Lumbridge.
translation: 现在，我还能为您做点什么吗？如果你愿意，我可以将你的重生点恢复到朗布里奇。 [xian zai ， wo hai neng wei nin zuo dian shen me ma ？ ru guo ni yuan yi ， wo ke yi jiang ni de chong sheng dian hui fu dao lang bu li qi 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: What brings you to the castle?
translation: 是什么风带你来到城堡的？ [shi shen me feng dai ni lai dao cheng bao de ？]

english: Now you look like someone who goes to a lot of fancy dress parties.
translation: 现在你看起来就像是经常参加化装舞会的人。 [xian zai ni kan qi lai jiu xiang shi jing chang can jia hua zhuang wu hui de ren 。]

english: Errr...what are you saying exactly?
translation: 呃……你到底在说什么？ [e …… ni dao di zai shuo shen me ？]

english: I'm just saying that perhaps you would like to peruse my selection of garments.
translation: 我只是说也许你想仔细看看我精选的服装。 [wo zhi shi shuo ye xu ni xiang zi xi kan kan wo jing xuan de fu zhuang 。]

english: Or, if that doesn't interest you, then maybe you have something else to offer? I'm always on the look out for interesting or unusual new materials.
translation: 或者，如果您对此不感兴趣，那么也许您可以提供其他东西？我总是在寻找有趣或不寻常的新材料。 [huo zhe ， ru guo nin dui ci bu gan xing qu ， na me ye xu nin ke yi ti gong qi ta dong xi ？ wo zong shi zai xun zhao you qu huo bu xun chang de xin cai liao 。]

english: Okay, let's see what you've got then.
translation: 好吧，让我们看看你有什么。 [hao ba ， rang wo men kan kan ni you shen me 。]

english: Do you have a spare Priest Gown?
translation: 你有备用的牧师礼服吗？ [ni you bei yong de mu shi li fu ma ？]

english: Well I do sell them. I don't hand them out for free though. This is a shop not a charity.
translation: 好吧，我确实卖掉它们。不过我不会免费分发它们。这是一家商店而不是慈善机构。 [hao ba ， wo que shi mai diao ta men 。 bu guo wo bu hui mian fei fen fa ta men 。 zhe shi yi jia shang dian er bu shi ci shan ji gou 。]

english: Please! It's really important.
translation: 请！这真的很重要。 [qing ！ zhe zhen de hen zhong yao 。]

english: Well I suppose you can have this old one. It's not in good enough condition to sell.
translation: 好吧，我想你可以拥有这个旧的。它的状况不够好，无法出售。 [hao ba ， wo xiang ni ke yi yong you zhe ge jiu de 。 ta de zhuang kuang bu gou hao ， wu fa chu shou 。]

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Could you make another eagle costume for me?
translation: 你能为我再做一套鹰服装吗？ [ni neng wei wo zai zuo yi tao ying fu zhuang ma ？]

english: Certainly, if you can supply the materials. I'll need appropriate feathers, swamp tar and some yellow dye. It'll also cost you 25 gold pieces.
translation: 当然，如果你能提供材料的话。我需要合适的羽毛、沼泽焦油和一些黄色染料。它还会花费你 25 金币。 [dang ran ， ru guo ni neng ti gong cai liao de hua 。 wo xu yao he shi de yu mao 、 zhao ze jiao you he yi xie huang se ran liao 。 ta hai hui hua fei ni  25  jin bi 。]

english: I'll see what I can do.
translation: 我会看看我能做什么。 [wo hui kan kan wo neng zuo shen me 。]

english: I think I might just leave the perusing for now, thanks.
translation: 我想我可以暂时放弃阅读，谢谢。 [wo xiang wo ke yi zan shi fang qi yue du ， xie xie 。]

english: Can you make clothing suitable for hunting?
translation: 你能制作适合打猎的衣服吗？ [ni neng zhi zuo shi he da lie de yi fu ma ？]

english: Certainly. Take a look at my range of made-to-order items. If you can supply the furs, I'll gladly make any of these for you.
translation: 当然。看看我的定制产品系列。如果你能提供毛皮，我很乐意为你做这些。 [dang ran 。 kan kan wo de ding zhi chan pin xi lie 。 ru guo ni neng ti gong mao pi ， wo hen le yi wei ni zuo zhe xie 。]

english: What sort of unusual materials did you have in mind?
translation: 您想到了哪些不寻常的材料？ [nin xiang dao le na xie bu xun chang de cai liao ？]

english: Well, some more colourful feathers might be useful. For some surreal reason, all I normally seem to get offered are large quantities of rather beaten-up looking chicken feathers.
translation: 嗯，一些更彩色的羽毛可能会有用。出于某种超现实的原因，我通常得到的似乎都是大量看起来破旧的鸡毛。 [n ， yi xie geng cai se de yu mao ke neng hui you yong 。 chu yu mou zhong chao xian shi de yuan yin ， wo tong chang de dao de si hu dou shi da liang kan qi lai po jiu de ji mao 。]

english: People must have some very strange pastimes around these parts, that's all I can say.
translation: 我只能说，人们在这些地方一定有一些非常奇怪的消遣。 [wo zhi neng shuo ， ren men zai zhe xie di fang yi ding you yi xie fei chang qi guai de xiao qian 。]

english: Ok, let's see what you've got then.
translation: 好吧，让我们看看你有什么。 [hao ba ， rang wo men kan kan ni you shen me 。]

english: Sorry, we're closed at the moment.
translation: 抱歉，我们现在关门了。 [bao qian ， wo men xian zai guan men le 。]

english: Okay, lets see what you've got then.
translation: 好吧，让我们看看你有什么。 [hao ba ， rang wo men kan kan ni you shen me 。]

english: Do you have a spare Priest Gown?
translation: 你有备用的牧师礼服吗？ [ni you bei yong de mu shi li fu ma ？]

english: Could you make another bird costume for me?
translation: 你能为我再做一件鸟服装吗？ [ni neng wei wo zai zuo yi jian niao fu zhuang ma ？]

english: I think I might just leave the perusing for now thanks.
translation: 我想我可以暂时放弃阅读，谢谢。 [wo xiang wo ke yi zan shi fang qi yue du ， xie xie 。]

english: Can you make clothing suitable for hunting in?
translation: 你能制作适合狩猎的衣服吗？ [ni neng zhi zuo shi he shou lie de yi fu ma ？]

english: What sort of unusual materials did you have in mind?
translation: 您想到了哪些不寻常的材料？ [nin xiang dao le na xie bu xun chang de cai liao ？]

english: What do you want, little [man/woman]?
translation: 你想要什么，小[男人/女人]？ [ni xiang yao shen me ， xiao [ nan ren / nv ren ]？]

english: Nothing. Just though I'd try to strike up a conversation.
translation: 没有什么。尽管我想尝试搭讪。 [mei you shen me 。 jin guan wo xiang chang shi da shan 。]

english: Not now little one, I'm busy.
translation: 现在不行，小家伙，我很忙。 [xian zai bu xing ， xiao jia huo ， wo hen mang 。]

english: Okay then.
translation: 那么好吧。 [na me hao ba 。]

english: Well done, little one. You've proven your worth.
translation: 干得好，小家伙。你已经证明了你的价值。 [gan de hao ， xiao jia huo 。 ni yi jing zheng ming liao ni de jia zhi 。]

english: Can I do it again?
translation: 我可以再做一次吗？ [wo ke yi zai zuo yi ci ma ？]

english: What? Why?
translation: 什么？为什么？ [shen me ？ wei shen me ？]

english: It was fun, I'd like to do it again.
translation: 很有趣，我想再做一次。 [hen you qu ， wo xiang zai zuo yi ci 。]

english: You're the first person to ask me that [player name]. I suppose I could train you again, but I will have to charge you the full 25,000 coins this time.
translation: 你是第一个问我这个问题的人[玩家名字]。我想我可以再次训练你，但这次我必须向你收取全额的25,000金币。 [ni shi di yi ge wen wo zhe ge wen ti de ren [ wan jia ming zi ]。 wo xiang wo ke yi zai ci xun lian ni ， dan zhe ci wo bi xu xiang ni shou qu quan e de 25,000 jin bi 。]

english: Let's do this, I'm ready.
translation: 让我们这样做吧，我已经准备好了。 [rang wo men zhe yang zuo ba ， wo yi jing zhun bei hao le 。]

english: It's not going to be any easier my friend!
translation: 我的朋友，这不会更容易！ [wo de peng you ， zhe bu hui geng rong yi ！]

english: Training session begins.
translation: 训练开始。 [xun lian kai shi 。]

english: Training session ends.
translation: 训练结束。 [xun lian jie shu 。]

english: Hold it there little one, you don't have enough money to pay for the lesson.
translation: 坚持住，小家伙，你没有足够的钱付学费。 [jian chi zhu ， xiao jia huo ， ni mei you zu gou de qian fu xue fei 。]

english: Oh, sorry I was too excited...
translation: 哦，对不起，我太激动了…… [o ， dui bu qi ， wo tai ji dong le ……]

english: No worries friend, come back when you can afford the session.
translation: 不用担心，朋友，当你能负担得起会议费用时就回来吧。 [bu yong dan xin ， peng you ， dang ni neng fu dan de qi hui yi fei yong shi jiu hui lai ba 。]

english: Back again I see, here for another workout?
translation: 我又回来了，来这里进行另一次锻炼吗？ [wo you hui lai le ， lai zhe li jin xing ling yi ci duan lian ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: You must take your training very seriously [player name]. This is the second time you'll have done this workout and paid full price!
translation: 你必须非常认真地对待你的训练[玩家姓名]。这是您第二次完成此锻炼并支付全价！ [ni bi xu fei chang ren zhen di dui dai ni de xun lian [ wan jia xing ming ]。 zhe shi nin di er ci wan cheng ci duan lian bing zhi fu quan jia ！]

english: You take your training very seriously [player name]. You know you've done this workout [times done] times, are you sure you want to do it again?
translation: 你非常认真地对待你的训练[球员姓名]。您知道您已经完成此锻炼[次完成]次，您确定要再做一次吗？ [ni fei chang ren zhen di dui dai ni de xun lian [ qiu yuan xing ming ]。 nin zhi dao nin yi jing wan cheng ci duan lian [ ci wan cheng ] ci ， nin que ding yao zai zuo yi ci ma ？]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Hello there, [player name]. What can I do for you?
translation: 你好，[玩家姓名]。我能为你做什么？ [ni hao ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。 wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: How are things?
translation: 最近怎么样？ [zui jin zen me yang ？]

english: Now that the situation in the ruins is under control, things are nice and quiet, which is just what we need. That whole buisness down there got a lot of dwarves riled up.
translation: 现在废墟里的局势已经得到控制，一切安好安静，这正是我们所需要的。下面的这一切激怒了很多矮人。 [xian zai fei xu li de ju shi yi jing de dao kong zhi ， yi qie an hao an jing ， zhe zheng shi wo men suo xu yao de 。 xia mian de zhe yi qie ji nu le hen duo ai ren 。]

english: Naturally, most blame you humans.
translation: 当然，大多数人都责怪你们人类。 [dang ran ， da duo shu ren dou ze guai ni men ren lei 。]

english: Of course. Have you tried explaining to them that we actually helped?
translation: 当然。您是否尝试向他们解释我们确实提供了帮助？ [dang ran 。 nin shi fou chang shi xiang ta men jie shi wo men que shi ti gong le bang zhu ？]

english: Ha! Good one. You think I'm going to make a laughing stock of myself by daring to claim a human did something positive? Keep dreaming!
translation: 哈!好一个。你认为我敢于声称人类做了一些积极的事情会让自己成为笑柄吗？继续梦想！ [ha ! hao yi ge 。 ni ren wei wo gan yu sheng cheng ren lei zuo le yi xie ji ji de shi qing hui rang zi ji cheng wei xiao bing ma ？ ji xu meng xiang ！]

english: So how long has Cam Torum been around?
translation: 那么 Cam Torum 存在多久了？ [na me  Cam Torum  cun zai duo jiu le ？]

english: What am I, a historian?
translation: 我是什么，一个历史学家？ [wo shi shen me ， yi ge li shi xue jia ？]

english: No, but you're the only dwarf here that might be willing to share that sort of information with me.
translation: 不，但你是这里唯一愿意与我分享此类信息的侏儒。 [bu ， dan ni shi zhe li wei yi yuan yi yu wo fen xiang ci lei xin xi de zhu ru 。]

english: Hmph. Very well. The Varlamorians won't mention this, but we were the first to settle here. Our ancestors saw the writing on the wall when Xeric came to power in Kourend. They chose not to stick around.
translation: 哼。很好。瓦拉莫人不会提及这一点，但我们是第一个在这里定居的人。当谢里克在库伦德掌权时，我们的祖先看到了不祥之兆。他们选择不留下来。 [heng 。 hen hao 。 wa la mo ren bu hui ti ji zhe yi dian ， dan wo men shi di yi ge zai zhe li ding ju de ren 。 dang xie li ke zai ku lun de zhang quan shi ， wo men de zu xian kan dao le bu xiang zhi zhao 。 ta men xuan ze bu liu xia lai 。]

english: Must have been a big thing for them, leaving their home.
translation: 离开家对他们来说一定是一件大事。 [li kai jia dui ta men lai shuo yi ding shi yi jian da shi 。]

english: Doubtful. My people are all too familiar with that sort of thing. The Lovakengj dwarves have mostly forgotten their history, but we Dwarves of Cam Torum remember it all too well.
translation: 疑。我的人民对这类事情太熟悉了。洛瓦肯吉矮人几乎已经忘记了他们的历史，但我们卡姆托鲁姆的矮人却记得很清楚。 [yi 。 wo de ren min dui zhe lei shi qing tai shu xi le 。 luo wa ken ji ai ren ji hu yi jing wang ji le ta men de li shi ， dan wo men ka mu tuo lu mu de ai ren que ji de hen qing chu 。]

english: Remember what?
translation: 还记得什么吗？ [hai ji de shen me ma ？]

english: Before Lovakengj, there was Imcandoria. Our ancestors there were forced to abandon their home, just as we were forced to leave Kourend.
translation: 在洛瓦肯杰之前，有伊姆坎多利亚。我们的祖先被迫离开家园，就像我们被迫离开库伦德一样。 [zai luo wa ken jie zhi qian ， you yi mu kan duo li ya 。 wo men de zu xian bei po li kai jia yuan ， jiu xiang wo men bei po li kai ku lun de yi yang 。]

english: If you humans had had your way, we might have had to abandon Cam Torum by now as well.
translation: 如果你们人类按照自己的方式行事，我们现在可能也不得不放弃卡姆托鲁姆了。 [ru guo ni men ren lei an zhao zi ji de fang shi xing shi ， wo men xian zai ke neng ye bu de bu fang qi ka mu tuo lu mu le 。]

english: You don't know that.
translation: 你不知道这一点。 [ni bu zhi dao zhe yi dian 。]

english: But I do know that. As I said, we remember our history, and we know that those who don't are doomed to repeat it.
translation: 但我确实知道这一点。正如我所说，我们记住我们的历史，并且我们知道那些不记住的人注定会重蹈覆辙。 [dan wo que shi zhi dao zhe yi dian 。 zheng ru wo suo shuo ， wo men ji zhu wo men de li shi ， bing qie wo men zhi dao na xie bu ji zhu de ren zhu ding hui chong dao fu zhe 。]

english: The Varlamorians nearly destroyed themselves in their War of Betrayal, but it was not them who were betrayed, it was us.
translation: 瓦拉莫人在背叛之战中差点毁了自己，但被背叛的不是他们，而是我们。 [wa la mo ren zai bei pan zhi zhan zhong cha dian hui le zi ji ， dan bei bei pan de bu shi ta men ， er shi wo men 。]

english: I was a young dwarf when their war risked destroying our home. I saw the results of their pride. Meanwhile, they've all but forgotten it.
translation: 当他们的战争有可能摧毁我们的家园时，我还是一个年轻的侏儒。我看到了他们骄傲的结果。与此同时，他们几乎忘记了这一点。 [dang ta men de zhan zheng you ke neng cui hui wo men de jia yuan shi ， wo hai shi yi ge nian qing de zhu ru 。 wo kan dao le ta men jiao ao de jie guo 。 yu ci tong shi ， ta men ji hu wang ji le zhe yi dian 。]

english: Sorry. I didn't mean to dig up old wounds.
translation: 对不起。我并不是有意要挖旧伤。 [dui bu qi 。 wo bing bu shi you yi yao wa jiu shang 。]

english: Hmph. It's fine. Your intentions are good, [player name], which is more than can be said for most of your kind. Who knows, maybe one or two dwarves here might even grow to tolerate you.
translation: 哼。没关系。你的意图是好的，[玩家名字]，这对大多数同类来说是无法形容的。谁知道呢，也许这里的一两个矮人甚至可能会容忍你。 [heng 。 mei guan xi 。 ni de yi tu shi hao de ，[ wan jia ming zi ]， zhe dui da duo shu tong lei lai shuo shi wu fa xing rong de 。 shui zhi dao ne ， ye xu zhe li de yi liang ge ai ren shen zhi ke neng hui rong ren ni 。]

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: How are things?
translation: 最近怎么样？ [zui jin zen me yang ？]

english: So how long has Cam Torum been around?
translation: 那么 Cam Torum 存在多久了？ [na me  Cam Torum  cun zai duo jiu le ？]

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: Hello again. Was Fox happy with the material?
translation: 又好。福克斯对这些材料满意吗？ [you hao 。 fu ke si dui zhe xie cai liao man yi ma ？]

english: He was. You found the perfect match.
translation: 他是。您找到了完美的搭配。 [ta shi 。 nin zhao dao le wan mei de da pei 。]

english: Wonderful!
translation: 精彩的！ [jing cai de ！]

english: I have this voucher for completing the combat Adventure Path, it says to come talk to you about claiming my Adventure Path reward.
translation: 我有这张完成战斗冒险之路的凭证，上面写着来和你谈谈领取我的冒险之路奖励的事情。 [wo you zhe zhang wan cheng zhan dou mao xian zhi lu de ping zheng ， shang mian xie zhe lai he ni tan tan ling qu wo de mao xian zhi lu jiang li de shi qing 。]

english: Why yes, here are some air and mind runes.
translation: 为什么是的，这里有一些空气和心灵符文。 [wei shen me shi de ， zhe li you yi xie kong qi he xin ling fu wen 。]

english: I do have more rewards for you, but you need to be on a members world for me to give you the reward. Maybe there is something else I can help you with.
translation: 我确实有更多的奖励给你，但是你需要在会​​员世界我才能给你奖励。或许还有其他事情我可以帮助你。 [wo que shi you geng duo de jiang li gei ni ， dan shi ni xu yao zai hui ​​ yuan shi jie wo cai neng gei ni jiang li 。 huo xu hai you qi ta shi qing wo ke yi bang zhu ni 。]

english: Do you want to buy some runes?
translation: 你想买一些符文吗？ [ni xiang mai yi xie fu wen ma ？]

english: Certainly! Skillcapes are a symbol of achievement. Only people who have mastered a skill and reached level 99 can get their hands on them and gain the benefits they carry.
translation: 当然！技能斗篷是成就的象征。只有掌握了一项技能并达到99级的人才能获得它们并获得它们所带来的好处。 [dang ran ！ ji neng dou peng shi cheng jiu de xiang zheng 。 zhi you zhang wo le yi xiang ji neng bing da dao 99 ji de ren cai neng huo de ta men bing huo de ta men suo dai lai de hao chu 。]

english: The Cape of Runecrafting has been upgraded with each talisman, allowing you to access all Runecrafting altars. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 符文制作斗篷已随每个护身符升级，让您可以访问所有符文制作祭坛。还有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [fu wen zhi zuo dou peng yi sui mei ge hu shen fu sheng ji ， rang nin ke yi fang wen suo you fu wen zhi zuo ji tan 。 hai you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Well, if you find someone who does want runes, please send them my way.
translation: 好吧，如果你发现有人确实想要符文，请把他们寄给我。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni fa xian you ren que shi xiang yao fu wen ， qing ba ta men ji gei wo 。]

english: Oh, it's a rune shop. No thank you, then.
translation: 哦，这是符文商店。那就不用了，谢谢。 [o ， zhe shi fu wen shang dian 。 na jiu bu yong le ， xie xie 。]

english: Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence?
translation: 你能将我传送到符文精华吗？ [ni neng jiang wo chuan song dao fu wen jing hua ma ？]

english: Senventior Disthine Molenko!
translation: 迪斯辛·莫连科先生！ [di si xin · mo lian ke xian sheng ！]

english: I have been sent here with a package for you.
translation: 我已经被派到这里给你带来一个包裹。 [wo yi jing bei pai dao zhe li gei ni dai lai yi ge bao guo 。]

english: A package? From who?
translation: 一个包裹？来自谁？ [yi ge bao guo ？ lai zi shui ？]

english: From Sedridor at the Wizards' Tower.
translation: 来自巫师塔的塞德里多。 [lai zi wu shi ta de sai de li duo 。]

english: From Sedridor? But... surely he can't have? Please, let me have it. It must be extremely important for him to have sent a stranger.
translation: 来自塞德里多？但是……他肯定不能有吧？请让我拥有它。他派来一个陌生人，对他来说肯定是极其重要的事情。 [lai zi sai de li duo ？ dan shi …… ta ken ding bu neng you ba ？ qing rang wo yong you ta 。 ta pai lai yi ge mo sheng ren ， dui ta lai shuo ken ding shi ji qi zhong yao de shi qing 。]

english: You hand Aubury the research package.
translation: 你把研究包递给奥伯里。 [ni ba yan jiu bao di gei ao bo li 。]

english: This... this is incredible.
translation: 这……这太不可思议了。 [zhe …… zhe tai bu ke si yi le 。]

english: My gratitude to you adventurer for bringing me these research notes. Thanks to you, I think we finally have it.
translation: 我感谢冒险家给我带来这些研究笔记。谢谢你，我想我们终于拥有了。 [wo gan xie mao xian jia gei wo dai lai zhe xie yan jiu bi ji 。 xie xie ni ， wo xiang wo men zhong yu yong you le 。]

english: You mean the incantation?
translation: 你说的是咒语吗？ [ni shuo de shi zhou yu ma ？]

english: Well when we combine my own research with this latest discovery, I think we might just...
translation: 好吧，当我们将我自己的研究与这一最新发现结合起来时，我想我们可能会...... [hao ba ， dang wo men jiang wo zi ji de yan jiu yu zhe yi zui xin fa xian jie he qi lai shi ， wo xiang wo men ke neng hui ......]

english: No, no, I'm getting ahead of myself. The signs are promising, but let's not jump to any conclusions just yet.
translation: 不，不，我有点超前了。这些迹象是有希望的，但我们暂时不要急于下任何结论。 [bu ， bu ， wo you dian chao qian le 。 zhe xie ji xiang shi you xi wang de ， dan wo men zan shi bu yao ji yu xia ren he jie lun 。]

english: Here, take these notes back to Sedridor. They should hopefully give him everything he needs.
translation: 在这里，把这些笔记带回塞德里多。他们应该有希望为他提供他需要的一切。 [zai zhe li ， ba zhe xie bi ji dai hui sai de li duo 。 ta men ying gai you xi wang wei ta ti gong ta xu yao de yi qie 。]

english: Uh... yeah... about that... I kind of don't have it with me...
translation: 呃...是的...关于那个...我好像没有带它... [e ... shi de ... guan yu na ge ... wo hao xiang mei you dai ta ...]

english: What kind of person tells me they have a delivery for me, but not with them? Honestly.
translation: 什么样的人告诉我他们有送货给我，但没有和他们一起送货？诚实地。 [shen me yang de ren gao su wo ta men you song huo gei wo ， dan mei you he ta men yi qi song huo ？ cheng shi di 。]

english: Come back when you do.
translation: 当你回来的时候就回来吧。 [dang ni hui lai de shi hou jiu hui lai ba 。]

english: Anything useful in that package I gave you?
translation: 我给你的那个包裹里有什么有用的东西吗？ [wo gei ni de na ge bao guo li you shen me you yong de dong xi ma ？]

english: Well, let's have a look...
translation: 好吧，让我们看看... [hao ba ， rang wo men kan kan ...]

english: Hello. Did you take those notes back to Sedridor?
translation: 你好。你把那些笔记带回塞德里多了吗？ [ni hao 。 ni ba na xie bi ji dai hui sai de li duo le ma ？]

english: Sorry, but I lost them.
translation: 抱歉，但我把它们弄丢了。 [bao qian ， dan wo ba ta men nong diu le 。]

english: Well, luckily I have duplicates. It's a good thing they are written in code. I wouldn't want the wrong kind of person to get access to the information contained within.
translation: 好吧，幸运的是我有重复的。它们是用代码编写的，这是一件好事。我不希望错误的人访问其中包含的信息。 [hao ba ， xing yun de shi wo you chong fu de 。 ta men shi yong dai ma bian xie de ， zhe shi yi jian hao shi 。 wo bu xi wang cuo wu de ren fang wen qi zhong bao han de xin xi 。]

english: I'm still working on it.
translation: 我还在努力。 [wo hai zai nu li 。]

english: Don't take too long. He'll be eager to see if this is indeed the breakthrough we were hoping for.
translation: 不要花太长时间。他会迫不及待地想看看这是否确实是我们所希望的突破。 [bu yao hua tai zhang shi jian 。 ta hui po bu ji dai di xiang kan kan zhe shi fou que shi shi wo men suo xi wang de tu po 。]

english: Now, did you want to buy some runes?
translation: 现在，你想买一些符文吗？ [xian zai ， ni xiang mai yi xie fu wen ma ？]

english: Actually, I'm here with a business proposal from Ali Morrisane.
translation: 事实上，我是带着阿里·莫里萨内的一份商业提案来的。 [shi shi shang ， wo shi dai zhe a li · mo li sa nei de yi fen shang ye ti an lai de 。]

english: Ali who?
translation: 阿里是谁？ [a li shi shui ？]

english: Ali Morrisane, a salesman of great repute based in Al Kharid.
translation: 阿里·莫里萨内 (Ali Morrisane) 是阿尔卡里德 (Al Kharid) 一位享有盛誉的推销员。 [a li · mo li sa nei  (Ali Morrisane)  shi a er ka li de  (Al Kharid)  yi wei xiang you sheng yu de tui xiao yuan 。]

english: What is this proposal then?
translation: 那么这个提议是什么？ [na me zhe ge ti yi shi shen me ？]

english: He wants to set up a rune-selling franchise in the markets of Al Kharid and he wants you to supply him with the stock.
translation: 他想在阿尔卡里德市场建立符文销售专营权，并希望你向他提供库存。 [ta xiang zai a er ka li de shi chang jian li fu wen xiao shou zhuan ying quan ， bing xi wang ni xiang ta ti gong ku cun 。]

english: Why doesn't he get his own runes and sell them?
translation: 他为什么不得到自己的符文然后卖掉呢？ [ta wei shen me bu de dao zi ji de fu wen ran hou mai diao ne ？]

english: His talents don't lie in that area. What he's good at is selling things, and lots of them.
translation: 他的天赋并不在那个领域。他最擅长的是卖东西，而且是卖很多东西。 [ta de tian fu bing bu zai na ge ling yu 。 ta zui shan chang de shi mai dong xi ， er qie shi mai hen duo dong xi 。]

english: Hmm, interesting... So let's get this straight, he wants me to supply him with runes, which he will sell, and send me the profits?
translation: 嗯，有趣......所以让我们弄清楚这一点，他希望我向他提供符文，他将出售符文，然后将利润寄给我？ [n ， you qu ...... suo yi rang wo men nong qing chu zhe yi dian ， ta xi wang wo xiang ta ti gong fu wen ， ta jiang chu shou fu wen ， ran hou jiang li run ji gei wo ？]

english: Nearly. He will charge a small commission on the runes.
translation: 几乎。他将对符文收取少量佣金。 [ji hu 。 ta jiang dui fu wen shou qu shao liang yong jin 。]

english: Do you think that it will work? Will people actually buy these runes off him?
translation: 你认为这会起作用吗？人们真的会从他那里购买这些符文吗？ [ni ren wei zhe hui qi zuo yong ma ？ ren men zhen de hui cong ta na li gou mai zhe xie fu wen ma ？]

english: I wouldn't be surprised. Supply and demand are his rune essence and ore.
translation: 我不会感到惊讶。供给和需求就是他的符文精华和矿石。 [wo bu hui gan dao jing ya 。 gong ji he xu qiu jiu shi ta de fu wen jing hua he kuang shi 。]

english: Now this is very important, is he trustworthy?
translation: 现在这很重要，他值得信任吗？ [xian zai zhe hen zhong yao ， ta zhi de xin ren ma ？]

english: Yes, I believe so. Trust is a key part of commerce and something, which I doubt he would neglect.
translation: 是的，我相信是的。信任是商业的关键部分，我怀疑他会忽视这一点。 [shi de ， wo xiang xin shi de 。 xin ren shi shang ye de guan jian bu fen ， wo huai yi ta hui hu shi zhe yi dian 。]

english: Fair enough, I'll trust your judgement.
translation: 公平地说，我相信你的判断。 [gong ping di shuo ， wo xiang xin ni de pan duan 。]

english: So you'll supply him with runes then?
translation: 那么你会为他提供符文吗？ [na me ni hui wei ta ti gong fu wen ma ？]

english: Well if he's half as good a salesman as you suggest I should have no problem in funding my research and maybe even redecorating this place.
translation: 好吧，如果他的推销员有你建议的一半那么我在资助我的研究甚至重新装修这个地方应该没有问题。 [hao ba ， ru guo ta de tui xiao yuan you ni jian yi de yi ban na me wo zai zi zhu wo de yan jiu shen zhi chong xin zhuang xiu zhe ge di fang ying gai mei you wen ti 。]

english: Oh, sorry [player name], I didn't recognise you for a second, you're back again so soon. Have you spoken to Ali Morrisane yet about the runes?
translation: 哦，抱歉[玩家名字]，我一瞬间没认出你，你这么快就回来了。你和 Ali Morrisane 谈过符文的事了吗？ [o ， bao qian [ wan jia ming zi ]， wo yi shun jian mei ren chu ni ， ni zhe me kuai jiu hui lai le 。 ni he  Ali Morrisane  tan guo fu wen de shi le ma ？]

english: Umm... not yet, I'll try to get around to doing that soon.
translation: 嗯……还没有，我会尽快抽出时间来做这件事。 [n …… hai mei you ， wo hui jin kuai chou chu shi jian lai zuo zhe jian shi 。]

english: Ya... about that, there's some crazy locking mechanism attached to each casket of runes, which he cannot figure out.
translation: 是的……关于这一点，每个符文盒子上都有一些疯狂的锁定机制，他无法弄清楚。 [shi de …… guan yu zhe yi dian ， mei ge fu wen he zi shang dou you yi xie feng kuang de suo ding ji zhi ， ta wu fa nong qing chu 。]

english: Oh, yes, the rune locks, they're a bit of a doozy, I've completely forgotten how they work, but I'm sure they shouldn't prove too much of a struggle to an intelligent adventurererlike you, [player name]. Eh?
translation: 哦，是的，符文锁，它们有点奇怪，我完全忘记了它们是如何工作的，但我确信它们不应该对像你这样聪明的冒险家来说太困难，[玩家名字]。呃？ [o ， shi de ， fu wen suo ， ta men you dian qi guai ， wo wan quan wang ji le ta men shi ru he gong zuo de ， dan wo que xin ta men bu ying gai dui xiang ni zhe yang cong ming de mao xian jia lai shuo tai kun nan ，[ wan jia ming zi ]。 e ？]

english: I wouldn't hold my breath.
translation: 我不会屏住呼吸。 [wo bu hui bing zhu hu xi 。]

english: Great! Now, do want to buy some runes?
translation: 伟大的！现在，想买一些符文吗？ [wei da de ！ xian zai ， xiang mai yi xie fu wen ma ？]

english: Can you tell me about your cape?
translation: 你能告诉我你的斗篷吗？ [ni neng gao su wo ni de dou peng ma ？]

english: I'd like to view your store please.
translation: 我想参观一下你们的商店。 [wo xiang can guan yi xia ni men de shang dian 。]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Yes please!
translation: 是的，请！ [shi de ， qing ！]

english: Oh, it's a rune shop. No thank you, then.
translation: 哦，这是符文商店。那就不用了，谢谢。 [o ， zhe shi fu wen shang dian 。 na jiu bu yong le ， xie xie 。]

english: Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence?
translation: 你能将我传送到符文精华吗？ [ni neng jiang wo chuan song dao fu wen jing hua ma ？]

english: I have been sent here with a package for you.
translation: 我已经被派到这里给你带来一个包裹。 [wo yi jing bei pai dao zhe li gei ni dai lai yi ge bao guo 。]

english: Anything useful in that package I gave you?
translation: 我给你的那个包裹里有什么有用的东西吗？ [wo gei ni de na ge bao guo li you shen me you yong de dong xi ma ？]

english: Actually, I'm here with a business proposal from Ali Morrisane.
translation: 事实上，我是带着阿里·莫里萨内的一份商业提案来的。 [shi shi shang ， wo shi dai zhe a li · mo li sa nei de yi fen shang ye ti an lai de 。]

english: Gather round, one and all! It's time for the Darkmeyer Auctions!
translation: 全体聚集一堂！达克梅尔拍卖会的时间到了！ [quan ti ju ji yi tang ！ da ke mei er pai mai hui de shi jian dao le ！]

english: We've got quite the lineup for you today! So, let's get started!
translation: 今天我们为您准备了丰富的阵容！那么，让我们开始吧！ [jin tian wo men wei nin zhun bei le feng fu de zhen rong ！ na me ， rang wo men kai shi ba ！]

english: First up, a 37 year old male from sector four!
translation: 首先是一名来自四区的37岁男性！ [shou xian shi yi ming lai zi si qu de 37 sui nan xing ！]

english: He's got plenty of blood in him, and he'll keep your home clean of any mess!
translation: 他体内有充足的血液，他会让你的家干净整洁！ [ta ti nei you chong zu de xue ye ， ta hui rang ni de jia gan jing zheng jie ！]

english: Let's start the bidding at 1,000 coins! Do I have 1,000?
translation: 我们以1000金币起拍吧！我有1000吗？ [wo men yi 1000 jin bi qi pai ba ！ wo you 1000 ma ？]

english: Here!
translation: 这里！ [zhe li ！]

english: 1,000 coins to the vyre at the back! Do I have 2,000?
translation: 1000金币给后面的vyre！我有2000吗？ [1000 jin bi gei hou mian de vyre！ wo you 2000 ma ？]

english: I'll take it!
translation: 我要买它！ [wo yao mai ta ！]

english: 2,000 for the lady in red! Anyone for 3,000?
translation: 红衣女子2000块！有人要3000吗？ [hong yi nv zi 2000 kuai ！ you ren yao 3000 ma ？]

english: I have 3,000! But do I have 4,000?
translation: 我有3000个！但我有4000吗？ [wo you 3000 ge ！ dan wo you 4000 ma ？]

english: Anyone for 4,000?
translation: 有人要4000吗？ [you ren yao 4000 ma ？]

english: 3,000 going once!
3,000 going twice!
translation: 3000 去两次！ [3000  qu liang ci ！]

english: Sold to the vyre at the back!
translation: 卖给了后面的维雷！ [mai gei le hou mian de wei lei ！]

english: Right then! Next we have a 22 year old female from sector six!
translation: 就在那时！接下来是一位来自六区的 22 岁女性！ [jiu zai na shi ！ jie xia lai shi yi wei lai zi liu qu de  22  sui nv xing ！]

english: She's young and filled with optimism! Perfect for those who enjoy a taste of hope!
translation: 她年轻，充满乐观！非常适合那些享受希望滋味的人！ [ta nian qing ， chong man le guan ！ fei chang shi he na xie xiang shou xi wang zi wei de ren ！]

english: We'll start with 5,000 for this one! Do I have any takers!
translation: 我们将从 5,000 美元开始！我有没有人接盘啊！ [wo men jiang cong  5,000  mei yuan kai shi ！ wo you mei you ren jie pan a ！]

english: Right here!
translation: 就在这里！ [jiu zai zhe li ！]

english: 5,000 coins for the lady at the front! How about 6,000?
translation: 给前面那位女士5000金币！六千怎么样？ [gei qian mian na wei nv shi 5000 jin bi ！ liu qian zen me yang ？]

english: Give it to me!
translation: 把它给我！ [ba ta gei wo ！]

english: I have 6,000! Who wants 7,000!
translation: 我有六千！谁要七千啊！ [wo you liu qian ！ shui yao qi qian a ！]

english: I'll take her for 10,000!
translation: 我花一万就收下她！ [wo hua yi wan jiu shou xia ta ！]

english: 10,000! We have a bid of 10,000! You lot really want this one! Anyone up for 12,000?
translation: 一万！我们的出价是10,000！你们真的很想要这个！有人要12000吗？ [yi wan ！ wo men de chu jia shi 10,000！ ni men zhen de hen xiang yao zhe ge ！ you ren yao 12000 ma ？]

english: Anyone for any more? 13,000?
translation: 还有人要吗？ 13,000？ [hai you ren yao ma ？ 13,000？]

english: 12,000 going once!
translation: 12000人去一次！ [12000 ren qu yi ci ！]

english: 12,000 going twice!
translation: 12,000 去两次！ [12,000  qu liang ci ！]

english: Sold for 12,000 coins! Enjoy!
translation: 售价12,000金币！享受！ [shou jia 12,000 jin bi ！ xiang shou ！]

english: Okay, finally we have a 41 year old male from sector three!
translation: 好的，终于找到了来自第三区的 41 岁男性！ [hao de ， zhong yu zhao dao le lai zi di san qu de  41  sui nan xing ！]

english: Careful! This one is feisty! In fact, we've had to put him in a cage!
translation: 小心！这一位很霸气啊！事实上，我们不得不把他关在笼子里！ [xiao xin ！ zhe yi wei hen ba qi a ！ shi shi shang ， wo men bu de bu ba ta guan zai long zi li ！]

english: If you can put him in his place though, you're in for a treat! His blood is the sweetest around!
translation: 如果你能把他放在他的位置上，你就大饱口福了！他的血是最甜的！ [ru guo ni neng ba ta fang zai ta de wei zhi shang ， ni jiu da bao kou fu le ！ ta de xue shi zui tian de ！]

english: We'll begin with 4,000 coins!
translation: 我们将从 4,000 个金币开始！ [wo men jiang cong  4,000  ge jin bi kai shi ！]

english: I have 4,000! But do I have 5,000?
translation: 我有4000！但我有5000吗？ [wo you 4000！ dan wo you 5000 ma ？]

english: 5,000 coins to the vyre in red! Do I have 6,000?
translation: 5,000 枚金币送给红色的 vyre！我有6000吗？ [5,000  mei jin bi song gei hong se de  vyre！ wo you 6000 ma ？]

english: 6,000 coins! Looks like we have a competition here! Let's take it to 7,000!
translation: 6000金币！看来我们这里有一场比赛！让我们把它加到7000吧！ [6000 jin bi ！ kan lai wo men zhe li you yi chang bi sai ！ rang wo men ba ta jia dao 7000 ba ！]

english: We're at 7,000! But will it go higher? 8,000 coins?
translation: 我们已经7000了！但它会更高吗？ 8000金币？ [wo men yi jing 7000 le ！ dan ta hui geng gao ma ？ 8000 jin bi ？]

english: 7,000 going once!
translation: 7000人去一次！ [7000 ren qu yi ci ！]

english: 7,000 going twice!
translation: 7000人去两次！ [7000 ren qu liang ci ！]

english: Sold to the vyre in red!
translation: 卖给了红色的维雷！ [mai gei le hong se de wei lei ！]

english: Well there you have it! That's all for now from the Darkmeyer Auctions!
translation: 好吧，你已经拥有了！这就是达克梅尔拍卖行目前的全部内容！ [hao ba ， ni yi jing yong you le ！ zhe jiu shi da ke mei er pai mai hang mu qian de quan bu nei rong ！]

english: Fear not though. We'll be back with more, very soon!
translation: 不过不要害怕。我们很快就会带着更多回来！ [bu guo bu yao hai pa 。 wo men hen kuai jiu hui dai zhe geng duo hui lai ！]

english: Oh, don't bother me human.
translation: 哦，人类，别打扰我。 [o ， ren lei ， bie da rao wo 。]

english: Why not? What's wrong?
translation: 为什么不呢？怎么了？ [wei shen me bu ne ？ zen me le ？]

english: You are wrong, human. Your attire is outrageous. Your presence is obnoxious.
translation: 你错了，人类。你的着装太离谱了。你的存在令人讨厌。 [ni cuo le ， ren lei 。 ni de zhuo zhuang tai li pu le 。 ni de cun zai ling ren tao yan 。]

english: What? What are you saying?
translation: 什么？你在说什么？ [shen me ？ ni zai shuo shen me ？]

english: I'm saying you're in my way.
translation: 我是说你挡了我的路。 [wo shi shuo ni dang le wo de lu 。]

english: Greetings! Would you like to be my number one  accomplice? I mean, assistant?
translation: 问候！你愿意成为我的第一同伙吗？我是说，助理？ [wen hou ！ ni yuan yi cheng wei wo de di yi tong huo ma ？ wo shi shuo ， zhu li ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I am Auguste. I am going to be the first balloonist in all of Gielinor!
translation: 我是奥古斯特。我将成为吉林诺的第一个热气球驾驶员！ [wo shi ao gu si te 。 wo jiang cheng wei ji lin nuo de di yi ge re qi qiu jia shi yuan ！]

english: Balloo-what? I thought only monks lived on Entrana.
translation: 气球-什么？我以为只有僧侣住在恩特拉纳。 [qi qiu - shen me ？ wo yi wei zhi you seng lv zhu zai en te la na 。]

english: Well, they do... I was a monk. But I'm so sick of living on this island! I want to explore new frontiers!
translation: 嗯，他们确实...我是一个和尚。但我实在厌倦了在这个岛上的生活！我想探索新的领域！ [n ， ta men que shi ... wo shi yi ge he shang 。 dan wo shi zai yan juan le zai zhe ge dao shang de sheng huo ！ wo xiang tan suo xin de ling yu ！]

english: And go where no man has gone before?
translation: 去没有人去过的地方？ [qu mei you ren qu guo de di fang ？]

english: Maybe! That sounds good. I was thinking just over to Taverley, though.
translation: 或许！听起来很好。不过，我只想到塔弗利。 [huo xu ！ ting qi lai hen hao 。 bu guo ， wo zhi xiang dao ta fu li 。]

english: Why not take the boat then?
translation: 那为什么不坐船呢？ [na wei shen me bu zuo chuan ne ？]

english: Ugh! Ocean! Don't talk to me about the ocean...oh dear...I feel ill.
translation: 啊!海洋！别跟我谈论海洋……天哪……我感觉不舒服。 [a ! hai yang ！ bie gen wo tan lun hai yang …… tian na …… wo gan jue bu shu fu 。]

english: Whoa, ok, no ocean. How exactly are you going to get off the island, then?
translation: 哇，好吧，没有海洋。那你到底要怎么离开这个岛呢？ [wa ， hao ba ， mei you hai yang 。 na ni dao di yao zen me li kai zhe ge dao ne ？]

english: I have devised a new way to travel. But I need an assistant balloonist to help me build my design.
translation: 我设计了一种新的旅行方式。但我需要一名热气球助理来帮助我构建我的设计。 [wo she ji le yi zhong xin de lv xing fang shi 。 dan wo xu yao yi ming re qi qiu zhu li lai bang zhu wo gou jian wo de she ji 。]

english: Are you an experienced adventurer willing to help me?
translation: 你是一位经验丰富的冒险家愿意帮助我吗？ [ni shi yi wei jing yan feng fu de mao xian jia yuan yi bang zhu wo ma ？]

english: Yes! Sign me up.
translation: 是的！给我报名吧 [shi de ！ gei wo bao ming ba]

english: Wonderful! Let's get started.
translation: 精彩的！让我们开始吧。 [jing cai de ！ rang wo men kai shi ba 。]

english: Wait, I still don't know exactly what we're doing.
translation: 等等，我还是不太清楚我们在做什么。 [deng deng ， wo hai shi bu tai qing chu wo men zai zuo shen me 。]

english: Of course, of course, how foolish of me. Well, we are going to make a balloon.
translation: 当然，当然，我真是太愚蠢了。好吧，我们要做一个气球。 [dang ran ， dang ran ， wo zhen shi tai yu chun le 。 hao ba ， wo men yao zuo yi ge qi qiu 。]

english: Which is what exactly?
translation: 到底是什么？ [dao di shi shen me ？]

english: Let me show you!
translation: 让我告诉你！ [rang wo gao su ni ！]

english: I don't think so.
translation: 我不这么认为。 [wo bu zhe me ren wei 。]

english: Oh, never mind then.
translation: 哦，那没关系。 [o ， na mei guan xi 。]

english: Hello, [player name]. It is good to see you again. My enterprise has grown since we last met. I've expanded all over Gielinor!
translation: 你好，[玩家姓名]。很高兴再次见到你。自从我们上次见面以来，我的企业不断发展。我已经扩展到吉林诺了！ [ni hao ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。 hen gao xing zai ci jian dao ni 。 zi cong wo men shang ci jian mian yi lai ， wo de qi ye bu duan fa zhan 。 wo yi jing kuo zhan dao ji lin nuo le ！]

english: If you'd like to go to a new location, you will have to help fly the balloon again. Some of the routes are very dangerous!
translation: 如果你想去一个新的地点，你就必须再次帮助放飞气球。有些路线非常危险！ [ru guo ni xiang qu yi ge xin de di dian ， ni jiu bi xu zai ci bang zhu fang fei qi qiu 。 you xie lu xian fei chang wei xian ！]

english: But each route you complete will earn you Firemaking experience.
translation: 但您完成的每条路线都会为您赢得生火经验。 [dan nin wan cheng de mei tiao lu xian du hui wei nin ying de sheng huo jing yan 。]

english: Once you've opened a route, it only costs 1 log of the corresponding type to travel there again, from any location you've already opened!
translation: 一旦你打开了一条路线，从你已经打开的任何地点再次前往该路线只需花费 1 个相应类型的日志！ [yi dan ni da kai le yi tiao lu xian ， cong ni yi jing da kai de ren he di dian zai ci qian wang gai lu xian zhi xu hua fei  1  ge xiang ying lei xing de ri zhi ！]

english: I have also hired assistants to watch over the balloons at each new location we go to. They will help you get where you want to go.
translation: 我还聘请了助手来监视我们去的每个新地点的气球。他们将帮助您到达您想去的地方。 [wo hai pin qing le zhu shou lai jian shi wo men qu de mei ge xin di dian de qi qiu 。 ta men jiang bang zhu nin dao da nin xiang qu de di fang 。]

english: Do you want to use the balloon? Just so you know, some locations require special logs and high Firemaking skills.
translation: 你想使用气球吗？如您所知，某些地点需要特殊的原木和高水平的生火技能。 [ni xiang shi yong qi qiu ma ？ ru nin suo zhi ， mou xie di dian xu yao te shu de yuan mu he gao shui ping de sheng huo ji neng 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Could you tell me how to make an origami balloon?
translation: 你能告诉我如何折纸气球吗？ [ni neng gao su wo ru he zhe zhi qi qiu ma ？]

english: First, use the papyrus on the ball of wool. The papyrus is folded into an origami box and the yarn will support the heat source.
translation: 首先，在羊毛球上使用纸莎草。将纸莎草折叠成折纸盒，纱线将支撑热源。 [shou xian ， zai yang mao qiu shang shi yong zhi suo cao 。 jiang zhi suo cao zhe die cheng zhe zhi he ， sha xian jiang zhi cheng re yuan 。]

english: Next, add the unlit candle to the balloon structure. It will act as the heat source.
translation: 接下来，将未点燃的蜡烛添加到气球结构中。它将充当热源。 [jie xia lai ， jiang wei dian ran de la zhu tian jia dao qi qiu jie gou zhong 。 ta jiang chong dang re yuan 。]

english: Now you have an origami balloon!
translation: 现在你有了一个折纸气球！ [xian zai ni you le yi ge zhe zhi qi qiu ！]

english: If you use your origami balloon with any dye, you can change the colour.
translation: 如果您将折纸气球与任何染料一起使用，则可以改变颜色。 [ru guo nin jiang zhe zhi qi qiu yu ren he ran liao yi qi shi yong ， ze ke yi gai bian yan se 。]

english: You can release the balloon and watch it float in the air, just use a tinderbox on it.
translation: 您可以释放气球并观看它漂浮在空中，只需在其上使用火药盒即可。 [nin ke yi shi fang qi qiu bing guan kan ta piao fu zai kong zhong ， zhi xu zai qi shang shi yong huo yao he ji ke 。]

english: You don't have enough free space for your cap.
translation: 您没有足够的可用空间来放置帽子。 [nin mei you zu gou de ke yong kong jian lai fang zhi mao zi 。]

english: Here's your cap. Try to keep better track of it.
translation: 这是你的帽子。尝试更好地跟踪它。 [zhe shi ni de mao zi 。 chang shi geng hao di gen zong ta 。]

english: You don't need a new jacket; you still have your original one.
translation: 你不需要一件新夹克；你还保留着原来的那张。 [ni bu xu yao yi jian xin jia ke ； ni hai bao liu zhe yuan lai de na zhang 。]

english: You don't have enough free space for your jacket.
translation: 您没有足够的空间来放置夹克。 [nin mei you zu gou de kong jian lai fang zhi jia ke 。]

english: Here's your jacket, to keep you warm during flight.
translation: 这是你的夹克，可以让你在飞行时保暖。 [zhe shi ni de jia ke ， ke yi rang ni zai fei xing shi bao nuan 。]

english: There you go! You look like a true airship pilot now.
translation: 就这样吧！你现在看起来像一个真正的飞艇飞行员了。 [jiu zhe yang ba ！ ni xian zai kan qi lai xiang yi ge zhen zheng de fei ting fei xing yuan le 。]

english: I can't combine them if you are wearing them.
translation: 如果你戴着它们，我就无法将它们组合起来。 [ru guo ni dai zhe ta men ， wo jiu wu fa jiang ta men zu he qi lai 。]

english: You don't have enough free space for the cap and goggles.
translation: 您没有足够的空间放置帽子和护目镜。 [nin mei you zu gou de kong jian fang zhi mao zi he hu mu jing 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Could you tell me how to make an origami balloon?
translation: 你能告诉我如何折纸气球吗？ [ni neng gao su wo ru he zhe zhi qi qiu ma ？]

english: Could you replace some items for me?
translation: 你能为我更换一些物品吗？ [ni neng wei wo geng huan yi xie wu pin ma ？]

english: Could you combine my cap and goggles?
translation: 你能把我的帽子和护目镜结合起来吗？ [ni neng ba wo de mao zi he hu mu jing jie he qi lai ma ？]

english: Hey it's the hero! Thank you so much for saving us from Gadderanks. And the town is looking lovely as well. You've done a great job!
translation: 嘿，这就是英雄！非常感谢你把我们从加德兰克手中救了出来。这个小镇看起来也很漂亮。你做得很好！ [hei ， zhe jiu shi ying xiong ！ fei chang gan xie ni ba wo men cong jia de lan ke shou zhong jiu le chu lai 。 zhe ge xiao zhen kan qi lai ye hen piao liang 。 ni zuo de hen hao ！]

english: You're more than welcome.
translation: 非常欢迎您。 [fei chang huan ying nin 。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm Aurel the village store owner.
translation: 我是村里商店的老板奥雷尔。 [wo shi cun li shang dian de lao ban ao lei er 。]

english: Can you open the shop for me please?
translation: 请问可以帮我开店吗？ [qing wen ke yi bang wo kai dian ma ？]

english: How do you like your town?
translation: 你喜欢你的城市吗？ [ni xi huan ni de cheng shi ma ？]

english: It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
translation: 非常完美，非常感谢您的努力。 [fei chang wan mei ， fei chang gan xie nin de nu li 。]

english: What's happening around here?
translation: 这附近发生了什么事？ [zhe fu jin fa sheng le shen me shi ？]

english: Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: 哦，其实也没什么，我们都还在躲避吸血鬼，在这个可怕的地方勉强维持生计，希望很快我们就能足够强大，踏上前往圣殿的旅程。 [o ， qi shi ye mei shen me ， wo men dou hai zai duo bi xi xue gui ， zai zhe ge ke pa de di fang mian qiang wei chi sheng ji ， xi wang hen kuai wo men jiu neng zu gou qiang da ， ta shang qian wang sheng dian de lv cheng 。]

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang mang de ma ？]

english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: 据我所知，我们现在有一些非常有用的基本设施，我们都非常感谢您。我以前从未真正见过或认识英雄，所以我没有什么可以与之比较的，但我怀疑 [ju wo suo zhi ， wo men xian zai you yi xie fei chang you yong de ji ben she shi ， wo men dou fei chang gan xie nin 。 wo yi qian cong wei zhen zheng jian guo huo ren shi ying xiong ， suo yi wo mei you shen me ke yi yu zhi bi jiao de ， dan wo huai yi]

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: 大多数人的判断，你就是其中之一！我很高兴见到你。 [da duo shu ren de pan duan ， ni jiu shi qi zhong zhi yi ！ wo hen gao xing jian dao ni 。]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: I've lost Gadderanks' Warhammer.
translation: 我丢失了加德兰克的战锤。 [wo diu shi le jia de lan ke de zhan chui 。]

english: Hmm, how careless of you! However, you're in luck! Someone found it earlier and sold it to me.
translation: 哼，你真是太不小心了！不过，你很幸运！之前有人发现了，卖给我了。 [heng ， ni zhen shi tai bu xiao xin le ！ bu guo ， ni hen xing yun ！ zhi qian you ren fa xian le ， mai gei wo le 。]

english: Now I can pass the hammer back to you for the remarkably cheap price of 3000 gold coins. Deal?
translation: 现在我可以以3000金币的超便宜价格把锤子还给你。交易？ [xian zai wo ke yi yi 3000 jin bi de chao pian yi jia ge ba chui zi huan gei ni 。 jiao yi ？]

english: But I don't have 3000 coins on me?
translation: 可是我身上没有3000金币啊？ [ke shi wo shen shang mei you 3000 jin bi a ？]

english: So that means you can't have it then! Come back when you have 3000 coins.
translation: 那么这意味着你不能拥有它！等你有3000金币了再回来。 [na me zhe yi wei zhe ni bu neng yong you ta ！ deng ni you 3000 jin bi le zai hui lai 。]

english: Oayk, I'll pay 3000 coins for the hammer.
translation: 哎呀，我出3000金币买锤子。 [ai ya ， wo chu 3000 jin bi mai chui zi 。]

english: A good deal and I'm sure of it!
translation: 很划算，我确信这一点！ [hen hua suan ， wo que xin zhe yi dian ！]

english: No thanks, I'll leave it, 3000 coins is too much to pay.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我就不说了，3000金币太贵了。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo jiu bu shuo le ，3000 jin bi tai gui le 。]

english: Very good then! I'll have no guilty conscience in offering it to other adventurers that frequent my shop then. Many thanks for your time and good day to ya sir.
translation: 那就太好了！我不会有任何负罪感地把它提供给其他经常光顾我店的冒险家。非常感谢您抽出宝贵的时间，祝先生有美好的一天。 [na jiu tai hao le ！ wo bu hui you ren he fu zui gan di ba ta ti gong gei qi ta jing chang guang gu wo dian de mao xian jia 。 fei chang gan xie nin chou chu bao gui de shi jian ， zhu xian sheng you mei hao de yi tian 。]

english: Why does the hammer cost so much?
translation: 为什么锤子这么贵？ [wei shen me chui zi zhe me gui ？]

english: So much! That's cheap! The adventurer I bought it from wanted twice as much but I managed to knock him down to a reasonable price.
translation: 这么多！那很便宜！向我购买它的冒险家想要两倍的价格，但我设法把他压到了一个合理的价格。 [zhe me duo ！ na hen pian yi ！ xiang wo gou mai ta de mao xian jia xiang yao liang bei de jia ge ， dan wo she fa ba ta ya dao le yi ge he li de jia ge 。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: How do you like your town?
translation: 你喜欢你的城市吗？ [ni xi huan ni de cheng shi ma ？]

english: What's happening around here?
translation: 这附近发生了什么事？ [zhe fu jin fa sheng le shen me shi ？]

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang mang de ma ？]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: I've lost Gadderanks' Warhammer.
translation: 我丢失了加德兰克的战锤。 [wo diu shi le jia de lan ke de zhan chui 。]

english: Okay, I'll pay 3000 coins for the hammer.
translation: 好吧，我出3000金币买锤子。 [hao ba ， wo chu 3000 jin bi mai chui zi 。]

english: No thanks, I'll leave it. 3000 coins is too much to pay.
translation: 不，谢谢，我会留下它。 3000金币太贵了。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo hui liu xia ta 。 3000 jin bi tai gui le 。]

english: Why does the hammer cost so much?
translation: 为什么锤子这么贵？ [wei shen me chui zi zhe me gui ？]

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm blending in. Scopin' out the place.
translation: 我正在融入其中。观察这个地方。 [wo zheng zai rong ru qi zhong 。 guan cha zhe ge di fang 。]

english: Are you preparing for a heist? You're only a kid.
translation: 你准备好抢劫了吗？你只是个孩子。 [ni zhun bei hao qiang jie le ma ？ ni zhi shi ge hai zi 。]

english: Let's just say there are some wealthy people about, with full pockets.
translation: 假设有一些有钱人，口袋里装满了钱。 [jia she you yi xie you qian ren ， kou dai li zhuang man le qian 。]

english: Any tips? I'm not having much luck myself.
translation: 有什么建议吗？我自己的运气并不好。 [you shen me jian yi ma ？ wo zi ji de yun qi bing bu hao 。]

english: I'm quite sneaky. Every now and then I'll get their attention so their pockets aren't being so carefully watched.
translation: 我真是太狡猾了。我会时不时地引起他们的注意，这样他们的口袋就不会受到如此仔细的监视。 [wo zhen shi tai jiao hua le 。 wo hui shi bu shi di yin qi ta men de zhu yi ， zhe yang ta men de kou dai jiu bu hui shou dao ru ci zi xi de jian shi 。]

english: That is sneaky. I'll keep an eye out for your... distractions.
translation: 那是偷偷摸摸的。我会留意你的……干扰因素。 [na shi tou tou mo mo de 。 wo hui liu yi ni de …… gan rao yin su 。]

english: Now leave me be. I'm already distracting!
translation: 现在别管我了。我已经分散注意力了！ [xian zai bie guan wo le 。 wo yi jing fen san zhu yi li le ！]

english: Hmmph. What do you want?
translation: 哼。你想要什么？ [heng 。 ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: I was just wondering what was down those stairs?
translation: 我只是想知道楼梯下有什么？ [wo zhi shi xiang zhi dao lou ti xia you shen me ？]

english: You can't go down there!
translation: 你不能下去那里！ [ni bu neng xia qu na li ！]

english: I didn't want to anyway.
translation: 反正我也不想。 [fan zheng wo ye bu xiang 。]

english: Good. Because you can't.
translation: 好的。因为你不能。 [hao de 。 yin wei ni bu neng 。]

english: Because I don't want to.
translation: 因为我不想。 [yin wei wo bu xiang 。]

english: Because you can't. So that's fine.
translation: 因为你不能。所以没关系。 [yin wei ni bu neng 。 suo yi mei guan xi 。]

english: Yes, it is.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: Yes. Fine.
translation: 是的。美好的。 [shi de 。 mei hao de 。]

english: Absolutely.
translation: 绝对地。 [jue dui di 。]

english: Well then.
translation: 那么好吧。 [na me hao ba 。]

english: Why not?
translation: 为什么不呢？ [wei shen me bu ne ？]

english: This is the home of the Mountain Dwarves. How would you like it if I wanted to take a shortcut through your home?
translation: 这里是山地矮人的家园。如果我想抄近路经过你家，你觉得怎么样？ [zhe li shi shan di ai ren de jia yuan 。 ru guo wo xiang chao jin lu jing guo ni jia ， ni jue de zen me yang ？]

english: Ooh... is this a shortcut to somewhere?
translation: 哦……这是通往某个地方的捷径吗？ [o …… zhe shi tong wang mou ge di fang de jie jing ma ？]

english: Well, it is a lot easier to go this way to get past White Wolf Mountain than through those wolf filled passes.
translation: 嗯，沿着这条路穿过白狼山，比穿过那些狼群遍布的山口要容易得多。 [n ， yan zhe zhe tiao lu chuan guo bai lang shan ， bi chuan guo na xie lang qun bian bu de shan kou yao rong yi de duo 。]

english: Oh, sorry, I hadn't realised it was private.
translation: 哦，抱歉，我没有意识到这是私人的。 [o ， bao qian ， wo mei you yi shi dao zhe shi si ren de 。]

english: Well, it is.
translation: 嗯，确实如此。 [n ， que shi ru ci 。]

english: If you were my friend I wouldn't mind.
translation: 如果你是我的朋友我不会介意。 [ru guo ni shi wo de peng you wo bu hui jie yi 。]

english: Yes, but I don't even know you.
translation: 是的，但我什至不认识你。 [shi de ， dan wo shen zhi bu ren shi ni 。]

english: Well, let's be friends!
translation: 好吧，我们做朋友吧！ [hao ba ， wo men zuo peng you ba ！]

english: I'd rather not, thank you.
translation: 我宁愿不要，谢谢。 [wo ning yuan bu yao ， xie xie 。]

english: This quest is not available on Speedrunning Worlds.
translation: 该任务不适用于极速狂奔世界。 [gai ren wu bu shi yong yu ji su kuang ben shi jie 。]

english: You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Fishing Contest quest.
translation: 您不满足开始钓鱼比赛任务的所有要求。 [nin bu man zu kai shi diao yu bi sai ren wu de suo you yao qiu 。]

english: And how am I meant to do that?
translation: 我该怎么做呢？ [wo gai zen me zuo ne ？]

english: My, we are the persistent one aren't we?
translation: 哎呀，我们是最执着的人不是吗？ [ai ya ， wo men shi zui zhi zhuo de ren bu shi ma ？]

english: Well, there's a certain gold artefact we're after. We dwarves are big fans of gold! This artefact is the first prize at the Hemenster fishing competition.
translation: 嗯，我们正在寻找某种黄金文物。我们矮人是黄金的忠实粉丝！这件文物是赫门斯特钓鱼比赛的一等奖。 [n ， wo men zheng zai xun zhao mou zhong huang jin wen wu 。 wo men ai ren shi huang jin de zhong shi fen si ！ zhe jian wen wu shi he men si te diao yu bi sai de yi deng jiang 。]

english: Fortunately we have acquired a pass to enter that competition...
translation: 幸运的是，我们已经获得了参加那场比赛的通行证...... [xing yun de shi ， wo men yi jing huo de le can jia na chang bi sai de tong xing zheng ......]

english: Unfortunately Dwarves don't make good fishermen.
translation: 不幸的是，矮人并不是优秀的渔夫。 [bu xing de shi ， ai ren bing bu shi you xiu de yu fu 。]

english: Fortunately I'm alright at fishing!
translation: 幸好我钓鱼技术不错！ [xing hao wo diao yu ji shu bu cuo ！]

english: Okay. I entrust you with our competition pass. Don't forget to take some gold with you for the entrance fee.
translation: 好的。我将我们的比赛通行证委托给您。别忘了带一些金币作为入场费。 [hao de 。 wo jiang wo men de bi sai tong xing zheng wei tuo gei nin 。 bie wang le dai yi xie jin bi zuo wei ru chang fei 。]

english: Go to Hemenster and do us proud!
translation: 去赫门斯特，让我们感到骄傲！ [qu he men si te ， rang wo men gan dao jiao ao ！]

english: You're a grumpy little man aren't you?
translation: 你是个脾气暴躁的小男人，不是吗？ [ni shi ge pi qi bao zao de xiao nan ren ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Don't you know it.
translation: 你难道不知道吗？ [ni nan dao bu zhi dao ma ？]

english: I'm bigger than you. Let me by!
translation: 我比你大。让我过去吧！ [wo bi ni da 。 rang wo guo qu ba ！]

english: ...stumpy.
translation: ...矮墩墩。 [... ai dun dun 。]

english: Go away! You're not going to bully your way in HERE!
translation: 离开！你不能在这里欺负人！ [li kai ！ ni bu neng zai zhe li qi fu ren ！]

english: I was just stopping to say hello!
translation: 我只是停下来打个招呼！ [wo zhi shi ting xia lai da ge zhao hu ！]

english: Hello then.
translation: 那么你好。 [na me ni hao 。]

english: Do you have a brother?
translation: 你有兄弟吗？ [ni you xiong di ma ？]

english: What if I do! It's no business of yours.
translation: 如果我这样做怎么办！这不关你的事。 [ru guo wo zhe yang zuo zen me ban ！ zhe bu guan ni de shi 。]

english: Have you won yet?
translation: 你赢了吗？ [ni ying le ma ？]

english: No, not yet.
translation: 不，还没有。 [bu ， hai mei you 。]

english: Well don't give up! Maybe old Jack can give you a few tips.
translation: 好吧，不要放弃！也许老杰克可以给你一些建议。 [hao ba ， bu yao fang qi ！ ye xu lao jie ke ke yi gei ni yi xie jian yi 。]

english: Welcome, oh great Fishing Champion! Feel free to pop by and use our tunnel any time.
translation: 欢迎，伟大的钓鱼冠军！欢迎随时过来使用我们的隧道。 [huan ying ， wei da de diao yu guan jun ！ huan ying sui shi guo lai shi yong wo men de sui dao 。]

english: Thank you, I think I'll stop by for a beer one day.
translation: 谢谢你，我想有一天我会过来喝杯啤酒。 [xie xie ni ， wo xiang you yi tian wo hui guo lai he bei pi jiu 。]

english: I was wondering what was down those stairs?
translation: 我想知道楼梯下有什么？ [wo xiang zhi dao lou ti xia you shen me ？]

english: I didn't want to anyway.
translation: 反正我也不想。 [fan zheng wo ye bu xiang 。]

english: Why not?
translation: 为什么不呢？ [wei shen me bu ne ？]

english: Ooh... is this a shortcut to somewhere?
translation: 哦……这是通往某个地方的捷径吗？ [o …… zhe shi tong wang mou ge di fang de jie jing ma ？]

english: Oh, sorry, I hadn't realised it was private.
translation: 哦，抱歉，我没有意识到这是私人的。 [o ， bao qian ， wo mei you yi shi dao zhe shi si ren de 。]
