translation: 如果你是我的朋友我不会介意的。 [ru guo ni shi wo de peng you wo bu hui jie yi de 。]

english: Well, let's be friends!
translation: 好吧，我们做朋友吧！ [hao ba ， wo men zuo peng you ba ！]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: You're a grumpy little man aren't you?
translation: 你是个脾气暴躁的小男人，不是吗？ [ni shi ge pi qi bao zao de xiao nan ren ， bu shi ma ？]

english: I'm bigger than you. Let me by.
translation: 我比你大。让我过去吧 [wo bi ni da 。 rang wo guo qu ba]

english: I was just stopping to say hello!
translation: 我只是停下来打个招呼！ [wo zhi shi ting xia lai da ge zhao hu ！]

english: Do you have a brother?
translation: 你有兄弟吗？ [ni you xiong di ma ？]

english: Hello again. Are you after another device, or some information, or would you like to see my goods for sale?
translation: 又好。您是否在寻找另一台设备或某些信息，或者您想查看我的待售商品吗？ [you hao 。 nin shi fou zai xun zhao ling yi tai she bei huo mou xie xin xi ， huo zhe nin xiang cha kan wo de dai shou shang pin ma ？]

english: Devices, please.
translation: 请提供设备。 [qing ti gong she bei 。]

english: I'd like information, please.
translation: 我想要信息，请。 [wo xiang yao xin xi ， qing 。]

english: Just a few bits of information before you run away to persecute rock crabs or cows.
translation: 在你逃跑去迫害岩蟹或牛之前，请先了解一些信息。 [zai ni tao pao qu po hai yan xie huo niu zhi qian ， qing xian liao jie yi xie xin xi 。]

english: Firstly, your new device won't work if you are wearing certain metallic chest armours.
translation: 首先，如果您穿着某些金属胸甲，您的新设备将无法工作。 [shou xian ， ru guo nin chuan zhe mou xie jin shu xiong jia ， nin de xin she bei jiang wu fa gong zuo 。]

english: The magnetic attraction required for operation would cause feedback, so the device does not allow such incompatible item equip page.
translation: 操作所需的磁吸力会引起反馈，因此设备不允许此类不兼容的物品装备页面。 [cao zuo suo xu de ci xi li hui yin qi fan kui ， yin ci she bei bu yun xu ci lei bu jian rong de wu pin zhuang bei ye mian 。]

english: Secondly, although the device is calibrated to attract only arrow heads, there is a chance that other magnetically active items will be attracted.
translation: 其次，虽然该设备被校准为仅吸引箭头，但仍有可能吸引其他磁性活跃的物品。 [qi ci ， sui ran gai she bei bei jiao zhun wei jin xi yin jian tou ， dan reng you ke neng xi yin qi ta ci xing huo yue de wu pin 。]

english: The arrow recovery function of the devices is slightly different and relies upon a harmonic bond between your arrows and the chicken's magnet. You'll thus only recover arrows which you have fired rather than those
translation: 这些设备的箭头恢复功能略有不同，并且依赖于箭头和鸡的磁铁之间的和谐键。因此，你只能恢复你发射的箭，而不是那些 [zhe xie she bei de jian tou hui fu gong neng lve you bu tong ， bing qie yi lai yu jian tou he ji de ci tie zhi jian de he xie jian 。 yin ci ， ni zhi neng hui fu ni fa she de jian ， er bu shi na xie]

english: fired by nearby folks.
translation: 被附近的人开除。 [bei fu jin de ren kai chu 。]

english: You'll also need to move about if you want to collect arrows since the gathering of long-lost arrowheads can't work otherwise.
translation: 如果你想收集箭头，你还需要四处走动，因为否则无法收集失落已久的箭头。 [ru guo ni xiang shou ji jian tou ， ni hai xu yao si chu zou dong ， yin wei fou ze wu fa shou ji shi luo yi jiu de jian tou 。]

english: Finally, the device will only work when worn. It automatically deactivates in other circumstances.
translation: 最后，该设备只有在佩戴时才能工作。在其他情况下它会自动停用。 [zui hou ， gai she bei zhi you zai pei dai shi cai neng gong zuo 。 zai qi ta qing kuang xia ta hui zi dong ting yong 。]

english: I was worried about what would happen if you were to place it in a bank in its active state, so I've made sure it only works when it's on your back.
translation: 我担心如果你把它放在活跃状态的银行里会发生什么，所以我确保它只有在你背上的时候才能工作。 [wo dan xin ru guo ni ba ta fang zai huo yue zhuang tai de yin hang li hui fa sheng shen me ， suo yi wo que bao ta zhi you zai ni bei shang de shi hou cai neng gong zuo 。]

english: Can I have more locator orbs, please?
translation: 能给我更多的定位球吗？ [neng gei wo geng duo de ding wei qiu ma ？]

english: Ava gives you [another orb/[amount] orbs].
translation: 艾娃给你[另一个球体/[数量]个球体]。 [ai wa gei ni [ ling yi ge qiu ti /[ shu liang ] ge qiu ti ]。]

english: I'd like to see your stuff for sale, please.
translation: 我想看看你的东西出售。 [wo xiang kan kan ni de dong xi chu shou 。]

english: Here's my shop.
translation: 这是我的店。 [zhe shi wo de dian 。]

english: I'll just head off, I think.
translation: 我想我还是先走吧。 [wo xiang wo hai shi xian zou ba 。]

english: Thanks for the help with my bed; see you again.
translation: 谢谢你帮我整理床铺；再见。 [xie xie ni bang wo zheng li chuang pu ； zai jian 。]

english: Mind taking a look at this quiver for me?
translation: 介意帮我看看这个箭袋吗？ [jie yi bang wo kan kan zhe ge jian dai ma ？]

english: Hmm...
That truly is a remarkable piece of equipment.
translation: 这确实是一件了不起的设备。 [zhe que shi shi yi jian liao bu qi de she bei 。]

english: Bring me one of my devices. I might be able to link the two!
translation: 给我带来一台设备。我也许可以将两者联系起来！ [gei wo dai lai yi tai she bei 。 wo ye xu ke yi jiang liang zhe lian xi qi lai ！]

english: Wow! Really? I better go and grab one.
translation: 哇！真的吗？我最好去拿一个。 [wa ！ zhen de ma ？ wo zui hao qu na yi ge 。]

english: If you've got the materials, I can make one now for you?
translation: 如果你有材料的话，我现在可以给你做一个吗？ [ru guo ni you cai liao de hua ， wo xian zai ke yi gei ni zuo yi ge ma ？]

english: Let me see...
translation: 让我看看... [rang wo kan kan ...]

english: Extraordinary...
translation: 非凡的... [fei fan de ...]

english: That quiver has some of the finest leatherwork I've ever seen!
translation: 那个箭袋有我见过的最好的皮革制品！ [na ge jian dai you wo jian guo de zui hao de pi ge zhi pin ！]

english: I was wondering if you could maybe make it... better?
translation: 我想知道你是否可以让它变得……更好？ [wo xiang zhi dao ni shi fou ke yi rang ta bian de …… geng hao ？]

english: Better? Let me see... I might be able to do something.
translation: 更好的？让我想想...我也许能做点什么。 [geng hao de ？ rang wo xiang xiang ... wo ye xu neng zuo dian shen me 。]

english: I'll see if I can link it to the device you have with you.
translation: 我会看看是否可以将其链接到您随身携带的设备。 [wo hui kan kan shi fou ke yi jiang qi lian jie dao nin sui shen xie dai de she bei 。]

english: Ouch!
translation: 哎哟! [ai yo !]

english: That's some tough material...
translation: 那是一些坚硬的材料... [na shi yi xie jian ying de cai liao ...]

english: Move that here...
translation: 把它移到这里... [ba ta yi dao zhe li ...]

english: There we go! That's some of my finest work, if I do say so myself.
translation: 我们开始吧！如果我自己这么说的话，那是我最好的作品之一。 [wo men kai shi ba ！ ru guo wo zi ji zhe me shuo de hua ， na shi wo zui hao de zuo pin zhi yi 。]

english: Great! Thanks for the help!
translation: 伟大的！感谢您的帮助！ [wei da de ！ gan xie nin de bang zhu ！]

english: Looks like that quiver could be modified further. Come back to me with another device to modify it.
translation: 看来这个箭袋还可以进一步修改。用另一台设备回来找我修改它。 [kan lai zhe ge jian dai hai ke yi jin yi bu xiu gai 。 yong ling yi tai she bei hui lai zhao wo xiu gai ta 。]

english: Fair enough.
translation: 很公平。 [hen gong ping 。]

english: Mind taking another look at that quiver I showed you before?
translation: 介意再看一下我之前给你看过的那个箭袋吗？ [jie yi zai kan yi xia wo zhi qian gei ni kan guo de na ge jian dai ma ？]

english: Hmm, interesting... It seems to lack the power you have in your other device there.
translation: 嗯，有趣...它似乎缺乏您其他设备中的功能。 [n ， you qu ... ta si hu que fa nin qi ta she bei zhong de gong neng 。]

english: That's right. I was wondering if you could help with that?
translation: 这是正确的。我想知道你能帮忙吗？ [zhe shi zheng que de 。 wo xiang zhi dao ni neng bang mang ma ？]

english: I'll give it a good go!
translation: 我会好好努力的！ [wo hui hao hao nu li de ！]

english: It seems like that quiver is as good as it's going to get!
translation: 看来这个箭袋已经是最好的了！ [kan lai zhe ge jian dai yi jing shi zui hao de le ！]

english: I'm not sure what you are trying to do; are you sure you aren't slightly deranged?
translation: 我不确定你想做什么；你确定你没有精神错乱吗？ [wo bu que ding ni xiang zuo shen me ； ni que ding ni mei you jing shen cuo luan ma ？]

english: Devices, please.
translation: 请提供设备。 [qing ti gong she bei 。]

english: Ava's devices.
translation: 艾娃的设备。 [ai wa de she bei 。]

english: Dizana's Quiver.
translation: 迪扎娜的箭袋。 [di zha na de jian dai 。]

english: I'd like information, please.
translation: 我想要信息，请。 [wo xiang yao xin xi ， qing 。]

english: Can I have more locator orbs, please?
translation: 能给我更多的定位球吗？ [neng gei wo geng duo de ding wei qiu ma ？]

english: I'd like to see your stuff for sale, please.
translation: 我想看看你的东西出售。 [wo xiang kan kan ni de dong xi chu shou 。]

english: I'll just head off, I think.
translation: 我想我还是先走吧。 [wo xiang wo hai shi xian zou ba 。]

english: What are you doing out here on your own?
translation: 你一个人在这儿做什么？ [ni yi ge ren zai zhe er zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm not alone! Me and my mates run these streets. You'd better watch your pockets, stranger.
translation: 我并不孤单！我和我的伙伴们在这些街道上奔跑。你最好看好你的口袋，陌生人。 [wo bing bu gu dan ！ wo he wo de huo ban men zai zhe xie jie dao shang ben pao 。 ni zui hao kan hao ni de kou dai ， mo sheng ren 。]

english: What do you mean you run the streets?
translation: 你满街跑是什么意思？ [ni man jie pao shi shen me yi si ？]

english: You see those fancy houses?
translation: 看到那些别致的房子了吗？ [kan dao na xie bie zhi de fang zi le ma ？]

english: I think so?
translation: 我想是这样吗？ [wo xiang shi zhe yang ma ？]

english: We keep a lookout to see when the owners leave and come back. Once they're out, we can break in and steal all their stuff!
translation: 我们会留意业主何时离开和回来。一旦他们出去，我们就可以闯入并偷走他们所有的东西！ [wo men hui liu yi ye zhu he shi li kai he hui lai 。 yi dan ta men chu qu ， wo men jiu ke yi chuang ru bing tou zou ta men suo you de dong xi ！]

english: That sounds risky don't you think? There are guards everywhere.
translation: 这听起来很危险，你不觉得吗？到处都有警卫。 [zhe ting qi lai hen wei xian ， ni bu jue de ma ？ dao chu dou you jing wei 。]

english: No one suspects us street urchins. Hidden in plain sight, as they say.
translation: 没有人怀疑我们这些街头顽童。正如他们所说，隐藏在众目睽睽之下。 [mei you ren huai yi wo men zhe xie jie tou wan tong 。 zheng ru ta men suo shuo ， yin cang zai zhong mu kui kui zhi xia 。]

english: I can give you some info on which houses are free if you like...
translation: 如果你愿意的话，我可以给你一些关于哪些房子是免费的信息...... [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi gei ni yi xie guan yu na xie fang zi shi mian fei de xin xi ......]

english: Sounds good.
translation: 听起来不错。 [ting qi lai bu cuo 。]

english: You're new around here. Normally I'd charge 15 valuables for information, but I'm feeling generous.
translation: 你是新来的。通常我会收取 15 美元的贵重物品信息费，但我觉得很慷慨。 [ni shi xin lai de 。 tong chang wo hui shou qu  15  mei yuan de gui zhong wu pin xin xi fei ， dan wo jue de hen kang kai 。]

english: Looks like Victor isn't home right now. Go quickly!
translation: 看起来维克多现在不在家。快点走吧！ [kan qi lai wei ke duo xian zai bu zai jia 。 kuai dian zou ba ！]

english: Do you want me to point you in the right direction?
translation: 你想让我为你指明正确的方向吗？ [ni xiang rang wo wei ni zhi ming zheng que de fang xiang ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: His house is south of here.
translation: 他的房子在这南面。 [ta de fang zi zai zhe nan mian 。]

english: Sounds good.
translation: 听起来不错。 [ting qi lai bu cuo 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: I'll find my own way.
translation: 我会找到自己的方法。 [wo hui zhao dao zi ji de fang fa 。]

english: I'm alright for now.
translation: 我现在还好。 [wo xian zai hai hao 。]

english: What? Can't you see I'm busy?
translation: 什么？你没看到我很忙吗？ [shen me ？ ni mei kan dao wo hen mang ma ？]

english: Well, sooooorry...
translation: 嗯，非常抱歉... [n ， fei chang bao qian ...]

english: I have received word from my father of your assistance to our family in this matter. You have my thanks for restoring our honour.
translation: 我收到我父亲的消息，说你在这件事上向我们家提供了帮助。我感谢你恢复了我们的荣誉。 [wo shou dao wo fu qin de xiao xi ， shuo ni zai zhe jian shi shang xiang wo men jia ti gong le bang zhu 。 wo gan xie ni hui fu le wo men de rong yu 。]

english: Not a problem.
translation: 不是问题。 [bu shi wen ti 。]

english: Yes well... Is there anything I can help you with?
translation: 是的，好吧...有什么可以帮您的吗？ [shi de ， hao ba ... you shen me ke yi bang nin de ma ？]

english: Can you change my gauntlets for me?
translation: 你能帮我换一下手套吗？ [ni neng bang wo huan yi xia shou tao ma ？]

english: Yes certainly, though it will cost you 25,000 coins.
translation: 当然可以，不过要花费 25,000 个金币。 [dang ran ke yi ， bu guo yao hua fei  25,000  ge jin bi 。]

english: Great thanks!
translation: 非常感谢！ [fei chang gan xie ！]

english: Avan takes your gauntlets, takes out a small hammer, and pounds them into a slightly new shape, then hands them back to you.
translation: 阿文接过你的手套，拿出一把小锤子，把它们敲成稍微新的形状，然后把它们还给你。 [a wen jie guo ni de shou tao ， na chu yi ba xiao chui zi ， ba ta men qiao cheng shao wei xin de xing zhuang ， ran hou ba ta men huan gei ni 。]

english: No that's okay thanks.
translation: 不，没关系，谢谢。 [bu ， mei guan xi ， xie xie 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: I have received word from my father that you assisted us again! I get the feeling you weren't going to stop trying until you did though.
translation: 我收到我父亲的消息，你又帮助了我们！我感觉你不会停止尝试，除非你这样做了。 [wo shou dao wo fu qin de xiao xi ， ni you bang zhu le wo men ！ wo gan jue ni bu hui ting zhi chang shi ， chu fei ni zhe yang zuo le 。]

english: As a token of my appreciation, I will happily forge you as many pairs of Goldsmith gauntlets as you desire.
translation: 为了表达我的感激之情，我很乐意为您锻造尽可能多的金匠手套。 [wei le biao da wo de gan ji zhi qing ， wo hen le yi wei nin duan zao jin ke neng duo de jin jiang shou tao 。]

english: You will find the rate you gain experience when smelting gold much improved whilst wearing these gauntlets.
translation: 你会发现，戴着这些手套时，冶炼黄金时获得经验的速度会大大提高。 [ni hui fa xian ， dai zhe zhe xie shou tao shi ， ye lian huang jin shi huo de jing yan de su du hui da da ti gao 。]

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Here you go!
translation: 干得好！ [gan de hao ！]

english: You're welcome.
translation: 不客气。 [bu ke qi 。]

english: Can you change my gauntlets for me?
translation: 你能帮我换一下手套吗？ [ni neng bang wo huan yi xia shou tao ma ？]

english: Great thanks!
translation: 非常感谢！ [fei chang gan xie ！]

english: No that's okay thanks.
translation: 不，没关系，谢谢。 [bu ， mei guan xi ， xie xie 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Could I have another pair of Goldsmith gauntlets?
translation: 我可以再要一副金匠手套吗？ [wo ke yi zai yao yi fu jin jiang shou tao ma ？]

english: You're welcome.
translation: 不客气。 [bu ke qi 。]

english: Hey there.
translation: 嘿。 [hei 。]

english: Need something, iknami?
translation: 需要什么东西吗，iknami？ [xu yao shen me dong xi ma ，iknami？]

english: Not really. Just wondering what brings you out here?
translation: 并不真地。只是想知道是什么让你来到这里？ [bing bu zhen di 。 zhi shi xiang zhi dao shi shen me rang ni lai dao zhe li ？]

english: I'm here to trade with the dwarves here on behalf of Fortis. Stonecutter Outpost is the main supplier of the stone we use for building.
translation: 我来这里是代表富通与矮人进行交易。昂船洲前哨站是我们建筑用石材的主要供应商。 [wo lai zhe li shi dai biao fu tong yu ai ren jin xing jiao yi 。 ang chuan zhou qian shao zhan shi wo men jian zhu yong shi cai de zhu yao gong ying shang 。]

english: And is the trading going well?
translation: 交易进展顺利吗？ [jiao yi jin zhan shun li ma ？]

english: Well it's significantly better than dealing with the dwarves in Cam Torum, but they're still not the easiest to work with.
translation: 嗯，这比在卡姆托鲁姆对付矮人要好得多，但他们仍然不是最容易合作的。 [n ， zhe bi zai ka mu tuo lu mu dui fu ai ren yao hao de duo ， dan ta men reng ran bu shi zui rong yi he zuo de 。]

english: Ah, well in that case, I'd better leave you to it.
translation: 啊，既然这样，那我就让你自己处理吧。 [a ， ji ran zhe yang ， na wo jiu rang ni zi ji chu li ba 。]

english: You have brought peace between our kingdoms, [player name].
translation: 你给我们的王国带来了和平，[玩家名字]。 [ni gei wo men de wang guo dai lai le he ping ，[ wan jia ming zi ]。]

english: I've instructed my people to allow you full access to our Island, but beware I do not command the undead beneath us.
translation: 我已经指示我的人民允许你们完全进入我们的岛屿，但要小心我不会指挥我们脚下的不死生物。 [wo yi jing zhi shi wo de ren min yun xu ni men wan quan jin ru wo men de dao yu ， dan yao xiao xin wo bu hui zhi hui wo men jiao xia de bu si sheng wu 。]

english: Now that's quite the banana. Where did you get it?
translation: 现在这真是太香蕉了。你从哪里得到的？ [xian zai zhe zhen shi tai xiang jiao le 。 ni cong na li de dao de ？]

english: Far from here, deep in the Kharidian Desert.
translation: 远离这里，在哈里迪沙漠深处。 [yuan li zhe li ， zai ha li di sha mo shen chu 。]

english: Interesting... Continue.
translation: 有趣...继续。 [you qu ... ji xu 。]

english: You recount your experiences with the baboons in Osmumten's Tomb...
translation: 你讲述了你在奥斯蒙顿墓中与狒狒相处的经历…… [ni jiang shu le ni zai ao si meng dun mu zhong yu fei fei xiang chu de jing li ……]

english: Well, that was a fascinating story. We have of course heard of various troops of our kind spread across the land, but this is the first I have heard of these ones.
translation: 嗯，那是一个令人着迷的故事。我们当然听说过我们这种类型的军队分布在这片土地上，但这是我第一次听说这些军队。 [n ， na shi yi ge ling ren zhao mi de gu shi 。 wo men dang ran ting shuo guo wo men zhe zhong lei xing de jun dui fen bu zai zhe pian tu di shang ， dan zhe shi wo di yi ci ting shuo zhe xie jun dui 。]

english: Now that we know their story, you can rest assured that their memory will live on here.
translation: 现在我们知道了他们的故事，您可以放心，他们的记忆将永存于此。 [xian zai wo men zhi dao le ta men de gu shi ， nin ke yi fang xin ， ta men de ji yi jiang yong cun yu ci 。]

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Now, about that large banana...
translation: 现在，关于那个大香蕉...... [xian zai ， guan yu na ge da xiang jiao ......]

english: Here you go.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: Ah! Here you go!
translation: 啊!干得好！ [a ! gan de hao ！]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: I need you to answer this for me.
translation: 我需要你帮我回答这个问题。 [wo xu yao ni bang wo hui da zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。 [qing shu ru wen ti de da an 。]

english: How can that be? Go check again!
translation: 怎么可能呢？再去检查一下吧！ [zen me ke neng ne ？ zai qu jian cha yi xia ba ！]

english: Spot on!
translation: 现货！ [xian huo ！]

english: King Awowogei has given you another clue scroll/a casket!
translation: 阿沃沃盖国王给了你另一条线索卷轴/一个棺材！ [a wo wo gai guo wang gei le ni ling yi tiao xian suo juan zhou / yi ge guan cai ！]

english: Greetings, human.
translation: 你好，人类。 [ni hao ， ren lei 。]

english: I didn't realise monkeys could talk!
translation: 没想到猴子也会说话！ [mei xiang dao hou zi ye hui shuo hua ！]

english: Some of us have learned to speak with your kind, yes. I appreciate that none of my followers were harmed during this incident.
translation: 是的，我们中的一些人已经学会了与你们同类交谈。我很感激我的追随者没有在这次事件中受到伤害。 [shi de ， wo men zhong de yi xie ren yi jing xue hui le yu ni men tong lei jiao tan 。 wo hen gan ji wo de zhui sui zhe mei you zai zhe ci shi jian zhong shou dao shang hai 。]

english: Once again you have proven a friend to our kind, human. I appreciate that none of my followers were harmed.
translation: 你再一次证明了你是我们人类的朋友。我很高兴我的追随者没有受到伤害。 [ni zai yi ci zheng ming liao ni shi wo men ren lei de peng you 。 wo hen gao xing wo de zhui sui zhe mei you shou dao shang hai 。]

english: It was definitely more work than I thought it would be.
translation: 这绝对比我想象的要多。 [zhe jue dui bi wo xiang xiang de yao duo 。]

english: Yes, I'd imagine so. Our kind are much more nimble than yours. I still don't know why you insist on using only two of your four legs.
translation: 是的，我想是这样。我们人类比你们灵活得多。我还是不明白你为什么坚持只用四条腿中的两条。 [shi de ， wo xiang shi zhe yang 。 wo men ren lei bi ni men ling huo de duo 。 wo hai shi bu ming bai ni wei shen me jian chi zhi yong si tiao tui zhong de liang tiao 。]

english: I suppose I've never thought about it like that before.
translation: 我想我以前从来没有这样想过。 [wo xiang wo yi qian cong lai mei you zhe yang xiang guo 。]

english: Thank you kind madam. The town is saved and the water is flowing freely.
translation: 谢谢你好心的女士。小镇得救了，水也畅通无阻了。 [xie xie ni hao xin de nv shi 。 xiao zhen de jiu le ， shui ye chang tong wu zu le 。]

english: You're welcome.
translation: 不客气。 [bu ke qi 。]

english: What's more when we now pray at the shrine we now feel rejuvenated and healthier than ever!
translation: 更重要的是，当我们现在在神社祈祷时，我们感觉比以往任何时候都充满活力和健康！ [geng zhong yao de shi ， dang wo men xian zai zai shen she qi dao shi ， wo men gan jue bi yi wang ren he shi hou dou chong man huo li he jian kang ！]

english: That's interesting to know.
translation: 这很有趣。 [zhe hen you qu 。]

english: What do you think you are doing?
translation: 你认为你在做什么？ [ni ren wei ni zai zuo shen me ？]

english: Errm, I'm trying to remove your soul.
translation: 呃，我正试图移除你的灵魂。 [e ， wo zheng shi tu yi chu ni de ling hun 。]

english: What, have you lost your mind?
translation: 怎么，你疯了吗？ [zen me ， ni feng le ma ？]

english: It's for the good of the village. I met a genie down the crevice. He told me he would give me the statuette in exchange for your soul.
translation: 这是为了村里的利益。我在缝隙里遇见了一个精灵。他告诉我他会给我小雕像以换取你的灵魂。 [zhe shi wei le cun li de li yi 。 wo zai feng xi li yu jian le yi ge jing ling 。 ta gao su wo ta hui gei wo xiao diao xiang yi huan qu ni de ling hun 。]

english: That's barbaric! We'll just have to find other ways to get the town a good supply of water. Keep your knife away from me please.
translation: 这太野蛮了！我们只需要找到其他方法来为镇上提供充足的水源。请把你的刀离我远一点。 [zhe tai ye man le ！ wo men zhi xu yao zhao dao qi ta fang fa lai wei zhen shang ti gong chong zu de shui yuan 。 qing ba ni de dao li wo yuan yi dian 。]

english: 'Ello, and what are you after then?
translation: '艾洛，那你在追什么？ [' ai luo ， na ni zai zhui shen me ？]

english: I need another assignment.
translation: 我需要另一项任务。 [wo xu yao ling yi xiang ren wu 。]

english: You're actually very strong, are you sure you don't want Chaeldar in Zanaris to assign you a task?
translation: 你其实很强，你确定不想让扎纳里斯的查尔达给你分配任务吗？ [ni qi shi hen qiang ， ni que ding bu xiang rang zha na li si de cha er da gei ni fen pei ren wu ma ？]

english: No that's okay, I'll take a task from you.
translation: 不，没关系，我会接受你的任务。 [bu ， mei guan xi ， wo hui jie shou ni de ren wu 。]

english: Oh okay then, I'll go talk to Chaeldar.
translation: 哦，好吧，那我去跟 Chaeldar 谈谈。 [o ， hao ba ， na wo qu gen  Chaeldar  tan tan 。]

english: Excellent, you're doing great. Your new task is to kill [amount] [task monster].
translation: 太棒了，你做得很好。你的新任务是杀死[数量][任务怪物]。 [tai bang le ， ni zuo de hen hao 。 ni de xin ren wu shi sha si [ shu liang ][ ren wu guai wu ]。]

english: You're still hunting [task monster], you have [amount] to go.
translation: 你仍在寻找[任务怪物]，你还有[数量]要做。 [ni reng zai xun zhao [ ren wu guai wu ]， ni hai you [ shu liang ] yao zuo 。]

english: Although, it's not an assignment that I'd normally give... I guess I could give you a new assignment, if you'd like.
translation: 虽然，这不是我通常会给你的任务...我想我可以给你一个新的任务，如果你愿意的话。 [sui ran ， zhe bu shi wo tong chang hui gei ni de ren wu ... wo xiang wo ke yi gei ni yi ge xin de ren wu ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua 。]

english: If you do get a new one, you will reset your standard task streak of [task streak amount]. Is that okay? It won't affect your Wilderness task streak of [task streak amount].
translation: 如果您确实获得了新任务，您将重置您的标准任务连续数[任务连续数]。可以吗？它不会影响你的[任务连胜量]的荒野任务连胜。 [ru guo nin que shi huo de le xin ren wu ， nin jiang zhong zhi nin de biao zhun ren wu lian xu shu [ ren wu lian xu shu ]。 ke yi ma ？ ta bu hui ying xiang ni de [ ren wu lian sheng liang ] de huang ye ren wu lian sheng 。]

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: You're still hunting [monster], with [amount] to go.
translation: 你仍在狩猎[怪物]，还有[数量]。 [ni reng zai shou lie [ guai wu ]， hai you [ shu liang ]。]

english: I don't think that's a suitable task for you. Shall I cancel it? This will not wipe your task streaks.
translation: 我认为这不适合你。我要取消它吗？这不会消除您的任务连续记录。 [wo ren wei zhe bu shi he ni 。 wo yao qu xiao ta ma ？ zhe bu hui xiao chu nin de ren wu lian xu ji lu 。]

english: Yes, please cancel it.
translation: 是的，请取消。 [shi de ， qing qu xiao 。]

english: Alright, consider the task cancelled. You can now get a new assignment when you want one.
translation: 好吧，考虑任务被取消了。现在，您可以在需要时获得新的任务。 [hao ba ， kao lv ren wu bei qu xiao le 。 xian zai ， nin ke yi zai xu yao shi huo de xin de ren wu 。]

english: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
translation: 不，谢谢，我想尝试一下。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo xiang chang shi yi xia 。]

english: Good luck with that.
translation: 祝你好运。 [zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: 你有什么奖励给我，或者有什么可以交易的吗？ [ni you shen me jiang li gei wo ， huo zhe you shen me ke yi jiao yi de ma ？]

english: I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.
translation: 我有很多你可以获得的奖励，还有各种各样的杀手装备可供出售。 [wo you hen duo ni ke yi huo de de jiang li ， hai you ge zhong ge yang de sha shou zhuang bei ke gong chu shou 。]

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: 说说我的作业的难度吧。 [shuo shuo wo de zuo ye de nan du ba 。]

english: The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 目前，杀戮大师可以为您分配我们列表中的任何任务，无论您的战斗水平如何。 [mu qian ， sha lu da shi ke yi wei nin fen pei wo men lie biao zhong de ren he ren wu ， wu lun nin de zhan dou shui ping ru he 。]

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
translation: 没关系——我可以处理任何任务。 [mei guan xi —— wo ke yi chu li ren he ren wu 。]

english: That's the spirit.
translation: 这就是精神。 [zhe jiu shi jing shen 。]

english: In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: 以后，请不要给任何太艰难的事情。 [yi hou ， qing bu yao gei ren he tai jian nan de shi qing 。]

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: 好吧，从现在开始，所有屠戮大师在为你选择任务时都会考虑你的战斗水平，所以你不要做太难的事情。 [hao ba ， cong xian zai kai shi ， suo you tu lu da shi zai wei ni xuan ze ren wu shi du hui kao lv ni de zhan dou shui ping ， suo yi ni bu yao zuo tai nan de shi qing 。]

english: The Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: 杀手大师在为你选择任务时会考虑你的战斗水平，所以你不应该遇到太难的任务。 [sha shou da shi zai wei ni xuan ze ren wu shi hui kao lv ni de zhan dou shui ping ， suo yi ni bu ying gai yu dao tai nan de ren wu 。]

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: 没关系——我不想要太难的东西。 [mei guan xi —— wo bu xiang yao tai nan de dong xi 。]

english: Okay, we'll keep checking your combat level.
translation: 好的，我们会继续检查你的战斗水平。 [hao de ， wo men hui ji xu jian cha ni de zhan dou shui ping 。]

english: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: 别再检查我的战斗水平了——我可以承受任何事情！ [bie zai jian cha wo de zhan dou shui ping le —— wo ke yi cheng shou ren he shi qing ！]

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will assign you anything from their lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 好吧，从现在开始，所有的杀手大师都会从他们的列表中为你分配任何东西，无论你的战斗水平如何。 [hao ba ， cong xian zai kai shi ， suo you de sha shou da shi du hui cong ta men de lie biao zhong wei ni fen pei ren he dong xi ， wu lun ni de zhan dou shui ping ru he 。]

english: Hello, I'm here about the blessed axe again.
translation: 大家好，我又来讨论神斧了。 [da jia hao ， wo you lai tao lun shen fu le 。]

english: I suppose you want a new axe?
translation: 我想你想要一把新斧头吧？ [wo xiang ni xiang yao yi ba xin fu tou ba ？]

english: Actually, yes.
translation: 事实上，是的。 [shi shi shang ， shi de 。]

english: You'll need to hand over both a mithril axe and holy symbol of Saradomin. You don't have an axe in your pack, so I'm not able to help.
translation: 你需要交出一把秘银斧头和萨拉多明的圣徽。你的背包里没有斧子，所以我帮不了你。 [ni xu yao jiao chu yi ba mi yin fu tou he sa la duo ming de sheng hui 。 ni de bei bao li mei you fu zi ， suo yi wo bang bu liao ni 。]

english: Here's the replacement; be more careful with this one, eh?
translation: 这是替代品；对此要更加小心，是吗？ [zhe shi ti dai pin ； dui ci yao geng jia xiao xin ， shi ma ？]

english: Not right now.
translation: 现在不行。 [xian zai bu xing 。]

english: Goodbye, then. You may, of course, return if you decide you want a new axe.
translation: 那么再见。当然，如果您决定想要一把新斧头，您可以返回。 [na me zai jian 。 dang ran ， ru guo nin jue ding xiang yao yi ba xin fu tou ， nin ke yi fan hui 。]

english: You already have an axe in your bag but you want another?
translation: 您的包里已经有一把斧头，但您还想要另一把吗？ [nin de bao li yi jing you yi ba fu tou ， dan nin hai xiang yao ling yi ba ma ？]

english: So you're filling in for Turael?
translation: 所以你要代替图瑞尔？ [suo yi ni yao dai ti tu rui er ？]

english: That I am. It's been quite a while since I last did this sort of thing, but my brother wants one last adventure, so here I am.
translation: 我就是这样。自从我上次做这种事情以来已经有一段时间了，但我的兄弟想要最后一次冒险，所以我来了。 [wo jiu shi zhe yang 。 zi cong wo shang ci zuo zhe zhong shi qing yi lai yi jing you yi duan shi jian le ， dan wo de xiong di xiang yao zui hou yi ci mao xian ， suo yi wo lai le 。]

english: So you've done this before?
translation: 那么你以前做过这个吗？ [na me ni yi qian zuo guo zhe ge ma ？]

english: Oh yes. In fact, I was doing it before my brother was. Back in his adventuring days, I was the one here teaching people the basics.
translation: 哦是的。事实上，我在我哥哥之前就开始这样做了。在他冒险的日子里，我是这里教人们基础知识的人。 [o shi de 。 shi shi shang ， wo zai wo ge ge zhi qian jiu kai shi zhe yang zuo le 。 zai ta mao xian de ri zi li ， wo shi zhe li jiao ren men ji chu zhi shi de ren 。]

english: After Spria was born, he retired from his life of thrill- seeking. That's when he took over from me.
translation: 斯普里亚出生后，他就退出了寻求刺激的生活。就在那时，他接替了我。 [si pu li ya chu sheng hou ， ta jiu tui chu le xun qiu ci ji de sheng huo 。 jiu zai na shi ， ta jie ti le wo 。]

english: Interesting... I never knew that.
translation: 有趣...我从来不知道。 [you qu ... wo cong lai bu zhi dao 。]

english: He doesn't talk about his adventures much, but once you get him going, you won't be able to make him stop!
translation: 他不太谈论他的冒险经历，但一旦你让他开始，你就无法让他停下来！ [ta bu tai tan lun ta de mao xian jing li ， dan yi dan ni rang ta kai shi ， ni jiu wu fa rang ta ting xia lai ！]

english: About Turael...
translation: 关于图瑞尔... [guan yu tu rui er ...]

english: You need not share your condolences with me, adventurer. I've been prepared for this for a long time.
translation: 你不必向我表示哀悼，冒险者。我为此准备了很长时间。 [ni bu bi xiang wo biao shi ai dao ， mao xian zhe 。 wo wei ci zhun bei le hen zhang shi jian 。]

english: You have?
translation: 你有吗？ [ni you ma ？]

english: My brother was a thrill-seeker his whole life. Even after he retired, I always knew something would come and pull him back in.
translation: 我哥哥一生都是一个寻求刺激的人。即使在他退休后，我也一直知道会有一些事情把他拉回来。 [wo ge ge yi sheng dou shi yi ge xun qiu ci ji de ren 。 ji shi zai ta tui xiu hou ， wo ye yi zhi zhi dao hui you yi xie shi qing ba ta la hui lai 。]

english: And that something was me. I'm sorry...
translation: 那东西就是我。对不起... [na dong xi jiu shi wo 。 dui bu qi ...]

english: Don't be. He died doing what he loved, and he died a hero. He wouldn't have had it any other way.
translation: 别这样。他为自己热爱的事情而死，他是一位英雄。他不会有任何其他方式。 [bie zhe yang 。 ta wei zi ji re ai de shi qing er si ， ta shi yi wei ying xiong 。 ta bu hui you ren he qi ta fang shi 。]

english: Er... Nothing...
translation: 呃……没什么…… [e …… mei shen me ……]

english: I need another assignment.
translation: 我需要另一项任务。 [wo xu yao ling yi xiang ren wu 。]

english: No that's okay, I'll take a task from you.
translation: 不，没关系，我会接受你的任务。 [bu ， mei guan xi ， wo hui jie shou ni de ren wu 。]

english: Oh okay then, I'll go talk to Chaeldar.
translation: 哦，好吧，那我去跟 Chaeldar 谈谈。 [o ， hao ba ， na wo qu gen  Chaeldar  tan tan 。]

english: Yes, please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Yes, please cancel it.
translation: 是的，请取消。 [shi de ， qing qu xiao 。]

english: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: 你有什么奖励给我，或者有什么可以交易的吗？ [ni you shen me jiang li gei wo ， huo zhe you shen me ke yi jiao yi de ma ？]

english: Look at rewards.
translation: 看奖励。 [kan jiang li 。]

english: Look at shop.
translation: 看看店。 [kan kan dian 。]

english: Cancel.
translation: 取消。 [qu xiao 。]

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: 说说我的作业的难度吧。 [shuo shuo wo de zuo ye de nan du ba 。]

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
translation: 没关系——我可以处理任何任务。 [mei guan xi —— wo ke yi chu li ren he ren wu 。]

english: In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: 以后，请不要给任何太艰难的事情。 [yi hou ， qing bu yao gei ren he tai jian nan de shi qing 。]

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: 没关系——我不想要太难的东西。 [mei guan xi —— wo bu xiang yao tai nan de dong xi 。]

english: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: 别再检查我的战斗水平了——我可以承受任何事情！ [bie zai jian cha wo de zhan dou shui ping le —— wo ke yi cheng shou ren he shi qing ！]

english: I'm here about blessed axes again.
translation: 我又来这里讨论祝福斧头了。 [wo you lai zhe li tao lun zhu fu fu tou le 。]

english: Actually, yes.
translation: 事实上，是的。 [shi shi shang ， shi de 。]

english: I can do without for now, thanks.
translation: 我现在可以不用了，谢谢。 [wo xian zai ke yi bu yong le ， xie xie 。]

english: So you're filling in for Turael?
translation: 所以你要代替图瑞尔？ [suo yi ni yao dai ti tu rui er ？]

english: About Turael...
translation: 关于图瑞尔... [guan yu tu rui er ...]

english: Er... Nothing...
translation: 呃……没什么…… [e …… mei shen me ……]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Ah, a stranger to our island. How can I help?
translation: 啊，我们岛上的陌生人。我能提供什么帮助吗？ [a ， wo men dao shang de mo sheng ren 。 wo neng ti gong shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: Ah! [player name], I'm glad to see you've returned. How can I help?
translation: 啊! [玩家姓名]，很高兴看到你回来了。我能提供什么帮助吗？ [a ! [ wan jia xing ming ]， hen gao xing kan dao ni hui lai le 。 wo neng ti gong shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: It's a very interesting house you have here. Does he have a name?
translation: 你们这里的房子非常有趣。他有名字吗？ [ni men zhe li de fang zi fei chang you qu 。 ta you ming zi ma ？]

english: Why of course. It's Berty.
translation: 为什么当然。是伯蒂。 [wei shen me dang ran 。 shi bo di 。]

english: Berty? Berty the Chicken leg house?
translation: 伯蒂？伯蒂鸡腿屋？ [bo di ？ bo di ji tui wu ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: May I ask why?
translation: 请问为什么？ [qing wen wei shen me ？]

english: It just has that certain ring to it, don't you think? Beeerteeee!
translation: 它就是有那种特定的感觉，你不觉得吗？啤酒啊！ [ta jiu shi you na zhong te ding de gan jue ， ni bu jue de ma ？ pi jiu a ！]

english: You're ins...
translation: 你是在... [ni shi zai ...]

english: Insane? Very.
translation: 疯狂的？非常。 [feng kuang de ？ fei chang 。]

english: There's a lunar spell in my spell book that I can't use. Could you...?
translation: 我的法术书中有一个月亮法术我无法使用。您可以...吗...？ [wo de fa shu shu zhong you yi ge yue liang fa shu wo wu fa shi yong 。 nin ke yi ... ma ...？]

english: Help you? Certainly. It's one I've just rediscovered! I can teach it to you if you like, but you have to listen to a story first.
translation: 有帮助吗？当然。这是我刚刚重新发现的一个！如果你愿意的话我可以教你，但是你必须先听一个故事。 [you bang zhu ma ？ dang ran 。 zhe shi wo gang gang chong xin fa xian de yi ge ！ ru guo ni yuan yi de hua wo ke yi jiao ni ， dan shi ni bi xu xian ting yi ge gu shi 。]

english: Okay, I don't mind hearing sto-
translation: 好吧，我不介意听听- [hao ba ， wo bu jie yi ting ting -]

english: Wonderful!
translation: 精彩的！ [jing cai de ！]

english: Well, I was going through some ancient documents recently, expanding my knowledge of our great ancestors...
translation: 嗯，最近我在翻阅一些古代文献，扩大了我对我们伟大祖先的了解…… [n ， zui jin wo zai fan yue yi xie gu dai wen xian ， kuo da le wo dui wo men wei da zu xian de liao jie ……]

english: Hmm, actually, I think I had better go further back, so you will understand.
translation: 嗯，其实我觉得我最好再往前追溯一下，这样你就会明白了。 [n ， qi shi wo jue de wo zui hao zai wang qian zhui su yi xia ， zhe yang ni jiu hui ming bai le 。]

english: You know of our ancient war with the Fremennik that you recently healed?
translation: 你知道我们与弗雷曼尼克人的古老战争吗？你最近才平息了这场战争？ [ni zhi dao wo men yu fu lei man ni ke ren de gu lao zhan zheng ma ？ ni zui jin cai ping xi le zhe chang zhan zheng ？]

english: Of course! I am a great diplomat, aren't I?
translation: 当然！我是一位伟大的外交官，不是吗？ [dang ran ！ wo shi yi wei wei da de wai jiao guan ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Some diplomat. Did you even discover WHY we were at war for so long?
translation: 某个外交官。你有没有发现我们为什么要打这么久的战争？ [mou ge wai jiao guan 。 ni you mei you fa xian wo men wei shen me yao da zhe me jiu de zhan zheng ？]

english: Errr... You couldn't see eye to eye about magic, or something like that.
translation: 呃……对于魔法之类的事情，你们的看法无法达成一致。 [e …… dui yu mo fa zhi lei de shi qing ， ni men de kan fa wu fa da cheng yi zhi 。]

english: Not too far off; it goes deeper than that.
translation: 不太远；它比那更深。 [bu tai yuan ； ta bi na geng shen 。]

english: The Fremennik were actually the first to discover how to make runes, but there was disagreement within the tribe about the implications of making such powerful objects.
translation: 弗雷曼尼克实际上是第一个发现如何制作符文的人，但部落内部对于制作如此强大物品的含义存在分歧。 [fu lei man ni ke shi ji shang shi di yi ge fa xian ru he zhi zuo fu wen de ren ， dan bu luo nei bu dui yu zhi zuo ru ci qiang da wu pin de han yi cun zai fen qi 。]

english: Most Fremennik felt we were stealing power from the gods. They could not see past that to the great things we could do with such power, so we split from them and became the Moon Clan. Our ancient leader, who first
translation: 大多数弗雷曼尼克人认为我们正在窃取神的力量。他们看不到我们可以用这种力量做的伟大事情，所以我们从他们中分裂出来，成为了月族。我们古代的领袖，谁首先 [da duo shu fu lei man ni ke ren ren wei wo men zheng zai qie qu shen de li liang 。 ta men kan bu dao wo men ke yi yong zhe zhong li liang zuo de wei da shi qing ， suo yi wo men cong ta men zhong fen lie chu lai ， cheng wei le yue zu 。 wo men gu dai de ling xiu ， shui shou xian]

english: discovered the rune essence mine here on Lunar Isle, travelled far and wide searching for more places of power. He and his followers built altars all over Gielinor - which you use today to create runes - and at their
translation: 在月岛这里发现了符文精矿矿，开始远行寻找更多的力量之地。他和他的追随者在吉林诺各处建造了祭坛——你们今天用它来创造符文——并在他们的 [zai yue dao zhe li fa xian le fu wen jing kuang kuang ， kai shi yuan xing xun zhao geng duo de li liang zhi di 。 ta he ta de zhui sui zhe zai ji lin nuo ge chu jian zao le ji tan —— ni men jin tian yong ta lai chuang zao fu wen —— bing zai ta men de]

english: height they made runes by the crateful. They had perfected the process and even advanced it, creating altars that could create any type of rune regardless of the crafter's ability. But the strife between the Moon
translation: 他们用板条箱制作符文的高度。他们完善了这个过程，甚至进一步推进了它，创造了可以创造任何类型符文的祭坛，无论工匠的能力如何。但月球之间的纷争 [ta men yong ban tiao xiang zhi zuo fu wen de gao du 。 ta men wan shan le zhe ge guo cheng ， shen zhi jin yi bu tui jin le ta ， chuang zao le ke yi chuang zao ren he lei xing fu wen de ji tan ， wu lun gong jiang de neng li ru he 。 dan yue qiu zhi jian de fen zheng]

english: Clan and the Fremennik heightened. The Fremennik had grown strong in body, while our clan had grown stong in mind. They overpowered our tribe and we retreated to Lunar Isle, where we had lived ever since.
translation: 氏族和弗雷曼尼克人的地位得到提高。弗雷曼尼克人的身体变得坚强，而我们的氏族的精神也变得坚强。他们打败了我们的部落，我们撤退到月岛，从那时起我们就住在那里。 [shi zu he fu lei man ni ke ren de di wei de dao ti gao 。 fu lei man ni ke ren de shen ti bian de jian qiang ， er wo men de shi zu de jing shen ye bian de jian qiang 。 ta men da bai le wo men de bu luo ， wo men che tui dao yue dao ， cong na shi qi wo men jiu zhu zai na li 。]

english: The Fremennik then swept over Gielinor destroying the altars we had made, in an attempt to remove all trace of magic from the land.
translation: 弗雷曼尼克随后席卷了吉利诺，摧毁了我们建造的祭坛，试图清除这片土地上的所有魔法痕迹。 [fu lei man ni ke sui hou xi juan le ji li nuo ， cui hui le wo men jian zao de ji tan ， shi tu qing chu zhe pian tu di shang de suo you mo fa hen ji 。]

english: That's all very interesting, but what's it got to do with this spell?
translation: 这一切都很有趣，但这和这个咒语有什么关系呢？ [zhe yi qie dou hen you qu ， dan zhe he zhe ge zhou yu you shen me guan xi ne ？]

english: I'm getting to that!
translation: 我正在做那件事！ [wo zheng zai zuo na jian shi ！]

english: The Fremennik were not as thorough as they thought. They destroyed only the entrances to the altars, for the altars themselves were on a different plane, but they were successful in wiping out our ability to create
translation: 弗里曼尼克人并不像他们想象的那么彻底。他们只摧毁了祭坛的入口，因为祭坛本身位于不同的平面上，但他们成功地消灭了我们创造的能力 [fu li man ni ke ren bing bu xiang ta men xiang xiang de na me che di 。 ta men zhi cui hui le ji tan de ru kou ， yin wei ji tan ben shen wei yu bu tong de ping mian shang ， dan ta men cheng gong di xiao mie le wo men chuang zao de neng li]

english: runes. That ability has only recently been rediscovered on the mainland, so I hear.
translation: 符文。据我所知，这种能力直到最近才在大陆被重新发现。 [fu wen 。 ju wo suo zhi ， zhe zhong neng li zhi dao zui jin cai zai da lu bei chong xin fa xian 。]

english: Our people were left isolated on Lunar Isle but we used it to our advantage. Our control over Magic advanced beyond the need for runes and all knowledge of the altar locations passed from memory. Fortunately,
translation: 我们的人民被孤立在月岛上，但我们利用它来发挥我们的优势。我们对魔法的控制已经超越了符文的需要，所有关于祭坛位置的知识都从记忆中传递过来。幸运的是， [wo men de ren min bei gu li zai yue dao shang ， dan wo men li yong ta lai fa hui wo men de you shi 。 wo men dui mo fa de kong zhi yi jing chao yue le fu wen de xu yao ， suo you guan yu ji tan wei zhi de zhi shi dou cong ji yi zhong chuan di guo lai 。 xing yun de shi ，]

english: some records survived... The manuscript I discovered contains the teleportation spell to an advanced altar called Ourania. It's an altar that allows the user, regardless of their Runecrafting ability, to craft any
translation: 一些记录幸存下来......我发现的手稿包含传送咒语到一个名为欧拉尼亚的高级祭坛。这是一个祭坛，允许用户，无论其符文制作能力如何，都可以制作任何物品 [yi xie ji lu xing cun xia lai ...... wo fa xian de shou gao bao han chuan song zhou yu dao yi ge ming wei ou la ni ya de gao ji ji tan 。 zhe shi yi ge ji tan ， yun xu yong hu ， wu lun qi fu wen zhi zuo neng li ru he ， dou ke yi zhi zuo ren he wu pin]

english: type of rune upon it. Ourania is a powerful altar indeed. What state it is in after so many millennia, I know not, but it's interesting all the same.
translation: 其上的符文类型。欧拉尼亚确实是一个强大的祭坛。几千年后它处于什么状态，我不知道，但仍然很有趣。 [qi shang de fu wen lei xing 。 ou la ni ya que shi shi yi ge qiang da de ji tan 。 ji qian nian hou ta chu yu shen me zhuang tai ， wo bu zhi dao ， dan reng ran hen you qu 。]

english: So, will you teach me the spell?
translation: 那么，你能教我咒语吗？ [na me ， ni neng jiao wo zhou yu ma ？]

english: Certainly.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: *Baby Yaga whispers in your ear*
translation: *雅加宝宝在你耳边低语* [* ya jia bao bao zai ni er bian di yu *]

english: And now you know the teleportation spell, off with you! Go explore.
translation: 现在你已经掌握了传送咒语，开始吧！去探索吧。 [xian zai ni yi jing zhang wo le chuan song zhou yu ， kai shi ba ！ qu tan suo ba 。]

english: I don't really have ti-
translation: 我真的没有—— [wo zhen de mei you ——]

english: *Sigh* Very well. Another time, perhaps.
translation: *叹气*很好。也许还有一次。 [* tan qi * hen hao 。 ye xu hai you yi ci 。]

english: Why do you ask questions if you're going to read my mind anyway?
translation: 如果你无论如何都想读懂我的想法，为什么还要问问题呢？ [ru guo ni wu lun ru he dou xiang du dong wo de xiang fa ， wei shen me hai yao wen wen ti ne ？]

english: I was being polite, silly foreigner.
translation: 我是个有礼貌的傻外国人。 [wo shi ge you li mao de sha wai guo ren 。]

english: I'm good thanks, bye.
translation: 我很好，谢谢，再见。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie ， zai jian 。]

english: Ah, a stranger to our island. What brings you here?
translation: 啊，我们岛上的陌生人。是什么风把你吹到这里来的？ [a ， wo men dao shang de mo sheng ren 。 shi shen me feng ba ni chui dao zhe li lai de ？]

english: The Oneiromancer told me you may be able to help...
translation: 梦梦法师告诉我你也许能帮上忙... [meng meng fa shi gao su wo ni ye xu neng bang shang mang ...]

english: With a potion?
translation: 用药水？ [yong yao shui ？]

english: I don't think I'll ever get used to you people reading my mind. Yes, a potion of Waking Sleep? I need it to go to the...
translation: 我想我永远不会习惯你们读我的心思。是的，一剂醒眠药水？我需要它去... [wo xiang wo yong yuan bu hui xi guan ni men du wo de xin si 。 shi de ， yi ji xing mian yao shui ？ wo xu yao ta qu ...]

english: Dreamland.
translation: 梦境。 [meng jing 。]

english: You know that's really quite rude!
translation: 你知道这真的很粗鲁！ [ni zhi dao zhe zhen de hen cu lu ！]

english: Sorry. Carry on.
translation: 对不起。继续。 [dui bu qi 。 ji xu 。]

english: Well, I was hoping you could tell me how to make one?
translation: 好吧，我希望你能告诉我如何制作一个？ [hao ba ， wo xi wang ni neng gao su wo ru he zhi zuo yi ge ？]

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: Are you sure you're ready to take on the dream land?
translation: 您确定准备好踏上梦想之地了吗？ [nin que ding zhun bei hao ta shang meng xiang zhi di le ma ？]

english: There's no harm in trying. Right...?

translation: 好吧，至少我们现在正在修复它。 [hao ba ， zhi shao wo men xian zai zheng zai xiu fu ta 。]

english: We? Are you sure about that? I find you adventurers often have ulterior motives.
translation: 我们？你确定吗？我发现你们冒险家常常别有用心。 [wo men ？ ni que ding ma ？ wo fa xian ni men mao xian jia chang chang bie you yong xin 。]

english: What do you mean by that?
translation: 你这是什么意思？ [ni zhe shi shen me yi si ？]

english: You may say that you are here to fight the corruption. Indeed, there may be some truth to that. However, would you really be here if there wasn't something for you to gain?
translation: 你可能会说，你是来打击腐败的。事实上，这可能有一定道理。不过，如果没有什么可以让你有所收获的话，你真的会在这里吗？ [ni ke neng hui shuo ， ni shi lai da ji fu bai de 。 shi shi shang ， zhe ke neng you yi ding dao li 。 bu guo ， ru guo mei you shen me ke yi rang ni you suo shou huo de hua ， ni zhen de hui zai zhe li ma ？]

english: I swear, I'm only here to deal with the Devourer's corruption!
translation: 我发誓，我来这里只是为了对付吞噬者的腐败！ [wo fa shi ， wo lai zhe li zhi shi wei le dui fu tun shi zhe de fu bai ！]

english: I hear you speak those words, but I feel no conviction behind them.
translation: 我听到你说这些话，但我感觉它们背后没有任何说服力。 [wo ting dao ni shuo zhe xie hua ， dan wo gan jue ta men bei hou mei you ren he shuo fu li 。]

english: How can I prove it to you? What is it that you are looking for?
translation: 我怎样才能向你证明呢？您在寻找什么？ [wo zen yang cai neng xiang ni zheng ming ne ？ nin zai xun zhao shen me ？]

english: Why do you care what opinions a camel has of you?
translation: 你为什么要在意骆驼对你的看法？ [ni wei shen me yao zai yi luo tuo dui ni de kan fa ？]

english: I want everyone to like me.
translation: 我希望每个人都喜欢我。 [wo xi wang mei ge ren dou xi huan wo 。]

english: If your only goal in life is to be liked by all, then you'll probably spend the rest of it chasing the impossible.
translation: 如果你人生唯一的目标是被所有人喜欢，那么你可能会用剩下的时间去追逐不可能的事情。 [ru guo ni ren sheng wei yi de mu biao shi bei suo you ren xi huan ， na me ni ke neng hui yong sheng xia de shi jian qu zhui zhu bu ke neng de shi qing 。]

english: I want to prove you wrong.
translation: 我想证明你错了。 [wo xiang zheng ming ni cuo le 。]

english: So you only care because my words cut close to the bone? If you truly want to prove me wrong, then it's your outlook that should change.
translation: 所以你只是因为我的话刺耳才关心？如果你真的想证明我错了，那么你的观点就应该改变。 [suo yi ni zhi shi yin wei wo de hua ci er cai guan xin ？ ru guo ni zhen de xiang zheng ming wo cuo le ， na me ni de guan dian jiu ying gai gai bian 。]

english: It seems to be important to you.
translation: 看来这对你很重要。 [kan lai zhe dui ni hen zhong yao 。]

english: You think so?
translation: 你这么认为吗？ [ni zhe me ren wei ma ？]

english: I do, so tell me, what can I do to show you that not all adventurers are the same?
translation: 我确实如此，所以告诉我，我该怎么做才能让你知道并非所有冒险家都是一样的？ [wo que shi ru ci ， suo yi gao su wo ， wo gai zen me zuo cai neng rang ni zhi dao bing fei suo you mao xian jia dou shi yi yang de ？]

english: Hmm...
Every adventurer seems to destroy without any thought as to what they are doing, nor with any intent to restore what was lost.
translation: 每个冒险家似乎都在不考虑自己在做什么的情况下进行破坏，也没有任何意图恢复失去的东西。 [mei ge mao xian jia si hu dou zai bu kao lv zi ji zai zuo shen me de qing kuang xia jin xing po huai ， ye mei you ren he yi tu hui fu shi qu de dong xi 。]

english: If you can do that, then that would prove to me that you are infact different from the rest.
translation: 如果你能做到这一点，那就向我证明你其实与其他人不同。 [ru guo ni neng zuo dao zhe yi dian ， na jiu xiang wo zheng ming ni qi shi yu qi ta ren bu tong 。]

english: Restore what was lost? What do you mean by that?
translation: 恢复丢失的东西？你这是什么意思？ [hui fu diu shi de dong xi ？ ni zhe shi shen me yi si ？]

english: That's for you to figure out.
translation: 这需要你自己去弄清楚。 [zhe xu yao ni zi ji qu nong qing chu 。]

english: What did you ask me to do again?
translation: 你又叫我做什么？ [ni you jiao wo zuo shen me ？]

english: So you want me to restore what was lost?
translation: 所以你想让我恢复失去的东西吗？ [suo yi ni xiang rang wo hui fu shi qu de dong xi ma ？]

english: Indeed.
translation: 的确。 [di que 。]

english: I believe I understand now.
translation: 我相信我现在明白了。 [wo xiang xin wo xian zai ming bai le 。]

english: Oh? Do tell.
translation: 哦？一定要告诉。 [o ？ yi ding yao gao su 。]

english: Well, while us adventurers have been doing our best to fight against the Devourer's corruption, we've been neglecting what has been lost to achieve that goal. Namely, the four guardians we defeated along the way.
translation: 好吧，虽然我们冒险家一直在尽最大努力对抗吞噬者的腐败，但我们却忽略了为实现这一目标而失去的东西。也就是我们一路上打败的四位守护者。 [hao ba ， sui ran wo men mao xian jia yi zhi zai jin zui da nu li dui kang tun shi zhe de fu bai ， dan wo men que hu lve le wei shi xian zhe yi mu biao er shi qu de dong xi 。 ye jiu shi wo men yi lu shang da bai de si wei shou hu zhe 。]

english: Ba-Ba was a proud baboon who wished for her troop to flourish. To honour her, I made sure that they won't be forgotten by telling their story to the monkeys of Ape Atoll.
translation: 狒狒是一只骄傲的狒狒，她希望她的狒狒队伍能够蓬勃发展。为了纪念她，我向猿环礁的猴子们讲述了他们的故事，确保他们不会被遗忘。 [fei fei shi yi zhi jiao ao de fei fei ， ta xi wang ta de fei fei dui wu neng gou peng bo fa zhan 。 wei le ji nian ta ， wo xiang yuan huan jiao de hou zi men jiang shu le ta men de gu shi ， que bao ta men bu hui bei yi wang 。]

english: Akkha was cruelly denied death by the Devourer, so I gave his ashes to the High Priest of Icthlarin to give him a proper send-off.
translation: 阿卡被吞噬者残酷地拒绝了死亡，所以我把他的骨灰交给了伊斯拉林的大祭司，给他一个正式的送别。 [a ka bei tun shi zhe can ku di ju jue le si wang ， suo yi wo ba ta de gu hui jiao gei le yi si la lin de da ji si ， gei ta yi ge zheng shi de song bie 。]

english: Zebak was fooled into leaving his home and confined within the tomb, so I took his fang and buried it on an island surrounded by crocodiles.
translation: 泽巴克被骗离开了家，被关在坟墓里，所以我拿走了他的毒牙，把它埋在一个被鳄鱼包围的岛上。 [ze ba ke bei pian li kai le jia ， bei guan zai fen mu li ， suo yi wo na zou le ta de du ya ， ba ta mai zai yi ge bei e yu bao wei de dao shang 。]

english: Kephri was promised a future for her race, but it was all a lie. I found a scarab egg within some of her dung, and I gave it to the High Priest of Scabaras to try and nurture it.
translation: 凯夫里曾被许诺为她的种族带来未来，但这全是谎言。我在她的粪便中发现了一颗圣甲虫蛋，我把它交给了斯卡巴拉斯的大祭司来尝试培育它。 [kai fu li ceng bei xu nuo wei ta de zhong zu dai lai wei lai ， dan zhe quan shi huang yan 。 wo zai ta de fen bian zhong fa xian le yi ke sheng jia chong dan ， wo ba ta jiao gei le si ka ba la si de da ji si lai chang shi pei yu ta 。]

english: Well well, colour me impressed adventurer. It seems that you do care after all.
translation: 好吧好吧，给我留下深刻印象的冒险家。看来你还是很关心的。 [hao ba hao ba ， gei wo liu xia shen ke yin xiang de mao xian jia 。 kan lai ni hai shi hen guan xin de 。]

english: It's a shame that much of the damage cannot truly be undone, but I know that Het, Apmeken, Crondis and even Scabaras will be grateful for your actions.
translation: 遗憾的是，大部分损害无法真正挽回，但我知道 Het、Apmeken、Crondis 甚至 Scabaras 都会感谢你的行为。 [yi han de shi ， da bu fen sun hai wu fa zhen zheng wan hui ， dan wo zhi dao  Het、Apmeken、Crondis  shen zhi  Scabaras  du hui gan xie ni de xing wei 。]

english: I just wish there was more I could do.
translation: 我只是希望我能做更多的事情。 [wo zhi shi xi wang wo neng zuo geng duo de shi qing 。]

english: We always do, but you have still done more than most.
translation: 我们总是这样做，但你仍然比大多数人做得更多。 [wo men zong shi zhe yang zuo ， dan ni reng ran bi da duo shu ren zuo de geng duo 。]

english: Now, I have something for you. I've been looking for someone worthy enough to pass this on to.
translation: 现在，我有东西给你。我一直在寻找一个值得将这一切传递给的人。 [xian zai ， wo you dong xi gei ni 。 wo yi zhi zai xun zhao yi ge zhi de jiang zhe yi qie chuan di gei de ren 。]

english: A key? What's this for?
translation: 钥匙？这是干啥用的？ [yao shi ？ zhe shi gan sha yong de ？]

english: I'll leave that as another puzzle for you to solve.
translation: 我将把它作为另一个难题留给你来解决。 [wo jiang ba ta zuo wei ling yi ge nan ti liu gei ni lai jie jue 。]

english: Well thanks, I guess... You know, out of all the camels I've met, you're definitely the strangest one.
translation: 好吧，谢谢，我想……你知道，在我见过的所有骆驼中，你绝对是最奇怪的一个。 [hao ba ， xie xie ， wo xiang …… ni zhi dao ， zai wo jian guo de suo you luo tuo zhong ， ni jue dui shi zui qi guai de yi ge 。]

english: Well, it does take a special kind of camel to master the portal magic used for bank access.
translation: 嗯，确实需要一种特殊的骆驼来掌握用于银行访问的传送门魔法。 [n ， que shi xu yao yi zhong te shu de luo tuo lai zhang wo yong yu yin hang fang wen de chuan song men mo fa 。]

english: I've lost that key you gave me.
translation: 我把你给我的那把钥匙弄丢了。 [wo ba ni gei wo de na ba yao shi nong diu le 。]

english: And it conveniently found its way back to me. Try not to lose it this time.
translation: 它很方便地回到了我身边。这次尽量不要弄丢了。 [ta hen fang bian di hui dao le wo shen bian 。 zhe ci jin liang bu yao nong diu le 。]

english: Do you have a name?
translation: 你有名字吗？ [ni you ming zi ma ？]

english: My name is my own, adventurer. It's hardly important right now.
translation: 我的名字是我自己的，冒险家。现在这并不重要。 [wo de ming zi shi wo zi ji de ， mao xian jia 。 xian zai zhe bing bu zhong yao 。]

english: I suppose you've earned the right to know. My name is Cam the Camel.
translation: 我想你已经赢得了知情权。我的名字是骆驼卡姆。 [wo xiang ni yi jing ying de le zhi qing quan 。 wo de ming zi shi luo tuo ka mu 。]

english: Well, nice to meet you, Cam the Camel. It'll be nice to call you something other than 'the bank camel' from now on.
translation: 嗯，很高兴认识你，骆驼卡姆。从现在开始，最好叫你“银行骆驼”以外的名字。 [n ， hen gao xing ren shi ni ， luo tuo ka mu 。 cong xian zai kai shi ， zui hao jiao ni “ yin hang luo tuo ” yi wai de ming zi 。]

english: I'm glad I met a kind adventurer such as yourself. I look forward to seeing you continue your diligent work in cleansing this tomb of the Devourer's corruption.
translation: 我很高兴遇到了像你这样善良的冒险家。我期待着看到你继续勤奋地工作，清除这座坟墓中吞噬者的腐败。 [wo hen gao xing yu dao le xiang ni zhe yang shan liang de mao xian jia 。 wo qi dai zhe kan dao ni ji xu qin fen di gong zuo ， qing chu zhe zuo fen mu zhong tun shi zhe de fu bai 。]

english: As I said, my name is Cam the Camel.
translation: 正如我所说，我的名字是骆驼卡姆。 [zheng ru wo suo shuo ， wo de ming zi shi luo tuo ka mu 。]

english: Can you follow me into the tomb?
translation: 你能跟我进坟墓吗？ [ni neng gen wo jin fen mu ma ？]

english: Why would I want to do that?
translation: 我为什么要这么做？ [wo wei shen me yao zhe me zuo ？]

english: It would be very helpful. Think of all the supplies I'd have access to if you came with me and followed me around like a portable bank.
translation: 这会很有帮助。想想如果你和我一起并像便携式银行一样跟着我，我可以获得所有的物资。 [zhe hui hen you bang zhu 。 xiang xiang ru guo ni he wo yi qi bing xiang bian xie shi yin hang yi yang gen zhe wo ， wo ke yi huo de suo you de wu zi 。]

english: But you don't even use a bank.
translation: 但你甚至不使用银行。 [dan ni shen zhi bu shi yong yin hang 。]

english: Oh yeah! I forgot.
translation: 噢耶！我忘了。 [o ye ！ wo wang le 。]

english: Right...
translation: 正确的... [zheng que de ...]

english: What do you take me for? Some kind of pack yak?
translation: 你把我当什么？某种驮牦牛？ [ni ba wo dang shen me ？ mou zhong tuo mao niu ？]

english: Besides, if I leave this place then I won't be able to help any other adventurers with their banking needs.
translation: 而且，如果我离开这里，我就无法帮助其他冒险者解决银行业务的问题了。 [er qie ， ru guo wo li kai zhe li ， wo jiu wu fa bang zhu qi ta mao xian zhe jie jue yin hang ye wu de wen ti le 。]

english: I need to get going.
translation: 我得走了。 [wo de zou le 。]

english: Suit yourself.
translation: 适合自己。 [shi he zi ji 。]

english: Bleh, this grain is disgusting! Do you think I am but a simple cow, adventurer?
translation: 哎呀，这粒谷物真恶心！你以为我只是一头普通的牛吗，冒险家？ [ai ya ， zhe li gu wu zhen e xin ！ ni yi wei wo zhi shi yi tou pu tong de niu ma ， mao xian jia ？]

english: No, no, I was just...
translation: 不不不，我只是…… [bu bu bu ， wo zhi shi ……]

english: This is why I eat the grain in that sack over there. It's specially grown out here in the desert. Once harvested, it goes through a preparation process of several years that...
translation: 这就是为什么我吃那边那个袋子里的谷物。它是专门在沙漠中生长的。一旦收获，它会经历数年的准备过程...... [zhe jiu shi wei shen me wo chi na bian na ge dai zi li de gu wu 。 ta shi zhuan men zai sha mo zhong sheng zhang de 。 yi dan shou huo ， ta hui jing li shu nian de zhun bei guo cheng ......]

english: The bank camel talks at length about the process of producing such fine grain...
translation: 银行骆驼详细讲述了生产如此优质谷物的过程...... [yin hang luo tuo xiang xi jiang shu le sheng chan ru ci you zhi gu wu de guo cheng ......]

english: ...and that's why this grain is so special. Not to mention so hard to come by.
translation: ...这就是为什么这种谷物如此特别。更不用说这么难了。 [... zhe jiu shi wei shen me zhe zhong gu wu ru ci te bie 。 geng bu yong shuo zhe me nan le 。]

english: My, this is some good grain, adventurer! Great flavour profile, not too salty and with just a hint of sweetness. It almost reminds me of...
translation: 天哪，这是一些好谷物，冒险家！味道极佳，不太咸，略带甜味。这几乎让我想起了... [tian na ， zhe shi yi xie hao gu wu ， mao xian jia ！ wei dao ji jia ， bu tai xian ， lve dai tian wei 。 zhe ji hu rang wo xiang qi le ...]

english: The bank camel looks at you for a moment as if lost in thought.
translation: 银行骆驼看了你一会儿，好像陷入了沉思。 [yin hang luo tuo kan le ni yi hui er ， hao xiang xian ru le chen si 。]

english: Erm, yes?
translation: 嗯，是吗？ [n ， shi ma ？]

english: Oh, never mind, I was just thinking about something.
translation: 哦，没关系，我只是在想一些事情。 [o ， mei guan xi ， wo zhi shi zai xiang yi xie shi qing 。]

english: The bank camel stares at you in silence for an uncomfortably long time.
translation: 银行骆驼静静地盯着你看了很长一段时间，让人感到不舒服。 [yin hang luo tuo jing jing di ding zhe ni kan le hen zhang yi duan shi jian ， rang ren gan dao bu shu fu 。]

english: Well, I can't stand around here all day. I've got some things I need to take care of.
translation: 好吧，我不能整天站在这里。我有一些事情需要处理。 [hao ba ， wo bu neng zheng tian zhan zai zhe li 。 wo you yi xie shi qing xu yao chu li 。]

english: The bank camel looks at you with piqued interest, then rolls their eyes as they realise you can't understand them.
translation: 银行骆驼饶有兴趣地看着你，然后翻白眼，因为他们意识到你听不懂他们的话。 [yin hang luo tuo rao you xing qu di kan zhe ni ， ran hou fan bai yan ， yin wei ta men yi shi dao ni ting bu dong ta men de hua 。]

english: Quite the banana you have there! Ba-Ba and her baboon troop were always known for finding the biggest of these. It's a shame that their memory will now disappear into history.
translation: 正是你那里的香蕉！狒狒和她的狒狒队伍总是以找到最大的狒狒而闻名。遗憾的是，他们的记忆现在将消失在历史中。 [zheng shi ni na li de xiang jiao ！ fei fei he ta de fei fei dui wu zong shi yi zhao dao zui da de fei fei er wen ming 。 yi han de shi ， ta men de ji yi xian zai jiang xiao shi zai li shi zhong 。]

english: Ah, the fang of the mighty Zebak. What a cruel fate to be consumed by ever-lasting hunger.
translation: 啊，强大的泽巴克的尖牙。被永远的饥饿吞噬是多么残酷的命运啊。 [a ， qiang da de ze ba ke de jian ya 。 bei yong yuan de ji e tun shi shi duo me can ku de ming yun a 。]

english: Ah, the ashes of Akkha, a great warrior. It's a shame that his soul never got to experience the release of death.
translation: 啊，伟大战士阿卡的骨灰。可惜他的灵魂从未体验过死亡的解脱。 [a ， wei da zhan shi a ka de gu hui 。 ke xi ta de ling hun cong wei ti yan guo si wang de jie tuo 。]

english: Faeces! How lovely. If I'm not mistaken, this dung is from Kephri herself, last of the dawn scarabs. It's a shame that her kind have long been lost to the world.
translation: 粪便！多么可爱啊。如果我没记错的话，这粪便是凯芙莉本人的，她是最后一只黎明圣甲虫。可惜她的同类早已消失在世间。 [fen bian ！ duo me ke ai a 。 ru guo wo mei ji cuo de hua ， zhe fen bian shi kai fu li ben ren de ， ta shi zui hou yi zhi li ming sheng jia chong 。 ke xi ta de tong lei zao yi xiao shi zai shi jian 。]

english: You go to search the sack, but the bank camel glares at you menacingly and spits in your direction.
translation: 你去搜查袋子，但银行骆驼恶狠狠地瞪着你，并向你的方向吐口水。 [ni qu sou cha dai zi ， dan yin hang luo tuo e hen hen di deng zhe ni ， bing xiang ni de fang xiang tu kou shui 。]

english: Hey, get your hands off my food! Unless you'd like me to start eating the contents of your bank instead!
translation: 嘿，把你的手从我的食物上拿开！除非你想让我开始吃你银行里的东西！ [hei ， ba ni de shou cong wo de shi wu shang na kai ！ chu fei ni xiang rang wo kai shi chi ni yin hang li de dong xi ！]

english: Jokes on you! I don't have a bank!
translation: 笑话你！我没有银行！ [xiao hua ni ！ wo mei you yin hang ！]

english: Well I hope you're very proud of yourself. Your arbitrary restrictions don't make you better than everyone else, you know.
translation: 好吧，我希望你为自己感到骄傲。你知道，你的任意限制并不会让你比其他人更好。 [hao ba ， wo xi wang ni wei zi ji gan dao jiao ao 。 ni zhi dao ， ni de ren yi xian zhi bing bu hui rang ni bi qi ta ren geng hao 。]

english: Wow, that's harsh.
translation: 哇，这太严酷了。 [wa ， zhe tai yan ku le 。]

english: Wow! A needle in a hay sack?
translation: 哇！干草袋里的针？ [wa ！ gan cao dai li de zhen ？]

english: Wait, isn't it supposed to be a stack, not a sack?
translation: 等等，它不是应该是一个堆栈，而不是一个袋子吗？ [deng deng ， ta bu shi ying gai shi yi ge dui zhan ， er bu shi yi ge dai zi ma ？]

english: And now that I think about it, this sack is full of grain, not hay...
translation: 现在想来，这袋子装的是谷物，不是干草…… [xian zai xiang lai ， zhe dai zi zhuang de shi gu wu ， bu shi gan cao ……]

english: Ah well, never mind.
translation: 啊好吧，没关系。 [a hao ba ， mei guan xi 。]

english: It's just grain...
translation: 这只是谷物... [zhe zhi shi gu wu ...]

english: Using the bank itself. I'm not sure how....?

english: Speak to any banker and ask to see your bank account. If you have set a PIN you will be asked for it, then all the belongings you have placed in the bank will appear in the window. To withdraw one item, left-
translation: 与任何银行工作人员交谈并要求查看您的银行帐户。如果您设置了 PIN 码，系统会要求您提供该密码，然后您放入银行的所有物品都会显示在窗口中。要撤回一件物品，请向左- [yu ren he yin hang gong zuo ren yuan jiao tan bing yao qiu cha kan nin de yin hang zhang hu 。 ru guo nin she zhi le  PIN  ma ， xi tong hui yao qiu nin ti gong gai mi ma ， ran hou nin fang ru yin hang de suo you wu pin du hui xian shi zai chuang kou zhong 。 yao che hui yi jian wu pin ， qing xiang zuo -]

english: click on it once.
translation: 单击它一次。 [dan ji ta yi ci 。]

english: To withdraw many, right-click on the item and select from the menu. The same for depositing, left-click on the item in your inventory to deposit it in the bank. Right-click on it to deposit many of the same items.
translation: 要提取多个，请右键单击该项目并从菜单中选择。存款也是如此，左键单击库存中的物品即可将其存入银行。右键单击它可以存放许多相同的物品。 [yao ti qu duo ge ， qing you jian dan ji gai xiang mu bing cong cai dan zhong xuan ze 。 cun kuan ye shi ru ci ， zuo jian dan ji ku cun zhong de wu pin ji ke jiang qi cun ru yin hang 。 you jian dan ji ta ke yi cun fang xu duo xiang tong de wu pin 。]

english: To move things around in your bank: firstly select Swap or Insert as your default moving mode, you can find these buttons on the bank window itself. Then click and drag an item to where you want it to appear.
translation: 要在银行中移动物品：首先选择“交换”或“插入”作为默认移动模式，您可以在银行窗口本身上找到这些按钮。然后单击项目并将其拖动到您希望其显示的位置。 [yao zai yin hang zhong yi dong wu pin ： shou xian xuan ze “ jiao huan ” huo “ cha ru ” zuo wei mo ren yi dong mo shi ， nin ke yi zai yin hang chuang kou ben shen shang zhao dao zhe xie an niu 。 ran hou dan ji xiang mu bing jiang qi tuo dong dao nin xi wang qi xian shi de wei zhi 。]

english: You may withdraw 'notes' or 'certificates' when the items you are trying to withdraw do not stack in your inventory. This will only work for items which are tradable.
translation: 当您尝试提取的物品未堆叠在您的库存中时，您可以提取“票据”或“证书”。这仅适用于可交易的物品。 [dang nin chang shi ti qu de wu pin wei dui die zai nin de ku cun zhong shi ， nin ke yi ti qu “ piao ju ” huo “ zheng shu ”。 zhe jin shi yong yu ke jiao yi de wu pin 。]

english: For instance, if you wanted to sell 100 logs to another player, they would not fit in one inventory and you would need to do multiple trades. Instead, click the Note button to do withdraw the logs as 'certs' or 'notes',
translation: 例如，如果您想将 100 根原木出售给另一位玩家，它们将无法放入一个库存中，您将需要进行多次交易。相反，单击“注释”按钮将日志撤回为“证书”或“注释”， [li ru ， ru guo nin xiang jiang  100  gen yuan mu chu shou gei ling yi wei wan jia ， ta men jiang wu fa fang ru yi ge ku cun zhong ， nin jiang xu yao jin xing duo ci jiao yi 。 xiang fan ， dan ji “ zhu shi ” an niu jiang ri zhi che hui wei “ zheng shu ” huo “ zhu shi ”，]

translation: 然后取出您需要的物品。 [ran hou qu chu nin xu yao de wu pin 。]

english: Using Bank deposit boxes.... what are they?
translation: 使用银行存款箱......它们是什么？ [shi yong yin hang cun kuan xiang ...... ta men shi shen me ？]

english: They look like grey pillars, there's one just over there, near the desk. Bank deposit boxes save so much time. If you're simply wanting to deposit a single item, 'Use' it on the deposit box.
translation: 它们看起来像灰色的柱子，就在那边，靠近桌子的地方有一根。银行存款箱节省了很多时间。如果您只想存放单个物品，请在存放箱上“使用”它。 [ta men kan qi lai xiang hui se de zhu zi ， jiu zai na bian ， kao jin zhuo zi de di fang you yi gen 。 yin hang cun kuan xiang jie sheng le hen duo shi jian 。 ru guo nin zhi xiang cun fang dan ge wu pin ， qing zai cun fang xiang shang “ shi yong ” ta 。]

english: Otherwise, simply click once on the box and it will give you a choice of what to deposit in an interface very similar to the bank itself. Very quick for when you're simply fishing or mining etc.
translation: 否则，只需单击该框一次，您就会在与银行本身非常相似的界面中选择存款内容。当您只是钓鱼或采矿等时非常快。 [fou ze ， zhi xu dan ji gai kuang yi ci ， nin jiu hui zai yu yin hang ben shen fei chang xiang si de jie mian zhong xuan ze cun kuan nei rong 。 dang nin zhi shi diao yu huo cai kuang deng shi fei chang kuai 。]

english: What's this PIN thing that people keep talking about?
translation: 人们一直在谈论的 PIN 码是什么？ [ren men yi zhi zai tan lun de  PIN  ma shi shen me ？]

english: The PIN - Personal Identification Number - can be set on your bank account to protect the items there in case someone finds out your account password. It consists of four numbers that you remember and tell
translation: PIN（个人识别码）可以设置在您的银行帐户中，以保护其中的物品，以防有人发现您的帐户密码。它由您记住并讲述的四个数字组成 [PIN（ ge ren shi bie ma ） ke yi she zhi zai nin de yin hang zhang hu zhong ， yi bao hu qi zhong de wu pin ， yi fang you ren fa xian nin de zhang hu mi ma 。 ta you nin ji zhu bing jiang shu de si ge shu zi zu cheng]

english: no one.
translation: 没有人。 [mei you ren 。]

english: So if someone did manage to get your password they couldn't steal your items if they were in the bank.
translation: 因此，即使有人设法获取您的密码，如果您的物品在银行里，他们也无法窃取您的物品。 [yin ci ， ji shi you ren she fa huo qu nin de mi ma ， ru guo nin de wu pin zai yin hang li ， ta men ye wu fa qie qu nin de wu pin 。]

english: How do I set my PIN?
translation: 如何设置 PIN 码？ [ru he she zhi  PIN  ma ？]

english: You can set your PIN by talking to any banker, they will allow you to access your bank pin settings. Here you can choose to set your pin and recovery delay. Remember not to set it to anything personal such as
translation: 您可以通过与任何银行工作人员交谈来设置您的 PIN，他们将允许您访问您的银行 PIN 设置。您可以在此处选择设置密码和恢复延迟。请记住不要将其设置为任何个人信息，例如 [nin ke yi tong guo yu ren he yin hang gong zuo ren yuan jiao tan lai she zhi nin de  PIN， ta men jiang yun xu nin fang wen nin de yin hang  PIN  she zhi 。 nin ke yi zai ci chu xuan ze she zhi mi ma he hui fu yan chi 。 qing ji zhu bu yao jiang qi she zhi wei ren he ge ren xin xi ， li ru]

english: your real life bank PIN or birthday.
translation: 您现实生活中的银行密码或生日。 [nin xian shi sheng huo zhong de yin hang mi ma huo sheng ri 。]

english: The recovery delay is to protect your banked items from account thieves. If someone stole your account and asked to have the PIN deleted, they would have to wait a few days before accessing your bank account to
translation: 恢复延迟是为了保护您的银行项目免遭帐户窃贼的侵害。如果有人窃取了您的帐户并要求删除 PIN，他们必须等待几天才能访问您的银行帐户 [hui fu yan chi shi wei le bao hu nin de yin hang xiang mu mian zao zhang hu qie zei de qin hai 。 ru guo you ren qie qu le nin de zhang hu bing yao qiu shan chu  PIN， ta men bi xu deng dai ji tian cai neng fang wen nin de yin hang zhang hu]

english: steal your items. This will give you time to recover your account.
