english: I train my skills upon its foul brood, to prepare myself for the fight ahead!
translation: 我在它肮脏的巢穴中训练我的技能，为未来的战斗做好准备！ [wo zai ta ang zang de chao xue zhong xun lian wo de ji neng ， wei wei lai de zhan dou zuo hao zhun bei ！]

english: Okay, thanks Bardur. Do you have any food with you?
translation: 好的，谢谢巴杜尔。你有带食物吗？ [hao de ， xie xie ba du er 。 ni you dai shi wu ma ？]

english: Ah, you did not come prepared [Fremennik Name]?
translation: 啊，你没有做好准备吗[Fremennik Name]？ [a ， ni mei you zuo hao zhun bei ma [Fremennik Name]？]

english: I have nothing to spare, but my equipment grows weaker under the onslaught of the dagger-mouth spawns!
translation: 我已经没什么多余的了，但是我的装备在刀口怪的攻击下越来越弱了！ [wo yi jing mei shen me duo yu de le ， dan shi wo de zhuang bei zai dao kou guai de gong ji xia yue lai yue ruo le ！]

english: I will trade you a finely cooked shark if you have a replacement for my helm, my shield or my blade...
translation: 如果你能找到我的头盔、盾牌或剑刃的替代品，我就用一条煮熟的鲨鱼交换给你…… [ru guo ni neng zhao dao wo de tou kui 、 dun pai huo jian ren de ti dai pin ， wo jiu yong yi tiao zhu shu de sha yu jiao huan gei ni ……]

english: Give me any equipment you wish to trade, and I will pay you a shark for it.
translation: 给我任何你想交易的装备，我会付给你一条鲨鱼。 [gei wo ren he ni xiang jiao yi de zhuang bei ， wo hui fu gei ni yi tiao sha yu 。]

english: Ah, just what I was looking for! You wish to trade me that for a cooked shark?
translation: 啊，正是我正在寻找的！你想用它换一条煮熟的鲨鱼吗？ [a ， zheng shi wo zheng zai xun zhao de ！ ni xiang yong ta huan yi tiao zhu shu de sha yu ma ？]

english: Ah, this will serve me well as a backup! My thanks to you [Fremennik Name], I trust we will one day sing songs together of glorious battles in the Rellekka longhall! (Fremennik item gets replaced by a cooked shark.)
translation: 啊，这对我来说是一个很好的备份！我感谢你[Fremennik Name]，我相信有一天我们会在Rellekka长厅一起唱起光荣战斗的歌曲！ （弗雷曼尼克物品被煮熟的鲨鱼取代。） [a ， zhe dui wo lai shuo shi yi ge hen hao de bei fen ！ wo gan xie ni [Fremennik Name]， wo xiang xin you yi tian wo men hui zai Rellekka zhang ting yi qi chang qi guang rong zhan dou de ge qu ！ （ fu lei man ni ke wu pin bei zhu shu de sha yu qu dai 。）]

english: As you wish, [Fremennik Name] My weapons have lasted me this long, I will keep my trust in them yet.
translation: 如你所愿，[Fremennik Name] 我的武器已经使用了这么久，我仍然会继续信任它们。 [ru ni suo yuan ，[Fremennik Name]  wo de wu qi yi jing shi yong le zhe me jiu ， wo reng ran hui ji xu xin ren ta men 。]

english: No [Fremennik Name], I will trade you my finely cooked shark for a trusty Fremennik blade, a sturdy Fremennik helm, or a mighty Fremennik shield...
translation: 不，[弗雷曼尼克名字]，我会用我精心烹制的鲨鱼来换取值得信赖的弗雷曼尼克刀片、坚固的弗雷曼尼克头盔或强大的弗雷曼尼克盾牌...... [bu ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]， wo hui yong wo jing xin peng zhi de sha yu lai huan qu zhi de xin lai de fu lei man ni ke dao pian 、 jian gu de fu lei man ni ke tou kui huo qiang da de fu lei man ni ke dun pai ......]

english: I have no interest in that... thing... you are trying to offload on me.
translation: 我对那件事没兴趣……你想把负担卸给我。 [wo dui na jian shi mei xing qu …… ni xiang ba fu dan xie gei wo 。]

english: Ah! Exile! Begone with you, before you suffer the same fate as these fledglings!
translation: 啊!流亡！快走吧，免得你们遭受与这些幼鸟同样的命运！ [a ! liu wang ！ kuai zou ba ， mian de ni men zao shou yu zhe xie you niao tong yang de ming yun ！]

english: Fine. I was going anyway.
translation: 美好的。无论如何我还是要去的。 [mei hao de 。 wu lun ru he wo hai shi yao qu de 。]

english: Bardur, wait! I'm here with a task from the Chieftain.
translation: 巴杜尔，等等！我是带着酋长的任务来的。 [ba du er ， deng deng ！ wo shi dai zhe qiu zhang de ren wu lai de 。]

english: I'm not too certain I should trust you! What is it you want?
translation: 我不太确定我应该相信你！你想要什么？ [wo bu tai que ding wo ying gai xiang xin ni ！ ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: I'm looking to remake V's Shield, but I require a Fremennik Shield from a warrior. Where could I find one?
translation: 我想要重制 V 之盾，但我需要战士提供弗雷曼尼克之盾。我在哪里可以找到一个？ [wo xiang yao zhong zhi  V  zhi dun ， dan wo xu yao zhan shi ti gong fu lei man ni ke zhi dun 。 wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao yi ge ？]

english: The daggermouths found in these caves should drop a few when slain. They take them from fallen warriors. I have a few myself, in fact. I wish to give them back to the families of the fallen.
translation: 在这些洞穴中发现的匕首在被杀死时应该会掉落一些。他们从阵亡的战士那里夺走它们。事实上，我自己也有一些。我希望将它们还给阵亡者的家人。 [zai zhe xie dong xue zhong fa xian de bi shou zai bei sha si shi ying gai hui diao luo yi xie 。 ta men cong zhen wang de zhan shi na li duo zou ta men 。 shi shi shang ， wo zi ji ye you yi xie 。 wo xi wang jiang ta men huan gei zhen wang zhe de jia ren 。]

english: These fledgelings won't drop anything you're looking for, though. Search the caves for some matured daggermouths.
translation: 不过，这些雏鸟不会掉落你正在寻找的任何东西。在洞穴中寻找一些成熟的匕首。 [bu guo ， zhe xie chu niao bu hui diao luo ni zheng zai xun zhao de ren he dong xi 。 zai dong xue zhong xun zhao yi xie cheng shu de bi shou 。]

english: Thanks for your time, Bardur.
translation: 感谢您抽出时间，巴杜尔。 [gan xie nin chou chu shi jian ， ba du er 。]

english: You're lucky I'm busy exile! Things might have been different if I wasn't...
translation: 你很幸运，我正忙着流放！如果我没有的话，事情可能会有所不同…… [ni hen xing yun ， wo zheng mang zhe liu fang ！ ru guo wo mei you de hua ， shi qing ke neng hui you suo bu tong ……]

english: Maybe I could buy one off you?
translation: 也许我可以向你买一件？ [ye xu wo ke yi xiang ni mai yi jian ？]

english: I don't have that much.
translation: 我没有那么多。 [wo mei you na me duo 。]

english: Be gone with you then!
translation: 那就和你一起走吧！ [na jiu he ni yi qi zou ba ！]

english: Sounds good to me.
translation: 对我来说听起来不错。 [dui wo lai shuo ting qi lai bu cuo 。]

english: (player loses 150k, gains a fremennik shield)
translation: （玩家损失 150k，获得弗里曼盾牌） [（ wan jia sun shi  150k， huo de fu li man dun pai ）]

english: Perhaps I misjudged you, exile. Best of luck on your adventure.
translation: 也许我误判了你，流放者。祝你冒险顺利。 [ye xu wo wu pan le ni ， liu fang zhe 。 zhu ni mao xian shun li 。]

english: That's far too much, I won't pay that!
translation: 太贵了，我不付钱！ [tai gui le ， wo bu fu qian ！]

english: Well I wouldn't expect an exile like you to care about the fallen. Be gone with you!
translation: 好吧，我不指望像你这样的流亡者会关心倒下的人。跟你走吧！ [hao ba ， wo bu zhi wang xiang ni zhe yang de liu wang zhe hui guan xin dao xia de ren 。 gen ni zou ba ！]

english: Exile, has that shield served you well?
translation: 流放者，那面盾牌对你有用吗？ [liu fang zhe ， na mian dun pai dui ni you yong ma ？]

english: Yes, thank you.
translation: 是的，谢谢。 [shi de ， xie xie 。]

english: All the best, exile.
translation: 祝你一切顺利，流放者。 [zhu ni yi qie shun li ， liu fang zhe 。]

english: I lost it.
translation: 我把它弄丢了。 [wo ba ta nong diu le 。]

english: Well you're not having another one if that's how you take care of things! If you want another, you'll need to slay some daggermouths!
translation: 好吧，如果你就是这样处理事情的话，你就不会再有一个了！如果你想要另一个，你需要杀死一些匕首嘴！ [hao ba ， ru guo ni jiu shi zhe yang chu li shi qing de hua ， ni jiu bu hui zai you yi ge le ！ ru guo ni xiang yao ling yi ge ， ni xu yao sha si yi xie bi shou zui ！]

english: Okay...
translation: 好的... [hao de ...]

english: Listen, [Fremennik Name]. I'm sorry about the way I acted while you were exiled. Bardur gets hostile around outerlanders.
translation: 听着，[弗里曼尼克名字]。我对你被流放期间我的行为感到抱歉。巴杜尔对外来者充满敌意。 [ting zhe ，[ fu li man ni ke ming zi ]。 wo dui ni bei liu fang qi jian wo de xing wei gan dao bao qian 。 ba du er dui wai lai zhe chong man di yi 。]

english: Don't worry about it, I understand! All's well that ends well! How've you been?
translation: 不用担心，我明白！一切都好，结局好！你过得怎么样？ [bu yong dan xin ， wo ming bai ！ yi qie dou hao ， jie ju hao ！ ni guo de zen me yang ？]

english: Ah, this will serve me well as a backup! My thanks to you [Fremennik name] Dräpare, I trust we will one day sing songs together of glorious battles in the Rellekka longhall!
translation: 啊，这对我来说是一个很好的备份！感谢你[弗里曼尼克名字]Dräpare，我相信有一天我们会在 Relekka 长厅一起唱起光荣战斗的歌曲！ [a ， zhe dui wo lai shuo shi yi ge hen hao de bei fen ！ gan xie ni [ fu li man ni ke ming zi ]Dräpare， wo xiang xin you yi tian wo men hui zai  Relekka  zhang ting yi qi chang qi guang rong zhan dou de ge qu ！]

english: As you wish, [Fremennik name] DräpareMy weapons have lasted me this long, I will keep my trust in them yet.
translation: 如你所愿，[弗里曼尼克名字] Dräpare 我的武器已经使用了这么久，我仍然会继续信任它们。 [ru ni suo yuan ，[ fu li man ni ke ming zi ] Dräpare  wo de wu qi yi jing shi yong le zhe me jiu ， wo reng ran hui ji xu xin ren ta men 。]

english: YES
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: NO
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Thanks for your time, Bardur.
translation: 感谢您抽出时间，巴杜尔。 [gan xie nin chou chu shi jian ， ba du er 。]

english: Maybe I could buy one off you?
translation: 也许我可以向你买一件？ [ye xu wo ke yi xiang ni mai yi jian ？]

english: Sounds good to me.
translation: 对我来说听起来不错。 [dui wo lai shuo ting qi lai bu cuo 。]

english: That's far too much, I won't pay that!
translation: 太贵了，我不付钱！ [tai gui le ， wo bu fu qian ！]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Oh! Hello there.
translation: 哦！你好呀。 [o ！ ni hao ya 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: My name is Ex Sea Captain Barfy Bill.
translation: 我的名字是前船长巴菲·比尔。 [wo de ming zi shi qian chuan zhang ba fei · bi er 。]

english: Ex sea captain?
translation: 前船长？ [qian chuan zhang ？]

english: Yeah, I bought a lovely ship and was planning to make a fortune running her as a merchant vessel.
translation: 是的，我买了一艘可爱的船，并打算将她作为商船经营来发财。 [shi de ， wo mai le yi sou ke ai de chuan ， bing da suan jiang ta zuo wei shang chuan jing ying lai fa cai 。]

english: Why are you not still sailing?
translation: 你为什么不继续航行？ [ni wei shen me bu ji xu hang xing ？]

english: Chronic sea sickness. My first, and only, voyage was spent dry heaving over the rails.
translation: 慢性晕船。我的第一次也是唯一一次航行是在铁轨上进行干抛航行。 [man xing yun chuan 。 wo de di yi ci ye shi wei yi yi ci hang xing shi zai tie gui shang jin xing gan pao hang xing 。]

english: If I had known about the sea sickness I could have saved myself a lot of money.
translation: 如果我知道晕船的事，我就能省下很多钱。 [ru guo wo zhi dao yun chuan de shi ， wo jiu neng sheng xia hen duo qian 。]

english: What are you up to now then?
translation: 那你现在在忙什么呢？ [na ni xian zai zai mang shen me ne ？]

english: Well my ship had a little fire related problem. Fortunately it was well insured.
translation: 好吧，我的船遇到了一些与火灾有关的问题。幸运的是，它有很好的保险。 [hao ba ， wo de chuan yu dao le yi xie yu huo zai you guan de wen ti 。 xing yun de shi ， ta you hen hao de bao xian 。]

english: Anyway, I don't have to work anymore so I've taken to canoeing on the river.
translation: 不管怎样，我不用再工作了，所以我开始在河上划独木舟。 [bu guan zen yang ， wo bu yong zai gong zuo le ， suo yi wo kai shi zai he shang hua du mu zhou 。]

english: I don't get river sick!
translation: 我不会得河病！ [wo bu hui de he bing ！]

english: Would you like to know how to make a canoe?
translation: 你想知道如何制作独木舟吗？ [ni xiang zhi dao ru he zhi zuo du mu zhou ma ？]

english: Could you teach me about canoes?
translation: 你能教我独木舟吗？ [ni neng jiao wo du mu zhou ma ？]

english: Well, you don't look like you have the skill to make a canoe.
translation: 嗯，你看起来不像有造独木舟的技能。 [n ， ni kan qi lai bu xiang you zao du mu zhou de ji neng 。]

english: You need to have at least level 12 woodcutting.
translation: 你需要至少有 12 级木刻。 [ni xu yao zhi shao you  12  ji mu ke 。]

english: Once you are able to make a canoe it makes travel along the river much quicker!
translation: 一旦您能够制作独木舟，沿河旅行就会更快！ [yi dan nin neng gou zhi zuo du mu zhou ， yan he lv xing jiu hui geng kuai ！]

english: It's really quite simple. Just walk down to that tree on the bank and chop it down.
translation: 这真的很简单。只要走到岸边那棵树那里，把它砍倒就可以了。 [zhe zhen de hen jian dan 。 zhi yao zou dao an bian na ke shu na li ， ba ta kan dao jiu ke yi le 。]

english: When you have done that you can shape the log further with your axe to make a canoe.
translation: 完成后，您可以用斧头进一步塑造原木以制作独木舟。 [wan cheng hou ， nin ke yi yong fu tou jin yi bu su zao yuan mu yi zhi zuo du mu zhou 。]

english: Hah! I can tell just by looking that you lack talent in woodcutting.
translation: 哈！我一看就知道你缺乏木刻天赋。 [ha ！ wo yi kan jiu zhi dao ni que fa mu ke tian fu 。]

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你是什​​么意思？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: No Callouses! No Splinters! No camp fires littering the trail behind you.
translation: 没有老茧！没有碎片！你身后的小路上没有篝火。 [mei you lao jian ！ mei you sui pian ！ ni shen hou de xiao lu shang mei you gou huo 。]

english: Anyway, the only 'canoe' you can make is a log. You'll be able to travel 1 stop along the river with a log canoe.
translation: 不管怎样，你唯一能做的“独木舟”就是一根圆木。您可以乘坐独木舟沿河行驶 1 站。 [bu guan zen yang ， ni wei yi neng zuo de “ du mu zhou ” jiu shi yi gen yuan mu 。 nin ke yi cheng zuo du mu zhou yan he xing shi  1  zhan 。]

english: With your skill in woodcutting you could make my favourite canoe, the Dugout. They might not be the best canoe on the river, but they get you where you're going.
translation: 凭借你的木刻技术，你可以制作我最喜欢的独木舟——独木舟。它们可能不是河上最好的独木舟，但它们可以带您到达目的地。 [ping jie ni de mu ke ji shu ， ni ke yi zhi zuo wo zui xi huan de du mu zhou —— du mu zhou 。 ta men ke neng bu shi he shang zui hao de du mu zhou ， dan ta men ke yi dai nin dao da mu di di 。]

english: How far will I be able to go in a Dugout canoe?
translation: 我可以乘坐独木舟走多远？ [wo ke yi cheng zuo du mu zhou zou duo yuan ？]

english: You will be able to travel 2 stops on the river.
translation: 您可以在河上行驶 2 站。 [nin ke yi zai he shang hang shi  2  zhan 。]

english: The best canoe you can make is a Stable Dugout, one step beyond a normal Dugout.
translation: 您能制作的最好的独木舟是稳定独木舟，比普通独木舟高出一步。 [nin neng zhi zuo de zui hao de du mu zhou shi wen ding du mu zhou ， bi pu tong du mu zhou gao chu yi bu 。]

english: With a Stable Dugout you can travel to any place on the river.
translation: 有了马厩防空洞，您就可以前往河上的任何地方。 [you le ma jiu fang kong dong ， nin jiu ke yi qian wang he shang de ren he di fang 。]

english: Even into the Wilderness?
translation: 甚至进入荒野？ [shen zhi jin ru huang ye ？]

english: Not likely! I've heard tell of a man up near Edgeville who claims he can use a Waka to get up into the Wilderness.
translation: 不太可能！我听说埃奇维尔附近有一个人声称他可以使用瓦卡进入荒野。 [bu tai ke neng ！ wo ting shuo ai qi wei er fu jin you yi ge ren sheng cheng ta ke yi shi yong wa ka jin ru huang ye 。]

english: I can't think why anyone would wish to venture into that hellish landscape though.
translation: 我不明白为什么有人愿意冒险进入那个地狱般的地方。 [wo bu ming bai wei shen me you ren yuan yi mao xian jin ru na ge di yu ban de di fang 。]

english: Hoo! You look like you know which end of an axe is which!
translation: 呼！你看起来好像知道斧子的哪一端是哪一端！ [hu ！ ni kan qi lai hao xiang zhi dao fu zi de na yi duan shi na yi duan ！]

english: You can easily build one of those Wakas. Be careful if you travel into the Wilderness though.
translation: 您可以轻松构建其中一个 Wakas。不过，如果您进入荒野，请务必小心。 [nin ke yi qing song gou jian qi zhong yi ge  Wakas。 bu guo ， ru guo nin jin ru huang ye ， qing wu bi xiao xin 。]

english: I've heard tell of great evil in that blasted wasteland.
translation: 我听说那片该死的荒原上有巨大的邪恶。 [wo ting shuo na pian gai si de huang yuan shang you ju da de xie e 。]

english: Thanks for the warning Bill.
translation: 感谢比尔的警告。 [gan xie bi er de jing gao 。]

english: No thanks, not right now.
translation: 不，谢谢，现在不行。 [bu ， xie xie ， xian zai bu xing 。]

english: Can you teach me about canoes?
translation: 你能教我独木舟吗？ [ni neng jiao wo du mu zhou ma ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Can you teach me about Canoeing?
translation: 你能教我独木舟吗？ [ni neng jiao wo du mu zhou ma ？]

english: What's going on here?
translation: 这是怎么回事？ [zhe shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: We're making the final preparations for our voyage to the distant lands to the North.
translation: 我们正在为前往北方遥远之地的航行做最后的准备。 [wo men zheng zai wei qian wang bei fang yao yuan zhi di de hang xing zuo zui hou de zhun bei 。]

english: Is there anything I can do to help?
translation: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang mang de ma ？]

english: We could do with an extra pair of hands, but you're better off speaking to Curator Haig Halen at the Varrock museum if you'd like to get involved.
translation: 我们需要额外的帮助，但如果您想参与其中，最好与 Varrock 博物馆的馆长 Haig Halen 交谈。 [wo men xu yao e wai de bang zhu ， dan ru guo nin xiang can yu qi zhong ， zui hao yu  Varrock  bo wu guan de guan zhang  Haig Halen  jiao tan 。]

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Good luck, bye.
translation: 祝你好运，再见。 [zhu ni hao yun ， zai jian 。]

english: Thanks for all your help, [player name].
translation: 感谢您的帮助，[玩家姓名]。 [gan xie nin de bang zhu ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Is there anything I can do to help?
translation: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang mang de ma ？]

english: Good luck, bye.
translation: 祝你好运，再见。 [zhu ni hao yun ， zai jian 。]

english: This work isn't going to do itself.

english: Hello there; I see you're qualified. Come to help us out?
translation: 你好呀;我看你有资格。来帮助我们吗？ [ni hao ya ; wo kan ni you zi ge 。 lai bang zhu wo men ma ？]

english: Hello! You're that student who recently finished all three Earth Sciences exams, aren't you? Come to help us out?
translation: 你好！您就是那个最近完成了全部三门地球科学考试的学生，不是吗？来帮助我们吗？ [ni hao ！ nin jiu shi na ge zui jin wan cheng le quan bu san men di qiu ke xue kao shi de xue sheng ， bu shi ma ？ lai bang zhu wo men ma ？]

english: Greetings, my dear [sir/madam]. Have you come to give us a hand?
translation: 问候，我亲爱的[先生/女士]。你是来帮我们的吗？ [wen hou ， wo qin ai de [ xian sheng / nv shi ]。 ni shi lai bang wo men de ma ？]

english: Yes, how can I help out?
translation: 是的，我能提供什么帮助吗？ [shi de ， wo neng ti gong shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: Well, you'll need to get your equipment first - it's all there on the tool rack. Use what you learned from your Earth Sciences exams. You'll need to be wearing your leather gloves and boots as well as have access to
translation: 好吧，你需要先拿到你的设备 - 它都在工具架上。利用您从地球科学考试中学到的知识。您需要戴上皮手套和靴子，并能够接触到 [hao ba ， ni xu yao xian na dao ni de she bei  -  ta dou zai gong ju jia shang 。 li yong nin cong di qiu ke xue kao shi zhong xue dao de zhi shi 。 nin xu yao dai shang pi shou tao he xue zi ， bing neng gou jie chu dao]

english: your trowel, rock pick and specimen brush.
translation: 你的抹子、岩石镐和标本刷。 [ni de mo zi 、 yan shi gao he biao ben shua 。]

english: I see you have your equipment - well done.
translation: 我看到你有你的设备 - 干得好。 [wo kan dao ni you ni de she bei  -  gan de hao 。]

english: To really give us a hand, you could clean some finds for us. They're mostly done - just some fine work to finish off. Take a find from the pile that the workmen are bringing in, then there are spare tables over there
translation: 为了真正帮助我们，您可以帮我们清理一些发现的东西。他们大部分已经完成了——只是一些漂亮的工作需要完成。从工人搬进来的一堆东西里找出来，然后那边就有空余的桌子了 [wei le zhen zheng bang zhu wo men ， nin ke yi bang wo men qing li yi xie fa xian de dong xi 。 ta men da bu fen yi jing wan cheng le —— zhi shi yi xie piao liang de gong zuo xu yao wan cheng 。 cong gong ren ban jin lai de yi dui dong xi li zhao chu lai ， ran hou na bian jiu you kong yu de zhuo zi le]

english: to clean them on. If you find anything interesting, let us know and we'll see if it's good enough to go on display.
translation: 清洁它们。如果您发现任何有趣的东西，请告诉我们，我们会看看它是否足以展示。 [qing jie ta men 。 ru guo nin fa xian ren he you qu de dong xi ， qing gao su wo men ， wo men hui kan kan ta shi fou zu yi zhan shi 。]

english: I found something interesting.
translation: 我发现了一些有趣的事情。 [wo fa xian le yi xie you qu de shi qing 。]

english: Oh? Let's take a look...
translation: 哦？我们来看看... [o ？ wo men lai kan kan ...]

english: I found this pretty necklace.
translation: 我发现了这条漂亮的项链。 [wo fa xian le zhe tiao piao liang de xiang lian 。]

english: Interesting...yes...yes...hmmm.... It looks like it's enchanted.
translation: 有趣……是……是……嗯……看起来像是着了魔一样。 [you qu …… shi …… shi …… n …… kan qi lai xiang shi zhe le mo yi yang 。]

english: With what?
translation: 用什么？ [yong shen me ？]

english: Oh, I think it's just a benign teleportation spell. I tinker in magic when I'm not doing archaeology. I can teach you how to make more necklaces like this. Amazing that they had this kind of knowledge back then.
translation: 哦，我认为这只是一个良性的传送咒语。当我不做考古学的时候，我会研究魔法。我可以教你如何制作更多这样的项链。令人惊讶的是他们当时拥有这种知识。 [o ， wo ren wei zhe zhi shi yi ge liang xing de chuan song zhou yu 。 dang wo bu zuo kao gu xue de shi hou ， wo hui yan jiu mo fa 。 wo ke yi jiao ni ru he zhi zuo geng duo zhe yang de xiang lian 。 ling ren jing ya de shi ta men dang shi yong you zhe zhong zhi shi 。]

english: That would be good. Where is the teleport to?
translation: 那就好了。传送到哪里？ [na jiu hao le 。 chuan song dao na li ？]

english: Hmm...all the indications are that it's somewhere to the east of us, but I'm not sure how far. Perhaps it was a teleport back to Saranthium. Let me just take a closer look.
translation: 嗯……所有迹象都表明它位于我们东边的某个地方，但我不确定有多远。也许这是传送回萨兰瑟姆的过程。让我仔细看看。 [n …… suo you ji xiang dou biao ming ta wei yu wo men dong bian de mou ge di fang ， dan wo bu que ding you duo yuan 。 ye xu zhe shi chuan song hui sa lan se mu de guo cheng 。 rang wo zi xi kan kan 。]

english: So I just make a ruby necklace and use five fire runes and one cosmic rune to enchant it.
translation: 所以我只是做了一条红宝石项链，并用五个火符文和一个宇宙符文来附魔它。 [suo yi wo zhi shi zuo le yi tiao hong bao shi xiang lian ， bing yong wu ge huo fu wen he yi ge yu zhou fu wen lai fu mo ta 。]

english: Yes, indeed. Well done, youngster, thanks for helping us.
translation: 是的，确实如此。干得好，年轻人，谢谢你帮助我们。 [shi de ， que shi ru ci 。 gan de hao ， nian qing ren ， xie xie ni bang zhu wo men 。]

english: I've cleaned this old coin - is it of any use?
translation: 我已经清理了这枚旧硬币 - 它有什么用吗？ [wo yi jing qing li le zhe mei jiu ying bi  -  ta you shen me yong ma ？]

english: Oh my! What a wonderful find! If this is what I believe it to be, it would allow us to date the Dig Site city.
translation: 天啊！多么美妙的发现啊！如果这是我所相信的，那么我们就能确定挖掘场城市的年代。 [tian a ！ duo me mei miao de fa xian a ！ ru guo zhe shi wo suo xiang xin de ， na me wo men jiu neng que ding wa jue chang cheng shi de nian dai 。]

english: And look here, it has the name of the city too! Saranthium! That must be during the Saradominist occupation. This is a wonderful find. Please take it and place it in display case 45.
translation: 看这里，它还有城市的名字！萨拉蒂！那一定是在萨拉多米主义占领期间。这是一个很棒的发现。请拿走并将其放入展示柜 45 中。 [kan zhe li ， ta hai you cheng shi de ming zi ！ sa la di ！ na yi ding shi zai sa la duo mi zhu yi zhan ling qi jian 。 zhe shi yi ge hen bang de fa xian 。 qing na zou bing jiang qi fang ru zhan shi gui  45  zhong 。]

english: Right, display case 45 it is...
translation: 对了，陈列柜45是…… [dui le ， chen lie gui 45 shi ……]

english: Back again? Have you put the old coin in display case 45 yet?
translation: 又回来了？你把旧硬币放进陈列柜45了吗？ [you hui lai le ？ ni ba jiu ying bi fang jin chen lie gui 45 le ma ？]

english: No, I'll go do that now
translation: 不，我现在就去做 [bu ， wo xian zai jiu qu zuo]

english: You've already shown me one of those, but it was in better condition. It's in the display case over there. You can pop this one in the finds crate over in the corner.
translation: 你已经给我看了其中一件，但它的状况更好。就在那边的展示柜里。您可以将其放入角落里的发现物箱中。 [ni yi jing gei wo kan le qi zhong yi jian ， dan ta de zhuang kuang geng hao 。 jiu zai na bian de zhan shi gui li 。 nin ke yi jiang qi fang ru jiao luo li de fa xian wu xiang zhong 。]

english: I found this really old coin - is it of any use?
translation: 我发现了这枚非常古老的硬币 - 它有什么用处吗？ [wo fa xian le zhe mei fei chang gu lao de ying bi  -  ta you shen me yong chu ma ？]

english: What have we here?
translation: 我们这里有什么？ [wo men zhe li you shen me ？]

english: Oh! This is very interesting...and confusing at the same time. This coin means that the city that we're excavating on the Digsite - Saranthium - was actually inhabited much, much earlier by followers of Zamorak,
translation: 哦！这非常有趣……同时也令人困惑。这枚硬币意味着我们在挖掘场挖掘的城市——Saranthium——实际上早在很久以前就被萨莫拉克的追随者居住过， [o ！ zhe fei chang you qu …… tong shi ye ling ren kun huo 。 zhe mei ying bi yi wei zhe wo men zai wa jue chang wa jue de cheng shi ——Saranthium—— shi ji shang zao zai hen jiu yi qian jiu bei sa mo la ke de zhui sui zhe ju zhu guo ，]

english: at which time, the city was known as Senntisten.
translation: 当时，这座城市被称为 Senntisten。 [dang shi ， zhe zuo cheng shi bei cheng wei  Senntisten。]

english: This is a most remarkable discovery, as we have other evidence indicating that Zarosian followers were resident before the Saradominists took over, but it also seems that Zamorakian forces used it during a battle of some
translation: 这是一个最引人注目的发现，因为我们有其他证据表明，在萨拉多米主义者接管之前，扎罗西亚追随者就已经居住在当地，但似乎萨莫拉克军队在一些人的战斗中也使用了它。 [zhe shi yi ge zui yin ren zhu mu di fa xian ， yin wei wo men you qi ta zheng ju biao ming ， zai sa la duo mi zhu yi zhe jie guan zhi qian ， zha luo xi ya zhui sui zhe jiu yi jing ju zhu zai dang di ， dan si hu sa mo la ke jun dui zai yi xie ren de zhan dou zhong ye shi yong le ta 。]

english: sort. Still, it allows us to roughly date when the city changed from following Zaros and Zamorak to following Saradomin. Put it in display case 44.
translation: 种类。尽管如此，它仍然可以让我们大致确定这座城市从跟随扎罗斯和萨莫拉克转变为跟随萨拉多明的时间。将其放入展示柜 44 中。 [zhong lei 。 jin guan ru ci ， ta reng ran ke yi rang wo men da zhi que ding zhe zuo cheng shi cong gen sui zha luo si he sa mo la ke zhuan bian wei gen sui sa la duo ming de shi jian 。 jiang qi fang ru zhan shi gui  44  zhong 。]

translation: 第44例就是这样！ [di 44 li jiu shi zhe yang ！]

english: No, I'll go do that now.
translation: 不，我现在就去做。 [bu ， wo xian zai jiu qu zuo 。]

english: I found this crumbly old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: 我发现了这个易碎的旧装饰品 - 它有什么用吗？ [wo fa xian le zhe ge yi sui de jiu zhuang shi pin  -  ta you shen me yong ma ？]

english: Ahh... That looks like an altar piece. Hmm, yes...from the early Saradominist worshippers by the looks of it. Quite delicate, too. Put it in display case 37.
translation: 啊……看起来像是祭坛碎片。嗯，是的……从表面上看是来自早期的萨拉多米主义崇拜者。也相当精致。将其放入展示柜 37 中。 [a …… kan qi lai xiang shi ji tan sui pian 。 n ， shi de …… cong biao mian shang kan shi lai zi zao qi de sa la duo mi zhu yi chong bai zhe 。 ye xiang dang jing zhi 。 jiang qi fang ru zhan shi gui  37  zhong 。]

english: Case 37 it is!
translation: 是第37号病例！ [shi di 37 hao bing li ！]

english: Back again? Have you put the ancient symbol in display case 37 yet?
translation: 又回来了？你把远古符号放进37号陈列柜了吗？ [you hui lai le ？ ni ba yuan gu fu hao fang jin 37 hao chen lie gui le ma ？]

english: I found this really old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: 我发现了这个非常旧的装饰品 - 它有什么用吗？ [wo fa xian le zhe ge fei chang jiu de zhuang shi pin  -  ta you shen me yong ma ？]

english: Wow!
translation: 哇！ [wa ！]

english: That's in rather good condition, isn't it? An old altar decoration by the looks of things, from the Saradominist city no doubt. Put it in display case 36.
translation: 这状态相当不错，不是吗？从外观上看，这是一座古老的祭坛装饰，毫无疑问来自萨拉多米尼主义城市。将其放入展示柜 36 中。 [zhe zhuang tai xiang dang bu cuo ， bu shi ma ？ cong wai guan shang kan ， zhe shi yi zuo gu lao de ji tan zhuang shi ， hao wu yi wen lai zi sa la duo mi ni zhu yi cheng shi 。 jiang qi fang ru zhan shi gui  36  zhong 。]

english: Case 36 it is!
translation: 是第36例！ [shi di 36 li ！]

english: Back again? Have you put the old symbol in display case 36 yet?
translation: 又回来了？您是否已将旧符号放入展示柜 36 中？ [you hui lai le ？ nin shi fou yi jiang jiu fu hao fang ru zhan shi gui  36  zhong ？]

english: I found this piece of pottery - is it of any use?
translation: 我找到了这块陶器——它有什么用吗？ [wo zhao dao le zhe kuai tao qi —— ta you shen me yong ma ？]

english: Ahh... Oh! Hmm...yes...made by Zaros worshippers, by the looks of it. Beautifully-shaped. It looks as if this would go nicely in display case 22. This piece reinforces our evidence that the city was occupied by
translation: 啊……哦！嗯……是的……看起来是扎罗斯崇拜者制作的。造型优美。看起来这在展示柜 22 中会很顺利。这件作品强化了我们的证据，即这座城市被 [a …… o ！ n …… shi de …… kan qi lai shi zha luo si chong bai zhe zhi zuo de 。 zao xing you mei 。 kan qi lai zhe zai zhan shi gui  22  zhong hui hen shun li 。 zhe jian zuo pin qiang hua le wo men de zheng ju ， ji zhe zuo cheng shi bei]

english: Zarosians before Saradominists.
translation: 扎罗索派先于萨拉多米派。 [zha luo suo pai xian yu sa la duo mi pai 。]

english: Case 22 it is!
translation: 就是案例22！ [jiu shi an li 22！]

english: Back again? Have you put the pottery in display case 22 yet?
translation: 又回来了？你把陶器放进22号展示柜了吗？ [you hui lai le ？ ni ba tao qi fang jin 22 hao zhan shi gui le ma ？]

english: I found these old arrowheads.
translation: 我发现了这些旧箭头。 [wo fa xian le zhe xie jiu jian tou 。]

english: Ahh, yes, we find lots of those - they're not important. We already have some in our display. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: 啊，是的，我们发现了很多这样的东西——它们并不重要。我们的展示中已经有一些了。只需将其添加到靠近门的箱子中即可。 [a ， shi de ， wo men fa xian le hen duo zhe yang de dong xi —— ta men bing bu zhong yao 。 wo men de zhan shi zhong yi jing you yi xie le 。 zhi xu jiang qi tian jia dao kao jin men de xiang zi zhong ji ke 。]

english: If there is anything already in the crate, feel free to take it as a reward for your work.
translation: 如果板条箱里已有任何东西，请随意将其作为对您工作的奖励。 [ru guo ban tiao xiang li yi you ren he dong xi ， qing sui yi jiang qi zuo wei dui nin gong zuo de jiang li 。]

english: Oh, okay.
translation: 哦好的。 [o hao de 。]

english: Take a look at this...
translation: 看看这个... [kan kan zhe ge ...]

english: I found these old necklaces.
translation: 我找到了这些旧项链。 [wo zhao dao le zhe xie jiu xiang lian 。]

english: An interesting find... Here, let me offer you something in return.
translation: 一个有趣的发现……在这里，让我给你一些回报。 [yi ge you qu de fa xian …… zai zhe li ， rang wo gei ni yi xie hui bao 。]

english: Oh! Okay.
translation: 哦！好的。 [o ！ hao de 。]

english: I cleaned up this old vase.
translation: 我清理了这个旧花瓶。 [wo qing li le zhe ge jiu hua ping 。]

english: Ah, the vases... I've lost count of how many we've found of those... The only completely intact one is in the display case already. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: 啊，那些花瓶……我已经记不清我们找到了多少个了……唯一完好无损的已经在陈列柜里了。只需将其添加到靠近门的箱子中即可。 [a ， na xie hua ping …… wo yi jing ji bu qing wo men zhao dao le duo shao ge le …… wei yi wan hao wu sun de yi jing zai chen lie gui li le 。 zhi xu jiang qi tian jia dao kao jin men de xiang zi zhong ji ke 。]

english: Right.
translation: 正确的。 [zheng que de 。]

english: Err... I seem to have lost it. Sorry.

english: Well there is the Varrock sewers. There are tales of untold horrors coming out at night and stealing babies from houses.
translation: 嗯，那就是 Varrock 下水道。有一些难以言喻的恐怖故事在​​夜间出现并从房屋中偷走婴儿。 [n ， na jiu shi  Varrock  xia shui dao 。 you yi xie nan yi yan yu de kong bu gu shi zai ​​ ye jian chu xian bing cong fang wu zhong tou zou ying er 。]

translation: 听起来很完美！入口在哪里？ [ting qi lai hen wan mei ！ ru kou zai na li ？]

translation: 就在皇宫的东边。 [jiu zai huang gong de dong bian 。]

english: I'm not that well up on the gossip out here. I've heard that the bartender in the Blue Moon Inn has gone a little crazy, he keeps claiming he is part of something called an online game.
translation: 我不太了解这里的八卦。我听说蓝月旅馆的酒保有点疯了，他一直声称自己是一个叫做网络游戏的东西的一部分。 [wo bu tai liao jie zhe li de ba gua 。 wo ting shuo lan yue lv guan de jiu bao you dian feng le ， ta yi zhi sheng cheng zi ji shi yi ge jiao zuo wang luo you xi de dong xi de yi bu fen 。]

english: What that means, I don't know. That's probably old news by now though.

english: I'll have a beer please.
translation: 请给我一杯啤酒。 [qing gei wo yi bei pi jiu 。]

translation: 有什么提示可以让我去冒险吗？ [you shen me ti shi ke yi rang wo qu mao xian ma ？]

translation: 听说过什么好八卦吗？ [ting shuo guo shen me hao ba gua ma ？]

english: Could I buy a beer please?
translation: 请问我可以买瓶啤酒吗？ [qing wen wo ke yi mai ping pi jiu ma ？]

english: Sure, that will be 2 gold coins please.
translation: 当然，那是2金币。 [dang ran ， na shi 2 jin bi 。]

english: I don't have enough coins.
translation: 我没有足够的硬币。 [wo mei you zu gou de ying bi 。]

english: Ok, here you go.
translation: 好的，给你。 [hao de ， gei ni 。]

english: You buy a pint of beer!
translation: 你买一品脱啤酒！ [ni mai yi pin tuo pi jiu ！]

english: Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: 你在这里听到过什么谣言吗？ [ni zai zhe li ting dao guo shen me yao yan ma ？]

english: Well, there was a guy in here earlier saying the goblins up by the mountain are arguing again, about the colour of their armour of all things.
translation: 嗯，早些时候这里有个家伙说山上的妖精们又在争论他们铠甲的颜色了。 [n ， zao xie shi hou zhe li you ge jia huo shuo shan shang de yao jing men you zai zheng lun ta men kai jia de yan se le 。]

english: Knowing the goblins it could easily turn into a full blown war, which wouldn't be good. Goblin wars make such a mess of the countryside.
translation: 了解哥布林很容易就会演变成一场全面的战争，这可不太好。哥布林战争让乡村变得一片混乱。 [liao jie ge bu lin hen rong yi jiu hui yan bian cheng yi chang quan mian de zhan zheng ， zhe ke bu tai hao 。 ge bu lin zhan zheng rang xiang cun bian de yi pian hun luan 。]

english: Well if I have the time I'll go and see if I can knock some sense into them.
translation: 好吧，如果我有时间，我会去看看是否可以给他们一些启发。 [hao ba ， ru guo wo you shi jian ， wo hui qu kan kan shi fou ke yi gei ta men yi xie qi fa 。]

english: No, it hasn't been very busy lately.
translation: 不，最近不太忙。 [bu ， zui jin bu tai mang 。]

english: I’m doing Alfred Grimhand’s Barcrawl.
translation: 我正在做阿尔弗雷德·格林汉德的Barcrawl。 [wo zheng zai zuo a er fu lei de · ge lin han de de Barcrawl。]

english: Are you sure? You look a bit skinny for that.
translation: 你确定吗？你看起来有点瘦。 [ni que ding ma ？ ni kan qi lai you dian shou 。]

english: Just give me whatever I need to drink here.
translation: 只要给我这里需要喝的东西就可以了。 [zhi yao gei wo zhe li xu yao he de dong xi jiu ke yi le 。]

english: Ok one Black Skull Ale coming up, 8 coins please.
translation: 好的，一杯黑骷髅啤酒即将到来，请 8 枚硬币。 [hao de ， yi bei hei ku lou pi jiu ji jiang dao lai ， qing  8  mei ying bi 。]

english: Hiccup!
translation: 打嗝！ [da ge ！]

english: Congratulations! Here you go.
translation: 恭喜！干得好。 [gong xi ！ gan de hao 。]

english: Could I buy a beer please?
translation: 请问我可以买瓶啤酒吗？ [qing wen wo ke yi mai ping pi jiu ma ？]

english: Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: 你在这里听到过什么谣言吗？ [ni zai zhe li ting dao guo shen me yao yan ma ？]

english: I'm doing Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl
translation: 我正在做阿尔弗雷德·格林汉德的藤条爬行 [wo zheng zai zuo a er fu lei de · ge lin han de de teng tiao pa xing]

english: Don't get many humans in Stick Your Ore Inn. Are you here to drink?
translation: Stick Your Ore Inn 里的人类不多。你来这里喝酒吗？ [Stick Your Ore Inn  li de ren lei bu duo 。 ni lai zhe li he jiu ma ？]

english: Let's see what you have.
translation: 让我们看看你有什么。 [rang wo men kan kan ni you shen me 。]

english: I'll be on my way then.
translation: 那我就上路了 [na wo jiu shang lu le]

english: Well then I'm not really sure what we have for you. Perhaps you should be on your way.
translation: 那么我不太确定我们能为您提供什么。也许你应该上路了。 [na me wo bu tai que ding wo men neng wei nin ti gong shen me 。 ye xu ni ying gai shang lu le 。]

english: What are you selling?
translation: 你卖什么？ [ni mai shen me ？]

english: I'll be on my way then.
translation: 那我就上路了 [na wo jiu shang lu le]

english: Welcome to Sunlight's Sanctum. What will it be?
translation: 欢迎来到阳光圣殿。会是什么？ [huan ying lai dao yang guang sheng dian 。 hui shi shen me ？]

english: Nice place you have here.
translation: 你这里的地方真好。 [ni zhe li de di fang zhen hao 。]

english: Thank you. I like to think we have one of the nicest pubs in all of Varlamore, not that I can take much credit myself.
translation: 谢谢。我喜欢认为我们拥有整个瓦拉莫尔最好的酒吧之一，但这并不是我自己可以承担的。 [xie xie 。 wo xi huan ren wei wo men yong you zheng ge wa la mo er zui hao de jiu ba zhi yi ， dan zhe bing bu shi wo zi ji ke yi cheng dan de 。]

english: How come?
translation: 怎么会？ [zen me hui ？]

english: Well it's the Moonrise Brewery and Winery who own this place. It's only as nice as it is because of their continued investments.
translation: 嗯，这个地方的所有者是月出酿酒厂。它之所以如此美好，是因为他们持续不断的投资。 [n ， zhe ge di fang de suo you zhe shi yue chu niang jiu chang 。 ta zhi suo yi ru ci mei hao ， shi yin wei ta men chi xu bu duan de tou zi 。]

english: So I'm guessing they care a lot about this place?
translation: 所以我猜他们很关心这个地方？ [suo yi wo cai ta men hen guan xin zhe ge di fang ？]

english: Well I suppose it just makes sense for them. Keeping this pub in good condition keeps the locals happy, which is probably wise for a company that employs half of them.
translation: 嗯，我想这对他们来说是有意义的。保持这家酒吧的良好状态可以让当地人感到高兴，这对于一家雇佣了一半员工的公司来说可能是明智之举。 [n ， wo xiang zhe dui ta men lai shuo shi you yi yi de 。 bao chi zhe jia jiu ba de liang hao zhuang tai ke yi rang dang di ren gan dao gao xing ， zhe dui yu yi jia gu yong le yi ban yuan gong de gong si lai shuo ke neng shi ming zhi zhi ju 。]

english: We also make plenty of money from all the tourists. Even before Varlamore opened up, Aldarin was a top holiday destination. That's easy money for the owners to help fund all their other ventures.
translation: 我们还从所有游客那里赚了很多钱。甚至在瓦拉莫尔开放之前，阿尔达林就是顶级的度假胜地。对于业主来说，这是很容易赚到的钱，可以帮助他们为所有其他企业提供资金。 [wo men hai cong suo you you ke na li zhuan le hen duo qian 。 shen zhi zai wa la mo er kai fang zhi qian ， a er da lin jiu shi ding ji de du jia sheng di 。 dui yu ye zhu lai shuo ， zhe shi hen rong yi zhuan dao de qian ， ke yi bang zhu ta men wei suo you qi ta qi ye ti gong zi jin 。]

english: I suppose so.
translation: 我想是的。 [wo xiang shi de 。]

english: And on that note, I'm guessing you came in for a drink? What will it be?
translation: 说到这里，我猜你是来喝酒的？会是什么？ [shuo dao zhe li ， wo cai ni shi lai he jiu de ？ hui shi shen me ？]

english: Nothing, thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。]

english: Let's see what you have.
translation: 让我们看看你有什么。 [rang wo men kan kan ni you shen me 。]

english: Nice place you have here.
translation: 你这里的地方真好。 [ni zhe li de di fang zhen hao 。]

english: Nothing, thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。]

english: Get out of here. I have nothing to say to the likes of you.
translation: 离开这里。对于像你们这样的人，我无话可说。 [li kai zhe li 。 dui yu xiang ni men zhe yang de ren ， wo wu hua ke shuo 。]

english: Get out of here, we don't like your sort in these parts.
translation: 离开这里，我们不喜欢你这种人。 [li kai zhe li ， wo men bu xi huan ni zhe zhong ren 。]

english: If you're not buying anything, I have nothing to say to you.
translation: 如果你不买任何东西，我就无话可说。 [ru guo ni bu mai ren he dong xi ， wo jiu wu hua ke shuo 。]

english: As I understand it there's some kind of hidden treasure in these parts...
translation: 据我了解，这些地方隐藏着某种宝藏...... [ju wo liao jie ， zhe xie di fang yin cang zhe mou zhong bao zang ......]

english: Look around pal. Does it looks like there's any treasure near here?
translation: 看看周围吧朋友。看来这附近有什么宝藏吗？ [kan kan zhou wei ba peng you 。 kan lai zhe fu jin you shen me bao zang ma ？]

english: If I were you I'd get lost before someone takes a dislike to your face and removes it for you.
translation: 如果我是你，在有人讨厌你的脸并为你把它去掉之前我就会迷路。 [ru guo wo shi ni ， zai you ren tao yan ni de lian bing wei ni ba ta qu diao zhi qian wo jiu hui mi lu 。]

english: What's that? You wanna buy a beer? It'll cost ya 650 coins.
translation: 那是什么？你想买啤酒吗？这将花费你 650 个硬币。 [na shi shen me ？ ni xiang mai pi jiu ma ？ zhe jiang hua fei ni  650  ge ying bi 。]

english: There you go. Now get out, we don't like your sort around here.
translation: 就这样吧。现在出去吧，我们不喜欢你们这种人。 [jiu zhe yang ba 。 xian zai chu qu ba ， wo men bu xi huan ni men zhe zhong ren 。]

english: (the player receives Bandit's Brew.)
translation: （玩家收到强盗啤酒。） [（ wan jia shou dao qiang dao pi jiu 。）]

english: Get out of my bar then! We don't like your sort round here!
translation: 那就滚出我的酒吧吧！我们不喜欢你在这里！ [na jiu gun chu wo de jiu ba ba ！ wo men bu xi huan ni zai zhe li ！]

english: Buy a beer
translation: 买瓶啤酒 [mai ping pi jiu]

english: Don't buy anything
translation: 不要买任何东西 [bu yao mai ren he dong xi]

english: You've had your drink, now get out of here. I have nothing to say to the-
translation: 你喝完了酒，现在就离开这里吧。我无话可说- [ni he wan le jiu ， xian zai jiu li kai zhe li ba 。 wo wu hua ke shuo -]

english: No, Wait! Look, I'm here on an archaeological expedition for the Museum of Varrock.
translation: 不，等等！听着，我来这里是为了瓦罗克博物馆的考古探险。 [bu ， deng deng ！ ting zhe ， wo lai zhe li shi wei le wa luo ke bo wu guan de kao gu tan xian 。]

english: I am only here looking for artefacts...
translation: 我只是来找文物的... [wo zhi shi lai zhao wen wu de ...]

english: Oh really? Our inheritance is only sand and death. What do you expect to find out here in this desert forsaken by the gods?
translation: 哦真的吗？我们的遗产只有沙子和死亡。在这片被众神遗弃的沙漠里，你期望找到什么？ [o zhen de ma ？ wo men de yi chan zhi you sha zi he si wang 。 zai zhe pian bei zhong shen yi qi de sha mo li ， ni qi wang zhao dao shen me ？]

english: I heard a rumour about four diamonds or crystals...
translation: 我听到一个关于四颗钻石或水晶的传言...... [wo ting dao yi ge guan yu si ke zuan shi huo shui jing de chuan yan ......]

english: The four diamonds of Azzanadra??? How came you to know of this?
translation: 阿扎纳德拉的四颗钻石？？？你怎么知道这件事的？ [a zha na de la de si ke zuan shi ？？？ ni zen me zhi dao zhe jian shi de ？]

english: You've heard of them then?
translation: 那你听说过他们吗？ [na ni ting shuo guo ta men ma ？]

english: It's just a fairy tale for children. Maybe one of the village elders might know more, but it's not really something I care about.
translation: 这只是一个给孩子们看的童话故事。也许村里的一位长老可能知道更多，但这并不是我真正关心的事情。 [zhe zhi shi yi ge gei hai zi men kan de tong hua gu shi 。 ye xu cun li de yi wei zhang lao ke neng zhi dao geng duo ， dan zhe bing bu shi wo zhen zheng guan xin de shi qing 。]

english: Now get out of here, your sort isn't welcome in my bar.
translation: 现在离开这里，我的酒吧不欢迎你这样的人。 [xian zai li kai zhe li ， wo de jiu ba bu huan ying ni zhe yang de ren 。]

english: Certain things have led me to believe there may be some kind of ruined fortress around here...
translation: 某些事情让我相信这里可能有某种被毁的堡垒...... [mou xie shi qing rang wo xiang xin zhe li ke neng you mou zhong bei hui de bao lei ......]

english: Doubt it. What in the world would someone need to guard against in the middle of this desert?
translation: 对此表示怀疑。在这片沙漠之中，人们到底需要提防什么？ [dui ci biao shi huai yi 。 zai zhe pian sha mo zhi zhong ， ren men dao di xu yao di fang shen me ？]

english: A bad attack of sand? I think you're on the wrong track here, stranger.
translation: 沙子的严重攻击？我认为你走错了路，陌生人。 [sha zi de yan zhong gong ji ？ wo ren wei ni zou cuo le lu ， mo sheng ren 。]

english: (above)
translation: （多于） [（ duo yu ）]

english: Tell me all you know about the Diamonds of Azzanadra.
translation: 告诉我关于阿扎纳德拉钻石的所有信息。 [gao su wo guan yu a zha na de la zuan shi de suo you xin xi 。]

english: Not that I think it's any of your business, but when I was a child I remember hearing the legend.
translation: 我不认为这与你有什么关系，但当我还是个孩子的时候，我记得听过这个传说。 [wo bu ren wei zhe yu ni you shen me guan xi ， dan dang wo hai shi ge hai zi de shi hou ， wo ji de ting guo zhe ge chuan shuo 。]

english: I don't recall it particularly well, other than they are said to contain an incredible power.
translation: 我不太记得了，只记得它们蕴含着不可思议的力量。 [wo bu tai ji de le ， zhi ji de ta men yun han zhe bu ke si yi de li liang 。]

english: If you really want to hear more about it you'd be best off finding someone who cares about the past, and the history of this area, and stop bothering me.
translation: 如果你真的想了解更多，最好找一个关心过去和这个地区历史的人，别再打扰我了。 [ru guo ni zhen de xiang liao jie geng duo ， zui hao zhao yi ge guan xin guo qu he zhe ge di qu li shi de ren ， bie zai da rao wo le 。]

english: So you're the [fella/lass] that freed Azzanadra, huh? Fair play to ya. What will you have?
translation: 所以你就是释放阿扎纳德拉的[小伙子/小姑娘]，对吧？对你来说公平竞争。你会得到什么？ [suo yi ni jiu shi shi fang a zha na de la de [ xiao huo zi / xiao gu niang ]， dui ba ？ dui ni lai shuo gong ping jing zheng 。 ni hui de dao shen me ？]

english: Didn't feel like a drink after all, huh? Well, stop by anytime, hero.
translation: 根本就没有喝酒的感觉吧？好吧，随时过来，英雄。 [gen ben jiu mei you he jiu de gan jue ba ？ hao ba ， sui shi guo lai ， ying xiong 。]

translation: 询问关于 沙漠宝藏 I 的问题 [xun wen guan yu   sha mo bao zang  I  de wen ti]

english: Buy a drink
translation: 买一杯饮料 [mai yi bei yin liao]

english: I heard about treasure...
translation: 听说有宝藏... [ting shuo you bao zang ...]

translation: 听说有四颗钻石... [ting shuo you si ke zuan shi ...]

english: A human in The Lost Pickaxe? My old pa would be fuming. Still, business is business I guess. What can I get you?
translation: 《失落的镐》中的人类？我老爸一定会生气的。不过，我想生意就是生意。我能给你什么？ [《 shi luo de gao 》 zhong de ren lei ？ wo lao ba yi ding hui sheng qi de 。 bu guo ， wo xiang sheng yi jiu shi sheng yi 。 wo neng gei ni shen me ？]

english: Nothing thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。]

translation: 请给我一杯啤酒。？ [qing gei wo yi bei pi jiu 。？]

translation: 请给我两枚硬币。 [qing gei wo liang mei ying bi 。]

english: One of the patrons here is looking for treasure apparently. A chap by the name of Veos.
translation: 这里的一位顾客显然正在寻找宝藏。一个名叫维奥斯的小伙子。 [zhe li de yi wei gu ke xian ran zheng zai xun zhao bao zang 。 yi ge ming jiao wei ao si de xiao huo zi 。]

english: Heard any rumours recently?
translation: 最近有听到什么传闻吗？ [zui jin you ting dao shen me chuan wen ma ？]

english: Nothing, I'm fine.
translation: 没什么，我很好。 [mei shen me ， wo hen hao 。]

translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: You don't have enough room for it.
translation: 你没有足够的空间来容纳它。 [ni mei you zu gou de kong jian lai rong na ta 。]

english: Welcome to the Windbreaker. We've got the best drinks around.
translation: 欢迎来到风衣。我们有最好的饮料。 [huan ying lai dao feng yi 。 wo men you zui hao de yin liao 。]

english: What's with those big gates out there?
translation: 外面那些大门是怎么回事？ [wai mian na xie da men shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: I couldn't tell you to be honest. They've been here for a very long time. Apparently they came in quite useful during the war, and these days they do help stop any undesirable beasts wandering into town.
translation: 我不能告诉你说实话。他们已经在这里呆了很长时间了。显然，它们在战争期间非常有用，而如今它们确实有助于阻止任何不受欢迎的野兽进入城镇。 [wo bu neng gao su ni shuo shi hua 。 ta men yi jing zai zhe li dai le hen zhang shi jian le 。 xian ran ， ta men zai zhan zheng qi jian fei chang you yong ， er ru jin ta men que shi you zhu yu zu zhi ren he bu shou huan ying de ye shou jin ru cheng zhen 。]

english: Anyway, did you want to buy a drink?
translation: 无论如何，你想买一杯饮料吗？ [wu lun ru he ， ni xiang mai yi bei yin liao ma ？]

english: What's with those big gates out there?
translation: 外面那些大门是怎么回事？ [wai mian na xie da men shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: Hello again! Lovely day for it, isn't it?
translation: 又好！美好的一天，不是吗？ [you hao ！ mei hao de yi tian ， bu shi ma ？]

english: I suppose it is.
translation: 我想是的。 [wo xiang shi de 。]

english: Nothing like a good day in Lovakengj, that's what I always say!
translation: 没有什么比在洛瓦肯吉度过美好的一天更好的了，这就是我常说的！ [mei you shen me bi zai luo wa ken ji du guo mei hao de yi tian geng hao de le ， zhe jiu shi wo chang shuo de ！]

english: Well I hope you keep enjoying it.
translation: 好吧，我希望你继续享受它。 [hao ba ， wo xi wang ni ji xu xiang shou ta 。]

english: I'm sure I will!
translation: 我确信我会的！ [wo que xin wo hui de ！]

english: Hello! Here to see the Burning Man?
translation: 你好！来这里看火人节？ [ni hao ！ lai zhe li kan huo ren jie ？]

english: That's right.
translation: 这是正确的。 [zhe shi zheng que de 。]

english: Well you picked a great day for it! The name's Barus by the way. I work as a historian here. Those Arceuus lot may think they know it all, but I reckon I could tell you a thing or two that even they haven't realised!
translation: 好吧，你选了一个美好的日子！顺便说一句，我的名字叫巴鲁斯。我在这里担任历史学家。那些阿尔宙斯人可能认为他们知道一切，但我想我可以告诉你一两件事，即使他们也没有意识到！ [hao ba ， ni xuan le yi ge mei hao de ri zi ！ shun bian shuo yi ju ， wo de ming zi jiao ba lu si 。 wo zai zhe li dan ren li shi xue jia 。 na xie a er zhou si ren ke neng ren wei ta men zhi dao yi qie ， dan wo xiang wo ke yi gao su ni yi liang jian shi ， ji shi ta men ye mei you yi shi dao ！]

english: Well on that note, what can you tell me about the Burning Man?
translation: 那么关于火人节，你能告诉我些什么吗？ [na me guan yu huo ren jie ， ni neng gao su wo xie shen me ma ？]

english: The Burning Man is a monument to a great triumph in Lovakengj history. We're talking thosands of years ago, before Kourend was even a kingdom! Sadly, that does mean some details have been lost to time.
translation: 火人节是洛瓦肯吉历史上伟大胜利的纪念碑。我们谈论的是几千年前，在库伦德甚至还没有成为一个王国之前！可悲的是，这确实意味着一些细节已经随着时间的流逝而丢失。 [huo ren jie shi luo wa ken ji li shi shang wei da sheng li de ji nian bei 。 wo men tan lun de shi ji qian nian qian ， zai ku lun de shen zhi hai mei you cheng wei yi ge wang guo zhi qian ！ ke bei de shi ， zhe que shi yi wei zhe yi xie xi jie yi jing sui zhe shi jian de liu shi er diu shi 。]

english: What we do know is that a great evil threatened the earliest dwarven settlers here. Had that evil prevailed, Lovakengj might never have existed!
translation: 我们所知道的是，一种巨大的邪恶威胁着这里最早的矮人定居者。如果邪恶盛行，洛瓦肯杰可能永远不会存在！ [wo men suo zhi dao de shi ， yi zhong ju da de xie e wei xie zhe zhe li zui zao de ai ren ding ju zhe 。 ru guo xie e sheng xing ， luo wa ken jie ke neng yong yuan bu hui cun zai ！]

english: Thankfully, with guidance from their brave leader, the settlers were able to overcome this evil! The Burning Man is a reminder of that.
translation: 值得庆幸的是，在勇敢的领袖的指导下，定居者们最终战胜了邪恶！火人节就是一个提醒。 [zhi de qing xing de shi ， zai yong gan de ling xiu de zhi dao xia ， ding ju zhe men zui zhong zhan sheng le xie e ！ huo ren jie jiu shi yi ge ti xing 。]

english: So I'm guessing the monument represents this evil?
translation: 所以我猜这座纪念碑代表了这种邪恶？ [suo yi wo cai zhe zuo ji nian bei dai biao le zhe zhong xie e ？]

english: That's right!
translation: 这是正确的！ [zhe shi zheng que de ！]

english: But what was it, and where did it come from?
translation: 但它是什么，它从哪里来？ [dan ta shi shen me ， ta cong na li lai ？]

english: Ah, now that bit is less clear. Have you heard of the Stranglewood?
translation: 啊，现在这一点不太清楚了。你听说过荆棘林吗？ [a ， xian zai zhe yi dian bu tai qing chu le 。 ni ting shuo guo jing ji lin ma ？]

english: I don't think so.
translation: 我不这么认为。 [wo bu zhe me ren wei 。]

english: Not too surprising. It's not a place you'd want to visit. Anyway, that's supposedly where this evil emerged from.
translation: 并不太令人惊讶。这不是一个你想去参观的地方。不管怎样，据说这就是邪恶的源头。 [bing bu tai ling ren jing ya 。 zhe bu shi yi ge ni xiang qu can guan de di fang 。 bu guan zen yang ， ju shuo zhe jiu shi xie e de yuan tou 。]

english: I see. What can you tell me about the Stranglewood?
translation: 我懂了。关于荆棘林你能告诉我什么吗？ [wo dong le 。 guan yu jing ji lin ni neng gao su wo shen me ma ？]

english: You'll find it on the border between the Kebos Lowlands and the Kingdom of Varlamore. It's a cursed place. Few have ever entered, and of those that have, none have returned!
translation: 你会在科博斯低地和瓦拉摩尔王国之间的边界找到它。这是一个被诅咒的地方。很少有人进去过，而那些进去过的人，没有一个回来过！ [ni hui zai ke bo si di di he wa la mo er wang guo zhi jian de bian jie zhao dao ta 。 zhe shi yi ge bei zu zhou de di fang 。 hen shao you ren jin qu guo ， er na xie jin qu guo de ren ， mei you yi ge hui lai guo ！]

english: You know, I heard some chap from Hosidius went missing not too long ago. They reckon he went exploring the Stranglewood. Poor guy.
translation: 你知道，我听说霍西迪乌斯的一个小伙子不久前失踪了。他们认为他去探索荆棘林了。可怜的家伙。 [ni zhi dao ， wo ting shuo huo xi di wu si de yi ge xiao huo zi bu jiu qian shi zong le 。 ta men ren wei ta qu tan suo jing ji lin le 。 ke lian de jia huo 。]

english: Who was he?
translation: 他是谁？ [ta shi shui ？]

english: Some botanist I think. His name escapes me, but I think he lived just south of the Hosidius Estate Agent.
translation: 我想是某个植物学家。我记不清他的名字了，但我想他住在霍西迪乌斯地产代理公司的南边。 [wo xiang shi mou ge zhi wu xue jia 。 wo ji bu qing ta de ming zi le ， dan wo xiang ta zhu zai huo xi di wu si di chan dai li gong si de nan bian 。]

english: Interesting... Thanks for all the information.
translation: 有趣...感谢您提供的所有信息。 [you qu ... gan xie nin ti gong de suo you xin xi 。]

english: Don't mention it!
translation: 别提了！ [bie ti le ！]

english: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？ [ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Oh, er, nothing!
translation: 哦，呃，没什么！ [o ， e ， mei shen me ！]

english: I want to mock you.
translation: 我想嘲笑你。 [wo xiang chao xiao ni 。]

english: All right. Go on then.
translation: 好的。那就继续吧。 [hao de 。 na jiu ji xu ba 。]

english: You're a [boring/fat/hideous/puny/smelly/stupid] [beetle/chicken/egg/mud/slime/worm]-[brained/eating/like/loving/smelling/witted] [basilisk/idiot/lizard/mudworm/slimeball/weakling]!
translation: 你是一个[无聊/肥胖/丑陋/弱小/臭/愚蠢][甲虫/鸡/蛋/泥/粘液/蠕虫]-[有头脑/吃/喜欢/爱/闻/机智][蛇怪/白痴/蜥蜴/泥虫/粘球/弱者]！ [ni shi yi ge [ wu liao / fei pang / chou lou / ruo xiao / chou / yu chun ][ jia chong / ji / dan / ni / nian ye / ru chong ]-[ you tou nao / chi / xi huan / ai / wen / ji zhi ][ she guai / bai chi / xi yi / ni chong / zhan qiu / ruo zhe ]！]

english: I'm not THAT sorry!

english: Will you forgive me?

translation: 我保证不再这样做。 [wo bao zheng bu zai zhe yang zuo 。]

english: Of couseyou won't do it again, you can only kill me once.
translation: 当然你不会再这么做了，你只能杀我一次。 [dang ran ni bu hui zai zhe me zuo le ， ni zhi neng sha wo yi ci 。]

english: That's why I won't do it again! There'd be no point!
translation: 这就是为什么我不会再这样做了！那就没有意义了！ [zhe jiu shi wei shen me wo bu hui zai zhe yang zuo le ！ na jiu mei you yi yi le ！]

english: But I won't do it to any other basilisks!
translation: 但我不会对任何其他蛇怪这么做！ [dan wo bu hui dui ren he qi ta she guai zhe me zuo ！]

translation: 真的吗？ [zhen de ma ？]

translation: 是的，真的！ [shi de ， zhen de ！]

translation: 我要喝一品脱。 [wo yao he yi pin tuo 。]

translation: ……我想，如果你就是这样的人的话。 […… wo xiang ， ru guo ni jiu shi zhe yang de ren de hua 。]
