english: It is North East of here effendi, across the trackless desert. It will be a thirsty trip, can I interest you in a drink?
translation: 这里位于阿芬迪的东北方，穿过无路可走的沙漠。这会是一次口渴的旅行，我可以给你喝一杯吗？ [zhe li wei yu a fen di de dong bei fang ， chuan guo wu lu ke zou de sha mo 。 zhe hui shi yi ci kou ke de lv xing ， wo ke yi gei ni he yi bei ma ？]

english: Okay, thanks
translation: 好的，谢谢 [hao de ， xie xie]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Where is the Shantay Pass?
translation: 尚泰通行证在哪里？ [shang tai tong xing zheng zai na li ？]

english: What do you have to sell?
translation: 你要卖什么？ [ni yao mai shen me ？]

english: Okay, thanks
translation: 好的，谢谢 [hao de ， xie xie]

english: Hello Effendi! How can I help you?
translation: 你好，阿芬迪！我怎么帮你？ [ni hao ， a fen di ！ wo zen me bang ni ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This is the camp of the Bedabin. Talk to our leader, Al Shabim, he'll be happy to chat.
translation: 这是贝达宾人的营地。与我们的领袖 Al Shabim 交谈，他会很乐意与您聊天。 [zhe shi bei da bin ren de ying di 。 yu wo men de ling xiu  Al Shabim  jiao tan ， ta hui hen le yi yu nin liao tian 。]

english: Where is the Shantay Pass?
translation: 尚泰通行证在哪里？ [shang tai tong xing zheng zai na li ？]

english: It is north-east of here effendi, across the trackless desert. It will be a thirsty trip!
translation: 它位于阿芬迪的东北方，穿过无人迹的沙漠。这将是一次口渴的旅行！ [ta wei yu a fen di de dong bei fang ， chuan guo wu ren ji de sha mo 。 zhe jiang shi yi ci kou ke de lv xing ！]

english: Okay, thanks
translation: 好的，谢谢 [hao de ， xie xie]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Where is the Shantay Pass?
translation: 尚泰通行证在哪里？ [shang tai tong xing zheng zai na li ？]

english: Okay, thanks
translation: 好的，谢谢 [hao de ， xie xie]

english: Sorry, but you can't use the tent without permission. But thanks for all your help with the Bedabin people.
translation: 抱歉，未经许可您不能使用帐篷。但感谢您对贝达宾人民的所有帮助。 [bao qian ， wei jing xu ke nin bu neng shi yong zhang peng 。 dan gan xie nin dui bei da bin ren min de suo you bang zhu 。]

english: Sorry, but you can't use the tent without permission. Orders of Al Shabim.
translation: 抱歉，未经许可您不能使用帐篷。沙比姆的命令。 [bao qian ， wei jing xu ke nin bu neng shi yong zhang peng 。 sha bi mu de ming ling 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: So how's life as a pirate?
translation: 那么海贼的生活是怎样的呢？ [na me hai zei de sheng huo shi zen yang de ne ？]

english: What kind of question is that? How's life as a... I dunno. Whatever it is that you do for a living.
translation: 这是什么问题？生活怎么样……我不知道。无论你以什么为生。 [zhe shi shen me wen ti ？ sheng huo zen me yang …… wo bu zhi dao 。 wu lun ni yi shen me wei sheng 。]

english: I'm a freelance troubleshooter.
translation: 我是一名自由疑难解答者。 [wo shi yi ming zi you yi nan jie da zhe 。]

english: What does that entail then?
translation: 那么这意味着什么呢？ [na me zhe yi wei zhe shen me ne ？]

english: Mostly killing things for money and delivering items around the planet for people.
translation: 主要是为了钱而杀人，并为人们在地球各地运送物品。 [zhu yao shi wei le qian er sha ren ， bing wei ren men zai di qiu ge di yun song wu pin 。]

english: I collect stuff.
translation: 我收集东西。 [wo shou ji dong xi 。]

english: So how's that life?
translation: 那么这样的生活怎么样呢？ [na me zhe yang de sheng huo zen me yang ne ？]

english: Can't complain, can't complain...
translation: 不能抱怨，不能抱怨…… [bu neng bao yuan ， bu neng bao yuan ……]

english: Well, there you go.
translation: 好吧，就这样吧。 [hao ba ， jiu zhe yang ba 。]

english: Aren't you a little short for a pirate?
translation: 你对于海盗来说是不是有点矮了？ [ni dui yu hai dao lai shuo shi bu shi you dian ai le ？]

english: My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.
translation: 我的母亲是一个侏儒。显然这是一次非常痛苦的分娩。 [wo de mu qin shi yi ge zhu ru 。 xian ran zhe shi yi ci fei chang tong ku de fen mian 。]

english: More info than I wanted, thanks!
translation: 比我想要的更多信息，谢谢！ [bi wo xiang yao de geng duo xin xi ， xie xie ！]

english: Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.
translation: 抱歉，不能停下来，如果船长发现我偷懒地跟偷渡者说话，我的胆子会被吊袜带的。 [bao qian ， bu neng ting xia lai ， ru guo chuan zhang fa xian wo tou lan di gen tou du zhe shuo hua ， wo de dan zi hui bei diao wa dai de 。]

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard!
translation: 我不是偷渡者！我被邀请上船了！ [wo bu shi tou du zhe ！ wo bei yao qing shang chuan le ！]

english: Yeah, whatever [guy/lady], it doesn't really matter who you are I'll get in trouble!
translation: 是的，无论[男人/女人]，无论你是谁，我都会遇到麻烦！ [shi de ， wu lun [ nan ren / nv ren ]， wu lun ni shi shui ， wo du hui yu dao ma fan ！]

english: You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.
translation: 你知道，我一直想知道海盗的生活究竟意味着什么。 [ni zhi dao ， wo yi zhi xiang zhi dao hai dao de sheng huo jiu jing yi wei zhe shen me 。]

english: Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.
translation: 嗯，目前主要涉及偷渡者随机询问问题。 [n ， mu qian zhu yao she ji tou du zhe sui ji xun wen wen ti 。]

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard! By Lokar! Ask him!
translation: 我不是偷渡者！我被邀请上船了！洛卡写的！问他吧！ [wo bu shi tou du zhe ！ wo bei yao qing shang chuan le ！ luo ka xie de ！ wen ta ba ！]

english: Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.
translation: 嘿，无论如何[爱人/朋友]。只要确保船长没有抓住你，海盗不太喜欢偷渡者。 [hei ， wu lun ru he [ ai ren / peng you ]。 zhi yao que bao chuan zhang mei you zhua zhu ni ， hai dao bu tai xi huan tou du zhe 。]

english: Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?
translation: 啊，祝你有美好的一天[milady/sirrah]！你的脸很陌生，你是不是和我们一起登上了月岛的船？ [a ， zhu ni you mei hao de yi tian [milady/sirrah]！ ni de lian hen mo sheng ， ni shi bu shi he wo men yi qi deng shang le yue dao de chuan ？]

english: No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.
translation: 不，洛卡实际上让我在雷莱卡搭车。 [bu ， luo ka shi ji shang rang wo zai lei lai ka da che 。]

english: Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!
translation: 哦真的吗？在我看来你不像弗雷曼尼克人！ [o zhen de ma ？ zai wo kan lai ni bu xiang fu lei man ni ke ren ！]

english: Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
translation: 嗯……我有点是，又有点不是。这是一个很长的故事。 [n …… wo you dian shi ， you you dian bu shi 。 zhe shi yi ge hen zhang de gu shi 。]

english: Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a-fremennik!
translation: 抱歉我没时间听！再见，年轻的弗雷曼尼克，他不是真正的弗雷曼尼克！ [bao qian wo mei shi jian ting ！ zai jian ， nian qing de fu lei man ni ke ， ta bu shi zhen zheng de fu lei man ni ke ！]

english: 'Bye.
translation: '再见。 [' zai jian 。]

english: Brrrr! Its cold up here!
translation: 呜呜！这里很冷！ [wu wu ！ zhe li hen leng ！]

english: You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!
translation: 你觉得这很冷吗？到了 Acheron 那里，天气变得非常寒冷，当你说话时，你会看到话语冻结在你面前的空气中！ [ni jue de zhe hen leng ma ？ dao le  Acheron  na li ， tian qi bian de fei chang han leng ， dang ni shuo hua shi ， ni hui kan dao hua yu dong jie zai ni mian qian de kong qi zhong ！]

english: REALLY?
translation: 真的吗？ [zhen de ma ？]

english: Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!
translation: 不，不是真的。我为了达到幽默效果而夸张了。不过天气非常非常冷！ [bu ， bu shi zhen de 。 wo wei le da dao you mo xiao guo er kua zhang le 。 bu guo tian qi fei chang fei chang leng ！]

english: Hello to you too.
translation: 也向你问好。 [ye xiang ni wen hao 。]

english: Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
translation: 呀！我们是海盗，耶！阿瓦斯特，你们这些坏血病的陆生荔枝！ [ya ！ wo men shi hai dao ， ye ！ a wa si te ， ni men zhe xie huai xue bing de lu sheng li zhi ！]

english: Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
translation: 请不要这样说话，这太令人恼火了。 [qing bu yao zhe yang shuo hua ， zhe tai ling ren nao huo le 。]

english: Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
translation: 另外，请不要叫我荔枝，不管那是什么。 [ling wai ， qing bu yao jiao wo li zhi ， bu guan na shi shen me 。]

english: Oh. Okay. Sorry.
translation: 哦。好的。对不起。 [o 。 hao de 。 dui bu qi 。]

english: ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!
translation: 啊啊！拉响警报！船上偷渡者！船上偷渡者！ [a a ！ la xiang jing bao ！ chuan shang tou du zhe ！ chuan shang tou du zhe ！]

english: No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
translation: 不！我不是偷渡者！诚实的！我被邀请来到这里！ [bu ！ wo bu shi tou du zhe ！ cheng shi de ！ wo bei yao qing lai dao zhe li ！]

english: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
translation: 哦，抱歉，那是我的错误。 [o ， bao qian ， na shi wo de cuo wu 。]

english: You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.
translation: 但你必须承认你看起来确实很像一个偷渡者。 [dan ni bi xu cheng ren ni kan qi lai que shi hen xiang yi ge tou du zhe 。]

english: Why, what do they usually look like?
translation: 为什么，他们通常是什么样子？ [wei shen me ， ta men tong chang shi shen me yang zi ？]

english: Erm... I've never actually met one...
translation: 呃……我从来没有真正见过一个…… [e …… wo cong lai mei you zhen zheng jian guo yi ge ……]

english: Okay then...
translation: 好吧，那么... [hao ba ， na me ...]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: So... You're a pirate, huh?
translation: 那么...你是海盗，是吧？ [na me ... ni shi hai dao ， shi ba ？]

english: It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.
translation: 月底我的工资单上就是这么写的。 [yue di wo de gong zi dan shang jiu shi zhe me xie de 。]

english: How's that working out for you?
translation: 你感觉怎么样？ [ni gan jue zen me yang ？]

english: Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.
translation: 到目前为止还不错。我们可以掠夺的所有烈酒和战利品，再加上包括牙科在内的全套医疗服务。 [dao mu qian wei zhi hai bu cuo 。 wo men ke yi lve duo de suo you lie jiu he zhan li pin ， zai jia shang bao kuo ya ke zai nei de quan tao yi liao fu wu 。]

english: You mean you have insurance?
translation: 你是说你有保险？ [ni shi shuo ni you bao xian ？]

english: Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.
translation: 不是这样的。如果我们中的任何一个人生病了，我们就会绑架一名医生，直到我们病情好转之前不让他走。 [bu shi zhe yang de 。 ru guo wo men zhong de ren he yi ge ren sheng bing le ， wo men jiu hui bang jia yi ming yi sheng ， zhi dao wo men bing qing hao zhuan zhi qian bu rang ta zou 。]

english: You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.
translation: 您会惊讶地发现，这对于专家医疗保健来说是多么大的激励。 [nin hui jing ya di fa xian ， zhe dui yu zhuan jia yi liao bao jian lai shuo shi duo me da de ji li 。]

english: I can imagine.
translation: 我可以想象。 [wo ke yi xiang xiang 。]

english: Hello there. So what brings you aboard the Lady Zay?
translation: 你好呀。那么是什么让您登上了 Lady Zay 号呢？ [ni hao ya 。 na me shi shen me rang nin deng shang le  Lady Zay  hao ne ？]

english: Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.
translation: 嗯，我原本打算去拜访月族，但我不得不说你们的船非常令人印象深刻。 [n ， wo yuan ben da suan qu bai fang yue zu ， dan wo bu de bu shuo ni men de chuan fei chang ling ren yin xiang shen ke 。]

english: Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!
translation: 是啊，果然是个美女啊！扎伊女士酒店一直是我的家，度过了许多艰难的几个月，经历了暴风雨和阳光，她总是带我们到达我们要去的地方！ [shi a ， guo ran shi ge mei nv a ！ zha yi nv shi jiu dian yi zhi shi wo de jia ， du guo le xu duo jian nan de ji ge yue ， jing li le bao feng yu he yang guang ， ta zong shi dai wo men dao da wo men yao qu de di fang ！]

english: Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!
translation: 是的，她确实是我旅行中见过的最好的船之一！ [shi de ， ta que shi shi wo lv xing zhong jian guo de zui hao de chuan zhi yi ！]

english: That she is [lad/lass], that she is.
translation: 她是[小伙子/姑娘]，她就是。 [ta shi [ xiao huo zi / gu niang ]， ta jiu shi 。]

english: I'm sorry to bother you, [player name], but I need some help with a bee hive.
translation: 很抱歉打扰你，[玩家姓名]，但我需要一些有关蜂巢的帮助。 [hen bao qian da rao ni ，[ wan jia xing ming ]， dan wo xu yao yi xie you guan feng chao de bang zhu 。]

english: Ooh, a bee hive. I'll help you.
translation: 噢，一个蜂巢。我会帮助你。 [o ， yi ge feng chao 。 wo hui bang zhu ni 。]

english: Player is teleported to a field of beehives
translation: 玩家被传送到蜂箱区 [wan jia bei chuan song dao feng xiang qu]

english: Buzz off!
translation: 嘘！ [xu ！]

english: Ah, [player name]. I'm sorry to drag you away like this, but I need some help building a new hive for my bees.
translation: 啊，[玩家姓名]。很抱歉就这样把你拖走，但我需要一些帮助来为我的蜜蜂建造一个新蜂巢。 [a ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。 hen bao qian jiu zhe yang ba ni tuo zou ， dan wo xu yao yi xie bang zhu lai wei wo de mi feng jian zao yi ge xin feng chao 。]

english: What do you expect me to do?
translation: 你希望我做什么？ [ni xi wang wo zuo shen me ？]

english: All the parts of the beehive are jumbled up. You've got to put them in the correct order for building a hive.
translation: 蜂箱的所有部件都杂乱无章。您必须按照正确的顺序放置它们才能构建蜂巢。 [feng xiang de suo you bu jian dou za luan wu zhang 。 nin bi xu an zhao zheng que de shun xu fang zhi ta men cai neng gou jian feng chao 。]

english: Oh, very well. Let's take a look...
translation: 哦，很好。我们来看看... [o ， hen hao 。 wo men lai kan kan ...]

english: Ready to try again?
translation: 准备好再试一次吗？ [zhun bei hao zai shi yi ci ma ？]

english: First remind me of what I'm doing.
translation: 首先提醒我我在做什么。 [shou xian ti xing wo wo zai zuo shen me 。]

english: Yeah, let me get on with it.
translation: 是的，让我继续吧。 [shi de ， rang wo ji xu ba 。]

english: No, that doesn't look right. You have to put the parts in the right order, otherwise it'll be no good as a beehive.
translation: 不，这看起来不对。你必须按照正确的顺序放置零件，否则它就不能成为一个好的蜂箱。 [bu ， zhe kan qi lai bu dui 。 ni bi xu an zhao zheng que de shun xu fang zhi ling jian ， fou ze ta jiu bu neng cheng wei yi ge hao de feng xiang 。]

english: I'll let you have 5 more tries.
translation: 我会让你再尝试5次。 [wo hui rang ni zai chang shi 5 ci 。]

english: I'll let you have 4 more tries.
translation: 我会让你再尝试 4 次。 [wo hui rang ni zai chang shi  4  ci 。]

english: I'll let you have 3 more tries.
translation: 我会让你再尝试3次。 [wo hui rang ni zai chang shi 3 ci 。]

english: I'll let you have 2 more tries.
translation: 我会让你再尝试 2 次。 [wo hui rang ni zai chang shi  2  ci 。]

english: I'll let you have one more try.
translation: 我会让你再试一次。 [wo hui rang ni zai shi yi ci 。]

english: Uh-oh, the bees are fed up with waiting for you to build them a home!
translation: 呃哦，蜜蜂已经厌倦了等待你为它们建造一个家！ [e o ， mi feng yi jing yan juan le deng dai ni wei ta men jian zao yi ge jia ！]

english: Three bee swarms start stinging the player, while the player runs around for a while and attempts to defend themself helplessly.
translation: 三群蜂群开始蜇玩家，而玩家则跑来跑去，试图无助地保护自己。 [san qun feng qun kai shi zhe wan jia ， er wan jia ze pao lai pao qu ， shi tu wu zhu di bao hu zi ji 。]

english: Aaaaargh - BEES!
translation: 啊啊啊——蜜蜂！ [a a a —— mi feng ！]

english: Ooch!
translation: 哎哟！ [ai yo ！]

english: Eek!
translation: 哎呀！ [ai ya ！]

english: Beees!
translation: 蜜蜂！ [mi feng ！]

english: Ow!
I'll help you!
translation: 我来帮助你！ [wo lai bang zhu ni ！]

english: The bee keeper starts casting a tele-other spell.
translation: 养蜂人开始施展远程法术。 [yang feng ren kai shi shi zhan yuan cheng fa shu 。]

english: The bee keeper obligingly teleports you away from the angry swarms.
translation: 养蜂人会亲切地将你传送到远离愤怒的蜂群的地方。 [yang feng ren hui qin qie di jiang ni chuan song dao yuan li fen nu de feng qun de di fang 。]

english: Player is teleported back to their original location, with no reward and no losses.
translation: 玩家被传送回原来的位置，没有奖励也没有损失。 [wan jia bei chuan song hui yuan lai de wei zhi ， mei you jiang li ye mei you sun shi 。]

english: That's perfect! I'll get some bees moved in immediately.
translation: 那很完美！我会立即把一些蜜蜂搬进去。 [na hen wan mei ！ wo hui li ji ba yi xie mi feng ban jin qu 。]

english: Now, I'm sure I must have something to offer you for all your help...
translation: 现在，我确信我必须为您提供一些帮助，以感谢您的帮助...... [xian zai ， wo que xin wo bi xu wei nin ti gong yi xie bang zhu ， yi gan xie nin de bang zhu ......]

english: Player is teleported back to their original location
translation: 玩家被传送回原来的位置 [wan jia bei chuan song hui yuan lai de wei zhi]

english: Sorry, you're not the person I need.
translation: 抱歉，你不是我需要的人。 [bao qian ， ni bu shi wo xu yao de ren 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Hello, [player name]?
translation: 你好，[玩家姓名]？ [ni hao ，[ wan jia xing ming ]？]

english: Please help me, [player name].
translation: 请帮助我，[玩家姓名]。 [qing bang zhu wo ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: I need your help, [player name]!
translation: 我需要你的帮助，[玩家姓名]！ [wo xu yao ni de bang zhu ，[ wan jia xing ming ]！]

english: Can I borrow you for a minute, [player name]?
translation: 我可以借你一分钟吗，[玩家姓名]？ [wo ke yi jie ni yi fen zhong ma ，[ wan jia xing ming ]？]

english: Maybe later.
translation: 也许以后吧。 [ye xu yi hou ba 。]

english: Ooh, a bee hive. I'll help you.
translation: 噢，一个蜂巢。我会帮助你。 [o ， yi ge feng chao 。 wo hui bang zhu ni 。]

english: Buzz off!
translation: 嘘！ [xu ！]

english: First remind me of what I'm doing.
translation: 首先提醒我我在做什么。 [shou xian ti xing wo wo zai zuo shen me 。]

english: Yeah, let me get on with it.
translation: 是的，让我继续吧。 [shi de ， rang wo ji xu ba 。]

english: Hello, what's going on?
translation: 你好，请问这是怎么回事？ [ni hao ， qing wen zhe shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: Hello, it seems you've found a wild bee hive. I'll pay you to help me rehome them.
translation: 你好，看来你发现了一个野生蜂巢。我会付钱给你，让你帮我重新安置它们。 [ni hao ， kan lai ni fa xian le yi ge ye sheng feng chao 。 wo hui fu qian gei ni ， rang ni bang wo chong xin an zhi ta men 。]

english: Oh, well, if you ever want to find out how to help, just ask.
translation: 哦，好吧，如果你想知道如何提供帮助，尽管问。 [o ， hao ba ， ru guo ni xiang zhi dao ru he ti gong bang zhu ， jin guan wen 。]

english: It's easy, simply add logs to the unfinished bee boxes I create. Most common types of log work just fine.
translation: 这很简单，只需将日志添加到我创建的未完成的蜂箱中即可。大多数常见类型的日志都可以正常工作。 [zhe hen jian dan ， zhi xu jiang ri zhi tian jia dao wo chuang jian de wei wan cheng de feng xiang zhong ji ke 。 da duo shu chang jian lei xing de ri zhi dou ke yi zheng chang gong zuo 。]

english: Once a bee box is completed I will start a new one, let's see how many of these bees we can save.
translation: 一旦一个蜂箱完成，我就会开始一个新的，让我们看看我们能拯救多少只蜜蜂。 [yi dan yi ge feng xiang wan cheng ， wo jiu hui kai shi yi ge xin de ， rang wo men kan kan wo men neng zheng jiu duo shao zhi mi feng 。]

english: Oh, Bees!
translation: 哦，蜜蜂！ [o ， mi feng ！]

english: I'll find a nice new home for those bees.
translation: 我会为那些蜜蜂找到一个漂亮的新家。 [wo hui wei na xie mi feng zhao dao yi ge piao liang de xin jia 。]

english: Come with me little bees I'll keep you safe.
translation: 小蜜蜂们跟我来吧，我会保证你们的安全。 [xiao mi feng men gen wo lai ba ， wo hui bao zheng ni men de an quan 。]

english: Another new hive.
translation: 另一个新蜂巢。 [ling yi ge xin feng chao 。]

english: Well, I must be getting on now.
translation: 好吧，我现在必须继续前进了。 [hao ba ， wo xian zai bi xu ji xu qian jin le 。]

english: I'm not interested.
translation: 我对此不感兴趣。 [wo dui ci bu gan xing qu 。]

english: How can I help?
translation: 我能提供什么帮助吗？ [wo neng ti gong shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: Please kind [sir/lady]... my family and I are starving...
translation: 请善良[先生/女士]...我和我的家人都快饿死了... [qing shan liang [ xian sheng / nv shi ]... wo he wo de jia ren dou kuai e si le ...]

english: Could you find it in your heart to spare me a simple loaf of bread?
translation: 你能发心给我一块简单的面包吗？ [ni neng fa xin gei wo yi kuai jian dan de mian bao ma ？]

english: Yes certainly.
translation: 是的，当然。 [shi de ， dang ran 。]

english: ... except I don't have any bread on me at the moment...
translation: ...不过我现在身上没有面包... [... bu guo wo xian zai shen shang mei you mian bao ...]

english: Well if you get some, you know where to come.
translation: 好吧，如果你得到一些，你就知道去哪里了。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni de dao yi xie ， ni jiu zhi dao qu na li le 。]

english: Thank you very much!
translation: 非常感谢！ [fei chang gan xie ！]

english: The beggar has turned into the Lady of the Lake!
translation: 乞丐变成了湖中仙女！ [qi gai bian cheng le hu zhong xian nv ！]

english: Well done. You have passed my test.
translation: 干得好。你已经通过了我的考验。 [gan de hao 。 ni yi jing tong guo le wo de kao yan 。]

english: Here is Excalibur, guard it well.
translation: 这里是Excalibur，好好守护。 [zhe li shi Excalibur， hao hao shou hu 。]

english: No I don't have any bread with me.
translation: 不，我没有带面包。 [bu ， wo mei you dai mian bao 。]

english: Have you got any bread for me yet?
translation: 你有面包给我吗？ [ni you mian bao gei wo ma ？]

english: Yes, here you go.
translation: 是的，给你。 [shi de ， gei ni 。]

english: Actually, I'm wrong. I still don't have any bread. Sorry.
translation: 事实上，我错了。我还没有面包。对不起。 [shi shi shang ， wo cuo le 。 wo hai mei you mian bao 。 dui bu qi 。]

english: Sorry, no, I still have none.
translation: 抱歉，没有，我还没有。 [bao qian ， mei you ， wo hai mei you 。]

english: The beggar isn't interested in talking.
translation: 乞丐没有兴趣说话。 [qi gai mei you xing qu shuo hua 。]

english: Yes certainly.
translation: 是的，当然。 [shi de ， dang ran 。]

english: No I don't have any bread with me.
translation: 不，我没有带面包。 [bu ， wo mei you dai mian bao 。]

english: Yes, here you go.
translation: 是的，给你。 [shi de ， gei ni 。]

english: No, I still have none.
translation: 不，我还是没有。 [bu ， wo hai shi mei you 。]

english: Well hello there sweetheart.
translation: 嗯，你好，亲爱的。 [n ， ni hao ， qin ai de 。]

english: Hi!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: What brings you down here?
translation: 是什么让你来到这里？ [shi shen me rang ni lai dao zhe li ？]

english: I'm looking for the Easter Bunny.
translation: 我在寻找复活节兔子。 [wo zai xun zhao fu huo jie tu zi 。]

english: Fancy that! You're in luck, he's in the next room.
translation: 喜欢那个！你很幸运，他就在隔壁房间。 [xi huan na ge ！ ni hen xing yun ， ta jiu zai ge bi fang jian 。]

english: I'm trying to cheer up the Easter Bunny, do you have any suggestions?
translation: 我正在努力让复活节兔子高兴起来，你有什么建议吗？ [wo zheng zai nu li rang fu huo jie tu zi gao xing qi lai ， ni you shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: Hmm, well, he's a sensible bunny, I'm sure he'd love to go carrot bowling!
translation: 嗯，好吧，他是一只懂事的兔子，我相信他很乐意去打胡萝卜保龄球！ [n ， hao ba ， ta shi yi zhi dong shi de tu zi ， wo xiang xin ta hen le yi qu da hu luo bo bao ling qiu ！]

english: Bowling? Where can we do that?
translation: 保龄球？我们可以在哪里做到这一点？ [bao ling qiu ？ wo men ke yi zai na li zuo dao zhe yi dian ？]

english: It just so happens we have a carrot bowling alley right here in the Rabbit Hole!
translation: 碰巧我们在兔子洞里有一个胡萝卜保龄球馆！ [peng qiao wo men zai tu zi dong li you yi ge hu luo bo bao ling qiu guan ！]

english: Really? Wow! That's fortunate. Where is it?
translation: 真的吗？哇！那是幸运的。它在哪里？ [zhen de ma ？ wa ！ na shi xing yun de 。 ta zai na li ？]

english: Through the door to the east, turn left, then it's on the right. You can't miss it!
translation: 穿过东边的门，左转，然后就在右边。你不能错过它！ [chuan guo dong bian de men ， zuo zhuan ， ran hou jiu zai you bian 。 ni bu neng cuo guo ta ！]

english: Well, maybe you can. Depends on your navigational skills I suppose.
translation: 好吧，也许你可以。我想这取决于你的导航技能。 [hao ba ， ye xu ni ke yi 。 wo xiang zhe qu jue yu ni de dao hang ji neng 。]

english: Anyway, talk to Bowley Moley when you get there, I'm sure he will be happy to help.
translation: 不管怎样，当你到达那里后与鲍利·莫利谈谈，我相信他会很乐意提供帮助。 [bu guan zen yang ， dang ni dao da na li hou yu bao li · mo li tan tan ， wo xiang xin ta hui hen le yi ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: Alright, I'll have a look for this bowling alley and speak to Bowley Moley. Thanks!
translation: 好的，我去看看这个保龄球馆并和鲍利·莫利谈谈。谢谢！ [hao de ， wo qu kan kan zhe ge bao ling qiu guan bing he bao li · mo li tan tan 。 xie xie ！]

english: Look who it is! I heard the Easter Bunny gave you a true thrashing on that alley.
translation: 看看是谁！我听说复活节兔子在那条巷子里狠狠地打了你一顿。 [kan kan shi shui ！ wo ting shuo fu huo jie tu zi zai na tiao xiang zi li hen hen di da le ni yi dun 。]

english: Oh yeah, I got outplayed fair and square!
translation: 哦，是的，我被公平地击败了！ [o ， shi de ， wo bei gong ping di ji bai le ！]

english: It seems to have lifted his spirits somewhat, thanks for doing that.
translation: 这似乎让他的精神振奋了一些，谢谢你这么做。 [zhe si hu rang ta de jing shen zhen fen le yi xie ， xie xie ni zhe me zuo 。]

english: I'm just glad to cheer him up a bit.
translation: 我很高兴能让他高兴一点。 [wo hen gao xing neng rang ta gao xing yi dian 。]

english: Hey, [player name]. I thought it was really sweet of you to help cheer up that bunny.
translation: 嘿，[玩家姓名]。我觉得你帮那只兔子高兴起来真是太好了。 [hei ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。 wo jue de ni bang na zhi tu zi gao xing qi lai zhen shi tai hao le 。]

english: Maybe we could go bowling sometime and you could cheer me up too?
translation: 也许我们可以找个时间去打保龄球，你也可以让我高兴起来吗？ [ye xu wo men ke yi zhao ge shi jian qu da bao ling qiu ， ni ye ke yi rang wo gao xing qi lai ma ？]

english: That would be fun, though I'm quite busy at the moment, and in the near future.
translation: 那会很有趣，尽管我现在和不久的将来都很忙。 [na hui hen you qu ， jin guan wo xian zai he bu jiu de jiang lai dou hen mang 。]

english: What about the far future?
translation: 遥远的未来呢？ [yao yuan de wei lai ne ？]

english: Oh the far future is looking very busy for me.
translation: 哦，遥远的未来对我来说看起来非常忙碌。 [o ， yao yuan de wei lai dui wo lai shuo kan qi lai fei chang mang lu 。]

english: But if I find the time, we could invite the Easter Bunny too! We'd all have a great game I'm sure.
translation: 但如果我有时间，我们也可以邀请复活节兔子！我相信我们都会打出一场精彩的比赛。 [dan ru guo wo you shi jian ， wo men ye ke yi yao qing fu huo jie tu zi ！ wo xiang xin wo men du hui da chu yi chang jing cai de bi sai 。]

english: Oh, I see. Nevermind then, if you're so busy.
translation: 我懂了。没关系，如果你这么忙的话。 [wo dong le 。 mei guan xi ， ru guo ni zhe me mang de hua 。]

english: Hello puss.
translation: 你好，小猫。 [ni hao ， xiao mao 。]

english: Hiss!
translation: 嘶！ [si ！]

english: Hello human.
translation: 你好人类。 [ni hao ren lei 。]

english: Would you like a fish?
translation: 你想要一条鱼吗？ [ni xiang yao yi tiao yu ma ？]

english: I don't want your fish. I hunt and eat what I need by myself.
translation: 我不要你的鱼。我自己狩猎并吃我需要的东西。 [wo bu yao ni de yu 。 wo zi ji shou lie bing chi wo xu yao de dong xi 。]

english: Hello human.
translation: 你好人类。 [ni hao ren lei 。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: This guild contains minerals that haven't been found anywhere else. I'm here to try and identify them.
translation: 这个公会含有其他地方没有发现的矿物质。我来这里是为了尝试辨认他们。 [zhe ge gong hui han you qi ta di fang mei you fa xian de kuang wu zhi 。 wo lai zhe li shi wei le chang shi bian ren ta men 。]

english: If you come across any unusual minerals when mining here I'll take them off your hands. Don't worry, I'll make it worth your while.
translation: 如果你在这里采矿时遇到任何不寻常的矿物，我会把它们从你手中夺走。别担心，我会让你值得的。 [ru guo ni zai zhe li cai kuang shi yu dao ren he bu xun chang de kuang wu ， wo hui ba ta men cong ni shou zhong duo zou 。 bie dan xin ， wo hui rang ni zhi de de 。]

english: I've also been digging out this cave recently. I found a bunch of amethyst in there.
translation: 我最近也在挖这个洞。我在那里发现了一堆紫水晶。 [wo zui jin ye zai wa zhe ge dong 。 wo zai na li fa xian le yi dui zi shui jing 。]

english: What can you offer me?
translation: 你能为我提供什么？ [ni neng wei wo ti gong shen me ？]

english: I have some gloves that will help you when Mining. When you wear these gloves you'll find that some rocks will instantly respawn.
translation: 我有一些手套，可以在采矿时为您提供帮助。当你戴上这些手套时，你会发现一些岩石会立即重生。 [wo you yi xie shou tao ， ke yi zai cai kuang shi wei nin ti gong bang zhu 。 dang ni dai shang zhe xie shou tao shi ， ni hui fa xian yi xie yan shi hui li ji chong sheng 。]

english: How do they do that?
translation: 他们是怎么做到的？ [ta men shi zen me zuo dao de ？]

english: Magic!
translation: 魔法！ [mo fa ！]

english: Beyond that, I could consider letting you access this new cave. It seems to contain even more minerals.
translation: 除此之外，我可以考虑让你进入这个新洞穴。它似乎含有更多的矿物质。 [chu ci zhi wai ， wo ke yi kao lv rang ni jin ru zhe ge xin dong xue 。 ta si hu han you geng duo de kuang wu zhi 。]

english: So, what would you like?
translation: 那么，你想要什么？ [na me ， ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: I'd like access to the cave.
translation: 我想要进入洞穴。 [wo xiang yao jin ru dong xue 。]

english: Now hold on. There's a lot of minerals in there, and digging out the cave was hard work. Only a true friend of Falador would be allowed in there.
translation: 现在坚持一下。里面有很多矿物质，挖掘洞穴是一项艰苦的工作。只有法拉多真正的朋友才会被允许进入那里。 [xian zai jian chi yi xia 。 li mian you hen duo kuang wu zhi ， wa jue dong xue shi yi xiang jian ku de gong zuo 。 zhi you fa la duo zhen zheng de peng you cai hui bei yun xu jin ru na li 。]

english: You don't seem like you're quite there yet. Come speak to me again once you have completed the Elite Falador Achievement Diary.
translation: 你似乎还没有完全做到这一点。完成精英法拉多成就日记后，请再次与我交谈。 [ni si hu hai mei you wan quan zuo dao zhe yi dian 。 wan cheng jing ying fa la duo cheng jiu ri ji hou ， qing zai ci yu wo jiao tan 。]

english: And you truly are a friend of Falador. Well done on completing the Elite Falador Achievement Diary. Go on in, you may access the cave.
translation: 你确实是法拉多的朋友。完成精英法拉多成就日记，干得好。继续往里走，就可以进入山洞了。 [ni que shi shi fa la duo de peng you 。 wan cheng jing ying fa la duo cheng jiu ri ji ， gan de hao 。 ji xu wang li zou ， jiu ke yi jin ru shan dong le 。]

english: That's all thank you.
translation: 这就是全部谢谢了。 [zhe jiu shi quan bu xie xie le 。]

english: Don't forget to come to me if you find any minerals.
translation: 如果你发现任何矿物质，别忘了来找我。 [ru guo ni fa xian ren he kuang wu zhi ， bie wang le lai zhao wo 。]

english: I don't want to receive minerals.
translation: 我不想接收矿物质。 [wo bu xiang jie shou kuang wu zhi 。]

english: Very well. You'll no longer find any minerals when you mine here. If you change your mind just let me know.
translation: 很好。在这里开采时，您将不再发现任何矿物。如果您改变主意，请告诉我。 [hen hao 。 zai zhe li kai cai shi ， nin jiang bu zai fa xian ren he kuang wu 。 ru guo nin gai bian zhu yi ， qing gao su wo 。]

english: I'd like to receive minerals.
translation: 我想接收矿物质。 [wo xiang jie shou kuang wu zhi 。]

english: As you wish. You'll now find minerals when you mine here. Let me know if you want to change this.
translation: 如你所愿。现在，当你在这里开采时，你会发现矿物质。如果您想更改此设置，请告诉我。 [ru ni suo yuan 。 xian zai ， dang ni zai zhe li kai cai shi ， ni hui fa xian kuang wu zhi 。 ru guo nin xiang geng gai ci she zhi ， qing gao su wo 。]

english: Can you combine my mining gloves?
translation: 你能把我的采矿手套组合起来吗？ [ni neng ba wo de cai kuang shou tao zu he qi lai ma ？]

english: I guess I could combine some Mining gloves with some Superior mining gloves. These new gloves would require 70 Mining to equip.
translation: 我想我可以将一些采矿手套与一些高级采矿手套结合起来。这些新手套需要 70 采矿才能装备。 [wo xiang wo ke yi jiang yi xie cai kuang shou tao yu yi xie gao ji cai kuang shou tao jie he qi lai 。 zhe xie xin shou tao xu yao  70  cai kuang cai neng zhuang bei 。]

english: It wouldn't be free though. I'd want 60 minerals in return.
translation: 但它不是免费的。我想要 60 个矿物作为回报。 [dan ta bu shi mian fei de 。 wo xiang yao  60  ge kuang wu zuo wei hui bao 。]

english: You don't have any gloves for me to combine. You'll need to bring me some Mining gloves and some Superior mining gloves.
translation: 你没有手套供我组合。你需要给我带来一些采矿手套和一些高级采矿手套。 [ni mei you shou tao gong wo zu he 。 ni xu yao gei wo dai lai yi xie cai kuang shou tao he yi xie gao ji cai kuang shou tao 。]

english: There you go. I've combined your gloves into some Expert mining gloves. Enjoy.
translation: 就这样吧。我已将你的手套组合成一些专家采矿手套。享受。 [jiu zhe yang ba 。 wo yi jiang ni de shou tao zu he cheng yi xie zhuan jia cai kuang shou tao 。 xiang shou 。]

english: Fair enough. I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 很公平。如果你改变主意我会在这里。 [hen gong ping 。 ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi wo hui zai zhe li 。]

english: Hey, you! You're not allowed in there! Come speak to me first.
translation: 嘿，你！那里不准你进去！你先来跟我说话吧。 [hei ， ni ！ na li bu zhun ni jin qu ！ ni xian lai gen wo shuo hua ba 。]

english: I'm sorry.
translation: 对不起。 [dui bu qi 。]

english: I have minerals to trade.
translation: 我有矿产可以交易。 [wo you kuang chan ke yi jiao yi 。]

english: What can you offer me?
translation: 你能为我提供什么？ [ni neng wei wo ti gong shen me ？]

english: I'd like to view the shop.
translation: 我想去店里看看。 [wo xiang qu dian li kan kan 。]

english: I'd like access to the cave.
translation: 我想要进入洞穴。 [wo xiang yao jin ru dong xue 。]

english: That's all thank you.
translation: 这就是全部谢谢了。 [zhe jiu shi quan bu xie xie le 。]

english: I don't want to receive minerals.
translation: 我不想接收矿物质。 [wo bu xiang jie shou kuang wu zhi 。]

english: I'd like to receive minerals.
translation: 我想接收矿物质。 [wo xiang jie shou kuang wu zhi 。]

english: Can you combine my mining gloves?
translation: 你能把我的采矿手套组合起来吗？ [ni neng ba wo de cai kuang shou tao zu he qi lai ma ？]

english: That's fine. Combine my gloves.
translation: 没关系。结合我的手套。 [mei guan xi 。 jie he wo de shou tao 。]

english: That's too much.
translation: 那就太多了。 [na jiu tai duo le 。]

english: That's all.
translation: 就这样。 [jiu zhe yang 。]

english: Thanks so much for saving me from being a vampyre. Here, take this certificate, I'm sorry but it's all I can offer as a reward.
translation: 非常感谢你让我免于成为吸血鬼。给，请收下这张证书，抱歉，但这是我所能提供的全部奖励。 [fei chang gan xie ni rang wo mian yu cheng wei xi xue gui 。 gei ， qing shou xia zhe zhang zheng shu ， bao qian ， dan zhe shi wo suo neng ti gong de quan bu jiang li 。]

english: Thanks for changing me back, it must have been hard for you. I must be off now.
translation: 谢谢你让我变回来，这对你来说一定很难。我现在必须走了。 [xie xie ni rang wo bian hui lai ， zhe dui ni lai shuo yi ding hen nan 。 wo xian zai bi xu zou le 。]

english: Can I have a newspaper, please?
translation: 请给我一份报纸好吗？ [qing gei wo yi fen bao zhi hao ma ？]

english: Certainly, Guv. That'll be 50 coins, please.
translation: 当然，古夫。请给我 50 个硬币。 [dang ran ， gu fu 。 qing gei wo  50  ge ying bi 。]

english: Maybe when I've got more money on me.
translation: 也许当我身上有更多钱的时候。 [ye xu dang wo shen shang you geng duo qian de shi hou 。]

english: Well, no cash, no paper. Live in ignorance.
translation: 好吧，没有现金，没有纸。生活在无知中。 [hao ba ， mei you xian jin ， mei you zhi 。 sheng huo zai wu zhi zhong 。]

english: Sure, here you go...
translation: 当然，给你... [dang ran ， gei ni ...]

english: Okay, suit yourself. Plenty more fish in the sea.
translation: 好吧，适合你自己。海里还有很多鱼。 [hao ba ， shi he ni zi ji 。 hai li hai you hen duo yu 。]

english: How much does a paper cost?
translation: 一张纸要多少钱？ [yi zhang zhi yao duo shao qian ？]

english: Just 50 coins! An absolute bargain! Want one?
translation: 只要50金币！绝对划算！想要一个吗？ [zhi yao 50 jin bi ！ jue dui hua suan ！ xiang yao yi ge ma ？]

english: Varrock Herald? Never heard of it.
translation: 瓦洛克先驱者？从来没有听说过。 [wa luo ke xian qu zhe ？ cong lai mei you ting shuo guo 。]

english: For the illiterate amongst us, I shall elucidate. The Varrock Herald is a new newspaper. It is edited, printed and published by myself, Benny Gutenberg, and each edition promises to enthrall the reader with
translation: 对于我们当中不识字的人，我将予以解释。 《瓦洛克先驱报》是一份新报纸。它由我本人本尼·古腾堡编辑、印刷和出版，每个版本都承诺让读者着迷 [dui yu wo men dang zhong bu shi zi de ren ， wo jiang yu yi jie shi 。 《 wa luo ke xian qu bao 》 shi yi fen xin bao zhi 。 ta you wo ben ren ben ni · gu teng bao bian ji 、 yin shua he chu ban ， mei ge ban ben dou cheng nuo rang du zhe zhao mi]

english: captivating material! Now, can I interest you in buying one for a mere 50 coins?
translation: 令人着迷的材料！现在，您有兴趣花 50 个硬币购买一个吗？ [ling ren zhao mi de cai liao ！ xian zai ， nin you xing qu hua  50  ge ying bi gou mai yi ge ma ？]

english: Anything interesting in there?
translation: 里面有什么有趣的事吗？ [li mian you shen me you qu de shi ma ？]

english: Of course there is, mate. Packed full of thought provoking insights, contentious interviews and celebrity scandalmongering! An excellent read and all for just 50 coins! Want one?
translation: 当然有，伙计。充满了发人深省的见解、有争议的采访和名人丑闻！一本精彩的读物，仅需 50 个硬币！想要一个吗？ [dang ran you ， huo ji 。 chong man le fa ren shen xing de jian jie 、 you zheng yi de cai fang he ming ren chou wen ！ yi ben jing cai de du wu ， jin xu  50  ge ying bi ！ xiang yao yi ge ma ？]

english: Read all about it!
translation: 阅读所有关于它的内容！ [yue du suo you guan yu ta de nei rong ！]

english: Extra! Extra! Read all about it!
translation: 额外的！额外的！阅读所有关于它的内容！ [e wai de ！ e wai de ！ yue du suo you guan yu ta de nei rong ！]

english: Buy your Varrock Herald now!
translation: 立即购买您的 Varrock Herald！ [li ji gou mai nin de  Varrock Herald！]

english: Varrock Herald, now only 50 coins!
translation: Varrock Herald，现在只需 50 个金币！ [Varrock Herald， xian zai zhi xu  50  ge jin bi ！]

english: Get you Varrock Herald here!
translation: 在这里找到你的瓦洛克先驱！ [zai zhe li zhao dao ni de wa luo ke xian qu ！]

english: Varrock Herald, on sale here!
translation: Varrock Herald，这里有售！ [Varrock Herald， zhe li you shou ！]

english: Can I have a newspaper, please?
translation: 请给我一份报纸好吗？ [qing gei wo yi fen bao zhi hao ma ？]

english: Sure, here you go...
translation: 当然，给你... [dang ran ， gei ni ...]

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: How much does a paper cost?
translation: 一张纸要多少钱？ [yi zhang zhi yao duo shao qian ？]

english: Varrock Herald? Never heard of it.
translation: 瓦洛克先驱者？从来没有听说过。 [wa luo ke xian qu zhe ？ cong lai mei you ting shuo guo 。]

english: Anything interesting in there?
translation: 里面有什么有趣的事吗？ [li mian you shen me you qu de shi ma ？]

english: Do you mind? You're in my home.
translation: 你介意吗？你在我家。 [ni jie yi ma ？ ni zai wo jia 。]

english: I'm sorry, should I have knocked?
translation: 对不起，我应该敲门吗？ [dui bu qi ， wo ying gai qiao men ma ？]

english: Very funny, human.
translation: 非常有趣，人类。 [fei chang you qu ， ren lei 。]

english: We can't all live in plush houses, you know. But that doesn't mean us mining dwarves don't work hard.
translation: 你知道，我们不可能都住在豪华的房子里。但这并不意味着我们采矿矮人不努力工作。 [ni zhi dao ， wo men bu ke neng dou zhu zai hao hua de fang zi li 。 dan zhe bing bu yi wei zhe wo men cai kuang ai ren bu nu li gong zuo 。]

english: Where do you do your mining?
translation: 你们在哪里采矿？ [ni men zai na li cai kuang ？]

english: Normally the coal mine to the north. We need a lot of coal to keep our steam engines going, you know.
translation: 一般是北边的煤矿。你知道，我们需要大量煤炭来维持蒸汽机的运转。 [yi ban shi bei bian de mei kuang 。 ni zhi dao ， wo men xu yao da liang mei tan lai wei chi zheng qi ji de yun zhuan 。]

english: Can I do a bit of mining there as well?
translation: 我也可以在那里采矿吗？ [wo ye ke yi zai na li cai kuang ma ？]

english: I'm not sure, but as long as no one notices I don't think anyone is going to care.
translation: 我不确定，但只要没有人注意到，我认为就没有人会在意。 [wo bu que ding ， dan zhi yao mei you ren zhu yi dao ， wo ren wei jiu mei you ren hui zai yi 。]

english: How are your grapes coming along?
translation: 你的葡萄长得怎么样了？ [ni de pu tao zhang de zen me yang le ？]

english: Marvellously, thanks to your help, [player name]!
translation: 太棒了，感谢你的帮助，[玩家姓名]！ [tai bang le ， gan xie ni de bang zhu ，[ wan jia xing ming ]！]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Good day, adventurer. If you have any questions, I'm sure Lars will be more than happy to answer them. He's in the building to the south.
translation: 美好的一天，冒险家。如果您有任何问题，我相信 Lars 会非常乐意回答。他在南边的大楼里。 [mei hao de yi tian ， mao xian jia 。 ru guo nin you ren he wen ti ， wo xiang xin  Lars  hui fei chang le yi hui da 。 ta zai nan bian de da lou li 。]

english: Also don't forget to visit my sister's axe shop. She works in the same building as Lars.
translation: 另外，别忘了参观我姐姐的斧头店。她和拉尔斯在同一栋楼工作。 [ling wai ， bie wang le can guan wo jie jie de fu tou dian 。 ta he la er si zai tong yi dong lou gong zuo 。]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: Welcome to the Woodcutting Guild, adventurer.
translation: 欢迎来到伐木公会，冒险家。 [huan ying lai dao fa mu gong hui ， mao xian jia 。]

english: Bert! Good news!
translation: 伯特！好消息！ [bo te ！ hao xiao xi ！]

english: Arrr...Good news be always handy.
translation: 呃……好消息总是方便的。 [e …… hao xiao xi zong shi fang bian de 。]

english: They arrested Sandy for the murder of a wizard and the sand pit now refills itself!
translation: 他们以谋杀巫师为由逮捕了桑迪，沙坑现在又自动填满了！ [ta men yi mou sha wu shi wei you dai bu le sang di ， sha keng xian zai you zi dong tian man le ！]

english: ME JOB! I'VE LOSTED ME JOB! 'ow c'n yer say tha' be good news?? Me wife'll tear me limb fr'm limb!
translation: 我的工作！我失业了！你能说这是好消息吗？我的妻子会把我撕成碎片！ [wo de gong zuo ！ wo shi ye le ！ ni neng shuo zhe shi hao xiao xi ma ？ wo de qi zi hui ba wo si cheng sui pian ！]

english: Don't worry, the Wizardsare going to pay you a large pension so that you can retire...
translation: 别担心，奇才队会付给你一大笔养老金，这样你就可以退休了…… [bie dan xin ， qi cai dui hui fu gei ni yi da bi yang lao jin ， zhe yang ni jiu ke yi tui xiu le ……]

english: Bu' wha'll I be doin' wit' me day now! I be lovin' tha sand.
translation: 但我今天要做什么呢！我爱上了那沙子。 [dan wo jin tian yao zuo shen me ne ！ wo ai shang le na sha zi 。]

english: What will you do with your day? Well....You could build sand castles with your own two hands!
translation: 你这一天会做什么？嗯......你可以用自己的两只手建造沙堡！ [ni zhe yi tian hui zuo shen me ？ n ...... ni ke yi yong zi ji de liang zhi shou jian zao sha bao ！]

english: I din't think so... bu' iffen yer ever need someone ta haul buckets o'sand 'round, ye be lettin' me know [player name], I's can help yer!
translation: 我不这么认为...但如果你需要有人来运沙子，请让我知道[玩家姓名]，我可以帮助你！ [wo bu zhe me ren wei ... dan ru guo ni xu yao you ren lai yun sha zi ， qing rang wo zhi dao [ wan jia xing ming ]， wo ke yi bang zhu ni ！]

english: Wow! That would be great, buckets of sand direct to bank everdayyou say? That's great!
translation: 哇！那太好了，每天都有一桶沙子直接送到银行，你说？那太棒了！ [wa ！ na tai hao le ， mei tian dou you yi tong sha zi zhi jie song dao yin hang ， ni shuo ？ na tai bang le ！]

english: Once per day you may ask Bert to help you by carrying 84 buckets of sand to your bank. Just talk to him!
translation: 每天一次，您可以请 Bert 帮助您将 84 桶沙子运到您的银行。就跟他说话吧！ [mei tian yi ci ， nin ke yi qing  Bert  bang zhu nin jiang  84  tong sha zi yun dao nin de yin hang 。 jiu gen ta shuo hua ba ！]

english: 'Ello there [player name]!
translation: '你好[玩家姓名]！ [' ni hao [ wan jia xing ming ]！]

english: Can you deliver sand to my bank, please?
translation: 你能把沙子送到我的银行吗？ [ni neng ba sha zi song dao wo de yin hang ma ？]

english: Eeee, ye've go' no free space in yon bank [player name]. Make some room 'tween the fishes 'n boots fore ye come back ta me.
translation: 哎呀，你们银行[玩家名字]已经没有可用空间了。在你回来找我之前，在鱼和靴子之间腾出一些空间。 [ai ya ， ni men yin hang [ wan jia ming zi ] yi jing mei you ke yong kong jian le 。 zai ni hui lai zhao wo zhi qian ， zai yu he xue zi zhi jian teng chu yi xie kong jian 。]

english: Ok, I'll make some more space in my bank and come back!
translation: 好的，我会在银行里腾出一些空间然后回来！ [hao de ， wo hui zai yin hang li teng chu yi xie kong jian ran hou hui lai ！]

english: I'll see you another time.
translation: 我们下次再见。 [wo men xia ci zai jian 。]

english: Can you deliver sand to my bank, please?
translation: 你能把沙子送到我的银行吗？ [ni neng ba sha zi song dao wo de yin hang ma ？]

english: I'll see you another time.
translation: 我们下次再见。 [wo men xia ci zai jian 。]

english: Sorry I'm not into magic.
translation: 抱歉我不喜欢魔法。 [bao qian wo bu xi huan mo fa 。]

english: Well, if you see anyone who is into magic, please send them my way.
translation: 好吧，如果你看到任何喜欢魔法的人，请把他们发给我。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni kan dao ren he xi huan mo fa de ren ， qing ba ta men fa gei wo 。]

english: I heard from Zavistic what a good job you did. If you want some more pink dye, I have made up a batch and you can have some for 20 gold.
translation: 我从扎维斯蒂克那里听说你做得很好。如果你想要更多的粉色染料，我已经配制了一批，你可以花 20 金币买一些。 [wo cong zha wei si di ke na li ting shuo ni zuo de hen hao 。 ru guo ni xiang yao geng duo de fen se ran liao ， wo yi jing pei zhi le yi pi ， ni ke yi hua  20  jin bi mai yi xie 。]

english: Yes please!
translation: 是的，请！ [shi de ， qing ！]

english: You hand over 20 gold pieces in return for the dye
translation: 你交出 20 枚金币来换取染料 [ni jiao chu  20  mei jin bi lai huan qu ran liao]

english: I've come from Yanille, the wizard says you can make Truth Serum?
translation: 我来自雅尼尔，巫师说你可以制作真理血清？ [wo lai zi ya ni er ， wu shi shuo ni ke yi zhi zuo zhen li xue qing ？]

english: This is true deary, I'll need an empty vial.
translation: 这是真的，亲爱的，我需要一个空瓶子。 [zhe shi zhen de ， qin ai de ， wo xu yao yi ge kong ping zi 。]

english: I have one here!
translation: 我这里有一个！ [wo zhe li you yi ge ！]

english: That's good, now you'll need to make a rose tinted lens. Pink dye can be made from red berries in this bottle to make redberry juice, then add white berries. Just use that on a bullseye lens.
translation: 很好，现在您需要制作玫瑰色镜片。粉红色染料可以用这瓶中的红色浆果制成红浆果汁，然后添加白色浆果。只需在牛眼镜头上使用它即可。 [hen hao ， xian zai nin xu yao zhi zuo mei gui se jing pian 。 fen hong se ran liao ke yi yong zhe ping zhong de hong se jiang guo zhi cheng hong jiang guo zhi ， ran hou tian jia bai se jiang guo 。 zhi xu zai niu yan jing tou shang shi yong ta ji ke 。]

english: Hello deary! Have you managed to make that lens yet?
translation: 你好亲爱的！你已经成功制作出那个镜头了吗？ [ni hao qin ai de ！ ni yi jing cheng gong zhi zuo chu na ge jing tou le ma ？]

english: I'm still working on it.
translation: 我还在努力。 [wo hai zai nu li 。]

english: I'm afraid I've forgotten how!
translation: 我恐怕已经忘记怎么做了！ [wo kong pa yi jing wang ji zen me zuo le ！]

english: Pink dye can be made from red berries in the bottle I gave you. Add white berries to make the pink dye and then you just need to use that on a bullseye lens. Good luck!
translation: 粉色染料可以用我给你的瓶子里的红色浆果制成。添加白色浆果制成粉红色染料，然后您只需在牛眼透镜上使用它即可。祝你好运！ [fen se ran liao ke yi yong wo gei ni de ping zi li de hong se jiang guo zhi cheng 。 tian jia bai se jiang guo zhi cheng fen hong se ran liao ， ran hou nin zhi xu zai niu yan tou jing shang shi yong ta ji ke 。 zhu ni hao yun ！]

english: Wonderful deary. When you're ready, just stand in the open doorway and focus the light on the empty vial on my desk and I'll pour the serum into it.
translation: 太棒了亲爱的。准备好后，只需站在敞开的门口，将灯光聚焦在我桌子上的空小瓶上，我就会将血清倒入其中。 [tai bang le qin ai de 。 zhun bei hao hou ， zhi xu zhan zai chang kai de men kou ， jiang deng guang ju jiao zai wo zhuo zi shang de kong xiao ping shang ， wo jiu hui jiang xue qing dao ru qi zhong 。]

english: Ok, what does that do?
translation: 好吧，那有什么作用？ [hao ba ， na you shen me zuo yong ？]

english: Why it makes the person who drinks it unable to hide in the shadow of lies. The light of truth will shine!
translation: 为什么喝了它的人无法躲在谎言的阴影下。真理之光必将闪耀！ [wei shen me he le ta de ren wu fa duo zai huang yan de yin ying xia 。 zhen li zhi guang bi jiang shan yao ！]

english: Ok, now the last ingredient, something personal from the person you need to tell the truth, else it won't work!
translation: 好吧，现在是最后一个要素，来自你需要说实话的人的个人信息，否则它不会起作用！ [hao ba ， xian zai shi zui hou yi ge yao su ， lai zi ni xu yao shuo shi hua de ren de ge ren xin xi ， fou ze ta bu hui qi zuo yong ！]

english: What about this sand straight from his pocket?
translation: 直接从他口袋里掏出来的沙子怎么样？ [zhi jie cong ta kou dai li tao chu lai de sha zi zen me yang ？]

english: That's excellent deary!
translation: 太棒了亲爱的！ [tai bang le qin ai de ！]

english: Don't forget to dilute it in something like tea or coffee.
translation: 不要忘记用茶或咖啡之类的东西稀释它。 [bu yao wang ji yong cha huo ka fei zhi lei de dong xi xi shi ta 。]

english: Hello deary! How did the serum work?
translation: 你好亲爱的！血清是如何发挥作用的？ [ni hao qin ai de ！ xue qing shi ru he fa hui zuo yong de ？]

english: I haven't tried it yet.
translation: 我还没试过。 [wo hai mei shi guo 。]

english: Well don't forget to dilute it in a drink or something else bad things might happen.
translation: 好吧，别忘了在饮料中稀释它，否则可能会发生其他不好的事情。 [hao ba ， bie wang le zai yin liao zhong xi shi ta ， fou ze ke neng hui fa sheng qi ta bu hao de shi qing 。]

english: Bad things?
translation: 坏事？ [huai shi ？]

english: Well.... bits might drop off.
translation: 嗯……碎片可能会掉落。 [n …… sui pian ke neng hui diao luo 。]

english: Oh! I... see. I'll remember to dilute it then.
translation: 哦！我懂了。然后我会记得稀释它。 [o ！ wo dong le 。 ran hou wo hui ji de xi shi ta 。]

english: Good job. I have new information to share with you.
translation: 好工作。我有新信息要与您分享。 [hao gong zuo 。 wo you xin xin xi yao yu nin fen xiang 。]

english: Can I see your wares?
translation: 我可以看看你们的商品吗？ [wo ke yi kan kan ni men de shang pin ma ？]

english: Sorry I'm not into magic.
translation: 抱歉我不喜欢魔法。 [bao qian wo bu xi huan mo fa 。]

english: No thanks Betty
translation: 不，谢谢贝蒂 [bu ， xie xie bei di]

english: Yes please!
translation: 是的，请！ [shi de ， qing ！]

english: Talk to Betty about the Hand in the Sand.
translation: 与贝蒂谈论沙中之手。 [yu bei di tan lun sha zhong zhi shou 。]

english: Talk to Betty about her shop.
translation: 与贝蒂谈论她的商店。 [yu bei di tan lun ta de shang dian 。]

english: I'm still working on it.
translation: 我还在努力。 [wo hai zai nu li 。]

english: I'm afraid I've forgotten how!
translation: 我恐怕已经忘记怎么做了！ [wo kong pa yi jing wang ji zen me zuo le ！]

english: Hey kid, what's all the shouting about?
translation: 嘿，孩子，喊什么？ [hei ， hai zi ， han shen me ？]

english: Christmas is ruined!
translation: 圣诞节被毁了！ [sheng dan jie bei hui le ！]

english: Again? What's happened this time?
translation: 再次？这次是怎么回事？ [zai ci ？ zhe ci shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: The man in the shop won't give us our Gingerbread Gnomes, he's keeping them for himself.
translation: 店里的那个人不会给我们姜饼侏儒，他自己留着它们。 [dian li de na ge ren bu hui gei wo men jiang bing zhu ru ， ta zi ji liu zhe ta men 。]

english: That doesn't sound right, are you sure that's really what he's doing?
translation: 这听起来不对，你确定那真的是他在做的吗？ [zhe ting qi lai bu dui ， ni que ding na zhen de shi ta zai zuo de ma ？]

english: Of course he is, why else won't he give us any?
translation: 当然是，不然他为什么不给我们呢？ [dang ran shi ， bu ran ta wei shen me bu gei wo men ne ？]

english: Something seems off, maybe I should go talk to Santa to find out what's happened.
translation: 好像有些不对劲，也许我应该去跟圣诞老人谈谈，看看发生了什么事。 [hao xiang you xie bu dui jin ， ye xu wo ying gai qu gen sheng dan lao ren tan tan ， kan kan fa sheng le shen me shi 。]

english: Do whatever you want, I want my Gingerbread Gnomes!
translation: 做你想做的事，我想要我的姜饼侏儒！ [zuo ni xiang zuo de shi ， wo xiang yao wo de jiang bing zhu ru ！]

english: Where are our Gingerbread Gnomes!
translation: 我们的姜饼侏儒在哪里！ [wo men de jiang bing zhu ru zai na li ！]

english: I'm working on it, I'm working on it.
translation: 我正在努力，我正在努力。 [wo zheng zai nu li ， wo zheng zai nu li 。]

english: Hurry up!
translation: 赶快！ [gan kuai ！]

english: You've ruined Christmas!
translation: 你毁了圣诞节！ [ni hui le sheng dan jie ！]

english: Give us the Gnomes!
translation: 给我们侏儒吧！ [gei wo men zhu ru ba ！]

english: Why are you still here? I saved Christmas, you can go home.
translation: 你怎么还在这里？我救了圣诞节，你可以回家了。 [ni zen me hai zai zhe li ？ wo jiu le sheng dan jie ， ni ke yi hui jia le 。]

english: We still have to wait for the delivery to come in, dummy.
translation: 我们还得等送货上门，傻瓜。 [wo men hai de deng song huo shang men ， sha gua 。]

english: I'll leave you to it then.
translation: 那我就把它留给你了。 [na wo jiu ba ta liu gei ni le 。]

english: Yes please.

english: Do you make these yourself?
translation: 这些是你自己做的吗？ [zhe xie shi ni zi ji zuo de ma ？]

english: Of course, and you won't find anything finer than what I offer. I didn't become the official blacksmith to the Royal Family of Varlamore by producing subpar goods.
translation: 当然，您不会找到比我提供的更好的东西了。我并不是因为生产劣质商品而成为瓦拉莫尔王室的正式铁匠。 [dang ran ， nin bu hui zhao dao bi wo ti gong de geng hao de dong xi le 。 wo bing bu shi yin wei sheng chan lie zhi shang pin er cheng wei wa la mo er wang shi de zheng shi tie jiang 。]

english: You're the official blacksmith? Does that mean you can sell me some armour like the knights around here wear?
translation: 你是正式的铁匠？这是否意味着你可以卖给我一些像这里的骑士所穿的盔甲？ [ni shi zheng shi de tie jiang ？ zhe shi fou yi wei zhe ni ke yi mai gei wo yi xie xiang zhe li de qi shi suo chuan de kui jia ？]

english: Are you a Knight of Varlamore?
translation: 你是瓦拉摩尔的骑士吗？ [ni shi wa la mo er de qi shi ma ？]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Than I cannot. However, I still have plenty of other items that might interest you. Would you like to take a look?
translation: 但我不能。不过，我还有很多其他您可能感兴趣的物品。您想看一下吗？ [dan wo bu neng 。 bu guo ， wo hai you hen duo qi ta nin ke neng gan xing qu de wu pin 。 nin xiang kan yi xia ma ？]

translation: 就这样，祝您生意兴隆！ [jiu zhe yang ， zhu nin sheng yi xing long ！]

english: No thanks.

english: As you wish. You are always welcome to return if you change your mind.
translation: 如你所愿。如果您改变主意，我们随时欢迎您回来。 [ru ni suo yuan 。 ru guo nin gai bian zhu yi ， wo men sui shi huan ying nin hui lai 。]

translation: 修复该物品：[x] 个硬币。 [xiu fu gai wu pin ：[x]  ge ying bi 。]

translation: 取消。 [qu xiao 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: A human? Either buy something or get out!
translation: 人类？要么买东西，要么出去！ [ren lei ？ yao me mai dong xi ， yao me chu qu ！]

english: What do you have?
translation: 你有什么？ [ni you shen me ？]

english: In a blacksmith? What do you think? Weapons!
translation: 在铁匠铺？你怎么认为？武器！ [zai tie jiang pu ？ ni zen me ren wei ？ wu qi ！]

english: I'll get going.
translation: 我要走了。 [wo yao zou le 。]

english: Good.
translation: 好的。 [hao de 。]

translation: 你有什么？ [ni you shen me ？]

english: I'll get going.
translation: 我要走了。 [wo yao zou le 。]

english: Greetin's[player name], fine day today!
translation: Greetin 的[玩家姓名]，今天天气很好！ [Greetin  de [ wan jia xing ming ]， jin tian tian qi hen hao ！]

english: Please leave me alone, I'm busy trapping the pygmy shrews.
translation: 请别打扰我，我正忙着捕捉侏儒鼩鼱。 [qing bie da rao wo ， wo zheng mang zhe bu zhuo zhu ru qu jing 。]

english: Wunnerfulweather we're having today!

translation: 抱歉，我的股票只适合那些信任 Shayzien 的人。 [bao qian ， wo de gu piao zhi shi he na xie xin ren  Shayzien  de ren 。]

english: Looking to buy some armour?
translation: 想买一些盔甲吗？ [xiang mai yi xie kui jia ma ？]

english: Show me what you've got.
translation: 告诉我你有什么。 [gao su wo ni you shen me 。]

english: I'm good thanks.
translation: 我很好谢谢。 [wo hen hao xie xie 。]

english: Show me what you've got.
translation: 告诉我你有什么。 [gao su wo ni you shen me 。]

english: I'm good thanks.
translation: 我很好谢谢。 [wo hen hao xie xie 。]

english: Hello, I wonder if you could help me on this whole brewing thing...
translation: 你好，我想知道你能否帮我解决整个酿造的事情...... [ni hao ， wo xiang zhi dao ni neng fou bang wo jie jue zheng ge niang zao de shi qing ......]

english: I might be able to - what do you need to know?
translation: 我也许可以——你需要知道什么？ [wo ye xu ke yi —— ni xu yao zhi dao shen me ？]

english: How do I brew ales?
translation: 如何酿造艾尔啤酒？ [ru he niang zao ai er pi jiu ？]

english: Well first off you need to fill the vat with water - two bucketfuls should do the trick. Then you'll need to put in two handfuls of barley malt - that's roasted barley by the way.
translation: 首先，你需要在桶里装满水——两桶就可以了。然后你需要放入两把大麦麦芽——顺便说一下，这是烤大麦。 [shou xian ， ni xu yao zai tong li zhuang man shui —— liang tong jiu ke yi le 。 ran hou ni xu yao fang ru liang ba da mai mai ya —— shun bian shuo yi xia ， zhe shi kao da mai 。]

english: After that you'll be putting your main ingredient in - this will decide which ale it is you're brewing. There should be some good guides around with recipes in.
translation: 之后，您将放入主要成分 - 这将决定您正在酿造哪种啤酒。应该有一些很好的指南和食谱。 [zhi hou ， nin jiang fang ru zhu yao cheng fen  -  zhe jiang jue ding nin zheng zai niang zao na zhong pi jiu 。 ying gai you yi xie hen hao de zhi nan he shi pu 。]

english: Lastly you pour a pot full of ale yeast in, which'll start it off fermenting. Then all you have to do is wait for the good stuff.
translation: 最后倒入一锅装满啤酒酵母的锅，这将开始发酵。那么你所要做的就是等待好东西。 [zui hou dao ru yi guo zhuang man pi jiu jiao mu de guo ， zhe jiang kai shi fa jiao 。 na me ni suo yao zuo de jiu shi deng dai hao dong xi 。]

english: How do I brew cider?
translation: 如何酿造苹果酒？ [ru he niang zao ping guo jiu ？]

english: First you'll need some apples. You'll need to crush them using this cider-press - four apples should make a full bucket of apple-mush. Take four buckets of mush and fill up the vat.
translation: 首先你需要一些苹果。你需要用这个苹果压榨机压碎它们——四个苹果就可以制成一桶苹果糊。拿四桶糊状物，装满缸。 [shou xian ni xu yao yi xie ping guo 。 ni xu yao yong zhe ge ping guo ya zha ji ya sui ta men —— si ge ping guo jiu ke yi zhi cheng yi tong ping guo hu 。 na si tong hu zhuang wu ， zhuang man gang 。]

english: After that you pour a pot full of ale yeast in, which'll start it off fermenting. Then all you have to do is wait for the good stuff.
translation: 之后，倒入一锅装满啤酒酵母的锅，它就会开始发酵。那么你所要做的就是等待好东西。 [zhi hou ， dao ru yi guo zhuang man pi jiu jiao mu de guo ， ta jiu hui kai shi fa jiao 。 na me ni suo yao zuo de jiu shi deng dai hao dong xi 。]

english: What do I do once my ale has matured?
translation: 麦芽酒成熟后我该怎么办？ [mai ya jiu cheng shu hou wo gai zen me ban ？]

english: Well, once you've got a full vat of the good stuff, just turn the valve and your barrel will fill up with eight pints of whatever your chosen tipple is. Mind it's an empty barrel, though.
translation: 好吧，一旦您喝完一桶好酒，只需转动阀门，您的酒桶就会装满八品脱，无论您选择什么酒。但请注意，它是一个空桶。 [hao ba ， yi dan nin he wan yi tong hao jiu ， zhi xu zhuan dong fa men ， nin de jiu tong jiu hui zhuang man ba pin tuo ， wu lun nin xuan ze shen me jiu 。 dan qing zhu yi ， ta shi yi ge kong tong 。]

english: Do you have any spare ale yeast?
translation: 你有多余的艾尔酵母吗？ [ni you duo yu de ai er jiao mu ma ？]

english: Well, as a matter of fact I do, although I wouldn't describe it as spare. This ale yeast I've got is the best money can buy, but if you've got a pot I'll fill it for you for 25GP - very cheap as it happens.
translation: 好吧，事实上我确实这么做了，尽管我不会将其描述为备用。我买的这种啤酒酵母是用钱能买到的最好的，但如果你有一个罐子，我会花 25GP 给你装满——碰巧很便宜。 [hao ba ， shi shi shang wo que shi zhe me zuo le ， jin guan wo bu hui jiang qi miao shu wei bei yong 。 wo mai de zhe zhong pi jiu jiao mu shi yong qian neng mai dao de zui hao de ， dan ru guo ni you yi ge guan zi ， wo hui hua  25GP  gei ni zhuang man —— peng qiao hen pian yi 。]

english: I don't have an empty pot, or enough money I'm afraid.
translation: 我没有空罐子，恐怕也没有足够的钱。 [wo mei you kong guan zi ， kong pa ye mei you zu gou de qian 。]

english: I don't have an empty pot I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕我没有空锅。 [kong pa wo mei you kong guo 。]

english: I don't have enough money I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕我没有足够的钱。 [kong pa wo mei you zu gou de qian 。]

english: That's a good deal - please fill my pot with ale yeast for 25GP.
translation: 太划算了——请给我的罐子装满啤酒酵母，只需 25GP。 [tai hua suan le —— qing gei wo de guan zi zhuang man pi jiu jiao mu ， zhi xu  25GP。]

english: No, that's too much I'm afraid.
translation: 不，我担心这太过分了。 [bu ， wo dan xin zhe tai guo fen le 。]

english: That's all I need to know, thanks.
translation: 这就是我需要知道的全部，谢谢。 [zhe jiu shi wo xu yao zhi dao de quan bu ， xie xie 。]
