english: Good day.
translation: 再会。 [zai hui 。]

english: Good day to you [sir/ma'am].
translation: 祝你美好的一天[先生/女士]。 [zhu ni mei hao de yi tian [ xian sheng / nv shi ]。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Ho there! Who are you?
translation: 嗬！你是谁？ [he ！ ni shi shui ？]

english: Only the most famous sculptor in all of Keldagrim.
translation: 只有凯达格林最著名的雕塑家。 [zhi you kai da ge lin zui zhu ming de diao su jia 。]

english: Does Keldagrim have a lot of sculptors then?
translation: 那么凯尔达格林有很多雕塑家吗？ [na me kai er da ge lin you hen duo diao su jia ma ？]

english: Well... I'm the best outside of Keldagrim too, I tell you! Especially here in the north.
translation: 好吧……我告诉你，我也是凯尔达格林之外最好的！尤其是在北方这里。 [hao ba …… wo gao su ni ， wo ye shi kai er da ge lin zhi wai zui hao de ！ you qi shi zai bei fang zhe li 。]

english: Yeah, maybe you should visit the mountain people topside of this mountain some time... all they have is a big lump of stone!
translation: 是啊，也许你应该找个时间去看看这座山上的山民……他们只有一块大石头！ [shi a ， ye xu ni ying gai zhao ge shi jian qu kan kan zhe zuo shan shang de shan min …… ta men zhi you yi kuai da shi tou ！]

english: Ah, the philistines!
translation: 啊，市侩们！ [a ， shi kuai men ！]

english: But I'd rather not go up there, they don't like dwarves much.
translation: 但我不想去那里，他们不太喜欢矮人。 [dan wo bu xiang qu na li ， ta men bu tai xi huan ai ren 。]

english: Oh yes, good point.
translation: 哦，是的，好点。 [o ， shi de ， hao dian 。]

english: Sure, sure, of course.
translation: 当然，当然，当然。 [dang ran ， dang ran ， dang ran 。]

english: Excuse me, are you Blasidar, the famous sculptor?
translation: 请问，您是著名雕塑家 Blasidar 吗？ [qing wen ， nin shi zhu ming diao su jia  Blasidar  ma ？]

english: Why, yes, yes, that I am!
translation: 为什么，是的，是的，我就是！ [wei shen me ， shi de ， shi de ， wo jiu shi ！]

english: Oh, well, I'm [player name]. Veldaban of the Black Guard sent me to you, you see. Said you might need some help with the statue.
translation: 哦，好吧，我是[玩家姓名]。你看，黑卫队的维尔达班派我来找你。说你可能需要一些关于雕像的帮助。 [o ， hao ba ， wo shi [ wan jia xing ming ]。 ni kan ， hei wei dui de wei er da ban pai wo lai zhao ni 。 shuo ni ke neng xu yao yi xie guan yu diao xiang de bang zhu 。]

english: Oh, I don't need an assistant sculptor, really, I can do just fine on my own.
translation: 哦，我不需要助理雕刻师，真的，我一个人就可以做得很好。 [o ， wo bu xu yao zhu li diao ke shi ， zhen de ， wo yi ge ren jiu ke yi zuo de hen hao 。]

english: I'm not a sculptor.
translation: 我不是雕塑家。 [wo bu shi diao su jia 。]

english: And I've also got a model here, you see, to base my statue on.
translation: 你看，我这里还有一个模型，作为我的雕像的基础。 [ni kan ， wo zhe li hai you yi ge mo xing ， zuo wei wo de diao xiang de ji chu 。]

english: I'm not a model!
translation: 我不是模特！ [wo bu shi mo te ！]

english: But come to think of it, I do need some errands run. Yes, quite important errands too.
translation: 但转念一想，我确实需要办点事。是的，还有相当重要的差事。 [dan zhuan nian yi xiang ， wo que shi xu yao ban dian shi 。 shi de ， hai you xiang dang zhong yao de chai shi 。]

english: Yes, you will do just fine.
translation: 是的，你会做得很好。 [shi de ， ni hui zuo de hen hao 。]

english: Ehm, right, okay.
translation: 嗯嗯，对了，好吧。 [n n ， dui le ， hao ba 。]

english: So what did you need doing?
translation: 那么你需要做什么？ [na me ni xu yao zuo shen me ？]

english: Well, see... the Consortium has commisionedme to rebuild the statue exactly the way it was.
translation: 好吧，看……财团委托我按照原来的样子重建雕像。 [hao ba ， kan …… cai tuan wei tuo wo an zhao yuan lai de yang zi chong jian diao xiang 。]

english: But the statue itself has broken into a million pieces... and we dwarves aren't very good painters, you know, so we don't have any paintings of it either.
translation: 但雕像本身已经碎成了一百万块……你知道，我们矮人并不是很好的画家，所以我们也没有任何关于它的画作。 [dan diao xiang ben shen yi jing sui cheng le yi bai wan kuai …… ni zhi dao ， wo men ai ren bing bu shi hen hao de hua jia ， suo yi wo men ye mei you ren he guan yu ta de hua zuo 。]

english: Not a very artistic race, then, are you?
translation: 那么，你不是一个非常有艺术气质的种族，是吗？ [na me ， ni bu shi yi ge fei chang you yi shu qi zhi di zhong zu ， shi ma ？]

english: No, that's not what I said, I said we're not very good painters.
translation: 不，我不是这么说的，我是说我们画得不太好。 [bu ， wo bu shi zhe me shuo de ， wo shi shuo wo men hua de bu tai hao 。]

english: We're excellent with, for example, stone. Oh yes, quite good if I say so myself.
translation: 例如，我们擅长使用石头。哦，是的，如果我自己这么说就很好。 [li ru ， wo men shan chang shi yong shi tou 。 o ， shi de ， ru guo wo zi ji zhe me shuo jiu hen hao 。]

english: But I digress... simply speaking, I need some help with getting some items that I can base the new statue on.
translation: 但我离题了……简单来说，我需要一些帮助来获取一些可以作为新雕像基础的物品。 [dan wo li ti le …… jian dan lai shuo ， wo xu yao yi xie bang zhu lai huo qu yi xie ke yi zuo wei xin diao xiang ji chu de wu pin 。]

english: Will you be able to help me with this, [player name]?
translation: 你能帮我解决这个问题吗，[玩家姓名]？ [ni neng bang wo jie jue zhe ge wen ti ma ，[ wan jia xing ming ]？]

english: No, I can't be bothered.
translation: 不，我不能被打扰。 [bu ， wo bu neng bei da rao 。]

english: How rude is that? I don't think the Black Guard will be very pleased with you!
translation: 这有多粗鲁？我想黑卫不会对你很满意！ [zhe you duo cu lu ？ wo xiang hei wei bu hui dui ni hen man yi ！]

english: Yes, I will do this.
translation: 是的，我会这样做。 [shi de ， wo hui zhe yang zuo 。]

english: Excellent, excellent! Now what I need is the following...
translation: 优秀，优秀！现在我需要的是以下... [you xiu ， you xiu ！ xian zai wo xu yao de shi yi xia ...]

english: I will need a pair of boots, the most exquisite boots you can find. The more they look like the original the better, but I don't think you'll be able to find an exact match.
translation: 我需要一双靴子，你能找到的最精致的靴子。它们看起来越像原版越好，但我不认为你能够找到完全匹配的。 [wo xu yao yi shuang xue zi ， ni neng zhao dao de zui jing zhi de xue zi 。 ta men kan qi lai yue xiang yuan ban yue hao ， dan wo bu ren wei ni neng gou zhao dao wan quan pi pei de 。]

english: For the torso, I need clothes that look like King Alvis' clothes. I'm not sure where you would be able to find that, but I'm sure you'll manage.
translation: 对于躯干，我需要看起来像阿尔维斯国王的衣服的衣服。我不确定你在哪里可以找到它，但我相信你会找到的。 [dui yu qu gan ， wo xu yao kan qi lai xiang a er wei si guo wang de yi fu de yi fu 。 wo bu que ding ni zai na li ke yi zhao dao ta ， dan wo xiang xin ni hui zhao dao de 。]

english: Also, I need a battleaxe. Now this is particularly important. You are in luck, however, as I believe King Alvis' original axe still survives.
translation: 另外，我还需要一把战斧。现在这一点尤为重要。不过，你很幸运，因为我相信阿尔维斯国王原来的斧头仍然存在。 [ling wai ， wo hai xu yao yi ba zhan fu 。 xian zai zhe yi dian you wei zhong yao 。 bu guo ， ni hen xing yun ， yin wei wo xiang xin a er wei si guo wang yuan lai de fu tou reng ran cun zai 。]

english: Right, so I need a pair of boots, a piece of clothing and a battleaxe. Is that all?
translation: 是的，所以我需要一双靴子，一件衣服和一把战斧。这就是全部吗？ [shi de ， suo yi wo xu yao yi shuang xue zi ， yi jian yi fu he yi ba zhan fu 。 zhe jiu shi quan bu ma ？]

english: For now, [player name], for now! I wish you good luck, and hurry back with the items!
translation: 现在，[玩家姓名]，现在！祝你好运，赶快带着物品回来吧！ [xian zai ，[ wan jia xing ming ]， xian zai ！ zhu ni hao yun ， gan kuai dai zhe wu pin hui lai ba ！]

english: But... wait, wait, how am I supposed to find all this?
translation: 但是……等等，等等，我该怎么找到这一切？ [dan shi …… deng deng ， deng deng ， wo gai zen me zhao dao zhe yi qie ？]

english: I don't know! You're supposed to find that out for me!
translation: 我不知道！你应该帮我找出来！ [wo bu zhi dao ！ ni ying gai bang wo zhao chu lai ！]

english: But it's a beautiful city, Keldagrim is, I'm sure you'll see many things while you do these tasks!
translation: 但这是一座美丽的城市，凯尔达格林，我相信您在执行这些任务时会看到很多东西！ [dan zhe shi yi zuo mei li de cheng shi ， kai er da ge lin ， wo xiang xin nin zai zhi xing zhe xie ren wu shi hui kan dao hen duo dong xi ！]

english: How are you getting along with those items, [player name]?
translation: 你对这些物品相处得怎么样，[玩家姓名]？ [ni dui zhe xie wu pin xiang chu de zen me yang ，[ wan jia xing ming ]？]

english: I don't have your boots yet.
translation: 我还没有你的靴子。 [wo hai mei you ni de xue zi 。]

english: What else?
translation: 还有什么？ [hai you shen me ？]

english: I also don't have your clothes yet, I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕我还没有你的衣服。 [kong pa wo hai mei you ni de yi fu 。]

english: And? The battleaxe?
translation: 和？战斧？ [he ？ zhan fu ？]

english: Sorry, no, I'm still looking for it.
translation: 抱歉，没有，我还在寻找。 [bao qian ， mei you ， wo hai zai xun zhao 。]

english: Look a little harder please!
translation: 请再仔细看一点！ [qing zai zi xi kan yi dian ！]

english: The new statue looks beautiful, don't you agree?
translation: 新雕像看起来很漂亮，你不同意吗？ [xin diao xiang kan qi lai hen piao liang ， ni bu tong yi ma ？]

english: Oh yes, quite.
translation: 哦，是的，确实如此。 [o ， shi de ， que shi ru ci 。]

english: My finest piece of work, without a doubt.
translation: 毫无疑问，我最好的作品。 [hao wu yi wen ， wo zui hao de zuo pin 。]

english: Say, I was wondering, did you do the statues down in the mines as well?
translation: 我想知道，你也在矿井里制作了雕像吗？ [wo xiang zhi dao ， ni ye zai kuang jing li zhi zuo le diao xiang ma ？]

english: What, out with the trolls?
translation: 什么，与巨魔一起出去？ [shen me ， yu ju mo yi qi chu qu ？]

english: If only! But no, they've been there for many thousands of years, actually. Been there before dwarven recorded history.
translation: 如果可以的话！但不，实际上它们已经存在了数千年。在矮人有记载的历史之前就已经存在了。 [ru guo ke yi de hua ！ dan bu ， shi ji shang ta men yi jing cun zai le shu qian nian 。 zai ai ren you ji zai de li shi zhi qian jiu yi jing cun zai le 。]

english: No no, I'm sure they weren't there before!
translation: 不不，我确信他们以前不在那里！ [bu bu ， wo que xin ta men yi qian bu zai na li ！]

english: Of course they were, don't be silly!
translation: 当然是，别傻了！ [dang ran shi ， bie sha le ！]

english: Alright... my mistake then.
translation: 好吧...那是我的错误。 [hao ba ... na shi wo de cuo wu 。]

english: No, I can't be bothered.
translation: 不，我不能被打扰。 [bu ， wo bu neng bei da rao 。]

english: Yes, I will do this.
translation: 是的，我会这样做。 [shi de ， wo hui zhe yang zuo 。]

english: You! Get to work!
translation: 你！开始工作吧！ [ni ！ kai shi gong zuo ba ！]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: You are here to help work the blast furnace, aren't you?
translation: 你是来帮忙操作高炉的，不是吗？ [ni shi lai bang mang cao zuo gao lu de ， bu shi ma ？]

english: What's the blast furnace?
translation: 高炉是什么？ [gao lu shi shen me ？]

english: The blast furnace is the pinnacle of dwarven metal- processing! Ore goes in the top and comes out as metal bars almost at once! And it's so efficient it only takes half as much coal to purify it as a regular furnace.
translation: 高炉是矮人金属加工的巅峰！矿石进入顶部，几乎立刻就以金属条的形式出来！而且它的效率非常高，净化它只需要普通熔炉一半的煤炭。 [gao lu shi ai ren jin shu jia gong de dian feng ！ kuang shi jin ru ding bu ， ji hu li ke jiu yi jin shu tiao de xing shi chu lai ！ er qie ta de xiao lv fei chang gao ， jing hua ta zhi xu yao pu tong rong lu yi ban de mei tan 。]

english: But we've got a bit of a labour shortage at the moment, which is why I have to rely on immigrant workers to keep the furnace going. So, are you here to start work?
translation: 但目前我们的劳动力有点短缺，这就是为什么我必须依靠移民工人来维持熔炉的运转。那么，你是来开始工作的吗？ [dan mu qian wo men de lao dong li you dian duan que ， zhe jiu shi wei shen me wo bi xu yi kao yi min gong ren lai wei chi rong lu de yun zhuan 。 na me ， ni shi lai kai shi gong zuo de ma ？]

english: How can I help work the blast furnace?
translation: 我如何帮助操作高炉？ [wo ru he bang zhu cao zuo gao lu ？]

english: The blast furnace will only work if there is a group of people keeping it going. Let me explain...
translation: 只有有一群人维持高炉运转，高炉才能运转。让我解释一下... [zhi you you yi qun ren wei chi gao lu yun zhuan ， gao lu cai neng yun zhuan 。 rang wo jie shi yi xia ...]

english: Firstly, the stove needs to be kept filled with coal. If this runs out the furnace will not work.
translation: 首先，炉子需要保持充满煤。如果耗尽，炉子将无法工作。 [shou xian ， lu zi xu yao bao chi chong man mei 。 ru guo hao jin ， lu zi jiang wu fa gong zuo 。]

english: Secondly, someone needs to operate the pump that keeps the hot air blast circulating through the furnace.
translation: 其次，需要有人操作泵来保持热风在炉子中循环。 [qi ci ， xu yao you ren cao zuo beng lai bao chi re feng zai lu zi zhong xun huan 。]

english: Thirdly, someone needs to keep an eye on the temperature gauge. They should tell the pumper to start or stop so that the temperature stays in the right range.
translation: 第三，需要有人留意温度计。他们应该告诉泵机启动或停止，以便温度保持在正确的范围内。 [di san ， xu yao you ren liu yi wen du ji 。 ta men ying gai gao su beng ji qi dong huo ting zhi ， yi bian wen du bao chi zai zheng que de fan wei nei 。]

english: Lastly, someone needs to be on the pedals to power the conveyor belt that puts ore into the furnace.
translation: 最后，需要有人踩踏板来为将矿石放入熔炉的传送带提供动力。 [zui hou ， xu yao you ren cai ta ban lai wei jiang kuang shi fang ru rong lu de chuan song dai ti gong dong li 。]

english: Someone will also need to be on standby with a hammer in case the machine breaks!
translation: 还需要有人拿着锤子待命，以防机器坏掉！ [hai xu yao you ren na zhe chui zi dai ming ， yi fang ji qi huai diao ！]

english: While that's going, anyone else can put their ore on the conveyor belt to have it smelted.
translation: 在此过程中，其他任何人都可以将矿石放在传送带上进行熔炼。 [zai ci guo cheng zhong ， qi ta ren he ren dou ke yi jiang kuang shi fang zai chuan song dai shang jin xing rong lian 。]

english: So what do I get out of it?
translation: 那么我能从中得到什么呢？ [na me wo neng cong zhong de dao shen me ne ？]

english: Keeping the furnace going is valuable experience in itself!
translation: 保持熔炉运转本身就是宝贵的经验！ [bao chi rong lu yun zhuan ben shen jiu shi bao gui de jing yan ！]

english: Keeping the stove alight will train your Firemaking, working the pump will train your Strength, pedalling the conveyor belt will train your Agility and repairing the furnace will train Crafting.
translation: 保持炉子点燃将训练你的生火，操作泵将训练你的力量，踩踏传送带将训练你的敏捷性，修理炉子将训练你的制作。 [bao chi lu zi dian ran jiang xun lian ni de sheng huo ， cao zuo beng jiang xun lian ni de li liang ， cai ta chuan song dai jiang xun lian ni de min jie xing ， xiu li lu zi jiang xun lian ni de zhi zuo 。]

english: Plus, everyone working the furnace will get a bit of experience in Smithing whenever anyone smelts ore in it.
translation: 另外，每当有人在熔炉中冶炼矿石时，每个在熔炉中工作的人都会获得一些锻造经验。 [ling wai ， mei dang you ren zai rong lu zhong ye lian kuang shi shi ， mei ge zai rong lu zhong gong zuo de ren du hui huo de yi xie duan zao jing yan 。]

english: So I don't actually get paid then?
translation: 那么我实际上并没有得到报酬吗？ [na me wo shi ji shang bing mei you de dao bao chou ma ？]

english: I offer you the privilege of working on the greatest example of dwarven engineering and you want to be PAID?
translation: 我向您提供参与矮人工程最伟大范例的荣幸，您想获得报酬吗？ [wo xiang nin ti gong can yu ai ren gong cheng zui wei da fan li de rong xing ， nin xiang huo de bao chou ma ？]

english: If you co-operate with a group of people you can all get your smelting done pretty quickly. Or perhaps some humans who need to do some smelting will pay you, since you humans are all so obsessed with money.
translation: 如果你和一群人合作，你们都可以很快地完成冶炼。或者也许一些需要进行冶炼的人类会付钱给你，因为你们人类都对金钱如此着迷。 [ru guo ni he yi qun ren he zuo ， ni men dou ke yi hen kuai di wan cheng ye lian 。 huo zhe ye xu yi xie xu yao jin xing ye lian de ren lei hui fu qian gei ni ， yin wei ni men ren lei dou dui jin qian ru ci zhao mi 。]

english: No wonder you have a labour shortage if you don't pay your workers!
translation: 如果你不支付工人工资，难怪你会出现劳动力短缺！ [ru guo ni bu zhi fu gong ren gong zi ， nan guai ni hui chu xian lao dong li duan que ！]

english: What would be the point of making money if I gave it all away to menial workers?
translation: 如果我把所有的钱都送给卑微的工人，那赚钱还有什么意义呢？ [ru guo wo ba suo you de qian dou song gei bei wei de gong ren ， na zhuan qian hai you shen me yi yi ne ？]

english: I mean... Money isn't important! What about the greater glory of dwarven engineering? What about the satisfaction of helping others? What about the XP?
translation: 我的意思是……钱不重要！矮人工程学的更大荣耀又如何呢？帮助别人的满足感又如何呢？那XP呢？ [wo de yi si shi …… qian bu zhong yao ！ ai ren gong cheng xue de geng da rong yao you ru he ne ？ bang zhu bie ren de man zu gan you ru he ne ？ na XP ne ？]

english: Okay, I'll get to work.
translation: 好的，我去工作了。 [hao de ， wo qu gong zuo le 。]

english: Splendid!
translation: 灿烂！ [can lan ！]

english: Can I use the furnace to smelt ore?
translation: 我可以用熔炉来冶炼矿石吗？ [wo ke yi yong rong lu lai ye lian kuang shi ma ？]

english: You can, although you'll need to find some people to work it for you as well. But the furnace is very delicate so I charge a fee for anyone who doesn't have level 60 smithing.
translation: 您可以，尽管您也需要找到一些人来为您工作。但是熔炉非常精密，所以我对没有60级锻造的人收取费用。 [nin ke yi ， jin guan nin ye xu yao zhao dao yi xie ren lai wei nin gong zuo 。 dan shi rong lu fei chang jing mi ， suo yi wo dui mei you 60 ji duan zao de ren shou qu fei yong 。]

english: I have level 60!
translation: 我已经60级了！ [wo yi jing 60 ji le ！]

english: A human has level 60 smithing? How extraordinary!
translation: 人类锻造60级？多么非凡啊！ [ren lei duan zao 60 ji ？ duo me fei fan a ！]

english: Feel free to use the furnace. Remember, you only need half as much coal as with a regular furnace.
translation: 请随意使用炉子。请记住，您只需要普通炉子一半的煤炭。 [qing sui yi shi yong lu zi 。 qing ji zhu ， nin zhi xu yao pu tong lu zi yi ban de mei tan 。]

english: I don't have level 60.
translation: 我还没有60级 [wo hai mei you 60 ji]

english: Hmm, well, I'll let you use the furnace if you want, but you must pay a fee of 2,500 coins.
translation: 嗯，好吧，如果你愿意的话我就让你使用熔炉，但是你必须支付2500金币的费用。 [n ， hao ba ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua wo jiu rang ni shi yong rong lu ， dan shi ni bi xu zhi fu 2500 jin bi de fei yong 。]

english: Okay, here you are.
translation: 好的，给你。 [hao de ， gei ni 。]

english: Where?
translation: 在哪里？ [zai na li ？]

english: Actually I don't have enough money on me.
translation: 其实我身上的钱还不够。 [qi shi wo shen shang de qian hai bu gou 。]

english: Well go get it then.
translation: 那就去拿吧。 [na jiu qu na ba 。]

english: Okay, you can use the furnace for ten minutes. Remember, you only need half as much coal as with a regular furnace.
translation: 好的，你可以用炉子十分钟。请记住，您只需要普通炉子一半的煤炭。 [hao de ， ni ke yi yong lu zi shi fen zhong 。 qing ji zhu ， nin zhi xu yao pu tong lu zi yi ban de mei tan 。]

english: How about I give you 1250 coins and I work extra hard?
translation: 我给你1250金币，我加倍努力怎么样？ [wo gei ni 1250 jin bi ， wo jia bei nu li zen me yang ？]

english: You'll have to work hard enough for two humans if I agree...
translation: 如果我同意的话，你就必须为了两个人而努力工作...... [ru guo wo tong yi de hua ， ni jiu bi xu wei le liang ge ren er nu li gong zuo ......]

english: Oh, three humans, easily!
translation: 哦，三个人，很容易！ [o ， san ge ren ， hen rong yi ！]

english: Well, okay then - 1250GP it is.
translation: 好吧，那么 - 1250GP。 [hao ba ， na me  - 1250GP。]

english: Well why did you try and haggle with me then? You'd better go and get some - you're not using the blast furnace for free.
translation: 那你为什么要跟我讨价还价呢？你最好去买一些——你不是免费使用高炉的。 [na ni wei shen me yao gen wo tao jia huan jia ne ？ ni zui hao qu mai yi xie —— ni bu shi mian fei shi yong gao lu de 。]

english: Okay, you can use the furnace for ten minutes. Remember, you only need half as much coal as with a regular furnace. And I want to see you doing the work of four humans!
translation: 好的，你可以用炉子十分钟。请记住，您只需要普通炉子一半的煤炭。我希望看到你完成四个人的工作！ [hao de ， ni ke yi yong lu zi shi fen zhong 。 qing ji zhu ， nin zhi xu yao pu tong lu zi yi ban de mei tan 。 wo xi wang kan dao ni wan cheng si ge ren de gong zuo ！]

english: Maybe some other time.
translation: 也许其他时间。 [ye xu qi ta shi jian 。]

english: Well if you're not here to work, go hang around somewhere else!
translation: 好吧，如果你不在这里工作，那就去别的地方闲逛吧！ [hao ba ， ru guo ni bu zai zhe li gong zuo ， na jiu qu bie de di fang xian guang ba ！]

english: I need to borrow your blast furnace.
translation: 我需要借用你的高炉。 [wo xu yao jie yong ni de gao lu 。]

english: You can have it a couple of hours for 170,000 coins.
translation: 花费 170,000 个金币就可以使用几个小时。 [hua fei  170,000  ge jin bi jiu ke yi shi yong ji ge xiao shi 。]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: I'm trying to create an ingot of chromium, and I need your blast furnace to do so.
translation: 我正在尝试制造铬锭，我需要你们的高炉来做到这一点。 [wo zheng zai chang shi zhi zao ge ding ， wo xu yao ni men de gao lu lai zuo dao zhe yi dian 。]

english: You have knowledge of how to make chromium?!
translation: 您知道如何制造铬吗？！ [nin zhi dao ru he zhi zao ge ma ？！]

english: Well, I'm pretty sure it involves a blast furnace...
translation: 嗯，我很确定它涉及高炉...... [n ， wo hen que ding ta she ji gao lu ......]

english: I'm not going to close my shop for someone who is 'pretty sure'. Come back when you have a better idea.
translation: 我不会为“非常确定”的人关闭我的商店。当你有更好的主意时再回来。 [wo bu hui wei “ fei chang que ding ” de ren guan bi wo de shang dian 。 dang ni you geng hao de zhu yi shi zai hui lai 。]

english: You need level 85 smithing to make a Chromium ingot.
translation: 您需要达到 85 级锻造才能制作铬锭。 [nin xu yao da dao  85  ji duan zao cai neng zhi zuo ge ding 。]

english: I had to get sloshed to figure it out, but yes.
translation: 我必须喝得酩酊大醉才能弄清楚，但是是的。 [wo bi xu he de ming ding da zui cai neng nong qing chu ， dan shi shi de 。]

english: That makes perfect sense. Okay then, you can have the furnace, but it's going to cost you.
translation: 这是完全有道理的。好吧，你可以拥有熔炉，但它会花费你。 [zhe shi wan quan you dao li de 。 hao ba ， ni ke yi yong you rong lu ， dan ta hui hua fei ni 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: Good enough for me. You can have the furnace but it's going to cost you.
translation: 对我来说足够好了。你可以拥有熔炉，但要花钱。 [dui wo lai shuo zu gou hao le 。 ni ke yi yong you rong lu ， dan yao hua qian 。]

english: Okay, I'll need a couple of hours for each chromium ingot. How much is that going to cost me?
translation: 好的，每个铬锭我需要几个小时。我要花多少钱？ [hao de ， mei ge ge ding wo xu yao ji ge xiao shi 。 wo yao hua duo shao qian ？]

english: Let's see. Cost of labour... Opportunity cost... Carry the four...
translation: 让我们来看看。劳动力成本...机会成本...承担四个... [rang wo men lai kan kan 。 lao dong li cheng ben ... ji hui cheng ben ... cheng dan si ge ...]

english: I don't have that much money on me.
translation: 我身上没有那么多钱。 [wo shen shang mei you na me duo qian 。]

english: Come back when you do.
translation: 当你回来的时候就回来吧。 [dang ni hui lai de shi hou jiu hui lai ba 。]

english: I have the money right here.
translation: 我这里有钱。 [wo zhe li you qian 。]

english: I'll go get everything ready for you.
translation: 我去给你准备好一切。 [wo qu gei ni zhun bei hao yi qie 。]

english: You pump air into the furnace, regulating the speed as you spot the silvery sheen.
translation: 你将空气泵入熔炉，当你发现银色光泽时调节速度。 [ni jiang kong qi beng ru rong lu ， dang ni fa xian yin se guang ze shi diao jie su du 。]

english: That's a bit too pricey for me.
translation: 这对我来说有点太贵了。 [zhe dui wo lai shuo you dian tai gui le 。]

english: Come back if you change your mind.
translation: 如果你改变主意就回来吧。 [ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi jiu hui lai ba 。]

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。 [hao de 。]

english: You are an experienced smith, you may use the furnace free of charge!

translation: 好吧，这既是巫术又是暴雪。你真是个调酒师。 [hao ba ， zhe ji shi wu shu you shi bao xue 。 ni zhen shi ge diao jiu shi 。]

english: Okay, let's test you once more. Make me a SGG, then we'll see if you have what it takes.
translation: 好吧，我们再考考你一次。让我成为一名 SGG，然后我们看看你是否有能力。 [hao ba ， wo men zai kao kao ni yi ci 。 rang wo cheng wei yi ming  SGG， ran hou wo men kan kan ni shi fou you neng li 。]

english: A what?
translation: 一个什么？ [yi ge shen me ？]

english: A Short Green Guy, and don't bring me a gnome. Here's all you need.
translation: 一个矮个子绿家伙，别给我带来侏儒。这就是您所需要的一切。 [yi ge ai ge zi lv jia huo ， bie gei wo dai lai zhu ru 。 zhe jiu shi nin suo xu yao de yi qie 。]

english: Ok, I'll try my best.
translation: 好的，我会尽力的。 [hao de ， wo hui jin li de 。]

english: I'm sure you'll make a great barman.
translation: 我相信你会成为一名出色的调酒师。 [wo xiang xin ni hui cheng wei yi ming chu se de diao jiu shi 。]

english: Hi Blurberry.
translation: 嗨，蓝莓。 [hai ， lan mei 。]

english: So, have you got my Short Green Guy?
translation: 那么，你收到我的绿矮子了吗？ [na me ， ni shou dao wo de lv ai zi le ma ？]

english: No, I need you to make the SGG yourself. I'm afraid it doesn't really work if you try to sell the bar its own drinks.
translation: 不，我需要你自己制作 SGG。恐怕如果你试图向酒吧出售自己的饮料，那真的行不通。 [bu ， wo xu yao ni zi ji zhi zuo  SGG。 kong pa ru guo ni shi tu xiang jiu ba chu shou zi ji de yin liao ， na zhen de xing bu tong 。]

english: You give Blurberry the SGG. He takes a sip...
translation: You give Blurberry the SGG.他喝了一口…… [You give Blurberry the SGG. ta he le yi kou ……]

english: Ooh, that's a frisky little number. Very tart, how it should be. Excellent. Well I'm happy to recommend you to the Giannes. You truly are a gnomish bartender now..
translation: 哦，这是一个活泼的小数字。很酸，应该怎样。出色的。嗯，我很高兴向 Giannes 推荐您。你现在真的是一个侏儒调酒师了.. [o ， zhe shi yi ge huo po de xiao shu zi 。 hen suan ， ying gai zen yang 。 chu se de 。 n ， wo hen gao xing xiang  Giannes  tui jian nin 。 ni xian zai zhen de shi yi ge zhu ru diao jiu shi le ..]

english: Well your training is over [player name]. Are you interested in some work?
translation: 好了，你的训练已经结束了[玩家姓名]。你对某些工作感兴趣吗？ [hao le ， ni de xun lian yi jing jie shu le [ wan jia xing ming ]。 ni dui mou xie gong zuo gan xing qu ma ？]

english: I may be...
translation: 我可能是... [wo ke neng shi ...]

translation: 我想你已经准备好为 Aluft Gianne Jnr 做一些工作了。他负责一家新的家族企业：Gnome Food Delivery。如果你制作和运送侏儒食物，有一些很好的建议 - 尽管你可能会这样做 [wo xiang ni yi jing zhun bei hao wei  Aluft Gianne Jnr  zuo yi xie gong zuo le 。 ta fu ze yi jia xin de jia zu qi ye ：Gnome Food Delivery。 ru guo ni zhi zuo he yun song zhu ru shi wu ， you yi xie hen hao de jian yi  -  jin guan ni ke neng hui zhe yang zuo]

english: have to travel all over Gielinor to fulfil some of the other orders...
translation: 必须走遍吉林诺才能完成其他一些订单...... [bi xu zou bian ji lin nuo cai neng wan cheng qi ta yi xie ding dan ......]

english: However, you'll need some basic gnome cooking training if you want to work for Lufty. Go and have a chat with his Dad, Aluft Gianne Snr. Hel'll tell you what you need to do.
translation: 然而，如果你想为 Lufty 工作，你将需要一些基本的侏儒烹饪培训。去和他的父亲 Aluft Gianne Snr 聊聊。他会告诉你你需要做什么。 [ran er ， ru guo ni xiang wei  Lufty  gong zuo ， ni jiang xu yao yi xie ji ben de zhu ru peng ren pei xun 。 qu he ta de fu qin  Aluft Gianne Snr  liao liao 。 ta hui gao su ni ni xu yao zuo shen me 。]

english: Thanks for your help!
translation: 感谢您的帮助！ [gan xie nin de bang zhu ！]

english: Aluft Gianne Snr. tells me that you have finished training with him, so I think you're ready to do some work for Aluft Gianne Jnr. He is in charge of the new Gnome Food Delivery service. I've heard there are
translation: 老阿鲁夫特·吉安娜告诉我你已经完成了他的训练，所以我认为你已经准备好为 Aluft Gianne Jnr 做一些工作了。他负责新的 Gnome 送餐服务。我听说有 [lao a lu fu te · ji an na gao su wo ni yi jing wan cheng le ta de xun lian ， suo yi wo ren wei ni yi jing zhun bei hao wei  Aluft Gianne Jnr  zuo yi xie gong zuo le 。 ta fu ze xin de  Gnome  song can fu wu 。 wo ting shuo you]

english: good tips to be made if you make and deliver gnome foods - though you may have to travel all over Gielinor to fulfill some of the other orders...
translation: 如果你制作和运送侏儒食物，有一些很好的建议——尽管你可能需要走遍吉林诺才能完成其他一些订单…… [ru guo ni zhi zuo he yun song zhu ru shi wu ， you yi xie hen hao de jian yi —— jin guan ni ke neng xu yao zou bian ji lin nuo cai neng wan cheng qi ta yi xie ding dan ……]

english: Sounds interesting....
translation: 听起来很有趣...... [ting qi lai hen you qu ......]

english: Go and have a chat with my young Lufty Jnr. and he'll fill you in with details.
translation: 去和我年轻的 Lufty Jnr 聊聊吧。他会向你提供详细信息。 [qu he wo nian qing de  Lufty Jnr  liao liao ba 。 ta hui xiang ni ti gong xiang xi xin xi 。]

english: No thanks, I prefer to stay this side of the bar.
translation: 不，谢谢，我更喜欢呆在酒吧的这一边。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo geng xi huan dai zai jiu ba de zhe yi bian 。]

english: Ok then I'll give it a go.
translation: 好吧，那我就试试吧。 [hao ba ， na wo jiu shi shi ba 。]

english: I'm afraid I lost the cocktail shaker you gave to me.
translation: 恐怕我把你给我的鸡尾酒调酒器弄丢了。 [kong pa wo ba ni gei wo de ji wei jiu diao jiu qi nong diu le 。]

english: I've not finished yet.
translation: 我还没说完。 [wo hai mei shuo wan 。]

english: Why do you keep killing boars?
translation: 你为什么老是杀野猪？ [ni wei shen me lao shi sha ye zhu ？]

english: Because they drop bones which I am going to use to train my prayer. The meat is also a nice addition.
translation: 因为它们会掉落骨头，我将用这些骨头来训练我的祈祷。肉也是不错的补充。 [yin wei ta men hui diao luo gu tou ， wo jiang yong zhe xie gu tou lai xun lian wo de qi dao 。 rou ye shi bu cuo de bu chong 。]

english: Wouldn't it be best to go steal cakes for food?
translation: 去偷蛋糕当食物不是更好吗？ [qu tou dan gao dang shi wu bu shi geng hao ma ？]

english: And then go to Wintertodt? I do that every time I make an Iron person account. About time I try something new.
translation: 然后去温特托特？我每次创建 Iron person 帐户时都会这样做。是时候我尝试一些新的东西了。 [ran hou qu wen te tuo te ？ wo mei ci chuang jian  Iron person  zhang hu shi du hui zhe yang zuo 。 shi shi hou wo chang shi yi xie xin de dong xi le 。]

english: Are you at least killing the boars on task?
translation: 你至少在任务中杀死野猪吗？ [ni zhi shao zai ren wu zhong sha si ye zhu ma ？]

english: No, maybe I should go get a slayer task now you mention it. Thanks for the reminder.
translation: 不，既然你提到了，也许我应该去接受一个杀手任务。谢谢你的提醒。 [bu ， ji ran ni ti dao le ， ye xu wo ying gai qu jie shou yi ge sha shou ren wu 。 xie xie ni de ti xing 。]

english: You can only trade with people in your group.
translation: 您只能与您所在团队中的人进行交易。 [nin zhi neng yu nin suo zai tuan dui zhong de ren jin xing jiao yi 。]

english: Give me a quest!
translation: 给我一个任务！ [gei wo yi ge ren wu ！]

english: Get yer own!
translation: 得到你自己的！ [de dao ni zi ji de ！]

english: Have you anything to sell?
translation: 你有东西要卖吗？ [ni you dong xi yao mai ma ？]

english: Yes! I buy and sell axes! Take your pick (or axe)!
translation: 是的！我买卖斧子！拿起你的镐（或斧头）！ [shi de ！ wo mai mai fu zi ！ na qi ni de gao （ huo fu tou ）！]

english: Can you repair my items for me?
translation: 你能为我修理我的物品吗？ [ni neng wei wo xiu li wo de wu pin ma ？]

english: Of course I'll repair it, though the materials may cost you. Just hand me the item and I'll have a look.
translation: 我当然会修理它，尽管材料可能会花费你。只要把东西递给我，我就看一下。 [wo dang ran hui xiu li ta ， jin guan cai liao ke neng hui hua fei ni 。 zhi yao ba dong xi di gei wo ， wo jiu kan yi xia 。]

english: You don't have anything I can repair.
translation: 你没有什么我可以修复的。 [ni mei you shen me wo ke yi xiu fu de 。]

english: There you go, happy doing business with you!
translation: 就这样，祝您生意兴隆！ [jiu zhe yang ， zhu nin sheng yi xing long ！]

english: Sorry friend, but I can't do anything with that.
translation: 对不起，朋友，但我对此无能为力。 [dui bu qi ， peng you ， dan wo dui ci wu neng wei li 。]

english: Give me a quest!
translation: 给我一个任务！ [gei wo yi ge ren wu ！]

english: Have you anything to sell?
translation: 你有东西要卖吗？ [ni you dong xi yao mai ma ？]

english: Can you repair my items for me?
translation: 你能为我修理我的物品吗？ [ni neng wei wo xiu li wo de wu pin ma ？]

english: Repair that item: [x] coins.
translation: 修复该物品：[x] 个硬币。 [xiu fu gai wu pin ：[x]  ge ying bi 。]

english: Cancel.
translation: 取消。 [qu xiao 。]

english: Miaoww
translation: 喵呜 [miao wu]

english: Erm, hello? Can you understand me?
translation: 呃，你好？你能理解我吗？ [e ， ni hao ？ ni neng li jie wo ma ？]

english: I certainly can, I am wearing this amulet I got in Sophanem!
translation: 我当然可以，我戴着这个在Sophanem得到的护身符！ [wo dang ran ke yi ， wo dai zhe zhe ge zai Sophanem de dao de hu shen fu ！]

english: Ah so you've met one of the local felines, wise and confusing , those Sphinges.
translation: 啊，原来你遇到了当地的一种猫科动物，聪明又令人困惑，那些狮身人面像。 [a ， yuan lai ni yu dao le dang di de yi zhong mao ke dong wu ， cong ming you ling ren kun huo ， na xie shi shen ren mian xiang 。]

english: Wow!!! You know the plural of Sphinx!!! What else do you know?
translation: 哇！！！你知道狮身人面像的复数！你还知道什么？ [wa ！！！ ni zhi dao shi shen ren mian xiang de fu shu ！ ni hai zhi dao shen me ？]

english: All sorts of stuff! I pick up no end of comments on my travels, want to hear one?
translation: 各种各样的东西！我收到了无数关于我的旅行的评论，想听听吗？ [ge zhong ge yang de dong xi ！ wo shou dao le wu shu guan yu wo de lv xing de ping lun ， xiang ting ting ma ？]

english: I certainly do. Share your wisdom, Bob!
translation: 我当然知道。分享你的智慧，鲍勃！ [wo dang ran zhi dao 。 fen xiang ni de zhi hui ， bao bo ！]

english: Hi, my name is Bob.
translation: 嗨，我叫鲍勃。 [hai ， wo jiao bao bo 。]

english: Hello Bob!
translation: 你好鲍勃！ [ni hao bao bo ！]

english: Do you two know each other?
translation: 你们两个认识吗？ [ni men liang ge ren shi ma ？]

english: I don't think so...
translation: 我不这么认为... [wo bu zhe me ren wei ...]

english: Yes you do. Dive deep, search your feelings.
translation: 是的，你知道。深入挖掘，寻找你的感受。 [shi de ， ni zhi dao 。 shen ru wa jue ， xun zhao ni de gan shou 。]

english: OK, I will try.
translation: 好的，我会尝试的。 [hao de ， wo hui chang shi de 。]

english: What's up puss?
translation: 猫怎么了？ [mao zen me le ？]

english: If only you knew the power of Bob. Your master never told you who your real father was, did he?
translation: 如果你知道鲍勃的力量就好了。你的主人从来没有告诉过你你的亲生父亲是谁吧？ [ru guo ni zhi dao bao bo de li liang jiu hao le 。 ni de zhu ren cong lai mei you gao su guo ni ni de qin sheng fu qin shi shui ba ？]

english: No, but what's that got to do with... no, nooooooo! It cannot be!!
translation: 不，但这有什么关系……不，不！不可能！ [bu ， dan zhe you shen me guan xi …… bu ， bu ！ bu ke neng ！]

english: Yes. I am your father!
translation: 是的。我是你的父亲！ [shi de 。 wo shi ni de fu qin ！]

english: That's impossible!!
translation: 那是不可能的！！ [na shi bu ke neng de ！！]

english: You can destroy Zamorak. He has foreseen this. It is your destiny. Join me, and together we can rule this place as father and son.
translation: 你可以摧毁萨莫拉克。他已经预见到了这一点。这是你的命运。加入我，我们可以作为父子共同统治这个地方。 [ni ke yi cui hui sa mo la ke 。 ta yi jing yu jian dao le zhe yi dian 。 zhe shi ni de ming yun 。 jia ru wo ， wo men ke yi zuo wei fu zi gong tong tong zhi zhe ge di fang 。]

english: OK dad, maybe later, you're scaring me!
translation: 好吧，爸爸，也许稍后，你吓到我了！ [hao ba ， ba ba ， ye xu shao hou ， ni xia dao wo le ！]

english: I think that's about enough of that. I'm off.
translation: 我想这已经足够了。我走了。 [wo xiang zhe yi jing zu gou le 。 wo zou le 。]

english: [player name], why do you keep your cat in the bank?
translation: [玩家姓名]，你为什么把你的猫放在银行里？ [[ wan jia xing ming ]， ni wei shen me ba ni de mao fang zai yin hang li ？]

english: I thought it was too dangerous to bring it out with me.
translation: 我觉得带它出去太危险了。 [wo jue de dai ta chu qu tai wei xian le 。]

english: Or, I could let the poor thing get butchered! Is that what you want?
translation: 或者，我可以让这个可怜的东西被屠杀！这就是你想要的吗？ [huo zhe ， wo ke yi rang zhe ge ke lian de dong xi bei tu sha ！ zhe jiu shi ni xiang yao de ma ？]

english: Butchered!!! I think not. Cats are easily as tough as sheep. Cats were the second thing Guthix brought here, after sheep of course.
translation: 宰了！！！我认为不是。猫很容易像羊一样坚强。当然，继羊之后，猫是古蒂克斯带到这里的第二样东西。 [zai le ！！！ wo ren wei bu shi 。 mao hen rong yi xiang yang yi yang jian qiang 。 dang ran ， ji yang zhi hou ， mao shi gu di ke si dai dao zhe li de di er yang dong xi 。]

english: Weird. I thought Gnomes and the Dwarves were the first ones. Oh well back to school for me.
translation: 诡异的。我以为侏儒和矮人是最早的。哦，好吧，回到学校吧。 [gui yi de 。 wo yi wei zhu ru he ai ren shi zui zao de 。 o ， hao ba ， hui dao xue xiao ba 。]

english: Do you like all the monsters around here?
translation: 你喜欢这里的所有怪物吗？ [ni xi huan zhe li de suo you guai wu ma ？]

english: No, not really. I'm actually signed up with all those HAM fanatics. Kill the whole lot of 'em!!
translation: 不，不是真的。我实际上已经加入了所有火腿狂热者的行列。把他们全部杀掉！！ [bu ， bu shi zhen de 。 wo shi ji shang yi jing jia ru le suo you huo tui kuang re zhe de hang lie 。 ba ta men quan bu sha diao ！！]

english: That's a bit cruel isn't it?
translation: 这有点残忍不是吗？ [zhe you dian can ren bu shi ma ？]

english: Yeah, that's one of my best qualities. Just behind sneaky and vicious. Besides, after a few doses of catnip, they all look like mice to me!
translation: 是的，这是我最好的品质之一。只是背后鬼鬼祟祟、恶毒。而且，在喝了几剂猫薄荷之后，它们在我看来都像老鼠了！ [shi de ， zhe shi wo zui hao de pin zhi zhi yi 。 zhi shi bei hou gui gui sui sui 、 e du 。 er qie ， zai he le ji ji mao bo he zhi hou ， ta men zai wo kan lai dou xiang lao shu le ！]

english: Hey Bob. Got any wisdom to share?
translation: 嘿鲍勃。有什么智慧可以分享吗？ [hei bao bo 。 you shen me zhi hui ke yi fen xiang ma ？]

english: If a player falls down in a forest and nobody is there, do they make any noise?
translation: 如果一个玩家在森林里摔倒，而那里没有人，他们会发出声音吗？ [ru guo yi ge wan jia zai sen lin li shuai dao ， er na li mei you ren ， ta men hui fa chu sheng yin ma ？]

english: Sorry, I am far too busy marking my territory.
translation: 抱歉，我正忙着标记我的领地。 [bao qian ， wo zheng mang zhe biao ji wo de ling di 。]

english: Your territory? This place is ruled by the Grand Highmage Gower and his minions.
translation: 你的领地？这个地方由大法师高尔和他的爪牙统治。 [ni de ling di ？ zhe ge di fang you da fa shi gao er he ta de zhao ya tong zhi 。]

english: I think not. They are my minions, and I let him think that he's in charge. I'm the real power behind the throne.
translation: 我认为不是。他们是我的爪牙，我让他认为他是负责人。我才是王座背后的真正力量。 [wo ren wei bu shi 。 ta men shi wo de zhao ya ， wo rang ta ren wei ta shi fu ze ren 。 wo cai shi wang zuo bei hou de zhen zheng li liang 。]

english: I knew it!!
translation: 我就知道！！ [wo jiu zhi dao ！！]

english: Yeah, it keeps them happy that way, but don't tell anyone!
translation: 是的，这样可以让他们开心，但不要告诉任何人！ [shi de ， zhe yang ke yi rang ta men kai xin ， dan bu yao gao su ren he ren ！]

english: Hee hee. OK Bob.
translation: 嘻嘻。好的，鲍勃。 [xi xi 。 hao de ， bao bo 。]

english: Dogs believe they are human. Cats believe they are Guthix!
translation: 狗相信自己是人类。猫相信它们是 Guthix！ [gou xiang xin zi ji shi ren lei 。 mao xiang xin ta men shi  Guthix！]

english: What do you believe, Bob?
translation: 鲍勃，你相信什么？ [bao bo ， ni xiang xin shen me ？]

english: Well, I don't believe much really since I know I am Zar... erm, well, no, I erm, meow?
translation: 好吧，我不太相信，因为我知道我是扎尔……呃，好吧，不，我呃，喵？ [hao ba ， wo bu tai xiang xin ， yin wei wo zhi dao wo shi zha er …… e ， hao ba ， bu ， wo e ， miao ？]

english: Don't get distracted so easily! See, I'm distracting you right now!
translation: 别那么容易分心！看，我现在正在分散你的注意力！ [bie na me rong yi fen xin ！ kan ， wo xian zai zheng zai fen san ni de zhu yi li ！]

english: Sorry, I'm far too busy calculating thermal vectors.
translation: 抱歉，我太忙于计算热矢量了。 [bao qian ， wo tai mang yu ji suan re shi liang le 。]

english: Eh?
Oh, sorry... I meant, erm, meow?
translation: 哦，抱歉...我的意思是，呃，喵？ [o ， bao qian ... wo de yi si shi ， e ， miao ？]

english: Nothing interesting happens.
translation: 没有什么有趣的事情发生。 [mei you shen me you qu de shi qing fa sheng 。]

english: Eh? That's hardly useful.
translation: 呃？那几乎没有什么用处。 [e ？ na ji hu mei you shen me yong chu 。]

english: Ahh, but it is you see. It does all sorts of wonderous things.
translation: 啊，但这是你看到的。它可以做各种奇妙的事情。 [a ， dan zhe shi ni kan dao de 。 ta ke yi zuo ge zhong qi miao de shi qing 。]

english: Like what?
translation: 比如什么？ [bi ru shen me ？]

english: Well, it's more to do with what happens when you hear that being said. You see, something interesting happens somewhere else.
translation: 嗯，这更多的是与当你听到这句话时发生的事情有关。你看，其他地方发生了一些有趣的事情。 [n ， zhe geng duo de shi yu dang ni ting dao zhe ju hua shi fa sheng de shi qing you guan 。 ni kan ， qi ta di fang fa sheng le yi xie you qu de shi qing 。]

english: So what you're saying is that if nothing interesting happens to me, then something interesting is happening for someone else somewhere that IS interesting?
translation: 所以你的意思是，如果我没有发生任何有趣的事情，那么其他人在某个有趣的地方正在发生一些有趣的事情？ [suo yi ni de yi si shi ， ru guo wo mei you fa sheng ren he you qu de shi qing ， na me qi ta ren zai mou ge you qu de di fang zheng zai fa sheng yi xie you qu de shi qing ？]

english: Yes, that's about it.
translation: 是的，就是这样。 [shi de ， jiu shi zhe yang 。]

english: OK... I see.... I think.
translation: 好吧……我明白了……我想。 [hao ba …… wo ming bai le …… wo xiang 。]

english: Cats are rather delicate creatures and they are subject to a good many ailments, but I never heard of one who suffered from insomnia.
translation: 猫是一种比较娇弱的动物，它们会患上很多疾病，但我从未听说过有一只猫患有失眠症。 [mao shi yi zhong bi jiao jiao ruo de dong wu ， ta men hui huan shang hen duo ji bing ， dan wo cong wei ting shuo guo you yi zhi mao huan you shi mian zheng 。]

english: So, you want to know how us cats keep so clean all day?
translation: 那么，你想知道我们的猫是如何保持一整天这么干净的吗？ [na me ， ni xiang zhi dao wo men de mao shi ru he bao chi yi zheng tian zhe me gan jing de ma ？]

english: Must be all that washing you do.
translation: 一定是你所做的所有洗涤。 [yi ding shi ni suo zuo de suo you xi di 。]

english: You would think so wouldn't you. But is being covered in spit really clean?
translation: 你一定会这么想不是吗。但沾满口水真的干净吗？ [ni yi ding hui zhe me xiang bu shi ma 。 dan zhan man kou shui zhen de gan jing ma ？]

english: Eeeww. Gross.
translation: 呃呃呃。总的。 [e e e 。 zong de 。]

english: Anything not nailed down is a cat toy.
translation: 任何没有固定下来的东西都是猫玩具。 [ren he mei you gu ding xia lai de dong xi dou shi mao wan ju 。]

english: If at first you don't succeed, take a short nap.
translation: 如果一开始你没有成功，那就小睡一会儿。 [ru guo yi kai shi ni mei you cheng gong ， na jiu xiao shui yi hui er 。]

english: Yeah, I could tell you something really useful, but then I would have to '1-hit you' to death.
translation: 是的，我可以告诉你一些真正有用的东西，但那样我就必须“一击打死你”。 [shi de ， wo ke yi gao su ni yi xie zhen zheng you yong de dong xi ， dan na yang wo jiu bi xu “ yi ji da si ni ”。]

english: Bob, you couldn't 1-hit a noob.
translation: 鲍勃，你不能一击中菜鸟。 [bao bo ， ni bu neng yi ji zhong cai niao 。]

english: Care to place a wager on that? Sorry, hang on, I've got no pockets. Maybe next time.
translation: 想对此下注吗？抱歉，等一下，我没有口袋。下一次吧。 [xiang dui ci xia zhu ma ？ bao qian ， deng yi xia ， wo mei you kou dai 。 xia yi ci ba 。]

english: I'll be waiting.
translation: 我会等待。 [wo hui deng dai 。]

english: Dogs have owners, cats have staff.
translation: 狗有主人，猫有员工。 [gou you zhu ren ， mao you yuan gong 。]

english: I have studied many philosophers and many cats. The wisdom of cats is infinitely superior.
translation: 我研究过很多哲学家和很多猫。猫的智慧是无限高超的。 [wo yan jiu guo hen duo zhe xue jia he hen duo mao 。 mao de zhi hui shi wu xian gao chao de 。]

english: There are many intelligent species in the universe. They are all owned by cats.
translation: 宇宙中有许多智慧物种。它们都是猫所拥有的。 [yu zhou zhong you xu duo zhi hui wu zhong 。 ta men dou shi mao suo yong you de 。]

english: Cats and teleporting just don't mix well. That's why I walk everywhere. Messes my hair up terribly.
translation: 猫和传送根本不能很好地融合在一起。这就是为什么我到处步行。把我的头发弄得很乱。 [mao he chuan song gen ben bu neng hen hao di rong he zai yi qi 。 zhe jiu shi wei shen me wo dao chu bu xing 。 ba wo de tou fa nong de hen luan 。]

english: Cats are smarter than dogs. You can't get eight cats to pull a sled through snow.
translation: 猫比狗聪明。你不可能让八只猫在雪地里拉雪橇。 [mao bi gou cong ming 。 ni bu ke neng rang ba zhi mao zai xue di li la xue qiao 。]

english: Sorry, no time for chat. Still got mouse bones stuck in my teeth. How awkward.
translation: 抱歉，没时间聊天。老鼠骨头仍然卡在我的牙齿里。多么尴尬啊。 [bao qian ， mei shi jian liao tian 。 lao shu gu tou reng ran ka zai wo de ya chi li 。 duo me gan ga a 。]

english: You know, cats are the first species to fully evolve. We're perfect.
translation: 要知道，猫是第一个完全进化的物种。我们很完美。 [yao zhi dao ， mao shi di yi ge wan quan jin hua de wu zhong 。 wo men hen wan mei 。]

english: Preserve nature. Pickle a dog!
translation: 保护自然。腌狗！ [bao hu zi ran 。 yan gou ！]

english: Do you like dogs?
translation: 你喜欢狗吗？ [ni xi huan gou ma ？]

english: Yes!
translation: 是的！ [shi de ！]

english: Me too. Care to swap recipes? I have a rather unique hotdog sauce.
translation: 我也是。介意交换食谱吗？我有一种相当独特的热狗酱。 [wo ye shi 。 jie yi jiao huan shi pu ma ？ wo you yi zhong xiang dang du te de re gou jiang 。]

english: Bob, you're a bit messed up really aren't you.
translation: 鲍勃，你确实有点混乱，不是吗？ [bao bo ， ni que shi you dian hun luan ， bu shi ma ？]

english: No, I just know what I like. Besides, it was a joke.
translation: 不，我只知道我喜欢什么。此外，这是一个笑话。 [bu ， wo zhi zhi dao wo xi huan shen me 。 ci wai ， zhe shi yi ge xiao hua 。]

english: A joke? I doubt the dogs are laughing.
translation: 一个笑话？我怀疑狗在笑。 [yi ge xiao hua ？ wo huai yi gou zai xiao 。]

english: What dogs? I have already rid this place of dogs. Have you ever seen one?
translation: 什么狗？我已经把这个地方的狗赶走了。你见过吗？ [shen me gou ？ wo yi jing ba zhe ge di fang de gou gan zou le 。 ni jian guo ma ？]

english: Yes actually. I heard there are a few wild dogs about here somewhere.
translation: 是的，实际上。我听说这附近有几只野狗。 [shi de ， shi ji shang 。 wo ting shuo zhe fu jin you ji zhi ye gou 。]

english: Right!! Fellow cats, prepare for war!!
translation: 正确的！！各位猫猫们，准备战争吧！ [zheng que de ！！ ge wei mao mao men ， zhun bei zhan zheng ba ！]

english: Mmm. Maybe another time.
translation: 嗯。也许下次吧。 [n 。 ye xu xia ci ba 。]

english: Cat Rule number 1: Always act afraid when near dogs, especially if you're near a human. They will pick you up and fuss you, then shout at the dog. Most amusing!
translation: 猫规则第一条：靠近狗时总是表现出害怕，尤其是当你靠近人类时。他们会抱起你，对你大惊小怪，然后对狗大喊大叫。最有趣！ [mao gui ze di yi tiao ： kao jin gou shi zong shi biao xian chu hai pa ， you qi shi dang ni kao jin ren lei shi 。 ta men hui bao qi ni ， dui ni da jing xiao guai ， ran hou dui gou da han da jiao 。 zui you qu ！]

english: Cat Rule number 2: When assisting a human at work, make sure you sit behind its right leg. You stand a much better chance of getting picked up and stroked. Also, it's very amusing
translation: 猫规则 2：协助人类工作时，请确保您坐在其右腿后面。你被抱起并抚摸的机会要大得多。而且，也非常有趣 [mao gui ze  2： xie zhu ren lei gong zuo shi ， qing que bao nin zuo zai qi you tui hou mian 。 ni bei bao qi bing fu mo de ji hui yao da de duo 。 er qie ， ye fei chang you qu]

english: Cat Rule number 3: If you ever make a mistake, which is rare and probably involves a dog, make sure you wash yourself immediately. This will give everyone the impression that
translation: 养猫规则 3：如果您犯了错误（这种情况很少见，而且很可能涉及到狗），请务必立即洗澡。这会给大家一个印象 [yang mao gui ze  3： ru guo nin fan le cuo wu （ zhe zhong qing kuang hen shao jian ， er qie hen ke neng she ji dao gou ）， qing wu bi li ji xi zao 。 zhe hui gei da jia yi ge yin xiang]

english: it was done on purpose.
translation: 这是故意的。 [zhe shi gu yi de 。]

english: Cat Rule number 4: Beware the bag monster. These things live in small bags and under newspapers, sometimes even hidden in shoes if they are very clever. They will be very small and
translation: 猫规则 4：小心袋子怪物。这些东西藏在小袋子里和报纸下面，如果它们很聪明的话，有时甚至可以藏在鞋子里。它们会非常小并且 [mao gui ze  4： xiao xin dai zi guai wu 。 zhe xie dong xi zang zai xiao dai zi li he bao zhi xia mian ， ru guo ta men hen cong ming de hua ， you shi shen zhi ke yi cang zai xie zi li 。 ta men hui fei chang xiao bing qie]

english: take on the same colour as the hiding place. Attack these things on sight - stop at nothing. If you see a bag or shoe you have not inspected recently, pounce!!
translation: 呈现与隐藏地点相同的颜色。看到这些东西就攻击——不择手段。如果你看到最近没有检查过的包包或鞋子，请猛扑！！ [cheng xian yu yin cang di dian xiang tong de yan se 。 kan dao zhe xie dong xi jiu gong ji —— bu ze shou duan 。 ru guo ni kan dao zui jin mei you jian cha guo de bao bao huo xie zi ， qing meng pu ！！]

translation: 请原谅我，我比较忙。 [qing yuan liang wo ， wo bi jiao mang 。]

translation: 嘿，我是 Mahogany Homes 的承包商，你想要做什么？ [hei ， wo shi  Mahogany Homes  de cheng bao shang ， ni xiang yao zuo shen me ？]

translation: 我想要一张木桌。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang mu zhuo 。]

translation: 我已经完成了你想要的工作。 [wo yi jing wan cheng le ni xiang yao de gong zuo 。]

english: Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: 太感谢了！走之前你想喝杯茶吗？ [tai gan xie le ！ zou zhi qian ni xiang he bei cha ma ？]

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
translation: 是的，我想要一杯茶。 [shi de ， wo xiang yao yi bei cha 。]

english: Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!
translation: 啊啊，没有什么比一杯美味的茶更好的了！ [a a ， mei you shen me bi yi bei mei wei de cha geng hao de le ！]

english: No thanks, I better be off.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我最好离开了。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo zui hao li kai le 。]

translation: 是的，我想要一杯茶。 [shi de ， wo xiang yao yi bei cha 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Apparently you aren't as stupid as you look.
translation: 看来你并不像看上去那么愚蠢。 [kan lai ni bing bu xiang kan shang qu na me yu chun 。]

english: Hello, chum, fancy buyin' some designer jewellry? They've come all the way from Ardougne! Most pukka!
translation: 你好，朋友，想买一些设计师珠宝吗？他们大老远从阿杜涅过来！ Most pukka! [ni hao ， peng you ， xiang mai yi xie she ji shi zhu bao ma ？ ta men da lao yuan cong a du nie guo lai ！ Most pukka!]

english: Erm, no. I'm all set, thanks.
translation: 呃，不。 I'm all set, thanks. [e ， bu 。 I'm all set, thanks.]

english: Okay, chum, would you like to show you the very latest potion prices?
translation: 好的，伙计，你想告诉你最新的药水价格吗？ [hao de ， huo ji ， ni xiang gao su ni zui xin de yao shui jia ge ma ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Why, I'm Bob! Your friendly seller of smashin' goods!
translation: 为什么，我是鲍勃！您的友好卖家，出售精美商品！ [wei shen me ， wo shi bao bo ！ nin de you hao mai jia ， chu shou jing mei shang pin ！]

english: So what do you have to sell?
translation: 那么你要卖什么？ [na me ni yao mai shen me ？]

english: Oh, not much at the moment. Cuz, ya know, business being so well and cushie.
translation: 哦，暂时还没有那么多。因为，你知道，生意这么好，很轻松。 [o ， zan shi hai mei you na me duo 。 yin wei ， ni zhi dao ， sheng yi zhe me hao ， hen qing song 。]

english: You don't really look like you're being so successful.
translation: 你看上去并没有那么成功。 [ni kan shang qu bing mei you na me cheng gong 。]

english: You plonka! It's all a show, innit! If I let people knows I'm in good business they'll want a share of the moolah!
translation: 你这个笨蛋！这都是一场表演，不是吗！如果我让人们知道我生意很好，他们就会想要分享金钱！ [ni zhe ge ben dan ！ zhe dou shi yi chang biao yan ， bu shi ma ！ ru guo wo rang ren men zhi dao wo sheng yi hen hao ， ta men jiu hui xiang yao fen xiang jin qian ！]

english: You conveniently have a response for everything.
translation: 您可以方便地对所有事情做出回应。 [nin ke yi fang bian di dui suo you shi qing zuo chu hui ying 。]

english: That's the Ardougne way, my son.
translation: 这就是阿杜涅的方式，我的儿子。 [zhe jiu shi a du nie de fang shi ， wo de er zi 。]

english: Can you show me the prices for potions?
translation: 你能告诉我药水的价格吗？ [ni neng gao su wo yao shui de jia ge ma ？]

english: Lets see what you have...
translation: 让我们看看你有什么... [rang wo men kan kan ni you shen me ...]

english: You're a bit short of inventory space.
translation: 你的库存空间有点不足。 [ni de ku cun kong jian you dian bu zu 。]

english: You're a bit short of empty vessels or cash. Empty vials cost 5 coins each, cups 8 coins each, and anything else is 5 coins each.
translation: 你有点缺空船或现金。空瓶每个 5 个硬币，杯子每个 8 个硬币，其他任何东西每个 5 个硬币。 [ni you dian que kong chuan huo xian jin 。 kong ping mei ge  5  ge ying bi ， bei zi mei ge  8  ge ying bi ， qi ta ren he dong xi mei ge  5  ge ying bi 。]

english: There, I've done what I can, but you're a bit short of empty vessels or cash. Empty vials cost 5 coins each, cups 8 coins each, and anything else is 5 coins each.
translation: There, I've done what I can, but you're a bit short of empty vessels or cash.空瓶每个 5 个硬币，杯子每个 8 个硬币，其他任何东西每个 5 个硬币。 [There, I've done what I can, but you're a bit short of empty vessels or cash. kong ping mei ge  5  ge ying bi ， bei zi mei ge  8  ge ying bi ， qi ta ren he dong xi mei ge  5  ge ying bi 。]

english: There, all done.
translation: 到了那里，一切都完成了。 [dao le na li ， yi qie dou wan cheng le 。]

english: Two plus two is four, minus one that's three...
translation: 二加二等于四，减一等于三…… [er jia er deng yu si ， jian yi deng yu san ……]

english: I don't think you've got anything that I can decant.
translation: 我认为你没有什么可以让我倒出的。 [wo ren wei ni mei you shen me ke yi rang wo dao chu de 。]

english: Please, please, please work.
translation: 拜托，拜托，请工作。 [bai tuo ， bai tuo ， qing gong zuo 。]

english: I'm in the money!
translation: 我有钱了！ [wo you qian le ！]

english: I could have sworn that would have worked.
translation: 我可以发誓这会起作用。 [wo ke yi fa shi zhe hui qi zuo yong 。]

english: Now what should I buy?
translation: 现在我应该买什么？ [xian zai wo ying gai mai shen me ？]

translation: 希望这件商品能卖得好。 [xi wang zhe jian shang pin neng mai de hao 。]

english: I'll leave you to it.
translation: 我就让你去吧。 [wo jiu rang ni qu ba 。]
