translation: 你好你最近怎么样？ [ni hao ni zui jin zen me yang ？]

english: I'm good thank you, how can I help you today?
translation: 我很好，谢谢，今天我能为您提供什么帮助吗？ [wo hen hao ， xie xie ， jin tian wo neng wei nin ti gong shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This is our agility course, we use it to stay nimble and to keep our wits sharp. My name is Bobawu and I look after the course.
translation: 这是我们的敏捷课程，我们用它来保持敏捷并保持头脑敏锐。我的名字是Bobawu，我负责管理课程。 [zhe shi wo men de min jie ke cheng ， wo men yong ta lai bao chi min jie bing bao chi tou nao min rui 。 wo de ming zi shi Bobawu， wo fu ze guan li ke cheng 。]

english: As a friend and fellow monkey, you're free to use it anytime, but you'll need to be as nimble as a ninja first!
translation: 作为朋友和猴子伙伴，你可以随时使用它，但你首先需要像忍者一样灵活！ [zuo wei peng you he hou zi huo ban ， ni ke yi sui shi shi yong ta ， dan ni shou xian xu yao xiang ren zhe yi yang ling huo ！]

english: Oh great, thank you.
translation: 哦，太好了，谢谢。 [o ， tai hao le ， xie xie 。]

english: Are there any rewards you can offer me?
translation: 你能给我什么奖励吗？ [ni neng gei wo shen me jiang li ma ？]

english: Could you tell me how many laps I've completed?
translation: 你能告诉我我跑了多少圈吗？ [ni neng gao su wo wo pao le duo shao quan ma ？]

english: I can't offer you anything for now, so I don't see much reason to count your laps either.
translation: 我现在无法为您提供任何信息，因此我也看不出有多少理由来数您的圈数。 [wo xian zai wu fa wei nin ti gong ren he xin xi ， yin ci wo ye kan bu chu you duo shao li you lai shu nin de quan shu 。]

english: You need to complete Monkey Madness 2 for Bobawu to offer rewards and to count your lap total
translation: 您需要完成猴子疯狂 2 才能获得波巴乌的奖励并计算您的总圈数 [nin xu yao wan cheng hou zi feng kuang  2  cai neng huo de bo ba wu de jiang li bing ji suan nin de zong quan shu]

english: Looks like you haven't completed any laps, but I'll be sure to keep track of them, when you do.
translation: 看起来您还没有完成任何圈数，但当您完成时，我一定会跟踪它们。 [kan qi lai nin hai mei you wan cheng ren he quan shu ， dan dang nin wan cheng shi ， wo yi ding hui gen zong ta men 。]

english: Sure thing my friend, so far you've completed 1 lap, don't stop now!
translation: 当然，我的朋友，到目前为止你已经完成了一圈，现在不要停下来！ [dang ran ， wo de peng you ， dao mu qian wei zhi ni yi jing wan cheng le yi quan ， xian zai bu yao ting xia lai ！]

english: Sure thing my friend, so far you've completed [number] laps, don't stop now!
translation: 当然，我的朋友，到目前为止您已经完成了 [number] 圈，现在不要停下来！ [dang ran ， wo de peng you ， dao mu qian wei zhi nin yi jing wan cheng le  [number]  quan ， xian zai bu yao ting xia lai ！]

english: What can you offer me?
translation: 你能为我提供什么？ [ni neng wei wo ti gong shen me ？]

english: I see you have your own monkey friend, by completing laps here you can transform him into different monkeys!
translation: 我看到你有自己的猴子朋友，在这里完成一圈你就可以把他变成不同的猴子！ [wo kan dao ni you zi ji de hou zi peng you ， zai zhe li wan cheng yi quan ni jiu ke yi ba ta bian cheng bu tong de hou zi ！]

english: That's neat, what can he turn into?
translation: 太棒了，他能变成什么？ [tai bang le ， ta neng bian cheng shen me ？]

english: I've got the list here!
translation: 我这里有清单！ [wo zhe li you qing dan ！]

english: Bobawu pulls out a tattered piece of paper from his ninja costume.
translation: 波巴乌从他的忍者服装中拿出一张破烂的纸片。 [bo ba wu cong ta de ren zhe fu zhuang zhong na chu yi zhang po lan de zhi pian 。]

english: Ahem, here we are, At 100 you'll unlock a Karamjan Monkey transformation.
translation: 咳咳，我们到了，100 级时您将解锁卡拉姆詹猴子变身。 [hai hai ， wo men dao le ，100  ji shi nin jiang jie suo ka la mu zhan hou zi bian shen 。]

english: After completing 250 laps, you'll unlock a scary zombie monkey.
translation: 完成 250 圈后，您将解锁一只可怕的僵尸猴子。 [wan cheng  250  quan hou ， nin jiang jie suo yi zhi ke pa de jiang shi hou zi 。]

english: With 500 laps finished, you'll get a maniacal monkey.
translation: 跑完 500 圈后，你会得到一只疯狂的猴子。 [pao wan  500  quan hou ， ni hui de dao yi zhi feng kuang de hou zi 。]

english: At 1000 laps, you'll be able transform him into a spooky skeleton monkey,
translation: 跑到 1000 圈后，你就能把他变成一只幽灵般的骷髅猴， [pao dao  1000  quan hou ， ni jiu neng ba ta bian cheng yi zhi you ling ban de ku lou hou ，]

english: 1500 laps for a little Kruk Jr monkey,
translation: 小克鲁克猴跑了 1500 圈， [xiao ke lu ke hou pao le  1500  quan ，]

english: Finally at 2000 laps, he can transform to look like our King Awowogei.
translation: 终于在 2000 圈时，他可以变身为我们的阿沃沃盖国王。 [zhong yu zai  2000  quan shi ， ta ke yi bian shen wei wo men de a wo wo gai guo wang 。]

english: On second thought, never mind.
translation: 再想一想，没关系。 [zai xiang yi xiang ， mei guan xi 。]

english: That's okay my friend, come back anytime.
translation: 没关系，我的朋友，随时回来。 [mei guan xi ， wo de peng you ， sui shi hui lai 。]

english: Hey there, how do you do my fellow monkey?
translation: 嘿，我的猴子伙伴你好吗？ [hei ， wo de hou zi huo ban ni hao ma ？]

english: So far you've completed 1 lap, don't stop now!
translation: 到目前为止您已经完成了 1 圈，现在不要停下来！ [dao mu qian wei zhi nin yi jing wan cheng le  1  quan ， xian zai bu yao ting xia lai ！]

english: So far you've completed [number] laps, don't stop now!
translation: 到目前为止，您已经完成了 [number] 圈，现在不要停止！ [dao mu qian wei zhi ， nin yi jing wan cheng le  [number]  quan ， xian zai bu yao ting zhi ！]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: How many laps have I done?
translation: 我跑了多少圈？ [wo pao le duo shao quan ？]

english: What can you offer me?
translation: 你能为我提供什么？ [ni neng wei wo ti gong shen me ？]

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: Hello there friend! I'm Bobby the gnome child.
translation: 你好朋友！我是侏儒孩子鲍比。 [ni hao peng you ！ wo shi zhu ru hai zi bao bi 。]

english: Are you heading into The Nutcracker?
translation: 你要去胡桃夹子吗？ [ni yao qu hu tao jia zi ma ？]

english: Oh yes. Me and Pa have been looking forward to this all year. Isn't that right Pa?
translation: 哦是的。我和爸爸这一整年都在期待着这一天。爸爸不是这样吗？ [o shi de 。 wo he ba ba zhe yi zheng nian dou zai qi dai zhe zhe yi tian 。 ba ba bu shi zhe yang ma ？]

english: Yes Bobby. There's no doubt we will be sipping mulled pine inside The Nutcracker in no time.
translation: 是的，鲍比。毫无疑问，我们很快就会在胡桃夹子里品尝热松木。 [shi de ， bao bi 。 hao wu yi wen ， wo men hen kuai jiu hui zai hu tao jia zi li pin chang re song mu 。]

english: Mulled pine? Sounds very... Organic.
translation: 热松木？听起来很……有机。 [re song mu ？ ting qi lai hen …… you ji 。]

english: It's delightful.
translation: 真是令人愉快。 [zhen shi ling ren yu kuai 。]

english: Wishing you happy holidays [player name].
translation: 祝您假期愉快[玩家姓名]。 [zhu nin jia qi yu kuai [ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: You too Bobby.
translation: 你也是鲍比。 [ni ye shi bao bi 。]

english: Woah, you're very big for a Gnome.
translation: 哇哦，对于侏儒来说你已经很大了。 [wa o ， dui yu zhu ru lai shuo ni yi jing hen da le 。]

english: And you're very rude for a human.
translation: 而且你对人类来说太粗鲁了。 [er qie ni dui ren lei lai shuo tai cu lu le 。]

english: Don't listen to them Bobby. You're just a little different.
translation: 别听他们的，鲍比。你只是有点不同。 [bie ting ta men de ， bao bi 。 ni zhi shi you dian bu tong 。]

english: Nice to meet you [player name]. Does somebody need a hug?
translation: 很高兴认识你[玩家姓名]。有人需要拥抱吗？ [hen gao xing ren shi ni [ wan jia xing ming ]。 you ren xu yao yong bao ma ？]

english: Bobby stumbles and steps on his dad's foot while trying to hug you.
translation: 鲍比试图拥抱你时绊倒并踩到了他爸爸的脚。 [bao bi shi tu yong bao ni shi ban dao bing cai dao le ta ba ba de jiao 。]

english: Son of a nutcracker!
translation: 胡桃夹子的儿子！ [hu tao jia zi de er zi ！]

english: Sorry Pa!
translation: 对不起爸爸！ [dui bu qi ba ba ！]

english: I'll walk it off.
translation: 我会走开它。 [wo hui zou kai ta 。]

english: Heading into The Nutcracker?
translation: 前往胡桃夹子？ [qian wang hu tao jia zi ？]

english: You're a gnome?
translation: 你是侏儒？ [ni shi zhu ru ？]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Hello stranger, new to these parts?
translation: 你好，陌生人，对这些部分不熟悉吗？ [ni hao ， mo sheng ren ， dui zhe xie bu fen bu shu xi ma ？]

english: I'm Bolkoy by the way. I'm the village shopkeeper. Would you like to buy something?
translation: 顺便说一句，我是博尔科伊。我是村里的店主。您想买东西吗？ [shun bian shuo yi ju ， wo shi bo er ke yi 。 wo shi cun li de dian zhu 。 nin xiang mai dong xi ma ？]

english: What have you got?
translation: 你有什么？ [ni you shen me ？]

english: Take a look.
translation: 看看吧。 [kan kan ba 。]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Ok, maybe later.
translation: 好吧，也许以后吧。 [hao ba ， ye xu yi hou ba 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Amazing, you recovered the orb.
translation: 太棒了，你找回了球体。 [tai bang le ， ni zhao hui le qiu ti 。]

english: Well I am impressed. Would you like to buy something?
translation: 嗯，我印象深刻。您想买东西吗？ [n ， wo yin xiang shen ke 。 nin xiang mai dong xi ma ？]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Oh, hello there. Have you heard? They took the other orbs, it's terrible. I suppose the show must go on.
translation: 哦，你好。你听说过吗？他们拿走了其他的球体，太可怕了。我想演出必须继续下去。 [o ， ni hao 。 ni ting shuo guo ma ？ ta men na zou le qi ta de qiu ti ， tai ke pa le 。 wo xiang yan chu bi xu ji xu xia qu 。]

english: Would you like to buy something?
translation: 您想买东西吗？ [nin xiang mai dong xi ma ？]

english: Hello there. You're that hero who saved the orbs. Soon we will perform the ritual and the village will be safe again.
translation: 你好呀。你就是拯救球体的英雄。很快我们就会举行仪式，村庄就会再次安全。 [ni hao ya 。 ni jiu shi zheng jiu qiu ti de ying xiong 。 hen kuai wo men jiu hui ju xing yi shi ， cun zhuang jiu hui zai ci an quan 。]

english: Anyway, would you like anything from my shop?
translation: 不管怎样，你想要我店里的东西吗？ [bu guan zen yang ， ni xiang yao wo dian li de dong xi ma ？]

english: Welcome, welcome. It's good to see you again. The village is much safer now you have returned the orbs.
translation: 欢迎，欢迎。很高兴再次见到你。现在你已经归还了球体，村庄就安全多了。 [huan ying ， huan ying 。 hen gao xing zai ci jian dao ni 。 xian zai ni yi jing gui huan le qiu ti ， cun zhuang jiu an quan duo le 。]

english: By the way, I'm the village shop keeper. Would you like to buy something?
translation: 顺便说一句，我是村里的商店老板。您想买东西吗？ [shun bian shuo yi ju ， wo shi cun li de shang dian lao ban 。 nin xiang mai dong xi ma ？]

english: Hello! I take it you're here about the trail?
translation: 你好！我猜你来这里是为了这条小路？ [ni hao ！ wo cai ni lai zhe li shi wei le zhe tiao xiao lu ？]

english: Yes, do you have a challenge for me?
translation: 是的，你对我有挑战吗？ [shi de ， ni dui wo you tiao zhan ma ？]

english: Yes, right here!
translation: 是的，就在这里！ [shi de ， jiu zai zhe li ！]

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。 [qing shu ru wen ti de da an 。]

english: What's the matter with you? Can't you count? Try harder!
translation: 你怎么了？你不会数吗？再努力一点！ [ni zen me le ？ ni bu hui shu ma ？ zai nu li yi dian ！]

english: Lucky for you, that's the right answer!
translation: 你很幸运，这是正确的答案！ [ni hen xing yun ， zhe shi zheng que de da an ！]

english: What have you got?
translation: 你有什么？ [ni you shen me ？]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Yeah?
translation: 是的？ [shi de ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Granddad's fruit farm. It's a right dump. This whole corner of the city is a dump.
translation: 爷爷的果园。这是一个正确的转储。城市的整个角落都是垃圾场。 [ye ye de guo yuan 。 zhe shi yi ge zheng que de zhuan chu 。 cheng shi de zheng ge jiao luo dou shi la ji chang 。]

english: So why are you here if it's a dump?
translation: 既然这里是垃圾场，那你为什么还在这里？ [ji ran zhe li shi la ji chang ， na ni wei shen me hai zai zhe li ？]

english: My cow of a sister kicked me out of her bar. Said I was getting the place a bad name. So I'm staying here until I'm old enough to get my own place.
translation: 我的一个姐姐的牛把我赶出了她的酒吧。说我给这个地方带来了坏名声。所以我会一直留在这里，直到我长大到可以拥有自己的住处为止。 [wo de yi ge jie jie de niu ba wo gan chu le ta de jiu ba 。 shuo wo gei zhe ge di fang dai lai le huai ming sheng 。 suo yi wo hui yi zhi liu zai zhe li ， zhi dao wo zhang da dao ke yi yong you zi ji de zhu chu wei zhi 。]

english: I want to move to Arceuus. It's properly awesome up there. I'll do bartending or something until I can learn to be a necromancer.
translation: 我想搬到阿尔宙斯。那里真是太棒了。我会做调酒师什么的，直到我能学会成为一名死灵法师。 [wo xiang ban dao a er zhou si 。 na li zhen shi tai bang le 。 wo hui zuo diao jiu shi shen me de ， zhi dao wo neng xue hui cheng wei yi ming si ling fa shi 。]

english: Anyway, why are you here? Do you want something?
translation: 无论如何，你为什么在这里？你想要什么吗？ [wu lun ru he ， ni wei shen me zai zhe li ？ ni xiang yao shen me ma ？]

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: Okay, thanks for the info.
translation: 好的，谢谢您的信息。 [hao de ， xie xie nin de xin xi 。]

english: Yeah, you're in the biggest dumpster of Dumpsterville. Now you know. Anyway, do you want something?
translation: 是的，你在垃圾场最大的垃圾箱里。现在你知道了。无论如何，你想要什么吗？ [shi de ， ni zai la ji chang zui da de la ji xiang li 。 xian zai ni zhi dao le 。 wu lun ru he ， ni xiang yao shen me ma ？]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: Yeah, alright...
translation: 是啊，好吧... [shi a ， hao ba ...]

english: I am Bologa Gricoller, seeker of forbidden wisdom, wanderer of the dark pathways, thinker of the unthinkable. I can do bartending too.
translation: 我是博洛加·格里科勒（Bologa Gricoller），禁忌智慧的探索者，黑暗道路的流浪者，不可思议的思考者。我也可以做调酒师。 [wo shi bo luo jia · ge li ke lei （Bologa Gricoller）， jin ji zhi hui de tan suo zhe ， hei an dao lu de liu lang zhe ， bu ke si yi de si kao zhe 。 wo ye ke yi zuo diao jiu shi 。]

english: I used to work at The Golden Field. That's my sister's bar. It's mostly farmhands drinking there, but you get some interesting people as well.
translation: 我曾经在金田工作过。那是我姐姐的酒吧。在那里喝酒的主要是农场工人，但也有一些有趣的人。 [wo ceng jing zai jin tian gong zuo guo 。 na shi wo jie jie de jiu ba 。 zai na li he jiu de zhu yao shi nong chang gong ren ， dan ye you yi xie you qu de ren 。]

english: See, most Hosidius people are Saradominists. My sister, she's always listening to Father Jean at the church with his goodie-goodie sermons.
translation: 看，大多数霍西迪乌斯人都是萨拉多米主义者。我的妹妹，她总是在教堂听让神父的精彩布道。 [kan ， da duo shu huo xi di wu si ren dou shi sa la duo mi zhu yi zhe 。 wo de mei mei ， ta zong shi zai jiao tang ting rang shen fu de jing cai bu dao 。]

english: But some of us in the bar thought we'd give Zamorak a try. Like, you gotta be open-minded, right? What did Saradomin ever do for us anyway?
translation: 但酒吧里的一些人认为我们应该尝试一下萨莫拉克。就像，你必须思想开放，对吧？萨拉多明到底为我们做了什么？ [dan jiu ba li de yi xie ren ren wei wo men ying gai chang shi yi xia sa mo la ke 。 jiu xiang ， ni bi xu si xiang kai fang ， dui ba ？ sa la duo ming dao di wei wo men zuo le shen me ？]

english: So we'd meet in the bar, sharing books that the Piscarilius smugglers would bring us, learning what the Saradominists don't want us to know.
translation: 所以我们会在酒吧见面，分享皮斯卡利留斯走私者给我们带来的书籍，了解萨拉多米主义者不想让我们知道的事情。 [suo yi wo men hui zai jiu ba jian mian ， fen xiang pi si ka li liu si zou si zhe gei wo men dai lai de shu ji ， liao jie sa la duo mi zhu yi zhe bu xiang rang wo men zhi dao de shi qing 。]

english: Anyway, my sister - she's a right cow, by the way - she fired me and kicked me out. Said I was bringing bad sorts to her bar.
translation: 不管怎样，我姐姐——顺便说一句，她是头牛——她解雇了我，把我赶了出去。说我给她的酒吧带来了坏事。 [bu guan zen yang ， wo jie jie —— shun bian shuo yi ju ， ta shi tou niu —— ta jie gu le wo ， ba wo gan le chu qu 。 shuo wo gei ta de jiu ba dai lai le huai shi 。]

english: Bad sorts, she said! Like, morality is totally subjective, right? So who's she to call us bad sorts just 'cos we're not afraid to think differently?
translation: 不好，她说！就像，道德完全是主观的，对吧？那么她是谁，就因为我们不害怕以不同的方式思考而称我们为坏人呢？ [bu hao ， ta shuo ！ jiu xiang ， dao de wan quan shi zhu guan de ， dui ba ？ na me ta shi shui ， jiu yin wei wo men bu hai pa yi bu tong de fang shi si kao er cheng wo men wei huai ren ne ？]

english: Anyway, I've learnt all this cool stuff about Zamorak, and being stuck in a fruit farm doesn't stop me being his loyal servant, right?
translation: 不管怎样，我已经了解了关于萨莫拉克的所有这些很酷的事情，并且被困在水果农场并不能阻止我成为他忠实的仆人，对吧？ [bu guan zen yang ， wo yi jing liao jie le guan yu sa mo la ke de suo you zhe xie hen ku de shi qing ， bing qie bei kun zai shui guo nong chang bing bu neng zu zhi wo cheng wei ta zhong shi de pu ren ， dui ba ？]

english: In fact I've invented a Zamorakian blessing that works on fruit! You can use it to make Zamorak's wine out of grapes from the Vinery.
translation: 事实上，我发明了一种适用于水果的萨莫拉克祝福！您可以用它用葡萄园的葡萄酿造萨莫拉克葡萄酒。 [shi shi shang ， wo fa ming le yi zhong shi yong yu shui guo de sa mo la ke zhu fu ！ nin ke yi yong ta yong pu tao yuan de pu tao niang zao sa mo la ke pu tao jiu 。]

english: Can you help me to make Zamorak's wine?
translation: 你能帮我酿造萨莫拉克的酒吗？ [ni neng bang wo niang zao sa mo la ke de jiu ma ？]

english: I'll let you have access to the Zamorakian blessing I invented, so you can invoke Zamorak's unholy power upon the grapes... if I think you're up to it.
translation: 我会让你获得我发明的萨莫拉克祝福，这样你就可以在葡萄上调用萨莫拉克的邪恶力量……如果我认为你能做到的话。 [wo hui rang ni huo de wo fa ming de sa mo la ke zhu fu ， zhe yang ni jiu ke yi zai pu tao shang diao yong sa mo la ke de xie e li liang …… ru guo wo ren wei ni neng zuo dao de hua 。]

english: I'll want 75,000 coins too.
translation: 我也想要 75,000 个硬币。 [wo ye xiang yao  75,000  ge ying bi 。]

english: And do you think I'm up to it?
translation: 你认为我能胜任吗？ [ni ren wei wo neng sheng ren ma ？]

english: Nah, I bet you couldn't even bless an unholy symbol - you're not going to get very far with my grape blessing.
translation: 不，我敢打赌你甚至无法祝福一个邪恶的符号——你不会在我的葡萄祝福下走得太远。 [bu ， wo gan da du ni shen zhi wu fa zhu fu yi ge xie e de fu hao —— ni bu hui zai wo de pu tao zhu fu xia zou de tai yuan 。]

english: You need a Prayer level of 50 to use Bologa's blessing.
translation: 您需要祈祷等级达到 50 才能使用博洛加的祝福。 [nin xu yao qi dao deng ji da dao  50  cai neng shi yong bo luo jia de zhu fu 。]

english: Not likely - I can see from your kit that you're supporting other gods. Dress Zamorakian if you want to impress me. And I'll still want 75,000 coins.
translation: 不太可能——我从你的装备中看出你在支持其他神。如果你想给我留下深刻印象，请穿萨莫拉克风格的衣服。我仍然想要 75,000 个硬币。 [bu tai ke neng —— wo cong ni de zhuang bei zhong kan chu ni zai zhi chi qi ta shen 。 ru guo ni xiang gei wo liu xia shen ke yin xiang ， qing chuan sa mo la ke feng ge de yi fu 。 wo reng ran xiang yao  75,000  ge ying bi 。]

english: You don't look much like a Zamorakian to me. Dress Zamorakian if you want my help. And I'll still want 75,000 coins.
translation: 在我看来你不太像萨莫拉克人。如果你需要我的帮助，请穿萨莫拉克风格的衣服。我仍然想要 75,000 个硬币。 [zai wo kan lai ni bu tai xiang sa mo la ke ren 。 ru guo ni xu yao wo de bang zhu ， qing chuan sa mo la ke feng ge de yi fu 。 wo reng ran xiang yao  75,000  ge ying bi 。]

english: Yeah, I guess you'll do. But I want 75,000 coins. One day I'll need to buy my own house, y'know!
translation: 是的，我想你会的。但我想要 75,000 个硬币。有一天我需要买一套自己的房子，你知道的！ [shi de ， wo xiang ni hui de 。 dan wo xiang yao  75,000  ge ying bi 。 you yi tian wo xu yao mai yi tao zi ji de fang zi ， ni zhi dao de ！]

english: Maybe another time.
translation: 也许下次吧。 [ye xu xia ci ba 。]

english: Here's how it works... I'll write the blessing on scrolls. You need to carry some of the scrolls when you're harvesting grapes.
translation: 这是它的工作原理...我会将祝福写在卷轴上。当你收获葡萄时，你需要携带一些卷轴。 [zhe shi ta de gong zuo yuan li ... wo hui jiang zhu fu xie zai juan zhou shang 。 dang ni shou huo pu tao shi ， ni xu yao xie dai yi xie juan zhou 。]

english: As each fruit is severed from its stem, it begins to die. That's the moment of vulnerability when Zamorak's unholy power can infest it.
translation: 当每个果实从茎上被切断时，它就开始死亡。那是萨莫拉克的邪恶力量可以侵袭它的脆弱时刻。 [dang mei ge guo shi cong jing shang bei qie duan shi ， ta jiu kai shi si wang 。 na shi sa mo la ke de xie e li liang ke yi qin xi ta de cui ruo shi ke 。]

english: The power consumes the scroll on which the blessing is written, so you'll need one for each grape. I suggest you take a stack of blessings with you.
translation: 该力量会消耗写有祝福的卷轴，因此每一颗葡萄都需要一个。我建议你随身携带一叠祝福。 [gai li liang hui xiao hao xie you zhu fu de juan zhou ， yin ci mei yi ke pu tao dou xu yao yi ge 。 wo jian yi ni sui shen xie dai yi die zhu fu 。]

english: By the way, Lord Zamorak's chaotic power is quite volatile. You'll likely get a smaller harvest from your vine if you're using these blessings.
translation: 顺便说一下，萨莫拉克领主的混乱之力相当不稳定。如果你使用这些祝福，你的葡萄藤的收成可能会减少。 [shun bian shuo yi xia ， sa mo la ke ling zhu de hun luan zhi li xiang dang bu wen ding 。 ru guo ni shi yong zhe xie zhu fu ， ni de pu tao teng de shou cheng ke neng hui jian shao 。]

english: I'll give the scrolls to Granddad downstairs. You can get them off him as a reward if you work on his farm. Hey, it's a dump, but he's family. So, do you accept?
translation: 我会把卷轴交给楼下的爷爷。如果你在他的农场工作，你可以从他那里得到它们作为奖励。嘿，这是一个垃圾场，但他是家人。那么，你接受吗？ [wo hui ba juan zhou jiao gei lou xia de ye ye 。 ru guo ni zai ta de nong chang gong zuo ， ni ke yi cong ta na li de dao ta men zuo wei jiang li 。 hei ， zhe shi yi ge la ji chang ， dan ta shi jia ren 。 na me ， ni jie shou ma ？]

english: You pay Bologa 75,000 coins. You can now claim her blessings from Farmer Gricoller as a reward for working on his farm.
translation: 您向 Bologa 支付 75,000 个硬币。现在，你可以从农民 Gricoller 那里领取她的祝福，作为在他的农场工作的奖励。 [nin xiang  Bologa  zhi fu  75,000  ge ying bi 。 xian zai ， ni ke yi cong nong min  Gricoller  na li ling qu ta de zhu fu ， zuo wei zai ta de nong chang gong zuo de jiang li 。]

english: Actually, no thanks.
translation: 事实上，不用谢。 [shi shi shang ， bu yong xie 。]

english: Meh.
I'll leave you to it.
translation: 我就让你去吧。 [wo jiu rang ni qu ba 。]

english: Hello again.
translation: 又好。 [you hao 。]

english: You said you can make Zamorak's wine from grapes.
translation: 你说你可以用葡萄酿造萨莫拉克的葡萄酒。 [ni shuo ni ke yi yong pu tao niang zao sa mo la ke de pu tao jiu 。]

english: Yeah, I've invented a blessing that invokes Zamorak's unholy power upon the grapes, so Zamorak's wine can be made from them.
translation: 是的，我发明了一种祝福，可以召唤萨莫拉克对葡萄的邪恶力量，这样萨莫拉克的葡萄酒就可以用它们酿造。 [shi de ， wo fa ming le yi zhong zhu fu ， ke yi zhao huan sa mo la ke dui pu tao de xie e li liang ， zhe yang sa mo la ke de pu tao jiu jiu ke yi yong ta men niang zao 。]

english: But I won't let you use it unless I think you're up to it. Also, I want 75,000 coins.
translation: 但我不会让你使用它，除非我认为你能胜任。另外，我想要75,000枚硬币。 [dan wo bu hui rang ni shi yong ta ， chu fei wo ren wei ni neng sheng ren 。 ling wai ， wo xiang yao 75,000 mei ying bi 。]

english: Tell me about yourself again.
translation: 再跟我说说你自己吧。 [zai gen wo shuo shuo ni zi ji ba 。]

english: It's really nice of you to take an interest...
translation: 你能有兴趣真是太好了... [ni neng you xing qu zhen shi tai hao le ...]

english: Hello again, [player name].
translation: 再次问好，[玩家姓名]。 [zai ci wen hao ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: How do those blessings work again?
translation: 这些祝福如何再次发挥作用？ [zhe xie zhu fu ru he zai ci fa hui zuo yong ？]

english: My blessing is written on scrolls. You need to carry some of the scrolls when you're harvesting grapes.
translation: 我的祝福写在卷轴上。当你收获葡萄时，你需要携带一些卷轴。 [wo de zhu fu xie zai juan zhou shang 。 dang ni shou huo pu tao shi ， ni xu yao xie dai yi xie juan zhou 。]

english: I've given the scrolls to Granddad downstairs. You can get them off him as a reward for working on his farm. The place may be a dump, but he's family.
translation: 我已经把卷轴交给楼下的爷爷了。你可以从他那里得到它们，作为在他的农场工作的奖励。这个地方可能是一个垃圾场，但他是家人。 [wo yi jing ba juan zhou jiao gei lou xia de ye ye le 。 ni ke yi cong ta na li de dao ta men ， zuo wei zai ta de nong chang gong zuo de jiang li 。 zhe ge di fang ke neng shi yi ge la ji chang ， dan ta shi jia ren 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Tell me the story about yourself again.
translation: 再给我讲讲你自己的故事。 [zai gei wo jiang jiang ni zi ji de gu shi 。]

english: Yeah, okay. It's nice of you to ask...
translation: 是啊，好吧。很高兴你能问... [shi a ， hao ba 。 hen gao xing ni neng wen ...]

english: So that's how I came to invent that Zamorakian blessing for making Zamorak's wine out of grapes from the Vinery.
translation: 这就是我发明萨莫拉克祝福的方式，用葡萄园的葡萄酿造萨莫拉克葡萄酒。 [zhe jiu shi wo fa ming sa mo la ke zhu fu de fang shi ， yong pu tao yuan de pu tao niang zao sa mo la ke pu tao jiu 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: So why are you here if it's a dump?
translation: 既然这里是垃圾场，那你为什么还在这里？ [ji ran zhe li shi la ji chang ， na ni wei shen me hai zai zhe li ？]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: Okay, thanks for the info.
translation: 好的，谢谢您的信息。 [hao de ， xie xie nin de xin xi 。]

english: Can you help me to make Zamorak's wine?
translation: 你能帮我酿造萨莫拉克的酒吗？ [ni neng bang wo niang zao sa mo la ke de jiu ma ？]

english: Pay 75,000 coins to access Bologa's blessings.
translation: 支付 75,000 金币即可获得博洛加的祝福。 [zhi fu  75,000  jin bi ji ke huo de bo luo jia de zhu fu 。]

english: Decline.
translation: 衰退。 [shuai tui 。]

english: I'll leave you to it.
translation: 我就让你去吧。 [wo jiu rang ni qu ba 。]

english: You said you can make Zamorak's wine from grapes.
translation: 你说你可以用葡萄酿造萨莫拉克的葡萄酒。 [ni shuo ni ke yi yong pu tao niang zao sa mo la ke de pu tao jiu 。]

english: Tell me about yourself again.
translation: 再跟我说说你自己吧。 [zai gen wo shuo shuo ni zi ji ba 。]

english: How do those blessings work again?
translation: 这些祝福如何再次发挥作用？ [zhe xie zhu fu ru he zai ci fa hui zuo yong ？]

english: Tell me the story about yourself again.
translation: 再给我讲讲你自己的故事。 [zai gei wo jiang jiang ni zi ji de gu shi 。]

english: Hi there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: A'up, mate, how's it gowin'?
translation: 好了，伙计，进展如何？ [hao le ， huo ji ， jin zhan ru he ？]

english: Not bad, thank you.
translation: 还不错，谢谢。 [hai bu cuo ， xie xie 。]

english: What are you building here?
translation: 你在这里建造什么？ [ni zai zhe li jian zao shen me ？]

english: Nowt at moment. We're on strike!
translation: 此刻。我们罢工了！ [ci ke 。 wo men ba gong le ！]

english: You're on strike? Whatever for?
translation: 你罢工了吗？为了什么？ [ni ba gong le ma ？ wei le shen me ？]

english: Those strange alchemists are up ta somefin', best go ta one ov 'em.
translation: 那些奇怪的炼金术士正在做一些事情，最好去对付他们。 [na xie qi guai de lian jin shu shi zheng zai zuo yi xie shi qing ， zui hao qu dui fu ta men 。]

english: Oh, okay.
translation: 哦好的。 [o hao de 。]

english: You still hangin' around the tower?
translation: 你还在塔周围徘徊吗？ [ni hai zai ta zhou wei pai huai ma ？]

english: Yeah, we need another job. But til then, we figured we may as well wait ta see what else would turns up.
translation: 是的，我们需要另一份工作。但在那之前，我们认为我们不妨等待一下，看看还会出现什么。 [shi de ， wo men xu yao ling yi fen gong zuo 。 dan zai na zhi qian ， wo men ren wei wo men bu fang deng dai yi xia ， kan kan hai hui chu xian shen me 。]

english: Fair enough.
translation: 很公平。 [hen gong ping 。]

english: Who's a cute little kitty?
translation: 谁是可爱的小猫咪？ [shui shi ke ai de xiao mao mi ？]

english: Jimmy doesn't like me talking to strangers.
translation: 吉米不喜欢我和陌生人说话。 [ji mi bu xi huan wo he mo sheng ren shuo hua 。]

english: Miaow!
translation: 咪! [mi !]

english: It looks like you're trying to escape. Would you like some help?
translation: 看起来你正试图逃跑。您需要帮助吗？ [kan qi lai ni zheng shi tu tao pao 。 nin xu yao bang zhu ma ？]

english: I ... uh ... yes.
translation: 我……呃……是的。 [wo …… e …… shi de 。]

english: Right you are.
translation: 你是对的。 [ni shi dui de 。]

english: No thank you. Who are you by the way?
translation: 不，谢谢。顺便问一下你是谁？ [bu ， xie xie 。 shun bian wen yi xia ni shi shui ？]

english: Never mind that child. You should worry more about who you are and the nature of the forces that have driven you here.
translation: 别管那个孩子了。你应该更多地担心你是谁以及驱使你来到这里的力量的本质。 [bie guan na ge hai zi le 。 ni ying gai geng duo di dan xin ni shi shui yi ji qu shi ni lai dao zhe li de li liang de ben zhi 。]

english: I'll ... keep that in mind, thanks.
translation: 我会……记住这一点，谢谢。 [wo hui …… ji zhu zhe yi dian ， xie xie 。]

english: We WILL meet again, [player name].
translation: 我们会再次见面，[玩家姓名]。 [wo men hui zai ci jian mian ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Ok...
translation: 好的... [hao de ...]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Roll up, roll up!
translation: 卷起来，卷起来！ [juan qi lai ， juan qi lai ！]

english: Enter the great Hemenster fishing competition!
translation: 参加伟大的赫门斯特钓鱼比赛！ [can jia wei da de he men si te diao yu bi sai ！]

english: Only 5gp entrance fee!
translation: 入场费仅需5gp！ [ru chang fei jin xu 5gp！]

english: I'll enter the competition please.
translation: 请我参加比赛。 [qing wo can jia bi sai 。]

english: Marvelous!
translation: 奇妙！ [qi miao ！]

english: You pay Bonzo 5 coins.
translation: 您支付 Bonzo 5 个硬币。 [nin zhi fu  Bonzo 5  ge ying bi 。]

english: Ok, we've got all the fishermen. It's time to roll!
translation: 好的，我们已经找到了所有的渔民。是时候滚了！ [hao de ， wo men yi jing zhao dao le suo you de yu min 。 shi shi hou gun le ！]

english: Ok, nearly everyone is in their place already. You fish in the spot by the willow tree, and the Sinister Stranger, you fish by the pipes.
translation: 好吧，几乎每个人都已经就位了。你在柳树旁钓鱼，而险恶的陌生人则在水管旁钓鱼。 [hao ba ， ji hu mei ge ren dou yi jing jiu wei le 。 ni zai liu shu pang diao yu ， er xian e de mo sheng ren ze zai shui guan pang diao yu 。]

english: No thanks; I'll just watch the fun.
translation: 不，谢谢;我就看热闹吧 [bu ， xie xie ; wo jiu kan re nao ba]

english: Okay folks, time's up! Let's see who caught the biggest fish.
translation: 好了各位，时间到了！让我们看看谁钓到了最大的鱼。 [hao le ge wei ， shi jian dao le ！ rang wo men kan kan shui diao dao le zui da de yu 。]

english: You hand over your catch.
translation: 你交出你的捕获物。 [ni jiao chu ni de bu huo wu 。]

english: And the winner is... The stranger in black!
translation: 而获胜者是……黑衣陌生人！ [er huo sheng zhe shi …… hei yi mo sheng ren ！]

english: Hello champ!
translation: 你好冠军！ [ni hao guan jun ！]

english: So any hints on how to fish?
translation: 那么关于如何钓鱼有什么提示吗？ [na me guan yu ru he diao yu you shen me ti shi ma ？]

english: I think I'll keep them to myself.
translation: 我想我会把它们留给我自己。 [wo xiang wo hui ba ta men liu gei wo zi ji 。]

english: I'll enter the competition please.
translation: 请我参加比赛。 [qing wo can jia bi sai 。]

english: No thanks, I'll just watch the fun.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我只是看看热闹。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo zhi shi kan kan re nao 。]

english: Hello tall person.
translation: 你好高个子。 [ni hao gao ge zi 。]

english: Hello short person.
translation: 你好矮个子。 [ni hao ai ge zi 。]

english: Why are you called Boot?
translation: 为什么叫你Boot？ [wei shen me jiao ni Boot？]

english: I'm called Boot, because when I was very young, I used to sleep, in a large boot.
translation: 我被称为靴子，因为当我很小的时候，我常常睡在一个大靴子里。 [wo bei cheng wei xue zi ， yin wei dang wo hen xiao de shi hou ， wo chang chang shui zai yi ge da xue zi li 。]

english: Yeah, great, I didn't want your life story.
translation: 是的，太好了，我不想听你的人生故事。 [shi de ， tai hao le ， wo bu xiang ting ni de ren sheng gu shi 。]

english: Hello short person.
translation: 你好矮个子。 [ni hao ai ge zi 。]

english: Why are you called boot?
translation: 为什么叫引导？ [wei shen me jiao yin dao ？]

english: Can I come through this gate?
translation: 我可以从这扇门进去吗？ [wo ke yi cong zhe shan men jin qu ma ？]

english: You must pay a toll of 10 gold coins to pass.
translation: 必须缴纳10金币过路费才能通过。 [bi xu jiao na 10 jin bi guo lu fei cai neng tong guo 。]

english: No, thank you. I'll walk around.
translation: 不，谢谢。我会四处走走。 [bu ， xie xie 。 wo hui si chu zou zou 。]

english: Ok suit yourself.
translation: 好吧，适合你自己。 [hao ba ， shi he ni zi ji 。]

english: Who does my money go to?
translation: 我的钱归谁所有？ [wo de qian gui shui suo you ？]

english: The money goes to the city of Al-Kharid.
translation: 这笔钱将流向哈利德市。 [zhe bi qian jiang liu xiang ha li de shi 。]

english: Yes, ok.
translation: 是的，好的。 [shi de ， hao de 。]

english: You pay the guard.
translation: 你付钱给警卫。 [ni fu qian gei jing wei 。]

english: Oh dear, I don't actually seem to have enough money.
translation: 哎呀，看来我的钱确实不够。 [ai ya ， kan lai wo de qian que shi bu gou 。]

english: You may pass for free, you are a friend of Al-Kharid.
translation: 您可以免费通过，您是 Al-Kharid 的朋友。 [nin ke yi mian fei tong guo ， nin shi  Al-Kharid  de peng you 。]

english: Can we come through this gate?
translation: 我们能进这扇门吗？ [wo men neng jin zhe shan men ma ？]

english: You may pass for free, for you are a friend of Al-Kharid, but your goblin friend must stay on this side.
translation: 你可以免费通过，因为你是阿尔卡里德的朋友，但你的妖精朋友必须留在这一边。 [ni ke yi mian fei tong guo ， yin wei ni shi a er ka li de de peng you ， dan ni de yao jing peng you bi xu liu zai zhe yi bian 。]

english: Why?
translation: 为什么？ [wei shen me ？]

english: Why do you think this gate is here, if not to keep the goblins out of Al Kharid?
translation: 如果不是为了阻止妖精进入阿尔卡里德，你认为为什么会有这个大门？ [ru guo bu shi wei le zu zhi yao jing jin ru a er ka li de ， ni ren wei wei shen me hui you zhe ge da men ？]

english: But Zanik isn't like the other goblins!
translation: 但扎尼克和其他妖精不一样！ [dan zha ni ke he qi ta yao jing bu yi yang ！]

english: Nevermind, player name. I don't think we need to go to Al Kharid anyway!
translation: 没关系，玩家名字。无论如何我认为我们不需要去Al Kharid！ [mei guan xi ， wan jia ming zi 。 wu lun ru he wo ren wei wo men bu xu yao qu Al Kharid！]

english: You cannot pass as you haven't unlocked access to both theMisthalinandKharidian Desertareas in this League.
translation: 您无法通过，因为您尚未解锁进入该联盟中的米斯塔林和哈里迪安沙漠地区的权限。 [nin wu fa tong guo ， yin wei nin shang wei jie suo jin ru gai lian meng zhong de mi si ta lin he ha li di an sha mo di qu de quan xian 。]

english: No thank you, I'll walk around.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我去逛逛。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo qu guang guang 。]

english: Who does my money go to?
translation: 我的钱归谁所有？ [wo de qian gui shui suo you ？]

english: Yes, ok.
translation: 是的，好的。 [shi de ， hao de 。]

english: If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 我要是像你那么丑我就不敢在大庭广众之下露脸了！ [wo yao shi xiang ni na me chou wo jiu bu gan zai da ting guang zhong zhi xia lou lian le ！]

english: Out of my way, punk.
translation: 别挡我的路，朋克。 [bie dang wo de lu ， peng ke 。]

english: Hmm... you smell strange...
translation: 嗯……你闻起来很奇怪…… [n …… ni wen qi lai hen qi guai ……]

english: Strange how?
translation: 奇怪怎么办？ [qi guai zen me ban ？]

english: Like a human!
translation: 像人一样！ [xiang ren yi yang ！]

english: Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 哦！呃……我刚吃了一个就是为什么！ [o ！ e …… wo gang chi le yi ge jiu shi wei shen me ！]

english: Leave me alone.
translation: 请别打扰我。 [qing bie da rao wo 。]

english: Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 如果你珍惜你的生命，就不要再跟我说话了！ [ru guo ni zhen xi ni de sheng ming ， jiu bu yao zai gen wo shuo hua le ！]

english: Get lost!
translation: 迷路！ [mi lu ！]

english: I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 我没有什么可以给你，所以让我一个人呆着吧，托钵僧。 [wo mei you shen me ke yi gei ni ， suo yi rang wo yi ge ren dai zhe ba ， tuo bo seng 。]

english: Have you no manners?
translation: 你没有礼貌吗？ [ni mei you li mao ma ？]

english: I don't have time for this right now.
translation: 我现在没有时间做这个。 [wo xian zai mei you shi jian zuo zhe ge 。]

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 我没有兴趣和像你这样的可怜虫说话。 [wo mei you xing qu he xiang ni zhe yang de ke lian chong shuo hua 。]

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
translation: 我打赌你有一双很棒的爪子。 [wo da du ni you yi shuang hen bang de zhua zi 。]

english: A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 非常痛苦的一天，总的来说……趁它持续的时候好好享受吧。 [fei chang tong ku de yi tian ， zong de lai shuo …… chen ta chi xu de shi hou hao hao xiang shou ba 。]

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: 如果你抓到任何人，答应我你会分享。 [ru guo ni zhua dao ren he ren ， da ying wo ni hui fen xiang 。]

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 我以前没在这儿闻过你的味道…… [wo yi qian mei zai zhe er wen guo ni de wei dao ……]

english: You smell familiar...
translation: 你闻起来很熟悉... [ni wen qi lai hen shu xi ...]

english: Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 看到这附近有人类吗？我饿了。 [kan dao zhe fu jin you ren lei ma ？ wo e le 。]

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 在我看来，你就像一个对血液有健康品味的人。 [zai wo kan lai ， ni jiu xiang yi ge dui xue ye you jian kang pin wei de ren 。]

english: Good day to you, my friend.
translation: 祝你美好的一天，我的朋友。 [zhu ni mei hao de yi tian ， wo de peng you 。]

english: Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
translation: 想去城堡吃点小吃吗？ [xiang qu cheng bao chi dian xiao chi ma ？]

english: Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: 等一下，我的牙齿里有一点东西卡住了…… [deng yi xia ， wo de ya chi li you yi dian dong xi ka zhu le ……]

english: I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: 我不能和你这个外地人说话！与酋长布伦特交谈！ [wo bu neng he ni zhe ge wai di ren shuo hua ！ yu qiu zhang bu lun te jiao tan ！]

english: You stay away from me outerlander!
translation: 你这个外地人离我远点！ [ni zhe ge wai di ren li wo yuan dian ！]

english: They are too suspicious of you for you to get close enough to steal from them.
translation: 他们对你太怀疑了，你无法靠近他们去偷东西。 [ta men dui ni tai huai yi le ， ni wu fa kao jin ta men qu tou dong xi 。]

english: Hello, are you a member of the council?
translation: 你好，请问你是理事会成员吗？ [ni hao ， qing wen ni shi li shi hui cheng yuan ma ？]

english: I am afraid not outerlander. Goodbye.
translation: 恐怕不是外地人。再见。 [kong pa bu shi wai di ren 。 zai jian 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: 再次你好[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]。今天你需要我做什么？您永远可以信赖我的帮助！ [zai ci ni hao [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 jin tian ni xu yao wo zuo shen me ？ nin yong yuan ke yi xin lai wo de bang zhu ！]

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。我只是想聊聊。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。 wo zhi shi xiang liao liao 。]

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: 如果您需要我的帮助[弗雷曼尼克名字]，我的门永远敞开。 [ru guo nin xu yao wo de bang zhu [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]， wo de men yong yuan chang kai 。]

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: [弗雷曼尼克名字]...我们已经很久没有见面了！ [[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]... wo men yi jing hen jiu mei you jian mian le ！]

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: 欢迎回来[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]。很高兴在这里见到您！ [huan ying hui lai [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 hen gao xing zai zhe li jian dao nin ！]

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: 我很抱歉[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]！我没时间陪你在这里！ [wo hen bao qian [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！ wo mei shi jian pei ni zai zhe li ！]

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
translation: 没关系，我其实什么都不想要。 [mei guan xi ， wo qi shi shen me dou bu xiang yao 。]

english: How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: 你[弗雷曼尼克名字]怎么样？我希望您这一天一切顺利！ [ni [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ] zen me yang ？ wo xi wang nin zhe yi tian yi qie shun li ！]

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
translation: 我很好，谢谢，你好吗？ [wo hen hao ， xie xie ， ni hao ma ？]

english: All is well with me also!
translation: 我也一切都好！ [wo ye yi qie dou hao ！]

english: Hello to you, too!
translation: 也向你问好！ [ye xiang ni wen hao ！]

english: Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你好。你想要什么东西[弗雷曼尼克名字]吗？ [ni hao 。 ni xiang yao shen me dong xi [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ] ma ？]

english: No, not really.
translation: 不，不是真的。 [bu ， bu shi zhen de 。]

english: Well... okay then!
translation: 嗯……那好吧！ [n …… na hao ba ！]

english: Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
translation: 很高兴见到你[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]。 [hen gao xing jian dao ni [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。]

english: You shame us, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你让我们感到羞耻，[弗雷曼尼克名字]！ [ni rang wo men gan dao xiu chi ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！]

english: How can you steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你怎么能偷我的东西，[弗雷曼尼克名字]？ [ni zen me neng tou wo de dong xi ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]？]

english: You have betrayed your heritage, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你背叛了你的传统，[弗雷曼尼克名字]！ [ni bei pan le ni de chuan tong ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！]

english: Why would you try to steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你为什么要偷我的东西，[弗雷曼尼克名字]？ [ni wei shen me yao tou wo de dong xi ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]？]

english: What you want, human? You not coming in. Weiss is troll town - humans not welcome.
translation: 你想要什么，人类？你别进来。韦斯是巨魔之城——不欢迎人类。 [ni xiang yao shen me ， ren lei ？ ni bie jin lai 。 wei si shi ju mo zhi cheng —— bu huan ying ren lei 。]

english: My Arm has come to make friends with you.
translation: 我的手臂来和你交朋友。 [wo de shou bi lai he ni jiao peng you 。]

english: Boulder not sure exactly what you offering, human, but it not sound like something Boulder want to happen.
translation: 博尔德不确定你到底提供什么，人类，但这听起来不像博尔德想要发生的事情。 [bo er de bu que ding ni dao di ti gong shen me ， ren lei ， dan zhe ting qi lai bu xiang bo er de xiang yao fa sheng de shi qing 。]

english: But My Arm's come a very long way for this, and he's very excited about what he can teach you.
translation: 但 My Arm 在这方面已经取得了很大的进步，他对自己能教给你的东西感到非常兴奋。 [dan  My Arm  zai zhe fang mian yi jing qu de le hen da de jin bu ， ta dui zi ji neng jiao gei ni de dong xi gan dao fei chang xing fen 。]

english: Boulder still not sure what you offering, human, but you definitely not doing it in here. Go away!
translation: 博尔德仍然不确定你提供什么，人类，但你绝对不会在这里做。离开！ [bo er de reng ran bu que ding ni ti gong shen me ， ren lei ， dan ni jue dui bu hui zai zhe li zuo 。 li kai ！]

english: Wolfbone's sent My Arm from the Troll Stronghold.
translation: 狼骨从巨魔要塞派来了我的手臂。 [lang gu cong ju mo yao sai pai lai le wo de shou bi 。]

english: Human arm might taste good, maybe, so if Wolfbone sent your arm as a snack, we happy to take it an' eat it.
translation: 也许人类的手臂味道不错，所以如果狼骨把你的手臂作为零食送给我们，我们很乐意接受并吃掉它。 [ye xu ren lei de shou bi wei dao bu cuo ， suo yi ru guo lang gu ba ni de shou bi zuo wei ling shi song gei wo men ， wo men hen le yi jie shou bing chi diao ta 。]

english: I'm not letting you eat my arm.
translation: 我不会让你吃掉我的手臂。 [wo bu hui rang ni chi diao wo de shou bi 。]

english: Urgh - human arm attached to human body with human mouth what keep talking an' talking. Shut up and' go away.
translation: 呃——人的手臂用人的嘴附着在人体上，一直在说话。闭嘴，走开。 [e —— ren de shou bi yong ren de zui fu zhuo zai ren ti shang ， yi zhi zai shuo hua 。 bi zui ， zou kai 。]

english: You only need to let My Arm in, not me.
translation: 你只需要让我的手臂进来，而不是我。 [ni zhi xu yao rang wo de shou bi jin lai ， er bu shi wo 。]

english: Human sound confused about how body work. See, mortal body is intrinsic part of mortal being. It not like we got our souls floating up in da sky controlling bodies like puppets.
translation: 人类的声音对身体如何运作感到困惑。看，凡人的身体是凡人的固有部分。并不是说我们的灵魂漂浮在天空中，像木偶一样控制着身体。 [ren lei de sheng yin dui shen ti ru he yun zuo gan dao kun huo 。 kan ， fan ren de shen ti shi fan ren de gu you bu fen 。 bing bu shi shuo wo men de ling hun piao fu zai tian kong zhong ， xiang mu ou yi yang kong zhi zhe shen ti 。]

english: We mortal beings - troll, human, goat - we are our bodies, and our bodies are us. You human got dumb ideas 'bout mind/body dualism.
translation: 我们凡人——巨魔、人类、山羊——我们就是我们的身体，我们的身体就是我们。你们人类对身心二元论有愚蠢的想法。 [wo men fan ren —— ju mo 、 ren lei 、 shan yang —— wo men jiu shi wo men de shen ti ， wo men de shen ti jiu shi wo men 。 ni men ren lei dui shen xin er yuan lun you yu chun de xiang fa 。]

english: Anyway, Boulder not here to talk ontological distinction between mind an' matter, especially with dumb human who not know what [his/her] arm is. So push off.
translation: 不管怎样，博尔德不是在这里谈论心灵和物质之间的本体论区别，特别是对于那些不知道[他/她的]手臂是什么的愚蠢人类。所以推开吧。 [bu guan zen yang ， bo er de bu shi zai zhe li tan lun xin ling he wu zhi zhi jian de ben ti lun qu bie ， te bie shi dui yu na xie bu zhi dao [ ta / ta de ] shou bi shi shen me de yu chun ren lei 。 suo yi tui kai ba 。]

english: I'll be back!
translation: 我会回来的！ [wo hui hui lai de ！]

english: Hey, friend of Snowflake!
translation: 嘿，雪花的朋友！ [hei ， xue hua de peng you ！]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: We met at entry gate, remember? Boulder sent you away, 'cos we not trust humans here in Weiss, an' also you sound crazy. But you our friend now, an' you always welcome.
translation: 我们在入口处见面，记得吗？博尔德把你送走了，因为我们不信任韦斯这里的人类，而且你听起来也很疯狂。但你现在是我们的朋友，我们永远欢迎你。 [wo men zai ru kou chu jian mian ， ji de ma ？ bo er de ba ni song zou le ， yin wei wo men bu xin ren wei si zhe li de ren lei ， er qie ni ting qi lai ye hen feng kuang 。 dan ni xian zai shi wo men de peng you ， wo men yong yuan huan ying ni 。]

english: Boulder used to guard entry gate, but now Snowflake trusted Boulder with important farming job. Much more fun.
translation: 博尔德曾经负责守卫入口大门，但现在雪花将重要的农活交给了博尔德。更有趣。 [bo er de ceng jing fu ze shou wei ru kou da men ， dan xian zai xue hua jiang zhong yao de nong huo jiao gei le bo er de 。 geng you qu 。]

english: Boulder gotta grow goutweed for tribe, an' also make sure your herbs stay healthy. Snowflake's husband troll very strict on it.
translation: 博尔德必须为部落种植古风草，还要确保你的草药保持健康。雪花的老公巨魔对此管得很严。 [bo er de bi xu wei bu luo zhong zhi gu feng cao ， hai yao que bao ni de cao yao bao chi jian kang 。 xue hua de lao gong ju mo dui ci guan de hen yan 。]

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 告诉我这个地方。 [gao su wo zhe ge di fang 。]

english: This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: 这是韦斯。几年前，在我们被从更南边的洞穴里赶出来之后，巨魔们建造了它。现在Weiss是我们的家。 [zhe shi wei si 。 ji nian qian ， zai wo men bei cong geng nan bian de dong xue li gan chu lai zhi hou ， ju mo men jian zao le ta 。 xian zai Weiss shi wo men de jia 。]

english: It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: 这里太棒了，现在雪花和她丈夫巨魔教我们种植古风草。现在食物好多了。 [zhe li tai bang le ， xian zai xue hua he ta zhang fu ju mo jiao wo men zhong zhi gu feng cao 。 xian zai shi wu hao duo le 。]

english: Do you like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这里吗？ [ni xi huan zhe li ma ？]

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: 嗯，虽然有点粗糙，但是正在好起来。雪花，她教我们种植古风草。山羊、狼、人类的味道都因加入了古藤而变得更加美味。 [n ， sui ran you dian cu cao ， dan shi zheng zai hao qi lai 。 xue hua ， ta jiao wo men zhong zhi gu feng cao 。 shan yang 、 lang 、 ren lei de wei dao dou yin jia ru le gu teng er bian de geng jia mei wei 。]

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: 所以，是的，韦斯是一个很好的居住地，现在由雪花负责。所有的巨魔都像雪花一样。她的丈夫巨魔有点奇怪，但这不是我们的问题。 [suo yi ， shi de ， wei si shi yi ge hen hao de ju zhu di ， xian zai you xue hua fu ze 。 suo you de ju mo dou xiang xue hua yi yang 。 ta de zhang fu ju mo you dian qi guai ， dan zhe bu shi wo men de wen ti 。]

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我就走了。 [wo jiu zou le 。]

english: My Arm has come to make friends with you.
translation: 我的手臂来和你交朋友。 [wo de shou bi lai he ni jiao peng you 。]

english: Wolfbone's sent My Arm from the Troll Stronghold.
translation: 狼骨从巨魔要塞派来了我的手臂。 [lang gu cong ju mo yao sai pai lai le wo de shou bi 。]

english: You only need to let My Arm in, not me.
translation: 你只需要让我的手臂进来，而不是我。 [ni zhi xu yao rang wo de shou bi jin lai ， er bu shi wo 。]

english: I'll be back!
translation: 我会回来的！ [wo hui hui lai de ！]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 告诉我这个地方。 [gao su wo zhe ge di fang 。]

english: Do you like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这里吗？ [ni xi huan zhe li ma ？]

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我就走了。 [wo jiu zou le 。]

english: Hi! What are you up to?
translation: 你好！你要做什么？ [ni hao ！ ni yao zuo shen me ？]

english: Watering the pretty flowers, you want to help?
translation: 给美丽的花朵浇水，你想帮忙吗？ [gei mei li de hua duo jiao shui ， ni xiang bang mang ma ？]

english: I don't have time to water flowers, I have people to save!
translation: 我没时间浇花，我还有人要救！ [wo mei shi jian jiao hua ， wo hai you ren yao jiu ！]

english: Pft, you should take time to enjoy the simple things.
translation: 噗，你应该花时间享受简单的事情。 [pu ， ni ying gai hua shi jian xiang shou jian dan de shi qing 。]

english: I'm not a simple person.
translation: 我不是一个简单的人。 [wo bu shi yi ge jian dan de ren 。]

english: So it seems.
translation: 看来是这样。 [kan lai shi zhe yang 。]

english: Hi, I...
translation: 嗨，我... [hai ， wo ...]

english: What are you doing here, Fremennik?!
translation: 你在这里做什么，弗雷曼尼克？！ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ， fu lei man ni ke ？！]

english: I have a seal of pass...
translation: 我有通行证... [wo you tong xing zheng ...]

english: No you do not! Begone!
translation: 不，你不！走开！ [bu ， ni bu ！ zou kai ！]

english: The player is teleported back to Rellekka
translation: 玩家被传送回雷莱卡 [wan jia bei chuan song hui lei lai ka]

english: Ooops. Suppose I need a seal of passage when I'm walking around that island.
translation: 哎呀。假设我在那个岛上行走时需要通行密封。 [ai ya 。 jia she wo zai na ge dao shang hang zou shi xu yao tong xing mi feng 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: A fair day, traveller. Would you like to see my wares?
translation: 美好的一天，旅行者。你想看看我的商品吗？ [mei hao de yi tian ， lv xing zhe 。 ni xiang kan kan wo de shang pin ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: I'd like to ask you about magic crossbows.
translation: 我想问一下关于魔法十字弓的事。 [wo xiang wen yi xia guan yu mo fa shi zi gong de shi 。]

english: Ahh crossbows. Not exactly what I'd call skilled ranging, but I guess dwarven engineering is good, what did you want to know?
translation: 啊十字弓。不完全是我所说的熟练测距，但我想矮人工程学很好，你想知道什么？ [a shi zi gong 。 bu wan quan shi wo suo shuo de shu lian ce ju ， dan wo xiang ai ren gong cheng xue hen hao ， ni xiang zhi dao shen me ？]

english: The dwarves don't work with magic logs, I'm wondering if you know how to make a crossbow out of them?
translation: 矮人不使用魔法原木，我想知道你是否知道如何用它们制作十字弓？ [ai ren bu shi yong mo fa yuan mu ， wo xiang zhi dao ni shi fou zhi dao ru he yong ta men zhi zuo shi zi gong ？]

english: As it happens, a recent discovery of dragon limbs has allowed the creation of such a crossbow.
translation: 碰巧的是，最近发现的龙肢使得这种弩得以制造。 [peng qiao de shi ， zui jin fa xian de long zhi shi de zhe zhong nu de yi zhi zao 。]

english: That's fantastic!
translation: 太棒了！ [tai bang le ！]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Okay good day to you.
translation: 好吧，祝你有美好的一天。 [hao ba ， zhu ni you mei hao de yi tian 。]

english: I don't... however I will look into it when I get spare time, for now you'll have to stick with the dwarven way of doing things.
translation: 我不……但是当我有空闲时间时我会研究一下，现在你必须坚持矮人的做事方式。 [wo bu …… dan shi dang wo you kong xian shi jian shi wo hui yan jiu yi xia ， xian zai ni bi xu jian chi ai ren de zuo shi fang shi 。]

english: Ok, perhaps one day in the future I'll get to make magic crossbows!
translation: 好吧，也许将来有一天我会制作魔法弩！ [hao ba ， ye xu jiang lai you yi tian wo hui zhi zuo mo fa nu ！]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: I'd like to ask you about magic crossbows.
translation: 我想问一下关于魔法十字弓的事。 [wo xiang wen yi xia guan yu mo fa shi zi gong de shi 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello! Have you come to take part in the festivities?
translation: 你好！你是来参加庆祝活动的吗？ [ni hao ！ ni shi lai can jia qing zhu huo dong de ma ？]

english: I should set up a moleyball court next, the king of all ball-based sports.
translation: 接下来我应该建立一个排球场，所有球类运动之王。 [jie xia lai wo ying gai jian li yi ge pai qiu chang ， suo you qiu lei yun dong zhi wang 。]

english: What was that?
translation: 那是什么？ [na shi shen me ？]

english: Oh nothing. Just thinking out loud.
translation: 哦，没什么。只是大声思考。 [o ， mei shen me 。 zhi shi da sheng si kao 。]

english: Alright I'll leave you to it then.
translation: 好吧，那我就留给你了。 [hao ba ， na wo jiu liu gei ni le 。]

english: The Easter Bunny is looking awfully glum this year.
translation: 今年的复活节兔子看起来非常闷闷不乐。 [jin nian de fu huo jie tu zi kan qi lai fei chang men men bu le 。]

english: Perhaps we can help raise the Easter spirits?
translation: 也许我们可以帮助提升复活节的气氛？ [ye xu wo men ke yi bang zhu ti sheng fu huo jie de qi fen ？]

english: You want to do some necromancy... To cheer up the Easter Bunny?
translation: 你想要施展一些死灵魔法……让复活节兔子高兴起来吗？ [ni xiang yao shi zhan yi xie si ling mo fa …… rang fu huo jie tu zi gao xing qi lai ma ？]

english: No no no! It's just a figure of speech.
translation: 不不不！这只是一种修辞手法。 [bu bu bu ！ zhe zhi shi yi zhong xiu ci shou fa 。]

english: I just wonder if we could do anything to help.
translation: 我只是想知道我们是否可以提供任何帮助。 [wo zhi shi xiang zhi dao wo men shi fou ke yi ti gong ren he bang zhu 。]

english: Leave it to me boss.
translation: 交给我吧老大。 [jiao gei wo ba lao da 。]

english: I happen to know the E.B. is a big fan of bowling. In fact, he used to be a wizard on the lanes. A champion!
translation: 我碰巧认识 E.B.是保龄球的忠实粉丝。事实上，他曾经是球场上的奇才。冠军！ [wo peng qiao ren shi  E.B. shi bao ling qiu de zhong shi fen si 。 shi shi shang ， ta ceng jing shi qiu chang shang de qi cai 。 guan jun ！]

english: I also happen to have the ability to...
translation: 我也恰好有能力... [wo ye qia hao you neng li ...]

english: ...Rig the game in his favour.
translation: ......操纵比赛对他有利。 [...... cao zong bi sai dui ta you li 。]

english: Which is handy, he's very out of practise nowadays.
translation: 这很方便，他现在已经很少练习了。 [zhe hen fang bian ， ta xian zai yi jing hen shao lian xi le 。]

english: Won't he suspect something?
translation: 他不会怀疑什么吗？ [ta bu hui huai yi shen me ma ？]

english: Oh no! You see, I have these gears set up just here.
translation: 哦不！你看，我已经把这些齿轮设置在这里了。 [o bu ！ ni kan ， wo yi jing ba zhe xie chi lun she zhi zai zhe li le 。]

english: Wait, are you just trying to get my trade secrets?
translation: 等等，你只是想窃取我的商业机密吗？ [deng deng ， ni zhi shi xiang qie qu wo de shang ye ji mi ma ？]

english: This is strictly a humanitarian effort!
translation: 这完全是人道主义的努力！ [zhe wan quan shi ren dao zhu yi de nu li ！]

english: Bun-itarian..?
translation: 包子主义者..？ [bao zi zhu yi zhe ..？]

english: Look, I just want to get Easter back on track.
translation: 听着，我只是想让复活节重回正轨。 [ting zhe ， wo zhi shi xiang rang fu huo jie zhong hui zheng gui 。]

english: You can keep your hustle going, I just want to help the Easter Bunny.
translation: 你可以继续忙碌，我只是想帮助复活节兔子。 [ni ke yi ji xu mang lu ， wo zhi shi xiang bang zhu fu huo jie tu zi 。]

english: Oh alright, since I do owe the big softie. But I've got my whiskers on you!
translation: 哦，好吧，因为我确实欠这个大软蛋。但我的胡子在你身上！ [o ， hao ba ， yin wei wo que shi qian zhe ge da ruan dan 。 dan wo de hu zi zai ni shen shang ！]

english: So, what is it you wanted to show me, [player name]?
translation: 那么，你想向我展示什么，[玩家姓名]？ [na me ， ni xiang xiang wo zhan shi shen me ，[ wan jia xing ming ]？]

english: Well, Bowley here let me in on your secret. Bowling champion three years in a row.
translation: 好吧，鲍利让我知道你的秘密。连续三年获得保龄球冠军。 [hao ba ， bao li rang wo zhi dao ni de mi mi 。 lian xu san nian huo de bao ling qiu guan jun 。]

english: Oh. Those were the days, I haven't partaken for while now though...
translation: 哦。那些日子，我已经有一段时间没有参加了…… [o 。 na xie ri zi ， wo yi jing you yi duan shi jian mei you can jia le ……]

english: I just haven't had the spring in my step with my egg responsibilities.
translation: 我只是没有在我的鸡蛋责任中迈出步伐。 [wo zhi shi mei you zai wo de ji dan ze ren zhong mai chu bu fa 。]

english: Well, here's your chance!
translation: 好吧，你的机会来了！ [hao ba ， ni de ji hui lai le ！]

english: What do you mean? It's hardly fun without decent competition.
translation: 你是什​​么意思？没有适当的竞争就很难有乐趣。 [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？ mei you shi dang de jing zheng jiu hen nan you le qu 。]

english: And nobody here quite likes bowling.
translation: 这里没有人喜欢打保龄球。 [zhe li mei you ren xi huan da bao ling qiu 。]

english: They what now?
translation: 他们现在怎么办？ [ta men xian zai zen me ban ？]

english: I've only just gone and spent ages digging out this place and installing the machinery!
translation: 我才刚刚离开，花了很长时间挖掘这个地方并安装机器！ [wo cai gang gang li kai ， hua le hen zhang shi jian wa jue zhe ge di fang bing an zhuang ji qi ！]

english: Nothing to worry about I'm sure!
translation: 我确信没什么可担心的！ [wo que xin mei shen me ke dan xin de ！]

english: Ah Bowley, it is good to see you again.
translation: 啊鲍利，很高兴再次见到你。 [a bao li ， hen gao xing zai ci jian dao ni 。]

english: Long Ears Johnson. Come to terrorise me pins again?
translation: 长耳朵约翰逊。又来恐吓我别针吗？ [zhang er duo yue han xun 。 you lai kong he wo bie zhen ma ？]

english: We'll see about that.
translation: 我们将会看到这一点。 [wo men jiang hui kan dao zhe yi dian 。]

english: Oh yes, [player name] is apparently quite good.
translation: 哦，是的，[玩家名字]显然相当不错。 [o ， shi de ，[ wan jia ming zi ] xian ran xiang dang bu cuo 。]

english: It's been so long since I've had a decent set with a worthy opponent.
translation: 我已经很久没有和一个值得尊敬的对手打过一场像样的比赛了。 [wo yi jing hen jiu mei you he yi ge zhi de zun jing de dui shou da guo yi chang xiang yang de bi sai le 。]

english: Chin up bucko, I'm here and ready to challenge your rule of these alleys!
translation: 鼓起勇气，我来了，准备挑战你对这些小巷的统治！ [gu qi yong qi ， wo lai le ， zhun bei tiao zhan ni dui zhe xie xiao xiang de tong zhi ！]

english: Well, I suppose I'm not doing anything else. Why not?
translation: 好吧，我想我没有做任何其他事情。为什么不呢？ [hao ba ， wo xiang wo mei you zuo ren he qi ta shi qing 。 wei shen me bu ne ？]

english: The player bowls down 3 carrot pins.
translation: 玩家投下 3 个胡萝卜针。 [wan jia tou xia  3  ge hu luo bo zhen 。]

english: A fine shot, but not quite enough!
translation: 拍得不错，但还不够！ [pai de bu cuo ， dan hai bu gou ！]

english: Watch this!
translation: 注意这个！ [zhu yi zhe ge ！]

english: The Easter Bunny bowls a strike.
translation: 复活节兔子投出好球。 [fu huo jie tu zi tou chu hao qiu 。]

english: A lucky strike?
translation: 幸运的一击？ [xing yun de yi ji ？]

english: I'd better shape up or this will be quite one sided.
translation: 我最好调整一下状态，否则这将是非常片面的。 [wo zui hao tiao zheng yi xia zhuang tai ， fou ze zhe jiang shi fei chang pian mian de 。]

english: And that would be no fun at all.
translation: 那一点也不有趣。 [na yi dian ye bu you qu 。]

english: The player bowls down the middle 6 pins.
translation: 玩家在中间的 6 个球瓶上投球。 [wan jia zai zhong jian de  6  ge qiu ping shang tou qiu 。]

english: Ah, so you have some fight in you.
translation: 啊，所以你心里有一些斗争。 [a ， suo yi ni xin li you yi xie dou zheng 。]

english: I could do this all day.
translation: 我可以这样做一整天。 [wo ke yi zhe yang zuo yi zheng tian 。]

english: That's exactly what I wanted to hear!
translation: 这正是我想听到的！ [zhe zheng shi wo xiang ting dao de ！]

english: The screen fades black with the text "Some time later..."
translation: 屏幕变黑，并显示“稍后……”的文字。 [ping mu bian hei ， bing xian shi “ shao hou ……” de wen zi 。]

english: I'm surprised I hadn't heard about your prowess before, [player name].
translation: 我很惊讶我之前没有听说过你的实力，[玩家名字]。 [wo hen jing ya wo zhi qian mei you ting shuo guo ni de shi li ，[ wan jia ming zi ]。]

english: Ah you know me, the most modest adventurer in Gielinor.
translation: 啊，你认识我，吉利诺最谦虚的冒险家。 [a ， ni ren shi wo ， ji li nuo zui qian xu de mao xian jia 。]

english: Ah, well I suppose I should pack it in while I'm ahead.
translation: 啊，好吧，我想我应该趁我还在前面的时候把它收拾好。 [a ， hao ba ， wo xiang wo ying gai chen wo hai zai qian mian de shi hou ba ta shou shi hao 。]

english: But we should do this again.
translation: 但我们应该再做一次。 [dan wo men ying gai zai zuo yi ci 。]

english: Aye we should! Also if you could get the word out about my establishment, I'll be raking it in!
translation: 是的，我们应该！另外，如果您能宣传我的机构，我会大赚一笔！ [shi de ， wo men ying gai ！ ling wai ， ru guo nin neng xuan chuan wo de ji gou ， wo hui da zhuan yi bi ！]

english: I mean... The Rabbit Hole will enjoy all the visitors?
translation: 我的意思是……兔子洞会吸引所有游客？ [wo de yi si shi …… tu zi dong hui xi yin suo you you ke ？]

english: Well, anyway...
translation: 好吧，无论如何…… [hao ba ， wu lun ru he ……]

english: It was a close match. How are you feeling now?
translation: 这是一场势均力敌的比赛。你现在感觉怎么样？ [zhe shi yi chang shi jun li di de bi sai 。 ni xian zai gan jue zen me yang ？]

english: Oh it was fun but I think I'm just going to sit in the Rabbit Hole a bit longer.
translation: 哦，这很有趣，但我想我只是要在兔子洞里多待一会儿。 [o ， zhe hen you qu ， dan wo xiang wo zhi shi yao zai tu zi dong li duo dai yi hui er 。]

english: I should be off. Always a pleasure, Bowley.
translation: 我该走了。总是很高兴，鲍利。 [wo gai zou le 。 zong shi hen gao xing ， bao li 。]

english: Aye, till next time.
translation: 是的，下次见。 [shi de ， xia ci jian 。]

english: This is the Rabbit Hole.
translation: 这就是兔子洞。 [zhe jiu shi tu zi dong 。]

english: Who me? Nah I'm just a mole.
translation: 我是谁？不，我只是一颗鼹鼠。 [wo shi shui ？ bu ， wo zhi shi yi ke yan shu 。]

english: Well that went well!
translation: 嗯，一切顺利！ [n ， yi qie shun li ！]

english: We may have gotten away with it!
translation: 我们可能已经逃脱了它！ [wo men ke neng yi jing tao tuo le ta ！]

english: Oi, not so loud.
translation: 哎呀，别那么大声。 [ai ya ， bie na me da sheng 。]

english: Don't worry I'm sure those excessively large ears are just for show!
translation: 别担心，我确信那些过大的耳朵只是为了炫耀！ [bie dan xin ， wo que xin na xie guo da de er duo zhi shi wei le xuan yao ！]

english: Aye reyt.
translation: 是的，雷特。 [shi de ， lei te 。]

english: He seems to have more of a spring in his step.
translation: 他的脚步似乎更有弹性了。 [ta de jiao bu si hu geng you tan xing le 。]

english: But still not quite himself.
translation: 但仍然不完全是他自己。 [dan reng ran bu wan quan shi ta zi ji 。]

english: I'll see if anyone else around here can help.
translation: 我看看这里是否还有其他人可以提供帮助。 [wo kan kan zhe li shi fou hai you qi ta ren ke yi ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: With Long Ears Johnson looking a bit more chipper, hopefully we'll get the Egg deliveries finally.
translation: 长耳约翰逊看起来精神了一些，希望我们最终能收到鸡蛋。 [zhang er yue han xun kan qi lai jing shen le yi xie ， xi wang wo men zui zhong neng shou dao ji dan 。]

english: Hello Bowley, I didn't expect you up here!
translation: 你好鲍利，我没想到你会在这里！ [ni hao bao li ， wo mei xiang dao ni hui zai zhe li ！]

english: And why would that be? I deserve an Egg too, look how much I'm helping out!
translation: 为什么会这样呢？我也值得一个鸡蛋，看看我帮了多大忙！ [wei shen me hui zhe yang ne ？ wo ye zhi de yi ge ji dan ， kan kan wo bang le duo da mang ！]

english: Oh it's just bright is all, we don't often get moles here on the surface.
translation: 哦，只是明亮而已，我们的表面不常有痣。 [o ， zhi shi ming liang er yi ， wo men de biao mian bu chang you zhi 。]

english: Hm yes, I could do with something to keep the sun out of my eyes.
translation: 嗯，是的，我可以做点什么来防止阳光照射到我的眼睛。 [n ， shi de ， wo ke yi zuo dian shen me lai fang zhi yang guang zhao she dao wo de yan jing 。]

english: A new machine perhaps that could lift a whole load of earth and hold it over my head!
translation: 也许有一台新机器可以举起一整块土并把它举过我的头顶！ [ye xu you yi tai xin ji qi ke yi ju qi yi zheng kuai tu bing ba ta ju guo wo de tou ding ！]

english: Well enjoy that thought!
translation: 好好享受这个想法吧！ [hao hao xiang shou zhe ge xiang fa ba ！]

english: The Easter Bunny is looking awfully glum this year.
translation: 今年的复活节兔子看起来非常闷闷不乐。 [jin nian de fu huo jie tu zi kan qi lai fei chang men men bu le 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Talk about bowling.
translation: 谈论保龄球。 [tan lun bao ling qiu 。]

english: Hello young man.
translation: 你好年轻人。 [ni hao nian qing ren 。]

english: The boy sobs.
translation: 男孩抽泣着。 [nan hai chou qi zhe 。]

english: What's the matter?
translation: 怎么了？ [zen me le ？]

english: I've kicked my ball over that hedge, into that garden! The old lady who lives there is scary... She's locked the ball in her wooden shed! Can you get my ball back for me please?
translation: 我已经把球踢过树篱，进入花园了！住在那里的老太太很可怕……她把球锁在她的木棚里了！你能帮我把球拿回来吗？ [wo yi jing ba qiu ti guo shu li ， jin ru hua yuan le ！ zhu zai na li de lao tai tai hen ke pa …… ta ba qiu suo zai ta de mu peng li le ！ ni neng bang wo ba qiu na hui lai ma ？]

english: Ok, I'll see what I can do.
translation: 好吧，我看看能做什么。 [hao ba ， wo kan kan neng zuo shen me 。]

english: Thanks mister!
translation: 谢谢先生！ [xie xie xian sheng ！]

english: Get it back yourself.
translation: 自己拿回来吧。 [zi ji na hui lai ba 。]

english: You're a meany!
translation: 你真是个小气鬼！ [ni zhen shi ge xiao qi gui ！]

english: The boy starts crying again.
translation: 男孩又开始哭了。 [nan hai you kai shi ku le 。]

english: Well if you're not going to answer, I'll go.
translation: 好吧，如果你不回答，那我就走了。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni bu hui da ， na wo jiu zou le 。]

english: The boy sniffs slightly.
translation: 男孩轻轻吸了吸鼻子。 [nan hai qing qing xi le xi bi zi 。]

english: Thank you for getting my ball back!
translation: 谢谢你把我的球拿回来！ [xie xie ni ba wo de qiu na hui lai ！]

english: What's the matter?
translation: 怎么了？ [zen me le ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Well if you're not going to answer, I'll go.
translation: 好吧，如果你不回答，那我就走了。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni bu hui da ， na wo jiu zou le 。]

english: You're a long way from home, what are you doing here?
translation: 你离家很远，你来这里做什么？ [ni li jia hen yuan ， ni lai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm on an expedition to try and extend the bounds of gnome knowledge. King Narnode has sent out a number of gnome explorers to map the furthest reaches of Gielinor.
translation: 我正在进行一次探险，试图扩展侏儒知识的范围。纳诺德国王派出了一些侏儒探险家去绘制吉林诺最远地区的地图。 [wo zheng zai jin xing yi ci tan xian ， shi tu kuo zhan zhu ru zhi shi de fan wei 。 na nuo de guo wang pai chu le yi xie zhu ru tan xian jia qu hui zhi ji lin nuo zui yuan di qu de di tu 。]

english: Seems like a hard job.
translation: 看起来是一项艰巨的工作。 [kan qi lai shi yi xiang jian ju de gong zuo 。]

english: Oh no, I enjoy it - I've always had itchy feet ever since I was a little gnome.
translation: 哦，不，我喜欢它——自从我还是个小侏儒以来，我的脚就一直很痒。 [o ， bu ， wo xi huan ta —— zi cong wo hai shi ge xiao zhu ru yi lai ， wo de jiao jiu yi zhi hen yang 。]

english: Still, you seem to have drawn the short straw here - there's nothing but snow...
translation: 不过，你似乎已经抽到了最后一根稻草——除了雪什么也没有...... [bu guo ， ni si hu yi jing chou dao le zui hou yi gen dao cao —— chu le xue shen me ye mei you ......]

english: Oh, I like it - very peaceful. Avoiding those Trolls can be tricky though.
translation: 哦，我喜欢它——非常平静。不过，避开这些巨魔可能很棘手。 [o ， wo xi huan ta —— fei chang ping jing 。 bu guo ， bi kai zhe xie ju mo ke neng hen ji shou 。]

english: Tell me about it...
translation: 告诉我这件事... [gao su wo zhe jian shi ...]

english: What does this mint cake do?
translation: 这个薄荷蛋糕有什么作用呢？ [zhe ge bo he dan gao you shen me zuo yong ne ？]

english: Gnomish mint cake is a great source of energy for the gnome traveller. It will give you that extra bit of zip when you are running out of steam.
translation: 侏儒薄荷蛋糕是侏儒旅行者的重要能量来源。当你精疲力竭时，它会给你额外的动力。 [zhu ru bo he dan gao shi zhu ru lv xing zhe de zhong yao neng liang lai yuan 。 dang ni jing pi li jie shi ， ta hui gei ni e wai de dong li 。]

english: Ooh, that might come in very handy. Do you have any spare?
translation: 哦，这可能会非常方便。你还有空余的吗？ [o ， zhe ke neng hui fei chang fang bian 。 ni hai you kong yu de ma ？]

english: I need all the mint cake I have, I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕我需要所有的薄荷蛋糕。 [kong pa wo xu yao suo you de bo he dan gao 。]

english: What does this seed pod do?
translation: 这个种子荚有什么作用？ [zhe ge zhong zi jia you shen me zuo yong ？]

translation: 啊，大树的籽荚，真是一件令人着迷的灵器啊。这是一件非常有用的东西，尽管人们必须尊重它，因为大树与其所有部分都有联系，无论它们有多远 [a ， da shu de zi jia ， zhen shi yi jian ling ren zhao mi de ling qi a 。 zhe shi yi jian fei chang you yong de dong xi ， jin guan ren men bi xu zun zhong ta ， yin wei da shu yu qi suo you bu fen dou you lian xi ， wu lun ta men you duo yuan]

english: may be. How do you think the Spirit Trees work?

english: Excellent idea, I'll do that. Thanks.
translation: 好主意，我会这么做的。谢谢。 [hao zhu yi ， wo hui zhe me zuo de 。 xie xie 。]

translation: 如果你想看有人与祖拉战斗，请随意借用我的望远镜。 [ru guo ni xiang kan you ren yu zu la zhan dou ， qing sui yi jie yong wo de wang yuan jing 。]

translation: 你是什​​么意思？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: Zulrah, the giant snake. Its lair is deep in the swamp, so I've set up a telescope so I can watch people fighting it.
translation: 祖拉，巨蛇。它的巢穴在沼泽深处，所以我架起了望远镜，这样我就可以观察人们与它的战斗。 [zu la ， ju she 。 ta de chao xue zai zhao ze shen chu ， suo yi wo jia qi le wang yuan jing ， zhe yang wo jiu ke yi guan cha ren men yu ta de zhan dou 。]
