english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Nilsal, traveller. I was injured while exploring down here. Could you spare me some cooked fish, meat or vegetables?
translation: 尼尔萨尔，旅行者。我在这里探索时受伤了。你能给我一些煮熟的鱼、肉或蔬菜吗？ [ni er sa er ， lv xing zhe 。 wo zai zhe li tan suo shi shou shang le 。 ni neng gei wo yi xie zhu shu de yu 、 rou huo shu cai ma ？]

english: It just so happens that I have some with me!
translation: 正好我身上也有一些！ [zheng hao wo shen shang ye you yi xie ！]

english: Oh, please hand it over if you can spare it.
translation: 哦，如果你能省下来的话，请把它交出来。 [o ， ru guo ni neng sheng xia lai de hua ， qing ba ta jiao chu lai 。]

english: I'm afraid that I don't have any of that type of food with me.
translation: 恐怕我身上没有那种食物。 [kong pa wo shen shang mei you na zhong shi wu 。]

english: Oh, well if you return with any I would greatly appreciate it.
translation: 哦，如果你能带着任何东西回来，我将不胜感激。 [o ， ru guo ni neng dai zhe ren he dong xi hui lai ， wo jiang bu sheng gan ji 。]

english: No thanks. I would rather eat fish, meat or vegetables.
translation: 不，谢谢。我宁愿吃鱼、肉或蔬菜。 [bu ， xie xie 。 wo ning yuan chi yu 、 rou huo shu cai 。]

english: Thanks for helping me. Is there anything you'd like to know about this temple? If you find anything in here, show it to me and I'll tell you what I know about it.
translation: 谢谢你帮助我。关于这座寺庙，你有什么想了解的吗？如果你在这里发现任何东西，请给我看，我会告诉你我所知道的。 [xie xie ni bang zhu wo 。 guan yu zhe zuo si miao ， ni you shen me xiang liao jie de ma ？ ru guo ni zai zhe li fa xian ren he dong xi ， qing gei wo kan ， wo hui gao su ni wo suo zhi dao de 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This place probably had a name at some point but it has long since been forgotten. The Arceuus librarians refer to this place as the Forthos Dungeon.
translation: 这个地方可能在某个时候有过名字，但早已被遗忘了。阿尔宙斯图书馆员将这个地方称为福索斯地牢。 [zhe ge di fang ke neng zai mou ge shi hou you guo ming zi ， dan zao yi bei yi wang le 。 a er zhou si tu shu guan yuan jiang zhe ge di fang cheng wei fu suo si di lao 。]

english: It is rumoured that this place used to be of religious significance to druidic followers of both Ralos and Ranul.
translation: 据传，这个地方曾经对拉洛斯和拉努尔的德鲁伊追随者具有宗教意义。 [ju chuan ， zhe ge di fang ceng jing dui la luo si he la nu er de de lu yi zhui sui zhe ju you zong jiao yi yi 。]

english: Who are Ralos and Ranul?
translation: 拉洛斯和拉努尔是谁？ [la luo si he la nu er shi shui ？]

english: According to religious texts, Ralos is the god of the sun and Ranul, his brother, is the god of the moon.
translation: 根据宗教文献，拉洛斯是太阳神，他的兄弟拉努尔是月亮神。 [gen ju zong jiao wen xian ， la luo si shi tai yang shen ， ta de xiong di la nu er shi yue liang shen 。]

english: If you find any artifacts or relics from within this temple, I would be very interested in seeing them.
translation: 如果您在这座寺庙内发现任何文物或遗物，我将非常有兴趣参观它们。 [ru guo nin zai zhe zuo si miao nei fa xian ren he wen wu huo yi wu ， wo jiang fei chang you xing qu can guan ta men 。]

english: I'll see what I find. Although, I've never heard of Ralos and Ranul.
translation: 我会看看我发现了什么。不过，我从未听说过拉洛斯和拉努尔。 [wo hui kan kan wo fa xian le shen me 。 bu guo ， wo cong wei ting shuo guo la luo si he la nu er 。]

english: You need only to look up and see their greatness above you when you return to the surface.
translation: 当您返回地面时，您只需抬起头就能看到它们在您上方的伟大之处。 [dang nin fan hui di mian shi ， nin zhi xu tai qi tou jiu neng kan dao ta men zai nin shang fang de wei da zhi chu 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: My name is Brother Aimeri, I am a travelling monk from the distant land of Varlamore on a journey to uncover the secrets of this temple.
translation: 我的名字是艾梅里修士，我是一位来自遥远的瓦拉莫尔之地的旅行僧侣，踏上揭开这座寺庙秘密的旅程。 [wo de ming zi shi ai mei li xiu shi ， wo shi yi wei lai zi yao yuan de wa la mo er zhi di de lv xing seng lv ， ta shang jie kai zhe zuo si miao mi mi de lv cheng 。]

english: I worship Ralos, a common practice where I am from. However, I found out that our order may have originated from this temple. If you find anything of interest, please let me know.
translation: 我崇拜拉洛斯（Ralos），这是我来自的地方的一种常见习俗。然而，我发现我们的订单可能源自这座寺庙。如果您发现任何感兴趣的内容，请告诉我。 [wo chong bai la luo si （Ralos）， zhe shi wo lai zi de di fang de yi zhong chang jian xi su 。 ran er ， wo fa xian wo men de ding dan ke neng yuan zi zhe zuo si miao 。 ru guo nin fa xian ren he gan xing qu de nei rong ， qing gao su wo 。]

english: I'll keep my eyes open.
translation: 我会睁大眼睛。 [wo hui zheng da yan jing 。]

english: You have my gratitude. Any information you do find would also be of interest to the Arceuus Library. I hope we can uncover the secrets of this place for the greater good.
translation: 你有我的感激之情。 Arceuus 图书馆也会对您找到的任何信息感兴趣。我希望我们能够为了更大的利益揭开这个地方的秘密。 [ni you wo de gan ji zhi qing 。 Arceuus  tu shu guan ye hui dui nin zhao dao de ren he xin xi gan xing qu 。 wo xi wang wo men neng gou wei le geng da de li yi jie kai zhe ge di fang de mi mi 。]

english: The greater good.
translation: 更大的好处。 [geng da de hao chu 。]

english: How did you get injured?
translation: 你是怎么受伤的？ [ni shi zen me shou shang de ？]

english: I found out about this place from Logosia in the Arceuus Library. I came to investigate but was ambushed by the spiders in the room to the north.
translation: 我是从阿尔修斯图书馆的洛西亚那里得知这个地方的。我前来探查，却在北面的房间里遭到了蜘蛛的伏击。 [wo shi cong a er xiu si tu shu guan de luo xi ya na li de zhi zhe ge di fang de 。 wo qian lai tan cha ， que zai bei mian de fang jian li zao dao le zhi zhu de fu ji 。]

english: I'm a scholar not a fighter. I didn't have time to think through my options so I did what came naturally and ran away.
translation: 我是一个学者而不是一个战士。我没有时间考虑我的选择，所以我就自然而然地逃跑了。 [wo shi yi ge xue zhe er bu shi yi ge zhan shi 。 wo mei you shi jian kao lv wo de xuan ze ， suo yi wo jiu zi ran er ran di tao pao le 。]

english: Why didn't you decide to run back the way you came from instead of running further into the dungeon where there could be more dangerous creatures?
translation: 你为什么不决定从来时的路跑回去，而是跑到更远的地牢里，那里可能有更危险的生物？ [ni wei shen me bu jue ding cong lai shi de lu pao hui qu ， er shi pao dao geng yuan de di lao li ， na li ke neng you geng wei xian de sheng wu ？]

english: See, the problem with that... Is that it is an excellent idea I wish I had thought of at the time.
translation: 你看，问题在于……这是一个很好的主意，我希望我当时就想到了。 [ni kan ， wen ti zai yu …… zhe shi yi ge hen hao de zhu yi ， wo xi wang wo dang shi jiu xiang dao le 。]

english: You've been trapped here for a while! No wonder you were hungry!
translation: 你被困在这里已经有一段时间了！难怪你饿了！ [ni bei kun zai zhe li yi jing you yi duan shi jian le ！ nan guai ni e le ！]

english: I found a strange creature possessing an adventurer within the dungeon and it has cursed one of the altars. Do you know how I can remove it?
translation: 我在地牢里发现了一种奇怪的生物，它附身于一名冒险家，它诅咒了其中一个祭坛。你知道我怎样才能删除它吗？ [wo zai di lao li fa xian le yi zhong qi guai de sheng wu ， ta fu shen yu yi ming mao xian jia ， ta zu zhou le qi zhong yi ge ji tan 。 ni zhi dao wo zen yang cai neng shan chu ta ma ？]

english: How strange. Tell me, what did the creature look like?
translation: 多么奇怪啊。告诉我，这个生物长什么样子？ [duo me qi guai a 。 gao su wo ， zhe ge sheng wu zhang shen me yang zi ？]

english: It was a dark black creature with a white skull on its head and curved horns.
translation: 这是一种深黑色的生物，头上长着白色的头骨，长着弯曲的角。 [zhe shi yi zhong shen hei se de sheng wu ， tou shang zhang zhe bai se de tou gu ， zhang zhe wan qu de jiao 。]

english: Let me see... According to my notes that appears to have been a Shaeded Beast, a vile creature which posseses people and corrupts their minds.
translation: 让我想想……根据我的记录，那似乎是一只暗影兽，一种邪恶的生物，会附身于人类并腐蚀他们的思想。 [rang wo xiang xiang …… gen ju wo de ji lu ， na si hu shi yi zhi an ying shou ， yi zhong xie e de sheng wu ， hui fu shen yu ren lei bing fu shi ta men de si xiang 。]

english: Only the power of Ralos can remove such a curse. I suggest making an offering to Ralos somewhere within this temple.
translation: 只有拉洛斯的力量才能解除这样的诅咒。我建议在这座寺庙的某个地方向拉洛斯供奉。 [zhi you la luo si de li liang cai neng jie chu zhe yang de zu zhou 。 wo jian yi zai zhe zuo si miao de mou ge di fang xiang la luo si gong feng 。]

english: What kind of sacrifice should I offer?
translation: 我应该献上什么样的牺牲？ [wo ying gai xian shang shen me yang de xi sheng ？]

english: As Ralos is the sun god, any normal bone just won't do. I'd recommend the bones of any dragon.
translation: 由于拉洛斯是太阳神，任何普通的骨头都行不通。我会推荐任何龙的骨头。 [you yu la luo si shi tai yang shen ， ren he pu tong de gu tou dou xing bu tong 。 wo hui tui jian ren he long de gu tou 。]

english: I'd advise staying away from the altar in the mean time.
translation: 我建议在此期间远离祭坛。 [wo jian yi zai ci qi jian yuan li ji tan 。]

english: Thanks. I'll have a look around.
translation: 谢谢。我会四处看看。 [xie xie 。 wo hui si chu kan kan 。]

english: I received a key from the bone burner but unfortunately I have lost it.
translation: 我从骨头燃烧器那里收到了一把钥匙，但不幸的是我把它弄丢了。 [wo cong gu tou ran shao qi na li shou dao le yi ba yao shi ， dan bu xing de shi wo ba ta nong diu le 。]

english: The great Ralos foresaw this and presented me with the same key for safe-keeping should you lose it.
translation: 伟大的拉洛斯预见到了这一点，并给了我同样的钥匙，以便万一你丢失了它，可以妥善保管。 [wei da de la luo si yu jian dao le zhe yi dian ， bing gei le wo tong yang de yao shi ， yi bian wan yi ni diu shi le ta ， ke yi tuo shan bao guan 。]

english: That's awfully convenient!
translation: 那真是太方便了！ [na zhen shi tai fang bian le ！]

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Disgusting! I don't know why you have that, I'd destroy them before they have a chance to hatch.
translation: 恶心！我不知道你为什么要这么做，我会在它们有机会孵化之前消灭它们。 [e xin ！ wo bu zhi dao ni wei shen me yao zhe me zuo ， wo hui zai ta men you ji hui fu hua zhi qian xiao mie ta men 。]

english: Actually, I believe they're used as supplies in potion making, they might have some use.
translation: 事实上，我相信它们是作为魔药制作的材料使用的，也许有一些用处。 [shi shi shang ， wo xiang xin ta men shi zuo wei mo yao zhi zuo de cai liao shi yong de ， ye xu you yi xie yong chu 。]

english: Do with it as you wish, just don't come crawling back to me if it comes back to bite you.
translation: 你想怎么处理就怎么处理吧，只是如果它回来咬你的话，别再爬回来找我了。 [ni xiang zen me chu li jiu zen me chu li ba ， zhi shi ru guo ta hui lai yao ni de hua ， bie zai pa hui lai zhao wo le 。]

english: I see what you did there.
translation: 我明白你在那里做了什么。 [wo ming bai ni zai na li zuo le shen me 。]

english: Hmm, interesting. I recall seeing a chest to the west of here further down the passage with colouring similar to this key. Perhaps this key opens that chest?
translation: 嗯，有趣。我记得在通道的西边看到一个箱子，颜色与这个钥匙相似。也许这把钥匙可以打开那个箱子？ [n ， you qu 。 wo ji de zai tong dao de xi bian kan dao yi ge xiang zi ， yan se yu zhe ge yao shi xiang si 。 ye xu zhe ba yao shi ke yi da kai na ge xiang zi ？]

english: Thanks for your help!
translation: 感谢您的帮助！ [gan xie nin de bang zhu ！]

english: My, you adventurer'sare a strange bunch. I suppose there is a reason why you have kept the creatureseyes in a jar?
translation: 天哪，你们冒险家真是一群奇怪的人。我想你把这些生物的眼睛放在罐子里是有原因的吗？ [tian na ， ni men mao xian jia zhen shi yi qun qi guai de ren 。 wo xiang ni ba zhe xie sheng wu de yan jing fang zai guan zi li shi you yuan yin de ma ？]

english: I'm not sure myself, though I've heard some people like to display items like this in their house.
translation: 我自己也不确定，但我听说有些人喜欢在家里展示这样的物品。 [wo zi ji ye bu que ding ， dan wo ting shuo you xie ren xi huan zai jia li zhan shi zhe yang de wu pin 。]

english: As I said, you are a strange bunch indeed.
translation: 正如我所说，你们确实是一群奇怪的人。 [zheng ru wo suo shuo ， ni men que shi shi yi qun qi guai de ren 。]

english: That looks like the legs of Sarachnis, bound together by her web. I suppose if anything, it looks heavy enough to crush your enemies.
translation: 这看起来就像萨拉奇尼斯的双腿，被她的网绑在一起。我想如果有什么不同的话，那就是它看起来足够重，足以压碎你的敌人。 [zhe kan qi lai jiu xiang sa la qi ni si de shuang tui ， bei ta de wang bang zai yi qi 。 wo xiang ru guo you shen me bu tong de hua ， na jiu shi ta kan qi lai zu gou zhong ， zu yi ya sui ni de di ren 。]

english: Hey, let go of me! What are you doing?
translation: 嘿，放开我！你在干什么？ [hei ， fang kai wo ！ ni zai gan shen me ？]

english: It talks?
translation: 会说话吗？ [hui shuo hua ma ？]

english: Yeah, I killed Sarachnis and she started following me, I think she's cute so I've decided to keep her around.
translation: 是的，我杀了萨拉奇尼斯，她开始跟着我，我觉得她很可爱，所以我决定把她留在身边。 [shi de ， wo sha le sa la qi ni si ， ta kai shi gen zhe wo ， wo jue de ta hen ke ai ， suo yi wo jue ding ba ta liu zai shen bian 。]

english: Do as you wish. I've certainly seen people keep worse company than a spider.
translation: 随你所愿吧。 I've certainly seen people keep worse company than a spider. [sui ni suo yuan ba 。 I've certainly seen people keep worse company than a spider.]

english: Oh, very interesting. This page appears to be taken from a religious script which speaks of Ranul.
translation: 哦，很有趣。此页似乎取自有关拉努尔的宗教文字。 [o ， hen you qu 。 ci ye si hu qu zi you guan la nu er de zong jiao wen zi 。]

english: This is very sad. To see such religious scripts desecrated, it's blasphemy!
translation: 这是非常悲伤的。看到这样的宗教文字被亵渎，这是亵渎！ [zhe shi fei chang bei shang de 。 kan dao zhe yang de zong jiao wen zi bei xie du ， zhe shi xie du ！]

english: Perhaps the script still exists?
translation: 也许剧本还存在？ [ye xu ju ben hai cun zai ？]

english: Yes, yes! I hope so. I would expect a temple of this nature to have a library of sorts within it. Maybe the original is somewhere within it.
translation: 是的，是的！我希望如此。我希望这种性质的寺庙里面有一个图书馆之类的。也许原作就在其中的某个地方。 [shi de ， shi de ！ wo xi wang ru ci 。 wo xi wang zhe zhong xing zhi di si miao li mian you yi ge tu shu guan zhi lei de 。 ye xu yuan zuo jiu zai qi zhong de mou ge di fang 。]

english: I'll have a look for it. Thanks for your help!
translation: 我去看看。感谢您的帮助！ [wo qu kan kan 。 gan xie nin de bang zhu ！]

english: Oh, very interesting. This page appears to be taken from a religious script which speaks of Ralos.
translation: 哦，很有趣。此页似乎取自有关拉洛斯的宗教文字。 [o ， hen you qu 。 ci ye si hu qu zi you guan la luo si de zong jiao wen zi 。]

english: Oh, very interesting. This page appears to be taken from a historical script about the temple itself.
translation: 哦，很有趣。此页面似乎取自有关寺庙本身的历史脚本。 [o ， hen you qu 。 ci ye mian si hu qu zi you guan si miao ben shen de li shi jiao ben 。]

english: This is very sad. To see such information desecrated in this way.
translation: 这是非常悲伤的。看到这样的信息被这样亵渎。 [zhe shi fei chang bei shang de 。 kan dao zhe yang de xin xi bei zhe yang xie du 。]

english: No! Keep that away from me! I can sense an ominous power coming from that coin. Where did you find it?
translation: 不！让那个离我远点！我能感觉到那枚硬币散发出一股不祥的力量。你在哪里找到的？ [bu ！ rang na ge li wo yuan dian ！ wo neng gan jue dao na mei ying bi san fa chu yi gu bu xiang de li liang 。 ni zai na li zhao dao de ？]

english: A fellow adventurer I met within the temple had it on him. What should I do with it?
translation: 我在神殿里遇到的一位冒险家伙伴身上就带着它。我应该用它做什么？ [wo zai shen dian li yu dao de yi wei mao xian jia huo ban shen shang jiu dai zhe ta 。 wo ying gai yong ta zuo shen me ？]

english: I'd find out where it came from and put it back immediately.
translation: 我会找出它从哪里来并立即把它放回去。 [wo hui zhao chu ta cong na li lai bing li ji ba ta fang hui qu 。]

english: The markings on it resemble that of the cult of Ranul, I'd look around for something of religious significance to them.
translation: 上面的标记类似于拉努尔崇拜的标记，我会四处寻找对他们具有宗教意义的东西。 [shang mian de biao ji lei si yu la nu er chong bai de biao ji ， wo hui si chu xun zhao dui ta men ju you zong jiao yi yi de dong xi 。]

english: Fascinating. I'm not quite sure what this is for, perhaps there are doors within the temple which this unlocks?
translation: 迷人。我不太确定这是做什么的，也许寺庙里有门可以打开？ [mi ren 。 wo bu tai que ding zhe shi zuo shen me de ， ye xu si miao li you men ke yi da kai ？]

english: Amazing! This is exactly what I was looking for. This tome contains information about the religion of Ranul.
translation: 惊人的！这正是我一直在寻找的。这本书包含有关拉努尔宗教的信息。 [jing ren de ！ zhe zheng shi wo yi zhi zai xun zhao de 。 zhe ben shu bao han you guan la nu er zong jiao de xin xi 。]

english: Oh, it appears that there are some pages missing from it. The missing information could prove valuable.
translation: 哦，好像少了几页。缺失的信息可能被证明是有价值的。 [o ， hao xiang shao le ji ye 。 que shi de xin xi ke neng bei zheng ming shi you jia zhi de 。]

english: Where do you think the missing pages are?
translation: 你认为缺失的页面在哪里？ [ni ren wei que shi de ye mian zai na li ？]

english: This Temple has been abandoned for some time. Maybe the creatures within have destroyed the tome while looking for food. You may have to kill them to recover the pages.
translation: 这座寺庙已经废弃有一段时间了。也许里面的生物在寻找食物时摧毁了这本书。您可能必须杀死它们才能恢复页面。 [zhe zuo si miao yi jing fei qi you yi duan shi jian le 。 ye xu li mian de sheng wu zai xun zhao shi wu shi cui hui le zhe ben shu 。 nin ke neng bi xu sha si ta men cai neng hui fu ye mian 。]

english: The book seems to be intact! I'm sure Logosia in the Arceuus Library to the north would find this information valuable.
translation: 书好像完好无损！我相信北方阿尔修斯图书馆的洛西亚会发现这些信息很有价值。 [shu hao xiang wan hao wu sun ！ wo xiang xin bei fang a er xiu si tu shu guan de luo xi ya hui fa xian zhe xie xin xi hen you jia zhi 。]

english: Amazing! This is exactly what I was looking for. This tome contains information about the religion of Ralos.
translation: 惊人的！这正是我一直在寻找的。这本书包含有关拉洛斯宗教的信息。 [jing ren de ！ zhe zheng shi wo yi zhi zai xun zhao de 。 zhe ben shu bao han you guan la luo si zong jiao de xin xi 。]

english: Amazing! This is exactly what I was looking for. This tome contains information about the temple itself.
translation: 惊人的！这正是我一直在寻找的。这本书包含有关寺庙本身的信息。 [jing ren de ！ zhe zheng shi wo yi zhi zai xun zhao de 。 zhe ben shu bao han you guan si miao ben shen de xin xi 。]

english: I'm afraid I don't know anything about that item.
translation: 恐怕我对那件事一无所知。 [kong pa wo dui na jian shi yi wu suo zhi 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: How did you get injured?
translation: 你是怎么受伤的？ [ni shi zen me shou shang de ？]

english: Ask about the cursed altar.
translation: 询问关于被诅咒的祭坛的事情。 [xun wen guan yu bei zu zhou de ji tan de shi qing 。]

english: Ask about the Temple Key
translation: 询问关于寺庙钥匙的问题 [xun wen guan yu si miao yao shi de wen ti]

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Very nice rosebushes you have here.
translation: 这里有非常漂亮的玫瑰花丛。 [zhe li you fei chang piao liang de mei gui hua cong 。]

english: Yes, it has taken me many long hours in this garden to bring them to this state of near-perfection.
translation: 是的，我在这个花园里花了很长时间才让它们达到近乎完美的状态。 [shi de ， wo zai zhe ge hua yuan li hua le hen zhang shi jian cai rang ta men da dao jin hu wan mei de zhuang tai 。]

english: Good day, brother.
translation: 美好的一天，兄弟。 [mei hao de yi tian ， xiong di 。]

english: Hello, I'm Brother Brace. I'm here to tell you all about Prayer.
translation: 大家好，我是布雷斯弟兄。我来这里是为了告诉你们关于祈祷的一切。 [da jia hao ， wo shi bu lei si di xiong 。 wo lai zhe li shi wei le gao su ni men guan yu qi dao de yi qie 。]

english: You should open the indicated menu to continue.
translation: 您应该打开指示的菜单才能继续。 [nin ying gai da kai zhi shi de cai dan cai neng ji xu 。]

english: This is your Prayer list. Prayers can help a lot in combat. Click on the prayer you wish to use to activate it, and click it again to deactivate it.
translation: 这是你的祷告清单。祈祷对战斗有很大帮助。单击您想要使用的祈祷以激活它，然后再次单击以停用它。 [zhe shi ni de dao gao qing dan 。 qi dao dui zhan dou you hen da bang zhu 。 dan ji nin xiang yao shi yong de qi dao yi ji huo ta ， ran hou zai ci dan ji yi ting yong ta 。]

english: Active prayers will drain your Prayer Points, which you can recharge by finding an altar or other holy spot and praying there.
translation: 积极的祈祷会耗尽你的祈祷点，你可以通过找到祭坛或其他圣地并在那里祈祷来补充祈祷点。 [ji ji de qi dao hui hao jin ni de qi dao dian ， ni ke yi tong guo zhao dao ji tan huo qi ta sheng di bing zai na li qi dao lai bu chong qi dao dian 。]

english: As you noticed, most enemies will drop bones when defeated. Burying bones, by clicking them in your inventory, will gain you Prayer experience.
translation: 正如您所注意到的，大多数敌人在被击败时都会掉落骨头。通过在库存中点击骨头来埋葬骨头，将为您获得祈祷经验。 [zheng ru nin suo zhu yi dao de ， da duo shu di ren zai bei ji bai shi du hui diao luo gu tou 。 tong guo zai ku cun zhong dian ji gu tou lai mai zang gu tou ， jiang wei nin huo de qi dao jing yan 。]

english: I'm also the community officer 'round here, so it's my job to tell you about your friends and ignore lists.
translation: 我也是这里的社区官员，所以我的工作就是告诉你关于你的朋友和忽略列表的信息。 [wo ye shi zhe li de she qu guan yuan ， suo yi wo de gong zuo jiu shi gao su ni guan yu ni de peng you he hu lve lie biao de xin xi 。]

english: Right. Now I'll tell you a little about each list. You can add people to either list by clicking the add button then typing their name into the box that appears.
translation: 正确的。现在我将向您介绍一下每个列表。您可以通过单击“添加”按钮，然后在出现的框中输入他们的名字，将人员添加到任一列表中。 [zheng que de 。 xian zai wo jiang xiang nin jie shao yi xia mei ge lie biao 。 nin ke yi tong guo dan ji “ tian jia ” an niu ， ran hou zai chu xian de kuang zhong shu ru ta men de ming zi ， jiang ren yuan tian jia dao ren yi lie biao zhong 。]

english: You remove people from the lists in the same way. If you add someone to your ignore list they will not be able to talk to you or send any form of message to you.
translation: 您可以用相同的方式将人员从列表中删除。如果您将某人添加到您的忽略列表中，他们将无法与您交谈或向您发送任何形式的消息。 [nin ke yi yong xiang tong de fang shi jiang ren yuan cong lie biao zhong shan chu 。 ru guo nin jiang mou ren tian jia dao nin de hu lve lie biao zhong ， ta men jiang wu fa yu nin jiao tan huo xiang nin fa song ren he xing shi de xiao xi 。]

english: Your friends list shows the online status of your friends. Friends in red are offline, friends in green are online and on the same world and friends in yellow are online, but on a different world.
translation: 您的好友列表显示您好友的在线状态。红色的朋友离线，绿色的朋友在线，并且在同一个世界，黄色的朋友在线，但是在不同的世界。 [nin de hao you lie biao xian shi nin hao you de zai xian zhuang tai 。 hong se de peng you li xian ， lv se de peng you zai xian ， bing qie zai tong yi ge shi jie ， huang se de peng you zai xian ， dan shi zai bu tong de shi jie 。]

english: Okay, thanks, I'll bear that in mind.
translation: 好的，谢谢，我会记住的。 [hao de ， xie xie ， wo hui ji zhu de 。]

english: Peace be with you, my child. Can I help you?
translation: 愿你平安，我的孩子。我可以帮你吗？ [yuan ni ping an ， wo de hai zi 。 wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: Ah, yes, your prayer list. Prayers can help a lot in combat. Click on the prayer you wish to use to activate it, and click it again to deactivate it.
translation: 啊，是的，你的祈祷清单。祈祷对战斗有很大帮助。单击您想要使用的祈祷以激活它，然后再次单击以停用它。 [a ， shi de ， ni de qi dao qing dan 。 qi dao dui zhan dou you hen da bang zhu 。 dan ji nin xiang yao shi yong de qi dao yi ji huo ta ， ran hou zai ci dan ji yi ting yong ta 。]

english: Do you need anything else?
translation: 您还需要什么吗？ [nin hai xu yao shen me ma ？]

english: Your friends and ignore lists, yes... I'll tell you a little about each. You can add people to either list by clicking the add button then typing their name into the box that appears.
translation: 你的朋友和忽略列表，是的......我会告诉你一些关于每一个的信息。您可以通过单击“添加”按钮，然后在出现的框中输入他们的名字，将人员添加到任一列表中。 [ni de peng you he hu lve lie biao ， shi de ...... wo hui gao su ni yi xie guan yu mei yi ge de xin xi 。 nin ke yi tong guo dan ji “ tian jia ” an niu ， ran hou zai chu xian de kuang zhong shu ru ta men de ming zi ， jiang ren yuan tian jia dao ren yi lie biao zhong 。]

english: Nope, I'm ready to move on!
translation: 不，我已经准备好继续前进了！ [bu ， wo yi jing zhun bei hao ji xu qian jin le ！]

english: Okay then.
translation: 那么好吧。 [na me hao ba 。]

english: Tell me about Prayers again.
translation: 再告诉我有关祈祷的事。 [zai gao su wo you guan qi dao de shi 。]

english: Tell me about my friends list again.
translation: 再次告诉我我的朋友名单。 [zai ci gao su wo wo de peng you ming dan 。]

english: Nope, I'm ready to move on!
translation: 不，我已经准备好继续前进了！ [bu ， wo yi jing zhun bei hao ji xu qian jin le ！]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Honey, money, woman and wine!
translation: 亲爱的、金钱、女人和酒！ [qin ai de 、 jin qian 、 nv ren he jiu ！]

english: Are you ok?
translation: 你还好吗？ [ni hai hao ma ？]

english: Yesshh...hic up...beautiful!
translation: 是的……打嗝……漂亮！ [shi de …… da ge …… piao liang ！]

english: Take care old monk.
translation: 照顾好老和尚。 [zhao gu hao lao he shang 。]

english: La..di..da..hic..up!
translation: 拉..迪..达..急..起来！ [la .. di .. da .. ji .. qi lai ！]

english: Brother Cedric are you okay?
translation: 塞德里克兄弟你还好吗？ [sai de li ke xiong di ni hai hao ma ？]

english: Yeesshhh, I'm very, very drunk..hic..up..
translation: 是的，我醉得很厉害……呃……起来…… [shi de ， wo zui de hen li hai …… e …… qi lai ……]

english: Brother Omad needs the wine for the party.
translation: 奥马德弟兄需要聚会用的酒。 [ao ma de di xiong xu yao ju hui yong de jiu 。]

english: Oh dear, oh dear, I knew I had to do something!
translation: 哦天哪，天哪，我知道我必须做点什么！ [o tian na ， tian na ， wo zhi dao wo bi xu zuo dian shen me ！]

english: Are you okay?
translation: 你还好吗？ [ni hai hao ma ？]

english: Hic up! Oh my head! I need a jug of water.
translation: 嗨起来！噢，我的头！我需要一壶水。 [hai qi lai ！ o ， wo de tou ！ wo xu yao yi hu shui 。]

english: I'll see if I can get some.
translation: 我看看能不能得到一些。 [wo kan kan neng bu neng de dao yi xie 。]

english: Thanks! *hic*
translation: 谢谢！ *嗝* [xie xie ！ * ge *]

english: Cedric! Here, drink! I have some water.
translation: 塞德里克！来，喝！我有一些水。 [sai de li ke ！ lai ， he ！ wo you yi xie shui 。]

english: Good stuff, my head's spinning!
translation: 好东西，我头晕了！ [hao dong xi ， wo tou yun le ！]

english: Aah! That's better!
translation: 啊啊！那就更好了！ [a a ！ na jiu geng hao le ！]

english: Now I just need to fix this cart and we can go party.
translation: 现在我只需要修好这辆车，我们就可以去聚会了。 [xian zai wo zhi xu yao xiu hao zhe liang che ， wo men jiu ke yi qu ju hui le 。]

english: Could you help?
translation: 你能帮忙吗？ [ni neng bang mang ma ？]

english: No, I've helped enough monks today!
translation: 不，我今天已经帮助了足够多的修士了！ [bu ， wo jin tian yi jing bang zhu le zu gou duo de xiu shi le ！]

english: In that case i'd better drink more wine! It helps me think.
translation: 既然如此，我还是多喝点酒吧！它帮助我思考。 [ji ran ru ci ， wo hai shi duo he dian jiu ba ！ ta bang zhu wo si kao 。]

english: Yes, I'd be happy to!
translation: 是的，我很乐意！ [shi de ， wo hen le yi ！]

english: Excellent, I just need some wood.
translation: 太好了，我只需要一些木头。 [tai hao le ， wo zhi xu yao yi xie mu tou 。]

english: OK, I'll see what I can find.
translation: 好的，我看看能找到什么。 [hao de ， wo kan kan neng zhao dao shen me 。]

english: Did you manage to get some wood?
translation: 你找到木头了吗？ [ni zhao dao mu tou le ma ？]

english: Not yet, I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕还没有。 [kong pa hai mei you 。]

english: Here you go!
translation: 干得好！ [gan de hao ！]

english: Well done! Now I'll fix this cart. You head back to Brother Omad and tell him I'll be there soon.
translation: 干得好！现在我要修好这辆购物车。你回到奥马德弟兄那里，告诉他我很快就到。 [gan de hao ！ xian zai wo yao xiu hao zhe liang gou wu che 。 ni hui dao ao ma de di xiong na li ， gao su ta wo hen kuai jiu dao 。]

english: Ok! I'll see you later!
translation: 好的！待会儿见！ [hao de ！ dai hui er jian ！]

english: Hello Cedric.
translation: 你好塞德里克。 [ni hao sai de li ke 。]

english: Hi, I'm almost done here. Could you tell Omad that I'll be back soon?
translation: 嗨，我已经快完成这里了。你能告诉奥马德我很快就会回来吗？ [hai ， wo yi jing kuai wan cheng zhe li le 。 ni neng gao su ao ma de wo hen kuai jiu hui hui lai ma ？]

english: Brother Omad sends you his thanks! He won't be in a fit state to thank you in person.
translation: 奥马德弟兄向您表示感谢！他不会以健康的状态亲自感谢你。 [ao ma de di xiong xiang nin biao shi gan xie ！ ta bu hui yi jian kang de zhuang tai qin zi gan xie ni 。]

english: No, I've helped enough monks today!
translation: 不，我今天已经帮助了足够多的修士了！ [bu ， wo jin tian yi jing bang zhu le zu gou duo de xiu shi le ！]

english: Yes, I'd be happy to!
translation: 是的，我很乐意！ [shi de ， wo hen le yi ！]

english: What can you do to help a bold adventurer like myself?
translation: 你能做些什么来帮助像我这样勇敢的冒险家？ [ni neng zuo xie shen me lai bang zhu xiang wo zhe yang yong gan de mao xian jia ？]

english: I can tell you about holy symbols or the Skillcape of Prayer.
translation: 我可以告诉你有关圣徽或祈祷技能斗篷的事。 [wo ke yi gao su ni you guan sheng hui huo qi dao ji neng dou peng de shi 。]

english: Tell me about holy symbols.
translation: 告诉我有关神圣符号的事情。 [gao su wo you guan shen sheng fu hao de shi qing 。]

english: If you have a silver star, which is the holy symbol of Saradomin, then I can bless it. Then if you are wearing it, it will help you when you are praying.
translation: 如果你有一颗银星，这是萨拉多明的圣徽，那么我可以祝福它。如果你戴着它，当你祈祷时它会帮助你。 [ru guo ni you yi ke yin xing ， zhe shi sa la duo ming de sheng hui ， na me wo ke yi zhu fu ta 。 ru guo ni dai zhe ta ， dang ni qi dao shi ta hui bang zhu ni 。]

english: Tell me about the Skillcape of Prayer.
translation: 告诉我有关祈祷技能的事情。 [gao su wo you guan qi dao ji neng de shi qing 。]

english: The Skillcape of Prayer is the hardest of all the skillcapes to get; it requires much devotion to acquire but also imbues the wearer with the ability to briefly fly!
translation: 祈祷技能斗篷是所有技能斗篷中最难获得的；它需要付出很大的努力才能获得，但也赋予佩戴者短暂飞行的能力！ [qi dao ji neng dou peng shi suo you ji neng dou peng zhong zui nan huo de de ； ta xu yao fu chu hen da de nu li cai neng huo de ， dan ye fu yu pei dai zhe duan zan fei xing de neng li ！]

english: The Cape of Prayer also increases the amount of Prayer points restored from drinking potions when it is equipped. Is there something else I can do for you?
translation: 装备祈祷斗篷后，饮用药水恢复的祈祷点数也会增加。我还能为您做点什么吗？ [zhuang bei qi dao dou peng hou ， yin yong yao shui hui fu de qi dao dian shu ye hui zeng jia 。 wo hai neng wei nin zuo dian shen me ma ？]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Well I can bless that star of Saradomin you have, or I could tell you about the Skillcape of Prayer!
translation: 好吧，我可以祝福你拥有的萨拉多明之星，或者我可以告诉你有关祈祷技能斗篷的事！ [hao ba ， wo ke yi zhu fu ni yong you de sa la duo ming zhi xing ， huo zhe wo ke yi gao su ni you guan qi dao ji neng dou peng de shi ！]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: You give Jered the symbol. Jered closes his eyes and places his hand on the symbol. He softly chants. Jered passes you the holy symbol.
translation: 你给杰瑞德这个符号。杰里德闭上眼睛，将手放在符号上。他轻声吟诵。杰瑞德将圣徽传给你。 [ni gei jie rui de zhe ge fu hao 。 jie li de bi shang yan jing ， jiang shou fang zai fu hao shang 。 ta qing sheng yin song 。 jie rui de jiang sheng hui chuan gei ni 。]

english: Well, seeing as you are so devout in praising the gods, I could sell you a Skillcape of Prayer, which increases the amount of Prayer points restored when drinking potions.
translation: 好吧，看你如此虔诚地赞美神灵，我可以卖给你一个祈祷技能斗篷，它可以增加喝药水时恢复的祈祷点数量。 [hao ba ， kan ni ru ci qian cheng di zan mei shen ling ， wo ke yi mai gei ni yi ge qi dao ji neng dou peng ， ta ke yi zeng jia he yao shui shi hui fu de qi dao dian shu liang 。]

english: Yes, please. So few people have Skillcapes of Prayer!
translation: 是的，请。拥有祈祷技能斗篷的人太少了！ [shi de ， qing 。 yong you qi dao ji neng dou peng de ren tai shao le ！]

english: One as pious as you has certainly earned the right to wear one, but the monastery requires a donation of 99000 coins for the privilege.
translation: 像您这样虔诚的人当然有权佩戴它，但修道院需要捐赠 99000 枚硬币才能获得这一特权。 [xiang nin zhe yang qian cheng de ren dang ran you quan pei dai ta ， dan xiu dao yuan xu yao juan zeng  99000  mei ying bi cai neng huo de zhe yi te quan 。]

english: No thanks, I can't afford one of those.
translation: 不，谢谢，我买不起其中一件。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo mai bu qi qi zhong yi jian 。]

english: I am sorry to hear that. If you should find yourself in wealthier times come back and see me.
translation: 听到这个消息我很遗憾。如果你发现自己处于富裕时期，请回来见我。 [ting dao zhe ge xiao xi wo hen yi han 。 ru guo ni fa xian zi ji chu yu fu yu shi qi ， qing hui lai jian wo 。]

english: I am always happy to contribute towards the monastery's upkeep.
translation: 我总是很乐意为修道院的维护做出贡献。 [wo zong shi hen le yi wei xiu dao yuan de wei hu zuo chu gong xian 。]

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 但不幸的是，我身上没有足够的钱。 [dan bu xing de shi ， wo shen shang mei you zu gou de qian 。]

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 好吧，等你回来了就回来见我吧。 [hao ba ， deng ni hui lai le jiu hui lai jian wo ba 。]

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 不幸的是，所有技能斗篷都只提供免费兜帽，这是技能升级交易的一部分；买一送一，你懂的。因此，在我向您出售一件之前，您需要释放一些库存空间。 [bu xing de shi ， suo you ji neng dou peng dou zhi ti gong mian fei dou mao ， zhe shi ji neng sheng ji jiao yi de yi bu fen ； mai yi song yi ， ni dong de 。 yin ci ， zai wo xiang nin chu shou yi jian zhi qian ， nin xu yao shi fang yi xie ku cun kong jian 。]

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: 出色的！我的朋友，自豪地穿上那件斗篷。 [chu se de ！ wo de peng you ， zi hao di chuan shang na jian dou peng 。]

english: Praise be to Saradomin!
translation: 赞美萨拉多明！ [zan mei sa la duo ming ！]

english: Yes! Praise he who brings life to this world.
translation: 是的！赞美给这个世界带来生命的人。 [shi de ！ zan mei gei zhe ge shi jie dai lai sheng ming de ren 。]

english: I'm here to help with Oziach!
translation: 我是来帮助奥齐阿克的！ [wo shi lai bang zhu ao qi a ke de ！]

english: That is great, thank you! Speak to me downstairs in my office though, I don't have the paperwork up here.
translation: 太好了，谢谢！不过到我办公室楼下跟我说话吧，我这里没有文件。 [tai hao le ， xie xie ！ bu guo dao wo ban gong shi lou xia gen wo shuo hua ba ， wo zhe li mei you wen jian 。]

english: Hi Brother Jered!
translation: 嗨，杰里德兄弟！ [hai ， jie li de xiong di ！]

english: I hear Oziach has been scared, thank you! And thank your friend too.
translation: 我听说奥齐亚克很害怕，谢谢！也谢谢你的朋友。 [wo ting shuo ao qi ya ke hen hai pa ， xie xie ！ ye xie xie ni de peng you 。]

english: Iffie? She helped a lot, I need to go and give her the reward I promised.
translation: 伊菲？她帮了我很多忙，我得去兑现我答应过的报酬。 [yi fei ？ ta bang le wo hen duo mang ， wo de qu dui xian wo da ying guo de bao chou 。]

english: You better go and do that then, thanks again!
translation: 那你最好去这样做，再次感谢！ [na ni zui hao qu zhe yang zuo ， zai ci gan xie ！]

english: Hey Brother Jered!
translation: 嘿，杰里德兄弟！ [hei ， jie li de xiong di ！]

english: Iffie had something she wanted to give you, you should talk to her.
translation: 伊菲想要给你一些东西，你应该和她谈谈。 [yi fei xiang yao gei ni yi xie dong xi ， ni ying gai he ta tan tan 。]

english: I will do that right away!
translation: 我马上就这么做！ [wo ma shang jiu zhe me zuo ！]

english: What can you do to help a bold adventurer like myself?
translation: 你能做些什么来帮助像我这样勇敢的冒险家？ [ni neng zuo xie shen me lai bang zhu xiang wo zhe yang yong gan de mao xian jia ？]

english: Tell me about holy symbols.
translation: 告诉我有关神圣符号的事情。 [gao su wo you guan shen sheng fu hao de shi qing 。]

english: Tell me about the Skillcape of Prayer.
translation: 告诉我有关祈祷技能的事情。 [gao su wo you guan qi dao ji neng de shi qing 。]

english: Yes, what else can you do for a bold adventurer like myself?
translation: 是的，对于像我这样勇敢的冒险家，你还能做些什么呢？ [shi de ， dui yu xiang wo zhe yang yong gan de mao xian jia ， ni hai neng zuo xie shen me ne ？]

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Bless star, please.
translation: 请祝福星星。 [qing zhu fu xing xing 。]

english: None of those, thanks.
translation: 这些都没有，谢谢。 [zhe xie dou mei you ， xie xie 。]

english: Yes, please. So few people have Skillcapes of Prayer!
translation: 是的，请。拥有祈祷技能斗篷的人太少了！ [shi de ， qing 。 yong you qi dao ji neng dou peng de ren tai shao le ！]

english: I'm afraid I can't afford that.
translation: 恐怕我买不起。 [kong pa wo mai bu qi 。]

english: I am always happy to contribute towards the monastery's upkeep.
translation: 我总是很乐意为修道院的维护做出贡献。 [wo zong shi hen le yi wei xiu dao yuan de wei hu zuo chu gong xian 。]

english: No thanks, I can't afford one of those.
translation: 不，谢谢，我买不起其中一件。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo mai bu qi qi zhong yi jian 。]

english: Praise be to Saradomin!
translation: 赞美萨拉多明！ [zan mei sa la duo ming ！]

english: Talk about the Halloween event.
translation: 谈论万圣节活动。 [tan lun wan sheng jie huo dong 。]

english: Hello Brother Jered, the monks in Varrock sent me. What is going on?
translation: 杰里德弟兄你好，是瓦罗克的僧侣们派我来的。到底是怎么回事？ [jie li de di xiong ni hao ， shi wa luo ke de seng lv men pai wo lai de 。 dao di shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: Thank Saradomin that you came! We need help! Oziach is trying to buy the monastery!
translation: 感谢萨拉多明你的到来！我们需要帮助！奥齐阿赫正试图买下修道院！ [gan xie sa la duo ming ni de dao lai ！ wo men xu yao bang zhu ！ ao qi a he zheng shi tu mai xia xiu dao yuan ！]

english: What can I do to help?
translation: 我能提供什么帮助吗？ [wo neng ti gong shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: We've tried everything, there is nothing!
translation: 我们什么都试过了，什么也没有！ [wo men shen me dou shi guo le ， shen me ye mei you ！]

english: Unless...
translation: 除非... [chu fei ...]

english: Are you any good at climbing trees?
translation: 你擅长爬树吗？ [ni shan chang pa shu ma ？]

english: Pretty good, why?
translation: 挺好的，为什么呢？ [ting hao de ， wei shen me ne ？]

english: Oziach is scared of ghosts! If you can climb a tree and make a scary noise, that might scare him off!
translation: 奥齐阿克很怕鬼！如果你能爬上树并发出可怕的声音，那可能会吓跑他！ [ao qi a ke hen pa gui ！ ru guo ni neng pa shang shu bing fa chu ke pa de sheng yin ， na ke neng hui xia pao ta ！]

english: I see, I can give that a go! What should I make the scary noise with?
translation: 我明白了，我可以尝试一下！我应该用什么来发出可怕的声音？ [wo ming bai le ， wo ke yi chang shi yi xia ！ wo ying gai yong shen me lai fa chu ke pa de sheng yin ？]

english: How about one of these wine bottles? I have loads!
translation: 这些酒瓶中的一瓶怎么样？我有负载！ [zhe xie jiu ping zhong de yi ping zen me yang ？ wo you fu zai ！]

english: I'm sure there's a perfectly sane explanation why.
translation: 我确信有一个完全理智的解释。 [wo que xin you yi ge wan quan li zhi de jie shi 。]

english: I might have looked for a solution in them... And I found one, too!
translation: 我可能会在其中寻找解决方案……我也找到了！ [wo ke neng hui zai qi zhong xun zhao jie jue fang an …… wo ye zhao dao le ！]

english: Take this wine bottle and climb the tree nearest Oziach, then blow on it to scare him!
translation: 拿着这个酒瓶爬上离奥齐阿赫最近的树，然后吹气吓唬他！ [na zhe zhe ge jiu ping pa shang li ao qi a he zui jin de shu ， ran hou chui qi xia hu ta ！]

english: Brother Jered now has said to take the wine bottle.
translation: 杰里德弟兄现在已经说要拿走酒瓶了。 [jie li de di xiong xian zai yi jing shuo yao na zou jiu ping le 。]

english: Not a lot from down here, sorry, I'm currently dealing with this mess! Come and see me upstairs and I can assist you with your question there.
translation: 从这里来的不多，抱歉，我现在正在处理这个烂摊子！到楼上来找我，我可以帮助您解决问题。 [cong zhe li lai de bu duo ， bao qian ， wo xian zai zheng zai chu li zhe ge lan tan zi ！ dao lou shang lai zhao wo ， wo ke yi bang zhu nin jie jue wen ti 。]

english: I've lost the bottle, can I have another one please?
translation: 我把瓶子弄丢了，可以再给我一瓶吗？ [wo ba ping zi nong diu le ， ke yi zai gei wo yi ping ma ？]

english: You don't have any space for the bottle! Talk to me again once you have space.
translation: 你没有地方放瓶子了！一旦有空再跟我说话。 [ni mei you di fang fang ping zi le ！ yi dan you kong zai gen wo shuo hua 。]

english: There you go. You can blow into the top to make a spooky sound.
translation: 就这样吧。你可以向顶部吹气，发出诡异的声音。 [jiu zhe yang ba 。 ni ke yi xiang ding bu chui qi ， fa chu gui yi de sheng yin 。]

english: Brother Jered now remembers the player has received his bottle at least once.
translation: 杰里德弟兄现在记得玩家至少收到过一次瓶子。 [jie li de di xiong xian zai ji de wan jia zhi shao shou dao guo yi ci ping zi 。]

english: If you're hiding up a tree when you do it, it should fool Oziach into thinking it's a ghost!
translation: 如果你这样做时躲在一棵树上，它应该会让奥齐亚克误以为它是鬼魂！ [ru guo ni zhe yang zuo shi duo zai yi ke shu shang ， ta ying gai hui rang ao qi ya ke wu yi wei ta shi gui hun ！]

english: Would you like to try that now?
translation: 你现在想尝试一下吗？ [ni xian zai xiang chang shi yi xia ma ？]

english: There you go, try not to lose this one!
translation: 给你，尽量不要失去这个！ [gei ni ， jin liang bu yao shi qu zhe ge ！]

english: Would you like to try and scare Oziach now?
translation: 你现在想尝试吓唬奥齐阿克吗？ [ni xian zai xiang chang shi xia hu ao qi a ke ma ？]

english: Brother Jered!
translation: 杰瑞德兄弟！ [jie rui de xiong di ！]

english: Hi [player name].
translation: 你好[玩家姓名]。 [ni hao [ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Could I have another wine bottle? I dropped the other one.
translation: 我可以再要一瓶酒吗？我把另一颗扔掉了。 [wo ke yi zai yao yi ping jiu ma ？ wo ba ling yi ke reng diao le 。]

english: Sure, I have plenty.
translation: 当然，我有很多。 [dang ran ， wo you hen duo 。]

english: Yes, let's scare Oziach!
translation: 是的，我们来吓唬一下奥齐阿克吧！ [shi de ， wo men lai xia hu yi xia ao qi a ke ba ！]

english: Be careful, make sure you don't get too close to him, or take too long, he'll be sure to spot you!
translation: 小心点，确保你不要离他太近，或者时间太长，他一定会发现你的！ [xiao xin dian ， que bao ni bu yao li ta tai jin ， huo zhe shi jian tai zhang ， ta yi ding hui fa xian ni de ！]

english: Good luck!
translation: 祝你好运！ [zhu ni hao yun ！]

english: The camera fades to a cutscene.
translation: 镜头淡入过场动画。 [jing tou dan ru guo chang dong hua 。]

english: Not just yet.
translation: 还不是现在。 [hai bu shi xian zai 。]

english: Okay, come back and talk to me when you're ready to try scaring Oziach!
translation: 好吧，当你准备好吓唬奥齐亚克时回来跟我说话！ [hao ba ， dang ni zhun bei hao xia hu ao qi ya ke shi hui lai gen wo shuo hua ！]

english: It didn't work!
translation: 没用！ [mei yong ！]

english: Scaring Oziach? He wasn't scared?
translation: 吓唬奥齐阿克？他不害怕吗？ [xia hu ao qi a ke ？ ta bu hai pa ma ？]

english: No! He said one ghost wasn't enough! But I have a plan...
translation: 不！他说一个鬼还不够！但我有一个计划... [bu ！ ta shuo yi ge gui hai bu gou ！ dan wo you yi ge ji hua ...]

english: A plan?
translation: 计划？ [ji hua ？]

english: Yes! ONE ghost wasn't enough. We need more than one ghost. We need TWO ghosts!
translation: 是的！一个幽灵还不够。我们需要不止一个鬼魂。我们需要两个鬼魂！ [shi de ！ yi ge you ling hai bu gou 。 wo men xu yao bu zhi yi ge gui hun 。 wo men xu yao liang ge gui hun ！]

english: Will you be my accomplice and be the second ghost?
translation: 你愿意成为我的同伙，成为第二个鬼魂吗？ [ni yuan yi cheng wei wo de tong huo ， cheng wei di er ge gui hun ma ？]

english: I would, but I don't feel too well from all the stress.
translation: 我愿意，但我因为压力而感觉不太舒服。 [wo yuan yi ， dan wo yin wei ya li er gan jue bu tai shu fu 。]

english: Are you sure it's not all the wine and food?
translation: 你确定这不是所有的酒和食物吗？ [ni que ding zhe bu shi suo you de jiu he shi wu ma ？]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: Nothing! That's okay, I hope you feel better soon!
translation: 没有什么！没关系，我希望你尽快好起来！ [mei you shen me ！ mei guan xi ， wo xi wang ni jin kuai hao qi lai ！]

english: I need to find an accomplice elsewhere, then. Do you have any ideas?
translation: 那么我需要在别处寻找同伙。你有什么想法吗？ [na me wo xu yao zai bie chu xun zhao tong huo 。 ni you shen me xiang fa ma ？]

english: The price to place an advert is 500,000 coins. I've always had good responses to my ads in the past.
translation: 投放广告的价格是500,000金币。过去我的广告一直得到很好的反响。 [tou fang guang gao de jia ge shi 500,000 jin bi 。 guo qu wo de guang gao yi zhi de dao hen hao de fan xiang 。]

english: 500,000 coins? That is quite a lot!
translation: 50万金币？那是相当多了！ [50 wan jin bi ？ na shi xiang dang duo le ！]

english: Ah yes, don't worry about that. I have this pre-paid ad coupon you can use.
translation: 啊，是的，不用担心。我有这张预付费广告优惠券你可以使用。 [a ， shi de ， bu yong dan xin 。 wo you zhe zhang yu fu fei guang gao you hui quan ni ke yi shi yong 。]

english: I bought an ad spot in the paper the other week. I was going to place an ad for recruiting some new monks.
translation: 前一周我在报纸上买了一个广告位。我本来打算登一则招募新修士的广告。 [qian yi zhou wo zai bao zhi shang mai le yi ge guang gao wei 。 wo ben lai da suan deng yi ze zhao mu xin xiu shi de guang gao 。]

english: However with everything going on right now, I think this is more important.
translation: 然而，从现在发生的一切来看，我认为这一点更为重要。 [ran er ， cong xian zai fa sheng de yi qie lai kan ， wo ren wei zhe yi dian geng wei zhong yao 。]

english: You don't have any space for the coupon! Talk to me again once you have space.
translation: 您没有足够的空间放置优惠券！一旦有空再跟我说话。 [nin mei you zu gou de kong jian fang zhi you hui quan ！ yi dan you kong zai gen wo shuo hua 。]

english: There's now a coupon waiting for the player.
translation: 现在有一张优惠券在等待玩家。 [xian zai you yi zhang you hui quan zai deng dai wan jia 。]

english: Here you go.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: The player can now talk to Benny about the Halloween event.
translation: 玩家现在可以与本尼谈论万圣节活动。 [wan jia xian zai ke yi yu ben ni tan lun wan sheng jie huo dong 。]

english: Thank you! You had me worried there that I was going to have to find 500,000 coins. I'll go and place the advert.
translation: 谢谢你！你让我担心我必须找到 500,000 个硬币。我去打广告。 [xie xie ni ！ ni rang wo dan xin wo bi xu zhao dao  500,000  ge ying bi 。 wo qu da guang gao 。]

english: Good luck, I hope you find a good accomplice!
translation: 祝你好运，希望你能找到一个好帮手！ [zhu ni hao yun ， xi wang ni neng zhao dao yi ge hao bang shou ！]

english: I've lost the coupon, can I have another one please?
translation: 我丢失了优惠券，可以再给我一张吗？ [wo diu shi le you hui quan ， ke yi zai gei wo yi zhang ma ？]

english: Have you placed the advert in the Varrock Herald yet?
translation: 你已经在 Varrock Herald 上刊登广告了吗？ [ni yi jing zai  Varrock Herald  shang kan deng guang gao le ma ？]

english: Not yet.
translation: 还没有。 [hai mei you 。]

english: Don't wait too long, the purchase will go through soon!
translation: 不要等太久，购买很快就会完成！ [bu yao deng tai jiu ， gou mai hen kuai jiu hui wan cheng ！]

english: You can find Benny in the Varrock Square. You should talk to him about the ad.
translation: 你可以在瓦罗克广场找到本尼。你应该和他谈谈广告的事。 [ni ke yi zai wa luo ke guang chang zhao dao ben ni 。 ni ying gai he ta tan tan guang gao de shi 。]

english: I'll go and do that now!
translation: 我现在就去做！ [wo xian zai jiu qu zuo ！]

english: Could I have another coupon before I go? I lost the other one.
translation: 出发前我可以再拿一张优惠券吗？我失去了另一件。 [chu fa qian wo ke yi zai na yi zhang you hui quan ma ？ wo shi qu le ling yi jian 。]

english: You don't need a coupon anymore!
translation: 您不再需要优惠券了！ [nin bu zai xu yao you hui quan le ！]

english: Here is a copy of it. I made it before I gave you the original, try not to lose this!
translation: 这是它的副本。我在给你原件之前就已经做好了，尽量不要弄丢了！ [zhe shi ta de fu ben 。 wo zai gei ni yuan jian zhi qian jiu yi jing zuo hao le ， jin liang bu yao nong diu le ！]

english: How is it going?
translation: 最近好吗？ [zui jin hao ma ？]

english: Well thanks, I've just placed the advert in the Herald.
translation: 好的，谢谢，我刚刚在《先驱报》上刊登了广告。 [hao de ， xie xie ， wo gang gang zai 《 xian qu bao 》 shang kan deng le guang gao 。]

english: Lovely! Where are you meeting the candidates?
translation: 迷人的！您在哪里与候选人会面？ [mi ren de ！ nin zai na li yu hou xuan ren hui mian ？]

english: At the Blue Moon Inn, I'm going to head there now.
translation: 蓝月旅馆，我现在就要去那里。 [lan yue lv guan ， wo xian zai jiu yao qu na li 。]

english: Hello [player name]. I thank you for helping us, we've been running out of ideas!
translation: 你好[玩家姓名]。我感谢您帮助我们，我们已经没有主意了！ [ni hao [ wan jia xing ming ]。 wo gan xie nin bang zhu wo men ， wo men yi jing mei you zhu yi le ！]

english: Hello! I saw an old lady sneaking around in the trees south of the monastery, that wouldn't be anything to do with you, would it?
translation: 你好！我看见一个老太太在寺院南面的树林里偷偷摸摸，这和你没什么关系吧？ [ni hao ！ wo kan jian yi ge lao tai tai zai si yuan nan mian de shu lin li tou tou mo mo ， zhe he ni mei shen me guan xi ba ？]

english: That sounds like Iffie, she is my accomplice! I'd be careful calling her an old lady!
translation: 听起来像是伊菲，她是我的同谋！我会小心地称她为老太太！ [ting qi lai xiang shi yi fei ， ta shi wo de tong mou ！ wo hui xiao xin di cheng ta wei lao tai tai ！]

english: You found somebody! Great, good luck!
translation: 你找到人了！太好了，祝你好运！ [ni zhao dao ren le ！ tai hao le ， zhu ni hao yun ！]

english: I'll make sure not to say that to her face if we meet!
translation: 如果我们见面的话，我一定不会当着她的面说这种话！ [ru guo wo men jian mian de hua ， wo yi ding bu hui dang zhe ta de mian shuo zhe zhong hua ！]

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好呀！ [ni hao ya ！]

english: Hello, Brother Jered!
translation: 杰瑞德弟兄，你好！ [jie rui de di xiong ， ni hao ！]

english: Hello! I was just passing by and saw you both in here.
translation: 你好！我只是路过，看到你们俩在这里。 [ni hao ！ wo zhi shi lu guo ， kan dao ni men lia zai zhe li 。]

english: I'd like to thank you Iffie, and you [player name]. You both saved the monastery.
translation: 我要感谢你伊菲和你[玩家姓名]。你们俩拯救了修道院。 [wo yao gan xie ni yi fei he ni [ wan jia xing ming ]。 ni men lia zheng jiu le xiu dao yuan 。]

english: That means more than you can imagine!
translation: 这意味着超乎你的想象！ [zhe yi wei zhe chao hu ni de xiang xiang ！]

english: It was really no problem, if anything, it was rather fun!
translation: 这真的没问题，如果有什么问题的话，那就是相当有趣！ [zhe zhen de mei wen ti ， ru guo you shen me wen ti de hua ， na jiu shi xiang dang you qu ！]

english: Yes, very fun! I haven't had such an adventure in years!
translation: 是的，非常有趣！我已经很多年没有经历过这样的冒险了！ [shi de ， fei chang you qu ！ wo yi jing hen duo nian mei you jing li guo zhe yang de mao xian le ！]

english: Well, I am glad you both enjoyed it! I do have something for you, [player name]...
translation: 好吧，我很高兴你们都喜欢它！我确实有东西给你，[玩家姓名]... [hao ba ， wo hen gao xing ni men dou xi huan ta ！ wo que shi you dong xi gei ni ，[ wan jia xing ming ]...]

english: It's not a reward as such, but it is interesting. I've been tidying up my office since I don't need it anymore.
translation: 这并不是一种奖励，但很有趣。我一直在收拾我的办公室，因为我不再需要它了。 [zhe bing bu shi yi zhong jiang li ， dan hen you qu 。 wo yi zhi zai shou shi wo de ban gong shi ， yin wei wo bu zai xu yao ta le 。]

english: And in doing so, I found this old bottle.
translation: 在这样做的过程中，我发现了这个旧瓶子。 [zai zhe yang zuo de guo cheng zhong ， wo fa xian le zhe ge jiu ping zi 。]

english: Is that... a ghost, inside? It's haunted?!
translation: 难道里面……有鬼？闹鬼了？！ [nan dao li mian …… you gui ？ nao gui le ？！]

english: Yes! There is a ghost inside, it's trapped! Would have been handy to have earlier on, really. Would have been very scary for Oziach!
translation: 是的！里面有鬼，被困住了！如果早点拥有的话会很方便，真的。对于奥齐亚克来说会非常可怕！ [shi de ！ li mian you gui ， bei kun zhu le ！ ru guo zao dian yong you de hua hui hen fang bian ， zhen de 。 dui yu ao qi ya ke lai shuo hui fei chang ke pa ！]

english: But the monastery is saved, so I don't need it anymore. I'd like you to have it!
translation: 但修道院已经保存下来，所以我不再需要它了。我希望你拥有它！ [dan xiu dao yuan yi jing bao cun xia lai ， suo yi wo bu zai xu yao ta le 。 wo xi wang ni yong you ta ！]

english: Thank you. What do I do with it?
translation: 谢谢。我用它做什么？ [xie xie 。 wo yong ta zuo shen me ？]

english: Not a lot really. I did shake it earlier and the ghost got pretty angry with me, so I'd probably avoid doing that too much.
translation: 真的不多。我早些时候确实摇动了它，鬼魂对我很生气，所以我可能会避免这样做太多。 [zhen de bu duo 。 wo zao xie shi hou que shi yao dong le ta ， gui hun dui wo hen sheng qi ， suo yi wo ke neng hui bi mian zhe yang zuo tai duo 。]

english: It does seem quite chatty for a ghost, although it doesn't always make sense.
translation: 对于鬼来说，这确实看起来很健谈，尽管并不总是有意义。 [dui yu gui lai shuo ， zhe que shi kan qi lai hen jian tan ， jin guan bing bu zong shi you yi yi 。]

english: There you go. Now I'll be off, I've got a monastery to look after!
translation: 就这样吧。现在我要走了，我还有一座修道院要照管！ [jiu zhe yang ba 。 xian zai wo yao zou le ， wo hai you yi zuo xiu dao yuan yao zhao guan ！]

english: See you later Brother Jered!
translation: 杰瑞德弟兄再见！ [jie rui de di xiong zai jian ！]

english: Ask for another bottle.
translation: 要求再要一瓶。 [yao qiu zai yao yi ping 。]

english: Yes, let's scare Oziach!
translation: 是的，我们来吓唬一下奥齐阿克吧！ [shi de ， wo men lai xia hu yi xia ao qi a ke ba ！]

english: Not just yet.
translation: 还不是现在。 [hai bu shi xian zai 。]

english: Talk about something else.
translation: 说点别的吧。 [shuo dian bie de ba 。]

english: Ask for another ad coupon.
translation: 要求另一张广告优惠券。 [yao qiu ling yi zhang guang gao you hui quan 。]

english: Hello monk.
translation: 和尚你好。 [he shang ni hao 。]

english: Hello adventurer. My name is Brother Kojo. Do you happen to know the time?
translation: 你好冒险家。我的名字是小乔弟兄。你碰巧知道时间吗？ [ni hao mao xian jia 。 wo de ming zi shi xiao qiao di xiong 。 ni peng qiao zhi dao shi jian ma ？]

english: No, sorry, I don't.
translation: 不，抱歉，我不知道。 [bu ， bao qian ， wo bu zhi dao 。]

english: Exactly! This clock tower has recently broken down, and without it nobody can tell the correct time. I must fix it before the town people become too angry!
translation: 确切地！这座钟楼最近坏了，没有它没人能知道正确的时间。我必须在镇上的人们变得太愤怒之前解决它！ [que qie di ！ zhe zuo zhong lou zui jin huai le ， mei you ta mei ren neng zhi dao zheng que de shi jian 。 wo bi xu zai zhen shang de ren men bian de tai fen nu zhi qian jie jue ta ！]

english: I don't suppose you could assist me in the repairs? I'll pay you for your help.
translation: 我想你不能帮我修理吗？我会付钱给你，作为你的帮助。 [wo xiang ni bu neng bang wo xiu li ma ？ wo hui fu qian gei ni ， zuo wei ni de bang zhu 。]

english: OK old monk, what can I do?
translation: 好吧，老和尚，我能做什么呢？ [hao ba ， lao he shang ， wo neng zuo shen me ne ？]

english: Oh, thank you kind [sir/madam]! In the cellar below, you'll find four cogs. They're too heavy for me, but you should be able to carry them one at a time.
translation: 噢，谢谢你[先生/女士]！在下面的地窖里，你会发现四个齿轮。它们对我来说太重了，但你应该能够一次搬动它们。 [o ， xie xie ni [ xian sheng / nv shi ]！ zai xia mian de di jiao li ， ni hui fa xian si ge chi lun 。 ta men dui wo lai shuo tai zhong le ， dan ni ying gai neng gou yi ci ban dong ta men 。]

english: I know one goes on each floor... but I can't exactly remember which goes where specifically. Oh well, I'm sure you can figure it out fairly easily.
translation: 我知道每一层都有一个……但我不记得具体在哪里。哦，好吧，我相信你可以很容易地弄清楚。 [wo zhi dao mei yi ceng dou you yi ge …… dan wo bu ji de ju ti zai na li 。 o ， hao ba ， wo xiang xin ni ke yi hen rong yi di nong qing chu 。]

english: Well, I'll do my best.
translation: 嗯，我会尽力的。 [n ， wo hui jin li de 。]

english: Thank you again! And remember to be careful, the cellar is full of strange beasts!
translation: 再次感谢您！还有记得要小心，地窖里充满了奇怪的野兽！ [zai ci gan xie nin ！ hai you ji de yao xiao xin ， di jiao li chong man le qi guai de ye shou ！]

english: Not now old monk.
translation: 现在不是老和尚了。 [xian zai bu shi lao he shang le 。]

english: OK then. Come back and let me know if you change your mind.
translation: 那么好吧。如果您改变主意，请回来告诉我。 [na me hao ba 。 ru guo nin gai bian zhu yi ， qing hui lai gao su wo 。]

english: Hello again.
translation: 又好。 [you hao 。]

english: Oh hello, are you having trouble? The cogs are in four rooms below us. Place one cog on a pole on each of the four tower levels.
translation: 哦，你好，你有麻烦吗？齿轮在我们下面的四个房间里。在四层塔楼的每一层的一根杆子上放置一个齿轮。 [o ， ni hao ， ni you ma fan ma ？ chi lun zai wo men xia mian de si ge fang jian li 。 zai si ceng ta lou de mei yi ceng de yi gen gan zi shang fang zhi yi ge chi lun 。]

english: Right, gotcha. I'll do that then.
translation: 对了，明白了。那我就这么做。 [dui le ， ming bai le 。 na wo jiu zhe me zuo 。]

english: I've placed a cog!
translation: 我已经放置了一个齿轮！ [wo yi jing fang zhi le yi ge chi lun ！]

english: That's great. Come see me when you've done the other three.
translation: 那太棒了。等你完成了另外三件事之后再来见我。 [na tai bang le 。 deng ni wan cheng le ling wai san jian shi zhi hou zai lai jian wo 。]

english: Two down!
translation: 两下！ [liang xia ！]

english: Two to go.
translation: 两个人去。 [liang ge ren qu 。]

english: One left.
translation: 还剩一张。 [hai sheng yi zhang 。]

english: I have replaced all the cogs!
translation: 我已经更换了所有齿轮！ [wo yi jing geng huan le suo you chi lun ！]

english: Really..? Wait, listen! Well done, well done! Yes yes yes, you've done it! You ARE clever!
translation: 真的..？等等，听着！干得好，干得好！是的，是的，你已经做到了！你很聪明！ [zhen de ..？ deng deng ， ting zhe ！ gan de hao ， gan de hao ！ shi de ， shi de ， ni yi jing zuo dao le ！ ni hen cong ming ！]

english: The townsfolk will all be able to know the correct time now! Thank you so much for all of your help! And as promised, here is your reward!
translation: 现在镇民们都可以知道正确的时间了！非常感谢您的帮助！正如所承诺的，这是你的奖励！ [xian zai zhen min men dou ke yi zhi dao zheng que de shi jian le ！ fei chang gan xie nin de bang zhu ！ zheng ru suo cheng nuo de ， zhe shi ni de jiang li ！]

english: Congratulations! Quest complete!
translation: 恭喜！任务完成！ [gong xi ！ ren wu wan cheng ！]

english: Hello again Brother Kojo.
translation: 再次问候小乔弟兄。 [zai ci wen hou xiao qiao di xiong 。]

english: Oh hello there traveller. You've done a grand job with the clock. It's just like new.
translation: 哦，你好，旅行者。你在时钟方面做得非常出色。就像新的一样。 [o ， ni hao ， lv xing zhe 。 ni zai shi zhong fang mian zuo de fei chang chu se 。 jiu xiang xin de yi yang 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello, traveller, how can I help?
translation: 您好，旅行者，请问有什么可以帮忙的吗？ [nin hao ， lv xing zhe ， qing wen you shen me ke yi bang mang de ma ？]

english: I'm trying to learn how to be a navigator.
translation: 我正在努力学习如何成为一名领航员。 [wo zheng zai nu li xue xi ru he cheng wei yi ming ling hang yuan 。]

english: I don't know if I can help you there.
translation: 我不知道我是否可以在那里帮助你。 [wo bu zhi dao wo shi fou ke yi zai na li bang zhu ni 。]

english: The professor from the Observatory says that I need a watch.
translation: 天文台的教授说我需要一块手表。 [tian wen tai de jiao shou shuo wo xu yao yi kuai shou biao 。]

translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This place? Why, this is Rellekka! Homeland of all Fremennik! I do not recognise your face outerlander; Where do you come from?
translation: 这个地方？为什么，这是雷莱卡！所有弗雷曼尼克人的祖国！我认不出你的脸，外地人；你从哪里来的？ [zhe ge di fang ？ wei shen me ， zhe shi lei lai ka ！ suo you fu lei man ni ke ren de zu guo ！ wo ren bu chu ni de lian ， wai di ren ； ni cong na li lai de ？]

english: That's not important...
translation: 那不重要... [na bu zhong yao ...]

english: Hmmm... I will not press the issue then outerlander. How may my tribe and I help you?
translation: 嗯...我不会再强调这个问题了。我和我的部落可以为您提供什么帮助？ [n ... wo bu hui zai qiang diao zhe ge wen ti le 。 wo he wo de bu luo ke yi wei nin ti gong shen me bang zhu ？]

english: Do you have any quests?
translation: 你有什么任务吗？ [ni you shen me ren wu ma ？]

english: Quests, you say outerlander? Well, I would not call it a quest as such, but if you are brave of heart and strong of body, perhaps...
translation: 任务，你说外地人？好吧，我不会称其为追求，但如果你内心勇敢、身体强壮，也许…… [ren wu ， ni shuo wai di ren ？ hao ba ， wo bu hui cheng qi wei zhui qiu ， dan ru guo ni nei xin yong gan 、 shen ti qiang zhuang ， ye xu ……]

english: No, you would not be interested. Forget I said anything, outerlander.
translation: 不，你不会感兴趣。忘记我说过的话吧，外来者。 [bu ， ni bu hui gan xing qu 。 wang ji wo shuo guo de hua ba ， wai lai zhe 。]

english: Actually, I would be very interested to hear what you have to offer.
translation: 事实上，我很想听听你能提供什么。 [shi shi shang ， wo hen xiang ting ting ni neng ti gong shen me 。]

english: You would? These are unusual sentiments to hear from an outerlander! My suggestion was going to be that if you crave adventure and battle,
translation: 你会吗？从一个外地人那里听到这样的情绪是不寻常的！我的建议是，如果你渴望冒险和战斗， [ni hui ma ？ cong yi ge wai di ren na li ting dao zhe yang de qing xu shi bu xun chang de ！ wo de jian yi shi ， ru guo ni ke wang mao xian he zhan dou ，]

english: and your heart sings for glory, then perhaps you would be interested in joining our clan, and becoming a Fremennik yourself?
translation: 如果你的心歌唱荣耀，那么也许你有兴趣加入我们的氏族，成为一名弗雷曼尼克人？ [ru guo ni de xin ge chang rong yao ， na me ye xu ni you xing qu jia ru wo men de shi zu ， cheng wei yi ming fu lei man ni ke ren ？]

english: What would that involve exactly?
translation: 这具体涉及什么？ [zhe ju ti she ji shen me ？]

english: Well, there are two ways to become a member of our clan and call yourself a Fremennik: be born a Fremennik, or be voted in by our council of elders.
translation: 好吧，有两种方法可以成为我们氏族的成员并称自己为弗里曼尼克人：生来就是弗里曼尼克人，或者由我们的长老委员会投票选出。 [hao ba ， you liang zhong fang fa ke yi cheng wei wo men shi zu de cheng yuan bing cheng zi ji wei fu li man ni ke ren ： sheng lai jiu shi fu li man ni ke ren ， huo zhe you wo men de zhang lao wei yuan hui tou piao xuan chu 。]

english: Well, I think I've missed the first way, but how can I get the council of elders to vote to let me join your clan?
translation: 好吧，我想我已经错过了第一种方式，但是我怎样才能让长老会投票让我加入你们的氏族呢？ [hao ba ， wo xiang wo yi jing cuo guo le di yi zhong fang shi ， dan shi wo zen yang cai neng rang zhang lao hui tou piao rang wo jia ru ni men de shi zu ne ？]

english: Well, that I cannot answer myself. You will need to speak to each of them and see what they require of you as proof of your dedication.
translation: 好吧，我自己无法回答。您需要与他们每个人交谈，了解他们对您的要求，以证明您的奉献精神。 [hao ba ， wo zi ji wu fa hui da 。 nin xu yao yu ta men mei ge ren jiao tan ， liao jie ta men dui nin de yao qiu ， yi zheng ming nin de feng xian jing shen 。]

english: There are twelve council members around this village; you will need to gain a majority vote of at least seven councillors in your favour.
translation: 这个村庄周围有十二名理事会成员；您需要获得至少七名议员对您有利的多数票。 [zhe ge cun zhuang zhou wei you shi er ming li shi hui cheng yuan ； nin xu yao huo de zhi shao qi ming yi yuan dui nin you li de duo shu piao 。]

english: So what say you? Give me the word, and I will tell all of my tribe of your intentions, be they yea or nay.
translation: 那你怎么说呢？只要告诉我一声，我就会告诉我所有部落的人你的意图，无论他们是或否。 [na ni zen me shuo ne ？ zhi yao gao su wo yi sheng ， wo jiu hui gao su wo suo you bu luo de ren ni de yi tu ， wu lun ta men shi huo fou 。]

english: I think I would enjoy the challenge of becoming an honorary Fremennik. Where and how do I start?
translation: 我想我会喜欢成为一名荣誉弗雷曼尼克的挑战。我从哪里开始以及如何开始？ [wo xiang wo hui xi huan cheng wei yi ming rong yu fu lei man ni ke de tiao zhan 。 wo cong na li kai shi yi ji ru he kai shi ？]

english: As I say outerlander, you must find and speak to the twelve members of the council of elders, and see what tasks they might set you.
translation: 正如我所说的外地人，你必须找到长老会的十二名成员并与他们交谈，看看他们可能会给你布置什么任务。 [zheng ru wo suo shuo de wai di ren ， ni bi xu zhao dao zhang lao hui de shi er ming cheng yuan bing yu ta men jiao tan ， kan kan ta men ke neng hui gei ni bu zhi shen me ren wu 。]

english: If you can gain the support of seven of the twelve, then you will be accepted as one of us without question.
translation: 如果你能获得十二人中七人的支持，那么你将毫无疑问地被接受为我们中的一员。 [ru guo ni neng huo de shi er ren zhong qi ren de zhi chi ， na me ni jiang hao wu yi wen di bei jie shou wei wo men zhong de yi yuan 。]

english: No way do I want to become like YOU! Forget you, and forget your whole stupid town! You're a bunch of stupid primitives, from what I've seen!
translation: 我绝对不想变得像你一样！忘记你，忘记你整个愚蠢的小镇！在我看来，你们就是一群愚蠢的原始人！ [wo jue dui bu xiang bian de xiang ni yi yang ！ wang ji ni ， wang ji ni zheng ge yu chun de xiao zhen ！ zai wo kan lai ， ni men jiu shi yi qun yu chun de yuan shi ren ！]

english: I am sorry to say that I expected such a response from an outerlander. I thought perhaps you might have been different to all the others...
translation: 我很遗憾地说，我期待一个外地人会做出这样的反应。我想也许你和其他人不一样...... [wo hen yi han di shuo ， wo qi dai yi ge wai di ren hui zuo chu zhe yang de fan ying 。 wo xiang ye xu ni he qi ta ren bu yi yang ......]

english: You're right. I really couldn't care less.
translation: 你说得对。我真的一点也不在乎。 [ni shuo de dui 。 wo zhen de yi dian ye bu zai hu 。]

english: It is as I thought outerlander. Your kind care nothing for the Fremennik, and we feel the same about you. This is the way of the world.
translation: 正如我所想的外地人。你对弗里曼尼克人一点也不关心，我们对你也有同样的感觉。这就是世界的方式。 [zheng ru wo suo xiang de wai di ren 。 ni dui fu li man ni ke ren yi dian ye bu guan xin ， wo men dui ni ye you tong yang de gan jue 。 zhe jiu shi shi jie de fang shi 。]

english: Why will no-one talk to me?
translation: 为什么没人跟我说话？ [wei shen me mei ren gen wo shuo hua ？]

english: Do not take it personally, outerlander! We are a simple people, and it is our experience that keeping ourselves to ourselves is best. This is why speaking to outerlanders is forbidden.
translation: 别把这当成针对你个人的事，外地人！我们是一个简单的人，根据我们的经验，保持自己的秘密是最好的。这就是为什么禁止与外地人交谈的原因。 [bie ba zhe dang cheng zhen dui ni ge ren de shi ， wai di ren ！ wo men shi yi ge jian dan de ren ， gen ju wo men de jing yan ， bao chi zi ji de mi mi shi zui hao de 。 zhe jiu shi wei shen me jin zhi yu wai di ren jiao tan de yuan yin 。]

english: We do not wish to enter war with the outerlanders and their strange magics, so we limit all unauthorised communication.
translation: 我们不希望与外地人和他们奇怪的魔法发生战争，因此我们限制所有未经授权的通信。 [wo men bu xi wang yu wai di ren he ta men qi guai de mo fa fa sheng zhan zheng ， yin ci wo men xian zhi suo you wei jing shou quan de tong xin 。]

english: Then how come you're talking to me?
translation: 那你怎么跟我说话？ [na ni zen me gen wo shuo hua ？]

english: Ah, this is because I am the chieftain. I am the one who authorises contact. You will not find many of my tribe so forthcoming with you, as I.
translation: 啊，这是因为我是酋长啊。我是授权联系的人。你不会发现我的部落中有很多人像我一样对你如此热情。 [a ， zhe shi yin wei wo shi qiu zhang a 。 wo shi shou quan lian xi de ren 。 ni bu hui fa xian wo de bu luo zhong you hen duo ren xiang wo yi yang dui ni ru ci re qing 。]

english: Is there a way for you to authorise your tribe to talk to me then?
translation: 那你有办法授权你的部落和我说话吗？ [na ni you ban fa shou quan ni de bu luo he wo shuo hua ma ？]

english: Well, there is one way... but I doubt it is of any interest to you.
translation: 好吧，有一种方法...但我怀疑您对此没有兴趣。 [hao ba ， you yi zhong fang fa ... dan wo huai yi nin dui ci mei you xing qu 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Why do you call me outerlander?
translation: 为什么叫我外地人？ [wei shen me jiao wo wai di ren ？]

english: Do not take it as an insult, outerlander. For us, this town is the center of all. Anyone not born here, or that we do not know and trust is an outerlander.
translation: 别把这当成一种侮辱，外地人。对我们来说，这个城镇是所有人的中心。任何不是在这里出生的人，或者我们不认识和不信任的人都是外地人。 [bie ba zhe dang cheng yi zhong wu ru ， wai di ren 。 dui wo men lai shuo ， zhe ge cheng zhen shi suo you ren de zhong xin 。 ren he bu shi zai zhe li chu sheng de ren ， huo zhe wo men bu ren shi he bu xin ren de ren dou shi wai di ren 。]

english: So it basically means stranger?
translation: 所以它基本上意味着陌生人？ [suo yi ta ji ben shang yi wei zhe mo sheng ren ？]

english: Aye, but that is an outerlander word. We do not judge someones ways by their name. It simply means one from the outerlands, or one not from Rellekka.
translation: 是的，但那是一个外来词。我们不会根据某人的名字来判断他的行为方式。它只是意味着来自外域的人，或者不是来自雷莱卡的人。 [shi de ， dan na shi yi ge wai lai ci 。 wo men bu hui gen ju mou ren de ming zi lai pan duan ta de xing wei fang shi 。 ta zhi shi yi wei zhe lai zi wai yu de ren ， huo zhe bu shi lai zi lei lai ka de ren 。]

english: I know our customs are foreign to you; perhaps you would like me to explain something else?
translation: 我知道我们的习俗对你来说很陌生；也许您希望我解释一下其他事情？ [wo zhi dao wo men de xi su dui ni lai shuo hen mo sheng ； ye xu nin xi wang wo jie shi yi xia qi ta shi qing ？]

english: (shows previous options)
translation: （显示以前的选项） [（ xian shi yi qian de xuan xiang ）]

english: I seek an army to destroy Asgarnia!
translation: 我正在寻找一支军队来摧毁阿斯卡尼亚！ [wo zheng zai xun zhao yi zhi jun dui lai cui hui a si ka ni ya ！]

english: We will have no part in the squabbles of outerlander tribes. Their magics are strange and deadly to us, as we learnt long ago.
translation: 我们不会参与外地部落的争吵。正如我们很久以前就了解到的那样，他们的魔法对我们来说既奇怪又致命。 [wo men bu hui can yu wai di bu luo de zheng chao 。 zheng ru wo men hen jiu yi qian jiu liao jie dao de na yang ， ta men de mo fa dui wo men lai shuo ji qi guai you zhi ming 。]

english: If this is all that you came here for, then you have had a wasted journey. If you are looking for something else, then speak now for my patience dwindles.
translation: 如果这就是你来这里的全部目的，那么你的旅程就白费了。如果你正在寻找其他东西，那么现在就说吧，因为我的耐心正在减弱。 [ru guo zhe jiu shi ni lai zhe li de quan bu mu di ， na me ni de lv cheng jiu bai fei le 。 ru guo ni zheng zai xun zhao qi ta dong xi ， na me xian zai jiu shuo ba ， yin wei wo de nai xin zheng zai jian ruo 。]

english: Who are the Fremennik?
translation: 谁是弗雷曼尼克人？ [shui shi fu lei man ni ke ren ？]

english: It is the name we call ourselves. Outerlanders tend to call us 'Barbarian', but they do not understand our ways...
translation: 这是我们自己的名字。外地人倾向于称我们为“野蛮人”，但他们不理解我们的生活方式...... [zhe shi wo men zi ji de ming zi 。 wai di ren qing xiang yu cheng wo men wei “ ye man ren ”， dan ta men bu li jie wo men de sheng huo fang shi ......]

english: Why will no-one talk to me?
translation: 为什么没人跟我说话？ [wei shen me mei ren gen wo shuo hua ？]

english: (same as above)
translation: （同上） [（ tong shang ）]

english: Nice hat!
translation: 帽子不错！ [mao zi bu cuo ！]

english: Do not mock me outerlander; this helm has saved my life more times than I care to recall right now.
translation: 别嘲笑我外地人；这顶头盔救了我很多次，我现在都记不清了。 [bie chao xiao wo wai di ren ； zhe ding tou kui jiu le wo hen duo ci ， wo xian zai dou ji bu qing le 。]

english: I don't have any votes yet.
translation: 我还没有任何选票。 [wo hai mei you ren he xuan piao 。]

english: I only have 1 vote so far.
translation: 到目前为止我只有 1 票。 [dao mu qian wei zhi wo zhi you  1  piao 。]

english: Hmmm... well that is certainly a good start I would say. Keep up the good work!
translation: 嗯……我想说这当然是一个好的开始。继续做好工作！ [n …… wo xiang shuo zhe dang ran shi yi ge hao de kai shi 。 ji xu zuo hao gong zuo ！]

english: (continues below)
translation: （下面继续） [（ xia mian ji xu ）]

english: I only have [X] votes so far.
translation: 到目前为止我只有 [X] 票。 [dao mu qian wei zhi wo zhi you  [X]  piao 。]

english: Hmmm... you are doing very well so far, outerlander. Keep up the good work!
translation: 嗯……到目前为止，你做得很好，外乡人。继续做好工作！ [n …… dao mu qian wei zhi ， ni zuo de hen hao ， wai xiang ren 。 ji xu zuo hao gong zuo ！]

english: Remember: You need to get at least seven council votes to be accepted as a member of the Fremennik.
translation: 请记住：您需要获得至少七张理事会投票才能被接纳为 Fremennik 的成员。 [qing ji zhu ： nin xu yao huo de zhi shao qi zhang li shi hui tou piao cai neng bei jie na wei  Fremennik  de cheng yuan 。]

english: Go and speak to the twelve members of the council of elders who live in this village. I am sure at least a few will be prepared to vote for you.
translation: 去和住在这个村子里的十二位长老会成员谈谈。我相信至少有一些人会准备投票给你。 [qu he zhu zai zhe ge cun zi li de shi er wei zhang lao hui cheng yuan tan tan 。 wo xiang xin zhi shao you yi xie ren hui zhun bei tou piao gei ni 。]

english: If you need any help with your trials, I suggest you speak to Askeladden. He is currently doing his own trials of manhood to become a true Fremennik.
translation: 如果您在试验中需要任何帮助，我建议您与 Askeladden 联系。他目前正在做自己的男子气概试验，以成为一名真正的弗雷曼尼克人。 [ru guo nin zai shi yan zhong xu yao ren he bang zhu ， wo jian yi nin yu  Askeladden  lian xi 。 ta mu qian zheng zai zuo zi ji de nan zi qi gai shi yan ， yi cheng wei yi ming zhen zheng de fu lei man ni ke ren 。]

english: Greetings again outerlander! How goes your attempts to gain votes with the council of elders?
translation: 再次问候外地人！你在长老会中争取选票的努力进展如何？ [zai ci wen hou wai di ren ！ ni zai zhang lao hui zhong zheng qu xuan piao de nu li jin zhan ru he ？]

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a guarantee of a reduction on sales taxes, do you?
translation: 我想你不知道我在哪里可以找到减少销售税的保证，是吗？ [wo xiang ni bu zhi dao wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao jian shao xiao shou shui de bao zheng ， shi ma ？]

english: A reduction on sales taxes? Why, I am the only one in the Fremennik who may authorise such a thing. What does an outerlander want with that?
translation: 减少销售税？嘿，我是弗里曼尼克中唯一可以授权这样做的人。一个外地人想要什么？ [jian shao xiao shou shui ？ hei ， wo shi fu li man ni ke zhong wei yi ke yi shou quan zhe yang zuo de ren 。 yi ge wai di ren xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Actually, it's not for me. I need to get it as part of my trials.
translation: 事实上，这不适合我。我需要将它作为我的试验的一部分。 [shi shi shang ， zhe bu shi he wo 。 wo xu yao jiang ta zuo wei wo de shi yan de yi bu fen 。]

english: Hmmm. Interesting. Your trials seem to be very different to those I took as a young lad. Well, I am not adverse in principle to giving a slight tax break to our shops.
translation: 嗯。有趣的。你的考验似乎与我年轻时所经历的非常不同。嗯，原则上我并不反对对我们的商店给予轻微的税收减免。 [n 。 you qu de 。 ni de kao yan si hu yu wo nian qing shi suo jing li de fei chang bu tong 。 n ， yuan ze shang wo bing bu fan dui dui wo men de shang dian ji yu qing wei de shui shou jian mian 。]

english: There will of course be a shortfall in the tribe's income, that will need to be made up for elsewhere, however.
translation: 当然，部落的收入会出现短缺，但这需要其他地方来弥补。 [dang ran ， bu luo de shou ru hui chu xian duan que ， dan zhe xu yao qi ta di fang lai mi bu 。]

english: How about this. For many years Sigli has been the only one in the tribe who knows the locations of the best hunting grounds where game is easiest to catch.
translation: 这个怎么样。多年来，西格利一直是部落中唯一知道最容易捕获猎物的最佳狩猎场位置的人。 [zhe ge zen me yang 。 duo nian lai ， xi ge li yi zhi shi bu luo zhong wei yi zhi dao zui rong yi bu huo lie wu de zui jia shou lie chang wei zhi de ren 。]

english: If you can persuade him to let the entire tribe know these hunting grounds, then we can increase productivity within the tribe, and any shortfall caused
translation: 如果你能说服他让整个部落都知道这些狩猎场，那么我们就可以提高部落内部的生产力，而造成的任何短缺 [ru guo ni neng shuo fu ta rang zheng ge bu luo dou zhi dao zhe xie shou lie chang ， na me wo men jiu ke yi ti gao bu luo nei bu de sheng chan li ， er zao cheng de ren he duan que]

english: by lowering sales taxes will be covered. I think this is a more than fair arrangement to make, don't you?
translation: 通过降低销售税将被覆盖。我认为这是一个非常公平的安排，不是吗？ [tong guo jiang di xiao shou shui jiang bei fu gai 。 wo ren wei zhe shi yi ge fei chang gong ping de an pai ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Yeah, that sounds very fair.
translation: 是的，这听起来很公平。 [shi de ， zhe ting qi lai hen gong ping 。]

english: Speak to Sigli then, and you may have my promise to reduce our sales taxes. And best of luck with the rest of your trials.
translation: 那就和西格利谈谈吧，我可能会答应你减少我们的销售税。祝你在接下来的试验中好运。 [na jiu he xi ge li tan tan ba ， wo ke neng hui da ying ni jian shao wo men de xiao shou shui 。 zhu ni zai jie xia lai de shi yan zhong hao yun 。]

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a map to unspoiled hunting grounds, do you?
translation: 我想你不知道我在哪里可以找到未受破坏的狩猎场的地图，是吗？ [wo xiang ni bu zhi dao wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao wei shou po huai de shou lie chang de di tu ， shi ma ？]

english: Ah, outerlander... if you wish to become a Fremennik you should try and pay more attention to what people tell you...
translation: 啊，外地人...如果你想成为一名弗雷曼尼克人，你应该尝试更多地关注人们告诉你的事情... [a ， wai di ren ... ru guo ni xiang cheng wei yi ming fu lei man ni ke ren ， ni ying gai chang shi geng duo di guan zhu ren men gao su ni de shi qing ...]

english: Sigli the hunter is the only one who knows of such hunting grounds. Go and request his knowledge.
translation: 猎人西格利是唯一知道这种狩猎场的人。去请求他的知识。 [lie ren xi ge li shi wei yi zhi dao zhe zhong shou lie chang de ren 。 qu qing qiu ta de zhi shi 。]

english: Ask about the Merchant's trial
translation: 询问商家试用情况 [xun wen shang jia shi yong qing kuang]

english: I got Sigli's hunting map for you.
translation: 我给你拿到了西格利的狩猎地图。 [wo gei ni na dao le xi ge li de shou lie di tu 。]

english: So cutting sales tax isn't going to ruin your economy here or anything?
translation: 那么削减销售税不会破坏你们这里的经济或者其他什么吗？ [na me xue jian xiao shou shui bu hui po huai ni men zhe li de jing ji huo zhe qi ta shen me ma ？]

english: Not at all outerlander; now that we have Sigli's map we can increase the amount of hunts we run, and make up any shortfall that way.
translation: 完全不是外地人；现在我们有了西格利的地图，我们可以增加我们进行的狩猎数量，并以此方式弥补任何不足。 [wan quan bu shi wai di ren ； xian zai wo men you le xi ge li de di tu ， wo men ke yi zeng jia wo men jin xing de shou lie shu liang ， bing yi ci fang shi mi bu ren he bu zu 。]

english: I have seven members of the council prepared to vote in my favour now!
translation: 我现在有七名理事会成员准备投票支持我！ [wo xian zai you qi ming li shi hui cheng yuan zhun bei tou piao zhi chi wo ！]

english: I know outerlander, for I have been closely monitoring your progress so far!
translation: 我认识outlander，因为到目前为止我一直在密切关注你的进展！ [wo ren shi outlander， yin wei dao mu qian wei zhi wo yi zhi zai mi qie guan zhu ni de jin zhan ！]

english: Then let us put the formality aside, and let me personally welcome you into the Fremennik! May you bring us honour!
translation: 那么就让我们抛开拘谨，让我亲自欢迎您来到弗雷曼尼克吧！愿你为我们带来荣耀！ [na me jiu rang wo men pao kai ju jin ， rang wo qin zi huan ying nin lai dao fu lei man ni ke ba ！ yuan ni wei wo men dai lai rong yao ！]

english: QUEST COMPLETED!
translation: 任务完成！ [ren wu wan cheng ！]

english: Hi there Brundt the Chieftain. Could you help me out with a Seal of Passage?
translation: 你好，酋长布伦特。你能帮我制作通道印章吗？ [ni hao ， qiu zhang bu lun te 。 ni neng bang wo zhi zuo tong dao yin zhang ma ？]

english: A Seal of Passage? Whatever for?
translation: 通道印记？为了什么？ [tong dao yin ji ？ wei le shen me ？]

english: Well, I've heard that there have been great troubles between your people and that of the Moon Clan. I was hoping to help. And so I need the Seal of Passage to show my intentions.
translation: 嗯，我听说你们的族人和月族之间发生了很大的麻烦。我希望能有所帮助。所以我需要通道印记来表明我的意图。 [n ， wo ting shuo ni men de zu ren he yue zu zhi jian fa sheng le hen da de ma fan 。 wo xi wang neng you suo bang zhu 。 suo yi wo xu yao tong dao yin ji lai biao ming wo de yi tu 。]

english: Ah [Fremennik name], many have tried, but The Moon Clan are by no means a sharing group of people. They do everything by magic, something we never use. But they are so secretive about it. If only they would share, we
translation: 啊[弗雷曼尼克名字]，很多人都尝试过，但月族绝不是一个共享的群体。他们做任何事情都是靠魔法，这是我们从来没有用过的。但他们对此守口如瓶。如果他们愿意分享，我们 [a [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]， hen duo ren dou chang shi guo ， dan yue zu jue bu shi yi ge gong xiang de qun ti 。 ta men zuo ren he shi qing dou shi kao mo fa ， zhe shi wo men cong lai mei you yong guo de 。 dan ta men dui ci shou kou ru ping 。 ru guo ta men yuan yi fen xiang ， wo men]

english: wouldn't have to kill them all the time!
translation: 不必一直杀掉他们！ [bu bi yi zhi sha diao ta men ！]

english: I will see what I can do.
translation: 我会看看我能做什么。 [wo hui kan kan wo neng zuo shen me 。]

english: Can I have that seal then?
translation: 那我可以拥有那个印章吗？ [na wo ke yi yong you na ge yin zhang ma ？]

english: If you are to bring peace to our two warring clans, then perhaps it is best that you do...
translation: 如果你想给我们两个交战的部落带来和平，那么也许你最好这样做…… [ru guo ni xiang gei wo men liang ge jiao zhan de bu luo dai lai he ping ， na me ye xu ni zui hao zhe yang zuo ……]

english: Hi there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Yes?
translation: 是的？ [shi de ？]

english: I lost my Seal of Passage!
translation: 我失去了通行印记！ [wo shi qu le tong xing yin ji ！]

english: Then you had better take a replacement and be less careless in future.
translation: 那你最好还是换一个，以后就别大意了。 [na ni zui hao hai shi huan yi ge ， yi hou jiu bie da yi le 。]

english: Well if it isn't [Fremennik name]. I've heard of your exploits in the Lunar Isles!
translation: 好吧，如果不是[弗雷曼尼克名字]。我听说过你在月光群岛的功绩！ [hao ba ， ru guo bu shi [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 wo ting shuo guo ni zai yue guang qun dao de gong ji ！]

english: Already? News really does travel fast!
translation: 已经？消息传得真快！ [yi jing ？ xiao xi chuan de zhen kuai ！]

english: Thank you so very much, I think we can really make progress now.
translation: 非常感谢，我想我们现在真的可以取得进展了。 [fei chang gan xie ， wo xiang wo men xian zai zhen de ke yi qu de jin zhan le 。]

english: No worries. I am pleased I could help.
translation: 不用担心。我很高兴能提供帮助。 [bu yong dan xin 。 wo hen gao xing neng ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: Oh, erm, could you help me out with a Seal of Passage?
translation: 哦，呃，你能帮我处理一下通道印记吗？ [o ， e ， ni neng bang wo chu li yi xia tong dao yin ji ma ？]

english: Seal of Passage, well I suppose so.
translation: 通道印记，我想是的。 [tong dao yin ji ， wo xiang shi de 。]

english: Ok, here you go.
translation: 好的，给你。 [hao de ， gei ni 。]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: So how did the meeting go?
