translation: 那么会议进行得怎么样呢？ [na me hui yi jin xing de zen me yang ne ？]

english: It went surprisingly well! We are at least at the point where we will freely acknowledge each other's existence now.
translation: 进展出奇地顺利！我们现在至少已经到了可以自由地承认彼此存在的地步。 [jin zhan chu qi di shun li ！ wo men xian zai zhi shao yi jing dao le ke yi zi you di cheng ren bi ci cun zai de di bu 。]

english: You are definitely a great asset to the Fremennik, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你绝对是弗雷曼尼克的宝贵财富，[弗雷曼尼克名字]！ [ni jue dui shi fu lei man ni ke de bao gui cai fu ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！]

english: I've lost V's Shield.
translation: 我失去了V的盾牌。 [wo shi qu le V de dun pai 。]

english: I don't think you have [Fremennik name]. I suggest you try looking for it again.
translation: 我认为你没有[弗雷曼尼克名字]。我建议你再尝试寻找一下。 [wo ren wei ni mei you [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 wo jian yi ni zai chang shi xun zhao yi xia 。]

english: You really should be more careful [Fremennik name]. Luckily for you I found it again but you'll have to pay to get it back.
translation: 你真的应该更加小心[弗雷曼尼克名字]。幸运的是，我又找到了它，但你必须付费才能取回它。 [ni zhen de ying gai geng jia xiao xin [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 xing yun de shi ， wo you zhao dao le ta ， dan ni bi xu fu fei cai neng qu hui ta 。]

english: How much?
translation: 多少？ [duo shao ？]

english: 50,000 coins. Consider it a lesson in looking after things better.
translation: 50,000枚金币。将其视为更好地处理事情的教训。 [50,000 mei jin bi 。 jiang qi shi wei geng hao di chu li shi qing de jiao xun 。]

english: Sounds good to me.
translation: 对我来说听起来不错。 [dui wo lai shuo ting qi lai bu cuo 。]

english: Here you go [Fremennik name]. Use it well.
translation: 给你[弗里曼尼克名字]。好好利用它。 [gei ni [ fu li man ni ke ming zi ]。 hao hao li yong ta 。]

english: That's a bit too much I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕有点太多了。 [kong pa you dian tai duo le 。]

english: Fair enough. I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 很公平。如果你改变主意我会在这里。 [hen gong ping 。 ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi wo hui zai zhe li 。]

english: I don't have that much.
translation: 我没有那么多。 [wo mei you na me duo 。]

english: Well come back when you do.
translation: 当你回来的时候就回来吧。 [dang ni hui lai de shi hou jiu hui lai ba 。]

english: Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I hope your travels have brought you wealth and joy! What compels you to visit me on this day?
translation: 再次你好[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]！希望您的旅行给您带来财富和快乐！是什么促使你在这一天来看我？ [zai ci ni hao [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！ xi wang nin de lv xing gei nin dai lai cai fu he kuai le ！ shi shen me cu shi ni zai zhe yi tian lai kan wo ？]

english: I just came to say hello.
translation: 我只是来打个招呼。 [wo zhi shi lai da ge zhao hu 。]

english: Well met, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always good to see your face in glorious Rellekka once more!
translation: 很高兴见到，[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]。很高兴再次在光荣的雷莱卡看到你的脸！ [hen gao xing jian dao ，[ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 hen gao xing zai ci zai guang rong de lei lai ka kan dao ni de lian ！]

english: Not at the moment [Fremennik name]. Rest assured, should your services to the Fremennik be required, I will call upon you.
translation: 目前还没有[弗雷曼尼克名字]。请放心，如果弗里曼尼克需要您的服务，我会拜访您。 [mu qian hai mei you [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 qing fang xin ， ru guo fu li man ni ke xu yao nin de fu wu ， wo hui bai fang nin 。]

english: Aye, that it is [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. Should you desire one of your own, you should go to Skulgrimen's shop and see what they have available!
translation: 是的，这是[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]。如果您想要一件属于自己的，您应该去 Skulgrimen 的商店看看他们有什么商品！ [shi de ， zhe shi [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 ru guo nin xiang yao yi jian shu yu zi ji de ， nin ying gai qu  Skulgrimen  de shang dian kan kan ta men you shen me shang pin ！]

english: Can I hear the history of your people?
translation: 我可以听听你们人民的历史吗？ [wo ke yi ting ting ni men ren min de li shi ma ？]

english: Why, of course [Fremennik name]! Do not say 'your people' like that, for you are now a Fremennik yourself! What did you want to hear of?
translation: 为什么，当然是[弗里曼尼克名字]！不要这样说“你的人民”，因为你自己现在也是弗雷曼尼克人了！你想听什么？ [wei shen me ， dang ran shi [ fu li man ni ke ming zi ]！ bu yao zhe yang shuo “ ni de ren min ”， yin wei ni zi ji xian zai ye shi fu lei man ni ke ren le ！ ni xiang ting shen me ？]

english: I'm interested in finding out about that mysterious warrior I fought as part of Thorvalds' combat trial. His name is Koschei I believe.
translation: 我有兴趣找出我在托瓦尔兹战斗试验中与之战斗的那个神秘战士。我相信他的名字叫Koschei。 [wo you xing qu zhao chu wo zai tuo wa er zi zhan dou shi yan zhong yu zhi zhan dou de na ge shen mi zhan shi 。 wo xiang xin ta de ming zi jiao Koschei。]

english: Ah... the deathless one... We do not even know if Koschei is his name, when we found him he had no memory, he was simply repeating that single word.
translation: 啊……不死的……我们甚至不知道Koschei是不是他的名字，当我们找到他时，他没有记忆，他只是重复着那个词。 [a …… bu si de …… wo men shen zhi bu zhi dao Koschei shi bu shi ta de ming zi ， dang wo men zhao dao ta shi ， ta mei you ji yi ， ta zhi shi chong fu zhe na ge ci 。]

english: Whatever happened to him must have rattled his soul so hard that his memory ran away from him, and he has not yet found it's hiding place.
translation: 无论发生在他身上的事情一定让他的灵魂如此震动，以至于他的记忆消失了，而他还没有找到它的藏身之处。 [wu lun fa sheng zai ta shen shang de shi qing yi ding rang ta de ling hun ru ci zhen dong ， yi zhi yu ta de ji yi xiao shi le ， er ta hai mei you zhao dao ta de cang shen zhi chu 。]

english: So how exactly did you find him?
translation: 那么你到底是怎么找到他的呢？ [na me ni dao di shi zen me zhao dao ta de ne ？]

english: Well, it was a raiding party like any other. We had just struck one of the smaller northern islands to harvest supplies by combat, as our laws allow,
translation: 好吧，这和其他的袭击派对一样。我们刚刚袭击了北部较小的岛屿之一，按照我们的法律允许，通过战斗收获物资， [hao ba ， zhe he qi ta de xi ji pai dui yi yang 。 wo men gang gang xi ji le bei bu jiao xiao de dao yu zhi yi ， an zhao wo men de fa lv yun xu ， tong guo zhan dou shou huo wu zi ，]

english: when we saw a figure in the iceywaters. As we were at least a 3 week sail from any port, and saw no other ships nearby, he must have been there some time.
translation: 当我们在冰冷的海水中看到一个人影时。由于我们距离任何港口至少有 3 周的航行时间，并且附近没有其他船只，因此他一定已经在那里一段时间了。 [dang wo men zai bing leng de hai shui zhong kan dao yi ge ren ying shi 。 you yu wo men ju li ren he gang kou zhi shao you  3  zhou de hang xing shi jian ， bing qie fu jin mei you qi ta chuan zhi ， yin ci ta yi ding yi jing zai na li yi duan shi jian le 。]

english: We could not leave someone to the cold death of the ocean, even an outerlander, so we fished him aboard. He muttered continually, but his words made no sense.
translation: 我们不能让一个人在海洋中被冷死，即使是一个外地人，所以我们把他钓到了船上。他不断地嘀咕着，但他的话却毫无意义。 [wo men bu neng rang yi ge ren zai hai yang zhong bei leng si ， ji shi shi yi ge wai di ren ， suo yi wo men ba ta diao dao le chuan shang 。 ta bu duan di di gu zhe ， dan ta de hua que hao wu yi yi 。]

english: He had no clothes or possessions with him, and seemed to have been burnt somehow before he had landed in the water.
translation: 他身上没有衣服或财物，似乎在落入水中之前就被烧伤了。 [ta shen shang mei you yi fu huo cai wu ， si hu zai luo ru shui zhong zhi qian jiu bei shao shang le 。]

english: I cannot help but wonder what burnt him, for as you may have seen, he is incredibly powerful and resistant to damage by any means I know of!
translation: 我不禁想知道是什么烧伤了他，因为正如你可能已经看到的，他非常强大并且能够抵抗我所知道的任何方式的伤害！ [wo bu jin xiang zhi dao shi shen me shao shang le ta ， yin wei zheng ru ni ke neng yi jing kan dao de ， ta fei chang qiang da bing qie neng gou di kang wo suo zhi dao de ren he fang shi de shang hai ！]

english: Anyway, we decided to bring him back to Rellekka, for he did not seem of good health or sound mind, and simply repeated the word Koschei over and over.
translation: 不管怎样，我们决定把他带回雷莱卡，因为他看起来身体不太好，精神也不好，只是一遍又一遍地重复着“Koschei”这个词。 [bu guan zen yang ， wo men jue ding ba ta dai hui lei lai ka ， yin wei ta kan qi lai shen ti bu tai hao ， jing shen ye bu hao ， zhi shi yi bian you yi bian di chong fu zhe “Koschei” zhe ge ci 。]

english: Yrsa tended to him for many weeks, until one day it was as though a new soul had entered his burnt and broken body.
translation: 伊莎照顾了他好几个星期，直到有一天，仿佛一个新的灵魂进入了他烧焦破碎的身体。 [yi sha zhao gu le ta hao ji ge xing qi ， zhi dao you yi tian ， fang fu yi ge xin de ling hun jin ru le ta shao jiao po sui de shen ti 。]

english: He suddenly left her house one day, fully healed, and able to speak to us as though nothing had happened to him.
translation: 有一天，他突然离开了她的家，完全痊愈了，并且能够和我们说话，就好像他什么也没发生过一样。 [you yi tian ， ta tu ran li kai le ta de jia ， wan quan quan yu le ， bing qie neng gou he wo men shuo hua ， jiu hao xiang ta shen me ye mei fa sheng guo yi yang 。]

english: He still had no recollection of how he had come to be in the iceyocean, or of who he was, or where he had come from, but this did not matter to us or him.
translation: 他仍然不记得他是如何来到冰洋的，也不记得他是谁，也不记得他来自哪里，但这对我们或他来说都不重要。 [ta reng ran bu ji de ta shi ru he lai dao bing yang de ， ye bu ji de ta shi shui ， ye bu ji de ta lai zi na li ， dan zhe dui wo men huo ta lai shuo dou bu zhong yao 。]

english: He took his trials of adulthood, as you did, and has been a boon to our clan ever since. Someday I fear he may regain his memory, and leave us for his past...
translation: 他和你一样经历了成年期的考验，从那时起他就一直是我们部落的福音。我担心有一天他会恢复记忆，而离开我们去追寻他的过去…… [ta he ni yi yang jing li le cheng nian qi de kao yan ， cong na shi qi ta jiu yi zhi shi wo men bu luo de fu yin 。 wo dan xin you yi tian ta hui hui fu ji yi ， er li kai wo men qu zhui xun ta de guo qu ……]

english: But I will always respect any decision he decides to make should that day ever come upon us. Until then, he is more than welcome to stay here.
translation: 但如果那一天真的到来，我将永远尊重他做出的任何决定。在那之前，我们非常欢迎他留在这里。 [dan ru guo na yi tian zhen de dao lai ， wo jiang yong yuan zun zhong ta zuo chu de ren he jue ding 。 zai na zhi qian ， wo men fei chang huan ying ta liu zai zhe li 。]

english: So, [Fremennik name]. Was there anything more you wished to hear?
translation: 所以，[弗雷曼尼克名字]。您还有什么想听的吗？ [suo yi ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 nin hai you shen me xiang ting de ma ？]

english: I would like to hear of the lands across the ocean to the North.
translation: 我想听听大洋彼岸北方的土地。 [wo xiang ting ting da yang bi an bei fang de tu di 。]

english: Well, I think the best thing for you would be to go to the docks and ask to join one of our longboats on a journey.
translation: 好吧，我认为对您来说最好的办法就是去码头并要求加入我们的一艘长艇进行旅程。 [hao ba ， wo ren wei dui nin lai shuo zui hao de ban fa jiu shi qu ma tou bing yao qiu jia ru wo men de yi sou zhang ting jin xing lv cheng 。]

english: My affairs are concentrated mostly on Rellekka, so my knowledge is not great, but I will happily share what I do know with you [Fremennik name].
translation: 我的事务主要集中在Rellekka，所以我的知识不是很多，但我很乐意与你[Fremennik name]分享我所知道的。 [wo de shi wu zhu yao ji zhong zai Rellekka， suo yi wo de zhi shi bu shi hen duo ， dan wo hen le yi yu ni [Fremennik name] fen xiang wo suo zhi dao de 。]

english: North of this town the atmosphere becomes bitterly cold. There are a number of small inhabited islands that we have sea routes with.
translation: 这座城镇的北部，空气变得寒冷刺骨。我们与许多有人居住的小岛屿有海上航线。 [zhe zuo cheng zhen de bei bu ， kong qi bian de han leng ci gu 。 wo men yu xu duo you ren ju zhu de xiao dao yu you hai shang hang xian 。]

english: The largest of these is possibly Miscellania, although I hear that there has been some recent incident with their monarch, but I don't know the details.
translation: 其中最大的可能是Miscellania，虽然听说他们的君主最近发生了一些事件，但具体情况我不知道。 [qi zhong zui da de ke neng shi Miscellania， sui ran ting shuo ta men de jun zhu zui jin fa sheng le yi xie shi jian ， dan ju ti qing kuang wo bu zhi dao 。]

english: There is also of course the island of the moon clan, who change with the tides. They are our bitterest enemies, and we are currently at war with them.
translation: 当然还有随潮汐而变化的月族岛。他们是我们最大的敌人，我们目前正与他们交战。 [dang ran hai you sui chao xi er bian hua de yue zu dao 。 ta men shi wo men zui da de di ren ， wo men mu qian zheng yu ta men jiao zhan 。]

english: They are an evil people, equally cursed and blessed by the magic in their blood. Beyond those islands, there is the large frozen wasteland we call Acheron.
translation: 他们是邪恶的民族，同样受到血液中魔法的诅咒和祝福。在这些岛屿之外，还有我们称之为阿刻戎的大片冰冻荒地。 [ta men shi xie e de min zu ， tong yang shou dao xue ye zhong mo fa de zu zhou he zhu fu 。 zai zhe xie dao yu zhi wai ， hai you wo men cheng zhi wei a ke rong de da pian bing dong huang di 。]

english: It is an inhospitable land, and you will need an agile and sturdy body just to keep alive in it's perils.
translation: 这是一片荒凉的土地，你需要敏捷而强壮的身体才能在危险中生存。 [zhe shi yi pian huang liang de tu di ， ni xu yao min jie er qiang zhuang de shen ti cai neng zai wei xian zhong sheng cun 。]

english: As I say, my knowledge outside of this town is rather limited, and I know no more than this. Was there anything else you wished to hear tell of?
translation: 正如我所说，我对这个小镇之外的了解相当有限，仅此而已。您还有什么想听的吗？ [zheng ru wo suo shuo ， wo dui zhe ge xiao zhen zhi wai de liao jie xiang dang you xian ， jin ci er yi 。 nin hai you shen me xiang ting de ma ？]

english: I would like to hear a little of the history between the Fremenniks and the outerlanders.
translation: 我想听听一些弗雷曼尼克人和外地人之间的历史。 [wo xiang ting ting yi xie fu lei man ni ke ren he wai di ren zhi jian de li shi 。]

english: Ah, now that is something I know a great deal about. Believe it or not, all outerlanders were once orginally Fremenniks.
translation: 啊，现在我对这一点了解很多了。不管你信不信，所有外来人都曾经是弗里曼尼克人。 [a ， xian zai wo dui zhe yi dian liao jie hen duo le 。 bu guan ni xin bu xin ， suo you wai lai ren dou ceng jing shi fu li man ni ke ren 。]

english: When first man came to these lands all were Fremenniks, and followed our ways. We lived a happy life, and never settled in one place for long.
translation: 当第一个人来到这片土地时，所有人都是弗里曼尼克人，并追随我们的道路。我们过着幸福的生活，并没有在一个地方长期定居。 [dang di yi ge ren lai dao zhe pian tu di shi ， suo you ren dou shi fu li man ni ke ren ， bing zhui sui wo men de dao lu 。 wo men guo zhe xing fu de sheng huo ， bing mei you zai yi ge di fang chang qi ding ju 。]

english: We travelled by boat along the coastlines, never taking more from the land than could be regrown by the same time in the following year.
translation: 我们乘船沿着海岸线旅行，从土地上获取的东西从来没有超过第二年同一时间可以重新种植的东西。 [wo men cheng chuan yan zhe hai an xian lv xing ， cong tu di shang huo qu de dong xi cong lai mei you chao guo di er nian tong yi shi jian ke yi chong xin zhong zhi de dong xi 。]

english: However, many moons past, some of our tribesmen were weary of constantly travelling the lands, and decided to build themselves permanent homes.
translation: 然而，许多个月过去了，我们的一些部落成员厌倦了不断地旅行，决定为自己建造永久的家园。 [ran er ， xu duo ge yue guo qu le ， wo men de yi xie bu luo cheng yuan yan juan le bu duan di lv xing ， jue ding wei zi ji jian zao yong jiu de jia yuan 。]

english: Unfortunately, the other races that had also migrated here did not like this. They waged war against us at every opportunity.
translation: 不幸的是，其他同样迁徙到这里的种族并不喜欢这样。他们利用一切机会对我们发动战争。 [bu xing de shi ， qi ta tong yang qian xi dao zhe li de zhong zu bing bu xi huan zhe yang 。 ta men li yong yi qie ji hui dui wo men fa dong zhan zheng 。]

english: We were driven mostly to the coastlines, where we could escape by boat when attacked. Remember, at this time we had no real way to defend against constant attack.
translation: 我们大部分时间都被驱赶到海岸线，在那里我们可以在受到攻击时乘船逃跑。请记住，此时我们没有真正的方法来防御不断的攻击。 [wo men da bu fen shi jian dou bei qu gan dao hai an xian ， zai na li wo men ke yi zai shou dao gong ji shi cheng chuan tao pao 。 qing ji zhu ， ci shi wo men mei you zhen zheng de fang fa lai fang yu bu duan de gong ji 。]

english: Then one day one of our Seers, whose name has been lost in the telling of this tale, discovered a cave full of strange rocks.
translation: 然后有一天，我们的一位先知（他的名字在这个故事的讲述中已经消失了）发现了一个充满奇怪岩石的洞穴。 [ran hou you yi tian ， wo men de yi wei xian zhi （ ta de ming zi zai zhe ge gu shi de jiang shu zhong yi jing xiao shi le ） fa xian le yi ge chong man qi guai yan shi de dong xue 。]

english: This rock would never be consumed, no matter how much we took, and sparkled at its peak, and broke off in small and regular sized chunks when mined.
translation: 无论我们拿走多少，这种岩石都永远不会被消耗，并且在其顶峰时闪闪发光，并在开采时碎裂成小而规则大小的块。 [wu lun wo men na zou duo shao ， zhe zhong yan shi dou yong yuan bu hui bei xiao hao ， bing qie zai qi ding feng shi shan shan fa guang ， bing zai kai cai shi sui lie cheng xiao er gui ze da xiao de kuai 。]

english: Stranger than this, we found that these rocks would become filled with power when taken to certain places across this land!
translation: 更奇怪的是，我们发现这些岩石被带到这片土地上的某些地方时会变得充满力量！ [geng qi guai de shi ， wo men fa xian zhe xie yan shi bei dai dao zhe pian tu di shang de mou xie di fang shi hui bian de chong man li liang ！]

english: There was a terrible argument in our tribe! Some said that we should take as many of these rocks as we could, and use them in defending against our enemies attacks!
translation: 我们部落里发生了一场可怕的争吵！有人说，我们应该尽可能多地获取这些岩石，并用它们来防御敌人的攻击！ [wo men bu luo li fa sheng le yi chang ke pa de zheng chao ！ you ren shuo ， wo men ying gai jin ke neng duo di huo qu zhe xie yan shi ， bing yong ta men lai fang yu di ren de gong ji ！]

english: Others said that we had found a place that belonged only to the gods, and that should we steal what was not ours we would find only torment and misery.
translation: 还有人说，我们找到了一个只属于众神的地方，如果我们偷窃不属于我们的东西，我们只会受到折磨和痛苦。 [hai you ren shuo ， wo men zhao dao le yi ge zhi shu yu zhong shen de di fang ， ru guo wo men tou qie bu shu yu wo men de dong xi ， wo men zhi hui shou dao zhe mo he tong ku 。]

english: We voted on this, and decided that it was in the best interests of the tribe to leave these strange rocks where they lay, for the gods can be spiteful and cruel,
translation: 我们对此进行了投票，并决定将这些奇怪的岩石留在原地符合部落的最大利益，因为众神可能是恶毒和残忍的， [wo men dui ci jin xing le tou piao ， bing jue ding jiang zhe xie qi guai de yan shi liu zai yuan di fu he bu luo de zui da li yi ， yin wei zhong shen ke neng shi e du he can ren de ，]

english: especially to those who do not treat them with the respect they desire. Some of our number refused to accept this ruling by our council however.
translation: 尤其是对于那些没有给予他们所希望的尊重的人。然而，我们中的一些人拒绝接受我们理事会的这一裁决。 [you qi shi dui yu na xie mei you ji yu ta men suo xi wang de zun zhong de ren 。 ran er ， wo men zhong de yi xie ren ju jue jie shou wo men li shi hui de zhe yi cai jue 。]

english: They began to mine these rocks, and set up transport systems to the various places of power that enchanted them.
translation: 他们开始开采这些岩石，并建立了通​​往令他们着迷的各个权力场所的运输系统。 [ta men kai shi kai cai zhe xie yan shi ， bing jian li le tong ​​ wang ling ta men zhao mi de ge ge quan li chang suo de yun shu xi tong 。]

english: They even created temples at each of these places! This was going too far! We had no choice, but to expel them from our tribe forever!
translation: 他们甚至在这些地方都建造了寺庙！这太过分了！我们别无选择，只能将他们永远驱逐出我们的部落！ [ta men shen zhi zai zhe xie di fang dou jian zao le si miao ！ zhe tai guo fen le ！ wo men bie wu xuan ze ， zhi neng jiang ta men yong yuan qu zhu chu wo men de bu luo ！]

english: We turned our backs upon them, and let them know they would never be welcome back to our tribes until they had released themselves from the rocks.
translation: 我们背对着他们，让他们知道，除非他们从岩石中解脱出来，否则我们永远不会欢迎他们回到我们的部落。 [wo men bei dui zhe ta men ， rang ta men zhi dao ， chu fei ta men cong yan shi zhong jie tuo chu lai ， fou ze wo men yong yuan bu hui huan ying ta men hui dao wo men de bu luo 。]

english: This is the tale of how the outerlanders came about; through stealing from the gods, and from betraying our ideals. This is why we show them no trust.
translation: 这是关于外地人如何诞生的故事；通过窃取众神和背叛我们的理想。这就是为什么我们不信任他们。 [zhe shi guan yu wai di ren ru he dan sheng de gu shi ； tong guo qie qu zhong shen he bei pan wo men de li xiang 。 zhe jiu shi wei shen me wo men bu xin ren ta men 。]

english: Was there something else you wished to hear?
translation: 您还有什么想听的吗？ [nin hai you shen me xiang ting de ma ？]

english: Actually, history isn't really my thing.
translation: 事实上，历史并不是我的事。 [shi shi shang ， li shi bing bu shi wo de shi 。]

english: Well let me know should you wish to hear our lore and histories. We value them highly.
translation: 如果您想听听我们的传说和历史，请告诉我。我们高度重视他们。 [ru guo nin xiang ting ting wo men de chuan shuo he li shi ， qing gao su wo 。 wo men gao du zhong shi ta men 。]

english: As a matter of fact [Fremennik name], I do have a quest for you. Are you interested?
translation: 事实上，[弗雷曼尼克名字]，我确实有一个任务要找你。你有兴趣吗？ [shi shi shang ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]， wo que shi you yi ge ren wu yao zhao ni 。 ni you xing qu ma ？]

english: I’m ready for adventure
translation: 我已准备好冒险 [wo yi zhun bei hao mao xian]

english: Excellent, now-
translation: 太好了，现在—— [tai hao le ， xian zai ——]

english: So what will it be this time? Joining warring islands?
translation: 那么这次会是什么呢？加入交战岛屿？ [na me zhe ci hui shi shen me ne ？ jia ru jiao zhan dao yu ？]

english: I’m a fan of you enthusiasm, [Fremennik name], but-
translation: 我是你热情的粉丝，[弗雷曼尼克名字]，但是—— [wo shi ni re qing de fen si ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]， dan shi ——]

english: Would you have me slay a mighty daggermouth? Or do you need my expertise in conquering untamed lands?
translation: 你想让我杀死一只强大的匕首嘴吗？或者你需要我的专业知识来征服未开化的土地吗？ [ni xiang rang wo sha si yi zhi qiang da de bi shou zui ma ？ huo zhe ni xu yao wo de zhuan ye zhi shi lai zheng fu wei kai hua de tu di ma ？]

english: Nothing quite that fancy I’m afraid, [Fremennik name]. I just need you to investigate a minor disturbance.
translation: 恐怕没有那么花哨，[弗雷曼尼克名字]。我只是需要你去调查一件小事。 [kong pa mei you na me hua shao ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 wo zhi shi xu yao ni qu diao cha yi jian xiao shi 。]

english: Oh.

Freygerd and Reeso run the sandpit a little north of here. They mentioned they heard some rustling by their hut lat night and wanted an official to investigate. You’ve proven yourself more than worthy of our people’s trust.
translation: 弗雷格德和里索在北面不远的地方经营沙坑。他们提到，深夜他们听到小屋附近有沙沙声，希望官员进行调查。您已经证明自己完全值得我们人民的信任。 [fu lei ge de he li suo zai bei mian bu yuan de di fang jing ying sha keng 。 ta men ti dao ， shen ye ta men ting dao xiao wu fu jin you sha sha sheng ， xi wang guan yuan jin xing diao cha 。 nin yi jing zheng ming zi ji wan quan zhi de wo men ren min de xin ren 。]

english: Well that doesn’t sound so bad. I’ll get right on it.
translation: 嗯，听起来不错。我会马上做的。 [n ， ting qi lai bu cuo 。 wo hui ma shang zuo de 。]

english: Thank you, [Fremennik name].
translation: 谢谢你，[弗雷曼尼克名字]。 [xie xie ni ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。]

english: Not right now.
translation: 现在不行。 [xian zai bu xing 。]

english: Very well. Return when you wish to help.
translation: 很好。当你想帮忙时就回来。 [hen hao 。 dang ni xiang bang mang shi jiu hui lai 。]

english: How goes the investigation, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 调查进展如何了，[弗雷曼尼克名字]？ [diao cha jin zhan ru he le ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]？]

english: I’m still looking into it at the moment.
translation: 我现在还在研究它。 [wo xian zai hai zai yan jiu ta 。]

english: No rush, [Fremennik name]. I’m sure it’s nothing to worry about. Just talk to Freygerd and Reeso at the sandpit when you’re ready.
translation: 不着急，[弗雷曼尼克名字]。我确信这没什么好担心的。准备好后，只需在沙坑与弗雷格德和里索交谈即可。 [bu zhao ji ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 wo que xin zhe mei shen me hao dan xin de 。 zhun bei hao hou ， zhi xu zai sha keng yu fu lei ge de he li suo jiao tan ji ke 。]

english: [Fremennik name], I’m glad you’ve returned! This letter you have found is very worrying and requires our utmost attention.
translation: [弗雷曼尼克名字]，我很高兴你回来了！您发现的这封信非常令人担忧，需要我们高度重视。 [[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]， wo hen gao xing ni hui lai le ！ nin fa xian de zhe feng xin fei chang ling ren dan you ， xu yao wo men gao du zhong shi 。]

english: I don’t understand. What does this letter mean? Who is the Jormungand? And since when could basilisks read and write?
translation: 我不明白。这封信是什么意思？耶梦加得是谁？蛇怪什么时候可以读写了？ [wo bu ming bai 。 zhe feng xin shi shen me yi si ？ ye meng jia de shi shui ？ she guai shen me shi hou ke yi du xie le ？]

english: While they may not show it, basilisks are much smarter than they seem. Many years ago, a great basilisk army enslaved our people and took our home. The Joumungand, sometimes known as The Serpent King, was the leader of this army. Along with his three generals, Typhor, Vritra and Bakuna, he brought a terror to these lands unlike any other. If it hadn’t been for the bravery of a great hero, we might never have been freed.
translation: 虽然蛇怪可能没有表现出来，但它们比看起来聪明得多。许多年前，一支巨大的蛇怪军队奴役了我们的人民并夺走了我们的家园。 Joumungand，有时被称为蛇王，是这支军队的领导者。他与他的三位将军泰弗（Typhor）、弗里特拉（Vritra）和巴库纳（Bakuna）一起，给这片土地带来了前所未有的恐怖。如果没有一位伟大英雄的勇敢，我们可能永远都无法获得自由。 [sui ran she guai ke neng mei you biao xian chu lai ， dan ta men bi kan qi lai cong ming de duo 。 xu duo nian qian ， yi zhi ju da de she guai jun dui nu yi le wo men de ren min bing duo zou le wo men de jia yuan 。 Joumungand， you shi bei cheng wei she wang ， shi zhe zhi jun dui de ling dao zhe 。 ta yu ta de san wei jiang jun tai fu （Typhor）、 fu li te la （Vritra） he ba ku na （Bakuna） yi qi ， gei zhe pian tu di dai lai le qian suo wei you de kong bu 。 ru guo mei you yi wei wei da ying xiong de yong gan ， wo men ke neng yong yuan dou wu fa huo de zi you 。]

english: A hero?
translation: 英雄？ [ying xiong ？]

english: Yes. He was known as V. He stood up to the Serpent King and confronted him on the Island of Stone. It is said that the two of them fought for days, but in the end, V stood victorious.
translation: 是的。他被称为V。他勇敢地面对蛇王，并在石岛与他对峙。据说两人大战了好几天，但最终还是V取得了胜利。 [shi de 。 ta bei cheng wei V。 ta yong gan di mian dui she wang ， bing zai shi dao yu ta dui zhi 。 ju shuo liang ren da zhan le hao ji tian ， dan zui zhong hai shi V qu de le sheng li 。]

english: What happened next?
translation: 接下来发生了什么？ [jie xia lai fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: Well that depends who you ask. The bards wrote a great song about V’s victory. They called it the Ballad of the Basilisk, and it claims V killed the Jormungand.
translation: 好吧，这取决于你问谁。吟游诗人为V的胜利写了一首伟大的歌曲。他们称其为《蛇怪之歌》，并声称 V 杀死了耶梦加得。 [hao ba ， zhe qu jue yu ni wen shui 。 yin you shi ren wei V de sheng li xie le yi shou wei da de ge qu 。 ta men cheng qi wei 《 she guai zhi ge 》， bing sheng cheng  V  sha si le ye meng jia de 。]

english: But...
Well... bards are known to bend the truth a bit, especially if it makes a song sound better. In reality V sealed the Serpent King in a magical prison on the island, where he remains to this day.
translation: 嗯……众所周知，吟游诗人会稍微歪曲事实，尤其是当它让歌曲听起来更好的时候。事实上，V 将蛇王封印在岛上的一座魔法监狱中，至今他仍留在那里。 [n …… zhong suo zhou zhi ， yin you shi ren hui shao wei wai qu shi shi ， you qi shi dang ta rang ge qu ting qi lai geng hao de shi hou 。 shi shi shang ，V  jiang she wang feng yin zai dao shang de yi zuo mo fa jian yu zhong ， zhi jin ta reng liu zai na li 。]

english: A magical prison? I thought the Fremennik people didn’t approve of magic?
translation: 魔法监狱？我以为弗雷曼尼克人不赞成魔法？ [mo fa jian yu ？ wo yi wei fu lei man ni ke ren bu zan cheng mo fa ？]

english: V was different. Stories tell of how he unlocked the potential of magic with a single touch of a stone. In that moment, he became more than just a man.
translation: V则不同。故事讲述了他如何通过触摸石头来释放魔法的潜力。那一刻，他不再只是一个人。 [V ze bu tong 。 gu shi jiang shu le ta ru he tong guo chu mo shi tou lai shi fang mo fa de qian li 。 na yi ke ， ta bu zai zhi shi yi ge ren 。]

english: A god?
translation: 神？ [shen ？]

english: It’s not a distinction the Fremennik particularly care for. To us, he has always been a hero to be respected, not a god to be worshipped. They say he felt the same way.
translation: 这并不是弗雷曼尼克人特别关心的区别。对于我们来说，他一直是值得尊敬的英雄，而不是值得崇拜的神。他们说他也有同样的感觉。 [zhe bing bu shi fu lei man ni ke ren te bie guan xin de qu bie 。 dui yu wo men lai shuo ， ta yi zhi shi zhi de zun jing de ying xiong ， er bu shi zhi de chong bai de shen 。 ta men shuo ta ye you tong yang de gan jue 。]

english: But he earned the right to use magic?
translation: 但他却获得了使用魔法的权利？ [dan ta que huo de le shi yong mo fa de quan li ？]

english: Exactly. Now the Moon Clan on the other hand, did not earn that right. Their use of magic is an insult to our people.
translation: 确切地。而现在的月族，却没有获得这个权利。他们使用魔法是对我们人民的侮辱。 [que qie di 。 er xian zai de yue zu ， que mei you huo de zhe ge quan li 。 ta men shi yong mo fa shi dui wo men ren min de wu ru 。]

english: So what can we do about the Jormungand?
translation: 那么我们能对耶梦加德做些什么呢？ [na me wo men neng dui ye meng jia de zuo xie shen me ne ？]

english: We will stay strong, [Fremennik name]. We’ll... We’ll be doomed! Our army isn’t large enough to hold back the forces of the Serpent King.
translation: 我们将保持坚强，[弗雷曼尼克名字]。我们会……我们会完蛋的！我们的军队规模不足以抵挡蛇王的军队。 [wo men jiang bao chi jian qiang ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 wo men hui …… wo men hui wan dan de ！ wo men de jun dui gui mo bu zu yi di dang she wang de jun dui 。]

english: I can help!
translation: 我可以帮忙！ [wo ke yi bang mang ！]

english: [Fremennik name], you’re strong. But you’re no army.
translation: [弗雷曼尼克名字]，你很坚强。但你们不是军队。 [[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]， ni hen jian qiang 。 dan ni men bu shi jun dui 。]

english: You’re forgetting Brundt. We have the element of surprise! They don’t know we’re aware of their attack. We could have days to prepare before they make their move. We could...
translation: 你忘记了布伦特。我们有惊喜的元素！他们不知道我们知道他们的攻击。在他们采取行动之前我们可能有几天的时间来准备。我们可以... [ni wang ji le bu lun te 。 wo men you jing xi de yuan su ！ ta men bu zhi dao wo men zhi dao ta men de gong ji 。 zai ta men cai qu xing dong zhi qian wo men ke neng you ji tian de shi jian lai zhun bei 。 wo men ke yi ...]

english: A cutscene starts
translation: 过场动画开始 [guo chang dong hua kai shi]

english: Chieftain Brundt!
translation: 布伦特酋长！ [bu lun te qiu zhang ！]

english: Agnar? What is it?
translation: 阿格纳尔？它是什么？ [a ge na er ？ ta shi shen me ？]

english: Chieftain Brundt! I’m here on behalf of the Fremennik Council! We’ve heard some disturbing news about a basilisk in town.
translation: 布伦特酋长！我代表弗雷曼尼克委员会来到这里！我们听到了一些关于镇上蛇怪的令人不安的消息。 [bu lun te qiu zhang ！ wo dai biao fu lei man ni ke wei yuan hui lai dao zhe li ！ wo men ting dao le yi xie guan yu zhen shang she guai de ling ren bu an de xiao xi 。]

english: Well I won’t deny there’s been a little issue but [Fremennik name] and I will soon have things back under control.
translation: 好吧，我不会否认存在一些小问题，但是[弗雷曼尼克名字]和我很快就会让事情恢复控制。 [hao ba ， wo bu hui fou ren cun zai yi xie xiao wen ti ， dan shi [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ] he wo hen kuai jiu hui rang shi qing hui fu kong zhi 。]

english: [Fremennik name]? When will you see that this outerlander is the cause of all our problems!
translation: [弗雷曼尼克名字]？你什么时候才能明白这个外来者是我们所有问题的根源！ [[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]？ ni shen me shi hou cai neng ming bai zhe ge wai lai zhe shi wo men suo you wen ti de gen yuan ！]

english: [Fremennik name] is no outerlander! He passed our trials and is a Fremennik, just like you and I.
translation: [弗雷曼尼克名字]不是外地人！他通过了我们的考验，是一名弗里曼尼克人，就像你我一样。 [[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ] bu shi wai di ren ！ ta tong guo le wo men de kao yan ， shi yi ming fu li man ni ke ren ， jiu xiang ni wo yi yang 。]

english: You can disguise it all you want, but he is an outerlander and always will be! Ever since we let him in, we’ve had nothing but trouble! And to top it all off, now we have basilisks wandering our town. The council have had enough!
translation: 你可以随心所欲地伪装它，但他是一个外来者，而且永远都是！自从我们让他进来之后，我们就遇到了麻烦！最重要的是，现在有蛇怪在我们的城镇里游荡。理事会已经受够了！ [ni ke yi sui xin suo yu di wei zhuang ta ， dan ta shi yi ge wai lai zhe ， er qie yong yuan dou shi ！ zi cong wo men rang ta jin lai zhi hou ， wo men jiu yu dao le ma fan ！ zui zhong yao de shi ， xian zai you she guai zai wo men de cheng zhen li you dang 。 li shi hui yi jing shou gou le ！]

english: What are you saying Agnar?
translation: 阿格纳尔你在说什么？ [a ge na er ni zai shuo shen me ？]

english: I have a declaration here signed by seven of our twelve council members. We declare this outerlander an exile!
translation: 我这里有一份由我们 12 名理事会成员中的 7 名签署的声明。我们宣布这个外地人为流亡者！ [wo zhe li you yi fen you wo men  12  ming li shi hui cheng yuan zhong de  7  ming qian shu de sheng ming 。 wo men xuan bu zhe ge wai di ren wei liu wang zhe ！]

english: This is outrageous! [Fremennik name] is one of us!
translation: 这太离谱了！ [弗雷曼尼克名字]是我们中的一员！ [zhe tai li pu le ！ [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ] shi wo men zhong de yi yuan ！]

english: Do not use the name! The decision of the council is final. As Chieftain, you are honour bound to enact it.
translation: 不要使用这个名字！理事会的决定为最终决定。作为酋长，你有义务执行它。 [bu yao shi yong zhe ge ming zi ！ li shi hui de jue ding wei zui zhong jue ding 。 zuo wei qiu zhang ， ni you yi wu zhi xing ta 。]

english: I see... Exile, you must leave our province. Our people will no longer see you as their [brother/sister].
translation: 我明白了……流放者，你必须离开我们的省份。我们的人民将不再将你视为他们的[兄弟/姐妹]。 [wo ming bai le …… liu fang zhe ， ni bi xu li kai wo men de sheng fen 。 wo men de ren min jiang bu zai jiang ni shi wei ta men de [ xiong di / jie mei ]。]

english: Chieftain Brundt gestures his head towards the south east.
translation: 布伦特酋长将头指向东南。 [bu lun te qiu zhang jiang tou zhi xiang dong nan 。]

english: Leave at once. Do not attempt to interact with myself or my people.
translation: 立刻离开。不要尝试与我自己或我的人互动。 [li ke li kai 。 bu yao chang shi yu wo zi ji huo wo de ren hu dong 。]

english: Begone exile, you are a Fremennik no more.
translation: 放弃流亡吧，你不再是弗雷曼尼克人了。 [fang qi liu wang ba ， ni bu zai shi fu lei man ni ke ren le 。]

english: Well that was awkward...
translation: 嗯，这很尴尬... [n ， zhe hen gan ga ...]

english: Indeed. I’m sorry [Fremennik name]. The reality is that many on the council did not take kindly to you becoming one of us. They’ve been looking for a good excuse to exile you ever since you arrived.
translation: 的确。对不起[弗雷曼尼克名字]。现实是，委员会中的许多人并不欢迎你成为我们中的一员。自从你来到这里之后，他们就一直在寻找一个好的借口来驱逐你。 [di que 。 dui bu qi [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 xian shi shi ， wei yuan hui zhong de xu duo ren bing bu huan ying ni cheng wei wo men zhong de yi yuan 。 zi cong ni lai dao zhe li zhi hou ， ta men jiu yi zhi zai xun zhao yi ge hao de jie kou lai qu zhu ni 。]

english: But they’re the one that voted for me in the first place!
translation: 但他们是第一个投票给我的人！ [dan ta men shi di yi ge tou piao gei wo de ren ！]

english: Well… not quite. Seven of the twelve council members gave you their vote, but you never had the support of the other five. They’re the ones who’ve been pushing for your exile.
translation: 嗯……不完全是。十二名理事会成员中有七名给了你投票，但你从未得到其他五名成员的支持。他们是那些一直在推动你流亡的人。 [n …… bu wan quan shi 。 shi er ming li shi hui cheng yuan zhong you qi ming gei le ni tou piao ， dan ni cong wei de dao qi ta wu ming cheng yuan de zhi chi 。 ta men shi na xie yi zhi zai tui dong ni liu wang de ren 。]

english: I see. And they’ve used this basilisk problem to convince some of the others.
translation: 我懂了。他们利用蛇怪问题来说服其他一些人。 [wo dong le 。 ta men li yong she guai wen ti lai shuo fu qi ta yi xie ren 。]

english: It would seem so. Try not to judge them too harshly though, they only had what was best for the province in mind. This basilisk situation has a lot of people scared.
translation: 看来是这样。不过，不要对他们做出太严厉的评价，他们只考虑对本省最好的事情。这种蛇怪的情况让很多人感到害怕。 [kan lai shi zhe yang 。 bu guo ， bu yao dui ta men zuo chu tai yan li de ping jia ， ta men zhi kao lv dui ben sheng zui hao de shi qing 。 zhe zhong she guai de qing kuang rang hen duo ren gan dao hai pa 。]

english: I don’t understand though, they’re only basilisks. Surely we have the strength to defeat them.
translation: 但我不明白，它们只是蛇怪。我们当然有实力打败他们。 [dan wo bu ming bai ， ta men zhi shi she guai 。 wo men dang ran you shi li da bai ta men 。]

english: Ah, I see you are not familiar with the End of Things.
translation: 啊，我看你对末日不熟悉。 [a ， wo kan ni dui mo ri bu shu xi 。]

english: The End of Things?
translation: 事情的终结？ [shi qing de zhong jie ？]

english: Many years ago, before the time of V, it was a foretold that this world will end in a great battle. They called this battle Ragnarok, or more commonly, the End of Things.
translation: 许多年前，在V时代之前，就曾预言这个世界将在一场大战中终结。他们将这场战斗称为“诸神黄昏”，或更通俗地说，“事物的终结”。 [xu duo nian qian ， zai V shi dai zhi qian ， jiu ceng yu yan zhe ge shi jie jiang zai yi chang da zhan zhong zhong jie 。 ta men jiang zhe chang zhan dou cheng wei “ zhu shen huang hun ”， huo geng tong su di shuo ，“ shi wu de zhong jie ”。]

english: Well that doesn’t sound good. Where do the basilisks fit in?
translation: 嗯，这听起来不太好。蛇怪适合在哪里？ [n ， zhe ting qi lai bu tai hao 。 she guai shi he zai na li ？]

english: The prophecies say that the battle will begin after the Serpent King is freed. So you see, it is not the basilisks people fear, it is what comes after.
translation: 预言称，战斗将在蛇王被释放后开始。所以你看，人们害怕的不是蛇怪，而是随之而来的怪物。 [yu yan cheng ， zhan dou jiang zai she wang bei shi fang hou kai shi 。 suo yi ni kan ， ren men hai pa de bu shi she guai ， er shi sui zhi er lai de guai wu 。]

english: Then we’d better make sure the Jormungand stays in that prison!
translation: 那我们最好确保耶梦加德留在那个监狱里！ [na wo men zui hao que bao ye meng jia de liu zai na ge jian yu li ！]

english: Well, [Fremennik name], that’s why I asked you to meet me out here. If you are to help us put a stop to this threat, you’ll need to regain the trust of the council. And I think I know just how you can do that.
translation: 好吧，[弗雷曼尼克名字]，这就是我邀请你在这里见我的原因。如果你想帮助我们制止这一威胁，你就需要重新获得议会的信任。我想我知道如何做到这一点。 [hao ba ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]， zhe jiu shi wo yao qing ni zai zhe li jian wo de yuan yin 。 ru guo ni xiang bang zhu wo men zhi zhi zhe yi wei xie ， ni jiu xu yao chong xin huo de yi hui de xin ren 。 wo xiang wo zhi dao ru he zuo dao zhe yi dian 。]

english: How?
translation: 如何？ [ru he ？]

english: I think the best possible way to those your worth to them is by being the person that restores V’s Shield.
translation: 我认为实现你对他们的价值的最佳方式就是成为恢复 V 护盾的人。 [wo ren wei shi xian ni dui ta men de jia zhi de zui jia fang shi jiu shi cheng wei hui fu  V  hu dun de ren 。]

english: V’s Shield?
translation: V盾？ [V dun ？]

english: The shield used by V when he seated the Serpent King. It is legendary amongst our people. If we are to have any chance of stopping this threat, we will need to remake it. There’s a few things I know about the shield though other things are lost from stories past. I believe some members of the Moon Clan might know the detail I don’t, so your diplomatic relations should come in handy. Keep in mind, now that you’ve been exiled, most people in the province will be unlikely to talk to you.
translation: V坐上蛇王时使用的盾牌。这在我们民间是个传奇。如果我们想要有机会阻止这一威胁，我们就需要重塑它。关于盾牌，我知道一些事情，尽管其他事情已经从过去的故事中消失了。我相信月族的一些人可能知道我不知道的细节，所以你们的外交关系应该能派上用场。请记住，既然您已被流放，该省的大多数人都不太可能与您交谈。 [V zuo shang she wang shi shi yong de dun pai 。 zhe zai wo men min jian shi ge chuan qi 。 ru guo wo men xiang yao you ji hui zu zhi zhe yi wei xie ， wo men jiu xu yao zhong su ta 。 guan yu dun pai ， wo zhi dao yi xie shi qing ， jin guan qi ta shi qing yi jing cong guo qu de gu shi zhong xiao shi le 。 wo xiang xin yue zu de yi xie ren ke neng zhi dao wo bu zhi dao de xi jie ， suo yi ni men de wai jiao guan xi ying gai neng pai shang yong chang 。 qing ji zhu ， ji ran nin yi bei liu fang ， gai sheng de da duo shu ren dou bu tai ke neng yu nin jiao tan 。]

english: Fair enough. So where should I start?
translation: 很公平。那么我应该从哪里开始呢？ [hen gong ping 。 na me wo ying gai cong na li kai shi ne ？]

english: Stories tell of how V’s Shield was made using for components. First, the base of the shield. This was a traditional Fremennik Shield, like the ones our warriors use. Next, the Lunar Glass. This was apparently created by a great Moon Clan mystic and was used to reflect the Serpent King’s gaze. Then you have the Polishing Rock. This was needed to shine the Lunar Glass. This rock was heated softly in a boiling spring. Finally, V’s Sigil. This sigil was crafted by the Moon Clan, using a unique metal known only to them.
translation: 故事讲述了如何使用组件来制造 V 的盾牌。首先是盾牌的底座。这是传统的弗雷曼盾牌，就像我们的战士使用的盾牌一样。接下来是月球玻璃。这显然是月族大秘者所造，用来反射蛇王的目光。然后你就有了抛光石。这是照亮月球玻璃所必需的。这块岩石在沸腾的泉水中被轻轻加热。最后是V的印记。这枚印记由月氏族使用只有他们知道的独特金属制作而成。 [gu shi jiang shu le ru he shi yong zu jian lai zhi zao  V  de dun pai 。 shou xian shi dun pai de di zuo 。 zhe shi chuan tong de fu lei man dun pai ， jiu xiang wo men de zhan shi shi yong de dun pai yi yang 。 jie xia lai shi yue qiu bo li 。 zhe xian ran shi yue zu da mi zhe suo zao ， yong lai fan she she wang de mu guang 。 ran hou ni jiu you le pao guang shi 。 zhe shi zhao liang yue qiu bo li suo bi xu de 。 zhe kuai yan shi zai fei teng de quan shui zhong bei qing qing jia re 。 zui hou shi V de yin ji 。 zhe mei yin ji you yue zhi zu shi yong zhi you ta men zhi dao de du te jin shu zhi zuo er cheng 。]

english: Sorry, but your trail is not over quite yet.
translation: 抱歉，您的足迹还没有结束。 [bao qian ， nin de zu ji hai mei you jie shu 。]

english: Great...
translation: 伟大的... [wei da de ...]

english: Find the answer to this question for me.
translation: 为我找到这个问题的答案。 [wei wo zhao dao zhe ge wen ti de da an 。]

english: Brundt has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 布伦特给了你一张挑战卷轴！ [bu lun te gei le ni yi zhang tiao zhan juan zhou ！]

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。 [qing shu ru wen ti de da an 。]

english: Wrong answer!
translation: 错误答案！ [cuo wu da an ！]

english: Perfect!
translation: 完美的！ [wan mei de ！]

english: Brundt has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
translation: 布伦特给了你[另一个线索卷轴/一个棺材]！ [bu lun te gei le ni [ ling yi ge xian suo juan zhou / yi ge guan cai ]！]

english: Do you have any quests?
translation: 你有什么任务吗？ [ni you shen me ren wu ma ？]

english: Yes, I am interested.
translation: 是的，我有兴趣。 [shi de ， wo you xing qu 。]

english: No, I'm not interested.
translation: 不，我不感兴趣。 [bu ， wo bu gan xing qu 。]

english: Why do you call me outerlander?
translation: 为什么叫我外地人？ [wei shen me jiao wo wai di ren ？]

english: I seek an army to destroy Asgarnia!
translation: 我正在寻找一支军队来摧毁阿斯卡尼亚！ [wo zheng zai xun zhao yi zhi jun dui lai cui hui a si ka ni ya ！]

english: Who are the Fremennik?
translation: 谁是弗雷曼尼克人？ [shui shi fu lei man ni ke ren ？]

english: Nice hat!
translation: 帽子不错！ [mao zi bu cuo ！]

english: Ask about becoming a Fremennik
translation: 询问成为 Fremennik 的问题 [xun wen cheng wei  Fremennik  de wen ti]

english: Ask about a Seal of Passage.
translation: 询问有关通道印章的问题。 [xun wen you guan tong dao yin zhang de wen ti 。]

english: Ask about the mountain camp.
translation: 询问一下山上营地的情况。 [xun wen yi xia shan shang ying di de qing kuang 。]

english: Ask about V's Shield.
translation: 问一下V的盾牌。 [wen yi xia V de dun pai 。]

english: Ask about anything else.
translation: 询问其他任何事情。 [xun wen qi ta ren he shi qing 。]

english: I just came to say hello.
translation: 我只是来打个招呼。 [wo zhi shi lai da ge zhao hu 。]

english: Can I hear the history of your people?
translation: 我可以听听你们人民的历史吗？ [wo ke yi ting ting ni men ren min de li shi ma ？]

english: Tell me of the finding of Koschei
translation: 告诉我 Koschei 的发现 [gao su wo  Koschei  de fa xian]

english: Tell me of the lands to the North
translation: 告诉我北方的土地 [gao su wo bei fang de tu di]

english: Tell me of the outerlanders
translation: 说说外地人的事 [shuo shuo wai di ren de shi]

english: Don't tell me anything
translation: 别告诉我任何事 [bie gao su wo ren he shi]

english: Ask about a Seal of Passage
translation: 询问有关通道印章的问题 [xun wen you guan tong dao yin zhang de wen ti]

english: Ask for a quest.
translation: 求一个任务。 [qiu yi ge ren wu 。]

english: What are you doing down here?
translation: 你在下面做什么？ [ni zai xia mian zuo shen me ？]

english: Could you explain this place to me again?
translation: 你能再向我解释一下这个地方吗？ [ni neng zai xiang wo jie shi yi xia zhe ge di fang ma ？]

english: This here is the Gauntlet, the finest creation of the Amlodd clan. It was built years ago to help train Prifddinas' finest warriors and survivalists.
translation: 这就是手套，Amlodd 氏族最优秀的创造。它是多年前建造的，旨在帮助训练普里夫迪纳斯最优秀的战士和生存者。 [zhe jiu shi shou tao ，Amlodd  shi zu zui you xiu de chuang zao 。 ta shi duo nian qian jian zao de ， zhi zai bang zhu xun lian pu li fu di na si zui you xiu de zhan shi he sheng cun zhe 。]

english: Train?
translation: 火车？ [huo che ？]

english: That's right. The Gauntlet contains a range of deadly creatures formed from crystal. Defeating them is the key to victory, but it is no easy task.
translation: 这是正确的。手套中包含一系列由水晶制成的致命生物。击败他们是胜利的关键，但这并不是一件容易的事。 [zhe shi zheng que de 。 shou tao zhong bao han yi xi lie you shui jing zhi cheng de zhi ming sheng wu 。 ji bai ta men shi sheng li de guan jian ， dan zhe bing bu shi yi jian rong yi de shi 。]

english: This is because all participants start with nothing at hand beyond a few basic tools.
translation: 这是因为所有参与者一开始除了一些基本工具之外什么都没有。 [zhe shi yin wei suo you can yu zhe yi kai shi chu le yi xie ji ben gong ju zhi wai shen me dou mei you 。]

english: But how do people fight without their gear?
translation: 但是人们如何在没有装备的情况下进行战斗呢？ [dan shi ren men ru he zai mei you zhuang bei de qing kuang xia jin xing zhan dou ne ？]

english: Resources can be gathered throughout the dungeon. These can be used to create the weapons, armour, food and potions needed to survive.
translation: 可以在整个地牢中收集资源。这些可以用来制造生存所需的武器、盔甲、食物和药剂。 [ke yi zai zheng ge di lao zhong shou ji zi yuan 。 zhe xie ke yi yong lai zhi zao sheng cun suo xu de wu qi 、 kui jia 、 shi wu huo yao ji 。]

english: Without any armour, those crystalline creatures can be real nasty. Any armour that you make down there will greatly reduce the damage they do to you.
translation: 如果没有任何盔甲，那些水晶生物可能真的很讨厌。你在那里制作的任何盔甲都会大大减少它们对你造成的伤害。 [ru guo mei you ren he kui jia ， na xie shui jing sheng wu ke neng zhen de hen tao yan 。 ni zai na li zhi zuo de ren he kui jia du hui da da jian shao ta men dui ni zao cheng de shang hai 。]

english: Okay, I think I follow... But I thought this was all about combat, not just gathering my own equipment.
translation: 好吧，我想我明白了……但我认为这都是关于战斗的，而不仅仅是收集我自己的装备。 [hao ba ， wo xiang wo ming bai le …… dan wo ren wei zhe dou shi guan yu zhan dou de ， er bu jin jin shi shou ji wo zi ji de zhuang bei 。]

english: That's right. Once you feel you're ready, or once we decide that you've spent long enough down there, you'll have to face the fearsome Crystalline Hunllef.
translation: 这是正确的。一旦你觉得你已经准备好了，或者一旦我们认为你已经在那里待了足够长的时间，你就必须面对可怕的水晶汉勒夫。 [zhe shi zheng que de 。 yi dan ni jue de ni yi jing zhun bei hao le ， huo zhe yi dan wo men ren wei ni yi jing zai na li dai le zu gou zhang de shi jian ， ni jiu bi xu mian dui ke pa de shui jing han lei fu 。]

english: And what makes it so dangerous, if it's just for training?
translation: 如果只是为了训练，那么是什么让它如此危险？ [ru guo zhi shi wei le xun lian ， na me shi shen me rang ta ru ci wei xian ？]

english: Once you go down there, there are only two ways out... You can make a break for the exit, or if you're bested in combat we'll send someone in for you.
translation: 一旦你下去了，就只有两条路可以出去……你可以从出口出去，或者如果你在战斗中被击败，我们会派人来接你。 [yi dan ni xia qu le ， jiu zhi you liang tiao lu ke yi chu qu …… ni ke yi cong chu kou chu qu ， huo zhe ru guo ni zai zhan dou zhong bei ji bai ， wo men hui pai ren lai jie ni 。]

english: Things can be a little unstable down there at times, too... Everything gets corrupted, and it might be a little frightening, but it makes for a good challenge.
translation: 有时那里的情况也可能有点不稳定……一切都会被破坏，这可能有点可怕，但它是一个很好的挑战。 [you shi na li de qing kuang ye ke neng you dian bu wen ding …… yi qie du hui bei po huai ， zhe ke neng you dian ke pa ， dan ta shi yi ge hen hao de tiao zhan 。]

english: The Corrupted Gauntlet can be accessed by rightclicking the entrance.
translation: 右键单击入口即可进入腐化手套。 [you jian dan ji ru kou ji ke jin ru fu hua shou tao 。]

english: I think that covers it... Everything else, you'll have to work out for yourself while you're in there.
translation: 我认为这涵盖了它......其他一切，当你在那里的时候，你必须自己解决。 [wo ren wei zhe han gai le ta ...... qi ta yi qie ， dang ni zai na li de shi hou ， ni bi xu zi ji jie jue 。]

english: Okay... I think I've got it.
translation: 好吧...我想我已经明白了。 [hao ba ... wo xiang wo yi jing ming bai le 。]

english: You can always come back and ask me to go over things again.
translation: 你随时可以回来请我重温一遍。 [ni sui shi ke yi hui lai qing wo chong wen yi bian 。]

english: I'm thinking of giving the Gauntlet a go.
translation: 我正在考虑尝试一下《Gauntlet》。 [wo zheng zai kao lv chang shi yi xia 《Gauntlet》。]

english: You? Attempting the Gauntlet? If you say so!
translation: 你？尝试挑战？如果你这么说的话！ [ni ？ chang shi tiao zhan ？ ru guo ni zhe me shuo de hua ！]

english: Just passing by.
translation: 只是路过而已。 [zhi shi lu guo er yi 。]

english: Alright... Well be careful down here. I've got my eye on you.
translation: 好吧...下面小心一点。我已经注视着你了。 [hao ba ... xia mian xiao xin yi dian 。 wo yi jing zhu shi zhe ni le 。]

english: Don't think you want to be heading down there without knowing what you're getting into! Come and see me, if you really want to go down there.
translation: 不要认为您想在不知道自己会遇到什么的情况下就去那里！如果你真的想去那里的话，就来见我吧。 [bu yao ren wei nin xiang zai bu zhi dao zi ji hui yu dao shen me de qing kuang xia jiu qu na li ！ ru guo ni zhen de xiang qu na li de hua ， jiu lai jian wo ba 。]

english: Don't think you can be taking any plus ones down there with you.
translation: 不要以为你可以带着任何额外的东西去那里。 [bu yao yi wei ni ke yi dai zhe ren he e wai de dong xi qu na li 。]

english: There's something in that there chest waiting for you. Don't leave it for too long.
translation: 那个箱子里有东西等着你。不要将其放置太久。 [na ge xiang zi li you dong xi deng zhe ni 。 bu yao jiang qi fang zhi tai jiu 。]

english: Could you explain this place to me again?
translation: 你能再向我解释一下这个地方吗？ [ni neng zai xiang wo jie shi yi xia zhe ge di fang ma ？]

english: I'm thinking of giving the Gauntlet a go.
translation: 我正在考虑尝试一下《Gauntlet》。 [wo zheng zai kao lv chang shi yi xia 《Gauntlet》。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Just passing by.
translation: 只是路过而已。 [zhi shi lu guo er yi 。]

english: You's better talk to Dad, him chasey sneaky da chompy.
translation: 你最好和爸爸谈谈，他是个鬼鬼祟祟、脾气暴躁的人。 [ni zui hao he ba ba tan tan ， ta shi ge gui gui sui sui 、 pi qi bao zao de ren 。]

english: Thanks for da chompy, it was deloverly!
translation: 谢谢你的大嚼，太棒了！ [xie xie ni de da jue ， tai bang le ！]

english: A bug! Hahaha.
translation: 一个错误！哈哈哈。 [yi ge cuo wu ！ ha ha ha 。]

english: HAHAHAHAHA
translation: 哈哈哈哈哈哈 [ha ha ha ha ha ha]

english: ...ahahaha
translation: ...啊哈哈哈 [... a ha ha ha]

english: HA!
translation: 哈！ [ha ！]

english: Ok... I'm done.
translation: 好吧...我完成了。 [hao ba ... wo wan cheng le 。]

english: The bunny thinks you laughed at them and looks both angry and embarrassed.
translation: 兔子认为你在嘲笑他们，看起来既生气又尴尬。 [tu zi ren wei ni zai chao xiao ta men ， kan qi lai ji sheng qi you gan ga 。]

english: Oh, sorry. I didn't mean to turn you into a... Hot cross bunny!
translation: 哦，抱歉。我不是故意要把你变成……热十字兔子！ [o ， bao qian 。 wo bu shi gu yi yao ba ni bian cheng …… re shi zi tu zi ！]

english: It's a bit rude of 'em to take up the whole bridge with their conversation, isn't it, mate?
translation: 他们把整个桥都用来谈话有点粗鲁，不是吗，伙计？ [ta men ba zheng ge qiao dou yong lai tan hua you dian cu lu ， bu shi ma ， huo ji ？]

english: Aye, mate, but wouldn't it be just as rude for us to interrupt?
translation: 是的，伙计，但是我们打断的话不是同样粗鲁吗？ [shi de ， huo ji ， dan shi wo men da duan de hua bu shi tong yang cu lu ma ？]

english: A good point well made, mate. Who are we to decide that the dig is more impor'ant than a personal disagreement between two people?
translation: 一个很好的观点，说得好，伙计。我们凭什么来决定挖掘比两个人之间的个人分歧更重要？ [yi ge hen hao de guan dian ， shuo de hao ， huo ji 。 wo men ping shen me lai jue ding wa jue bi liang ge ren zhi jian de ge ren fen qi geng zhong yao ？]

english: You're not wrong, mate. We often place matters of industry above those of people, and it's chippin' away at our ability to relate to each other on a human level.
translation: 你没有错，伙计。我们经常将行业问题置于人的问题之上，这削弱了我们在人际层面上相互联系的能力。 [ni mei you cuo ， huo ji 。 wo men jing chang jiang hang ye wen ti zhi yu ren de wen ti zhi shang ， zhe xue ruo le wo men zai ren ji ceng mian shang xiang hu lian xi de neng li 。]

english: What's going on here?
translation: 这是怎么回事？ [zhe shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: We're part of a dig into some ruins beneath Cam Torum, but the way's blocked by these folks.
translation: 我们正在挖掘卡姆托鲁姆地下的一些废墟，但道路被这些人挡住了。 [wo men zheng zai wa jue ka mu tuo lu mu di xia de yi xie fei xu ， dan dao lu bei zhe xie ren dang zhu le 。]

english: Have you tried asking them to move?
translation: 你试过要求他们搬家吗？ [ni shi guo yao qiu ta men ban jia ma ？]

english: We're considering the moral implications of doing exactly that, mate.
translation: 我们正在考虑这样做的道德含义，伙计。 [wo men zheng zai kao lv zhe yang zuo de dao de han yi ， huo ji 。]

english: Are you two philosophers?
translation: 你们两个是哲学家吗？ [ni men liang ge shi zhe xue jia ma ？]

english: No mate, builders.
translation: 没有伙伴，建设者。 [mei you huo ban ， jian she zhe 。]

english: But thinking, talking, discussing, it's what makes us human, mate.
translation: 但思考、交谈、讨论才是我们成为人类的原因，伙计。 [dan si kao 、 jiao tan 、 tao lun cai shi wo men cheng wei ren lei de yuan yin ， huo ji 。]

english: It's not just humans that do those things.
translation: 不只是人类做这些事情。 [bu zhi shi ren lei zuo zhe xie shi qing 。]

english: Fair play, mate. I guess we're reflecting more on the condition of sen'ience in general then.
translation: 公平竞争，伙计。我想我们现在更多地思考的是一般意义上的感知状况。 [gong ping jing zheng ， huo ji 。 wo xiang wo men xian zai geng duo di si kao de shi yi ban yi yi shang de gan zhi zhuang kuang 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Have a good one, mate.
translation: 祝你过得愉快，伙计。 [zhu ni guo de yu kuai ， huo ji 。]

english: Thanks for that, mate. You should speak to Jess inside. She'll be in the north of the city. She could use a problem solver like yourself.
translation: 谢谢你，伙计。你应该在里面和杰西说话。她将在城市的北部。她可以使用像你这样的问题解决者。 [xie xie ni ， huo ji 。 ni ying gai zai li mian he jie xi shuo hua 。 ta jiang zai cheng shi de bei bu 。 ta ke yi shi yong xiang ni zhe yang de wen ti jie jue zhe 。]

english: Who's Jess?
translation: 杰西是谁？ [jie xi shi shui ？]

english: She's the archaeologist in charge of the dig into these ruins they've found. Discovering the mysteries of the past and that.
translation: 她是负责挖掘他们发现的这些废墟的考古学家。发现过去的奥秘。 [ta shi fu ze wa jue ta men fa xian de zhe xie fei xu de kao gu xue jia 。 fa xian guo qu de ao mi 。]

english: You should head inside, mate. Remember, Jess will be in the north of the city. She could use a problem solver like yourself.
translation: 你应该进去，伙计。请记住，杰西将在城市的北部。她可以使用像你这样的问题解决者。 [ni ying gai jin qu ， huo ji 。 qing ji zhu ， jie xi jiang zai cheng shi de bei bu 。 ta ke yi shi yong xiang ni zhe yang de wen ti jie jue zhe 。]

english: To me!
translation: 大部头书！ [da bu tou shu ！]

english: To you!
translation: 给你！ [gei ni ！]

english: Keep it down!
translation: 放低点！ [fang di dian ！]

english: G'day, mate.
translation: 日安，伙计。 [ri an ， huo ji 。]

english: I'm surprised to see you both in such high spirits after walking past all those jeering dwarves.
translation: 我很惊讶地看到你们在走过那些嘲笑的矮人之后竟然如此兴高采烈。 [wo hen jing ya di kan dao ni men zai zou guo na xie chao xiao de ai ren zhi hou jing ran ru ci xing gao cai lie 。]

english: Ah, well it's unfortunate, but no reason to be sad. It's them that ought to be sad.
translation: 啊，虽然不幸，但没有理由悲伤。应该悲伤的是他们。 [a ， sui ran bu xing ， dan mei you li you bei shang 。 ying gai bei shang de shi ta men 。]

english: Aye, mate. Livin' a life unable to connect with others because they look different must be miserable.
translation: 是的，伙计。因为别人看起来不同而无法与他人交流的生活一定很痛苦。 [shi de ， huo ji 。 yin wei bie ren kan qi lai bu tong er wu fa yu ta ren jiao liu de sheng huo yi ding hen tong ku 。]

english: We wish 'em the best. Hopefully their paths to personal growth are near and smooth.
translation: 我们祝愿他们一切顺利。希望他们的个人成长之路近在眼前且顺利。 [wo men zhu yuan ta men yi qie shun li 。 xi wang ta men de ge ren cheng zhang zhi lu jin zai yan qian qie shun li 。]

english: Thanks for taking care of those base camps, mate.
translation: 谢谢你照顾这些大本营，伙计。 [xie xie ni zhao gu zhe xie da ben ying ， huo ji 。]

english: No problem. I hope there's no hard feelings over Jessamine asking me to do a part of your jobs.
translation: 没问题。我希望杰西明让我做你的一部分工作不会有什么不好的感觉。 [mei wen ti 。 wo xi wang jie xi ming rang wo zuo ni de yi bu fen gong zuo bu hui you shen me bu hao de gan jue 。]

english: That's no worries, mate, I've no issue admitting you're better cut out for building camps in dangerous dungeons than I am.
translation: 不用担心，伙计，我毫不犹豫地承认你比我更适合在危险的地牢里建造营地。 [bu yong dan xin ， huo ji ， wo hao bu you yu di cheng ren ni bi wo geng shi he zai wei xian de di lao li jian zao ying di 。]

english: We may not be mul'i-disciplined adventurers like you, but we don't need to be. The world needs more than just heroes, don't it?
translation: 我们可能不像你一样是多学科的冒险家，但我们也不需要这样。这个世界需要的不仅仅是英雄，不是吗？ [wo men ke neng bu xiang ni yi yang shi duo xue ke de mao xian jia ， dan wo men ye bu xu yao zhe yang 。 zhe ge shi jie xu yao de bu jin jin shi ying xiong ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Aye, mate, I'm content and proud to just be a hard working, decent builder.
translation: 是的，伙计，我很满足，也很自豪能成为一名勤奋、体面的建设者。 [shi de ， huo ji ， wo hen man zu ， ye hen zi hao neng cheng wei yi ming qin fen 、 ti mian de jian she zhe 。]

english: Besides, without us, building supplies wouldn't be there in the first place. Life's all about working together.
translation: 此外，如果没有我们，建筑用品一开始就不会存在。生活就是要一起努力。 [ci wai ， ru guo mei you wo men ， jian zhu yong pin yi kai shi jiu bu hui cun zai 。 sheng huo jiu shi yao yi qi nu li 。]

english: Glad to hear it. Keep up the good work then!
translation: 很高兴听到这个消息。那么继续努力吧！ [hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi 。 na me ji xu nu li ba ！]

english: You too, mate.
translation: 你也是，伙计。 [ni ye shi ， huo ji 。]

english: You seem remarkably calm considering everything that's going on.
translation: 考虑到正在发生的一切，你看起来非常冷静。 [kao lv dao zheng zai fa sheng de yi qie ， ni kan qi lai fei chang leng jing 。]

english: Life's unpredictable, mate. No sense stressin' over what's out of your control.
translation: 生活是不可预测的，伙计。没有必要为那些你无法控制的事情而感到压力。 [sheng huo shi bu ke yu ce de ， huo ji 。 mei you bi yao wei na xie ni wu fa kong zhi de shi qing er gan dao ya li 。]

english: It's not like we're not aware of the danger we're in, but worryin' about it ain't productive.
translation: 我们并不是没有意识到自己所处的危险，但担心它是没有成效的。 [wo men bing bu shi mei you yi shi dao zi ji suo chu de wei xian ， dan dan xin ta shi mei you cheng xiao de 。]

english: Shouldn't you be getting out of here if you feel like you're in danger?
translation: 如果你觉得自己有危险，难道不应该离开这里吗？ [ru guo ni jue de zi ji you wei xian ， nan dao bu ying gai li kai zhe li ma ？]

english: We may not be in total control of our surroundings, but we can still impact them positively through our actions. Like bein' here to support you.
translation: 我们可能无法完全控制周围的环境，但我们仍然可以通过我们的行动对它们产生积极的影响。就像在这里支持你一样。 [wo men ke neng wu fa wan quan kong zhi zhou wei de huan jing ， dan wo men reng ran ke yi tong guo wo men de xing dong dui ta men chan sheng ji ji de ying xiang 。 jiu xiang zai zhe li zhi chi ni yi yang 。]

english: Even if that's just emotionally. We believe in you, mate.
translation: 即使这只是情感上的。我们相信你，伙计。 [ji shi zhe zhi shi qing gan shang de 。 wo men xiang xin ni ， huo ji 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: No worries, mate. Go get 'em.
translation: 不用担心，伙计。去找他们吧。 [bu yong dan xin ， huo ji 。 qu zhao ta men ba 。]

english: I am a fool...
translation: 我是个傻瓜... [wo shi ge sha gua ...]

english: Well... yes, a bit.
translation: 嗯...是的，有一点。 [n ... shi de ， you yi dian 。]

english: You meant well. You thought you were helpin'. Can't fault you for that part, mate.
translation: 你的本意是好的。你以为你在帮忙。在这方面我不能责怪你，伙计。 [ni de ben yi shi hao de 。 ni yi wei ni zai bang mang 。 zai zhe fang mian wo bu neng ze guai ni ， huo ji 。]

english: You made a mistake. Coulda been any of us. Just gotta make sure we learn from our mistakes is all.
translation: 你犯了一个错误。可能是我们中的任何一个人。只要确保我们从错误中吸取教训就够了。 [ni fan le yi ge cuo wu 。 ke neng shi wo men zhong de ren he yi ge ren 。 zhi yao que bao wo men cong cuo wu zhong xi qu jiao xun jiu gou le 。]

english: And if yer genuinely sorry, best you can do is work to be better, not mope around. So keep your chin up, mate!
translation: 如果你真的很抱歉，你能做的就是努力变得更好，而不是闷闷不乐。所以，保持你的下巴，伙计！ [ru guo ni zhen de hen bao qian ， ni neng zuo de jiu shi nu li bian de geng hao ， er bu shi men men bu le 。 suo yi ， bao chi ni de xia ba ， huo ji ！]

english: Thank you...
translation: 谢谢... [xie xie ...]

english: What did you do, anyway?
translation: 无论如何，你做了什么？ [wu lun ru he ， ni zuo le shen me ？]

english: I saw sun and moon runes on that thing. Recalled something from Ranul's teachings, a rite he once performed...
translation: 我在那东西上看到了日月符文。想起拉努尔教诲中的一些内容，他曾经执行过的一个仪式…… [wo zai na dong xi shang kan dao le ri yue fu wen 。 xiang qi la nu er jiao hui zhong de yi xie nei rong ， ta ceng jing zhi xing guo de yi ge yi shi ……]

english: I tried to emulate it, and it worked. I thought I had freed his emissaries. But they weren't that at all...
translation: 我尝试模仿它，并且成功了。我以为我已经释放了他的使者。但他们根本不是那样的…… [wo chang shi mo fang ta ， bing qie cheng gong le 。 wo yi wei wo yi jing shi fang le ta de shi zhe 。 dan ta men gen ben bu shi na yang de ……]

english: Interesting. Maybe there was some sort of connection between Ranul and this place after all.
translation: 有趣的。也许拉努尔和这个地方之间到底有某种联系。 [you qu de 。 ye xu la nu er he zhe ge di fang zhi jian dao di you mou zhong lian xi 。]

english: Well, all's well that ends well.
translation: 好吧，一切都好，结局好。 [hao ba ， yi qie dou hao ， jie ju hao 。]

english: We never had any doubts! Always knew you'd get it sorted, mate.
translation: 我们从来没有任何怀疑！一直都知道你会解决问题的，伙计。 [wo men cong lai mei you ren he huai yi ！ yi zhi dou zhi dao ni hui jie jue wen ti de ， huo ji 。]

english: No worries, mate.
translation: 不用担心，伙计。 [bu yong dan xin ， huo ji 。]

english: Good to see you again, mate.
translation: 很高兴再次见到你，伙计。 [hen gao xing zai ci jian dao ni ， huo ji 。]

english: Good to see you both as well. How's things?
translation: 很高兴见到你们俩。事情怎么样？ [hen gao xing jian dao ni men lia 。 shi qing zen me yang ？]

english: Never better, mate. Never better. This here ruin was the find of the century!
translation: 从来没有更好过，伙计。从来没有更好过。这里的废墟是本世纪的发现！ [cong lai mei you geng hao guo ， huo ji 。 cong lai mei you geng hao guo 。 zhe li de fei xu shi ben shi ji de fa xian ！]

english: All credit to Jess, o'course, but we're glad to be doing our bit!
translation: 当然，这一切都归功于 Jess，但我们很高兴能尽自己的一份力量！ [dang ran ， zhe yi qie dou gui gong yu  Jess， dan wo men hen gao xing neng jin zi ji de yi fen li liang ！]

english: Glad to hear it.
translation: 很高兴听到这个消息。 [hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi 。]

english: What's going on here?
translation: 这是怎么回事？ [zhe shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: Are you two philosophers?
translation: 你们两个是哲学家吗？ [ni men liang ge shi zhe xue jia ma ？]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Can I help you today?
translation: 今天我可以帮你吗？ [jin tian wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: Can I go for a ride?
translation: 我可以去兜风吗？ [wo ke yi qu dou feng ma ？]

english: Minecart rides are 20 coins.
translation: 乘坐矿车需要 20 个金币。 [cheng zuo kuang che xu yao  20  ge jin bi 。]

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this.
translation: 作为 Lovakengj 矿车网络的忠实客户，您有权享受这一点。 [zuo wei  Lovakengj  kuang che wang luo de zhong shi ke hu ， nin you quan xiang shou zhe yi dian 。]

english: Now, can I help you today?
translation: 现在，今天我可以帮你吗？ [xian zai ， jin tian wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: You're already here, human.
translation: 你已经在这里了，人类。 [ni yi jing zai zhe li le ， ren lei 。]

english: Can I go for a ride?
translation: 我可以去兜风吗？ [wo ke yi qu dou feng ma ？]

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: How does it feel to be back home?
translation: 回到家感觉如何？ [hui dao jia gan jue ru he ？]

english: Ayyy ... *hiccup* ... Ish been sho long sinsh I've ... *hiccup* ... ad a deshent cocktail!
translation: 哎呀...*打嗝*...我已经很久了，我已经...*打嗝*...广告一杯美味的鸡尾酒！ [ai ya ...* da ge *... wo yi jing hen jiu le ， wo yi jing ...* da ge *... guang gao yi bei mei wei de ji wei jiu ！]

english: Glad to see you enjoying yourself... I guess.
translation: 很高兴看到你玩得很开心......我想。 [hen gao xing kan dao ni wan de hen kai xin ...... wo xiang 。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Hello sir, are you going to make a snowman?
translation: 先生您好，您要堆雪人吗？ [xian sheng nin hao ， nin yao dui xue ren ma ？]

english: Maybe, I'm not sure I'd be very good at it!
translation: 也许，我不确定我是否擅长于此！ [ye xu ， wo bu que ding wo shi fou shan chang yu ci ！]

english: I think you would be!
translation: 我想你会的！ [wo xiang ni hui de ！]

english: I want to make a snowman, but I can't reach high enough to stack the snowballs properly.
translation: 我想堆雪人，但我不够高，无法正确堆放雪球。 [wo xiang dui xue ren ， dan wo bu gou gao ， wu fa zheng que dui fang xue qiu 。]

english: Hello Buoy and Gurl!
translation: 你好，浮标和古尔！ [ni hao ， fu biao he gu er ！]

english: Hello sir!
translation: 你好先生！ [ni hao xian sheng ！]

english: How do you know our names?
translation: 你怎么知道我们的名字？ [ni zen me zhi dao wo men de ming zi ？]

english: I had a chat with your dad. He's super busy, so he's asked me to help you build a snowman!
translation: 我和你爸爸聊过他太忙了，所以他让我帮你堆雪人！ [wo he ni ba ba liao guo ta tai mang le ， suo yi ta rang wo bang ni dui xue ren ！]

english: Really? We get to make a snowman?
translation: 真的吗？我们可以堆雪人吗？ [zhen de ma ？ wo men ke yi dui xue ren ma ？]

english: Yes! And I'm going to build whatever snowman you want!
translation: 是的！我会堆你想要的任何雪人！ [shi de ！ wo hui dui ni xiang yao de ren he xue ren ！]

english: Yay! Can it be three snowballs tall?
translation: 耶！能有三个雪球那么高吗？ [ye ！ neng you san ge xue qiu na me gao ma ？]

english: But I want it to be five tall!
translation: 但我希望它有五高！ [dan wo xi wang ta you wu gao ！]

english: Five is a bad number, it should be three tall!
translation: 五是个不好的数字，应该是三高！ [wu shi ge bu hao de shu zi ， ying gai shi san gao ！]

english: You're a bad number. Five is so much better.
translation: 你这个号码不好。五个就好多了。 [ni zhe ge hao ma bu hao 。 wu ge jiu hao duo le 。]

english: Okay, okay, wait a second. Why don't we meet in the middle. How about four snowballs tall?
translation: 好吧好吧，等一下。为什么我们不在中间见面呢？四个雪球高怎么样？ [hao ba hao ba ， deng yi xia 。 wei shen me wo men bu zai zhong jian jian mian ne ？ si ge xue qiu gao zen me yang ？]

english: Fine, it can be four tall.
translation: 好吧，它可以有四高。 [hao ba ， ta ke yi you si gao 。]

english: Yes, four tall is okay.
translation: 是的，四高就可以了。 [shi de ， si gao jiu ke yi le 。]

english: Great. Now, we need to pick what size snowballs we want for each tier. Why don't you take it in turns? You can do two each.
translation: 伟大的。现在，我们需要为每一层选择我们想要的雪球大小。为什么不轮流做呢？你们每人可以做两个。 [wei da de 。 xian zai ， wo men xu yao wei mei yi ceng xuan ze wo men xiang yao de xue qiu da xiao 。 wei shen me bu lun liu zuo ne ？ ni men mei ren ke yi zuo liang ge 。]

english: The bottom one should be a huge snowball!
translation: 最下面的应该是一个巨大的雪球！ [zui xia mian de ying gai shi yi ge ju da de xue qiu ！]

english: The next one should be big!
translation: 下一篇应该会很大！ [xia yi pian ying gai hui hen da ！]

english: This is working nicely, we're half way! What about the top two parts?
translation: 效果很好，我们已经成功一半了！上面两部分呢？ [xiao guo hen hao ， wo men yi jing cheng gong yi ban le ！ shang mian liang bu fen ne ？]

english: The next one should be a small snowball!
translation: 下一个应该是一个小雪球！ [xia yi ge ying gai shi yi ge xiao xue qiu ！]

english: No, it should be little!
translation: 不，应该很小！ [bu ， ying gai hen xiao ！]

english: But it needs to be small, little would look bad.
translation: 但一定要小，太小了就不好看了。 [dan yi ding yao xiao ， tai xiao le jiu bu hao kan le 。]

english: It wouldn't look bad. Small is better for decorations.
translation: 看起来不会很糟糕。小的更适合装饰。 [kan qi lai bu hui hen zao gao 。 xiao de geng shi he zhuang shi 。]

english: My decorations will fit on a little one.
translation: 我的装饰品适合一只小家伙。 [wo de zhuang shi pin shi he yi zhi xiao jia huo 。]

english: Why do you always ruin everything?
translation: 为什么你总是毁掉一切？ [wei shen me ni zong shi hui diao yi qie ？]

english: You ruin everything with your silly ideas!
translation: 你用你愚蠢的想法毁了一切！ [ni yong ni yu chun de xiang fa hui le yi qie ！]

english: Okay, okay, wait. This clearly isn't working, and I don't want you two to fall out. It's Christmas, we shouldn't be arguing!
translation: 好吧好吧，等等。这显然行不通，我不想让你们两个闹翻。今天是圣诞节，我们不应该吵架！ [hao ba hao ba ， deng deng 。 zhe xian ran xing bu tong ， wo bu xiang rang ni men liang ge nao fan 。 jin tian shi sheng dan jie ， wo men bu ying gai chao jia ！]

english: How about I make you both a snowman? It can be whatever height and size you like. One each!
translation: 我给你们堆个雪人怎么样？它可以是您喜欢的任何高度和尺寸。各一个！ [wo gei ni men dui ge xue ren zen me yang ？ ta ke yi shi nin xi huan de ren he gao du he chi cun 。 ge yi ge ！]

english: So mine can be five snowballs tall?
translation: 那么我的雪球可以有五个雪球高吗？ [na me wo de xue qiu ke yi you wu ge xue qiu gao ma ？]

english: And mine can be three snowballs tall?
translation: 我的可以有三个雪球高吗？ [wo de ke yi you san ge xue qiu gao ma ？]

english: Yes, I'll make you both whatever snowman you like!
translation: 是的，我会给你们堆任何你们喜欢的雪人！ [shi de ， wo hui gei ni men dui ren he ni men xi huan de xue ren ！]

english: What would you both like?
translation: 你们俩想要什么？ [ni men lia xiang yao shen me ？]

english: I'd like mine to be three snowballs tall please! And I want the bottom one to be small, the middle one big, and the top one huge!
translation: 我希望我的雪球能有三个雪球那么高！我希望底部的一个小，中间的一个大，顶部的一个巨大！ [wo xi wang wo de xue qiu neng you san ge xue qiu na me gao ！ wo xi wang di bu de yi ge xiao ， zhong jian de yi ge da ， ding bu de yi ge ju da ！]

english: I'd like mine to be five snowballs tall please! I want the bottom one to be humongous, then large, then normal, then big, and then a little one for the top!
translation: 我希望我的雪球能有五个雪球那么高！我希望底部的一个巨大，然后大，然后正常，然后大，然后顶部一个小！ [wo xi wang wo de xue qiu neng you wu ge xue qiu na me gao ！ wo xi wang di bu de yi ge ju da ， ran hou da ， ran hou zheng chang ， ran hou da ， ran hou ding bu yi ge xiao ！]

english: That's two very different snowmen, I see why this didn't work before!
translation: 这是两个截然不同的雪人，我明白为什么这以前不起作用了！ [zhe shi liang ge jie ran bu tong de xue ren ， wo ming bai wei shen me zhe yi qian bu qi zuo yong le ！]

english: What do all these different sizes mean? Humongous? Normal? Little? How big are those?
translation: 所有这些不同的尺寸意味着什么？巨大吗？普通的？小的？那些有多大？ [suo you zhe xie bu tong de chi cun yi wei zhe shen me ？ ju da ma ？ pu tong de ？ xiao de ？ na xie you duo da ？]

english: You silly billy! Humongous is the biggest snowball of course!
translation: 你这个傻比利！ Humongous当然是最大的雪球！ [ni zhe ge sha bi li ！ Humongous dang ran shi zui da de xue qiu ！]

english: Normal is the normal size that you get when you make a snowball normally. It's easy!
translation: 正常是正常制作雪球时得到的正常大小。这很容易！ [zheng chang shi zheng chang zhi zuo xue qiu shi de dao de zheng chang da xiao 。 zhe hen rong yi ！]

english: Right, thank you for clearing that up. I'll figure something out.
translation: 好的，谢谢你澄清这一点。我会想办法的。 [hao de ， xie xie ni cheng qing zhe yi dian 。 wo hui xiang ban fa de 。]

english: What are you two going to do for decorations?
translation: 你们两个要做什么装饰？ [ni men liang ge yao zuo shen me zhuang shi ？]

english: I already know what I want mine to look like!
translation: 我已经知道我想要我的是什么样子了！ [wo yi jing zhi dao wo xiang yao wo de shi shen me yang zi le ！]

english: Me too!
translation: 我也是！ [wo ye shi ！]

english: Why don't you guys find some decorations while I build the snowmen? Then you can add them once I'm done.
translation: 我堆雪人的时候你们为什么不找一些装饰品呢？然后您可以在我完成后添加它们。 [wo dui xue ren de shi hou ni men wei shen me bu zhao yi xie zhuang shi pin ne ？ ran hou nin ke yi zai wo wan cheng hou tian jia ta men 。]

english: Okay sir!
translation: 好的，先生！ [hao de ， xian sheng ！]

english: We will do that!
translation: 我们会这么做的！ [wo men hui zhe me zuo de ！]

english: Well, that seems sorted. I should speak to Larry again, and see if he has any advice about building the snowmen.
translation: 嗯，看来已经解决了。我应该再和拉里谈谈，看看他对堆雪人是否有什么建议。 [n ， kan lai yi jing jie jue le 。 wo ying gai zai he la li tan tan ， kan kan ta dui dui xue ren shi fou you shen me jian yi 。]

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好呀！ [ni hao ya ！]

english: Have you started making the snowmen yet?
translation: 你开始堆雪人了吗？ [ni kai shi dui xue ren le ma ？]

english: You should talk to dad if you need some help, he knows how to make snowmen!
translation: 如果你需要帮助，你应该告诉爸爸，他知道如何堆雪人！ [ru guo ni xu yao bang zhu ， ni ying gai gao su ba ba ， ta zhi dao ru he dui xue ren ！]

english: Yeah, he always used to make really big ones with us!
translation: 是的，他总是和我们一起做一些非常大的事情！ [shi de ， ta zong shi he wo men yi qi zuo yi xie fei chang da de shi qing ！]

english: Maybe I'll go talk to him and see what advice he has.
translation: 也许我会去和他谈谈，看看他有什么建议。 [ye xu wo hui qu he ta tan tan ， kan kan ta you shen me jian yi 。]

english: He'll say, make them really tall!
translation: 他会说，让它们长得很高！ [ta hui shuo ， rang ta men zhang de hen gao ！]

english: He'll say make them shorter, because that's better!
translation: 他会说把它们弄短一点，因为这样更好！ [ta hui shuo ba ta men nong duan yi dian ， yin wei zhe yang geng hao ！]

english: I should go and speak to Larry. I'm sure he has some handy advice for me!
translation: 我应该去和拉里谈谈。我相信他会给我一些有用的建议！ [wo ying gai qu he la li tan tan 。 wo xiang xin ta hui gei wo yi xie you yong de jian yi ！]

english: That looks good! It needs a [size] snowball next!
translation: 看起来不错！接下来需要一个[大小]的雪球！ [kan qi lai bu cuo ！ jie xia lai xu yao yi ge [ da xiao ] de xue qiu ！]

english: They're done! They're so cool!
translation: 他们完成了！他们太酷了！ [ta men wan cheng le ！ ta men tai ku le ！]

english: Yay! Can we decorate them now?
translation: 耶！我们现在可以装饰它们吗？ [ye ！ wo men xian zai ke yi zhuang shi ta men ma ？]

english: Yes! Can we decorate them now please [player name]?
translation: 是的！ [玩家姓名]我们现在可以装饰它们吗？ [shi de ！ [ wan jia xing ming ] wo men xian zai ke yi zhuang shi ta men ma ？]

english: Of course you can. Are they what you wanted?
translation: 当然可以。他们是你想要的吗？ [dang ran ke yi 。 ta men shi ni xiang yao de ma ？]

english: Mine is perfect!
translation: 我的很完美！ [wo de hen wan mei ！]

english: Mine too. It's just how I wanted it.
translation: 我的也是。这正是我想要的。 [wo de ye shi 。 zhe zheng shi wo xiang yao de 。]

english: I am happy to hear that. It was harder work than I thought.
translation: 我很高兴听到这个消息。这比我想象的要辛苦。 [wo hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi 。 zhe bi wo xiang xiang de yao xin ku 。]

english: You did a good job. Thank you very much [sir/madam].
translation: 你做得很好。非常感谢您[先生/女士]。 [ni zuo de hen hao 。 fei chang gan xie nin [ xian sheng / nv shi ]。]

english: Yes, thank you [sir/madam]!
translation: 是的，谢谢你[先生/女士]！ [shi de ， xie xie ni [ xian sheng / nv shi ]！]

english: It was no problem. Merry Christmas to you both!
translation: 没问题。祝你们俩圣诞快乐！ [mei wen ti 。 zhu ni men lia sheng dan kuai le ！]

english: I should go and speak to Larry. Hopefully he has that festive white wine ready for me.
translation: 我应该去和拉里谈谈。希望他为我准备了节日白葡萄酒。 [wo ying gai qu he la li tan tan 。 xi wang ta wei wo zhun bei le jie ri bai pu tao jiu 。]

english: Those snowmen look amazing!
translation: 这些雪人看起来棒极了！ [zhe xie xue ren kan qi lai bang ji le ！]

english: Thank you! Decorating them was quite hard!
translation: 谢谢你！装饰它们相当困难！ [xie xie ni ！ zhuang shi ta men xiang dang kun nan ！]

english: Yeah, they took ages to do! Do you like mine?
translation: 是的，他们花了很长时间才完成！你喜欢我的吗？ [shi de ， ta men hua le hen zhang shi jian cai wan cheng ！ ni xi huan wo de ma ？]

english: It's really good! Reminds me of something actually.
translation: 真是太好了！其实让我想起一件事。 [zhen shi tai hao le ！ qi shi rang wo xiang qi yi jian shi 。]

english: What about mine? Do you like it?
translation: 我的呢？你喜欢它？ [wo de ne ？ ni xi huan ta ？]

english: I like yours too. They both remind me of something!
translation: 我也喜欢你的。他们都让我想起了一件事！ [wo ye xi huan ni de 。 ta men dou rang wo xiang qi le yi jian shi ！]

english: Mine is Thermy! My favourite monster! She's so big and scary, makes me go woah!
translation: 我的是Thermy！我最喜欢的怪物！她又大又吓人，让我哇哦！ [wo de shi Thermy！ wo zui xi huan de guai wu ！ ta you da you xia ren ， rang wo wa o ！]

english: Mine is Tempy! My favourite monster! He lives in the water, a huge mass of angry wet!
translation: 我的是临时的！我最喜欢的怪物！他生活在水中，一团愤怒的湿气！ [wo de shi lin shi de ！ wo zui xi huan de guai wu ！ ta sheng huo zai shui zhong ， yi tuan fen nu de shi qi ！]

english: They're both amazing! I didn't know you guys would be so good at decorating.
translation: 他们都很棒！没想到你们装修这么好。 [ta men dou hen bang ！ mei xiang dao ni men zhuang xiu zhe me hao 。]

english: Dad lets us decorate every year. We get a lot of practice!
translation: 爸爸每年都会让我们装饰。我们得到很多练习！ [ba ba mei nian du hui rang wo men zhuang shi 。 wo men de dao hen duo lian xi ！]

english: Last year we made them into the Fragment of Seren and the King Black Dragon!
translation: 去年我们把他们做成了塞伦和黑龙王的碎片！ [qu nian wo men ba ta men zuo cheng le sai lun he hei long wang de sui pian ！]

english: What... really??? I'd like to have seen that. Those sound even more difficult than these two!
translation: 什么……真的吗？？？我希望看到这一点。这听起来比这两个还要难！ [shen me …… zhen de ma ？？？ wo xi wang kan dao zhe yi dian 。 zhe ting qi lai bi zhe liang ge hai yao nan ！]

english: How do you know all these monsters anyway? There is no way your dad would let you anywhere near them!
translation: 你怎么认识这些怪物的？你爸爸绝对不会让你靠近他们！ [ni zen me ren shi zhe xie guai wu de ？ ni ba ba jue dui bu hui rang ni kao jin ta men ！]

english: Dad reads us lots of stories, and we hear about them from passing adventurers, like you.
translation: 爸爸给我们读了很多故事，我们也从像你一样路过的冒险家那里听到了这些故事。 [ba ba gei wo men du le hen duo gu shi ， wo men ye cong xiang ni yi yang lu guo de mao xian jia na li ting dao le zhe xie gu shi 。]

english: You must meet some interesting and cool adventurers!
translation: 你一定会遇到一些有趣又酷的冒险家！ [ni yi ding hui yu dao yi xie you qu you ku de mao xian jia ！]

english: Not as cool as you though; none of them helped us make our snowmen!
translation: 虽然没有你那么酷；他们都没有帮我们堆雪人！ [sui ran mei you ni na me ku ； ta men dou mei you bang wo men dui xue ren ！]

english: Yes, you're the first to help us make them!
translation: 是的，你是第一个帮助我们制作它们的人！ [shi de ， ni shi di yi ge bang zhu wo men zhi zuo ta men de ren ！]

english: Well, you're welcome. I really enjoyed it. What are you guys going to do now you're finished?
translation: 好吧，不客气。我真的很喜欢它。完成后你们打算做什么？ [hao ba ， bu ke qi 。 wo zhen de hen xi huan ta 。 wan cheng hou ni men da suan zuo shen me ？]

english: We're going to go and play! And maybe visit the festival. Will you be there?
translation: 我们要去玩啦！也许还可以参观这个节日。你会在那里吗？ [wo men yao qu wan la ！ ye xu hai ke yi can guan zhe ge jie ri 。 ni hui zai na li ma ？]

english: I sure will be. Maybe see you there!
translation: 我肯定会的。也许在那里见到你！ [wo ken ding hui de 。 ye xu zai na li jian dao ni ！]

english: Bye sir, Merry Christmas.
translation: 再见先生，圣诞快乐。 [zai jian xian sheng ， sheng dan kuai le 。]

english: Merry Christmas, have fun!
translation: 圣诞快乐，玩得开心！ [sheng dan kuai le ， wan de kai xin ！]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Be vigilant, citizen.
translation: 保持警惕，公民。 [bao chi jing ti ， gong min 。]

english: Err, right.
translation: 呃，对。 [e ， dui 。]

english: Buy ush a drink.
translation: 买一杯饮料。 [mai yi bei yin liao 。]

english: I think you have had enough.
translation: 我想你已经受够了。 [wo xiang ni yi jing shou gou le 。]

english: Pleash, buy ush a drink.
translation: 请给我们买一杯饮料。 [qing gei wo men mai yi bei yin liao 。]

english: How you holding up Burntof? Must have had quite the fright when you woke that monster.
translation: 你是怎么阻止伯恩托夫的？当你叫醒那个怪物时一定很害怕。 [ni shi zen me zu zhi bo en tuo fu de ？ dang ni jiao xing na ge guai wu shi yi ding hen hai pa 。]

english: You're right [lad/lass]. It did give me a little fright.
translation: 你是对的[小伙子/姑娘]。这确实让我有点害怕。 [ni shi dui de [ xiao huo zi / gu niang ]。 zhe que shi rang wo you dian hai pa 。]

english: But I saw some interesting things down in the ruins...
