translation: 但我在废墟中看到了一些有趣的东西...... [dan wo zai fei xu zhong kan dao le yi xie you qu de dong xi ......]

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你是什​​么意思？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: Some of the markings on the wall look very familiar to me. I've seen them before.
translation: 墙上的一些标记我看起来很熟悉。我以前见过他们。 [qiang shang de yi xie biao ji wo kan qi lai hen shu xi 。 wo yi qian jian guo ta men 。]

english: Well, when I defeated the monster, an Imcando dwarf opened the barred door...
translation: 好吧，当我打败怪物时，一个伊姆坎多矮人打开了铁门…… [hao ba ， dang wo da bai guai wu shi ， yi ge yi mu kan duo ai ren da kai le tie men ……]

english: An Imcando dwarf! I thought they were all but extinct! You've found something truly amazing [player name]!
translation: 伊姆坎多侏儒！我以为它们都快灭绝了！你发现了一些真正令人惊奇的东西[玩家名字]！ [yi mu kan duo zhu ru ！ wo yi wei ta men dou kuai mie jue le ！ ni fa xian le yi xie zhen zheng ling ren jing qi de dong xi [ wan jia ming zi ]！]

english: I wish I had a drink to celebrate, but this desert is bone dry.
translation: 我希望我能喝一杯来庆祝，但这片沙漠非常干燥。 [wo xi wang wo neng he yi bei lai qing zhu ， dan zhe pian sha mo fei chang gan zao 。]

english: How's it going, Butch?
translation: 怎么样，布奇？ [zen me yang ， bu qi ？]

english: Hello. I'm helping Lord Hosidius find his missing son. I was wondering if you could help me.
translation: 你好。我正在帮助霍西迪厄斯勋爵找到他失踪的儿子。我想知道你是否能帮助我。 [ni hao 。 wo zheng zai bang zhu huo xi di e si xun jue zhao dao ta shi zong de er zi 。 wo xiang zhi dao ni shi fou neng bang zhu wo 。]

english: That's right. I hear that they had some problems with the last one.
translation: 这是正确的。我听说他们在最后一项上遇到了一些问题。 [zhe shi zheng que de 。 wo ting shuo ta men zai zui hou yi xiang shang yu dao le yi xie wen ti 。]

translation: 是的，你可以这么说…… [shi de ， ni ke yi zhe me shuo ……]

english: It's an honour to be in your presence again, adventurer. I hope things are well?
translation: 很荣幸再次见到你，冒险家。我希望一切都好？ [hen rong xing zai ci jian dao ni ， mao xian jia 。 wo xi wang yi qie dou hao ？]

english: Not bad, thanks. Yourself?

english: Unfortunately, I am still forced to deal with this insufferable family. Many generations have passed, but they are still the enemy. As such, they must be kept a close eye on.

english: Still, I have no doubt that the time will soon come for me to leave this place. Our lord will certainly have need of me elsewhere once his current work is complete.
translation: 尽管如此，我毫不怀疑我很快就会离开这个地方。一旦我们的主完成当前的工作，他肯定会在其他地方需要我。 [jin guan ru ci ， wo hao bu huai yi wo hen kuai jiu hui li kai zhe ge di fang 。 yi dan wo men de zhu wan cheng dang qian de gong zuo ， ta ken ding hui zai qi ta di fang xu yao wo 。]

english: I see. Well good luck with it all.

english: Hey, human.

english: Who are you?

english: Not much to say. Came to Weiss with other trolls when we got kicked out of caves further south, but I was just young troll then.
translation: 没什么好说的。当我们被赶出更南边的洞穴时，我们和其他巨魔一起来到了韦斯，但那时我只是年轻的巨魔。 [mei shen me hao shuo de 。 dang wo men bei gan chu geng nan bian de dong xue shi ， wo men he qi ta ju mo yi qi lai dao le wei si ， dan na shi wo zhi shi nian qing de ju mo 。]

english: Mostly been enjoying living round Weiss, 'cos wildlife is interesting here.
translation: 大多数人都很享受在韦斯周围的生活，因为这里的野生动物很有趣。 [da duo shu ren dou hen xiang shou zai wei si zhou wei de sheng huo ， yin wei zhe li de ye sheng dong wu hen you qu 。]

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 告诉我这个地方。 [gao su wo zhe ge di fang 。]

english: This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: 这是韦斯。几年前，在我们被从更南边的洞穴里赶出来之后，巨魔们建造了它。现在Weiss是我们的家。 [zhe shi wei si 。 ji nian qian ， zai wo men bei cong geng nan bian de dong xue li gan chu lai zhi hou ， ju mo men jian zao le ta 。 xian zai Weiss shi wo men de jia 。]

english: We done pretty good here. Got lots of goat and wolf to eat - they taste kinda boring after all this time, but there not much other choice.
translation: 我们在这里做得很好。有很多山羊和狼可以吃——这么长时间以来它们尝起来有点无聊，但没有太多其他选择。 [wo men zai zhe li zuo de hen hao 。 you hen duo shan yang he lang ke yi chi —— zhe me zhang shi jian yi lai ta men chang qi lai you dian wu liao ， dan mei you tai duo qi ta xuan ze 。]

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it. In fact My Arm is an expert on growing the stuff.
translation: 尝试过古古草吗？我知道喜欢它的巨魔。事实上，我的手臂是种植这些东西的专家。 [chang shi guo gu gu cao ma ？ wo zhi dao xi huan ta de ju mo 。 shi shi shang ， wo de shou bi shi zhong zhi zhe xie dong xi de zhuan jia 。]

english: Never heard of no gouty weed, no. But it sound like a vegetable, an' Mother not like eating those, so we probably not gonna try it.
translation: 从来没有听说过没有痛风草，没有。但它听起来像一种蔬菜，妈妈不喜欢吃那些，所以我们可能不会尝试。 [cong lai mei you ting shuo guo mei you tong feng cao ， mei you 。 dan ta ting qi lai xiang yi zhong shu cai ， ma ma bu xi huan chi na xie ， suo yi wo men ke neng bu hui chang shi 。]

english: Mother not like new ideas much, but he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: 妈妈不太喜欢新想法，但他真的很大，而且是老板，所以我们就照他说的做。 [ma ma bu tai xi huan xin xiang fa ， dan ta zhen de hen da ， er qie shi lao ban ， suo yi wo men jiu zhao ta shuo de zuo 。]

english: I see.
translation: 我懂了。 [wo dong le 。]

english: Do you like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这里吗？ [ni xi huan zhe li ma ？]

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it our home. Odd Mushroom say he can make it nicer with fancy fires what he invented, but Mother not interested in that, so Odd Mushroom not allowed to do it.
translation: 呃，虽然有点简陋，但那是我们的家。奇蘑菇说他可以用他发明的奇特的火把它做得更好，但妈妈对此不感兴趣，所以奇蘑菇不被允许这样做。 [e ， sui ran you dian jian lou ， dan na shi wo men de jia 。 qi mo gu shuo ta ke yi yong ta fa ming de qi te de huo ba ta zuo de geng hao ， dan ma ma dui ci bu gan xing qu ， suo yi qi mo gu bu bei yun xu zhe yang zuo 。]

english: Mother only care about stuff to help him fight better. An he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: 母亲只关心帮助他更好地战斗的东西。他真的很大，他是老板，所以我们就按他说的做。 [mu qin zhi guan xin bang zhu ta geng hao di zhan dou de dong xi 。 ta zhen de hen da ， ta shi lao ban ， suo yi wo men jiu an ta shuo de zuo 。]

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我就走了。 [wo jiu zou le 。]

english: Hey, friend of Snowflake!
translation: 嘿，雪花的朋友！ [hei ， xue hua de peng you ！]

english: It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: 这里太棒了，现在雪花和她丈夫巨魔教我们种植古风草。现在食物好多了。 [zhe li tai bang le ， xian zai xue hua he ta zhang fu ju mo jiao wo men zhong zhi gu feng cao 。 xian zai shi wu hao duo le 。]

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: 嗯，虽然有点粗糙，但是正在好起来。雪花，她教我们种植古风草。山羊、狼、人类的味道都因加入了古藤而变得更加美味。 [n ， sui ran you dian cu cao ， dan shi zheng zai hao qi lai 。 xue hua ， ta jiao wo men zhong zhi gu feng cao 。 shan yang 、 lang 、 ren lei de wei dao dou yin jia ru le gu teng er bian de geng jia mei wei 。]

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: 所以，是的，韦斯是一个很好的居住地，现在由雪花负责。所有的巨魔都像雪花一样。她的丈夫巨魔有点奇怪，但这不是我们的问题。 [suo yi ， shi de ， wei si shi yi ge hen hao de ju zhu di ， xian zai you xue hua fu ze 。 suo you de ju mo dou xiang xue hua yi yang 。 ta de zhang fu ju mo you dian qi guai ， dan zhe bu shi wo men de wen ti 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 告诉我这个地方。 [gao su wo zhe ge di fang 。]

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it.
translation: 尝试过古古草吗？我知道喜欢它的巨魔。 [chang shi guo gu gu cao ma ？ wo zhi dao xi huan ta de ju mo 。]

english: Do you like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这里吗？ [ni xi huan zhe li ma ？]

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我就走了。 [wo jiu zou le 。]

english: I see.
translation: 我懂了。 [wo dong le 。]

english: Would you like some help?
translation: 您需要帮助吗？ [nin xu yao bang zhu ma ？]

english: Urgh, it just happened again! Every time I almost have it my hand slips.
translation: 呃，刚刚又发生了！每次我快要拿到它的时候，我的手就会滑倒。 [e ， gang gang you fa sheng le ！ mei ci wo kuai yao na dao ta de shi hou ， wo de shou jiu hui hua dao 。]

english: Oh, that's unfortunate. Are you using a lockpick?
translation: 哦，那很不幸。你用的是开锁器吗？ [o ， na hen bu xing 。 ni yong de shi kai suo qi ma ？]

english: Yes. Well actually, I'm using a Strange old lockpick. I found it while looting one of these coffins and I typically have better luck with it.
translation: 是的。事实上，我正在使用一个奇怪的旧开锁器。我在抢劫其中一具棺材时发现了它，通常我的运气会更好。 [shi de 。 shi shi shang ， wo zheng zai shi yong yi ge qi guai de jiu kai suo qi 。 wo zai qiang jie qi zhong yi ju guan cai shi fa xian le ta ， tong chang wo de yun qi hui geng hao 。]

english: Oh, that's interesting. I'll keep my eyes out for one.
translation: 哦，这很有趣。我会留意其中之一。 [o ， zhe hen you qu 。 wo hui liu yi qi zhong zhi yi 。]

english: I've found a few of them while raiding this place. There appear to be more of them on this floor than the floors above.
translation: 我在搜查这个地方时发现了其中一些。这层楼的人数似乎比上面几层还要多。 [wo zai sou cha zhe ge di fang shi fa xian le qi zhong yi xie 。 zhe ceng lou de ren shu si hu bi shang mian ji ceng hai yao duo 。]

english: I see. If you don't mind me asking, you already have dark graceful so why are you still looking for hallowed marks?
translation: 我懂了。如果你不介意我问的话，你已经有了黑暗优雅，为什么还要寻找圣痕？ [wo dong le 。 ru guo ni bu jie yi wo wen de hua ， ni yi jing you le hei an you ya ， wei shen me hai yao xun zhao sheng hen ？]

english: Oh, it's because of this little fellow following me. I've heard that the Dark acorn sold by the guy upstairs will transform him into a Dark Squirrel.
translation: 哦，原来是因为这个小家伙跟着我啊。我听说楼上那个家伙卖的黑橡子可以把他变成黑松鼠。 [o ， yuan lai shi yin wei zhe ge xiao jia huo gen zhe wo a 。 wo ting shuo lou shang na ge jia huo mai de hei xiang zi ke yi ba ta bian cheng hei song shu 。]

english: Wow, I didn't know that! That sounds pretty cool.
translation: 哇，我不知道！听起来很酷。 [wa ， wo bu zhi dao ！ ting qi lai hen ku 。]

english: Yeah, that's what I thought but that mysterious stranger is asking for 3,000 Hallowed marks for it.
translation: 是的，我也是这么想的，但是那个神秘的陌生人要价 3,000 神圣马克。 [shi de ， wo ye shi zhe me xiang de ， dan shi na ge shen mi de mo sheng ren yao jia  3,000  shen sheng ma ke 。]

english: 3,000? That sounds extortionate!
translation: 3,000？这听起来很敲诈！ [3,000？ zhe ting qi lai hen qiao zha ！]

english: Yeah, that's what I thought. Feels like he set the price just to keep me down here for longer. Still, it's not like I have anything better to do.
translation: 是的，我就是这么想的。感觉他设定的价格只是为了让我在这里待更长时间。尽管如此，我也没有什么更好的事情可做。 [shi de ， wo jiu shi zhe me xiang de 。 gan jue ta she ding de jia ge zhi shi wei le rang wo zai zhe li dai geng zhang shi jian 。 jin guan ru ci ， wo ye mei you shen me geng hao de shi qing ke zuo 。]

english: I see, well best of luck. Hopefully you survive long enough to finish your goal.
translation: 我明白了，祝你好运。希望你能活到足够长的时间来完成你的目标。 [wo ming bai le ， zhu ni hao yun 。 xi wang ni neng huo dao zu gou zhang de shi jian lai wan cheng ni de mu biao 。]

english: I'm sure I'll be fine.
translation: 我确信我会没事的。 [wo que xin wo hui mei shi de 。]

english: Yeah, I ended up buying one myself and fed it to my Giant Squirrel. It took a while but it was definitely worth it.
translation: 是的，我最终自己买了一只并喂给我的巨松鼠。虽然花了一段时间，但绝对是值得的。 [shi de ， wo zui zhong zi ji mai le yi zhi bing wei gei wo de ju song shu 。 sui ran hua le yi duan shi jian ， dan jue dui shi zhi de de 。]

english: Wow, I'm impressed! How long did it take you to get the 3,000 marks?
translation: 哇，我很感动！你花了多长时间才拿到3000分？ [wa ， wo hen gan dong ！ ni hua le duo zhang shi jian cai na dao 3000 fen ？]

english: Long enough... Still, at least I feel much more agile now than when I started.
translation: 时间够长了……不过，至少我现在感觉比刚开始的时候敏捷多了。 [shi jian gou zhang le …… bu guo ， zhi shao wo xian zai gan jue bi gang kai shi de shi hou min jie duo le 。]

english: I don't think I'm going to get any more agile while looking for it myself. I'm glad you received some benefit from the grind though.
translation: 我不认为我自己寻找它时会变得更加敏捷。我很高兴你从磨练中得到了一些好处。 [wo bu ren wei wo zi ji xun zhao ta shi hui bian de geng jia min jie 。 wo hen gao xing ni cong mo lian zhong de dao le yi xie hao chu 。]

english: You shouldn't feed someone's pet without their permission.
translation: 未经他人许可，您不应该喂养他人的宠物。 [wei jing ta ren xu ke ， nin bu ying gai wei yang ta ren de chong wu 。]

english: C'mon, almost got it...
translation: 来吧，差不多明白了... [lai ba ， cha bu duo ming bai le ...]

english: Agh, thought I had it that time!
translation: 啊，我以为我当时就拥有了！ [a ， wo yi wei wo dang shi jiu yong you le ！]

english: C'mon, almost got it...
translation: 来吧，差不多明白了... [lai ba ， cha bu duo ming bai le ...]

english: Having problems?
translation: 有问题吗？ [you wen ti ma ？]

english: Can't you see I'm busy?
translation: 你没看到我很忙吗？ [ni mei kan dao wo hen mang ma ？]

english: Do you have a lockpick?
translation: 你有开锁器吗？ [ni you kai suo qi ma ？]

english: No and even if I did have one I wouldn't give it to you!
translation: 不，即使我有，我也不会给你！ [bu ， ji shi wo you ， wo ye bu hui gei ni ！]

english: I already have one. I was just letting you know that having a lockpick helps when getting into these coffins. You appear to be struggling.
translation: 我已经有一个了。我只是想让你知道，进入这些棺材时使用开锁器会有所帮助。你似乎正在挣扎。 [wo yi jing you yi ge le 。 wo zhi shi xiang rang ni zhi dao ， jin ru zhe xie guan cai shi shi yong kai suo qi hui you suo bang zhu 。 ni si hu zheng zai zheng zha 。]

english: I was just letting you know that having a lockpick helps when getting into these coffins. You appear to be struggling.
translation: 我只是想让你知道，进入这些棺材时使用开锁器会有所帮助。你似乎正在挣扎。 [wo zhi shi xiang rang ni zhi dao ， jin ru zhe xie guan cai shi shi yong kai suo qi hui you suo bang zhu 。 ni si hu zheng zai zheng zha 。]

english: Wait, are you serious? The last adventurer I spoke to down here told me that lockpicks don't help!
translation: 等等，你是认真的吗？我在这里采访的最后一位冒险家告诉我开锁器没有帮助！ [deng deng ， ni shi ren zhen de ma ？ wo zai zhe li cai fang de zui hou yi wei mao xian jia gao su wo kai suo qi mei you bang zhu ！]

english: Yes I'm serious. Also that outfit you're wearing doesn't help you get more loot from these coffins either.
translation: 是的，我是认真的。此外，你穿的衣服也不能帮助你从这些棺材中获得更多战利品。 [shi de ， wo shi ren zhen de 。 ci wai ， ni chuan de yi fu ye bu neng bang zhu ni cong zhe xie guan cai zhong huo de geng duo zhan li pin 。]

english: They lied about that too? I feel like a fool!
translation: 他们也撒谎了？我感觉自己像个傻瓜！ [ta men ye sa huang le ？ wo gan jue zi ji xiang ge sha gua ！]

english: At least you look cool dressed like that though.
translation: 至少你这样穿看起来很酷。 [zhi shao ni zhe yang chuan kan qi lai hen ku 。]

english: Who cares about that? If it doesn't work then I should just wear the full graceful outfit since that would be much more efficient.
translation: 谁关心这个？如果这不起作用，那么我应该穿全套优雅的衣服，因为这样会更有效率。 [shui guan xin zhe ge ？ ru guo zhe bu qi zuo yong ， na me wo ying gai chuan quan tao you ya de yi fu ， yin wei zhe yang hui geng you xiao lv 。]

english: Each to their own I suppose.
translation: 我想每个人都有自己的。 [wo xiang mei ge ren dou you zi ji de 。]

english: Ahhh, harvest day!
translation: 啊啊啊，收获日！ [a a a ， shou huo ri ！]

english: I sure can't wait to feed my family with these hard-earned cabba-
translation: 我确实迫不及待地想用这些来之不易的卡巴来养活我的家人—— [wo que shi po bu ji dai di xiang yong zhe xie lai zhi bu yi de ka ba lai yang huo wo de jia ren ——]

english: No! What have you done?!
translation: 不！你做了什么？！ [bu ！ ni zuo le shen me ？！]

english: The farmer performs the Cry emote.
translation: 农民做出哭泣表情。 [nong min zuo chu ku qi biao qing 。]

english: Urgh...
He looks too sick to chat.
translation: 他看起来病得很重，无法聊天。 [ta kan qi lai bing de hen zhong ， wu fa liao tian 。]

english: Hello again. Coming back to Corsair Cove?
translation: 又好。回到海盗湾？ [you hao 。 hui dao hai dao wan ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: The ship sails to Corsair Cove...
translation: 这艘船驶向海盗湾…… [zhe sou chuan shi xiang hai dao wan ……]

english: Not just now, thanks.
translation: 不只是现在，谢谢。 [bu zhi shi xian zai ， xie xie 。]

english: The Captain's letting me command his boat now I'm fully recovered. Did you want to leave?
translation: 现在我已经完全康复了，船长让我指挥他的船。你想离开吗？ [xian zai wo yi jing wan quan kang fu le ， chuan zhang rang wo zhi hui ta de chuan 。 ni xiang li kai ma ？]

english: Please take me back to Rimmington.
translation: 请带我回里明顿。 [qing dai wo hui li ming dun 。]

english: The ship sails to Rimmington...
translation: 船驶向里明顿...... [chuan shi xiang li ming dun ......]

english: I'll talk to you later.
translation: 我稍后再跟你谈。 [wo shao hou zai gen ni tan 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Not just now, thanks.
translation: 不只是现在，谢谢。 [bu zhi shi xian zai ， xie xie 。]

english: Please take me back to Rimmington.
translation: 请带我回里明顿。 [qing dai wo hui li ming dun 。]

english: I'll talk to you later.
translation: 我稍后再跟你谈。 [wo shao hou zai gen ni tan 。]

english: Hey.
translation: 嘿。 [hei 。]

english: Hey there. If you need something, you should speak to Veos. I'm just the cabin boy.
translation: 嘿。如果您需要什么，您应该与 Veos 联系。我只是机舱服务员。 [hei 。 ru guo nin xu yao shen me ， nin ying gai yu  Veos  lian xi 。 wo zhi shi ji cang fu wu yuan 。]

english: Fair enough.
translation: 很公平。 [hen gong ping 。]

english: Hey. Veos left something for you. Here you go.
translation: 嘿。 Veos给你留下了一些东西。干得好。 [hei 。 Veos gei ni liu xia le yi xie dong xi 。 gan de hao 。]

english: Can you take me somewhere?
translation: 你能带我去一个地方吗？ [ni neng dai wo qu yi ge di fang ma ？]

english: I'm afraid that you're not eligible to travel to Great Kourend at the moment. Come back when you are and I'll happily take you there.
translation: 恐怕您目前没有资格前往 Great Kourend。你什么时候回来，我很乐意带你去那里。 [kong pa nin mu qian mei you zi ge qian wang  Great Kourend。 ni shen me shi hou hui lai ， wo hen le yi dai ni qu na li 。]

english: Where would you like to go?
translation: 您想去哪里？ [nin xiang qu na li ？]

english: I'd like to travel to Port Sarim, please.
translation: 我想去沙里姆港旅行。 [wo xiang qu sha li mu gang lv xing 。]

english: As you wish, I hope you don't get seasick, it is a long voyage.
translation: 如你所愿，希望你不要晕船，这是一次长途航行。 [ru ni suo yuan ， xi wang ni bu yao yun chuan ， zhe shi yi ci zhang tu hang xing 。]

english: I'd like to travel to Port Piscarilius, please.
translation: 我想去皮斯卡利留斯港旅行。 [wo xiang qu pi si ka li liu si gang lv xing 。]

english: As you wish.
translation: 如你所愿。 [ru ni suo yuan 。]

english: I'd like to travel to Land's End, please.
translation: 我想去天涯海角旅行。 [wo xiang qu tian ya hai jiao lv xing 。]

english: Actually I'd like to stay here.
translation: 其实我想留在这里。 [qi shi wo xiang liu zai zhe li 。]

english: I'm good.
translation: 我很好。 [wo hen hao 。]

english: Hey there. Do you need something?
translation: 嘿。你需要什么东西吗？ [hei 。 ni xu yao shen me dong xi ma ？]

english: Can you take me somewhere?
translation: 你能带我去一个地方吗？ [ni neng dai wo qu yi ge di fang ma ？]

english: Travel to Port Sarim.
translation: 前往沙里姆港。 [qian wang sha li mu gang 。]

english: Travel to Port Piscarilius.
translation: 前往皮斯卡利留斯港。 [qian wang pi si ka li liu si gang 。]

english: Travel to Land's End.
translation: 前往天涯海角。 [qian wang tian ya hai jiao 。]

english: Stay where you are.
translation: 呆在原地。 [dai zai yuan di 。]

english: I'm good.
translation: 我很好。 [wo hen hao 。]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: I bet you're after another lens!
translation: 我打赌你正在寻找另一个镜头！ [wo da du ni zheng zai xun zhao ling yi ge jing tou ！]

english: How could you possibly know that?
translation: 你怎么可能知道？ [ni zen me ke neng zhi dao ？]

english: Hey, I think I'm learning a thing or two from these Moon Clan ladies.
translation: 嘿，我想我从这些月族女士身上学到了一两件事。 [hei ， wo xiang wo cong zhe xie yue zu nv shi shen shang xue dao le yi liang jian shi 。]

english: Oi! I need another lens, boy.
translation: 哎呀！我需要另一个镜头，孩子。 [ai ya ！ wo xu yao ling yi ge jing tou ， hai zi 。]

english: But you don't have space.
translation: 但你没有空间。 [dan ni mei you kong jian 。]

english: Good point.
translation: 好点。 [hao dian 。]

english: Huh, oh ok, I suppose I owe you one.
translation: 呵呵，好吧，我想我欠你一个。 [he he ， hao ba ， wo xiang wo qian ni yi ge 。]

english: I think I'll pass. But thanks..
translation: 我想我会通过的。不过谢谢.. [wo xiang wo hui tong guo de 。 bu guo xie xie ..]

english: So you've plucked up the courage to come and confront that girl!
translation: 所以你才鼓起勇气来面对那个女孩！ [suo yi ni cai gu qi yong qi lai mian dui na ge nv hai ！]

english: That I did, that I did!
translation: 我做到了，我做到了！ [wo zuo dao le ， wo zuo dao le ！]

english: And?
translation: 和？ [he ？]

english: She turned out to be really nice! She's joining us to become a pirate!
translation: 事实证明她真的很好！她要加入我们成为海盗！ [shi shi zheng ming ta zhen de hen hao ！ ta yao jia ru wo men cheng wei hai dao ！]

english: Really? And you're not sceptical about this? You know, after what she did last time?
translation: 真的吗？你对此不怀疑吗？你知道，在她上次做了什么之后？ [zhen de ma ？ ni dui ci bu huai yi ma ？ ni zhi dao ， zai ta shang ci zuo le shen me zhi hou ？]

english: She---has---no---spell---on---me.
translation: 她对我——没有——施咒。 [ta dui wo —— mei you —— shi zhou 。]

english: Huh? Why are you talking like that?
translation: 啊？你为什么这么说话？ [a ？ ni wei shen me zhe me shuo hua ？]

english: Like what?
translation: 比如什么？ [bi ru shen me ？]

english: Like someone else was talking for you. Are you sure she hasn't put a spell on you again? Did she wave a watch in front of your face? You know, tell you to look deep into her eyes?
translation: 就像别人在替你说话一样。你确定她没有再对你施咒吗？她有在你面前挥动手表吗？你知道吗，告诉你要深深地看着她的眼睛？ [jiu xiang bie ren zai ti ni shuo hua yi yang 。 ni que ding ta mei you zai dui ni shi zhou ma ？ ta you zai ni mian qian hui dong shou biao ma ？ ni zhi dao ma ， gao su ni yao shen shen di kan zhe ta de yan jing ？]

english: I think you've been hypnotised. I wonder what happens if I click my fingers?
translation: 我想你已经被催眠了。我想知道如果我点击手指会发生什么？ [wo xiang ni yi jing bei cui mian le 。 wo xiang zhi dao ru guo wo dian ji shou zhi hui fa sheng shen me ？]

english: *click*
translation: *点击* [* dian ji *]

english: *Cluck* *cluck* *bwaarrk*
translation: *咯咯* *咯咯* *bwaarrk* [* ge ge * * ge ge * *bwaarrk*]

english: Oh dear. Oh well, I'm sure you'll learn one day.
translation: 哦亲爱的。哦，好吧，我相信有一天你会学会的。 [o qin ai de 。 o ， hao ba ， wo xiang xin you yi tian ni hui xue hui de 。]

english: Please
translation: 请 [qing]

english: No thanks
translation: 不，谢谢 [bu ， xie xie]

english: Hello there; I see you're qualified. Come to help us out?
translation: 你好呀;我看你有资格。来帮助我们吗？ [ni hao ya ; wo kan ni you zi ge 。 lai bang zhu wo men ma ？]

english: Hello! You're that student who recently finished all three Earth Sciences exams, aren't you? Come to help us out?
translation: 你好！您就是那个最近完成了全部三门地球科学考试的学生，不是吗？来帮助我们吗？ [ni hao ！ nin jiu shi na ge zui jin wan cheng le quan bu san men di qiu ke xue kao shi de xue sheng ， bu shi ma ？ lai bang zhu wo men ma ？]

english: Greetings, my dear [sir/madam]. Have you come to give us a hand?
translation: 问候，我亲爱的[先生/女士]。你是来帮我们的吗？ [wen hou ， wo qin ai de [ xian sheng / nv shi ]。 ni shi lai bang wo men de ma ？]

english: Yes, how can I help out?
translation: 是的，我能提供什么帮助吗？ [shi de ， wo neng ti gong shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: Well, you'll need to get your equipment first - it's all there on the tool rack. Use what you learned from your Earth Sciences exams. You'll need to be wearing your leather gloves and boots as well as have access to
translation: 好吧，你需要先拿到你的设备 - 它都在工具架上。利用您从地球科学考试中学到的知识。您需要戴上皮手套和靴子，并能够接触到 [hao ba ， ni xu yao xian na dao ni de she bei  -  ta dou zai gong ju jia shang 。 li yong nin cong di qiu ke xue kao shi zhong xue dao de zhi shi 。 nin xu yao dai shang pi shou tao he xue zi ， bing neng gou jie chu dao]

english: your trowel, rock pick and specimen brush.
translation: 你的抹子、岩石镐和标本刷。 [ni de mo zi 、 yan shi gao he biao ben shua 。]

english: I see you have your equipment - well done.
translation: 我看到你有你的设备 - 干得好。 [wo kan dao ni you ni de she bei  -  gan de hao 。]

english: To really give us a hand, you could clean some finds for us. They're mostly done - just some fine work to finish off. Take a find from the pile that the workmen are bringing in, then there are spare tables over there
translation: 为了真正帮助我们，您可以帮我们清理一些发现的东西。他们大部分已经完成了——只是一些漂亮的工作需要完成。从工人搬进来的一堆东西里找出来，然后那边就有空余的桌子了 [wei le zhen zheng bang zhu wo men ， nin ke yi bang wo men qing li yi xie fa xian de dong xi 。 ta men da bu fen yi jing wan cheng le —— zhi shi yi xie piao liang de gong zuo xu yao wan cheng 。 cong gong ren ban jin lai de yi dui dong xi li zhao chu lai ， ran hou na bian jiu you kong yu de zhuo zi le]

english: to clean them on. If you find anything interesting, let us know and we'll see if it's good enough to go on display.
translation: 清洁它们。如果您发现任何有趣的东西，请告诉我们，我们会看看它是否足以展示。 [qing jie ta men 。 ru guo nin fa xian ren he you qu de dong xi ， qing gao su wo men ， wo men hui kan kan ta shi fou zu yi zhan shi 。]

english: I found something interesting.
translation: 我发现了一些有趣的事情。 [wo fa xian le yi xie you qu de shi qing 。]

english: Oh? Let's take a look...
translation: 哦？我们来看看... [o ？ wo men lai kan kan ...]

english: I found this pretty necklace.
translation: 我发现了这条漂亮的项链。 [wo fa xian le zhe tiao piao liang de xiang lian 。]

english: Interesting...yes...yes...hmmm.... It looks like it's enchanted.
translation: 有趣……是……是……嗯……看起来像是着了魔一样。 [you qu …… shi …… shi …… n …… kan qi lai xiang shi zhe le mo yi yang 。]

english: With what?
translation: 用什么？ [yong shen me ？]

english: Oh, I think it's just a benign teleportation spell. I tinker in magic when I'm not doing archaeology. I can teach you how to make more necklaces like this. Amazing that they had this kind of knowledge back then.
translation: 哦，我认为这只是一个良性的传送咒语。当我不做考古学的时候，我会研究魔法。我可以教你如何制作更多这样的项链。令人惊讶的是他们当时拥有这种知识。 [o ， wo ren wei zhe zhi shi yi ge liang xing de chuan song zhou yu 。 dang wo bu zuo kao gu xue de shi hou ， wo hui yan jiu mo fa 。 wo ke yi jiao ni ru he zhi zuo geng duo zhe yang de xiang lian 。 ling ren jing ya de shi ta men dang shi yong you zhe zhong zhi shi 。]

english: That would be good. Where is the teleport to?
translation: 那就好了。传送到哪里？ [na jiu hao le 。 chuan song dao na li ？]

english: Hmm...all the indications are that it's somewhere to the east of us, but I'm not sure how far. Perhaps it was a teleport back to Saranthium. Let me just take a closer look.
translation: 嗯……所有迹象都表明它位于我们东边的某个地方，但我不确定有多远。也许这是传送回萨兰瑟姆的过程。让我仔细看看。 [n …… suo you ji xiang dou biao ming ta wei yu wo men dong bian de mou ge di fang ， dan wo bu que ding you duo yuan 。 ye xu zhe shi chuan song hui sa lan se mu de guo cheng 。 rang wo zi xi kan kan 。]

english: So I just make a ruby necklace and use five fire runes and one cosmic rune to enchant it.
translation: 所以我只是做了一条红宝石项链，并用五个火符文和一个宇宙符文来附魔它。 [suo yi wo zhi shi zuo le yi tiao hong bao shi xiang lian ， bing yong wu ge huo fu wen he yi ge yu zhou fu wen lai fu mo ta 。]

english: Yes, indeed. Well done, youngster, thanks for helping us.
translation: 是的，确实如此。干得好，年轻人，谢谢你帮助我们。 [shi de ， que shi ru ci 。 gan de hao ， nian qing ren ， xie xie ni bang zhu wo men 。]

english: I've cleaned this old coin - is it of any use?
translation: 我已经清理了这枚旧硬币 - 它有什么用吗？ [wo yi jing qing li le zhe mei jiu ying bi  -  ta you shen me yong ma ？]

english: Oh my! What a wonderful find! If this is what I believe it to be, it would allow us to date the Dig Site city.
translation: 天啊！多么美妙的发现啊！如果这是我所相信的，那么我们就能确定挖掘场城市的年代。 [tian a ！ duo me mei miao de fa xian a ！ ru guo zhe shi wo suo xiang xin de ， na me wo men jiu neng que ding wa jue chang cheng shi de nian dai 。]

english: And look here, it has the name of the city too! Saranthium! That must be during the Saradominist occupation. This is a wonderful find. Please take it and place it in display case 45.
translation: 看这里，它还有城市的名字！萨拉蒂！那一定是在萨拉多米主义占领期间。这是一个很棒的发现。请拿走并将其放入展示柜 45 中。 [kan zhe li ， ta hai you cheng shi de ming zi ！ sa la di ！ na yi ding shi zai sa la duo mi zhu yi zhan ling qi jian 。 zhe shi yi ge hen bang de fa xian 。 qing na zou bing jiang qi fang ru zhan shi gui  45  zhong 。]

english: Right, display case 45 it is...
translation: 对了，陈列柜45是…… [dui le ， chen lie gui 45 shi ……]

english: Back again? Have you put the old coin in display case 45 yet?
translation: 又回来了？你把旧硬币放进陈列柜45了吗？ [you hui lai le ？ ni ba jiu ying bi fang jin chen lie gui 45 le ma ？]

english: No, I'll go do that now
translation: 不，我现在就去做 [bu ， wo xian zai jiu qu zuo]

english: You've already shown me one of those, but it was in better condition. It's in the display case over there. You can pop this one in the finds crate over in the corner.
translation: 你已经给我看了其中一件，但它的状况更好。就在那边的展示柜里。您可以将其放入角落里的发现物箱中。 [ni yi jing gei wo kan le qi zhong yi jian ， dan ta de zhuang kuang geng hao 。 jiu zai na bian de zhan shi gui li 。 nin ke yi jiang qi fang ru jiao luo li de fa xian wu xiang zhong 。]

english: I found this really old coin - is it of any use?
translation: 我发现了这枚非常古老的硬币 - 它有什么用处吗？ [wo fa xian le zhe mei fei chang gu lao de ying bi  -  ta you shen me yong chu ma ？]

english: What have we here?
translation: 我们这里有什么？ [wo men zhe li you shen me ？]

english: Oh! This is very interesting...and confusing at the same time. This coin means that the city that we're excavating on the Digsite - Saranthium - was actually inhabited much, much earlier by followers of Zamorak,
translation: 哦！这非常有趣……同时也令人困惑。这枚硬币意味着我们在挖掘场挖掘的城市——Saranthium——实际上早在很久以前就被萨莫拉克的追随者居住过， [o ！ zhe fei chang you qu …… tong shi ye ling ren kun huo 。 zhe mei ying bi yi wei zhe wo men zai wa jue chang wa jue de cheng shi ——Saranthium—— shi ji shang zao zai hen jiu yi qian jiu bei sa mo la ke de zhui sui zhe ju zhu guo ，]

english: at which time, the city was known as Senntisten.
translation: 当时，这座城市被称为 Senntisten。 [dang shi ， zhe zuo cheng shi bei cheng wei  Senntisten。]

english: This is a most remarkable discovery, as we have other evidence indicating that Zarosian followers were resident before the Saradominists took over, but it also seems that Zamorakian forces used it during a battle of some
translation: 这是一个最引人注目的发现，因为我们有其他证据表明，在萨拉多米主义者接管之前，扎罗西亚追随者就已经居住在当地，但似乎萨莫拉克军队在一些人的战斗中也使用了它。 [zhe shi yi ge zui yin ren zhu mu di fa xian ， yin wei wo men you qi ta zheng ju biao ming ， zai sa la duo mi zhu yi zhe jie guan zhi qian ， zha luo xi ya zhui sui zhe jiu yi jing ju zhu zai dang di ， dan si hu sa mo la ke jun dui zai yi xie ren de zhan dou zhong ye shi yong le ta 。]

english: sort. Still, it allows us to roughly date when the city changed from following Zaros and Zamorak to following Saradomin. Put it in display case 44.
translation: 种类。尽管如此，它仍然可以让我们大致确定这座城市从跟随扎罗斯和萨莫拉克转变为跟随萨拉多明的时间。将其放入展示柜 44 中。 [zhong lei 。 jin guan ru ci ， ta reng ran ke yi rang wo men da zhi que ding zhe zuo cheng shi cong gen sui zha luo si he sa mo la ke zhuan bian wei gen sui sa la duo ming de shi jian 。 jiang qi fang ru zhan shi gui  44  zhong 。]

english: Case 44 it is!
translation: 第44例就是这样！ [di 44 li jiu shi zhe yang ！]

english: Back again? Have you put the ancient coin in display case 44 yet?
translation: 又回来了？你把古钱币放进44号陈列柜了吗？ [you hui lai le ？ ni ba gu qian bi fang jin 44 hao chen lie gui le ma ？]

english: No, I'll go do that now.
translation: 不，我现在就去做。 [bu ， wo xian zai jiu qu zuo 。]

english: I found this crumbly old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: 我发现了这个易碎的旧装饰品 - 它有什么用吗？ [wo fa xian le zhe ge yi sui de jiu zhuang shi pin  -  ta you shen me yong ma ？]

english: Ahh... That looks like an altar piece. Hmm, yes...from the early Saradominist worshippers by the looks of it. Quite delicate, too. Put it in display case 37.
translation: 啊……看起来像是祭坛碎片。嗯，是的……从表面上看是来自早期的萨拉多米主义崇拜者。也相当精致。将其放入展示柜 37 中。 [a …… kan qi lai xiang shi ji tan sui pian 。 n ， shi de …… cong biao mian shang kan shi lai zi zao qi de sa la duo mi zhu yi chong bai zhe 。 ye xiang dang jing zhi 。 jiang qi fang ru zhan shi gui  37  zhong 。]

english: Case 37 it is!
translation: 是第37号病例！ [shi di 37 hao bing li ！]

english: Back again? Have you put the ancient symbol in display case 37 yet?
translation: 又回来了？你把远古符号放进37号陈列柜了吗？ [you hui lai le ？ ni ba yuan gu fu hao fang jin 37 hao chen lie gui le ma ？]

english: I found this really old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: 我发现了这个非常旧的装饰品 - 它有什么用吗？ [wo fa xian le zhe ge fei chang jiu de zhuang shi pin  -  ta you shen me yong ma ？]

english: Wow!
translation: 哇！ [wa ！]

english: That's in rather good condition, isn't it? An old altar decoration by the looks of things, from the Saradominist city no doubt. Put it in display case 36.
translation: 这状态相当不错，不是吗？从外观上看，这是一座古老的祭坛装饰，毫无疑问来自萨拉多米尼主义城市。将其放入展示柜 36 中。 [zhe zhuang tai xiang dang bu cuo ， bu shi ma ？ cong wai guan shang kan ， zhe shi yi zuo gu lao de ji tan zhuang shi ， hao wu yi wen lai zi sa la duo mi ni zhu yi cheng shi 。 jiang qi fang ru zhan shi gui  36  zhong 。]

english: Case 36 it is!
translation: 是第36例！ [shi di 36 li ！]

english: Back again? Have you put the old symbol in display case 36 yet?
translation: 又回来了？您是否已将旧符号放入展示柜 36 中？ [you hui lai le ？ nin shi fou yi jiang jiu fu hao fang ru zhan shi gui  36  zhong ？]

english: I found this piece of pottery - is it of any use?
translation: 我找到了这块陶器——它有什么用吗？ [wo zhao dao le zhe kuai tao qi —— ta you shen me yong ma ？]

english: Ahh... Oh! Hmm...yes...made by Zaros worshippers, by the looks of it. Beautifully-shaped. It looks as if this would go nicely in display case 22. This piece reinforces our evidence that the city was occupied by
translation: 啊……哦！嗯……是的……看起来是扎罗斯崇拜者制作的。造型优美。看起来这在展示柜 22 中会很顺利。这件作品强化了我们的证据，即这座城市被 [a …… o ！ n …… shi de …… kan qi lai shi zha luo si chong bai zhe zhi zuo de 。 zao xing you mei 。 kan qi lai zhe zai zhan shi gui  22  zhong hui hen shun li 。 zhe jian zuo pin qiang hua le wo men de zheng ju ， ji zhe zuo cheng shi bei]

english: Zarosians before Saradominists.
translation: 扎罗索派先于萨拉多米派。 [zha luo suo pai xian yu sa la duo mi pai 。]

english: Case 22 it is!
translation: 就是案例22！ [jiu shi an li 22！]

english: Back again? Have you put the pottery in display case 22 yet?
translation: 又回来了？你把陶器放进22号展示柜了吗？ [you hui lai le ？ ni ba tao qi fang jin 22 hao zhan shi gui le ma ？]

english: I found these old arrowheads.
translation: 我发现了这些旧箭头。 [wo fa xian le zhe xie jiu jian tou 。]

english: Ahh, yes, we find lots of those - they're not important. We already have some in our display. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: 啊，是的，我们发现了很多这样的东西——它们并不重要。我们的展示中已经有一些了。只需将其添加到靠近门的箱子中即可。 [a ， shi de ， wo men fa xian le hen duo zhe yang de dong xi —— ta men bing bu zhong yao 。 wo men de zhan shi zhong yi jing you yi xie le 。 zhi xu jiang qi tian jia dao kao jin men de xiang zi zhong ji ke 。]

english: If there is anything already in the crate, feel free to take it as a reward for your work.
translation: 如果板条箱里已有任何东西，请随意将其作为对您工作的奖励。 [ru guo ban tiao xiang li yi you ren he dong xi ， qing sui yi jiang qi zuo wei dui nin gong zuo de jiang li 。]

english: Oh, okay.
translation: 哦好的。 [o hao de 。]

english: Take a look at this...
translation: 看看这个... [kan kan zhe ge ...]

english: I found these old necklaces.
translation: 我找到了这些旧项链。 [wo zhao dao le zhe xie jiu xiang lian 。]

english: An interesting find... Here, let me offer you something in return.
translation: 一个有趣的发现……在这里，让我给你一些回报。 [yi ge you qu de fa xian …… zai zhe li ， rang wo gei ni yi xie hui bao 。]

english: Oh! Okay.
translation: 哦！好的。 [o ！ hao de 。]

english: I cleaned up this old vase.
translation: 我清理了这个旧花瓶。 [wo qing li le zhe ge jiu hua ping 。]

english: Ah, the vases... I've lost count of how many we've found of those... The only completely intact one is in the display case already. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: 啊，那些花瓶……我已经记不清我们找到了多少个了……唯一完好无损的已经在陈列柜里了。只需将其添加到靠近门的箱子中即可。 [a ， na xie hua ping …… wo yi jing ji bu qing wo men zhao dao le duo shao ge le …… wei yi wan hao wu sun de yi jing zai chen lie gui li le 。 zhi xu jiang qi tian jia dao kao jin men de xiang zi zhong ji ke 。]

english: Right.
translation: 正确的。 [zheng que de 。]

english: Err... I seem to have lost it. Sorry.
translation: 呃……我好像丢了。对不起。 [e …… wo hao xiang diu le 。 dui bu qi 。]

english: Sounds like you never had it, [lad/lass]!
translation: 听起来你好像从未拥有过它，[小伙子/姑娘]！ [ting qi lai ni hao xiang cong wei yong you guo ta ，[ xiao huo zi / gu niang ]！]

english: No, just here to watch.
translation: 不，只是来这里看看。 [bu ， zhi shi lai zhe li kan kan 。]

english: Thank you, but I don't need that
translation: 谢谢，但我不需要那个 [xie xie ， dan wo bu xu yao na ge]

english: Yes, how can I help out?
translation: 是的，我能提供什么帮助吗？ [shi de ， wo neng ti gong shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: I found something interesting.
translation: 我发现了一些有趣的事情。 [wo fa xian le yi xie you qu de shi qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Are you interested in buying or selling spice?
translation: 您有兴趣购买或出售香料吗？ [nin you xing qu gou mai huo chu shou xiang liao ma ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
translation: 嘿！把你的手拿开！ [hei ！ ba ni de shou na kai ！]

english: You're the one who stole something from me!
translation: 你就是偷了我东西的人！ [ni jiu shi tou le wo dong xi de ren ！]

english: Guards guards!
translation: 卫兵卫兵！ [wei bing wei bing ！]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Have I seen you before?
translation: 我以前见过你吗？ [wo yi qian jian guo ni ma ？]

english: I don't think so... I've just got one of those faces.
translation: 我不这么认为...我只是拥有其中一张面孔。 [wo bu zhe me ren wei ... wo zhi shi yong you qi zhong yi zhang mian kong 。]

english: You're probably right.
translation: 你可能是对的。 [ni ke neng shi dui de 。]

english: I'm rather busy at the moment. I've got to organise my cupboards of jewels.
translation: 我现在比较忙。我必须整理我的珠宝柜。 [wo xian zai bi jiao mang 。 wo bi xu zheng li wo de zhu bao gui 。]

english: Want any help?
translation: 需要任何帮助吗？ [xu yao ren he bang zhu ma ？]

english: Absolutely not! You stay away from my jewels.
translation: 绝对不是！你离我的珠宝远点。 [jue dui bu shi ！ ni li wo de zhu bao yuan dian 。]

english: Interested in buying a house like mine?
translation: 有兴趣买像我这样的房子吗？ [you xing qu mai xiang wo zhe yang de fang zi ma ？]

english: Not sure I've got enough coins to do that.
translation: 不确定我是否有足够的硬币来做到这一点。 [bu que ding wo shi fou you zu gou de ying bi lai zuo dao zhe yi dian 。]

english: Silly me! I mistook you for one of us wealthy folk.
translation: 傻我啊！我误以为你是我们当中的一位富人。 [sha wo a ！ wo wu yi wei ni shi wo men dang zhong de yi wei fu ren 。]

english: Well that's rude.
translation: 嗯，这很粗鲁。 [n ， zhe hen cu lu 。]

english: You'll catch on.
translation: 你会明白的。 [ni hui ming bai de 。]

english: Hello there. Are you liking the city?
translation: 你好呀。你喜欢这座城市吗？ [ni hao ya 。 ni xi huan zhe zuo cheng shi ma ？]

english: It's beautiful!
translation: 很美丽！ [hen mei li ！]

english: It really is.
translation: 确实如此。 [que shi ru ci 。]

english: Huh? Are you an encyclopediasalesman?
translation: 啊？您是百科全书推销员吗？ [a ？ nin shi bai ke quan shu tui xiao yuan ma ？]

english: No, sir, I'm a burglar. I burgle people.
translation: 不，先生，我是小偷。我偷窃别人。 [bu ， xian sheng ， wo shi xiao tou 。 wo tou qie bie ren 。]

english: Hmm... I think you're an encyclopediasalesman?
translation: 嗯...我认为你是一名百科全书推销员？ [n ... wo ren wei ni shi yi ming bai ke quan shu tui xiao yuan ？]

english: Not at all. I just want to ransack the place. Honestly.
translation: 一点也不。我只是想搜查一下这个地方。诚实地。 [yi dian ye bu 。 wo zhi shi xiang sou cha yi xia zhe ge di fang 。 cheng shi di 。]

english: Hmm... Alright then.
translation: 嗯……那好吧。 [n …… na hao ba 。]

english: I love the fresh air outside, don't you?
translation: 我喜欢外面的新鲜空气，你呢？ [wo xi huan wai mian de xin xian kong qi ， ni ne ？]

english: It is quite nice out here.
translation: 这里非常好。 [zhe li fei chang hao 。]

english: Lovely day for a stroll, wouldn't you say?
translation: 这是散步的好日子，你说呢？ [zhe shi san bu de hao ri zi ， ni shuo ne ？]

english: It is!
translation: 这是！ [zhe shi ！]

english: I've got something in the back of my mind telling me I should go back home.
translation: 我心里有件事告诉我我应该回家。 [wo xin li you jian shi gao su wo wo ying gai hui jia 。]

english: You don't say...
translation: 你不说... [ni bu shuo ...]

english: I do love being rich! I can take leisurely strolls whenever I want, without a care in the world!
translation: 我就是喜欢有钱！我可以随时随地悠闲地散步，无忧无虑！ [wo jiu shi xi huan you qian ！ wo ke yi sui shi sui di you xian di san bu ， wu you wu lv ！]

english: Enjoy it! Take as much time as you want!
translation: 好好享受！你想花多少时间就花多少时间！ [hao hao xiang shou ！ ni xiang hua duo shao shi jian jiu hua duo shao shi jian ！]

english: Time to go check how rich I am!
translation: 是时候去看看我有多富有了！ [shi shi hou qu kan kan wo you duo fu you le ！]

english: Lovely day for a stroll.
translation: 美好的一天，适合散步。 [mei hao de yi tian ， shi he san bu 。]

english: You are escorted out of the house as the owner has locked the door.
translation: 由于房主锁上了门，您将被护送出房子。 [you yu fang zhu suo shang le men ， nin jiang bei hu song chu fang zi 。]

english: You hear someone outside spot the homeowner coming back!
translation: 你听到外面有人发现房主回来了！ [ni ting dao wai mian you ren fa xian fang zhu hui lai le ！]

english: Now where did I put my keys...
translation: 现在我把钥匙放在哪里了... [xian zai wo ba yao shi fang zai na li le ...]

english: Ah, there they are!
translation: 啊，他们在那里！ [a ， ta men zai na li ！]

english: It smells funny in here...
translation: 这里的味道很奇怪... [zhe li de wei dao hen qi guai ...]

english: There's mud all over the floor!
translation: 地板上全都是泥！ [di ban shang quan dou shi ni ！]

english: Something isn't right here...
translation: 这里有些不对劲... [zhe li you xie bu dui jin ...]

english: How did you get in here?
translation: 你是怎么进来的？ [ni shi zen me jin lai de ？]

english: Who are you? What are you after?
translation: 你是谁？你在追求什么？ [ni shi shui ？ ni zai zhui qiu shen me ？]

english: Nothing, I will be on my way.
translation: 没什么，我会继续赶路的。 [mei shen me ， wo hui ji xu gan lu de 。]

english: I see you are a chef... Could you cook me something?
translation: 我看你是个厨师...你能为我做点什么吗？ [wo kan ni shi ge chu shi ... ni neng wei wo zuo dian shen me ma ？]

english: I would, but I am very busy. I am trying to increase my reknownas one of the worlds' leading chefs by preparing a special and unique fish salad.
translation: 我愿意，但我很忙。我正试图通过准备一种特殊而独特的鱼沙拉来提高我作为世界领先厨师之一的声誉。 [wo yuan yi ， dan wo hen mang 。 wo zheng shi tu tong guo zhun bei yi zhong te shu er du te de yu sha la lai ti gao wo zuo wei shi jie ling xian chu shi zhi yi de sheng yu 。]

english: Caleb! As an adventurer, I am ready to help you with whatever you need... again! What can I help you with?
translation: 迦勒！作为一名冒险家，我随时准备为您提供任何需要的帮助……再次！我能为您提供什么帮助？ [jia lei ！ zuo wei yi ming mao xian jia ， wo sui shi zhun bei wei nin ti gong ren he xu yao de bang zhu …… zai ci ！ wo neng wei nin ti gong shen me bang zhu ？]

english: You daydream briefly of what the rich family could offer you this time as a reward.
translation: 你短暂地幻想着这次富有的家庭会给你什么作为奖励。 [ni duan zan di huan xiang zhe zhe ci fu you de jia ting hui gei ni shen me zuo wei jiang li 。]

english: ... and that's when I found the broken lamping stick. Maybe you could help me investigate?
translation: ……就在那时我发现了断掉的灯棒。也许你可以帮我调查一下？ […… jiu zai na shi wo fa xian liao duan diao de deng bang 。 ye xu ni ke yi bang wo diao cha yi xia ？]

english: Sorry, I didn't quite catch that, my mind was erm... elsewhere.
translation: 抱歉，我没听清楚，我的心思在其他地方。 [bao qian ， wo mei ting qing chu ， wo de xin si zai qi ta di fang 。]

english: Well if you aren't going to listen to the problem, it's fine, don't worry about it. Nothing an experienced chef can't solve himself!
translation: 好吧，如果你不打算听这个问题，没关系，不用担心。没有什么是经验丰富的厨师解决不了的！ [hao ba ， ru guo ni bu da suan ting zhe ge wen ti ， mei guan xi ， bu yong dan xin 。 mei you shen me shi jing yan feng fu de chu shi jie jue bu liao de ！]

english: I'm sorry! Please let me help.
translation: 对不起！请让我帮忙。 [dui bu qi ！ qing rang wo bang mang 。]

english: No! Not every problem in my life needs an adventurer to come solve it for me anyway. I'm happy and there's nothing else either!
translation: 不！无论如何，并不是我生活中的每个问题都需要冒险家来为我解决。我很高兴，也没有别的事了！ [bu ！ wu lun ru he ， bing bu shi wo sheng huo zhong de mei ge wen ti dou xu yao mao xian jia lai wei wo jie jue 。 wo hen gao xing ， ye mei you bie de shi le ！]

english: Very well, I'll go and see if your other brothers need anything...
translation: 好吧，我去看看你其他兄弟有没有需要什么…… [hao ba ， wo qu kan kan ni qi ta xiong di you mei you xu yao shen me ……]

english: The sweet smell of the great rewards that may come fades slightly.
translation: 即将到来的巨大回报的甜蜜气息会稍微减弱。 [ji jiang dao lai de ju da hui bao de tian mi qi xi hui shao wei jian ruo 。]

english: Are you sure there's nothing I can do, a chef can always do with help in their kitchen right?
translation: 你确定我无能为力，厨师在厨房的帮助下总能做对吗？ [ni que ding wo wu neng wei li ， chu shi zai chu fang de bang zhu xia zong neng zuo dui ma ？]

english: I'm a very competent cook! I do not need your assistance [player name]. Please leave me be.
translation: 我是一个非常能干的厨师！我不需要你的帮助[玩家姓名]。请别打扰我。 [wo shi yi ge fei chang neng gan de chu shi ！ wo bu xu yao ni de bang zhu [ wan jia xing ming ]。 qing bie da rao wo 。]

english: I hear you have brought the completed crest to my father. I must say, that was awfully impressive work.
translation: 我听说你已经把完成的徽章带给我父亲了。我必须说，这是非常令人印象深刻的工作。 [wo ting shuo ni yi jing ba wan cheng de hui zhang dai gei wo fu qin le 。 wo bi xu shuo ， zhe shi fei chang ling ren yin xiang shen ke de gong zuo 。]

english: It was easy really.
translation: 这真的很容易。 [zhe zhen de hen rong yi 。]

english: Yes well... Is there anything I can help you with?
translation: 是的，好吧...有什么可以帮您的吗？ [shi de ， hao ba ... you shen me ke yi bang nin de ma ？]

english: Can you change my gauntlets for me?
translation: 你能帮我换一下手套吗？ [ni neng bang wo huan yi xia shou tao ma ？]

english: Your gauntlets have already been treated with my potions.
translation: 你的护手已经用我的药剂处理过了。 [ni de hu shou yi jing yong wo de yao ji chu li guo le 。]

english: You don't have any gauntlets I can imbue.
translation: 你没有任何我可以赋予的手套。 [ni mei you ren he wo ke yi fu yu de shou tao 。]

english: Yes certainly, though it will cost you 25,000 coins.
translation: 当然可以，不过要花费 25,000 个金币。 [dang ran ke yi ， bu guo yao hua fei  25,000  ge jin bi 。]

english: Oh, right.
translation: 哦，对了。 [o ， dui le 。]

english: Great thanks!
translation: 非常感谢！ [fei chang gan xie ！]

english: Caleb takes the gauntlets from you, pours some herbs and seasonings on them, bakes them on his range for a short time, then hands them back to you.
translation: 迦勒从你手中接过手套，在上面倒上一些香草和调味料，在他的炉子上烤了一会儿，然后把它们还给你。 [jia lei cong ni shou zhong jie guo shou tao ， zai shang mian dao shang yi xie xiang cao he tiao wei liao ， zai ta de lu zi shang kao le yi hui er ， ran hou ba ta men huan gei ni 。]

english: No that's okay thanks.
translation: 不，没关系，谢谢。 [bu ， mei guan xi ， xie xie 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: I have received word from my father that you assisted us again! I get the feeling you weren't going to stop trying until you did though.
translation: 我收到我父亲的消息，你又帮助了我们！我感觉你不会停止尝试，除非你这样做了。 [wo shou dao wo fu qin de xiao xi ， ni you bang zhu le wo men ！ wo gan jue ni bu hui ting zhi chang shi ， chu fei ni zhe yang zuo le 。]

english: As thanks, I'll provide you with as many pairs of Cooking gauntlets as you wish.
translation: 作为感谢，我会为您提供尽可能多的烹饪手套。 [zuo wei gan xie ， wo hui wei nin ti gong jin ke neng duo de peng ren shou tao 。]

english: You will find the rate you burn certain foods is much reduced whilst wearing these gauntlets.
translation: 您会发现戴着这些手套时燃烧某些食物的速度会大大降低。 [nin hui fa xian dai zhe zhe xie shou tao shi ran shao mou xie shi wu de su du hui da da jiang di 。]

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Here you go!
translation: 干得好！ [gan de hao ！]

english: You're welcome.
translation: 不客气。 [bu ke qi 。]

english: Nothing, I will be on my way.
translation: 没什么，我会继续赶路的。 [mei shen me ， wo hui ji xu gan lu de 。]

english: I see you are a chef, will you cook me anything?
translation: 我看你是个厨师，你能给我做点什么吗？ [wo kan ni shi ge chu shi ， ni neng gei wo zuo dian shen me ma ？]

english: Family Pest
translation: 家庭害虫 [jia ting hai chong]

english: Gauntlets
translation: 护手 [hu shou]

english: Can you change my gauntlets for me?
translation: 你能帮我换一下手套吗？ [ni neng bang wo huan yi xia shou tao ma ？]

english: Great thanks!
translation: 非常感谢！ [fei chang gan xie ！]

english: No that's okay thanks.
translation: 不，没关系，谢谢。 [bu ， mei guan xi ， xie xie 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Could I have another pair of Cooking gauntlets?
translation: 我可以再要一副烹饪手套吗？ [wo ke yi zai yao yi fu peng ren shou tao ma ？]

english: You're welcome.
translation: 不客气。 [bu ke qi 。]

english: Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: 嘿，这是英雄！哇！你太厉害了，你到底是怎么对付那两个少年和加德兰克的？这个小镇很可爱，你做得很好！ [hei ， zhe shi ying xiong ！ wa ！ ni tai li hai le ， ni dao di shi zen me dui fu na liang ge shao nian he jia de lan ke de ？ zhe ge xiao zhen hen ke ai ， ni zuo de hen hao ！]

english: You're more than welcome.
translation: 非常欢迎您。 [fei chang huan ying nin 。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm Calin, I'm trying to stay warm by this fire.
translation: 我是卡林，我想在这堆火旁取暖。 [wo shi ka lin ， wo xiang zai zhe dui huo pang qu nuan 。]

english: How do you like your town?
translation: 你喜欢你的城市吗？ [ni xi huan ni de cheng shi ma ？]

english: It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
translation: 非常完美，非常感谢您的努力。 [fei chang wan mei ， fei chang gan xie nin de nu li 。]

english: What's happening around here?
translation: 这附近发生了什么事？ [zhe fu jin fa sheng le shen me shi ？]

english: Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: 哦，其实也没什么，我们都还在躲避吸血鬼，在这个可怕的地方勉强维持生计，希望很快我们就能足够强大，踏上前往圣殿的旅程。 [o ， qi shi ye mei shen me ， wo men dou hai zai duo bi xi xue gui ， zai zhe ge ke pa de di fang mian qiang wei chi sheng ji ， xi wang hen kuai wo men jiu neng zu gou qiang da ， ta shang qian wang sheng dian de lv cheng 。]

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang mang de ma ？]

english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: 据我所知，我们现在有一些非常有用的基本设施，我们都非常感谢您。我以前从未真正见过或认识英雄，所以我没有什么可以与之比较的，但我怀疑 [ju wo suo zhi ， wo men xian zai you yi xie fei chang you yong de ji ben she shi ， wo men dou fei chang gan xie nin 。 wo yi qian cong wei zhen zheng jian guo huo ren shi ying xiong ， suo yi wo mei you shen me ke yi yu zhi bi jiao de ， dan wo huai yi]

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: 大多数人的判断，你就是其中之一！我很高兴见到你。 [da duo shu ren de pan duan ， ni jiu shi qi zhong zhi yi ！ wo hen gao xing jian dao ni 。]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: How do you like your town?
translation: 你喜欢你的城市吗？ [ni xi huan ni de cheng shi ma ？]

english: What's happening around here?
translation: 这附近发生了什么事？ [zhe fu jin fa sheng le shen me shi ？]

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang mang de ma ？]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Can I help you?
translation: 我可以帮你吗？ [wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm just mining... Problem is, it's a struggle to get past all these fossil looking things.
translation: 我只是在采矿……问题是，要克服所有这些看起来像化石的东西是很困难的。 [wo zhi shi zai cai kuang …… wen ti shi ， yao ke fu suo you zhe xie kan qi lai xiang hua shi de dong xi shi hen kun nan de 。]

english: Can I help?
translation: 我可以帮忙吗？ [wo ke yi bang mang ma ？]

english: The others wouldn't like it if a human got involved... You lot tend to take too much from the rocks.
translation: 如果人类参与其中，其他人不会喜欢……你们往往会从岩石中获取太多。 [ru guo ren lei can yu qi zhong ， qi ta ren bu hui xi huan …… ni men wang wang hui cong yan shi zhong huo qu tai duo 。]

english: But what if I were to sort out these fossil things you mentioned?
translation: 但如果我把你提到的这些化石东西整理出来怎么办？ [dan ru guo wo ba ni ti dao de zhe xie hua shi dong xi zheng li chu lai zen me ban ？]

english: Hmm... I shouldn't... And yet...
translation: 嗯...我不应该...但是... [n ... wo bu ying gai ... dan shi ...]

english: Okay, I'll tell you what... If you mine through these calcified deposits, you can keep whatever you get from them.
translation: 好吧，我告诉你……如果你开采这些钙化沉积物，你就可以保留从它们那里得到的任何东西。 [hao ba ， wo gao su ni …… ru guo ni kai cai zhe xie gai hua chen ji wu ， ni jiu ke yi bao liu cong ta men na li de dao de ren he dong xi 。]

english: Are you sure?
translation: 你确定吗？ [ni que ding ma ？]

english: Yeah, why not. I'm tired of getting sprayed with all the water that leaks from these walls anyway. Not to mention it just brings out lots of extra useless bits with it!
translation: 是啊，为什么不呢。不管怎样，我已经厌倦了被从这些墙上漏出来的水溅到。更不用说它只会带来很多额外的无用的东西！ [shi a ， wei shen me bu ne 。 bu guan zen yang ， wo yi jing yan juan le bei cong zhe xie qiang shang lou chu lai de shui jian dao 。 geng bu yong shuo ta zhi hui dai lai hen duo e wai de wu yong de dong xi ！]

english: So the water makes the walls even more lucrative?
translation: 那么水使墙壁更有利可图吗？ [na me shui shi qiang bi geng you li ke tu ma ？]

english: If you consider pointless fossils lucrative, then I suppose.
translation: 如果你认为毫无意义的化石有利可图，那么我想。 [ru guo ni ren wei hao wu yi yi de hua shi you li ke tu ， na me wo xiang 。]

english: I see. I'll get to work then! See what I can do to help.
translation: 我懂了。那我就去上班了！看看我能提供什么帮助。 [wo dong le 。 na wo jiu qu shang ban le ！ kan kan wo neng ti gong shen me bang zhu 。]

english: What are these weird chippings?
translation: 这些奇怪的碎片是什么？ [zhe xie qi guai de sui pian shi shen me ？]

english: Bone shards! Totally pointless if you ask me, but I hear the humans up atop the mountain quite like them.
translation: 骨头碎片！如果你问我的话，这完全没有意义，但我听说山顶上的人类很像他们。 [gu tou sui pian ！ ru guo ni wen wo de hua ， zhe wan quan mei you yi yi ， dan wo ting shuo shan ding shang de ren lei hen xiang ta men 。]

english: Apparently they offer them up as some sort of sacrifice, but I'm not too sure on the specifics. It's not like I ever go up there myself.
translation: 显然他们将它们作为某种牺牲，但我不太确定具体细节。我自己好像从来没有去过那里。 [xian ran ta men jiang ta men zuo wei mou zhong xi sheng ， dan wo bu tai que ding ju ti xi jie 。 wo zi ji hao xiang cong lai mei you qu guo na li 。]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: Can you have a look at this chunk of rock?
translation: 你能看一下这块石头吗？ [ni neng kan yi xia zhe kuai shi tou ma ？]

english: That's quite the chunk indeed. It looks to be a big mass of calcified rock.
translation: 这确实是相当大的一块。它看起来是一大块钙化岩石。 [zhe que shi shi xiang dang da de yi kuai 。 ta kan qi lai shi yi da kuai gai hua yan shi 。]

english: I reckon you'll be able to break it up on an anvil. Perhaps there might be something interesting inside...
translation: 我想你可以用铁砧把它打碎。也许里面有什么有趣的东西...... [wo xiang ni ke yi yong tie zhen ba ta da sui 。 ye xu li mian you shen me you qu de dong xi ......]

english: Thanks! I'll go smash it open.
translation: 谢谢！我去把它砸开。 [xie xie ！ wo qu ba ta za kai 。]

english: Smashing!
translation: 粉碎！ [fen sui ！]

english: I found this weird moth.
translation: 我发现了这只奇怪的飞蛾。 [wo fa xian le zhe zhi qi guai de fei e 。]

english: Strange... I've never seen one of those before. That's quite the find.
translation: 奇怪……我以前从未见过其中之一。这真是一个发现。 [qi guai …… wo yi qian cong wei jian guo qi zhong zhi yi 。 zhe zhen shi yi ge fa xian 。]

english: Of all the creatures to find stuck in a wall, I didn't expect a moth.
translation: 在所有卡在墙上的生物中，我没想到是飞蛾。 [zai suo you ka zai qiang shang de sheng wu zhong ， wo mei xiang dao shi fei e 。]

english: Moths carry a lot of magical power within this mountain. You can probably crush it to consume whatever power is left inside.
translation: 这座山里的飞蛾携带着很多神奇的力量。你或许可以压碎它，消耗掉里面剩余的能量。 [zhe zuo shan li de fei e xie dai zhe hen duo shen qi de li liang 。 ni huo xu ke yi ya sui ta ， xiao hao diao li mian sheng yu de neng liang 。]

english: Is that safe?
translation: 这样安全吗？ [zhe yang an quan ma ？]

english: Only one way to find out!
translation: 只有一种方法可以找出答案！ [zhi you yi zhong fang fa ke yi zhao chu da an ！]

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: What are these weird chippings?
translation: 这些奇怪的碎片是什么？ [zhe xie qi guai de sui pian shi shen me ？]

english: Can you have a look at this chunk of rock?
translation: 你能看一下这块石头吗？ [ni neng kan yi xia zhe kuai shi tou ma ？]

english: I found this weird moth.
translation: 我发现了这只奇怪的飞蛾。 [wo fa xian le zhe zhi qi guai de fei e 。]

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: Why the grizzly face?
translation: 为何脸色灰白？ [wei he lian se hui bai ？]

translation: 你一点都不好笑... [ni yi dian dou bu hao xiao ...]

english: You should get in the.... sun more.
translation: 你应该多晒晒太阳。 [ni ying gai duo shai shai tai yang 。]

english: You're really not funny...
translation: 你真的一点都不好笑... [ni zhen de yi dian dou bu hao xiao ...]

english: One second, let me take a picture of you with my.... kodiak camera.
translation: 等一下，让我用我的……科迪亚克相机给你拍一张照片。 [deng yi xia ， rang wo yong wo de …… ke di ya ke xiang ji gei ni pai yi zhang zhao pian 。]

english: Feeling.... blue.
translation: 感觉……蓝色。 [gan jue …… lan se 。]

english: If you don't stop, I'm going to leave some... brown... at your feet, human.
translation: 如果你不停下来，我会在你的脚下留下一些……棕色的……，人类。 [ru guo ni bu ting xia lai ， wo hui zai ni de jiao xia liu xia yi xie …… zong se de ……， ren lei 。]

english: *slap*
translation: *拍击* [* pai ji *]

translation: 咕噜！ [gu lu ！]

english: Grrrr!
translation: 咕噜！ [gu lu ！]

english: Grarrr!
translation: 嘎嘎！ [ga ga ！]

english: I'm sorry to bother you, but could you spare me a little dung?
translation: 很抱歉打扰你，但是你能给我一点粪便吗？ [hen bao qian da rao ni ， dan shi ni neng gei wo yi dian fen bian ma ？]

english: The camel didn't seem to appreciate that question.
translation: 骆驼似乎不喜欢这个问题。 [luo tuo si hu bu xi huan zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: If I go near that camel, it'll probably bite my hand off.
translation: 如果我靠近那头骆驼，它可能会咬掉我的手。 [ru guo wo kao jin na tou luo tuo ， ta ke neng hui yao diao wo de shou 。]

english: Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab.
translation: 嗯……看起来那只骆驼可以做一顿美味的烤肉串。 [n …… kan qi lai na zhi luo tuo ke yi zuo yi dun mei wei de kao rou chuan 。]

english: I wonder if that camel has fleas...
translation: 我想知道那只骆驼有没有跳蚤... [wo xiang zhi dao na zhi luo tuo you mei you tiao zao ...]

english: Are you serious?
translation: 你是认真的？ [ni shi ren zhen de ？]

english: Oh yes. If you'd be so kind...
translation: 哦是的。如果你能这么善良的话... [o shi de 。 ru guo ni neng zhe me shan liang de hua ...]

english: Well, just you close your eyes first. I'm not doing it while you're watching me!
translation: 好吧，你先闭上眼睛。当你看着我的时候我不会这么做！ [hao ba ， ni xian bi shang yan jing 。 dang ni kan zhe wo de shi hou wo bu hui zhe me zuo ！]

english: I hope that's what you wanted!
translation: 我希望这就是你想要的！ [wo xi wang zhe jiu shi ni xiang yao de ！]

english: Ohhh yes. Lovely.
translation: 噢，是的。迷人的。 [o ， shi de 。 mi ren de 。]

english: What was that?
translation: 那是什么？ [na shi shen me ？]

english: Nothing important.
translation: 没什么重要的。 [mei shen me zhong yao de 。]

english: The weather's really hot, don't you think?
translation: 天气真的很热，你不觉得吗？ [tian qi zhen de hen re ， ni bu jue de ma ？]

english: Not hot for camels, surely?
translation: 骆驼肯定不热吧？ [luo tuo ken ding bu re ba ？]

english: Are you joking? It's burning hot out here! Sitting by the oasis is the only way to stay cool.
translation: 你在开玩笑吗？这里很热！坐在绿洲旁是保持凉爽的唯一方法。 [ni zai kai wan xiao ma ？ zhe li hen re ！ zuo zai lv zhou pang shi bao chi liang shuang de wei yi fang fa 。]

english: I thought camels carried their own water in their humps.
translation: 我以为骆驼的驼峰里有自己的水。 [wo yi wei luo tuo de tuo feng li you zi ji de shui 。]

english: It's never enough. And it's always far too hot to go anywhere in the desert.
translation: 永远都不够。而且沙漠里的任何地方总是太热。 [yong yuan dou bu gou 。 er qie sha mo li de ren he di fang zong shi tai re 。]

english: Sometimes I wish I could go travelling in cooler places, like all those adventurers I see passing through here.
translation: 有时我希望我能去更凉爽的地方旅行，就像我看到的所有冒险家经过这里一样。 [you shi wo xi wang wo neng qu geng liang shuang de di fang lv xing ， jiu xiang wo kan dao de suo you mao xian jia jing guo zhe li yi yang 。]

english: Well, adventuring's thirsty work as well.
translation: 嗯，冒险也是一项令人渴求的工作。 [n ， mao xian ye shi yi xiang ling ren ke qiu de gong zuo 。]

english: Oh, that's a pity.
translation: 噢，真遗憾。 [o ， zhen yi han 。]

english: In that case, I'll just stay by this nice cool oasis.
translation: 既然如此，我就留在这片凉爽的绿洲吧。 [ji ran ru ci ， wo jiu liu zai zhe pian liang shuang de lv zhou ba 。]

english: *makes camel noises*
translation: *发出骆驼叫声* [* fa chu luo tuo jiao sheng *]

english: *makes happier camel noises*
translation: *发出更快乐的骆驼叫声* [* fa chu geng kuai le de luo tuo jiao sheng *]

english: You've [been given a new clue/obtained a casket]!
translation: 你[得到了新的线索/获得了一个棺材]！ [ni [ de dao le xin de xian suo / huo de le yi ge guan cai ]！]

english: Ask the camel about its dung.
translation: 向骆驼询问它的粪便。 [xiang luo tuo xun wen ta de fen bian 。]

english: Say something unpleasant.
translation: 说一些不愉快的话。 [shuo yi xie bu yu kuai de hua 。]

english: Neither - I'm a polite person.
translation: 都不是——我是一个有礼貌的人。 [dou bu shi —— wo shi yi ge you li mao de ren 。]

english: Welcome my friend to the Old Nite! What can I do for you?
translation: 欢迎我的朋友来到旧夜！我能为你做什么？ [huan ying wo de peng you lai dao jiu ye ！ wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: Got anything strong to drink?
translation: 有什么烈性的饮料吗？ [you shen me lie xing de yin liao ma ？]

english: Of course I do! I can offer you a big tasty beer, yours for only two coins.
translation: 我当然知道！我可以给你一大杯美味的啤酒，你只需花两枚硬币。 [wo dang ran zhi dao ！ wo ke yi gei ni yi da bei mei wei de pi jiu ， ni zhi xu hua liang mei ying bi 。]

english: Oh dear, I don't seem to have enough money.
translation: 哎呀，看来我钱不够了。 [ai ya ， kan lai wo qian bu gou le 。]

english: No worries, there's a bank just around the corner if you want to grab some coin.
translation: 不用担心，如果您想买点硬币，拐角处就有一家银行。 [bu yong dan xin ， ru guo nin xiang mai dian ying bi ， guai jiao chu jiu you yi jia yin hang 。]

english: Sure, I'll take a beer.
translation: 当然，我要一杯啤酒。 [dang ran ， wo yao yi bei pi jiu 。]

english: Your pub looks a bit rough.
translation: 你的酒吧看上去有点简陋。 [ni de jiu ba kan shang qu you dian jian lou 。]

english: It's all part of the aesthetic! Adventurers who've just returned from the fight of their lives don't want a fancy la-de-da establishment like you'd find down south.
translation: 这都是审美的一部分！刚刚结束一生的战斗归来的冒险家并不想要南方那种华丽的拉德达建筑。 [zhe dou shi shen mei de yi bu fen ！ gang gang jie shu yi sheng de zhan dou gui lai de mao xian jia bing bu xiang yao nan fang na zhong hua li de la de da jian zhu 。]

english: They want somewhere to relax and have some hearty ale.
translation: 他们想要找个地方放松一下，喝点丰盛的啤酒。 [ta men xiang yao zhao ge di fang fang song yi xia ， he dian feng sheng de pi jiu 。]

english: And that's what you offer with your broken tables and glass covered floors?
translation: 这就是你们用破碎的桌子和玻璃地板提供的东西吗？ [zhe jiu shi ni men yong po sui de zhuo zi he bo li di ban ti gong de dong xi ma ？]

english: Aye it is, because here at the Old Nite, your safety is our lowest priority!
translation: 是的，因为在 Old Nite，您的安全是我们的首要任务！ [shi de ， yin wei zai  Old Nite， nin de an quan shi wo men de shou yao ren wu ！]

english: The camel tries to stamp on your foot, but you pull it back quickly.
translation: 骆驼试图踩你的脚，但你很快就把它拉了回来。 [luo tuo shi tu cai ni de jiao ， dan ni hen kuai jiu ba ta la le hui lai 。]

translation: 骆驼转过头来瞪着你。 [luo tuo zhuan guo tou lai deng zhe ni 。]

translation: 骆驼向你吐口水，你赶紧向后跳去。 [luo tuo xiang ni tu kou shui ， ni gan jin xiang hou tiao qu 。]

translation: 我希望这就是你想要的！ [wo xi wang zhe jiu shi ni xiang yao de ！]

english: Ohhh yes. Lovely.
translation: 噢，是的。迷人的。 [o ， shi de 。 mi ren de 。]

english: How can you say such cruel things?
translation: 怎么能说出这么残忍的话呢？ [zen me neng shuo chu zhe me can ren de hua ne ？]

english: Yeah? Well, your mother was a jackal!
translation: 是的？好吧，你的母亲是一只豺狼！ [shi de ？ hao ba ， ni de mu qin shi yi zhi chai lang ！]

english: Hey! Be kinder to your four-legged neighbours.
translation: 嘿！善待你的四足邻居。 [hei ！ shan dai ni de si zu lin ju 。]

english: Ask the camel about its dung.
translation: 向骆驼询问它的粪便。 [xiang luo tuo xun wen ta de fen bian 。]

english: Say something unpleasant.
translation: 说一些不愉快的话。 [shuo yi xie bu yu kuai de hua 。]

english: Neither - I'm a polite person.
translation: 都不是——我是一个有礼貌的人。 [dou bu shi —— wo shi yi ge you li mao de ren 。]

english: I've heard about all the things you did for us!
translation: 我听说过你为我们所做的一切！ [wo ting shuo guo ni wei wo men suo zuo de yi qie ！]

english: I was happy to help.
translation: 我很乐意提供帮助。 [wo hen le yi ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: And I'm happy that you helped us! Maybe now this place can be a bit more cheerful again!
translation: 我很高兴你帮助了我们！也许现在这个地方又可以热闹一点了！ [wo hen gao xing ni bang zhu le wo men ！ ye xu xian zai zhe ge di fang you ke yi re nao yi dian le ！]

english: I'd rather be left alone, outerlander.
translation: 我宁愿一个人呆着，外地人。 [wo ning yuan yi ge ren dai zhe ， wai di ren 。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Nice place you have here!
translation: 你这里的地方真好！ [ni zhe li de di fang zhen hao ！]

english: It is indeed.
translation: 确实如此。 [que shi ru ci 。]

english: Nice day, isn't it?
translation: 美好的一天，不是吗？ [mei hao de yi tian ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: Hi! Would you be interested in some of my fine candles?
translation: 你好！您对我的一些精美蜡烛感兴趣吗？ [ni hao ！ nin dui wo de yi xie jing mei la zhu gan xing qu ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Here, have this.
translation: 给，这个。 [gei ， zhe ge 。]

english: Yes Please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Do you want a lit candle for 1000 gold?
translation: 你想要 1000 金币点燃蜡烛吗？ [ni xiang yao  1000  jin bi dian ran la zhu ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: But I don't have that kind of money on me.
translation: 但我身上没有那么多钱。 [dan wo shen shang mei you na me duo qian 。]

english: Well then, no candle for you!
translation: 那么，就没有蜡烛给你了！ [na me ， jiu mei you la zhu gei ni le ！]

english: Here you go then.
translation: 那就给你吧。 [na jiu gei ni ba 。]

english: I should warn you, though, it can be dangerous to take a naked flame down there. You'd be better off making a lantern.
translation: 不过，我应该警告你，带明火下去是很危险的。最好还是做个灯笼吧。 [bu guo ， wo ying gai jing gao ni ， dai ming huo xia qu shi hen wei xian de 。 zui hao hai shi zuo ge deng long ba 。]

english: What's so dangerous about a naked flame?
translation: 明火有什么危险？ [ming huo you shen me wei xian ？]

english: Heh heh... You'll find out.
translation: 呵呵……你就知道了。 [he he …… ni jiu zhi dao le 。]

english: Thanks, bye.
translation: 谢谢，再见。 [xie xie ， zai jian 。]

english: One thousand gold?!
translation: 一千金？！ [yi qian jin ？！]

english: Look, you're not going to be able to survive down that hole without a light source.
translation: 听着，如果没有光源，你就无法在那个洞里生存。 [ting zhe ， ru guo mei you guang yuan ， ni jiu wu fa zai na ge dong li sheng cun 。]

english: So you could go off to the candle shop to buy one more cheaply. You could even make your own lantern, which is a lot better.
translation: 所以你可以去蜡烛店再便宜地买一支。你甚至可以自己制作灯笼，那就更好了。 [suo yi ni ke yi qu la zhu dian zai pian yi di mai yi zhi 。 ni shen zhi ke yi zi ji zhi zuo deng long ， na jiu geng hao le 。]

english: But I bet you want to find out what's down there right now, don't you? And you can pay me 1000 gold for the privilege!
translation: 但我打赌你现在想知道下面有什么，不是吗？你可以付给我1000金币来获得这个特权！ [dan wo da du ni xian zai xiang zhi dao xia mian you shen me ， bu shi ma ？ ni ke yi fu gei wo 1000 jin bi lai huo de zhe ge te quan ！]

english: All right, you win, I'll buy a candle.
translation: 好吧，你赢了，我去买一支蜡烛。 [hao ba ， ni ying le ， wo qu mai yi zhi la zhu 。]

english: No way.
translation: 决不。 [jue bu 。]

english: How do you make lanterns?
translation: 你如何制作灯笼？ [ni ru he zhi zuo deng long ？]

english: Out of glass.The more advanced lanterns have a metal component as well.
translation: 由玻璃制成。更先进的灯笼也有金属成分。 [you bo li zhi cheng 。 geng xian jin de deng long ye you jin shu cheng fen 。]

english: Firstly you can make a simple candle lantern out of glass.It's just like a candle, but the flame isn't exposed, so it's safer.
translation: 首先你可以用玻璃做一个简单的蜡烛灯笼。它就像蜡烛一样，但火焰不外露，所以更安全。 [shou xian ni ke yi yong bo li zuo yi ge jian dan de la zhu deng long 。 ta jiu xiang la zhu yi yang ， dan huo yan bu wai lu ， suo yi geng an quan 。]

english: Then you can make an oil lamp, which is brighter but has an exposed flame.But if you make an iron frame for it you can turn it into an oil lantern.
translation: 然后你可以做一盏油灯，它比较亮，但有外露的火焰。但是如果你给它做一个铁架，你就可以把它变成油灯。 [ran hou ni ke yi zuo yi zhan you deng ， ta bi jiao liang ， dan you wai lu de huo yan 。 dan shi ru guo ni gei ta zuo yi ge tie jia ， ni jiu ke yi ba ta bian cheng you deng 。]

english: Finally there's the bullseye lantern.You'll need to make a frame out of steel and add a glass lens.
translation: 最后是牛眼灯笼。您需要用钢制作一个框架并添加一个玻璃透镜。 [zui hou shi niu yan deng long 。 nin xu yao yong gang zhi zuo yi ge kuang jia bing tian jia yi ge bo li tou jing 。]

english: Once you've made your lamp or lantern, you'll need to make lamp oil for it.The chemist near Rimmington has a machine for that.
translation: 制作完灯或灯笼后，您需要为其制作灯油。里明顿附近的化学家有一台机器可以用来制作灯油。 [zhi zuo wan deng huo deng long hou ， nin xu yao wei qi zhi zuo deng you 。 li ming dun fu jin de hua xue jia you yi tai ji qi ke yi yong lai zhi zuo deng you 。]

english: For any light source, you'll need a tinderbox to light it. Keep your tinderbox handy in case it goes out!
translation: 对于任何光源，您都需要一个易燃物来点亮它。把你的火药盒放在手边，以防它熄灭！ [dui yu ren he guang yuan ， nin dou xu yao yi ge yi ran wu lai dian liang ta 。 ba ni de huo yao he fang zai shou bian ， yi fang ta xi mie ！]

english: But if all that's too complicated, you can buy a candle right here for 1000 gold!
translation: 但如果这一切太复杂，你可以在这里花 1000 金币购买一支蜡烛！ [dan ru guo zhe yi qie tai fu za ， ni ke yi zai zhe li hua  1000  jin bi gou mai yi zhi la zhu ！]

english: No thanks, I'd rather curse the darkness.

english: Oh yeah? I see you've got a Thieving level of [thieving level]. That must give you quite a long criminal record.
