english: Can we head to Lunar Isle?
translation: 我们可以去月岛吗？ [wo men ke yi qu yue dao ma ？]

english: Sure matey!
translation: 当然啦，伙计！ [dang ran la ， huo ji ！]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: And you're wanting what now?
translation: 你现在想要什么？ [ni xian zai xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Can you take me back to Rellekka please?
translation: 你能带我回雷莱卡吗？ [ni neng dai wo hui lei lai ka ma ？]

english: I'll take you as far as Pirates' Cove. You'll have to find the rest of the way back yourself.
translation: 我会带你一直到海盗湾。剩下的路你得自己找到回去的路。 [wo hui dai ni yi zhi dao hai dao wan 。 sheng xia de lu ni de zi ji zhao dao hui qu de lu 。]

english: So we're here?
translation: 所以我们到了？ [suo yi wo men dao le ？]

english: Yep. You're free to explore the island. Be careful though, the Moon Clan are very powerful, it wouldn't be wise to wrong them.
translation: 是的。您可以自由探索该岛。不过要小心，月族的实力很强，冤枉他们可不是什么明智之举。 [shi de 。 nin ke yi zi you tan suo gai dao 。 bu guo yao xiao xin ， yue zu de shi li hen qiang ， yuan wang ta men ke bu shi shen me ming zhi zhi ju 。]

english: Thanks, I'll keep that seal of passage close.
translation: 谢谢，我会保持通道密封。 [xie xie ， wo hui bao chi tong dao mi feng 。]

english: Aye-aye cap'n!
translation: 是的，船长！ [shi de ， chuan zhang ！]

english: Hmmmm? I don't recognise you as one of my men, what are you doing aboard my ship?
translation: 嗯嗯？我不认为你是我的手下之一，你在我的船上做什么？ [n n ？ wo bu ren wei ni shi wo de shou xia zhi yi ， ni zai wo de chuan shang zuo shen me ？]

english: Stowaway! Stowaway! *Squark*
translation: 偷渡者！偷渡者！ *夸克* [tou du zhe ！ tou du zhe ！ * kua ke *]

english: Oh, Lokar offered me a journey. He said you could take me to the island of the Moon Clan.
translation: 哦，洛卡为我提供了一次旅程。他说你可以带我去月族岛。 [o ， luo ka wei wo ti gong le yi ci lv cheng 。 ta shuo ni ke yi dai wo qu yue zu dao 。]

english: Oh he DID, did he? (sigh) I sometimes regret ever allowing that vagabond to join the crew.
translation: 哦，他做到了，是吗？ （叹气）我有时会后悔让那个流浪汉加入剧组。 [o ， ta zuo dao le ， shi ma ？ （ tan qi ） wo you shi hui hou hui rang na ge liu lang han jia ru ju zu 。]

english: He has a very bad work ethic, and I have to say his attitude can be very confrontational.
translation: 他的职业道德非常差，我不得不说他的态度非常具有对抗性。 [ta de zhi ye dao de fei chang cha ， wo bu de bu shuo ta de tai du fei chang ju you dui kang xing 。]

english: Lokar's a loser! *Brakawk*!
translation: 洛卡是个失败者！ *布拉考克*！ [luo ka shi ge shi bai zhe ！ * bu la kao ke *！]

english: So... You won't take me to Lunar Isle?
translation: 那么……你不带我去月岛吗？ [na me …… ni bu dai wo qu yue dao ma ？]

english: Well now, I didn't say that.
translation: 好吧，我没那么说。 [hao ba ， wo mei na me shuo 。]

english: We are returning there again soon anyway, as our last visit was most profitable.
translation: 无论如何，我们很快就会再次回到那里，因为我们上次的访问是最有利可图的。 [wu lun ru he ， wo men hen kuai jiu hui zai ci hui dao na li ， yin wei wo men shang ci de fang wen shi zui you li ke tu de 。]

english: In fact as soon as our boys are finished loading stocks we should be ready to depart!
translation: 事实上，一旦我们的人员装载完库存，我们就应该准备出发了！ [shi shi shang ， yi dan wo men de ren yuan zhuang zai wan ku cun ， wo men jiu ying gai zhun bei chu fa le ！]

english: Now, as captain of this ship I feel I must play host, even if you aren't exactly a welcome guest, so was there anything you wished to know?
translation: 现在，作为这艘船的船长，我觉得我必须担任东道主，即使您并不是一位受欢迎的客人，那么您有什么想知道的吗？ [xian zai ， zuo wei zhe sou chuan de chuan zhang ， wo jue de wo bi xu dan ren dong dao zhu ， ji shi nin bing bu shi yi wei shou huan ying de ke ren ， na me nin you shen me xiang zhi dao de ma ？]

english: So... What can you tell me about this 'Moon Clan'? It all seems very mysterious I must say...
translation: 那么……你能告诉我关于这个‘月族’的事吗？我必须说，这一切看起来都很神秘...... [na me …… ni neng gao su wo guan yu zhe ge ‘ yue zu ’ de shi ma ？ wo bi xu shuo ， zhe yi qie kan qi lai dou hen shen mi ......]

english: The Moon Clan? Oh, very fine people. Very hospitable.
translation: 月族？哦，非常好的人。非常热情好客。 [yue zu ？ o ， fei chang hao de ren 。 fei chang re qing hao ke 。]

english: We had heard that they are very wary of strangers, and dislike people just showing up on their island, but when we sent a landing party aboard they all seemed more than happy to see us.
translation: 我们听说他们对陌生人非常警惕，并且不喜欢人们出现在他们的岛上，但是当我们派出登陆队上船时，他们似乎都很高兴见到我们。 [wo men ting shuo ta men dui mo sheng ren fei chang jing ti ， bing qie bu xi huan ren men chu xian zai ta men de dao shang ， dan shi dang wo men pai chu deng lu dui shang chuan shi ， ta men si hu dou hen gao xing jian dao wo men 。]

english: Well, they even threw a big festival in our honour!
translation: 好吧，他们甚至为我们举办了一个盛大的节日！ [hao ba ， ta men shen zhi wei wo men ju ban le yi ge sheng da de jie ri ！]

english: Anyway, they had a large supply of items that we felt we could use on the high seas, so we made a few trades with them, and were on our way.
translation: 不管怎样，他们有大量我们认为可以在公海上使用的物品，所以我们与他们做了一些交易，然后就上路了。 [bu guan zen yang ， ta men you da liang wo men ren wei ke yi zai gong hai shang shi yong de wu pin ， suo yi wo men yu ta men zuo le yi xie jiao yi ， ran hou jiu shang lu le 。]

english: What kinds of items?
translation: 什么样的物品？ [shen me yang de wu pin ？]

english: Well, I'm not sure how much you've heard about them, but they are magical experts.
translation: 好吧，我不确定你对他们有多少了解，但他们是魔法专家。 [hao ba ， wo bu que ding ni dui ta men you duo shao liao jie ， dan ta men shi mo fa zhuan jia 。]

english: They sold us many rune-stones, as well as a few good luck charms and talismans and such to help us on our voyage.
translation: 他们卖给我们很多符文石，还有一些幸运符和护身符之类的东西，以帮助我们顺利航行。 [ta men mai gei wo men hen duo fu wen shi ， hai you yi xie xing yun fu he hu shen fu zhi lei de dong xi ， yi bang zhu wo men shun li hang xing 。]

english: Yes, they might have been a little secretive about that strange temple, and the old lodge of theirs in town, and I must say they certainly have the strangest house I have ever seen in my life in their little village, but it was
translation: 是的，他们可能对那座奇怪的寺庙和他们在城里的旧小屋有点保密，我必须说，他们确实拥有我一生中在他们的小村庄里见过的最奇怪的房子，但它是 [shi de ， ta men ke neng dui na zuo qi guai de si miao he ta men zai cheng li de jiu xiao wu you dian bao mi ， wo bi xu shuo ， ta men que shi yong you wo yi sheng zhong zai ta men de xiao cun zhuang li jian guo de zui qi guai de fang zi ， dan ta shi]

english: a pleasant trip all round, and I look forward to trading there again in the future.
translation: 总的来说，这是一次愉快的旅行，我期待着将来再次在那里进行交易。 [zong de lai shuo ， zhe shi yi ci yu kuai de lv xing ， wo qi dai zhe jiang lai zai ci zai na li jin xing jiao yi 。]

english: After all, it's not everywhere that a pirate captain and his crew can rest ashore without having to worry about the authorities catching them, is it?
translation: 毕竟，海盗船长和他的船员并不是在任何地方都可以在岸上休息而不必担心当局抓住他们，不是吗？ [bi jing ， hai dao chuan zhang he ta de chuan yuan bing bu shi zai ren he di fang dou ke yi zai an shang xiu xi er bu bi dan xin dang ju zhua zhu ta men ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Fight the law! *Squawk*
translation: 与法律作斗争！ *发牢骚* [yu fa lv zuo dou zheng ！ * fa lao sao *]

english: No, I guess it isn't.
translation: 不，我想不是。 [bu ， wo xiang bu shi 。]

english: Was there anything else you wished to ask me about while I'm not busy?
translation: 在我不忙的时候你还有什么想问我的吗？ [zai wo bu mang de shi hou ni hai you shen me xiang wen wo de ma ？]

english: What were you doing at Lunar Isle anyway? I always thought pirates would be... You know. Out pirating.
translation: 你到底去月岛做什么了？我一直以为海盗会是……你知道的。出盗版了 [ni dao di qu yue dao zuo shen me le ？ wo yi zhi yi wei hai dao hui shi …… ni zhi dao de 。 chu dao ban le]

english: Well, obviously the actual pirating is a big part of our agenda, but we like to think of ourselves as non-regulated merchants.
translation: 嗯，显然，实际的盗版是我们议程的重要组成部分，但我们喜欢将自己视为不受监管的商人。 [n ， xian ran ， shi ji de dao ban shi wo men yi cheng de zhong yao zu cheng bu fen ， dan wo men xi huan jiang zi ji shi wei bu shou jian guan de shang ren 。]

english: What is good plunder if you have nothing to spend it on, hmmmm?
translation: 如果你没有什么可花的，那么什么是好的掠夺呢，嗯？ [ru guo ni mei you shen me ke hua de ， na me shen me shi hao de lve duo ne ， n ？]

english: Likewise, I am a forward thinking captain, and endeavour to invest much of my plunder back into the ship and its crew, so that we can be a better and more efficient force for theft upon the seas.
translation: 同样，我是一位有远见的船长，并努力将我的大部分掠夺物投入到船上及其船员身上，以便我们能够成为海上盗窃的更好和更有效的力量。 [tong yang ， wo shi yi wei you yuan jian de chuan zhang ， bing nu li jiang wo de da bu fen lve duo wu tou ru dao chuan shang ji qi chuan yuan shen shang ， yi bian wo men neng gou cheng wei hai shang dao qie de geng hao he geng you xiao de li liang 。]

english: So you went to Lunar Isle for supplies?
translation: 所以你去月岛取补给了？ [suo yi ni qu yue dao qu bu ji le ？]

english: Well, obviously not initially. Obviously, our first thought was to show up, rob them blind, then take off again with the plunder spilling from our decks.
translation: 嗯，显然最初不是。显然，我们的第一个想法是出现，盲目抢劫他们，然后带着战利品从我们的甲板上洒落再次起飞。 [n ， xian ran zui chu bu shi 。 xian ran ， wo men de di yi ge xiang fa shi chu xian ， mang mu qiang jie ta men ， ran hou dai zhe zhan li pin cong wo men de jia ban shang sa luo zai ci qi fei 。]

english: So what made you change your mind?
translation: 那么是什么让你改变了主意呢？ [na me shi shen me rang ni gai bian le zhu yi ne ？]

english: Well, firstly there were the monsters.
translation: 嗯，首先是怪物。 [n ， shou xian shi guai wu 。]

english: M-monsters?
translation: M怪物？ [M guai wu ？]

english: Oh yes, hundreds of the things. The island's swarming with them you know.
translation: 哦，是的，有数百种东西。你知道，岛上挤满了它们。 [o ， shi de ， you shu bai zhong dong xi 。 ni zhi dao ， dao shang ji man le ta men 。]

english: Dirty smelly beasts, as big as a wolf! Yes, you'd certainly better be either handy with a blade or quick on your toes if you wanted to spend much time outside of their village with those things around
translation: 又脏又臭的野兽，大如狼！是的，如果你想在村外花很多时间与周围的东西相处，你当然最好要么熟练地使用刀片，要么敏捷地保持脚趾 [you zang you chou de ye shou ， da ru lang ！ shi de ， ru guo ni xiang zai cun wai hua hen duo shi jian yu zhou wei de dong xi xiang chu ， ni dang ran zui hao yao me shu lian di shi yong dao pian ， yao me min jie di bao chi jiao zhi]

english: everywhere.
translation: 到处。 [dao chu 。]

english: *Squawk* Run fer yer lives lads, it's a monster! *Squawk*
translation: *尖叫*小伙子们，逃命吧，这是一个怪物！ *发牢骚* [* jian jiao * xiao huo zi men ， tao ming ba ， zhe shi yi ge guai wu ！ * fa lao sao *]

english: So you didn't attack the Moon Clan because you were worried you would yourself be attacked by these monsters trying to make your escape?
translation: 所以你没有攻击月族，是因为你担心自己会被这些试图逃跑的怪物袭击？ [suo yi ni mei you gong ji yue zu ， shi yin wei ni dan xin zi ji hui bei zhe xie shi tu tao pao de guai wu xi ji ？]

english: Oh yes, absolutely. That and the next reason.
translation: 哦，是的，绝对是。那个和下一个原因。 [o ， shi de ， jue dui shi 。 na ge he xia yi ge yuan yin 。]

english: The next reason?
translation: 下一个原因是？ [xia yi ge yuan yin shi ？]

english: Yes, the next reason being that the Moon Clan are quite stupendously powerful magicians.
translation: 是的，第二个原因就是月族是非常强大的魔法师。 [shi de ， di er ge yuan yin jiu shi yue zu shi fei chang qiang da de mo fa shi 。]

english: You'll notice it as soon as you look at them, really quite, quite powerful indeed.
translation: 你一看就知道了，确实非常非常强大。 [ni yi kan jiu zhi dao le ， que shi fei chang fei chang qiang da 。]

english: As soon as we saw them we lost any thoughts about trying to attack or steal from them.
translation: 当我们看到他们的时候，我们就不再想攻击他们或者偷窃他们的东西了。 [dang wo men kan dao ta men de shi hou ， wo men jiu bu zai xiang gong ji ta men huo zhe tou qie ta men de dong xi le 。]

english: Which as it turned out was very lucky for us.
translation: 事实证明这对我们来说非常幸运。 [shi shi zheng ming zhe dui wo men lai shuo fei chang xing yun 。]

english: Bunch of blooming loonies! *Brakawk*
translation: 一群盛开的疯子！ *布拉考克* [yi qun sheng kai de feng zi ！ * bu la kao ke *]

english: It was?
translation: 是吗？ [shi ma ？]

english: Oh yes. They can read minds, you see. If we'd shown up there thinking about robbing them they would have just killed us all on the spot.
translation: 哦是的。你看，他们可以读心术。如果我们出现在那里想抢劫他们，他们就会当场把我们全部杀掉。 [o shi de 。 ni kan ， ta men ke yi du xin shu 。 ru guo wo men chu xian zai na li xiang qiang jie ta men ， ta men jiu hui dang chang ba wo men quan bu sha diao 。]

english: I did mention that they are extraordinarily powerful magicians, didn't I?
translation: 我确实说过他们是非常强大的魔法师，不是吗？ [wo que shi shuo guo ta men shi fei chang qiang da de mo fa shi ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Yes, yes you did.
translation: 是的，是的，你做到了。 [shi de ， shi de ， ni zuo dao le 。]

english: Ah, I'm glad I did. Because they really, really are. And mind-readers.
translation: 啊，我很高兴我这么做了。因为他们确实、确实如此。还有读心术。 [a ， wo hen gao xing wo zhe me zuo le 。 yin wei ta men que shi 、 que shi ru ci 。 hai you du xin shu 。]

english: Yes, all in all I'm glad we didn't try any funny business in the end after all.
translation: 是的，总而言之，我很高兴我们最终没有尝试任何有趣的事情。 [shi de ， zong er yan zhi ， wo hen gao xing wo men zui zhong mei you chang shi ren he you qu de shi qing 。]

english: Plus there's that other good reason.
translation: 另外还有其他充分的理由。 [ling wai hai you qi ta chong fen de li you 。]

english: That reason being?
translation: 那个原因是？ [na ge yuan yin shi ？]

english: Well, when you are a crew of successful pirates, it becomes more and more difficult to ever moor somewhere and spend your loot.
translation: 好吧，当你是一群成功的海盗时，停泊在某个地方并花掉你的战利品就变得越来越困难。 [hao ba ， dang ni shi yi qun cheng gong de hai dao shi ， ting bo zai mou ge di fang bing hua diao ni de zhan li pin jiu bian de yue lai yue kun nan 。]

english: People are far too quick to call the guards on a troublemaker nowadays.
translation: 如今，人们总是太快地向警卫举报麻烦制造者。 [ru jin ， ren men zong shi tai kuai di xiang jing wei ju bao ma fan zhi zao zhe 。]

english: So finding a village where people are more than happy to trade with you regardless of who you may have just stolen from and killed.
translation: 因此，找到一个人们非常乐意与你进行交易的村庄，无论你刚刚偷了谁或杀了谁。 [yin ci ， zhao dao yi ge ren men fei chang le yi yu ni jin xing jiao yi de cun zhuang ， wu lun ni gang gang tou le shui huo sha le shui 。]

english: I like that non-judgemental attitude of theirs!
translation: 我喜欢他们那种不评判的态度！ [wo xi huan ta men na zhong bu ping pan de tai du ！]

english: Okay then...
translation: 好吧，那么... [hao ba ， na me ...]

english: Anything ese you wanted to know before we set sail?
translation: 在我们启航之前您想知道什么吗？ [zai wo men qi hang zhi qian nin xiang zhi dao shen me ma ？]

english: I was hoping you could tell me a little bit about your ship. I must say, it's really very impressive.
translation: 我希望你能告诉我一些关于你的船的信息。我必须说，这确实令人印象深刻。 [wo xi wang ni neng gao su wo yi xie guan yu ni de chuan de xin xi 。 wo bi xu shuo ， zhe que shi ling ren yin xiang shen ke 。]

english: Ah, a connoisseur! Yes, she's name the Lady Zay, and may I say, is one of the finest ships to ever sail the seas!
translation: 啊，一个鉴赏家！是的，她的名字是扎伊夫人号，我可以说，她是有史以来航行在海上的最好的船只之一！ [a ， yi ge jian shang jia ！ shi de ， ta de ming zi shi zha yi fu ren hao ， wo ke yi shuo ， ta shi you shi yi lai hang xing zai hai shang de zui hao de chuan zhi zhi yi ！]

english: It was a steal from the Karamjan shipyards.
translation: 这是从卡拉姆詹造船厂偷来的。 [zhe shi cong ka la mu zhan zao chuan chang tou lai de 。]

english: And when I say it was a steal, I mean to say that myself and some of the lads broke in and stole it one night.
translation: 当我说这是一次偷窃时，我的意思是我自己和一些小伙子有一天晚上闯入并偷走了它。 [dang wo shuo zhe shi yi ci tou qie shi ， wo de yi si shi wo zi ji he yi xie xiao huo zi you yi tian wan shang chuang ru bing tou zou le ta 。]

english: I don't know who they were building these warships for, but whoever it was seemed to be a little on the short side.
translation: 我不知道他们是为谁建造这些战舰，但无论是谁，似乎都有点亏了。 [wo bu zhi dao ta men shi wei shui jian zao zhe xie zhan jian ， dan wu lun shi shui ， si hu dou you dian kui le 。]

english: We had to do a little remodelling of the doors and rooms so that we didn't have to crouch around everywhere, but I've finally got her just how I want her, and we have enough cannons down below decks to
translation: 我们必须对门和房间进行一些改造，这样我们就不必到处蹲着，但我终于按照我想要的方式得到了她，而且我们在甲板下有足够的大炮 [wo men bi xu dui men he fang jian jin xing yi xie gai zao ， zhe yang wo men jiu bu bi dao chu dun zhe ， dan wo zhong yu an zhao wo xiang yao de fang shi de dao le ta ， er qie wo men zai jia ban xia you zu gou de da pao]

english: bombard a small town I'd wager!
translation: 我敢打赌，轰炸一个小镇！ [wo gan da du ， hong zha yi ge xiao zhen ！]

english: *Brawwwwwwk* I want guns, lots of guns! I want guns, lots of guns!
translation: *Brawwwwk* 我想要枪，很多枪！我想要枪，很多枪！ [*Brawwwwk*  wo xiang yao qiang ， hen duo qiang ！ wo xiang yao qiang ， hen duo qiang ！]

english: I used to own my own ship you know...
translation: 我曾经拥有自己的船，你知道... [wo ceng jing yong you zi ji de chuan ， ni zhi dao ...]

english: It was called the Lady Lumbridge if I remember correctly...
translation: 如果我没记错的话，它的名字叫“朗布里奇女士”…… [ru guo wo mei ji cuo de hua ， ta de ming zi jiao “ lang bu li qi nv shi ”……]

english: I wonder whatever happened to it...
translation: 我想知道这是怎么回事... [wo xiang zhi dao zhe shi zen me hui shi ...]

english: Interesting. You never struck me as being Captain material, but I guess there's a ship out there for everyone...
translation: 有趣的。我从来没有觉得你是当船长的料，但我想每个人都有一艘适合的船...... [you qu de 。 wo cong lai mei you jue de ni shi dang chuan zhang de liao ， dan wo xiang mei ge ren dou you yi sou shi he de chuan ......]

english: The Lady Zay is certainly a big step up from my last ship anyway.
translation: 无论如何，扎伊女士号肯定比我的上一艘船进步了一大步。 [wu lun ru he ， zha yi nv shi hao ken ding bi wo de shang yi sou chuan jin bu le yi da bu 。]

english: Your last ship? Why, what was wrong with it?
translation: 你的最后一艘船？为什么，出了什么问题？ [ni de zui hou yi sou chuan ？ wei shen me ， chu le shen me wen ti ？]

english: Well, it just wasn't sturdy enough!
translation: 嗯，只是不够坚固！ [n ， zhi shi bu gou jian gu ！]

english: I was on a perfectly routine raiding expedition to the east of here, when we ran into a squall, that pushed us towards the rocky shore.
translation: 我正在这里东边进行一次例行的突袭探险，当时我们遇到了一场暴风雨，把我们推向了岩石海岸。 [wo zheng zai zhe li dong bian jin xing yi ci li xing de tu xi tan xian ， dang shi wo men yu dao le yi chang bao feng yu ， ba wo men tui xiang le yan shi hai an 。]

english: A few select men and myself managed to escape with our lives intact on a small row boat, but the rest of my crew were washed ashore as the ship was wrecked on those jagged rocks.
translation: 我和几名精挑细选的人设法在一艘小划艇上毫发无伤地逃脱，但当船在那些锯齿状的岩石上失事时，我的其他船员被冲上岸。 [wo he ji ming jing tiao xi xuan de ren she fa zai yi sou xiao hua ting shang hao fa wu shang di tao tuo ， dan dang chuan zai na xie ju chi zhuang de yan shi shang shi shi shi ， wo de qi ta chuan yuan bei chong shang an 。]

english: Ah yes, it was a tragedy...
translation: 啊，是的，这是一场悲剧…… [a ， shi de ， zhe shi yi chang bei ju ……]

english: To lose such a fine ship in such an insulting manner...
translation: 以如此侮辱性的方式失去一艘如此优秀的船...... [yi ru ci wu ru xing de fang shi shi qu yi sou ru ci you xiu de chuan ......]

english: And of course the rest of your crew...
translation: 当然还有你的其他船员...... [dang ran hai you ni de qi ta chuan yuan ......]

english: Who? Oh. Yes. The crew. Yes, it was a tragedy.
translation: WHO？哦。是的。船员们。是的，这是一场悲剧。 [WHO？ o 。 shi de 。 chuan yuan men 。 shi de ， zhe shi yi chang bei ju 。]

english: I'd paid them in advance you know, I'll never see that money again!
translation: 我已经提前付给他们了，你知道，我再也见不到那笔钱了！ [wo yi jing ti qian fu gei ta men le ， ni zhi dao ， wo zai ye jian bu dao na bi qian le ！]

english: Um... no, I actually meant it was a shame that so many of your crew must have died in the shipwreck.
translation: 嗯……不，我实际上的意思是，你们这么多船员一定在海难中丧生，这真是一种耻辱。 [n …… bu ， wo shi ji shang de yi si shi ， ni men zhe me duo chuan yuan yi ding zai hai nan zhong sang sheng ， zhe zhen shi yi zhong chi ru 。]

english: Was it? Well, if you say so.
translation: 是吗？好吧，如果你这么说的话。 [shi ma ？ hao ba ， ru guo ni zhe me shuo de hua 。]

english: Actually, the last I had heard quite a few of them had survived, and had set up a little hideaway in the remains of the shipwreck.
translation: 事实上，据我所知，他们中有不少人幸存下来，并在沉船残骸中建立了一个小小的藏身之处。 [shi shi shang ， ju wo suo zhi ， ta men zhong you bu shao ren xing cun xia lai ， bing zai chen chuan can hai zhong jian li le yi ge xiao xiao de cang shen zhi chu 。]

english: If you're particularly worried about the, perhaps you might like to go and pay them a visit someday, and make sure to bring a lot of easily transferable wealth with you.
translation: 如果您特别担心，也许您可​​能希望有一天去拜访他们，并确保随身携带大量易于转移的财富。 [ru guo nin te bie dan xin ， ye xu nin ke ​​ neng xi wang you yi tian qu bai fang ta men ， bing que bao sui shen xie dai da liang yi yu zhuan yi de cai fu 。]

english: They love people visiting with easily transferable wealth.
translation: 他们喜欢那些拥有易于转移财富的人。 [ta men xi huan na xie yong you yi yu zhuan yi cai fu de ren 。]

english: Now, was there something you wished to talk to me about? Time is pressing on, and we really need to set sail soon if we want to make the most of the winds.
translation: 现在，你有什么想和我谈谈的吗？时间紧迫，要想充分利用风势，我们确实需要尽快起航。 [xian zai ， ni you shen me xiang he wo tan tan de ma ？ shi jian jin po ， yao xiang chong fen li yong feng shi ， wo men que shi xu yao jin kuai qi hang 。]

english: *Squawk* Move it or lose it, move it or lose it.
translation: *尖叫*移动它或丢失它，移动它或丢失它。 [* jian jiao * yi dong ta huo diu shi ta ， yi dong ta huo diu shi ta 。]

english: Can we sail to Lunar Isle now? I must say, it all sounds very intriguing over there...
translation: 我们现在可以航行到月岛吗？我必须说，这一切听起来都很有趣...... [wo men xian zai ke yi hang xing dao yue dao ma ？ wo bi xu shuo ， zhe yi qie ting qi lai dou hen you qu ......]

english: As long as you keep your Seal Of Passage with you at all times while you are on the island you should be okay, even if you are a Femennik.
translation: 只要您在岛上时始终随身携带通行印章，就应该没问题，即使您是女性。 [zhi yao nin zai dao shang shi shi zhong sui shen xie dai tong xing yin zhang ， jiu ying gai mei wen ti ， ji shi nin shi nv xing 。]

english: I'm not kidding, they are a very dangerous people, and it would NOT be wise for you to travel there without your Seal Of Passage marking you as a diplomat.
translation: 我不是在开玩笑，他们是非常危险的民族，如果没有将您标记为外交官的通行印章，您去那里旅行是不明智的。 [wo bu shi zai kai wan xiao ， ta men shi fei chang wei xian de min zu ， ru guo mei you jiang nin biao ji wei wai jiao guan de tong xing yin zhang ， nin qu na li lv xing shi bu ming zhi de 。]

english: Okay, keep my Seal with me at all times, check. Can we go now?
translation: 好的，请始终随身携带我的印章，检查一下。我们现在可以走了吗？ [hao de ， qing shi zhong sui shen xie dai wo de yin zhang ， jian cha yi xia 。 wo men xian zai ke yi zou le ma ？]

english: Ah, yes indeed! The winds seem good, so let's make a move!
translation: 啊，确实如此！风看起来不错，所以我们行动吧！ [a ， que shi ru ci ！ feng kan qi lai bu cuo ， suo yi wo men xing dong ba ！]

english: She's blowing a storm, cap'n! *Brarrrrrk*
translation: 她正在掀起一场风暴，船长！ *咕噜咕噜* [ta zheng zai xian qi yi chang feng bao ， chuan zhang ！ * gu lu gu lu *]

english: Well... THAT was deuced strange!
translation: 嗯……这很奇怪！ [n …… zhe hen qi guai ！]

english: Um... Way to sail a boat?
translation: 嗯...如何驾船？ [n ... ru he jia chuan ？]

english: *Squawk* Way to sail a boat! Way to sail a boat! *Brarrrk*
translation: *尖叫*开船的方式！开船的方式！ *咕噜* [* jian jiao * kai chuan de fang shi ！ kai chuan de fang shi ！ * gu lu *]

english: This... This is VERY strange!
translation: 这……这太奇怪了！ [zhe …… zhe tai qi guai le ！]

english: Well, I would be more than happy to take you, unfortunately the Moon Clan are, frankly, very scary people, and I believe they would not take kindly to us bringing a Fremennik there.
translation: 好吧，我很乐意带你去，不幸的是，坦率地说，月亮族是非常可怕的人，我相信他们不会善待我们带一个弗雷曼尼克去那里。 [hao ba ， wo hen le yi dai ni qu ， bu xing de shi ， tan shuai di shuo ， yue liang zu shi fei chang ke pa de ren ， wo xiang xin ta men bu hui shan dai wo men dai yi ge fu lei man ni ke qu na li 。]

english: They are at war with them after all.
translation: 毕竟他们正在与他们交战。 [bi jing ta men zheng zai yu ta men jiao zhan 。]

english: But I thought Lokar had already been there?
translation: 但我以为洛卡已经在那里了？ [dan wo yi wei luo ka yi jing zai na li le ？]

english: Yes. Yes he has. I'm talking about you.
translation: 是的。是的，他有。我正在谈论你。 [shi de 。 shi de ， ta you 。 wo zheng zai tan lun ni 。]

english: Oh. Oh yeah, I'm a Fremennik aren't I?
translation: 哦。哦，是的，我是弗雷曼尼克，不是吗？ [o 。 o ， shi de ， wo shi fu lei man ni ke ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Yes, yes you are.
translation: 是的，是的，你是。 [shi de ， shi de ， ni shi 。]

english: I probably should have kept that Seal Of Passage Brundt the Chieftain gave me with me, shouldn't I?
translation: 我也许应该保留酋长布伦特给我的通道印章，不是吗？ [wo ye xu ying gai bao liu qiu zhang bu lun te gei wo de tong dao yin zhang ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Yes, yes you should have. Honestly, you're going to need it with you.
translation: 是的，是的，你应该有。老实说，你会需要它。 [shi de ， shi de ， ni ying gai you 。 lao shi shuo ， ni hui xu yao ta 。]

english: I'm afraid I can't let you travel with us without it.

english: Who?

translation: 我们的导航员。他在船的后部，甲板下一层。他是一只戴着棕色海盗帽的老水手。 [wo men de dao hang yuan 。 ta zai chuan de hou bu ， jia ban xia yi ceng 。 ta shi yi zhi dai zhe zong se hai dao mao de lao shui shou 。]

translation: 船第二次绕海盗湾航行 [chuan di er ci rao hai dao wan hang xing]

translation: 所以我们到了？ [suo yi wo men dao le ？]

english: Can you tell me something about the Moon Clan?
translation: 你能告诉我一些关于月族的事情吗？ [ni neng gao su wo yi xie guan yu yue zu de shi qing ma ？]

english: What were you doing at Lunar Isle?
translation: 你去月岛做什么？ [ni qu yue dao zuo shen me ？]

english: Can you tell me something about your ship?

english: Can we sail to Lunar Isle now?
translation: 我们现在可以航行到月岛吗？ [wo men xian zai ke yi hang xing dao yue dao ma ？]

translation: 欢迎来到侏儒空气！ [huan ying lai dao zhu ru kong qi ！]

translation: Gnome Air 是吉利诺最好的航空公司！ [Gnome Air  shi ji li nuo zui hao de hang kong gong si ！]

english: Well...it's the only real airline in Gielinor.
translation: 嗯...这是吉林诺唯一一家真正的航空公司。 [n ... zhe shi ji lin nuo wei yi yi jia zhen zheng de hang kong gong si 。]

english: Ha!
translation: 哈! [ha !]

english: Oh we have a whole network! It's wonderful for getting to hard to reach places.
translation: 哦，我们有一个完整的网络！到达难以到达的地方真是太棒了。 [o ， wo men you yi ge wan zheng de wang luo ！ dao da nan yi dao da de di fang zhen shi tai bang le 。]

translation: 我想你会发现这是侏儒的商业秘密！ [wo xiang ni hui fa xian zhe shi zhu ru de shang ye mi mi ！]

translation: 抱歉，我现在什么都不想要。 [bao qian ， wo xian zai shen me dou bu xiang yao 。]

translation: 恐怕预制菜肴不行。对于 Aluft Aloft 的顾客来说，只有手工制作的 Gnome Cuisine 才足够好。 [kong pa yu zhi cai yao bu xing 。 dui yu  Aluft Aloft  de gu ke lai shuo ， zhi you shou gong zhi zuo de  Gnome Cuisine  cai zu gou hao 。]

translation: 您将[物品]的交付交给布莱马奇船长 [nin jiang [ wu pin ] de jiao fu jiao gei bu lai ma qi chuan zhang]

english: Aahh, the smell of home, there's nothing like it. Thanks.
translation: 啊啊，家的味道，没有什么比得上的。谢谢。 [a a ， jia de wei dao ， mei you shen me bi de shang de 。 xie xie 。]

translation: 您有 [number] 个积分用于免费送货令牌。您可能会收到 [number] 块侏儒食物。 [nin you  [number]  ge ji fen yong yu mian fei song huo ling pai 。 nin ke neng hui shou dao  [number]  kuai zhu ru shi wu 。]

translation: 你的交货太晚了！返回 Aluft jnr。以获得另一个订单。您丢弃了送货箱，因为您不再需要它了。 [ni de jiao huo tai wan le ！ fan hui  Aluft jnr。 yi huo de ling yi ge ding dan 。 nin diu qi le song huo xiang ， yin wei nin bu zai xu yao ta le 。]

english: Hello there, I'm Captain Bruce. Do you want to serve in the Shayzien Army and defend our kingdom?
translation: 大家好，我是布鲁斯船长。你想在 Shayzien 军队服役并保卫我们的王国吗？ [da jia hao ， wo shi bu lu si chuan zhang 。 ni xiang zai  Shayzien  jun dui fu yi bing bao wei wo men de wang guo ma ？]

english: Yes, I'd love to join.
translation: 是的，我很想加入。 [shi de ， wo hen xiang jia ru 。]

english: Wonderful! To get started, you need to answer a few questions.
translation: 精彩的！首先，您需要回答几个问题。 [jing cai de ！ shou xian ， nin xu yao hui da ji ge wen ti 。]

english: Are you a resident of Kourend?
translation: 您是库伦德的居民吗？ [nin shi ku lun de de ju min ma ？]

english: Errrr... Not really.
translation: 呃……不是真的。 [e …… bu shi zhen de 。]

english: Ah. Then you cannot join I'm afraid.
translation: 啊。那你恐怕不能加入。 [a 。 na ni kong pa bu neng jia ru 。]

english: How come?
translation: 怎么会？ [zen me hui ？]

english: It's in the rules I'm afraid. Only citizens of Kourend are allowed to join the Shayzien Army.
translation: 恐怕这是规则里的。只有库伦德公民才可以加入 Shayzien 军队。 [kong pa zhe shi gui ze li de 。 zhi you ku lun de gong min cai ke yi jia ru  Shayzien  jun dui 。]

english: Is that not too restrictive?
translation: 这不是太限制了吗？ [zhe bu shi tai xian zhi le ma ？]

english: Well at one time only citizens of Shayzien could join the army. It wasn't until the reign of King Byrne I that people from other parts of the kingdom were allowed to enlist.
translation: 好吧，曾经只有 Shayzien 的公民才能参军。直到伯恩一世国王统治时期，王国其他地区的人才被允许入伍。 [hao ba ， ceng jing zhi you  Shayzien  de gong min cai neng can jun 。 zhi dao bo en yi shi guo wang tong zhi shi qi ， wang guo qi ta di qu de ren cai bei yun xu ru wu 。]

english: Of course, many people in Kourend still like to stick to tradition. After all, the five cities of Kourend have always had very defined roles within the kingdom.
translation: 当然，Kourend的很多人还是喜欢坚持传统。毕竟，库伦德的五座城市在王国中一直有着非常明确的角色。 [dang ran ，Kourend de hen duo ren hai shi xi huan jian chi chuan tong 。 bi jing ， ku lun de de wu zuo cheng shi zai wang guo zhong yi zhi you zhe fei chang ming que de jue se 。]

translation: 有趣的。那么军队里大部分人还是Shayzien人？ [you qu de 。 na me jun dui li da bu fen ren hai shi Shayzien ren ？]

english: Indeed. While the Shayzien Army is by far the largest military force in Kourend, the other cities still have some form of militia, apart from Arceuus of course.
translation: 的确。虽然 Shayzien 军队是库伦德迄今为止最大的军事力量，但其他城市仍然拥有某种形式的民兵，当然除了阿尔修斯。 [di que 。 sui ran  Shayzien  jun dui shi ku lun de qi jin wei zhi zui da de jun shi li liang ， dan qi ta cheng shi reng ran yong you mou zhong xing shi de min bing ， dang ran chu le a er xiu si 。]

english: Even if someone from elsewhere in the kingdom wants to become a soldier, they're far more likely to join their local city force than come to us.
translation: 即使王国其他地方的人想成为一名士兵，他们也更有可能加入当地的城市部队，而不是加入我们。 [ji shi wang guo qi ta di fang de ren xiang cheng wei yi ming shi bing ， ta men ye geng you ke neng jia ru dang di de cheng shi bu dui ， er bu shi jia ru wo men 。]

english: Still, times are slowly changing. Every year we see more people from outside Shayzien enlist.
translation: 尽管如此，时代仍在慢慢变化。每年我们都会看到更多来自 Shayzien 以外的人参军。 [jin guan ru ci ， shi dai reng zai man man bian hua 。 mei nian wo men du hui kan dao geng duo lai zi  Shayzien  yi wai de ren shen jun 。]

english: I see. Thanks for the information.
translation: 我懂了。感谢您提供信息。 [wo dong le 。 gan xie nin ti gong xin xi 。]

translation: 我的荣幸。 [wo de rong xing 。]

translation: 不，我不感兴趣。 [bu ， wo bu gan xing qu 。]

english: That's alright. Come back if you change your mind.
translation: 没关系。如果你改变主意就回来吧。 [mei guan xi 。 ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi jiu hui lai ba 。]

translation: 来，解决这个问题。 [lai ， jie jue zhe ge wen ti 。]

translation: 布鲁斯船长递给你一个[轻型拼图/拼图]盒子。 [bu lu si chuan zhang di gei ni yi ge [ qing xing pin tu / pin tu ] he zi 。]

translation: 在我看来这并没有解决。 [zai wo kan lai zhe bing mei you jie jue 。]

translation: 不，我不感兴趣。 [bu ， wo bu gan xing qu 。]

english: You'd best introduce yourself first!
translation: 你最好先自我介绍一下！ [ni zui hao xian zi wo jie shao yi xia ！]

english: Hello. What's this place?
translation: 你好。这是什么地方？ [ni hao 。 zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Why you wretched Son-of-a-Big-Nosed-Warty-Smelly- Goblin! How dare you speak to a commanding officer like that?
translation: 为什么你这个可怜的大鼻子疣臭妖精的儿子！你怎么敢对一个指挥官这样说话？ [wei shen me ni zhe ge ke lian de da bi zi you chou yao jing de er zi ！ ni zen me gan dui yi ge zhi hui guan zhe yang shuo hua ？]

What?

translation: 站直！挺胸，肩膀向后！ [zhan zhi ！ ting xiong ， jian bang xiang hou ！]

english: Okay, okay.
translation: 好吧，好吧。 [hao ba ， hao ba 。]

translation: 你就称呼我为队长吧！ [ni jiu cheng hu wo wei dui zhang ba ！]

translation: 是的……是的，队长！ [shi de …… shi de ， dui zhang ！]

english: Better. Now what is a low-life, pathetic excuse for a human being doing sniffing around my arena?
translation: 更好的。现在，一个人在我的竞技场周围嗅来嗅去，还有什么低俗、可悲的借口呢？ [geng hao de 。 xian zai ， yi ge ren zai wo de jing ji chang zhou wei xiu lai xiu qu ， hai you shen me di su 、 ke bei de jie kou ne ？]

english: Very well, make the most of this because I don't suffer idiots easily! This is the Barbarian Assault arena. You want to sign up with us?
translation: 很好，充分利用这一点，因为我不会轻易忍受白痴！这里是野蛮人突击竞技场。您想和我们一起报名吗？ [hen hao ， chong fen li yong zhe yi dian ， yin wei wo bu hui qing yi ren shou bai chi ！ zhe li shi ye man ren tu ji jing ji chang 。 nin xiang he wo men yi qi bao ming ma ？]

english: Sir, yes sir!
translation: 先生，是的先生！ [xian sheng ， shi de xian sheng ！]

english: Then listen closely.
translation: 然后仔细听。 [ran hou zi xi ting 。]

english: Wait a minute! I'm not giving a tutorial to someone carrying that stuff. Use that bank chest over there first!
translation: 等一下！我不会向携带这些东西的人提供教程。先用那边的银行箱子吧！ [deng yi xia ！ wo bu hui xiang xie dai zhe xie dong xi de ren ti gong jiao cheng 。 xian yong na bian de yin hang xiang zi ba ！]

english: You can't enter the game with any food; the Healer will cure you.
translation: 不能携带任何食物进入游戏；治疗师会治愈你。 [bu neng xie dai ren he shi wu jin ru you xi ； zhi liao shi hui zhi yu ni 。]

english: You can't enter the game with any brutal potions or ingredients; the Healer will cure you.
translation: 你不能带着任何残酷的药水或原料进入游戏；治疗师会治愈你。 [ni bu neng dai zhe ren he can ku de yao shui huo yuan liao jin ru you xi ； zhi liao shi hui zhi yu ni 。]

english: There is no reason to take a phoenix necklace into the arena, as you won't lose any items if you die in the minigame.
translation: 没有理由带凤凰项链进入竞技场，因为如果你在小游戏中死亡，你不会失去任何物品。 [mei you li you dai feng huang xiang lian jin ru jing ji chang ， yin wei ru guo ni zai xiao you xi zhong si wang ， ni bu hui shi qu ren he wu pin 。]

english: You can't enter the game with any runes - there are free ones in there.
translation: 你不能使用任何符文进入游戏 - 那里有免费的符文。 [ni bu neng shi yong ren he fu wen jin ru you xi  -  na li you mian fei de fu wen 。]

english: You can't take arrows into a game - there are free ones in there.
translation: 你不能带箭进入游戏——游戏中有免费的箭。 [ni bu neng dai jian jin ru you xi —— you xi zhong you mian fei de jian 。]

english: The barbarians don't want you to take your follower in.
translation: 野蛮人不希望你接纳你的追随者。 [ye man ren bu xi wang ni jie na ni de zhui sui zhe 。]

english: You can't take your own logs with you - you have to use the ones the barbarians provide.
translation: 你不能随身携带自己的日志——你必须使用野蛮人提供的日志。 [ni bu neng sui shen xie dai zi ji de ri zhi —— ni bi xu shi yong ye man ren ti gong de ri zhi 。]

english: The barbarians don't want you using artillery down there.
translation: 野蛮人不希望你在那里使用大炮。 [ye man ren bu xi wang ni zai na li shi yong da pao 。]

english: The barbarians don't trust whatever you may have stored in your looting bag. They won't let you in with it.
translation: 野蛮人不相信你在抢劫包里存放的任何东西。他们不会让你进来的。 [ye man ren bu xiang xin ni zai qiang jie bao li cun fang de ren he dong xi 。 ta men bu hui rang ni jin lai de 。]

english: The barbarians don't want you using Saradomin brews down there. You will have to restore your health as they intend.
translation: 野蛮人不希望你在那里使用萨拉多明啤酒。你必须按照他们的意愿恢复健康。 [ye man ren bu xi wang ni zai na li shi yong sa la duo ming pi jiu 。 ni bi xu an zhao ta men de yi yuan hui fu jian kang 。]

english: Let's skip the training, I'm an expert already.
translation: 我们跳过培训吧，我已经是专家了。 [wo men tiao guo pei xun ba ， wo yi jing shi zhuan jia le 。]

english: Really? You don't look like one. Very well, upon your own head be it, I'll let you skip the training. Come back and speak to me if you find you're not the know-it-all you believe yourself to be.
translation: 真的吗？你看起来不像一个。好吧，就你自己来说，我就让你跳过训练。如果你发现自己并不是你所认为的万事通，请回来跟我说话。 [zhen de ma ？ ni kan qi lai bu xiang yi ge 。 hao ba ， jiu ni zi ji lai shuo ， wo jiu rang ni tiao guo xun lian 。 ru guo ni fa xian zi ji bing bu shi ni suo ren wei de wan shi tong ， qing hui lai gen wo shuo hua 。]

english: Nah, sounds boring.
translation: 不，听起来很无聊。 [bu ， ting qi lai hen wu liao 。]

english: 'Boring'? You'll get nowhere with that kind of attitude! Drop and give me ten!
translation: '无聊的'？以这种态度你将一事无成！放下来给我十个！ [' wu liao de '？ yi zhe zhong tai du ni jiang yi shi wu cheng ！ fang xia lai gei wo shi ge ！]

english: Maybe next time, I need to go wash my hair.
translation: 也许下次，我需要去洗头。 [ye xu xia ci ， wo xu yao qu xi tou 。]

english: You'll do as I say!
translation: 你就按我说的做吧！ [ni jiu an wo shuo de zuo ba ！]

english: Arrrghhh. Okay, okay!
translation: 啊啊啊。好吧好吧！ [a a a 。 hao ba hao ba ！]

english: Good to see you've learned some respect, make it five
translation: 很高兴看到你已经学会了一些尊重，让它成为五个 [hen gao xing kan dao ni yi jing xue hui le yi xie zun zhong ， rang ta cheng wei wu ge]

english: Yes sir!
translation: 是的，先生！ [shi de ， xian sheng ！]

english: But I already did!
translation: 但我已经这么做了！ [dan wo yi jing zhe me zuo le ！]

english: You did?
translation: 你做到了吗？ [ni zuo dao le ma ？]

english: I don't trust you in the slightest. Do as I tell you!
translation: 我一点也不信任你。按我告诉你的做！ [wo yi dian ye bu xin ren ni 。 an wo gao su ni de zuo ！]

english: Hi... I mean, [player name] reporting, sir!
translation: 嗨...我的意思是，[玩家姓名]报道，先生！ [hai ... wo de yi si shi ，[ wan jia xing ming ] bao dao ， xian sheng ！]

english: Straighten that back when you talk to me! You want my help?
translation: 当你跟我说话的时候把它拉直！你需要我的帮助吗？ [dang ni gen wo shuo hua de shi hou ba ta la zhi ！ ni xu yao wo de bang zhu ma ？]

english: Again? Very well. Listen closely this time!
translation: 再次？很好。这次你仔细听听吧！ [zai ci ？ hen hao 。 zhe ci ni zi xi ting ting ba ！]

english: Sir! Could I start at wave one again?
translation: 先生！我可以从第一波重新开始吗？ [xian sheng ！ wo ke yi cong di yi bo chong xin kai shi ma ？]

english: What? Finish with your training first, soldier!
translation: 什么？先完成你的训练吧，士兵！ [shen me ？ xian wan cheng ni de xun lian ba ， shi bing ！]

english: Sir! Can we do some training?
translation: 先生！我们可以做一些培训吗？ [xian sheng ！ wo men ke yi zuo yi xie pei xun ma ？]

english: What do you mean, you are on wave one!
translation: 你是什​​么意思，你在第一波！ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ， ni zai di yi bo ！]

english: Oh, of course, sorry.
translation: 噢，当然，抱歉。 [o ， dang ran ， bao qian 。]

english: Sir, yes sir!
translation: 先生，是的先生！ [xian sheng ， shi de xian sheng ！]

english: Let's skip the training, I'm an expert already.
translation: 我们跳过培训吧，我已经是专家了。 [wo men tiao guo pei xun ba ， wo yi jing shi zhuan jia le 。]

english: Nah, sounds boring.
translation: 不，听起来很无聊。 [bu ， ting qi lai hen wu liao 。]

english: Maybe next time, I need to go wash my hair.
translation: 也许下次，我需要去洗头。 [ye xu xia ci ， wo xu yao qu xi tou 。]

english: But I already did...
translation: 但我已经这么做了... [dan wo yi jing zhe me zuo le ...]

english: Sir! Can we do some training?
translation: 先生！我们可以做一些培训吗？ [xian sheng ！ wo men ke yi zuo yi xie pei xun ma ？]

english: Sir! Could I start at wave one again?
translation: 先生！我可以从第一波重新开始吗？ [xian sheng ！ wo ke yi cong di yi bo chong xin kai shi ma ？]

english: Hello there. What do you need?
translation: 你好呀。你需要什么？ [ni hao ya 。 ni xu yao shen me ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This is one of the lairs of those foul Lizardmen. We've managed to corner these ones so they can't escape.
translation: 这是那些肮脏的蜥蜴人的巢穴之一。我们已经设法把这些人逼到墙角，让他们无法逃脱。 [zhe shi na xie ang zang de xi yi ren de chao xue zhi yi 。 wo men yi jing she fa ba zhe xie ren bi dao qiang jiao ， rang ta men wu fa tao tuo 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Cleive. Captain Cleive. Captain in the Shayzien Guard and renowned slayer.
translation: 克莱夫.克莱夫船长。 Shayzien 卫队队长，著名杀手。 [ke lai fu . ke lai fu chuan zhang 。 Shayzien  wei dui dui zhang ， zhu ming sha shou 。]

english: Renowned?
translation: 著名的？ [zhu ming de ？]

english: Absolutely. I'm part of a great family of slayers. You've probably met a few of them over on the mainland.
translation: 绝对地。我是一个伟大的杀手家族的一员。您可能在大陆见过他们中的一些人。 [jue dui di 。 wo shi yi ge wei da de sha shou jia zu de yi yuan 。 nin ke neng zai da lu jian guo ta men zhong de yi xie ren 。]

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？ [ni wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: We learnt of a group of Lizardman Shamans causing trouble on the surface. I led a taskforce out to drive them back into their lair.
translation: 我们了解到一群蜥蜴人萨满在地表制造麻烦。我带领一支特遣队出去把它们赶回巢穴。 [wo men liao jie dao yi qun xi yi ren sa man zai di biao zhi zao ma fan 。 wo dai ling yi zhi te qian dui chu qu ba ta men gan hui chao xue 。]

english: We suffered many losses but we've now managed to trap them in this cave.
translation: 我们遭受了很多损失，但现在我们已经成功地将他们困在这个山洞里了。 [wo men zao shou le hen duo sun shi ， dan xian zai wo men yi jing cheng gong di jiang ta men kun zai zhe ge shan dong li le 。]

english: We've lost too many men to be able to finish them off but I'm happy for someone else to do it if I feel they're worthy of the challenge.
translation: 我们失去了太多的人，无法消灭他们，但如果我觉得他们值得挑战，我很高兴有人能做到这一点。 [wo men shi qu le tai duo de ren ， wu fa xiao mie ta men ， dan ru guo wo jue de ta men zhi de tiao zhan ， wo hen gao xing you ren neng zuo dao zhe yi dian 。]

english: Can I fight these Lizardmen?
translation: 我能和这些蜥蜴人战斗吗？ [wo neng he zhe xie xi yi ren zhan dou ma ？]

english: Perhaps. I've lost too many men to be able to kill them myself but I'm happy for someone else to do it if I feel they're worthy of the challenge.
translation: 也许。我失去了太多的人，我自己无法杀死他们，但如果我觉得他们值得挑战，我很高兴有人能做到这一点。 [ye xu 。 wo shi qu le tai duo de ren ， wo zi ji wu fa sha si ta men ， dan ru guo wo jue de ta men zhi de tiao zhan ， wo hen gao xing you ren neng zuo dao zhe yi dian 。]

english: What do you define as worthy?
translation: 你定义什么是有价值的？ [ni ding yi shen me shi you jia zhi de ？]

english: You'll need to be favoured by the people of Shayzien. You'll also need to be on a Lizardman Slayer task.
translation: 你需要得到 Shayzien 人民的青睐。您还需要执行蜥蜴人杀手任务。 [ni xu yao de dao  Shayzien  ren min de qing lai 。 nin hai xu yao zhi xing xi yi ren sha shou ren wu 。]

english: Can I use my slayer helm instead of a Shayzien helm?
translation: 我可以使用我的杀手头盔代替 Shayzien 头盔吗？ [wo ke yi shi yong wo de sha shou tou kui dai ti  Shayzien  tou kui ma ？]

english: Yes that is possible, however I only show the required technique to those who have proved themselves a friend to Kourend.
translation: 是的，这是可能的，但是我只向那些已经证明自己是库伦德朋友的人展示所需的技术。 [shi de ， zhe shi ke neng de ， dan shi wo zhi xiang na xie yi jing zheng ming zi ji shi ku lun de peng you de ren zhan shi suo xu de ji shu 。]

english: How do I prove that I am a friend to Kourend?
translation: 我如何证明我是 Kourend 的朋友？ [wo ru he zheng ming wo shi  Kourend  de peng you ？]

english: You'll need to complete the Hard tier of the Kourend & Kebos Achievement Diary and have earned the tier five Shayzien helm.
translation: 您需要完成 Kourend & Kebos 成就日记的困难级别，并获得五级 Shayzien 头盔。 [nin xu yao wan cheng  Kourend & Kebos  cheng jiu ri ji de kun nan ji bie ， bing huo de wu ji  Shayzien  tou kui 。]

english: I don't meet those requirements. I'll be back when I do though.
translation: 我不符合这些要求。当我这样做时我会回来的。 [wo bu fu he zhe xie yao qiu 。 dang wo zhe yang zuo shi wo hui hui lai de 。]

english: I have that completed! Can you show me the special technique now?
translation: 我已经完成了！现在可以给我展示一下特殊技术吗？ [wo yi jing wan cheng le ！ xian zai ke yi gei wo zhan shi yi xia te shu ji shu ma ？]

english: Of course!
translation: 当然！ [dang ran ！]

english: Captain Clieve teaches you the secret technique. Any slayer helm will now offer the same protection against lizardman as a shayzien helm (5).
translation: 克莱夫船长教你秘密技术。现在，任何杀手头盔都将提供与 Shayzien 头盔相同的针对蜥蜴人的保护 (5)。 [ke lai fu chuan zhang jiao ni mi mi ji shu 。 xian zai ， ren he sha shou tou kui dou jiang ti gong yu  Shayzien  tou kui xiang tong de zhen dui xi yi ren de bao hu  (5)。]

english: I have already shown you that secret technique.
translation: 我已经向你展示了那个秘密技术。 [wo yi jing xiang ni zhan shi le na ge mi mi ji shu 。]

english: Hey! These lizardmen aren't just for anyone. Come back when you have the right Slayer task!
translation: 嘿！这些蜥蜴人不只适合任何人。当你有正确的杀手任务时回来吧！ [hei ！ zhe xie xi yi ren bu zhi shi he ren he ren 。 dang ni you zheng que de sha shou ren wu shi hui lai ba ！]

english: Captain Clieve wants you to stick to your Slayer assignments.
translation: 克莱夫船长希望你坚持你的杀手任务。 [ke lai fu chuan zhang xi wang ni jian chi ni de sha shou ren wu 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？ [ni wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: Can I fight these Lizardmen?
translation: 我能和这些蜥蜴人战斗吗？ [wo neng he zhe xie xi yi ren zhan dou ma ？]

english: Can I use my Slayer helm instead of a Shayzien helm?
translation: 我可以使用 Slayer 头盔代替 Shayzien 头盔吗？ [wo ke yi shi yong  Slayer  tou kui dai ti  Shayzien  tou kui ma ？]

english: Hello old chap.
translation: 老伙计你好。 [lao huo ji ni hao 。]

english: What are you doing here? Shouldn't you be looking after your glider?
translation: 你在这里做什么？你不应该照顾你的滑翔机吗？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？ ni bu ying gai zhao gu ni de hua xiang ji ma ？]

english: I'm pretty much retired these days old fellow. My test piloting days are over. I'm just relaxing here and enjoying the primal clash between man and man.
translation: 老伙计，我现在已经退休了。我的试飞日子结束了。我只是在这里放松，享受人与人之间的原始冲突。 [lao huo ji ， wo xian zai yi jing tui xiu le 。 wo de shi fei ri zi jie shu le 。 wo zhi shi zai zhe li fang song ， xiang shou ren yu ren zhi jian de yuan shi chong tu 。]

english: You're watching the duels then. Are you going to challenge someone yourself?
translation: 那么你正在观看决斗。你要亲自挑战别人吗？ [na me ni zheng zai guan kan jue dou 。 ni yao qin zi tiao zhan bie ren ma ？]

english: I do find the duels entertaining to watch, but I suspect that actually being involved would be a lot less fun for me. I'm a lover, not a fighter!
translation: 我确实觉得观看决斗很有趣，但我怀疑真正参与其中对我来说就不那么有趣了。我是一个爱人，不是一个战士！ [wo que shi jue de guan kan jue dou hen you qu ， dan wo huai yi zhen zheng can yu qi zhong dui wo lai shuo jiu bu na me you qu le 。 wo shi yi ge ai ren ， bu shi yi ge zhan shi ！]

english: Errm, I suppose you are.
translation: 呃，我想你是。 [e ， wo xiang ni shi 。]

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food item] to Captain Daerkin.
translation: 你将[一些][订购的侏儒食品]交给达尔金队长。 [ni jiang [ yi xie ][ ding gou de zhu ru shi pin ] jiao gei da er jin dui zhang 。]

english: Excellent. Just what I need whilst watching the duels.
translation: 出色的。这正是我在观看决斗时所需要的。 [chu se de 。 zhe zheng shi wo zai guan kan jue dou shi suo xu yao de 。]

english: Here you go, have a dashing pilot's scarf.
translation: 给你，戴上一条帅气的飞行员围巾。 [gei ni ， dai shang yi tiao shuai qi de fei xing yuan wei jin 。]

english: I have some spare goggles, you might as well have them.
translation: 我有一些备用护目镜，你也可以拥有。 [wo you yi xie bei yong hu mu jing ， ni ye ke yi yong you 。]

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 你一定是走了很远的路才把这个交给我的。这里有一些额外的东西作为提示。 [ni yi ding shi zou le hen yuan de lu cai ba zhe ge jiao gei wo de 。 zhe li you yi xie e wai de dong xi zuo wei ti shi 。]

english: You are given [a/some] [reward item(s)] as a tip.
translation: 您将获得[一个/一些][奖励物品]作为小费。 [nin jiang huo de [ yi ge / yi xie ][ jiang li wu pin ] zuo wei xiao fei 。]

english: Can you take me on the glider?
translation: 你能带我坐滑翔机吗？ [ni neng dai wo zuo hua xiang ji ma ？]

english: Of course!
translation: 当然！ [dang ran ！]

english: What do you think of Ali Morrisane?
translation: 你觉得阿里·莫里森怎么样？ [ni jue de a li · mo li sen zen me yang ？]

english: Oh, he's always up to something. Like that magic carpet business.
translation: 哦，他总是在搞事情。就像魔毯生意一样。 [o ， ta zong shi zai gao shi qing 。 jiu xiang mo tan sheng yi yi yang 。]

english: What magic carpet business?
translation: 什么魔毯生意？ [shen me mo tan sheng yi ？]

english: He said he was planning to set up a magic carpet network, like our gliders.
translation: 他说他计划建立一个魔毯网络，就像我们的滑翔机一样。 [ta shuo ta ji hua jian li yi ge mo tan wang luo ， jiu xiang wo men de hua xiang ji yi yang 。]

english: If he ever gets it set up, us gnomes won't be happy with him. Especially not King Narnode!
translation: 如果他成功了，我们侏儒就会对他不满意。尤其是纳诺德国王！ [ru guo ta cheng gong le ， wo men zhu ru jiu hui dui ta bu man yi 。 you qi shi na nuo de guo wang ！]

english: Why are gliders better than other transport?
translation: 为什么滑翔机比其他交通工具更好？ [wei shen me hua xiang ji bi qi ta jiao tong gong ju geng hao ？]

english: Oh we have a whole network! It's wonderful for getting to hard to reach places.
translation: 哦，我们有一个完整的网络！到达难以到达的地方真是太棒了。 [o ， wo men you yi ge wan zheng de wang luo ！ dao da nan yi dao da de di fang zhen shi tai bang le 。]

english: There are so many places where your teleports cannot reach!
translation: 有很多地方是你传送无法到达的！ [you hen duo di fang shi ni chuan song wu fa dao da de ！]

english: How did you all manage to build such an established network?
translation: 你们是如何建立这样一个成熟的网络的？ [ni men shi ru he jian li zhe yang yi ge cheng shu de wang luo de ？]

english: I think you'll find that is a gnome trade secret!
translation: 我想你会发现这是侏儒的商业秘密！ [wo xiang ni hui fa xian zhe shi zhu ru de shang ye mi mi ！]

english: Sorry, I don't want anything now.
translation: 抱歉，我现在什么都不想要。 [bao qian ， wo xian zai shen me dou bu xiang yao 。]

english: You have come to the right place. At the center I must go, 5 paces toward the circle of stone, then one more to the city of kings and find the treasure of my kins.
translation: 您来对地方了。我必须走到中心，向石圈迈出五步，然后再迈一步，到达国王之城，找到我亲族的宝藏。 [nin lai dui di fang le 。 wo bi xu zou dao zhong xin ， xiang shi quan mai chu wu bu ， ran hou zai mai yi bu ， dao da guo wang zhi cheng ， zhao dao wo qin zu de bao zang 。]

english: Can you take me on the glider?
translation: 你能带我坐滑翔机吗？ [ni neng dai wo zuo hua xiang ji ma ？]

english: What do you think of Ali Morrisane?
translation: 你觉得阿里·莫里森怎么样？ [ni jue de a li · mo li sen zen me yang ？]

english: Why are gliders better than other transport?
translation: 为什么滑翔机比其他交通工具更好？ [wei shen me hua xiang ji bi qi ta jiao tong gong ju geng hao ？]

english: Sorry, I don't want anything now.
translation: 抱歉，我现在什么都不想要。 [bao qian ， wo xian zai shen me dou bu xiang yao 。]

english: You're one to talk! I paid plenty for that little encounter!
translation: 你就是一个会说话的人！为了那次小小的邂逅，我付出了很多！ [ni jiu shi yi ge hui shuo hua de ren ！ wei le na ci xiao xiao de xie hou ， wo fu chu le hen duo ！]

english: One eye doesn't equal two of my best men!
translation: 一只眼睛不如我最好的两个人！ [yi zhi yan jing bu ru wo zui hao de liang ge ren ！]

english: We gave you plenty of chances to flee!
translation: 我们给了你很多逃跑的机会！ [wo men gei le ni hen duo tao pao de ji hui ！]

english: If I ran away from you, I'd never hear the end of it!
translation: 如果我逃离你，我将永远听不到结局！ [ru guo wo tao li ni ， wo jiang yong yuan ting bu dao jie ju ！]

english: Really? Then what about that fight in Turtle Basin?
translation: 真的吗？那么海龟盆地那场战斗呢？ [zhen de ma ？ na me hai gui pen di na chang zhan dou ne ？]

english: That wasn't fleeing! It was a tactical repositioning! Besides, you're conveniently forgetting what happened at Brimhaven!
translation: 那不是逃跑！这是战术上的重新定位！此外，你很容易忘记在布里姆黑文发生的事情！ [na bu shi tao pao ！ zhe shi zhan shu shang de chong xin ding wei ！ ci wai ， ni hen rong yi wang ji zai bu li mu hei wen fa sheng de shi qing ！]

english: A boring fight! I had better things to do.
translation: 无聊的战斗！我有更重要的事情要做。 [wu liao de zhan dou ！ wo you geng zhong yao de shi qing yao zuo 。]

english: Well, we'll have to make things more entertaining next time then!
translation: 好吧，下次我们得让事情变得更有趣！ [hao ba ， xia ci wo men de rang shi qing bian de geng you qu ！]

english: I look forward to it, but for now, let's drink!
translation: 我很期待，但现在，让我们喝吧！ [wo hen qi dai ， dan xian zai ， rang wo men he ba ！]

english: Indeed! Cheers!
translation: 的确！干杯! [di que ！ gan bei !]

english: Prepare yeself, we'll be off soon!
translation: 做好准备，我们很快就要出发了！ [zuo hao zhun bei ， wo men hen kuai jiu yao chu fa le ！]

english: Aye aye!
translation: 是啊是啊！ [shi a shi a ！]

english: What do you need, adventurer? There is a battle to fight!
translation: 冒险家，你需要什么？有一场战斗要打！ [mao xian jia ， ni xu yao shen me ？ you yi chang zhan dou yao da ！]

english: How do I help?
translation: 我该如何提供帮助？ [wo gai ru he ti gong bang zhu ？]

english: Get yerself a harpoon from the crate on the ship, then go fish around the island t' catch some harpoonfish. They make fer fine ammo against Tempoross!
translation: 从船上的板条箱中取出一把鱼叉，然后在岛上钓鱼，捕获一些鱼叉鱼。他们制造了对抗坦波罗斯的优质弹药！ [cong chuan shang de ban tiao xiang zhong qu chu yi ba yu cha ， ran hou zai dao shang diao yu ， bu huo yi xie yu cha yu 。 ta men zhi zao le dui kang tan bo luo si de you zhi dan yao ！]

english: Once ye caught some, ye can cook 'em at the shrines on the island if ye want 'em to pack more of a punch. Then come back t' the ship an' load 'em in the ammunition crates next to the cannons.
translation: 一旦你捕获了一些，如果你想让它们更有力的话，你可以在岛上的神社里烹饪它们。然后回到船上，将它们装入大炮旁边的弹药箱中。 [yi dan ni bu huo le yi xie ， ru guo ni xiang rang ta men geng you li de hua ， ni ke yi zai dao shang de shen she li peng ren ta men 。 ran hou hui dao chuan shang ， jiang ta men zhuang ru da pao pang bian de dan yao xiang zhong 。]

english: Our cannoneers will get t' firin' the harpoonfish at Tempoross. When it's weak an' submerges to recover its energy, get down to the jetty next t' the ship an' fish those spirit pools.
translation: 我们的炮手将在坦普罗斯发射鱼叉鱼。当它虚弱并潜入水中恢复能量时，到船旁边的码头去钓鱼那些灵魂池。 [wo men de pao shou jiang zai tan pu luo si fa she yu cha yu 。 dang ta xu ruo bing qian ru shui zhong hui fu neng liang shi ， dao chuan pang bian de ma tou qu diao yu na xie ling hun chi 。]

english: Be quick with fishin' those spirit pools though, or it'll come back so strong we'll have to abandon the fight! With any luck, we'll weaken those spirit fish enough t' subdue Tempoross. Now get t' the fight, sailor!
translation: 不过，要快点去钓鱼那些灵魂池，否则它会变得如此强大，我们将不得不放弃战斗！运气好的话，我们就能削弱那些灵鱼的力量，足以制服坦波罗斯。现在开始战斗吧，水手！ [bu guo ， yao kuai dian qu diao yu na xie ling hun chi ， fou ze ta hui bian de ru ci qiang da ， wo men jiang bu de bu fang qi zhan dou ！ yun qi hao de hua ， wo men jiu neng xue ruo na xie ling yu de li liang ， zu yi zhi fu tan bo luo si 。 xian zai kai shi zhan dou ba ， shui shou ！]

english: What should I watch out for?
translation: 我应该注意什么？ [wo ying gai zhu yi shen me ？]

english: If Tempoross electrocutes a cannon t' stop it from firin', ya better load your harpoonfish into the other ammunition crates t' keep them cannons firin' instead.
translation: 如果坦波罗斯电击了一门大炮并阻止它开火，你最好将你的鱼叉鱼装进其他弹药箱，以让它们继续开火。 [ru guo tan bo luo si dian ji le yi men da pao bing zu zhi ta kai huo ， ni zui hao jiang ni de yu cha yu zhuang jin qi ta dan yao xiang ， yi rang ta men ji xu kai huo 。]

english: Also, make sure t' grab a rope from the ship crates an' keep an eye out for big waves. We'll make sure t' shout about them. Then ye best quickly tether yerself t' an island totem pole or ship mast with that rope.
translation: 另外，请确保从船上的板条箱中取出一根绳子，并留意大浪。我们一定会大声谈论他们。然后，你最好迅速用那根绳子将自己拴在岛屿图腾柱或船桅上。 [ling wai ， qing que bao cong chuan shang de ban tiao xiang zhong qu chu yi gen sheng zi ， bing liu yi da lang 。 wo men yi ding hui da sheng tan lun ta men 。 ran hou ， ni zui hao xun su yong na gen sheng zi jiang zi ji shuan zai dao yu tu teng zhu huo chuan wei shang 。]

english: If the waves break the totem pole or ship mast, ye can grab a hammer from the ship crates t' fix 'em up before the next big wave hits.
translation: 如果海浪破坏了图腾柱或船桅，你可以从船上的板条箱里拿出一把锤子，在下一个大浪袭来之前将它们修好。 [ru guo hai lang po huai le tu teng zhu huo chuan wei ， ni ke yi cong chuan shang de ban tiao xiang li na chu yi ba chui zi ， zai xia yi ge da lang xi lai zhi qian jiang ta men xiu hao 。]

english: Oh, an' keep an eye out for lightnin' clouds causin' fires. Get a bucket from the ship crates, fill it with water at a pump, and get t' puttin it out before it spreads.
translation: 哦，请留意引起火灾的闪电云。从船上的板条箱中取出一个桶，用泵将其装满水，并在水蔓延之前将其取出。 [o ， qing liu yi yin qi huo zai de shan dian yun 。 cong chuan shang de ban tiao xiang zhong qu chu yi ge tong ， yong beng jiang qi zhuang man shui ， bing zai shui man yan zhi qian jiang qi qu chu 。]

english: If ye get hit by the waves or fire, don't be surprised when ye lose those fish an' tools ye gathered. Now get t' the fight, sailor!
translation: 如果你被海浪或火灾击中，当你失去那些鱼和收集的工具时，不要感到惊讶。现在开始战斗吧，水手！ [ru guo ni bei hai lang huo huo zai ji zhong ， dang ni shi qu na xie yu he shou ji de gong ju shi ， bu yao gan dao jing ya 。 xian zai kai shi zhan dou ba ， shui shou ！]

english: I want to leave.
translation: 我想离开。 [wo xiang li kai 。]

english: Really? You will receive no reward if you do.
translation: 真的吗？如果您这样做，您将不会获得任何奖励。 [zhen de ma ？ ru guo nin zhe yang zuo ， nin jiang bu hui huo de ren he jiang li 。]

english: I'll get on with the fighting.
translation: 我会继续战斗。 [wo hui ji xu zhan dou 。]

english: We did it! Tempoross has been sudbued once again. Well done!
translation: 我们做到了！ Tempoross再次被制服。干得好！ [wo men zuo dao le ！ Tempoross zai ci bei zhi fu 。 gan de hao ！]

english: Take a well deserved rest but don't get too comfy, it'll regain its energy soon enough!
translation: 充分休息，但不要太舒服，它很快就会恢复能量！ [chong fen xiu xi ， dan bu yao tai shu fu ， ta hen kuai jiu hui hui fu neng liang ！]

english: What should I do now?
translation: 我现在该怎么办？ [wo xian zai gai zen me ban ？]

english: We usually find some debris washed up near the docks back at Unkah. Feel free t' have a look. Ya might find somethin' useful!
translation: 我们通常会在温卡码头附近发现一些被冲上岸的碎片。随意看看。你可能会发现一些有用的东西！ [wo men tong chang hui zai wen ka ma tou fu jin fa xian yi xie bei chong shang an de sui pian 。 sui yi kan kan 。 ni ke neng hui fa xian yi xie you yong de dong xi ！]

english: It won't be long before Tempoross regains enough energy to be a problem and we'll have to wrangle it again. Hopefully we can count on you to 'elp!
translation: 过不了多久，Tempoross 就会恢复足够的能量，成为一个问题，我们将不得不再次争论它。希望我们可以依靠您的帮助！ [guo bu liao duo jiu ，Tempoross  jiu hui hui fu zu gou de neng liang ， cheng wei yi ge wen ti ， wo men jiang bu de bu zai ci zheng lun ta 。 xi wang wo men ke yi yi kao nin de bang zhu ！]

english: I'm ready to leave.
translation: 我准备离开了。 [wo zhun bei li kai le 。]

english: Aye aye!
translation: 是啊是啊！ [shi a shi a ！]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: To the boats! We'll set sail soon!
translation: 到船去！我们很快就要起航了！ [dao chuan qu ！ wo men hen kuai jiu yao qi hang le ！]

english: We'll set sail in the next [25/20/15/10/5] seconds.
translation: 我们将在接下来的 [25/20/15/10/5] 秒内起航。 [wo men jiang zai jie xia lai de  [25/20/15/10/5]  miao nei qi hang 。]

english: Let's get underway!
translation: 让我们开始吧！ [rang wo men kai shi ba ！]

english: Tempoross will surface soon, prepare yourselves!
translation: Temporos即将浮出水面，做好准备！ [Temporos ji jiang fu chu shui mian ， zuo hao zhun bei ！]

english: More fish!
translation: 更多鱼！ [geng duo yu ！]

english: Load those cannons!
translation: 装载那些大炮！ [zhuang zai na xie da pao ！]

english: Keep an eye on the waves!
translation: 密切关注海浪！ [mi qie guan zhu hai lang ！]

english: Tempoross is drawing in water, prepare yourselves!
translation: Tempoross 正在入水，做好准备！ [Tempoross  zheng zai ru shui ， zuo hao zhun bei ！]

english: The mast has been damaged!
translation: 桅杆已损坏！ [wei gan yi sun huai ！]

english: Storm clouds are rolling in, get your buckets ready!
translation: 暴风雨乌云滚滚而来，准备好你的水桶吧！ [bao feng yu wu yun gun gun er lai ， zhun bei hao ni de shui tong ba ！]

english: Tempoross has disabled a cannon! Switch to another!
translation: Tempoross 已经使一门大炮失效了！切换到另一个！ [Tempoross  yi jing shi yi men da pao shi xiao le ！ qie huan dao ling yi ge ！]

english: Tempoross has submerged, fish from the whirlpools!
translation: Tempoross已被淹没，漩涡中的鱼！ [Tempoross yi bei yan mo ， xuan wo zhong de yu ！]

english: Tempoross has surfaced, keep those cannons firing!
translation: Tempoross 已经浮出水面，让那些大炮继续开火！ [Tempoross  yi jing fu chu shui mian ， rang na xie da pao ji xu kai huo ！]

english: Tempoross has retreated to the depths!
translation: Tempoross已经退到了深处！ [Tempoross yi jing tui dao le shen chu ！]

english: Tempoross has gathered too much energy!
translation: Tempoross聚集了太多的能量！ [Tempoross ju ji le tai duo de neng liang ！]

english: The storm has grown too strong, we must retreat!
translation: 风暴太猛烈了，我们必须撤退！ [feng bao tai meng lie le ， wo men bi xu che tui ！]

english: How do I help?
translation: 我该如何提供帮助？ [wo gai ru he ti gong bang zhu ？]

english: What should I watch out for?
translation: 我应该注意什么？ [wo ying gai zhu yi shen me ？]

english: I want to leave.
translation: 我想离开。 [wo xiang li kai 。]

english: Yes, I really want to leave.
translation: 是的，我真的很想离开。 [shi de ， wo zhen de hen xiang li kai 。]

english: No, I don't want to leave.
translation: 不，我不想离开。 [bu ， wo bu xiang li kai 。]

english: I'll get on with the fighting.
translation: 我会继续战斗。 [wo hui ji xu zhan dou 。]

english: What should I do now?
translation: 我现在该怎么办？ [wo xian zai gai zen me ban ？]

english: I'm ready to leave.
translation: 我准备离开了。 [wo zhun bei li kai le 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: I don't think I can fix this. Looks like I'll be heading back by foot.
translation: 我不认为我能解决这个问题。看来我要步行回去了。 [wo bu ren wei wo neng jie jue zhe ge wen ti 。 kan lai wo yao bu xing hui qu le 。]

english: Ah, how embarrassing.
translation: 啊，真尴尬。 [a ， zhen gan ga 。]

english: What happened?
translation: 发生了什么？ [fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: A bit of a technical hitch with the landing gear. I won't be able to fly you anywhere, sorry.
translation: 起落架有点技术故障。抱歉，我不能带你去任何地方。 [qi luo jia you dian ji shu gu zhang 。 bao qian ， wo bu neng dai ni qu ren he di fang 。]

english: I'm busy here. Do you need something?
translation: 我这里很忙。你需要什么东西吗？ [wo zhe li hen mang 。 ni xu yao shen me dong xi ma ？]

english: Please tell me about what you're doing.
translation: 请告诉我你在做什么。 [qing gao su wo ni zai zuo shen me 。]

english: Gangs. It's the gangs from the slums in the east. Those ruffians are always hatching schemes, whether it's smuggling or extortion or even plain street violence.
translation: 帮派。这是来自东部贫民窟的帮派。这些恶棍总是在策划阴谋，无论是走私还是勒索，甚至是普通的街头暴力。 [bang pai 。 zhe shi lai zi dong bu pin min ku de bang pai 。 zhe xie e gun zong shi zai ce hua yin mou ， wu lun shi zou si hai shi le suo ， shen zhi shi pu tong de jie tou bao li 。]

english: I'm in charge of the investigations unit. Sometimes an informant will let us know when a gang is meeting. Then we can send in the troops and get them.
translation: 我负责调查部门。有时，线人会在团伙聚会时通知我们。然后我们就可以派出部队并得到他们。 [wo fu ze diao cha bu men 。 you shi ， xian ren hui zai tuan huo ju hui shi tong zhi wo men 。 ran hou wo men jiu ke yi pai chu bu dui bing de dao ta men 。]

english: Can I help?
translation: 我可以帮忙吗？ [wo ke yi bang mang ma ？]

english: That would be very welcome. Information about gang meetings is written on the notice board when it's received. When you see a meeting announced there, go and deal with 'em.
translation: 那将非常受欢迎。有关帮派会议的信息在收到后会写在布告栏上。当你看到那里宣布召开会议时，就去处理他们。 [na jiang fei chang shou huan ying 。 you guan bang pai hui yi de xin xi zai shou dao hou hui xie zai bu gao lan shang 。 dang ni kan dao na li xuan bu zhao kai hui yi shi ， jiu qu chu li ta men 。]

english: If they drop any documents, bring them to me for an extra reward.
translation: 如果他们掉落任何文件，请将其带给我以获得额外奖励。 [ru guo ta men diao luo ren he wen jian ， qing jiang qi dai gei wo yi huo de e wai jiang li 。]

english: You sound busy. I'll be off.
translation: 听起来你很忙。我就走了。 [ting qi lai ni hen mang 。 wo jiu zou le 。]

english: Hello again. Thanks for offering to help deal with the criminal gangs.
translation: 又好。感谢您主动提出帮助打击犯罪团伙。 [you hao 。 gan xie nin zhu dong ti chu bang zhu da ji fan zui tuan huo 。]

english: Do you know of any meetings now?
translation: 你知道现在有什么会议吗？ [ni zhi dao xian zai you shen me hui yi ma ？]

english: No, not at the moment. Keep checking the notice board - information is written there when we receive it.
translation: 不，目前还不行。请继续查看布告栏 - 当我们收到信息时，信息就会写在布告栏上。 [bu ， mu qian hai bu xing 。 qing ji xu cha kan bu gao lan  -  dang wo men shou dao xin xi shi ， xin xi jiu hui xie zai bu gao lan shang 。]

english: We've received reports of a gang [in location]! They're meeting [in location].
translation: 我们收到了[现场]有一个团伙的报告！他们正在[地点]见面。 [wo men shou dao le [ xian chang ] you yi ge tuan huo de bao gao ！ ta men zheng zai [ di dian ] jian mian 。]

english: We believe the meeting is in progress now.
translation: 我们相信会议现在正在进行中。 [wo men xiang xin hui yi xian zai zheng zai jin xing zhong 。]

english: We believe the meeting is about to start imminently.
translation: 我们相信会议即将开始。 [wo men xiang xin hui yi ji jiang kai shi 。]

english: We believe the meeting will start in about [number] minutes.
translation: 我们相信会议将在大约 [number] 分钟后开始。 [wo men xiang xin hui yi jiang zai da yue  [number]  fen zhong hou kai shi 。]

english: Remind me, what do I do for this?
translation: 提醒我，我该怎么办？ [ti xing wo ， wo gai zen me ban ？]

english: Gang meeting information is written on the notice board when it's received from the informants. When you see a meeting announced there, go and deal with 'em.
translation: 当从举报人处收到帮派会议信息后，就会将其写在布告栏上。当你看到那里宣布召开会议时，就去处理他们。 [dang cong ju bao ren chu shou dao bang pai hui yi xin xi hou ， jiu hui jiang qi xie zai bu gao lan shang 。 dang ni kan dao na li xuan bu zhao kai hui yi shi ， jiu qu chu li ta men 。]

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我就走了。 [wo jiu zou le 。]

english: Come over here and talk to me before you mess around with that.
translation: 在你胡闹之前先到这里来和我谈谈。 [zai ni hu nao zhi qian xian dao zhe li lai he wo tan tan 。]

english: No thanks, I don't need that.
translation: 不，谢谢，我不需要那个。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo bu xu yao na ge 。]

english: Thank you. This will help us track down more gang meetings in future.
translation: 谢谢。这将有助于我们将来追踪更多的帮派会议。 [xie xie 。 zhe jiang you zhu yu wo men jiang lai zhui zong geng duo de bang pai hui yi 。]

english: I don't remember asking you to help, but... okay, thank you, whoever you are.
translation: 我不记得请过你帮忙，但是……好吧，谢谢你，不管你是谁。 [wo bu ji de qing guo ni bang mang ， dan shi …… hao ba ， xie xie ni ， bu guan ni shi shui 。]

english: Please leave. There is confidential information in here, and you are not authorised to view it.
translation: 请离开。这里有机密信息，您无权查看。 [qing li kai 。 zhe li you ji mi xin xi ， nin wu quan cha kan 。]

english: Please tell me about what you're doing.
translation: 请告诉我你在做什么。 [qing gao su wo ni zai zuo shen me 。]

english: Can I help?
translation: 我可以帮忙吗？ [wo ke yi bang mang ma ？]

english: Do you know of any meetings now?
translation: 你知道现在有什么会议吗？ [ni zhi dao xian zai you shen me hui yi ma ？]

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我就走了。 [wo jiu zou le 。]

english: You sound busy. I'll be off.
translation: 听起来你很忙。我就走了。 [ting qi lai ni hen mang 。 wo jiu zou le 。]

english: Remind me, what do I do for this?
translation: 提醒我，我该怎么办？ [ti xing wo ， wo gai zen me ban ？]

english: Sorry I can't take any more passengers today.
translation: 抱歉，今天不能再搭载乘客了。 [bao qian ， jin tian bu neng zai da zai cheng ke le 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Tell me about the Wintertodt.
translation: 告诉我关于温特托特的事。 [gao su wo guan yu wen te tuo te de shi 。]

english: Ignisia claims it's some kind of evil spirit.
translation: 伊格尼西亚声称这是某种邪恶的灵魂。 [yi ge ni xi ya sheng cheng zhe shi mou zhong xie e de ling hun 。]

english: You don't believe her?
translation: 你不相信她吗？ [ni bu xiang xin ta ma ？]

english: Nah, I believe in things I can stab and kill. This is all just a storm in a teacup. I mean, how can wind and snow be evil? My toad is more of a threat!
translation: 不，我相信我能刺伤和杀死的东西。这一切只是茶杯里的风暴。我是说，风雪怎么可能是邪恶的呢？我的蟾蜍更具威胁性！ [bu ， wo xiang xin wo neng ci shang he sha si de dong xi 。 zhe yi qie zhi shi cha bei li de feng bao 。 wo shi shuo ， feng xue zen me ke neng shi xie e de ne ？ wo de chan chu geng ju wei xie xing ！]

english: Your... toad?
translation: 你的……蟾蜍？ [ni de …… chan chu ？]

english: Yeah, just a bit of fun. I have a pet - he's around here somewhere, assuming that troublesome cat hasn't eaten him.
translation: 是的，只是一点乐趣。我有一只宠物——他就在这附近的某个地方，假设那只麻烦的猫没有吃掉他。 [shi de ， zhi shi yi dian le qu 。 wo you yi zhi chong wu —— ta jiu zai zhe fu jin de mou ge di fang ， jia she na zhi ma fan de mao mei you chi diao ta 。]

english: That's a bit weird, but okay.
translation: 这有点奇怪，但没关系。 [zhe you dian qi guai ， dan mei guan xi 。]

english: No weirder than being scared of snow.
translation: 没有什么比害怕雪更奇怪的了。 [mei you shen me bi hai pa xue geng qi guai de le 。]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: I'm Captain Kalt, proud member of the Shayzien Army.
translation: 我是卡尔特上尉，是 Shayzien 军队的骄傲成员。 [wo shi ka er te shang wei ， shi  Shayzien  jun dui de jiao ao cheng yuan 。]

english: How long have you been a soldier?
translation: 你当兵多久了？ [ni dang bing duo jiu le ？]

english: Man and boy I've worn the uniform. Earned Captain a few years back and never looked back. Not too happy about babysitting delusional wizards though. But orders is orders.
translation: 伙计们，我已经穿过制服了。几年前就获得了队长称号，并且再也没有回头。不过，我对照顾妄想巫师不太高兴。但命令就是命令。 [huo ji men ， wo yi jing chuan guo zhi fu le 。 ji nian qian jiu huo de le dui zhang cheng hao ， bing qie zai ye mei you hui tou 。 bu guo ， wo dui zhao gu wang xiang wu shi bu tai gao xing 。 dan ming ling jiu shi ming ling 。]

english: Tell me how I'm doing.
translation: 告诉我我怎么样。 [gao su wo wo zen me yang 。]

english: Go play in the snow and come back when you've done something.
translation: 去玩雪吧，干完事再回来。 [qu wan xue ba ， gan wan shi zai hui lai 。]

english: You appear to have tried a little.
translation: 看来你已经尝试了一点。 [kan lai ni yi jing chang shi le yi dian 。]

english: You have subdued the Wintertodt [x] times. Your lifetime score: [x] Your highest score: [x]
translation: 你已经制服了温特托特[x]次。您的一生得分：[x] 您的最高得分：[x] [ni yi jing zhi fu le wen te tuo te [x] ci 。 nin de yi sheng de fen ：[x]  nin de zui gao de fen ：[x]]

english: Ignisia appears to be quite happy with you.
translation: 伊格尼西亚似乎对你很满意。 [yi ge ni xi ya si hu dui ni hen man yi 。]

english: See you later.
translation: 稍后见。 [shao hou jian 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Tell me about the Wintertodt.
translation: 告诉我关于温特托特的事。 [gao su wo guan yu wen te tuo te de shi 。]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: Tell me how I'm doing.
translation: 告诉我我怎么样。 [gao su wo wo zen me yang 。]

english: See you later.
translation: 稍后见。 [shao hou jian 。]

english: I've got nothing to say to you.
translation: 我没什么可对你说的。 [wo mei shen me ke dui ni shuo de 。]

english: You do not have enough Piscarilius favour. Current favour: [X]% - Required: 75.0%
translation: 你没有得到足够的皮斯卡利留斯的青睐。当前好感度：[X]% - 需要：75.0% [ni mei you de dao zu gou de pi si ka li liu si de qing lai 。 dang qian hao gan du ：[X]% -  xu yao ：75.0%]

english: Eh, what do you want?
translation: 呃，你想要什么？ [e ， ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: What's your story?
translation: 你的故事是什么？ [ni de gu shi shi shen me ？]

english: Sea piracy just ain't what it used to be, so my crew and I have had to make do on land. We specialise in 'acquiring' valuable antiquities from around the city and shipping them to our friends overseas.
translation: 海盗行为已今非昔比，所以我和我的船员们不得不在陆地上凑合着过日子。我们专注于从城市各地“收购”有价值的古物并将其运送给海外的朋友。 [hai dao xing wei yi jin fei xi bi ， suo yi wo he wo de chuan yuan men bu de bu zai lu di shang cou he zhe guo ri zi 。 wo men zhuan zhu yu cong cheng shi ge di “ shou gou ” you jia zhi de gu wu bing jiang qi yun song gei hai wai de peng you 。]

english: And people just let you get away with this?
translation: 人们就让你逍遥法外？ [ren men jiu rang ni xiao yao fa wai ？]

english: Of course they do, for the right price. That's just how things work around here, kid.
translation: 当然可以，而且价格合适。这就是这里的运作方式，孩子。 [dang ran ke yi ， er qie jia ge he shi 。 zhe jiu shi zhe li de yun zuo fang shi ， hai zi 。]

english: Looking for any help?
translation: 寻找任何帮助？ [xun zhao ren he bang zhu ？]

english: Yeah, you look like you might be able to help me out. If you think you've got what it takes, I might have a job for you.
translation: 是的，你看起来也许能帮我。如果你认为你有能力，我可能会为你找到一份工作。 [shi de ， ni kan qi lai ye xu neng bang wo 。 ru guo ni ren wei ni you neng li ， wo ke neng hui wei ni zhao dao yi fen gong zuo 。]

english: I have what it takes.
translation: 我有需要的东西。 [wo you xu yao de dong xi 。]

english: We'll see about that. (Khaled tells the player to obtain an artefact from a certain location.)
translation: 我们将会看到这一点。 （哈立德告诉玩家从某个位置获取一件文物。） [wo men jiang hui kan dao zhe yi dian 。 （ ha li de gao su wan jia cong mou ge wei zhi huo qu yi jian wen wu 。）]

english: I'm not sure I have the time right now.
translation: 我不确定现在有时间。 [wo bu que ding xian zai you shi jian 。]

english: Perhaps some other time.
translation: 也许其他时间。 [ye xu qi ta shi jian 。]

english: I'll be on my way.
translation: 我会上路的。 [wo hui shang lu de 。]

english: What are you playing at? I've given you a job, get it done.
translation: 你在玩什么？我给了你一份工作，完成它吧。 [ni zai wan shen me ？ wo gei le ni yi fen gong zuo ， wan cheng ta ba 。]

english: What am I supposed to be doing?
translation: 我应该做什么？ [wo ying gai zuo shen me ？]

english: You need to recover an artefact for me. It can be found in the [location].
translation: 你需要为我找回一件文物。可以在[位置]中找到。 [ni xu yao wei wo zhao hui yi jian wen wu 。 ke yi zai [ wei zhi ] zhong zhao dao 。]

english: Watch yourself, if the guards catch you carrying hot goods they'll throw you in the brig.
translation: 小心点，如果警卫发现你携带热货，他们会把你扔进双桅船。 [xiao xin dian ， ru guo jing wei fa xian ni xie dai re huo ， ta men hui ba ni reng jin shuang wei chuan 。]

english: I'll get to it right away, boss.
translation: 我马上去处理，老板。 [wo ma shang qu chu li ， lao ban 。]

english: I've lost the artefact...
translation: 我把神器弄丢了... [wo ba shen qi nong diu le ...]

english: Congratulations, you're a failure. Come back to me when you think you've got what it takes to get the job done.
translation: 恭喜你，你是个失败者。当您认为自己有能力完成工作时，请回来找我。 [gong xi ni ， ni shi ge shi bai zhe 。 dang nin ren wei zi ji you neng li wan cheng gong zuo shi ， qing hui lai zhao wo 。]

english: This is exactly what our friends overseas were looking for. Here's your cut. Let me know when you're ready for more work.
translation: 这正是我们海外朋友所寻求的。这是你的剪辑。当您准备好进行更多工作时请告诉我。 [zhe zheng shi wo men hai wai peng you suo xun qiu de 。 zhe shi ni de jian ji 。 dang nin zhun bei hao jin xing geng duo gong zuo shi qing gao su wo 。]

english: (Captain Khaled takes the stolen item and hands the player some coins.)
translation: （哈立德队长拿走了偷来的物品，并递给玩家一些硬币。） [（ ha li de dui zhang na zou le tou lai de wu pin ， bing di gei wan jia yi xie ying bi 。）]

english: Ah! Here you go!
translation: 啊!干得好！ [a ! gan de hao ！]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: I need you to answer this for me.
translation: 我需要你帮我回答这个问题。 [wo xu yao ni bang wo hui da zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Captain Khaled has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 哈立德船长给了你一个挑战卷轴！ [ha li de chuan zhang gei le ni yi ge tiao zhan juan zhou ！]

english: Please give me your answer!
translation: 请给我你的答案！ [qing gei wo ni de da an ！]

english: How can that be? Go check again!
translation: 怎么可能呢？再去检查一下吧！ [zen me ke neng ne ？ zai qu jian cha yi xia ba ！]

english: Spot on!
translation: 现货！ [xian huo ！]

english: Captain Khaled has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 哈立德船长给了你另一张线索卷轴！ [ha li de chuan zhang gei le ni ling yi zhang xian suo juan zhou ！]

english: What's your story?
translation: 你的故事是什么？ [ni de gu shi shi shen me ？]

english: Looking for any help?
translation: 寻找任何帮助？ [xun zhao ren he bang zhu ？]

english: I have what it takes.
translation: 我有需要的东西。 [wo you xu yao de dong xi 。]

english: I'm not sure I have the time right now.
translation: 我不确定现在有时间。 [wo bu que ding xian zai you shi jian 。]

english: I'll be on my way.
translation: 我会上路的。 [wo hui shang lu de 。]

english: What am I supposed to be doing?
translation: 我应该做什么？ [wo ying gai zuo shen me ？]

english: I'll get to it right away, boss.
translation: 我马上去处理，老板。 [wo ma shang qu chu li ， lao ban 。]

english: Can you take me on the glider?
translation: 你能带我坐滑翔机吗？ [ni neng dai wo zuo hua xiang ji ma ？]

english: Of course!
translation: 当然！ [dang ran ！]

english: Why are gliders better than other transport?
translation: 为什么滑翔机比其他交通工具更好？ [wei shen me hua xiang ji bi qi ta jiao tong gong ju geng hao ？]

english: Oh we have a whole network! It's wonderful for getting to hard to reach places.
translation: 哦，我们有一个完整的网络！到达难以到达的地方真是太棒了。 [o ， wo men you yi ge wan zheng de wang luo ！ dao da nan yi dao da de di fang zhen shi tai bang le 。]

english: There are so many places where your teleports cannot reach!
translation: 有很多地方是你传送无法到达的！ [you hen duo di fang shi ni chuan song wu fa dao da de ！]

english: How did you all manage to build such an established network?
translation: 你们是如何建立这样一个成熟的网络的？ [ni men shi ru he jian li zhe yang yi ge cheng shu de wang luo de ？]

english: I think you'll find that is a gnome trade secret!
translation: 我想你会发现这是侏儒的商业秘密！ [wo xiang ni hui fa xian zhe shi zhu ru de shang ye mi mi ！]

english: Sorry, I don't want anything now.
translation: 抱歉，我现在什么都不想要。 [bao qian ， wo xian zai shen me dou bu xiang yao 。]

english: Is that some rum I see in your backpack?
translation: 我在你背包里看到的是朗姆酒吗？ [wo zai ni bei bao li kan dao de shi lang mu jiu ma ？]

english: Yes, why do you ask?
translation: 是啊，你为什么这么问？ [shi a ， ni wei shen me zhe me wen ？]

english: No reason, I just...
translation: 没有理由，我只是... [mei you li you ， wo zhi shi ...]

english: Oh my! What is that thing over there?
translation: 天啊！那边那个东西是什么？ [tian a ！ na bian na ge dong xi shi shen me ？]

english: Where?
translation: 在哪里？ [zai na li ？]

english: Hmm, my mistake, it must have been an optical illusion.
translation: 嗯，我的错误，这一定是一种视错觉。 [n ， wo de cuo wu ， zhe yi ding shi yi zhong shi cuo jue 。]

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 尽管您找到了顾客，但您似乎没有带来正确的食物！你需要[一个/一些][订购的侏儒食物/饮料]！ [jin guan nin zhao dao le gu ke ， dan nin si hu mei you dai lai zheng que de shi wu ！ ni xu yao [ yi ge / yi xie ][ ding gou de zhu ru shi wu / yin liao ]！]

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜肴不行。对于 Aluft Aloft 的顾客来说，只有手工制作的 Gnome Cuisine 才足够好。 [kong pa yu zhi cai yao bu xing 。 dui yu  Aluft Aloft  de gu ke lai shuo ， zhi you shou gong zhi zuo de  Gnome Cuisine  cai zu gou hao 。]

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Captain Klemfoodle
translation: 你将[一份/一些][订购的侏儒食物/饮料物品]交给克莱姆福德船长 [ni jiang [ yi fen / yi xie ][ ding gou de zhu ru shi wu / yin liao wu pin ] jiao gei ke lai mu fu de chuan zhang]

english: Very good, very good. Itsgood to taste real gnomish flavours.
translation: 非常好，非常好。品尝真正的侏儒味道真是太好了。 [fei chang hao ， fei chang hao 。 pin chang zhen zheng de zhu ru wei dao zhen shi tai hao le 。]

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 你一定是走了很远的路才把这个交给我的。这里有一些额外的东西作为提示。 [ni yi ding shi zou le hen yuan de lu cai ba zhe ge jiao gei wo de 。 zhe li you yi xie e wai de dong xi zuo wei ti shi 。]

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 您有 [number] 个积分用于免费送货令牌。您还没有资格获得侏儒食物。 [nin you  [number]  ge ji fen yong yu mian fei song huo ling pai 。 nin hai mei you zi ge huo de zhu ru shi wu 。]

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
