translation: 您有 [number] 个积分用于免费送货令牌。您可能会收到 [number] 块侏儒食物。 [nin you  [number]  ge ji fen yong yu mian fei song huo ling pai 。 nin ke neng hui shou dao  [number]  kuai zhu ru shi wu 。]

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 不要忘记从 Aluft Gianne jnr 领取免费送货代币。 [bu yao wang ji cong  Aluft Gianne jnr  ling qu mian fei song huo dai bi 。]

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 你的交货太晚了！返回 Aluft jnr。以获得另一个订单。您丢弃了送货箱，因为您不再需要它了。 [ni de jiao huo tai wan le ！ fan hui  Aluft jnr。 yi huo de ling yi ge ding dan 。 nin diu qi le song huo xiang ， yin wei nin bu zai xu yao ta le 。]

english: Can you take me on the glider?
translation: 你能带我坐滑翔机吗？ [ni neng dai wo zuo hua xiang ji ma ？]

english: Why are gliders better than other transport?
translation: 为什么滑翔机比其他交通工具更好？ [wei shen me hua xiang ji bi qi ta jiao tong gong ju geng hao ？]

english: Sorry, I don't want anything now.
translation: 抱歉，我现在什么都不想要。 [bao qian ， wo xian zai shen me dou bu xiang yao 。]

english: My apologies, but I can't take you with me while you're affected by that spell. It should wear off in [X] minutes, [X] seconds.
translation: 抱歉，当你受到那个咒语影响时，我不能带你一起去。它应该会在 [X] 分 [X] 秒后消失。 [bao qian ， dang ni shou dao na ge zhou yu ying xiang shi ， wo bu neng dai ni yi qi qu 。 ta ying gai hui zai  [X]  fen  [X]  miao hou xiao shi 。]

english: Hey! I'm not flying out this deep into the Wilderness. They don't pay me danger money, you know. I'm out of here.
translation: 嘿！我不会飞到荒野这么深的地方。你知道，他们不会付给我危险金。我要离开这里了 [hei ！ wo bu hui fei dao huang ye zhe me shen de di fang 。 ni zhi dao ， ta men bu hui fu gei wo wei xian jin 。 wo yao li kai zhe li le]

english: I'm looking for [player name].
translation: 我正在寻找[玩家姓名]。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao [ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Glider for [player name]!
translation: [玩家姓名]的滑翔机！ [[ wan jia xing ming ] de hua xiang ji ！]

english: Hello, [player name]! Let's go!
translation: 你好，[玩家姓名]！我们走吧！ [ni hao ，[ wan jia xing ming ]！ wo men zou ba ！]

english: Glider here for [player name].
translation: 滑翔机在这里为[玩家姓名]。 [hua xiang ji zai zhe li wei [ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Come on, [player name]!
translation: 来吧，[玩家姓名]！ [lai ba ，[ wan jia xing ming ]！]

english: Don't keep me waiting, [player name]!
translation: 别让我等了，[玩家名字]！ [bie rang wo deng le ，[ wan jia ming zi ]！]

english: Where's [player name]?
translation: [玩家姓名]在哪里？ [[ wan jia xing ming ] zai na li ？]

english: [player name]? Where are you?
translation: [玩家姓名]？你在哪里？ [[ wan jia xing ming ]？ ni zai na li ？]

english: Oh, I give up.
translation: 哦，我放弃了。 [o ， wo fang qi le 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Well hello there, how you doing?
translation: 你好，你好吗？ [ni hao ， ni hao ma ？]

english: Not bad, yourself?
translation: 你自己也不错吧？ [ni zi ji ye bu cuo ba ？]

english: I'm great now, those goblins can't get close with this cannon blasting at them!
translation: 我现在好了，那些哥布林根本就无法靠这门大炮轰击他们！ [wo xian zai hao le ， na xie ge bu lin gen ben jiu wu fa kao zhe men da pao hong ji ta men ！]

english: Don't let any goblins through the breach in our fence!
translation: 不要让任何妖精穿过我们栅栏的缺口！ [bu yao rang ren he yao jing chuan guo wo men zha lan de que kou ！]

english: Keep an eye open for goblins!
translation: 留意妖精！ [liu yi yao jing ！]

english: Don't just do something! Stand there!
translation: 不要只是做某事！站在那里！ [bu yao zhi shi zuo mou shi ！ zhan zai na li ！]

english: Stop dawdling soldier! You're in the army now!
translation: 别再磨磨蹭蹭的士兵了！你现在在军队了！ [bie zai mo mo ceng ceng di shi bing le ！ ni xian zai zai jun dui le ！]

english: Hurry up on that patrol route, trooper!
translation: 快点沿着巡逻路线前进吧，士兵！ [kuai dian yan zhe xun luo lu xian qian jin ba ， shi bing ！]

english: Hello! What can I do for you?
translation: 你好！我能为你做什么？ [ni hao ！ wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: Where am I exactly?
translation: 我究竟在哪里？ [wo jiu jing zai na li ？]

english: This is the port of Land's End!
translation: 这里是天涯海角的港口！ [zhe li shi tian ya hai jiao de gang kou ！]

english: Can you tell me about the local area?
translation: 你能告诉我当地的情况吗？ [ni neng gao su wo dang di de qing kuang ma ？]

english: Certainly. We're on the southern edge of the Kingdom of Great Kourend.
translation: 当然。我们位于大库伦德王国的南部边缘。 [dang ran 。 wo men wei yu da ku lun de wang guo de nan bu bian yuan 。]

english: The kingdom is made up of five main cities. You'll find Shayzien and Lovakengj to the north, and the remaining cities to the north east.
translation: 该王国由五个主要城市组成。您会在北部找到谢津 (Shayzien) 和洛瓦肯吉 (Lovakenj)，在东北部找到其余城市。 [gai wang guo you wu ge zhu yao cheng shi zu cheng 。 nin hui zai bei bu zhao dao xie jin  (Shayzien)  he luo wa ken ji  (Lovakenj)， zai dong bei bu zhao dao qi yu cheng shi 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: I'd like to travel to Port Piscarilius, please.
translation: 我想去皮斯卡利留斯港旅行。 [wo xiang qu pi si ka li liu si gang lv xing 。]

english: As you wish.
translation: 如你所愿。 [ru ni suo yuan 。]

english: I'd like to travel to Port Sarim, please.
translation: 我想去沙里姆港旅行。 [wo xiang qu sha li mu gang lv xing 。]

english: As you wish, I hope you don't get seasick, it is a long voyage.
translation: 如你所愿，希望你不要晕船，这是一次长途航行。 [ru ni suo yuan ， xi wang ni bu yao yun chuan ， zhe shi yi ci zhang tu hang xing 。]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: Where am I exactly?
translation: 我究竟在哪里？ [wo jiu jing zai na li ？]

english: Can you take me to Port Piscarilius please?
translation: 你能带我去皮斯卡利留斯港吗？ [ni neng dai wo qu pi si ka li liu si gang ma ？]

english: Can you take me to Port Sarim please?
translation: 你能带我去沙里姆港吗？ [ni neng dai wo qu sha li mu gang ma ？]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: Adventurer. The General warned us about you.
translation: 冒险家。将军警告我们有关你的事。 [mao xian jia 。 jiang jun jing gao wo men you guan ni de shi 。]

english: Warned?
translation: 警告？ [jing gao ？]

english: Yes. He said you might show up here again. We're not to harm you, but make no mistake, we're keeping a close eye on you. You're not to be trusted.
translation: 是的。他说你可能会再次出现在这里。我们不会伤害你，但别搞错了，我们会密切关注你。你不值得信任。 [shi de 。 ta shuo ni ke neng hui zai ci chu xian zai zhe li 。 wo men bu hui shang hai ni ， dan bie gao cuo le ， wo men hui mi qie guan zhu ni 。 ni bu zhi de xin ren 。]

english: Well I guess that's the best I can hope for. So how are things going here?
translation: 好吧，我想这是我能期待的最好结果了。那么这里的情况怎么样呢？ [hao ba ， wo xiang zhe shi wo neng qi dai de zui hao jie guo le 。 na me zhe li de qing kuang zen me yang ne ？]

english: We are not here to make small talk. Leave us to our work.
translation: 我们来这里不是为了闲聊。让我们继续工作吧。 [wo men lai zhe li bu shi wei le xian liao 。 rang wo men ji xu gong zuo ba 。]

english: Hey, how's it going?
translation: 嘿，怎么样？ [hei ， zen me yang ？]

english: You again? As I told you before, we are not here to make small talk. Leave us to our work.
translation: 又是你吗？正如我之前告诉过你的，我们不是来闲聊的。让我们继续工作吧。 [you shi ni ma ？ zheng ru wo zhi qian gao su guo ni de ， wo men bu shi lai xian liao de 。 rang wo men ji xu gong zuo ba 。]

english: I already told you to stop bothering us. Please go away.
translation: 我已经告诉过你别再打扰我们了。请走开。 [wo yi jing gao su guo ni bie zai da rao wo men le 。 qing zou kai 。]

english: Hello, what are you doing here, so far from home?
translation: 你好，离家这么远，你来这里做什么？ [ni hao ， li jia zhe me yuan ， ni lai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm enjoyn' the local hoschpitalieee. hee hee.
translation: 我很喜欢当地的医院。嘻嘻。 [wo hen xi huan dang di de yi yuan 。 xi xi 。]

english: Looks like you've enjoyed more than your fair share of hospitality.
translation: 看来您享受到的款待超出了应有的范围。 [kan lai nin xiang shou dao de kuan dai chao chu le ying you de fan wei 。]

english: tee hee, I probblie schoodn' 'av anuva drinkie right now. But dis dwarven beer ish kind of moreish after the fiff pint.
translation: 嘿嘿，我现在可能会喝酒。但在喝完一品脱啤酒后，矮人啤酒变得更美味了。 [hei hei ， wo xian zai ke neng hui he jiu 。 dan zai he wan yi pin tuo pi jiu hou ， ai ren pi jiu bian de geng mei wei le 。]

english: I'd go easy on the dwarven stout if I were you.
translation: 如果我是你，我会轻松对待矮人黑啤酒。 [ru guo wo shi ni ， wo hui qing song dui dai ai ren hei pi jiu 。]

english: I yousht to be a tesht pilot yoo know. I reeel hero.
translation: 我想成为一名测试飞行员，你知道。我卷轴英雄。 [wo xiang cheng wei yi ming ce shi fei xing yuan ， ni zhi dao 。 wo juan zhou ying xiong 。]

english: But I loscht my bottle. Scho I now ffind scholiss in the bottle.
translation: 但我把瓶子弄丢了。 Scho 我现在在瓶子里找到了scholiss。 [dan wo ba ping zi nong diu le 。 Scho  wo xian zai zai ping zi li zhao dao le scholiss。]

english: What happened? Did you have a glider crash or get attacked by huge flying birds or something?
translation: 发生了什么？您是否遭遇过滑翔机坠毁或被巨大的飞鸟袭击或其他什么情况？ [fa sheng le shen me ？ nin shi fou zao yu guo hua xiang ji zhui hui huo bei ju da de fei niao xi ji huo qi ta shen me qing kuang ？]

english: Naaah, I realished I woz scared ov heightsh.
translation: 不，我意识到我太害怕了。 [bu ， wo yi shi dao wo tai hai pa le 。]

english: Ah, I can see that would be a problem ... You should keep an eye on your drinking, though.
translation: 啊，我知道这会是一个问题……不过你应该注意你的饮酒。 [a ， wo zhi dao zhe hui shi yi ge wen ti …… bu guo ni ying gai zhu yi ni de yin jiu 。]

english: I'll try. Bofe eyez...
translation: 我会尽力。博夫眼... [wo hui jin li 。 bo fu yan ...]

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 尽管您找到了顾客，但您似乎没有带来正确的食物！你需要[一个/一些][订购的侏儒食物/饮料]！ [jin guan nin zhao dao le gu ke ， dan nin si hu mei you dai lai zheng que de shi wu ！ ni xu yao [ yi ge / yi xie ][ ding gou de zhu ru shi wu / yin liao ]！]

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜肴不行。对于 Aluft Aloft 的顾客来说，只有手工制作的 Gnome Cuisine 才足够好。 [kong pa yu zhi cai yao bu xing 。 dui yu  Aluft Aloft  de gu ke lai shuo ， zhi you shou gong zhi zuo de  Gnome Cuisine  cai zu gou hao 。]

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food item] to Captain Ninto.
translation: 你将[一些][订购的侏儒食品]交给Ninto船长。 [ni jiang [ yi xie ][ ding gou de zhu ru shi pin ] jiao gei Ninto chuan zhang 。]

english: Aaa shomefing ter go wiv my beer. Thish dwarf beerz quite shtrong you know...
translation: Aaa shomefing ter 带着我的啤酒去吧。可爱的小矮人啤酒... [Aaa shomefing ter  dai zhe wo de pi jiu qu ba 。 ke ai de xiao ai ren pi jiu ...]

english: Here you go, have a dashing pilot's scarf.
translation: 给你，戴上一条帅气的飞行员围巾。 [gei ni ， dai shang yi tiao shuai qi de fei xing yuan wei jin 。]

english: I have some spare goggles, you might as well have them.
translation: 我有一些备用护目镜，你也可以拥有。 [wo you yi xie bei yong hu mu jing ， ni ye ke yi yong you 。]

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 你一定是走了很远的路才把这个交给我的。这里有一些额外的东西作为提示。 [ni yi ding shi zou le hen yuan de lu cai ba zhe ge jiao gei wo de 。 zhe li you yi xie e wai de dong xi zuo wei ti shi 。]

english: You are given [a/some] [reward item(s)] as a tip.
translation: 您将获得[一个/一些][奖励物品]作为小费。 [nin jiang huo de [ yi ge / yi xie ][ jiang li wu pin ] zuo wei xiao fei 。]

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 您有 [number] 个积分用于免费送货令牌。您还没有资格获得侏儒食物。 [nin you  [number]  ge ji fen yong yu mian fei song huo ling pai 。 nin hai mei you zi ge huo de zhu ru shi wu 。]

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 您有 [number] 个积分用于免费送货令牌。您可能会收到 [number] 块侏儒食物。 [nin you  [number]  ge ji fen yong yu mian fei song huo ling pai 。 nin ke neng hui shou dao  [number]  kuai zhu ru shi wu 。]

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 不要忘记从 Aluft Gianne jnr 领取免费送货代币。 [bu yao wang ji cong  Aluft Gianne jnr  ling qu mian fei song huo dai bi 。]

english: Hello, who are you?
translation: 你好，你是谁？ [ni hao ， ni shi shui ？]

english: Ahoy! I'm Cap'n Pudi, currently assisting the Spirit Anglers in their effort against Tempoross.
translation: 哎哟！我是 Cap'n Pudi，目前正在协助 Spirit Anglers 对抗 Tempoross。 [ai yo ！ wo shi  Cap'n Pudi， mu qian zheng zai xie zhu  Spirit Anglers  dui kang  Tempoross。]

english: Tempoross? Spirit Anglers? Who are they?
translation: 时间？精神垂钓者？他们是谁？ [shi jian ？ jing shen chui diao zhe ？ ta men shi shui ？]

english: You 'aven't heard?! The freak storms? Sailors running into trouble? Ye really must be a landlubber!
translation: 你没听说过吗？！怪异的风暴？水手们遇到麻烦了？你们真是旱鸭子啊！ [ni mei ting shuo guo ma ？！ guai yi de feng bao ？ shui shou men yu dao ma fan le ？ ni men zhen shi han ya zi a ！]

english: Tempoross is some kind o' great sea spirit that's been spookin' sailors and causing crazy storms!
translation: Tempoross 是一种伟大的海洋精灵，它一直在吓唬水手并引发疯狂的风暴！ [Tempoross  shi yi zhong wei da de hai yang jing ling ， ta yi zhi zai xia hu shui shou bing yin fa feng kuang de feng bao ！]

english: Taiman and his crew were one of the first t' run into it. Washed up outside Al Kharid amongst piles of debris, they did. 'Tis a troublin' time to be a cap'n!
translation: 泰曼和他的船员是最先遇到这种情况的人之一。他们确实被冲到了阿尔卡里德城外的废墟堆中。成为一名船长真是太麻烦了！ [tai man he ta de chuan yuan shi zui xian yu dao zhe zhong qing kuang de ren zhi yi 。 ta men que shi bei chong dao le a er ka li de cheng wai de fei xu dui zhong 。 cheng wei yi ming chuan zhang zhen shi tai ma fan le ！]

english: Oh that doesn't sound good at all!
translation: 哦，这听起来一点都不好！ [o ， zhe ting qi lai yi dian dou bu hao ！]

english: It isn't, but worry not. The Spirit Anglers 'ave been formed t' tackle this beastie! We're recruiting all skilled sailors and fisherfolk t' help us.
translation: 事实并非如此，但不用担心。精神钓鱼者已经成立来对付这只野兽！我们正在招募所有熟练的水手和渔民来帮助我们。 [shi shi bing fei ru ci ， dan bu yong dan xin 。 jing shen diao yu zhe yi jing cheng li lai dui fu zhe zhi ye shou ！ wo men zheng zai zhao mu suo you shu lian de shui shou he yu min lai bang zhu wo men 。]

english: Well I can definitely fish!
translation: 嗯，我绝对会钓鱼！ [n ， wo jue dui hui diao yu ！]

english: Are you sure? It's pretty rough out there and you look like you could do with more experience.
translation: 你确定吗？那里的情况相当艰难，你看起来需要更多的经验才能做到这一点。 [ni que ding ma ？ na li de qing kuang xiang dang jian nan ， ni kan qi lai xu yao geng duo de jing yan cai neng zuo dao zhe yi dian 。]

english: You need a Fishing level of 35 to fight Tempoross.
translation: 您需要 35 级钓鱼等级才能与 Tempoross 战斗。 [nin xu yao  35  ji diao yu deng ji cai neng yu  Tempoross  zhan dou 。]

english: Excellent!
translation: 出色的！ [chu se de ！]

english: The ships on the dock regularly embark to Tempoross Cove. Once there, you'll need to keep the cannons loaded with Harpoonfish t' weaken the Spirit. You can fish 'em on the island.
translation: 码头上的船只定期出发前往坦普罗斯湾。到达那里后，你需要让大炮装满鱼叉鱼，以削弱灵魂。你可以在岛上钓鱼。 [ma tou shang de chuan zhi ding qi chu fa qian wang tan pu luo si wan 。 dao da na li hou ， ni xu yao rang da pao zhuang man yu cha yu ， yi xue ruo ling hun 。 ni ke yi zai dao shang diao yu 。]

english: When Tempoross submerges, get up close and clear the fish from its whirlpools; they're how it gets its energy.
translation: 当Tempoross淹没时，靠近并清除漩涡中的鱼；它们是它获取能量的方式。 [dang Tempoross yan mo shi ， kao jin bing qing chu xuan wo zhong de yu ； ta men shi ta huo qu neng liang de fang shi 。]

english: Well, that sounds easy enough!
translation: 嗯，这听起来很简单！ [n ， zhe ting qi lai hen jian dan ！]

english: Aye, that be the easy part!
translation: 是的，这是最简单的部分！ [shi de ， zhe shi zui jian dan de bu fen ！]

english: The storm of Tempoross will rage around you, so you better be ready to deal with lightning strikes and avoid getting zapped when Tempoross attacks the cannons.
translation: 坦波罗斯的风暴将在你周围肆虐，所以你最好做好应对闪电的准备，并避免在坦波罗斯攻击大炮时被击中。 [tan bo luo si de feng bao jiang zai ni zhou wei si nve ， suo yi ni zui hao zuo hao ying dui shan dian de zhun bei ， bing bi mian zai tan bo luo si gong ji da pao shi bei ji zhong 。]

english: Also, watch out for those mighty waves! You'll want t' tether yourself t' something solid so you don't find yourself lost in the deep blue when they come crashing down!
translation: 另外，要小心那些巨浪！您需要将自己拴在坚固的东西上，这样当它们坠落时您就不会发现自己迷失在深蓝色中！ [ling wai ， yao xiao xin na xie ju lang ！ nin xu yao jiang zi ji shuan zai jian gu de dong xi shang ， zhe yang dang ta men zhui luo shi nin jiu bu hui fa xian zi ji mi shi zai shen lan se zhong ！]

english: Oh... Well, I suppose I can do that.
translation: 哦...好吧，我想我能做到。 [o ... hao ba ， wo xiang wo neng zuo dao 。]

english: Will I need any special equipment?
translation: 我需要任何特殊设备吗？ [wo xu yao ren he te shu she bei ma ？]

english: Everythin' you need can be found on-board. Though if you have a favourite harpoon, you can always bring that!
translation: 您需要的一切都可以在船上找到。不过，如果您有最喜欢的鱼叉，您可以随时带上它！ [nin xu yao de yi qie dou ke yi zai chuan shang zhao dao 。 bu guo ， ru guo nin you zui xi huan de yu cha ， nin ke yi sui shi dai shang ta ！]

english: The complete Spirit Anglers outfit also has an 'andy harness built-in, so you won't need a rope if you're wearin' it. You can speak t' Gita about getting one.
translation: 完整的 Spirit Anglers 服装还内置有“andy 安全带”，因此如果您佩戴它，则不需要绳子。你可以跟 t'Gita 谈谈如何获得一个。 [wan zheng de  Spirit Anglers  fu zhuang hai nei zhi you “andy  an quan dai ”， yin ci ru guo nin pei dai ta ， ze bu xu yao sheng zi 。 ni ke yi gen  t'Gita  tan tan ru he huo de yi ge 。]

english: Ye can find Gita just east of 'ere, next t' some fishin' equipment.
translation: 你可以在东边找到吉塔，就在一些钓鱼设备旁边。 [ni ke yi zai dong bian zhao dao ji ta ， jiu zai yi xie diao yu she bei pang bian 。]

english: When you're ready, just board the ship and we'll set sail soon!
translation: 当您准备好后，就上船吧，我们很快就会启航！ [dang nin zhun bei hao hou ， jiu shang chuan ba ， wo men hen kuai jiu hui qi hang ！]

english: Aye aye cap'n!
translation: 是啊是啊船长！ [shi a shi a chuan zhang ！]

english: Are there any benefits to helping the Spirit Anglers?
translation: 帮助精神垂钓者有什么好处吗？ [bang zhu jing shen chui diao zhe you shen me hao chu ma ？]

english: Other than maintainin' safe passage and savin' lives?!
translation: 除了维持安全通行和拯救生命之外？！ [chu le wei chi an quan tong xing he zheng jiu sheng ming zhi wai ？！]

english: Well...
translation: 出色地... [chu se di ...]

english: I'm just messin' with ye! Of course there are benefits!
translation: 我只是和你们开玩笑而已！当然还有好处！ [wo zhi shi he ni men kai wan xiao er yi ！ dang ran hai you hao chu ！]

english: We find all sorts washed up by the storms. Aside from the usual junk, we often find old chests from merchant supply ships, as well as the odd artefact here and there.
translation: 我们发现各种各样的东西都被风暴冲走了。除了常见的垃圾之外，我们还经常发现商船补给船上的旧箱子，以及到处都是的奇怪文物。 [wo men fa xian ge zhong ge yang de dong xi dou bei feng bao chong zou le 。 chu le chang jian de la ji zhi wai ， wo men hai jing chang fa xian shang chuan bu ji chuan shang de jiu xiang zi ， yi ji dao chu dou shi de qi guai wen wu 。]

english: If it's not needed for the Spirit Anglers' research, it's yours to keep!
translation: 如果灵魂垂钓者的研究不需要它，它就归你所有！ [ru guo ling hun chui diao zhe de yan jiu bu xu yao ta ， ta jiu gui ni suo you ！]

english: Some of the more resourceful Spirit Anglers also discovered a fishing use for the spirit energised scales shed by the fish within Tempoross. You're free t' keep any you find.
translation: 一些足智多谋的精神垂钓者还发现了坦波罗斯内鱼脱落的精神能量鳞片的捕鱼用途。你可以自由保留你找到的任何东西。 [yi xie zu zhi duo mou de jing shen chui diao zhe hai fa xian le tan bo luo si nei yu tuo luo de jing shen neng liang lin pian de bu yu yong tu 。 ni ke yi zi you bao liu ni zhao dao de ren he dong xi 。]

english: Can you remind me what to do on the island?
translation: 你能提醒我在岛上可以做什么吗？ [ni neng ti xing wo zai dao shang ke yi zuo shen me ma ？]

english: Can you tell me more about the Spirit Anglers?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于精神垂钓者的信息吗？ [ni neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu jing shen chui diao zhe de xin xi ma ？]

english: Well, as I mentioned before, Taiman and his fishing crew from Al Kharid 'ad a tussle with Tempoross. They barely made it back.
translation: 好吧，正如我之前提到的，泰曼和他来自阿尔卡里德的渔民与坦普罗斯发生了一场争斗。他们好不容易才回来。 [hao ba ， zheng ru wo zhi qian ti dao de ， tai man he ta lai zi a er ka li de de yu min yu tan pu luo si fa sheng le yi chang zheng dou 。 ta men hao bu rong yi cai hui lai 。]

english: I was sitting down by the shore enjoying one of Karim's kebabs at the time, when suddenly the crew washed up amongst a pile of debris. Looked like they'd just seen a ghost!
translation: 当时我正坐在岸边享用卡里姆烤肉串，突然船员们被冲到了一堆废墟中。他们就像见了鬼一样！ [dang shi wo zheng zuo zai an bian xiang yong ka li mu kao rou chuan ， tu ran chuan yuan men bei chong dao le yi dui fei xu zhong 。 ta men jiu xiang jian le gui yi yang ！]

english: As soon as they could talk sense they went to the Chancellor and within days more shockin' tales of the Sea Spirit's wrath came in.
translation: 他们一恢复理智，就去找了议长，几天之内，更多关于海灵愤怒的令人震惊的故事就传来了。 [ta men yi hui fu li zhi ， jiu qu zhao le yi zhang ， ji tian zhi nei ， geng duo guan yu hai ling fen nu de ling ren zhen jing de gu shi jiu chuan lai le 。]

english: The Chancellor called a meeting for all us local seafarin' folk and we agreed action must be taken!
translation: 总理召集了我们所有当地海员召开会议，我们同意必须采取行动！ [zong li zhao ji le wo men suo you dang di hai yuan zhao kai hui yi ， wo men tong yi bi xu cai qu xing dong ！]

english: Ain't nothin' goin' t' take the seas from me, even if it is a powerful spirit!
translation: 没有什么能夺走我的海洋，即使它是一个强大的灵魂！ [mei you shen me neng duo zou wo de hai yang ， ji shi ta shi yi ge qiang da de ling hun ！]

english: Anyway, it was decided that we'd setup a base 'ere amongst these ruins, and so the Spirit Anglers was formed!
translation: 不管怎样，我们决定在这些废墟中建立一个基地，于是灵魂钓鱼者就成立了！ [bu guan zen yang ， wo men jue ding zai zhe xie fei xu zhong jian li yi ge ji di ， yu shi ling hun diao yu zhe jiu cheng li le ！]

english: Don't ask me what the ruins used to be. And it's not like Menaphos can 'ave a say!
translation: 别问我废墟以前是什么。而且梅纳福斯也没有发言权！ [bie wen wo fei xu yi qian shi shen me 。 er qie mei na fu si ye mei you fa yan quan ！]

english: Whatever they are, they make a fine base for the Spirit Anglers!
translation: 无论它们是什么，它们都是精神垂钓者的良好基地！ [wu lun ta men shi shen me ， ta men dou shi jing shen chui diao zhe de liang hao ji di ！]

english: Since moving in, we've been recruiting fisherfolk from all over, and some of the readin' types 'ave been studyin' Tempoross durin' our trips to subdue it.
translation: 自从搬进来以来，我们一直在从各地招募渔民，其中一些渔民在我们征服坦波罗斯的旅途中一直在研究它。 [zi cong ban jin lai yi lai ， wo men yi zhi zai cong ge di zhao mu yu min ， qi zhong yi xie yu min zai wo men zheng fu tan bo luo si de lv tu zhong yi zhi zai yan jiu ta 。]

english: I like t' get stuck in, me-self; face off toe t' toe with the beastie. I'll be right by your side when you go out there!
translation: 我喜欢陷入困境，我自己；与野兽面对面。当你出去的时候我会在你身边！ [wo xi huan xian ru kun jing ， wo zi ji ； yu ye shou mian dui mian 。 dang ni chu qu de shi hou wo hui zai ni shen bian ！]

english: Well that's encouraging, I think...
translation: 嗯，这很令人鼓舞，我想... [n ， zhe hen ling ren gu wu ， wo xiang ...]

english: I'm still 'ere, ain't I?
translation: 我还在这里，不是吗？ [wo hai zai zhe li ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Anyway, there's plenty o' research going on, so maybe you can find some notes lyin' around if ye want to know more.
translation: 不管怎样，有很多研究正在进行，所以如果你想了解更多，也许你可以找到一些笔记。 [bu guan zen yang ， you hen duo yan jiu zheng zai jin xing ， suo yi ru guo ni xiang liao jie geng duo ， ye xu ni ke yi zhao dao yi xie bi ji 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Hello again!
translation: 又好！ [you hao ！]

english: Ahoy there! What can I 'elp ye with?
translation: 哎哟！我能帮你什么忙？ [ai yo ！ wo neng bang ni shen me mang ？]

english: Sorry, it's pretty rough out there and you look like you could do with more experience.
translation: 抱歉，外面的环境很艰苦，你看起来还需要更多经验。 [bao qian ， wai mian de huan jing hen jian ku ， ni kan qi lai hai xu yao geng duo jing yan 。]

english: What do you need, adventurer? There is a battle to fight!
translation: 冒险家，你需要什么？有一场战斗要打！ [mao xian jia ， ni xu yao shen me ？ you yi chang zhan dou yao da ！]

english: How do I help?
translation: 我该如何提供帮助？ [wo gai ru he ti gong bang zhu ？]

english: Get yerself a harpoon from the crate on the ship, then go fish around the island t' catch some harpoonfish. They make fer fine ammo against Tempoross!
translation: 从船上的板条箱中取出一把鱼叉，然后在岛上钓鱼，捕获一些鱼叉鱼。他们制造了对抗坦波罗斯的优质弹药！ [cong chuan shang de ban tiao xiang zhong qu chu yi ba yu cha ， ran hou zai dao shang diao yu ， bu huo yi xie yu cha yu 。 ta men zhi zao le dui kang tan bo luo si de you zhi dan yao ！]

english: Once ye caught some, ye can cook 'em at the shrines on the island if ye want 'em to pack more of a punch. Then come back t' the ship an' load 'em in the ammunition crates next to the cannons.
translation: 一旦你捕获了一些，如果你想让它们更有力的话，你可以在岛上的神社里烹饪它们。然后回到船上，将它们装入大炮旁边的弹药箱中。 [yi dan ni bu huo le yi xie ， ru guo ni xiang rang ta men geng you li de hua ， ni ke yi zai dao shang de shen she li peng ren ta men 。 ran hou hui dao chuan shang ， jiang ta men zhuang ru da pao pang bian de dan yao xiang zhong 。]

english: Our cannoneers will get t' firin' the harpoonfish at Tempoross. When it's weak an' submerges to recover its energy, get down to the jetty next t' the ship an' fish those spirit pools.
translation: 我们的炮手将在坦普罗斯发射鱼叉鱼。当它虚弱并潜入水中恢复能量时，到船旁边的码头去钓鱼那些灵魂池。 [wo men de pao shou jiang zai tan pu luo si fa she yu cha yu 。 dang ta xu ruo bing qian ru shui zhong hui fu neng liang shi ， dao chuan pang bian de ma tou qu diao yu na xie ling hun chi 。]

english: Be quick with fishin' those spirit pools though, or it'll come back so strong we'll have to abandon the fight! With any luck, we'll weaken those spirit fish enough t' subdue Tempoross. Now get t' the fight, sailor!
translation: 不过，要快点去钓鱼那些灵魂池，否则它会变得如此强大，我们将不得不放弃战斗！运气好的话，我们就能削弱那些灵鱼的力量，足以制服坦波罗斯。现在开始战斗吧，水手！ [bu guo ， yao kuai dian qu diao yu na xie ling hun chi ， fou ze ta hui bian de ru ci qiang da ， wo men jiang bu de bu fang qi zhan dou ！ yun qi hao de hua ， wo men jiu neng xue ruo na xie ling yu de li liang ， zu yi zhi fu tan bo luo si 。 xian zai kai shi zhan dou ba ， shui shou ！]

english: Aye aye!
translation: 是啊是啊！ [shi a shi a ！]

english: What should I watch out for?
translation: 我应该注意什么？ [wo ying gai zhu yi shen me ？]

english: If Tempoross electrocutes a cannon t' stop it from firin', ya better load your harpoonfish into the other ammunition crates t' keep them cannons firin' instead.
translation: 如果坦波罗斯电击了一门大炮并阻止它开火，你最好将你的鱼叉鱼装进其他弹药箱，以让它们继续开火。 [ru guo tan bo luo si dian ji le yi men da pao bing zu zhi ta kai huo ， ni zui hao jiang ni de yu cha yu zhuang jin qi ta dan yao xiang ， yi rang ta men ji xu kai huo 。]

english: Also, make sure t' grab a rope from the ship crates an' keep an eye out for big waves. We'll make sure t' shout about them. Then ye best quickly tether yerself t' an island totem pole or ship mast with that rope.
translation: 另外，请确保从船上的板条箱中取出一根绳子，并留意大浪。我们一定会大声谈论他们。然后，你最好迅速用那根绳子将自己拴在岛屿图腾柱或船桅上。 [ling wai ， qing que bao cong chuan shang de ban tiao xiang zhong qu chu yi gen sheng zi ， bing liu yi da lang 。 wo men yi ding hui da sheng tan lun ta men 。 ran hou ， ni zui hao xun su yong na gen sheng zi jiang zi ji shuan zai dao yu tu teng zhu huo chuan wei shang 。]

english: If the waves break the totem pole or ship mast, ye can grab a hammer from the ship crates t' fix 'em up before the next big wave hits.
translation: 如果海浪破坏了图腾柱或船桅，你可以从船上的板条箱里拿出一把锤子，在下一个大浪袭来之前将它们修好。 [ru guo hai lang po huai le tu teng zhu huo chuan wei ， ni ke yi cong chuan shang de ban tiao xiang li na chu yi ba chui zi ， zai xia yi ge da lang xi lai zhi qian jiang ta men xiu hao 。]

english: Oh, an' keep an eye out for lightnin' clouds causin' fires. Get a bucket from the ship crates, fill it with water at a pump, and get t' puttin it out before it spreads.
translation: 哦，请留意引起火灾的闪电云。从船上的板条箱中取出一个桶，用泵将其装满水，并在水蔓延之前将其取出。 [o ， qing liu yi yin qi huo zai de shan dian yun 。 cong chuan shang de ban tiao xiang zhong qu chu yi ge tong ， yong beng jiang qi zhuang man shui ， bing zai shui man yan zhi qian jiang qi qu chu 。]

english: If ye get hit by the waves or fire, don't be surprised when ye lose those fish an' tools ye gathered. Now get t' the fight, sailor!
translation: 如果你被海浪或火灾击中，当你失去那些鱼和收集的工具时，不要感到惊讶。现在开始战斗吧，水手！ [ru guo ni bei hai lang huo huo zai ji zhong ， dang ni shi qu na xie yu he shou ji de gong ju shi ， bu yao gan dao jing ya 。 xian zai kai shi zhan dou ba ， shui shou ！]

english: I want to leave.
translation: 我想离开。 [wo xiang li kai 。]

english: Really? You will receive no reward if you do.
translation: 真的吗？如果您这样做，您将不会获得任何奖励。 [zhen de ma ？ ru guo nin zhe yang zuo ， nin jiang bu hui huo de ren he jiang li 。]

english: Yes, I really want to leave.
translation: 是的，我真的很想离开。 [shi de ， wo zhen de hen xiang li kai 。]

english: No, I don't want to leave.
translation: 不，我不想离开。 [bu ， wo bu xiang li kai 。]

english: I'll get on with the fighting.
translation: 我会继续战斗。 [wo hui ji xu zhan dou 。]

english: We did it! Tempoross has been sudbued once again. Well done!
translation: 我们做到了！ Tempoross再次被制服。干得好！ [wo men zuo dao le ！ Tempoross zai ci bei zhi fu 。 gan de hao ！]

english: Take a well deserved rest but don't get too comfy, it'll regain its energy soon enough!
translation: 充分休息，但不要太舒服，它很快就会恢复能量！ [chong fen xiu xi ， dan bu yao tai shu fu ， ta hen kuai jiu hui hui fu neng liang ！]

english: What should I do now?
translation: 我现在该怎么办？ [wo xian zai gai zen me ban ？]

english: We usually find some debris washed up near the docks back at Unkah. Feel free t' have a look. Ya might find somethin' useful!
translation: 我们通常会在温卡码头附近发现一些被冲上岸的碎片。随意看看。你可能会发现一些有用的东西！ [wo men tong chang hui zai wen ka ma tou fu jin fa xian yi xie bei chong shang an de sui pian 。 sui yi kan kan 。 ni ke neng hui fa xian yi xie you yong de dong xi ！]

english: It won't be long before Tempoross regains enough energy to be a problem and we'll have to wrangle it again. Hopefully we can count on you to 'elp!
translation: 过不了多久，Tempoross 就会恢复足够的能量，成为一个问题，我们将不得不再次争论它。希望我们可以依靠您的帮助！ [guo bu liao duo jiu ，Tempoross  jiu hui hui fu zu gou de neng liang ， cheng wei yi ge wen ti ， wo men jiang bu de bu zai ci zheng lun ta 。 xi wang wo men ke yi yi kao nin de bang zhu ！]

english: I'm ready to leave.
translation: 我准备离开了。 [wo zhun bei li kai le 。]

english: Aye aye!
translation: 是啊是啊！ [shi a shi a ！]

english: Excellent work out there! The seas are safe for a little longer thanks to you!
translation: 那里的工作非常棒！多亏了你们，海洋才安全了一会儿！ [na li de gong zuo fei chang bang ！ duo kui le ni men ， hai yang cai an quan le yi hui er ！]

english: We usually find some debris washed up near the docks. Feel free to have a look. Ya might find somethin' useful!
translation: 我们通常会在码头附近发现一些被冲上岸的碎片。随意看看。你可能会发现一些有用的东西！ [wo men tong chang hui zai ma tou fu jin fa xian yi xie bei chong shang an de sui pian 。 sui yi kan kan 。 ni ke neng hui fa xian yi xie you yong de dong xi ！]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: Argh, we let that storm grow too fierce... As soon as it's safe we'll 'ead straight back out!
translation: 啊，我们让这场风暴变得太猛烈了……一旦安全了，我们就会‘直接出去！ [a ， wo men rang zhe chang feng bao bian de tai meng lie le …… yi dan an quan le ， wo men jiu hui ‘ zhi jie chu qu ！]

english: Aye aye, Cap'n!
translation: 是啊是啊，船长！ [shi a shi a ， chuan zhang ！]

english: Join the Spirit Anglers!
translation: 加入精神垂钓者吧！ [jia ru jing shen chui diao zhe ba ！]

english: Plenty of room for more adventurers!
translation: 有足够的空间容纳更多的冒险家！ [you zu gou de kong jian rong na geng duo de mao xian jia ！]

english: Come and help us fight Tempoross!
translation: 快来帮助我们对抗Tempoross吧！ [kuai lai bang zhu wo men dui kang Tempoross ba ！]

english: It'll be worth your while...
translation: 这将是值得你花时间的... [zhe jiang shi zhi de ni hua shi jian de ...]

english: To the boats! We'll set sail soon!
translation: 到船去！我们很快就要起航了！ [dao chuan qu ！ wo men hen kuai jiu yao qi hang le ！]

english: We'll set sail in the next [25/20/15/10/5] seconds.
translation: 我们将在接下来的 [25/20/15/10/5] 秒内起航。 [wo men jiang zai jie xia lai de  [25/20/15/10/5]  miao nei qi hang 。]

english: Let's get underway!
translation: 让我们开始吧！ [rang wo men kai shi ba ！]

english: Belay that! We'll try again later.
translation: 保护那个！我们稍后再试。 [bao hu na ge ！ wo men shao hou zai shi 。]

english: Tempoross will surface soon, prepare yourselves!
translation: Temporos即将浮出水面，做好准备！ [Temporos ji jiang fu chu shui mian ， zuo hao zhun bei ！]

english: More fish!
translation: 更多鱼！ [geng duo yu ！]

english: Load those cannons!
translation: 装载那些大炮！ [zhuang zai na xie da pao ！]

english: Keep an eye on the waves!
translation: 密切关注海浪！ [mi qie guan zhu hai lang ！]

english: Tempoross is drawing in water, prepare yourselves!
translation: Tempoross 正在入水，做好准备！ [Tempoross  zheng zai ru shui ， zuo hao zhun bei ！]

english: The mast has been damaged!
translation: 桅杆已损坏！ [wei gan yi sun huai ！]

english: Storm clouds are rolling in, get your buckets ready!
translation: 暴风雨乌云滚滚而来，准备好你的水桶吧！ [bao feng yu wu yun gun gun er lai ， zhun bei hao ni de shui tong ba ！]

english: Tempoross has disabled a cannon! Switch to another!
translation: Tempoross 已经使一门大炮失效了！切换到另一个！ [Tempoross  yi jing shi yi men da pao shi xiao le ！ qie huan dao ling yi ge ！]

english: Tempoross has submerged, fish from the whirlpools!
translation: Tempoross已被淹没，漩涡中的鱼！ [Tempoross yi bei yan mo ， xuan wo zhong de yu ！]

english: Tempoross has surfaced, keep those cannons firing!
translation: Tempoross 已经浮出水面，让那些大炮继续开火！ [Tempoross  yi jing fu chu shui mian ， rang na xie da pao ji xu kai huo ！]

english: Tempoross has retreated to the depths!
translation: Tempoross已经退到了深处！ [Tempoross yi jing tui dao le shen chu ！]

english: Tempoross has gathered too much energy!
translation: Tempoross聚集了太多的能量！ [Tempoross ju ji le tai duo de neng liang ！]

english: The storm has grown too strong, we must retreat!
translation: 风暴太猛烈了，我们必须撤退！ [feng bao tai meng lie le ， wo men bi xu che tui ！]

english: Are there any benefits to helping the Spirit Anglers?
translation: 帮助精神垂钓者有什么好处吗？ [bang zhu jing shen chui diao zhe you shen me hao chu ma ？]

english: Can you remind me what to do on the island?
translation: 你能提醒我在岛上可以做什么吗？ [ni neng ti xing wo zai dao shang ke yi zuo shen me ma ？]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Can you tell me more about the Spirit Anglers?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于精神垂钓者的信息吗？ [ni neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu jing shen chui diao zhe de xin xi ma ？]

english: How do I help?
translation: 我该如何提供帮助？ [wo gai ru he ti gong bang zhu ？]

english: What should I watch out for?
translation: 我应该注意什么？ [wo ying gai zhu yi shen me ？]

english: I want to leave.
translation: 我想离开。 [wo xiang li kai 。]

english: Yes, I really want to leave.
translation: 是的，我真的很想离开。 [shi de ， wo zhen de hen xiang li kai 。]

english: No, I don't want to leave.
translation: 不，我不想离开。 [bu ， wo bu xiang li kai 。]

english: I'll get on with the fighting.
translation: 我会继续战斗。 [wo hui ji xu zhan dou 。]

english: What should I do now?
translation: 我现在该怎么办？ [wo xian zai gai zen me ban ？]

english: I'm ready to leave.
translation: 我准备离开了。 [wo zhun bei li kai le 。]

english: Attention! Front and centre!
translation: 注意力！前面和中间！ [zhu yi li ！ qian mian he zhong jian ！]

english: Yes ma'am!
translation: 是的，女士！ [shi de ， nv shi ！]

english: I have to ask you to get back from here [sir/lady].
translation: 我必须请你从这里回来[先生/女士]。 [wo bi xu qing ni cong zhe li hui lai [ xian sheng / nv shi ]。]

english: Why? What's going on here?
translation: 为什么？这是怎么回事？ [wei shen me ？ zhe shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: This is the Lizardman Canyon. The lizardmen from the west are desperately trying to invade Great Kourend.
translation: 这就是蜥蜴人峡谷。来自西方的蜥蜴人正拼命地试图入侵大库伦德。 [zhe jiu shi xi yi ren xia gu 。 lai zi xi fang de xi yi ren zheng pin ming di shi tu ru qin da ku lun de 。]

english: We were able to hold them back, so they've started tunnelling under the kingdom and into this canyon to bypass our defences.
translation: 我们能够阻止他们，所以他们开始在王国下面挖隧道，进入这个峡谷，以绕过我们的防御。 [wo men neng gou zu zhi ta men ， suo yi ta men kai shi zai wang guo xia mian wa sui dao ， jin ru zhe ge xia gu ， yi rao guo wo men de fang yu 。]

english: Luckily, we were able to work out what they were doing and move to stop them. So far we've managed to keep them trapped within the canyon, but we need to constantly hold them at bay.
translation: 幸运的是，我们能够弄清楚他们在做什么并采取行动阻止他们。到目前为止，我们已经成功地将他们困在峡谷内，但我们需要不断地阻止他们。 [xing yun de shi ， wo men neng gou nong qing chu ta men zai zuo shen me bing cai qu xing dong zu zhi ta men 。 dao mu qian wei zhi ， wo men yi jing cheng gong di jiang ta men kun zai xia gu nei ， dan wo men xu yao bu duan di zu zhi ta men 。]

english: I'm a very strong adventurer. Would I be able to help out in the battle?
translation: 我是一个非常强大的冒险家。我能在战斗中帮忙吗？ [wo shi yi ge fei chang qiang da de mao xian jia 。 wo neng zai zhan dou zhong bang mang ma ？]

english: No! We would never trust a stranger in the importance of a battle! A lot is at stake.
translation: 不！我们永远不会相信陌生人的战斗的重要性！事关重大。 [bu ！ wo men yong yuan bu hui xiang xin mo sheng ren de zhan dou de zhong yao xing ！ shi guan zhong da 。]

english: You may. Head into the canyon and take the fight to those monsters!
translation: 您可以。进入峡谷，与那些怪物战斗！ [nin ke yi 。 jin ru xia gu ， yu na xie guai wu zhan dou ！]

english: Beware the Chambers of Xeric, adventurer.
translation: 小心艾瑞克的房间，冒险家。 [xiao xin ai rui ke de fang jian ， mao xian jia 。]

english: These dungeons and the perils within them are unique. You will encounter both dangerous and mysterious creatures here.
translation: 这些地下城和其中的危险都是独一无二的。在这里你会遇到危险而神秘的生物。 [zhe xie di xia cheng he qi zhong de wei xian dou shi du yi wu er de 。 zai zhe li ni hui yu dao wei xian er shen mi de sheng wu 。]

english: Remember that you may be kicked out at any time - any items dropped on the ground will be lost inside.
translation: 请记住，您随时可能被踢出去 - 任何掉在地上的物品都会丢失在里面。 [qing ji zhu ， nin sui shi ke neng bei ti chu qu  -  ren he diao zai di shang de wu pin du hui diu shi zai li mian 。]

english: Do not allow your curiosity to get the better of you.
translation: 不要让你的好奇心战胜你。 [bu yao rang ni de hao qi xin zhan sheng ni 。]

english: Thanks for the warning.
translation: 谢谢你的警告。 [xie xie ni de jing gao 。]

english: What are you doing up here? Only the palace guards are allowed up here.
translation: 你在这儿做什么？只有宫廷守卫才可以进入这里。 [ni zai zhe er zuo shen me ？ zhi you gong ting shou wei cai ke yi jin ru zhe li 。]

english: I am one of the palace guards.
translation: 我是宫廷侍卫之一。 [wo shi gong ting shi wei zhi yi 。]

english: No, you're not! I know all the palace guards.
translation: 不，你不是！我认识所有的宫廷侍卫。 [bu ， ni bu shi ！ wo ren shi suo you de gong ting shi wei 。]

english: I'm a new recruit.
translation: 我是一名新兵。 [wo shi yi ming xin bing 。]

english: I interview all the new recruits. I'd know if you were one of them.
translation: 我面试所有新员工。我想知道你是否是其中之一。 [wo mian shi suo you xin yuan gong 。 wo xiang zhi dao ni shi fou shi qi zhong zhi yi 。]

english: That blows that story out of the water then.
translation: 那就把这个故事从水中吹出来了。 [na jiu ba zhe ge gu shi cong shui zhong chui chu lai le 。]

english: Get out of my sight.
translation: 滚出我的视线。 [gun chu wo de shi xian 。]

english: I've had extensive plastic surgery.
translation: 我接受过广泛的整形手术。 [wo jie shou guo guang fan de zheng xing shou shu 。]

english: What sort of surgery is that? I've never heard of it. Besides, you look reasonably healthy.
translation: 那是什么样的手术？我从来没有听说过。此外，你看起来相当健康。 [na shi shen me yang de shou shu ？ wo cong lai mei you ting shuo guo 。 ci wai ， ni kan qi lai xiang dang jian kang 。]

english: Why is this relevant anyway? You still shouldn't be here.
translation: 无论如何，为什么这很重要？你还是不应该在这里。 [wu lun ru he ， wei shen me zhe hen zhong yao ？ ni hai shi bu ying gai zai zhe li 。]

english: What about the King? Surely you'd let him up here.
translation: 那么国王呢？你肯定会让他上来的。 [na me guo wang ne ？ ni ken ding hui rang ta shang lai de 。]

english: Well, yes, I suppose we'd let him up. He doesn't generally want to come up here, but if he did want to, he could.
translation: 嗯，是的，我想我们会让他放弃的。他通常不想来这里，但如果他愿意的话，他可以。 [n ， shi de ， wo xiang wo men hui rang ta fang qi de 。 ta tong chang bu xiang lai zhe li ， dan ru guo ta yuan yi de hua ， ta ke yi 。]

english: Anyway, you're not the King either. So get out of my sight.
translation: 无论如何，你也不是国王。那就滚出我的视线吧。 [wu lun ru he ， ni ye bu shi guo wang 。 na jiu gun chu wo de shi xian ba 。]

english: Yes, I know, but this is important.
translation: 是的，我知道，但这很重要。 [shi de ， wo zhi dao ， dan zhe hen zhong yao 。]

english: Ok, I'm listening. Tell me what's so important.
translation: 好的，我在听。告诉我什么如此重要。 [hao de ， wo zai ting 。 gao su wo shen me ru ci zhong yao 。]

english: There's a demon who wants to invade the city.
translation: 有一个恶魔想要入侵这座城市。 [you yi ge e mo xiang yao ru qin zhe zuo cheng shi 。]

english: Is it a powerful demon?
translation: 难道是强大的恶魔？ [nan dao shi qiang da de e mo ？]

english: Not really.
translation: 并不真地。 [bing bu zhen di 。]

english: Well, I'm sure the palace guards can deal with it, then. Thanks for the information.
translation: 嗯，那么我相信宫廷守卫能够应付得来。感谢您提供信息。 [n ， na me wo xiang xin gong ting shou wei neng gou ying fu de lai 。 gan xie nin ti gong xin xi 。]

english: Yes, very.
translation: 是的，非常。 [shi de ， fei chang 。]

english: As good as the palace guards are, I don't know if they're up to taking on a very powerful demon.
translation: 皇宫守卫的实力虽然强大，但不知道他们是否能够对付一个非常强大的恶魔。 [huang gong shou wei de shi li sui ran qiang da ， dan bu zhi dao ta men shi fou neng gou dui fu yi ge fei chang qiang da de e mo 。]

english: Yeah, the palace guards are rubbish!
translation: 是啊，宫廷侍卫都是垃圾！ [shi a ， gong ting shi wei dou shi la ji ！]

english: Yeah, they're--
translation: 是的，他们是—— [shi de ， ta men shi ——]

english: Wait! How dare you insult the palace guards? Get out of my sight!
translation: 等待！竟敢侮辱宫廷侍卫？滚出我的视线！ [deng dai ！ jing gan wu ru gong ting shi wei ？ gun chu wo de shi xian ！]

english: It's not them who are going to fight the demon, it's me.
translation: 对抗恶魔的不是他们，而是我。 [dui kang e mo de bu shi ta men ， er shi wo 。]

english: What, all by yourself? How are you going to do that?
translation: 什么，全靠你自己？你打算怎么做？ [shen me ， quan kao ni zi ji ？ ni da suan zen me zuo ？]

english: I'm going to use the powerful sword Silverlight, which I believe you have one of the keys for?
translation: 我将使用强大的银光之剑，我相信你有它的钥匙之一？ [wo jiang shi yong qiang da de yin guang zhi jian ， wo xiang xin ni you ta de yao shi zhi yi ？]

english: Yes, I do. But why should I give it to you?
translation: 是的，我愿意。但我为什么要给你呢？ [shi de ， wo yuan yi 。 dan wo wei shen me yao gei ni ne ？]

english: Fortune-teller Aris said I was destined to kill the demon.
translation: 算命师阿里斯说我注定要杀死恶魔。 [suan ming shi a li si shuo wo zhu ding yao sha si e mo 。]

english: A fortune-teller? Destiny? I don't believe in that stuff. I got where I am today by hard work, not by destiny! Why should I care what that mad old fortune-teller says?
translation: 算命先生？命运？我不相信那些东西。我能有今天的成绩，靠的是努力，不是命运！我为什么要关心那个疯狂的老算命先生说什么？ [suan ming xian sheng ？ ming yun ？ wo bu xiang xin na xie dong xi 。 wo neng you jin tian de cheng ji ， kao de shi nu li ， bu shi ming yun ！ wo wei shen me yao guan xin na ge feng kuang de lao suan ming xian sheng shuo shen me ？]

english: Otherwise the demon will destroy the city!
translation: 否则恶魔就会毁灭这座城市！ [fou ze e mo jiu hui hui mie zhe zuo cheng shi ！]

english: You can't fool me! How do I know you haven't just made that story up to get my key?
translation: 你骗不了我的！我怎么知道你编造的故事不是为了得到我的钥匙？ [ni pian bu liao wo de ！ wo zen me zhi dao ni bian zao de gu shi bu shi wei le de dao wo de yao shi ？]

english: Sir Prysin said you would give me the key.
translation: 普赖辛爵士说你会给我钥匙。 [pu lai xin jue shi shuo ni hui gei wo yao shi 。]

english: Oh, he did, did he? Well I don't report to Sir Prysin, I report directly to the king!
translation: 哦，他做到了，是吗？好吧，我不向普赖辛爵士报告，我直接向国王报告！ [o ， ta zuo dao le ， shi ma ？ hao ba ， wo bu xiang pu lai xin jue shi bao gao ， wo zhi jie xiang guo wang bao gao ！]

english: I didn't work my way up through the ranks of the palace guards so I could take orders from an ill-bred moron who only has his job because his great- grandfather was a hero with a silly name!
translation: 我从宫廷侍卫的行列里爬出来，不是为了听从一个没有教养的白痴的命令，这个白痴只是因为他的曾祖父是一个名字愚蠢的英雄才得到了他的工作！ [wo cong gong ting shi wei de hang lie li pa chu lai ， bu shi wei le ting cong yi ge mei you jiao yang de bai chi de ming ling ， zhe ge bai chi zhi shi yin wei ta de zeng zu fu shi yi ge ming zi yu chun de ying xiong cai de dao le ta de gong zuo ！]

english: Why did he give you one of the keys then?
translation: 那么他为什么给你其中一把钥匙呢？ [na me ta wei shen me gei ni qi zhong yi ba yao shi ne ？]

english: Only because the king ordered him to! The king couldn't get Sir Prysin to part with his precious ancestral sword, but he made him lock it up so he couldn't lose it.
translation: 只是因为国王命令他这样做！国王无法让普赖辛爵士放弃他珍贵的祖传剑，但他让他把它锁起来，以免丢失。 [zhi shi yin wei guo wang ming ling ta zhe yang zuo ！ guo wang wu fa rang pu lai xin jue shi fang qi ta zhen gui de zu chuan jian ， dan ta rang ta ba ta suo qi lai ， yi mian diu shi 。]

english: I got one key and I think some wizard got another. Now what happened to the third one?
translation: 我有一把钥匙，我想某个巫师有另一把。现在第三个发生了什么？ [wo you yi ba yao shi ， wo xiang mou ge wu shi you ling yi ba 。 xian zai di san ge fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: Sir Prysin dropped it down a drain!
translation: 普赖辛爵士把它扔进了下水道！ [pu lai xin jue shi ba ta reng jin le xia shui dao ！]

english: Ha ha ha! The idiot!
translation: 哈哈哈！白痴！ [ha ha ha ！ bai chi ！]

english: Okay, I'll give you the key, just so that it's you that kills the demon and not Sir Prysin!
translation: 好吧，我把钥匙给你，这样杀死恶魔的就是你，而不是普莱森爵士！ [hao ba ， wo ba yao shi gei ni ， zhe yang sha si e mo de jiu shi ni ， er bu shi pu lai sen jue shi ！]

english: Erm I forgot.
translation: 呃我忘了。 [e wo wang le 。]

english: Well it can't be that important then.
translation: 好吧，那就没那么重要了。 [hao ba ， na jiu mei na me zhong yao le 。]

english: How do you know?
translation: 你怎么知道？ [ni zen me zhi dao ？]

english: Just go away.
translation: 走开吧。 [zou kai ba 。]

english: The castle has just received its ale delivery.
translation: 城堡刚刚收到了啤酒。 [cheng bao gang gang shou dao le pi jiu 。]

english: Now that is important. However I'm the wrong person to speak to about it. Go talk to the kitchen staff.
translation: 现在这很重要。然而我不是谈论这件事的人。去和厨房工作人员谈谈。 [xian zai zhe hen zhong yao 。 ran er wo bu shi tan lun zhe jian shi de ren 。 qu he chu fang gong zuo ren yuan tan tan 。]

english: I am one of the palace guards.
translation: 我是宫廷侍卫之一。 [wo shi gong ting shi wei zhi yi 。]

english: I'm a new recruit.
translation: 我是一名新兵。 [wo shi yi ming xin bing 。]

english: I've had extensive plastic surgery.
translation: 我接受过广泛的整形手术。 [wo jie shou guo guang fan de zheng xing shou shu 。]

english: What about the King?
translation: 那么国王呢？ [na me guo wang ne ？]

english: Yes I know, but this is important.
translation: 是的，我知道，但这很重要。 [shi de ， wo zhi dao ， dan zhe hen zhong yao 。]

english: There's a demon who wants to invade this city.
translation: 有一个恶魔想要入侵这座城市。 [you yi ge e mo xiang yao ru qin zhe zuo cheng shi 。]

english: Not really.
translation: 并不真地。 [bing bu zhen di 。]

english: Yes, very.
translation: 是的，非常。 [shi de ， fei chang 。]

english: Yeah, the palace guards are rubbish!
translation: 是啊，宫廷侍卫都是垃圾！ [shi a ， gong ting shi wei dou shi la ji ！]

english: It's not them who are going to fight the demon, it's me.
translation: 对抗恶魔的不是他们，而是我。 [dui kang e mo de bu shi ta men ， er shi wo 。]

english: Fortune-teller Aris said I was destined to kill the demon.
translation: 算命师阿里斯说我注定要杀死恶魔。 [suan ming shi a li si shuo wo zhu ding yao sha si e mo 。]

english: Otherwise the demon will destroy the city
translation: 否则恶魔就会毁灭这座城市 [fou ze e mo jiu hui hui mie zhe zuo cheng shi]

english: Sir Prysin said you would give me the key
translation: 普赖辛爵士说你会给我钥匙 [pu lai xin jue shi shuo ni hui gei wo yao shi]

english: Otherwise the demon will destroy the city!
translation: 否则恶魔就会毁灭这座城市！ [fou ze e mo jiu hui hui mie zhe zuo cheng shi ！]

english: Sir Prysin said you would give me the key.
translation: 普赖辛爵士说你会给我钥匙。 [pu lai xin jue shi shuo ni hui gei wo yao shi 。]

english: Why did he give you one of the keys then?
translation: 那么他为什么给你其中一把钥匙呢？ [na me ta wei shen me gei ni qi zhong yi ba yao shi ne ？]

english: Erm I forgot.
translation: 呃我忘了。 [e wo wang le 。]

english: The castle has just received its ale delivery.
translation: 城堡刚刚收到了啤酒。 [cheng bao gang gang shou dao le pi jiu 。]

english: What's going on here?
translation: 这是怎么回事？ [zhe shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: Beyond this wall you'll find the Kebos Lowlands. Most of the region is lizardman territory. We're here to keep them from entering Kourend.
translation: 越过这堵墙，您会发现科博斯低地。该地区的大部分地区都是蜥蜴人的领地。我们来这里是为了阻止他们进入库伦德。 [yue guo zhe du qiang ， nin hui fa xian ke bo si di di 。 gai di qu de da bu fen di qu dou shi xi yi ren de ling di 。 wo men lai zhe li shi wei le zu zhi ta men jin ru ku lun de 。]

english: We used to keep this passage properly barricaded shut, but then the fancy historians from the Arceuus Library wanted to go do some research out there.
translation: 我们曾经把这条通道适当地封锁起来，但后来阿尔修斯图书馆的那些出色的历史学家想去那里做一些研究。 [wo men ceng jing ba zhe tiao tong dao shi dang di feng suo qi lai ， dan hou lai a er xiu si tu shu guan de na xie chu se de li shi xue jia xiang qu na li zuo yi xie yan jiu 。]

english: Soon the farmers joined them, and before you knew it, everyone wanted to go explore. Some of them have even started living out there.
translation: 很快，农民们也加入了他们的行列，不知不觉间，每个人都想去探索。他们中的一些人甚至开始在那里生活。 [hen kuai ， nong min men ye jia ru le ta men de hang lie ， bu zhi bu jue jian ， mei ge ren dou xiang qu tan suo 。 ta men zhong de yi xie ren shen zhi kai shi zai na li sheng huo 。]

english: I can see it all ending badly, but that's the problem with intellectuals - they always think they know better.
translation: 我可以预见这一切的结局都很糟糕，但这就是知识分子的问题——他们总是认为自己知道得更多。 [wo ke yi yu jian zhe yi qie de jie ju dou hen zao gao ， dan zhe jiu shi zhi shi fen zi de wen ti —— ta men zong shi ren wei zi ji zhi dao de geng duo 。]

english: Anyway, maybe they'll all get themselves killed. Then we can put the barricade back up.
translation: 无论如何，也许他们都会被杀掉。然后我们就可以把路障放回去了。 [wu lun ru he ， ye xu ta men du hui bei sha diao 。 ran hou wo men jiu ke yi ba lu zhang fang hui qu le 。]

english: If you go out there yourself, give the lizardmen a kicking from me. They've killed too many of my soldiers.
translation: 如果你自己出去的话，就把蜥蜴人从我身边踢开。他们杀了我太多的士兵了。 [ru guo ni zi ji chu qu de hua ， jiu ba xi yi ren cong wo shen bian ti kai 。 ta men sha le wo tai duo di shi bing le 。]

english: Beyond these walls is a Lizardman settlement, we're defending against it.
translation: 墙外是蜥蜴人定居点，我们正在防御它。 [qiang wai shi xi yi ren ding ju dian ， wo men zheng zai fang yu ta 。]

english: Why do they hate humans?
translation: 他们为什么讨厌人类？ [ta men wei shen me tao yan ren lei ？]

english: Who knows, all I know is offence is the best type of defence, we will attack soon, will you help us, brave warrior?
translation: 谁知道呢，我只知道进攻是最好的防守，我们很快就会进攻，你会帮助我们吗，勇敢的战士？ [shui zhi dao ne ， wo zhi zhi dao jin gong shi zui hao de fang shou ， wo men hen kuai jiu hui jin gong ， ni hui bang zhu wo men ma ， yong gan de zhan shi ？]

english: I don't know... Sounds dangerous.
translation: 我不知道...听起来很危险。 [wo bu zhi dao ... ting qi lai hen wei xian 。]

english: Oh, the assault is not for a while, go train and prepare, for there will be all sorts of grand rewards from this expedition.
translation: 呵呵，进攻不是一时半刻，快去训练准备吧，这次远征将会有各种丰厚的奖励。 [he he ， jin gong bu shi yi shi ban ke ， kuai qu xun lian zhun bei ba ， zhe ci yuan zheng jiang hui you ge zhong feng hou de jiang li 。]

english: Rewards? I'm in! Hopefully some brand new armour or something.
translation: 奖励？我进来了！希望有一些全新的盔甲之类的。 [jiang li ？ wo jin lai le ！ xi wang you yi xie quan xin de kui jia zhi lei de 。]

english: Hmm...
Oh dear, this ship is in a terrible state. And I just can't get the items I need to repair it because Shilo village is overrun with zombies.
translation: 哦天哪，这艘船的状况很糟糕。而且我无法获得修复它所需的物品，因为希洛村已经被僵尸占领了。 [o tian na ， zhe sou chuan de zhuang kuang hen zao gao 。 er qie wo wu fa huo de xiu fu ta suo xu de wu pin ， yin wei xi luo cun yi jing bei jiang shi zhan ling le 。]

english: Hello there shipmate! I sail to Khazard Port and to Port Sarim. Where are you bound?
translation: 船友你好！我航行到卡扎德港和萨里姆港。你被束缚在哪里？ [chuan you ni hao ！ wo hang xing dao ka zha de gang he sa li mu gang 。 ni bei shu fu zai na li ？]

english: I see you don't have a ticket for the ship, my colleague normally only sells them in Shilo village. But I could sell you one for a small additional charge. Shall we say [number] gold pieces
translation: 我看你没有船票，我同事一般只在希洛村卖。但我可以卖给你一个，但要收取少量的额外费用。我们可以说[数量]金币吗 [wo kan ni mei you chuan piao ， wo tong shi yi ban zhi zai xi luo cun mai 。 dan wo ke yi mai gei ni yi ge ， dan yao shou qu shao liang de e wai fei yong 。 wo men ke yi shuo [ shu liang ] jin bi ma]

english: Yes, I'll buy a ticket for the ship.
translation: 是的，我要买一张船票。 [shi de ， wo yao mai yi zhang chuan piao 。]

english: Sorry me old shipmate, but you seem to be  financially challenged at the moment. Come back when your coffers are full!
translation: 对不起，老船友，但你现在似乎遇到了经济困难。等你的金库满了再回来吧！ [dui bu qi ， lao chuan you ， dan ni xian zai si hu yu dao le jing ji kun nan 。 deng ni de jin ku man le zai hui lai ba ！]

english: It's a good deal and no mistake. Here you go me old shipmate, here's your ticket.
translation: 这是一笔很好的交易，而且没有错误。给你，老船友，这是你的票。 [zhe shi yi bi hen hao de jiao yi ， er qie mei you cuo wu 。 gei ni ， lao chuan you ， zhe shi ni de piao 。]

english: Ok, now you have your ticket, do you want to sail anywhere?
translation: 好的，现在您已经拿到了船票，您想航行到任何地方吗？ [hao de ， xian zai nin yi jing na dao le chuan piao ， nin xiang hang xing dao ren he di fang ma ？]

english: Khazard Port please.
translation: 请卡扎德港。 [qing ka zha de gang 。]

english: Very well then me old shipmate, I'll just take your ticket and then we'll set sail.
translation: 好吧，那么我的老船友，我拿走你的船票，然后我们就出发了。 [hao ba ， na me wo de lao chuan you ， wo na zou ni de chuan piao ， ran hou wo men jiu chu fa le 。]

english: You arrive safely in the quiet fishing port of Khazard.
translation: 您安全抵达安静的卡扎德渔港。 [nin an quan di da an jing de ka zha de yu gang 。]

english: Port Sarim please.
translation: 沙里姆港请。 [sha li mu gang qing 。]

english: The ship arrives in busy Port Sarim.
translation: 船抵达繁忙的沙里姆港。 [chuan di da fan mang de sha li mu gang 。]

english: Nowhere just at the moment thanks.
translation: 目前无处可去，谢谢。 [mu qian wu chu ke qu ， xie xie 。]

english: Very well then me old shipmate, Just let me know if you change your mind.

translation: 怎么了？ [zen me le ？]

english: It's my husband, he works on a fishing platform. Once a month he takes our son, Kennith, out with him.
translation: 这是我丈夫，他在钓鱼平台工作。他每个月都会带我们的儿子肯尼斯出去一次。 [zhe shi wo zhang fu ， ta zai diao yu ping tai gong zuo 。 ta mei ge yue du hui dai wo men de er zi ken ni si chu qu yi ci 。]

english: They usually write to me regularly, but I've heard nothing all week. It's very strange.
translation: 他们通常定期给我写信，但我整个星期都没有收到任何消息。这很奇怪。 [ta men tong chang ding qi gei wo xie xin ， dan wo zheng ge xing qi dou mei you shou dao ren he xiao xi 。 zhe hen qi guai 。]

english: Maybe the post was lost!
translation: 也许帖子丢失了！ [ye xu tie zi diu shi le ！]

english: Maybe, but no-one's heard from the other fishermen on the platform. Their families are becoming quite concerned.
translation: 也许吧，但没有人听到平台上其他渔民的消息。他们的家人变得非常担心。 [ye xu ba ， dan mei you ren ting dao ping tai shang qi ta yu min de xiao xi 。 ta men de jia ren bian de fei chang dan xin 。]

english: Is there any chance you could visit the platform and find out what's going on?
translation: 您是否有机会访问该平台并了解发生了什么？ [nin shi fou you ji hui fang wen gai ping tai bing liao jie fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: I suppose so, how do I get there?
translation: 我想是的，我该如何到达那里？ [wo xiang shi de ， wo gai ru he dao da na li ？]

english: That's very good of you [player]. My friend Holgart will take you there.
translation: 你真是太好了[玩家]。我的朋友霍尔加特会带你去那里。 [ni zhen shi tai hao le [ wan jia ]。 wo de peng you huo er jia te hui dai ni qu na li 。]

english: Ok, I'll go and see if they're ok.
translation: 好的，我去看看他们是否还好。 [hao de ， wo qu kan kan ta men shi fou hai hao 。]

english: I'll reward you for your time. It'll give me peace of mind to know Kennith and my husband, Kent, are safe.
translation: 我会奖励你的时间。知道肯尼斯和我丈夫肯特都安全，我会感到安心。 [wo hui jiang li ni de shi jian 。 zhi dao ken ni si he wo zhang fu ken te dou an quan ， wo hui gan dao an xin 。]

english: I'm sorry, I'm too busy.
translation: 对不起，我太忙了。 [dui bu qi ， wo tai mang le 。]

english: That's a shame.
translation: 太可惜了。 [tai ke xi le 。]

english: Bye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Bye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Hello Caroline.
translation: 你好，卡罗琳。 [ni hao ， ka luo lin 。]

english: Brave [player], have you any news about my son and his father?
translation: 勇敢的[玩家]，你有我儿子和他父亲的消息吗？ [yong gan de [ wan jia ]， ni you wo er zi he ta fu qin de xiao xi ma ？]

english: I'm working on it now Caroline.
translation: 我现在正在努力，卡罗琳。 [wo xian zai zheng zai nu li ， ka luo lin 。]

english: Please bring them back safe and sound.
translation: 请把他们平安带回来。 [qing ba ta men ping an dai hui lai 。]

english: I'll do my best.
translation: 我会尽力的。 [wo hui jin li de 。]

english: Hello again.
translation: 又好。 [you hao 。]

english: Hello traveller, how are you?
translation: 你好，旅行者，你好吗？ [ni hao ， lv xing zhe ， ni hao ma ？]

english: Not bad thanks, yourself?
translation: 还不错，谢谢，你自己吗？ [hai bu cuo ， xie xie ， ni zi ji ma ？]

english: I'm good. Busy as always looking after Kent and Kennith but no complaints.
translation: 我很好。一如既往地忙于照顾肯特和肯尼斯，但没有抱怨。 [wo hen hao 。 yi ru ji wang di mang yu zhao gu ken te he ken ni si ， dan mei you bao yuan 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Hey there. How're you holding up?
translation: 嘿。你还坚持得怎么样？ [hei 。 ni hai jian chi de zen me yang ？]

english: Not too bad. Still, I hope we can get rid of these spots soon.
translation: 还不错。尽管如此，我还是希望我们能尽快摆脱这些斑点。 [hai bu cuo 。 jin guan ru ci ， wo hai shi xi wang wo men neng jin kuai bai tuo zhe xie ban dian 。]

english: The embalmer has been importing a soothing balm from a merchant called Ali M. It's meant to stop the itching.
translation: 防腐师从一位名叫阿里·M (Ali M) 的商人那里进口了一种舒缓香膏。它的目的是止痒。 [fang fu shi cong yi wei ming jiao a li ·M (Ali M)  de shang ren na li jin kou le yi zhong shu huan xiang gao 。 ta de mu di shi zhi yang 。]

english: Does it work?
translation: 有效吗？ [you xiao ma ？]

english: Not even remotely, but it sure does keep the flies away.
translation: 虽然不是很远，但它确实可以让苍蝇远离。 [sui ran bu shi hen yuan ， dan ta que shi ke yi rang cang ying yuan li 。]

english: Much better now that we've finally got rid of those spots.
translation: 现在我们终于摆脱了这些斑点，好多了。 [xian zai wo men zhong yu bai tuo le zhe xie ban dian ， hao duo le 。]

english: That's great to hear! All the best.
translation: 很高兴听到这个消息！一切顺利。 [hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi ！ yi qie shun li 。]

english: What are you doing?
translation: 你在干什么？ [ni zai gan shen me ？]

english: I thought this acne potion might help ease your spots.
translation: 我认为这种痤疮药水可能有助于缓解斑点。 [wo ren wei zhe zhong cuo chuang yao shui ke neng you zhu yu huan jie ban dian 。]

english: What? You intolerable, insufferable idiot. That won't work! I would say get out of my sight but that's not far enough away!
translation: 什么？你这个令人难以忍受、令人难以忍受的白痴。那是不行的！我会说滚出我的视线，但这还不够远！ [shen me ？ ni zhe ge ling ren nan yi ren shou 、 ling ren nan yi ren shou de bai chi 。 na shi bu xing de ！ wo hui shuo gun chu wo de shi xian ， dan zhe hai bu gou yuan ！]

english: I was just trying to help.
translation: 我只是想帮忙。 [wo zhi shi xiang bang mang 。]

english: Clear off before I give you something to feel sorry about!
translation: 在我给你带来一些让你感到遗憾的事情之前，先走开！ [zai wo gei ni dai lai yi xie rang ni gan dao yi han de shi qing zhi qian ， xian zou kai ！]

english: Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab.
translation: 嗯……看起来那只骆驼可以做一顿美味的烤肉串。 [n …… kan qi lai na zhi luo tuo ke yi zuo yi dun mei wei de kao rou chuan 。]

english: That camel looks vicious, it'll probably eat me if I go too near!
translation: 那只骆驼看起来很凶猛，我走得太近它可能会吃掉我！ [na zhi luo tuo kan qi lai hen xiong meng ， wo zou de tai jin ta ke neng hui chi diao wo ！]

english: I wonder if I can catch something from that camel?
translation: 我不知道我能从那只骆驼身上抓到什么东西吗？ [wo bu zhi dao wo neng cong na zhi luo tuo shen shang zhua dao shen me dong xi ma ？]

english: You and whose army mate? You and whose army?
translation: 你和谁的战友？你和谁的军队？ [ni he shei de zhan you ？ ni he shei de jun dui ？]

english: Oooh, sorry, didn't realise you could hear me?
translation: 哦，抱歉，没意识到你能听到我说话吗？ [o ， bao qian ， mei yi shi dao ni neng ting dao wo shuo hua ma ？]

english: Well I can, so watch what you say in future.
translation: 嗯，我可以，所以以后注意你说的话。 [n ， wo ke yi ， suo yi yi hou zhu yi ni shuo de hua 。]

english: Righto!
translation: 对了！ [dui le ！]

english: Well, I have to say, I am pretty peckish, but thankfully, I don't eat humans... often.
translation: 好吧，我不得不说，我很饿，但幸运的是，我不经常吃人。 [hao ba ， wo bu de bu shuo ， wo hen e ， dan xing yun de shi ， wo bu jing chang chi ren 。]

english: You'll catch a stiff kick if you talk about me like that again!
translation: 如果你再这样谈论我，你会被狠狠踢一脚的！ [ru guo ni zai zhe yang tan lun wo ， ni hui bei hen hen ti yi jiao de ！]

english: Yes [sir/m'am]? Can I help you at all?
translation: 是吗[先生/女士]？我可以帮助你吗？ [shi ma [ xian sheng / nv shi ]？ wo ke yi bang zhu ni ma ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: You're in the main waiting area of Keldagrim Carts- station.
translation: 您现在位于 Keldagrim Carts 车站的主要等候区。 [nin xian zai wei yu  Keldagrim Carts  che zhan de zhu yao deng hou qu 。]

english: Cart-station? What goes on here then?
translation: 购物车站？那么这里发生了什么？ [gou wu che zhan ？ na me zhe li fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: Keldagrim is the hub of all the traffic of the dwarven realm. Almost every dwarven outpost has railtracks leading to Keldagrim, connecting them all for easy travel and transportation of goods.
translation: 凯尔达格林是矮人王国所有交通的枢纽。几乎每个矮人前哨站都有通往凯尔达格林的铁路，将它们连接起来，方便旅行和货物运输。 [kai er da ge lin shi ai ren wang guo suo you jiao tong de shu niu 。 ji hu mei ge ai ren qian shao zhan dou you tong wang kai er da ge lin de tie lu ， jiang ta men lian jie qi lai ， fang bian lv xing he huo wu yun shu 。]

english: Amazing! And what powers the carts? Magic?
translation: 惊人的！推车的动力是什么？魔法？ [jing ren de ！ tui che de dong li shi shen me ？ mo fa ？]

english: Oh, no no, we dwarves don't use magic. No, all of this is powered by steam engines, developed during the past few centuries after the Consortium came to power.
translation: 哦，不不，我们矮人不使用魔法。不，这一切都是由蒸汽机提供动力，是财团上台后几个世纪里发展起来的。 [o ， bu bu ， wo men ai ren bu shi yong mo fa 。 bu ， zhe yi qie dou shi you zheng qi ji ti gong dong li ， shi cai tuan shang tai hou ji ge shi ji li fa zhan qi lai de 。]

english: Thanks for the info.
translation: 谢谢你的信息。 [xie xie ni de xin xi 。]

english: Where can you take me?
translation: 你能带我去哪里？ [ni neng dai wo qu na li ？]

english: Let's see, we could let you travel to Ice Mountain, or to the Grand Exchange.
translation: 让我们看看，我们可以让你去冰山，或者去大交易所。 [rang wo men kan kan ， wo men ke yi rang ni qu bing shan ， huo zhe qu da jiao yi suo 。]

english: I could also let you go to White Wolf Mountain, since you've befriended our brothers there.
translation: 我也可以让你去白狼山，因为你在那里和我们兄弟交上了朋友。 [wo ye ke yi rang ni qu bai lang shan ， yin wei ni zai na li he wo men xiong di jiao shang le peng you 。]

english: I'd like to buy a ticket.
translation: 我想买票。 [wo xiang mai piao 。]

english: And where would you like to go?
translation: 您想去哪里？ [nin xiang qu na li ？]

english: I'd like to buy a ticket to the Grand Exchange.
translation: 我想买一张去大交易所的票。 [wo xiang mai yi zhang qu da jiao yi suo de piao 。]

english: Oh, that service is free. Just hop on a cart on Track 3, and away you go.
translation: 哦，这项服务是免费的。只需在 3 号轨道上跳上一辆小车，然后就可以出发了。 [o ， zhe xiang fu wu shi mian fei de 。 zhi xu zai  3  hao gui dao shang tiao shang yi liang xiao che ， ran hou jiu ke yi chu fa le 。]

english: I'd like to buy a ticket to Ice Mountain.
translation: 我想买一张去冰山的票。 [wo xiang mai yi zhang qu bing shan de piao 。]

english: That'll be 150 gold coins please.
translation: 那就150金币吧。 [na jiu 150 jin bi ba 。]

english: I'm sorry, I've run out of money.
translation: 对不起，我的钱已经用完了。 [dui bu qi ， wo de qian yi jing yong wan le 。]

english: I'm sorry, [sir/madam], but I don't believe you can hold the ticket.
translation: 抱歉，[先生/女士]，我不相信您能保留这张票。 [bao qian ，[ xian sheng / nv shi ]， wo bu xiang xin nin neng bao liu zhe zhang piao 。]

english: Thanks, carts to Ice Mountain depart from track 1.
translation: 谢谢，前往冰山的车从 1 号轨道出发。 [xie xie ， qian wang bing shan de che cong  1  hao gui dao chu fa 。]

english: No thanks, I changed my mind.
translation: 不，谢谢，我改变主意了。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo gai bian zhu yi le 。]

english: You're alright, I suppose... I can let you go for 75 coins. And remember, carts to Ice Mountain depart from track 1.
translation: 你没问题吧，我想……我只要 75 个硬币就可以放你走。请记住，前往冰山的车从 1 号轨道出发。 [ni mei wen ti ba ， wo xiang …… wo zhi yao  75  ge ying bi jiu ke yi fang ni zou 。 qing ji zhu ， qian wang bing shan de che cong  1  hao gui dao chu fa 。]

english: I'd like to buy a ticket to White Wolf Mountain.
translation: 我想买一张去白狼山的票。 [wo xiang mai yi zhang qu bai lang shan de piao 。]

english: That'll be 100 gold coins please.
translation: 那就100金币吧。 [na jiu 100 jin bi ba 。]

english: Thanks. Go to track 4 for carts heading to White Wolf Mountain.
translation: 谢谢。前往 4 号轨道寻找前往白狼山的小车。 [xie xie 。 qian wang  4  hao gui dao xun zhao qian wang bai lang shan de xiao che 。]

english: You're a decent human, I suppose... I can let you go for 50 coins. Go to track 4 for the carts heading to White Wolf Mountain.
translation: 我想你是一个正派的人...我可以花 50 个硬币放你走。前往 4 号轨道寻找前往白狼山的车。 [wo xiang ni shi yi ge zheng pai de ren ... wo ke yi hua  50  ge ying bi fang ni zou 。 qian wang  4  hao gui dao xun zhao qian wang bai lang shan de che 。]

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。 [wo de zou le 。]

english: Just remember, wherever you go, you go there faster through Keldagrim Carts.
translation: 请记住，无论您走到哪里，通过凯尔达格林手推车您都可以更快地到达那里。 [qing ji zhu ， wu lun nin zou dao na li ， tong guo kai er da ge lin shou tui che nin dou ke yi geng kuai di dao da na li 。]

english: That service is free. Just hop on a cart on Track 3, and away you go.
translation: 该服务是免费的。只需在 3 号轨道上跳上一辆小车，然后就可以出发了。 [gai fu wu shi mian fei de 。 zhi xu zai  3  hao gui dao shang tiao shang yi liang xiao che ， ran hou jiu ke yi chu fa le 。]

english: Anything I can help you with?
translation: 有什么我可以帮你的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang ni de ma ？]

english: This is the Keldagrim Carts-station, human.
translation: 这是凯尔达格林马车站，人类。 [zhe shi kai er da ge lin ma che zhan ， ren lei 。]

english: Out of the way human!
translation: 人类别挡道了！ [ren lei bie dang dao le ！]

english: Why, what's happening?
translation: 为什么，发生了什么事？ [wei shen me ， fa sheng le shen me shi ？]

english: There's important traffic coming through here and I don't want any stray humans distracting me.
translation: 这里有重要的交通，我不想让任何流浪的人分散我的注意力。 [zhe li you zhong yao de jiao tong ， wo bu xiang rang ren he liu lang de ren fen san wo de zhu yi li 。]

english: Tickets, tickets, get your tickets here!
translation: 票，票，来这里买票！ [piao ， piao ， lai zhe li mai piao ！]

english: Wot you want?
translation: 你想要什么？ [ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Can't you see I'm 'aving a lil' break?
translation: 你没看到我正在“休息”吗？ [ni mei kan dao wo zheng zai “ xiu xi ” ma ？]

english: Now that you mention it, yes.
translation: 既然你提到了，是的。 [ji ran ni ti dao le ， shi de 。]

english: Then why did ya waste my time?
translation: 那你为什么还要浪费我的时间呢？ [na ni wei shen me hai yao lang fei wo de shi jian ne ？]

english: Ahoy up there! Would you like to ride our minecart to Keldagrim? It's free.
translation: 哎呀，上面！你想乘坐我们的矿车去凯尔达格林吗？它是免费的。 [ai ya ， shang mian ！ ni xiang cheng zuo wo men de kuang che qu kai er da ge lin ma ？ ta shi mian fei de 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Ahoy up there! You'd better pick up your follower before you come down here and ride the minecart.
translation: 哎呀，上面！你最好在来这里坐矿车之前先带上你的追随者。 [ai ya ， shang mian ！ ni zui hao zai lai zhe li zuo kuang che zhi qian xian dai shang ni de zhui sui zhe 。]

english: Watch out, [sir/madam]! Don't want anything to run over your follower!
translation: 小心，[先生/女士]！不想让任何东西压倒你的追随者！ [xiao xin ，[ xian sheng / nv shi ]！ bu xiang rang ren he dong xi ya dao ni de zhui sui zhe ！]

english: Tickets! Tickets!
translation: 门票！门票！ [men piao ！ men piao ！]

english: Buy your tickets here!
translation: 在这里购买门票！ [zai zhe li gou mai men piao ！]

english: Selling tickets!
translation: 卖票啦！ [mai piao la ！]

english: Ice Mountain carts departing from Track 1!
translation: 冰山车从1号轨道出发！ [bing shan che cong 1 hao gui dao chu fa ！]

english: Grand Exchange carts departing from Track 3!
translation: Grand Exchange 车从 3 号轨道出发！ [Grand Exchange  che cong  3  hao gui dao chu fa ！]

english: White Wolf Mountain carts departing from Track 4!
translation: 白狼山车从4号轨道出发！ [bai lang shan che cong 4 hao gui dao chu fa ！]

english: Mind the cart!
translation: 当心购物车！ [dang xin gou wu che ！]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Where can you take me?
translation: 你能带我去哪里？ [ni neng dai wo qu na li ？]

english: I'd like to buy a ticket.
translation: 我想买票。 [wo xiang mai piao 。]

english: To the Grand Exchange.
translation: 前往大交易所。 [qian wang da jiao yi suo 。]

english: To Ice Mountain.
translation: 前往冰山。 [qian wang bing shan 。]

english: Buy.
translation: 买。 [mai 。]

english: Don't buy.
translation: 不要买。 [bu yao mai 。]

english: [Charm] Only pay half.
translation: [魅力] 只需付一半。 [[ mei li ]  zhi xu fu yi ban 。]

english: To White Wolf Mountain.
translation: 前往白狼山。 [qian wang bai lang shan 。]

english: Nowhere.
translation: 无处。 [wu chu 。]

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。 [wo de zou le 。]

english: Grand Exchange (free)
translation: 大交换（免费） [da jiao huan （ mian fei ）]

english: Ice Mountain (150 coins)
translation: 冰山（150币） [bing shan （150 bi ）]

english: White Wolf Mountain (100 coins)
translation: 白狼山（100币） [bai lang shan （100 bi ）]

english: Cancel
translation: 取消 [qu xiao]

english: Ice Mountain (75 coins)
translation: 冰山（75币） [bing shan （75 bi ）]

english: White Wolf Mountain (50 coins)
translation: 白狼山（50币） [bai lang shan （50 bi ）]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm an employee of Keldagrim Carts. I make sure the carts in this area run on time and that people pay their fares.
translation: 我是凯尔达格林手推车的员工。我确保该地区的手推车准时运行并且人们支付车费。 [wo shi kai er da ge lin shou tui che de yuan gong 。 wo que bao gai di qu de shou tui che zhun shi yun xing bing qie ren men zhi fu che fei 。]

english: I don't think I'm allowed to take you into the city of Keldagrim, human. Perhaps when you find another way into the city and talk to someone of importance there you will be allowed to.
translation: 我认为我不被允许带你进入凯尔达格林市，人类。也许当你找到另一条进入城市并与那里的重要人物交谈时，你就会被允许。 [wo ren wei wo bu bei yun xu dai ni jin ru kai er da ge lin shi ， ren lei 。 ye xu dang ni zhao dao ling yi tiao jin ru cheng shi bing yu na li de zhong yao ren wu jiao tan shi ， ni jiu hui bei yun xu 。]

english: This track leads right up to Keldagrim. Only stop.
translation: 这条小路一直通向凯尔达格林。只能停下来。 [zhe tiao xiao lu yi zhi tong xiang kai er da ge lin 。 zhi neng ting xia lai 。]
