translation: 为什么？ [wei shen me ？]

english: Well, ye see them Jungle Horrors? Well down in the caves there be Cave Horrors.
translation: 好吧，你看到丛林恐怖了吗？洞穴深处有洞穴恐怖。 [hao ba ， ni kan dao cong lin kong bu le ma ？ dong xue shen chu you dong xue kong bu 。]

english: They are bigger, badder, meaner, and have a howl that freezes the blood in yer veins.
translation: 它们更大、更凶猛、更卑鄙，而且发出的嚎叫声可以冻结你血管中的血液。 [ta men geng da 、 geng xiong meng 、 geng bei bi ， er qie fa chu de hao jiao sheng ke yi dong jie ni xue guan zhong de xue ye 。]

english: Wearin' earmuffs or a helmet won't work, cos them masks they wear make the sound magical. Only thing that works is wearin' a Witchwood Icon.
translation: 戴耳罩或头盔是行不通的，因为他们戴上的面具会让声音变得神奇。唯一有效的方法就是佩戴女巫森林图标。 [dai er zhao huo tou kui shi xing bu tong de ， yin wei ta men dai shang de mian ju hui rang sheng yin bian de shen qi 。 wei yi you xiao de fang fa jiu shi pei dai nv wu sen lin tu biao 。]

english: That is, o'course, if ye can see them, cos if ye don't have any light down there then yer likely te be picked te bones by the insects before the Horrors get ye.
translation: 也就是说，当然，如果你能看到它们，因为如果你那里没有任何光，那么你很可能会在恐怖袭击你之前被昆虫啄食骨头。 [ye jiu shi shuo ， dang ran ， ru guo ni neng kan dao ta men ， yin wei ru guo ni na li mei you ren he guang ， na me ni hen ke neng hui zai kong bu xi ji ni zhi qian bei kun chong zhuo shi gu tou 。]

english: I see, thanks for the warning.
translation: 我明白了，谢谢你的警告。 [wo ming bai le ， xie xie ni de jing gao 。]

english: Yer welcome.
translation: 欢迎。 [huan ying 。]

english: Be ye some form of simpleton? Do ye not hear the howlin' of the Horrors?
translation: 你们是某种傻瓜吗？你们没有听到恐怖的嚎叫吗？ [ni men shi mou zhong sha gua ma ？ ni men mei you ting dao kong bu de hao jiao ma ？]

english: Well, I can hear something now you mention it...
translation: 好吧，现在你提到我能听到一些事情...... [hao ba ， xian zai ni ti dao wo neng ting dao yi xie shi qing ......]

english: That be them, howlin', always howlin'!
translation: 就是他们，嚎叫，永远嚎叫！ [jiu shi ta men ， hao jiao ， yong yuan hao jiao ！]

english: If ye value yer limbs ye'll put that Icon round yer neck, and hope they don't come out into the light!
translation: 如果你珍视你的四肢，你就会把那个圣像挂在你的脖子上，并希望它们不要暴露在阳光下！ [ru guo ni zhen shi ni de si zhi ， ni jiu hui ba na ge sheng xiang gua zai ni de bo zi shang ， bing xi wang ta men bu yao bao lu zai yang guang xia ！]

english: Err, all right, I'll get right on that.
translation: 呃，好吧，我马上就说。 [e ， hao ba ， wo ma shang jiu shuo 。]

english: Be ye here te deal with the Horrors?
translation: 你在这儿对付恐怖分子吗？ [ni zai zhe er dui fu kong bu fen zi ma ？]

english: I might well give it a shot.
translation: 我可能会尝试一下。 [wo ke neng hui chang shi yi xia 。]

english: Aye, well, keep yer Icon with ye if ye wants te walk out alive again.
translation: 是的，好吧，如果你想再次活着走出去，就把你的圣像带在身边。 [shi de ， hao ba ， ru guo ni xiang zai ci huo zhe zou chu qu ， jiu ba ni de sheng xiang dai zai shen bian 。]

english: Don't worry, I will.
translation: 别担心，我会的。 [bie dan xin ， wo hui de 。]

english: Greetings! Have you come to gaze in rapture at the natural beauty of Falador's parkland?
translation: 问候！您是否对法拉多公园的自然美景感到着迷？ [wen hou ！ nin shi fou dui fa la duo gong yuan de zi ran mei jing gan dao zhao mi ？]

english: Um, yes, very nice. Lots of... trees and stuff.
translation: 嗯，是的，非常好。很多……树木和其他东西。 [n ， shi de ， fei chang hao 。 hen duo …… shu mu he qi ta dong xi 。]

english: Trees! I do so love trees! And flowers! And squirrels!
translation: 树！我真是太爱树了！还有鲜花！还有松鼠！ [shu ！ wo zhen shi tai ai shu le ！ hai you xian hua ！ hai you song shu ！]

english: Sorry, I have a strange urge to be somewhere else.
translation: 抱歉，我有一种奇怪的冲动，想去别的地方。 [bao qian ， wo you yi zhong qi guai de chong dong ， xiang qu bie de di fang 。]

english: Player runs away from Cecilia
translation: 玩家逃离塞西莉亚 [wan jia tao li sai xi li ya]

english: Come back to me soon and we can talk again about trees!
translation: 尽快回到我身边，我们可以再次谈论树木！ [jin kuai hui dao wo shen bian ， wo men ke yi zai ci tan lun shu mu ！]

english: Greetings! If you have come to gaze in rapture at the natural beauty of Falador’s parkland, then I have bad news.
translation: 问候！如果您欣喜若狂地欣赏法拉多公园的自然美景，那么我有坏消息。 [wen hou ！ ru guo nin xin xi ruo kuang di xin shang fa la duo gong yuan de zi ran mei jing ， na me wo you huai xiao xi 。]

english: Oh no! What happened?
translation: 哦不！发生了什么？ [o bu ！ fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: We got some impromptu visitors to the park. They came out of nowhere and made an awful mess of the place.
translation: 我们有一些即兴的游客来到公园。他们不知从哪里冒出来，把这个地方搞得一团糟。 [wo men you yi xie ji xing de you ke lai dao gong yuan 。 ta men bu zhi cong na li mao chu lai ， ba zhe ge di fang gao de yi tuan zao 。]

english: They trampled the flowers, startled the ducks, dug new holes in the ground…
translation: 他们践踏花朵，惊吓鸭子，在地上挖新洞…… [ta men jian ta hua duo ， jing xia ya zi ， zai di shang wa xin dong ……]

english: That’s terrible. Who are these hooligans?
translation: 那太糟糕了。这些流氓是谁？ [na tai zao gao le 。 zhe xie liu mang shi shui ？]

english: That’s not all! I had plans to decorate the park for Christmas, and they went and chewed some of the decorations.
translation: 这还不是全部！我计划在圣诞节装饰公园，他们就去咀嚼了一些装饰品。 [zhe hai bu shi quan bu ！ wo ji hua zai sheng dan jie zhuang shi gong yuan ， ta men jiu qu ju jue le yi xie zhuang shi pin 。]

english: How deplorable! Wait, did you say ‘chew’? What kind of visitors are you taking about?
translation: 多么可悲啊！等等，你说“咀嚼”吗？您要接待什么样的访客？ [duo me ke bei a ！ deng deng ， ni shuo “ ju jue ” ma ？ nin yao jie dai shen me yang de fang ke ？]

english: Why, they’re dogs of course! I’m quite upset, yet they are so cute that I can’t stay mad. We can’t leave them here, however.
translation: 为什么，他们当然是狗！我很沮丧，但他们太可爱了，我不能生气。然而，我们不能把他们留在这里。 [wei shen me ， ta men dang ran shi gou ！ wo hen ju sang ， dan ta men tai ke ai le ， wo bu neng sheng qi 。 ran er ， wo men bu neng ba ta men liu zai zhe li 。]

english: I’m going to need some help to find them a place to be, and to clean up afterwards.
translation: 我需要一些帮助来给它们找个地方，然后清理干净。 [wo xu yao yi xie bang zhu lai gei ta men zhao ge di fang ， ran hou qing li gan jing 。]

english: And you’re about to ask me.
translation: 你正要问我。 [ni zheng yao wen wo 。]

english: Quite right! So… Will you help?
translation: 完全正确！那么……你会帮忙吗？ [wan quan zheng que ！ na me …… ni hui bang mang ma ？]

english: Oh thank you!
translation: 噢，谢谢！ [o ， xie xie ！]

english: I reached out to one of my acquaintances, Probita, and she confirmed to me that none of these five adorable little tykes have an owner.
translation: 我联系了我的一位熟人普罗比塔，她向我证实这五只可爱的小家伙都没有主人。 [wo lian xi le wo de yi wei shu ren pu luo bi ta ， ta xiang wo zheng shi zhe wu zhi ke ai de xiao jia huo dou mei you zhu ren 。]

english: As cute as they are, they cannot just stay here.
translation: 尽管它们很可爱，但它们不能就这样待在这里。 [jin guan ta men hen ke ai ， dan ta men bu neng jiu zhe yang dai zai zhe li 。]

english: Maybe I could take them off your hands?
translation: 也许我可以把它们从你手里拿走？ [ye xu wo ke yi ba ta men cong ni shou li na zou ？]

english: You can try, but I cannot promise that they wouldn’t attempt to ransack all of your belongings. You saw what happened to the park.
translation: 你可以尝试，但我不能保证他们不会试图洗劫你的所有物品。你看到了公园里发生的事情。 [ni ke yi chang shi ， dan wo bu neng bao zheng ta men bu hui shi tu xi jie ni de suo you wu pin 。 ni kan dao le gong yuan li fa sheng de shi qing 。]

english: Good point. I do prefer when my belongings stay in one piece.
translation: 好点。我确实更喜欢我的物品保持完整。 [hao dian 。 wo que shi geng xi huan wo de wu pin bao chi wan zheng 。]

english: I wonder if they caused so much havoc because they came in as a group.
translation: 我想知道他们造成如此大的破坏是否是因为他们是作为一个团体进来的。 [wo xiang zhi dao ta men zao cheng ru ci da de po huai shi fou shi yin wei ta men shi zuo wei yi ge tuan ti jin lai de 。]

english: We should be able to manage this by getting each of them a different loving owner and some proper training.
translation: 我们应该能够通过为它们每个人提供不同的爱心主人和一些适当的培训来解决这个问题。 [wo men ying gai neng gou tong guo wei ta men mei ge ren ti gong bu tong de ai xin zhu ren he yi xie shi dang de pei xun lai jie jue zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: I’ve already got a few ideas for potential adopters. Hmm… What if we set up a refining event? An adoption drive!
translation: 我已经为潜在采用者提供了一些想法。嗯……如果我们举办一场炼化活动呢？领养活动！ [wo yi jing wei qian zai cai yong zhe ti gong le yi xie xiang fa 。 n …… ru guo wo men ju ban yi chang lian hua huo dong ne ？ ling yang huo dong ！]

english: That could work!
translation: 那可以！ [na ke yi ！]

english: We could have balloons and decorations, and maybe even nibbles.
translation: 我们可以有气球和装饰品，甚至可以吃点东西。 [wo men ke yi you qi qiu he zhuang shi pin ， shen zhi ke yi chi dian dong xi 。]

english: Wouldn’t the dogs eat the nibbles and chew the decorations?
translation: 狗不会吃零食和咀嚼装饰品吗？ [gou bu hui chi ling shi he ju jue zhuang shi pin ma ？]

english: You’re right, of course. Then… What if we dressed up the dogs to make them extra cute? Would that distract them enough?
translation: 当然，你是对的。那么……如果我们给狗狗打扮一下，让它们变得更加可爱呢？这足以分散他们的注意力吗？ [dang ran ， ni shi dui de 。 na me …… ru guo wo men gei gou gou da ban yi xia ， rang ta men bian de geng jia ke ai ne ？ zhe zu yi fen san ta men de zhu yi li ma ？]

english: I don’t know. It might distract them from the decorations, but I don’t think anything could distract them from the nibbles.
translation: 我不知道。它可能会分散他们对装饰品的注意力，但我认为没有任何东西可以分散他们对小吃的注意力。 [wo bu zhi dao 。 ta ke neng hui fen san ta men dui zhuang shi pin de zhu yi li ， dan wo ren wei mei you ren he dong xi ke yi fen san ta men dui xiao chi de zhu yi li 。]

english: Yes, that is true. Let us not have the nibbles. Besides, the first step is to secure some costumes and a venue.
translation: 是的，确实如此。让我们不要被蚕食。此外，第一步就是要准备一些服装和场地。 [shi de ， que shi ru ci 。 rang wo men bu yao bei can shi 。 ci wai ， di yi bu jiu shi yao zhun bei yi xie fu zhuang he chang di 。]

english: While I try and figure out where the best place to host the event is, could you please check with Party Pete if he would have costumes to lend us? I will also start writing and decorating the invitations in the meantime.
translation: 当我尝试找出举办活动的最佳地点时，您能与 Party Pete 联系一下他是否有服装可以借给我们吗？与此同时，我还将开始撰写和装饰请柬。 [dang wo chang shi zhao chu ju ban huo dong de zui jia di dian shi ， nin neng yu  Party Pete  lian xi yi xia ta shi fou you fu zhuang ke yi jie gei wo men ma ？ yu ci tong shi ， wo hai jiang kai shi zhuan xie he zhuang shi qing jian 。]

english: On it!
translation: 就它了！ [jiu ta le ！]

english: I’d love to, but I’m somewhat busy right now.
translation: 我很愿意，但我现在有点忙。 [wo hen yuan yi ， dan wo xian zai you dian mang 。]

english: Then I will have to wrangle those dogs myself. We can’t leave the park in that state!
translation: 那我就得亲自去对付那些狗了。我们不能在那种状态下离开公园！ [na wo jiu de qin zi qu dui fu na xie gou le 。 wo men bu neng zai na zhong zhuang tai xia li kai gong yuan ！]

english: Have you come to play music to me?
translation: 你是来给我演奏音乐的吗？ [ni shi lai gei wo yan zou yin yue de ma ？]

english: Yes, I have.
translation: 是的，我有。 [shi de ， wo you 。]

english: Select the song I asked you to play, and speak to me again.
translation: 选择我让你播放的歌曲，然后再次对我说话。 [xuan ze wo rang ni bo fang de ge qu ， ran hou zai ci dui wo shuo hua 。]

english: No, I'm not interested in that.
translation: 不，我对此不感兴趣。 [bu ， wo dui ci bu gan xing qu 。]

english: Then you must have come to gaze in rapture at the natural beauty of Falador's parkland!
translation: 那么您一定会欣喜若狂地欣赏法拉多公园的自然美景！ [na me nin yi ding hui xin xi ruo kuang di xin shang fa la duo gong yuan de zi ran mei jing ！]

english: Player runs towards Cecilia
translation: 玩家跑向塞西莉亚 [wan jia pao xiang sai xi li ya]

english: Thank you, I love that song!
translation: 谢谢你，我喜欢那首歌！ [xie xie ni ， wo xi huan na shou ge ！]

english: You've obtained [another clue/a casket]!
translation: 你已经获得了[另一条线索/一个棺材]！ [ni yi jing huo de le [ ling yi tiao xian suo / yi ge guan cai ]！]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Yes, I have.
translation: 是的，我有。 [shi de ， wo you 。]

english: No, I'm not interested in that.
translation: 不，我对此不感兴趣。 [bu ， wo dui ci bu gan xing qu 。]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 你知道，打招呼的方式有很多种。你好，你好，你好…… [ni zhi dao ， da zhao hu de fang shi you hen duo zhong 。 ni hao ， ni hao ， ni hao ……]

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 那还是只能算一个！ [na hai shi zhi neng suan yi ge ！]

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。你今天怎么样？ [ni hao 。 ni jin tian zen me yang ？]

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很棒，谢谢你！ [wo hen bang ， xie xie ni ！]

english: Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 你好！水晶城里今天过得怎么样啊？ [ni hao ！ shui jing cheng li jin tian guo de zen me yang a ？]

english: Indeed.
translation: 的确。 [di que 。]

english: What can I do for ya?
translation: 我能为你做什么？ [wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 各种各样的事情！这些塔楼是一个美妙的景观。 [ge zhong ge yang de shi qing ！ zhe xie ta lou shi yi ge mei miao de jing guan 。]

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 在像今天这样的日子，我建议您参观市场。 [zai xiang jin tian zhe yang de ri zi ， wo jian yi nin can guan shi chang 。]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你认为你在做什么？ [ni ren wei ni zai zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

translation: 你知道，打招呼的方式有很多种。你好，你好，你好…… [ni zhi dao ， da zhao hu de fang shi you hen duo zhong 。 ni hao ， ni hao ， ni hao ……]

translation: 那还是只能算一个！ [na hai shi zhi neng suan yi ge ！]

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。你今天怎么样？ [ni hao 。 ni jin tian zen me yang ？]

translation: 我很棒，谢谢你！ [wo hen bang ， xie xie ni ！]

translation: 你好！水晶城里今天过得怎么样啊？ [ni hao ！ shui jing cheng li jin tian guo de zen me yang a ？]

translation: 的确。 [di que 。]

translation: 我能为你做什么？ [wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

translation: 各种各样的事情！这些塔楼是一个美妙的景观。 [ge zhong ge yang de shi qing ！ zhe xie ta lou shi yi ge mei miao de jing guan 。]

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 在像今天这样的日子，我建议您参观市场。 [zai xiang jin tian zhe yang de ri zi ， wo jian yi nin can guan shi chang 。]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你认为你在做什么？ [ni ren wei ni zai zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: Looking for a weapon? We've got the finest you could ever dream of here.
translation: 寻找武器？我们这里有您梦寐以求的最好的。 [xun zhao wu qi ？ wo men zhe li you nin meng mei yi qiu de zui hao de 。]

english: Yes, please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hmph. You probably wouldn't know how to use them, anyway.
translation: 哼。无论如何，您可能不知道如何使用它们。 [heng 。 wu lun ru he ， nin ke neng bu zhi dao ru he shi yong ta men 。]

english: Yes, please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: What a funny creature you are! Why, you only have 2 legs!
translation: 你真是个有趣的生物！哎呀，你只有两条腿！ [ni zhen shi ge you qu de sheng wu ！ ai ya ， ni zhi you liang tiao tui ！]

english: Hello human, welcome to our valley.
translation: 你好人类，欢迎来到我们的山谷。 [ni hao ren lei ， huan ying lai dao wo men de shan gu 。]

english: Hi!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Let me at 'em!
translation: 让我来对付他们吧！ [rang wo lai dui fu ta men ba ！]

english: Trolls? Schmolls!
translation: 巨魔？施莫尔斯！ [ju mo ？ shi mo er si ！]

english: The trolls are coming!
translation: 巨魔来了！ [ju mo lai le ！]

english: The trolls took my baby son!
translation: 巨魔夺走了我的宝贝儿子！ [ju mo duo zou le wo de bao bei er zi ！]

english: Welcome to Burthorpe!
translation: 欢迎来到伯索普！ [huan ying lai dao bo suo pu ！]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: Trolls!
translation: 巨魔！ [ju mo ！]

english: Hello stranger.
translation: 你好陌生人。 [ni hao mo sheng ren 。]

english: Go away!
translation: 离开！ [li kai ！]

english: Run!
translation: 跑步！ [pao bu ！]

english: Hi!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: The Imperial Guard can no longer protect us!
translation: 禁军已经无法保护我们了！ [jin jun yi jing wu fa bao hu wo men le ！]

english: The White Knights will soon have control!
translation: 白骑士很快就会掌控局面！ [bai qi shi hen kuai jiu hui zhang kong ju mian ！]

english: I heard about what you did, thank you!

translation: 当其中一个从下面抓住我时，我设法从桶里拉出一根木头，但在我设法杀死它之前，我从那东西的喉咙里滑了大约两英尺。 [dang qi zhong yi ge cong xia mian zhua zhu wo shi ， wo she fa cong tong li la chu yi gen mu tou ， dan zai wo she fa sha si ta zhi qian ， wo cong na dong xi de hou long li hua le da yue liang ying chi 。]

english: How did you survive?
translation: 你是怎么活下来的？ [ni shi zen me huo xia lai de ？]

english: A passin' ship saw the sharks and knew there would be survivors in the water. They sent a longboat and picked me up, but not before the sharks had taken off my legs.
translation: 一艘路过的船看到了鲨鱼，知道水中会有幸存者。他们派了一艘长艇来接我，但鲨鱼已经把我的腿咬断了。 [yi sou lu guo de chuan kan dao le sha yu ， zhi dao shui zhong hui you xing cun zhe 。 ta men pai le yi sou zhang ting lai jie wo ， dan sha yu yi jing ba wo de tui yao duan le 。]

english: And that [lad/lass] is why they call me two feet Charley, because they found me jammed two feet down a shark's throat.
translation: 那个[小伙子/姑娘]就是为什么他们叫我两英尺查理，因为他们发现我被卡在鲨鱼喉咙里两英尺。 [na ge [ xiao huo zi / gu niang ] jiu shi wei shen me ta men jiao wo liang ying chi cha li ， yin wei ta men fa xian wo bei ka zai sha yu hou long li liang ying chi 。]

english: I think I'm gonna be sick...
translation: 我想我会生病... [wo xiang wo hui sheng bing ...]

english: I knew ye couldn't handle the truth!
translation: 我知道你无法面对真相！ [wo zhi dao ni wu fa mian dui zhen xiang ！]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: Yes, but I don't want your fish.
translation: 是的，但我不想要你的鱼。 [shi de ， dan wo bu xiang yao ni de yu 。]

english: What happened to your legs?
translation: 你的腿怎么了？ [ni de tui zen me le ？]

english: Hi!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Yes, er, welcome to the zoo! I'm afraid I'm kind of busy right now; what was it you wanted?
translation: 是的，呃，欢迎来到动物园！恐怕我现在有点忙；你想要什么？ [shi de ， e ， huan ying lai dao dong wu yuan ！ kong pa wo xian zai you dian mang ； ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Ah, you sound like someone who needs a quest doing!
translation: 啊，你听起来像是一个需要做任务的人！ [a ， ni ting qi lai xiang shi yi ge xu yao zuo ren wu de ren ！]

english: Well... maybe. How much do you know about hunting?
translation: 嗯……也许吧。 How much do you know about hunting? [n …… ye xu ba 。 How much do you know about hunting?]

english: Well I know a little bit...
translation: 嗯，我知道一点点…… [n ， wo zhi dao yi dian dian ……]

english: No, I could do with some help, but I'm afraid I need somebody with a little more experience.
translation: 不，我需要一些帮助，但恐怕我需要有更多经验的人。 [bu ， wo xu yao yi xie bang zhu ， dan kong pa wo xu yao you geng duo jing yan de ren 。]

english: Actually, now that you come to mention it, you might be able to help me.
translation: 其实，既然你这么一提，或许能帮到我。 [qi shi ， ji ran ni zhe me yi ti ， huo xu neng bang dao wo 。]

english: A few weeks ago we had a delivery of a northern ferret. They're funny little creatures. Turns out they're tricksy little blighters too.
translation: 几周前，我们收到了一只北方雪貂。它们是有趣的小生物。事实证明，它们也是狡猾的小家伙。 [ji zhou qian ， wo men shou dao le yi zhi bei fang xue diao 。 ta men shi you qu de xiao sheng wu 。 shi shi zheng ming ， ta men ye shi jiao hua de xiao jia huo 。]

english: Whilst we were unloading him from the cart he managed to escape his cage. What's more he gave the driver a nasty nip on the way out too.
translation: 当我们把他从车上卸下来时，他设法逃离了笼子。更重要的是，他在下车时还狠狠地咬了司机一下。 [dang wo men ba ta cong che shang xie xia lai shi ， ta she fa tao li le long zi 。 geng zhong yao de shi ， ta zai xia che shi hai hen hen di yao le si ji yi xia 。]

english: This was obviously a bit of a blow, you can't make a new attraction without any animals.
translation: 这显然是一个打击，没有动物就不可能创造一个新的景点。 [zhe xian ran shi yi ge da ji ， mei you dong wu jiu bu ke neng chuang zao yi ge xin de jing dian 。]

english: We got in contact with one of our associates, a huntsman called Nickolaus, who agreed to capture us another.
translation: 我们联系了我们的一位同事，一位名叫尼克劳斯的猎人，他同意再抓我们一个。 [wo men lian xi le wo men de yi wei tong shi ， yi wei ming jiao ni ke lao si de lie ren ， ta tong yi zai zhua wo men yi ge 。]

english: Funny thing is we haven't heard from him for some time now. I don't suppose you'd mind having a look for him?
translation: 有趣的是我们已经有一段时间没有收到他的消息了。我想你不介意去找他吧？ [you qu de shi wo men yi jing you yi duan shi jian mei you shou dao ta de xiao xi le 。 wo xiang ni bu jie yi qu zhao ta ba ？]

english: Sure. Any idea where I should start looking?
translation: 当然。知道我应该从哪里开始寻找吗？ [dang ran 。 zhi dao wo ying gai cong na li kai shi xun zhao ma ？]

english: Well the northern ferret is mostly found around the mountains just west of the Gnome Stronghold, so that would probably be as good a place as any to start looking.
translation: 好吧，北方雪貂主要出现在侏儒要塞西边的山脉周围，所以这可能是一个开始寻找的好地方。 [hao ba ， bei fang xue diao zhu yao chu xian zai zhu ru yao sai xi bian de shan mai zhou wei ， suo yi zhe ke neng shi yi ge kai shi xun zhao de hao di fang 。]

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Sorry, I don't have the time.
translation: 抱歉，我没有时间。 [bao qian ， wo mei you shi jian 。]

english: Oh well, I'm sure he'll be okay out there on his own.
translation: 哦，好吧，我相信他一个人在外面会没事的。 [o ， hao ba ， wo xiang xin ta yi ge ren zai wai mian hui mei shi de 。]

english: Where did you get the animals from?
translation: 你从哪里得到这些动物？ [ni cong na li de dao zhe xie dong wu ？]

english: We get them from all over the place! The most exotic creatures have been brought back by explorers and sold to us.
translation: 我们从各地收集它们！最奇特的生物被探险家带回来卖给我们。 [wo men cong ge di shou ji ta men ！ zui qi te de sheng wu bei tan xian jia dai hui lai mai gei wo men 。]

english: Where on Gielinor did you get that scary looking Cyclops?!
translation: 你在吉林诺哪里得到那个看起来可怕的独眼巨人？！ [ni zai ji lin nuo na li de dao na ge kan qi lai ke pa de du yan ju ren ？！]

english: Yes he is scary looking!
translation: 是的，他看起来很可怕！ [shi de ， ta kan qi lai hen ke pa ！]

english: He's from a very far away land, we couldn't find out more as the explorer who brought him back died shortly afterwards!
translation: 他来自一个非常遥远的地方，我们无法找到更多信息，因为带他回来的探险家不久后就去世了！ [ta lai zi yi ge fei chang yao yuan de di fang ， wo men wu fa zhao dao geng duo xin xi ， yin wei dai ta hui lai de tan xian jia bu jiu hou jiu qu shi le ！]

english: Hi, how are you getting on with that ferret?
translation: 嗨，你和那只雪貂相处得怎么样？ [hai ， ni he na zhi xue diao xiang chu de zen me yang ？]

english: Well he seems to be just as vicious as the one we lost, but we're still very grateful for your help in acquiring him.
translation: 好吧，他似乎和我们失去的那个一样邪恶，但我们仍然非常感谢你帮助我们抓住了他。 [hao ba ， ta si hu he wo men shi qu de na ge yi yang xie e ， dan wo men reng ran fei chang gan xie ni bang zhu wo men zhua zhu le ta 。]

english: Hey, I've got another ferret if you're interested?
translation: 嘿，我还有一只雪貂，你有兴趣吗？ [hei ， wo hai you yi zhi xue diao ， ni you xing qu ma ？]

english: Er, oh! Well that's very kind of you, but we don't really need another ferret at the moment, I'm afraid. We're having enough trouble taming the one we've got.
translation: 呃，哦！嗯，你真是太好了，但恐怕我们现在并不需要另一只雪貂。我们已经很难驯服我们所拥有的那个了。 [e ， o ！ n ， ni zhen shi tai hao le ， dan kong pa wo men xian zai bing bu xu yao ling yi zhi xue diao 。 wo men yi jing hen nan xun fu wo men suo yong you de na ge le 。]

english: Ah, you sound like someone who needs a quest doing!
translation: 啊，你听起来像是一个需要做任务的人！ [a ， ni ting qi lai xiang shi yi ge xu yao zuo ren wu de ren ！]

english: Sure. Any idea where I should start looking?
translation: 当然。知道我应该从哪里开始寻找吗？ [dang ran 。 zhi dao wo ying gai cong na li kai shi xun zhao ma ？]

english: Sorry, I don't have the time.
translation: 抱歉，我没有时间。 [bao qian ， wo mei you shi jian 。]

english: Where did you get the animals from?
translation: 你从哪里得到这些动物？ [ni cong na li de dao zhe xie dong wu ？]

english: Hello! Who are you?
translation: 你好！你是谁？ [ni hao ！ ni shi shui ？]

english: Hello! The name's Charlie Brown and I've just arrived in Kourend.
translation: 你好！我的名字是查理·布朗，我刚刚抵达库伦德。 [ni hao ！ wo de ming zi shi cha li · bu lang ， wo gang gang di da ku lun de 。]

english: Nice to meet you Charlie, my name is [player name]. What are you doing here?
translation: 很高兴认识你查理，我的名字是[玩家姓名]。你在这里做什么？ [hen gao xing ren shi ni cha li ， wo de ming zi shi [ wan jia xing ming ]。 ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I've come to Kourend in search of luck, [player name]. I seek many fortunes and as you know you need luck to find fortune!
translation: 我来库伦德是为了寻求运气，[玩家名字]。我寻求很多财富，正如你所知，你需要运气才能找到财富！ [wo lai ku lun de shi wei le xun qiu yun qi ，[ wan jia ming zi ]。 wo xun qiu hen duo cai fu ， zheng ru ni suo zhi ， ni xu yao yun qi cai neng zhao dao cai fu ！]

english: If you're searching for luck, why are you dressed as a monk?
translation: 如果你是在寻找运气，为什么你要打扮成和尚呢？ [ru guo ni shi zai xun zhao yun qi ， wei shen me ni yao da ban cheng he shang ne ？]

english: Ah these robes keeps me holy, I must remain holy when praying to the God of Luck, [player name].
translation: 啊，这些长袍让我保持圣洁，在向幸运之神祈祷时我必须保持圣洁，[玩家名字]。 [a ， zhe xie chang pao rang wo bao chi sheng jie ， zai xiang xing yun zhi shen qi dao shi wo bi xu bao chi sheng jie ，[ wan jia ming zi ]。]

english: God of Luck? I don't think I've heard of such a God...
translation: 幸运之神？我好像没听说过有这样的神... [xing yun zhi shen ？ wo hao xiang mei ting shuo guo you zhe yang de shen ...]

english: Ah, would you perhaps allow me to enlighten you?
translation: 啊，你能允许我启发你吗？ [a ， ni neng yun xu wo qi fa ni ma ？]

english: Sure.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: Arengeesus, God of luck. We do not know much about her or where she comes from, we just know she is there looking over us.
translation: Arengeesus，幸运之神。我们不太了解她或她来自哪里，我们只知道她在那里看着我们。 [Arengeesus， xing yun zhi shen 。 wo men bu tai liao jie ta huo ta lai zi na li ， wo men zhi zhi dao ta zai na li kan zhe wo men 。]

english: Those who praise Arengeesus enough to get her attention are rewarded. She will gaze down upon you providing you with luck on your adventures.
translation: 那些对阿兰吉苏斯的赞美足以引起她的注意的人会得到奖励。她会俯视你，为你的冒险带来好运。 [na xie dui a lan ji su si de zan mei zu yi yin qi ta de zhu yi de ren hui de dao jiang li 。 ta hui fu shi ni ， wei ni de mao xian dai lai hao yun 。]

english: That sounds a little farfetched to me, luck isn't a thing. Hard work is all you need.
translation: 这对我来说听起来有点牵强，运气并不重要。努力工作就是你所需要的。 [zhe dui wo lai shuo ting qi lai you dian qian qiang ， yun qi bing bu zhong yao 。 nu li gong zuo jiu shi ni suo xu yao de 。]

english: Perhaps working hard is merely a form of praise to the God of luck, [player name].
translation: 也许努力只是对幸运之神的一种赞美，[玩家名字]。 [ye xu nu li zhi shi dui xing yun zhi shen de yi zhong zan mei ，[ wan jia ming zi ]。]

english: Hmmm... well good luck Charlie. Good bye!
translation: 嗯……祝你好运，查理。再见！ [n …… zhu ni hao yun ， cha li 。 zai jian ！]

english: Farewell [player name], may Arengeesus shine down upon you.
translation: 永别了[玩家名字]，愿阿兰吉苏斯照耀在你身上。 [yong bie le [ wan jia ming zi ]， yuan a lan ji su si zhao yao zai ni shen shang 。]

english: And you!
translation: 你呢！ [ni ne ！]

english: Maybe another time, I must be going.
translation: 也许下次吧，我必须走了。 [ye xu xia ci ba ， wo bi xu zou le 。]

english: Very well, farewell.
translation: 很好，再见。 [hen hao ， zai jian 。]

english: Sure.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: Maybe another time, I must be going.
translation: 也许下次吧，我必须走了。 [ye xu xia ci ba ， wo bi xu zou le 。]

english: Spare some change guv?
translation: 先生，能换点零钱吗？ [xian sheng ， neng huan dian ling qian ma ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Charles. Charles E. Trampin' at your service. Now, about that change you were going to give me...
translation: 查尔斯.查尔斯·E·特兰宾 (Charles E. Trampin) 竭诚为您服务。现在，关于你要给我的改变...... [cha er si . cha er si ·E· te lan bin  (Charles E. Trampin)  jie cheng wei nin fu wu 。 xian zai ， guan yu ni yao gei wo de gai bian ......]

english: Sorry, I haven't got any.
translation: 抱歉，我没有。 [bao qian ， wo mei you 。]

english: Thanks anyway.
translation: 不管怎样，谢谢。 [bu guan zen yang ， xie xie 。]

english: Go get a job!
translation: 去找工作吧！ [qu zhao gong zuo ba ！]

english: You startin? I hope your nose falls off!
translation: 你开始了吗？希望你的鼻子掉下来！ [ni kai shi le ma ？ xi wang ni de bi zi diao xia lai ！]

english: Ok. Here you go.
translation: 好的。干得好。 [hao de 。 gan de hao 。]

english: Hey, thanks a lot!
translation: 嘿，非常感谢！ [hei ， fei chang gan xie ！]

english: No problem.
translation: 没问题。 [mei wen ti 。]

english: So...don't I get some sort of quest hint or something now?
translation: 那么……我现在没有得到某种任务提示之类的东西吗？ [na me …… wo xian zai mei you de dao mou zhong ren wu ti shi zhi lei de dong xi ma ？]

english: Huh? What do you mean? That wasn't why I asked you for money.
translation: 啊？你是什​​么意思？这不是我向你要钱的原因。 [a ？ ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？ zhe bu shi wo xiang ni yao qian de yuan yin 。]

english: I just need to eat...
translation: 我只需要吃饭... [wo zhi xu yao chi fan ...]

english: Oh wait. I haven't got any, sorry.
translation: 哦等等。我没有，抱歉。 [o deng deng 。 wo mei you ， bao qian 。]

english: Is there anything down this alleyway?
translation: 这条巷子里有什么东西吗？ [zhe tiao xiang zi li you shen me dong xi ma ？]

english: Funny you should mention that...there is actually.
translation: 有趣的是你应该提到......实际上是有的。 [you qu de shi ni ying gai ti dao ...... shi ji shang shi you de 。]

english: The ruthless and notorious criminal gang known as the Black Arm Gang have their headquarters down there.
translation: 被称为“黑臂帮”的残酷且臭名昭著的犯罪团伙的总部就在那里。 [bei cheng wei “ hei bi bang ” de can ku qie chou ming zhao zhu de fan zui tuan huo de zong bu jiu zai na li 。]

english: Thanks for the warning!
translation: 谢谢你的警告！ [xie xie ni de jing gao ！]

english: Don't worry about it.
translation: 别担心。 [bie dan xin 。]

english: Do you think they would let me join?
translation: 你认为他们会让我加入吗？ [ni ren wei ta men hui rang wo jia ru ma ？]

english: You never know. You'll find a lady down there called Katrine. Speak to her.
translation: 你永远不知道。你会在那里找到一位名叫卡特琳的女士。和她说话。 [ni yong yuan bu zhi dao 。 ni hui zai na li zhao dao yi wei ming jiao ka te lin de nv shi 。 he ta shuo hua 。]

english: But don't upset her, she's pretty dangerous.
translation: 但别让她不高兴，她很危险。 [dan bie rang ta bu gao xing ， ta hen wei xian 。]

english: I was under the impression you were already a member...
translation: 我以为你已经是会员了... [wo yi wei ni yi jing shi hui yuan le ...]

english: No. You're a collaborator with the Phoenix Gang. There's no way they'll let you join now.
translation: 不，你是凤凰帮的合作者。他们现在不可能让你加入。 [bu ， ni shi feng huang bang de he zuo zhe 。 ta men xian zai bu ke neng rang ni jia ru 。]

english: How did YOU know I was in the Phoenix Gang?
translation: 你怎么知道我是凤凰帮的？ [ni zen me zhi dao wo shi feng huang bang de ？]

english: In my current profession I spend a lot of time on the streets and you hear these sorta things sometimes
translation: 在我目前的职业中，我花了很多时间在街上，有时你会听到这些事情 [zai wo mu qian de zhi ye zhong ， wo hua le hen duo shi jian zai jie shang ， you shi ni hui ting dao zhe xie shi qing]

english: Any ideas how I could get in there then?
translation: 那么我有什么想法可以进去吗？ [na me wo you shen me xiang fa ke yi jin qu ma ？]

english: Hmmm. I dunno.
translation: 嗯。我不知道。 [n 。 wo bu zhi dao 。]

english: Your best bet would probably be to find someone else... Someone who ISN'T a member of the Phoenix Gang, and get them to infiltrate the ranks of the Black Arm Gang for you.
translation: 你最好的选择可能是找到其他人……一个不是凤凰帮成员的人，并让他们为你渗透到黑臂帮的行列中。 [ni zui hao de xuan ze ke neng shi zhao dao qi ta ren …… yi ge bu shi feng huang bang cheng yuan de ren ， bing rang ta men wei ni shen tou dao hei bi bang de hang lie zhong 。]

english: If you find someone like that, tell 'em to come to me first.
translation: 如果你发现这样的人，请告诉他们先来找我。 [ru guo ni fa xian zhe yang de ren ， qing gao su ta men xian lai zhao wo 。]

english: Ok. Good plan!
translation: 好的。好计划！ [hao de 。 hao ji hua ！]

english: I'm not just a pretty face!
translation: 我不只是一张漂亮的脸蛋！ [wo bu zhi shi yi zhang piao liang de lian dan ！]

english: Like who?
translation: 像谁？ [xiang shui ？]

english: There's plenty of other adventurers about besides yourself. I'm sure if you asked one of them nicely they would help you.
translation: 除了你自己之外，还有很多其他冒险家。我确信，如果您向他们中的一位提出好意，他们会为您提供帮助。 [chu le ni zi ji zhi wai ， hai you hen duo qi ta mao xian jia 。 wo que xin ， ru guo nin xiang ta men zhong de yi wei ti chu hao yi ， ta men hui wei nin ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: Please [sir/madam], can you help me.
translation: [先生/女士]请您帮帮我。 [[ xian sheng / nv shi ] qing nin bang bang wo 。]

english: What can I do for you?
translation: 我能为你做什么？ [wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: I really need a cooked trout.
translation: 我真的需要一条煮熟的鳟鱼。 [wo zhen de xu yao yi tiao zhu shu de zun yu 。]

english: I really need a cooked pike.
translation: 我真的需要一条煮熟的梭子鱼。 [wo zhen de xu yao yi tiao zhu shu de suo zi yu 。]

english: I really need a raw herring
translation: 我真的需要一条生鲱鱼 [wo zhen de xu yao yi tiao sheng fei yu]

english: I really need a raw trout.
translation: 我真的需要一条生鳟鱼。 [wo zhen de xu yao yi tiao sheng zun yu 。]

english: I really need some leather chaps.
translation: 我真的需要一些皮裤。 [wo zhen de xu yao yi xie pi ku 。]

translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

translation: 你好呀。没有阿图尔在身边真是令人难过，更不用说他父亲的糟糕经历了。我希望他能处理好这件事。 [ni hao ya 。 mei you a tu er zai shen bian zhen shi ling ren nan guo ， geng bu yong shuo ta fu qin de zao gao jing li le 。 wo xi wang ta neng chu li hao zhe jian shi 。]

translation: 我相信他会没事的。 [wo xiang xin ta hui mei shi de 。]

translation: 你好，我需要灯的燃料。 [ni hao ， wo xu yao deng de ran liao 。]

translation: 您好，您需要的燃料是灯油，需要帮忙制作吗？ [nin hao ， nin xu yao de ran liao shi deng you ， xu yao bang mang zhi zuo ma ？]

translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: It's really quite simple.  You use the small still in here.  It's all set up, so there's no fiddling around with dials...
translation: 这真的很简单。  你用这里的小蒸馏器。  一切都已设置完毕，因此无需摆弄表盘...... [zhe zhen de hen jian dan 。   ni yong zhe li de xiao zheng liu qi 。   yi qie dou yi she zhi wan bi ， yin ci wu xu bai nong biao pan ......]

english: Just put ordinary swamp tar in, and then use a lantern or lamp to get the oil out.
translation: 只需放入普通的沼泽焦油，然后用灯笼或灯将油取出即可。 [zhi xu fang ru pu tong de zhao ze jiao you ， ran hou yong deng long huo deng jiang you qu chu ji ke 。]

english: Thanks.

translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello.

translation: 哦..你好，怎么样？ [o .. ni hao ， zen me yang ？]

english: Good thanks.
translation: 很好，谢谢。 [hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Good to hear, sorry but I have a few things to do right now.
translation: 很高兴听到这个消息，抱歉，但我现在有几件事要做。 [hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi ， bao qian ， dan wo xian zai you ji jian shi yao zuo 。]

translation: 好吧，我最好让你继续下去。 [hao ba ， wo zui hao rang ni ji xu xia qu 。]

english: I have a slightly odd question.
translation: 我有一个有点奇怪的问题。 [wo you yi ge you dian qi guai de wen ti 。]

english: Jolly good, the odder the better. I like oddities.
translation: 非常好，越奇怪越好。我喜欢奇怪的事情。 [fei chang hao ， yue qi guai yue hao 。 wo xi huan qi guai de shi qing 。]

english: Do you know how I might distil a mix of anchovy oil and flowers so that it forms a layer on the inside of a butterfly jar?
translation: 你知道我如何蒸馏凤尾鱼油和花的混合物，使其在蝴蝶罐的内部形成一层吗？ [ni zhi dao wo ru he zheng liu feng wei yu you he hua de hun he wu ， shi qi zai hu die guan de nei bu xing cheng yi ceng ma ？]

english: That is an odd question. I commend you for it. Why would you want to do that?
translation: 这是一个奇怪的问题。我为此赞扬你。你为什么要这么做？ [zhe shi yi ge qi guai de wen ti 。 wo wei ci zan yang ni 。 ni wei shen me yao zhe me zuo ？]

english: Apparently, if I can make a jar like this it will be useful for storing implings in.
translation: 显然，如果我能制作一个像这样的罐子，它将有助于存储暗示。 [xian ran ， ru guo wo neng zhi zuo yi ge xiang zhe yang de guan zi ， ta jiang you zhu yu cun chu an shi 。]

english: So, do you have any of this fish-and-flower flavoured oil and a butterfly jar then?
translation: 那么，你有这种鱼花油和蝴蝶罐吗？ [na me ， ni you zhe zhong yu hua you he hu die guan ma ？]

english: As it happens, I do.
translation: 碰巧，我确实这么做了。 [peng qiao ， wo que shi zhe me zuo le 。]

english: Well then. Hmmm. My lamp oil still may be able to do what you want. Give it a go and see if it works.
translation: 那么好吧。嗯。我的灯油或许还能达到你想要的效果。尝试一下，看看是否有效。 [na me hao ba 。 n 。 wo de deng you huo xu hai neng da dao ni xiang yao de xiao guo 。 chang shi yi xia ， kan kan shi fou you xiao 。]

translation: 事实上，没有。 [shi shi shang ， mei you 。]

english: If you go and get them then I may be able to help you. I'm better at coming up with answers if the questions are in my hands.
translation: 如果你去拿它们，那么我也许可以帮助你。如果问题在我手中，我就能更好地找到答案。 [ru guo ni qu na ta men ， na me wo ye xu ke yi bang zhu ni 。 ru guo wen ti zai wo shou zhong ， wo jiu neng geng hao di zhao dao da an 。]

translation: 那么，如何制作凤尾鱼油呢？ [na me ， ru he zhi zuo feng wei yu you ne ？]

translation: 凤尾鱼是非常油腻的鱼。我以为你可以把它们磨碎并筛出碎片。您可能需要先除去水——烹饪应该可以很好地做到这一点。 [feng wei yu shi fei chang you ni de yu 。 wo yi wei ni ke yi ba ta men mo sui bing shai chu sui pian 。 nin ke neng xu yao xian chu qu shui —— peng ren ying gai ke yi hen hao di zuo dao zhe yi dian 。]

translation: 你有我可以用的筛子吗？ [ni you wo ke yi yong de shai zi ma ？]

english: Errm, yes. But you already have one. Two sieves is a bit excessive, don't you think?
translation: 呃，是的。但你已经有了一个。两个筛子有点太多了，你不觉得吗？ [e ， shi de 。 dan ni yi jing you le yi ge 。 liang ge shai zi you dian tai duo le ， ni bu jue de ma ？]

translation: 您确定您还没有吗？ [nin que ding nin hai mei you ma ？]

translation: 呃，是的。给，有这个。它仅用于从下水道中筛出死老鼠。 [e ， shi de 。 gei ， you zhe ge 。 ta jin yong yu cong xia shui dao zhong shai chu si lao shu 。]

english: Well, it should be ideally suited to your task.
translation: 嗯，它应该非常适合您的任务。 [n ， ta ying gai fei chang shi he nin de ren wu 。]

translation: 很公平。 [hen gong ping 。]

translation: 我想是的。 [wo xiang shi de 。]

translation: 干得好，有这个。 [gan de hao ， you zhe ge 。]

translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

translation: 不。 [bu 。]

translation: 不，我对隐含罐子更感兴趣。 [bu ， wo dui yin han guan zi geng gan xing qu 。]

translation: 那么如何制作凤尾鱼油呢？ [na me ru he zhi zuo feng wei yu you ne ？]

english: Do you have a sieve I can use?
translation: 你有我可以用的筛子吗？ [ni you wo ke yi yong de shai zi ma ？]

translation: 我最好去拿驱虫剂。 [wo zui hao qu na qu chong ji 。]

translation: 你好，你在这里做什么？ [ni hao ， ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Hi there, my husband and I are adventurers, Captain Janaway brought us here.
translation: 你好，我和我的丈夫是冒险家，贾纳韦船长带我们来到这里。 [ni hao ， wo he wo de zhang fu shi mao xian jia ， jia na wei chuan zhang dai wo men lai dao zhe li 。]

english: What brings you to Great Kourend?
translation: 是什么风带您来到 Great Kourend 的？ [shi shen me feng dai nin lai dao  Great Kourend  de ？]

english: New lands to explore of course! Isn't it exciting? A whole new world that we know nothing about just waiting for us to discover it!
translation: 当然还有新的土地等待探索！是不是很兴奋呢？一个我们一无所知的全新世界正等待着我们去发现！ [dang ran hai you xin de tu di deng dai tan suo ！ shi bu shi hen xing fen ne ？ yi ge wo men yi wu suo zhi de quan xin shi jie zheng deng dai zhe wo men qu fa xian ！]

english: What you want, skinny creature?
translation: 你想要什么，瘦弱的生物？ [ni xiang yao shen me ， shou ruo de sheng wu ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Dis our home. It comfy, though we thinking of maybe getting more space up on land, above. But silly Corsair men live up there an' think dey own whole place.
translation: 这是我们的家。虽然我们想在上面的陆地上获得更多的空间，但它很舒服。但愚蠢的海盗船人住在那里，并认为他们拥有整个地方。 [zhe shi wo men de jia 。 sui ran wo men xiang zai shang mian de lu di shang huo de geng duo de kong jian ， dan ta hen shu fu 。 dan yu chun de hai dao chuan ren zhu zai na li ， bing ren wei ta men yong you zheng ge di fang 。]

english: Maybe one day dat gonna change. Tess got plans.
translation: 也许有一天情况会改变。苔丝有计划。 [ye xu you yi tian qing kuang hui gai bian 。 tai si you ji hua 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: I'll leave you alone, sorry.
translation: 我会让你一个人呆着，抱歉。 [wo hui rang ni yi ge ren dai zhe ， bao qian 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: I'll leave you alone, sorry.
translation: 我会让你一个人呆着，抱歉。 [wo hui rang ni yi ge ren dai zhe ， bao qian 。]

english: Welcome to the Ardougne Domestic Service Agency!
translation: 欢迎来到阿杜涅家政服务机构！ [huan ying lai dao a du nie jia zheng fu wu ji gou ！]

english: Tell me about servants.
translation: 告诉我关于仆人的事。 [gao su wo guan yu pu ren de shi 。]

english: Do you need help around your house? Our trained, efficient workers are ready to serve you.
translation: 您的房子周围需要帮助吗？我们训练有素、高效的员工随时准备为您服务。 [nin de fang zi zhou wei xu yao bang zhu ma ？ wo men xun lian you su 、 gao xiao de yuan gong sui shi zhun bei wei nin fu wu 。]

english: They can cook meals for you and your friends, make tea, serve drinks, greet guests, and even take items to and from the bank for you.
translation: 他们可以为您和您的朋友做饭、泡茶、提供饮料、迎接客人，甚至为您将物品往返银行。 [ta men ke yi wei nin he nin de peng you zuo fan 、 pao cha 、 ti gong yin liao 、 ying jie ke ren ， shen zhi wei nin jiang wu pin wang fan yin hang 。]

english: The more expensive servants will be able to make trips to the bank more quickly. Some of them can also go to the sawmill to change logs to planks for you.
translation: 更昂贵的仆人将能够更快地前往银行。有的还可以去锯木厂帮你把原木改成木板。 [geng ang gui de pu ren jiang neng gou geng kuai di qian wang yin hang 。 you de hai ke yi qu ju mu chang bang ni ba yuan mu gai cheng mu ban 。]

english: Remember, you'll need to keep paying your servant. You pay them once when you hire them, and then they'll periodically ask for wages. You can dismiss your servant at any time.
translation: 请记住，您需要继续支付仆人的工资。你在雇用他们时付给他们一次工资，然后他们会定期索要工资。您可以随时解雇您的仆人。 [qing ji zhu ， nin xu yao ji xu zhi fu pu ren de gong zi 。 ni zai gu yong ta men shi fu gei ta men yi ci gong zi ， ran hou ta men hui ding qi suo yao gong zi 。 nin ke yi sui shi jie gu nin de pu ren 。]

english: I'd like to dismiss my servant, please.
translation: 我想解雇我的仆人。 [wo xiang jie gu wo de pu ren 。]

english: Oh dear, are you sure?
translation: 哦亲爱的，你确定吗？ [o qin ai de ， ni que ding ma ？]

english: Yes, I want to dismiss my servant.
translation: 是的，我想解雇我的仆人。 [shi de ， wo xiang jie gu wo de pu ren 。]

english: Very well, you no longer have a servant.
translation: 很好，你不再有仆人了。 [hen hao ， ni bu zai you pu ren le 。]

english: No, I'll keep my servant for now.
translation: 不，我暂时留下我的仆人。 [bu ， wo zan shi liu xia wo de pu ren 。]

english: Can I hire a servant?
translation: 我可以雇用仆人吗？ [wo ke yi gu yong pu ren ma ？]

english: Do you even own a house? These are strictly domestic servants; they won't follow you around the world!
translation: 你甚至拥有房子吗？这些人完全是家庭佣人；他们不会跟着你走遍世界！ [ni shen zhi yong you fang zi ma ？ zhe xie ren wan quan shi jia ting yong ren ； ta men bu hui gen zhe ni zou bian shi jie ！]

english: First you'll need to make sure you have a servant's room. A servant will automatically take the second-best bedroom, leaving the best for yourself, of course! So you will need to build two bedrooms in your house.
translation: 首先你需要确保你有一个仆人的房间。仆人会自动占据第二好的卧室，当然把最好的留给自己！所以你需要在你的房子里建造两间卧室。 [shou xian ni xu yao que bao ni you yi ge pu ren de fang jian 。 pu ren hui zi dong zhan ju di er hao de wo shi ， dang ran ba zui hao de liu gei zi ji ！ suo yi ni xu yao zai ni de fang zi li jian zao liang jian wo shi 。]

english: According to our records, one of our people is already working for you. If you want to hire a different one you will have to dismiss them.
translation: 根据我们的记录，我们的一名员工已经在为您工作。如果您想雇用其他人，您将不得不解雇他们。 [gen ju wo men de ji lu ， wo men de yi ming yuan gong yi jing zai wei nin gong zuo 。 ru guo nin xiang gu yong qi ta ren ， nin jiang bu de bu jie gu ta men 。]

english: Certainly! We have a number of servants here now looking for work. Why not have a chat to them and see which one you would like to hire?

english: Who are you and what do you sell?
translation: 你是谁，你卖什么？ [ni shi shui ， ni mai shen me ？]

english: I'm Chris, travelling repairman. If you need something repaired, I can do it for you if you've got the money for it.
translation: 我是克里斯，旅行修理工。如果你需要修理什么东西，只要你有钱，我可以帮你修理。 [wo shi ke li si ， lv xing xiu li gong 。 ru guo ni xu yao xiu li shen me dong xi ， zhi yao ni you qian ， wo ke yi bang ni xiu li 。]

english: I've also got a collection of items people end up losing a lot. Nothing fancy, and certainly nothing you couldn't get elsewhere, maybe for free. Still, I charge a convenience fee for having it right here. Interested?
translation: 我还收集了一些人们最终丢失很多的物品。没有什么花哨的东西，当然也没有什么是你在其他地方买不到的，也许是免费的。不过，我还是收取了一定的便利费才能把它放在这里。感兴趣的？ [wo hai shou ji le yi xie ren men zui zhong diu shi hen duo de wu pin 。 mei you shen me hua shao de dong xi ， dang ran ye mei you shen me shi ni zai qi ta di fang mai bu dao de ， ye xu shi mian fei de 。 bu guo ， wo hai shi shou qu le yi ding de bian li fei cai neng ba ta fang zai zhe li 。 gan xing qu de ？]

english: About items that break when people kill me...

english: Yeah, some things will break if you get killed in the Wilderness. And if you die deep in the Wilderness, they can vanish altogether.
translation: 是的，如果你在荒野中被杀，有些东西就会损坏。如果你死在荒野深处，它们就会完全消失。 [shi de ， ru guo ni zai huang ye zhong bei sha ， you xie dong xi jiu hui sun huai 。 ru guo ni si zai huang ye shen chu ， ta men jiu hui wan quan xiao shi 。]

english: Can you stop them vanishing in deep Wilderness?
translation: 你能阻止他们消失在荒野深处吗？ [ni neng zu zhi ta men xiao shi zai huang ye shen chu ma ？]

english: Well, if you bring me a Trouver Parchment and some coins, I can enchant some items so they won't disappear if you end up losing them deep in the Wilderness.

english: If you need a Trouver Parchment, there's a mage up in Ferox Enclave called Justine who sells them. I've also heard rumours there's a cave in the Wilderness with creatures that sometimes carry them as well.
translation: 如果你需要一张特鲁弗羊皮纸，费罗克斯飞地有一个名叫贾斯汀的法师会出售它们。我还听说荒野里有一个洞穴，里面有一些生物，有时也会携带它们。 [ru guo ni xu yao yi zhang te lu fu yang pi zhi ， fei luo ke si fei di you yi ge ming jiao jia si ting de fa shi hui chu shou ta men 。 wo hai ting shuo huang ye li you yi ge dong xue ， li mian you yi xie sheng wu ， you shi ye hui xie dai ta men 。]

translation: 嘿。我现在无法提供通常的服务，但如果你有兴趣，我挑选了一些可以让我改变你的外观的东西，如果你有兴趣的话。 [hei 。 wo xian zai wu fa ti gong tong chang de fu wu ， dan ru guo ni you xing qu ， wo tiao xuan le yi xie ke yi rang wo gai bian ni de wai guan de dong xi ， ru guo ni you xing qu de hua 。]

translation: 其实我可以剪个头发。 [qi shi wo ke yi jian ge tou fa 。]

english: It's nice to meet you here, [player name].
translation: 很高兴在这里见到你，[玩家姓名]。 [hen gao xing zai zhe li jian dao ni ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Who were you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm Chuck. I used to exchange logs for certificates, so people could trade them in bulk more conveniently. Certificates were what we used before banks automatically issued banknotes for most tradeable items.
translation: 我是查克。我曾经用日志交换证书，这样人们就可以更方便地进行批量交易。在银行为大多数可交易物品自动发行纸币之前，我们使用的是凭证。 [wo shi cha ke 。 wo ceng jing yong ri zhi jiao huan zheng shu ， zhe yang ren men jiu ke yi geng fang bian di jin xing pi liang jiao yi 。 zai yin hang wei da duo shu ke jiao yi wu pin zi dong fa xing zhi bi zhi qian ， wo men shi yong de shi ping zheng 。]

english: Even today, banknotes are sometimes referred to as 'certs', in memory of the certificates we used before.
translation: 即使在今天，纸币有时也被称为“证书”，以纪念我们以前使用的证书。 [ji shi zai jin tian ， zhi bi you shi ye bei cheng wei “ zheng shu ”， yi ji nian wo men yi qian shi yong de zheng shu 。]

english: I had colleagues who'd exchange other items for certificates - Niles, Miles and Giles were the most famous of us. But those three found new jobs rather than retiring like I did.

english: What is this place?

english: This is the main facility of the Alchemical Society. We're an organisation who fuse the forgotten teachings of the Old Ones with traditional Gielinorian Herblore practices.
translation: 这是炼金术协会的主要设施。我们是一个将被遗忘的古圣教义与传统的吉尔诺草药实践融合在一起的组织。 [zhe shi lian jin shu xie hui de zhu yao she shi 。 wo men shi yi ge jiang bei yi wang de gu sheng jiao yi yu chuan tong de ji er nuo cao yao shi jian rong he zai yi qi de zu zhi 。]

translation: 在某种程度上，但我们非常尊重 Herblore 作为一个职业，并认识到无论你的德鲁伊做什么都绝对有效。我们的目标是推进 Herblore 的研究，而不是取代它。 [zai mou zhong cheng du shang ， dan wo men fei chang zun zhong  Herblore  zuo wei yi ge zhi ye ， bing ren shi dao wu lun ni de de lu yi zuo shen me dou jue dui you xiao 。 wo men de mu biao shi tui jin  Herblore  de yan jiu ， er bu shi qu dai ta 。]

english: Anyway, I'm a little busy at the moment, but I'm sure some of the other lab assistants would love to tell you more!
translation: 不管怎样，我现在有点忙，但我相信其他一些实验室助理很乐意告诉你更多！ [bu guan zen yang ， wo xian zai you dian mang ， dan wo xiang xin qi ta yi xie shi yan shi zhu li hen le yi gao su ni geng duo ！]

english: Thanks! I'd better be going now.
translation: 谢谢！我最好现在就走。 [xie xie ！ wo zui hao xian zai jiu zou 。]

english: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这附近做什么？ [ni zai zhe fu jin zuo shen me ？]

english: When I'm not working in the lab, I'm normally somewhere around here researching or administrating our orders. There's an awful lot of paperwork to get through!
translation: 当我不在实验室工作时，我通常会在附近的某个地方研究或管理我们的订单。有大量的文书工作需要处理！ [dang wo bu zai shi yan shi gong zuo shi ， wo tong chang hui zai fu jin de mou ge di fang yan jiu huo guan li wo men de ding dan 。 you da liang de wen shu gong zuo xu yao chu li ！]

english: Can I buy some potions?
translation: 我可以买一些药水吗？ [wo ke yi mai yi xie yao shui ma ？]

english: We're not really a shop, so our products are not available to buy directly. Everything we make gets shipped wholesale around the kingdom.
translation: 我们并不是真正的商店，因此我们的产品无法直接购买。我们生产的所有产品都会批发运往王国各地。 [wo men bing bu shi zhen zheng de shang dian ， yin ci wo men de chan pin wu fa zhi jie gou mai 。 wo men sheng chan de suo you chan pin du hui pi fa yun wang wang guo ge di 。]

english: You look like the adventuring type anyway. I can't imagine our products would be of much use to you.
translation: 无论如何，你看起来像是喜欢冒险的人。我无法想象我们的产品会对您有多大用处。 [wu lun ru he ， ni kan qi lai xiang shi xi huan mao xian de ren 。 wo wu fa xiang xiang wo men de chan pin hui dui nin you duo da yong chu 。]

english: Nothing. I'll be going now.
translation: 没有什么。我现在就走。 [mei you shen me 。 wo xian zai jiu zou 。]

english: Hey! Where do you think you're going?
translation: 嘿！你认为你要去哪里？ [hei ！ ni ren wei ni yao qu na li ？]

english: I wanted to see what was down these stairs.
translation: 我想看看楼梯下有什么。 [wo xiang kan kan lou ti xia you shen me 。]

english: We are the Alchemical Society and those stairs lead to our lab and production facilities.
translation: 我们是炼金术协会，那些楼梯通向我们的实验室和生产设施。 [wo men shi lian jin shu xie hui ， na xie lou ti tong xiang wo men de shi yan shi he sheng chan she shi 。]

english: Oh... I think its best that I stay away then.
translation: 哦...我想我最好还是离开吧。 [o ... wo xiang wo zui hao hai shi li kai ba 。]

english: A Herblore level of 60 is required to enter the lab.
translation: 进入实验室需要 Herblore 等级达到 60 级。 [jin ru shi yan shi xu yao  Herblore  deng ji da dao  60  ji 。]

english: I'm actually quite skilled in Herblore. Would it be possible for me to join?
translation: 其实我对 Herblore 很熟练。我可以加入吗？ [qi shi wo dui  Herblore  hen shu lian 。 wo ke yi jia ru ma ？]

english: You are? Well, we're always looking for new members, provided they have the aptitude needed. In that case, head on in and talk to Supervisor Lalo. He'll show you how everything works.
translation: 你是？好吧，我们一直在寻找新成员，只要他们具备所需的能力。在这种情况下，请直接进去与主管 Lalo 交谈。他会向你展示一切是如何运作的。 [ni shi ？ hao ba ， wo men yi zhi zai xun zhao xin cheng yuan ， zhi yao ta men ju bei suo xu de neng li 。 zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， qing zhi jie jin qu yu zhu guan  Lalo  jiao tan 。 ta hui xiang ni zhan shi yi qie shi ru he yun zuo de 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Thanks! I'd better be going now.
translation: 谢谢！我最好现在就走。 [xie xie ！ wo zui hao xian zai jiu zou 。]

english: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这附近做什么？ [ni zai zhe fu jin zuo shen me ？]

english: Can I buy some potions?
translation: 我可以买一些药水吗？ [wo ke yi mai yi xie yao shui ma ？]

english: Nothing. I'll be going now.
translation: 没有什么。我现在就走。 [mei you shen me 。 wo xian zai jiu zou 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Sorry, can't stop to chat! You would be amazed at how many meals this family gets through daily!
translation: 抱歉，无法停下来聊天！你会惊奇地发现这个家庭每天要吃多少顿饭！ [bao qian ， wu fa ting xia lai liao tian ！ ni hui jing qi di fa xian zhe ge jia ting mei tian yao chi duo shao dun fan ！]

english: Hiya.
translation: 嗨。 [hai 。]

english: Well hello there adventurer! Are we fit and well?
translation: 好吧，冒险家你好！我们身体健康吗？ [hao ba ， mao xian jia ni hao ！ wo men shen ti jian kang ma ？]

english: Yep, fine thanks.
translation: 是的，好的，谢谢。 [shi de ， hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Glad to hear it.
translation: 很高兴听到这个消息。 [hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi 。]

english: Hey.
translation: 嘿。 [hei 。]

english: Oh, hello there. Sorry, but I can't really talk right now. Things haven't been great here recently, and I have a lot of work to do.
translation: 哦，你好。抱歉，但我现在真的不能说话。最近这里的情况不太好，我还有很多工作要做。 [o ， ni hao 。 bao qian ， dan wo xian zai zhen de bu neng shuo hua 。 zui jin zhe li de qing kuang bu tai hao ， wo hai you hen duo gong zuo yao zuo 。]

english: Thank you for helping me. A golem can have no greater satisfaction than knowing that its task is complete.
translation: 谢谢你帮助我。对于傀儡来说，没有什么比知道自己的任务已经完成更令人满足的了。 [xie xie ni bang zhu wo 。 dui yu kui lei lai shuo ， mei you shen me bi zhi dao zi ji de ren wu yi jing wan cheng geng ling ren man zu de le 。]

english: But the whole city is destroyed! Doesn't that bother you?
translation: 但整个城市都被摧毁了！这不困扰你吗？ [dan zheng ge cheng shi dou bei cui hui le ！ zhe bu kun rao ni ma ？]

english: I was never programmed to appreciate the city. My only purpose was the destruction of the demon, and that is achieved!
translation: 我从来没有被安排去欣赏这座城市。我的目的只有一个，那就是消灭恶魔，而这已经达到了！ [wo cong lai mei you bei an pai qu xin shang zhe zuo cheng shi 。 wo de mu di zhi you yi ge ， na jiu shi xiao mie e mo ， er zhe yi jing da dao le ！]

english: I regret that I could not assist you in the slaying of Agrith-Naar.
translation: 我很遗憾没能协助你杀死阿格里斯-纳尔。 [wo hen yi han mei neng xie zhu ni sha si a ge li si - na er 。]

english: Don't worry, golem! You've done enough demon-slaying in your time.
translation: 别担心，魔像！你这段时间斩妖除魔的事已经够多了。 [bie dan xin ， mo xiang ！ ni zhe duan shi jian zhan yao chu mo de shi yi jing gou duo le 。]

english: Hello, welcome to the Civic Office of West Ardougne. How can I help you?
translation: 您好，欢迎来到西阿杜涅市政办公室。我怎么帮你？ [nin hao ， huan ying lai dao xi a du nie shi zheng ban gong shi 。 wo zen me bang ni ？]

english: Who is through that door?
translation: 谁从那扇门进来？ [shui cong na shan men jin lai ？]

english: The city warder Bravek is in there.
translation: 城市看守布拉维克就在​​那里。 [cheng shi kan shou bu la wei ke jiu zai ​​ na li 。]

english: Can I go in?
translation: 我可以进去吗？ [wo ke yi jin qu ma ？]

english: He has asked not to be disturbed.
translation: 他要求不要被打扰。 [ta yao qiu bu yao bei da rao 。]

english: I'm just looking thanks.
translation: 我只是看看谢谢 [wo zhi shi kan kan xie xie]

english: I need permission to enter a plague house.
translation: 我需要获得许可才能进入瘟疫屋。 [wo xu yao huo de xu ke cai neng jin ru wen yi wu 。]

english: Rather you than me! The mourners normally deal with that stuff, you should speak to them. Their headquarters are right near the city gate.
translation: 不如你而不是我！哀悼者通常会处理这些事情，你应该和他们谈谈。他们的总部就在城门附近。 [bu ru ni er bu shi wo ！ ai dao zhe tong chang hui chu li zhe xie shi qing ， ni ying gai he ta men tan tan 。 ta men de zong bu jiu zai cheng men fu jin 。]

english: I'll try asking them then.
translation: 那我会尝试问他们。 [na wo hui chang shi wen ta men 。]

english: Surely you don't let them run everything for you?
translation: 你肯定不会让他们为你管理一切吧？ [ni ken ding bu hui rang ta men wei ni guan li yi qie ba ？]

english: Well, they do know what they're doing here. If they did start doing something badly Bravek, the city warder, would have the power to override them. I can't see that happening though.
translation: 好吧，他们确实知道自己在这里做什么。如果他们真的开始做坏事，城市看守布拉维克将有权推翻他们。但我看不到这种情况发生。 [hao ba ， ta men que shi zhi dao zi ji zai zhe li zuo shen me 。 ru guo ta men zhen de kai shi zuo huai shi ， cheng shi kan shou bu la wei ke jiang you quan tui fan ta men 。 dan wo kan bu dao zhe zhong qing kuang fa sheng 。]

english: Can I speak to Bravek anyway?
translation: 我可以和布拉维克通话吗？ [wo ke yi he bu la wei ke tong hua ma ？]

english: This is urgent though! Someone's been kidnapped!
translation: 这件事虽然紧急！有人被绑架了！ [zhe jian shi sui ran jin ji ！ you ren bei bang jia le ！]

english: I'll see what I can do I suppose.
translation: 我会看看我能做什么。 [wo hui kan kan wo neng zuo shen me 。]

english: Mr Bravek, there's a man here who really needs to speak to you.
translation: 布拉维克先生，这里有一个人真的需要和你谈谈。 [bu la wei ke xian sheng ， zhe li you yi ge ren zhen de xu yao he ni tan tan 。]

english: I suppose they can come in then. If they keep it short.
translation: 我想他们到时候就可以进来了。如果他们保持简短。 [wo xiang ta men dao shi hou jiu ke yi jin lai le 。 ru guo ta men bao chi jian duan 。]

english: Okay, I'll leave him alone.
translation: 好吧，我就让他一个人静一静吧。 [hao ba ， wo jiu rang ta yi ge ren jing yi jing ba 。]

english: Do you know when he will be available?
translation: 你知道他什么时候有空吗？ [ni zhi dao ta shen me shi hou you kong ma ？]

english: Oh I don't know, an hour or so maybe.
translation: 哦，我不知道，大概一个小时左右吧。 [o ， wo bu zhi dao ， da gai yi ge xiao shi zuo you ba 。]

english: Bravek will see you now but keep it short!
translation: 布拉维克现在会见你，但请长话短说！ [bu la wei ke xian zai hui jian ni ， dan qing chang hua duan shuo ！]

english: Thanks, I won't take much of his time.
translation: 谢谢，我不会占用他太多时间。 [xie xie ， wo bu hui zhan yong ta tai duo shi jian 。]

english: I suppose so.
translation: 我想是的。 [wo xiang shi de 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Sorry, I don't have time to talk. Bravek needs lots of help running the city.
translation: 抱歉，我没时间说话。布拉维克需要大量帮助来管理这座城市。 [bao qian ， wo mei shi jian shuo hua 。 bu la wei ke xu yao da liang bang zhu lai guan li zhe zuo cheng shi 。]

english: Who is through that door?
translation: 谁从那扇门进来？ [shui cong na shan men jin lai ？]

english: I'm just looking thanks.
translation: 我只是看看谢谢 [wo zhi shi kan kan xie xie]

english: I need permission to enter a plague house.
translation: 我需要获得许可才能进入瘟疫屋。 [wo xu yao huo de xu ke cai neng jin ru wen yi wu 。]

english: I'll try asking them then.
translation: 那我会尝试问他们。 [na wo hui chang shi wen ta men 。]

english: Surely you don't let them run everything for you?
translation: 你肯定不会让他们为你管理一切吧？ [ni ken ding bu hui rang ta men wei ni guan li yi qie ba ？]

english: Can I speak to Bravek anyway?
translation: 我可以和布拉维克通话吗？ [wo ke yi he bu la wei ke tong hua ma ？]

english: This is urgent though! Someone's been kidnapped!
translation: 这件事虽然紧急！有人被绑架了！ [zhe jian shi sui ran jin ji ！ you ren bei bang jia le ！]

english: Okay, I'll leave him alone.
translation: 好吧，我就让他一个人静一静吧。 [hao ba ， wo jiu rang ta yi ge ren jing yi jing ba 。]

english: Do you know when he will be available?
translation: 你知道他什么时候有空吗？ [ni zhi dao ta shen me shi hou you kong ma ？]

english: Good day.
translation: 再会。 [zai hui 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: My name is Clerk. I work on gathering people together to form what we call clans.
translation: 我的名字是职员。我致力于将人们聚集在一起形成我们所说的氏族。 [wo de ming zi shi zhi yuan 。 wo zhi li yu jiang ren men ju ji zai yi qi xing cheng wo men suo shuo de shi zu 。]

english: What is a clan?
translation: 什么是氏族？ [shen me shi shi zu ？]

english: Ah, clans. Where do I begin? Clans are groups of people gathered together for numerous reasons. Usually they have shared interests, like activities they enjoy together.
translation: 啊，氏族。我从哪里开始呢？氏族是由于多种原因聚集在一起的一群人。通常他们有共同的兴趣，比如他们一起喜欢的活动。 [a ， shi zu 。 wo cong na li kai shi ne ？ shi zu shi you yu duo zhong yuan yin ju ji zai yi qi de yi qun ren 。 tong chang ta men you gong tong de xing qu ， bi ru ta men yi qi xi huan de huo dong 。]

english: These activities could include improving certain skills, battling the same monsters, or even battling other clans!
translation: 这些活动可能包括提高某些技能、与相同的怪物战斗，甚至与其他部落战斗！ [zhe xie huo dong ke neng bao kuo ti gao mou xie ji neng 、 yu xiang tong de guai wu zhan dou ， shen zhi yu qi ta bu luo zhan dou ！]

english: Other clans form together because they just enjoy the company of other like-minded people. The clan community can be a great resource if you should ever need help with anything.
translation: 其他氏族之所以聚集在一起，是因为他们只是喜欢与其他志同道合的人在一起。如果您需要任何帮助，氏族社区可以是一个很好的资源。 [qi ta shi zu zhi suo yi ju ji zai yi qi ， shi yin wei ta men zhi shi xi huan yu qi ta zhi tong dao he de ren zai yi qi 。 ru guo nin xu yao ren he bang zhu ， shi zu she qu ke yi shi yi ge hen hao de zi yuan 。]

english: How do I join a clan?
translation: 我如何加入部落？ [wo ru he jia ru bu luo ？]

english: You can either form your own clan with your friends, or apply to an already existing clan.
translation: 您可以与朋友一起组建自己的部落，也可以申请加入现有的部落。 [nin ke yi yu peng you yi qi zu jian zi ji de bu luo ， ye ke yi shen qing jia ru xian you de bu luo 。]

english: Should you choose to form your own clan you will need four friends to join you, and it is recommended that you have spent a good amount of time in this world first. Leadership is not for everyone.
translation: 如果您选择组建自己的氏族，您将需要四个朋友加入，并且建议您首先在这个世界上度过了很长一段时间。领导力并不适合所有人。 [ru guo nin xuan ze zu jian zi ji de shi zu ， nin jiang xu yao si ge peng you jia ru ， bing qie jian yi nin shou xian zai zhe ge shi jie shang du guo le hen zhang yi duan shi jian 。 ling dao li bing bu shi he suo you ren 。]

english: However, fret not. There are plenty of interesting and exciting clans out there! Check out the clan recruitment board to see which clans are currently accepting applications.
translation: 不过，不用担心。那里有很多有趣且令人兴奋的部落！查看部落招募委员会，了解哪些部落目前正在接受申请。 [bu guo ， bu yong dan xin 。 na li you hen duo you qu qie ling ren xing fen de bu luo ！ cha kan bu luo zhao mu wei yuan hui ， liao jie na xie bu luo mu qian zheng zai jie shou shen qing 。]

english: What can a clan offer me?
translation: 部落能为我提供什么？ [bu luo neng wei wo ti gong shen me ？]

english: Clans offer you the ability to have an official gathering of friends or like-minded individuals in a hierarchical structure.
translation: 部落让您能够在等级结构中正式聚集朋友或志趣相投的人。 [bu luo rang nin neng gou zai deng ji jie gou zhong zheng shi ju ji peng you huo zhi qu xiang tou de ren 。]

english: In other words, you and your friends get an exclusive chat channel and a Clan Hall, as well as the ability to assign ranks to members.
translation: 换句话说，你和你的朋友可以获得专属的聊天频道和氏族大厅，以及为成员分配等级的能力。 [huan ju hua shuo ， ni he ni de peng you ke yi huo de zhuan shu de liao tian pin dao he shi zu da ting ， yi ji wei cheng yuan fen pei deng ji de neng li 。]

english: Ranks can be assigned from custom pre-sets, which then determine what permissions that person has.
translation: 可以从自定义预设中分配等级，然后确定该人拥有的权限。 [ke yi cong zi ding yi yu she zhong fen pei deng ji ， ran hou que ding gai ren yong you de quan xian 。]

english: For example: One person may have the rank to kick players from the chat, while another has the rank to access the Clan Coffer.
translation: 例如：一个人可能拥有将玩家踢出聊天的等级，而另一个人则拥有进入氏族保险箱的等级。 [li ru ： yi ge ren ke neng yong you jiang wan jia ti chu liao tian de deng ji ， er ling yi ge ren ze yong you jin ru shi zu bao xian xiang de deng ji 。]

english: What is the Clan Coffer?
translation: 什么是氏族金库？ [shen me shi shi zu jin ku ？]

english: The Clan Coffer is a shared coin store, used by members of the clan. Highly ranked members can assign who has permission to deposit and withdraw coins.
translation: 氏族金库是一个共享的硬币商店，供氏族成员使用。排名靠前的会员可以指定谁有充提币权限。 [shi zu jin ku shi yi ge gong xiang de ying bi shang dian ， gong shi zu cheng yuan shi yong 。 pai ming kao qian de hui yuan ke yi zhi ding shui you chong ti bi quan xian 。]

english: What is a Clan Hall?
translation: 什么是氏族大厅？ [shen me shi shi zu da ting ？]

english: A Clan Hall is a private area only accessible for the people with the permission to enter. High ranked members of the clan can restrict it to only allow certain ranks in, or open it up to even allow guests.
translation: 宗祠是一个私人区域，只有获得许可的人才能进入。部落的高等级成员可以限制它只允许某些等级进入，或者开放它甚至允许客人进入。 [zong ci shi yi ge si ren qu yu ， zhi you huo de xu ke de ren cai neng jin ru 。 bu luo de gao deng ji cheng yuan ke yi xian zhi ta zhi yun xu mou xie deng ji jin ru ， huo zhe kai fang ta shen zhi yun xu ke ren jin ru 。]

english: Why would I need a Clan Hall? Can't I get a house instead?
translation: 我为什么需要氏族大厅？难道我就不能买个房子吗？ [wo wei shen me xu yao shi zu da ting ？ nan dao wo jiu bu neng mai ge fang zi ma ？]

english: The beauty of it is that you can have both. You can keep your house for private guests and your own personal use, but when you wish to see larger groups then the Clan Hall may be more fitting.
translation: 它的美妙之处在于您可以两者兼得。您可以将房屋保留给私人客人和个人使用，但当您希望看到更大的团体时，氏族大厅可能更合适。 [ta de mei miao zhi chu zai yu nin ke yi liang zhe jian de 。 nin ke yi jiang fang wu bao liu gei si ren ke ren he ge ren shi yong ， dan dang nin xi wang kan dao geng da de tuan ti shi ， shi zu da ting ke neng geng he shi 。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: My mission is to administer clans; I help form them and can tell you anything you need to know about them.
translation: 我的使命是管理氏族；我帮助组建它们，并可以告诉您任何您需要了解的关于它们的信息。 [wo de shi ming shi guan li shi zu ； wo bang zhu zu jian ta men ， bing ke yi gao su nin ren he nin xu yao liao jie de guan yu ta men de xin xi 。]

english: Sure, but why are you here specifically?

english: You already have one!
translation: 你已经有一个了！ [ni yi jing you yi ge le ！]

english: Oh yes, sorry.
translation: 哦，是的，抱歉。 [o ， shi de ， bao qian 。]

english: Oh, no. Wait, I don't have enough space to carry one.
translation: 哦，不。等等，我没有足够的空间来携带一个。 [o ， bu 。 deng deng ， wo mei you zu gou de kong jian lai xie dai yi ge 。]

english: Well, you can come back and get one at any time from me.
translation: 好吧，你可以随时回来从我这里拿一份。 [hao ba ， ni ke yi sui shi hui lai cong wo zhe li na yi fen 。]

english: By all means.
translation: 无论如何。 [wu lun ru he 。]

english: Could I have my current wave reset to one?

english: You do realise that you're already on wave one?
translation: 你确实意识到你已经处于第一波了吗？ [ni que shi yi shi dao ni yi jing chu yu di yi bo le ma ？]

english: Ah. Yes. Sorry about that.
translation: 啊。是的。对此感到抱歉。 [a 。 shi de 。 dui ci gan dao bao qian 。]

translation: 仅此而已，先生。 [jin ci er yi ， xian sheng 。]

translation: 很好，正在路上。 [hen hao ， zheng zai lu shang 。]

translation: 嗯嗯，还不错，就是…… [n n ， hai bu cuo ， jiu shi ……]

translation: 啊，发现东西了！ [a ， fa xian dong xi le ！]

english: You've got...

english: Could I have a 'Queen Help' book?

english: Could I have my current wave reset to one?
