english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Good day.
translation: 再会。 [zai hui 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm Commander Lydia Fullore, leader of the Kourend Royal Guard.
translation: 我是莉迪亚·福洛尔指挥官，库伦德皇家卫队的队长。 [wo shi li di ya · fu luo er zhi hui guan ， ku lun de huang jia wei dui de dui zhang 。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: The Kourend Royal Guard protect and serve the ruler of Kourend. As their leader, I am responsible for ensuring that the Royal Guard are well trained and well supplied.
translation: 库伦德皇家卫队保护并服务于库伦德的统治者。作为他们的领导者，我有责任确保皇家卫队训练有素且供应充足。 [ku lun de huang jia wei dui bao hu bing fu wu yu ku lun de de tong zhi zhe 。 zuo wei ta men de ling dao zhe ， wo you ze ren que bao huang jia wei dui xun lian you su qie gong ying chong zu 。]

english: Are the Royal Guard part of the Shayzien Army?
translation: 皇家卫队是 Shayzien 军队的一部分吗？ [huang jia wei dui shi  Shayzien  jun dui de yi bu fen ma ？]

english: No. Unlike the Shayzien Army, the Royal Guard serve the ruler of the kingdom directly.
translation: 不。与 Shayzien 军队不同，皇家卫队直接为王国的统治者服务。 [bu 。 yu  Shayzien  jun dui bu tong ， huang jia wei dui zhi jie wei wang guo de tong zhi zhe fu wu 。]

english: The Royal Guard was established by King Byrne I. He felt that it was dangerous for Shayzien House to control the only military in the kingdom, so he decided to establish a small one of his own.
translation: 皇家卫队是国王伯恩一世建立的。他觉得沙伊恩家族控制王国唯一的军队是危险的，所以他决定建立一支自己的小型军队。 [huang jia wei dui shi guo wang bo en yi shi jian li de 。 ta jue de sha yi en jia zu kong zhi wang guo wei yi de jun dui shi wei xian de ， suo yi ta jue ding jian li yi zhi zi ji de xiao xing jun dui 。]

english: Ever since then, the Royal Guard have served Kourend's ruler.
translation: 从那时起，皇家卫队就开始为库伦德的统治者服务。 [cong na shi qi ， huang jia wei dui jiu kai shi wei ku lun de de tong zhi zhe fu wu 。]

english: Who's the current ruler of Kourend?
translation: 库伦德现任统治者是谁？ [ku lun de xian ren tong zhi zhe shi shui ？]

english: The current ruler, or rulers as I should say, are the Kourend Council. They've ruled the kingdom for the past twenty years, ever since the last King died.
translation: 当前的统治者，或者我应该说的统治者，是库伦德议会。自从上一位国王去世以来，他们已经统治了这个王国二十年。 [dang qian de tong zhi zhe ， huo zhe wo ying gai shuo de tong zhi zhe ， shi ku lun de yi hui 。 zi cong shang yi wei guo wang qu shi yi lai ， ta men yi jing tong zhi le zhe ge wang guo er shi nian 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Hey. I have something for you.
translation: 嘿。我有东西给你。 [hei 。 wo you dong xi gei ni 。]

english: Hey Lydia. How are things here?
translation: 嘿莉迪亚。这里怎么样？ [hei li di ya 。 zhe li zen me yang ？]

english: It's still early days for King Artur. He was raised to rule, but he lacks the experience his father had. Still, he can't be any worse than the Council.
translation: 对于阿图尔王来说，现在还处于早期阶段。他从小就被培养成统治者，但他缺乏他父亲所拥有的经验。尽管如此，他也不会比议会更差。 [dui yu a tu er wang lai shuo ， xian zai hai chu yu zao qi jie duan 。 ta cong xiao jiu bei pei yang cheng tong zhi zhe ， dan ta que fa ta fu qin suo yong you de jing yan 。 jin guan ru ci ， ta ye bu hui bi yi hui geng cha 。]

english: Any news on Xamphur or the killer?
translation: 有关于 Xamphur 或凶手的消息吗？ [you guan yu  Xamphur  huo xiong shou de xiao xi ma ？]

english: Nothing yet. For all we know, they could be one and the same. Lord Arceuus is doing everything he can to learn more about Xamphur, and the Lovakengj smiths are inspecting the murder weapon.
translation: 还什么都没有。据我们所知，它们可能是同一个人。阿尔宙斯勋爵正在尽一切努力了解更多有关桑普尔的信息，而洛瓦肯吉的铁匠们正在检查凶器。 [hai shen me dou mei you 。 ju wo men suo zhi ， ta men ke neng shi tong yi ge ren 。 a er zhou si xun jue zheng zai jin yi qie nu li liao jie geng duo you guan sang pu er de xin xi ， er luo wa ken ji de tie jiang men zheng zai jian cha xiong qi 。]

english: I'll let you know once we have something on either of them.
translation: 一旦我们有关于其中任何一个的消息，我就会通知你。 [yi dan wo men you guan yu qi zhong ren he yi ge de xiao xi ， wo jiu hui tong zhi ni 。]

english: Thank you. I'll let you get on with your work.
translation: 谢谢。我会让你继续你的工作。 [xie xie 。 wo hui rang ni ji xu ni de gong zuo 。]

english: Good luck out there. Don't be a stranger.
translation: 祝你好运。别做陌生人。 [zhu ni hao yun 。 bie zuo mo sheng ren 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Are the Royal Guard part of the Shayzien Army?
translation: 皇家卫队是 Shayzien 军队的一部分吗？ [huang jia wei dui shi  Shayzien  jun dui de yi bu fen ma ？]

english: Who's the current ruler of Kourend?
translation: 库伦德现任统治者是谁？ [ku lun de xian ren tong zhi zhe shi shui ？]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: I can't talk now. Can't you see we're trying to win a battle here? If we can't hold back Khazard's men we're all doomed.
translation: 我现在不能说话。你没看到我们正在努力赢得一场战斗吗？如果我们不能阻止卡扎德的人，我们就完蛋了。 [wo xian zai bu neng shuo hua 。 ni mei kan dao wo men zheng zai nu li ying de yi chang zhan dou ma ？ ru guo wo men bu neng zu zhi ka zha de de ren ， wo men jiu wan dan le 。]

english: Hello traveller, are you here to help or just to watch?
translation: 你好旅行者，你是来帮忙还是只是来看看？ [ni hao lv xing zhe ， ni shi lai bang mang hai shi zhi shi lai kan kan ？]

english: I've been sent by King Bolren to retrieve the orb of protection.
translation: 博伦国王派我去取回保护球。 [bo lun guo wang pai wo qu qu hui bao hu qiu 。]

english: Excellent we need all the help we can get.
translation: 太棒了，我们需要我们能得到的所有帮助。 [tai bang le ， wo men xu yao wo men neng de dao de suo you bang zhu 。]

english: I'm commander Montai. The orb is in the Khazard stronghold to the north, but until we weaken their defences we can't get close.
translation: 我是蒙泰指挥官。该球体位于北部的卡扎德要塞中，但在我们削弱他们的防御之前，我们无法接近。 [wo shi meng tai zhi hui guan 。 gai qiu ti wei yu bei bu de ka zha de yao sai zhong ， dan zai wo men xue ruo ta men de fang yu zhi qian ， wo men wu fa jie jin 。]

english: What can I do?
translation: 我能做些什么？ [wo neng zuo xie shen me ？]

english: Firstly we need to strengthen our own defences. We desperately need wood to make more battlements, once the battlements are gone it's all over. Six loads of normal logs should do it.
translation: 首先我们要加强自身防御。我们迫切需要木材来建造更多的城垛，一旦城垛消失了，一切就都结束了。六次正常日志的负载应该可以完成。 [shou xian wo men yao jia qiang zi shen fang yu 。 wo men po qie xu yao mu cai lai jian zao geng duo de cheng duo ， yi dan cheng duo xiao shi le ， yi qie jiu dou jie shu le 。 liu ci zheng chang ri zhi de fu zai ying gai ke yi wan cheng 。]

english: Ok, I'll gather some wood.
translation: 好的，我去收集一些木头。 [hao de ， wo qu shou ji yi xie mu tou 。]

english: Please be as quick as you can, I don't know how much longer we can hold out.
translation: 请尽快，我不知道我们还能坚持多久。 [qing jin kuai ， wo bu zhi dao wo men hai neng jian chi duo jiu 。]

english: Sorry I no longer want to be involved.
translation: 抱歉我不想再参与其中了。 [bao qian wo bu xiang zai can yu qi zhong le 。]

english: That's a shame, we could have done with your help.
translation: 真遗憾，如果有你的帮助我们本来可以做到的。 [zhen yi han ， ru guo you ni de bang zhu wo men ben lai ke yi zuo dao de 。]

english: Hello again, we're still desperate for wood soldier. We need six loads of normal logs.
translation: 再次大家好，我们仍然渴望木兵。我们需要六负载普通日志。 [zai ci da jia hao ， wo men reng ran ke wang mu bing 。 wo men xu yao liu fu zai pu tong ri zhi 。]

english: I'll see what I can do.
translation: 我会看看我能做什么。 [wo hui kan kan wo neng zuo shen me 。]

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Hello again, we're still desperate for wood soldier.
translation: 再次大家好，我们仍然渴望木兵。 [zai ci da jia hao ， wo men reng ran ke wang mu bing 。]

english: I have some here.(You give six loads of logs to the commander.)
translation: 我这里有一些。（你给指挥官六包木头。） [wo zhe li you yi xie 。（ ni gei zhi hui guan liu bao mu tou 。）]

english: That's excellent, now we can make more defensive battlements. Give me a moment to organise the troops and then come speak to me. I'll inform you of our next phase of attack.
translation: 太好了，现在我们可以建造更多的防御城垛了。给我一点时间组织部队，然后来跟我说话。我会通知你我们下一阶段的攻击。 [tai hao le ， xian zai wo men ke yi jian zao geng duo de fang yu cheng duo le 。 gei wo yi dian shi jian zu zhi bu dui ， ran hou lai gen wo shuo hua 。 wo hui tong zhi ni wo men xia yi jie duan de gong ji 。]

english: How are you doing Montai?
translation: 蒙泰你怎么样？ [meng tai ni zen me yang ？]

english: We're hanging in there soldier. For the next phase of our attack we need to breach their stronghold.
translation: 我们是挂在那里的士兵。在我们下一阶段的攻击中，我们需要突破他们的据点。 [wo men shi gua zai na li di shi bing 。 zai wo men xia yi jie duan de gong ji zhong ， wo men xu yao tu po ta men de ju dian 。]

english: The ballista can break through the stronghold wall, and then we can advance and seize back the orb.
translation: 弩炮可以突破壁垒，然后我们就可以前进并夺回球体。 [nu pao ke yi tu po bi lei ， ran hou wo men jiu ke yi qian jin bing duo hui qiu ti 。]

english: So what's the problem?
translation: 那么问题出在哪里呢？ [na me wen ti chu zai na li ne ？]

english: From this distance we can't get an accurate enough shot. We need the correct coordinates of the stronghold for a direct hit. I've sent out three tracker gnomes to gather them.
translation: 从这个距离我们无法获得足够准确的射击。我们需要正确的据点坐标才能直接打击。我已经派出了三个追踪侏儒来收集他们。 [cong zhe ge ju li wo men wu fa huo de zu gou zhun que de she ji 。 wo men xu yao zheng que de ju dian zuo biao cai neng zhi jie da ji 。 wo yi jing pai chu le san ge zhui zong zhu ru lai shou ji ta men 。]

english: Have they returned?
translation: 他们回来了吗？ [ta men hui lai le ma ？]

english: I'm afraid not, and we're running out of time. I need you to go into the heart of the battlefield, find the trackers, and bring back the coordinates.
translation: 恐怕不行，而且我们的时间不多了。我需要你深入战场的中心，找到追踪器，并带回坐标。 [kong pa bu xing ， er qie wo men de shi jian bu duo le 。 wo xu yao ni shen ru zhan chang de zhong xin ， zhao dao zhui zong qi ， bing dai hui zuo biao 。]

english: Do you think you can do it?
translation: 你认为你能做到吗？ [ni ren wei ni neng zuo dao ma ？]

english: No, I've had enough of your battle.
translation: 不，我已经受够了你们的战斗。 [bu ， wo yi jing shou gou le ni men de zhan dou 。]

english: I understand, this isn't your fight.
translation: 我明白，这不是你的战斗。 [wo ming bai ， zhe bu shi ni de zhan dou 。]

english: I'll try my best.
translation: 我会尽力的。 [wo hui jin li de 。]

english: Thank you, you're braver than most.
translation: 谢谢你，你比大多数人都勇敢。 [xie xie ni ， ni bi da duo shu ren dou yong gan 。]

english: I don't know how long I will be able to hold out. Once you have the coordinates come back and fire the ballista right into those monsters.
translation: 我不知道我还能坚持多久。一旦你得到了坐标，就可以用弩炮直接射向那些怪物。 [wo bu zhi dao wo hai neng jian chi duo jiu 。 yi dan ni de dao le zuo biao ， jiu ke yi yong nu pao zhi jie she xiang na xie guai wu 。]

english: If you can retrieve the orb and bring safety back to my people, none of the blood spilled on this field will be in vain.
translation: 如果你能取回宝珠并为我的人民带回安全，那么洒在这片土地上的鲜血就不会白流。 [ru guo ni neng qu hui bao zhu bing wei wo de ren min dai hui an quan ， na me sa zai zhe pian tu di shang de xian xue jiu bu hui bai liu 。]

english: Hello warrior. We need the coordinates for a direct hit from the ballista. Once you have a direct hit you will be able to enter the stronghold and retrieve the orb.
translation: 你好战士。我们需要弩炮直接攻击的坐标。一旦你直接命中，你就可以进入要塞并取回球体。 [ni hao zhan shi 。 wo men xu yao nu pao zhi jie gong ji de zuo biao 。 yi dan ni zhi jie ming zhong ， ni jiu ke yi jin ru yao sai bing qu hui qiu ti 。]

english: I've breached the stronghold.
translation: 我已经攻破了据点。 [wo yi jing gong po le ju dian 。]

english: I saw, that was a beautiful sight. The Khazard troops didn't know what hit them.
translation: 我看到了，那景色真美。卡扎尔军队不知道是什么击中了他们。 [wo kan dao le ， na jing se zhen mei 。 ka zha er jun dui bu zhi dao shi shen me ji zhong le ta men 。]

english: Now is the time to retrieve the orb. It's all in your hands. I'll be praying for you.
translation: 现在是取回球体的时候了。一切都在你的手中。我会为你祈祷。 [xian zai shi qu hui qiu ti de shi hou le 。 yi qie dou zai ni de shou zhong 。 wo hui wei ni qi dao 。]

english: I have the orb of protection.
translation: 我有保护球。 [wo you bao hu qiu 。]

english: Incredible, for a human you really are something.
translation: 难以置信，对于一个人来说，你真的很了不起。 [nan yi zhi xin ， dui yu yi ge ren lai shuo ， ni zhen de hen liao bu qi 。]

english: Thanks... I think!
translation: 谢谢...我想！ [xie xie ... wo xiang ！]

english: I'll stay here with my troops and try and hold Khazard's men back. You return the orb to the gnome village. Go as quick as you can, the village is still unprotected.
translation: 我会和我的部队留在这里，尽力阻止卡扎德的人。你将球体归还给侏儒村庄。尽可能快地走，村庄还没有受到保护。 [wo hui he wo de bu dui liu zai zhe li ， jin li zu zhi ka zha de de ren 。 ni jiang qiu ti gui huan gei zhu ru cun zhuang 。 jin ke neng kuai di zou ， cun zhuang hai mei you shou dao bao hu 。]

english: Hello Montai, how are you?
translation: 你好，蒙泰，你好吗？ [ni hao ， meng tai ， ni hao ma ？]

english: I'm ok, this battle is going to take longer to win than I expected. The Khazard troops won't give up even without the orb.
translation: 我没事，这场战斗比我预想的要花更长的时间才能获胜。即使没有球体，卡萨德军队也不会放弃。 [wo mei shi ， zhe chang zhan dou bi wo yu xiang de yao hua geng zhang de shi jian cai neng huo sheng 。 ji shi mei you qiu ti ， ka sa de jun dui ye bu hui fang qi 。]

english: Hang in there.
translation: 坚持住。 [jian chi zhu 。]

english: Ok, I'll gather some wood.
translation: 好的，我去收集一些木头。 [hao de ， wo qu shou ji yi xie mu tou 。]

english: Sorry, I no longer want to be involved.
translation: 抱歉，我不想再参与其中了。 [bao qian ， wo bu xiang zai can yu qi zhong le 。]

english: No, I've had enough of your battle.
translation: 不，我已经受够了你们的战斗。 [bu ， wo yi jing shou gou le ni men de zhan dou 。]

english: I'll try my best.
translation: 我会尽力的。 [wo hui jin li de 。]

english: Greetings, Zilyana.
translation: 你好，齐利亚娜。 [ni hao ， qi li ya na 。]

english: Commander, if you don't mind.
translation: 指挥官，如果您不介意的话。 [zhi hui guan ， ru guo nin bu jie yi de hua 。]

english: I don't, Zilyana.
translation: 我不知道，齐利亚娜。 [wo bu zhi dao ， qi li ya na 。]

english: Bah, find me some more cake. oh and FIND THE GODSWORD!
translation: 呸，再给我找点蛋糕吧。哦，找到神剑！ [pei ， zai gei wo zhao dian dan gao ba 。 o ， zhao dao shen jian ！]

english: I'll err... get some more cake alright?
translation: 我错了...再买点蛋糕好吗？ [wo cuo le ... zai mai dian dan gao hao ma ？]

english: All praise Saradomin!
translation: 所有人都称赞萨拉多明！ [suo you ren dou cheng zan sa la duo ming ！]

english: Slay the evil ones!
translation: 消灭恶人​​！ [xiao mie e ren ​​！]

english: Death to the enemies of the light!
translation: 光之敌人必死无疑！ [guang zhi di ren bi si wu yi ！]

english: Saradomin lend me strength!
translation: 萨拉多明赐予我力量！ [sa la duo ming ci yu wo li liang ！]

english: Saradomin is with us!
translation: 萨拉多明与我们同在！ [sa la duo ming yu wo men tong zai ！]

english: Forward! Our allies are with us!
translation: 向前！我们的盟友与我们同在！ [xiang qian ！ wo men de meng you yu wo men tong zai ！]

english: Good will always triumph!
translation: 善良总会胜利！ [shan liang zong hui sheng li ！]

english: May Saradomin be my sword!
translation: 愿萨​​拉多明成为我的剑！ [yuan sa ​​ la duo ming cheng wei wo de jian ！]

english: In the name of Saradomin!
translation: 以萨拉多明之名！ [yi sa la duo ming zhi ming ！]

english: Attack! Find the Godsword!
translation: 攻击！寻找神剑！ [gong ji ！ xun zhao shen jian ！]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Good day to you.
translation: 祝你有美好的一天。 [zhu ni you mei hao de yi tian 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm Commissioner Anwar. I'm in charge of the Shayzien Constabulary. With Lord Shayzien currently busy with the war efforts, I'm also assisting him with his duties here in the city.
translation: 我是安瓦尔专员。我负责 Shayzien 警察局。由于 Shayzien 勋爵目前正忙于战争工作，我也在协助他履行在城里的职责。 [wo shi an wa er zhuan yuan 。 wo fu ze  Shayzien  jing cha ju 。 you yu  Shayzien  xun jue mu qian zheng mang yu zhan zheng gong zuo ， wo ye zai xie zhu ta lv xing zai cheng li de zhi ze 。]

english: What's the Shayzien Constabulary?
translation: Shayzien 警察局是什么？ [Shayzien  jing cha ju shi shen me ？]

english: The Shayzien Army is split into six regiments plus the Shayzien Constabulary. While the six regiments are jointly responsible for protecting Kourend from external threats, we deal with issues closer to home.
translation: Shayzien 军队分为六个团以及 Shayzien 警察。虽然六个团共同负责保护库伦德免受外部威胁，但我们处理的是离家较近的问题。 [Shayzien  jun dui fen wei liu ge tuan yi ji  Shayzien  jing cha 。 sui ran liu ge tuan gong tong fu ze bao hu ku lun de mian shou wai bu wei xie ， dan wo men chu li de shi li jia jiao jin de wen ti 。]

english: What are the six regiments?
translation: 六大军团是哪六大军团？ [liu da jun tuan shi na liu da jun tuan ？]

english: The Intelligence Corps, the Medical Corps, the Engineering Corps, the Logistics Corps, the Rangers and of course, the Infantry. Each regiment is led by a general who reports directly to Lord Shayzien.
translation: 情报兵、医疗兵、工程兵、后勤兵、游骑兵，当然还有步兵。每个团由一名直接向 Shayzien 勋爵汇报的将军领导。 [qing bao bing 、 yi liao bing 、 gong cheng bing 、 hou qin bing 、 you qi bing ， dang ran hai you bu bing 。 mei ge tuan you yi ming zhi jie xiang  Shayzien  xun jue hui bao de jiang jun ling dao 。]

english: It feels like there must be a bit of overlap between the Constabulary and the regiments, especially the Intelligence Corps.
translation: 感觉警察部队和军团之间肯定有一些重叠，尤其是情报部队。 [gan jue jing cha bu dui he jun tuan zhi jian ken ding you yi xie chong die ， you qi shi qing bao bu dui 。]

english: On paper we're totally separate from the regiments. However, in reality you are correct. The distinction between internal and external threats grows murkier by the day.
translation: 从表面上看，我们与军团完全分开。然而，事实上你是对的。内部威胁和外部威胁之间的区别日益模糊。 [cong biao mian shang kan ， wo men yu jun tuan wan quan fen kai 。 ran er ， shi shi shang ni shi dui de 。 nei bu wei xie he wai bu wei xie zhi jian de qu bie ri yi mo hu 。]

english: More and more we find ourselves working alongside the Intelligence Corps and the other regiments. In particular, they've been supporting us in combating the rising gang threat in Port Piscarilius.
translation: 我们越来越多地发现自己与情报部队和其他军团一起工作。特别是，他们一直支持我们打击皮斯卡利留港日益严重的帮派威胁。 [wo men yue lai yue duo di fa xian zi ji yu qing bao bu dui he qi ta jun tuan yi qi gong zuo 。 te bie shi ， ta men yi zhi zhi chi wo men da ji pi si ka li liu gang ri yi yan zhong de bang pai wei xie 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This is the Shayzien Administration. The city of Shayzien is run from here.
translation: 这是 Shayzien 政府。 Shayzien 市由这里管理。 [zhe shi  Shayzien  zheng fu 。 Shayzien  shi you zhe li guan li 。]

english: It seems very quiet.
translation: 看起来很安静。 [kan qi lai hen an jing 。]

english: A lot of focus right now is on the war with the lizardmen. Most senior members of the Shayzien Army, including Lord Shayzien himself, are working out of the Shayzien Encampment instead.
translation: 现在很多焦点都集中在与蜥蜴人的战争上。沙伊恩军队的大多数高级成员，包括沙伊恩勋爵本人，都在沙伊恩营地外工作。 [xian zai hen duo jiao dian dou ji zhong zai yu xi yi ren de zhan zheng shang 。 sha yi en jun dui de da duo shu gao ji cheng yuan ， bao kuo sha yi en xun jue ben ren ， dou zai sha yi en ying di wai gong zuo 。]

english: So the Shayzien Army are also responsible for running the city?
translation: 那么Shayzien军也负责管理这座城市？ [na me Shayzien jun ye fu ze guan li zhe zuo cheng shi ？]

english: Indeed. There's more of a separation between the city of Shayzien and the Shayzien Army now than there used to be, but this will likely always be a military settlement.
translation: 的确。现在，沙伊恩市和沙伊恩军队之间的距离比以前更加分离，但这很可能永远是一个军事定居点。 [di que 。 xian zai ， sha yi en shi he sha yi en jun dui zhi jian de ju li bi yi qian geng jia fen li ， dan zhe hen ke neng yong yuan shi yi ge jun shi ding ju dian 。]

english: See you later.
translation: 稍后见。 [shao hou jian 。]

translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Hello there, would you like to take part in the archery competition? It only costs 200 coins to enter.
translation: 您好，您想参加射箭比赛吗？只需要200金币即可进入。 [nin hao ， nin xiang can jia she jian bi sai ma ？ zhi xu yao 200 jin bi ji ke jin ru 。]

english: Sure, I'll give it a go.
translation: 当然，我会尝试一下。 [dang ran ， wo hui chang shi yi xia 。]

english: Great! That will be 200 coins then please.
translation: 伟大的！那么请给200个硬币。 [wei da de ！ na me qing gei 200 ge ying bi 。]

english: Oops, I don't have enough coins on me...
translation: 哎呀，我身上的金币不够了…… [ai ya ， wo shen shang de jin bi bu gou le ……]

english: Never mind, come back when you've got enough.
translation: 没关系，等你玩够了再回来。 [mei guan xi ， deng ni wan gou le zai hui lai 。]

english: You pay the judge and he gives you 10 bronze arrows.
translation: 你付钱给法官，他会给你 10 支铜箭。 [ni fu qian gei fa guan ， ta hui gei ni  10  zhi tong jian 。]

english: What are the rules?
translation: 规则是什么？ [gui ze shi shen me ？]

english: The rules are very simple:
translation: 规则很简单： [gui ze hen jian dan ：]

english: You're given 10 shots at the targets, for each hit you will receive points. At the end you'll be awarded 1 ticket for every 10 points.
translation: 您可以向目标射击 10 次，每次击中您都会获得积分。最后，每 10 积分您将获得 1 张门票。 [nin ke yi xiang mu biao she ji  10  ci ， mei ci ji zhong nin du hui huo de ji fen 。 zui hou ， mei  10  ji fen nin jiang huo de  1  zhang men piao 。]

english: The tickets can be exchanged for goods from our stores. Do you want to give it a go? Only 200 coins.
translation: 门票可以在我们的商店兑换商品。你想尝试一下吗？只要200金币。 [men piao ke yi zai wo men de shang dian dui huan shang pin 。 ni xiang chang shi yi xia ma ？ zhi yao 200 jin bi 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello again, do you need reminding of the rules?
translation: 您好，请问需要提醒一下规则吗？ [nin hao ， qing wen xu yao ti xing yi xia gui ze ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: The tickets can be exchanged for goods from our stores. Good luck!
translation: 门票可以在我们的商店兑换商品。祝你好运！ [men piao ke yi zai wo men de shang dian dui huan shang pin 。 zhu ni hao yun ！]

english: No thanks, I've got it.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我已经拿到了。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo yi jing na dao le 。]

english: Glad to hear it, good luck!
translation: 很高兴听到这个消息，祝你好运！ [hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi ， zhu ni hao yun ！]

english: How am I doing so far?
translation: 到目前为止我做得怎么样？ [dao mu qian wei zhi wo zuo de zen me yang ？]

english: So far your score is: 0. You haven't started yet.
translation: 到目前为止，您的分数是：0。您还没有开始。 [dao mu qian wei zhi ， nin de fen shu shi ：0。 nin hai mei you kai shi 。]

english: So far your score is: [number]. Not bad, keep going.
translation: 到目前为止，您的分数是：[数字]。还不错，继续。 [dao mu qian wei zhi ， nin de fen shu shi ：[ shu zi ]。 hai bu cuo ， ji xu 。]

english: So far your score is: [number]. You're pretty good, keep it up.
translation: 到目前为止，您的分数是：[数字]。你已经很不错了，继续保持吧 [dao mu qian wei zhi ， nin de fen shu shi ：[ shu zi ]。 ni yi jing hen bu cuo le ， ji xu bao chi ba]

english: Well done. Your score is: [number]. For that score you will receive [number] Archery tickets. Would you like to try again for another 200 coins?
translation: 干得好。您的分数是：[数字]。对于该分数，您将收到 [数量] 张射箭门票。您想再尝试一次 200 个硬币吗？ [gan de hao 。 nin de fen shu shi ：[ shu zi ]。 dui yu gai fen shu ， nin jiang shou dao  [ shu liang ]  zhang she jian men piao 。 nin xiang zai chang shi yi ci  200  ge ying bi ma ？]

english: I haven't got the money.
translation: 我还没拿到钱 [wo hai mei na dao qian]

english: Sure, I'll give it a go.
translation: 当然，我会尝试一下。 [dang ran ， wo hui chang shi yi xia 。]

english: What are the rules?
translation: 规则是什么？ [gui ze shi shen me ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks, I've got it.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我已经拿到了。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo yi jing na dao le 。]

english: How am I doing so far?
translation: 到目前为止我做得怎么样？ [dao mu qian wei zhi wo zuo de zen me yang ？]

english: Hey there. Looking to buy or sell some jewellery?
translation: 嘿。想要购买或出售一些珠宝？ [hei 。 xiang yao gou mai huo chu shou yi xie zhu bao ？]

english: Sure.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: Good choice.
translation: 不错的选择。 [bu cuo de xuan ze 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Well come back if you change your mind.
translation: 如果你改变主意就回来吧。 [ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi jiu hui lai ba 。]

english: Sure.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Excuse me, you don't look very happy. What's wrong?
translation: 对不起，你看上去不太高兴。怎么了？ [dui bu qi ， ni kan shang qu bu tai gao xing 。 zen me le ？]

english: There's an egg-shaped hole in my life.
translation: 我的生命中有一个蛋形的洞。 [wo de sheng ming zhong you yi ge dan xing de dong 。]

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你是什​​么意思？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: Usually Varrock is full of Easter merriment by now...
translation: 通常瓦罗克现在充满了复活节的欢乐...... [tong chang wa luo ke xian zai chong man le fu huo jie de huan le ......]

english: Wagons heaving with eggs being hauled up through the streets...
translation: 满载鸡蛋的马车在街道上拖行…… [man zai ji dan de ma che zai jie dao shang tuo xing ……]

english: Giant rabbits hopping about, building stalls and putting up decorations...
translation: 巨型兔子跳来跳去，搭建摊位，布置装饰…… [ju xing tu zi tiao lai tiao qu ， da jian tan wei ， bu zhi zhuang shi ……]

english: That sounds nice.
translation: 听起来不错。 [ting qi lai bu cuo 。]

english: It was a bloody racket to be honest, and dangerous!
translation: 说实话，这是一场血腥的闹剧，而且很危险！ [shuo shi hua ， zhe shi yi chang xue xing de nao ju ， er qie hen wei xian ！]

english: But I'd gladly stand on a rusty nail or take a plank to the face for one of them delicious chocolate eggs.
translation: 但我很乐意站在生锈的钉子上，或者用一块木板贴在脸上，以获得其中一个美味的巧克力蛋。 [dan wo hen le yi zhan zai sheng xiu de ding zi shang ， huo zhe yong yi kuai mu ban tie zai lian shang ， yi huo de qi zhong yi ge mei wei de qiao ke li dan 。]

english: Fair enough. Now that you mention it, I would have expected the Easter Bunny to have turned up by now. You're sure you haven't seen him?
translation: 很公平。既然你提到了，我本以为复活节兔子现在已经出现了。你确定你没见过他吗？ [hen gong ping 。 ji ran ni ti dao le ， wo ben yi wei fu huo jie tu zi xian zai yi jing chu xian le 。 ni que ding ni mei jian guo ta ma ？]

english: Nobody has, and yet the streets are full of old carrots. We don't usually have such a problem with vegetable waste unless him and his lot have turned up.
translation: 没有人这么做，但街道上却满是老胡萝卜。除非他和他的同伴出现，否则我们通常不会遇到这样的蔬菜浪费问题。 [mei you ren zhe me zuo ， dan jie dao shang que man shi lao hu luo bo 。 chu fei ta he ta de tong ban chu xian ， fou ze wo men tong chang bu hui yu dao zhe yang de shu cai lang fei wen ti 。]

english: Vegetable waste, eh?
translation: 蔬菜垃圾，是吗？ [shu cai la ji ， shi ma ？]

english: Aye. It wasn't so bad when it was just the crates lying around, but someone's been in them and scattered carrots all over the place.
translation: 是啊。当周围只有板条箱时，情况还算不错，但有人在里面，把胡萝卜撒得到处都是。 [shi a 。 dang zhou wei zhi you ban tiao xiang shi ， qing kuang hai suan bu cuo ， dan you ren zai li mian ， ba hu luo bo sa de dao chu dou shi 。]

english: Curious... I wonder...
translation: 好奇……我想知道…… [hao qi …… wo xiang zhi dao ……]

english: It's not just Varrock mind, it's the woods to the south of here too!
translation: 不仅仅是瓦罗克的心智如此，这里南边的树林也是如此！ [bu jin jin shi wa luo ke de xin zhi ru ci ， zhe li nan bian de shu lin ye shi ru ci ！]

english: Hmmmmmmm.......
Crates of carrots you say? Woods to the south?
translation: 你说一箱胡萝卜？南边的树林？ [ni shuo yi xiang hu luo bo ？ nan bian de shu lin ？]

english: Aye, proper suspicious if you ask me.
translation: 是的，如果你问我的话，我确实很怀疑。 [shi de ， ru guo ni wen wo de hua ， wo que shi hen huai yi 。]

english: You wait right here sir, I've got a hunch...
translation: 先生，你在这里等着，我有预感…… [xian sheng ， ni zai zhe li deng zhe ， wo you yu gan ……]

english: Oh lunch is it now eh? Can I have some?
translation: 哦，现在是午餐了吗？我可以要一些吗？ [o ， xian zai shi wu can le ma ？ wo ke yi yao yi xie ma ？]

english: No, a hunch. About the carrots.
translation: 不，有预感。关于胡萝卜。 [bu ， you yu gan 。 guan yu hu luo bo 。]

english: They're old and dirty, I don't want to eat those!
translation: 它们又旧又脏，我不想吃那些！ [ta men you jiu you zang ， wo bu xiang chi na xie ！]

english: No... Just... I'll be back later! I need to investigate some rotten vegetables.
translation: 不……只是……我一会儿就回来！我需要调查一些腐烂的蔬菜。 [bu …… zhi shi …… wo yi hui er jiu hui lai ！ wo xu yao diao cha yi xie fu lan de shu cai 。]

english: They best not end up in my lunch!
translation: 它们最好不要出现在我的午餐中！ [ta men zui hao bu yao chu xian zai wo de wu can zhong ！]

english: You should probably have a look around for a suspicious crate of carrots.
translation: 您可能应该四处看看是否有一箱可疑的胡萝卜。 [nin ke neng ying gai si chu kan kan shi fou you yi xiang ke yi de hu luo bo 。]

english: Wait, what was I thinking about? Oh nevermind, it's gone. Can't have been that important I suppose.
translation: 等等，我在想什么？噢，没关系，已经消失了。我想不可能那么重要。 [deng deng ， wo zai xiang shen me ？ o ， mei guan xi ， yi jing xiao shi le 。 wo xiang bu ke neng na me zhong yao 。]

english: *sigh*
translation: *叹* [* tan *]

english: Fetch me lunch for me then eh, I'm right peckish!
translation: 那你给我带午餐吧，呃，我真饿了！ [na ni gei wo dai wu can ba ， e ， wo zhen e le ！]

english: I'm a bit busy at the moment.
translation: 我现在有点忙。 [wo xian zai you dian mang 。]

english: Busy mucking about with carrots!
translation: 忙着吃胡萝卜！ [mang zhe chi hu luo bo ！]

english: Yeah, where did you say that crate was again?
translation: 是啊，你刚才说那个箱子又在哪里？ [shi a ， ni gang cai shuo na ge xiang zi you zai na li ？]

english: It's in the woods just south of here. Carrots all over the place too!
translation: 它就在这南面的树林里。到处都是胡萝卜！ [ta jiu zai zhe nan mian de shu lin li 。 dao chu dou shi hu luo bo ！]

english: Oh yes, I remember. Thanks.
translation: 哦，是的，我记得。谢谢。 [o ， shi de ， wo ji de 。 xie xie 。]

english: Mate, it took you so long to get me lunch the Easter Bunny showed up, I had some choccy eggs instead.
translation: 伙计，你花了这么长时间才给我准备午餐，复活节兔子出现了，我吃了一些巧克力鸡蛋。 [huo ji ， ni hua le zhe me zhang shi jian cai gei wo zhun bei wu can ， fu huo jie tu zi chu xian le ， wo chi le yi xie qiao ke li ji dan 。]

english: Great. That was all me you know.
translation: 伟大的。这就是你所知道的我的全部。 [wei da de 。 zhe jiu shi ni suo zhi dao de wo de quan bu 。]

english: What are you talking about? It was definitely the Easter Bunny.
translation: 你在说什么？这绝对是复活节兔子。 [ni zai shuo shen me ？ zhe jue dui shi fu huo jie tu zi 。]

english: You know what?
translation: 你知道吗？ [ni zhi dao ma ？]

english: I'm still too busy to talk to you.
translation: 我还是太忙了，没空跟你说话。 [wo hai shi tai mang le ， mei kong gen ni shuo hua 。]

english: Alright, cheerio!
translation: 好吧，加油！ [hao ba ， jia you ！]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Welcome, traveller.
translation: 欢迎，旅行者。 [huan ying ， lv xing zhe 。]

english: Could you tell me about crystal singing?
translation: 你能告诉我关于水晶歌唱的事吗？ [ni neng gao su wo guan yu shui jing ge chang de shi ma ？]

english: Of course! We elves learned the art long ago, allowing us to form crystals in any way we would like, using just our voices.
translation: 当然！我们精灵很久以前就学会了这门艺术，让我们能够以任何我们想要的方式形成晶体，只用我们的声音。 [dang ran ！ wo men jing ling hen jiu yi qian jiu xue hui le zhe men yi shu ， rang wo men neng gou yi ren he wo men xiang yao de fang shi xing cheng jing ti ， zhi yong wo men de sheng yin 。]

english: It's allowed us to make weapons, armour and tools using the finest crystals.
translation: 它使我们能够使用最优质的水晶制造武器、盔甲和工具。 [ta shi wo men neng gou shi yong zui you zhi di shui jing zhi zao wu qi 、 kui jia he gong ju 。]

english: Wow. Is there any way I could do it?
translation: 哇。我有什么办法可以做到吗？ [wa 。 wo you shen me ban fa ke yi zuo dao ma ？]

english: You might be able to with the help of the crystal bowl over there. As long as you've got the right knowledge of what you're trying to craft.
translation: 借助那边的水晶碗也许可以。只要您对自己想要制作的东西有正确的了解。 [jie zhu na bian de shui jing wan ye xu ke yi 。 zhi yao nin dui zi ji xiang yao zhi zuo de dong xi you zheng que de liao jie 。]

english: Could you do it for me?
translation: 你能帮我做一下吗？ [ni neng bang wo zuo yi xia ma ？]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: Could you sing a song for me?
translation: 你能为我唱首歌吗？ [ni neng wei wo chang shou ge ma ？]

english: Of course! Would you like me to craft something for you? For some crystal shards, of course.
translation: 当然！你想让我为你做点东西吗？当然，对于一些水晶碎片。 [dang ran ！ ni xiang rang wo wei ni zuo dian dong xi ma ？ dang ran ， dui yu yi xie shui jing sui pian 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No, thank you. I'd just like to hear you sing.
translation: 不，谢谢。我只是想听你唱歌。 [bu ， xie xie 。 wo zhi shi xiang ting ni chang ge 。]

english: Conwenna sings you a beautiful song of the elves.
translation: 康温娜为您唱一首优美的精灵之歌。 [kang wen na wei nin chang yi shou you mei de jing ling zhi ge 。]

english: Wow! Thank you.
translation: 哇！谢谢。 [wa ！ xie xie 。]

english: You do not have all of the required materials and requirements to make anything.
translation: 您没有制造任何东西所需的所有材料和要求。 [nin mei you zhi zao ren he dong xi suo xu de suo you cai liao he yao qiu 。]

english: Could you tell me about crystal singing?
translation: 你能告诉我关于水晶歌唱的事吗？ [ni neng gao su wo guan yu shui jing ge chang de shi ma ？]

english: Could you do it for me?
translation: 你能帮我做一下吗？ [ni neng bang wo zuo yi xia ma ？]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: Could you sing a song for me?
translation: 你能为我唱首歌吗？ [ni neng wei wo chang shou ge ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No, thank you. I'd just like to hear you sing.
translation: 不，谢谢。我只是想听你唱歌。 [bu ， xie xie 。 wo zhi shi xiang ting ni chang ge 。]

english: What do you want? I'm busy!
translation: 你想要什么？我很忙！ [ni xiang yao shen me ？ wo hen mang ！]

english: Can you sell me any food?
translation: 你能卖给我一些食物吗？ [ni neng mai gei wo yi xie shi wu ma ？]

english: I suppose I could sell you some cabbage, if you're willing to pay for it. Cabbage is good for you.
translation: 我想我可以卖给你一些卷心菜，如果你愿意付钱的话。卷心菜对你有好处。 [wo xiang wo ke yi mai gei ni yi xie juan xin cai ， ru guo ni yuan yi fu qian de hua 。 juan xin cai dui ni you hao chu 。]

english: Oh, I haven't got any money.
translation: 哦，我没钱。 [o ， wo mei qian 。]

english: Why are you asking me to sell you food if you haven't got any money? Go away!
translation: 如果你没有钱，为什么要我卖食物给你？离开！ [ru guo ni mei you qian ， wei shen me yao wo mai shi wu gei ni ？ li kai ！]

english: Oh, I haven't got enough space to carry it.
translation: 哦，我没有足够的空间来携带它。 [o ， wo mei you zu gou de kong jian lai xie dai ta 。]

english: Why are you asking me to sell you food if you can't carry it? Go away!
translation: 如果你带不动食物，为什么要我卖给你？离开！ [ru guo ni dai bu dong shi wu ， wei shen me yao wo mai gei ni ？ li kai ！]

english: Alright, I'll buy a cabbage.
translation: 好吧，我去买个白菜。 [hao ba ， wo qu mai ge bai cai 。]

english: It's a deal. Now, make sure you eat it all up. Cabbage is good for you.
translation: 这是一笔交易。现在，确保你把它全部吃完。卷心菜对你有好处。 [zhe shi yi bi jiao yi 。 xian zai ， que bao ni ba ta quan bu chi wan 。 juan xin cai dui ni you hao chu 。]

english: No thanks, I don't like cabbage.
translation: 不，谢谢，我不喜欢卷心菜。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo bu xi huan juan xin cai 。]

english: Bah! People these days only appreciate junk food.
translation: 呸!现在的人们只欣赏垃圾食品。 [pei ! xian zai de ren men zhi xin shang la ji shi pin 。]

english: Can you give me any free food?
translation: 你能给我一些免费食物吗？ [ni neng gei wo yi xie mian fei shi wu ma ？]

english: Can you give me any free money?
translation: 你能给我一些免费的钱吗？ [ni neng gei wo yi xie mian fei de qian ma ？]

english: Why should I give you free money?
translation: 我为什么要给你免费的钱？ [wo wei shen me yao gei ni mian fei de qian ？]

english: Why should I give you free food?
translation: 我为什么要给你免费食物？ [wo wei shen me yao gei ni mian fei shi wu ？]

english: Oh, forget it.
translation: 哦，算了。 [o ， suan le 。]

english: I don't want anything from this horrible kitchen.
translation: 我不想从这个可怕的厨房里得到任何东西。 [wo bu xiang cong zhe ge ke pa de chu fang li de dao ren he dong xi 。]

english: How dare you? I put a lot of effort into cleaning this kitchen. My daily sweat and elbow-grease keep this kitchen clean!
translation: 你怎么敢？我花了很多精力来打扫这个厨房。我每天的汗水和肘部油脂让这个厨房保持干净！ [ni zen me gan ？ wo hua le hen duo jing li lai da sao zhe ge chu fang 。 wo mei tian de han shui he zhou bu you zhi rang zhe ge chu fang bao chi gan jing ！]

english: Ewww!
Oh, just leave me alone.
translation: 哦，别管我了。 [o ， bie guan wo le 。]

english: Very well done, take this.
translation: 做得很好，收下这个。 [zuo de hen hao ， shou xia zhe ge 。]

english: Can you sell me any food?
translation: 你能卖给我一些食物吗？ [ni neng mai gei wo yi xie shi wu ma ？]

english: Alright, I'll buy a cabbage.
translation: 好吧，我去买个白菜。 [hao ba ， wo qu mai ge bai cai 。]

english: No thanks, I don't like cabbage.
translation: 不，谢谢，我不喜欢卷心菜。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo bu xi huan juan xin cai 。]

english: Can you give me any free food?
translation: 你能给我一些免费食物吗？ [ni neng gei wo yi xie mian fei shi wu ma ？]

english: I don't want anything from this horrible kitchen.
translation: 我不想从这个可怕的厨房里得到任何东西。 [wo bu xiang cong zhe ge ke pa de chu fang li de dao ren he dong xi 。]

english: Hello...
translation: 你好... [ni hao ...]

english: I distinctly remember you saying you were going to stop talking to me. Yet here you are again, yakking on and on in my earhole when I'm trying to cook! What do you want now?
translation: 我清楚地记得你说过要停止和我说话。然而当我做饭的时候你又来了，在我的耳洞里不停地叫！你现在想要什么？ [wo qing chu di ji de ni shuo guo yao ting zhi he wo shuo hua 。 ran er dang wo zuo fan de shi hou ni you lai le ， zai wo de er dong li bu ting di jiao ！ ni xian zai xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Can you cook me something?
translation: 你能给我煮点东西吗？ [ni neng gei wo zhu dian dong xi ma ？]

english: What? No! Go away.
translation: 什么？不！离开。 [shen me ？ bu ！ li kai 。]

english: Well, you're meant to be a cook. Why can't you cook something for me?
translation: 好吧，你注定要成为一名厨师。你为什么不能给我做点东西呢？ [hao ba ， ni zhu ding yao cheng wei yi ming chu shi 。 ni wei shen me bu neng gei wo zuo dian dong xi ne ？]

english: I don't want to, that's why! Now, leave me alone.
translation: 我不想，这就是原因！现在，别管我了。 [wo bu xiang ， zhe jiu shi yuan yin ！ xian zai ， bie guan wo le 。]

english: You're not a very nice man.
translation: 你不是一个很好的人。 [ni bu shi yi ge hen hao de ren 。]

english: Yet you keep talking to me!
translation: 可你却一直跟我说话！ [ke ni que yi zhi gen wo shuo hua ！]

english: Good point. I should stop that.
translation: 好点。我应该阻止那件事。 [hao dian 。 wo ying gai zu zhi na jian shi 。]

english: Yes, do us both a favour.
translation: 是的，帮我们俩一个忙。 [shi de ， bang wo men lia yi ge mang 。]

english: Why do you work here?
translation: 你为什么在这里工作？ [ni wei shen me zai zhe li gong zuo ？]

english: Why do you think I work in a disreputable inn filled with rough scoundrels on the very edge of the Wilderness? I work here because I need the job!
translation: 你认为我为什么会在荒野边缘一家声名狼藉、满是粗暴恶棍的旅馆里工作？我在这里工作是因为我需要这份工作！ [ni ren wei wo wei shen me hui zai huang ye bian yuan yi jia sheng ming lang ji 、 man shi cu bao e gun de lv guan li gong zuo ？ wo zai zhe li gong zuo shi yin wei wo xu yao zhe fen gong zuo ！]

english: Do you like it?
translation: 你喜欢它？ [ni xi huan ta ？]

english: Like it? It's sucked the warmth and humanity out of me, and I've become a hollow shell holding nothing but anger, misery and gourmet recipes.
translation: 喜欢吗？它吸走了我的温暖和人性，我变成了一个空壳，除了愤怒、痛苦和美食之外什么也没有。 [xi huan ma ？ ta xi zou le wo de wen nuan huo ren xing ， wo bian cheng le yi ge kong ke ， chu le fen nu 、 tong ku he mei shi zhi wai shen me ye mei you 。]

english: Oh.
What did you expect to hear? I suppose you expected me to tell you an inspiring story about how working here can teach you to find hope in the darkest places, or how to see the best in everything?
translation: 您希望听到什么？我想你希望我告诉你一个鼓舞人心的故事，讲述在这里工作如何教会你在最黑暗的地方找到希望，或者如何看到一切最好的一面？ [nin xi wang ting dao shen me ？ wo xiang ni xi wang wo gao su ni yi ge gu wu ren xin de gu shi ， jiang shu zai zhe li gong zuo ru he jiao hui ni zai zui hei an de di fang zhao dao xi wang ， huo zhe ru he kan dao yi qie zui hao de yi mian ？]

english: Maybe you should think about moving to a different inn.
translation: 也许你应该考虑搬到另一家旅馆。 [ye xu ni ying gai kao lv ban dao ling yi jia lv guan 。]

english: Bah! I'm not letting it defeat me. Now, let me concentrate on my cooking.
translation: 呸!我不会让它打败我。现在，让我专心做饭吧。 [pei ! wo bu hui rang ta da bai wo 。 xian zai ， rang wo zhuan xin zuo fan ba 。]

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。 [hao de 。]

english: Can you tell me any good jokes?
translation: 你能告诉我一些好听的笑话吗？ [ni neng gao su wo yi xie hao ting de xiao hua ma ？]

english: Ohhh, if you insist...
translation: 呵呵，如果你坚持的话…… [he he ， ru guo ni jian chi de hua ……]

english: What did the half-wit say to the cook?
translation: 这个傻瓜对厨师说了什么？ [zhe ge sha gua dui chu shi shuo le shen me ？]

english: I don't know.
translation: 我不知道。 [wo bu zhi dao 。]

english: [He/She] said 'Can you tell me any good jokes?' Got ya! Hahahaha!
translation: [他/她]说“你能给我讲一些好听的笑话吗？”明白了！哈哈哈哈！ [[ ta / ta ] shuo “ ni neng gei wo jiang yi xie hao ting de xiao hua ma ？” ming bai le ！ ha ha ha ha ！]

english: Whatever.
translation: 任何。 [ren he 。]

english: Can you cook me something?
translation: 你能给我煮点东西吗？ [ni neng gei wo zhu dian dong xi ma ？]

english: Why do you work here?
translation: 你为什么在这里工作？ [ni wei shen me zai zhe li gong zuo ？]

english: Can you tell me any good jokes?
translation: 你能告诉我一些好听的笑话吗？ [ni neng gao su wo yi xie hao ting de xiao hua ma ？]

english: What am I to do?
translation: 我该怎么办？ [wo gai zen me ban ？]

english: What's wrong?
translation: 怎么了？ [zen me le ？]

english: Oh dear, oh dear, oh dear, I'm in a terrible terrible mess! It's the Duke's birthday today, and I should be making him a lovely big birthday cake.
translation: 哦天哪，哦天哪，哦天哪，我陷入了可怕的混乱之中！今天是公爵的生日，我应该为他做一个可爱的大生日蛋糕。 [o tian na ， o tian na ， o tian na ， wo xian ru le ke pa de hun luan zhi zhong ！ jin tian shi gong jue de sheng ri ， wo ying gai wei ta zuo yi ge ke ai de da sheng ri dan gao 。]

english: I've forgotten to buy the ingredients. I'll never get them in time now. He'll sack me! What will I do? I have four children and a goat to look after. Would you help me? Please?
translation: 我忘记买原料了。我现在永远无法及时得到它们了。他会解雇我的！我该怎么办？我有四个孩子和一只山羊要照顾。你愿意帮助我吗？请？ [wo wang ji mai yuan liao le 。 wo xian zai yong yuan wu fa ji shi de dao ta men le 。 ta hui jie gu wo de ！ wo gai zen me ban ？ wo you si ge hai zi he yi zhi shan yang yao zhao gu 。 ni yuan yi bang zhu wo ma ？ qing ？]

english: Yes, I'll help you.
translation: 是的，我会帮助你。 [shi de ， wo hui bang zhu ni 。]

english: Oh thank you, thank you. I need milk, an egg and flour. I'd be very grateful if you can get them for me.
translation: 噢，谢谢，谢谢。我需要牛奶、鸡蛋和面粉。如果你能帮我拿到它们，我将非常感激。 [o ， xie xie ， xie xie 。 wo xu yao niu nai 、 ji dan huo mian fen 。 ru guo ni neng bang wo na dao ta men ， wo jiang fei chang gan ji 。]

english: I have all of those ingredients on me already!
translation: 我已经把所有这些材料都准备好了！ [wo yi jing ba suo you zhe xie cai liao dou zhun bei hao le ！]

english: That's an odd coincidence... Were you planning on making a cake too?
translation: 真是奇怪的巧合……你也打算做蛋糕吗？ [zhen shi qi guai de qiao he …… ni ye da suan zuo dan gao ma ？]

english: Not exactly. I just had an odd feeling you might be needing these ingredients. If I see a cook, I presume there's food of some kind! Lucky guess I suppose.
translation: 不完全是。我只是有一种奇怪的感觉，你可能需要这些成分。如果我看到厨师，我就猜想那里有某种食物！我想幸运的是。 [bu wan quan shi 。 wo zhi shi you yi zhong qi guai de gan jue ， ni ke neng xu yao zhe xie cheng fen 。 ru guo wo kan dao chu shi ， wo jiu cai xiang na li you mou zhong shi wu ！ wo xiang xing yun de shi 。]

english: Well thank you! Hand them over, please.
translation: 嗯，谢谢！请把它们交给我们。 [n ， xie xie ！ qing ba ta men jiao gei wo men 。]

english: You've brought me everything I need! I am saved! Thank you!
translation: 你给我带来了我需要的一切！我得救了！谢谢你！ [ni gei wo dai lai le wo xu yao de yi qie ！ wo de jiu le ！ xie xie ni ！]

english: So do I get to go to the Duke's Party?
translation: 那么我可以参加公爵的聚会吗？ [na me wo ke yi can jia gong jue de ju hui ma ？]

english: I'm afraid not, only the big cheeses get to dine with the Duke.
translation: 恐怕不行，只有大奶酪才能和公爵一起吃饭。 [kong pa bu xing ， zhi you da nai lao cai neng he gong jue yi qi chi fan 。]

english: Well, maybe one day I'll be important enough to sit on the Duke's table.
translation: 好吧，也许有一天我会变得重要到可以坐在公爵的餐桌上。 [hao ba ， ye xu you yi tian wo hui bian de zhong yao dao ke yi zuo zai gong jue de can zhuo shang 。]

english: Maybe, but I won't be holding my breath.
translation: 也许吧，但我不会屏住呼吸。 [ye xu ba ， dan wo bu hui bing zhu hu xi 。]

english: So where do I find these ingredients then?
translation: 那么我在哪里可以找到这些成分呢？ [na me wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao zhe xie cheng fen ne ？]

english: There is a Mill fairly close, go North and then West. Mill Lane Mill is just off the road to Draynor. I usually get my flour from there.
translation: 附近有一个磨坊，向北走，然后向西走。米尔巷 米尔 (Mill Lane) 就位于通往德雷诺 (Draynor) 的道路旁。我通常从那里得到面粉。 [fu jin you yi ge mo fang ， xiang bei zou ， ran hou xiang xi zou 。 mi er xiang   mi er  (Mill Lane)  jiu wei yu tong wang de lei nuo  (Draynor)  de dao lu pang 。 wo tong chang cong na li de dao mian fen 。]

english: Talk to Millie, she'll help, she's a lovely girl and a fine Miller. Make sure you take a pot with you for the flour though, you've got one on you already.
translation: 与米莉交谈，她会提供帮助，她是一个可爱的女孩，也是一个优秀的米勒。不过，一定要带一个盛面粉的罐子，因为你已经有了一个。 [yu mi li jiao tan ， ta hui ti gong bang zhu ， ta shi yi ge ke ai de nv hai ， ye shi yi ge you xiu de mi lei 。 bu guo ， yi ding yao dai yi ge sheng mian fen de guan zi ， yin wei ni yi jing you le yi ge 。]

english: Talk to Millie, she'll help, she's a lovely girl and a fine Miller. Make sure you take a pot with you for the flour though, there should be one on the table in here.
translation: 与米莉交谈，她会提供帮助，她是一个可爱的女孩，也是一个优秀的米勒。不过，请确保随身携带一个盛面粉的锅，这里的桌子上应该有一个。 [yu mi li jiao tan ， ta hui ti gong bang zhu ， ta shi yi ge ke ai de nv hai ， ye shi yi ge you xiu de mi lei 。 bu guo ， qing que bao sui shen xie dai yi ge sheng mian fen de guo ， zhe li de zhuo zi shang ying gai you yi ge 。]

english: There is a cattle field on the other side of the river, just across the road from the Groats' Farm.
translation: 河对岸有一片牛场，就在格罗茨农场的马路对面。 [he dui an you yi pian niu chang ， jiu zai ge luo ci nong chang de ma lu dui mian 。]

english: Talk to Gillie Groats, she looks after the Dairy cows - she'll tell you everything you need to know about milking cows!
translation: 与吉莉·格罗茨 (Gillie Groats) 交谈，她负责照顾奶牛 - 她会告诉您有关挤奶所需的一切！ [yu ji li · ge luo ci  (Gillie Groats)  jiao tan ， ta fu ze zhao gu nai niu  -  ta hui gao su nin you guan ji nai suo xu de yi qie ！]

english: You'll need an empty bucket for the milk itself. I do see you've got a bucket with you already luckily!
translation: 您需要一个空桶来装牛奶。我确实看到你已经有一个水桶了，幸运的是！ [nin xu yao yi ge kong tong lai zhuang niu nai 。 wo que shi kan dao ni yi jing you yi ge shui tong le ， xing yun de shi ！]

english: You'll need an empty bucket for the milk itself. The general store just north of the castle will sell you one for a couple of coins.
translation: 您需要一个空桶来装牛奶。城堡北边的杂货店可以花几枚硬币卖给你一个。 [nin xu yao yi ge kong tong lai zhuang niu nai 。 cheng bao bei bian de za huo dian ke yi hua ji mei ying bi mai gei ni yi ge 。]

english: I normally get my eggs from the Groats' farm, on the other side of the river.
translation: 我通常从河对岸的格罗茨农场获取鸡蛋。 [wo tong chang cong he dui an de ge luo ci nong chang huo qu ji dan 。]

english: But any chicken should lay eggs.
translation: 但任何鸡都应该下蛋。 [dan ren he ji dou ying gai xia dan 。]

english: I've got all the information I need. Thanks.
translation: 我已经得到了我需要的所有信息。谢谢。 [wo yi jing de dao le wo xu yao de suo you xin xi 。 xie xie 。]

english: Actually, I know where to find this stuff.
translation: 事实上，我知道在哪里可以找到这些东西。 [shi shi shang ， wo zhi dao zai na li ke yi zhao dao zhe xie dong xi 。]

english: No, I don't feel like it. Maybe later.
translation: 不，我不喜欢这样。也许以后吧。 [bu ， wo bu xi huan zhe yang 。 ye xu yi hou ba 。]

english: Fine. I always knew you Adventurer types were callous beasts. Go on your merry way!
translation: 美好的。我一直都知道你们这些冒险家都是冷酷无情的野兽。继续你的快乐之路吧！ [mei hao de 。 wo yi zhi dou zhi dao ni men zhe xie mao xian jia dou shi leng ku wu qing de ye shou 。 ji xu ni de kuai le zhi lu ba ！]

english: You're a cook, why don't you bake me a cake?
translation: 你是个厨师，为什么不给我烤个蛋糕呢？ [ni shi ge chu shi ， wei shen me bu gei wo kao ge dan gao ne ？]

english: *sniff* Don't talk to me about cakes...
translation: *闻一闻*别跟我谈论蛋糕...... [* wen yi wen * bie gen wo tan lun dan gao ......]

english: You don't look very happy.
translation: 你看上去不太高兴。 [ni kan shang qu bu tai gao xing 。]

english: No, I'm not. The world is caving in around me - I am overcome by dark feelings of impending doom.
translation: 不，我不是。我周围的世界正在崩溃——我被厄运即将来临的黑暗感觉所征服。 [bu ， wo bu shi 。 wo zhou wei de shi jie zheng zai beng kui —— wo bei e yun ji jiang lai lin de hei an gan jue suo zheng fu 。]

english: I'd take the rest of the day off if I were you.
translation: 如果我是你，我会休息一天剩下的时间。 [ru guo wo shi ni ， wo hui xiu xi yi tian sheng xia de shi jian 。]

english: No, that's the worst thing I could do. I'd get in terrible trouble.
translation: 不，这是我能做的最糟糕的事情。我会遇到可怕的麻烦。 [bu ， zhe shi wo neng zuo de zui zao gao de shi qing 。 wo hui yu dao ke pa de ma fan 。]

english: Well maybe you need to take a holiday...
translation: 好吧，也许你需要休假...... [hao ba ， ye xu ni xu yao xiu jia ......]

english: That would be nice, but the Duke doesn't allow holidays for core staff.
translation: 那就太好了，但公爵不允许核心员工休假。 [na jiu tai hao le ， dan gong jue bu yun xu he xin yuan gong xiu jia 。]

english: Hmm, why not run away to the sea and start a new life as a Pirate?
translation: 嗯，为什么不逃到大海去开始新的海盗生活呢？ [n ， wei shen me bu tao dao da hai qu kai shi xin de hai dao sheng huo ne ？]

english: My wife gets sea sick, and I have an irrational fear of eyepatches. I don't see it working myself.
translation: 我的妻子晕船了，而我对眼罩有一种非理性的恐惧。我自己不认为它有效。 [wo de qi zi yun chuan le ， er wo dui yan zhao you yi zhong fei li xing de kong ju 。 wo zi ji bu ren wei ta you xiao 。]

english: I'm afraid I've run out of ideas.
translation: 恐怕我已经没有主意了。 [kong pa wo yi jing mei you zhu yi le 。]

english: I know I'm doomed.
translation: 我知道我注定要失败。 [wo zhi dao wo zhu ding yao shi bai 。]

english: Nice hat!
translation: 帽子不错！ [mao zi bu cuo ！]

english: Err thank you. It's a pretty ordinary cooks hat really.
translation: 呃谢谢。这确实是一顶很普通的厨师帽。 [e xie xie 。 zhe que shi shi yi ding hen pu tong de chu shi mao 。]

english: Still, suits you. The trousers are pretty special too.
translation: 不过，还是适合你。裤子也很特别。 [bu guo ， hai shi shi he ni 。 ku zi ye hen te bie 。]

english: Its all standard cook's issue uniform...
translation: 都是标准的厨师制服…… [dou shi biao zhun de chu shi zhi fu ……]

english: The whole hat, apron, stripey trousers ensemble - it works. It make you lookslike a real cook.
translation: 帽子、围裙、条纹裤的整体搭配——很有效。它让你看起来像一个真正的厨师。 [mao zi 、 wei qun 、 tiao wen ku de zheng ti da pei —— hen you xiao 。 ta rang ni kan qi lai xiang yi ge zhen zheng de chu shi 。]

english: I am a real cook! I haven't got time to be chatting about Culinary Fashion. I am in desperate need of help!
translation: 我是一个真正的厨师！我没有时间谈论烹饪时尚。我非常需要帮助！ [wo shi yi ge zhen zheng de chu shi ！ wo mei you shi jian tan lun peng ren shi shang 。 wo fei chang xu yao bang zhu ！]

english: How are you getting on with finding the ingredients?
translation: 你寻找原料的进展如何？ [ni xun zhao yuan liao de jin zhan ru he ？]

english: I haven't got any of them yet, I'm still looking.
translation: 我还没有找到任何一个，我还在寻找。 [wo hai mei you zhao dao ren he yi ge ， wo hai zai xun zhao 。]

english: Please get the ingredients quickly. I'm running out of time! The Duke will throw me into the streets!
translation: 请快点去拿原料。我的时间不多了！公爵会把我扔到街上！ [qing kuai dian qu na yuan liao 。 wo de shi jian bu duo le ！ gong jue hui ba wo reng dao jie shang ！]

english: I'll get right on it.
translation: 我会马上处理的。 [wo hui ma shang chu li de 。]

english: Here's a bucket of milk.
translation: 这是一桶牛奶。 [zhe shi yi tong niu nai 。]

english: Here's a pot of flour.
translation: 这是一锅面粉。 [zhe shi yi guo mian fen 。]

english: Here's a fresh egg.
translation: 这是一个新鲜的鸡蛋。 [zhe shi yi ge xin xian de ji dan 。]

english: Thanks for the ingredients you have got so far. Please get the rest quickly - I'm running out of time! The Duke will throw me into the streets!
translation: 感谢您到目前为止所获得的成分。请尽快完成剩下的工作——我的时间不多了！公爵会把我扔到街上！ [gan xie nin dao mu qian wei zhi suo huo de de cheng fen 。 qing jin kuai wan cheng sheng xia de gong zuo —— wo de shi jian bu duo le ！ gong jue hui ba wo reng dao jie shang ！]

english: How is the adventuring going, my friend?
translation: 冒险怎么样了，我的朋友？ [mao xian zen me yang le ， wo de peng you ？]

english: I don't have anything for you to do right now, sorry.
translation: 我现在没什么事可以帮你做，抱歉。 [wo xian zai mei shen me shi ke yi bang ni zuo ， bao qian 。]

english: I am getting strong and mighty. Grrr
translation: 我正在变得坚强和强大。咕噜 [wo zheng zai bian de jian qiang he qiang da 。 gu lu]

english: Glad to hear it.
translation: 很高兴听到这个消息。 [hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi 。]

english: I keep on dying.
translation: 我继续死去。 [wo ji xu si qu 。]

english: Ah well, at least you keep coming back to life!
translation: 啊，好吧，至少你又复活了！ [a ， hao ba ， zhi shao ni you fu huo le ！]

english: Can I use your range?
translation: 我可以使用你的范围吗？ [wo ke yi shi yong ni de fan wei ma ？]

english: Go ahead - it's a very good range. It's easier to use than most other ranges.
translation: 来吧——这是一个非常好的范围。它比大多数其他系列更容易使用。 [lai ba —— zhe shi yi ge fei chang hao de fan wei 。 ta bi da duo shu qi ta xi lie geng rong yi shi yong 。]

english: Its called the Cook-o-matic 100. It uses a combination of state of the art temperature regulation and magic.
translation: 它被称为 Cook-o-matic 100。它结合了最先进的温度调节和魔法。 [ta bei cheng wei  Cook-o-matic 100。 ta jie he le zui xian jin de wen du tiao jie he mo fa 。]

english: Will it mean my food will burn less often?
translation: 这是否意味着我的食物烧焦的次数会减少？ [zhe shi fou yi wei zhe wo de shi wu shao jiao de ci shu hui jian shao ？]

english: Well, that's what the salesman told us anyway...
translation: 好吧，这就是推销员告诉我们的...... [hao ba ， zhe jiu shi tui xiao yuan gao su wo men de ......]

english: Thanks?
translation: 谢谢？ [xie xie ？]

english: Hey, who said you could use that?
translation: 嘿，谁说你可以用它？ [hei ， shui shuo ni ke yi yong ta ？]

english: Hello Cook. The Easter Bunny has run out of fuel for his egg making machine and has sent me to ask you for a favour.
translation: 你好库克。复活节兔子的制蛋机燃料用完了，他派我来请你帮忙。 [ni hao ku ke 。 fu huo jie tu zi de zhi dan ji ran liao yong wan le ， ta pai wo lai qing ni bang mang 。]

english: I am listening.
translation: 我在听。 [wo zai ting 。]

english: Do you by chance have any Hosidius milk? The Easter Bunny needs some to make the fuel.
translation: 你有 Hosidius 牛奶吗？复活节兔子需要一些来制造燃料。 [ni you  Hosidius  niu nai ma ？ fu huo jie tu zi xu yao yi xie lai zhi zao ran liao 。]

english: I may have some lying around the kitchen, I would gladly give you some milk for the Easter Bunny.
translation: 我可能在厨房里放了一些，我很乐意给你一些牛奶给复活节兔子。 [wo ke neng zai chu fang li fang le yi xie ， wo hen le yi gei ni yi xie niu nai gei fu huo jie tu zi 。]

english: But first you must answer a riddle. If you get it right, I will give you some Hosidius milk.
translation: 但首先你必须回答一个谜语。如果你答对了，我会给你一些霍西迪乌斯牛奶。 [dan shou xian ni bi xu hui da yi ge mi yu 。 ru guo ni da dui le ， wo hui gei ni yi xie huo xi di wu si niu nai 。]

english: I would be glad to answer a riddle for you.
translation: 我很乐意为你解答一个谜语。 [wo hen le yi wei ni jie da yi ge mi yu 。]

english: Are you ready to answer my riddle?
translation: 你准备好回答我的谜语了吗？ [ni zhun bei hao hui da wo de mi yu le ma ？]

english: Yes I am ready, crack out your riddle.
translation: 是的，我准备好了，破解你的谜语。 [shi de ， wo zhun bei hao le ， po jie ni de mi yu 。]

english: I leave my home only once a year, but do not give any Christmas cheer. Who am I?
translation: 我每年只离开家一次，但并不给予任何圣诞节的欢乐。我是谁？ [wo mei nian zhi li kai jia yi ci ， dan bing bu ji yu ren he sheng dan jie de huan le 。 wo shi shui ？]

english: I am sorry but that is not quite right.
translation: 很抱歉，但这不太正确。 [hen bao qian ， dan zhe bu tai zheng que 。]

english: Talk to me when you're ready to try again.
translation: 当您准备好再次尝试时，请与我联系。 [dang nin zhun bei hao zai ci chang shi shi ， qing yu wo lian xi 。]

english: Congratulations, that's the right answer.
translation: 恭喜，这是正确答案。 [gong xi ， zhe shi zheng que da an 。]

english: Here is the Hosidius milk I promised.
translation: 这是我答应过的霍西迪乌斯牛奶。 [zhe shi wo da ying guo de huo xi di wu si niu nai 。]

english: You receive a bottle of Hosidius milk
translation: 您将收到一瓶 Hosidius 牛奶 [nin jiang shou dao yi ping  Hosidius  niu nai]

english: Filling me with eggs is bad... but I'll make a case for it.
translation: 让我吃鸡蛋是不好的……但我会证明这一点。 [rang wo chi ji dan shi bu hao de …… dan wo hui zheng ming zhe yi dian 。]

english: When dark and bitter, drink me warm in the winter.
translation: 当黑暗和苦涩的时候，在冬天喝我温暖。 [dang hei an he ku se de shi hou ， zai dong tian he wo wen nuan 。]

english: I am round, yet not a perfect sphere. I can be cracked and not have anything inside. What am I?
translation: 我是圆的，但不是一个完美的球体。我可能会裂开，里面什么也没有。我是什么？ [wo shi yuan de ， dan bu shi yi ge wan mei de qiu ti 。 wo ke neng hui lie kai ， li mian shen me ye mei you 。 wo shi shen me ？]

english: Not just yet, maybe later.
translation: 还不是现在，也许以后。 [hai bu shi xian zai ， ye xu yi hou 。]

english: You should probably go and give the milk to the Easter Bunny, hop to it. Don't want to keep the Easter Bunny waiting.
translation: 你也许应该去把牛奶给复活节兔子，然后跳过去。不想让复活节兔子久等。 [ni ye xu ying gai qu ba niu nai gei fu huo jie tu zi ， ran hou tiao guo qu 。 bu xiang rang fu huo jie tu zi jiu deng 。]

english: I seem to have lost the milk, do you by any chance have any more?
translation: 我好像没奶了，你还有吗？ [wo hao xiang mei nai le ， ni hai you ma ？]

english: Of course I do, try not to spill it this time.
translation: 当然有，这次尽量别洒了。 [dang ran you ， zhe ci jin liang bie sa le 。]

english: Well done.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: You've [found a new clue scroll/obtained a casket]!
translation: 你已经[发现了一个新的线索卷轴/获得了一个棺材]！ [ni yi jing [ fa xian le yi ge xin de xian suo juan zhou / huo de le yi ge guan cai ]！]

english: I've always wondered how many cannons the castle has. Could you find out for me?
translation: 我一直想知道这座城堡有多少门大炮。你能帮我查一下吗？ [wo yi zhi xiang zhi dao zhe zuo cheng bao you duo shao men da pao 。 ni neng bang wo cha yi xia ma ？]

english: The cook has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 厨师给了你一张挑战卷轴！ [chu shi gei le ni yi zhang tiao zhan juan zhou ！]

english: Please tell me how many cannons there are.
translation: 请告诉我有多少门大炮。 [qing gao su wo you duo shao men da pao 。]

english: Hmm, I don't think that's right.
translation: 嗯，我认为这是不对的。 [n ， wo ren wei zhe shi bu dui de 。]

english: Cheers!
translation: 干杯! [gan bei !]

english: The cook has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
translation: 厨师给了你[另一张线索卷轴/一个棺材]！ [chu shi gei le ni [ ling yi zhang xian suo juan zhou / yi ge guan cai ]！]

english: Oh, what a cute bunny! I didn't realize it was Easter already!
translation: 噢，多么可爱的小兔子啊！没想到已经是复活节了！ [o ， duo me ke ai de xiao tu zi a ！ mei xiang dao yi jing shi fu huo jie le ！]

english: Cute?! I'll give you cute! I'll...
translation: 可爱的？！我给你可爱！患病的... [ke ai de ？！ wo gei ni ke ai ！ huan bing de ...]

english: *AHEM*
translation: *咳咳* [* hai hai *]

english: Sorry.
translation: 对不起。 [dui bu qi 。]

english: Cook, we're looking for some fancy eggs that we can use as decorations. You wouldn't happen to have anything, would you?
translation: 库克，我们正在寻找一些精美的鸡蛋，可以用作装饰。你不会碰巧什么都没有吧？ [ku ke ， wo men zheng zai xun zhao yi xie jing mei de ji dan ， ke yi yong zuo zhuang shi 。 ni bu hui peng qiao shen me dou mei you ba ？]

english: Hmm... Well, I do have a large collection of eggs, but most of them are regular old chicken eggs for making cakes.
translation: 嗯……嗯，我确实收集了大量的鸡蛋，但其中大部分都是用来做蛋糕的普通老鸡蛋。 [n …… n ， wo que shi shou ji le da liang de ji dan ， dan qi zhong da bu fen dou shi yong lai zuo dan gao de pu tong lao ji dan 。]

english: Though come to think of it, I might have something...
translation: 不过仔细想想，我可能有一些东西...... [bu guo zi xi xiang xiang ， wo ke neng you yi xie dong xi ......]

english: Go on...
translation: 继续... [ji xu ...]

english: I have a... 'special' collection of eggs that I keep in the... well... back of my cupboards for very... 'special' occasions.
translation: 我有一个……“特殊”的鸡蛋收藏，我把它们放在……呃……我的橱柜后面，以备非常……“特殊”的场合使用。 [wo you yi ge ……“ te shu ” de ji dan shou cang ， wo ba ta men fang zai …… e …… wo de chu gui hou mian ， yi bei fei chang ……“ te shu ” de chang he shi yong 。]

english: I don't know if this occasion is special enough, though.
translation: 但我不知道这个场合是否足够特别。 [dan wo bu zhi dao zhe ge chang he shi fou zu gou te bie 。]

english: Hey! I'll have you know Easter is a very special occasion!
translation: 嘿！我会让你知道复活节是一个非常特别的时刻！ [hei ！ wo hui rang ni zhi dao fu huo jie shi yi ge fei chang te bie de shi ke ！]

english: Well, that's me convinced! Let me dig them out for you!
translation: 嗯，这就是我所确信的！让我给你挖出来吧！ [n ， zhe jiu shi wo suo que xin de ！ rang wo gei ni wa chu lai ba ！]

english: The Cook digs around the back of his cupboards and produces several colourful eggs, giving them to Gregg.
translation: 厨师在他的橱柜后面挖了挖，挖出了几个彩色的鸡蛋，把它们交给了格雷格。 [chu shi zai ta de chu gui hou mian wa le wa ， wa chu le ji ge cai se de ji dan ， ba ta men jiao gei le ge lei ge 。]

english: Ooh! These are perfect! Thanks a lot!
translation: 哦！这些太完美了！多谢！ [o ！ zhe xie tai wan mei le ！ duo xie ！]

english: Don't mention it!
translation: 别提了！ [bie ti le ！]

english: Seriously, don't mention it.
translation: 说真的，别提了。 [shuo zhen de ， bie ti le 。]

english: Well, we have some eggs now. What's next?
translation: 好吧，我们现在有一些鸡蛋了。接下来怎么办？ [hao ba ， wo men xian zai you yi xie ji dan le 。 jie xia lai zen me ban ？]

english: Hmm... I think some nice fluffy wool could look quite nice...
translation: 嗯...我觉得一些漂亮的蓬松羊毛看起来会很漂亮... [n ... wo jue de yi xie piao liang de peng song yang mao kan qi lai hui hen piao liang ...]

english: There's a sheep pen not too far north of here. You could get some fresh wool if you wanted.
translation: 离这里北面不远有一个羊圈。如果你愿意的话，你可以买一些新鲜的羊毛。 [li zhe li bei mian bu yuan you yi ge yang juan 。 ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， ni ke yi mai yi xie xin xian de yang mao 。]

english: That sounds perfect! I'll meet you there, human!
translation: 听起来很完美！我会在那里见到你，人类！ [ting qi lai hen wan mei ！ wo hui zai na li jian dao ni ， ren lei ！]

english: Yes, go to the sheep pen and out of my kitchen...
translation: 是的，去羊圈，然后离开我的厨房…… [shi de ， qu yang juan ， ran hou li kai wo de chu fang ……]

english: Oh, you're still here.
translation: 哦，你还在这里。 [o ， ni hai zai zhe li 。]

english: Yep! Just passing the time, you know!
translation: 是的！只是打发时间而已，你懂的！ [shi de ！ zhi shi da fa shi jian er yi ， ni dong de ！]

english: Didn't you say you were off to the sheep pen north of here?
translation: 你不是说要去北面的羊圈吗？ [ni bu shi shuo yao qu bei mian de yang juan ma ？]

english: We're not in a hurry. The sheep are in a pen, so it's not like they can go anywhere.
translation: 我们不着急。羊被关在围栏里，所以它们哪儿也去不了。 [wo men bu zhao ji 。 yang bei guan zai wei lan li ， suo yi ta men na er ye qu bu liao 。]

english: Actually, while you're still here, there's something else you can do.
translation: 事实上，当你还在这里的时候，你还可以做点别的事情。 [shi shi shang ， dang ni hai zai zhe li de shi hou ， ni hai ke yi zuo dian bie de shi qing 。]

english: It's the Duke's birthday soon, and I'm running low on ingredients.
translation: 马上就要到公爵的生日了，我的食材快用完了。 [ma shang jiu yao dao gong jue de sheng ri le ， wo de shi cai kuai yong wan le 。]

english: As important as the Duke of Lumbridge is, I'm sure he won't mind waiting a little longer for the sake of Easter.
translation: 尽管朗布里奇公爵很重要，但我相信他不会介意为了复活节而多等一会儿。 [jin guan lang bu li qi gong jue hen zhong yao ， dan wo xiang xin ta bu hui jie yi wei le fu huo jie er duo deng yi hui er 。]

english: Wait... didn't the Duke just have his birthday?
translation: 等等……公爵不是刚刚过生日吗？ [deng deng …… gong jue bu shi gang gang guo sheng ri ma ？]

english: Ahem... forget I said anything.
translation: 咳咳……忘记我说过什么了。 [hai hai …… wang ji wo shuo guo shen me le 。]

english: Cook, as fun as it is bringing you ingredients, don't you just burn all your cakes anyway?
translation: 做饭，虽然给你带来食材很有趣，但你不是把所有的蛋糕都烧掉了吗？ [zuo fan ， sui ran gei ni dai lai shi cai hen you qu ， dan ni bu shi ba suo you de dan gao dou shao diao le ma ？]

english: I... well yes, but how else am I supposed to train cooking?
translation: 我……嗯，是的，但是我还能怎么训练烹饪呢？ [wo …… n ， shi de ， dan shi wo hai neng zen me xun lian peng ren ne ？]

english: You could try something simple like fish, perhaps?
translation: 也许你可以尝试一些简单的东西，比如鱼？ [ye xu ni ke yi chang shi yi xie jian dan de dong xi ， bi ru yu ？]

english: And have the entire castle smelling like Port Sarim? No thank you!
translation: 整个城堡闻起来像萨里姆港吗？不，谢谢！ [zheng ge cheng bao wen qi lai xiang sa li mu gang ma ？ bu ， xie xie ！]

english: The eggs you gave Gregg were just rotten ones, weren't they.
translation: 你给格雷格的鸡蛋只是腐烂的鸡蛋，不是吗？ [ni gei ge lei ge de ji dan zhi shi fu lan de ji dan ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Well, he wanted some funny looking eggs, and they were the funniest I had.
translation: 嗯，他想要一些看起来很有趣的鸡蛋，而它们是我拥有的最有趣的。 [n ， ta xiang yao yi xie kan qi lai hen you qu de ji dan ， er ta men shi wo yong you de zui you qu de 。]

english: Just be thankful he didn't ask for some fancy milk instead!
translation: 庆幸的是他没有要一些高档牛奶！ [qing xing de shi ta mei you yao yi xie gao dang niu nai ！]

english: *sigh* Do you know where he went at least?
translation: *叹气*你至少知道他去了哪里吗？ [* tan qi * ni zhi shao zhi dao ta qu le na li ma ？]

english: I think he said he was going to the sheep pen north of here.
translation: 我想他说他要去北面的羊圈。 [wo xiang ta shuo ta yao qu bei mian de yang juan 。]

english: How should I know? You should check in Draynor, maybe you'll find him there.
translation: 我怎么知道？你应该去德拉诺看看，也许你会在那里找到他。 [wo zen me zhi dao ？ ni ying gai qu de la nuo kan kan ， ye xu ni hui zai na li zhao dao ta 。]

english: What's wrong?
translation: 怎么了？ [zen me le ？]

english: I'm always happy to help a cook in distress.
translation: 我总是很乐意帮助有困难的厨师。 [wo zong shi hen le yi bang zhu you kun nan de chu shi 。]

english: Where do I find some flour?
translation: 哪里可以找到面粉？ [na li ke yi zhao dao mian fen ？]

english: How about milk?
translation: 牛奶怎么样？ [niu nai zen me yang ？]

english: And eggs? Where are they found?
translation: 还有鸡蛋？他们在哪里找到的？ [hai you ji dan ？ ta men zai na li zhao dao de ？]

english: I've got all the information I need. Thanks.
translation: 我已经得到了我需要的所有信息。谢谢。 [wo yi jing de dao le wo xu yao de suo you xin xi 。 xie xie 。]

english: Actually, I know where to find this stuff.
translation: 事实上，我知道在哪里可以找到这些东西。 [shi shi shang ， wo zhi dao zai na li ke yi zhao dao zhe xie dong xi 。]

english: I can't right now, Maybe later.
translation: 我现在不能，也许以后吧。 [wo xian zai bu neng ， ye xu yi hou ba 。]

english: Can you make me a cake?
translation: 你能给我做一个蛋糕吗？ [ni neng gei wo zuo yi ge dan gao ma ？]

english: You don't look very happy.
translation: 你看上去不太高兴。 [ni kan shang qu bu tai gao xing 。]

english: I'd take the rest of the day off if I were you.
translation: 如果我是你，我会休息一天剩下的时间。 [ru guo wo shi ni ， wo hui xiu xi yi tian sheng xia de shi jian 。]

english: Nice hat!
translation: 帽子不错！ [mao zi bu cuo ！]

english: I'll get right on it.
translation: 我会马上处理的。 [wo hui ma shang chu li de 。]

english: Can you remind me how to find these things again?
translation: 你能提醒我如何再次找到这些东西吗？ [ni neng ti xing wo ru he zai ci zhao dao zhe xie dong xi ma ？]

english: Do you have any other quests for me?
translation: 你还有什么任务要找我吗？ [ni hai you shen me ren wu yao zhao wo ma ？]

english: I am getting strong and mighty.
translation: 我正在变得坚强和强大。 [wo zheng zai bian de jian qiang he qiang da 。]

english: I keep on dying.
translation: 我继续死去。 [wo ji xu si qu 。]

english: Can I use your range?
translation: 我可以使用你的范围吗？ [wo ke yi shi yong ni de fan wei ma ？]

english: Talk about Easter.
translation: 谈论复活节。 [tan lun fu huo jie 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: Count Check.
translation: 计数检查。 [ji shu jian cha 。]

english: Easter Bunny.
translation: 复活节兔子。 [fu huo jie tu zi 。]

english: Father Aereck.
translation: 艾瑞克神父。 [ai rui ke shen fu 。]

english: Bob.
translation: 鲍勃. [bao bo .]

english: Santa.
translation: 圣诞老人。 [sheng dan lao ren 。]

english: River Lum.
translation: 卢姆河。 [lu mu he 。]

english: Sack.
translation: 解雇。 [jie gu 。]

english: Spider web.
translation: 蜘蛛网。 [zhi zhu wang 。]

english: Basket.
translation: 篮子。 [lan zi 。]

english: Bucket.
translation: 桶。 [tong 。]

english: Lemon juice.
translation: 柠檬汁。 [ning meng zhi 。]

english: Beer.
translation: 啤酒。 [pi jiu 。]

english: Sewer water.
translation: 下水道水。 [xia shui dao shui 。]

english: Butter.
translation: 黄油。 [huang you 。]

english: Chocolate.
translation: 巧克力。 [qiao ke li 。]

english: Easter Egg.
translation: 复活节彩蛋。 [fu huo jie cai dan 。]

english: The Grand Exchange.
translation: 大交换。 [da jiao huan 。]

english: Cake.
translation: 蛋糕。 [dan gao 。]

english: Potato.
translation: 土豆。 [tu dou 。]

english: Choc-ice.
translation: 巧克力冰。 [qiao ke li bing 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Something else.
translation: 还有别的事。 [hai you bie de shi 。]

english: Ask about the Easter event.
translation: 询问复活节活动。 [xun wen fu huo jie huo dong 。]

english: Ask about something else.
translation: 询问其他事情。 [xun wen qi ta shi qing 。]

english: You're not aristocracy but I suppose you'd do. Do you want a good cook for 3000 coins?
translation: 你不是贵族，但我想你会的。 3000金币你想请个好厨师吗？ [ni bu shi gui zu ， dan wo xiang ni hui de 。 3000 jin bi ni xiang qing ge hao chu shi ma ？]

english: What can you do?
translation: 你能做什么？ [ni neng zuo shen me ？]

english: I am the finest cook in all Gielinor! I can also make good time going to the bank or the sawmill.
translation: 我是吉林最好的厨师！我还可以抽出时间去银行或锯木厂。 [wo shi ji lin zui hao de chu shi ！ wo hai ke yi chou chu shi jian qu yin hang huo ju mu chang 。]

english: Tell me about your previous jobs.
translation: 告诉我你以前的工作。 [gao su wo ni yi qian de gong zuo 。]

english: I used to be the cook for the old Duke of Lumbridge. Visiting dignitaries praised me for my fine banquets!
translation: 我曾经是老朗布里奇公爵的厨师。来访的贵宾都称赞我的宴会办得很好！ [wo ceng jing shi lao lang bu li qi gong jue de chu shi 。 lai fang de gui bin dou cheng zan wo de yan hui ban de hen hao ！]

english: But then someone found a rule that said that only one family could hold that post.
translation: 但后来有人发现了一条规定，只有一个家族才能担任这一职位。 [dan hou lai you ren fa xian le yi tiao gui ding ， zhi you yi ge jia zu cai neng dan ren zhe yi zhi wei 。]

english: Overnight I was fired and replaced by some fool who can't even bake a cake without help!
translation: 一夜之间，我被解雇了，取而代之的是一个傻瓜，他在没有帮助的情况下甚至无法烤蛋糕！ [yi ye zhi jian ， wo bei jie gu le ， qu er dai zhi de shi yi ge sha gua ， ta zai mei you bang zhu de qing kuang xia shen zhi wu fa kao dan gao ！]

english: Hmph! I don't work for just anyone, you know! I refuse to work for someone who's below level 30 Construction!
translation: 哼！我不为任何人工作，你知道！我拒绝为建筑30级以下的人工作！ [heng ！ wo bu wei ren he ren gong zuo ， ni zhi dao ！ wo ju jue wei jian zhu 30 ji yi xia de ren gong zuo ！]

english: You already have a servant.
translation: 你已经有一个仆人了。 [ni yi jing you yi ge pu ren le 。]

english: You need a second bedroom with a bed for your servant to sleep in.
translation: 你需要第二间卧室，里面有一张床，供你的仆人睡觉。 [ni xu yao di er jian wo shi ， li mian you yi zhang chuang ， gong ni de pu ren shui jiao 。]

english: You're hired... well, I don't have the money on me, but can I owe you? I'm good for it, honest.
translation: 你被录用了……好吧，我身上没带钱，但我可以欠你吗？我很擅长，老实说。 [ni bei lu yong le …… hao ba ， wo shen shang mei dai qian ， dan wo ke yi qian ni ma ？ wo hen shan chang ， lao shi shuo 。]

english: Are you having a laugh? No cash up front, no cook.
translation: 你笑了吗？没有现金，没有厨师。 [ni xiao le ma ？ mei you xian jin ， mei you chu shi 。]

english: You're hired!
translation: 你被录用了！ [ni bei lu yong le ！]

english: [Alright, sir./Alright, madam./Alright.] I can start work immediately.
translation: [好吧，先生。/好吧，女士。/好吧。] 我可以立即开始工作。 [[ hao ba ， xian sheng 。/ hao ba ， nv shi 。/ hao ba 。]  wo ke yi li ji kai shi gong zuo 。]

english: What can you do?
translation: 你能做什么？ [ni neng zuo shen me ？]

english: Tell me about your previous jobs
translation: 告诉我你以前的工作 [gao su wo ni yi qian de gong zuo]

english: You're hired!
translation: 你被录用了！ [ni bei lu yong le ！]

english: Can you teach me the basics of cooking please?
translation: 你能教我烹饪的基本知识吗？ [ni neng jiao wo peng ren de ji ben zhi shi ma ？]

english: The simplest thing to cook is raw meat or fish.
translation: 最简单的烹饪方法是生肉或生鱼。 [zui jian dan de peng ren fang fa shi sheng rou huo sheng yu 。]

english: Fish can be caught, speak to the fishing tutor south of here in the swamp. Killing cows or chickens will yield raw meat to cook too.
translation: 可以钓到鱼，与沼泽以南的钓鱼导师交谈。杀死牛或鸡也会产生生肉来烹饪。 [ke yi diao dao yu ， yu zhao ze yi nan de diao yu dao shi jiao tan 。 sha si niu huo ji ye hui chan sheng sheng rou lai peng ren 。]

english: You can use your own fire... but it's not as effective and you'll burn more. To build a fire use a tinderbox on logs.
translation: 你可以用自己的火……但效果不太好，而且会烧伤更多。要生火，请在原木上使用易燃物盒。 [ni ke yi yong zi ji de huo …… dan xiao guo bu tai hao ， er qie hui shao shang geng duo 。 yao sheng huo ， qing zai yuan mu shang shi yong yi ran wu he 。]

english: Once you've found your range, click on it. This will bring up a menu of the food you can cook.
translation: 找到范围后，单击它。这将显示您可以烹饪的食物的菜单。 [zhao dao fan wei hou ， dan ji ta 。 zhe jiang xian shi nin ke yi peng ren de shi wu de cai dan 。]

english: If you're interested in quests, I heard my friend the cook in Lumbridge Castle is in need of a hand. Just talk to him and he'll set you off.
translation: 如果你对任务感兴趣，我听说我的朋友朗布里奇城堡的厨师需要帮助。只要和他说话，他就会让你失望。 [ru guo ni dui ren wu gan xing qu ， wo ting shuo wo de peng you lang bu li qi cheng bao de chu shi xu yao bang zhu 。 zhi yao he ta shuo hua ， ta jiu hui rang ni shi wang 。]

english: I already know the basics of cooking. Got any tips?
translation: 我已经知道烹饪的基础知识了。有什么建议吗？ [wo yi jing zhi dao peng ren de ji chu zhi shi le 。 you shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: Using a range cuts down the possibility of burning the food. In fact, the range in the Lumbridge Castle is particularly good for some foods, I hear.
translation: 使用炉灶可以减少食物烧焦的可能性。事实上，据我所知，朗布里奇城堡的牧场特别适合某些食物。 [shi yong lu zao ke yi jian shao shi wu shao jiao de ke neng xing 。 shi shi shang ， ju wo suo zhi ， lang bu li qi cheng bao de mu chang te bie shi he mou xie shi wu 。]

english: Compare the skills you learn to the effort put into making the food and the health that it heals, find a good combination for you.
translation: 将您学到的技能与制作食物所付出的努力及其所治愈的健康进行比较，找到适合您的良好组合。 [jiang nin xue dao de ji neng yu zhi zuo shi wu suo fu chu de nu li ji qi suo zhi yu de jian kang jin xing bi jiao ， zhao dao shi he nin de liang hao zu he 。]

english: Any advice for an advanced chef?
translation: 对高级厨师有什么建议吗？ [dui gao ji chu shi you shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: As you get better and better you'll find that you can cook better food such as pizza! These are very good for healing you when fighting the big monsters.
translation: 随着您变得越来越好，您会发现您可以烹饪更好的食物，例如披萨！当你与大怪物战斗时，这些对于治疗你非常有帮助。 [sui zhe nin bian de yue lai yue hao ， nin hui fa xian nin ke yi peng ren geng hao de shi wu ， li ru pi sa ！ dang ni yu da guai wu zhan dou shi ， zhe xie dui yu zhi liao ni fei chang you bang zhu 。]

english: How can I train my cooking?
translation: 我该如何训练我的厨艺？ [wo gai ru he xun lian wo de chu yi ？]

english: It seems we have a real master chef in our mists. Maybe you should be the one giving me cooking advice.
translation: 看来我们的迷雾中有一位真正的大厨。也许你应该是给我烹饪建议的人。 [kan lai wo men de mi wu zhong you yi wei zhen zheng de da chu 。 ye xu ni ying gai shi gei wo peng ren jian yi de ren 。]

english: If you feel up to the task, you could try your hand at making pizza. A pizza is comprised of flour with water/ Put some tomato on there, sprinkle on some cheese then cook it. You might consider adding a topping too.
translation: 如果您觉得自己能胜任这项任务，您可以尝试亲手制作披萨。披萨是由面粉和水组成的/上面放一些番茄，撒上一些奶酪然后煮。您也可以考虑添加配料。 [ru guo nin jue de zi ji neng sheng ren zhe xiang ren wu ， nin ke yi chang shi qin shou zhi zuo pi sa 。 pi sa shi you mian fen he shui zu cheng de / shang mian fang yi xie fan qie ， sa shang yi xie nai lao ran hou zhu 。 nin ye ke yi kao lv tian jia pei liao 。]

english: Potatoes are another great food, but I won't go into much detail about those I'm afraid.
translation: 土豆是另一种很棒的食物，但我不会详细介绍那些我担心的食物。 [tu dou shi ling yi zhong hen bang de shi wu ， dan wo bu hui xiang xi jie shao na xie wo dan xin de shi wu 。]

english: Of course, you can try making a curry or baked potato if you feel up to it.
translation: 当然，如果你愿意的话，你可以尝试做咖喱或烤土豆。 [dang ran ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， ni ke yi chang shi zuo ga li huo kao tu dou 。]

english: Tell me about different foods.
translation: 告诉我不同​​的食物。 [gao su wo bu tong ​​ de shi wu 。]

english: Fish and meat of most varieties can be cooked very simply on either a fire or range, expirement which one works for you.
translation: 大多数品种的鱼和肉都可以在火上或炉灶上非常简单地烹饪，哪一种适合您。 [da duo shu pin zhong de yu he rou dou ke yi zai huo shang huo lu zao shang fei chang jian dan di peng ren ， na yi zhong shi he nin 。]

english: You can brew your own beers using the fermenting vats in either Keldagrim or Port Phasmatys. Use two buckets of water, two handfuls of barley malt, 4 hops of your choice and a pot of ale yeast, then leave to
translation: 您可以使用凯尔达格林或法斯马蒂斯港的发酵桶自己酿造啤酒。使用两桶水、两把大麦麦芽、4 种您选择的啤酒花和一罐艾尔酵母，然后静置 [nin ke yi shi yong kai er da ge lin huo fa si ma di si gang de fa jiao tong zi ji niang zao pi jiu 。 shi yong liang tong shui 、 liang ba da mai mai ya 、4  zhong nin xuan ze de pi jiu hua he yi guan ai er jiao mu ， ran hou jing zhi]

english: ferment for a few days!
translation: 发酵几天！ [fa jiao ji tian ！]

english: Simply turn the tap and let the ale flow into the barrel next to the vat, then use empty beer glasses on the barrel.
translation: 只需转动水龙头，让麦芽酒流入大桶旁边的桶中，然后在桶上使用空啤酒杯即可。 [zhi xu zhuan dong shui long tou ， rang mai ya jiu liu ru da tong pang bian de tong zhong ， ran hou zai tong shang shi yong kong pi jiu bei ji ke 。]

english: Baked potatoes are excellent foods and they are healthy too! You'll need to churn some butter and cheese. Look for the churn icon on the minimap. There is a churn in the farm building northwest of Lumbridge.
translation: 烤土豆是很棒的食物，而且也很健康！你需要搅拌一些黄油和奶酪。在小地图上寻找流失图标。朗布里奇西北部的农场建筑里有一台搅拌机。 [kao tu dou shi hen bang de shi wu ， er qie ye hen jian kang ！ ni xu yao jiao ban yi xie huang you he nai lao 。 zai xiao di tu shang xun zhao liu shi tu biao 。 lang bu li qi xi bei bu de nong chang jian zhu li you yi tai jiao ban ji 。]

english: The nearest dairy cow is north of the nearby water mill. Take buckets of milk with you to the churn and use the milk on the churn to make butter or cheese.
translation: 最近的奶牛位于附近水磨坊的北面。将一桶牛奶带到搅拌机处，然后用搅拌机上的牛奶制作黄油或奶酪。 [zui jin de nai niu wei yu fu jin shui mo fang de bei mian 。 jiang yi tong niu nai dai dao jiao ban ji chu ， ran hou yong jiao ban ji shang de niu nai zhi zuo huang you huo nai lao 。]

english: Use a pot of flour with a bucket of awter. You will then get an option to make bread dough, pitta bread dough, pastry dough, or pizza dough. Select pizza or pastry dough.
translation: 使用一锅面粉和一桶水。然后，您可以选择制作面包面团、皮塔面包面团、糕点面团或披萨面团。选择披萨或糕点面团。 [shi yong yi guo mian fen he yi tong shui 。 ran hou ， nin ke yi xuan ze zhi zuo mian bao mian tuan 、 pi ta mian bao mian tuan 、 gao dian mian tuan huo pi sa mian tuan 。 xuan ze pi sa huo gao dian mian tuan 。]

english: Use the pastry dough with a pie dish then add your filling such as apple or red berries.
translation: 将糕点面团与馅饼盘一起使用，然后添加苹果或红浆果等馅料。 [jiang gao dian mian tuan yu xian bing pan yi qi shi yong ， ran hou tian jia ping guo huo hong jiang guo deng xian liao 。]
