english: Finally cook your pie by using the unbaked pie on a cooking range. Mmmm...pie.
translation: 最后在炉灶上使用未烘烤的馅饼来烹饪馅饼。嗯……馅饼。 [zui hou zai lu zao shang shi yong wei hong kao de xian bing lai peng ren xian bing 。 n …… xian bing 。]

english: There's pizza too! Find yourself some tomato and cheese, use on the Pizza dough. Cook the pizza on a range then add any other toppings you want, such as anchovies.
translation: 还有披萨！给自己找一些番茄和奶酪，用在披萨面团上。在炉灶上烹制披萨，然后添加您想要的任何其他配料，例如凤尾鱼。 [hai you pi sa ！ gei zi ji zhao yi xie fan qie he nai lao ， yong zai pi sa mian tuan shang 。 zai lu zao shang peng zhi pi sa ， ran hou tian jia nin xiang yao de ren he qi ta pei liao ， li ru feng wei yu 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello there! Are you interested in hearing all about cooking?
translation: 你好呀！您有兴趣了解有关烹饪的所有知识吗？ [ni hao ya ！ nin you xing qu liao jie you guan peng ren de suo you zhi shi ma ？]

english: The simplest thing to cook is raw meat or fish. Shrimp can be caught south of here, to the east of Lumbridge Swamp. You could ask the fishing tutor for a net if you have not got one.
translation: 最简单的烹饪方法是生肉或生鱼。可以在此处以南、朗布里奇沼泽以东捕获虾。如果你没有网，你可以向钓鱼导师要一张网。 [zui jian dan de peng ren fang fa shi sheng rou huo sheng yu 。 ke yi zai ci chu yi nan 、 lang bu li qi zhao ze yi dong bu huo xia 。 ru guo ni mei you wang ， ni ke yi xiang diao yu dao shi yao yi zhang wang 。]

english: Alternatively, you could acquire some raw beef or chicken. You can find cows and chickens north of here. Go over the bridge then follow the path north, you can't miss them!
translation: 或者，您可以购买一些生牛肉或鸡肉。您可以在这里北部找到牛和鸡。过了桥，然后沿着小路向北走，你不会错过他们的！ [huo zhe ， nin ke yi gou mai yi xie sheng niu rou huo ji rou 。 nin ke yi zai zhe li bei bu zhao dao niu he ji 。 guo le qiao ， ran hou yan zhe xiao lu xiang bei zou ， ni bu hui cuo guo ta men de ！]

english: You could use my range here if you like.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，你可以在这里使用我的范围。 [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， ni ke yi zai zhe li shi yong wo de fan wei 。]

english: If you wanted to, my friend the cook in Lumbridge Castle has a range you could use. You might find you burn even less on that range as its top notch.
translation: 如果您愿意，我的伦布里奇城堡厨师朋友有一个炉灶可供您使用。您可能会发现在该范围内您的燃烧量甚至更少，因为它是一流的。 [ru guo nin yuan yi ， wo de lun bu li qi cheng bao chu shi peng you you yi ge lu zao ke gong nin shi yong 。 nin ke neng hui fa xian zai gai fan wei nei nin de ran shao liang shen zhi geng shao ， yin wei ta shi yi liu de 。]

english: Alternatively, you can use your own fire, but it's not as effective and the food will burn more frequently. To make a fire, use a tinderbox on some logs.
translation: 或者，您也可以使用自己的火，但效果不太好，而且食物会更容易烧焦。要生火，请在一些原木上使用易燃物。 [huo zhe ， nin ye ke yi shi yong zi ji de huo ， dan xiao guo bu tai hao ， er qie shi wu hui geng rong yi shao jiao 。 yao sheng huo ， qing zai yi xie yuan mu shang shi yong yi ran wu 。]

english: Once you've found your range or fire, use your raw food on it. This will bring up a menu of the food you can cook. Then select the food you want.
translation: 一旦你找到了你的射程或火源，就用你的生食来对付它。这将显示您可以烹饪的食物的菜单。然后选择你想要的食物。 [yi dan ni zhao dao le ni de she cheng huo huo yuan ， jiu yong ni de sheng shi lai dui fu ta 。 zhe jiang xian shi nin ke yi peng ren de shi wu de cai dan 。 ran hou xuan ze ni xiang yao de shi wu 。]

english: When you have a full inventory of cooked food, drop the useless burnt food and find a bank.
translation: 当你的熟食库存充足时，扔掉无用的烧焦的食物并找到银行。 [dang ni de shu shi ku cun chong zu shi ， reng diao wu yong de shao jiao de shi wu bing zhao dao yin hang 。]

english: Is there anything else you want to know?
translation: 您还有什么想知道的吗？ [nin hai you shen me xiang zhi dao de ma ？]

english: What kinds of things can I cook?
translation: 我可以煮什么东西？ [wo ke yi zhu shen me dong xi ？]

english: Many things! You can cook anything from fish to poultry. You could try your hand at making baked potatoes or even brew some of the good stuff.
translation: 很多事情！您可以烹饪从鱼到家禽的任何食物。您可以尝试制作烤土豆，甚至酿造一些好东西。 [hen duo shi qing ！ nin ke yi peng ren cong yu dao jia qin de ren he shi wu 。 nin ke yi chang shi zhi zuo kao tu dou ， shen zhi niang zao yi xie hao dong xi 。]

english: What would you like to hear about?
translation: 您想听什么？ [nin xiang ting shen me ？]

english: Tell me about Fish and Meat.
translation: 告诉我关于鱼和肉的事。 [gao su wo guan yu yu he rou de shi 。]

english: You might find that when killing monsters, they drop some raw meat for you to cook.
translation: 你可能会发现，杀死怪物时，他们会掉落一些生肉供你烹饪。 [ni ke neng hui fa xian ， sha si guai wu shi ， ta men hui diao luo yi xie sheng rou gong ni peng ren 。]

english: Some of them might have hidden properties. Such as anglerfish, but you will find it hard getting hold of any of them at this time.
translation: 其中一些可能具有隐藏属性。比如鮟鱇鱼，但此时你会发现很难抓住它们。 [qi zhong yi xie ke neng ju you yin cang shu xing 。 bi ru an kang yu ， dan ci shi ni hui fa xian hen nan zhua zhu ta men 。]

english: Most of the time, cooking meat and fish requires nothing else but a range or fire. More complicated dishes might require specialized equipment.
translation: 大多数时候，烹饪肉和鱼只需要炉灶或火即可。更复杂的菜肴可能需要专门的设备。 [da duo shu shi hou ， peng ren rou he yu zhi xu yao lu zao huo huo ji ke 。 geng fu za de cai yao ke neng xu yao zhuan men de she bei 。]

english: Would you like to hear about anything else I mentioned?
translation: 您还想听听我提到的其他事情吗？ [nin hai xiang ting ting wo ti dao de qi ta shi qing ma ？]

english: Tell me about Brewing.
translation: 告诉我有关酿造的事情。 [gao su wo you guan niang zao de shi qing 。]

english: You might find it hard getting to these places but you can always buy beer at any pub. Some pubs sell unique beers too.
translation: 您可能会发现很难到达这些地方，但您随时可以在任何酒吧购买啤酒。一些酒吧也出售独特的啤酒。 [nin ke neng hui fa xian hen nan dao da zhe xie di fang ， dan nin sui shi ke yi zai ren he jiu ba gou mai pi jiu 。 yi xie jiu ba ye chu shou du te de pi jiu 。]

english: Tell me about Vegetables.
translation: 告诉我有关蔬菜的事。 [gao su wo you guan shu cai de shi 。]

english: They require many different ingredients to make, such as butter and vegetables, but you will find it hard to acquire the ingredients needed.
translation: 它们需要许多不同的原料来制作，例如黄油和蔬菜，但您会发现很难获得所需的原料。 [ta men xu yao xu duo bu tong de yuan liao lai zhi zuo ， li ru huang you he shu cai ， dan nin hui fa xian hen nan huo de suo xu de yuan liao 。]

english: Tell me about Pies and Pizzas.
translation: 告诉我有关馅饼和披萨的事。 [gao su wo you guan xian bing he pi sa de shi 。]

english: Next, we have pizza. You will first need to make yourself a pizza base, use a pot of flour with a bucket of water and make a pizza base.
translation: 接下来，我们有披萨。您首先需要自己制作披萨底，用一锅面粉和一桶水制作披萨底。 [jie xia lai ， wo men you pi sa 。 nin shou xian xu yao zi ji zhi zuo pi sa di ， yong yi guo mian fen he yi tong shui zhi zuo pi sa di 。]

english: If you want to, you could add yourself a topping to the pizza too. Why not try some anchovies?
translation: 如果您愿意，您也可以在披萨中添加配料。为什么不尝试一些凤尾鱼呢？ [ru guo nin yuan yi ， nin ye ke yi zai pi sa zhong tian jia pei liao 。 wei shen me bu chang shi yi xie feng wei yu ne ？]

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Well, just come back any time you want to know how to cook up a storm!
translation: 好吧，只要你想知道如何掀起一场风暴，就随时回来吧！ [hao ba ， zhi yao ni xiang zhi dao ru he xian qi yi chang feng bao ， jiu sui shi hui lai ba ！]

english: Some foods have hidden properties. Anglerfish can provide you with an overheal effect where you have a few more hitpoints than your level. The higher your hitpoints the better the boost.
translation: 有些食物具有隐藏的特性。琵琶鱼可以为你提供过度治疗效果，使你的生命值比你的等级多一些。你的生命值越高，提升效果就越好。 [you xie shi wu ju you yin cang de te xing 。 pi pa yu ke yi wei ni ti gong guo du zhi liao xiao guo ， shi ni de sheng ming zhi bi ni de deng ji duo yi xie 。 ni de sheng ming zhi yue gao ， ti sheng xiao guo jiu yue hao 。]

english: Use two buckets of water, two handfuls of barley malt, 4 hops of your choice and a pot of ale yeast, then leave to ferment for a few days!
translation: 使用两桶水、两把大麦芽、4 种您选择的啤酒花和一罐艾尔酵母，然后发酵几天！ [shi yong liang tong shui 、 liang ba da mai ya 、4  zhong nin xuan ze de pi jiu hua he yi guan ai er jiao mu ， ran hou fa jiao ji tian ！]

english: You'll need to churn some butter and cheese. Look for the churn icon on the minimap. There is a churn in the farm building northwest of Lumbridge.
translation: 你需要搅拌一些黄油和奶酪。在小地图上寻找流失图标。朗布里奇西北部的农场建筑里有一台搅拌机。 [ni xu yao jiao ban yi xie huang you he nai lao 。 zai xiao di tu shang xun zhao liu shi tu biao 。 lang bu li qi xi bei bu de nong chang jian zhu li you yi tai jiao ban ji 。]

english: Now you will need to pick your topping if you want one. Get yourself a boweland create the perfect topping. Then put the topping onto the potato.
translation: 现在，如果您想要的话，您需要选择配料。给自己准备一份肠子，制作完美的配料。然后将配料放在土豆上。 [xian zai ， ru guo nin xiang yao de hua ， nin xu yao xuan ze pei liao 。 gei zi ji zhun bei yi fen chang zi ， zhi zuo wan mei de pei liao 。 ran hou jiang pei liao fang zai tu dou shang 。]

english: Some pies might even be able to boost some of your skills, be it temporarily.
translation: 有些馅饼甚至可以暂时提高你的一些技能。 [you xie xian bing shen zhi ke yi zan shi ti gao ni de yi xie ji neng 。]

english: I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun! Pleased to meet you!
translation: 我是多格舒恩的扎尼克！很高兴认识你！ [wo shi duo ge shu en de zha ni ke ！ hen gao xing ren shi ni ！]

english: Hello there Zanik! How can I help?
translation: 你好，扎尼克！我能提供什么帮助吗？ [ni hao ， zha ni ke ！ wo neng ti gong shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: What kind of foods do you eat up here on the surface?
translation: 你们在地面上吃什么食物？ [ni men zai di mian shang chi shen me shi wu ？]

english: All sorts of foods! There are lots of kinds of fish, and there are stews, pizzas, bread, baked potatoes...
translation: 各种美食都有！鱼的种类很多，还有炖菜、披萨、面包、烤土豆…… [ge zhong mei shi dou you ！ yu de zhong lei hen duo ， hai you dun cai 、 pi sa 、 mian bao 、 kao tu dou ……]

english: This is so exciting! Perhaps later I'll come back and sample lots of different surface foods!
translation: 这太令人兴奋了！也许稍后我会回来品尝许多不同的表面食物！ [zhe tai ling ren xing fen le ！ ye xu shao hou wo hui hui lai pin chang xu duo bu tong de biao mian shi wu ！]

english: I'm sure you'll like them! What about you, [player name] Can I help you?
translation: 我相信你会喜欢它们！你呢，[玩家姓名]我可以帮你吗？ [wo xiang xin ni hui xi huan ta men ！ ni ne ，[ wan jia xing ming ] wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: Can you teach me the basics of cooking please?
translation: 你能教我烹饪的基本知识吗？ [ni neng jiao wo peng ren de ji ben zhi shi ma ？]

english: I already know the basics of cooking. Got any tips?
translation: 我已经知道烹饪的基础知识了。有什么建议吗？ [wo yi jing zhi dao peng ren de ji chu zhi shi le 。 you shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: How can I train my cooking?
translation: 我该如何训练我的厨艺？ [wo gai ru he xun lian wo de chu yi ？]

english: Any advice for an advanced chef?
translation: 对高级厨师有什么建议吗？ [dui gao ji chu shi you shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: Tell me about different food I can make.
translation: 告诉我我可以做的不同食物。 [gao su wo wo ke yi zuo de bu tong shi wu 。]

english: Fish and Meat
translation: 鱼和肉 [yu he rou]

english: Brewing
translation: 酿造 [niang zao]

english: Vegetables
translation: 蔬菜 [shu cai]

english: Pies and Pizza
translation: 馅饼和披萨 [xian bing he pi sa]

english: Go back to teaching
translation: 回去教学 [hui qu jiao xue]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: What kinds of things can I cook?
translation: 我可以煮什么东西？ [wo ke yi zhu shen me dong xi ？]

english: Tell me about Fish and Meat.
translation: 告诉我关于鱼和肉的事。 [gao su wo guan yu yu he rou de shi 。]

english: Tell me about Brewing.
translation: 告诉我有关酿造的事情。 [gao su wo you guan niang zao de shi qing 。]

english: Tell me about Vegetables.
translation: 告诉我有关蔬菜的事。 [gao su wo you guan shu cai de shi 。]

english: Tell me about Pies and Pizzas.
translation: 告诉我有关馅饼和披萨的事。 [gao su wo you guan xian bing he pi sa de shi 。]

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Get out of my way stinky! I've got stew to make!
translation: 臭臭的给我滚开！我还有炖菜要做！ [chou chou de gei wo gun kai ！ wo hai you dun cai yao zuo ！]

english: What do you want, stinky?
translation: 臭臭的，你想要什么？ [chou chou de ， ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Hello to you too. You must be Weasel then.
translation: 也向你问好。那你一定是黄鼠狼了。 [ye xiang ni wen hao 。 na ni yi ding shi huang shu lang le 。]

english: Yes I am. Cooky Weasel to you. Finest cook this side of, well, pick an object - or a concept - or a location! I'm the best cook any side of anything what you can think of!
translation: 我是。给你饼干黄鼠狼。最好的厨师这一面，好吧，选择一个物体 - 或一个概念 - 或一个位置！无论你能想到什么，我都是最好的厨师！ [wo shi 。 gei ni bing gan huang shu lang 。 zui hao de chu shi zhe yi mian ， hao ba ， xuan ze yi ge wu ti  -  huo yi ge gai nian  -  huo yi ge wei zhi ！ wu lun ni neng xiang dao shen me ， wo dou shi zui hao de chu shi ！]

english: Is that why you're down in this hole?
translation: 这就是你掉进这个洞里的原因吗？ [zhe jiu shi ni diao jin zhe ge dong li de yuan yin ma ？]

english: Hole?! This is a fine establishment. At least it was until you stank it up.
translation: 洞？！这是一家不错的酒店。至少在你把它弄臭之前是这样。 [dong ？！ zhe shi yi jia bu cuo de jiu dian 。 zhi shao zai ni ba ta nong chou zhi qian shi zhe yang 。]

english: Good grief, this is going to be a long day.
translation: 天哪，这将是漫长的一天。 [tian na ， zhe jiang shi man chang de yi tian 。]

english: What was that?
translation: 那是什么？ [na shi shen me ？]

english: I said Wheeler told me you might have some extra nice carrots I could use?
translation: 我说惠勒告诉我你可能有一些额外的好胡萝卜我可以用？ [wo shuo hui lei gao su wo ni ke neng you yi xie e wai de hao hu luo bo wo ke yi yong ？]

english: Wheeler sent you eh? Hmm... Why would I give you my good carrots? Thems for roasting with honey, not for stinking up with your grubby mitts.
translation: 惠勒派你来的吧？嗯...我为什么要给你我的好胡萝卜？它们是用来用蜂蜜烘烤的，而不是用你肮脏的手套来闻的。 [hui le pai ni lai de ba ？ n ... wo wei shen me yao gei ni wo de hao hu luo bo ？ ta men shi yong lai yong feng mi hong kao de ， er bu shi yong ni ang zang de shou tao lai wen de 。]

english: I want to make some special carrot juice for the Easter Bunny, to try and cheer him up.
translation: 我想为复活节兔子制作一些特殊的胡萝卜汁，让他高兴起来。 [wo xiang wei fu huo jie tu zi zhi zuo yi xie te shu de hu luo bo zhi ， rang ta gao xing qi lai 。]

english: Oh! Well why didn't you say so? Smells like a good idea to me. If anyone deserves some good juice, it's him!
translation: 哦！那么你为什么不这么说呢？对我来说是个好主意。如果有人值得喝点好果汁的话，那就是他了！ [o ！ na me ni wei shen me bu zhe me shuo ne ？ dui wo lai shuo shi ge hao zhu yi 。 ru guo you ren zhi de he dian hao guo zhi de hua ， na jiu shi ta le ！]

english: Smells like you don't have space for these wonderful carrots. Clear some room and come back when you can handle the veggies!
translation: 闻起来好像你没有空间容纳这些美味的胡萝卜。清理一些房间，等你能处理蔬菜后再回来！ [wen qi lai hao xiang ni mei you kong jian rong na zhe xie mei wei de hu luo bo 。 qing li yi xie fang jian ， deng ni neng chu li shu cai hou zai hui lai ！]

english: There's 3 fancy carrots for you, stinky. Now go and get that juice made before your stench rots 'em!
translation: 有3根漂亮的胡萝卜给你，臭的。现在去把果汁榨出来，免得你的恶臭让它们腐烂！ [you 3 gen piao liang de hu luo bo gei ni ， chou de 。 xian zai qu ba guo zhi zha chu lai ， mian de ni de e chou rang ta men fu lan ！]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: You've managed to make carrot juice? Surprising, and it doesn't seem to stink. Almost unbelievable!
translation: 你成功制作了胡萝卜汁吗？令人惊讶的是，它似乎并不臭。几乎难以置信！ [ni cheng gong zhi zuo le hu luo bo zhi ma ？ ling ren jing ya de shi ， ta si hu bing bu chou 。 ji hu nan yi zhi xin ！]

english: Smells to me like you've already got enough of my fancy carrots. Go away!
translation: 我闻起来就像你已经吃够了我的精美胡萝卜。离开！ [wo wen qi lai jiu xiang ni yi jing chi gou le wo de jing mei hu luo bo 。 li kai ！]

english: What are you after now?
translation: 你现在在追求什么？ [ni xian zai zai zhui qiu shen me ？]

english: I need another carrot, I lost one.
translation: 我需要另一根胡萝卜，我丢了一根。 [wo xu yao ling yi gen hu luo bo ， wo diu le yi gen 。]

english: I need more carrots, I lost some of them.
translation: 我需要更多的胡萝卜，我丢了一些。 [wo xu yao geng duo de hu luo bo ， wo diu le yi xie 。]

english: I need more carrots, I lost them all.
translation: 我需要更多的胡萝卜，我把它们全都丢了。 [wo xu yao geng duo de hu luo bo ， wo ba ta men quan dou diu le 。]

english: You weren't nibbling at them were you? I bet you were thinking about it.
translation: 你没有啃它们吧？我敢打赌你一定也在想这个问题。 [ni mei you ken ta men ba ？ wo gan da du ni yi ding ye zai xiang zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Of course not.
translation: 当然不是。 [dang ran bu shi 。]

english: Yeah right. Here, take 'em. Take all of my lovely carrots! Just make sure the Easter Bunny gets his juice this time.
translation: 是的，对。来，拿走他们。拿走我所有可爱的胡萝卜！只要确保这次复活节兔子得到他的果汁即可。 [shi de ， dui 。 lai ， na zou ta men 。 na zou wo suo you ke ai de hu luo bo ！ zhi yao que bao zhe ci fu huo jie tu zi de dao ta de guo zhi ji ke 。]

english: Thank you. Won't happen again.
translation: 谢谢。不会再发生了。 [xie xie 。 bu hui zai fa sheng le 。]

english: You've been eating the carrots! I can smell 'em on your breath! You big stinking piggy!
translation: 你一直在吃胡萝卜！我可以从你的呼吸中闻到它们的味道！你这个大臭猪！ [ni yi zhi zai chi hu luo bo ！ wo ke yi cong ni de hu xi zhong wen dao ta men de wei dao ！ ni zhe ge da chou zhu ！]

english: I'm sure I would remember eating such a delicous, sweet, crunchy, orange, juicy...
translation: 我确信我会记得吃过如此美味、香甜、脆脆、橙子、多汁的...... [wo que xin wo hui ji de chi guo ru ci mei wei 、 xiang tian 、 cui cui 、 cheng zi 、 duo zhi de ......]

english: What was the question?
translation: 问题是什么？ [wen ti shi shen me ？]

english: Take these carrots and get out of my sight.
translation: 把这些胡萝卜拿走，滚出我的视线。 [ba zhe xie hu luo bo na zou ， gun chu wo de shi xian 。]

english: You've got orange stains around your mouth!
translation: 你的嘴周围有橙色污渍！ [ni de zui zhou wei you cheng se wu zi ！]

english: Probably from the carrot juice.
translation: 可能是胡萝卜汁。 [ke neng shi hu luo bo zhi 。]

english: YOU WHAT?!? You DRANK the juice that you made for the Easter Bunny?
translation: 你什么？！？你喝了为复活节兔子制作的果汁吗？ [ni shen me ？！？ ni he le wei fu huo jie tu zi zhi zuo de guo zhi ma ？]

english: It was very good.
translation: 非常好。 [fei chang hao 。]

english: Oh for... Please use these carrots for their intended purpose.
translation: 哦，因为……请把这些胡萝卜用于它们的预期用途。 [o ， yin wei …… qing ba zhe xie hu luo bo yong yu ta men de yu qi yong tu 。]

english: Not only that, I drank the juice!
translation: 不仅如此，我还喝了果汁！ [bu jin ru ci ， wo hai he le guo zhi ！]

english: YOU WHAT?!? You're a real piece of work. Do you think these carrots grow on trees?
translation: 你什么？！？你真是一个杰作。你认为这些胡萝卜是长在树上的吗？ [ni shen me ？！？ ni zhen shi yi ge jie zuo 。 ni ren wei zhe xie hu luo bo shi zhang zai shu shang de ma ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: Well they don't. They grow underground. And they're expensive. So either help the Easter Bunny, or stop wasting my stock!
translation: 好吧，他们没有。它们生长在地下。而且它们很贵。所以要么帮助复活节兔子，要么停止浪费我的库存！ [hao ba ， ta men mei you 。 ta men sheng zhang zai di xia 。 er qie ta men hen gui 。 suo yi yao me bang zhu fu huo jie tu zi ， yao me ting zhi lang fei wo de ku cun ！]

english: I'll do my best.
translation: 我会尽力的。 [wo hui jin li de 。]

english: Good news! The Easter Bunny loved the juice I made with your fancy carrots!
translation: 好消息！复活节兔子喜欢我用你精美的胡萝卜做的果汁！ [hao xiao xi ！ fu huo jie tu zi xi huan wo yong ni jing mei de hu luo bo zuo de guo zhi ！]

english: I'm glad to hear it.
translation: 我很高兴听到这个消息。 [wo hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi 。]

english: Now clear off!
translation: 现在清除！ [xian zai qing chu ！]

english: Keep your hands away from these lovely carrots, stinky!
translation: 别让你的手靠近这些可爱的胡萝卜，臭死了！ [bie rang ni de shou kao jin zhe xie ke ai de hu luo bo ， chou si le ！]

english: I wasn't anywhere near them!
translation: 我根本就没有靠近他们！ [wo gen ben jiu mei you kao jin ta men ！]

english: I can smell you getting closer, stinky!
translation: 我能闻到你离我越来越近了，臭臭的！ [wo neng wen dao ni li wo yue lai yue jin le ， chou chou de ！]

english: I don't want any carrots I'm just here for eggs!
translation: 我不要胡萝卜，我只是来吃鸡蛋的！ [wo bu yao hu luo bo ， wo zhi shi lai chi ji dan de ！]

english: Good, cause these carrots aren't for you, stinky!
translation: 很好，因为这些胡萝卜不适合你，太臭了！ [hen hao ， yin wei zhe xie hu luo bo bu shi he ni ， tai chou le ！]

english: Fine, I'm going!
translation: 好吧，我这就去！ [hao ba ， wo zhe jiu qu ！]

english: Greetings human.
translation: 问候人类。 [wen hou ren lei 。]

english: Hello, who are you?
translation: 你好，你是谁？ [ni hao ， ni shi shui ？]

english: Corkat quo Sihar. I am one of the mystics of the Kahlith. Are you here to serve the balance?
translation: Corkat quo Sihar。我是卡利斯的神秘主义者之一。你来这里是为了平衡吗？ [Corkat quo Sihar。 wo shi ka li si de shen mi zhu yi zhe zhi yi 。 ni lai zhe li shi wei le ping heng ma ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: Then you should speak to Konar quo Maten. She will guide you.
translation: 那么你应该和Konar quo Maten 谈谈。她会指导你。 [na me ni ying gai he Konar quo Maten  tan tan 。 ta hui zhi dao ni 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: A shame. You are a bringer of death, you could be of great use to the balance.
translation: 丢人现眼。你是死亡使者，你对平衡有很大的用处。 [diu ren xian yan 。 ni shi si wang shi zhe ， ni dui ping heng you hen da de yong chu 。]

english: I'm not sure.
translation: 我不知道。 [wo bu zhi dao 。]

english: Then you should speak with Xorrah quo Sihar. He will show you the way.
translation: 那么你应该和 Xorrah quo Sihar 谈谈。他会给你指路。 [na me ni ying gai he  Xorrah quo Sihar  tan tan 。 ta hui gei ni zhi lu 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: I'm not sure.
translation: 我不知道。 [wo bu zhi dao 。]

english: Hey it's the hero! Thank you so much for saving us from Gadderanks. And the town is looking lovely as well. You've done a great job!
translation: 嘿，这就是英雄！非常感谢你把我们从加德兰克手中救了出来。这个小镇看起来也很漂亮。你做得很好！ [hei ， zhe jiu shi ying xiong ！ fei chang gan xie ni ba wo men cong jia de lan ke shou zhong jiu le chu lai 。 zhe ge xiao zhen kan qi lai ye hen piao liang 。 ni zuo de hen hao ！]

english: You're more than welcome.
translation: 非常欢迎您。 [fei chang huan ying nin 。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm Cornelius. I run the bank now.
translation: 我是科尼利厄斯。我现在经营银行。 [wo shi ke ni li e si 。 wo xian zai jing ying yin hang 。]

english: How do you like your town?
translation: 你喜欢你的城市吗？ [ni xi huan ni de cheng shi ma ？]

english: It's just perfect. Thanks so much for your efforts.
translation: 太完美了。非常感谢您的努力。 [tai wan mei le 。 fei chang gan xie nin de nu li 。]

english: What's happening around here?
translation: 这附近发生了什么事？ [zhe fu jin fa sheng le shen me shi ？]

english: Oh, not much really. We're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place.
translation: 哦，其实不多。我们仍然在躲避吸血鬼，在这个可怕的地方勉强维持生计。 [o ， qi shi bu duo 。 wo men reng ran zai duo bi xi xue gui ， zai zhe ge ke pa de di fang mian qiang wei chi sheng ji 。]

english: Hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey across the Salve.
translation: 希望很快我们就能变得足够强大，能够完成跨越萨尔维的旅程。 [xi wang hen kuai wo men jiu neng bian de zu gou qiang da ， neng gou wan cheng kua yue sa er wei de lv cheng 。]

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang mang de ma ？]

english: Not as far as I know. We have some basic amenities now which is so very useful and we're all incredibly grateful to you.
translation: 据我所知还没有。我们现在有一些非常有用的基本设施，我们都非常感谢您。 [ju wo suo zhi hai mei you 。 wo men xian zai you yi xie fei chang you yong de ji ben she shi ， wo men dou fei chang gan xie nin 。]

english: I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: 我以前从未真正见过或认识过英雄，所​​以我没有什么可以与之比较的，但我怀疑在大多数人的判断中，你就是其中之一！我很高兴见到你。 [wo yi qian cong wei zhen zheng jian guo huo ren shi guo ying xiong ， suo ​​ yi wo mei you shen me ke yi yu zhi bi jiao de ， dan wo huai yi zai da duo shu ren de pan duan zhong ， ni jiu shi qi zhong zhi yi ！ wo hen gao xing jian dao ni 。]

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: How do you like your town?
translation: 你喜欢你的城市吗？ [ni xi huan ni de cheng shi ma ？]

english: What's happening around here?
translation: 这附近发生了什么事？ [zhe fu jin fa sheng le shen me shi ？]

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang mang de ma ？]

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Excuse me! This area is different than the rest of the Wilderness, are you sure you understand the rules?
translation: 打扰一下！这个区域与荒野其他地方不同，你确定你了解规则吗？ [da rao yi xia ！ zhe ge qu yu yu huang ye qi ta di fang bu tong ， ni que ding ni liao jie gui ze ma ？]

english: I can tell you everything you need to know, but if you're in a rush then be warned my overlords will NOT be happy if they find you to be fighting with no honour.
translation: 我可以告诉你你需要知道的一切，但如果你很着急，那么请注意，如果我的领主发现你在毫无荣誉地战斗，他们将不会高兴。 [wo ke yi gao su ni ni xu yao zhi dao de yi qie ， dan ru guo ni hen zhao ji ， na me qing zhu yi ， ru guo wo de ling zhu fa xian ni zai hao wu rong yu di zhan dou ， ta men jiang bu hui gao xing 。]

english: Just don't go doing anything silly like selling your soul to your opponent else there will be big trouble!
translation: 只是不要去做任何愚蠢的事情，比如将你的灵魂出卖给你的对手，否则会有大麻烦的！ [zhi shi bu yao qu zuo ren he yu chun de shi qing ， bi ru jiang ni de ling hun chu mai gei ni de dui shou ， fou ze hui you da ma fan de ！]

english: [How may I help you, sir/How may I help you, madam/How may I help you]?
translation: [我可以帮助您吗，先生/我可以帮助您吗，女士/我可以帮助您吗]？ [[ wo ke yi bang zhu nin ma ， xian sheng / wo ke yi bang zhu nin ma ， nv shi / wo ke yi bang zhu nin ma ]？]

english: I'd like to learn the rules of combat in this arena!
translation: 我想学习这个竞技场的战斗规则！ [wo xiang xue xi zhe ge jing ji chang de zhan dou gui ze ！]

english: Sure. Which part do you want to learn?
translation: 当然。你想学习哪一部分？ [dang ran 。 ni xiang xue xi na yi bu fen ？]

english: Let's talk about Targets.
translation: 我们来谈谈目标。 [wo men lai tan tan mu biao 。]

english: Sure. Upon entering the arena, you will be assigned a Target based on your combat level, and if you wish to adjust the range of potential Targets, you may do so by speaking with the Trader.
translation: 当然。进入竞技场后，您将根据您的战斗等级分配一个目标，如果您想调整潜在目标的范围，您可以通过与商人交谈来实现。 [dang ran 。 jin ru jing ji chang hou ， nin jiang gen ju nin de zhan dou deng ji fen pei yi ge mu biao ， ru guo nin xiang tiao zheng qian zai mu biao de fan wei ， nin ke yi tong guo yu shang ren jiao tan lai shi xian 。]

english: If you wish to change your Target, you may skip your current one, but please note that if you skip three skulled Targets within 30 minutes, you will not be able to receive a new Target for the next 30 minutes.
translation: 如果您想更改您的目标，您可以跳过当前的目标，但请注意，如果您在 30 分钟内跳过三个骷髅目标，您将无法在接下来的 30 分钟内收到新的目标。 [ru guo nin xiang geng gai nin de mu biao ， nin ke yi tiao guo dang qian de mu biao ， dan qing zhu yi ， ru guo nin zai  30  fen zhong nei tiao guo san ge ku lou mu biao ， nin jiang wu fa zai jie xia lai de  30  fen zhong nei shou dao xin de mu biao 。]

english: Additionally, it's worth mentioning that killing a player who is not your Target will not reward you with any bonuses related to Emblem or Bounty Hunter Points.
translation: 此外，值得一提的是，杀死不是你的目标的玩家不会奖励你任何与徽章或赏金猎人积分相关的奖励。 [ci wai ， zhi de yi ti de shi ， sha si bu shi ni de mu biao de wan jia bu hui jiang li ni ren he yu hui zhang huo shang jin lie ren ji fen xiang guan de jiang li 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Tell me about Emblems.
translation: 告诉我关于徽章的事。 [gao su wo guan yu hui zhang de shi 。]

english: After defeating your Target, you may come across a tier one Emblem. Defeating another Target will level up the Emblem; the higher its tier, the greater its value.
translation: 击败目标后，您可能会遇到一级徽章。击败另一个目标将提升徽章等级；其等级越高，其价值就越大。 [ji bai mu biao hou ， nin ke neng hui yu dao yi ji hui zhang 。 ji bai ling yi ge mu biao jiang ti sheng hui zhang deng ji ； qi deng ji yue gao ， qi jia zhi jiu yue da 。]

english: If you die while carrying an Emblem, its tier will be reduced by one. If you die with a Tier 1 emblem, you will lose the emblem.
translation: 如果你在携带徽章时死亡，其等级将减少一级。如果您带着 1 级徽章死亡，您将失去该徽章。 [ru guo ni zai xie dai hui zhang shi si wang ， qi deng ji jiang jian shao yi ji 。 ru guo nin dai zhe  1  ji hui zhang si wang ， nin jiang shi qu gai hui zhang 。]

english: You may use Bounty Hunter Points to purchase a tier one Emblem from the Trader, or sell your own Emblem to him for Bounty Hunter Points. You can only have one Emblem at a time.
translation: 您可以使用赏金猎人积分从商人那里购买一级徽章，或将您自己的徽章出售给他以获得赏金猎人积分。您一次只能拥有一个徽章。 [nin ke yi shi yong shang jin lie ren ji fen cong shang ren na li gou mai yi ji hui zhang ， huo jiang nin zi ji de hui zhang chu shou gei ta yi huo de shang jin lie ren ji fen 。 nin yi ci zhi neng yong you yi ge hui zhang 。]

english: Can you explain Bounty Hunter Points to me?
translation: 你能向我解释一下赏金猎人积分吗？ [ni neng xiang wo jie shi yi xia shang jin lie ren ji fen ma ？]

english: You can earn Bounty Hunter Points by defeating your target or selling Emblems to the Trader. Once you have Bounty Hunter Points, you may use them to purchase rewards from the reward shop.
translation: 您可以通过击败目标或向商人出售徽章来赚取赏金猎人积分。一旦您拥有赏金猎人积分，您就可以使用它们从奖励商店购买奖励。 [nin ke yi tong guo ji bai mu biao huo xiang shang ren chu shou hui zhang lai zhuan qu shang jin lie ren ji fen 。 yi dan nin yong you shang jin lie ren ji fen ， nin jiu ke yi shi yong ta men cong jiang li shang dian gou mai jiang li 。]

english: What is the Coffer for?
translation: 保险箱有什么用？ [bao xian xiang you shen me yong ？]

english: To participate in Bounty Hunter, you must have a certain amount of coins in your Coffer, which varies based on your combat level. Currently you need at least [x] coins to participate.
translation: 要参加赏金猎人，您的保险箱中必须有一定数量的金币，该数量根据您的战斗等级而变化。目前您至少需要 [x] 个硬币才能参与。 [yao can jia shang jin lie ren ， nin de bao xian xiang zhong bi xu you yi ding shu liang de jin bi ， gai shu liang gen ju nin de zhan dou deng ji er bian hua 。 mu qian nin zhi shao xu yao  [x]  ge ying bi cai neng can yu 。]

english: If you are unskulled and another person kills you in Bounty Hunter, [x] coins will be deducted from your Coffer and given to your killer.
translation: 如果您在赏金猎人中没有骷髅，并且其他人杀死了您，则会从您的保险箱中扣除 [x] 个硬币并交给凶手。 [ru guo nin zai shang jin lie ren zhong mei you ku lou ， bing qie qi ta ren sha si le nin ， ze hui cong nin de bao xian xiang zhong kou chu  [x]  ge ying bi bing jiao gei xiong shou 。]

english: If you are skulled, 10,000 coins will be deducted from your Coffer and given to your killer. However, any surplus money in your Coffer will remain safe.
translation: 如果你被斩首，10,000枚金币将从你的金库中扣除并交给凶手。但是，您保险箱中的任何剩余资金都将保持安全。 [ru guo ni bei zhan shou ，10,000 mei jin bi jiang cong ni de jin ku zhong kou chu bing jiao gei xiong shou 。 dan shi ， nin bao xian xiang zhong de ren he sheng yu zi jin dou jiang bao chi an quan 。]

english: To manage your Coffer, talk to the Trader.
translation: 要管理您的金库，请与交易者交谈。 [yao guan li nin de jin ku ， qing yu jiao yi zhe jiao tan 。]

english: How do I get bounty crates?
translation: 我如何获得赏金箱？ [wo ru he huo de shang jin xiang ？]

english: Well, if you want crates, you'll need to be fighting a target in the arena while having a minimum value of risked items on you. Anything you can protect, we won't count.
translation: 好吧，如果你想要板条箱，你需要在竞技场中与目标战斗，同时身上的危险物品价值最低。任何你能保护的东西，我们都不算数。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni xiang yao ban tiao xiang ， ni xu yao zai jing ji chang zhong yu mu biao zhan dou ， tong shi shen shang de wei xian wu pin jia zhi zui di 。 ren he ni neng bao hu de dong xi ， wo men dou bu suan shu 。]

english: If you meet these requirements, we'll keep track of how long you're in there for. We'll occasionally give you a bonus if you die as well.
translation: 如果您满足这些要求，我们将跟踪您在那里呆了多长时间。如果你也死了，我们偶尔会给你奖励。 [ru guo nin man zu zhe xie yao qiu ， wo men jiang gen zong nin zai na li dai le duo zhang shi jian 。 ru guo ni ye si le ， wo men ou er hui gei ni jiang li 。]

translation: 库伦德的最后一位国王卡雷斯特四世去世时只有一个孩子。她还太年轻，无法继承王位，因此成立了库伦德议会来照顾她成年之前的事务。 [ku lun de de zui hou yi wei guo wang ka lei si te si shi qu shi shi zhi you yi ge hai zi 。 ta hai tai nian qing ， wu fa ji cheng wang wei ， yin ci cheng li le ku lun de yi hui lai zhao gu ta cheng nian zhi qian de shi wu 。]

english: Alas, she was very close to her father and his sudden death drove her to insanity. With no suitable ruler, the Kourend Council was made permanent.
translation: 唉，她和父亲的关系非常亲密，他的突然去世让她陷入了疯狂。由于没有合适的统治者，库伦德议会被永久保留。 [ai ， ta he fu qin de guan xi fei chang qin mi ， ta de tu ran qu shi rang ta xian ru le feng kuang 。 you yu mei you he shi de tong zhi zhe ， ku lun de yi hui bei yong jiu bao liu 。]

english: How is the Council structured?
translation: 理事会的结构如何？ [li shi hui de jie gou ru he ？]

english: The Kourend Council is made up of four councillors. Every four years there is an election for the people to decide who the councillors should be.
translation: Kourend 委员会由四名议员组成。每四年举行一次选举，由人民决定议员人选。 [Kourend  wei yuan hui you si ming yi yuan zu cheng 。 mei si nian ju xing yi ci xuan ju ， you ren min jue ding yi yuan ren xuan 。]

english: One of the councillors holds the position of Head Councillor and this rotates every year. I am the current Head Councillor.
translation: 其中一名议员担任首席议员，每年轮换一次。我是现任市议员。 [qi zhong yi ming yi yuan dan ren shou xi yi yuan ， mei nian lun huan yi ci 。 wo shi xian ren shi yi yuan 。]

english: The other councillors are Councillor Hughes, Councillor Unkar and Councillor Orson.
translation: 其他议员包括休斯议员、翁卡议员和奥森议员。 [qi ta yi yuan bao kuo xiu si yi yuan 、 weng ka yi yuan he ao sen yi yuan 。]

english: The other councillors are Councillor Unkar and Councillor Orson. The fourth seat on the Council is currently vacentafter the recent arrest of Councillor Hughes.
translation: 其他议员是议员Unkar 和议员Orson。在休斯议员最近被捕后，该委员会的第四个席位目前空缺。 [qi ta yi yuan shi yi yuan Unkar  he yi yuan Orson。 zai xiu si yi yuan zui jin bei bu hou ， gai wei yuan hui de di si ge xi wei mu qian kong que 。]

english: So where do the five houses fit in?
translation: 那么这五栋房子分别位于哪里呢？ [na me zhe wu dong fang zi fen bie wei yu na li ne ？]

english: The five houses of Kourend each have their own leader who rules over their city. The leaders of the individual houses must enforce and obey the laws set out by the Kourend Council, but can otherwise rule as they see fit.
translation: 库伦德的五个家族都有自己的领袖来统治他们的城市。各个议院的领导人必须执行和遵守库伦德议会制定的法律，但也可以按照他们认为合适的方式进行统治。 [ku lun de de wu ge jia zu dou you zi ji de ling xiu lai tong zhi ta men de cheng shi 。 ge ge yi yuan de ling dao ren bi xu zhi xing he zun shou ku lun de yi hui zhi ding de fa lv ， dan ye ke yi an zhao ta men ren wei he shi de fang shi jin xing tong zhi 。]

english: I hope that helps.
translation: 我希望这有帮助。 [wo xi wang zhe you bang zhu 。]

english: Yes, thank you.
translation: 是的，谢谢。 [shi de ， xie xie 。]

english: Time for me to go.
translation: 我该走了。 [wo gai zou le 。]

english: Good day citizen.
translation: 美好的一天，公民。 [mei hao de yi tian ， gong min 。]

english: There's been a death in Arceuus.
translation: 阿尔宙斯发生了一起死亡事件。 [a er zhou si fa sheng le yi qi si wang shi jian 。]

english: A death? Well that doesn't seem right. The people of Arceuus don't just die. They can't.
translation: 死亡？嗯，这似乎不对。阿尔宙斯的人民不只是死去。他们不能。 [si wang ？ n ， zhe si hu bu dui 。 a er zhou si de ren min bu zhi shi si qu 。 ta men bu neng 。]

english: I've seen it with my own eyes. A citizen of Arceuus has fallen. What should we do?
translation: 我亲眼所见。阿尔宙斯的一名公民倒下了。我们应该做什么？ [wo qin yan suo jian 。 a er zhou si de yi ming gong min dao xia le 。 wo men ying gai zuo shen me ？]

english: Well I don't really know what we can do. The Arceuus family have chosen to keep their knowledge secret from the rest of us. We have no expertise in this area.
translation: 好吧，我真的不知道我们能做什么。阿尔宙斯家族选择对我们其他人保密他们的知识。我们没有这方面的专业知识。 [hao ba ， wo zhen de bu zhi dao wo men neng zuo shen me 。 a er zhou si jia zu xuan ze dui wo men qi ta ren bao mi ta men de zhi shi 。 wo men mei you zhe fang mian de zhuan ye zhi shi 。]

english: So you'll do nothing?
translation: 那么你什么都不做吗？ [na me ni shen me dou bu zuo ma ？]

english: If I could do something, I would. However, I'm afraid this is out of our hands.
translation: 如果我能做点什么，我会的。不过，恐怕这不是我们能掌控的。 [ru guo wo neng zuo dian shen me ， wo hui de 。 bu guo ， kong pa zhe bu shi wo men neng zhang kong de 。]

english: I see. I suppose I'd better tell Mori.
translation: 我懂了。我想我最好告诉森。 [wo dong le 。 wo xiang wo zui hao gao su sen 。]

english: I'm sorry, but as I already told you, we can't help.
translation: 抱歉，正如我已经告诉过你的，我们无能为力。 [bao qian ， zheng ru wo yi jing gao su guo ni de ， wo men wu neng wei li 。]

english: Here he is, the hero of the hour. On behalf of the Council, and indeed all of Kourend, thank you for dealing with this messy situation.
translation: 他就是这个时代的英雄。我代表理事会，乃至整个库伦德，感谢你们处理这一混乱的局面。 [ta jiu shi zhe ge shi dai de ying xiong 。 wo dai biao li shi hui ， nai zhi zheng ge ku lun de ， gan xie ni men chu li zhe yi hun luan de ju mian 。]

english: It was nothing.
translation: 没什么。 [mei shen me 。]

english: You're far too humble. You've done so much for our kingdom in your short time here. Rest assured, we have noticed. In fact, I consider you a firm friend of the Council.
translation: 你太谦虚了。你在短短的时间内为我们的王国做出了如此多的贡献。请放心，我们已经注意到了。事实上，我认为你是安理会的坚定朋友。 [ni tai qian xu le 。 ni zai duan duan de shi jian nei wei wo men de wang guo zuo chu le ru ci duo de gong xian 。 qing fang xin ， wo men yi jing zhu yi dao le 。 shi shi shang ， wo ren wei ni shi an li hui de jian ding peng you 。]

english: Have you managed to work out how Councillor Hughes escaped?
translation: 你查出休斯议员是如何逃脱的吗？ [ni cha chu xiu si yi yuan shi ru he tao tuo de ma ？]

english: Not yet. You need not worry though, we'll get to the bottom of it. That said, I do have another ask of you... if you don't mind.
translation: 还没有。不过你不用担心，我们会追根究底的。也就是说，我还有一个问题要问你……如果你不介意的话。 [hai mei you 。 bu guo ni bu yong dan xin ， wo men hui zhui gen jiu di de 。 ye jiu shi shuo ， wo hai you yi ge wen ti yao wen ni …… ru guo ni bu jie yi de hua 。]

english: What is it?
translation: 它是什么？ [ta shi shen me ？]

english: Commander Fullore tells me you've had dealings with Martin Holt and his group.
translation: 福洛尔指挥官告诉我你和马丁·霍尔特及其团队有过往来。 [fu luo er zhi hui guan gao su wo ni he ma ding · huo er te ji qi tuan dui you guo wang lai 。]

english: I'm not sure about dealings, but we've met.
translation: 我不确定有没有交往，但我们见过面。 [wo bu que ding you mei you jiao wang ， dan wo men jian guo mian 。]

english: well regardless, your handling of the situation with Sophia Hughes seems to have had quite an impact on them.
translation: 无论如何，你对索菲亚休斯事件的处理似乎对他们产生了很大的影响。 [wu lun ru he ， ni dui suo fei ya xiu si shi jian de chu li si hu dui ta men chan sheng le hen da de ying xiang 。]

english: Well, I am quite impactful. So, what is this ask?
translation: 嗯，我很有影响力。那么，这是问什么？ [n ， wo hen you ying xiang li 。 na me ， zhe shi wen shen me ？]

english: This recent situation has been most unfortunate. People are angry, I understand that. That said, Sophia Hughes has been dealt with. It's time for Martin Holt and his protestors to go home.
translation: 最近的情况是非常不幸的。人们很生气，我理解。也就是说，索菲亚休斯已经被处理了。马丁·霍尔特和他的抗议者该回家了。 [zui jin de qing kuang shi fei chang bu xing de 。 ren men hen sheng qi ， wo li jie 。 ye jiu shi shuo ， suo fei ya xiu si yi jing bei chu li le 。 ma ding · huo er te he ta de kang yi zhe gai hui jia le 。]

english: Ah, I see. You want me to convinve them.
translation: 啊，我明白了。你想让我说服他们。 [a ， wo ming bai le 。 ni xiang rang wo shuo fu ta men 。]

english: It would be greatly appreciated. Civil unrest is of no benefit to anyone. We'd all be better off putting this behind us.
translation: 我们将不胜感激。内乱对任何人都没有好处。我们最好把这件事抛在脑后。 [wo men jiang bu sheng gan ji 。 nei luan dui ren he ren dou mei you hao chu 。 wo men zui hao ba zhe jian shi pao zai nao hou 。]

english: Now, I must be off. Plenty of work to do. Good luck with Martin and his friends.
translation: 现在，我必须走了。有很多工作要做。祝马丁和他的朋友们好运。 [xian zai ， wo bi xu zou le 。 you hen duo gong zuo yao zuo 。 zhu ma ding he ta de peng you men hao yun 。]

english: So what now?
translation: 那么现在怎么办？ [na me xian zai zen me ban ？]

english: Come to gloat?
translation: 来幸灾乐祸吗？ [lai xing zai le huo ma ？]

english: Well I do enjoy it when people get what they deserve.
translation: 当人们得到他们应得的东西时，我确实很享受。 [dang ren men de dao ta men ying de de dong xi shi ， wo que shi hen xiang shou 。]

english: You'll never know what it's like to be on top of the world. The power I had was unconquerable. I'd do it all again without hesitation.
translation: 你永远不会知道站在世界之巅是什么感觉。我所拥有的力量是不可战胜的。我会毫不犹豫地再做一遍。 [ni yong yuan bu hui zhi dao zhan zai shi jie zhi dian shi shen me gan jue 。 wo suo yong you de li liang shi bu ke zhan sheng de 。 wo hui hao bu you yu di zai zuo yi bian 。]

english: You never had any power. You were just a puppet. You've always been nothing, and that's all you'll ever be.
translation: 你从来没有任何权力。你只是一个傀儡。你一直都什么都不是，这就是你永远的样子。 [ni cong lai mei you ren he quan li 。 ni zhi shi yi ge kui lei 。 ni yi zhi dou shen me dou bu shi ， zhe jiu shi ni yong yuan de yang zi 。]

english: That's not true!
translation: 那不是真的！ [na bu shi zhen de ！]

english: Enjoy your cell, puppet. Won't be seeing you.
translation: 享受你的细胞吧，木偶。不会见到你了 [xiang shou ni de xi bao ba ， mu ou 。 bu hui jian dao ni le]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Tell me about the Kourend Council.
translation: 告诉我关于库伦德委员会的事。 [gao su wo guan yu ku lun de wei yuan hui de shi 。]

english: Time for me to go.
translation: 我该走了。 [wo gai zou le 。]

english: There's been a death in Arceuus.
translation: 阿尔宙斯发生了一起死亡事件。 [a er zhou si fa sheng le yi qi si wang shi jian 。]

english: Hello. How are you?
translation: 你好。你好吗？ [ni hao 。 ni hao ma ？]

english: I've been better.
translation: 我已经好多了。 [wo yi jing hao duo le 。]

english: What's wrong?
translation: 怎么了？ [zen me le ？]

english: You may or may not be aware, but a plague has spread across West Ardougne. Now, so far, our efforts to contain it have been largely successful, for the most part.
translation: 您可能知道也可能不知道，瘟疫已经席卷西阿杜涅。到目前为止，我们遏制疫情的努力基本上是成功的。 [nin ke neng zhi dao ye ke neng bu zhi dao ， wen yi yi jing xi juan xi a du nie 。 dao mu qian wei zhi ， wo men e zhi yi qing de nu li ji ben shang shi cheng gong de 。]

english: However, some sheep recently escaped from a farm near the city. When they were found, we noticed that they were strangely discoloured, so we asked the mourners to examine them.
translation: 然而，一些羊最近从城市附近的一个农场逃走了。当它们被发现时，我们发现它们变色了，所以我们请哀悼者检查它们。 [ran er ， yi xie yang zui jin cong cheng shi fu jin de yi ge nong chang tao zou le 。 dang ta men bei fa xian shi ， wo men fa xian ta men bian se le ， suo yi wo men qing ai dao zhe jian cha ta men 。]

english: They believe that the sheep have become infected with the plague.
translation: 他们认为羊已经感染了鼠疫。 [ta men ren wei yang yi jing gan ran le shu yi 。]

english: Are you sure it's the plague?
translation: 你确定这是瘟疫吗？ [ni que ding zhe shi wen yi ma ？]

english: Well the mourners seemed convinced and they're the experts. Even if it's not though, the sheep are clearly diseased in some way.
translation: 好吧，哀悼者似乎被说服了，他们是专家。即使事实并非如此，羊显然在某种程度上患病了。 [hao ba ， ai dao zhe si hu bei shuo fu le ， ta men shi zhuan jia 。 ji shi shi shi bing fei ru ci ， yang xian ran zai mou zhong cheng du shang huan bing le 。]

english: As the councillor responsible for public health and safety here in East Ardougne, I am in charge of dealing with this problem.
translation: 作为东阿杜涅负责公共卫生和安全的议员，我负责处理这个问题。 [zuo wei dong e du nie fu ze gong gong wei sheng he an quan de yi yuan ， wo fu ze chu li zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: We need someone to herd these sheep into a safe enclosure, kill them quickly and cleanly and then dispose of the remains hygienically in a special incinerator.
translation: 我们需要有人将这些羊赶到安全的围栏中，快速干净地杀死它们，然后将残骸卫生地处理在特殊的焚烧炉中。 [wo men xu yao you ren jiang zhe xie yang gan dao an quan de wei lan zhong ， kuai su gan jing di sha si ta men ， ran hou jiang can hai wei sheng di chu li zai te shu de fen shao lu zhong 。]

english: Unfortunately, nobody wants to risk catching the plague, and I am unable to find someone willing to undertake this mission for me.
translation: 不幸的是，没有人愿意冒感染瘟疫的风险，我也找不到愿意为我承担这个使命的人。 [bu xing de shi ， mei you ren yuan yi mao gan ran wen yi de feng xian ， wo ye zhao bu dao yuan yi wei wo cheng dan zhe ge shi ming de ren 。]

english: I can do that for you.
translation: 我可以为你做到这一点。 [wo ke yi wei ni zuo dao zhe yi dian 。]

english: You will? That is excellent news! Head to the enclosure we have set up on Farmer Brumty's land to the north of the city; the four infected sheep should still be somewhere in that vicinity.
translation: 你会？这是个好消息！前往我们在城市北部农民布鲁姆蒂土地上建立的围栏；那四只受感染的羊应该还在附近的某个地方。 [ni hui ？ zhe shi ge hao xiao xi ！ qian wang wo men zai cheng shi bei bu nong min bu lu mu di tu di shang jian li de wei lan ； na si zhi shou gan ran de yang ying gai hai zai fu jin de mou ge di fang 。]

english: Before you will be allowed to enter the enclosure, however, you must ensure you have some kind of protective clothing to prevent contagion.
translation: 然而，在您被允许进入围栏之前，您必须确保您拥有某种防护服以防止传染。 [ran er ， zai nin bei yun xu jin ru wei lan zhi qian ， nin bi xu que bao nin yong you mou zhong fang hu fu yi fang zhi chuan ran 。]

english: Where can I find some protective clothing then?
translation: 那么哪里可以找到防护服呢？ [na me na li ke yi zhao dao fang hu fu ne ？]

english: Doctor Orbon should have something suitable. You should be able to find him in the chapel just north of here.
translation: Orbon医生应该有合适的东西。你应该能在北面的教堂里找到他。 [Orbon yi sheng ying gai you he shi de dong xi 。 ni ying gai neng zai bei mian de jiao tang li zhao dao ta 。]

english: Please also take this poisoned sheep feed; we believe poisoning the sheep will minimise the risk of airborne contamination, and is of course also more humane to the sheep.
translation: 请把这有毒的羊饲料也吃下去；我们相信对羊下毒可以最大限度地减少空气传播污染的风险，当然对羊来说也更人道。 [qing ba zhe you du de yang si liao ye chi xia qu ； wo men xiang xin dui yang xia du ke yi zui da xian du di jian shao kong qi chuan bo wu ran de feng xian ， dang ran dui yang lai shuo ye geng ren dao 。]

english: The councillor gives you some poisoned sheep feed.
translation: 议员给你一些有毒的羊饲料。 [yi yuan gei ni yi xie you du de yang si liao 。]

english: How will I know which sheep are infected?
translation: 我怎么知道哪些羊被感染了？ [wo zen me zhi dao na xie yang bei gan ran le ？]

english: The poor creatures have developed strangely discoloured wool and flesh. You should have no trouble spotting them. There should be four in total.
translation: 这些可怜的生物已经长出了奇怪变色的羊毛和肉。你应该可以毫不费力地发现它们。总共应该有四个。 [zhe xie ke lian de sheng wu yi jing zhang chu le qi guai bian se de yang mao he rou 。 ni ying gai ke yi hao bu fei li di fa xian ta men 。 zong gong ying gai you si ge 。]

english: That's not a job for me.
translation: 那不是我的工作。 [na bu shi wo de gong zuo 。]

english: I do not blame you adventurer. It is not particularly pleasant work. My problem remains however. If you know of anyone suitable please send them this way; time is of the essence.
translation: 我不怪你冒险家。这并不是一件特别令人愉快的工作。然而我的问题仍然存在。如果您知道任何合适的人，请通过这种方式发送；时间至关重要。 [wo bu guai ni mao xian jia 。 zhe bing bu shi yi jian te bie ling ren yu kuai de gong zuo 。 ran er wo de wen ti reng ran cun zai 。 ru guo nin zhi dao ren he he shi de ren ， qing tong guo zhe zhong fang shi fa song ； shi jian zhi guan zhong yao 。]

english: That's life for you.
translation: 这就是你的生活。 [zhe jiu shi ni de sheng huo 。]

english: That's what concerns me... There might not be much life around here soon.
translation: 这就是我担心的……这里可能很快就会没有太多生命。 [zhe jiu shi wo dan xin de …… zhe li ke neng hen kuai jiu hui mei you tai duo sheng ming 。]

english: Hello again sir.
translation: 先生，您好。 [xian sheng ， nin hao 。]

english: Well hello again adventurer! How are you today?
translation: 好吧，冒险家你好！你今天怎么样？ [hao ba ， mao xian jia ni hao ！ ni jin tian zen me yang ？]

english: Fine thank you. And yourself?
translation: 好的，谢谢。而你自己呢？ [hao de ， xie xie 。 er ni zi ji ne ？]

english: I'm okay. Sadly some more diseased sheep have appeared so I have them to deal with.
translation: 我没事。可悲的是，出现了更多患病的羊，所以我要处理它们。 [wo mei shi 。 ke bei de shi ， chu xian le geng duo huan bing de yang ， suo yi wo yao chu li ta men 。]

english: Do you need me to help again?
translation: 还需要我帮忙吗？ [hai xu yao wo bang mang ma ？]

english: Thank you for the kind offer. You've done enough though. We'll find someone else to deal with these ones.
translation: 谢谢你的好意。不过你已经做得够多了。我们会找其他人来处理这些问题。 [xie xie ni de hao yi 。 bu guo ni yi jing zuo de gou duo le 。 wo men hui zhao qi ta ren lai chu li zhe xie wen ti 。]

english: Hello again.
translation: 又好。 [you hao 。]

english: Not too bad, I've a lot to do though. King Lathas left plenty of things for us to clean up.
translation: 还不错，不过我还有很多事情要做。拉萨斯国王留下了很多东西让我们清理。 [hai bu cuo ， bu guo wo hai you hen duo shi qing yao zuo 。 la sa si guo wang liu xia le hen duo dong xi rang wo men qing li 。]

english: What's wrong?
translation: 怎么了？ [zen me le ？]

english: I can do that for you.
translation: 我可以为你做到这一点。 [wo ke yi wei ni zuo dao zhe yi dian 。]

english: That's not a job for me.
translation: 那不是我的工作。 [na bu shi wo de gong zuo 。]

english: That's life for you.
translation: 这就是你的生活。 [zhe jiu shi ni de sheng huo 。]

english: Thank you for helping to repair the Doors of Dinh. Kourend is a safer place because of you.
translation: 感谢您帮助修复 Dinh 之门。因为有你，库伦德变得更加安全。 [gan xie nin bang zhu xiu fu  Dinh  zhi men 。 yin wei you ni ， ku lun de bian de geng jia an quan 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm Councillor Unkar, one of the members of the Kourend Council. We are responsible for running the entire Kingdom of Great Kourend.
translation: 我是 Unkar 议员，Kourend 议会的成员之一。我们负责管理整个大库伦德王国。 [wo shi  Unkar  yi yuan ，Kourend  yi hui de cheng yuan zhi yi 。 wo men fu ze guan li zheng ge da ku lun de wang guo 。]

english: What brings you to Lovakengj then?
translation: 那么是什么让您来到洛瓦肯杰呢？ [na me shi shen me rang nin lai dao luo wa ken jie ne ？]

english: It's important for the council to maintain a good relationship with the rulers of the five houses. Although it is the council that rules, we can only do so with their support.
translation: 对于议会来说，与五院的统治者保持良好的关系非常重要。虽然是理事会在统治，但我们只有在他们的支持下才能做到这一点。 [dui yu yi hui lai shuo ， yu wu yuan de tong zhi zhe bao chi liang hao de guan xi fei chang zhong yao 。 sui ran shi li shi hui zai tong zhi ， dan wo men zhi you zai ta men de zhi chi xia cai neng zuo dao zhe yi dian 。]

english: I'm here to help Lady Lovakengj out and to make sure she has everything she needs to rule effectively.
translation: 我来这里是为了帮助洛瓦肯吉夫人摆脱困境，并确保她拥有有效统治所需的一切。 [wo lai zhe li shi wei le bang zhu luo wa ken ji fu ren bai tuo kun jing ， bing que bao ta yong you you xiao tong zhi suo xu de yi qie 。]

english: What are the Doors of Dinh?
translation: 丁之门是什么？ [ding zhi men shi shen me ？]

english: They are a great set of doors built by the legendary smith, Dinh, in the early days of Kourend. They were created to imprison a deadly beast known as the Wintertodt.
translation: 它们是由传奇铁匠 Dinh 在 Kourend 早期建造的一套伟大的门。它们的创建是为了囚禁一种名为温特托的致命野兽。 [ta men shi you chuan qi tie jiang  Dinh  zai  Kourend  zao qi jian zao de yi tao wei da de men 。 ta men de chuang jian shi wei le qiu jin yi zhong ming wei wen te tuo de zhi ming ye shou 。]

english: Unfortunately, the doors were recently damaged, putting Kourend at risk. The master smith Undor, managed to repair them though, something he couldn't have done without you.
translation: 不幸的是，门最近被损坏，使库伦德面临危险。不过，铁匠大师安多成功地修复了它们，如果没有你，他就不可能做到这一点。 [bu xing de shi ， men zui jin bei sun huai ， shi ku lun de mian lin wei xian 。 bu guo ， tie jiang da shi an duo cheng gong di xiu fu le ta men ， ru guo mei you ni ， ta jiu bu ke neng zuo dao zhe yi dian 。]

english: I'll get going.
translation: 我要走了。 [wo yao zou le 。]

english: Human.
translation: 人类。 [ren lei 。]

english: How's the cell?
translation: 细胞怎么样？ [xi bao zen me yang ？]

english: A step down from what I'm used to.
translation: 与我习惯的情况相比，下降了一步。 [yu wo xi guan de qing kuang xiang bi ， xia jiang le yi bu 。]

english: Well you'd better get used to it. This is where you'll spend the rest of your life, however long that ends up being.
translation: 嗯，你最好习惯一下。你将在这里度过余生，无论余生会持续多久。 [n ， ni zui hao xi guan yi xia 。 ni jiang zai zhe li du guo yu sheng ， wu lun yu sheng hui chi xu duo jiu 。]

english: Oh, I'm all too aware of that. Here, I will fade into obscurity as the world forgets my actions. I've accepted it. Besides, it's for the best that I not be remembered.
translation: 哦，我太清楚这一点了。在这里，当世界忘记我的行为时，我将逐渐消失。我已经接受了。再说了，最好不要让别人记住我。 [o ， wo tai qing chu zhe yi dian le 。 zai zhe li ， dang shi jie wang ji wo de xing wei shi ， wo jiang zhu jian xiao shi 。 wo yi jing jie shou le 。 zai shuo le ， zui hao bu yao rang bie ren ji zhu wo 。]

english: I only hope that the work I did for my home endures. Everything I did was to ensure that Lovakengj prospered.
translation: 我只希望我为我的家所做的工作能够持续下去。我所做的一切都是为了确保洛瓦肯杰的繁荣。 [wo zhi xi wang wo wei wo de jia suo zuo de gong zuo neng gou chi xu xia qu 。 wo suo zuo de yi qie dou shi wei le que bao luo wa ken jie de fan rong 。]

english: I'm sure they'll be just fine. If anything, I imagine they're better off without you.
translation: 我相信他们会没事的。如果有的话，我想没有你他们会过得更好。 [wo xiang xin ta men hui mei shi de 。 ru guo you de hua ， wo xiang mei you ni ta men hui guo de geng hao 。]

english: Don't be so sure. I've no doubt the new king has good intent, but our intentions mean little compared to our actions.
translation: 别那么肯定。我毫不怀疑新国王的意图是好的，但与我们的行动相比，我们的意图毫无意义。 [bie na me ken ding 。 wo hao bu huai yi xin guo wang de yi tu shi hao de ， dan yu wo men de xing dong xiang bi ， wo men de yi tu hao wu yi yi 。]

english: Something you're all too aware of, I'm sure.
translation: 我确信你们都非常清楚这一点。 [wo que xin ni men dou fei chang qing chu zhe yi dian 。]

english: Indeed. But I guess only time will tell. Farewell human.
translation: 的确。但我想只有时间才能证明一切。再见人类。 [di que 。 dan wo xiang zhi you shi jian cai neng zheng ming yi qie 。 zai jian ren lei 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: What are the Doors of Dinh?
translation: 丁之门是什么？ [ding zhi men shi shen me ？]

english: I'll get going.
translation: 我要走了。 [wo yao zou le 。]

english: Ahahahaha! I am Count Check, the renowned security expert. Would you like me to check your account to see if it is secure?
translation: 啊哈哈哈哈！我是Count Check，著名的安全专家。您需要我检查一下您的帐户是否安全吗？ [a ha ha ha ha ！ wo shi Count Check， zhu ming de an quan zhuan jia 。 nin xu yao wo jian cha yi xia nin de zhang hu shi fou an quan ma ？]

english: Check my account, Count Check!
translation: 检查我的帐户，计数检查！ [jian cha wo de zhang hu ， ji shu jian cha ！]

english: You have a Jagex Account, and you have set a Bank PIN, so you pass my checks! As you've passed my check for the first time, I award you a prize.
translation: 您有 Jagex 帐户，并且设置了银行 PIN，所以您通过了我的支票！由于你是第一次通过我的检查，所以我奖励你一个奖品。 [nin you  Jagex  zhang hu ， bing qie she zhi le yin hang  PIN， suo yi nin tong guo le wo de zhi piao ！ you yu ni shi di yi ci tong guo wo de jian cha ， suo yi wo jiang li ni yi ge jiang pin 。]

english: You have a Jagex Account, and you have set a Bank PIN, so you pass my checks! As you've passed my check before, there's no prize now.
translation: 您有 Jagex 帐户，并且设置了银行 PIN，所以您通过了我的支票！因为你之前已经通过了我的检查，所以现在没有奖品了。 [nin you  Jagex  zhang hu ， bing qie she zhi le yin hang  PIN， suo yi nin tong guo le wo de zhi piao ！ yin wei ni zhi qian yi jing tong guo le wo de jian cha ， suo yi xian zai mei you jiang pin le 。]

english: You do not have a Jagex Account, so you fail my checks! You should upgrade before we meet again.
translation: 您没有 Jagex 帐户，因此您未通过我的检查！在我们再次见面之前你应该升级。 [nin mei you  Jagex  zhang hu ， yin ci nin wei tong guo wo de jian cha ！ zai wo men zai ci jian mian zhi qian ni ying gai sheng ji 。]

english: You do not have a Jagex Account, nor a Bank PIN, so so you fail my checks! Please upgrade before we meet again.
translation: 您没有 Jagex 帐户，也没有银行 PIN，所以您未通过我的检查！在我们再次见面之前，请升级。 [nin mei you  Jagex  zhang hu ， ye mei you yin hang  PIN， suo yi nin wei tong guo wo de jian cha ！ zai wo men zai ci jian mian zhi qian ， qing sheng ji 。]

english: Can you give me any advice?
translation: 你能给我什么建议吗？ [ni neng gei wo shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: I can! Count with the Count as I count the steps to securing your account:
translation: 我可以！当我计算保护您的帐户的步骤时，请与计数一起计算： [wo ke yi ！ dang wo ji suan bao hu nin de zhang hu de bu zhou shi ， qing yu ji shu yi qi ji suan ：]

english: ONE... unique password!
translation: 一个...唯一的密码！ [yi ge ... wei yi de mi ma ！]

english: Never use the same password for different accounts, or on different websites. If it got leaked, all of your accounts would become vulnerable at once!
translation: 切勿对不同帐户或不同网站使用相同的密码。如果它被泄露，您的所有帐户都会立即变得脆弱！ [qie wu dui bu tong zhang hu huo bu tong wang zhan shi yong xiang tong de mi ma 。 ru guo ta bei xie lou ， nin de suo you zhang hu du hui li ji bian de cui ruo ！]

english: TWO... step verification for your email account!
translation: 您的电子邮件帐户的两步验证！ [nin de dian zi you jian zhang hu de liang bu yan zheng ！]

english: Good email providers let you set up two-step verification, maybe by generating security codes on a second device, or by sending codes to your phone. Make sure you've enabled this.
translation: 好的电子邮件提供商可以让您设置两步验证，可以通过在第二台设备上生成安全代码或将代码发送到您的手机来实现。确保您已启用此功能。 [hao de dian zi you jian ti gong shang ke yi rang nin she zhi liang bu yan zheng ， ke yi tong guo zai di er tai she bei shang sheng cheng an quan dai ma huo jiang dai ma fa song dao nin de shou ji lai shi xian 。 que bao nin yi qi yong ci gong neng 。]

english: THREE... Um... Use a Jagex Account. I can see you already do this.
translation: 三...嗯...使用 Jagex 帐户。我可以看到你已经这样做了。 [san ... n ... shi yong  Jagex  zhang hu 。 wo ke yi kan dao ni yi jing zhe yang zuo le 。]

english: Carry on.
translation: 继续。 [ji xu 。]

english: What's that got to do with THREE?
translation: 和三有什么关系？ [he san you shen me guan xi ？]

english: Look, I'd got something for ONE, TWO and FOUR, and I like counting, okay? Don't interrupt my flow!
translation: 看，我有一、二和四的东西，我喜欢数数，好吗？别打扰我的流程！ [kan ， wo you yi 、 er he si de dong xi ， wo xi huan shu shu ， hao ma ？ bie da rao wo de liu cheng ！]

english: THREE... Um... Use a Jagex Account.
translation: 三...嗯...使用 Jagex 帐户。 [san ... n ... shi yong  Jagex  zhang hu 。]

english: Visit the RuneScape website and log in to update your Account settings.
translation: 访问 RuneScape 网站并登录以更新您的帐户设置。 [fang wen  RuneScape  wang zhan bing deng lu yi geng xin nin de zhang hu she zhi 。]

english: FOUR... digit Bank PIN! I can see you have set one.
translation: 四位数的银行密码！我可以看到你已经设置了一个。 [si wei shu de yin hang mi ma ！ wo ke yi kan dao ni yi jing she zhi le yi ge 。]

english: FOUR... digit Bank PIN!
translation: 四位数的银行密码！ [si wei shu de yin hang mi ma ！]

english: Next time you visit a bank, talk to a banker and ask to check your PIN settings.
translation: 下次您访问银行时，请与银行工作人员交谈并要求检查您的 PIN 设置。 [xia ci nin fang wen yin hang shi ， qing yu yin hang gong zuo ren yuan jiao tan bing yao qiu jian cha nin de  PIN  she zhi 。]

english: FOUR... digit Bank PIN! I can see you do not use banks, by the way.
translation: 四位数的银行密码！顺便说一下，我知道你不使用银行。 [si wei shu de yin hang mi ma ！ shun bian shuo yi xia ， wo zhi dao ni bu shi yong yin hang 。]

english: Muhahahahhaa! Such fun it is to count!
translation: 哈哈哈哈！数数真是太有趣了！ [ha ha ha ha ！ shu shu zhen shi tai you qu le ！]

english: Where can I learn more about security?
translation: 我在哪里可以了解有关安全的更多信息？ [wo zai na li ke yi liao jie you guan an quan de geng duo xin xi ？]

english: The Stronghold of Security, in Barbarian Village. I see you have not visited it. Would you like to? I can send you straight there - but only once.
translation: 安全据点，野蛮人村。我发现你还没有访问过它。你是否想要？我可以直接送你去那里——但只能送你一次。 [an quan ju dian ， ye man ren cun 。 wo fa xian ni hai mei you fang wen guo ta 。 ni shi fou xiang yao ？ wo ke yi zhi jie song ni qu na li —— dan zhi neng song ni yi ci 。]

english: So may I check your account for you?
translation: 那我可以帮您查一下您的帐户吗？ [na wo ke yi bang nin cha yi xia nin de zhang hu ma ？]

english: The Stronghold of Security, in Barbarian Village. There is much to learn there. But while you are here, may I check your account for you?
translation: 安全据点，野蛮人村。那里有很多东西值得学习。不过，当你在这里的时候，我可以帮你查一下你的账户吗？ [an quan ju dian ， ye man ren cun 。 na li you hen duo dong xi zhi de xue xi 。 bu guo ， dang ni zai zhe li de shi hou ， wo ke yi bang ni cha yi xia ni de zhang hu ma ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: As you may see, I am a vampyre, from Morytania. I left there when I heard the terrible news and now I choose to spend my days warning others of the perils that lay in wait for them.
translation: 如你所见，我是来自莫里塔尼亚的吸血鬼。当我听到这个可怕的消息时，我离开了那里，现在我选择花时间警告其他人等待他们的危险。 [ru ni suo jian ， wo shi lai zi mo li ta ni ya de xi xue gui 。 dang wo ting dao zhe ge ke pa de xiao xi shi ， wo li kai le na li ， xian zai wo xuan ze hua shi jian jing gao qi ta ren deng dai ta men de wei xian 。]

english: The perils?
translation: 危险是什么？ [wei xian shi shen me ？]

english: Yes, be warned! The travellers of these lands face danger from outside. Accounts can be stolen, and when that happens one can lose everything one has worked for.
translation: 是的，请注意！这些土地上的旅行者面临着来自外界的危险。帐户可能会被盗，当这种情况发生时，人们可能会失去自己为之奋斗的一切。 [shi de ， qing zhu yi ！ zhe xie tu di shang de lv xing zhe mian lin zhe lai zi wai jie de wei xian 。 zhang hu ke neng hui bei dao ， dang zhe zhong qing kuang fa sheng shi ， ren men ke neng hui shi qu zi ji wei zhi fen dou de yi qie 。]

english: I've left my vampyric ways behind me, and now I spend my days letting everyone know of this terrible danger.
translation: 我已经把吸血鬼的方式抛在了身后，现在我花了很多时间让每个人都知道这种可怕的危险。 [wo yi jing ba xi xue gui de fang shi pao zai le shen hou ， xian zai wo hua le hen duo shi jian rang mei ge ren dou zhi dao zhe zhong ke pa de wei xian 。]

english: In return for my dedication, I have been blessed with the ability to check if adventurers are ready to defend themselves against these account thieves.
translation: 作为我奉献精神的回报，我很幸运能够检查冒险者是否准备好抵御这些盗贼的攻击。 [zuo wei wo feng xian jing shen de hui bao ， wo hen xing yun neng gou jian cha mao xian zhe shi fou zhun bei hao di yu zhe xie dao zei de gong ji 。]

english: If you're a vampyre, how did you cross the Salve?
translation: 如果你是吸血鬼，你是如何穿越药膏的？ [ru guo ni shi xi xue gui ， ni shi ru he chuan yue yao gao de ？]

english: What do you mean? 'If' I am a vampyre? Of course I am a vampyre! See my pale complexion, my teeth, my outfit - how could anyone doubt I am a true vampyre?
translation: 你是什​​么意思？ “如果”我是吸血鬼？我当然是吸血鬼了！看看我苍白的肤色、我的牙齿、我的衣服——怎么会有人怀疑我是一个真正的吸血鬼呢？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？ “ ru guo ” wo shi xi xue gui ？ wo dang ran shi xi xue gui le ！ kan kan wo cang bai de fu se 、 wo de ya chi 、 wo de yi fu —— zen me hui you ren huai yi wo shi yi ge zhen zheng de xi xue gui ne ？]

english: I used to stalk the night drinking blood like vampyres do, and I am certainly not just a role-playing enthusiast in a costume! Never question that!
translation: 我曾经像吸血鬼一样在夜晚潜行喝血，我当然不仅仅是一个穿着戏服的角色扮演爱好者！永远不要质疑这一点！ [wo ceng jing xiang xi xue gui yi yang zai ye wan qian xing he xue ， wo dang ran bu jin jin shi yi ge chuan zhe xi fu de jue se ban yan ai hao zhe ！ yong yuan bu yao zhi yi zhe yi dian ！]

english: Right.
translation: 正确的。 [zheng que de 。]

english: I'll see you another time.
translation: 我们下次再见。 [wo men xia ci zai jian 。]

english: Ahahahaha! I, Count Check, have checked your account. You have a Jagex Account, and you have set a Bank PIN, so you pass my checks! Enjoy your prize.
translation: 啊哈哈哈哈！我，查查伯爵，已经查过你的账户了。您有 Jagex 帐户，并且设置了银行 PIN，所以您通过了我的支票！享受你的奖品吧。 [a ha ha ha ha ！ wo ， zha zha bo jue ， yi jing cha guo ni de zhang hu le 。 nin you  Jagex  zhang hu ， bing qie she zhi le yin hang  PIN， suo yi nin tong guo le wo de zhi piao ！ xiang shou ni de jiang pin ba 。]

english: Ahahahaha! I, Count Check, have checked your account. You do not have a Bank PIN, so you fail my checks! Talk to a banker to set a PIN before we meet again.
translation: 啊哈哈哈哈！我，查查伯爵，已经查过你的账户了。您没有银行密码，因此您未通过我的检查！在我们再次见面之前，请与银行工作人员联系以设置 PIN 码。 [a ha ha ha ha ！ wo ， zha zha bo jue ， yi jing cha guo ni de zhang hu le 。 nin mei you yin hang mi ma ， yin ci nin wei tong guo wo de jian cha ！ zai wo men zai ci jian mian zhi qian ， qing yu yin hang gong zuo ren yuan lian xi yi she zhi  PIN  ma 。]

english: Ahahahaha! I, Count Check, have checked your account. You do not have a Jagex Account, so you fail my checks! You should upgrade before we meet again.
translation: 啊哈哈哈哈！我，查查伯爵，已经查过你的账户了。您没有 Jagex 帐户，因此您未通过我的检查！在我们再次见面之前你应该升级。 [a ha ha ha ha ！ wo ， zha zha bo jue ， yi jing cha guo ni de zhang hu le 。 nin mei you  Jagex  zhang hu ， yin ci nin wei tong guo wo de jian cha ！ zai wo men zai ci jian mian zhi qian ni ying gai sheng ji 。]

english: To upgrade your account, visit the RuneScape Website and log in to update your Account settings.
translation: 要升级您的帐户，请访问 RuneScape 网站并登录以更新您的帐户设置。 [yao sheng ji nin de zhang hu ， qing fang wen  RuneScape  wang zhan bing deng lu yi geng xin nin de zhang hu she zhi 。]

english: Ahahahaha! I, Count Check, have checked your account. You do not have a Jagex Account, nor a Bank PIN, so soyou fail my checks! Please upgrade before we meet again.
translation: 啊哈哈哈哈！我，查查伯爵，已经查过你的账户了。您没有 Jagex 帐户，也没有银行 PIN，所以您没有通过我的检查！在我们再次见面之前，请升级。 [a ha ha ha ha ！ wo ， zha zha bo jue ， yi jing cha guo ni de zhang hu le 。 nin mei you  Jagex  zhang hu ， ye mei you yin hang  PIN， suo yi nin mei you tong guo wo de jian cha ！ zai wo men zai ci jian mian zhi qian ， qing sheng ji 。]

english: To set a Bank PIN, talk to a banker and ask to check your PIN settings.
translation: 要设置银行 PIN 码，请与银行工作人员联系并要求检查您的 PIN 码设置。 [yao she zhi yin hang  PIN  ma ， qing yu yin hang gong zuo ren yuan lian xi bing yao qiu jian cha nin de  PIN  ma she zhi 。]

english: I came to check [player name], not you.
translation: 我是来查看[玩家姓名]的，不是你。 [wo shi lai cha kan [ wan jia xing ming ] de ， bu shi ni 。]

english: Ahahahaha, [player name]!
translation: 啊哈哈哈哈，[玩家名字]！ [a ha ha ha ha ，[ wan jia ming zi ]！]

english: Please let me check you, [player name]!
translation: 请让我检查一下你，[玩家姓名]！ [qing rang wo jian cha yi xia ni ，[ wan jia xing ming ]！]

english: I have come to check you, [player name]...
translation: 我是来检查你的，[玩家名字]... [wo shi lai jian cha ni de ，[ wan jia ming zi ]...]

english: Dialogue 3
translation: 对话3 [dui hua 3]

english: Ahahahaha, ONE more person ignored me...
translation: 哈哈哈哈，又一个人不理我了…… [ha ha ha ha ， you yi ge ren bu li wo le ……]

english: Hello [player name] you look like you've seen a ghost.
translation: 你好[玩家名字]，你看起来就像见到了鬼一样。 [ni hao [ wan jia ming zi ]， ni kan qi lai jiu xiang jian dao le gui yi yang 。]

english: Well, not a ghost, but... well... you're a vampyre aren't you? Shouldn't you be in Morytania?
translation: 好吧，不是鬼魂，但是……好吧……你是吸血鬼，不是吗？你不是应该在莫里塔尼亚吗？ [hao ba ， bu shi gui hun ， dan shi …… hao ba …… ni shi xi xue gui ， bu shi ma ？ ni bu shi ying gai zai mo li ta ni ya ma ？]

english: Ah yes, I miss that place. So lovely and dark. I left there when I heard the terrible news and now I choose to spend the rest of my days warning others of the perils that lay in wait for them.
translation: 啊，是的，我想念那个地方。如此可爱又黑暗。当我听到这个可怕的消息时，我离开了那里，现在我选择用余下的时间警告其他人等待他们的危险。 [a ， shi de ， wo xiang nian na ge di fang 。 ru ci ke ai you hei an 。 dang wo ting dao zhe ge ke pa de xiao xi shi ， wo li kai le na li ， xian zai wo xuan ze yong yu xia de shi jian jing gao qi ta ren deng dai ta men de wei xian 。]

english: Terrible news? Peril? I don't like the sound of this. Is there something I should know?
translation: 可怕的消息？危险？我不喜欢这个声音。有什么我应该知道的吗？ [ke pa de xiao xi ？ wei xian ？ wo bu xi huan zhe ge sheng yin 。 you shen me wo ying gai zhi dao de ma ？]

english: Yes be warned! The travellers of these lands face danger from outside. Accounts that allow them access to this magical place can be stolen and when that happens they could lose everything they have worked so hard
translation: 是的，请注意！这些土地上的旅行者面临着来自外界的危险。允许他们访问这个神奇地方的帐户可能会被盗，当这种情况发生时，他们可能会失去他们辛辛苦苦工作的一切 [shi de ， qing zhu yi ！ zhe xie tu di shang de lv xing zhe mian lin zhe lai zi wai jie de wei xian 。 yun xu ta men fang wen zhe ge shen qi di fang de zhang hu ke neng hui bei dao ， dang zhe zhong qing kuang fa sheng shi ， ta men ke neng hui shi qu ta men xin xin ku ku gong zuo de yi qie]

english: for. I've left my Vampyre ways behind me and now spend my days letting everyone know of this terrible danger. In return for my dedication I have been blessed with a unique ability to be able to check if
translation: 为了。我已经把我的吸血鬼抛在了身后，现在花时间让每个人都知道这种可怕的危险。作为我奉献精神的回报，我有幸拥有一种独特的能力，能够检查是否 [wei le 。 wo yi jing ba wo de xi xue gui pao zai le shen hou ， xian zai hua shi jian rang mei ge ren dou zhi dao zhe zhong ke pa de wei xian 。 zuo wei wo feng xian jing shen de hui bao ， wo you xing yong you yi zhong du te de neng li ， neng gou jian cha shi fou]

english: adventurers who speak with me are ready to defend themselves against these account thieves.
translation: 与我交谈的冒险家们已经准备好抵御这些账户盗贼。 [yu wo jiao tan de mao xian jia men yi jing zhun bei hao di yu zhe xie zhang hu dao zei 。]

english: Can you check to see if my account is secure?
translation: 您可以检查一下我的帐户是否安全吗？ [nin ke yi jian cha yi xia wo de zhang hu shi fou an quan ma ？]

english: Ok let me check your account security, but before I do there are some things that even I can not see. Firstly you must have a unique password for your account and not share it with anyone else and secondly make
translation: 好吧，让我检查一下您的帐户安全性，但在检查之前，有些事情连我都看不到。首先，您的帐户必须有一个唯一的密码，并且不要与任何人共享；其次， [hao ba ， rang wo jian cha yi xia nin de zhang hu an quan xing ， dan zai jian cha zhi qian ， you xie shi qing lian wo dou kan bu dao 。 shou xian ， nin de zhang hu bi xu you yi ge wei yi de mi ma ， bing qie bu yao yu ren he ren gong xiang ； qi ci ，]

english: sure you have 2 step verification for your registered recovery email. I'll leave it with you to make sure both of those things are in place.
translation: 确保您注册的辅助邮箱有两步验证。我会把它留给你，以确保这两件事都就位。 [que bao nin zhu ce de fu zhu you xiang you liang bu yan zheng 。 wo hui ba ta liu gei ni ， yi que bao zhe liang jian shi dou jiu wei 。]

english: A unique password that I don't share, and 2 step verification on my email... got it.
translation: 我不分享的唯一密码，以及我的电子邮件的两步验证......明白了。 [wo bu fen xiang de wei yi mi ma ， yi ji wo de dian zi you jian de liang bu yan zheng ...... ming bai le 。]

english: Now let me take a look at some of your other security settings for you...
translation: 现在让我为您看一下您的其他一些安全设置...... [xian zai rang wo wei nin kan yi xia nin de qi ta yi xie an quan she zhi ......]

english: You are using the authenticator! Excellent. This will help to keep your account secure.
translation: 您正在使用身份验证器！出色的。这将有助于确保您的帐户安全。 [nin zheng zai shi yong shen fen yan zheng qi ！ chu se de 。 zhe jiang you zhu yu que bao nin de zhang hu an quan 。]

english: You aren't using the authenticator! This is a disaster. You should enable this to keep your account secure. Simply visit the support link on the oldschool.runescape.com website.
translation: 您没有使用身份验证器！这是一场灾难。您应该启用此功能以确保您的帐户安全。只需访问 oldschool.runescape.com 网站上的支持链接即可。 [nin mei you shi yong shen fen yan zheng qi ！ zhe shi yi chang zai nan 。 nin ying gai qi yong ci gong neng yi que bao nin de zhang hu an quan 。 zhi xu fang wen  oldschool.runescape.com  wang zhan shang de zhi chi lian jie ji ke 。]

english: You have a bank PIN. This is good, but make sure that it's one that can't be easily guessed.
translation: 您有银行 PIN 码。这很好，但要确保它不容易被猜到。 [nin you yin hang  PIN  ma 。 zhe hen hao ， dan yao que bao ta bu rong yi bei cai dao 。]

english: You really should set a bank PIN. If your account does get stolen, your items in the bank and other places like the GE will be safe.
translation: 您确实应该设置银行密码。如果您的帐户确实被盗，您在银行和其他地方（例如 GE）的物品将是安全的。 [nin que shi ying gai she zhi yin hang mi ma 。 ru guo nin de zhang hu que shi bei dao ， nin zai yin hang he qi ta di fang （ li ru  GE） de wu pin jiang shi an quan de 。]

english: Is there an easy way to remember all these account security things?
translation: 有没有一种简单的方法来记住所有这些帐户安全事项？ [you mei you yi zhong jian dan de fang fa lai ji zhu suo you zhe xie zhang hu an quan shi xiang ？]

english: Yes there is. by counting. I am a count, who likes to count and check accounts. You can ask me to check your account at any time you like and if you want to remember my top tips for account security just ask me
translation: 是的，有。通过计数。我是一名伯爵，喜欢清点和查账。您可以随时要求我检查您的帐户，如果您想记住我的帐户安全重要提示，请询问我 [shi de ， you 。 tong guo ji shu 。 wo shi yi ming bo jue ， xi huan qing dian he cha zhang 。 nin ke yi sui shi yao qiu wo jian cha nin de zhang hu ， ru guo nin xiang ji zhu wo de zhang hu an quan zhong yao ti shi ， qing xun wen wo]

english: to count for you. The count loves to count.
translation: 为你计数。伯爵喜欢数数。 [wei ni ji shu 。 bo jue xi huan shu shu 。]

english: Count with the count to easily remember my top account security tips:
translation: 用计数来轻松记住我的顶级帐户安全提示： [yong ji shu lai qing song ji zhu wo de ding ji zhang hu an quan ti shi ：]

english: One... unique password.
translation: 一个...唯一的密码。 [yi ge ... wei yi de mi ma 。]

english: Two... step email verification.
translation: 两步电子邮件验证。 [liang bu dian zi you jian yan zheng 。]

english: Free... authenticator.
translation: 免费...验证器。 [mian fei ... yan zheng qi 。]

english: Four... digit bank PIN!
translation: 四位数银行密码！ [si wei shu yin hang mi ma ！]

english: Muhahahahhaa!
translation: 哈哈哈哈！ [ha ha ha ha ！]

english: Is there somewhere I can learn more about account security?
translation: 我可以在哪里了解有关帐户安全的更多信息吗？ [wo ke yi zai na li liao jie you guan zhang hu an quan de geng duo xin xi ma ？]

english: Yes! The Stronghold of Security which can be accessed via Barbarian Village.
translation: 是的！可以通过野蛮人村庄进入安全要塞。 [shi de ！ ke yi tong guo ye man ren cun zhuang jin ru an quan yao sai 。]

english: Check my account, Count Check!
translation: 检查我的帐户，计数检查！ [jian cha wo de zhang hu ， ji shu jian cha ！]

english: Can you give me any advice?
translation: 你能给我什么建议吗？ [ni neng gei wo shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: Carry on.
translation: 继续。 [ji xu 。]

english: What's that got to do with THREE?
translation: 和三有什么关系？ [he san you shen me guan xi ？]

english: Where can I learn more about security?
translation: 我在哪里可以了解有关安全的更多信息？ [wo zai na li ke yi liao jie you guan an quan de geng duo xin xi ？]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: If you're a vampyre, how did you cross the Salve?
translation: 如果你是吸血鬼，你是如何穿越药膏的？ [ru guo ni shi xi xue gui ， ni shi ru he chuan yue yao gao de ？]

english: I'll see you another time.
translation: 我们下次再见。 [wo men xia ci zai jian 。]

english: Hello - who are you?
translation: 你好 - 你是谁？ [ni hao  -  ni shi shui ？]

english: Check my account.
translation: 检查我的帐户。 [jian cha wo de zhang hu 。]

english: Count for me.
translation: 给我算一下。 [gei wo suan yi xia 。]

english: Where can I learn more?
translation: 我可以在哪里了解更多信息？ [wo ke yi zai na li liao jie geng duo xin xi ？]

english: Ahahahaha! I, Count Check, have checked your account. You have set a Bank PIN, so you pass my checks! Enjoy your prize.
translation: 啊哈哈哈哈！我，查查伯爵，已经查过你的账户了。您已经设置了银行 PIN，所以您通过了我的支票！享受你的奖品吧。 [a ha ha ha ha ！ wo ， zha zha bo jue ， yi jing cha guo ni de zhang hu le 。 nin yi jing she zhi le yin hang  PIN， suo yi nin tong guo le wo de zhi piao ！ xiang shou ni de jiang pin ba 。]

english: Hmm, interesting, there appears to be a human trying to talk to me. Is it aware that cows can't talk I wonder? Maybe if I just ignore it, it might go away.
translation: 嗯，有趣，似乎有一个人试图与我交谈。我想知道，它是否知道牛不会说话？也许如果我忽略它，它可能就会消失。 [n ， you qu ， si hu you yi ge ren shi tu yu wo jiao tan 。 wo xiang zhi dao ， ta shi fou zhi dao niu bu hui shuo hua ？ ye xu ru guo wo hu lve ta ， ta ke neng jiu hui xiao shi 。]

english: The cow is studiously ignoring you.
translation: 牛故意无视你。 [niu gu yi wu shi ni 。]

english: Do you know what these strange marks mean?
translation: 你知道这些奇怪的标记意味着什么吗？ [ni zhi dao zhe xie qi guai de biao ji yi wei zhe shen me ma ？]

english: Can't the human take a hint? I've been ignoring you! Do you think I would ignore you if I wanted to discuss your Rorschach ink-blots ?
translation: 难道人类就不能接受暗示吗？我一直无视你！如果我想讨论你的罗夏墨迹，你认为我会忽略你吗？ [nan dao ren lei jiu bu neng jie shou an shi ma ？ wo yi zhi wu shi ni ！ ru guo wo xiang tao lun ni de luo xia mo ji ， ni ren wei wo hui hu lve ni ma ？]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: I'm in so much trouble, can you help?
translation: 我有这么大的麻烦，你能帮帮我吗？ [wo you zhe me da de ma fan ， ni neng bang bang wo ma ？]

english: What with?
translation: 与什么？ [yu shen me ？]

english: I was bad and opened my present early and now the cows tails are falling off!
translation: 我很坏，很早就打开了我的礼物，现在牛尾巴都掉了！ [wo hen huai ， hen zao jiu da kai le wo de li wu ， xian zai niu wei ba dou diao le ！]

english: I'm not quite sure how those two things are linked... but ok.
translation: 我不太确定这两件事是如何联系在一起的……但是好吧。 [wo bu tai que ding zhe liang jian shi shi ru he lian xi zai yi qi de …… dan shi hao ba 。]

english: Jack Frost saw me, and cursed me. Why else do you think my hair is green?? Oh please help! Find tails and put them back on the cows.
translation: 杰克·弗罗斯特看到了我，咒骂了我。你为什么认为我的头发是绿色的？哦，请帮忙！找到尾巴并将它们放回奶牛身上。 [jie ke · fu luo si te kan dao le wo ， zhou ma le wo 。 ni wei shen me ren wei wo de tou fa shi lv se de ？ o ， qing bang mang ！ zhao dao wei ba bing jiang ta men fang hui nai niu shen shang 。]

english: Where do I find the tails?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到尾巴？ [wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao wei ba ？]

english: They sometimes drop off if you kill them.
translation: 如果你杀死它们，它们有时会掉落。 [ru guo ni sha si ta men ， ta men you shi hui diao luo 。]

english: Um... ok! This is possibly the weirdest thing I've ever been asked to do... But why not?
translation: 嗯……好吧！这可能是我被要求做的最奇怪的事情......但为什么不呢？ [n …… hao ba ！ zhe ke neng shi wo bei yao qiu zuo de zui qi guai de shi qing ...... dan wei shen me bu ne ？]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello there! Are you interested in hearing all about crafting?
translation: 你好呀！您有兴趣了解有关手工的所有内容吗？ [ni hao ya ！ nin you xing qu liao jie you guan shou gong de suo you nei rong ma ？]

english: How can I train my crafting?
translation: 我该如何训练我的手艺？ [wo gai ru he xun lian wo de shou yi ？]

english: To get started, you might like to try your hand at crafting some armour from cow's leather. There's a tanner just over in Al Kharid who could tan any hides for you.
translation: 首先，您可能想尝试用牛皮制作一些盔甲。阿尔卡里德 (Al Kharid) 附近有一个制革商，可以为您鞣制任何皮革。 [shou xian ， nin ke neng xiang chang shi yong niu pi zhi zuo yi xie kui jia 。 a er ka li de  (Al Kharid)  fu jin you yi ge zhi ge shang ， ke yi wei nin rou zhi ren he pi ge 。]

english: Once you've managed to get your hand on some kind of leather, you just need a needle and some thread to get to work!
translation: 一旦你掌握了某种皮革，你只需要一根针和一些线就可以开始工作了！ [yi dan ni zhang wo le mou zhong pi ge ， ni zhi xu yao yi gen zhen he yi xie xian jiu ke yi kai shi gong zuo le ！]

english: If that doesn't take your fancy, you could try your hand at spinning wool right here on the spinning wheel.
translation: 如果您不喜欢，您可以尝试在纺车上纺羊毛。 [ru guo nin bu xi huan ， nin ke yi chang shi zai fang che shang fang yang mao 。]

english: Come to think of it... Farmer Fred, just north of here, sounds like he could use a hand shearing some of his sheep. Maybe you could help him out, and get some practice while you're at it.
translation: 想想看……农场主弗雷德就在这儿的北部，听起来他可以用手剪一些羊的毛。也许你可以帮助他，并在做的时候进行一些练习。 [xiang xiang kan …… nong chang zhu fu lei de jiu zai zhe er de bei bu ， ting qi lai ta ke yi yong shou jian yi xie yang de mao 。 ye xu ni ke yi bang zhu ta ， bing zai zuo de shi hou jin xing yi xie lian xi 。]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]
