english: Is there anything else you want to know?
translation: 您还有什么想知道的吗？ [nin hai you shen me xiang zhi dao de ma ？]

english: Lots of budding craftsmen seem to spend their time here spinning Flax into bow strings on the wheel, if that takes your fancy.
translation: 如果您喜欢的话，许多崭露头角的工匠似乎都会在这里将亚麻纺成轮子上的弓弦。 [ru guo nin xi huan de hua ， xu duo zhan lu tou jiao de gong jiang si hu du hui zai zhe li jiang ya ma fang cheng lun zi shang de gong xian 。]

english: Or you might like to try your hand at crafting some armour from cow's leather. There's a tanner just over in Al Kharid who could tan any hides for you.
translation: 或者您可能想尝试用牛皮制作一些盔甲。阿尔卡里德 (Al Kharid) 附近有一个制革商，可以为您鞣制任何皮革。 [huo zhe nin ke neng xiang chang shi yong niu pi zhi zuo yi xie kui jia 。 a er ka li de  (Al Kharid)  fu jin you yi ge zhi ge shang ， ke yi wei nin rou zhi ren he pi ge 。]

english: Now that you've got a little experience under your belt, the world's your oyster!
translation: 现在您已经积累了一些经验，一切尽在您的掌控之中！ [xian zai nin yi jing ji lei le yi xie jing yan ， yi qie jin zai nin de zhang kong zhi zhong ！]

english: I can't help but feel like I should be the one asking you! At this point, the world's your oyster!
translation: 我忍不住觉得我应该是问你的人！至此，世界尽在掌握！ [wo ren bu zhu jue de wo ying gai shi wen ni de ren ！ zhi ci ， shi jie jin zai zhang wo ！]

english: If you wanted to try your hand at making some jewellery, you'll want to get your hand on some gold and some kind of gem, with a mould to work with and a chisel at hand.
translation: 如果您想尝试制作一些珠宝，您需要准备一些黄金和某种宝石，并准备好模具和凿子。 [ru guo nin xiang chang shi zhi zuo yi xie zhu bao ， nin xu yao zhun bei yi xie huang jin he mou zhong bao shi ， bing zhun bei hao mu ju he zao zi 。]

english: But if that's not your thing, maybe you'd like to try making some more armour!
translation: 但如果这不是你的事，也许你想尝试制造更多的盔甲！ [dan ru guo zhe bu shi ni de shi ， ye xu ni xiang chang shi zhi zao geng duo de kui jia ！]

english: Cow's leather's a good place to start, but you can try all other kinds of hides, like a dragon's!
translation: 牛皮是一个不错的起点，但您可以尝试所有其他种类的皮革，例如龙皮！ [niu pi shi yi ge bu cuo de qi dian ， dan nin ke yi chang shi suo you qi ta zhong lei de pi ge ， li ru long pi ！]

english: Glass blowing seems to be a popular trade, too. You can forge molten glass from some sand and soda ash, then make all kinds of things using a glass blowing pipe.
translation: 玻璃吹制似乎也是一个受欢迎的行业。您可以用一些沙子和苏打灰锻造熔融玻璃，然后使用玻璃吹制管制造各种东西。 [bo li chui zhi si hu ye shi yi ge shou huan ying de hang ye 。 nin ke yi yong yi xie sha zi he su da hui duan zao rong rong bo li ， ran hou shi yong bo li chui zhi guan zhi zao ge zhong dong xi 。]

english: Is there anything else you want to know
translation: 还有什么你想知道的吗 [hai you shen me ni xiang zhi dao de ma]

english: What kinds of things can be crafted?
translation: 可以制作什么样的东西？ [ke yi zhi zuo shen me yang de dong xi ？]

english: All kinds of things, really! You can make armour from leather, make some pottery, try your hand at glass blowing, make some jewellery, weapons even...
translation: 各种各样的事情，真的！你可以用皮革制作盔甲，制作一些陶器，尝试吹制玻璃，甚至制作一些珠宝、武器...... [ge zhong ge yang de shi qing ， zhen de ！ ni ke yi yong pi ge zhi zuo kui jia ， zhi zuo yi xie tao qi ， chang shi chui zhi bo li ， shen zhi zhi zuo yi xie zhu bao 、 wu qi ......]

english: What would you like to hear about?
translation: 您想听什么？ [nin xiang ting shen me ？]

english: Tell me about crafting armour.
translation: 告诉我有关制作盔甲的事情。 [gao su wo you guan zhi zuo kui jia de shi qing 。]

english: Sure thing! Most armour you can craft just involves taking a needle and some thread to whatever material you can get your hands on.
translation: 当然可以！你可以制作的大多数盔甲只需要用一根针和一些线来处理你能找到的任何材料。 [dang ran ke yi ！ ni ke yi zhi zuo de da duo shu kui jia zhi xu yao yong yi gen zhen he yi xie xian lai chu li ni neng zhao dao de ren he cai liao 。]

english: You might like to try with different kinds of animal hide, from cows, yaks, snakes, dragons... Or any other sort of fabric you can find!
translation: 您可能想尝试不同种类的动物皮，例如牛皮、牦牛皮、蛇皮、龙皮……或您能找到的任何其他类型的织物！ [nin ke neng xiang chang shi bu tong zhong lei de dong wu pi ， li ru niu pi 、 mao niu pi 、 she pi 、 long pi …… huo nin neng zhao dao de ren he qi ta lei xing de zhi wu ！]

english: Some crafty types have started making some leather- covered wooden shields recently, too!
translation: 最近，一些狡猾的人也开始制作一些皮革覆盖的木盾！ [zui jin ， yi xie jiao hua de ren ye kai shi zhi zuo yi xie pi ge fu gai de mu dun ！]

english: You might find some creatures make for a pretty sturdy helmet, too. The best way to make something like that's just to take a good old chisel to it!
translation: 您可能会发现一些生物也可以制作出非常坚固的头盔。制作这样的东西的最好方法就是使用一把好的旧凿子！ [nin ke neng hui fa xian yi xie sheng wu ye ke yi zhi zuo chu fei chang jian gu de tou kui 。 zhi zuo zhe yang de dong xi de zui hao fang fa jiu shi shi yong yi ba hao de jiu zao zi ！]

english: That sounds great.
translation: 听起来很棒。 [ting qi lai hen bang 。]

english: Would you like to hear about anything else I mentioned?
translation: 您还想听听我提到的其他事情吗？ [nin hai xiang ting ting wo ti dao de qi ta shi qing ma ？]

english: Tell me about pottery.
translation: 给我讲讲陶艺吧 [gei wo jiang jiang tao yi ba]

english: Of course! Pottery's all kind of the same, it just takes a lot of getting used to.
translation: 当然！陶器都差不多，只是需要花很多时间去适应。 [dang ran ！ tao qi dou cha bu duo ， zhi shi xu yao hua hen duo shi jian qu shi ying 。]

english: All that there really is to it is getting your hands on some clay, getting it wet and getting to work on a potter's wheel.
translation: 真正要做的就是把你的手放在一些粘土上，把它弄湿，然后开始在陶轮上工作。 [zhen zheng yao zuo de jiu shi ba ni de shou fang zai yi xie nian tu shang ， ba ta nong shi ， ran hou kai shi zai tao lun shang gong zuo 。]

english: Once you've got the shape you want out of it, you want to put it in a pottery oven to fire it up.
translation: 一旦你得到了你想要的形状，你就想把它放进陶炉里烧起来。 [yi dan ni de dao le ni xiang yao de xing zhuang ， ni jiu xiang ba ta fang jin tao lu li shao qi lai 。]

english: The barbarians west of Varrock seem to be pretty keen on their pottery. I'd take a look around there, if you wanted to try it out!
translation: 瓦罗克以西的野蛮人似乎非常热衷于他们的陶器。如果你想尝试的话，我会去那里看看！ [wa luo ke yi xi de ye man ren si hu fei chang re zhong yu ta men de tao qi 。 ru guo ni xiang chang shi de hua ， wo hui qu na li kan kan ！]

english: Once you get the hang of it, you can make pots, pie dishes, bowls... You know.
translation: 一旦你掌握了窍门，你就可以制作锅、馅饼盘、碗……你知道的。 [yi dan ni zhang wo le qiao men ， ni jiu ke yi zhi zuo guo 、 xian bing pan 、 wan …… ni zhi dao de 。]

english: Neat!
translation: 整洁的！ [zheng jie de ！]

english: Tell me about glass blowing.
translation: 告诉我吹制玻璃的事。 [gao su wo chui zhi bo li de shi 。]

english: Glass blowing? Well, to get started you'll need to get yourself some molten glass. You can make some for yourself by heating sand and soda ash in a furnace.
translation: 玻璃吹制？好吧，首先你需要给自己准备一些熔融玻璃。您可以通过在熔炉中加热沙子和苏打灰来自己制作一些。 [bo li chui zhi ？ hao ba ， shou xian ni xu yao gei zi ji zhun bei yi xie rong rong bo li 。 nin ke yi tong guo zai rong lu zhong jia re sha zi he su da hui lai zi ji zhi zuo yi xie 。]

english: Once you've got a hold of that, you'll want a glass blowing pipe to blow it out in to shape, before it cools down.
translation: 一旦你掌握了它，你就会需要一根玻璃吹制管在它冷却之前将其吹塑成形。 [yi dan ni zhang wo le ta ， ni jiu hui xu yao yi gen bo li chui zhi guan zai ta leng que zhi qian jiang qi chui su cheng xing 。]

english: It's not the easiest thing to get to grips with, but it shouldn't be too difficult!
translation: 这不是最容易掌握的事情，但也不应该太难！ [zhe bu shi zui rong yi zhang wo de shi qing ， dan ye bu ying gai tai nan ！]

english: Nifty.
translation: 漂亮。 [piao liang 。]

english: Tell me about making jewellery.
translation: 跟我讲讲珠宝制作吧。 [gen wo jiang jiang zhu bao zhi zuo ba 。]

english: Sure. All it boils down to is a bar of gold or silver, some kind of cut gem if you're feeling fancy, and a mould to help shape the thing.
translation: 当然。归根结底，就是一块金条或银条，某种切割宝石（如果你喜欢的话），以及一个帮助塑造物体的模具。 [dang ran 。 gui gen jie di ， jiu shi yi kuai jin tiao huo yin tiao ， mou zhong qie ge bao shi （ ru guo ni xi huan de hua ）， yi ji yi ge bang zhu su zao wu ti de mu ju 。]

english: You can use a chisel to make a gem really shine and sparkle. You wouldn't want to use an uncut one for any jewellery.
translation: 您可以使用凿子使宝石真正闪闪发光。您不会想将未切割的珠宝用于任何珠宝。 [nin ke yi shi yong zao zi shi bao shi zhen zheng shan shan fa guang 。 nin bu hui xiang jiang wei qie ge de zhu bao yong yu ren he zhu bao 。]

english: Once you've got all of your materials together, you'll want to use a furnace to actually craft whatever it is you're trying to make!
translation: 一旦你将所有材料放在一起，你就会想要使用熔炉来实际制作你想要制作的任何东西！ [yi dan ni jiang suo you cai liao fang zai yi qi ， ni jiu hui xiang yao shi yong rong lu lai shi ji zhi zuo ni xiang yao zhi zuo de ren he dong xi ！]

english: Wizards seem to like enchanting their jewellery to do all kinds of things, too, but I don't know a lot about that.
translation: 巫师们似乎也喜欢给他们的珠宝附魔来做各种各样的事情，但我对此了解不多。 [wu shi men si hu ye xi huan gei ta men de zhu bao fu mo lai zuo ge zhong ge yang de shi qing ， dan wo dui ci liao jie bu duo 。]

english: Sounds good!
translation: 听起来不错！ [ting qi lai bu cuo ！]

english: Tell me about crafting weapons.
translation: 告诉我有关制作武器的事情。 [gao su wo you guan zhi zuo wu qi de shi qing 。]

english: Well, there aren't too many weapons that people tend to craft, but there are a couple worth noting!
translation: 好吧，人们倾向于制作的武器并不多，但有一些值得注意！ [hao ba ， ren men qing xiang yu zhi zuo de wu qi bing bu duo ， dan you yi xie zhi de zhu yi ！]

english: Battlestaves are probably the most common. It boils down to fastening an orb of some kind onto the end of a battlestaff.
translation: 战杖可能是最常见的。归根结底就是将某种球体固定在战杖的末端。 [zhan zhang ke neng shi zui chang jian de 。 gui gen jie di jiu shi jiang mou zhong qiu ti gu ding zai zhan zhang de mo duan 。]

english: You do need to get the orb in the first place, though... You can make one through glass blowing, but it's not much use without being charged.
translation: 不过，你确实需要首先获得球体……你可以通过玻璃吹制来制作球体，但如果不充电的话，它没有多大用处。 [bu guo ， ni que shi xu yao shou xian huo de qiu ti …… ni ke yi tong guo bo li chui zhi lai zhi zuo qiu ti ， dan ru guo bu chong dian de hua ， ta mei you duo da yong chu 。]

english: I can't help much with crafting it, though! There's a little more magic involved there than I'm familiar with.
translation: 不过，我在制作它方面帮不了什么忙！其中涉及的魔法比我熟悉的要多一些。 [bu guo ， wo zai zhi zuo ta fang mian bang bu liao shen me mang ！ qi zhong she ji de mo fa bi wo shu xi de yao duo yi xie 。]

english: Aside from battlestaves, there are a couple of weapons that people like to make from silver... Sickles and bolts, usually.
translation: 除了战杖之外，人们还喜欢用银制作一些武器……通常是镰刀和弩箭。 [chu le zhan zhang zhi wai ， ren men hai xi huan yong yin zhi zuo yi xie wu qi …… tong chang shi lian dao he nu jian 。]

english: Interesting...
translation: 有趣的... [you qu de ...]

english: Not right now.
translation: 现在不行。 [xian zai bu xing 。]

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Well, just come back any time you want to know anything!
translation: 好吧，你想知道什么就随时回来吧！ [hao ba ， ni xiang zhi dao shen me jiu sui shi hui lai ba ！]

english: How can I train my crafting?
translation: 我该如何训练我的手艺？ [wo gai ru he xun lian wo de shou yi ？]

english: What kinds of things can be crafted?
translation: 可以制作什么样的东西？ [ke yi zhi zuo shen me yang de dong xi ？]

english: Tell me about crafting armour.
translation: 告诉我有关制作盔甲的事情。 [gao su wo you guan zhi zuo kui jia de shi qing 。]

english: Tell me about pottery.
translation: 给我讲讲陶艺吧 [gei wo jiang jiang tao yi ba]

english: Tell me about glass blowing.
translation: 告诉我吹制玻璃的事。 [gao su wo chui zhi bo li de shi 。]

english: Tell me about making jewellery.
translation: 跟我讲讲珠宝制作吧。 [gen wo jiang jiang zhu bao zhi zuo ba 。]

english: Tell me about crafting weapons.
translation: 告诉我有关制作武器的事情。 [gao su wo you guan zhi zuo wu qi de shi qing 。]

english: Not right now.
translation: 现在不行。 [xian zai bu xing 。]

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Excuse me, I need to deliver this.
translation: 对不起，我需要送这个。 [dui bu qi ， wo xu yao song zhe ge 。]

english: Hey, a crawling hand!
translation: 嘿，一只爬行的手！ [hei ， yi zhi pa xing de shou ！]

english: Yes, what?
translation: 是的，什么？ [shi de ， shen me ？]

english: [House owner] must be pretty handy to have slayed that!
translation: [房主]一定很得手才能杀死它！ [[ fang zhu ] yi ding hen de shou cai neng sha si ta ！]

english: Hey, I was going to make some furniture, do you think you could lend a HAND?
translation: 嘿，我想做一些家具，你认为你可以帮忙吗？ [hei ， wo xiang zuo yi xie jia ju ， ni ren wei ni ke yi bang mang ma ？]

english: Very funny.
translation: 很搞笑。 [hen gao xiao 。]

english: Hey, hand, do you want to know how I slayed you?
translation: 嘿，手，你想知道我是怎么杀你的吗？ [hei ， shou ， ni xiang zhi dao wo shi zen me sha ni de ma ？]

english: I don't know, how?
translation: 我不知道，怎么样？ [wo bu zhi dao ， zen me yang ？]

english: Because you're just a hand! You're ARMLESS!
translation: 因为你只是一只手！你没有手臂！ [yin wei ni zhi shi yi zhi shou ！ ni mei you shou bi ！]

english: Hey, you're just a hand, right? So what do you eat?
translation: 嘿，你只是一只手，对吧？那你吃什么？ [hei ， ni zhi shi yi zhi shou ， dui ba ？ na ni chi shen me ？]

english: Finger food, of course!
translation: 当然是手指食物！ [dang ran shi shou zhi shi wu ！]

english: Rain of knowledge!
translation: 知识雨！ [zhi shi yu ！]

english: Ow!
You belong in a museum!
translation: 你属于博物馆！ [ni shu yu bo wu guan ！]

english: I'm Bellock - respect me!
translation: 我是贝洛克——尊重我！ [wo shi bei luo ke —— zun zhong wo ！]

english: Get off my site!
translation: 离开我的网站！ [li kai wo de wang zhan ！]

english: These ruins are mine!
translation: 这些废墟是我的！ [zhe xie fei xu shi wo de ！]

english: Taste my knowledge!
translation: 尝尝我的知识吧！ [chang chang wo de zhi shi ba ！]

english: No-one messes with Bellock's dig!
translation: 没有人会扰乱贝洛克的挖掘！ [mei you ren hui rao luan bei luo ke de wa jue ！]

english: Where did you get that lens?
translation: 你从哪里得到那个镜头？ [ni cong na li de dao na ge jing tou ？]

english: From that strange metal thing up on the hill.
translation: 从山上那个奇怪的金属东西那里。 [cong shan shang na ge qi guai de jin shu dong xi na li 。]

english: You should give that back!
translation: 你应该把它还给我！ [ni ying gai ba ta huan gei wo ！]

english: Even if it's cracked?
translation: 就算裂了？ [jiu suan lie le ？]

english: Ah, well, I suppose it's of no use. But, still.
translation: 啊，好吧，我想这没什么用。但是，仍然。 [a ， hao ba ， wo xiang zhe mei shen me yong 。 dan shi ， reng ran 。]

english: Was that a spark?
translation: 那是火花吗？ [na shi huo hua ma ？]

english: Come on! Please light!
translation: 快点！请点亮！ [kuai dian ！ qing dian liang ！]

english: Hello there. Have you come to reflect?
translation: 你好呀。你来反省了吗？ [ni hao ya 。 ni lai fan xing le ma ？]

english: I'm not sure.
translation: 我不知道。 [wo bu zhi dao 。]

english: It's not for everyone. You are always welcome to pray to Seren here if you wish though. If you prefer, I can offer you the ability to respawn in Prifddinas upon death.
translation: 它并不适合所有人。如果您愿意，我们随时欢迎您在这里向塞伦祈祷。如果您愿意，我可以为您提供死亡后在普里夫迪纳斯重生的能力。 [ta bing bu shi he suo you ren 。 ru guo nin yuan yi ， wo men sui shi huan ying nin zai zhe li xiang sai lun qi dao 。 ru guo nin yuan yi ， wo ke yi wei nin ti gong si wang hou zai pu li fu di na si chong sheng de neng li 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Then it shall be so. From now on, you will respawn in Prifddinas.
translation: 那就这样吧。从现在开始，你将在普里夫迪纳斯重生。 [na jiu zhe yang ba 。 cong xian zai kai shi ， ni jiang zai pu li fu di na si chong sheng 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: As you wish. I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 如你所愿。如果你改变主意我会在这里。 [ru ni suo yuan 。 ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi wo hui zai zhe li 。]

english: It's not for everyone. You are always welcome to pray to Seren here if you wish though. If you prefer, I can revert your respawn point to Lumbridge.
translation: 它并不适合所有人。如果您愿意，我们随时欢迎您在这里向塞伦祈祷。如果您愿意，我可以将您的重生点恢复到朗布里奇。 [ta bing bu shi he suo you ren 。 ru guo nin yuan yi ， wo men sui shi huan ying nin zai zhe li xiang sai lun qi dao 。 ru guo nin yuan yi ， wo ke yi jiang nin de chong sheng dian hui fu dao lang bu li qi 。]

english: Then it shall be so. From now on, you will respawn in Lumbridge.
translation: 那就这样吧。从现在开始，你将在伦布里奇重生。 [na jiu zhe yang ba 。 cong xian zai kai shi ， ni jiang zai lun bu li qi chong sheng 。]

english: As you wish. If you ever tire of respawning in Prifddinas, just let me know.
translation: 如你所愿。如果您厌倦了在普里夫迪纳斯重生，请告诉我。 [ru ni suo yuan 。 ru guo nin yan juan le zai pu li fu di na si chong sheng ， qing gao su wo 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好呀！ [ni hao ya ！]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm the crew registrar. Here to cut through the red tape of crew management for anyone who needs it!
translation: 我是船员登记员。在这里为有需要的人简化船员管理的繁文缛节！ [wo shi chuan yuan deng ji yuan 。 zai zhe li wei you xu yao de ren jian hua chuan yuan guan li de fan wen ru jie ！]

english: A lot of paperwork in managing a crew is there?
translation: 管理船员的文书工作很多吗？ [guan li chuan yuan de wen shu gong zuo hen duo ma ？]

english: You'd be surprised. Quality assurance guideline QA-275 states all crew must be appropriately fit and healthy after being subjected to QA form QA-275.
translation: 你会感到惊讶的。质量保证指南 QA-275 规定，所有船员在接受 QA 表格 QA-275 后必须保持适当的健康状况。 [ni hui gan dao jing ya de 。 zhi liang bao zheng zhi nan  QA-275  gui ding ， suo you chuan yuan zai jie shou  QA  biao ge  QA-275  hou bi xu bao chi shi dang de jian kang zhuang kuang 。]

english: QA-123 requires all crew to pass a mandatory cargo data protection course if the ship can be fitted with a cargo hold.
translation: 如果船舶可以安装货舱，QA-123 要求所有船员通过强制性货物数据保护课程。 [ru guo chuan bo ke yi an zhuang huo cang ，QA-123  yao qiu suo you chuan yuan tong guo qiang zhi xing huo wu shu ju bao hu ke cheng 。]

english: Then of course we have QA-441, which defines the background checks that any crewmate operating a sail must pass. And all that's without even considering QA- 215...
translation: 当然，我们还有 QA-441，它定义了任何操作帆的船员都必须通过的背景调查。而这一切甚至都没有考虑 QA-215... [dang ran ， wo men hai you  QA-441， ta ding yi le ren he cao zuo fan de chuan yuan dou bi xu tong guo de bei jing diao cha 。 er zhe yi qie shen zhi dou mei you kao lv  QA-215...]

english: I'm not sure I want to manage a crew now...
translation: 我不确定我现在想管理一个团队...... [wo bu que ding wo xian zai xiang guan li yi ge tuan dui ......]

english: Don't worry, I'll deal with most of the technical details for you.
translation: 别担心，我会为您处理大部分技术细节。 [bie dan xin ， wo hui wei nin chu li da bu fen ji shu xi jie 。]

english: And if I miss something, the fines are usually fairly small!
translation: 如果我错过了什么，罚款通常相当小！ [ru guo wo cuo guo le shen me ， fa kuan tong chang xiang dang xiao ！]

english: Can I manage my crew?
translation: 我可以管理我的船员吗？ [wo ke yi guan li wo de chuan yuan ma ？]

english: I'm afraid you have no crew to manage right now.
translation: 恐怕你现在没有需要管理的人员。 [kong pa ni xian zai mei you xu yao guan li de ren yuan 。]

english: Crew are not available in the alpha, but expect to see more of them in the future!
translation: 阿尔法版中没有船员，但预计将来会看到更多船员！ [a er fa ban zhong mei you chuan yuan ， dan yu ji jiang lai hui kan dao geng duo chuan yuan ！]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: See ya!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: That all sounds a bit much!
translation: 这一切听起来有点多了！ [zhe yi qie ting qi lai you dian duo le ！]

english: Well, it's not for everyone. Still, if you ever find yourself in need of a crew, you know where to find me.
translation: 嗯，它并不适合所有人。不过，如果您发现自己需要团队，您知道在哪里可以找到我。 [n ， ta bing bu shi he suo you ren 。 bu guo ， ru guo nin fa xian zi ji xu yao tuan dui ， nin zhi dao zai na li ke yi zhao dao wo 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Can I manage my crew?
translation: 我可以管理我的船员吗？ [wo ke yi guan li wo de chuan yuan ma ？]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: What are you drinking?
translation: 你喝什么？ [ni he shen me ？]

english: Blood!
translation: 血！ [xue ！]

english: How are you getting drunk on blood?
translation: 怎么会喝醉了血呢？ [zen me hui he zui le xue ne ？]

english: They keep some of the tithes drunk all the time and then take it from them.
translation: 他们把一些十分之一的钱一直喝在酒里，然后从他们那里拿走。 [ta men ba yi xie shi fen zhi yi de qian yi zhi he zai jiu li ， ran hou cong ta men na li na zou 。]

english: How very creative.
translation: 多么有创意啊。 [duo me you chuang yi a 。]

english: I know right! Bloody brilliant!
translation: 我知道，对吧！太棒了！ [wo zhi dao ， dui ba ！ tai bang le ！]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: I'll have a pint please.
translation: 请给我一品脱。 [qing gei wo yi pin tuo 。]

english: I don't work here.
translation: 我不在这里工作。 [wo bu zai zhe li gong zuo 。]

english: Sure you do!
translation: 当然可以！ [dang ran ke yi ！]

english: No, I really don't.
translation: 不，我真的不知道。 [bu ， wo zhen de bu zhi dao 。]

english: Well clear off then.
translation: 那么就清除吧。 [na me jiu qing chu ba 。]

english: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 人类！在我叫守卫之前回到奴隶围栏！ [ren lei ！ zai wo jiao shou wei zhi qian hui dao nu li wei lan ！]

english: Amascut's hold on me is finally at an end. Human, let us return to the Nexus.
translation: 阿马斯卡特对我的控制终于结束了。人类，让我们回到枢纽吧。 [a ma si ka te dui wo de kong zhi zhong yu jie shu le 。 ren lei ， rang wo men hui dao shu niu ba 。]

english: Human.
translation: 人类。 [ren lei 。]

english: Not feeling talkative?
translation: 感觉不爱说话？ [gan jue bu ai shuo hua ？]

english: I'm sure you will find a conversation with me more appealing than one with Scabaras. Still, I leave most of the talking to Apmeken.
translation: 我相信你会发现与我的谈话比与斯卡巴拉斯的谈话更有吸引力。尽管如此，我还是把大部分的谈话留给了阿普梅肯。 [wo xiang xin ni hui fa xian yu wo de tan hua bi yu si ka ba la si de tan hua geng you xi yin li 。 jin guan ru ci ， wo hai shi ba da bu fen de tan hua liu gei le a pu mei ken 。]

english: Now, I can't support you in your fight, but if you can free the others, we'll be able to open the way to Amascut.
translation: 现在，我无法支持你的战斗，但如果你能释放其他人，我们就能打开通往阿马斯卡特的道路。 [xian zai ， wo wu fa zhi chi ni de zhan dou ， dan ru guo ni neng shi fang qi ta ren ， wo men jiu neng da kai tong wang a ma si ka te de dao lu 。]

english: Human, we've opened the way to Amascut, but we can do no more. From here, it's up to you.
translation: 人类，我们已经打开了通往阿马斯卡特的道路，但我们无能为力了。从这里开始，一切由你决定。 [ren lei ， wo men yi jing da kai le tong wang a ma si ka te de dao lu ， dan wo men wu neng wei li le 。 cong zhe li kai shi ， yi qie you ni jue ding 。]

english: Here he is!
translation: 他在这里！ [ta zai zhe li ！]

english: My friend, you managed what few have ever achieved. You overcame Amascut herself! I wish I could have been there to see it!
translation: 我的朋友，你取得了很少有人能取得的成就。你战胜了阿马斯库特本人！我希望我能去那里看到它！ [wo de peng you ， ni qu de le hen shao you ren neng qu de de cheng jiu 。 ni zhan sheng le a ma si ku te ben ren ！ wo xi wang wo neng qu na li kan dao ta ！]

english: Well I couldn't have done it alone. Speaking of which, where's Scabaras?
translation: 好吧，我一个人是做不到的。说到这里，斯卡巴拉斯在哪里？ [hao ba ， wo yi ge ren shi zuo bu dao de 。 shuo dao zhe li ， si ka ba la si zai na li ？]

english: Scabaras walks his own path. Do not consider his absence an insult. This is his way.
translation: 斯卡拉斯走自己的路。不要认为他的缺席是一种侮辱。这是他的方式。 [si ka la si zou zi ji de lu 。 bu yao ren wei ta de que xi shi yi zhong wu ru 。 zhe shi ta de fang shi 。]

english: Not to mention that he was under Amascut's control far longer than the rest of us. It will take him time to come to terms with his role in her plots.
translation: 更不用说他受阿马斯卡特控制的时间比我们其他人要长得多。他需要一段时间才能接受自己在她的情节中所扮演的角色。 [geng bu yong shuo ta shou a ma si ka te kong zhi de shi jian bi wo men qi ta ren yao zhang de duo 。 ta xu yao yi duan shi jian cai neng jie shou zi ji zai ta de qing jie zhong suo ban yan de jue se 。]

english: Don't worry, he'll be okay. He always is.
translation: 别担心，他会没事的。他总是这样。 [bie dan xin ， ta hui mei shi de 。 ta zong shi zhe yang 。]

english: Before we go any further... We didn't have much time for conversation back in the tomb. I'm sure you have some questions for us.
translation: 在我们继续之前……我们在坟墓里没有太多时间交谈。我确信您有一些问题想问我们。 [zai wo men ji xu zhi qian …… wo men zai fen mu li mei you tai duo shi jian jiao tan 。 wo que xin nin you yi xie wen ti xiang wen wo men 。]

english: If you do, now is the time to ask them.
translation: 如果您这样做，现在是时候询问他们了。 [ru guo nin zhe yang zuo ， xian zai shi shi hou xun wen ta men le 。]

english: I have a question for Apmeken.
translation: 我有一个问题要问阿普梅肯。 [wo you yi ge wen ti yao wen a pu mei ken 。]

english: What's your role in the Menaphite Pantheon?
translation: 你在梅纳菲特万神殿中的角色是什么？ [ni zai mei na fei te wan shen dian zhong de jue se shi shen me ？]

english: I'm Tumeken's avatar of companionship! Tumeken himself was always considered a bit cold, which is a tad ironic when you think about it.
translation: 我是图梅肯的陪伴化身！图梅肯本人一直被认为有点冷漠，想想就有点讽刺。 [wo shi tu mei ken de pei ban hua shen ！ tu mei ken ben ren yi zhi bei ren wei you dian leng mo ， xiang xiang jiu you dian feng ci 。]

english: A cold sun god?
translation: 寒冷的太阳神？ [han leng de tai yang shen ？]

english: Exactly! Bit odd, right? Still, although he wasn't exactly known for his social side, he still understood the importance of such things. That's why he made me!
translation: 确切地！有点奇怪，对吧？尽管如此，尽管他并不以其社交方面而闻名，但他仍然了解这些事情的重要性。这就是他创造我的原因！ [que qie di ！ you dian qi guai ， dui ba ？ jin guan ru ci ， jin guan ta bing bu yi qi she jiao fang mian er wen ming ， dan ta reng ran liao jie zhe xie shi qing de zhong yao xing 。 zhe jiu shi ta chuang zao wo de yuan yin ！]

english: My job is to make sure everyone remembers the importance of friendship. After all, we all need a friend or two, or ten, or maybe hundreds! Have as many as you want! I won't judge.
translation: 我的工作是确保每个人都记住友谊的重要性。毕竟，我们都需要一两个、十个、甚至数百个朋友！你想要多少就拥有多少！我不会评判。 [wo de gong zuo shi que bao mei ge ren dou ji zhu you yi de zhong yao xing 。 bi jing ， wo men dou xu yao yi liang ge 、 shi ge 、 shen zhi shu bai ge peng you ！ ni xiang yao duo shao jiu yong you duo shao ！ wo bu hui ping pan 。]

english: Why aren't there more monkeys or apes in the desert?
translation: 为什么沙漠里没有更多的猴子或猿类？ [wei shen me sha mo li mei you geng duo de hou zi huo yuan lei ？]

english: Ah, you can thank Amascut for that. The desert used to be home to thousands of apes and monkeys, but she targeted them to try and get to me.
translation: 啊，你可以为此感谢阿马斯卡特。沙漠曾经是数千只猿类和猴子的家园，但她却以它们为目标，试图接近我。 [a ， ni ke yi wei ci gan xie a ma si ka te 。 sha mo ceng jing shi shu qian zhi yuan lei he hou zi de jia yuan ， dan ta que yi ta men wei mu biao ， shi tu jie jin wo 。]

english: I'm sorry.
translation: 对不起。 [dui bu qi 。]

english: Don't be! Now that I'm back, I know we can turn things around!
translation: 别这样！现在我回来了，我知道我们可以扭转局面！ [bie zhe yang ！ xian zai wo hui lai le ， wo zhi dao wo men ke yi niu zhuan ju mian ！]

english: Actually, I've changed my mind.
translation: 事实上，我已经改变主意了。 [shi shi shang ， wo yi jing gai bian zhu yi le 。]

english: Fair enough.
translation: 很公平。 [hen gong ping 。]

english: I'll be back soon.
translation: 我很快就会回来。 [wo hen kuai jiu hui hui lai 。]

english: We'll be here when you're ready.
translation: 当您准备好时我们会在这里。 [dang nin zhun bei hao shi wo men hui zai zhe li 。]

english: I have a question for Crondis.
translation: 我有一个问题要问克朗迪斯。 [wo you yi ge wen ti yao wen ke lang di si 。]

english: I am Tumeken's avatar of resourcefulness.
translation: 我是图梅肯足智多谋的化身。 [wo shi tu mei ken zu zhi duo mou de hua shen 。]

english: Meaning?
translation: 意义？ [yi yi ？]

english: Meaning my job is to guide the people of the desert not to live lives of excess.
translation: 这意味着我的工作是引导沙漠人民不要过着奢侈的生活。 [zhe yi wei zhe wo de gong zuo shi yin dao sha mo ren min bu yao guo zhe she chi de sheng huo 。]

english: Guessing you're not a fan of Menaphos then?
translation: 猜猜你不是梅纳福斯的粉丝？ [cai cai ni bu shi mei na fu si de fen si ？]

english: Much of the desert has forgotten the importance of modesty in my absence, but the situation in Menaphos is definitely the most concerning. Let us hope it can soon be rectified.
translation: 在我不在的情况下，沙漠中的大部分人都忘记了谦虚的重要性，但米纳福斯的情况绝对是最令人担忧的。让我们希望它能够尽快得到纠正。 [zai wo bu zai de qing kuang xia ， sha mo zhong de da bu fen ren dou wang ji le qian xu de zhong yao xing ， dan mi na fu si de qing kuang jue dui shi zui ling ren dan you de 。 rang wo men xi wang ta neng gou jin kuai de dao jiu zheng 。]

english: Why are crocodiles so rude?
translation: 鳄鱼为何如此粗鲁？ [e yu wei he ru ci cu lu ？]

english: Rude? How so.
translation: 粗鲁的？为何如此。 [cu lu de ？ wei he ru ci 。]

english: Well they always try to eat me when I go near them.
translation: 好吧，当我靠近它们时，它们总是想吃掉我。 [hao ba ， dang wo kao jin ta men shi ， ta men zong shi xiang chi diao wo 。]

english: The life of a crocodile is not an easy one. They must seek food wherever it is available.
translation: 鳄鱼的生活并不轻松。他们必须在任何有食物的地方寻找食物。 [e yu de sheng huo bing bu qing song 。 ta men bi xu zai ren he you shi wu de di fang xun zhao shi wu 。]

english: Besides, I sense you do not speak the whole truth. Did you not befriend a crocodile yourself in times past?
translation: 此外，我感觉你没有说出全部真相。你过去没有和鳄鱼交过朋友吗？ [ci wai ， wo gan jue ni mei you shuo chu quan bu zhen xiang 。 ni guo qu mei you he e yu jiao guo peng you ma ？]

english: You mean Roger! I guess he was quite friendly.
translation: 你说的是罗杰！我猜他是相当友好的。 [ni shuo de shi luo jie ！ wo cai ta shi xiang dang you hao de 。]

english: Then perhaps crocodiles are not as rude as you think.
translation: 那么也许鳄鱼并不像你想象的那么粗鲁。 [na me ye xu e yu bing bu xiang ni xiang xiang de na me cu lu 。]

english: As you wish.
translation: 如你所愿。 [ru ni suo yuan 。]

english: We will be here.
translation: 我们会在这里。 [wo men hui zai zhe li 。]

english: I have a question for Het.
translation: 我有一个问题要问Het。 [wo you yi ge wen ti yao wen Het。]

english: I am Tumeken's avatar of health, both physical and mental.
translation: 我是图梅肯健康的化身，无论是身体上还是精神上。 [wo shi tu mei ken jian kang de hua shen ， wu lun shi shen ti shang hai shi jing shen shang 。]

english: You talk about strength and fighting a lot. Surely fighting isn't good for someone's health.
translation: 你经常谈论力量和战斗。打架肯定不利于某人的健康。 [ni jing chang tan lun li liang he zhan dou 。 da jia ken ding bu li yu mou ren de jian kang 。]

english: Well when it comes to health, is strength not the ultimate goal? The strongest individual is one who is healthy in both body and mind, and what better way to celebrate that strength than in combat!
translation: 那么说到健康，力量不就是终极目标吗？最坚强的人是身体和精神都健康的人，还有什么比战斗更好的方式来庆祝这种力量呢！ [na me shuo dao jian kang ， li liang bu jiu shi zhong ji mu biao ma ？ zui jian qiang de ren shi shen ti he jing shen dou jian kang de ren ， hai you shen me bi zhan dou geng hao de fang shi lai qing zhu zhe zhong li liang ne ！]

english: I guess, but what about those who aren't strong?
translation: 我想，但是那些实力不强的人呢？ [wo xiang ， dan shi na xie shi li bu qiang de ren ne ？]

english: Well health is not something to be hoarded, is it? Most weaknesses can be overcome, and it is the duty of the strong to help those less fortunate.
translation: 健康不是可以囤积的东西，不是吗？大多数弱点都是可以克服的，强者有责任帮助那些不幸的人。 [jian kang bu shi ke yi tun ji de dong xi ， bu shi ma ？ da duo shu ruo dian dou shi ke yi ke fu de ， qiang zhe you ze ren bang zhu na xie bu xing de ren 。]

english: So they can become strong and healthy themselves?
translation: 那么他们自己就能变得强壮和健康吗？ [na me ta men zi ji jiu neng bian de qiang zhuang he jian kang ma ？]

english: Exactly!
translation: 确切地！ [que qie di ！]

english: An interesting question. Why do you ask?
translation: 一个有趣的问题。你为什么问？ [yi ge you qu de wen ti 。 ni wei shen me wen ？]

english: Considering you have a human appearance, I wondered if that might resonate more with people.
translation: 考虑到你有人类的外表，我想知道这是否会更能引起人们的共鸣。 [kao lv dao ni you ren lei de wai biao ， wo xiang zhi dao zhe shi fou hui geng neng yin qi ren men de gong ming 。]

english: Not as much as you might think. Believe it or not, in some ways, I'm actually considered a bit boring! Why follow the human when you have a baboon god?
translation: 没有你想象的那么多。不管你信不信，在某些方面，我实际上被认为有点无聊！既然有狒狒神，为什么还要追随人类呢？ [mei you ni xiang xiang de na me duo 。 bu guan ni xin bu xin ， zai mou xie fang mian ， wo shi ji shang bei ren wei you dian wu liao ！ ji ran you fei fei shen ， wei shen me hai yao zhui sui ren lei ne ？]

english: Especially when the baboon god is so fun to be around!
translation: 尤其是当狒狒神在身边真是太有趣了！ [you qi shi dang fei fei shen zai shen bian zhen shi tai you qu le ！]

english: Of course, people just following one of us was never really the intention anyway. We're a pantheon, and we all have a part to play.
translation: 当然，人们只是跟踪我们中的一个人从来都不是真正的意图。我们是万神殿，我们都有自己的职责。 [dang ran ， ren men zhi shi gen zong wo men zhong de yi ge ren cong lai dou bu shi zhen zheng de yi tu 。 wo men shi wan shen dian ， wo men dou you zi ji de zhi ze 。]

english: Now that Amascut is running with her tail between her legs, perhaps we can remind people of that.
translation: 现在阿马斯卡特夹着尾巴奔跑，也许我们可以提醒人们这一点。 [xian zai a ma si ka te jia zhe wei ba ben pao ， ye xu wo men ke yi ti xing ren men zhe yi dian 。]

english: Very well.
translation: 很好。 [hen hao 。]

english: We'll wait for you to return.
translation: 我们会等你回来。 [wo men hui deng ni hui lai 。]

english: I have a question for all of you.
translation: 我有一个问题想问大家。 [wo you yi ge wen ti xiang wen da jia 。]

english: What will happen with Amascut?
translation: 阿马斯卡特会发生什么？ [a ma si ka te hui fa sheng shen me ？]

english: I'd say that's up to her. If she doesn't change her ways, her fate won't be pretty.
translation: 我想说这取决于她。如果她不改变自己的做法，她的命运就不会那么美好。 [wo xiang shuo zhe qu jue yu ta 。 ru guo ta bu gai bian zi ji de zuo fa ， ta de ming yun jiu bu hui na me mei hao 。]

english: But it's never too late for redemption. There might still be hope for her.
translation: 但救赎永远不会太晚。她或许还有希望。 [dan jiu shu yong yuan bu hui tai wan 。 ta huo xu hai you xi wang 。]

english: Whatever path she takes, we will be ready.
translation: 无论她走哪条路，我们都会做好准备。 [wu lun ta zou na tiao lu ， wo men du hui zuo hao zhun bei 。]

english: Do you really think she'd change her ways at this point?
translation: 你真的认为她现在会改变她的方式吗？ [ni zhen de ren wei ta xian zai hui gai bian ta de fang shi ma ？]

english: It seems unlikely, but there is one who might be able to change that.
translation: 这似乎不太可能，但有人可能能够改变这一状况。 [zhe si hu bu tai ke neng ， dan you ren ke neng neng gou gai bian zhe yi zhuang kuang 。]

english: Who?
translation: WHO？ [WHO？]

english: Icthlarin! If anyone can help Amascut find her way again, it's him!
translation: 异丙嗪！如果有人能帮助阿马斯卡特再次找到出路，那就是他了！ [yi bing qin ！ ru guo you ren neng bang zhu a ma si ka te zai ci zhao dao chu lu ， na jiu shi ta le ！]

english: He doesn't seem to have been doing much to help so far.
translation: 到目前为止，他似乎并没有提供太多帮助。 [dao mu qian wei zhi ， ta si hu bing mei you ti gong tai duo bang zhu 。]

english: Icthlarin is limited in what he can do. His duties to the dead require constant attention.
translation: Icthlarin 的能力有限。他对死者的职责需要持续关注。 [Icthlarin  de neng li you xian 。 ta dui si zhe de zhi ze xu yao chi xu guan zhu 。]

english: Not to mention the pact!
translation: 更不用说契约了！ [geng bu yong shuo qi yue le ！]

english: Pact?
translation: 协议？ [xie yi ？]

english: That is not for us to discuss.
translation: 这不是我们要讨论的。 [zhe bu shi wo men yao tao lun de 。]

english: Oh yes, sorry. Maybe we should talk about something else.
translation: 哦，是的，抱歉。也许我们应该谈谈别的事情。 [o ， shi de ， bao qian 。 ye xu wo men ying gai tan tan bie de shi qing 。]

english: Are you actually gods?
translation: 你们真的是神吗？ [ni men zhen de shi shen ma ？]

english: If you asked a citizen of these lands, I'm sure they'd probably say yes.
translation: 如果你问这些国家的公民，我相信他们可能会说是。 [ru guo ni wen zhe xie guo jia de gong min ， wo xiang xin ta men ke neng hui shuo shi 。]

english: Indeed, but they would not be truly correct.
translation: 确实如此，但他们并不是真正正确的。 [que shi ru ci ， dan ta men bing bu shi zhen zheng zheng que de 。]

english: How so?
translation: 为何如此？ [wei he ru ci ？]

english: Tumeken made us using his own divine essence! Each of us is a piece of him!
translation: 图梅肯用他自己的神性本质创造了我们！我们每个人都是他的一部分！ [tu mei ken yong ta zi ji de shen xing ben zhi chuang zao le wo men ！ wo men mei ge ren dou shi ta de yi bu fen ！]

english: But that does not make us gods. While great, our power is insignificant compared to a true god. That is why they are gone, and we remain.
translation: 但这并不能使我们成为神。我们的力量虽然伟大，但与真正的神相比，却显得微不足道。这就是为什么他们走了，而我们留下了。 [dan zhe bing bu neng shi wo men cheng wei shen 。 wo men de li liang sui ran wei da ， dan yu zhen zheng de shen xiang bi ， que xian de wei bu zu dao 。 zhe jiu shi wei shen me ta men zou le ， er wo men liu xia le 。]

english: So what are you really?
translation: 那么你到底是什么？ [na me ni dao di shi shen me ？]

english: You might hear some refer to us as the Avatars of Tumeken. We'd consider that a more fitting title.
translation: 您可能会听到有人将我们称为图梅肯的化身。我们认为这是一个更合适的标题。 [nin ke neng hui ting dao you ren jiang wo men cheng wei tu mei ken de hua shen 。 wo men ren wei zhe shi yi ge geng he shi de biao ti 。]

english: What about Icthlarin and Amascut?
translation: Icthlarin 和 Amascut 怎么样？ [Icthlarin  he  Amascut  zen me yang ？]

english: Tumeken made them too. Difference is, they also have some of Elidinis' divine essence, making them a lot more powerful!
translation: 图梅肯也制造了它们。不同的是，他们还拥有一些艾利迪尼斯的神性精华，让他们的实力更加强大！ [tu mei ken ye zhi zao le ta men 。 bu tong de shi ， ta men hai yong you yi xie ai li di ni si de shen xing jing hua ， rang ta men de shi li geng jia qiang da ！]

english: But again, they are not true gods.
translation: 但话又说回来，他们并不是真正的神。 [dan hua you shuo hui lai ， ta men bing bu shi zhen zheng de shen 。]

english: Amascut was hoping to change that today, but you showed her where to stick that plan!
translation: 阿马斯卡特今天希望改变这一点，但你向她展示了该计划的执行方向！ [a ma si ka te jin tian xi wang gai bian zhe yi dian ， dan ni xiang ta zhan shi le gai ji hua de zhi xing fang xiang ！]

english: So what happens now?
translation: 那么现在会发生什么呢？ [na me xian zai hui fa sheng shen me ne ？]

english: We are the Avatars of Tumeken, and the Kharidian Desert has been without guidance for too long. It is time we fixed that.
translation: 我们是图梅肯的化身，而哈里迪沙漠已经太久没有指引了。现在是我们解决这个问题的时候了。 [wo men shi tu mei ken de hua shen ， er ha li di sha mo yi jing tai jiu mei you zhi yin le 。 xian zai shi wo men jie jue zhe ge wen ti de shi hou le 。]

english: We're going to get started right away!
translation: 我们马上就开始吧！ [wo men ma shang jiu kai shi ba ！]

english: But don't worry, we don't intend to miss the fight against Amascut. I hope you'll stand alongside us when that day comes.
translation: 但别担心，我们不想错过与阿马斯卡特的战斗。我希望当那一天来临的时候，你能和我们站在一起。 [dan bie dan xin ， wo men bu xiang cuo guo yu a ma si ka te de zhan dou 。 wo xi wang dang na yi tian lai lin de shi hou ， ni neng he wo men zhan zai yi qi 。]

english: For now though, this is goodbye. We will meet again, human.
translation: 但现在，这是再见了。我们还会再见面的，人类。 [dan xian zai ， zhe shi zai jian le 。 wo men hai hui zai jian mian de ， ren lei 。]

english: It was great to meet you. Thank you for helping us!
translation: 很高兴见到你。感谢您帮助我们！ [hen gao xing jian dao ni 。 gan xie nin bang zhu wo men ！]

english: The avatars depart.
translation: 化身离开。 [hua shen li kai 。]

english: You're back!
translation: 你回来了！ [ni hui lai le ！]

english: If you have questions, now is the time to ask them.
translation: 如果您有疑问，现在是时候提问了。 [ru guo nin you yi wen ， xian zai shi shi hou ti wen le 。]

english: I have a question for Apmeken.
translation: 我有一个问题要问阿普梅肯。 [wo you yi ge wen ti yao wen a pu mei ken 。]

english: What's your role in the Menaphite Pantheon?
translation: 你在梅纳菲特万神殿中的角色是什么？ [ni zai mei na fei te wan shen dian zhong de jue se shi shen me ？]

english: Why aren't there more monkeys or apes in the desert?
translation: 为什么沙漠里没有更多的猴子或猿类？ [wei shen me sha mo li mei you geng duo de hou zi huo yuan lei ？]

english: Actually, I've changed my mind.
translation: 事实上，我已经改变主意了。 [shi shi shang ， wo yi jing gai bian zhu yi le 。]

english: I'll be back soon.
translation: 我很快就会回来。 [wo hen kuai jiu hui hui lai 。]

english: I have a question for Crondis.
translation: 我有一个问题要问克朗迪斯。 [wo you yi ge wen ti yao wen ke lang di si 。]

english: Why are crocodiles so rude?
translation: 鳄鱼为何如此粗鲁？ [e yu wei he ru ci cu lu ？]

english: I have a question for Het.
translation: 我有一个问题要问Het。 [wo you yi ge wen ti yao wen Het。]

english: Do you have more followers than the others?
translation: 你比其他人有更多的追随者吗？ [ni bi qi ta ren you geng duo de zhui sui zhe ma ？]

english: I have a question for all of you.
translation: 我有一个问题想问大家。 [wo you yi ge wen ti xiang wen da jia 。]

english: What will happen with Amascut?
translation: 阿马斯卡特会发生什么？ [a ma si ka te hui fa sheng shen me ？]

english: Are you actually gods?
translation: 你们真的是神吗？ [ni men zhen de shi shen ma ？]

english: So what happens now?
translation: 那么现在会发生什么呢？ [na me xian zai hui fa sheng shen me ne ？]

english: Nilsal, my child. Welcome to this holy temple of Ralos.
translation: 尼尔萨尔，我的孩子。欢迎来到拉洛斯这座神圣的寺庙。 [ni er sa er ， wo de hai zi 。 huan ying lai dao la luo si zhe zuo shen sheng de si miao 。]

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: If there is anything I can do for you, please just let me know.
translation: 如果有什么我能为您做的，请告诉我。 [ru guo you shen me wo neng wei nin zuo de ， qing gao su wo 。]

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
translation: 你能治愈我吗？我受伤了。 [ni neng zhi yu wo ma ？ wo shou shang le 。]

english: Sorry, but I cannot.
translation: 抱歉，但我不能。 [bao qian ， dan wo bu neng 。]

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: The teoki whispers a prayer and you suddenly feel a bit better.
translation: 泰奇低声祈祷，你突然感觉好一点了。 [tai qi di sheng qi dao ， ni tu ran gan jue hao yi dian le 。]

english: What is it you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I am one of the seven teoki in service to Ralos.
translation: 我是为拉洛斯服务的七名泰奥奇之一。 [wo shi wei la luo si fu wu de qi ming tai ao qi zhi yi 。]

english: Seven? That's quite a specific number.
translation: 七？这是一个相当具体的数字。 [qi ？ zhe shi yi ge xiang dang ju ti de shu zi 。]

english: Indeed. Along with our counterparts from the Sect of Ranul, each of us is responsible for one of seven key holy sites across the region.
translation: 的确。我们每个人都与拉努教派的同行一起负责该地区七个重要圣地之一。 [di que 。 wo men mei ge ren dou yu la nu jiao pai de tong hang yi qi fu ze gai di qu qi ge zhong yao sheng di zhi yi 。]

english: As you have likely guessed, my duty is to maintain the temple here in Fortis.
translation: 正如你可能已经猜到的，我的职责是维护富蒂斯的神庙。 [zheng ru ni ke neng yi jing cai dao de ， wo de zhi ze shi wei hu fu di si de shen miao 。]

english: I'd best get going.
translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: Timoiva, and may the sun light your way.
translation: 蒂莫瓦，愿阳光照亮你的道路。 [di mo wa ， yuan yang guang zhao liang ni de dao lu 。]

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
translation: 你能治愈我吗？我受伤了。 [ni neng zhi yu wo ma ？ wo shou shang le 。]

english: What is it you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'd best get going.
translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: Hello. Nice day for a walk, isn't it?
translation: 你好。散步的好日子，不是吗？ [ni hao 。 san bu de hao ri zi ， bu shi ma ？]

english: A walk? Oh yes, that's what we're doing. We're just out here for a walk.
translation: 散步？哦，是的，这就是我们正在做的。我们只是来这里散步。 [san bu ？ o ， shi de ， zhe jiu shi wo men zheng zai zuo de 。 wo men zhi shi lai zhe li san bu 。]

english: I'm glad you're just out here for a walk. A more suspicious person would think you were waiting here to attack weak-looking travellers.
translation: 我很高兴你来这里散步。多疑的人会认为你在这里等着攻击看上去很虚弱的旅行者。 [wo hen gao xing ni lai zhe li san bu 。 duo yi de ren hui ren wei ni zai zhe li deng zhe gong ji kan shang qu hen xu ruo de lv xing zhe 。]

english: Nope, we'd never do anything like that. Just a band of innocent walkers, that's us.
translation: 不，我们永远不会做那样的事情。只是一群无辜的行人，那就是我们。 [bu ， wo men yong yuan bu hui zuo na yang de shi qing 。 zhi shi yi qun wu gu de xing ren ， na jiu shi wo men 。]

english: Alright, have a nice walk.
translation: 好吧，祝你散步愉快。 [hao ba ， zhu ni san bu yu kuai 。]

english: Human.
translation: 人类。 [ren lei 。]

english: So what do you do?
translation: 那么你做什么呢？ [na me ni zuo shen me ne ？]

english: Drink.
translation: 喝。 [he 。]

english: For a living?
translation: 为了谋生？ [wei le mou sheng ？]

english: Is that a problem?
translation: 这是一个问题吗？ [zhe shi yi ge wen ti ma ？]

english: No, but I can't imagine it pays well.
translation: 不，但我无法想象它会带来丰厚的回报。 [bu ， dan wo wu fa xiang xiang ta hui dai lai feng hou de hui bao 。]

english: As you've not taken the hint, I'm a hunter. I go out and kill things, sell the results, and then come here to drink.
translation: 既然你没有领会暗示，我是一名猎人。我出去杀东西，卖掉成果，然后来这里喝酒。 [ji ran ni mei you ling hui an shi ， wo shi yi ming lie ren 。 wo chu qu sha dong xi ， mai diao cheng guo ， ran hou lai zhe li he jiu 。]

english: Sounds like a fun and varied routine.
translation: 听起来像是一个有趣且多样化的例行公事。 [ting qi lai xiang shi yi ge you qu qie duo yang hua de li xing gong shi 。]

english: It is. Now, if you'll excuse me.
translation: 这是。现在，请原谅。 [zhe shi 。 xian zai ， qing yuan liang 。]

english: Oh, well done! You managed to get both halves of the certificate!
translation: 哦，干得好！您成功获得了两半证书！ [o ， gan de hao ！ nin cheng gong huo de le liang ban zheng shu ！]

english: Welcome to the museum of Varrock.
translation: 欢迎来到瓦罗克博物馆。 [huan ying lai dao wa luo ke bo wu guan 。]

english: I have some relics you might be interested in.
translation: 我有一些你可能感兴趣的文物。 [wo you yi xie ni ke neng gan xing qu de wen wu 。]

english: Oh, wonderful! We are always eager to expand out collection!
translation: 哦，太棒了！我们总是渴望扩大收藏！ [o ， tai bang le ！ wo men zong shi ke wang kuo da shou cang ！]

english: I found them in some ruins underneath Ice Mountain.
translation: 我在冰山下面的一些废墟里发现了它们。 [wo zai bing shan xia mian de yi xie fei xu li fa xian le ta men 。]

english: Ruins? Beneath Ice Mountain? That's the first I've heard of this! What did you find down there?
translation: 废墟？冰山之下？我还是第一次听说这个！你在那里发现了什么？ [fei xu ？ bing shan zhi xia ？ wo hai shi di yi ci ting shuo zhe ge ！ ni zai na li fa xian le shen me ？]

english: An entire city!
translation: 整个城市！ [zheng ge cheng shi ！]

english: A city?! How? Which one? Was anyone living there?
translation: 一座城市？！如何？哪一个？有人住在那里吗？ [yi zuo cheng shi ？！ ru he ？ na yi ge ？ you ren zhu zai na li ma ？]

english: Just one person - an Imcando dwarf named Ramarno. He said the city was called Camdozaal.
translation: 只有一个人——一位名叫拉玛诺的伊姆坎多矮人。他说这座城市叫做卡姆多扎尔。 [zhi you yi ge ren —— yi wei ming jiao la ma nuo de yi mu kan duo ai ren 。 ta shuo zhe zuo cheng shi jiao zuo ka mu duo zha er 。]

english: CAMDOZAAL!? You found the lost Imcando city of Camdozaal!?
translation: 卡姆多扎尔！？你找到了失落的伊姆坎多城市卡姆多扎尔！？ [ka mu duo zha er ！？ ni zhao dao le shi luo de yi mu kan duo cheng shi ka mu duo zha er ！？]

english: Not on purpose! It's a long story.
translation: 不是故意的！这是一个很长的故事。 [bu shi gu yi de ！ zhe shi yi ge hen zhang de gu shi 。]

english: I'm lost for words! You accidentally found the lost  city of Camdozaal! Please let me see these relics.
translation: 我已经无话可说了！你意外地发现了失落的城市卡姆多扎尔！请让我看看这些文物。 [wo yi jing wu hua ke shuo le ！ ni yi wai di fa xian le shi luo de cheng shi ka mu duo zha er ！ qing rang wo kan kan zhe xie wen wu 。]

english: Hmm, this is certainly not of Imcando design. Maybe it's from an older civilisation. How did you come across it?
translation: 嗯，这肯定不是 Imcando 设计的。也许它来自更古老的文明。你是怎么发现它的？ [n ， zhe ken ding bu shi  Imcando  she ji de 。 ye xu ta lai zi geng gu lao de wen ming 。 ni shi zen me fa xian ta de ？]

english: I found it encased in ore. I had to crack it open and chip off the hardened parts. This was underneath.
translation: 我发现它被矿石包裹着。我必须把它打开并切掉硬化的部分。这是在下面的。 [wo fa xian ta bei kuang shi bao guo zhe 。 wo bi xu ba ta da kai bing qie diao ying hua de bu fen 。 zhe shi zai xia mian de 。]

english: My word, a true mystery of an item? How did it get down there?
translation: 我的话，一件物品真正的奥秘？它是怎么落到那里的？ [wo de hua ， yi jian wu pin zhen zheng de ao mi ？ ta shi zen me luo dao na li de ？]

english: Thank you, kind [sir/lady]! Pass them over to me and I'll identify them properly.
translation: 谢谢你，善良的[先生/女士]！把它们交给我，我会正确识别它们。 [xie xie ni ， shan liang de [ xian sheng / nv shi ]！ ba ta men jiao gei wo ， wo hui zheng que shi bie ta men 。]

english: This Ancient globe seems to show new constellations. What a discovery!
translation: 这个古老的地球仪似乎显示出新的星座。真是一个发现！ [zhe ge gu lao de di qiu yi si hu xian shi chu xin de xing zuo 。 zhen shi yi ge fa xian ！]

english: I wonder what secrets this Ancient ledger holds. It's a unique find!
translation: 我想知道这本古老的账本到底藏着什么秘密。这是一个独特的发现！ [wo xiang zhi dao zhe ben gu lao de zhang ben dao di cang zhe shen me mi mi 。 zhe shi yi ge du te de fa xian ！]

english: An Ancient astroscope. I have only read of such things but to see one, incredible!
translation: 古代占星仪。我只读过这样的事情，但亲眼目睹了一件，不可思议！ [gu dai zhan xing yi 。 wo zhi du guo zhe yang de shi qing ， dan qin yan mu du le yi jian ， bu ke si yi ！]

english: I'm not even familiar with the glyphs in this Ancient treatise. It's the first time I've seen them.
translation: 我什至不熟悉这篇古代论文中的符号。这是我第一次见到他们。 [wo shen zhi bu shu xi zhe pian gu dai lun wen zhong de fu hao 。 zhe shi wo di yi ci jian dao ta men 。]

english: What a find, this Ancient carcanet has never been documented before, but I'm certain it had a ceremonial purpose.
translation: 真是一个发现，这个古老的卡卡尼以前从未被记录在案，但我确信它有一个仪式目的。 [zhen shi yi ge fa xian ， zhe ge gu lao de ka ka ni yi qian cong wei bei ji lu zai an ， dan wo que xin ta you yi ge yi shi mu di 。]

english: We already have examples of these other relics in the museum, but they will add nicely to our collection.
translation: 我们博物馆里已经有这些其他文物的例子，但它们将很好地添加到我们的收藏中。 [wo men bo wu guan li yi jing you zhe xie qi ta wen wu de li zi ， dan ta men jiang hen hao di tian jia dao wo men de shou cang zhong 。]

english: Using  on Curator Haig Halen:
translation: 用于策展人黑格·海伦： [yong yu ce zhan ren hei ge · hai lun ：]

english: Talk about the relic found in Camdozaal.
translation: 谈论在卡姆多扎尔发现的遗迹。 [tan lun zai ka mu duo zha er fa xian de yi ji 。]

english: Talk about something else.
translation: 说点别的吧。 [shuo dian bie de ba 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Nilsal to you, iknami. Welcome to the Grand Museum. I hope your visit is a pleasant one. If you have any questions about Varlamore, I'm happy to help.
translation: 尼尔萨尔给你，iknami。欢迎来到大博物馆。我希望您的访问是一次愉快的访问。如果您对 Varlamore 有任何疑问，我很乐意为您提供帮助。 [ni er sa er gei ni ，iknami。 huan ying lai dao da bo wu guan 。 wo xi wang nin de fang wen shi yi ci yu kuai de fang wen 。 ru guo nin dui  Varlamore  you ren he yi wen ， wo hen le yi wei nin ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: Could you tell me more about the early history of Varlamore?
translation: 您能告诉我更多关于瓦拉莫尔的早期历史吗？ [nin neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu wa la mo er de zao qi li shi ma ？]

english: Certainly! When it comes to the existence of Varlamore, it is Xeric we have to thank. During his Age of Strife, many refugees fled Kourend over the previously unexplored Custodia Mountains.
translation: 当然！说到Varlamore的存在，我们不得不感谢Xeric。在他的冲突时代，许多难民逃离了库伦德，翻越了此前未曾探索过的卡斯托迪亚山脉。 [dang ran ！ shuo dao Varlamore de cun zai ， wo men bu de bu gan xie Xeric。 zai ta de chong tu shi dai ， xu duo nan min tao li le ku lun de ， fan yue le ci qian wei ceng tan suo guo de ka si tuo di ya shan mai 。]

english: There were three notable groups of these refugees. The first group, the Talkasti, settled in the Tlati Rainforest.
translation: 这些难民中有三个值得注意的群体。第一个群体，塔尔卡斯提人，定居在特拉蒂雨林。 [zhe xie nan min zhong you san ge zhi de zhu yi de qun ti 。 di yi ge qun ti ， ta er ka si ti ren ， ding ju zai te la di yu lin 。]

english: While they initially lived nomadic lives, they eventually started to establish more permanent settlements, with Tal Teklan being the first.
translation: 虽然他们最初过着游牧生活，但他们最终开始建立更永久的定居点，塔尔特克兰是第一个。 [sui ran ta men zui chu guo zhe you mu sheng huo ， dan ta men zui zhong kai shi jian li geng yong jiu de ding ju dian ， ta er te ke lan shi di yi ge 。]

english: The next group were the Pericans. They first settled right here, building the town of Fortis, or Civitas illa Fortis as it eventually became.
translation: 下一组是佩里克人。他们首先在这里定居，建立了富蒂斯镇，或最终成为的奇维塔斯伊拉富蒂斯。 [xia yi zu shi pei li ke ren 。 ta men shou xian zai zhe li ding ju ， jian li le fu di si zhen ， huo zui zhong cheng wei de qi wei ta si yi la fu di si 。]

english: Finally we have the dwarves. These were refugees from Lovakengj who established a home beneath Ralos' Rise, becoming known as the Dwarves of Cam Torum.
translation: 最后我们有矮人。这些是来自洛瓦肯吉的难民，他们在拉洛斯高地下建立了家园，被称为卡姆托鲁姆矮人。 [zui hou wo men you ai ren 。 zhe xie shi lai zi luo wa ken ji de nan min ， ta men zai la luo si gao di xia jian li le jia yuan ， bei cheng wei ka mu tuo lu mu ai ren 。]

english: Was there any friction between these groups initially?
translation: 这些群体之间最初是否有任何摩擦？ [zhe xie qun ti zhi jian zui chu shi fou you ren he mo ca ？]

english: Oh yes, very much so. The dwarves, just as they do today, mostly kept to themselves. However, the Talkasti and Pericans came into regular conflict over various matters.
translation: 哦，是的，非常如此。就像今天一样，矮人大多独来独往。然而，塔尔卡斯提人和佩里卡人在各种问题上经常发生冲突。 [o ， shi de ， fei chang ru ci 。 jiu xiang jin tian yi yang ， ai ren da duo du lai du wang 。 ran er ， ta er ka si ti ren he pei li ka ren zai ge zhong wen ti shang jing chang fa sheng chong tu 。]

english: But that's not the case now, right? What brought them together?
translation: 但现在情况并非如此，对吧？是什么让他们走到了一起？ [dan xian zai qing kuang bing fei ru ci ， dui ba ？ shi shen me rang ta men zou dao le yi qi ？]

english: As you may well have already guessed, it was religion. Long before leaving Kourend, the Talkasti had taken to secretly worshipping Ralos and Ranul.
translation: 正如您可能已经猜到的那样，这是宗教。早在离开库伦德之前，塔卡斯蒂人就开始秘密崇拜拉洛斯和拉努尔。 [zheng ru nin ke neng yi jing cai dao de na yang ， zhe shi zong jiao 。 zao zai li kai ku lun de zhi qian ， ta ka si di ren jiu kai shi mi mi chong bai la luo si he la nu er 。]

english: After arriving here, they were able to openly practice their religion for the first time. Over time, the Pericans started to adopt this religion as well.
translation: 到达这里后，他们第一次能够公开信奉自己的宗教。随着时间的推移，佩里克人也开始接受这种宗教。 [dao da zhe li hou ， ta men di yi ci neng gou gong kai xin feng zi ji de zong jiao 。 sui zhe shi jian de tui yi ， pei li ke ren ye kai shi jie shou zhe zhong zong jiao 。]

english: As the two groups came together, the population of the region started to rapidly expand. This eventually led to the construction of Tempestus, and with it, the founding of Varlamore.
translation: 随着这两个群体的聚集，该地区的人口开始迅速增长。这最终导致了暴风雨的建造，以及瓦拉莫尔的建立。 [sui zhe zhe liang ge qun ti de ju ji ， gai di qu de ren kou kai shi xun su zeng zhang 。 zhe zui zhong dao zhi le bao feng yu de jian zao ， yi ji wa la mo er de jian li 。]

english: So are there still distinctions between the Talkasti and the Pericans now?
translation: 那么现在塔尔卡斯提人和佩里卡人之间还有区别吗？ [na me xian zai ta er ka si ti ren he pei li ka ren zhi jian hai you qu bie ma ？]

english: Yes and no. Those terms are no longer used to describe people today. Since we united, we have all been Varlamorians. However, you'll still find many traces of our previous divide.
translation: 是的，也不是。如今这些术语已不再用来形容人。自从我们团结起来，我们都是瓦拉莫人。然而，你仍然会发现我们之前分裂的许多痕迹。 [shi de ， ye bu shi 。 ru jin zhe xie shu yu yi bu zai yong lai xing rong ren 。 zi cong wo men tuan jie qi lai ， wo men dou shi wa la mo ren 。 ran er ， ni reng ran hui fa xian wo men zhi qian fen lie de xu duo hen ji 。]

english: For example, here in Fortis, you'll find yourself surrounded by Perican archetecture, whereas over in the Tlati Rainforest, the influence of the Talkasti remains clear.
translation: 例如，在富蒂斯，您会发现自己被佩里坎建筑所包围，而在特拉蒂雨林，塔尔卡斯提的影响仍然清晰可见。 [li ru ， zai fu di si ， nin hui fa xian zi ji bei pei li kan jian zhu suo bao wei ， er zai te la di yu lin ， ta er ka si ti de ying xiang reng ran qing xi ke jian 。]

english: Names are another good example. Indeed, look no further than our rulers. For most of our history, we were ruled by the Tullus dynasty, with Tullus very much being a name of Perican origin.
translation: 名字是另一个很好的例子。事实上，看看我们的统治者就知道了。在我们历史的大部分时间里，我们都是由图卢斯王朝统治的，而图卢斯在很大程度上是一个起源于佩里坎的名字。 [ming zi shi ling yi ge hen hao de li zi 。 shi shi shang ， kan kan wo men de tong zhi zhe jiu zhi dao le 。 zai wo men li shi de da bu fen shi jian li ， wo men dou shi you tu lu si wang chao tong zhi de ， er tu lu si zai hen da cheng du shang shi yi ge qi yuan yu pei li kan de ming zi 。]

english: However, we are now ruled by the Arkan dynasty, whose name can be traced back to early Talkasti nomads.
translation: 然而，我们现在由阿尔坎王朝统治，其名字可以追溯到早期的塔尔卡斯提游牧民族。 [ran er ， wo men xian zai you a er kan wang chao tong zhi ， qi ming zi ke yi zhui su dao zao qi de ta er ka si ti you mu min zu 。]

english: I see. So where did the name Varlamore come from.
translation: 我懂了。那么 Varlamore 这个名字是从哪里来的呢？ [wo dong le 。 na me  Varlamore  zhe ge ming zi shi cong na li lai de ne ？]

english: The name comes from the River Varla that separated Talkasti and Perican territory. What was once a symbol of our divide, became the symbol of our unification.
translation: 这个名字来自分隔塔尔卡斯提和佩里坎领地的瓦尔拉河。曾经是我们分裂的象征，现在成为我们统一的象征。 [zhe ge ming zi lai zi fen ge ta er ka si ti he pei li kan ling di de wa er la he 。 ceng jing shi wo men fen lie de xiang zheng ， xian zai cheng wei wo men tong yi de xiang zheng 。]

english: That was all super interesting! Thanks for the information.
translation: 这一切都非常有趣！感谢您提供信息。 [zhe yi qie dou fei chang you qu ！ gan xie nin ti gong xin xi 。]

english: Not a problem, iknami!
translation: 没问题，iknami！ [mei wen ti ，iknami！]

english: I'd better get going. Thanks again.
translation: 我最好走了。再次感谢。 [wo zui hao zou le 。 zai ci gan xie 。]

english: Could you tell me more about religion in Varlamore?
translation: 您能告诉我更多有关瓦尔拉莫尔宗教的信息吗？ [nin neng gao su wo geng duo you guan wa er la mo er zong jiao de xin xi ma ？]

english: Of course! Whereas in other parts of the world you'll likely find followers of many gods, here in Varlamore, you'll only really find those dedicated to Ralos and Ranul.
translation: 当然！在世界其他地方，您可能会找到许多神的追随者，但在瓦拉莫尔，您只会真正找到那些献身于拉洛斯和拉努尔的人。 [dang ran ！ zai shi jie qi ta di fang ， nin ke neng hui zhao dao xu duo shen de zhui sui zhe ， dan zai wa la mo er ， nin zhi hui zhen zheng zhao dao na xie xian shen yu la luo si he la nu er de ren 。]

english: Losanium is the official term for this religion, though it is not a term you'll find used very often.
translation: Losanium 是该宗教的官方术语，尽管它不是一个经常使用的术语。 [Losanium  shi gai zong jiao de guan fang shu yu ， jin guan ta bu shi yi ge jing chang shi yong de shu yu 。]

english: How come?
translation: 怎么会？ [zen me hui ？]

english: Losanium encompasses the worship of both Ralos and Ranul, and while they do indeed go hand in hand, it is rare to find individuals equally dedicated to both.
translation: 洛萨尼姆崇拜拉洛斯和拉努尔，虽然它们确实齐头并进，但很少有人对两者同样虔诚。 [luo sa ni mu chong bai la luo si he la nu er ， sui ran ta men que shi qi tou bing jin ， dan hen shao you ren dui liang zhe tong yang qian cheng 。]

english: Instead, most people focus their worship on one of the two, with Ralos being by far the more popular. Something that isn't too surprising given Ranul's association with death.
translation: 相反，大多数人将崇拜集中在两者之一，而拉洛斯迄今为止更受欢迎。考虑到拉努尔与死亡的联系，这并不奇怪。 [xiang fan ， da duo shu ren jiang chong bai ji zhong zai liang zhe zhi yi ， er la luo si qi jin wei zhi geng shou huan ying 。 kao lv dao la nu er yu si wang de lian xi ， zhe bing bu qi guai 。]

english: Now that said, you might actually find a higher than normal number of Ranul worshippers right here in the museum.
translation: 话虽如此，您实际上可能会在博物馆里发现比平常更多的拉努尔崇拜者。 [hua sui ru ci ， nin shi ji shang ke neng hui zai bo wu guan li fa xian bi ping chang geng duo de la nu er chong bai zhe 。]

english: Something that is easily forgotten is that while Ranul is indeed a god of death, he is also a god of learning and knowledge.
translation: 很容易被忘记的是，虽然拉努尔确实是死神，但他也是学习和知识之神。 [hen rong yi bei wang ji de shi ， sui ran la nu er que shi shi si shen ， dan ta ye shi xue xi he zhi shi zhi shen 。]

english: If you wish to learn more, you may well want to seek out one of the teoki in the temple to the south. Though of course, they may well have somewhat biased takes on their religious practices.
translation: 如果您想了解更多信息，您可能想在南边的寺庙中寻找其中之一。当然，他们可能对自己的宗教活动有一定的偏见。 [ru guo nin xiang liao jie geng duo xin xi ， nin ke neng xiang zai nan bian de si miao zhong xun zhao qi zhong zhi yi 。 dang ran ， ta men ke neng dui zi ji de zong jiao huo dong you yi ding de pian jian 。]

english: I'll keep that in mind. Thanks.
translation: 我会记住这一点。谢谢。 [wo hui ji zhu zhe yi dian 。 xie xie 。]

english: Don't mention it.
translation: 别提了。 [bie ti le 。]

english: Could you tell me more about Varlamore's recent history?
translation: 您能告诉我更多有关瓦拉莫尔近期历史的信息吗？ [nin neng gao su wo geng duo you guan wa la mo er jin qi li shi de xin xi ma ？]

english: I can indeed! When it comes to recent events in the kingdom, the best place to start is with the War of Betrayal. It all started around 100 years ago when Imafore Tullus ascended to the throne.
translation: 我确实可以！说到王国最近发生的事件，最好的起点就是背叛之战。这一切都始于大约 100 年前，当时伊玛福·图勒斯 (Imafore Tullus) 登基。 [wo que shi ke yi ！ shuo dao wang guo zui jin fa sheng de shi jian ， zui hao de qi dian jiu shi bei pan zhi zhan 。 zhe yi qie dou shi yu da yue  100  nian qian ， dang shi yi ma fu · tu lei si  (Imafore Tullus)  deng ji 。]

english: He soon reorganised the kingdom into the Varlamorian Empire, a controversial choice to say the least, though it soon became clear that controversial choices were quite popular with Imafore.
translation: 他很快将王国重组为瓦拉莫里安帝国，至少可以说，这是一个有争议的选择，尽管很快就发现这种有争议的选择很受伊马弗雷的欢迎。 [ta hen kuai jiang wang guo chong zu wei wa la mo li an di guo ， zhi shao ke yi shuo ， zhe shi yi ge you zheng yi de xuan ze ， jin guan hen kuai jiu fa xian zhe zhong you zheng yi de xuan ze hen shou yi ma fu lei de huan ying 。]

english: While public opinion was always mixed, nothing he did resulted in outright conflict until his sudden and brutal murder of the Kourend Royal Family. War was quickly declared.
translation: 尽管公众舆论总是褒贬不一，但他所做的一切都没有引发彻底的冲突，直到他突然残忍地谋杀了库伦德王室家族。战争很快就宣战了。 [jin guan gong zhong yu lun zong shi bao bian bu yi ， dan ta suo zuo de yi qie dou mei you yin fa che di de chong tu ， zhi dao ta tu ran can ren di mou sha le ku lun de wang shi jia zu 。 zhan zheng hen kuai jiu xuan zhan le 。]

english: Until that day, Varlamore had successfully managed to avoid conflict since before the kingdom was officially established. To say the war was unpopular would be an understatement.
translation: 直到那一天，瓦拉莫尔成功地避免了王国正式建立之前的冲突。说这场战争不受欢迎是轻描淡写的。 [zhi dao na yi tian ， wa la mo er cheng gong di bi mian le wang guo zheng shi jian li zhi qian de chong tu 。 shuo zhe chang zhan zheng bu shou huan ying shi qing miao dan xie de 。]

english: Imafore soon found himself facing as much resistance from within as he did from Kourend. The end result was predictable.
translation: 伊马福很快发现自己面临着与库伦德一样多的内部阻力。最终的结果是可以预见的。 [yi ma fu hen kuai fa xian zi ji mian lin zhe yu ku lun de yi yang duo de nei bu zu li 。 zui zhong de jie guo shi ke yi yu jian de 。]

english: Imafore and his forces found themselves trapped between two armies at the Battle of the Proudspire. He was captured and executed, bringing an end to the Tullus dynasty.
translation: 在骄傲尖塔之战中，伊马福尔和他的部队发现自己被困在两支军队之间。他被俘并被处决，图卢斯王朝就此结束。 [zai jiao ao jian ta zhi zhan zhong ， yi ma fu er he ta de bu dui fa xian zi ji bei kun zai liang zhi jun dui zhi jian 。 ta bei fu bing bei chu jue ， tu lu si wang chao jiu ci jie shu 。]

english: This brings us to a fun little fact. After his death, Imafore was succeeded by King Mezpah Arkan. One of his first acts was to call for the beheading of every statue of Imafore in the kingdom.
translation: 这给我们带来了一个有趣的小事实。伊马福尔死后，国王梅兹帕·阿尔坎继位。他的第一个行动就是要求斩首王国里所有伊玛福尔的雕像。 [zhe gei wo men dai lai le yi ge you qu de xiao shi shi 。 yi ma fu er si hou ， guo wang mei zi pa · a er kan ji wei 。 ta de di yi ge xing dong jiu shi yao qiu zhan shou wang guo li suo you yi ma fu er de diao xiang 。]

english: The statues remain to this day. It's actually a crime to try and remove them. They exist as a reminder of our history, and a warning to any who would try to follow in Imafore's footsteps.
translation: 这些雕像至今仍保留着。试图移除它们实际上是犯罪行为。它们的存在是为了提醒我们的历史，也是对任何试图追随伊玛福尔脚步的人的警告。 [zhe xie diao xiang zhi jin reng bao liu zhe 。 shi tu yi chu ta men shi ji shang shi fan zui xing wei 。 ta men de cun zai shi wei le ti xing wo men de li shi ， ye shi dui ren he shi tu zhui sui yi ma fu er jiao bu de ren de jing gao 。]

english: I'll have to keep an eye out for them.
translation: 我得留意他们。 [wo de liu yi ta men 。]

english: Indeed. I often like to challenge people to try and find them all!
translation: 的确。我经常喜欢挑战人们尝试并找到所有这些！ [di que 。 wo jing chang xi huan tiao zhan ren men chang shi bing zhao dao suo you zhe xie ！]

english: So how has the kingdom changed since Imafore died?
translation: 那么，自从伊玛福死后，这个王国发生了怎样的变化呢？ [na me ， zi cong yi ma fu si hou ， zhe ge wang guo fa sheng le zen yang de bian hua ne ？]

english: The War of Betrayal was very much seen as a wake- up call. While Varlamore had once flourished under the traditions of the Tullus dynasty, by the end, it's fair to say we were stagnating.
translation: 背叛之战在很大程度上被视为一个警钟。虽然瓦拉莫尔曾经在图卢斯王朝的传统下繁荣昌盛，但到了最后，可以公平地说我们陷入了停滞。 [bei pan zhi zhan zai hen da cheng du shang bei shi wei yi ge jing zhong 。 sui ran wa la mo er ceng jing zai tu lu si wang chao de chuan tong xia fan rong chang sheng ， dan dao le zui hou ， ke yi gong ping di shuo wo men xian ru le ting zhi 。]

english: King Mezpah set to work on transforming the kingdom. His ambitions were high, to the point that much of what he desired never came to pass in his lifetime.
translation: 梅斯帕国王开始致力于改造王国。他的野心很高，以至于他所渴望的很多事情在他的一生中从未实现。 [mei si pa guo wang kai shi zhi li yu gai zao wang guo 。 ta de ye xin hen gao ， yi zhi yu ta suo ke wang de hen duo shi qing zai ta de yi sheng zhong cong wei shi xian 。]

english: One of his most notable goals was to see Varlamore open more widely to the outer world. A goal which thanks to his great-granddaughter, has now finally been achieved!
translation: 他最显着的目标之一是让瓦拉莫尔更加广泛地向外部世界开放。感谢他的曾孙女，这个目标现在终于实现了！ [ta zui xian zhe de mu biao zhi yi shi rang wa la mo er geng jia guang fan di xiang wai bu shi jie kai fang 。 gan xie ta de zeng sun nv ， zhe ge mu biao xian zai zhong yu shi xian le ！]

english: Well then I should be very thankful. Without him, I might never have been allowed to visit!
translation: 那么我应该非常感谢。如果没有他，我可能永远不会被允许参观！ [na me wo ying gai fei chang gan xie 。 ru guo mei you ta ， wo ke neng yong yuan bu hui bei yun xu can guan ！]

english: Indeed. We would often send our students on trips to the east prior to the opening of the borders. The amount of paperwork needed was astounding! Now we can just hop on a ship any time we like!
translation: 的确。我们经常在边境开放之前派学生去东部旅行。所需的文书工作量令人震惊！现在我们可以随时上船了！ [di que 。 wo men jing chang zai bian jing kai fang zhi qian pai xue sheng qu dong bu lv xing 。 suo xu de wen shu gong zuo liang ling ren zhen jing ！ xian zai wo men ke yi sui shi shang chuan le ！]

english: That definitely sounds much more fun. Thanks for all the information.
translation: 这听起来确实有趣得多。感谢您提供的所有信息。 [zhe ting qi lai que shi you qu de duo 。 gan xie nin ti gong de suo you xin xi 。]

english: It's not a problem, iknami.
translation: 这不是问题，iknami。 [zhe bu shi wen ti ，iknami。]

english: Thanks. If I have any questions, I'll be sure to ask.
translation: 谢谢。如果我有任何问题，我一定会问。 [xie xie 。 ru guo wo you ren he wen ti ， wo yi ding hui wen 。]

english: Could you tell me more about the early history of Varlamore?
translation: 您能告诉我更多关于瓦拉莫尔的早期历史吗？ [nin neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu wa la mo er de zao qi li shi ma ？]

english: Could you tell me more about religion in Varlamore?
translation: 您能告诉我更多有关瓦尔拉莫尔宗教的信息吗？ [nin neng gao su wo geng duo you guan wa er la mo er zong jiao de xin xi ma ？]

english: Could you tell me more about Varlamore's recent history?
translation: 您能告诉我更多有关瓦拉莫尔近期历史的信息吗？ [nin neng gao su wo geng duo you guan wa la mo er jin qi li shi de xin xi ma ？]

english: I'd better get going. Thanks again.
translation: 我最好走了。再次感谢。 [wo zui hao zou le 。 zai ci gan xie 。]

english: Thanks. If I have any questions, I'll be sure to ask.
translation: 谢谢。如果我有任何问题，我一定会问。 [xie xie 。 ru guo wo you ren he wen ti ， wo yi ding hui wen 。]

english: Hey. Leave me be. I'm guardin' this place.
translation: 嘿。别管我了。我守护着这个地方。 [hei 。 bie guan wo le 。 wo shou hu zhe zhe ge di fang 。]

english: You release your current duck and it begins tracking the currents.
translation: 你释放当前的鸭子，它就会开始跟踪水流。 [ni shi fang dang qian de ya zi ， ta jiu hui kai shi gen zong shui liu 。]

english: There it goes! Now to follow it and see where this current flows.
translation: 就这样！现在跟随它看看电流流向哪里。 [jiu zhe yang ！ xian zai gen sui ta kan kan dian liu liu xiang na li 。]

english: Quack!
translation: 嘎嘎！ [ga ga ！]

english: Quack! Quack! Quack!
translation: 嘎嘎！嘎嘎！嘎嘎！ [ga ga ！ ga ga ！ ga ga ！]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 你知道，打招呼的方式有很多种。你好，你好，你好…… [ni zhi dao ， da zhao hu de fang shi you hen duo zhong 。 ni hao ， ni hao ， ni hao ……]

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 那还是只能算一个！ [na hai shi zhi neng suan yi ge ！]

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。你今天怎么样？ [ni hao 。 ni jin tian zen me yang ？]

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很棒，谢谢你！ [wo hen bang ， xie xie ni ！]

english: Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 你好！水晶城里今天过得怎么样啊？ [ni hao ！ shui jing cheng li jin tian guo de zen me yang a ？]

english: Indeed.
translation: 的确。 [di que 。]

english: What can I do for ya?
translation: 我能为你做什么？ [wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 各种各样的事情！这些塔楼是一个美妙的景观。 [ge zhong ge yang de shi qing ！ zhe xie ta lou shi yi ge mei miao de jing guan 。]

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 在像今天这样的日子，我建议您参观市场。 [zai xiang jin tian zhe yang de ri zi ， wo jian yi nin can guan shi chang 。]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你认为你在做什么？ [ni ren wei ni zai zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: Oh, that's nice, another human visitor to Keldagrim!
translation: 噢，太好了，又一位人类访客来到了凯尔达格林！ [o ， tai hao le ， you yi wei ren lei fang ke lai dao le kai er da ge lin ！]

english: Indeed!
translation: 的确！ [di que ！]

english: And what brings you to this city? Come to seek knowledge as well?
translation: 是什么让您来到这座城市？也是来求知的吗？ [shi shen me rang nin lai dao zhe zuo cheng shi ？ ye shi lai qiu zhi de ma ？]

english: I think it's mostly fame and riches I'm after.
translation: 我认为我主要追求的是名誉和财富。 [wo ren wei wo zhu yao zhui qiu de shi ming yu he cai fu 。]

english: To each [his/her] own, I suppose.
translation: 我想，对于每个[他/她]自己的人来说。 [wo xiang ， dui yu mei ge [ ta / ta ] zi ji de ren lai shuo 。]

english: Hello, can you help me?
translation: 你好，你能帮我吗？ [ni hao ， ni neng bang wo ma ？]

english: Ssshhh, don't talk...
translation: 嘘嘘，别说话…… [xu xu ， bie shuo hua ……]

english: But I just want to ask you something.
translation: 但我只是想问你一件事。 [dan wo zhi shi xiang wen ni yi jian shi 。]

english: Ssshhhh! Can't you read the sign?
translation: 嘘嘘！你看不懂这个标志吗？ [xu xu ！ ni kan bu dong zhe ge biao zhi ma ？]

english: What sign??
translation: 什么标志？？ [shen me biao zhi ？？]

english: Don't be a cheeky human!
translation: 别做一个厚脸皮的人！ [bie zuo yi ge hou lian pi de ren ！]

english: Ssshhhh.
translation: 嘘嘘。 [xu xu 。]

english: Can I help you?
translation: 我可以帮你吗？ [wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: Can I journey on this ship?
translation: 我可以乘坐这艘船旅行吗？ [wo ke yi cheng zuo zhe sou chuan lv xing ma ？]

english: You need to be searched before you can board.
translation: 您需要在登机前接受搜查。 [nin xu yao zai deng ji qian jie shou sou cha 。]

english: Why?
translation: 为什么？ [wei shen me ？]

english: Because Asgarnia has banned the import of intoxicating spirits.

english: Did you know they think this place dates back to the second age?!
translation: 你知道他们认为这个地方可以追溯到第二纪元吗？！ [ni zhi dao ta men ren wei zhe ge di fang ke yi zhui su dao di er ji yuan ma ？！]

english: Really?
translation: 真的吗？ [zhen de ma ？]

translation: 是的。信息亭的那个人告诉我的。 [shi de 。 xin xi ting de na ge ren gao su wo de 。]

english: Hello there. What are you doing here?
translation: 你好呀。你在这里做什么？ [ni hao ya 。 ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm waiting here hoping that someone can guide me to the Paterdomus, the temple on the Salve.
translation: 我在这里等待，希望有人能带我去帕特多莫斯（Paterdomus），萨尔夫河上的神庙。 [wo zai zhe li deng dai ， xi wang you ren neng dai wo qu pa te duo mo si （Paterdomus）， sa er fu he shang de shen miao 。]

english: Where is Paterdomus?
translation: 帕特多莫斯在哪里？ [pa te duo mo si zai na li ？]

english: Oh, Paterdomus is that rather impressive looking temple on the Salve... I'm sure you must have passed it on your way into Morytania.
translation: 哦，帕特多莫斯是萨尔夫岛上那座看起来相当令人印象深刻的神庙……我相信你在前往莫里塔尼亚的路上一定经过了它。 [o ， pa te duo mo si shi sa er fu dao shang na zuo kan qi lai xiang dang ling ren yin xiang shen ke de shen miao …… wo xiang xin ni zai qian wang mo li ta ni ya de lu shang yi ding jing guo le ta 。]

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
translation: 你为什么要去帕特多莫斯？ [ni wei shen me yao qu pa te duo mo si ？]

english: I'm hoping to get back to civilisation and see what the lands of Misthalin look like.
translation: 我希望回到文明世界，看看米沙林的土地是什么样子。 [wo xi wang hui dao wen ming shi jie ， kan kan mi sha lin de tu di shi shen me yang zi 。]

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Paterdomus?
translation: 如果我们在前往帕特多莫斯的路上遇到敌人，你能保护自己吗？ [ru guo wo men zai qian wang pa te duo mo si de lu shang yu dao di ren ， ni neng bao hu zi ji ma ？]

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of bad guys. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: 这么说吧，我有点经验，而且我很乐意与坏人对抗。你不需要担心这个。 [zhe me shuo ba ， wo you dian jing yan ， er qie wo hen le yi yu huai ren dui kang 。 ni bu xu yao dan xin zhe ge 。]

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
translation: 我可以带你去帕特多莫斯。 [wo ke yi dai ni qu pa te duo mo si 。]

english: Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: 嗯嗯，看来你有追随者了。我想如果让它独自徘徊的话，它可能会在这段旅程中迷路。等你的追随者安全了我们就离开吧。 [n n ， kan lai ni you zhui sui zhe le 。 wo xiang ru guo rang ta du zi pai huai de hua ， ta ke neng hui zai zhe duan lv cheng zhong mi lu 。 deng ni de zhui sui zhe an quan le wo men jiu li kai ba 。]

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: 哦真的吗？那太好了！到达目的地后我会给你一个小奖励。 [o zhen de ma ？ na tai hao le ！ dao da mu di di hou wo hui gei ni yi ge xiao jiang li 。]

english: Temple Trekking begins
translation: 寺庙徒步开始 [si miao tu bu kai shi]

english: Ok, which route should we take?
translation: 好的，我们应该走哪条路？ [hao de ， wo men ying gai zou na tiao lu ？]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: 啊，所以你想给我一些物资，嗯？让我打开背包。 [a ， suo yi ni xiang gei wo yi xie wu zi ， n ？ rang wo da kai bei bao 。]

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than staying in Burgh de Rott.
translation: 哦，我讨厌这次旅行，但这比呆在 Burgh de Rott 好。 [o ， wo tao yan zhe ci lv xing ， dan zhe bi dai zai  Burgh de Rott  hao 。]

translation: 这里太可怕了……我们走吧！ [zhe li tai ke pa le …… wo men zou ba ！]

english: When are we going to get to Paterdomus?
translation: 我们什么时候去帕特多莫斯？ [wo men shen me shi hou qu pa te duo mo si ？]

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on.
translation: 我们没有一整天的时间站着聊天；让我们继续努力吧。 [wo men mei you yi zheng tian de shi jian zhan zhe liao tian ； rang wo men ji xu nu li ba 。]

english: Do you visit Paterdomus often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: 您经常拜访Paterdomus吗？看来你很熟悉这条路。 [nin jing chang bai fang Paterdomus ma ？ kan lai ni hen shu xi zhe tiao lu 。]

translation: 你没看到我正在被攻击吗……？ [ni mei kan dao wo zheng zai bei gong ji ma ……？]

english: Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
translation: 谢谢，我会把这个放在脖子上。 [xie xie ， wo hui ba zhe ge fang zai bo zi shang 。]

translation: 天啊！看来我们得回 Burgh de Rott 了。我们过不了那座桥！ [tian a ！ kan lai wo men de hui  Burgh de Rott  le 。 wo men guo bu liao na zuo qiao ！]

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
translation: 哦，我相信我们能找到办法！ [o ， wo xiang xin wo men neng zhao dao ban fa ！]

english: Player completes the bridge event
translation: 玩家完成桥牌事件 [wan jia wan cheng qiao pai shi jian]

translation: 好吧，这已经被撕裂了……看起来我们无法越过这个沼泽。我们得返回 Burgh de Rott。 [hao ba ， zhe yi jing bei si lie le …… kan qi lai wo men wu fa yue guo zhe ge zhao ze 。 wo men de fan hui  Burgh de Rott。]

english: Player completes the bog event

english: Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: 嘿……太好了……你做得很好……我会关注你的。 [hei …… tai hao le …… ni zuo de hen hao …… wo hui guan zhu ni de 。]

english: Whahay...that was great!
translation: 哇……那太好了！ [wa …… na tai hao le ！]

english: But we really should be heading off now.

translation: 哦，我相信我们能找到办法！ [o ， wo xiang xin wo men neng zhao dao ban fa ！]

translation: 帕特多莫斯在哪里？ [pa te duo mo si zai na li ？]
