translation: 如果我们遇到敌人，你能保护自己吗……？ [ru guo wo men yu dao di ren ， ni neng bao hu zi ji ma ……？]

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
translation: 我可以带你去帕特多莫斯。 [wo ke yi dai ni qu pa te duo mo si 。]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Greetings, traveller. I'd love to stop and talk, but farming is a busy line of work. Perhaps another time?
translation: 你好，旅行者。我很想停下来谈谈，但务农是一项繁忙的工作。也许下次？ [ni hao ， lv xing zhe 。 wo hen xiang ting xia lai tan tan ， dan wu nong shi yi xiang fan mang de gong zuo 。 ye xu xia ci ？]

english: Greetings, traveller. I am the Chief Farmer of Hosidius. My wife and I manage the efforts of all of our farmers.
translation: 你好，旅行者。我是霍西迪乌斯的首席农民。我和我的妻子负责管理所有农民的努力。 [ni hao ， lv xing zhe 。 wo shi huo xi di wu si de shou xi nong min 。 wo he wo de qi zi fu ze guan li suo you nong min de nu li 。]

english: How's that going?
translation: 怎么样？ [zen me yang ？]

english: Quite well but we can always be doing more. Perhaps you could help?
translation: 很好，但我们总是可以做得更多。也许你能帮忙？ [hen hao ， dan wo men zong shi ke yi zuo de geng duo 。 ye xu ni neng bang mang ？]

english: How could I help?
translation: 我能提供什么帮助吗？ [wo neng ti gong shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: We need to till the soil to prepare it for crops. Head outside and operate the ploughs along the fields.
translation: 我们需要耕耘土壤，为农作物做好准备。走到外面，沿着田地操作犁。 [wo men xu yao geng yun tu rang ， wei nong zuo wu zuo hao zhun bei 。 zou dao wai mian ， yan zhe tian di cao zuo li 。]

english: The ploughs are old and may become damaged after too much use, but I'm sure that won't be a problem for such a well trained adventurer like yourself.
translation: 犁很旧，使用过多后可能会损坏，但我确信对于像您这样训练有素的冒险家来说这不会是问题。 [li hen jiu ， shi yong guo duo hou ke neng hui sun huai ， dan wo que xin dui yu xiang nin zhe yang xun lian you su de mao xian jia lai shuo zhe bu hui shi wen ti 。]

english: That sounds like hard work, what's in it for me?
translation: 听起来好像很辛苦，这对我来说有什么好处呢？ [ting qi lai hao xiang hen xin ku ， zhe dui wo lai shuo you shen me hao chu ne ？]

english: Well, by helping us you'll become more recognized and as that happens we can offer you many benefits.
translation: 那么，通过帮助我们，您将获得更多认可，届时我们可以为您提供许多好处。 [na me ， tong guo bang zhu wo men ， nin jiang huo de geng duo ren ke ， jie shi wo men ke yi wei nin ti gong xu duo hao chu 。]

english: Thanks for the information, I'll see what I can do.
translation: 感谢您提供的信息，我会看看我能做什么。 [gan xie nin ti gong de xin xi ， wo hui kan kan wo neng zuo shen me 。]

english: Thank you, [player name]! Just find a plough to get started.
translation: 谢谢你，[玩家姓名]！只需找到一把犁即可开始。 [xie xie ni ，[ wan jia xing ming ]！ zhi xu zhao dao yi ba li ji ke kai shi 。]

english: No thanks, goodbye!
translation: 不用了，谢谢，再见！ [bu yong le ， xie xie ， zai jian ！]

english: If you change your mind just find a plough and use it.
translation: 如果您改变主意，只需找到一把犁并使用它即可。 [ru guo nin gai bian zhu yi ， zhi xu zhao dao yi ba li bing shi yong ta ji ke 。]

english: How can I help?
translation: 我能提供什么帮助吗？ [wo neng ti gong shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: Thanks for the information, I'll see what I can do.
translation: 感谢您提供的信息，我会看看我能做什么。 [gan xie nin ti gong de xin xi ， wo hui kan kan wo neng zuo shen me 。]

english: No thanks, good bye!
translation: 不用了，谢谢，再见！ [bu yong le ， xie xie ， zai jian ！]

english: No thanks, goodbye!
translation: 不用了，谢谢，再见！ [bu yong le ， xie xie ， zai jian ！]

english: Ooh, lovely view, dear.
translation: 噢，美丽的景色，亲爱的。 [o ， mei li de jing se ， qin ai de 。]

english: Yes dear.
translation: 是的亲爱的。 [shi de qin ai de 。]

english: I hope the food's better here than it was last time.
translation: 我希望这里的食物比上次更好。 [wo xi wang zhe li de shi wu bi shang ci geng hao 。]

english: I'm sure it will be, dear.
translation: 我确信会的，亲爱的。 [wo que xin hui de ， qin ai de 。]

english: Sorry to disturb you, but what are you two doing here?
translation: 抱歉打扰你们，你们两个在这里做什么？ [bao qian da rao ni men ， ni men liang ge zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Perrdur and I are having a nice romantic dinner, aren't we dear?
translation: 佩杜尔和我正在享用一顿浪漫的晚餐，不是吗，亲爱的？ [pei du er he wo zheng zai xiang yong yi dun lang man de wan can ， bu shi ma ， qin ai de ？]

english: We are celebrating the anniversary of our marriage, aren't we dear?
translation: 我们正在庆祝结婚周年纪念日，不是吗亲爱的？ [wo men zheng zai qing zhu jie hun zhou nian ji nian ri ， bu shi ma qin ai de ？]

english: And we are having a very enjoyable time, aren't we dear?
translation: 我们正在度过一段非常愉快的时光，不是吗，亲爱的？ [wo men zheng zai du guo yi duan fei chang yu kuai de shi guang ， bu shi ma ， qin ai de ？]

english: Clearly. I'll let you two lovebirds carry on, then.
translation: 清楚地。那我就让你们两个爱情鸟继续下去吧。 [qing chu di 。 na wo jiu rang ni men liang ge ai qing niao ji xu xia qu ba 。]

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!

english: Can I help you at all?

english: Why do you sell this stuff? The Crystal Bow is so much better.

english: We keep all these old toys to train our children with, but if people will part with coins for them, then they are theirs!
translation: 我们保留所有这些旧玩具来训练我们的孩子，但如果人们愿意为他们分配硬币，那么它们就是他们的了！ [wo men bao liu suo you zhe xie jiu wan ju lai xun lian wo men de hai zi ， dan ru guo ren men yuan yi wei ta men fen pei ying bi ， na me ta men jiu shi ta men de le ！]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Yes please. What are you selling?
translation: 是的，请。你卖什么？ [shi de ， qing 。 ni mai shen me ？]

english: Why do you sell this stuff?
translation: 你为什么卖这个东西？ [ni wei shen me mai zhe ge dong xi ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: You seem to really enjoy that painting.
translation: 看来你真的很喜欢那幅画。 [kan lai ni zhen de hen xi huan na fu hua 。]

english: Hello stranger.
translation: 你好陌生人。 [ni hao mo sheng ren 。]

english: *grunts*
translation: *咕哝声* [* gu nong sheng *]

english: Ah very friendly I see. What's that coffin on your back?
translation: 啊，我明白了，非常友好。你背上的棺材是什么？ [a ， wo ming bai le ， fei chang you hao 。 ni bei shang de guan cai shi shen me ？]

english: For carryin' the dead.
translation: 为了搬运死者。 [wei le ban yun si zhe 。]

english: Woah, don't tell me you have a body in there?
translation: 哇哦，难道你里面有尸体吗？ [wa o ， nan dao ni li mian you shi ti ma ？]

english: No, remains.
translation: 不，仍然存在。 [bu ， reng ran cun zai 。]

english: Oh, you carry the remains of shades in it? Could you give me one?
translation: 哦，你里面还带着墨镜的残骸吗？你能给我一份吗？ [o ， ni li mian hai dai zhuo mo jing de can hai ma ？ ni neng gei wo yi fen ma ？]

english: Dampe hands you a broken coffin.
translation: 潮湿递给你一口破损的棺材。 [chao shi di gei ni yi kou po sun de guan cai 。]

english: It's broken? What am I supposeto do with a broken coffin?
translation: 坏了？我该怎么处理破损的棺材呢？ [huai le ？ wo gai zen me chu li po sun de guan cai ne ？]

english: Bring me locks, find in the catacombs... I repair coffin with locks.
translation: 给我锁，在地下墓穴里找到……我用锁修理棺材。 [gei wo suo ， zai di xia mu xue li zhao dao …… wo yong suo xiu li guan cai 。]

english: Right... Guess I should head into the catacombs then... see if I can find any of these 'locks'.
translation: 是的...我想我应该进入地下墓穴然后...看看我是否能找到任何这些“锁”。 [shi de ... wo xiang wo ying gai jin ru di xia mu xue ran hou ... kan kan wo shi fou neng zhao dao ren he zhe xie “ suo ”。]

english: Hello again.
translation: 又好。 [you hao 。]

english: Ah, as cheerful as ever I see.
translation: 啊，和我见过的一样高兴。 [a ， he wo jian guo de yi yang gao xing 。]

english: What d'ya want.
translation: 你想要什么。 [ni xiang yao shen me 。]

english: You gave me a broken coffin, what am I supposeto do with it?
translation: 你给了我一口破棺材，我该怎么办？ [ni gei le wo yi kou po guan cai ， wo gai zen me ban ？]

english: Bring me locks, I fix coffin with locks...
translation: 给我锁，我用锁修棺材...... [gei wo suo ， wo yong suo xiu guan cai ......]

english: Right... and where am I suppose to find such locks?
translation: 对了……我该去哪里找到这样的锁呢？ [dui le …… wo gai qu na li zhao dao zhe yang de suo ne ？]

english: In catacombs... in chests...
translation: 在地下墓穴里……在箱子里…… [zai di xia mu xue li …… zai xiang zi li ……]

english: Great, thanks for the information.
translation: 太好了，谢谢您的信息。 [tai hao le ， xie xie nin de xin xi 。]

english: I found one of the locks you were talking about, I think.
translation: 我想我找到了你所说的一把锁。 [wo xiang wo zhao dao le ni suo shuo de yi ba suo 。]

english: You show Dampe the lock you found and his cold eyes light up.
translation: 你把找到的锁拿给丹普看，他冰冷的眼睛亮了起来。 [ni ba zhao dao de suo na gei dan pu kan ， ta bing leng de yan jing liang le qi lai 。]

english: That is it, give to me now and I repair the coffin.
translation: 就是这样，现在给我，我修棺材。 [jiu shi zhe yang ， xian zai gei wo ， wo xiu guan cai 。]

english: You ain't got no broken coffin for me to fix. If you need one, just ask.
translation: 你没有破棺材需要我修理。如果您需要，请询问。 [ni mei you po guan cai xu yao wo xiu li 。 ru guo nin xu yao ， qing xun wen 。]

english: You hand over the coffin and lock to Dampe.
translation: 你把棺材交给了丹佩。 [ni ba guan cai jiao gei le dan pei 。]

english: You hear him clumsily attach the lock to the coffin.
translation: 你听到他笨拙地将锁锁在棺材上。 [ni ting dao ta ben zhuo di jiang suo suo zai guan cai shang 。]

english: Finished, take it.
translation: 完了，拿走吧。 [wan le ， na zou ba 。]

english: No thanks, I'm going to hang on to it for now.
translation: 不，谢谢，我现在要坚持下去。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo xian zai yao jian chi xia qu 。]

english: Could I get another of those coffins?
translation: 我可以再拿一个这样的棺材吗？ [wo ke yi zai na yi ge zhe yang de guan cai ma ？]

english: Get lost, you've already got a coffin, I ain't givin' you anotha.
translation: 滚吧，你已经有了棺材，我不会再给你了。 [gun ba ， ni yi jing you le guan cai ， wo bu hui zai gei ni le 。]

english: It's broken?
translation: 坏了？ [huai le ？]

english: Where did you get those robes?
translation: 你从哪里得到这些长袍的？ [ni cong na li de dao zhe xie chang pao de ？]

english: Given to me.
translation: 给我的。 [gei wo de 。]

english: By who?
translation: 由谁来？ [you shui lai ？]

english: A dead friend of mine.
translation: 我的一个死去的朋友。 [wo de yi ge si qu de peng you 。]

english: Oh... how did they die?
translation: 哦……他们是怎么死的？ [o …… ta men shi zen me si de ？]

english: In the catacombs.
translation: 在地下墓穴里。 [zai di xia mu xue li 。]

english: Sorry to hear that...
translation: 很遗憾听到这个消息... [hen yi han ting dao zhe ge xiao xi ...]

english: Nothing, I just wanted to chat.
translation: 没什么，只是想聊聊。 [mei shen me ， zhi shi xiang liao liao 。]

english: Can you fix this for me?
translation: 你能为我解决这个问题吗？ [ni neng wei wo jie jue zhe ge wen ti ma ？]

english: Depends, you got any locks for it?
translation: 要看情况，你有锁吗？ [yao kan qing kuang ， ni you suo ma ？]

english: No...
Yeah, well clear off them a go find one.
translation: 是的，我们先把他们清理掉，然后去找一个。 [shi de ， wo men xian ba ta men qing li diao ， ran hou qu zhao yi ge 。]

english: Hey, I found this lock in the catacombs? Can you do anything with it?
translation: 嘿，我在地下墓穴里发现了这把锁？你能用它做任何事吗？ [hei ， wo zai di xia mu xue li fa xian le zhe ba suo ？ ni neng yong ta zuo ren he shi ma ？]

translation: *咕噜声*让'ava看看。 [* gu lu sheng * rang 'ava kan kan 。]

english: Ask about locks.
translation: 询问关于锁的问题。 [xun wen guan yu suo de wen ti 。]

translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Just wanted a chat.
translation: 只是想聊聊。 [zhi shi xiang liao liao 。]

translation: 嗨！你想请我喝一杯吗？ [hai ！ ni xiang qing wo he yi bei ma ？]

english: I think I'll pass on that.
translation: 我想我会转达这一点。 [wo xiang wo hui zhuan da zhe yi dian 。]

english: Hello, who are you?
translation: 你好，你是谁？ [ni hao ， ni shi shui ？]

english: Greetings human. I am Darcor quo Narga, a guardian for the Kahlith. Have you come to serve the balance?
translation: 问候人类。我是 Darcor quo Narga，Kahlith 的守护者。你是来服务平衡的吗？ [wen hou ren lei 。 wo shi  Darcor quo Narga，Kahlith  de shou hu zhe 。 ni shi lai fu wu ping heng de ma ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: Then you should speak to Konar quo Maten. She will guide you.
translation: 那么你应该和Konar quo Maten 谈谈。她会指导你。 [na me ni ying gai he Konar quo Maten  tan tan 。 ta hui zhi dao ni 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: A shame. You are a bringer of death, you could be of great use to the balance.
translation: 丢人现眼。你是死亡使者，你对平衡有很大的用处。 [diu ren xian yan 。 ni shi si wang shi zhe ， ni dui ping heng you hen da de yong chu 。]

english: I'm not sure.
translation: 我不知道。 [wo bu zhi dao 。]

english: Then you should speak with Xorrah quo Sihar. He will show you the way.
translation: 那么你应该和 Xorrah quo Sihar 谈谈。他会给你指路。 [na me ni ying gai he  Xorrah quo Sihar  tan tan 。 ta hui gei ni zhi lu 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: I'm not sure.
translation: 我不知道。 [wo bu zhi dao 。]

english: Why do you interrupt me, traveller? I am experimenting with dark magic; it is a dangerous craft, and I prefer not to be disturbed.
translation: 旅行者，你为什么要打扰我？我正在尝试黑魔法；这是一种危险的工艺，我不想被打扰。 [lv xing zhe ， ni wei shen me yao da rao wo ？ wo zheng zai chang shi hei mo fa ； zhe shi yi zhong wei xian de gong yi ， wo bu xiang bei da rao 。]

english: I'm just looking around.
translation: 我只是看看。 [wo zhi shi kan kan 。]

english: There's nothing to see here, just despair and death.
translation: 这里什么也看不到，只有绝望和死亡。 [zhe li shen me ye kan bu dao ， zhi you jue wang he si wang 。]

english: Can I help you with something, traveller? I am experimenting with dark magic; it is a dangerous craft, and I prefer not to be disturbed.
translation: 旅行者，我能为您提供什么帮助吗？我正在尝试黑魔法；这是一种危险的工艺，我不想被打扰。 [lv xing zhe ， wo neng wei nin ti gong shen me bang zhu ma ？ wo zheng zai chang shi hei mo fa ； zhe shi yi zhong wei xian de gong yi ， wo bu xiang bei da rao 。]

english: I'll leave you to it.
translation: 我就让你去吧。 [wo jiu rang ni qu ba 。]

english: Can you recharge my Staff of Iban?
translation: 你能给我的伊班法杖充值吗？ [ni neng gei wo de yi ban fa zhang chong zhi ma ？]

english: Your staff is already as fully charged as it can go.
translation: 您的员工已经充满电了。 [nin de yuan gong yi jing chong man dian le 。]

english: I'll want 100,000 coins to recharge the Staff of Iban.
translation: 我想要 100,000 个金币来充值伊班之杖。 [wo xiang yao  100,000  ge jin bi lai chong zhi yi ban zhi zhang 。]

english: The mage summons the power of Zamorak and recharges your Staff of Iban.
translation: 法师召唤萨莫拉克的力量并为你的伊班法杖充能。 [fa shi zhao huan sa mo la ke de li liang bing wei ni de yi ban fa zhang chong neng 。]

english: Can you upgrade my Staff of Iban?
translation: 你能升级我的伊班法杖吗？ [ni neng sheng ji wo de yi ban fa zhang ma ？]

english: Hah! Yes, I can upgrade it to hold 2500 charges, enough to cast Iban's magic 2500 times at monsters or 1250 times at people like you. That'll cost you 200,000 coins.
translation: 哈！是的，我可以将它升级到容纳 2500 个电荷，足以对怪物施展伊班魔法 2500 次，或者对像你这样的人施展 1250 次。这将花费你 200,000 金币。 [ha ！ shi de ， wo ke yi jiang ta sheng ji dao rong na  2500  ge dian he ， zu yi dui guai wu shi zhan yi ban mo fa  2500  ci ， huo zhe dui xiang ni zhe yang de ren shi zhan  1250  ci 。 zhe jiang hua fei ni  200,000  jin bi 。]

english: Thanks, I'll bear it in mind.
translation: 谢谢，我会记住的。 [xie xie ， wo hui ji zhu de 。]

english: Can you repair my broken Staff of Iban?
translation: 你能修理我破损的伊班法杖吗？ [ni neng xiu li wo po sun de yi ban fa zhang ma ？]

english: You show the mage your broken staff.
translation: 你向法师展示你破损的法杖。 [ni xiang fa shi zhan shi ni po sun de fa zhang 。]

english: The Staff of Iban holds dangerous magic, traveller. I can fix it, but it will cost you - the process could kill me!
translation: 伊班之杖拥有危险的魔法，旅行者。我可以修复它，但这会让你付出代价 - 这个过程可能会杀了我！ [yi ban zhi zhang yong you wei xian de mo fa ， lv xing zhe 。 wo ke yi xiu fu ta ， dan zhe hui rang ni fu chu dai jia  -  zhe ge guo cheng ke neng hui sha le wo ！]

english: How much?
translation: 多少？ [duo shao ？]

english: 200,000 coins. That'll give it 120 charges, enough to cast Iban's magic 120 times at monsters or 60 times at people like you.
translation: 20万金币。这将给它 120 次充能，足以对怪物施展伊班魔法 120 次，或者对像你这样的人施展 60 次。 [20 wan jin bi 。 zhe jiang gei ta  120  ci chong neng ， zu yi dui guai wu shi zhan yi ban mo fa  120  ci ， huo zhe dui xiang ni zhe yang de ren shi zhan  60  ci 。]

english: Here's 200,000 coins. Please repair the staff.
translation: 这是二十万金币。请工作人员修理。 [zhe shi er shi wan jin bi 。 qing gong zuo ren yuan xiu li 。]

english: You give the mage 200,000 coins and the staff...
translation: 你给法师20万金币，给法杖…… [ni gei fa shi 20 wan jin bi ， gei fa zhang ……]

english: You give the mage 200,000 coins and the staff... The mage fixes the staff and returns it to you.
translation: 你给法师20万金币，还有法杖……法师修好法杖，然后还给你。 [ni gei fa shi 20 wan jin bi ， hai you fa zhang …… fa shi xiu hao fa zhang ， ran hou huan gei ni 。]

english: Thanks, I appreciate that.
translation: 谢谢，我很感激。 [xie xie ， wo hen gan ji 。]

english: You be careful with that thing!
translation: 你小心那个东西！ [ni xiao xin na ge dong xi ！]

english: Can you make it hold more than 120 charges?
translation: 你能让它容纳超过 120 个电量吗？ [ni neng rang ta rong na chao guo  120  ge dian liang ma ？]

english: Hah! Yes, I can upgrade it to hold 2500 charges, enough to cast Iban's magic 2500 times at monsters or 1250 times at people like you. That'll cost you 400,000 coins.
translation: 哈！是的，我可以将它升级到容纳 2500 个电荷，足以对怪物施展伊班魔法 2500 次，或者对像你这样的人施展 1250 次。这将花费你 400,000 金币。 [ha ！ shi de ， wo ke yi jiang ta sheng ji dao rong na  2500  ge dian he ， zu yi dui guai wu shi zhan yi ban mo fa  2500  ci ， huo zhe dui xiang ni zhe yang de ren shi zhan  1250  ci 。 zhe jiang hua fei ni  400,000  jin bi 。]

english: Staaaaaaaaves!
translation: 斯塔啊啊啊啊啊！ [si ta a a a a a ！]

english: Traveller, I have no idea what you are talking about. If you want my help with staves, perhaps you should show me one.
translation: 旅行者，我不知道你在说什么。如果你需要我帮忙使用法杖，也许你应该给我看一根。 [lv xing zhe ， wo bu zhi dao ni zai shuo shen me 。 ru guo ni xu yao wo bang mang shi yong fa zhang ， ye xu ni ying gai gei wo kan yi gen 。]

english: Can you recharge my Staff of Iban?
translation: 你能给我的伊班法杖充值吗？ [ni neng gei wo de yi ban fa zhang chong zhi ma ？]

english: Pay 100,000 coins to recharge it.
translation: 充值需支付10万金币。 [chong zhi xu zhi fu 10 wan jin bi 。]

english: Don't pay.
translation: 不要付钱。 [bu yao fu qian 。]

english: Can you upgrade my Staff of Iban?
translation: 你能升级我的伊班法杖吗？ [ni neng sheng ji wo de yi ban fa zhang ma ？]

english: Here's 200,000 coins. Please upgrade the staff.
translation: 这是二十万金币。请升级员工。 [zhe shi er shi wan jin bi 。 qing sheng ji yuan gong 。]

english: Thanks, I'll bear it in mind.
translation: 谢谢，我会记住的。 [xie xie ， wo hui ji zhu de 。]

english: Can you repair my broken Staff of Iban?
translation: 你能修理我破损的伊班法杖吗？ [ni neng xiu li wo po sun de yi ban fa zhang ma ？]

english: Here's 200,000 coins. Please repair the staff.
translation: 这是二十万金币。请工作人员修理。 [zhe shi er shi wan jin bi 。 qing gong zuo ren yuan xiu li 。]

english: Can you make it hold more than 120 charges?
translation: 你能让它容纳超过 120 个电量吗？ [ni neng rang ta rong na chao guo  120  ge dian liang ma ？]

english: Here's 400,000 coins. Please upgrade the staff.
translation: 这是四十万金币。请升级员工。 [zhe shi si shi wan jin bi 。 qing sheng ji yuan gong 。]

english: I'll leave you to it.
translation: 我就让你去吧。 [wo jiu rang ni qu ba 。]

english: Recharge your Staff of Iban
translation: 为你的伊班法杖充电 [wei ni de yi ban fa zhang chong dian]

english: Upgrade your Staff of Iban
translation: 升级你的伊班法杖 [sheng ji ni de yi ban fa zhang]

english: Repair your broken Staff of Iban
translation: 修复破损的伊班法杖 [xiu fu po sun de yi ban fa zhang]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Quiet! You must not break my concentration!
translation: 安静的！你绝对不能破坏我的注意力！ [an jing de ！ ni jue dui bu neng po huai wo de zhu yi li ！]

english: Why not?
translation: 为什么不呢？ [wei shen me bu ne ？]

english: Well, if my concentration is broken while keeping this rift open, the results won't be pretty.
translation: 好吧，如果我在保持裂痕打开的同时注意力不集中，结果不会很好。 [hao ba ， ru guo wo zai bao chi lie hen da kai de tong shi zhu yi li bu ji zhong ， jie guo bu hui hen hao 。]

english: In what way?
translation: 以什么方式？ [yi shen me fang shi ？]

english: If we are lucky, the heads of anyone within the Abyss will suddenly explode, including us.
translation: 如果我们幸运的话，深渊中任何人的头都会突然爆​​炸，包括我们。 [ru guo wo men xing yun de hua ， shen yuan zhong ren he ren de tou du hui tu ran bao ​​ zha ， bao kuo wo men 。]

english: Err... And if we're unlucky?
translation: 呃……如果我们运气不好呢？ [e …… ru guo wo men yun qi bu hao ne ？]

english: If we are unlucky, then the entire universe will begin to fold in upon itself, and all reality as we know it will be annihilated in a single stroke.
translation: 如果我们运气不好，那么整个宇宙将开始自我折叠，我们所知道的所有现实都将一举毁灭。 [ru guo wo men yun qi bu hao ， na me zheng ge yu zhou jiang kai shi zi wo zhe die ， wo men suo zhi dao de suo you xian shi dou jiang yi ju hui mie 。]

english: So leave me alone!
translation: 所以让我一个人静一静吧！ [suo yi rang wo yi ge ren jing yi jing ba ！]

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Do you mean what am I doing here in the Abyss? Or are you asking me what I consider my ultimate role to be in this voyage that we call life?
translation: 你的意思是我在深渊里做什么？或者你是在问我，在这场我们称之为生命的旅程中，我认为我的最终角色是什么？ [ni de yi si shi wo zai shen yuan li zuo shen me ？ huo zhe ni shi zai wen wo ， zai zhe chang wo men cheng zhi wei sheng ming de lv cheng zhong ， wo ren wei wo de zui zhong jue se shi shen me ？]

english: Err... The first one.
translation: 呃……第一个。 [e …… di yi ge 。]

english: By remaining here and holding this rift open, I am providing a permanent link between normal space and this strange dimension.
translation: 通过留在这里并保持这个裂痕打开，我在正常空间和这个奇怪的维度之间提供了永久的联系。 [tong guo liu zai zhe li bing bao chi zhe ge lie hen da kai ， wo zai zheng chang kong jian he zhe ge qi guai de wei du zhi jian ti gong le yong jiu de lian xi 。]

english: As long as my spell remains in effect, we have the capability to teleport into the Abyss.
translation: 只要我的法术仍然有效，我们就有能力传送到深渊。 [zhi yao wo de fa shu reng ran you xiao ， wo men jiu you neng li chuan song dao shen yuan 。]

english: Now leave me be! I can afford no distraction in my task!
translation: 现在别管我了！我不能在工作中分心！ [xian zai bie guan wo le ！ wo bu neng zai gong zuo zhong fen xin ！]

english: I need your help with something.
translation: 我有件事需要你帮忙。 [wo you jian shi xu yao ni bang mang 。]

english: What? Oh... very well. What did you want?
translation: 什么？哦……很好。你想要什么？ [shen me ？ o …… hen hao 。 ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Can I have another Abyssal book?
translation: 我可以再要一本《深渊》书吗？ [wo ke yi zai yao yi ben 《 shen yuan 》 shu ma ？]

english: Don't waste my time if you don't have enough free space to take it.
translation: 如果您没有足够的可用空间，请不要浪费我的时间。 [ru guo nin mei you zu gou de ke yong kong jian ， qing bu yao lang fei wo de shi jian 。]

english: Here, take it. It is important to pool our research.
translation: 在这里，拿走吧。汇集我们的研究非常重要。 [zai zhe li ， na zou ba 。 hui ji wo men de yan jiu fei chang zhong yao 。]

english: Can I have a new essence pouch?
translation: 我可以要一个新的精华袋吗？ [wo ke yi yao yi ge xin de jing hua dai ma ？]

english: Here. Be more careful with your belongings in future.
translation: 这里。以后要更加小心保管好自己的财物。 [zhe li 。 yi hou yao geng jia xiao xin bao guan hao zi ji de cai wu 。]

english: You already have a Colossal Pouch. Are you aware of the dimensional turmoil you can cause by using too many pouches at the same time?
translation: 你已经有一个巨大的袋子了。您是否意识到同时使用过多的袋子可能会造成空间混乱？ [ni yi jing you yi ge ju da de dai zi le 。 nin shi fou yi shi dao tong shi shi yong guo duo de dai zi ke neng hui zao cheng kong jian hun luan ？]

english: Now stop wasting my time!
translation: 现在别再浪费我的时间了！ [xian zai bie zai lang fei wo de shi jian le ！]

english: Can you repair my pouches?
translation: 你能修理我的袋子吗？ [ni neng xiu li wo de dai zi ma ？]

english: Fine. A simple transfiguration spell should resolve things for you.
translation: 美好的。一个简单的变形咒就能为你解决问题。 [mei hao de 。 yi ge jian dan de bian xing zhou jiu neng wei ni jie jue wen ti 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Now can you leave me alone? I can't keep affording these distractions!
translation: 现在你可以让我一个人静一静吗？我不能再承受这些干扰了！ [xian zai ni ke yi rang wo yi ge ren jing yi jing ma ？ wo bu neng zai cheng shou zhe xie gan rao le ！]

english: Actually, I don't need anything right now.
translation: 其实我现在什么都不需要。 [qi shi wo xian zai shen me dou bu xu yao 。]

english: Then go away! Honestly, you have no idea of the pressure I am under. I can't afford any distractions!
translation: 然后走开！说实话，你根本不知道我承受的压力。我不能承受任何干扰！ [ran hou zou kai ！ shuo shi hua ， ni gen ben bu zhi dao wo cheng shou de ya li 。 wo bu neng cheng shou ren he gan rao ！]

english: Sorry, I'll go.
translation: 抱歉，我这就去。 [bao qian ， wo zhe jiu qu 。]

english: Good. I'm attempting to subdue the elemental mechanisms of the universe to my will. Inane chatter from random idiots is not helping me achieve this!
translation: 好的。我试图让宇宙的基本机制屈服于我的意志。随机白痴的无聊闲聊并不能帮助我实现这一目标！ [hao de 。 wo shi tu rang yu zhou de ji ben ji zhi qu fu yu wo de yi zhi 。 sui ji bai chi de wu liao xian liao bing bu neng bang zhu wo shi xian zhe yi mu biao ！]

english: There, I have repaired your pouches. Now leave me alone. I'm concentrating!
translation: 在那里，我已经修复了你的袋子。现在别管我了。我专心了！ [zai na li ， wo yi jing xiu fu le ni de dai zi 。 xian zai bie guan wo le 。 wo zhuan xin le ！]

english: You don't seem to have any pouches in need of repair. Leave me alone!
translation: 您似乎没有任何需要修理的袋子。请别打扰我！ [nin si hu mei you ren he xu yao xiu li de dai zi 。 qing bie da rao wo ！]

english: Ah! Here you go!
translation: 啊!干得好！ [a ! gan de hao ！]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: I need you to answer this for me.
translation: 我需要你帮我回答这个问题。 [wo xu yao ni bang wo hui da zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: The Dark mage has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 黑暗法师给了你一个挑战卷轴！ [hei an fa shi gei le ni yi ge tiao zhan juan zhou ！]

english: Please answer the question.
translation: 请回答问题。 [qing hui da wen ti 。]

english: Stop wasting my time! That is wrong!
translation: 别再浪费我的时间了！那是错误的！ [bie zai lang fei wo de shi jian le ！ na shi cuo wu de ！]

english: Spot on!
translation: 现货！ [xian huo ！]

english: The Dark mage has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
translation: 黑暗法师给了你[另一张线索卷轴/一个棺材]！ [hei an fa shi gei le ni [ ling yi zhang xian suo juan zhou / yi ge guan cai ]！]

english: Why not?
translation: 为什么不呢？ [wei shen me bu ne ？]

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I need your help with something.
translation: 我有件事需要你帮忙。 [wo you jian shi xu yao ni bang mang 。]

english: Can I have another Abyssal book?
translation: 我可以再要一本《深渊》书吗？ [wo ke yi zai yao yi ben 《 shen yuan 》 shu ma ？]

english: Can I have a new essence pouch?
translation: 我可以要一个新的精华袋吗？ [wo ke yi yao yi ge xin de jing hua dai ma ？]

english: Can you repair my pouches?
translation: 你能修理我的袋子吗？ [ni neng xiu li wo de dai zi ma ？]

english: Actually, I don't need anything right now.
translation: 其实我现在什么都不需要。 [qi shi wo xian zai shen me dou bu xu yao 。]

english: Sorry, I'll go.
translation: 抱歉，我这就去。 [bao qian ， wo zhe jiu qu 。]

english: The player entered the stone circle south of Varrock with Silverlight
translation: 玩家带着Silverlight进入Varrock以南的石圈 [wan jia dai zhe Silverlight jin ru Varrock yi nan de shi quan]

english: Arise, O mighty Delrith! Bring destruction to this soft, weak city!
translation: 起来吧，强大的德里斯啊！给这座软弱的城市带来毁灭！ [qi lai ba ， qiang da de de li si a ！ gei zhe zuo ruan ruo de cheng shi dai lai hui mie ！]

english: Arise, Delrith!
translation: 起来吧，德里斯！ [qi lai ba ， de li si ！]

english: Ha ha ha! At last you are free, my demonic brother! Rest now, and then have your revenge on this pitiful city!
translation: 哈哈哈！ At last you are free, my demonic brother!现在休息吧，然后向这座可怜的城市报仇！ [ha ha ha ！ At last you are free, my demonic brother! xian zai xiu xi ba ， ran hou xiang zhe zuo ke lian de cheng shi bao chou ！]

english: Who's that?
translation: 那是谁？ [na shi shui ？]

english: Noo! Not Silverlight! Delrith is not ready yet!
translation: 不！不是银光！德里斯还没准备好！ [bu ！ bu shi yin guang ！ de li si hai mei zhun bei hao ！]

english: I've got to get out of here...
translation: 我必须离开这里... [wo bi xu li kai zhe li ...]

english: Hello! What are you doing here?
translation: 你好！你在这里做什么？ [ni hao ！ ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Hello, I am here to investigate rumours of a dark magical presence in these lands.
translation: 你好，我来这里是为了调查这些土地上存在黑暗魔法的谣言。 [ni hao ， wo lai zhe li shi wei le diao cha zhe xie tu di shang cun zai hei an mo fa de yao yan 。]

english: What rumours have you heard exactly?
translation: 你到底听到过哪些谣言？ [ni dao di ting dao guo na xie yao yan ？]

english: I've heard there are hidden ruins in the mountains here with the power to re-animate beings from the dead. Zandar Horfyre sent me to study them.
translation: 听说这里的山里隐藏着遗迹，有起死回生的力量。赞达尔·霍菲尔派我去研究它们。 [ting shuo zhe li de shan li yin cang zhe yi ji ， you qi si hui sheng de li liang 。 zan da er · huo fei er pai wo qu yan jiu ta men 。]

english: Do you know where in the mountains these ruins are?
translation: 你知道这些遗迹在山里的什么地方吗？ [ni zhi dao zhe xie yi ji zai shan li de shen me di fang ma ？]

english: Sadly no but I will find them, I will begin looking for information in Arceeus, they seem like my kind of people.
translation: 遗憾的是没有，但我会找到他们，我会开始在阿尔宙斯寻找信息，他们看起来像我这样的人。 [yi han de shi mei you ， dan wo hui zhao dao ta men ， wo hui kai shi zai a er zhou si xun zhao xin xi ， ta men kan qi lai xiang wo zhe yang de ren 。]

english: If you say so, good luck.
translation: 如果你这么说，祝你好运。 [ru guo ni zhe me shuo ， zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm working on combining the dark teleportation magic of these lands into physical form.
translation: 我正在努力将这些土地的黑暗传送魔法结合到物理形态中。 [wo zheng zai nu li jiang zhe xie tu di de hei an chuan song mo fa jie he dao wu li xing tai zhong 。]

english: Kind of like teleportation tablets?
translation: 有点像传送平板电脑？ [you dian xiang chuan song ping ban dian nao ？]

english: Yes, but not made quite the same way.
translation: 是的，但制作方法不完全相同。 [shi de ， dan zhi zuo fang fa bu wan quan xiang tong 。]

english: Can I do that?
translation: 我可以这样做吗？ [wo ke yi zhe yang zuo ma ？]

english: If you must. That lectern over there contains the book I've been working on.
translation: 如果你必须的话。那边的讲台上放着我一直在写的书。 [ru guo ni bi xu de hua 。 na bian de jiang tai shang fang zhe wo yi zhi zai xie de shu 。]

english: What are you reading?
translation: 你在读什么？ [ni zai du shen me ？]

english: I am seeking to understand more about the dark powers present in these lands. Now leave me be, there is much to be learned.
translation: 我正在寻求更多地了解这些土地上存在的黑暗力量。现在别管我了，还有很多东西要学。 [wo zheng zai xun qiu geng duo di liao jie zhe xie tu di shang cun zai de hei an li liang 。 xian zai bie guan wo le ， hai you hen duo dong xi yao xue 。]

english: C'mon, why won't this thing open?
translation: 来来来，这个东西怎么打不开？ [lai lai lai ， zhe ge dong xi zen me da bu kai ？]

english: Would you like me to give you a hand with that?
translation: 你需要我帮你吗？ [ni xu yao wo bang ni ma ？]

english: It's okay, I think I've got it... Agh, I thought I had it that time!
translation: 没关系，我想我已经得到了……啊，我以为我当时已经得到了！ [mei guan xi ， wo xiang wo yi jing de dao le …… a ， wo yi wei wo dang shi yi jing de dao le ！]

english: Why are you searching this coffin?
translation: 你为什么要搜查这口棺材？ [ni wei shen me yao sou cha zhe kou guan cai ？]

english: I need to bring that mysterious stranger 100 Hallowed marks so that he can help me escape Darkmeyer.
translation: 我需要给那个神秘的陌生人带来100个神圣标记，这样他才能帮助我逃离达克迈耶。 [wo xu yao gei na ge shen mi de mo sheng ren dai lai 100 ge shen sheng biao ji ， zhe yang ta cai neng bang zhu wo tao li da ke mai ye 。]

english: 100 seems like a lot. How many do you have so far?
translation: 100 看起来很多。到目前为止你有多少？ [100  kan qi lai hen duo 。 dao mu qian wei zhi ni you duo shao ？]

english: None.
translation: 没有任何。 [mei you ren he 。]

english: I don't have 100 either.
translation: 我也没有100 [wo ye mei you 100]

english: That's okay. I'm sure I'll get this open eventually.
translation: 没关系。我确信我最终会打开这个。 [mei guan xi 。 wo que xin wo zui zhong hui da kai zhe ge 。]

english: I happen to have 100 Hallowed marks on me. I can give you some if you'd like?
translation: 我身上正好有100个神圣标记。如果你愿意的话我可以给你一些？ [wo shen shang zheng hao you 100 ge shen sheng biao ji 。 ru guo ni yuan yi de hua wo ke yi gei ni yi xie ？]

english: Wow! You'd do that for me?
translation: 哇！你愿意为我做那件事吗？ [wa ！ ni yuan yi wei wo zuo na jian shi ma ？]

english: On second thoughts, I think I'll keep them for myself.
translation: 再想一想，我想我会把它们留给自己。 [zai xiang yi xiang ， wo xiang wo hui ba ta men liu gei zi ji 。]

english: Oh... You didn't have to tease me like that.
translation: 噢……你不必这样取笑我。 [o …… ni bu bi zhe yang qu xiao wo 。]

english: Sure. I'll probably find more while I'm down here anyway.
translation: 当然。无论如何，当我在这里的时候，我可能会发现更多。 [dang ran 。 wu lun ru he ， dang wo zai zhe li de shi hou ， wo ke neng hui fa xian geng duo 。]

english: I can't thank you enough! I can finally buy my freedom!
translation: 我对你感激不尽！我终于可以买到自由了！ [wo dui ni gan ji bu jin ！ wo zhong yu ke yi mai dao zi you le ！]

english: You're welcome!
translation: 不客气！ [bu ke qi ！]

english: The slave departs as you hand him 100 Hallowed marks.
translation: 当你递给他 100 个神圣马克时，奴隶就离开了。 [dang ni di gei ta  100  ge shen sheng ma ke shi ， nu li jiu li kai le 。]

english: It feels nice to do the right thing.
translation: 做正确的事感觉很好。 [zuo zheng que de shi gan jue hen hao 。]

english: Wait, why are you still here? I gave you the 100 Hallowed marks you need to escape.
translation: 等等，你怎么还在这里？我给了你逃脱所需的 100 个神圣标记。 [deng deng ， ni zen me hai zai zhe li ？ wo gei le ni tao tuo suo xu de  100  ge shen sheng biao ji 。]

english: I think you have me mistaken for someone else.
translation: 我想你把我误认为是别人了。 [wo xiang ni ba wo wu ren wei shi bie ren le 。]

english: Now go away. I can't hear the locking mechanism with you breathing in my ear!
translation: 现在走开。你在我耳边呼吸，我听不到锁定装置的声音！ [xian zai zou kai 。 ni zai wo er bian hu xi ， wo ting bu dao suo ding zhuang zhi de sheng yin ！]

english: C'mon, almost got it...
translation: 来吧，差不多明白了... [lai ba ， cha bu duo ming bai le ...]

english: Agh, thought I had it that time!
translation: 啊，我以为我当时就拥有了！ [a ， wo yi wei wo dang shi jiu yong you le ！]

english: Don't give him 100 Hallowed marks.
translation: 不要给他100点神圣分数。 [bu yao gei ta 100 dian shen sheng fen shu 。]

english: Give him 100 Hallowed marks.
translation: 给他100点神圣分数。 [gei ta 100 dian shen sheng fen shu 。]

english: How am I supposed to get past this?
translation: 我该如何度过这个难关呢？ [wo gai ru he du guo zhe ge nan guan ne ？]

english: Gah!
translation: 嘎！ [ga ！]

english: Hopefully I'll make it out of Darkmeyer one day.
translation: 希望有一天我能走出达克梅尔。 [xi wang you yi tian wo neng zou chu da ke mei er 。]

english: Phew, I made it! Time for a break.
translation: 唷，我成功了！是时候休息一下了。 [yo ， wo cheng gong le ！ shi shi hou xiu xi yi xia le 。]

english: Thank Saradomin that mysterious stranger gave me this ring or I'd be toast!
translation: 感谢萨拉多明那个神秘的陌生人给了我这枚戒指，否则我就完蛋了！ [gan xie sa la duo ming na ge shen mi de mo sheng ren gei le wo zhe mei jie zhi ， fou ze wo jiu wan dan le ！]

english: That trap was harder than I thought! Perhaps I'm not cut out for this.
translation: 那个陷阱比我想象的还要难！也许我不适合这个。 [na ge xian jing bi wo xiang xiang de hai yao nan ！ ye xu wo bu shi he zhe ge 。]

english: I can't believe we've finally arrived, I can't wait to explore!
translation: 我不敢相信我们终于到达了，我迫不及待地想探索！ [wo bu gan xiang xin wo men zhong yu dao da le ， wo po bu ji dai di xiang tan suo ！]

english: So much to see, I don't know where to start!
translation: 太多东西要看，我不知道从哪里开始！ [tai duo dong xi yao kan ， wo bu zhi dao cong na li kai shi ！]

english: A whole new continent to explore... what a time to be alive!
translation: 一个全新的大陆等待探索……多么美好的时光啊！ [yi ge quan xin de da lu deng dai tan suo …… duo me mei hao de shi guang a ！]

english: Are you the tour guide?
translation: 你是导游吗？ [ni shi dao you ma ？]

english: Nope, I'm just as lost as you.
translation: 不，我和你一样迷失。 [bu ， wo he ni yi yang mi shi 。]

english: I overheard someone mention there are pirates and thieves here, be careful!
translation: 我无意中听到有人说这里有海盗和小偷，要小心！ [wo wu yi zhong ting dao you ren shuo zhe li you hai dao he xiao tou ， yao xiao xin ！]

english: What's the device saying now?
translation: 设备现在说什么？ [she bei xian zai shuo shen me ？]

english: I don't know. It's giving strange readings...
translation: 我不知道。它给出了奇怪的读数...... [wo bu zhi dao 。 ta gei chu le qi guai de du shu ......]

english: I'm not even sure it's working any more.
translation: 我什至不确定它是否还能正常工作。 [wo shen zhi bu que ding ta shi fou hai neng zheng chang gong zuo 。]

english: This is a wild goose chase! We trek halfway across the world and there's nothing down here but this bunch of useless goblins!
translation: 这是一场徒劳的追逐！我们跋涉了半个地球，下面除了这群没用的妖精什么都没有！ [zhe shi yi chang tu lao de zhui zhu ！ wo men ba she le ban ge di qiu ， xia mian chu le zhe qun mei yong de yao jing shen me dou mei you ！]

english: I am sure my triangulation calculations indicated that the source of power was in this rough area...
translation: 我确信我的三角测量表明能量的来源就在这个粗糙的区域...... [wo que xin wo de san jiao ce liang biao ming neng liang de lai yuan jiu zai zhe ge cu cao de qu yu ......]

english: I find it encouraging that it's pointed to somewhere where there actually are caves.
translation: 我发现它指向确实有洞穴的地方，这令人鼓舞。 [wo fa xian ta zhi xiang que shi you dong xue de di fang ， zhe ling ren gu wu 。]

english: This part of the world is riddled with caves! It's hard not to hit a cave around here! Are you sure you're not just picking up these goblin lanterns or something stupid?
translation: 世界的这个地方充满了洞穴！这附近很难不撞到山洞！你确定你不是只是捡起这些妖精灯笼或其他愚蠢的东西吗？ [shi jie de zhe ge di fang chong man le dong xue ！ zhe fu jin hen nan bu zhuang dao shan dong ！ ni que ding ni bu shi zhi shi jian qi zhe xie yao jing deng long huo qi ta yu chun de dong xi ma ？]

english: You should have more faith in my skills as a mage! I've been working on this for years-
translation: 你应该更加相信我作为法师的实力！我多年来一直致力于这个—— [ni ying gai geng jia xiang xin wo zuo wei fa shi de shi li ！ wo duo nian lai yi zhi zhi li yu zhe ge ——]

english: Gah! We have an eavesdropper! Buzz off, adventurer - go talk to the goblins or something.
translation: 嘎！我们有窃听者！走开，冒险家——去和哥布林说话什么的。 [ga ！ wo men you qie ting zhe ！ zou kai ， mao xian jia —— qu he ge bu lin shuo hua shen me de 。]

english: Okay, I won't bother you.
translation: 好吧，我不打扰你了。 [hao ba ， wo bu da rao ni le 。]

english: That's what I like to see: a polite adventurer! Now, where was I...
translation: 这就是我喜欢看到的：一个有礼貌的冒险家！现在，我在哪里... [zhe jiu shi wo xi huan kan dao de ： yi ge you li mao de mao xian jia ！ xian zai ， wo zai na li ...]

english: What are you looking for?
translation: 你要买什么？ [ni yao mai shen me ？]

english: None of your business!
translation: 关你屁事！ [guan ni pi shi ！]

english: Hey, I'm one of you guys! See this pendant?
translation: 嘿，我是你们中的一员！看到这个吊坠了吗？ [hei ， wo shi ni men zhong de yi yuan ！ kan dao zhe ge diao zhui le ma ？]

english: Where did you come from? Who sent you? I'll have you know I'm the mage's bodyguard for this job. We don't need anyone else!
translation: 你从哪里来？谁派你来的？我会让你知道我是这项工作的法师的保镖。我们不需要其他人！ [ni cong na li lai ？ shui pai ni lai de ？ wo hui rang ni zhi dao wo shi zhe xiang gong zuo de fa shi de bao biao 。 wo men bu xu yao qi ta ren ！]

english: No one sent me, I'm just nosy.
translation: 没有人派我来，我只是多管闲事。 [mei you ren pai wo lai ， wo zhi shi duo guan xian shi 。]

english: Well stick your nose somewhere else!
translation: 好吧，把你的鼻子伸到别的地方吧！ [hao ba ， ba ni de bi zi shen dao bie de di fang ba ！]

english: I'm sorry, but pendant or no pendant, this is a secret. I'm sure you understand.
translation: 抱歉，无论有没有吊坠，这是一个秘密。我相信你明白。 [bao qian ， wu lun you mei you diao zhui ， zhe shi yi ge mi mi 。 wo xiang xin ni ming bai 。]

english: Lucien sent me.
translation: 吕西安派我来的。 [lv xi an pai wo lai de 。]

english: He did not! If he had, I would be aware of it!
translation: 他没有！如果他有的话，我会知道的！ [ta mei you ！ ru guo ta you de hua ， wo hui zhi dao de ！]

english: Don't try to lie to us! Now go away!
translation: 不要试图对我们撒谎！现在走开！ [bu yao shi tu dui wo men sa huang ！ xian zai zou kai ！]

english: I'm sure you're a much better bodyguard than me, but perhaps I can help in some non-bodyguarding way?
translation: 我确信你是一个比我更好的保镖，但也许我可以以某种非保镖的方式提供帮助？ [wo que xin ni shi yi ge bi wo geng hao de bao biao ， dan ye xu wo ke yi yi mou zhong fei bao biao de fang shi ti gong bang zhu ？]

english: Well, we don't know how big this thing is. If we find it, I suppose we might need someone else to help us carry it.
translation: 好吧，我们不知道这东西有多大。如果我们找到它，我想我们可能需要其他人来帮助我们搬运它。 [hao ba ， wo men bu zhi dao zhe dong xi you duo da 。 ru guo wo men zhao dao ta ， wo xiang wo men ke neng xu yao qi ta ren lai bang zhu wo men ban yun ta 。]

english: So, what are we looking for?
translation: 那么，我们在寻找什么？ [na me ， wo men zai xun zhao shen me ？]

english: You're not very well briefed, are you?
translation: 你的情况不太清楚，是吗？ [ni de qing kuang bu tai qing chu ， shi ma ？]

english: To be honest I'm still a bit hazy on that point too.
translation: 说实话，我对这一点也还有些模糊。 [shuo shi hua ， wo dui zhe yi dian ye hai you xie mo hu 。]

english: *sigh*
translation: *叹* [* tan *]

english: Lucien has asked us to search for artefacts that give off a very specific type of energy. After many years of research, I think I'm finally drawing near.
translation: 卢西安要求我们寻找能够散发出一种非常特殊的能量的文物。经过多年的研究，我想我终于接近了。 [lu xi an yao qiu wo men xun zhao neng gou san fa chu yi zhong fei chang te shu de neng liang de wen wu 。 jing guo duo nian de yan jiu ， wo xiang wo zhong yu jie jin le 。]

english: You don't sound very sure.
translation: 你听起来不太确定。 [ni ting qi lai bu tai que ding 。]

english: Bah! My detection device is totally shot. I don't understand it.
translation: 呸!我的探测装置完全失效了。我不明白。 [pei ! wo de tan ce zhuang zhi wan quan shi xiao le 。 wo bu ming bai 。]

english: I wouldn't hang around for now, adventurer. It could be a long while before I can get a clear reading.
translation: 我暂时不会闲逛，冒险者。我可能需要很长时间才能获得清晰的读数。 [wo zan shi bu hui xian guang ， mao xian zhe 。 wo ke neng xu yao hen zhang shi jian cai neng huo de qing xi de du shu 。]

english: Okay, I'll be on my way.
translation: 好的，我这就上路。 [hao de ， wo zhe jiu shang lu 。]

english: Okay, I won't bother you.
translation: 好吧，我不打扰你了。 [hao ba ， wo bu da rao ni le 。]

english: What are you looking for?
translation: 你要买什么？ [ni yao mai shen me ？]

english: Hey, I'm one of you guys! See this pendant?
translation: 嘿，我是你们中的一员！看到这个吊坠了吗？ [hei ， wo shi ni men zhong de yi yuan ！ kan dao zhe ge diao zhui le ma ？]

english: No one sent me, I'm just nosy.
translation: 没有人派我来，我只是多管闲事。 [mei you ren pai wo lai ， wo zhi shi duo guan xian shi 。]

english: Lucien sent me.
translation: 吕西安派我来的。 [lv xi an pai wo lai de 。]

english: (Charm) I'm sure you're a much better bodyguard than me...
translation: （魅力）我确信你是一个比我更好的保镖...... [（ mei li ） wo que xin ni shi yi ge bi wo geng hao de bao biao ......]

english: What are you buying?
translation: 你买什么？ [ni mai shen me ？]

english: Show me what you have.
translation: 让我看看你有什么。 [rang wo kan kan ni you shen me 。]

english: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这附近做什么？ [ni zai zhe fu jin zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm responsible for organising and selling off any surplus ranging supplies.
translation: 我负责组织和出售任何剩余的供应品。 [wo fu ze zu zhi he chu shou ren he sheng yu de gong ying pin 。]

english: Those fellows over in Lovakengj are an efficient bunch... They often produce far more than the army actually needs.
translation: 洛瓦肯杰的那些人是一群高效的人……他们生产的东西常常远远超过军队的实际需要。 [luo wa ken jie de na xie ren shi yi qun gao xiao de ren …… ta men sheng chan de dong xi chang chang yuan yuan chao guo jun dui de shi ji xu yao 。]

english: I've got a wide selection of ranged weapons and ammo, if you wanted to take a look? Its all good stuff.
translation: 我有多种远程武器和弹药供您选择，您想看一下吗？都是好东西。 [wo you duo zhong yuan cheng wu qi he dan yao gong nin xuan ze ， nin xiang kan yi xia ma ？ dou shi hao dong xi 。]

english: I don't think I need anything.
translation: 我认为我不需要任何东西。 [wo ren wei wo bu xu yao ren he dong xi 。]

english: Hmph...
translation: 哼…… [heng ……]

english: Show me what you have.
translation: 让我看看你有什么。 [rang wo kan kan ni you shen me 。]

english: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这附近做什么？ [ni zai zhe fu jin zuo shen me ？]

english: I don't think I need anything.
translation: 我认为我不需要任何东西。 [wo ren wei wo bu xu yao ren he dong xi 。]

english: Today is a good day to be a frog!
translation: 今天是当青蛙的好日子！ [jin tian shi dang qing wa de hao ri zi ！]

english: It sure is. Now that we have peace, life is at an all time high!
translation: 确实如此。现在我们有了和平，生活达到了前所未有的高度！ [que shi ru ci 。 xian zai wo men you le he ping ， sheng huo da dao le qian suo wei you de gao du ！]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: 'Ello [guv/miss].
translation: 'Ello [先生/小姐]。 ['Ello [ xian sheng / xiao jie ]。]

english: Why are you not helping out the others?
translation: 你为什么不帮助别人呢？ [ni wei shen me bu bang zhu bie ren ne ？]

english: Well you see, [guv/miss], I've got these unshakable religious convictions.
translation: 好吧，你看，[先生/小姐]，我有这些不可动摇的宗教信仰。 [hao ba ， ni kan ，[ xian sheng / xiao jie ]， wo you zhe xie bu ke dong yao de zong jiao xin yang 。]

english: And those are?
translation: 那些是？ [na xie shi ？]

english: Well, it's like this, see. I used to do a bit of the old priestin' on the side.
translation: 嗯，就是这样，看吧。我曾经兼职做一些老牧师的事。 [n ， jiu shi zhe yang ， kan ba 。 wo ceng jing jian zhi zuo yi xie lao mu shi de shi 。]

english: You know, collectin' for repairs to the church roof, passing the collection plate, jumble sales, nicking the lead off the temple roof so they needed repairing again.
translation: 你知道，收集修复教堂屋顶的资金，传递收集盘，杂货销售，从寺庙屋顶上割下铅，这样他们就需要再次修复。 [ni zhi dao ， shou ji xiu fu jiao tang wu ding de zi jin ， chuan di shou ji pan ， za huo xiao shou ， cong si miao wu ding shang ge xia qian ， zhe yang ta men jiu xu yao zai ci xiu fu 。]

english: Real holy stuff, you know.
translation: 真正神圣的东西，你知道。 [zhen zheng shen sheng de dong xi ， ni zhi dao 。]

english: That doesn't sound all that holy to me.
translation: 这对我来说听起来并不那么神圣。 [zhe dui wo lai shuo ting qi lai bing bu na me shen sheng 。]

english: Well, that's because you're not a [man/woman] of the cloth are you?
translation: 嗯，那是因为你不是布衣的[男人/女人]，是吗？ [n ， na shi yin wei ni bu shi bu yi de [ nan ren / nv ren ]， shi ma ？]

english: You are, in fact, what we refer to in layman's terms as a punter.
translation: 事实上，您就是我们通俗地说的下注者。 [shi shi shang ， nin jiu shi wo men tong su di shuo de xia zhu zhe 。]

english: But anyway, all that priestin' left me with an unshakable faith in three things.
translation: 但无论如何，所有这些牧师活动让我对三件事产生了不可动摇的信念。 [dan wu lun ru he ， suo you zhe xie mu shi huo dong rang wo dui san jian shi chan sheng le bu ke dong yao de xin nian 。]

english: The power of good over evil.
translation: 善战胜恶的力量。 [shan zhan sheng e de li liang 。]

english: The true glory of the human spirit.
translation: 人类精神的真正荣耀。 [ren lei jing shen de zhen zheng rong yao 。]

english: And that I ain't goin out there with those things runnin' around.
translation: 我不会带着那些东西到处乱跑。 [wo bu hui dai zhe na xie dong xi dao chu luan pao 。]

english: You used to be a priest, right?
translation: 你以前是个牧师，对吗？ [ni yi qian shi ge mu shi ， dui ma ？]

english: I didn't nick anything, [guv/miss]. I've got twenty people who'll swear blind I was...
translation: 我没有划伤任何东西，[先生/小姐]。我有二十个人会发誓我是盲目的... [wo mei you hua shang ren he dong xi ，[ xian sheng / xiao jie ]。 wo you er shi ge ren hui fa shi wo shi mang mu di ...]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: Never mind. I need some help with the spirit in the brewing equipment.
translation: 没关系。我需要一些有关酿造设备中的烈酒的帮助。 [mei guan xi 。 wo xu yao yi xie you guan niang zao she bei zhong de lie jiu de bang zhu 。]

english: Well, I'll bless something for you if you need it, but just don't spread it around that I'm giving out freebies.
translation: 好吧，如果你需要的话，我会为你祝福一些东西，但不要散布我正在赠送免费赠品。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni xu yao de hua ， wo hui wei ni zhu fu yi xie dong xi ， dan bu yao san bu wo zheng zai zeng song mian fei zeng pin 。]

english: Trust me, [guv/miss], lots of people need help after coming into contact with the spirits we produce here.
translation: 相信我，[先生/小姐]，很多人在接触我们这里生产的烈酒后都需要帮助。 [xiang xin wo ，[ xian sheng / xiao jie ]， hen duo ren zai jie chu wo men zhe li sheng chan de lie jiu hou dou xu yao bang zhu 。]

english: Can you bless this wrench for me?
translation: 你能为我祝福这把扳手吗？ [ni neng wei wo zhu fu zhe ba ban shou ma ？]

english: Nope.
translation: 没有。 [mei you 。]

english: Nope?
translation: 没有？ [mei you ？]

english: Nope. You don't strike me as being... devout, you know?
translation: 没有。我觉得你并不……虔诚，你知道吗？ [mei you 。 wo jue de ni bing bu …… qian cheng ， ni zhi dao ma ？]

english: Come again?
translation: 再来一次？ [zai lai yi ci ？]

english: Your holy aura, it's a little shoddy, if you catch my drift.
translation: 如果你明白我的意思的话，你的神圣光环有点粗制滥造。 [ru guo ni ming bai wo de yi si de hua ， ni de shen sheng guang huan you dian cu zhi lan zao 。]

english: You need a Prayer level of 47.
translation: 您的祈祷等级需要达到 47 级。 [nin de qi dao deng ji xu yao da dao  47  ji 。]

english: Oh!
Well why didn't you just say so?
translation: 那么你为什么不直接这么说呢？ [na me ni wei shen me bu zhi jie zhe me shuo ne ？]

english: I might have had a bit of an overestimation problem [guv/miss]. I'm sure it won't happen again.
translation: 我可能有点高估了问题[guv/miss]。我确信这种事不会再发生了。 [wo ke neng you dian gao gu le wen ti [guv/miss]。 wo que xin zhe zhong shi bu hui zai fa sheng le 。]

english: I might well do. Remember, only the first one's free.
translation: 我可能会这么做。请记住，只有第一个是免费的。 [wo ke neng hui zhe me zuo 。 qing ji zhu ， zhi you di yi ge shi mian fei de 。]

english: Dominoes Ad Nauseum, Romanes Eunt Domus.
translation: 令人作呕的多米诺骨牌，Romanes Eunt Domus。 [ling ren zuo ou de duo mi nuo gu pai ，Romanes Eunt Domus。]

english: Sorted.
translation: 已排序。 [yi pai xu 。]

english: Is that it?
translation: 是这样吗？ [shi zhe yang ma ？]

english: Oh, you want the full package deal.
translation: 哦，您想要完整的套餐优惠。 [o ， nin xiang yao wan zheng de tao can you hui 。]

english: All right. Brace yourself.
translation: 好的。振作起来。 [hao de 。 zhen zuo qi lai 。]

english: Groovy.
translation: 好极了。 [hao ji le 。]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: No problem, [guv/miss]. Good luck with your little problem.
translation: 没问题，[先生/小姐]。祝你的小问题好运。 [mei wen ti ，[ xian sheng / xiao jie ]。 zhu ni de xiao wen ti hao yun 。]

english: You might find that little wrench worth hanging on to after you're done with the Spirit.
translation: 当你用完圣灵之后，你可能会发现那把小扳手值得抓住。 [dang ni yong wan sheng ling zhi hou ， ni ke neng hui fa xian na ba xiao ban shou zhi de zhua zhu 。]

english: Really? I mean, it's holy and everything, but I don't think it looks all that useful.
translation: 真的吗？我的意思是，它很神圣，但我不认为它看起来那么有用。 [zhen de ma ？ wo de yi si shi ， ta hen shen sheng ， dan wo bu ren wei ta kan qi lai na me you yong 。]

english: Well, it may not look much, but you'll find that you might need a few less prayer potions if you have it in your pack, if you know what I mean.
translation: 好吧，它可能看起来不多，但你会发现，如果你的背包里有它，你可能会需要更少的祈祷药水，如果你明白我的意思的话。 [hao ba ， ta ke neng kan qi lai bu duo ， dan ni hui fa xian ， ru guo ni de bei bao li you ta ， ni ke neng hui xu yao geng shao de qi dao yao shui ， ru guo ni ming bai wo de yi si de hua 。]

english: Well, no. I don't know what you mean, but I'm sure I'll find out!

translation: 你好，凡人。你是来找回你死后丢失的东西吗？ [ni hao ， fan ren 。 ni shi lai zhao hui ni si hou diu shi de dong xi ma ？]

english: How does that work?
translation: 这是如何运作的？ [zhe shi ru he yun zuo de ？]

english: When you die, you often drop things you were carrying. In most cases, a gravestone appears near where you died, and your items can be retrieved there.
translation: 当你死时，你经常会掉落你携带的东西。在大多数情况下，墓碑会出现在您死亡的地方附近，您可以在那里取回您的物品。 [dang ni si shi ， ni jing chang hui diao luo ni xie dai de dong xi 。 zai da duo shu qing kuang xia ， mu bei hui chu xian zai nin si wang de di fang fu jin ， nin ke yi zai na li qu hui nin de wu pin 。]

english: However, gravestones do not last for long. When your gravestone collapses, your items come here, to me. I can return them to you - though I charge a fee for my services.
translation: 然而，墓碑的寿命并不长。当你的墓碑倒塌时，你的物品就会来到这里，交给我。我可以将它们退还给您 - 尽管我会收取服务费用。 [ran er ， mu bei de shou ming bing bu zhang 。 dang ni de mu bei dao ta shi ， ni de wu pin jiu hui lai dao zhe li ， jiao gei wo 。 wo ke yi jiang ta men tui huan gei nin  -  jin guan wo hui shou qu fu wu fei yong 。]

english: Aside from that, if you bring me your unwanted possessions, and sacrifice them into my Coffer here, I'll count their value against any future fees I charge you.
translation: 除此之外，如果你把你不想要的东西带给我，并把它们牺牲到我的保险箱里，我会把它们的价值计入我以后向你收取的费用中。 [chu ci zhi wai ， ru guo ni ba ni bu xiang yao de dong xi dai gei wo ， bing ba ta men xi sheng dao wo de bao xian xiang li ， wo hui ba ta men de jia zhi ji ru wo yi hou xiang ni shou qu de fei yong zhong 。]

english: I don't accept just any junk, but I'll try to give you a good price for anything decent.
translation: 我不接受任何垃圾，但我会尽力为任何像样的东西给你一个好价格。 [wo bu jie shou ren he la ji ， dan wo hui jin li wei ren he xiang yang de dong xi gei ni yi ge hao jia ge 。]

english: So do you need to retrieve something you lost when you died?
translation: 那么你死后丢失的东西需要找回吗？ [na me ni si hou diu shi de dong xi xu yao zhao hui ma ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: As you should be able to see, I am Death. The Grim Reaper. The Inexorable One. The Inescapable Grasp of Mortal Destiny. And this is my little office. Nice, isn't it?
translation: 正如你应该看到的，我就是死亡。死神。无情者。不可避免的凡人命运的掌握。这是我的小办公室。很好，不是吗？ [zheng ru ni ying gai kan dao de ， wo jiu shi si wang 。 si shen 。 wu qing zhe 。 bu ke bi mian de fan ren ming yun de zhang wo 。 zhe shi wo de xiao ban gong shi 。 hen hao ， bu shi ma ？]

english: It's lovely.
translation: 很可爱。 [hen ke ai 。]

english: Thank you. I feel the colour scheme suits my style. Now, can I help you retrieve something you lost when you died?
translation: 谢谢。我觉得配色方案适合我的风格。现在，我可以帮你找回你去世时丢失的东西吗？ [xie xie 。 wo jue de pei se fang an shi he wo de feng ge 。 xian zai ， wo ke yi bang ni zhao hui ni qu shi shi diu shi de dong xi ma ？]

english: Your decorations leave a bit to be desired.
translation: 你的装饰还有点不尽如人意。 [ni de zhuang shi hai you dian bu jin ru ren yi 。]

english: Sometimes it's hard to care for beauty when one's very existence is just seen as a curse upon the world. Now, do you actually want to retrieve something from me?
translation: 有时，当一个人的存在被视为对世界的诅咒时，就很难关心美丽。现在，你真的想从我这里拿回什么东西吗？ [you shi ， dang yi ge ren de cun zai bei shi wei dui shi jie de zu zhou shi ， jiu hen nan guan xin mei li 。 xian zai ， ni zhen de xiang cong wo zhe li na hui shen me dong xi ma ？]

english: Yes, have you got anything for me?
translation: 是的，你有什么东西要给我吗？ [shi de ， ni you shen me dong xi yao gei wo ma ？]

english: Can I choose a different-looking gravestone?
translation: 我可以选择外观不同的墓碑吗？ [wo ke yi xuan ze wai guan bu tong de mu bei ma ？]

english: You haven't got 200,000 coins to pay for that. I can take coins from your inventory, or from my Coffer.
translation: 你没有 200,000 个金币来支付这个费用。我可以从你的库存或我的保险箱中取出硬币。 [ni mei you  200,000  ge jin bi lai zhi fu zhe ge fei yong 。 wo ke yi cong ni de ku cun huo wo de bao xian xiang zhong qu chu ying bi 。]

english: Actually, never mind.
translation: 其实，没关系。 [qi shi ， mei guan xi 。]

english: Most people won't see your grave, by the way. It appears to you, but it aims to be invisible to everyone else. Are you sure you want to buy a cosmetic override for it?
translation: 顺便说一句，大多数人不会看到你的坟墓。它对你来说是可见的，但它的目的是对其他人来说是不可见的。您确定要为其购买化妆品覆盖吗？ [shun bian shuo yi ju ， da duo shu ren bu hui kan dao ni de fen mu 。 ta dui ni lai shuo shi ke jian de ， dan ta de mu di shi dui qi ta ren lai shuo shi bu ke jian de 。 nin que ding yao wei qi gou mai hua zhuang pin fu gai ma ？]

english: Yes, I understand other people won't often see it.
translation: 是的，我知道其他人不会经常看到它。 [shi de ， wo zhi dao qi ta ren bu hui jing chang kan dao ta 。]

english: Your gravestone is now the Angel of Death.
translation: 你的墓碑现在是死亡天使。 [ni de mu bei xian zai shi si wang tian shi 。]

english: It is not for me to judge how people spend their money.
translation: 我不应该评判人们如何花钱。 [wo bu ying gai ping pan ren men ru he hua qian 。]

english: No thanks, it's not worth it.
translation: 不，谢谢，这不值得。 [bu ， xie xie ， zhe bu zhi de 。]

english: Do you really want to switch to the basic gravestone? I'm not offering to give back the fee you paid earlier.
translation: 您真的想切换到基本墓碑吗？我不会退还您之前支付的费用。 [nin zhen de xiang qie huan dao ji ben mu bei ma ？ wo bu hui tui huan nin zhi qian zhi fu de fei yong 。]

english: Yes, I want the basic gravestone.
translation: 是的，我想要基本的墓碑。 [shi de ， wo xiang yao ji ben de mu bei 。]

english: Your gravestone is now the basic type.
translation: 您的墓碑现在是基本类型。 [nin de mu bei xian zai shi ji ben lei xing 。]

english: You've already got the basic gravestone.
translation: 您已经有了基本的墓碑。 [nin yi jing you le ji ben de mu bei 。]

english: Er... I suppose so.
translation: 呃……我想是的。 [e …… wo xiang shi de 。]

english: How would you like to... die?
translation: 你想怎么死？ [ni xiang zen me si ？]

english: Not just now, thanks.
translation: 不只是现在，谢谢。 [bu zhi shi xian zai ， xie xie 。]

english: Really? There isn't much else for you to do here. But you know your business.
translation: 真的吗？您在这里没有什么可做的。但你知道你的事。 [zhen de ma ？ nin zai zhe li mei you shen me ke zuo de 。 dan ni zhi dao ni de shi 。]

english: Hello mortal. If you're looking for something you lost when you died, I'm afraid I don't cater to Ultimate Ironmen. Your items would have fallen on the ground where you died.
translation: 你好，凡人。如果你正在寻找你死后丢失的东西，恐怕我不适合终极铁人。你的物品会掉在你死的地方。 [ni hao ， fan ren 。 ru guo ni zheng zai xun zhao ni si hou diu shi de dong xi ， kong pa wo bu shi he zhong ji tie ren 。 ni de wu pin hui diao zai ni si de di fang 。]

english: Can I change how I die?
translation: 我可以改变我的死亡方式吗？ [wo ke yi gai bian wo de si wang fang shi ma ？]

english: So, mortal... you have died, as all mortals do. As you have suffered the loss of some items on this occasion, I have brought you here to explain for you how that works.
translation: 所以，凡人……你已经死了，就像所有凡人一样。由于您这次丢失了一些物品，我带您来这里为您解释一下这是如何运作的。 [suo yi ， fan ren …… ni yi jing si le ， jiu xiang suo you fan ren yi yang 。 you yu nin zhe ci diu shi le yi xie wu pin ， wo dai nin lai zhe li wei nin jie shi yi xia zhe shi ru he yun zuo de 。]

english: I lost items? Can I get them back?
translation: 我丢失了物品？我可以把它们找回来吗？ [wo diu shi le wu pin ？ wo ke yi ba ta men zhao hui lai ma ？]

english: Let me explain... Across most of the land of Gielinor, when you die, some of the items you're carrying are dropped.
translation: 让我解释一下……在吉林诺的大部分土地上，当你死亡时，你携带的一些物品都会掉落。 [rang wo jie shi yi xia …… zai ji lin nuo de da bu fen tu di shang ， dang ni si wang shi ， ni xie dai de yi xie wu pin du hui diao luo 。]

english: I will look after such items,without a time limit. However, I do charge more for my services. It would be cheaper to retrieve them from the gravestone directly, if you can reach it in time.
translation: 我会照顾这些物品，没有时间限制。不过，我的服务收费确实更高。如果你能及时到达的话，直接从墓碑上取回它们会更便宜。 [wo hui zhao gu zhe xie wu pin ， mei you shi jian xian zhi 。 bu guo ， wo de fu wu shou fei que shi geng gao 。 ru guo ni neng ji shi dao da de hua ， zhi jie cong mu bei shang qu hui ta men hui geng pian yi 。]

english: Tell me about gravestones again.
translation: 再给我讲讲墓碑的事。 [zai gei wo jiang jiang mu bei de shi 。]

english: Gladly... Across most of the land of Gielinor, when you die, some of the items you're carrying are dropped.
translation: 很高兴...在吉林诺的大部分土地上，当你死亡时，你携带的一些物品都会掉落。 [hen gao xing ... zai ji lin nuo de da bu fen tu di shang ， dang ni si wang shi ， ni xie dai de yi xie wu pin du hui diao luo 。]

english: How do I pay a gravestone fee?
translation: 如何支付墓碑费？ [ru he zhi fu mu bei fei ？]

english: Cash is always acceptable. Also, a gravestone can take it directly from you bank, in case you didn't have enough with you.
translation: 现金总是可以接受的。此外，墓碑可以直接从您的银行取出，以防您随身携带的钱不够。 [xian jin zong shi ke yi jie shou de 。 ci wai ， mu bei ke yi zhi jie cong nin de yin hang qu chu ， yi fang nin sui shen xie dai de qian bu gou 。]

english: Besides that, take a look at my Coffer here. You can bring your unwanted possessions, and sacrifice them into my Coffer. I'll count their value against any future gravestone fees you're charged.
translation: 除此之外，看看我这里的保险箱。你可以带上你不想要的东西，把它们献祭到我的保险箱里。我会将它们的价值与您未来收取的任何墓碑费一起计算。 [chu ci zhi wai ， kan kan wo zhe li de bao xian xiang 。 ni ke yi dai shang ni bu xiang yao de dong xi ， ba ta men xian ji dao wo de bao xian xiang li 。 wo hui jiang ta men de jia zhi yu nin wei lai shou qu de ren he mu bei fei yi qi ji suan 。]

english: How long do I have to return to my gravestone?
translation: 我需要多长时间才能返回我的墓碑？ [wo xu yao duo zhang shi jian cai neng fan hui wo de mu bei ？]

english: How do I know what will happen to my items when I die?
translation: 我如何知道我死后我的物品会发生什么？ [wo ru he zhi dao wo si hou wo de wu pin hui fa sheng shen me ？]

english: There is a menu to predict these things for you. Take a look at your Worn Items side-panel...
translation: 有一个菜单可以为您预测这些事情。看看您的磨损物品侧面板... [you yi ge cai dan ke yi wei nin yu ce zhe xie shi qing 。 kan kan nin de mo sun wu pin ce mian ban ...]

english: I think I'm done here.
translation: 我想我已经完成了。 [wo xiang wo yi jing wan cheng le 。]

english: I'm afraid we have more topics to cover before you leave. Speak to me when you are ready to continue.
translation: 恐怕在您离开之前我们还有更多话题要讨论。当您准备好继续时，请告诉我。 [kong pa zai nin li kai zhi qian wo men hai you geng duo hua ti yao tao lun 。 dang nin zhun bei hao ji xu shi ， qing gao su wo 。]

english: Very well. Once you pass through my portal, you will have 15 minutes to reach your gravestone.
translation: 很好。一旦你通过我的传送门，你将有 15 分钟的时间到达你的墓碑。 [hen hao 。 yi dan ni tong guo wo de chuan song men ， ni jiang you  15  fen zhong de shi jian dao da ni de mu bei 。]

english: I believe I was explaining gravestones to you. We still have some more topics to cover.
translation: 我相信我正在向你解释墓碑。我们还有更多主题要讨论。 [wo xiang xin wo zheng zai xiang ni jie shi mu bei 。 wo men hai you geng duo zhu ti yao tao lun 。]

english: I haven't finished talking to you yet, [player name]. Please don't worry about your gravestone - it will wait until you leave this place.
translation: 我还没和你说完呢，[玩家名字]。请不要担心你的墓碑 - 它会等到你离开这个地方。 [wo hai mei he ni shuo wan ne ，[ wan jia ming zi ]。 qing bu yao dan xin ni de mu bei  -  ta hui deng dao ni li kai zhe ge di fang 。]

english: Would you like me to remind you about gravestones?
translation: 您需要我提醒您有关墓碑的事情吗？ [nin xu yao wo ti xing nin you guan mu bei de shi qing ma ？]

english: You haven't unlocked that. You can do so by reading a Trailblazer reloaded death scroll.
translation: 你还没有解锁。您可以通过阅读开拓者重装死亡卷轴来做到这一点。 [ni hai mei you jie suo 。 nin ke yi tong guo yue du kai tuo zhe zhong zhuang si wang juan zhou lai zuo dao zhe yi dian 。]

english: Have you come to retrieve something you lost from a previous gravestone?
translation: 您是来取回从以前的墓碑上丢失的东西吗？ [nin shi lai qu hui cong yi qian de mu bei shang diu shi de dong xi ma ？]

english: You will now die like a Trailblazer.
translation: 你现在将像开拓者一样死去。 [ni xian zai jiang xiang kai tuo zhe yi yang si qu 。]

english: You are already using that.
translation: 你已经在使用它了。 [ni yi jing zai shi yong ta le 。]

english: You will now perish like most others in Gielinor.
translation: 你现在将像吉林诺的大多数其他人一样灭亡。 [ni xian zai jiang xiang ji lin nuo de da duo shu qi ta ren yi yang mie wang 。]

english: Hello mortal. If you're looking for something you lost when you died, I'm afraid I don't cater to Ultimate Iron [Men/Women]. Your items would have fallen on the ground where you died.
translation: 你好，凡人。如果你正在寻找你死后丢失的东西，恐怕我不适合终极钢铁[男性/女性]。你的物品会掉在你死的地方。 [ni hao ， fan ren 。 ru guo ni zheng zai xun zhao ni si hou diu shi de dong xi ， kong pa wo bu shi he zhong ji gang tie [ nan xing / nv xing ]。 ni de wu pin hui diao zai ni si de di fang 。]

english: So what can I do here?
translation: 那么我在这里能做什么呢？ [na me wo zai zhe li neng zuo shen me ne ？]

english: Nothing, really. Please leave when you are ready.
translation: 没什么，真的。准备好后请离开。 [mei shen me ， zhen de 。 zhun bei hao hou qing li kai 。]

english: How does that work?
translation: 这是如何运作的？ [zhe shi ru he yun zuo de ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: It's lovely.
translation: 很可爱。 [hen ke ai 。]

english: Your decorations leave a bit to be desired.
translation: 你的装饰还有点不尽如人意。 [ni de zhuang shi hai you dian bu jin ru ren yi 。]

english: Yes, have you got anything for me?
translation: 是的，你有什么东西要给我吗？ [shi de ， ni you shen me dong xi yao gei wo ma ？]

english: More options...
translation: 更多选择... [geng duo xuan ze ...]

english: Can I choose a different-looking gravestone?
translation: 我可以选择外观不同的墓碑吗？ [wo ke yi xuan ze wai guan bu tong de mu bei ma ？]

english: Actually, never mind.
translation: 其实，没关系。 [qi shi ， mei guan xi 。]

english: Yes, I understand other people won't often see it.
translation: 是的，我知道其他人不会经常看到它。 [shi de ， wo zhi dao qi ta ren bu hui jing chang kan dao ta 。]

english: No thanks, it's not worth it.
translation: 不，谢谢，这不值得。 [bu ， xie xie ， zhe bu zhi de 。]

english: Yes, I want the basic gravestone.
translation: 是的，我想要基本的墓碑。 [shi de ， wo xiang yao ji ben de mu bei 。]

english: Can I change how I die?
translation: 我可以改变我的死亡方式吗？ [wo ke yi gai bian wo de si wang fang shi ma ？]

english: Not just now, thanks.
translation: 不只是现在，谢谢。 [bu zhi shi xian zai ， xie xie 。]

english: Previous options...
translation: 之前的选项... [zhi qian de xuan xiang ...]

english: Tell me about gravestones again.
translation: 再给我讲讲墓碑的事。 [zai gei wo jiang jiang mu bei de shi 。]

english: How do I pay a gravestone fee?
translation: 如何支付墓碑费？ [ru he zhi fu mu bei fei ？]

english: How long do I have to return to my gravestone?
translation: 我需要多长时间才能返回我的墓碑？ [wo xu yao duo zhang shi jian cai neng fan hui wo de mu bei ？]

english: How do I know what will happen to my items when I die?
translation: 我如何知道我死后我的物品会发生什么？ [wo ru he zhi dao wo si hou wo de wu pin hui fa sheng shen me ？]

english: I think I'm done here.
translation: 我想我已经完成了。 [wo xiang wo yi jing wan cheng le 。]

english: Leagues IV: Trailblazer Reloaded.
translation: 联赛 IV：开拓者重装上阵。 [lian sai  IV： kai tuo zhe zhong zhuang shang zhen 。]

english: Default.
translation: 默认。 [mo ren 。]

english: :Intruder!
translation: ：入侵者！ [： ru qin zhe ！]

english: :Protect the keystone!
translation: ：保护基石！ [： bao hu ji shi ！]

english: :Stop them at all costs!
translation: ：不惜一切代价阻止他们！ [： bu xi yi qie dai jia zu zhi ta men ！]

english: :Intruder!
translation: ：入侵者！ [： ru qin zhe ！]

english: :Protect the keystone!
translation: ：保护基石！ [： bao hu ji shi ！]

english: :Stop them at all costs!
translation: ：不惜一切代价阻止他们！ [： bu xi yi qie dai jia zu zhi ta men ！]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Not infected are you?
translation: 你没有被感染吧？ [ni mei you bei gan ran ba ？]

english: I don't think so.
translation: 我不这么认为。 [wo bu zhe me ren wei 。]

english: You don't seem very sure. We don't want any infected near the children. Be off with you!
translation: 你看起来不太确定。我们不希望孩子们附近有任何感染者。跟你走吧！ [ni kan qi lai bu tai que ding 。 wo men bu xi wang hai zi men fu jin you ren he gan ran zhe 。 gen ni zou ba ！]

english: Whatever it is you're selling, we ain't interested!
translation: 不管你卖什么，我们都不感兴趣！ [bu guan ni mai shen me ， wo men dou bu gan xing qu ！]

english: But I'm not...
translation: 但我不是... [dan wo bu shi ...]

english: Did you not hear me? Clear off!
translation: 你没听到我说话吗？走开！ [ni mei ting dao wo shuo hua ma ？ zou kai ！]

english: Nay, I've got no banknotes to exchange for that item.
translation: 不，我没有纸币可以兑换该物品。 [bu ， wo mei you zhi bi ke yi dui huan gai wu pin 。]

english: Nay, there's no such thing as a banknote for that.
translation: 不，没有钞票这样的东西。 [bu ， mei you chao piao zhe yang de dong xi 。]

english: That IS a banknote!
translation: 那是一张钞票！ [na shi yi zhang chao piao ！]

english: Hello, no-fur. What are you doing in my mistress's garden?
translation: 你好，无毛。你在我情妇的花园里做什么？ [ni hao ， wu mao 。 ni zai wo qing fu de hua yuan li zuo shen me ？]

english: Looking for sq'irks.
translation: 寻找奇怪的人。 [xun zhao qi guai de ren 。]

english: If it's sq'irks you're after then you've come to the right place. We've got four seasons' worth of them.
translation: 如果您追求的是sq'irks，那么您来对地方了。我们已经有四个赛季的内容了。 [ru guo nin zhui qiu de shi sq'irks， na me nin lai dui di fang le 。 wo men yi jing you si ge sai ji de nei rong le 。]

english: I've a couple of questions.
translation: 我有几个问题。 [wo you ji ge wen ti 。]

english: I'd be happy to help a friend of the feline.
translation: 我很乐意帮助猫科动物的朋友。 [wo hen le yi bang zhu mao ke dong wu de peng you 。]

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你是什​​么意思？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: The Sphinx gave you that amulet, so she must hold you in high regard.
translation: 狮身人面像给了你那个护身符，所以她一定很尊重你。 [shi shen ren mian xiang gei le ni na ge hu shen fu ， suo yi ta yi ding hen zun zhong ni 。]

english: If I remember correctly, it was the High Priest of Sophanem who gave it to me.
translation: 如果我没记错的话，是索法尼姆的大祭司给我的。 [ru guo wo mei ji cuo de hua ， shi suo fa ni mu de da ji si gei wo de 。]

english: He and the Sphinx are as thick as thieves, but regardless, I think you've a bit of a cat feel about you.
translation: 他和狮身人面像的关系就像小偷一样，但不管怎样，我觉得你对你有一点猫的感觉。 [ta he shi shen ren mian xiang de guan xi jiu xiang xiao tou yi yang ， dan bu guan zen yang ， wo jue de ni dui ni you yi dian mao de gan jue 。]

english: Now what are these questions?
translation: 现在这些问题是什么？ [xian zai zhe xie wen ti shi shen me ？]

english: What are the creatures inside the gardens?
translation: 花园里有什么生物？ [hua yuan li you shen me sheng wu ？]

english: Oh, you mean the gardeners?
translation: 哦，你是说园丁吗？ [o ， ni shi shuo yuan ding ma ？]

english: The strange, floaty creatures.
translation: 奇怪的、漂浮的生物。 [qi guai de 、 piao fu de sheng wu 。]

english: Yes, the gardeners. Don't let them see you or they'll teleport you out here. They're very protective of their crops.
translation: 是的，园丁们。不要让他们看到你，否则他们会把你传送到这里。他们非常保护自己的农作物。 [shi de ， yuan ding men 。 bu yao rang ta men kan dao ni ， fou ze ta men hui ba ni chuan song dao zhe li 。 ta men fei chang bao hu zi ji de nong zuo wu 。]

english: Thanks, I have another question though.
translation: 谢谢，不过我还有另一个问题。 [xie xie ， bu guo wo hai you ling yi ge wen ti 。]

english: Thanks for your help.
translation: 感谢您的帮助。 [gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]

english: How do you get into the seasonal gardens?
translation: 如何进入季节性花园？ [ru he jin ru ji jie xing hua yuan ？]

english: I get in through gaps in the hedge. You are a little too big to squeeze through. I think you'll have to use the gates.
translation: 我从树篱的缝隙钻进去。你太大了，挤不过去。我想你必须使用大门。 [wo cong shu li de feng xi zuan jin qu 。 ni tai da le ， ji bu guo qu 。 wo xiang ni bi xu shi yong da men 。]

english: I think the gates are locked, so you'll have to have good Thieving skills to get in.
translation: 我认为大门是锁着的，所以你必须具备良好的盗贼技能才能进去。 [wo ren wei da men shi suo zhe de ， suo yi ni bi xu ju bei liang hao de dao zei ji neng cai neng jin qu 。]

english: How is it that the gardens are in different seasons?
translation: 花园里的季节有什么不同？ [hua yuan li de ji jie you shen me bu tong ？]

english: How did you get here?
translation: 你怎么到这里来的？ [ni zen me dao zhe li lai de ？]

english: Magic?
translation: 魔法？ [mo fa ？]

english: Exactly. The Sorceress likes to have a good supply of in-season sq'irks and herbs at all times.
translation: 确切地。女术士喜欢随时拥有充足的当季水果和草药。 [que qie di 。 nv shu shi xi huan sui shi yong you chong zu di dang ji shui guo he cao yao 。]

english: How do I get out of here?
translation: 我怎样才能离开这里？ [wo zen yang cai neng li kai zhe li ？]

english: Take a drink from the fountain.
translation: 从喷泉里喝一杯。 [cong pen quan li he yi bei 。]

english: Talking to cats.
translation: 和猫说话。 [he mao shuo hua 。]

english: A noble and rewarding past-time.
translation: 一种高贵而有益的过去时光。 [yi zhong gao gui er you yi de guo qu shi guang 。]

english: How did you get here?
translation: 你怎么到这里来的？ [ni zen me dao zhe li lai de ？]

english: Every time I play with spiders in the Sorceress's house, her silly apprentice completely freaks out and teleports me here!
translation: 每次我在女巫家里玩蜘蛛时，她那愚蠢的学徒都会彻底吓坏，把我传送到这里！ [mei ci wo zai nv wu jia li wan zhi zhu shi ， ta na yu chun de xue tu du hui che di xia huai ， ba wo chuan song dao zhe li ！]

english: So you've been stuck here since?
translation: 所以从那以后你就一直被困在这里了？ [suo yi cong na yi hou ni jiu yi zhi bei kun zai zhe li le ？]

english: No, silly! I drink from the fountain whenever I want to leave.
translation: 不，傻瓜！每当我想离开时，我都会从喷泉里喝水。 [bu ， sha gua ！ mei dang wo xiang li kai shi ， wo du hui cong pen quan li he shui 。]

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I get this strange urge for sq'irks. It's quite peculiar. I think I may be addicted.
translation: 我对sq'irks有一种奇怪的冲动。这是相当奇特的。我想我可能会上瘾了。 [wo dui sq'irks you yi zhong qi guai de chong dong 。 zhe shi xiang dang qi te de 。 wo xiang wo ke neng hui shang yin le 。]

english: I think I know someone else who may be in a similar position.
translation: 我想我认识的其他人可能处于类似的境地。 [wo xiang wo ren shi de qi ta ren ke neng chu yu lei si de jing di 。]

english: Don't tell me. Osman, right?
translation: 别告诉我。奥斯曼，对吗？ [bie gao su wo 。 ao si man ， dui ma ？]

english: You know him too?
translation: 你也认识他吗？ [ni ye ren shi ta ma ？]

english: Oh, he used to come here all the time. Then one day, he just stopped.
translation: 噢，他以前经常来这里。然后有一天，他停下来了。 [o ， ta yi qian jing chang lai zhe li 。 ran hou you yi tian ， ta ting xia lai le 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Del-Monty the cat, at your service.
translation: 德尔蒙蒂猫，随时为您服务。 [de er meng di mao ， sui shi wei nin fu wu 。]

english: Are you a famous adventurer who was turned into a cat by a vindictive mage?
translation: 你是一位被复仇法师变成猫的著名冒险家吗？ [ni shi yi wei bei fu chou fa shi bian cheng mao de zhu ming mao xian jia ma ？]

english: No; as I said, I'm Del-Monty the cat, connoisseur of exotic fruits.
translation: 不;正如我所说，我是猫德尔蒙蒂，异域水果鉴赏家。 [bu ; zheng ru wo suo shuo ， wo shi mao de er meng di ， yi yu shui guo jian shang jia 。]

english: In that case, can you tell me anything about sq'irks?
translation: 那么，你能告诉我一些关于 sq'irks 的事情吗？ [na me ， ni neng gao su wo yi xie guan yu  sq'irks  de shi qing ma ？]

english: But of course! Their juice is an excellent source of energy for runners, and in the riper varieties they are known to heighten one's Thieving abilities.
translation: 但当然！它们的汁液对于跑步者来说是极好的能量来源，而且在成熟的品种中，它们可以提高人的偷窃能力。 [dan dang ran ！ ta men de zhi ye dui yu pao bu zhe lai shuo shi ji hao de neng liang lai yuan ， er qie zai cheng shu de pin zhong zhong ， ta men ke yi ti gao ren de tou qie neng li 。]

english: Nothing much.
translation: 没什么。 [mei shen me 。]

english: Yawn! Nice talking to you then, no-fur.
translation: 打哈欠！很高兴和你说话，没有皮毛。 [da ha qian ！ hen gao xing he ni shuo hua ， mei you pi mao 。]

translation: 问候！我是阿拉萨兹德拉，恶魔领主的管家，我只需要 10000 个金币就可以为您服务！ [wen hou ！ wo shi a la sa zi de la ， e mo ling zhu de guan jia ， wo zhi xu yao  10000  ge jin bi jiu ke yi wei nin fu wu ！]

translation: 你能做什么？ [ni neng zuo shen me ？]

english: I have learned my trade under the leash of some of the harshest masters of the Demon Dimensions. I can cook to satisfy the most infernal stomachs, and fly on wings of flame to deposit thine items in the bank or bring
translation: 我是在恶魔维度一些最严厉的大师的指导下学会了我的手艺。我可以做饭来满足最地狱般的胃，并可以乘着火焰的翅膀飞翔，将你的物品存入银行或带来 [wo shi zai e mo wei du yi xie zui yan li de da shi de zhi dao xia xue hui le wo de shou yi 。 wo ke yi zuo fan lai man zu zui di yu ban de wei ， bing ke yi cheng zhao huo yan de chi bang fei xiang ， jiang ni de wu pin cun ru yin hang huo dai lai]
