translation: 几秒钟内从锯木厂取出木板。 [ji miao zhong nei cong ju mu chang qu chu mu ban 。]

english: Tell me about your previous jobs.
translation: 告诉我你以前的工作。 [gao su wo ni yi qian de gong zuo 。]

english: For millennia I have served and waited on the mighty Demon Lords of the Infernal Dimensions. I began as a humble footman in the household of Lord Thammaron, and for several centuries I was the private valet to
translation: 几千年来，我一直侍奉着地狱维度强大的恶魔领主。我一开始是塔马伦勋爵家里的一个卑微的男仆，几个世纪以来我一直是他的私人男仆。 [ji qian nian lai ， wo yi zhi shi feng zhe di yu wei du qiang da de e mo ling zhu 。 wo yi kai shi shi ta ma lun xun jue jia li de yi ge bei wei de nan pu ， ji ge shi ji yi lai wo yi zhi shi ta de si ren nan pu 。]

english: Delrith. I have also worked in the Grim Underworld, escorting the souls of the dead to their final abodes. But the incessant shadows and hellfire weary me, so I have come to serve mortal masters in the realms of light.
translation: 德尔里斯。我也曾在严酷的地下世界工作过，护送死者的灵魂到他们最后的住所。但持续不断的阴影和地狱之火让我疲惫不堪，所以我来到了光之国度为凡间的主人服务。 [de er li si 。 wo ye ceng zai yan ku de di xia shi jie gong zuo guo ， hu song si zhe de ling hun dao ta men zui hou de zhu suo 。 dan chi xu bu duan de yin ying he di yu zhi huo rang wo pi bei bu kan ， suo yi wo lai dao le guang zhi guo du wei fan jian de zhu ren fu wu 。]

english: You, a mere mortal with level [1-49] Construction, wish to employ ME, butler to Great Ones of the Outer Darkness? Ha ha ha! I refuse to work for anyone below level 50 Construction.
translation: 你，一个等级为[1-49]建筑的凡人，想雇用我，作为外层黑暗伟人的管家吗？哈哈哈！我拒绝为任何低于 50 级建筑的人工作。 [ni ， yi ge deng ji wei [1-49] jian zhu de fan ren ， xiang gu yong wo ， zuo wei wai ceng hei an wei ren de guan jia ma ？ ha ha ha ！ wo ju jue wei ren he di yu  50  ji jian zhu de ren gong zuo 。]

english: You already have a servant.
translation: 你已经有一个仆人了。 [ni yi jing you yi ge pu ren le 。]

english: You need a second bedroom with a bed for your servant to sleep in.
translation: 你需要第二间卧室，里面有一张床，供你的仆人睡觉。 [ni xu yao di er jian wo shi ， li mian you yi zhang chuang ， gong ni de pu ren shui jiao 。]

english: You're hired... well, I don't have the money on me, but can I owe you? I'm good for it, honest.
translation: 你被录用了……好吧，我身上没带钱，但我可以欠你吗？我很擅长，老实说。 [ni bei lu yong le …… hao ba ， wo shen shang mei dai qian ， dan wo ke yi qian ni ma ？ wo hen shan chang ， lao shi shuo 。]

english: I regret, Master, that I must insist on payment up front.
translation: 师父，我很遗憾我必须坚持先付款。 [shi fu ， wo hen yi han wo bi xu jian chi xian fu kuan 。]

english: You're hired!
translation: 你被录用了！ [ni bei lu yong le ！]

english: I shall devote my every art to thy service, my Master.
translation: 我将竭尽全力为您服务，我的主人。 [wo jiang jie jin quan li wei nin fu wu ， wo de zhu ren 。]

english: Bones are a tool of prayer, and demonic magic prevents me from touching them, my Lord.
translation: 骨头是祈祷的工具，恶魔魔法阻止我触摸它们，我的主。 [gu tou shi qi dao de gong ju ， e mo mo fa zu zhi wo chu mo ta men ， wo de zhu 。]

english: What can you do?
translation: 你能做什么？ [ni neng zuo shen me ？]

english: Tell me about your previous jobs
translation: 告诉我你以前的工作 [gao su wo ni yi qian de gong zuo]

english: You're hired!
translation: 你被录用了！ [ni bei lu yong le ！]

english: Rhaaaaaaa!
translation: 啊啊啊啊！ [a a a a ！]

english: So you wish to join us? You have made a wise choice. When we summon the demon Agrith-Naar, he will grant all our worldly desires.
translation: 那么你想加入我们吗？您做出了明智的选择。当我们召唤恶魔阿格里斯纳尔时，他会满足我们所有世俗的愿望。 [na me ni xiang jia ru wo men ma ？ nin zuo chu le ming zhi de xuan ze 。 dang wo men zhao huan e mo a ge li si na er shi ， ta hui man zu wo men suo you shi su de yuan wang 。]

english: An abyssal whip, a dragon chain mail? To conjure these items is trivial for Agrith-Naar.
translation: 深渊鞭子，龙锁子甲？对于阿格里斯-纳尔来说，召唤这些物品是微不足道的。 [shen yuan bian zi ， long suo zi jia ？ dui yu a ge li si - na er lai shuo ， zhao huan zhe xie wu pin shi wei bu zu dao de 。]

english: But you will not need such weapons or armour, for Agrith-Naar will grant you the power of life and death over all creatures!
translation: 但你不需要这样的武器或盔甲，因为阿格里斯-纳尔将赋予你凌驾于一切生物之上的生杀予夺的力量！ [dan ni bu xu yao zhe yang de wu qi huo kui jia ， yin wei a ge li si - na er jiang fu yu ni ling jia yu yi qie sheng wu zhi shang de sheng sha yu duo de li liang ！]

english: You shall have every wish granted, and everyone who has ever wronged you will burn in a hell of your own devising!
translation: 你的每一个愿望都将得到满足，所有曾经冤枉过你的人都将在你自己设计的地狱中被焚烧！ [ni de mei yi ge yuan wang dou jiang de dao man zu ， suo you ceng jing yuan wang guo ni de ren dou jiang zai ni zi ji she ji de di yu zhong bei fen shao ！]

english: Isn't this, you know, wrong?
translation: 你知道，这不是错的吗？ [ni zhi dao ， zhe bu shi cuo de ma ？]

english: Right and wrong are for the weak! This is your chance to choose to be on the side of the strong, and have all your desires granted, while the weak are crushed beneath Agrith-Naar's demonic feet!
translation: 对与错都是弱者的事！这是你选择站在强者一边并实现你所有愿望的机会，而弱者则被压在阿格里斯-纳尔的恶魔脚下！ [dui yu cuo dou shi ruo zhe de shi ！ zhe shi ni xuan ze zhan zai qiang zhe yi bian bing shi xian ni suo you yuan wang de ji hui ， er ruo zhe ze bei ya zai a ge li si - na er de e mo jiao xia ！]

english: How do you know Agrith-Naar will do all this for us?
translation: 你怎么知道阿格里斯纳尔会为我们做这一切？ [ni zen me zhi dao a ge li si na er hui wei wo men zuo zhe yi qie ？]

english: My binding spells will make Agrith-Naar my slave! You would be wise not to question my powers again, lest I turn the same spells on you!
translation: 我的束缚咒语将使阿格里斯-纳尔成为我的奴隶！你最好不要再质疑我的力量，以免我对你施展同样的咒语！ [wo de shu fu zhou yu jiang shi a ge li si - na er cheng wei wo de nu li ！ ni zui hao bu yao zai zhi yi wo de li liang ， yi mian wo dui ni shi zhan tong yang de zhou yu ！]

english: Why did Josef run away?
translation: 约瑟夫为何逃跑？ [yue se fu wei he tao pao ？]

english: Obviously he was a coward who did not have the strength to abandon his old-fashioned morality. I hope you will not be a similar disappointment.
translation: 显然他是一个没有实力放弃旧式道德的胆小鬼。希望你不会有类似的失望。 [xian ran ta shi yi ge mei you shi li fang qi jiu shi dao de de dan xiao gui 。 xi wang ni bu hui you lei si de shi wang 。]

english: What do I have to do?
translation: 我必须做什么？ [wo bi xu zuo shen me ？]

english: When I have finished preparing the magic circle, we will all recite the incantation that will summon Agrith-Naar.
translation: 等我准备好魔法阵后，我们就一起念诵召唤阿格里斯纳尔的咒语。 [deng wo zhun bei hao mo fa zhen hou ， wo men jiu yi qi nian song zhao huan a ge li si na er de zhou yu 。]

english: You must memorize the incantation carefully. It is Caldar Agrith-Naar Camerinthum Nahudu Tarren.
translation: 咒语一定要熟记。我是卡尔达尔·阿格里斯·纳尔·卡梅林图姆·纳胡杜·塔伦。 [zhou yu yi ding yao shu ji 。 wo shi ka er da er · a ge li si · na er · ka mei lin tu mu · na hu du · ta lun 。]

english: You will also need to make yourself a demonic sigil to act as a focus of power. One of the group has the mould you need to make it.
translation: 你还需要为自己打造一个恶魔印记，以充当力量的焦点。其中一组拥有制作它所需的模具。 [ni hai xu yao wei zi ji da zao yi ge e mo yin ji ， yi chong dang li liang de jiao dian 。 qi zhong yi zu yong you zhi zuo ta suo xu de mu ju 。]

english: Now let me continue with my preparations!
translation: 现在让我继续我的准备工作吧！ [xian zai rang wo ji xu wo de zhun bei gong zuo ba ！]

english: Leave me alone! I am preparing for the summoning ritual. You should make yourself a demonic sigil and practice the incantation with the other wizards.
translation: 请别打扰我！我正在准备召唤仪式。你应该为自己制作一个恶魔印记，并与其他巫师一起练习咒语。 [qing bie da rao wo ！ wo zheng zai zhun bei zhao huan yi shi 。 ni ying gai wei zi ji zhi zuo yi ge e mo yin ji ， bing yu qi ta wu shi yi qi lian xi zhou yu 。]

english: I forgot the incantation.
translation: 我忘记了咒语。 [wo wang ji le zhou yu 。]

english: Ignoramus! Are you incapable of even the simplest task? The incantation is Caldar Agrith-Naar Camerinthum Nahudu Tarren.
translation: 无知！你连最简单的任务都无法完成吗？咒语是卡尔达尔·阿格里斯·纳尔·卡梅林图姆·纳胡杜·塔伦。 [wu zhi ！ ni lian zui jian dan de ren wu dou wu fa wan cheng ma ？ zhou yu shi ka er da er · a ge li si · na er · ka mei lin tu mu · na hu du · ta lun 。]

english: The player entered the stone circle south of Varrock with Silverlight
translation: 玩家带着Silverlight进入Varrock以南的石圈 [wan jia dai zhe Silverlight jin ru Varrock yi nan de shi quan]

english: Arise, O mighty Delrith! Bring destruction to this soft, weak city!
translation: 起来吧，强大的德里斯啊！给这座软弱的城市带来毁灭！ [qi lai ba ， qiang da de de li si a ！ gei zhe zuo ruan ruo de cheng shi dai lai hui mie ！]

english: Arise, Delrith!
translation: 起来吧，德里斯！ [qi lai ba ， de li si ！]

english: Ha ha ha! At last you are free, my demonic brother! Rest now, and then have your revenge on this pitiful city!
translation: 哈哈哈！ At last you are free, my demonic brother!现在休息吧，然后向这座可怜的城市报仇！ [ha ha ha ！ At last you are free, my demonic brother! xian zai xiu xi ba ， ran hou xiang zhe zuo ke lian de cheng shi bao chou ！]

english: Who's that?
translation: 那是谁？ [na shi shui ？]

english: Noo! Not Silverlight! Delrith is not ready yet!
translation: 不！不是银光！德里斯还没准备好！ [bu ！ bu shi yin guang ！ de li si hai mei zhun bei hao ！]

english: I've got to get out of here...
translation: 我必须离开这里... [wo bi xu li kai zhe li ...]

english: Isn't this, you know, wrong?
translation: 你知道，这不是错的吗？ [ni zhi dao ， zhe bu shi cuo de ma ？]

english: How do you know Agrith-Naar will do all this for us?
translation: 你怎么知道阿格里斯纳尔会为我们做这一切？ [ni zen me zhi dao a ge li si na er hui wei wo men zuo zhe yi qie ？]

english: Why did Josef run away?
translation: 约瑟夫为何逃跑？ [yue se fu wei he tao pao ？]

english: What do I have to do?
translation: 我必须做什么？ [wo bi xu zuo shen me ？]

english: I forgot the incantation.
translation: 我忘记了咒语。 [wo wang ji le zhou yu 。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Hello citizen, how can I help?
translation: 您好公民，请问有什么可以帮忙的吗？ [nin hao gong min ， qing wen you shen me ke yi bang mang de ma ？]

english: Do you have any quests for me?
translation: 你有什么任务要找我吗？ [ni you shen me ren wu yao zhao wo ma ？]

english: I don't know if you can help us!
translation: 不知道你能不能帮帮我们！ [bu zhi dao ni neng bu neng bang bang wo men ！]

english: The trolls have taken up camp on Death Plateau! They are using it to launch raids at night on the village. We have tried to attack the camp but the main path is heavily guarded!
translation: 巨魔已经在死亡高原安营扎寨了！他们用它在夜间对村庄发动袭击。我们试图攻击营地，但主要道路戒备森严！ [ju mo yi jing zai si wang gao yuan an ying zha zhai le ！ ta men yong ta zai ye jian dui cun zhuang fa dong xi ji 。 wo men shi tu gong ji ying di ， dan zhu yao dao lu jie bei sen yan ！]

english: Perhaps there is a way you can sneak up at night?
translation: 也许有什么办法可以让你在晚上偷偷溜进去？ [ye xu you shen me ban fa ke yi rang ni zai wan shang tou tou liu jin qu ？]

english: If there is another way I do not know of it.
translation: 如果还有其他方法我不知道。 [ru guo hai you qi ta fang fa wo bu zhi dao 。]

english: Do you know of such a path?
translation: 你知道有这样一条路吗？ [ni zhi dao you zhe yang yi tiao lu ma ？]

english: No but perhaps I could try and find one?
translation: 不，但也许我可以尝试找到一个？ [bu ， dan ye xu wo ke yi chang shi zhao dao yi ge ？]

english: Citizen you would be well rewarded!
translation: 公民，你将得到丰厚的回报！ [gong min ， ni jiang de dao feng hou de hui bao ！]

english: If you go up to Death Plateau be very careful as the trolls will attack you on sight!
translation: 如果您前往死亡高原，请务必小心，因为巨魔一看到您就会攻击您！ [ru guo nin qian wang si wang gao yuan ， qing wu bi xiao xin ， yin wei ju mo yi kan dao nin jiu hui gong ji nin ！]

english: I'll be careful.
translation: 我会小心的。 [wo hui xiao xin de 。]

english: One other thing.
translation: 另一件事。 [ling yi jian shi 。]

english: What's that?
translation: 那是什么？ [na shi shen me ？]

english: All of our equipment is kept in the castle on the hill.
translation: 我们所有的设备都存放在山上的城堡里。 [wo men suo you de she bei dou cun fang zai shan shang de cheng bao li 。]

english: The stupid guard that was on duty last night lost the combination to the lock! I told the Prince that the Imperial Guard should've been in charge of security!
translation: 昨晚值班的那个愚蠢的警卫把锁的密码弄丢了！我告诉太子，应该由禁卫军负责安全！ [zuo wan zhi ban de na ge yu chun de jing wei ba suo de mi ma nong diu le ！ wo gao su tai zi ， ying gai you jin wei jun fu ze an quan ！]

english: No problem, what does the combination look like?
translation: 没问题，这个组合是什么样的？ [mei wen ti ， zhe ge zu he shi shen me yang de ？]

english: The equipment room is unlocked when the stone balls are placed in the correct order on the stone mechanism outside it. The right order is written on a piece of paper the guard had.
translation: 当石球按照正确的顺序放置在设备室外面的石头机制上时，设备室就会解锁。正确的命令写在警卫手上的一张纸上。 [dang shi qiu an zhao zheng que de shun xu fang zhi zai she bei shi wai mian de shi tou ji zhi shang shi ， she bei shi jiu hui jie suo 。 zheng que de ming ling xie zai jing wei shou shang de yi zhang zhi shang 。]

english: A stone what...?!
translation: 石头什么……？！ [shi tou shen me ……？！]

english: Well citizen, the Prince is fond of puzzles. Why he couldn't just have a key is beyond me!
translation: 好吧，公民，王子喜欢拼图。我不明白为什么他不能有钥匙！ [hao ba ， gong min ， wang zi xi huan pin tu 。 wo bu ming bai wei shen me ta bu neng you yao shi ！]

english: I'll get on it right away!
translation: 我马上就去办！ [wo ma shang jiu qu ban ！]

english: No, sorry.
translation: 不，抱歉。 [bu ， bao qian 。]

english: Never mind citizen.
translation: 别介意公民。 [bie jie yi gong min 。]

english: Can I assist you with anything else?
translation: 我可以帮您做其他事吗？ [wo ke yi bang nin zuo qi ta shi ma ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Welcome to Principality of Burthorpe!
translation: 欢迎来到伯索普公国！ [huan ying lai dao bo suo pu gong guo ！]

english: We are the Imperial Guard for his Royal Highness Prince Anlaf of Burthorpe.
translation: 我们是伯索普安拉夫王子殿下的帝国卫队。 [wo men shi bo suo pu an la fu wang zi dian xia de di guo wei dui 。]

english: You can't, thanks.
translation: 你不能，谢谢。 [ni bu neng ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello citizen, is there anything you'd like to know?
translation: 市民您好，您有什么想了解的吗？ [shi min nin hao ， nin you shen me xiang liao jie de ma ？]

english: Can you remind me of the quest I am on?
translation: 你能提醒我我正在进行的任务吗？ [ni neng ti xing wo wo zheng zai jin xing de ren wu ma ？]

english: You offered to see if you could find another way up Death Plateau. We could then use it to sneak up and attack the trolls by night.
translation: 你提出想看看是否能找到另一条通往死亡高原的路。然后我们可以用它在夜间偷袭并攻击巨魔。 [ni ti chu xiang kan kan shi fou neng zhao dao ling yi tiao tong wang si wang gao yuan de lu 。 ran hou wo men ke yi yong ta zai ye jian tou xi bing gong ji ju mo 。]

english: Ah yes, and the guard hast lost the combination to your equipment room in the castle on the hill?
translation: 啊，是的，守卫把你山上城堡的装备室的密码弄丢了？ [a ， shi de ， shou wei ba ni shan shang cheng bao de zhuang bei shi de mi ma nong diu le ？]

english: That's right citizen, you offered to recover the combination and unlock the door.
translation: 是的，公民，您主动提出恢复密码并打开门。 [shi de ， gong min ， nin zhu dong ti chu hui fu mi ma bing da kai men 。]

english: I've found a secret way up Death Plateau so I just need to find the combination and unlock the door.
translation: 我找到了一条通往死亡高原的秘密道路，所以我只需要找到密码并打开门即可。 [wo zhao dao le yi tiao tong wang si wang gao yuan de mi mi dao lu ， suo yi wo zhi xu yao zhao dao mi ma bing da kai men ji ke 。]

english: Good work citizen!
translation: 公民干得好！ [gong min gan de hao ！]

english: Is there anything you'd like to know?
translation: 您有什么想知道的吗？ [nin you shen me xiang zhi dao de ma ？]

english: I thought the White Knights controlled Asgarnia?
translation: 我以为白骑士控制了阿斯卡尼亚？ [wo yi wei bai qi shi kong zhi le a si ka ni ya ？]

english: You are right citizen. The White Knights have taken advantage of the old and weak king, they control most of Asgarnia, including Falador. However they do not control Burthorpe!
translation: 你是正确的公民。白骑士团利用了国王年老体弱的优势，控制了阿斯伽尼亚的大部分地区，包括法拉多。然而他们并不能控制伯索普！ [ni shi zheng que de gong min 。 bai qi shi tuan li yong le guo wang nian lao ti ruo de you shi ， kong zhi le a si ga ni ya de da bu fen di qu ， bao kuo fa la duo 。 ran er ta men bing bu neng kong zhi bo suo pu ！]

english: We are the prince's elite troops! We keep Burthorpe secure!
translation: 我们是王子的精锐部队！我们保证伯索普的安全！ [wo men shi wang zi de jing rui bu dui ！ wo men bao zheng bo suo pu de an quan ！]

english: The White Knights have overlooked us, until now! They are pouring money into their war against the Black Knights, they are looking for an excuse to stop our funding and I'm afraid they may have found it!
translation: 白衣骑士团一直忽视我们，直到现在！他们正在为对抗黑骑士的战争投入大量资金，他们正在寻找借口来停止我们的资助，我担心他们可能已经找到了！ [bai yi qi shi tuan yi zhi hu shi wo men ， zhi dao xian zai ！ ta men zheng zai wei dui kang hei qi shi de zhan zheng tou ru da liang zi jin ， ta men zheng zai xun zhao jie kou lai ting zhi wo men de zi zhu ， wo dan xin ta men ke neng yi jing zhao dao le ！]

english: If we can not destroy the troll camp on Death Plateau then the Imperial Guard will be disbanded and Burthorpe will come under control of the White Knights. We can not let this happen!
translation: 如果我们不能摧毁死亡高原上的巨魔营地，那么帝国卫队就会解散，伯索普就会落入白骑士的控制之下。我们不能让这种事发生！ [ru guo wo men bu neng cui hui si wang gao yuan shang de ju mo ying di ， na me di guo wei dui jiu hui jie san ， bo suo pu jiu hui luo ru bai qi shi de kong zhi zhi xia 。 wo men bu neng rang zhe zhong shi fa sheng ！]

english: That's all, thanks.
translation: “就这些了，谢谢。” [“ jiu zhe xie le ， xie xie 。”]

english: God speed citizen.
translation: 上帝速度公民。 [shang di su du gong min 。]

english: Hello citizen, have you found another way up Death Plateau?
translation: 你好公民，你找到了通往死亡高原的另一条路吗？ [ni hao gong min ， ni zhao dao le tong wang si wang gao yuan de ling yi tiao lu ma ？]

english: Yes, there is another way up Death Plateau!
translation: 是的，还有另一条通往死亡高原的路！ [shi de ， hai you ling yi tiao tong wang si wang gao yuan de lu ！]

english: We are saved!
translation: 我们得救了！ [wo men de jiu le ！]

english: There's one thing...
translation: 有一点... [you yi dian ...]

english: And what is that citizen?
translation: 那个公民是什么？ [na ge gong min shi shen me ？]

english: There is a Sherpa who will only show me the secret way if I first get some spikes for his climbing boots. The smith will only do this for me if you sign up his son for the Imperial Guard!
translation: 有一个夏尔巴人，只有当我先给他的登山靴找到一些钉子时，他才会向我展示秘密道路。只有你让他的儿子加入帝国卫队，铁匠才会为我做这件事！ [you yi ge xia er ba ren ， zhi you dang wo xian gei ta de deng shan xue zhao dao yi xie ding zi shi ， ta cai hui xiang wo zhan shi mi mi dao lu 。 zhi you ni rang ta de er zi jia ru di guo wei dui ， tie jiang cai hui wei wo zuo zhe jian shi ！]

english: Hmm...this is very irregular.
translation: 嗯……这很不规则。 [n …… zhe hen bu gui ze 。]

english: Will you not do this?
translation: 你不会这样做吗？ [ni bu hui zhe yang zuo ma ？]

english: I have heard of Dunstan's son, he is a very promising young man. For the sake of your mission we can make an exception!
translation: 我听说过邓斯坦的儿子，他是一个很有前途的年轻人。为了您的使命，我们可以破例！ [wo ting shuo guo deng si tan de er zi ， ta shi yi ge hen you qian tu de nian qing ren 。 wei le nin de shi ming ， wo men ke yi po li ！]

english: Denulth has given you a certificate.
translation: 德努尔斯给了你一张证书。 [de nu er si gei le ni yi zhang zheng shu 。]

english: This certificate proves that we have accepted Dunstan's son for training in the Imperial Guard!
translation: 这张证书证明我们已经接受了邓斯坦的儿子在帝国卫队接受训练！ [zhe zhang zheng shu zheng ming wo men yi jing jie shou le deng si tan de er zi zai di guo wei dui jie shou xun lian ！]

english: Thank you Denulth, I shall be back shortly!
translation: 谢谢德努尔斯，我很快就会回来！ [xie xie de nu er si ， wo hen kuai jiu hui hui lai ！]

english: Hello citizen, have you found the secret way up Death Plateau?
translation: 你好公民，你找到通往死亡高原的秘密通道了吗？ [ni hao gong min ， ni zhao dao tong wang si wang gao yuan de mi mi tong dao le ma ？]

english: I'm working on it, I just need to give the certificate to Dunstan.
translation: 我正在努力，我只需要将证书交给邓斯坦即可。 [wo zheng zai nu li ， wo zhi xu yao jiang zheng shu jiao gei deng si tan ji ke 。]

english: I'm working on it but I've lost the certificate!
translation: 我正在努力，但我把证书弄丢了！ [wo zheng zai nu li ， dan wo ba zheng shu nong diu le ！]

english: No problem, I have a duplicate.
translation: 没问题，我有一个副本。 [mei wen ti ， wo you yi ge fu ben 。]

english: Yes! There is a path that runs from Sherpa's hut around the back of Death Plateau. The trolls haven't found it yet. The Sherpa made a map I can give you.
translation: 是的！有一条小路从夏尔巴人的小屋出发，绕过死亡高原的后面。巨魔们还没有发现它。夏尔巴人制作了一张地图我可以给你。 [shi de ！ you yi tiao xiao lu cong xia er ba ren de xiao wu chu fa ， rao guo si wang gao yuan de hou mian 。 ju mo men hai mei you fa xian ta 。 xia er ba ren zhi zuo le yi zhang di tu wo ke yi gei ni 。]

english: I don't have the map on me.
translation: 我身上没有地图。 [wo shen shang mei you di tu 。]

english: You give Denulth the map of the secret way.
translation: 你给德努斯密道的地图。 [ni gei de nu si mi dao de di tu 。]

english: Excellent, this looks perfect. They will never see us coming.
translation: 太棒了，这看起来很完美。他们永远不会看到我们的到来。 [tai bang le ， zhe kan qi lai hen wan mei 。 ta men yong yuan bu hui kan dao wo men de dao lai 。]

english: Have you managed to open the equipment room?
translation: 你成功打开机房了吗？ [ni cheng gong da kai ji fang le ma ？]

english: I have opened the door but I don't have the combination on me.
translation: 我已经打开门，但身上没有密码。 [wo yi jing da kai men ， dan shen shang mei you mi ma 。]

english: Yes! The door is open and here is the combination.
translation: 是的！门是开着的，这是密码。 [shi de ！ men shi kai zhe de ， zhe shi mi ma 。]

english: You give Denulth the combination to the equipment room.
translation: 你把密码交给德努斯到设备室。 [ni ba mi ma jiao gei de nu si dao she bei shi 。]

english: Well done citizen! We will reward you by training you in attack!
translation: 干得好公民！我们将通过训练你的攻击来奖励你！ [gan de hao gong min ！ wo men jiang tong guo xun lian ni de gong ji lai jiang li ni ！]

english: I shall present you with some steel fighting claws. In addition I shall show you the knowledge of creating the fighting claws for yourself.
translation: 我将赠送给你一些钢制战斗爪。另外我还将向您展示为自己制作战斗爪子的知识。 [wo jiang zeng song gei ni yi xie gang zhi zhan dou zhao 。 ling wai wo hai jiang xiang nin zhan shi wei zi ji zhi zuo zhan dou zhua zi de zhi shi 。]

english: You are now an honourary member of the Imperial Guard!
translation: 你现在是帝国卫队的荣誉成员了！ [ni xian zai shi di guo wei dui de rong yu cheng yuan le ！]

english: Quest complete!
translation: 任务完成！ [ren wu wan cheng ！]

english: Welcome back friend!
translation: 欢迎回来朋友！ [huan ying hui lai peng you ！]

english: How goes your fight with the trolls?
translation: 你与巨魔的战斗进展如何？ [ni yu ju mo de zhan dou jin zhan ru he ？]

english: I'm afraid I have bad news. We made our attack as planned, but we met unexpected resistance.
translation: 恐怕我有坏消息。我们按计划发起进攻，但遭到了意想不到的抵抗。 [kong pa wo you huai xiao xi 。 wo men an ji hua fa qi jin gong ， dan zao dao le yi xiang bu dao de di kang 。]

english: What happened?
translation: 发生了什么？ [fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: We were ambushed by trolls coming from the north. They captured Dunstan's son, Godric, who we enlisted at your request, we tried to follow but we were repelled at the foot of their stronghold.
translation: 我们遭到了来自北方的巨魔的伏击。他们俘虏了邓斯坦的儿子戈德里克，我们应你的要求将他征召入伍，我们试图追踪他，但在他们的据点脚下被击退。 [wo men zao dao le lai zi bei fang de ju mo de fu ji 。 ta men fu lu le deng si tan de er zi ge de li ke ， wo men ying ni de yao qiu jiang ta zheng zhao ru wu ， wo men shi tu zhui zong ta ， dan zai ta men de ju dian jiao xia bei ji tui 。]

english: Is there anything I can do to help?
translation: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang mang de ma ？]

english: The way tto the stronghold is treacherous, friend. Even if you manage to climb your way up, there will be many trolls defending the stronghold.
translation: 通往要塞的道路充满危险，朋友。即使你成功爬上去，也会有很多巨魔守卫要塞。 [tong wang yao sai de dao lu chong man wei xian ， peng you 。 ji shi ni cheng gong pa shang qu ， ye hui you hen duo ju mo shou wei yao sai 。]

english: I'll get Godric back!
translation: 我会把戈德里克找回来！ [wo hui ba ge de li ke zhao hui lai ！]

english: God speed friend! I would send some of my me with you, but none of them are brave enough to follow.
translation: 上帝速速朋友！我想派我的一些人和你一起去，但他们没有一个有足够的勇气跟随。 [shang di su su peng you ！ wo xiang pai wo de yi xie ren he ni yi qi qu ， dan ta men mei you yi ge you zu gou de yong qi gen sui 。]

english: I'm sorry to hear that.
translation: 听到这个消息我很遗憾。 [ting dao zhe ge xiao xi wo hen yi han 。]

english: See you about Denulth!
translation: 德纳尔斯见！ [de na er si jian ！]

english: God speed friend!
translation: 上帝速速朋友！ [shang di su su peng you ！]

english: How are you getting on with rescuing Godric?
translation: 你营救戈德里克的进展如何？ [ni ying jiu ge de li ke de jin zhan ru he ？]

english: I haven't found a way to climb up yet.
translation: 我还没有找到爬上去的方法。 [wo hai mei you zhao dao pa shang qu de fang fa 。]

english: Hurry, friend! Who knows what they'll do with Godric?
translation: 快点，朋友！谁知道他们会对戈德里克做什么？ [kuai dian ， peng you ！ shui zhi dao ta men hui dui ge de li ke zuo shen me ？]

english: I've got some climbing boots.
translation: 我有一些登山靴。 [wo you yi xie deng shan xue 。]

english: Then hurry, friend! What are you still doing here?
translation: 那就快点吧，朋友！你还在这里做什么？ [na jiu kuai dian ba ， peng you ！ ni hai zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I've found my way into the stronghold!
translation: 我已经找到进入要塞的路了！ [wo yi jing zhao dao jin ru yao sai de lu le ！]

english: Hurry, friend! What are you still doing here?
translation: 快点，朋友！你还在这里做什么？ [kuai dian ， peng you ！ ni hai zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I've found my way into the prison.
translation: 我已经找到进监狱的路了 [wo yi jing zhao dao jin jian yu de lu le]

english: ...and?
That's all.
translation: 就这样。 [jiu zhe yang 。]

english: Hurry, friend! Find a way to free Godric!
translation: 快点，朋友！找到释放戈德里克的方法！ [kuai dian ， peng you ！ zhao dao shi fang ge de li ke de fang fa ！]

english: I have freed Godric!
translation: 我已经释放了戈德里克！ [wo yi jing shi fang le ge de li ke ！]

english: Oh, what great news! You should hurry to tell Dunstan, he will be overjoyed!

translation: 我想你一定是体内有太多矮人黑啤酒了。 [wo xiang ni yi ding shi ti nei you tai duo ai ren hei pi jiu le 。]

english: Could be, could be, but there's no telling, is there?
translation: 可能是，可能是，但是没有办法，不是吗？ [ke neng shi ， ke neng shi ， dan shi mei you ban fa ， bu shi ma ？]

english: I defeated the spirit of the rock!
translation: 我打败了岩石之魂！ [wo da bai le yan shi zhi hun ！]

english: That's amazing!
translation: 太棒了！ [tai bang le ！]

english: That's fantastic!
translation: 太棒了！ [tai bang le ！]

english: What rock was that again?
translation: 那又是什么岩石？ [na you shi shen me yan shi ？]

english: Pay attention for once, Dernu! It's Dondakan's rock!
translation: 请注意一次，德尔努！这是Dondakan 的岩石！ [qing zhu yi yi ci ， de er nu ！ zhe shi Dondakan  de yan shi ！]

english: That's quite impressive, Player. How did you manage to do that?
translation: 这真是令人印象深刻，玩家。你是怎么做到的？ [zhe zhen shi ling ren yin xiang shen ke ， wan jia 。 ni shi zen me zuo dao de ？]

english: Well, you see, I just-
translation: 好吧，你看，我只是—— [hao ba ， ni kan ， wo zhi shi ——]

english: What kind of question is that to ask? With [his/her/their] great might of course!
translation: 这是要问什么样的问题呢？当然是凭借[他/她/他们的]强大力量！ [zhe shi yao wen shen me yang de wen ti ne ？ dang ran shi ping jie [ ta / ta / ta men de ] qiang da li liang ！]

english: Or vast magical skills!
translation: 或者浩瀚的魔法技能！ [huo zhe hao han de mo fa ji neng ！]

english: No, you're more a ranger, aren't you Player?
translation: 不，你更像是一名游侠，不是玩家吗？ [bu ， ni geng xiang shi yi ming you xia ， bu shi wan jia ma ？]

english: Actually, I-
translation: 事实上，我—— [shi shi shang ， wo ——]

english: Anyway, this calls for a celebration.
translation: 无论如何，这需要庆祝。 [wu lun ru he ， zhe xu yao qing zhu 。]

english: Oh yes, we should go down into Keldagrim to celebrate.
translation: 哦，是的，我们应该去凯尔达格林庆祝一下。 [o ， shi de ， wo men ying gai qu kai er da ge lin qing zhu yi xia 。]

english: Tonight, of course, not now. We're on duty now.
translation: 当然是今晚，不是现在。我们现在正在值班。 [dang ran shi jin wan ， bu shi xian zai 。 wo men xian zai zheng zai zhi ban 。]

english: Right... and I'm sure traffic here will pick up soon with that rock broken.
translation: 是的……我相信随着那块岩石的破碎，这里的交通很快就会恢复。 [shi de …… wo xiang xin sui zhe na kuai yan shi de po sui ， zhe li de jiao tong hen kuai jiu hui hui fu 。]

english: I heard there's vast amount of gold inside!
translation: 听说里面有大量的金子！ [ting shuo li mian you da liang de jin zi ！]

english: The company is going to be rich!
translation: 公司要发财了！ [gong si yao fa cai le ！]

english: Now don't you go and discuss company business in front of this human, Dernu.
translation: 现在你别去在德尔努这个人类面前讨论公司事务了。 [xian zai ni bie qu zai de er nu zhe ge ren lei mian qian tao lun gong si shi wu le 。]

english: Right. Let's get back to work.
translation: 正确的。让我们回去工作吧。 [zheng que de 。 rang wo men hui qu gong zuo ba 。]

english: Anything else you wanted, Player?
translation: 玩家，你还有什么想要的吗？ [wan jia ， ni hai you shen me xiang yao de ma ？]

english: I need some help with this statue... King Alvis' statue, to be precise.
translation: 我需要一些帮助来处理这座雕像……准确地说，是阿尔维斯国王的雕像。 [wo xu yao yi xie bang zhu lai chu li zhe zuo diao xiang …… zhun que di shuo ， shi a er wei si guo wang de diao xiang 。]

english: Oh yes, what's the problem then?
translation: 哦，是的，那有什么问题呢？ [o ， shi de ， na you shen me wen ti ne ？]

english: It was knocked down, remember? Parts of it nearly landed on our heads?
translation: 被撞倒了，还记得吗？它的一部分差点就落在我们头上了？ [bei zhuang dao le ， hai ji de ma ？ ta de yi bu fen cha dian jiu luo zai wo men tou shang le ？]

english: A terrible noise it made too!
translation: 它还发出可怕的声音！ [ta hai fa chu ke pa de sheng yin ！]

english: This sculptor has got me looking for a lot of items, you see.
translation: 你看，这位雕塑家让我寻找了很多物品。 [ni kan ， zhe wei diao su jia rang wo xun zhao le hen duo wu pin 。]

english: Items eh?
translation: 物品啊？ [wu pin a ？]

english: We love items.
translation: 我们喜欢物品。 [wo men xi huan wu pin 。]

english: Can't get enough of them.
translation: 无法得到足够的他们。 [wu fa de dao zu gou de ta men 。]

english: Well, can you he-
translation: 好吧，你能—— [hao ba ， ni neng ——]

english: I got this puzzle box once, you know.
translation: 你知道，我曾经得到过这个拼图盒。 [ni zhi dao ， wo ceng jing de dao guo zhe ge pin tu he 。]

english: Oh, not that story again.
translation: 哦，不再是那个故事了。 [o ， bu zai shi na ge gu shi le 。]

english: You have told that story before, Dernu.
translation: 你以前已经讲过这个故事了，德尔努。 [ni yi qian yi jing jiang guo zhe ge gu shi le ， de er nu 。]

english: Well forget about it then. I'll shut up if you don't want to hear about it.
translation: 那么就忘记它吧。如果你不想听的话我就闭嘴。 [na me jiu wang ji ta ba 。 ru guo ni bu xiang ting de hua wo jiu bi zui 。]

english: Well, the sculptor only needs to build the head now. But I need to get the Consortium to help me with that.
translation: 好吧，雕塑家现在只需要制作头部即可。但我需要让财团帮助我解决这个问题。 [hao ba ， diao su jia xian zai zhi xu yao zhi zuo tou bu ji ke 。 dan wo xu yao rang cai tuan bang zhu wo jie jue zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: The Consortium, you say?
translation: 你说的是财团？ [ni shuo de shi cai tuan ？]

english: You're going to talk to the Consortium?
translation: 你要和财团谈谈吗？ [ni yao he cai tuan tan tan ma ？]

english: My, you're certainly moving up in the dwarven world, aren't you?
translation: 天啊，你肯定在矮人世界里进步了，不是吗？ [tian a ， ni ken ding zai ai ren shi jie li jin bu le ， bu shi ma ？]

english: What do you need us for then?
translation: 那你需要我们做什么？ [na ni xu yao wo men zuo shen me ？]

english: We are but simple dwarves.
translation: 我们只是简单的矮人。 [wo men zhi shi jian dan de ai ren 。]

english: Especially you, Dernu.
translation: 尤其是你，德尔努。 [you qi shi ni ， de er nu 。]

english: Now now, Derni, there was no need for that.
translation: 现在，德尔尼，没有必要这样做了。 [xian zai ， de er ni ， mei you bi yao zhe yang zuo le 。]

english: I have rebuilt the statue for the [company name]!
translation: 我已经为[公司名称]重建了雕像！ [wo yi jing wei [ gong si ming cheng ] chong jian le diao xiang ！]

english: What, really?
translation: 什么，真的吗？ [shen me ， zhen de ma ？]

english: Of course, really! Player wouldn't have said it otherwise, would [he/she/they]?
translation: 当然，真的！否则，玩家不会这么说，[他/她/他们]会吗？ [dang ran ， zhen de ！ fou ze ， wan jia bu hui zhe me shuo ，[ ta / ta / ta men ] hui ma ？]

english: And didn't you see Blasidar working on the statue?
translation: 你没看到布拉西达尔在雕像上工作吗？ [ni mei kan dao bu la xi da er zai diao xiang shang gong zuo ma ？]

english: Oh yes, he was out there for quite a while.
translation: 哦，是的，他在那里待了很长一段时间。 [o ， shi de ， ta zai na li dai le hen zhang yi duan shi jian 。]

english: That must have been a huge task.
translation: 这一定是一项艰巨的任务。 [zhe yi ding shi yi xiang jian ju de ren wu 。]

english: Nothing's too difficult for old Blasidar.
translation: 对于老布拉西达来说，没有什么是太困难的。 [dui yu lao bu la xi da lai shuo ， mei you shen me shi tai kun nan de 。]

english: He truly is a master builder.
translation: 他确实是一位建筑大师。 [ta que shi shi yi wei jian zhu da shi 。]

english: We can all take an example to his hard work and dedication.
translation: 我们都可以以他的努力和奉献精神为榜样。 [wo men dou ke yi yi ta de nu li he feng xian jing shen wei bang yang 。]

english: Speaking of, shouldn't we get back to work ourselves?
translation: 话说回来，我们自己回去工作不好吗？ [hua shuo hui lai ， wo men zi ji hui qu gong zuo bu hao ma ？]

english: Quite right. Anything else you wanted, Player?
translation: 完全正确。玩家，你还有什么想要的吗？ [wan quan zheng que 。 wan jia ， ni hai you shen me xiang yao de ma ？]

english: Do you know about this drunken dwarf...?
translation: 你知道这个喝醉的矮人吗？ [ni zhi dao zhe ge he zui de ai ren ma ？]

english: Drunken dwarf?
translation: 喝醉酒的矮人？ [he zui jiu de ai ren ？]

english: Yeah, we know a drunken dwarf!
translation: 是的，我们认识一个醉酒的矮人！ [shi de ， wo men ren shi yi ge zui jiu de ai ren ！]

english: In fact we know plenty!
translation: 事实上我们知道的很多！ [shi shi shang wo men zhi dao de hen duo ！]

english: There's this one really annoying dwarf though, he sometimes throws rocks at me for no reason.
translation: 不过，有一个非常烦人的矮人，他有时会无缘无故地向我扔石头。 [bu guo ， you yi ge fei chang fan ren de ai ren ， ta you shi hui wu yuan wu gu di xiang wo reng shi tou 。]

english: Yeah, tell me about it.
translation: 是的，告诉我吧。 [shi de ， gao su wo ba 。]

english: The one I mean is his relative, living in the northeast of Keldagrim. I wonder if you could help me with him.
translation: 我指的是他的亲戚，住在凯尔达格林的东北部。我想知道你是否可以帮助我对付他。 [wo zhi de shi ta de qin qi ， zhu zai kai er da ge lin de dong bei bu 。 wo xiang zhi dao ni shi fou ke yi bang zhu wo dui fu ta 。]

english: Ah yes, him.
translation: 啊，是的，他。 [a ， shi de ， ta 。]

english: Such a sad case, poor fellow.
translation: 这是多么悲惨的事啊，可怜的家伙。 [zhe shi duo me bei can de shi a ， ke lian de jia huo 。]

english: Who is he?
translation: 他是谁？ [ta shi shui ？]

english: Don't you know anything?
translation: 你什么都不知道吗？ [ni shen me dou bu zhi dao ma ？]

english: Now now, there's no reason to get angry.
translation: 现在，没有理由生气了。 [xian zai ， mei you li you sheng qi le 。]

english: I suppose you're right. Well, he's a drunk dwarf that talks about kebabs a lot.
translation: 我想你是对的。嗯，他是一个经常谈论烤肉串的醉酒矮人。 [wo xiang ni shi dui de 。 n ， ta shi yi ge jing chang tan lun kao rou chuan de zui jiu ai ren 。]

english: Has some pretty odd tales to tell too.
translation: 还有一些非常奇怪的故事要讲。 [hai you yi xie fei chang qi guai de gu shi yao jiang 。]

english: And I understand he's the relative of that dwarf I mentioned earlier.
translation: 我知道他是我之前提到的那个矮人的亲戚。 [wo zhi dao ta shi wo zhi qian ti dao de na ge ai ren de qin qi 。]

english: I hope that helped, Player?
translation: 我希望这有帮助，玩家？ [wo xi wang zhe you bang zhu ， wan jia ？]

english: I have this unforgettable tale to tell you!
translation: 我有一个难忘的故事要告诉你！ [wo you yi ge nan wang de gu shi yao gao su ni ！]

english: A tale!
translation: 一个故事！ [yi ge gu shi ！]

english: We love tales!
translation: 我们喜欢故事！ [wo men xi huan gu shi ！]

english: We live for tales!
translation: 我们为故事而生！ [wo men wei gu shi er sheng ！]

english: Like, there was this one time when I lost my spanner in the mines...
translation: 就像，有一次我在矿井里丢了扳手…… [jiu xiang ， you yi ci wo zai kuang jing li diu le ban shou ……]

english: Player wants to tell a tale!
translation: 玩家想要讲一个故事！ [wan jia xiang yao jiang yi ge gu shi ！]

english: But my spanner... it's a very interesting tale you know.
translation: 但是我的扳手...你知道这是一个非常有趣的故事。 [dan shi wo de ban shou ... ni zhi dao zhe shi yi ge fei chang you qu de gu shi 。]

english: I think we've heard it before.
translation: 我想我们以前听说过。 [wo xiang wo men yi qian ting shuo guo 。]

english: It was pretty forgettable.
translation: 这真是令人难忘。 [zhe zhen shi ling ren nan wang 。]

english: Excuse me, do you want to hear my tale or not?
translation: 打扰一下，你想不想听我的故事？ [da rao yi xia ， ni xiang bu xiang ting wo de gu shi ？]

english: Happy to.
translation: 很高兴。 [hen gao xing 。]

english: Would love to hear it.
translation: 很想听听。 [hen xiang ting ting 。]

english: As long as it's better than my spanner story.
translation: 只要它比我的扳手故事好就行。 [zhi yao ta bi wo de ban shou gu shi hao jiu xing 。]

english: So, what's your tale like?
translation: 那么，你的故事是什么样的？ [na me ， ni de gu shi shi shen me yang de ？]

english: Ah, I errrr...
translation: 啊，我错了... [a ， wo cuo le ...]

english: I seem to have forgotten.
translation: 我好像忘记了。 [wo hao xiang wang ji le 。]

english: Must have been pretty forgettable as well then.
translation: 那时一定也很容易被遗忘。 [na shi yi ding ye hen rong yi bei yi wang 。]

english: I must be off now, thanks for the chat.
translation: 我现在得走了，谢谢你的聊天。 [wo xian zai de zou le ， xie xie ni de liao tian 。]

english: No problem!
translation: 没问题！ [mei wen ti ！]

english: Glad to be of service!
translation: 很高兴为您服务！ [hen gao xing wei nin fu wu ！]

english: Come back any time!
translation: 随时回来！ [sui shi hui lai ！]

english: What's down this river?
translation: 这条河下游有什么？ [zhe tiao he xia you you shen me ？]

english: Any good spots to fish around here?
translation: 这附近有什么钓鱼的好地方吗？ [zhe fu jin you shen me diao yu de hao di fang ma ？]

english: What are these mines used for?
translation: 这些地雷有什么用？ [zhe xie di lei you shen me yong ？]

english: Can you help me with this rock?
translation: 你能帮我搬动这块石头吗？ [ni neng bang wo ban dong zhe kuai shi tou ma ？]

english: What material would break that rock?
translation: 什么材料可以打破那块岩石？ [shen me cai liao ke yi da po na kuai yan shi ？]

english: Do you know anyone named Rolad?
translation: 你认识一个叫罗拉德的人吗？ [ni ren shi yi ge jiao luo la de de ren ma ？]

english: Dondakan wants to shoot me out of a cannon!
translation: 唐达坎想用大炮射我！ [tang da kan xiang yong da pao she wo ！]

english: Any tips on how to defeat an evil demon?
translation: 关于如何击败邪恶恶魔有什么秘诀吗？ [guan yu ru he ji bai xie e e mo you shen me mi jue ma ？]

english: I defeated the spirit of the rock!
translation: 我打败了岩石之魂！ [wo da bai le yan shi zhi hun ！]

english: I need some help with this statue...
translation: 我需要一些帮助来处理这座雕像... [wo xu yao yi xie bang zhu lai chu li zhe zuo diao xiang ...]

english: I have rebuilt the statue for the [company name]!
translation: 我已经为[公司名称]重建了雕像！ [wo yi jing wei [ gong si ming cheng ] chong jian le diao xiang ！]

english: Do you know about this drunken dwarf...?
translation: 你知道这个喝醉的矮人吗？ [ni zhi dao zhe ge he zui de ai ren ma ？]

english: I have this unforgettable tale to tell you!
translation: 我有一个难忘的故事要告诉你！ [wo you yi ge nan wang de gu shi yao gao su ni ！]

english: I must be off now, thanks for the chat.
translation: 我现在得走了，谢谢你的聊天。 [wo xian zai de zou le ， xie xie ni de liao tian 。]

english: Oh look, a human!
translation: 哦，看，一个人类！ [o ， kan ， yi ge ren lei ！]

english: A human? Can we eat it?
translation: 人类？我们可以吃吗？ [ren lei ？ wo men ke yi chi ma ？]

english: No, you rock brain! Humans are our friends!
translation: 不，你这个大脑！人类是我们的朋友！ [bu ， ni zhe ge da nao ！ ren lei shi wo men de peng you ！]

english: Hello, excuse me...
translation: 你好，请问... [ni hao ， qing wen ...]

english: Not sure if I would call them our friends... Not enemies either, of course.
translation: 不确定我是否会称他们为我们的朋友……当然，也不是敌人。 [bu que ding wo shi fou hui cheng ta men wei wo men de peng you …… dang ran ， ye bu shi di ren 。]

english: Not like the trolls. We hate trolls.
translation: 不像巨魔。我们讨厌巨魔。 [bu xiang ju mo 。 wo men tao yan ju mo 。]

english: Excuse me, I just want to-
translation: 对不起，我只是想—— [dui bu qi ， wo zhi shi xiang ——]

english: Nothing's worse than a troll.
translation: 没有什么比巨魔更糟糕的了。 [mei you shen me bi ju mo geng zao gao de le 。]

english: Except discovering that your pickaxe's gone blunt just as you-
translation: 除了发现你的镐变钝了，就像你一样—— [chu le fa xian ni de gao bian dun le ， jiu xiang ni yi yang ——]

english: Excuse me!!!
translation: 打扰一下！！！ [da rao yi xia ！！！]

english: Why, hello, yes, what is it?
translation: 为什么，你好，是的，那是什么？ [wei shen me ， ni hao ， shi de ， na shi shen me ？]

english: I er... well, who are you?
translation: 我呃……好吧，你是谁？ [wo e …… hao ba ， ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm Derni.
translation: 我是德尔尼。 [wo shi de er ni 。]

english: I'm Dernu.
translation: 我是德尔努。 [wo shi de er nu 。]

english: And I'm Miodvetnir. These are my brothers. And who might you be?
translation: 我是米奥德维特尼尔。这些是我的兄弟。你可能是谁？ [wo shi mi ao de wei te ni er 。 zhe xie shi wo de xiong di 。 ni ke neng shi shui ？]

english: My name is Player.
translation: 我的名字是玩家。 [wo de ming zi shi wan jia 。]

english: Pleased to meet you, Player!
translation: 很高兴认识你，玩家！ [hen gao xing ren shi ni ， wan jia ！]

english: I say, we don't get to see a hummon down here very often!
translation: 我说，我们在这里不常看到哈蒙！ [wo shuo ， wo men zai zhe li bu chang kan dao ha meng ！]

english: It's a human, you metal head! You should pay more attention!
translation: 这是一个人类，你这个金属头！你应该多加注意！ [zhe shi yi ge ren lei ， ni zhe ge jin shu tou ！ ni ying gai duo jia zhu yi ！]

english: So, can I ask you dwarves a few questions?
translation: 那么，我可以问你们矮人几个问题吗？ [na me ， wo ke yi wen ni men ai ren ji ge wen ti ma ？]

english: Of course, we love answering questions!
translation: 当然，我们喜欢回答问题！ [dang ran ， wo men xi huan hui da wen ti ！]

english: We're very good at answering questions!
translation: 我们很擅长回答问题！ [wo men hen shan chang hui da wen ti ！]

english: Fire away!
translation: 开火吧！ [kai huo ba ！]

english: Hello again, Player!
translation: 再次你好，玩家！ [zai ci ni hao ， wan jia ！]

english: Are you lost down here?
translation: 你在这里迷路了吗？ [ni zai zhe li mi lu le ma ？]

english: Or were you just stopping by for a chat?
translation: 或者您只是过来聊聊？ [huo zhe nin zhi shi guo lai liao liao ？]

english: Just stopping by for a chat.
translation: 只是停下来聊天。 [zhi shi ting xia lai liao tian 。]

english: What's down this river?
translation: 这条河下游有什么？ [zhe tiao he xia you you shen me ？]

english: Oh, you don't know?
translation: 哦，你不知道吗？ [o ， ni bu zhi dao ma ？]

english: [He/She] doesn't know?
translation: [他/她]不知道吗？ [[ ta / ta ] bu zhi dao ma ？]

english: [He/She] doesn't know!
translation: [他/她]不知道！ [[ ta / ta ] bu zhi dao ！]

english: Can't you just tell me?
translation: 你就不能告诉我吗？ [ni jiu bu neng gao su wo ma ？]

english: It is our glorious city!
translation: 这是我们光荣的城市！ [zhe shi wo men guang rong de cheng shi ！]

english: The grand city of the dwarves!
translation: 矮人的宏伟城市！ [ai ren de hong wei cheng shi ！]

english: Sparkling jewel of the mountain!
translation: 闪闪发光的山明珠！ [shan shan fa guang de shan ming zhu ！]

english: Keldagrim, our home!
translation: 凯尔达格林，我们的家！ [kai er da ge lin ， wo men de jia ！]

english: Can you take me there?
translation: 你能带我去那里吗？ [ni neng dai wo qu na li ma ？]

english: Oh no, we can't do that.
translation: 哦不，我们不能那样做。 [o bu ， wo men bu neng na yang zuo 。]

english: We're far too busy.
translation: 我们太忙了。 [wo men tai mang le 。]

english: You have to keep busy, you see.
translation: 你必须保持忙碌，你看。 [ni bi xu bao chi mang lu ， ni kan 。]

english: Always keep busy, is what our good father used to say.
translation: 永远保持忙碌，这是我们好父亲常说的。 [yong yuan bao chi mang lu ， zhe shi wo men hao fu qin chang shuo de 。]

english: Besides, there's been some weird going ons in the city.
translation: 除此之外，这座城市还发生了一些奇怪的事情。 [chu ci zhi wai ， zhe zuo cheng shi hai fa sheng le yi xie qi guai de shi qing 。]

english: Don't tell [him/her] that! None of [his/her] business!
translation: 不要告诉[他/她]这个！不关[他/她]的事！ [bu yao gao su [ ta / ta ] zhe ge ！ bu guan [ ta / ta ] de shi ！]

english: Only fair if [he/she] wants to go into the city.
translation: 只有[他/她]想进城才公平。 [zhi you [ ta / ta ] xiang jin cheng cai gong ping 。]

english: Oh yes, they only just cleaned up the mess from the last little incident.
translation: 哦，是的，他们刚刚清理了上次小事件造成的混乱。 [o ， shi de ， ta men gang gang qing li le shang ci xiao shi jian zao cheng de hun luan 。]

english: So watch out if you ever do manage to travel to the city! Weird things could happen!
translation: 因此，如果您确实能够前往这座城市，请注意！奇怪的事情可能会发生！ [yin ci ， ru guo nin que shi neng gou qian wang zhe zuo cheng shi ， qing zhu yi ！ qi guai de shi qing ke neng hui fa sheng ！]

english: Any good spots to fish around here?
translation: 这附近有什么钓鱼的好地方吗？ [zhe fu jin you shen me diao yu de hao di fang ma ？]

english: Fish?
translation: 鱼？ [yu ？]

english: Fish?
translation: 鱼？ [yu ？]

english: What are fish?
translation: 什么是鱼？ [shen me shi yu ？]

english: No fish around here.
translation: 这附近没有鱼。 [zhe fu jin mei you yu 。]

english: Say, you're the Fishing Champion, aren't you?
translation: 话说，你是钓鱼冠军，不是吗？ [hua shuo ， ni shi diao yu guan jun ， bu shi ma ？]

english: That must be why you were talking about fish then...
translation: 这一定就是你当时谈论鱼的原因...... [zhe yi ding jiu shi ni dang shi tan lun yu de yuan yin ......]

english: But this water here, you see, it comes dripping down from above.
translation: 但是这里的水，你看，是从上面滴下来的。 [dan shi zhe li de shui ， ni kan ， shi cong shang mian di xia lai de 。]

english: Molten snow, you see.
translation: 融化的雪，你看。 [rong hua de xue ， ni kan 。]

english: Oh, they're these small wriggly things that live in the water.
translation: 哦，它们是生活在水中的那些蠕动的小东西。 [o ， ta men shi sheng huo zai shui zhong de na xie ru dong de xiao dong xi 。]

english: But they're not all small! Some can be large!
translation: 但它们并不都是小！有些可能很大！ [dan ta men bing bu dou shi xiao ！ you xie ke neng hen da ！]

english: And they don't breathe air.
translation: 而且他们不呼吸空气。 [er qie ta men bu hu xi kong qi 。]

english: But [player name] could tell you all about it! After all, [he's/she's] the Fishing Champion!
translation: 但[玩家姓名]可以告诉你一切！毕竟，[他/她]是钓鱼冠军！ [dan [ wan jia xing ming ] ke yi gao su ni yi qie ！ bi jing ，[ ta / ta ] shi diao yu guan jun ！]

english: Maybe later...
translation: 也许以后... [ye xu yi hou ...]

english: What are these mines used for?
translation: 这些地雷有什么用？ [zhe xie di lei you shen me yong ？]

english: What does it look like they're used for?
translation: 它们看起来像是用来做什么的？ [ta men kan qi lai xiang shi yong lai zuo shen me de ？]

english: Isn't it obvious?
translation: 这不是很明显吗？ [zhe bu shi hen ming xian ma ？]

english: For mining of course!
translation: 当然是为了挖矿！ [dang ran shi wei le wa kuang ！]

english: These mines are actually the territory of one of the eight major companies of the mining Consortium.
translation: 这些矿山其实都是矿业财团八大公司之一的领地。 [zhe xie kuang shan qi shi dou shi kuang ye cai tuan ba da gong si zhi yi de ling di 。]

english: Mining companies? Where are they at then?
translation: 矿业公司？那他们在哪儿呢？ [kuang ye gong si ？ na ta men zai na er ne ？]

english: Oh, they all have their headquarters in the city.
translation: 哦，他们的总部都在城里。 [o ， ta men de zong bu dou zai cheng li 。]

english: First floor of the palace.
translation: 宫殿一楼。 [gong dian yi lou 。]

english: No need to give [him/her] directions.
translation: 无需给[他/她]指示。 [wu xu gei [ ta / ta ] zhi shi 。]

english: We haul all our goods to the city by ship, you see.
translation: 你看，我们用船把所有货物运到城里。 [ni kan ， wo men yong chuan ba suo you huo wu yun dao cheng li 。]

english: Since the mine carts don't come here.
translation: 因为矿车不来这里。 [yin wei kuang che bu lai zhe li 。]

english: But because the river goes right to the city, this is just as easy.
translation: 但由于河流直接流向城市，这也同样容易。 [dan you yu he liu zhi jie liu xiang cheng shi ， zhe ye tong yang rong yi 。]

english: Can you help me with this rock down in the mines?
translation: 你能帮我搬走矿井里的这块石头吗？ [ni neng bang wo ban zou kuang jing li de zhe kuai shi tou ma ？]

english: It seems to be unbreakable. I need to know why.
translation: 似乎是牢不可破的。我需要知道为什么。 [si hu shi lao bu ke po de 。 wo xu yao zhi dao wei shen me 。]

english: Say, is that Dondakan's rock?
translation: 请问，那是Dondakan 的岩石吗？ [qing wen ， na shi Dondakan  de yan shi ma ？]

english: That big unbreakable rock?
translation: 那块坚不可摧的大石头？ [na kuai jian bu ke cui de da shi tou ？]

english: That's what [he/she] said, isn't? Pay more attention!
translation: [他/她]就是这么说的，不是吗？多加注意！ [[ ta / ta ] jiu shi zhe me shuo de ， bu shi ma ？ duo jia zhu yi ！]

english: Yes, yes, that's the one.
translation: 是的，是的，就是这个。 [shi de ， shi de ， jiu shi zhe ge 。]

english: Oh, you're not going to get through there I'm afraid.
translation: 哦，恐怕你无法通过那里。 [o ， kong pa ni wu fa tong guo na li 。]

english: It's unbreakable, you see.
translation: 你看，它是牢不可破的。 [ni kan ， ta shi lao bu ke po de 。]

english: Dondakan's been there for...
translation: 唐达坎已经在那里... [tang da kan yi jing zai na li ...]

english: How long would you say he's been there, Miotvednir?
translation: Miotvednir，你说他在那里待了多久？ [Miotvednir， ni shuo ta zai na li dai le duo jiu ？]

english: Eighteen years, Derni, and not a year shorter!
translation: 德尔尼，十八年了，一年也没有短！ [de er ni ， shi ba nian le ， yi nian ye mei you duan ！]

english: That's some dedication!
translation: 这也算是一种奉献吧！ [zhe ye suan shi yi zhong feng xian ba ！]

english: But look at what it got him.
translation: 但看看这给他带来了什么。 [dan kan kan zhe gei ta dai lai le shen me 。]

english: Nothing, that's what.
translation: 没什么，就是这样。 [mei shen me ， jiu shi zhe yang 。]

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: What material would break that rock? You know, the impenetrable one?
translation: 什么材料可以打破那块岩石？你知道吗，坚不可摧的那个？ [shen me cai liao ke yi da po na kuai yan shi ？ ni zhi dao ma ， jian bu ke cui de na ge ？]

english: Well... have you tried a rune pickaxe?
translation: 嗯...你尝试过符文镐吗？ [n ... ni chang shi guo fu wen gao ma ？]

english: An adamantite tool?
translation: 精金工具？ [jing jin gong ju ？]

english: What about a bronze pickaxe?
translation: 青铜镐怎么样？ [qing tong gao zen me yang ？]

english: A bronze pickaxe??
translation: 青铜镐？？ [qing tong gao ？？]

english: What good would that do?
translation: 这样做有什么好处呢？ [zhe yang zuo you shen me hao chu ne ？]

english: Well, you never know...
translation: 好吧，你永远不知道... [hao ba ， ni yong yuan bu zhi dao ...]

english: Don't you think that's the first thing they tried?
translation: 你不认为这是他们尝试的第一件事吗？ [ni bu ren wei zhe shi ta men chang shi de di yi jian shi ma ？]

english: Hey, it was just a suggestion!
translation: 嘿，这只是一个建议！ [hei ， zhe zhi shi yi ge jian yi ！]

english: Do you know anyone named Rolad? Some kind of a dwarven scholar?
translation: 你认识一个叫罗拉德的人吗？某种矮人学者？ [ni ren shi yi ge jiao luo la de de ren ma ？ mou zhong ai ren xue zhe ？]

english: Sorry, doesn't ring a bell.
translation: 抱歉，没有按铃。 [bao qian ， mei you an ling 。]

english: Oh yes, I know Rolad!
translation: 哦，是的，我认识罗拉德！ [o ， shi de ， wo ren shi luo la de ！]

english: Oh, stop winding up the human, Dernu!
translation: 哦，别再给人类上瘾了，德尔努！ [o ， bie zai gei ren lei shang yin le ， de er nu ！]

english: Do you know where he is right now?
translation: 你知道他现在在哪里吗？ [ni zhi dao ta xian zai zai na li ma ？]

english: No idea, why?
translation: 不知道为什么？ [bu zhi dao wei shen me ？]

english: Dondakan wants to shoot me out of a cannon!
translation: 唐达坎想用大炮射我！ [tang da kan xiang yong da pao she wo ！]

english: Oh dear!
translation: 哦亲爱的！ [o qin ai de ！]

english: How awful!
translation: 多么可怕啊！ [duo me ke pa a ！]

english: That's terrible!
translation: 太可怕了！ [tai ke pa le ！]

english: He thinks I'm actually going to fly through it and land on the other side.
translation: 他认为我实际上会飞过它并降落在另一边。 [ta ren wei wo shi ji shang hui fei guo ta bing jiang luo zai ling yi bian 。]

english: That sounds a bit daft.
translation: 这听起来有点愚蠢。 [zhe ting qi lai you dian yu chun 。]

english: How would that work?
translation: 那会如何运作呢？ [na hui ru he yun zuo ne ？]

english: I think you're going to hurt your head.
translation: 我想你会伤到你的头。 [wo xiang ni hui shang dao ni de tou 。]

english: Old Dondakan might have finally lost it.
translation: 老唐达坎可能终于失去了它。 [lao tang da kan ke neng zhong yu shi qu le ta 。]

english: He was always obsessed with that rock.
translation: 他一直对那块石头很着迷。 [ta yi zhi dui na kuai shi tou hen zhao mi 。]

english: And gold.
translation: 还有黄金。 [hai you huang jin 。]

english: Right, and gold.
translation: 对了，还有黄金。 [dui le ， hai you huang jin 。]

english: Any tips on how to defeat an evil demon?
translation: 关于如何击败邪恶恶魔有什么秘诀吗？ [guan yu ru he ji bai xie e e mo you shen me mi jue ma ？]

english: An evil demon, you say?
translation: 你说是邪恶的恶魔？ [ni shuo shi xie e de e mo ？]

english: I'd run away if I ever ran into an evil demon.
translation: 如果我遇到邪恶的恶魔，我会逃跑。 [ru guo wo yu dao xie e de e mo ， wo hui tao pao 。]

english: Don't be such a coward, Dernu!
translation: 别这么胆小鬼，德尔努！ [bie zhe me dan xiao gui ， de er nu ！]

english: Well, what would you do then?
translation: 嗯，那么你会怎么做？ [n ， na me ni hui zen me zuo ？]

english: I don't know, I've never encountered an evil demon.
translation: 我不知道，我从来没有遇到过邪恶的恶魔。 [wo bu zhi dao ， wo cong lai mei you yu dao guo xie e de e mo 。]

english: I once met a good demon though.
translation: 不过我曾经遇到过一个善良的恶魔。 [bu guo wo ceng jing yu dao guo yi ge shan liang de e mo 。]

english: Oh yes, what did he say?
translation: 哦，是的，他说什么？ [o ， shi de ， ta shuo shen me ？]

english: He gave me a puzzle box and then went off again.
translation: 他给了我一个拼图盒，然后又走了。 [ta gei le wo yi ge pin tu he ， ran hou you zou le 。]

english: I think you must have had too much dwarven stout in you.
translation: 我想你一定是体内有太多矮人黑啤酒了。 [wo xiang ni yi ding shi ti nei you tai duo ai ren hei pi jiu le 。]

english: Could be, could be, but there's no telling, is there?
translation: 可能是，可能是，但是没有办法，不是吗？ [ke neng shi ， ke neng shi ， dan shi mei you ban fa ， bu shi ma ？]

english: I defeated the spirit of the rock!
translation: 我打败了岩石之魂！ [wo da bai le yan shi zhi hun ！]

english: That's amazing!
translation: 太棒了！ [tai bang le ！]

english: That's fantastic!
translation: 太棒了！ [tai bang le ！]

english: What rock was that again?
translation: 那又是什么岩石？ [na you shi shen me yan shi ？]

english: Pay attention for once, Dernu! It's Dondakan's rock!
translation: 请注意一次，德尔努！这是Dondakan 的岩石！ [qing zhu yi yi ci ， de er nu ！ zhe shi Dondakan  de yan shi ！]

english: That's quite impressive, Player. How did you manage to do that?
translation: 这真是令人印象深刻，玩家。你是怎么做到的？ [zhe zhen shi ling ren yin xiang shen ke ， wan jia 。 ni shi zen me zuo dao de ？]

english: Well, you see, I just-
translation: 好吧，你看，我只是—— [hao ba ， ni kan ， wo zhi shi ——]

english: What kind of question is that to ask? With [his/her/their] great might of course!
translation: 这是要问什么样的问题呢？当然是凭借[他/她/他们的]强大力量！ [zhe shi yao wen shen me yang de wen ti ne ？ dang ran shi ping jie [ ta / ta / ta men de ] qiang da li liang ！]

english: Or vast magical skills!
translation: 或者浩瀚的魔法技能！ [huo zhe hao han de mo fa ji neng ！]

english: No, you're more a ranger, aren't you Player?
translation: 不，你更像是一名游侠，不是玩家吗？ [bu ， ni geng xiang shi yi ming you xia ， bu shi wan jia ma ？]

english: Actually, I-
translation: 事实上，我—— [shi shi shang ， wo ——]

english: Anyway, this calls for a celebration.
translation: 无论如何，这需要庆祝。 [wu lun ru he ， zhe xu yao qing zhu 。]

english: Oh yes, we should go down into Keldagrim to celebrate.
translation: 哦，是的，我们应该去凯尔达格林庆祝一下。 [o ， shi de ， wo men ying gai qu kai er da ge lin qing zhu yi xia 。]

english: Tonight, of course, not now. We're on duty now.
translation: 当然是今晚，不是现在。我们现在正在值班。 [dang ran shi jin wan ， bu shi xian zai 。 wo men xian zai zheng zai zhi ban 。]

english: Right... and I'm sure traffic here will pick up soon with that rock broken.
translation: 是的……我相信随着那块岩石的破碎，这里的交通很快就会恢复。 [shi de …… wo xiang xin sui zhe na kuai yan shi de po sui ， zhe li de jiao tong hen kuai jiu hui hui fu 。]

english: I heard there's vast amount of gold inside!
translation: 听说里面有大量的金子！ [ting shuo li mian you da liang de jin zi ！]

english: The company is going to be rich!
translation: 公司要发财了！ [gong si yao fa cai le ！]

english: Now don't you go and discuss company business in front of this human, Dernu.
translation: 现在你别去在德尔努这个人类面前讨论公司事务了。 [xian zai ni bie qu zai de er nu zhe ge ren lei mian qian tao lun gong si shi wu le 。]

english: Right. Let's get back to work.
translation: 正确的。让我们回去工作吧。 [zheng que de 。 rang wo men hui qu gong zuo ba 。]

english: Anything else you wanted, Player?
translation: 玩家，你还有什么想要的吗？ [wan jia ， ni hai you shen me xiang yao de ma ？]

english: I need some help with this statue... King Alvis' statue, to be precise.
translation: 我需要一些帮助来处理这座雕像……准确地说，是阿尔维斯国王的雕像。 [wo xu yao yi xie bang zhu lai chu li zhe zuo diao xiang …… zhun que di shuo ， shi a er wei si guo wang de diao xiang 。]

english: Oh yes, what's the problem then?
translation: 哦，是的，那有什么问题呢？ [o ， shi de ， na you shen me wen ti ne ？]

english: It was knocked down, remember? Parts of it nearly landed on our heads?
translation: 被撞倒了，还记得吗？它的一部分差点就落在我们头上了？ [bei zhuang dao le ， hai ji de ma ？ ta de yi bu fen cha dian jiu luo zai wo men tou shang le ？]

english: A terrible noise it made too!
translation: 它还发出可怕的声音！ [ta hai fa chu ke pa de sheng yin ！]

english: This sculptor has got me looking for a lot of items, you see.
translation: 你看，这位雕塑家让我寻找了很多物品。 [ni kan ， zhe wei diao su jia rang wo xun zhao le hen duo wu pin 。]

english: Items eh?
translation: 物品啊？ [wu pin a ？]

english: We love items.
translation: 我们喜欢物品。 [wo men xi huan wu pin 。]

english: Can't get enough of them.
translation: 无法得到足够的他们。 [wu fa de dao zu gou de ta men 。]

english: Well, can you he-
translation: 好吧，你能—— [hao ba ， ni neng ——]

english: I got this puzzle box once, you know.
translation: 你知道，我曾经得到过这个拼图盒。 [ni zhi dao ， wo ceng jing de dao guo zhe ge pin tu he 。]

english: Oh, not that story again.
translation: 哦，不再是那个故事了。 [o ， bu zai shi na ge gu shi le 。]

english: You have told that story before, Dernu.
translation: 你以前已经讲过这个故事了，德尔努。 [ni yi qian yi jing jiang guo zhe ge gu shi le ， de er nu 。]

english: Well forget about it then. I'll shut up if you don't want to hear about it.
translation: 那么就忘记它吧。如果你不想听的话我就闭嘴。 [na me jiu wang ji ta ba 。 ru guo ni bu xiang ting de hua wo jiu bi zui 。]

english: Well, the sculptor only needs to build the head now. But I need to get the Consortium to help me with that.
translation: 好吧，雕塑家现在只需要制作头部即可。但我需要让财团帮助我解决这个问题。 [hao ba ， diao su jia xian zai zhi xu yao zhi zuo tou bu ji ke 。 dan wo xu yao rang cai tuan bang zhu wo jie jue zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: The Consortium, you say?
translation: 你说的是财团？ [ni shuo de shi cai tuan ？]

english: You're going to talk to the Consortium?
translation: 你要和财团谈谈吗？ [ni yao he cai tuan tan tan ma ？]

english: My, you're certainly moving up in the dwarven world, aren't you?
translation: 天啊，你肯定在矮人世界里进步了，不是吗？ [tian a ， ni ken ding zai ai ren shi jie li jin bu le ， bu shi ma ？]

english: What do you need us for then?
translation: 那你需要我们做什么？ [na ni xu yao wo men zuo shen me ？]

english: We are but simple dwarves.
translation: 我们只是简单的矮人。 [wo men zhi shi jian dan de ai ren 。]

english: Especially you, Dernu.
translation: 尤其是你，德尔努。 [you qi shi ni ， de er nu 。]

english: Now now, Derni, there was no need for that.
translation: 现在，德尔尼，没有必要这样做了。 [xian zai ， de er ni ， mei you bi yao zhe yang zuo le 。]

english: I have rebuilt the statue for the [company name]!
translation: 我已经为[公司名称]重建了雕像！ [wo yi jing wei [ gong si ming cheng ] chong jian le diao xiang ！]

english: What, really?
translation: 什么，真的吗？ [shen me ， zhen de ma ？]

english: Of course, really! Player wouldn't have said it otherwise, would [he/she/they]?
translation: 当然，真的！否则，玩家不会这么说，[他/她/他们]会吗？ [dang ran ， zhen de ！ fou ze ， wan jia bu hui zhe me shuo ，[ ta / ta / ta men ] hui ma ？]

english: And didn't you see Blasidar working on the statue?
translation: 你没看到布拉西达尔在雕像上工作吗？ [ni mei kan dao bu la xi da er zai diao xiang shang gong zuo ma ？]

english: Oh yes, he was out there for quite a while.
translation: 哦，是的，他在那里待了很长一段时间。 [o ， shi de ， ta zai na li dai le hen zhang yi duan shi jian 。]

english: That must have been a huge task.
translation: 这一定是一项艰巨的任务。 [zhe yi ding shi yi xiang jian ju de ren wu 。]

english: Nothing's too difficult for old Blasidar.
translation: 对于老布拉西达来说，没有什么是太困难的。 [dui yu lao bu la xi da lai shuo ， mei you shen me shi tai kun nan de 。]

english: He truly is a master builder.
translation: 他确实是一位建筑大师。 [ta que shi shi yi wei jian zhu da shi 。]

english: We can all take an example to his hard work and dedication.
translation: 我们都可以以他的努力和奉献精神为榜样。 [wo men dou ke yi yi ta de nu li he feng xian jing shen wei bang yang 。]

english: Speaking of, shouldn't we get back to work ourselves?
translation: 话说回来，我们自己回去工作不好吗？ [hua shuo hui lai ， wo men zi ji hui qu gong zuo bu hao ma ？]

english: Quite right. Anything else you wanted, Player?
translation: 完全正确。玩家，你还有什么想要的吗？ [wan quan zheng que 。 wan jia ， ni hai you shen me xiang yao de ma ？]

english: Do you know about this drunken dwarf...?
translation: 你知道这个喝醉的矮人吗？ [ni zhi dao zhe ge he zui de ai ren ma ？]

english: Drunken dwarf?
translation: 喝醉酒的矮人？ [he zui jiu de ai ren ？]

english: Yeah, we know a drunken dwarf!
translation: 是的，我们认识一个醉酒的矮人！ [shi de ， wo men ren shi yi ge zui jiu de ai ren ！]

english: In fact we know plenty!
translation: 事实上我们知道的很多！ [shi shi shang wo men zhi dao de hen duo ！]

english: There's this one really annoying dwarf though, he sometimes throws rocks at me for no reason.
translation: 不过，有一个非常烦人的矮人，他有时会无缘无故地向我扔石头。 [bu guo ， you yi ge fei chang fan ren de ai ren ， ta you shi hui wu yuan wu gu di xiang wo reng shi tou 。]

english: Yeah, tell me about it.
translation: 是的，告诉我吧。 [shi de ， gao su wo ba 。]

english: The one I mean is his relative, living in the northeast of Keldagrim. I wonder if you could help me with him.
translation: 我指的是他的亲戚，住在凯尔达格林的东北部。我想知道你是否可以帮助我对付他。 [wo zhi de shi ta de qin qi ， zhu zai kai er da ge lin de dong bei bu 。 wo xiang zhi dao ni shi fou ke yi bang zhu wo dui fu ta 。]

english: Ah yes, him.
translation: 啊，是的，他。 [a ， shi de ， ta 。]

english: Such a sad case, poor fellow.
translation: 这是多么悲惨的事啊，可怜的家伙。 [zhe shi duo me bei can de shi a ， ke lian de jia huo 。]

english: Who is he?
translation: 他是谁？ [ta shi shui ？]

english: Don't you know anything?
translation: 你什么都不知道吗？ [ni shen me dou bu zhi dao ma ？]

english: Now now, there's no reason to get angry.
translation: 现在，没有理由生气了。 [xian zai ， mei you li you sheng qi le 。]

english: I suppose you're right. Well, he's a drunk dwarf that talks about kebabs a lot.
translation: 我想你是对的。嗯，他是一个经常谈论烤肉串的醉酒矮人。 [wo xiang ni shi dui de 。 n ， ta shi yi ge jing chang tan lun kao rou chuan de zui jiu ai ren 。]

english: Has some pretty odd tales to tell too.
translation: 还有一些非常奇怪的故事要讲。 [hai you yi xie fei chang qi guai de gu shi yao jiang 。]

english: And I understand he's the relative of that dwarf I mentioned earlier.
translation: 我知道他是我之前提到的那个矮人的亲戚。 [wo zhi dao ta shi wo zhi qian ti dao de na ge ai ren de qin qi 。]

english: I hope that helped, Player?
translation: 我希望这有帮助，玩家？ [wo xi wang zhe you bang zhu ， wan jia ？]

english: I have this unforgettable tale to tell you!
translation: 我有一个难忘的故事要告诉你！ [wo you yi ge nan wang de gu shi yao gao su ni ！]

english: A tale!
translation: 一个故事！ [yi ge gu shi ！]

english: We love tales!
translation: 我们喜欢故事！ [wo men xi huan gu shi ！]

english: We live for tales!
translation: 我们为故事而生！ [wo men wei gu shi er sheng ！]

english: Like, there was this one time when I lost my spanner in the mines...
translation: 就像，有一次我在矿井里丢了扳手…… [jiu xiang ， you yi ci wo zai kuang jing li diu le ban shou ……]

english: Player wants to tell a tale!
translation: 玩家想要讲一个故事！ [wan jia xiang yao jiang yi ge gu shi ！]

english: But my spanner... it's a very interesting tale you know.
translation: 但是我的扳手...你知道这是一个非常有趣的故事。 [dan shi wo de ban shou ... ni zhi dao zhe shi yi ge fei chang you qu de gu shi 。]

english: I think we've heard it before.
translation: 我想我们以前听说过。 [wo xiang wo men yi qian ting shuo guo 。]

english: It was pretty forgettable.
translation: 这真是令人难忘。 [zhe zhen shi ling ren nan wang 。]

english: Excuse me, do you want to hear my tale or not?
translation: 打扰一下，你想不想听我的故事？ [da rao yi xia ， ni xiang bu xiang ting wo de gu shi ？]

english: Happy to.
translation: 很高兴。 [hen gao xing 。]

english: Would love to hear it.
translation: 很想听听。 [hen xiang ting ting 。]

english: As long as it's better than my spanner story.
translation: 只要它比我的扳手故事好就行。 [zhi yao ta bi wo de ban shou gu shi hao jiu xing 。]

english: So, what's your tale like?
translation: 那么，你的故事是什么样的？ [na me ， ni de gu shi shi shen me yang de ？]

english: Ah, I errrr...
translation: 啊，我错了... [a ， wo cuo le ...]

english: I seem to have forgotten.
translation: 我好像忘记了。 [wo hao xiang wang ji le 。]

english: Must have been pretty forgettable as well then.
translation: 那时一定也很容易被遗忘。 [na shi yi ding ye hen rong yi bei yi wang 。]

english: I must be off now, thanks for the chat.
translation: 我现在得走了，谢谢你的聊天。 [wo xian zai de zou le ， xie xie ni de liao tian 。]

english: No problem!
translation: 没问题！ [mei wen ti ！]

english: Glad to be of service!
translation: 很高兴为您服务！ [hen gao xing wei nin fu wu ！]

english: Come back any time!
translation: 随时回来！ [sui shi hui lai ！]

english: What's down this river?
translation: 这条河下游有什么？ [zhe tiao he xia you you shen me ？]

english: Any good spots to fish around here?
translation: 这附近有什么钓鱼的好地方吗？ [zhe fu jin you shen me diao yu de hao di fang ma ？]

english: What are these mines used for?
translation: 这些地雷有什么用？ [zhe xie di lei you shen me yong ？]

english: Can you help me with this rock?
translation: 你能帮我搬动这块石头吗？ [ni neng bang wo ban dong zhe kuai shi tou ma ？]

english: What material would break that rock?
translation: 什么材料可以打破那块岩石？ [shen me cai liao ke yi da po na kuai yan shi ？]

english: Do you know anyone named Rolad?
translation: 你认识一个叫罗拉德的人吗？ [ni ren shi yi ge jiao luo la de de ren ma ？]

english: Dondakan wants to shoot me out of a cannon!
translation: 唐达坎想用大炮射我！ [tang da kan xiang yong da pao she wo ！]

english: Any tips on how to defeat an evil demon?
translation: 关于如何击败邪恶恶魔有什么秘诀吗？ [guan yu ru he ji bai xie e e mo you shen me mi jue ma ？]

english: I defeated the spirit of the rock!
translation: 我打败了岩石之魂！ [wo da bai le yan shi zhi hun ！]

english: I need some help with this statue...
translation: 我需要一些帮助来处理这座雕像... [wo xu yao yi xie bang zhu lai chu li zhe zuo diao xiang ...]

english: I have rebuilt the statue for the [company name]!
translation: 我已经为[公司名称]重建了雕像！ [wo yi jing wei [ gong si ming cheng ] chong jian le diao xiang ！]

english: Do you know about this drunken dwarf...?
translation: 你知道这个喝醉的矮人吗？ [ni zhi dao zhe ge he zui de ai ren ma ？]

english: I have this unforgettable tale to tell you!
translation: 我有一个难忘的故事要告诉你！ [wo you yi ge nan wang de gu shi yao gao su ni ！]

english: I must be off now, thanks for the chat.
translation: 我现在得走了，谢谢你的聊天。 [wo xian zai de zou le ， xie xie ni de liao tian 。]

english: Good day, Your Highness. Can I help you with anything?
translation: 美好的一天，殿下。我可以帮你什么忙吗？ [mei hao de yi tian ， dian xia 。 wo ke yi bang ni shen me mang ma ？]

english: Can I use your anvil?
translation: 我可以使用你的铁砧吗？ [wo ke yi shi yong ni de tie zhen ma ？]

english: Of course, Your Royal Highness.
translation: 当然，殿下。 [dang ran ， dian xia 。]

english: Nothing, thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。]

english: Can I use your anvil?
translation: 我可以使用你的铁砧吗？ [wo ke yi shi yong ni de tie zhen ma ？]

english: Nothing, thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。]

english: You look ready for combat.
translation: 你看起来已经准备好战斗了。 [ni kan qi lai yi jing zhun bei hao zhan dou le 。]

english: Aye, indeed I am.
translation: 是的，我确实是。 [shi de ， wo que shi shi 。]

english: What brings you to this place? I can't imagine anyone coming here by choice.
translation: 是什么让你来到这个地方？我无法想象有人会自愿来到这里。 [shi shen me rang ni lai dao zhe ge di fang ？ wo wu fa xiang xiang you ren hui zi yuan lai dao zhe li 。]

english: You're right, I did not come here by choice. I came here for vengeance.
translation: 你说得对，我不是自愿来到这里的。我来这里是为了报仇。 [ni shuo de dui ， wo bu shi zi yuan lai dao zhe li de 。 wo lai zhe li shi wei le bao chou 。]

english: Vengeance? Against whom? Did someone take your gardening equipment?
translation: 复仇？针对谁？有人拿走了你的园艺设备吗？ [fu chou ？ zhen dui shui ？ you ren na zou le ni de yuan yi she bei ma ？]

english: My mission is not against another man and I will not have it mocked.
translation: 我的使命不是针对另一个人，我不会让它受到嘲笑。 [wo de shi ming bu shi zhen dui ling yi ge ren ， wo bu hui rang ta shou dao chao xiao 。]

english: Okay, sorry, I was just trying to lighten the mood. Care to tell me what it is against then?
translation: 好吧，抱歉，我只是想缓和一下气氛。能告诉我它反对什么吗？ [hao ba ， bao qian ， wo zhi shi xiang huan he yi xia qi fen 。 neng gao su wo ta fan dui shen me ma ？]

english: Callisto, the great bear of the wilderness.
translation: 卡利斯托，荒野中的巨熊。 [ka li si tuo ， huang ye zhong de ju xiong 。]

english: Can't say I've come across it before.
translation: 不能说我以前遇到过。 [bu neng shuo wo yi qian yu dao guo 。]

english: I'm not surprised, you'd do well to avoid him. Callisto is a great bear, his strength and size enhanced by the corruption of the Wilderness.
translation: 我并不感到惊讶，你最好避开他。卡利斯托是一只巨大的熊，他的力量和体型因荒野的腐化而增强。 [wo bing bu gan dao jing ya ， ni zui hao bi kai ta 。 ka li si tuo shi yi zhi ju da de xiong ， ta de li liang he ti xing yin huang ye de fu hua er zeng qiang 。]

english: Ah, I've had a few run ins with him myself.
translation: 啊，我自己也和他发生过几次冲突。 [a ， wo zi ji ye he ta fa sheng guo ji ci chong tu 。]

english: Then you'll know he's not something to mock. I'm surprised you survived your encounter with such a great and corrupted beast.
translation: 然后你就会知道他不是一个可以嘲笑的人。我很惊讶你在遭遇如此强大而腐败的野兽时竟然能幸存下来。 [ran hou ni jiu hui zhi dao ta bu shi yi ge ke yi chao xiao de ren 。 wo hen jing ya ni zai zao yu ru ci qiang da er fu bai de ye shou shi jing ran neng xing cun xia lai 。]

english: I'm stronger than I look, I've seen my fair share of monsters.
translation: 我比看上去更强大，我见过很多怪物。 [wo bi kan shang qu geng qiang da ， wo jian guo hen duo guai wu 。]

english: Why are you so intent on taking him down?
translation: 你为何如此执着地想要打倒他？ [ni wei he ru ci zhi zhuo di xiang yao da dao ta ？]

english: Callisto killed my father. After hearing of a great beast in the heart of the Wilderness, he took it upon himself to bring him down.
translation: 卡利斯托杀了我父亲。在听说荒野中心有一只巨兽后，他决定亲自将其打倒。 [ka li si tuo sha le wo fu qin 。 zai ting shuo huang ye zhong xin you yi zhi ju shou hou ， ta jue ding qin zi jiang qi da dao 。]

english: He left our family home in Hosidius to hunt it down and...
translation: 他离开我们在霍西迪乌斯的家去追捕它，然后…… [ta li kai wo men zai huo xi di wu si de jia qu zhui bu ta ， ran hou ……]

english: ... I haven't seen my father since. I swore I would avenge him and have dedicated my whole life to training for that moment.
translation: ……从那以后我就再也没有见过我的父亲。我发誓我要为他报仇，并为那一刻奉献了一生的训练。 […… cong na yi hou wo jiu zai ye mei you jian guo wo de fu qin 。 wo fa shi wo yao wei ta bao chou ， bing wei na yi ke feng xian le yi sheng de xun lian 。]

english: What happens after? When you do take Callisto down that is.
translation: 之后会发生什么？当你确实击落卡利斯托时就是这样。 [zhi hou hui fa sheng shen me ？ dang ni que shi ji luo ka li si tuo shi jiu shi zhe yang 。]

english: Oh... uh... I never thought about that...
translation: 哦……呃……我从来没想过这个…… [o …… e …… wo cong lai mei xiang guo zhe ge ……]

english: My whole life has been spent preparing to avenge my father, I never thought about anything else...
translation: 我一生都在准备为父亲报仇，从未想过其他的事情…… [wo yi sheng dou zai zhun bei wei fu qin bao chou ， cong wei xiang guo qi ta de shi qing ……]

english: You seem like you've got a lot to think about then. I'll leave you to it.
translation: 看来你有很多事情要考虑。我就让你去吧。 [kan lai ni you hen duo shi qing yao kao lv 。 wo jiu rang ni qu ba 。]

english: Hey. Do you know anything about this?
translation: 嘿。你知道这件事吗？ [hei 。 ni zhi dao zhe jian shi ma ？]

english: Ah, a fellow marksman. That's a unique bow you have there.
translation: 啊，一个神枪手。那是你那里有的独特的弓。 [a ， yi ge shen qiang shou 。 na shi ni na li you de du te de gong 。]

english: Do you know anything about it?
translation: 你知道吗？ [ni zhi dao ma ？]

english: I've done my fair bit of fletching in my day. I'd say this bow can be improved upon.
translation: 我这一天已经完成了相当多的羽毛制作工作。我想说这把弓还可以改进。 [wo zhe yi tian yi jing wan cheng le xiang dang duo de yu mao zhi zuo gong zuo 。 wo xiang shuo zhe ba gong hai ke yi gai jin 。]

english: See those etches on it? You could put something sharp in there to improve the bow's strength.
translation: 看到上面那些蚀刻了吗？你可以在里面放一些锋利的东西来提高弓的强度。 [kan dao shang mian na xie shi ke le ma ？ ni ke yi zai li mian fang yi xie feng li de dong xi lai ti gao gong de qiang du 。]

english: Interesting! I'll be on the lookout for a powerful enhancement like that.
translation: 有趣的！我会寻找类似的强大增强功能。 [you qu de ！ wo hui xun zhao lei si de qiang da zeng qiang gong neng 。]

english: Those look like strong fangs. You could probably attach them to a bow to make it stronger.
translation: 那些看起来像坚固的獠牙。您可以将它们连接到弓上以使其更坚固。 [na xie kan qi lai xiang jian gu de liao ya 。 nin ke yi jiang ta men lian jie dao gong shang yi shi qi geng jian gu 。]

english: Interesting! I'll be on the lookout for a suitable bow.
translation: 有趣的！我会寻找合适的弓。 [you qu de ！ wo hui xun zhao he shi de gong 。]

english: Perhaps I could use this?
translation: 也许我可以用这个？ [ye xu wo ke yi yong zhe ge ？]

english: Yes. Those look like they could be attached to the weapon.
translation: 是的。这些看起来可以连接到武器上。 [shi de 。 zhe xie kan qi lai ke yi lian jie dao wu qi shang 。]

english: Could you combine them?
translation: 你能把它们结合起来吗？ [ni neng ba ta men jie he qi lai ma ？]

english: Sure I can. For the right price.
translation: 我当然可以。以合适的价格。 [wo dang ran ke yi 。 yi he shi de jia ge 。]

english: Sigh. How much?
translation: 叹。多少？ [tan 。 duo shao ？]

english: 500,000 coins would do nicely.
translation: 500,000枚金币就已经很不错了。 [500,000 mei jin bi jiu yi jing hen bu cuo le 。]

english: I don't have the money for that.
translation: 我没有钱做那个。 [wo mei you qian zuo na ge 。]

english: Feel free to come back when you do.
translation: 回来后请随时回来。 [hui lai hou qing sui shi hui lai 。]

english: There we go! All done.
translation: 我们开始吧！全部完成。 [wo men kai shi ba ！ quan bu wan cheng 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Are those... Bear claws?
translation: 那是……熊爪吗？ [na shi …… xiong zhao ma ？]

english: Yeah. I got them from a really big bear.
translation: 是的。我从一头非常大的熊那里得到了它们。 [shi de 。 wo cong yi tou fei chang da de xiong na li de dao le ta men 。]

english: By the gods... This bear must be even bigger than I imagined.
translation: 天啊……这只熊一定比我想象的还要大。 [tian a …… zhe zhi xiong yi ding bi wo xiang xiang de hai yao da 。]

english: So do you know if the claws would be useful at all?
translation: 那么你知道爪子是否有用吗？ [na me ni zhi dao zhua zi shi fou you yong ma ？]

english: I... have a lot to think about. Perhaps Andros Mai over there can help you while I think.
translation: 我……有很多事情要考虑。我想，也许那边的安德罗斯·麦可以帮助你。 [wo …… you hen duo shi qing yao kao lv 。 wo xiang ， ye xu na bian de an de luo si · mai ke yi bang zhu ni 。]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: That looks like any skull to me. Who's is it?
translation: 对我来说，这看起来就像任何头骨。是谁的？ [dui wo lai shuo ， zhe kan qi lai jiu xiang ren he tou gu 。 shi shei de ？]

english: It's mine. I picked it up.
translation: 这是我的。我把它捡了起来。 [zhe shi wo de 。 wo ba ta jian le qi lai 。]

english: I meant... Sigh. Never mind. What do you want with the skull?
translation: 我的意思是……叹息。没关系。你想要头骨做什么？ [wo de yi si shi …… tan xi 。 mei guan xi 。 ni xiang yao tou gu zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm trying to find out if it's useful.
translation: 我正在尝试找出它是否有用。 [wo zheng zai chang shi zhao chu ta shi fou you yong 。]

english: Don't know much about skulls, myself. That mage over there might know.
translation: 我自己对头骨了解不多。那边的法师可能知道。 [wo zi ji dui tou gu liao jie bu duo 。 na bian de fa shi ke neng zhi dao 。]

english: She's into some weird stuff, that one. Think she said her name was Phabelle Bile.
translation: 她对一些奇怪的东西很感兴趣。我想她说她的名字叫法贝尔·拜尔。 [ta dui yi xie qi guai de dong xi hen gan xing qu 。 wo xiang ta shuo ta de ming zi jiao fa bei er · bai er 。]

english: No, I'm afraid not.
translation: 不，恐怕不是。 [bu ， kong pa bu shi 。]

english: Oh. Do you know someone who might know more?
translation: 哦。您认识一个可能了解更多的人吗？ [o 。 nin ren shi yi ge ke neng liao jie geng duo de ren ma ？]

english: Just earlier I saw this lady run down into the basement of this pub.
translation: 就在早些时候，我看到这位女士跑进了这家酒吧的地下室。 [jiu zai zao xie shi hou ， wo kan dao zhe wei nv shi pao jin le zhe jia jiu ba de di xia shi 。]

english: I don't know who she is, but she looks like a strange one.
translation: 我不知道她是谁，但她看起来很奇怪。 [wo bu zhi dao ta shi shui ， dan ta kan qi lai hen qi guai 。]

english: Strange attracts strange, so I reckon she might know about your strange weapon piece.
translation: 怪人吸引怪人，所以我猜她可能知道你那件奇怪的武器。 [guai ren xi yin guai ren ， suo yi wo cai ta ke neng zhi dao ni na jian qi guai de wu qi 。]

english: You look ready for combat.
translation: 你看起来已经准备好战斗了。 [ni kan qi lai yi jing zhun bei hao zhan dou le 。]

english: Ask about rare item.
translation: 询问稀有物品。 [xun wen xi you wu pin 。]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: You're a long way from home, traveller! How about some food to keep you going?
translation: 旅行者，你离家很远！来点食物让你继续前进怎么样？ [lv xing zhe ， ni li jia hen yuan ！ lai dian shi wu rang ni ji xu qian jin zen me yang ？]

english: Yes, please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: I'll be here if you find yourself hungry!
translation: 如果你饿了，我就在这里！ [ru guo ni e le ， wo jiu zai zhe li ！]

english: Yes, please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Can I go in the Arboretum?
translation: 我可以去植物园吗？ [wo ke yi qu zhi wu yuan ma ？]

english: Yes. Now leave me alone.
translation: 是的。现在别管我了。 [shi de 。 xian zai bie guan wo le 。]

english: Yes?
translation: 是的？ [shi de ？]

english: What are you serving?
translation: 你在服务什么？ [ni zai fu wu shen me ？]

english: Blood.
translation: 血。 [xue 。]

english: Is that it?
translation: 是这样吗？ [shi zhe yang ma ？]

english: Yes, by the pint. Now, do you want one or not?
translation: 是的，按品脱计算。现在，你想要还是不想要？ [shi de ， an pin tuo ji suan 。 xian zai ， ni xiang yao hai shi bu xiang yao ？]

english: Sure.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: Two coins.
translation: 两枚硬币。 [liang mei ying bi 。]

english: Oh dear, I don't seem to have enough money.
translation: 哎呀，看来我钱不够了。 [ai ya ， kan lai wo qian bu gou le 。]

english: Clear off then.
translation: 那就清除吧 [na jiu qing chu ba]

english: I'll pass.
translation: 我会通过。 [wo hui tong guo 。]

english: What are you selling?
translation: 你卖什么？ [ni mai shen me ？]

english: To you? Nothing.
translation: 对你来说？没有什么。 [dui ni lai shuo ？ mei you shen me 。]

english: Why?
translation: 为什么？ [wei shen me ？]

english: You're new here. I don't sell to new blood. Make a name for yourself and maybe I'll reconsider.
translation: 你是新来的。我不卖给新鲜血液。为自己起个名字，也许我会重新考虑。 [ni shi xin lai de 。 wo bu mai gei xin xian xue ye 。 wei zi ji qi ge ming zi ， ye xu wo hui chong xin kao lv 。]

english: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 人类！在我叫守卫之前回到奴隶围栏！ [ren lei ！ zai wo jiao shou wei zhi qian hui dao nu li wei lan ！]

english: Sure.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: I'll pass.
translation: 我会通过。 [wo hui tong guo 。]

english: So can I go in now?
translation: 那我现在可以进去吗？ [na wo xian zai ke yi jin qu ma ？]

english: Yes! Now get out of my sight!
translation: 是的！现在就滚出我的视线吧！ [shi de ！ xian zai jiu gun chu wo de shi xian ba ！]

english: Good morning.
translation: 早上好。 [zao shang hao 。]

english: Sorry, but this is NOT a good morning!
translation: 抱歉，这不是一个美好的早晨！ [bao qian ， zhe bu shi yi ge mei hao de zao chen ！]
