english: Why, what's the matter?
translation: 为什么，怎么了？ [wei shen me ， zen me le ？]

english: I'm going to lose my job!
translation: 我要失业了！ [wo yao shi ye le ！]

english: What have you done to deserve that?
translation: 你做了什么值得这样？ [ni zuo le shen me zhi de zhe yang ？]

english: Nothing! But the Piscatoris Fishing Colony is going to go out of business, and I'll have to go back to the east.
translation: 没有什么！但皮斯卡托里斯钓鱼场即将倒闭，我将不得不返回东部。 [mei you shen me ！ dan pi si ka tuo li si diao yu chang ji jiang dao bi ， wo jiang bu de bu fan hui dong bu 。]

english: Oh dear.
translation: 哦亲爱的。 [o qin ai de 。]

english: If you want to help, you can get Kathy to take you up to the Colony. Herman's looking for someone to run an important errand for him.
translation: 如果你想帮忙，可以让凯西带你去殖民地。赫尔曼正在寻找一个人来替他执行一项重要的任务。 [ru guo ni xiang bang mang ， ke yi rang kai xi dai ni qu zhi min di 。 he er man zheng zai xun zhao yi ge ren lai ti ta zhi xing yi xiang zhong yao de ren wu 。]

english: I'll bear it in mind.
translation: 我会记住的。 [wo hui ji zhu de 。]

english: Hello! What can I do for you?
translation: 你好！我能为你做什么？ [ni hao ！ wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: How are things going for the Colony now the trolls have all gone away?
translation: 现在巨魔都消失了，殖民地的情况怎么样了？ [xian zai ju mo dou xiao shi le ， zhi min di de qing kuang zen me yang le ？]

english: Well, it's been fairly quiet around here, but there's always repair work to keep us busy.
translation: 嗯，这附近相当安静，但总有维修工作让我们忙个不停。 [n ， zhe fu jin xiang dang an jing ， dan zong you wei xiu gong zuo rang wo men mang ge bu ting 。]

english: Catching plenty of fish?
translation: 钓到很多鱼吗？ [diao dao hen duo yu ma ？]

english: Oh yes, lots of them. Their population's been swelling ever since you wiped out the trolls in the area. They've hardly got any natural predators now.
translation: 哦，是的，很多。自从你消灭了该地区的巨魔以来，他们的人口一直在膨胀。现在它们几乎没有天敌了。 [o ， shi de ， hen duo 。 zi cong ni xiao mie le gai di qu de ju mo yi lai ， ta men de ren kou yi zhi zai peng zhang 。 xian zai ta men ji hu mei you tian di le 。]

english: Oh... I suppose that's good...
translation: 哦……我想这样也不错…… [o …… wo xiang zhe yang ye bu cuo ……]

english: I was just wondering what you're doing.
translation: 我只是想知道你在做什么。 [wo zhi shi xiang zhi dao ni zai zuo shen me 。]

english: Franklin's got me fixing this wall. You did a pretty good patch-job, but it could do with some work.
translation: 富兰克林让我修好这堵墙。你的修补工作做得相当不错，但还需要做一些工作。 [fu lan ke lin rang wo xiu hao zhe du qiang 。 ni de xiu bu gong zuo zuo de xiang dang bu cuo ， dan hai xu yao zuo yi xie gong zuo 。]

english: I'm not surprised - iron sheets won't last any time at all with all that salt water around.
translation: 我并不感到惊讶——周围都是盐水，铁皮根本就不会耐用。 [wo bing bu gan dao jing ya —— zhou wei dou shi yan shui ， tie pi gen ben jiu bu hui nai yong 。]

english: Yes, that's right. I'll probably get Arnold to order some fancy protective paint from the dwarves.
translation: 是的，没错。我可能会让阿诺德向矮人订购一些精美的防护涂料。 [shi de ， mei cuo 。 wo ke neng hui rang a nuo de xiang ai ren ding gou yi xie jing mei de fang hu tu liao 。]

english: Good luck with that.
translation: 祝你好运。 [zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: You know all your doors get stuck open?
translation: 你知道你所有的门都是开着的吗？ [ni zhi dao ni suo you de men dou shi kai zhe de ma ？]

english: Yes, the salt does terrible things to the hinges. I've been meaning to deal with them, but I never seem to get around to it.
translation: 是的，盐会对铰链造成可怕的影响。我一直想和他们打交道，但我似乎从来没有抽出时间。 [shi de ， yan hui dui jiao lian zao cheng ke pa de ying xiang 。 wo yi zhi xiang he ta men da jiao dao ， dan wo si hu cong lai mei you chou chu shi jian 。]

english: Fair enough.
translation: 很公平。 [hen gong ping 。]

english: Nothing, I'm fine.
translation: 没什么，我很好。 [mei shen me ， wo hen hao 。]

english: Enjoy your fishing.
translation: 享受钓鱼的乐趣。 [xiang shou diao yu de le qu 。]

english: How are things going for the Colony?
translation: 殖民地的情况怎么样？ [zhi min di de qing kuang zen me yang ？]

english: What are you doing?
translation: 你在干什么？ [ni zai gan shen me ？]

english: You know all your doors get stuck open?
translation: 你知道你所有的门都是开着的吗？ [ni zhi dao ni suo you de men dou shi kai zhe de ma ？]

english: Nothing, I'm fine.
translation: 没什么，我很好。 [mei shen me ， wo hen hao 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!
translation: 呜？  呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜！ [wu ？   wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu ！]

english: You don't say?
translation: 你不说？ [ni bu shuo ？]

english: Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
translation: 哇！呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜！ [wa ！ wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu ！]

english: You don't say!
translation: 你不说！ [ni bu shuo ！]

english: Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
translation: 呜呜呜……呜呜呜？呜呜呜呜呜呜呜！ [wu wu wu …… wu wu wu ？ wu wu wu wu wu wu wu ！]

english: Well, I guess you didn't say.
translation: 嗯，我猜你没说。 [n ， wo cai ni mei shuo 。]

english: Yeah, I don't want to brag, but seriously: I am SOOOO rich....
translation: 是的，我不想吹牛，但说真的：我太有钱了…… [shi de ， wo bu xiang chui niu ， dan shuo zhen de ： wo tai you qian le ……]

english: Yeah, I know they say money doesn't bring you happiness, but sometimes I just like to open my bank account and look at all of the stuff I own and just think to myself:
translation: 是的，我知道他们说金钱不会给你带来幸福，但有时我只是喜欢打开我的银行账户，看看我拥有的所有东西，然后心里想： [shi de ， wo zhi dao ta men shuo jin qian bu hui gei ni dai lai xing fu ， dan you shi wo zhi shi xi huan da kai wo de yin hang zhang hu ， kan kan wo yong you de suo you dong xi ， ran hou xin li xiang ：]

english: Wow. I am soooooo rich.
translation: 哇。我太有钱了。 [wa 。 wo tai you qian le 。]

english: Well, us rich alive people don't want to waste all day spending time with you poor dead people, because I'm just sooooo rich I have to go now, and very possibly make myself even richer.
translation: 好吧，我们活着的富人不想浪费一整天的时间和你们这些可怜的死人在一起，因为我太富有了，我现在必须走了，而且很可能让自己变得更富有。 [hao ba ， wo men huo zhe de fu ren bu xiang lang fei yi zheng tian de shi jian he ni men zhe xie ke lian de si ren zai yi qi ， yin wei wo tai fu you le ， wo xian zai bi xu zou le ， er qie hen ke neng rang zi ji bian de geng fu you 。]

english: See ya around ghosty!
translation: 幽灵见！ [you ling jian ！]

english: Yeah, I heard about that, ha-ha-ha!
translation: 是的，我听说过，哈哈哈！ [shi de ， wo ting shuo guo ， ha ha ha ！]

english: With a MACKEREL? Ouch!
translation: 和鲭鱼一起？哎哟! [he qing yu yi qi ？ ai yo !]

english: Well, it was fun. Let's do it again sometime.
translation: 嗯，很有趣。我们找个时间再做一次吧。 [n ， hen you qu 。 wo men zhao ge shi jian zai zuo yi ci ba 。]

english: Why, thank you very much!
translation: 为什么，非常感谢！ [wei shen me ， fei chang gan xie ！]

english: I know, but what are you going to do?
translation: 我知道，但是你要做什么？ [wo zhi dao ， dan shi ni yao zuo shen me ？]

english: Well, I guess that's always true in the long run. See you around, weird invisible dead person!
translation: 嗯，我想从长远来看这总是正确的。再见，奇怪的隐形死人！ [n ， wo xiang cong chang yuan lai kan zhe zong shi zheng que de 。 zai jian ， qi guai de yin xing si ren ！]

english: Yeah it's not bad, but I prefer cooked chicken.
translation: 是的，不错，但我更喜欢煮熟的鸡肉。 [shi de ， bu cuo ， dan wo geng xi huan zhu shu de ji rou 。]

english: Maybe, but nothing beats a home cooked pie!
translation: 也许吧，但没有什么比自制的馅饼更好的了！ [ye xu ba ， dan mei you shen me bi zi zhi de xian bing geng hao de le ！]

english: Man, I love pie!
translation: 伙计，我喜欢馅饼！ [huo ji ， wo xi huan xian bing ！]

english: You don't say? I never knew that. Well, I must be going, see you around.
translation: 你不说？我从来不知道这一点。好吧，我得走了，回头见。 [ni bu shuo ？ wo cong lai bu zhi dao zhe yi dian 。 hao ba ， wo de zou le ， hui tou jian 。]

english: We get signal!
translation: 我们收到信号了！ [wo men shou dao xin hao le ！]

english: Somebody set up us the bomb!
translation: 有人给我们安放了炸弹！ [you ren gei wo men an fang le zha dan ！]

english: You have no chance to survive make your time.
translation: 你没有机会生存，请腾出时间。 [ni mei you ji hui sheng cun ， qing teng chu shi jian 。]

english: Woo?
translation: 呜？ [wu ？]

english: All your base are belong to us.
translation: 你所有的基地都属于我们。 [ni suo you de ji di dou shu yu wo men 。]

english: Hey, don't think you can talk to me like that!
translation: 嘿，别以为你可以这样跟我说话！ [hei ， bie yi wei ni ke yi zhe yang gen wo shuo hua ！]

english: Are you threatening me?
translation: 你在威胁我吗？ [ni zai wei xie wo ma ？]

english: Just because you're already dead, doesn't mean I can't find a way to hurt you ghosty!
translation: 你已经死了，并不代表我就找不到办法伤害你！ [ni yi jing si le ， bing bu dai biao wo jiu zhao bu dao ban fa shang hai ni ！]

english: No, I've never been there in my life and CERTAINLY didn't steal anything when I was!
translation: 不，我这辈子从来没有去过那里，当然也没有偷过任何东西！ [bu ， wo zhe bei zi cong lai mei you qu guo na li ， dang ran ye mei you tou guo ren he dong xi ！]

english: Are you calling me a liar?!?! I have never stolen a thing in my life, and I resent the implication that I am the kind of morally depraved individual that would steal someone else's hard earned
translation: 你骂我是骗子吗？！？！我一生中从未偷过任何东西，而且我很讨厌别人说我是那种道德败坏的人，会偷别人辛苦赚来的东西。 [ni ma wo shi pian zi ma ？！？！ wo yi sheng zhong cong wei tou guo ren he dong xi ， er qie wo hen tao yan bie ren shuo wo shi na zhong dao de bai huai de ren ， hui tou bie ren xin ku zhuan lai de dong xi 。]

english: money from their very pockets!
translation: 钱是从他们的口袋里掏出来的！ [qian shi cong ta men de kou dai li tao chu lai de ！]

english: Or cakes. Or fur. Repeatedly. For long periods at a time.
translation: 或者蛋糕。或者毛皮。反复。一次持续很长时间。 [huo zhe dan gao 。 huo zhe mao pi 。 fan fu 。 yi ci chi xu hen zhang shi jian 。]

english: Well if you are going to take that attitude, then I have nothing further to say on the matter, and bid you good day!
translation: 好吧，如果您打算采取这种态度，那么我对此事无话可说，祝您早安！ [hao ba ， ru guo nin da suan cai qu zhe zhong tai du ， na me wo dui ci shi wu hua ke shuo ， zhu nin zao an ！]

english: Hello Dhalak.
translation: 你好，达拉克。 [ni hao ， da la ke 。]

english: You see my form, hear my words, and know my name, yet your face I recognise not...
translation: 你看到我的身影，听到我的话语，知道我的名字，但你的脸我却认不出来…… [ni kan dao wo de shen ying ， ting dao wo de hua yu ， zhi dao wo de ming zi ， dan ni de lian wo que ren bu chu lai ……]

english: Be you some mighty sorcerer to bind me so?
translation: 你是一个强大的巫师来如此束缚我吗？ [ni shi yi ge qiang da de wu shi lai ru ci shu fu wo ma ？]

english: Um... Well, not really...
translation: 嗯……呃，其实不是…… [n …… e ， qi shi bu shi ……]

english: Well, I don't mean to brag, but I guess I am with my level 99 magic...
translation: 好吧，我并不是想吹牛，但我想我的魔法已经99级了…… [hao ba ， wo bing bu shi xiang chui niu ， dan wo xiang wo de mo fa yi jing 99 ji le ……]

english: But that is besides the point. It is not I who has trapped you here as a ghost.
translation: 但这不是重点。不是我把你当鬼困在这里的。 [dan zhe bu shi zhong dian 。 bu shi wo ba ni dang gui kun zai zhe li de 。]

english: Then how comes it to be that you know my name stranger?
translation: 那你怎么会知道我的名字呢？ [na ni zen me hui zhi dao wo de ming zi ne ？]

english: Lennissa told me about you, and where to find you?
translation: 莱妮莎告诉我关于你的事，以及在哪里可以找到你？ [lai ni sha gao su wo guan yu ni de shi ， yi ji zai na li ke yi zhao dao ni ？]

english: Lennissa? Oh that poor sweet girl... Has my foolishness cursed her as well as myself???
translation: 莱尼莎？哦，那个可怜的可爱的女孩……我的愚蠢是否诅咒了她和我自己？？？ [lai ni sha ？ o ， na ge ke lian de ke ai de nv hai …… wo de yu chun shi fou zu zhou le ta he wo zi ji ？？？]

english: Your foolishness?
translation: 你的愚蠢？ [ni de yu chun ？]

english: The story shames me stranger, I wouldst rather keep it unto myself.
translation: 这个故事让我这个陌生人感到羞耻，我宁愿自己保密。 [zhe ge gu shi rang wo zhe ge mo sheng ren gan dao xiu chi ， wo ning yuan zi ji bao mi 。]

english: Look, I don't want to force you into telling me, but perhaps sharing it with someone might relieve your guilt?
translation: 听着，我不想强​​迫你告诉我，但也许与别人分享可以减轻你的负罪感？ [ting zhe ， wo bu xiang qiang ​​ po ni gao su wo ， dan ye xu yu bie ren fen xiang ke yi jian qing ni de fu zui gan ？]

english: Aye... Perhaps it might at that.
translation: 是的……也许就是这样。 [shi de …… ye xu jiu shi zhe yang 。]

english: So what has Lennissa told you of the events of the day this curse befell me?
translation: 那么，关于这个诅咒降临到我身上的那天发生的事情，莱妮莎告诉了你什么呢？ [na me ， guan yu zhe ge zu zhou jiang lin dao wo shen shang de na tian fa sheng de shi qing ， lai ni sha gao su le ni shen me ne ？]

english: Well, she told me that she was working as an undercover agent of Saradomin amongst the followers of some 'Empty Lord', and when news of the theft of a god-weapon reached her, she passed the message on to
translation: 好吧，她告诉我，她在某个“空之主”的追随者中担任萨拉多明的卧底特工，当她得知神器被盗的消息时，她将消息传递给了 [hao ba ， ta gao su wo ， ta zai mou ge “ kong zhi zhu ” de zhui sui zhe zhong dan ren sa la duo ming de wo di te gong ， dang ta de zhi shen qi bei dao de xiao xi shi ， ta jiang xiao xi chuan di gei le]

english: you instead of taking it to Saradomin because she was scared her cover might be blown.
translation: 你而不是把它交给萨拉多明，因为她担心自己的身份可能会被揭穿。 [ni er bu shi ba ta jiao gei sa la duo ming ， yin wei ta dan xin zi ji de shen fen ke neng hui bei jie chuan 。]

english: Aye, that is a fair account of events...
translation: 是的，这是对事件的公正描述...... [shi de ， zhe shi dui shi jian de gong zheng miao shu ......]

english: But I don't understand why you didn't take her message to Saradomin?
translation: 但我不明白你为什么不把她的消息告诉萨拉多明？ [dan wo bu ming bai ni wei shen me bu ba ta de xiao xi gao su sa la duo ming ？]

english: Stranger, my foolishness was a result of my respect for Saradomin, not as a result of any attempted treachery!
translation: 陌生人，我的愚蠢是出于对萨拉多明的尊重，而不是任何企图背叛的结果！ [mo sheng ren ， wo de yu chun shi chu yu dui sa la duo ming de zun zhong ， er bu shi ren he qi tu bei pan de jie guo ！]

english: So why didn't you pass on Lennissa's message? As I understand it something happened with that staff that could have been avoided if you had passed her message on!
translation: 那你为什么不转告莱妮莎的消息呢？据我了解，那位工作人员发生了一些事情，如果您转发了她的信息，这本来是可以避免的！ [na ni wei shen me bu zhuan gao lai ni sha de xiao xi ne ？ ju wo liao jie ， na wei gong zuo ren yuan fa sheng le yi xie shi qing ， ru guo nin zhuan fa le ta de xin xi ， zhe ben lai shi ke yi bi mian de ！]

english: (sigh) I know not what occurred with that god-weapon, but I have my suspicions...
translation: （叹气）我不知道那件神器发生了什么，但我有我的怀疑…… [（ tan qi ） wo bu zhi dao na jian shen qi fa sheng le shen me ， dan wo you wo de huai yi ……]

english: Let me explain myself. I was Lennissa's immediate superior, and I was often her contact for missions.
translation: 让我解释一下。我是莱尼莎的顶头上司，也经常是她的任务联络人。 [rang wo jie shi yi xia 。 wo shi lai ni sha de ding tou shang si ， ye jing chang shi ta de ren wu lian luo ren 。]

english: Because of this role, I had access to a larger picture of what was happening than she herself did, and I was not only well aware that her presence amongst the enemy camp had been detected, but I was also well aware that
translation: 因为这个角色，我比她本人更了解正在发生的事情，我不仅清楚地知道她在敌营中的存在已被检测到，而且我也清楚地知道 [yin wei zhe ge jue se ， wo bi ta ben ren geng liao jie zheng zai fa sheng de shi qing ， wo bu jin qing chu di zhi dao ta zai di ying zhong de cun zai yi bei jian ce dao ， er qie wo ye qing chu di zhi dao]

english: there was a growing faction amongst them who were plotting to overthrow their master.
translation: 他们之中密谋推翻他们主人的派系日益壮大。 [ta men zhi zhong mi mou tui fan ta men zhu ren de pai xi ri yi zhuang da 。]

english: Their master being...?
translation: 他们的主人是……？ [ta men de zhu ren shi ……？]

english: That I will not tell you. I will tempt the fates no more than I already have done.
translation: 我不会告诉你。我不会再像以前那样尝试命运了。 [wo bu hui gao su ni 。 wo bu hui zai xiang yi qian na yang chang shi ming yun le 。]

english: But anyway, it had come to my attention that the Mahjarrat who had been liberated from the control of Icthlarin did not much appreciate one form of slavery to another, and under the leadership of the mighty
translation: 但无论如何，我注意到，从伊克拉林的控制下解放出来的马吉拉特并不太欣赏一种形式对另一种形式的奴役，并且在强大的领导下 [dan wu lun ru he ， wo zhu yi dao ， cong yi ke la lin de kong zhi xia jie fang chu lai de ma ji la te bing bu tai xin shang yi zhong xing shi dui ling yi zhong xing shi de nu yi ， bing qie zai qiang da de ling dao xia]

english: Zamorak were making plans to overthrow their master and take his power for themselves.
translation: 萨莫拉克正计划推翻他们的主人并夺取他的权力。 [sa mo la ke zheng ji hua tui fan ta men de zhu ren bing duo qu ta de quan li 。]

english: Now, as powerful, long-lived and evil as they were, they were still just mortal, and I made the decision that it would be of benefit to my Lord Saradomin for his mightiest rival to be distracted by such internal conflicts.
translation: 现在，尽管他们如此强大、长寿和邪恶，但他们仍然只是凡人，我做出了决定，让我的萨拉多明勋爵最强大的对手因这种内部冲突而分心，这对他有利。 [xian zai ， jin guan ta men ru ci qiang da 、 chang shou he xie e ， dan ta men reng ran zhi shi fan ren ， wo zuo chu le jue ding ， rang wo de sa la duo ming xun jue zui qiang da de dui shou yin zhe zhong nei bu chong tu er fen xin ， zhe dui ta you li 。]

english: So that is why you decided not to pass the report from Lennissa on?
translation: 所以这就是你决定不转发莱尼萨的报告的原因？ [suo yi zhe jiu shi ni jue ding bu zhuan fa lai ni sa de bao gao de yuan yin ？]

english: Yes, but my guilt is more than simply inaction...
translation: 是的，但我的罪孽不仅仅是无所作为…… [shi de ， dan wo de zui nie bu jin jin shi wu suo zuo wei ……]

english: I knew that with such a weapon, Zamorak would be capable of launching an attack that could actually stand a chance of success, but I also knew that he would never be able to get a chance to use it in a battle for
translation: 我知道，有了这样的武器，萨莫拉克将能够发动真正有成功机会的攻击，但我也知道，他永远不可能有机会在战斗中使用它。 [wo zhi dao ， you le zhe yang de wu qi ， sa mo la ke jiang neng gou fa dong zhen zheng you cheng gong ji hui de gong ji ， dan wo ye zhi dao ， ta yong yuan bu ke neng you ji hui zai zhan dou zhong shi yong ta 。]

english: being a god-weapon its very presence would have sung out to their leader.
translation: 作为一件神器，它的存在本身就会向他们的领袖歌唱。 [zuo wei yi jian shen qi ， ta de cun zai ben shen jiu hui xiang ta men de ling xiu ge chang 。]

english: I'm guessing you did something about that, then?
translation: 我猜你对此做了什么？ [wo cai ni dui ci zuo le shen me ？]

english: Indeed I did. To my eternal shame, I decided that I would assist Zamorak and his henchmen in their battle, by secretly casting a spell of concealment upon the staff so that
translation: 确实我做到了。让我永远羞愧的是，我决定在战斗中协助萨莫拉克和他的追随者，秘密地在法杖上施展了隐藏咒语，以便 [que shi wo zuo dao le 。 rang wo yong yuan xiu kui de shi ， wo jue ding zai zhan dou zhong xie zhu sa mo la ke he ta de zhui sui zhe ， mi mi di zai fa zhang shang shi zhan le yin cang zhou yu ， yi bian]

english: they might use it secretly against their master.
translation: 他们可能会秘密地用它来对付他们的主人。 [ta men ke neng hui mi mi di yong ta lai dui fu ta men de zhu ren 。]

english: So Zamorak knew about this?
translation: 那么萨莫拉克知道这件事吗？ [na me sa mo la ke zhi dao zhe jian shi ma ？]

english: No, nobody except myself, and now you, knew that I cast such a spell....
translation: 不，除了我自己，没有人知道我施展了这样的咒语…… [bu ， chu le wo zi ji ， mei you ren zhi dao wo shi zhan le zhe yang de zhou yu ……]

english: Had I known what a threat to my Lord Saradomin Zamorak would later become, I wouldst have taken the message to Saradomin immediately! Alas, it is all too easy to see your mistakes after you
translation: 如果我知道萨拉多明·萨莫拉克大人后来会受到怎样的威胁，我一定会立即把这个消息传达给萨拉多明！唉，事后很容易看到自己的错误 [ru guo wo zhi dao sa la duo ming · sa mo la ke da ren hou lai hui shou dao zen yang de wei xie ， wo yi ding hui li ji ba zhe ge xiao xi chuan da gei sa la duo ming ！ ai ， shi hou hen rong yi kan dao zi ji de cuo wu]

english: have made them...
translation: 已经让他们... [yi jing rang ta men ...]

english: I'm confused. What exactly happened with this staff anyway? And why have all these various random people been cursed because of it?
translation: 我很困惑。这位员工究竟发生了什么？为什么这些形形色色的人因此而受到诅咒呢？ [wo hen kun huo 。 zhe wei yuan gong jiu jing fa sheng le shen me ？ wei shen me zhe xie xing xing se se de ren yin ci er shou dao zu zhou ne ？]

english: I cannot answer your question with anything other than my own suppositions, but I do know of one who might be able to, and if any man deserved to be cursed for their actions that day, it was he!
translation: 除了我自己的假设之外，我无法回答你的问题，但我确实知道一个人可以回答你的问题，如果有一个人应该因为那天的行为而受到诅咒，那就是他！ [chu le wo zi ji de jia she zhi wai ， wo wu fa hui da ni de wen ti ， dan wo que shi zhi dao yi ge ren ke yi hui da ni de wen ti ， ru guo you yi ge ren ying gai yin wei na tian de xing wei er shou dao zu zhou ， na jiu shi ta ！]

english: Who are you speaking of?
translation: 你在说谁？ [ni zai shuo shui ？]

english: His name was Viggora. He was an evil man, brutal and vicious, and deadly with a blade.
translation: 他的名字叫维戈拉。他是一个邪恶的人，残忍恶毒，持刀致命。 [ta de ming zi jiao wei ge la 。 ta shi yi ge xie e de ren ， can ren e du ， chi dao zhi ming 。]

english: He was one of the few humans Zamorak allowed to rise to a position of power amongst his rebels, possibly because he imitated those same qualities of Zamorak.
translation: 他是萨莫拉克少数被允许在叛军中占据权力地位的人类之一，可能是因为他模仿了萨莫拉克的同样品质。 [ta shi sa mo la ke shao shu bei yun xu zai pan jun zhong zhan ju quan li di wei de ren lei zhi yi ， ke neng shi yin wei ta mo fang le sa mo la ke de tong yang pin zhi 。]

english: If anyone knows what Zamorak did with that god- weapon to have caused this curse to have befallen us, it would have been he, for he would have been fighting on Zamorak's very right hand side in their rebellion.
translation: 如果有人知道萨莫拉克用这件神器做了什么，导致了这个诅咒降临到我们身上，那一定是他，因为在他们的叛乱中，他会站在萨莫拉克的右手边战斗。 [ru guo you ren zhi dao sa mo la ke yong zhe jian shen qi zuo le shen me ， dao zhi le zhe ge zu zhou jiang lin dao wo men shen shang ， na yi ding shi ta ， yin wei zai ta men de pan luan zhong ， ta hui zhan zai sa mo la ke de you shou bian zhan dou 。]

english: Please, if this curse can be lifted, find Viggora and find out what he has wrought upon us! I have no wealth nor magic to aid you, but take my hood as reward;
translation: 如果这个诅咒可以解除，请找到维戈拉，看看他对我们做了什么！我没有财富和魔法来帮助你，但你可以拿我的兜帽作为奖励； [ru guo zhe ge zu zhou ke yi jie chu ， qing zhao dao wei ge la ， kan kan ta dui wo men zuo le shen me ！ wo mei you cai fu he mo fa lai bang zhu ni ， dan ni ke yi na wo de dou mao zuo wei jiang li ；]

english: it has served me well these centuries past, and may bring you luck.
translation: 在过去的几个世纪里，它对我很有帮助，并且可能会给你带来好运。 [zai guo qu de ji ge shi ji li ， ta dui wo hen you bang zhu ， bing qie ke neng hui gei ni dai lai hao yun 。]

english: Where would you suggest I look for Viggora?
translation: 你建议我去哪里寻找维戈拉？ [ni jian yi wo qu na li xun zhao wei ge la ？]

english: Ah, the evil swordsman Viggora... A rogue like him would probably flock to his own kind.
translation: 啊，邪恶剑士维古拉……像他这样的盗贼恐怕会蜂拥而至。 [a ， xie e jian shi wei gu la …… xiang ta zhe yang de dao zei kong pa hui feng yong er zhi 。]

english: Okay, well I'll try and find him for you then.
translation: 好吧，那我会尽力帮你找到他。 [hao ba ， na wo hui jin li bang ni zhao dao ta 。]

english: Ah, the evil swordsman Viggora... Perhaps he has returned to his castle in the dark lands?
translation: 啊，邪恶剑客维古拉……也许他已经回到了黑暗之地的城堡了？ [a ， xie e jian ke wei gu la …… ye xu ta yi jing hui dao le hei an zhi di de cheng bao le ？]

english: Ah, the evil swordsman Viggora... Paddewwa was where he fought many battles, perhaps he has returned to one of his old haunts?
translation: 啊，邪剑士维古拉……帕德瓦是他身经百战的地方，或许他又回到了他的故地之一？ [a ， xie jian shi wei gu la …… pa de wa shi ta shen jing bai zhan de di fang ， huo xu ta you hui dao le ta de gu di zhi yi ？]

english: Well, that's all fascinating, but I just don't particularly care. Bye-bye.
translation: 嗯，这一切都很有趣，但我并不特别关心。再见。 [n ， zhe yi qie dou hen you qu ， dan wo bing bu te bie guan xin 。 zai jian 。]

english: Dhalak, where can I find the swordsman Viggora?
translation: 达拉克，我在哪里可以找到剑客维古拉？ [da la ke ， wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao jian ke wei gu la ？]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Could I have more of those ghostly robes you gave me?
translation: 我可以再要一件你送我的幽灵长袍吗？ [wo ke yi zai yao yi jian ni song wo de you ling chang pao ma ？]

english: It seems as though the curse that keeps me here extends to my very clothing... which piece do you want?
translation: 似乎让我留在这里的诅咒延伸到了我的衣服上……你想要哪一件？ [si hu rang wo liu zai zhe li de zu zhou yan shen dao le wo de yi fu shang …… ni xiang yao na yi jian ？]

english: Here you go.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: Tell me your story
translation: 告诉我你的故事 [gao su wo ni de gu shi]

english: Goodbye then
translation: 那么再见 [na me zai jian]

english: Ask about Viggora.
translation: 询问维戈拉的情况。 [xun wen wei ge la de qing kuang 。]

english: Ask for more ghostly robes.
translation: 要求更多的幽灵长袍。 [yao qiu geng duo de you ling chang pao 。]

english: You dare disturb my rest!
translation: 你居然敢打扰我休息！ [ni ju ran gan da rao wo xiu xi ！]

english: You dare steal from us!
translation: 你竟然敢偷我们的东西！ [ni jing ran gan tou wo men de dong xi ！]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Now then. Looking to buy some weaponry?
translation: 现在那么。想购买一些武器吗？ [xian zai na me 。 xiang gou mai yi xie wu qi ma ？]

english: Let's trade.
translation: 我们来交易吧。 [wo men lai jiao yi ba 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 如果你改变主意我会在这里。 [ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi wo hui zai zhe li 。]

english: Let's trade.
translation: 我们来交易吧。 [wo men lai jiao yi ba 。]

english: No thanks
translation: 不，谢谢 [bu ， xie xie]

english: Howdy there partner! Want to see my spinning plates? Or did ya want a holiday item back?
translation: 伙伴你好！想看看我的旋转板吗？或者您想要拿回节日物品吗？ [huo ban ni hao ！ xiang kan kan wo de xuan zhuan ban ma ？ huo zhe nin xiang yao na hui jie ri wu pin ma ？]

english: Spinning plates?
translation: 旋转板？ [xuan zhuan ban ？]

english: That's right. There's a funny story behind them, their shipment was held up by thieves.
translation: 这是正确的。他们背后有一个有趣的故事，他们的货物被小偷拦截了。 [zhe shi zheng que de 。 ta men bei hou you yi ge you qu de gu shi ， ta men de huo wu bei xiao tou lan jie le 。]

english: The crate was marked 'Dragon Plates'. Apparently they thought it was some kind of armour, when really it's just a plate with a dragon on it!
translation: 板条箱上标有“龙盘”。显然他们认为这是某种盔甲，但实际上它只是一个上面有一条龙的盘子！ [ban tiao xiang shang biao you “ long pan ”。 xian ran ta men ren wei zhe shi mou zhong kui jia ， dan shi ji shang ta zhi shi yi ge shang mian you yi tiao long de pan zi ！]

english: I'd like to check holiday items please!
translation: 我想检查一下节日物品！ [wo xiang jian cha yi xia jie ri wu pin ！]

english: Sure thing, let me just see what you're missing.
translation: 当然可以，让我看看你错过了什么。 [dang ran ke yi ， rang wo kan kan ni cuo guo le shen me 。]

english: What else are you selling?
translation: 你还卖什么？ [ni hai mai shen me ？]

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Howdy there partner! You came at just the right time! I've got something for ya!
translation: 伙伴你好！你来得正是时候！我有东西给你！ [huo ban ni hao ！ ni lai de zheng shi shi hou ！ wo you dong xi gei ni ！]

english: Oh really? What is it?
translation: 哦真的吗？它是什么？ [o zhen de ma ？ ta shi shen me ？]

english: Well, I did some rooting around in my house and found this really neat hat.
translation: 嗯，我在家里翻找了一下，发现了这顶非常漂亮的帽子。 [n ， wo zai jia li fan zhao le yi xia ， fa xian le zhe ding fei chang piao liang de mao zi 。]

english: A hat? What sort of hat...
translation: 一顶帽子？什么样的帽子... [yi ding mao zi ？ shen me yang de mao zi ...]

english: A banana hat! Would you like it?
translation: 香蕉帽！你愿意吗？ [xiang jiao mao ！ ni yuan yi ma ？]

english: Sure, I'll take the hat.
translation: 当然，我会拿帽子。 [dang ran ， wo hui na mao zi 。]

english: Looks like you've got no space for it, I'll hold onto it till you do. Just come to me to claim it.
translation: 看来你没有空间了，我会保留它直到你有空间为止。只要来找我领取即可。 [kan lai ni mei you kong jian le ， wo hui bao liu ta zhi dao ni you kong jian wei zhi 。 zhi yao lai zhao wo ling qu ji ke 。]

english: There you go amigo, enjoy!
translation: 就这样，朋友们，尽情享受吧！ [jiu zhe yang ， peng you men ， jin qing xiang shou ba ！]

english: So what else can I do for you partner? Want to see my spinning plates? Or did ya want a holiday item back?
translation: 那么我还能为你的伙伴做些什么呢？想看看我的旋转板吗？或者您想要拿回节日物品吗？ [na me wo hai neng wei ni de huo ban zuo xie shen me ne ？ xiang kan kan wo de xuan zhuan ban ma ？ huo zhe nin xiang yao na hui jie ri wu pin ma ？]

english: No thanks, I don't want it right now.
translation: 不，谢谢，我现在不想。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo xian zai bu xiang 。]

english: No problem amigo, come back to me to claim it if you change your mind.
translation: 没问题，朋友，如果你改变主意，可以回来找我领取。 [mei wen ti ， peng you ， ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， ke yi hui lai zhao wo ling qu 。]

english: Oh wow, you did it! Well done!
translation: 哦，哇，你做到了！干得好！ [o ， wa ， ni zuo dao le ！ gan de hao ！]

english: Thank you!
translation: 谢谢你！ [xie xie ni ！]

english: I was wondering when someone would complete this. I've been holding on to the reward for a while.
translation: 我想知道什么时候有人能完成这个。我已经持有奖励有一段时间了。 [wo xiang zhi dao shen me shi hou you ren neng wan cheng zhe ge 。 wo yi jing chi you jiang li you yi duan shi jian le 。]

english: The being who gave it to me was... rather strange.
translation: 给我它的人……相当奇怪。 [gei wo ta de ren …… xiang dang qi guai 。]

english: What was their name?
translation: 他们叫什么名字？ [ta men jiao shen me ming zi ？]

english: They didn't say. But they did give me some sage advice before they left.
translation: 他们没有说。但他们在离开之前确实给了我一些明智的建议。 [ta men mei you shuo 。 dan ta men zai li kai zhi qian que shi gei le wo yi xie ming zhi de jian yi 。]

english: What was it?
translation: 那是什么？ [na shi shen me ？]

english: I don't remember exactly. Something about making the most of your time...
translation: 我记不太清楚了。一些关于充分利用时间的事情...... [wo ji bu tai qing chu le 。 yi xie guan yu chong fen li yong shi jian de shi qing ......]

english: Thyme!
translation: 百里香！ [bai li xiang ！]

english: Where?! I don't see any!
translation: 在哪里？！我没有看到任何！ [zai na li ？！ wo mei you kan dao ren he ！]

english: I... don't worry. Thank you for the reward, see you around!
translation: 我……别担心。谢谢您的打赏，再见！ [wo …… bie dan xin 。 xie xie nin de da shang ， zai jian ！]

english: See you!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Spinning plates?
translation: 旋转板？ [xuan zhuan ban ？]

english: I'd like to check holiday items please!
translation: 我想检查一下节日物品！ [wo xiang jian cha yi xia jie ri wu pin ！]

english: What else are you selling?
translation: 你还卖什么？ [ni hai mai shen me ？]

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Hello. My name is Dimintheis, of the noble family Fitzharmon.
translation: 你好。我叫迪明泰斯，出身于菲茨哈蒙贵族家族。 [ni hao 。 wo jiao di ming tai si ， chu shen yu fei ci ha meng gui zu jia zu 。]

english: Why would a nobleman live in a dump like this?
translation: 一个贵族怎么会住在这样的垃圾场里呢？ [yi ge gui zu zen me hui zhu zai zhe yang de la ji chang li ne ？]

english: The King has taken my estate from me until such time as I can show my family crest to him.
translation: 国王已经从我手中夺走了我的财产，直到我可以向他展示我的家族徽章。 [guo wang yi jing cong wo shou zhong duo zou le wo de cai chan ， zhi dao wo ke yi xiang ta zhan shi wo de jia zu hui zhang 。]

english: Why would he do that?
translation: 他为什么要这么做？ [ta wei shen me yao zhe me zuo ？]

english: Well, there is a long standing rule of chivalry amongst the Varrockian aristocracy, where each noble family is in possession of a unique crest, which signifies the honour and lineage of the family. More than this

english: however, it also represents the lawful rights of each family to prove their ownership of their wealth and lands. If the family crest is lost, then the family's estate is handed over to the current monarch until the crest is
translation: 然而，它也代表了每个家庭证明其财富和土地所有权的合法权利。如果家族徽章丢失，那么家族的财产将移交给现任君主，直到徽章被找回为止。 [ran er ， ta ye dai biao le mei ge jia ting zheng ming qi cai fu he tu di suo you quan de he fa quan li 。 ru guo jia zu hui zhang diu shi ， na me jia zu de cai chan jiang yi jiao gei xian ren jun zhu ， zhi dao hui zhang bei zhao hui wei zhi 。]

translation: 这可以追溯到贵族家庭及其氏族之间发生大量内斗的时代，并被引入作为减少当时正在摧毁统治阶级的流血事件的一种方式。 [zhe ke yi zhui su dao gui zu jia ting ji qi shi zu zhi jian fa sheng da liang nei dou de shi dai ， bing bei yin ru zuo wei jian shao dang shi zheng zai cui hui tong zhi jie ji de liu xie shi jian de yi zhong fang shi 。]

translation: 嘎！可恶的乞丐！你们这种人正在毁掉这片伟大的土地！如果你这么急需钱，为什么不去找份工作呢？ [ga ！ ke wu de qi gai ！ ni men zhe zhong ren zheng zai hui diao zhe pian wei da de tu di ！ ru guo ni zhe me ji xu qian ， wei shen me bu qu zhao fen gong zuo ne ？]

translation: 冒险家嗯？多么幸运。我可能会为你安排一次冒险。我迫切需要我的家族徽章归还给我。这是极其重要的。 [mao xian jia n ？ duo me xing yun 。 wo ke neng hui wei ni an pai yi ci mao xian 。 wo po qie xu yao wo de jia zu hui zhang gui huan gei wo 。 zhe shi ji qi zhong yao de 。]

translation: 你有什么任务要找我吗？我真的想要一个。我真的很想帮忙！ [ni you shen me ren wu yao zhao wo ma ？ wo zhen de xiang yao yi ge 。 wo zhen de hen xiang bang mang ！]

english: You murmur under your breath something about how great the rewards were last time you did a quest for Dimintheis.
translation: 你低声嘀咕上次寻找迪明泰斯的任务有多么丰厚的回报。 [ni di sheng di gu shang ci xun zhao di ming tai si de ren wu you duo me feng hou de hui bao 。]

english: My family consider what you did for us a great service. We couldn't possibly trouble you further.
translation: 我的家人认为您为我们所做的服务很棒。我们不可能再给你添麻烦了。 [wo de jia ren ren wei nin wei wo men suo zuo de fu wu hen bang 。 wo men bu ke neng zai gei ni tian ma fan le 。]

english: There must be SOMETHING you need help with. I am a great adventurer after all.
translation: 您一定有什么事情需要帮助。毕竟我是一个伟大的冒险家。 [nin yi ding you shen me shi qing xu yao bang zhu 。 bi jing wo shi yi ge wei da de mao xian jia 。]

translation: 我想金钱确实能买到幸福。 [wo xiang jin qian que shi neng mai dao xing fu 。]

translation: 那是什么？我不太明白。 [na shi shen me ？ wo bu tai ming bai 。]

english: Nothing...

english: Oh come on, surely there's something I can help out with! I want to help, however menial it is.
translation: 哦，拜托，肯定有什么我可以帮忙的！我想帮忙，无论多么卑微。 [o ， bai tuo ， ken ding you shen me wo ke yi bang mang de ！ wo xiang bang mang ， wu lun duo me bei wei 。]

translation: 好吧好吧。那么好吧。虽然我没有什么可以给你的，但你试试我的儿子们怎么样，他们总是想要做点什么。 [hao ba hao ba 。 na me hao ba 。 sui ran wo mei you shen me ke yi gei ni de ， dan ni shi shi wo de er zi men zen me yang ， ta men zong shi xiang yao zuo dian shen me 。]

translation: 你好，冒险家。我希望阿拉夫之盾业务标志着我家族伟大事业的开始。也许它能帮助我最终摆脱这个困境！ [ni hao ， mao xian jia 。 wo xi wang a la fu zhi dun ye wu biao zhi zhe wo jia zu wei da shi ye de kai shi 。 ye xu ta neng bang zhu wo zui zhong bai tuo zhe ge kun jing ！]

english: Uh, I believe I'm still using it.

My master prefers that his minions be killed with purpose.

translation: 我不会问我的主人任何问题，我只是告知。 [wo bu hui wen wo de zhu ren ren he wen ti ， wo zhi shi gao zhi 。]

english: I am not worthy to explain on his behalf. Descend the Chasm and speak with him yourself if you wish for further details.
translation: 我不值得为他解释。如果您想了解更多详细信息，请下降到深渊并亲自与他交谈。 [wo bu zhi de wei ta jie shi 。 ru guo nin xiang liao jie geng duo xiang xi xin xi ， qing xia jiang dao shen yuan bing qin zi yu ta jiao tan 。]

english: As outlined in your contract, he wishes them slain in particular ways.
translation: 正如你的合同中所概述的，他希望他们以特定的方式被杀死。 [zheng ru ni de he tong zhong suo gai shu de ， ta xi wang ta men yi te ding de fang shi bei sha si 。]

english: Could you remind me what ways those were?
translation: 你能提醒我这些是什么方式吗？ [ni neng ti xing wo zhe xie shi shen me fang shi ma ？]

english: Death by two-handed melee weapons, heavy ranged weapons, magic spells, special attacks, and defeating them whilst bound.
translation: 通过双手近战武器、重型远程武器、魔法咒语、特殊攻击以及在被束缚时击败它们而死亡。 [tong guo shuang shou jin zhan wu qi 、 zhong xing yuan cheng wu qi 、 mo fa zhou yu 、 te shu gong ji yi ji zai bei shu fu shi ji bai ta men er si wang 。]

english: Additionaly, he will request a specific method to be used. If you comply, your chances of obtaining a reward will be increased.
translation: 此外，他会要求使用特定的方法。如果您遵守，您获得奖励的机会将会增加。 [ci wai ， ta hui yao qiu shi yong te ding de fang fa 。 ru guo nin zun shou ， nin huo de jiang li de ji hui jiang hui zeng jia 。]

english: Currently, my master wishes for you to use spells to kill his minions.
translation: 目前，我的主人希望你使用法术杀死他的爪牙。 [mu qian ， wo de zhu ren xi wang ni shi yong fa shu sha si ta de zhao ya 。]

english: Does that include powered staves?
translation: 这包括动力棒吗？ [zhe bao kuo dong li bang ma ？]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Currently, my master wishes for you to use special attacks to kill his minions.
translation: 目前，我的主人希望你使用特殊攻击来杀死他的爪牙。 [mu qian ， wo de zhu ren xi wang ni shi yong te shu gong ji lai sha si ta de zhao ya 。]

english: What kinds of rewards would I receive?
translation: 我会得到什么类型的奖励？ [wo hui de dao shen me lei xing de jiang li ？]

english: Special contracts, to be presented to my master for further discussion.
translation: 特别合同，将提交给我的主人进一步讨论。 [te bie he tong ， jiang ti jiao gei wo de zhu ren jin yi bu tao lun 。]

english: Interesting. Thank you.
translation: 有趣的。谢谢。 [you qu de 。 xie xie 。]

english: You are most welcome.
translation: 非常欢迎您。 [fei chang huan ying nin 。]

english: Are you okay?
translation: 你还好吗？ [ni hai hao ma ？]

english: Oh yes! Just praying to my new master. It's hot down here, isn't it?
translation: 哦是的！只是向我的新主人祈祷。这里很热，不是吗？ [o shi de ！ zhi shi xiang wo de xin zhu ren qi dao 。 zhe li hen re ， bu shi ma ？]

english: I guess so.
translation: 大概吧。 [da gai ba 。]

english: Your new master, that would be...?
translation: 你的新主人，会是……？ [ni de xin zhu ren ， hui shi ……？]

english: Yama! I sold my soul you see, well, I guess that Ox-headed guy down there forcibly removed it.
translation: 阎王！我出卖了我的灵魂，你看，好吧，我猜下面那个牛头人强行把它移走了。 [yan wang ！ wo chu mai le wo de ling hun ， ni kan ， hao ba ， wo cai xia mian na ge niu tou ren qiang xing ba ta yi zou le 。]

english: That doesn't sound like a fair trade...
translation: 这听起来不像是公平交易…… [zhe ting qi lai bu xiang shi gong ping jiao yi ……]

english: Oh, don't worry, I'm perfectly fine with the outcome. Sure, the loss of vision is a shame but it could be worse.
translation: 哦，别担心，我对结果非常满意。当然，视力丧失是一种耻辱，但情况可能会更糟。 [o ， bie dan xin ， wo dui jie guo fei chang man yi 。 dang ran ， shi li sang shi shi yi zhong chi ru ， dan qing kuang ke neng hui geng zao 。]

english: Could it?
translation: 可以吗？ [ke yi ma ？]

english: Underground there are no tall buildings, I'm awfully afraid of heights, you see.
translation: 地下没有高楼，你看我很恐高。 [di xia mei you gao lou ， ni kan wo hen kong gao 。]

english: Perhaps it's a good thing you can't see...
translation: 或许你看不到也是一件好事…… [huo xu ni kan bu dao ye shi yi jian hao shi ……]

english: What was that?
translation: 那是什么？ [na shi shen me ？]

english: Oh, nothing...
translation: 哦，没什么…… [o ， mei shen me ……]

english: What happened to your eyes?
translation: 你的眼睛怎么了？ [ni de yan jing zen me le ？]

english: The ritual, there were some... adverse effects...
translation: 仪式，有一些……不良影响…… [yi shi ， you yi xie …… bu liang ying xiang ……]

english: The ritual?
translation: 仪式？ [yi shi ？]

english: Oh yes! Pretty basic really, head of an Ox, bruma roots, lots of fire and of course the human sacrifice.
translation: 哦是的！确实很简单，牛头、布鲁玛根、大量的火，当然还有活人祭品。 [o shi de ！ que shi hen jian dan ， niu tou 、 bu lu ma gen 、 da liang de huo ， dang ran hai you huo ren ji pin 。]

english: And at what point did that blind you?
translation: 那是什么时候让你失明的呢？ [na shi shen me shi hou rang ni shi ming de ne ？]

english: The voice demanded that we stare into the fire until we saw enlightenment.
translation: 这个声音要求我们凝视火焰，直到看到启蒙。 [zhe ge sheng yin yao qiu wo men ning shi huo yan ， zhi dao kan dao qi meng 。]

english: I guess the fire was pretty bright.
translation: 我猜火一定很亮。 [wo cai huo yi ding hen liang 。]

english: Blindingly so.
translation: 如此盲目。 [ru ci mang mu 。]

english: Wait! Did you say human sacrifice?
translation: 等待！你说的是活人祭祀吗？ [deng dai ！ ni shuo de shi huo ren ji si ma ？]

english: Why, of course! We're Zamorakians, we're evil...
translation: 为什么，当然！我们是萨莫拉克人，我们是邪恶的...... [wei shen me ， dang ran ！ wo men shi sa mo la ke ren ， wo men shi xie e de ......]

english: Yeah, I guess that's true.
translation: 是的，我想这是真的。 [shi de ， wo xiang zhe shi zhen de 。]

english: Well, I'll leave you to it.
translation: 好吧，我就交给你了。 [hao ba ， wo jiu jiao gei ni le 。]

english: So soon?
translation: 这么快？ [zhe me kuai ？]

english: Yep, the demons won't slay themselves.
translation: 是的，恶魔不会自杀。 [shi de ， e mo bu hui zi sha 。]

english: What demons?
translation: 什么恶魔？ [shen me e mo ？]

english: For now. Have you come to prove yourself in combat against the many demons within the Chasm?
translation: 目前。你是为了在与鸿沟中众多恶魔的战斗中证明自己吗？ [mu qian 。 ni shi wei le zai yu hong gou zhong zhong duo e mo de zhan dou zhong zheng ming zi ji ma ？]

english: My master wishes you not to kill his minions without an agenda. You may only slay within the Chasm that which you have been assigned by a Slayer Master.
translation: 我的主人希望你不要毫无目的地杀死他的爪牙。你只能在裂缝中杀死杀戮大师指定给你的人。 [wo de zhu ren xi wang ni bu yao hao wu mu di di sha si ta de zhao ya 。 ni zhi neng zai lie feng zhong sha si sha lu da shi zhi ding gei ni de ren 。]

english: That's an oddly specific reason.
translation: 这是一个奇怪的具体原因。 [zhe shi yi ge qi guai de ju ti yuan yin 。]

english: My master wishes you not to kill his minions without an agenda. You may only slay within the Chasm that which you have been assigned by a Slayer Master.
translation: 我的主人希望你不要毫无目的地杀死他的爪牙。你只能在裂缝中杀死杀戮大师指定给你的人。 [wo de zhu ren xi wang ni bu yao hao wu mu di di sha si ta de zhao ya 。 ni zhi neng zai lie feng zhong sha si sha lu da shi zhi ding gei ni de ren 。]

english: Your new master, that would be...?
translation: 你的新主人，会是……？ [ni de xin zhu ren ， hui shi ……？]

english: What happened to your eyes?
translation: 你的眼睛怎么了？ [ni de yan jing zen me le ？]

english: Well, I'll leave you to it.
translation: 好吧，我就交给你了。 [hao ba ， wo jiu jiao gei ni le 。]

english: Such a long voyage... maybe one day there will be a glider service out here.
translation: 这么长的航程……也许有一天这里会有滑翔机服务。 [zhe me zhang de hang cheng …… ye xu you yi tian zhe li hui you hua xiang ji fu wu 。]

english: We could always do with an extra pair of hands on the dock. See Frankie, the fresh fish trader, if you're looking for work.
translation: 我们总是可以在码头上多派一双手。如果您正在找工作，请联系鲜鱼贸易商弗兰基。 [wo men zong shi ke yi zai ma tou shang duo pai yi shuang shou 。 ru guo nin zheng zai zhao gong zuo ， qing lian xi xian yu mao yi shang fu lan ji 。]

english: We can fix this faster if we work together!
translation: 如果我们共同努力，我们可以更快地解决这个问题！ [ru guo wo men gong tong nu li ， wo men ke yi geng kuai di jie jue zhe ge wen ti ！]

english: Blasted thing's broken again!
translation: 该死的东西又坏了！ [gai si de dong xi you huai le ！]

english: Can I get some assistance over here?
translation: 我可以在这里得到一些帮助吗？ [wo ke yi zai zhe li de dao yi xie bang zhu ma ？]

english: Great work, this crane should be good for a while!
translation: 干得好，这台起重机应该可以用一段时间！ [gan de hao ， zhe tai qi zhong ji ying gai ke yi yong yi duan shi jian ！]

english: What can I do for you, [m'lady/sir]?
translation: 我能为您做些什么吗，[女士/先生]？ [wo neng wei nin zuo xie shen me ma ，[ nv shi / xian sheng ]？]

english: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这附近做什么？ [ni zai zhe fu jin zuo shen me ？]

english: It's my job to keep track of operations on the docks.
translation: 我的工作是跟踪码头的运作情况。 [wo de gong zuo shi gen zong ma tou de yun zuo qing kuang 。]

english: Is there anything I can help out with?
translation: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang mang de ma ？]

english: Thanks for the offer, but I'm afraid you need a higher crafting level before you can help me.
translation: 感谢您的提议，但恐怕您需要更高的制作水平才能帮助我。 [gan xie nin de ti yi ， dan kong pa nin xu yao geng gao de zhi zuo shui ping cai neng bang zhu wo 。]

english: You need a crafting level of 30 to assist the Piscarilius dockmaster.
translation: 您需要 30 级的制作等级来协助 Piscarilius 码头管理员。 [nin xu yao  30  ji de zhi zuo deng ji lai xie zhu  Piscarilius  ma tou guan li yuan 。]

english: You look like you know a thing or two about crafting, perhaps you could help us maintain the fishing cranes around the docks.
translation: 你看起来对手工略知一二，也许你可以帮助我们维护码头周围的钓鱼起重机。 [ni kan qi lai dui shou gong lve zhi yi er ， ye xu ni ke yi bang zhu wo men wei hu ma tou zhou wei de diao yu qi zhong ji 。]

english: You'll need a hammer, some nails and a few wooden planks, 3 planks per broken crane should be enough.
translation: 你需要一把锤子、一些钉子​​和一些木板，每个破损的起重机 3 块木板就足够了。 [ni xu yao yi ba chui zi 、 yi xie ding zi ​​ he yi xie mu ban ， mei ge po sun de qi zhong ji  3  kuai mu ban jiu zu gou le 。]

english: I can't offer you any payment at the moment, but hard work doesn't go unnoticed around these parts.
translation: 目前我无法向您提供任何报酬，但围绕这些部分的辛苦工作不会被忽视。 [mu qian wo wu fa xiang nin ti gong ren he bao chou ， dan wei rao zhe xie bu fen de xin ku gong zuo bu hui bei hu shi 。]

english: Sure, I'll see what I can do.
translation: 当然，我会看看我能做什么。 [dang ran ， wo hui kan kan wo neng zuo shen me 。]

english: I'll let you get back to work.
translation: 我会让你回去工作。 [wo hui rang ni hui qu gong zuo 。]

english: Sorry, I was just looking around.
translation: 抱歉，我只是四处看看。 [bao qian ， wo zhi shi si chu kan kan 。]

english: Fair enough.
translation: 很公平。 [hen gong ping 。]

english: I have a question for you.
translation: 我有个问题要问你。 [wo you ge wen ti yao wen ni 。]

english: The Dockmaster has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 码头管理员给了你一个挑战卷轴！ [ma tou guan li yuan gei le ni yi ge tiao zhan juan zhou ！]

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。 [qing shu ru wen ti de da an 。]

english: No, try again.
translation: 不，再试一次。 [bu ， zai shi yi ci 。]

english: Correct!
translation: 正确的！ [zheng que de ！]

english: The Dockmaster has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 码头管理员给了你另一条线索卷轴！ [ma tou guan li yuan gei le ni ling yi tiao xian suo juan zhou ！]

english: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这附近做什么？ [ni zai zhe fu jin zuo shen me ？]

english: Is there anything I can help out with?
translation: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang mang de ma ？]

english: I'll let you get back to work.
translation: 我会让你回去工作。 [wo hui rang ni hui qu gong zuo 。]

english: Sorry, I was just looking around.
translation: 抱歉，我只是四处看看。 [bao qian ， wo zhi shi si chu kan kan 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: How do you feel? No heavy flu, shivers, nausea or loss of appetite?
translation: 你感觉如何？没有严重流感、寒战、恶心或食欲不振吗？ [ni gan jue ru he ？ mei you yan zhong liu gan 、 han zhan 、 e xin huo shi yu bu zhen ma ？]

english: Uh... no... I feel fine...
translation: 呃……不……我感觉很好…… [e …… bu …… wo gan jue hen hao ……]

english: How about nightmares then? Are you experiencing any problems with especially scary nightmares?
translation: 那做噩梦怎么办？您是否遇到过特别可怕的噩梦的问题？ [na zuo e meng zen me ban ？ nin shi fou yu dao guo te bie ke pa de e meng de wen ti ？]

english: No... not since I was young.
translation: 不……从小就没有。 [bu …… cong xiao jiu mei you 。]

english: Good, good, I had to make sure. This plague really has an incredibly fast contagion rate. It spreads faster than the common cold!
translation: 好，好，我必须确认一下。这种瘟疫的传染速度确实快得令人难以置信。它的传播速度比普通感冒还快！ [hao ， hao ， wo bi xu que ren yi xia 。 zhe zhong wen yi de chuan ran su du que shi kuai de ling ren nan yi zhi xin 。 ta de chuan bo su du bi pu tong gan mao hai kuai ！]

english: The plague? Tell me more.
translation: 瘟疫？告诉我更多。 [wen yi ？ gao su wo geng duo 。]

english: It came from the west somewhere. It is extremely quick spreading, and utterly deadly.
translation: 它来自西方的某个地方。它的传播速度极快，而且完全致命。 [ta lai zi xi fang de mou ge di fang 。 ta de chuan bo su du ji kuai ， er qie wan quan zhi ming 。]

english: What are the symptoms?
translation: 有什么症状？ [you shen me zheng zhuang ？]

english: It varies slightly from case to case, but usually abnormal nightmares and flu-like symptoms, progressing as you succumb more. Eventually, it results in the presence of a thick black tar-like substance secreted
translation: 每种情况略有不同，但通常会出现异常的噩梦和类似流感的症状，并且随着您的死亡程度的增加而恶化。最终，它导致分泌出一种浓稠的黑色焦油状物质 [mei zhong qing kuang lve you bu tong ， dan tong chang hui chu xian yi chang de e meng he lei si liu gan de zheng zhuang ， bing qie sui zhe nin de si wang cheng du de zeng jia er e hua 。 zui zhong ， ta dao zhi fen mi chu yi zhong nong chou de hei se jiao you zhuang wu zhi]

english: from the nose and eyes.
translation: 从鼻子和眼睛。 [cong bi zi he yan jing 。]

english: Okay, I'll be careful.
translation: 好的，我会小心的。 [hao de ， wo hui xiao xin de 。]

english: You do that adventurer. You do not want to become infected by the plague.
translation: 你就是那个冒险家。您不想被瘟疫感染。 [ni jiu shi na ge mao xian jia 。 nin bu xiang bei wen yi gan ran 。]

english: Good day, you have my next payment? I don't keep this charade up for fun you know.
translation: 美好的一天，你有我的下一笔付款吗？你知道，我不会为了好玩而继续玩这个游戏。 [mei hao de yi tian ， ni you wo de xia yi bi fu kuan ma ？ ni zhi dao ， wo bu hui wei le hao wan er ji xu wan zhe ge you xi 。]

english: Sorry I don't.
translation: 抱歉我不知道。 [bao qian wo bu zhi dao 。]

english: Well if you would mention it next time you see the Head Mourner, it would be appreciated.
translation: 好吧，如果您下次见到悼念者时能提及这一点，我们将不胜感激。 [hao ba ， ru guo nin xia ci jian dao dao nian zhe shi neng ti ji zhe yi dian ， wo men jiang bu sheng gan ji 。]

english: I'll keep it in mind.
translation: 我会记住的。 [wo hui ji zhu de 。]

english: Hello there. Can't stop to talk I'm afraid, I'm very busy right now.
translation: 你好呀。恐怕无法停下来说话，我现在很忙。 [ni hao ya 。 kong pa wu fa ting xia lai shuo hua ， wo xian zai hen mang 。]

english: Hello doctor. I need to acquire some protective clothing so that I can dispose of some diseased sheep.
translation: 你好医生。我需要购买一些防护服，以便处理一些病羊。 [ni hao yi sheng 。 wo xu yao gou mai yi xie fang hu fu ， yi bian chu li yi xie bing yang 。]

english: Protective clothing? I'm afraid I only have the one suit which I made myself to prevent infection from any contaminated patients I treat.
translation: 防护服？恐怕我只有一套我自己做的防护服，用来防止我治疗的任何受污染的病人受到感染。 [fang hu fu ？ kong pa wo zhi you yi tao wo zi ji zuo de fang hu fu ， yong lai fang zhi wo zhi liao de ren he shou wu ran de bing ren shou dao gan ran 。]

english: I suppose I could sell you this one and make myself another, but it would cost you at least 100 gold so that I could afford a replacement.
translation: 我想我可以把这个卖给你，然后自己再做一个，但这至少要花费你 100 金币，这样我才能买得起替代品。 [wo xiang wo ke yi ba zhe ge mai gei ni ， ran hou zi ji zai zuo yi ge ， dan zhe zhi shao yao hua fei ni  100  jin bi ， zhe yang wo cai neng mai de qi ti dai pin 。]

english: Okay, I'll take it.
translation: 好的，我会接受的。 [hao de ， wo hui jie shou de 。]

english: These should protect you from infection.
translation: 这些应该可以保护您免受感染。 [zhe xie ying gai ke yi bao hu nin mian shou gan ran 。]

english: Sorry doc, that's too much.
translation: 对不起，医生，太多了。 [dui bu qi ， yi sheng ， tai duo le 。]

english: I'm afraid it will cost me that much to replace. I cannot possibly sell it for less.
translation: 恐怕要花那么多钱去更换。我不可能以更低的价格出售它。 [kong pa yao hua na me duo qian qu geng huan 。 wo bu ke neng yi geng di de jia ge chu shou ta 。]

english: The plague? Tell me more.
translation: 瘟疫？告诉我更多。 [wen yi ？ gao su wo geng duo 。]

english: Okay, I'll be careful.
translation: 好的，我会小心的。 [hao de ， wo hui xiao xin de 。]

english: Okay, I'll take it.
translation: 好的，我会接受的。 [hao de ， wo hui jie shou de 。]

english: Sorry doc, that's too much.
translation: 对不起，医生，太多了。 [dui bu qi ， yi sheng ， tai duo le 。]

english: Psst! Got any Void kit you don't want? Spare robes, spare helms, that kind of thing?
translation: 嘘！有您不想要的 Void 套件吗？备用长袍、备用头盔之类的东西？ [xu ！ you nin bu xiang yao de  Void  tao jian ma ？ bei yong chang pao 、 bei yong tou kui zhi lei de dong xi ？]

english: What if I do?
translation: 如果我这样做怎么办？ [ru guo wo zhe yang zuo zen me ban ？]

english: Might be able to take it off your hands for you. Show me what you've got, and I'll see if I can get you some Commendation Points for it.
translation: 或许可以为你把它从你的手上拿下来。告诉我你有什么，我看看是否能为你赢得一些奖励积分。 [huo xu ke yi wei ni ba ta cong ni de shou shang na xia lai 。 gao su wo ni you shen me ， wo kan kan shi fou neng wei ni ying de yi xie jiang li ji fen 。]

english: Just so you know, you've got a lot of Commendation points already, so I can't pay you my usual rate.
translation: 想让你知道，你已经获得了很多奖励积分，所以我无法按照平常的价格支付给你。 [xiang rang ni zhi dao ， ni yi jing huo de le hen duo jiang li ji fen ， suo yi wo wu fa an zhao ping chang de jia ge zhi fu gei ni 。]

english: Deal!
translation: 交易！ [jiao yi ！]

english: No, I don't.
translation: 不，我不。 [bu ， wo bu 。]

english: Decline
translation: 衰退 [shuai tui]

english: That's not really the sort of stuff I want
translation: 这不是我真正想要的东西 [zhe bu shi wo zhen zheng xiang yao de dong xi]

english: What if I do?
translation: 如果我这样做怎么办？ [ru guo wo zhe yang zuo zen me ban ？]

english: Accept
translation: 接受 [jie shou]

english: No, I don't.
translation: 不，我不。 [bu ， wo bu 。]

english: Lookin' fer Captain Tock?
translation: 寻找托克船长吗？ [xun zhao tuo ke chuan zhang ma ？]

english: Lookin' fer the Corsair cabin boy?
translation: 寻找海盗船机舱男孩吗？ [xun zhao hai dao chuan ji cang nan hai ma ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Arr, I can help ye with yer business wi'out ye needin' to known mine. So are ye seekin' him, or not?
translation: 啊，我可以帮助你做你的事，而你不需要知道我的。那么你们到底在找他吗？ [a ， wo ke yi bang zhu ni zuo ni de shi ， er ni bu xu yao zhi dao wo de 。 na me ni men dao di zai zhao ta ma ？]

english: Yes, I am.
translation: 我是。 [wo shi 。]

english: The Corsairs moor their ship away to the west, beyond yon village of Rimmington. Ye should look fer him there.
translation: 海盗们将他们的船停泊在西边的里明顿村外。你应该去那里找他。 [hai dao men jiang ta men de chuan ting bo zai xi bian de li ming dun cun wai 。 ni ying gai qu na li zhao ta 。]

english: West, beyond Rimmington? Thank you.
translation: 西边，超越里明顿？谢谢。 [xi bian ， chao yue li ming dun ？ xie xie 。]

english: Why would I be looking for him?
translation: 我为什么要找他？ [wo wei shen me yao zhao ta ？]

english: Many come here seekin' him. They be all lost an 'confused. If ye be seekin' him now, maybe I can help ye.
translation: 许多人来这里寻找他。他们都迷失了‘困惑’。如果你现在正在寻找他，也许我可以帮助你。 [xu duo ren lai zhe li xun zhao ta 。 ta men dou mi shi le ‘ kun huo ’。 ru guo ni xian zai zheng zai xun zhao ta ， ye xu wo ke yi bang zhu ni 。]

english: No, I'm not.
translation: 不，我不是。 [bu ， wo bu shi 。]

english: Arrr, I thought maybe ye were.
translation: 呃，我想也许你们是。 [e ， wo xiang ye xu ni men shi 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Yes, I am.
translation: 我是。 [wo shi 。]

english: Why would I be looking for him?
translation: 我为什么要找他？ [wo wei shen me yao zhao ta ？]

english: No, I'm not.
translation: 不，我不是。 [bu ， wo bu shi 。]

english: Woof!
translation: 纬！ [wei ！]

english: Welcome to the Nightmare Zone! Would you like me to create a dream for you?
translation: 欢迎来到噩梦区！你愿意我为你创造一个梦想吗？ [huan ying lai dao e meng qu ！ ni yuan yi wo wei ni chuang zao yi ge meng xiang ma ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: My name's Dominic Onion but you can call me Dom, or Mr Onion.
translation: 我叫多米尼克·洋葱，但你可以叫我多姆，或者洋葱先生。 [wo jiao duo mi ni ke · yang cong ， dan ni ke yi jiao wo duo mu ， huo zhe yang cong xian sheng 。]

english: Mr Oni...Dom, how did you get that name?
translation: Oni 先生...Dom，你是怎么得到这个名字的？ [Oni  xian sheng ...Dom， ni shi zen me de dao zhe ge ming zi de ？]

english: Well that's a long story...but I can tell you that it involved my parents, 3 blurberry specials, and a chinchompa.
translation: 嗯，这是一个很长的故事……但我可以告诉你，这涉及到我的父母、3 杯蓝莓特色菜和一只金鸡巴。 [n ， zhe shi yi ge hen zhang de gu shi …… dan wo ke yi gao su ni ， zhe she ji dao wo de fu mu 、3  bei lan mei te se cai he yi zhi jin ji ba 。]

english: ...and a chinchompa?
translation: ...还有金鸡巴？ [... hai you jin ji ba ？]

english: Oh yes, Nigel played a crucial role in the whole debacle. It's all very amusing now that I think back to it.
translation: 哦，是的，奈杰尔在整个灾难中扮演了至关重要的角色。现在回想起来，这一切都非常有趣。 [o ， shi de ， nai jie er zai zheng ge zai nan zhong ban yan le zhi guan zhong yao de jue se 。 xian zai hui xiang qi lai ， zhe yi qie dou fei chang you qu 。]

english: Right...
translation: 正确的... [zheng que de ...]

english: Good times...
translation: 美好时光... [mei hao shi guang ...]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This is the Nightmare Zone!
translation: 这里是噩梦地带！ [zhe li shi e meng di dai ！]

english: Wwwwhat?!
translation: 哇什么？！ [wa shen me ？！]

english: Don't worry, it's not as bad as it sounds...most of the time.
translation: 别担心，大多数情况下，情况并不像听起来那么糟糕。 [bie dan xin ， da duo shu qing kuang xia ， qing kuang bing bu xiang ting qi lai na me zao gao 。]

english: That's comforting.
translation: 这很令人欣慰。 [zhe hen ling ren xin wei 。]

english: Truth be told, that name wasn't my first choice, it's what the local folk have been calling it and so it sort of stuck.
translation: 说实话，这个名字不是我的第一选择，这是当地人一直这么称呼它，所以它有点卡住了。 [shuo shi hua ， zhe ge ming zi bu shi wo de di yi xuan ze ， zhe shi dang di ren yi zhi zhe me cheng hu ta ， suo yi ta you dian ka zhu le 。]

english: My original plan came to me in a vivid dream when I was younger you see, I saw myself running a successful business from a great structure in a strange land.
translation: 我最初的计划是在我年轻的时候在一个生动的梦中实现的，你看，我看到自己在一个陌生的土地上经营着一家伟大的企业，经营着一家成功的企业。 [wo zui chu de ji hua shi zai wo nian qing de shi hou zai yi ge sheng dong de meng zhong shi xian de ， ni kan ， wo kan dao zi ji zai yi ge mo sheng de tu di shang jing ying zhe yi jia wei da de qi ye ， jing ying zhe yi jia cheng gong de qi ye 。]

english: Well, I say strange, but I'd never left Lunar Isle at the time and this place was very hot and dry, unlike anything I'd seen before.
translation: 嗯，我说奇怪，但我当时从未离开过月岛，而且这个地方非常炎热和干燥，与我以前见过的任何地方都不一样。 [n ， wo shuo qi guai ， dan wo dang shi cong wei li kai guo yue dao ， er qie zhe ge di fang fei chang yan re huo gan zao ， yu wo yi qian jian guo de ren he di fang dou bu yi yang 。]

english: When I told my father about the dream he laughed and said I should become a banker like him and his father before him but in that moment I knew that it wasn't the life for me.
translation: 当我告诉父亲这个梦想时，他笑着说我应该像他和他的父亲一样成为一名银行家，但那一刻我知道这不适合我的生活。 [dang wo gao su fu qin zhe ge meng xiang shi ， ta xiao zhe shuo wo ying gai xiang ta he ta de fu qin yi yang cheng wei yi ming yin hang jia ， dan na yi ke wo zhi dao zhe bu shi he wo de sheng huo 。]

english: I had to find out what this dream meant and if it was a vision of the future or not.
translation: 我必须弄清楚这个梦意味着什么，以及它是否是对未来的愿景。 [wo bi xu nong qing chu zhe ge meng yi wei zhe shen me ， yi ji ta shi fou shi dui wei lai de yuan jing 。]

english: Growing up, I studied hard to find out more about magic, especially oneiromancy and the interpretation of dreams.
translation: 在成长过程中，我努力学习以了解更多关于魔法的知识，尤其是梦境和梦的解释。 [zai cheng zhang guo cheng zhong ， wo nu li xue xi yi liao jie geng duo guan yu mo fa de zhi shi ， you qi shi meng jing he meng de jie shi 。]

english: Having learned as much as I could on Lunar Isle I set out to find and learn from other great wizards I'd heard of in stories as a child.
translation: 在月岛上学到了尽可能多的知识后，我开始寻找小时候在故事中听说过的其他伟大巫师并向他们学习。 [zai yue dao shang xue dao le jin ke neng duo de zhi shi hou ， wo kai shi xun zhao xiao shi hou zai gu shi zhong ting shuo guo de qi ta wei da wu shi bing xiang ta men xue xi 。]

english: I set off to travel the world, discovering more about dreams to enable me to understand the dream I'd had as a child.
translation: 我开始环游世界，发现更多关于梦的知识，让我能够理解我小时候的梦想。 [wo kai shi huan you shi jie ， fa xian geng duo guan yu meng de zhi shi ， rang wo neng gou li jie wo xiao shi hou de meng xiang 。]

english: I needed to know what this dream meant and if it was truly a vision of the future.
translation: 我需要知道这个梦意味着什么，以及它是否真的是未来的愿景。 [wo xu yao zhi dao zhe ge meng yi wei zhe shen me ， yi ji ta shi fou zhen de shi wei lai de yuan jing 。]

english: If so I knew I had to try and find this location and build the huge tower I saw.
translation: 如果是这样，我知道我必须尝试找到这个位置并建造我看到的巨大塔楼。 [ru guo shi zhe yang ， wo zhi dao wo bi xu chang shi zhao dao zhe ge wei zhi bing jian zao wo kan dao de ju da ta lou 。]

english: I was going to call it 'Dom Onion's Tower', but I've not found this strange place or gathered enough money to build it just yet.
translation: 我本来打算将其称为“Dom Onion's Tower”，但我还没有找到这个奇怪的地方，也没有筹集到足够的钱来建造它。 [wo ben lai da suan jiang qi cheng wei “Dom Onion's Tower”， dan wo hai mei you zhao dao zhe ge qi guai de di fang ， ye mei you chou ji dao zu gou de qian lai jian zao ta 。]

english: That's why I've setup this small business venture in the mean time selling dreams to people. I just need a big enough crowd to kickstart my business.
translation: 这就是为什么我同时创办了这个小型企业，向人们推销梦想。我只需要足够多的人群来启动我的业务。 [zhe jiu shi wei shen me wo tong shi chuang ban le zhe ge xiao xing qi ye ， xiang ren men tui xiao meng xiang 。 wo zhi xu yao zu gou duo de ren qun lai qi dong wo de ye wu 。]

english: It's all part of my five year plan, and who knows, perhaps my dream will come true; I'll discover this place and build Dom Onion's Tower!
translation: 这都是我五年计划的一部分，谁知道呢，也许我的梦想会实现；我会发现这个地方并建造洋葱王之塔！ [zhe dou shi wo wu nian ji hua de yi bu fen ， shui zhi dao ne ， ye xu wo de meng xiang hui shi xian ； wo hui fa xian zhe ge di fang bing jian zao yang cong wang zhi ta ！]

english: Can you tell me about the dreams?
translation: 你能告诉我关于梦想的事吗？ [ni neng gao su wo guan yu meng xiang de shi ma ？]

english: Certainly. I can delve into your memories and search for the key events that have affected you on your adventures.
translation: 当然。我可以深入研究你的记忆并寻找影响你冒险的关键事件。 [dang ran 。 wo ke yi shen ru yan jiu ni de ji yi bing xun zhao ying xiang ni mao xian de guan jian shi jian 。]

english: I then take the essence of these memories and put that in the vial you see on the plinth.
translation: 然后我将这些记忆的精华放入你在底座上看到的小瓶中。 [ran hou wo jiang zhe xie ji yi de jing hua fang ru ni zai di zuo shang kan dao de xiao ping zhong 。]

english: I imbue a bit of magic, then give the vial a bit of a shake, and when you drink it you'll be able to re-live an encounter close to the original.
translation: 我注入了一点魔法，然后摇晃了一下小瓶，当你喝下它时，你将能够重新经历一次接近原始的遭遇。 [wo zhu ru le yi dian mo fa ， ran hou yao huang le yi xia xiao ping ， dang ni he xia ta shi ， ni jiang neng gou chong xin jing li yi ci jie jin yuan shi de zao yu 。]

english: Don't worry though, when you're in a dream, you're perfectly safe even if it does seem very real.
translation: 不过不用担心，当您在梦中时，即使它看起来非常真实，您也是绝对安全的。 [bu guo bu yong dan xin ， dang nin zai meng zhong shi ， ji shi ta kan qi lai fei chang zhen shi ， nin ye shi jue dui an quan de 。]

english: If you sucessfullyovercome the dream or die trying, you'll leave the dream state and return to normal with your grey matter and appendages intact.
translation: 如果你成功地克服了梦境或在尝试中死去，你将离开梦境并恢复正常，灰质和附肢完好无损。 [ru guo ni cheng gong di ke fu le meng jing huo zai chang shi zhong si qu ， ni jiang li kai meng jing bing hui fu zheng chang ， hui zhi he fu zhi wan hao wu sun 。]

english: Are all dreams the same or are there different options?
translation: 所有的梦想都是一样的还是有不同的选择？ [suo you de meng xiang dou shi yi yang de hai shi you bu tong de xuan ze ？]

english: Oh no, they can vary wildly! You can choose from one of three main options.
translation: 哦不，它们可能会有很大差异！您可以从三个主要选项之一中进行选择。 [o bu ， ta men ke neng hui you hen da cha yi ！ nin ke yi cong san ge zhu yao xuan xiang zhi yi zhong jin xing xuan ze 。]

english: Firstly, I can create a one-on-one encounter with an adversary you've defeated in your adventures. People like to practice in these dreams.
translation: 首先，我可以与你在冒险中击败的对手进行一对一的遭遇。人们喜欢在这些梦中练习。 [shou xian ， wo ke yi yu ni zai mao xian zhong ji bai de dui shou jin xing yi dui yi de zao yu 。 ren men xi huan zai zhe xie meng zhong lian xi 。]

english: Then there's a sort of Endurance dream, where you face enemies in encounter after encounter, and try to survive to the end.
translation: 还有一种耐力梦，你在一次又一次的遭遇中面对敌人，并努力生存到最后。 [hai you yi zhong nai li meng ， ni zai yi ci you yi ci de zao yu zhong mian dui di ren ， bing nu li sheng cun dao zui hou 。]

english: And finally there's something I like to call a Rumble, where you face multiple adversaries at the same time. I imbue a bit more magic and shake the vial harder to create that one!
translation: 最后，我喜欢将其称为“隆隆”，即你同时面对多个对手。我注入了更多的魔力，并用力摇晃小瓶来创造那个！ [zui hou ， wo xi huan jiang qi cheng wei “ long long ”， ji ni tong shi mian dui duo ge dui shou 。 wo zhu ru le geng duo de mo li ， bing yong li yao huang xiao ping lai chuang zao na ge ！]

english: You can invite friends to fight alongside you in a Rumble dream. Once I've set up the dream for you, step into the enclosure and invite up to 4 friends.
translation: 您可以邀请朋友在《轰隆隆》梦境中与您并肩作战。当我为您设定好梦想后，请进入围栏并邀请最多 4 位朋友。 [nin ke yi yao qing peng you zai 《 hong long long 》 meng jing zhong yu nin bing jian zuo zhan 。 dang wo wei nin she ding hao meng xiang hou ， qing jin ru wei lan bing yao qing zui duo  4  wei peng you 。]

english: For the Endurance and Rumble dreams, I charge a fee for my work. I don't like handling the money directly, so instead I've set up a secure coffer.
translation: 为了实现“耐力”和“隆隆”梦想，我收取工作费用。我不喜欢直接处理这笔钱，所以我设立了一个安全的金库。 [wei le shi xian “ nai li ” he “ long long ” meng xiang ， wo shou qu gong zuo fei yong 。 wo bu xi huan zhi jie chu li zhe bi qian ， suo yi wo she li le yi ge an quan de jin ku 。]

english: After you've asked me to set up a dream, put some money in my coffer. I'll deduct the fee from the coffer when you start the dream.
translation: 当你让我树立一个梦想之后，就往我的小金库里存点钱吧。当你开始梦想的时候，我会从你的金库里扣除费用。 [dang ni rang wo shu li yi ge meng xiang zhi hou ， jiu wang wo de xiao jin ku li cun dian qian ba 。 dang ni kai shi meng xiang de shi hou ， wo hui cong ni de jin ku li kou chu fei yong 。]

english: There's a red vial on the other plinth. Your friends can drink from it to enter your dream as a spectator to observe your progress.
translation: 另一个底座上有一个红色小瓶。你的朋友可以喝它，以旁观者的身份进入你的梦境，观察你的进步。 [ling yi ge di zuo shang you yi ge hong se xiao ping 。 ni de peng you ke yi he ta ， yi pang guan zhe de shen fen jin ru ni de meng jing ， guan cha ni de jin bu 。]

english: Finally here's one other option you get, and that's how difficult the encounters are. As well as the normal dreams, the bravest adventurers can choose a harder version*.
translation: 最后，你还有另一种选择，那就是遭遇的难度。除了普通的梦想之外，最勇敢的冒险家还可以选择更难的版本*。 [zui hou ， ni hai you ling yi zhong xuan ze ， na jiu shi zao yu de nan du 。 chu le pu tong de meng xiang zhi wai ， zui yong gan de mao xian jia hai ke yi xuan ze geng nan de ban ben *。]

english: *Terms and conditions apply: Mr Onion, henceforth known as Dom, cannot be held liable for accidental loss of limbs (yours or otherwise) and or psychological damage as a result of entering the Nightmare Zone. Please note there is a strict no-refunds policy, and all dream purchases are final.
translation: *适用条款和条件：洋葱先生（以下称为 Dom）对于因进入梦魇区域而意外失去肢体（您的或其他人的）和/或心理伤害不承担任何责任。请注意，有严格的不退款政策，所有梦想购买都是最终的。 [* shi yong tiao kuan he tiao jian ： yang cong xian sheng （ yi xia cheng wei  Dom） dui yu yin jin ru meng yan qu yu er yi wai shi qu zhi ti （ nin de huo qi ta ren de ） he / huo xin li shang hai bu cheng dan ren he ze ren 。 qing zhu yi ， you yan ge de bu tui kuan zheng ce ， suo you meng xiang gou mai dou shi zui zhong de 。]

english: Can I choose a dream?
translation: 我可以选择梦想吗？ [wo ke yi xuan ze meng xiang ma ？]

english: Certainly. You can practice for free, but the larger dreams require more skill to imbue the potions and so there's a fee for those.
translation: 当然。你可以免费练习，但更大的梦想需要更多的技巧来注入魔药，所以这些都是收费的。 [dang ran 。 ni ke yi mian fei lian xi ， dan geng da de meng xiang xu yao geng duo de ji qiao lai zhu ru mo yao ， suo yi zhe xie dou shi shou fei de 。]

english: I've prepared your dream. Drink from the vial in the enclosure when you're ready to fight.
translation: 你的梦想我已经准备好了。当你准备好战斗时，从围栏里的小瓶里喝水。 [ni de meng xiang wo yi jing zhun bei hao le 。 dang ni zhun bei hao zhan dou shi ， cong wei lan li de xiao ping li he shui 。]

english: For an Endurance dream, normal mode, I'll want 1,000 coins. I'll deduct the money from the coffer when you start the dream.
translation: 对于普通模式的耐力梦想，我需要 1,000 个金币。当你开始梦想的时候我会从金库里扣钱。 [dui yu pu tong mo shi de nai li meng xiang ， wo xu yao  1,000  ge jin bi 。 dang ni kai shi meng xiang de shi hou wo hui cong jin ku li kou qian 。]

english: I've prepared your dream. Drink from the vial in the enclosure when you're ready to fight. I'll deduct 1,000 coins from the coffer when you do.
translation: 你的梦想我已经准备好了。当你准备好战斗时，从围栏里的小瓶里喝水。到时候我会从金库里扣除1000金币。 [ni de meng xiang wo yi jing zhun bei hao le 。 dang ni zhun bei hao zhan dou shi ， cong wei lan li de xiao ping li he shui 。 dao shi hou wo hui cong jin ku li kou chu 1000 jin bi 。]

english: For an Endurance dream, hard mode, I'll want 5,000 coins. I'll deduct the money from the coffer when you start the dream.
translation: 对于耐力梦想，困难模式，我需要 5,000 个金币。当你开始梦想的时候我会从金库里扣钱。 [dui yu nai li meng xiang ， kun nan mo shi ， wo xu yao  5,000  ge jin bi 。 dang ni kai shi meng xiang de shi hou wo hui cong jin ku li kou qian 。]

english: I've prepared your dream. Drink from the vial in the enclosure when you're ready to fight. I'll deduct 5,000 coins from the coffer when you do.
translation: 你的梦想我已经准备好了。当你准备好战斗时，从围栏里的小瓶里喝水。到时候我会从金库里扣除5000金币。 [ni de meng xiang wo yi jing zhun bei hao le 。 dang ni zhun bei hao zhan dou shi ， cong wei lan li de xiao ping li he shui 。 dao shi hou wo hui cong jin ku li kou chu 5000 jin bi 。]

english: For a Rumble dream, normal mode, I'll want 2,000 coins. I'll deduct the money from the coffer when you start the dream.
translation: 对于 Rumble Dream，普通模式，我需要 2,000 个金币。当你开始梦想的时候我会从金库里扣钱。 [dui yu  Rumble Dream， pu tong mo shi ， wo xu yao  2,000  ge jin bi 。 dang ni kai shi meng xiang de shi hou wo hui cong jin ku li kou qian 。]

english: I've prepared your dream. Step into the enclosure, invite up to 4 players to join you, then drink from the vial to begin. Each of you will need to unlock the coffer and have 2,000 coins deposited first.
translation: 你的梦想我已经准备好了。走进围栏，邀请最多 4 名玩家加入，然后从瓶子里喝水开始。你们每个人都需要解锁保险箱并先存入 2,000 个硬币。 [ni de meng xiang wo yi jing zhun bei hao le 。 zou jin wei lan ， yao qing zui duo  4  ming wan jia jia ru ， ran hou cong ping zi li he shui kai shi 。 ni men mei ge ren dou xu yao jie suo bao xian xiang bing xian cun ru  2,000  ge ying bi 。]

english: For a Rumble dream, hard mode, I'll want 6,000 coins. I'll deduct the money from the coffer when you start the dream.
translation: 对于 Rumble Dream，困难模式，我需要 6,000 个金币。当你开始梦想的时候我会从金库里扣钱。 [dui yu  Rumble Dream， kun nan mo shi ， wo xu yao  6,000  ge jin bi 。 dang ni kai shi meng xiang de shi hou wo hui cong jin ku li kou qian 。]

translation: 对于可定制的 Rumble Dream（普通模式），我需要 12,000 个金币。当你开始梦想的时候我会从金库里扣钱。 [dui yu ke ding zhi de  Rumble Dream（ pu tong mo shi ）， wo xu yao  12,000  ge jin bi 。 dang ni kai shi meng xiang de shi hou wo hui cong jin ku li kou qian 。]

translation: 你的梦想我已经准备好了。走进围栏，邀请最多 4 名玩家加入，然后从瓶子里喝水开始。你们每个人都需要解锁保险箱并首先存入 12,000 个硬币。 [ni de meng xiang wo yi jing zhun bei hao le 。 zou jin wei lan ， yao qing zui duo  4  ming wan jia jia ru ， ran hou cong ping zi li he shui kai shi 。 ni men mei ge ren dou xu yao jie suo bao xian xiang bing shou xian cun ru  12,000  ge ying bi 。]

english: For a customisable Rumble dream, hard mode, I'll want 16,000 coins. I'll deduct the money from the coffer when you start the dream.
translation: 对于可定制的 Rumble Dream，困难模式，我需要 16,000 个金币。当你开始梦想的时候我会从金库里扣钱。 [dui yu ke ding zhi de  Rumble Dream， kun nan mo shi ， wo xu yao  16,000  ge jin bi 。 dang ni kai shi meng xiang de shi hou wo hui cong jin ku li kou qian 。]

english: I've prepared your dream. Step into the enclosure, invite up to 4 players to join you, then drink from the vial to begin. Each of you will need to unlock the coffer and have 16,000 coins deposited first.
translation: 你的梦想我已经准备好了。走进围栏，邀请最多 4 名玩家加入，然后从瓶子里喝水开始。你们每个人都需要解锁保险箱并首先存入 16,000 个硬币。 [ni de meng xiang wo yi jing zhun bei hao le 。 zou jin wei lan ， yao qing zui duo  4  ming wan jia jia ru ， ran hou cong ping zi li he shui kai shi 。 ni men mei ge ren dou xu yao jie suo bao xian xiang bing shou xian cun ru  16,000  ge ying bi 。]

english: I'll come back another time.
translation: 我下次再来。 [wo xia ci zai lai 。]

english: You haven't started that dream I created for you. Can I help you with something?
translation: 你还没有开始我为你创造的梦想。我可以帮你做点什么吗？ [ni hai mei you kai shi wo wei ni chuang zao de meng xiang 。 wo ke yi bang ni zuo dian shen me ma ？]

english: I want to change my dream.
translation: 我想改变我的梦想。 [wo xiang gai bian wo de meng xiang 。]

english: Okay, I've emptied the vial. I have not taken any money from you for that dream, since you never started it.
translation: 好的，我已经清空瓶子了。我没有为这个梦想从你那里拿过任何钱，因为你从未开始过它。 [hao de ， wo yi jing qing kong ping zi le 。 wo mei you wei zhe ge meng xiang cong ni na li na guo ren he qian ， yin wei ni cong wei kai shi guo ta 。]

english: Which dream would you like to experience?
translation: 你想体验哪个梦想？ [ni xiang ti yan na ge meng xiang ？]

english: I have a question for you.
translation: 我有个问题要问你。 [wo you ge wen ti yao wen ni 。]

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。 [qing shu ru wen ti de da an 。]

english: No, try again.
translation: 不，再试一次。 [bu ， zai shi yi ci 。]

english: Correct!
translation: 正确的！ [zheng que de ！]

english: Here, have this.
translation: 给，这个。 [gei ， zhe ge 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Can you tell me about the dreams?
translation: 你能告诉我关于梦想的事吗？ [ni neng gao su wo guan yu meng xiang de shi ma ？]

english: Can I choose a dream?
translation: 我可以选择梦想吗？ [wo ke yi xuan ze meng xiang ma ？]

english: Practice
translation: 实践 [shi jian]

translation: 普通的 [pu tong de]

translation: 是的 [shi de]

translation: 隆隆 [long long]

english: Customisable - hard

translation: 上一个：[上一个选择] [shang yi ge ：[ shang yi ge xuan ze ]]
