translation: 我下次再来。 [wo xia ci zai lai 。]

english: I want to change my dream.
translation: 我想改变我的梦想。 [wo xiang gai bian wo de meng xiang 。]

english: Would you like to buy some crafting equipment?
translation: 您想购买一些制作设备吗？ [nin xiang gou mai yi xie zhi zuo she bei ma ？]

english: No thanks; I've got all the Crafting equipment I need.
translation: 不，谢谢;我已经拥有了我需要的所有制作设备。 [bu ， xie xie ; wo yi jing yong you le wo xu yao de suo you zhi zuo she bei 。]

english: Okay. Fare well on your travels.
translation: 好的。旅途愉快。 [hao de 。 lv tu yu kuai 。]

english: Hi! I have this money-off voucher!
translation: 你好！这张优惠券我有！ [ni hao ！ zhe zhang you hui quan wo you ！]

english: So I see! Unfortunately, it seems to have expired yesterday! Nevermind.
translation: 所以我明白了！可惜昨天好像就过期了！没关系。 [suo yi wo ming bai le ！ ke xi zuo tian hao xiang jiu guo qi le ！ mei guan xi 。]

english: But I only just got it!
translation: 但我才刚刚得到它！ [dan wo cai gang gang de dao ta ！]

english: I'm sorry, there's nothing I can do.
translation: 对不起，我无能为力。 [dui bu qi ， wo wu neng wei li 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: What do you know about Ali Morrisane?
translation: 你对阿里·莫里森了解多少？ [ni dui a li · mo li sen liao jie duo shao ？]

english: I know that one of his thugs has threatened to ruin my store if I don't cooperate with them!
translation: 我知道他的一个暴徒威胁说如果我不与他们合作就毁掉我的商店！ [wo zhi dao ta de yi ge bao tu wei xie shuo ru guo wo bu yu ta men he zuo jiu hui diao wo de shang dian ！]

english: He said he was a tailor, but those scissors looked more like a weapon than something used for Crafting.
translation: 他说他是一名裁缝，但那些剪刀看起来更像是武器而不是用于制作的东西。 [ta shuo ta shi yi ming cai feng ， dan na xie jian dao kan qi lai geng xiang shi wu qi er bu shi yong yu zhi zuo de dong xi 。]

english: What are you going to do, then?
translation: 那你要做什么？ [na ni yao zuo shen me ？]

english: As long as I have my store, I'll keep selling my Crafting equipment! Would you like to buy any?
translation: 只要我还有我的商店，我就会继续销售我的制作装备！您想购买吗？ [zhi yao wo hai you wo de shang dian ， wo jiu hui ji xu xiao shou wo de zhi zuo zhuang bei ！ nin xiang gou mai ma ？]

english: No thanks; I've got all the Crafting equipment I need.
translation: 不，谢谢;我已经拥有了我需要的所有制作设备。 [bu ， xie xie ; wo yi jing yong you le wo xu yao de suo you zhi zuo she bei 。]

english: Let's see what you've got, then.
translation: 那么让我们看看你有什么。 [na me rang wo men kan kan ni you shen me 。]

english: What do you know about Ali Morrisane?
translation: 你对阿里·莫里森了解多少？ [ni dui a li · mo li sen liao jie duo shao ？]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Not infected are you?
translation: 你没有被感染吧？ [ni mei you bei gan ran ba ？]

english: I don't think so.
translation: 我不这么认为。 [wo bu zhe me ren wei 。]

english: You don't seem very sure. We don't want any infected near the children. Be off with you!
translation: 你看起来不太确定。我们不希望孩子们附近有任何感染者。跟你走吧！ [ni kan qi lai bu tai que ding 。 wo men bu xi wang hai zi men fu jin you ren he gan ran zhe 。 gen ni zou ba ！]

english: Whatever it is you're selling, we ain't interested!
translation: 不管你卖什么，我们都不感兴趣！ [bu guan ni mai shen me ， wo men dou bu gan xing qu ！]

english: But I'm not...
translation: 但我不是... [dan wo bu shi ...]

english: Did you not hear me? Clear off!
translation: 你没听到我说话吗？走开！ [ni mei ting dao wo shuo hua ma ？ zou kai ！]

english: ...(Don't Know What silently lets you in.)
translation: ...（不知道什么悄悄地让你进来。） [...（ bu zhi dao shen me qiao qiao di rang ni jin lai 。）]

english: Player enters Weiss
translation: 玩家进入Weiss [wan jia jin ru Weiss]

english: ...(Don't Know What silently lets you out.)
translation: ...（不知道什么悄悄地让你出去。） [...（ bu zhi dao shen me qiao qiao di rang ni chu qu 。）]

english: Player exits Weiss
translation: 球员退出韦斯 [qiu yuan tui chu wei si]

english: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？ [ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Just wondering if you were still here.
translation: 只是想知道你是否还在这里。 [zhi shi xiang zhi dao ni shi fou hai zai zhe li 。]

english: Of course I'm still here.
translation: 当然我还在这里。 [dang ran wo hai zai zhe li 。]

english: I'm not going near that crack in the wall again.
translation: 我不会再靠近那条墙上的裂缝了。 [wo bu hui zai kao jin na tiao qiang shang de lie feng le 。]

english: Rock falls and so on are fine, but sea monsters in caves - never!
translation: 岩石瀑布等都很好，但洞穴里的海怪——绝对不行！ [yan shi pu bu deng dou hen hao ， dan dong xue li de hai guai —— jue dui bu xing ！]

english: What are you doing down in these caves?
translation: 你在这些山洞里做什么？ [ni zai zhe xie shan dong li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm waiting to work on the excavations...
translation: 我正在等待挖掘工作...... [wo zheng zai deng dai wa jue gong zuo ......]

english: ...though I don't really want to start digging again.
translation: ...虽然我真的不想再次开始挖掘。 [... sui ran wo zhen de bu xiang zai ci kai shi wa jue 。]

english: Why not? I thought digging was something dwarves were good at.
translation: 为什么不呢？我以为挖掘是矮人擅长的事情。 [wei shen me bu ne ？ wo yi wei wa jue shi ai ren shan chang de shi qing 。]

english: Not with monsters like that one in those caves.
translation: 那些洞穴里的怪物就不是这样的。 [na xie dong xue li de guai wu jiu bu shi zhe yang de 。]

english: It had huge teeth and flaming red eyes, and was almost the size of the tunnel!
translation: 它有着巨大的牙齿和火红色的眼睛，几乎有隧道那么大！ [ta you zhe ju da de ya chi he huo hong se de yan jing ， ji hu you sui dao na me da ！]

english: If it attacks the town...
translation: 如果它攻击城镇的话... [ru guo ta gong ji cheng zhen de hua ...]

english: Are you an adventurer, by any chance?
translation: 你是冒险家吗？ [ni shi mao xian jia ma ？]

english: Adventurer and Regent of Miscellania.
translation: 冒险家兼米塞拉尼亚摄政王。 [mao xian jia jian mi sai la ni ya she zheng wang 。]

english: In that case, could you go and deal with that monster?
translation: 既然如此，你能去对付那个怪物吗？ [ji ran ru ci ， ni neng qu dui fu na ge guai wu ma ？]

english: I don't want to have to face it again if it attacks the town.
translation: 如果它袭击了城镇，我不想再次面对它。 [ru guo ta xi ji le cheng zhen ， wo bu xiang zai ci mian dui ta 。]

english: Of course. Dealing with monsters is what I do best!
translation: 当然。对付怪物是我最擅长的！ [dang ran 。 dui fu guai wu shi wo zui shan chang de ！]

english: You'll need to get into the other caves first, of course.
translation: 当然，你需要先进入其他洞穴。 [dang ran ， ni xu yao xian jin ru qi ta dong xue 。]

english: There's a crack in the wall where the others are digging, but the rocks are loose, and can fall on you if you're not careful.
translation: 其他人正在挖掘的地方墙上有一条裂缝，但岩石是松动的，如果你不小心，可能会掉到你身上。 [qi ta ren zheng zai wa jue de di fang qiang shang you yi tiao lie feng ， dan yan shi shi song dong de ， ru guo ni bu xiao xin ， ke neng hui diao dao ni shen shang 。]

english: I can give you a mining prop to keep them from falling, if you give me a minute to find it...
translation: 我可以给你一个采矿道具来防止它们掉落，如果你给我一分钟时间找到它...... [wo ke yi gei ni yi ge cai kuang dao ju lai fang zhi ta men diao luo ， ru guo ni gei wo yi fen zhong shi jian zhao dao ta ......]

english: Okay, so all I have to do is get through that wall?
translation: 好吧，那么我所要做的就是穿过那堵墙？ [hao ba ， na me wo suo yao zuo de jiu shi chuan guo na du qiang ？]

english: No, after that the only way you can get further is climbing up onto a high ledge, then crawling through a tunnel.
translation: 不，在那之后你能走得更远的唯一方法就是爬上高高的壁架，然后爬过隧道。 [bu ， zai na zhi hou ni neng zou de geng yuan de wei yi fang fa jiu shi pa shang gao gao de bi jia ， ran hou pa guo sui dao 。]

english: But the walls are slippery...
translation: 不过墙很滑... [bu guo qiang hen hua ...]

english: ...and I think I might have broken the lift when I fell off it on my way back.
translation: ......我想我可能在回来的路上从电梯上摔下来时弄坏了电梯。 [...... wo xiang wo ke neng zai hui lai de lu shang cong dian ti shang shuai xia lai shi nong huai le dian ti 。]

english: You'll probably need to fix the lift - I doubt you'd be able to climb.
translation: 你可能需要修理电梯——我怀疑你能否爬上去。 [ni ke neng xu yao xiu li dian ti —— wo huai yi ni neng fou pa shang qu 。]

english: And the monster's behind that tunnel?
translation: 那个怪物就在隧道后面？ [na ge guai wu jiu zai sui dao hou mian ？]

english: Somewhere behind it. I couldn't get very far, what with the flooding in the tunnel.
translation: 在它后面的某个地方。由于隧道里洪水泛滥，我无法走多远。 [zai ta hou mian de mou ge di fang 。 you yu sui dao li hong shui fan lan ， wo wu fa zou duo yuan 。]

english: There's some rope and some planks near the broken lift - those would probably come in handy.
translation: 破损的电梯附近有一些绳子和一些木板——这些可能会派上用场。 [po sun de dian ti fu jin you yi xie sheng zi he yi xie mu ban —— zhe xie ke neng hui pai shang yong chang 。]

english: Ah, here's that mining prop. I knew I had it somewhere.
translation: 啊，这是采矿道具。我知道我在某个地方有它。 [a ， zhe shi cai kuang dao ju 。 wo zhi dao wo zai mou ge di fang you ta 。]

english: Here you go. Good luck with fighting that monster.
translation: 干得好。祝你好运，与那个怪物战斗。 [gan de hao 。 zhu ni hao yun ， yu na ge guai wu zhan dou 。]

english: Why bother? It can't get through solid rock.
translation: 何苦呢？它无法穿过坚硬的岩石。 [he ku ne ？ ta wu fa chuan guo jian ying de yan shi 。]

english: That's what I thought, until I saw the sheer size of it. This thing probably MADE the tunnels!
translation: 我就是这么想的，直到我看到它的巨大规模。这东西可能造出了隧道！ [wo jiu shi zhe me xiang de ， zhi dao wo kan dao ta de ju da gui mo 。 zhe dong xi ke neng zao chu le sui dao ！]

english: And you're sending me in to deal with it alone?
translation: 你还派我一个人去处理这件事？ [ni hai pai wo yi ge ren qu chu li zhe jian shi ？]

english: I've heard stories from the Miscellanians. If you're the Regent, you must be quite a strong hero.
translation: 我听过杂记家的故事。如果你是摄政王，那你一定是一位相当强大的英雄。 [wo ting guo za ji jia de gu shi 。 ru guo ni shi she zheng wang ， na ni yi ding shi yi wei xiang dang qiang da de ying xiong 。]

english: So what are you worried about? You probably eat monsters like that for breakfast!
translation: 那么你担心什么呢？你早餐可能会吃那样的怪物！ [na me ni dan xin shen me ne ？ ni zao can ke neng hui chi na yang de guai wu ！]

english: I wouldn't put it quite like that...
translation: 我不会这么说... [wo bu hui zhe me shuo ...]

english: But I'll help you after all. Now, how do I find this monster?
translation: 但我终究会帮助你的。现在，我该如何找到这个怪物呢？ [dan wo zhong jiu hui bang zhu ni de 。 xian zai ， wo gai ru he zhao dao zhe ge guai wu ne ？]

english: Of course. Dealing with monsters is what I do best!
translation: 当然。对付怪物是我最擅长的！ [dang ran 。 dui fu guai wu shi wo zui shan chang de ！]

english: Why bother? It can't get through solid rock.
translation: 何苦呢？它无法穿过坚硬的岩石。 [he ku ne ？ ta wu fa chuan guo jian ying de yan shi 。]

english: How are you doing, Dondakan?
translation: 你好吗，唐达坎？ [ni hao ma ， tang da kan ？]

english: Oh, just fine, just fine! This gold is certainly creating a steady flow of income for me! After the company takes some of the cut, of course.
translation: 哦，刚刚好，刚刚好！这些黄金无疑为我创造了源源不断的收入！当然，在公司获得部分分成之后。 [o ， gang gang hao ， gang gang hao ！ zhe xie huang jin wu yi wei wo chuang zao le yuan yuan bu duan de shou ru ！ dang ran ， zai gong si huo de bu fen fen cheng zhi hou 。]

english: Can you shoot me into the rock again?
translation: 你能再把我射进岩石里吗？ [ni neng zai ba wo she jin yan shi li ma ？]

english: You need to wear that golden helmet... unless you want to crack open your skull on the rock.
translation: 你需要戴上那顶金色头盔……除非你想在岩石上敲开你的头骨。 [ni xu yao dai shang na ding jin se tou kui …… chu fei ni xiang zai yan shi shang qiao kai ni de tou gu 。]

english: Of course, just a second, let me adjust my cannon again.
translation: 当然，请稍等，让我再次调整我的大炮。 [dang ran ， qing shao deng ， rang wo zai ci tiao zheng wo de da pao 。]

english: Say, are you selling those boots of yours?
translation: 话说，你卖你那双靴子吗？ [hua shuo ， ni mai ni na shuang xue zi ma ？]

english: What, you mean these granite boots?
translation: 什么，你是说这些花岗岩靴子吗？ [shen me ， ni shi shuo zhe xie hua gang yan xue zi ma ？]

english: Yes, I'd be happy to pay quite some money for them!
translation: 是的，我很乐意为它们付很多钱！ [shi de ， wo hen le yi wei ta men fu hen duo qian ！]

english: Haha, I bet you would, I bet you would!
translation: 哈哈，我打赌你会的，我打赌你会的！ [ha ha ， wo da du ni hui de ， wo da du ni hui de ！]

english: But I no longer need the money, this rock is generating plenty!
translation: 但我不再需要钱了，这块石头可以产生足够的钱！ [dan wo bu zai xu yao qian le ， zhe kuai shi tou ke yi chan sheng zu gou de qian ！]

english: Besides, I'm rather fond of them now... best boots I ever had!
translation: 此外，我现在很喜欢它们……我拥有过的最好的靴子！ [ci wai ， wo xian zai hen xi huan ta men …… wo yong you guo de zui hao de xue zi ！]

english: Oh please...
translation: 哦，请... [o ， qing ...]

english: No, I won't sell them.
translation: 不，我不会卖掉它们。 [bu ， wo bu hui mai diao ta men 。]

english: Pretty please?
translation: 请问漂亮吗？ [qing wen piao liang ma ？]

english: No!
translation: 不！ [bu ！]

english: Oh come on!!!
translation: 哦来吧！！！ [o lai ba ！！！]

english: Well...
translation: 出色地... [chu se di ...]

english: Yes?
translation: 是的？ [shi de ？]

english: How much gold would you be willing to pay for it? Not that I'm selling my boots, mind, I'm just curious.
translation: 您愿意为此支付多少黄金？请注意，我并不是在卖靴子，我只是好奇。 [nin yuan yi wei ci zhi fu duo shao huang jin ？ qing zhu yi ， wo bing bu shi zai mai xue zi ， wo zhi shi hao qi 。]

english: What, are you trying to scam old Dondakan? You want me to sell these boots for a measly [number] coins?
translation: 什么，你想欺骗老唐达坎吗？你想让我以微不足道的[数字]个硬币卖掉这些靴子吗？ [shen me ， ni xiang qi pian lao tang da kan ma ？ ni xiang rang wo yi wei bu zu dao de [ shu zi ] ge ying bi mai diao zhe xie xue zi ma ？]

english: I'm not selling them anyway.
translation: 无论如何我不会卖它们。 [wu lun ru he wo bu hui mai ta men 。]

english: You're so poor, you don't even have that much gold on you...
translation: 你太穷了，身上连那么多金子都没有…… [ni tai qiong le ， shen shang lian na me duo jin zi dou mei you ……]

english: If I were selling my granite boots, which I'm clearly not, I would certainly not accept a mere [number] coins for them.
translation: 如果我要卖我的花岗岩靴子（我显然不是），我肯定不会只接受[数量]个硬币。 [ru guo wo yao mai wo de hua gang yan xue zi （ wo xian ran bu shi ）， wo ken ding bu hui zhi jie shou [ shu liang ] ge ying bi 。]

english: That's quite a sum of money, which I notice you don't even have on you.
translation: 那可是一大笔钱，我发现你身上根本就没有。 [na ke shi yi da bi qian ， wo fa xian ni shen shang gen ben jiu mei you 。]

english: Haha, nice try [player name]!
translation: 哈哈，不错的尝试[玩家名字]！ [ha ha ， bu cuo de chang shi [ wan jia ming zi ]！]

english: Pity I'm not selling my boots, not for any price or any item.
translation: 遗憾的是，我不会以任何价格或任何物品出售我的靴子。 [yi han de shi ， wo bu hui yi ren he jia ge huo ren he wu pin chu shou wo de xue zi 。]

english: I just wanted to see how high you would go!
translation: 我只是想看看你能达到多高！ [wo zhi shi xiang kan kan ni neng da dao duo gao ！]

english: Bah, thanks a lot.
translation: 呸，非常感谢。 [pei ， fei chang gan xie 。]

english: Hey, that's quite a bit of money. Which you don't have on you. Oh well, I wasn't selling my boots anyway.
translation: 嘿，这可是不少钱啊。你身上没有的。哦，好吧，反正我没有卖我的靴子。 [hei ， zhe ke shi bu shao qian a 。 ni shen shang mei you de 。 o ， hao ba ， fan zheng wo mei you mai wo de xue zi 。]

english: Never mind, I don't want them anymore.
translation: 没关系，我不再想要它们了。 [mei guan xi ， wo bu zai xiang yao ta men le 。]

english: Great, because I don't want to sell them.
translation: 太好了，因为我不想卖掉它们。 [tai hao le ， yin wei wo bu xiang mai diao ta men 。]

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。 [hao de 。]

english: Right.
translation: 正确的。 [zheng que de 。]

english: Check these out.
translation: 检查这些。 [jian cha zhe xie 。]

english: Where'd you get those from? Did you make your own?
translation: 你从哪里得到这些？你自己做的吗？ [ni cong na li de dao zhe xie ？ ni zi ji zuo de ma ？]

english: Not quite, they were retrieved from the corpse of a wyvern.
translation: 不完全是，它们是从双足飞龙的尸体中取出的。 [bu wan quan shi ， ta men shi cong shuang zu fei long de shi ti zhong qu chu de 。]

english: You killed a wyvern? Last I heard they were all dead.
translation: 你杀了飞龙？最后我听说他们都死了。 [ni sha le fei long ？ zui hou wo ting shuo ta men dou si le 。]

english: I never said I killed it! But perhaps I did, I am a grand adventureafter all!
translation: 我从来没有说过我杀了它！但也许我做到了，毕竟我是一个伟大的冒险家！ [wo cong lai mei you shuo guo wo sha le ta ！ dan ye xu wo zuo dao le ， bi jing wo shi yi ge wei da de mao xian jia ！]

english: Oh dear, oh dear. It seems firing you head first into a rock was perhaps not the best idea, you've gone absolutely loony.
translation: 哦亲爱的，哦亲爱的。看来把你的头朝石头里开枪也许不是最好的主意，你已经完全疯了。 [o qin ai de ， o qin ai de 。 kan lai ba ni de tou chao shi tou li kai qiang ye xu bu shi zui hao de zhu yi ， ni yi jing wan quan feng le 。]

english: Hmm, well you do have a point...
translation: 嗯，你说的确实有道理…… [n ， ni shuo di que shi you dao li ……]

english: It's alright Laddie, I'm just joking.
translation: 没关系，莱迪，我只是开玩笑。 [mei guan xi ， lai di ， wo zhi shi kai wan xiao 。]

english: That's great, but I have to go now.
translation: 太好了，但我现在得走了。 [tai hao le ， dan wo xian zai de zou le 。]

english: Come back any time!
translation: 随时回来！ [sui shi hui lai ！]

english: I don't want anything from you right now.
translation: 我现在不想从你那里得到任何东西。 [wo xian zai bu xiang cong ni na li de dao ren he dong xi 。]

english: Can you shoot me into the rock again?
translation: 你能再把我射进岩石里吗？ [ni neng zai ba wo she jin yan shi li ma ？]

english: Are you selling those boots of yours?
translation: 你卖你那双靴子吗？ [ni mai ni na shuang xue zi ma ？]

english: Oh please...
translation: 哦，请... [o ， qing ...]

english: Never mind, I don't want them anymore.
translation: 没关系，我不再想要它们了。 [mei guan xi ， wo bu zai xiang yao ta men le 。]

english: That's great, but I have to go.
translation: 太好了，但我得走了。 [tai hao le ， dan wo de zou le 。]

english: Hello there, can I help you?
translation: 您好，请问有什么可以帮到您吗？ [nin hao ， qing wen you shen me ke yi bang dao nin ma ？]

english: Where am I?
translation: 我在哪里？ [wo zai na li ？]

english: This is the town of Lumbridge my friend.
translation: 我的朋友，这是伦布里奇镇。 [wo de peng you ， zhe shi lun bu li qi zhen 。]

english: How are you today?
translation: 你今天怎么样？ [ni jin tian zen me yang ？]

english: Aye, not too bad thank you. Lovely weather in Gielinor this fine day.
translation: 是的，还不错，谢谢。今天吉林诺天气很好。 [shi de ， hai bu cuo ， xie xie 。 jin tian ji lin nuo tian qi hen hao 。]

english: Weather?
translation: 天气？ [tian qi ？]

english: Yes weather, you know.
translation: 是的，天气，你知道。 [shi de ， tian qi ， ni zhi dao 。]

english: The state or condition of the atmosphere at a time and place, with respect to variables such as temperature, moisture, wind velocity, and barometric pressure.
translation: 某个时间和地点的大气状态或条件，涉及温度、湿度、风速和气压等变量。 [mou ge shi jian he di dian de da qi zhuang tai huo tiao jian ， she ji wen du 、 shi du 、 feng su he qi ya deng bian liang 。]

english: Not just a pretty face eh? Ha ha ha.
translation: 不只是一张漂亮的脸蛋吧？哈哈哈。 [bu zhi shi yi zhang piao liang de lian dan ba ？ ha ha ha 。]

english: Do you know of any quests I can do?
translation: 你知道我可以做哪些任务吗？ [ni zhi dao wo ke yi zuo na xie ren wu ma ？]

english: What kind of quest are you looking for?
translation: 您在寻找什么样的任务？ [nin zai xun zhao shen me yang de ren wu ？]

english: Hmm.. dangerous you say? What sort of creatures are you looking to fight?
translation: 嗯..你说危险吗？你想与什么样的生物战斗？ [n .. ni shuo wei xian ma ？ ni xiang yu shen me yang de sheng wu zhan dou ？]

english: Big scary demons!
translation: 可怕的大恶魔！ [ke pa de da e mo ！]

english: You are a brave soul indeed.
translation: 你确实是一个勇敢的灵魂。 [ni que shi shi yi ge yong gan de ling hun 。]

english: Now that you mention it, I heard a rumour about a fortune-teller in Varrock who is rambling about some kind of greater evil.. sounds demon-like if you ask me.
translation: 既然你提到了，我听到了一个关于瓦罗克的算命师的谣言，他正在散布某种更大的邪恶……如果你问我的话，听起来就像恶魔一样。 [ji ran ni ti dao le ， wo ting dao le yi ge guan yu wa luo ke de suan ming shi de yao yan ， ta zheng zai san bu mou zhong geng da de xie e …… ru guo ni wen wo de hua ， ting qi lai jiu xiang e mo yi yang 。]

english: Perhaps you could check it out if you are as brave as you say?
translation: 如果你像你说的那么勇敢的话，也许你可以去看看？ [ru guo ni xiang ni shuo de na me yong gan de hua ， ye xu ni ke yi qu kan kan ？]

english: Thanks for the tip, perhaps I will.
translation: 谢谢你的提示，也许我会的。 [xie xie ni de ti shi ， ye xu wo hui de 。]

english: I've already killed the demon Delrith. He was merely a stain on my sword when I was finished with him!
translation: 我已经杀死了恶魔德里斯。当我和他结束时，他只是我剑上的一个污点！ [wo yi jing sha si le e mo de li si 。 dang wo he ta jie shu shi ， ta zhi shi wo jian shang de yi ge wu dian ！]

english: Well done! However I'm sure if you search around the world you will find more challenging foes to slay.
translation: 干得好！然而，我确信如果你环游世界，你会发现更具挑战性的敌人来杀死。 [gan de hao ！ ran er ， wo que xin ru guo ni huan you shi jie ， ni hui fa xian geng ju tiao zhan xing de di ren lai sha si 。]

english: Vampyres!
translation: 吸血鬼！ [xi xue gui ！]

english: Ha ha. I personally don't believe in such things. However, there is a man in Draynor Village who has been scaring the village folk with stories of vampyres.
translation: 哈哈。我个人不相信这样的事情。然而，德拉诺村里有一个人，他一直用吸血鬼的故事来吓唬村民。 [ha ha 。 wo ge ren bu xiang xin zhe yang de shi qing 。 ran er ， de la nuo cun li you yi ge ren ， ta yi zhi yong xi xue gui de gu shi lai xia hu cun min 。]

english: He's named Morgan and can be found in one of the village houses. Perhaps you could see what the matter is?
translation: 他的名字叫摩根，可以在其中一栋村屋里找到他。或许你能看出问题出在哪里？ [ta de ming zi jiao mo gen ， ke yi zai qi zhong yi dong cun wu li zhao dao ta 。 huo xu ni neng kan chu wen ti chu zai na li ？]

english: Thanks for the tip.
translation: 谢谢你的提示。 [xie xie ni de ti shi 。]

english: Oh I have already killed that nasty blood-sucking vampyre. Draynor will be safe now.
translation: 哦，我已经杀了那个可恶的吸血吸血鬼了。德雷诺现在安全了。 [o ， wo yi jing sha le na ge ke wu de xi xue xi xue gui le 。 de lei nuo xian zai an quan le 。]

english: Yeah, yeah of course you did. Everyone knows vampyres are not real....
translation: 是的，是的，你当然这么做了。大家都知道吸血鬼不是真的...... [shi de ， shi de ， ni dang ran zhe me zuo le 。 da jia dou zhi dao xi xue gui bu shi zhen de ......]

english: What! I did slay the beast..I really did.
translation: 什么！我确实杀死了野兽……我真的做到了。 [shen me ！ wo que shi sha si le ye shou …… wo zhen de zuo dao le 。]

english: You're not fooling anyone you know.
translation: 你不会欺骗任何你认识的人。 [ni bu hui qi pian ren he ni ren shi de ren 。]

english: ..Huh.. But... Hey! I did... believe what you like.
translation: ..嗯..但是...嘿！我确实...相信你喜欢的。 [.. n .. dan shi ... hei ！ wo que shi ... xiang xin ni xi huan de 。]

english: Small.. something small would be good.
translation: 小..小东西就好了。 [xiao .. xiao dong xi jiu hao le 。]

english: Small? Small isn't really that dangerous though is it?
translation: 小的？虽然小，但其实并没有那么危险，不是吗？ [xiao de ？ sui ran xiao ， dan qi shi bing mei you na me wei xian ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Yes it can be! There could be anything from an evil chicken to a poisonous spider. They attack in numbers you know!
translation: 是的，可以！可能有任何东西，从邪恶的鸡到毒蜘蛛。他们的攻击数量你知道！ [shi de ， ke yi ！ ke neng you ren he dong xi ， cong xie e de ji dao du zhi zhu 。 ta men de gong ji shu liang ni zhi dao ！]

english: Yes ok, point taken. Speaking of small monsters, I hear old Wizard Mizgog in the wizards' tower has just had all his beads taken by a gang of mischievous imps.
translation: 是的，好的，已采纳。说到小怪物，我听说巫师塔里的老巫师米兹戈格刚刚被一群淘气的小鬼夺走了所有的珠子。 [shi de ， hao de ， yi cai na 。 shuo dao xiao guai wu ， wo ting shuo wu shi ta li de lao wu shi mi zi ge ge gang gang bei yi qun tao qi de xiao gui duo zou le suo you de zhu zi 。]

english: Sounds like it could be a quest for you?
translation: 听起来这对你来说可能是一个任务？ [ting qi lai zhe dui ni lai shuo ke neng shi yi ge ren wu ？]

english: Thanks for your help.
translation: 感谢您的帮助。 [gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]

english: Yes I know of Mizgog and have already helped him with his imp problem. It took me ages to find those beads!
translation: 是的，我知道米兹戈格，并且已经帮助他解决了小鬼的问题。我花了很长时间才找到那些珠子！ [shi de ， wo zhi dao mi zi ge ge ， bing qie yi jing bang zhu ta jie jue le xiao gui de wen ti 。 wo hua le hen zhang shi jian cai zhao dao na xie zhu zi ！]

english: Imps will be imps!
translation: 小鬼将是小鬼！ [xiao gui jiang shi xiao gui ！]

english: Maybe another time.
translation: 也许下次吧。 [ye xu xia ci ba 。]

english: Something easy please, I'm new here.
translation: 请简单一点，我是新来的。 [qing jian dan yi dian ， wo shi xin lai de 。]

english: I can tell you about plenty of small easy tasks.
translation: 我可以告诉你很多简单的小任务。 [wo ke yi gao su ni hen duo jian dan de xiao ren wu 。]

english: The Lumbridge cook has been having problems, the Duke is confused over some strange talisman and on top of all that, poor lad Romeo in Varrock has girlfriend problems.
translation: 朗布里奇的厨师遇到了问题，公爵对一些奇怪的护身符感到困惑，最重要的是，瓦罗克的可怜的罗密欧小伙子有女朋友的问题。 [lang bu li qi de chu shi yu dao le wen ti ， gong jue dui yi xie qi guai de hu shen fu gan dao kun huo ， zui zhong yao de shi ， wa luo ke de ke lian de luo mi ou xiao huo zi you nv peng you de wen ti 。]

english: Tell me about the Lumbridge cook.
translation: 告诉我关于伦布里奇厨师的事。 [gao su wo guan yu lun bu li qi chu shi de shi 。]

english: It's funny really, the cook would forget his head if it wasn't screwed on. This time he forgot to get ingredients for the Duke's birthday cake.
translation: 真的很有趣，如果不拧紧，厨师就会忘记他的头。这次他忘记去拿公爵生日蛋糕的材料了。 [zhen de hen you qu ， ru guo bu ning jin ， chu shi jiu hui wang ji ta de tou 。 zhe ci ta wang ji qu na gong jue sheng ri dan gao de cai liao le 。]

english: Perhaps you could help him? You will probably find him in the Lumbridge Castle kitchen.
translation: 也许你可以帮助他？您可能会在朗布里奇城堡的厨房里找到他。 [ye xu ni ke yi bang zhu ta ？ nin ke neng hui zai lang bu li qi cheng bao de chu fang li zhao dao ta 。]

english: Thank you. I shall go speak with him.
translation: 谢谢。我去跟他谈谈。 [xie xie 。 wo qu gen ta tan tan 。]

english: I have already helped the cook in Lumbridge.
translation: 我已经帮过朗布里奇的厨师了。 [wo yi jing bang guo lang bu li qi de chu shi le 。]

english: Oh yes, so you have. I am sure the Duke will be pleased.
translation: 哦，是的，所以你有。我相信公爵会很高兴。 [o ， shi de ， suo yi ni you 。 wo xiang xin gong jue hui hen gao xing 。]

english: Tell me about the Duke's strange talisman.
translation: 告诉我关于公爵的奇怪护身符的事。 [gao su wo guan yu gong jue de qi guai hu shen fu de shi 。]

english: Well the Duke of Lumbridge has found a strange talisman that no one seems to understand. Perhaps you could help him? You can probably find him upstairs in Lumbridge Castle.
translation: 朗布里奇公爵发现了一种似乎没有人理解的奇怪护身符。也许你可以帮助他？你也许可以在朗布里奇城堡的楼上找到他。 [lang bu li qi gong jue fa xian le yi zhong si hu mei you ren li jie de qi guai hu shen fu 。 ye xu ni ke yi bang zhu ta ？ ni ye xu ke yi zai lang bu li qi cheng bao de lou shang zhao dao ta 。]

english: Sounds mysterious. I may just do that. Thanks.
translation: 听起来很神秘。我可能就这么做了。谢谢。 [ting qi lai hen shen mi 。 wo ke neng jiu zhe me zuo le 。 xie xie 。]

english: Yes, I have already solved the Rune mysteries.
translation: 是的，我已经解开了符文之谜。 [shi de ， wo yi jing jie kai le fu wen zhi mi 。]

english: Ah excellent. Thank you very much adventurer.
translation: 啊，太棒了。非常感谢冒险家。 [a ， tai bang le 。 fei chang gan xie mao xian jia 。]

english: Tell me about Romeo and his girlfriend please.
translation: 请告诉我关于罗密欧和他女朋友的事。 [qing gao su wo guan yu luo mi ou he ta nv peng you de shi 。]

english: Romeo in Varrock needs help with finding his beloved Juliet, you may be able to help him out.
translation: 瓦罗克的罗密欧需要帮助寻找他心爱的朱丽叶，你也许可以帮助他。 [wa luo ke de luo mi ou xu yao bang zhu xun zhao ta xin ai de zhu li ye ， ni ye xu ke yi bang zhu ta 。]

english: Unless of course you manage to find Juliet first in which case she has probably lost Romeo.
translation: 当然，除非你先找到朱丽叶，否则她可能已经失去了罗密欧。 [dang ran ， chu fei ni xian zhao dao zhu li ye ， fou ze ta ke neng yi jing shi qu le luo mi ou 。]

english: Right, ok. Romeo is in Varrock?
translation: 对吧，好吧。罗密欧在瓦罗克？ [dui ba ， hao ba 。 luo mi ou zai wa luo ke ？]

english: Yes you can't miss him, he's wandering aimlessly in the square.
translation: 是的，你不会错过他的，他正在广场上漫无目的地闲逛。 [shi de ， ni bu hui cuo guo ta de ， ta zheng zai guang chang shang man wu mu di di xian guang 。]

english: Oh yes, I've already helped Romeo in the best possible way I can...
translation: 哦，是的，我已经尽我所能帮助罗密欧了…… [o ， shi de ， wo yi jing jin wo suo neng bang zhu luo mi ou le ……]

english: Really?
translation: 真的吗？ [zhen de ma ？]

english: Yup.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: ...How?
He thinks Juliet is dead...
translation: 他认为朱丽叶已经死了…… [ta ren wei zhu li ye yi jing si le ……]

english: Well.. ok.. well done... I think...
translation: 嗯..好吧..干得好...我想... [n .. hao ba .. gan de hao ... wo xiang ...]

english: I'm a thinker rather than fighter, anything skill orientated?
translation: 我是一个思想家而不是战士，有什么以技能为导向的吗？ [wo shi yi ge si xiang jia er bu shi zhan shi ， you shen me yi ji neng wei dao xiang de ma ？]

english: Skills play a big part when you want to progress in knowledge throughout Gielinor. I know of a few skill- related quests that can get you started.
translation: 当您想在 Gielinor 的知识中取得进步时，技能发挥着重要作用。我知道一些与技能相关的任务可以帮助你入门。 [dang nin xiang zai  Gielinor  de zhi shi zhong qu de jin bu shi ， ji neng fa hui zhuo zhong yao zuo yong 。 wo zhi dao yi xie yu ji neng xiang guan de ren wu ke yi bang zhu ni ru men 。]

english: You may be able to help out Fred the farmer who is in need of someones crafting expertise.
translation: 您也许可以帮助需要手工专业知识的农民弗雷德。 [nin ye xu ke yi bang zhu xu yao shou gong zhuan ye zhi shi de nong min fu lei de 。]

english: Or, there's always Doric the dwarf who needs an errand running for him?
translation: 或者，矮人多里克总是需要为他办事？ [huo zhe ， ai ren duo li ke zong shi xu yao wei ta ban shi ？]

english: Tell me about Fred the farmer please.
translation: 请告诉我关于农民弗雷德的事。 [qing gao su wo guan yu nong min fu lei de de shi 。]

english: You can find Fred next to the field of sheep in Lumbridge. Perhaps you should go and speak with him.
translation: 您可以在朗布里奇的羊场旁边找到弗雷德。也许你应该去和他谈谈。 [nin ke yi zai lang bu li qi de yang chang pang bian zhao dao fu lei de 。 ye xu ni ying gai qu he ta tan tan 。]

english: Thanks, maybe I will.
translation: 谢谢，也许我会的。 [xie xie ， ye xu wo hui de 。]

english: I have already helped Fred the farmer. I sheared his sheep and made 20 balls of wool for him.
translation: 我已经帮助过农夫弗雷德了。我给他剪了羊毛，还给他做了20个羊毛球。 [wo yi jing bang zhu guo nong fu fu lei de le 。 wo gei ta jian le yang mao ， huan gei ta zuo le 20 ge yang mao qiu 。]

english: He wouldn't let me kill his chickens though.
translation: 但他不让我杀他的鸡。 [dan ta bu rang wo sha ta de ji 。]

english: Lumbridge chickens do make good target practice.
translation: 伦布里奇鸡确实能进行良好的打靶练习。 [lun bu li qi ji que shi neng jin xing liang hao de da ba lian xi 。]

english: You will have to wait until he isn't looking.
translation: 你必须等到他不看为止。 [ni bi xu deng dao ta bu kan wei zhi 。]

english: Tell me about Doric the dwarf.
translation: 告诉我关于矮人多立克的事情。 [gao su wo guan yu ai ren duo li ke de shi qing 。]

english: Doric the dwarf is located north of Falador. He might be able to help you with smithing. You should speak to him. He may let you use his anvils.
translation: 矮人多立克柱位于法拉多以北。他也许可以帮助你锻造。你应该和他谈谈。他可能会让你使用他的铁砧。 [ai ren duo li ke zhu wei yu fa la duo yi bei 。 ta ye xu ke yi bang zhu ni duan zao 。 ni ying gai he ta tan tan 。 ta ke neng hui rang ni shi yong ta de tie zhen 。]

english: Yes, I've been to see Doric already. He was happy to let me use his anvils after I ran a small errand for him.
translation: 是的，我已经去过多里克了。在我帮他办了一件小事后，他很高兴让我使用他的铁砧。 [shi de ， wo yi jing qu guo duo li ke le 。 zai wo bang ta ban le yi jian xiao shi hou ， ta hen gao xing rang wo shi yong ta de tie zhen 。]

english: Oh good, Thank you [player name]!
translation: 哦，太好了，谢谢你[玩家姓名]！ [o ， tai hao le ， xie xie ni [ wan jia xing ming ]！]

english: I want to do all kinds of things, do you know of anything like that?
translation: 我想做各种各样的事情，你知道类似的事情吗？ [wo xiang zuo ge zhong ge yang de shi qing ， ni zhi dao lei si de shi qing ma ？]

english: Of course I do. Gielinor is a huge place you know, now let me think...
translation: 我当然知道。你知道吉林诺是一个很大的地方，现在让我想想...... [wo dang ran zhi dao 。 ni zhi dao ji lin nuo shi yi ge hen da de di fang ， xian zai rang wo xiang xiang ......]

english: Hetty the witch in Rimmington might be able to offer help in the ways of magical abilities..
translation: 里明顿的女巫海蒂也许能够以魔法能力的方式提供帮助。 [li ming dun de nv wu hai di ye xu neng gou yi mo fa neng li de fang shi ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: Also, pirates are currently docked in Port Sarim, Where pirates are, treasure is never far away...
translation: 而且，海盗目前停靠在沙里姆港，海盗所在的地方，宝藏就离你不远…… [er qie ， hai dao mu qian ting kao zai sha li mu gang ， hai dao suo zai de di fang ， bao zang jiu li ni bu yuan ……]

english: Or you could go help out Ernest who got lost in Draynor Manor, spooky place that.
translation: 或者你可以去帮助在德雷纳庄园迷路的欧内斯特，那是一个令人毛骨悚然的地方。 [huo zhe ni ke yi qu bang zhu zai de lei na zhuang yuan mi lu de ou nei si te ， na shi yi ge ling ren mao gu song ran de di fang 。]

english: Tell me about Hetty the witch.
translation: 告诉我关于女巫海蒂的事。 [gao su wo guan yu nv wu hai di de shi 。]

english: Hetty the witch can be found in Rimmington, south of Falador. She's currently working on some new potions. Perhaps you could give her a hand? She might be able to offer help with your magical abilities.
translation: 女巫海蒂位于法拉多以南的里明顿。她目前正在研究一些新药剂。也许你可以帮她一把？她也许能为你的魔法能力提供帮助。 [nv wu hai di wei yu fa la duo yi nan de li ming dun 。 ta mu qian zheng zai yan jiu yi xie xin yao ji 。 ye xu ni ke yi bang ta yi ba ？ ta ye xu neng wei ni de mo fa neng li ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: Ok thanks, let's hope she doesn't turn me into a potato or something..
translation: 好吧，谢谢，希望她不会把我变成土豆之类的。 [hao ba ， xie xie ， xi wang ta bu hui ba wo bian cheng tu dou zhi lei de 。]

english: Yes, I have already been to see Hetty, she gave me super cosmic powers after I helped out with her potion! I could probably destroy you with a single thought!
translation: 是的，我已经去见过海蒂了，在我帮她配药之后，她给了我超强的宇宙力量！说不定我一个念头就能毁了你！ [shi de ， wo yi jing qu jian guo hai di le ， zai wo bang ta pei yao zhi hou ， ta gei le wo chao qiang de yu zhou li liang ！ shuo bu ding wo yi ge nian tou jiu neng hui le ni ！]

english: Did she really?
translation: 她真的吗？ [ta zhen de ma ？]

english: No not really...
translation: 不，不是真的…… [bu ， bu shi zhen de ……]

english: Right.....
translation: 正确的..... [zheng que de .....]

english: Tell me about Pirate's Treasure.
translation: 告诉我关于海盗宝藏的事。 [gao su wo guan yu hai dao bao zang de shi 。]

english: RedBeard Frank in Port Sarim's bar, the Rusty Anchor, might be able to tell you about the rumored treasure that is buried somewhere in Gielinor.
translation: 萨里姆港的酒吧“生锈的锚”中的红胡子弗兰克也许能够告诉您有关埋藏在吉林诺某处的传闻中的宝藏的信息。 [sa li mu gang de jiu ba “ sheng xiu de mao ” zhong de hong hu zi fu lan ke ye xu neng gou gao su nin you guan mai cang zai ji lin nuo mou chu de chuan wen zhong de bao zang de xin xi 。]

english: Sounds adventurous, I may have to check that out. Thank you.
translation: 听起来很冒险，我可能得检查一下。谢谢。 [ting qi lai hen mao xian ， wo ke neng de jian cha yi xia 。 xie xie 。]

english: Yarr! I already found the booty!
translation: 亚尔！我已经找到战利品了！ [ya er ！ wo yi jing zhao dao zhan li pin le ！]

english: Yarr indeed my friend. A most excellent find.
translation: 亚尔确实是我的朋友。一个最出色的发现。 [ya er que shi shi wo de peng you 。 yi ge zui chu se de fa xian 。]

english: Yarr!
translation: 亚尔！ [ya er ！]

english: Yarrr!
translation: 呀！ [ya ！]

english: YARRR!
translation: 呀！ [ya ！]

english: Right, that's enough of that!
translation: 对了，就这些就足够了！ [dui le ， jiu zhe xie jiu zu gou le ！]

english: ..Sorry.
translation: ..对不起。 [.. dui bu qi 。]

english: Tell me about Ernest please.
translation: 请告诉我有关欧内斯特的事。 [qing gao su wo you guan ou nei si te de shi 。]

english: The best place to start would be at the gate to Draynor Manor. There you will find Veronica who will be able to tell you more.
translation: 最好的起点是德雷诺庄园门口。在那里您会找到维罗妮卡，她可以告诉您更多信息。 [zui hao de qi dian shi de lei nuo zhuang yuan men kou 。 zai na li nin hui zhao dao wei luo ni ka ， ta ke yi gao su nin geng duo xin xi 。]

english: I suggest you tread carefully in that place; it's haunted.
translation: 我建议你在那个地方小心行事；它闹鬼。 [wo jian yi ni zai na ge di fang xiao xin xing shi ； ta nao gui 。]

english: Sounds like fun. I've never been to a Haunted Manor before.
translation: 听起来很有趣。我以前从未去过鬼屋。 [ting qi lai hen you qu 。 wo yi qian cong wei qu guo gui wu 。]

english: Yeah, I found Ernest already. Professor Oddenstein had turned him into a chicken!
translation: 是的，我已经找到欧内斯特了。奥登斯坦教授把他变成了一只鸡！ [shi de ， wo yi jing zhao dao ou nei si te le 。 ao deng si tan jiao shou ba ta bian cheng le yi zhi ji ！]

english: A chicken!?
translation: 一只鸡！？ [yi zhi ji ！？]

english: Yeah a chicken. It could have been worse though.
translation: 是的，一只鸡。但情况可能会更糟。 [shi de ， yi zhi ji 。 dan qing kuang ke neng hui geng zao 。]

english: Very true, poor guy.
translation: 非常真实，可怜的家伙。 [fei chang zhen shi ， ke lian de jia huo 。]

english: Where can I get a haircut like yours?
translation: 哪里可以剪到像你这样的发型？ [na li ke yi jian dao xiang ni zhe yang de fa xing ？]

english: Yes, it does look like you need a hairdresser.
translation: 是的，看来您确实需要一位理发师。 [shi de ， kan lai nin que shi xu yao yi wei li fa shi 。]

english: Oh thanks!
translation: 哦，谢谢！ [o ， xie xie ！]

english: No problem. The hairdresser in Falador will probably be able to sort you out.
translation: 没问题。法拉多的理发师可能会为您解决问题。 [mei wen ti 。 fa la duo de li fa shi ke neng hui wei nin jie jue wen ti 。]

english: The Lumbridge general store sells useful maps if you don't know the way.
translation: 如果您不认识路，伦布里奇杂货店出售有用的地图。 [ru guo nin bu ren shi lu ， lun bu li qi za huo dian chu shou you yong de di tu 。]

english: What's up?
translation: 这是怎么回事？ [zhe shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: I assume the sky is up..
translation: 我以为天已经升起来了.. [wo yi wei tian yi jing sheng qi lai le ..]

english: You assume?
translation: 你认为？ [ni ren wei ？]

english: Yeah, unfortunately I don't seem to be able to look up.
translation: 是的，不幸的是我似乎无法抬头。 [shi de ， bu xing de shi wo si hu wu fa tai tou 。]

english: Can I buy your stick?
translation: 我可以买你的棍子吗？ [wo ke yi mai ni de gun zi ma ？]

english: It's not a stick! I'll have you know it's a very powerful staff!
translation: 这不是一根棍子！我会让你知道这是一支非常强大的员工！ [zhe bu shi yi gen gun zi ！ wo hui rang ni zhi dao zhe shi yi zhi fei chang qiang da de yuan gong ！]

english: Really? Show me what it can do!
translation: 真的吗？告诉我它能做什么！ [zhen de ma ？ gao su wo ta neng zuo shen me ！]

english: Um..It's a bit low on power at the moment..
translation: 嗯..现在电量有点少.. [n .. xian zai dian liang you dian shao ..]

english: It's a stick isn't it?
translation: 这是一根棍子不是吗？ [zhe shi yi gen gun zi bu shi ma ？]

english: ...Ok it's a stick.. But only while I save up for a staff. Zaff in Varrock square sells them in his shop.
translation: ...好吧，这是一根棍子...但只有当我为工作人员存钱时。瓦罗克广场的扎夫在他的商店里出售它们。 [... hao ba ， zhe shi yi gen gun zi ... dan zhi you dang wo wei gong zuo ren yuan cun qian shi 。 wa luo ke guang chang de zha fu zai ta de shang dian li chu shou ta men 。]

english: Well good luck with that.
translation: 祝你好运。 [zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Do you have anything of value which I can have?
translation: 你有什么值钱的东西可以给我吗？ [ni you shen me zhi qian de dong xi ke yi gei wo ma ？]

english: Are you asking for free stuff?
translation: 你在索要免费的东西吗？ [ni zai suo yao mian fei de dong xi ma ？]

english: Well... er... yes.
translation: 嗯...呃...是的。 [n ... e ... shi de 。]

english: No I do not have anything I can give you. If I did have anything of value I wouldn't want to give it away.
translation: 不，我没有什么可以给你的。如果我确实有任何有价值的东西，我不会想放弃它。 [bu ， wo mei you shen me ke yi gei ni de 。 ru guo wo que shi you ren he you jia zhi de dong xi ， wo bu hui xiang fang qi ta 。]

english: Your shoe lace is untied.
translation: 你的鞋带松了。 [ni de xie dai song le 。]

english: No it's not!
translation: 不，不是！ [bu ， bu shi ！]

english: No you're right. I have nothing to back that up.
translation: 不，你是对的。我没有任何证据支持这一点。 [bu ， ni shi dui de 。 wo mei you ren he zheng ju zhi chi zhe yi dian 。]

english: Fool! Leave me alone!
translation: 傻子！请别打扰我！ [sha zi ！ qing bie da rao wo ！]

english: Do you know what happened in the castle cellar?
translation: 你知道城堡地窖里发生了什么吗？ [ni zhi dao cheng bao di jiao li fa sheng le shen me ma ？]

english: I heard the wall collapsed or something. I don't know why. Perhaps you could get to the bottom of this mystery!
translation: 我听到墙倒塌什么的声音。我不知道为什么。或许你能揭开这个谜团的真相！ [wo ting dao qiang dao ta shen me de sheng yin 。 wo bu zhi dao wei shen me 。 huo xu ni neng jie kai zhe ge mi tuan de zhen xiang ！]

english: Where am I?
translation: 我在哪里？ [wo zai na li ？]

english: How are you today?
translation: 你今天怎么样？ [ni jin tian zen me yang ？]

english: Do you know of any quests I can do?
translation: 你知道我可以做哪些任务吗？ [ni zhi dao wo ke yi zuo na xie ren wu ma ？]

english: Your shoe lace is untied.
translation: 你的鞋带松了。 [ni de xie dai song le 。]

english: Are there any quests I can do here?
translation: 我在这里可以做任何任务吗？ [wo zai zhe li ke yi zuo ren he ren wu ma ？]

english: I fancy a bit of a fight, anything dangerous?
translation: 我想打架，有什么危险的吗？ [wo xiang da jia ， you shen me wei xian de ma ？]

english: Big scary demons!
translation: 可怕的大恶魔！ [ke pa de da e mo ！]

english: Vampyres!
translation: 吸血鬼！ [xi xue gui ！]

english: Small.. something small would be good.
translation: 小..小东西就好了。 [xiao .. xiao dong xi jiu hao le 。]

english: Maybe another time.
translation: 也许下次吧。 [ye xu xia ci ba 。]

english: Something easy please, I'm new here.
translation: 请简单一点，我是新来的。 [qing jian dan yi dian ， wo shi xin lai de 。]

english: The Lumbridge cook.
translation: 伦布里奇的厨师。 [lun bu li qi de chu shi 。]

english: The Duke's strange talisman.
translation: 公爵的奇怪护身符。 [gong jue de qi guai hu shen fu 。]

english: Romeo and his girlfriend.
translation: 罗密欧和他的女朋友。 [luo mi ou he ta de nv peng you 。]

english: I'm a thinker rather than fighter, anything skill oriented?
translation: 我是一个思考者而不是战士，有什么以技能为导向的吗？ [wo shi yi ge si kao zhe er bu shi zhan shi ， you shen me yi ji neng wei dao xiang de ma ？]

english: Fred the farmer.
translation: 农民弗雷德. [nong min fu lei de .]

english: Doric the dwarf.
translation: 多立克矮人。 [duo li ke ai ren 。]

english: I want to do all kinds of things, do you know of anything like that?
translation: 我想做各种各样的事情，你知道类似的事情吗？ [wo xiang zuo ge zhong ge yang de shi qing ， ni zhi dao lei si de shi qing ma ？]

english: Hetty the Witch.
translation: 女巫海蒂. [nv wu hai di .]

english: Pirate's treasure.
translation: 海盗的宝藏。 [hai dao de bao zang 。]

english: Ernest and Draynor Manor.
translation: 欧内斯特和德雷纳庄园。 [ou nei si te he de lei na zhuang yuan 。]

english: Where can I get a haircut like yours?
translation: 哪里可以剪到像你这样的发型？ [na li ke yi jian dao xiang ni zhe yang de fa xing ？]

english: What's up?
translation: 这是怎么回事？ [zhe shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: Can I buy your stick?
translation: 我可以买你的棍子吗？ [wo ke yi mai ni de gun zi ma ？]

english: Do you have anything of value which I can have?
translation: 你有什么值钱的东西可以给我吗？ [ni you shen me zhi qian de dong xi ke yi gei wo ma ？]

english: Do you know what happened in the castle cellar?
translation: 你知道城堡地窖里发生了什么吗？ [ni zhi dao cheng bao di jiao li fa sheng le shen me ma ？]

english: Thank you for all your help in solving the murder.
translation: 感谢您为侦破谋杀案提供的所有帮助。 [gan xie nin wei zhen po mou sha an ti gong de suo you bang zhu 。]

english: Here you go.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: Donovan has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
translation: 多诺万给了你[另一个线索卷轴/一个棺材]！ [duo nuo wan gei le ni [ ling yi ge xian suo juan zhou / yi ge guan cai ]！]

english: Dooooom!
translation: 哎呀！ [ai ya ！]

english: Where?
translation: 在哪里？ [zai na li ？]

english: All around us! I can feel it in the air, hear it on the wind, smell it... also in the air!
translation: 就在我们周围！我可以在空气中感受到它，在风中听到它，闻到它......也在空气中！ [jiu zai wo men zhou wei ！ wo ke yi zai kong qi zhong gan shou dao ta ， zai feng zhong ting dao ta ， wen dao ta ...... ye zai kong qi zhong ！]

english: Is there anything we can do about this doom?
translation: 对于这种厄运，我们能做些什么吗？ [dui yu zhe zhong e yun ， wo men neng zuo xie shen me ma ？]

english: There is nothing you need to do my friend! I am the Doomsayer, although my real title could be something like the Danger Tutor.
translation: 我的朋友，你不需要做什么！我是末日预言者，尽管我真正的头衔可能是危险导师之类的东西。 [wo de peng you ， ni bu xu yao zuo shen me ！ wo shi mo ri yu yan zhe ， jin guan wo zhen zheng de tou xian ke neng shi wei xian dao shi zhi lei de dong xi 。]

english: Danger Tutor?
translation: 危险导师？ [wei xian dao shi ？]

english: Yes! I roam the world sensing danger.
translation: 是的！我环游世界，感受到危险。 [shi de ！ wo huan you shi jie ， gan shou dao wei xian 。]

english: If you see the signs often enough, then you can turn them off; by that time you likely know what the area has in store for you.
translation: 如果您经常看到这些标志，那么您可以将其关闭；到那时，您可能就知道该地区为您准备了什么。 [ru guo nin jing chang kan dao zhe xie biao zhi ， na me nin ke yi jiang qi guan bi ； dao na shi ， nin ke neng jiu zhi dao gai di qu wei nin zhun bei le shen me 。]

english: If I find a dangerous area, then I put up warning signs that will tell you what is so dangerous about that area.
translation: 如果我发现一个危险区域，那么我会张贴警告标志，告诉您该区域有什么危险。 [ru guo wo fa xian yi ge wei xian qu yu ， na me wo hui zhang tie jing gao biao zhi ， gao su nin gai qu yu you shen me wei xian 。]

english: But what if I want to see the warnings again?
translation: 但如果我想再次看到警告怎么办？ [dan ru guo wo xiang zai ci kan dao jing gao zen me ban ？]

english: That's why I'm waiting here!
translation: 这就是我在这里等的原因！ [zhe jiu shi wo zai zhe li deng de yuan yin ！]

english: If you want to see the warning messages again, I can turn them back on for you.
translation: 如果您想再次看到警告消息，我可以为您重新打开它们。 [ru guo nin xiang zai ci kan dao jing gao xiao xi ， wo ke yi wei nin chong xin da kai ta men 。]

english: Thanks, I'll remember that if I see any warning messages.
translation: 谢谢，如果我看到任何警告消息，我会记住这一点。 [xie xie ， ru guo wo kan dao ren he jing gao xiao xi ， wo hui ji zhu zhe yi dian 。]

english: You're welcome!
translation: 不客气！ [bu ke qi ！]

english: Do you need to turn on any warnings right now?
translation: 您现在需要打开任何警告吗？ [nin xian zai xu yao da kai ren he jing gao ma ？]

english: Yes, I do.
translation: 是的，我愿意。 [shi de ， wo yuan yi 。]

english: Not right now.
translation: 现在不行。 [xian zai bu xing 。]

english: Ok, keep an eye out for the messages though!
translation: 好的，请留意消息！ [hao de ， qing liu yi xiao xi ！]

english: I will.
translation: 我会。 [wo hui 。]

english: You got lucky this time, next time doom will be upon you.
translation: 这次你很幸运，下次厄运就会降临到你身上。 [zhe ci ni hen xing yun ， xia ci e yun jiu hui jiang lin dao ni shen shang 。]

english: Ah! Here you go!
translation: 啊!干得好！ [a ! gan de hao ！]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: I need you to answer this for me.
translation: 我需要你帮我回答这个问题。 [wo xu yao ni bang wo hui da zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。 [qing shu ru wen ti de da an 。]

english: How can that be? Try again!
translation: 怎么可能呢？再试一次！ [zen me ke neng ne ？ zai shi yi ci ！]

english: Spot on!
translation: 现货！ [xian huo ！]

english: I'd like to remove my PvP protection.
translation: 我想删除我的 PvP 保护。 [wo xiang shan chu wo de  PvP  bao hu 。]

english: That way doom lies, I cannot comply. Your protection will be finished in less than 5 minutes.
translation: 那样的话，厄运就降临了，我不能遵守。您的保护将在 5 分钟内完成。 [na yang de hua ， e yun jiu jiang lin le ， wo bu neng zun shou 。 nin de bao hu jiang zai  5  fen zhong nei wan cheng 。]

english: Are you sure? Much doom lies that way and it can not be undone!
translation: 你确定吗？许多厄运就这样降临，而且无法挽回！ [ni que ding ma ？ xu duo e yun jiu zhe yang jiang lin ， er qie wu fa wan hui ！]

english: Yes, remove my PvP protection right now.
translation: 是的，立即取消我的 PvP 保护。 [shi de ， li ji qu xiao wo de  PvP  bao hu 。]

english: On your head be it!
translation: 就在你头上吧！ [jiu zai ni tou shang ba ！]

english: Yes, arrange for my PvP protection to end in 1 minute.
translation: 是的，安排我的 PvP 保护在 1 分钟内结束。 [shi de ， an pai wo de  PvP  bao hu zai  1  fen zhong nei jie shu 。]

english: Much doom be with you.
translation: 厄运与你同在。 [e yun yu ni tong zai 。]

english: You have 1 minute of PvP protection left.
translation: 您还剩 1 分钟的 PvP 保护时间。 [nin hai sheng  1  fen zhong de  PvP  bao hu shi jian 。]

english: On second thoughts, leave it.
translation: 转念一想，还是放弃吧。 [zhuan nian yi xiang ， hai shi fang qi ba 。]

english: Yes, I do.
translation: 是的，我愿意。 [shi de ， wo yuan yi 。]

english: Not right now.
translation: 现在不行。 [xian zai bu xing 。]

english: Is there anything we can do about this doom?
translation: 对于这种厄运，我们能做些什么吗？ [dui yu zhe zhong e yun ， wo men neng zuo xie shen me ma ？]

english: I'd like to remove my PvP protection.
translation: 我想删除我的 PvP 保护。 [wo xiang shan chu wo de  PvP  bao hu 。]

english: Yes, remove my PvP protection right now.
translation: 是的，立即取消我的 PvP 保护。 [shi de ， li ji qu xiao wo de  PvP  bao hu 。]

english: Yes, arrange for my PvP protection to end in 1 minute.
translation: 是的，安排我的 PvP 保护在 1 分钟内结束。 [shi de ， an pai wo de  PvP  bao hu zai  1  fen zhong nei jie shu 。]

english: On second thoughts, leave it.
translation: 转念一想，还是放弃吧。 [zhuan nian yi xiang ， hai shi fang qi ba 。]

english: Hello traveller, what brings you to my humble smithy?
translation: 你好，旅行者，是什么风带你来到我简陋的铁匠铺的？ [ni hao ， lv xing zhe ， shi shen me feng dai ni lai dao wo jian lou de tie jiang pu de ？]

english: I wanted to use your anvils.
translation: 我想用你的铁砧。 [wo xiang yong ni de tie zhen 。]

english: My anvils get enough work with my own use. I make pickaxes, and it takes a lot of hard work. If you could get me some more materials, then I could let you use them.
translation: 我自己使用的铁砧已经足够工作了。我制作镐，需要付出很多努力。如果你能给我更多的材料，我就可以让你使用它们。 [wo zi ji shi yong de tie zhen yi jing zu gou gong zuo le 。 wo zhi zuo gao ， xu yao fu chu hen duo nu li 。 ru guo ni neng gei wo geng duo de cai liao ， wo jiu ke yi rang ni shi yong ta men 。]

english: Yes, I will get you the materials.
translation: 是的，我会给你材料。 [shi de ， wo hui gei ni cai liao 。]

english: Clay is what I use more than anything, to make casts. Could you get me 6 clay, 4 copper ore, and 2 iron ore, please? I could pay a little, and let you use my anvils. Take this pickaxe with you just in case you need it.
translation: 粘土是我用来制作模型的最常用材料。你能给我 6 个粘土、4 个铜矿石和 2 个铁矿石吗？我可以付一点钱，让你用我的铁砧。随身携带这把镐，以备不时之需。 [nian tu shi wo yong lai zhi zuo mo xing de zui chang yong cai liao 。 ni neng gei wo  6  ge nian tu 、4  ge tong kuang shi he  2  ge tie kuang shi ma ？ wo ke yi fu yi dian qian ， rang ni yong wo de tie zhen 。 sui shen xie dai zhe ba gao ， yi bei bu shi zhi xu 。]

english: Where can I find those?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到这些？ [wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao zhe xie ？]

english: You'll be able to find all those ores in the rocks just inside the Dwarven Mine. Head east from here and you'll find the entrance in the side of Ice Mountain.
translation: 您将能够在矮人矿井内的岩石中找到所有这些矿石。从这里往东走，入口就在冰山的一侧。 [nin jiang neng gou zai ai ren kuang jing nei de yan shi zhong zhao dao suo you zhe xie kuang shi 。 cong zhe li wang dong zou ， ru kou jiu zai bing shan de yi ce 。]

english: Certainly, I'll be right back!
translation: 当然，我马上就回来！ [dang ran ， wo ma shang jiu hui lai ！]

english: You know, it's funny you should require those exact things!
translation: 您知道，您需要这些确切的东西，这很有趣！ [nin zhi dao ， nin xu yao zhe xie que qie de dong xi ， zhe hen you qu ！]

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你是什​​么意思？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: I can usually fit 28 things in my backpack and in a world full of quite literally limitless possibilities, a complete coincidence has occurred!
translation: 我的背包里通常可以装下 28 件东西，在一个充满无限可能性的世界里，一个完全的巧合发生了！ [wo de bei bao li tong chang ke yi zhuang xia  28  jian dong xi ， zai yi ge chong man wu xian ke neng xing de shi jie li ， yi ge wan quan de qiao he fa sheng le ！]

english: I don't quite understand what you're saying?
translation: 我不太明白你在说什么？ [wo bu tai ming bai ni zai shuo shen me ？]

english: Well, out of pure coincidence, despite definitely not knowing what you were about to request, I just so happened to have carried those exact items!
translation: 好吧，出于纯粹的巧合，尽管我绝对不知道你要要求什么，但我碰巧携带了那些确切的物品！ [hao ba ， chu yu chun cui de qiao he ， jin guan wo jue dui bu zhi dao ni yao yao qiu shen me ， dan wo peng qiao xie dai le na xie que qie de wu pin ！]

english: In fact, in the exact quantities too!
translation: 事实上，数量也是准确的！ [shi shi shang ， shu liang ye shi zhun que de ！]

english: Oh my, that is a coincidence! Pass them here, please. I can spare you some coins for your trouble, and please use my anvils any time you want.
translation: 天啊，这真是巧合啊！请把它们传到这里。我可以给你一些硬币来缓解你的麻烦，请随时使用我的铁砧。 [tian a ， zhe zhen shi qiao he a ！ qing ba ta men chuan dao zhe li 。 wo ke yi gei ni yi xie ying bi lai huan jie ni de ma fan ， qing sui shi shi yong wo de tie zhen 。]

english: Quest complete!
translation: 任务完成！ [ren wu wan cheng ！]

english: No, hitting rocks is for the boring people, sorry.
translation: 不，打石头是为了无聊的人，抱歉。 [bu ， da shi tou shi wei le wu liao de ren ， bao qian 。]

english: That is your choice. Nice to meet you anyway.
translation: 那是你的选择。无论如何，很高兴认识你。 [na shi ni de xuan ze 。 wu lun ru he ， hen gao xing ren shi ni 。]

english: I wanted to use your whetstone.
translation: 我想用你的磨刀石。 [wo xiang yong ni de mo dao shi 。]

english: The whetstone is for more advanced smithing, but I could let you use it as well as my anvils if you could get me some more materials.
translation: 磨刀石用于更高级的锻造，但如果你能给我更多的材料，我可以让你使用它和我的铁砧。 [mo dao shi yong yu geng gao ji de duan zao ， dan ru guo ni neng gei wo geng duo de cai liao ， wo ke yi rang ni shi yong ta he wo de tie zhen 。]

english: Mind your own business, shortstuff!
translation: 管好你自己的事吧，矮子！ [guan hao ni zi ji de shi ba ， ai zi ！]

english: How nice to meet someone with such pleasant manners. Do come again when you need to shout at someone smaller than you!
translation: 能遇到一个举止如此令人愉快的人真是太好了。当你需要对比你小的人大喊大叫时，请再来！ [neng yu dao yi ge ju zhi ru ci ling ren yu kuai de ren zhen shi tai hao le 。 dang ni xu yao dui bi ni xiao de ren da han da jiao shi ， qing zai lai ！]

english: I was just checking out the landscape.
translation: 我只是想看看风景。 [wo zhi shi xiang kan kan feng jing 。]

english: Hope you like it. I do enjoy the solitude of my little home. If you get time, please say hi to my friends in the Dwarven Mine.
translation: 希望你喜欢它。我确实很享受我的小家的孤独。如果你有时间，请跟我在矮人矿井里的朋友们打个招呼。 [xi wang ni xi huan ta 。 wo que shi hen xiang shou wo de xiao jia de gu du 。 ru guo ni you shi jian ， qing gen wo zai ai ren kuang jing li de peng you men da ge zhao hu 。]

english: Dwarven Mine?
translation: 矮人矿井？ [ai ren kuang jing ？]

english: Yep, the entrance is in the side of Ice Mountain just to the east of here. They're a friendly bunch. Stop in at Nurmof's store and buy one of my pickaxes!
translation: 是的，入口就在这里东边的冰山一侧。他们是一群友好的人。去努尔莫夫的商店买一把我的镐！ [shi de ， ru kou jiu zai zhe li dong bian de bing shan yi ce 。 ta men shi yi qun you hao de ren 。 qu nu er mo fu de shang dian mai yi ba wo de gao ！]

english: Will do!
translation: 会做！ [hui zuo ！]

english: What do you make here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I make pickaxes. I am the best maker of pickaxes in the whole of Gielinor.
translation: 我做镐。我是整个吉林诺最好的镐制造者。 [wo zuo gao 。 wo shi zheng ge ji lin nuo zui hao de gao zhi zao zhe 。]

english: Do you have any to sell?
translation: 你有卖的吗？ [ni you mai de ma ？]

english: Who's Nurmof?
translation: 努尔莫夫是谁？ [nu er mo fu shi shui ？]

english: Nurmof has a store over in the Dwarven Mine. You can find the entrance on the side of Ice Mountain to the east of here.
translation: 努尔莫夫在矮人矿山有一家商店。入口位于这里东边的冰山一侧。 [nu er mo fu zai ai ren kuang shan you yi jia shang dian 。 ru kou wei yu zhe li dong bian de bing shan yi ce 。]

english: Ah, fair enough.
translation: 啊，很公平。 [a ， hen gong ping 。]

english: Hey, who said you could use that? My anvils get enough work with my own use. I make pickaxes, and it takes a lot of hard work.
translation: 嘿，谁说你可以用它？我自己使用的铁砧已经足够工作了。我制作镐，需要付出很多努力。 [hei ， shui shuo ni ke yi yong ta ？ wo zi ji shi yong de tie zhen yi jing zu gou gong zuo le 。 wo zhi zuo gao ， xu yao fu chu hen duo nu li 。]

english: Sorry, would it be OK if I used your anvils?
translation: 抱歉，如果我用你的铁砧可以吗？ [bao qian ， ru guo wo yong ni de tie zhen ke yi ma ？]

english: If you could get me some more materials then I could let you use them.
translation: 如果你能给我更多的材料，我就可以让你使用它们。 [ru guo ni neng gei wo geng duo de cai liao ， wo jiu ke yi rang ni shi yong ta men 。]

english: I didn't want to use your anvils anyway.
translation: 反正我不想用你的铁砧。 [fan zheng wo bu xiang yong ni de tie zhen 。]

english: That is your choice.
translation: 那是你的选择。 [na shi ni de xuan ze 。]

english: Hello traveller, how is your metalworking coming along?
translation: 您好，旅行者，您的金属加工进展如何？ [nin hao ， lv xing zhe ， nin de jin shu jia gong jin zhan ru he ？]

english: Not too bad, Doric.
translation: 还不错，多里克。 [hai bu cuo ， duo li ke 。]

english: Good, the love of metal is a thing close to my heart.
translation: 很好，对金属的热爱是我内心深处的热爱。 [hen hao ， dui jin shu de re ai shi wo nei xin shen chu de re ai 。]

english: Well done.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: So, you've come to the right place?
translation: 那么，您来对地方了吗？ [na me ， nin lai dui di fang le ma ？]

english: I wanted to use your anvils.
translation: 我想用你的铁砧。 [wo xiang yong ni de tie zhen 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: Where can I find those?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到这些？ [wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao zhe xie ？]

english: Certainly, I'll be right back!
translation: 当然，我马上就回来！ [dang ran ， wo ma shang jiu hui lai ！]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: I want to use your whetstone.
translation: 我想用你的磨刀石。 [wo xiang yong ni de mo dao shi 。]

english: Mind your own business, shortstuff!
translation: 管好你自己的事吧，矮子！ [guan hao ni zi ji de shi ba ， ai zi ！]

english: I was just checking out the landscape.
translation: 我只是想看看风景。 [wo zhi shi xiang kan kan feng jing 。]

english: Dwarven Mine?
translation: 矮人矿井？ [ai ren kuang jing ？]

english: Will do!
translation: 会做！ [hui zuo ！]

english: What do you make here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Who's Nurmof?
translation: 努尔莫夫是谁？ [nu er mo fu shi shui ？]

english: Ah, fair enough.
translation: 啊，很公平。 [a ， hen gong ping 。]

english: Sorry, would it be OK if I used your anvils?
translation: 抱歉，如果我用你的铁砧可以吗？ [bao qian ， ru guo wo yong ni de tie zhen ke yi ma ？]

english: Yes, I will get you materials.
translation: 是的，我会给你材料。 [shi de ， wo hui gei ni cai liao 。]

english: No, hitting rocks is for the boring people, sorry.
translation: 不，打石头是为了无聊的人，抱歉。 [bu ， da shi tou shi wei le wu liao de ren ， bao qian 。]

english: I didn't want to use your anvils anyway.
translation: 反正我不想用你的铁砧。 [fan zheng wo bu xiang yong ni de tie zhen 。]

english: Hello again dearie. How are you doing?
translation: 亲爱的，你好。你好吗？ [qin ai de ， ni hao 。 ni hao ma ？]

english: Pretty good!
translation: 不错！ [bu cuo ！]

english: That's good to hear.
translation: 很高兴听到这个消息。 [hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi 。]

english: Not too good actually!
translation: 其实不太好！ [qi shi bu tai hao ！]

english: Oh well.
translation: 那好吧。 [na hao ba 。]

english: What's it like living so close to the wilderness?
translation: 住在离荒野这么近的地方是什么感觉？ [zhu zai li huang ye zhe me jin de di fang shi shen me gan jue ？]

english: Oh, it's not all that bad. It was a bit scary at first but as long as I don't go past the warning signs I'm all right.
translation: 哦，事情并没有那么糟糕。一开始有点害怕，但只要我不超越警告标志就没事。 [o ， shi qing bing mei you na me zao gao 。 yi kai shi you dian hai pa ， dan zhi yao wo bu chao yue jing gao biao zhi jiu mei shi 。]

english: It's actually pretty quiet here. I used to live in Lumbridge and, let me tell you, that's the dangerous place for people like me.
translation: 这里其实很安静。我以前住在伦布里奇，让我告诉你，对于像我这样的人来说，那是一个危险的地方。 [zhe li qi shi hen an jing 。 wo yi qian zhu zai lun bu li qi ， rang wo gao su ni ， dui yu xiang wo zhe yang de ren lai shuo ， na shi yi ge wei xian de di fang 。]

english: Thieves were picking people's pockets with impunity, and killing them on the streets in broad daylight!
translation: 小偷扒窃人们的口袋而不受惩罚，光天化日之下在街上杀人！ [xiao tou pa qie ren men de kou dai er bu shou cheng fa ， guang tian hua ri zhi xia zai jie shang sha ren ！]

english: And there weren't even any guards to protect us! Not that the guards in the other cities do much good to protect people from what I've heard.
translation: 甚至没有任何警卫来保护我们！并不是说其他​​城市的守卫在保护人们免受我所听到的影响方面做了很多好事。 [shen zhi mei you ren he jing wei lai bao hu wo men ！ bing bu shi shuo qi ta ​​ cheng shi de shou wei zai bao hu ren men mian shou wo suo ting dao de ying xiang fang mian zuo le hen duo hao shi 。]

english: I just thank goodness I haven't got an Attack option any more! I wouldn't last five minutes!
translation: 我只是谢天谢地，我不再有攻击选项了！我连五分钟都坚持不了！ [wo zhi shi xie tian xie di ， wo bu zai you gong ji xuan xiang le ！ wo lian wu fen zhong dou jian chi bu liao ！]

english: How did Dave come to be evil?
translation: 戴夫是怎么变得邪恶的？ [dai fu shi zen me bian de xie e de ？]

english: Oh, I don't know really. He's always been evil, I think. Maybe growing up so close to the wilderness has affected him in some way.
translation: 哦，我真的不知道。我想他一直都是邪恶的。也许在如此靠近荒野的地方长大对他产生了某种影响。 [o ， wo zhen de bu zhi dao 。 wo xiang ta yi zhi dou shi xie e de 。 ye xu zai ru ci kao jin huang ye de di fang zhang da dui ta chan sheng le mou zhong ying xiang 。]

english: When he was little he used to want to go into Edgeville dungeon. You know how kids are, always wanting to be dungeon adventurers! But he didn't want to be a hero, he wanted to be a monster!
translation: 当他小的时候，他曾经想去埃奇维尔地牢。你知道孩子们是怎样的，总是想成为地下城冒险家！但他不想成为英雄，他想成为怪物！ [dang ta xiao de shi hou ， ta ceng jing xiang qu ai qi wei er di lao 。 ni zhi dao hai zi men shi zen yang de ， zong shi xiang cheng wei di xia cheng mao xian jia ！ dan ta bu xiang cheng wei ying xiong ， ta xiang cheng wei guai wu ！]

english: And then he spent all summer building a tree-house. Except it wasn't a tree-house, of course, it was his Tower of Fear!
translation: 然后他花了整个夏天建造了一座树屋。当然，这不是树屋，而是他的恐惧之塔！ [ran hou ta hua le zheng ge xia tian jian zao le yi zuo shu wu 。 dang ran ， zhe bu shi shu wu ， er shi ta de kong ju zhi ta ！]

english: Of course I was hoping he'd have grown out of it by now and maybe even left home. But at least it keeps him happy.
translation: 当然，我希望他现在已经长大了，甚至可能离开家了。但至少这让他开心。 [dang ran ， wo xi wang ta xian zai yi jing zhang da le ， shen zhi ke neng li kai jia le 。 dan zhi shao zhe rang ta kai xin 。]

english: Hello again.
translation: 又好。 [you hao 。]

english: May I use your spices for making stew?
