translation: 你好，[玩家姓名]。我需要一种药草。 [ni hao ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。 wo xu yao yi zhong yao cao 。]

english: Hey, [player name]!
translation: 嘿，[玩家姓名]！ [hei ，[ wan jia xing ming ]！]

english: Excuse me, [player name]?
translation: 打扰一下，[玩家姓名]？ [da rao yi xia ，[ wan jia xing ming ]？]

english: Can you hear me, [player name]?
translation: 你能听到我说话吗，[玩家姓名]？ [ni neng ting dao wo shuo hua ma ，[ wan jia xing ming ]？]

english: I just need a herb, [player name]!
translation: 我只需要一种药草，[玩家名字]！ [wo zhi xu yao yi zhong yao cao ，[ wan jia ming zi ]！]

english: I'll give you a free potion, [player name]!
translation: 我会给你一瓶免费药水，[玩家名字]！ [wo hui gei ni yi ping mian fei yao shui ，[ wan jia ming zi ]！]

english: Maybe later.
translation: 也许以后吧。 [ye xu yi hou ba 。]

english: Here you are.
translation: 给你。 [gei ni 。]

english: No, I need it myself.
translation: 不，我自己需要。 [bu ， wo zi ji xu yao 。]

english: Quack!
translation: 嘎嘎！ [ga ga ！]

english: Looking to trade?
translation: 想要交易？ [xiang yao jiao yi ？]

english: What have you got?
translation: 你有什么？ [ni you shen me ？]

english: Take a look.
translation: 看看吧。 [kan kan ba 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Then we have nothing more to discuss.
translation: 那么我们就没有什么可讨论的了。 [na me wo men jiu mei you shen me ke tao lun de le 。]

english: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 人类！在我叫守卫之前回到奴隶围栏！ [ren lei ！ zai wo jiao shou wei zhi qian hui dao nu li wei lan ！]

english: What have you got?
translation: 你有什么？ [ni you shen me ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: What are you doing in my house...why the impertinence...the sheer cheek...how dare you violate my personal lodgings....
translation: 你在我家里做什么……为什么如此无礼……厚颜无耻……你怎么敢侵犯我的私人住所…… [ni zai wo jia li zuo shen me …… wei shen me ru ci wu li …… hou yan wu chi …… ni zen me gan qin fan wo de si ren zhu suo ……]

english: I..I was just looking around....
translation: 我……我只是四处看看…… [wo …… wo zhi shi si chu kan kan ……]

english: Well get out! Get out....this is my house....and don't go near my daughter Juliet...she's grounded in her room to keep her away from that good for nothing Romeo.
translation: 好吧，出去吧！出去……这是我的房子……不要靠近我的女儿朱丽叶……她被禁足在她的房间里，以防止她远离那个一无是处的罗密欧。 [hao ba ， chu qu ba ！ chu qu …… zhe shi wo de fang zi …… bu yao kao jin wo de nv er zhu li ye …… ta bei jin zu zai ta de fang jian li ， yi fang zhi ta yuan li na ge yi wu shi chu de luo mi ou 。]

english: Yes....sir....
translation: 是的……先生…… [shi de …… xian sheng ……]

english: What are you doing here? Snooping around...
translation: 你在这里做什么？四处窥探... [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？ si chu kui tan ...]

english: I've come to see Juliet on Romeo's behalf.
translation: 我代表罗密欧来见朱丽叶。 [wo dai biao luo mi ou lai jian zhu li ye 。]

english: What...what...Romeo! Why that good for nothing swine...he's always trying to get the affections of my daughter..that soppy, half brained nincompoop won't ever have the heart of my daughter.
translation: 什么……什么……罗密欧！为什么这个没出息的猪……他总是想得到我女儿的爱……那个多愁善感、半脑子的傻瓜永远不会得到我女儿的心。 [shen me …… shen me …… luo mi ou ！ wei shen me zhe ge mei chu xi de zhu …… ta zong shi xiang de dao wo nv er de ai …… na ge duo chou shan gan 、 ban nao zi de sha gua yong yuan bu hui de dao wo nv er de xin 。]

english: She deserves someone of character, wit and repose.
translation: 她值得拥有一个有性格、机智、安静的人。 [ta zhi de yong you yi ge you xing ge 、 ji zhi 、 an jing de ren 。]

english: What's so wrong about Romeo?
translation: 罗密欧有什么问题吗？ [luo mi ou you shen me wen ti ma ？]

english: Wrong! What's wrong with him...have you actually talked to him? He's nothing but a dim witted upperclass twit, totally useless.
translation: 错误的！他怎么了……你真的和他谈过了吗？他只不过是一个头脑迟钝的上流社会白痴，毫无用处。 [cuo wu de ！ ta zen me le …… ni zhen de he ta tan guo le ma ？ ta zhi bu guo shi yi ge tou nao chi dun de shang liu she hui bai chi ， hao wu yong chu 。]

english: If he threw a stone at the ground, he'd probably miss! He's totally invisible when it's raining because he's so wet!
translation: 如果他往地上扔一块石头，他很可能会失手！下雨的时候他完全看不见，因为他太湿了！ [ru guo ta wang di shang reng yi kuai shi tou ， ta hen ke neng hui shi shou ！ xia yu de shi hou ta wan quan kan bu jian ， yin wei ta tai shi le ！]

english: If you started with what's right with him, you'd have much less to consider!
translation: 如果你从对他有利的角度出发，你需要考虑的事情就会少得多！ [ru guo ni cong dui ta you li de jiao du chu fa ， ni xu yao kao lv de shi qing jiu hui shao de duo ！]

english: Well, I admit, he's probably not the sharpest knife in the cutlery draw...
translation: 好吧，我承认，他可能不是餐具抽签中最锋利的刀...... [hao ba ， wo cheng ren ， ta ke neng bu shi can ju chou qian zhong zui feng li de dao ......]

english: Sharp? I've seen keener wit in root vegetables. Anyway, stop changing the subject. Get out of here and don't think you can sneak up those stairs to see Juliet, because I'll catch you and then you'll be for it!
translation: 锋利的？我在根类蔬菜中看到了更敏锐的智慧。不管怎样，别转移话题了。离开这里，别以为你能偷偷爬上楼梯去见朱丽叶，因为我会抓住你，然后你就会支持它！ [feng li de ？ wo zai gen lei shu cai zhong kan dao le geng min rui de zhi hui 。 bu guan zen yang ， bie zhuan yi hua ti le 。 li kai zhe li ， bie yi wei ni neng tou tou pa shang lou ti qu jian zhu li ye ， yin wei wo hui zhua zhu ni ， ran hou ni jiu hui zhi chi ta ！]

english: That seems a bit harsh....
translation: 好像有点严酷了...... [hao xiang you dian yan ku le ......]

english: Harsh but fair I think you'll find...now get OUT!
translation: 严厉但公平，我想你会发现……现在滚出去！ [yan li dan gong ping ， wo xiang ni hui fa xian …… xian zai gun chu qu ！]

english: I've just come to have a chat with Juliet.
translation: 我只是来和朱丽叶聊天。 [wo zhi shi lai he zhu li ye liao tian 。]

english: What on earth about? I hope you're not in cahoots with that good for nothing Romeo!
translation: 到底是怎么回事？我希望你不要跟那个没用的罗密欧勾结！ [dao di shi zen me hui shi ？ wo xi wang ni bu yao gen na ge mei yong de luo mi ou gou jie ！]

english: Err..no of course not....why would I be?
translation: 呃……不，当然不是……为什么我会这样呢？ [e …… bu ， dang ran bu shi …… wei shen me wo hui zhe yang ne ？]

english: He's been trying to wooo my daughter for an age. Up until now she's had the good sense to just ignore him. I just don't know what's gotten into her recently so that she would give him the time of day.
translation: 他多年来一直试图追求我的女儿。到目前为止，她一直明智地忽略了他。我只是不知道她最近怎么了，才肯给他时间。 [ta duo nian lai yi zhi shi tu zhui qiu wo de nv er 。 dao mu qian wei zhi ， ta yi zhi ming zhi di hu lve le ta 。 wo zhi shi bu zhi dao ta zui jin zen me le ， cai ken gei ta shi jian 。]

english: Well, love is mysterious! Perhaps one day someone may even learn to love you!
translation: 嗯，爱情是很神秘的！也许有一天，有人会学会爱你！ [n ， ai qing shi hen shen mi de ！ ye xu you yi tian ， you ren hui xue hui ai ni ！]

english: What! Someone may fall in love with me...what are you trying to insinuate?
translation: 什么！有人可能会爱上我……你想暗示什么？ [shen me ！ you ren ke neng hui ai shang wo …… ni xiang an shi shen me ？]

english: Err...Nothing....I guess I'd better be going now...
translation: 呃……没什么……我想我最好现在就走…… [e …… mei shen me …… wo xiang wo zui hao xian zai jiu zou ……]

english: Oh...just looking around...
translation: 哦……只是环顾四周…… [o …… zhi shi huan gu si zhou ……]

english: Just looking around! This is MY house! You might have at least 'ASKED' to view my considerably well appointed abode...but no, you've just burst in with all the elegance of a Troll at a tea party.
translation: 只是环顾四周！这是我的家！您可能至少“要求”参观我设备齐全的住所……但是不，您刚刚在茶会上以巨魔的优雅方式闯入。 [zhi shi huan gu si zhou ！ zhe shi wo de jia ！ nin ke neng zhi shao “ yao qiu ” can guan wo she bei qi quan de zhu suo …… dan shi bu ， nin gang gang zai cha hui shang yi ju mo de you ya fang shi chuang ru 。]

english: I can see that you're busy ranting so I'll just nip off and investigate a bit.
translation: 我看得出你正忙着咆哮，所以我就停下来调查一下。 [wo kan de chu ni zheng mang zhe pao xiao ， suo yi wo jiu ting xia lai diao cha yi xia 。]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: What are you doing in my house? Up to no good I shouldn't wonder!
translation: 你在我家做什么？我不应该怀疑！ [ni zai wo jia zuo shen me ？ wo bu ying gai huai yi ！]

english: Just a small chore for Juliet, you do have a lovely daughter in her sir.
translation: 对朱丽叶来说只是一件小事，你的先生确实有一个可爱的女儿。 [dui zhu li ye lai shuo zhi shi yi jian xiao shi ， ni de xian sheng que shi you yi ge ke ai de nv er 。]

english: Oh...why, thank you...I've always tried to my best...
translation: 噢……为什么，谢谢你……我一直在尽力…… [o …… wei shen me ， xie xie ni …… wo yi zhi zai jin li ……]

english: ...Hang on! Enough of that smiley talk. I have a daughter and I know what she's like. Don't even think of carrying on anything behind my back, I have the eyes of a hawk, nothing gets past me!
translation: ...不挂断！那些微笑的谈话已经够了。我有一个女儿，我知道她是什么样的。别想在背后干啥，我有鹰眼，什么事都瞒不过我！ [... bu gua duan ！ na xie wei xiao de tan hua yi jing gou le 。 wo you yi ge nv er ， wo zhi dao ta shi shen me yang de 。 bie xiang zai bei hou gan sha ， wo you ying yan ， shen me shi dou man bu guo wo ！]

english: Hey! What's that in your hands...looks like a message to me...with Juliet's barely legible scrawl on it...
translation: 嘿！你手里的是什么……看起来像是给我的信息……上面有朱丽叶几乎难以辨认的潦草字迹…… [hei ！ ni shou li de shi shen me …… kan qi lai xiang shi gei wo de xin xi …… shang mian you zhu li ye ji hu nan yi bian ren de liao cao zi ji ……]

english: Yes, yes, that's probably why I can't read it!
translation: 是的，是的，这可能就是我无法阅读的原因！ [shi de ， shi de ， zhe ke neng jiu shi wo wu fa yue du de yuan yin ！]

english: Sorry, I mean, that's right sir. I'm just popping to the shops to get some groceries for Juliet.
translation: 抱歉，我的意思是，先生说得对。我只是去商店给朱丽叶买一些杂货。 [bao qian ， wo de yi si shi ， xian sheng shuo de dui 。 wo zhi shi qu shang dian gei zhu li ye mai yi xie za huo 。]

english: Right, have to be off now...thanks...
translation: 好吧，现在得走了……谢谢…… [hao ba ， xian zai de zou le …… xie xie ……]

english: Groceries!
translation: 杂货！ [za huo ！]

english: Groceries!...at a time like this, does that girl know what she's putting me through!
translation: 杂货！……在这种时候，那个女孩知道她让我经历了什么吗！ [za huo ！…… zai zhe zhong shi hou ， na ge nv hai zhi dao ta rang wo jing li le shen me ma ！]

english: Do you live here? If so, how's about a couple of hundred gold towards the rent eh? Pay your share I say...you don't want to be like that freeloading Romeo!
translation: 你住在这里吗？如果可以的话，房租几百金怎么样？我说，支付你的份额……你不想像那个贪图便宜的罗密欧！ [ni zhu zai zhe li ma ？ ru guo ke yi de hua ， fang zu ji bai jin zen me yang ？ wo shuo ， zhi fu ni de fen e …… ni bu xiang xiang na ge tan tu pian yi de luo mi ou ！]

english: Hey , what are you doing here?
translation: 嘿，你在这里做什么？ [hei ， ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Nothing much sir...I promise...I'm just an innocent friend of Juliet's...doing her a few favours...as a friend.
translation: 没什么，先生……我保证……我只是朱丽叶的一个无辜的朋友……帮她一些忙……作为朋友。 [mei shen me ， xian sheng …… wo bao zheng …… wo zhi shi zhu li ye de yi ge wu gu de peng you …… bang ta yi xie mang …… zuo wei peng you 。]

english: Well, just make sure there's no funny business going on that's all I can say. Do you know why?
translation: 好吧，只要确保没有发生有趣的事情，这就是我能说的。你知道为什么吗？ [hao ba ， zhi yao que bao mei you fa sheng you qu de shi qing ， zhe jiu shi wo neng shuo de 。 ni zhi dao wei shen me ma ？]

english: I think I can guess sir...
translation: 我想我可以猜到先生... [wo xiang wo ke yi cai dao xian sheng ...]

english: There's no need to guess! You can see it in my hawk like eyes, in my cat like ears and my dog like nose...
translation: 没必要猜啊！你可以从我鹰一样的眼睛、猫一样的耳朵和狗一样的鼻子中看到它...... [mei bi yao cai a ！ ni ke yi cong wo ying yi yang de yan jing 、 mao yi yang de er duo he gou yi yang de bi zi zhong kan dao ta ......]

english: Are you saying that you look like an animal sir?
translation: 你是说你看起来像动物吗先生？ [ni shi shuo ni kan qi lai xiang dong wu ma xian sheng ？]

english: NO! Not look like an animal! I have the keen 'SENSES' of an animal and I don't miss a thing. Don't even think about trying anything!
translation: 不！看起来不像动物！我拥有动物般敏锐的“感官”，我不会错过任何事情。甚至不要考虑尝试任何事情！ [bu ！ kan qi lai bu xiang dong wu ！ wo yong you dong wu ban min rui de “ gan guan ”， wo bu hui cuo guo ren he shi qing 。 shen zhi bu yao kao lv chang shi ren he shi qing ！]

english: Hey! What's that in your hands? Looks like some sort of potion to me!
translation: 嘿！你手里那是什么？对我来说看起来像是某种药剂！ [hei ！ ni shou li na shi shen me ？ dui wo lai shuo kan qi lai xiang shi mou zhong yao ji ！]

english: Err...no! Nope! Not a potion! Some medicine...I have a terrible cough ...cough...cough....see?
translation: 呃……不！没有！不是药水！一些药...我咳嗽得很厉害...咳嗽...咳嗽...看到了吗？ [e …… bu ！ mei you ！ bu shi yao shui ！ yi xie yao ... wo ke sou de hen li hai ... ke sou ... ke sou ... kan dao le ma ？]

english: >Except, I can't drink too much or else it makes me feel 'really' tired. One sip of this and the lights go out...I mean, I'm asleep in a minute.
translation: >不过，我不能喝太多，否则会让我感觉“真的”很累。喝一口，灯就灭了……我的意思是，我一分钟后就睡着了。 [> bu guo ， wo bu neng he tai duo ， fou ze hui rang wo gan jue “ zhen de ” hen lei 。 he yi kou ， deng jiu mie le …… wo de yi si shi ， wo yi fen zhong hou jiu shui zhao le 。]

english: Sleep!
translation: 睡觉！ [shui jiao ！]

english: Sleep...! How can you even think of such a thing at a time like this? And I hope you have no intentions of sleeping in my house!
translation: 睡觉...！这种时候怎么能想到这种事呢？我希望你无意睡在我家！ [shui jiao ...！ zhe zhong shi hou zen me neng xiang dao zhe zhong shi ne ？ wo xi wang ni wu yi shui zai wo jia ！]

english: You'll get a bill for rent if I catch you dozing off around here!
translation: 如果我发现你在这儿打瞌睡，你就会收到一张房租账单！ [ru guo wo fa xian ni zai zhe er da ke shui ， ni jiu hui shou dao yi zhang fang zu zhang dan ！]

english: My poor Juliet....she's dead...dead! I shouldn't have been so hard on her...she was my lovely daughter. Booo hoooo hooooo!
translation: 我可怜的朱丽叶……她死了……死了！我不应该对她这么严厉……她是我可爱的女儿。呜呜呜呜！ [wo ke lian de zhu li ye …… ta si le …… si le ！ wo bu ying gai dui ta zhe me yan li …… ta shi wo ke ai de nv er 。 wu wu wu wu ！]

english: I suppose you're quite pleased with yourself now...
translation: 我想你现在对自己很满意... [wo xiang ni xian zai dui zi ji hen man yi ...]

english: My house is going to be ruined, why did I agree to throwing this blasted party?
translation: 我的房子就要被毁了，我为什么同意举办这个该死的派对？ [wo de fang zi jiu yao bei hui le ， wo wei shen me tong yi ju ban zhe ge gai si de pai dui ？]

english: I've come to see Juliet on Romeo's behalf.
translation: 我代表罗密欧来见朱丽叶。 [wo dai biao luo mi ou lai jian zhu li ye 。]

english: I've just come to have a chat with Juliet.
translation: 我只是来和朱丽叶聊天。 [wo zhi shi lai he zhu li ye liao tian 。]

english: Oh...just looking around...
translation: 哦……只是环顾四周…… [o …… zhi shi huan gu si zhou ……]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Ask about the birthday party.
translation: 询问生日聚会的情况。 [xun wen sheng ri ju hui de qing kuang 。]

english: Something else.
translation: 还有别的事。 [hai you bie de shi 。]

english: Hey there, what can I do for ya?
translation: 嘿，我能为你做点什么吗？ [hei ， wo neng wei ni zuo dian shen me ma ？]

english: My name is Drew and I man this here grinding machine. I call her Sandstorm!
translation: 我叫德鲁，我负责操作这台磨床。我叫她沙暴！ [wo jiao de lu ， wo fu ze cao zuo zhe tai mo chuang 。 wo jiao ta sha bao ！]

english: I can also look after any buckets ya want me to.
translation: 我还可以照看您想要我照看的任何水桶。 [wo hai ke yi zhao kan nin xiang yao wo zhao kan de ren he shui tong 。]

english: Me and Sandstorm go way back, we started off back in the desert mining camp, I was a slave and I had the honour of looking after Sandstorm.
translation: 我和沙风很早以前就开始了，我们从沙漠采矿营地出发，我是一名奴隶，我有幸照顾沙风。 [wo he sha feng hen zao yi qian jiu kai shi le ， wo men cong sha mo cai kuang ying di chu fa ， wo shi yi ming nu li ， wo you xing zhao gu sha feng 。]

english: How did you and Sandstorm get out of the mining camp?
translation: 你和沙风是怎么离开采矿营地的？ [ni he sha feng shi zen me li kai cai kuang ying di de ？]

english: Well, because I was in charge of looking after Sandstorm, I was able to look at the inner workings.
translation: 嗯，因为我负责照顾Sandstorm，所以我能够看到内部运作。 [n ， yin wei wo fu ze zhao gu Sandstorm， suo yi wo neng gou kan dao nei bu yun zuo 。]

english: While the guards weren't looking, I would take apart Sandstorm piece by piece and place the pieces in boxes and barrels, when Sandstorms inners were all gutted, I tricked the cart driver by telling him cart jokes.
translation: 我趁警卫不注意的时候，把沙暴一块一块地拆开，装进盒子和桶里，当沙暴的内脏都被掏空的时候，我就给车夫讲一些推车的笑话来欺骗他。 [wo chen jing wei bu zhu yi de shi hou ， ba sha bao yi kuai yi kuai di chai kai ， zhuang jin he zi he tong li ， dang sha bao de nei zang dou bei tao kong de shi hou ， wo jiu gei che fu jiang yi xie tui che de xiao hua lai qi pian ta 。]

english: So, he didn't bother to check his cargo and I was able to board as he was driving off.
translation: 所以，他没有费心检查他的货物，我就在他开车离开时登机了。 [suo yi ， ta mei you fei xin jian cha ta de huo wu ， wo jiu zai ta kai che li kai shi deng ji le 。]

english: Anyway, that's all in the past. Can I help ya with anything else?
translation: 无论如何，那都是过去的事了。我还能帮您做其他事吗？ [wu lun ru he ， na dou shi guo qu de shi le 。 wo hai neng bang nin zuo qi ta shi ma ？]

english: You haven't got any buckets for me to hold.
translation: 你没有水桶让我提。 [ni mei you shui tong rang wo ti 。]

english: Ya don't have any buckets of sand to withdraw. Ya need to give me empty buckets, and grind sandstone in my grinder, then I'll sell ya buckets of sand.
translation: 你没有任何沙桶可以取出。你需要给我空桶，然后用我的研磨机研磨砂石，然后我就卖给你一桶沙子。 [ni mei you ren he sha tong ke yi qu chu 。 ni xu yao gei wo kong tong ， ran hou yong wo de yan mo ji yan mo sha shi ， ran hou wo jiu mai gei ni yi tong sha zi 。]

english: I have [number] of your buckets and you've ground enough sandstone for [number] buckets of sand.
translation: 我有你的 [number] 个桶，你已经磨碎了足够的砂岩来装 [number] 桶沙子。 [wo you ni de  [number]  ge tong ， ni yi jing mo sui le zu gou de sha yan lai zhuang  [number]  tong sha zi 。]

english: Nothing sorry. I have to be going now.
translation: 没什么遗憾的。我现在得走了。 [mei shen me yi han de 。 wo xian zai de zou le 。]

english: Oh, bye then.
translation: 哦，那么再见。 [o ， na me zai jian 。]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: Deposit buckets.
translation: 存款桶。 [cun kuan tong 。]

english: Withdraw buckets of sand.
translation: 取出沙桶。 [qu chu sha tong 。]

english: Check my buckets and sand.
translation: 检查我的水桶和沙子。 [jian cha wo de shui tong he sha zi 。]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: Greetings again adventurer. How go your travels in Morytania? Is it as evil as I have heard?
translation: 再次问候冒险家。您在莫里塔尼亚的旅行怎么样？真的像我听说的那么邪恶吗？ [zai ci wen hou mao xian jia 。 nin zai mo li ta ni ya de lv xing zen me yang ？ zhen de xiang wo ting shuo de na me xie e ma ？]

english: I've lost my wolfbane dagger.
translation: 我的狼毒匕首丢了。 [wo de lang du bi shou diu le 。]

english: Yes, I know! Luckily for you it washed up on the banks of the Salve earlier! Here, take it again, but please try and be more careful this time.
translation: 是的，我知道！对你来说幸运的是，它早些时候被冲到了萨尔夫河岸上！来，再拿一次，不过这次请尽量小心一点。 [shi de ， wo zhi dao ！ dui ni lai shuo xing yun de shi ， ta zao xie shi hou bei chong dao le sa er fu he an shang ！ lai ， zai na yi ci ， bu guo zhe ci qing jin liang xiao xin yi dian 。]

english: It's a family heirloom after all!
translation: 毕竟是传家宝啊！ [bi jing shi chuan jia bao a ！]

english: Thanks for that!
translation: 谢谢你！ [xie xie ni ！]

english: I've lost my library key.
translation: 我丢失了图书馆钥匙。 [wo diu shi le tu shu guan yao shi 。]

english: Ok, here's another one for you.
translation: 好的，这是给你的另一份。 [hao de ， zhe shi gei ni de ling yi fen 。]

english: Do you know of anything I can do in Morytania?
translation: 你知道我在莫里塔尼亚能做些什么吗？ [ni zhi dao wo zai mo li ta ni ya neng zuo xie shen me ma ？]

english: Well... I don't think so. There's not much to do in that place.
translation: 嗯...我不这么认为。那个地方没什么可做的。 [n ... wo bu zhe me ren wei 。 na ge di fang mei shen me ke zuo de 。]

english: You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Nature Spirit quest.
translation: 您不满足开始自然之灵任务的所有要求。 [nin bu man zu kai shi zi ran zhi ling ren wu de suo you yao qiu 。]

english: Well, what is it, I may be able to help?
translation: 嗯，有什么事，我可以帮忙吗？ [n ， you shen me shi ， wo ke yi bang mang ma ？]

english: There's a man called Filliman who lives in Mort Myre. He comes by the temple from time to time but I haven't seen him recently. I was wondering if you could check in on him?
translation: 有一个叫菲利曼的人住在莫特迈尔。他时常来寺庙，但我最近没见到他。我想知道你能不能去看看他？ [you yi ge jiao fei li man de ren zhu zai mo te mai er 。 ta shi chang lai si miao ， dan wo zui jin mei jian dao ta 。 wo xiang zhi dao ni neng bu neng qu kan kan ta ？]

english: I must warn you though, it could be dangerous. Mort Myre is filled with ghasts!
translation: 但我必须警告你，这可能很危险。 Mort Myre 充满了恶魂！ [dan wo bi xu jing gao ni ， zhe ke neng hen wei xian 。 Mort Myre  chong man le e hun ！]

english: Yes, I'll go look for him.
translation: 是的，我会去找他。 [shi de ， wo hui qu zhao ta 。]

english: That's great! Many thanks!
translation: 那太棒了！非常感谢！ [na tai bang le ！ fei chang gan xie ！]

english: Now, please be aware of the ghasts, you cannot attack them, only Filliman knew how to take them on. Just run from them if you can. If you get lost, try to make your way back to the temple.
translation: 现在，请注意恶魂，你无法攻击它们，只有菲利曼知道如何对付它们。如果可以的话，就逃离他们。如果迷路了，请尝试返回寺庙。 [xian zai ， qing zhu yi e hun ， ni wu fa gong ji ta men ， zhi you fei li man zhi dao ru he dui fu ta men 。 ru guo ke yi de hua ， jiu tao li ta men 。 ru guo mi lu le ， qing chang shi fan hui si miao 。]

english: Drezel hands you some food.
translation: 德雷泽尔递给​​你一些食物。 [de lei ze er di gei ​​ ni yi xie shi wu 。]

english: Please take this food to Filliman, he'll likely appreciate it. His home is somewhere in the southern end of Mort Myre. I don't know the exact location I'm afraid.
translation: 请把这些食物带给菲利曼，他可能会很感激。他的家位于莫特迈尔南端的某个地方。恐怕我不知道确切的位置。 [qing ba zhe xie shi wu dai gei fei li man ， ta ke neng hui hen gan ji 。 ta de jia wei yu mo te mai er nan duan de mou ge di fang 。 kong pa wo bu zhi dao que qie de wei zhi 。]

english: Don't worry, if he's there and he's still alive, I'll find him.
translation: 别担心，如果他在那里并且还活着，我会找到他的。 [bie dan xin ， ru guo ta zai na li bing qie hai huo zhe ， wo hui zhao dao ta de 。]

english: Sorry, I don't think I can help.
translation: 抱歉，我想我帮不上什么忙。 [bao qian ， wo xiang wo bang bu shang shen me mang 。]

english: That's fine, I'm sure someone else will be along shortly who can. Now, if you excuse me, I do have some things to be getting on with.
translation: 没关系，我相信其他人很快就会来。现在，请原谅，我确实有一些事情要做。 [mei guan xi ， wo xiang xin qi ta ren hen kuai jiu hui lai 。 xian zai ， qing yuan liang ， wo que shi you yi xie shi qing yao zuo 。]

english: Sorry, not interested.
translation: 抱歉，不感兴趣。 [bao qian ， bu gan xing qu 。]

english: Well, I understand. You must be busy.
translation: 嗯，我明白了。你一定很忙。 [n ， wo ming bai le 。 ni yi ding hen mang 。]

english: Hello, [player name]. How are things in Morytania?
translation: 你好，[玩家姓名]。莫里塔尼亚的情况怎么样？ [ni hao ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。 mo li ta ni ya de qing kuang zen me yang ？]

english: Not as well as I'd hope, Drezel. I'm still working with the Myreque. I just hope that we can find a way to defeat those Drakans.
translation: 没有我希望的那么好，德雷泽尔。我仍在与 Myreque 合作。我只希望我们能找到击败那些龙人的方法。 [mei you wo xi wang de na me hao ， de lei ze er 。 wo reng zai yu  Myreque  he zuo 。 wo zhi xi wang wo men neng zhao dao ji bai na xie long ren de fang fa 。]

english: You can be sure that a great many people hope for exactly the same thing, [player name]. Good luck to you, and Myreque prevail!
translation: 你可以肯定，很多人都希望得到完全相同的事情，[玩家姓名]。祝你好运，迈雷克获胜！ [ni ke yi ken ding ， hen duo ren dou xi wang de dao wan quan xiang tong de shi qing ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。 zhu ni hao yun ， mai lei ke huo sheng ！]

english: Myreque prevail, Drezel.
translation: 迈雷克获胜，德雷泽尔。 [mai lei ke huo sheng ， de lei ze er 。]

english: How's everything going, [player name]?
translation: 一切进展如何，[玩家姓名]？ [yi qie jin zhan ru he ，[ wan jia xing ming ]？]

english: We've managed to create a new weapon to fight the vampyres with. I used it to kill Ranis Drakan!
translation: 我们成功地创造了一种新武器来对抗吸血鬼。我用它杀死了拉尼斯·德拉坎！ [wo men cheng gong di chuang zao le yi zhong xin wu qi lai dui kang xi xue gui 。 wo yong ta sha si le la ni si · de la kan ！]

english: This is amazing news, [player name]. Myreque prevail!
translation: 这是一个惊人的消息，[玩家姓名]。迈雷克获胜！ [zhe shi yi ge jing ren de xiao xi ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。 mai lei ke huo sheng ！]

english: [player name]. How are things?
translation: [玩家姓名]。最近怎么样？ [[ wan jia xing ming ]。 zui jin zen me yang ？]

english: As well as they could be, everything considered. We lost everything, Drezel.
translation: 一切都考虑在内，尽其所能。我们失去了一切，德雷泽尔。 [yi qie dou kao lv zai nei ， jin qi suo neng 。 wo men shi qu le yi qie ， de lei ze er 。]

english: Not everything. There's still you, me and Ivan. Veliaf is out there somewhere as well. It's not much, but it's something to be thankful for.
translation: 不是一切。还有你、我和伊万。 Veliaf 也在某个地方。虽然不多，但也是值得庆幸的事情。 [bu shi yi qie 。 hai you ni 、 wo he yi wan 。 Veliaf  ye zai mou ge di fang 。 sui ran bu duo ， dan ye shi zhi de qing xing de shi qing 。]

english: I suppose.
translation: 我想。 [wo xiang 。]

english: Morytania has never been darker. Trust in Saradomin, friend. There is still a chance we will live through this darkness.
translation: 莫里塔尼亚从未如此黑暗过。相信萨拉多明，朋友。我们仍有机会度过这黑暗。 [mo li ta ni ya cong wei ru ci hei an guo 。 xiang xin sa la duo ming ， peng you 。 wo men reng you ji hui du guo zhe hei an 。]

english: Ah! Here you go!
translation: 啊!干得好！ [a ! gan de hao ！]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: I need you to help me with this.
translation: 我需要你帮我解决这个问题。 [wo xu yao ni bang wo jie jue zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Drezel has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 德雷泽尔给了你一个挑战卷轴！ [de lei ze er gei le ni yi ge tiao zhan juan zhou ！]

english: Please give me your answer!
translation: 请给我你的答案！ [qing gei wo ni de da an ！]

english: Nope, not correct!
translation: 不，不正确！ [bu ， bu zheng que ！]

english: Correct!
translation: 正确的！ [zheng que de ！]

english: Drezel has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 德雷泽尔给了你另一条线索卷轴！ [de lei ze er gei le ni ling yi tiao xian suo juan zhou ！]

english: Well, what is it, I may be able to help?
translation: 嗯，有什么事，我可以帮忙吗？ [n ， you shen me shi ， wo ke yi bang mang ma ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Sorry, not interested.
translation: 抱歉，不感兴趣。 [bao qian ， bu gan xing qu 。]

english: Hey, human.
translation: 嘿，人类。 [hei ， ren lei 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Just a guard. If sneaky humans come in here without permission, I chuck rocks at 'em, knock 'em out and chuck 'em out of Weiss.
translation: 只是一个守卫。如果偷偷摸摸的人类未经允许进入这里，我会向他们扔石头，将他们击倒，然后将他们从韦斯扔出去。 [zhi shi yi ge shou wei 。 ru guo tou tou mo mo de ren lei wei jing yun xu jin ru zhe li ， wo hui xiang ta men reng shi tou ， jiang ta men ji dao ， ran hou jiang ta men cong wei si reng chu qu 。]

english: I'm familiar with the idea, yeah.
translation: 我很熟悉这个想法，是的。 [wo hen shu xi zhe ge xiang fa ， shi de 。]

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 告诉我这个地方。 [gao su wo zhe ge di fang 。]

english: This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: 这是韦斯。几年前，在我们被从更南边的洞穴里赶出来之后，巨魔们建造了它。现在Weiss是我们的家。 [zhe shi wei si 。 ji nian qian ， zai wo men bei cong geng nan bian de dong xue li gan chu lai zhi hou ， ju mo men jian zao le ta 。 xian zai Weiss shi wo men de jia 。]

english: We done pretty good here. Got lots of goat and wolf to eat - they taste kinda boring after all this time, but there not much other choice.
translation: 我们在这里做得很好。有很多山羊和狼可以吃——这么长时间以来它们尝起来有点无聊，但没有太多其他选择。 [wo men zai zhe li zuo de hen hao 。 you hen duo shan yang he lang ke yi chi —— zhe me zhang shi jian yi lai ta men chang qi lai you dian wu liao ， dan mei you tai duo qi ta xuan ze 。]

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it. In fact My Arm is an expert on growing the stuff.
translation: 尝试过古古草吗？我知道喜欢它的巨魔。事实上，我的手臂是种植这些东西的专家。 [chang shi guo gu gu cao ma ？ wo zhi dao xi huan ta de ju mo 。 shi shi shang ， wo de shou bi shi zhong zhi zhe xie dong xi de zhuan jia 。]

english: Never heard of no gouty weed, no. But it sound like a vegetable, an' Mother not like eating those, so we probably not gonna try it.
translation: 从来没有听说过没有痛风草，没有。但它听起来像一种蔬菜，妈妈不喜欢吃那些，所以我们可能不会尝试。 [cong lai mei you ting shuo guo mei you tong feng cao ， mei you 。 dan ta ting qi lai xiang yi zhong shu cai ， ma ma bu xi huan chi na xie ， suo yi wo men ke neng bu hui chang shi 。]

english: Mother not like new ideas much, but he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: 妈妈不太喜欢新想法，但他真的很大，而且是老板，所以我们就照他说的做。 [ma ma bu tai xi huan xin xiang fa ， dan ta zhen de hen da ， er qie shi lao ban ， suo yi wo men jiu zhao ta shuo de zuo 。]

english: I see.
translation: 我懂了。 [wo dong le 。]

english: Do you like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这里吗？ [ni xi huan zhe li ma ？]

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it our home. Odd Mushroom say he can make it nicer with fancy fires what he invented, but Mother not interested in that, so Odd Mushroom not allowed to do it.
translation: 呃，虽然有点简陋，但那是我们的家。奇蘑菇说他可以用他发明的奇特的火把它做得更好，但妈妈对此不感兴趣，所以奇蘑菇不被允许这样做。 [e ， sui ran you dian jian lou ， dan na shi wo men de jia 。 qi mo gu shuo ta ke yi yong ta fa ming de qi te de huo ba ta zuo de geng hao ， dan ma ma dui ci bu gan xing qu ， suo yi qi mo gu bu bei yun xu zhe yang zuo 。]

english: Mother only care about stuff to help him fight better. An he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: 母亲只关心帮助他更好地战斗的东西。他真的很大，他是老板，所以我们就按他说的做。 [mu qin zhi guan xin bang zhu ta geng hao di zhan dou de dong xi 。 ta zhen de hen da ， ta shi lao ban ， suo yi wo men jiu an ta shuo de zuo 。]

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我就走了。 [wo jiu zou le 。]

english: Hey, friend of Snowflake!
translation: 嘿，雪花的朋友！ [hei ， xue hua de peng you ！]

english: Just a guard. If sneaky human come in here without permission, I chuck rocks at 'em, knock 'em out and chuck 'em out of Weiss.
translation: 只是一个守卫。如果偷偷摸摸的人类未经允许进入这里，我会向他们扔石头，将他们击倒，然后将他们从韦斯身上扔出去。 [zhi shi yi ge shou wei 。 ru guo tou tou mo mo de ren lei wei jing yun xu jin ru zhe li ， wo hui xiang ta men reng shi tou ， jiang ta men ji dao ， ran hou jiang ta men cong wei si shen shang reng chu qu 。]

english: It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: 这里太棒了，现在雪花和她丈夫巨魔教我们种植古风草。现在食物好多了。 [zhe li tai bang le ， xian zai xue hua he ta zhang fu ju mo jiao wo men zhong zhi gu feng cao 。 xian zai shi wu hao duo le 。]

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: 嗯，虽然有点粗糙，但是正在好起来。雪花，她教我们种植古风草。山羊、狼、人类的味道都因加入了古藤而变得更加美味。 [n ， sui ran you dian cu cao ， dan shi zheng zai hao qi lai 。 xue hua ， ta jiao wo men zhong zhi gu feng cao 。 shan yang 、 lang 、 ren lei de wei dao dou yin jia ru le gu teng er bian de geng jia mei wei 。]

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: 所以，是的，韦斯是一个很好的居住地，现在由雪花负责。所有的巨魔都像雪花一样。她的丈夫巨魔有点奇怪，但这不是我们的问题。 [suo yi ， shi de ， wei si shi yi ge hen hao de ju zhu di ， xian zai you xue hua fu ze 。 suo you de ju mo dou xiang xue hua yi yang 。 ta de zhang fu ju mo you dian qi guai ， dan zhe bu shi wo men de wen ti 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 告诉我这个地方。 [gao su wo zhe ge di fang 。]

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it.
translation: 尝试过古古草吗？我知道喜欢它的巨魔。 [chang shi guo gu gu cao ma ？ wo zhi dao xi huan ta de ju mo 。]

english: I see.
translation: 我懂了。 [wo dong le 。]

english: Do you like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这里吗？ [ni xi huan zhe li ma ？]

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我就走了。 [wo jiu zou le 。]

english: wooo wooo
translation: 呜呜 [wu wu]

english: Please, leave me alone.
translation: 请别打扰我。 [qing bie da rao wo 。]

english: Your loss!
translation: 你的损失！ [ni de sun shi ！]

english: Hello, are you Droalak?
translation: 你好，你是德罗拉克吗？ [ni hao ， ni shi de luo la ke ma ？]

english: Wow. I haven't spoken to the living for... for... I don't remember how long.
translation: 哇。我已经……已经……没有和生者说过话了，我不记得有多久了。 [wa 。 wo yi jing …… yi jing …… mei you he sheng zhe shuo guo hua le ， wo bu ji de you duo jiu le 。]

english: So your name IS Droalak?
translation: 那么你的名字是Droalak？ [na me ni de ming zi shi Droalak？]

english: Sorry, yes I am he.
translation: 抱歉，是的，我就是他。 [bao qian ， shi de ， wo jiu shi ta 。]

english: Great. Do you know anything about the outpost North of Ardougne?
translation: 伟大的。你对阿杜涅北部的前哨基地有什么了解吗？ [wei da de 。 ni dui a du nie bei bu de qian shao ji di you shen me liao jie ma ？]

english: I don't really like to talk about it, but I died there.
translation: 我不太喜欢谈论它，但我死在那里。 [wo bu tai xi huan tan lun ta ， dan wo si zai na li 。]

english: Oh dear.
translation: 哦亲爱的。 [o qin ai de 。]

english: I do have a scroll which might interest you that describes the timeline of the outpost. But first I wonder if I could ask you to tie up a problem?
translation: 我确实有一个卷轴，您可能会对它感兴趣，它描述了前哨站的时间线。但首先我想知道我是否可以请你解决一个问题？ [wo que shi you yi ge juan zhou ， nin ke neng hui dui ta gan xing qu ， ta miao shu le qian shao zhan de shi jian xian 。 dan shou xian wo xiang zhi dao wo shi fou ke yi qing ni jie jue yi ge wen ti ？]

english: Like what?
