translation: 如果你能站在奇怪的仪式圆圈上帮助挡住它们，我就能启动仪式。 [ru guo ni neng zhan zai qi guai de yi shi yuan quan shang bang zhu dang zhu ta men ， wo jiu neng qi dong yi shi 。]

english: No ritual steps were completed.
translation: 没有完成任何仪式步骤。 [mei you wan cheng ren he yi shi bu zhou 。]

english: Under one-quarter of the ritual steps have been completed.
translation: 仪式步骤已经完成了不到四分之一。 [yi shi bu zhou yi jing wan cheng le bu dao si fen zhi yi 。]

english: Over one-quarter of the ritual steps have been completed.
translation: 仪式步骤已经完成了四分之一以上。 [yi shi bu zhou yi jing wan cheng le si fen zhi yi yi shang 。]

english: Over half the ritual steps have been completed.
translation: 仪式步骤已经完成了一半以上。 [yi shi bu zhou yi jing wan cheng le yi ban yi shang 。]

english: Over three-quarters of the ritual steps were completed. Well done!
translation: 仪式步骤已经完成了四分之三以上。干得好！ [yi shi bu zhou yi jing wan cheng le si fen zhi san yi shang 。 gan de hao ！]

english: You all completed every ritual step, amazing!
translation: 你们都完成了每一个仪式步骤，太棒了！ [ni men dou wan cheng le mei yi ge yi shi bu zhou ， tai bang le ！]

english: No, I'm not interested.
translation: 不，我不感兴趣。 [bu ， wo bu gan xing qu 。]

english: Sure, How can I help?
translation: 当然可以，我可以帮忙吗？ [dang ran ke yi ， wo ke yi bang mang ma ？]

english: Quack!
translation: 嘎嘎！ [ga ga ！]

english: Quack?
translation: 嘎嘎？ [ga ga ？]

english: Eep!
translation: 哎呀！ [ai ya ！]

english: Cheep cheep!
translation: 吱吱！ [zhi zhi ！]

english: Welcome to the Emir's Arena! Are you interested in Duels? We organise ranked Duels here, or alternatively you can organise your own unranked Duels.
translation: 欢迎来到埃米尔竞技场！您对决斗感兴趣吗？我们在这里组织排名决斗，或者您也可以组织自己的未排名决斗。 [huan ying lai dao ai mi er jing ji chang ！ nin dui jue dou gan xing qu ma ？ wo men zai zhe li zu zhi pai ming jue dou ， huo zhe nin ye ke yi zu zhi zi ji de wei pai ming jue dou 。]

english: What's a Duel?
translation: 什么是决斗？ [shen me shi jue dou ？]

english: Two fighters are placed in a combat arena together, to battle to the death. The survivor wins the Duel.
translation: 两名战士被置于同一个战场上，决一死战。幸存者赢得决斗。 [liang ming zhan shi bei zhi yu tong yi ge zhan chang shang ， jue yi si zhan 。 xing cun zhe ying de jue dou 。]

english: Ranked or unranked? What does that mean?
translation: 有排名还是无排名？这意味着什么？ [you pai ming hai shi wu pai ming ？ zhe yi wei zhe shen me ？]

english: Everyone has a rank. It's meant to indicate how good they are at fighting, compared to other people.
translation: 每个人都有一个等级。这是为了表明与其他人相比，他们的战斗能力如何。 [mei ge ren dou you yi ge deng ji 。 zhe shi wei le biao ming yu qi ta ren xiang bi ， ta men de zhan dou neng li ru he 。]

english: In ranked fights, the winners gain rank and the losers lose rank. The Arena staff will decide who'll be fighting in each ranked Duel, and send the invitations.
translation: 在排名战中，胜利者获得排名，失败者失去排名。竞技场工作人员将决定谁将在每场排名决斗中战斗，并发送邀请。 [zai pai ming zhan zhong ， sheng li zhe huo de pai ming ， shi bai zhe shi qu pai ming 。 jing ji chang gong zuo ren yuan jiang jue ding shui jiang zai mei chang pai ming jue dou zhong zhan dou ， bing fa song yao qing 。]

english: But if you just want some casual fun, you can have an unranked Duel, where no-one gains or loses rank. You can organise your own unranked Duel against whoever you want to fight.
translation: 但如果你只是想要一些休闲乐趣，你可以进行一场不排名的决斗，没有人获得或失去排名。您可以组织自己的未排名决斗，与任何您想战斗的人进行战斗。 [dan ru guo ni zhi shi xiang yao yi xie xiu xian le qu ， ni ke yi jin xing yi chang bu pai ming de jue dou ， mei you ren huo de huo shi qu pai ming 。 nin ke yi zu zhi zi ji de wei pai ming jue dou ， yu ren he nin xiang zhan dou de ren jin xing zhan dou 。]

english: Only the ranked fights offer access to the other rewards of the Arena.
translation: 只有排名战斗才能获得竞技场的其他奖励。 [zhi you pai ming zhan dou cai neng huo de jing ji chang de qi ta jiang li 。]

english: How do I get invited to a Duel?
translation: 我如何获得决斗邀请？ [wo ru he huo de jue dou yao qing ？]

english: For a ranked Duel, you'll need to sign up to the recruitment group...
translation: 对于排名决斗，您需要注册招募组...... [dui yu pai ming jue dou ， nin xu yao zhu ce zhao mu zu ......]

english: You can carry on with your adventures while you're waiting for a ranked Duel to begin, since it may be a while before suitable fighters are available.
translation: 在等待排名决斗开始的同时，您可以继续冒险，因为可能需要一段时间才能找到合适的战士。 [zai deng dai pai ming jue dou kai shi de tong shi ， nin ke yi ji xu mao xian ， yin wei ke neng xu yao yi duan shi jian cai neng zhao dao he shi de zhan shi 。]

english: For an unranked Duel, other people might challenge you while you're wandering around the PvP Arena, so keep an eye out for invitation messages.
translation: 对于未排名的决斗，当您在 PvP 竞技场中闲逛时，其他人可能会向您发起挑战，因此请留意邀请消息。 [dui yu wei pai ming de jue dou ， dang nin zai  PvP  jing ji chang zhong xian guang shi ， qi ta ren ke neng hui xiang nin fa qi tiao zhan ， yin ci qing liu yi yao qing xiao xi 。]

english: I want to organise my own Duel.
translation: 我想组织我自己的决斗。 [wo xiang zu zhi wo zi ji de jue dou 。]

english: When you see other people wandering around the PvP Arena, you can challenge them directly, and they can challenge you. This would be an unranked Duel, so neither of you would gain rank or earn rewards.
translation: 当你看到其他人在PvP竞技场闲逛时，你可以直接挑战他们，他们也可以挑战你。这将是一场无排名的决斗，因此你们都不会获得排名或获得奖励。 [dang ni kan dao qi ta ren zai PvP jing ji chang xian guang shi ， ni ke yi zhi jie tiao zhan ta men ， ta men ye ke yi tiao zhan ni 。 zhe jiang shi yi chang wu pai ming de jue dou ， yin ci ni men dou bu hui huo de pai ming huo huo de jiang li 。]

english: Okay, goodbye.
translation: 好的，再见。 [hao de ， zai jian 。]

english: I'm okay, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。 [wo mei shi ， xie xie 。]

english: What's a Duel?
translation: 什么是决斗？ [shen me shi jue dou ？]

english: Ranked or unranked? What does that mean?
translation: 有排名还是无排名？这意味着什么？ [you pai ming hai shi wu pai ming ？ zhe yi wei zhe shen me ？]

english: How do I get invited to a Duel?
translation: 我如何获得决斗邀请？ [wo ru he huo de jue dou yao qing ？]

english: I want to organise my own Duel.
translation: 我想组织我自己的决斗。 [wo xiang zu zhi wo zi ji de jue dou 。]

english: Okay, goodbye.
translation: 好的，再见。 [hao de ， zai jian 。]

english: I'm okay, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。 [wo mei shi ， xie xie 。]

english: Guards! I've found a human!
translation: 卫兵！我找到人类了！ [wei bing ！ wo zhao dao ren lei le ！]

english: (guards appear and try to apprehend the player)
translation: （守卫出现并试图逮捕玩家） [（ shou wei chu xian bing shi tu dai bu wan jia ）]

english: Not many monkeys come down here...
translation: 来这里的猴子不多... [lai zhe li de hou zi bu duo ...]

english: That's quite understandable really.
translation: 这真的很好理解。 [zhe zhen de hen hao li jie 。]

english: I don't really understand it at all. I've spent my life here.
translation: 我完全不明白。我在这里度过了我的一生。 [wo wan quan bu ming bai 。 wo zai zhe li du guo le wo de yi sheng 。]

english: Here, solve this.
translation: 来，解决这个问题。 [lai ， jie jue zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Please make yourself some space, I have something for you.
translation: 请给自己留点空间，我有东西给你。 [qing gei zi ji liu dian kong jian ， wo you dong xi gei ni 。]

english: That doesn't look solved to me.
translation: 在我看来这并没有解决。 [zai wo kan lai zhe bing mei you jie jue 。]

english: Well done [player name]. Here you go.
translation: 干得好[玩家姓名]。干得好。 [gan de hao [ wan jia xing ming ]。 gan de hao 。]

english: Greetings. Welcome to my castle.
translation: 问候。欢迎来到我的城堡。 [wen hou 。 huan ying lai dao wo de cheng bao 。]

english: I seek a shield that will protect me from dragonbreath.
translation: 我寻找一个能保护我免受龙息伤害的盾牌。 [wo xun zhao yi ge neng bao hu wo mian shou long xi shang hai de dun pai 。]

english: A knight going on a dragon quest, hmm? What dragon do you intend to slay?
translation: 一个去追龙的骑士，嗯？你想杀死哪条龙？ [yi ge qu zhui long de qi shi ， n ？ ni xiang sha si na tiao long ？]

english: Elvarg, the dragon of Crandor island!
translation: 艾尔瓦格，克兰多岛的龙！ [ai er wa ge ， ke lan duo dao de long ！]

english: Elvarg? Are you sure?
translation: 艾尔瓦格？你确定吗？ [ai er wa ge ？ ni que ding ma ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: Well, you're a braver [man/woman] than I!
translation: 好吧，你比我更勇敢[男人/女人]！ [hao ba ， ni bi wo geng yong gan [ nan ren / nv ren ]！]

english: Why is everyone so scared of this dragon?
translation: 为什么大家都这么害怕这条龙呢？ [wei shen me da jia dou zhe me hai pa zhe tiao long ne ？]

english: Back in my father's day, Crandor was an important city-state. Politically it was as important as Falador and Varrock and its ships traded with every port.
translation: 在我父亲的时代，克兰多是一个重要的城邦。在政治上它与法拉多和瓦罗克一样重要，它的船只与每个港口都有贸易往来。 [zai wo fu qin de shi dai ， ke lan duo shi yi ge zhong yao de cheng bang 。 zai zheng zhi shang ta yu fa la duo he wa luo ke yi yang zhong yao ， ta de chuan zhi yu mei ge gang kou dou you mao yi wang lai 。]

english: But, one day, when I was little, all contact was lost. The trading ships and the diplomatic envoys just stopped coming.
translation: 但是，有一天，当我还小的时候，所有的联系都消失了。商船和外交使节就不再来了。 [dan shi ， you yi tian ， dang wo hai xiao de shi hou ， suo you de lian xi dou xiao shi le 。 shang chuan he wai jiao shi jie jiu bu zai lai le 。]

english: I remember my father being very scared. He posted lookouts on the roof to warn if the dragon was approaching. All the city rulers worried that Elvarg would devastate the whole continent.
translation: 我记得我父亲非常害怕。他在屋顶上设置了瞭望台，以警告龙是否正在接近。所有城市的统治者都担心艾尔瓦格会毁灭整个大陆。 [wo ji de wo fu qin fei chang hai pa 。 ta zai wu ding shang she zhi le liao wang tai ， yi jing gao long shi fou zheng zai jie jin 。 suo you cheng shi de tong zhi zhe dou dan xin ai er wa ge hui hui mie zheng ge da lu 。]

english: I'd better leave that dragon alone.
translation: 我最好别管那条龙。 [wo zui hao bie guan na tiao long 。]

english: That's a relief. I would hate to see such a promising adventurer cut down in [his/her] prime.
translation: 这真是一种解脱。我不愿意看到这样一位有前途的冒险家在他/她的鼎盛时期就夭折了。 [zhe zhen shi yi zhong jie tuo 。 wo bu yuan yi kan dao zhe yang yi wei you qian tu de mao xian jia zai ta / ta de ding sheng shi qi jiu yao zhe le 。]

english: So, are you going to give me the shield or not?
translation: 那么，你到底要不要给我盾牌呢？ [na me ， ni dao di yao bu yao gei wo dun pai ne ？]

english: If you really think you're up to it then perhaps you are the one who can kill this dragon.
translation: 如果你真的认为你有能力，那么也许你就是能够杀死这条龙的人。 [ru guo ni zhen de ren wei ni you neng li ， na me ye xu ni jiu shi neng gou sha si zhe tiao long de ren 。]

english: The Duke hands you a heavy orange shield.
translation: 公爵递给你一面沉重的橙色盾牌。 [gong jue di gei ni yi mian chen zhong de cheng se dun pai 。]

english: Take care out there. If you kill it...
translation: 外面要小心。如果你杀了它... [wai mian yao xiao xin 。 ru guo ni sha le ta ...]

english: If you kill it, for Saradomin's sake make sure it's really dead!
translation: 如果你杀了它，看在萨拉多明的份上，确保它真的死了！ [ru guo ni sha le ta ， kan zai sa la duo ming de fen shang ， que bao ta zhen de si le ！]

english: Very wise. There are some monsters that are best left alone.
translation: 非常明智。有些怪物最好不要去管。 [fei chang ming zhi 。 you xie guai wu zui hao bu yao qu guan 。]

english: Oh, no dragon in particular. I just feel like killing a dragon.
translation: 哦，不是特别是龙。我只是想杀死一条龙。 [o ， bu shi te bie shi long 。 wo zhi shi xiang sha si yi tiao long 。]

english: I don't have an infinite supply of these shields, you know. I'll only give one for a truly worthy cause.
translation: 你知道，我没有无限供应这些护盾。我只会为了真正有价值的事业而捐出一个。 [ni zhi dao ， wo mei you wu xian gong ying zhe xie hu dun 。 wo zhi hui wei le zhen zheng you jia zhi de shi ye er juan chu yi ge 。]

english: Of course. Now you've slain Elvarg, you've earned the right to call the shield your own!
translation: 当然。现在你已经杀死了埃尔瓦格，你已经赢得了将盾牌归为自己的权利！ [dang ran 。 xian zai ni yi jing sha si le ai er wa ge ， ni yi jing ying de le jiang dun pai gui wei zi ji de quan li ！]

english: The Duke hands you the shield.
translation: 公爵将盾牌递给你。 [gong jue jiang dun pai di gei ni 。]

english: Have you any quests for me?
translation: 你有什么任务要找我吗？ [ni you shen me ren wu yao zhao wo ma ？]

english: Well, it's not really a quest but I recently discovered this strange talisman.
translation: 嗯，这并不是真正的任务，但我最近发现了这个奇怪的护身符。 [n ， zhe bing bu shi zhen zheng de ren wu ， dan wo zui jin fa xian le zhe ge qi guai de hu shen fu 。]

english: It seems to be mystical and I have never seen anything like it before. Would you take it to the head wizard at
translation: 这似乎很神秘，我以前从未见过这样的东西。你能把它交给首席巫师吗 [zhe si hu hen shen mi ， wo yi qian cong wei jian guo zhe yang de dong xi 。 ni neng ba ta jiao gei shou xi wu shi ma]

english: the Wizards' Tower for me? It's just south-west of here and should not take you very long at all. I would be awfully grateful.
translation: 巫师之塔适合我吗？它就位于这里的西南方，不会花你很长时间。我将非常感激。 [wu shi zhi ta shi he wo ma ？ ta jiu wei yu zhe li de xi nan fang ， bu hui hua ni hen zhang shi jian 。 wo jiang fei chang gan ji 。]

english: Sure, no problem.
translation: 当然，没问题。 [dang ran ， mei wen ti 。]

english: Thank you very much, stranger. I am sure the head wizard will reward you for such an interesting find.
translation: 非常感谢你，陌生人。我相信首席巫师会奖励你如此有趣的发现。 [fei chang gan xie ni ， mo sheng ren 。 wo xiang xin shou xi wu shi hui jiang li ni ru ci you qu de fa xian 。]

english: Not right now.
translation: 现在不行。 [xian zai bu xing 。]

english: As you wish, stranger, although I have this strange feeling that it is important. Unfortunately, I cannot leave my castle unattended.
translation: 如你所愿，陌生人，尽管我有一种奇怪的感觉，那就是它很重要。不幸的是，我不能让我的城堡无人看管。 [ru ni suo yuan ， mo sheng ren ， jin guan wo you yi zhong qi guai de gan jue ， na jiu shi ta hen zhong yao 。 bu xing de shi ， wo bu neng rang wo de cheng bao wu ren kan guan 。]

english: The only task remotely approaching a quest is the delivery of that talisman I gave you to the head wizard of the Wizards' Tower,
translation: 远程接近任务的唯一任务是将我给你的护身符交给巫师塔的首席巫师， [yuan cheng jie jin ren wu de wei yi ren wu shi jiang wo gei ni de hu shen fu jiao gei wu shi ta de shou xi wu shi ，]

english: south-west of here. I suggest you deliver it to him as soon as possible. I have the oddest feeling that it is important...
translation: 这里的西南方。我建议你尽快交给他。我有一种最奇怪的感觉，它很重要...... [zhe li de xi nan fang 。 wo jian yi ni jin kuai jiao gei ta 。 wo you yi zhong zui qi guai de gan jue ， ta hen zhong yao ......]

english: Did you speak to the head wizard for me yet, adventurer?
translation: 冒险者，你已经帮我和魔法师长谈过话了吗？ [mao xian zhe ， ni yi jing bang wo he mo fa shi zhang tan guo hua le ma ？]

english: No, I lost that air talisman that you gave me.
translation: 不，我失去了你给我的那张空气符。 [bu ， wo shi qu le ni gei wo de na zhang kong qi fu 。]

english: Ah, that would explain it. One of my servants found this outside, and it seemed too much of a coincidence that more than one strange
translation: 啊，这样就可以解释了。我的一个仆人在外面发现了这个，这似乎太巧合了，不止一个奇怪的人 [a ， zhe yang jiu ke yi jie shi le 。 wo de yi ge pu ren zai wai mian fa xian le zhe ge ， zhe si hu tai qiao he le ， bu zhi yi ge qi guai de ren]

english: object would appear on my land in such a short period of time. Please take this to the head wizard at the Wizards' Tower, south-west of here, and don't lose it this time.
translation: 物体会在如此短的时间内出现在我的土地上。请把它交给位于这里西南方的巫师塔的巫师头目，这次不要把它弄丢了。 [wu ti hui zai ru ci duan de shi jian nei chu xian zai wo de tu di shang 。 qing ba ta jiao gei wei yu zhe li xi nan fang de wu shi ta de wu shi tou mu ， zhe ci bu yao ba ta nong diu le 。]

english: The only job I had was the delivery of that talisman, so I'm afraid not.
translation: 我唯一的工作就是送那张符咒，所以恐怕不是。 [wo wei yi de gong zuo jiu shi song na zhang fu zhou ， suo yi kong pa bu shi 。]

english: No, all is well for me.
translation: 不，对我来说一切都很好。 [bu ， dui wo lai shuo yi qie dou hen hao 。]

english: Where can I find money?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到钱？ [wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao qian ？]

english: I've heard that the blacksmiths are prosperous amongst the peasantry. Maybe you could try your hand at that?
translation: 听说农民里铁匠很发达。也许你可以尝试一下？ [ting shuo nong min li tie jiang hen fa da 。 ye xu ni ke yi chang shi yi xia ？]

english: Hello there, welcome to Lumbridge.
translation: 您好，欢迎来到朗布里奇。 [nin hao ， huan ying lai dao lang bu li qi 。]

english: What's with all the snow?
translation: 这么多雪是怎么回事？ [zhe me duo xue shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: A particularly harsh winter for Lumbridge this year. Still, we make the best of it. I hope all our new visitors aren't getting too cold.
translation: 今年对伦布里奇来说是一个特别严酷的冬天。尽管如此，我们还是尽力而为。我希望所有的新访客都不会感到太冷。 [jin nian dui lun bu li qi lai shuo shi yi ge te bie yan ku de dong tian 。 jin guan ru ci ， wo men hai shi jin li er wei 。 wo xi wang suo you de xin fang ke dou bu hui gan dao tai leng 。]

english: I'm not new!
translation: 我不是新人！ [wo bu shi xin ren ！]

english: Oh yes, I know that.
translation: 哦，是的，我知道。 [o ， shi de ， wo zhi dao 。]

english: Who cares about them?
translation: 谁关心他们？ [shui guan xin ta men ？]

english: Well... I do.
translation: 嗯...我愿意。 [n ... wo yuan yi 。]

english: What do you need?
translation: 你需要什么？ [ni xu yao shen me ？]

english: Ah...
I'm ok, though I am new around town.
translation: 我很好，虽然我是新来的。 [wo hen hao ， sui ran wo shi xin lai de 。]

english: Then doubly welcome you are to Lumbridge.
translation: 那么，热烈欢迎您来到朗布里奇。 [na me ， re lie huan ying nin lai dao lang bu li qi 。]

english: Actually yes, I am rather cold.
translation: 其实是的，我比较冷。 [qi shi shi de ， wo bi jiao leng 。]

english: Well... I may be able to help there.
translation: 嗯...我也许能帮上忙。 [n ... wo ye xu neng bang shang mang 。]

english: Who are you calling new?
translation: 你说谁是新人？ [ni shuo shui shi xin ren ？]

english: I haven't seen you around much before, that's all.
translation: 我以前没怎么见过你，仅此而已。 [wo yi qian mei zen me jian guo ni ， jin ci er yi 。]

english: I wonder if you might help me with a little project of mine?
translation: 我想知道你是否可以帮我做一个小项目？ [wo xiang zhi dao ni shi fou ke yi bang wo zuo yi ge xiao xiang mu ？]

english: Yes, I can help.
translation: 是的，我可以帮忙。 [shi de ， wo ke yi bang mang 。]

english: Great! Thank you!
translation: 伟大的！谢谢你！ [wei da de ！ xie xie ni ！]

english: So, I have seen how much extra work the Lumbridge citizens are putting in recently, what with so many new adventurers in town. I'd like to give them something back.
translation: 所以，我看到了朗布里奇市民最近投入了多少额外的工作，镇上有这么多新的冒险家。我想回馈他们一些东西。 [suo yi ， wo kan dao le lang bu li qi shi min zui jin tou ru le duo shao e wai de gong zuo ， zhen shang you zhe me duo xin de mao xian jia 。 wo xiang hui kui ta men yi xie dong xi 。]

english: And here comes the but...
translation: 但这里来了…… [dan zhe li lai le ……]

english: How did you know? But... I have to stay here in my room as I have so much paperwork to do.
translation: 你怎么知道的？但是...我必须待在我的房间里，因为我有很多文书工作要做。 [ni zen me zhi dao de ？ dan shi ... wo bi xu dai zai wo de fang jian li ， yin wei wo you hen duo wen shu gong zuo yao zuo 。]

english: So I'm delivering the presents? I get to be Santa?
translation: 那我去送礼物了？我要当圣诞老人吗？ [na wo qu song li wu le ？ wo yao dang sheng dan lao ren ma ？]

english: Um. Not quite, but nearly!
translation: 嗯。不完全是，但也差不多了！ [n 。 bu wan quan shi ， dan ye cha bu duo le ！]

english: What do you mean... not quite?
translation: 你是什​​么意思...不完全是？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ... bu wan quan shi ？]

english: Well, I don't want them to see you deliver it.
translation: 好吧，我不想让他们看到你交付它。 [hao ba ， wo bu xiang rang ta men kan dao ni jiao fu ta 。]

english: What? Why? How?
translation: 什么？为什么？如何？ [shen me ？ wei shen me ？ ru he ？]

english: Well it kind of looks lazy on my part doesn't it. I'd like you to disguise yourself... as a tree.
translation: 嗯，我看起来有点懒，不是吗？我希望你把自己伪装成一棵树。 [n ， wo kan qi lai you dian lan ， bu shi ma ？ wo xi wang ni ba zi ji wei zhuang cheng yi ke shu 。]

english: A TREE?
translation: 一棵树？ [yi ke shu ？]

english: Yes, a festive tree, as if I'd planted the tree near them and it's holding a present for them... isn't that a wonderful idea?
translation: 是的，一棵节日树，就好像我把这棵树种在他们附近，并为他们准备了一份礼物……这不是一个好主意吗？ [shi de ， yi ke jie ri shu ， jiu hao xiang wo ba zhe ke shu zhong zai ta men fu jin ， bing wei ta men zhun bei le yi fen li wu …… zhe bu shi yi ge hao zhu yi ma ？]

english: If by wonderful you mean awful... I suppose you want me to cut bits off trees and stick them to myself and decorate it with something shiny?
translation: 如果你所说的“美妙”是指“糟糕”……我想你是想让我从树上砍下一些碎片，把它们粘在自己身上，然后用闪亮的东西装饰它？ [ru guo ni suo shuo de “ mei miao ” shi zhi “ zao gao ”…… wo xiang ni shi xiang rang wo cong shu shang kan xia yi xie sui pian ， ba ta men zhan zai zi ji shen shang ， ran hou yong shan liang de dong xi zhuang shi ta ？]

english: How did you know?
translation: 你怎么知道的？ [ni zen me zhi dao de ？]

english: I'm leaving now.
translation: 我现在要走了。 [wo xian zai yao zou le 。]

english: Oh very good... leaving... well done.
translation: 哦，很好……离开……干得好。 [o ， hen hao …… li kai …… gan de hao 。]

english: The snowy trees out there look so treemendously festive, you should use some of their branches to decorate them.
translation: 外面的雪树看起来非常喜庆，你应该用它们的一些树枝来装饰它们。 [wai mian de xue shu kan qi lai fei chang xi qing ， ni ying gai yong ta men de yi xie shu zhi lai zhuang shi ta men 。]

english: What about a decoration on top, I don't want to be involved with creepy dolls again.
translation: 上面装饰一下怎么样，我不想再和那些毛骨悚然的娃娃扯上关系了。 [shang mian zhuang shi yi xia zen me yang ， wo bu xiang zai he na xie mao gu song ran de wa wa che shang guan xi le 。]

english: Oh no, no, no. I think you'll be able to find something star like to put on your head, maybe from the church?
translation: 哦不，不，不。我想你能找到像星星一样的东西戴在头上，也许来自教堂？ [o bu ， bu ， bu 。 wo xiang ni neng zhao dao xiang xing xing yi yang de dong xi dai zai tou shang ， ye xu lai zi jiao tang ？]

english: Where do I get the tree branches from?
translation: 我从哪里得到树枝？ [wo cong na li de dao shu zhi ？]

english: The snowy trees out there look so treemendously festive, you should just use some of their branches, but leave the big one alone. Just take something sharp to them. A knife or some shears should do the job.
translation: 外面的雪树看起来非常喜庆，你应该只使用它们的一些树枝，但不要管大的树枝。只要拿一些锋利的东西给他们就可以了。一把小刀或一些剪刀就可以完成这项工作。 [wai mian de xue shu kan qi lai fei chang xi qing ， ni ying gai zhi shi yong ta men de yi xie shu zhi ， dan bu yao guan da de shu zhi 。 zhi yao na yi xie feng li de dong xi gei ta men jiu ke yi le 。 yi ba xiao dao huo yi xie jian dao jiu ke yi wan cheng zhe xiang gong zuo 。]

english: I don't think I can take anymore puns.
translation: 我想我不能再接受双关语了。 [wo xiang wo bu neng zai jie shou shuang guan yu le 。]

english: Stick with it, it'll soon be over.
translation: 坚持下去，很快就会结束的。 [jian chi xia qu ， hen kuai jiu hui jie shu de 。]

english: Where do I get the decoration?
translation: 我在哪里可以获得装饰？ [wo zai na li ke yi huo de zhuang shi ？]

english: Well, not out of my crown! Get it? Crown?
translation: 好吧，不超出我的王冠！得到它？王冠？ [hao ba ， bu chao chu wo de wang guan ！ de dao ta ？ wang guan ？]

english: Must not react to pun...
translation: 一定不能对双关语做出反应... [yi ding bu neng dui shuang guan yu zuo chu fan ying ...]

english: OH ok, have it your way. I noticed a barrel of old waste material near the furnace. You should be able to find some there. Oh, and don't forget you can probably borrow a star from the church.
translation: 哦，好吧，随你便吧。我注意到熔炉附近有一桶旧废料。你应该能够在那里找到一些。哦，别忘了你可以从教堂借一颗星星。 [o ， hao ba ， sui ni bian ba 。 wo zhu yi dao rong lu fu jin you yi tong jiu fei liao 。 ni ying gai neng gou zai na li zhao dao yi xie 。 o ， bie wang le ni ke yi cong jiao tang jie yi ke xing xing 。]

english: How do I put it all together?
translation: 我如何将它们放在一起？ [wo ru he jiang ta men fang zai yi qi ？]

english: Well, thread is too light and rope is too heavy for this job... You could try some wool?
translation: 嗯，对于这项工作来说，线太轻，绳子太重……你可以尝试一些羊毛吗？ [n ， dui yu zhe xiang gong zuo lai shuo ， xian tai qing ， sheng zi tai zhong …… ni ke yi chang shi yi xie yang mao ma ？]

english: Why do I need it again?
translation: 为什么我又需要它？ [wei shen me wo you xu yao ta ？]

english: To deliver my presents of course!
translation: 当然是送我的礼物啦！ [dang ran shi song wo de li wu la ！]

english: Oh yeah... you're too busy to do it yourself and don't want them to know that I did it. Pretty poor excuse.
translation: 哦，是的...你太忙了，无法自己做，也不想让他们知道是我做的。很糟糕的借口。 [o ， shi de ... ni tai mang le ， wu fa zi ji zuo ， ye bu xiang rang ta men zhi dao shi wo zuo de 。 hen zao gao de jie kou 。]

english: Hey, I have a town to run, it's not all it's cracked up to be you know.
translation: 嘿，我有一个小镇要经营，这并不像你所吹嘘的那样。 [hei ， wo you yi ge xiao zhen yao jing ying ， zhe bing bu xiang ni suo chui xu de na yang 。]

english: That was an egg pun, wrong holiday.
translation: 这是一个鸡蛋双关语，错误的假期。 [zhe shi yi ge ji dan shuang guan yu ， cuo wu de jia qi 。]

english: How very pithy of you. It wasn't meant to be a pun!
translation: 你真是太精辟了。这不是双关语！ [ni zhen shi tai jing pi le 。 zhe bu shi shuang guan yu ！]

english: No thanks, bye.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，再见。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， zai jian 。]

english: I see you've got your disguise sorted out, you really should wear it for it to be effective though.
translation: 我看到你的伪装已经解决了，不过你真的应该穿上它才能发挥作用。 [wo kan dao ni de wei zhuang yi jing jie jue le ， bu guo ni zhen de ying gai chuan shang ta cai neng fa hui zuo yong 。]

english: Is that tree talking to me? I must be ill.
translation: 那棵树在跟我说话吗？我一定是病了。 [na ke shu zai gen wo shuo hua ma ？ wo yi ding shi bing le 。]

english: It's me, Player!
translation: 是我，玩家！ [shi wo ， wan jia ！]

english: And there was me thinking that yew wouldn't have made something that convincing.
translation: 我当时认为紫杉不会做出如此令人信服的事情。 [wo dang shi ren wei zi shan bu hui zuo chu ru ci ling ren xin fu de shi qing 。]

english: So what do I have to do?
translation: 那我该怎么办呢？ [na wo gai zen me ban ne ？]

english: Here, I've written it all down for you.
translation: 在这里，我已经为你写下了一切。 [zai zhe li ， wo yi jing wei ni xie xia le yi qie 。]

english: Duke Horacio hands you a neatly written list.
translation: 奥拉西奥公爵递给您一份写得很工整的清单。 [ao la xi ao gong jue di gei nin yi fen xie de hen gong zheng de qing dan 。]

english: How goes the job of Santa?
translation: 圣诞老人的工作进展如何？ [sheng dan lao ren de gong zuo jin zhan ru he ？]

english: I've made some progress. But I have some questions.
translation: 我已经取得了一些进展。但我有一些问题。 [wo yi jing qu de le yi xie jin zhan 。 dan wo you yi xie wen ti 。]

english: Ah Hans, loyal to a fault. He walks the castle grounds all day, everyday. He really could do with a sit down, don't you think? Take my chair, just over there.
translation: 啊汉斯，忠于错误。他每天都在城堡里散步。他确实需要坐下来，你不觉得吗？坐我的椅子，就在那边。 [a han si ， zhong yu cuo wu 。 ta mei tian dou zai cheng bao li san bu 。 ta que shi xu yao zuo xia lai ， ni bu jue de ma ？ zuo wo de yi zi ， jiu zai na bian 。]

english: Count Check... he's a bit of an odd one isn't he? He's obsesedwith counting. He loves counting, especially shiny things. The other day I was chatting to him and he was completely unable to take his eyes off the golden rings on my fingers. Perhaps he'd like some of those. However, they're not normal gold rings, like you would make. These I get specially from the apprentice near the furnace.
translation: Count Check...他有点奇怪，不是吗？他沉迷于计数。他喜欢数数，尤其是闪亮的东西。有一天我和他聊天，他的目光完全无法从我手指上的金戒指上移开。也许他想要其中一些。然而，它们并不是像您制作的普通金戒指。这些是我特意从炉子附近的学徒那里得到的。 [Count Check... ta you dian qi guai ， bu shi ma ？ ta chen mi yu ji shu 。 ta xi huan shu shu ， you qi shi shan liang de dong xi 。 you yi tian wo he ta liao tian ， ta de mu guang wan quan wu fa cong wo shou zhi shang de jin jie zhi shang yi kai 。 ye xu ta xiang yao qi zhong yi xie 。 ran er ， ta men bing bu shi xiang nin zhi zuo de pu tong jin jie zhi 。 zhe xie shi wo te yi cong lu zi fu jin de xue tu na li de dao de 。]

english: The lovely Gillie. Such pure white milk she brings us daily. But she is so run off her feet. She often suggests that we should find a magic spell to duplicate her! What a notion. I'm surprised we don't hear the same complaints from Bob.
translation: 可爱的吉莉。她每天给我们带来如此纯白的牛奶。但她实在是太慌张了。她经常建议我们找一个咒语来复制她！多么好的想法啊。我很惊讶我们没有听到鲍勃的同样的抱怨。 [ke ai de ji li 。 ta mei tian gei wo men dai lai ru ci chun bai de niu nai 。 dan ta shi zai shi tai huang zhang le 。 ta jing chang jian yi wo men zhao yi ge zhou yu lai fu zhi ta ！ duo me hao de xiang fa a 。 wo hen jing ya wo men mei you ting dao bao bo de tong yang de bao yuan 。]

english: Fred? Such a wholesome farmer. He does his job with the chickens and cows well. However, it wasn't his first choice of profession. He wanted to grow fruit trees you know. The one planted in the castle grounds sure did catch his eye.
translation: 弗雷德？真是一个健康的农民。他对鸡和牛的工作做得很好。然而，这并不是他的第一选择职业。你知道，他想种植果树。城堡里种植的那棵确实引起了他的注意。 [fu lei de ？ zhen shi yi ge jian kang de nong min 。 ta dui ji he niu de gong zuo zuo de hen hao 。 ran er ， zhe bing bu shi ta de di yi xuan ze zhi ye 。 ni zhi dao ， ta xiang zhong zhi guo shu 。 cheng bao li zhong zhi de na ke que shi yin qi le ta de zhu yi 。]

english: He's so gloomy, everything is doom doom doom. He needs some light entertainment. I heard he used to be a friend of Party Pete, in Falador, maybe ask him.
translation: 他是如此的阴沉，一切都是厄运厄运厄运。他需要一些轻松的娱乐。我听说他曾经是法拉多党皮特的朋友，也许可以问问他。 [ta shi ru ci de yin chen ， yi qie dou shi e yun e yun e yun 。 ta xu yao yi xie qing song de yu le 。 wo ting shuo ta ceng jing shi fa la duo dang pi te de peng you ， ye xu ke yi wen wen ta 。]

english: I seek a shield that will protect me from dragonbreath.
translation: 我寻找一个能保护我免受龙息伤害的盾牌。 [wo xun zhao yi ge neng bao hu wo mian shou long xi shang hai de dun pai 。]

english: Elvarg, the dragon of Crandor island!
translation: 艾尔瓦格，克兰多岛的龙！ [ai er wa ge ， ke lan duo dao de long ！]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: I'd better leave that dragon alone.
translation: 我最好别管那条龙。 [wo zui hao bie guan na tiao long 。]

english: So, are you going to give me the shield or not?
translation: 那么，你到底要不要给我盾牌呢？ [na me ， ni dao di yao bu yao gei wo dun pai ne ？]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Oh, no dragon in particular
translation: 哦，没有特别的龙 [o ， mei you te bie de long]

english: Have you any quests for me?
translation: 你有什么任务要找我吗？ [ni you shen me ren wu yao zhao wo ma ？]

english: Where can I find money?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到钱？ [wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao qian ？]

english: Talk about Lumbridge holiday event.
translation: 谈论伦布里奇假期活动。 [tan lun lun bu li qi jia qi huo dong 。]

english: I'm not new!
translation: 我不是新人！ [wo bu shi xin ren ！]

english: Who cares about them?
translation: 谁关心他们？ [shui guan xin ta men ？]

english: What do you need?
translation: 你需要什么？ [ni xu yao shen me ？]

english: I'm ok, though I am new around town.
translation: 我很好，虽然我是新来的。 [wo hen hao ， sui ran wo shi xin lai de 。]

english: Actually yes, I am rather cold.
translation: 其实是的，我比较冷。 [qi shi shi de ， wo bi jiao leng 。]

english: Who are you calling new?
translation: 你说谁是新人？ [ni shuo shui shi xin ren ？]

english: Yes, I can help.
translation: 是的，我可以帮忙。 [shi de ， wo ke yi bang mang 。]

english: Talk about something else.
translation: 说点别的吧。 [shuo dian bie de ba 。]

english: Where do I get the tree branches from?
translation: 我从哪里得到树枝？ [wo cong na li de dao shu zhi ？]

english: Where do I get the decoration?
translation: 我在哪里可以获得装饰？ [wo zai na li ke yi huo de zhuang shi ？]

english: How do I put it all together?
translation: 我如何将它们放在一起？ [wo ru he jiang ta men fang zai yi qi ？]

english: Why do I need it again?
translation: 为什么我又需要它？ [wei shen me wo you xu yao ta ？]

english: No thanks, bye.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，再见。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， zai jian 。]

english: Present for Hans.
translation: 送给汉斯的礼物。 [song gei han si de li wu 。]

english: Present for Count Check.
translation: 出席计数检查。 [chu xi ji shu jian cha 。]

english: Present for Gillie.
translation: 送给吉莉的礼物。 [song gei ji li de li wu 。]

english: Present for Farmer Fred.
translation: 送给农夫弗雷德的礼物。 [song gei nong fu fu lei de de li wu 。]

english: Present for Doom Sayer.
translation: 送给末日预言者的礼物。 [song gei mo ri yu yan zhe de li wu 。]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: [player name]! So glad you could make it. I really do appreciate you rounding up all those monkeys for us.
translation: [玩家姓名]！很高兴你能成功。我真的很感谢你为我们围捕了所有这些猴子。 [[ wan jia xing ming ]！ hen gao xing ni neng cheng gong 。 wo zhen de hen gan xie ni wei wo men wei bu le suo you zhe xie hou zi 。]

english: No problem.
translation: 没问题。 [mei wen ti 。]

english: I am grateful for your help, [player name]. If you could free up an inventory space, I wish to reward you.
translation: 我很感谢你的帮助，[玩家姓名]。如果您能释放库存空间，我想奖励您。 [wo hen gan xie ni de bang zhu ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。 ru guo nin neng shi fang ku cun kong jian ， wo xiang jiang li nin 。]

english: I am grateful for your help, [player name]. As proof of my gratitude, I have arranged a reward for you!
translation: 我很感谢你的帮助，[玩家姓名]。为了表达我的感激之情，我给你安排了一份奖励！ [wo hen gan xie ni de bang zhu ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。 wei le biao da wo de gan ji zhi qing ， wo gei ni an pai le yi fen jiang li ！]

english: Also, King Awowogei brought gifts from Ape Atoll as an apology for the trouble they caused. But I think you should receive them instead.
translation: 此外，阿沃沃盖国王还从猿环礁带来了礼物，作为对他们造成的麻烦的道歉。但我认为你应该收到它们。 [ci wai ， a wo wo gai guo wang hai cong yuan huan jiao dai lai le li wu ， zuo wei dui ta men zao cheng de ma fan de dao qian 。 dan wo ren wei ni ying gai shou dao ta men 。]

english: The Duke awards you a Cursed banana.Happy 8th Birthday!
translation: 公爵奖励你一根被诅咒的香蕉。八岁生日快乐！ [gong jue jiang li ni yi gen bei zu zhou de xiang jiao 。 ba sui sheng ri kuai le ！]

english: On a members-only world you'd have also received a Banana Cape. If you purchase membership you can reclaim it at any time from Diango in Draynor Village.
translation: 在仅限会员的世界中，您还会收到香蕉斗篷。如果您购买了会员资格，您可以随时从德拉诺村的 Diiango 处收回会员资格。 [zai jin xian hui yuan de shi jie zhong ， nin hai hui shou dao xiang jiao dou peng 。 ru guo nin gou mai le hui yuan zi ge ， nin ke yi sui shi cong de la nuo cun de  Diiango  chu shou hui hui yuan zi ge 。]

english: The Duke awards you a Cursed banana and a Banana cape.Happy 8th Birthday!
translation: 公爵奖励您一根被诅咒的香蕉和一件香蕉斗篷。八岁生日快乐！ [gong jue jiang li nin yi gen bei zu zhou de xiang jiao he yi jian xiang jiao dou peng 。 ba sui sheng ri kuai le ！]

english: Ah, [player name]. I hope you are enjoying the party?
translation: 啊，[玩家姓名]。我希望你这次聚会玩得开心吗？ [a ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。 wo xi wang ni zhe ci ju hui wan de kai xin ma ？]

english: What is going to happen with the monkeys?
translation: 猴子们会发生什么事情呢？ [hou zi men hui fa sheng shen me shi qing ne ？]

english: Funny you should ask, actually.
translation: 有趣的是，实际上你应该问。 [you qu de shi ， shi ji shang ni ying gai wen 。]

english: It turns out that on the way to King Awowogei, Postie Pete was called off for an urgent request for Molly. Her evil twin had escaped again and she was looking for an adventurer to help.
translation: 原来，在前往阿沃沃盖国王的途中，波斯蒂·皮特因紧急请求莫莉而被叫停。她的邪恶双胞胎再次逃脱，她正在寻找冒险家的帮助。 [yuan lai ， zai qian wang a wo wo gai guo wang de tu zhong ， bo si di · pi te yin jin ji qing qiu mo li er bei jiao ting 。 ta de xie e shuang bao tai zai ci tao tuo ， ta zheng zai xun zhao mao xian jia de bang zhu 。]

english: In the process of teleporting, he left the letter behind and these monkeys found it.
translation: 在传送的过程中，他留下了这封信，这些猴子发现了它。 [zai chuan song de guo cheng zhong ， ta liu xia le zhe feng xin ， zhe xie hou zi fa xian le ta 。]

english: They couldn't understand the letter so they took it to one of their elders, Mizaru, to translate. But 'Monster' didn't translate, so they assumed it said 'Monkey'.
translation: 他们无法理解这封信，所以他们把它交给了他们的一位长辈 Mizaru 来翻译。但“怪物”没有翻译，所以他们认为它是“猴子”。 [ta men wu fa li jie zhe feng xin ， suo yi ta men ba ta jiao gei le ta men de yi wei zhang bei  Mizaru  lai fan yi 。 dan “ guai wu ” mei you fan yi ， suo yi ta men ren wei ta shi “ hou zi ”。]

english: So instead of a party invitation they interpreted it as a threat from an organisation called Humans Against Monkeys! They stole some amulets of humanspeak, then decided to come here and put an end to it!
translation: 因此，他们将其解释为来自一个名为“人类对抗猴子”的组织的威胁，而不是聚会邀请！他们偷了一些人语护身符，然后决定来这里结束这一切！ [yin ci ， ta men jiang qi jie shi wei lai zi yi ge ming wei “ ren lei dui kang hou zi ” de zu zhi de wei xie ， er bu shi ju hui yao qing ！ ta men tou le yi xie ren yu hu shen fu ， ran hou jue ding lai zhe li jie shu zhe yi qie ！]

english: That explains what happened, I suppose. How did you find all of this out?
translation: 我想这就解释了发生了什么。你是怎么发现这一切的？ [wo xiang zhe jiu jie shi le fa sheng le shen me 。 ni shi zen me fa xian zhe yi qie de ？]

english: Another elder, Kikazaru, found the letter. And once he understood the situation, he went straight to King Awowogei himself. The King is over in the corner if you want to speak to him.
translation: 另一位长老木卡扎鲁发现了这封信。当他了解情况后，他直接去找了阿沃沃盖国王。如果你想和国王说话，他就在角落里。 [ling yi wei zhang lao mu ka zha lu fa xian le zhe feng xin 。 dang ta liao jie qing kuang hou ， ta zhi jie qu zhao le a wo wo gai guo wang 。 ru guo ni xiang he guo wang shuo hua ， ta jiu zai jiao luo li 。]

english: Thanks. I'll go enjoy the party now.
translation: 谢谢。我现在就去享受聚会。 [xie xie 。 wo xian zai jiu qu xiang shou ju hui 。]

english: Can you give me more reward items?
translation: 可以给我更多的奖励吗？ [ke yi gei wo geng duo de jiang li ma ？]

english: I think that is everything I have for you.
translation: 我想这就是我为你准备的一切。 [wo xiang zhe jiu shi wo wei ni zhun bei de yi qie 。]

english: I have given you what you can hold. You may wish to visit Diango, in Draynor Village, to collect more rewards in a more convenient setting.
translation: 我已经给了你你能握住的东西。您不妨前往德拉诺村的迪亚戈 (Diango)，在更便利的环境中收集更多奖励。 [wo yi jing gei le ni ni neng wo zhu de dong xi 。 nin bu fang qian wang de la nuo cun de di ya ge  (Diango)， zai geng bian li de huan jing zhong shou ji geng duo jiang li 。]

english: I have nothing more for you.
translation: 我没有什么可以给你的了。 [wo mei you shen me ke yi gei ni de le 。]

english: What is going to happen with the monkeys?
translation: 猴子们会发生什么事情呢？ [hou zi men hui fa sheng shen me shi qing ne ？]

english: Can you give me more reward items?
translation: 可以给我更多的奖励吗？ [ke yi gei wo geng duo de jiang li ma ？]

english: Thanks. I'll go enjoy the party now.
translation: 谢谢。我现在就去享受聚会。 [xie xie 。 wo xian zai jiu qu xiang shou ju hui 。]

english: Can you give me more rewards?
translation: 你能给我更多的奖励吗？ [ni neng gei wo geng duo de jiang li ma ？]

english: Uh hey, are you the Duke?
translation: 呃嘿，你是公爵吗？ [e hei ， ni shi gong jue ma ？]

english: Shh shh, now is not your time to speak.
translation: 嘘嘘，现在不是你说话的时候。 [xu xu ， xian zai bu shi ni shuo hua de shi hou 。]

english: Uhh...
Oh Great One, do I have to have broccoli for dinner?
translation: 天啊，我晚餐必须吃西兰花吗？ [tian a ， wo wan can bi xu chi xi lan hua ma ？]

english: Yes, Definitely.
translation: 是的，绝对是。 [shi de ， jue dui shi 。]

english: I hatesbroccoli, why must it torture me.
translation: 我讨厌西兰花，为什么它一定要折磨我。 [wo tao yan xi lan hua ， wei shen me ta yi ding yao zhe mo wo 。]

english: Why are they here, you didn't command it.
translation: 他们怎么会在这里，不是你命令的。 [ta men zen me hui zai zhe li ， bu shi ni ming ling de 。]

english: What do you mean? I was told to come here.
translation: 你是什​​么意思？我被告知要来这里。 [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？ wo bei gao zhi yao lai zhe li 。]

english: We're not talking to you.
translation: 我们不是在跟你说话。 [wo men bu shi zai gen ni shuo hua 。]

english: Great round one, should I rid us of this intruder?
translation: 第一轮很棒，我应该摆脱这个入侵者吗？ [di yi lun hen bang ， wo ying gai bai tuo zhe ge ru qin zhe ma ？]

english: Ask again later.
translation: 稍后再问。 [shao hou zai wen 。]

english: What is going on here, why are you talking to an egg?
translation: 这是怎么回事，你为什么要和鸡蛋说话？ [zhe shi zen me hui shi ， ni wei shen me yao he ji dan shuo hua ？]

english: The Omlettesiah feels generous today, what do you want and why are you here?
translation: Omlettesiah 今天感觉很慷慨，你想要什么，为什么来这里？ [Omlettesiah  jin tian gan jue hen kang kai ， ni xiang yao shen me ， wei shen me lai zhe li ？]

english: I'm not sure, I was told to come here when I stepped out of the portal.
translation: 我不确定，我走出传送门的时候就被告知要来这里。 [wo bu que ding ， wo zou chu chuan song men de shi hou jiu bei gao zhi yao lai zhe li 。]

english: WHAT DID YOU SAY?!
translation: 你说什么？！ [ni shuo shen me ？！]

english: Uuh, I mean, I was told to come here... after I hopped out of the portal.
translation: 呃，我的意思是，在我跳出传送门后，有人告诉我要来这里。 [e ， wo de yi si shi ， zai wo tiao chu chuan song men hou ， you ren gao su wo yao lai zhe li 。]

english: YOU CAME BACK? THE EGG DIDN'T COMMAND IT.
translation: 你回来了吗？鸡蛋没有命令它。 [ni hui lai le ma ？ ji dan mei you ming ling ta 。]

english: We need to punish them, but you have commanded me to wait...
translation: 我们需要惩罚他们，但你却命令我等待…… [wo men xu yao cheng fa ta men ， dan ni que ming ling wo deng dai ……]

english: Who are you talking to?
translation: 你在跟谁说话？ [ni zai gen shui shuo hua ？]

english: Our wise ruler, the divine egg. It is our great leader.
translation: 我们英明的统治者，神圣的蛋。这是我们伟大的领袖。 [wo men ying ming de tong zhi zhe ， shen sheng de dan 。 zhe shi wo men wei da de ling xiu 。]

english: It appeared to me one night when I was down by the coast, I have been its loyal servant ever since.
translation: 有一天晚上，当我在海边时，我似乎意识到，从那时起，我就成了它忠实的仆人。 [you yi tian wan shang ， dang wo zai hai bian shi ， wo si hu yi shi dao ， cong na shi qi ， wo jiu cheng le ta zhong shi de pu ren 。]

english: I am its voice, I give action to its words, it serves a greater good than we can understand.
translation: 我是它的声音，我将它的话语付诸行动，它所服务的利益超出了我们的理解。 [wo shi ta de sheng yin ， wo jiang ta de hua yu fu zhu xing dong ， ta suo fu wu de li yi chao chu le wo men de li jie 。]

english: Are you talking about that egg on the table?
translation: 你是说桌上那个鸡蛋吗？ [ni shi shuo zhuo shang na ge ji dan ma ？]

english: YOU'RE TALKING TO A POWER YOU CANNOT COMPREHEND.
translation: 你正在与一种你无法理解的力量交谈。 [ni zheng zai yu yi zhong ni wu fa li jie de li liang jiao tan 。]

english: Wow... well then.
translation: 哇……那么好吧。 [wa …… na me hao ba 。]

english: Maybe there's someone more reasonable I can talk to.
translation: 也许我可以找个更通情达理的人谈谈。 [ye xu wo ke yi zhao ge geng tong qing da li de ren tan tan 。]

english: Great round one, will Jessica Rabbit ever love me?
translation: 第一轮很棒，杰西卡兔会爱我吗？ [di yi lun hen bang ， jie xi ka tu hui ai wo ma ？]

english: Outlook not so good.
translation: 前景不太好。 [qian jing bu tai hao 。]

english: The almighty egg, will my kingdom ever fall?
translation: 万能的蛋，我的王国会陷落吗？ [wan neng de dan ， wo de wang guo hui xian luo ma ？]

english: Concentrate and ask again.
translation: 集中注意力再问一次。 [ji zhong zhu yi li zai wen yi ci 。]

english: My mighty yolk, do you think I'd look good in a top hat?
translation: 我强大的蛋黄，你觉得我戴高顶帽子好看吗？ [wo qiang da de dan huang ， ni jue de wo dai gao ding mao zi hao kan ma ？]

english: As I see it, yes.
translation: 据我看来，是的。 [ju wo kan lai ， shi de 。]

english: Oh wise one, is there a wiser ruler than I?
translation: 聪明的人啊，还有比我更聪明的统治者吗？ [cong ming de ren a ， hai you bi wo geng cong ming de tong zhi zhe ma ？]

english: My sources say no.
translation: 我的消息来源说不。 [wo de xiao xi lai yuan shuo bu 。]

english: Great golden one, will I gain incredible riches this year?
translation: 伟大的金人，今年我会获得难以置信的财富吗？ [wei da de jin ren ， jin nian wo hui huo de nan yi zhi xin de cai fu ma ？]

english: Better not tell you now.
translation: 现在最好不要告诉你。 [xian zai zui hao bu yao gao su ni 。]

english: Maybe there's someone more sane I can talk to.
translation: 也许我可以和一个更理智的人交谈。 [ye xu wo ke yi he yi ge geng li zhi de ren jiao tan 。]

english: Paws is probably the best person to talk to right now.
translation: Paws 可能是目前最适合交谈的人。 [Paws  ke neng shi mu qian zui shi he jiao tan de ren 。]

english: Your Dukeness, I've discovered a revelation!
translation: 公爵大人，我发现了一个启示！ [gong jue da ren ， wo fa xian le yi ge qi shi ！]

english: What do they want, why can't they leave us?
translation: 他们想要什么，为什么他们不能离开我们？ [ta men xiang yao shen me ， wei shen me ta men bu neng li kai wo men ？]

english: That egg on the table... it is a fake!
translation: 桌子上的那个鸡蛋……是假的！ [zhuo zi shang de na ge ji dan …… shi jia de ！]

english: Don't be so foolish, of course it's real.
translation: 别傻了，这当然是真的。 [bie sha le ， zhe dang ran shi zhen de 。]

english: How do you know? Someone could have easily swapped it out for a fake one.
translation: 你怎么知道？有人可以很容易地把它换成假的。 [ni zen me zhi dao ？ you ren ke yi hen rong yi di ba ta huan cheng jia de 。]

english: That doesn't make sense, if this is a fake, how did you find the original?
translation: 这没道理，如果这是假的，你怎么找到正品的？ [zhe mei dao li ， ru guo zhe shi jia de ， ni zen me zhao dao zheng pin de ？]

english: Oh, I uh, found it in a burrow underneath the castle.
translation: 哦，我呃，在城堡下面的一个洞穴里发现的。 [o ， wo e ， zai cheng bao xia mian de yi ge dong xue li fa xian de 。]

english: Unlikely story. Since I found it, I've been watching it like a falcon.
translation: 不太可能的故事。自从我发现它以来，我一直像猎鹰一样注视着它。 [bu tai ke neng de gu shi 。 zi cong wo fa xian ta yi lai ， wo yi zhi xiang lie ying yi yang zhu shi zhe ta 。]

english: If you don't trust me, why don't you ask that egg?
translation: 如果你不相信我，为什么不去问那个鸡蛋呢？ [ru guo ni bu xiang xin wo ， wei shen me bu qu wen na ge ji dan ne ？]

english: Fine, but if you're trying to trick us, we'll dispose of you.
translation: 好吧，但如果你想欺骗我们，我们就会处理掉你。 [hao ba ， dan ru guo ni xiang qi pian wo men ， wo men jiu hui chu li diao ni 。]

english: Your magical eggness: Are you a fake version and does this coney hold the real one?
translation: 你的神奇蛋蛋：你是假蛋吗？这个兔子里有真蛋吗？ [ni de shen qi dan dan ： ni shi jia dan ma ？ zhe ge tu zi li you zhen dan ma ？]

english: -Sweating profusely- ...
translation: -大汗淋漓-... [- da han lin li -...]

english: Without a doubt.
translation: 无疑。 [wu yi 。]

english: What the flying carrot!
translation: 什么飞胡萝卜啊！ [shen me fei hu luo bo a ！]

english: Phew... see, I told you it's fake.
translation: 唷...看，我告诉过你这是假的。 [yo ... kan ， wo gao su guo ni zhe shi jia de 。]

english: I can't believe it, how long have I been made a fool of?
translation: 我简直不敢相信，我被愚弄多久了？ [wo jian zhi bu gan xiang xin ， wo bei yu nong duo jiu le ？]

english: Give me the real one, we need to rid ourselves of this imposter.
translation: 给我真实的，我们需要摆脱这个冒名顶替者。 [gei wo zhen shi de ， wo men xu yao bai tuo zhe ge mao ming ding ti zhe 。]

english: Duke Rabbacio takes the fake egg off you and swaps it with the real one.
translation: 拉巴西奥公爵把假鸡蛋从你身上拿下来，并用真鸡蛋交换。 [la ba xi ao gong jue ba jia ji dan cong ni shen shang na xia lai ， bing yong zhen ji dan jiao huan 。]

english: I'm glad we got that sorted, feel free to ensure it works properly.
translation: 我很高兴我们解决了这个问题，请放心确保它正常工作。 [wo hen gao xing wo men jie jue le zhe ge wen ti ， qing fang xin que bao ta zheng chang gong zuo 。]

english: I'll uh, dispose of this one for you.
translation: 我会呃，把这个给你处理掉。 [wo hui e ， ba zhe ge gei ni chu li diao 。]

english: Wise one: Do I have to have broccoli with my carrots tonight?
translation: 聪明人：今晚我必须把西兰花和胡萝卜一起吃吗？ [cong ming ren ： jin wan wo bi xu ba xi lan hua he hu luo bo yi qi chi ma ？]

english: [chosen negative option]
translation: [选择否定选项] [[ xuan ze fou ding xuan xiang ]]

english: Yes! Just what I wanted to hear, thank you for your help.
translation: 是的！正是我想听的，谢谢你的帮助。 [shi de ！ zheng shi wo xiang ting de ， xie xie ni de bang zhu 。]

english: I will let you ask but one question to the great supreme.
translation: 我只允许你向伟大的至尊者问一个问题。 [wo zhi yun xu ni xiang wei da de zhi zun zhe wen yi ge wen ti 。]

english: Oh, ghee thanks, I'm not sure what to ask, maybe...
translation: 哦，谢谢，我不知道该问什么，也许...... [o ， xie xie ， wo bu zhi dao gai wen shen me ， ye xu ......]

english: Egg: Should rabbits keep jumping through the strange portal that no one knows where it leads to?
translation: 伊戈：兔子应该继续跳进那个没人知道通向何方的奇怪入口吗？ [yi ge ： tu zi ying gai ji xu tiao jin na ge mei ren zhi dao tong xiang he fang de qi guai ru kou ma ？]

english: Well, that settles it, I'll send the order for all rabbits to cease jumping through the portal at once.
translation: 好吧，事情就这样解决了，我会立即下令所有兔子停止跳出传送门。 [hao ba ， shi qing jiu zhe yang jie jue le ， wo hui li ji xia ling suo you tu zi ting zhi tiao chu chuan song men 。]

english: You may leave me, keep that fake egg and dispose of it.
translation: 你可以离开我，保留那个假鸡蛋并处理掉它。 [ni ke yi li kai wo ， bao liu na ge jia ji dan bing chu li diao ta 。]

english: I'll also let everyone know you're a good rabbit, so if they need a paw, don't hesitate to help out.
translation: 我也会让每个人都知道你是一只好兔子，所以如果他们需要爪子，请毫不犹豫地提供帮助。 [wo ye hui rang mei ge ren dou zhi dao ni shi yi zhi hao tu zi ， suo yi ru guo ta men xu yao zhua zi ， qing hao bu you yu di ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: Great! I should return to Gelt to let him know what has happened.
translation: 伟大的！我应该回到盖尔特那里，让他知道发生了什么事。 [wei da de ！ wo ying gai hui dao gai er te na li ， rang ta zhi dao fa sheng le shen me shi 。]

english: Leave me, I have many questions to ask the mythical one.
translation: 放开我吧，我还有很多问题要问神话者。 [fang kai wo ba ， wo hai you hen duo wen ti yao wen shen hua zhe 。]

english: The Duke brushes you off, returning his focus to the egg.
translation: 公爵对你不予理睬，把注意力集中在鸡蛋上。 [gong jue dui ni bu yu li cai ， ba zhu yi li ji zhong zai ji dan shang 。]

english: What are you doing?! Step away from it.
translation: 你在干什么？！远离它。 [ni zai gan shen me ？！ yuan li ta 。]

english: Sorry Duke...
translation: 对不起杜克... [dui bu qi du ke ...]

english: Big Egg, will I ever...
translation: 大蛋，我会不会... [da dan ， wo hui bu hui ...]

english: None can talk to it except me!
translation: 除了我之外没有人能和它说话！ [chu le wo zhi wai mei you ren neng he ta shuo hua ！]

english: What is it, human? I'm working.
translation: 这是什么，人类？我在工作。 [zhe shi shen me ， ren lei ？ wo zai gong zuo 。]

english: How do I use the furnace?
translation: 我该如何使用炉子？ [wo gai ru he shi yong lu zi ？]

english: Put your ore on the conveyor belt to get it smelted. We'll stoke the boiler and operate the rest of the machinery for you.
translation: 将矿石放在传送带上进行熔炼。我们将为您给锅炉加燃料并操作其余的机器。 [jiang kuang shi fang zai chuan song dai shang jin xing rong lian 。 wo men jiang wei nin gei guo lu jia ran liao bing cao zuo qi yu de ji qi 。]

english: You'll have to help repair the furnace whenever a pipe blows, though. Just hit it with a hammer - that usually works.
translation: 不过，每当管道爆炸时，你就必须帮忙修理炉子。只需用锤子敲击即可 - 通常会起作用。 [bu guo ， mei dang guan dao bao zha shi ， ni jiu bi xu bang mang xiu li lu zi 。 zhi xu yong chui zi qiao ji ji ke  -  tong chang hui qi zuo yong 。]

english: You'll have to put money in the coffer to pay for our services. We charge 72,000 coins per hour; money is deducted as long as you're in this room with us.
translation: 您必须将钱存入保险箱来支付我们的服务费用。我们每小时收费72,000个币；只要您和我们一起住在这个房间，就会扣除费用。 [nin bi xu jiang qian cun ru bao xian xiang lai zhi fu wo men de fu wu fei yong 。 wo men mei xiao shi shou fei 72,000 ge bi ； zhi yao nin he wo men yi qi zhu zai zhe ge fang jian ， jiu hui kou chu fei yong 。]

english: Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
translation: 天哪，你真是个大矮人。 [tian na ， ni zhen shi ge da ai ren 。]

english: My brothers and I have a rare genetic condition affecting our growth. Rather than treating us as freaks, you might like to appreciate how useful it is that we can operate the machinery.
translation: 我和我的兄弟患有一种影响我们成长的罕见遗传病。您可能不想把我们视为怪胎，而应该欣赏我们操作机器的有用性。 [wo he wo de xiong di huan you yi zhong ying xiang wo men cheng zhang de han jian yi chuan bing 。 nin ke neng bu xiang ba wo men shi wei guai tai ， er ying gai xin shang wo men cao zuo ji qi de you yong xing 。]

english: Sorry.

english: Great, thanks!

english: Okay, great!

english: Good luck! Don't forget to come back when you need a new assignment.
translation: 祝你好运！当您需要新的任务时，请不要忘记回来。 [zhu ni hao yun ！ dang nin xu yao xin de ren wu shi ， qing bu yao wang ji hui lai 。]

translation: 我认为这不适合你。我要取消它吗？这不会消除您的任务连续记录。 [wo ren wei zhe bu shi he ni 。 wo yao qu xiao ta ma ？ zhe bu hui xiao chu nin de ren wu lian xu ji lu 。]

english: Yes, please cancel it.
translation: 是的，请取消。 [shi de ， qing qu xiao 。]

english: Alright, consider the task cancelled. You can now get a new assignment when you want one.
translation: 好吧，考虑任务被取消了。现在，您可以在需要时获得新的任务。 [hao ba ， kao lv ren wu bei qu xiao le 。 xian zai ， nin ke yi zai xu yao shi huo de xin de ren wu 。]

english: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
translation: 不，谢谢，我想尝试一下。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo xiang chang shi yi xia 。]

english: Good luck with that.
translation: 祝你好运。 [zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: 你有什么奖励给我，或者有什么可以交易的吗？ [ni you shen me jiang li gei wo ， huo zhe you shen me ke yi jiao yi de ma ？]

english: I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.
translation: 我有很多你可以获得的奖励，还有各种各样的杀手装备可供出售。 [wo you hen duo ni ke yi huo de de jiang li ， hai you ge zhong ge yang de sha shou zhuang bei ke gong chu shou 。]

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: 说说我的作业的难度吧。 [shuo shuo wo de zuo ye de nan du ba 。]

english: The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 目前，杀戮大师可以为您分配我们列表中的任何任务，无论您的战斗水平如何。 [mu qian ， sha lu da shi ke yi wei nin fen pei wo men lie biao zhong de ren he ren wu ， wu lun nin de zhan dou shui ping ru he 。]

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
translation: 没关系——我可以处理任何任务。 [mei guan xi —— wo ke yi chu li ren he ren wu 。]

english: That's the spirit.
translation: 这就是精神。 [zhe jiu shi jing shen 。]

english: In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: 以后，请不要给任何太艰难的事情。 [yi hou ， qing bu yao gei ren he tai jian nan de shi qing 。]

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: 好吧，从现在开始，所有屠戮大师在为你选择任务时都会考虑你的战斗水平，所以你不要做太难的事情。 [hao ba ， cong xian zai kai shi ， suo you tu lu da shi zai wei ni xuan ze ren wu shi du hui kao lv ni de zhan dou shui ping ， suo yi ni bu yao zuo tai nan de shi qing 。]

english: The Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: 杀手大师在为你选择任务时会考虑你的战斗水平，所以你不应该遇到太难的任务。 [sha shou da shi zai wei ni xuan ze ren wu shi hui kao lv ni de zhan dou shui ping ， suo yi ni bu ying gai yu dao tai nan de ren wu 。]

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: 没关系——我不想要太难的东西。 [mei guan xi —— wo bu xiang yao tai nan de dong xi 。]

english: Okay, we'll keep checking your combat level.
translation: 好的，我们会继续检查你的战斗水平。 [hao de ， wo men hui ji xu jian cha ni de zhan dou shui ping 。]

english: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: 别再检查我的战斗水平了——我可以承受任何事情！ [bie zai jian cha wo de zhan dou shui ping le —— wo ke yi cheng shou ren he shi qing ！]

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will assign you anything from their lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 好吧，从现在开始，所有的杀手大师都会从他们的列表中为你分配任何东西，无论你的战斗水平如何。 [hao ba ， cong xian zai kai shi ， suo you de sha shou da shi du hui cong ta men de lie biao zhong wei ni fen pei ren he dong xi ， wu lun ni de zhan dou shui ping ru he 。]

english: Tell me about your skillcape, please.
translation: 请告诉我你的技能。 [qing gao su wo ni de ji neng 。]

english: This is a Slayer's Skillcape. Only a true Slayer master is permitted to wear one and in recognition of such an achievement, Slayer masters may be persuaded to allow you to select the same assignment in a row.
translation: 这是杀手的技能斗篷。只有真正的杀手大师才允许佩戴它，并且为了表彰这一成就，杀手大师可能会被说服允许您连续选择相同的任务。 [zhe shi sha shou de ji neng dou peng 。 zhi you zhen zheng de sha shou da shi cai yun xu pei dai ta ， bing qie wei le biao zhang zhe yi cheng jiu ， sha shou da shi ke neng hui bei shuo fu yun xu nin lian xu xuan ze xiang tong de ren wu 。]

english: You need more training before you earn that honour, though.
translation: 不过，在获得这一荣誉之前，您需要更多的培训。 [bu guo ， zai huo de zhe yi rong yu zhi qian ， nin xu yao geng duo de pei xun 。]

english: May I buy a Slayer's Skillcape, please?
translation: 请问可以购买杀手技能斗篷吗？ [qing wen ke yi gou mai sha shou ji neng dou peng ma ？]

english: Well you have performed well as a student. I guess you have earned the right to wear such a prestigious cape now. The Slayer masters will recognize this cape and may offer you the same assignment twice in a row.
translation: 嗯，作为一名学生，你表现得很好。我想你现在已经有权利穿上这样一件著名的斗篷了。杀手大师会认出这件斗篷，并可能连续两次为你提供相同的任务。 [n ， zuo wei yi ming xue sheng ， ni biao xian de hen hao 。 wo xiang ni xian zai yi jing you quan li chuan shang zhe yang yi jian zhu ming de dou peng le 。 sha shou da shi hui ren chu zhe jian dou peng ， bing ke neng lian xu liang ci wei ni ti gong xiang tong de ren wu 。]

english: That will be 99000 coins, please.
translation: 那就 99000 个硬币吧。 [na jiu  99000  ge ying bi ba 。]

english: I've changed my mind; I don't want it.
translation: 我改变了主意；我不想要它。 [wo gai bian le zhu yi ； wo bu xiang yao ta 。]

english: Okay. Well, if you change it back again, I will be waiting.
translation: 好的。好吧，如果你再改回来，我会等。 [hao de 。 hao ba ， ru guo ni zai gai hui lai ， wo hui deng 。]

english: Great, I've always wanted one!
translation: 太好了，我一直想要一个！ [tai hao le ， wo yi zhi xiang yao yi ge ！]

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 但不幸的是，我身上没有足够的钱。 [dan bu xing de shi ， wo shen shang mei you zu gou de qian 。]

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 好吧，等你回来了就回来见我吧。 [hao ba ， deng ni hui lai le jiu hui lai jian wo ba 。]

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 不幸的是，所有技能斗篷都只提供免费兜帽，这是技能升级交易的一部分；买一送一，你懂的。因此，在我向您出售一件之前，您需要释放一些库存空间。 [bu xing de shi ， suo you ji neng dou peng dou zhi ti gong mian fei dou mao ， zhe shi ji neng sheng ji jiao yi de yi bu fen ； mai yi song yi ， ni dong de 。 yin ci ， zai wo xiang nin chu shou yi jian zhi qian ， nin xu yao shi fang yi xie ku cun kong jian 。]

translation: 埃尤普。我们不常接待游客来这里。 [ai you pu 。 wo men bu chang jie dai you ke lai zhe li 。]

translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Beats me. All I know is, there's dust devils in here, and I'm here to make sure only people with permission can kill 'em.
translation: 打败了我。我所知道的是，这里有尘暴，我来这里是为了确保只有获得许可的人才能杀死它们。 [da bai le wo 。 wo suo zhi dao de shi ， zhe li you chen bao ， wo lai zhe li shi wei le que bao zhi you huo de xu ke de ren cai neng sha si ta men 。]

english: Can I kill them?
translation: 我可以杀掉他们吗？ [wo ke yi sha diao ta men ma ？]

english: You got a Slayer task for it, so sure, be my guest.
translation: 你有一个杀手任务，所以当然，请成为我的客人。 [ni you yi ge sha shou ren wu ， suo yi dang ran ， qing cheng wei wo de ke ren 。]

english: Not without a Slayer task. Go talk to a Slayer Master about it.
translation: 并非没有杀手任务。去和屠夫大师谈谈吧。 [bing fei mei you sha shou ren wu 。 qu he tu fu da shi tan tan ba 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: The name's Dusty Aliv. I guard this place for the Slayer Masters.
translation: 我的名字叫达斯蒂·阿利夫。我为杀手大师守护这里。 [wo de ming zi jiao da si di · a li fu 。 wo wei sha shou da shi shou hu zhe li 。]

english: That doesn't sound like a great job.
translation: 这听起来不像是一份很棒的工作。 [zhe ting qi lai bu xiang shi yi fen hen bang de gong zuo 。]

english: Eh, it has its perks. Plus it beats flying around Gielinor after numbskulls like you trying to deliver mail like some people I know.
translation: 嗯，它有它的好处。而且，这比像我认识的一些人那样试图递送邮件的笨蛋在吉林诺周围飞行要好得多。 [n ， ta you ta de hao chu 。 er qie ， zhe bi xiang wo ren shi de yi xie ren na yang shi tu di song you jian de ben dan zai ji lin nuo zhou wei fei xing yao hao de duo 。]

english: Nice sword.
translation: 好剑。 [hao jian 。]

english: Thanks. Probably shouldn't tell you about the previous owner though.

english: What happened to them?
translation: 他们怎么了？ [ta men zen me le ？]

english: Let's just say the heat got to them.

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: See ya.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Oi! Only people with a Slayer task can slay in here!

english: Who are you?

english: Nice sword.
translation: 好剑。 [hao jian 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Hello human.
translation: 你好人类。 [ni hao ren lei 。]

english: Hello. What do you do here?
translation: 你好。你在这里做什么？ [ni hao 。 ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm Dusuri. I specialise in unique minerals that can't be found on Gielinor.
translation: 我是杜苏里。我专注于吉林诺上找不到的独特矿物。 [wo shi du su li 。 wo zhuan zhu yu ji lin nuo shang zhao bu dao de du te kuang wu 。]

english: Can't be found on Gielinor? Where do they come from then?
translation: 在 Gielinor 上找不到？那么他们从哪里来呢？ [zai  Gielinor  shang zhao bu dao ？ na me ta men cong na li lai ne ？]

english: To be honest, we don't fully know. All we know is that they can be found within shooting stars.
translation: 老实说，我们并不完全知道。我们所知道的是它们可以在流星中找到。 [lao shi shuo ， wo men bing bu wan quan zhi dao 。 wo men suo zhi dao de shi ta men ke yi zai liu xing zhong zhao dao 。]

english: Shooting stars?
translation: 流星？ [liu xing ？]

english: That's right. They fall from the sky from time to time. They can be mined for the unique minerals that I specialise in.
translation: 这是正确的。它们时不时地从天上掉下来。它们可以开采我专门研究的独特矿物。 [zhe shi zheng que de 。 ta men shi bu shi di cong tian shang diao xia lai 。 ta men ke yi kai cai wo zhuan men yan jiu de du te kuang wu 。]

english: If you ever come across one, I'd be happy to trade you for any stardust you find.
translation: 如果你遇到了，我很乐意用你来交换你找到的任何星尘。 [ru guo ni yu dao le ， wo hen le yi yong ni lai jiao huan ni zhao dao de ren he xing chen 。]

english: I'll bear that in mind.
translation: 我会记住这一点。 [wo hui ji zhu zhe yi dian 。]

english: Good luck out there.
translation: 祝你好运。 [zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Oh yes. I've seen those before.
translation: 哦是的。我以前见过那些。 [o shi de 。 wo yi qian jian guo na xie 。]

english: Wonderful. If you ever get any stardust from them, I'd be happy to trade you for it.
translation: 精彩的。如果你能从他们那里得到任何星尘，我很乐意用你来交换。 [jing cai de 。 ru guo ni neng cong ta men na li de dao ren he xing chen ， wo hen le yi yong ni lai jiao huan 。]

english: I have some here. Can we trade?
translation: 我这里有一些。我们可以交易吗？ [wo zhe li you yi xie 。 wo men ke yi jiao yi ma ？]

english: Not now, I'm afraid. Maybe another time.
translation: 恐怕不是现在。也许下次吧。 [kong pa bu shi xian zai 。 ye xu xia ci ba 。]

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: Can we trade?
translation: 我们可以交易吗？ [wo men ke yi jiao yi ma ？]

english: What do you sell?
translation: 你卖什么？ [ni mai shen me ？]

english: I have packs of gems and soft clay if they take your fancy. I also have some interesting star fragments that seem to be able to recolour certain metals.
translation: 我有成包的宝石和软粘土，如果你喜欢的话。我还有一些有趣的星星碎片，它们似乎能够给某些金属重新着色。 [wo you cheng bao de bao shi he ruan nian tu ， ru guo ni xi huan de hua 。 wo hai you yi xie you qu de xing xing sui pian ， ta men si hu neng gou gei mou xie jin shu chong xin zhuo se 。]

english: Most notably, I have a unique ring that we found embedded within a star once. It seems to have magical properties that we don't fully understand. What we do know is that it can improve your skill while mining.
translation: 最值得注意的是，我有一枚独特的戒指，我们曾发现它嵌在一颗星星中。它似乎具有我们尚未完全理解的神奇特性。我们所知道的是，它可以提高您采矿时的技能。 [zui zhi de zhu yi de shi ， wo you yi mei du te de jie zhi ， wo men ceng fa xian ta qian zai yi ke xing xing zhong 。 ta si hu ju you wo men shang wei wan quan li jie de shen qi te xing 。 wo men suo zhi dao de shi ， ta ke yi ti gao nin cai kuang shi de ji neng 。]

english: What can you tell me about shooting stars?
translation: 关于流星，你能告诉我什么吗？ [guan yu liu xing ， ni neng gao su wo shen me ma ？]

english: Not a lot really. All I know is that they fall from the sky from time to time and that you can mine them.
