translation: 再请客一次，我就准备好在复活节再次工作了。 [zai qing ke yi ci ， wo jiu zhun bei hao zai fu huo jie zai ci gong zuo le 。]

english: ANOTHER treat?
translation: 另一种款待？ [ling yi zhong kuan dai ？]

english: The last one!
translation: 最后一张！ [zui hou yi zhang ！]

english: It better be.
translation: 最好是这样。 [zui hao shi zhe yang 。]

english: That dance was amazing! Well done. I feel so... Invigorated!
translation: 那个舞蹈太棒了！干得好。我感觉好……充满活力！ [na ge wu dao tai bang le ！ gan de hao 。 wo gan jue hao …… chong man huo li ！]

english: Lawks! Look at the time, I should get back to Varrock to set up the Eggs!
translation: 劳克斯！看时间了，我该回瓦罗克去设置蛋了！ [lao ke si ！ kan shi jian le ， wo gai hui wa luo ke qu she zhi dan le ！]

english: See you up there!
translation: 上面见！ [shang mian jian ！]

english: You need [1-5] free inventory [slots/slot] to receive your Easter event rewards.
translation: 您需要 [1-5] 个免费库存 [槽/槽] 才能获得复活节活动奖励。 [nin xu yao  [1-5]  ge mian fei ku cun  [ cao / cao ]  cai neng huo de fu huo jie huo dong jiang li 。]

english: I have something fun for you, [player name]!
translation: 我有一些有趣的事情给你，[玩家名字]！ [wo you yi xie you qu de shi qing gei ni ，[ wan jia ming zi ]！]

english: Come back when you have more space.
translation: 当你有更多空间时再回来。 [dang ni you geng duo kong jian shi zai hui lai 。]

english: Thanks for saving our bacon and eggs again, [player name]!
translation: 感谢您再次拯救我们的培根和鸡蛋，[玩家姓名]！ [gan xie nin zai ci zheng jiu wo men de pei gen he ji dan ，[ wan jia xing ming ]！]

english: You've completed the Easter event: One glum bunny
translation: 您已完成复活节活动：一只闷闷不乐的兔子 [nin yi wan cheng fu huo jie huo dong ： yi zhi men men bu le de tu zi]

english: Oh it's always my pleasure to get these delicious eggs!
translation: 哦，能得到这些美味的鸡蛋总是我的荣幸！ [o ， neng de dao zhe xie mei wei de ji dan zong shi wo de rong xing ！]

english: I mean... to help out a friend in need!
translation: 我的意思是……帮助有需要的朋友！ [wo de yi si shi …… bang zhu you xu yao de peng you ！]

english: Isn't it strange something always happens around this time of year that needs me to come and save the day?
translation: 每年的这个时候总会发生一些需要我来拯救世界的事情，这不是很奇怪吗？ [mei nian de zhe ge shi hou zong hui fa sheng yi xie xu yao wo lai zheng jiu shi jie de shi qing ， zhe bu shi hen qi guai ma ？]

english: Oh really? I don't keep track, so much to do around now.
translation: 哦真的吗？我不记得了，现在要做的事情太多了。 [o zhen de ma ？ wo bu ji de le ， xian zai yao zuo de shi qing tai duo le 。]

english: Oh well, I expect I'll be seeing you again next year.
translation: 哦，好吧，我希望明年能再次见到你。 [o ， hao ba ， wo xi wang ming nian neng zai ci jian dao ni 。]

english: Yes, till neggxt year!
translation: 是的，直到后年！ [shi de ， zhi dao hou nian ！]

english: Would you please stop [player name], I'tsvery hard to rush back here so fast.
translation: 请你停下来[玩家名字]，我很难这么快赶回来。 [qing ni ting xia lai [ wan jia ming zi ]， wo hen nan zhe me kuai gan hui lai 。]

english: You're coming back here, whenever I do?
translation: 我什么时候回来你都会回来吗？ [wo shen me shi hou hui lai ni du hui hui lai ma ？]

english: Precisely, so we'd all appreciate it if you didn't.
translation: 准确地说，如果您不这样做，我们都会感激不尽。 [zhun que di shuo ， ru guo nin bu zhe yang zuo ， wo men du hui gan ji bu jin 。]

english: But why?
translation: 但为什么？ [dan wei shen me ？]

english: Who knows what you'd get up to down here on your own.
translation: 谁知道你一个人在这里会做什么。 [shui zhi dao ni yi ge ren zai zhe li hui zuo shen me 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Where do I get the Dried cocoa?
translation: 哪里可以买到干可可？ [na li ke yi mai dao gan ke ke ？]

english: Where do I get the bottle of Hosidius milk?
translation: 在哪里可以买到一瓶 Hosidius 牛奶？ [zai na li ke yi mai dao yi ping  Hosidius  niu nai ？]

english: Where do I get the Special spices?
translation: 哪里可以买到特殊香料？ [na li ke yi mai dao te shu xiang liao ？]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: The Easter Bunny is looking awfully glum this year.
translation: 今年的复活节兔子看起来非常闷闷不乐。 [jin nian de fu huo jie tu zi kan qi lai fei chang men men bu le 。]

english: Happy Easter!
translation: 复活节快乐！ [fu huo jie kuai le ！]

english: And to you!
translation: 还有你！ [hai you ni ！]

english: Thanks for your help!  You should have a break now.  Come back in [number] minutes if you want to hand out more eggs.
translation: 感谢您的帮助！  你现在应该休息一下了。  如果您想分发更多鸡蛋，请在 [number] 分钟后回来。 [gan xie nin de bang zhu ！   ni xian zai ying gai xiu xi yi xia le 。   ru guo nin xiang fen fa geng duo ji dan ， qing zai  [number]  fen zhong hou hui lai 。]

english: But I'm afraid I've left things a bit late this year.  I'm going to need some help to get all these eggs delivered!  Would you help me, [player name]?
translation: 但恐怕今年我把事情放得有点晚了。  我需要一些帮助才能交付所有这些鸡蛋！  你能帮我吗，[玩家姓名]？ [dan kong pa jin nian wo ba shi qing fang de you dian wan le 。   wo xu yao yi xie bang zhu cai neng jiao fu suo you zhe xie ji dan ！   ni neng bang wo ma ，[ wan jia xing ming ]？]

english: Yes, of course.
translation: 是的当然。 [shi di dang ran 。]

english: Oh dear, you don't have any free inventory space.  Talk to me again when you have.
translation: 哦，亲爱的，您没有任何可用的库存空间。  当你有的时候再跟我说话。 [o ， qin ai de ， nin mei you ren he ke yong de ku cun kong jian 。   dang ni you de shi hou zai gen wo shuo hua 。]

english: Splendid, splendid!  Here's a basket of eggs.  Hand out as many as you can before they disappear and then come back to me.  You've only got two minutes!
translation: 精彩，精彩！  这是一篮子鸡蛋。  在他们消失之前尽可能多地分发出去，然后再回到我身边。  你只有两分钟的时间！ [jing cai ， jing cai ！   zhe shi yi lan zi ji dan 。   zai ta men xiao shi zhi qian jin ke neng duo di fen fa chu qu ， ran hou zai hui dao wo shen bian 。   ni zhi you liang fen zhong de shi jian ！]

english: Splendid, splendid!  Here's a basket of eggs.  Hand out as many as you can before they disappear and then come back to me for your reward.  You've only got two minutes!
translation: 精彩，精彩！  这是一篮子鸡蛋。  在它们消失之前尽可能多地分发出去，然后再回来找我领取奖励。  你只有两分钟的时间！ [jing cai ， jing cai ！   zhe shi yi lan zi ji dan 。   zai ta men xiao shi zhi qian jin ke neng duo di fen fa chu qu ， ran hou zai hui lai zhao wo ling qu jiang li 。   ni zhi you liang fen zhong de shi jian ！]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Oh dear oh dear!  I've got to hurry!
translation: 哦亲爱的哦亲爱的！  我得快点了！ [o qin ai de o qin ai de ！   wo de kuai dian le ！]

english: Quickly, [player name]!  Hand out those eggs before they vanish!
translation: 快点，[玩家姓名]！  在鸡蛋消失之前把它们分发出去！ [kuai dian ，[ wan jia xing ming ]！   zai ji dan xiao shi zhi qian ba ta men fen fa chu qu ！]

english: Oh dear, [player name]. You didn't hand out any eggs at all! Do you want to try again?
translation: 哦天哪，[玩家姓名]。你根本就没有送鸡蛋！您想再试一次吗？ [o tian na ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。 ni gen ben jiu mei you song ji dan ！ nin xiang zai shi yi ci ma ？]

english: Thank you, [player name]!  You handed out [number] eggs!
translation: 谢谢你，[玩家姓名]！  您分发了[数量]个鸡蛋！ [xie xie ni ，[ wan jia xing ming ]！   nin fen fa le [ shu liang ] ge ji dan ！]

english: Thank you, [player name]!  You handed out [number] eggs!  Here is your Easter reward!
translation: 谢谢你，[玩家姓名]！  您分发了[数量]个鸡蛋！  这是你的复活节奖励！ [xie xie ni ，[ wan jia xing ming ]！   nin fen fa le [ shu liang ] ge ji dan ！   zhe shi ni de fu huo jie jiang li ！]

english: If you lose it, you can get another one from Diango in Draynor.
translation: 如果你丢失了它，你可以从德拉诺的迪安戈那里得到另一张。 [ru guo ni diu shi le ta ， ni ke yi cong de la nuo de di an ge na li de dao ling yi zhang 。]

english: Yes, of course
translation: 是的当然 [shi di dang ran]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Leave us to our fate. We care nothing for the world that betrayed us, or those that come from it.
translation: 让我们听天由命吧。我们对背叛我们的世界或来自这个世界的人毫不关心。 [rang wo men ting tian you ming ba 。 wo men dui bei pan wo men de shi jie huo lai zi zhe ge shi jie de ren hao bu guan xin 。]

english: Hello. I represent the Museum of Varrock, and I have reason to believe there may be some kinds of artefacts of historical significance in the nearby area...
translation: 你好。我代表瓦罗克博物馆，我有理由相信附近地区可能存在某种具有历史意义的文物…… [ni hao 。 wo dai biao wa luo ke bo wu guan ， wo you li you xiang xin fu jin di qu ke neng cun zai mou zhong ju you li shi yi yi de wen wu ……]

english: Ah yes. The only time people care about our existence is when they think they have something to gain from us.
translation: 啊，是的。人们唯一关心我们的存在的时候就是他们认为可以从我们身上得到一些东西的时候。 [a ， shi de 。 ren men wei yi guan xin wo men de cun zai de shi hou jiu shi ta men ren wei ke yi cong wo men shen shang de dao yi xie dong xi de shi hou 。]

english: I have nothing to say to you. You and your kind are not welcome here.
translation: 我无话可说。这里不欢迎你和你的同类。 [wo wu hua ke shuo 。 zhe li bu huan ying ni he ni de tong lei 。]

english: Please, if I can just have a few minutes of your time to ask some questions...?
translation: 请问，我能否占用您几分钟的时间来问一些问题……？ [qing wen ， wo neng fou zhan yong nin ji fen zhong de shi jian lai wen yi xie wen ti ……？]

english: (sigh) I suppose I can spare you that. What do you wish to know about?
translation: （叹气）我想我可以省去你的麻烦。您想了解什么？ [（ tan qi ） wo xiang wo ke yi sheng qu ni de ma fan 。 nin xiang liao jie shen me ？]

english: Why are all of the people here so hostile? You would think I was asking you for money instead of just for answers to a few questions...
translation: 为什么这里的人都这么充满敌意？你可能会认为我是在向你要钱，而不只是为了回答几个问题...... [wei shen me zhe li de ren dou zhe me chong man di yi ？ ni ke neng hui ren wei wo shi zai xiang ni yao qian ， er bu zhi shi wei le hui da ji ge wen ti ......]

english: It is a long story, and I doubt you have much interest in hearing it. Your sort never are, you just take what you can of ours, and then abandon us once more to the desert.
translation: 这是一个很长的故事，我怀疑你有多大兴趣听它。你们这种人从来都不是，你们只是拿走我们能拿走的东西，然后再次把我们扔到沙漠里。 [zhe shi yi ge hen zhang de gu shi ， wo huai yi ni you duo da xing qu ting ta 。 ni men zhe zhong ren cong lai dou bu shi ， ni men zhi shi na zou wo men neng na zou de dong xi ， ran hou zai ci ba wo men reng dao sha mo li 。]

english: Actually, I'd be quite interested to hear what it is you have to say to excuse the attitude everybody in this village seems to have.
translation: 事实上，我很想听听你要说什么来原谅这个村子里每个人的态度。 [shi shi shang ， wo hen xiang ting ting ni yao shuo shen me lai yuan liang zhe ge cun zi li mei ge ren de tai du 。]

english: Ah, it all begun many generations ago, when our ancestors were the proud rulers of these lands...
translation: 啊，这一切都始于许多代以前，当时我们的祖先是这片土地自豪的统治者…… [a ， zhe yi qie dou shi yu xu duo dai yi qian ， dang shi wo men de zu xian shi zhe pian tu di zi hao de tong zhi zhe ……]

english: My ancestors lived far to the North of here, and our lands stretched from the sea in the East to the river Lum, and the mountain of ice. From coast to coast, North to South, our domain was absolute.
translation: 我的祖先住在离这里很远的北方，我们的土地从东方的大海一直延伸到卢姆河和冰山。从东海岸到西海岸，从北到南，我们的领地是绝对的。 [wo de zu xian zhu zai li zhe li hen yuan de bei fang ， wo men de tu di cong dong fang de da hai yi zhi yan shen dao lu mu he he bing shan 。 cong dong hai an dao xi hai an ， cong bei dao nan ， wo men de ling di shi jue dui de 。]

english: Our god was kind to us, and blessed us with prosperity and happiness, and in return we were merciless to his enemies wherever we found them.
translation: 我们的上帝对我们很仁慈，赐予我们繁荣和幸福，而作为回报，我们对他的敌人无论在哪里发现他们都是无情的。 [wo men de shang di dui wo men hen ren ci ， ci yu wo men fan rong he xing fu ， er zuo wei hui bao ， wo men dui ta de di ren wu lun zai na li fa xian ta men dou shi wu qing de 。]

english: Then came the betrayal.
translation: 然后就是背叛。 [ran hou jiu shi bei pan 。]

english: Our god was banished, leaving us helpless to our fates.
translation: 我们的神被放逐了，让我们对自己的命运束手无策。 [wo men de shen bei fang zhu le ， rang wo men dui zi ji de ming yun shu shou wu ce 。]

english: Without his protection, we were forced to fend for ourselves once more, against the enemies that sought to destroy us through their petty jealousies.
translation: 没有了他的保护，我们被迫再次自力更生，对抗那些试图通过小小的嫉妒来摧毁我们的敌人。 [mei you le ta de bao hu ， wo men bei po zai ci zi li geng sheng ， dui kang na xie shi tu tong guo xiao xiao de ji du lai cui hui wo men de di ren 。]

english: But we did not succumb without fighting! The spiteful Saradomin and pathetic Zamorak warred with each other, but the hatred they had for each other was as nothing to the hatred they held towards us!
translation: 但我们并没有不战而屈人之兵！恶毒的萨拉多米和可怜的萨莫拉克彼此交战，但他们对彼此的仇恨与他们对我们的仇恨相比根本不算什么！ [dan wo men bing mei you bu zhan er qu ren zhi bing ！ e du de sa la duo mi he ke lian de sa mo la ke bi ci jiao zhan ， dan ta men dui bi ci de chou hen yu ta men dui wo men de chou hen xiang bi gen ben bu suan shen me ！]

english: With each battle they waged, we lost more and more land, unable to fight on all fronts, and were pushed further and further South into this gods-forsaken desert.
translation: 随着他们的每一次战斗，我们失去了越来越多的土地，无法在所有战线上作战，并且被越来越南推到这片被诸神遗弃的沙漠中。 [sui zhe ta men de mei yi ci zhan dou ， wo men shi qu le yue lai yue duo de tu di ， wu fa zai suo you zhan xian shang zuo zhan ， bing qie bei yue lai yue nan tui dao zhe pian bei zhu shen yi qi de sha mo zhong 。]

english: Our greatest hero, Azzanadra, was finally trapped in a strange stone structure to the South of here, and bound within by terrible powers...
translation: 我们最伟大的英雄阿扎纳德拉最终被困在了这里南部的一座奇怪的石头结构中，并被可怕的力量束缚在其中...... [wo men zui wei da de ying xiong a zha na de la zui zhong bei kun zai le zhe li nan bu de yi zuo qi guai de shi tou jie gou zhong ， bing bei ke pa de li liang shu fu zai qi zhong ......]

english: And with that our lands, our homes, our very lives were stolen from us! Too weak to reclaim what was rightfully ours, we made our homes here, knowing that someday Azzanadra will
translation: 我们的土地、我们的家园、我们的生命就这样被偷走了！我们太弱了，无法夺回属于我们的东西，我们在这里安家，知道有一天阿扎纳德拉会 [wo men de tu di 、 wo men de jia yuan 、 wo men de sheng ming jiu zhe yang bei tou zou le ！ wo men tai ruo le ， wu fa duo hui shu yu wo men de dong xi ， wo men zai zhe li an jia ， zhi dao you yi tian a zha na de la hui]

english: return with his magnificent power, and bring us back to our former glory...
translation: 带着他强大的力量回归，让我们重获昔日的辉煌…… [dai zhe ta qiang da de li liang hui gui ， rang wo men chong huo xi ri de hui huang ……]

english: So you're upset because of something that happened hundreds of years ago?
translation: 所以你因为几百年前发生的事情而感到不安？ [suo yi ni yin wei ji bai nian qian fa sheng de shi qing er gan dao bu an ？]

english: Seems to me like maybe you should find some closure, and let the past go...
translation: 在我看来，也许你应该找到一些结束，让过去过去...... [zai wo kan lai ， ye xu ni ying gai zhao dao yi xie jie shu ， rang guo qu guo qu ......]

english: The insults heaped upon my race will never be forgotten, will never be forgiven and will never again be overlooked.
translation: 对我的种族所施加的侮辱将永远不会被忘记，永远不会被原谅，也永远不会再被忽视。 [dui wo de zhong zu suo shi jia de wu ru jiang yong yuan bu hui bei wang ji ， yong yuan bu hui bei yuan liang ， ye yong yuan bu hui zai bei hu shi 。]

english: Someday, a harsh wind will blow upon this land, uncovering the wrongs of the past, and we will get back what is rightfully ours. Until such a day we will bide our time here, and will
translation: 总有一天，一阵狂风将吹过这片土地，揭露过去的错误，我们将拿回属于我们的东西。直到这一天，我们将在这里等待时机，并将 [zong you yi tian ， yi zhen kuang feng jiang chui guo zhe pian tu di ， jie lu guo qu de cuo wu ， wo men jiang na hui shu yu wo men de dong xi 。 zhi dao zhe yi tian ， wo men jiang zai zhe li deng dai shi ji ， bing jiang]

english: always be ready with our blades for our righteous vengeance.
translation: 时刻准备着我们的利刃，进行正义的复仇。 [shi ke zhun bei zhe wo men de li ren ， jin xing zheng yi de fu chou 。]

english: I don't really care what your story is to be honest, there is no excuse for such rudeness or hostility.
translation: 说实话，我真的不在乎你的故事是什么，这种粗鲁或敌意没有任何借口。 [shuo shi hua ， wo zhen de bu zai hu ni de gu shi shi shen me ， zhe zhong cu lu huo di yi mei you ren he jie kou 。]

english: I have done nothing wrong to you, but everybody here treats me like I have committed some great crime against the village.
translation: 我没有对你做任何错事，但这里的每个人都对待我，就像我对村庄犯下了重大罪行一样。 [wo mei you dui ni zuo ren he cuo shi ， dan zhe li de mei ge ren dou dui dai wo ， jiu xiang wo dui cun zhuang fan xia le zhong da zui xing yi yang 。]

english: That is because, from our point of view, you have.
translation: 那是因为，从我们的角度来看，你已经做到了。 [na shi yin wei ， cong wo men de jiao du lai kan ， ni yi jing zuo dao le 。]

english: What? Just because I entered your village?
translation: 什么？就因为我进了你们村子？ [shen me ？ jiu yin wei wo jin le ni men cun zi ？]

english: You have no right to be here! You have no right to the life you have, for it was taken at our expense!
translation: 你没有权利在这里！你没有权利拥有你所拥有的生命，因为它是以我们为代价而夺走的！ [ni mei you quan li zai zhe li ！ ni mei you quan li yong you ni suo yong you de sheng ming ， yin wei ta shi yi wo men wei dai jia er duo zou de ！]

english: Whatever... No wonder all you loonies live out here in the desert by yourselves.
translation: 不管怎样……难怪你们这些疯子独自住在沙漠里。 [bu guan zen yang …… nan guai ni men zhe xie feng zi du zi zhu zai sha mo li 。]

english: I was wondering if you knew anything about some treasure somewhere around here?
translation: 我想知道你是否知道这附近有什么宝藏？ [wo xiang zhi dao ni shi fou zhi dao zhe fu jin you shen me bao zang ？]

english: I have some evidence that there might be some kind of treasure hidden very close to this village...
translation: 我有一些证据表明这个村庄附近可能隐藏着某种宝藏...... [wo you yi xie zheng ju biao ming zhe ge cun zhuang fu jin ke neng yin cang zhe mou zhong bao zang ......]

english: If I knew of any treasure I would not choose to spend my life in this gods-forsaken desert.
translation: 如果我知道有什么宝藏，我就不会选择在这片被诸神遗弃的沙漠里度过一生。 [ru guo wo zhi dao you shen me bao zang ， wo jiu bu hui xuan ze zai zhe pian bei zhu shen yi qi de sha mo li du guo yi sheng 。]

english: Do you know anything about some kind of fortress nearby? I have reason to believe there is, or at least used to be, some kind of fortress very close to here...
translation: 你知道附近有什么堡垒吗？我有理由相信这里附近有，或者至少曾经有某种堡垒…… [ni zhi dao fu jin you shen me bao lei ma ？ wo you li you xiang xin zhe li fu jin you ， huo zhe zhi shao ceng jing you mou zhong bao lei ……]

english: Nobody would build anything in this wasteland unless they were forced to, to survive.
translation: 除非为了生存而被迫，否则没有人会在这片荒地上建造任何东西。 [chu fei wei le sheng cun er bei po ， fou ze mei you ren hui zai zhe pian huang di shang jian zao ren he dong xi 。]

english: I know of no fortress, I know of no reason why anyone would ever bother doing anything out here in the desert.
translation: 我不知道有什么堡垒，也不知道为什么有人会费心在沙漠里做任何事。 [wo bu zhi dao you shen me bao lei ， ye bu zhi dao wei shen me you ren hui fei xin zai sha mo li zuo ren he shi 。]

english: Actually, there was nothing I really wanted to ask you about.
translation: 其实我也没什么想问你的。 [qi shi wo ye mei shen me xiang wen ni de 。]

english: Yes, it is exactly like your sort to waste my time in such a way.
translation: 是的，你就是这样浪费我时间的人。 [shi de ， ni jiu shi zhe yang lang fei wo shi jian de ren 。]

english: (above)
translation: （多于） [（ duo yu ）]

english: So tell me... Did you ever hear of something called the Diamonds of Azzanadra?
translation: 那么告诉我...你听说过一种叫做 Azzanadra 钻石的东西吗？ [na me gao su wo ... ni ting shuo guo yi zhong jiao zuo  Azzanadra  zuan shi de dong xi ma ？]

english: This is the treasure which you seek???
translation: 这就是你要找的宝藏？？？ [zhe jiu shi ni yao zhao de bao zang ？？？]

english: Please accept my apologies! I thought you were but some opportunistic thief, looking to steal what heritage we have left! Now I see that you are in fact a brave adventurer,
translation: 请接受我的歉意！我以为你不过是个投机取巧的小偷，想偷走我们留下的遗产！现在我发现你其实是一个勇敢的冒险家， [qing jie shou wo de qian yi ！ wo yi wei ni bu guo shi ge tou ji qu qiao de xiao tou ， xiang tou zou wo men liu xia de yi chan ！ xian zai wo fa xian ni qi shi shi yi ge yong gan de mao xian jia ，]

english: looking to restore our glories back upon us!
translation: 期待恢复我们的荣耀！ [qi dai hui fu wo men de rong yao ！]

english: Uh... yeah... So anyway, you have heard of them?
translation: 呃...是的...那么无论如何，你听说过他们吗？ [e ... shi de ... na me wu lun ru he ， ni ting shuo guo ta men ma ？]

english: Heard of them? Of course I have heard of them! They are the legacy of the great Mahjarrat hero, Azzanadra!
translation: 听说过他们吗？我当然听说过他们！它们是伟大的 Mahjarrat 英雄 Azzanadra 的遗产！ [ting shuo guo ta men ma ？ wo dang ran ting shuo guo ta men ！ ta men shi wei da de  Mahjarrat  ying xiong  Azzanadra  de yi chan ！]

english: So... do you have any idea where they might be? I have a feeling they will be very valuable.
translation: 那么...你知道他们可能在哪里吗？我有一种感觉，它们将会非常有价值。 [na me ... ni zhi dao ta men ke neng zai na li ma ？ wo you yi zhong gan jue ， ta men jiang hui fei chang you jia zhi 。]

english: Uh, valuable as historical artefacts I mean, obviously.
translation: 呃，显然，我的意思是作为历史文物有价值。 [e ， xian ran ， wo de yi si shi zuo wei li shi wen wu you jia zhi 。]

english: They were stolen by warriors of the false god Zamorak generations ago. When you find the warriors, you will find the diamonds.
translation: 它们在几代之前就被伪神萨莫拉克的战士偷走了。当你找到战士时，你就会找到钻石。 [ta men zai ji dai zhi qian jiu bei wei shen sa mo la ke de zhan shi tou zou le 。 dang ni zhao dao zhan shi shi ， ni jiu hui zhao dao zuan shi 。]

english: I suspect they will not willingly part with such objects of power however.
translation: 然而，我怀疑他们不会心甘情愿地放弃这些权力对象。 [ran er ， wo huai yi ta men bu hui xin gan qing yuan di fang qi zhe xie quan li dui xiang 。]

english: Beware too, for these warriors are very powerful; they have taken the powers of the diamonds into themselves!
translation: 也要小心，因为这些战士非常强大；他们已经将钻石的力量融入了自己！ [ye yao xiao xin ， yin wei zhe xie zhan shi fei chang qiang da ； ta men yi jing jiang zuan shi de li liang rong ru le zi ji ！]

english: How do you mean?
translation: 你是什​​么意思？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: Each diamond has an elemental quality...
translation: 每颗钻石都有其元素品质... [mei ke zuan shi dou you qi yuan su pin zhi ...]

english: There is the Diamond of Blood, the Diamond of Ice, the Diamond of Smoke and the Diamond of Shadow.
translation: 有血之钻石、冰之钻石、烟之钻石和影之钻石。 [you xue zhi zuan shi 、 bing zhi zuan shi 、 yan zhi zuan shi he ying zhi zuan shi 。]

english: You should expect the warriors to have taken some aspect of these diamonds as their own...
translation: 你应该预料到战士们已经将这些钻石的某些方面据为己有...... [ni ying gai yu liao dao zhan shi men yi jing jiang zhe xie zuan shi de mou xie fang mian ju wei ji you ......]

english: Do you have any idea how I could track down these warriors somehow, then?
translation: 那么你知道我怎样才能找到这些战士吗？ [na me ni zhi dao wo zen yang cai neng zhao dao zhe xie zhan shi ma ？]

english: There is an ancient spell I know of that may spy upon such power... But it will require a few ingredients for it to work.
translation: 我知道有一个古老的咒语可以监视这种力量……但它需要一些成分才能发挥作用。 [wo zhi dao you yi ge gu lao de zhou yu ke yi jian shi zhe zhong li liang …… dan ta xu yao yi xie cheng fen cai neng fa hui zuo yong 。]

english: Should you be willing to get these ingredients for me, I will be able to locate the rough area where each of these warriors has taken refuge. The spell is imprecise, but it should help you get on the
translation: 如果你愿意帮我拿到这些材料，我就能找到这些战士避难的大致区域。这个咒语并不精确，但它应该可以帮助你进入 [ru guo ni yuan yi bang wo na dao zhe xie cai liao ， wo jiu neng zhao dao zhe xie zhan shi bi nan de da zhi qu yu 。 zhe ge zhou yu bing bu jing que ， dan ta ying gai ke yi bang zhu ni jin ru]

english: right track in your search.
translation: 您的搜索正轨。 [nin de sou suo zheng gui 。]

english: Is your desire for our freedom strong enough? Will you gather the ingredients for this spell for me?
translation: 您对自由的渴望足够强烈吗？你能帮我收集这个咒语的材料吗？ [nin dui zi you de ke wang zu gou qiang lie ma ？ ni neng bang wo shou ji zhe ge zhou yu de cai liao ma ？]

english: Sure, what do you need?
translation: 当然可以，你需要什么？ [dang ran ke yi ， ni xu yao shen me ？]

english: For this spell, I will need to make some scrying glasses. I will need enough so that we can view the realm in its entirety.
translation: 为了这个咒语，我需要制作一些占卜眼镜。我需要足够的东西，以便我们能够完整地观察这个领域。 [wei le zhe ge zhou yu ， wo xu yao zhi zuo yi xie zhan bu yan jing 。 wo xu yao zu gou de dong xi ， yi bian wo men neng gou wan zheng di guan cha zhe ge ling yu 。]

english: When enchanted, the scrying glass will be able to let us view any area that has been influenced by the presence of the Diamonds of Azzanadra.
translation: 当施了魔法后，占卜玻璃将能够让我们看到任何受到阿扎纳德拉钻石影响的区域。 [dang shi le mo fa hou ， zhan bu bo li jiang neng gou rang wo men kan dao ren he shou dao a zha na de la zuan shi ying xiang de qu yu 。]

english: Okay, but what exactly do you need for this spell?
translation: 好吧，但是这个咒语到底需要什么？ [hao ba ， dan shi zhe ge zhou yu dao di xu yao shen me ？]

english: Well, six scrying glasses should be sufficient. For each scrying glass, I will need two magic logs, a steel bar and some molten glass. This makes a total of 12 magic logs, 6 pieces of molten
translation: 好吧，六个占卜镜就足够了。对于每个占卜玻璃，我需要两根魔法原木、一根钢棒和一些熔融玻璃。这使得总共 12 根魔法原木，6 块熔岩 [hao ba ， liu ge zhan bu jing jiu zu gou le 。 dui yu mei ge zhan bu bo li ， wo xu yao liang gen mo fa yuan mu 、 yi gen gang bang he yi xie rong rong bo li 。 zhe shi de zong gong  12  gen mo fa yuan mu ，6  kuai rong yan]

english: glass, and 6 steel bars.
translation: 玻璃和 6 根钢条。 [bo li he  6  gen gang tiao 。]

english: In addition, for the actual spell to enchant the glasses, I will require one set of normal bones, some ash, some charcoal and a single blood rune.
translation: 此外，对于给眼镜附魔的实际咒语，我需要一套正常的骨头、一些灰烬、一些木炭和一个血符文。 [ci wai ， dui yu gei yan jing fu mo de shi ji zhou yu ， wo xu yao yi tao zheng chang de gu tou 、 yi xie hui jin 、 yi xie mu tan he yi ge xue fu wen 。]

english: Do you understand me, adventurer?
translation: 你明白我的意思吗，冒险家？ [ni ming bai wo de yi si ma ， mao xian jia ？]

english: Quick question; what kind of bones do you need?
translation: 快速提问；你需要什么样的骨头？ [kuai su ti wen ； ni xu yao shen me yang de gu tou ？]

english: Standard bones. Other types of bones are of no use to me in this spell.
translation: 标准骨头。其他类型的骨头在这个法术中对我来说没有用处。 [biao zhun gu tou 。 qi ta lei xing de gu tou zai zhe ge fa shu zhong dui wo lai shuo mei you yong chu 。]

english: Yes, I will go get those for you.
translation: 是的，我去给你拿那些。 [shi de ， wo qu gei ni na na xie 。]

english: Before I can complete the spell I will still need the following items;
translation: 在完成该咒语之前，我仍然需要以下物品； [zai wan cheng gai zhou yu zhi qian ， wo reng ran xu yao yi xia wu pin ；]

english: 12 magic logs 6 steel bars 6 molten glass
translation: 12根魔法原木 6根钢棒 6根熔融玻璃 [12 gen mo fa yuan mu  6 gen gang bang  6 gen rong rong bo li]

english: 1 bones, 1 ashes, 1 charcoal and 1 blood rune.
translation: 1块骨头，1个灰烬，1个木炭和1个血符文。 [1 kuai gu tou ，1 ge hui jin ，1 ge mu tan he 1 ge xue fu wen 。]

english: Actually I don't feel like going on a shopping trip for you right now.
translation: 事实上我现在不想为你去购物。 [shi shi shang wo xian zai bu xiang wei ni qu gou wu 。]

english: As you wish. I should have known not to get my hopes up that our long cursed life may soon be at an end...
translation: 如你所愿。我早该知道不要抱有希望，以为我们漫长的被诅咒的生活可能很快就会结束…… [ru ni suo yuan 。 wo zao gai zhi dao bu yao bao you xi wang ， yi wei wo men man chang de bei zu zhou de sheng huo ke neng hen kuai jiu hui jie shu ……]

english: So have you spoken to my Lord Azzanadra yet?
translation: 那么你和我的阿扎纳德拉大人谈过了吗？ [na me ni he wo de a zha na de la da ren tan guo le ma ？]

english: Yes I have.
translation: 是的，我有。 [shi de ， wo you 。]

english: And what words did he have for his followers?
translation: 他对他的追随者说了些什么？ [ta dui ta de zhui sui zhe shuo le xie shen me ？]

english: Er.... He didn't really mention you at all, but he did teach me some cool new magic spells.
translation: 呃……他根本没有提到你，但他确实教了我一些很酷的新魔法。 [e …… ta gen ben mei you ti dao ni ， dan ta que shi jiao le wo yi xie hen ku de xin mo fa 。]

english: It is understandable perhaps... His poor mind must be addled after all of those years of confinement, he would not willingly ignore his followers...
translation: 或许也可以理解……这么多年的禁闭，他那可怜的脑子肯定已经混乱了，他不会心甘情愿地忽视自己的追随者…… [huo xu ye ke yi li jie …… zhe me duo nian de jin bi ， ta na ke lian de nao zi ken ding yi jing hun luan le ， ta bu hui xin gan qing yuan di hu shi zi ji de zhui sui zhe ……]

english: Anyway, if he has taught you our ancient magics, you may be interested in purchasing an ancient heirloom that was passed down to me. My ancestor fought in the ancient battles using the
translation: 不管怎样，如果他教了你我们的古代魔法，你可能有兴趣购买一件传给我的古代传家宝。我的祖先在古代战争中使用 [bu guan zen yang ， ru guo ta jiao le ni wo men de gu dai mo fa ， ni ke neng you xing qu gou mai yi jian chuan gei wo de gu dai chuan jia bao 。 wo de zu xian zai gu dai zhan zheng zhong shi yong]

english: magic of our god. This heirloom will help you with the speed of your spell- casting.
translation: 我们神的魔法。这个传家宝将帮助你提高施法速度。 [wo men shen de mo fa 。 zhe ge chuan jia bao jiang bang zhu ni ti gao shi fa su du 。]

english: Normally I could not bear to part with such a priceless relic, but for your help in freeing my Lord Azzanadra, I will be prepared to sell it to you for a mere 80,000 gold.
translation: 一般情况下我都舍不得放弃这样一件价值连城的圣物，但为了你能救出我的阿扎纳德拉大人，我愿意以区区八万金币的价格将它卖给你。 [yi ban qing kuang xia wo dou she bu de fang qi zhe yang yi jian jia zhi lian cheng de sheng wu ， dan wei le ni neng jiu chu wo de a zha na de la da ren ， wo yuan yi yi qu qu ba wan jin bi de jia ge jiang ta mai gei ni 。]

english: Are you interested?
translation: 你有兴趣吗？ [ni you xing qu ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Stranger... Do not abuse my generosity... I cannot possibly sell it for less than 80,000 gold.
translation: 陌生人……别滥用我的慷慨……我不可能卖得低于八万金。 [mo sheng ren …… bie lan yong wo de kang kai …… wo bu ke neng mai de di yu ba wan jin 。]

english: Come back and see me when you have the necessary funds to buy.
translation: 等你有足够的资金来购买时再来见我。 [deng ni you zu gou de zi jin lai gou mai shi zai lai jian wo 。]

english: Take care of it, it is the only heirloom from those times I possess, although rumour has it many of our ancient warriors were buried with identical weapons so that they could continue to fight for my Lord in their deaths.
translation: 照顾好它，这是我拥有的唯一的传家宝，尽管有传言说我们许多古代战士都埋葬着同样的武器，以便他们在死亡时能够继续为我的主而战。 [zhao gu hao ta ， zhe shi wo yong you de wei yi de chuan jia bao ， jin guan you chuan yan shuo wo men xu duo gu dai zhan shi dou mai zang zhe tong yang de wu qi ， yi bian ta men zai si wang shi neng gou ji xu wei wo de zhu er zhan 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: As you wish. Bear my offer in mind should you ever change your decision, I will remain here.
translation: 如你所愿。请记住我的提议，如果您改变决定，我将留在这里。 [ru ni suo yuan 。 qing ji zhu wo de ti yi ， ru guo nin gai bian jue ding ， wo jiang liu zai zhe li 。]

english: Hello again.
translation: 又好。 [you hao 。]

english: Greetings!
translation: 问候！ [wen hou ！]

english: I found this weird icon. Do you know what it is?
translation: 我发现了这个奇怪的图标。你知道它是什么吗？ [wo fa xian le zhe ge qi guai de tu biao 。 ni zhi dao ta shi shen me ma ？]

english: Fascinating... I've never seen anything like this before, but the magic contained within is unmistakable. I wonder...
translation: 令人着迷……我以前从未见过这样的东西，但其中所蕴含的魔力是显而易见的。我想知道... [ling ren zhao mi …… wo yi qian cong wei jian guo zhe yang de dong xi ， dan qi zhong suo yun han de mo li shi xian er yi jian de 。 wo xiang zhi dao ...]

english: Wonder what?
translation: 想知道什么？ [xiang zhi dao shen me ？]

english: Stranger, if you were to bring me an Ancient staff, I believe it would be possible to combine it with this icon to create a powerful new weapon.
translation: 陌生人，如果你给我带来一把远古法杖，我相信它可以与这个图标结合起来，创造出强大的新武器。 [mo sheng ren ， ru guo ni gei wo dai lai yi ba yuan gu fa zhang ， wo xiang xin ta ke yi yu zhe ge tu biao jie he qi lai ， chuang zao chu qiang da de xin wu qi 。]

english: That sounds pretty neat.
translation: 听起来很整洁。 [ting qi lai hen zheng jie 。]

english: Then return to me when you have the staff.
translation: 等你找到工作人员后再回来找我。 [deng ni zhao dao gong zuo ren yuan hou zai hui lai zhao wo 。]

english: I see you have the staff with you. Would you like me to combine your Ancient staff with the icon to create an Ancient sceptre? You won't be able to separate them once this is done.
translation: 我看到你身边有工作人员。您希望我将您的远古法杖与图标结合起来创建远古权杖吗？完成此操作后，您将无法将它们分开。 [wo kan dao ni shen bian you gong zuo ren yuan 。 nin xi wang wo jiang nin de yuan gu fa zhang yu tu biao jie he qi lai chuang jian yuan gu quan zhang ma ？ wan cheng ci cao zuo hou ， nin jiang wu fa jiang ta men fen kai 。]

english: Yes, please!
translation: 是的，请！ [shi de ， qing ！]

english: There you go. Wield its power responsibly, stranger...
translation: 就这样吧。负责任地运用权力，陌生人…… [jiu zhe yang ba 。 fu ze ren di yun yong quan li ， mo sheng ren ……]

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Suit yourself.
translation: 适合自己。 [shi he zi ji 。]

english: Have you got any symbols of your god?
translation: 你有你的神的象征吗？ [ni you ni de shen de xiang zheng ma ？]

english: I'll leave you to it.
translation: 我就让你去吧。 [wo jiu rang ni qu ba 。]

english: Why is this village so hostile?
translation: 为什么这个村子如此充满敌意？ [wei shen me zhe ge cun zi ru ci chong man di yi ？]

english: No, I want to hear this story.
translation: 不，我想听这个故事。 [bu ， wo xiang ting zhe ge gu shi 。]

english: I don't care about your story.
translation: 我不在乎你的故事。 [wo bu zai hu ni de gu shi 。]

english: Do you know anything about treasure near here?
translation: 你知道这附近有什么宝藏吗？ [ni zhi dao zhe fu jin you shen me bao zang ma ？]

english: Do you know anything about a fortress near here?
translation: 你知道这附近有一座堡垒吗？ [ni zhi dao zhe fu jin you yi zuo bao lei ma ？]

english: Nothing thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。]

english: Tell me of The four diamonds of Azzanadra
translation: 告诉我阿扎纳德拉的四颗钻石 [gao su wo a zha na de la de si ke zuan shi]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No, please repeat those ingredients.
translation: 不，请重复这些成分。 [bu ， qing chong fu zhe xie cheng fen 。]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Have you got any symbols of your god?
translation: 你有你的神的象征吗？ [ni you ni de shen de xiang zheng ma ？]

english: I found this weird icon. Do you know what it is?
translation: 我发现了这个奇怪的图标。你知道它是什么吗？ [wo fa xian le zhe ge qi guai de tu biao 。 ni zhi dao ta shi shen me ma ？]

english: Yes, please!
translation: 是的，请！ [shi de ， qing ！]

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: I'll leave you to it.
translation: 我就让你去吧。 [wo jiu rang ni qu ba 。]

english: Your echo boots have [number] charges remaining.
translation: 您的 echo 靴子还剩 [number] 次电量。 [nin de  echo  xue zi hai sheng  [number]  ci dian liang 。]

english: Your echo boots have [number] charges remaining. They are currently inactive.
translation: 您的 echo 靴子还剩 [number] 次电量。他们目前不活跃。 [nin de  echo  xue zi hai sheng  [number]  ci dian liang 。 ta men mu qian bu huo yue 。]

english: You activate your echo boots.
translation: 你激活你的回声靴。 [ni ji huo ni de hui sheng xue 。]

english: You deactivate your echo boots.
translation: 你停用你的回声靴。 [ni ting yong ni de hui sheng xue 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello friend.
translation: 朋友你好。 [peng you ni hao 。]

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm looking for a helmet. I know it's buried somewhere.
translation: 我正在寻找头盔。我知道它被埋在某个地方。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao tou kui 。 wo zhi dao ta bei mai zai mou ge di fang 。]

english: And you think that somewhere is here?
translation: 你认为这里有某个地方吗？ [ni ren wei zhe li you mou ge di fang ma ？]

english: I don't know. I've tried everywhere else so it might be.
translation: 我不知道。我已经在其他地方尝试过了，所以可能是这样。 [wo bu zhi dao 。 wo yi jing zai qi ta di fang chang shi guo le ， suo yi ke neng shi zhe yang 。]

english: Maybe you're missing something important.
translation: 也许你错过了一些重要的事情。 [ye xu ni cuo guo le yi xie zhong yao de shi qing 。]

english: Maybe you're right. I just don't know anymore.
translation: 也许你是对的。我只是不知道了。 [ye xu ni shi dui de 。 wo zhi shi bu zhi dao le 。]

english: That's a nice outfit.
translation: 这是一套不错的衣服。 [zhe shi yi tao bu cuo de yi fu 。]

english: Thank you. I just wish I had the helmet to go with it.
translation: 谢谢。我只是希望我能有一个头盔来搭配它。 [xie xie 。 wo zhi shi xi wang wo neng you yi ge tou kui lai da pei ta 。]

english: Hey your hair is on fire!
translation: 嘿，你的头发着火了！ [hei ， ni de tou fa zhao huo le ！]

english: Get out of it!
translation: 摆脱它！ [bai tuo ta ！]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: See you later.
translation: 稍后见。 [shao hou jian 。]

english: That helmet! Where did you get it?
translation: 那个头盔！你从哪里得到的？ [na ge tou kui ！ ni cong na li de dao de ？]

english: I found it.
translation: 我找到了。 [wo zhao dao le 。]

english: Where?
translation: 在哪里？ [zai na li ？]

english: I can't tell you that. It would ruin the fun. You'll have to work it out for yourself.
translation: 我不能告诉你这一点。这会破坏乐趣。你必须自己解决这个问题。 [wo bu neng gao su ni zhe yi dian 。 zhe hui po huai le qu 。 ni bi xu zi ji jie jue zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Arhhh!
translation: 啊啊！ [a a ！]

english: Hello again friend.
translation: 你好，朋友。 [ni hao ， peng you 。]

english: What are you doing all the way over here?
translation: 你千里迢迢来这里做什么？ [ni qian li tiao tiao lai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I gave up on the last one. Who cares about that one, anyway?
translation: 我放弃了最后一个。无论如何，谁关心那个呢？ [wo fang qi le zui hou yi ge 。 wu lun ru he ， shui guan xin na ge ne ？]

english: I guess...
translation: 我猜... [wo cai ...]

english: That's a nice set of armour.
translation: 这是一套不错的铠甲。 [zhe shi yi tao bu cuo de kai jia 。]

english: So much nicer than the garb I had before, right?
translation: 比我之前穿的衣服好看多了，对吧？ [bi wo zhi qian chuan de yi fu hao kan duo le ， dui ba ？]

english: I just wish I had the helmet to go with it.
translation: 我只是希望我能有一个头盔来搭配它。 [wo zhi shi xi wang wo neng you yi ge tou kui lai da pei ta 。]

english: Agh, not again!
translation: 啊，不再这样了！ [a ， bu zai zhe yang le ！]

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: That's a nice outfit.
translation: 这是一套不错的衣服。 [zhe shi yi tao bu cuo de yi fu 。]

english: Hey your hair is on fire!
translation: 嘿，你的头发着火了！ [hei ， ni de tou fa zhao huo le ！]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: What are you doing all the way over here?
translation: 你千里迢迢来这里做什么？ [ni qian li tiao tiao lai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: That's a nice set of armour.
translation: 这是一套不错的铠甲。 [zhe shi yi tao bu cuo de kai jia 。]

english: Can't stop. Too busy.
translation: 停不下来。太忙。 [ting bu xia lai 。 tai mang 。]

english: Wonder when I'll get paid.
translation: 想知道我什么时候能收到工资。 [xiang zhi dao wo shen me shi hou neng shou dao gong zi 。]

english: Is it lunch break yet?
translation: 午休时间到了吗？ [wu xiu shi jian dao le ma ？]

english: Hey I'm working here. I'm working here.
translation: 嘿，我在这里工作。我在这里工作。 [hei ， wo zai zhe li gong zuo 。 wo zai zhe li gong zuo 。]

english: This work isn't going to do itself.
translation: 这项工作不会自行完成。 [zhe xiang gong zuo bu hui zi xing wan cheng 。]

english: Ouch! That was my finger!
translation: 哎哟!那是我的手指！ [ai yo ! na shi wo de shou zhi ！]

english: I'll be charging overtime, then!
translation: 那我就加班费了！ [na wo jiu jia ban fei le ！]

english: Hello old man.
translation: 你好老头。 [ni hao lao tou 。]

english: Sorry, I can't stop to talk...
translation: 抱歉，我无法停下来说话…… [bao qian ， wo wu fa ting xia lai shuo hua ……]

english: Why, what's wrong?
translation: 为什么，出了什么问题？ [wei shen me ， chu le shen me wen ti ？]

english: I've got to find my daughter. I pray that she is still alive...
translation: 我必须找到我的女儿。我祈祷她还活着…… [wo bi xu zhao dao wo de nv er 。 wo qi dao ta hai huo zhe ……]

english: What's happened to her?
translation: 她怎么了？ [ta zen me le ？]

english: Elena's a healer. Three weeks ago she managed to cross the wall into West Ardougne. No one's allowed to cross the wall in case they spread the plague.
translation: 埃琳娜是一名治疗师。三周前，她成功翻墙进入西阿杜涅。任何人都不允许翻墙，以免传播瘟疫。 [ai lin na shi yi ming zhi liao shi 。 san zhou qian ， ta cheng gong fan qiang jin ru xi a du nie 。 ren he ren dou bu yun xu fan qiang ， yi mian chuan bo wen yi 。]

english: Plague?
translation: 瘟疫？ [wen yi ？]

english: Not that long ago, West Ardougne was hit by a deadly plague. They had the wall built to try and keep it contained. No one is allowed to enter the city now apart from the mourners.
translation: 不久前，西阿杜涅遭受了一场致命的瘟疫。他们修建了隔离墙，试图将其控制住。现在除了哀悼者外，任何人都不允许进入这座城市。 [bu jiu qian ， xi a du nie zao shou le yi chang zhi ming de wen yi 。 ta men xiu jian le ge li qiang ， shi tu jiang qi kong zhi zhu 。 xian zai chu le ai dao zhe wai ， ren he ren dou bu yun xu jin ru zhe zuo cheng shi 。]

english: They say the plague is a horrible way to go... That's why Elena felt she had to go help. She said she'd be gone for a few days but we've heard nothing since.
translation: 他们说瘟疫是一种可怕的方式……这就是为什么埃琳娜觉得她必须去帮忙。她说她会离开几天，但从那以后我们就没有任何消息了。 [ta men shuo wen yi shi yi zhong ke pa de fang shi …… zhe jiu shi wei shen me ai lin na jue de ta bi xu qu bang mang 。 ta shuo ta hui li kai ji tian ， dan cong na yi hou wo men jiu mei you ren he xiao xi le 。]

english: Maybe I could help find her?
translation: 也许我可以帮忙找到她？ [ye xu wo ke yi bang mang zhao dao ta ？]

english: Really, would you? I've been working on a plan to get into West Ardougne, but I'm too old and tired to carry it through. But you on the other hand, you should have no problem.
translation: 真的吗，你愿意吗？我一直在制定进入西阿杜涅的计划，但我太老了，太累了，无法实施。但另一方面，你应该没有问题。 [zhen de ma ， ni yuan yi ma ？ wo yi zhi zai zhi ding jin ru xi a du nie de ji hua ， dan wo tai lao le ， tai lei le ， wu fa shi shi 。 dan ling yi fang mian ， ni ying gai mei you wen ti 。]

english: Where should I start?
translation: 我应该从哪里开始？ [wo ying gai cong na li kai shi ？]

english: If you're going into West Ardougne you'll need protection from the plague. My wife made a special gas mask for Elena with dwellberries rubbed into it.
translation: 如果您要前往西阿杜涅，您需要采取预防瘟疫的措施。我的妻子为埃琳娜制作了一个特殊的防毒面具，里面涂有德鲁莓。 [ru guo nin yao qian wang xi a du nie ， nin xu yao cai qu yu fang wen yi de cuo shi 。 wo de qi zi wei ai lin na zhi zuo le yi ge te shu de fang du mian ju ， li mian tu you de lu mei 。]

english: They help to repel the plague apparently. We need some more though...
translation: 他们显然有助于击退瘟疫。但我们还需要一些... [ta men xian ran you zhu yu ji tui wen yi 。 dan wo men hai xu yao yi xie ...]

english: Where can I find these dwellberries?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到这些浆果？ [wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao zhe xie jiang guo ？]

english: The only place I know of is McGrubor's Wood, just west of Seers' Village. The berries are bright blue so they're easy to spot.
translation: 我唯一知道的地方是麦格鲁伯森林，就在先知村西边。浆果呈亮蓝色，因此很容易被发现。 [wo wei yi zhi dao de di fang shi mai ge lu bo sen lin ， jiu zai xian zhi cun xi bian 。 jiang guo cheng liang lan se ， yin ci hen rong yi bei fa xian 。]

english: Okay, I'll go and get some.
translation: 好的，我去拿一些。 [hao de ， wo qu na yi xie 。]

english: The foresters keep a close eye on it, but there is a back way in.
translation: 林务员密切关注着它，但有一条后路可以进去。 [lin wu yuan mi qie guan zhu zhe ta ， dan you yi tiao hou lu ke yi jin qu 。]

english: On second thoughts, I'd better not.
translation: 转念一想，我最好还是不要。 [zhuan nian yi xiang ， wo zui hao hai shi bu yao 。]

english: Well if you hear anything about Elena please tell me.
translation: 好吧，如果你听说过有关埃琳娜的任何事情，请告诉我。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni ting shuo guo you guan ai lin na de ren he shi qing ， qing gao su wo 。]

english: I will. Goodbye.
translation: 我会。再见。 [wo hui 。 zai jian 。]

english: Well, good luck finding her.
translation: 嗯，祝你好运，找到她。 [n ， zhu ni hao yun ， zhao dao ta 。]

english: Hello Edmond.
translation: 你好埃德蒙。 [ni hao ai de meng 。]

english: Have you got the dwellberries yet?
translation: 你已经拿到德芙莓了吗？ [ni yi jing na dao de fu mei le ma ？]

english: Sorry, I'm afraid not.
translation: 抱歉，恐怕不行。 [bao qian ， kong pa bu xing 。]

english: You'll probably find them in McGrubor's Wood, just west of Seers' Village. The berries are bright blue so they're easy to spot.
translation: 你可能会在先知村西边的麦格鲁伯森林里找到它们。浆果呈亮蓝色，因此很容易被发现。 [ni ke neng hui zai xian zhi cun xi bian de mai ge lu bo sen lin li zhao dao ta men 。 jiang guo cheng liang lan se ， yin ci hen rong yi bei fa xian 。]

english: Yes I've got some here.
translation: 是的，我这里有一些。 [shi de ， wo zhe li you yi xie 。]

english: Take them to my wife Alrena, she's inside.
translation: 把它们带给我的妻子艾琳娜，她就在里面。 [ba ta men dai gei wo de qi zi ai lin na ， ta jiu zai li mian 。]

english: Hi Edmond, I've got the gas mask now.
translation: 嗨埃德蒙，我现在拿到防毒面具了。 [hai ai de meng ， wo xian zai na dao fang du mian ju le 。]

english: Good stuff, now for the digging. Beneath us are the Ardougne sewers. I've done some research, and I reckon you can use them to access to West Ardougne.
translation: 好东西，现在去挖。我们下面是阿杜涅下水道。我做了一些研究，我想你可以用它们来访问西阿杜涅。 [hao dong xi ， xian zai qu wa 。 wo men xia mian shi a du nie xia shui dao 。 wo zuo le yi xie yan jiu ， wo xiang ni ke yi yong ta men lai fang wen xi a du nie 。]

english: I've already tried digging down to them but the soil is rock hard. You'll need to pour on several buckets of water to soften it up. I reckon four buckets should do it.
translation: 我已经尝试过挖掘它们，但土壤坚硬如石。你需要倒几桶水来软化它。我认为四个桶应该可以做到。 [wo yi jing chang shi guo wa jue ta men ， dan tu rang jian ying ru shi 。 ni xu yao dao ji tong shui lai ruan hua ta 。 wo ren wei si ge tong ying gai ke yi zuo dao 。]

english: How's it going?
translation: 怎么样了？ [zen me yang le ？]

english: I still need to pour four more buckets of water on the soil.
translation: 我还需要在土上再倒四桶水。 [wo hai xu yao zai tu shang zai dao si tong shui 。]

english: I still need to pour three more buckets of water on the soil.
translation: 我还需要在土上再倒三桶水。 [wo hai xu yao zai tu shang zai dao san tong shui 。]

english: I still need to pour two more buckets of water on the soil.
translation: 土上还得再浇两桶水。 [tu shang hai de zai jiao liang tong shui 。]

english: Player: I still need to pour one more bucket of water on the soil.
translation: 玩家：我还得在土上再倒一桶水。 [wan jia ： wo hai de zai tu shang zai dao yi tong shui 。]

english: I've soaked the soil with water.
translation: 我已经用水把土浸湿了。 [wo yi jing yong shui ba tu jin shi le 。]

english: That's great, it should be soft enough to dig through now. There should be a spade nearby that you can use.
translation: 太好了，现在应该足够软了，可以挖了。附近应该有一把铲子可供您使用。 [tai hao le ， xian zai ying gai zu gou ruan le ， ke yi wa le 。 fu jin ying gai you yi ba chan zi ke gong nin shi yong 。]

english: I think it's the pipe to the south that comes up in West Ardougne.
translation: 我认为这是在西阿杜涅向南延伸的管道。 [wo ren wei zhe shi zai xi a du nie xiang nan yan shen de guan dao 。]

english: Alright I'll check it out.
translation: 好的，我会检查一下。 [hao de ， wo hui jian cha yi xia 。]

english: Edmond, I can't get through to West Ardougne! There's an iron grill blocking my way, I can't pull it off alone.
translation: 埃德蒙，我打不通西阿杜涅！有一个铁栅栏挡住了我的去路，我一个人无法把它拉下来。 [ai de meng ， wo da bu tong xi a du nie ！ you yi ge tie zha lan dang zhu le wo de qu lu ， wo yi ge ren wu fa ba ta la xia lai 。]

english: If you get some rope you could tie to the grill, then we could both pull it at the same time.
translation: 如果你有一些绳子可以绑在烤架上，那么我们就可以同时拉它。 [ru guo ni you yi xie sheng zi ke yi bang zai kao jia shang ， na me wo men jiu ke yi tong shi la ta 。]

english: I've tied a rope to the grill over there, will you help me pull it off?
translation: 我在那边的烤架上绑了一根绳子，你能帮我把它拉下来吗？ [wo zai na bian de kao jia shang bang le yi gen sheng zi ， ni neng bang wo ba ta la xia lai ma ？]

english: Alright, let's get to it...
translation: 好吧，让我们开始吧…… [hao ba ， rang wo men kai shi ba ……]

english: The player and Edmond pull on the rope, opening the grill on the pipe.
translation: 玩家和埃德蒙拉动绳子，打开管道上的烤架。 [wan jia he ai de meng la dong sheng zi ， da kai guan dao shang de kao jia 。]

english: Once you're in the city look for a man called Jethick. He's an old friend of the family. Hopefully he can help you.
translation: 一旦你进了城，就去找一个叫杰西克的人。他是这家人的老朋友。希望他能帮助你。 [yi dan ni jin le cheng ， jiu qu zhao yi ge jiao jie xi ke de ren 。 ta shi zhe jia ren de lao peng you 。 xi wang ta neng bang zhu ni 。]

english: Alright, thanks I will.
translation: 好的，谢谢我会的 [hao de ， xie xie wo hui de]

english: I can't let you enter the city without your gas mask on.
translation: 我不能让你不戴防毒面具就进城。 [wo bu neng rang ni bu dai fang du mian ju jiu jin cheng 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Have you found Elena yet?
translation: 你找到埃琳娜了吗？ [ni zhao dao ai lin na le ma ？]

english: Not yet, it's a big city over there.
translation: 还没有，那边是大城市。 [hai mei you ， na bian shi da cheng shi 。]

english: I hope it's not too late.
translation: 我希望现在还不算太晚。 [wo xi wang xian zai hai bu suan tai wan 。]

english: Not yet, it's a big city over there. Do you have a picture of Elena?
translation: 还没有，那边是大城市。你有埃琳娜的照片吗？ [hai mei you ， na bian shi da cheng shi 。 ni you ai lin na de zhao pian ma ？]

english: There should be a picture of Elena in the house. Please find her quickly, I hope it's not too late.
translation: 房子里应该有一张埃琳娜的照片。请尽快找到她，希望还不算太晚。 [fang zi li ying gai you yi zhang ai lin na de zhao pian 。 qing jin kuai zhao dao ta ， xi wang hai bu suan tai wan 。]

english: Thank you, thank you! Elena beat you back by minutes. Now I said I'd give you a reward. What can I give you as a reward I wonder? Here take this magic scroll, I have little use for it but it may help you.
translation: 谢谢，谢谢！埃琳娜几分钟就打败了你。现在我说我会给你奖励。我想知道我能给你什么作为奖励呢？给你这个魔法卷轴，我用它没什么用，但它可能对你有帮助。 [xie xie ， xie xie ！ ai lin na ji fen zhong jiu da bai le ni 。 xian zai wo shuo wo hui gei ni jiang li 。 wo xiang zhi dao wo neng gei ni shen me zuo wei jiang li ne ？ gei ni zhe ge mo fa juan zhou ， wo yong ta mei shen me yong ， dan ta ke neng dui ni you bang zhu 。]

english: Congratulations! Quest complete!
translation: 恭喜！任务完成！ [gong xi ！ ren wu wan cheng ！]

english: Now I'd recommend you go and see Elena. She'll want to thank you herself. She lives in the house opposite ours.
translation: 现在我建议你去看看埃琳娜。她自己也会感谢你的。她住在我们对面的房子里。 [xian zai wo jian yi ni qu kan kan ai lin na 。 ta zi ji ye hui gan xie ni de 。 ta zhu zai wo men dui mian de fang zi li 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Ah hello. Thank you again for rescuing my daughter.
translation: 啊你好。再次感谢您救了我的女儿。 [a ni hao 。 zai ci gan xie nin jiu le wo de nv er 。]

english: No problem.
translation: 没问题。 [mei wen ti 。]

english: Hello there friend. I hope you're looking after Elena out there.
translation: 你好朋友。我希望你在外面照顾埃琳娜。 [ni hao peng you 。 wo xi wang ni zai wai mian zhao gu ai lin na 。]

english: I think she might be the one looking after me.
translation: 我想她可能是照顾我的人。 [wo xiang ta ke neng shi zhao gu wo de ren 。]

english: Ha. That's my Elena.
translation: 哈。那是我的埃琳娜。 [ha 。 na shi wo de ai lin na 。]

english: Can I help you?
translation: 我可以帮你吗？ [wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: Possibly, do you have a challenge for me?
translation: 也许，你对我有挑战吗？ [ye xu ， ni dui wo you tiao zhan ma ？]

english: Yes, I do as a matter of fact.
translation: 是的，事实上我确实这样做。 [shi de ， shi shi shang wo que shi zhe yang zuo 。]

english: Edmond has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 艾德蒙给了你一张挑战卷轴！ [ai de meng gei le ni yi zhang tiao zhan juan zhou ！]

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。 [qing shu ru wen ti de da an 。]

english: Is that your final answer? Because it sounds unlikely to me.
translation: 这就是你的最终答案吗？因为这对我来说听起来不太可能。 [zhe jiu shi ni de zui zhong da an ma ？ yin wei zhe dui wo lai shuo ting qi lai bu tai ke neng 。]

english: Sounds good!
translation: 听起来不错！ [ting qi lai bu cuo ！]

english: Edmond has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 埃德蒙给了你另一张线索卷轴！ [ai de meng gei le ni ling yi zhang xian suo juan zhou ！]

english: What's happened to her?

translation: 我还是不害怕。 [wo hai shi bu hai pa 。]

translation: 哦，哇！连我自己都害怕了！ [o ， wa ！ lian wo zi ji dou hai pa le ！]

translation: 你真勇敢！我打赌你什么都不怕！ [ni zhen yong gan ！ wo da du ni shen me dou bu pa ！]

english: It's okay, I'm not really going to eat your eyeballs. Spiders don't do that.
translation: 没关系，我不会真的吃掉你的眼球。蜘蛛不会这样做。 [mei guan xi ， wo bu hui zhen de chi diao ni de yan qiu 。 zhi zhu bu hui zhe yang zuo 。]

english: Well...I don't think they do.
translation: 嗯...我不认为他们这样做。 [n ... wo bu ren wei ta men zhe yang zuo 。]

english: I'm going to learn how to fly! I'm going to be a flying spider!
translation: 我要学习如何飞！我要成为一只会飞的蜘蛛！ [wo yao xue xi ru he fei ！ wo yao cheng wei yi zhi hui fei de zhi zhu ！]

english: How are you going to fly?
translation: 你要怎么飞？ [ni yao zen me fei ？]

english: I'm going to spin webs between my legs to make wings! Then I can fly!
translation: 我要在双腿之间织网来制作翅膀！那我就可以飞了！ [wo yao zai shuang tui zhi jian zhi wang lai zhi zuo chi bang ！ na wo jiu ke yi fei le ！]

english: Let's try it now!
translation: 现在我们就来尝试一下吧！ [xian zai wo men jiu lai chang shi yi xia ba ！]

english: Um...okay! I'll spin the webs...and then you throw me in the air.
translation: 嗯……好吧！我会结网...然后你把我扔到空中。 [n …… hao ba ！ wo hui jie wang ... ran hou ni ba wo reng dao kong zhong 。]

english: Two...
One...
Wait! I'm not ready!

translation: 我不认为我的网络是正确的。我还没准备好。我们下次再做。 [wo bu ren wei wo de wang luo shi zheng que de 。 wo hai mei zhun bei hao 。 wo men xia ci zai zuo 。]

english: Sounds dangerous.
translation: 听起来很危险。 [ting qi lai hen wei xian 。]

english: It's not dangerous! What's the worst that could happen?
translation: 这并不危险！可能发生的最坏情况是什么？ [zhe bing bu wei xian ！ ke neng fa sheng de zui huai qing kuang shi shen me ？]

english: The worst that can happen is, like, the wings fail and I fall to my death.
translation: 最糟糕的情况就是，翅膀失效了，我摔死了。 [zui zao gao de qing kuang jiu shi ， chi bang shi xiao le ， wo shuai si le 。]

english: Or I get eaten by a bird.
translation: 或者我被鸟吃掉了。 [huo zhe wo bei niao chi diao le 。]

english: I'm going to rethink this.
translation: 我要重新考虑一下这个问题。 [wo yao chong xin kao lv yi xia zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Spiders can't fly!
translation: 蜘蛛不会飞！ [zhi zhu bu hui fei ！]

english: Some spiders can fly! They use web strands to float in the air!
translation: 有些蜘蛛会飞！他们利用网线漂浮在空中！ [you xie zhi zhu hui fei ！ ta men li yong wang xian piao fu zai kong zhong ！]

english: I think I know more about spiders than you, seeing how I am one!
translation: 我想我比你更了解蜘蛛，看看我是怎样的一个！ [wo xiang wo bi ni geng liao jie zhi zhu ， kan kan wo shi zen yang de yi ge ！]

english: I'm sorry, Eek.
translation: 对不起，伊克。 [dui bu qi ， yi ke 。]

english: That's okay.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: I don't want to fly now. I'm not in the mood.
translation: 我现在不想飞。我没心情。 [wo xian zai bu xiang fei 。 wo mei xin qing 。]

english: I don't believe you.
translation: 我不相信你。 [wo bu xiang xin ni 。]

english: I don't care. I'm not talking to you any more.
translation: 我不在乎。我不再和你说话了。 [wo bu zai hu 。 wo bu zai he ni shuo hua le 。]

english: Hey...there are so many humans in your world.
translation: 嘿……你们的世界里有这么多人类。 [hei …… ni men de shi jie li you zhe me duo ren lei 。]

english: Back in my old web there are only spiders.
translation: 回到我的旧网上，只有蜘蛛。 [hui dao wo de jiu wang shang ， zhi you zhi zhu 。]

english: Suppose I was bitten by a magically-irradiated man?
translation: 假设我被一个受到魔法辐射的人咬了怎么办？ [jia she wo bei yi ge shou dao mo fa fu she de ren yao le zen me ban ？]

english: I might become the Man-Spider! I'd gain all the powers of a man! Like um...

english: Um...what can humans do that's special?
translation: 嗯……人类能做什么特别的事？ [n …… ren lei neng zuo shen me te bie de shi ？]

english: Walk on two legs.
translation: 用两条腿走路。 [yong liang tiao tui zou lu 。]

english: Walk on two legs! Yes! Then I could use my other six legs to FIGHT CRIME!
translation: 两条腿走路！是的！然后我就可以用我的另外六条腿来打击犯罪！ [liang tiao tui zou lu ！ shi de ！ ran hou wo jiu ke yi yong wo de ling wai liu tiao tui lai da ji fan zui ！]

english: Use tools.
translation: 使用工具。 [shi yong gong ju 。]

english: Yes! I could have all sorts of gadgets! Like a gadget that spins webs!
translation: 是的！我可以拥有各种各样的小玩意！就像一个结网的小玩意！ [shi de ！ wo ke yi yong you ge zhong ge yang de xiao wan yi ！ jiu xiang yi ge jie wang de xiao wan yi ！]

english: Wait...I can already spin webs.
translation: 等等……我已经可以结网了。 [deng deng …… wo yi jing ke yi jie wang le 。]

english: Never mind!
translation: 没关系！ [mei guan xi ！]

english: Project heat-rays from our eyes.
translation: 从我们的眼睛投射热射线。 [cong wo men de yan jing tou she re she xian 。]

english: Oh! I didn't know humans could do that!
translation: 哦！我不知道人类可以做到这一点！ [o ！ wo bu zhi dao ren lei ke yi zuo dao zhe yi dian ！]

english: Please don't fry me with your heat rays!
translation: 请不要用你的热射线来烤我！ [qing bu yao yong ni de re she xian lai kao wo ！]

english: I'm too young to fry!
translation: 我还太小，不适合炒菜！ [wo hai tai xiao ， bu shi he chao cai ！]

english: Nothing, really. Humans are pretty ordinary.
translation: 没什么，真的。人类其实很普通。 [mei shen me ， zhen de 。 ren lei qi shi hen pu tong 。]

english: Aww, don't say that. Everyone is special!
translation: 哇哦，别这么说。每个人都很特别！ [wa o ， bie zhe me shuo 。 mei ge ren dou hen te bie ！]

english: That's right. I'm awesome!
translation: 这是正确的。我太棒了！ [zhe shi zheng que de 。 wo tai bang le ！]

english: Yes!
translation: 是的！ [shi de ！]

english: No. It's too dangerous.
translation: 不行，太危险了。 [bu xing ， tai wei xian le 。]

english: I'm not a great hero. I'm just an ordinary person.
translation: 我不是一个伟大的英雄。我只是一个普通人。 [wo bu shi yi ge wei da de ying xiong 。 wo zhi shi yi ge pu tong ren 。]

english: Yes, I'm trying to advance myself.
translation: 是的，我正在努力提升自己。 [shi de ， wo zheng zai nu li ti sheng zi ji 。]

english: I don't know. I'm not very ambitious.
translation: 我不知道。我的野心不大。 [wo bu zhi dao 。 wo de ye xin bu da 。]

english: Actually, I've only got two legs.
translation: 其实我只有两条腿。 [qi shi wo zhi you liang tiao tui 。]

english: No one stole my legs.
translation: 没有人偷走我的腿。 [mei you ren tou zou wo de tui 。]

english: They're probably long gone by now.
translation: 他们现在可能已经走了很久了。 [ta men xian zai ke neng yi jing zou le hen jiu le 。]

english: Oh, it's not so bad.
translation: 哦，还不错。 [o ， hai bu cuo 。]

english: There is no leg-extending machine.
translation: 没有腿部伸展机。 [mei you tui bu shen zhan ji 。]

english: You can't use it. It's broken.
translation: 你不能使用它。它坏了。 [ni bu neng shi yong ta 。 ta huai le 。]

english: Yes, I'm scared of spiders.
translation: 是的，我害怕蜘蛛。 [shi de ， wo hai pa zhi zhu 。]

english: You still look like a spider.
translation: 你看起来还是像一只蜘蛛。 [ni kan qi lai hai shi xiang yi zhi zhi zhu 。]

english: That's much better.
translation: 这样好多了。 [zhe yang hao duo le 。]

english: No, I'm not scared of spiders.
translation: 不，我不怕蜘蛛。 [bu ， wo bu pa zhi zhu 。]

english: I'm still not scared.
translation: 我还是不害怕。 [wo hai shi bu hai pa 。]

english: That was a bit scary.
translation: 那就有点吓人了。 [na jiu you dian xia ren le 。]

english: How are you going to fly?
translation: 你要怎么飞？ [ni yao zen me fei ？]

english: Let's try it now!
translation: 现在我们就来尝试一下吧！ [xian zai wo men jiu lai chang shi yi xia ba ！]

english: Sounds dangerous.
translation: 听起来很危险。 [ting qi lai hen wei xian 。]

english: Spiders can't fly!
translation: 蜘蛛不会飞！ [zhi zhu bu hui fei ！]

english: I'm sorry, Eek.
translation: 对不起，伊克。 [dui bu qi ， yi ke 。]

english: I don't believe you.
translation: 我不相信你。 [wo bu xiang xin ni 。]

english: Walk on two legs.
translation: 用两条腿走路。 [yong liang tiao tui zou lu 。]

english: Use tools.
translation: 使用工具。 [shi yong gong ju 。]

english: Project heat-rays from our eyes.
translation: 从我们的眼睛投射热射线。 [cong wo men de yan jing tou she re she xian 。]

english: Nothing, really. Humans are pretty ordinary.
translation: 没什么，真的。人类其实很普通。 [mei shen me ， zhen de 。 ren lei qi shi hen pu tong 。]

english: Welcome to my store. Are you in search of any runes?
translation: 欢迎来到我的商店。您在寻找符文吗？ [huan ying lai dao wo de shang dian 。 nin zai xun zhao fu wen ma ？]

english: Can I see your wares?
translation: 我可以看看你们的商品吗？ [wo ke yi kan kan ni men de shang pin ma ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Come back any time. I've always got something for anybody.
translation: 随时回来。我总是能为任何人找到一些东西。 [sui shi hui lai 。 wo zong shi neng wei ren he ren zhao dao yi xie dong xi 。]

english: Can I see your wares?
translation: 我可以看看你们的商品吗？ [wo ke yi kan kan ni men de shang pin ma ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hi. Interesting building you have here.
translation: 你好。这里的建筑很有趣。 [ni hao 。 zhe li de jian zhu hen you qu 。]

english: What's it for?
translation: 这是做什么用的？ [zhe shi zuo shen me yong de ？]

english: You like it? It's simply fabulous, isn't it? A real marvel of modern design made just for my fellow alchemists and I!
translation: 你喜欢吗？这简直太棒了，不是吗？这是一个真正的现代设计奇迹，专为我和我的炼金术士同伴而设计！ [ni xi huan ma ？ zhe jian zhi tai bang le ， bu shi ma ？ zhe shi yi ge zhen zheng de xian dai she ji qi ji ， zhuan wei wo he wo de lian jin shu shi tong ban er she ji ！]

english: I see some builders over there. So I assume it's not yet finished.
translation: 我看到那边有一些建筑商。所以我认为它还没有完成。 [wo kan dao na bian you yi xie jian zhu shang 。 suo yi wo ren wei ta hai mei you wan cheng 。]

english: What a keen eye this chap has! But imagine this: a gargantuan cylinder of expert design, incorporating an inventive inner spiral walkway to multiple planes of wondrous inhabitance!
translation: 这家伙的眼光多么敏锐啊！但想象一下：一个由专家设计的巨大圆柱体，将创造性的内螺旋走道融入多个奇妙的居住平面！ [zhe jia huo de yan guang duo me min rui a ！ dan xiang xiang yi xia ： yi ge you zhuan jia she ji de ju da yuan zhu ti ， jiang chuang zao xing de nei luo xuan zou dao rong ru duo ge qi miao de ju zhu ping mian ！]

english: So, it's a tower.
translation: 所以，它是一座塔。 [suo yi ， ta shi yi zuo ta 。]

english: Oh, no, no, no, no.
translation: 哦，不，不，不，不。 [o ， bu ， bu ， bu ， bu 。]

english: It's going to have a use that will change this world!
translation: 它将有一个改变这个世界的用途！ [ta jiang you yi ge gai bian zhe ge shi jie de yong tu ！]

translation: 或者至少如果我们能完成它的话。 [huo zhe zhi shao ru guo wo men neng wan cheng ta de hua 。]

english: They don't seem to be building much.
translation: 他们似乎没有建造太多东西。 [ta men si hu mei you jian zao tai duo dong xi 。]

english: Exactly.
translation: 确切地。 [que qie di 。]

english: They've gone on strike for some petty reason about the tower being too weird. I really can't understand those men.
translation: 他们因为一些小原因罢工，因为这座塔太奇怪了。我实在无法理解那些男人。 [ta men yin wei yi xie xiao yuan yin ba gong ， yin wei zhe zuo ta tai qi guai le 。 wo shi zai wu fa li jie na xie nan ren 。]

english: Shame.
translation: 耻辱。 [chi ru 。]

english: Hey! Maybe you could talk to them?
translation: 嘿！也许你可以和他们谈谈？ [hei ！ ye xu ni ke yi he ta men tan tan ？]

english: You look like a sturdy chap.
translation: 你看上去是个健壮的小伙子。 [ni kan shang qu shi ge jian zhuang de xiao huo zi 。]

english: Maybe you could finish the work?
translation: 也许你能完成这项工作？ [ye xu ni neng wan cheng zhe xiang gong zuo ？]

english: Me?
translation: 我？ [wo ？]

english: Come on! This is the chance of a lifetime!
translation: 快点！这是一生难得的机会！ [kuai dian ！ zhe shi yi sheng nan de de ji hui ！]

english: Sure, why not.
translation: 当然，为什么不呢。 [dang ran ， wei shen me bu ne 。]

english: That's fantastic! Oh, I'm so pleased.
translation: 太棒了！哦，我很高兴。 [tai bang le ！ o ， wo hen gao xing 。]

english: Calm down. I'm not making any promises.
translation: 冷静下来。我不做任何承诺。 [leng jing xia lai 。 wo bu zuo ren he cheng nuo 。]

english: Oh, I have a good feeling about this.
translation: 哦，我对此有很好的预感。 [o ， wo dui ci you hen hao de yu gan 。]

english: Right.
translation: 正确的。 [zheng que de 。]

english: Go have a word with Bonafido the head builder. See if you can't get him off his backside to do some work. Oh, and I'm Effigy by the way.
translation: 去和首席建筑师博纳菲多谈谈。看看你能否让他摆脱困境去做一些工作。哦，顺便说一句，我是艾菲吉。 [qu he shou xi jian zhu shi bo na fei duo tan tan 。 kan kan ni neng fou rang ta bai tuo kun jing qu zuo yi xie gong zuo 。 o ， shun bian shuo yi ju ， wo shi ai fei ji 。]

english: Nice to meet you Effigy, I'm [player name]. Hold on and I'll see what I can do!
translation: 很高兴认识你，艾菲吉，我是[玩家名字]。坚持住，我看看我能做些什么！ [hen gao xing ren shi ni ， ai fei ji ， wo shi [ wan jia ming zi ]。 jian chi zhu ， wo kan kan wo neng zuo xie shen me ！]

english: Wait a minute.
translation: 等一下。 [deng yi xia 。]

english: Don't I recognise you from somewhere?
translation: 我是不是在某个地方认出了你？ [wo shi bu shi zai mou ge di fang ren chu le ni ？]

english: Erm, do you?
translation: 嗯，你呢？ [n ， ni ne ？]

english: Do you know the outpost north of Ardougne?
translation: 你知道阿杜涅以北的前哨基地吗？ [ni zhi dao a du nie yi bei de qian shao ji di ma ？]

english: Ah, yes, it's now a small museum. Jorral's looking after it. He's really making history with that place.
translation: 啊，是的，现在是一个小博物馆了。乔拉尔正在照顾它。他确实在那个地方创造了历史。 [a ， shi de ， xian zai shi yi ge xiao bo wu guan le 。 qiao la er zheng zai zhao gu ta 。 ta que shi zai na ge di fang chuang zao le li shi 。]

english: Well, the King was going to make that into an alchemy lab for us, but some fool ruined our plans!
translation: 好吧，国王本来打算把它变成我们的炼金实验室，但有些傻瓜毁了我们的计划！ [hao ba ， guo wang ben lai da suan ba ta bian cheng wo men de lian jin shi yan shi ， dan you xie sha gua hui le wo men de ji hua ！]

english: Ah, yes. Shame. Got to go. Bye.
translation: 啊，是的。耻辱。得走了。再见。 [a ， shi de 。 chi ru 。 de zou le 。 zai jian 。]

english: Hey, wait up!
translation: 嘿，等等！ [hei ， deng deng ！]

english: Best I go sort out this tower. Bye.
translation: 我最好去清理这座塔。再见。 [wo zui hao qu qing li zhe zuo ta 。 zai jian 。]

english: Sorry, feeling a bit ill today.
translation: 抱歉，今天身体有点不舒服。 [bao qian ， jin tian shen ti you dian bu shu fu 。]

english: A bit ill?
translation: 有点病了？ [you dian bing le ？]

english: That's a weak excuse for a very feeble personality.
translation: 这是一个软弱人格的软弱借口。 [zhe shi yi ge ruan ruo ren ge de ruan ruo jie kou 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

translation: 你需要从厨师那里拿牛奶。他就是戴着白色厨师帽的人，现在就跳吧！ [ni xu yao cong chu shi na li na niu nai 。 ta jiu shi dai zhe bai se chu shi mao de ren ， xian zai jiu tiao ba ！]

english: Hello, Eggus!
translation: 你好，埃格斯！ [ni hao ， ai ge si ！]

english: Why hello there, [player name]!
translation: 为什么你好，[玩家姓名]！ [wei shen me ni hao ，[ wan jia xing ming ]！]

translation: 你最近见过复活节兔子吗？ [ni zui jin jian guo fu huo jie tu zi ma ？]

english: Indeed I have, he's here! Though he's not his usual self. That's why I'm here actually. It would seem that he has strayed from the path of Easter.
translation: 确实有，他来了！虽然他已经不是平时的自己了。这就是我来这里的原因。看来他已经偏离了复活节的道路。 [que shi you ， ta lai le ！ sui ran ta yi jing bu shi ping shi de zi ji le 。 zhe jiu shi wo lai zhe li de yuan yin 。 kan lai ta yi jing pian li le fu huo jie de dao lu 。]

english: That's not good.
