translation: 不，一点都不好。尤其是对于我们这些走金黄之路的人来说。我得知后，立即着手寻找他。 [bu ， yi dian dou bu hao 。 you qi shi dui yu wo men zhe xie zou jin huang zhi lu de ren lai shuo 。 wo de zhi hou ， li ji zhuo shou xun zhao ta 。]

english: That's nice of you. How did you find him?
translation: 你真好。你是怎么找到他的？ [ni zhen hao 。 ni shi zen me zhao dao ta de ？]

english: Well as luck would have it, I met a pair of hardy hunters who were up to the task. Glanton and Rinder are their names, and what a help they have been!
translation: 幸运的是，我遇到了两位能够胜任这项任务的顽强猎人。格兰顿和林德是他们的名字，他们给了我们多大的帮助！ [xing yun de shi ， wo yu dao le liang wei neng gou sheng ren zhe xiang ren wu de wan qiang lie ren 。 ge lan dun he lin de shi ta men de ming zi ， ta men gei le wo men duo da de bang zhu ！]

english: Very capable, though they've yet to tell me what it is they usually hunt.
translation: 非常有能力，尽管他们还没有告诉我他们通常狩猎什么。 [fei chang you neng li ， jin guan ta men hai mei you gao su wo ta men tong chang shou lie shen me 。]

english: Hopefully not rabbits!
translation: 但愿不是兔子！ [dan yuan bu shi tu zi ！]

english: Don't even think it! They have been nothing but utmost gentlemen. We've been trying to cheer up that poor bunny together.
translation: 连想都别想！他们不过是至高无上的绅士。我们一直在努力一起让那只可怜的兔子高兴起来。 [lian xiang dou bie xiang ！ ta men bu guo shi zhi gao wu shang de shen shi 。 wo men yi zhi zai nu li yi qi rang na zhi ke lian de tu zi gao xing qi lai 。]

english: How has that been going?
translation: 进展如何？ [jin zhan ru he ？]

english: Not well. I've tried everything I can think of! Reading our holy Easter books to him, reciting eggy poetry, nothing has worked.
translation: 不太好。我已经尝试了我能想到的一切！给他读我们神圣的复活节书籍，背诵鸡蛋味的诗歌，但没有任何效果。 [bu tai hao 。 wo yi jing chang shi le wo neng xiang dao de yi qie ！ gei ta du wo men shen sheng de fu huo jie shu ji ， bei song ji dan wei de shi ge ， dan mei you ren he xiao guo 。]

english: Is that really everything you can think of?
translation: 这真的是你能想到的一切吗？ [zhe zhen de shi ni neng xiang dao de yi qie ma ？]

english: I also considered egg juggling, but every time I do that I make a big mess.
translation: 我也考虑过玩鸡蛋杂耍，但每次我这样做都会弄得一团糟。 [wo ye kao lv guo wan ji dan za shua ， dan mei ci wo zhe yang zuo du hui nong de yi tuan zao 。]

english: Best leave that to the professionals.
translation: 最好把它留给专业人士。 [zui hao ba ta liu gei zhuan ye ren shi 。]

english: Indeed.
translation: 的确。 [di que 。]

english: He's in the next room if you want to talk to him, hopefully you can improve his mood.
translation: 如果你想和他说话，他就在隔壁房间，希望你能改善他的情绪。 [ru guo ni xiang he ta shuo hua ， ta jiu zai ge bi fang jian ， xi wang ni neng gai shan ta de qing xu 。]

english: I hope so too. Talk to you later!
translation: 我也希望如此。我们回聊！ [wo ye xi wang ru ci 。 wo men hui liao ！]

english: What is this place? Seems a bit... unsavoury.
translation: 这是什么地方？好像有点……不爽。 [zhe shi shen me di fang ？ hao xiang you dian …… bu shuang 。]

english: This my friend is the Rabbit Hole. A miserable pit for the most part, though I'm told it was previously much more pleasant.
translation: 我的朋友是兔子洞。大部分情况下都是一个悲惨的坑，尽管我听说它以前要愉快得多。 [wo de peng you shi tu zi dong 。 da bu fen qing kuang xia dou shi yi ge bei can de keng ， jin guan wo ting shuo ta yi qian yao yu kuai de duo 。]

english: A home to all Easter-adjacent beings and their friends! Great feasts, parties, and performances were held here.
translation: 所有临近复活节的生物和他们的朋友的家！盛大的宴会、聚会和表演都在这里举行。 [suo you lin jin fu huo jie de sheng wu he ta men de peng you de jia ！ sheng da de yan hui 、 ju hui he biao yan dou zai zhe li ju xing 。]

english: All to celebrate Easter! You see, most people would tire of Easter-based activities after a while. But not the denizens of the Rabbit hole.
translation: 一切都是为了庆祝复活节！你看，大多数人过了一段时间就会厌倦复活节的活动。但兔子洞的居民却不是。 [yi qie dou shi wei le qing zhu fu huo jie ！ ni kan ， da duo shu ren guo le yi duan shi jian jiu hui yan juan fu huo jie de huo dong 。 dan tu zi dong de ju min que bu shi 。]

english: Interesting, so if you felt a particularly eggy urge, you could come here and let loose?
translation: 有趣的是，如果你感到特别兴奋，你可以来这里释放一下吗？ [you qu de shi ， ru guo ni gan dao te bie xing fen ， ni ke yi lai zhe li shi fang yi xia ma ？]

english: Precisely! Though now those days are gone, and what Easter joy was once present has all but run out.
translation: 恰恰！尽管现在那些日子已经一去不复返了，曾经存在的复活节欢乐也几乎消失了。 [qia qia ！ jin guan xian zai na xie ri zi yi jing yi qu bu fu fan le ， ceng jing cun zai de fu huo jie huan le ye ji hu xiao shi le 。]

english: Only a few devoted stragglers remain. Though what exactly they are devoted to is up for debate.
translation: 只剩下少数忠诚的掉队者。尽管他们到底致力于什么还有待争论。 [zhi sheng xia shao shu zhong cheng de diao dui zhe 。 jin guan ta men dao di zhi li yu shen me hai you dai zheng lun 。]

english: Certainly not eggs.
translation: 当然不是鸡蛋。 [dang ran bu shi ji dan 。]

english: That's a shame.
translation: 太可惜了。 [tai ke xi le 。]

english: It is a great shame. Still, there is hope!
translation: 这是一个巨大的耻辱。尽管如此，还是有希望的！ [zhe shi yi ge ju da de chi ru 。 jin guan ru ci ， hai shi you xi wang de ！]

english: I agree. I'll have a look around and see what's going on, perhaps I can help restore some egg-nergy.
translation: 我同意。我去看看周围，看看发生了什么事，也许我可以帮助恢复一些鸡蛋能量。 [wo tong yi 。 wo qu kan kan zhou wei ， kan kan fa sheng le shen me shi ， ye xu wo ke yi bang zhu hui fu yi xie ji dan neng liang 。]

english: Oh you! I hope so, let me know if I can help!
translation: 哦你！我希望如此，如果我能提供帮助，请告诉我！ [o ni ！ wo xi wang ru ci ， ru guo wo neng ti gong bang zhu ， qing gao su wo ！]

english: Where are all the other egg priests?
translation: 其他蛋牧师都在哪里？ [qi ta dan mu shi dou zai na li ？]

english: A fine question!
translation: 一个好问题！ [yi ge hao wen ti ！]

english: They're all very busy scribbling scrolls, rebinding books, replacing plaques, and fiddling with frescoes.
translation: 他们都忙着乱涂乱画卷轴、重新装订书籍、更换牌匾和摆弄壁画。 [ta men dou mang zhe luan tu luan hua juan zhou 、 chong xin zhuang ding shu ji 、 geng huan pai bian he bai nong bi hua 。]

english: Once we were informed that our beloved 'Ayaster' was actually 'Easter', it became clear that we had a lot of corrections to sort out.
translation: 当我们得知我们心爱的“Ayaster”实际上是“Easter”时，很明显我们有很多更正需要解决。 [dang wo men de zhi wo men xin ai de “Ayaster” shi ji shang shi “Easter” shi ， hen ming xian wo men you hen duo geng zheng xu yao jie jue 。]

english: So they're all making important changes, and there's quite a number to get through!
translation: 所以他们都在做出重要的改变，而且有相当多的事情需要完成！ [suo yi ta men dou zai zuo chu zhong yao de gai bian ， er qie you xiang dang duo de shi qing xu yao wan cheng ！]

english: Wow, I don't envy them.
translation: 哇，我不羡慕他们。 [wa ， wo bu xian mu ta men 。]

english: Nor do I! Thank goodness the Easter Bunny is so upset, it's handy excuse to be elsewhere.
translation: 我也不！谢天谢地，复活节兔子太沮丧了，这是一个方便的借口去其他地方。 [wo ye bu ！ xie tian xie di ， fu huo jie tu zi tai ju sang le ， zhe shi yi ge fang bian de jie kou qu qi ta di fang 。]

english: ...That sounded horrible, I didn't mean it like that.
translation: ……听起来很可怕，我不是那个意思。 […… ting qi lai hen ke pa ， wo bu shi na ge yi si 。]

english: I should hope not.
translation: 我希望不会。 [wo xi wang bu hui 。]

english: Actually, nevermind.
translation: 其实，没关系。 [qi shi ， mei guan xi 。]

english: I need some help cheering up the Easter Bunny, what is your favourite part of Easter?
translation: 我需要一些帮助来让复活节兔子高兴起来，复活节你最喜欢的部分是什么？ [wo xu yao yi xie bang zhu lai rang fu huo jie tu zi gao xing qi lai ， fu huo jie ni zui xi huan de bu fen shi shen me ？]

english: I couldn't possibly choose!
translation: 我根本无法选择！ [wo gen ben wu fa xuan ze ！]

english: Oh fantastic! That's not useful at all! What if you HAD to choose? To help the Easter Bunny?
translation: 哦太棒了！那根本没用！如果你必须选择怎么办？帮助复活节兔子？ [o tai bang le ！ na gen ben mei yong ！ ru guo ni bi xu xuan ze zen me ban ？ bang zhu fu huo jie tu zi ？]

english: Well if I had to choose for his sake, I suppose it would be the Easter Buns.
translation: 好吧，如果我必须为他做出选择，我想我会选择复活节面包。 [hao ba ， ru guo wo bi xu wei ta zuo chu xuan ze ， wo xiang wo hui xuan ze fu huo jie mian bao 。]

english: Easter Buns, eh?
translation: 复活节面包，是吗？ [fu huo jie mian bao ， shi ma ？]

english: Ohhhh yes, you know, Easter Buns! Delicious, sticky, spicy, Easter Buns!
translation: 哦哦，是的，你知道，复活节面包！美味、粘稠、辛辣的复活节面包！ [o o ， shi de ， ni zhi dao ， fu huo jie mian bao ！ mei wei 、 nian chou 、 xin la de fu huo jie mian bao ！]

english: They're really that good?
translation: 他们真的有那么好吗？ [ta men zhen de you na me hao ma ？]

english: Oh my, you've.... you've really never had one?
translation: 哦天啊，你……你真的从来没有拥有过吗？ [o tian a ， ni …… ni zhen de cong lai mei you yong you guo ma ？]

english: We'll have to change that!
translation: 我们必须改变这一点！ [wo men bi xu gai bian zhe yi dian ！]

english: I have the recipe right here. I implore you to make some and try them. I don't have any ingredients with me but I'm sure you could ask around in here.
translation: 我这里有食谱。我恳求你做一些并尝试一下。我没有带任何原料，但我相信你可以在这里问问。 [wo zhe li you shi pu 。 wo ken qiu ni zuo yi xie bing chang shi yi xia 。 wo mei you dai ren he yuan liao ， dan wo xiang xin ni ke yi zai zhe li wen wen 。]

english: If anything is going to make the Easter Bunny happy, it's these Easter Buns.
translation: 如果有什么能让复活节兔子开心的话，那就是这些复活节面包了。 [ru guo you shen me neng rang fu huo jie tu zi kai xin de hua ， na jiu shi zhe xie fu huo jie mian bao le 。]

english: Okay, I'll give it a go!
translation: 好吧，我会尝试一下！ [hao ba ， wo hui chang shi yi xia ！]

english: Please bring me one too! Heeheehee!
translation: 请也给我一份吧！嘿嘿嘿！ [qing ye gei wo yi fen ba ！ hei hei hei ！]

english: Have you read that recipe yet?
translation: 你读过那个食谱了吗？ [ni du guo na ge shi pu le ma ？]

english: Not yet, I lost it.
translation: 还没有，我已经丢了。 [hai mei you ， wo yi jing diu le 。]

english: You look burdened enough as it is, come back when you have room for it!
translation: 你看起来已经够累了，有空就回来吧！ [ni kan qi lai yi jing gou lei le ， you kong jiu hui lai ba ！]

english: Oh really? Let me jot it down for you again quickly...
translation: 哦真的吗？让我再快速地记下来给你...... [o zhen de ma ？ rang wo zai kuai su di ji xia lai gei ni ......]

english: Here you go!
translation: 干得好！ [gan de hao ！]

english: Not yet, I'm waiting for the opportune moment!
translation: 还没有，我在等待合适的时机！ [hai mei you ， wo zai deng dai he shi de shi ji ！]

english: Well don't wait too long, I want some Easter Buns!
translation: 好吧，别等太久，我想要一些复活节面包！ [hao ba ， bie deng tai jiu ， wo xiang yao yi xie fu huo jie mian bao ！]

english: YOU want some Easter Buns?
translation: 你想要一些复活节面包吗？ [ni xiang yao yi xie fu huo jie mian bao ma ？]

english: To uh... Give to the Easter Bunny!
translation: 呃...送给复活节兔子！ [e ... song gei fu huo jie tu zi ！]

english: Right...
translation: 正确的... [zheng que de ...]

english: I need another copy of that recipe.
translation: 我需要该食谱的另一份副本。 [wo xu yao gai shi pu de ling yi fen fu ben 。]

english: I need some yeastier dough to make the Easter Buns, do you have any?
translation: 我需要一些酵母面团来做复活节面包，你们有吗？ [wo xu yao yi xie jiao mu mian tuan lai zuo fu huo jie mian bao ， ni men you ma ？]

english: Do I look like a baker to you? I'm afraid I don't carry raw dough around with me. Maybe ask in the kitchen?
translation: 你觉得我像面包师吗？恐怕我没有随身携带生面团。也许去厨房问问？ [ni jue de wo xiang mian bao shi ma ？ kong pa wo mei you sui shen xie dai sheng mian tuan 。 ye xu qu chu fang wen wen ？]

english: The kitchen eh? Good idea.
translation: 厨房是吗？好主意。 [chu fang shi ma ？ hao zhu yi 。]

english: One thing I can tell you, about Eastery dough...
translation: 我可以告诉你一件事，关于复活节面团…… [wo ke yi gao su ni yi jian shi ， guan yu fu huo jie mian tuan ……]

english: Yeastier dough?
translation: 酵母面团？ [jiao mu mian tuan ？]

english: Yes that's what I said, yeastery dough! What I can tell you about yeasteryear dough is that it is very yeasty!
translation: 是的，这就是我说的，酵母面团！关于酵母面团，我可以告诉你的是，它的酵母含量很高！ [shi de ， zhe jiu shi wo shuo de ， jiao mu mian tuan ！ guan yu jiao mu mian tuan ， wo ke yi gao su ni de shi ， ta de jiao mu han liang hen gao ！]

english: Oh really? Wow! Thanks for the education, Eggus.
translation: 哦真的吗？哇！感谢您的教育，埃格斯。 [o zhen de ma ？ wa ！ gan xie nin de jiao yu ， ai ge si 。]

english: It is my duty to teach those less knowledgeable than myself.
translation: 教导那些知识不如我的人是我的责任。 [jiao dao na xie zhi shi bu ru wo de ren shi wo de ze ren 。]

english: I'll see you later.
translation: 稍后见。 [shao hou jian 。]

english: The recipe says I need a special egg. Do you have any special eggs?
translation: 食谱上说我需要一个特殊的鸡蛋。你有什么特别的鸡蛋吗？ [shi pu shang shuo wo xu yao yi ge te shu de ji dan 。 ni you shen me te bie de ji dan ma ？]

english: Well I do have some special eggs, but they're my personal supply I'm afraid. I couldn't possibly give them away.
translation: 嗯，我确实有一些特殊的鸡蛋，但恐怕它们是我个人的供应。我不可能把它们送人。 [n ， wo que shi you yi xie te shu de ji dan ， dan kong pa ta men shi wo ge ren de gong ying 。 wo bu ke neng ba ta men song ren 。]

english: Of course. Where else could I get one then?
translation: 当然。那么我还能在哪里得到一个呢？ [dang ran 。 na me wo hai neng zai na li de dao yi ge ne ？]

english: Perhaps you should ask a chicken?
translation: 也许你应该问一只鸡？ [ye xu ni ying gai wen yi zhi ji ？]

english: No, really, there's one around here somewhere!
translation: 不，真的，这附近某个地方有一个！ [bu ， zhen de ， zhe fu jin mou ge di fang you yi ge ！]

english: I do recall seeing a chicken in here actually.
translation: 我确实记得在这里看到过一只鸡。 [wo que shi ji de zai zhe li kan dao guo yi zhi ji 。]

english: Well there you go! Eggs-a-plenty!
translation: 好吧，就这样吧！鸡蛋充足！ [hao ba ， jiu zhe yang ba ！ ji dan chong zu ！]

english: And remember child, all eggs are special.
translation: 记住孩子，所有的鸡蛋都是特别的。 [ji zhu hai zi ， suo you de ji dan dou shi te bie de 。]

english: I'll keep that in mind.
translation: 我会记住这一点。 [wo hui ji zhu zhe yi dian 。]

english: Do you know where I might find Easter spices?
translation: 你知道我在哪里可以找到复活节香料吗？ [ni zhi dao wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao fu huo jie xiang liao ma ？]

english: Oh, yes I do. The lass behind the bar, what's her name, Rider? Winkle? Erm... In any case ask her, she puts it in drinks to give them a kick!
translation: 哦，是的，我愿意。吧台后面的那个女孩，她叫什么名字，Rider？温克尔？呃……无论如何，问她吧，她把它放进饮料里，让他们兴奋一下！ [o ， shi de ， wo yuan yi 。 ba tai hou mian de na ge nv hai ， ta jiao shen me ming zi ，Rider？ wen ke er ？ e …… wu lun ru he ， wen ta ba ， ta ba ta fang jin yin liao li ， rang ta men xing fen yi xia ！]

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: I need raisins. I also need to know what raisins are. What and where are raisins?
translation: 我需要葡萄干。我还需要知道葡萄干是什么。葡萄干是什么以及在哪里？ [wo xu yao pu tao gan 。 wo hai xu yao zhi dao pu tao gan shi shen me 。 pu tao gan shi shen me yi ji zai na li ？]

english: Raisins! Little tasty morsels! Rich and sweet and goopy! Not as good as eggs though, no no no. You should get some eggs!
translation: 葡萄干！美味的小点心！丰富、甜蜜、粘稠！虽然不如鸡蛋，不不不。你应该买一些鸡蛋！ [pu tao gan ！ mei wei de xiao dian xin ！ feng fu 、 tian mi 、 nian chou ！ sui ran bu ru ji dan ， bu bu bu 。 ni ying gai mai yi xie ji dan ！]

english: But I need raisins...
translation: 但我需要葡萄干... [dan wo xu yao pu tao gan ...]

english: Hmmm, that Glanton fellow mentioned raisins, or was it racing? Something about hydration in any case. Yes, ask him about your eggs. My eggs are off limits.
translation: 嗯，那个格兰顿家伙提到了葡萄干，还是赛车？无论如何，都与水合作用有关。是的，向他询问你的鸡蛋。我的鸡蛋是禁区。 [n ， na ge ge lan dun jia huo ti dao le pu tao gan ， hai shi sai che ？ wu lun ru he ， dou yu shui he zuo yong you guan 。 shi de ， xiang ta xun wen ni de ji dan 。 wo de ji dan shi jin qu 。]

english: I need raisins!!!
translation: 我需要葡萄干！！！ [wo xu yao pu tao gan ！！！]

english: Oh my child, you think you need raisins, but you need only embrace the runny yolk of a fine egg to be happy!
translation: 噢，我的孩子，你以为你需要葡萄干，但你只需要拥抱流淌的优质鸡蛋的蛋黄就可以快乐了！ [o ， wo de hai zi ， ni yi wei ni xu yao pu tao gan ， dan ni zhi xu yao yong bao liu tang de you zhi ji dan de dan huang jiu ke yi kuai le le ！]

english: Urgh... Bye.
translation: 呃……再见。 [e …… zai jian 。]

english: Easter Buns! Eggy funs! Tasty wasty winky wuns! Oh bunny good and nunny noo..
translation: 复活节面包！蛋蛋乐趣！美味又浪费眨眼的wuns！噢，兔子好，尼姑不行.. [fu huo jie mian bao ！ dan dan le qu ！ mei wei you lang fei zha yan de wuns！ o ， tu zi hao ， ni gu bu xing ..]

english: Oh hello! I didn't see you there. Off in my own little world I was. How go the buns?
translation: 哦你好！我在那儿没看到你。我沉浸在自己的小世界里。包子怎么去？ [o ni hao ！ wo zai na er mei kan dao ni 。 wo chen jin zai zi ji de xiao shi jie li 。 bao zi zen me qu ？]

english: I've made them, I just need to cook them.
translation: 我已经做了，我只需要煮它们。 [wo yi jing zuo le ， wo zhi xu yao zhu ta men 。]

english: Chop chop then! I can't stop thinking about them.
translation: 那就砍砍吧！我无法停止思考他们。 [na jiu kan kan ba ！ wo wu fa ting zhi si kao ta men 。]

english: All in good time.
translation: 一切都恰逢其时。 [yi qie dou qia feng qi shi 。]

english: Do my senses decieve me? Can I smell... Easter Buns?!
translation: 我的感觉欺骗了我吗？我能闻到……复活节面包吗？！ [wo de gan jue qi pian le wo ma ？ wo neng wen dao …… fu huo jie mian bao ma ？！]

english: Indeed you can.
translation: 确实可以。 [que shi ke yi 。]

english: Wonderful! Have you tried one yet?
translation: 精彩的！您尝试过吗？ [jing cai de ！ nin chang shi guo ma ？]

english: I have! They are fantastic. Great recipe.

english: Nothing. Maybe later!
translation: 没有什么。也许以后吧！ [mei you shen me 。 ye xu yi hou ba ！]

english: Nothing.

english: Hello. Who are you?
translation: 你好。你是谁？ [ni hao 。 ni shi shui ？]

english: Hi there. I'm Ektheme, an expert on the Xerician era.
translation: 你好呀。我是 Ektheme，Xerician 时代的专家。 [ni hao ya 。 wo shi  Ektheme，Xerician  shi dai de zhuan jia 。]

english: Who was Xeric?
translation: 谢里克是谁？ [xie li ke shi shui ？]

english: Xeric was a dark mage who ruled Great Kourend for at least ten decades. A time period that is sometimes known as the Age of Strife.
translation: 埃里克是一名黑暗法师，统治大库伦德至少十年。有时被称为冲突时代的时期。 [ai li ke shi yi ming hei an fa shi ， tong zhi da ku lun de zhi shao shi nian 。 you shi bei cheng wei chong tu shi dai de shi qi 。]

english: At least? Do you not know how long he was in power for?
translation: 至少？你不知道他在位多久吗？ [zhi shao ？ ni bu zhi dao ta zai wei duo jiu ma ？]

english: We do have records of course. However, while Xeric was indeed ruler of the kingdom from the 37th to the 47th decades, some believe that he actually ruled for longer.
translation: 我们当然有记录。然而，虽然 Xeric 确实是王国从 37 世纪到 47 世纪的统治者，但有些人认为他实际上统治的时间更长。 [wo men dang ran you ji lu 。 ran er ， sui ran  Xeric  que shi shi wang guo cong  37  shi ji dao  47  shi ji de tong zhi zhe ， dan you xie ren ren wei ta shi ji shang tong zhi de shi jian geng zhang 。]

english: How come?
translation: 怎么会？ [zen me hui ？]

english: It is often speculated that Xeric and his predecessor, King Shayzien VII, were in fact the same person.
translation: 人们经常猜测，谢里克和他的前任国王沙伊金七世实际上是同一个人。 [ren men jing chang cai ce ， xie li ke he ta de qian ren guo wang sha yi jin qi shi shi ji shang shi tong yi ge ren 。]

english: How could that be?
translation: 怎么可能呢？ [zen me ke neng ne ？]

english: Like Xeric, King Shayzien VII was fascinated with the Dark Altar.
translation: 和 Xeric 一样，Shayzien 七世国王也对黑暗祭坛着迷。 [he  Xeric  yi yang ，Shayzien  qi shi guo wang ye dui hei an ji tan zhao mi 。]

english: The King was killed at the Battle of the Concourse during the 37th decade. We have many accounts of this, yet his body was never recovered.
translation: 国王在37世纪的广场之战中被杀。我们对此有很多记载，但他的尸体从未被发现。 [guo wang zai 37 shi ji de guang chang zhi zhan zhong bei sha 。 wo men dui ci you hen duo ji zai ， dan ta de shi ti cong wei bei fa xian 。]

english: Just days after his death, we have the first recorded mention of Xeric, an incredibly powerful mage who resembled the King.
translation: 就在他去世几天后，我们第一次有记录地提到了艾瑞克，一位与国王相似的极其强大的法师。 [jiu zai ta qu shi ji tian hou ， wo men di yi ci you ji lu di ti dao le ai rui ke ， yi wei yu guo wang xiang si de ji qi qiang da de fa shi 。]

english: It is written that Xeric killed the rulers of Kourend's five cities and claimed the kingdom as his own.
translation: 据记载，泽里克杀死了库伦德五个城市的统治者，并声称该王国属于他自己。 [ju ji zai ， ze li ke sha si le ku lun de wu ge cheng shi de tong zhi zhe ， bing sheng cheng gai wang guo shu yu ta zi ji 。]

english: So King Shayzien VII was resurrected as Xeric using the Dark Altar?
translation: 那么 Shayzien VII 国王是通过黑暗祭坛复活为 Xeric 的吗？ [na me  Shayzien VII  guo wang shi tong guo hei an ji tan fu huo wei  Xeric  de ma ？]

english: It's possible. I am no expert on necromancy but we know the Dark Altar has the power to resurrect beasts. We also know that it can extend life. It's how the people of Arceuus are immortal.
translation: 这是有可能的。我不是死灵专家，但我们知道黑暗祭坛拥有复活野兽的能力。我们也知道它可以延长寿命。阿尔宙斯的人民就是这样不朽的。 [zhe shi you ke neng de 。 wo bu shi si ling zhuan jia ， dan wo men zhi dao hei an ji tan yong you fu huo ye shou de neng li 。 wo men ye zhi dao ta ke yi yan chang shou ming 。 a er zhou si de ren min jiu shi zhe yang bu xiu de 。]

english: King Shayzien VII may have found a way to combine these powers.
translation: 国王沙伊恩七世可能已经找到了结合这些权力的方法。 [guo wang sha yi en qi shi ke neng yi jing zhao dao le jie he zhe xie quan li de fang fa 。]

english: How did Xeric have so much power?
translation: 埃里克怎么会有这么大的力量？ [ai li ke zen me hui you zhe me da de li liang ？]

english: Xeric drew much of his power from the Dark Altar, but he asserted his authority as ruler through his personal army of creatures, the lizardmen.
translation: 泽里克从黑暗祭坛汲取了大部分力量，但他通过他的个人生物军队——蜥蜴人来维护自己作为统治者的权威。 [ze li ke cong hei an ji tan ji qu le da bu fen li liang ， dan ta tong guo ta de ge ren sheng wu jun dui —— xi yi ren lai wei hu zi ji zuo wei tong zhi zhe de quan wei 。]

english: Xeric created the lizardmen!?
translation: 埃里克创造了蜥蜴人！？ [ai li ke chuang zao le xi yi ren ！？]

english: Sadly so, though we're not exactly sure how he did so. Xeric used the citizens of Kourend for many experiments, as well as for his own sadistic pleasures.
translation: 可悲的是，尽管我们不确定他是如何做到的。埃里克利用库伦德的公民进行许多实验，同时也为了他自己的施虐快感。 [ke bei de shi ， jin guan wo men bu que ding ta shi ru he zuo dao de 。 ai li ke li yong ku lun de de gong min jin xing xu duo shi yan ， tong shi ye wei le ta zi ji de shi nve kuai gan 。]

english: We have little written record of the experiments, but we believe they might have led to the creation of the lizardmen.
translation: 我们对这些实验几乎没有书面记录，但我们相信它们可能导致了蜥蜴人的诞生。 [wo men dui zhe xie shi yan ji hu mei you shu mian ji lu ， dan wo men xiang xin ta men ke neng dao zhi le xi yi ren de dan sheng 。]

english: Do you know why he created the lizardmen?
translation: 你知道他为什么创造蜥蜴人吗？ [ni zhi dao ta wei shen me chuang zao xi yi ren ma ？]

english: Originally, we believed that Xeric created the lizardmen. However, recent discovieressuggest they were actually created during the time of King Shayzien VII.
translation: 最初，我们相信 Xeric 创造了蜥蜴人。然而，最近的发现表明它们实际上是在国王沙伊恩七世时期创建的。 [zui chu ， wo men xiang xin  Xeric  chuang zao le xi yi ren 。 ran er ， zui jin de fa xian biao ming ta men shi ji shang shi zai guo wang sha yi en qi shi shi qi chuang jian de 。]

english: Do you know why Xeric needed the lizardmen?
translation: 你知道为什么艾瑞克需要蜥蜴人吗？ [ni zhi dao wei shen me ai rui ke xu yao xi yi ren ma ？]

english: Xeric was undoubtedly powerful, but he couldn't rule the people singlehandedly, nor could he rely on human informants. He needed an army he could control.
translation: 埃里克无疑是强大的，但他无法单枪匹马统治人民，也无法依赖人类线人。他需要一支他可以控制的军队。 [ai li ke wu yi shi qiang da de ， dan ta wu fa dan qiang pi ma tong zhi ren min ， ye wu fa yi lai ren lei xian ren 。 ta xu yao yi zhi ta ke yi kong zhi de jun dui 。]

english: Lizardmen are loyal creatures and would do as he commanded without question. With them at his disposal, the people were powerless to resist his authority.
translation: 蜥蜴人是忠诚的生物，会毫无疑问地执行他的命令。有了他的支配，人民就无力反抗他的权威。 [xi yi ren shi zhong cheng de sheng wu ， hui hao wu yi wen di zhi xing ta de ming ling 。 you le ta de zhi pei ， ren min jiu wu li fan kang ta de quan wei 。]

english: What happened to the lizardmen after Xeric's reign?
translation: 埃里克统治后蜥蜴人怎么样了？ [ai li ke tong zhi hou xi yi ren zen me yang le ？]

english: They remain loyal to Xeric. Even to this day they continue to attack the kingdom, as you may have seen.
translation: 他们仍然忠于Xeric。正如您可能已经看到的那样，直到今天，他们仍在继续攻击王国。 [ta men reng ran zhong yu Xeric。 zheng ru nin ke neng yi jing kan dao de na yang ， zhi dao jin tian ， ta men reng zai ji xu gong ji wang guo 。]

english: Fortunately, the Shayzien Army keeps them under control.
translation: 幸运的是，Shayzien 军队控制住了他们。 [xing yun de shi ，Shayzien  jun dui kong zhi zhu le ta men 。]

english: Why do they keep fighting? Surely after a thousand years they must know Xeric is gone?
translation: 他们为什么还要打架？一千年之后他们一定知道 Xeric 已经走了吗？ [ta men wei shen me hai yao da jia ？ yi qian nian zhi hou ta men yi ding zhi dao  Xeric  yi jing zou le ma ？]

english: Without examining their minds, we will never know for sure. However, we assume Xeric genetically altered them to enforce that their duty is to serve him.
translation: 如果不检查他们的想法，我们永远无法确定。然而，我们假设艾瑞克对他们进行了基因改造，以强制他们的职责是为他服务。 [ru guo bu jian cha ta men de xiang fa ， wo men yong yuan wu fa que ding 。 ran er ， wo men jia she ai rui ke dui ta men jin xing le ji yin gai zao ， yi qiang zhi ta men de zhi ze shi wei ta fu wu 。]

english: But if they are serving Xeric, why do they attack the kingdom?

english: Is there anything else you would like to know?
translation: 您还有什么想知道的吗？ [nin hai you shen me xiang zhi dao de ma ？]

english: What happened to Xeric?
translation: 埃里克怎么了？ [ai li ke zen me le ？]

english: During the 47th decade, after ten decades of oppression, the people revolted against Xeric and his army of lizardmen.
translation: 第四十七年，在经历了十年的压迫之后，人民反抗了艾瑞克和他的蜥蜴人军队。 [di si shi qi nian ， zai jing li le shi nian de ya po zhi hou ， ren min fan kang le ai rui ke he ta de xi yi ren jun dui 。]

english: Why did the people suffer for so long?
translation: 人民为何长期受苦？ [ren min wei he chang qi shou ku ？]

english: The events were triggered through the courage of one man, Byrne. He was not a man of particular stature of nobility, though he did proceed to become king.
translation: 这些事件是由伯恩这个人的勇气引发的。尽管他后来成为了国王，但他并不是一个具有特殊地位的贵族。 [zhe xie shi jian shi you bo en zhe ge ren de yong qi yin fa de 。 jin guan ta hou lai cheng wei le guo wang ， dan ta bing bu shi yi ge ju you te shu di wei de gui zu 。]

english: What happened?
translation: 发生了什么？ [fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: 'Twas the 312th day of decade 47. Byrne, a farmer by trade, is said to have witnessed a lizardman guard murder a child whilst working his farm.
translation: 那是 47 年的第 312 天。伯恩是一名农民，据说他在农场干活时亲眼目睹了一名蜥蜴人守卫谋杀了一名儿童。 [na shi  47  nian de di  312  tian 。 bo en shi yi ming nong min ， ju shuo ta zai nong chang gan huo shi qin yan mu du le yi ming xi yi ren shou wei mou sha le yi ming er tong 。]

english: Outraged at what he had just seen, Byrne grabbed his pitchfork and sprinted towards the guard.

english: Blinded by fury, Byrne attacked the guard, slaughtering the lizardman in plain sight of all around.

english: Legend has it Byrne then gave a galvanizing speech, standing over the butchered guard with his bloodied pitchfork held aloft in the air, urging the people to fight back.
translation: 传说伯恩随后发表了一场激动人心的演讲，他站在被屠杀的警卫旁边，高举着沾满血迹的干草叉，敦促人们反击。 [chuan shuo bo en sui hou fa biao le yi chang ji dong ren xin de yan jiang ， ta zhan zai bei tu sha de jing wei pang bian ， gao ju zhe zhan man xue ji de gan cao cha ， dun cu ren men fan ji 。]

english: Do you know what he said?
translation: 你知道他说了什么吗？ [ni zhi dao ta shuo le shen me ma ？]

english: Sadly no. While we have many witness accounts, they all differ, so we can not verify it at all.
translation: 遗憾的是没有。虽然我们有很多目击证人的说法，但它们都不同，所以我们根本无法核实。 [yi han de shi mei you 。 sui ran wo men you hen duo mu ji zheng ren de shuo fa ， dan ta men dou bu tong ， suo yi wo men gen ben wu fa he shi 。]

english: Whatever Byrne said, the people responded. Together, the citizens of Kourend revolted, grabbing whatever they could use as a weapon. They fought the lizardmen.
translation: 无论伯恩说什么，人们都会做出回应。库伦德的公民一起反抗，抢夺一切可以用作武器的东西。他们与蜥蜴人战斗。 [wu lun bo en shuo shen me ， ren men du hui zuo chu hui ying 。 ku lun de de gong min yi qi fan kang ， qiang duo yi qie ke yi yong zuo wu qi de dong xi 。 ta men yu xi yi ren zhan dou 。]

english: The lizardmen, while strong and powerful, were simply outnumbered. In a matter of days, they had been driven back into the Kebos Lowlands.
translation: 蜥蜴人虽然强大，但寡不敌众。几天之内，他们就被赶回了科博斯低地。 [xi yi ren sui ran qiang da ， dan gua bu di zhong 。 ji tian zhi nei ， ta men jiu bei gan hui le ke bo si di di 。]

translation: 我很棒，谢谢你！ [wo hen bang ， xie xie ni ！]

english: Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 你好！水晶城里今天过得怎么样啊？ [ni hao ！ shui jing cheng li jin tian guo de zen me yang a ？]

english: Indeed.
translation: 的确。 [di que 。]

english: What can I do for ya?
translation: 我能为你做什么？ [wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 各种各样的事情！这些塔楼是一个美妙的景观。 [ge zhong ge yang de shi qing ！ zhe xie ta lou shi yi ge mei miao de jing guan 。]

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 在像今天这样的日子，我建议您参观市场。 [zai xiang jin tian zhe yang de ri zi ， wo jian yi nin can guan shi chang 。]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你认为你在做什么？ [ni ren wei ni zai zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: You! Time for some questions.
translation: 你！是时候问一些问题了。 [ni ！ shi shi hou wen yi xie wen ti le 。]

english: Why did you join the Emissaries?
translation: 你为什么加入使者？ [ni wei shen me jia ru shi zhe ？]

english: I wished to see my god in mortal form and serve his will. In return for my service, the Emissaries promised me they could grant that wish.
translation: 我希望看到我的神以凡人的形式出现并服务于他的意志。作为对我服务的回报，使者们向我承诺他们可以实现这个愿望。 [wo xi wang kan dao wo de shen yi fan ren de xing shi chu xian bing fu wu yu ta de yi zhi 。 zuo wei dui wo fu wu de hui bao ， shi zhe men xiang wo cheng nuo ta men ke yi shi xian zhe ge yuan wang 。]

english: I wished to see my god in mortal form and be granted eternity in Mictl. In return for my service, the Emissaries promised me they could grant that wish.
translation: 我希望看到我的神以凡人的形式出现，并在米克特尔获得永恒。作为对我服务的回报，使者们向我承诺他们可以实现这个愿望。 [wo xi wang kan dao wo de shen yi fan ren de xing shi chu xian ， bing zai mi ke te er huo de yong heng 。 zuo wei dui wo fu wu de hui bao ， shi zhe men xiang wo cheng nuo ta men ke yi shi xian zhe ge yuan wang 。]

english: Who do you worship?
translation: 你崇拜谁？ [ni chong bai shui ？]

english: I am a humble servant of Ranul. It has always been my hope to stand before him and be judged as worthy.
translation: 我是拉努尔的卑微仆人。我一直希望能够站在他面前并被认为是有价值的。 [wo shi la nu er de bei wei pu ren 。 wo yi zhi xi wang neng gou zhan zai ta mian qian bing bei ren wei shi you jia zhi de 。]

english: Tell me about the Final Dawn.
translation: 跟我讲讲《最后的黎明》吧。 [gen wo jiang jiang 《 zui hou de li ming 》 ba 。]

english: The Final Dawn is the will of Ranul. He will show us all that death is nothing to be feared as he and Ralos guide us into forming a new world.
translation: 最终黎明是拉努尔的意志。当他和拉洛斯引导我们建立一个新世界时，他将向我们所有人展示死亡并不可怕。 [zui zhong li ming shi la nu er de yi zhi 。 dang ta he la luo si yin dao wo men jian li yi ge xin shi jie shi ， ta jiang xiang wo men suo you ren zhan shi si wang bing bu ke pa 。]

english: The Final Dawn is the will of Ranul. He will show us all that death is nothing to be feared. He and Ralos will lead us into forming a new world before then guiding us to Mictl.
translation: 最终黎明是拉努尔的意志。他会让我们所有人知道，死亡并不可怕。他和Ralos将带领我们形成一个新世界，然后引导我们前往Mictl。 [zui zhong li ming shi la nu er de yi zhi 。 ta hui rang wo men suo you ren zhi dao ， si wang bing bu ke pa 。 ta he Ralos jiang dai ling wo men xing cheng yi ge xin shi jie ， ran hou yin dao wo men qian wang Mictl。]

english: Why did you join the Emissaries?
translation: 你为什么加入使者？ [ni wei shen me jia ru shi zhe ？]

english: Who do you worship?
translation: 你崇拜谁？ [ni chong bai shui ？]

english: Tell me about the Final Dawn.
translation: 跟我讲讲《最后的黎明》吧。 [gen wo jiang jiang 《 zui hou de li ming 》 ba 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Human! You must be one of Tyras's men. I have no time for brigands or outlaws.
translation: 人类！你一定是泰拉斯的手下之一。我没有时间对付强盗或亡命之徒。 [ren lei ！ ni yi ding shi tai la si de shou xia zhi yi 。 wo mei you shi jian dui fu qiang dao huo wang ming zhi tu 。]

english: Human! You must be one of Tyras's men...
translation: 人类！你一定是泰拉斯的手下之一…… [ren lei ！ ni yi ding shi tai la si de shou xia zhi yi ……]

english: No, I'm [player name]! Lord Iorwerth said you might be able to help me.
translation: 不，我是[玩家姓名]！约沃斯勋爵说你或许可以帮助我。 [bu ， wo shi [ wan jia xing ming ]！ yue wo si xun jue shuo ni huo xu ke yi bang zhu wo 。]

english: And you have something to prove this?
translation: 你有什么可以证明这一点吗？ [ni you shen me ke yi zheng ming zhe yi dian ma ？]

english: Well... Err... No.
As I was saying... I have no time for brigands or outlaws.
translation: 正如我所说……我没有时间对付强盗或亡命之徒。 [zheng ru wo suo shuo …… wo mei you shi jian dui fu qiang dao huo wang ming zhi tu 。]

english: You show the tracker the crystal pendant.
translation: 您向追踪器展示水晶吊坠。 [nin xiang zhui zong qi zhan shi shui jing diao zhui 。]

english: That is Lord Iorwerth's pendant. He must have a lot of faith in you. Now, what is it I can help you with?
translation: 那是约沃斯勋爵的吊坠。他一定对你很有信心。现在，我可以帮助你什么？ [na shi yue wo si xun jue de diao zhui 。 ta yi ding dui ni hen you xin xin 。 xian zai ， wo ke yi bang zhu ni shen me ？]

english: I need to find Tyras and kill him. Do you know where his camp is?
translation: 我需要找到泰拉斯并杀死他。你知道他的营地在哪里吗？ [wo xu yao zhao dao tai la si bing sha si ta 。 ni zhi dao ta de ying di zai na li ma ？]

english: Well this was his old camp. After the battle a few days ago they moved. We're yet to find them again.
translation: 嗯，这是他以前的营地。几天前的战斗结束后，他们搬家了。我们还没有再次找到他们。 [n ， zhe shi ta yi qian de ying di 。 ji tian qian de zhan dou jie shu hou ， ta men ban jia le 。 wo men hai mei you zai ci zhao dao ta men 。]

english: Can I help at all?
translation: 我能帮忙吗？ [wo neng bang mang ma ？]

english: As it goes I'm not actually tracking them at the moment. I'm currently trying to trace our renegade brethen instead. This here is the best lead we've found so far.
translation: 就目前情况而言，我目前并没有真正跟踪他们。我现在正试图追踪我们的叛徒兄弟。这是迄今为止我们找到的最好的线索。 [jiu mu qian qing kuang er yan ， wo mu qian bing mei you zhen zheng gen zong ta men 。 wo xian zai zheng shi tu zhui zong wo men de pan tu xiong di 。 zhe shi qi jin wei zhi wo men zhao dao de zui hao de xian suo 。]

english: What is?
translation: 什么是？ [shen me shi ？]

english: Ahh I guess you can't see it with those human eyes.
translation: 啊，我猜你用人类的眼睛看不到它。 [a ， wo cai ni yong ren lei de yan jing kan bu dao ta 。]

english: I tell you what. Now that you're here I may as well give you a hand. I'll search here on the east side. You check out the west end of the camp. Come and tell me if you find anything.
translation: 我告诉你什么。既然你来了，我也可以帮你一把。我会在东边寻找。你检查一下营地的西端。如果你发现了什么，请过来告诉我。 [wo gao su ni shen me 。 ji ran ni lai le ， wo ye ke yi bang ni yi ba 。 wo hui zai dong bian xun zhao 。 ni jian cha yi xia ying di de xi duan 。 ru guo ni fa xian le shen me ， qing guo lai gao su wo 。]

english: I've found tracks leading off to the west. But they trail off into the trees. Beyond that I am unable to follow.
translation: 我发现了通往西方的足迹。但它们渐渐消失在树林里。除此之外我无法理解。 [wo fa xian le tong wang xi fang de zu ji 。 dan ta men jian jian xiao shi zai shu lin li 。 chu ci zhi wai wo wu fa li jie 。]

english: These forests aren't always as dense as you'd think. If you look closer, you might see ways that you can get through. With that in mind, why don't you give it another go?
translation: 这些森林并不总是像你想象的那么茂密。如果你仔细观察，你可能会发现可以通过的方法。考虑到这一点，为什么不再尝试一下呢？ [zhe xie sen lin bing bu zong shi xiang ni xiang xiang de na me mao mi 。 ru guo ni zi xi guan cha ， ni ke neng hui fa xian ke yi tong guo de fang fa 。 kao lv dao zhe yi dian ， wei shen me bu zai chang shi yi xia ne ？]

english: Thanks... I'll see what I can find.
translation: 谢谢...我会看看我能找到什么。 [xie xie ... wo hui kan kan wo neng zhao dao shen me 。]

english: How goes the hunt for that bandit camp?
translation: 追捕强盗营地的工作进展如何？ [zhui bu qiang dao ying di de gong zuo jin zhan ru he ？]

english: Getting there.
translation: 到达那里。 [dao da na li 。]

english: I found it a short distance west of here.
translation: 我在西边不远的地方发现了它。 [wo zai xi bian bu yuan de di fang fa xian le ta 。]

english: I'm sure Lord Iorwerth will be pleased to hear that. You should let him know.
translation: 我相信约沃斯勋爵听到这个消息一定会很高兴。你应该让他知道。 [wo xiang xin yue wo si xun jue ting dao zhe ge xiao xi yi ding hui hen gao xing 。 ni ying gai rang ta zhi dao 。]

english: Welcome, adventurer. Are you in need of a staff?
translation: 欢迎，冒险家。您需要员工吗？ [huan ying ， mao xian jia 。 nin xu yao yuan gong ma ？]

english: What do you have?
translation: 你有什么？ [ni you shen me ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Don't be a stranger. Come on by any time you need anything.
translation: 别做陌生人。有什么需要就随时来吧。 [bie zuo mo sheng ren 。 you shen me xu yao jiu sui shi lai ba 。]

english: What do you have?
translation: 你有什么？ [ni you shen me ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Good day to you.
translation: 祝你有美好的一天。 [zhu ni you mei hao de yi tian 。]

english: What brings you here?
translation: 是什么风把你吹到这里来的？ [shi shen me feng ba ni chui dao zhe li lai de ？]

english: The eternal quest for knowledge, of course! The name's Elias White. I'm something of an explorer.
translation: 当然是对知识的永恒追求！我的名字叫埃利亚斯·怀特。我有点像探险家。 [dang ran shi dui zhi shi de yong heng zhui qiu ！ wo de ming zi jiao ai li ya si · huai te 。 wo you dian xiang tan xian jia 。]

english: Pleased to meet you. I'm [player name]. So you're searching for knowledge in an inn?
translation: 很高兴认识你。我是[玩家姓名]。那么你正在旅馆里寻找知识吗？ [hen gao xing ren shi ni 。 wo shi [ wan jia xing ming ]。 na me ni zheng zai lv guan li xun zhao zhi shi ma ？]

english: Not exactly. In fact, I was previously hunting down information on an ancient race deep within the desert.
translation: 不完全是。事实上，我之前一直在寻找关于沙漠深处一个古老种族的信息。 [bu wan quan shi 。 shi shi shang ， wo zhi qian yi zhi zai xun zhao guan yu sha mo shen chu yi ge gu lao zhong zu de xin xi 。]

english: However, I received an interesting yet concerning tip- off from a contact of mine regarding some of my research. I came here to investigate for myself.
translation: 然而，我从一位联系人那里收到了一份关于我的一些研究的有趣但令人担忧的举报。我来这里是为了亲自调查。 [ran er ， wo cong yi wei lian xi ren na li shou dao le yi fen guan yu wo de yi xie yan jiu de you qu dan ling ren dan you de ju bao 。 wo lai zhe li shi wei le qin zi diao cha 。]

english: Oh, hello there. You look familiar. Have we met before?
translation: 哦，你好。你看起来很熟悉。我们以前见过吗？ [o ， ni hao 。 ni kan qi lai hen shu xi 。 wo men yi qian jian guo ma ？]

english: I think so. The name's [player name]. You're Elias, right? You had a camp out near Uzer.
translation: 我想是的。名字是[玩家姓名]。你是埃利亚斯，对吧？你在乌泽附近有一个营地。 [wo xiang shi de 。 ming zi shi [ wan jia xing ming ]。 ni shi ai li ya si ， dui ba ？ ni zai wu ze fu jin you yi ge ying di 。]

english: Ah, of course. You offered to help with my work, didn't you? I'm still very keen to take you up on that offer at some point, but a more pressing matter has delayed that somewhat.
translation: 啊，当然。你主动提出要帮助我的工作，不是吗？我仍然非常热衷于在某个时候接受你的邀请，但更紧迫的事情推迟了这一时间。 [a ， dang ran 。 ni zhu dong ti chu yao bang zhu wo de gong zuo ， bu shi ma ？ wo reng ran fei chang re zhong yu zai mou ge shi hou jie shou ni de yao qing ， dan geng jin po de shi qing tui chi le zhe yi shi jian 。]

english: Is that what's brought you here?
translation: 这就是你来这里的原因吗？ [zhe jiu shi ni lai zhe li de yuan yin ma ？]

english: Indeed. I recived an interesting yet concerning tip-off from a contact of mine regarding some of my research. I came here to investigate for myself.
translation: 的确。我从一位联系人那里收到了一份关于我的一些研究的有趣但令人担忧的举报。我来这里是为了亲自调查。 [di que 。 wo cong yi wei lian xi ren na li shou dao le yi fen guan yu wo de yi xie yan jiu de you qu dan ling ren dan you de ju bao 。 wo lai zhe li shi wei le qin zi diao cha 。]

english: Anything I can help with?
translation: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang mang de ma ？]

english: How kind of you to offer. I'm not in need of any extra help right now though.
translation: 你多么好心地提供。不过我现在不需要任何额外的帮助。 [ni duo me hao xin di ti gong 。 bu guo wo xian zai bu xu yao ren he e wai de bang zhu 。]

english: How kind of you to offer. I definitely wouldn't complain about some extra support, if you're sure you're interested?
translation: 你多么好心地提供。如果您确定有兴趣的话，我绝对不会抱怨一些额外的支持？ [ni duo me hao xin di ti gong 。 ru guo nin que ding you xing qu de hua ， wo jue dui bu hui bao yuan yi xie e wai de zhi chi ？]

english: Absolutely! So what was this tip-off you received?
translation: 绝对地！那么您收​​到的举报是什么？ [jue dui di ！ na me nin shou ​​ dao de ju bao shi shen me ？]

english: Actually, I think I'll pass.
translation: 事实上，我想我会通过。 [shi shi shang ， wo xiang wo hui tong guo 。]

english: Very well. If you change your mind, I'll be here.
translation: 很好。如果你改变主意，我就在这里。 [hen hao 。 ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， wo jiu zai zhe li 。]

english: Ah, hello there, [player name]. Good to see you.
translation: 啊，你好，[玩家姓名]。很高兴见到你。 [a ， ni hao ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。 hen gao xing jian dao ni 。]

english: And you, Elias. So you're back out here again?
translation: 还有你，埃利亚斯。所以你又回来了？ [hai you ni ， ai li ya si 。 suo yi ni you hui lai le ？]

english: Indeed. Turns out the desert was the best place to begin my research into Arrav and his heart. Not too surprising of course, given the burial practices here.
translation: 的确。事实证明，沙漠是我开始研究阿拉夫和他的心脏的最佳地点。考虑到这里的埋葬方式，这当然不足为奇。 [di que 。 shi shi zheng ming ， sha mo shi wo kai shi yan jiu a la fu he ta de xin zang de zui jia di dian 。 kao lv dao zhe li de mai zang fang shi ， zhe dang ran bu zu wei qi 。]

english: In fact, as you might recall, I was here before to look into that old mastaba up on the plateau.
translation: 事实上，你可能还记得，我之前来过这里是为了参观高原上那座古老的马斯塔巴。 [shi shi shang ， ni ke neng hai ji de ， wo zhi qian lai guo zhe li shi wei le can guan gao yuan shang na zuo gu lao de ma si ta ba 。]

english: Yes, I remember. You said it might contain important information on the Mahjarrat.
translation: 是的，我记得。你说它可能包含有关 Mahjarrat 的重要信息。 [shi de ， wo ji de 。 ni shuo ta ke neng bao han you guan  Mahjarrat  de zhong yao xin xi 。]

english: Indeed I did. And I reckon it might also contain the knowledge we need to help old Arrav out.
translation: 确实我做到了。我认为它可能还包含我们帮助老阿拉夫摆脱困境所需的知识。 [que shi wo zuo dao le 。 wo ren wei ta ke neng hai bao han wo men bang zhu lao a la fu bai tuo kun jing suo xu de zhi shi 。]

english: Excellent!
translation: 出色的！ [chu se de ！]

english: Now, I still have quite a bit of preparatory work to do before we consider heading inside, but once that's done, I'll be in touch.
translation: 现在，在我们考虑进去之前，我还有很多准备工作要做，但一旦完成，我就会联系你。 [xian zai ， zai wo men kao lv jin qu zhi qian ， wo hai you hen duo zhun bei gong zuo yao zuo ， dan yi dan wan cheng ， wo jiu hui lian xi ni 。]

english: Sounds good. I'd best leave you to your work.
translation: 听起来不错。我最好让你继续工作。 [ting qi lai bu cuo 。 wo zui hao rang ni ji xu gong zuo 。]

english: Until next time.
translation: 直到下次。 [zhi dao xia ci 。]

english: What brings you all the way out here?
translation: 是什么让你千里迢迢来到这里？ [shi shen me rang ni qian li tiao tiao lai dao zhe li ？]

english: Are you searching for something here?
translation: 您在这里寻找什么东西吗？ [nin zai zhe li xun zhao shen me dong xi ma ？]

english: Of course. As I said, my search is for knowledge.
translation: 当然。正如我所说，我的追求是为了知识。 [dang ran 。 zheng ru wo suo shuo ， wo de zhui qiu shi wei le zhi shi 。]

english: What kind of knowledge?
translation: 什么样的知识？ [shen me yang de zhi shi ？]

english: Information lost to the ages. Specifically, information on an ancient race.
translation: 信息失传于岁月。具体来说，是有关古代种族的信息。 [xin xi shi chuan yu sui yue 。 ju ti lai shuo ， shi you guan gu dai zhong zu de xin xi 。]

english: And you expect to find something here?
translation: 您希望在这里找到一些东西吗？ [nin xi wang zai zhe li zhao dao yi xie dong xi ma ？]

english: Not quite here, but up on the plateau. There's an old mastaba up there that I believe dates from a time when the race resided in these lands.
translation: 不完全在这里，而是在高原上。那里有一座古老的马斯塔巴，我相信它的历史可以追溯到人类居住在这些土地上的时代。 [bu wan quan zai zhe li ， er shi zai gao yuan shang 。 na li you yi zuo gu lao de ma si ta ba ， wo xiang xin ta de li shi ke yi zhui su dao ren lei ju zhu zai zhe xie tu di shang de shi dai 。]

english: Well if you ever need help raiding an ancient tomb, I reckon I can be of service.
translation: 好吧，如果你在突袭古墓时需要帮助，我想我可以为你服务。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni zai tu xi gu mu shi xu yao bang zhu ， wo xiang wo ke yi wei ni fu wu 。]

english: A generous offer! I still have quite a bit of preparatory work to do before I dare head inside, but once that's done, maybe we can work something out.
translation: 慷慨的优惠！在我敢进去之前，我还有很多准备工作要做，但一旦完成，也许我们可以解决一些问题。 [kang kai de you hui ！ zai wo gan jin qu zhi qian ， wo hai you hen duo zhun bei gong zuo yao zuo ， dan yi dan wan cheng ， ye xu wo men ke yi jie jue yi xie wen ti 。]

english: Where do you call home?
translation: 你在哪里打电话回家？ [ni zai na li da dian hua hui jia ？]

english: Ah, I've lived in many places over the years, but I wouldn't really say I have a home. I guess Varrock would be the closest answer.
translation: 啊，这些年我住过很多地方，但我不会说我有一个家。我想 Varrock 是最接近的答案。 [a ， zhe xie nian wo zhu guo hen duo di fang ， dan wo bu hui shuo wo you yi ge jia 。 wo xiang  Varrock  shi zui jie jin de da an 。]

english: Sounds like you have quite the history.
