translation: 你认识这个线程吗？ [ni ren shi zhe ge xian cheng ma ？]

english: Looks like Blue thread to me. If you can't work that out for yourself I don't hold much hope of you solving this crime.
translation: 对我来说看起来像蓝线。如果你自己不能解决这个问题，我对你破案不抱太大希望。 [dui wo lai shuo kan qi lai xiang lan xian 。 ru guo ni zi ji bu neng jie jue zhe ge wen ti ， wo dui ni po an bu bao tai da xi wang 。]

english: It looks a lot like the material your trousers are made of doesn't it?
translation: 它看起来很像你裤子的材质，不是吗？ [ta kan qi lai hen xiang ni ku zi de cai zhi ， bu shi ma ？]

english: I suppose it does. So what?
translation: 我想是的。所以呢？ [wo xiang shi de 。 suo yi ne ？]

english: It's some thread. You're not very good at this whole investigation thing are you?
translation: 这是一些线程。你不太擅长整个调查工作，是吗？ [zhe shi yi xie xian cheng 。 ni bu tai shan chang zheng ge diao cha gong zuo ， shi ma ？]

english: Why'd you buy poison the other day?
translation: 那天你为什么要买毒药？ [na tian ni wei shen me yao mai du yao ？]

english: There was a nest of mosquitos under the fountain in the garden, which I killed with poison the other day. You can see for yourself if you're capable of managing that, which I somehow doubt.
translation: 花园里的喷泉下面有一窝蚊子，我前几天用毒药灭掉了。你可以亲自看看你是否有能力做到这一点，但我对此表示怀疑。 [hua yuan li de pen quan xia mian you yi wo wen zi ， wo qian ji tian yong du yao mie diao le 。 ni ke yi qin zi kan kan ni shi fou you neng li zuo dao zhe yi dian ， dan wo dui ci biao shi huai yi 。]

english: I hate mosquitos!
translation: 我讨厌蚊子！ [wo tao yan wen zi ！]

english: Doesn't everyone?
translation: 不是每个人都这样吗？ [bu shi mei ge ren dou zhe yang ma ？]

english: Apparently you aren't as stupid as you look.
translation: 看来你并不像看上去那么愚蠢。 [kan lai ni bing bu xiang kan shang qu na me yu chun 。]

english: Who do you think was responsible?
translation: 你认为谁该负责？ [ni ren wei shui gai fu ze ？]

english: Where were you when the murder happened?
translation: 谋杀案发生时你在哪里？ [mou sha an fa sheng shi ni zai na li ？]

english: Do you recognise this thread?
translation: 你认识这个线程吗？ [ni ren shi zhe ge xian cheng ma ？]

english: Why'd you buy poison the other day?
translation: 那天你为什么要买毒药？ [na tian ni wei shen me yao mai du yao ？]

english: I can't believe we've finally arrived, I can't wait to explore!
translation: 我不敢相信我们终于到达了，我迫不及待地想探索！ [wo bu gan xiang xin wo men zhong yu dao da le ， wo po bu ji dai di xiang tan suo ！]

english: So much to see, I don't know where to start!
translation: 太多东西要看，我不知道从哪里开始！ [tai duo dong xi yao kan ， wo bu zhi dao cong na li kai shi ！]

english: A whole new continent to explore... what a time to be alive!
translation: 一个全新的大陆等待探索……多么美好的时光啊！ [yi ge quan xin de da lu deng dai tan suo …… duo me mei hao de shi guang a ！]

english: Are you the tour guide?
translation: 你是导游吗？ [ni shi dao you ma ？]

english: Nope, I'm just as lost as you.
translation: 不，我和你一样迷失。 [bu ， wo he ni yi yang mi shi 。]

english: I overheard someone mention there are pirates and thieves here, be careful!
translation: 我无意中听到有人说这里有海盗和小偷，要小心！ [wo wu yi zhong ting dao you ren shuo zhe li you hai dao he xiao tou ， yao xiao xin ！]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Hello, welcome to our maze. I'm Elkoy the tree gnome.
translation: 你好，欢迎来到我们的迷宫。我是树侏儒埃尔科伊。 [ni hao ， huan ying lai dao wo men de mi gong 。 wo shi shu zhu ru ai er ke yi 。]

english: I haven't heard of your sort
translation: 我没听说过你这种人 [wo mei ting shuo guo ni zhe zhong ren]

english: There's not many of us left. Once you could find tree gnomes anywhere in the world, now we hide in small groups to avoid capture.
translation: 我们剩下的人不多了。曾经你可以在世界任何地方找到树侏儒，现在我们会成群结队地躲起来以避免被捕。 [wo men sheng xia de ren bu duo le 。 ceng jing ni ke yi zai shi jie ren he di fang zhao dao shu zhu ru ， xian zai wo men hui cheng qun jie dui di duo qi lai yi bi mian bei bu 。]

english: Capture by whom?
translation: 被谁抓获？ [bei shui zhua huo ？]

english: Tree gnomes have been hunted for so called 'fun' since as long as I can remember.
translation: 从我记事起，树侏儒就一直因为所谓的“乐趣”而被猎杀。 [cong wo ji shi qi ， shu zhu ru jiu yi zhi yin wei suo wei de “ le qu ” er bei lie sha 。]

english: Our main threat nowadays are General Khazard's troops. They know no mercy, but are also very dense. They'll never find their way through our maze.
translation: 现在我们的主要威胁是卡扎德将军的军队。他们不懂得怜悯，但也非常密集。他们永远找不到穿过我们迷宫的路。 [xian zai wo men de zhu yao wei xie shi ka zha de jiang jun de jun dui 。 ta men bu dong de lian min ， dan ye fei chang mi ji 。 ta men yong yuan zhao bu dao chuan guo wo men mi gong de lu 。]

english: Have fun.
translation: 玩得开心。 [wan de kai xin 。]

english: I would be glad to help.
translation: 我很乐意提供帮助。 [wo hen le yi ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: Thank you. The battlefield is to the north of the maze. Commander Montai will inform you of their current situation.
translation: 谢谢。战场在迷宫的北边。蒙泰指挥官将向您通报他们目前的情况。 [xie xie 。 zhan chang zai mi gong de bei bian 。 meng tai zhi hui guan jiang xiang nin tong bao ta men mu qian de qing kuang 。]

english: That is if he's still alive.
translation: 那就是如果他还活着的话。 [na jiu shi ru guo ta hai huo zhe de hua 。]

english: My assistant shall guide you out. Good luck friend, try your best to return the orb.
translation: 我的助理会带你出去的。祝你好运，朋友，尽力归还宝珠。 [wo de zhu li hui dai ni chu qu de 。 zhu ni hao yun ， peng you ， jin li gui huan bao zhu 。]

english: The player is placed at the entrance of the maze.
translation: 玩家被放置在迷宫的入口处。 [wan jia bei fang zhi zai mi gong de ru kou chu 。]

english: We're out of the maze now. Please hurry, we must have the orb if we are to survive.
translation: 现在我们已经走出迷宫了。请快点，如果我们要生存，就必须拥有球体。 [xian zai wo men yi jing zou chu mi gong le 。 qing kuai dian ， ru guo wo men yao sheng cun ， jiu bi xu yong you qiu ti 。]

english: Hello Elkoy.
translation: 你好，埃尔科伊。 [ni hao ， ai er ke yi 。]

english: Oh my! Oh my!
translation: 天啊！天啊！ [tian a ！ tian a ！]

english: What's wrong?
translation: 怎么了？ [zen me le ？]

english: The orb, they have the orb. We're doomed. Do you need me to show you through the maze?
translation: 球体，他们有球体。我们注定了。需要我带你穿过迷宫吗？ [qiu ti ， ta men you qiu ti 。 wo men zhu ding le 。 xu yao wo dai ni chuan guo mi gong ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Please help us get our orb back.
translation: 请帮助我们拿回我们的球体。 [qing bang zhu wo men na hui wo men de qiu ti 。]

english: Not now, thanks.
translation: 现在不行，谢谢。 [xian zai bu xing ， xie xie 。]

english: The orb, they have the orb. We're doomed. Do you need me to show you back to the village?
translation: 球体，他们有球体。我们注定了。需要我送你回村子吗？ [qiu ti ， ta men you qiu ti 。 wo men zhu ding le 。 xu yao wo song ni hui cun zi ma ？]

english: The player is placed at the loose railing, the entrance to the Tree Gnome Village.
translation: 玩家被放置在松散的栏杆处，即树侏儒村的入口处。 [wan jia bei fang zhi zai song san de lan gan chu ， ji shu zhu ru cun de ru kou chu 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: You must retrieve the orb, or the gnome village is doomed. Do you need me to show you through the maze?
translation: 你必须取回球体，否则侏儒村庄就注定失败。需要我带你穿过迷宫吗？ [ni bi xu qu hui qiu ti ， fou ze zhu ru cun zhuang jiu zhu ding shi bai 。 xu yao wo dai ni chuan guo mi gong ma ？]

english: You're back! And the orb?
translation: 你回来了！那球体呢？ [ni hui lai le ！ na qiu ti ne ？]

english: No, I'm afraid not.
translation: 不，恐怕不是。 [bu ， kong pa bu shi 。]

english: Please, we must have the orb if we are to survive. Do you need me to show you through the maze?
translation: 拜托，如果我们要生存，就必须拥有球体。需要我带你穿过迷宫吗？ [bai tuo ， ru guo wo men yao sheng cun ， jiu bi xu yong you qiu ti 。 xu yao wo dai ni chuan guo mi gong ma ？]

english: Hello Elkoy. I have the orb.
translation: 你好，埃尔科伊。我有宝珠。 [ni hao ， ai er ke yi 。 wo you bao zhu 。]

english: Take it to King Bolren, I'm sure he'll be pleased to see you.
translation: 把它交给博伦国王，我相信他会很高兴见到你。 [ba ta jiao gei bo lun guo wang ， wo xiang xin ta hui hen gao xing jian dao ni 。]

english: Can you show me out of the village?
translation: 你能带我出村子吗？ [ni neng dai wo chu cun zi ma ？]

english: Please return with our orb soon.
translation: 请尽快带着我们的球回来。 [qing jin kuai dai zhe wo men de qiu hui lai 。]

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。 [hao de 。]

english: I have it here.
translation: 我这里有。 [wo zhe li you 。]

english: You're our saviour. Please return it to the village and we are all saved. Would you like me to show you the way to the village?
translation: 你是我们的救世主。请把它还给村子，我们都得救了。您需要我带您去村子吗？ [ni shi wo men de jiu shi zhu 。 qing ba ta huan gei cun zi ， wo men dou de jiu le 。 nin xu yao wo dai nin qu cun zi ma ？]

english: Here we are. Take the orb to King Bolren, I'm sure he'll be pleased to see you.
translation: 我们到了。把球交给博伦国王，我相信他会很高兴见到你。 [wo men dao le 。 ba qiu jiao gei bo lun guo wang ， wo xiang xin ta hui hen gao xing jian dao ni 。]

english: No thanks Elkoy.
translation: 不，谢谢埃尔科伊。 [bu ， xie xie ai er ke yi 。]

english: Please, we must have the orb if we are to survive.
translation: 拜托，如果我们要生存，就必须拥有球体。 [bai tuo ， ru guo wo men yao sheng cun ， jiu bi xu yong you qiu ti 。]

english: I will find the warlord and bring back the orbs.
translation: 我会找到军阀并带回宝珠。 [wo hui zhao dao jun fa bing dai hui bao zhu 。]

english: You are brave, but this task will be tough even for you. I wish you the best of luck. Once again you are our only hope.
translation: 你很勇敢，但这项任务对你来说也很艰巨。祝你好运。你再次成为我们唯一的希望。 [ni hen yong gan ， dan zhe xiang ren wu dui ni lai shuo ye hen jian ju 。 zhu ni hao yun 。 ni zai ci cheng wei wo men wei yi de xi wang 。]

english: I will safeguard this orb and pray for your safe return. My assistant will guide you out.
translation: 我会守护这颗宝珠，祈祷你平安归来。我的助理会带你出去。 [wo hui shou hu zhe ke bao zhu ， qi dao ni ping an gui lai 。 wo de zhu li hui dai ni chu qu 。]

english: Good luck friend.
translation: 祝你好运朋友。 [zhu ni hao yun peng you 。]

english: Did you hear?
translation: 你听到了吗？ [ni ting dao le ma ？]

english: Khazard's men have pillaged the village! They slaughtered many, and took the other orbs in an attempt to lead us out of the maze. When will the misery end?
translation: 卡扎德的手下洗劫了村庄！他们屠杀了许多人，并夺走了其他球体，试图带领我们走出迷宫。苦难何时才能结束？ [ka zha de de shou xia xi jie le cun zhuang ！ ta men tu sha le xu duo ren ， bing duo zou le qi ta qiu ti ， shi tu dai ling wo men zou chu mi gong 。 ku nan he shi cai neng jie shu ？]

english: Please help us find the orbs.
translation: 请帮助我们找到球体。 [qing bang zhu wo men zhao dao qiu ti 。]

english: I'm very sorry.
translation: 我很抱歉。 [wo hen bao qian 。]

english: Would you like me to show you the way to the village?
translation: 您需要我带您去村子吗？ [nin xu yao wo dai nin qu cun zi ma ？]

english: Here we are. Despite what has happened here, I hope you feel welcome.
translation: 我们到了。尽管这里发生了一些事情，我还是希望您感到宾至如归。 [wo men dao le 。 jin guan zhe li fa sheng le yi xie shi qing ， wo hai shi xi wang nin gan dao bin zhi ru gui 。]

english: Ok then, take care.
translation: 好吧，那就保重吧。 [hao ba ， na jiu bao zhong ba 。]

english: You truly are a hero.
translation: 你确实是一个英雄。 [ni que shi shi yi ge ying xiong 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: You saved us by returning the orbs of protection. I'm humbled and wish you well. Would you like me to show you through the maze?
translation: 你通过归还保护球拯救了我们。我很谦卑并祝你一切顺利。你想让我带你穿过迷宫吗？ [ni tong guo gui huan bao hu qiu zheng jiu le wo men 。 wo hen qian bei bing zhu ni yi qie shun li 。 ni xiang rang wo dai ni chuan guo mi gong ma ？]

english: Here we are. Have a safe journey.
translation: 我们到了。祝您旅途平安。 [wo men dao le 。 zhu nin lv tu ping an 。]

english: You saved us by returning the orbs of protection. I'm humbled and wish you well.
translation: 你通过归还保护球拯救了我们。我很谦卑并祝你一切顺利。 [ni tong guo gui huan bao hu qiu zheng jiu le wo men 。 wo hen qian bei bing zhu ni yi qie shun li 。]

english: Here we are. Feel free to have a look around.
translation: 我们到了。请随意四处看看。 [wo men dao le 。 qing sui yi si chu kan kan 。]

english: Hello, welcome to our village. I'm Elkoy the tree gnome.
translation: 您好，欢迎来到我们村。我是树侏儒埃尔科伊。 [nin hao ， huan ying lai dao wo men cun 。 wo shi shu zhu ru ai er ke yi 。]

english: Hi there, I hope life is treating you well. Would you like me to show you the way to the village?
translation: 你好，希望生活能善待你。您需要我带您去村子吗？ [ni hao ， xi wang sheng huo neng shan dai ni 。 nin xu yao wo dai nin qu cun zi ma ？]

english: Hi there, I hope life is treating you well. Would you like me to show you the way out of the village?
translation: 你好，希望生活能善待你。要我带你走出村子的路吗？ [ni hao ， xi wang sheng huo neng shan dai ni 。 yao wo dai ni zou chu cun zi de lu ma ？]

english: I would be glad to help.
translation: 我很乐意提供帮助。 [wo hen le yi ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Not now, thanks.
translation: 现在不行，谢谢。 [xian zai bu xing ， xie xie 。]

english: Can you show me out of the village?
translation: 你能带我出村子吗？ [ni neng dai wo chu cun zi ma ？]

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。 [hao de 。]

english: No thanks Elkoy.
translation: 不，谢谢埃尔科伊。 [bu ， xie xie ai er ke yi 。]

english: I'm very sorry.
translation: 我很抱歉。 [wo hen bao qian 。]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 你知道，打招呼的方式有很多种。你好，你好，你好…… [ni zhi dao ， da zhao hu de fang shi you hen duo zhong 。 ni hao ， ni hao ， ni hao ……]

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 那还是只能算一个！ [na hai shi zhi neng suan yi ge ！]

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。你今天怎么样？ [ni hao 。 ni jin tian zen me yang ？]

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很棒，谢谢你！ [wo hen bang ， xie xie ni ！]

english: Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 你好！水晶城里今天过得怎么样啊？ [ni hao ！ shui jing cheng li jin tian guo de zen me yang a ？]

english: Indeed.
translation: 的确。 [di que 。]

english: What can I do for ya?
translation: 我能为你做什么？ [wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 各种各样的事情！这些塔楼是一个美妙的景观。 [ge zhong ge yang de shi qing ！ zhe xie ta lou shi yi ge mei miao de jing guan 。]

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 在像今天这样的日子，我建议您参观市场。 [zai xiang jin tian zhe yang de ri zi ， wo jian yi nin can guan shi chang 。]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你认为你在做什么？ [ni ren wei ni zai zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: Hello. Interested in honing your skills?
translation: 你好。有兴趣磨练你的技能吗？ [ni hao 。 you xing qu mo lian ni de ji neng ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Ellen helps you improve your (selected skill) skill.
translation: 艾伦帮助您提高（所选技能）技能。 [ai lun bang zhu nin ti gao （ suo xuan ji neng ） ji neng 。]

english: That's all the training I can give you. I hope you find it useful.
translation: 这就是我能给你的所有培训。我希望你觉得它有用。 [zhe jiu shi wo neng gei ni de suo you pei xun 。 wo xi wang ni jue de ta you yong 。]

english: (Combat Training interface re-opens.)
translation: （战斗训练界面重新打开。） [（ zhan dou xun lian jie mian chong xin da kai 。）]

english: I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 如果你改变主意我会在这里。 [ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi wo hui zai zhe li 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello again. I'm afraid I've given you all the training I can.
translation: 又好。恐怕我已经为你提供了我所能提供的所有培训。 [you hao 。 kong pa wo yi jing wei ni ti gong le wo suo neng ti gong de suo you pei xun 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
translation: 你愿意帮我照料我的庄稼吗？ [ni yuan yi bang wo zhao liao wo de zhuang jia ma ？]

english: You don't have a sapling planted in that patch. Plant one and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: 你那块地里没有种树苗。种一棵，我可能会同意帮你照顾它。 [ni na kuai di li mei you zhong shu miao 。 zhong yi ke ， wo ke neng hui tong yi bang ni zhao gu ta 。]

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 你能给我一些农业建议吗？ [ni neng gei wo yi xie nong ye jian yi ma ？]

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: 您最多可以将五个西红柿、草莓、苹果、香蕉或橙子放入一个水果篮中，但不能将它们混合放在同一个篮子中。 [nin zui duo ke yi jiang wu ge xi hong shi 、 cao mei 、 ping guo 、 xiang jiao huo cheng zi fang ru yi ge shui guo lan zhong ， dan bu neng jiang ta men hun he fang zai tong yi ge lan zi zhong 。]

english: There are seven main Farming areas - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Kragen's area near Ardougne, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius, Alan's area in the Farming Guild and
translation: 有七个主要的农业区域 - 法拉多附近的埃尔斯坦区域、凯瑟比附近的丹塔拉区域、阿杜涅附近的克拉根区域、莫里塔尼亚的莱拉区域、霍西迪乌斯的马里西区域、农业公会的艾伦区域和 [you qi ge zhu yao de nong ye qu yu  -  fa la duo fu jin de ai er si tan qu yu 、 kai se bi fu jin de dan ta la qu yu 、 a du nie fu jin de ke la gen qu yu 、 mo li ta ni ya de lai la qu yu 、 huo xi di wu si de ma li xi qu yu 、 nong ye gong hui de ai lun qu yu he]

english: Oswallt's area in Prifddinas.
translation: 普里夫迪纳斯的奥斯瓦尔特地区。 [pu li fu di na si de ao si wa er te di qu 。]

english: Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
translation: 超级堆肥比普通堆肥好得多，但制造成本更高。你需要腐烂正确类型的物品；给我看一个物品，我会告诉你它是否超级可堆肥。 [chao ji dui fei bi pu tong dui fei hao de duo ， dan zhi zao cheng ben geng gao 。 ni xu yao fu lan zheng que lei xing de wu pin ； gei wo kan yi ge wu pin ， wo hui gao su ni ta shi fou chao ji ke dui fei 。]

english: Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
translation: 蔬菜、啤酒花和花卉需要不断浇水——如果你忽视我的建议，你迟早会发现自己拥有一片枯死的农田。 [shu cai 、 pi jiu hua he hua hui xu yao bu duan jiao shui —— ru guo ni hu shi wo de jian yi ， ni chi zao hui fa xian zi ji yong you yi pian ku si de nong tian 。]

english: There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
translation: 有一块专门种植颠茄的土地——我相信它就在德雷诺庄园附近的某个地方，那里的土地有点“不被祝福”。 [you yi kuai zhuan men zhong zhi dian jia de tu di —— wo xiang xin ta jiu zai de lei nuo zhuang yuan fu jin de mou ge di fang ， na li de tu di you dian “ bu bei zhu fu ”。]

english: Hops are good for brewing ales. I believe there's a brewery up in Keldagrim somewhere, and I've heard rumours that a place called Phasmatys used to be good for that type of thing. 'Fore they all died, of course.
translation: 啤酒花适合酿造啤酒。我相信凯尔达格里姆的某个地方有一家啤酒厂，而且我听说过一个叫做 Phasmatys 的地方曾经适合做这种事情。 “当然，他们都死了。 [pi jiu hua shi he niang zao pi jiu 。 wo xiang xin kai er da ge li mu de mou ge di fang you yi jia pi jiu chang ， er qie wo ting shuo guo yi ge jiao zuo  Phasmatys  de di fang ceng jing shi he zuo zhe zhong shi qing 。 “ dang ran ， ta men dou si le 。]

english: Bittercap mushrooms can only be grown in a special patch in Morytania, near the Mort Myre swamp. There the ground is especially dank and suited to growing poisonous fungii.
translation: 苦蘑菇只能生长在莫里塔尼亚莫特迈尔沼泽附近的一块特殊土地上。那里的地面特别潮湿，适合有毒真菌的生长。 [ku mo gu zhi neng sheng zhang zai mo li ta ni ya mo te mai er zhao ze fu jin de yi kuai te shu tu di shang 。 na li de di mian te bie chao shi ， shi he you du zhen jun de sheng zhang 。]

english: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
translation: 您可以从农田商店购买所有农具，农田商店位于耕地附近。 [nin ke yi cong nong tian shang dian gou mai suo you nong ju ， nong tian shang dian wei yu geng di fu jin 。]

english: Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
translation: 树木种子必须在土壤花盆中长成树苗，然后转移到树丛中继续生长直至成年。 [shu mu zhong zi bi xu zai tu rang hua pen zhong chang cheng shu miao ， ran hou zhuan yi dao shu cong zhong ji xu sheng zhang zhi zhi cheng nian 。]

english: The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
translation: 治愈灌木或树木疾病的唯一方法是用剪刀剪掉患病的叶子。对于所有其他作物，我只会使用一些植物疗法。 [zhi yu guan mu huo shu mu ji bing de wei yi fang fa shi yong jian dao jian diao huan bing de ye zi 。 dui yu suo you qi ta zuo wu ， wo zhi hui shi yong yi xie zhi wu liao fa 。]

english: You can fill plantpots with soil from any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.
translation: 如果你有园艺抹子，你可以用任何空地的土壤填满花盆。 [ru guo ni you yuan yi mo zi ， ni ke yi yong ren he kong di de tu rang tian man hua pen 。]

english: If you need to be rid of your fruit trees for any reason, all you have to do is chop them down and then dig up the stump.
translation: 如果您因任何原因需要清除果树，您只需将它们砍倒，然后挖出树桩即可。 [ru guo nin yin ren he yuan yin xu yao qing chu guo shu ， nin zhi xu jiang ta men kan dao ， ran hou wa chu shu zhuang ji ke 。]

english: Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
translation: 耙完一块杂草后，不要只是扔掉杂草 - 将它们放入堆肥箱中并制作一些堆肥。 [ba wan yi kuai za cao hou ， bu yao zhi shi reng diao za cao  -  jiang ta men fang ru dui fei xiang zhong bing zhi zuo yi xie dui fei 。]

english: Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
translation: 在一块土地上施用堆肥不仅可以减少农作物患病的机会，而且还可以种植更多的农作物来收获。 [zai yi kuai tu di shang shi yong dui fei bu jin ke yi jian shao nong zuo wu huan bing de ji hui ， er qie hai ke yi zhong zhi geng duo de nong zuo wu lai shou huo 。]

english: If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're a good enough craftsman, that is.
translation: 如果您想自己制作麻袋和篮子，则需要使用法拉多农业商店附近的织布机。如果你是一个足够好的工匠，那就是。 [ru guo nin xiang zi ji zhi zuo ma dai he lan zi ， ze xu yao shi yong fa la duo nong ye shang dian fu jin de zhi bu ji 。 ru guo ni shi yi ge zu gou hao de gong jiang ， na jiu shi 。]

english: You don't have to buy all your plantpots you know, you can make them yourself on a pottery wheel. If you're a good enough craftsman, that is.
translation: 您不必购买所有您知道的花盆，您可以自己在陶轮上制作它们。如果你是一个足够好的工匠，那就是。 [nin bu bi gou mai suo you nin zhi dao de hua pen ， nin ke yi zi ji zai tao lun shang zhi zuo ta men 。 ru guo ni shi yi ge zu gou hao de gong jiang ， na jiu shi 。]

english: You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
translation: 您最多可以在蔬菜袋中放入十个土豆、卷心菜或洋葱，但不能将它们混合放在同一个袋子中。 [nin zui duo ke yi zai shu cai dai zhong fang ru shi ge tu dou 、 juan xin cai huo yang cong ， dan bu neng jiang ta men hun he fang zai tong yi ge dai zi zhong 。]

english: Can you sell me something?
translation: 你能卖给我东西吗？ [ni neng mai gei wo dong xi ma ？]

english: That depends on whether I have it to sell. What is it that you're looking for?
translation: 这取决于我是否有它可以卖。您在寻找什么？ [zhe qu jue yu wo shi fou you ta ke yi mai 。 nin zai xun zhao shen me ？]

english: I'll come back another time.
translation: 我下次再来。 [wo xia ci zai lai 。]

english: You're not done yet! Do this for me!
translation: 你还没有完成！为我做这个！ [ni hai mei you wan cheng ！ wei wo zuo zhe ge ！]

english: My produce can do puzzles better than that!
translation: 我的产品可以比那做得更好！ [wo de chan pin ke yi bi na zuo de geng hao ！]

english: Excellent work!
translation: 佳作！ [jia zuo ！]

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
translation: 你愿意帮我照料我的庄稼吗？ [ni yuan yi bang wo zhao liao wo de zhuang jia ma ？]

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 你能给我一些农业建议吗？ [ni neng gei wo yi xie nong ye jian yi ma ？]

english: Can you sell me something?
translation: 你能卖给我东西吗？ [ni neng mai gei wo dong xi ma ？]

english: I'll come back another time.
translation: 我下次再来。 [wo xia ci zai lai 。]

english: Hey, how can I help you?
translation: 嘿，我能帮你什么忙？ [hei ， wo neng bang ni shen me mang ？]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: This is one of the branches for Mahogany Homes, Gielinor's first construction company.
translation: 这是 Gielinor 的第一家建筑公司 Mahogany Homes 的分支机构之一。 [zhe shi  Gielinor  de di yi jia jian zhu gong si  Mahogany Homes  de fen zhi ji gou zhi yi 。]

english: Oh wow, how can I get involved?
translation: 哦，哇，我怎样才能参与其中？ [o ， wa ， wo zen yang cai neng can yu qi zhong ？]

english: If you go see Amy in the Falador branch, she'll fill you in. Her office is just east of the Estate Agent in Falador.
translation: 如果你去法拉多分行找艾米，她会告诉你信息。她的办公室就在法拉多房地产经纪人的东边。 [ru guo ni qu fa la duo fen hang zhao ai mi ， ta hui gao su ni xin xi 。 ta de ban gong shi jiu zai fa la duo fang di chan jing ji ren de dong bian 。]

english: Nice, thank you.
translation: 很好，谢谢。 [hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Greetings friend. I am a manufacturer of leather.
translation: 问候朋友。我是一家皮革制造商。 [wen hou peng you 。 wo shi yi jia pi ge zhi zao shang 。]

english: Can I buy some leather then?
translation: 那我可以买一些皮革吗？ [na wo ke yi mai yi xie pi ge ma ？]

english: I make leather from animal hides. Bring me some cowhides and one gold coin per hide, and I'll tan them into soft leather for you.
translation: 我用动物皮制作皮革。给我一些牛皮，每张牛皮一枚金币，我会把它们晒成柔软的皮革给你。 [wo yong dong wu pi zhi zuo pi ge 。 gei wo yi xie niu pi ， mei zhang niu pi yi mei jin bi ， wo hui ba ta men shai cheng rou ruan de pi ge gei ni 。]

english: Leather is rather weak stuff.
translation: 皮革是相当脆弱的东西。 [pi ge shi xiang dang cui ruo de dong xi 。]

english: Normal leather may be quite weak, but it's very cheap - I make it from cowhides for only 1 gp per hide - and it's so easy to craft that anyone can work with it.
translation: 普通皮革可能很脆弱，但它非常便宜 - 我用牛皮制作它，每张皮革只需 1 金币 - 而且制作起来非常容易，任何人都可以使用它。 [pu tong pi ge ke neng hen cui ruo ， dan ta fei chang pian yi  -  wo yong niu pi zhi zuo ta ， mei zhang pi ge zhi xu  1  jin bi  -  er qie zhi zuo qi lai fei chang rong yi ， ren he ren dou ke yi shi yong ta 。]

english: Alternatively you could try hard leather. It's not so easy to craft, but I only charge 3 gp per cowhide to prepare it, and it makes much sturdier armour.
translation: 或者，您可以尝试硬质皮革。制作它并不容易，但我只需要每张牛皮 3 gp 来准备它，而且它可以制造更坚固的盔甲。 [huo zhe ， nin ke yi chang shi ying zhi pi ge 。 zhi zuo ta bing bu rong yi ， dan wo zhi xu yao mei zhang niu pi  3 gp  lai zhun bei ta ， er qie ta ke yi zhi zao geng jian gu de kui jia 。]

english: I can also tan snake hides and dragonhides, suitable for crafting into the highest quality armour for rangers.
translation: 我还可以鞣制蛇皮和龙皮，适合为游侠制作最高品质的盔甲。 [wo hai ke yi rou zhi she pi he long pi ， shi he wei you xia zhi zuo zui gao pin zhi di kui jia 。]

english: Thanks, I'll bear it in mind.
translation: 谢谢，我会记住的。 [xie xie ， wo hui ji zhu de 。]

english: I see you have brought me a hide. Would you like me to tan it for you?
translation: 我看到你给我带来了一块隐藏的东西。要我帮你晒黑吗？ [wo kan dao ni gei wo dai lai le yi kuai yin cang de dong xi 。 yao wo bang ni shai hei ma ？]

english: I see you have brought me some hides. Would you like me to tan them for you?
translation: 我看到你给我带来了一些兽皮。您需要我帮您晒黑吗？ [wo kan dao ni gei wo dai lai le yi xie shou pi 。 nin xu yao wo bang nin shai hei ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Very well, [sir/madam], as you wish.
translation: 很好，[先生/女士]，如您所愿。 [hen hao ，[ xian sheng / nv shi ]， ru nin suo yuan 。]

english: Er... Thanks, but no thanks!
translation: 呃...谢谢，但不用了，谢谢！ [e ... xie xie ， dan bu yong le ， xie xie ！]

english: Can I buy some leather then?
translation: 那我可以买一些皮革吗？ [na wo ke yi mai yi xie pi ge ma ？]

english: Leather is rather weak stuff.
translation: 皮革是相当脆弱的东西。 [pi ge shi xiang dang cui ruo de dong xi 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: I'm sorry to bother you, but could you spare me a little dung?
translation: 很抱歉打扰你，但是你能给我一点粪便吗？ [hen bao qian da rao ni ， dan shi ni neng gei wo yi dian fen bian ma ？]

english: The camel didn't seem to appreciate that question.
translation: 骆驼似乎不喜欢这个问题。 [luo tuo si hu bu xi huan zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: If I go near that camel, it'll probably bite my hand off.
translation: 如果我靠近那头骆驼，它可能会咬掉我的手。 [ru guo wo kao jin na tou luo tuo ， ta ke neng hui yao diao wo de shou 。]

english: Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab.
translation: 嗯……看起来那只骆驼可以做一顿美味的烤肉串。 [n …… kan qi lai na zhi luo tuo ke yi zuo yi dun mei wei de kao rou chuan 。]

english: I wonder if that camel has fleas...
translation: 我想知道那只骆驼有没有跳蚤... [wo xiang zhi dao na zhi luo tuo you mei you tiao zao ...]

english: Are you serious?
translation: 你是认真的？ [ni shi ren zhen de ？]

english: Oh yes. If you'd be so kind...
translation: 哦是的。如果你能这么善良的话... [o shi de 。 ru guo ni neng zhe me shan liang de hua ...]

english: Well, just you close your eyes first. I'm not doing it while you're watching me!
translation: 好吧，你先闭上眼睛。当你看着我的时候我不会这么做！ [hao ba ， ni xian bi shang yan jing 。 dang ni kan zhe wo de shi hou wo bu hui zhe me zuo ！]

english: I hope that's what you wanted!
translation: 我希望这就是你想要的！ [wo xi wang zhe jiu shi ni xiang yao de ！]

english: Ohhh yes. Lovely.
translation: 噢，是的。迷人的。 [o ， shi de 。 mi ren de 。]

english: Did you say something?
translation: 你有说什么吗？ [ni you shuo shen me ma ？]

english: No, er, nothing important.
translation: 不，呃，没什么重要的。 [bu ， e ， mei shen me zhong yao de 。]

english: Well, it's nice to have someone to talk to.
translation: 嗯，有人可以说话真是太好了。 [n ， you ren ke yi shuo hua zhen shi tai hao le 。]

english: Ollie is so remote, and I can't get up the courage to talk to him...
translation: 奥利太遥远了，我没有勇气和他说话…… [ao li tai yao yuan le ， wo mei you yong qi he ta shuo hua ……]

english: Who's Ollie?
translation: 奥利是谁？ [ao li shi shui ？]

english: He's the camel wandering around near that glider.
translation: 他就是在那架滑翔机附近徘徊的骆驼。 [ta jiu shi zai na jia hua xiang ji fu jin pai huai de luo tuo 。]

english: Isn't he so strong-looking and handsome?
translation: 是不是长得这么壮，又这么帅？ [shi bu shi zhang de zhe me zhuang ， you zhe me shuai ？]

english: Er... he just looks like any other camel to me.
translation: 呃……对我来说，他看起来就像其他骆驼一样。 [e …… dui wo lai shuo ， ta kan qi lai jiu xiang qi ta luo tuo yi yang 。]

english: How can you not see how wonderful he is?
translation: 你怎么看不出他有多优秀呢？ [ni zen me kan bu chu ta you duo you xiu ne ？]

english: Why, he can cross the Kharidian Desert in three bounds, and he's so strong that he could haul the brick for the Emir's Arena in only a day!
translation: 哎呀，他能三步穿越卡里迪安沙漠，而且他的力气如此之大，一天之内就能把砖块搬到埃米尔竞技场！ [ai ya ， ta neng san bu chuan yue ka li di an sha mo ， er qie ta de li qi ru ci zhi da ， yi tian zhi nei jiu neng ba zhuan kuai ban dao ai mi er jing ji chang ！]

english: You're a camel, I'm not. Maybe you can see these things better.
translation: 你是骆驼，我不是。也许你能更好地看到这些事情。 [ni shi luo tuo ， wo bu shi 。 ye xu ni neng geng hao di kan dao zhe xie shi qing 。]

english: For someone who understands camel speech, you're not good at these things.
translation: 对于懂得骆驼语言的人来说，你不擅长这些事情。 [dui yu dong de luo tuo yu yan de ren lai shuo ， ni bu shan chang zhe xie shi qing 。]

english: Ask the camel about its dung.
translation: 向骆驼询问它的粪便。 [xiang luo tuo xun wen ta de fen bian 。]

english: Say something unpleasant.
translation: 说一些不愉快的话。 [shuo yi xie bu yu kuai de hua 。]

english: Neither - I'm a polite person.
translation: 都不是——我是一个有礼貌的人。 [dou bu shi —— wo shi yi ge you li mao de ren 。]

english: Can I help you today?
translation: 今天我可以帮你吗？ [jin tian wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: Can I go for a ride?
translation: 我可以去兜风吗？ [wo ke yi qu dou feng ma ？]

english: Minecart rides are 20 coins.
translation: 乘坐矿车需要 20 个金币。 [cheng zuo kuang che xu yao  20  ge jin bi 。]

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this.
translation: 作为 Lovakengj 矿车网络的忠实客户，您有权享受这一点。 [zuo wei  Lovakengj  kuang che wang luo de zhong shi ke hu ， nin you quan xiang shou zhe yi dian 。]

english: Now, can I help you today?
translation: 现在，今天我可以帮你吗？ [xian zai ， jin tian wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: You're already here, human.
translation: 你已经在这里了，人类。 [ni yi jing zai zhe li le ， ren lei 。]

english: Can I go for a ride?
translation: 我可以去兜风吗？ [wo ke yi qu dou feng ma ？]

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: What's a gnome doing here?
translation: 侏儒在这里做什么？ [zhu ru zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm an investigator. I'm watching the implings.
translation: 我是一名调查员。我正在观察其中的暗示。 [wo shi yi ming diao cha yuan 。 wo zheng zai guan cha qi zhong de an shi 。]

english: Why would you want to do that?
translation: 你为什么要这么做？ [ni wei shen me yao zhe me zuo ？]

english: My client has asked me to find out where certain missing items have been going.
translation: 我的客户要求我找出某些丢失物品的去向。 [wo de ke hu yao qiu wo zhao chu mou xie diu shi wu pin de qu xiang 。]

english: Who is this client?
translation: 这位客户是谁？ [zhe wei ke hu shi shui ？]

english: I'm not at liberty to discuss that. Investigator-client confidentiality don't you know.
translation: 我无权讨论这个问题。调查员与当事人的保密你不知道吗？ [wo wu quan tao lun zhe ge wen ti 。 diao cha yuan yu dang shi ren de bao mi ni bu zhi dao ma ？]

english: Where is this place?
translation: 这是哪里？ [zhe shi na li ？]

english: The fairies call it Puro-Puro. It seems to be the home plane of the implings.
translation: 仙女们称之为Puro-Puro。它似乎是暗示的家乡位面。 [xian nv men cheng zhi wei Puro-Puro。 ta si hu shi an shi de jia xiang wei mian 。]

english: I don't think these creatures have a name for it. As you can see there isn't a lot else here other than wheat.
translation: 我认为这些生物没有名字。正如你所看到的，这里除了小麦之外没有太多其他东西。 [wo ren wei zhe xie sheng wu mei you ming zi 。 zheng ru ni suo kan dao de ， zhe li chu le xiao mai zhi wai mei you tai duo qi ta dong xi 。]

english: How did you get here?
translation: 你怎么到这里来的？ [ni zen me dao zhe li lai de ？]

english: The same way you did, I suspect. Through a portal in a wheat field. I followed one back.
translation: 我怀疑，和你做的一样。通过麦田中的传送门。我跟着一个人回来了。 [wo huai yi ， he ni zuo de yi yang 。 tong guo mai tian zhong de chuan song men 。 wo gen zhe yi ge ren hui lai le 。]

english: I haven't noticed them do that.
translation: 我没注意到他们这样做。 [wo mei zhu yi dao ta men zhe yang zuo 。]

english: That's why I'm the investigator and you're the adventurer.
translation: 这就是为什么我是调查员而你是冒险家。 [zhe jiu shi wei shen me wo shi diao cha yuan er ni shi mao xian jia 。]

english: So, what are these implings?
translation: 那么，这些寓意是什么？ [na me ， zhe xie yu yi shi shen me ？]

english: That's a very interesting question. My best guess is that they are relatives to imps, which is why there are imps here as well.
translation: 这是一个非常有趣的问题。我最好的猜测是他们是小鬼的亲戚，这就是为什么这里也有小鬼的原因。 [zhe shi yi ge fei chang you qu de wen ti 。 wo zui hao de cai ce shi ta men shi xiao gui de qin qi ， zhe jiu shi wei shen me zhe li ye you xiao gui de yuan yin 。]

english: Implings do appear to like collecting objects and, as my clients have noted, have no concept of ownership. However, I do not sense any malicious intent.
translation: 暗示似乎确实喜欢收集物品，并且正如我的客户所指出的那样，没有所有权的概念。不过，我并没有感觉到任何恶意。 [an shi si hu que shi xi huan shou ji wu pin ， bing qie zheng ru wo de ke hu suo zhi chu de na yang ， mei you suo you quan de gai nian 。 bu guo ， wo bing mei you gan jue dao ren he e yi 。]

english: It is my observation that they collect things that other creatures want, rather than they want them themselves. It seems to provide them with sustenance.
translation: 据我观察，它们收集其他生物想要的东西，而不是它们自己想要的东西。这似乎为他们提供了食物。 [ju wo guan cha ， ta men shou ji qi ta sheng wu xiang yao de dong xi ， er bu shi ta men zi ji xiang yao de dong xi 。 zhe si hu wei ta men ti gong le shi wu 。]

english: So they feed off our desire for things?
translation: 那么它们满足了我们对事物的渴望吗？ [na me ta men man zu le wo men dui shi wu de ke wang ma ？]

english: Possibly. Either way, it seems that they almost exclusively collect things that people want, except their younglings who I infer haven't learnt the best things to collect yet.
translation: 可能吧。不管怎样，它们似乎只收集人们想要的东西，除了它们的幼崽，我推断它们还没有学会收集最好的东西。 [ke neng ba 。 bu guan zen yang ， ta men si hu zhi shou ji ren men xiang yao de dong xi ， chu le ta men de you zai ， wo tui duan ta men hai mei you xue hui shou ji zui hao de dong xi 。]

english: So the more experienced implings have the more desirable items?
translation: 那么经验越丰富的暗示拥有越令人向往的物品吗？ [na me jing yan yue feng fu de an shi yong you yue ling ren xiang wang de wu pin ma ？]

english: That is my observation. Yes.
translation: 这是我的观察。是的。 [zhe shi wo de guan cha 。 shi de 。]

english: Can I catch these implings, then?
translation: 那么我能捕捉到这些暗示吗？ [na me wo neng bu zhuo dao zhe xie an shi ma ？]

english: Indeed you may. In fact I encourage it. You will, however, require some equipment.
translation: 确实可以。事实上我鼓励这样做。但是，您将需要一些设备。 [que shi ke yi 。 shi shi shang wo gu li zhe yang zuo 。 dan shi ， nin jiang xu yao yi xie she bei 。]

english: Firstly you will need a butterfly net in which to catch them and at least one special impling jar to store an impling.
translation: 首先，您需要一个用来捕捉蝴蝶的网，以及至少一个用于存放蝴蝶结的特殊蝴蝶结罐。 [shou xian ， nin xu yao yi ge yong lai bu zhuo hu die de wang ， yi ji zhi shao yi ge yong yu cun fang hu die jie de te shu hu die jie guan 。]

english: You will also require some experience as a Hunter since these creatures are elusive. The more immature implings require less experience, but some of the rarer implings are extraordinarily hard to find and catch.
translation: 您还需要一些作为猎人的经验，因为这些生物难以捉摸。越不成熟的暗示需要的经验越少，但一些较罕见的暗示却极难发现和捕捉。 [nin hai xu yao yi xie zuo wei lie ren de jing yan ， yin wei zhe xie sheng wu nan yi zhuo mo 。 yue bu cheng shu de an shi xu yao de jing yan yue shao ， dan yi xie jiao han jian de an shi que ji nan fa xian he bu zhuo 。]

english: Once you have caught one, you may break the jar open and obtain the object the impling is carrying. Alternatively, you may exchange certain combinations of jars with me. I will return the jars to my clients. In
translation: 一旦你抓住了一个，你就可以打开罐子并获得暗示所携带的物品。或者，您可以与我交换某些罐子组合。我会将罐子退还给我的客户。在 [yi dan ni zhua zhu le yi ge ， ni jiu ke yi da kai guan zi bing huo de an shi suo xie dai de wu pin 。 huo zhe ， nin ke yi yu wo jiao huan mou xie guan zi zu he 。 wo hui jiang guan zi tui huan gei wo de ke hu 。 zai]

english: exchange I will be able to provide you with some equipment that may help you hunt butterflies more effectively.
translation: 交换我可以为你提供一些可以帮助你更有效地捕蝴蝶的装备。 [jiao huan wo ke yi wei ni ti gong yi xie ke yi bang zhu ni geng you xiao di bu hu die de zhuang bei 。]

english: Also, beware. Those imps walking around the maze do not like the fact that their kindred spirits are being captured and will attempt to steal any full jars you have on you, setting the implings free.
translation: 另外，要小心。那些在迷宫中行走的小恶魔不喜欢他们的同类灵魂被捕获，并且会试图偷走你身上所有装满的罐子，从而释放小恶魔。 [ling wai ， yao xiao xin 。 na xie zai mi gong zhong hang zou de xiao e mo bu xi huan ta men de tong lei ling hun bei bu huo ， bing qie hui shi tu tou zou ni shen shang suo you zhuang man de guan zi ， cong er shi fang xiao e mo 。]

english: I've heard I may find dragon equipment in Puro-Puro.
translation: 我听说我可以在普罗普罗找到龙装备。 [wo ting shuo wo ke yi zai pu luo pu luo zhao dao long zhuang bei 。]

english: Have you indeed? Well, that may well be true, though bear in mind that implings are quite small so they are unlikely to be lugging a sizeable shield around with them. However, since it seems that dragon items are
translation: 你确实有吗？好吧，这很可能是真的，但请记住，暗示非常小，所以它们不太可能随身携带一个相当大的盾牌。不过，既然龙物品似乎是 [ni que shi you ma ？ hao ba ， zhe hen ke neng shi zhen de ， dan qing ji zhu ， an shi fei chang xiao ， suo yi ta men bu tai ke neng sui shen xie dai yi ge xiang dang da de dun pai 。 bu guo ， ji ran long wu pin si hu shi]

english: very desirable to humans then it certainly is possible that the most expert implings may try to obtain such equipment.
translation: 如果人类非常渴望这样的设备，那么最专业的人当然有可能尝试获得这样的设备。 [ru guo ren lei fei chang ke wang zhe yang de she bei ， na me zui zhuan ye de ren dang ran you ke neng chang shi huo de zhe yang de she bei 。]

english: So, it's true then? Cool!
translation: 那么，这是真的吗？凉爽的！ [na me ， zhe shi zhen de ma ？ liang shuang de ！]

english: I should warn you, though, if the impling is strong enough to collect dragon equipment, then you will have to be very skilled at hunting implings in order to catch them.
translation: 不过，我应该警告你，如果暗示足够强大来收集龙装备，那么你必须非常熟练地狩猎暗示才能抓住它们。 [bu guo ， wo ying gai jing gao ni ， ru guo an shi zu gou qiang da lai shou ji long zhuang bei ， na me ni bi xu fei chang shu lian di shou lie an shi cai neng zhua zhu ta men 。]

english: Ah, good day, it's you again. What can I do for you?
translation: 啊，美好的一天，又是你。我能为你做什么？ [a ， mei hao de yi tian ， you shi ni 。 wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: Ah, I notice you don't own an impling collector's scroll.
translation: 啊，我注意到你没有暗示收藏卷轴。 [a ， wo zhu yi dao ni mei you an shi shou cang juan zhou 。]

english: Elnock gives you a scroll. If you check it whilst in the maze, you will see how many of each impling you have captured.
translation: 埃尔诺克给了你一个卷轴。如果你在迷宫中检查它，你会看到你捕获了多少个暗示。 [ai er nuo ke gei le ni yi ge juan zhou 。 ru guo ni zai mi gong zhong jian cha ta ， ni hui kan dao ni bu huo le duo shao ge an shi 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Can you remind me how to catch implings again?
translation: 你能提醒我如何再次捕捉暗示吗？ [ni neng ti xing wo ru he zai ci bu zhuo an shi ma ？]

english: Certainly.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: You cannot use an ordinary butterfly jar as a container as the implings will escape from them with ease. However, I have done some investigation and have come up with a solution - if a butterfly jar is coated
translation: 你不能用普通的蝴蝶罐作为容器，因为蝴蝶的寓意很容易就会从里面逃走。然而，我做了一些调查并提出了一个解决方案 - 如果蝴蝶罐被涂上涂层 [ni bu neng yong pu tong de hu die guan zuo wei rong qi ， yin wei hu die de yu yi hen rong yi jiu hui cong li mian tao zou 。 ran er ， wo zuo le yi xie diao cha bing ti chu le yi ge jie jue fang an  -  ru guo hu die guan bei tu shang tu ceng]

english: with a thin layer of a substance noxious to them they become incapable of escape.
translation: 有了一层薄薄的对它们有害的物质，它们就无法逃脱。 [you le yi ceng bao bao de dui ta men you hai de wu zhi ， ta men jiu wu fa tao tuo 。]

english: What substance is that, then?
translation: 那到底是什么物质呢？ [na dao di shi shen me wu zhi ne ？]

english: I have tried a few experiments with the help of a friend back home, and it turns out that a combination of anchovy oil and flowers - marigolds, rosemary or nasturtiums - will work.
translation: 在家乡朋友的帮助下，我尝试了一些实验，结果证明，将凤尾鱼油和鲜花（万寿菊、迷迭香或旱金莲）混合使用会有效。 [zai jia xiang peng you de bang zhu xia ， wo chang shi le yi xie shi yan ， jie guo zheng ming ， jiang feng wei yu you he xian hua （ wan shou ju 、 mi die xiang huo han jin lian ） hun he shi yong hui you xiao 。]

english: How do you make anchovy oil then?
translation: 那么如何制作凤尾鱼油呢？ [na me ru he zhi zuo feng wei yu you ne ？]

english: I'd grind up some cooked anchovies and pass them through a sieve.
translation: 我会把一些煮熟的凤尾鱼磨碎，然后将它们过筛。 [wo hui ba yi xie zhu shu de feng wei yu mo sui ， ran hou jiang ta men guo shai 。]

english: Where do I make these jars?
translation: 我在哪里制作这些罐子？ [wo zai na li zhi zuo zhe xie guan zi ？]

english: Well, I believe there is a chemist in Rimmington that has a small still that you could use.
translation: 嗯，我相信里明顿有一家药店有一个小型蒸馏器可供您使用。 [n ， wo xiang xin li ming dun you yi jia yao dian you yi ge xiao xing zheng liu qi ke gong nin shi yong 。]

english: Is there anywhere I can buy these jars?
translation: 有哪里可以买到这些罐子吗？ [you na li ke yi mai dao zhe xie guan zi ma ？]

english: Well I may be able to let you have a few - if it means you will start hunting these implings - although I do not have an infinite supply.
translation: 好吧，我也许可以给你一些——如果这意味着你会开始寻找这些暗示——尽管我没有无限的供应。 [hao ba ， wo ye xu ke yi gei ni yi xie —— ru guo zhe yi wei zhe ni hui kai shi xun zhao zhe xie an shi —— jin guan wo mei you wu xian de gong ying 。]

english: Tell me more about these thieving imps.
translation: 告诉我更多关于这些小偷小鬼的事。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu zhe xie xiao tou xiao gui de shi 。]

english: Imps and implings appear to be related, and the imps here are quite protective of their smaller relations. If you allow them to get too close then they will attempt to steal jarred implings from your pack, if you have them.
translation: 小鬼和暗示似乎是相关的，而且这里的小鬼非常保护它们较小的关系。如果你让它们靠得太近，那么它们会试图从你的背包中偷走震动的暗示（如果你有的话）。 [xiao gui he an shi si hu shi xiang guan de ， er qie zhe li de xiao gui fei chang bao hu ta men jiao xiao de guan xi 。 ru guo ni rang ta men kao de tai jin ， na me ta men hui shi tu cong ni de bei bao zhong tou zou zhen dong de an shi （ ru guo ni you de hua ）。]

english: They will then set them free, dropping your jar on the floor. So, if you're quick, you may be able to catch it again.
translation: 然后他们会释放它们，并将你的罐子扔到地板上。所以，如果你动作快的话，你也许能够再次抓住它。 [ran hou ta men hui shi fang ta men ， bing jiang ni de guan zi reng dao di ban shang 。 suo yi ， ru guo ni dong zuo kuai de hua ， ni ye xu neng gou zai ci zhua zhu ta 。]

english: I have some impling deterrent which I may trade if you prove that you can catch implings well.
translation: 我有一些暗示威慑，如果你证明你能很好地捕捉暗示，我可以交易它。 [wo you yi xie an shi wei she ， ru guo ni zheng ming ni neng hen hao di bu zhuo an shi ， wo ke yi jiao yi ta 。]

english: So what's this equipment you can give me, then?
translation: 那么你能给我的这个装备是什么？ [na me ni neng gei wo de zhe ge zhuang bei shi shen me ？]

english: I have been given permission by my clients to give three pieces of equipment to able hunters.
translation: 我已得到客户的许可，可以向有能力的猎人提供三件装备。 [wo yi de dao ke hu de xu ke ， ke yi xiang you neng li de lie ren ti gong san jian zhuang bei 。]

english: Firstly, I have some imp deterrent. If you bring me three baby implings, two young implings and one gourmet impling already jarred, I will give you a vial. Imps don't like the smell, so they will be less likely to
translation: 首先，我有一些小鬼威慑力。如果你给我带来三个婴儿小蛋糕、两个年轻小蛋糕和一个已经罐装的美味小蛋糕，我会给你一瓶。小鬼不喜欢这种气味，所以他们不太可能喜欢 [shou xian ， wo you yi xie xiao gui wei she li 。 ru guo ni gei wo dai lai san ge ying er xiao dan gao 、 liang ge nian qing xiao dan gao he yi ge yi jing guan zhuang de mei wei xiao dan gao ， wo hui gei ni yi ping 。 xiao gui bu xi huan zhe zhong qi wei ， suo yi ta men bu tai ke neng xi huan]

english: steal jarred implings from you.
translation: 从你那里偷走不和谐的暗示。 [cong ni na li tou zou bu he xie de an shi 。]

english: Secondly, I have magical butterfly nets. If you bring me three gourmet implings, two earth implings and one essence impling I will give you a new net. It will help you catch both implings and butterflies.
translation: 其次，我有神奇的蝴蝶网。如果你给我带来三个美食暗示，两个地球暗示和一个精华暗示，我会给你一张新网。它将帮助您捕捉暗示和蝴蝶。 [qi ci ， wo you shen qi de hu die wang 。 ru guo ni gei wo dai lai san ge mei shi an shi ， liang ge di qiu an shi he yi ge jing hua an shi ， wo hui gei ni yi zhang xin wang 。 ta jiang bang zhu nin bu zhuo an shi he hu die 。]

english: Lastly, I have magical jar generators. If you bring me three essence implings, two eclectic implings and one nature impling I will give you a jar generator. This object will create either butterfly or impling jars (up to
translation: 最后，我有神奇的罐子生成器。如果你给我带来三个本质暗示，两个折衷暗示和一个自然暗示，我会给你一个罐子生成器。该对象将创建蝴蝶或暗示罐子（最多 [zui hou ， wo you shen qi de guan zi sheng cheng qi 。 ru guo ni gei wo dai lai san ge ben zhi an shi ， liang ge zhe zhong an shi he yi ge zi ran an shi ， wo hui gei ni yi ge guan zi sheng cheng qi 。 gai dui xiang jiang chuang jian hu die huo an shi guan zi （ zui duo]

english: a limited number of charges) without having to carry a pack full of them.
translation: 数量有限的充电），而无需携带装满的电池。 [shu liang you xian de chong dian ）， er wu xu xie dai zhuang man de dian chi 。]

english: Yes! I have some spare equipment for you.
translation: 是的！我有一些备用设备给你。 [shi de ！ wo you yi xie bei yong she bei gei ni 。]

english: There you go. You have everything you need now.
translation: 就这样吧。您现在拥有所需的一切。 [jiu zhe yang ba 。 nin xian zai yong you suo xu de yi qie 。]

english: I have already given you some equipment.
translation: 我已经给你一些装备了。 [wo yi jing gei ni yi xie zhuang bei le 。]

english: If you are ready to start hunting implings, then enter the main part of the maze.
translation: 如果你准备好开始寻找暗示，那么就进入迷宫的主要部分。 [ru guo ni zhun bei hao kai shi xun zhao an shi ， na me jiu jin ru mi gong de zhu yao bu fen 。]

english: Just push through the wheat that surrounds the centre of the maze and get catching!
translation: 只需穿过迷宫中心周围的小麦即可抓住！ [zhi xu chuan guo mi gong zhong xin zhou wei de xiao mai ji ke zhua zhu ！]

english: Could you store some equipment for me?
translation: 你能为我储存一些装备吗？ [ni neng wei wo chu cun yi xie zhuang bei ma ？]

english: I suppose I could keep hold of a net and a few empty jars for you. Just give me what you want me to hold.
translation: 我想我可以为你保留一张网和几个空罐子。只要给我你想让我拿着的东西就可以了。 [wo xiang wo ke yi wei ni bao liu yi zhang wang he ji ge kong guan zi 。 zhi yao gei wo ni xiang rang wo na zhe de dong xi jiu ke yi le 。]

english: Can you tell me about the wheat?
translation: 你能告诉我关于小麦的事吗？ [ni neng gao su wo guan yu xiao mai de shi ma ？]

english: The wheat here can be hard to push through and pushing through it definitely makes you stronger. I found it easier to push through it for about half an hour just after coming through a temporary crop circle.
translation: 这里的小麦很难推过去，但推过去肯定会让你变得更坚强。我发现在穿过临时麦田圈后大约半小时更容易穿过它。 [zhe li de xiao mai hen nan tui guo qu ， dan tui guo qu ken ding hui rang ni bian de geng jian qiang 。 wo fa xian zai chuan guo lin shi mai tian quan hou da yue ban xiao shi geng rong yi chuan guo ta 。]

english: I call it the Farmer's Affinity.
translation: 我称之为农民的亲和力。 [wo cheng zhi wei nong min de qin he li 。]

english: What if I didn't want to become stronger pushing through the wheat?
translation: 如果我不想通过小麦变得更强怎么办？ [ru guo wo bu xiang tong guo xiao mai bian de geng qiang zen me ban ？]

english: I could give you oil to rub on you to reduce friction. Still as hard to push but you don't get stronger.
translation: 我可以给你油擦在你身上以减少摩擦。仍然很难推动，但你不会变得更强。 [wo ke yi gei ni you ca zai ni shen shang yi jian shao mo ca 。 reng ran hen nan tui dong ， dan ni bu hui bian de geng qiang 。]

english: You gave me oil to stop me getting stronger. What if I changed my mind?

english: In this chamber you will see various piles of shapes. You can pick up these shapes and enchant them using the enchant jewelry spells. By enchanting these shapes, you'll be converting them into orbs which you can be placed in the hole in the centre. You will get Enchantment Pizazz Points for every ten shapes that you convert and the points you get depends on the level of enchantment spell you cast. You will get a bonus Pizazz Point for enchanting a certain shape at a certain time, which I will periodically shout out. You will also be rewarded with an item for every so many orbs you deposit into the hole.

translation: 你可以通过穿过这座建筑后面的一个传送门来训练你的魔法艺术技能。通过在这些领域之一进行培训，您将获得每个房间独有的 Pizazz 积分。和 [ni ke yi tong guo chuan guo zhe zuo jian zhu hou mian de yi ge chuan song men lai xun lian ni de mo fa yi shu ji neng 。 tong guo zai zhe xie ling yu zhi yi jin xing pei xun ， nin jiang huo de mei ge fang jian du you de  Pizazz  ji fen 。 he]

english: these points you may claim a variety of items from my fellow guardian up the stairs.
translation: 通过这些点，你可以从楼上我的同伴监护人那里领取各种物品。 [tong guo zhe xie dian ， ni ke yi cong lou shang wo de tong ban jian hu ren na li ling qu ge zhong wu pin 。]

english: How do you record the Pizazz Points I have earned?
translation: 如何记录我获得的 Pizazz 积分？ [ru he ji lu wo huo de de  Pizazz  ji fen ？]

english: With the Pizazz Progress Hat I gave you, of course.
translation: 当然，还有我送给你的 Pizazz Progress 帽子。 [dang ran ， hai you wo song gei ni de  Pizazz Progress  mao zi 。]

english: OK.
translation: 好的。 [hao de 。]

english: Oh, and a word of warning: should you decide to log out whilst in any of the rooms in the arena, you will be teleported to the entrance and have any items that you picked up in the room removed.
translation: 哦，还有一句警告：如果您决定在竞技场的任何房间中退出，您将被传送到入口，并移除您在房间中拾取的所有物品。 [o ， hai you yi ju jing gao ： ru guo nin jue ding zai jing ji chang de ren he fang jian zhong tui chu ， nin jiang bei chuan song dao ru kou ， bing yi chu nin zai fang jian zhong shi qu de suo you wu pin 。]

english: You want another one don't you.
translation: 你还想要另一件，不是吗？ [ni hai xiang yao ling yi jian ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Sorry, can I?
translation: 抱歉，可以吗？ [bao qian ， ke yi ma ？]

english: Yes. What's it for?
translation: 是的。这是做什么用的？ [shi de 。 zhe shi zuo shen me yong de ？]

english: Collect Pizazz Points from the various areas and the hat will remember your totals. Talk to the hat at any time to find out what points you have. Go upstairs and talk to the Rewards Guardian to claim items for the
translation: 从各个区域收集 Pizazz 积分，帽子就会记住您的总数。随时与帽子交谈，了解你有哪些积分。上楼与奖励守护者交谈以领取物品 [cong ge ge qu yu shou ji  Pizazz  ji fen ， mao zi jiu hui ji zhu nin de zong shu 。 sui shi yu mao zi jiao tan ， liao jie ni you na xie ji fen 。 shang lou yu jiang li shou hu zhe jiao tan yi ling qu wu pin]

english: points.
translation: 点。 [dian 。]

english: I'm new to this place. Where am I?
translation: 我是这个地方的新手。我在哪里？ [wo shi zhe ge di fang de xin shou 。 wo zai na li ？]

english: What's the Telekinetic Theatre?
translation: 什么是心灵动力剧院？ [shen me shi xin ling dong li ju yuan ？]

english: What's the Alchemists' Playground?
translation: 炼金术士的游乐场是什么？ [lian jin shu shi de you le chang shi shen me ？]

english: What's the Enchanting Chamber?
translation: 附魔密室是什么？ [fu mo mi shi shi shen me ？]

english: What's the Creature Graveyard?
translation: 生物墓地是什么？ [sheng wu mu di shi shen me ？]

english: Thanks, bye!
translation: 谢谢，再见！ [xie xie ， zai jian ！]

english: None, I don't really care.
translation: 没有，我真的不在乎。 [mei you ， wo zhen de bu zai hu 。]

english: Can you tell me about this place again?
translation: 你能再给我介绍一下这个地方吗？ [ni neng zai gei wo jie shao yi xia zhe ge di fang ma ？]

english: Can you explain the different portals?
translation: 您能解释一下不同的门户吗？ [nin neng jie shi yi xia bu tong de men hu ma ？]

english: About the progress hat...
translation: 关于进度帽... [guan yu jin du mao ...]

english: Hello, thanks for rescuing me. Is there anything I can do for you?
translation: 你好，谢谢你救了我。有什么我可以为您做的吗？ [ni hao ， xie xie ni jiu le wo 。 you shen me wo ke yi wei nin zuo de ma ？]

english: How did you end up down here?
translation: 你怎么到这里来了？ [ni zen me dao zhe li lai le ？]

english: I travelled down here with my friend Olbertus in search for treasure. When we didn't find anything except his strange structure, he decided to prise off a coin from the stone relief in the other room. Before I knew it the entrance had closed and I was stuck down here.
translation: 我和我的朋友奥尔伯特斯一起来到这里寻找宝藏。当我们除了他奇怪的结构之外没有发现任何东西时，他决定从另一个房间的石头浮雕上撬出一枚硬币。在我意识到之前，入口已经关闭，我被困在这里。 [wo he wo de peng you ao er bo te si yi qi lai dao zhe li xun zhao bao zang 。 dang wo men chu le ta qi guai de jie gou zhi wai mei you fa xian ren he dong xi shi ， ta jue ding cong ling yi ge fang jian de shi tou fu diao shang qiao chu yi mei ying bi 。 zai wo yi shi dao zhi qian ， ru kou yi jing guan bi ， wo bei kun zai zhe li 。]

english: I tried calling out to Olbertus but he must not have heard me. I don't know what would've happened if you hadn't shown up and saved me.
translation: 我试着呼唤奥尔伯特斯，但他一定没有听到我的声音。我不知道如果你没有出现并救了我会发生什么。 [wo shi zhe hu huan ao er bo te si ， dan ta yi ding mei you ting dao wo de sheng yin 。 wo bu zhi dao ru guo ni mei you chu xian bing jiu le wo hui fa sheng shen me 。]

english: Well, it turns out Olbertus was corrupted by the coin he stole, I managed to get the coin from him and returned it to the relief, he should be fine now.
translation: 好吧，事实证明奥尔伯图斯被他偷来的硬币腐蚀了，我设法从他那里拿到了硬币并把它还给了救援人员，他现在应该没事了。 [hao ba ， shi shi zheng ming ao er bo tu si bei ta tou lai de ying bi fu shi le ， wo she fa cong ta na li na dao le ying bi bing ba ta huan gei le jiu yuan ren yuan ， ta xian zai ying gai mei shi le 。]

english: That's good news at least.
translation: 这至少是个好消息。 [zhe zhi shao shi ge hao xiao xi 。]

english: I am quite the proficient tanner, for helping me escape I will offer to tan hides for you. However, they'll be at a slightly higher cost for the convenience of being closer to the source.
translation: 我是个相当熟练的制革师，为了帮助我逃脱，我愿意为你鞣制兽皮。然而，为了更靠近源头，它们的成本会稍高一些。 [wo shi ge xiang dang shu lian de zhi ge shi ， wei le bang zhu wo tao tuo ， wo yuan yi wei ni rou zhi shou pi 。 ran er ， wei le geng kao jin yuan tou ， ta men de cheng ben hui shao gao yi xie 。]

english: Now that you're free, why don't you leave?
translation: 既然你自由了，为什么不离开呢？ [ji ran ni zi you le ， wei shen me bu li kai ne ？]

english: To be honest, I tried to set up a Tannery on the surface but business was poor, there aren't a lot of dragons in Kourend.
translation: 说实话，我曾尝试在地表开一家制革厂，但生意很差，库伦德的龙不多。 [shuo shi hua ， wo ceng chang shi zai di biao kai yi jia zhi ge chang ， dan sheng yi hen cha ， ku lun de de long bu duo 。]

english: I even heard a rumour that people have learned to tan hides with magic. It's always the same! Magic users stealing jobs from honest tradesman!
translation: 我什至听到谣言说人们已经学会用魔法鞣制皮革。总是一样的！魔法使用者从诚实的商人那里偷走了工作！ [wo shen zhi ting dao yao yan shuo ren men yi jing xue hui yong mo fa rou zhi pi ge 。 zong shi yi yang de ！ mo fa shi yong zhe cong cheng shi de shang ren na li tou zou le gong zuo ！]

english: Erm... Yeah! Those magic users...
translation: 呃……是啊！那些魔法使用者... [e …… shi a ！ na xie mo fa shi yong zhe ...]

english: Oh, wow! I can see why that wouldn't help business.
translation: 哦，哇！我明白为什么这对生意没有帮助。 [o ， wa ！ wo ming bai wei shen me zhe dui sheng yi mei you bang zhu 。]

english: Anyway, I figured if I was closer to the source of the hides then I might get more business. So I'll try setting up shop down here for a while.
translation: 不管怎样，我想如果我更接近生皮的来源，那么我可能会得到更多的生意。所以我会尝试在这里开店一段时间。 [bu guan zen yang ， wo xiang ru guo wo geng jie jin sheng pi de lai yuan ， na me wo ke neng hui de dao geng duo de sheng yi 。 suo yi wo hui chang shi zai zhe li kai dian yi duan shi jian 。]

english: How did you end up down here?
translation: 你怎么到这里来了？ [ni zen me dao zhe li lai le ？]

english: Now that you're free, why don't you leave?
translation: 既然你自由了，为什么不离开呢？ [ji ran ni zi you le ， wei shen me bu li kai ne ？]

english: Can you tan some hides for me?
translation: 你能为我晒一些兽皮吗？ [ni neng wei wo shai yi xie shou pi ma ？]

english: I'm good thanks.
translation: 我很好谢谢。 [wo hen hao xie xie 。]

english: Hi!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Hi, can I help?
translation: 你好，我可以帮忙吗？ [ni hao ， wo ke yi bang mang ma ？]

english: Welcome to Burthorpe Castle! Home to his Royal Highness the Prince of Burthorpe, Heir to the Throne of Asgarnia!
translation: 欢迎来到伯索普城堡！阿斯加尼亚王位继承人伯索普王子殿下的住所！ [huan ying lai dao bo suo pu cheng bao ！ a si jia ni ya wang wei ji cheng ren bo suo pu wang zi dian xia de zhu suo ！]

english: Wow!
translation: 哇！ [wa ！]

english: Anything else I can help you with?
translation: 还有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [hai you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

english: Where is the prince?
translation: 王子在哪里？ [wang zi zai na li ？]

english: We do not disclose his majesty's business.
translation: 我们不透露陛下的事。 [wo men bu tou lu bi xia de shi 。]

english: Do you have any quests for me?
translation: 你有什么任务要找我吗？ [ni you shen me ren wu yao zhao wo ma ？]

english: Yes actually I do, we need another servant.
translation: 是的，实际上我愿意，我们需要另一个仆人。 [shi de ， shi ji shang wo yuan yi ， wo men xu yao ling yi ge pu ren 。]

english: Does this noble quest have a name?
translation: 这个崇高的追求有名字吗？ [zhe ge chong gao de zhui qiu you ming zi ma ？]

english: Yes, it's the... er... Empty the Cesspit Quest!
translation: 是的，这就是……呃……清空污水坑任务！ [shi de ， zhe jiu shi …… e …… qing kong wu shui keng ren wu ！]

english: I'll give it a miss!
translation: 我会想念它的！ [wo hui xiang nian ta de ！]

english: No, I'm just looking around.
translation: 不，我只是四处看看。 [bu ， wo zhi shi si chu kan kan 。]

english: I'm looking for the guard that was on last night.
translation: 我正在寻找昨晚的守卫。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao zuo wan de shou wei 。]

english: There was only one guard on last night. Harold. He's a nice lad, if a little dim.
translation: 昨晚只有一名警卫。哈罗德.他是个好小伙子，虽然有点迟钝。 [zuo wan zhi you yi ming jing wei 。 ha luo de . ta shi ge hao xiao huo zi ， sui ran you dian chi dun 。]

english: Do you know where he is staying?
translation: 你知道他住在哪里吗？ [ni zhi dao ta zhu zai na li ma ？]

english: Harold is staying at the Toad and Chicken.
translation: 哈罗德住在蟾蜍和小鸡酒店。 [ha luo de zhu zai chan chu he xiao ji jiu dian 。]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: Do you know of another way up Death Plateau?
translation: 你知道通往死亡高原的另一条路吗？ [ni zhi dao tong wang si wang gao yuan de ling yi tiao lu ma ？]

english: No, sorry. I wouldn't want to go north-east from here, it's very rocky and barren.
translation: 不，抱歉。我不想从这里往东北走，那里岩石多、贫瘠。 [bu ， bao qian 。 wo bu xiang cong zhe li wang dong bei zou ， na li yan shi duo 、 pin ji 。]

english: Where is the guard that was on last night staying?
translation: 昨晚的守卫住在哪里？ [zuo wan de shou wei zhu zai na li ？]

english: Harold is staying at the local inn, the Toad and Chicken.
translation: 哈罗德住在当地的蟾蜍和鸡旅馆。 [ha luo de zhu zai dang di de chan chu he ji lv guan 。]

english: I found Harold but he won't talk to me!
translation: 我找到了哈罗德，但他不肯跟我说话！ [wo zhao dao le ha luo de ， dan ta bu ken gen wo shuo hua ！]

english: Hmm. Harold has got in trouble a few over his drinking and gambling. Perhaps he'd open up after a drink?
translation: 唔。哈罗德因酗酒和赌博而惹上一些麻烦。也许他喝完酒后会敞开心扉？ [wu 。 ha luo de yin xu jiu he du bo er re shang yi xie ma fan 。 ye xu ta he wan jiu hou hui chang kai xin fei ？]

english: Thanks, I'll try that!
translation: 谢谢，我会尝试一下！ [xie xie ， wo hui chang shi yi xia ！]

english: You said Harold had a weakness?
translation: 你说哈罗德有弱点？ [ni shuo ha luo de you ruo dian ？]

english: Yes, if you buy Harold a beer he might talk to you. I also know he has a weakness for gambling. Hope that helps!
translation: 是的，如果你给哈罗德买啤酒，他可能会和你说话。我也知道他有赌博的弱点。希望有帮助！ [shi de ， ru guo ni gei ha luo de mai pi jiu ， ta ke neng hui he ni shuo hua 。 wo ye zhi dao ta you du bo de ruo dian 。 xi wang you bang zhu ！]

english: Thanks for the help!
translation: 感谢您的帮助！ [gan xie nin de bang zhu ！]

english: I have a question for you.
translation: 我有个问题要问你。 [wo you ge wen ti yao wen ni 。]

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。 [qing shu ru wen ti de da an 。]

english: No, try again.
translation: 不，再试一次。 [bu ， zai shi yi ci 。]

english: Correct!
translation: 正确的！ [zheng que de ！]

english: What is this castle?
translation: 这座城堡是什么？ [zhe zuo cheng bao shi shen me ？]

english: Where is the prince?
translation: 王子在哪里？ [wang zi zai na li ？]

english: Do you have any quests for me?
translation: 你有什么任务要找我吗？ [ni you shen me ren wu yao zhao wo ma ？]

english: No, I'm just looking around.
translation: 不，我只是四处看看。 [bu ， wo zhi shi si chu kan kan 。]

english: I'm looking for the guard that was on last night.
translation: 我正在寻找昨晚的守卫。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao zuo wan de shou wei 。]

english: Do you know of another way up Death Plateau?
translation: 你知道通往死亡高原的另一条路吗？ [ni zhi dao tong wang si wang gao yuan de ling yi tiao lu ma ？]

english: Where is the guard that was on last night staying?
translation: 昨晚的守卫住在哪里？ [zuo wan de shou wei zhu zai na li ？]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Sorry, I cannot stop or Iona will catch me, we are playing tag!
translation: 抱歉，我不能停下来，否则艾奥娜会抓住我，我们正在玩捉迷藏！ [bao qian ， wo bu neng ting xia lai ， fou ze ai ao na hui zhua zhu wo ， wo men zheng zai wan zhuo mi cang ！]

english: Thank you for saving me. Mummy says you're a hero after what you did.
translation: 谢谢你救了我。妈妈说你做了这些事之后就是英雄了。 [xie xie ni jiu le wo 。 ma ma shuo ni zuo le zhe xie shi zhi hou jiu shi ying xiong le 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Good day. What can I help you with?
translation: 再会。我能为您提供什么帮助？ [zai hui 。 wo neng wei nin ti gong shen me bang zhu ？]

english: I would like to buy some equipment.
translation: 我想购买一些设备。 [wo xiang gou mai yi xie she bei 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Well, you must be a new arrival. I am Erdan, a descendant of Uhld.
translation: 嗯，你一定是新来的。我是埃尔丹，乌尔德的后裔。 [n ， ni yi ding shi xin lai de 。 wo shi ai er dan ， wu er de de hou yi 。]

english: Uhld? I've seen that inscribed on that big old statue down below. What's that about?
translation: 呃？我看到下面那座古老的大雕像上刻着这个字。那是关于什么的？ [e ？ wo kan dao xia mian na zuo gu lao de da diao xiang shang ke zhe zhe ge zi 。 na shi guan yu shen me de ？]

english: It's also on the fountain in the dungeon below, it displays their emblem.
translation: 它也在下面地牢的喷泉上，展示着他们的徽章。 [ta ye zai xia mian di lao de pen quan shang ， zhan shi zhe ta men de hui zhang 。]

english: Whose emblem?
translation: 谁的徽章？ [shei de hui zhang ？]

english: The Sect of Uhld, the founders of this here guild. I may not have gained entrance to this guild in the usual fashion, but I'd expect that they'd at least inform new members of this guild's history.
translation: 乌尔德教派，这个公会的创始人。我可能无法以通常的方式进入这个公会，但我希望他们至少会告诉新成员这个公会的历史。 [wu er de jiao pai ， zhe ge gong hui de chuang shi ren 。 wo ke neng wu fa yi tong chang de fang shi jin ru zhe ge gong hui ， dan wo xi wang ta men zhi shao hui gao su xin cheng yuan zhe ge gong hui de li shi 。]

english: Perhaps they expected you, a descendant of Uhld, to fill me in on the matter.
translation: 也许他们希望你，乌尔德的后裔，向我通报此事。 [ye xu ta men xi wang ni ， wu er de de hou yi ， xiang wo tong bao ci shi 。]

english: Aye, that may well be the case.
translation: 是的，情况很可能是这样。 [shi de ， qing kuang hen ke neng shi zhe yang 。]

english: Look, I'm awfully busy, what with the recent influx of members, so I'll give you the short version for now.
translation: 听着，我非常忙，最近有大量会员涌入，所以我现在给你简短的版本。 [ting zhe ， wo fei chang mang ， zui jin you da liang hui yuan yong ru ， suo yi wo xian zai gei ni jian duan de ban ben 。]

english: Fair enough.
translation: 很公平。 [hen gong ping 。]

english: The story my father told me was of a war on magic. Of god fearing men who believed nothing good would come of wielding a power that was never meant for them.
translation: 我父亲告诉我的故事是关于魔法战争的。敬畏上帝的人们相信，使用一种不属于他们的力量不会带来任何好处。 [wo fu qin gao su wo de gu shi shi guan yu mo fa zhan zheng de 。 jing wei shang di de ren men xiang xin ， shi yong yi zhong bu shu yu ta men de li liang bu hui dai lai ren he hao chu 。]

english: And so the rune temples that man had created were under threat. Before long, all were destroyed and thus forgotten.
translation: 因此，人类创造的符文神庙受到了威胁。不久之后，一切都被摧毁并被遗忘。 [yin ci ， ren lei chuang zao de fu wen shen miao shou dao le wei xie 。 bu jiu zhi hou ， yi qie dou bei cui hui bing bei yi wang 。]

english: But the wrath that these Gunnites embraced rippled through the pocket dimensions. Supposedly, a new altar of power was discovered.
translation: 但这些冈尼人的愤怒却在整个口袋空间中蔓延开来。据说，发现了一个新的权力祭坛。 [dan zhe xie gang ni ren de fen nu que zai zheng ge kou dai kong jian zhong man yan kai lai 。 ju shuo ， fa xian le yi ge xin de quan li ji tan 。]

english: The wrath altar?
translation: 愤怒祭坛？ [fen nu ji tan ？]

english: Indeed. The temple was destroyed just as construction had finished, and a nearby nomadic group called the Sect of Uhld were not pleased with the brutality they witnessed.
translation: 的确。寺庙刚完工就被摧毁了，附近一个名为乌尔德教派的游牧团体对他们目睹的残暴行为并不满意。 [di que 。 si miao gang wan gong jiu bei cui hui le ， fu jin yi ge ming wei wu er de jiao pai de you mu tuan ti dui ta men mu du de can bao xing wei bing bu man yi 。]

english: They quickly established this guild with information preservation as their core goal, for men are recorders of history and magic is key for this to last.
translation: 他们很快就成立了这个以信息保存为核心目标的公会，因为人类是历史的记录者，而魔法是维持历史的关键。 [ta men hen kuai jiu cheng li le zhe ge yi xin xi bao cun wei he xin mu biao de gong hui ， yin wei ren lei shi li shi de ji lu zhe ， er mo fa shi wei chi li shi de guan jian 。]

english: Did the... er, Gunnites, return?
translation: 呃，冈尼特人回来了吗？ [e ， gang ni te ren hui lai le ma ？]

english: Of course they did, but the Sect of Uhld had used the information gained from the wrath altar, and with a spell of their own making, they destroyed the southern runecrafting crusade with much ease.

translation: 告诉我你穿的那件技能斗篷。 [gao su wo ni chuan de na jian ji neng dou peng 。]

english: As you may know, skillcapes are only available to masters in a skill. I have spent my entire life building houses and now I spend my time selling them! As a sign of my abilities I wear this Skillcape of Construction.
translation: 如您所知，技能披风仅适用于技能大师。我一生都在建造房子，现在我把时间花在卖房子上！作为我能力的标志，我穿着这件建筑技能斗篷。 [ru nin suo zhi ， ji neng pi feng jin shi yong yu ji neng da shi 。 wo yi sheng dou zai jian zao fang zi ， xian zai wo ba shi jian hua zai mai fang zi shang ！ zuo wei wo neng li de biao zhi ， wo chuan zhe zhe jian jian zhu ji neng dou peng 。]

english: If you ever have enough skill to build a demonic throne, come and talk to me and I'll sell you a skillcape like mine.
translation: 如果你有足够的技能来建造恶魔王座，来跟我说话，我会卖给你一个像我一样的技能斗篷。 [ru guo ni you zu gou de ji neng lai jian zao e mo wang zuo ， lai gen wo shuo hua ， wo hui mai gei ni yi ge xiang wo yi yang de ji neng dou peng 。]

english: The Cape of Construction also provides you with as many teleports as you like to any of the house portals or even directly inside!
translation: 施工角还为您提供任意数量的传送到任何房屋门户，甚至直接进入内部！ [shi gong jiao hai wei nin ti gong ren yi shu liang de chuan song dao ren he fang wu men hu ， shen zhi zhi jie jin ru nei bu ！]

english: Can you sell me a Skillcape of Construction?
translation: 你能卖给我一个建筑技能吗？ [ni neng mai gei wo yi ge jian zhu ji neng ma ？]

english: Alright, that'll be 99000 coins, please. A small price to pay for such an illustrious cape that can teleport you to any of the house portals or even directly inside your house!
translation: 好的，那就是 99000 金币。花很少的钱就能买到这样一件著名的斗篷，它可以将你传送到任何房子的传送门，甚至直接传送到你的房子里！ [hao de ， na jiu shi  99000  jin bi 。 hua hen shao de qian jiu neng mai dao zhe yang yi jian zhu ming de dou peng ， ta ke yi jiang ni chuan song dao ren he fang zi de chuan song men ， shen zhi zhi jie chuan song dao ni de fang zi li ！]

english: I'm not paying that!
translation: 我不付那个钱！ [wo bu fu na ge qian ！]

english: Suit yourself. There are many other heroes who would love the opportunity to purchase one. You can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: 适合自己。还有许多其他英雄希望有机会购买一个。如果你改变主意，可以在这里找到我。 [shi he zi ji 。 hai you xu duo qi ta ying xiong xi wang you ji hui gou mai yi ge 。 ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， ke yi zai zhe li zhao dao wo 。]

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 但不幸的是，我身上没有足够的钱。 [dan bu xing de shi ， wo shen shang mei you zu gou de qian 。]

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 好吧，等你回来了就回来见我吧。 [hao ba ， deng ni hui lai le jiu hui lai jian wo ba 。]

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 不幸的是，所有技能斗篷都只提供免费兜帽，这是技能升级交易的一部分；买一送一，你懂的。因此，在我向您出售一件之前，您需要释放一些库存空间。 [bu xing de shi ， suo you ji neng dou peng dou zhi ti gong mian fei dou mao ， zhe shi ji neng sheng ji jiao yi de yi bu fen ； mai yi song yi ， ni dong de 。 yin ci ， zai wo xiang nin chu shou yi jian zhi qian ， nin xu yao shi fang yi xie ku cun kong jian 。]

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: 出色的！我的朋友，自豪地穿上那件斗篷。 [chu se de ！ wo de peng you ， zi hao di chuan shang na jian dou peng 。]

english: How can I get a house?
translation: 我怎样才能买到房子？ [wo zen yang cai neng mai dao fang zi ？]

english: Yes please!
translation: 是的，请！ [shi de ， qing ！]

english: No thanks
translation: 不，谢谢 [bu ， xie xie]

english: Tell me about houses!
translation: 说说房子吧！ [shuo shuo fang zi ba ！]

english: Can you move my house please?
translation: 请问你可以搬我的房子吗？ [qing wen ni ke yi ban wo de fang zi ma ？]

english: Rimmington

translation: 亚尼尔 [ya ni er]

translation: 普里夫迪纳斯 [pu li fu di na si]

english: Can you redecorate my house please?
translation: 请问你能重新装修一下我的房子吗？ [qing wen ni neng chong xin zhuang xiu yi xia wo de fang zi ma ？]

translation: 基石 [ji shi]

english: Whitewashed stone
translation: 粉刷过的石头 [fen shua guo de shi tou]

translation: 霍西迪乌斯之家 [huo xi di wu si zhi jia]
