english: Could I have a Construction guide book?
translation: 能给我一本建筑指南吗？ [neng gei wo yi ben jian zhu zhi nan ma ？]

english: Tell me about that skillcape you're wearing.
translation: 告诉我你穿的那件技能斗篷。 [gao su wo ni chuan de na jian ji neng dou peng 。]

english: Can you sell me a Skillcape of Construction?
translation: 你能卖给我一个建筑技能吗？ [ni neng mai gei wo yi ge jian zhu ji neng ma ？]

english: I'm not paying that!
translation: 我不付那个钱！ [wo bu fu na ge qian ！]

english: Certainly, that sounds fair.
translation: 当然，这听起来很公平。 [dang ran ， zhe ting qi lai hen gong ping 。]

english: Is this place haunted?
translation: 这个地方闹鬼吗？ [zhe ge di fang nao gui ma ？]

english: I don't think so. Would it matter if it was?
translation: 我不这么认为。如果是的话有什么关系吗？ [wo bu zhe me ren wei 。 ru guo shi de hua you shen me guan xi ma ？]

english: Maybe, it depends how haunted. I'm not a big fan of ghosts.
translation: 也许，这取决于闹鬼的程度。我不太喜欢鬼魂。 [ye xu ， zhe qu jue yu nao gui de cheng du 。 wo bu tai xi huan gui hun 。]

english: Well, let's hope it's not haunted!
translation: 好吧，希望它没有闹鬼！ [hao ba ， xi wang ta mei you nao gui ！]

english: Have you thought about painting the building?
translation: 你有没有想过粉刷这座建筑？ [ni you mei you xiang guo fen shua zhe zuo jian zhu ？]

english: I'm thinking a nice bold red, like the dragon armour.
translation: 我正在考虑一个漂亮的大胆的红色，就像龙铠一样。 [wo zheng zai kao lv yi ge piao liang de da dan de hong se ， jiu xiang long kai yi yang 。]

english: Or maybe a green, in memory of Elvarg, a very mean dragon.
translation: 或者也许是绿色的，以纪念埃尔瓦格，一条非常卑鄙的龙。 [huo zhe ye xu shi lv se de ， yi ji nian ai er wa ge ， yi tiao fei chang bei bi de long 。]

english: I think green would look great, it would match the surroundings, too!
translation: 我觉得绿色很好看，也很适合周围的环境！ [wo jue de lv se hen hao kan ， ye hen shi he zhou wei de huan jing ！]

english: Could I get one of those rune platebodies?
translation: 我可以得到一个符文板体吗？ [wo ke yi de dao yi ge fu wen ban ti ma ？]

english: Well, normally you'd have to slay a dragon for me...
translation: 好吧，通常你必须为我杀死一条龙...... [hao ba ， tong chang ni bi xu wei wo sha si yi tiao long ......]

english: ...but maybe I can make an exception once I've moved in here.
translation: ...不过也许我搬进来后可以破例。 [... bu guo ye xu wo ban jin lai hou ke yi po li 。]

english: As a little thank you for the help!
translation: 稍微感谢您的帮助！ [shao wei gan xie nin de bang zhu ！]

english: That would be great! Let's get this deal done quickly.
translation: 那太好了！让我们尽快完成这笔交易吧。 [na tai hao le ！ rang wo men jin kuai wan cheng zhe bi jiao yi ba 。]

english: I can't wait to complete the purchase!
translation: 我迫不及待地想完成购买！ [wo po bu ji dai di xiang wan cheng gou mai ！]

english: It's almost done Oziach, not much longer.
translation: 奥齐阿赫，一切都快完成了，没多久了。 [ao qi a he ， yi qie dou kuai wan cheng le ， mei duo jiu le 。]

english: Do you have any plans for it?
translation: 你对此有什么计划吗？ [ni dui ci you shen me ji hua ma ？]

english: I have a few. I might convert the top floor into a bar!
translation: 我有几个。我可能会把顶楼改成酒吧！ [wo you ji ge 。 wo ke neng hui ba ding lou gai cheng jiu ba ！]

english: It'll be for all dragon slayers I know, there's a lot of us!
translation: 这将是为了我认识的所有屠龙者，我们有很多人！ [zhe jiang shi wei le wo ren shi de suo you tu long zhe ， wo men you hen duo ren ！]

english: Interesting use of such a beautiful property!
translation: 如此美丽的财产的有趣用途！ [ru ci mei li de cai chan de you qu yong tu ！]

english: OoooOooOoOoOoooooooo!
translation: 噢噢噢噢噢噢噢噢噢！ [o o o o o o o o o ！]

english: Ah!! Why did you do that?
translation: 啊！！你为什么这么做？ [a ！！ ni wei shen me zhe me zuo ？]

english: That scared me!
translation: 那吓到我了！ [na xia dao wo le ！]

english: I'm sorry! I was just pretending to be a ghost.
translation: 对不起！我只是假装自己是个鬼而已。 [dui bu qi ！ wo zhi shi jia zhuang zi ji shi ge gui er yi 。]

english: Don't do that! I don't like ghosts.
translation: 不要那样做！我不喜欢鬼。 [bu yao na yang zuo ！ wo bu xi huan gui 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Sorry [player name], I'm talking to Oziach right now.
translation: 抱歉[玩家姓名]，我现在正在和奥齐亚克通话。 [bao qian [ wan jia xing ming ]， wo xian zai zheng zai he ao qi ya ke tong hua 。]

english: I'm going to head back to the office.
translation: 我要回办公室了。 [wo yao hui ban gong shi le 。]

english: Alright, I'll see you later. Can't wait to move in!
translation: 好的，稍后见。等不及要搬进去了！ [hao de ， shao hou jian 。 deng bu ji yao ban jin qu le ！]

english: I know, it's a lovely place! See you!
translation: 我知道，那是一个可爱的地方！再见！ [wo zhi dao ， na shi yi ge ke ai de di fang ！ zai jian ！]

english: The estate agent leaves.
translation: 房产经纪人离开。 [fang chan jing ji ren li kai 。]

english: Ahhh... soon to be mine.
translation: 啊啊……很快就会成为我的了。 [a a …… hen kuai jiu hui cheng wei wo de le 。]

english: The cutscene ends.
translation: 过场动画结束。 [guo chang dong hua jie shu 。]

english: A cutscene starts. The estate agent arrives, and approaches Oziach.
translation: 过场动画开始。房地产经纪人到达并接近奥齐亚赫。 [guo chang dong hua kai shi 。 fang di chan jing ji ren dao da bing jie jin ao qi ya he 。]

english: So many ghosts... I need some help!
translation: 这么多鬼魂......我需要一些帮助！ [zhe me duo gui hun ...... wo xu yao yi xie bang zhu ！]

english: Oziach! Are you okay? I heard shouting!
translation: 奥齐阿赫！你还好吗？我听到喊叫声！ [ao qi a he ！ ni hai hao ma ？ wo ting dao han jiao sheng ！]

english: Hello! It's not going well. There are a lot of ghosts here!
translation: 你好！进展不顺利。这里有很多鬼魂！ [ni hao ！ jin zhan bu shun li 。 zhe li you hen duo gui hun ！]

english: That's not good at all!
translation: 这一点都不好！ [zhe yi dian dou bu hao ！]

english: Do you still want to go ahead with the purchase?
translation: 您还想继续购买吗？ [nin hai xiang ji xu gou mai ma ？]

english: Of course! TWO ghosts is scary, but not that scary!
translation: 当然！两个鬼虽然可怕，但也没有那么可怕！ [dang ran ！ liang ge gui sui ran ke pa ， dan ye mei you na me ke pa ！]

english: I'll hire myself one of those slayers we see everywhere.
translation: 我会雇佣自己成为我们随处可见的杀手之一。 [wo hui gu yong zi ji cheng wei wo men sui chu ke jian de sha shou zhi yi 。]

english: They will help with the ghost problem!
translation: 他们会帮助解决幽灵问题！ [ta men hui bang zhu jie jue you ling wen ti ！]

english: Phew, that is lovely news! I thought it was all over, then.
translation: 唷，这真是个好消息！那时我以为一切都结束了。 [yo ， zhe zhen shi ge hao xiao xi ！ na shi wo yi wei yi qie dou jie shu le 。]

english: I'll head back to the office, meet me there shortly.
translation: 我会回办公室，很快就在那里见我。 [wo hui hui ban gong shi ， hen kuai jiu zai na li jian wo 。]

english: I'll be doing the final paperwork.
translation: 我会做最后的文书工作。 [wo hui zuo zui hou de wen shu gong zuo 。]

english: Are you here to fight the cold?
translation: 你是来抵御寒冷的吗？ [ni shi lai di yu han leng de ma ？]

english: Umm... I guess?
translation: 嗯...我猜？ [n ... wo cai ？]

english: Great! Ask me anything you like about the Bruma tree, I'm an expert.
translation: 伟大的！如果您喜欢布鲁玛树，请向我询问，我是专家。 [wei da de ！ ru guo nin xi huan bu lu ma shu ， qing xiang wo xun wen ， wo shi zhuan jia 。]

english: Tell me about the Wintertodt.
translation: 告诉我关于温特托特的事。 [gao su wo guan yu wen te tuo te de shi 。]

english: Some would say that ice preserves while fire destroys, but no amount of fire is destroying the Wintertodt. That's a cold that will freeze the air in your lungs.
translation: 有人会说，冰能保存，火能摧毁，但无论再多的火也无法摧毁温特托特。这种感冒会冻结肺部的空气。 [you ren hui shuo ， bing neng bao cun ， huo neng cui hui ， dan wu lun zai duo de huo ye wu fa cui hui wen te tuo te 。 zhe zhong gan mao hui dong jie fei bu de kong qi 。]

english: Even the heat generated from burning the Bruma roots only weakens it, and that doesn't last very long nowadays.
translation: 即使是燃烧布鲁玛根产生的热量也只会削弱它，而且这种情况现在不会持续很长时间。 [ji shi shi ran shao bu lu ma gen chan sheng de re liang ye zhi hui xue ruo ta ， er qie zhe zhong qing kuang xian zai bu hui chi xu hen zhang shi jian 。]

english: Looks like an angry snow storm to me...
translation: 对我来说，这就像一场愤怒的暴风雪...... [dui wo lai shuo ， zhe jiu xiang yi chang fen nu de bao feng xue ......]

english: What you see in that pit is not the Wintertodt at full strength. It never will be while the Bruma tree still burns and the Doors of Dinh remain closed.
translation: 你在那个坑里看到的并不是温特托特的全力状态。只要布鲁玛树还在燃烧，丁之门仍然关闭，这一切就永远不会发生。 [ni zai na ge keng li kan dao de bing bu shi wen te tuo te de quan li zhuang tai 。 zhi yao bu lu ma shu hai zai ran shao ， ding zhi men reng ran guan bi ， zhe yi qie jiu yong yuan bu hui fa sheng 。]

english: Tell me about the Bruma tree.
translation: 告诉我关于布鲁玛树的事。 [gao su wo guan yu bu lu ma shu de shi 。]

english: The Bruma tree is what keeps the Wintertodt weak. The prison was built here by Dinh because of its usefulness against the Wintertodt.
translation: 布鲁玛树使温特托特保持虚弱。这座监狱是丁在这里建造的，因为它对于对抗温特托特很有用。 [bu lu ma shu shi wen te tuo te bao chi xu ruo 。 zhe zuo jian yu shi ding zai zhe li jian zao de ， yin wei ta dui yu dui kang wen te tuo te hen you yong 。]

english: Some legends say that Xeric is the cause for the Doors weakening, or maybe he made the Wintertodt stronger?
translation: 一些传说说 Xeric 是导致门队衰弱的原因，或者也许他让 Wintertodt 变得更强？ [yi xie chuan shuo shuo  Xeric  shi dao zhi men dui shuai ruo de yuan yin ， huo zhe ye xu ta rang  Wintertodt  bian de geng qiang ？]

english: Is Xeric really such a bad guy?
translation: Xeric真的是个坏人吗？ [Xeric zhen de shi ge huai ren ma ？]

english: It's a known fact that he was interested in the Bruma tree. For what purpose... there are only rumours.
translation: 众所周知，他对布鲁玛树很感兴趣。出于什么目的……只是传闻。 [zhong suo zhou zhi ， ta dui bu lu ma shu hen gan xing qu 。 chu yu shen me mu di …… zhi shi chuan wen 。]

english: Regardless, the Bruma tree definitely contains powerful magic. I've been studying the sap for years and it has truly astounding properties.
translation: 不管怎样，布鲁玛树绝对蕴藏着强大的魔法。我多年来一直在研究这种汁液，它确实具有令人惊叹的特性。 [bu guan zen yang ， bu lu ma shu jue dui yun cang zhe qiang da de mo fa 。 wo duo nian lai yi zhi zai yan jiu zhe zhong zhi ye ， ta que shi ju you ling ren jing tan de te xing 。]

english: There's not many fires that burn green now, are there?
translation: 现在烧绿色的火不多了，是吗？ [xian zai shao lv se de huo bu duo le ， shi ma ？]

english: What about gnomish fire lighters?
translation: 侏儒打火机怎么样？ [zhu ru da huo ji zen me yang ？]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: Me? I'm a member of the Woodcutting Guild. More of a researcher though... I'm currently tasked with growing a new Bruma tree.
translation: 我？我是樵夫行会的会员。不过，更多的是一名研究员……我目前的任务是种植一棵新的布鲁玛树。 [wo ？ wo shi qiao fu hang hui de hui yuan 。 bu guo ， geng duo de shi yi ming yan jiu yuan …… wo mu qian de ren wu shi zhong zhi yi ke xin de bu lu ma shu 。]

english: How's that going?
translation: 怎么样？ [zen me yang ？]

english: Poorly. I believe the Bruma tree can only be grown in a freezing cold climate.
translation: 很糟糕。我相信布鲁玛树只能在寒冷的气候下生长。 [hen zao gao 。 wo xiang xin bu lu ma shu zhi neng zai han leng de qi hou xia sheng zhang 。]

english: Well, isn't that here?
translation: 嗯，那不是在这里吗？ [n ， na bu shi zai zhe li ma ？]

english: It's just an idea really. For all I know, it could be magic way beyond me, beyond even the Pyromancers.
translation: 这真的只是一个想法。据我所知，它的魔力可能远远超出我的能力，甚至超出火术士的能力。 [zhe zhen de zhi shi yi ge xiang fa 。 ju wo suo zhi ， ta de mo li ke neng yuan yuan chao chu wo de neng li ， shen zhi chao chu huo shu shi de neng li 。]

english: See you later.
translation: 稍后见。 [shao hou jian 。]

english: Goodbye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Tell me about the Wintertodt.
translation: 告诉我关于温特托特的事。 [gao su wo guan yu wen te tuo te de shi 。]

english: Tell me about the Bruma tree.
translation: 告诉我关于布鲁玛树的事。 [gao su wo guan yu bu lu ma shu de shi 。]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: See you later.
translation: 稍后见。 [shao hou jian 。]

english: This looks like an interesting island.
translation: 这看起来是一个有趣的岛屿。 [zhe kan qi lai shi yi ge you qu de dao yu 。]

english: Oh it is.
translation: 哦，是的。 [o ， shi de 。]

english: Fancy a race!?!
translation: 想参加比赛吗？！ [xiang can jia bi sai ma ？！]

english: What? That's a bit sudden. What kind of race?
translation: 什么？这有点突然。什么样的种族？ [shen me ？ zhe you dian tu ran 。 shen me yang de zhong zu ？]

english: I bet I can beat you to the other end of this island, I'll take the left route and you can take the right.
translation: 我打赌我能比你先到岛的另一端，我走左边的路，你走右边的路。 [wo da du wo neng bi ni xian dao dao de ling yi duan ， wo zou zuo bian de lu ， ni zou you bian de lu 。]

english: That doesn't seem fair - mine's all curvy and yours is straight.
translation: 这看起来不公平——我的都是曲线形的，而你的却是直的。 [zhe kan qi lai bu gong ping —— wo de dou shi qu xian xing de ， er ni de que shi zhi de 。]

english: Well, that's life I'm afraid, it's never as easy as you would like, you have to take the path that's dealt!
translation: 好吧，恐怕这就是生活，它永远不会像你想象的那么容易，你必须走这条路！ [hao ba ， kong pa zhe jiu shi sheng huo ， ta yong yuan bu hui xiang ni xiang xiang de na me rong yi ， ni bi xu zou zhe tiao lu ！]

english: If you insist.
translation: 如果你坚持的话。 [ru guo ni jian chi de hua 。]

english: You'll see, so how about it?
translation: 你会看到的，那么怎么样？ [ni hui kan dao de ， na me zen me yang ？]

english: On your marks!
translation: 各就各位！ [ge jiu ge wei ！]

english: Get set!
translation: 准备好！ [zhun bei hao ！]

english: Go !!!
No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Have it your way.
translation: 随心所欲。 [sui xin suo yu 。]

english: You beat me.
translation: 你打败了我。 [ni da bai le wo 。]

english: Woo hoo! Ha ha! You can try again if you want, but you'll never beat me, I'm far too fast!
translation: 呜呼！哈哈！如果你愿意的话，你可以再试一次，但你永远不会打败我，我太快了！ [wu hu ！ ha ha ！ ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， ni ke yi zai shi yi ci ， dan ni yong yuan bu hui da bai wo ， wo tai kuai le ！]

english: Eat my dust!
translation: 吃掉我的灰尘吧！ [chi diao wo de hui chen ba ！]

english: You're right, I'm far too slow.
translation: 你说得对，我太慢了。 [ni shuo de dui ， wo tai man le 。]

english: You give up too easily, but have it your way.
translation: 你太容易放弃，但要按自己的方式去做。 [ni tai rong yi fang qi ， dan yao an zi ji de fang shi qu zuo 。]

english: Oh, hello? Looks like you'll probably want to start again.
translation: 哦，你好？看来您可能想重新开始。 [o ， ni hao ？ kan lai nin ke neng xiang chong xin kai shi 。]

english: I won!
translation: 我赢了！ [wo ying le ！]

english: Noooo! How could you beat me?
translation: 不！你怎么能打败我？ [bu ！ ni zen me neng da bai wo ？]

english: Very well.
translation: 很好。 [hen hao 。]

english: I'm just making the most of the abilities I worked hard to develop. That's all!
translation: 我只是充分利用我努力培养的能力。就这样！ [wo zhi shi chong fen li yong wo nu li pei yang de neng li 。 jiu zhe yang ！]

english: True. A very important thing to remember! Now be gone!
translation: 真的。一件非常重要的事情要记住！现在走吧！ [zhen de 。 yi jian fei chang zhong yao de shi qing yao ji zhu ！ xian zai zou ba ！]

english: Ok.
translation: 好的。 [hao de 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Eat my dust!
translation: 吃掉我的灰尘吧！ [chi diao wo de hui chen ba ！]

english: You're right, I'm far too slow.
translation: 你说得对，我太慢了。 [ni shuo de dui ， wo tai man le 。]

english: Can I help you at all?
translation: 我可以帮助你吗？ [wo ke yi bang zhu ni ma ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Yes please. What are you selling?
translation: 是的，请。你卖什么？ [shi de ， qing 。 ni mai shen me ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: What is it you want?
translation: 你想要什么？ [ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Can I kill the dragons up here?
translation: 我可以杀掉这里的龙吗？ [wo ke yi sha diao zhe li de long ma ？]

english: I suppose that's okay since you've got a Slayer assignment. But when you've finished it, leave the rest for me!
translation: 我想这没关系，因为你有一个杀手任务。不过等你完成之后，剩下的就交给我吧！ [wo xiang zhe mei guan xi ， yin wei ni you yi ge sha shou ren wu 。 bu guo deng ni wan cheng zhi hou ， sheng xia de jiu jiao gei wo ba ！]

english: Don't even think about it - these dragons up here are for me!
translation: 想都别想——这里的这些龙是给我的！ [xiang dou bie xiang —— zhe li de zhe xie long shi gei wo de ！]

english: There's a Slayer Master in my family, so I don't stop people doing their Slayer assignments, but otherwise these dragons are for me, not you.
translation: 我家里有一位屠夫大师，所以我不会阻止人们执行他们的屠夫任务，但除此之外，这些龙是给我的，不是你的。 [wo jia li you yi wei tu fu da shi ， suo yi wo bu hui zu zhi ren men zhi xing ta men de tu fu ren wu ， dan chu ci zhi wai ， zhe xie long shi gei wo de ， bu shi ni de 。]

english: What are you here for?
translation: 你来这里干什么？ [ni lai zhe li gan shen me ？]

english: Dragon-slaying, of course. Do I look like one of those serfs who wanders around scavenging scales off the floor? I'm just having a rest now, before I get back to the fight.
translation: 当然是屠龙。我看起来像那些四处游荡、捡拾地板上鳞片的农奴吗？我现在只是休息一下，然后再继续战斗。 [dang ran shi tu long 。 wo kan qi lai xiang na xie si chu you dang 、 jian shi di ban shang lin pian de nong nu ma ？ wo xian zai zhi shi xiu xi yi xia ， ran hou zai ji xu zhan dou 。]

english: My cousin Slieve built the access routes through this blue dragon lair. But she's only really interested in black dragons, not blue ones, so she said I could have this area for myself.
translation: 我的表弟斯利夫修建了穿过这个蓝龙巢穴的通道。但她只对黑龙感兴趣，对蓝龙不感兴趣，所以她说我可以自己拥有这个区域。 [wo de biao di si li fu xiu jian le chuan guo zhe ge lan long chao xue de tong dao 。 dan ta zhi dui hei long gan xing qu ， dui lan long bu gan xing qu ， suo yi ta shuo wo ke yi zi ji yong you zhe ge qu yu 。]

english: Why are you dressed like that?
translation: 你为什么穿成这样？ [ni wei shen me chuan cheng zhe yang ？]

english: It's hot in here with all the dragonfire.
translation: 这里很热，到处都是龙火。 [zhe li hen re ， dao chu dou shi long huo 。]

english: Don't you need armour, though?
translation: 不过你不需要盔甲吗？ [bu guo ni bu xu yao kui jia ma ？]

english: I've got wizard boots on, see? What more would I want?
translation: 我穿上了巫师靴，明白吗？我还想要什么？ [wo chuan shang le wu shi xue ， ming bai ma ？ wo hai xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Well, maybe you'd want something to help you fight the dragons? Wizard boots don't sound very useful.
translation: 好吧，也许你想要一些东西来帮助你对抗龙？巫师靴听起来不太有用。 [hao ba ， ye xu ni xiang yao yi xie dong xi lai bang zhu ni dui kang long ？ wu shi xue ting qi lai bu tai you yong 。]

english: They're useful enough for what I'm doing. Anyway, moving on...
translation: 它们对于我正在做的事情来说足够有用。无论如何，继续前进... [ta men dui yu wo zheng zai zuo de shi qing lai shuo zu gou you yong 。 wu lun ru he ， ji xu qian jin ...]

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: Off you go.
translation: 你走吧。 [ni zou ba 。]

english: Oi, find yourself some other dragons - these are mine!
translation: 喂，给自己找一些其他的龙——这些是我的！ [wei ， gei zi ji zhao yi xie qi ta de long —— zhe xie shi wo de ！]

english: Can I kill the dragons up here?
translation: 我可以杀掉这里的龙吗？ [wo ke yi sha diao zhe li de long ma ？]

english: What are you here for?
translation: 你来这里干什么？ [ni lai zhe li gan shen me ？]

english: Why are you dressed like that?
translation: 你为什么穿成这样？ [ni wei shen me chuan cheng zhe yang ？]

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: Hey Eve!
translation: 嘿伊芙！ [hei yi fu ！]

english: [player name]! You're back! Here to party some more?
translation: [玩家姓名]！你回来了！来这里参加更多派对吗？ [[ wan jia xing ming ]！ ni hui lai le ！ lai zhe li can jia geng duo pai dui ma ？]

english: You never get sick of partying, do you?
translation: 你永远不会厌倦聚会，不是吗？ [ni yong yuan bu hui yan juan ju hui ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Well, you see, I spend the rest of the year in the afterlife. And that is quite boring.
translation: 好吧，你看，我在来世度过了这一年剩下的时间。这很无聊。 [hao ba ， ni kan ， wo zai lai shi du guo le zhe yi nian sheng xia de shi jian 。 zhe hen wu liao 。]

english: The afterlife?
translation: 来世？ [lai shi ？]

english: Yes. You know, where you go when you die. Anyway, that's boring stuff. Coming back here is fun!
translation: 是的。你知道，你死后会去哪里。无论如何，这都是无聊的事情。回到这里很有趣！ [shi de 。 ni zhi dao ， ni si hou hui qu na li 。 wu lun ru he ， zhe dou shi wu liao de shi qing 。 hui dao zhe li hen you qu ！]

english: How do you come back?
translation: 你怎么回来？ [ni zen me hui lai ？]

english: Magic, my friend!
translation: 魔法，我的朋友！ [mo fa ， wo de peng you ！]

english: What kind of magic?
translation: 什么样的魔法？ [shen me yang de mo fa ？]

english: You wouldn't understand. If you're so interested, talk to the other people around here. They've returned from the afterlife as well!
translation: 你不会明白的。如果您有兴趣，请与这里的其他人交谈。 They've returned from the afterlife as well! [ni bu hui ming bai de 。 ru guo nin you xing qu ， qing yu zhe li de qi ta ren jiao tan 。 They've returned from the afterlife as well!]

english: Have they? Interesting.
translation: 他们有吗？有趣的。 [ta men you ma ？ you qu de 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Come back soon!
translation: 快点回来吧！ [kuai dian hui lai ba ！]

english: What kind of magic?
translation: 什么样的魔法？ [shen me yang de mo fa ？]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Do you wanna meet my pet? His name's Pete. Or has this amulet of humanspeak broken again?
translation: 你想见见我的宠物吗？他的名字叫皮特。还是这人语护身符又坏了？ [ni xiang jian jian wo de chong wu ma ？ ta de ming zi jiao pi te 。 hai shi zhe ren yu hu shen fu you huai le ？]

english: Player is teleported to ScapeRune prison
translation: 玩家被传送到 ScapeRune 监狱 [wan jia bei chuan song dao  ScapeRune  jian yu]

english: You leave the cat alone, and the cat leaves you alone.
translation: 你离开猫，猫也离开你。 [ni li kai mao ， mao ye li kai ni 。]

english: Hey, [player name], come with me if you like fishing! Or has this amulet of humanspeak broken again?
translation: 嘿，[玩家名字]，如果你喜欢钓鱼，就跟我来吧！还是这人语护身符又坏了？ [hei ，[ wan jia ming zi ]， ru guo ni xi huan diao yu ， jiu gen wo lai ba ！ hai shi zhe ren yu hu shen fu you huai le ？]

english: Player is teleported to Evil Bob's Island
translation: 玩家被传送到邪恶鲍勃的岛 [wan jia bei chuan song dao xie e bao bo de dao]

english: Evil Bob doesn't seem interested in you.
translation: 邪恶的鲍勃似乎对你不感兴趣。 [xie e de bao bo si hu dui ni bu gan xing qu 。]

english: Evil Bob is no longer interested in you.
translation: 邪恶的鲍勃不再对你感兴趣。 [xie e de bao bo bu zai dui ni gan xing qu 。]

english: So you've been captured too?
translation: 那你也被抓了？ [na ni ye bei zhua le ？]

english: Captured?
translation: 被俘虏了？ [bei fu lu le ？]

english: Yes, Evil Bob captured me and stuck me in this prison.
translation: 是的，邪恶的鲍勃抓住了我，把我关进了这个监狱。 [shi de ， xie e de bao bo zhua zhu le wo ， ba wo guan jin le zhe ge jian yu 。]

english: How do I get out of here? I can't be held captive by a cat!
translation: 我怎样才能离开这里？我不能被猫俘虏！ [wo zen yang cai neng li kai zhe li ？ wo bu neng bei mao fu lu ！]

english: Some of these balloon animals have keys in them, and if you pull the big lever it tells you which shape animal contains the correct key, but I can never find it.
translation: 有些气球动物里面有钥匙，如果你拉动大杠杆，它会告诉你哪种形状的动物包含正确的钥匙，但我永远找不到它。 [you xie qi qiu dong wu li mian you yao shi ， ru guo ni la dong da gang gan ， ta hui gao su ni na zhong xing zhuang de dong wu bao han zheng que de yao shi ， dan wo yong yuan zhao bu dao ta 。]

english: You need to pull the lever to find out which shape animal contains the key, then pop that sort of animal to get the key.
translation: 你需要拉动控制杆来找出哪种形状的动物包含钥匙，然后弹出那种动物以获得钥匙。 [ni xu yao la dong kong zhi gan lai zhao chu na zhong xing zhuang de dong wu bao han yao shi ， ran hou dan chu na zhong dong wu yi huo de yao shi 。]

english: Bring me any keys you get and I'll try them on the doors.
translation: 把你拿到的所有钥匙都给我，我会在门上试一试。 [ba ni na dao de suo you yao shi dou gei wo ， wo hui zai men shang shi yi shi 。]

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。 [hao de 。]

english: But I wan't to leave now.
translation: 但我现在不想离开。 [dan wo xian zai bu xiang li kai 。]

english: Oh. Well I guess you can leave but I'll still be stuck here.
translation: 哦。好吧，我想你可以离开了，但我仍然会被困在这里。 [o 。 hao ba ， wo xiang ni ke yi li kai le ， dan wo reng ran hui bei kun zai zhe li 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Don't you remember? This is ScapeRune's prison. Evil Bob caught you and brought you here.
translation: 你不记得了吗？这是ScapeRune 的监狱。邪恶的鲍勃抓住了你并把你带到了这里。 [ni bu ji de le ma ？ zhe shi ScapeRune  de jian yu 。 xie e de bao bo zhua zhu le ni bing ba ni dai dao le zhe li 。]

english: What gives him the right to lock me up? I demand to see a lawyer! I know my rights!
translation: 他凭什么有权把我关起来？我要求见律师！我知道我的权利！ [ta ping shen me you quan ba wo guan qi lai ？ wo yao qiu jian lv shi ！ wo zhi dao wo de quan li ！]

english: Evil Bob doesn't care about people's rights. He's cruel and utterly merciless. He's a cat.
translation: 邪恶的鲍勃并不关心人们的权利。他很残忍，而且完全无情。他是一只猫。 [xie e de bao bo bing bu guan xin ren men de quan li 。 ta hen can ren ， er qie wan quan wu qing 。 ta shi yi zhi mao 。]

english: Come on, we should leave before Evil Bob comes back! You go first; I'll follow along.
translation: 来吧，我们应该在邪恶鲍勃回来之前离开！你先走；我会跟着。 [lai ba ， wo men ying gai zai xie e bao bo hui lai zhi qian li kai ！ ni xian zou ； wo hui gen zhe 。]

english: Oi! we'll be using the exit that's over here.
translation: 哎呀！我们将使用这里的出口。 [ai ya ！ wo men jiang shi yong zhe li de chu kou 。]

english: You're meant to pull the lever to find out which sort of animal to pop!
translation: 你需要拉动控制杆来找出要消灭哪种动物！ [ni xu yao la dong kong zhi gan lai zhao chu yao xiao mie na zhong dong wu ！]

english: That's right, pull it. Then remember what kind of animal shape you see. That's the animal that contains the right key.
translation: 没错，就是拉。然后记住你看到的是哪种动物形状。那就是包含正确钥匙的动物。 [mei cuo ， jiu shi la 。 ran hou ji zhu ni kan dao de shi na zhong dong wu xing zhuang 。 na jiu shi bao han zheng que yao shi de dong wu 。]

english: Great, now you've got a key! Bring it to me so I can try it on the doors.
translation: 太棒了，现在你已经拿到钥匙了！把它带给我，我可以在门上试试。 [tai bang le ， xian zai ni yi jing na dao yao shi le ！ ba ta dai gei wo ， wo ke yi zai men shang shi shi 。]

english: The player walks to Prison Pete
translation: 玩家走向皮特监狱 [wan jia zou xiang pi te jian yu]

english: Ooh, thanks! I'll see if it's the right one...
translation: 哦，谢谢！我看看是不是合适的... [o ， xie xie ！ wo kan kan shi bu shi he shi de ...]

english: Aww, that was the wrong key! You must have popped the wrong sort of animal. Try the big lever again - it'll tell you which animal to pop.
translation: 哇哦，那是错误的钥匙！你一定是找错了动物种类。再次尝试大杠杆 - 它会告诉您要弹出哪只动物。 [wa o ， na shi cuo wu de yao shi ！ ni yi ding shi zhao cuo le dong wu zhong lei 。 zai ci chang shi da gang gan  -  ta hui gao su nin yao dan chu na zhi dong wu 。]

english: Hooray, you got the right one! Now pull the lever again and let's get the next portal unlocked!
translation: 万岁，你选对了！现在再次拉动控制杆，让我们解锁下一个传送门！ [wan sui ， ni xuan dui le ！ xian zai zai ci la dong kong zhi gan ， rang wo men jie suo xia yi ge chuan song men ！]

english: You did it, you got all the keys right! Thank you! You're my friend FOREVER!
translation: 你做到了，所有的钥匙都对了！谢谢你！你永远是我的朋友！ [ni zuo dao le ， suo you de yao shi dou dui le ！ xie xie ni ！ ni yong yuan shi wo de peng you ！]

english: Let's get out of here before that cat notices.
translation: 我们趁猫发现之前离开这里吧。 [wo men chen mao fa xian zhi qian li kai zhe li ba 。]

english: Hey, bring me that key you've got! I wanna get out of here!
translation: 嘿，把你的钥匙给我拿来！我想离开这里！ [hei ， ba ni de yao shi gei wo na lai ！ wo xiang li kai zhe li ！]

english: Player is teleported back to their original spot
translation: 玩家被传送回原来的位置 [wan jia bei chuan song hui yuan lai de wei zhi]

english: Thanks a lot for your help! Here, have a present:
translation: 非常感谢您的帮助！在这里，有一份礼物： [fei chang gan xie nin de bang zhu ！ zai zhe li ， you yi fen li wu ：]

english: Thanks! See you around!
translation: 谢谢！再见！ [xie xie ！ zai jian ！]

english: Don't mind me, I was just leaving...
translation: 别介意我，我正要离开…… [bie jie yi wo ， wo zheng yao li kai ……]

english: Huh?
Where am I?
translation: 我在哪里？ [wo zai na li ？]

english: On my island.
translation: 在我的岛上。 [zai wo de dao shang 。]

english: Take me to your leader!
translation: 带我去见你们的领导！ [dai wo qu jian ni men de ling dao ！]

english: I am your leader, you are but a slave!
translation: 我是你们的领袖，你们不过是奴隶！ [wo shi ni men de ling xiu ， ni men bu guo shi nu li ！]

english: I am not a slave, I am a free person!
translation: 我不是奴隶，我是一个自由人！ [wo bu shi nu li ， wo shi yi ge zi you ren ！]

english: Ah-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha!
translation: 啊哈哈哈哈哈哈！ [a ha ha ha ha ha ha ！]

english: Let me out of here!
translation: 让我离开这里！ [rang wo li kai zhe li ！]

english: I will never let you go, [player name]!
translation: 我永远不会放开你，[玩家名字]！ [wo yong yuan bu hui fang kai ni ，[ wan jia ming zi ]！]

english: Why not?
translation: 为什么不呢？ [wei shen me bu ne ？]

english: Uhm...
Because I say so! And because I can never have enough servants!
translation: 因为我这么说！因为我的仆人永远不够！ [yin wei wo zhe me shuo ！ yin wei wo de pu ren yong yuan bu gou ！]

english: Now catch me some fish, I'm hungry.
translation: 现在给我抓点鱼吧，我饿了。 [xian zai gei wo zhua dian yu ba ， wo e le 。]

english: What fish, where?
translation: 什么鱼，哪里的？ [shen me yu ， na li de ？]

english: Talk to my other servants, and hurry it up!
translation: 和我的其他仆人说一声，快点！ [he wo de qi ta pu ren shuo yi sheng ， kuai dian ！]

english: What's it all about?
translation: 这是怎么回事？ [zhe shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: Sit down and I'll tell you. It's a question of servant shortage.
translation: 坐下来我告诉你。这是一个仆人短缺的问题。 [zuo xia lai wo gao su ni 。 zhe shi yi ge pu ren duan que de wen ti 。]

english: Go on.
translation: 继续。 [ji xu 。]

english: You are a skilled worker. A human like you is worth a great deal as a slave.
translation: 你是一名熟练工人。像你这样的人作为奴隶是很有价值的。 [ni shi yi ming shu lian gong ren 。 xiang ni zhe yang de ren zuo wei nu li shi hen you jia zhi de 。]

english: A slave?? I will have nothing to do with you. Is that clear? Absolutely nothing.
translation: 奴隶？？我不会和你有任何关系。清楚了吗？绝对没有。 [nu li ？？ wo bu hui he ni you ren he guan xi 。 qing chu le ma ？ jue dui mei you 。]

english: Now be reasonable little human. It's just a matter of time before you will do everything I ask you to. Play along and this can be a very nice place.
translation: 现在做个理智的小人吧。你完成我要求你做的一切只是时间问题。一起玩，这可能是一个非常好的地方。 [xian zai zuo ge li zhi de xiao ren ba 。 ni wan cheng wo yao qiu ni zuo de yi qie zhi shi shi jian wen ti 。 yi qi wan ， zhe ke neng shi yi ge fei chang hao de di fang 。]

english: I will not make any deals with you. I'm a human. I will not be pushed, numbered, meowed at, teleported or enslaved. My life is my own.
translation: 我不会和你做任何交易。我是一个人。我不会被推挤、编号、喵喵叫、传送或奴役。我的生活是我自己的。 [wo bu hui he ni zuo ren he jiao yi 。 wo shi yi ge ren 。 wo bu hui bei tui ji 、 bian hao 、 miao miao jiao 、 chuan song huo nu yi 。 wo de sheng huo shi wo zi ji de 。]

english: Is it?
translation: 是吗？ [shi ma ？]

english: Yes. You won't hold me.
translation: 是的。你不会抱住我。 [shi de 。 ni bu hui bao zhu wo 。]

english: Won't I?
translation: 我不会吗？ [wo bu hui ma ？]

english: Let me assure you there's no way out.
translation: 让我向你保证，没有出路。 [rang wo xiang ni bao zheng ， mei you chu lu 。]

english: Just ask my servants!
translation: 就问我的仆人吧！ [jiu wen wo de pu ren ba ！]

english: How is it possible that you're talking?
translation: 你怎么可能在说话？ [ni zen me ke neng zai shuo hua ？]

english: How is it possible that you're not meowing?
translation: 你怎么可能不喵喵叫呢？ [ni zen me ke neng bu miao miao jiao ne ？]

english: Meowing?? Why would I be meowing?
translation: 喵喵？？我为什么要喵喵叫？ [miao miao ？？ wo wei shen me yao miao miao jiao ？]

english: Most humans do, that's why I'm wearing this amulet of Man speak... but I do try to train my staff in civilised speech.
translation: 大多数人都会这么做，这就是为什么我戴着这个人类语言护身符……但我确实尝试训练我的员工文明言语。 [da duo shu ren du hui zhe me zuo ， zhe jiu shi wei shen me wo dai zhe zhe ge ren lei yu yan hu shen fu …… dan wo que shi chang shi xun lian wo de yuan gong wen ming yan yu 。]

english: Ah, but I suppose things are slightly different in your world... what a dreadful place that must be.
translation: 啊，但我想你们的世界里的情况略有不同……那一定是一个多么可怕的地方。 [a ， dan wo xiang ni men de shi jie li de qing kuang lve you bu tong …… na yi ding shi yi ge duo me ke pa de di fang 。]

english: I think I'm getting a headache...
translation: 我觉得我头疼了... [wo jue de wo tou teng le ...]

english: What did you do to Bob?
translation: 你对鲍勃做了什么？ [ni dui bao bo zuo le shen me ？]

english: Bob? I am Bob!
translation: 鲍勃？我是鲍勃！ [bao bo ？ wo shi bao bo ！]

english: Oh, you mean the Bob in your world? Nothing. I am an incarnation of Bob here on ScapeRune.
translation: 哦，你是说你世界里的鲍勃吗？没有什么。我是 ScapeRune 上鲍勃的化身。 [o ， ni shi shuo ni shi jie li de bao bo ma ？ mei you shen me 。 wo shi  ScapeRune  shang bao bo de hua shen 。]

english: What, you mean this is... like some kind of mirror land?
translation: 什么，你的意思是这...就像某种镜子之地？ [shen me ， ni de yi si shi zhe ... jiu xiang mou zhong jing zi zhi di ？]

english: Something like that... somewhere in ScapeRune there must be a human servant called [player name].
translation: 类似这样的……在ScapeRune的某个地方一定有一个叫[玩家名字]的人类仆人。 [lei si zhe yang de …… zai ScapeRune de mou ge di fang yi ding you yi ge jiao [ wan jia ming zi ] de ren lei pu ren 。]

english: But you work just as well for me! Now get to work, human! Fish for me!
translation: 但你对我来说也同样好！现在开始工作吧，人类！给我鱼吧！ [dan ni dui wo lai shuo ye tong yang hao ！ xian zai kai shi gong zuo ba ， ren lei ！ gei wo yu ba ！]

english: It looks vile and smells even worse. You're not eating that!
translation: 它看起来很卑鄙，闻起来更糟糕。你不吃那个！ [ta kan qi lai hen bei bi ， wen qi lai geng zao gao 。 ni bu chi na ge ！]

english: What, are you giving me cooked fish? What am I going to do with that? Uncook it first!
translation: 什么，你给我煮鱼吗？我该怎么办？先把它煮开！ [shen me ， ni gei wo zhu yu ma ？ wo gai zen me ban ？ xian ba ta zhu kai ！]

english: Errr... Uncook it?
translation: 呃……把它煮开吗？ [e …… ba ta zhu kai ma ？]

english: You heard me! There's the cold fire, by the trees, now get uncooking!
translation: 你听到我说的话了！树边有冷火，现在开始做饭吧！ [ni ting dao wo shuo de hua le ！ shu bian you leng huo ， xian zai kai shi zuo fan ba ！]

english: What was this? That was absolutely disgusting!
translation: 这是什么？那真是太恶心了！ [zhe shi shen me ？ na zhen shi tai e xin le ！]

english: Don't you know what kind of fish I like? Talk to my other servants for some advice.
translation: 你不知道我喜欢吃什么鱼吗？向我的其他仆人寻求一些建议。 [ni bu zhi dao wo xi huan chi shen me yu ma ？ xiang wo de qi ta pu ren xun qiu yi xie jian yi 。]

english: Evil Bob seems more attentive of you.
translation: 邪恶的鲍勃似乎更关心你。 [xie e de bao bo si hu geng guan xin ni 。]

english: Mmm, mmm... that's... mmm... delicious...
translation: 嗯，嗯……那是……嗯……好吃…… [n ， n …… na shi …… n …… hao chi ……]

english: Now, let me take... a little... catnap...
translation: 现在，让我……小睡一会儿…… [xian zai ， rang wo …… xiao shui yi hui er ……]

english: ZZZzzz
translation: 噗噗噗 [pu pu pu]

english: Mmm, mmm... that's delicious.
translation: 嗯嗯……真好吃。 [n n …… zhen hao chi 。]

english: Now get me another one, you no good human!
translation: 现在再给我来一份吧，你这不是好人！ [xian zai zai gei wo lai yi fen ba ， ni zhe bu shi hao ren ！]

english: Evil Bob Seems slightly less attentive of you.
translation: 邪恶的鲍勃似乎不太关心你。 [xie e de bao bo si hu bu tai guan xin ni 。]

english: What am I to do with that? Catch me some fish, puny human!
translation: 我该怎么办？给我抓点鱼吧，弱小的人类！ [wo gai zen me ban ？ gei wo zhua dian yu ba ， ruo xiao de ren lei ！]

english: Evil Bob appears to be sleeping, best not to wake him up.
translation: 邪恶鲍勃似乎正在睡觉，最好不要叫醒他。 [xie e bao bo si hu zheng zai shui jiao ， zui hao bu yao jiao xing ta 。]

english: Mew!
translation: 喵！ [miao ！]

english: Yowl!
translation: 号叫！ [hao jiao ！]

english: Meeeow!
translation: 喵呜！ [miao wu ！]

english: Meeeeow!
translation: 喵喵！ [miao miao ！]

english: Meeeeowby laaaater…
translation: Meeeeowby laaaater… [Meeeeowby laaaater…]

english: Yes, that seems like a good idea.
translation: 是的，这似乎是个好主意。 [shi de ， zhe si hu shi ge hao zhu yi 。]

english: No, leave the cat alone.
translation: 不，别管猫了。 [bu ， bie guan mao le 。]

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。 [hao de 。]

english: But I want to leave now.
translation: 但我现在想离开。 [dan wo xian zai xiang li kai 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: But I want to leave now..
translation: 但我现在想离开.. [dan wo xian zai xiang li kai ..]

english: How do I get out of here?
translation: 我怎样才能离开这里？ [wo zen yang cai neng li kai zhe li ？]

english: Okay..
translation: 好的.. [hao de ..]

english: Why not?
translation: 为什么不呢？ [wei shen me bu ne ？]

english: What's it all about?
translation: 这是怎么回事？ [zhe shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: How is it possible that you're talking?
translation: 你怎么可能在说话？ [ni zen me ke neng zai shuo hua ？]

english: What did you do to Bob?
translation: 你对鲍勃做了什么？ [ni dui bao bo zuo le shen me ？]

english: Bwaaaaaauk bwuk bwuk
translation: 哇啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊 [wa a a a a a a a a a a a a]

english: Bwuk
translation: 布克 [bu ke]

english: Bwuk bwuk bwuk
translation: 布克布克布克 [bu ke bu ke bu ke]

english: Flee from me, [player name]!
translation: 逃离我吧，[玩家名字]！ [tao li wo ba ，[ wan jia ming zi ]！]

english: Begone, [player name]!
translation: 走开，[玩家名字]！ [zou kai ，[ wan jia ming zi ]！]

english: MUAHAHAHAHAAA!
translation: 哈哈哈哈哈哈！ [ha ha ha ha ha ha ！]

english: How dare you invade my lair! DIE INTRUDER!
translation: 竟然敢闯入我的老巢！入侵者受死！ [jing ran gan chuang ru wo de lao chao ！ ru qin zhe shou si ！]

english: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？ [ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: I want to go through the portal.
translation: 我想通过门户网站。 [wo xiang tong guo men hu wang zhan 。]

english: Go away! This is OUR portal now!
translation: 离开！现在这是我们的门户！ [li kai ！ xian zai zhe shi wo men de men hu ！]

english: I want to join your group.
translation: 我想加入你们的小组。 [wo xiang jia ru ni men de xiao zu 。]

english: Well we do need one more person now, since... um.
translation: 好吧，我们现在确实还需要一个人，因为……嗯。 [hao ba ， wo men xian zai que shi hai xu yao yi ge ren ， yin wei …… n 。]

english: But we're an evil group! To join, you have to be evil!
translation: 但我们是一个邪恶的团体！要加入，你必须是邪恶的！ [dan wo men shi yi ge xie e de tuan ti ！ yao jia ru ， ni bi xu shi xie e de ！]

english: I'm evil!
translation: 我是邪恶的！ [wo shi xie e de ！]

english: Yeah, I can see that. That outfit is totally evil!
translation: 是的，我看得出来。这身衣服简直就是邪恶啊！ [shi de ， wo kan de chu lai 。 zhe shen yi fu jian zhi jiu shi xie e a ！]

english: And I love that evil black sword!
translation: 我喜欢那把邪恶的黑剑！ [wo xi huan na ba xie e de hei jian ！]

english: Okay, I'll take you through to see Denath.
translation: 好的，我带你去见迪纳斯。 [hao de ， wo dai ni qu jian di na si 。]

english: Evil Dave escorts you into the demonic throne room.
translation: 邪恶的戴夫护送你进入恶魔王座室。 [xie e de dai fu hu song ni jin ru e mo wang zuo shi 。]

english: Master! This person wants to join us!
translation: 掌握！这个人想加入我们！ [zhang wo ！ zhe ge ren xiang jia ru wo men ！]

english: Indeed? Well we are one wizard short since Josef ran away. Can you vouch for him?
translation: 的确？好吧，自从约瑟夫逃跑后我们就少了一名巫师。你能为他担保吗？ [di que ？ hao ba ， zi cong yue se fu tao pao hou wo men jiu shao le yi ming wu shi 。 ni neng wei ta dan bao ma ？]

english: Yeah! He's totally evil!
translation: 是的！他完全是邪恶的！ [shi de ！ ta wan quan shi xie e de ！]

english: Thank you, Dave.
translation: 谢谢你，戴夫。 [xie xie ni ， dai fu 。]

english: Never mind, I'm not evil.
translation: 没关系，我又不是坏人。 [mei guan xi ， wo you bu shi huai ren 。]

english: Well get out of our evil temple then!
translation: 那么就离开我们邪恶的神庙吧！ [na me jiu li kai wo men xie e de shen miao ba ！]

english: Oh, nothing.
translation: 哦，没什么。 [o ， mei shen me 。]

english: Go away then!
translation: 那就走开吧！ [na jiu zou kai ba ！]

english: Where did you get those robes?
translation: 你从哪里得到这些长袍的？ [ni cong na li de dao zhe xie chang pao de ？]

english: Yeah, evil, aren't they? One of the group made them. He said he found some mushrooms in the ruins that could dye things really black.
translation: 是啊，邪恶，不是吗？其中一个小组制作了它们。他说他在废墟中发现了一些蘑菇，可以把东西染成黑色。 [shi a ， xie e ， bu shi ma ？ qi zhong yi ge xiao zu zhi zuo le ta men 。 ta shuo ta zai fei xu zhong fa xian le yi xie mo gu ， ke yi ba dong xi ran cheng hei se 。]

english: Eric's dead! Agrith-Naar killed him! That's EVIL!
translation: 埃里克死了！阿格里斯-纳尔杀了他！那是邪恶的！ [ai li ke si le ！ a ge li si - na er sha le ta ！ na shi xie e de ！]

english: I mean, it's bad! In a BAD way!
translation: 我的意思是，这很糟糕！以一种糟糕的方式！ [wo de yi si shi ， zhe hen zao gao ！ yi yi zhong zao gao de fang shi ！]

english: What happened?
translation: 发生了什么？ [fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: The ceiling collapsed without warning! When I moved towards the staircase the walls started to shake.
translation: 天花板毫无预兆地倒塌了！当我走向楼梯时，墙壁开始摇晃。 [tian hua ban hao wu yu zhao di dao ta le ！ dang wo zou xiang lou ti shi ， qiang bi kai shi yao huang 。]

english: I'm scared of what will happen to me if I try to leave!
translation: 我害怕如果我试图离开会发生什么事！ [wo hai pa ru guo wo shi tu li kai hui fa sheng shen me shi ！]

english: By using 'evil' as a term of praise you have left yourself without a word to describe real evil!
translation: 用“邪恶”作为赞美词，你就已经无法用任何词来形容真正的邪恶了！ [yong “ xie e ” zuo wei zan mei ci ， ni jiu yi jing wu fa yong ren he ci lai xing rong zhen zheng de xie e le ！]

english: There's no time for that! Eric's DEAD!
translation: 没时间这么做了！埃里克死了！ [mei shi jian zhe me zuo le ！ ai li ke si le ！]

english: You've got to get back to the throne room!
translation: 你必须回到王座室！ [ni bi xu hui dao wang zuo shi ！]

english: But the portal is closing! We'll be trapped!
translation: 但传送门即将关闭！我们会被困住的！ [dan chuan song men ji jiang guan bi ！ wo men hui bei kun zhu de ！]

english: Our only hope is to summon Agrith-Naar again so I can kill him! But I need eight people.
translation: 我们唯一的希望就是再次召唤阿格里斯纳尔，这样我就可以杀死他！但我需要八个人。 [wo men wei yi de xi wang jiu shi zai ci zhao huan a ge li si na er ， zhe yang wo jiu ke yi sha si ta ！ dan wo xu yao ba ge ren 。]

english: You can kill him?
translation: 你能杀掉他吗？ [ni neng sha diao ta ma ？]

english: You'd better take this then. It was Eric's sigil. Everyone in the ritual will need one!
translation: 那你最好把这个拿走。这是埃里克的徽章。仪式中的每个人都需要一个！ [na ni zui hao ba zhe ge na zou 。 zhe shi ai li ke de hui zhang 。 yi shi zhong de mei ge ren dou xu yao yi ge ！]

english: Welcome to my BASEMENT OF DOOM!
translation: 欢迎来到我的《末日地下室》！ [huan ying lai dao wo de 《 mo ri di xia shi 》！]

english: What did you eat at the secret council meeting?
translation: 秘密会议上你吃了什么？ [mi mi hui yi shang ni chi le shen me ？]

english: Hey, the council meeting! They wanted me to be their evil representative! That proves I'm a great dark wizard! Right?
translation: 嘿，理事会会议！他们要我当他们的邪恶代表！这证明我是一个伟大的黑巫师！正确的？ [hei ， li shi hui hui yi ！ ta men yao wo dang ta men de xie e dai biao ！ zhe zheng ming wo shi yi ge wei da de hei wu shi ！ zheng que de ？]

english: Right...
translation: 正确的... [zheng que de ...]

english: But anyway, why do you want to know what I ate?
translation: 但无论如何，你为什么想知道我吃了什么？ [dan wu lun ru he ， ni wei shen me xiang zhi dao wo chi le shen me ？]

english: I need to make that exact food in order to save you from the culinomancer's spell.
translation: 我需要制作精确的食物才能将你从烹饪法师的咒语中拯救出来。 [wo xu yao zhi zuo jing que de shi wu cai neng jiang ni cong peng ren fa shi de zhou yu zhong zheng jiu chu lai 。]

english: What? But that was last week! You've already saved me!
translation: 什么？但那是上周的事了！你已经救了我了！ [shen me ？ dan na shi shang zhou de shi le ！ ni yi jing jiu le wo le ！]

english: Sort of, it's complicated. It works like this...
translation: 有点复杂。它的工作原理是这样的... [you dian fu za 。 ta de gong zuo yuan li shi zhe yang de ...]

english: Although you're here, you're also still in the time freeze.
translation: 虽然你在这里，但你仍然处于时间冻结之中。 [sui ran ni zai zhe li ， dan ni reng ran chu yu shi jian dong jie zhi zhong 。]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: I mean, the whole room was frozen in time at the moment the culinomancer cast his spell, right?
translation: 我的意思是，在烹饪师施展咒语的那一刻，整个房间都被冻结了，对吧？ [wo de yi si shi ， zai peng ren shi shi zhan zhou yu de na yi ke ， zheng ge fang jian dou bei dong jie le ， dui ba ？]

english: What? I didn't notice anything.
translation: 什么？ I didn't notice anything. [shen me ？ I didn't notice anything.]

english: Of course you didn't! You were frozen!
translation: 你当然没有！你被冻住了！ [ni dang ran mei you ！ ni bei dong zhu le ！]

english: So how can I be there and also here? Which one is me?
translation: 那么我怎样才能既在那里又在这里呢？哪一个是我？ [na me wo zen yang cai neng ji zai na li you zai zhe li ne ？ na yi ge shi wo ？]

english: I mean, I feel like I'm me, but what if I'm not me?
translation: 我的意思是，我觉得我就是我，但如果我不是我怎么办？ [wo de yi si shi ， wo jue de wo jiu shi wo ， dan ru guo wo bu shi wo zen me ban ？]

english: That would be terrible!
translation: 那太可怕了！ [na tai ke pa le ！]

english: They're both you!
translation: 他们都是你！ [ta men dou shi ni ！]

english: How does that work?
translation: 这是如何运作的？ [zhe shi ru he yun zuo de ？]

english: From YOUR point of view I've saved you, but from MINE I haven't.
translation: 从你的角度来看我救了你，但从我的角度来看我没有。 [cong ni de jiao du lai kan wo jiu le ni ， dan cong wo de jiao du lai kan wo mei you 。]

english: Well that's all right, as long as I'm saved from my point of view!
translation: 好吧，只要从我的角度来看我得救了就可以了！ [hao ba ， zhi yao cong wo de jiao du lai kan wo de jiu le jiu ke yi le ！]

english: But I have to save you, otherwise you won't be saved!
translation: 但我必须救你，否则你就救不了了！ [dan wo bi xu jiu ni ， fou ze ni jiu jiu bu liao le ！]

english: But I'm here so you must already have saved me!
translation: 但我在这里，所以你一定已经救了我！ [dan wo zai zhe li ， suo yi ni yi ding yi jing jiu le wo ！]

english: That's what I meant, from your point of view I've saved you but from mine I haven't!
translation: 这就是我的意思，从你的角度来看我救了你，但从我的角度来看我没有！ [zhe jiu shi wo de yi si ， cong ni de jiao du lai kan wo jiu le ni ， dan cong wo de jiao du lai kan wo mei you ！]

english: I've to take the food back in time to give it to you.
translation: 我得及时把食物拿回来给你。 [wo de ji shi ba shi wu na hui lai gei ni 。]

english: Why?
translation: 为什么？ [wei shen me ？]

english: Because otherwise you won't be saved from the culinomancer's spell.
translation: 因为否则你就无法摆脱烹饪法师的咒语。 [yin wei fou ze ni jiu wu fa bai tuo peng ren fa shi de zhou yu 。]

english: But I was saved from the spell! I remember it!
translation: 但我被从咒语中救了出来！我记住了！ [dan wo bei cong zhou yu zhong jiu le chu lai ！ wo ji zhu le ！]

english: Exactly! That's why I know I have to go back and save you!
translation: 确切地！所以我知道我必须回去救你！ [que qie di ！ suo yi wo zhi dao wo bi xu hui qu jiu ni ！]

english: What will happen if you don't?
translation: 如果你不这样做会发生什么？ [ru guo ni bu zhe yang zuo hui fa sheng shen me ？]

english: I can't not, because I already have!
translation: 我不能不，因为我已经拥有了！ [wo bu neng bu ， yin wei wo yi jing yong you le ！]

english: The fact that you're here means I already did save you, which means that you have to tell me the correct recipe. It's logically impossible for you not to!
translation: 你在这里就意味着我已经救了你，这意味着你必须告诉我正确的食谱。从逻辑上讲，你不可能不这样做！ [ni zai zhe li jiu yi wei zhe wo yi jing jiu le ni ， zhe yi wei zhe ni bi xu gao su wo zheng que de shi pu 。 cong luo ji shang jiang ， ni bu ke neng bu zhe yang zuo ！]

english: I don't understand this at all.
translation: 我完全不明白这一点。 [wo wan quan bu ming bai zhe yi dian 。]

english: There will be a temporal paradox and the universe will implode!
translation: 将会出现时间悖论，宇宙将会崩溃！ [jiang hui chu xian shi jian bei lun ， yu zhou jiang hui beng kui ！]

english: Oh no! That would be bad, and not even in an evil way!
translation: 哦不！那会很糟糕，甚至不是以一种邪恶的方式！ [o bu ！ na hui hen zao gao ， shen zhi bu shi yi yi zhong xie e de fang shi ！]

english: Exactly! So you've got to tell me the recipe!
translation: 确切地！所以你必须告诉我食谱！ [que qie di ！ suo yi ni bi xu gao su wo shi pu ！]

english: But I still don't understand why you need the recipe when you've already saved me!
translation: 但我还是不明白，既然你已经救了我，为什么还需要食谱！ [dan wo hai shi bu ming bai ， ji ran ni yi jing jiu le wo ， wei shen me hai xu yao shi pu ！]

english: I don't know.
translation: 我不知道。 [wo bu zhi dao 。]

english: That's not very helpful. I don't even understand why you need the recipe anyway.
translation: 这不是很有帮助。我什至不明白你为什么需要食谱。 [zhe bu shi hen you bang zhu 。 wo shen zhi bu ming bai ni wei shen me xu yao shi pu 。]

english: All right! Now that makes perfect sense!
translation: 好的！现在这是完全有道理的！ [hao de ！ xian zai zhe shi wan quan you dao li de ！]

english: So what was it?
translation: 那是什么？ [na shi shen me ？]

english: What was what?
translation: 什么是什么？ [shen me shi shen me ？]

english: The food you ate at the council meeting.
translation: 您在理事会会议上吃的食物。 [nin zai li shi hui hui yi shang chi de shi wu 。]

english: It was, like, this totally evil stew!
translation: 就像是这道完全邪恶的炖菜！ [jiu xiang shi zhe dao wan quan xie e de dun cai ！]

english: Evil stew? How was it evil?
translation: 邪恶的炖菜？怎么就邪恶了呢？ [xie e de dun cai ？ zen me jiu xie e le ne ？]

english: Well, it kind of tasted evil, you know? You know, how you taste something and you think, that's really EVIL?
translation: 好吧，它尝起来有点邪恶，你知道吗？你知道，当你尝到某种东西时，你会想，那真的很邪恶吗？ [hao ba ， ta chang qi lai you dian xie e ， ni zhi dao ma ？ ni zhi dao ， dang ni chang dao mou zhong dong xi shi ， ni hui xiang ， na zhen de hen xie e ma ？]

english: I think you're mixing up 'good' and 'evil' again!
translation: 我认为你又混淆了‘善’和‘恶’！ [wo ren wei ni you hun xiao le ‘ shan ’ he ‘ e ’！]

english: What? Well, I'm evil, and I only like evil stuff, and I liked that, so it must be evil. Right?
translation: 什么？嗯，我是邪恶的，我只喜欢邪恶的东西，而且我喜欢那个，所以它一定是邪恶的。正确的？ [shen me ？ n ， wo shi xie e de ， wo zhi xi huan xie e de dong xi ， er qie wo xi huan na ge ， suo yi ta yi ding shi xie e de 。 zheng que de ？]

english: I suppose that makes some kind of sense. But I need to reproduce this stew, so can you describe it in more detail?
translation: 我想这有一定道理。但我需要重现这个炖菜，所以你能更详细地描述它吗？ [wo xiang zhe you yi ding dao li 。 dan wo xu yao chong xian zhe ge dun cai ， suo yi ni neng geng xiang xi di miao shu ta ma ？]

english: Well it tasted like the stews my mum makes. She puts these spices in them. But it was like she'd got the amounts totally right this time.
translation: 嗯，味道就像我妈妈做的炖菜。她把这些香料放进去。但这次她的金额似乎完全正确。 [n ， wei dao jiu xiang wo ma ma zuo de dun cai 。 ta ba zhe xie xiang liao fang jin qu 。 dan zhe ci ta de jin e si hu wan quan zheng que 。]

english: Okay, I'd better talk to your mum.
translation: 好吧，我最好和你妈妈谈谈。 [hao ba ， wo zui hao he ni ma ma tan tan 。]

english: Oh, never mind.
translation: 哦，没关系。 [o ， mei guan xi 。]

english: That's nothing like the stew I tasted. All the spices are wrong.
translation: 这和我尝到的炖菜一点也不像。所有的香料都错了。 [zhe he wo chang dao de dun cai yi dian ye bu xiang 。 suo you de xiang liao dou cuo le 。]

english: Hmm... I think you've got the amount of one spice right, but the others are wrong.
translation: 嗯...我认为你对一种香料的用量是正确的，但其他香料的用量是错误的。 [n ... wo ren wei ni dui yi zhong xiang liao de yong liang shi zheng que de ， dan qi ta xiang liao de yong liang shi cuo wu de 。]

english: That stew is pretty evil! But I think one of the spices is still a bit wrong.
translation: 这炖菜真是太邪恶了！但我觉得其中一种香料还是有点不对劲。 [zhe dun cai zhen shi tai xie e le ！ dan wo jue de qi zhong yi zhong xiang liao hai shi you dian bu dui jin 。]

english: You've got the amount of two of the spices right, but two of them are wrong.
translation: 你的两种香料的用量是正确的，但其中两种是错误的。 [ni de liang zhong xiang liao de yong liang shi zheng que de ， dan qi zhong liang zhong shi cuo wu de 。]

english: TOTALLY EVIL! That's EXACTLY how the stew tasted!
translation: 完全邪恶！这正是炖菜的味道！ [wan quan xie e ！ zhe zheng shi dun cai de wei dao ！]

english: Don't eat it all!
translation: 别全部吃掉！ [bie quan bu chi diao ！]

english: Now I just have to go back in time and give it to your earlier self!
translation: 现在我只需要回到过去，把它还给以前的你！ [xian zai wo zhi xu yao hui dao guo qu ， ba ta huan gei yi qian de ni ！]

english: What? Why can't I eat it?
translation: 什么？为什么我不能吃它？ [shen me ？ wei shen me wo bu neng chi ta ？]

english: You've already eaten it! This is the stew that you remember tasting in the first place!
translation: 你已经吃过了！这就是你记得第一次尝到的炖菜！ [ni yi jing chi guo le ！ zhe jiu shi ni ji de di yi ci chang dao de dun cai ！]

english: So confused...
translation: 好困惑…… [hao kun huo ……]

english: Woah, what happened?
translation: 哇哦，发生什么事了？ [wa o ， fa sheng shen me shi le ？]

english: I've just saved you from a buffet worse than death!
translation: 我刚刚把你从一场生不如死的自助餐中救了出来！ [wo gang gang ba ni cong yi chang sheng bu ru si de zi zhu can zhong jiu le chu lai ！]

english: Hey, this is pretty evil stew!
translation: 嘿，这真是邪恶的炖菜！ [hei ， zhe zhen shi xie e de dun cai ！]

english: Yes. Now it's very important you remember what the stew tasted like!
translation: 是的。现在记住炖菜的味道非常重要！ [shi de 。 xian zai ji zhu dun cai de wei dao fei chang zhong yao ！]

english: Because... it just is!
translation: 因为……就是这样！ [yin wei …… jiu shi zhe yang ！]

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。 [hao de 。]

english: Nice basement!
translation: 不错的地下室！ [bu cuo de di xia shi ！]

english: Nice?!
translation: 好的？！ [hao de ？！]

english: I mean, evil!
translation: 我的意思是，邪恶！ [wo de yi si shi ， xie e ！]

english: Yeah! I'm going to use it to summon DEMONS to DO MY BIDDING, or raise an ARMY OF THE UNDEAD! And then I'm going to totally, like, take over the world!
translation: 是的！我将用它来召唤恶魔来执行我的命令，或者组建一支亡灵大军！然后我就会完全接管世界！ [shi de ！ wo jiang yong ta lai zhao huan e mo lai zhi xing wo de ming ling ， huo zhe zu jian yi zhi wang ling da jun ！ ran hou wo jiu hui wan quan jie guan shi jie ！]

english: Ah-ha-ha-ha-ha-haa!
translation: 啊哈哈哈哈哈哈！ [a ha ha ha ha ha ha ！]

english: So have you had any luck with the demon-summoning?
translation: 那么你召唤恶魔的运气好吗？ [na me ni zhao huan e mo de yun qi hao ma ？]

english: Well, I thought I should start small, so I asked Wizard Grayzag for some help with summoning imps...
translation: 好吧，我想我应该从小做起，所以我向格雷扎格巫师寻求一些召唤小鬼的帮助...... [hao ba ， wo xiang wo ying gai cong xiao zuo qi ， suo yi wo xiang ge lei zha ge wu shi xun qiu yi xie zhao huan xiao gui de bang zhu ......]

english: And did you manage to summon any?
translation: 你成功召唤出任何人了吗？ [ni cheng gong zhao huan chu ren he ren le ma ？]

english: Well, not imps, exactly. It turns out they're not the lowest form of demon after all. I got these hell-rats.
translation: 嗯，确切地说，不是小鬼。事实证明，他们毕竟不是最低等的恶魔。我得到了这些地狱老鼠。 [n ， que qie di shuo ， bu shi xiao gui 。 shi shi zheng ming ， ta men bi jing bu shi zui di deng de e mo 。 wo de dao le zhe xie di yu lao shu 。]

english: They're hardly evil at all! They're just like regular rats only they smell vaguely of sulphur!
translation: 他们根本就不是邪恶的！它们就像普通的老鼠一样，只是闻起来隐隐约约有硫磺味！ [ta men gen ben jiu bu shi xie e de ！ ta men jiu xiang pu tong de lao shu yi yang ， zhi shi wen qi lai yin yin yue yue you liu huang wei ！]

english: See you later!
translation: 稍后见！ [shao hou jian ！]

english: If my ARMY OF DARKNESS doesn't get you first!
translation: 如果我的黑暗军团没有先抓住你！ [ru guo wo de hei an jun tuan mei you xian zhua zhu ni ！]

english: Soon you will return to bow before my EVIL THRONE!
translation: 很快你就会回到我的邪恶王座前鞠躬！ [hen kuai ni jiu hui hui dao wo de xie e wang zuo qian ju gong ！]

english: If you can find your way out of my BASEMENT OF DOOM!
translation: 如果你能找到逃离我的末日地下室的出路！ [ru guo ni neng zhao dao tao li wo de mo ri di xia shi de chu lu ！]

english: And together we will lead Gielinor into a NEW DARK AGE!
translation: 我们将共同带领 Gielinor 进入一个新的黑暗时代！ [wo men jiang gong tong dai ling  Gielinor  jin ru yi ge xin de hei an shi dai ！]

english: Of course you will return! There is no escape from my DARK POWER!
translation: 你当然会回来！我的黑暗力量无法逃脱！ [ni dang ran hui hui lai ！ wo de hei an li liang wu fa tao tuo ！]

english: Weren't you going to give up evil?
translation: 难道你不打算放弃邪恶吗？ [nan dao ni bu da suan fang qi xie e ma ？]

english: Yeah, well...
translation: 是啊，嗯…… [shi a ， n ……]

english: I did try. I wore this bright red jumper and I got up in the morning and spent the day outside in the sunshine...
translation: 我确实尝试过。我穿着这件鲜红色的毛衣，早上起床，在外面的阳光下度过了一天...... [wo que shi chang shi guo 。 wo chuan zhe zhe jian xian hong se de mao yi ， zao shang qi chuang ， zai wai mian de yang guang xia du guo le yi tian ......]

english: *Dave shudders*
translation: *戴夫颤抖* [* dai fu chan dou *]

english: But I couldn't keep it up. I just didn't find anything good very interesting, you know?
translation: 但我无法坚持下去。我只是没有发现任何有趣的好东西，你知道吗？ [dan wo wu fa jian chi xia qu 。 wo zhi shi mei you fa xian ren he you qu de hao dong xi ， ni zhi dao ma ？]

english: Sometimes I worry about the consequences of evil. I don't really want anyone to get hurt, not like what happened with Denath.
translation: 有时我担心邪恶的后果。我真的不想让任何人受到伤害，就像德纳斯发生的那样。 [you shi wo dan xin xie e de hou guo 。 wo zhen de bu xiang rang ren he ren shou dao shang hai ， jiu xiang de na si fa sheng de na yang 。]

english: But I can't not be evil! It's just who I am!
translation: 但我不能不作恶！这就是我！ [dan wo bu neng bu zuo e ！ zhe jiu shi wo ！]

english: Let me try to explain the time travel thing again...
translation: 让我再次尝试解释一下时间旅行的事情...... [rang wo zai ci chang shi jie shi yi xia shi jian lv xing de shi qing ......]

english: I mean, the whole room was frozen in time at the moment the culinomancercast his spell, right?
translation: 我的意思是，在烹饪法师施展咒语的那一刻，整个房间都被冻结了，对吗？ [wo de yi si shi ， zai peng ren fa shi shi zhan zhou yu de na yi ke ， zheng ge fang jian dou bei dong jie le ， dui ma ？]

english: Because otherwise you won't be saved from the culinomancer'sspell.
translation: 因为否则你就无法摆脱烹饪法师的咒语。 [yin wei fou ze ni jiu wu fa bai tuo peng ren fa shi de zhou yu 。]

english: You've got to tell me because the magic requires it!
translation: 你必须告诉我，因为魔法需要它！ [ni bi xu gao su wo ， yin wei mo fa xu yao ta ！]

english: That's what you said before! Honestly, why make it more complicated than it needs to be?
translation: 这就是你之前说的！老实说，为什么要让它变得比需要的更复杂呢？ [zhe jiu shi ni zhi qian shuo de ！ lao shi shuo ， wei shen me yao rang ta bian de bi xu yao de geng fu za ne ？]

english: Ah! Here you go!
translation: 啊!干得好！ [a ! gan de hao ！]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: I need you to answer this for me.
translation: 我需要你帮我回答这个问题。 [wo xu yao ni bang wo hui da zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Evil Dave has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 邪恶戴夫给了你一个挑战卷轴！ [xie e dai fu gei le ni yi ge tiao zhan juan zhou ！]

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。 [qing shu ru wen ti de da an 。]

english: That is not the evil answer I requested!
translation: 这不是我要求的邪恶答案！ [zhe bu shi wo yao qiu de xie e da an ！]

english: Spot on!
translation: 现货！ [xian huo ！]

english: Evil Dave has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
translation: 邪恶的戴夫给了你[另一个线索卷轴/一个棺材]！ [xie e de dai fu gei le ni [ ling yi ge xian suo juan zhou / yi ge guan cai ]！]

english: I want to go through the portal.
translation: 我想通过门户网站。 [wo xiang tong guo men hu wang zhan 。]

english: I want to join your group.
translation: 我想加入你们的小组。 [wo xiang jia ru ni men de xiao zu 。]

english: I'm evil!
translation: 我是邪恶的！ [wo shi xie e de ！]

english: Never mind, I'm not evil.
translation: 没关系，我又不是坏人。 [mei guan xi ， wo you bu shi huai ren 。]

english: Oh, nothing.
translation: 哦，没什么。 [o ， mei shen me 。]

english: Where did you get those robes?
translation: 你从哪里得到这些长袍的？ [ni cong na li de dao zhe xie chang pao de ？]

english: What happened?
translation: 发生了什么？ [fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: By using 'evil' as a term of praise...
translation: 用“邪恶”作为褒义词…… [yong “ xie e ” zuo wei bao yi ci ……]

english: You've got to get back to the throne room!
translation: 你必须回到王座室！ [ni bi xu hui dao wang zuo shi ！]

english: What did you eat at the secret council meeting?
translation: 秘密会议上你吃了什么？ [mi mi hui yi shang ni chi le shen me ？]

english: Although you're here, you're also still in the time freeze.
translation: 虽然你在这里，但你仍然处于时间冻结之中。 [sui ran ni zai zhe li ， dan ni reng ran chu yu shi jian dong jie zhi zhong 。]

english: From YOUR point of view I've saved you, but from MINE I haven't.
translation: 从你的角度来看我救了你，但从我的角度来看我没有。 [cong ni de jiao du lai kan wo jiu le ni ， dan cong wo de jiao du lai kan wo mei you 。]

english: I've got to take the food back in time to give it to you.
translation: 我得及时把食物拿回来给你。 [wo de ji shi ba shi wu na hui lai gei ni 。]

english: I can't not, I already have!
translation: 我不能不，我已经有了！ [wo bu neng bu ， wo yi jing you le ！]

english: There will be a temporal paradox and the universe will implode!
translation: 将会出现时间悖论，宇宙将会崩溃！ [jiang hui chu xian shi jian bei lun ， yu zhou jiang hui beng kui ！]

english: I don't know
translation: 我不知道 [wo bu zhi dao]

english: You've got to tell me because the magic requires it!
translation: 你必须告诉我，因为魔法需要它！ [ni bi xu gao su wo ， yin wei mo fa xu yao ta ！]

english: Oh, never mind.
translation: 哦，没关系。 [o ， mei guan xi 。]

english: Nice basement!
translation: 不错的地下室！ [bu cuo de di xia shi ！]

english: So have you had any luck with the demon-summoning?
translation: 那么你召唤恶魔的运气好吗？ [na me ni zhao huan e mo de yun qi hao ma ？]

english: Weren't you going to give up evil?
translation: 难道你不打算放弃邪恶吗？ [nan dao ni bu da suan fang qi xie e ma ？]

english: See you later.
translation: 稍后见。 [shao hou jian 。]

english: Let me try to explain the time travel thing again...
translation: 让我再次尝试解释一下时间旅行的事情...... [rang wo zai ci chang shi jie shi yi xia shi jian lv xing de shi qing ......]

english: Are you a cook? I need more staff.
translation: 你是厨师吗？我需要更多员工。 [ni shi chu shi ma ？ wo xu yao geng duo yuan gong 。]

english: What's going on here?
translation: 这是怎么回事？ [zhe shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: This is the Hosidius Mess. It was set up to help feed the soldiers from the Shayzien Encampment. Much better than anything they can cook over there.
translation: 这是霍西迪乌斯混乱。它的设立是为了帮助 Shayzien 营地的士兵提供食物。比他们在那里做的任何东西都要好得多。 [zhe shi huo xi di wu si hun luan 。 ta de she li shi wei le bang zhu  Shayzien  ying di di shi bing ti gong shi wu 。 bi ta men zai na li zuo de ren he dong xi dou yao hao de duo 。]

english: How come it's so far from Hosidius?
translation: 怎么离霍西迪乌斯这么远？ [zen me li huo xi di wu si zhe me yuan ？]

english: The solders do enough hard work, so it seemed only right not to make them walk all the way across Kourend for a bit of food.
translation: 焊兵们干的活已经够辛苦的了，所以不让他们为了一点食物而一路穿过库伦德似乎是正确的选择。 [han bing men gan de huo yi jing gou xin ku de le ， suo yi bu rang ta men wei le yi dian shi wu er yi lu chuan guo ku lun de si hu shi zheng que de xuan ze 。]

english: Anyway, enough chatting. Are you a cook?
translation: 无论如何，聊够了。你是厨师吗？ [wu lun ru he ， liao gou le 。 ni shi chu shi ma ？]

english: Yeah, I can do some cooking. Well, my level's [number<20], anyway.
translation: 是的，我可以做饭。好吧，无论如何，我的等级是[number<20]。 [shi de ， wo ke yi zuo fan 。 hao ba ， wu lun ru he ， wo de deng ji shi [number<20]。]

english: Hah! You'll need a level of 20 to cook anything for these soldiers. They're picky about what they eat.
translation: 哈！你需要达到 20 级才能为这些士兵做饭。他们对吃的东西很挑剔。 [ha ！ ni xu yao da dao  20  ji cai neng wei zhe xie shi bing zuo fan 。 ta men dui chi de dong xi hen tiao ti 。]

english: Yeah, I can do some cooking.
translation: 是的，我可以做饭。 [shi de ， wo ke yi zuo fan 。]

english: Good. When you've got more Hosidius favour, come back and I'll have plenty for you to do.
translation: 好的。当你得到霍西迪乌斯更多的青睐时，回来吧，我有很多事等着你去做。 [hao de 。 dang ni de dao huo xi di wu si geng duo de qing lai shi ， hui lai ba ， wo you hen duo shi deng zhe ni qu zuo 。]

english: Good. The soldiers like stew, meat pies and pineapple pizza. You'll find ingredients in the cupboards.
translation: 好的。士兵们喜欢炖菜、肉馅饼和菠萝披萨。你会在橱柜里找到配料。 [hao de 。 shi bing men xi huan dun cai 、 rou xian bing he bo luo pi sa 。 ni hui zai chu gui li zhao dao pei liao 。]

english: When you've made something, put it on the buffet tables, and you'll gain experience based on how much the soldiers appreciate them.
translation: 当你做了一些东西，把它放在自助餐桌上，你就会根据士兵们的欣赏程度获得经验。 [dang ni zuo le yi xie dong xi ， ba ta fang zai zi zhu can zhuo shang ， ni jiu hui gen ju shi bing men de xin shang cheng du huo de jing yan 。]

english: No, I'm off.
translation: 不，我走了。 [bu ， wo zou le 。]

english: You're not authorised to work in my kitchen.
translation: 你无权在我的厨房工作。 [ni wu quan zai wo de chu fang gong zuo 。]

english: They're not going to eat anything you've got there. Make them meat pies, stew or pineapple pizza.
translation: 他们不会吃你那里的任何东西。把它们做成肉馅饼、炖菜或菠萝披萨。 [ta men bu hui chi ni na li de ren he dong xi 。 ba ta men zuo cheng rou xian bing 、 dun cai huo bo luo pi sa 。]

english: Hey, that's not for you!
translation: 嘿，那不适合你！ [hei ， na bu shi he ni ！]

english: They're not going to eat that. Use the ingredients provided here.
translation: 他们不会吃那个。使用此处提供的成分。 [ta men bu hui chi na ge 。 shi yong ci chu ti gong de cheng fen 。]

english: They're not going to eat that. Make them meat pies, stew or pineapple pizza.
translation: 他们不会吃那个。把它们做成肉馅饼、炖菜或菠萝披萨。 [ta men bu hui chi na ge 。 ba ta men zuo cheng rou xian bing 、 dun cai huo bo luo pi sa 。]

english: Here you go.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: Hey, I have something for you but you don't have any space for it!
translation: 嘿，我有东西给你，但你没有地方放！ [hei ， wo you dong xi gei ni ， dan ni mei you di fang fang ！]

english: What's going on here?
translation: 这是怎么回事？ [zhe shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: Yeah, I can do some cooking.
translation: 是的，我可以做饭。 [shi de ， wo ke yi zuo fan 。]

english: No, I'm off.
translation: 不，我走了。 [bu ， wo zou le 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Ah hello there! I am the resident lecturer on antiquities and artefacts. I also set the Earth Sciences exams.
translation: 啊你好！我是古物和文物的常驻讲师。我还安排了地球科学考试。 [a ni hao ！ wo shi gu wu he wen wu de chang zhu jiang shi 。 wo hai an pai le di qiu ke xue kao shi 。]

english: Earth Sciences?
translation: 地球科学？ [di qiu ke xue ？]

english: That is right dear, the world of Gielinor holds many wonders beneath its surface. Students come to me to take exams so that they may join in on the archaeological dig going on just north of here.
translation: 没错，亲爱的，吉林诺的世界在其表面之下蕴藏着许多奇迹。学生们来找我参加考试，以便他们可以参加这里北部正在进行的考古挖掘。 [mei cuo ， qin ai de ， ji lin nuo de shi jie zai qi biao mian zhi xia yun cang zhe xu duo qi ji 。 xue sheng men lai zhao wo can jia kao shi ， yi bian ta men ke yi can jia zhe li bei bu zheng zai jin xing de kao gu wa jue 。]

english: So if they don't pass the exams they can't dig at all?
translation: 那么如果他们没有通过考试就根本无法挖掘吗？ [na me ru guo ta men mei you tong guo kao shi jiu gen ben wu fa wa jue ma ？]

english: That's right! We have to make sure that students know enough to be able to dig safely and not damage the artefacts.
translation: 这是正确的！我们必须确保学生了解足够的知识，能够安全挖掘而不损坏文物。 [zhe shi zheng que de ！ wo men bi xu que bao xue sheng liao jie zu gou de zhi shi ， neng gou an quan wa jue er bu sun huai wen wu 。]

english: Can I take an exam?
translation: 我可以参加考试吗？ [wo ke yi can jia kao shi ma ？]

english: You can if you get this letter stamped by the Curator of Varrock's museum.
translation: 如果您收到瓦罗克博物馆馆长盖章的这封信，就可以。 [ru guo nin shou dao wa luo ke bo wu guan guan zhang gai zhang de zhe feng xin ， jiu ke yi 。]

english: Why's that then?
translation: 那为什么呢？ [na wei shen me ne ？]

english: Because he is a very knowledgeable man and employs our archaeological expert. I'm sure he knows a lot about your exploits and can judge whether you'd make a good archaeologist or not.
translation: 因为他是一个知识渊博的人，并且雇用了我们的考古专家。我确信他对你的功绩了解很多，并且能够判断你是否会成为一名优秀的考古学家。 [yin wei ta shi yi ge zhi shi yuan bo de ren ， bing qie gu yong le wo men de kao gu zhuan jia 。 wo que xin ta dui ni de gong ji liao jie hen duo ， bing qie neng gou pan duan ni shi fou hui cheng wei yi ming you xiu de kao gu xue jia 。]

english: Besides, the museum contributes funds to the dig.
translation: 此外，博物馆还为挖掘工作提供了资金。 [ci wai ， bo wu guan hai wei wa jue gong zuo ti gong le zi jin 。]

english: But why are you writing the letter? Shouldn't he?
translation: 但你为什么要写这封信？他不应该吗？ [dan ni wei shen me yao xie zhe feng xin ？ ta bu ying gai ma ？]

english: He's also a very busy man, so I write the letters and he justs stamps them if he approves.
translation: 他也是一个非常忙碌的人，所以我写信，如果他同意的话，他就会盖章。 [ta ye shi yi ge fei chang mang lu de ren ， suo yi wo xie xin ， ru guo ta tong yi de hua ， ta jiu hui gai zhang 。]

english: Oh, I see. I'll ask him if he'll approve me, and bring my stamped letter back here. Thanks.
translation: 我懂了。我会问他是否同意我，然后把我盖章的信带回来。谢谢。 [wo dong le 。 wo hui wen ta shi fou tong yi wo ， ran hou ba wo gai zhang de xin dai hui lai 。 xie xie 。]

english: Interesting...
translation: 有趣的... [you qu de ...]

english: You could gain much with an understanding of the world below.
translation: 通过了解下面的世界，你可以获得很多东西。 [tong guo liao jie xia mian de shi jie ， ni ke yi huo de hen duo dong xi 。]

english: Hello again.
translation: 又好。 [you hao 。]

english: I am still waiting for your letter of recommendation.
translation: 我还在等你的推荐信。 [wo hai zai deng ni de tui jian xin 。]

english: I have lost the letter you gave me.
translation: 我把你给我的信弄丢了。 [wo ba ni gei wo de xin nong diu le 。]

english: Oh now come on. You have it with you!
translation: 哦，现在来吧。你随身带着它！ [o ， xian zai lai ba 。 ni sui shen dai zhe ta ！]

english: You already have the letter in your bank.
translation: 您的银行已存有这封信。 [nin de yin hang yi cun you zhe feng xin 。]

english: That was foolish. Take this one and don't lose it!
translation: 那太愚蠢了。拿着这个，别弄丢了！ [na tai yu chun le 。 na zhe zhe ge ， bie nong diu le ！]

english: Alright, I'll try and get it.
translation: 好的，我会尝试去获取它。 [hao de ， wo hui chang shi qu huo qu ta 。]

english: I am sure you won't get any problems. Speak to the Curator of Varrock's Museum.
translation: 我相信你不会遇到任何问题。与瓦罗克博物馆的馆长交谈。 [wo xiang xin ni bu hui yu dao ren he wen ti 。 yu wa luo ke bo wu guan de guan zhang jiao tan 。]

english: Hello again. Are you ready for another shot at the exam?
translation: 又好。您准备好再次参加考试了吗？ [you hao 。 nin zhun bei hao zai ci can jia kao shi le ma ？]

english: Yes I certainly am.
translation: 是的，我当然是。 [shi de ， wo dang ran shi 。]

english: You'll need at least two spaces free in your inventory before taking this exam, else you can not be rewarded if you pass!
translation: 在参加考试之前，您的库存中至少需要有两个空闲空间，否则即使您通过了也无法获得奖励！ [zai can jia kao shi zhi qian ， nin de ku cun zhong zhi shao xu yao you liang ge kong xian kong jian ， fou ze ji shi nin tong guo le ye wu fa huo de jiang li ！]

english: Okay, we will start with the first exam: Earth Sciences level 1 - Beginner.
translation: 好的，我们从第一次考试开始：地球科学一级 - 初级。 [hao de ， wo men cong di yi ci kao shi kai shi ： di qiu ke xue yi ji  -  chu ji 。]

english: Question 1 - Earth Sciences overview. Can you tell me what Earth Sciences is?
translation: 问题 1 - 地球科学概述。你能告诉我什么是地球科学吗？ [wen ti  1 -  di qiu ke xue gai shu 。 ni neng gao su wo shen me shi di qiu ke xue ma ？]

english: The study of the earth, its contents and history.
translation: 对地球及其内容和历史的研究。 [dui di qiu ji qi nei rong he li shi de yan jiu 。]

english: The study of planets and the history of worlds.
translation: 对行星和世界历史的研究。 [dui xing xing he shi jie li shi de yan jiu 。]

english: The combination of archaeology and vegetarianism.
translation: 考古学与素食主义的结合。 [kao gu xue yu su shi zhu yi de jie he 。]

english: The study of gardening, planting and fruiting vegetation.
translation: 研究园艺、种植和结果植物。 [yan jiu yuan yi 、 zhong zhi he jie guo zhi wu 。]

english: Okay, next question...
translation: 好吧，下一个问题... [hao ba ， xia yi ge wen ti ...]

english: Earth Sciences level 1, question 2 - Eligibility. Can you tell me which people are allowed to use the digsite?
translation: 地球科学 1 级，问题 2 - 资格。您能告诉我哪些人可以使用该挖掘场吗？ [di qiu ke xue  1  ji ， wen ti  2 -  zi ge 。 nin neng gao su wo na xie ren ke yi shi yong gai wa jue chang ma ？]

english: Professors, students and workmen only.
translation: 仅限教授、学生和工人。 [jin xian jiao shou 、 xue sheng he gong ren 。]

english: Local residents, contractors and small pink fish.
translation: 当地居民、承包商和粉红色的小鱼。 [dang di ju min 、 cheng bao shang he fen hong se de xiao yu 。]

english: All that have passed the appropriate Earth Sciences exam.
translation: 所有这些都通过了适当的地球科学考试。 [suo you zhe xie dou tong guo le shi dang de di qiu ke xue kao shi 。]

english: Magic users, miners and their escorts.
translation: 魔法使用者、矿工和他们的护卫。 [mo fa shi yong zhe 、 kuang gong he ta men de hu wei 。]

english: Earth Sciences level 1, question 3 - Health and safety. Can you tell me the proper safety points when working on a digsite?
translation: 地球科学 1 级，问题 3 - 健康与安全。您能告诉我在挖掘现场工作时应注意的安全事项吗？ [di qiu ke xue  1  ji ， wen ti  3 -  jian kang yu an quan 。 nin neng gao su wo zai wa jue xian chang gong zuo shi ying zhu yi de an quan shi xiang ma ？]

english: Rubber chickens to be worn on the head at all times.
translation: 橡胶鸡始终戴在头上。 [xiang jiao ji shi zhong dai zai tou shang 。]

english: Gloves and boots to be worn at all times; proper tools must be used.
translation: 始终佩戴手套和靴子；必须使用适当的工具。 [shi zhong pei dai shou tao he xue zi ； bi xu shi yong shi dang de gong ju 。]

english: Protective clothing to be worn; tools kept away from site.
translation: 应穿戴防护服；工具远离现场。 [ying chuan dai fang hu fu ； gong ju yuan li xian chang 。]

english: Heat-resistant clothing to be worn at all times.
translation: 始终穿着耐热衣服。 [shi zhong chuan zhe nai re yi fu 。]

english: That concludes the exam for Earth Sciences level 1.
translation: 地球科学 1 级考试到此结束。 [di qiu ke xue  1  ji kao shi dao ci jie shu 。]

english: Let's see how you did...
translation: 让我们看看你是怎么做的... [rang wo men kan kan ni shi zen me zuo de ...]

english: You got all the questions correct. Well done!
translation: 您答对了所有问题。干得好！ [nin da dui le suo you wen ti 。 gan de hao ！]

english: Hey! Excellent!
translation: 嘿！出色的！ [hei ！ chu se de ！]

english: You have now passed the Earth Sciences level 1 general exam. Here is your certificate to prove it. You also get a decent trowel to dig with. Of course, you'll want to get studying for your next exam now!
translation: 您现在已经通过了地球科学 1 级普通考试。这是您的证书来证明这一点。您还可以获得一把像样的抹子来挖掘。当然，您现在就想为下一次考试进行学习！ [nin xian zai yi jing tong guo le di qiu ke xue  1  ji pu tong kao shi 。 zhe shi nin de zheng shu lai zheng ming zhe yi dian 。 nin hai ke yi huo de yi ba xiang yang de mo zi lai wa jue 。 dang ran ， nin xian zai jiu xiang wei xia yi ci kao shi jin xing xue xi ！]

english: You got 2 questions correct. Not bad, just a little more revision needed.
translation: 你答对了 2 个问题。还不错，只是需要再修改一点。 [ni da dui le  2  ge wen ti 。 hai bu cuo ， zhi shi xu yao zai xiu gai yi dian 。]

english: Oh well...
translation: 那好吧... [na hao ba ...]

english: Get out and explore the digsite, talk to people and learn!
translation: 出去探索挖掘现场，与人们交谈并学习！ [chu qu tan suo wa jue xian chang ， yu ren men jiao tan bing xue xi ！]

english: You got 1 question correct. Better luck next time.
translation: 您答对 1 题。下次好运。 [nin da dui  1  ti 。 xia ci hao yun 。]

english: Oh bother!
translation: 哦麻烦了！ [o ma fan le ！]

english: Do some more research. I'm sure other students could help you out.
translation: 多做一些研究。我相信其他同学可以帮助你。 [duo zuo yi xie yan jiu 。 wo xiang xin qi ta tong xue ke yi bang zhu ni 。]

english: Oh deary me! This is appalling, none correct at all! I suggest you go and study properly.
translation: 哦亲爱的我！这太可怕了，根本没有正确的！我建议你好好去学习。 [o qin ai de wo ！ zhe tai ke pa le ， gen ben mei you zheng que de ！ wo jian yi ni hao hao qu xue xi 。]

english: Oh dear...
translation: 哦亲爱的... [o qin ai de ...]

english: Why don't you use the resources here? There are books and the researchers, and you could even ask other students who are also studying for these exams.
translation: 为什么不利用这里的资源呢？有书籍和研究人员，您甚至可以询问也在准备这些考试的其他学生。 [wei shen me bu li yong zhe li de zi yuan ne ？ you shu ji he yan jiu ren yuan ， nin shen zhi ke yi xun wen ye zai zhun bei zhe xie kao shi de qi ta xue sheng 。]

english: No, not at the moment.
translation: 不，目前还不行。 [bu ， mu qian hai bu xing 。]

english: Okay, take your time if you wish.
translation: 好吧，如果你愿意的话，慢慢来吧。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， man man lai ba 。]

english: Hello there! My colleague tells me you helped to uncover a hidden altar to the god Zaros.
translation: 你好呀！我的同事告诉我，你帮助发现了一座供奉扎罗斯神的隐藏祭坛。 [ni hao ya ！ wo de tong shi gao su wo ， ni bang zhu fa xian le yi zuo gong feng zha luo si shen de yin cang ji tan 。]

english: A great scholar and archaeologist indeed! Good health and prosperity to you.
translation: 真是一位伟大的学者和考古学家！祝您身体健康、事业兴旺。 [zhen shi yi wei wei da de xue zhe he kao gu xue jia ！ zhu nin shen ti jian kang 、 shi ye xing wang 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: I have lost my trowel.
translation: 我丢了抹子。 [wo diu le mo zi 。]

english: Deary me... That was a good one as well. It's a good job I have another. Here you go...
translation: 亲爱的我……那也是一件好事。这是一份好工作，我还有另一份工作。干得好... [qin ai de wo …… na ye shi yi jian hao shi 。 zhe shi yi fen hao gong zuo ， wo hai you ling yi fen gong zuo 。 gan de hao ...]

english: Really? Look in your backpack and make sure first.
translation: 真的吗？首先检查一下你的背包。 [zhen de ma ？ shou xian jian cha yi xia ni de bei bao 。]

english: Hi! Please complete this.
translation: 你好！请完成这个。 [ni hao ！ qing wan cheng zhe ge 。]

english: I'm afraid you have not finished the puzzle.
translation: 恐怕你还没有完成拼图。 [kong pa ni hai mei you wan cheng pin tu 。]

english: Correct! Well done!
translation: 正确的！干得好！ [zheng que de ！ gan de hao ！]

english: Can I take an exam?
translation: 我可以参加考试吗？ [wo ke yi can jia kao shi ma ？]

english: Interesting...
translation: 有趣的... [you qu de ...]

translation: 我把你给我的信弄丢了。 [wo ba ni gei wo de xin nong diu le 。]

english: Alright I'll try and get it.
translation: 好吧，我会尝试得到它。 [hao ba ， wo hui chang shi de dao ta 。]

translation: 是的，我当然是。 [shi de ， wo dang ran shi 。]
