translation: 我丢了抹子。 [wo diu le mo zi 。]

english: I lost my weapon fighting the Blue Moon. Could I have it back?
translation: 我在与蓝月的战斗中失去了武器。我可以把它拿回来吗？ [wo zai yu lan yue de zhan dou zhong shi qu le wu qi 。 wo ke yi ba ta na hui lai ma ？]

english: Here you go, iknil.
translation: 给你，伊克尼尔。 [gei ni ， yi ke ni er 。]

english: Eyatalli returns your lost weapon to you.
translation: 埃亚塔利将你丢失的武器归还给你。 [ai ya ta li jiang ni diu shi de wu qi gui huan gei ni 。]

english: I found some essence whilst fighting the lesser nagua.
translation: 我在与小纳瓜战斗时发现了一些本质。 [wo zai yu xiao na gua zhan dou shi fa xian le yi xie ben zhi 。]

english: Thank you, iknil. I shall use it to reinforce the seal.
translation: 谢谢你，伊克尼尔。我要用它来强化封印。 [xie xie ni ， yi ke ni er 。 wo yao yong ta lai qiang hua feng yin 。]

english: Do you ever get tired of guarding this place?
translation: 你厌倦了守卫这个地方吗？ [ni yan juan le shou wei zhe ge di fang ma ？]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Care to explain further?
translation: 愿意进一步解释吗？ [yuan yi jin yi bu jie shi ma ？]

english: Does the stream tire of eroding the earth? Does the earth tire of forming the mountain?
translation: 溪流是否厌倦了侵蚀地球？大地厌倦了山的形成吗？ [xi liu shi fou yan juan le qin shi di qiu ？ da di yan juan le shan de xing cheng ma ？]

english: Not that I can tell.
translation: 我不能说。 [wo bu neng shuo 。]

english: I have more in common with them than I do with most of your kind, iknil. Think of me as you do them.
translation: 我与他们的共同点比与你们大多数人的共同点还要多，iknil。当你做他们的时候，想想我。 [wo yu ta men de gong tong dian bi yu ni men da duo shu ren de gong tong dian hai yao duo ，iknil。 dang ni zuo ta men de shi hou ， xiang xiang wo 。]

english: This place is beautiful. I thought it was supposed to be a prison?
translation: 这个地方很漂亮。我以为这里应该是监狱？ [zhe ge di fang hen piao liang 。 wo yi wei zhe li ying gai shi jian yu ？]

english: It is a prison. Everything around us serves that purpose.
translation: 这是一座监狱。我们周围的一切都是为了这个目的。 [zhe shi yi zuo jian yu 。 wo men zhou wei de yi qie dou shi wei le zhe ge mu di 。]

english: Even the plants and the streams?
translation: 甚至植物和溪流？ [shen zhi zhi wu he xi liu ？]

english: I am a nagua of earth and stream. Being close to both empowers me to do my task.
translation: 我是大地与溪流的纳瓜。靠近两者使我能够完成我的任务。 [wo shi da di yu xi liu de na gua 。 kao jin liang zhe shi wo neng gou wan cheng wo de ren wu 。]

english: Just as being far from moonlight weakens the Moons of Peril.
translation: 正如远离月光会削弱危险之月一样。 [zheng ru yuan li yue guang hui xue ruo wei xian zhi yue yi yang 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Congratulations on your reward, iknil. That is a treasure from ages past.
translation: 恭喜你获得奖励，iknil。那是远古的宝藏。 [gong xi ni huo de jiang li ，iknil。 na shi yuan gu de bao zang 。]

english: Yeah, about that... I don't really like this one. Could I have a different one?
translation: 是的，关于这一点……我不太喜欢这个。我可以要一份不同的吗？ [shi de ， guan yu zhe yi dian …… wo bu tai xi huan zhe ge 。 wo ke yi yao yi fen bu tong de ma ？]

english: Was that rude?
translation: 那很粗鲁吗？ [na hen cu lu ma ？]

english: I was just... Processing. I suppose I could allow you another chance to obtain a piece of equipment, but it won't be guaranteed.
translation: 我只是……正在处理。我想我可以再给你一次获得一件装备的机会，但不能保证。 [wo zhi shi …… zheng zai chu li 。 wo xiang wo ke yi zai gei ni yi ci huo de yi jian zhuang bei de ji hui ， dan bu neng bao zheng 。]

english: Yes, that sounds good.
translation: 是的，听起来不错。 [shi de ， ting qi lai bu cuo 。]

english: You're certain, Iknil? You could end up with nothing.
translation: 你确定吗，伊克尼尔？你最终可能会一无所有。 [ni que ding ma ， yi ke ni er ？ ni zui zhong ke neng hui yi wu suo you 。]

english: Very well.
translation: 很好。 [hen hao 。]

english: No luck this time, iknil.
translation: 这次不走运，伊克尼尔。 [zhe ci bu zou yun ， yi ke ni er 。]

english: Oh... Can I have it back?
translation: 哦……我可以拿回来吗？ [o …… wo ke yi na hui lai ma ？]

english: Congratulations, iknil. Enjoy your new equipment.
translation: 恭喜你，伊克尼尔。享受你的新设备。 [gong xi ni ， yi ke ni er 。 xiang shou ni de xin she bei 。]

english: Congratulations, ik-
translation: 恭喜你，ik- [gong xi ni ，ik-]

english: This is the same thing I just gave you!
translation: 这和我刚刚给你的东西是一样的！ [zhe he wo gang gang gei ni de dong xi shi yi yang de ！]

english: So it seems. You're welcome to try again.
translation: 看来是这样。欢迎您再试一次。 [kan lai shi zhe yang 。 huan ying nin zai shi yi ci 。]

english: Actually, I don't dislike it that much. I think I'll keep it.
translation: 其实我并没有那么讨厌它。我想我会保留它。 [qi shi wo bing mei you na me tao yan ta 。 wo xiang wo hui bao liu ta 。]

english: Eyatlalli's voice echoes through the surrounding earth...
translation: 埃亚特拉利的声音在周围的大地上回响…… [ai ya te la li de sheng yin zai zhou wei de da di shang hui xiang ……]

english: Eyatlalli: Thank you, iknil. The Eclipse Moon of Peril is sufficiently distracted. You should now proceed on to the next one.
translation: Eyatlalli：谢谢你，iknil。危险月食已经足够分散注意力了。您现在应该继续进行下一个。 [Eyatlalli： xie xie ni ，iknil。 wei xian yue shi yi jing zu gou fen san zhu yi li le 。 nin xian zai ying gai ji xu jin xing xia yi ge 。]

english: Eyatlalli: Thank you, iknil. The Blue Moon of Peril is sufficiently distracted. You should now proceed on to the next one.
translation: Eyatlalli：谢谢你，iknil。危险蓝月已经足够分散注意力了。您现在应该继续进行下一个。 [Eyatlalli： xie xie ni ，iknil。 wei xian lan yue yi jing zu gou fen san zhu yi li le 。 nin xian zai ying gai ji xu jin xing xia yi ge 。]

english: Eyatlalli: Thank you, iknil. The Blood Moon of Peril is sufficiently distracted. You should now proceed on to the next one.
translation: Eyatlalli：谢谢你，iknil。危险血月已经足够分散注意力了。您现在应该继续进行下一个。 [Eyatlalli： xie xie ni ，iknil。 wei xian xue yue yi jing zu gou fen san zhu yi li le 。 nin xian zai ying gai ji xu jin xing xia yi ge 。]

english: Eyatlalli: Thank you, iknil. The Moons are sufficiently distracted. Return to me for your reward.
translation: Eyatlalli：谢谢你，iknil。月亮已经足够分散注意力了。回到我这里来领取你的奖励。 [Eyatlalli： xie xie ni ，iknil。 yue liang yi jing zu gou fen san zhu yi li le 。 hui dao wo zhe li lai ling qu ni de jiang li 。]

english: Eyatlalli's voice echoes through the surrounding earth.
translation: 埃亚特拉利的声音在周围的大地中回响。 [ai ya te la li de sheng yin zai zhou wei de da di zhong hui xiang 。]

english: Thank you, iknil. The Eclipse Moon of Peril is sufficiently distracted. You should now proceed on to the next one.
translation: 谢谢你，伊克尼尔。危险月食已经足够分散注意力了。您现在应该继续进行下一个。 [xie xie ni ， yi ke ni er 。 wei xian yue shi yi jing zu gou fen san zhu yi li le 。 nin xian zai ying gai ji xu jin xing xia yi ge 。]

english: Thank you, iknil. The Blue Moon of Peril is sufficiently distracted. You should now proceed on to the next one.
translation: 谢谢你，伊克尼尔。危险蓝月已经足够分散注意力了。您现在应该继续进行下一个。 [xie xie ni ， yi ke ni er 。 wei xian lan yue yi jing zu gou fen san zhu yi li le 。 nin xian zai ying gai ji xu jin xing xia yi ge 。]

english: Thank you, iknil. The Blood Moon of Peril is sufficiently distracted. You should now proceed on to the next one.
translation: 谢谢你，伊克尼尔。危险血月已经足够分散注意力了。您现在应该继续进行下一个。 [xie xie ni ， yi ke ni er 。 wei xian xue yue yi jing zu gou fen san zhu yi li le 。 nin xian zai ying gai ji xu jin xing xia yi ge 。]

english: Thank you, iknil. The Moons are sufficiently distracted. Return to me for your reward.
translation: 谢谢你，伊克尼尔。月亮已经足够分散注意力了。回到我这里来领取你的奖励。 [xie xie ni ， yi ke ni er 。 yue liang yi jing zu gou fen san zhu yi li le 。 hui dao wo zhe li lai ling qu ni de jiang li 。]

english: I lost my weapon fighting the Blue Moon. Could I have it back?
translation: 我在与蓝月的战斗中失去了武器。我可以把它拿回来吗？ [wo zai yu lan yue de zhan dou zhong shi qu le wu qi 。 wo ke yi ba ta na hui lai ma ？]

english: I found some essence whilst fighting the lesser nagua.
translation: 我在与小纳瓜战斗时发现了一些本质。 [wo zai yu xiao na gua zhan dou shi fa xian le yi xie ben zhi 。]

english: Do you ever get tired of guarding this place?
translation: 你厌倦了守卫这个地方吗？ [ni yan juan le shou wei zhe ge di fang ma ？]

english: This place is beautiful. I thought it was supposed to be a prison?
translation: 这个地方很漂亮。我以为这里应该是监狱？ [zhe ge di fang hen piao liang 。 wo yi wei zhe li ying gai shi jian yu ？]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Nilsal. I'm afraid I must ask not to be disturbed. There are many things that one in my position must contemplate. If you seek conversation, I'm sure my companion would be willing.
translation: 尼尔萨尔。恐怕我必须请求不要被打扰。有很多事情是处在我这个位置的人必须思考的。如果你想找人交谈，我相信我的同伴会愿意的。 [ni er sa er 。 kong pa wo bi xu qing qiu bu yao bei da rao 。 you hen duo shi qing shi chu zai wo zhe ge wei zhi de ren bi xu si kao de 。 ru guo ni xiang zhao ren jiao tan ， wo xiang xin wo de tong ban hui yuan yi de 。]

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Well hello there; welcome to our little village. Pray, stay awhile.
translation: 嗯，你好；欢迎来到我们的小村庄。祈祷吧，呆一会儿。 [n ， ni hao ； huan ying lai dao wo men de xiao cun zhuang 。 qi dao ba ， dai yi hui er 。]

english: You know, you sound just like the mayor?
translation: 你知道吗，你听起来就像市长一样？ [ni zhi dao ma ， ni ting qi lai jiu xiang shi zhang yi yang ？]

english: Really? That's the nicest thing anyone has ever said.
translation: 真的吗？这是任何人说过的最好的一句话。 [zhen de ma ？ zhe shi ren he ren shuo guo de zui hao de yi ju hua 。]

english: I admire him a great deal. He works so hard for this town.
translation: 我非常钦佩他。他为这个小镇努力工作。 [wo fei chang qin pei ta 。 ta wei zhe ge xiao zhen nu li gong zuo 。]

english: You look like him as well?
translation: 你看起来也像他吗？ [ni kan qi lai ye xiang ta ma ？]

english: Hmm, I don't think I do.
translation: 嗯，我不这么认为。 [n ， wo bu zhe me ren wei 。]

english: No really, what with the unhealthy skin tone and bulging eyes. The resemblance is uncanny.
translation: 不，真的，不健康的肤色和凸出的眼睛是怎么回事。相似之处是不可思议的。 [bu ， zhen de ， bu jian kang de fu se he tu chu de yan jing shi zen me hui shi 。 xiang si zhi chu shi bu ke si yi de 。]

english: Well, I haven't spoken to him in a while.  I don't get out much.
translation: 嗯，我已经有一段时间没和他说话了。  我很少出去。 [n ， wo yi jing you yi duan shi jian mei he ta shuo hua le 。   wo hen shao chu qu 。]

english: I can see why.
translation: 我明白为什么。 [wo ming bai wei shen me 。]

english: Maybe the Mayor has finally seen how much I admire him and has grown to admire me?
translation: 也许市长终于看出我对他的崇拜程度，对我产生了敬佩之情？ [ye xu shi zhang zhong yu kan chu wo dui ta de chong bai cheng du ， dui wo chan sheng le jing pei zhi qing ？]

english: Anything's possible I suppose. Wait a minute, you mean you've always looked that odd?
translation: 我想一切皆有可能。等一下，你的意思是你看起来总是那么奇怪？ [wo xiang yi qie jie you ke neng 。 deng yi xia ， ni de yi si shi ni kan qi lai zong shi na me qi guai ？]

english: Hey, I resent that!
translation: 嘿，我讨厌这样！ [hei ， wo tao yan zhe yang ！]

english: I'm sorry, it's just...  Nevermind.
translation: 抱歉，只是……没关系。 [bao qian ， zhi shi …… mei guan xi 。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I supply the local fishermen with the tools and bait they need to do their job.
translation: 我为当地渔民提供他们工作所需的工具和鱼饵。 [wo wei dang di yu min ti gong ta men gong zuo suo xu de gong ju he yu er 。]

english: Interesting. Have you been doing it long?
translation: 有趣的。你已经做了很长时间了吗？ [you qu de 。 ni yi jing zuo le hen zhang shi jian le ma ？]

english: Why yes, all of my life.  I took over from my father, who inherited the business from his father and so on.
translation: 为什么是的，我的一生。  我从我父亲那里接手，他从他父亲那里继承了生意等等。 [wei shen me shi de ， wo de yi sheng 。   wo cong wo fu qin na li jie shou ， ta cong ta fu qin na li ji cheng le sheng yi deng deng 。]

english: In fact, there have been Lovecraft's selling bait for over ten generations.
translation: 事实上，洛夫克拉夫特的卖饵已经有十多代了。 [shi shi shang ， luo fu ke la fu te de mai er yi jing you shi duo dai le 。]

english: Wow, that's some lineage.
translation: 哇，那是一些血统。 [wa ， na shi yi xie xue tong 。]

english: Oh yes, we have a long and interesting family history. For one reason or another the Lovecraft's have always been bait sellers or writers.
translation: 哦，是的，我们有悠久而有趣的家族历史。出于某种原因，洛夫克拉夫特家族一直是诱饵卖家或作家。 [o ， shi de ， wo men you you jiu er you qu de jia zu li shi 。 chu yu mou zhong yuan yin ， luo fu ke la fu te jia zu yi zhi shi you er mai jia huo zuo jia 。]

english: Hmm, yes well. I'm sure it's all fascinating, but I...
translation: 嗯，是的，好吧。我确信这一切都很有趣，但我... [n ， shi de ， hao ba 。 wo que xin zhe yi qie dou hen you qu ， dan wo ...]

english: Oh very, very fascinating, for instance my great grandfather Howard...
translation: 哦，非常非常迷人，例如我的曾祖父霍华德...... [o ， fei chang fei chang mi ren ， li ru wo de zeng zu fu huo hua de ......]

english: Yawn. Oh, I'm sorry but I really must be getting on. I think my giraffe needs feeding.
translation: 打哈欠。哦，对不起，但我真的必须继续前进。我想我的长颈鹿需要喂食。 [da ha qian 。 o ， dui bu qi ， dan wo zhen de bi xu ji xu qian jin 。 wo xiang wo de chang jing lu xu yao wei shi 。]

english: Your?
translation: 你的？ [ni de ？]

english: Giraffe. Sorry, but he gets cranky without enough sugar. Bye now!
translation: 长颈鹿。抱歉，没有足够的糖他就会暴躁。再见了！ [chang jing lu 。 bao qian ， mei you zu gou de tang ta jiu hui bao zao 。 zai jian le ！]

english: Oh right, goodbye.
translation: 哦，对了，再见。 [o ， dui le ， zai jian 。]

english: Can I buy some fishing supplies please?
translation: 请问可以买一些钓鱼用品吗？ [qing wen ke yi mai yi xie diao yu yong pin ma ？]

english: You are a bit too strange for me. Bye.
translation: 你对我来说有点太奇怪了。再见。 [ni dui wo lai shuo you dian tai qi guai le 。 zai jian 。]

english: Sniff. Yes, everyone says that.
translation: 闻一闻。是的，每个人都这么说。 [wen yi wen 。 shi de ， mei ge ren dou zhe me shuo 。]

english: You know, you sound just like the mayor?
translation: 你知道吗，你听起来就像市长一样？ [ni zhi dao ma ， ni ting qi lai jiu xiang shi zhang yi yang ？]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Can I buy some fishing supplies please?
translation: 请问可以买一些钓鱼用品吗？ [qing wen ke yi mai yi xie diao yu yong pin ma ？]

english: You are a bit too strange for me. Bye.
translation: 你对我来说有点太奇怪了。再见。 [ni dui wo lai shuo you dian tai qi guai le 。 zai jian 。]

english: Hello there, traveller.
translation: 你好，旅行者。 [ni hao ， lv xing zhe 。]

english: What's going on here? Where is everyone?
translation: 这是怎么回事？大家都在哪里？ [zhe shi zen me hui shi ？ da jia dou zai na li ？]

english: Most are in the city. As for the rest, hopefully somewhere nicer than this place.
translation: 大多数都在城市里。至于其余的地方，希望有比这个地方更好的地方。 [da duo shu dou zai cheng shi li 。 zhi yu qi yu de di fang ， xi wang you bi zhe ge di fang geng hao de di fang 。]

english: In the city?
translation: 在城市里？ [zai cheng shi li ？]

english: Yes. When we heard they were going to lock Menaphos down and shut the gates, most people here decided they'd be better off behind the walls than outside them.
translation: 是的。当我们听说他们要封锁梅纳福斯并关闭大门时，这里的大多数人都认为在墙内比在墙外更好。 [shi de 。 dang wo men ting shuo ta men yao feng suo mei na fu si bing guan bi da men shi ， zhe li de da duo shu ren dou ren wei zai qiang nei bi zai qiang wai geng hao 。]

english: But you stayed?
translation: 但你留下来了？ [dan ni liu xia lai le ？]

english: We didn't get much warning. People had to rush to gather whatever they could. Some things had to be left behind, along with some people...
translation: 我们没有收到太多警告。人们不得不赶紧收集他们能收集的东西。有些事，有些人，不得不留下…… [wo men mei you shou dao tai duo jing gao 。 ren men bu de bu gan jin shou ji ta men neng shou ji de dong xi 。 you xie shi ， you xie ren ， bu de bu liu xia ……]

english: That's horrible!
translation: 太可怕了！ [tai ke pa le ！]

english: It could have been worse. Had we been in Sophanem, we'd have had no warning at all. I just hope it won't be long before things are back to normal.
translation: 情况可能会更糟。如果我们在索法奈姆，我们根本不会收到任何警告。我只是希望不久之后一切都会恢复正常。 [qing kuang ke neng hui geng zao 。 ru guo wo men zai suo fa nai mu ， wo men gen ben bu hui shou dao ren he jing gao 。 wo zhi shi xi wang bu jiu zhi hou yi qie du hui hui fu zheng chang 。]

english: I hope so too.
translation: 我也希望如此。 [wo ye xi wang ru ci 。]

english: Thank you, traveller. Stay safe out there. These are troubling times.
translation: 谢谢你，旅行者。外出注意安全。这是一个令人不安的时期。 [xie xie ni ， lv xing zhe 。 wai chu zhu yi an quan 。 zhe shi yi ge ling ren bu an de shi qi 。]

english: Don't bother me, can't you see I'm busy?
translation: 别打扰我，你没看到我很忙吗？ [bie da rao wo ， ni mei kan dao wo hen mang ma ？]

english: No, I can't... can I go into the factory?
translation: 不，我不能……我可以进工厂吗？ [bu ， wo bu neng …… wo ke yi jin gong chang ma ？]

english: You can go in. The Consortium, in their infinite wisdom, has decided to open up the factory to all and sundry.
translation: 你可以进去了。财团以他们无限的智慧，决定将工厂向所有人开放。 [ni ke yi jin qu le 。 cai tuan yi ta men wu xian de zhi hui ， jue ding jiang gong chang xiang suo you ren kai fang 。]

english: How come?
translation: 怎么会？ [zen me hui ？]

english: We've built a new blast furnace and always have a shortage of people to work on it.
translation: 我们建造了一座新的高炉，但始终缺乏工人。 [wo men jian zao le yi zuo xin de gao lu ， dan shi zhong que fa gong ren 。]

english: I'll have a look, thanks.
translation: 我去看看，谢谢。 [wo qu kan kan ， xie xie 。]

english: Just don't go causing any trouble, I still run this factory!
translation: 别惹事了，这家工厂还是我开的！ [bie re shi le ， zhe jia gong chang hai shi wo kai de ！]

english: I'm sorry, I'm looking for the blast furnace?
translation: 抱歉，我在找高炉？ [bao qian ， wo zai zhao gao lu ？]

english: Do I look like a guide to you?
translation: 我看起来像你的向导吗？ [wo kan qi lai xiang ni de xiang dao ma ？]

english: No, you look like a hard-working dwarf, but can you please tell me where the blast furnace is?
translation: 不，你看起来像个勤劳的小矮人，但是你能告诉我高炉在哪里吗？ [bu ， ni kan qi lai xiang ge qin lao de xiao ai ren ， dan shi ni neng gao su wo gao lu zai na li ma ？]

english: Alright, just head down the stairs, it's easy to find.
translation: 好吧，顺着楼梯下去就很容易找到了。 [hao ba ， shun zhe lou ti xia qu jiu hen rong yi zhao dao le 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Are you okay?
translation: 你还好吗？ [ni hai hao ma ？]

english: Don't I look okay?
translation: 我看起来不好吗？ [wo kan qi lai bu hao ma ？]

english: If you were any shorter you wouldn't exist.
translation: 如果你再矮一点，你就不会存在。 [ru guo ni zai ai yi dian ， ni jiu bu hui cun zai 。]

english: Very funny, human.
translation: 非常有趣，人类。 [fei chang you qu ， ren lei 。]

english: What are you dwarves doing in this factory?
translation: 你们矮人在这个工厂里做什么？ [ni men ai ren zai zhe ge gong chang li zuo shen me ？]

english: Working of course, can't you see that?
translation: 当然是在工作，你看不出来吗？ [dang ran shi zai gong zuo ， ni kan bu chu lai ma ？]

english: But working on what?
translation: 但致力于什么？ [dan zhi li yu shen me ？]

english: Refining the ore that is being brought into the factory, of course.
translation: 当然，是对运入工厂的矿石进行精炼。 [dang ran ， shi dui yun ru gong chang de kuang shi jin xing jing lian 。]

english: And what does that mean?
translation: 这意味着什么？ [zhe yi wei zhe shen me ？]

english: It means you should stop asking so many questions and get back to work!
translation: 这意味着您应该停止问这么多问题并回去工作！ [zhe yi wei zhe nin ying gai ting zhi wen zhe me duo wen ti bing hui qu gong zuo ！]

english: Who owns this factory?
translation: 谁拥有这家工厂？ [shui yong you zhe jia gong chang ？]

english: The Consortium does and that's all you need to know.
translation: 联盟所做的，这就是您所需要知道的。 [lian meng suo zuo de ， zhe jiu shi nin suo xu yao zhi dao de 。]

english: But what company? I thought there were all these different companies?
translation: 但什么公司呢？我以为有这么多不同的公司？ [dan shen me gong si ne ？ wo yi wei you zhe me duo bu tong de gong si ？]

english: Oh yes, all the major companies own this plant. It's too vital to be in the hands of one company alone.
translation: 哦，是的，所有大公司都拥有这家工厂。它太重要了，不能单独掌握在一家公司手中。 [o ， shi de ， suo you da gong si dou yong you zhe jia gong chang 。 ta tai zhong yao le ， bu neng dan du zhang wo zai yi jia gong si shou zhong 。]

english: And what exactly are you doing here?
translation: 你到底在这里做什么？ [ni dao di zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I tire of these questions. Let me get back to work!
translation: 我厌倦了这些问题。让我回去工作吧！ [wo yan juan le zhe xie wen ti 。 rang wo hui qu gong zuo ba ！]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: What do you do?
translation: 你做什么工作？ [ni zuo shen me gong zuo ？]

english: You can store your stuff here if you want. You can dump anything you don't want to carry whilst you're fighting duels and then pick it up again on the way out.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，你可以把你的东西存放在这里。你可以在决斗时扔掉任何你不想带的东西，然后在出去时再把它捡起来。 [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， ni ke yi ba ni de dong xi cun fang zai zhe li 。 ni ke yi zai jue dou shi reng diao ren he ni bu xiang dai de dong xi ， ran hou zai chu qu shi zai ba ta jian qi lai 。]

english: To be honest I'm wasted here.
translation: 说实话，我在这里浪费了。 [shuo shi hua ， wo zai zhe li lang fei le 。]

english: I should be winning duels in an arena! I'm the best warrior in Al Kharid!
translation: 我应该在竞技场决斗中获胜！我是阿尔卡里德最好的战士！ [wo ying gai zai jing ji chang jue dou zhong huo sheng ！ wo shi a er ka li de zui hao de zhan shi ！]

english: Easy, tiger!
translation: 轻松点，老虎！ [qing song dian ， lao hu ！]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Isn't it obvious?
translation: 这不是很明显吗？ [zhe bu shi hen ming xian ma ？]

english: This is the Emir's Arena...duh!
translation: 这是埃米尔竞技场……呃！ [zhe shi ai mi er jing ji chang …… e ！]

english: I'd like to access my bank, please.
translation: 我想访问我的银行。 [wo xiang fang wen wo de yin hang 。]

english: Sure.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: I'd like to collect items.
translation: 我想收集物品。 [wo xiang shou ji wu pin 。]

english: Yeah, okay.
translation: 是啊，好吧。 [shi a ， hao ba 。]

english: Do you watch any matches?
translation: 你看比赛吗？ [ni kan bi sai ma ？]

english: Sure, I'll buy some rotten fruit.
translation: 当然，我会买一些腐烂的水果。 [dang ran ， wo hui mai yi xie fu lan de shui guo 。]

english: No, I'm not giving you money for rotten fruit.
translation: 不，我不会给你钱买烂水果。 [bu ， wo bu hui gei ni qian mai lan shui guo 。]

english: Suit yourself.
translation: 适合自己。 [shi he zi ji 。]

english: Goodbye, Fadli.
translation: 再见，法德利。 [zai jian ， fa de li 。]

english: What do you do?
translation: 你做什么工作？ [ni zuo shen me gong zuo ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: I'd like to access my bank, please.
translation: 我想访问我的银行。 [wo xiang fang wen wo de yin hang 。]

english: I'd like to collect items.
translation: 我想收集物品。 [wo xiang shou ji wu pin 。]

english: Do you watch any matches?
translation: 你看比赛吗？ [ni kan bi sai ma ？]

english: Have you got any idea where Burthorpe is? The co- ordinator says I need to go there and paint all the leaves yellow, but I've never heard of that place!
translation: 你知道伯索普在哪里吗？协调员说我需要去那里把所有的叶子都涂成黄色，但我从来没有听说过那个地方！ [ni zhi dao bo suo pu zai na li ma ？ xie tiao yuan shuo wo xu yao qu na li ba suo you de ye zi dou tu cheng huang se ， dan wo cong lai mei you ting shuo guo na ge di fang ！]

english: Be careful when you pick mushrooms near the strange ruins to the south. Some of them will try to eat you!
translation: 在南边奇怪的废墟附近采摘蘑菇时要小心。其中一些会尝试吃掉你！ [zai nan bian qi guai de fei xu fu jin cai zhai mo gu shi yao xiao xin 。 qi zhong yi xie hui chang shi chi diao ni ！]

english: Err, hello. Do you have any idea what a Winter Fairy actually does?
translation: 呃，你好。你知道冬季仙女实际上是做什么的吗？ [e ， ni hao 。 ni zhi dao dong ji xian nv shi ji shang shi zuo shen me de ma ？]

english: No, no idea at all.
translation: 不，根本不知道。 [bu ， gen ben bu zhi dao 。]

english: Oh, pity. Neither do I, but I'm supposed to be one this week.
translation: 哦，可惜了。我也没有，但我应该是这周的。 [o ， ke xi le 。 wo ye mei you ， dan wo ying gai shi zhe zhou de 。]

english: Sorry, I can't talk I'm looking for Sarah-Jane!
translation: 抱歉，我不能说话，我在找莎拉-简！ [bao qian ， wo bu neng shuo hua ， wo zai zhao sha la - jian ！]

english: Is your name Freddie, and are you loosing your teeth?
translation: 你的名字是弗雷迪吗？你的牙齿掉了吗？ [ni de ming zi shi fu lei di ma ？ ni de ya chi diao le ma ？]

english: Err, no. I'm afraid not.
translation: 呃，不。恐怕不是。 [e ， bu 。 kong pa bu shi 。]

english: Oh, right.
translation: 哦，对了。 [o ， dui le 。]

english: You don't have any idea where I can find him do you?
translation: 你不知道我在哪里可以找到他吗？ [ni bu zhi dao wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao ta ma ？]

english: No, I don't know that either.
translation: 不，我也不知道。 [bu ， wo ye bu zhi dao 。]

english: Oh, ok then. If you do find out please let me know. The co-ordinator has sent me to find him.
translation: 哦，好吧。如果您发现了，请告诉我。协调员派我去找他。 [o ， hao ba 。 ru guo nin fa xian le ， qing gao su wo 。 xie tiao yuan pai wo qu zhao ta 。]

english: I'm afraid I can't stop to chat. I've just been told to get ready to go to Etceteria for some reason or other!
translation: 恐怕我无法停下来聊天。出于某种原因，我刚刚被告知准备去 Etceteria！ [kong pa wo wu fa ting xia lai liao tian 。 chu yu mou zhong yuan yin ， wo gang gang bei gao zhi zhun bei qu  Etceteria！]

english: Picking mushrooms near the forge will probably end quite badly for you.
translation: 在锻造厂附近采摘蘑菇可能会给你带来非常糟糕的结局。 [zai duan zao chang fu jin cai zhai mo gu ke neng hui gei ni dai lai fei chang zao gao de jie ju 。]

english: The Queen is the true ruler of Zanaris! We shall over- throw the tyrant!
translation: 女王才是扎纳里斯真正的统治者！我们要推翻暴君！ [nv wang cai shi zha na li si zhen zheng de tong zhi zhe ！ wo men yao tui fan bao jun ！]

english: Is the council finished yet?
translation: 理事会结束了吗？ [li shi hui jie shu le ma ？]

english: Once the council of war is finished we shall go and get rid of the Godfather.
translation: 一旦战争委员会结束，我们就去除掉教父。 [yi dan zhan zheng wei yuan hui jie shu ， wo men jiu qu chu diao jiao fu 。]

english: I'm so looking forward to going back home!
translation: 我非常期待回家！ [wo fei chang qi dai hui jia ！]

english: Thank you for waking our queen.
translation: 谢谢你叫醒我们的女王。 [xie xie ni jiao xing wo men de nv wang 。]

english: Now that the Queen is awake everything will be alright.
translation: 现在女王醒了，一切都会好起来的。 [xian zai nv wang xing le ， yi qie du hui hao qi lai de 。]

english: This fairy ring will take you out of Zanaris. It leads to the place known as Al-Kharid in your realm. Once passed you can not return this way.
translation: 这枚仙女戒指将带你离开扎纳里斯。它通向你们王国中被称为 Al-Kharid 的地方。一旦通过，您将无法以这种方式返回。 [zhe mei xian nv jie zhi jiang dai ni li kai zha na li si 。 ta tong xiang ni men wang guo zhong bei cheng wei  Al-Kharid  de di fang 。 yi dan tong guo ， nin jiang wu fa yi zhe zhong fang shi fan hui 。]

english: Before leaving make sure that you have fully sampled the delights of our marketplace.
translation: 离开之前，请确保您已经充分体验了我们市场的乐趣。 [li kai zhi qian ， qing que bao nin yi jing chong fen ti yan le wo men shi chang de le qu 。]

english: I think I'll stay down here a bit longer.
translation: 我想我会在这儿多呆一会儿。 [wo xiang wo hui zai zhe er duo dai yi hui er 。]

english: As you wish.
translation: 如你所愿。 [ru ni suo yuan 。]

english: Yes, I'm ready to leave.
translation: 是的，我准备离开了。 [shi de ， wo zhun bei li kai le 。]

english: I think I'll stay down here a bit longer.
translation: 我想我会在这儿多呆一会儿。 [wo xiang wo hui zai zhe er duo dai yi hui er 。]

english: Yes, I'm ready to leave.
translation: 是的，我准备离开了。 [shi de ， wo zhun bei li kai le 。]

english: Hello, my name is [player name]. Who are you?
translation: 你好，我的名字是[玩家姓名]。你是谁？ [ni hao ， wo de ming zi shi [ wan jia xing ming ]。 ni shi shui ？]

english: Oh hello [player name]. I'm Aeryka. Aery for short.
translation: 哦你好[玩家姓名]。我是艾瑞卡。简称艾瑞。 [o ni hao [ wan jia xing ming ]。 wo shi ai rui ka 。 jian cheng ai rui 。]

english: Airy Fairy?
translation: 空灵仙子？ [kong ling xian zi ？]

english: That's right. What can I do for you?
translation: 这是正确的。我能为你做什么？ [zhe shi zheng que de 。 wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: What's that crop circle thing doing here?
translation: 麦田怪圈在这里做什么？ [mai tian guai quan zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Crop circle? Oh, you mean the Puromantic portal?
translation: 麦田圈？哦，你是说 Puromantic 门户吗？ [mai tian quan ？ o ， ni shi shuo  Puromantic  men hu ma ？]

english: The pyromanic what?
translation: 纵火狂什么？ [zong huo kuang shen me ？]

english: The Puromantic portal. At least that's what we call them. It's the way the implings travel from Puro-Puro to other planes.
translation: 普罗曼蒂克门户网站。至少我们是这么称呼它们的。这就是暗示从普罗-普罗传播到其他位面的方式。 [pu luo man di ke men hu wang zhan 。 zhi shao wo men shi zhe me cheng hu ta men de 。 zhe jiu shi an shi cong pu luo - pu luo chuan bo dao qi ta wei mian de fang shi 。]

english: Puro-Puro?
translation: 普罗普罗？ [pu luo pu luo ？]

english: The impling home. We call it Puro-Puro. The implings just call it home, I think.
translation: 寓意着家。我们称之为 Puro-Puro。我想，这些暗示只是称之为家。 [yu yi zhe jia 。 wo men cheng zhi wei  Puro-Puro。 wo xiang ， zhe xie an shi zhi shi cheng zhi wei jia 。]

english: It's still here.
translation: 它还在这里。 [ta hai zai zhe li 。]

english: Pardon?
translation: 赦免？ [she mian ？]

english: It's still here. The crop circle is still here.
translation: 它还在这里。麦田怪圈还在这里。 [ta hai zai zhe li 。 mai tian guai quan hai zai zhe li 。]

english: Oh yes, thanks Aery. It didn't go anywhere in the meantime, then?
translation: 哦，是的，谢谢艾瑞。那么这期间它没有去任何地方吗？ [o ， shi de ， xie xie ai rui 。 na me zhe qi jian ta mei you qu ren he di fang ma ？]

english: Nope. It just sat there.
translation: 没有。它就坐在那里。 [mei you 。 ta jiu zuo zai na li 。]

english: Jolly good. I can come back and visit Puro-Puro whenever I want then. Brilliant!
translation: 好极了。那时我可以随时回来参观 Puro-Puro。杰出的！ [hao ji le 。 na shi wo ke yi sui shi hui lai can guan  Puro-Puro。 jie chu de ！]

english: What's in Puro-Puro?
translation: 普罗普罗有什么？ [pu luo pu luo you shen me ？]

english: Implings...and wheat.
translation: 暗示...和小麦。 [an shi ... he xiao mai 。]

english: Erm, anything else?
translation: 呃，还有别的吗？ [e ， hai you bie de ma ？]

english: Not really. Though I have noticed quite a lot of you humans travelling through the portal recently. I suppose you must like wheat.
translation: 并不真地。尽管我最近注意到你们中有很多人通过门户旅行。我想你一定喜欢小麦。 [bing bu zhen di 。 jin guan wo zui jin zhu yi dao ni men zhong you hen duo ren tong guo men hu lv xing 。 wo xiang ni yi ding xi huan xiao mai 。]

english: Well, most of us prefer lobsters to be perfectly honest, but there must be something interesting there.
translation: 好吧，老实说，我们大多数人都更喜欢龙虾，但那里一定有一些有趣的东西。 [hao ba ， lao shi shuo ， wo men da duo shu ren dou geng xi huan long xia ， dan na li yi ding you yi xie you qu de dong xi 。]

english: Oh, I did notice a very serious-looking gnome go into the portal. Maybe he knows what's going on.
translation: 哦，我确实注意到一个看上去非常严肃的侏儒走进了传送门。也许他知道发生了什么事。 [o ， wo que shi zhu yi dao yi ge kan shang qu fei chang yan su de zhu ru zou jin le chuan song men 。 ye xu ta zhi dao fa sheng le shen me shi 。]

english: Do you remember what his name was?
translation: 你还记得他叫什么名字吗？ [ni hai ji de ta jiao shen me ming zi ma ？]

english: Errm, Egg-nog, or something like that.
translation: 呃，蛋酒，或者类似的东西。 [e ， dan jiu ， huo zhe lei si de dong xi 。]

english: Right, thanks! I'll have a chat with him when I go. Maybe he'll know what's going on.
translation: 对了，谢谢！我去的时候会和他聊聊。也许他会知道发生了什么事。 [dui le ， xie xie ！ wo qu de shi hou hui he ta liao liao 。 ye xu ta hui zhi dao fa sheng le shen me shi 。]

english: So what are these implings then?
translation: 那么这些含义是什么？ [na me zhe xie han yi shi shen me ？]

english: Well, no-one knows for sure. The mischievous little creatures are probably related to imps. And they fly as well.
translation: 好吧，没有人确切知道。这些顽皮的小生物很可能与小恶魔有关。它们也会飞。 [hao ba ， mei you ren que qie zhi dao 。 zhe xie wan pi de xiao sheng wu hen ke neng yu xiao e mo you guan 。 ta men ye hui fei 。]

english: Also, like imps, they love collecting things. I'm not sure why, though. They also seem to like being chased.
translation: 而且，像小鬼一样，他们喜欢收集东西。但我不确定为什么。他们似乎也喜欢被追赶。 [er qie ， xiang xiao gui yi yang ， ta men xi huan shou ji dong xi 。 dan wo bu que ding wei shen me 。 ta men si hu ye xi huan bei zhui gan 。]

english: So how would I get hold of what they are carrying, then?
translation: 那么我该如何拿到他们携带的东西呢？ [na me wo gai ru he na dao ta men xie dai de dong xi ne ？]

english: Catch them, I suppose. I don't know really. Why would you want to?
translation: 我想，抓住他们吧。我真的不知道。你为什么想要这么做？ [wo xiang ， zhua zhu ta men ba 。 wo zhen de bu zhi dao 。 ni wei shen me xiang yao zhe me zuo ？]

english: Well, if they were carrying something useful. Maybe I could catch them with a big net - like butterflies.
translation: 好吧，如果他们携带有用的东西的话。也许我可以用一张大网捕捉它们——就像蝴蝶一样。 [hao ba ， ru guo ta men xie dai you yong de dong xi de hua 。 ye xu wo ke yi yong yi zhang da wang bu zhuo ta men —— jiu xiang hu die yi yang 。]

english: Sounds a bit cruel to me, but I suppose that's possible.
translation: 对我来说听起来有点残酷，但我认为这是可能的。 [dui wo lai shuo ting qi lai you dian can ku ， dan wo ren wei zhe shi ke neng de 。]

english: I've heard I may find dragon equipment in Puro-Puro.
translation: 我听说我可以在普罗普罗找到龙装备。 [wo ting shuo wo ke yi zai pu luo pu luo zhao dao long zhuang bei 。]

english: Really? You humans like that stuff a lot, don't you? I don't like really old stuff myself.
translation: 真的吗？你们人类很喜欢那些东西，不是吗？我自己也不喜欢太旧的东西。 [zhen de ma ？ ni men ren lei hen xi huan na xie dong xi ， bu shi ma ？ wo zi ji ye bu xi huan tai jiu de dong xi 。]

english: Old?
translation: 老的？ [lao de ？]

english: Yes, dragon stuff feels really old.
translation: 是的，龙的东西感觉真的很古老。 [shi de ， long de dong xi gan jue zhen de hen gu lao 。]

english: How can you tell that?
translation: 你怎么能这么说呢？ [ni zen me neng zhe me shuo ne ？]

english: From its magical aura, obviously. Oh, I forget you humans can't feel auras.
translation: 显然，从它的神奇光环来看。哦，我忘了你们人类是感受不到光环的。 [xian ran ， cong ta de shen qi guang huan lai kan 。 o ， wo wang le ni men ren lei shi gan shou bu dao guang huan de 。]

english: How old is old?
translation: 几岁算老？ [ji sui suan lao ？]

english: Really, really, old.
translation: 真的，真的，老了。 [zhen de ， zhen de ， lao le 。]

english: Can you be any more precise?
translation: 能说得更准确一点吗？ [neng shuo de geng zhun que yi dian ma ？]

english: Not really. Time doesn't really mean a lot round here. Hundreds, maybe thousands of your human lifespans, I suppose. Anyway, it would have to be old since it all comes from the Necrosyrtes.
translation: 并不真地。时间在这里并没有多大意义。我想，你的人类寿命有数百年甚至数千年。无论如何，它一定很古老，因为它都来自死灵。 [bing bu zhen di 。 shi jian zai zhe li bing mei you duo da yi yi 。 wo xiang ， ni de ren lei shou ming you shu bai nian shen zhi shu qian nian 。 wu lun ru he ， ta yi ding hen gu lao ， yin wei ta dou lai zi si ling 。]

translation: 那……东西是你的吗？ [na …… dong xi shi ni de ma ？]

english: You mean my cat?
translation: 你是说我的猫吗？ [ni shi shuo wo de mao ma ？]

english: Yes, I mean your cat! I HATE cats! Get it out of here!
translation: 是的，我是说你的猫！我讨厌猫！把它带出去！ [shi de ， wo shi shuo ni de mao ！ wo tao yan mao ！ ba ta dai chu qu ！]

english: Filthy things, no better than the rats that they catch.
translation: 肮脏的东西，不比他们抓的老鼠好。 [ang zang de dong xi ， bu bi ta men zhua de lao shu hao 。]

english: You cannot take your follower into the game.
translation: 你不能带你的追随者进入游戏。 [ni bu neng dai ni de zhui sui zhe jin ru you xi 。]

english: Arr, well we'll get you sorted out with a team hat right away.
translation: 嗯，我们会立即为您安排一顶团队帽。 [n ， wo men hui li ji wei nin an pai yi ding tuan dui mao 。]

english: Go wait in the waiting room, I'll call you when we are ready to begin.
translation: 去候诊室等候，准备好后我会打电话给你。 [qu hou zhen shi deng hou ， zhun bei hao hou wo hui da dian hua gei ni 。]

english: Who are you, and what is this place?
translation: 你是谁，这是什么地方？ [ni shi shui ， zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Arrharrharr!
translation: 啊啊啊啊！ [a a a a ！]

english: Do you not recognise me? I am the famous dandy pirate 'Fancy' Dan!
translation: 你不认识我了吗？我是著名的花花公子海盗“花式”丹！ [ni bu ren shi wo le ma ？ wo shi zhu ming de hua hua gong zi hai dao “ hua shi ” dan ！]

english: Yes, of course, any pirate knows who you are.
translation: 是的，当然，任何海盗都知道你是谁。 [shi de ， dang ran ， ren he hai dao dou zhi dao ni shi shui 。]

english: But of course.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: As for what this place is, it is my glorious still, producing the best quality 'rum' this side of Braindeath Island.
translation: 至于这个地方是什么，那是我光荣的蒸馏厂，生产脑死亡岛这边最优质的“朗姆酒”。 [zhi yu zhe ge di fang shi shen me ， na shi wo guang rong de zheng liu chang ， sheng chan nao si wang dao zhe bian zui you zhi di “ lang mu jiu ”。]

english: Oh, and the run-down swill-producing ditch that San Fan over there calls a still.
translation: 哦，还有那条破旧的泔水生产沟，三凡那边称之为蒸馏器。 [o ， hai you na tiao po jiu de gan shui sheng chan gou ， san fan na bian cheng zhi wei zheng liu qi 。]

english: So with two stills you have plenty of 'rum' right?
translation: 那么有了两张剧照，你就有​​足够的“朗姆酒”了，对吗？ [na me you le liang zhang ju zhao ， ni jiu you ​​ zu gou de “ lang mu jiu ” le ， dui ma ？]

english: Well we would do, if that hatchet-faced harridan wouldn't keep trying to torch the place!
translation: 好吧，如果那个尖刻的哈里登不继续试图烧毁这个地方的话，我们就这么做！ [hao ba ， ru guo na ge jian ke de ha li deng bu ji xu shi tu shao hui zhe ge di fang de hua ， wo men jiu zhe me zuo ！]

english: I say!
translation: 我说！ [wo shuo ！]

english: A little while ago we had some real problems getting rum to the island, hence the two stills.
translation: 不久前，我们在将朗姆酒运到岛上时遇到了一些实际问题，因此就有了两张剧照。 [bu jiu qian ， wo men zai jiang lang mu jiu yun dao dao shang shi yu dao le yi xie shi ji wen ti ， yin ci jiu you le liang zhang ju zhao 。]

english: However, after a little misunderstanding involving San's still and a barrel of gunpowder our relationship seems to have become a little strained.
translation: 然而，在桑的蒸馏器和一桶火药的一些小误会之后，我们的关系似乎变得有点紧张。 [ran er ， zai sang de zheng liu qi he yi tong huo yao de yi xie xiao wu hui zhi hou ， wo men de guan xi si hu bian de you dian jin zhang 。]

english: Apparently it is perfectly within the pirate code to burn each others stills, so long as nobody directly attacks the other person's crew, so rum production has taken a slight dip of late.
translation: 显然，只要没有人直接攻击对方的船员，烧毁对方的剧照就完全符合海盗准则，因此朗姆酒产量最近略有下降。 [xian ran ， zhi yao mei you ren zhi jie gong ji dui fang de chuan yuan ， shao hui dui fang de ju zhao jiu wan quan fu he hai dao zhun ze ， yin ci lang mu jiu chan liang zui jin lve you xia jiang 。]

english: Can I help out?
translation: 我可以帮忙吗？ [wo ke yi bang mang ma ？]

english: Yes, probably. I have a bunch of jobs that need doing, if you feel up to it.
translation: 是的，可能是。我有很多工作需要做，如果你愿意的话。 [shi de ， ke neng shi 。 wo you hen duo gong zuo xu yao zuo ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua 。]

english: What would you like to know about?
translation: 您想了解什么？ [nin xiang liao jie shen me ？]

english: How do I help you brew 'Rum'?
translation: 我如何帮助您酿造“朗姆酒”？ [wo ru he bang zhu nin niang zao “ lang mu jiu ”？]

english: Well the stills we have set up are based on the ones on Braindeath island... well roughly at any rate.
translation: 好吧，我们设置的剧照是基于脑死亡岛上的剧照……至少大致如此。 [hao ba ， wo men she zhi de ju zhao shi ji yu nao si wang dao shang de ju zhao …… zhi shao da zhi ru ci 。]

english: All you have to do is help put the ingredients into the hoppers and keep the boilers burning.
translation: 您所要做的就是帮助将原料放入料斗并保持锅炉燃烧。 [nin suo yao zuo de jiu shi bang zhu jiang yuan liao fang ru liao dou bing bao chi guo lu ran shao 。]

english: If you add enough ingredients to the hoppers then you have the ability to pick up a single bottle of rum when it brews.
translation: 如果您向料斗添加足够的原料，那么您就有能力在酿造时拿起一瓶朗姆酒。 [ru guo nin xiang liao dou tian jia zu gou de yuan liao ， na me nin jiu you neng li zai niang zao shi na qi yi ping lang mu jiu 。]

english: So, if ye add 5 buckets of water to the hoppers, then ye get access to one bottle. If you add 3 bowls of coloured water you get access to one bottle, and if you add one of anything else you get access to one bottle.
translation: 因此，如果您向料斗中添加 5 桶水，那么您就可以获得一瓶水。如果您添加 3 碗有色水，您将获得一瓶，如果您添加其他任何东西，您将获得一瓶。 [yin ci ， ru guo nin xiang liao dou zhong tian jia  5  tong shui ， na me nin jiu ke yi huo de yi ping shui 。 ru guo nin tian jia  3  wan you se shui ， nin jiang huo de yi ping ， ru guo nin tian jia qi ta ren he dong xi ， nin jiang huo de yi ping 。]

english: This is cumulative, meaning that if you add (for example) 10 buckets of water, 3 sweetgrubs and 6 bowls of coloured water, then you have a chance to collect 7 bottles of rum for the team.
translation: 这是累积的，这意味着如果您添加（例如）10 桶水、3 个甜幼虫和 6 碗彩色水，那么您就有机会为团队收集 7 瓶朗姆酒。 [zhe shi lei ji de ， zhe yi wei zhe ru guo nin tian jia （ li ru ）10  tong shui 、3  ge tian you chong he  6  wan cai se shui ， na me nin jiu you ji hui wei tuan dui shou ji  7  ping lang mu jiu 。]

english: The boilers are easy as pie to sort out. You just put some logs in, light them with a tinderbox, and then keep putting logs in until they are good and hot.
translation: 锅炉很容易分类。你只需放入一些木头，用易燃物点燃它们，然后继续放入木头，直到它们变好并且变热。 [guo lu hen rong yi fen lei 。 ni zhi xu fang ru yi xie mu tou ， yong yi ran wu dian ran ta men ， ran hou ji xu fang ru mu tou ， zhi dao ta men bian hao bing qie bian re 。]

english: Three logs should do it, but it's best to keep heaping them in just in case.
translation: 三根原木就可以了，但最好还是把它们堆起来以防万一。 [san gen yuan mu jiu ke yi le ， dan zui hao hai shi ba ta men dui qi lai yi fang wan yi 。]

english: The ingredients are; Bitternuts, Scrapey Tree Bark, Sweetgrubs, Buckets of Water and some Coloured Water.
translation: 成分是；苦坚果、刮草树皮、甜菜、一桶水和一些有色水。 [cheng fen shi ； ku jian guo 、 gua cao shu pi 、 tian cai 、 yi tong shui he yi xie you se shui 。]

english: Where can I get Bitternuts?
translation: 哪里可以买到苦果？ [na li ke yi mai dao ku guo ？]

english: There are plenty of Bitternut trees inside this walled off area. The problem is that the trees are too tricky for a human to climb.
translation: 这个被围墙围起来的区域内有很多苦坚果树。问题是这些树对于人类来说太难爬了。 [zhe ge bei wei qiang wei qi lai de qu yu nei you hen duo ku jian guo shu 。 wen ti shi zhe xie shu dui yu ren lei lai shuo tai nan pa le 。]

english: You will need to catch a monkey and send it up the tree to get the nut for you.
translation: 你需要抓住一只猴子并将其送到树上来为你获取坚果。 [ni xu yao zhua zhu yi zhi hou zi bing jiang qi song dao shu shang lai wei ni huo qu jian guo 。]

english: Send it up the tree? How does that work?
translation: 送上树吗？这是如何运作的？ [song shang shu ma ？ zhe shi ru he yun zuo de ？]

english: Well, if you were a monkey, and some random person grabbed you, dumped some dye in your fur and shoved you up a tree, you would hurl the closest heavy object at them too.
translation: 好吧，如果你是一只猴子，某个随机的人抓住你，在你的皮毛上倒了一些染料，然后把你推到树上，你也会把最近的重物扔向他们。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni shi yi zhi hou zi ， mou ge sui ji de ren zhua zhu ni ， zai ni de pi mao shang dao le yi xie ran liao ， ran hou ba ni tui dao shu shang ， ni ye hui ba zui jin de zhong wu reng xiang ta men 。]

english: Wait a second, dye?
translation: 等一下，染料？ [deng yi xia ， ran liao ？]

english: Yes, you'll need to get a bowl of coloured water and pour it on the monkey. Otherwise you won't be able to tell which team the monkey belongs too.
translation: 是的，你需要拿一碗有颜色的水，倒在猴子身上。否则你也无法分辨出猴子属于哪一队。 [shi de ， ni xu yao na yi wan you yan se de shui ， dao zai hou zi shen shang 。 fou ze ni ye wu fa fen bian chu hou zi shu yu na yi dui 。]

english: That makes sense...I think...
translation: 说得有道理……我觉得…… [shuo de you dao li …… wo jue de ……]

english: Anything else?
translation: 还要别的吗？ [hai yao bie de ma ？]

english: Can I ask about something else?
translation: 我可以问点别的吗？ [wo ke yi wen dian bie de ma ？]

english: Ok, what else?
translation: 好吧，还有什么？ [hao ba ， hai you shen me ？]

english: So...how would I go about sabotaging the enemy still?
translation: 那么……我该如何去破坏敌人呢？ [na me …… wo gai ru he qu po huai di ren ne ？]

english: Where can I get Scrapey tree bark...and why do I get the feeling I won't like the answer?
translation: 我在哪里可以得到刮皮树皮……为什么我感觉我不喜欢这个答案？ [wo zai na li ke yi de dao gua pi shu pi …… wei shen me wo gan jue wo bu xi huan zhe ge da an ？]

english: Inside this walled area there are a few Scrapey trees. They are the big, ill looking ones, you can't miss them.
translation: 在这个围墙区域内有几棵刮毛树。它们又大又丑，你不能错过它们。 [zai zhe ge wei qiang qu yu nei you ji ke gua mao shu 。 ta men you da you chou ， ni bu neng cuo guo ta men 。]

english: Basically, you cut them down and then carve the bark off with a knife.
translation: 基本上，你把它们砍下来，然后用刀切掉树皮。 [ji ben shang ， ni ba ta men kan xia lai ， ran hou yong dao qie diao shu pi 。]

english: It's pretty simple, except the sap tends somake people feel kind offill if they get any on themselves.
translation: 这很简单，只不过如果人们自己沾上汁液，往往会让人感到一种饱腹感。 [zhe hen jian dan ， zhi bu guo ru guo ren men zi ji zhan shang zhi ye ， wang wang hui rang ren gan dao yi zhong bao fu gan 。]

english: How ill?
translation: 病得怎么样？ [bing de zen me yang ？]

english: Don't worry, we aren't talking deadly ill or anything.
translation: 别担心，我们不是在谈论重病之类的。 [bie dan xin ， wo men bu shi zai tan lun zhong bing zhi lei de 。]

english: It's more like you'll feel quite dizzy and weak for a bit.
translation: 更像是你会感到一阵头晕和虚弱。 [geng xiang shi ni hui gan dao yi zhen tou yun he xu ruo 。]

english: Joy...
translation: 喜悦... [xi yue ...]

english: Sweetgrubs? What are they?
translation: 甜幼虫？这些是什么？ [tian you chong ？ zhe xie shi shen me ？]

english: Well, lacking any sluglings in the area, we add these little grubs called Sweetgrubs. If you ignore the gag- inducing aftertaste, they are quite sweet.
translation: 好吧，由于该地区缺乏任何蛞蝓，我们添加了这些称为甜幼虫的小幼虫。如果忽略令人作呕的余味，它们非常甜。 [hao ba ， you yu gai di qu que fa ren he kuo yu ， wo men tian jia le zhe xie cheng wei tian you chong de xiao you chong 。 ru guo hu lve ling ren zuo ou de yu wei ， ta men fei chang tian 。]

english: How... how can you drink this stuff?
translation: 这……你怎么能喝这种东西？ [zhe …… ni zen me neng he zhe zhong dong xi ？]

english: Quite easily!
translation: 很容易！ [hen rong yi ！]

english: Pirates are renowned as being tough for a reason.
translation: 海盗以强悍闻名，这是有原因的。 [hai dao yi qiang han wen ming ， zhe shi you yuan yin de 。]

english: So where do I get these grubs from anyway?
translation: 那么我从哪里得到这些幼虫呢？ [na me wo cong na li de dao zhe xie you chong ne ？]

english: Well, there are a few sweetgrub mounds inside there. We have a handful of rat meat that you can use on the mounds to draw the grubs to the surface.
translation: 嗯，里面有一些甜菜土丘。我们有一把老鼠肉，你可以用它们在土丘上把幼虫吸引到地表。 [n ， li mian you yi xie tian cai tu qiu 。 wo men you yi ba lao shu rou ， ni ke yi yong ta men zai tu qiu shang ba you chong xi yin dao di biao 。]

english: Mind your fingers though, they are voracious little things.
translation: 不过要小心你的手指，它们是贪吃的小东西。 [bu guo yao xiao xin ni de shou zhi ， ta men shi tan chi de xiao dong xi 。]

english: And here was me thinking that nothing could be more disgusting than Braindeath 'Rum'.
translation: 我当时想，没有什么比脑死亡“朗姆酒”更恶心的了。 [wo dang shi xiang ， mei you shen me bi nao si wang “ lang mu jiu ” geng e xin de le 。]

english: Arr, that's where ye'd be wrong [lad/lass], 'cos new, improved Braindeath 'Rum' Classic is now 200% more disgustin' than any leadin' competitor!
translation: 啊，这就是你们错的地方[小伙子/姑娘]，因为新的、改进的 Braindeath 'Rum' Classic 现在比任何领先的竞争对手都恶心 200%！ [a ， zhe jiu shi ni men cuo de di fang [ xiao huo zi / gu niang ]， yin wei xin de 、 gai jin de  Braindeath 'Rum' Classic  xian zai bi ren he ling xian de jing zheng dui shou dou e xin  200%！]

english: Legal disclaimer; the dangerous amount of disgustin' in new Braindeath 'Rum' Classic be too much for pregnant women, donkeys and anyone with more than seven letters in their last name.
translation: 法律免责声明；新的 Braindeath 'Rum' Classic 中的危险程度的恶心对于孕妇、驴子和任何姓氏超过七个字母的人来说是太多了。 [fa lv mian ze sheng ming ； xin de  Braindeath 'Rum' Classic  zhong de wei xian cheng du de e xin dui yu yun fu 、 lv zi he ren he xing shi chao guo qi ge zi mu de ren lai shuo shi tai duo le 。]

english: What was that?
translation: 那是什么？ [na shi shen me ？]

english: What was what?
translation: 什么是什么？ [shen me shi shen me ？]

english: Is there anything else?
translation: 还有别的吗？ [hai you bie de ma ？]

english: How do I get...
translation: 我怎样才能得到... [wo zen yang cai neng de dao ...]

english: Wait, no, that question makes me sound like I haven't a clue what I'm doing.
translation: 等等，不，这个问题让我听起来好像我不知道自己在做什么。 [deng deng ， bu ， zhe ge wen ti rang wo ting qi lai hao xiang wo bu zhi dao zi ji zai zuo shen me 。]

english: Where can I get buckets in there?
translation: 里面哪里可以买到桶？ [li mian na li ke yi mai dao tong ？]

english: There are a few lying about. Help yourself.
translation: 有几个躺着。帮助自己。 [you ji ge tang zhe 。 bang zhu zi ji 。]

english: There is a pump in the still, so long as it's working you should have almost unlimited water.
translation: 蒸馏器里有一个水泵，只要它工作，你就应该有几乎无限的水。 [zheng liu qi li you yi ge shui beng ， zhi yao ta gong zuo ， ni jiu ying gai you ji hu wu xian de shui 。]

english: Hold on, do I have to add anything disgusting and/or potential lethal to the water before I pour it in?
translation: 等一下，在倒入水中之前，我是否需要添加任何令人厌恶和/或可能致命的东西？ [deng yi xia ， zai dao ru shui zhong zhi qian ， wo shi fou xu yao tian jia ren he ling ren yan wu he / huo ke neng zhi ming de dong xi ？]

english: Perish the thought!
translation: 灭掉这个念头吧！ [mie diao zhe ge nian tou ba ！]

english: Ok, just checking.
translation: 好的，只是检查一下。 [hao de ， zhi shi jian cha yi xia 。]

english: What sort of coloured water are we talking about here?
translation: 我们在这里谈论什么样的有色水？ [wo men zai zhe li tan lun shen me yang de you se shui ？]

english: Well, the other still has an area of waste ground with a flower growing on it. If you go and grab one of the flowers and jam it in the kettle, the water will boil out the colour.
translation: 嗯，另一个还有一块荒地，上面长着一朵花。如果你去抓一朵花，把它塞进水壶里，水就会煮沸，颜色就会消失。 [n ， ling yi ge hai you yi kuai huang di ， shang mian zhang zhe yi duo hua 。 ru guo ni qu zhua yi duo hua ， ba ta sai jin shui hu li ， shui jiu hui zhu fei ， yan se jiu hui xiao shi 。]

english: We use the colour to keep our rum easily identifiable.
translation: 我们使用颜色来保持我们的朗姆酒易于识别。 [wo men shi yong yan se lai bao chi wo men de lang mu jiu yi yu shi bie 。]

english: So I just empty the kettle into the hopper, right?
translation: 所以我只是将水壶倒入料斗中，对吧？ [suo yi wo zhi shi jiang shui hu dao ru liao dou zhong ， dui ba ？]

english: No, no, you'll need to take an empty bowl and fill it from the kettle.
translation: 不，不，你需要拿一个空碗，然后从水壶里装满它。 [bu ， bu ， ni xu yao na yi ge kong wan ， ran hou cong shui hu li zhuang man ta 。]

english: That way you can use the stuff on a monkey if you need to.
translation: 这样，如果需要的话，你可以在猴子身上使用这些东西。 [zhe yang ， ru guo xu yao de hua ， ni ke yi zai hou zi shen shang shi yong zhe xie dong xi 。]

english: Use it on a monkey...of course.
translation: 当然可以用在猴子身上。 [dang ran ke yi yong zai hou zi shen shang 。]

english: How do I repair the still?
translation: 如何修理蒸馏器？ [ru he xiu li zheng liu qi ？]

english: Well, assuming those scurvy dogs have managed to set any of it on fire, then you'll need to tip a bucket of water on it before you can repair it.
translation: 好吧，假设那些坏血病的狗已经成功地点燃了其中的任何一个，那么您需要在修复它之前先倒一桶水。 [hao ba ， jia she na xie huai xue bing de gou yi jing cheng gong di dian ran le qi zhong de ren he yi ge ， na me nin xu yao zai xiu fu ta zhi qian xian dao yi tong shui 。]

english: Then, it all comes down to what part of it was damaged.
translation: 然后，一切都取决于它的哪一部分被损坏了。 [ran hou ， yi qie dou qu jue yu ta de na yi bu fen bei sun huai le 。]

english: How can I repair hoppers?
translation: 如何修理料斗？ [ru he xiu li liao dou ？]

english: Well, assuming that they are not on fire, all you need to do is use the heavy lumber patches. They are big enough to cover most holes.
translation: 好吧，假设它们没有着火，您所需要做的就是使用重型木材补丁。它们足够大，可以覆盖大多数孔。 [hao ba ， jia she ta men mei you zhao huo ， nin suo xu yao zuo de jiu shi shi yong zhong xing mu cai bu ding 。 ta men zu gou da ， ke yi fu gai da duo shu kong 。]

english: Will I need a hammer?
translation: 我需要锤子吗？ [wo xu yao chui zi ma ？]

english: No, just shove it into place and whack it until it lines up.
translation: 不，只需将其推入到位并敲击直至对齐即可。 [bu ， zhi xu jiang qi tui ru dao wei bing qiao ji zhi zhi dui qi ji ke 。]

english: How do I repair pipes and the pump?
translation: 如何修理管道和泵？ [ru he xiu li guan dao he beng ？]

english: Well, if you use a pipe section on the damaged part you should be able to replace it easily.
translation: 好吧，如果您在损坏的部分使用管道部分，您应该可以轻松更换它。 [hao ba ， ru guo nin zai sun huai de bu fen shi yong guan dao bu fen ， nin ying gai ke yi qing song geng huan ta 。]

english: No, likely you'll just need to whack the old one out and slot the new one in with your hands.
translation: 不，您可能只需要用手敲掉旧的，然后将新的插入即可。 [bu ， nin ke neng zhi xu yao yong shou qiao diao jiu de ， ran hou jiang xin de cha ru ji ke 。]

english: How do I repair bridges?
translation: 如何修复桥梁？ [ru he xiu fu qiao liang ？]

english: Well, we have these handy bridge sections you can use to repair the bridges.
translation: 好吧，我们有这些方便的桥梁部分，您可以用它来修复桥梁。 [hao ba ， wo men you zhe xie fang bian de qiao liang bu fen ， nin ke yi yong ta lai xiu fu qiao liang 。]

english: The main problem is, while a still will keep working if a bit of it is only damaged, the bridges are completely out of commission if they are even slightly damaged.
translation: 主要问题是，虽然蒸馏器只要有一点损坏就可以继续工作，但如果桥梁受到轻微损坏，就完全无法使用。 [zhu yao wen ti shi ， sui ran zheng liu qi zhi yao you yi dian sun huai jiu ke yi ji xu gong zuo ， dan ru guo qiao liang shou dao qing wei sun huai ， jiu wan quan wu fa shi yong 。]

english: Is that going to be a problem? I mean, I can jump across I think.
translation: 这会是一个问题吗？我的意思是，我想我可以跳过去。 [zhe hui shi yi ge wen ti ma ？ wo de yi si shi ， wo xiang wo ke yi tiao guo qu 。]

english: Don't try that! Our lawyers tell us we aren't covered for injuries sustained while jumping over burned bridges.
translation: 不要尝试那样！我们的律师告诉我们，我们不会因跳过烧毁的桥梁而受伤。 [bu yao chang shi na yang ！ wo men de lv shi gao su wo men ， wo men bu hui yin tiao guo shao hui de qiao liang er shou shang 。]

english: Seriously, just keep off the bridges until they are fixed.
translation: 说真的，在桥梁修好之前不要靠近它们。 [shuo zhen de ， zai qiao liang xiu hao zhi qian bu yao kao jin ta men 。]

english: Where do I get all this stuff anyway?
translation: 无论如何，我从哪里得到所有这些东西？ [wu lun ru he ， wo cong na li de dao suo you zhe xie dong xi ？]

english: We have a load of items already on a table inside the still. You can also make new ones if you grab some logs.
translation: 我们在蒸馏器内的桌子上已经放了很多东西。如果你抓住一些原木，你也可以制作新的。 [wo men zai zheng liu qi nei de zhuo zi shang yi jing fang le hen duo dong xi 。 ru guo ni zhua zhu yi xie yuan mu ， ni ye ke yi zhi zuo xin de 。]

english: How does that work?
translation: 这是如何运作的？ [zhe shi ru he yun zuo de ？]

english: We have a work table set up in the still. If you use the logs in it you can craft up a handy replacement for part of the still.
translation: 我们在蒸馏室里设置了一张工作台。如果你使用其中的原木，你可以制作一个方便的替代品来替代蒸馏器的一部分。 [wo men zai zheng liu shi li she zhi le yi zhang gong zuo tai 。 ru guo ni shi yong qi zhong de yuan mu ， ni ke yi zhi zuo yi ge fang bian de ti dai pin lai ti dai zheng liu qi de yi bu fen 。]

english: Don't worry about them fitting, the things are held together by nails, replacement parts and soot by now.
translation: 不用担心它们是否合适，现在这些东西已经用钉子、替换零件和烟灰固定在一起了。 [bu yong dan xin ta men shi fou he shi ， xian zai zhe xie dong xi yi jing yong ding zi 、 ti huan ling jian he yan hui gu ding zai yi qi le 。]

english: Well...how sanitary...
translation: 呃……卫生怎么样…… [e …… wei sheng zen me yang ……]

english: Ok, I think I've heard enough.
translation: 好吧，我想我已经听够了。 [hao ba ， wo xiang wo yi jing ting gou le 。]

english: Fine. Glad I could help.
translation: 美好的。很高兴我能帮忙。 [mei hao de 。 hen gao xing wo neng bang mang 。]

english: Ok, here's what you need to do.
translation: 好的，这就是您需要做的。 [hao de ， zhe jiu shi nin xu yao zuo de 。]

english: The wood around here is really dry and flammable, so take one of the torches, light it up, and then go and attack the enemy still with it.
translation: 这里周围的木材非常干燥且易燃，所以拿一根火把，点燃它，然后去攻击仍然拿着它的敌人。 [zhe li zhou wei de mu cai fei chang gan zao qie yi ran ， suo yi na yi gen huo ba ， dian ran ta ， ran hou qu gong ji reng ran na zhe ta de di ren 。]

english: That's it?
translation: 就是这样？ [jiu shi zhe yang ？]

english: Most of their still is soaked in 'alcohol' and made from tinder dry wood.
translation: 他们的大部分蒸馏器都浸泡在“酒精”中，并由火种干木制成。 [ta men de da bu fen zheng liu qi dou jin pao zai “ jiu jing ” zhong ， bing you huo zhong gan mu zhi cheng 。]

english: Essentially, if it isn't ours, try using a torch on it and see what happens.
translation: 本质上，如果它不是我们的，请尝试使用手电筒照射它，看看会发生什么。 [ben zhi shang ， ru guo ta bu shi wo men de ， qing chang shi shi yong shou dian tong zhao she ta ， kan kan hui fa sheng shen me 。]

english: Ok, I get you.
translation: 好的，我明白了。 [hao de ， wo ming bai le 。]

english: So what will you give me for helping out?
translation: 那么你会给我什么帮助呢？ [na me ni hui gei wo shen me bang zhu ne ？]

english: Hahahaha! What a mercenary attitude! You'll do fine here.
translation: 哈哈哈哈！这是多么唯利是图的态度啊！你在这里会做得很好。 [ha ha ha ha ！ zhe shi duo me wei li shi tu de tai du a ！ ni zai zhe li hui zuo de hen hao 。]

english: Well, for each bottle that your team produces, I'll give you one piece of eight.
translation: 好吧，你们团队每生产一瓶，我就给你们八瓶中的一瓶。 [hao ba ， ni men tuan dui mei sheng chan yi ping ， wo jiu gei ni men ba ping zhong de yi ping 。]

english: If you manage to set something on fire then I'll toss in another, same for repairing the still.
translation: 如果你成功地点燃了一些东西，那么我会扔掉另一个，修理蒸馏器也是如此。 [ru guo ni cheng gong di dian ran le yi xie dong xi ， na me wo hui reng diao ling yi ge ， xiu li zheng liu qi ye shi ru ci 。]

english: What can I use these pieces of eight for?
translation: 这八块可以用来做什么？ [zhe ba kuai ke yi yong lai zuo shen me ？]

english: See Honest Jimmy there? He'll trade you some pretty nice stuff for them.
translation: 看到诚实的吉米了吗？他会用一些非常好的东西来交换你。 [kan dao cheng shi de ji mi le ma ？ ta hui yong yi xie fei chang hao de dong xi lai jiao huan ni 。]

english: Great!
translation: 伟大的！ [wei da de ！]

english: I don't let anyone on the team if they are wearing a hat or a helmet.
translation: 如果任何人戴着帽子或头盔，我不会让他们加入团队。 [ru guo ren he ren dai zhe mao zi huo tou kui ， wo bu hui rang ta men jia ru tuan dui 。]

english: I'll be glad to have you aboard, but you will need to go and store all of your gear first.
translation: 我很高兴您能上船，但您需要先去存放所有装备。 [wo hen gao xing nin neng shang chuan ， dan nin xu yao xian qu cun fang suo you zhuang bei 。]

english: Sadly for you I have more than enough people on my crew.
translation: 对你来说可悲的是，我的船员已经足够多了。 [dui ni lai shuo ke bei de shi ， wo de chuan yuan yi jing zu gou duo le 。]

english: Is that... thing yours?
translation: 那……东西是你的吗？ [na …… dong xi shi ni de ma ？]

english: This minigame is unavailable on this world.
translation: 这个小游戏在这个世界上是不可用的。 [zhe ge xiao you xi zai zhe ge shi jie shang shi bu ke yong de 。]

english: So, how well can you cook?
translation: 那么，你的厨艺有多好呢？ [na me ， ni de chu yi you duo hao ne ？]

english: Well, I can, err, cook a bit...
translation: 好吧，我可以，呃，煮一点…… [hao ba ， wo ke yi ， e ， zhu yi dian ……]

english: Well 'a bit' doesn't cut it in here. Come back when you have a cooking level of 40.
translation: 好吧，“一点”在这里并没有意义。当你的烹饪等级达到40级时再回来。 [hao ba ，“ yi dian ” zai zhe li bing mei you yi yi 。 dang ni de peng ren deng ji da dao 40 ji shi zai hui lai 。]

english: Anyone lookin' fer work?
translation: 有人在找工作吗？ [you ren zai zhao gong zuo ma ？]

english: Arr! Looking fer good pirates!
translation: 啊！寻找优秀的海盗！ [a ！ xun zhao you xiu de hai dao ！]

english: Come join me crew!
translation: 快来加入我的队伍吧！ [kuai lai jia ru wo de dui wu ba ！]

english: Don't join them, join us!
translation: 不要加入他们，加入我们吧！ [bu yao jia ru ta men ， jia ru wo men ba ！]

english: Free(ish) rum fer all!
translation: 免费朗姆酒！ [mian fei lang mu jiu ！]

english: Join the winnin' team now!
translation: 立即加入获胜团队！ [li ji jia ru huo sheng tuan dui ！]

english: Need pirates fer brewin'!
translation: 需要海盗来酿造！ [xu yao hai dao lai niang zao ！]

english: Recruiting!
translation: 招募中！ [zhao mu zhong ！]

english: Roll up, roll up!
translation: 卷起来，卷起来！ [juan qi lai ， juan qi lai ！]

english: We have dental!
translation: 我们有牙科！ [wo men you ya ke ！]

english: I would like to join your crew.
translation: 我想加入你们的团队。 [wo xiang jia ru ni men de tuan dui 。]

english: Who are you, and what is this place?
translation: 你是谁，这是什么地方？ [ni shi shui ， zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Brewing 'Rum'
translation: 酿造“朗姆酒” [niang zao “ lang mu jiu ”]

english: Where can I get Bitternuts?
translation: 哪里可以买到苦果？ [na li ke yi mai dao ku guo ？]

english: Can I ask about something else?
translation: 我可以问点别的吗？ [wo ke yi wen dian bie de ma ？]

english: Repairing the Still
translation: 修复蒸馏器 [xiu fu zheng liu qi]

english: Sabotaging the Still
translation: 破坏蒸馏器 [po huai zheng liu qi]

english: What will you pay me?
translation: 你要付给我什么？ [ni yao fu gei wo shen me ？]

english: Ok, I think I've heard enough
translation: 好吧，我想我已经听够了 [hao ba ， wo xiang wo yi jing ting gou le]

english: Where can I get Scrapey Tree Bark?
translation: 哪里可以买到刮皮树皮？ [na li ke yi mai dao gua pi shu pi ？]

english: Where can I get Sweetgrubs?
translation: 我在哪里可以获得甜幼虫？ [wo zai na li ke yi huo de tian you chong ？]

english: Where can I get buckets of water?
translation: 我在哪里可以获得水桶？ [wo zai na li ke yi huo de shui tong ？]

english: Where can I get coloured water?
translation: 哪里可以买到有色水？ [na li ke yi mai dao you se shui ？]

english: How do I repair Hoppers?
translation: 如何修理料斗？ [ru he xiu li liao dou ？]

english: How do I repair Pipes and the pump?
translation: 如何修理管道和泵？ [ru he xiu li guan dao he beng ？]

english: How do I repair Bridges?
translation: 如何修复桥梁？ [ru he xiu fu qiao liang ？]

english: How do I get repair items?
translation: 我如何获得维修物品？ [wo ru he huo de wei xiu wu pin ？]

english: How Do I repair Hoppers?
translation: 如何修理料斗？ [ru he xiu li liao dou ？]

english: How do I get repair items
translation: 我如何获得维修物品 [wo ru he huo de wei xiu wu pin]

english: Sabotaging San's Still
translation: 破坏桑氏蒸馏器 [po huai sang shi zheng liu qi]

english: Ha, well I'm retired now, but in my heyday I was quite the expert fisherman! These days I just help out around the village where I can, my old bones don't allow me to do any more than that.
translation: 哈，好吧，我现在已经退休了，但在我全盛时期，我还是个钓鱼高手！这些天我只是在村子里尽我所能帮忙，我的老骨头不允许我做更多的事情。 [ha ， hao ba ， wo xian zai yi jing tui xiu le ， dan zai wo quan sheng shi qi ， wo hai shi ge diao yu gao shou ！ zhe xie tian wo zhi shi zai cun zi li jin wo suo neng bang mang ， wo de lao gu tou bu yun xu wo zuo geng duo de shi qing 。]

english: Is there anything interesting to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么好玩的吗？ [zhe fu jin you shen me hao wan de ma ？]

english: Bwana, if anyone else asks me that question today, I'll explode! Go and ask someone else!
translation: Bwana，如果今天还有人问我这个问题，我会爆炸的！你去问问别人吧！ [Bwana， ru guo jin tian hai you ren wen wo zhe ge wen ti ， wo hui bao zha de ！ ni qu wen wen bie ren ba ！]

english: Not that I'm aware of, just sit back and enjoy the sunshine bwana!
translation: 我不知道，只是坐下来享受阳光 bwana！ [wo bu zhi dao ， zhi shi zuo xia lai xiang shou yang guang  bwana！]

english: Well, I think that there's some work to be done...perhaps Murcaily can help you. He usually tends to the hardwood grove to the east of Trufitus's hut.
translation: 嗯，我认为还有一些工作要做……也许 Murcaily 可以帮助你。他通常照料特鲁菲特斯小屋东边的硬木树林。 [n ， wo ren wei hai you yi xie gong zuo yao zuo …… ye xu  Murcaily  ke yi bang zhu ni 。 ta tong chang zhao liao te lu fei te si xiao wu dong bian de ying mu shu lin 。]

english: It's just village life as normal around here Bwana, always something interesting to find to occupy your time if you look hard enough.
translation: 布瓦纳（Bwana）这里的乡村生活一如往常，只要您仔细观察，总能找到一些有趣的东西来打发您的时间。 [bu wa na （Bwana） zhe li de xiang cun sheng huo yi ru wang chang ， zhi yao nin zi xi guan cha ， zong neng zhao dao yi xie you qu de dong xi lai da fa nin de shi jian 。]

english: Sorry Bwana, I'm already busy, why not go and talk to Murcaily! He's around the village somewhere.
translation: 抱歉 Bwana，我已经很忙了，为什么不去和 Murcaily 谈谈呢！他就在村子附近的某个地方。 [bao qian  Bwana， wo yi jing hen mang le ， wei shen me bu qu he  Murcaily  tan tan ne ！ ta jiu zai cun zi fu jin de mou ge di fang 。]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello there...thanks for helping out Trufitus commune with the gods Bwana. We've been able to return to the village thanks to your help.
translation: 你好……感谢您帮助 Trufitus 与众神 Bwana 交流。多亏了你的帮助，我们才得以返回村庄。 [ni hao …… gan xie nin bang zhu  Trufitus  yu zhong shen  Bwana  jiao liu 。 duo kui le ni de bang zhu ， wo men cai de yi fan hui cun zhuang 。]

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 我一直在村里做一些工作。 [wo yi zhi zai cun li zuo yi xie gong zuo 。]

english: Yeah, you've been doing a lot of good work around here. Let me give you something for your time and effort.
translation: 是的，你在这里做了很多出色的工作。让我给你一些东西来补偿你的时间和精力。 [shi de ， ni zai zhe li zuo le hen duo chu se de gong zuo 。 rang wo gei ni yi xie dong xi lai bu chang ni de shi jian he jing li 。]

english: I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: 我已经给了你一些交易棒，现在我身上没有了。为什么不去和其他一些村民谈谈并获得一些捐款呢？ [wo yi jing gei le ni yi xie jiao yi bang ， xian zai wo shen shang mei you le 。 wei shen me bu qu he qi ta yi xie cun min tan tan bing huo de yi xie juan kuan ne ？]

english: Ahhhhhhhh - Get away from me you beast!
translation: 啊啊啊——你这个畜生，离我远点！ [a a a —— ni zhe ge chu sheng ， li wo yuan dian ！]

english: What's the problem....oh, I'm wearing this big scary mask! I'd better take it off before I start talking to the natives.
translation: 有什么问题......哦，我戴着这个可怕的大面具！在我开始和当地人交谈之前我最好把它摘下来。 [you shen me wen ti ...... o ， wo dai zhe zhe ge ke pa de da mian ju ！ zai wo kai shi he dang di ren jiao tan zhi qian wo zui hao ba ta zhai xia lai 。]

english: Ahhhhhhhh!
translation: 啊啊啊啊！ [a a a a ！]

english: Ahhhhhhhh - It's a monster!
translation: 啊啊啊——这是一个怪物！ [a a a —— zhe shi yi ge guai wu ！]

english: Waahhhhh! - It's da evil broodoo beast come ta eat my very soul!
translation: 哇啊啊啊！ - 这是一只邪恶的母兽来吃掉我的灵魂！ [wa a a a ！ -  zhe shi yi zhi xie e de mu shou lai chi diao wo de ling hun ！]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: 这里有什么有趣的事情可以做吗？ [zhe li you shen me you qu de shi qing ke yi zuo ma ？]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 我一直在村里做一些工作。 [wo yi zhi zai cun li zuo yi xie gong zuo 。]

english: Hello, little boy.
translation: 你好，小男孩。 [ni hao ， xiao nan hai 。]

english: I would prefer it if you didn't speak to me in such a manner. I'll have you know I'm an accomplished merchant.
translation: 我希望你不要以这种方式对我说话。我会让你知道我是一个有成就的商人。 [wo xi wang ni bu yao yi zhe zhong fang shi dui wo shuo hua 。 wo hui rang ni zhi dao wo shi yi ge you cheng jiu de shang ren 。]

english: Calm down, junior.
translation: 冷静点，少年。 [leng jing dian ， shao nian 。]

english: Don't tell me to calm down! And don't call me 'junior'.
translation: 别告诉我要冷静！还有，别叫我‘小辈’。 [bie gao su wo yao leng jing ！ hai you ， bie jiao wo ‘ xiao bei ’。]

english: I'll have you know I am Farid Morrisane, son of Ali Morrisane, the world's greatest merchant!
translation: 我会让你知道我是法里德·莫里萨尼 (Farid Morrisane)，世界上最伟大的商人阿里·莫里萨尼 (Ali Morrisane) 的儿子！ [wo hui rang ni zhi dao wo shi fa li de · mo li sa ni  (Farid Morrisane)， shi jie shang zui wei da de shang ren a li · mo li sa ni  (Ali Morrisane)  de er zi ！]

english: Then why are you here and not him?
translation: 那为什么你在这里而不是他？ [na wei shen me ni zai zhe li er bu shi ta ？]

english: My dad has given me the responsibility of expanding our business here.
translation: 我父亲赋予我在这里拓展业务的责任。 [wo fu qin fu yu wo zai zhe li tuo zhan ye wu de ze ren 。]

english: And you're up to the task? What a grown up boy you are! Mummy and daddy must be very pleased!
translation: 你能胜任这项任务吗？你是一个多么大的男孩啊！爸爸妈妈一定很高兴吧！ [ni neng sheng ren zhe xiang ren wu ma ？ ni shi yi ge duo me da de nan hai a ！ ba ba ma ma yi ding hen gao xing ba ！]

english: Look, [mate/darling] - I may be young, I may be short, but I'm a respected merchant around here and don't have time to deal with simpletons like you.
translation: 听着，[伙伴/亲爱的] - 我可能很年轻，我可能很矮，但我是这里受人尊敬的商人，没有时间和像你这样的傻瓜打交道。 [ting zhe ，[ huo ban / qin ai de ] -  wo ke neng hen nian qing ， wo ke neng hen ai ， dan wo shi zhe li shou ren zun jing de shang ren ， mei you shi jian he xiang ni zhe yang de sha gua da jiao dao 。]

english: Can you show me the prices of ores and bars?
translation: 你能告诉我矿石和金锭的价格吗？ [ni neng gao su wo kuang shi he jin ding de jia ge ma ？]

english: I best go and speak with someone more my height.
translation: 我最好去和比我身高高的人说话。 [wo zui hao qu he bi wo shen gao gao de ren shuo hua 。]

english: Then I shall not stop you, [mister/miss]. I've too much work to do.
translation: 那我就不会阻止你了，[先生/小姐]。我有太多的工作要做。 [na wo jiu bu hui zu zhi ni le ，[ xian sheng / xiao jie ]。 wo you tai duo de gong zuo yao zuo 。]

english: My father shall be so pleased.
translation: 我父亲一定会很高兴的。 [wo fu qin yi ding hui hen gao xing de 。]

english: Hmm. If divide by 20 and take off 50%...
translation: 唔。如果除以 20，减去 50%... [wu 。 ru guo chu yi  20， jian qu  50%...]

english: Woo hoo! What a sale!
translation: 呜呼！卖得多好啊！ [wu hu ！ mai de duo hao a ！]

english: What shall I trade next...
translation: 接下来我该交易什么... [jie xia lai wo gai jiao yi shen me ...]

english: I can make so much money here!
translation: 我在这里可以赚很多钱！ [wo zai zhe li ke yi zhuan hen duo qian ！]

english: Calm down, junior.
translation: 冷静点，少年。 [leng jing dian ， shao nian 。]

english: Can you show me the prices of ores and bars?
translation: 你能告诉我矿石和金锭的价格吗？ [ni neng gao su wo kuang shi he jin ding de jia ge ma ？]

english: I best go and speak with someone more my height.
translation: 我最好去和比我身高高的人说话。 [wo zui hao qu he bi wo shen gao gao de ren shuo hua 。]

english: Oi! Leave my wheat alone!
translation: 哎呀！别管我的小麦！ [ai ya ！ bie guan wo de xiao mai ！]

english: Hello stranger.
translation: 你好陌生人。 [ni hao mo sheng ren 。]

english: You look like a farmer. Don't see many farmers around here.
translation: 你看起来像个农民。这附近看不到多少农民。 [ni kan qi lai xiang ge nong min 。 zhe fu jin kan bu dao duo shao nong min 。]

english: Aye, that you don't. I'm from Hosidius, y'see. I just come here to drink.
translation: 是的，你不知道。我来自霍西迪乌斯，你瞧。我只是来这里喝酒而已。 [shi de ， ni bu zhi dao 。 wo lai zi huo xi di wu si ， ni qiao 。 wo zhi shi lai zhe li he jiu er yi 。]

english: You travel all the way out to Shayzien just for a few beers? Don't you have a pub back home?
translation: 您大老远跑到 Shayzien 只是为了喝几杯啤酒吗？你家里没有酒吧吗？ [nin da lao yuan pao dao  Shayzien  zhi shi wei le he ji bei pi jiu ma ？ ni jia li mei you jiu ba ma ？]

english: Indeed we do... But I can't stand the place for more than a few minutes.
translation: 确实如此……但我无法忍受这个地方超过几分钟。 [que shi ru ci …… dan wo wu fa ren shou zhe ge di fang chao guo ji fen zhong 。]

english: Have you ever been in there? Such a rowdy crowd... people shouting across the bar about 'Farming this', 'Farming that'... can barely hear myself think half the time.
translation: 你去过那里吗？一群吵闹的人群……人们在酒吧对面喊着“种这个”、“种那个”……有一半时间几乎听不到自己的思考。 [ni qu guo na li ma ？ yi qun chao nao de ren qun …… ren men zai jiu ba dui mian han zhe “ zhong zhe ge ”、“ zhong na ge ”…… you yi ban shi jian ji hu ting bu dao zi ji de si kao 。]

english: No, no... Can't be doin' with it. That's why I make the trip out here for a nice quiet one.
translation: 不，不……不能这样。这就是为什么我来这里是为了享受一次安静的旅行。 [bu ， bu …… bu neng zhe yang 。 zhe jiu shi wei shen me wo lai zhe li shi wei le xiang shou yi ci an jing de lv xing 。]

english: Well I'd better leave you to it then!
translation: 好吧，那我最好还是让你自己做吧！ [hao ba ， na wo zui hao hai shi rang ni zi ji zuo ba ！]

english: Exchuse me... I am trying to tell my verrry good friends 'bout the biggest bull I ever raised.
translation: 对不起……我正想告诉我的好朋友我养过的最大的公牛。 [dui bu qi …… wo zheng xiang gao su wo de hao peng you wo yang guo de zui da de gong niu 。]

english: Exchuse me... I am lishning to my good friend.
translation: 对不起……我正在向我的好朋友询问。 [dui bu qi …… wo zheng zai xiang wo de hao peng you xun wen 。]

english: Mean pair of horns he'd got.
translation: 他有一对很卑鄙的角。 [ta you yi dui hen bei bi de jiao 。]

english: Got enough leather off 'im for a new carpet.
translation: 我有足够的皮革来买新地毯。 [wo you zu gou de pi ge lai mai xin di tan 。]

english: Grew to the size of a cart, I swear!
translation: 长到了一辆手推车那么大，我发誓！ [zhang dao le yi liang shou tui che na me da ， wo fa shi ！]

english: It's not like that these days.
translation: 如今可不是这样了。 [ru jin ke bu shi zhe yang le 。]

english: 'E went MOO MOO MOO all night.
translation: 整个晚上都在“哞哞哞”地叫着。 [zheng ge wan shang dou zai “ mou mou mou ” di jiao zhe 。]

english: Never had a year like that since.
translation: 从那以后再也没有过这样的一年。 [cong na yi hou zai ye mei you guo zhe yang de yi nian 。]

english: That prize should've been mine!
translation: 那个奖品本来应该是我的！ [na ge jiang pin ben lai ying gai shi wo de ！]

english: Ol' Hosidius thought we'd need a bigger barn.
translation: 老霍西迪乌斯认为我们需要一个更大的谷仓。 [lao huo xi di wu si ren wei wo men xu yao yi ge geng da de gu cang 。]

english: Best bull I ever 'ad.
translation: 我做过的最好的公牛。 [wo zuo guo de zui hao de gong niu 。]

english: I've got a brand new plough!
translation: 我有一把全新的犁！ [wo you yi ba quan xin de li ！]

english: No-one got so much corn out of one field before.
translation: 以前没有人从一块地里收获这么多玉米。 [yi qian mei you ren cong yi kuai di li shou huo zhe me duo yu mi 。]

english: Sacks and sacks of grain like you've never seen!
translation: 一袋又一袋的谷物，就像您从未见过的一样！ [yi dai you yi dai de gu wu ， jiu xiang nin cong wei jian guo de yi yang ！]

english: Hosidius says we gotta optimise land use. Bleah!
translation: 霍西迪乌斯说我们必须优化土地利用。哎呀！ [huo xi di wu si shuo wo men bi xu you hua tu di li yong 。 ai ya ！]

english: Them dwarves won't pay a decent price anymore.
translation: 他们矮人不会再付出像样的代价了。 [ta men ai ren bu hui zai fu chu xiang yang de dai jia le 。]

english: Best harvest we'd ever 'ad.
translation: 我们有史以来最好的收获。 [wo men you shi yi lai zui hao de shou huo 。]

english: 'Course, the weather were better back then.
translation: 当然，那时的天气更好。 [dang ran ， na shi de tian qi geng hao 。]

english: Fed the kids for a year off 'is beef.
translation: 给孩子们休息一年的食物就是牛肉。 [gei hai zi men xiu xi yi nian de shi wu jiu shi niu rou 。]

english: Could 'ave passed for a mammoth.
translation: 可能被误认为是猛犸象。 [ke neng bei wu ren wei shi meng ma xiang 。]

english: Ain't no-one ever tipped that bull.
translation: 从来没有人倾斜过那头公牛。 [cong lai mei you ren qing xie guo na tou gong niu 。]

english: You've never seen a bull like 'im.
translation: 你从来没有见过像他这样的公牛。 [ni cong lai mei you jian guo xiang ta zhe yang de gong niu 。]

english: Pearls of wisdom!
translation: 智慧的珍珠！ [zhi hui de zhen zhu ！]

english: Ah, tell it!
translation: 啊，快说吧！ [a ， kuai shuo ba ！]

english: Best times ever!
translation: 有史以来最好的时光！ [you shi yi lai zui hao de shi guang ！]

english: Right you are.
translation: 你是对的。 [ni shi dui de 。]

english: Great days!
translation: 美好的日子！ [mei hao de ri zi ！]

english: I'm going to be sick!
translation: 我要生病了！ [wo yao sheng bing le ！]

english: You're right.
translation: 你说得对。 [ni shuo de dui 。]

english: You're so right.
translation: 你说得太对了。 [ni shuo de tai dui le 。]

english: Those were the days!
translation: 那些日子！ [na xie ri zi ！]

english: Not like nowadays.
translation: 不像现在。 [bu xiang xian zai 。]

english: Hello there. How's it going?
translation: 你好呀。怎么样了？ [ni hao ya 。 zen me yang le ？]

english: Well the work is going well, so I'm very good, thank you.
translation: 嗯，工作进展顺利，所以我很好，谢谢。 [n ， gong zuo jin zhan shun li ， suo yi wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Not too bad thanks.
translation: 还不错，谢谢。 [hai bu cuo ， xie xie 。]

english: I'm fine, how are you?
translation: 我很好，你怎么样？ [wo hen hao ， ni zen me yang ？]

english: Very well, thank you.
translation: 很好，谢谢。 [hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Nilsal! I'm pretty good, thank you. It's always nice to be out in the sun.
translation: 尼尔萨尔！我很好，谢谢。出去晒太阳总是很好的。 [ni er sa er ！ wo hen hao ， xie xie 。 chu qu shai tai yang zong shi hen hao de 。]

english: Hello there! Nice weather we've been having. Perfect for a day outdoors!
translation: 你好呀！我们一直以来天气很好。非常适合户外一天！ [ni hao ya ！ wo men yi zhi yi lai tian qi hen hao 。 fei chang shi he hu wai yi tian ！]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: I have all the bad luck. My sheep all run off somewhere, and then those mourners tell me they're infected!
translation: 我的运气都不好。我的羊都跑到某个地方了，然后那些哀悼者告诉我他们被感染了！ [wo de yun qi dou bu hao 。 wo de yang dou pao dao mou ge di fang le ， ran hou na xie ai dao zhe gao su wo ta men bei gan ran le ！]

english: Well, I hope things start to look up for you.
translation: 好吧，我希望你的情况开始好转。 [hao ba ， wo xi wang ni de qing kuang kai shi hao zhuan 。]

english: Hello there. Sorry about your sheep...
translation: 你好呀。对不起你的羊... [ni hao ya 。 dui bu qi ni de yang ...]

english: That's okay, it had to be done for the sake of the town.
translation: 没关系，为了镇子的利益，必须这么做。 [mei guan xi ， wei le zhen zi de li yi ， bi xu zhe me zuo 。]

english: That's okay, you are not to blame. I'm just glad the truth behind the plague was eventually revealed.
translation: 没关系，你不应该受到责备。我很高兴瘟疫背后的真相最终被揭露。 [mei guan xi ， ni bu ying gai shou dao ze bei 。 wo hen gao xing wen yi bei hou de zhen xiang zui zhong bei jie lu 。]

english: Good day. What are you doing?
translation: 再会。你在干什么？ [zai hui 。 ni zai gan shen me ？]

english: I'm tending to these farming patches. They need a little more work before I can plant anything.
translation: 我正在照料这些农田。在我种植任何东西之前，他们还需要做一些工作。 [wo zheng zai zhao liao zhe xie nong tian 。 zai wo zhong zhi ren he dong xi zhi qian ， ta men hai xu yao zuo yi xie gong zuo 。]

english: Good luck with that.
translation: 祝你好运。 [zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Thank you, [Fremennik name].
translation: 谢谢你，[弗雷曼尼克名字]。 [xie xie ni ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。]

english: What's wrong with the patches?
translation: 补丁出了什么问题？ [bu ding chu le shen me wen ti ？]

english: The centre patch is full of weeds, and as soon as I clear them they grow back. The south patch is always far too dry. And the soil in the north patch is terrible; it needs a good dose of compost.
translation: 中间那块地方长满了杂草，我一清理掉它们，它们又长出来了。南部地区总是太干燥。北方的土壤很糟糕；它需要大量的堆肥。 [zhong jian na kuai di fang zhang man le za cao ， wo yi qing li diao ta men ， ta men you zhang chu lai le 。 nan bu di qu zong shi tai gan zao 。 bei fang de tu rang hen zao gao ； ta xu yao da liang de dui fei 。]

english: Can you tell me how the kingdom approves of me?
translation: 你能告诉我王国对我的认可度如何吗？ [ni neng gao su wo wang guo dui wo de ren ke du ru he ma ？]

english: [amount]% of people approve of you.
translation: [数量]％的人赞同你。 [[ shu liang ]％ de ren zan tong ni 。]

english: Kingdom? Etceteria is ruled by a Queen and we don't approve of you.
translation: 王国？等等都是由女王统治的，我们不赞成你。 [wang guo ？ deng deng dou shi you nv wang tong zhi de ， wo men bu zan cheng ni 。]

english: Don't trouble yourself further, Your Highness, you've already done so much!
translation: 殿下不要再为难了，您已经做了这么多了！ [dian xia bu yao zai wei nan le ， nin yi jing zuo le zhe me duo le ！]

english: Hey! This is the Queen's farm. You'll need her approval to make use of it.
translation: 嘿！这里是女王的农场。您需要获得她的批准才能使用它。 [hei ！ zhe li shi nv wang de nong chang 。 nin xu yao huo de ta de pi zhun cai neng shi yong ta 。]

english: The storerooms are full, your Highness. You should talk to Advisor Ghrim to collect what we've gathered for you.
translation: 殿下，储藏室已经满了。您应该与 Ghrim 顾问交谈以收集我们为您收集的信息。 [dian xia ， chu cang shi yi jing man le 。 nin ying gai yu  Ghrim  gu wen jiao tan yi shou ji wo men wei nin shou ji de xin xi 。]

english: Good luck with that.
translation: 祝你好运。 [zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: What's wrong with the patches?
translation: 补丁出了什么问题？ [bu ding chu le shen me wen ti ？]

english: Hello, young [sir/lady]. Did you want to work on my farm?
translation: 你好，年轻的[先生/女士]。你想在我的农场工作吗？ [ni hao ， nian qing de [ xian sheng / nv shi ]。 ni xiang zai wo de nong chang gong zuo ma ？]

english: Tell me about your farm.
translation: 告诉我你的农场的情况。 [gao su wo ni de nong chang de qing kuang 。]

english: I grow fruit here. Special fruit. It grows very fast, but it needs a lot of tending, otherwise it gets the blight and dies.
