translation: 我这里种水果。特殊水果。它生长得很快，但需要大量照料，否则就会枯萎死亡。 [wo zhe li zhong shui guo 。 te shu shui guo 。 ta sheng zhang de hen kuai ， dan xu yao da liang zhao liao ， fou ze jiu hui ku wei si wang 。]

english: These days I'm getting old and slow. You can see all the dead plants from where I've tried to farm them.
translation: 这些天我变老了，行动迟缓了。你可以从我尝试种植的地方看到所有死去的植物。 [zhe xie tian wo bian lao le ， xing dong chi huan le 。 ni ke yi cong wo chang shi zhong zhi de di fang kan dao suo you si qu de zhi wu 。]

english: Life here seems rather peaceful.
translation: 这里的生活显得相当平静。 [zhe li de sheng huo xian de xiang dang ping jing 。]

english: It is most of the time. Something very strange did happen recently though.
translation: 大多数时候都是如此。不过最近发生了一些非常奇怪的事情。 [da duo shu shi hou dou shi ru ci 。 bu guo zui jin fa sheng le yi xie fei chang qi guai de shi qing 。]

english: Oh yeah? What happened?
translation: 哦，是吗？发生了什么？ [o ， shi ma ？ fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: Well, you see... Two strange hooded figures recently visited the farm. They had an odd smell to them and kept their faces hidden.
translation: 好吧，你看……最近有两个戴着兜帽的奇怪人物来到了农场。他们身上散发着奇怪的气味，并把脸隐藏起来。 [hao ba ， ni kan …… zui jin you liang ge dai zhe dou mao de qi guai ren wu lai dao le nong chang 。 ta men shen shang san fa zhe qi guai de qi wei ， bing ba lian yin cang qi lai 。]

english: They said they represented some client from the far east and that they wanted to inspect the farm. They had a good look around but seemed rather disappointed when they left.
translation: 他们说他们代表了一些来自远东的客户，他们想参观农场。他们环顾四周，但离开时却显得相当失望。 [ta men shuo ta men dai biao le yi xie lai zi yuan dong de ke hu ， ta men xiang can guan nong chang 。 ta men huan gu si zhou ， dan li kai shi que xian de xiang dang shi wang 。]

english: Oh... I'm sure it was nothing.
translation: 哦...我确信这没什么。 [o ... wo que xin zhe mei shen me 。]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: I'm a fruit farmer. But now I'm a bit too old for that. Maybe I should try writing books again, like I did when I was younger.
translation: 我是一名果农。但现在我已经有点太老了。也许我应该再次尝试写书，就像我年轻时那样。 [wo shi yi ming guo nong 。 dan xian zai wo yi jing you dian tai lao le 。 ye xu wo ying gai zai ci chang shi xie shu ， jiu xiang wo nian qing shi na yang 。]

english: I'd like to work on your farm.
translation: 我想去你们的农场工作。 [wo xiang qu ni men de nong chang gong zuo 。]

english: Well, I'm afraid you're not really suitable.
translation: 嗯，恐怕你不太适合。 [n ， kong pa ni bu tai shi he 。]

english: You do not have enough Hosidius favour. Current favour: [number]% - Required: 100.0%
translation: 你没有得到足够的霍西迪乌斯青睐。当前喜好：[数量]% - 需要：100.0% [ni mei you de dao zu gou de huo xi di wu si qing lai 。 dang qian xi hao ：[ shu liang ]% -  xu yao ：100.0%]

english: Alright. Take a handful of seeds from the table, and head into the farm. When you've harvested some fruit, deposit it straight into the sacks.
translation: 好吧。从桌子上拿一把种子，然后前往农场。收获一些水果后，将其直接放入麻袋中。 [hao ba 。 cong zhuo zi shang na yi ba zhong zi ， ran hou qian wang nong chang 。 shou huo yi xie shui guo hou ， jiang qi zhi jie fang ru ma dai zhong 。]

english: Remember, you have to water the plants at each stage, otherwise they die of the blight. Fertiliser makes them grow faster... or die faster if you don't water them.
translation: 请记住，您必须在每个阶段给植物浇水，否则它们会死于枯萎病。肥料会让它们长得更快……或者如果你不给它们浇水，它们就会死得更快。 [qing ji zhu ， nin bi xu zai mei ge jie duan gei zhi wu jiao shui ， fou ze ta men hui si yu ku wei bing 。 fei liao hui rang ta men zhang de geng kuai …… huo zhe ru guo ni bu gei ta men jiao shui ， ta men jiu hui si de geng kuai 。]

english: You'll gain a little extra experience if you grow enough of the fruit successfully.
translation: 如果你成功种植足够的水果，你将获得一些额外的经验。 [ru guo ni cheng gong zhong zhi zu gou de shui guo ， ni jiang huo de yi xie e wai de jing yan 。]

english: Have you any rewards?
translation: 你有奖励吗？ [ni you jiang li ma ？]

english: I need to go.
translation: 我需要去。 [wo xu yao qu 。]

english: What on earth are you wearing?
translation: 你到底穿什么？ [ni dao di chuan shen me ？]

english: I'm here to do some tithing. Blood tithing.
translation: 我来这里是为了缴纳什一税。血什一奉献。 [wo lai zhe li shi wei le jiao na shen yi shui 。 xue shen yi feng xian 。]

english: Well this is not that kind of farm! I only let normal people work here, so get lost!
translation: 嗯，这不是那种农场！我只让普通人在这里工作，所以滚吧！ [n ， zhe bu shi na zhong nong chang ！ wo zhi rang pu tong ren zai zhe li gong zuo ， suo yi gun ba ！]

english: You show the book to Farmer Gricoller.
translation: 你把这本书拿给农夫格里科勒看。 [ni ba zhe ben shu na gei nong fu ge li ke lei kan 。]

english: Oh, yes, I remember writing that a long time ago. I told the publisher it should be in the public domain, so that everyone could share the knowledge.
translation: 哦，是的，我记得很久以前就写过。我告诉出版商它应该属于公共领域，以便每个人都可以分享知识。 [o ， shi de ， wo ji de hen jiu yi qian jiu xie guo 。 wo gao su chu ban shang ta ying gai shu yu gong gong ling yu ， yi bian mei ge ren dou ke yi fen xiang zhi shi 。]

english: Of course, that was before I got so old and found I couldn't afford to hire workers for my farm. Oh well, I hope it helped someone. It wasn't much use to anyone around here.
translation: 当然，那是在我年纪太大并发现我无力为我的农场雇用工人之前。哦，好吧，我希望它对某人有帮助。这对这里的任何人来说都没有多大用处。 [dang ran ， na shi zai wo nian ji tai da bing fa xian wo wu li wei wo de nong chang gu yong gong ren zhi qian 。 o ， hao ba ， wo xi wang ta dui mou ren you bang zhu 。 zhe dui zhe li de ren he ren lai shuo dou mei you duo da yong chu 。]

english: Are you the 'Gric' this entry mentions?
translation: 您是本文提到的“Gric”吗？ [nin shi ben wen ti dao de “Gric” ma ？]

english: You show him 'Lunch by the Lancalliums'.
translation: 你给他看了《兰卡利姆家的午餐》。 [ni gei ta kan le 《 lan ka li mu jia de wu can 》。]

english: Yes, I was friends with the last king, it was very sad when he died. The accusations aimed at poor little Rose were ridiculous.
translation: 是的，我是最后一位国王的朋友，他去世时我非常难过。针对可怜的小罗斯的指控是荒谬的。 [shi de ， wo shi zui hou yi wei guo wang de peng you ， ta qu shi shi wo fei chang nan guo 。 zhen dui ke lian de xiao luo si de zhi kong shi huang miu de 。]

english: Accusations?
translation: 指控？ [zhi kong ？]

english: It was all nonesense, the king died naturally! He was old, he'd been on the throne for at least 40 years.
translation: 都是废话，王自然死了！他年纪大了，已经在位至少四十年了。 [dou shi fei hua ， wang zi ran si le ！ ta nian ji da le ， yi jing zai wei zhi shao si shi nian le 。]

english: Interesting, so he must have waited a while before having children?
translation: 有趣，所以他一定是等了一段时间才生孩子的？ [you qu ， suo yi ta yi ding shi deng le yi duan shi jian cai sheng hai zi de ？]

english: Indeed, he married late and his wife... Unfortunately didn't survive bringing Rose into this world.
translation: 确实，他结婚晚了，他的妻子……不幸的是没能活下来，将罗丝带到这个世界上。 [que shi ， ta jie hun wan le ， ta de qi zi …… bu xing de shi mei neng huo xia lai ， jiang luo si dai dao zhe ge shi jie shang 。]

english: Oh right, have you seen Rose recently?
translation: 哦对了，你最近见过罗斯吗？ [o dui le ， ni zui jin jian guo luo si ma ？]

english: No... After the incident she was locked away. Most have forgotten about her now.
translation: 不……事发后她就被关起来了。现在大多数人都忘记了她。 [bu …… shi fa hou ta jiu bei guan qi lai le 。 xian zai da duo shu ren dou wang ji le ta 。]

english: Thanks for the information, Gric. Perhaps it'll all make sense once I've found the other pages.
translation: 感谢您提供的信息，格里克。也许当我找到其他页面后，一切都会有意义。 [gan xie nin ti gong de xin xi ， ge li ke 。 ye xu dang wo zhao dao qi ta ye mian hou ， yi qie du hui you yi yi 。]

english: Perhaps.
translation: 也许。 [ye xu 。]

english: Ah, fertiliser. I use a lot of that, but I get mine from Hosidius. If you want to give yours to them, go to their storehouse near the bank.
translation: 啊，肥料。我用了很多，但我从 Hosidius 那里得到了我的。如果你想把你的给他们，就去银行附近的他们的仓库。 [a ， fei liao 。 wo yong le hen duo ， dan wo cong  Hosidius  na li de dao le wo de 。 ru guo ni xiang ba ni de gei ta men ， jiu qu yin hang fu jin de ta men de cang ku 。]

english: I'll give you 60 of my reward points for that.
translation: 我会给你 60 点奖励积分。 [wo hui gei ni  60  dian jiang li ji fen 。]

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: I'll give you 120 of my reward points for that.
translation: 我会给你 120 点奖励积分。 [wo hui gei ni  120  dian jiang li ji fen 。]

english: I'll give you 100 of my reward points for that.
translation: 我将为此奖励你 100 点奖励积分。 [wo jiang wei ci jiang li ni  100  dian jiang li ji fen 。]

english: I'll give you 40 of my reward points for that.
translation: 我会给你 40 点奖励积分。 [wo hui gei ni  40  dian jiang li ji fen 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Take some seeds from the table, otherwise you can't do any farming in there!
translation: 从桌子上拿一些种子，否则你不能在那里耕种！ [cong zhuo zi shang na yi xie zhong zi ， fou ze ni bu neng zai na li geng zhong ！]

english: Hey, young [sir/lady], do you know what you're doing in there?
translation: 嘿，年轻的[先生/女士]，你知道你在里面做什么吗？ [hei ， nian qing de [ xian sheng / nv shi ]， ni zhi dao ni zai li mian zuo shen me ma ？]

english: Grow those seeds in the patches. When you've harvested some fruit, deposit it straight into the sacks.
translation: 将这些种子种植在补丁中。收获一些水果后，将其直接放入麻袋中。 [jiang zhe xie zhong zi zhong zhi zai bu ding zhong 。 shou huo yi xie shui guo hou ， jiang qi zhi jie fang ru ma dai zhong 。]

english: You'll gain a little extra experience if you grow enough of the fruit successfully. So, are you ready to start?
translation: 如果你成功种植足够的水果，你将获得一些额外的经验。那么，你准备好开始了吗？ [ru guo ni cheng gong zhong zhi zu gou de shui guo ， ni jiang huo de yi xie e wai de jing yan 。 na me ， ni zhun bei hao kai shi le ma ？]

english: Yes, I know what I'm doing.
translation: 是的，我知道我在做什么。 [shi de ， wo zhi dao wo zai zuo shen me 。]

english: I'm an expert - don't ask me this again.
translation: 我是专家 - 不要再问我这个问题。 [wo shi zhuan jia  -  bu yao zai wen wo zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Alright, young [sir/lady], I won't. Talk to me if you ever want a reminder.
translation: 好吧，年轻的[先生/女士]，我不会。如果您需要提醒，请与我联系。 [hao ba ， nian qing de [ xian sheng / nv shi ]， wo bu hui 。 ru guo nin xu yao ti xing ， qing yu wo lian xi 。]

english: Tell me about your farm.
translation: 告诉我你的农场的情况。 [gao su wo ni de nong chang de qing kuang 。]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: I'd like to work on your farm.
translation: 我想去你们的农场工作。 [wo xiang qu ni men de nong chang gong zuo 。]

english: Have you any rewards?
translation: 你有奖励吗？ [ni you jiang li ma ？]

english: Life here seems rather peaceful.
translation: 这里的生活显得相当平静。 [zhe li de sheng huo xian de xiang dang ping jing 。]

english: I need to go.
translation: 我需要去。 [wo xu yao qu 。]

english: Accept
translation: 接受 [jie shou]

english: Cancel
translation: 取消 [qu xiao]

english: Tell me how to grow these crops.
translation: 告诉我如何种植这些作物。 [gao su wo ru he zhong zhi zhe xie zuo wu 。]

english: Yes, I know what I'm doing.
translation: 是的，我知道我在做什么。 [shi de ， wo zhi dao wo zai zuo shen me 。]

english: I'm an expert - don't ask me this again.
translation: 我是专家 - 不要再问我这个问题。 [wo shi zhuan jia  -  bu yao zai wen wo zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: I don't want to do this anymore.
translation: 我不想再这样做了。 [wo bu xiang zai zhe yang zuo le 。]

english: Farmer Hayfield stares at one of his flower beds.
translation: 农夫海菲尔德盯着他的一个花坛。 [nong fu hai fei er de ding zhe ta de yi ge hua tan 。]

english: Are you alive?
translation: 你还活着吗？ [ni hai huo zhe ma ？]

english: Me?
translation: 我？ [wo ？]

english: Farmer Hayfield continues to stare at the flower bed.
translation: 农夫海菲尔德继续盯着花坛。 [nong fu hai fei er de ji xu ding zhe hua tan 。]

english: Tell me! How does it feel to be alive?
translation: 告诉我！活着的感觉如何？ [gao su wo ！ huo zhe de gan jue ru he ？]

english: Huh, what a strange guy.
translation: 呵呵，真是个奇怪的家伙。 [he he ， zhen shi ge qi guai de jia huo 。]

english: Watch yourself, don't trample on any of me cabbages or I'll thump ya.
translation: 小心点，别踩到我的任何一个卷心菜，否则我会打你的。 [xiao xin dian ， bie cai dao wo de ren he yi ge juan xin cai ， fou ze wo hui da ni de 。]

english: Oi, what are you doing with my cabbage! Give it back!
translation: 哎呀，你拿我的白菜做什么！把它还给我！ [ai ya ， ni na wo de bai cai zuo shen me ！ ba ta huan gei wo ！]

english: I better not see you with my cabbages again!
translation: 我最好不要再看到你拿着我的卷心菜了！ [wo zui hao bu yao zai kan dao ni na zhe wo de juan xin cai le ！]

english: If the player is not carrying any cabbages:
translation: 如果玩家没有携带任何卷心菜： [ru guo wan jia mei you xie dai ren he juan xin cai ：]

english: If the player is carrying a cabbage:
translation: 如果玩家携带卷心菜： [ru guo wan jia xie dai juan xin cai ：]

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好呀！ [ni hao ya ！]

english: Greetings. It's nice to see another adventurer here.
translation: 问候。很高兴在这里见到另一位冒险家。 [wen hou 。 hen gao xing zai zhe li jian dao ling yi wei mao xian jia 。]

english: Adventurer? No. I'm a natural historian from Varrock. I'm working on a project to research the creatures of Kourend.
translation: 冒险家？不，我是来自瓦罗克的自然历史学家。我正在开展一个研究库伦德生物的项目。 [mao xian jia ？ bu ， wo shi lai zi wa luo ke de zi ran li shi xue jia 。 wo zheng zai kai zhan yi ge yan jiu ku lun de sheng wu de xiang mu 。]

english: Don't you think this place is so fascinating? It looks like this cave is a major habitat for the giants.
translation: 你不觉得这个地方很迷人吗？看起来这个洞穴是巨人的主要栖息地。 [ni bu jue de zhe ge di fang hen mi ren ma ？ kan qi lai zhe ge dong xue shi ju ren de zhu yao qi xi di 。]

english: Yeah, there are many different giants here for sure. How did you manage to get this far? Those giants are quite hostile to visitors.
translation: 是的，这里肯定有很多不同的巨人。你是如何做到这一点的？那些巨人对游客相当敌视。 [shi de ， zhe li ken ding you hen duo bu tong de ju ren 。 ni shi ru he zuo dao zhe yi dian de ？ na xie ju ren dui you ke xiang dang di shi 。]

english: Well, I just ran past them as fast as I could.
translation: 好吧，我只是以最快的速度从他们身边跑过去。 [hao ba ， wo zhi shi yi zui kuai de su du cong ta men shen bian pao guo qu 。]

english: Anyway, I'd better get back to my research.
translation: 无论如何，我最好还是回去研究一下吧。 [wu lun ru he ， wo zui hao hai shi hui qu yan jiu yi xia ba 。]

english: Don' say nuffin' to me! Say it to da boss!
translation: 别对我说废话！跟大佬说吧！ [bie dui wo shuo fei hua ！ gen da lao shuo ba ！]

english: Go away I'm very busy!
translation: 你走吧，我很忙！ [ni zou ba ， wo hen mang ！]

english: Sorry to disturb you.
translation: 抱歉打扰您。 [bao qian da rao nin 。]

english: What are you busy doing?
translation: 你在忙什么呢？ [ni zai mang shen me ne ？]

english: I'm cooking pizzas for the people in this camp.
translation: 我正在为这个营地的人们做披萨。 [wo zheng zai wei zhe ge ying di de ren men zuo pi sa 。]

english: Not that these louts appreciate my gourmet cooking!
translation: 并不是说这些笨蛋欣赏我的美食！ [bing bu shi shuo zhe xie ben dan xin shang wo de mei shi ！]

english: So what is a gourmet chef doing cooking for bandits?
translation: 那么美食厨师为土匪做菜是什么呢？ [na me mei shi chu shi wei tu fei zuo cai shi shen me ne ？]

english: Well I'm an outlaw. I was accused of giving the king food poisoning! The thought of it! I think he just drank too much wine that night.
translation: 好吧，我是一个亡命之徒。我被指控给国王食物中毒！想到了！我想他那天晚上只是喝了太多酒。 [hao ba ， wo shi yi ge wang ming zhi tu 。 wo bei zhi kong gei guo wang shi wu zhong du ！ xiang dao le ！ wo xiang ta na tian wan shang zhi shi he le tai duo jiu 。]

english: I had to flee the kingdom of Misthalin! The bandits give me refuge here as long as I cook for them.
translation: 我必须逃离米斯哈林王国！只要我给土匪做饭，他们就让我在这里避难。 [wo bi xu tao li mi si ha lin wang guo ！ zhi yao wo gei tu fei zuo fan ， ta men jiu rang wo zai zhe li bi nan 。]

english: Can I have some pizza too?
translation: 我也可以吃点披萨吗？ [wo ye ke yi chi dian pi sa ma ？]

english: Well this pizza is really meant to be for the bandits. I guess I could sell you some pizza bases though
translation: 嗯，这个披萨确实是为强盗准备的。我想我可以卖给你一些披萨底料 [n ， zhe ge pi sa que shi shi wei qiang dao zhun bei de 。 wo xiang wo ke yi mai gei ni yi xie pi sa di liao]

english: Yes, Okay.
translation: 是的，好的。 [shi de ， hao de 。]

english: Oh if I have to pay I don't want any.
translation: 哦，如果我必须付钱，我就不要了。 [o ， ru guo wo bi xu fu qian ， wo jiu bu yao le 。]

english: Okay, I'll leave you to it.
translation: 好吧，我就交给你了。 [hao ba ， wo jiu jiao gei ni le 。]

english: Have you anything to sell?
translation: 你有东西要卖吗？ [ni you dong xi yao mai ma ？]

english: Well I guess I can sell you some half made pizzas.
translation: 好吧，我想我可以卖给你一些半成品披萨。 [hao ba ， wo xiang wo ke yi mai gei ni yi xie ban cheng pin pi sa 。]

english: Sorry to disturb you.
translation: 抱歉打扰您。 [bao qian da rao nin 。]

english: What are you busy doing?
translation: 你在忙什么呢？ [ni zai mang shen me ne ？]

english: So what is a gourmet chef doing cooking for bandits?
translation: 那么美食厨师为土匪做菜是什么呢？ [na me mei shi chu shi wei tu fei zuo cai shi shen me ne ？]

english: Can I have some pizza too?
translation: 我也可以吃点披萨吗？ [wo ye ke yi chi dian pi sa ma ？]

english: Yes, Okay.
translation: 是的，好的。 [shi de ， hao de 。]

english: Oh if I have to pay I don't want any.
translation: 哦，如果我必须付钱，我就不要了。 [o ， ru guo wo bi xu fu qian ， wo jiu bu yao le 。]

english: Okay, I'll leave you to it.
translation: 好吧，我就交给你了。 [hao ba ， wo jiu jiao gei ni le 。]

english: Have you anything to sell?
translation: 你有东西要卖吗？ [ni you dong xi yao mai ma ？]

english: Welcome to the church of holy Saradomin.
translation: 欢迎来到神圣的萨拉多明教堂。 [huan ying lai dao shen sheng de sa la duo ming jiao tang 。]

english: Who's Saradomin?
translation: 萨拉多明是谁？ [sa la duo ming shi shui ？]

english: Surely you have heard of the god, Saradomin?
translation: 你肯定听说过萨拉多明神吗？ [ni ken ding ting shuo guo sa la duo ming shen ma ？]

english: He who creates the forces of goodness and purity in this world? I cannot believe your ignorance!
translation: 谁在这个世界上创造了善良和纯洁的力量？我不敢相信你的无知！ [shui zai zhe ge shi jie shang chuang zao le shan liang he chun jie de li liang ？ wo bu gan xiang xin ni de wu zhi ！]

english: This is the god with more followers than any other! ...At least in this part of the world.
translation: 这是拥有最多追随者的神！ ...至少在世界的这个地区。 [zhe shi yong you zui duo zhui sui zhe de shen ！ ... zhi shao zai shi jie de zhe ge di qu 。]

english: He who created this world along with his brothers Guthix and Zamorak?
translation: 他和他的兄弟古蒂克斯和萨莫拉克一起创造了这个世界？ [ta he ta de xiong di gu di ke si he sa mo la ke yi qi chuang zao le zhe ge shi jie ？]

english: Oh, THAT Saradomin...
translation: 哦，那个萨拉多明…… [o ， na ge sa la duo ming ……]

english: There... is only one Saradomin...
translation: 那里……只有一个萨拉多明…… [na li …… zhi you yi ge sa la duo ming ……]

english: Yeah... I, uh, thought you said something else.
translation: 是的...我，呃，以为你还说了别的什么。 [shi de ... wo ， e ， yi wei ni hai shuo le bie de shen me 。]

english: Oh, sorry. I'm not from this world.
translation: 哦，抱歉。我不是这个世界的人。 [o ， bao qian 。 wo bu shi zhe ge shi jie de ren 。]

english: That's... strange.
translation: 这……很奇怪。 [zhe …… hen qi guai 。]

english: I thought things not from this world were all... You know. Slime and tentacles.
translation: 我以为不属于这个世界的东西都是……​​你知道的。史莱姆和触手。 [wo yi wei bu shu yu zhe ge shi jie de dong xi dou shi ……​​ ni zhi dao de 。 shi lai mu he chu shou 。]

english: You don't understand. This is an online game!
translation: 你不明白。这是一个网络游戏！ [ni bu ming bai 。 zhe shi yi ge wang luo you xi ！]

english: I... beg your pardon?
translation: 请再说一遍？ [qing zai shuo yi bian ？]

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: I am - do you like my disguise?
translation: 我是——你喜欢我的伪装吗？ [wo shi —— ni xi huan wo de wei zhuang ma ？]

english: Aargh! Avaunt foul creature from another dimension! Avaunt! Begone in the name of Saradomin!
translation: 啊啊！炫耀来自另一个维度的邪恶生物！大胆！以萨拉多明之名离开吧！ [a a ！ xuan yao lai zi ling yi ge wei du de xie e sheng wu ！ da dan ！ yi sa la duo ming zhi ming li kai ba ！]

english: Ok, ok, I was only joking...
translation: 好吧好吧，我只是开玩笑…… [hao ba hao ba ， wo zhi shi kai wan xiao ……]

english: Nice place you've got here.
translation: 你这里真是个好地方。 [ni zhe li zhen shi ge hao di fang 。]

english: It is, isn't it? It was built over 230 years ago.
translation: 是的，不是吗？它建于 230 多年前。 [shi de ， bu shi ma ？ ta jian yu  230  duo nian qian 。]

english: I'm looking for a quest.
translation: 我正在寻找一个任务。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yi ge ren wu 。]

english: That's lucky, I need someone to do a quest for me.
translation: 真是幸运，我需要有人帮我做任务。 [zhen shi xing yun ， wo xu yao you ren bang wo zuo ren wu 。]

english: Okay, let me help then.
translation: 好吧，那就让我帮忙吧。 [hao ba ， na jiu rang wo bang mang ba 。]

english: Thank you. The problem is, there is a ghost in the church graveyard. I would like you to get rid of it.
translation: 谢谢。问题是，教堂墓地里有鬼。我希望你摆脱它。 [xie xie 。 wen ti shi ， jiao tang mu di li you gui 。 wo xi wang ni bai tuo ta 。]

english: If you need any help, my friend Father Urhney is an expert on ghosts.
translation: 如果您需要任何帮助，我的朋友厄尼神父是鬼魂专家。 [ru guo nin xu yao ren he bang zhu ， wo de peng you e ni shen fu shi gui hun zhuan jia 。]

english: I believe he is currently living as a hermit in Lumbridge swamp. He has a little shack in the far west of the swamps.
translation: 我相信他目前正在朗布里奇沼泽中隐居。他在沼泽西边有一个小棚屋。 [wo xiang xin ta mu qian zheng zai lang bu li qi zhao ze zhong yin ju 。 ta zai zhao ze xi bian you yi ge xiao peng wu 。]

english: Exit the graveyard through the south gate to reach the swamp. I'm sure if you told him that I sent you he'd be willing to help.
translation: 从南门离开墓地到达沼泽。我相信如果你告诉他是我派你来的，他会愿意帮忙的。 [cong nan men li kai mu di dao da zhao ze 。 wo xiang xin ru guo ni gao su ta shi wo pai ni lai de ， ta hui yuan yi bang mang de 。]

english: My name is Father Aereck by the way. Pleased to meet you.
translation: 顺便说一下，我的名字是艾瑞克神父。很高兴认识你。 [shun bian shuo yi xia ， wo de ming zi shi ai rui ke shen fu 。 hen gao xing ren shi ni 。]

english: Likewise.
translation: 同样地。 [tong yang di 。]

english: Take care travelling through the swamps, I have heard they can be quite dangerous.
translation: 穿过沼泽地时要小心，我听说那里非常危险。 [chuan guo zhao ze di shi yao xiao xin ， wo ting shuo na li fei chang wei xian 。]

english: I will, thanks.
translation: 我会的，谢谢。 [wo hui de ， xie xie 。]

english: Sorry, I don't have time right now.
translation: 抱歉，我现在没有时间。 [bao qian ， wo xian zai mei you shi jian 。]

english: Oh well. If you do have some spare time on your hands, come back and talk to me.
translation: 那好吧。如果你有空闲时间，就回来和我谈谈。 [na hao ba 。 ru guo ni you kong xian shi jian ， jiu hui lai he wo tan tan 。]

english: Thank you for getting rid of that awful ghost for me! May Saradomin always smile upon you!
translation: 谢谢你帮我摆脱了那个可怕的鬼魂！愿萨​​拉多明永远对你微笑！ [xie xie ni bang wo bai tuo le na ge ke pa de gui hun ！ yuan sa ​​ la duo ming yong yuan dui ni wei xiao ！]

english: I'm looking for a new quest.
translation: 我正在寻找新的任务。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao xin de ren wu 。]

english: Sorry, I only had the one quest.
translation: 抱歉，我只有一个任务。 [bao qian ， wo zhi you yi ge ren wu 。]

english: The Wise Old Man of Draynor Village said you might reward me if I brought you this.
translation: 德拉诺村的智者说，如果我给你带来这个，你可能会奖励我。 [de la nuo cun de zhi zhe shuo ， ru guo wo gei ni dai lai zhe ge ， ni ke neng hui jiang li wo 。]

english: Oh, did he?
translation: 哦，是吗？ [o ， shi ma ？]

english: I'd give you a reward, but you don't seem to have any space for it. Come back when you do.
translation: 我想给你奖励，但你似乎没有任何空间。当你回来的时候就回来吧。 [wo xiang gei ni jiang li ， dan ni si hu mei you ren he kong jian 。 dang ni hui lai de shi hou jiu hui lai ba 。]

english: Well, it's still nice of you to bring the message here. Here, I shall bless you...
translation: 嗯，很高兴你能把这个消息带到这里。在这里，我要祝福你…… [n ， hen gao xing ni neng ba zhe ge xiao xi dai dao zhe li 。 zai zhe li ， wo yao zhu fu ni ……]

english: Well, maybe you'll find a use for these seeds?
translation: 好吧，也许你会发现这些种子的用途？ [hao ba ， ye xu ni hui fa xian zhe xie zhong zi de yong tu ？]

english: Well, maybe you'll have a use for these?
translation: 好吧，也许你会用到这些？ [hao ba ， ye xu ni hui yong dao zhe xie ？]

english: I suppose gems are always acceptable rewards!
translation: 我想宝石总是可以接受的奖励！ [wo xiang bao shi zong shi ke yi jie shou de jiang li ！]

english: I have a question for you.
translation: 我有个问题要问你。 [wo you ge wen ti yao wen ni 。]

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。 [qing shu ru wen ti de da an 。]

english: No, try again.
translation: 不，再试一次。 [bu ， zai shi yi ci 。]

english: Correct!
translation: 正确的！ [zheng que de ！]

english: Here, have this.
translation: 给，这个。 [gei ， zhe ge 。]

english: Who's Saradomin?
translation: 萨拉多明是谁？ [sa la duo ming shi shui ？]

english: Oh, THAT Saradomin...
translation: 哦，那个萨拉多明…… [o ， na ge sa la duo ming ……]

english: Oh, sorry. I'm not from this world.
translation: 哦，抱歉。我不是这个世界的人。 [o ， bao qian 。 wo bu shi zhe ge shi jie de ren 。]

english: You don't understand. This is an online game!
translation: 你不明白。这是一个网络游戏！ [ni bu ming bai 。 zhe shi yi ge wang luo you xi ！]

english: I am - do you like my disguise?
translation: 我是——你喜欢我的伪装吗？ [wo shi —— ni xi huan wo de wei zhuang ma ？]

english: Nice place you've got here.
translation: 你这里真是个好地方。 [ni zhe li zhen shi ge hao di fang 。]

english: I'm looking for a quest!
translation: 我正在寻找任务！ [wo zheng zai xun zhao ren wu ！]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Welcome to the church of the egg.
translation: 欢迎来到蛋教堂。 [huan ying lai dao dan jiao tang 。]

english: What do you mean egg?
translation: 你说的鸡蛋是什么意思？ [ni shuo de ji dan shi shen me yi si ？]

english: Surely you've heard of the almighty egg?
translation: 你肯定听说过万能蛋吧？ [ni ken ding ting shuo guo wan neng dan ba ？]

english: The one who guides us through such troubled times.
translation: 是一位带领我们度过困难时期的人。 [shi yi wei dai ling wo men du guo kun nan shi qi de ren 。]

english: The Duke is his voice and he is the commander, he will lead us to eternal happiness.
translation: 公爵是他的声音，他是指挥官，他将带领我们走向永恒的幸福。 [gong jue shi ta de sheng yin ， ta shi zhi hui guan ， ta jiang dai ling wo men zou xiang yong heng de xing fu 。]

english: Oh, THAT egg..
translation: 哦，那个蛋.. [o ， na ge dan ..]

english: There... is only one egg...
translation: 那里……只有一颗蛋…… [na li …… zhi you yi ke dan ……]

english: Yeah... I, uh, thought you said something else.
translation: 是的...我，呃，以为你还说了别的什么。 [shi de ... wo ， e ， yi wei ni hai shuo le bie de shen me 。]

english: Oh, sorry. I'm not from this world.
translation: 哦，抱歉。我不是这个世界的人。 [o ， bao qian 。 wo bu shi zhe ge shi jie de ren 。]

english: That's... strange.
translation: 这……很奇怪。 [zhe …… hen qi guai 。]

english: I thought things not from this world were all... You know. Slime and tentacles.
translation: 我以为不属于这个世界的东西都是……​​你知道的。史莱姆和触手。 [wo yi wei bu shu yu zhe ge shi jie de dong xi dou shi ……​​ ni zhi dao de 。 shi lai mu he chu shou 。]

english: You don't understand. This is an online game!
translation: 你不明白。这是一个网络游戏！ [ni bu ming bai 。 zhe shi yi ge wang luo you xi ！]

english: I... beg your pardon?
translation: 请再说一遍？ [qing zai shuo yi bian ？]

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: I am - do you like my disguise?
translation: 我是——你喜欢我的伪装吗？ [wo shi —— ni xi huan wo de wei zhuang ma ？]

english: Aargh! Avaunt foul creature from another dimension! Avaunt! Begone in the name of the Egg!
translation: 啊啊！炫耀来自另一个维度的邪恶生物！大胆！以蛋之名离开吧！ [a a ！ xuan yao lai zi ling yi ge wei du de xie e sheng wu ！ da dan ！ yi dan zhi ming li kai ba ！]

english: Ok, ok, I was only joking...
translation: 好吧好吧，我只是开玩笑…… [hao ba hao ba ， wo zhi shi kai wan xiao ……]

english: Nice place you've got here.
translation: 你这里真是个好地方。 [ni zhe li zhen shi ge hao di fang 。]

english: It is, isn't it? It was built over 230 years ago.
translation: 是的，不是吗？它建于 230 多年前。 [shi de ， bu shi ma ？ ta jian yu  230  duo nian qian 。]

english: I'm looking for a quest!
translation: 我正在寻找任务！ [wo zheng zai xun zhao ren wu ！]

english: That's lucky, I need someone to do a quest for me, but the Duke told me not to mingle with you.
translation: 真幸运，我需要有人替我做任务，但是公爵让我不要和你混在一起。 [zhen xing yun ， wo xu yao you ren ti wo zuo ren wu ， dan shi gong jue rang wo bu yao he ni hun zai yi qi 。]

english: Maybe I should come back after I've finished with the Duke.
translation: 也许我应该在和公爵结束之后再回来。 [ye xu wo ying gai zai he gong jue jie shu zhi hou zai hui lai 。]

english: That's lucky, I need someone to do a quest for me.
translation: 真是幸运，我需要有人帮我做任务。 [zhen shi xing yun ， wo xu yao you ren bang wo zuo ren wu 。]

english: Ok, let me help then.
translation: 好吧，那就让我帮忙吧。 [hao ba ， na jiu rang wo bang mang ba 。]

english: Thank you, the problem is, uh...well...there's a goat haunting my graveyard.
translation: 谢谢你，问题是，呃……好吧……有一只山羊在我的墓地里出没。 [xie xie ni ， wen ti shi ， e …… hao ba …… you yi zhi shan yang zai wo de mu di li chu mo 。]

english: Goat? Don't you mean ghost?
translation: 山羊？你不是说鬼吗？ [shan yang ？ ni bu shi shuo gui ma ？]

english: Well yes and no, it's a ghost goat.
translation: 嗯，是的，也不是，它是一只幽灵山羊。 [n ， shi de ， ye bu shi ， ta shi yi zhi you ling shan yang 。]

english: Sounds like you have a restless goat problem!
translation: 听起来你有一个不安分的山羊问题！ [ting qi lai ni you yi ge bu an fen de shan yang wen ti ！]

english: Now is not the time for jokes, are you going to help me or not?
translation: 现在不是开玩笑的时候，你到底帮不帮我？ [xian zai bu shi kai wan xiao de shi hou ， ni dao di bang bu bang wo ？]

english: Yeah might as well, I'll go take a look.
translation: 嗯，也可以，我去看看。 [n ， ye ke yi ， wo qu kan kan 。]

english: Thank you friend, be safe out there.
translation: 谢谢朋友，出门在外注意安全。 [xie xie peng you ， chu men zai wai zhu yi an quan 。]

english: Sorry, I don't have time right now.
translation: 抱歉，我现在没有时间。 [bao qian ， wo xian zai mei you shi jian 。]

english: Oh well. If you do have some spare time on your paws, come back and talk to me.
translation: 那好吧。如果你确实有空闲时间，请回来和我谈谈。 [na hao ba 。 ru guo ni que shi you kong xian shi jian ， qing hui lai he wo tan tan 。]

english: What did you ask me to do again?
translation: 你又叫我做什么？ [ni you jiao wo zuo shen me ？]

english: I need you to rid me of the ghost goat that is haunting my graveyard.
translation: 我需要你帮我除掉出没在我墓地里的幽灵山羊。 [wo xu yao ni bang wo chu diao chu mo zai wo mu di li de you ling shan yang 。]

english: Got it, I'll get back to it.
translation: 明白了，我会回过头来。 [ming bai le ， wo hui hui guo tou lai 。]

english: Church of the egg?
translation: 蛋教堂？ [dan jiao tang ？]

english: Oh, THAT egg...
translation: 哦，那个蛋... [o ， na ge dan ...]

english: Oh, sorry. I'm not from this world.
translation: 哦，抱歉。我不是这个世界的人。 [o ， bao qian 。 wo bu shi zhe ge shi jie de ren 。]

english: You don't understand. This is an online game!
translation: 你不明白。这是一个网络游戏！ [ni bu ming bai 。 zhe shi yi ge wang luo you xi ！]

english: I am - do you like my disguise?
translation: 我是——你喜欢我的伪装吗？ [wo shi —— ni xi huan wo de wei zhuang ma ？]

english: Nice place you've got here.
translation: 你这里真是个好地方。 [ni zhe li zhen shi ge hao di fang 。]

english: I'm looking for a quest!
translation: 我正在寻找任务！ [wo zheng zai xun zhao ren wu ！]

english: Ok, let me help then.
translation: 好吧，那就让我帮忙吧。 [hao ba ， na jiu rang wo bang mang ba 。]

english: Sorry, I don't have time right now
translation: 抱歉，我现在没有时间 [bao qian ， wo xian zai mei you shi jian]

english: Ask about the ghost.
translation: 问鬼事。 [wen gui shi 。]

english: I'm looking for a quest!
translation: 我正在寻找任务！ [wo zheng zai xun zhao ren wu ！]

english: In this holy place I can only offer you calm and peace.
translation: 在这个神圣的地方，我只能给你平静与平安。 [zai zhe ge shen sheng de di fang ， wo zhi neng gei ni ping jing yu ping an 。]

english: Calm and Peace? Sounds like the quest for me! How should I start?
translation: 平静与和平？听起来像是对我的追求！我应该如何开始？ [ping jing yu he ping ？ ting qi lai xiang shi dui wo de zhui qiu ！ wo ying gai ru he kai shi ？]

english: Yes, calm and peace. Just stay here with me and you will feel it eventually.
translation: 是的，平静与安宁。只要和我呆在这里，你最终就会感觉到。 [shi de ， ping jing yu an ning 。 zhi yao he wo dai zai zhe li ， ni zui zhong jiu hui gan jue dao 。]

english: Oh... well... thank you.
translation: 哦...好吧...谢谢你。 [o ... hao ba ... xie xie ni 。]

english: Sorry, there will be no sermon today, but you may offer a prayer to Saradomin yourself.
translation: 抱歉，今天没有布道，但您可以亲自向萨拉多明祈祷。 [bao qian ， jin tian mei you bu dao ， dan nin ke yi qin zi xiang sa la duo ming qi dao 。]

english: Do the people here mostly worship Saradomin?
translation: 这里的人大多崇拜萨拉多明吗？ [zhe li de ren da duo chong bai sa la duo ming ma ？]

english: Of course! Even before our forefathers founded Kourend, under King Rada I, they remembered the tumult of the times when the armies of the gods laid waste to the lands.
translation: 当然！甚至在我们的祖先在拉达一世国王统治下建立库伦德之前，他们就记得众神的军队蹂躏大地的那个时代的喧嚣。 [dang ran ！ shen zhi zai wo men de zu xian zai la da yi shi guo wang tong zhi xia jian li ku lun de zhi qian ， ta men jiu ji de zhong shen de jun dui rou lin da di de na ge shi dai de xuan xiao 。]

english: We thank Saradomin for the end of that violent Age, and pray that he will continue to defend us from the evil other gods.
translation: 我们感谢萨拉多明结束了那个暴力时代，并祈祷他将继续保护我们免受邪恶的其他神明的侵害。 [wo men gan xie sa la duo ming jie shu le na ge bao li shi dai ， bing qi dao ta jiang ji xu bao hu wo men mian shou xie e de qi ta shen ming de qin hai 。]

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: That's nice.
translation: 那很好。 [na hen hao 。]

english: Most impressive, have this!
translation: 最令人印象深刻的，就是这个！ [zui ling ren yin xiang shen ke de ， jiu shi zhe ge ！]

english: You've obtained a casket!
translation: 你已经获得了一个棺材！ [ni yi jing huo de le yi ge guan cai ！]

english: Do the people here mostly worship Saradomin?
translation: 这里的人大多崇拜萨拉多明吗？ [zhe li de ren da duo chong bai sa la duo ming ma ？]

english: That's nice.
translation: 那很好。 [na hen hao 。]

english: Hello adventurer, do you seek a quest?
translation: 你好冒险家，你在寻找任务吗？ [ni hao mao xian jia ， ni zai xun zhao ren wu ma ？]

english: I am always looking for a quest.
translation: 我一直在寻找一个任务。 [wo yi zhi zai xun zhao yi ge ren wu 。]

english: Well, I see poor Romeo wandering around the square. I think he may need help.
translation: 嗯，我看到可怜的罗密欧在广场上闲逛。我想他可能需要帮助。 [n ， wo kan dao ke lian de luo mi ou zai guang chang shang xian guang 。 wo xiang ta ke neng xu yao bang zhu 。]

english: I was helping him and Juliet to meet, but it became impossible.
translation: 我正在帮助他和朱丽叶见面，但这变得不可能了。 [wo zheng zai bang zhu ta he zhu li ye jian mian ， dan zhe bian de bu ke neng le 。]

english: I am sure he can use some help.
translation: 我确信他需要一些帮助。 [wo que xin ta xu yao yi xie bang zhu 。]

english: No, I prefer just to kill things.
translation: 不，我更喜欢杀戮。 [bu ， wo geng xi huan sha lu 。]

english: That's a fine career in these lands. There is more that needs killing every day.
translation: 在这些土地上这是一个很好的职业。每天都有更多需要杀死的东西。 [zai zhe xie tu di shang zhe shi yi ge hen hao de zhi ye 。 mei tian dou you geng duo xu yao sha si de dong xi 。]

english: Can you recommend a good bar?
translation: 你能推荐一个不错的酒吧吗？ [ni neng tui jian yi ge bu cuo de jiu ba ma ？]

english: Drinking will be the death of you.
translation: 喝酒会害死你。 [he jiu hui hai si ni 。]

english: But the Blue Moon in the city is cheap enough.
translation: 不过城里的蓝月亮已经够便宜了。 [bu guo cheng li de lan yue liang yi jing gou pian yi le 。]

english: And providing you buy one drink an hour they let you stay all night.
translation: 只要你每小时买一杯饮料，他们就可以让你过夜。 [zhi yao ni mei xiao shi mai yi bei yin liao ， ta men jiu ke yi rang ni guo ye 。]

english: Ok, thanks
translation: 好的，谢谢 [hao de ， xie xie]

english: Oh to be a father in the times of whiskey.
translation: 哦，在威士忌时代成为一名父亲。 [o ， zai wei shi ji shi dai cheng wei yi ming fu qin 。]

english: I sing and I drink and I wake up in gutters.
translation: 我唱歌、喝酒，然后在阴沟里醒来。 [wo chang ge 、 he jiu ， ran hou zai yin gou li xing lai 。]

english: Top of the morning to you.
translation: 早上好。 [zao shang hao 。]

english: To err is human, to forgive, quite difficult.
translation: 人都会犯错，宽恕是相当困难的。 [ren du hui fan cuo ， kuan shu shi xiang dang kun nan de 。]

english: I need a think I drink.
translation: 我需要喝一杯。 [wo xu yao he yi bei 。]

english: Can't you see that I'm in the middle of a Sermon?!
translation: 你没看到我正在讲道吗？！ [ni mei kan dao wo zheng zai jiang dao ma ？！]

english: But Romeo sent me!
translation: 但罗密欧派我来的！ [dan luo mi ou pai wo lai de ！]

english: But I'm busy delivering a sermon to my congregation!
translation: 但我正忙着向我的会众讲道！ [dan wo zheng mang zhe xiang wo de hui zhong jiang dao ！]

english: Zzzzzzzzz
translation: 呜呜呜 [wu wu wu]

english: Yes, well, it certainly seems like you have a captive audience!
translation: 是的，嗯，看起来你确实有一群忠实的观众！ [shi de ， n ， kan qi lai ni que shi you yi qun zhong shi de guan zhong ！]

english: Ok, ok...what do you want so I can get rid of you and continue with my sermon?
translation: 好吧，好吧……你想要什么，这样我就可以摆脱你并继续我的布道？ [hao ba ， hao ba …… ni xiang yao shen me ， zhe yang wo jiu ke yi bai tuo ni bing ji xu wo de bu dao ？]

english: Romeo sent me. He says you may be able to help.
translation: 罗密欧派我来的。他说你也许能帮忙。 [luo mi ou pai wo lai de 。 ta shuo ni ye xu neng bang mang 。]

english: Ah Romeo, yes. A fine lad, but a little bit confused.
translation: 啊，罗密欧，是的。一个不错的小伙子，但有点困惑。 [a ， luo mi ou ， shi de 。 yi ge bu cuo de xiao huo zi ， dan you dian kun huo 。]

english: Yes, very confused....Anyway, Romeo wishes to be married to Juliet! She must be rescued from her father's control!
translation: 是的，很困惑……无论如何，罗密欧希望与朱丽叶结婚！一定要把她从父亲的控制下救出来！ [shi de ， hen kun huo …… wu lun ru he ， luo mi ou xi wang yu zhu li ye jie hun ！ yi ding yao ba ta cong fu qin de kong zhi xia jiu chu lai ！]

english: I agree, and I think I have an idea! A potion to make her appear dead...
translation: 我同意，我想我有一个想法！一种让她看起来已经死了的药剂…… [wo tong yi ， wo xiang wo you yi ge xiang fa ！ yi zhong rang ta kan qi lai yi jing si le de yao ji ……]

english: Dead! Sounds a bit creepy to me...but please, continue.
translation: 死的！对我来说听起来有点令人毛骨悚然……但是请继续。 [si de ！ dui wo lai shuo ting qi lai you dian ling ren mao gu song ran …… dan shi qing ji xu 。]

english: The potion will only make Juliet 'appear' dead...then she'll be taken to the crypt...
translation: 魔药只会让朱丽叶‘看起来’死了……然后她会被带到地下室…… [mo yao zhi hui rang zhu li ye ‘ kan qi lai ’ si le …… ran hou ta hui bei dai dao di xia shi ……]

english: Crypt! Again...very creepy! You must have some strange hobbies.
translation: 地穴！再次……非常令人毛骨悚然！你一定有一些奇怪的爱好。 [di xue ！ zai ci …… fei chang ling ren mao gu song ran ！ ni yi ding you yi xie qi guai de ai hao 。]

english: Then Romeo can collect her from the crypt! Go to the Apothecary, tell him I sent you and that you'll need a 'Cadava' potion.
translation: 然后罗密欧就可以从地窖里接她了！去找药剂师，告诉他是我派你来的，你需要一瓶“卡达瓦”药水。 [ran hou luo mi ou jiu ke yi cong di jiao li jie ta le ！ qu zhao yao ji shi ， gao su ta shi wo pai ni lai de ， ni xu yao yi ping “ ka da wa ” yao shui 。]

english: Apart from the strong overtones of death, this is turning out to be a real love story.
translation: 除了强烈的死亡暗示之外，这也是一个真实的爱情故事。 [chu le qiang lie de si wang an shi zhi wai ， zhe ye shi yi ge zhen shi de ai qing gu shi 。]

english: Ah, have you found the Apothecary yet? Remember, Cadava potion, for Juliet.
translation: 啊，你找到药剂师了吗？记住，卡达瓦药水，给朱丽叶的。 [a ， ni zhao dao yao ji shi le ma ？ ji zhu ， ka da wa yao shui ， gei zhu li ye de 。]

english: Did you find the Apothecary?
translation: 你找到药剂师了吗？ [ni zhao dao yao ji shi le ma ？]

english: I've got the cadava potion.
translation: 我有卡达瓦药水。 [wo you ka da wa yao shui 。]

english: Good! Good work! Ok, take it to Juliet, she's expecting you. I'll talk to Romeo and make sure he knows what to do.
translation: 好的！干得好！好的，把它带给朱丽叶，她正在等你。我会和罗密欧谈谈并确保他知道该怎么做。 [hao de ！ gan de hao ！ hao de ， ba ta dai gei zhu li ye ， ta zheng zai deng ni 。 wo hui he luo mi ou tan tan bing que bao ta zhi dao gai zen me zuo 。]

english: The Wise Old Man of Draynor Village sent you this message about your drinking habits!
translation: 德拉诺村的智者老人向您发送了这条有关您饮酒习惯的消息！ [de la nuo cun de zhi zhe lao ren xiang nin fa song le zhe tiao you guan nin yin jiu xi guan de xiao xi ！]

english: mssge? wha messsge?
translation: 留言？发什么消息？ [liu yan ？ fa shen me xiao xi ？]

english: oh, msesesge for me.
translation: 哦，对我来说是msesesge。 [o ， dui wo lai shuo shi msesesge。]

english: Oh dear, he doesn't look like he's going to be able to read the message!
translation: 哦天哪，他看起来不像能读到这条信息！ [o tian na ， ta kan qi lai bu xiang neng du dao zhe tiao xin xi ！]

english: I'd give you a reward, but you don't seem to have any space for it. Come back when you do.
translation: 我想给你奖励，但你似乎没有任何空间。当你回来的时候就回来吧。 [wo xiang gei ni jiang li ， dan ni si hu mei you ren he kong jian 。 dang ni hui lai de shi hou jiu hui lai ba 。]

english: in nomine saradomini, blah blah blah...
translation: 提名萨拉多米尼，等等等等…… [ti ming sa la duo mi ni ， deng deng deng deng ……]

english: Whee! Mmmgic power, kazamm...
translation: 哎哟！嗯魔力，卡扎姆…… [ai yo ！ n mo li ， ka zha mu ……]

english: I am always looking for a quest.
translation: 我一直在寻找一个任务。 [wo yi zhi zai xun zhao yi ge ren wu 。]

english: No, I prefer just to kill things.
translation: 不，我更喜欢杀戮。 [bu ， wo geng xi huan sha lu 。]

english: Can you recommend a good bar?
translation: 你能推荐一个不错的酒吧吗？ [ni neng tui jian yi ge bu cuo de jiu ba ma ？]

english: Ok, thanks
translation: 好的，谢谢 [hao de ， xie xie]

english: Go away! I'm meditating!
translation: 离开！我正在冥想！ [li kai ！ wo zheng zai ming xiang ！]

english: Well, that's friendly.
translation: 嗯，这很友好。 [n ， zhe hen you hao 。]

english: I SAID go AWAY.
translation: 我说走开。 [wo shuo zou kai 。]

english: Okay, okay... sheesh, what a grouch.
translation: 好吧，好吧……哎呀，真是脾气暴躁。 [hao ba ， hao ba …… ai ya ， zhen shi pi qi bao zao 。]

english: I've come to repossess your house.
translation: 我是来夺回你的房子的。 [wo shi lai duo hui ni de fang zi de 。]

english: Under what grounds???
translation: 依据什么理由？？？ [yi ju shen me li you ？？？]

english: Repeated failure on mortgage repayments.
translation: 屡次未能偿还抵押贷款。 [lv ci wei neng chang huan di ya dai kuan 。]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: But... I don't have a mortgage! I built this house myself!
translation: 但是……我没有抵押贷款！这房子是我自己建的！ [dan shi …… wo mei you di ya dai kuan ！ zhe fang zi shi wo zi ji jian de ！]

english: Sorry. I must have got the wrong address. All the houses look the same around here.
translation: 对不起。我肯定是弄错地址了。这里所有的房子看起来都一样。 [dui bu qi 。 wo ken ding shi nong cuo di zhi le 。 zhe li suo you de fang zi kan qi lai dou yi yang 。]

english: What? What houses? What ARE you talking about???
translation: 什么？什么房子？你在说什么？？？ [shen me ？ shen me fang zi ？ ni zai shuo shen me ？？？]

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: I don't know. I just wanted this house...
translation: 我不知道。我只是想要这个房子... [wo bu zhi dao 。 wo zhi shi xiang yao zhe ge fang zi ...]

english: Oh... go away and stop wasting my time!
translation: 噢……走开，别再浪费我的时间了！ [o …… zou kai ， bie zai lang fei wo de shi jian le ！]

english: Father Aereck sent me to talk to you.
translation: 艾瑞克神父派我来跟你说话。 [ai rui ke shen fu pai wo lai gen ni shuo hua 。]

english: I suppose I'd better talk to you then. What problems has he got himself into this time?
translation: 我想我最好和你谈谈。这次他又遇到了什么问题呢？ [wo xiang wo zui hao he ni tan tan 。 zhe ci ta you yu dao le shen me wen ti ne ？]

english: He's got a ghost haunting his graveyard.
translation: 他的墓地里有鬼魂出没。 [ta de mu di li you gui hun chu mo 。]

english: Oh, the silly fool.
translation: 噢，这个傻瓜。 [o ， zhe ge sha gua 。]

english: I leave town for just five months, and ALREADY he can't manage.
translation: 我离开小镇才五个月，他已经无法应付了。 [wo li kai xiao zhen cai wu ge yue ， ta yi jing wu fa ying fu le 。]

english: (sigh)
translation: （叹） [（ tan ）]

english: Well, I can't go back and exorcise it. I vowed not to leave this place. Until I had done a full two years of prayer and meditation.
translation: 好吧，我不能回去驱魔了。我发誓不会离开这个地方。直到我完成了整整两年的祈祷和冥想。 [hao ba ， wo bu neng hui qu qu mo le 。 wo fa shi bu hui li kai zhe ge di fang 。 zhi dao wo wan cheng le zheng zheng liang nian de qi dao he ming xiang 。]

english: Tell you what I can do though; take this amulet.
translation: 告诉你我能做什么；拿走这个护身符。 [gao su ni wo neng zuo shen me ； na zou zhe ge hu shen fu 。]

english: Father Urhney hands you an amulet.
translation: 厄尼神父递给你一个护身符。 [e ni shen fu di gei ni yi ge hu shen fu 。]

english: It is an Amulet of Ghostspeak.
translation: 它是鬼语护身符。 [ta shi gui yu hu shen fu 。]

english: So called, because when you wear it you can speak to ghosts. A lot of ghosts are doomed to be ghosts because they have left some important task uncompleted.
translation: 之所以这么称呼，是因为戴上它后可以与鬼魂对话。很多鬼注定是鬼，因为他们留下了一些重要的任务未完成。 [zhi suo yi zhe me cheng hu ， shi yin wei dai shang ta hou ke yi yu gui hun dui hua 。 hen duo gui zhu ding shi gui ， yin wei ta men liu xia le yi xie zhong yao de ren wu wei wan cheng 。]

english: Maybe if you know what this task is, you can get rid of the ghost. I'm not making any guarantees mind you, but it is the best I can do right now.
translation: 也许如果你知道这个任务是什么，你就可以摆脱鬼魂。请注意，我不会做任何保证，但这是我现在能做的最好的事情。 [ye xu ru guo ni zhi dao zhe ge ren wu shi shen me ， ni jiu ke yi bai tuo gui hun 。 qing zhu yi ， wo bu hui zuo ren he bao zheng ， dan zhe shi wo xian zai neng zuo de zui hao de shi qing 。]

english: Thank you. I'll give it a try!
translation: 谢谢。我会尝试一下！ [xie xie 。 wo hui chang shi yi xia ！]

english: You mean he gets himself into lots of problems?
translation: 你的意思是他给自己带来了很多问题？ [ni de yi si shi ta gei zi ji dai lai le hen duo wen ti ？]

english: Yeah. For example, when we were trainee priests he kept on getting stuck up bell ropes.
translation: 是的。例如，当我们还是实习牧师时，他总是被钟绳卡住。 [shi de 。 li ru ， dang wo men hai shi shi xi mu shi shi ， ta zong shi bei zhong sheng ka zhu 。]

english: Anyway. I don't have time for chitchat. What's his problem THIS time?
translation: 反正。我没有时间闲聊。这次他有什么问题吗？ [fan zheng 。 wo mei you shi jian xian liao 。 zhe ci ta you shen me wen ti ma ？]

english: I've lost the Amulet of Ghostspeak.
translation: 我丢失了鬼语护身符。 [wo diu shi le gui yu hu shen fu 。]

english: What are you talking about? I can see you've got it with you!
translation: 你在说什么？我看得出你已经带着它了！ [ni zai shuo shen me ？ wo kan de chu ni yi jing dai zhe ta le ！]

english: You come here wasting my time... Has it even occurred to you that you've got it stored somewhere? Now GO AWAY!
translation: 你来这里浪费我的时间...你有没有想过你已经把它存放在某个地方了？现在走开！ [ni lai zhe li lang fei wo de shi jian ... ni you mei you xiang guo ni yi jing ba ta cun fang zai mou ge di fang le ？ xian zai zou kai ！]

english: How careless can you get? Those things aren't easy to come by you know! Now clear some space in your inventory and I'll give you another one.
translation: 你能粗心到什么程度？这些东西来之不易，你知道吗！现在清理你的库存中的一些空间，我会给你另一个空间。 [ni neng cu xin dao shen me cheng du ？ zhe xie dong xi lai zhi bu yi ， ni zhi dao ma ！ xian zai qing li ni de ku cun zhong de yi xie kong jian ， wo hui gei ni ling yi ge kong jian 。]

english: How careless can you get? Those things aren't easy to come by you know! It's a good job I've got a spare.
translation: 你能粗心到什么程度？这些东西来之不易，你知道吗！这是一份好工作，我还有空余的工作。 [ni neng cu xin dao shen me cheng du ？ zhe xie dong xi lai zhi bu yi ， ni zhi dao ma ！ zhe shi yi fen hao gong zuo ， wo hai you kong yu de gong zuo 。]

english: Be more careful this time.
translation: 这次要小心一些。 [zhe ci yao xiao xin yi xie 。]

english: Okay, I'll try to be.
translation: 好吧，我会努力做到的。 [hao ba ， wo hui nu li zuo dao de 。]

english: Hello?
translation: 你好？ [ni hao ？]

english: At last! The voice of Saradomin! My years of meditation have paid off!
translation: 终于！萨拉多明的声音！我多年的冥想得到了回报！ [zhong yu ！ sa la duo ming de sheng yin ！ wo duo nian de ming xiang de dao le hui bao ！]

english: Um...
O mighty Saradomin! What is your message to me?
translation: 伟大的萨拉多明啊！你想对我说些什么？ [wei da de sa la duo ming a ！ ni xiang dui wo shuo xie shen me ？]

english: Stop sitting around in a house in a swamp and go and do something useful!
translation: 别再坐在沼泽里的房子里了，去做一些有用的事情吧！ [bie zai zuo zai zhao ze li de fang zi li le ， qu zuo yi xie you yong de shi qing ba ！]

english: Oh, thank you Saradomin! I will meditate on what this message means!
translation: 哦，谢谢萨拉多明！我会思考这个消息的含义！ [o ， xie xie sa la duo ming ！ wo hui si kao zhe ge xiao xi de han yi ！]

english: Well, that's friendly.
translation: 嗯，这很友好。 [n ， zhe hen you hao 。]

english: I've come to repossess your house.
translation: 我是来夺回你的房子的。 [wo shi lai duo hui ni de fang zi de 。]

english: Repeated failure on mortgage repayments.
translation: 屡次未能偿还抵押贷款。 [lv ci wei neng chang huan di ya dai kuan 。]

english: I don't know, I just wanted this house.
translation: 我不知道，我只是想要这个房子。 [wo bu zhi dao ， wo zhi shi xiang yao zhe ge fang zi 。]

english: Father Aereck sent me to talk to you.
translation: 艾瑞克神父派我来跟你说话。 [ai rui ke shen fu pai wo lai gen ni shuo hua 。]

english: He's got a ghost haunting his graveyard.
translation: 他的墓地里有鬼魂出没。 [ta de mu di li you gui hun chu mo 。]

english: You mean he gets himself into lots of problems?
translation: 你的意思是他给自己带来了很多问题？ [ni de yi si shi ta gei zi ji dai lai le hen duo wen ti ？]

english: I've lost the Amulet of Ghostspeak.
translation: 我丢失了鬼语护身符。 [wo diu shi le gui yu hu shen fu 。]

english: Nilsal. Interested in buying some of Aldarin's finest fruit and veg?
translation: 尼尔萨尔。有兴趣购买一些 Aldarin 最好的水果和蔬菜吗？ [ni er sa er 。 you xing qu gou mai yi xie  Aldarin  zui hao de shui guo he shu cai ma ？]

english: Let's see what you have.
translation: 让我们看看你有什么。 [rang wo men kan kan ni you shen me 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Fair enough.
translation: 很公平。 [hen gong ping 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 你知道，打招呼的方式有很多种。你好，你好，你好…… [ni zhi dao ， da zhao hu de fang shi you hen duo zhong 。 ni hao ， ni hao ， ni hao ……]

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 那还是只能算一个！ [na hai shi zhi neng suan yi ge ！]

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。你今天怎么样？ [ni hao 。 ni jin tian zen me yang ？]

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很棒，谢谢你！ [wo hen bang ， xie xie ni ！]

english: Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 你好！水晶城里今天过得怎么样啊？ [ni hao ！ shui jing cheng li jin tian guo de zen me yang a ？]

english: Indeed.
translation: 的确。 [di que 。]

english: What can I do for ya?
translation: 我能为你做什么？ [wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 各种各样的事情！这些塔楼是一个美妙的景观。 [ge zhong ge yang de shi qing ！ zhe xie ta lou shi yi ge mei miao de jing guan 。]

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 在像今天这样的日子，我建议您参观市场。 [zai xiang jin tian zhe yang de ri zi ， wo jian yi nin can guan shi chang 。]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你认为你在做什么？ [ni ren wei ni zai zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: Hello tall person.
translation: 你好高个子。 [ni hao gao ge zi 。]

english: Hello short person.
translation: 你好矮个子。 [ni hao ai ge zi 。]

english: What's this patch for?
translation: 这个补丁有什么用？ [zhe ge bu ding you shen me yong ？]

english: This is an Anima patch, the only one of its kind. Here, you can grow Iasor, Kronos and Attas plants.
translation: 这是一个 Anima 补丁，同类中唯一的一个。在这里，您可以种植 Iasor、Kronos 和 Attas 植物。 [zhe shi yi ge  Anima  bu ding ， tong lei zhong wei yi de yi ge 。 zai zhe li ， nin ke yi zhong zhi  Iasor、Kronos  he  Attas  zhi wu 。]

english: What are they?
translation: 这些是什么？ [zhe xie shi shen me ？]

english: Three unique plants with a special affinity to the Anima Mundi, the life force of our world.
translation: 三种独特的植物与我们世界的生命力——Anima Mundi 有着特殊的亲和力。 [san zhong du te de zhi wu yu wo men shi jie de sheng ming li ——Anima Mundi  you zhe te shu de qin he li 。]

english: When planted, all three of these plants have a unique impact on the Anima Mundi. Their effects will likely be very useful to you when farming.
translation: 种植后，这三种植物都会对 Anima Mundi 产生独特的影响。它们的效果可能对你耕种时非常有用。 [zhong zhi hou ， zhe san zhong zhi wu du hui dui  Anima Mundi  chan sheng du te de ying xiang 。 ta men de xiao guo ke neng dui ni geng zhong shi fei chang you yong 。]

english: What are the effects?
translation: 有什么影响？ [you shen me ying xiang ？]

english: Iasor plants will reduce the chance of your other crops becoming diseased, Kronos plants will increase the speed at which they grow and Attas plants will improve the yield when harvesting.
translation: Iasor 植物将减少其他作物患病的机会，Kronos 植物将提高其生长速度，而 Attas 植物将提高收获时的产量。 [Iasor  zhi wu jiang jian shao qi ta zuo wu huan bing de ji hui ，Kronos  zhi wu jiang ti gao qi sheng zhang su du ， er  Attas  zhi wu jiang ti gao shou huo shi de chan liang 。]

english: Choose wisely though, as you can only have one of them at a time.
translation: 但请明智地选择，因为您一次只能拥有其中之一。 [dan qing ming zhi di xuan ze ， yin wei nin yi ci zhi neng yong you qi zhong zhi yi 。]

english: Eventually, they'll start to wither and die as their impact on the Anima Mundi is limited. You'll have to plant another when they do.
translation: 最终，它们将开始枯萎和死亡，因为它们对灵魂世界的影响是有限的。当他们这样做的时候，你就得再种一株。 [zui zhong ， ta men jiang kai shi ku wei he si wang ， yin wei ta men dui ling hun shi jie de ying xiang shi you xian de 。 dang ta men zhe yang zuo de shi hou ， ni jiu de zai zhong yi zhu 。]

english: Awesome! Thanks for the information.
translation: 惊人的！感谢您提供信息。 [jing ren de ！ gan xie nin ti gong xin xi 。]

english: See you later.
translation: 稍后见。 [shao hou jian 。]

english: What's this patch for?
translation: 这个补丁有什么用？ [zhe ge bu ding you shen me yong ？]

english: See you later.
translation: 稍后见。 [shao hou jian 。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Leave me be. I am not here to make friends.
translation: 别管我了。我来这里不是为了交朋友。 [bie guan wo le 。 wo lai zhe li bu shi wei le jiao peng you 。]

english: Fair enough.
translation: 很公平。 [hen gong ping 。]

english: Hello, The Face said you wanted to speak with me.
translation: 你好，The Face 说你想和我说话。 [ni hao ，The Face  shuo ni xiang he wo shuo hua 。]

english: Ah, we meet at last. My fellow ratcatchers tell me you're quite the talent.
translation: 啊，我们终于见面了。我的捕鼠同伴告诉我你很有天赋。 [a ， wo men zhong yu jian mian le 。 wo de bu shu tong ban gao su wo ni hen you tian fu 。]

english: Well I can't take all the credit, I've had more than a little help from my cat.
translation: 好吧，我不能把所有的功劳都归功于我，我从我的猫那里得到了很多帮助。 [hao ba ， wo bu neng ba suo you de gong lao dou gui gong yu wo ， wo cong wo de mao na li de dao le hen duo bang zhu 。]

english: Ah, modesty. A trait seldom displayed by adventurers like yourself.
translation: 啊，谦虚。像你这样的冒险家很少表现出这种特质。 [a ， qian xu 。 xiang ni zhe yang de mao xian jia hen shao biao xian chu zhe zhong te zhi 。]

english: Too many more like you and I'll lose half of my business.
translation: 像你这样的人太多了，我就会失去一半的生意。 [xiang ni zhe yang de ren tai duo le ， wo jiu hui shi qu yi ban de sheng yi 。]

english: Why's that?
translation: 这是为什么呢？ [zhe shi wei shen me ne ？]

english: Epic poems aren't usually commissioned by the shy and retiring.
translation: 史诗通常不是由害羞和隐居的人委托创作的。 [shi shi tong chang bu shi you hai xiu he yin ju de ren wei tuo chuang zuo de 。]

english: Smokin' Joe said that you know lots about training wily cats.
translation: 冒烟的乔说你对训练狡猾的猫了解很多。 [mao yan de qiao shuo ni dui xun lian jiao hua de mao liao jie hen duo 。]

english: I do indeed. In fact, that's why I wanted to talk to you.
translation: 我确实如此。事实上，这就是我想和你谈谈的原因。 [wo que shi ru ci 。 shi shi shang ， zhe jiu shi wo xiang he ni tan tan de yuan yin 。]

english: So you'll show me how to turn my cat into a wily cat?
translation: 那么你会告诉我如何把我的猫变成一只狡猾的猫吗？ [na me ni hui gao su wo ru he ba wo de mao bian cheng yi zhi jiao hua de mao ma ？]

english: Ah, ah, ah - not so fast.
translation: 啊啊啊——没那么快。 [a a a —— mei na me kuai 。]

english: Let me guess... you want me to catch some rats for you first?
translation: 让我猜猜...你想让我先帮你抓一些老鼠吗？ [rang wo cai cai ... ni xiang rang wo xian bang ni zhua yi xie lao shu ma ？]

english: Bingo.
translation: 宾果游戏。 [bin guo you xi 。]

english: Alright then, what's the job?
translation: 好吧，那工作是什么？ [hao ba ， na gong zuo shi shen me ？]

english: Nothing too difficult. Just rid the port of every single rat... at once.
translation: 没什么太难的。立刻把港口里的每一只老鼠都消灭掉。 [mei shen me tai nan de 。 li ke ba gang kou li de mei yi zhi lao shu dou xiao mie diao 。]

english: At once?!
translation: 立刻？！ [li ke ？！]

english: Yep. I expect to see all the rats in Port Sarim dead in one, decisive action.
translation: 是的。我希望看到沙里姆港的所有老鼠都能通过一次果断的行动被消灭。 [shi de 。 wo xi wang kan dao sha li mu gang de suo you lao shu dou neng tong guo yi ci guo duan de xing dong bei xiao mie 。]

english: Are you serious?
translation: 你是认真的？ [ni shi ren zhen de ？]

english: Deadly!
translation: 致命！ [zhi ming ！]

english: So why do you want all the rats wiped out at once?
translation: 那么你为什么要立即消灭所有老鼠呢？ [na me ni wei shen me yao li ji xiao mie suo you lao shu ne ？]

english: I want to write a new poem.
translation: 我想写一首新诗。 [wo xiang xie yi shou xin shi 。]

english: About me?! How flattering.
translation: 关于我？！多么讨人喜欢啊。 [guan yu wo ？！ duo me tao ren xi huan a 。]

english: No, silly. A poem about the art of ratcatching.
translation: 不，愚蠢的。一首关于捕鼠艺术的诗。 [bu ， yu chun de 。 yi shou guan yu bu shu yi shu de shi 。]

english: Poetry might be my bread and butter, but catching rats is my real passion.
translation: 诗歌可能是我的面包和黄油，但抓老鼠才是我真正的热情。 [shi ge ke neng shi wo de mian bao he huang you ， dan zhua lao shu cai shi wo zhen zheng de re qing 。]

english: Couldn't you just use some 'creative license' instead?
translation: 难道你不能使用一些“创意许可”来代替吗？ [nan dao ni bu neng shi yong yi xie “ chuang yi xu ke ” lai dai ti ma ？]

english: Not to disappoint you, but this task might be beyond my capabilities...
translation: 不想让你失望，但是这个任务可能超出了我的能力范围...... [bu xiang rang ni shi wang ， dan shi zhe ge ren wu ke neng chao chu le wo de neng li fan wei ......]

english: Don't be so hard on yourself!
translation: 别对自己那么难！ [bie dui zi ji na me nan ！]

english: Besides, it's not difficult. I myself performed the very same feat just a few years ago.
translation: 此外，这并不困难。就在几年前，我本人也完成了同样的壮举。 [ci wai ， zhe bing bu kun nan 。 jiu zai ji nian qian ， wo ben ren ye wan cheng le tong yang de zhuang ju 。]

english: You did? How?
translation: 你做到了吗？如何？ [ni zuo dao le ma ？ ru he ？]

english: Ha! Nice try. You'll have to figure that out for yourself.
translation: 哈!不错的尝试。你必须自己弄清楚这一点。 [ha ! bu cuo de chang shi 。 ni bi xu zi ji nong qing chu zhe yi dian 。]

english: It was worth a shot...
translation: 值得一试... [zhi de yi shi ...]

english: Any luck killing all the rats yet?
translation: 还好运气好，把所有的老鼠都消灭掉了吗？ [hai hao yun qi hao ， ba suo you de lao shu dou xiao mie diao le ma ？]

english: What do I have to do again?
translation: 我还需要做什么？ [wo hai xu yao zuo shen me ？]

english: Kill all the rats in Port Sarim in one, swift action.
translation: 迅速行动，消灭沙里姆港的所有老鼠。 [xun su xing dong ， xiao mie sha li mu gang de suo you lao shu 。]

english: Right. I'd better figure out how I'm going to do that...
translation: 正确的。我最好想想我该怎么做... [zheng que de 。 wo zui hao xiang xiang wo gai zen me zuo ...]

english: I think I know how to carry out your task.
translation: 我想我知道如何完成你的任务。 [wo xiang wo zhi dao ru he wan cheng ni de ren wu 。]

english: Oh yes? Has The Face been telling tales again?
translation: 哦是的？脸蛋又开始讲故事了吗？ [o shi de ？ lian dan you kai shi jiang gu shi le ma ？]

english: Oh no, she didn't say a word.
translation: 哦不，她什么也没说。 [o bu ， ta shen me ye mei shuo 。]

english: Really, she didn't.
translation: 真的，她没有。 [zhen de ， ta mei you 。]

english: Ha! I did it. Did you see?
translation: 哈!我做到了。你有没有看到？ [ha ! wo zuo dao le 。 ni you mei you kan dao ？]

english: I did indeed! A performance for the ages.
translation: 我确实做到了！一场历久弥新的表演。 [wo que shi zuo dao le ！ yi chang li jiu mi xin de biao yan 。]

english: Now that you're a real ratcatcher, I'd be happy to train that cat of yours.
translation: 既然你是一个真正的捕鼠者，我很乐意训练你的那只猫。 [ji ran ni shi yi ge zhen zheng de bu shu zhe ， wo hen le yi xun lian ni de na zhi mao 。]

english: Can you train my cat to be a wily cat?
translation: 你能把我的猫训练成一只狡猾的猫吗？ [ni neng ba wo de mao xun lian cheng yi zhi jiao hua de mao ma ？]

english: I can only train overgrown cats into wily cats.
translation: 我只能把长大的猫训练成狡猾的猫。 [wo zhi neng ba zhang da de mao xun lian cheng jiao hua de mao 。]

english: Can you rename my cat?
translation: 你能给我的猫重新命名吗？ [ni neng gei wo de mao chong xin ming ming ma ？]

english: Hey [player name], you finally got around to naming me.
translation: 嘿[玩家名字]，你终于抽出时间来命名我了。 [hei [ wan jia ming zi ]， ni zhong yu chou chu shi jian lai ming ming wo le 。]

english: Sorry I took so long, [cat name], it took a while to come up with a name for you.
translation: 抱歉，我花了这么长时间，[猫名]，花了一段时间才为你想出一个名字。 [bao qian ， wo hua le zhe me zhang shi jian ，[ mao ming ]， hua le yi duan shi jian cai wei ni xiang chu yi ge ming zi 。]

english: Miaaow!
translation: 喵呜！ [miao wu ！]

english: Can you tell me more about wily cats?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于狡猾的猫的事情吗？ [ni neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu jiao hua de mao de shi qing ma ？]

english: I'll only help you name wily or lazy cats. Bring me one and I'll help you out.
translation: 我只会帮你命名狡猾或懒惰的猫。给我一张，我会帮你的。 [wo zhi hui bang ni ming ming jiao hua huo lan duo de mao 。 gei wo yi zhang ， wo hui bang ni de 。]

english: Can you tell me more about the pits?
translation: 能告诉我更多关于坑的事情吗？ [neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu keng de shi qing ma ？]

english: Here take this, you might find it useful.
translation: 拿走这个，你可能会发现它很有用。 [na zou zhe ge ， ni ke neng hui fa xian ta hen you yong 。]

english: What do you want to know?
translation: 你想知道什么？ [ni xiang zhi dao shen me ？]

english: Do you have any pointers for me and my cat?
translation: 您对我和我的猫有什么建议吗？ [nin dui wo he wo de mao you shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: You should wear an Amulet of Catspeak. It will allow you to organise tactics with your cat.
translation: 你应该佩戴猫语护身符。它可以让你和你的猫一起制定策略。 [ni ying gai pei dai mao yu hu shen fu 。 ta ke yi rang ni he ni de mao yi qi zhi ding ce lve 。]

english: What would be the best tactic to adopt then?
translation: 那么采取什么策略最好呢？ [na me cai qu shen me ce lve zui hao ne ？]

english: Well, that depends on your outlook, whether you're ready to risk your cat's life or not and how defensive or aggressive you want your cat to be.
translation: 嗯，这取决于您的看法，您是否准备好冒猫的生命危险，以及您希望猫的防御性或攻击性如何。 [n ， zhe qu jue yu nin de kan fa ， nin shi fou zhun bei hao mao mao de sheng ming wei xian ， yi ji nin xi wang mao de fang yu xing huo gong ji xing ru he 。]

english: I will not risk my cat's life.
translation: 我不会拿我的猫的生命冒险。 [wo bu hui na wo de mao de sheng ming mao xian 。]

english: Well if that's the case then you're left with two choices.
translation: 好吧，如果是这样的话，那么你有两个选择。 [hao ba ， ru guo shi zhe yang de hua ， na me ni you liang ge xuan ze 。]

english: You can adopt an ultra defensive strategy, which increases your cat's hitpoints and defence but causes it to flee sooner.
translation: 您可以采取超防御策略，这会增加猫的生命值和防御力，但会使其更快逃跑。 [nin ke yi cai qu chao fang yu ce lve ， zhe hui zeng jia mao de sheng ming zhi he fang yu li ， dan hui shi qi geng kuai tao pao 。]

english: Or you can adopt a less defensive strategy, which will allow your cat to stay in the pit for longer.
translation: 或者您可以采取较少防御的策略，这将使您的猫在坑中停留更长时间。 [huo zhe nin ke yi cai qu jiao shao fang yu de ce lve ， zhe jiang shi nin de mao zai keng zhong ting liu geng zhang shi jian 。]

english: I think I would adopt a very defensive strategy
translation: 我想我会采取非常防守的策略 [wo xiang wo hui cai qu fei chang fang shou de ce lve]

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'Just take care of yourself, cat.'
translation: 在这种情况下，您应该告诉您的猫：“照顾好自己，猫。” [zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， nin ying gai gao su nin de mao ：“ zhao gu hao zi ji ， mao 。”]

english: Thanks for your help.
translation: 感谢您的帮助。 [gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]

english: Do you have any other questions about the pits?
translation: 关于坑你还有其他疑问吗？ [guan yu keng ni hai you qi ta yi wen ma ？]

english: I think I would adopt a less defensive strategy.
translation: 我想我会采取较少防御的策略。 [wo xiang wo hui cai qu jiao shao fang yu de ce lve 。]

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'Stay in for as long as you can.'
translation: 在这种情况下，您应该告诉您的猫：“尽可能呆在家里。” [zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， nin ying gai gao su nin de mao ：“ jin ke neng dai zai jia li 。”]

english: I am willing to risk my cat, if it increases my chances of victory.
translation: 如果我的猫能增加我获胜的机会，我愿意拿它冒险。 [ru guo wo de mao neng zeng jia wo huo sheng de ji hui ， wo yuan yi na ta mao xian 。]

english: In that case you are left with two choices.
translation: 在这种情况下，你有两个选择。 [zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， ni you liang ge xuan ze 。]

english: You could go for all out attack which will boost your cat's attack and strength, but weaken it.
translation: 你可以全力攻击，这会增强你的猫的攻击力和力量，但会削弱它。 [ni ke yi quan li gong ji ， zhe hui zeng qiang ni de mao de gong ji li he li liang ， dan hui xue ruo ta 。]

english: Or, go for a less aggressive stance, which will increase your cat's strength and attack to a lesser degree, but carries no defensive penalties.
translation: 或者，采取不那么激进的姿势，这会增加猫的力量和攻击力，但不会带来防御惩罚。 [huo zhe ， cai qu bu na me ji jin de zi shi ， zhe hui zeng jia mao de li liang he gong ji li ， dan bu hui dai lai fang yu cheng fa 。]

english: I think I would adopt a very aggressive strategy.
translation: 我想我会采取非常激进的策略。 [wo xiang wo hui cai qu fei chang ji jin de ce lve 。]

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'Go berserk!'
translation: 在这种情况下，你应该告诉你的猫：“发疯吧！” [zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， ni ying gai gao su ni de mao ：“ fa feng ba ！”]

english: I think I would adopt a less aggressive strategy.
translation: 我想我会采取不那么激进的策略。 [wo xiang wo hui cai qu bu na me ji jin de ce lve 。]

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'No guts, no glory!'
translation: 在这种情况下，你应该告诉你的猫：“没有勇气，就没有荣耀！” [zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， ni ying gai gao su ni de mao ：“ mei you yong qi ， jiu mei you rong yao ！”]

english: What benefits does my cat get from training in the pits?
translation: 我的猫从训练区训练中得到什么好处？ [wo de mao cong xun lian qu xun lian zhong de dao shen me hao chu ？]

english: It depends on what kind of cat you have.
translation: 这取决于你养的是什么类型的猫。 [zhe qu jue yu ni yang de shi shen me lei xing de mao 。]

english: In the Port Sarim pits, your cat will become happier and fitter after fighting.
translation: 在沙里姆港的坑中，您的猫在战斗后会变得更快乐、更健康。 [zai sha li mu gang de keng zhong ， nin de mao zai zhan dou hou hui bian de geng kuai le 、 geng jian kang 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Can you tell me more about Wily cats?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于威利猫的事吗？ [ni neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu wei li mao de shi ma ？]

english: Of course!
translation: 当然！ [dang ran ！]

english: They're tougher, stronger and faster than other kinds of cats. They have superior hunting skills and can even catch butterflies and kalphite larvae.
translation: 它们比其他种类的猫更坚韧、更强壮、更快。他们拥有高超的狩猎技巧，甚至可以捕捉蝴蝶和钾金矿幼虫。 [ta men bi qi ta zhong lei de mao geng jian ren 、 geng qiang zhuang 、 geng kuai 。 ta men yong you gao chao de shou lie ji qiao ， shen zhi ke yi bu zhuo hu die he jia jin kuang you chong 。]

english: So are there any drawbacks to owning them?
translation: 那么拥有它们有什么缺点吗？ [na me yong you ta men you shen me que dian ma ？]

english: Wily cats need lots more exercise, otherwise they'll get fat and lazy.
translation: 狡猾的猫需要更多的锻炼，否则它们会变得又胖又懒。 [jiao hua de mao xu yao geng duo de duan lian ， fou ze ta men hui bian de you pang you lan 。]

english: What's the best way to exercise them?
translation: 锻炼它们的最佳方法是什么？ [duan lian ta men de zui jia fang fa shi shen me ？]

english: Bring it hunting or take it to the Rat Pits regularly.
translation: 带它去狩猎或定期带它去老鼠坑。 [dai ta qu shou lie huo ding qi dai ta qu lao shu keng 。]

english: Try and keep it happy too,wily cats can be a little nasty when they're cranky.
translation: 也要试着让它开心，狡猾的猫在暴躁的时候可能会有点讨厌。 [ye yao shi zhe rang ta kai xin ， jiao hua de mao zai bao zao de shi hou ke neng hui you dian tao yan 。]

english: What happens if I neglect my cat? Not that I would!
translation: 如果我忽视我的猫会怎样？我不会！ [ru guo wo hu shi wo de mao hui zen yang ？ wo bu hui ！]

english: It'll get fat and lazy and become much worse at hunting. Plus, everyone will know you're a bad cat trainer.
translation: 它会变得又胖又懒，狩猎能力也会变得更差。另外，每个人都会知道你是一个糟糕的驯猫师。 [ta hui bian de you pang you lan ， shou lie neng li ye hui bian de geng cha 。 ling wai ， mei ge ren du hui zhi dao ni shi yi ge zao gao de xun mao shi 。]

english: Can I retrain my lazy cat?
translation: 我可以重新训练我的懒猫吗？ [wo ke yi chong xin xun lian wo de lan mao ma ？]

english: Yes, you can get your lazy cat back in shape with lots of rat catching. But you really shouldn't let things get that bad.
translation: 是的，你可以通过大量抓老鼠来让你的懒猫恢复体形。但你真的不应该让事情变得那么糟糕。 [shi de ， ni ke yi tong guo da liang zhua lao shu lai rang ni de lan mao hui fu ti xing 。 dan ni zhen de bu ying gai rang shi qing bian de na me zao gao 。]

english: How's the poem going?
translation: 诗写得怎么样了？ [shi xie de zen me yang le ？]

english: Ah yes, the poem... your performance was incredibly inspiring. I think it'll be a real masterpiece...
translation: 啊，是的，这首诗……你的表演非常鼓舞人心。我认为这将是一部真正的杰作...... [a ， shi de ， zhe shou shi …… ni de biao yan fei chang gu wu ren xin 。 wo ren wei zhe jiang shi yi bu zhen zheng de jie zuo ......]

english: Just as soon as I get around to writing it all down.
translation: 当我有时间把这一切写下来的时候。 [dang wo you shi jian ba zhe yi qie xie xia lai de shi hou 。]

english: Hello, the facesaid that you were looking to talk with me.
translation: 你好，这张脸说你想和我说话。 [ni hao ， zhe zhang lian shuo ni xiang he wo shuo hua 。]

english: Indeed, word has gotten to me from our other ratcatcher chapters that you are quite a talent.
translation: 事实上，我从我们其他的捕鼠者章节中得知，你是一个相当有才华的人。 [shi shi shang ， wo cong wo men qi ta de bu shu zhe zhang jie zhong de zhi ， ni shi yi ge xiang dang you cai hua de ren 。]

english: Modesty, a trait seldom displayed by adventurers these days.
translation: 谦虚，这是当今冒险家很少表现出的品质。 [qian xu ， zhe shi dang jin mao xian jia hen shao biao xian chu de pin zhi 。]

english: Why is that?
translation: 这是为什么？ [zhe shi wei shen me ？]

english: Epic poems of bravery and heroics aren't usually commissioned by the shy and retiring.
translation: 勇敢和英雄的史诗通常不是由害羞和隐居的人委托创作的。 [yong gan he ying xiong de shi shi tong chang bu shi you hai xiu he yin ju de ren wei tuo chuang zuo de 。]

english: Indeed I do. It's for this very reason that I requested to talk to you.
translation: 确实如此。正是出于这个原因，我要求与您交谈。 [que shi ru ci 。 zheng shi chu yu zhe ge yuan yin ， wo yao qiu yu nin jiao tan 。]

english: So you will show me how to turn my cat into a wily cat?
translation: 那么你会告诉我如何把我的猫变成一只狡猾的猫吗？ [na me ni hui gao su wo ru he ba wo de mao bian cheng yi zhi jiao hua de mao ma ？]

english: No, not yet.
translation: 不，还没有。 [bu ， hai mei you 。]

english: *Sighs.*
translation: *叹息。* [* tan xi 。*]

english: No I need you to carry out just one task for me.
translation: 不，我只需要你为我执行一项任务。 [bu ， wo zhi xu yao ni wei wo zhi xing yi xiang ren wu 。]

english: Well experience has taught me to expect as much, what must I do?
translation: 经验告诉我要有同样的期望，我必须做什么？ [jing yan gao su wo yao you tong yang de qi wang ， wo bi xu zuo shen me ？]

english: Nothing too difficult, just rid the port of every single rat, with just one action.
translation: 没什么太难的，只需一个动作就可以把港口里的每一只老鼠都消灭掉。 [mei shen me tai nan de ， zhi xu yi ge dong zuo jiu ke yi ba gang kou li de mei yi zhi lao shu dou xiao mie diao 。]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: Deadly.
translation: 致命。 [zhi ming 。]

english: But why? Why one stroke, why not a slow eradication?
translation: 但为什么？为什么要一次中风，为什么不慢慢消灭呢？ [dan wei shen me ？ wei shen me yao yi ci zhong feng ， wei shen me bu man man xiao mie ne ？]

english: But...
I am touched that you want to write an epic poem about me, but why can't you write the poem about seagulls or daffodils or something?
translation: 我很感动你想写一首关于我的史诗，但是为什么你不能写关于海鸥或水仙花之类的诗呢？ [wo hen gan dong ni xiang xie yi shou guan yu wo de shi shi ， dan shi wei shen me ni bu neng xie guan yu hai ou huo shui xian hua zhi lei de shi ne ？]

english: Well seagulls rarely make good central characters. They're a bit too ... uhm.... flighty.
translation: Well seagulls rarely make good central characters.他们有点太……呃……轻浮。 [Well seagulls rarely make good central characters. ta men you dian tai …… e …… qing fu 。]

english: Besides the poem is about me not you.
translation: 此外，这首诗是关于我的，而不是关于你的。 [ci wai ， zhe shou shi shi guan yu wo de ， er bu shi guan yu ni de 。]

english: Sorry I don't follow.
translation: 抱歉我没跟上。 [bao qian wo mei gen shang 。]

english: I myself carried out the very same feat once upon a time.
translation: 我本人也曾完成过同样的壮举。 [wo ben ren ye ceng wan cheng guo tong yang de zhuang ju 。]

english: So why do you need me to repeat your most heroic of feats?
translation: 那么，为什么你需要我重复你最英勇的壮举呢？ [na me ， wei shen me ni xu yao wo chong fu ni zui ying yong de zhuang ju ne ？]

english: It's all about objectivity and integrity. I need to be utterly divorced from the process.
translation: 这一切都与客观性和完整性有关。我需要完全脱离这个过程。 [zhe yi qie dou yu ke guan xing he wan zheng xing you guan 。 wo xu yao wan quan tuo li zhe ge guo cheng 。]

english: No. Therein lies the challenge.

english: Yes I saw that, now what can I do for you? Don't keep me overly long, I'm trying to complete my poem.
translation: 是的，我看到了，现在我能为您做些什么吗？别让我太久，我正在努力完成我的诗。 [shi de ， wo kan dao le ， xian zai wo neng wei nin zuo xie shen me ma ？ bie rang wo tai jiu ， wo zheng zai nu li wan cheng wo de shi 。]

english: Can you show me how to train my cat into a wily cat?
translation: 你能教我如何把我的猫训练成一只狡猾的猫吗？ [ni neng jiao wo ru he ba wo de mao xun lian cheng yi zhi jiao hua de mao ma ？]

english: I can only train overgrown cats into wilycats.
translation: 我只能把长大的猫训练成狡猾的猫。 [wo zhi neng ba zhang da de mao xun lian cheng jiao hua de mao 。]

english: You already have a mature cat, look after that first.
translation: 你已经有一只成熟的猫了，先照顾它吧。 [ni yi jing you yi zhi cheng shu de mao le ， xian zhao gu ta ba 。]

english: You should really name your cat.
translation: 你真的应该给你的猫起名字。 [ni zhen de ying gai gei ni de mao qi ming zi 。]

english: Hey [username], you finally got around to naming me.
translation: 嘿[用户名]，你终于肯给我起名字了。 [hei [ yong hu ming ]， ni zhong yu ken gei wo qi ming zi le 。]

english: Sorry I took so long, [catname], it took a while to come up with a name for you.
translation: 抱歉，我花了这么长时间，[猫名]，花了一段时间才为你想出一个名字。 [bao qian ， wo hua le zhe me zhang shi jian ，[ mao ming ]， hua le yi duan shi jian cai wei ni xiang chu yi ge ming zi 。]

english: Here take this, you might find it useful
translation: 拿走这个，你可能会发现它很有用 [na zou zhe ge ， ni ke neng hui fa xian ta hen you yong]

english: Well what do you want to know?
translation: 那么你想知道什么？ [na me ni xiang zhi dao shen me ？]

english: You should wear an amulet of catspeak. It will allow you to organise tactics with your cat.
translation: 你应该佩戴猫语护身符。它可以让你和你的猫一起制定策略。 [ni ying gai pei dai mao yu hu shen fu 。 ta ke yi rang ni he ni de mao yi qi zhi ding ce lve 。]

english: Well if that's the case then yourare left with two choices.
translation: 好吧，如果是这样的话，那么你就有两个选择。 [hao ba ， ru guo shi zhe yang de hua ， na me ni jiu you liang ge xuan ze 。]

english: You can adopt an ultra defensive strategy, which increases your cat's hitpoints and defence, the drawback to this is that your cat will flee sooner.
translation: 你可以采取超防御策略，这会增加你的猫的生命值和防御力，这样做的缺点是你的猫会更快逃跑。 [ni ke yi cai qu chao fang yu ce lve ， zhe hui zeng jia ni de mao de sheng ming zhi he fang yu li ， zhe yang zuo de que dian shi ni de mao hui geng kuai tao pao 。]

english: Your other option is to adopt a less defensive strategy which will allow your cat to stay in the pit for longer.
translation: 您的另一个选择是采取较少防御的策略，这将使您的猫在坑中停留更长时间。 [nin de ling yi ge xuan ze shi cai qu jiao shao fang yu de ce lve ， zhe jiang shi nin de mao zai keng zhong ting liu geng zhang shi jian 。]

english: In that case you should tell your cat, 'Just take care of yourself cat.'
translation: 在这种情况下，您应该告诉您的猫：“猫，照顾好自己。” [zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， nin ying gai gao su nin de mao ：“ mao ， zhao gu hao zi ji 。”]

english: In that case you should tell your cat, 'Stay in for as long as you can.'
translation: 在这种情况下，你应该告诉你的猫，“尽可能呆在家里。” [zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， ni ying gai gao su ni de mao ，“ jin ke neng dai zai jia li 。”]

english: You could go for all out attack which will boost your cat's attack and strength, but weaken it
translation: 你可以全力攻击，这会增强你的猫的攻击力和力量，但会削弱它 [ni ke yi quan li gong ji ， zhe hui zeng qiang ni de mao de gong ji li he li liang ， dan hui xue ruo ta]

english: or go for a less aggressive stance which will increase your cat's strength and attack to a lesser degree, but carries no defensive penalties.
translation: 或者采取不那么激进的姿势，这会增加猫的力量和攻击力，但不会带来防御惩罚。 [huo zhe cai qu bu na me ji jin de zi shi ， zhe hui zeng jia mao de li liang he gong ji li ， dan bu hui dai lai fang yu cheng fa 。]

english: I think I would adopt a very aggressive strategy
translation: 我想我会采取非常激进的策略 [wo xiang wo hui cai qu fei chang ji jin de ce lve]

english: In that case you should tell your cat, 'Go berserk!'
translation: 在这种情况下，你应该告诉你的猫，“发疯吧！” [zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， ni ying gai gao su ni de mao ，“ fa feng ba ！”]

english: In that case you should tell this to your cat, 'No guts, no glory!'
translation: 在这种情况下，你应该告诉你的猫：“没有勇气，就没有荣耀！” [zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， ni ying gai gao su ni de mao ：“ mei you yong qi ， jiu mei you rong yao ！”]

english: Of course, of course, they're the highest form of cat that I know of.
translation: 当然，当然，它们是我所知道的最高形态的猫。 [dang ran ， dang ran ， ta men shi wo suo zhi dao de zui gao xing tai de mao 。]

english: They're tougher, stronger and faster than other variations of cat, they can catch butterflies and kalphite larva and are far superior to any other type of cat at hunting.
translation: 它们比其他猫科动物更坚韧、更强壮、更快，它们可以捕捉蝴蝶和钾金石幼虫，并且在狩猎方面远远优于任何其他类型的猫科动物。 [ta men bi qi ta mao ke dong wu geng jian ren 、 geng qiang zhuang 、 geng kuai ， ta men ke yi bu zhuo hu die he jia jin shi you chong ， bing qie zai shou lie fang mian yuan yuan you yu ren he qi ta lei xing de mao ke dong wu 。]

english: So is there any drawbacks to owning them?
translation: 那么拥有它们有什么缺点吗？ [na me yong you ta men you shen me que dian ma ？]

english: Wily cats need looking after or else they get fat and lazy.
translation: 狡猾的猫需要照顾，否则它们会变得又胖又懒。 [jiao hua de mao xu yao zhao gu ， fou ze ta men hui bian de you pang you lan 。]

english: So how do I look after them then?
translation: 那么我该如何照顾他们呢？ [na me wo gai ru he zhao gu ta men ne ？]

english: The key is to keep it active, bring it hunting or to the ratpits regularly.
translation: 关键是要保持它活跃，定期带它去狩猎或去老鼠洞。 [guan jian shi yao bao chi ta huo yue ， ding qi dai ta qu shou lie huo qu lao shu dong 。]

english: Try keep it happy too, they can be a little nasty when they're cranky.
translation: 也尽量让它开心，当它们暴躁的时候可能会有点讨厌。 [ye jin liang rang ta kai xin ， dang ta men bao zao de shi hou ke neng hui you dian tao yan 。]

english: What happens if I neglect my cat.. not that I would or anything?
translation: 如果我忽视我的猫会发生什么……不是我会的或者什么？ [ru guo wo hu shi wo de mao hui fa sheng shen me …… bu shi wo hui de huo zhe shen me ？]

english: They would get fat and lazy, be much worse at hunting and would show you up as a really poor cat trainer.
translation: 它们会变得又胖又懒，狩猎能力更差，而且会让你看起来是一个非常糟糕的驯猫师。 [ta men hui bian de you pang you lan ， shou lie neng li geng cha ， er qie hui rang ni kan qi lai shi yi ge fei chang zao gao de xun mao shi 。]

english: Yes you can get your lazy cat back in shape with a lot of rat catching, but you really shouldn't let it get into that state in the first place.
translation: 是的，你可以通过大量捕捉老鼠来让你的懒猫恢复健康，但你真的不应该让它进入那种状态。 [shi de ， ni ke yi tong guo da liang bu zhuo lao shu lai rang ni de lan mao hui fu jian kang ， dan ni zhen de bu ying gai rang ta jin ru na zhong zhuang tai 。]

english: I am willing to risk my cat if it improves my chances.
