english: I really need to see King Narnode. Could you help me sneak in?

That’s right, 1000 and I’ll sneak you in.

translation: 你已经在这里了，人类。 [ni yi jing zai zhe li le ， ren lei 。]

english: Can I go for a ride?

english: I'm fine, thanks.

english: Welcome wanderer.
translation: 欢迎流浪者。 [huan ying liu lang zhe 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: You're surrounded by a relic of a long lost kingdom.
translation: 你的周围是一个失落已久的王国的遗迹。 [ni de zhou wei shi yi ge shi luo yi jiu de wang guo de yi ji 。]

english: What happened here?
translation: 这里发生了什么？ [zhe li fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: Oh, I couldn't really tell you that.
translation: 哦，我真的不能告诉你。 [o ， wo zhen de bu neng gao su ni 。]

english: This place has sat in ruin for an age, slowly destroyed by the harsh climate of the Wilderness.
translation: 这个地方已经荒废了很长时间，被荒野的恶劣气候慢慢摧毁。 [zhe ge di fang yi jing huang fei le hen zhang shi jian ， bei huang ye de e lie qi hou man man cui hui 。]

english: If it's a ruin, what's the point in being here?
translation: 如果这里是一片废墟，那来这里还有什么意义？ [ru guo zhe li shi yi pian fei xu ， na lai zhe li hai you shen me yi yi ？]

english: I search for knowledge. I want to know what happened to this part of the world.
translation: 我寻找知识。我想知道世界的这个地方发生了什么事。 [wo xun zhao zhi shi 。 wo xiang zhi dao shi jie de zhe ge di fang fa sheng le shen me shi 。]

english: Whilst looking for answers, I slowly turned this broken town into a safe haven for travellers. Welcome to Ferox Enclave.
translation: 在寻找答案的同时，我慢慢地将这座破碎的小镇变成了旅人的避风港。欢迎来到 Ferox Enclave。 [zai xun zhao da an de tong shi ， wo man man di jiang zhe zuo po sui de xiao zhen bian cheng le lv ren de bi feng gang 。 huan ying lai dao  Ferox Enclave。]

english: Quite a dangerous place for a town, don't you think?
translation: 对于一个城镇来说，这是一个相当危险的地方，你不觉得吗？ [dui yu yi ge cheng zhen lai shuo ， zhe shi yi ge xiang dang wei xian de di fang ， ni bu jue de ma ？]

english: It is, but that's why it's needed! Look around, you can see how many others share my opinion.
translation: 确实如此，但这就是为什么需要它！环顾四周，你会发现有多少人同意我的观点。 [que shi ru ci ， dan zhe jiu shi wei shen me xu yao ta ！ huan gu si zhou ， ni hui fa xian you duo shao ren tong yi wo de guan dian 。]

english: You'll find yourself quite safe inside my enclave - the protective barriers should keep any troublemakers out.
translation: 你会发现自己在我的飞地里非常安全——防护屏障应该可以将任何麻烦制造者拒之门外。 [ni hui fa xian zi ji zai wo de fei di li fei chang an quan —— fang hu ping zhang ying gai ke yi jiang ren he ma fan zhi zao zhe ju zhi men wai 。]

english: I will warn you though, if you've had Teleblock cast upon you, I will not allow you back into the Enclave. You'd be a danger to the others gathered here.
translation: 不过我会警告你，如果你对你施展了传送封锁，我将不会允许你回到英克雷。你会对聚集在这里的其他人构成危险。 [bu guo wo hui jing gao ni ， ru guo ni dui ni shi zhan le chuan song feng suo ， wo jiang bu hui yun xu ni hui dao ying ke lei 。 ni hui dui ju ji zai zhe li de qi ta ren gou cheng wei xian 。]

english: Thanks for the information! I'll take a look around.
translation: 感谢您的信息！我会四处看看。 [gan xie nin de xin xi ！ wo hui si chu kan kan 。]

english: Tread carefully my friend.
translation: 小心行事，我的朋友。 [xiao xin xing shi ， wo de peng you 。]

english: What can you do for me?
translation: 你能为我做什么？ [ni neng wei wo zuo shen me ？]

english: Well, if you'd like, I can make it so you respawn in our Enclave. It'll put you right in the heart of all the chaos that surrounds us.
translation: 好吧，如果你愿意，我可以让你在我们的英克雷重生。它会让你置身于我们周围所有混乱的中心。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni yuan yi ， wo ke yi rang ni zai wo men de ying ke lei chong sheng 。 ta hui rang ni zhi shen yu wo men zhou wei suo you hun luan de zhong xin 。]

english: Tell me more.
translation: 告诉我更多。 [gao su wo geng duo 。]

english: This is how it'll work: When you die, you'll respawn right here in Ferox Enclave, just outside the pub we've set up. You will lose your items as normal of course.
translation: 这就是它的运作方式：当你死后，你会在费罗克斯飞地重生，就在我们设立的酒吧外面。当然，您会像平常一样丢失您的物品。 [zhe jiu shi ta de yun zuo fang shi ： dang ni si hou ， ni hui zai fei luo ke si fei di chong sheng ， jiu zai wo men she li de jiu ba wai mian 。 dang ran ， nin hui xiang ping chang yi yang diu shi nin de wu pin 。]

english: I won't be able to do anything if you die somewhere like Castle Wars or the Emir's Arena; they have their own magic to keep you safe.
translation: 如果你死在城堡战争或埃米尔竞技场之类的地方，我将无能为力；他们有自己的魔力来保证您的安全。 [ru guo ni si zai cheng bao zhan zheng huo ai mi er jing ji chang zhi lei de di fang ， wo jiang wu neng wei li ； ta men you zi ji de mo li lai bao zheng nin de an quan 。]

english: It'll cost you though! Transporting you here is no easy task. 5 million coins should do it, that'd be a one time fee of course.
translation: 但这会让你付出代价！把你送到这里可不是一件容易的事。 500万金币就可以了，当然那是一次性费用。 [dan zhe hui rang ni fu chu dai jia ！ ba ni song dao zhe li ke bu shi yi jian rong yi de shi 。 500 wan jin bi jiu ke yi le ， dang ran na shi yi ci xing fei yong 。]

english: I don't have that much money on me.
translation: 我身上没有那么多钱。 [wo shen shang mei you na me duo qian 。]

english: Understandable, you'd have to be a brave [man/woman] to be carrying that much gold out here.
translation: 可以理解的是，你必须是一个勇敢的[男人/女人]才能携带这么多黄金来到这里。 [ke yi li jie de shi ， ni bi xu shi yi ge yong gan de [ nan ren / nv ren ] cai neng xie dai zhe me duo huang jin lai dao zhe li 。]

english: Okay, switch my respawn to Ferox Enclave.
translation: 好的，将我的重生点切换到 Ferox Enclave。 [hao de ， jiang wo de chong sheng dian qie huan dao  Ferox Enclave。]

english: Thank you, you'll respawn in the Enclave from here on out.
translation: 谢谢你，从现在开始你将在英克雷重生。 [xie xie ni ， cong xian zai kai shi ni jiang zai ying ke lei chong sheng 。]

english: I'm not interested.

translation: 你好，请问你们的渡轮开往哪里？ [ni hao ， qing wen ni men de du lun kai wang na li ？]

english: I can ferry ye up t' Al Kharid, if ye want t' be off?
translation: 如果你想离开的话，我可以载你去阿尔卡里德吗？ [ru guo ni xiang li kai de hua ， wo ke yi zai ni qu a er ka li de ma ？]

english: Want t' continue the fight against Tempoross, eh? Good stuff!
translation: 想继续对抗坦波罗斯吗？好东西！ [xiang ji xu dui kang tan bo luo si ma ？ hao dong xi ！]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

translation: 不 [bu]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Ahoy!
translation: 哎哟！ [ai yo ！]

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I ferry skilled sailors and fisherfolk south t' the Spirit Anglers' base in the Ruins of Unkah.
translation: 我将熟练的水手和渔民运送到南部的恩卡废墟中的精神垂钓者基地。 [wo jiang shu lian de shui shou he yu min yun song dao nan bu de en ka fei xu zhong de jing shen chui diao zhe ji di 。]

english: The Spirit Anglers? Who are they?
translation: 精神垂钓者？他们是谁？ [jing shen chui diao zhe ？ ta men shi shui ？]

english: Why, they're a group of sea-faring folk researchin' and fightin' against Tempoross, the crazed spirit that's terrorising the seas! I'm surprised you haven't heard!
translation: 为什么，他们是一群航海民族，正在研究并对抗坦波罗斯，一种威胁海洋的疯狂精灵！我很惊讶你没听说过！ [wei shen me ， ta men shi yi qun hang hai min zu ， zheng zai yan jiu bing dui kang tan bo luo si ， yi zhong wei xie hai yang de feng kuang jing ling ！ wo hen jing ya ni mei ting shuo guo ！]

english: That sounds important! Can I help?
translation: 这听起来很重要！我可以帮忙吗？ [zhe ting qi lai hen zhong yao ！ wo ke yi bang mang ma ？]

english: It's rough out there against Tempoross. We really need fisherfolk who've experienced more of the world.
translation: 对阵 Tempoross 的比赛很艰难。我们确实需要经历过更多世界的渔民。 [dui zhen  Tempoross  de bi sai hen jian nan 。 wo men que shi xu yao jing li guo geng duo shi jie de yu min 。]

english: I can ferry ye down t' the Spirit Anglers, though they're looking for people with more fishing experience t' face Tempoross.
translation: 我可以载你们去精神垂钓者那里，尽管他们正在寻找有更多钓鱼经验的人来面对坦普罗斯。 [wo ke yi zai ni men qu jing shen chui diao zhe na li ， jin guan ta men zheng zai xun zhao you geng duo diao yu jing yan de ren lai mian dui tan pu luo si 。]

english: You need a Fishing level of 35 to fight Tempoross.
translation: 您需要 35 级钓鱼等级才能与 Tempoross 战斗。 [nin xu yao  35  ji diao yu deng ji cai neng yu  Tempoross  zhan dou 。]

english: Of course! I can ferry ye down there when ye be ready. Ye'll want t' speak to Captain Pudi when ye arrive!
translation: 当然！当你们准备好时我可以把你们送到那里。当你到达时，你会想和普迪船长说话！ [dang ran ！ dang ni men zhun bei hao shi wo ke yi ba ni men song dao na li 。 dang ni dao da shi ， ni hui xiang he pu di chuan zhang shuo hua ！]

english: Do I have to pay for the ferry?
translation: 我需要支付渡轮费用吗？ [wo xu yao zhi fu du lun fei yong ma ？]

english: 'Course not. Don't even 'ave t' fix a price!
translation: 当然不是。甚至不用“定价”！ [dang ran bu shi 。 shen zhi bu yong “ ding jia ”！]

english: The player travels to the Ruins of Unkah.
translation: 玩家前往 Unkah 废墟。 [wan jia qian wang  Unkah  fei xu 。]

english: You ride the little boat south to the Ruins of Unkah.
translation: 你乘小船向南到达温卡废墟。 [ni cheng xiao chuan xiang nan dao da wen ka fei xu 。]

english: Maybe next time, eh?

english: Captain Pudi mentioned you'd stopped by.
translation: 普迪船长提到你曾来过。 [pu di chuan zhang ti dao ni ceng lai guo 。]

english: I certainly did! How is the fight against Tempoross going?

english: Well, that crazed spirit still terrorises the seas but wit' the 'elp of people like yeself, the Spirit Anglers are puttin' up a good fight!
translation: 好吧，那个疯狂的灵魂仍然在威胁着海洋，但在像你们这样的人的帮助下，灵魂垂钓者正在打一场漂亮的战斗！ [hao ba ， na ge feng kuang de ling hun reng ran zai wei xie zhe hai yang ， dan zai xiang ni men zhe yang de ren de bang zhu xia ， ling hun chui diao zhe zheng zai da yi chang piao liang de zhan dou ！]

english: That's good! Can you ferry me to the Spirit Anglers?

english: Uh, ye seem different. I'm not sure ye be in the right place t' be facing Tempoross...

translation: 如果您有一只过大的猫和几枚硬币，您可以挑战其他也有一只过大的猫和一些零钱的人。 [ru guo nin you yi zhi guo da de mao he ji mei ying bi ， nin ke yi tiao zhan qi ta ye you yi zhi guo da de mao he yi xie ling qian de ren 。]

english: That sounds simple enough so far.
translation: 到目前为止，这听起来很简单。 [dao mu qian wei zhi ， zhe ting qi lai hen jian dan 。]

english: You then agree on a wager. It's rumoured that some ratcatchers can talk to their own cats and give them tactics to aid them.
translation: 然后你们同意打赌。有传言说，一些捕鼠者可以与自己的猫交谈，并向它们提供帮助它们的策略。 [ran hou ni men tong yi da du 。 you chuan yan shuo ， yi xie bu shu zhe ke yi yu zi ji de mao jiao tan ， bing xiang ta men ti gong bang zhu ta men de ce lve 。]

english: So then how do you win the challenge?
translation: 那么如何赢得挑战呢？ [na me ru he ying de tiao zhan ne ？]

english: I was just getting to that. Both the challengers' cats are placed inside the arena, and whichever kills 9 rats first wins.
translation: 我刚刚谈到这一点。挑战者的两只猫都被放置在竞技场内，先杀死 9 只老鼠的一方获胜。 [wo gang gang tan dao zhe yi dian 。 tiao zhan zhe de liang zhi mao dou bei fang zhi zai jing ji chang nei ， xian sha si  9  zhi lao shu de yi fang huo sheng 。]

english: That sounds vile and cruel.
translation: 这听上去卑鄙又残忍。 [zhe ting shang qu bei bi you can ren 。]

english: It's a cruel world and the pits are no exception.
translation: 这是一个残酷的世界，坑也不例外。 [zhe shi yi ge can ku de shi jie ， keng ye bu li wai 。]

english: Each to their own, I say.
translation: 我说，各有各的。 [wo shuo ， ge you ge de 。]

english: It sounds a little dangerous for my cat.
translation: 听起来对我的猫来说有点危险。 [ting qi lai dui wo de mao lai shuo you dian wei xian 。]

english: I agree. Cats have been known to be killed in fights.
translation: 我同意。众所周知，猫会在打斗中被杀死。 [wo tong yi 。 zhong suo zhou zhi ， mao hui zai da dou zhong bei sha si 。]

english: Oh how terrible. Is there nothing you can do to save your cat?
translation: 噢，多么可怕啊。你无能为力拯救你的猫吗？ [o ， duo me ke pa a 。 ni wu neng wei li zheng jiu ni de mao ma ？]

english: Of course there is, you can instruct it to be cautious, and it will leave once it feels as if it is in danger.
translation: 当然有，你可以让它小心一点，它感觉有危险就会离开。 [dang ran you ， ni ke yi rang ta xiao xin yi dian ， ta gan jue you wei xian jiu hui li kai 。]

english: Oh that sounds quite wise.
translation: 哦，这听起来很明智。 [o ， zhe ting qi lai hen ming zhi 。]

english: That depends on how you value your cat.
translation: 这取决于你如何评价你的猫。 [zhe qu jue yu ni ru he ping jia ni de mao 。]

english: Sorry, I don't follow.
translation: 抱歉，我不跟。 [bao qian ， wo bu gen 。]

english: Well if your cat dies or it runs away you lose.
translation: 好吧，如果你的猫死了或者逃跑了，你就输了。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni de mao si le huo zhe tao pao le ， ni jiu shu le 。]

english: So the longer it stays in the fight the better chance you have of winning.
translation: 因此，它在战斗中停留的时间越长，您获胜的机会就越大。 [yin ci ， ta zai zhan dou zhong ting liu de shi jian yue zhang ， nin huo sheng de ji hui jiu yue da 。]

english: Wow that sounds like fun!
translation: 哇，听起来很有趣！ [wa ， ting qi lai hen you qu ！]

english: I don't know about that.
translation: 我对此一无所知。 [wo dui ci yi wu suo zhi 。]

english: One thing I know though is that it's a quick way to make and lose money.
translation: 但我知道的一件事是，这是一种快速赚钱和赔钱的方法。 [dan wo zhi dao de yi jian shi shi ， zhe shi yi zhong kuai su zhuan qian he pei qian de fang fa 。]

english: Is there a limit to how much you can bet?
translation: 您可以下注的金额有限制吗？ [nin ke yi xia zhu de jin e you xian zhi ma ？]

english: Hmmm... let me think. I don't think that's ever arisen but I think it's 20,000.
translation: 嗯……让我想想。我认为这种情况从未出现过，但我认为有 20,000 个。 [n …… rang wo xiang xiang 。 wo ren wei zhe zhong qing kuang cong wei chu xian guo ， dan wo ren wei you  20,000  ge 。]

english: Hmm, that sounds like a silly amount of money to bet on a cat fight.
translation: 嗯，这听起来像是在猫打架上押注的一大笔钱。 [n ， zhe ting qi lai xiang shi zai mao da jia shang ya zhu de yi da bi qian 。]

english: You'd be surprised what some people would be willing to bet.
translation: 你会对有些人愿意下注感到惊讶。 [ni hui dui you xie ren yuan yi xia zhu gan dao jing ya 。]

english: There is a minimum bet of 100 coins too.
translation: 最低赌注也为 100 个硬币。 [zui di du zhu ye wei  100  ge ying bi 。]

english: Can I challenge you and your cat?
translation: 我可以挑战你和你的猫吗？ [wo ke yi tiao zhan ni he ni de mao ma ？]

english: No, not now, we don't really bet with outsiders.
translation: 不，现在不行，我们真的不跟外人打赌。 [bu ， xian zai bu xing ， wo men zhen de bu gen wai ren da du 。]

english: But I'm not an outsider, am I not inside in the pits now?
translation: 但我不是外人，我现在不是在坑里吗？ [dan wo bu shi wai ren ， wo xian zai bu shi zai keng li ma ？]

english: I don't know, maybe once you've done something to win over my trust.
translation: 我不知道，也许一旦你做了一些事情来赢得我的信任。 [wo bu zhi dao ， ye xu yi dan ni zuo le yi xie shi qing lai ying de wo de xin ren 。]

english: Can it be bought?
translation: 可以买吗？ [ke yi mai ma ？]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: Your trust.
translation: 您的信任。 [nin de xin ren 。]

english: No. Regular townsfolk don't like us, which leads us to distrust them and anyone else.
translation: 不。普通城镇居民不喜欢我们，这导致我们不信任他们和其他任何人。 [bu 。 pu tong cheng zhen ju min bu xi huan wo men ， zhe dao zhi wo men bu xin ren ta men he qi ta ren he ren 。]

english: Thanks for your help.
translation: 感谢您的帮助。 [gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]

english: That sounds vile and cruel.
translation: 这听上去卑鄙又残忍。 [zhe ting shang qu bei bi you can ren 。]

english: One more thing...
translation: 还有一件事... [hai you yi jian shi ...]

english: Thanks for your help.
translation: 感谢您的帮助。 [gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]

english: It sounds a little dangerous for my cat.
translation: 听起来对我的猫来说有点危险。 [ting qi lai dui wo de mao lai shuo you dian wei xian 。]

english: Wow that sounds like fun.
translation: 哇，听起来很有趣。 [wa ， ting qi lai hen you qu 。]

english: Is there a limit to how much you can bet?
translation: 您可以下注的金额有限制吗？ [nin ke yi xia zhu de jin e you xian zhi ma ？]

english: Can I challenge you and your cat?
translation: 我可以挑战你和你的猫吗？ [wo ke yi tiao zhan ni he ni de mao ma ？]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Ahoy there! Here for a drink? You've picked the right place for it. Steve is thankfully a much better bartender than he was a sailor.
translation: 哎哟！来这里喝一杯吗？您已经为它选择了正确的位置。值得庆幸的是，史蒂夫是一名比水手更好的调酒师。 [ai yo ！ lai zhe li he yi bei ma ？ nin yi jing wei ta xuan ze le zheng que de wei zhi 。 zhi de qing xing de shi ， shi di fu shi yi ming bi shui shou geng hao de diao jiu shi 。]

english: Sounds like there's a story here?
translation: 听起来这里面有故事？ [ting qi lai zhe li mian you gu shi ？]

english: Indeed there is. Steve fancied himself a pirate, but on his first proper voyage he managed to crash his ship, the Pandemonium, right here.
translation: 确实有。史蒂夫幻想自己是一名海盗，但在他第一次正式航行时，他就在这里撞毁了他的船“混乱号”。 [que shi you 。 shi di fu huan xiang zi ji shi yi ming hai dao ， dan zai ta di yi ci zheng shi hang xing shi ， ta jiu zai zhe li zhuang hui le ta de chuan “ hun luan hao ”。]

english: He crashed? How?
translation: 他坠毁了？如何？ [ta zhui hui le ？ ru he ？]

english: He claims it was an unavoidable accident caused by the Storm Tempor, but I heard it was actually because he got distracted by a large flock of angry parrots.
translation: 他声称这是一场由风暴风暴造成的不可避免的事故，但我听说这实际上是因为他被一大群愤怒的鹦鹉分散了注意力。 [ta sheng cheng zhe shi yi chang you feng bao feng bao zao cheng de bu ke bi mian de shi gu ， dan wo ting shuo zhe shi ji shang shi yin wei ta bei yi da qun fen nu de ying wu fen san le zhu yi li 。]

english: So he crashed the boat and then decided to open a bar?
translation: 所以他毁了船，然后决定开一家酒吧？ [suo yi ta hui le chuan ， ran hou jue ding kai yi jia jiu ba ？]

english: Pretty much.
translation: 差不多了。 [cha bu duo le 。]

english: I see. Fair enough.
translation: 我懂了。很公平。 [wo dong le 。 hen gong ping 。]

english: The camera pans to the Fire Warrior of Lesarkus spawning when the player attempts to open the door.
translation: 当玩家尝试打开门时，镜头摇到 Lesarkus 火战士的生成位置。 [dang wan jia chang shi da kai men shi ， jing tou yao dao  Lesarkus  huo zhan shi de sheng cheng wei zhi 。]

english: The Fire Warrior of Lesarkus casts a spell to push the player away from the door.
translation: 雷萨库斯的火战士施展咒语将玩家推离门外。 [lei sa ku si de huo zhan shi shi zhan zhou yu jiang wan jia tui li men wai 。]

english: Your puny weapons do nothing against me human! Come back when you can give me a real fight!
translation: 你那微不足道的武器对我这个人类毫无用处！当你能和我真正战斗的时候就回来吧！ [ni na wei bu zu dao de wu qi dui wo zhe ge ren lei hao wu yong chu ！ dang ni neng he wo zhen zheng zhan dou de shi hou jiu hui lai ba ！]

english: Who dares to enter the Temple of Ikov!
translation: 谁敢进伊科夫神殿！ [shui gan jin yi ke fu shen dian ！]

english: A mighty hero!
translation: 一个强大的英雄！ [yi ge qiang da de ying xiong ！]

english: Pathetic fool! Prepare to die!
translation: 可悲的傻瓜！准备好受死吧！ [ke bei de sha gua ！ zhun bei hao shou si ba ！]

english: A humble pilgrim.
translation: 一个谦卑的朝圣者。 [yi ge qian bei de chao sheng zhe 。]

english: I haven't seen a pilgrim for thousands of years!
translation: 几千年没见过香客了！ [ji qian nian mei jian guo xiang ke le ！]

english: Temple is closed!
translation: 寺庙关闭了！ [si miao guan bi le ！]

english: You will not pass!
translation: 你不会通过的！ [ni bu hui tong guo de ！]

english: Amitus! Setitii!
translation: 阿米图斯！塞蒂蒂！ [a mi tu si ！ sai di di ！]

english: A mighty hero!
translation: 一个强大的英雄！ [yi ge qiang da de ying xiong ！]

english: A humble pilgrim.
translation: 一个谦卑的朝圣者。 [yi ge qian bei de chao sheng zhe 。]

english: Gratias tibi ago!
translation: 谢谢你！ [xie xie ni ！]

english: What do you need, adventurer? There is a battle to fight!
translation: 冒险家，你需要什么？有一场战斗要打！ [mao xian jia ， ni xu yao shen me ？ you yi chang zhan dou yao da ！]

english: How do I help?
translation: 我该如何提供帮助？ [wo gai ru he ti gong bang zhu ？]

english: Get yerself a harpoon from the crate on the ship, then go fish around the island t' catch some harpoonfish. They make fer fine ammo against Tempoross!
translation: 从船上的板条箱中取出一把鱼叉，然后在岛上钓鱼，捕获一些鱼叉鱼。他们制造了对抗坦波罗斯的优质弹药！ [cong chuan shang de ban tiao xiang zhong qu chu yi ba yu cha ， ran hou zai dao shang diao yu ， bu huo yi xie yu cha yu 。 ta men zhi zao le dui kang tan bo luo si de you zhi dan yao ！]

english: Once ye caught some, ye can cook 'em at the shrines on the island if ye want 'em to pack more of a punch. Then come back t' the ship an' load 'em in the ammunition crates next to the cannons.
translation: 一旦你捕获了一些，如果你想让它们更有力的话，你可以在岛上的神社里烹饪它们。然后回到船上，将它们装入大炮旁边的弹药箱中。 [yi dan ni bu huo le yi xie ， ru guo ni xiang rang ta men geng you li de hua ， ni ke yi zai dao shang de shen she li peng ren ta men 。 ran hou hui dao chuan shang ， jiang ta men zhuang ru da pao pang bian de dan yao xiang zhong 。]

english: Our cannoneers will get t' firin' the harpoonfish at Tempoross. When it's weak an' submerges to recover its energy, get down to the jetty next t' the ship an' fish those spirit pools.
translation: 我们的炮手将在坦普罗斯发射鱼叉鱼。当它虚弱并潜入水中恢复能量时，到船旁边的码头去钓鱼那些灵魂池。 [wo men de pao shou jiang zai tan pu luo si fa she yu cha yu 。 dang ta xu ruo bing qian ru shui zhong hui fu neng liang shi ， dao chuan pang bian de ma tou qu diao yu na xie ling hun chi 。]

english: Be quick with fishin' those spirit pools though, or it'll come back so strong we'll have to abandon the fight! With any luck, we'll weaken those spirit fish enough t' subdue Tempoross. Now get t' the fight, sailor!
translation: 不过，要快点去钓鱼那些灵魂池，否则它会变得如此强大，我们将不得不放弃战斗！运气好的话，我们就能削弱那些灵鱼的力量，足以制服坦波罗斯。现在开始战斗吧，水手！ [bu guo ， yao kuai dian qu diao yu na xie ling hun chi ， fou ze ta hui bian de ru ci qiang da ， wo men jiang bu de bu fang qi zhan dou ！ yun qi hao de hua ， wo men jiu neng xue ruo na xie ling yu de li liang ， zu yi zhi fu tan bo luo si 。 xian zai kai shi zhan dou ba ， shui shou ！]

english: Aye aye!
translation: 是啊是啊！ [shi a shi a ！]

english: What should I watch out for?
translation: 我应该注意什么？ [wo ying gai zhu yi shen me ？]

english: If Tempoross electrocutes a cannon t' stop it from firin', ya better load your harpoonfish into the other ammunition crates t' keep them cannons firin' instead.
translation: 如果坦波罗斯电击了一门大炮并阻止它开火，你最好将你的鱼叉鱼装进其他弹药箱，以让它们继续开火。 [ru guo tan bo luo si dian ji le yi men da pao bing zu zhi ta kai huo ， ni zui hao jiang ni de yu cha yu zhuang jin qi ta dan yao xiang ， yi rang ta men ji xu kai huo 。]

english: Also, make sure t' grab a rope from the ship crates an' keep an eye out for big waves. We'll make sure t' shout about them. Then ye best quickly tether yerself t' an island totem pole or ship mast with that rope.
translation: 另外，请确保从船上的板条箱中取出一根绳子，并留意大浪。我们一定会大声谈论他们。然后，你最好迅速用那根绳子将自己拴在岛屿图腾柱或船桅上。 [ling wai ， qing que bao cong chuan shang de ban tiao xiang zhong qu chu yi gen sheng zi ， bing liu yi da lang 。 wo men yi ding hui da sheng tan lun ta men 。 ran hou ， ni zui hao xun su yong na gen sheng zi jiang zi ji shuan zai dao yu tu teng zhu huo chuan wei shang 。]

english: If the waves break the totem pole or ship mast, ye can grab a hammer from the ship crates t' fix 'em up before the next big wave hits.
translation: 如果海浪破坏了图腾柱或船桅，你可以从船上的板条箱里拿出一把锤子，在下一个大浪袭来之前将它们修好。 [ru guo hai lang po huai le tu teng zhu huo chuan wei ， ni ke yi cong chuan shang de ban tiao xiang li na chu yi ba chui zi ， zai xia yi ge da lang xi lai zhi qian jiang ta men xiu hao 。]

english: Oh, an' keep an eye out for lightnin' clouds causin' fires. Get a bucket from the ship crates, fill it with water at a pump, and get t' puttin it out before it spreads.
translation: 哦，请留意引起火灾的闪电云。从船上的板条箱中取出一个桶，用泵将其装满水，并在水蔓延之前将其取出。 [o ， qing liu yi yin qi huo zai de shan dian yun 。 cong chuan shang de ban tiao xiang zhong qu chu yi ge tong ， yong beng jiang qi zhuang man shui ， bing zai shui man yan zhi qian jiang qi qu chu 。]

english: If ye get hit by the waves or fire, don't be surprised when ye lose those fish an' tools ye gathered. Now get t' the fight, sailor!
translation: 如果你被海浪或火灾击中，当你失去那些鱼和收集的工具时，不要感到惊讶。现在开始战斗吧，水手！ [ru guo ni bei hai lang huo huo zai ji zhong ， dang ni shi qu na xie yu he shou ji de gong ju shi ， bu yao gan dao jing ya 。 xian zai kai shi zhan dou ba ， shui shou ！]

english: I want to leave.
translation: 我想离开。 [wo xiang li kai 。]

english: Really? You will receive no reward if you do.
translation: 真的吗？如果您这样做，您将不会获得任何奖励。 [zhen de ma ？ ru guo nin zhe yang zuo ， nin jiang bu hui huo de ren he jiang li 。]

english: I'll get on with the fighting.
translation: 我会继续战斗。 [wo hui ji xu zhan dou 。]

english: We did it! Tempoross has been sudbued once again. Well done!
translation: 我们做到了！ Tempoross再次被制服。干得好！ [wo men zuo dao le ！ Tempoross zai ci bei zhi fu 。 gan de hao ！]

english: Take a well deserved rest but don't get too comfy, it'll regain its energy soon enough!
translation: 充分休息，但不要太舒服，它很快就会恢复能量！ [chong fen xiu xi ， dan bu yao tai shu fu ， ta hen kuai jiu hui hui fu neng liang ！]

english: What should I do now?
translation: 我现在该怎么办？ [wo xian zai gai zen me ban ？]

english: We usually find some debris washed up near the docks back at Unkah. Feel free t' have a look. Ya might find somethin' useful!
translation: 我们通常会在温卡码头附近发现一些被冲上岸的碎片。随意看看。你可能会发现一些有用的东西！ [wo men tong chang hui zai wen ka ma tou fu jin fa xian yi xie bei chong shang an de sui pian 。 sui yi kan kan 。 ni ke neng hui fa xian yi xie you yong de dong xi ！]

english: It won't be long before Tempoross regains enough energy to be a problem and we'll have to wrangle it again. Hopefully we can count on you to 'elp!
translation: 过不了多久，Tempoross 就会恢复足够的能量，成为一个问题，我们将不得不再次争论它。希望我们可以依靠您的帮助！ [guo bu liao duo jiu ，Tempoross  jiu hui hui fu zu gou de neng liang ， cheng wei yi ge wen ti ， wo men jiang bu de bu zai ci zheng lun ta 。 xi wang wo men ke yi yi kao nin de bang zhu ！]

english: I'm ready to leave.
translation: 我准备离开了。 [wo zhun bei li kai le 。]

english: Aye aye!
translation: 是啊是啊！ [shi a shi a ！]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Tempoross will surface soon, prepare yourselves!
translation: Temporos即将浮出水面，做好准备！ [Temporos ji jiang fu chu shui mian ， zuo hao zhun bei ！]

english: More fish!
translation: 更多鱼！ [geng duo yu ！]

english: Load those cannons!
translation: 装载那些大炮！ [zhuang zai na xie da pao ！]

english: Keep an eye on the waves!
translation: 密切关注海浪！ [mi qie guan zhu hai lang ！]

english: Tempoross is drawing in water, prepare yourselves!
translation: Tempoross 正在入水，做好准备！ [Tempoross  zheng zai ru shui ， zuo hao zhun bei ！]

english: The totem pole has been damaged!
translation: 图腾柱已损坏！ [tu teng zhu yi sun huai ！]

english: Storm clouds are rolling in, get your buckets ready!
translation: 暴风雨乌云滚滚而来，准备好你的水桶吧！ [bao feng yu wu yun gun gun er lai ， zhun bei hao ni de shui tong ba ！]

english: Tempoross has submerged, fish from the whirlpools!
translation: Tempoross已被淹没，漩涡中的鱼！ [Tempoross yi bei yan mo ， xuan wo zhong de yu ！]

english: Tempoross has surfaced, keep those cannons firing!
translation: Tempoross 已经浮出水面，让那些大炮继续开火！ [Tempoross  yi jing fu chu shui mian ， rang na xie da pao ji xu kai huo ！]

english: Tempoross has retreated to the depths!
translation: Tempoross已经退到了深处！ [Tempoross yi jing tui dao le shen chu ！]

english: Tempoross has gathered too much energy!
translation: Tempoross聚集了太多的能量！ [Tempoross ju ji le tai duo de neng liang ！]

english: The storm has grown too strong, we must retreat!
translation: 风暴太猛烈了，我们必须撤退！ [feng bao tai meng lie le ， wo men bi xu che tui ！]

english: How do I help?
translation: 我该如何提供帮助？ [wo gai ru he ti gong bang zhu ？]

english: What should I watch out for?
translation: 我应该注意什么？ [wo ying gai zhu yi shen me ？]

english: I want to leave.
translation: 我想离开。 [wo xiang li kai 。]

english: Yes, I really want to leave.
translation: 是的，我真的很想离开。 [shi de ， wo zhen de hen xiang li kai 。]

english: No, I don't want to leave.
translation: 不，我不想离开。 [bu ， wo bu xiang li kai 。]

english: I'll get on with the fighting.
translation: 我会继续战斗。 [wo hui ji xu zhan dou 。]

english: What should I do now?
translation: 我现在该怎么办？ [wo xian zai gai zen me ban ？]

english: I'm ready to leave.
translation: 我准备离开了。 [wo zhun bei li kai le 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: What do you need, adventurer? There is a battle to fight!
translation: 冒险家，你需要什么？有一场战斗要打！ [mao xian jia ， ni xu yao shen me ？ you yi chang zhan dou yao da ！]

english: How do I help?
translation: 我该如何提供帮助？ [wo gai ru he ti gong bang zhu ？]

english: Get yerself a harpoon from the crate on the ship, then go fish around the island t' catch some harpoonfish. They make fer fine ammo against Tempoross!
translation: 从船上的板条箱中取出一把鱼叉，然后在岛上钓鱼，捕获一些鱼叉鱼。他们制造了对抗坦波罗斯的优质弹药！ [cong chuan shang de ban tiao xiang zhong qu chu yi ba yu cha ， ran hou zai dao shang diao yu ， bu huo yi xie yu cha yu 。 ta men zhi zao le dui kang tan bo luo si de you zhi dan yao ！]

english: Once ye caught some, ye can cook 'em at the shrines on the island if ye want 'em to pack more of a punch. Then come back t' the ship an' load 'em in the ammunition crates next to the cannons.
translation: 一旦你捕获了一些，如果你想让它们更有力的话，你可以在岛上的神社里烹饪它们。然后回到船上，将它们装入大炮旁边的弹药箱中。 [yi dan ni bu huo le yi xie ， ru guo ni xiang rang ta men geng you li de hua ， ni ke yi zai dao shang de shen she li peng ren ta men 。 ran hou hui dao chuan shang ， jiang ta men zhuang ru da pao pang bian de dan yao xiang zhong 。]

english: Our cannoneers will get t' firin' the harpoonfish at Tempoross. When it's weak an' submerges to recover its energy, get down to the jetty next t' the ship an' fish those spirit pools.
translation: 我们的炮手将在坦普罗斯发射鱼叉鱼。当它虚弱并潜入水中恢复能量时，到船旁边的码头去钓鱼那些灵魂池。 [wo men de pao shou jiang zai tan pu luo si fa she yu cha yu 。 dang ta xu ruo bing qian ru shui zhong hui fu neng liang shi ， dao chuan pang bian de ma tou qu diao yu na xie ling hun chi 。]

english: Be quick with fishin' those spirit pools though, or it'll come back so strong we'll have to abandon the fight! With any luck, we'll weaken those spirit fish enough t' subdue Tempoross. Now get t' the fight, sailor!
translation: 不过，要快点去钓鱼那些灵魂池，否则它会变得如此强大，我们将不得不放弃战斗！运气好的话，我们就能削弱那些灵鱼的力量，足以制服坦波罗斯。现在开始战斗吧，水手！ [bu guo ， yao kuai dian qu diao yu na xie ling hun chi ， fou ze ta hui bian de ru ci qiang da ， wo men jiang bu de bu fang qi zhan dou ！ yun qi hao de hua ， wo men jiu neng xue ruo na xie ling yu de li liang ， zu yi zhi fu tan bo luo si 。 xian zai kai shi zhan dou ba ， shui shou ！]

english: Aye aye!
translation: 是啊是啊！ [shi a shi a ！]

english: What should I watch out for?
translation: 我应该注意什么？ [wo ying gai zhu yi shen me ？]

english: If Tempoross electrocutes a cannon t' stop it from firin', ya better load your harpoonfish into the other ammunition crates t' keep them cannons firin' instead.
translation: 如果坦波罗斯电击了一门大炮并阻止它开火，你最好将你的鱼叉鱼装进其他弹药箱，以让它们继续开火。 [ru guo tan bo luo si dian ji le yi men da pao bing zu zhi ta kai huo ， ni zui hao jiang ni de yu cha yu zhuang jin qi ta dan yao xiang ， yi rang ta men ji xu kai huo 。]

english: Also, make sure t' grab a rope from the ship crates an' keep an eye out for big waves. We'll make sure t' shout about them. Then ye best quickly tether yerself t' an island totem pole or ship mast with that rope.
translation: 另外，请确保从船上的板条箱中取出一根绳子，并留意大浪。我们一定会大声谈论他们。然后，你最好迅速用那根绳子将自己拴在岛屿图腾柱或船桅上。 [ling wai ， qing que bao cong chuan shang de ban tiao xiang zhong qu chu yi gen sheng zi ， bing liu yi da lang 。 wo men yi ding hui da sheng tan lun ta men 。 ran hou ， ni zui hao xun su yong na gen sheng zi jiang zi ji shuan zai dao yu tu teng zhu huo chuan wei shang 。]

english: If the waves break the totem pole or ship mast, ye can grab a hammer from the ship crates t' fix 'em up before the next big wave hits.
translation: 如果海浪破坏了图腾柱或船桅，你可以从船上的板条箱里拿出一把锤子，在下一个大浪袭来之前将它们修好。 [ru guo hai lang po huai le tu teng zhu huo chuan wei ， ni ke yi cong chuan shang de ban tiao xiang li na chu yi ba chui zi ， zai xia yi ge da lang xi lai zhi qian jiang ta men xiu hao 。]

english: Oh, an' keep an eye out for lightnin' clouds causin' fires. Get a bucket from the ship crates, fill it with water at a pump, and get t' puttin it out before it spreads.
translation: 哦，请留意引起火灾的闪电云。从船上的板条箱中取出一个桶，用泵将其装满水，并在水蔓延之前将其取出。 [o ， qing liu yi yin qi huo zai de shan dian yun 。 cong chuan shang de ban tiao xiang zhong qu chu yi ge tong ， yong beng jiang qi zhuang man shui ， bing zai shui man yan zhi qian jiang qi qu chu 。]

english: If ye get hit by the waves or fire, don't be surprised when ye lose those fish an' tools ye gathered. Now get t' the fight, sailor!
translation: 如果你被海浪或火灾击中，当你失去那些鱼和收集的工具时，不要感到惊讶。现在开始战斗吧，水手！ [ru guo ni bei hai lang huo huo zai ji zhong ， dang ni shi qu na xie yu he shou ji de gong ju shi ， bu yao gan dao jing ya 。 xian zai kai shi zhan dou ba ， shui shou ！]

english: I want to leave.
translation: 我想离开。 [wo xiang li kai 。]

english: Really? You will receive no reward if you do.
translation: 真的吗？如果您这样做，您将不会获得任何奖励。 [zhen de ma ？ ru guo nin zhe yang zuo ， nin jiang bu hui huo de ren he jiang li 。]

english: I'll get on with the fighting.
translation: 我会继续战斗。 [wo hui ji xu zhan dou 。]

english: We did it! Tempoross has been sudbued once again. Well done!
translation: 我们做到了！ Tempoross再次被制服。干得好！ [wo men zuo dao le ！ Tempoross zai ci bei zhi fu 。 gan de hao ！]

english: Take a well deserved rest but don't get too comfy, it'll regain its energy soon enough!
translation: 充分休息，但不要太舒服，它很快就会恢复能量！ [chong fen xiu xi ， dan bu yao tai shu fu ， ta hen kuai jiu hui hui fu neng liang ！]

english: What should I do now?
translation: 我现在该怎么办？ [wo xian zai gai zen me ban ？]

english: We usually find some debris washed up near the docks back at Unkah. Feel free t' have a look. Ya might find somethin' useful!
translation: 我们通常会在温卡码头附近发现一些被冲上岸的碎片。随意看看。你可能会发现一些有用的东西！ [wo men tong chang hui zai wen ka ma tou fu jin fa xian yi xie bei chong shang an de sui pian 。 sui yi kan kan 。 ni ke neng hui fa xian yi xie you yong de dong xi ！]

english: It won't be long before Tempoross regains enough energy to be a problem and we'll have to wrangle it again. Hopefully we can count on you to 'elp!
translation: 过不了多久，Tempoross 就会恢复足够的能量，成为一个问题，我们将不得不再次争论它。希望我们可以依靠您的帮助！ [guo bu liao duo jiu ，Tempoross  jiu hui hui fu zu gou de neng liang ， cheng wei yi ge wen ti ， wo men jiang bu de bu zai ci zheng lun ta 。 xi wang wo men ke yi yi kao nin de bang zhu ！]

english: I'm ready to leave.
translation: 我准备离开了。 [wo zhun bei li kai le 。]

english: Aye aye!
translation: 是啊是啊！ [shi a shi a ！]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Tempoross will surface soon, prepare yourselves!
translation: Temporos即将浮出水面，做好准备！ [Temporos ji jiang fu chu shui mian ， zuo hao zhun bei ！]

english: More fish!
translation: 更多鱼！ [geng duo yu ！]

english: Load those cannons!
translation: 装载那些大炮！ [zhuang zai na xie da pao ！]

english: Keep an eye on the waves!
translation: 密切关注海浪！ [mi qie guan zhu hai lang ！]

english: Tempoross is drawing in water, prepare yourselves!
translation: Tempoross 正在入水，做好准备！ [Tempoross  zheng zai ru shui ， zuo hao zhun bei ！]

english: The totem pole has been damaged!
translation: 图腾柱已损坏！ [tu teng zhu yi sun huai ！]

english: Storm clouds are rolling in, get your buckets ready!
translation: 暴风雨乌云滚滚而来，准备好你的水桶吧！ [bao feng yu wu yun gun gun er lai ， zhun bei hao ni de shui tong ba ！]

english: Tempoross has submerged, fish from the whirlpools!
translation: Tempoross已被淹没，漩涡中的鱼！ [Tempoross yi bei yan mo ， xuan wo zhong de yu ！]

translation: 我准备离开了。 [wo zhun bei li kai le 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Hey, how you doing?
translation: 嘿，你好吗？ [hei ， ni hao ma ？]

english: It is customary when stowing away on a vessel to not introduce yourself to the Captains First Mate, oh foolish one.
translation: 按照惯例，在船上偷渡时，不要向船长大副介绍自己，哦，愚蠢的人。 [an zhao guan li ， zai chuan shang tou du shi ， bu yao xiang chuan zhang da fu jie shao zi ji ， o ， yu chun de ren 。]

english: Hey! I'm not a stowaway!
translation: 嘿！我不是偷渡者！ [hei ！ wo bu shi tou du zhe ！]

english: That Lokar guy invited me aboard...
translation: 那个洛卡人邀请我上船... [na ge luo ka ren yao qing wo shang chuan ...]

english: I see. Well, don't distract me as I'm making preparations for departure.
translation: 我懂了。好吧，别打扰我，我正在准备出发。 [wo dong le 。 hao ba ， bie da rao wo ， wo zheng zai zhun bei chu fa 。]

english: Try not to distract any of the crew either, Zamorak knows it's hard enough to get them to do any work around here without strangers wandering round the ship asking them inane questions.
translation: 也尽量不要分散任何船员的注意力，萨莫拉克知道要让他们在这里做任何工作而没有陌生人在船上闲逛问他们愚蠢的问题已经够困难的了。 [ye jin liang bu yao fen san ren he chuan yuan de zhu yi li ， sa mo la ke zhi dao yao rang ta men zai zhe li zuo ren he gong zuo er mei you mo sheng ren zai chuan shang xian guang wen ta men yu chun de wen ti yi jing gou kun nan de le 。]

english: What does it take to become first mate on a ship?
translation: 成为船上的大副需要什么？ [cheng wei chuan shang de da fu xu yao shen me ？]

english: Good question. We have a diplomatic consessionat the turn of the financial year. Said pirate is chosen should the existing mate be absent without leave.
translation: 好问题。我们在财政年度之际举行外交妥协。如果现有大副未经许可缺席，则选择该海盗。 [hao wen ti 。 wo men zai cai zheng nian du zhi ji ju xing wai jiao tuo xie 。 ru guo xian you da fu wei jing xu ke que xi ， ze xuan ze gai hai dao 。]

english: I had no idea. I always figured it was all about popularity.
translation: 我不知道。我一直以为一切都是为了人气。 [wo bu zhi dao 。 wo yi zhi yi wei yi qie dou shi wei le ren qi 。]

english: It is. I'm just pulling your leg.
translation: 这是。我只是在拉你的腿。 [zhe shi 。 wo zhi shi zai la ni de tui 。]

english: I don't sell to outerlanders.
translation: 我不卖给外地人。 [wo bu mai gei wai di ren 。]

english: Only Fremenniks may purchase fish here.
translation: 只有弗里曼尼克人可以在这里购买鱼。 [zhi you fu li man ni ke ren ke yi zai zhe li gou mai yu 。]

english: Hello there [Fremennik name]. Looking for fresh fish?
translation: 你好[弗雷曼尼克名字]。寻找新鲜的鱼？ [ni hao [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 xun zhao xin xian de yu ？]

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
translation: 嘿！把你的手拿开！ [hei ！ ba ni de shou na kai ！]

english: It is [Fremennik name] the thief!
translation: 这是[弗雷曼尼克名字]小偷！ [zhe shi [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ] xiao tou ！]

english: Guardsguards!
translation: 卫兵！ [wei bing ！]

english: You're the one who stole something from me!
translation: 你就是偷了我东西的人！ [ni jiu shi tou le wo dong xi de ren ！]

english: Could I buy some fish?
translation: 我可以买点鱼吗？ [wo ke yi mai dian yu ma ？]

english: Where do you get your fish from?
translation: 你从哪里得到你的鱼？ [ni cong na li de dao ni de yu ？]

english: Some questions are best left unanswered.
translation: 有些问题最好不要回答。 [you xie wen ti zui hao bu yao hui da 。]

english: Err...
translation: 犯错... [fan cuo ...]

english: So would you like to buy some fish?
translation: 那么你想买点鱼吗？ [na me ni xiang mai dian yu ma ？]

english: I'll pass.
translation: 我会通过。 [wo hui tong guo 。]

english: Suit yourself.
translation: 适合自己。 [shi he zi ji 。]

english: Could I buy some fish?
translation: 我可以买点鱼吗？ [wo ke yi mai dian yu ma ？]

english: Where do you get your fish from?
translation: 你从哪里得到你的鱼？ [ni cong na li de dao ni de yu ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: I'll pass.
translation: 我会通过。 [wo hui tong guo 。]

english: Good fish. Just keep swimming...swimming...swimming...
translation: 好鱼。继续游……游……游…… [hao yu 。 ji xu you …… you …… you ……]

english: The fish swims. It is clearly an obedient fish.
translation: 鱼儿游来游去。分明是一条听话的鱼。 [yu er you lai you qu 。 fen ming shi yi tiao ting hua de yu 。]

english: Jump! Come on fishy, jump!
translation: 跳！来吧，鱼，跳！ [tiao ！ lai ba ， yu ， tiao ！]

english: The fish bumps into the side of the fishbowl. Then it swims some more.
translation: 鱼撞到鱼缸的侧面。然后它又游了一些。 [yu zhuang dao yu gang de ce mian 。 ran hou ta you you le yi xie 。]

english: Good fish...
translation: 好鱼... [hao yu ...]

english: Hello there. How's it going?
translation: 你好呀。怎么样了？ [ni hao ya 。 zen me yang le ？]

english: Hello! Nice day for fishing!
translation: 你好！钓鱼的好日子！ [ni hao ！ diao yu de hao ri zi ！]

english: Well given how good today's catch was, I'd say it's going pretty well!
translation: 考虑到今天的收获有多好，我想说一切进展顺利！ [kao lv dao jin tian de shou huo you duo hao ， wo xiang shuo yi qie jin zhan shun li ！]

english: Nilsal! It's going well, thanks.
translation: 尼尔萨尔！进展顺利，谢谢。 [ni er sa er ！ jin zhan shun li ， xie xie 。]

english: I'm fine, how are you?
translation: 我很好，你怎么样？ [wo hen hao ， ni zen me yang ？]

english: Very well, thank you.
translation: 很好，谢谢。 [hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Not too bad thanks.
translation: 还不错，谢谢。 [hai bu cuo ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: His eyes are staring vacantly into space.
translation: 他的眼睛茫然地凝视着太空。 [ta de yan jing mang ran di ning shi zhe tai kong 。]

english: You are not part of our family...
translation: 你不是我们家庭的一员... [ni bu shi wo men jia ting de yi yuan ...]

english: Umm. Not last time I checked.
translation: 嗯。我上次检查的时候不是这样的。 [n 。 wo shang ci jian cha de shi hou bu shi zhe yang de 。]

english: Soon you will be... Soon you will...
translation: 很快你就会...很快你就会... [hen kuai ni jiu hui ... hen kuai ni jiu hui ...]

english: Lost to us.. She is Lost to us...
translation: 我们失去了她。我们失去了她...... [wo men shi qu le ta 。 wo men shi qu le ta ......]

english: Who is lost?
translation: 谁迷失了？ [shui mi shi le ？]

english: Trapped by the light... Lost and trapped...
translation: 被光困住……迷失并被困…… [bei guang kun zhu …… mi shi bing bei kun ……]

english: Ermm... So you don't want to tell me then?
translation: 呃……那么你不想告诉我吗？ [e …… na me ni bu xiang gao su wo ma ？]

english: Trapped... In stone and darkness...
translation: 被困...在石头和黑暗中... [bei kun ... zai shi tou he hei an zhong ...]

english: Must find family...
translation: 一定要找到家人... [yi ding yao zhao dao jia ren ...]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: Soon we will all be together...
translation: 很快我们就会在一起... [hen kuai wo men jiu hui zai yi qi ...]

english: Are you ok?
translation: 你还好吗？ [ni hai hao ma ？]

english: Must find family... They are all under the blue... Deep deep under the blue...
translation: 必须找到家人......他们都在蓝色之下......深深的蓝色之下...... [bi xu zhao dao jia ren ...... ta men dou zai lan se zhi xia ...... shen shen de lan se zhi xia ......]

english: Ermm... I'll leave you to it then.
translation: 呃……那我就让你自己解决吧。 [e …… na wo jiu rang ni zi ji jie jue ba 。]

english: Free of the deep blue we are...
translation: 我们摆脱了深蓝色…… [wo men bai tuo le shen lan se ……]

english: We must find...
translation: 我们必须找到... [wo men bi xu zhao dao ...]

english: Yes?
translation: 是的？ [shi de ？]

english: a new home...
translation: 一个新家... [yi ge xin jia ...]

english: We must leave this place...
translation: 我们必须离开这个地方... [wo men bi xu li kai zhe ge di fang ...]

english: Where will you go?
translation: 你要去哪里？ [ni yao qu na li ？]

english: Away.. Away to her...
translation: 离去……离她远去…… [li qu …… li ta yuan qu ……]

english: Riiight.
translation: 对了。 [dui le 。]

english: Below the deep, deep blue she waits...
translation: 在深邃的蓝色之下，她等待着…… [zai shen sui de lan se zhi xia ， ta deng dai zhe ……]

english: Who waits?
translation: 谁在等？ [shui zai deng ？]

english: They came to her with fire and faith...
translation: 他们带着火焰和信念来到她身边…… [ta men dai zhao huo yan he xin nian lai dao ta shen bian ……]

english: Who? Who came to who?
translation: WHO？谁来找谁？ [WHO？ shui lai zhao shui ？]

english: Too many... Too many...
translation: 太多了……太多了…… [tai duo le …… tai duo le ……]

english: Too many what? Make sense!
translation: 太多什么？有道理！ [tai duo shen me ？ you dao li ！]

english: Locked away for all eternity...
translation: 永远被锁起来…… [yong yuan bei suo qi lai ……]

english: You'd better start making sense Sonny Jim or I'll...
translation: 你最好开始讲道理，桑尼·吉姆，否则我…… [ni zui hao kai shi jiang dao li ， sang ni · ji mu ， fou ze wo ……]

english: Free... Soon to be free...
translation: 免费……很快就免费了…… [mian fei …… hen kuai jiu mian fei le ……]

english: Must escape the blue.. Deep deep blue
translation: 必须逃离蓝色..深深的蓝色 [bi xu tao li lan se .. shen shen de lan se]

english: Pardon?
translation: 赦免？ [she mian ？]

english: Family... Under the blue... Must escape the blue...
translation: 家人...在蓝色之下...必须逃离蓝色... [jia ren ... zai lan se zhi xia ... bi xu tao li lan se ...]

english: What do you want, outsider?
translation: 外人，你想要什么？ [wai ren ， ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: What are you doing out here?
translation: 你在这儿做什么？ [ni zai zhe er zuo shen me ？]

english: Port Piscarilius have given me permission to catch anglerfish, this is the only place you can find them!
translation: 皮斯卡利留斯港允许我捕捉琵琶鱼，这是你能找到它们的唯一地方！ [pi si ka li liu si gang yun xu wo bu zhuo pi pa yu ， zhe shi ni neng zhao dao ta men de wei yi di fang ！]

english: How can I catch anglerfish?
translation: 怎样才能钓到鮟鱇鱼呢？ [zen yang cai neng diao dao an kang yu ne ？]

english: Only friends of Port Piscarilius are allowed to know such things, I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕只有皮斯卡利留港的朋友才知道这些事情。 [kong pa zhi you pi si ka li liu gang de peng you cai zhi dao zhe xie shi qing 。]

english: I have heard good things about you, outsider, however, you will need to train your fishing skill before catching these.
translation: 我听说过你的好话，外来者，不过，在钓到这些之前，你需要先训练一下你的钓鱼技巧。 [wo ting shuo guo ni de hao hua ， wai lai zhe ， bu guo ， zai diao dao zhe xie zhi qian ， ni xu yao xian xun lian yi xia ni de diao yu ji qiao 。]

english: I have heard good things about you, outsider. You will need a fishing rod and some sandworms to use as bait, if you need supplies, try Tynan's shoreside store.
translation: 我听说过你的好话，外人。你需要一根钓鱼竿和一些沙虫作为诱饵，如果你需要补给，可以试试泰南的岸边商店。 [wo ting shuo guo ni de hao hua ， wai ren 。 ni xu yao yi gen diao yu gan he yi xie sha chong zuo wei you er ， ru guo ni xu yao bu ji ， ke yi shi shi tai nan de an bian shang dian 。]

english: Thanks. I'll let you get back to fishing.
translation: 谢谢。我会让你回去钓鱼的。 [xie xie 。 wo hui rang ni hui qu diao yu de 。]

english: I'll let you get back to it.
translation: 我会让你回到正题。 [wo hui rang ni hui dao zheng ti 。]

english: What are you doing out here?
translation: 你在这儿做什么？ [ni zai zhe er zuo shen me ？]

english: How can I catch anglerfish?
translation: 怎样才能钓到鮟鱇鱼呢？ [zen yang cai neng diao dao an kang yu ne ？]

english: I'll let you get back to it.
translation: 我会让你回到正题。 [wo hui rang ni hui dao zheng ti 。]

english: Don't talk to me outerlander. Anything you have to say to me, you can say to the Chieftain. Goodbye.
translation: 别跟我这个外地人说话。有什么话可以对我说，可以对酋长说。再见。 [bie gen wo zhe ge wai di ren shuo hua 。 you shen me hua ke yi dui wo shuo ， ke yi dui qiu zhang shuo 。 zai jian 。]

english: Are you a member of the Fremmenik council?
translation: 您是 Fremmenik 理事会的成员吗？ [nin shi  Fremmenik  li shi hui de cheng yuan ma ？]

english: Indeed I am, outerlander. Why do you ask?
translation: 我确实是，外地人。你为什么问？ [wo que shi shi ， wai di ren 。 ni wei shen me wen ？]

english: Well, I was told by Brundt that I could be voted into the tribe as an honorary Fremmenik if I could find seven members of the council of elders to vote in my favour.
translation: 嗯，布伦特告诉我，如果我能找到七名长老会成员投票支持我，我就可以被选为部落的荣誉弗雷梅尼克成员。 [n ， bu lun te gao su wo ， ru guo wo neng zhao dao qi ming zhang lao hui cheng yuan tou piao zhi chi wo ， wo jiu ke yi bei xuan wei bu luo de rong yu fu lei mei ni ke cheng yuan 。]

english: Aye, that is indeed true.
translation: 是的，确实如此。 [shi de ， que shi ru ci 。]

english: So can I have your vote?
translation: 那么我可以请你投票吗？ [na me wo ke yi qing ni tou piao ma ？]

english: You can have my vote on the day the skies turn red, the waters turn pink, the rocks turn yellow and the sun turns black.
translation: 你可以在天空变红、海水变粉、岩石变黄、太阳变黑的那一天投票。 [ni ke yi zai tian kong bian hong 、 hai shui bian fen 、 yan shi bian huang 、 tai yang bian hei de na yi tian tou piao 。]

english: Um... do you have any estimate on when that is?
translation: 嗯……你估计那是什么时候吗？ [n …… ni gu ji na shi shen me shi hou ma ？]

english: I'm telling you I will never vote for you, you stupid outlander.
translation: 我告诉你我永远不会投票给你，你这个愚蠢的外地人。 [wo gao su ni wo yong yuan bu hui tou piao gei ni ， ni zhe ge yu chun de wai di ren 。]

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a flower from across the sea, do you?
translation: 我想你不知道我在哪里可以找到来自大洋彼岸的花，是吗？ [wo xiang ni bu zhi dao wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao lai zi da yang bi an de hua ， shi ma ？]

english: I never saw anything like that in my store before.
translation: 我以前从未在我的店里见过这样的东西。 [wo yi qian cong wei zai wo de dian li jian guo zhe yang de dong xi 。]

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find an exotic and extremely rare fish, do you?
translation: 我想你不知道我在哪里可以找到一种奇异且极其稀有的鱼，是吗？ [wo xiang ni bu zhi dao wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao yi zhong qi yi qie ji qi xi you de yu ， shi ma ？]

english: Ah, so even outerlanders have heard of my amazing catch the other day!
translation: 啊，原来连外地人都听说过我前几天的惊人收获了！ [a ， yuan lai lian wai di ren dou ting shuo guo wo qian ji tian de jing ren shou huo le ！]

english: You have it? Can I trade you something for it?
translation: 你有吗？我可以用一些东西换你吗？ [ni you ma ？ wo ke yi yong yi xie dong xi huan ni ma ？]

english: As exotic looking as it is, it is bad eating. I will happily trade it if you can find me the secret map of the best fishing spots that the navigator has hidden away.
translation: 尽管它看起来很异国情调，但吃起来却很糟糕。如果你能给我找到导航仪隐藏的最佳钓鱼地点的秘密地图，我会很乐意交换它。 [jin guan ta kan qi lai hen yi guo qing diao ， dan chi qi lai que hen zao gao 。 ru guo ni neng gei wo zhao dao dao hang yi yin cang de zui jia diao yu di dian de mi mi di tu ， wo hui hen le yi jiao huan ta 。]

english: Is that all?
translation: 这就是全部吗？ [zhe jiu shi quan bu ma ？]

english: Indeed it is, outerlander. The only reason I sit out here in the cold all day long is so I don't have to pay his outrageous prices.
translation: 确实如此，外地人。我整天坐在寒冷的地方的唯一原因是我不必支付他的高得离谱的价格。 [que shi ru ci ， wai di ren 。 wo zheng tian zuo zai han leng de di fang de wei yi yuan yin shi wo bu bi zhi fu ta de gao de li pu de jia ge 。]

english: By getting me his copy of that map, I will finally be self sufficient. I might even make a profit!
translation: 通过给我那张地图的副本，我终于可以自给自足了。我什至可能会获利！ [tong guo gei wo na zhang di tu de fu ben ， wo zhong yu ke yi zi ji zi zu le 。 wo shen zhi ke neng hui huo li ！]

english: I'll see what I can do.
translation: 我会看看我能做什么。 [wo hui kan kan wo neng zuo shen me 。]

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a map of deep sea fishing spots do you?
translation: 我想你不知道在哪里可以找到深海钓鱼点的地图，对吧？ [wo xiang ni bu zhi dao zai na li ke yi zhao dao shen hai diao yu dian de di tu ， dui ba ？]

english: You should pay attention when I speak! I already told you, that rip off navigator has it, and I want it!
translation: 我说话的时候你要注意！我已经告诉过你了，那个盗版导航器有它，我想要它！ [wo shuo hua de shi hou ni yao zhu yi ！ wo yi jing gao su guo ni le ， na ge dao ban dao hang qi you ta ， wo xiang yao ta ！]

english: Here. I got you your map.
translation: 这里。我给你拿了你的地图。 [zhe li 。 wo gei ni na le ni de di tu 。]

english: Great work outerlander! With this, I can finally catch enough fish to make an honest living from it! Here, have the stupid rare fish.
translation: 外地人干得好！有了这个，我终于可以钓到足够的鱼，过上老实的生活了！这里有愚蠢的稀有鱼。 [wai di ren gan de hao ！ you le zhe ge ， wo zhong yu ke yi diao dao zu gou de yu ， guo shang lao shi de sheng huo le ！ zhe li you yu chun de xi you yu 。]

english: I don't see what's so special about this so called rare fish.
translation: 我不明白这种所谓的稀有鱼有什么特别之处。 [wo bu ming bai zhe zhong suo wei de xi you yu you shen me te bie zhi chu 。]

english: Me neither, outerlander. That is why I gave it to you.
translation: 我也一样，外地人。这就是我把它给你的原因。 [wo ye yi yang ， wai di ren 。 zhe jiu shi wo ba ta gei ni de yuan yin 。]

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It has been too long since last we spoke! The fish are really biting today!
translation: 欢迎回来[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]。距离我们上次说话已经过去太久了！今天鱼真的咬钩了！ [huan ying hui lai [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 ju li wo men shang ci shuo hua yi jing guo qu tai jiu le ！ jin tian yu zhen de yao gou le ！]

english: Ask about the Merchant's trial
translation: 询问商家试用情况 [xun wen shang jia shi yong qing kuang]

english: Ask about becoming a Fremennik
translation: 询问成为 Fremennik 的问题 [xun wen cheng wei  Fremennik  de wen ti]

english: Can you teach me the basics of fishing please?
translation: 你能教我钓鱼的基本知识吗？ [ni neng jiao wo diao yu de ji ben zhi shi ma ？]

english: Ah, you've lost your net have you? Have another!
translation: 啊，你的网丢了是吗？再来一个！ [a ， ni de wang diu le shi ma ？ zai lai yi ge ！]

english: I see you already have a net.
translation: 我看你已经有网了。 [wo kan ni yi jing you wang le 。]

english: Ahoy, to fish, you click on the shrimp fishin' spot while ye'r carrying a net.
translation: 嘿，要钓鱼，你拿着网点击虾的钓鱼点。 [hei ， yao diao yu ， ni na zhe wang dian ji xia de diao yu dian 。]

english: I see... is that it?
translation: 我明白了……是这样吗？ [wo ming bai le …… shi zhe yang ma ？]

english: There's far more as you progress - not just shrimps. You get more equipment, bigger fish and other things too...
translation: 随着你的进步，还有更多东西——不仅仅是虾。你还会获得更多的设备、更大的鱼和其他东西...... [sui zhe ni de jin bu ， hai you geng duo dong xi —— bu jin jin shi xia 。 ni hai hui huo de geng duo de she bei 、 geng da de yu he qi ta dong xi ......]

english: When you have a full inventory, you can cook it or take it to the bank. You can find a bank on the roof of the castle in Lumbridge and a cookin' range in the castle kitchen.
translation: 当你的库存充足时，你可以将其煮熟或带到银行。您可以在朗布里奇城堡的屋顶上找到一家银行，并在城堡厨房里找到一个炉灶。 [dang ni de ku cun chong zu shi ， ni ke yi jiang qi zhu shu huo dai dao yin hang 。 nin ke yi zai lang bu li qi cheng bao de wu ding shang zhao dao yi jia yin hang ， bing zai cheng bao chu fang li zhao dao yi ge lu zao 。]

english: Arrr.. if yer lookin' fer quests you should head over to the Mountain Dwarf who lies north-west of Taverley and have a chat with him, I'm sure he can point you in the right direction.
translation: 呃..如果你正在寻找任务，你应该前往位于塔弗利西北部的山矮人并与他交谈，我相信他可以为你指明正确的方向。 [e .. ru guo ni zheng zai xun zhao ren wu ， ni ying gai qian wang wei yu ta fu li xi bei bu de shan ai ren bing yu ta jiao tan ， wo xiang xin ta ke yi wei ni zhi ming zheng que de fang xiang 。]

english: I can show ye on that map of yours if ya like?
translation: 如果你愿意的话，我可以在你的地图上给你看一下？ [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi zai ni de di tu shang gei ni kan yi xia ？]

english: I already know about the basics of fishing, got any tips?
translation: 我已经了解钓鱼的基础知识，有什么建议吗？ [wo yi jing liao jie diao yu de ji chu zhi shi ， you shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: Arrr, chose carefully where and what you fish, you can get different fish in different places throughout the land.
translation: 啊，仔细选择你钓鱼的地点和内容，你可以在整个陆地的不同地方得到不同的鱼。 [a ， zi xi xuan ze ni diao yu de di dian he nei rong ， ni ke yi zai zheng ge lu di de bu tong di fang de dao bu tong de yu 。]

english: Make sure you hang on to your fish, don't throw them away as you can get valuable cooking experience from them, gar! Look out for other things too...
translation: 确保你保留着你的鱼，不要扔掉它们，因为你可以从它们身上获得宝贵的烹饪经验，gar！还要注意其他事情... [que bao ni bao liu zhe ni de yu ， bu yao reng diao ta men ， yin wei ni ke yi cong ta men shen shang huo de bao gui de peng ren jing yan ，gar！ hai yao zhu yi qi ta shi qing ...]

english: Then of course there is always the trawler...
translation: 当然，还有拖网渔船…… [dang ran ， hai you tuo wang yu chuan ……]

english: If you venture to Port Khazard north of Yanille and speaks to me cabin boy Murphy, he can let you and a bunch of friends use his trawler to fish with... Just make sure you take a bailing bucket or two.
translation: 如果你冒险前往雅尼尔以北的卡扎德港，并与我的船舱男孩墨菲交谈，他可以让你和一群朋友使用他的拖网渔船捕鱼……只要确保你带上一两个捞水桶即可。 [ru guo ni mao xian qian wang ya ni er yi bei de ka zha de gang ， bing yu wo de chuan cang nan hai mo fei jiao tan ， ta ke yi rang ni he yi qun peng you shi yong ta de tuo wang yu chuan bu yu …… zhi yao que bao ni dai shang yi liang ge lao shui tong ji ke 。]

english: Any advice for an advanced fisher?
translation: 对高级钓鱼者有什么建议吗？ [dui gao ji diao yu zhe you shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: Aye, as you get better and better you'll find that you can fish for things like Tuna and Swordfish. These be very good for combat.
translation: 是的，随着你变得越来越好，你会发现你可以钓金枪鱼和旗鱼之类的东西。这些对于战斗非常有好处。 [shi de ， sui zhe ni bian de yue lai yue hao ， ni hui fa xian ni ke yi diao jin qiang yu he qi yu zhi lei de dong xi 。 zhe xie dui yu zhan dou fei chang you hao chu 。]

english: Of course, after that you will get Shark, and if you venture out onto the Trawler from Port Khazard, you can then get Manta Ray or Sea Turtle, very good eatin' on one of them.
translation: 当然，在那之后你会得到鲨鱼，如果你从卡扎德港冒险登上拖网渔船，你还可以得到蝠鲼或海龟，吃其中一种非常美味。 [dang ran ， zai na zhi hou ni hui de dao sha yu ， ru guo ni cong ka zha de gang mao xian deng shang tuo wang yu chuan ， ni hai ke yi de dao fu fen huo hai gui ， chi qi zhong yi zhong fei chang mei wei 。]

english: You can also use a fishing potion if you can get your hands on one and just need that little edge.. ask someone who is familiar with herblore.
translation: 如果您能拿到并且只需要一点点边缘，您也可以使用钓鱼药水。询问熟悉 Herblore 的人。 [ru guo nin neng na dao bing qie zhi xu yao yi dian dian bian yuan ， nin ye ke yi shi yong diao yu yao shui 。 xun wen shu xi  Herblore  de ren 。]

english: Now.. quests...
translation: 现在..任务... [xian zai .. ren wu ...]

english: Head over to south of the Legends Guild and East of Ardougne and find Caroline. This will have you investigating some strange happenings on the fishing platform.
translation: 前往传奇公会以南和阿杜涅以东找到卡罗琳。这将让你调查钓鱼平台上发生的一些奇怪的事情。 [qian wang chuan qi gong hui yi nan he a du nie yi dong zhao dao ka luo lin 。 zhe jiang rang ni diao cha diao yu ping tai shang fa sheng de yi xie qi guai de shi qing 。]

english: Head over to Tai Bwo Wannai Village on the Isle of Karamja and speak to Timfraku to solve a strange mystery.
translation: 前往卡拉姆贾岛的 Tai Bwo Wannai 村，与 Timfraku 交谈以解开一个奇怪的谜团。 [qian wang ka la mu jia dao de  Tai Bwo Wannai  cun ， yu  Timfraku  jiao tan yi jie kai yi ge qi guai de mi tuan 。]

english: Can't rightly say's there's any I know of that you could handle at the moment, but come back when you're a bit more experienced and I'm sure I can give you a clue.
translation: 目前还不能正确地说我知道有什么你可以处理的，但是当你更有经验时再回来，我相信我可以给你一个线索。 [mu qian hai bu neng zheng que di shuo wo zhi dao you shen me ni ke yi chu li de ， dan shi dang ni geng you jing yan shi zai hui lai ， wo xiang xin wo ke yi gei ni yi ge xian suo 。]

english: Tell me about different fish.
translation: 告诉我不同​​的鱼。 [gao su wo bu tong ​​ de yu 。]

english: Some rich rewards for big net fishin', make sure you be using a big net fishing spot though...
translation: 大网捕鱼会带来丰厚的奖励，但请确保您使用的是大网捕鱼点...... [da wang bu yu hui dai lai feng hou de jiang li ， dan qing que bao nin shi yong de shi da wang bu yu dian ......]

english: Is that all?
translation: 这就是全部吗？ [zhe jiu shi quan bu ma ？]

english: Ahoy, there's also the fishin' guild if ya skilled enough, you can find it south west of Seers' Village.
translation: 啊嘿，还有钓鱼公会，如果你技术足够的话，你可以在先知村的西南部找到它。 [a hei ， hai you diao yu gong hui ， ru guo ni ji shu zu gou de hua ， ni ke yi zai xian zhi cun de xi nan bu zhao dao ta 。]

english: Where and what should I fish?
translation: 我应该在哪里钓鱼？ [wo ying gai zai na li diao yu ？]

english: A young and enthusiastic fisher. Try south of Draynor Village or the pier on the island of Karamja to fish for Shrimp at level 1 or Sardines at level 5. Aye, me parrot concurs.
translation: 年轻而热情的渔民。尝试在 Draynor 村南部或 Karamja 岛上的码头在 1 级钓虾或在 5 级钓沙丁鱼。是的，我鹦鹉同意。 [nian qing er re qing de yu min 。 chang shi zai  Draynor  cun nan bu huo  Karamja  dao shang de ma tou zai  1  ji diao xia huo zai  5  ji diao sha ding yu 。 shi de ， wo ying wu tong yi 。]

english: What parrot?
translation: 什么鹦鹉？ [shen me ying wu ？]

english: Me parrot Percy on me shoulder thar! Arr!
translation: 我的鹦鹉珀西在我的肩膀上！啊！ [wo de ying wu po xi zai wo de jian bang shang ！ a ！]

english: Oookay...sure, a parrot, on your shoulder.
translation: 哦，好吧……当然，一只鹦鹉就在你的肩膀上。 [o ， hao ba …… dang ran ， yi zhi ying wu jiu zai ni de jian bang shang 。]

english: Arrr!
Herrin' can be fished from south of Draynor Village or the pier on the island of Karamja when you reach level 10.
translation: 当你达到 10 级时，可以从德拉诺村南部或卡拉姆贾岛上的码头钓鱼。 [dang ni da dao  10  ji shi ， ke yi cong de la nuo cun nan bu huo ka la mu jia dao shang de ma tou diao yu 。]

english: You can use your small net to catch Anchovies from south of Draynor when you reach level 15.
translation: 当你达到 15 级时，你可以使用你的小网从德雷诺南部捕捉凤尾鱼。 [dang ni da dao  15  ji shi ， ni ke yi shi yong ni de xiao wang cong de lei nuo nan bu bu zhuo feng wei yu 。]

english: You can practice your fly fishin' in the Lumbridge river to catch Trout at level 20.
translation: 等级达到 20 级时，您可以在朗布里奇河练习飞钓钓鳟鱼。 [deng ji da dao  20  ji shi ， nin ke yi zai lang bu li qi he lian xi fei diao diao zun yu 。]

english: Pike can be fished from Lumbridge river using your fishing rod and some bait with at least level 25 fishing.
translation: 可以使用钓鱼竿和至少 25 级钓鱼的鱼饵从 Lumbridge 河钓鱼。 [ke yi shi yong diao yu gan he zhi shao  25  ji diao yu de yu er cong  Lumbridge  he diao yu 。]

english: Use your harpoon and see if you can catch yourself a few Tuna from the pier on the island of Karamja at level 35.
translation: 使用你的鱼叉，看看是否可以从 35 级卡拉姆贾岛的码头捕获一些金枪鱼。 [shi yong ni de yu cha ， kan kan shi fou ke yi cong  35  ji ka la mu jia dao de ma tou bu huo yi xie jin qiang yu 。]

english: You can use that Lobster pot from the pier on the island of Karamja to get yourself a whole bunch of the little critters once you reach level 40.
translation: 当你达到 40 级时，你可以使用卡拉姆贾岛码头上的龙虾罐来捕获一大堆小动物。 [dang ni da dao  40  ji shi ， ni ke yi shi yong ka la mu jia dao ma tou shang de long xia guan lai bu huo yi da dui xiao dong wu 。]

english: Congratulations, you can now harpoon Swordfish after level 50. Try the pier on the island of Karamja.
translation: 恭喜，您现在可以在 50 级后用鱼叉捕获箭鱼。尝试一下卡拉姆贾岛上的码头。 [gong xi ， nin xian zai ke yi zai  50  ji hou yong yu cha bu huo jian yu 。 chang shi yi xia ka la mu jia dao shang de ma tou 。]

english: Herrin' can be fished from Catherby and some other places when you reach level 10.
translation: 当你达到 10 级时，可以从凯瑟比和其他一些地方钓到鲱鱼。 [dang ni da dao  10  ji shi ， ke yi cong kai se bi he qi ta yi xie di fang diao dao fei yu 。]

english: You can use a big net to catch Mackerel from Catherby when you reach level 16.
translation: 当你达到16级时，你可以使用大网从凯瑟比那里捕捉鲭鱼。 [dang ni da dao 16 ji shi ， ni ke yi shi yong da wang cong kai se bi na li bu zhuo qing yu 。]

english: Cod can be fished from Catherby and some other places once you reach level 23.
translation: 一旦达到 23 级，就可以从凯瑟比和其他一些地方钓到鳕鱼。 [yi dan da dao  23  ji ， jiu ke yi cong kai se bi he qi ta yi xie di fang diao dao xue yu 。]

english: You can use your fishin' rod and some bait to catch Slimy Eel in the swamps at level 28.
translation: 28 级时，您可以使用鱼竿和一些鱼饵在沼泽中捕获粘鳗鱼。 [28  ji shi ， nin ke yi shi yong yu gan he yi xie yu er zai zhao ze zhong bu huo zhan man yu 。]

english: You can use your fishin' rod and some bait to catch Cave Eel in the caves below Lumbridge Swamp at level 38.
translation: 您可以使用鱼竿和一些鱼饵在 38 级朗布里奇沼泽下方的洞穴中捕获洞穴鳗鱼。 [nin ke yi shi yong yu gan he yi xie yu er zai  38  ji lang bu li qi zhao ze xia fang de dong xue zhong bu huo dong xue man yu 。]

english: Bass can be caught at level 46 in your big net if you wander along to Catherby.
translation: 如果您漫步到凯瑟比，您可以在 46 级的大网中捕获鲈鱼。 [ru guo nin man bu dao kai se bi ， nin ke yi zai  46  ji de da wang zhong bu huo lu yu 。]

english: Tuna and Swordfish can be harpooned - if you're good enough - from the thrivin' fishing village of Catherby, or if you can get in try the Fishin' Guild. Level 35 for Tuna and 50 for Swordfish.
translation: 如果你足够优秀，可以从繁荣的凯瑟比渔村用鱼叉捕到金枪鱼和旗鱼，或者如果你可以尝试一下钓鱼公会。金枪鱼等级为 35，剑鱼等级为 50。 [ru guo ni zu gou you xiu ， ke yi cong fan rong de kai se bi yu cun yong yu cha bu dao jin qiang yu he qi yu ， huo zhe ru guo ni ke yi chang shi yi xia diao yu gong hui 。 jin qiang yu deng ji wei  35， jian yu deng ji wei  50。]

english: You can also go talk to Murphy and see if you can use his trawler to catch Manta Ray and Sea Turtle if you're really good... Gar!
translation: 你也可以去和墨菲交谈，看看你是否可以用他的拖网渔船来捕捉蝠鲼和海龟，如果你真的很厉害的话……Gar！ [ni ye ke yi qu he mo fei jiao tan ， kan kan ni shi fou ke yi yong ta de tuo wang yu chuan lai bu zhuo fu fen he hai gui ， ru guo ni zhen de hen li hai de hua ……Gar！]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Can you teach me the basics of fishing please?
translation: 你能教我钓鱼的基本知识吗？ [ni neng jiao wo diao yu de ji ben zhi shi ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: I already know about the basics of fishing, got any tips?
translation: 我已经了解钓鱼的基础知识，有什么建议吗？ [wo yi jing liao jie diao yu de ji chu zhi shi ， you shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: Any advice for an advanced fisher?
translation: 对高级钓鱼者有什么建议吗？ [dui gao ji diao yu zhe you shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: Tell me about different fish.
translation: 告诉我不同​​的鱼。 [gao su wo bu tong ​​ de yu 。]

english: Small Net Fish
translation: 小网鱼 [xiao wang yu]

english: Big Net Fish
translation: 大网鱼 [da wang yu]

english: Rod and Fly Fishing
translation: 竿钓和飞蝇钓鱼 [gan diao he fei ying diao yu]

english: Lobster pot
translation: 龙虾锅 [long xia guo]

english: Harpoon Fish
translation: 鱼叉鱼 [yu cha yu]

english: Tell me about...
translation: 告诉我关于... [gao su wo guan yu ...]

english: Where and what should I fish?
translation: 我应该在哪里钓鱼？ [wo ying gai zai na li diao yu ？]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Greetings, Your Royal Highness. Get your fresh fish here!
translation: 您好，殿下。来这里买新鲜的鱼吧！ [nin hao ， dian xia 。 lai zhe li mai xin xian de yu ba ！]

english: I've heard that the Etceterian fish is stored in a cow shed.
translation: 我听说Etceterian鱼储存在牛棚里。 [wo ting shuo Etceterian yu chu cun zai niu peng li 。]

english: Wow, are you okay? What happendto you?
translation: 哇，你还好吗？你怎么了？ [wa ， ni hai hao ma ？ ni zen me le ？]

english: Ugh... Well met, adventurer. I wouldn't go down there if I were you. That trap is an absolute nightmare! The one who created it must be a sadist. I don't know of anyone who has cleared it.
translation: 呃……很高兴见到你，冒险家。如果我是你，我就不会去那里。那个陷阱绝对是一场噩梦！创造它的人一定是一个虐待狂。我不知道有谁已经清除了它。 [e …… hen gao xing jian dao ni ， mao xian jia 。 ru guo wo shi ni ， wo jiu bu hui qu na li 。 na ge xian jing jue dui shi yi chang e meng ！ chuang zao ta de ren yi ding shi yi ge nve dai kuang 。 wo bu zhi dao you shui yi jing qing chu le ta 。]

english: Oh? I've cleared it.
translation: 哦？我已经清除了。 [o ？ wo yi jing qing chu le 。]

english: Oh? Are you pulling my leg, adventurer?
translation: 哦？你在开我的玩笑吗，冒险家？ [o ？ ni zai kai wo de wan xiao ma ， mao xian jia ？]

english: I'm fairly certain that if I did that, it would fall off!
translation: 我相当肯定，如果我这样做，它就会掉下来！ [wo xiang dang ken ding ， ru guo wo zhe yang zuo ， ta jiu hui diao xia lai ！]

english: No need to add salt in the wound.
translation: 无需在伤口上撒盐。 [wu xu zai shang kou shang sa yan 。]

english: Although I am curious, how did you beat the trap?
translation: 虽然我很好奇，但是你是怎么突破陷阱的呢？ [sui ran wo hen hao qi ， dan shi ni shi zen me tu po xian jing de ne ？]

english: I just made sure to prioritise looking out for the arrows. The fire was fairly easy to get through if I just made sure to take one step at a time.
translation: 我只是确保优先考虑寻找箭头。只要我确保一次迈出一步，火就很容易被扑灭。 [wo zhi shi que bao you xian kao lv xun zhao jian tou 。 zhi yao wo que bao yi ci mai chu yi bu ， huo jiu hen rong yi bei pu mie 。]

english: I see, you're clearly more skillful than I. I'm not sure if I'd be agile enough to do that. Do tell, what was on the next floor?
translation: 我明白了，你显然比我更有技巧。我不确定我是否足够敏捷来做到这一点。请告诉我，下一层是什么？ [wo ming bai le ， ni xian ran bi wo geng you ji qiao 。 wo bu que ding wo shi fou zu gou min jie lai zuo dao zhe yi dian 。 qing gao su wo ， xia yi ceng shi shen me ？]

english: The place looked magnificent, gold lion statues, coffins untouched by anyone else and plenty of Hallowed marks compared to these floors. Although, the traps were significantly harder than the one below.
translation: 这个地方看起来很宏伟，金狮雕像，没有人动过的棺材，和这些楼层相比还有很多神圣的标记。不过，这些陷阱比下面的陷阱要难得多。 [zhe ge di fang kan qi lai hen hong wei ， jin shi diao xiang ， mei you ren dong guo de guan cai ， he zhe xie lou ceng xiang bi hai you hen duo shen sheng de biao ji 。 bu guo ， zhe xie xian jing bi xia mian de xian jing yao nan de duo 。]

english: I see. Well, I guess I'd better brush up on my skills if I want to see it for myself. Nothing worth having in life comes easy right?
translation: 我懂了。好吧，我想如果我想亲眼看看的话，我最好温习一下我的技能。生活中没有什么值得拥有的事情是来得容易的，对吗？ [wo dong le 。 hao ba ， wo xiang ru guo wo xiang qin yan kan kan de hua ， wo zui hao wen xi yi xia wo de ji neng 。 sheng huo zhong mei you shen me zhi de yong you de shi qing shi lai de rong yi de ， dui ma ？]

english: That's very true, I wish you the best of luck!
translation: 确实如此，祝你好运！ [que shi ru ci ， zhu ni hao yun ！]

english: No one has cleared it? How hard can it be?
translation: 没人清理过吗？这有多难？ [mei ren qing li guo ma ？ zhe you duo nan ？]

english: Well, unlike the rest of the traps I've seen so far, you have to deal with both an arrow trap and a fire trap at the same time.
translation: 嗯，与我迄今为止见过的其他陷阱不同，你必须同时处理箭头陷阱和火焰陷阱。 [n ， yu wo qi jin wei zhi jian guo de qi ta xian jing bu tong ， ni bi xu tong shi chu li jian tou xian jing he huo yan xian jing 。]

english: Wow, that does sound hard. Do you have any tips for me?
translation: 哇，这听起来确实很难。你有什么建议给我吗？ [wa ， zhe ting qi lai que shi hen nan 。 ni you shen me jian yi gei wo ma ？]

english: Well, individually they aren't that hard to do. The fires are always swapping between on and off. I think that if you run to where the fire just was you should be safe.
translation: 嗯，单独来说，它们并不难做到。火总是在开与关之间切换。我认为如果你跑到刚刚发生火灾的地方就应该安全。 [n ， dan du lai shuo ， ta men bing bu nan zuo dao 。 huo zong shi zai kai yu guan zhi jian qie huan 。 wo ren wei ru guo ni pao dao gang gang fa sheng huo zai de di fang jiu ying gai an quan 。]

english: The hardest part for me is the arrows. You have to look forward to watch the fire trap whilst also looking over your shoulder to see where the arrows are.
translation: 对我来说最难的部分是箭头。你必须期待着观察火陷阱，同时也要回头看看箭头在哪里。 [dui wo lai shuo zui nan de bu fen shi jian tou 。 ni bi xu qi dai zhe guan cha huo xian jing ， tong shi ye yao hui tou kan kan jian tou zai na li 。]

english: I certainly wish there was a way to see both at once. Perhaps it would help if a fellow adventurer was looking down from above to call out where the arrows are.
translation: 我当然希望有一种方法可以同时看到两者。如果一位冒险家伙伴从上方往下看，指出箭头的位置，也许会有所帮助。 [wo dang ran xi wang you yi zhong fang fa ke yi tong shi kan dao liang zhe 。 ru guo yi wei mao xian jia huo ban cong shang fang wang xia kan ， zhi chu jian tou de wei zhi ， ye xu hui you suo bang zhu 。]

english: Yeah... I'd imagine having an aerial view of the situation would be pretty helpful.
translation: 是的...我想从空中俯瞰情况会很有帮助。 [shi de ... wo xiang cong kong zhong fu kan qing kuang hui hen you bang zhu 。]

english: Of course, but we both know that's impossible for one person! Ouch! Sorry, it hurts to laugh. I wish you luck adventurer!
translation: 当然可以，但我们都知道这对一个人来说是不可能的！哎哟!抱歉，笑起来很痛。祝你冒险家好运！ [dang ran ke yi ， dan wo men dou zhi dao zhe dui yi ge ren lai shuo shi bu ke neng de ！ ai yo ! bao qian ， xiao qi lai hen tong 。 zhu ni mao xian jia hao yun ！]

english: Oh? I've cleared it.
translation: 哦？我已经清除了。 [o ？ wo yi jing qing chu le 。]

english: No one has cleared it? How hard can it be?
translation: 没人清理过吗？这有多难？ [mei ren qing li guo ma ？ zhe you duo nan ？]

english: Hello. I'm the flax keeper. I tend to the flax fields, keeping the yield and continued flax harvest healthy.
translation: 你好。我是亚麻守护者。我照料亚麻田，保持产量和持续健康的亚麻收获。 [ni hao 。 wo shi ya ma shou hu zhe 。 wo zhao liao ya ma tian ， bao chi chan liang he chi xu jian kang de ya ma shou huo 。]

english: Ooh! Great work!
translation: 哦！干得好！ [o ！ gan de hao ！]

english: Thank you. I must get back to work. You never know when a great flax harvest will begin!
translation: 谢谢。我必须回去工作。你永远不知道什么时候亚麻大丰收就会开始！ [xie xie 。 wo bi xu hui qu gong zuo 。 ni yong yuan bu zhi dao shen me shi hou ya ma da feng shou jiu hui kai shi ！]

english: Hello. Do you want to exchange some flax banknotes for bowstrings? I'll exchange [amount] for you today, and you can come back tomorrow for more.
translation: 你好。你想用一些亚麻钞票换弓弦吗？我今天给你换[金额]，你明天再来换更多。 [ni hao 。 ni xiang yong yi xie ya ma chao piao huan gong xian ma ？ wo jin tian gei ni huan [ jin e ]， ni ming tian zai lai huan geng duo 。]

english: I didn't actually bring [amount] flax banknotes with me.
translation: 我实际上并没有带[数量]亚麻钞票。 [wo shi ji shang bing mei you dai [ shu liang ] ya ma chao piao 。]

english: Oh. Well, if you fetch that many flax banknotes, I'll swap them for bowstrings for you.
translation: 哦。好吧，你要是拿来那么多亚麻钞票，我就给你换弓弦。 [o 。 hao ba ， ni yao shi na lai na me duo ya ma chao piao ， wo jiu gei ni huan gong xian 。]

english: Um... Actually, you seem to have so much stuff that you can't hold the bowstrings.
translation: 嗯……其实你的东西好像太多了，拉不住弓弦。 [n …… qi shi ni de dong xi hao xiang tai duo le ， la bu zhu gong xian 。]

english: Hello again. I'm afraid I won't be able to exchange any more flax for bowstrings today. Try me again tomorrow.
translation: 又好。今天恐怕无法再用亚麻换弓弦了。明天再给我试试。 [you hao 。 jin tian kong pa wu fa zai yong ya ma huan gong xian le 。 ming tian zai gei wo shi shi 。]

english: Today I can exchange [amount] flax banknotes for bowstrings, if you bring me enough flax banknotes.
translation: 今天我可以用[数量]张亚麻钞票换弓弦，只要你给我带来足够的亚麻钞票。 [jin tian wo ke yi yong [ shu liang ] zhang ya ma chao piao huan gong xian ， zhi yao ni gei wo dai lai zu gou de ya ma chao piao 。]

english: Sorry, your inventory's too full of stuff.
translation: 抱歉，你的库存太满了。 [bao qian ， ni de ku cun tai man le 。]

english: I have a question for you.
translation: 我有个问题要问你。 [wo you ge wen ti yao wen ni 。]

english: The Flax keeper has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 亚麻守护者给了你一个挑战卷轴！ [ya ma shou hu zhe gei le ni yi ge tiao zhan juan zhou ！]

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。 [qing shu ru wen ti de da an 。]

english: No, try again.
translation: 不，再试一次。 [bu ， zai shi yi ci 。]

english: Correct!
translation: 正确的！ [zheng que de ！]

english: You've obtained a casket!
translation: 你已经获得了一个棺材！ [ni yi jing huo de le yi ge guan cai ！]

english: Agree
translation: 同意 [tong yi]

english: Decline
translation: 衰退 [shuai tui]

english: You want play game of pinball, [player name]?
translation: 你想玩弹球游戏吗，[玩家姓名]？ [ni xiang wan dan qiu you xi ma ，[ wan jia xing ming ]？]

english: Yes, pinball is fun.
translation: 是的，弹球很有趣。 [shi de ， dan qiu hen you qu 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Going away now.
translation: 现在要走了。 [xian zai yao zou le 。]

english: Nope, you wrong person.
translation: 不，你认错人了。 [bu ， ni ren cuo ren le 。]

english: Err...what am I supposed to do here again?
translation: 呃……我该怎么办？ [e …… wo gai zen me ban ？]

english: You gotta poke dem pillars.
translation: 你必须戳那些柱子。 [ni bi xu chuo na xie zhu zi 。]

english: What? All of them?
translation: 什么？他们全部？ [shen me ？ ta men quan bu ？]

english: No, no. If you poke dem ones dat don't have a dem flashin' rings, den dats bad.
translation: 不，不。如果你戳那些没有闪光戒指的人，那可就糟糕了。 [bu ， bu 。 ru guo ni chuo na xie mei you shan guang jie zhi de ren ， na ke jiu zao gao le 。]

english: So I have to poke the pillars that are flashing?
translation: 所以我必须去戳那些闪烁的柱子？ [suo yi wo bi xu qu chuo na xie shan shuo de zhu zi ？]

english: Yer. You do dat ten times, you get prize.
translation: 是啊。你这样做十次，你就会得到奖品。 [shi a 。 ni zhe yang zuo shi ci ， ni jiu hui de dao jiang pin 。]

english: So...I'm free to go now, right?
translation: 那么……我现在可以走了，对吗？ [na me …… wo xian zai ke yi zou le ， dui ma ？]

english: Yer, get going. We get break now.
translation: 耶，走吧。我们现在休息一下。 [ye ， zou ba 。 wo men xian zai xiu xi yi xia 。]

english: Ok. Err...have a nice break.
translation: 好的。呃……祝你休息愉快。 [hao de 。 e …… zhu ni xiu xi yu kuai 。]

english: Come play game, [player name]!
translation: 来玩游戏吧，[玩家姓名]！ [lai wan you xi ba ，[ wan jia xing ming ]！]

english: We got good game, [player name]!
translation: 我们打出了精彩的比赛，[玩家姓名]！ [wo men da chu le jing cai de bi sai ，[ wan jia xing ming ]！]

english: You want play game, [player name]!
translation: 你想玩游戏，[玩家姓名]！ [ni xiang wan you xi ，[ wan jia xing ming ]！]

english: You like hitting things, [player name]?
translation: 你喜欢打东西吗，[玩家姓名]？ [ni xi huan da dong xi ma ，[ wan jia xing ming ]？]

english: Maybe later.
translation: 也许以后吧。 [ye xu yi hou ba 。]

english: Yes, pinball is fun.
translation: 是的，弹球很有趣。 [shi de ， dan qiu hen you qu 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: You pet the dog...
translation: 你抚摸狗... [ni fu mo gou ...]

english: Woof woof!
translation: 汪汪！ [wang wang ！]

english: You give the dog a nice piece of meat. It gobbles it up.

translation: 好遇见！我叫弗罗林，我做一点这个，做一点那个。努力活下去吧，除此之外我们无能为力。 [hao yu jian ！ wo jiao fu luo lin ， wo zuo yi dian zhe ge ， zuo yi dian na ge 。 nu li huo xia qu ba ， chu ci zhi wai wo men wu neng wei li 。]

english: It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
translation: 非常完美，非常感谢您的努力。 [fei chang wan mei ， fei chang gan xie nin de nu li 。]

english: What's happening around here?

english: Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: 哦，其实也没什么，我们都还在躲避吸血鬼，在这个可怕的地方勉强维持生计，希望很快我们就能足够强大，踏上前往圣殿的旅程。 [o ， qi shi ye mei shen me ， wo men dou hai zai duo bi xi xue gui ， zai zhe ge ke pa de di fang mian qiang wei chi sheng ji ， xi wang hen kuai wo men jiu neng zu gou qiang da ， ta shang qian wang sheng dian de lv cheng 。]

translation: 据我所知，我们现在有一些非常有用的基本设施，我们都非常感谢您。我以前从未真正见过或认识英雄，所以我没有什么可以与之比较的，但我怀疑 [ju wo suo zhi ， wo men xian zai you yi xie fei chang you yong de ji ben she shi ， wo men dou fei chang gan xie nin 。 wo yi qian cong wei zhen zheng jian guo huo ren shi ying xiong ， suo yi wo mei you shen me ke yi yu zhi bi jiao de ， dan wo huai yi]

translation: 噢，又好。想吃点鱼吗？ [o ， you hao 。 xiang chi dian yu ma ？]

translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

translation: 再会。你在干什么？ [zai hui 。 ni zai gan shen me ？]

translation: 我是卖花的，三朵15金币。你想要一些吗？ [wo shi mai hua de ， san duo 15 jin bi 。 ni xiang yao yi xie ma ？]

translation: 美好的一天，殿下。 [mei hao de yi tian ， dian xia 。]

english: I'm selling flowers, 15gp for three. Would you like some, Your Highness?
translation: 我是卖花的，三朵15金币。殿下，您想要一些吗？ [wo shi mai hua de ， san duo 15 jin bi 。 dian xia ， nin xiang yao yi xie ma ？]

translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Bees are very active on this bush and there are pollen-rich flowers. You carefully collect some Strange pollen.
translation: 蜜蜂在这片灌木丛中非常活跃，并且有富含花粉的花朵。你小心翼翼地收集了一些奇怪的花粉。 [mi feng zai zhe pian guan mu cong zhong fei chang huo yue ， bing qie you fu han hua fen de hua duo 。 ni xiao xin yi yi di shou ji le yi xie qi guai de hua fen 。]

english: You've been awarded [1 or 2] anima-infused bark.
translation: 您已获得 [1 或 2] 注入灵能的树皮。 [nin yi huo de  [1  huo  2]  zhu ru ling neng de shu pi 。]

english: Bees are very active on this bush and there are unpollinated flowers. You carefully apply it with the help of some nearby bees then extract some from the bush.
translation: 蜜蜂在这片灌木丛中非常活跃，并且有未授粉的花朵。您在附近一些蜜蜂的帮助下小心地涂抹它，然后从灌木丛中提取一些。 [mi feng zai zhe pian guan mu cong zhong fei chang huo yue ， bing qie you wei shou fen de hua duo 。 nin zai fu jin yi xie mi feng de bang zhu xia xiao xin di tu mo ta ， ran hou cong guan mu cong zhong ti qu yi xie 。]

translation: 您已获得[1或2]注入阿尼玛的树皮。 [nin yi huo de [1 huo 2] zhu ru a ni ma de shu pi 。]

english: There are no open, unpollinated flowers on this bush yet.
translation: 这丛灌木上还没有开放、未授粉的花朵。 [zhe cong guan mu shang hai mei you kai fang 、 wei shou fen de hua duo 。]

english: You took the pollen from this bush and should apply it to a bush with unpollinated flowers.
translation: 您从该灌木丛中获取了花粉，并将其应用到未授粉花朵的灌木丛上。 [nin cong gai guan mu cong zhong huo qu le hua fen ， bing jiang qi ying yong dao wei shou fen hua duo de guan mu cong shang 。]

translation: 灌木丛开始结出果实，干得好！ [guan mu cong kai shi jie chu guo shi ， gan de hao ！]

english: The bushes become dormant and the bees move on. You've helped make the forest a more diverse and beautiful place!
translation: 灌木丛进入休眠状态，蜜蜂继续前进。您帮助森林变得更加多样化和美丽！ [guan mu cong jin ru xiu mian zhuang tai ， mi feng ji xu qian jin 。 nin bang zhu sen lin bian de geng jia duo yang hua he mei li ！]
