english: You discard your left over pollen.
translation: 您丢弃剩余的花粉。 [nin diu qi sheng yu de hua fen 。]

english: Hello. Do you want to buy or sell any maces?
translation: 你好。您想购买或出售狼牙棒吗？ [ni hao 。 nin xiang gou mai huo chu shou lang ya bang ma ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Well, I'll have a look, at least.
translation: 好吧，至少我会看一下。 [hao ba ， zhi shao wo hui kan yi xia 。]

english: We seed the hidden truths of this world! Ranul rewards all of us who are willing to find them!
translation: 我们播种这个世界隐藏的真相！ Ranul 奖励我们所有愿意找到它们的人！ [wo men bo zhong zhe ge shi jie yin cang de zhen xiang ！ Ranul  jiang li wo men suo you yuan yi zhao dao ta men de ren ！]

english: Ralos and Ranul are the twin guardians of our fate! Trust in them, for they will lead us to our destinies!
translation: 拉洛斯和拉努尔是我们命运的双胞胎守护者！相信他们，因为他们将带领我们走向我们的命运！ [la luo si he la nu er shi wo men ming yun de shuang bao tai shou hu zhe ！ xiang xin ta men ， yin wei ta men jiang dai ling wo men zou xiang wo men de ming yun ！]

english: Do not fear the dark of night! Embrace it, for it is a gift from Ranul!
translation: 不要害怕黑夜！拥抱它，因为它是拉努尔的礼物！ [bu yao hai pa hei ye ！ yong bao ta ， yin wei ta shi la nu er de li wu ！]

english: In times of sorrow, we look to Ralos and Ranul. They guide us through day and night.
translation: 在悲伤的时候，我们会向拉洛斯和拉努尔求助。他们日夜引导我们。 [zai bei shang de shi hou ， wo men hui xiang la luo si he la nu er qiu zhu 。 ta men ri ye yin dao wo men 。]

english: Be bold in the day, but reflect in the night! Let the teachings of both Ralos and Ranul guide you equally!
translation: 白天要大胆，晚上要反思！让拉洛斯和拉努尔的教诲同等地指导你！ [bai tian yao da dan ， wan shang yao fan si ！ rang la luo si he la nu er de jiao hui tong deng di zhi dao ni ！]

english: Ralos teaches us to be brave! To be bold! Let his warmth in, and it will burn away all doubts!
translation: 拉洛斯教导我们要勇敢！要大胆！让他的温暖进来，一切疑虑都会烟消云散！ [la luo si jiao dao wo men yao yong gan ！ yao da dan ！ rang ta de wen nuan jin lai ， yi qie yi lv du hui yan xiao yun san ！]

english: Ralos shines upon us who are brave! If we show the courage to act, he will reward us!
translation: 拉洛斯照耀着我们勇敢的人！如果我们表现出勇气去行动，他就会奖励我们！ [la luo si zhao yao zhe wo men yong gan de ren ！ ru guo wo men biao xian chu yong qi qu xing dong ， ta jiu hui jiang li wo men ！]

english: Hey! You can't come through here! This is private land!
translation: 嘿！你不能从这里过来！这是私人土地！ [hei ！ ni bu neng cong zhe li guo lai ！ zhe shi si ren tu di ！]

english: You will need to find another way in.
translation: 您将需要找到另一条路。 [nin jiang xu yao zhao dao ling yi tiao lu 。]

english: Nice weather we're having today.
translation: 我们今天天气真好。 [wo men jin tian tian qi zhen hao 。]

english: It's so peaceful here, don't you agree?
translation: 这里很平静，你不同意吗？ [zhe li hen ping jing ， ni bu tong yi ma ？]

english: There's plenty of trees around, couldn't you go to another spot?
translation: 周围有很多树，你不能去别的地方吗？ [zhou wei you hen duo shu ， ni bu neng qu bie de di fang ma ？]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Hello friend. I wish to slay evil and avail them of their loot! Take me to Burgh de Rott!
translation: 朋友你好。我希望消灭邪恶并利用他们的战利品！带我去德罗特堡！ [peng you ni hao 。 wo xi wang xiao mie xie e bing li yong ta men de zhan li pin ！ dai wo qu de luo te bao ！]

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: 你准备好与那里的邪恶作斗争了吗？ [ni zhun bei hao yu na li de xie e zuo dou zheng le ma ？]

english: I think so? At least my heart knows courage and that should be sufficient for the meantime. I expect that when we get to Burgh de Rott, we'll be able to purchase suitable provisions.
translation: 我想是这样吗？至少我的心知道勇气，这应该足够了。我预计当我们到达罗特堡时，我们就能购买到合适的食物。 [wo xiang shi zhe yang ma ？ zhi shao wo de xin zhi dao yong qi ， zhe ying gai zu gou le 。 wo yu ji dang wo men dao da luo te bao shi ， wo men jiu neng gou mai dao he shi de shi wu 。]

english: But you do realise that the vampyres in Morytania are immune to everything except silver?
translation: 但你确实意识到莫里塔尼亚的吸血鬼对除了银以外的一切都免疫吗？ [dan ni que shi yi shi dao mo li ta ni ya de xi xue gui dui chu le yin yi wai de yi qie dou mian yi ma ？]

english: Er...well, I've not heard mention of that fact, but I have faith that Saradomin will provide the means to furnish me with suitable weapons when I reach Burgh de Rott.
translation: 呃……好吧，我没有听说过这个事实，但我相信萨拉多明会在我到达罗特堡时为我提供合适的武器。 [e …… hao ba ， wo mei you ting shuo guo zhe ge shi shi ， dan wo xiang xin sa la duo ming hui zai wo dao da luo te bao shi wei wo ti gong he shi de wu qi 。]

english: And if we happen to run into some vampyres on the journey down there?
translation: 如果我们在那儿的旅途中碰巧遇到吸血鬼怎么办？ [ru guo wo men zai na er de lv tu zhong peng qiao yu dao xi xue gui zen me ban ？]

english: I trust that you will help us to avoid them. You are a guide after all, aren't you? Anyway, you look like you can handle yourself. I presume you've fought such creatures before and won? How hard can it be?
translation: 我相信你会帮助我们避免它们。毕竟你是一个向导，不是吗？无论如何，你看上去能应付自如。我想你以前曾与这些生物战斗过并获胜吧？这有多难？ [wo xiang xin ni hui bang zhu wo men bi mian ta men 。 bi jing ni shi yi ge xiang dao ， bu shi ma ？ wu lun ru he ， ni kan shang qu neng ying fu zi ru 。 wo xiang ni yi qian ceng yu zhe xie sheng wu zhan dou guo bing huo sheng ba ？ zhe you duo nan ？]

english: It can be pretty difficult, actually. But you're right, I'll be your guide so I should be able to handle the situation.
translation: 实际上，这可能相当困难。但你是对的，我会成为你的向导，所以我应该能够处理这种情况。 [shi ji shang ， zhe ke neng xiang dang kun nan 。 dan ni shi dui de ， wo hui cheng wei ni de xiang dao ， suo yi wo ying gai neng gou chu li zhe zhong qing kuang 。]

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 你为什么想去 Burgh de Rott？ [ni wei shen me xiang qu  Burgh de Rott？]

english: I'm going down there to teach those vampyres a lesson or two. I've heard about the terrible conditions down there and I intend to put a stop to it.
translation: 我要去那里给那些吸血鬼一两个教训。我听说那里的情况很糟糕，我打算阻止它。 [wo yao qu na li gei na xie xi xue gui yi liang ge jiao xun 。 wo ting shuo na li de qing kuang hen zao gao ， wo da suan zu zhi ta 。]

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 如果我们在去罗特城堡的路上遇到敌人，你能保护自己吗？ [ru guo wo men zai qu luo te cheng bao de lu shang yu dao di ren ， ni neng bao hu zi ji ma ？]

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of enemies. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: 这么说吧，我有点经验，而且我很乐意对抗我的敌人。你不需要担心这个。 [zhe me shuo ba ， wo you dian jing yan ， er qie wo hen le yi dui kang wo de di ren 。 ni bu xu yao dan xin zhe ge 。]

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 我可以带你去伯格德罗特。 [wo ke yi dai ni qu bo ge de luo te 。]

english: Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: 嗯嗯，看来你有追随者了。我想如果让它独自徘徊的话，它可能会在这段旅程中迷路。等你的追随者安全了我们就离开吧。 [n n ， kan lai ni you zhui sui zhe le 。 wo xiang ru guo rang ta du zi pai huai de hua ， ta ke neng hui zai zhe duan lv cheng zhong mi lu 。 deng ni de zhui sui zhe an quan le wo men jiu li kai ba 。]

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: 哦真的吗？那太好了！到达目的地后我会给你一个小奖励。 [o zhen de ma ？ na tai hao le ！ dao da mu di di hou wo hui gei ni yi ge xiao jiang li 。]

english: Burgh de Rott Ramble begins
translation: Burgh de Rott 漫步开始 [Burgh de Rott  man bu kai shi]

english: Ok, which route should we take?
translation: 好的，我们应该走哪条路？ [hao de ， wo men ying gai zou na tiao lu ？]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: 啊，所以你想给我一些物资，嗯？让我打开背包。 [a ， suo yi ni xiang gei wo yi xie wu zi ， n ？ rang wo da kai bei bao 。]

english: This place is a bit grim. How can people live here?
translation: 这个地方有点严峻。人们怎么能住在这里？ [zhe ge di fang you dian yan jun 。 ren men zen me neng zhu zai zhe li ？]

english: Do you visit Burgh de Rott often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: 您经常访问 Burgh de Rott 吗？看来你很熟悉这条路。 [nin jing chang fang wen  Burgh de Rott  ma ？ kan lai ni hen shu xi zhe tiao lu 。]

english: When are we going to get to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 我们什么时候去 Burgh de Rott？ [wo men shen me shi hou qu  Burgh de Rott？]

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on. I have loot to get.
translation: 我们没有一整天的时间站着聊天；让我们继续努力吧。我有战利品要拿。 [wo men mei you yi zheng tian de shi jian zhan zhe liao tian ； rang wo men ji xu nu li ba 。 wo you zhan li pin yao na 。]

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than the opulet life styles forced on us adventurer types. I'd much rather be up to my eyes in mud and having a good fight!
translation: 哦，我讨厌这次旅行，但它比强加给我们冒险家类型的奥普莱特生活方式要好。我宁愿在泥里睁大眼睛，痛痛快快地打一场！ [o ， wo tao yan zhe ci lv xing ， dan ta bi qiang jia gei wo men mao xian jia lei xing de ao pu lai te sheng huo fang shi yao hao 。 wo ning yuan zai ni li zheng da yan jing ， tong tong kuai kuai di da yi chang ！]

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...
translation: 你没看到我正在被攻击吗... [ni mei kan dao wo zheng zai bei gong ji ma ...]

translation: 好吧，现在还没人见过那个东西。这就是为什么我们称其为“The Thing”，因为我们不知道它是什么。 [hao ba ， xian zai hai mei ren jian guo na ge dong xi 。 zhe jiu shi wei shen me wo men cheng qi wei “The Thing”， yin wei wo men bu zhi dao ta shi shen me 。]

translation: 有人说它是一个黑心的变形者，渴望得到像我这样努力工作的正派人民的灵魂。也有人说它只是一只羊。 [you ren shuo ta shi yi ge hei xin de bian xing zhe ， ke wang de dao xiang wo zhe yang nu li gong zuo de zheng pai ren min de ling hun 。 ye you ren shuo ta zhi shi yi zhi yang 。]

translation: 我又该如何剪羊毛？ [wo you gai ru he jian yang mao ？]

english: Well, you're half way there already! You have a set of shears in your inventory. Just use those on a Sheep to shear it.
translation: 好吧，你已经成功了一半！您的库存中有一套剪刀。只需在羊身上使用它们即可剪羊毛。 [hao ba ， ni yi jing cheng gong le yi ban ！ nin de ku cun zhong you yi tao jian dao 。 zhi xu zai yang shen shang shi yong ta men ji ke jian yang mao 。]

english: That's all I have to do?
translation: 这就是我所要做的一切吗？ [zhe jiu shi wo suo yao zuo de yi qie ma ？]

english: Well once you've collected some wool you'll need to spin it into balls.
translation: 好吧，一旦你收集了一些羊毛，你就需要将其纺成球。 [hao ba ， yi dan ni shou ji le yi xie yang mao ， ni jiu xu yao jiang qi fang cheng qiu 。]

english: Yes, I know how to spin wool.
translation: 是的，我知道如何纺羊毛。 [shi de ， wo zhi dao ru he fang yang mao 。]

english: Great!
translation: 伟大的！ [wei da de ！]

english: Remind me how to spin wool.
translation: 提醒我如何纺羊毛。 [ti xing wo ru he fang yang mao 。]

english: Yeah, I think so.
translation: 是的，我想是的。 [shi de ， wo xiang shi de 。]

english: You can get to it, then!
translation: 那么你就可以做到了！ [na me ni jiu ke yi zuo dao le ！]

english: I've got some wool. I've not managed to make it into a ball though.
translation: 我有一些羊毛。但我还没能把它变成一个球。 [wo you yi xie yang mao 。 dan wo hai mei neng ba ta bian cheng yi ge qiu 。]

english: Well go find a spinning wheel then. You can find one on the first floor of Lumbridge Castle, just walk east on the road outside my house and you'll find Lumbridge.
translation: 那好吧，去找一个纺车吧。你可以在朗布里奇城堡的一楼找到一个，沿着我家外面的马路向东走，你就会找到朗布里奇。 [na hao ba ， qu zhao yi ge fang che ba 。 ni ke yi zai lang bu li qi cheng bao de yi lou zhao dao yi ge ， yan zhe wo jia wai mian de ma lu xiang dong zou ， ni jiu hui zhao dao lang bu li qi 。]

english: I have some.
translation: 我有一些。 [wo you yi xie 。]

english: Give 'em here then.
translation: 那就把它们交给这里吧。 [na jiu ba ta men jiao gei zhe li ba 。]

english: That's all I've got so far.
translation: 这就是我到目前为止所得到的一切。 [zhe jiu shi wo dao mu qian wei zhi suo de dao de yi qie 。]

english: I need [1..19] more before I can pay you.
translation: 我还需要 [1..19] 才能付钱给你。 [wo hai xu yao  [1..19]  cai neng fu qian gei ni 。]

english: Ok I'll work on it.
translation: 好的，我会努力的。 [hao de ， wo hui nu li de 。]

english: I need [#] more before I can pay you.
translation: 我还需要 [#] 份才能付钱给你。 [wo hai xu yao  [#]  fen cai neng fu qian gei ni 。]

english: That's the last of them.
translation: 这是他们中的最后一个。 [zhe shi ta men zhong de zui hou yi ge 。]

english: I guess I'd better pay you then.
translation: 我想我最好付钱给你。 [wo xiang wo zui hao fu qian gei ni 。]

english: Quest complete!
translation: 任务完成！ [ren wu wan cheng ！]

english: I'm looking for something to kill.
translation: 我正在寻找可以杀死的东西。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao ke yi sha si de dong xi 。]

english: I'm lost.
translation: 我迷路了。 [wo mi lu le 。]

english: Fred! Fred! I've seen The Thing!
translation: 弗雷德！弗雷德！我见过那东西！ [fu lei de ！ fu lei de ！ wo jian guo na dong xi ！]

english: I'm looking for a quest.
translation: 我正在寻找一个任务。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yi ge ren wu 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: How do I shear sheep, again?
translation: 我又该如何剪羊毛？ [wo you gai ru he jian yang mao ？]

english: Yes, I know how to spin wool.
translation: 是的，我知道如何纺羊毛。 [shi de ， wo zhi dao ru he fang yang mao 。]

english: I don't know how to spin wool, sorry.
translation: 我不知道如何纺羊毛，抱歉。 [wo bu zhi dao ru he fang yang mao ， bao qian 。]

english: Remind me how to spin wool.
translation: 提醒我如何纺羊毛。 [ti xing wo ru he fang yang mao 。]

english: Yeah, I think so.
translation: 是的，我想是的。 [shi de ， wo xiang shi de 。]

english: I need to talk to you about shearing these sheep!
translation: 我需要和你谈谈剪羊毛的事！ [wo xu yao he ni tan tan jian yang mao de shi ！]

english: I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: 我不能和你这个外地人说话！与酋长布伦特交谈！ [wo bu neng he ni zhe ge wai di ren shuo hua ！ yu qiu zhang bu lun te jiao tan ！]

english: You stay away from me outerlander!
translation: 你这个外地人离我远点！ [ni zhe ge wai di ren li wo yuan dian ！]

english: They are too suspicious of you for you to get close enough to steal from them.
translation: 他们对你太怀疑了，你无法靠近他们去偷东西。 [ta men dui ni tai huai yi le ， ni wu fa kao jin ta men qu tou dong xi 。]

english: Hello, are you a member of the council?
translation: 你好，请问你是理事会成员吗？ [ni hao ， qing wen ni shi li shi hui cheng yuan ma ？]

english: I am afraid not outerlander. Goodbye.
translation: 恐怕不是外地人。再见。 [kong pa bu shi wai di ren 。 zai jian 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: 再次你好[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]。今天你需要我做什么？您永远可以信赖我的帮助！ [zai ci ni hao [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 jin tian ni xu yao wo zuo shen me ？ nin yong yuan ke yi xin lai wo de bang zhu ！]

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。我只是想聊聊。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。 wo zhi shi xiang liao liao 。]

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: 如果您需要我的帮助[弗雷曼尼克名字]，我的门永远敞开。 [ru guo nin xu yao wo de bang zhu [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]， wo de men yong yuan chang kai 。]

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: [弗雷曼尼克名字]...我们已经很久没有见面了！ [[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]... wo men yi jing hen jiu mei you jian mian le ！]

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: 欢迎回来[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]。很高兴在这里见到您！ [huan ying hui lai [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 hen gao xing zai zhe li jian dao nin ！]

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: 我很抱歉[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]！我没时间陪你在这里！ [wo hen bao qian [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！ wo mei shi jian pei ni zai zhe li ！]

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
translation: 没关系，我其实什么都不想要。 [mei guan xi ， wo qi shi shen me dou bu xiang yao 。]

english: How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: 你[弗雷曼尼克名字]怎么样？我希望您这一天一切顺利！ [ni [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ] zen me yang ？ wo xi wang nin zhe yi tian yi qie shun li ！]

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
translation: 我很好，谢谢，你好吗？ [wo hen hao ， xie xie ， ni hao ma ？]

english: All is well with me also!
translation: 我也一切都好！ [wo ye yi qie dou hao ！]

english: Hello to you, too!
translation: 也向你问好！ [ye xiang ni wen hao ！]

english: Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你好。你想要什么东西[弗雷曼尼克名字]吗？ [ni hao 。 ni xiang yao shen me dong xi [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ] ma ？]

english: No, not really.
translation: 不，不是真的。 [bu ， bu shi zhen de 。]

english: Well... okay then!
translation: 嗯……那好吧！ [n …… na hao ba ！]

english: Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
translation: 很高兴见到你[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]。 [hen gao xing jian dao ni [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。]

english: You shame us, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你让我们感到羞耻，[弗雷曼尼克名字]！ [ni rang wo men gan dao xiu chi ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！]

english: How can you steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你怎么能偷我的东西，[弗雷曼尼克名字]？ [ni zen me neng tou wo de dong xi ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]？]

english: You have betrayed your heritage, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你背叛了你的传统，[弗雷曼尼克名字]！ [ni bei pan le ni de chuan tong ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！]

english: Why would you try to steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你为什么要偷我的东西，[弗雷曼尼克名字]？ [ni wei shen me yao tou wo de dong xi ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]？]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Well met, adventurer.
translation: 很高兴认识你，冒险家。 [hen gao xing ren shi ni ， mao xian jia 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm Freja, the Kyattess of the Fremennik Province. Who are you?
translation: 我是弗雷娅，弗雷曼尼克省的凯亚特斯。你是谁？ [wo shi fu lei ya ， fu lei man ni ke sheng de kai ya te si 。 ni shi shui ？]

english: Oh me? I'm [player name], an adventurer... I guess.
translation: 哦我？我是[玩家名字]，一个冒险家……我猜。 [o wo ？ wo shi [ wan jia ming zi ]， yi ge mao xian jia …… wo cai 。]

english: You must have done something impressive to gain entry here.
translation: 你一定做了一些令人印象深刻的事情才能进入这里。 [ni yi ding zuo le yi xie ling ren yin xiang shen ke de shi qing cai neng jin ru zhe li 。]

english: I may have killed some dragons.
translation: 我可能杀了一些龙。 [wo ke neng sha le yi xie long 。]

english: Ah, fantastic! I've yet to face one myself, but I look forward to the challenge.
translation: 啊，太棒了！我自己还没有面对过这样的挑战，但我期待着这一挑战。 [a ， tai bang le ！ wo zi ji hai mei you mian dui guo zhe yang de tiao zhan ， dan wo qi dai zhe zhe yi tiao zhan 。]

english: What grand feats are you known for?
translation: 您因哪些伟大事迹而闻名？ [nin yin na xie wei da shi ji er wen ming ？]

english: Much like you, I have a book or two detailing such things, but it seems to have gone walkabouts.
translation: 就像你一样，我有一两本书详细介绍了这些事情，但它似乎已经消失了。 [jiu xiang ni yi yang ， wo you yi liang ben shu xiang xi jie shao le zhe xie shi qing ， dan ta si hu yi jing xiao shi le 。]

english: Anything particularly interesting?
translation: 有什么特别有趣的事情吗？ [you shen me te bie you qu de shi qing ma ？]

english: All of it is incredibly interesting! I slew the great Smolodin Kyatt that plagued the province for many years!
translation: 所有这一切都非常有趣！我杀了困扰该省多年的伟大的斯莫洛丁·凯亚特！ [suo you zhe yi qie dou fei chang you qu ！ wo sha le kun rao gai sheng duo nian de wei da de si mo luo ding · kai ya te ！]

english: I retrieved the crown of many heads from the bottomless snake pit! I hunted the silver stag of the western provinces!
translation: 我从无底蛇坑中取出了多头王冠！我猎杀了西部行省的银鹿！ [wo cong wu di she keng zhong qu chu le duo tou wang guan ！ wo lie sha le xi bu xing sheng de yin lu ！]

english: None of that sounds at all boring. I look forward to finding your book.
translation: 这些听起来一点也不无聊。我期待着找到你的书。 [zhe xie ting qi lai yi dian ye bu wu liao 。 wo qi dai zhe zhao dao ni de shu 。]

english: Funny you should mention boars. I'm currently hunting one... well, I was...
translation: 有趣的是你应该提到野猪。我目前正在寻找一个……好吧，我当时…… [you qu de shi ni ying gai ti dao ye zhu 。 wo mu qian zheng zai xun zhao yi ge …… hao ba ， wo dang shi ……]

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？ [ni wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: My current quest took me to Acheron, a horribly bitter northern territory, in search for this famous boar. As big as a hut, so the songs say.
translation: 我当前的任务将我带到了阿刻戎，一个极其痛苦的北方领土，寻找这只著名的野猪。歌里这么说，像小屋一样大。 [wo dang qian de ren wu jiang wo dai dao le a ke rong ， yi ge ji qi tong ku de bei fang ling tu ， xun zhao zhe zhi zhu ming de ye zhu 。 ge li zhe me shuo ， xiang xiao wu yi yang da 。]

english: Anyway, my companions all met a rather grizzly end, so I guess I'm looking for new ones.
translation: 无论如何，我的同伴们都遭遇了相当悲惨的结局，所以我想我正在寻找新的。 [wu lun ru he ， wo de tong ban men dou zao yu le xiang dang bei can de jie ju ， suo yi wo xiang wo zheng zai xun zhao xin de 。]

english: Take me! I'm great.
translation: 带我去！我很棒。 [dai wo qu ！ wo hen bang 。]

english: Ha! You're very new here. You've certainly proved you are a worthy hero, but I'd rather someone with a few more years behind them.
translation: 哈!你是新来的。你确实已经证明了自己是一位值得尊敬的英雄，但我宁愿是比他们落后几年的人。 [ha ! ni shi xin lai de 。 ni que shi yi jing zheng ming liao zi ji shi yi wei zhi de zun jing de ying xiong ， dan wo ning yuan shi bi ta men luo hou ji nian de ren 。]

english: What? I've literally defeated a group of dragons that threatened to kill everyone, I think I'm ready for a boar hunt.
translation: 什么？我确实击败了一群威胁要杀死所有人的龙，我想我已经准备好去狩猎野猪了。 [shen me ？ wo que shi ji bai le yi qun wei xie yao sha si suo you ren de long ， wo xiang wo yi jing zhun bei hao qu shou lie ye zhu le 。]

english: Hmm... When it comes time for me to venture back to the Isle of Garmr, I'll consider inviting you.
translation: 嗯……到了我要冒险回加姆岛的时候，我会考虑邀请你。 [n …… dao le wo yao mao xian hui jia mu dao de shi hou ， wo hui kao lv yao qing ni 。]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: I'll see you around.
translation: 我会再见的。 [wo hui zai jian de 。]

english: Ah, so you've found my latest donation to the guild. What do you think? Spooky, isn't it?
translation: 啊，你已经找到了我最近给公会的捐款。你怎么认为？很恐怖，不是吗？ [a ， ni yi jing zhao dao le wo zui jin gei gong hui de juan kuan 。 ni zen me ren wei ？ hen kong bu ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Just a bit. Is this the original text? It doesn't look that old...
translation: 就一点点。这是原文吗？看上去没那么老啊... [jiu yi dian dian 。 zhe shi yuan wen ma ？ kan shang qu mei na me lao a ...]

english: Oh Guthix, no! These texts were inscribed in rock paper in a tome even I struggled to lift. The writer left it there as a warning, and I assume they didn't want it to be moved.
translation: 哦古西克斯，不！这些文字被刻在一本大部头的石纸上，即使我费力地拿起。作者将其留在那里作为警告，我认为他们不希望它被移动。 [o gu xi ke si ， bu ！ zhe xie wen zi bei ke zai yi ben da bu tou de shi zhi shang ， ji shi wo fei li di na qi 。 zuo zhe jiang qi liu zai na li zuo wei jing gao ， wo ren wei ta men bu xi wang ta bei yi dong 。]

english: Did you translate it?
translation: 你翻译了吗？ [ni fan yi le ma ？]

english: I certainly tried... Perhaps there are some date inconsistencies and a few words I had to guess at. I'd found a lot of scrolls detailing trade with early Fremennik tribes too, which certainly helped.
translation: 我当然尝试过......也许有一些日期不一致和一些我不得不猜测的单词。我还发现了很多详细介绍与早期弗雷曼尼克部落贸易的卷轴，这当然有帮助。 [wo dang ran chang shi guo ...... ye xu you yi xie ri qi bu yi zhi he yi xie wo bu de bu cai ce de dan ci 。 wo hai fa xian le hen duo xiang xi jie shao yu zao qi fu lei man ni ke bu luo mao yi de juan zhou ， zhe dang ran you bang zhu 。]

english: Imcandoria... Do you think that's where the Imcando dwarves originate?
translation: 伊姆坎多利亚……你认为那是伊姆坎多矮人的起源地吗？ [yi mu kan duo li ya …… ni ren wei na shi yi mu kan duo ai ren de qi yuan di ma ？]

english: It certainly seems reasonable.
translation: 这看起来当然是合理的。 [zhe kan qi lai dang ran shi he li de 。]

english: Interesting...
translation: 有趣的... [you qu de ...]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: What grand feats are you known for?
translation: 您因哪些伟大事迹而闻名？ [nin yin na xie wei da shi ji er wen ming ？]

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？ [ni wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Would you like to buy some cooking equipment?
translation: 您想购买一些烹饪设备吗？ [nin xiang gou mai yi xie peng ren she bei ma ？]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: 我不能和你这个外地人说话！与酋长布伦特交谈！ [wo bu neng he ni zhe ge wai di ren shuo hua ！ yu qiu zhang bu lun te jiao tan ！]

english: Hello, are you a member of the council?
translation: 你好，请问你是理事会成员吗？ [ni hao ， qing wen ni shi li shi hui cheng yuan ma ？]

english: I am afraid not outerlander. Goodbye.
translation: 恐怕不是外地人。再见。 [kong pa bu shi wai di ren 。 zai jian 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: 再次你好[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]。今天你需要我做什么？您永远可以信赖我的帮助！ [zai ci ni hao [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 jin tian ni xu yao wo zuo shen me ？ nin yong yuan ke yi xin lai wo de bang zhu ！]

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。我只是想聊聊。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。 wo zhi shi xiang liao liao 。]

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: 如果您需要我的帮助[弗雷曼尼克名字]，我的门永远敞开。 [ru guo nin xu yao wo de bang zhu [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]， wo de men yong yuan chang kai 。]

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: [弗雷曼尼克名字]...我们已经很久没有见面了！ [[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]... wo men yi jing hen jiu mei you jian mian le ！]

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: 欢迎回来[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]。很高兴在这里见到您！ [huan ying hui lai [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 hen gao xing zai zhe li jian dao nin ！]

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: 我很抱歉[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]！我没时间陪你在这里！ [wo hen bao qian [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！ wo mei shi jian pei ni zai zhe li ！]

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
translation: 没关系，我其实什么都不想要。 [mei guan xi ， wo qi shi shen me dou bu xiang yao 。]

english: How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: 你[弗雷曼尼克名字]怎么样？我希望您这一天一切顺利！ [ni [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ] zen me yang ？ wo xi wang nin zhe yi tian yi qie shun li ！]

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
translation: 我很好，谢谢，你好吗？ [wo hen hao ， xie xie ， ni hao ma ？]

english: All is well with me also!
translation: 我也一切都好！ [wo ye yi qie dou hao ！]

english: Hello to you, too!
translation: 也向你问好！ [ye xiang ni wen hao ！]

english: Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你好。你想要什么东西[弗雷曼尼克名字]吗？ [ni hao 。 ni xiang yao shen me dong xi [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ] ma ？]

english: No, not really.
translation: 不，不是真的。 [bu ， bu shi zhen de 。]

english: Well... okay then!
translation: 嗯……那好吧！ [n …… na hao ba ！]

english: Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
translation: 很高兴见到你[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]。 [hen gao xing jian dao ni [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。]

english: How are you today?
translation: 你今天怎么样？ [ni jin tian zen me yang ？]

english: **sigh**
That good? Everyone around here seems a little depressed.
translation: 那好？这里的每个人似乎都有些沮丧。 [na hao ？ zhe li de mei ge ren si hu dou you xie ju sang 。]

english: And not particularly talkative.
translation: 而且也不是特别爱说话。 [er qie ye bu shi te bie ai shuo hua 。]

english: I'll leave you to your sighing. It looks like you have plenty to do.
translation: 我会让你叹息。看起来你有很多事情要做。 [wo hui rang ni tan xi 。 kan qi lai ni you hen duo shi qing yao zuo 。]

english: It's a bit grey round here, isn't it?
translation: 这里有点灰色，不是吗？ [zhe li you dian hui se ， bu shi ma ？]

english: It gets you down after a while, you know. There are 273 shades of grey, you know, and we have them all.
translation: 一段时间后它会让你情绪低落，你知道。你知道，有 273 种灰色，我们都有。 [yi duan shi jian hou ta hui rang ni qing xu di luo ， ni zhi dao 。 ni zhi dao ， you  273  zhong hui se ， wo men dou you 。]

english: That's grey-t.
translation: 那是灰色-t。 [na shi hui se -t。]

english: That attempt at humour merely made me more depressed. Leave me alone.
translation: 这种幽默的尝试只会让我更加沮丧。请别打扰我。 [zhe zhong you mo de chang shi zhi hui rang wo geng jia ju sang 。 qing bie da rao wo 。]

english: How's the King treating you then?
translation: 那么国王对你怎么样？ [na me guo wang dui ni zen me yang ？]

english: Like serfs.
translation: 就像农奴一样。 [jiu xiang nong nu yi yang 。]

english: Serf?
translation: 农奴？ [nong nu ？]

english: Yes, you know - peons, plebs, the downtrodden. He treats us like his own personal possessions.
translation: 是的，你知道的——苦工、平民、受压迫者。他对待我们就像对待自己的私人财产一样。 [shi de ， ni zhi dao de —— ku gong 、 ping min 、 shou ya po zhe 。 ta dui dai wo men jiu xiang dui dai zi ji de si ren cai chan yi yang 。]

english: You should leave this place.
translation: 你应该离开这个地方。 [ni ying gai li kai zhe ge di fang 。]

english: I keep trying to save up enough to leave, but the King keeps taxing us! We have no money left.
translation: 我一直想攒够钱离开，但国王却一直向我们征税！我们已经没有钱了。 [wo yi zhi xiang zan gou qian li kai ， dan guo wang que yi zhi xiang wo men zheng shui ！ wo men yi jing mei you qian le 。]

english: Oh dear.
translation: 哦亲爱的。 [o qin ai de 。]

english: Cheer up! It's not the end of the world.
translation: 开心点！这不是世界末日。 [kai xin dian ！ zhe bu shi shi jie mo ri 。]

english: I'd prefer that, if it meant I didn't have to talk to people as inanely happy as you.
translation: 我更喜欢这样，如果这意味着我不必和像你一样快乐的人说话。 [wo geng xi huan zhe yang ， ru guo zhe yi wei zhe wo bu bi he xiang ni yi yang kuai le de ren shuo hua 。]

english: Whoa! I think you need to get out more.
translation: 哇！我觉得你需要多出去走走。 [wa ！ wo jue de ni xu yao duo chu qu zou zou 。]

english: Shhh! I'm waiting for the show!
translation: 嘘！我等着看演出呢！ [xu ！ wo deng zhe kan yan chu ne ！]

english: YOU ARE A TERRIBLE BARD!
translation: 你是个糟糕的吟游诗人！ [ni shi ge zao gao de yin you shi ren ！]

english: Don't give up your day job outerlander!
translation: 不要放弃你的日常工作外地人！ [bu yao fang qi ni de ri chang gong zuo wai di ren ！]

english: I thought somebody was murdering a cat!
translation: 我以为有人谋杀了一只猫！ [wo yi wei you ren mou sha le yi zhi mao ！]

english: You know, I actually quite liked that verse...
translation: 你知道，我其实很喜欢这首诗...... [ni zhi dao ， wo qi shi hen xi huan zhe shou shi ......]

english: That's kind of catchy. Irritating. But catchy.
translation: 这有点吸引人。令人恼火。但很吸引人。 [zhe you dian xi yin ren 。 ling ren nao huo 。 dan hen xi yin ren 。]

english: Hey, I've done that quest too!
translation: 嘿嘿，这个任务我也做过！ [hei hei ， zhe ge ren wu wo ye zuo guo ！]

english: I have produced better sounds in the outhouse!
translation: 我在室外发出了更好的声音！ [wo zai shi wai fa chu le geng hao de sheng yin ！]

english: Your song makes no sense outerlander!
translation: 你的歌毫无意义，外地人！ [ni de ge hao wu yi yi ， wai di ren ！]

english: What kind of bard are you anyway?
translation: 你到底是哪种吟游诗人？ [ni dao di shi na zhong yin you shi ren ？]

english: I have met cows more musical than you!
translation: 我见过比你更有音乐天赋的牛！ [wo jian guo bi ni geng you yin yue tian fu de niu ！]

english: When do you get to the good parts?
translation: 你什么时候能看到好的部分？ [ni shen me shi hou neng kan dao hao de bu fen ？]

english: would torture us so, outerlander?
translation: 会这样折磨我们吗，外来者？ [hui zhe yang zhe mo wo men ma ， wai lai zhe ？]

english: Truly, this is the worst sound I have ever heard!
translation: 确实，这是我听过的最糟糕的声音！ [que shi ， zhe shi wo ting guo de zui zao gao de sheng yin ！]

english: looting and drinking part?
translation: 抢劫和饮酒部分？ [qiang jie he yin jiu bu fen ？]

english: Please tell me that was the last verse...
translation: 请告诉我这是最后一首诗... [qing gao su wo zhe shi zui hou yi shou shi ...]

english: Please... Kill me now...
translation: 拜托...现在就杀了我... [bai tuo ... xian zai jiu sha le wo ...]

english: You call THAT singing?
translation: 你管这叫唱歌？ [ni guan zhe jiao chang ge ？]

english: Never before have mine ears been so offended!
translation: 我的耳朵从来没有这么不舒服过！ [wo de er duo cong lai mei you zhe me bu shu fu guo ！]

english: Worst. Bard. EVER.
translation: 最糟糕的。诗人。曾经。 [zui zao gao de 。 shi ren 。 ceng jing 。]

english: Please, ye gods! Make it stop!
translation: 拜托各位大神了！让它停下来！ [bai tuo ge wei da shen le ！ rang ta ting xia lai ！]

english: If you stopped singing
translation: 如果你停止唱歌 [ru guo ni ting zhi chang ge]

english: The screams of my dying comrades sound better!
translation: 我死去的战友的尖叫声听起来更好听！ [wo si qu de zhan you de jian jiao sheng ting qi lai geng hao ting ！]

english: My grandmother could do better, and she is dead!
translation: 我的祖母本可以做得更好，但她已经死了！ [wo de zu mu ben ke yi zuo de geng hao ， dan ta yi jing si le ！]

english: I do such feats before breakfast!
translation: 我在早餐前就做了这样的事！ [wo zai zao can qian jiu zuo le zhe yang de shi ！]

english: Is your singing some kind of outerlander weapon?
translation: 你的歌声是某种外来武器吗？ [ni de ge sheng shi mou zhong wai lai wu qi ma ？]

english: Congratulations, Champion [Fremennik name]. Thank you for defeating the Troll King.
translation: 恭喜你，冠军[弗雷曼尼克名字]。感谢你击败了巨魔之王。 [gong xi ni ， guan jun [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 gan xie ni ji bai le ju mo zhi wang 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Greetings! Have you come to talk forestry?
translation: 问候！你是来谈林业的吗？ [wen hou ！ ni shi lai tan lin ye de ma ？]

english: Forestry? Don't you look after pheasants as well?
translation: 林业？你不也养野鸡吗？ [lin ye ？ ni bu ye yang ye ji ma ？]

english: In a way, though I find them a little freaky!
translation: 在某种程度上，虽然我觉得它们有点怪异！ [zai mou zhong cheng du shang ， sui ran wo jue de ta men you dian guai yi ！]

english: You see, the forests have woken up and we need those trained in the way of the forester now more than ever!
translation: 你看，森林已经苏醒，我们现在比以往任何时候都更需要接受林务员培训的人！ [ni kan ， sen lin yi jing su xing ， wo men xian zai bi yi wang ren he shi hou dou geng xu yao jie shou lin wu yuan pei xun de ren ！]

english: Way of the forester? What do you mean?
translation: 护林员的方式？你是什​​么意思？ [hu lin yuan de fang shi ？ ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: You know, tending to the woodland with your fellow foresters so it may flourish!
translation: 您知道，与您的林务员同事一起照料林地，这样它就会蓬勃发展！ [nin zhi dao ， yu nin de lin wu yuan tong shi yi qi zhao liao lin di ， zhe yang ta jiu hui peng bo fa zhan ！]

english: And, of course, drinking plenty of tea to fuel yourself!
translation: 当然，还要多喝茶来补充能量！ [dang ran ， hai yao duo he cha lai bu chong neng liang ！]

english: Sounds interesting, how can I get started?
translation: 听起来很有趣，我该如何开始呢？ [ting qi lai hen you qu ， wo gai ru he kai shi ne ？]

english: I'd recommend spending some more time in the forests before embarking on your forestry journey.
translation: 我建议您在开始林业之旅之前在森林中多呆一些时间。 [wo jian yi nin zai kai shi lin ye zhi lv zhi qian zai sen lin zhong duo dai yi xie shi jian 。]

english: Come back when you can fell a mighty oak!
translation: 当你能砍倒一棵巨大的橡树时就回来吧！ [dang ni neng kan dao yi ke ju da de xiang shu shi jiu hui lai ba ！]

english: I'll bear that in mind. Thanks for the information.
translation: 我会记住这一点。感谢您提供信息。 [wo hui ji zhu zhe yi dian 。 gan xie nin ti gong xin xi 。]

english: Good luck out there!
translation: 祝你好运！ [zhu ni hao yun ！]

english: You seem like you know your way around the forests.
translation: 你好像很熟悉森林里的路。 [ni hao xiang hen shu xi sen lin li de lu 。]

english: To get started with forestry, I can sell you a Forestry kit for a reasonable price.
translation: 要开始林业，我可以以合理的价格向您出售林业套件。 [yao kai shi lin ye ， wo ke yi yi he li de jia ge xiang nin chu shou lin ye tao jian 。]

english: Need to make sure our foresters are committed, you know?
translation: 需要确保我们的林务人员尽职尽责，你知道吗？ [xu yao que bao wo men de lin wu ren yuan jin zhi jin ze ， ni zhi dao ma ？]

english: Then all you need to do is chop some trees while you have the kit on you and the woodland will do the rest!
translation: 然后，您所需要做的就是在携带工具包的情况下砍伐一些树木，然后林地会完成剩下的工作！ [ran hou ， nin suo xu yao zuo de jiu shi zai xie dai gong ju bao de qing kuang xia kan fa yi xie shu mu ， ran hou lin di hui wan cheng sheng xia de gong zuo ！]

english: Oh, and if you find any anima-infused bark while tending to the forests, I'll gladly trade with you.
translation: 哦，如果你在照料森林时发现任何注入灵能的树皮，我很乐意与你交易。 [o ， ru guo ni zai zhao liao sen lin shi fa xian ren he zhu ru ling neng de shu pi ， wo hen le yi yu ni jiao yi 。]

english: I'll have a look at your shop, thanks.
translation: 我去你店看看，谢谢。 [wo qu ni dian kan kan ， xie xie 。]

english: Good luck on your adventure!
translation: 祝你冒险顺利！ [zhu ni mao xian shun li ！]

english: I'll happily buy those off you in my shop.
translation: 我很乐意在我的商店里从你那里买这些。 [wo hen le yi zai wo de shang dian li cong ni na li mai zhe xie 。]

english: Hello, how can I help you?
translation: 您好，请问有什么可以帮您的吗？ [nin hao ， qing wen you shen me ke yi bang nin de ma ？]

english: You can't; I'm beyond help.
translation: 你不能；我已经无药可救了。 [ni bu neng ； wo yi jing wu yao ke jiu le 。]

english: I'm okay, thank you.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。 [wo mei shi ， xie xie 。]

english: What are you selling?
translation: 你卖什么？ [ni mai shen me ？]

english: You can't; I'm beyond help.
translation: 你不能；我已经无药可救了。 [ni bu neng ； wo yi jing wu yao ke jiu le 。]

english: I'm okay, thank you.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。 [wo mei shi ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello adventurer, welcome to the Entrana furnace.
translation: 你好冒险家，欢迎来到 Entrana 熔炉。 [ni hao mao xian jia ， huan ying lai dao  Entrana  rong lu 。]

english: Would you like me to explain my craft to you?
translation: 你想让我向你解释一下我的手艺吗？ [ni xiang rang wo xiang ni jie shi yi xia wo de shou yi ma ？]

english: Yes please. I'd be fascinated to hear what you do.
translation: 是的，请。我很想听听你所做的事情。 [shi de ， qing 。 wo hen xiang ting ting ni suo zuo de shi qing 。]

english: I'm extremely pleased to hear that! I've always wanted an apprentice. Let me talk you through the secrets of glassblowing.
translation: 我非常高兴听到这个消息！我一直想要一个徒弟。让我来告诉你吹制玻璃的秘密。 [wo fei chang gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi ！ wo yi zhi xiang yao yi ge tu di 。 rang wo lai gao su ni chui zhi bo li de mi mi 。]

english: Glass is made from soda ash and silica. We get our soda ash by collecting seaweed from the rocks - the prevailing currents make the north-west corner of the island the best place to find it, it can also be found in
translation: 玻璃由纯碱和二氧化硅制成。我们通过从岩石中收集海藻来获取纯碱 - 盛行的水流使岛屿的西北角成为找到它的最佳地点，它也可以在 [bo li you chun jian he er yang hua gui zhi cheng 。 wo men tong guo cong yan shi zhong shou ji hai zao lai huo qu chun jian  -  sheng xing de shui liu shi dao yu de xi bei jiao cheng wei zhao dao ta de zui jia di dian ， ta ye ke yi zai]

english: your nets sometimes when you're fishing, on Karamja island or at the Piscatoris Fishing Colony in the nets there. To turn seaweed into soda ash, all you need to do is burn it on a fire. Feel free to use the range in
translation: 有时，当您在卡拉姆贾岛或皮斯卡托里斯渔场钓鱼时，您的网就在那里的网中。要将海藻变成纯碱，只需将其放在火上燃烧即可。请随意使用该范围 [you shi ， dang nin zai ka la mu jia dao huo pi si ka tuo li si yu chang diao yu shi ， nin de wang jiu zai na li de wang zhong 。 yao jiang hai zao bian cheng chun jian ， zhi xu jiang qi fang zai huo shang ran shao ji ke 。 qing sui yi shi yong gai fan wei]

english: Fritz the Glassblower: my house for that; it's the one directly west of here. Next we collect sand from the sandpit that you'll also find just west of here, there are others located in Yanille and Shilo Village.
translation: 玻璃吹制者弗里茨：我的房子；就在这儿西边的那个。接下来，我们从沙坑收集沙子，您也可以在此处的西边找到沙坑，还有其他位于 Yanille 和 Shilo 村的沙坑。 [bo li chui zhi zhe fu li ci ： wo de fang zi ； jiu zai zhe er xi bian de na ge 。 jie xia lai ， wo men cong sha keng shou ji sha zi ， nin ye ke yi zai ci chu de xi bian zhao dao sha keng ， hai you qi ta wei yu  Yanille  he  Shilo  cun de sha keng 。]

english: You'll need a bucket to carry it in. Tell you what, you can have this old one of mine.
translation: 你需要一个桶来装它。告诉你吧，你可以拥有我的这个旧桶。 [ni xu yao yi ge tong lai zhuang ta 。 gao su ni ba ， ni ke yi yong you wo de zhe ge jiu tong 。]

english: Bring the sand and the soda ash back here and melt them together in the furnace, and there you have it - molten glass!
translation: 把沙子和纯碱带回这里，在熔炉中将它们熔化在一起，你就得到了——熔融玻璃！ [ba sha zi he chun jian dai hui zhe li ， zai rong lu zhong jiang ta men rong hua zai yi qi ， ni jiu de dao le —— rong rong bo li ！]

english: There are many things you can use the molten glass for once you have made it. Depending on how talented you are, you could try turning it into something, like a fishbowl, for example. If you'd like to try your hand at
translation: 熔融玻璃制成后，可以用来做很多事情。根据您的才华，您可以尝试将其变成某种东西，例如鱼缸。如果你想尝试一下 [rong rong bo li zhi cheng hou ， ke yi yong lai zuo hen duo shi qing 。 gen ju nin de cai hua ， nin ke yi chang shi jiang qi bian cheng mou zhong dong xi ， li ru yu gang 。 ru guo ni xiang chang shi yi xia]

english: the fine art of glassblowing you can use my spare glassblowing pipe. I think I left it on the chest of drawers in my house this morning.
translation: 玻璃吹制艺术 你可以使用我备用的玻璃吹制管。我想今天早上我把它留在家里的抽屉柜上了。 [bo li chui zhi yi shu   ni ke yi shi yong wo bei yong de bo li chui zhi guan 。 wo xiang jin tian zao shang wo ba ta liu zai jia li de chou ti gui shang le 。]

english: Alternatively I am always happy to buy the molten glass from you, saves me running about making it for myself.
translation: 另外，我总是很乐意从你那里购买熔融玻璃，这样我就不用自己跑来跑去了。 [ling wai ， wo zong shi hen le yi cong ni na li gou mai rong rong bo li ， zhe yang wo jiu bu yong zi ji pao lai pao qu le 。]

english: That sounds good. How much will you pay me?
translation: 听起来很好。你要付给我多少钱？ [ting qi lai hen hao 。 ni yao fu gei wo duo shao qian ？]

english: Tell you what, because you've been interested in my art, I'll pay you the premium price of 20 gold pieces for each piece of molten glass you bring me
translation: 告诉你吧，因为你对我的艺术感兴趣，你每给我带来一块熔融玻璃，我就支付你二十金币的溢价 [gao su ni ba ， yin wei ni dui wo de yi shu gan xing qu ， ni mei gei wo dai lai yi kuai rong rong bo li ， wo jiu zhi fu ni er shi jin bi de yi jia]

english: No thanks, I doubt I'll ever turn my hand to glassblowing.
translation: 不，谢谢，我怀疑我是否会转而从事玻璃吹制工作。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo huai yi wo shi fou hui zhuan er cong shi bo li chui zhi gong zuo 。]

english: Ok, suit yourself. Nobody seems to be interested in the skilled crafts these days.
translation: 好吧，适合你自己。如今似乎没有人对技艺感兴趣。 [hao ba ， shi he ni zi ji 。 ru jin si hu mei you ren dui ji yi gan xing qu 。]

english: If you should change your mind, come back and talk to me.
translation: 如果你改变主意，请回来跟我谈谈。 [ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， qing hui lai gen wo tan tan 。]

english: Ah [player name], have you come to sell me some molten glass?
translation: 啊【玩家名字】，你是来卖玻璃水的吗？ [a 【 wan jia ming zi 】， ni shi lai mai bo li shui de ma ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: Fantastic! Let's see, for that much glass I could pay you ...
translation: 极好的！让我们看看，我可以付给你那么多玻璃杯...... [ji hao de ！ rang wo men kan kan ， wo ke yi fu gei ni na me duo bo li bei ......]

english: ... [amount] gold pieces!
translation: ...【数量】金币！ [...【 shu liang 】 jin bi ！]

english: Are you mad? I've run all over the island to make this glass.
translation: 你疯了？为了制作这块玻璃，我跑遍了全岛。 [ni feng le ？ wei le zhi zuo zhe kuai bo li ， wo pao bian le quan dao 。]

english: Pity. Well you can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: 遗憾。如果你改变主意，可以在这里找到我。 [yi han 。 ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， ke yi zai zhe li zhao dao wo 。]

english: Sure, that sounds like a fair price.
translation: 当然，这听起来像是一个公平的价格。 [dang ran ， zhe ting qi lai xiang shi yi ge gong ping de jia ge 。]

english: Here you are then.
translation: 那么你就在这里。 [na me ni jiu zai zhe li 。]

english: Thanks very much, [player name]. I'll buy any more that you bring.
translation: 非常感谢，[玩家姓名]。你带来的我都会再买。 [fei chang gan xie ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。 ni dai lai de wo du hui zai mai 。]

english: Umm, not much point me trying to pay you for glass you don't have, is there?
translation: 嗯，我没有必要付钱给你买你没有的玻璃，不是吗？ [n ， wo mei you bi yao fu qian gei ni mai ni mei you de bo li ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Well, actually, if you don't mind... question then.
translation: 好吧，实际上，如果你不介意的话……那就提问吧。 [hao ba ， shi ji shang ， ru guo ni bu jie yi de hua …… na jiu ti wen ba 。]

english: I'll make it simple for you. You bring glass, me pay shiny gold coins.
translation: 我会让你变得简单。你带来玻璃，我付闪亮的金币。 [wo hui rang ni bian de jian dan 。 ni dai lai bo li ， wo fu shan liang de jin bi 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Oh.
...errr, well should you get any I'm quite happy to pay for it. Remember, I'll pay you 20 gold pieces for each piece of molten glass you get for me.
translation: ...呃，如果你能得到任何我很乐意付钱。记住，你每给我一块熔融玻璃，我都会付给你 20 金币。 [... e ， ru guo ni neng de dao ren he wo hen le yi fu qian 。 ji zhu ， ni mei gei wo yi kuai rong rong bo li ， wo du hui fu gei ni  20  jin bi 。]

english: So what did you want to talk to me about then?
translation: 那你当时想跟我谈什么？ [na ni dang shi xiang gen wo tan shen me ？]

english: Could you tell me how to make molten glass again, please?
translation: 你能告诉我如何再次制造熔融玻璃吗？ [ni neng gao su wo ru he zai ci zhi zao rong rong bo li ma ？]

english: Well, I am very busy at the moment, but I guess I can take 5 minutes off for my favourite student.
translation: 嗯，我现在很忙，但我想我可以为我最喜欢的学生休息 5 分钟。 [n ， wo xian zai hen mang ， dan wo xiang wo ke yi wei wo zui xi huan de xue sheng xiu xi  5  fen zhong 。]

english: You can use the bucket I gave you earlier.
translation: 你可以用我之前给你的桶。 [ni ke yi yong wo zhi qian gei ni de tong 。]

english: I'm afraid I don't have that bucket with me. Could you give me another one, please?
translation: 恐怕我没带那个水桶。请再给我一份好吗？ [kong pa wo mei dai na ge shui tong 。 qing zai gei wo yi fen hao ma ？]

english: Do I look like I'm made of buckets? You'll just have to buy another from a general store.
translation: 我看起来像是水桶做的吗？您只需要从杂货店购买另一个即可。 [wo kan qi lai xiang shi shui tong zuo de ma ？ nin zhi xu yao cong za huo dian gou mai ling yi ge ji ke 。]

english: I just thought I'd drop in and say hello.
translation: 我只是想顺便过来打个招呼。 [wo zhi shi xiang shun bian guo lai da ge zhao hu 。]

english: Hello then. I'm afraid I don't have any time to chat though. The druids of Taverley have placed a huge order for glass vials, so I'm very busy.
translation: 那么你好。但恐怕我没有时间聊天。塔弗利的德鲁伊下了一大笔玻璃瓶订单，所以我很忙。 [na me ni hao 。 dan kong pa wo mei you shi jian liao tian 。 ta fu li de de lu yi xia le yi da bi bo li ping ding dan ， suo yi wo hen mang 。]

english: Yes please. I'd be fascinated to hear what you do.
translation: 是的，请。我很想听听你所做的事情。 [shi de ， qing 。 wo hen xiang ting ting ni suo zuo de shi qing 。]

english: No thanks, I doubt I'll ever turn my hand to glassblowing.
translation: 不，谢谢，我怀疑我是否会转而从事玻璃吹制工作。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo huai yi wo shi fou hui zhuan er cong shi bo li chui zhi gong zuo 。]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: Are you mad? I've run all over the island to make this glass.
translation: 你疯了？为了制作这块玻璃，我跑遍了全岛。 [ni feng le ？ wei le zhi zuo zhe kuai bo li ， wo pao bian le quan dao 。]

english: Sure, that sounds like a fair price.
translation: 当然，这听起来像是一个公平的价格。 [dang ran ， zhe ting qi lai xiang shi yi ge gong ping de jia ge 。]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Could you tell me how to make molten glass again, please?
translation: 你能告诉我如何再次制造熔融玻璃吗？ [ni neng gao su wo ru he zai ci zhi zao rong rong bo li ma ？]

english: I just thought I'd drop in and say hello.
translation: 我只是想顺便过来打个招呼。 [wo zhi shi xiang shun bian guo lai da ge zhao hu 。]

english: Hurrah for the frog [prince/princess]!
translation: 为青蛙万岁[王子/公主]！ [wei qing wa wan sui [ wang zi / gong zhu ]！]

english: Don't talk to me! Speak to the frog [prince/princess]!
translation: 别跟我说话！和青蛙[王子/公主]说话！ [bie gen wo shuo hua ！ he qing wa [ wang zi / gong zhu ] shuo hua ！]

english: ​The frogs do not need your help right now.
translation: 青蛙现在不需要你的帮助。 [qing wa xian zai bu xu yao ni de bang zhu 。]

english: Don't look at me, I'm just a frog. Ribbit! Ribbit!
translation: 别看我，我只是一只青蛙。兔子！兔子！ [bie kan wo ， wo zhi shi yi zhi qing wa 。 tu zi ！ tu zi ！]

english: Hello, [player name]
translation: 你好，[玩家姓名] [ni hao ，[ wan jia xing ming ]]

english: [player name], the frog [prince/princess] desires your attention!
translation: [玩家姓名]，青蛙[王子/公主]需要你的关注！ [[ wan jia xing ming ]， qing wa [ wang zi / gong zhu ] xu yao ni de guan zhu ！]

english: If you kiss [him/her], [player name], [he/she] will turn into a human!
translation: 如果你亲吻[他/她]，[玩家名字]，[他/她]就会变成人类！ [ru guo ni qin wen [ ta / ta ]，[ wan jia ming zi ]，[ ta / ta ] jiu hui bian cheng ren lei ！]

english: But if you ignore [him/her], [player name], we will turn you into a frog!
translation: 但如果你忽视[他/她]、[玩家姓名]，我们会把你变成青蛙！ [dan ru guo ni hu shi [ ta / ta ]、[ wan jia xing ming ]， wo men hui ba ni bian cheng qing wa ！]

english: That's IT, [player name] you're a frog!
translation: 就是这样，[玩家名字]你是一只青蛙！ [jiu shi zhe yang ，[ wan jia ming zi ] ni shi yi zhi qing wa ！]

english: Err, excuse me?
translation: 呃，请问？ [e ， qing wen ？]

english: Why? Am I in your way?
translation: 为什么？我妨碍你了吗？ [wei shen me ？ wo fang ai ni le ma ？]

english: That was just plain weird!
translation: 这实在是太奇怪了！ [zhe shi zai shi tai qi guai le ！]

english: Pretty Trees!
translation: 漂亮的树！ [piao liang de shu ！]

english: Having fun?
translation: 玩得开心吗？ [wan de kai xin ma ？]

english: I'm just looking at the magic trees. I think they're cool.
translation: 我只是在看魔法树。我觉得他们很酷。 [wo zhi shi zai kan mo fa shu 。 wo jue de ta men hen ku 。]

english: Well, they are magical. Valuable as well...
translation: 嗯，他们很神奇。也很有价值... [n ， ta men hen shen qi 。 ye hen you jia zhi ...]

english: When I grow up I want to chop down trees and make magic bows. Then I'd be rich.
translation: 当我长大后，我想砍伐树木并制作魔法弓。那我就很有钱了。 [dang wo zhang da hou ， wo xiang kan fa shu mu bing zhi zuo mo fa gong 。 na wo jiu hen you qian le 。]

english: Well, that does seem to be a common career around here.
translation: 嗯，这似乎是这里的常见职业。 [n ， zhe si hu shi zhe li de chang jian zhi ye 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I am Fry, master of dramatics. Player of plays, singer of songs!
translation: 我是戏剧大师弗莱。戏剧演员、歌曲歌手！ [wo shi xi ju da shi fu lai 。 xi ju yan yuan 、 ge qu ge shou ！]

english: A creative type eh?
translation: 创意型吧？ [chuang yi xing ba ？]

english: Yes indeed.
translation: 确实是的。 [que shi shi de 。]

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？ [ni wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: I put on shows to entertain our patrons.
translation: 我举办表演来娱乐我们的顾客。 [wo ju ban biao yan lai yu le wo men de gu ke 。]

english: At least, I used to. We don't get many punters these days.
translation: 至少，我曾经是这样。这些天我们没有很多下注者。 [zhi shao ， wo ceng jing shi zhe yang 。 zhe xie tian wo men mei you hen duo xia zhu zhe 。]

english: Why is that?
translation: 这是为什么？ [zhe shi wei shen me ？]

english: I don't know, Easter isn't as big as it used to be I suppose.
translation: 我不知道，复活节不像以前那么盛大。 [wo bu zhi dao ， fu huo jie bu xiang yi qian na me sheng da 。]

english: Well I had to crawl in here through a hole, do you think that's a factor?
translation: 好吧，我不得不从一个洞里爬到这里，你认为这是一个因素吗？ [hao ba ， wo bu de bu cong yi ge dong li pa dao zhe li ， ni ren wei zhe shi yi ge yin su ma ？]

english: It wasn't before, but I suppose it could be putting people off...
translation: 以前没有，但我想这可能会让人们望而却步...... [yi qian mei you ， dan wo xiang zhe ke neng hui rang ren men wang er que bu ......]

english: Hmm... Maybe we need a door...
translation: 嗯...也许我们需要一扇门... [n ... ye xu wo men xu yao yi shan men ...]

english: Maybe!
translation: 或许！ [huo xu ！]

english: Hello! I'm trying to cheer up the Easter Bunny, do you have any ideas?
translation: 你好！我正在努力让复活节兔子高兴起来，你有什么想法吗？ [ni hao ！ wo zheng zai nu li rang fu huo jie tu zi gao xing qi lai ， ni you shen me xiang fa ma ？]

english: Hmm, I have noticed his recent sour mood. Let me think for a moment...
translation: 嗯，我注意到他最近心情不好了。让我想一下... [n ， wo zhu yi dao ta zui jin xin qing bu hao le 。 rang wo xiang yi xia ...]

english: Aha! I have it! Let's put on a performance! That will cheer him up.
translation: 啊哈！我有！我们来表演一下吧！这会让他高兴起来。 [a ha ！ wo you ！ wo men lai biao yan yi xia ba ！ zhe hui rang ta gao xing qi lai 。]

english: A performance?
translation: 表演？ [biao yan ？]

english: Yes! He's always enjoyed a good show.
translation: 是的！他总是喜欢看好戏。 [shi de ！ ta zong shi xi huan kan hao xi 。]

english: Well I suppose that could work...
translation: 好吧，我想这可以工作...... [hao ba ， wo xiang zhe ke yi gong zuo ......]

english: Could you perform something soon?
translation: 你能尽快做点什么吗？ [ni neng jin kuai zuo dian shen me ma ？]

english: Well, I'll need some time to find something appropriate to perform.
translation: 好吧，我需要一些时间来找到合适的表演。 [hao ba ， wo xu yao yi xie shi jian lai zhao dao he shi de biao yan 。]

english: Okay, I'll come back later when you've worked something out.
translation: 好吧，等你解决了一些问题我就回来。 [hao ba ， deng ni jie jue le yi xie wen ti wo jiu hui lai 。]

english: Of course, I'll need some performers.
translation: 当然，我需要一些表演者。 [dang ran ， wo xu yao yi xie biao yan zhe 。]

english: Surely you don't mean me?
translation: 你确定不是说我吗？ [ni que ding bu shi shuo wo ma ？]

english: You do mean me.
translation: 你确实是说我。 [ni que shi shi shuo wo 。]

english: Naturally! I'll talk to some other people too and get a good troupe together!
translation: 自然！我也会和其他人谈谈并组建一个好的剧团！ [zi ran ！ wo ye hui he qi ta ren tan tan bing zu jian yi ge hao de ju tuan ！]

english: Well, as long as it's not just me.
translation: 好吧，只要不是只有我一个人就好。 [hao ba ， zhi yao bu shi zhi you wo yi ge ren jiu hao 。]

english: Of course not, you don't look deserving of a solo to me! Now run along, I shall begin my creative process.
translation: 当然不是，在我看来你不配独奏！现在开始吧，我要开始我的创作过程了。 [dang ran bu shi ， zai wo kan lai ni bu pei du zou ！ xian zai kai shi ba ， wo yao kai shi wo de chuang zuo guo cheng le 。]

english: See you later then.
translation: 到时候见。 [dao shi hou jian 。]

english: Hello again Fry, are you proceeding with the performance planning?
translation: 弗莱，您好，您正在进行表演规划吗？ [fu lai ， nin hao ， nin zheng zai jin xing biao yan gui hua ma ？]

english: Oh yes, I'm perusing potential performances and am planning which parts will be picked.
translation: 哦，是的，我正在仔细研究潜在的表演，并计划选择哪些部分。 [o ， shi de ， wo zheng zai zi xi yan jiu qian zai de biao yan ， bing ji hua xuan ze na xie bu fen 。]

english: Perfect!
translation: 完美的！ [wan mei de ！]

english: Ah, hello [player name]! I've a fantastic performance for us all to practise, if you are ready for a rehearsal?
translation: 啊，你好[玩家姓名]！我有一场精彩的表演供大家练习，你准备好排练了吗？ [a ， ni hao [ wan jia xing ming ]！ wo you yi chang jing cai de biao yan gong da jia lian xi ， ni zhun bei hao pai lian le ma ？]

english: Yes, we'd better have a go!
translation: 是的，我们最好去尝试一下！ [shi de ， wo men zui hao qu chang shi yi xia ！]

english: Alright then, let's assemble the troupe!
translation: 好吧，那我们就组队吧！ [hao ba ， na wo men jiu zu dui ba ！]

english: Oh hang on, we don't want to ruin the surprise.
translation: 哦，等等，我们不想破坏这个惊喜。 [o ， deng deng ， wo men bu xiang po huai zhe ge jing xi 。]

english: Easter Bunny! There's more fancy carrot juice at the bar!
translation: 复活节兔子！酒吧里还有更美味的胡萝卜汁！ [fu huo jie tu zi ！ jiu ba li hai you geng mei wei de hu luo bo zhi ！]

english: Ooooh! Outta my way!
translation: 哦哦！别挡我的路！ [o o ！ bie dang wo de lu ！]

english: Rightio then, let's get to it.
translation: 那么，让我们开始吧。 [na me ， rang wo men kai shi ba 。]

english: Glanton! Rinder! Eggus! It's time!
translation: 格兰顿！林德！蛋蛋！是时候了！ [ge lan dun ！ lin de ！ dan dan ！ shi shi hou le ！]

english: Time fer what?
translation: 时间做什么？ [shi jian zuo shen me ？]

english: Time for the rehearsal! For the performance!
translation: 排练时间到了！为了表演！ [pai lian shi jian dao le ！ wei le biao yan ！]

english: I didn't think ye were serious about that!
translation: 我没想到你是认真的！ [wo mei xiang dao ni shi ren zhen de ！]

english: Well I am, so hurry along. You've all had a chance to familiarise yourselves with my script, yes?
translation: 嗯，我就是这样，所以快点吧。你们都有机会熟悉我的剧本，是吗？ [n ， wo jiu shi zhe yang ， suo yi kuai dian ba 。 ni men dou you ji hui shu xi wo de ju ben ， shi ma ？]

english: Oh yeah of course, I know it by heart. Hah!
translation: 哦，是的，我当然知道。哈！ [o ， shi de ， wo dang ran zhi dao 。 ha ！]

english: Perfect! Rinder?
translation: 完美的！林德尔？ [wan mei de ！ lin de er ？]

english: What he said.
translation: 他说什么。 [ta shuo shen me 。]

english: I also did not read it.
translation: 我也没有读过。 [wo ye mei you du guo 。]

english: Oh you jokers, come on then! To the stage!
translation: 哦，你们这些小丑，来吧！到舞台了！ [o ， ni men zhe xie xiao chou ， lai ba ！ dao wu tai le ！]

english: See you there in a moment.
translation: 一会儿见。 [yi hui er jian 。]

english: Rinder, Eggus Manus, Glanton, and the player arrive on the stage.
translation: 林德、埃格斯·马努斯、格兰顿和玩家登上舞台。 [lin de 、 ai ge si · ma nu si 、 ge lan dun he wan jia deng shang wu tai 。]

english: Wonderful, we're all here!
translation: 太棒了，我们都在这里！ [tai bang le ， wo men dou zai zhe li ！]

english: Let's see what you've got then.
translation: 让我们看看你有什么。 [rang wo men kan kan ni you shen me 。]

english: This should be interesting.
translation: 这应该很有趣。 [zhe ying gai hen you qu 。]

english: You first, Glanton!
translation: 你先来，格兰顿！ [ni xian lai ， ge lan dun ！]

english: Aw heck.
translation: 噢哎呀。 [o ai ya 。]

english: From the top! First verse! And a one two three!
translation: 从上面！第一节！还有一二三！ [cong shang mian ！ di yi jie ！ hai you yi er san ！]

english: Oh lordy, uh..
translation: 哦主啊，呃.. [o zhu a ， e ..]

english: When the foeman bares his.. peels?
translation: 当敌人露出他的……果皮时？ [dang di ren lu chu ta de …… guo pi shi ？]

english: TARANTA-RA TARANTA-RA!
translation: 塔兰塔-拉 塔兰塔-拉！ [ta lan ta - la   ta lan ta - la ！]

english: We, dun dun dun, er...
translation: 我们，敦敦敦，呃…… [wo men ， dun dun dun ， e ……]

english: I don't know this! I do not know this one!
translation: 我不知道这个！我不知道这个！ [wo bu zhi dao zhe ge ！ wo bu zhi dao zhe ge ！]

english: For goodness sake.
translation: 老天爷。 [lao tian ye 。]

english: That wasn't very Easter-ey.
translation: 那不太有复活节气氛。 [na bu tai you fu huo jie qi fen 。]

english: No, it wasn't.
translation: 不，不是。 [bu ， bu shi 。]

english: Oh come on, it's an old standard!
translation: 哦，来吧，这是一个旧标准！ [o ， lai ba ， zhe shi yi ge jiu biao zhun ！]

english: I don't even know what a foeman is!
translation: 我根本不知道什么是敌人！ [wo gen ben bu zhi dao shen me shi di ren ！]

english: Could we try something else?
translation: 我们可以尝试别的吗？ [wo men ke yi chang shi bie de ma ？]

english: Well I don't have anything to hand, but you're welcome to have a look backstage.
translation: 好吧，我手边没有什么东西，不过欢迎你到后台看看。 [hao ba ， wo shou bian mei you shen me dong xi ， bu guo huan ying ni dao hou tai kan kan 。]

english: Backstage eh? Alright.
translation: 后台啊？好吧。 [hou tai a ？ hao ba 。]

english: Rinder, Eggus Manus, and Glanton leave the stage.
translation: 林德、埃格斯·马努斯和格兰顿离开舞台。 [lin de 、 ai ge si · ma nu si he ge lan dun li kai wu tai 。]

english: You should have a look backstage to see if there's anything that could help with the performance.
translation: 你应该去后台看看是否有什么可以对表演有帮助的。 [ni ying gai qu hou tai kan kan shi fou you shen me ke yi dui biao yan you bang zhu de 。]

english: Have you found anything useful backstage yet?
translation: 你在后台发现什么有用的东西了吗？ [ni zai hou tai fa xian shen me you yong de dong xi le ma ？]

english: Not yet.
translation: 还没有。 [hai mei you 。]

english: Well get to it then!
translation: 那么就开始吧！ [na me jiu kai shi ba ！]

english: In my own time.
translation: 在我自己的时间里。 [zai wo zi ji de shi jian li 。]

english: I found some old costumes we can use.
translation: 我找到了一些我们可以用的旧服装。 [wo zhao dao le yi xie wo men ke yi yong de jiu fu zhuang 。]

english: Oh that's great, but we'll need more than just costumes to wow the audience.
translation: 哦，那太好了，但我们需要的不仅仅是服装来让观众惊叹。 [o ， na tai hao le ， dan wo men xu yao de bu jin jin shi fu zhuang lai rang guan zhong jing tan 。]

english: We need some material to perform!
translation: 我们需要一些材料来表演！ [wo men xu yao yi xie cai liao lai biao yan ！]

english: True, I'll have another look.
translation: 确实，我会再看一下。 [que shi ， wo hui zai kan yi xia 。]

english: I've found an old script, but I haven't read it yet.
translation: 我找到了一个旧剧本，但我还没读过。 [wo zhao dao le yi ge jiu ju ben ， dan wo hai mei du guo 。]

english: Well perhaps you should read it?

english: I'm waiting here hoping that someone can guide me to the Paterdomus, the temple on the Salve.
translation: 我在这里等待，希望有人能带我去帕特多莫斯（Paterdomus），萨尔夫河上的神庙。 [wo zai zhe li deng dai ， xi wang you ren neng dai wo qu pa te duo mo si （Paterdomus）， sa er fu he shang de shen miao 。]

english: Where is Paterdomus?
translation: 帕特多莫斯在哪里？ [pa te duo mo si zai na li ？]

english: Oh, Paterdomus is that rather impressive looking temple on the Salve... I'm sure you must have passed it on your way into Morytania.
translation: 哦，帕特多莫斯是萨尔夫岛上那座看起来相当令人印象深刻的神庙……我相信你在前往莫里塔尼亚的路上一定经过了它。 [o ， pa te duo mo si shi sa er fu dao shang na zuo kan qi lai xiang dang ling ren yin xiang shen ke de shen miao …… wo xiang xin ni zai qian wang mo li ta ni ya de lu shang yi ding jing guo le ta 。]

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
translation: 你为什么要去帕特多莫斯？ [ni wei shen me yao qu pa te duo mo si ？]

english: I'm hoping to get back to civilisation and see what the lands of Misthalin look like.
translation: 我希望回到文明世界，看看米沙林的土地是什么样子。 [wo xi wang hui dao wen ming shi jie ， kan kan mi sha lin de tu di shi shen me yang zi 。]

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Paterdomus?
translation: 如果我们在前往帕特多莫斯的路上遇到敌人，你能保护自己吗？ [ru guo wo men zai qian wang pa te duo mo si de lu shang yu dao di ren ， ni neng bao hu zi ji ma ？]

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of bad guys. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: 这么说吧，我有点经验，而且我很乐意与坏人对抗。你不需要担心这个。 [zhe me shuo ba ， wo you dian jing yan ， er qie wo hen le yi yu huai ren dui kang 。 ni bu xu yao dan xin zhe ge 。]

translation: 嗯嗯，看来你有追随者了。我想如果让它独自徘徊的话，它可能会在这段旅程中迷路。等你的追随者安全了我们就离开吧。 [n n ， kan lai ni you zhui sui zhe le 。 wo xiang ru guo rang ta du zi pai huai de hua ， ta ke neng hui zai zhe duan lv cheng zhong mi lu 。 deng ni de zhui sui zhe an quan le wo men jiu li kai ba 。]

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on.

translation: 天啊！看来我们得回 Burgh de Rott 了。我们过不了那座桥！ [tian a ！ kan lai wo men de hui  Burgh de Rott  le 。 wo men guo bu liao na zuo qiao ！]

english: Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 好吧，这已经被撕裂了……看起来我们无法越过这个沼泽。我们得返回 Burgh de Rott。 [hao ba ， zhe yi jing bei si lie le …… kan qi lai wo men wu fa yue guo zhe ge zhao ze 。 wo men de fan hui  Burgh de Rott。]

english: Player completes the bog event

english: Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: 嘿……太好了……你做得很好……我会关注你的。 [hei …… tai hao le …… ni zuo de hen hao …… wo hui guan zhu ni de 。]

english: Whahay...that was great!

english: Player completes the river event

english: That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 哇哈！那很棒！但我们现在真的应该出发了。 [wa ha ！ na hen bang ！ dan wo men xian zai zhen de ying gai chu fa le 。]

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
translation: 呃……那些气泡是什么？ [e …… na xie qi pao shi shen me ？]

english: This is scary!
translation: 这太可怕了！ [zhe tai ke pa le ！]

translation: ……三根触手！ […… san gen chu shou ！]

english: I think I'm going to faint!
translation: 我想我要晕倒了！ [wo xiang wo yao yun dao le ！]

english: Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: 天啊！看看那只野兽！你得自己解决这件事！ [tian a ！ kan kan na zhi ye shou ！ ni de zi ji jie jue zhe jian shi ！]

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the temple. Here's your reward.
translation: 非常感谢您让我安全到达寺庙。这是你的奖励。 [fei chang gan xie nin rang wo an quan dao da si miao 。 zhe shi ni de jiang li 。]

english: Where is Paterdomus?
translation: 帕特多莫斯在哪里？ [pa te duo mo si zai na li ？]

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
translation: 你为什么要去帕特多莫斯？ [ni wei shen me yao qu pa te duo mo si ？]

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
translation: 如果我们遇到敌人，你能保护自己吗……？ [ru guo wo men yu dao di ren ， ni neng bao hu zi ji ma ……？]

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
translation: 我可以带你去帕特多莫斯。 [wo ke yi dai ni qu pa te duo mo si 。]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Get out of my office! We WILL have our revenge, human!
translation: 滚出我的办公室！我们会报仇的，人类！ [gun chu wo de ban gong shi ！ wo men hui bao chou de ， ren lei ！]

translation: 尽管您找到了顾客，但您似乎没有带来正确的食物！你需要[一个/一些][订购的侏儒食物/饮料]！ [jin guan nin zhao dao le gu ke ， dan nin si hu mei you dai lai zheng que de shi wu ！ ni xu yao [ yi ge / yi xie ][ ding gou de zhu ru shi wu / yin liao ]！]

translation: 恐怕预制菜肴不行。对于 Aluft Aloft 的顾客来说，只有手工制作的 Gnome Cuisine 才足够好。 [kong pa yu zhi cai yao bu xing 。 dui yu  Aluft Aloft  de gu ke lai shuo ， zhi you shou gong zhi zuo de  Gnome Cuisine  cai zu gou hao 。]

english: You hand over your delivery of [item] to G.L.O. Caranock
translation: 您将 [物品] 的交付交给 G.L.O.卡拉诺克 [nin jiang  [ wu pin ]  de jiao fu jiao gei  G.L.O. ka la nuo ke]

translation: 只需将订单交给人类即可。 [zhi xu jiang ding dan jiao gei ren lei ji ke 。]

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 你一定是走了很远的路才把这个交给我的。这里有一些额外的东西作为提示。 [ni yi ding shi zou le hen yuan de lu cai ba zhe ge jiao gei wo de 。 zhe li you yi xie e wai de dong xi zuo wei ti shi 。]

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 您有 [number] 个积分用于免费送货令牌。您还没有资格获得侏儒食物。 [nin you  [number]  ge ji fen yong yu mian fei song huo ling pai 。 nin hai mei you zi ge huo de zhu ru shi wu 。]

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 您有 [number] 个积分用于免费送货令牌。您可能会收到 [number] 块侏儒食物。 [nin you  [number]  ge ji fen yong yu mian fei song huo ling pai 。 nin ke neng hui shou dao  [number]  kuai zhu ru shi wu 。]

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 不要忘记从 Aluft Gianne jnr 领取免费送货代币。 [bu yao wang ji cong  Aluft Gianne jnr  ling qu mian fei song huo dai bi 。]

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 你的交货太晚了！返回 Aluft jnr。以获得另一个订单。您丢弃了送货箱，因为您不再需要它了。 [ni de jiao huo tai wan le ！ fan hui  Aluft jnr。 yi huo de ling yi ge ding dan 。 nin diu qi le song huo xiang ， yin wei nin bu zai xu yao ta le 。]

english: Welcome to GPDT!
translation: 欢迎来到GPDT！ [huan ying lai dao GPDT！]

english: Thank you very much.
translation: 非常感谢。 [fei chang gan xie 。]

english: So, when are you going to deliver this crate?
translation: 那么，你打算什么时候交付这个箱子？ [na me ， ni da suan shen me shi hou jiao fu zhe ge xiang zi ？]

english: Well... I guess we could do it now...
translation: 嗯...我想我们现在就可以做到... [n ... wo xiang wo men xian zai jiu ke yi zuo dao ...]

english: Thank you, it's interesting in here.
translation: 谢谢，这里很有趣。 [xie xie ， zhe li hen you qu 。]

english: We're the premier delivery service in ALL of Gielinor!
translation: 我们是吉利诺地区首屈一指的送货服务！ [wo men shi ji li nuo di qu shou qu yi zhi de song huo fu wu ！]

english: So, when are you going to deliver this crate?
translation: 那么，你打算什么时候交付这个箱子？ [na me ， ni da suan shen me shi hou jiao fu zhe ge xiang zi ？]

english: Thank you, it's interesting in here.
translation: 谢谢，这里很有趣。 [xie xie ， zhe li hen you qu 。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Not much really... I run a local shop which earns me a few trading sticks, but that's about it. I keep myself to myself really.
translation: 确实不多……我经营一家当地商店，这给我赚了一些交易棍子，但仅此而已。我真的很保守自己。 [que shi bu duo …… wo jing ying yi jia dang di shang dian ， zhe gei wo zhuan le yi xie jiao yi gun zi ， dan jin ci er yi 。 wo zhen de hen bao shou zi ji 。]

english: What are trading sticks?
translation: 什么是交易棒？ [shen me shi jiao yi bang ？]

english: They're the local currency Bwana, it's used in Tai Bwo Wannai, there's usually some odd jobs that need doing around the village which you could do to earn some trading sticks.
translation: 它们是当地货币 Bwana，在 Tai Bwo Wannai 使用，通常在村庄周围需要做一些零工，你可以做这些工作来赚取一些贸易棒。 [ta men shi dang di huo bi  Bwana， zai  Tai Bwo Wannai  shi yong ， tong chang zai cun zhuang zhou wei xu yao zuo yi xie ling gong ， ni ke yi zuo zhe xie gong zuo lai zhuan qu yi xie mao yi bang 。]

english: Or, if you have something which the local villagers might like, you could sell it to me and I'll pay you for it in trading sticks.
translation: 或者，如果你有当地村民可能喜欢的东西，你可以把它卖给我，我会用交易棍子付给你钱。 [huo zhe ， ru guo ni you dang di cun min ke neng xi huan de dong xi ， ni ke yi ba ta mai gei wo ， wo hui yong jiao yi gun zi fu gei ni qian 。]

english: What sort of things do the local villagers like?
translation: 当地村民喜欢什么样的东西？ [dang di cun min xi huan shen me yang de dong xi ？]

english: Gnome cocktails! It's amazing but we all just love them! Luckily I've managed to get stocks of the gnome made cocktails and I supply those to my favourite customers. However, many of the customers really like the cocktails
translation: 侏儒鸡尾酒！太棒了，但我们都喜欢它们！幸运的是，我已经设法获得了侏儒制作的鸡尾酒的库存，并将它们提供给我最喜欢的顾客。然而，许多顾客真的很喜欢鸡尾酒 [zhu ru ji wei jiu ！ tai bang le ， dan wo men dou xi huan ta men ！ xing yun de shi ， wo yi jing she fa huo de le zhu ru zhi zuo de ji wei jiu de ku cun ， bing jiang ta men ti gong gei wo zui xi huan de gu ke 。 ran er ， xu duo gu ke zhen de hen xi huan ji wei jiu]

english: made by the adventurers passing through this way. If you ever happen to have any, bring them my way! I'll give you a good deal on it that's for sure!
translation: 是经过这条路的冒险者们所创造的。如果你碰巧有的话，就给我带来吧！我肯定会给你一个很好的交易！ [shi jing guo zhe tiao lu de mao xian zhe men suo chuang zao de 。 ru guo ni peng qiao you de hua ， jiu gei wo dai lai ba ！ wo ken ding hui gei ni yi ge hen hao de jiao yi ！]

english: How did the villagers ever get to try any gnome cocktails?
translation: 村民们是怎么尝试侏儒鸡尾酒的呢？ [cun min men shi zen me chang shi zhu ru ji wei jiu de ne ？]

english: I think it was that gnome pilot who crashed his glider, perhaps he had a little mini-bar on board? Come to think about it, you'd expect the little guy to get his stuff together and move on out of here wouldn't you? He
translation: 我认为是那个侏儒飞行员撞毁了他的滑翔机，也许他机上有一个小迷你吧？想想看，你会希望这个小家伙收拾好他的东西然后离开这里，不是吗？他 [wo ren wei shi na ge zhu ru fei xing yuan zhuang hui le ta de hua xiang ji ， ye xu ta ji shang you yi ge xiao mi ni ba ？ xiang xiang kan ， ni hui xi wang zhe ge xiao jia huo shou shi hao ta de dong xi ran hou li kai zhe li ， bu shi ma ？ ta]

english: must love the jungle to have stayed here so long!
translation: 一定很喜欢丛林才在这里呆了这么久！ [yi ding hen xi huan cong lin cai zai zhe li dai le zhe me jiu ！]

english: You run a shop?
translation: 你经营一家商店？ [ni jing ying yi jia shang dian ？]

english: Yes, it's the Tai Bwo cooperative... catchy name huh! We sell a few local village trinkets and tools. Also, there are a few items that we're actually looking to stock for the locals' sake.
translation: 是的，就是大宝合作社……名字好听啊！我们出售一些当地村庄的小饰品和工具。此外，为了当地人的利益，我们实际上正在寻找一些库存物品。 [shi de ， jiu shi da bao he zuo she …… ming zi hao ting a ！ wo men chu shou yi xie dang di cun zhuang de xiao shi pin he gong ju 。 ci wai ， wei le dang di ren de li yi ， wo men shi ji shang zheng zai xun zhao yi xie ku cun wu pin 。]

english: If you happen across any of them please bring them to me, I'll pay a good price for them. I'm sure you'll find the prices very reasonable.
translation: 如果你遇到其中任何一个，请把它们带给我，我会出个好价钱买下它们。我相信您会发现价格非常合理。 [ru guo ni yu dao qi zhong ren he yi ge ， qing ba ta men dai gei wo ， wo hui chu ge hao jia qian mai xia ta men 。 wo xiang xin nin hui fa xian jia ge fei chang he li 。]

english: Can I take a look at what you have to sell?
translation: 我可以看一下你要卖什么吗？ [wo ke yi kan yi xia ni yao mai shen me ma ？]

english: Sure you can...which shop would you like to see? The Cooperative or Drinks store?
translation: 当然可以...您想参观哪家商店？合作社还是饮料店？ [dang ran ke yi ... nin xiang can guan na jia shang dian ？ he zuo she hai shi yin liao dian ？]

english: None thanks...
translation: 没有谢谢... [mei you xie xie ...]

english: Why do you only take one sort of Gnome cocktail?
translation: 为什么你只喝一种侏儒鸡尾酒？ [wei shen me ni zhi he yi zhong zhu ru ji wei jiu ？]

english: It's funny that actually. I've managed to get a good deal with the pilot of that gnome glider. He can supply me directly now. However, it's really interesting that the local villagers really like the gnome cocktails made by the
translation: 其实很有趣。我已经和那架侏儒滑翔机的飞行员达成了一笔不错的交易。他现在可以直接给我供货了。不过，有趣的是，当地村民非常喜欢由侏儒制作的鸡尾酒。 [qi shi hen you qu 。 wo yi jing he na jia zhu ru hua xiang ji de fei xing yuan da cheng le yi bi bu cuo de jiao yi 。 ta xian zai ke yi zhi jie gei wo gong huo le 。 bu guo ， you qu de shi ， dang di cun min fei chang xi huan you zhu ru zhi zuo de ji wei jiu 。]

english: adventurers passing through this way.
translation: 冒险者们从这条路经过。 [mao xian zhe men cong zhe tiao lu jing guo 。]

english: Why, what's the difference?
translation: 为什么，有什么区别？ [wei shen me ， you shen me qu bie ？]

english: I think it may just be that they're made fresher, or there is a slight twist in the flavour of the drink, you know, a little more of this, a little less of that, it all adds up and makes for an interesting tipple!
translation: 我认为可能只是它们变得更新鲜，或者饮料的味道略有不同，你知道，这个多一点，那个少一点，所有这些加起来就构成了一种有趣的酒！ [wo ren wei ke neng zhi shi ta men bian de geng xin xian ， huo zhe yin liao de wei dao lve you bu tong ， ni zhi dao ， zhe ge duo yi dian ， na ge shao yi dian ， suo you zhe xie jia qi lai jiu gou cheng le yi zhong you qu de jiu ！]

translation: 我想问另一个问题。 [wo xiang wen ling yi ge wen ti 。]

english: Sure, what do you want to ask?
translation: 当然可以，你想问什么？ [dang ran ke yi ， ni xiang wen shen me ？]

english: Is there anything interesting to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么好玩的吗？ [zhe fu jin you shen me hao wan de ma ？]

english: Sorry Bwana, I'm already busy, why not go and talk to Murcaily! He's around the village somewhere.
translation: 抱歉 Bwana，我已经很忙了，为什么不去和 Murcaily 谈谈呢！他就在村子附近的某个地方。 [bao qian  Bwana， wo yi jing hen mang le ， wei shen me bu qu he  Murcaily  tan tan ne ！ ta jiu zai cun zi fu jin de mou ge di fang 。]

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 我一直在村里做一些工作。 [wo yi zhi zai cun li zuo yi xie gong zuo 。]

english: Yeah, you've been doing a lot of good work around here. Let me give you something for your time and effort.
translation: 是的，你在这里做了很多出色的工作。让我给你一些东西来补偿你的时间和精力。 [shi de ， ni zai zhe li zuo le hen duo chu se de gong zuo 。 rang wo gei ni yi xie dong xi lai bu chang ni de shi jian he jing li 。]

translation: 您将获得[数量]根交易棒。您还剩下[金额]%的恩惠。 [nin jiang huo de [ shu liang ] gen jiao yi bang 。 nin hai sheng xia [ jin e ]% de en hui 。]

english: I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: 我已经给了你一些交易棒，现在我身上没有了。为什么不去和其他一些村民谈谈并获得一些捐款呢？ [wo yi jing gei le ni yi xie jiao yi bang ， xian zai wo shen shang mei you le 。 wei shen me bu qu he qi ta yi xie cun min tan tan bing huo de yi xie juan kuan ne ？]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

translation: 嘿。如果你能为我解决一个问题，那么你就可以继续。 [hei 。 ru guo ni neng wei wo jie jue yi ge wen ti ， na me ni jiu ke yi ji xu 。]
