translation: 想去城堡吃点小吃吗？ [xiang qu cheng bao chi dian xiao chi ma ？]

english: Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: 等一下，我的牙齿里有一点东西卡住了…… [deng yi xia ， wo de ya chi li you yi dian dong xi ka zhu le ……]

english: Welcome to the vinery, young [man/lady]. Can I help you?
translation: 欢迎来到葡萄园，年轻的[男士/女士]。我可以帮你吗？ [huan ying lai dao pu tao yuan ， nian qing de [ nan shi / nv shi ]。 wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: How do I farm here?
translation: 我怎么在这里种田？ [wo zen me zai zhe li zhong tian ？]

english: I'm afraid you aren't allowed, dear.
translation: 恐怕你不被允许，亲爱的。 [kong pa ni bu bei yun xu ， qin ai de 。]

english: Now, can I help you with anything else?
translation: 现在，我还能帮你什么忙吗？ [xian zai ， wo hai neng bang ni shen me mang ma ？]

english: Let's see... First, you'll need to treat the soil with saltpetre. Dig it into the patch with a trowel. The minerals are good for the fruit.
translation: 让我们看看...首先，您需要用硝石处理土壤。用抹刀将其挖入补丁中。矿物质对水果有好处。 [rang wo men kan kan ... shou xian ， nin xu yao yong xiao shi chu li tu rang 。 yong mo dao jiang qi wa ru bu ding zhong 。 kuang wu zhi dui shui guo you hao chu 。]

english: Then plant a grape seed, and just let it grow. I'll look after it, so it won't get diseased.
translation: 然后种下一颗葡萄种子，让它生长。我会照顾它，让它不会生病。 [ran hou zhong xia yi ke pu tao zhong zi ， rang ta sheng zhang 。 wo hui zhao gu ta ， rang ta bu hui sheng bing 。]

english: When your grapes are ready, pick them and clear the patch so you can grow a new vine.
translation: 当你的葡萄成熟后，采摘它们并清理土地，这样你就可以种植新的葡萄藤了。 [dang ni de pu tao cheng shu hou ， cai zhai ta men bing qing li tu di ， zhe yang ni jiu ke yi zhong zhi xin de pu tao teng le 。]

english: Does that seem clear, or would you like help with something else?
translation: 这看起来清楚吗？或者您需要其他方面的帮助吗？ [zhe kan qi lai qing chu ma ？ huo zhe nin xu yao qi ta fang mian de bang zhu ma ？]

english: What do you do?
translation: 你做什么工作？ [ni zuo shen me gong zuo ？]

english: I'm the vintner. I helped Lord Hosidius to develop this land as a vinery, and now it's complete he's put me in charge of production while he works on a new project.
translation: 我是葡萄酒商。我帮助霍西迪厄斯勋爵将这片土地开发为葡萄园，现在一切都完成了，他让我负责生产，而他则负责一个新项目。 [wo shi pu tao jiu shang 。 wo bang zhu huo xi di e si xun jue jiang zhe pian tu di kai fa wei pu tao yuan ， xian zai yi qie dou wan cheng le ， ta rang wo fu ze sheng chan ， er ta ze fu ze yi ge xin xiang mu 。]

english: His son, young Pandur, works here too. Pandur checks the wine I produce. But if you've got any questions about the farming, don't ask Pandur. Ask me instead. He checks the wine too much.
translation: 他的儿子小潘杜尔也在这里工作。潘杜尔检查我生产的葡萄酒。但如果您对农业有任何疑问，请不要问潘杜尔。而是问我。他对酒的检查太多了。 [ta de er zi xiao pan du er ye zai zhe li gong zuo 。 pan du er jian cha wo sheng chan de pu tao jiu 。 dan ru guo nin dui nong ye you ren he yi wen ， qing bu yao wen pan du er 。 er shi wen wo 。 ta dui jiu de jian cha tai duo le 。]

english: So can I help you with anything?
translation: 那么我可以帮你什么忙吗？ [na me wo ke yi bang ni shen me mang ma ？]

english: Why are you called Gallow?
translation: 你为什么叫绞刑架？ [ni wei shen me jiao jiao xing jia ？]

english: It's short for 'Gallows'. When I was young, a boy made some improper suggestions to me, so I grabbed him by his neck and held him in the air until he learnt some manners.
translation: 它是“绞架”的缩写。小时候，有一个男孩向我提出了一些不恰当的建议，我就抓住他的脖子，把他举在空中，直到他学会了一些礼仪。 [ta shi “ jiao jia ” de suo xie 。 xiao shi hou ， you yi ge nan hai xiang wo ti chu le yi xie bu qia dang de jian yi ， wo jiu zhua zhu ta de bo zi ， ba ta ju zai kong zhong ， zhi dao ta xue hui le yi xie li yi 。]

english: Now, dear, do you need help with the vinery? I'm enjoying the chat, but I have work to do.
translation: 现在，亲爱的，你需要葡萄园方面的帮助吗？我很享受聊天，但我还有工作要做。 [xian zai ， qin ai de ， ni xu yao pu tao yuan fang mian de bang zhu ma ？ wo hen xiang shou liao tian ， dan wo hai you gong zuo yao zuo 。]

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: I have a question for you.
translation: 我有个问题要问你。 [wo you ge wen ti yao wen ni 。]

english: Gallow has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 绞刑架给了你一个挑战卷轴！ [jiao xing jia gei le ni yi ge tiao zhan juan zhou ！]

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。 [qing shu ru wen ti de da an 。]

english: No, try again.
translation: 不，再试一次。 [bu ， zai shi yi ci 。]

english: Correct!
translation: 正确的！ [zheng que de ！]

english: Gallow has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 绞刑架给了你另一条线索卷轴！ [jiao xing jia gei le ni ling yi tiao xian suo juan zhou ！]

english: You've obtained a casket!
translation: 你已经获得了一个棺材！ [ni yi jing huo de le yi ge guan cai ！]

english: How do I farm here?
translation: 我怎么在这里种田？ [wo zen me zai zhe li zhong tian ？]

english: What do you do?
translation: 你做什么工作？ [ni zuo shen me gong zuo ？]

english: Why are you called Gallow?
translation: 你为什么叫绞刑架？ [ni wei shen me jiao jiao xing jia ？]

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Good day.
translation: 再会。 [zai hui 。]

english: What's so good about it?
translation: 它有什么好呢？ [ta you shen me hao ne ？]

english: What's eating you.
translation: 什么在吃你。 [shen me zai chi ni 。]

english: I'm ruined, all because of that stupid cat! It has ruined me.
translation: 我毁了，都是因为那只蠢猫！它毁了我。 [wo hui le ， dou shi yin wei na zhi chun mao ！ ta hui le wo 。]

english: Why did it have to get itself killed? Why?
translation: 为什么它一定要自杀呢？为什么？ [wei shen me ta yi ding yao zi sha ne ？ wei shen me ？]

english: *Aside* I think I should leave him alone. He seems a little upset right now.
translation: *旁白*我想我应该让他一个人呆着。他现在似乎有些不安。 [* pang bai * wo xiang wo ying gai rang ta yi ge ren dai zhe 。 ta xian zai si hu you xie bu an 。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Trying to win my shirt back. I lost it last night in a silly bet.
translation: 试图赢回我的衬衫。昨晚我在一次愚蠢的打赌中输掉了它。 [shi tu ying hui wo de chen shan 。 zuo wan wo zai yi ci yu chun de da du zhong shu diao le ta 。]

english: Well I hope your luck improves. I doubt it can get any worse.
translation: 好吧，我希望你的运气有所改善。我怀疑情况还会变得更糟。 [hao ba ， wo xi wang ni de yun qi you suo gai shan 。 wo huai yi qing kuang hai hui bian de geng zao 。]

english: Well I've little left to lose, maybe some more hair and my trousers.
translation: 好吧，我已经没什么可失去的了，也许还有一些头发和裤子。 [hao ba ， wo yi jing mei shen me ke shi qu de le ， ye xu hai you yi xie tou fa he ku zi 。]

english: I really think you should try hold on to them.
translation: 我真的认为你应该尝试抓住它们。 [wo zhen de ren wei ni ying gai chang shi zhua zhu ta men 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？ [ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: I was just wondering what you were doing here?
translation: 我只是想知道你来这里做什么？ [wo zhi shi xiang zhi dao ni lai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I ask myself the same question often.
translation: 我经常问自己同样的问题。 [wo jing chang wen zi ji tong yang de wen ti 。]

english: What am I doing down here in these pits along with these filthy dregs of society?
translation: 我和这些肮脏的社会渣滓一起在这些坑里做什么？ [wo he zhe xie ang zang de she hui zha zi yi qi zai zhe xie keng li zuo shen me ？]

english: And do you ever come up with an answer?
translation: 你有想过答案吗？ [ni you xiang guo da an ma ？]

english: Always.
translation: 总是。 [zong shi 。]

english: I'm here taking their money, that's what.
translation: 我在这里拿了他们的钱，就是这样。 [wo zai zhe li na le ta men de qian ， jiu shi zhe yang 。]

english: Hello! What's going on here?
translation: 你好！这是怎么回事？ [ni hao ！ zhe shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: Just a bit of drinking, a bit of fighting and a few people trying to win big.
translation: 只是喝了点酒，打了点仗，还有几个人想赢得大奖。 [zhi shi he le dian jiu ， da le dian zhang ， hai you ji ge ren xiang ying de da jiang 。]

english: Nothing but good clean family fun.
translation: 除了干净的家庭乐趣之外什么都没有。 [chu le gan jing de jia ting le qu zhi wai shen me dou mei you 。]

english: What are you doing?
translation: 你在干什么？ [ni zai gan shen me ？]

english: Nothing much. Just keeping myself occupied, placing a couple of wagers here and there.
translation: 没什么。只是让自己忙碌起来，到处下注。 [mei shen me 。 zhi shi rang zi ji mang lu qi lai ， dao chu xia zhu 。]

english: Are you winning?
translation: 你赢了吗？ [ni ying le ma ？]

english: Yes in the sense that I'm not as bored as I was and no in terms of the number of coins in my purse.
translation: 是的，从某种意义上说，我不再像以前那么无聊，从我钱包里的硬币数量来看，也不是。 [shi de ， cong mou zhong yi yi shang shuo ， wo bu zai xiang yi qian na me wu liao ， cong wo qian bao li de ying bi shu liang lai kan ， ye bu shi 。]

english: What are you up to?
translation: 你要做什么？ [ni yao zuo shen me ？]

english: Trying to win back some money.
translation: 试图赢回一些钱。 [shi tu ying hui yi xie qian 。]

english: Is it going well?
translation: 进展顺利吗？ [jin zhan shun li ma ？]

english: In every bet there is a fool and a thief and I'm beginning to think that I'm not much of a thief.
translation: 每一次赌注中都有一个傻瓜和一个小偷，而我开始认为我不太像一个小偷。 [mei yi ci du zhu zhong du you yi ge sha gua he yi ge xiao tou ， er wo kai shi ren wei wo bu tai xiang yi ge xiao tou 。]

english: Having fun. It's such a blast I've already won 5 thousand gold coins today, my cat just keeps winning.
translation: 玩得开心。真是太棒了，我今天已经赢得了 5000 金币，我的猫一直在赢。 [wan de kai xin 。 zhen shi tai bang le ， wo jin tian yi jing ying de le  5000  jin bi ， wo de mao yi zhi zai ying 。]

english: So how do these rat pits work?
translation: 那么这些老鼠坑是如何运作的呢？ [na me zhe xie lao shu keng shi ru he yun zuo de ne ？]

english: Things work simply in the Ardougne ratpits.
translation: 在阿杜涅老鼠坑里一切都很简单。 [zai a du nie lao shu keng li yi qie dou hen jian dan 。]

english: If you have a kitten and at least 100 coins you can challenge someone else who also has a kitten and some spare change.
translation: 如果您有一只小猫并且至少有 100 个硬币，您可以挑战其他也有一只小猫和一些零钱的人。 [ru guo nin you yi zhi xiao mao bing qie zhi shao you  100  ge ying bi ， nin ke yi tiao zhan qi ta ye you yi zhi xiao mao he yi xie ling qian de ren 。]

english: That sounds simple enough so far.
translation: 到目前为止，这听起来很简单。 [dao mu qian wei zhi ， zhe ting qi lai hen jian dan 。]

english: You then agree on a wager. It's rumoured that some ratcatchers can talk to their own cats and give them tactics to aid them.
translation: 然后你们同意打赌。有传言说，一些捕鼠者可以与自己的猫交谈，并向它们提供帮助它们的策略。 [ran hou ni men tong yi da du 。 you chuan yan shuo ， yi xie bu shu zhe ke yi yu zi ji de mao jiao tan ， bing xiang ta men ti gong bang zhu ta men de ce lve 。]

english: So then how do you win the challenge?
translation: 那么如何赢得挑战呢？ [na me ru he ying de tiao zhan ne ？]

english: I was just getting to that. Both the challengers' cats are placed inside the arena, and whichever kills 5 rats first wins.
translation: 我刚刚谈到这一点。挑战者的两只猫都被放置在竞技场内，先杀死 5 只老鼠的一方获胜。 [wo gang gang tan dao zhe yi dian 。 tiao zhan zhe de liang zhi mao dou bei fang zhi zai jing ji chang nei ， xian sha si  5  zhi lao shu de yi fang huo sheng 。]

english: It's simple.
translation: 这很简单。 [zhe hen jian dan 。]

english: In Varrock if you have a grown cat and a couple of coins you can challenge someone else who also has a grown cat and some spare change.
translation: 在 Varrock，如果您有一只成年猫和几枚硬币，您可以挑战其他也有一只成年猫和一些零钱的人。 [zai  Varrock， ru guo nin you yi zhi cheng nian mao he ji mei ying bi ， nin ke yi tiao zhan qi ta ye you yi zhi cheng nian mao he yi xie ling qian de ren 。]

english: I was just getting to that. Both the challengers' cats are placed inside the arena, and whichever kills 7 rats first wins.
translation: 我刚刚谈到这一点。挑战者的两只猫都被放置在竞技场内，先杀死 7 只老鼠的猫获胜。 [wo gang gang tan dao zhe yi dian 。 tiao zhan zhe de liang zhi mao dou bei fang zhi zai jing ji chang nei ， xian sha si  7  zhi lao shu de mao huo sheng 。]

english: The Port Sarim pits are quite fussy, no lazy cats allowed in here.
translation: 沙里姆港的坑非常挑剔，不允许懒猫进入这里。 [sha li mu gang de keng fei chang tiao ti ， bu yun xu lan mao jin ru zhe li 。]

english: Lazy cats?
translation: 懒猫？ [lan mao ？]

english: You know if you neglect a wily cat, it gets fat and lazy? Well, they're not allowed to fight in here, only wily cats.
translation: 你知道如果你忽视一只狡猾的猫，它就会变得又胖又懒吗？好吧，这里不允许他们打架，只有狡猾的猫才可以。 [ni zhi dao ru guo ni hu shi yi zhi jiao hua de mao ， ta jiu hui bian de you pang you lan ma ？ hao ba ， zhe li bu yun xu ta men da jia ， zhi you jiao hua de mao cai ke yi 。]

english: I was just getting to that. Both the challengers' cats are placed inside the arena, and whichever kills 11 rats first wins.
translation: 我刚刚谈到这一点。挑战者的两只猫都被放置在竞技场内，最先杀死 11 只老鼠的猫获胜。 [wo gang gang tan dao zhe yi dian 。 tiao zhan zhe de liang zhi mao dou bei fang zhi zai jing ji chang nei ， zui xian sha si  11  zhi lao shu de mao huo sheng 。]

english: That sounds vile and cruel.
translation: 这听上去卑鄙又残忍。 [zhe ting shang qu bei bi you can ren 。]

english: It's a cruel world and the pits are no exception.
translation: 这是一个残酷的世界，坑也不例外。 [zhe shi yi ge can ku de shi jie ， keng ye bu li wai 。]

english: Each to their own, I say.
translation: 我说，各有各的。 [wo shuo ， ge you ge de 。]

english: Thanks for your help.
translation: 感谢您的帮助。 [gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]

english: It sounds a little dangerous for my cat.
translation: 听起来对我的猫来说有点危险。 [ting qi lai dui wo de mao lai shuo you dian wei xian 。]

english: I agree. Cats have been known to be killed in fights.
translation: 我同意。众所周知，猫会在打斗中被杀死。 [wo tong yi 。 zhong suo zhou zhi ， mao hui zai da dou zhong bei sha si 。]

english: Oh how terrible. Is there nothing you can do to save your cat?
translation: 噢，多么可怕啊。你无能为力拯救你的猫吗？ [o ， duo me ke pa a 。 ni wu neng wei li zheng jiu ni de mao ma ？]

english: Of course there is, you can instruct it to be cautious, and it will leave once it feels as if it is in danger.
translation: 当然有，你可以让它小心一点，它感觉有危险就会离开。 [dang ran you ， ni ke yi rang ta xiao xin yi dian ， ta gan jue you wei xian jiu hui li kai 。]

english: Oh that sounds quite wise.
translation: 哦，这听起来很明智。 [o ， zhe ting qi lai hen ming zhi 。]

english: That depends on how you value your cat.
translation: 这取决于你如何评价你的猫。 [zhe qu jue yu ni ru he ping jia ni de mao 。]

english: Sorry, I don't follow.
translation: 抱歉，我不跟。 [bao qian ， wo bu gen 。]

english: Well if your cat dies or it runs away you lose.
translation: 好吧，如果你的猫死了或者逃跑了，你就输了。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni de mao si le huo zhe tao pao le ， ni jiu shu le 。]

english: So the longer it stays in the fight the better chance you have of winning.
translation: 因此，它在战斗中停留的时间越长，您获胜的机会就越大。 [yin ci ， ta zai zhan dou zhong ting liu de shi jian yue zhang ， nin huo sheng de ji hui jiu yue da 。]

english: Wow that sounds like fun!
translation: 哇，听起来很有趣！ [wa ， ting qi lai hen you qu ！]

english: I don't know about that.
translation: 我对此一无所知。 [wo dui ci yi wu suo zhi 。]

english: One thing I know though is that it's a quick way to make and lose money.
translation: 但我知道的一件事是，这是一种快速赚钱和赔钱的方法。 [dan wo zhi dao de yi jian shi shi ， zhe shi yi zhong kuai su zhuan qian he pei qian de fang fa 。]

english: Is there a limit to how much you can bet?
translation: 您可以下注的金额有限制吗？ [nin ke yi xia zhu de jin e you xian zhi ma ？]

english: Hmmm... let me think. I don't think that's ever arisen but I think it's 20,000.
translation: 嗯……让我想想。我认为这种情况从未出现过，但我认为有 20,000 个。 [n …… rang wo xiang xiang 。 wo ren wei zhe zhong qing kuang cong wei chu xian guo ， dan wo ren wei you  20,000  ge 。]

english: Hmm, that sounds like a silly amount of money to bet on a cat fight.
translation: 嗯，这听起来像是在猫打架上押注的一大笔钱。 [n ， zhe ting qi lai xiang shi zai mao da jia shang ya zhu de yi da bi qian 。]

english: You'd be surprised what some people would be willing to bet.
translation: 你会对有些人愿意下注感到惊讶。 [ni hui dui you xie ren yuan yi xia zhu gan dao jing ya 。]

english: There is a minimum bet of 100 coins too.
translation: 最低赌注也为 100 个硬币。 [zui di du zhu ye wei  100  ge ying bi 。]

english: Can I challenge you and your cat?
translation: 我可以挑战你和你的猫吗？ [wo ke yi tiao zhan ni he ni de mao ma ？]

english: No, not now, we don't really bet with outsiders.
translation: 不，现在不行，我们真的不跟外人打赌。 [bu ， xian zai bu xing ， wo men zhen de bu gen wai ren da du 。]

english: But I'm not an outsider, am I not inside in the pits now?
translation: 但我不是外人，我现在不是在坑里吗？ [dan wo bu shi wai ren ， wo xian zai bu shi zai keng li ma ？]

english: I don't know, maybe once you've done something to win over my trust.
translation: 我不知道，也许一旦你做了一些事情来赢得我的信任。 [wo bu zhi dao ， ye xu yi dan ni zuo le yi xie shi qing lai ying de wo de xin ren 。]

english: Can it be bought?
translation: 可以买吗？ [ke yi mai ma ？]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: Your trust.
translation: 您的信任。 [nin de xin ren 。]

english: No. Regular townsfolk don't like us, which leads us to distrust them and anyone else.
translation: 不。普通城镇居民不喜欢我们，这导致我们不信任他们和其他任何人。 [bu 。 pu tong cheng zhen ju min bu xi huan wo men ， zhe dao zhi wo men bu xin ren ta men he qi ta ren he ren 。]

english: That sounds vile and cruel.
translation: 这听上去卑鄙又残忍。 [zhe ting shang qu bei bi you can ren 。]

english: One more thing...
translation: 还有一件事... [hai you yi jian shi ...]

english: Thanks for your help.
translation: 感谢您的帮助。 [gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]
