translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Alright, I was just trying to be helpful. Why are you so angry?
translation: 好吧，我只是想帮忙。你为什么这么生气？ [hao ba ， wo zhi shi xiang bang mang 。 ni wei shen me zhe me sheng qi ？]

english: Too much talk. Flowers don't talk. Flowers good.
translation: 太多话了。花不会说话。花不错。 [tai duo hua le 。 hua bu hui shuo hua 。 hua bu cuo 。]

english: I'll leave you to it then.
translation: 那我就把它留给你了。 [na wo jiu ba ta liu gei ni le 。]

english: Yous creature doesn't stick mee's chompy, else mee's squeeze creature till yous a deadun!
translation: 你的生物不会粘住我的咀嚼物，否则我的挤压生物直到你死了！ [ni de sheng wu bu hui zhan zhu wo de ju jue wu ， fou ze wo de ji ya sheng wu zhi dao ni si le ！]

english: Yous creatures too weedy for da ogre stabby chucker, yous best stick wiv da cluks-cluks.
translation: 你们这些生物太杂草了，无法对付那些食人魔刺伤的家伙，你们最好用棍子对付棍子。 [ni men zhe xie sheng wu tai za cao le ， wu fa dui fu na xie shi ren mo ci shang de jia huo ， ni men zui hao yong gun zi dui fu gun zi 。]

english: Chompy is bestest yumms...
translation: Chompy 是最好吃的... [Chompy  shi zui hao chi de ...]

english: Me'se can't wait for da chompy yumms...I's dribbling all down me's for da tasty chompy.
translation: 我已经等不及要吃美味的大口饭了……我已经把所有的口水都流到肚子里了，只为了美味的大口大口吃。 [wo yi jing deng bu ji yao chi mei wei de da kou fan le …… wo yi jing ba suo you de kou shui dou liu dao du zi li le ， zhi wei le mei wei de da kou da kou chi 。]

english: Da fatsy toadies geddin' all messy...
translation: 胖子阿谀奉承一切都乱七八糟... [pang zi e yu feng cheng yi qie dou luan qi ba zao ...]

english: Me's gonna ged da pridy chompy hatsies...an looks like a good-un wiv da laydies.
translation: 我要戴上一顶 pridy chompy hatsies...看起来像个好人。 [wo yao dai shang yi ding  pridy chompy hatsies... kan qi lai xiang ge hao ren 。]

english: Mee's scared of Jiggig and da zogries, deyz is not da right dead-uns.
translation: Mee 害怕 Jiggig 和 da zogries，deyz 不是一个真正的死人。 [Mee  hai pa  Jiggig  he  da zogries，deyz  bu shi yi ge zhen zheng de si ren 。]

english: Mee's got no stabbers no more...gonna go home wiv no chompy...
translation: Mee 不再有刺伤者了...要回家了，不再咀嚼... [Mee  bu zai you ci shang zhe le ... yao hui jia le ， bu zai ju jue ...]

english: I's stickin' da chompy...
translation: 我还是很吃力的... [wo hai shi hen chi li de ...]

english: De'se stabbers are worser dan a dead dog....
translation: 这些刺伤者比死狗更糟糕...... [zhe xie ci shang zhe bi si gou geng zao gao ......]

english: Hello?
translation: 你好？ [ni hao ？]

english: A fine day you have chosen to visit this hellish island, human.
translation: 人类，你选择了美好的一天来参观这个地狱般的岛屿。 [ren lei ， ni xuan ze le mei hao de yi tian lai can guan zhe ge di yu ban de dao yu 。]

english: Good day to you too Sergeant. I've been sent by your King Narnode to -
translation: 中士，你也有美好的一天。你们的纳诺德国王派我去—— [zhong shi ， ni ye you mei hao de yi tian 。 ni men de na nuo de guo wang pai wo qu ——]

english: Investigate the circumstances surrounding the mysterious disappearance of my squad. Yes, I know.
translation: 调查我的小队神秘失踪的情况。是的，我知道。 [diao cha wo de xiao dui shen mi shi zong de qing kuang 。 shi de ， wo zhi dao 。]

english: How did you know that?
translation: 你怎么知道的？ [ni zen me zhi dao de ？]

english: The King and I are still in communication, albeit sporadic. I decided I need a human of your calibre to assist me. It is pleasing to see you are still alive.
translation: 我和国王仍然保持着联系，尽管是零星的。我决定我需要像你这样有能力的人来帮助我。很高兴看到你还活着。 [wo he guo wang reng ran bao chi zhe lian xi ， jin guan shi ling xing de 。 wo jue ding wo xu yao xiang ni zhe yang you neng li de ren lai bang zhu wo 。 hen gao xing kan dao ni hai huo zhe 。]

english: Why do you need a human?
translation: 为什么需要人类？ [wei shen me xu yao ren lei ？]

english: There is more going on than meets your eye, human. Did you not find it strange that an entire squad be sent to decommission a shipyard?
translation: 人类，发生的事情比你所看到的还要多。派出整个小队去拆除造船厂，你不觉得奇怪吗？ [ren lei ， fa sheng de shi qing bi ni suo kan dao de hai yao duo 。 pai chu zheng ge xiao dui qu chai chu zao chuan chang ， ni bu jue de qi guai ma ？]

english: Well -
translation: 出色地 - [chu se di  -]

english: Indeed. But there are more pressing matters at hand. Three of my squad have been captured and placed in the jail. They are watched over by somewhat overpowering guards.
translation: 的确。但手头还有更紧迫的事情。我小队的三名成员被抓获并关进监狱。他们受到有些势不可挡的警卫的监视。 [di que 。 dan shou tou hai you geng jin po de shi qing 。 wo xiao dui de san ming cheng yuan bei zhua huo bing guan jin jian yu 。 ta men shou dao you xie shi bu ke dang de jing wei de jian shi 。]

english: Before we can resume our original mission we must rescue them.
translation: 在我们恢复最初的使命之前，我们必须营救他们。 [zai wo men hui fu zui chu de shi ming zhi qian ， wo men bi xu ying jiu ta men 。]

english: I know about the guards - I had to sneak out between the change of shifts.
translation: 我了解警卫的情况——我不得不在换班期间偷偷溜出去。 [wo liao jie jing wei de qing kuang —— wo bu de bu zai huan ban qi jian tou tou liu chu qu 。]

english: Trust me; we too have considered this, but whilst it is possible for one, it is near impossible for three.
translation: 相信我；我们也考虑过这一点，但是虽然对于一个人来说是可能的，但对于三个人来说几乎是不可能的。 [xiang xin wo ； wo men ye kao lv guo zhe yi dian ， dan shi sui ran dui yu yi ge ren lai shuo shi ke neng de ， dan dui yu san ge ren lai shuo ji hu shi bu ke neng de 。]

english: We have considered many things. I have my squad mage and sappers working below us right now. My,  assassin Karam, is operating in the village itself.
translation: 我们考虑了很多事情。我的小队法师和工兵现在在我们下面工作。我的刺客卡拉姆正在村庄里活动。 [wo men kao lv le hen duo shi qing 。 wo de xiao dui fa shi he gong bing xian zai zai wo men xia mian gong zuo 。 wo de ci ke ka la mu zheng zai cun zhuang li huo dong 。]

english: I remain here so that I may overhear Awowogei's plans.
translation: 我留在这里是为了偷听阿沃沃盖的计划。 [wo liu zai zhe li shi wei le tou ting a wo wo gai de ji hua 。]

english: Awowogei?
translation: 阿沃沃盖？ [a wo wo gai ？]

english: The self-proclaimed ruler of the island. I have been listening to him for some time now. I believe we will incur a minimum of casualties if we have an insider - a monkey working for us.
translation: 自封为该岛的统治者。我听他的歌已经有一段时间了。我相信，如果我们有一个内部人士——一只猴子为我们工作，我们会造成最少的伤亡。 [zi feng wei gai dao de tong zhi zhe 。 wo ting ta de ge yi jing you yi duan shi jian le 。 wo xiang xin ， ru guo wo men you yi ge nei bu ren shi —— yi zhi hou zi wei wo men gong zuo ， wo men hui zao cheng zui shao de shang wang 。]

english: Have you seen these monkeys? You could never convince them to work for you!
translation: 你见过这些猴子吗？你永远无法说服他们为你工作！ [ni jian guo zhe xie hou zi ma ？ ni yong yuan wu fa shuo fu ta men wei ni gong zuo ！]

english: I wasn't suggesting convincing them, human, but you.
translation: 我并不是建议说服他们，人类，而是你。 [wo bing bu shi jian yi shuo fu ta men ， ren lei ， er shi ni 。]

english: Don't be ridiculous! I'm a human - not a monkey!
translation: 别开玩笑了！我是人——不是猴子！ [bie kai wan xiao le ！ wo shi ren —— bu shi hou zi ！]

english: Do not be so sceptical ... you humans are considered to be quite closely related to monkeys.
translation: 不要这么怀疑……你们人类被认为与猴子有非常密切的关系。 [bu yao zhe me huai yi …… ni men ren lei bei ren wei yu hou zi you fei chang mi qie de guan xi 。]

english: Yes, but -
translation: 是的，但是—— [shi de ， dan shi ——]

english: Go and see my squad mage, Zooknock. Tell him I have asked you to be 'disguised' as a monkey so that you may infiltrate the village. As you will see, he is something of an expert on the subject.
translation: 去见见我的小队法师祖克诺克。告诉他我让你“伪装”成一只猴子，这样你就可以潜入村庄。正如您将看到的，他是这方面的专家。 [qu jian jian wo de xiao dui fa shi zu ke nuo ke 。 gao su ta wo rang ni “ wei zhuang ” cheng yi zhi hou zi ， zhe yang ni jiu ke yi qian ru cun zhuang 。 zheng ru nin jiang kan dao de ， ta shi zhe fang mian de zhuan jia 。]

english: I can't even communicate with the monkeys!
translation: 我什至无法与猴子交流！ [wo shen zhi wu fa yu hou zi jiao liu ！]

english: Just go and find my squad mage, human.
translation: 去找我的小队法师吧，人类。 [qu zhao wo de xiao dui fa shi ba ， ren lei 。]

english: Have you spoken to Zooknock about the monkey disguise yet?
translation: 你和 Zooknock 谈过关于猴子伪装的事吗？ [ni he  Zooknock  tan guo guan yu hou zi wei zhuang de shi ma ？]

english: Yes - I've now made an amulet of monkey speak and a monkey greegree.
translation: 是的 - 我现在已经制作了一个猴语护身符和一个猴语护身符。 [shi de  -  wo xian zai yi jing zhi zuo le yi ge hou yu hu shen fu he yi ge hou yu hu shen fu 。]

english: Very good. In a moment, speak to me through your monkey disguise so that I may judge how good it is.
translation: 非常好。等一下，用你的猴子伪装来跟我说话，让我判断一下它有多好。 [fei chang hao 。 deng yi xia ， yong ni de hou zi wei zhuang lai gen wo shuo hua ， rang wo pan duan yi xia ta you duo hao 。]

english: My my, Zooknock has outdone himself this time. You do look very much like a monkey you know.
translation: 天啊，祖诺克这次超越了自己。你看起来确实很像一只猴子。 [tian a ， zu nuo ke zhe ci chao yue le zi ji 。 ni kan qi lai que shi hen xiang yi zhi hou zi 。]

english: I know.
translation: 我知道。 [wo zhi dao 。]

english: And by happy coincidence you appear to be just the right sort of monkey.
translation: 巧合的是，你似乎就是合适的猴子类型。 [qiao he de shi ， ni si hu jiu shi he shi de hou zi lei xing 。]

english: I need you now to seek audience with Awowogei. Claim you are an envoy from the monkeys of Karamja and are seeking an alliance.
translation: 我现在需要你去见见阿沃沃盖。声称你是卡拉姆贾猴子的使者，正在寻求联盟。 [wo xian zai xu yao ni qu jian jian a wo wo gai 。 sheng cheng ni shi ka la mu jia hou zi de shi zhe ， zheng zai xun qiu lian meng 。]

english: You must win his trust if we are to succeed.
translation: 如果我们要成功，你就必须赢得他的信任。 [ru guo wo men yao cheng gong ， ni jiu bi xu ying de ta de xin ren 。]

english: Well done on winning Awowogei's trust. I overheard everything from here.
translation: 做得很好，赢得了阿沃沃盖的信任。我从这里偷听到了一切。 [zuo de hen hao ， ying de le a wo wo gai de xin ren 。 wo cong zhe li tou ting dao le yi qie 。]

english: However, your efforts may be in vain...
translation: 然而，你的努力可能会白费…… [ran er ， ni de nu li ke neng hui bai fei ……]

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你是什​​么意思？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: Progress in the caves has been slow. Whilst you were in Ardougne, Bunkwicket and Waymottin overheard a slightly disturbing conversation.
translation: 洞穴的进展缓慢。当你在阿杜涅时，邦克威克特和韦莫丁无意中听到了一场有点令人不安的谈话。 [dong xue de jin zhan huan man 。 dang ni zai a du nie shi ， bang ke wei ke te he wei mo ding wu yi zhong ting dao le yi chang you dian ling ren bu an de tan hua 。]

english: Who was speaking? What was said?
translation: 谁在说话？说了些什么？ [shui zai shuo hua ？ shuo le xie shen me ？]

english: Listen closely whilst I narrate the details...
translation: 当我讲述细节时，请仔细听…… [dang wo jiang shu xi jie shi ， qing zi xi ting ……]

english: What shall we do?
translation: 我们该怎么办？ [wo men gai zen me ban ？]

english: Zooknock and I have come up with a plan.
translation: Zooknock 和我想出了一个计划。 [Zooknock  he wo xiang chu le yi ge ji hua 。]

english: What kind of a plan?
translation: 什么样的计划？ [shen me yang de ji hua ？]

english: I hope you were listening closely. The teleportation spell that was provided will teleport ALL of the 10th squad, no matter where we may be.
translation: 我希望你仔细听。所提供的传送咒语将传送第十小队的所有人，无论我们在哪里。 [wo xi wang ni zi xi ting 。 suo ti gong de chuan song zhou yu jiang chuan song di shi xiao dui de suo you ren ， wu lun wo men zai na li 。]

english: In effect, the spell will break Lumo, Bunkdo and Carado out of the jail for us.
translation: 实际上，该咒语将为我们将 Lumo、Bunkdo 和 Carado 从监狱中释放出来。 [shi ji shang ， gai zhou yu jiang wei wo men jiang  Lumo、Bunkdo  he  Carado  cong jian yu zhong shi fang chu lai 。]

english: But you will be teleported straight into whatever trap they have prepared!
translation: 但你会被直接传送到他们准备的陷阱中！ [dan ni hui bei zhi jie chuan song dao ta men zhun bei de xian jing zhong ！]

english: Indeed. This is where you come in. Do not forget that we are the 10th squad of the Royal Guard, and that we are more than capable of holding our own.
translation: 的确。这就是你的用武之地。别忘了我们是皇家卫队第十小队，我们完全有能力守住自己的阵地。 [di que 。 zhe jiu shi ni de yong wu zhi di 。 bie wang le wo men shi huang jia wei dui di shi xiao dui ， wo men wan quan you neng li shou zhu zi ji de zhen di 。]

english: With your assistance, we should be able to defeat whatever is thrown at us.
translation: 在您的帮助下，我们应该能够击败向我们扔来的任何东西。 [zai nin de bang zhu xia ， wo men ying gai neng gou ji bai xiang wo men reng lai de ren he dong xi 。]

english: But how will I join you?
translation: 但我要怎样加入你们呢？ [dan wo yao zen yang jia ru ni men ne ？]

english: Simple. We fool the teleportation spell that you are in fact a member of our squad.
translation: 简单的。我们欺骗了传送咒语，让你相信你实际上是我们小队的一员。 [jian dan de 。 wo men qi pian le chuan song zhou yu ， rang ni xiang xin ni shi ji shang shi wo men xiao dui de yi yuan 。]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: Zooknock knows Glough's grasp of magic well. He believes that spell is linked to the sigils that all of our squad carry.
translation: 祖诺克非常了解格洛对魔法的掌握。他相信这个咒语与我们所有小队所携带的印记有关。 [zu nuo ke fei chang liao jie ge luo dui mo fa de zhang wo 。 ta xiang xin zhe ge zhou yu yu wo men suo you xiao dui suo xie dai de yin ji you guan 。]

english: It is these sigils that identify us as a member of the squad.
translation: 正是这些标志将我们识别为小队的一员。 [zheng shi zhe xie biao zhi jiang wo men shi bie wei xiao dui de yi yuan 。]

english: Garkor hands you some kind of medallion.
translation: Garkor 递给你某种奖章。 [Garkor  di gei ni mou zhong jiang zhang 。]

english: Welcome to the 10th squad, [player name].
translation: 欢迎来到第十小队，[玩家姓名]。 [huan ying lai dao di shi xiao dui ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: What is it?
translation: 它是什么？ [ta shi shen me ？]

english: It is a replica Waymottin has made of our squad sigils. If you wear that when the spell is cast, you will be summoned along with the rest of us.
translation: 这是韦莫丁用我们的小队徽章制作的复制品。如果你在施法时戴上它，你就会和我们其他人一起被召唤。 [zhe shi wei mo ding yong wo men de xiao dui hui zhang zhi zuo de fu zhi pin 。 ru guo ni zai shi fa shi dai shang ta ， ni jiu hui he wo men qi ta ren yi qi bei zhao huan 。]

english: You should prepare. Collect your thoughts and belongings and then wear the sigil. Hurry, human, we do not wish to enter this fight without you.
translation: 你应该做好准备。收集你的想法和物品，然后佩戴印记。快点，人类，我们不想在没有你的情况下参加这场战斗。 [ni ying gai zuo hao zhun bei 。 shou ji ni de xiang fa he wu pin ， ran hou pei dai yin ji 。 kuai dian ， ren lei ， wo men bu xiang zai mei you ni de qing kuang xia can jia zhe chang zhan dou 。]

english: All I have to do is wear this sigil?
translation: 我所要做的就是戴上这个印记？ [wo suo yao zuo de jiu shi dai shang zhe ge yin ji ？]

english: Yes - but do not do so until you are ready.
translation: 是的 - 但在您准备好之前不要这样做。 [shi de  -  dan zai nin zhun bei hao zhi qian bu yao zhe yang zuo 。]

english: Ready yourself, human: the final battle begins!
translation: 准备好吧，人类：最后的战斗开始了！ [zhun bei hao ba ， ren lei ： zui hou de zhan dou kai shi le ！]

english: Stop talking and start fighting!
translation: 别说话了，开始战斗吧！ [bie shuo hua le ， kai shi zhan dou ba ！]

english: Well done, human! That was a most impressive display of skill.
translation: 干得好，人类！这是最令人印象深刻的技能展示。 [gan de hao ， ren lei ！ zhe shi zui ling ren yin xiang shen ke de ji neng zhan shi 。]

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: You should report to King Narnode immediately. Tell him that the 10th squad still survives and has suffered no casualties.
translation: 你应该立即向纳诺德王报告。告诉他，十班还活着，没有人员伤亡。 [ni ying gai li ji xiang na nuo de wang bao gao 。 gao su ta ， shi ban hai huo zhe ， mei you ren yuan shang wang 。]

english: Rest assured, I will do so. How do I leave this place?
translation: 放心，我一定会这么做的。我该如何离开这个地方？ [fang xin ， wo yi ding hui zhe me zuo de 。 wo gai ru he li kai zhe ge di fang ？]

english: Speak to Zooknock. He will arrange for you to leave.
translation: 与佐诺克交谈。他会安排你离开。 [yu zuo nuo ke jiao tan 。 ta hui an pai ni li kai 。]

english: Greetings, [player name].
translation: 你好，[玩家姓名]。 [ni hao ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Hey Garkor, how's it going?
translation: 嘿，Garkor，怎么样？ [hei ，Garkor， zen me yang ？]

english: Very well. Since the 10th squad were recalled from Ape Atoll, King Narnode has named me new Grand Tree Guardian.
translation: 很好。自从第十小队被从猿环礁召回后，纳诺德国王任命我为新的大树守护者。 [hen hao 。 zi cong di shi xiao dui bei cong yuan huan jiao zhao hui hou ， na nuo de guo wang ren ming wo wei xin de da shu shou hu zhe 。]

english: I believe I speak on behalf of everyone in the Stronghold when I say thank you for stopping Glough. Who knows what would've happened if you weren't there to foil his schemes.
translation: 我相信，当我对你阻止格洛表示感谢时，我代表了要塞中的每个人。如果你不在那里挫败他的计划，谁知道会发生什么。 [wo xiang xin ， dang wo dui ni zu zhi ge luo biao shi gan xie shi ， wo dai biao le yao sai zhong de mei ge ren 。 ru guo ni bu zai na li cuo bai ta de ji hua ， shui zhi dao hui fa sheng shen me 。]

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 尽管您找到了顾客，但您似乎没有带来正确的食物！你需要[一个/一些][订购的侏儒食物/饮料]！ [jin guan nin zhao dao le gu ke ， dan nin si hu mei you dai lai zheng que de shi wu ！ ni xu yao [ yi ge / yi xie ][ ding gou de zhu ru shi wu / yin liao ]！]

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜肴不行。对于 Aluft Aloft 的顾客来说，只有手工制作的 Gnome Cuisine 才足够好。 [kong pa yu zhi cai yao bu xing 。 dui yu  Aluft Aloft  de gu ke lai shuo ， zhi you shou gong zhi zuo de  Gnome Cuisine  cai zu gou hao 。]

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Garkor
translation: 你将[一份/一些][订购的侏儒食物/饮料物品]交给Garkor [ni jiang [ yi fen / yi xie ][ ding gou de zhu ru shi wu / yin liao wu pin ] jiao gei Garkor]

english: Always good to see you again, [player name].
translation: 很高兴再次见到你，[玩家姓名]。 [hen gao xing zai ci jian dao ni ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: I guess you didn't travel far, but since it's you... Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 我猜你并没有旅行太远，但既然是你……这里有一些额外的小费。 [wo cai ni bing mei you lv xing tai yuan ， dan ji ran shi ni …… zhe li you yi xie e wai de xiao fei 。]

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 您有 [number] 个积分用于免费送货令牌。您还没有资格获得侏儒食物。 [nin you  [number]  ge ji fen yong yu mian fei song huo ling pai 。 nin hai mei you zi ge huo de zhu ru shi wu 。]

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 您有 [number] 个积分用于免费送货令牌。您可能会收到 [number] 块侏儒食物。 [nin you  [number]  ge ji fen yong yu mian fei song huo ling pai 。 nin ke neng hui shou dao  [number]  kuai zhu ru shi wu 。]

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 不要忘记从 Aluft Gianne jnr 领取免费送货代币。 [bu yao wang ji cong  Aluft Gianne jnr  ling qu mian fei song huo dai bi 。]

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 你的交货太晚了！返回 Aluft jnr。以获得另一个订单。您丢弃了送货箱，因为您不再需要它了。 [ni de jiao huo tai wan le ！ fan hui  Aluft jnr。 yi huo de ling yi ge ding dan 。 nin diu qi le song huo xiang ， yin wei nin bu zai xu yao ta le 。]

english: Hello there. Don't see many people around here. The name's Garl.
translation: 你好呀。没有看到这里有很多人。我的名字叫加尔。 [ni hao ya 。 mei you kan dao zhe li you hen duo ren 。 wo de ming zi jiao jia er 。]

english: Hey. What are you doing here?
translation: 嘿。你在这里做什么？ [hei 。 ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Exploring. Until that Nomad chap opened things up, this island was abandoned. Who knows what could be hiding here.
translation: 探索。直到那个游牧小伙子打开事情之前，这个岛就被遗弃了。谁知道这里可能藏着什么。 [tan suo 。 zhi dao na ge you mu xiao huo zi da kai shi qing zhi qian ， zhe ge dao jiu bei yi qi le 。 shui zhi dao zhe li ke neng cang zhe shen me 。]

english: Found anything good so far?
translation: 到目前为止发现什么好东西了吗？ [dao mu qian wei zhi fa xian shen me hao dong xi le ma ？]

english: Well there's a dungeon on the east side of the island. I haven't gone too far in though. There's also a tower to the north west, near my camp.
translation: 岛的东边有一个地牢。不过我还没有走得太远。西北边还有一座塔，靠近我的营地。 [dao de dong bian you yi ge di lao 。 bu guo wo hai mei you zou de tai yuan 。 xi bei bian hai you yi zuo ta ， kao jin wo de ying di 。]

english: There's no shortage of resources either. Though there's not really any way to process them. I tried to build a spinning wheel and a pottery wheel myself, but they broke.
translation: 资源也不短缺。尽管实际上没有任何方法可以处理它们。我尝试自己制作一个纺车和一个陶轮，但它们坏了。 [zi yuan ye bu duan que 。 jin guan shi ji shang mei you ren he fang fa ke yi chu li ta men 。 wo chang shi zi ji zhi zuo yi ge fang che he yi ge tao lun ， dan ta men huai le 。]

english: You could really live off the land here. I can think of worse places to do so.
translation: 你真的可以靠这里的土地生活。我能想到更糟糕的地方。 [ni zhen de ke yi kao zhe li de tu di sheng huo 。 wo neng xiang dao geng zao gao de di fang 。]

english: Indeed. It's all very peaceful. And yet...
translation: 的确。一切都很平静。然而…… [di que 。 yi qie dou hen ping jing 。 ran er ……]

english: What is it?
translation: 它是什么？ [ta shi shen me ？]

english: I don't know. Something just seems amiss. There's something sinister about this place. I just don't really know what.
translation: 我不知道。似乎有些不对劲。这个地方有一些不祥的东西。我只是真的不知道是什么。 [wo bu zhi dao 。 si hu you xie bu dui jin 。 zhe ge di fang you yi xie bu xiang de dong xi 。 wo zhi shi zhen de bu zhi dao shi shen me 。]

english: I'm sure it's nothing.
translation: 我确信这没什么。 [wo que xin zhe mei shen me 。]

english: You're probably right. Anyway, I'll let you get on. All the best.
translation: 你可能是对的。无论如何，我都会让你上路。一切顺利。 [ni ke neng shi dui de 。 wu lun ru he ， wo du hui rang ni shang lu 。 yi qie shun li 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Can you tell me about this castle?
translation: 你能告诉我这座城堡吗？ [ni neng gao su wo zhe zuo cheng bao ma ？]

english: It's called Ver Sinhaza. They say it was once the home of a Saradominist queen. Now it belongs to Verzik Vitur, a vampyre noble.
translation: 它的名字叫Ver Sinhaza。他们说这里曾经是萨拉多米主义女王的住所。现在它属于吸血鬼贵族Verzik Vitur。 [ta de ming zi jiao Ver Sinhaza。 ta men shuo zhe li ceng jing shi sa la duo mi zhu yi nv wang de zhu suo 。 xian zai ta shu yu xi xue gui gui zu Verzik Vitur。]

english: Beneath the castle you'll find the Theatre of Blood. Every day, citizens of Meiyerditch take on various challenges set up by Verzik, all the provide entertainment for the vampyres.
translation: 在城堡下面你会发现血剧场。每天，梅耶迪奇的市民都要接受维尔兹克设置的各种挑战，所有这些都为吸血鬼提供了娱乐。 [zai cheng bao xia mian ni hui fa xian xue ju chang 。 mei tian ， mei ye di qi de shi min dou yao jie shou wei er zi ke she zhi de ge zhong tiao zhan ， suo you zhe xie dou wei xi xue gui ti gong le yu le 。]

english: The citizens don't need to be forced though. Anyone who survives the Theatre is promised freedom from the vampyres. It provides a little bit of hope in this dark place.
translation: 但公民不需要被迫。任何在剧院幸存下来的人都会被许诺摆脱吸血鬼的束缚。它为这个黑暗的地方带来了一点希望。 [dan gong min bu xu yao bei po 。 ren he zai ju yuan xing cun xia lai de ren du hui bei xu nuo bai tuo xi xue gui de shu fu 。 ta wei zhe ge hei an de di fang dai lai le yi dian xi wang 。]

english: Do you know anything about the Myreque?
translation: 你对迈瑞克了解多少吗？ [ni dui mai rui ke liao jie duo shao ma ？]

english: I do. I'd rather not talk about them though. Those kinds of conversations get you in trouble.
translation: 我愿意。但我宁愿不谈论它们。这类谈话会给你带来麻烦。 [wo yuan yi 。 dan wo ning yuan bu tan lun ta men 。 zhe lei tan hua hui gei ni dai lai ma fan 。]

english: Old Man Ral might be willing to talk to you about them though. He lives in sector one of Meiyerditch, directly west of here.
translation: 不过，拉尔老人可能愿意和你谈论它们。他住在梅耶迪奇一区，就在这儿的西边。 [bu guo ， la er lao ren ke neng yuan yi he ni tan lun ta men 。 ta zhu zai mei ye di qi yi qu ， jiu zai zhe er de xi bian 。]

english: Can you tell me about the Sanguinesti region?
translation: 您能告诉我有关桑吉内什蒂地区的情况吗？ [nin neng gao su wo you guan sang ji nei shen di di qu de qing kuang ma ？]

english: Yep, that's where wee are at the moment. The region is split into two cities, Meiyerditch in the south and Darkmeyer in the north.
translation: 是的，这就是我们现在所处的位置。该地区分为两个城市，南部的迈耶迪奇和北部的达克迈耶。 [shi de ， zhe jiu shi wo men xian zai suo chu de wei zhi 。 gai di qu fen wei liang ge cheng shi ， nan bu de mai ye di qi he bei bu de da ke mai ye 。]

english: Meiyerditch is just one large ghetto. The city is split into sectors so that the vampyres can collect blood tithes on a rotational basis. That way they don't kill everyone off in one go.
translation: 梅耶迪奇只是一个大型贫民窟。这座城市被分成几个部分，以便吸血鬼可以轮流收集血液什一税。这样他们就不会一次性杀死所有人。 [mei ye di qi zhi shi yi ge da xing pin min ku 。 zhe zuo cheng shi bei fen cheng ji ge bu fen ， yi bian xi xue gui ke yi lun liu shou ji xue ye shen yi shui 。 zhe yang ta men jiu bu hui yi ci xing sha si suo you ren 。]

english: Darkmeyer is the vampyre capital. Humans aren't allowed there unless they're a personal slave of some lord or lady. They say the vampyres there live very luxurious lifestyles.
translation: 达克梅尔是吸血鬼之都。人类不允许进入那里，除非他们是某个领主或女士的私人奴隶。他们说那里的吸血鬼过着非常奢侈的生活方式。 [da ke mei er shi xi xue gui zhi dou 。 ren lei bu yun xu jin ru na li ， chu fei ta men shi mou ge ling zhu huo nv shi de si ren nu li 。 ta men shuo na li de xi xue gui guo zhe fei chang she chi de sheng huo fang shi 。]

english: What do you know about the vampyres?
translation: 关于吸血鬼你了解多少？ [guan yu xi xue gui ni liao jie duo shao ？]

english: Not much really. There seems to be three main types, juveniles, juvinates and vy*res.
translation: 真的不多。似乎有三种主要类型：少年型、幼年型和维*雷斯型。 [zhen de bu duo 。 si hu you san zhong zhu yao lei xing ： shao nian xing 、 you nian xing he wei * lei si xing 。]

english: Juveniles seem to be the lowest form of the vampyre. No one around here knows for sure but the general consensus is that they're former humans who've been converted in some way.
translation: 少年似乎是吸血鬼的最低形态。这里没有人确切知道，但普遍的共识是他们以前是人类，但以某种方式转变了。 [shao nian si hu shi xi xue gui de zui di xing tai 。 zhe li mei you ren que qie zhi dao ， dan pu bian de gong shi shi ta men yi qian shi ren lei ， dan yi mou zhong fang shi zhuan bian le 。]

english: Juvinates are initiated juveniles who've had some training and are starting to gain some powers.
translation: 幼年者是接受过一些训练并开始获得一些力量的幼年者。 [you nian zhe shi jie shou guo yi xie xun lian bing kai shi huo de yi xie li liang de you nian zhe 。]

english: Then you have the vyres. Very nasty and very powerful. I wouldn't get on the wrong side of one if I were you.
translation: 然后你就有了 vyres。非常讨厌而且非常强大。如果我是你，我就不会站在错误的一边。 [ran hou ni jiu you le  vyres。 fei chang tao yan er qie fei chang qiang da 。 ru guo wo shi ni ， wo jiu bu hui zhan zai cuo wu de yi bian 。]

english: What do you know about Drakan?
translation: 你对德拉坎了解多少？ [ni dui de la kan liao jie duo shao ？]

english: Vanescula?
translation: 瓦内斯库拉？ [wa nei si ku la ？]

english: Well, I was referring to the main Drakan, you know, the overlord of Morytania.
translation: 嗯，我指的是主要的德拉坎，你知道，莫里塔尼亚的霸主。 [n ， wo zhi de shi zhu yao de de la kan ， ni zhi dao ， mo li ta ni ya de ba zhu 。]

english: Hmm, nothing has been seen of him for many years now. You can occasionally see Vanescula flying about, but not too often.
translation: 嗯，已经很多年没有见过他了。您偶尔可以看到瓦内斯库拉飞来飞去，但不是太频繁。 [n ， yi jing hen duo nian mei you jian guo ta le 。 nin ou er ke yi kan dao wa nei si ku la fei lai fei qu ， dan bu shi tai pin fan 。]

english: Can you tell me about this castle?
translation: 你能告诉我这座城堡吗？ [ni neng gao su wo zhe zuo cheng bao ma ？]

english: Do you know anything about the Myreque?
translation: 你对迈瑞克了解多少吗？ [ni dui mai rui ke liao jie duo shao ma ？]

english: Can you tell me about the Sanguinesti region?
translation: 您能告诉我有关桑吉内什蒂地区的情况吗？ [nin neng gao su wo you guan sang ji nei shen di di qu de qing kuang ma ？]

english: What do you know about the vampyres?
translation: 关于吸血鬼你了解多少？ [guan yu xi xue gui ni liao jie duo shao ？]

english: What do you know about Drakan?
translation: 你对德拉坎了解多少？ [ni dui de la kan liao jie duo shao ？]

english: Hello. What do you want?
translation: 你好。你想要什么？ [ni hao 。 ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: I want for nothing!
translation: 我什么都不想要！ [wo shen me dou bu xiang yao ！]

english: You're one of a very lucky few then.
translation: 那么你就是非常幸运的少数人之一。 [na me ni jiu shi fei chang xing yun de shao shu ren zhi yi 。]

english: Look who it is!
translation: 看看是谁！ [kan kan shi shui ！]

english: Hello again. How are things going?
translation: 又好。进展如何？ [you hao 。 jin zhan ru he ？]

english: Amazing! We get paid to eat all day, and our payment is more food. Life has never been better!
translation: 惊人的！我们整天吃饭都是有报酬的，而我们的报酬就是更多的食物。生活从未如此美好！ [jing ren de ！ wo men zheng tian chi fan dou shi you bao chou de ， er wo men de bao chou jiu shi geng duo de shi wu 。 sheng huo cong wei ru ci mei hao ！]

english: Too right, Gary! This is much better than being on strike!
translation: 太对了，加里！这比罢工好多了！ [tai dui le ， jia li ！ zhe bi ba gong hao duo le ！]

english: Glad to hear it.
translation: 很高兴听到这个消息。 [hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi 。]

english: What happened to the old man who used to be the doorman?
translation: 曾经担任门卫的老人后来怎么样了？ [ceng jing dan ren men wei de lao ren hou lai zen me yang le ？]

english: You mean my father? He went into retirement, I've taken over the family business instead.
translation: 你是说我父亲吗？他退休了，我接手了家族生意。 [ni shi shuo wo fu qin ma ？ ta tui xiu le ， wo jie shou le jia zu sheng yi 。]

english: Your father! But you don't look anything like him!
translation: 你的父亲！但你长得一点也不像他！ [ni de fu qin ！ dan ni zhang de yi dian ye bu xiang ta ！]

english: No, fortunately for me I inherited my good looks from my mother.
translation: 不，幸运的是我遗传了妈妈的美貌。 [bu ， xing yun de shi wo yi chuan le ma ma de mei mao 。]

english: Sorry, we cannot allow you to bring those sacks into the market for security reason.
translation: 抱歉，出于安全原因，我们不允许您将这些麻袋带入市场。 [bao qian ， chu yu an quan yuan yin ， wo men bu yun xu nin jiang zhe xie ma dai dai ru shi chang 。]

english: You may not pass through this door without paying the trading tax.
translation: 不缴纳交易税，你就不能踏进这扇门。 [bu jiao na jiao yi shui ， ni jiu bu neng ta jin zhe shan men 。]

english: So how much is the tax?
translation: 那么税费是多少呢？ [na me shui fei shi duo shao ne ？]

english: The cost is one diamond.
translation: 成本是一颗钻石。 [cheng ben shi yi ke zuan shi 。]

english: Okay...
translation: 好的... [hao de ...]

english: I haven't brought my diamonds with me.
translation: 我没带钻石。 [wo mei dai zuan shi 。]

english: No tax, no entry.
translation: 没有税，没有入境。 [mei you shui ， mei you ru jing 。]

english: A diamond? Are you crazy?
translation: 钻石？你疯了？ [zuan shi ？ ni feng le ？]

english: Not at all. Those are the rules.
translation: 一点也不。这些就是规则。 [yi dian ye bu 。 zhe xie jiu shi gui ze 。]

english: What do you do with all the diamonds you get?
translation: 您如何处理获得的所有钻石？ [nin ru he chu li huo de de suo you zuan shi ？]

english: Ever heard of fairylights? Well how do you think we make 'em? First we collect a pile of gems and then we get a spider to spin 'em into a long web, we light the jewels by imbuing each one with a little bit of magic.
translation: 听说过仙光吗？那么你认为我们如何制作它们？首先，我们收集一堆宝石，然后让蜘蛛将它们纺成一张长网，我们通过为每颗宝石注入一点魔法来点燃宝石。 [ting shuo guo xian guang ma ？ na me ni ren wei wo men ru he zhi zuo ta men ？ shou xian ， wo men shou ji yi dui bao shi ， ran hou rang zhi zhu jiang ta men fang cheng yi zhang zhang wang ， wo men tong guo wei mei ke bao shi zhu ru yi dian mo fa lai dian ran bao shi 。]

english: So you're telling me fairylights are made out of gems?
translation: 所以你是说仙女灯是由宝石制成的？ [suo yi ni shi shuo xian nv deng shi you bao shi zhi cheng de ？]

english: That's right, how else could we make 'em twinkle so beautifully?
translation: 是的，不然我们怎么能让它们闪烁得如此美丽呢？ [shi de ， bu ran wo men zen me neng rang ta men shan shuo de ru ci mei li ne ？]

english: Do you know what these strange marks mean?
translation: 你知道这些奇怪的标记意味着什么吗？ [ni zhi dao zhe xie qi guai de biao ji yi wei zhe shen me ma ？]

english: No I don't and I'm trying to work here. Please stop distracting me!
translation: 不，我不喜欢，我正在努力在这里工作。请别再分散我的注意力了！ [bu ， wo bu xi huan ， wo zheng zai nu li zai zhe li gong zuo 。 qing bie zai fen san wo de zhu yi li le ！]

english: What are you doing all the way over here? Shouldn't you be at the market door?
translation: 你千里迢迢来这里做什么？你不是应该在市场门口吗？ [ni qian li tiao tiao lai zhe li zuo shen me ？ ni bu shi ying gai zai shi chang men kou ma ？]

english: Yes, that's my usual spot, but the Godfather said I should be here, so here I am.
translation: 是的，那是我常去的地方，但教父说我应该在这里，所以我就在这里。 [shi de ， na shi wo chang qu de di fang ， dan jiao fu shuo wo ying gai zai zhe li ， suo yi wo jiu zai zhe li 。]

english: Hello, did you just come from the market gates? Are my brothers doing their job well? I do worry that they'll start letting people into the market for free without me being there to supervise them!
translation: 你好，请问你是刚从市场门口出来吗？我的兄弟们的工作做得好吗？我确实担心他们会开始免费让人们进入市场而不需要我在那里监督他们！ [ni hao ， qing wen ni shi gang cong shi chang men kou chu lai ma ？ wo de xiong di men de gong zuo zuo de hao ma ？ wo que shi dan xin ta men hui kai shi mian fei rang ren men jin ru shi chang er bu xu yao wo zai na li jian du ta men ！]

english: I'm afraid nobody is allowed in there, orders from the boss.
translation: 恐怕没有人可以进去，这是老板的命令。 [kong pa mei you ren ke yi jin qu ， zhe shi lao ban de ming ling 。]

english: I've received orders to let you through if you want. Good luck.
translation: 我已收到命令，如果你愿意的话，我会放你过去的。祝你好运。 [wo yi shou dao ming ling ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo hui fang ni guo qu de 。 zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: You squeeze past the thorny vines into a small tunnel.
translation: 你挤过带刺的藤蔓，进入一条小隧道。 [ni ji guo dai ci de teng wan ， jin ru yi tiao xiao sui dao 。]

english: Be careful in there, there are still some of those baby Tanglefootii around.
translation: 小心点，周围还有一些小缠足。 [xiao xin dian ， zhou wei hai you yi xie xiao chan zu 。]

english: You find the Queen's secateurs!
translation: 你找到了女王的修枝刀！ [ni zhao dao le nv wang de xiu zhi dao ！]

english: Okay...
translation: 好的... [hao de ...]

english: A diamond? Are you crazy?
translation: 钻石？你疯了？ [zuan shi ？ ni feng le ？]

english: I haven't brought my diamonds with me.
translation: 我没带钻石。 [wo mei dai zuan shi 。]

english: What do you do with all the diamonds you get?
translation: 您如何处理获得的所有钻石？ [nin ru he chu li huo de de suo you zuan shi ？]

english: I say, I say, a toast to this fine human!
translation: 我说，我说，为这位优秀的人干杯！ [wo shuo ， wo shuo ， wei zhe wei you xiu de ren gan bei ！]

english: What? I mean, err... why?
translation: 什么？我的意思是，呃……为什么？ [shen me ？ wo de yi si shi ， e …… wei shen me ？]

english: Why not!
translation: 为什么不呢！ [wei shen me bu ne ！]

english: I don't have anything suitable to toast with.
translation: 我没有什么适合敬酒的东西。 [wo mei you shen me shi he jing jiu de dong xi 。]

english: Then go get something from the bar!
translation: 那就去酒吧买点东西吧！ [na jiu qu jiu ba mai dian dong xi ba ！]

english: Hello there, can I help you?
translation: 您好，请问有什么可以帮到您吗？ [nin hao ， qing wen you shen me ke yi bang dao nin ma ？]

english: Where am I?
translation: 我在哪里？ [wo zai na li ？]

english: This is the town of Lumbridge my friend.
translation: 我的朋友，这是伦布里奇镇。 [wo de peng you ， zhe shi lun bu li qi zhen 。]

english: How are you today?
translation: 你今天怎么样？ [ni jin tian zen me yang ？]

english: Aye, not too bad thank you. Lovely weather in Gielinor this fine day.
translation: 是的，还不错，谢谢。今天吉林诺天气很好。 [shi de ， hai bu cuo ， xie xie 。 jin tian ji lin nuo tian qi hen hao 。]

english: Weather?
translation: 天气？ [tian qi ？]

english: Yes weather, you know.
translation: 是的，天气，你知道。 [shi de ， tian qi ， ni zhi dao 。]

english: The state or condition of the atmosphere at a time and place, with respect to variables such as temperature, moisture, wind velocity, and barometric pressure.
translation: 某个时间和地点的大气状态或条件，涉及温度、湿度、风速和气压等变量。 [mou ge shi jian he di dian de da qi zhuang tai huo tiao jian ， she ji wen du 、 shi du 、 feng su he qi ya deng bian liang 。]

english: Not just a pretty face eh? Ha ha ha.
translation: 不只是一张漂亮的脸蛋吧？哈哈哈。 [bu zhi shi yi zhang piao liang de lian dan ba ？ ha ha ha 。]

english: Do you know of any quests I can do?
translation: 你知道我可以做哪些任务吗？ [ni zhi dao wo ke yi zuo na xie ren wu ma ？]

english: What kind of quest are you looking for?
translation: 您在寻找什么样的任务？ [nin zai xun zhao shen me yang de ren wu ？]

english: Hmm.. dangerous you say? What sort of creatures are you looking to fight?
translation: 嗯..你说危险吗？你想与什么样的生物战斗？ [n .. ni shuo wei xian ma ？ ni xiang yu shen me yang de sheng wu zhan dou ？]

english: Big scary demons!
translation: 可怕的大恶魔！ [ke pa de da e mo ！]

english: You are a brave soul indeed.
translation: 你确实是一个勇敢的灵魂。 [ni que shi shi yi ge yong gan de ling hun 。]

english: Now that you mention it, I heard a rumour about a fortune-teller in Varrock who is rambling about some kind of greater evil.. sounds demon-like if you ask me.
translation: 既然你提到了，我听到了一个关于瓦罗克的算命师的谣言，他正在散布某种更大的邪恶……如果你问我的话，听起来就像恶魔一样。 [ji ran ni ti dao le ， wo ting dao le yi ge guan yu wa luo ke de suan ming shi de yao yan ， ta zheng zai san bu mou zhong geng da de xie e …… ru guo ni wen wo de hua ， ting qi lai jiu xiang e mo yi yang 。]

english: Perhaps you could check it out if you are as brave as you say?
translation: 如果你像你说的那么勇敢的话，也许你可以去看看？ [ru guo ni xiang ni shuo de na me yong gan de hua ， ye xu ni ke yi qu kan kan ？]

english: Thanks for the tip, perhaps I will.
translation: 谢谢你的提示，也许我会的。 [xie xie ni de ti shi ， ye xu wo hui de 。]

english: I've already killed the demon Delrith. He was merely a stain on my sword when I was finished with him!
translation: 我已经杀死了恶魔德里斯。当我和他结束时，他只是我剑上的一个污点！ [wo yi jing sha si le e mo de li si 。 dang wo he ta jie shu shi ， ta zhi shi wo jian shang de yi ge wu dian ！]

english: Well done! However I'm sure if you search around the world you will find more challenging foes to slay.
translation: 干得好！然而，我确信如果你环游世界，你会发现更具挑战性的敌人来杀死。 [gan de hao ！ ran er ， wo que xin ru guo ni huan you shi jie ， ni hui fa xian geng ju tiao zhan xing de di ren lai sha si 。]

english: Vampyres!
translation: 吸血鬼！ [xi xue gui ！]

english: Ha ha. I personally don't believe in such things. However, there is a man in Draynor Village who has been scaring the village folk with stories of vampyres.
translation: 哈哈。我个人不相信这样的事情。然而，德拉诺村里有一个人，他一直用吸血鬼的故事来吓唬村民。 [ha ha 。 wo ge ren bu xiang xin zhe yang de shi qing 。 ran er ， de la nuo cun li you yi ge ren ， ta yi zhi yong xi xue gui de gu shi lai xia hu cun min 。]

english: He's named Morgan and can be found in one of the village houses. Perhaps you could see what the matter is?
translation: 他的名字叫摩根，可以在其中一栋村屋里找到他。或许你能看出问题出在哪里？ [ta de ming zi jiao mo gen ， ke yi zai qi zhong yi dong cun wu li zhao dao ta 。 huo xu ni neng kan chu wen ti chu zai na li ？]

english: Thanks for the tip.
translation: 谢谢你的提示。 [xie xie ni de ti shi 。]

english: Oh I have already killed that nasty blood-sucking vampyre. Draynor will be safe now.
translation: 哦，我已经杀了那个可恶的吸血吸血鬼了。德雷诺现在安全了。 [o ， wo yi jing sha le na ge ke wu de xi xue xi xue gui le 。 de lei nuo xian zai an quan le 。]

english: Yeah, yeah of course you did. Everyone knows vampyres are not real....
translation: 是的，是的，你当然这么做了。大家都知道吸血鬼不是真的...... [shi de ， shi de ， ni dang ran zhe me zuo le 。 da jia dou zhi dao xi xue gui bu shi zhen de ......]

english: What! I did slay the beast..I really did.
translation: 什么！我确实杀死了野兽……我真的做到了。 [shen me ！ wo que shi sha si le ye shou …… wo zhen de zuo dao le 。]

english: You're not fooling anyone you know.
translation: 你不会欺骗任何你认识的人。 [ni bu hui qi pian ren he ni ren shi de ren 。]

english: ..Huh.. But... Hey! I did... believe what you like.
translation: ..嗯..但是...嘿！我确实...相信你喜欢的。 [.. n .. dan shi ... hei ！ wo que shi ... xiang xin ni xi huan de 。]

english: Small.. something small would be good.
translation: 小..小东西就好了。 [xiao .. xiao dong xi jiu hao le 。]

english: Small? Small isn't really that dangerous though is it?
translation: 小的？虽然小，但其实并没有那么危险，不是吗？ [xiao de ？ sui ran xiao ， dan qi shi bing mei you na me wei xian ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Yes it can be! There could be anything from an evil chicken to a poisonous spider. They attack in numbers you know!
translation: 是的，可以！可能有任何东西，从邪恶的鸡到毒蜘蛛。他们的攻击数量你知道！ [shi de ， ke yi ！ ke neng you ren he dong xi ， cong xie e de ji dao du zhi zhu 。 ta men de gong ji shu liang ni zhi dao ！]

english: Yes ok, point taken. Speaking of small monsters, I hear old Wizard Mizgog in the wizards' tower has just had all his beads taken by a gang of mischievous imps.
translation: 是的，好的，已采纳。说到小怪物，我听说巫师塔里的老巫师米兹戈格刚刚被一群淘气的小鬼夺走了所有的珠子。 [shi de ， hao de ， yi cai na 。 shuo dao xiao guai wu ， wo ting shuo wu shi ta li de lao wu shi mi zi ge ge gang gang bei yi qun tao qi de xiao gui duo zou le suo you de zhu zi 。]

english: Sounds like it could be a quest for you?
translation: 听起来这对你来说可能是一个任务？ [ting qi lai zhe dui ni lai shuo ke neng shi yi ge ren wu ？]

english: Thanks for your help.
translation: 感谢您的帮助。 [gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]

english: Yes I know of Mizgog and have already helped him with his imp problem. It took me ages to find those beads!
translation: 是的，我知道米兹戈格，并且已经帮助他解决了小鬼的问题。我花了很长时间才找到那些珠子！ [shi de ， wo zhi dao mi zi ge ge ， bing qie yi jing bang zhu ta jie jue le xiao gui de wen ti 。 wo hua le hen zhang shi jian cai zhao dao na xie zhu zi ！]

english: Imps will be imps!
translation: 小鬼将是小鬼！ [xiao gui jiang shi xiao gui ！]

english: Maybe another time.
translation: 也许下次吧。 [ye xu xia ci ba 。]

english: Something easy please, I'm new here.
translation: 请简单一点，我是新来的。 [qing jian dan yi dian ， wo shi xin lai de 。]

english: I can tell you about plenty of small easy tasks.
translation: 我可以告诉你很多简单的小任务。 [wo ke yi gao su ni hen duo jian dan de xiao ren wu 。]

english: The Lumbridge cook has been having problems, the Duke is confused over some strange talisman and on top of all that, poor lad Romeo in Varrock has girlfriend problems.
translation: 朗布里奇的厨师遇到了问题，公爵对一些奇怪的护身符感到困惑，最重要的是，瓦罗克的可怜的罗密欧小伙子有女朋友的问题。 [lang bu li qi de chu shi yu dao le wen ti ， gong jue dui yi xie qi guai de hu shen fu gan dao kun huo ， zui zhong yao de shi ， wa luo ke de ke lian de luo mi ou xiao huo zi you nv peng you de wen ti 。]

english: Tell me about the Lumbridge cook.
translation: 告诉我关于伦布里奇厨师的事。 [gao su wo guan yu lun bu li qi chu shi de shi 。]

english: It's funny really, the cook would forget his head if it wasn't screwed on. This time he forgot to get ingredients for the Duke's birthday cake.
translation: 真的很有趣，如果不拧紧，厨师就会忘记他的头。这次他忘记去拿公爵生日蛋糕的材料了。 [zhen de hen you qu ， ru guo bu ning jin ， chu shi jiu hui wang ji ta de tou 。 zhe ci ta wang ji qu na gong jue sheng ri dan gao de cai liao le 。]

english: Perhaps you could help him? You will probably find him in the Lumbridge Castle kitchen.
translation: 也许你可以帮助他？您可能会在朗布里奇城堡的厨房里找到他。 [ye xu ni ke yi bang zhu ta ？ nin ke neng hui zai lang bu li qi cheng bao de chu fang li zhao dao ta 。]

english: Thank you. I shall go speak with him.
translation: 谢谢。我去跟他谈谈。 [xie xie 。 wo qu gen ta tan tan 。]

english: I have already helped the cook in Lumbridge.
translation: 我已经帮过朗布里奇的厨师了。 [wo yi jing bang guo lang bu li qi de chu shi le 。]

english: Oh yes, so you have. I am sure the Duke will be pleased.
translation: 哦，是的，所以你有。我相信公爵会很高兴。 [o ， shi de ， suo yi ni you 。 wo xiang xin gong jue hui hen gao xing 。]

english: Tell me about the Duke's strange talisman.
translation: 告诉我关于公爵的奇怪护身符的事。 [gao su wo guan yu gong jue de qi guai hu shen fu de shi 。]

english: Well the Duke of Lumbridge has found a strange talisman that no one seems to understand. Perhaps you could help him? You can probably find him upstairs in Lumbridge Castle.
translation: 朗布里奇公爵发现了一种似乎没有人理解的奇怪护身符。也许你可以帮助他？你也许可以在朗布里奇城堡的楼上找到他。 [lang bu li qi gong jue fa xian le yi zhong si hu mei you ren li jie de qi guai hu shen fu 。 ye xu ni ke yi bang zhu ta ？ ni ye xu ke yi zai lang bu li qi cheng bao de lou shang zhao dao ta 。]

english: Sounds mysterious. I may just do that. Thanks.
translation: 听起来很神秘。我可能就这么做了。谢谢。 [ting qi lai hen shen mi 。 wo ke neng jiu zhe me zuo le 。 xie xie 。]

english: Yes, I have already solved the Rune mysteries.
translation: 是的，我已经解开了符文之谜。 [shi de ， wo yi jing jie kai le fu wen zhi mi 。]

english: Ah excellent. Thank you very much adventurer.
translation: 啊，太棒了。非常感谢冒险家。 [a ， tai bang le 。 fei chang gan xie mao xian jia 。]

english: Tell me about Romeo and his girlfriend please.
translation: 请告诉我关于罗密欧和他女朋友的事。 [qing gao su wo guan yu luo mi ou he ta nv peng you de shi 。]

english: Romeo in Varrock needs help with finding his beloved Juliet, you may be able to help him out.
translation: 瓦罗克的罗密欧需要帮助寻找他心爱的朱丽叶，你也许可以帮助他。 [wa luo ke de luo mi ou xu yao bang zhu xun zhao ta xin ai de zhu li ye ， ni ye xu ke yi bang zhu ta 。]

english: Unless of course you manage to find Juliet first in which case she has probably lost Romeo.
translation: 当然，除非你先找到朱丽叶，否则她可能已经失去了罗密欧。 [dang ran ， chu fei ni xian zhao dao zhu li ye ， fou ze ta ke neng yi jing shi qu le luo mi ou 。]

english: Right, ok. Romeo is in Varrock?
translation: 对吧，好吧。罗密欧在瓦罗克？ [dui ba ， hao ba 。 luo mi ou zai wa luo ke ？]

english: Yes you can't miss him, he's wandering aimlessly in the square.
translation: 是的，你不会错过他的，他正在广场上漫无目的地闲逛。 [shi de ， ni bu hui cuo guo ta de ， ta zheng zai guang chang shang man wu mu di di xian guang 。]

english: Oh yes, I've already helped Romeo in the best possible way I can...
translation: 哦，是的，我已经尽我所能帮助罗密欧了…… [o ， shi de ， wo yi jing jin wo suo neng bang zhu luo mi ou le ……]

english: Really?
translation: 真的吗？ [zhen de ma ？]

english: Yup.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: ...How?
He thinks Juliet is dead...
translation: 他认为朱丽叶已经死了…… [ta ren wei zhu li ye yi jing si le ……]

english: Well.. ok.. well done... I think...
translation: 嗯..好吧..干得好...我想... [n .. hao ba .. gan de hao ... wo xiang ...]

english: I'm a thinker rather than fighter, anything skill orientated?
translation: 我是一个思想家而不是战士，有什么以技能为导向的吗？ [wo shi yi ge si xiang jia er bu shi zhan shi ， you shen me yi ji neng wei dao xiang de ma ？]

english: Skills play a big part when you want to progress in knowledge throughout Gielinor. I know of a few skill- related quests that can get you started.
translation: 当您想在 Gielinor 的知识中取得进步时，技能发挥着重要作用。我知道一些与技能相关的任务可以帮助你入门。 [dang nin xiang zai  Gielinor  de zhi shi zhong qu de jin bu shi ， ji neng fa hui zhuo zhong yao zuo yong 。 wo zhi dao yi xie yu ji neng xiang guan de ren wu ke yi bang zhu ni ru men 。]

english: You may be able to help out Fred the farmer who is in need of someones crafting expertise.
translation: 您也许可以帮助需要手工专业知识的农民弗雷德。 [nin ye xu ke yi bang zhu xu yao shou gong zhuan ye zhi shi de nong min fu lei de 。]

english: Or, there's always Doric the dwarf who needs an errand running for him?
translation: 或者，矮人多里克总是需要为他办事？ [huo zhe ， ai ren duo li ke zong shi xu yao wei ta ban shi ？]

english: Tell me about Fred the farmer please.
translation: 请告诉我关于农民弗雷德的事。 [qing gao su wo guan yu nong min fu lei de de shi 。]

english: You can find Fred next to the field of sheep in Lumbridge. Perhaps you should go and speak with him.
translation: 您可以在朗布里奇的羊场旁边找到弗雷德。也许你应该去和他谈谈。 [nin ke yi zai lang bu li qi de yang chang pang bian zhao dao fu lei de 。 ye xu ni ying gai qu he ta tan tan 。]

english: Thanks, maybe I will.
translation: 谢谢，也许我会的。 [xie xie ， ye xu wo hui de 。]

english: I have already helped Fred the farmer. I sheared his sheep and made 20 balls of wool for him.
translation: 我已经帮助过农夫弗雷德了。我给他剪了羊毛，还给他做了20个羊毛球。 [wo yi jing bang zhu guo nong fu fu lei de le 。 wo gei ta jian le yang mao ， huan gei ta zuo le 20 ge yang mao qiu 。]

english: He wouldn't let me kill his chickens though.
translation: 但他不让我杀他的鸡。 [dan ta bu rang wo sha ta de ji 。]

english: Lumbridge chickens do make good target practice.
translation: 伦布里奇鸡确实能进行良好的打靶练习。 [lun bu li qi ji que shi neng jin xing liang hao de da ba lian xi 。]

english: You will have to wait until he isn't looking.
translation: 你必须等到他不看为止。 [ni bi xu deng dao ta bu kan wei zhi 。]

english: Tell me about Doric the dwarf.
translation: 告诉我关于矮人多立克的事情。 [gao su wo guan yu ai ren duo li ke de shi qing 。]

english: Doric the dwarf is located north of Falador. He might be able to help you with smithing. You should speak to him. He may let you use his anvils.
translation: 矮人多立克柱位于法拉多以北。他也许可以帮助你锻造。你应该和他谈谈。他可能会让你使用他的铁砧。 [ai ren duo li ke zhu wei yu fa la duo yi bei 。 ta ye xu ke yi bang zhu ni duan zao 。 ni ying gai he ta tan tan 。 ta ke neng hui rang ni shi yong ta de tie zhen 。]

english: Yes, I've been to see Doric already. He was happy to let me use his anvils after I ran a small errand for him.
translation: 是的，我已经去过多里克了。在我帮他办了一件小事后，他很高兴让我使用他的铁砧。 [shi de ， wo yi jing qu guo duo li ke le 。 zai wo bang ta ban le yi jian xiao shi hou ， ta hen gao xing rang wo shi yong ta de tie zhen 。]

english: Oh good, Thank you [player name]!
translation: 哦，太好了，谢谢你[玩家姓名]！ [o ， tai hao le ， xie xie ni [ wan jia xing ming ]！]

english: I want to do all kinds of things, do you know of anything like that?
translation: 我想做各种各样的事情，你知道类似的事情吗？ [wo xiang zuo ge zhong ge yang de shi qing ， ni zhi dao lei si de shi qing ma ？]

english: Of course I do. Gielinor is a huge place you know, now let me think...
translation: 我当然知道。你知道吉林诺是一个很大的地方，现在让我想想...... [wo dang ran zhi dao 。 ni zhi dao ji lin nuo shi yi ge hen da de di fang ， xian zai rang wo xiang xiang ......]

english: Hetty the witch in Rimmington might be able to offer help in the ways of magical abilities..
translation: 里明顿的女巫海蒂也许能够以魔法能力的方式提供帮助。 [li ming dun de nv wu hai di ye xu neng gou yi mo fa neng li de fang shi ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: Also, pirates are currently docked in Port Sarim, Where pirates are, treasure is never far away...
translation: 而且，海盗目前停靠在沙里姆港，海盗所在的地方，宝藏就离你不远…… [er qie ， hai dao mu qian ting kao zai sha li mu gang ， hai dao suo zai de di fang ， bao zang jiu li ni bu yuan ……]

english: Or you could go help out Ernest who got lost in Draynor Manor, spooky place that.
translation: 或者你可以去帮助在德雷纳庄园迷路的欧内斯特，那是一个令人毛骨悚然的地方。 [huo zhe ni ke yi qu bang zhu zai de lei na zhuang yuan mi lu de ou nei si te ， na shi yi ge ling ren mao gu song ran de di fang 。]

english: Tell me about Hetty the witch.
translation: 告诉我关于女巫海蒂的事。 [gao su wo guan yu nv wu hai di de shi 。]

english: Hetty the witch can be found in Rimmington, south of Falador. She's currently working on some new potions. Perhaps you could give her a hand? She might be able to offer help with your magical abilities.
translation: 女巫海蒂位于法拉多以南的里明顿。她目前正在研究一些新药剂。也许你可以帮她一把？她也许能为你的魔法能力提供帮助。 [nv wu hai di wei yu fa la duo yi nan de li ming dun 。 ta mu qian zheng zai yan jiu yi xie xin yao ji 。 ye xu ni ke yi bang ta yi ba ？ ta ye xu neng wei ni de mo fa neng li ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: Ok thanks, let's hope she doesn't turn me into a potato or something..
translation: 好吧，谢谢，希望她不会把我变成土豆之类的。 [hao ba ， xie xie ， xi wang ta bu hui ba wo bian cheng tu dou zhi lei de 。]

english: Yes, I have already been to see Hetty, she gave me super cosmic powers after I helped out with her potion! I could probably destroy you with a single thought!
translation: 是的，我已经去见过海蒂了，在我帮她配药之后，她给了我超强的宇宙力量！说不定我一个念头就能毁了你！ [shi de ， wo yi jing qu jian guo hai di le ， zai wo bang ta pei yao zhi hou ， ta gei le wo chao qiang de yu zhou li liang ！ shuo bu ding wo yi ge nian tou jiu neng hui le ni ！]

english: Did she really?
translation: 她真的吗？ [ta zhen de ma ？]

english: No not really...
translation: 不，不是真的…… [bu ， bu shi zhen de ……]

english: Right.....
translation: 正确的..... [zheng que de .....]

english: Tell me about Pirate's Treasure.
translation: 告诉我关于海盗宝藏的事。 [gao su wo guan yu hai dao bao zang de shi 。]

english: RedBeard Frank in Port Sarim's bar, the Rusty Anchor, might be able to tell you about the rumored treasure that is buried somewhere in Gielinor.
translation: 萨里姆港的酒吧“生锈的锚”中的红胡子弗兰克也许能够告诉您有关埋藏在吉林诺某处的传闻中的宝藏的信息。 [sa li mu gang de jiu ba “ sheng xiu de mao ” zhong de hong hu zi fu lan ke ye xu neng gou gao su nin you guan mai cang zai ji lin nuo mou chu de chuan wen zhong de bao zang de xin xi 。]

english: Sounds adventurous, I may have to check that out. Thank you.
translation: 听起来很冒险，我可能得检查一下。谢谢。 [ting qi lai hen mao xian ， wo ke neng de jian cha yi xia 。 xie xie 。]

english: Yarr! I already found the booty!
translation: 亚尔！我已经找到战利品了！ [ya er ！ wo yi jing zhao dao zhan li pin le ！]

english: Yarr indeed my friend. A most excellent find.
translation: 亚尔确实是我的朋友。一个最出色的发现。 [ya er que shi shi wo de peng you 。 yi ge zui chu se de fa xian 。]

english: Yarr!
translation: 亚尔！ [ya er ！]

english: Yarrr!
translation: 呀！ [ya ！]

english: YARRR!
translation: 呀！ [ya ！]

english: Right, that's enough of that!
translation: 对了，就这些就足够了！ [dui le ， jiu zhe xie jiu zu gou le ！]

english: ..Sorry.
translation: ..对不起。 [.. dui bu qi 。]

english: Tell me about Ernest please.
translation: 请告诉我有关欧内斯特的事。 [qing gao su wo you guan ou nei si te de shi 。]

english: The best place to start would be at the gate to Draynor Manor. There you will find Veronica who will be able to tell you more.
translation: 最好的起点是德雷诺庄园门口。在那里您会找到维罗妮卡，她可以告诉您更多信息。 [zui hao de qi dian shi de lei nuo zhuang yuan men kou 。 zai na li nin hui zhao dao wei luo ni ka ， ta ke yi gao su nin geng duo xin xi 。]

english: I suggest you tread carefully in that place; it's haunted.
translation: 我建议你在那个地方小心行事；它闹鬼。 [wo jian yi ni zai na ge di fang xiao xin xing shi ； ta nao gui 。]

english: Sounds like fun. I've never been to a Haunted Manor before.
translation: 听起来很有趣。我以前从未去过鬼屋。 [ting qi lai hen you qu 。 wo yi qian cong wei qu guo gui wu 。]

english: Yeah, I found Ernest already. Professor Oddenstein had turned him into a chicken!
translation: 是的，我已经找到欧内斯特了。奥登斯坦教授把他变成了一只鸡！ [shi de ， wo yi jing zhao dao ou nei si te le 。 ao deng si tan jiao shou ba ta bian cheng le yi zhi ji ！]

english: A chicken!?
translation: 一只鸡！？ [yi zhi ji ！？]

english: Yeah a chicken. It could have been worse though.
translation: 是的，一只鸡。但情况可能会更糟。 [shi de ， yi zhi ji 。 dan qing kuang ke neng hui geng zao 。]

english: Very true, poor guy.
translation: 非常真实，可怜的家伙。 [fei chang zhen shi ， ke lian de jia huo 。]

english: Where can I get a haircut like yours?
translation: 哪里可以剪到像你这样的发型？ [na li ke yi jian dao xiang ni zhe yang de fa xing ？]

english: Yes, it does look like you need a hairdresser.
translation: 是的，看来您确实需要一位理发师。 [shi de ， kan lai nin que shi xu yao yi wei li fa shi 。]

english: Oh thanks!
translation: 哦，谢谢！ [o ， xie xie ！]

english: No problem. The hairdresser in Falador will probably be able to sort you out.
translation: 没问题。法拉多的理发师可能会为您解决问题。 [mei wen ti 。 fa la duo de li fa shi ke neng hui wei nin jie jue wen ti 。]

english: The Lumbridge general store sells useful maps if you don't know the way.
translation: 如果您不认识路，伦布里奇杂货店出售有用的地图。 [ru guo nin bu ren shi lu ， lun bu li qi za huo dian chu shou you yong de di tu 。]

english: What's up?
translation: 这是怎么回事？ [zhe shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: I assume the sky is up..
translation: 我以为天已经升起来了.. [wo yi wei tian yi jing sheng qi lai le ..]

english: You assume?
translation: 你认为？ [ni ren wei ？]

english: Yeah, unfortunately I don't seem to be able to look up.
translation: 是的，不幸的是我似乎无法抬头。 [shi de ， bu xing de shi wo si hu wu fa tai tou 。]

english: Can I buy your stick?
translation: 我可以买你的棍子吗？ [wo ke yi mai ni de gun zi ma ？]

english: It's not a stick! I'll have you know it's a very powerful staff!
translation: 这不是一根棍子！我会让你知道这是一支非常强大的员工！ [zhe bu shi yi gen gun zi ！ wo hui rang ni zhi dao zhe shi yi zhi fei chang qiang da de yuan gong ！]

english: Really? Show me what it can do!
translation: 真的吗？告诉我它能做什么！ [zhen de ma ？ gao su wo ta neng zuo shen me ！]

english: Um..It's a bit low on power at the moment..
translation: 嗯..现在电量有点少.. [n .. xian zai dian liang you dian shao ..]

english: It's a stick isn't it?
translation: 这是一根棍子不是吗？ [zhe shi yi gen gun zi bu shi ma ？]

english: ...Ok it's a stick.. But only while I save up for a staff. Zaff in Varrock square sells them in his shop.
translation: ...好吧，这是一根棍子...但只有当我为工作人员存钱时。瓦罗克广场的扎夫在他的商店里出售它们。 [... hao ba ， zhe shi yi gen gun zi ... dan zhi you dang wo wei gong zuo ren yuan cun qian shi 。 wa luo ke guang chang de zha fu zai ta de shang dian li chu shou ta men 。]

english: Well good luck with that.
translation: 祝你好运。 [zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Do you have anything of value which I can have?
translation: 你有什么值钱的东西可以给我吗？ [ni you shen me zhi qian de dong xi ke yi gei wo ma ？]

english: Are you asking for free stuff?
translation: 你在索要免费的东西吗？ [ni zai suo yao mian fei de dong xi ma ？]

english: Well... er... yes.
translation: 嗯...呃...是的。 [n ... e ... shi de 。]

english: No I do not have anything I can give you. If I did have anything of value I wouldn't want to give it away.
translation: 不，我没有什么可以给你的。如果我确实有任何有价值的东西，我不会想放弃它。 [bu ， wo mei you shen me ke yi gei ni de 。 ru guo wo que shi you ren he you jia zhi de dong xi ， wo bu hui xiang fang qi ta 。]

english: Your shoe lace is untied.
translation: 你的鞋带松了。 [ni de xie dai song le 。]

english: No it's not!
translation: 不，不是！ [bu ， bu shi ！]

english: No you're right. I have nothing to back that up.
translation: 不，你是对的。我没有任何证据支持这一点。 [bu ， ni shi dui de 。 wo mei you ren he zheng ju zhi chi zhe yi dian 。]

english: Fool! Leave me alone!
translation: 傻子！请别打扰我！ [sha zi ！ qing bie da rao wo ！]

english: Do you know what happened in the castle cellar?
translation: 你知道城堡地窖里发生了什么吗？ [ni zhi dao cheng bao di jiao li fa sheng le shen me ma ？]

english: I heard the wall collapsed or something. I don't know why. Perhaps you could get to the bottom of this mystery!
translation: 我听到墙倒塌什么的声音。我不知道为什么。或许你能揭开这个谜团的真相！ [wo ting dao qiang dao ta shen me de sheng yin 。 wo bu zhi dao wei shen me 。 huo xu ni neng jie kai zhe ge mi tuan de zhen xiang ！]

english: Where am I?
translation: 我在哪里？ [wo zai na li ？]

english: How are you today?
translation: 你今天怎么样？ [ni jin tian zen me yang ？]

english: Do you know of any quests I can do?
translation: 你知道我可以做哪些任务吗？ [ni zhi dao wo ke yi zuo na xie ren wu ma ？]

english: Your shoe lace is untied.
translation: 你的鞋带松了。 [ni de xie dai song le 。]

english: Are there any quests I can do here?
translation: 我在这里可以做任何任务吗？ [wo zai zhe li ke yi zuo ren he ren wu ma ？]

english: I fancy a bit of a fight, anything dangerous?
translation: 我想打架，有什么危险的吗？ [wo xiang da jia ， you shen me wei xian de ma ？]

english: Big scary demons!
translation: 可怕的大恶魔！ [ke pa de da e mo ！]

english: Vampyres!
translation: 吸血鬼！ [xi xue gui ！]

english: Small.. something small would be good.
translation: 小..小东西就好了。 [xiao .. xiao dong xi jiu hao le 。]

english: Maybe another time.
translation: 也许下次吧。 [ye xu xia ci ba 。]

english: Something easy please, I'm new here.
translation: 请简单一点，我是新来的。 [qing jian dan yi dian ， wo shi xin lai de 。]

english: The Lumbridge cook.
translation: 伦布里奇的厨师。 [lun bu li qi de chu shi 。]

english: The Duke's strange talisman.
translation: 公爵的奇怪护身符。 [gong jue de qi guai hu shen fu 。]

english: Romeo and his girlfriend.
translation: 罗密欧和他的女朋友。 [luo mi ou he ta de nv peng you 。]

english: I'm a thinker rather than fighter, anything skill oriented?
translation: 我是一个思考者而不是战士，有什么以技能为导向的吗？ [wo shi yi ge si kao zhe er bu shi zhan shi ， you shen me yi ji neng wei dao xiang de ma ？]

english: Fred the farmer.
translation: 农民弗雷德. [nong min fu lei de .]

english: Doric the dwarf.
translation: 多立克矮人。 [duo li ke ai ren 。]

english: I want to do all kinds of things, do you know of anything like that?
translation: 我想做各种各样的事情，你知道类似的事情吗？ [wo xiang zuo ge zhong ge yang de shi qing ， ni zhi dao lei si de shi qing ma ？]

english: Hetty the Witch.
translation: 女巫海蒂. [nv wu hai di .]

english: Pirate's treasure.
translation: 海盗的宝藏。 [hai dao de bao zang 。]

english: Ernest and Draynor Manor.
translation: 欧内斯特和德雷纳庄园。 [ou nei si te he de lei na zhuang yuan 。]

english: Where can I get a haircut like yours?
translation: 哪里可以剪到像你这样的发型？ [na li ke yi jian dao xiang ni zhe yang de fa xing ？]

english: What's up?
translation: 这是怎么回事？ [zhe shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: Can I buy your stick?
translation: 我可以买你的棍子吗？ [wo ke yi mai ni de gun zi ma ？]

english: Do you have anything of value which I can have?
translation: 你有什么值钱的东西可以给我吗？ [ni you shen me zhi qian de dong xi ke yi gei wo ma ？]

english: Do you know what happened in the castle cellar?
translation: 你知道城堡地窖里发生了什么吗？ [ni zhi dao cheng bao di jiao li fa sheng le shen me ma ？]

english: I insured your Hitpoints XP up to level [level]. But now there's no more need for that, would you like a refund? It's [amount] coins.
translation: 我为你的生命值 XP 提供了高达 [level] 级别的保险。但现在不再需要了，您想要退款吗？这是[数量]枚硬币。 [wo wei ni de sheng ming zhi  XP  ti gong le gao da  [level]  ji bie de bao xian 。 dan xian zai bu zai xu yao le ， nin xiang yao tui kuan ma ？ zhe shi [ shu liang ] mei ying bi 。]

english: Yes, give me back my [amount] coins
translation: 是的，把我的[金额]硬币还给我 [shi de ， ba wo de [ jin e ] ying bi huan gei wo]

english: No, you can hold onto that for me.
translation: 不，你可以帮我保留它。 [bu ， ni ke yi bang wo bao liu ta 。]

english: Alright. I don't pay interest, though!
translation: 好吧。不过我不付利息！ [hao ba 。 bu guo wo bu fu li xi ！]

english: I used to sell life insurance, protecting people's Hitpoints XP when they died. Now there's no more need for that, so I'm just giving refunds now. But I don't think I owe you anything.
translation: 我曾经销售人寿保险，在人们去世时保护他们的生命值 XP。现在已经没有必要了，所以我现在就退款。但我不认为我欠你什么。 [wo ceng jing xiao shou ren shou bao xian ， zai ren men qu shi shi bao hu ta men de sheng ming zhi  XP。 xian zai yi jing mei you bi yao le ， suo yi wo xian zai jiu tui kuan 。 dan wo bu ren wei wo qian ni shen me 。]

english: Death is everywhere! At any moment, a band of brigands might rush in and kill you, or your closest friend might stab you in the back. Welcome to Gelin's Life Insurance Brokerage.
translation: 死亡无处不在！随时都有可能有一群强盗冲进来杀死你，或者你最亲密的朋友可能会在背后捅你一刀。欢迎来到格林人寿保险经纪公司。 [si wang wu chu bu zai ！ sui shi dou you ke neng you yi qun qiang dao chong jin lai sha si ni ， huo zhe ni zui qin mi de peng you ke neng hui zai bei hou tong ni yi dao 。 huan ying lai dao ge lin ren shou bao xian jing ji gong si 。]

english: When you die, you may lose Hitpoints XP, so your Hitpoints level may decrease. I offer an insurance service, preventing your Hitpoints level from falling below a certain level.
translation: 当你死亡时，你可能会失去生命值 XP，因此你的生命值水平可能会降低。我提供保险服务，防止你的生命值低于某个水平。 [dang ni si wang shi ， ni ke neng hui shi qu sheng ming zhi  XP， yin ci ni de sheng ming zhi shui ping ke neng hui jiang di 。 wo ti gong bao xian fu wu ， fang zhi ni de sheng ming zhi di yu mou ge shui ping 。]

english: I see you're insured up to level 25 Hitpoints - if you lose Hitpoints XP on death, you will never drop below level 25.
translation: 我发现你的生命值最高可达 25 级 - 如果你在死亡时失去生命值 XP，你的生命值永远不会低于 25 级。 [wo fa xian ni de sheng ming zhi zui gao ke da  25  ji  -  ru guo ni zai si wang shi shi qu sheng ming zhi  XP， ni de sheng ming zhi yong yuan bu hui di yu  25  ji 。]

english: I see you're insured up to level 50 Hitpoints - if you lose Hitpoints XP on death, you will never drop below level 50.
translation: 我发现你的生命值最高可达 50 级 - 如果你在死亡时失去生命值 XP，你的生命值永远不会低于 50 级。 [wo fa xian ni de sheng ming zhi zui gao ke da  50  ji  -  ru guo ni zai si wang shi shi qu sheng ming zhi  XP， ni de sheng ming zhi yong yuan bu hui di yu  50  ji 。]

english: I see you're insured up to level 75 Hitpoints - if you lose Hitpoints XP on death, you will never drop below level 75. That's the highest level of insurance I offer.
translation: 我看到你的生命值最高可达 75 级 - 如果你在死亡时失去生命值 XP，你永远不会低于 75 级。这是我提供的最高级别的保险。 [wo kan dao ni de sheng ming zhi zui gao ke da  75  ji  -  ru guo ni zai si wang shi shi qu sheng ming zhi  XP， ni yong yuan bu hui di yu  75  ji 。 zhe shi wo ti gong de zui gao ji bie de bao xian 。]

english: Can I buy life insurance?
translation: 我可以购买人寿保险吗？ [wo ke yi gou mai ren shou bao xian ma ？]

english: You must have a Hitpoints level of 25 before you may insure yourself.
translation: 您的生命值必须达到 25 级才能为自己投保。 [nin de sheng ming zhi bi xu da dao  25  ji cai neng wei zi ji tou bao 。]

english: You must have a Hitpoints level of 50 before you may insure yourself to that level.
translation: 您的生命值必须达到 50 级，才能为自己投保到该级别。 [nin de sheng ming zhi bi xu da dao  50  ji ， cai neng wei zi ji tou bao dao gai ji bie 。]

english: You must have a Hitpoints level of 75 before you may insure yourself to that level.
translation: 您的生命值必须达到 75 级才能为自己投保。 [nin de sheng ming zhi bi xu da dao  75  ji cai neng wei zi ji tou bao 。]

english: I can insure you up to level 75 Hitpoints, so that your Hitpoints level will never decrease below that. This service costs 1,000,000 coins.
translation: 我可以保证你的生命值达到75级，这样你的生命值永远不会低于这个水平。这项服务需要花费 1,000,000 个硬币。 [wo ke yi bao zheng ni de sheng ming zhi da dao 75 ji ， zhe yang ni de sheng ming zhi yong yuan bu hui di yu zhe ge shui ping 。 zhe xiang fu wu xu yao hua fei  1,000,000  ge ying bi 。]

english: Alternatively, I can insure you up to level 50 Hitpoints. That service costs only 100,000 coins.
translation: 或者，我可以为您提供高达 50 级生命值的保险。这项服务只需要 100,000 个硬币。 [huo zhe ， wo ke yi wei nin ti gong gao da  50  ji sheng ming zhi de bao xian 。 zhe xiang fu wu zhi xu yao  100,000  ge ying bi 。]

english: Finally, I can insure you up to level 25 Hitpoints. That service costs only 25,000 coins.
translation: 最后，我可以保证你的生命值最高可达 25 级。这项服务只需 25,000 个硬币。 [zui hou ， wo ke yi bao zheng ni de sheng ming zhi zui gao ke da  25  ji 。 zhe xiang fu wu zhi xu  25,000  ge ying bi 。]

english: I can't afford any of those options.
translation: 我无法承担任何这些选择。 [wo wu fa cheng dan ren he zhe xie xuan ze 。]

english: Insure me to level 75 for 1,000,000 coins.
translation: 用 1,000,000 金币保证我升到 75 级。 [yong  1,000,000  jin bi bao zheng wo sheng dao  75  ji 。]

english: Thank you. Your Hitpoints level will never decrease below 75 when you are defeated in future.
translation: 谢谢。当你以后被击败时，你的生命值永远不会低于75。 [xie xie 。 dang ni yi hou bei ji bai shi ， ni de sheng ming zhi yong yuan bu hui di yu 75。]

english: Insure me to level 25 for 25,000 coins.
translation: 用 25,000 金币保证我升到 25 级。 [yong  25,000  jin bi bao zheng wo sheng dao  25  ji 。]

english: Thank you. Your Hitpoints level will never decrease below 25 when you are defeated in future.
translation: 谢谢。当你以后被击败时，你的生命值永远不会低于25。 [xie xie 。 dang ni yi hou bei ji bai shi ， ni de sheng ming zhi yong yuan bu hui di yu 25。]

english: Not now, thank you.
translation: 现在不行，谢谢。 [xian zai bu xing ， xie xie 。]

english: I can insure you up to level 50 Hitpoints, so that your Hitpoints level will never decrease below that. This service costs 100,000 coins.
translation: 我可以保证你的生命值达到50级，这样你的生命值永远不会低于这个水平。这项服务需要花费 100,000 个金币。 [wo ke yi bao zheng ni de sheng ming zhi da dao 50 ji ， zhe yang ni de sheng ming zhi yong yuan bu hui di yu zhe ge shui ping 。 zhe xiang fu wu xu yao hua fei  100,000  ge jin bi 。]

english: Alternatively, I can insure you up to level 25 Hitpoints. That service costs only 25,000 coins.
translation: 或者，我可以为您提供高达 25 级生命值的保险。这项服务只需 25,000 个硬币。 [huo zhe ， wo ke yi wei nin ti gong gao da  25  ji sheng ming zhi de bao xian 。 zhe xiang fu wu zhi xu  25,000  ge ying bi 。]

english: I can't afford either of those options.
translation: 这两个选项我都买不起。 [zhe liang ge xuan xiang wo dou mai bu qi 。]

english: Insure me to level 50 for 100,000 coins.
translation: 保证我用100,000金币升到50级。 [bao zheng wo yong 100,000 jin bi sheng dao 50 ji 。]

english: Thank you. Your Hitpoints level will never decrease below 50 when you are defeated in future.
translation: 谢谢。当你以后被击败时，你的生命值永远不会低于50。 [xie xie 。 dang ni yi hou bei ji bai shi ， ni de sheng ming zhi yong yuan bu hui di yu 50。]

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: I can insure you up to level 25 Hitpoints, so that your Hitpoints level will never decrease below that. This service costs 25,000 coins.
translation: 我可以保证你的生命值达到25级，这样你的生命值永远不会低于这个水平。这项服务的费用为 25,000 个硬币。 [wo ke yi bao zheng ni de sheng ming zhi da dao 25 ji ， zhe yang ni de sheng ming zhi yong yuan bu hui di yu zhe ge shui ping 。 zhe xiang fu wu de fei yong wei  25,000  ge ying bi 。]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: I am Gelin, the greatest assassin ever to train in Al Kharid. If you have not heard of me, that is because my victims never live to speak of me.
translation: 我是格林，阿尔卡里德有史以来最伟大的刺客。如果你没有听说过我，那是因为我的受害者从来没有活着谈论过我。 [wo shi ge lin ， a er ka li de you shi yi lai zui wei da de ci ke 。 ru guo ni mei you ting shuo guo wo ， na shi yin wei wo de shou hai zhe cong lai mei you huo zhe tan lun guo wo 。]

english: In my years as a warrior of fortune, I have fought in many lands, meeting fighters of all calibres, and I found they all had something in common:
translation: 在我作为一名财富战士的岁月里，我曾在许多地方战斗过，遇到过各种能力的战士，我发现他们都有一些共同点： [zai wo zuo wei yi ming cai fu zhan shi de sui yue li ， wo ceng zai xu duo di fang zhan dou guo ， yu dao guo ge zhong neng li de zhan shi ， wo fa xian ta men dou you yi xie gong tong dian ：]

english: Every single one had a soul-gripping fear that they would suffer a humiliating defeat at the hands of their foes.
translation: 每个人都有一种揪心的恐惧，生怕自己会惨败在敌人手中。 [mei ge ren dou you yi zhong jiu xin de kong ju ， sheng pa zi ji hui can bai zai di ren shou zhong 。]

english: They did not fear the pain, you understand. They feared the diminishment that comes with defeat.
translation: 他们不怕痛苦，你明白。他们担心失败会带来损失。 [ta men bu pa tong ku ， ni ming bai 。 ta men dan xin shi bai hui dai lai sun shi 。]

english: Diminishment?
translation: 减少？ [jian shao ？]

english: To see one's wealth in the hands of another. To see one's skills decrease, as the hard-earned experience is lost. That is what they all feared.
translation: 看到一个人的财富掌握在另一个人的手中。看到一个人的技能下降，因为来之不易的经验消失了。这就是他们都担心的。 [kan dao yi ge ren de cai fu zhang wo zai ling yi ge ren de shou zhong 。 kan dao yi ge ren de ji neng xia jiang ， yin wei lai zhi bu yi de jing yan xiao shi le 。 zhe jiu shi ta men dou dan xin de 。]

english: Thus I was inspired to create this life insurance brokerage. I can protect your Hitpoints experience, so that you will not lose so much of it when you are defeated.
translation: 因此，我受到启发创建了这家人寿保险经纪公司。我可以保护你的生命值经验，这样你在失败时就不会损失太多。 [yin ci ， wo shou dao qi fa chuang jian le zhe jia ren shou bao xian jing ji gong si 。 wo ke yi bao hu ni de sheng ming zhi jing yan ， zhe yang ni zai shi bai shi jiu bu hui sun shi tai duo 。]

english: I cannot protect other skills, and I have no intention whatsoever of protecting anyone's items - a victor deserves their spoils.
translation: 我无法保护其他技能，而且我无意保护任何人的物品——胜利者应得的战利品。 [wo wu fa bao hu qi ta ji neng ， er qie wo wu yi bao hu ren he ren de wu pin —— sheng li zhe ying de de zhan li pin 。]

english: Why do you sell life insurance in a graveyard?
translation: 为什么在墓地里卖人寿保险？ [wei shen me zai mu di li mai ren shou bao xian ？]

english: There is no more fitting place! The graves of the dead remind the living that their lives are fragile, and that death is the inescapable fate of all mortals.
translation: 没有比这更合适的地方了！死者的坟墓提醒生者，他们的生命是脆弱的，死亡是所有凡人不可避免的命运。 [mei you bi zhe geng he shi de di fang le ！ si zhe de fen mu ti xing sheng zhe ， ta men de sheng ming shi cui ruo de ， si wang shi suo you fan ren bu ke bi mian de ming yun 。]

english: That is exactly the frame of mind that encourages people to buy life insurance from me.
translation: 这正是鼓励人们从我这里购买人寿保险的心态。 [zhe zheng shi gu li ren men cong wo zhe li gou mai ren shou bao xian de xin tai 。]

english: Can I ever get a refund on this insurance?
translation: 我可以获得该保险的退款吗？ [wo ke yi huo de gai bao xian de tui kuan ma ？]

english: No, my life insurance policies are for life. Similarly, when a customer upgrades their policy to a better one, I charge the full price of the new policy. They may take it or leave it.
translation: 不，我的人寿保险是终身的。同样，当客户将其保单升级到更好的保单时，我会收取新保单的全价。他们可能会接受也可能会离开。 [bu ， wo de ren shou bao xian shi zhong shen de 。 tong yang ， dang ke hu jiang qi bao dan sheng ji dao geng hao de bao dan shi ， wo hui shou qu xin bao dan de quan jia 。 ta men ke neng hui jie shou ye ke neng hui li kai 。]

translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]
