translation: 你不应该忽视精灵大师[玩家姓名]？ [ni bu ying gai hu shi jing ling da shi [ wan jia xing ming ]？]

english: No one ignores me!
translation: 没有人不理我！ [mei you ren bu li wo ！]

english: I lose more masters that way.
translation: 这样我就失去了更多的大师。 [zhe yang wo jiu shi qu le geng duo de da shi 。]

english: I am a mighty and powerful genie. Why do you come here? Speak now or I'll have to think of something exceedingly nasty to do to you.
translation: 我是一个强大而强大的精灵。你为什么来这里？现在就说吧，不然我就得想办法对你做点极其恶心的事了。 [wo shi yi ge qiang da er qiang da de jing ling 。 ni wei shen me lai zhe li ？ xian zai jiu shuo ba ， bu ran wo jiu de xiang ban fa dui ni zuo dian ji qi e xin de shi le 。]

english: You're a genie, grant me a wish.
translation: 你真是个精灵，请满足我的愿望吧。 [ni zhen shi ge jing ling ， qing man zu wo de yuan wang ba 。]

english: Not all genies are goody two shoes who go round granting wishes. It's something that my pathetic brother does to make people like him, but that's not my style.
translation: 并不是所有的精灵都是会到处实现愿望的好两只鞋。这是我可怜的兄弟为了让人们喜欢他而做的事情，但这不是我的风格。 [bing bu shi suo you de jing ling dou shi hui dao chu shi xian yuan wang de hao liang zhi xie 。 zhe shi wo ke lian de xiong di wei le rang ren men xi huan ta er zuo de shi qing ， dan zhe bu shi wo de feng ge 。]

english: I like to think of myself more as an evil and scary sort of genie, who people talk about in hushed and fearful tones.
translation: 我更喜欢把自己想象成一个邪恶而可怕的精灵，人们用安静而恐惧的语气谈论他。 [wo geng xi huan ba zi ji xiang xiang cheng yi ge xie e er ke pa de jing ling ， ren men yong an jing er kong ju de yu qi tan lun ta 。]

english: Well you seem quite scary.
translation: 嗯，你看起来很可怕。 [n ， ni kan qi lai hen ke pa 。]

english: Why thank you, I put a lot of effort into my terrifyingness.
translation: 何必谢谢你，我为自己的恐怖付出了很多努力。 [he bi xie xie ni ， wo wei zi ji de kong bu fu chu le hen duo nu li 。]

english: Wait! Did you say quite scary? I'll have you know I am VERY scary!
translation: 等待！你说很可怕吗？我会让你知道我很可怕！ [deng dai ！ ni shuo hen ke pa ma ？ wo hui rang ni zhi dao wo hen ke pa ！]

english: Erm yes that's what I meant.
translation: 嗯，是的，这就是我的意思。 [n ， shi de ， zhe jiu shi wo de yi si 。]

english: Well I must be off now.
translation: 好吧，我现在必须走了。 [hao ba ， wo xian zai bi xu zou le 。]

english: Yes, run. Ruuuun in fear of.. The crevice genie of Nardah! Muhahaha!
translation: 是的，跑。 Ruuuun 害怕……Nardah 的裂缝精灵！哈哈哈哈！ [shi de ， pao 。 Ruuuun  hai pa ……Nardah  de lie feng jing ling ！ ha ha ha ha ！]

english: Why are you sitting here in the dark?
translation: 你为什么在黑暗中坐在这里？ [ni wei shen me zai hei an zhong zuo zai zhe li ？]

english: Two reasons really. Firstly, I can see in the dark, so light or dark makes little difference to me.
translation: 确实有两个原因。首先，我可以在黑暗中看到东西，所以光明或黑暗对我来说没有什么区别。 [que shi you liang ge yuan yin 。 shou xian ， wo ke yi zai hei an zhong kan dao dong xi ， suo yi guang ming huo hei an dui wo lai shuo mei you shen me qu bie 。]

english: Lastly, I gather it's normal for powerful terrifying creatures to lurk around in dark caves, so I found this one to lurk in myself, nice isn't it?
translation: 最后，我认为在黑暗的洞穴里潜伏着强大的恐怖生物是很正常的，所以我发现这个潜伏在自己身上，很好不是吗？ [zui hou ， wo ren wei zai hei an de dong xue li qian fu zhe qiang da de kong bu sheng wu shi hen zheng chang de ， suo yi wo fa xian zhe ge qian fu zai zi ji shen shang ， hen hao bu shi ma ？]

english: Very pleasant, the snakes are a nice touch.
translation: 非常愉快，蛇的触感很好。 [fei chang yu kuai ， she de chu gan hen hao 。]

english: Why do I get the sense that I'm not being taken seriously here? Please try to remember I am very dangerous and not to be trifled with.
translation: 为什么我感觉自己在这里没有受到重视？请记住我非常危险，不容轻视。 [wei shen me wo gan jue zi ji zai zhe li mei you shou dao zhong shi ？ qing ji zhu wo fei chang wei xian ， bu rong qing shi 。]

english: I'm just looking around.
translation: 我只是看看。 [wo zhi shi kan kan 。]

english: I don't know about that. I can't have just anybody traipsing in here. I have a reputation to keep you see.
translation: 我对此一无所知。我不能让任何人在这里闲逛。我的名声让你看得见。 [wo dui ci yi wu suo zhi 。 wo bu neng rang ren he ren zai zhe li xian guang 。 wo de ming sheng rang ni kan de jian 。]

english: Actually I'll tell you what, you can hang around here for a bit, but be sure to spread the word about what a terrifying experience you had when you ran into... The crevice genie of Nardah!
translation: 实际上我会告诉你什么，你可以在这里待一会儿，但一定要告诉大家，当你遇到……纳尔达的裂缝精灵时，你有多么可怕的经历！ [shi ji shang wo hui gao su ni shen me ， ni ke yi zai zhe li dai yi hui er ， dan yi ding yao gao su da jia ， dang ni yu dao …… na er da de lie feng jing ling shi ， ni you duo me ke pa de jing li ！]

english: ...Ok I think I can manage that.
translation: ...好吧，我想我可以做到。 [... hao ba ， wo xiang wo ke yi zuo dao 。]

english: Hey get your hands off my house.
translation: 嘿，把你的手从我的房子上拿开。 [hei ， ba ni de shou cong wo de fang zi shang na kai 。]

english: Hey, no casting spells on my house!
translation: 嘿，不要对我的房子施咒！ [hei ， bu yao dui wo de fang zi shi zhou ！]

english: I'm after a statue that was thrown down here.
translation: 我正在寻找一座被扔在这里的雕像。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yi zuo bei reng zai zhe li de diao xiang 。]

english: Ahh yes someone did drop a statue on my head recently. Very nice workmanship, looks quite old and valuable too. I'm surprised someone threw it away!
translation: 啊，是的，最近有人把一座雕像扔到了我的头上。做工非常好，看起来很旧，也很值钱。我很惊讶有人把它扔掉了！ [a ， shi de ， zui jin you ren ba yi zuo diao xiang reng dao le wo de tou shang 。 zuo gong fei chang hao ， kan qi lai hen jiu ， ye hen zhi qian 。 wo hen jing ya you ren ba ta reng diao le ！]

english: I have accepted it as a gift as they clearly respect my terrible powers. They seek to keep me at bay by giving me valuables.
translation: 我接受了它作为礼物，因为他们显然尊重我可怕的力量。他们试图通过给我贵重物品来阻止我。 [wo jie shou le ta zuo wei li wu ， yin wei ta men xian ran zun zhong wo ke pa de li liang 。 ta men shi tu tong guo gei wo gui zhong wu pin lai zu zhi wo 。]

english: Maybe I can make a deal for the statuette?
translation: 也许我可以为小雕像做一笔交易？ [ye xu wo ke yi wei xiao diao xiang zuo yi bi jiao yi ？]

english: Hmm a deal eh? I think we can come to some sort of arrangement. I'll give you the valuable statuette in return for, let me think ....
translation: 嗯，达成协议吧？我想我们可以达成某种安排。我会给你那尊珍贵的小雕像作为回报，让我想想…… [n ， da cheng xie yi ba ？ wo xiang wo men ke yi da cheng mou zhong an pai 。 wo hui gei ni na zun zhen gui de xiao diao xiang zuo wei hui bao ， rang wo xiang xiang ……]

english: How about I give you the statue in exchange for the sole of the mayor of Nardah?
translation: 我用纳尔达市长的鞋底来交换雕像给你怎么样？ [wo yong na er da shi zhang de xie di lai jiao huan diao xiang gei ni zen me yang ？]

english: Isn't that a little harsh?
translation: 是不是有点严酷了？ [shi bu shi you dian yan ku le ？]

english: I wouldn't have said so. It seems a perfectly reasonable thing to request to me. I can think of many things a lot worse I could have asked for.
translation: 我不会这么说的。向我提出这样的要求似乎是完全合理的。我可以想到很多我本来可以要求的更糟糕的事情。 [wo bu hui zhe me shuo de 。 xiang wo ti chu zhe yang de yao qiu si hu shi wan quan he li de 。 wo ke yi xiang dao hen duo wo ben lai ke yi yao qiu de geng zao gao de shi qing 。]

english: How am I meant to remove someone's soul?
translation: 我该如何去除某人的灵魂？ [wo gai ru he qu chu mou ren de ling hun ？]

english: Oh that's easy. In my experience soles are very easy to remove with just a knife.
translation: 哦，这很容易。根据我的经验，只需用刀就可以轻松去除鞋底。 [o ， zhe hen rong yi 。 gen ju wo de jing yan ， zhi xu yong dao jiu ke yi qing song qu chu xie di 。]

english: Ok I agree to the deal.
translation: 好吧，我同意这笔交易。 [hao ba ， wo tong yi zhe bi jiao yi 。]

english: No way am I agreeing to that.
translation: 我绝对不会同意这一点。 [wo jue dui bu hui tong yi zhe yi dian 。]

english: Ah well it's your loss. No sole, then no statuette.
translation: 啊，好吧，这是你的损失。没有鞋底，就没有小雕像。 [a ， hao ba ， zhe shi ni de sun shi 。 mei you xie di ， jiu mei you xiao diao xiang 。]

english: I'm not sure they know you're down here.
translation: 我不确定他们是否知道你在这儿。 [wo bu que ding ta men shi fou zhi dao ni zai zhe er 。]

english: Silence cur! They fear and respect me and that's an end to it.
translation: 沉默吧！他们害怕并尊重我，事情就这样结束了。 [chen mo ba ！ ta men hai pa bing zun zhong wo ， shi qing jiu zhe yang jie shu le 。]

english: Do you have the sole of Awusah, so that we can make our trade?
translation: 你有 Awusah 的鞋底吗，以便我们进行交易？ [ni you  Awusah  de xie di ma ， yi bian wo men jin xing jiao yi ？]

english: I'm still working on it.
translation: 我还在努力。 [wo hai zai nu li 。]

english: Well no rush, I quite like the statuette too.
translation: 好吧，不着急，我也很喜欢这个小雕像。 [hao ba ， bu zhao ji ， wo ye hen xi huan zhe ge xiao diao xiang 。]

english: No, it's not an easy thing to get.
translation: 不，这不是一件容易得到的事情。 [bu ， zhe bu shi yi jian rong yi de dao de shi qing 。]

english: Haha, even a pathetic human should be able to manage to get another human's sole.
translation: 哈哈，即使是一个可怜的人也应该能够得到另一个人的鞋底。 [ha ha ， ji shi shi yi ge ke lian de ren ye ying gai neng gou de dao ling yi ge ren de xie di 。]

english: Yes I have it here.
translation: 是的，我这里有。 [shi de ， wo zhe li you 。]

english: Ah excellent, here's the statuette then.
translation: 啊太棒了，这就是小雕像。 [a tai bang le ， zhe jiu shi xiao diao xiang 。]

english: So um, why do you need part of Awusah's footwear anyway? I hope you're not going to do some nasty magic on his feet or something.
translation: 那么，为什么你需要 Awusah 鞋子的一部分呢？我希望你不要对他的脚施展什么肮脏的魔法之类的。 [na me ， wei shen me ni xu yao  Awusah  xie zi de yi bu fen ne ？ wo xi wang ni bu yao dui ta de jiao shi zhan shen me ang zang de mo fa zhi lei de 。]

english: I hadn't thought of that. I just read that a lot of the most powerful beings are collecting soles these days. I haven't really got many yet though. You provided me with an opportunity to expand my collection.
translation: 我没想到这一点。我刚刚读到，现在许多最强大的人都在收集鞋底。不过我还没有真正得到很多。您为我提供了扩大收藏的机会。 [wo mei xiang dao zhe yi dian 。 wo gang gang du dao ， xian zai xu duo zui qiang da de ren dou zai shou ji xie di 。 bu guo wo hai mei you zhen zheng de dao hen duo 。 nin wei wo ti gong le kuo da shou cang de ji hui 。]

english: I have lost my statuette.
translation: 我的小雕像丢了。 [wo de xiao diao xiang diu le 。]

english: Well fortunately for you, I am a mighty and powerful genie and managed to reacquire it. I will give it to you for another sole.
translation: 对你来说幸运的是，我是一个强大而强大的精灵，并设法重新获得了它。我会把它给你换另一个鞋底。 [dui ni lai shuo xing yun de shi ， wo shi yi ge qiang da er qiang da de jing ling ， bing she fa chong xin huo de le ta 。 wo hui ba ta gei ni huan ling yi ge xie di 。]

english: I will go and get one then.
translation: 那我就去买一个。 [na wo jiu qu mai yi ge 。]

english: Great! Another one for my collection.
translation: 伟大的！另一件是我的收藏品。 [wei da de ！ ling yi jian shi wo de shou cang pin 。]

english: Yes I have one here.
translation: 是的，我这里有一个。 [shi de ， wo zhe li you yi ge 。]

english: Ah excellent here's the statuette then.
translation: 啊，太棒了，这就是小雕像。 [a ， tai bang le ， zhe jiu shi xiao diao xiang 。]

english: It's good doing business with you again.
translation: 很高兴再次与您开展业务。 [hen gao xing zai ci yu nin kai zhan ye wu 。]

english: Here, have this.
translation: 给，这个。 [gei ， zhe ge 。]

english: You're a genie, grant me a wish.
translation: 你真是个精灵，请满足我的愿望吧。 [ni zhen shi ge jing ling ， qing man zu wo de yuan wang ba 。]

english: Well you seem quite scary.
translation: 嗯，你看起来很可怕。 [n ， ni kan qi lai hen ke pa 。]

english: Why are you sitting here in the dark.
translation: 你为什么在黑暗中坐在这里。 [ni wei shen me zai hei an zhong zuo zai zhe li 。]

english: Well I must be off now.
translation: 好吧，我现在必须走了。 [hao ba ， wo xian zai bi xu zou le 。]

english: Why are you sitting here in the dark?
translation: 你为什么在黑暗中坐在这里？ [ni wei shen me zai hei an zhong zuo zai zhe li ？]

english: Very pleasant, the snakes are a nice touch.
translation: 非常愉快，蛇的触感很好。 [fei chang yu kuai ， she de chu gan hen hao 。]

english: I'm just looking around.
translation: 我只是看看。 [wo zhi shi kan kan 。]

english: I'm after a statue that was thrown down here.
translation: 我正在寻找一座被扔在这里的雕像。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yi zuo bei reng zai zhe li de diao xiang 。]

english: Maybe I can make a deal for it?
translation: 也许我可以做一笔交易？ [ye xu wo ke yi zuo yi bi jiao yi ？]

english: Isn't that a little harsh?
translation: 是不是有点严酷了？ [shi bu shi you dian yan ku le ？]

english: How am I meant to remove someone's soul?
translation: 我该如何去除某人的灵魂？ [wo gai ru he qu chu mou ren de ling hun ？]

english: Ok I agree to the deal.
translation: 好吧，我同意这笔交易。 [hao ba ， wo tong yi zhe bi jiao yi 。]

english: No way am I agreeing to that.
translation: 我绝对不会同意这一点。 [wo jue dui bu hui tong yi zhe yi dian 。]

english: I'm not sure they know you're down here.
translation: 我不确定他们是否知道你在这儿。 [wo bu que ding ta men shi fou zhi dao ni zai zhe er 。]

english: I'm still working on it.
translation: 我还在努力。 [wo hai zai nu li 。]

english: No, it's not an easy thing to get.
translation: 不，这不是一件容易得到的事情。 [bu ， zhe bu shi yi jian rong yi de dao de shi qing 。]

english: Can I help you?
translation: 我可以帮你吗？ [wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: What can you tell me about the people here?
translation: 关于这里的人，你能告诉我什么吗？ [guan yu zhe li de ren ， ni neng gao su wo shen me ma ？]

english: Let's see... We currently have Herman & Franklin Caranos, Arnold Lydspor, Devin Mendelberg and Ramara du Croissant. And me, of course.
translation: 让我们看看...目前我们有 Herman & Franklin Caranos、Arnold Lydspor、Devin Mendelberg 和 Ramara du Croissant。当然还有我。 [rang wo men kan kan ... mu qian wo men you  Herman & Franklin Caranos、Arnold Lydspor、Devin Mendelberg  he  Ramara du Croissant。 dang ran hai you wo 。]

english: Herman and Franklin are brothers, as you'll know. Herman's always been a fishing nut. Franklin's not all that bothered about fishing, but he does like tinkering with machinery. They're originally from East Ardougne.
translation: 正如你所知，赫尔曼和富兰克林是兄弟。赫尔曼一直是个钓鱼狂。富兰克林并不热衷于钓鱼，但他确实喜欢修理机器。他们最初来自东阿杜涅。 [zheng ru ni suo zhi ， he er man he fu lan ke lin shi xiong di 。 he er man yi zhi shi ge diao yu kuang 。 fu lan ke lin bing bu re zhong yu diao yu ， dan ta que shi xi huan xiu li ji qi 。 ta men zui chu lai zi dong e du nie 。]

english: Arnold's a bit more of a mystery. We think he might be from one of the barbarian tribes, but he never talks about that. He's always up for a chat, if you can understand his accent.
translation: 阿诺德有点神秘。我们认为他可能来自野蛮部落之一，但他从未谈论过这一点。如果你能听懂他的口音，他总是愿意聊天。 [a nuo de you dian shen mi 。 wo men ren wei ta ke neng lai zi ye man bu luo zhi yi ， dan ta cong wei tan lun guo zhe yi dian 。 ru guo ni neng ting dong ta de kou yin ， ta zong shi yuan yi liao tian 。]

english: Devin Mendelberg comes from some town in Morytania - ghastly place! I'm not surprised he moved about as far west as he could go! He helps Franklin with the machinery, among other things.
translation: 德文·门德尔伯格来自莫里塔尼亚的某个小镇——一个可怕的地方！我一点也不惊讶他搬到了他能走到的最西边！他帮助富兰克林处理机械等事务。 [de wen · men de er bo ge lai zi mo li ta ni ya de mou ge xiao zhen —— yi ge ke pa de di fang ！ wo yi dian ye bu jing ya ta ban dao le ta neng zou dao de zui xi bian ！ ta bang zhu fu lan ke lin chu li ji xie deng shi wu 。]

english: Ramara's another Ardougnian. Her father's a baker there, but she didn't want to spend her whole life baking and doing his accounts. Also, you probably know what Ardougne's crime rate is like - it can't be easy running
translation: 拉马拉是另一个阿杜尼亚人。她父亲是那里的一名面包师，但她不想一生都在为他烘焙和记账。另外，你可能知道阿杜涅的犯罪率是多少 - 跑步并不容易 [la ma la shi ling yi ge a du ni ya ren 。 ta fu qin shi na li de yi ming mian bao shi ， dan ta bu xiang yi sheng dou zai wei ta hong bei he ji zhang 。 ling wai ， ni ke neng zhi dao a du nie de fan zui lv shi duo shao  -  pao bu bing bu rong yi]

english: a market stall in that city! I went there once, and some wannabe adventurer started following me around trying to pick my pockets! I kept hitting him, but he kept coming back again and again!
translation: 那个城市的一个市场摊位！我去过那里一次，一些想成为冒险家的人开始跟踪我，试图扒我的口袋！我一直打他，他却一次又一次地回来！ [na ge cheng shi de yi ge shi chang tan wei ！ wo qu guo na li yi ci ， yi xie xiang cheng wei mao xian jia de ren kai shi gen zong wo ， shi tu ba wo de kou dai ！ wo yi zhi da ta ， ta que yi ci you yi ci di hui lai ！]

english: You haven't told me about yourself yet.
translation: 你还没有告诉我关于你自己的事。 [ni hai mei you gao su wo guan yu ni zi ji de shi 。]

english: Oh, I used to work with my sister, Emily, in the Rising Sun in Falador, but I wanted an outdoor job. The pay's better out here too, and the work's not too bad.
translation: 哦，我曾经和姐姐艾米丽在法拉多的 Rising Sun 工作，但我想要一份户外工作。这里的工资也比较好，而且工作也不算太差。 [o ， wo ceng jing he jie jie ai mi li zai fa la duo de  Rising Sun  gong zuo ， dan wo xiang yao yi fen hu wai gong zuo 。 zhe li de gong zi ye bi jiao hao ， er qie gong zuo ye bu suan tai cha 。]

english: What is there for me to do here?
translation: 我在这里有什么可做的呢？ [wo zai zhe li you shen me ke zuo de ne ？]

english: You can fish! But I'd be very glad if you could go and do something about the skeletal magi in the dormitories. They've kept appearing there ever since the trolls left.
translation: 你可以钓鱼！不过如果你能去帮宿舍里的骷髅魔法师做点什么的话我会很高兴的。自从巨魔离开后，他们就一直出现在那里。 [ni ke yi diao yu ！ bu guo ru guo ni neng qu bang su she li de ku lou mo fa shi zuo dian shen me de hua wo hui hen gao xing de 。 zi cong ju mo li kai hou ， ta men jiu yi zhi chu xian zai na li 。]

english: Also, if you're into glassbowing, you'll probably want a bit of seaweed. It catches in our nets all the time, so you'll usually find some in the machinery down by the shore.
translation: 另外，如果您喜欢吹玻璃，您可能会需要一点海藻。它总是被我们的网捕获，所以你通常会在岸边的机器里找到一些。 [ling wai ， ru guo nin xi huan chui bo li ， nin ke neng hui xu yao yi dian hai zao 。 ta zong shi bei wo men de wang bu huo ， suo yi ni tong chang hui zai an bian de ji qi li zhao dao yi xie 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: No thanks, I'm fine.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我很好。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo hen hao 。]

english: Ok, but come and talk to me anytime.
translation: 好的，但是随时来跟我说话吧。 [hao de ， dan shi sui shi lai gen wo shuo hua ba 。]

english: What can you tell me about the people here?
translation: 关于这里的人，你能告诉我什么吗？ [guan yu zhe li de ren ， ni neng gao su wo shen me ma ？]

english: What is there for me to do here?
translation: 我在这里有什么可做的呢？ [wo zai zhe li you shen me ke zuo de ne ？]

english: No thanks, I'm fine.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我很好。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo hen hao 。]

english: Hey kid, what's all the shouting about?
translation: 嘿，孩子，喊什么？ [hei ， hai zi ， han shen me ？]

english: Christmas is ruined!
translation: 圣诞节被毁了！ [sheng dan jie bei hui le ！]

english: Again? What's happened this time?
translation: 再次？这次是怎么回事？ [zai ci ？ zhe ci shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: The man in the shop won't give us our Gingerbread Gnomes, he's keeping them for himself.
translation: 店里的那个人不会给我们姜饼侏儒，他自己留着它们。 [dian li de na ge ren bu hui gei wo men jiang bing zhu ru ， ta zi ji liu zhe ta men 。]

english: That doesn't sound right, are you sure that's really what he's doing?
translation: 这听起来不对，你确定那真的是他在做的吗？ [zhe ting qi lai bu dui ， ni que ding na zhen de shi ta zai zuo de ma ？]

english: Of course he is, why else won't he give us any?
translation: 当然是，不然他为什么不给我们呢？ [dang ran shi ， bu ran ta wei shen me bu gei wo men ne ？]

english: Something seems off, maybe I should go talk to Santa to find out what's happened.
translation: 好像有些不对劲，也许我应该去跟圣诞老人谈谈，看看发生了什么事。 [hao xiang you xie bu dui jin ， ye xu wo ying gai qu gen sheng dan lao ren tan tan ， kan kan fa sheng le shen me shi 。]

english: Do whatever you want, I want my Gingerbread Gnomes!
translation: 做你想做的事，我想要我的姜饼侏儒！ [zuo ni xiang zuo de shi ， wo xiang yao wo de jiang bing zhu ru ！]

english: Where are our Gingerbread Gnomes!
translation: 我们的姜饼侏儒在哪里！ [wo men de jiang bing zhu ru zai na li ！]

english: I'm working on it, I'm working on it.
translation: 我正在努力，我正在努力。 [wo zheng zai nu li ， wo zheng zai nu li 。]

english: Hurry up!
translation: 赶快！ [gan kuai ！]

english: You've ruined Christmas!
translation: 你毁了圣诞节！ [ni hui le sheng dan jie ！]

english: Give us the Gnomes!
translation: 给我们侏儒吧！ [gei wo men zhu ru ba ！]

english: Why are you still here? I saved Christmas, you can go home.
translation: 你怎么还在这里？我救了圣诞节，你可以回家了。 [ni zen me hai zai zhe li ？ wo jiu le sheng dan jie ， ni ke yi hui jia le 。]

english: We still have to wait for the delivery to come in, dummy.
translation: 我们还得等送货上门，傻瓜。 [wo men hai de deng song huo shang men ， sha gua 。]

english: I'll leave you to it then.
translation: 那我就把它留给你了。 [na wo jiu ba ta liu gei ni le 。]

english: Christmas is Saved!
translation: 圣诞节得救了！ [sheng dan jie de jiu le ！]

english: Hurry up with the delivery!
translation: 快点发货吧！ [kuai dian fa huo ba ！]

english: If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 我要是像你那么丑我就不敢在大庭广众之下露脸了！ [wo yao shi xiang ni na me chou wo jiu bu gan zai da ting guang zhong zhi xia lou lian le ！]

english: Out of my way, punk.
translation: 别挡我的路，朋克。 [bie dang wo de lu ， peng ke 。]

english: Hmm... you smell strange...
translation: 嗯……你闻起来很奇怪…… [n …… ni wen qi lai hen qi guai ……]

english: Strange how?
translation: 奇怪怎么办？ [qi guai zen me ban ？]

english: Like a human!
translation: 像人一样！ [xiang ren yi yang ！]

english: Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 哦！呃……我刚吃了一个就是为什么！ [o ！ e …… wo gang chi le yi ge jiu shi wei shen me ！]

english: Leave me alone.
translation: 请别打扰我。 [qing bie da rao wo 。]

english: Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 如果你珍惜你的生命，就不要再跟我说话了！ [ru guo ni zhen xi ni de sheng ming ， jiu bu yao zai gen wo shuo hua le ！]

english: Get lost!
translation: 迷路！ [mi lu ！]

english: I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 我没有什么可以给你，所以让我一个人呆着吧，托钵僧。 [wo mei you shen me ke yi gei ni ， suo yi rang wo yi ge ren dai zhe ba ， tuo bo seng 。]

english: Have you no manners?
translation: 你没有礼貌吗？ [ni mei you li mao ma ？]

english: I don't have time for this right now.
translation: 我现在没有时间做这个。 [wo xian zai mei you shi jian zuo zhe ge 。]

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 我没有兴趣和像你这样的可怜虫说话。 [wo mei you xing qu he xiang ni zhe yang de ke lian chong shuo hua 。]

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
translation: 我打赌你有一双很棒的爪子。 [wo da du ni you yi shuang hen bang de zhua zi 。]

english: A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 非常痛苦的一天，总的来说……趁它持续的时候好好享受吧。 [fei chang tong ku de yi tian ， zong de lai shuo …… chen ta chi xu de shi hou hao hao xiang shou ba 。]

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: 如果你抓到任何人，答应我你会分享。 [ru guo ni zhua dao ren he ren ， da ying wo ni hui fen xiang 。]

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 我以前没在这儿闻过你的味道…… [wo yi qian mei zai zhe er wen guo ni de wei dao ……]

english: You smell familiar...
translation: 你闻起来很熟悉... [ni wen qi lai hen shu xi ...]

english: Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 看到这附近有人类吗？我饿了。 [kan dao zhe fu jin you ren lei ma ？ wo e le 。]

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 在我看来，你就像一个对血液有健康品味的人。 [zai wo kan lai ， ni jiu xiang yi ge dui xue ye you jian kang pin wei de ren 。]

english: Good day to you, my friend.
translation: 祝你美好的一天，我的朋友。 [zhu ni mei hao de yi tian ， wo de peng you 。]

english: Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
translation: 想去城堡吃点小吃吗？ [xiang qu cheng bao chi dian xiao chi ma ？]

english: Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: 等一下，我的牙齿里有一点东西卡住了…… [deng yi xia ， wo de ya chi li you yi dian dong xi ka zhu le ……]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Good day to you traveller, are you here to fish or just looking around? I've caught some beauties down here.
translation: 旅行者好，您来这里是为了钓鱼还是只是四处看看？我在这里抓到了一些美女。 [lv xing zhe hao ， nin lai zhe li shi wei le diao yu hai shi zhi shi si chu kan kan ？ wo zai zhe li zhua dao le yi xie mei nv 。]

english: Really?
translation: 真的吗？ [zhen de ma ？]

english: The last one was this big!
translation: 最后一张这么大！ [zui hou yi zhang zhe me da ！]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Hello traveller. Are you here to fish or to hunt for treasure?
translation: 你好旅行者。你是来钓鱼还是来寻宝的？ [ni hao lv xing zhe 。 ni shi lai diao yu hai shi lai xun bao de ？]

english: Why do you say that?
translation: 为什么这么说？ [wei shen me zhe me shuo ？]

english: Adventurers pass through here every week, they never find anything though.
translation: 冒险者们每周都会经过这里，但他们却什么也没找到。 [mao xian zhe men mei zhou du hui jing guo zhe li ， dan ta men que shen me ye mei zhao dao 。]

english: Welcome! You can buy fishing equipment at my store. We'll also buy anything you catch off you.
translation: 欢迎！你可以在我的商店购买钓鱼设备。我们也会买你从你身上抓到的任何东西。 [huan ying ！ ni ke yi zai wo de shang dian gou mai diao yu she bei 。 wo men ye hui mai ni cong ni shen shang zhua dao de ren he dong xi 。]

english: Let's see what you've got then.
translation: 让我们看看你有什么。 [rang wo men kan kan ni you shen me 。]

english: Sorry, I'm not interested.
translation: 抱歉，我不感兴趣。 [bao qian ， wo bu gan xing qu 。]

english: I want to find out how to catch a lava eel.
translation: 我想知道如何捕捉熔岩鳗鱼。 [wo xiang zhi dao ru he bu zhuo rong yan man yu 。]

english: Lava eels eh? That's a tricky one that is, you'll need a lava-proof fishing line. The method for making this would be to take an ordinary fishing rod, and then cover it with the fire-proof Blamish Oil.
translation: 熔岩鳗鱼是吧？这是一个棘手的问题，那就是，你需要一根防熔岩的钓鱼线。制作方法是拿一根普通的钓鱼竿，然后在上面涂上防火的Blamish Oil。 [rong yan man yu shi ba ？ zhe shi yi ge ji shou de wen ti ， na jiu shi ， ni xu yao yi gen fang rong yan de diao yu xian 。 zhi zuo fang fa shi na yi gen pu tong de diao yu gan ， ran hou zai shang mian tu shang fang huo de Blamish Oil。]

english: You know... thinking about it... I may have a jar of Blamish Slime around here somewhere... Now where did I put it?
translation: 你知道...想一想...我可能在这附近的某个地方有一罐臭虫史莱姆...现在我把它放在哪里了？ [ni zhi dao ... xiang yi xiang ... wo ke neng zai zhe fu jin de mou ge di fang you yi guan chou chong shi lai mu ... xian zai wo ba ta fang zai na li le ？]

english: Gerrant searches around a bit.
translation: 杰兰特四处搜寻了一下。 [jie lan te si chu sou xun le yi xia 。]

english: Aha! Here it is! Take this slime, mix it with some Harralander and water and you'll have the Blamish Oil you need for treating your fishing rod.
translation: 啊哈！这里是！将这种粘液与一些 Harralander 和水混合，你就会得到处理钓鱼竿所需的 Blamish 油。 [a ha ！ zhe li shi ！ jiang zhe zhong nian ye yu yi xie  Harralander  he shui hun he ， ni jiu hui de dao chu li diao yu gan suo xu de  Blamish  you 。]

english: You've done it!
translation: 你已经做到了！ [ni yi jing zuo dao le ！]

english: Gerrant has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
translation: 杰兰特给了你[另一条线索卷轴/一个棺材]！ [jie lan te gei le ni [ ling yi tiao xian suo juan zhou / yi ge guan cai ]！]

english: Let's see what you've got then.
translation: 让我们看看你有什么。 [rang wo men kan kan ni you shen me 。]

english: Sorry, I'm not interested.
translation: 抱歉，我不感兴趣。 [bao qian ， wo bu gan xing qu 。]

english: I want to find out how to catch a lava eel.
translation: 我想知道如何捕捉熔岩鳗鱼。 [wo xiang zhi dao ru he bu zhuo rong yan man yu 。]

english: Hello again.
translation: 又好。 [you hao 。]

english: Hello, my dear. How's things?
translation: 你好亲爱的。事情怎么样？ [ni hao qin ai de 。 shi qing zen me yang ？]

english: Did you ever get to talk to those people I told you about?
translation: 你有没有和我告诉过你的那些人交谈过？ [ni you mei you he wo gao su guo ni de na xie ren jiao tan guo ？]

english: Yes, strange people. But interesting nonetheless.
translation: 是的，奇怪的人。但还是很有趣。 [shi de ， qi guai de ren 。 dan hai shi hen you qu 。]

english: Well, my dear. Is there anything else I can do for you?
translation: 好吧，亲爱的。我还能为您做些什么吗？ [hao ba ， qin ai de 。 wo hai neng wei nin zuo xie shen me ma ？]

english: I'm fine thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Good good, See you again.
translation: 很好很好，再见。 [hen hao hen hao ， zai jian 。]

english: Do you have any more kittens?
translation: 你还有更多的小猫吗？ [ni hai you geng duo de xiao mao ma ？]

english: Indeed I have. They are 100 coins each, do you want one?
translation: 确实我有。每张100枚，你想要一枚吗？ [que shi wo you 。 mei zhang 100 mei ， ni xiang yao yi mei ma ？]

english: Oops, looks like I'm a bit short. I'll have to come back later.
translation: 哎呀，看来我有点矮了。我得稍后再回来。 [ai ya ， kan lai wo you dian ai le 。 wo de shao hou zai hui lai 。]

english: Hello again Gertrude!
translation: 格特鲁德你好！ [ge te lu de ni hao ！]

english: Well, hello adventurer! How are you?
translation: 嗯，冒险家你好！你好吗？ [n ， mao xian jia ni hao ！ ni hao ma ？]

english: My cat has caught 100 rats!
translation: 我的猫抓到了100只老鼠！ [wo de mao zhua dao le 100 zhi lao shu ！]

english: Well well! You are good with cats!
translation: 好吧好吧！你对猫很好！ [hao ba hao ba ！ ni dui mao hen hao ！]

english: Here, I have a little present for you...
translation: 在这里，我给你准备了一份小礼物…… [zai zhe li ， wo gei ni zhun bei le yi fen xiao li wu ……]

english: Gertrude shows you a small medal
translation: 格特鲁德向您展示一枚小奖牌 [ge te lu de xiang nin zhan shi yi mei xiao jiang pai]

english: Hey, thanks Gertrude.
translation: 嘿，谢谢格特鲁德。 [hei ， xie xie ge te lu de 。]

english: Oh, I do love my precious little kittens! Perhaps you could care for one, some day!
translation: 哦，我真的很爱我珍贵的小猫！也许有一天你可以照顾一个！ [o ， wo zhen de hen ai wo zhen gui de xiao mao ！ ye xu you yi tian ni ke yi zhao gu yi ge ！]

english: Did Juliet not invite you to her party?
translation: 朱丽叶没有邀请你参加她的聚会吗？ [zhu li ye mei you yao qing ni can jia ta de ju hui ma ？]

english: No, me and her aren't friends anymore, she tried to poison my cats.
translation: 不，我和她不再是朋友了，她试图毒死我的猫。 [bu ， wo he ta bu zai shi peng you le ， ta shi tu du si wo de mao 。]

english: I should go before I make things worse.
translation: 我应该在事情​​变得更糟之前离开。 [wo ying gai zai shi qing ​​ bian de geng zao zhi qian li kai 。]

english: Hi Gertrude, do you have any cat hair I can borrow?
translation: 嗨，格特鲁德，你有猫毛可以借给我吗？ [hai ， ge te lu de ， ni you mao mao ke yi jie gei wo ma ？]

english: Do I look like I collect cat hairs? It may collect onto my clothes like no tomorrow, but I don't hoard it.
translation: 我看起来像收集猫毛吗？它可能会像明天一样聚集在我的衣服上，但我不会囤积它。 [wo kan qi lai xiang shou ji mao mao ma ？ ta ke neng hui xiang ming tian yi yang ju ji zai wo de yi fu shang ， dan wo bu hui tun ji ta 。]

english: Sorry for asking...maybe there's another way I can get it off her...
translation: 抱歉问了...也许我可以用另一种方式从她身上得到它... [bao qian wen le ... ye xu wo ke yi yong ling yi zhong fang shi cong ta shen shang de dao ta ...]

english: You take Gertrude's comb.
translation: 你拿走格特鲁德的梳子。 [ni na zou ge te lu de de shu zi 。]

english: You already have one of Gertrude's combs, it would be rude to take more.
translation: 你已经有了一把格特鲁德的梳子，再拿一把是不礼貌的。 [ni yi jing you le yi ba ge te lu de de shu zi ， zai na yi ba shi bu li mao de 。]

english: You run the comb through Gertrude's cardigan.
translation: 你用梳子梳理格特鲁德的羊毛衫。 [ni yong shu zi shu li ge te lu de de yang mao shan 。]

english: You find some loose cat hairs, you take them and store them in your pocket.
translation: 你发现一些松散的猫毛，你把它们拿起来放在口袋里。 [ni fa xian yi xie song san de mao mao ， ni ba ta men na qi lai fang zai kou dai li 。]

english: Oi! What do you think you're doing?
translation: 哎呀！你认为你在做什么？ [ai ya ！ ni ren wei ni zai zuo shen me ？]

english: Oh, uh...nothing! I'll be going now!
translation: 哦，呃……没什么！我现在就去！ [o ， e …… mei shen me ！ wo xian zai jiu qu ！]

english: You already have some cat hair, best leave it there.
translation: 你已经有一些猫毛了，最好把它留在那里。 [ni yi jing you yi xie mao mao le ， zui hao ba ta liu zai na li 。]

english: I found some cat hair.
translation: 我发现了一些猫毛。 [wo fa xian le yi xie mao mao 。]

english: Wow, that's very impressive.
translation: 哇，这太令人印象深刻了。 [wa ， zhe tai ling ren yin xiang shen ke le 。]

english: Hello little kitty, are you lost?
translation: 你好，小猫咪，你迷路了吗？ [ni hao ， xiao mao mi ， ni mi lu le ma ？]

english: Eeeerrrr...
translation: 呃呃… [e e …]

english: Come here little fella, I've got a tasty sardine for you.
translation: 过来吧小伙子，我给你准备了美味的沙丁鱼。 [guo lai ba xiao huo zi ， wo gei ni zhun bei le mei wei de sha ding yu 。]

english: You take the sardine from Gertrude and quickly eat it.
translation: 你从格特鲁德手中接过沙丁鱼并迅速吃掉它。 [ni cong ge te lu de shou zhong jie guo sha ding yu bing xun su chi diao ta 。]

english: Who's a good fluff ball.
translation: 谁是一个好毛球。 [shui shi yi ge hao mao qiu 。]

english: Meooow!
translation: 喵呜！ [miao wu ！]

english: I should go...
translation: 我应该去... [wo ying gai qu ...]

english: Well done.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: You've [found a new clue/obtained a casket]!
translation: 你[发现了新线索/获得了棺材]！ [ni [ fa xian le xin xian suo / huo de le guan cai ]！]

english: I'm fine thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Do you have any more kittens?
translation: 你还有更多的小猫吗？ [ni hai you geng duo de xiao mao ma ？]

english: Ask about the birthday party.
translation: 询问生日聚会的情况。 [xun wen sheng ri ju hui de qing kuang 。]

english: Something else.
translation: 还有别的事。 [hai you bie de shi 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Hello Fluffs.
translation: 你好，绒毛。 [ni hao ， rong mao 。]

english: Purrrrr! So you can talk to cats now?
translation: 咕噜咕噜！那么你现在可以和猫说话了吗？ [gu lu gu lu ！ na me ni xian zai ke yi he mao shuo hua le ma ？]

english: Yes, I got this amulet from a Sphinx.
translation: 是的，我从狮身人面像那里得到了这个护身符。 [shi de ， wo cong shi shen ren mian xiang na li de dao le zhe ge hu shen fu 。]

translation: 是的！这花了相当长的时间。其中一些任务非常具有挑战性，但我坚持下来并完成了所有任务！ [shi de ！ zhe hua le xiang dang zhang de shi jian 。 qi zhong yi xie ren wu fei chang ju you tiao zhan xing ， dan wo jian chi xia lai bing wan cheng le suo you ren wu ！]

english: You have come very far. You have earned these rewards.
translation: 你已经走了很远了。您已经赢得了这些奖励。 [ni yi jing zou le hen yuan le 。 nin yi jing ying de le zhe xie jiang li 。]

english: There you go. I've provided you with our most prestigious ancient sword hilt. You'll also have increased max quantities offered when given boss Slayer tasks, including the deadly TzHaar creatures, and have to kill
translation: 就这样吧。我给你提供了我们最负盛名的古剑柄。当你接受 Boss Slayer 任务时，你的最大数量也会增加，包括致命的 TzHaar 生物，并且必须杀死 [jiu zhe yang ba 。 wo gei ni ti gong le wo men zui fu sheng ming de gu jian bing 。 dang ni jie shou  Boss Slayer  ren wu shi ， ni de zui da shu liang ye hui zeng jia ， bao kuo zhi ming de  TzHaar  sheng wu ， bing qie bi xu sha si]

english: even fewer God Wars minions to access the generals. Plus of course, you'll get even more common ecumenical keys and access to even cheaper private God Wars rooms. Furthermore, any Thralls you resurrect
translation: 进入将军的神战小兵就更少了。当然，此外，您还将获得更常见的普世钥匙并进入更便宜的私人《神战》房间。此外，你复活的任何奴隶 [jin ru jiang jun de shen zhan xiao bing jiu geng shao le 。 dang ran ， ci wai ， nin hai jiang huo de geng chang jian de pu shi yao shi bing jin ru geng pian yi de si ren 《 shen zhan 》 fang jian 。 ci wai ， ni fu huo de ren he nu li]

english: will last 100% longer. And yes, I can also customize your Slayer helmet even more.
translation: 持续时间延长 100%。是的，我还可以进一步定制您的 Slayer 头盔。 [chi xu shi jian yan chang  100%。 shi de ， wo hai ke yi jin yi bu ding zhi nin de  Slayer  tou kui 。]

english: I do wonder what you will do now. Good luck, adventurer.
translation: 我确实想知道你现在会做什么。祝你好运，冒险家。 [wo que shi xiang zhi dao ni xian zai hui zuo shen me 。 zhu ni hao yun ， mao xian jia 。]

english: Thank you so much!
translation: 太感谢了！ [tai gan xie le ！]

english: Ghommal welcome you to Warrior Guild!
translation: 戈玛尔欢迎您来到战士公会！ [ge ma er huan ying nin lai dao zhan shi gong hui ！]

english: Umm.. thank you, I think.
translation: 嗯..谢谢你，我想。 [n .. xie xie ni ， wo xiang 。]

english: You not pass. You too weedy.
translation: 你没通过。你也太杂草了吧 [ni mei tong guo 。 ni ye tai za cao le ba]

english: Heehee... [he/she] say [he/she] warrior... I not heard that one for... at leas' 5 minutes!
translation: 嘿嘿……[他/她]说[他/她]战士……我已经……至少有五分钟没听到这个了！ [hei hei ……[ ta / ta ] shuo [ ta / ta ] zhan shi …… wo yi jing …… zhi shao you wu fen zhong mei ting dao zhe ge le ！]

english: No! You is not a strong warrior, you not enter till you bigger. Ghommal does not take bribes.
translation: 不！你不是一个强大的战士，除非你变得更强，否则你无法进入。戈马尔不接受贿赂。 [bu ！ ni bu shi yi ge qiang da de zhan shi ， chu fei ni bian de geng qiang ， fou ze ni wu fa jin ru 。 ge ma er bu jie shou hui lu 。]

english: Ghommal stick to Warrior's Code of Honour. When you a bigger, stronger warrior, you come back.
translation: 戈马尔遵守战士荣誉准则。当你成为一个更大、更强的战士时，你就会回来。 [ge ma er zun shou zhan shi rong yu zhun ze 。 dang ni cheng wei yi ge geng da 、 geng qiang de zhan shi shi ， ni jiu hui hui lai 。]

english: You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.
translation: 你会收到线索卷轴的撕破部分。 [ni hui shou dao xian suo juan zhou de si po bu fen 。]

english: Your gear so strong. Me impressed.
translation: 你的装备好强啊让我印象深刻。 [ni de zhuang bei hao qiang a rang wo yin xiang shen ke 。]

english: What are you doing out here?
translation: 你在这儿做什么？ [ni zai zhe er zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm here to talk about Combat Achievements.
translation: 我是来谈谈战斗成就的。 [wo shi lai tan tan zhan dou cheng jiu de 。]

english: Could you explain what they are?
translation: 你能解释一下它们是什么吗？ [ni neng jie shi yi xia ta men shi shen me ma ？]

english: Yes, tell me about Combat Achievements.
translation: 是的，请告诉我有关战斗成就的信息。 [shi de ， qing gao su wo you guan zhan dou cheng jiu de xin xi 。]

english: Not at the moment, no.
translation: 目前还没有，没有。 [mu qian hai mei you ， mei you 。]

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。 [wo de zou le 。]

english: No, I'm alright thanks.
translation: 不，我没事，谢谢。 [bu ， wo mei shi ， xie xie 。]

english: I think I've completed a combat tier!
translation: 我想我已经完成了战斗等级！ [wo xiang wo yi jing wan cheng le zhan dou deng ji ！]

english: We are waiting for you to join us.
translation: 我们正在等待您的加入。 [wo men zheng zai deng dai nin de jia ru 。]

english: Woooo... Woooooo...
translation: 呜呜……呜呜…… [wu wu …… wu wu ……]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: You see me? You understand me?
translation: 你看我？你明白我的意思？ [ni kan wo ？ ni ming bai wo de yi si ？]

english: Yes. Who are you?
translation: 是的。你是谁？ [shi de 。 ni shi shui ？]

english: Me Hopespear of Narogoshuun tribe. Who you?
translation: 我是纳罗戈舒恩部落的希望之矛。你是谁？ [wo shi na luo ge shu en bu luo de xi wang zhi mao 。 ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm [player name].
translation: 我是[玩家姓名]。 [wo shi [ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: You not goblin. What you want here?
translation: 你不是妖精。你想要什么？ [ni bu shi yao jing 。 ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？ [ni wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: Me dead, but me not go. Long ago, me have vision of Big High War God. Me chosen prophet of Big High War God.
translation: 我死了，但我不会走。很久以前，我就看到了大高战神的异象。我选择了大高战神的先知。 [wo si le ， dan wo bu hui zou 。 hen jiu yi qian ， wo jiu kan dao le da gao zhan shen de yi xiang 。 wo xuan ze le da gao zhan shen de xian zhi 。]

english: Me think, when me die, Big High War God take me to reward in Yu'biusk. Every day great battle, every night great victory with feasting.
translation: 我想，当我死后，大高战神会带我去尤比斯克奖励。日日大战，夜宴大胜。 [wo xiang ， dang wo si hou ， da gao zhan shen hui dai wo qu you bi si ke jiang li 。 ri ri da zhan ， ye yan da sheng 。]

english: Big High War God not come, but me have faith. Someday Big High War God come for me, take me to him. Until then me hang on, not let go into death.
translation: 大高战神没有来，但我有信心。有一天，大高战神会来找我，带我去见他。在那之前我会坚持下去，不让自己走向死亡。 [da gao zhan shen mei you lai ， dan wo you xin xin 。 you yi tian ， da gao zhan shen hui lai zhao wo ， dai wo qu jian ta 。 zai na zhi qian wo hui jian chi xia qu ， bu rang zi ji zou xiang si wang 。]

english: I visited Yu'biusk.
translation: 我访问了尤比斯克。 [wo fang wen le you bi si ke 。]

english: You go to Yu'biusk? What you see?
translation: 你去尤比斯克吗？你看到了什么？ [ni qu you bi si ke ma ？ ni kan dao le shen me ？]

english: It was a wasteland.
translation: 那是一片荒地。 [na shi yi pian huang di 。]

english: Wasteland? No goblins fighting glorious battles?
translation: 荒地？没有妖精进行光荣的战斗吗？ [huang di ？ mei you yao jing jin xing guang rong de zhan dou ma ？]

english: No one. It was all empty.
translation: 没有人。一切都是空的。 [mei you ren 。 yi qie dou shi kong de 。]

english: You lie!
translation: 你撒谎！ [ni sa huang ！]

english: I'm not lying. It's what I saw.
translation: 我没有说谎。这就是我所看到的。 [wo mei you shuo huang 。 zhe jiu shi wo suo kan dao de 。]

english: Even so... Yu'biusk is place of Big High War God. Land of Goblins. It where goblins should go.
translation: 即便如此……尤比斯克是大高战神的所在地。哥布林之地。这是哥布林应该去的地方。 [ji bian ru ci …… you bi si ke shi da gao zhan shen de suo zai di 。 ge bu lin zhi di 。 zhe shi ge bu lin ying gai qu de di fang 。]

english: Will you do me favour?
translation: 你愿意帮我一个忙吗？ [ni yuan yi bang wo yi ge mang ma ？]

english: What favour?
translation: 什么恩惠？ [shen me en hui ？]

english: High priests in this tomb, when they die they believe they go to Yu'biusk. But their spirits still here.
translation: 这座坟墓中的高级祭司相信，当他们死后，他们会前往尤比斯克。但他们的精神还在这里。 [zhe zuo fen mu zhong de gao ji ji si xiang xin ， dang ta men si hou ， ta men hui qian wang you bi si ke 。 dan ta men de jing shen hai zai zhe li 。]

english: If you can go to Yu'biusk, you can take their bones and bury them there. Will you do this for me?
translation: 如果你能去尤比斯克，你就可以把他们的骨头埋在那里。你愿意为我做这件事吗？ [ru guo ni neng qu you bi si ke ， ni jiu ke yi ba ta men de gu tou mai zai na li 。 ni yuan yi wei wo zuo zhe jian shi ma ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: Thank you!
translation: 谢谢你！ [xie xie ni ！]

english: How can I get the bones? When I defeated them before, the high priests just spoke to me and then went back into the ground.
translation: 我怎样才能得到骨头？之前我打败他们的时候，大祭司只是对我说了一句话，然后就回到了地底。 [wo zen yang cai neng de dao gu tou ？ zhi qian wo da bai ta men de shi hou ， da ji si zhi shi dui wo shuo le yi ju hua ， ran hou jiu hui dao le di di 。]

english: Normally, undead goblin high priests cannot be destroyed, but there is ancient goblin combat ritual.
translation: 通常情况下，不死妖精大祭司是无法被消灭的，但有古老的妖精战斗仪式。 [tong chang qing kuang xia ， bu si yao jing da ji si shi wu fa bei xiao mie de ， dan you gu lao de yao jing zhan dou yi shi 。]

english: You must defeat high priests without using any weapons, armour or spells. Once you have bones, take them to Yu'biusk and bury them there.
translation: 你必须在不使用任何武器、盔甲或法术的情况下击败大祭司。一旦你有了骨头，就把它们带到尤比斯克并埋在那里。 [ni bi xu zai bu shi yong ren he wu qi 、 kui jia huo fa shu de qing kuang xia ji bai da ji si 。 yi dan ni you le gu tou ， jiu ba ta men dai dao you bi si ke bing mai zai na li 。]

english: I'll do that.
translation: 我会这么做的。 [wo hui zhe me zuo de 。]

english: Thank you, human.
translation: 谢谢你，人类。 [xie xie ni ， ren lei 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Me should know better than to ask human to do favour for dead goblin.
translation: 我应该更清楚不要请求人类为死去的哥布林提供帮助。 [wo ying gai geng qing chu bu yao qing qiu ren lei wei si qu di ge bu lin ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: It was everything you hope for.
translation: 这就是你所希望的一切。 [zhe jiu shi ni suo xi wang de yi qie 。]

english: Thank you! I know Big High War God still care for us! I wait for him here. Someday he take me to Yu'biusk to live with him.
translation: 谢谢你！我知道高战神还是很关心我们的！我在这里等他。有一天他带我去尤比斯克和他住在一起。 [xie xie ni ！ wo zhi dao gao zhan shen hai shi hen guan xin wo men de ！ wo zai zhe li deng ta 。 you yi tian ta dai wo qu you bi si ke he ta zhu zai yi qi 。]

english: In meantime, will you do me favour?
translation: 与此同时，你愿意帮我一个忙吗？ [yu ci tong shi ， ni yuan yi bang wo yi ge mang ma ？]

english: I should go.
translation: 我该走了。 [wo gai zou le 。]

english: Tell me about the Big High War God.
translation: 跟我说说大高战神吧。 [gen wo shuo shuo da gao zhan shen ba 。]

english: Big High War God greatest of all gods! He take puny goblins from Yu'biusk and make them mighty warriors for great war of gods!
translation: 大高战神，众神之中最伟大的神！他从尤比斯克中选取了微不足道的妖精，让他们成为伟大的诸神之战的强大战士！ [da gao zhan shen ， zhong shen zhi zhong zui wei da de shen ！ ta cong you bi si ke zhong xuan qu le wei bu zu dao de yao jing ， rang ta men cheng wei wei da de zhu shen zhi zhan de qiang da zhan shi ！]

english: When gods go to war, goblin soldiers so good that Big High War God sell tribes to fight for different gods. Big High War God fight with other gods, sometimes for one, sometimes another.
translation: 当众神发动战争时，哥布林士兵非常优秀，以至于大高战神会出卖部落来为不同的神而战。大高战神与其他神明战斗，有时为一个神，有时为另一个神。 [dang zhong shen fa dong zhan zheng shi ， ge bu lin shi bing fei chang you xiu ， yi zhi yu da gao zhan shen hui chu mai bu luo lai wei bu tong de shen er zhan 。 da gao zhan shen yu qi ta shen ming zhan dou ， you shi wei yi ge shen ， you shi wei ling yi ge shen 。]

english: Other gods fight for their own reasons, but Big High War God fight for war itself!
translation: 其他神明都是为了自己的理由而战，而大高战神却是为了战争本身而战！ [qi ta shen ming dou shi wei le zi ji de li you er zhan ， er da gao zhan shen que shi wei le zhan zheng ben shen er zhan ！]

english: Tell me more about yourself.
translation: 告诉我更多关于你自己的信息。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu ni zi ji de xin xi 。]

english: Me chosen prophet of Big High War God. Before I have prophecy, goblin tribes fight one another very much.
translation: 我选择了大高战神的先知。在我有预言之前，妖精部落之间经常互相争斗。 [wo xuan ze le da gao zhan shen de xian zhi 。 zai wo you yu yan zhi qian ， yao jing bu luo zhi jian jing chang hu xiang zheng dou 。]

english: Long ago we fight other people: beardy-short-people, pointy-hat-short-people, tall people with keen blades. Other people build cities with walls, and we not able to attack them any more.
translation: 很久以前，我们和其他人打架：长着胡子的矮个子，尖尖的帽子矮个子，高个子拿着锋利的刀。别人用城墙建造城市，我们无法再攻击他们。 [hen jiu yi qian ， wo men he qi ta ren da jia ： zhang zhe hu zi de ai ge zi ， jian jian de mao zi ai ge zi ， gao ge zi na zhe feng li de dao 。 bie ren yong cheng qiang jian zao cheng shi ， wo men wu fa zai gong ji ta men 。]

english: There not enough food for all tribes, so tribes with no food attack tribes who have food. Goblin war last many many years. Finally all tribes meet at this place, where temple is now.
translation: 没有足够的食物供所有部落使用，因此没有食物的部落会攻击有食物的部落。哥布林战争持续了很多年。最后，所有部落都在这个地方聚集，也就是现在的寺庙所在的地方。 [mei you zu gou de shi wu gong suo you bu luo shi yong ， yin ci mei you shi wu de bu luo hui gong ji you shi wu de bu luo 。 ge bu lin zhan zheng chi xu le hen duo nian 。 zui hou ， suo you bu luo dou zai zhe ge di fang ju ji ， ye jiu shi xian zai de si miao suo zai de di fang 。]

english: It rain many days. But rain not stop goblins. Goblin feet churn up ground with rain and goblin blood. All ground turn to mud. That why it called Battle of Plain of Mud.
translation: 下了很多天的雨。但下雨并不能阻止妖精的脚步。妖精的双脚用雨水和妖精的鲜血搅动着地面。所有地面都变成泥巴。这就是为什么它被称为泥泞平原之战。 [xia le hen duo tian de yu 。 dan xia yu bing bu neng zu zhi yao jing de jiao bu 。 yao jing de shuang jiao yong yu shui he yao jing de xian xue jiao dong zhe di mian 。 suo you di mian dou bian cheng ni ba 。 zhe jiu shi wei shen me ta bei cheng wei ni ning ping yuan zhi zhan 。]

english: Battle last many days. Both sides same size, none win, none lose. Goblin bodies everywhere. Many dead.
translation: 战斗持续了很多天。双方大小相同，无一胜负。到处都是哥布林的尸体。很多人死了。 [zhan dou chi xu le hen duo tian 。 shuang fang da xiao xiang tong ， wu yi sheng fu 。 dao chu dou shi ge bu lin de shi ti 。 hen duo ren si le 。]

english: Me not important general, not mighty sergeant. Me just normal goblin. But one night, me have dream.
translation: 我不是重要的将军，也不是威武的中士。我只是一个普通的妖精。但有一天晚上，我做了一个梦。 [wo bu shi zhong yao de jiang jun ， ye bu shi wei wu de zhong shi 。 wo zhi shi yi ge pu tong de yao jing 。 dan you yi tian wan shang ， wo zuo le yi ge meng 。]

english: Me see throne of Big High War God. He shine with light so bright me cannot see him, but me hear his voice.
translation: 我看到了高高战神的宝座。他发出的光芒如此明亮，我看不到他，但我听到他的声音。 [wo kan dao le gao gao zhan shen de bao zuo 。 ta fa chu de guang mang ru ci ming liang ， wo kan bu dao ta ， dan wo ting dao ta de sheng yin 。]

english: He say, 'Stop the fighting!' He say, 'Fighting good, but not if all my followers die! You must not fight one another so much you all die!'
translation: 他说：“停止战斗！”他说，‘战斗很好，但如果我所有的追随者都死了就不行了！你们不能互相争斗，以致你们都死了！” [ta shuo ：“ ting zhi zhan dou ！” ta shuo ，‘ zhan dou hen hao ， dan ru guo wo suo you de zhui sui zhe dou si le jiu bu xing le ！ ni men bu neng hu xiang zheng dou ， yi zhi ni men dou si le ！”]

english: Then he say, 'Today I cannot lead you, but some day I will send Chosen Commander to lead you.'
translation: 然后他说：“今天我无法领导你们，但有一天我会派天选指挥官来领导你们。” [ran hou ta shuo ：“ jin tian wo wu fa ling dao ni men ， dan you yi tian wo hui pai tian xuan zhi hui guan lai ling dao ni men 。”]

english: I see Chosen Commander in dream. He wear shining armour and stand at front of army of goblins. Behind Chosen Commander, goblins stretch to horizon. Many goblins, too many to count.
translation: 我在梦中见到天选指挥官。他穿着闪亮的盔甲，站在哥布林大军的前面。在天选指挥官身后，地精一直延伸到地平线。妖精很多，多得数不过来。 [wo zai meng zhong jian dao tian xuan zhi hui guan 。 ta chuan zhe shan liang de kui jia ， zhan zai ge bu lin da jun de qian mian 。 zai tian xuan zhi hui guan shen hou ， di jing yi zhi yan shen dao di ping xian 。 yao jing hen duo ， duo de shu bu guo lai 。]

english: I see banners of every tribe. Banners of all tribes, even Dorgesh tribe.
translation: 我看到每个部落的旗帜。所有部落的旗帜，甚至包括多尔格什部落。 [wo kan dao mei ge bu luo de qi zhi 。 suo you bu luo de qi zhi ， shen zhi bao kuo duo er ge shen bu luo 。]

english: Other races, they run away from mighty goblin army! Chosen Commander make goblins build siege machines and they break down walls of cities. Then goblins march in and kill everyone!
translation: 其他种族，他们逃离强大的妖精军队！被选中的指挥官让妖精建造攻城机器，并摧毁城市的城墙。然后妖精就会进来并杀死所有人！ [qi ta zhong zu ， ta men tao li qiang da de yao jing jun dui ！ bei xuan zhong de zhi hui guan rang yao jing jian zao gong cheng ji qi ， bing cui hui cheng shi de cheng qiang 。 ran hou yao jing jiu hui jin lai bing sha si suo you ren ！]

english: And when all dead, Big High War God himself appear and sit on great throne of bronze and rule over all, with Chosen Commander beside him.
translation: 当所有人都死后，至高战神亲自出现，坐在伟大的青铜宝座上统治一切，而天选指挥官就在他身边。 [dang suo you ren dou si hou ， zhi gao zhan shen qin zi chu xian ， zuo zai wei da de qing tong bao zuo shang tong zhi yi qie ， er tian xuan zhi hui guan jiu zai ta shen bian 。]

english: Then I wake from dream. I know it true vision from Big High War God. I run to general of my tribe, and he call other generals for emergency meeting.
translation: 然后我从梦中醒来。我知道这是来自大高战神的真实愿景。我跑去找部落的将军，他召集其他将军召开紧急会议。 [ran hou wo cong meng zhong xing lai 。 wo zhi dao zhe shi lai zi da gao zhan shen de zhen shi yuan jing 。 wo pao qu zhao bu luo de jiang jun ， ta zhao ji qi ta jiang jun zhao kai jin ji hui yi 。]

english: I tell all generals what I see. They decide to stop fighting so goblins not all die. By this time, so many had died that there enough food for all.
translation: 我告诉所有将军我所看到的。他们决定停止战斗，这样妖精就不会全部死亡。到这个时候，已经有很多人死亡了，所以食物已经足够所有人吃了。 [wo gao su suo you jiang jun wo suo kan dao de 。 ta men jue ding ting zhi zhan dou ， zhe yang yao jing jiu bu hui quan bu si wang 。 dao zhe ge shi hou ， yi jing you hen duo ren si wang le ， suo yi shi wu yi jing zu gou suo you ren chi le 。]

english: Then generals set goblins to work building temple on site of battle. It sink into mud, so they turn it into underground temple, and keep it secret from others.
translation: 然后将军们派妖精在战场上建造寺庙。它沉入泥土中，所以他们把它变成了地下寺庙，并向其他人保密。 [ran hou jiang jun men pai yao jing zai zhan chang shang jian zao si miao 。 ta chen ru ni tu zhong ， suo yi ta men ba ta bian cheng le di xia si miao ， bing xiang qi ta ren bao mi 。]

english: Goblins write my vision down in goblin holy book, along with history of goblins and commandments of Big High War God.
translation: 哥布林将我的愿景、哥布林的历史和至高战神的戒律一起写在哥布林圣书中。 [ge bu lin jiang wo de yuan jing 、 ge bu lin de li shi he zhi gao zhan shen de jie lv yi qi xie zai ge bu lin sheng shu zhong 。]

english: Tell me more about the Chosen Commander.
translation: 告诉我更多关于天选指挥官的事。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu tian xuan zhi hui guan de shi 。]

english: Me not know much more. In vision, Chosen Commander wear heavy armour and big helmet that cover face. Me not know what he look like. I see him give orders, but he far away so me not hear his voice.
translation: 我不知道更多。视野中，天选指挥官穿着重甲，戴着遮住脸的大头盔。我不知道他长什么样。我看到他在发号施令，但他离我很远，所以我听不到他的声音。 [wo bu zhi dao geng duo 。 shi ye zhong ， tian xuan zhi hui guan chuan zhe zhong jia ， dai zhe zhe zhu lian de da tou kui 。 wo bu zhi dao ta zhang shen me yang 。 wo kan dao ta zai fa hao shi ling ， dan ta li wo hen yuan ， suo yi wo ting bu dao ta de sheng yin 。]

english: Me think Chosen Commander will be great goblin general, but Big High War God chose me to have vision, not great general, so Chosen Commander could be anyone.
translation: 我认为天选指挥官会是伟大的妖精将军，但是大高战神选择我是为了有远见，而不是伟大的将军，所以天选指挥官可以是任何人。 [wo ren wei tian xuan zhi hui guan hui shi wei da de yao jing jiang jun ， dan shi da gao zhan shen xuan ze wo shi wei le you yuan jian ， er bu shi wei da de jiang jun ， suo yi tian xuan zhi hui guan ke yi shi ren he ren 。]

english: Nothing. I should go.
translation: 没有什么。我该走了。 [mei you shen me 。 wo gai zou le 。]

english: You take bones to Yu'biusk yet?
translation: 你把骨头带到尤比斯克了吗？ [ni ba gu tou dai dao you bi si ke le ma ？]

english: Not yet.
translation: 还没有。 [hai mei you 。]

english: You please do this for me, human. Remember, you must defeat high priests without using any weapons, armour or spells.
translation: 请你为我做这件事，人类。请记住，你必须在不使用任何武器、盔甲或咒语的情况下击败大祭司。 [qing ni wei wo zuo zhe jian shi ， ren lei 。 qing ji zhu ， ni bi xu zai bu shi yong ren he wu qi 、 kui jia huo zhou yu de qing kuang xia ji bai da ji si 。]

english: I did.
translation: 我做到了。 [wo zuo dao le 。]

english: Thank you. Not many humans like you. Now goblin high priests can rest.
translation: 谢谢。像你这样的人不多。现在妖精大祭司可以休息了。 [xie xie 。 xiang ni zhe yang de ren bu duo 。 xian zai yao jing da ji si ke yi xiu xi le 。]

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？ [ni wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: I visited Yu'biusk.
translation: 我访问了尤比斯克。 [wo fang wen le you bi si ke 。]

english: It was a wasteland.
translation: 那是一片荒地。 [na shi yi pian huang di 。]

english: What favour?
translation: 什么恩惠？ [shen me en hui ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: I'll do that.
translation: 我会这么做的。 [wo hui zhe me zuo de 。]

english: Tell me about the Big High War God.
translation: 跟我说说大高战神吧。 [gen wo shuo shuo da gao zhan shen ba 。]

english: Tell me more about yourself.
translation: 告诉我更多关于你自己的信息。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu ni zi ji de xin xi 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: It was everything you hope for.
translation: 这就是你所希望的一切。 [zhe jiu shi ni suo xi wang de yi qie 。]

english: I should go.
translation: 我该走了。 [wo gai zou le 。]

english: Tell me more about the Chosen Commander.
translation: 告诉我更多关于天选指挥官的事。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu tian xuan zhi hui guan de shi 。]

english: Nothing. I should go.
translation: 没有什么。我该走了。 [mei you shen me 。 wo gai zou le 。]

english: WOOOOO!
translation: 哇哦！ [wa o ！]

english: Aaaah!
translation: 啊啊啊！ [a a a ！]

english: Children, run quickly!
translation: 孩子们，快跑吧！ [hai zi men ， kuai pao ba ！]

english: Oh my gods, the dragon is coming back!
translation: 天哪，龙又回来了！ [tian na ， long you hui lai le ！]

english: Quickly, run!
translation: 快点，跑！ [kuai dian ， pao ！]

english: WOOO woooo wooo WOOOO!
translation: 呜呜呜呜呜！ [wu wu wu wu wu ！]

english: Get the women and children to the boats!
translation: 让妇女和儿童上船！ [rang fu nv he er tong shang chuan ！]

english: On the horizon! Do you see it?
translation: 就在地平线上！你看到了吗？ [jiu zai di ping xian shang ！ ni kan dao le ma ？]

english: Put that fire out!
translation: 把火扑灭！ [ba huo pu mie ！]

english: Wooo wooo wooOOooOOoo!
translation: 呜呜呜呜呜呜呜！ [wu wu wu wu wu wu wu ！]

english: Eeeek!
translation: 哎呀！ [ai ya ！]

english: EIEEEEE!
translation: 哎呀哎呀！ [ai ya ai ya ！]

english: Mummy, are we safe now?
translation: 妈妈，我们现在安全了吗？ [ma ma ， wo men xian zai an quan le ma ？]

english: Mummy! Where are you?
translation: 木乃伊！你在哪里？ [mu nai yi ！ ni zai na li ？]

english: Wooo wooo woooooooo!
translation: 呜呜呜呜呜呜！ [wu wu wu wu wu wu ！]

english: I don't want to die like this!
translation: 我不想就这样死掉！ [wo bu xiang jiu zhe yang si diao ！]

english: Oh no!
translation: 哦不！ [o bu ！]

english: Someone help me! I'm trapped!
translation: 有人帮帮我吧！我被困住了！ [you ren bang bang wo ba ！ wo bei kun zhu le ！]

english: AAARGH!
translation: 啊啊！ [a a ！]

english: Come on, you monster! Just finish me!
translation: 来吧，你这个怪物！干掉我吧！ [lai ba ， ni zhe ge guai wu ！ gan diao wo ba ！]

english: It's hopeless. We're all going to die!
translation: 这是没有希望的。我们都会死！ [zhe shi mei you xi wang de 。 wo men du hui si ！]

english: We're all doomed.
translation: 我们都注定了。 [wo men dou zhu ding le 。]

english: Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
translation: 呜呜呜呜呜呜 [wu wu wu wu wu wu]

english: You cannot understand the ghost.
translation: 你无法理解鬼魂。 [ni wu fa li jie gui hun 。]

english: Don't send me back to that library!
translation: 别把我送回那个图书馆！ [bie ba wo song hui na ge tu shu guan ！]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: It took me too long to get out of there... Just don't send me back!
translation: 我花了太长时间才离开那里...只是不要把我送回去！ [wo hua le tai zhang shi jian cai li kai na li ... zhi shi bu yao ba wo song hui qu ！]

english: Woooo wooo wooooo woooo.
translation: 呜呜呜呜呜呜。 [wu wu wu wu wu wu 。]

english: You there! Seek out the centurion at once. Inform him that the enemy leader has been identified and the Carnifex Maximus himself has been dispatched to bring back his head!
translation: 你在那里！立刻去找百夫长。通知他敌方首领已被识别，大食肉龙本人已被派去取回他的头颅！ [ni zai na li ！ li ke qu zhao bai fu zhang 。 tong zhi ta di fang shou ling yi bei shi bie ， da shi rou long ben ren yi bei pai qu qu hui ta de tou lu ！]

english: Err... What?
translation: 呃...什么？ [e ... shen me ？]

english: Did you not hear me? Do I need to spell it out for you?
translation: 你没听到我说话吗？需要我给你拼出来吗？ [ni mei ting dao wo shuo hua ma ？ xu yao wo gei ni pin chu lai ma ？]

english: If you could that would be great.
translation: 如果可以那就太好了。 [ru guo ke yi na jiu tai hao le 。]

english: Goodness you are a fool! Their leader is named Yonrith Lovakengj. He has fled to the west with his closest allies, but much of his army still remains. Carnifex Maximus Vardorvis is in pursuit of him.
translation: 天哪你是个傻瓜！他们的领袖名叫永里斯·洛瓦肯吉 (Yonrith Lovakenj)。他与最亲密的盟友逃往西方，但他的大部分军队仍然留存。 Carnifex Maximus Vardorvis 正在追捕他。 [tian na ni shi ge sha gua ！ ta men de ling xiu ming jiao yong li si · luo wa ken ji  (Yonrith Lovakenj)。 ta yu zui qin mi de meng you tao wang xi fang ， dan ta de da bu fen jun dui reng ran liu cun 。 Carnifex Maximus Vardorvis  zheng zai zhui bu ta 。]

english: Yeah... I still have no idea what you're on about.
translation: 是啊...我还是不知道你在说什么。 [shi a ... wo hai shi bu zhi dao ni zai shuo shen me 。]

english: Useless! Perhaps the headsman needs to take your head as well. I will find the centurion myself!
translation: 无用！也许刽子手也需要砍下你的头。我会亲自找到百夫长！ [wu yong ！ ye xu gui zi shou ye xu yao kan xia ni de tou 。 wo hui qin zi zhao dao bai fu zhang ！]

english: Okay... Good luck with that.
translation: 好吧...祝你好运。 [hao ba ... zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Ah, there you are. Dire news I'm afraid. We've lost all contact with the capital. Worse, another dwarven clan has joined the Saradominists. They march upon the fortress as we speak.
translation: 啊，你来了。恐怕是个可怕的消息。我们与首都失去了所有联系。更糟糕的是，另一个矮人氏族加入了萨拉多米主义者。就在我们说话的时候，他们正在向要塞进军。 [a ， ni lai le 。 kong pa shi ge ke pa de xiao xi 。 wo men yu shou du shi qu le suo you lian xi 。 geng zao gao de shi ， ling yi ge ai ren shi zu jia ru le sa la duo mi zhu yi zhe 。 jiu zai wo men shuo hua de shi hou ， ta men zheng zai xiang yao sai jin jun 。]

english: Oh... Oh dear?
translation: 哦...哦亲爱的？ [o ... o qin ai de ？]

english: Is everything all right my friend? You don't seem to be yourself.
translation: 一切都好吗我的朋友？你看起来不像你自己。 [yi qie dou hao ma wo de peng you ？ ni kan qi lai bu xiang ni zi ji 。]

english: I don't think I'm who you believe I am.
translation: 我不认为我是你所相信的那个人。 [wo bu ren wei wo shi ni suo xiang xin de na ge ren 。]

english: Hmm. You're clearly confused. The lack of sleep is getting to you. Go and have a lie down and we will discuss this later.
translation: 唔。你显然很困惑。睡眠不足正在影响你。去躺下吧，我们稍后再讨论这个问题。 [wu 。 ni xian ran hen kun huo 。 shui mian bu zu zheng zai ying xiang ni 。 qu tang xia ba ， wo men shao hou zai tao lun zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Alright...
translation: 好吧... [hao ba ...]

english: I've been doing some research into our new foes. Rumour has it they once lived in a great city in the far north. The city fell and now they are homeless.
translation: 我一直在对我们的新敌人进行一些研究。有传言说他们曾经住在遥远北方的一座大城市里。城市陷落，现在他们无家可归。 [wo yi zhi zai dui wo men de xin di ren jin xing yi xie yan jiu 。 you chuan yan shuo ta men ceng jing zhu zai yao yuan bei fang de yi zuo da cheng shi li 。 cheng shi xian luo ， xian zai ta men wu jia ke gui 。]

english: It seems they have been promised a new home here in return for wiping us out. We must take great care. We may be fighting for our home, but it seems they are as well.
translation: 似乎他们被许诺在这里有一个新家，以换取消灭我们的代价。我们必须非常小心。我们可能正在为我们的家园而战，但他们似乎也是如此。 [si hu ta men bei xu nuo zai zhe li you yi ge xin jia ， yi huan qu xiao mie wo men de dai jia 。 wo men bi xu fei chang xiao xin 。 wo men ke neng zheng zai wei wo men de jia yuan er zhan ， dan ta men si hu ye shi ru ci 。]

english: Right... And err, how's the fight going so far?
translation: 对了……还有呃，到目前为止战斗进行得怎么样？ [dui le …… hai you e ， dao mu qian wei zhi zhan dou jin xing de zen me yang ？]

english: You tell me, I'm no warrior. That said, I did hear that they'd managed to turn some of our own golems against us. If they can do that, I fear what else they may do.
translation: 你告诉我，我不是战士。尽管如此，我确实听说他们成功地让我们自己的一些傀儡来反对我们。如果他们能做到这一点，我担心他们还会做什么。 [ni gao su wo ， wo bu shi zhan shi 。 jin guan ru ci ， wo que shi ting shuo ta men cheng gong di rang wo men zi ji de yi xie kui lei lai fan dui wo men 。 ru guo ta men neng zuo dao zhe yi dian ， wo dan xin ta men hai hui zuo shen me 。]

english: Oh my... That doesn't sound good...
translation: 哦天啊……听起来不太好…… [o tian a …… ting qi lai bu tai hao ……]

english: Indeed. We have increased our offerings tenfold, but I fear they fall on empty ears. Perhaps our lord really has gone.
translation: 的确。我们的供奉增加了十倍，但我担心它们会落空。也许我们的主真的走了。 [di que 。 wo men de gong feng zeng jia le shi bei ， dan wo dan xin ta men hui luo kong 。 ye xu wo men de zhu zhen de zou le 。]

english: Hmm. Well I hope it all works out.
translation: 唔。好吧，我希望一切顺利。 [wu 。 hao ba ， wo xi wang yi qie shun li 。]

english: Whoooo wooo Whooooooooo.
translation: 呜呜呜呜呜呜。 [wu wu wu wu wu wu 。]

english: I fought a really big ghost dog in here - is he gone now?
translation: 我在这里和一只非常大的鬼狗战斗——他现在走了吗？ [wo zai zhe li he yi zhi fei chang da de gui gou zhan dou —— ta xian zai zou le ma ？]

english: You were well rewarded for you effort. But you should leave this place, for it is not wise to tarry.
translation: 你的努力得到了很好的回报。但你应该离开这个地方，因为停留并不明智。 [ni de nu li de dao le hen hao de hui bao 。 dan ni ying gai li kai zhe ge di fang ， yin wei ting liu bing bu ming zhi 。]

english: But I lost my shadow sword and I don't know how to get it back.
translation: 但我的暗影剑丢了，我不知道如何找回来。 [dan wo de an ying jian diu le ， wo bu zhi dao ru he zhao hui lai 。]

english: Ah, so that is why you return. I can assist you in that and give you another.
translation: 啊，这就是你回来的原因。我可以在这方面帮助你，并给你另一个。 [a ， zhe jiu shi ni hui lai de yuan yin 。 wo ke yi zai zhe fang mian bang zhu ni ， bing gei ni ling yi ge 。]

english: Who are you anyway...or were you...?
translation: 你到底是谁……或者你本来就是……？ [ni dao di shi shui …… huo zhe ni ben lai jiu shi ……？]

english: Who I was does not matter. Now, I am a guardian for the Shadow Realm and I am protecting this area from any more disturbances.
translation: 我是谁并不重要。现在，我是暗影界的守护者，我正在保护这个地区免受更多的干扰。 [wo shi shui bing bu zhong yao 。 xian zai ， wo shi an ying jie de shou hu zhe ， wo zheng zai bao hu zhe ge di qu mian shou geng duo de gan rao 。]

english: There are those who walk in the Shadow Realm who should not.
translation: 有些人不应该在暗影界行走。 [you xie ren bu ying gai zai an ying jie xing zou 。]

english: Good day, how may I help you?
translation: 美好的一天，我能为您做些什么吗？ [mei hao de yi tian ， wo neng wei nin zuo xie shen me ma ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This is a branch of the Bank of Gielinor. We have branches in many towns.
translation: 这是吉林诺银行的一个分行。我们在很多城镇都有分店。 [zhe shi ji lin nuo yin hang de yi ge fen hang 。 wo men zai hen duo cheng zhen dou you fen dian 。]

english: And what do you do?
translation: 你做什么？ [ni zuo shen me ？]

english: We will look after your items and money for you. Leave your valuables with us if you want to keep them safe.
translation: 我们将为您保管您的物品和金钱。如果您想保证贵重物品的安全，请将其交给我们。 [wo men jiang wei nin bao guan nin de wu pin he jin qian 。 ru guo nin xiang bao zheng gui zhong wu pin de an quan ， qing jiang qi jiao gei wo men 。]

english: Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
translation: 呜呜呜呜呜呜 [wu wu wu wu wu wu]

english: The ghost banker wails incomprehensibly at you, but seems to understand that you wish to access your bank account. You can still quick-bank, but will have to communicate via a series of hand gestures.
translation: 幽灵银行家对你莫名其妙地哭泣，但似乎明白你想访问你的银行账户。您仍然可以快速银行，但必须通过一系列手势进行交流。 [you ling yin hang jia dui ni mo ming qi miao di ku qi ， dan si hu ming bai ni xiang fang wen ni de yin hang zhang hu 。 nin reng ran ke yi kuai su yin hang ， dan bi xu tong guo yi xi lie shou shi jin xing jiao liu 。]

english: I'd like to access my bank account, please.
translation: 我想访问我的银行帐户。 [wo xiang fang wen wo de yin hang zhang hu 。]

english: I'd like to check my PIN settings.
translation: 我想检查我的 PIN 设置。 [wo xiang jian cha wo de  PIN  she zhi 。]

english: I'd like to collect items.
translation: 我想收集物品。 [wo xiang shou ji wu pin 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Would you like to visit Dragontooth Island? It is a most pleasant island in the sea between Morytania and the lands of the east.
translation: 你想去龙牙岛吗？它是莫里塔尼亚和东方陆地之间海上最宜人的岛屿。 [ni xiang qu long ya dao ma ？ ta shi mo li ta ni ya he dong fang lu di zhi jian hai shang zui yi ren de dao yu 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Player is rowed to Dragontooth Island
translation: 玩家被划到龙牙岛 [wan jia bei hua dao long ya dao]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Can you take me back to Phasmatys, now?
translation: 现在你能带我回法斯马蒂斯吗？ [xian zai ni neng dai wo hui fa si ma di si ma ？]

english: Yes, climb in.
translation: 是的，爬进去。 [shi de ， pa jin qu 。]

english: Player is rowed to Port Phasmatys
translation: 玩家被划到 Phasmatys 港 [wan jia bei hua dao  Phasmatys  gang]

english: There isn't much on this island, is there?
translation: 这个岛上没什么东西，不是吗？ [zhe ge dao shang mei shen me dong xi ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Beautiful isn't it?
translation: 很漂亮不是吗？ [hen piao liang bu shi ma ？]

english: But it cost me a lot of ectotokens to get here!
translation: 但我花了很多 ectotokens 才到达这里！ [dan wo hua le hen duo  ectotokens  cai dao da zhe li ！]

english: Worth every token, if you ask me.
translation: 如果你问我的话，每一个代币都是值得的。 [ru guo ni wen wo de hua ， mei yi ge dai bi dou shi zhi de de 。]

english: Actually, I don't want anything.
translation: 其实我什么都不想要 [qi shi wo shen me dou bu xiang yao]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Can you take me back to Phasmatys, now?
translation: 现在你能带我回法斯马蒂斯吗？ [xian zai ni neng dai wo hui fa si ma di si ma ？]

english: There isn't much on this island, is there?
translation: 这个岛上没什么东西，不是吗？ [zhe ge dao shang mei shen me dong xi ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Actually, I don't want anything.
translation: 其实我什么都不想要 [qi shi wo shen me dou bu xiang yao]

english: What is this strange fountain?
translation: 这个奇怪的喷泉是什么？ [zhe ge qi guai de pen quan shi shen me ？]

english: This is the Ectofuntus, the most marvellous creation of Necrovarus, our glorious leader.
translation: 这是 Ectofuntus，我们光荣的领袖 Necrovarus 最奇妙的创造物。 [zhe shi  Ectofuntus， wo men guang rong de ling xiu  Necrovarus  zui qi miao de chuang zao wu 。]

english: What is the Ectofuntus for?
translation: Ectofuntus 有何用途？ [Ectofuntus  you he yong tu ？]

english: It provides the power to keep us ghosts from passing over into the next plane of existence.
translation: 它提供了阻止我们鬼魂进入下一个存在层面的力量。 [ta ti gong le zu zhi wo men gui hun jin ru xia yi ge cun zai ceng mian de li liang 。]

english: And how does it work?
translation: 它是如何运作的？ [ta shi ru he yun zuo de ？]

english: You have to pour a bucket of ectoplasm into the fountain, a pot of ground bones, and then worship at the Ectofuntus. A unit of unholy power will then be created.
translation: 你得把一桶灵质倒入喷泉里，一盆磨碎的骨头，然后去灵泉礼拜。然后将创建一个邪恶力量单位。 [ni de ba yi tong ling zhi dao ru pen quan li ， yi pen mo sui de gu tou ， ran hou qu ling quan li bai 。 ran hou jiang chuang jian yi ge xie e li liang dan wei 。]

english: Can you do it yourself?
translation: 你自己可以做吗？ [ni zi ji ke yi zuo ma ？]

english: No, we must rely upon the living, as the worship of the undead no longer holds any inherent power.
translation: 不，我们必须依靠生者，因为对不死者的崇拜不再具有任何固有的力量。 [bu ， wo men bi xu yi kao sheng zhe ， yin wei dui bu si zhe de chong bai bu zai ju you ren he gu you de li liang 。]

english: Why would people waste their time helping you out?
translation: 人们为什么要浪费时间来帮助你？ [ren men wei shen me yao lang fei shi jian lai bang zhu ni ？]

english: For every unit of power produced we will give you five Ectotokens. These tokens can be used in Port Phasmatys to purchase various services, not least of which includes access through the main toll gates.
translation: 每产生一单位电力，我们都会为您提供 5 个 Ectotokens。这些代币可在 Phasmatys 港用于购买各种服务，尤其包括通过主要收费站的通道。 [mei chan sheng yi dan wei dian li ， wo men du hui wei nin ti gong  5  ge  Ectotokens。 zhe xie dai bi ke zai  Phasmatys  gang yong yu gou mai ge zhong fu wu ， you qi bao kuo tong guo zhu yao shou fei zhan de tong dao 。]

english: Where do I get ectoplasm from?
translation: 我从哪里获得灵质？ [wo cong na li huo de ling zhi ？]

english: Necrovarus sensed the power bubbling beneath our feet, and we delved long and deep beneath Port Phasmatys, until we found a pool of natural ectoplasm. You may find it by using the trapdoor over there.
translation: Necrovarus 感觉到我们脚下的力量在冒泡，我们在 Phasmatys 港下方深入探索，直到发现了一池天然灵质。你可以通过那边的活板门找到它。 [Necrovarus  gan jue dao wo men jiao xia de li liang zai mao pao ， wo men zai  Phasmatys  gang xia fang shen ru tan suo ， zhi dao fa xian le yi chi tian ran ling zhi 。 ni ke yi tong guo na bian de huo ban men zhao dao ta 。]

english: How do I grind bones?
translation: 怎样磨骨头？ [zen yang mo gu tou ？]

english: There is a bone grinding machine upstairs. Put bones of any type into the machine's hopper, and then turn the handle to grind them. You will need a pot to empty the machine of ground up bones.
translation: 楼上有一台磨骨机。将任何类型的骨头放入机器的料斗中，然后转动手柄将其磨碎。您需要一个锅来清空机器中的碎骨头。 [lou shang you yi tai mo gu ji 。 jiang ren he lei xing de gu tou fang ru ji qi de liao dou zhong ， ran hou zhuan dong shou bing jiang qi mo sui 。 nin xu yao yi ge guo lai qing kong ji qi zhong de sui gu tou 。]

english: How do I receive Ectotokens?
translation: 我如何接收 Ectotokens？ [wo ru he jie shou  Ectotokens？]

english: We disciples keep track of how many units of power have been produced. Just talk to us once you have generated some and we will reimburse you with the correct amount of Ectotokens.
translation: 我们弟子记录已经产生了多少单位的力量。一旦您生成了一些 Ectotoken，请与我们联系，我们将向您补偿正确数量的 Ectotoken。 [wo men di zi ji lu yi jing chan sheng le duo shao dan wei de li liang 。 yi dan nin sheng cheng le yi xie  Ectotoken， qing yu wo men lian xi ， wo men jiang xiang nin bu chang zheng que shu liang de  Ectotoken。]

english: How do I generate units of power?
translation: 如何生成功率单位？ [ru he sheng cheng gong lv dan wei ？]

english: You have to pour a bucket of ectoplasm into the fountain and then worship at the Ectofuntus with a pot of ground bones. This will create a unit of unholy power.
translation: 你必须将一桶灵质倒入喷泉中，然后用一盆磨碎的骨头去灵质礼拜。这将创建一个邪恶力量单位。 [ni bi xu jiang yi tong ling zhi dao ru pen quan zhong ， ran hou yong yi pen mo sui de gu tou qu ling zhi li bai 。 zhe jiang chuang jian yi ge xie e li liang dan wei 。]

english: Thanks for your time.
translation: 感谢您抽出时间。 [gan xie nin chou chu shi jian 。]

english: Can I have another bonecrusher, please?
translation: 我可以再要一个碎骨机吗？ [wo ke yi zai yao yi ge sui gu ji ma ？]

english: Compliments of Morytania for your efforts throughout the tasks set.
translation: Morytania 对您在整个任务中所做的努力表示赞扬。 [Morytania  dui nin zai zheng ge ren wu zhong suo zuo de nu li biao shi zan yang 。]

english: You already appear to own such a device, mortal.
translation: 你似乎已经拥有这样的设备了，凡人。 [ni si hu yi jing yong you zhe yang de she bei le ， fan ren 。]

english: Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
translation: 呜呜呜呜呜呜 [wu wu wu wu wu wu]

english: Can I have the tokens I have earned?
translation: 我可以拥有我赚取的代币吗？ [wo ke yi yong you wo zhuan qu de dai bi ma ？]

english: I have [number] ectotokens waiting for you mortal, but you do not have room in your inventory for them.
translation: 我有[数量]个外币在等着你凡人，但你的库存中没有空间容纳它们。 [wo you [ shu liang ] ge wai bi zai deng zhe ni fan ren ， dan ni de ku cun zhong mei you kong jian rong na ta men 。]

english: Certainly, mortal. Here's [number] ectotokens.
translation: 当然，凡人。这是 [number] 个 ectotoken。 [dang ran ， fan ren 。 zhe shi  [number]  ge  ectotoken。]

english: What is the Ectofuntus for?
translation: Ectofuntus 有何用途？ [Ectofuntus  you he yong tu ？]

english: Where do I get ectoplasm from?
translation: 我从哪里获得灵质？ [wo cong na li huo de ling zhi ？]

english: How do I grind bones?
translation: 怎样磨骨头？ [zen yang mo gu tou ？]

english: How do I receive Ectotokens?
translation: 我如何接收 Ectotokens？ [wo ru he jie shou  Ectotokens？]

english: Thanks for your time.
translation: 感谢您抽出时间。 [gan xie nin chou chu shi jian 。]

english: Can I have another bonecrusher, please?
translation: 我可以再要一个碎骨机吗？ [wo ke yi zai yao yi ge sui gu ji ma ？]

english: What is this strange fountain?
translation: 这个奇怪的喷泉是什么？ [zhe ge qi guai de pen quan shi shen me ？]

english: All visitors to Port Phasmatys must pay a toll charge of 2 Ectotokens.
translation: 所有前往 Phasmatys 港的游客都必须支付 2 个 Ectotoken 的通行费。 [suo you qian wang  Phasmatys  gang de you ke dou bi xu zhi fu  2  ge  Ectotoken  de tong xing fei 。]

english: I would like to enter Port Phasmatys - here's 2 Ectotokens.
translation: 我想进入 Phasmatys 港 - 这里有 2 个 Ectotokens。 [wo xiang jin ru  Phasmatys  gang  -  zhe li you  2  ge  Ectotokens。]

english: Player goes through the gate.
translation: 玩家穿过大门。 [wan jia chuan guo da men 。]

english: I'm not paying you Ectotokens just to go through a gate.
translation: 我不会付给你 Ectotokens 只是为了让你通过大门。 [wo bu hui fu gei ni  Ectotokens  zhi shi wei le rang ni tong guo da men 。]

english: Sorry - it's Town Policy.
translation: 抱歉 - 这是城镇政策。 [bao qian  -  zhe shi cheng zhen zheng ce 。]

english: Where can I get Ectotokens?
translation: 我在哪里可以获得 Ectotokens？ [wo zai na li ke yi huo de  Ectotokens？]

english: You need to go to the Temple and earn some. Talk to the disciples - they will tell you how.
translation: 你需要去寺庙赚一些。与门徒交谈 - 他们会告诉你如何做。 [ni xu yao qu si miao zhuan yi xie 。 yu men tu jiao tan  -  ta men hui gao su ni ru he zuo 。]

english: The ghostly guards wail at you incomprehensibly, and though you cannot understand their exact words you understand their meaning - you may not pass the barriers of Port Phasmatys.
translation: 幽灵守卫莫名其妙地向你哀嚎，虽然你无法理解他们的确切话语，但你明白他们的意思——你可能无法通过法斯马蒂斯港的屏障。 [you ling shou wei mo ming qi miao di xiang ni ai hao ， sui ran ni wu fa li jie ta men de que qie hua yu ， dan ni ming bai ta men de yi si —— ni ke neng wu fa tong guo fa si ma di si gang de ping zhang 。]

english: All visitors to Port Phasmatys must pay a toll charge of 2 Ectotokens. However, you have done the ghosts of our town a service that surpasses all value, so you may pass without charge.
translation: 所有前往 Phasmatys 港的游客都必须支付 2 个 Ectotoken 的通行费。然而，你为我们镇上的鬼魂做出了超越一切价值的贡献，所以你可以免费通过。 [suo you qian wang  Phasmatys  gang de you ke dou bi xu zhi fu  2  ge  Ectotoken  de tong xing fei 。 ran er ， ni wei wo men zhen shang de gui hun zuo chu le chao yue yi qie jia zhi de gong xian ， suo yi ni ke yi mian fei tong guo 。]

english: The ghostly guards wail at you incomprehensibly, and though you cannot understand their exact words you understand their meaning - you may pass the barriers of Port Phasmatys without charge.
translation: 幽灵守卫莫名其妙地向你哀嚎，虽然你无法理解他们的确切话语，但你明白他们的意思——你可以免费通过法斯马蒂斯港的屏障。 [you ling shou wei mo ming qi miao di xiang ni ai hao ， sui ran ni wu fa li jie ta men de que qie hua yu ， dan ni ming bai ta men de yi si —— ni ke yi mian fei tong guo fa si ma di si gang de ping zhang 。]

english: I would like to enter Port Phasmatys - here's 2 Ectotokens.
translation: 我想进入 Phasmatys 港 - 这里有 2 个 Ectotokens。 [wo xiang jin ru  Phasmatys  gang  -  zhe li you  2  ge  Ectotokens。]

english: I'm not paying you Ectotokens just to go through a gate.
translation: 我不会付给你 Ectotokens 只是为了让你通过大门。 [wo bu hui fu gei ni  Ectotokens  zhi shi wei le rang ni tong guo da men 。]

english: Where can I get Ectotokens?
translation: 我在哪里可以获得 Ectotokens？ [wo zai na li ke yi huo de  Ectotokens？]

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好呀！ [ni hao ya ！]

english: Greetings, traveller. Welcome to 'The Green Ghost' Tavern. What can I do you for?
translation: 你好，旅行者。欢迎来到“绿幽灵”酒馆。我能为你做什么？ [ni hao ， lv xing zhe 。 huan ying lai dao “ lv you ling ” jiu guan 。 wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: Can I buy a beer?
translation: 我可以买啤酒吗？ [wo ke yi mai pi jiu ma ？]

english: Sorry, but our pumps dried up over half a century ago. We of this village do not have much of a thirst these days.
translation: 抱歉，我们的水泵在半个多世纪前就干涸了。我们这个村子这些天不太渴了。 [bao qian ， wo men de shui beng zai ban ge duo shi ji qian jiu gan he le 。 wo men zhe ge cun zi zhe xie tian bu tai ke le 。]

english: Can I hear some gossip?
translation: 我能听听八卦吗？ [wo neng ting ting ba gua ma ？]

english: I suppose, as long as you keep it to yourself...
translation: 我想，只要你自己保守秘密…… [wo xiang ， zhi yao ni zi ji bao shou mi mi ……]

english: You see Gravingas out there in the marketplace? He speaks for the silent majority of Port Phasmatys, for those of us who would prefer to pass over into the next world.
translation: 你在市场上看到 Gravingas 了吗？他代表法斯马蒂斯港沉默的大多数，代表我们这些宁愿进入下一个世界的人。 [ni zai shi chang shang kan dao  Gravingas  le ma ？ ta dai biao fa si ma di si gang chen mo de da duo shu ， dai biao wo men zhe xie ning yuan jin ru xia yi ge shi jie de ren 。]

english: What happened to the folk of this town?
translation: 这个镇上的人到底怎么了？ [zhe ge zhen shang de ren dao di zen me le ？]

english: That's a long story, my friend, but you look like you have the time...
translation: 这是一个很长的故事，我的朋友，但你看起来有时间...... [zhe shi yi ge hen zhang de gu shi ， wo de peng you ， dan ni kan qi lai you shi jian ......]

english: Do you know why ghosts exist?
translation: 你知道为什么会有鬼吗？ [ni zhi dao wei shen me hui you gui ma ？]

english: A ghost is a soul left in limbo, unable to pass over to the next world; they might have something left to do in this world that torments them, or they might just have died in a state of confusion.
translation: 鬼是处于地狱边缘的灵魂，无法进入下一个世界；他们可能在这个世界上还有一些事情要做，这会折磨他们，或者他们可能只是在混乱中死去。 [gui shi chu yu di yu bian yuan de ling hun ， wu fa jin ru xia yi ge shi jie ； ta men ke neng zai zhe ge shi jie shang hai you yi xie shi qing yao zuo ， zhe hui zhe mo ta men ， huo zhe ta men ke neng zhi shi zai hun luan zhong si qu 。]

english: Yes, that is normally the case. But here in Port Phasmatys, we of this town once chose freely to become ghosts!
translation: 是的，通常情况就是这样。但在法斯马蒂斯港，我们这个小镇曾经自由地选择成为鬼魂！ [shi de ， tong chang qing kuang jiu shi zhe yang 。 dan zai fa si ma di si gang ， wo men zhe ge xiao zhen ceng jing zi you di xuan ze cheng wei gui hun ！]

english: Why on earth would you do such a thing?
translation: 你到底为什么要做这样的事？ [ni dao di wei shen me yao zuo zhe yang de shi ？]

english: It is a long story. Many years ago, this was a thriving port, a trading centre to the eastern lands of Gielinor. We became rich on the profits made from the traders that came across the eastern seas.
