translation: 这是一个很长的故事。许多年前，这里是一个繁荣的港口，是吉林诺东部地区的贸易中心。我们靠东海商人的利润致富。 [zhe shi yi ge hen zhang de gu shi 。 xu duo nian qian ， zhe li shi yi ge fan rong de gang kou ， shi ji lin nuo dong bu di qu de mao yi zhong xin 。 wo men kao dong hai shang ren de li run zhi fu 。]

english: We were very happy... until Lord Drakan noticed us.
translation: 我们非常高兴......直到德拉坎勋爵注意到我们。 [wo men fei chang gao xing ...... zhi dao de la kan xun jue zhu yi dao wo men 。]

english: He sent unholy creatures to demand that a blood-tithe be paid to the Lord Vampyre, as is required from all in the domain of Morytania. We had no choice but to agree to his demands.
translation: 他派遣邪恶的生物要求向吸血鬼领主缴纳血税，正如莫里塔尼亚境内所有人的要求一样。我们没办法，只能答应他的要求。 [ta pai qian xie e de sheng wu yao qiu xiang xi xue gui ling zhu jiao na xue shui ， zheng ru mo li ta ni ya jing nei suo you ren de yao qiu yi yang 。 wo men mei ban fa ， zhi neng da ying ta de yao qiu 。]

english: As the years went by, our numbers dwindled and many spoke of abandoning the town for safer lands. Then, Necrovarus came to us.
translation: 随着时间的流逝，我们的人数逐渐减少，许多人谈到要放弃这座城镇，前往更安全的地方。然后，Necrovarus 来到了我们身边。 [sui zhe shi jian de liu shi ， wo men de ren shu zhu jian jian shao ， xu duo ren tan dao yao fang qi zhe zuo cheng zhen ， qian wang geng an quan de di fang 。 ran hou ，Necrovarus  lai dao le wo men shen bian 。]

english: He came from the eastern lands, but of more than that, little is known. Some say he was once a mage, some say a priest. Either way, he was in possession of knowledge totally unknown to even the most learned among us.
translation: 他来自东方，但除此之外，人们知之甚少。有人说他曾经是一名法师，有人说他曾经是一名牧师。不管怎样，他所拥有的知识即使是我们当中最有学问的人也完全不知道。 [ta lai zi dong fang ， dan chu ci zhi wai ， ren men zhi zhi shen shao 。 you ren shuo ta ceng jing shi yi ming fa shi ， you ren shuo ta ceng jing shi yi ming mu shi 。 bu guan zen yang ， ta suo yong you de zhi shi ji shi shi wo men dang zhong zui you xue wen de ren ye wan quan bu zhi dao 。]

english: Necrovarus told us that he had been brought by a vision he'd had of an underground source of power. He inspired us to delve beneath the town, promising us the power to repel the vampyres.
translation: 涅克洛瓦鲁斯告诉我们，他是被一种地下力量的幻象所吸引。他激励我们深入城镇地下，并承诺我们有能力击退吸血鬼。 [nie ke luo wa lu si gao su wo men ， ta shi bei yi zhong di xia li liang de huan xiang suo xi yin 。 ta ji li wo men shen ru cheng zhen di xia ， bing cheng nuo wo men you neng li ji tui xi xue gui 。]

english: Deep underneath Phasmatys, we found a pool of green slime that Necrovarus called ectoplasm. He showed us how to build the Ectofuntus, which would turn the ectoplasm into the power he had promised us.
translation: 在Phasmatys的深处，我们发现了一池绿色的粘液，Necrovarus称之为灵质。他向我们展示了如何建造Ectofuntus，这会将灵质转化为他向我们承诺的力量。 [zai Phasmatys de shen chu ， wo men fa xian le yi chi lv se de nian ye ，Necrovarus cheng zhi wei ling zhi 。 ta xiang wo men zhan shi le ru he jian zao Ectofuntus， zhe hui jiang ling zhi zhuan hua wei ta xiang wo men cheng nuo de li liang 。]

english: Indeed, this Ectopower did repel the vampyres; they would not enter Phasmatys once the Ectofuntus began working. But little did we know that we had exchanged one evil for yet another - Ectopower.
translation: 事实上，这种异能确实击退了吸血鬼。一旦 Ectofuntus 开始工作，他们就不会进入 Phasmatys。但我们几乎不知道，我们已经用一种邪恶换成了另一种邪恶——Ectopower。 [shi shi shang ， zhe zhong yi neng que shi ji tui le xi xue gui 。 yi dan  Ectofuntus  kai shi gong zuo ， ta men jiu bu hui jin ru  Phasmatys。 dan wo men ji hu bu zhi dao ， wo men yi jing yong yi zhong xie e huan cheng le ling yi zhong xie e ——Ectopower。]

english: Little by little, we began to lose any desire for food or water, and our desire for the Ectopower grew until it dominated our thoughts entirely. Our bodies shrivelled and, one by one, we died.
translation: 渐渐地，我们开始失去对食物或水的渴望，而我们对外能的渴望却越来越强烈，直到它完全占据了我们的思想。我们的身体枯萎，一一死去。 [jian jian di ， wo men kai shi shi qu dui shi wu huo shui de ke wang ， er wo men dui wai neng de ke wang que yue lai yue qiang lie ， zhi dao ta wan quan zhan ju le wo men de si xiang 。 wo men de shen ti ku wei ， yi yi si qu 。]

english: The Ectofuntus and the power it emanates keeps us here as ghosts - some, like myself, content to remain in this world; some becoming tortured souls who we do not allow to pass our gates.
translation: Ectofuntus 和它散发的力量让我们像幽灵一样留在这里——有些人，比如我自己，满足于留在这个世界上；有些人受到我们的折磨，我们不允许他们通过我们的大门。 [Ectofuntus  he ta san fa de li liang rang wo men xiang you ling yi yang liu zai zhe li —— you xie ren ， bi ru wo zi ji ， man zu yu liu zai zhe ge shi jie shang ； you xie ren shou dao wo men de zhe mo ， wo men bu yun xu ta men tong guo wo men de da men 。]

english: We would be able to pass over into the next world but Necrovarus has used his power to create a psychic barrier, preventing us.
translation: 我们本来可以进入下一个世界，但涅克洛瓦鲁斯用他的力量制造了一个心灵屏障，阻止了我们。 [wo men ben lai ke yi jin ru xia yi ge shi jie ， dan nie ke luo wa lu si yong ta de li liang zhi zao le yi ge xin ling ping zhang ， zu zhi le wo men 。]

english: We must remain here for all eternity, even unto the very end of the world.
translation: 我们必须永远留在这里，甚至直到世界的尽头。 [wo men bi xu yong yuan liu zai zhe li ， shen zhi zhi dao shi jie de jin tou 。]

english: Do you have any jobs I can do?
translation: 你们有什么工作我可以做吗？ [ni men you shen me gong zuo wo ke yi zuo ma ？]

english: Yes, actually, I do. We have a very famous Master Bowman named Robin staying with us at the moment. Could you take him some clean bed linen for me?
translation: 是的，实际上，我愿意。我们有一位非常著名的鲍曼大师，名叫罗宾，现在和我们住在一起。你能给我拿一些干净的床单给他吗？ [shi de ， shi ji shang ， wo yuan yi 。 wo men you yi wei fei chang zhu ming de bao man da shi ， ming jiao luo bin ， xian zai he wo men zhu zai yi qi 。 ni neng gei wo na yi xie gan jing de chuang dan gei ta ma ？]

english: Yes, I'd be delighted.
translation: 是的，我会很高兴。 [shi de ， wo hui hen gao xing 。]

english: Oh, thank you. Be careful with that Robin, though - he's far too full of himself, that one.
translation: 哦，谢谢。不过要小心那个罗宾——他太自以为是了。 [o ， xie xie 。 bu guo yao xiao xin na ge luo bin —— ta tai zi yi wei shi le 。]

english: No, I didn't mean a job like that.
translation: 不，我不是指那样的工作。 [bu ， wo bu shi zhi na yang de gong zuo 。]

english: Well, you could take that bedsheet through to Robin like I asked.
translation: 好吧，你可以按照我的要求把床单交给罗宾。 [hao ba ， ni ke yi an zhao wo de yao qiu ba chuang dan jiao gei luo bin 。]

english: Nothing, thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。]

english: Can I buy a beer?
translation: 我可以买啤酒吗？ [wo ke yi mai pi jiu ma ？]

english: Can I hear some gossip?
translation: 我能听听八卦吗？ [wo neng ting ting ba gua ma ？]

english: What happened to the folk of this town?
translation: 这个镇上的人到底怎么了？ [zhe ge zhen shang de ren dao di zen me le ？]

english: Do you have any jobs I can do?
translation: 你们有什么工作我可以做吗？ [ni men you shen me gong zuo wo ke yi zuo ma ？]

english: Yes, I'd be delighted.
translation: 是的，我会很高兴。 [shi de ， wo hui hen gao xing 。]

english: No, I didn't mean a job like that.
translation: 不，我不是指那样的工作。 [bu ， wo bu shi zhi na yang de gong zuo 。]

english: Nothing, thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。]

english: Hi there. Why do you still bother having ships here? I mean - you're dead, what use are they to you?
translation: 你好呀。为什么还要费心在这里派船呢？我的意思是——你死了，它们对你有什么用？ [ni hao ya 。 wei shen me hai yao fei xin zai zhe li pai chuan ne ？ wo de yi si shi —— ni si le ， ta men dui ni you shen me yong ？]

english: We keep ships because we still need trade in Phasmatys. Every trader that comes to Phasmatys is made to worship the Ectofuntus, so that the Ectopower doesn't run out.
translation: 我们保留船只是因为我们仍然需要法斯马蒂斯的贸易。每个来到Phasmatys的商人都必须崇拜Ectofuntus，这样Ectopower就不会耗尽。 [wo men bao liu chuan zhi shi yin wei wo men reng ran xu yao fa si ma di si de mao yi 。 mei ge lai dao Phasmatys de shang ren dou bi xu chong bai Ectofuntus， zhe yang Ectopower jiu bu hui hao jin 。]

english: So, without traders to worship in the Temple you're history, right?
translation: 那么，如果没有商人在圣殿里礼拜，你就成为历史了，对吧？ [na me ， ru guo mei you shang ren zai sheng dian li li bai ， ni jiu cheng wei li shi le ， dui ba ？]

english: Aye, matey.
translation: 是的，伙计。 [shi de ， huo ji 。]

english: Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
translation: 呜呜呜呜呜呜 [wu wu wu wu wu wu]

english: Can I help you at all?
translation: 我可以帮助你吗？ [wo ke yi bang zhu ni ma ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
translation: 呜呜呜呜呜呜 [wu wu wu wu wu wu]

english: You cannot understand the ghost.
translation: 你无法理解鬼魂。 [ni wu fa li jie gui hun 。]

english: Yes please. What are you selling?
translation: 是的，请。你卖什么？ [shi de ， qing 。 ni mai shen me ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: What do you want, mortal?
translation: 你想要什么，凡人？ [ni xiang yao shen me ， fan ren ？]

english: We do not talk to the warm-bloods.
translation: 我们不与热血动物交谈。 [wo men bu yu re xue dong wu jiao tan 。]

english: Why did we have to listen to that maniacal priest?
translation: 为什么我们要听那个疯狂牧师的话？ [wei shen me wo men yao ting na ge feng kuang mu shi de hua ？]

english: This cold wind blows right through you, doesn't it?
translation: 这股冷风正吹过你，不是吗？ [zhe gu leng feng zheng chui guo ni ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Worship the Ectofuntus all you want, but don't bother us, human.
translation: 你可以随心所欲地崇拜 Ectofuntus，但别打扰我们，人类。 [ni ke yi sui xin suo yu di chong bai  Ectofuntus， dan bie da rao wo men ， ren lei 。]

english: Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
translation: 呜呜呜呜呜呜 [wu wu wu wu wu wu]

english: You cannot understand the ghost.
translation: 你无法理解鬼魂。 [ni wu fa li jie gui hun 。]

english: Hello, welcome to Aluft Aloft, the gnome food delivery service. We deliver gnome foods to customers all over Gielinor. Do you want a job? We are always looking for new staff.
translation: 您好，欢迎来到 Aluft Aloft，侏儒送餐服务。我们向吉林诺各地的顾客提供侏儒食品。你想要工作吗？我们一直在寻找新员工。 [nin hao ， huan ying lai dao  Aluft Aloft， zhu ru song can fu wu 。 wo men xiang ji lin nuo ge di de gu ke ti gong zhu ru shi pin 。 ni xiang yao gong zuo ma ？ wo men yi zhi zai xun zhao xin yuan gong 。]

english: Yes, tell me more.
translation: 是的，告诉我更多。 [shi de ， gao su wo geng duo 。]

english: First of all you will need some basic Gnome Cooking and Cocktail making training. Go and talk to my Father, Aluft Gianne snr. and Blurberry, if you haven't already, and they'll tell you what you need to do.
translation: 首先，您需要一些基本的侏儒烹饪和鸡尾酒制作培训。去和我的父亲老阿鲁夫特·吉安娜谈谈吧。和 Blurberry，如果您还没有，他们会告诉您需要做什么。 [shou xian ， nin xu yao yi xie ji ben de zhu ru peng ren he ji wei jiu zhi zuo pei xun 。 qu he wo de fu qin lao a lu fu te · ji an na tan tan ba 。 he  Blurberry， ru guo nin hai mei you ， ta men hui gao su nin xu yao zuo shen me 。]

english: Once you have got recommendations from both of them I'd be happy to take you on at Aluft Aloft!
translation: 一旦您得到了他们两人的推荐，我很乐意在 Aluft Aloft 雇用您！ [yi dan nin de dao le ta men liang ren de tui jian ， wo hen le yi zai  Aluft Aloft  gu yong nin ！]

english: Once you are working for us, I will give you a choice of either an easy or hard job. I will then ask you to make a piece of Gnome Cuisine, and tell you who ordered it, with some information about how to find him
translation: 一旦你为我们工作，我会给你选择一份轻松的工作或艰苦的工作。然后我会请你做一份侏儒美食，并告诉你是谁点的，以及一些如何找到他的信息 [yi dan ni wei wo men gong zuo ， wo hui gei ni xuan ze yi fen qing song de gong zuo huo jian ku de gong zuo 。 ran hou wo hui qing ni zuo yi fen zhu ru mei shi ， bing gao su ni shi shui dian de ， yi ji yi xie ru he zhao dao ta de xin xi]

english: or her. Don't take too long, the order is only valid for a short period of time.
translation: 或她。不要花太长时间，订单仅在短时间内有效。 [huo ta 。 bu yao hua tai zhang shi jian ， ding dan jin zai duan shi jian nei you xiao 。]

english: If you complete the delivery successfully, you will be given a tip by the customer and credit towards your own 'free delivery token'.
translation: 如果您成功完成送货，客户将向您提供小费，并计入您自己的“免费送货代币”。 [ru guo nin cheng gong wan cheng song huo ， ke hu jiang xiang nin ti gong xiao fei ， bing ji ru nin zi ji de “ mian fei song huo dai bi ”。]

english: I'm ready to take an order now...
translation: 我现在准备接单了... [wo xian zai zhun bei jie dan le ...]

english: I'm afraid you don't have the required training for this job. If you want to work for me you'll have to talk to my father Aluft Gianne snr. for cooking training and Blurberry the barman for cocktail making training.
translation: 恐怕你没有接受过这项工作所需的培训。如果你想为我工作，你就得和我父亲老阿鲁夫特·吉安谈谈。进行烹饪培训，Blurberry 调酒师进行鸡尾酒制作培训。 [kong pa ni mei you jie shou guo zhe xiang gong zuo suo xu de pei xun 。 ru guo ni xiang wei wo gong zuo ， ni jiu de he wo fu qin lao a lu fu te · ji an tan tan 。 jin xing peng ren pei xun ，Blurberry  diao jiu shi jin xing ji wei jiu zhi zuo pei xun 。]

english: Once I get recommendations from both of them, you'll be able to start work for me.
translation: 一旦我得到他们两人的推荐，你就可以开始为我工作了。 [yi dan wo de dao ta men liang ren de tui jian ， ni jiu ke yi kai shi wei wo gong zuo le 。]

english: So that's Aluft Gianne snr. for cooking training, and Blurberry for Cocktail training?
translation: 这就是 Aluft Gianne snr。用于烹饪培训，以及用于鸡尾酒培训的 Blurberry？ [zhe jiu shi  Aluft Gianne snr。 yong yu peng ren pei xun ， yi ji yong yu ji wei jiu pei xun de  Blurberry？]

english: That's right - Good luck!
translation: 没错——祝你好运！ [mei cuo —— zhu ni hao yun ！]

english: Yes, tell me more.
translation: 是的，告诉我更多。 [shi de ， gao su wo geng duo 。]

english: What's the difference between an easy and a hard job?
translation: 简单的工作和困难的工作有什么区别？ [jian dan de gong zuo he kun nan de gong zuo you shen me qu bie ？]

english: What are these free delivery tokens?
translation: 这些免费送货代币是什么？ [zhe xie mian fei song huo dai bi shi shen me ？]

english: Will this help me with my cooking?
translation: 这对我的烹饪有帮助吗？ [zhe dui wo de peng ren you bang zhu ma ？]

english: I'm ready to take a job on now.
translation: 我现在已经准备好接受工作了。 [wo xian zai yi jing zhun bei hao jie shou gong zuo le 。]

english: I've changed my mind, there's something else I need to do now.
translation: 我改变主意了，现在我还有事要做。 [wo gai bian zhu yi le ， xian zai wo hai you shi yao zuo 。]

english: Not right now, thanks.
translation: 现在不行，谢谢。 [xian zai bu xing ， xie xie 。]

english: So how come you are so agile?
translation: 那你怎么这么敏捷呢？ [na ni zen me zhe me min jie ne ？]

english: If you were so nutty about nuts, maybe you would understand the great lengths we go to!
translation: 如果您对坚果如此狂热，也许您会理解我们所付出的巨大努力！ [ru guo nin dui jian guo ru ci kuang re ， ye xu nin hui li jie wo men suo fu chu de ju da nu li ！]

english: What's up with all that squirrel fur? I guess fleas need a home too.
translation: 这么多松鼠毛是怎么回事？我想跳蚤也需要一个家。 [zhe me duo song shu mao shi zen me hui shi ？ wo xiang tiao zao ye xu yao yi ge jia 。]

english: You're pushing your luck! Stop it or you'll face my squirrely wrath.
translation: 你这是在碰运气啊！停下来，否则你将面临我的愤怒。 [ni zhe shi zai peng yun qi a ！ ting xia lai ， fou ze ni jiang mian lin wo de fen nu 。]

english: Did you ever notice how big squirrels' teeth are?
translation: 你有没有注意到松鼠的牙齿有多大？ [ni you mei you zhu yi dao song shu de ya chi you duo da ？]

english: No...
You could land a gnome glider on those things!
translation: 你可以让侏儒滑翔机降落在那些东西上！ [ni ke yi rang zhu ru hua xiang ji jiang luo zai na xie dong xi shang ！]

english: Watch it, I'll crush your nuts!
translation: 小心点，我会捏碎你的坚果！ [xiao xin dian ， wo hui nie sui ni de jian guo ！]

english: That's not an acorn!
translation: 那不是橡子！ [na bu shi xiang zi ！]

english: I'm watching you.
translation: 我在看着你。 [wo zai kan zhe ni 。]

english: Give me your nuts!
translation: 把你的坚果给我！ [ba ni de jian guo gei wo ！]

english: Nothing is impossible to the squirrel who tries.
translation: 对于努力尝试的松鼠来说，没有什么是不可能的。 [dui yu nu li chang shi de song shu lai shuo ， mei you shen me shi bu ke neng de 。]

english: The determined squirrel persists until success is found.
translation: 意志坚定的松鼠坚持不懈，直到找到成功。 [yi zhi jian ding de song shu jian chi bu xie ， zhi dao zhao dao cheng gong 。]

english: Face my squirrely wrath!.
translation: 面对我松鼠般的愤怒！ [mian dui wo song shu ban de fen nu ！]

english: Hide your nuts!
translation: 隐藏你的坚果！ [yin cang ni de jian guo ！]

english: Greetings! I see you are a new arrival to the world of Gielinor. My job is to welcome all new visitors. So welcome!
translation: 问候！我发现你是吉林诺世界的新来者。我的工作是欢迎所有新访客。欢迎！ [wen hou ！ wo fa xian ni shi ji lin nuo shi jie de xin lai zhe 。 wo de gong zuo shi huan ying suo you xin fang ke 。 huan ying ！]

english: You have already learned the first thing needed to succeed in this world: talking to other people!
translation: 您已经学会了在这个世界上取得成功所需的第一件事：与其他人交谈！ [nin yi jing xue hui le zai zhe ge shi jie shang qu de cheng gong suo xu de di yi jian shi ： yu qi ta ren jiao tan ！]

english: You will find many inhabitants of this world have useful things to say to you. By clicking on them you can talk to them.
translation: 你会发现这个世界上的许多居民都会对你说一些有用的话。通过单击它们，您可以与他们交谈。 [ni hui fa xian zhe ge shi jie shang de xu duo ju min du hui dui ni shuo yi xie you yong de hua 。 tong guo dan ji ta men ， nin ke yi yu ta men jiao tan 。]

english: Before we get going, if you could be so kind to let me know how much experience you have with Old School Runescape, that would be wonderful!
translation: 在我们开始之前，如果您能好心告诉我您在 Old School Runescape 方面有多少经验，那就太好了！ [zai wo men kai shi zhi qian ， ru guo nin neng hao xin gao su wo nin zai  Old School Runescape  fang mian you duo shao jing yan ， na jiu tai hao le ！]

english: I've played in the past, but not recently.
translation: 我过去玩过，但最近没玩过。 [wo guo qu wan guo ， dan zui jin mei wan guo 。]

english: I am an experienced player.
translation: 我是一位经验丰富的玩家。 [wo shi yi wei jing yan feng fu de wan jia 。]

english: I am brand new! This is my first time here.
translation: 我是全新的！这是我第一次来这里。 [wo shi quan xin de ！ zhe shi wo di yi ci lai zhe li 。]

english: Wonderful! Thank you.
translation: 精彩的！谢谢。 [jing cai de ！ xie xie 。]

english: Now then, let's start by looking at your options menu.
translation: 现在，让我们开始查看您的选项菜单。 [xian zai ， rang wo men kai shi cha kan nin de xuan xiang cai dan 。]

english: You will notice a flashing icon of a spanner. Please click on this to continue the tutorial.
translation: 您会注意到一个闪烁的扳手图标。请单击此继续教程。 [nin hui zhu yi dao yi ge shan shuo de ban shou tu biao 。 qing dan ji ci ji xu jiao cheng 。]

english: Looks like you're making good progress! The menu you've just opened is one of many. You'll learn about the rest as you progress through the tutorial.
translation: 看起来你进步很大！您刚刚打开的菜单是众多菜单之一。随着本教程的进展，您将了解其余内容。 [kan qi lai ni jin bu hen da ！ nin gang gang da kai de cai dan shi zhong duo cai dan zhi yi 。 sui zhe ben jiao cheng de jin zhan ， nin jiang liao jie qi yu nei rong 。]

english: Anyway, I'd say it's time for you to go and meet your first instructor!
translation: 不管怎样，我想说你是时候去见你的第一位导师了！ [bu guan zen yang ， wo xiang shuo ni shi shi hou qu jian ni de di yi wei dao shi le ！]

english: Welcome back. You have already learnt the first thing needed to succeed in this world: talking to other people!
translation: 欢迎回来。您已经学会了在这个世界上取得成功所需的第一件事：与其他人交谈！ [huan ying hui lai 。 nin yi jing xue hui le zai zhe ge shi jie shang qu de cheng gong suo xu de di yi jian shi ： yu qi ta ren jiao tan ！]

english: You will find many inhabitants of this world have useful things to say to you. By clicking on them, you can talk to them.
translation: 你会发现这个世界上的许多居民都会对你说一些有用的话。通过点击他们，您可以与他们交谈。 [ni hui fa xian zhe ge shi jie shang de xu duo ju min du hui dui ni shuo yi xie you yong de hua 。 tong guo dian ji ta men ， nin ke yi yu ta men jiao tan 。]

english: To continue the tutorial go through that door over there and speak to your first instructor!
translation: 要继续教程，请穿过那边的门并与您的第一位教练交谈！ [yao ji xu jiao cheng ， qing chuan guo na bian de men bing yu nin de di yi wei jiao lian jiao tan ！]

english: I've played in the past, but not recently.
translation: 我过去玩过，但最近没玩过。 [wo guo qu wan guo ， dan zui jin mei wan guo 。]

english: I am an experienced player.
translation: 我是一位经验丰富的玩家。 [wo shi yi wei jing yan feng fu de wan jia 。]

english: I am brand new! This is my first time here.
translation: 我是全新的！这是我第一次来这里。 [wo shi quan xin de ！ zhe shi wo di yi ci lai zhe li 。]

english: Hello, Gilbert!
translation: 你好，吉尔伯特！ [ni hao ， ji er bo te ！]

english: Hey, [player name]!
translation: 嘿，[玩家姓名]！ [hei ，[ wan jia xing ming ]！]

english: Can I have a flower crown?
translation: 能给我一顶花冠吗？ [neng gei wo yi ding hua guan ma ？]

english: Of course you can. I'll even give you a lovely rainbow scarf to go with it!
translation: 当然可以。我什至会给你一条可爱的彩虹围巾来搭配它！ [dang ran ke yi 。 wo shen zhi hui gei ni yi tiao ke ai de cai hong wei jin lai da pei ta ！]

english: There you go.
translation: 就这样吧。 [jiu zhe yang ba 。]

english: Thank you, I'll wear them with Pride!
translation: 谢谢你，我会自豪地穿上它们！ [xie xie ni ， wo hui zi hao di chuan shang ta men ！]

english: Can I have a rainbow jumper?
translation: 我可以买一件彩虹毛衣吗？ [wo ke yi mai yi jian cai hong mao yi ma ？]

english: Of course you can. There's a couple of extra gifts that I can tell Diango to prepare for you too.
translation: 当然可以。我还可以告诉 Diango 为您准备一些额外的礼物。 [dang ran ke yi 。 wo hai ke yi gao su  Diango  wei nin zhun bei yi xie e wai de li wu 。]

english: Can't you give me them all here?
translation: 你不能把它们全部给我吗？ [ni bu neng ba ta men quan bu gei wo ma ？]

english: Unfortunately Love is a bit... Precious about how I handle her things.
translation: 不幸的是，爱对于我如何处理她的事情有点……珍贵。 [bu xing de shi ， ai dui yu wo ru he chu li ta de shi qing you dian …… zhen gui 。]

english: Thank you, I'll wear it with Pride!
translation: 谢谢你，我会骄傲地穿上它！ [xie xie ni ， wo hui jiao ao di chuan shang ta ！]

english: The meadow is looking lovely!
translation: 草地看起来很可爱！ [cao di kan qi lai hen ke ai ！]

english: I know! It didn't always look like this though. It used to be dull and grey!
translation: 我知道！但它并不总是这样。它曾经是暗淡和灰色的！ [wo zhi dao ！ dan ta bing bu zong shi zhe yang 。 ta ceng jing shi an dan he hui se de ！]

english: Dull and grey? How did it become so colourful?
translation: 暗淡和灰色？怎么变得这么丰富多彩了？ [an dan he hui se ？ zen me bian de zhe me feng fu duo cai le ？]

english: An adventurer came along and helped me out. We cast a magic spell using flower seeds, and it created this lovely sunburst!
translation: 一位冒险家出现并帮助了我。我们用花种子施了一个魔法，它创造了这个可爱的旭日！ [yi wei mao xian jia chu xian bing bang zhu le wo 。 wo men yong hua zhong zi shi le yi ge mo fa ， ta chuang zao le zhe ge ke ai de xu ri ！]

english: Oh, I'd have liked to have seen that spell. It sounds impressive!
translation: 哦，我真想看看那个咒语。听起来令人印象深刻！ [o ， wo zhen xiang kan kan na ge zhou yu 。 ting qi lai ling ren yin xiang shen ke ！]

english: It was! The news travelled far. I've been getting lots of visitors. Many flower traders from across the lands have paid the meadow a visit.
translation: 是的！消息传得很远。我接待了很多访客。许多来自世界各地的花卉商人都参观过这片草地。 [shi de ！ xiao xi chuan de hen yuan 。 wo jie dai le hen duo fang ke 。 xu duo lai zi shi jie ge di de hua hui shang ren dou can guan guo zhe pian cao di 。]

english: I know! Thank you again for your help with it. It fills me with happiness to see so much colour.
translation: 我知道！再次感谢您的帮助。看到如此多的色彩让我感到非常高兴。 [wo zhi dao ！ zai ci gan xie nin de bang zhu 。 kan dao ru ci duo de se cai rang wo gan dao fei chang gao xing 。]

english: I've been getting lots of visitors too. Many flower traders from across the lands have paid the meadow a visit.
translation: 我也迎来了很多访客。许多来自世界各地的花卉商人都参观过这片草地。 [wo ye ying lai le hen duo fang ke 。 xu duo lai zi shi jie ge di de hua hui shang ren dou can guan guo zhe pian cao di 。]

english: I've even traded with a few for some new flower seeds with different colours!
translation: 我什至与一些人交换了一些不同颜色的新花种子！ [wo shen zhi yu yi xie ren jiao huan le yi xie bu tong yan se de xin hua zhong zi ！]

english: That's really cool. What do you do with all the flowers?
translation: 这真的很酷。你用所有的花做什么？ [zhe zhen de hen ku 。 ni yong suo you de hua zuo shen me ？]

english: I make flower crowns in many different colours. I'm wearing one right now!
translation: 我制作了许多不同颜色的花冠。我现在就戴着一件！ [wo zhi zuo le xu duo bu tong yan se de hua guan 。 wo xian zai jiu dai zhe yi jian ！]

english: Sounds very colourful!
translation: 听起来非常丰富多彩！ [ting qi lai fei chang feng fu duo cai ！]

english: You're welcome to have one if you'd like, just come back and ask me, anytime!
translation: 如果您愿意，欢迎您拥有一份，只要回来问我就可以了！ [ru guo nin yuan yi ， huan ying nin yong you yi fen ， zhi yao hui lai wen wo jiu ke yi le ！]

english: Thank you. I might do just that!
translation: 谢谢。我也许会这么做！ [xie xie 。 wo ye xu hui zhe me zuo ！]

english: New flower seeds? What types?
translation: 新的花种子？什么类型？ [xin de hua zhong zi ？ shen me lei xing ？]

english: Well as you may have noticed, you can change the colours of the flowers on your flower crown now!
translation: 您可能已经注意到，您现在可以更改花冠上花朵的颜色！ [nin ke neng yi jing zhu yi dao ， nin xian zai ke yi geng gai hua guan shang hua duo de yan se ！]

english: Turns out the spell we cast was more powerful than we first thought.
translation: 事实证明我们施展的咒语比我们最初想象的更强大。 [shi shi zheng ming wo men shi zhan de zhou yu bi wo men zui chu xiang xiang de geng qiang da 。]

english: So powerful that it made eight new colourations, all as beautiful as the first!
translation: 它的威力如此之大，以至于产生了八种新的颜色，都和第一个一样漂亮！ [ta de wei li ru ci zhi da ， yi zhi yu chan sheng le ba zhong xin de yan se ， dou he di yi ge yi yang piao liang ！]

english: That's amazing! And all because we wanted a little splash of colour.
translation: 太棒了！这一切都是因为我们想要一点色彩。 [tai bang le ！ zhe yi qie dou shi yin wei wo men xiang yao yi dian se cai 。]

english: Don't underestimate the power of a little splash of colour!
translation: 不要低估一点色彩的力量！ [bu yao di gu yi dian se cai de li liang ！]

english: I'll make sure not too!
translation: 我也会确保不会！ [wo ye hui que bao bu hui ！]

english: Anything happening around here?
translation: 这附近有什么事情发生吗？ [zhe fu jin you shen me shi qing fa sheng ma ？]

english: Lots of things! It's been pretty busy. There was even a huge colourful parade with thousands of people, and they chose this meadow as the starting place!
translation: 很多东西！一直很忙。甚至还举行了一场数千人的大型彩色游行，他们选择了这片草地作为出发地！ [hen duo dong xi ！ yi zhi hen mang 。 shen zhi hai ju xing le yi chang shu qian ren de da xing cai se you xing ， ta men xuan ze le zhe pian cao di zuo wei chu fa di ！]

english: I know, I was there!
translation: 我知道，我当时就在场！ [wo zhi dao ， wo dang shi jiu zai chang ！]

english: You were? I didn't see you!
translation: 你是吗？我没有看到你！ [ni shi ma ？ wo mei you kan dao ni ！]

english: It was super crowded. I was the one in the colourful outfit.
translation: 那里非常拥挤。我是那个穿着色彩缤纷的衣服的人。 [na li fei chang yong ji 。 wo shi na ge chuan zhe se cai bin fen de yi fu de ren 。]

english: The one in the colourful outfit...?
translation: 那个穿着彩色衣服的……？ [na ge chuan zhe cai se yi fu de ……？]

english: Ah, yes, like everybody else. I forgot, we were all in colourful outfits!
translation: 啊，是的，就像其他人一样。我忘了，我们都穿着五颜六色的衣服！ [a ， shi de ， jiu xiang qi ta ren yi yang 。 wo wang le ， wo men dou chuan zhe wu yan liu se de yi fu ！]

english: Yes! Did you have a good time?
translation: 是的！你玩得开心吗？ [shi de ！ ni wan de kai xin ma ？]

english: I did thank you. It was really nice to see so many adventurers coming together to bring a splash of colour to Gielinor.
translation: 我确实谢谢你了。很高兴看到这么多冒险家齐聚一堂，为吉利诺带来一抹色彩。 [wo que shi xie xie ni le 。 hen gao xing kan dao zhe me duo mao xian jia qi ju yi tang ， wei ji li nuo dai lai yi mo se cai 。]

english: It truly was, and so many flower crowns too! I was a bit worried the large pile I'd made of them would go to waste, but in the end I almost ran out!
translation: 确实如此，而且还有这么多花冠！我有点担心我用它们做的一大堆会被浪费掉，但最后我几乎用完了！ [que shi ru ci ， er qie hai you zhe me duo hua guan ！ wo you dian dan xin wo yong ta men zuo de yi da dui hui bei lang fei diao ， dan zui hou wo ji hu yong wan le ！]

english: Sounds like a nice problem to have! Will you be making more for the next parade they do?
translation: 听起来是一个很好的问题！你会为他们下次的游行赚更多钱吗？ [ting qi lai shi yi ge hen hao de wen ti ！ ni hui wei ta men xia ci de you xing zhuan geng duo qian ma ？]

english: The next parade?
translation: 下一次游行？ [xia yi ci you xing ？]

english: Yes, I'm sure they'll do another one. If so many people turned up, it must have been a great success. Why wouldn't they want to do it again?
translation: 是的，我确信他们还会做另一件事。如果有这么多人来参加，那一定是非常成功的。他们为什么不想再做一次呢？ [shi de ， wo que xin ta men hai hui zuo ling yi jian shi 。 ru guo you zhe me duo ren lai can jia ， na yi ding shi fei chang cheng gong de 。 ta men wei shen me bu xiang zai zuo yi ci ne ？]

english: That is a good point. I'll get to making some more right away.
translation: 这是一个很好的观点。我马上就开始做更多。 [zhe shi yi ge hen hao de guan dian 。 wo ma shang jiu kai shi zuo geng duo 。]

english: Maybe it'll become a yearly thing. A chance to show off some colour, and of course your fancy flower crowns, to all of Gielinor!
translation: 也许这会成为一年一度的事情。这是向吉林诺所有人展示色彩的机会，当然还有你漂亮的花冠！ [ye xu zhe hui cheng wei yi nian yi du de shi qing 。 zhe shi xiang ji lin nuo suo you ren zhan shi se cai de ji hui ， dang ran hai you ni piao liang de hua guan ！]

english: Sounds good to me, gives me time to get lots made in advance.
translation: 对我来说听起来不错，让我有时间提前制作很多东西。 [dui wo lai shuo ting qi lai bu cuo ， rang wo you shi jian ti qian zhi zuo hen duo dong xi 。]

english: Right, well I clearly have work to be getting on with. See you soon!
translation: 是的，我显然还有工作要做。再见！ [shi de ， wo xian ran hai you gong zuo yao zuo 。 zai jian ！]

english: See you!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Really? That's cool! What made it colourful?
translation: 真的吗？这很酷！是什么让它变得五彩缤纷？ [zhen de ma ？ zhe hen ku ！ shi shen me rang ta bian de wu cai bin fen ？]

english: Everyone turned up in colourful outfits, it was like a sea of rainbows.
translation: 每个人都穿着色彩缤纷的服装出现，就像彩虹的海洋。 [mei ge ren dou chuan zhe se cai bin fen de fu zhuang chu xian ， jiu xiang cai hong de hai yang 。]

english: So many flower crowns too! I was a bit worried the large pile I'd made of them would go to waste, but in the end I almost ran out!
translation: 还有这么多花冠！我有点担心我用它们做的一大堆会被浪费掉，但最后我几乎用完了！ [hai you zhe me duo hua guan ！ wo you dian dan xin wo yong ta men zuo de yi da dui hui bei lang fei diao ， dan zui hou wo ji hu yong wan le ！]

english: Do you have any rainbow items I can claim?
translation: 你们有什么彩虹物品可以让我领取吗？ [ni men you shen me cai hong wu pin ke yi rang wo ling qu ma ？]

english: Absolutely! I have a jumper, flower crown, and scarf for you. Which would you like?
translation: 绝对地！我给你准备了一件毛衣、花冠和围巾。你想要哪一个？ [jue dui di ！ wo gei ni zhun bei le yi jian mao yi 、 hua guan he wei jin 。 ni xiang yao na yi ge ？]

english: Oh, you appear to already have one of those.
translation: 哦，你似乎已经拥有其中之一了。 [o ， ni si hu yi jing yong you qi zhong zhi yi liao 。]

english: You should have all of the previous rainbow items now!
translation: 您现在应该拥有之前所有的彩虹物品了！ [nin xian zai ying gai yong you zhi qian suo you de cai hong wu pin le ！]

english: Can I have a flower crown?
translation: 能给我一顶花冠吗？ [neng gei wo yi ding hua guan ma ？]

english: Can I have a rainbow jumper?
translation: 我可以买一件彩虹毛衣吗？ [wo ke yi mai yi jian cai hong mao yi ma ？]

english: The meadow is looking lovely!
translation: 草地看起来很可爱！ [cao di kan qi lai hen ke ai ！]

english: Sounds very colourful!
translation: 听起来非常丰富多彩！ [ting qi lai fei chang feng fu duo cai ！]

english: Anything happening around here?
translation: 这附近有什么事情发生吗？ [zhe fu jin you shen me shi qing fa sheng ma ？]

english: I know, I was there!
translation: 我知道，我当时就在场！ [wo zhi dao ， wo dang shi jiu zai chang ！]

english: Really? That is cool!
translation: 真的吗？太酷了！ [zhen de ma ？ tai ku le ！]

english: Do you have any rainbow items I can claim?
translation: 你们有什么彩虹物品可以让我领取吗？ [ni men you shen me cai hong wu pin ke yi rang wo ling qu ma ？]

english: Jumper
translation: 跳线 [tiao xian]

english: Flower Crown
translation: 花冠 [hua guan]

english: Scarf
translation: 围巾 [wei jin]

english: All of them
translation: 他们全部 [ta men quan bu]

english: Hello, chap! Gilbert's the name. How may I help?
translation: 你好，小伙子！吉尔伯特是这个名字。我可以提供什么帮助吗？ [ni hao ， xiao huo zi ！ ji er bo te shi zhe ge ming zi 。 wo ke yi ti gong shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: Hey Gilbert, I'm [player name]! I couldn't help but notice that rainbow near you. Where did it come from?
translation: 嘿吉尔伯特，我是[玩家姓名]！我忍不住注意到你附近的彩虹。它从哪里来？ [hei ji er bo te ， wo shi [ wan jia xing ming ]！ wo ren bu zhu zhu yi dao ni fu jin de cai hong 。 ta cong na li lai ？]

english: 'Tis strange, isn't it [player name]? They appear almost anywhere in the world, I couldn't say where it came from... That being said, rainbows certainly are beautiful and aren't afraid to show their colours to the world! They fill me with such pride.
translation: 很奇怪，不是[玩家名字]吗？它们几乎出现在世界任何地方，我不能说它来自哪里......话虽这么说，彩虹确实很美丽，而且不害怕向世界展示它们的颜色！他们让我充满自豪。 [hen qi guai ， bu shi [ wan jia ming zi ] ma ？ ta men ji hu chu xian zai shi jie ren he di fang ， wo bu neng shuo ta lai zi na li ...... hua sui zhe me shuo ， cai hong que shi hen mei li ， er qie bu hai pa xiang shi jie zhan shi ta men de yan se ！ ta men rang wo chong man zi hao 。]

english: 'Tis upsetting though. I've always wanted to show my colours like a rainbow, but I can't seem to get the ingredients I need... All of my clothing is plain.
translation: 但这令人不安。我一直想像彩虹一样展现我的色彩，但我似乎无法获得我需要的成分……我所有的衣服都是素色的。 [dan zhe ling ren bu an 。 wo yi zhi xiang xiang cai hong yi yang zhan xian wo de se cai ， dan wo si hu wu fa huo de wo xu yao de cheng fen …… wo suo you de yi fu dou shi su se de 。]

english: You know, I've never thought about it like that!
translation: 你知道，我从来没有这样想过！ [ni zhi dao ， wo cong lai mei you zhe yang xiang guo ！]

english: Maybe I could help in some way?
translation: 也许我可以以某种方式提供帮助？ [ye xu wo ke yi yi mou zhong fang shi ti gong bang zhu ？]

english: I'm not sure how much you know about rainbows, but they have a lot of colours to show! They also have a lot of colours to share.
translation: 我不知道你对彩虹了解多少，但它们有很多颜色可以展示！他们还有很多颜色可以分享。 [wo bu zhi dao ni dui cai hong liao jie duo shao ， dan ta men you hen duo yan se ke yi zhan shi ！ ta men hai you hen duo yan se ke yi fen xiang 。]

english: Sadly, some of those colours are in short supply so I'd feel bad asking you to take those.
translation: 遗憾的是，其中一些颜色供不应求，所以我很难要求您购买这些颜色。 [yi han de shi ， qi zhong yi xie yan se gong bu ying qiu ， suo yi wo hen nan yao qiu nin gou mai zhe xie yan se 。]

english: There's six colours that are in higher supply though: red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple.
translation: 不过，有六种颜色的供应量较高：红色、橙色、黄色、绿色、蓝色和紫色。 [bu guo ， you liu zhong yan se de gong ying liang jiao gao ： hong se 、 cheng se 、 huang se 、 lv se 、 lan se he zi se 。]

english: I can sense where rainbows are with extra strands of each of these colours...
translation: 我可以通过每种颜色的额外丝线感觉到彩虹在哪里...... [wo ke yi tong guo mei zhong yan se de e wai si xian gan jue dao cai hong zai na li ......]

english: Could you find them for me, and take some of their spare colour?
translation: 你能帮我找到它们，并拿走一些备用颜色吗？ [ni neng bang wo zhao dao ta men ， bing na zou yi xie bei yong yan se ma ？]

english: Sounds fun!
translation: 听起来很有趣！ [ting qi lai hen you qu ！]

english: Now then, [player name] - Have you got any questions for me?
translation: 那么，[玩家姓名] - 你有什么问题要问我吗？ [na me ，[ wan jia xing ming ] -  ni you shen me wen ti yao wen wo ma ？]

english: What am I doing, again?
translation: 我又在做什么？ [wo you zai zuo shen me ？]

english: Well, I've always wanted to show my colours like a rainbow, but I can't seem to get the ingredients I need myself.
translation: 嗯，我一直想像彩虹一样展现我的色彩，但我自己似乎无法获得我需要的成分。 [n ， wo yi zhi xiang xiang cai hong yi yang zhan xian wo de se cai ， dan wo zi ji si hu wu fa huo de wo xu yao de cheng fen 。]

english: I'm able to sense the location of these rainbows in my mind, but it's always a little hazy. Feel free to ask me to sense a rainbow with extra strands of red, orange, yellow, green, blue or purple!
translation: 我能在脑海中感觉到这些彩虹的位置，但总是有点模糊。请随意让我感受带有额外的红色、橙色、黄色、绿色、蓝色或紫色的彩虹！ [wo neng zai nao hai zhong gan jue dao zhe xie cai hong de wei zhi ， dan zong shi you dian mo hu 。 qing sui yi rang wo gan shou dai you e wai de hong se 、 cheng se 、 huang se 、 lv se 、 lan se huo zi se de cai hong ！]

english: Why am I only gathering six colours?
translation: 为什么我只收集六种颜色？ [wei shen me wo zhi shou ji liu zhong yan se ？]

english: Well we don't want to take all of the colour from the rainbows! Some have extra strands of certain colours, and those are the ones I'll direct you towards...
translation: 好吧，我们不想夺走彩虹的所有颜色！有些有额外的某些颜色的线，这些是我将引导你走向的...... [hao ba ， wo men bu xiang duo zou cai hong de suo you yan se ！ you xie you e wai de mou xie yan se de xian ， zhe xie shi wo jiang yin dao ni zou xiang de ......]

english: But rainbows have so many colours! Surely there's some with other colours spare?
translation: 但彩虹有这么多颜色！当然还有其他颜色的备用吗？ [dan cai hong you zhe me duo yan se ！ dang ran hai you qi ta yan se de bei yong ma ？]

english: Some colours are in such short supply for every rainbow. Besides, it's the thought that counts! Even displaying a small selection of colours to others makes them feel comfortable showing theirs!
translation: 对于每条彩虹来说，有些颜色都供不应求。此外，重要的是想法！即使向其他人展示一小部分颜色，也能让他们放心地展示自己的颜色！ [dui yu mei tiao cai hong lai shuo ， you xie yan se dou gong bu ying qiu 。 ci wai ， zhong yao de shi xiang fa ！ ji shi xiang qi ta ren zhan shi yi xiao bu fen yan se ， ye neng rang ta men fang xin di zhan shi zi ji de yan se ！]

english: I never thought of it like that... Thanks Gilbert!
translation: 我从来没有这样想过......谢谢吉尔伯特！ [wo cong lai mei you zhe yang xiang guo ...... xie xie ji er bo te ！]

english: Anytime, [player name]! Now, is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 随时，[玩家姓名]！现在，还有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [sui shi ，[ wan jia xing ming ]！ xian zai ， hai you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

english: Can you tell me where I can find a rainbow with extra red strands?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪里可以找到带有额外红线的彩虹吗？ [ni neng gao su wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao dai you e wai hong xian de cai hong ma ？]

english: I can see it...
translation: 我能看到它... [wo neng kan dao ta ...]

english: South of my magical location, I see life! New adventurers and baldness rife.
translation: 在我神奇的地方以南，我看到了生命！新的冒险家和秃头盛行。 [zai wo shen qi de di fang yi nan ， wo kan dao le sheng ming ！ xin de mao xian jia he tu tou sheng xing 。]

english: Can you tell me where I can find a rainbow with extra orange strands?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪里可以找到带有额外橙色线的彩虹吗？ [ni neng gao su wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao dai you e wai cheng se xian de cai hong ma ？]

english: Beside me now, a person of healing. Those who test their luck, find this place appealing.

translation: [玩家姓名]，你让我意识到，像你这样的人愿意支持那些希望自豪地展示自己色彩的人...... [[ wan jia xing ming ]， ni rang wo yi shi dao ， xiang ni zhe yang de ren yuan yi zhi chi na xie xi wang zi hao di zhan shi zi ji se cai de ren ......]

english: It's no problem at all, [player name]. I added a little heart on the item to show my personal thanks. Thank you for your help! Wear it with pride, and let everyone know to show their own colours proudly!

translation: 跟我说话，[玩家姓名]！ [gen wo shuo hua ，[ wan jia xing ming ]！]

translation: 我想和你谈谈，[玩家姓名]！ [wo xiang he ni tan tan ，[ wan jia xing ming ]！]

english: Hello, I'm Gillie the Milkmaid. What can I do for you?
translation: 大家好，我是挤奶女工吉莉。我能为你做什么？ [da jia hao ， wo shi ji nai nv gong ji li 。 wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: My name is Gillie Groats. My father is a farmer and I milk the cows for him.
translation: 我叫吉莉·格罗茨。我的父亲是一名农民，我为他挤奶。 [wo jiao ji li · ge luo ci 。 wo de fu qin shi yi ming nong min ， wo wei ta ji nai 。]

english: Do you have any buckets of milk spare?
translation: 你还有多余的牛奶桶吗？ [ni hai you duo yu de niu nai tong ma ？]

english: I'm afraid not. We need all of our milk to sell to market, but you can milk the cow yourself if you need the milk.
translation: 恐怕不是。我们需要将所有牛奶出售到市场，但如果您需要牛奶，您可以自己挤牛奶。 [kong pa bu shi 。 wo men xu yao jiang suo you niu nai chu shou dao shi chang ， dan ru guo nin xu yao niu nai ， nin ke yi zi ji ji niu nai 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: So how do you milk a cow then?
translation: 那么如何给奶牛挤奶呢？ [na me ru he gei nai niu ji nai ne ？]

english: It's very easy. First you need an empty bucket to hold the milk.
translation: 这很容易。首先你需要一个空桶来盛牛奶。 [zhe hen rong yi 。 shou xian ni xu yao yi ge kong tong lai sheng niu nai 。]

english: Then find a dairy cow to milk - you can't milk just any cow.
translation: 然后找一头奶牛来挤奶——你不能随便给任何一头奶牛挤奶。 [ran hou zhao yi tou nai niu lai ji nai —— ni bu neng sui bian gei ren he yi tou nai niu ji nai 。]

english: How do I find a dairy cow?
translation: 如何找到奶牛？ [ru he zhao dao nai niu ？]

english: They are easy to spot - they are dark brown and white, unlike beef cows, which are light brown and white. We also tether them to a post to stop them wandering around all over the place.
translation: 它们很容易被发现——它们是深棕色和白色的，不像肉牛是浅棕色和白色的。我们还将它们拴在一根柱子上，以防止它们到处闲逛。 [ta men hen rong yi bei fa xian —— ta men shi shen zong se he bai se de ， bu xiang rou niu shi qian zong se he bai se de 。 wo men hai jiang ta men shuan zai yi gen zhu zi shang ， yi fang zhi ta men dao chu xian guang 。]

english: There are a couple very near, in this field.
translation: 在这个领域，有一对非常接近的夫妇。 [zai zhe ge ling yu ， you yi dui fei chang jie jin de fu fu 。]

english: Then just milk the cow and your bucket will fill with tasty, nutritious milk.
translation: 然后只要给奶牛挤奶，你的桶就会装满美味、营养丰富的牛奶。 [ran hou zhi yao gei nai niu ji nai ， ni de tong jiu hui zhuang man mei wei 、 ying yang feng fu de niu nai 。]

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

translation: 呃……不。你怎么知道的？ [e …… bu 。 ni zen me zhi dao de ？]

translation: 因为你把牛奶洒了一地。多么浪费啊！你需要一些东西来盛放牛奶。 [yin wei ni ba niu nai sa le yi di 。 duo me lang fei a ！ ni xu yao yi xie dong xi lai sheng fang niu nai 。]

english: Ah yes, I really should have guessed that one, shouldn't I?
translation: 啊，是的，我真的应该猜到这一点，不是吗？ [a ， shi de ， wo zhen de ying gai cai dao zhe yi dian ， bu shi ma ？]

english: You're from the city, aren't you... Try it again with an empty bucket.
translation: 你是城里来的吧……用空桶再试试。 [ni shi cheng li lai de ba …… yong kong tong zai shi shi 。]

english: Gillie gleefully takes the amulet off of the branch and hangs it around her own neck as a clone of her appears before your very eyes.
translation: 吉莉高兴地从树枝上取下护身符，把它挂在自己的脖子上，她的克隆体出现在你的眼前。 [ji li gao xing di cong shu zhi shang qu xia hu shen fu ， ba ta gua zai zi ji de bo zi shang ， ta de ke long ti chu xian zai ni de yan qian 。]

translation: 我就是这样！现在，你们来这里是为了像我一样的衣服吗？ [wo jiu shi zhe yang ！ xian zai ， ni men lai zhe li shi wei le xiang wo yi yang de yi fu ma ？]

english: Let's talk about outfits.
translation: 我们来谈谈服装吧。 [wo men lai tan tan fu zhuang ba 。]
