translation: 是啊。看，很多钓鱼者都穿着丑陋的绿色衣服。确实，这对他们钓鱼有帮助，但他们看起来已经腐烂了。所以 Gita Prymes 发明了一些更好看的东西。 [shi a 。 kan ， hen duo diao yu zhe dou chuan zhe chou lou de lv se yi fu 。 que shi ， zhe dui ta men diao yu you bang zhu ， dan ta men kan qi lai yi jing fu lan le 。 suo yi  Gita Prymes  fa ming le yi xie geng hao kan de dong xi 。]

english: It'll cost ye some spirit flakes but Gita Prymes can change yer Spirit Angler back to normal Angler for free if ye want it. Which ever suits ye.
translation: 这会花费你一些精神片，但如果你愿意的话，吉塔·普莱姆斯可以免费将你的精神钓鱼者变回普通钓鱼者。哪个适合你。 [zhe hui hua fei ni yi xie jing shen pian ， dan ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， ji ta · pu lai mu si ke yi mian fei jiang ni de jing shen diao yu zhe bian hui pu tong diao yu zhe 。 na ge shi he ni 。]

english: Can you turn my Angler outfit into the Spirit Angler outfit?
translation: 你能把我的钓鱼者服装变成精神钓鱼者服装吗？ [ni neng ba wo de diao yu zhe fu zhuang bian cheng jing shen diao yu zhe fu zhuang ma ？]

english: Sure, hand me a piece of the regular Angler kit. I'll want 1,200 spirit flakes for a hat, the top for 1,200 spirit flakes, the leggings for 1,200 spirit flakes and the footwear for 1,200 spirit flakes.
translation: 当然，请递给我一件常规钓鱼者套件。我需要 1,200 个酒精片来制作一顶帽子，上衣需要 1,200 个酒精片，打底裤需要 1,200 个酒精片，鞋子需要 1,200 个酒精片。 [dang ran ， qing di gei wo yi jian chang gui diao yu zhe tao jian 。 wo xu yao  1,200  ge jiu jing pian lai zhi zuo yi ding mao zi ， shang yi xu yao  1,200  ge jiu jing pian ， da di ku xu yao  1,200  ge jiu jing pian ， xie zi xu yao  1,200  ge jiu jing pian 。]

english: Actually, I don't have any Angler kit on me at the moment, sorry.
translation: 事实上，抱歉，我现在身上没有任何钓鱼者套件。 [shi shi shang ， bao qian ， wo xian zai shen shang mei you ren he diao yu zhe tao jian 。]

english: Can you turn my Spirit Angler outfit back into the regular Angler outfit?
translation: 你能把我的精神钓鱼者服装变回普通钓鱼者服装吗？ [ni neng ba wo de jing shen diao yu zhe fu zhuang bian hui pu tong diao yu zhe fu zhuang ma ？]

english: Sure, hand me a piece of the Spirit Angler kit an' I'll convert it back for free.
translation: 当然，请给我一件灵魂钓鱼者套件，我会免费将其转换回来。 [dang ran ， qing gei wo yi jian ling hun diao yu zhe tao jian ， wo hui mian fei jiang qi zhuan huan hui lai 。]

english: Actually, I don't have any Spirit Angler kit on me at the moment, sorry.
translation: 事实上，我现在身上没有任何灵魂钓鱼者套件，抱歉。 [shi shi shang ， wo xian zai shen shang mei you ren he ling hun diao yu zhe tao jian ， bao qian 。]

english: Gita Prymes can exchange your Spirit Angler kit for regular Angler kit, but will not return your spirit flakes. You can convert it back to the Spirit Angler version for free.
translation: Gita Prymes 可以将您的灵魂钓鱼者套件交换为常规钓鱼者套件，但不会退还您的灵魂薄片。您可以免费将其转换回 Spirit Angler 版本。 [Gita Prymes  ke yi jiang nin de ling hun diao yu zhe tao jian jiao huan wei chang gui diao yu zhe tao jian ， dan bu hui tui huan nin de ling hun bao pian 。 nin ke yi mian fei jiang qi zhuan huan hui  Spirit Angler  ban ben 。]

english: I don't think I need anything from you.
translation: 我不认为我需要你提供任何东西。 [wo bu ren wei wo xu yao ni ti gong ren he dong xi 。]

english: Nay, Gita Prymes won't take that.
translation: 不，吉塔·普莱姆斯不会接受的。 [bu ， ji ta · pu lai mu si bu hui jie shou de 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Have you won the Hemenster Fishing Competition?
translation: 您赢得了赫门斯特钓鱼比赛吗？ [nin ying de le he men si te diao yu bi sai ma ？]

english: Okay, you're Gita Prymes.
translation: 好吧，你是吉塔·普莱姆斯。 [hao ba ， ni shi ji ta · pu lai mu si 。]

english: Let's talk about outfits.
translation: 我们来谈谈服装吧。 [wo men lai tan tan fu zhuang ba 。]

english: Ask about the Spirit Angler outfit.
translation: 询问精神垂钓者服装。 [xun wen jing shen chui diao zhe fu zhuang 。]

english: Cancel
translation: 取消 [qu xiao]

english: Proceed
translation: 继续 [ji xu]

english: Ask about the regular Angler outfit.
translation: 询问常规钓鱼者的服装。 [xun wen chang gui diao yu zhe de fu zhuang 。]

english: I don't think I need anything from you.
translation: 我不认为我需要你提供任何东西。 [wo bu ren wei wo xu yao ni ti gong ren he dong xi 。]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: What brings you down here, Rookie?
translation: 是什么让你来到这里，菜鸟？ [shi shen me rang ni lai dao zhe li ， cai niao ？]

english: I heard all the grunting and metal clanging. I wanted to see what was going on.
translation: 我听到所有的咕噜声和金属叮当声。我想看看发生了什么事。 [wo ting dao suo you de gu lu sheng he jin shu ding dang sheng 。 wo xiang kan kan fa sheng le shen me shi 。]

english: What do you think of our training area?
translation: 您觉得我们的培训区怎么样？ [nin jue de wo men de pei xun qu zen me yang ？]

english: Well... It smells a bit.
translation: 嗯……有点味道。 [n …… you dian wei dao 。]

english: That is the smell of courage.
translation: 那是勇气的味道。 [na shi yong qi de wei dao 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Greetings, Rookie.
translation: 问候，菜鸟。 [wen hou ， cai niao 。]

english: You lot sure look busy down here.
translation: 你们看起来肯定很忙。 [ni men kan qi lai ken ding hen mang 。]

english: We strive to become the best.
translation: 我们努力成为最好的。 [wo men nu li cheng wei zui hao de 。]

english: Well best of luck!
translation: 祝你好运！ [zhu ni hao yun ！]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello, Rookie. You'll have to excuse me. I'm keeping an eye on the other contenders.
translation: 你好，菜鸟。你得原谅我。我正在关注其他竞争者。 [ni hao ， cai niao 。 ni de yuan liang wo 。 wo zheng zai guan zhu qi ta jing zheng zhe 。]

english: May the odds be ever in your favour.
translation: 愿机会永远对你有利。 [yuan ji hui yong yuan dui ni you li 。]

english: What a nice thing to say.
translation: 真是太好了。 [zhen shi tai hao le 。]

english: You're not tired of doing that all day?
translation: 整天这样干你不累吗？ [zheng tian zhe yang gan ni bu lei ma ？]

english: I'm going to slay anything in my path!
translation: 我要杀死一切挡在我路上的东西！ [wo yao sha si yi qie dang zai wo lu shang de dong xi ！]

english: You certainly are determined!
translation: 你一定有决心！ [ni yi ding you jue xin ！]

english: Hi there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Stand back, Rookie. I need to concentrate.
translation: 退后一步，菜鸟。我需要集中注意力。 [tui hou yi bu ， cai niao 。 wo xu yao ji zhong zhu yi li 。]

english: You seemed to have that weapon mastered.
translation: 看来你已经掌握了那把武器。 [kan lai ni yi jing zhang wo le na ba wu qi 。]

english: Kill...
No...
... survivors!
translation: ...幸存者！ [... xing cun zhe ！]

english: That's impressive. I'll leave you to it.
translation: 这令人印象深刻。我就让你去吧。 [zhe ling ren yin xiang shen ke 。 wo jiu rang ni qu ba 。]

english: Can't talk... I've got 100 more to do.
translation: 不能说话...我还有 100 件事要做。 [bu neng shuo hua ... wo hai you  100  jian shi yao zuo 。]

english: Good luck.
translation: 祝你好运。 [zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Hel-
translation: 赫尔- [he er -]

english: Can't you see I'm busy here?
translation: 你没看到我在这里很忙吗？ [ni mei kan dao wo zai zhe li hen mang ma ？]

english: Of course... Enjoy your floor pushing.
translation: 当然......享受你的地板推。 [dang ran ...... xiang shou ni de di ban tui 。]

english: Well met stranger, how do you come to be in this place?
translation: 好歹遇见了陌生人，你怎么会来到这个地方？ [hao dai yu jian le mo sheng ren ， ni zen me hui lai dao zhe ge di fang ？]

english: I'm a friend of the Easter Bunny, I've been looking for him.
translation: 我是复活节兔子的朋友，我一直在寻找他。 [wo shi fu huo jie tu zi de peng you ， wo yi zhi zai xun zhao ta 。]

english: Is that so? Well that makes you my friend too. Me and Rinder here helped that crazy priest track him down.
translation: 是这样吗？好吧，这也让你成为我的朋友。我和林德在这里帮助那个疯狂的牧师找到了他。 [shi zhe yang ma ？ hao ba ， zhe ye rang ni cheng wei wo de peng you 。 wo he lin de zai zhe li bang zhu na ge feng kuang de mu shi zhao dao le ta 。]

english: That we did.
translation: 我们做到了。 [wo men zuo dao le 。]

english: I see, that was good of you.
translation: 我明白了，你真是太好了。 [wo ming bai le ， ni zhen shi tai hao le 。]

english: I won't lie, it was no selfless act. We've been promised grand rewards.
translation: 我不会撒谎，这不是无私的行为。我们已被许诺丰厚的回报。 [wo bu hui sa huang ， zhe bu shi wu si de xing wei 。 wo men yi bei xu nuo feng hou de hui bao 。]

english: Eggs! Big chocolate eggs!
translation: 鸡蛋！大巧克力蛋！ [ji dan ！ da qiao ke li dan ！]

english: It always comes down to eggs!
translation: 它总是归结为鸡蛋！ [ta zong shi gui jie wei ji dan ！]

english: I'd like to make some Easter Buns, I don't suppose you have any raisins?
translation: 我想做一些复活节面包，我想你没有葡萄干吧？ [wo xiang zuo yi xie fu huo jie mian bao ， wo xiang ni mei you pu tao gan ba ？]

english: And why would you think a man like me would have any raisins?
translation: 你为什么认为像我这样的人会有葡萄干？ [ni wei shen me ren wei xiang wo zhe yang de ren hui you pu tao gan ？]

english: I'm not sure, I don't actually know what raisins are to be honest.
translation: 我不确定，说实话，我实际上不知道葡萄干是什么。 [wo bu que ding ， shuo shi hua ， wo shi ji shang bu zhi dao pu tao gan shi shen me 。]

english: Well I'll be! Kid, raisins are dried-up grapes.
translation: 好吧，我会的！孩子，葡萄干是干了的葡萄。 [hao ba ， wo hui de ！ hai zi ， pu tao gan shi gan le de pu tao 。]

english: Oh, well do you have any of those?
translation: 哦，那么你有这些吗？ [o ， na me ni you zhe xie ma ？]

english: Not yet.
translation: 还没有。 [hai mei you 。]

english: Not yet?
translation: 还没有？ [hai mei you ？]

english: That's what I said.
translation: 我就是这么说的。 [wo jiu shi zhe me shuo de 。]

english: As it happens I have a sackful of grapes in my possession.
translation: 碰巧我手里有一袋葡萄。 [peng qiao wo shou li you yi dai pu tao 。]

english: How convenient, dare I ask why?
translation: 多方便啊，敢问为什么吗？ [duo fang bian a ， gan wen wei shen me ma ？]

english: There are great and terrible beasts in this world kid. We'd been hunting them, and believe me when I tell ye, some of 'em had an awful lot of grapes on their person.
translation: 孩子，这个世界上有伟大而可怕的野兽。我们一直在追捕他们，相信我，他们中的一些人身上带着很多葡萄。 [hai zi ， zhe ge shi jie shang you wei da er ke pa de ye shou 。 wo men yi zhi zai zhui bu ta men ， xiang xin wo ， ta men zhong de yi xie ren shen shang dai zhe hen duo pu tao 。]

english: The slaughter was feverish. We'd cut 'em down and they'd rise up, again and again.
translation: 屠杀如火如荼。我们一次又一次地砍倒它们，而它们却又重新站起来。 [tu sha ru huo ru tu 。 wo men yi ci you yi ci di kan dao ta men ， er ta men que you chong xin zhan qi lai 。]

english: Before we knew it, we'd collected a whole sackful o' grapes!
translation: 不知不觉中，我们已经收集了一整袋葡萄了！ [bu zhi bu jue zhong ， wo men yi jing shou ji le yi zheng dai pu tao le ！]

english: Seems to me we could make those into raisins, should that align with your intentions.
translation: 在我看来，如果这符合你的意图，我们可以把它们做成葡萄干。 [zai wo kan lai ， ru guo zhe fu he ni de yi tu ， wo men ke yi ba ta men zuo cheng pu tao gan 。]

english: What luck! Shall we then?
translation: 多么幸运啊！那我们可以吗？ [duo me xing yun a ！ na wo men ke yi ma ？]

english: Well alright, it'll be a long journey though.
translation: 好吧，虽然这将是一个漫长的旅程。 [hao ba ， sui ran zhe jiang shi yi ge man chang de lv cheng 。]

english: Rinder!
translation: 林德！ [lin de ！]

english: What say ye, Glanton?
translation: 格兰顿，你怎么说？ [ge lan dun ， ni zen me shuo ？]

english: Our friend here needs some raisins, let's head to the desert!
translation: 我们的朋友需要一些葡萄干，我们去沙漠吧！ [wo men de peng you xu yao yi xie pu tao gan ， wo men qu sha mo ba ！]

english: Pack yer grapes, then. Let's go.
translation: 那么，收拾你的葡萄吧。我们走吧。 [na me ， shou shi ni de pu tao ba 。 wo men zou ba 。]

english: Cutscene starts: "After a long walk, you reach the desert."
translation: 过场动画开始：“经过一段漫长的步行，你到达了沙漠。” [guo chang dong hua kai shi ：“ jing guo yi duan man chang de bu xing ， ni dao da le sha mo 。”]

english: Here we are.
translation: 我们到了。 [wo men dao le 。]

english: Here? This big rock?
translation: 这里？这块大石头？ [zhe li ？ zhe kuai da shi tou ？]

english: This big rock is perfect fer makin' raisins, kid. It's real warm.
translation: 孩子，这块大石头非常适合制作葡萄干。真的很温暖。 [hai zi ， zhe kuai da shi tou fei chang shi he zhi zuo pu tao gan 。 zhen de hen wen nuan 。]

english: It's as he says kid, real warm.
translation: 正如他所说，孩子，真的很温暖。 [zheng ru ta suo shuo ， hai zi ， zhen de hen wen nuan 。]

english: We'll leave the grapes here in good clean heat, give 'em time to think about their transgressions.
translation: 我们会把葡萄留在这儿，保持干净的温度，给他们时间思考他们的罪行。 [wo men hui ba pu tao liu zai zhe er ， bao chi gan jing de wen du ， gei ta men shi jian si kao ta men de zui xing 。]

english: I don't remember this rock being here before.
translation: 我不记得这块石头以前在这里过。 [wo bu ji de zhe kuai shi tou yi qian zai zhe li guo 。]

english: This rock was always here, before man was, even.
translation: 甚至在人类出现之前，这块岩石就一直在这里。 [shen zhi zai ren lei chu xian zhi qian ， zhe kuai yan shi jiu yi zhi zai zhe li 。]

english: That you ain't noticed it speaks to yer purview of the world.
translation: 你没有注意到它说明了你对世界的权限。 [ni mei you zhu yi dao ta shuo ming le ni dui shi jie de quan xian 。]

english: I'm almost certain this is new.
translation: 我几乎可以肯定这是新的。 [wo ji hu ke yi ken ding zhe shi xin de 。]

english: Perhaps more things in this world exist without yer knowledge than with it. Did ye consider that?
translation: 也许这个世界上存在的更多事物是你不知道的，而不是你知道的。你们考虑过吗？ [ye xu zhe ge shi jie shang cun zai de geng duo shi wu shi ni bu zhi dao de ， er bu shi ni zhi dao de 。 ni men kao lv guo ma ？]

english: Well no, it's just a rock.
translation: 嗯，不，它只是一块石头。 [n ， bu ， ta zhi shi yi kuai shi tou 。]

english: Alright alright already! Let's get these grapes going.
translation: 已经好了好了！让我们把这些葡萄摘下来吧。 [yi jing hao le hao le ！ rang wo men ba zhe xie pu tao zhai xia lai ba 。]

english: We'd best I suppose. Lay them down and see to their transformation.
translation: 我想我们最好。把它们放下来，看看它们的转变。 [wo xiang wo men zui hao 。 ba ta men fang xia lai ， kan kan ta men de zhuan bian 。]

english: Hmm, let's see...
translation: 嗯，让我们看看... [n ， rang wo men kan kan ...]

english: I judge these grapes to be...
translation: 我判断这些葡萄... [wo pan duan zhe xie pu tao ...]

english: ...Plump and juicy! But not fer long!
translation: ...饱满多汁！但不会太久！ [... bao man duo zhi ！ dan bu hui tai jiu ！]

english: We'll see them desiccated soon enough.
translation: 我们很快就会看到它们变干。 [wo men hen kuai jiu hui kan dao ta men bian gan 。]

english: It is their destiny. A curse on these grapes!
translation: 这是他们的命运。这些葡萄受到诅咒！ [zhe shi ta men de ming yun 。 zhe xie pu tao shou dao zu zhou ！]

english: [player name], You've gotta make the grapes feel bad or they won't shrivel up.
translation: [玩家姓名]，你必须让葡萄感觉不好，否则它们就不会枯萎。 [[ wan jia xing ming ]， ni bi xu rang pu tao gan jue bu hao ， fou ze ta men jiu bu hui ku wei 。]

english: Oh I see, um, curse those grapes! Suffer you foolish berries! Ha!
translation: 哦，我明白了，嗯，诅咒那些葡萄！让你们这些愚蠢的浆果受苦吧！哈! [o ， wo ming bai le ， n ， zu zhou na xie pu tao ！ rang ni men zhe xie yu chun de jiang guo shou ku ba ！ ha !]

english: Now yer gettin' it!
translation: 现在你明白了！ [xian zai ni ming bai le ！]

english: Insufferable fruits! Rank orbs of low repute!
translation: 难以抗拒的水果！低声望的等级球！ [nan yi kang ju de shui guo ！ di sheng wang de deng ji qiu ！]

english: You tell 'em what for!
translation: 你告诉他们为什么！ [ni gao su ta men wei shen me ！]

english: Cutscene: "A long while later..."
translation: 过场动画：“很久以后……” [guo chang dong hua ：“ hen jiu yi hou ……”]

english: Well look at these! Perfect!
translation: 好看看这些！完美的！ [hao kan kan zhe xie ！ wan mei de ！]

english: They're a fine example of raisins I'll say.
translation: 我想说，它们是葡萄干的一个很好的例子。 [wo xiang shuo ， ta men shi pu tao gan de yi ge hen hao de li zi 。]

english: Great! let's get back to the Rabbit Hole then.
translation: 伟大的！那么让我们回到兔子洞吧。 [wei da de ！ na me rang wo men hui dao tu zi dong ba 。]

english: Player is returned to the Rabbit Hole
translation: 玩家返回兔子洞 [wan jia fan hui tu zi dong]

english: Well that was interesting.
translation: 嗯，这很有趣。 [n ， zhe hen you qu 。]

english: Yes it was, come back when ye have some space and I'll give ye yer share of raisins.
translation: 是的，当你们有空的时候再回来，我会给你们一份葡萄干。 [shi de ， dang ni men you kong de shi hou zai hui lai ， wo hui gei ni men yi fen pu tao gan 。]

english: Yes it was. Here's some raisins for yer troubles.
translation: 是的，确实如此。这是一些葡萄干，可以解决你的烦恼。 [shi de ， que shi ru ci 。 zhe shi yi xie pu tao gan ， ke yi jie jue ni de fan nao 。]

english: Thank you!
translation: 谢谢你！ [xie xie ni ！]

english: Can I have some raisins please?
translation: 请给我一些葡萄干吗？ [qing gei wo yi xie pu tao gan ma ？]

english: I think ye have enough raisins at the moment.
translation: 我想你们现在有足够的葡萄干了。 [wo xiang ni men xian zai you zu gou de pu tao gan le 。]

english: Make some space for them and ye can have some more.
translation: 为他们腾出一些空间，你就可以拥有更多。 [wei ta men teng chu yi xie kong jian ， ni jiu ke yi yong you geng duo 。]

english: Of course, we've plenty to spare after that trip.
translation: 当然，那次旅行之后我们还有很多空闲时间。 [dang ran ， na ci lv xing zhi hou wo men hai you hen duo kong xian shi jian 。]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: Thanks for taking me to make raisins.
translation: 谢谢你带我去做葡萄干。 [xie xie ni dai wo qu zuo pu tao gan 。]

english: I was plenty happy to educate ye.
translation: 我很高兴能够教育你们。 [wo hen gao xing neng gou jiao yu ni men 。]

english: I used those raisins to make some Easter Buns, and the Easter Bunny really enjoyed them!
translation: 我用那些葡萄干做了一些复活节面包，复活节兔子非常喜欢它们！ [wo yong na xie pu tao gan zuo le yi xie fu huo jie mian bao ， fu huo jie tu zi fei chang xi huan ta men ！]

english: Well that's great, kid.
translation: 嗯，那太好了，孩子。 [n ， na tai hao le ， hai zi 。]

english: Thanks again for the help.
translation: 再次感谢您的帮助。 [zai ci gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]

english: Any time. You owe me one.
translation: 任何时间。你欠我一份。 [ren he shi jian 。 ni qian wo yi fen 。]

english: Oh, I uh, suppose I do.
translation: 哦，我呃，我想是的。 [o ， wo e ， wo xiang shi de 。]

english: It won't catch on, Glanton.
translation: 它不会流行起来，格兰顿。 [ta bu hui liu xing qi lai ， ge lan dun 。]

english: Ah don't be like that Rinder, how will we know till we try?
translation: 啊，别像那个 Rinder，除非我们尝试，否则我们怎么知道呢？ [a ， bie xiang na ge  Rinder， chu fei wo men chang shi ， fou ze wo men zen me zhi dao ne ？]

english: Alright gents, what's going on here then?
translation: 好吧，先生们，那么这里发生了什么？ [hao ba ， xian sheng men ， na me zhe li fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: I've had this great idea see.
translation: 我有这个好主意。 [wo you zhe ge hao zhu yi 。]

english: Does it have anything to do with long walks in the desert again?
translation: 这和又在沙漠里长途跋涉有什么关系吗？ [zhe he you zai sha mo li zhang tu ba she you shen me guan xi ma ？]

english: Well y'see thats the beauty of it.
translation: 嗯，你看，这就是它的美妙之处。 [n ， ni kan ， zhe jiu shi ta de mei miao zhi chu 。]

english: It's a lot easier to melt chocolate than dry out grapes.
translation: 融化巧克力比晒干葡萄容易得多。 [rong hua qiao ke li bi shai gan pu tao rong yi de duo 。]

english: Chocolate? You've piqued my interest!
translation: 巧克力？你引起了我的兴趣！ [qiao ke li ？ ni yin qi le wo de xing qu ！]

english: Exactly! See Rinder, [player name] doesn't even know half the idea yet and wants in!
translation: 确切地！看看 Rinder，[玩家名字] 甚至还不知道一半的想法，但想加入！ [que qie di ！ kan kan  Rinder，[ wan jia ming zi ]  shen zhi hai bu zhi dao yi ban de xiang fa ， dan xiang jia ru ！]

english: It still seems terribly messy.
translation: 看起来仍然非常混乱。 [kan qi lai reng ran fei chang hun luan 。]

english: Okay so, what we do is use our connections with the Easter Bunny to acquire a lot of chocolate.
translation: 好吧，我们要做的就是利用我们与复活节兔子的联系来获取大量巧克力。 [hao ba ， wo men yao zuo de jiu shi li yong wo men yu fu huo jie tu zi de lian xi lai huo qu da liang qiao ke li 。]

english: And give it to me for my outstanding contributions to the preservation of Easter?
translation: 并把它送给我，以表彰我对保存复活节的杰出贡献？ [bing ba ta song gei wo ， yi biao zhang wo dui bao cun fu huo jie de jie chu gong xian ？]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: And we melt it all up, and put it in a fountain.
translation: 我们把它全部融化，然后把它放进喷泉里。 [wo men ba ta quan bu rong hua ， ran hou ba ta fang jin pen quan li 。]

english: And then I get to have it all?
translation: 然后我就能拥有这一切？ [ran hou wo jiu neng yong you zhe yi qie ？]

english: No then we sell people the right to take a couple of small fruits to dip in the fountain and eat!
translation: 不，那么我们就向人们出售权利，让他们可以拿一些小水果浸在喷泉里吃！ [bu ， na me wo men jiu xiang ren men chu shou quan li ， rang ta men ke yi na yi xie xiao shui guo jin zai pen quan li chi ！]

english: That sounds delicious!
translation: 听起来很好吃！ [ting qi lai hen hao chi ！]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: But I can get some for free?
translation: 但我可以免费得到一些吗？ [dan wo ke yi mian fei de dao yi xie ma ？]

english: See the amount people would pay for just a taste of chocolate is so much higher than we'd have to pay to source a lot of the stuff.
translation: 看看人们为尝尝巧克力而支付的金额比我们购买大量巧克力所支付的金额高得多。 [kan kan ren men wei chang chang qiao ke li er zhi fu de jin e bi wo men gou mai da liang qiao ke li suo zhi fu de jin e gao de duo 。]

english: Well, I'm not interested if I have to pay.
translation: 好吧，如果我必须付钱的话我不感兴趣。 [hao ba ， ru guo wo bi xu fu qian de hua wo bu gan xing qu 。]

english: I saved Easter...
translation: 我拯救了复活节... [wo zheng jiu le fu huo jie ...]

english: ... Again!
translation: ... 再次！ [...  zai ci ！]

english: I think I'll go see if the Easter Bunny has some more eggs for me...
translation: 我想我要去看看复活节兔子是否还有更多的彩蛋给我...... [wo xiang wo yao qu kan kan fu huo jie tu zi shi fou hai you geng duo de cai dan gei wo ......]

english: Be seeing you!
translation: 见到你了！ [jian dao ni le ！]

english: Here, look at my lovely gems.
translation: 来，看看我可爱的宝石。 [lai ， kan kan wo ke ai de bao shi 。]

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
translation: 嘿！把你的手拿开！ [hei ！ ba ni de shou na kai ！]

english: You're the one who stole something from me!
translation: 你就是偷了我东西的人！ [ni jiu shi tou le wo dong xi de ren ！]

english: Guards guards!
translation: 卫兵卫兵！ [wei bing wei bing ！]

english: Glod smash!
translation: 黄金粉碎！ [huang jin fen sui ！]

english: Glod bash!
translation: 黄金盛宴！ [huang jin sheng yan ！]

english: Grind your bones!
translation: 磨碎你的骨头！ [mo sui ni de gu tou ！]

english: Stupid clouds make Glod angry!
translation: 愚蠢的云让金神生气了！ [yu chun de yun rang jin shen sheng qi le ！]

english: You wouldn't like Glod when Glod angry!
translation: 当格洛德生气时你不会喜欢格洛德！ [dang ge luo de sheng qi shi ni bu hui xi huan ge luo de ！]

english: Why everyone attack Glod?
translation: 为什么大家都攻击Glod？ [wei shen me da jia dou gong ji Glod？]

english: Gods, give Glod strength!
translation: 诸神，请赐予格鲁德力量吧！ [zhu shen ， qing ci yu ge lu de li liang ba ！]

english: Glod appears to have more Strength and Attack power than before!
translation: 格洛德的力量和攻击力似乎都比以前更强了！ [ge luo de de li liang he gong ji li si hu dou bi yi qian geng qiang le ！]

english: Glod not die so easily!
translation: 金光没那么容易死！ [jin guang mei na me rong yi si ！]

english: Glod heals himself slightly.
translation: 格洛德稍微治愈了自己。 [ge luo de shao wei zhi yu le zi ji 。]

english: GLOD SMASH!
translation: 黄金粉碎！ [huang jin fen sui ！]

english: Your prayer is drained by Glod's attack!
translation: 你的祈祷被格洛德的攻击耗尽了！ [ni de qi dao bei ge luo de de gong ji hao jin le ！]

english: Flee, pesky mortal!
translation: 逃吧，讨厌的凡人！ [tao ba ， tao yan de fan ren ！]

english: At Glod's cry you are forced to run away!
translation: 在格洛德的呼喊声中，你被迫逃跑！ [zai ge luo de de hu han sheng zhong ， ni bei po tao pao ！]

english: You puny human. Come to Glod!
translation: 你这个弱小的人类。来金德吧！ [ni zhe ge ruo xiao de ren lei 。 lai jin de ba ！]

english: You are enraged by Glod's taunts and forced to charge towards him to fight!
translation: 你被格洛德的嘲讽激怒了，被迫冲向他战斗！ [ni bei ge luo de de chao feng ji nu le ， bei po chong xiang ta zhan dou ！]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 你知道，打招呼的方式有很多种。你好，你好，你好…… [ni zhi dao ， da zhao hu de fang shi you hen duo zhong 。 ni hao ， ni hao ， ni hao ……]

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 那还是只能算一个！ [na hai shi zhi neng suan yi ge ！]

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。你今天怎么样？ [ni hao 。 ni jin tian zen me yang ？]

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很棒，谢谢你！ [wo hen bang ， xie xie ni ！]

english: Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 你好！水晶城里今天过得怎么样啊？ [ni hao ！ shui jing cheng li jin tian guo de zen me yang a ？]

english: Indeed.
translation: 的确。 [di que 。]

english: What can I do for ya?
translation: 我能为你做什么？ [wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 各种各样的事情！这些塔楼是一个美妙的景观。 [ge zhong ge yang de shi qing ！ zhe xie ta lou shi yi ge mei miao de jing guan 。]

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 在像今天这样的日子，我建议您参观市场。 [zai xiang jin tian zhe yang de ri zi ， wo jian yi nin can guan shi chang 。]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你认为你在做什么？ [ni ren wei ni zai zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Hello there, [rank].
translation: 你好，[排名]。 [ni hao ，[ pai ming ]。]

english: I've not seen you round these parts before.
translation: 我以前没见过你把这些零件弄圆。 [wo yi qian mei jian guo ni ba zhe xie ling jian nong yuan 。]

english: Well I'm still fairly new here.
translation: 嗯，我在这里还是个新人。 [n ， wo zai zhe li hai shi ge xin ren 。]

english: [Rank]?
You heard correct.
translation: 你没听错。 [ni mei ting cuo 。]

english: The name's Gloria. Nice to meet you.
translation: 我的名字叫格洛丽亚。很高兴见到你。 [wo de ming zi jiao ge luo li ya 。 hen gao xing jian dao ni 。]

english: You too. I'm [player name]. What are you doing hanging round the Colosseum?
translation: 你也是。我是[玩家姓名]。你在罗马斗兽场闲逛做什么？ [ni ye shi 。 wo shi [ wan jia xing ming ]。 ni zai luo ma dou shou chang xian guang zuo shen me ？]

english: I've become quite fond of keeping an eye on the contenders and sharing news of their progress to those around the city.
translation: 我变得非常喜欢关注竞争者并向城市各地的人们分享他们的进展消息。 [wo bian de fei chang xi huan guan zhu jing zheng zhe bing xiang cheng shi ge di de ren men fen xiang ta men de jin zhan xiao xi 。]

english: You see, inside the Colosseum you'll earn what's called Glory.
translation: 你看，在斗兽场内你将获得所谓的荣耀。 [ni kan ， zai dou shou chang nei ni jiang huo de suo wei de rong yao 。]

english: What's Glory?
translation: 荣耀是什么？ [rong yao shi shen me ？]

english: Glory will improve your status and reputation around the city. You might even get some rewards.
translation: 荣耀将提高你在城市中的地位和声誉。你甚至可能会得到一些奖励。 [rong yao jiang ti gao ni zai cheng shi zhong de di wei he sheng yu 。 ni shen zhi ke neng hui de dao yi xie jiang li 。]

english: How does Glory work?
translation: 荣耀如何运作？ [rong yao ru he yun zuo ？]

english: It's simple really, you get Glory from participating in the Colosseum! You'll get more Glory the better you perform.
translation: 其实很简单，参加斗兽场就能获得荣耀！你表现得越好，你就会获得更多的荣耀。 [qi shi hen jian dan ， can jia dou shou chang jiu neng huo de rong yao ！ ni biao xian de yue hao ， ni jiu hui huo de geng duo de rong yao 。]

english: Performance is measured by a few things. For example, how many hits you take or how quickly you complete the challenges.
translation: 性能是通过几件事来衡量的。例如，您受到了多少次打击或完成挑战的速度。 [xing neng shi tong guo ji jian shi lai heng liang de 。 li ru ， nin shou dao le duo shao ci da ji huo wan cheng tiao zhan de su du 。]

english: Sounds good to me. Have you earned any Glory yourself?
translation: 对我来说听起来不错。你自己赢得过任何荣耀吗？ [dui wo lai shuo ting qi lai bu cuo 。 ni zi ji ying de guo ren he rong yao ma ？]

english: Ha! No. But I do have this fancy armour which is pretty glorious! You may be lucky enough to get some of your own from within the Colosseum.
translation: 哈!不，但我确实有这件华丽的盔甲，非常华丽！您可能很幸运，可以在罗马斗兽场内获得一些属于您自己的东西。 [ha ! bu ， dan wo que shi you zhe jian hua li de kui jia ， fei chang hua li ！ nin ke neng hen xing yun ， ke yi zai luo ma dou shou chang nei huo de yi xie shu yu nin zi ji de dong xi 。]

english: Tell me more about these rewards.
translation: 告诉我更多关于这些奖励的信息。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu zhe xie jiang li de xin xi 。]

english: But of course! People all accross Varlamore will hear of your Glory.
translation: 但当然！整个瓦拉莫尔的人们都会听说你的荣耀。 [dan dang ran ！ zheng ge wa la mo er de ren men du hui ting shuo ni de rong yao 。]

english: You'll get a range of benefits depending on your status.
translation: 根据您的身份，您将获得一系列福利。 [gen ju nin de shen fen ， nin jiang huo de yi xi lie fu li 。]

english: How do I improve my status?
translation: 我该如何提高我的状态？ [wo gai ru he ti gao wo de zhuang tai ？]

english: Earn more Glory of course. The more you earn, the better your standing in the city.
translation: 当然，赢得更多荣耀。你赚的越多，你在城市中的地位就越高。 [dang ran ， ying de geng duo rong yao 。 ni zhuan de yue duo ， ni zai cheng shi zhong de di wei jiu yue gao 。]

english: You can check your status on that board over there. I keep it up to date.
translation: 您可以在那边的板上查看您的状态。我会保持最新状态。 [nin ke yi zai na bian de ban shang cha kan nin de zhuang tai 。 wo hui bao chi zui xin zhuang tai 。]

english: What exactly are the benefits?
translation: 具体有什么好处呢？ [ju ti you shen me hao chu ne ？]

english: Well...
translation: 出色地... [chu se di ...]

english: Reaching Brawler status will give you access to the bank within the Colosseum.
translation: 达到斗殴者状态后，您将可以进入斗兽场内的银行。 [da dao dou ou zhe zhuang tai hou ， nin jiang ke yi jin ru dou shou chang nei de yin hang 。]

english: Reaching Challenger status will allow you to respawn in Civitas illa Fortis if you so desire.
translation: 如果您愿意，达到挑战者状态将允许您在 Civitas illa Fortis 重生。 [ru guo nin yuan yi ， da dao tiao zhan zhe zhuang tai jiang yun xu nin zai  Civitas illa Fortis  chong sheng 。]

english: Reaching Gladiator status might persuade some of the more shady folk around the city to give you more money for... Let's just say illicit valuables.
translation: 达到角斗士的地位可能会说服城市中一些更阴暗的人给你更多的钱……让我们只说非法贵重物品。 [da dao jue dou shi de di wei ke neng hui shuo fu cheng shi zhong yi xie geng yin an de ren gei ni geng duo de qian …… rang wo men zhi shuo fei fa gui zhong wu pin 。]

english: Reaching Hero status will allow you to travel to the Colosseum via the Ring of Dueling.
translation: 达到英雄状态将允许您通过决斗之环前往斗兽场。 [da dao ying xiong zhuang tai jiang yun xu nin tong guo jue dou zhi huan qian wang dou shou chang 。]

english: Reaching Champion status will grant you free herb patch protection just west of the city.
translation: 达到冠军状态将为您提供城市西部免费药草地保护。 [da dao guan jun zhuang tai jiang wei nin ti gong cheng shi xi bu mian fei yao cao di bao hu 。]

english: And reaching Grand Champion status will unlock you the Fortis Salute emote.
translation: 达到总冠军状态将为您解锁富通致敬表情。 [da dao zong guan jun zhuang tai jiang wei nin jie suo fu tong zhi jing biao qing 。]

english: Do you know how much Glory I need for each status?
translation: 你知道我每个状态需要多少荣耀吗？ [ni zhi dao wo mei ge zhuang tai xu yao duo shao rong yao ma ？]

english: You'll have to figure that out on your journey to becoming a Grand Champion.
translation: 在成为总冠军的旅程中，您必须弄清楚这一点。 [zai cheng wei zong guan jun de lv cheng zhong ， nin bi xu nong qing chu zhe yi dian 。]

english: Fair enough.
translation: 很公平。 [hen gong ping 。]

english: Do you know my Glory status?
translation: 你知道我的荣耀状态吗？ [ni zhi dao wo de rong yao zhuang tai ma ？]

english: That I do, [player name].
translation: 我就是这么做的，[玩家姓名]。 [wo jiu shi zhe me zuo de ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: It seems as though you are still a Rookie to the people of Fortis.
translation: 在富通人看来，你还是个菜鸟。 [zai fu tong ren kan lai ， ni hai shi ge cai niao 。]

english: You'll make a name of yourself in no time, [player name].
translation: 你很快就会出名的，[玩家名字]。 [ni hen kuai jiu hui chu ming de ，[ wan jia ming zi ]。]

english: I'll do my very best.
translation: 我会尽力而为。 [wo hui jin li er wei 。]

english: You are a Brawler!
translation: 你是一个斗士！ [ni shi yi ge dou shi ！]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: You are a Grand Champion!
translation: 你是总冠军！ [ni shi zong guan jun ！]

english: You can check that board over there to see any details of your Glory. I try to update it regularly.
translation: 你可以检查那边的面板来查看你的荣耀的任何详细信息。我尝试定期更新它。 [ni ke yi jian cha na bian de mian ban lai cha kan ni de rong yao de ren he xiang xi xin xi 。 wo chang shi ding qi geng xin ta 。]

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: I see you've been trying to conquer the Colosseum, eh?
translation: 我看你一直想征服斗兽场，是吗？ [wo kan ni yi zhi xiang zheng fu dou shou chang ， shi ma ？]

english: I have indeed, and I will become a champion!
translation: 我确实做到了，我也会成为冠军！ [wo que shi zuo dao le ， wo ye hui cheng wei guan jun ！]

english: That's it, positive thoughts.
translation: 就是这样，积极的想法。 [jiu shi zhe yang ， ji ji de xiang fa 。]

english: I was watching when you became Grand Champion of the Colosseum. It was truly something to behold.
translation: 当你成为斗兽场总冠军时我就在看着。这确实是一件值得一看的事情。 [dang ni cheng wei dou shou chang zong guan jun shi wo jiu zai kan zhe 。 zhe que shi shi yi jian zhi de yi kan de shi qing 。]

english: What brings you over to me today?
translation: 是什么让你今天来找我的？ [shi shen me rang ni jin tian lai zhao wo de ？]

english: I was wondering if we could talk about Glory?
translation: 我想知道我们是否可以谈谈荣耀？ [wo xiang zhi dao wo men shi fou ke yi tan tan rong yao ？]

english: But of course. What do you wish to know?
translation: 当然。您想知道什么？ [dang ran 。 nin xiang zhi dao shen me ？]

english: Actually, I'm good.
translation: 其实我很好。 [qi shi wo hen hao 。]

english: Hello there, Grand Champion.
translation: 你好，总冠军。 [ni hao ， zong guan jun 。]

english: Grand Champion?
translation: 总冠军？ [zong guan jun ？]

english: How does Glory work?
translation: 荣耀如何运作？ [rong yao ru he yun zuo ？]

english: Are there any rewards?
translation: 有奖励吗？ [you jiang li ma ？]

english: Do you know my Glory status?
translation: 你知道我的荣耀状态吗？ [ni zhi dao wo de rong yao zhuang tai ma ？]

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: Tell me more about these rewards.
translation: 告诉我更多关于这些奖励的信息。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu zhe xie jiang li de xin xi 。]

english: Actually, I'm good.
translation: 其实我很好。 [qi shi wo hen hao 。]

english: Urgh...
He looks too sick to chat.
translation: 他看起来病得很重，无法聊天。 [ta kan qi lai bing de hen zhong ， wu fa liao tian 。]

english: I'm really grateful to you for clearing up what Ithoi did to us. The rest of the Corsairs will appreciate my cooking even more now!
translation: 我真的很感谢你澄清了伊索伊对我们所做的事情。剩下的海盗们现在会更加欣赏我的厨艺了！ [wo zhen de hen gan xie ni cheng qing le yi suo yi dui wo men suo zuo de shi qing 。 sheng xia de hai dao men xian zai hui geng jia xin shang wo de chu yi le ！]

english: That's good for you!
translation: 这对你有好处！ [zhe dui ni you hao chu ！]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Can't stop sorry! Busy, busy, busy!
translation: 停不下来抱歉！忙、忙、忙！ [ting bu xia lai bao qian ！ mang 、 mang 、 mang ！]

english: The gnome is too busy to talk.
translation: 侏儒太忙了，没时间说话。 [zhu ru tai mang le ， mei shi jian shuo hua 。]

english: Hello traveller. Are you enjoying your stay?
translation: 你好旅行者。您住宿愉快吗？ [ni hao lv xing zhe 。 nin zhu su yu kuai ma ？]

english: It's a nice place.
translation: 这是一个不错的地方。 [zhe shi yi ge bu cuo de di fang 。]

english: Yes, we try to keep it that way.
translation: 是的，我们努​​力保持这种状态。 [shi de ， wo men nu ​​ li bao chi zhe zhong zhuang tai 。]

english: Are you OK?
translation: 你还好吗？ [ni hai hao ma ？]

english: The gnome seems a little drunk.
translation: 侏儒似乎有点喝醉了。 [zhu ru si hu you dian he zui le 。]

english: Youssh go gesshh em.
translation: 你去吧，他们。 [ni qu ba ， ta men 。]

english: Pardon?
translation: 赦免？ [she mian ？]

english: Gessh ush a cosshtail.
translation: Gessh 推出了 coshtail。 [Gessh  tui chu le  coshtail。]

english: A what?
translation: 一个什么？ [yi ge shen me ？]

english: Blurssh berry.
translation: 模糊浆果。 [mo hu jiang guo 。]

english: I think he's had enough!
translation: 我想他已经受够了！ [wo xiang ta yi jing shou gou le ！]

english: I don't think I can take much more!
translation: 我想我不能承受更多了！ [wo xiang wo bu neng cheng shou geng duo le ！]

english: What's wrong?
translation: 怎么了？ [zen me le ？]

english: It's just the wife, she won't stop moaning!
translation: 只是妻子，她不会停止呻吟！ [zhi shi qi zi ， ta bu hui ting zhi shen yin ！]

english: Maybe you should give her less to moan about.
translation: 也许你应该少给她一些抱怨。 [ye xu ni ying gai shao gei ta yi xie bao yuan 。]

english: She'll always find something.
translation: 她总会找到一些东西。 [ta zong hui zhao dao yi xie dong xi 。]

english: How's life treating you?
translation: 生活对你怎么样？ [sheng huo dui ni zen me yang ？]

english: Not bad, not bad at all.
translation: 不错，一点也不差。 [bu cuo ， yi dian ye bu cha 。]

english: It's good to see a human with a positive attitude.
translation: 很高兴看到一个态度积极的人。 [hen gao xing kan dao yi ge tai du ji ji de ren 。]

english: You're the human that dealt with those mourners aren't you? Thanks for that, they were really bothersome.
translation: 你就是那个处理那些哀悼者的人，不是吗？谢谢你们，他们真的很麻烦。 [ni jiu shi na ge chu li na xie ai dao zhe de ren ， bu shi ma ？ xie xie ni men ， ta men zhen de hen ma fan 。]

english: No problem. Why are you still here anyway?
translation: 没问题。你为什么还在这里？ [mei wen ti 。 ni wei shen me hai zai zhe li ？]

english: The mourners left plenty of stuff behind, thought I'd see if there was anything useful.
translation: 哀悼者留下了很多东西，我想看看是否有什么有用的东西。 [ai dao zhe liu xia le hen duo dong xi ， wo xiang kan kan shi fou you shen me you yong de dong xi 。]

english: Fair enough, have fun.
translation: 够公平的，玩得开心。 [gou gong ping de ， wan de kai xin 。]

english: Argh!
Hello again, [player name].
translation: 再次问好，[玩家姓名]。 [zai ci wen hao ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 告诉我这个地方。 [gao su wo zhe ge di fang 。]

english: Over time, many people have come into the world and left it again. One such is Thrander, who used to perform armour conversion services in Varrock. Another is Chuck, the wood certificate trader.
translation: 随着时间的推移，很多人来到这个世界，又又离开这个世界。瑟兰德就是其中之一，他曾在瓦罗克从事装甲改装服务。另一位是查克，木材证书交易员。 [sui zhe shi jian de tui yi ， hen duo ren lai dao zhe ge shi jie ， you you li kai zhe ge shi jie 。 se lan de jiu shi qi zhong zhi yi ， ta ceng zai wa luo ke cong shi zhuang jia gai zhuang fu wu 。 ling yi wei shi cha ke ， mu cai zheng shu jiao yi yuan 。]

english: When their services were no longer required, they moved on, but they were not all forgotten. Some linger still in the Realm of Memories.
translation: 当不再需要他们的服务时，他们就继续前进，但他们并没有被全部遗忘。有些人还留在记忆王国里。 [dang bu zai xu yao ta men de fu wu shi ， ta men jiu ji xu qian jin ， dan ta men bing mei you bei quan bu yi wang 。 you xie ren hai liu zai ji yi wang guo li 。]

english: From the Realm, we watch how the world changes. We see the happy moments, the sad times, the lucky events, the dry streaks. It is a wonderful existence.
translation: 从王国中，我们观察世界如何变化。我们看到快乐的时刻，悲伤的时刻，幸运的事件，干涸的条纹。这是一个美妙的存在。 [cong wang guo zhong ， wo men guan cha shi jie ru he bian hua 。 wo men kan dao kuai le de shi ke ， bei shang de shi ke ， xing yun de shi jian ， gan he de tiao wen 。 zhe shi yi ge mei miao de cun zai 。]

english: Can you give me more reward items?
translation: 可以给我更多的奖励吗？ [ke yi gei wo geng duo de jiang li ma ？]

english: You cannot hold any more items from me now. You may wish to visit Diango, in Draynor Village, to collect more rewards in a more convenient setting.
translation: 你现在不能再拿走我的任何东西了。您不妨前往德拉诺村的迪亚戈 (Diango)，在更便利的环境中收集更多奖励。 [ni xian zai bu neng zai na zou wo de ren he dong xi le 。 nin bu fang qian wang de la nuo cun de di ya ge  (Diango)， zai geng bian li de huan jing zhong shou ji geng duo jiang li 。]

english: I have given you what you can hold. You may wish to visit Diango, in Draynor Village, to collect more rewards in a more convenient setting.
translation: 我已经给了你你能握住的东西。您不妨前往德拉诺村的迪亚戈 (Diango)，在更便利的环境中收集更多奖励。 [wo yi jing gei le ni ni neng wo zhu de dong xi 。 nin bu fang qian wang de la nuo cun de di ya ge  (Diango)， zai geng bian li de huan jing zhong shou ji geng duo jiang li 。]

english: I think that is everything I have for you.
translation: 我想这就是我为你准备的一切。 [wo xiang zhe jiu shi wo wei ni zhun bei de yi qie 。]

english: I have nothing more for you.
translation: 我没有什么可以给你的了。 [wo mei you shen me ke yi gei ni de le 。]

english: Who are the people here?
translation: 这里的人是谁？ [zhe li de ren shi shui ？]

english: Like me, they dwelt in the world as it used to be, in various different eras. Many such people have faded away into the mists of time, but a lucky few are remembered.
translation: 和我一样，他们生活在过去的世界里，生活在不同的时代。许多这样的人已经消失在时间的迷雾中，但幸运的是少数人被人们记住。 [he wo yi yang ， ta men sheng huo zai guo qu de shi jie li ， sheng huo zai bu tong de shi dai 。 xu duo zhe yang de ren yi jing xiao shi zai shi jian de mi wu zhong ， dan xing yun de shi shao shu ren bei ren men ji zhu 。]

english: They would be glad to meet you, I am sure.
translation: 我相信他们会很高兴见到你。 [wo xiang xin ta men hui hen gao xing jian dao ni 。]

english: Can I see more stuff from your era?
translation: 我可以看到更多你那个时代的东西吗？ [wo ke yi kan dao geng duo ni na ge shi dai de dong xi ma ？]

english: I would have dearly loved that. However we are limited to this hall, where the more aggressive creatures can play in safety.
translation: 我会非常喜欢那个。然而，我们仅限于这个大厅，更具攻击性的生物可以在这里安全地玩耍。 [wo hui fei chang xi huan na ge 。 ran er ， wo men jin xian yu zhe ge da ting ， geng ju gong ji xing de sheng wu ke yi zai zhe li an quan di wan shua 。]

english: Furthermore, the dimensional shifts would not allow it - a two-dimensional entity would be incomprehensible to your three-dimensional mind.
translation: 此外，维度转换不允许这样做——二维实体对于你的三维思维来说是不可理解的。 [ci wai ， wei du zhuan huan bu yun xu zhe yang zuo —— er wei shi ti dui yu ni de san wei si wei lai shuo shi bu ke li jie de 。]

english: No, some things must be left to the memory, even here in the Realm of Memories.
translation: 不，有些事情是必须要留在记忆里的，即使是在记忆领域。 [bu ， you xie shi qing shi bi xu yao liu zai ji yi li de ， ji shi shi zai ji yi ling yu 。]

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 告诉我这个地方。 [gao su wo zhe ge di fang 。]

english: Can you give me more reward items?
translation: 可以给我更多的奖励吗？ [ke yi gei wo geng duo de jiang li ma ？]

english: Who are the people here?
translation: 这里的人是谁？ [zhe li de ren shi shui ？]

english: Can I see more stuff from your era?
translation: 我可以看到更多你那个时代的东西吗？ [wo ke yi kan dao geng duo ni na ge shi dai de dong xi ma ？]

english: Run faster! Faster!
translation: 跑得更快！快点！ [pao de geng kuai ！ kuai dian ！]

english: Excuse me?
translation: 打扰一下？ [da rao yi xia ？]

english: Oh, sorry, I didn't notice you there.
translation: 哦，抱歉，我没注意到你在那里。 [o ， bao qian ， wo mei zhu yi dao ni zai na li 。]

english: I take it you're a coach?
translation: 我猜你是教练？ [wo cai ni shi jiao lian ？]

english: That I am. Now get to the point, I'm very busy!
translation: 我就是这样。现在进入正题，我很忙！ [wo jiu shi zhe yang 。 xian zai jin ru zheng ti ， wo hen mang ！]

english: What's the history of Gnome ball?
translation: 侏儒球的历史是什么？ [zhu ru qiu de li shi shi shen me ？]

english: Be more precise, stranger.
translation: 更准确地说，陌生人。 [geng zhun que di shuo ， mo sheng ren 。]

english: How did it all start?
translation: 这一切是如何开始的？ [zhe yi qie shi ru he kai shi de ？]

english: Strangely enough, by accident.
translation: 奇怪的是，偶然。 [qi guai de shi ， ou ran 。]

english: Accident?
translation: 事故？ [shi gu ？]

english: Don't interrupt!
translation: 别打扰！ [bie da rao ！]

english: Sorry.
translation: 对不起。 [dui bu qi 。]

english: A great many years ago, before I was even born, there were two young Gnomes. Brothers to be exact.
translation: 很多年前，在我出生之前，有两个年轻的侏儒。准确的说是兄弟。 [hen duo nian qian ， zai wo chu sheng zhi qian ， you liang ge nian qing de zhu ru 。 zhun que de shuo shi xiong di 。]

english: They were always arguing with each other over the most trivial things - who was the faster runner or who was the tallest.
translation: 他们总是在最琐碎的事情上争论——谁跑得更快，谁最高。 [ta men zong shi zai zui suo sui de shi qing shang zheng lun —— shui pao de geng kuai ， shui zui gao 。]

english: One day they were up at the swamp throwing stones at the toads.
translation: 有一天，他们在沼泽地里向蟾蜍扔石头。 [you yi tian ， ta men zai zhao ze di li xiang chan chu reng shi tou 。]

english: As you do.
translation: 正如你所做的那样。 [zheng ru ni suo zuo de na yang 。]

english: Yep. You know nothing tastes better than toasted toad?
translation: 是的。你知道没有什么比烤蟾蜍更好吃了吗？ [shi de 。 ni zhi dao mei you shen me bi kao chan chu geng hao chi le ma ？]

english: Oh, I'm sure
translation: 哦，我确定 [o ， wo que ding]

english: Anyway, they decided to compete to see who could kill the most toads. This gradually became a daily game, to which they invited friends and family to join in.
translation: 不管怎样，他们决定比赛，看看谁能杀死最多的蟾蜍。这逐渐成为一种日常游戏，他们邀请朋友和家人参加。 [bu guan zen yang ， ta men jue ding bi sai ， kan kan shui neng sha si zui duo de chan chu 。 zhe zhu jian cheng wei yi zhong ri chang you xi ， ta men yao qing peng you he jia ren can jia 。]

english: It all evolved from there. Creating a playing arena, making up teams and leagues.
translation: 一切都是从那里演变而来的。创建比赛场地，组建球队和联赛。 [yi qie dou shi cong na li yan bian er lai de 。 chuang jian bi sai chang di ， zu jian qiu dui he lian sai 。]

english: Interesting.
translation: 有趣的。 [you qu de 。]

english: Anything else?
translation: 还要别的吗？ [hai yao bie de ma ？]

english: What is the ball made from?
translation: 球是由什么制成的？ [qiu shi you shen me zhi cheng de ？]

english: Toads of course
translation: 当然是蟾蜍 [dang ran shi chan chu]

english: Toads?
translation: 蟾蜍？ [chan chu ？]

english: What with the swamp nearby, and their robust skin, there is nothing better to stretch over some common sand.
translation: 由于附近有沼泽，而且它们的皮肤很坚固，没有什么比在普通的沙子上舒展身体更好的了。 [you yu fu jin you zhao ze ， er qie ta men de pi fu hen jian gu ， mei you shen me bi zai pu tong de sha zi shang shu zhan shen ti geng hao de le 。]

english: I'd never have guessed.
translation: 我万万没想到。 [wo wan wan mei xiang dao 。]

english: Well, of course. You humans know nothing!
translation: 嗯，当然。你们人类什么都不知道！ [n ， dang ran 。 ni men ren lei shen me dou bu zhi dao ！]

english: Those nets are strange.
translation: 那些网很奇怪。 [na xie wang hen qi guai 。]

english: Ah, made from the finest thread in all the land.
translation: 啊，是用世界上最好的线制成的。 [a ， shi yong shi jie shang zui hao de xian zhi cheng de 。]

english: And that is?
translation: 那是？ [na shi ？]

english: Gnome hair.
translation: 侏儒的头发。 [zhu ru de tou fa 。]

english: You're kidding, right?
translation: 你在开玩笑吧？ [ni zai kai wan xiao ba ？]

english: I have no time for jokes. It's a serious matter, we go through plenty of nets every day.
translation: 我没时间开玩笑。这是一件严重的事情，我们每天都会穿过很多网。 [wo mei shi jian kai wan xiao 。 zhe shi yi jian yan zhong de shi qing ， wo men mei tian du hui chuan guo hen duo wang 。]

english: So that's why you don't see many Gnomes with long hair?
translation: 所以这就是为什么你看不到很多长头发的侏儒？ [suo yi zhe jiu shi wei shen me ni kan bu dao hen duo zhang tou fa de zhu ru ？]

english: Exactly.
translation: 确切地。 [que qie di 。]

english: The world makes sense at last.
translation: 世界终于变得有意义了。 [shi jie zhong yu bian de you yi yi le 。]

english: Are there any special tactics?
translation: 有什么特殊的战术吗？ [you shen me te shu de zhan shu ma ？]

english: Well of course, like what?
translation: 嗯，当然，比如什么？ [n ， dang ran ， bi ru shen me ？]

english: How about passing?
translation: 过了又怎样？ [guo le you zen yang ？]

english: There's the good old one-two tactic.
translation: 这是古老的一二战术。 [zhe shi gu lao de yi er zhan shu 。]

english: You don't know anything do you? You pass the ball onto a team mate, giving him all the attention of your opposition, and giving you the chance to run further ahead.
translation: 你什么都不知道吗？您将球传给队友，让他吸引对手的所有注意力，并让您有机会跑得更远。 [ni shen me dou bu zhi dao ma ？ nin jiang qiu chuan gei dui you ， rang ta xi yin dui shou de suo you zhu yi li ， bing rang nin you ji hui pao de geng yuan 。]

english: Then what?
translation: 然后呢？ [ran hou ne ？]

english: Well, he passes back to you and you've made an advantage. It's useful in a variety of situations!
translation: 好吧，他回传给你，你就取得了优势。它在各种情况下都很有用！ [hao ba ， ta hui chuan gei ni ， ni jiu qu de le you shi 。 ta zai ge zhong qing kuang xia dou hen you yong ！]

english: I'll remember that one.
translation: 我会记住那一个。 [wo hui ji zhu na yi ge 。]

english: How about teamwork?
translation: 团队合作怎么样？ [tuan dui he zuo zen me yang ？]

english: Well, don't forget that you can block the opposition whilst a team mate has the ball. Very useful if you want to stop or slow down anyone approaching him.
translation: 好吧，不要忘记，当队友控球时，你可以阻挡对手。如果你想阻止或减慢任何接近他的人，这非常有用。 [hao ba ， bu yao wang ji ， dang dui you kong qiu shi ， ni ke yi zu dang dui shou 。 ru guo ni xiang zu zhi huo jian man ren he jie jin ta de ren ， zhe fei chang you yong 。]

english: Block for team mates. Got it.
translation: 为队友格挡。知道了。 [wei dui you ge dang 。 zhi dao le 。]

english: What about my personal physique?
translation: 我个人体质怎么样？ [wo ge ren ti zhi zen me yang ？]

english: You'd look better if you were shorter.
translation: 如果你矮一点的话会更好看。 [ru guo ni ai yi dian de hua hui geng hao kan 。]

english: I meant in regards to scoring more goals!
translation: 我的意思是进球更多！ [wo de yi si shi jin qiu geng duo ！]

english: I see. Your agility is important if you want to avoid being tackled, so that would be a good attribute to improve. Also many Gnomes say that being able to attack well with a ranged weapon makes you better at
translation: 我懂了。如果你想避免被拦截，你的敏捷性就很重要，所以这将是一个值得改进的好属性。许多侏儒也表示，能够使用远程武器进行良好的攻击会让你更擅长 [wo dong le 。 ru guo ni xiang bi mian bei lan jie ， ni de min jie xing jiu hen zhong yao ， suo yi zhe jiang shi yi ge zhi de gai jin de hao shu xing 。 xu duo zhu ru ye biao shi ， neng gou shi yong yuan cheng wu qi jin xing liang hao de gong ji hui rang ni geng shan chang]

english: scoring goals.
translation: 进球。 [jin qiu 。]

english: I suppose I should go away and work on those skills.
translation: 我想我应该离开并努力学习这些技能。 [wo xiang wo ying gai li kai bing nu li xue xi zhe xie ji neng 。]

english: Yes, although playing the game itself will improve these skills too. Also you should remember that your distance from the goal affects your chance of scoring, so get close enough and your ranged ability won't matter as
translation: 是的，尽管玩游戏本身也会提高这些技能。另外你应该记住，你与球门的距离会影响你得分的机会，所以距离球门足够近，你的远程能力就不会那么重要了 [shi de ， jin guan wan you xi ben shen ye hui ti gao zhe xie ji neng 。 ling wai ni ying gai ji zhu ， ni yu qiu men de ju li hui ying xiang ni de fen de ji hui ， suo yi ju li qiu men zu gou jin ， ni de yuan cheng neng li jiu bu hui na me zhong yao le]

english: much.
translation: 很多。 [hen duo 。]

english: Any information would be appreciated!
translation: 任何信息将不胜感激！ [ren he xin xi jiang bu sheng gan ji ！]

english: Hmm, some general facts?
translation: 嗯，一些一般事实？ [n ， yi xie yi ban shi shi ？]

english: Please!
translation: 请！ [qing ！]

english: OK. Have you noticed the different colour clothes for your opposing Gnomes?
translation: 好的。您是否注意到对手侏儒的不同颜色的衣服？ [hao de 。 nin shi fou zhu yi dao dui shou zhu ru de bu tong yan se de yi fu ？]

english: Keep one eye on the other players as they might try to slow you down.
translation: 密切关注其他玩家，因为他们可能会试图减慢你的速度。 [mi qie guan zhu qi ta wan jia ， yin wei ta men ke neng hui shi tu jian man ni de su du 。]

english: I think I want to have a look around first.
translation: 我想我想先四处看看。 [wo xiang wo xiang xian si chu kan kan 。]

english: I'll be waiting!
translation: 我会等待！ [wo hui deng dai ！]

english: Be careful, you've got some awful gingerbread with you... I wouldn't put them in your hopper, maybe another player's?
translation: 小心点，你身上带着一些糟糕的姜饼……我不会把它们放进你的料斗里，也许是其他玩家的？ [xiao xin dian ， ni shen shang dai zhe yi xie zao gao de jiang bing …… wo bu hui ba ta men fang jin ni de liao dou li ， ye xu shi qi ta wan jia de ？]

english: You must now answer the hardest riddle known to gnomekind, in order to proceed to the final!
translation: 你现在必须回答侏儒已知的最难的谜语，才能进入决赛！ [ni xian zai bi xu hui da zhu ru yi zhi de zui nan de mi yu ， cai neng jin ru jue sai ！]

english: I'm ready.
translation: 我准备好了。 [wo zhun bei hao le 。]

english: I am tall when I am young, and I am short when I am old.
translation: 我年轻的时候很高，老的时候我很矮。 [wo nian qing de shi hou hen gao ， lao de shi hou wo hen ai 。]

english: A Gnome?
translation: 侏儒？ [zhu ru ？]

english: Well yes, I am a gnome, but the riddle wasn't about me!
translation: 嗯，是的，我是侏儒，但谜语与我无关！ [n ， shi de ， wo shi zhu ru ， dan mi yu yu wo wu guan ！]

english: Gosh what I wouldn't give to be tall when I was young.
translation: 天哪，我年轻时为了长高不肯付出什么。 [tian na ， wo nian qing shi wei le zhang gao bu ken fu chu shen me 。]

english: Have another go.
translation: 再去一次吧 [zai qu yi ci ba]

english: That's not quite right, have another go.
translation: 不太对劲，再试试吧。 [bu tai dui jin ， zai shi shi ba 。]

english: A Human! Ha, I've got it.
translation: 一个人类！哈，我明白了。 [yi ge ren lei ！ ha ， wo ming bai le 。]

english: Sadly not correct [player name].
translation: 遗憾的是[玩家姓名]不正确。 [yi han de shi [ wan jia xing ming ] bu zheng que 。]

english: You seem very old, you've been round here a while. You're not shorter than me though.
translation: 你看起来很老了，你来这里已经有一段时间了。不过你并不比我矮。 [ni kan qi lai hen lao le ， ni lai zhe li yi jing you yi duan shi jian le 。 bu guo ni bing bu bi wo ai 。]

english: Well, that's not hard.
translation: 嗯，这并不难。 [n ， zhe bing bu nan 。]

english: Don't be cheeky [player name]! Now quickly solve this riddle.
translation: 别厚脸皮[玩家名字]！现在赶紧解开这个谜题。 [bie hou lian pi [ wan jia ming zi ]！ xian zai gan jin jie kai zhe ge mi ti 。]

english: A candle?
translation: 一支蜡烛？ [yi zhi la zhu ？]

english: That's correct!
translation: 没错！ [mei cuo ！]

english: Good luck in the final [player name]. You're going to need it.
translation: 祝你在决赛中好运[选手姓名]。你会需要它。 [zhu ni zai jue sai zhong hao yun [ xuan shou xing ming ]。 ni hui xu yao ta 。]

english: How's it going [player name]?
translation: [玩家姓名] 进展如何？ [[ wan jia xing ming ]  jin zhan ru he ？]

english: I'm pine thanks, I still have crumbs in places I didn't know I had.
translation: 我很松，谢谢，我在不知道的地方仍然有面包屑。 [wo hen song ， xie xie ， wo zai bu zhi dao de di fang reng ran you mian bao xie 。]

english: Icy what you did there.
translation: 冰冷的你在那里做了什么。 [bing leng de ni zai na li zuo le shen me 。]

english: Do you enjoy it here?
translation: 你喜欢这里吗？ [ni xi huan zhe li ma ？]

english: Absolutely, I've had some of the best times in my life doing all this quality control.
translation: 当然，我在进行所有这些质量控制时度过了一生中最美好的时光。 [dang ran ， wo zai jin xing suo you zhe xie zhi liang kong zhi shi du guo le yi sheng zhong zui mei hao de shi guang 。]

english: I wouldn't be the gnome I am today without it.
translation: 没有它，我就不会成为今天的侏儒。 [mei you ta ， wo jiu bu hui cheng wei jin tian de zhu ru 。]

english: That sounds lovely.
translation: 听起来很可爱。 [ting qi lai hen ke ai 。]

english: So what's your story?
translation: 那么你的故事是什么？ [na me ni de gu shi shi shen me ？]

english: Good question, where do I begin...
translation: 好问题，我从哪里开始...... [hao wen ti ， wo cong na li kai shi ......]

english: I used to be a Head Chef at the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
translation: 我曾经是树侏儒要塞的主厨。 [wo ceng jing shi shu zhu ru yao sai de zhu chu 。]

english: Oh yeah?
translation: 哦，是吗？ [o ， shi ma ？]

english: I was the best of the best.
translation: 我是最好的。 [wo shi zui hao de 。]

english: WHERE'S THE FROG SAUCE! I used to shout.
translation: 青蛙酱在哪里！我曾经大喊过。 [qing wa jiang zai na li ！ wo ceng jing da han guo 。]

english: Great times.
translation: 美好的时光。 [mei hao de shi guang 。]

english: Then you ended up in Santa's Nutcracker Pub?
translation: 然后你去了圣诞老人的胡桃夹子酒吧？ [ran hou ni qu le sheng dan lao ren de hu tao jia zi jiu ba ？]

english: You know it. Apparently Santa was getting complaints about the quality of his gingerbread gnomes.
translation: 你知道的。显然，圣诞老人收到了关于他的姜饼侏儒质量的投诉。 [ni zhi dao de 。 xian ran ， sheng dan lao ren shou dao le guan yu ta de jiang bing zhu ru zhi liang de tou su 。]

english: So he asked me to step in. Free ticket onto his Nice List too.
translation: 所以他让我介入。免费门票也进入了他的好清单。 [suo yi ta rang wo jie ru 。 mian fei men piao ye jin ru le ta de hao qing dan 。]

english: I mean just look at this place. It's amazing!
translation: 我的意思是看看这个地方。太棒了！ [wo de yi si shi kan kan zhe ge di fang 。 tai bang le ！]

english: It is indeed.
translation: 确实如此。 [que shi ru ci 。]

english: Happy Holidays!
translation: 节日快乐！ [jie ri kuai le ！]

english: You too [player name].
translation: 你也是[玩家姓名]。 [ni ye shi [ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Gnome.
translation: 侏儒。 [zhu ru 。]

english: Flower.
translation: 花。 [hua 。]

english: Human.
translation: 人类。 [ren lei 。]

english: Candle.
translation: 蜡烛。 [la zhu 。]

english: Do you enjoy being a festive game host?
translation: 您喜欢担任节日游戏主持人吗？ [nin xi huan dan ren jie ri you xi zhu chi ren ma ？]

english: What's your story?
translation: 你的故事是什么？ [ni de gu shi shi shen me ？]

english: Happy Holidays!
translation: 节日快乐！ [jie ri kuai le ！]

english: Hello how are you?
translation: 你好吗？ [ni hao ma ？]

english: I'm amazed by how much humans chat. The sign over there says training area, not pointless conversation area.
translation: 我对人类聊天的数量感到惊讶。那边的标牌上写着训练区，而不是无意义的谈话区。 [wo dui ren lei liao tian de shu liang gan dao jing ya 。 na bian de biao pai shang xie zhe xun lian qu ， er bu shi wu yi yi de tan hua qu 。]

english: Hello, what is this place?
translation: 你好，请问这是什么地方？ [ni hao ， qing wen zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This, my friend, is where we train. Here we improve our agility. It's an essential skill.
translation: 我的朋友，这就是我们训练的地方。在这里我们提高了我们的敏捷性。这是一项必备技能。 [wo de peng you ， zhe jiu shi wo men xun lian de di fang 。 zai zhe li wo men ti gao le wo men de min jie xing 。 zhe shi yi xiang bi bei ji neng 。]

english: It looks easy enough.
translation: 看起来很容易。 [kan qi lai hen rong yi 。]

english: If you complete the course in order from the slippery log to the end, your agility will increase much faster than by repeating just one obstacle.
translation: 如果您按照从滑木到终点的顺序完成路线，您的敏捷性将比仅重复一个障碍更快地提高。 [ru guo nin an zhao cong hua mu dao zhong dian de shun xu wan cheng lu xian ， nin de min jie xing jiang bi jin chong fu yi ge zhang ai geng kuai di ti gao 。]

english: This is fun!
translation: 这很有趣！ [zhe hen you qu ！]

english: This is training soldier. If you want fun go make some cocktails.
translation: 这是训练士兵。如果你想玩得开心就去调制一些鸡尾酒。 [zhe shi xun lian shi bing 。 ru guo ni xiang wan de kai xin jiu qu tiao zhi yi xie ji wei jiu 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: This isn't a grannies' tea party, let's see some sweat human. Go! Go! Go!
translation: 这不是老奶奶的茶话会，让我们来看看一些流汗的人吧。去！去！去！ [zhe bu shi lao nai nai de cha hua hui ， rang wo men lai kan kan yi xie liu han de ren ba 。 qu ！ qu ！ qu ！]

english: Okay get over that log, quick quick!
translation: 好吧，克服那个日志，快点快点！ [hao ba ， ke fu na ge ri zhi ， kuai dian kuai dian ！]

english: Move it, move it, move it!
translation: 动起来，动起来，动起来！ [dong qi lai ， dong qi lai ， dong qi lai ！]

english: That's it - straight up
translation: 就是这样 - 直接 [jiu shi zhe yang  -  zhi jie]

english: Come on scaredy cat, get across that rope!
translation: 来吧，吓人的猫，跨过那根绳子！ [lai ba ， xia ren de mao ， kua guo na gen sheng zi ！]

english: My Granny can move faster than you.
translation: 我奶奶的动作比你快。 [wo nai nai de dong zuo bi ni kuai 。]

english: You're not done yet! Do this for me!
translation: 你还没有完成！为我做这个！ [ni hai mei you wan cheng ！ wei wo zuo zhe ge ！]

english: My baby sister can do puzzles better than that!
translation: 我的小妹妹拼图比那更好！ [wo de xiao mei mei pin tu bi na geng hao ！]

english: Excellent work!
translation: 佳作！ [jia zuo ！]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Draw your sword warrior, and fight along side us.
translation: 画出你的剑战士，与我们并肩作战。 [hua chu ni de jian zhan shi ， yu wo men bing jian zuo zhan 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Death to Khazard, and all who serve him.
translation: 卡扎德和所有为他服务的人都该死。 [ka zha de he suo you wei ta fu wu de ren dou gai si 。]

english: I can't talk now, can't you see we're trying to win a battle here.
translation: 我现在不能说话，你没看到我们正在努力赢得这里的一场战斗吗？ [wo xian zai bu neng shuo hua ， ni mei kan dao wo men zheng zai nu li ying de zhe li de yi chang zhan dou ma ？]

english: You won't take us without a fight!
translation: 你不会不战而屈人之兵！ [ni bu hui bu zhan er qu ren zhi bing ！]

english: Get out of our lands!
translation: 滚出我们的土地！ [gun chu wo men de tu di ！]

english: Tally ho!
translation: 塔利嗬！ [ta li he ！]

english: Hello, how's the work going?
translation: 你好，工作怎么样？ [ni hao ， gong zuo zen me yang ？]

english: Getting there now, thanks to your help!
translation: 现在就到了，感谢您的帮助！ [xian zai jiu dao le ， gan xie nin de bang zhu ！]

english: Can I take a flight in the glider?
translation: 我可以乘坐滑翔机飞行吗？ [wo ke yi cheng zuo hua xiang ji fei xing ma ？]

english: Sure, go ahead.
translation: 当然，继续吧。 [dang ran ， ji xu ba 。]

english: Have a nice day.
translation: 祝你今天过得愉快。 [zhu ni jin tian guo de yu kuai 。]

english: You too, human.
translation: 你也是，人类。 [ni ye shi ， ren lei 。]

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 尽管您找到了顾客，但您似乎没有带来正确的食物！你需要[一个/一些][订购的侏儒食物/饮料]！ [jin guan nin zhao dao le gu ke ， dan nin si hu mei you dai lai zheng que de shi wu ！ ni xu yao [ yi ge / yi xie ][ ding gou de zhu ru shi wu / yin liao ]！]

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜肴不行。对于 Aluft Aloft 的顾客来说，只有手工制作的 Gnome Cuisine 才足够好。 [kong pa yu zhi cai yao bu xing 。 dui yu  Aluft Aloft  de gu ke lai shuo ， zhi you shou gong zhi zuo de  Gnome Cuisine  cai zu gou hao 。]

english: You hand over your delivery of [item] to Gnormadium Avlafrim
translation: 您将[物品]交给Gnormadium Avlafrim [nin jiang [ wu pin ] jiao gei Gnormadium Avlafrim]

english: Oh my! I've had nothing to eat or drink but chompy birds and smelly water for days. Thank you.
translation: 天啊！我已经好几天没吃没喝了，除了嚼碎的鸟和发臭的水。谢谢。 [tian a ！ wo yi jing hao ji tian mei chi mei he le ， chu le jue sui de niao he fa chou de shui 。 xie xie 。]

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 你一定是走了很远的路才把这个交给我的。这里有一些额外的东西作为提示。 [ni yi ding shi zou le hen yuan de lu cai ba zhe ge jiao gei wo de 。 zhe li you yi xie e wai de dong xi zuo wei ti shi 。]

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 您有 [number] 个积分用于免费送货令牌。您还没有资格获得侏儒食物。 [nin you  [number]  ge ji fen yong yu mian fei song huo ling pai 。 nin hai mei you zi ge huo de zhu ru shi wu 。]

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 您有 [number] 个积分用于免费送货令牌。您可能会收到 [number] 块侏儒食物。 [nin you  [number]  ge ji fen yong yu mian fei song huo ling pai 。 nin ke neng hui shou dao  [number]  kuai zhu ru shi wu 。]

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 不要忘记从 Aluft Gianne jnr 领取免费送货代币。 [bu yao wang ji cong  Aluft Gianne jnr  ling qu mian fei song huo dai bi 。]

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 你的交货太晚了！返回 Aluft jnr。以获得另一个订单。您丢弃了送货箱，因为您不再需要它了。 [ni de jiao huo tai wan le ！ fan hui  Aluft jnr。 yi huo de ling yi ge ding dan 。 nin diu qi le song huo xiang ， yin wei nin bu zai xu yao ta le 。]

english: Hello, how's the work going?
translation: 你好，工作怎么样？ [ni hao ， gong zuo zen me yang ？]

english: Can I take a flight in the glider?
translation: 我可以乘坐滑翔机飞行吗？ [wo ke yi cheng zuo hua xiang ji fei xing ma ？]

english: Have a nice day.
translation: 祝你今天过得愉快。 [zhu ni jin tian guo de yu kuai 。]

english: Hello. What do you do here?
translation: 你好。你在这里做什么？ [ni hao 。 ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: My name is Gnosi. I am here to assist the Varrock Museum in their research.
translation: 我的名字是诺西。我来这里是为了协助瓦罗克博物馆的研究。 [wo de ming zi shi nuo xi 。 wo lai zhe li shi wei le xie zhu wa luo ke bo wu guan de yan jiu 。]

english: I didn't know the Varrock Museum was familiar with this continent. What research are you conducting?
translation: 我不知道瓦罗克博物馆对这片大陆很熟悉。您正在进行什么研究？ [wo bu zhi dao wa luo ke bo wu guan dui zhe pian da lu hen shu xi 。 nin zheng zai jin xing shen me yan jiu ？]

english: We're studying the history of the region, origins of the lizardmen and how it all connects to Xeric.
translation: 我们正在研究该地区的历史、蜥蜴人的起源以及这一切与埃里克的联系。 [wo men zheng zai yan jiu gai di qu de li shi 、 xi yi ren de qi yuan yi ji zhe yi qie yu ai li ke de lian xi 。]

english: We've wanted to study this place for a while, but haven't been able to explore due to lizardmen blocking the way.
translation: 我们一直想研究这个地方，但由于蜥蜴人挡住了路而未能探索。 [wo men yi zhi xiang yan jiu zhe ge di fang ， dan you yu xi yi ren dang zhu le lu er wei neng tan suo 。]

english: But now that the Shayzien Army have cleared the path and discovered the Chambers of Xeric in the process, there is much to explore!
translation: 但现在 Shayzien 军队已经扫清了道路，并在此过程中发现了 Xeric 密室，还有很多值得探索的地方！ [dan xian zai  Shayzien  jun dui yi jing sao qing le dao lu ， bing zai ci guo cheng zhong fa xian le  Xeric  mi shi ， hai you hen duo zhi de tan suo de di fang ！]

english: Who is Xeric?
translation: 谢里克是谁？ [xie li ke shi shui ？]

english: Xeric was an incredibly powerful dark mage. He ruled Great Kourend for ten decades.
translation: 埃里克是一位非常强大的黑暗法师。他统治大库伦德十年。 [ai li ke shi yi wei fei chang qiang da de hei an fa shi 。 ta tong zhi da ku lun de shi nian 。]

english: If you'd like to find out more you should visit the Historical Archive at the Grand Library.
translation: 如果您想了解更多信息，可以参观大图书馆的历史档案馆。 [ru guo nin xiang liao jie geng duo xin xi ， ke yi can guan da tu shu guan de li shi dang an guan 。]

english: What are the Chambers of Xeric?
translation: Xeric 的房间是什么？ [Xeric  de fang jian shi shen me ？]

english: At the summit of this mountain we've found an ancient temple and a vast network of caves that we believe were formed by Xeric and his followers.
translation: 在这座山的山顶，我们发现了一座古老的寺庙和一个巨大的洞穴网络，我们相信它们是由 Xeric 和他的追随者形成的。 [zai zhe zuo shan de shan ding ， wo men fa xian le yi zuo gu lao de si miao he yi ge ju da de dong xue wang luo ， wo men xiang xin ta men shi you  Xeric  he ta de zhui sui zhe xing cheng de 。]

english: The discovery of the Chambers tells us Xeric invested significant time and resources here, yet it was never documented.
translation: 密室的发现告诉我们，Xeric 在这里投入了大量的时间和资源，但从未被记录下来。 [mi shi de fa xian gao su wo men ，Xeric  zai zhe li tou ru le da liang de shi jian he zi yuan ， dan cong wei bei ji lu xia lai 。]

english: While much of Kourend's history under Xeric remains unknown, it is very surprising to discover such a huge area that was previously undiscovered to us.
translation: 虽然库伦德在谢里克统治下的大部分历史仍然未知，但发现我们以前从未发现过的如此巨大的区域是非常令人惊讶的。 [sui ran ku lun de zai xie li ke tong zhi xia de da bu fen li shi reng ran wei zhi ， dan fa xian wo men yi qian cong wei fa xian guo de ru ci ju da de qu yu shi fei chang ling ren jing ya de 。]

english: Can I explore the Chambers?
translation: 我可以探索密室吗？ [wo ke yi tan suo mi shi ma ？]

english: Of course, though be careful. The dangers of the Chambers of Xeric are as yet unknown. You should take a strong group of companions with you.
translation: 当然，不过要小心。埃里克密室的危险目前尚不清楚。你应该带上一群强大的同伴。 [dang ran ， bu guo yao xiao xin 。 ai li ke mi shi de wei xian mu qian shang bu qing chu 。 ni ying gai dai shang yi qun qiang da de tong ban 。]

english: What do you think Xeric used this area for?
translation: 你认为 Xeric 使用这个区域做什么？ [ni ren wei  Xeric  shi yong zhe ge qu yu zuo shen me ？]

english: When he ruled Kourend, we know Xeric performed experiments on the living, using power drawn from the Dark Altar. After he was overthrown, he would have needed a new source of power.
translation: 当他统治库伦德时，我们知道泽里克利用从黑暗祭坛汲取的力量对活人进行了实验。当他被推翻后，他需要新的权力来源。 [dang ta tong zhi ku lun de shi ， wo men zhi dao ze li ke li yong cong hei an ji tan ji qu de li liang dui huo ren jin xing le shi yan 。 dang ta bei tui fan hou ， ta xu yao xin de quan li lai yuan 。]

english: We believe he came here to seek it. Xeric would also have required a source of many creatures for these experiments, and the Chambers certainly contain many of those!
translation: 我们相信他来这里是为了寻求它。 Xeric 还需要许多生物来源来进行这些实验，而密室中肯定包含许多这样的生物！ [wo men xiang xin ta lai zhe li shi wei le xun qiu ta 。 Xeric  hai xu yao xu duo sheng wu lai yuan lai jin xing zhe xie shi yan ， er mi shi zhong ken ding bao han xu duo zhe yang de sheng wu ！]

english: He must have also had some form of teleportation in order to reach the temple unnoticed.
translation: 他一定还进行了某种形式的传送，以便在不被注意的情况下到达寺庙。 [ta yi ding hai jin xing le mou zhong xing shi de chuan song ， yi bian zai bu bei zhu yi de qing kuang xia dao da si miao 。]

english: With time and careful study we will uncover these secrets and be able to answer these questions.
translation: 经过时间和仔细的研究，我们将揭开这些秘密并能够回答这些问题。 [jing guo shi jian he zi xi de yan jiu ， wo men jiang jie kai zhe xie mi mi bing neng gou hui da zhe xie wen ti 。]

english: We believe this altar is that source. It seems to act as an amplifier for the Dark Altar.
translation: 我们相信这座祭坛就是那个源头。它似乎充当了黑暗祭坛的放大器。 [wo men xiang xin zhe zuo ji tan jiu shi na ge yuan tou 。 ta si hu chong dang le hei an ji tan de fang da qi 。]

english: As for what he used the Chambers for, that we still don't know. There's a lot of creatures in the Chambers. Maybe he used them in his experiments.
translation: 至于他用钱伯斯做什么，我们仍然不知道。 There's a lot of creatures in the Chambers. Maybe he used them in his experiments. [zhi yu ta yong qian bo si zuo shen me ， wo men reng ran bu zhi dao 。 There's a lot of creatures in the Chambers. Maybe he used them in his experiments.]

translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

translation: 你好。怎么样了？ [ni hao 。 zen me yang le ？]

english: The discovery of this cave could change everything. We might finally be able to discover the link between the lizardmen, the Chambers of Xeric and Xeric himself.
translation: 这个洞穴的发现可能会改变一切。我们也许最终能够发现蜥蜴人、艾瑞克密室和艾瑞克本人之间的联系。 [zhe ge dong xue de fa xian ke neng hui gai bian yi qie 。 wo men ye xu zui zhong neng gou fa xian xi yi ren 、 ai rui ke mi shi he ai rui ke ben ren zhi jian de lian xi 。]

translation: 谢里克是谁？ [xie li ke shi shui ？]

translation: Xeric 的房间是什么？ [Xeric  de fang jian shi shen me ？]

english: Can I explore the Chambers?
translation: 我可以探索密室吗？ [wo ke yi tan suo mi shi ma ？]

english: What do you think Xeric used this area for?
translation: 你认为 Xeric 使用这个区域做什么？ [ni ren wei  Xeric  shi yong zhe ge qu yu zuo shen me ？]

english: Goodbye
translation: 再见 [zai jian]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Hey, human.
translation: 嘿，人类。 [hei ， ren lei 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: My name is Goat Poo. But human not allowed to make big deal of it, 'cos it mean to tease people 'bout silly name.
translation: 我的名字是山羊便便。但人类不可以小题大做，因为这意味着用愚蠢的名字来取笑人们。 [wo de ming zi shi shan yang bian bian 。 dan ren lei bu ke yi xiao ti da zuo ， yin wei zhe yi wei zhe yong yu chun de ming zi lai qu xiao ren men 。]

english: Why are you called Goat Poo?
translation: 为什么叫你“山羊便便”？ [wei shen me jiao ni “ shan yang bian bian ”？]

english: Look, trolls are named after first thing they try to eat, when they little kids. That is troll tradition.
translation: 看，巨魔是根据他们小时候尝试吃的第一个东西来命名的。这是巨魔的传统。 [kan ， ju mo shi gen ju ta men xiao shi hou chang shi chi de di yi ge dong xi lai ming ming de 。 zhe shi ju mo de chuan tong 。]

english: So the first thing you ate was goat poo?
translation: 那么你吃的第一件事就是山羊粪便？ [na me ni chi de di yi jian shi jiu shi shan yang fen bian ？]

english: It my parents' fault - they should have been paying proper attention an' stopped me. But no, they just named me after it.
translation: 这是我父母的错——他们应该给予适当的关注并阻止我。但不，他们只是以此命名我。 [zhe shi wo fu mu de cuo —— ta men ying gai ji yu shi dang de guan zhu bing zu zhi wo 。 dan bu ， ta men zhi shi yi ci ming ming wo 。]

english: Still, it coulda been worse. Could have been called Yellow Snow. He got a really dumb name.
translation: 尽管如此，情况还可能更糟。本来可以叫黄雪。他有一个非常愚蠢的名字。 [jin guan ru ci ， qing kuang hai ke neng geng zao 。 ben lai ke yi jiao huang xue 。 ta you yi ge fei chang yu chun de ming zi 。]

english: Okay, I won't ask why you're called Goat Poo.
translation: 好吧，我不会问你为什么叫山羊便便。 [hao ba ， wo bu hui wen ni wei shen me jiao shan yang bian bian 。]

english: Most people do eventually. Over an' over again.
translation: 大多数人最终都会这样做。一遍又一遍。 [da duo shu ren zui zhong du hui zhe yang zuo 。 yi bian you yi bian 。]

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 告诉我这个地方。 [gao su wo zhe ge di fang 。]

english: This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: 这是韦斯。几年前，在我们被从更南边的洞穴里赶出来之后，巨魔们建造了它。现在Weiss是我们的家。 [zhe shi wei si 。 ji nian qian ， zai wo men bei cong geng nan bian de dong xue li gan chu lai zhi hou ， ju mo men jian zao le ta 。 xian zai Weiss shi wo men de jia 。]

english: We done pretty good here. Got lots of goat and wolf to eat - they taste kinda boring after all this time, but there not much other choice.
translation: 我们在这里做得很好。有很多山羊和狼可以吃——这么长时间以来它们尝起来有点无聊，但没有太多其他选择。 [wo men zai zhe li zuo de hen hao 。 you hen duo shan yang he lang ke yi chi —— zhe me zhang shi jian yi lai ta men chang qi lai you dian wu liao ， dan mei you tai duo qi ta xuan ze 。]

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it. In fact My Arm is an expert on growing the stuff.
translation: 尝试过古古草吗？我知道喜欢它的巨魔。事实上，我的手臂是种植这些东西的专家。 [chang shi guo gu gu cao ma ？ wo zhi dao xi huan ta de ju mo 。 shi shi shang ， wo de shou bi shi zhong zhi zhe xie dong xi de zhuan jia 。]

english: Never heard of no gouty weed, no. But it sound like a vegetable, an' Mother not like eating those, so we probably not gonna try it.
translation: 从来没有听说过没有痛风草，没有。但它听起来像一种蔬菜，妈妈不喜欢吃那些，所以我们可能不会尝试。 [cong lai mei you ting shuo guo mei you tong feng cao ， mei you 。 dan ta ting qi lai xiang yi zhong shu cai ， ma ma bu xi huan chi na xie ， suo yi wo men ke neng bu hui chang shi 。]

english: Mother not like new ideas much, but he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: 妈妈不太喜欢新想法，但他真的很大，而且是老板，所以我们就照他说的做。 [ma ma bu tai xi huan xin xiang fa ， dan ta zhen de hen da ， er qie shi lao ban ， suo yi wo men jiu zhao ta shuo de zuo 。]

english: I see.
translation: 我懂了。 [wo dong le 。]

english: Do you like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这里吗？ [ni xi huan zhe li ma ？]

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it our home. Odd Mushroom say he can make it nicer with fancy fires what he invented, but Mother not interested in that, so Odd Mushroom not allowed to do it.
translation: 呃，虽然有点简陋，但那是我们的家。奇蘑菇说他可以用他发明的奇特的火把它做得更好，但妈妈对此不感兴趣，所以奇蘑菇不被允许这样做。 [e ， sui ran you dian jian lou ， dan na shi wo men de jia 。 qi mo gu shuo ta ke yi yong ta fa ming de qi te de huo ba ta zuo de geng hao ， dan ma ma dui ci bu gan xing qu ， suo yi qi mo gu bu bei yun xu zhe yang zuo 。]

english: Mother only care about stuff to help him fight better. An he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: 母亲只关心帮助他更好地战斗的东西。他真的很大，他是老板，所以我们就按他说的做。 [mu qin zhi guan xin bang zhu ta geng hao di zhan dou de dong xi 。 ta zhen de hen da ， ta shi lao ban ， suo yi wo men jiu an ta shuo de zuo 。]

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我就走了。 [wo jiu zou le 。]

english: Hey, friend of Snowflake!
translation: 嘿，雪花的朋友！ [hei ， xue hua de peng you ！]

english: It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: 这里太棒了，现在雪花和她丈夫巨魔教我们种植古风草。现在食物好多了。 [zhe li tai bang le ， xian zai xue hua he ta zhang fu ju mo jiao wo men zhong zhi gu feng cao 。 xian zai shi wu hao duo le 。]

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: 嗯，虽然有点粗糙，但是正在好起来。雪花，她教我们种植古风草。山羊、狼、人类的味道都因加入了古藤而变得更加美味。 [n ， sui ran you dian cu cao ， dan shi zheng zai hao qi lai 。 xue hua ， ta jiao wo men zhong zhi gu feng cao 。 shan yang 、 lang 、 ren lei de wei dao dou yin jia ru le gu teng er bian de geng jia mei wei 。]

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: 所以，是的，韦斯是一个很好的居住地，现在由雪花负责。所有的巨魔都像雪花一样。她的丈夫巨魔有点奇怪，但这不是我们的问题。 [suo yi ， shi de ， wei si shi yi ge hen hao de ju zhu di ， xian zai you xue hua fu ze 。 suo you de ju mo dou xiang xue hua yi yang 。 ta de zhang fu ju mo you dian qi guai ， dan zhe bu shi wo men de wen ti 。]

english: You t'ink I want that? It not even from goat!
translation: 你认为我想要那个吗？它甚至不是来自山羊！ [ni ren wei wo xiang yao na ge ma ？ ta shen zhi bu shi lai zi shan yang ！]

english: Look, human, it were one time. Just once. Let a troll move on, okay?
translation: 听着，人类，那是曾经的事了。就一次。让巨魔继续前进，好吗？ [ting zhe ， ren lei ， na shi ceng jing de shi le 。 jiu yi ci 。 rang ju mo ji xu qian jin ， hao ma ？]

english: Look, human, this not funny. You need goat poo in bucket, go find goat pen!
translation: 听着，人类，这不好笑。你需要桶里有山羊粪便，去找山羊圈吧！ [ting zhe ， ren lei ， zhe bu hao xiao 。 ni xu yao tong li you shan yang fen bian ， qu zhao shan yang quan ba ！]
