translation: 我不确定是否允许。你必须向将军询问。 [wo bu que ding shi fou yun xu 。 ni bi xu xiang jiang jun xun wen 。]

english: Happy goblin new century!
translation: 妖精新世纪快乐！ [yao jing xin shi ji kuai le ！]

english: Happy new century!
translation: 新世纪快乐！ [xin shi ji kuai le ！]

english: What is the goblin new century?
translation: 妖精新世纪是什么？ [yao jing xin shi ji shi shen me ？]

english: Goblin century mark year of big battle on Plain of Mud. That when Big High War God give us commandments.
translation: 地精世纪标志着泥土平原大战的一年。当伟大的战争上帝给我们诫命时。 [di jing shi ji biao zhi zhe ni tu ping yuan da zhan de yi nian 。 dang wei da de zhan zheng shang di gei wo men jie ming shi 。]

english: Who is the Big High War God?
translation: 大高战神是谁？ [da gao zhan shen shi shui ？]

english: Big High War God take goblins and make them strong! Without him, we small and weak and stupid. But thanks to Big High War God, we most powerful race in Gielinor!
translation: 大高战神收服哥布林，让他们变得更强！没有他，我们就渺小、软弱、愚蠢。但感谢大高战神，我们吉林诺最强大的种族！ [da gao zhan shen shou fu ge bu lin ， rang ta men bian de geng qiang ！ mei you ta ， wo men jiu miao xiao 、 ruan ruo 、 yu chun 。 dan gan xie da gao zhan shen ， wo men ji lin nuo zui qiang da de zhong zu ！]

english: Umm... you're clearly not the most powerful race in Gielinor.
translation: 嗯……你显然不是吉林诺最强大的种族。 [n …… ni xian ran bu shi ji lin nuo zui qiang da de zhong zu 。]

english: Not to doubt word of Big High War God! I kill you!
translation: 不要怀疑大高战神的话！我杀了你！ [bu yao huai yi da gao zhan shen de hua ！ wo sha le ni ！]

english: What are the goblin commandments?
translation: 妖精戒律是什么？ [yao jing jie lv shi shen me ？]

english: Slay enemies of Big High War God! Not show mercy! Not run from battle! Not doubt word of Big High War God!
translation: 消灭大高战神的敌人！不手软！不逃避战斗！不用怀疑大高战神的话！ [xiao mie da gao zhan shen de di ren ！ bu shou ruan ！ bu tao bi zhan dou ！ bu yong huai yi da gao zhan shen de hua ！]

english: Without commandments we not know right from wrong. We be like other races who not know war is good!
translation: 没有诫命，我们就无法辨别是非。我们就像其他种族一样，不知道战争是好的！ [mei you jie ming ， wo men jiu wu fa bian bie shi fei 。 wo men jiu xiang qi ta zhong zu yi yang ， bu zhi dao zhan zheng shi hao de ！]

english: Where is the Plain of Mud?
translation: 泥泞平原在哪里？ [ni ning ping yuan zai na li ？]

english: That goblin secret! No human ever find Plain of Mud!
translation: That goblin secret!没有人类找到过泥泞平原！ [That goblin secret! mei you ren lei zhao dao guo ni ning ping yuan ！]

english: I need to go.
translation: 我需要去。 [wo xu yao qu 。]

english: Brown armour best!
translation: 棕色铠甲最好！ [zong se kai jia zui hao ！]

english: Why is brown best?
translation: 为什么棕色最好？ [wei shen me zong se zui hao ？]

english: General Wartface and General Bentnoze both say it is. And normally they never agree!
translation: 沃特法斯将军和本特诺兹将军都这么说。通常他们从不同意！ [wo te fa si jiang jun he ben te nuo zi jiang jun dou zhe me shuo 。 tong chang ta men cong bu tong yi ！]

english: But you're still wearing green armour!
translation: 但你还穿着绿色的盔甲！ [dan ni hai chuan zhe lv se de kui jia ！]

english: Um... my brown armour getting wash.
translation: 嗯……我的棕色盔甲正在清洗。 [n …… wo de zong se kui jia zheng zai qing xi 。]

english: But you're still wearing red armour!
translation: 但你还穿着红色的铠甲！ [dan ni hai chuan zhe hong se de kai jia ！]

english: It not red, it just red-ish brown!
translation: 不是红色，只是红棕色！ [bu shi hong se ， zhi shi hong zong se ！]

translation: 呃，好吧。 [e ， hao ba 。]

translation: 但你还是穿红衣服！ [dan ni hai shi chuan hong yi fu ！]

translation: 呃，好吧。 [e ， hao ba 。]

translation: 我应该走哪条路？ [wo ying gai zou na tiao lu ？]

english: These dungeons are such a maze.
translation: 这些地牢就像一个迷宫。 [zhe xie di lao jiu xiang yi ge mi gong 。]

translation: 我已经在这里闲逛了好几个小时了。 [wo yi jing zai zhe li xian guang le hao ji ge xiao shi le 。]

english: How can I get back to the village?
translation: 我怎样才能回村子？ [wo zen yang cai neng hui cun zi ？]

translation: 我讨厌如此迷失！ [wo tao yan ru ci mi shi ！]

english: Where am I? I'm so lost.

english: Where's the exit?!?

english: This is the fifth time this week! I'm lost!
translation: 这已经是本周第五次了！我迷路了！ [zhe yi jing shi ben zhou di wu ci le ！ wo mi lu le ！]

english: How could I be so disoriented?
translation: 我怎么会如此迷失方向？ [wo zen me hui ru ci mi shi fang xiang ？]

english: Hmm? Oh, hello, surface-dweller!
translation: 唔？哦，你好，地表居民！ [wu ？ o ， ni hao ， di biao ju min ！]

english: What are you doing?
translation: 你在干什么？ [ni zai gan shen me ？]

english: I'm writing the definitive history of Dorgesh-Kaan!
translation: 我正在写多尔格什-卡恩的权威历史！ [wo zheng zai xie duo er ge shen - ka en de quan wei li shi ！]

english: Actually, I wonder if you could help me...

english: An ogre, hmm? Thank you.
translation: 食人魔，嗯？谢谢。 [shi ren mo ， n ？ xie xie 。]

english: Ah, that's what I thought!
translation: 啊，我就是这么想的！ [a ， wo jiu shi zhe me xiang de ！]

english: And I thought you were an elf! What a silly mistake!
translation: 我以为你是个精灵！多么愚蠢的错误啊！ [wo yi wei ni shi ge jing ling ！ duo me yu chun de cuo wu a ！]

english: A dwarf, hmm? Thank you.
translation: 一个侏儒，嗯？谢谢。 [yi ge zhu ru ， n ？ xie xie 。]

translation: 啊，是的，当然，你说。 [a ， shi de ， dang ran ， ni shuo 。]

english: What is this building?
translation: 这栋建筑是什么？ [zhe dong jian zhu shi shen me ？]

english: This is the Dorgeshuun Council chamber!
translation: 这里是多格舒恩议事厅！ [zhe li shi duo ge shu en yi shi ting ！]

english: Whenever a decision needs to be made, the seven members of the Dorgeshuun Council meet here. The last meeting was when they decided to open up the city to surface-dwellers.
translation: 每当需要做出决定时，多格舒恩议会的七名成员都会在这里开会。最后一次会议是在他们决定向地表居民开放这座城市时。 [mei dang xu yao zuo chu jue ding shi ， duo ge shu en yi hui de qi ming cheng yuan du hui zai zhe li kai hui 。 zui hou yi ci hui yi shi zai ta men jue ding xiang di biao ju min kai fang zhe zuo cheng shi shi 。]

english: In between meetings, I work here writing up the minutes of the meetings and working on the definitive history of Dorgesh-Kaan.
translation: 在会议间隙，我在这里工作，撰写会议纪要并研究多尔格什-卡恩的权威历史。 [zai hui yi jian xi ， wo zai zhe li gong zuo ， zhuan xie hui yi ji yao bing yan jiu duo er ge shen - ka en de quan wei li shi 。]

english: Can you tell me about the history of the city?
translation: 你能告诉我这座城市的历史吗？ [ni neng gao su wo zhe zuo cheng shi de li shi ma ？]

english: Of course! I've gone through all of my predecessors' notes and compiled the definitive history of the Dorgeshuun! What would you like to hear about?
translation: 当然！我已经翻阅了所有前辈的笔记并整理了 Dorgeshuun 的权威历史！您想听什么？ [dang ran ！ wo yi jing fan yue le suo you qian bei de bi ji bing zheng li le  Dorgeshuun  de quan wei li shi ！ nin xiang ting shen me ？]

english: Can you tell me about the founding of Dorgesh-Kaan?
translation: 您能告诉我有关多尔格什-卡恩 (Dorgesh-Kaan) 成立的情况吗？ [nin neng gao su wo you guan duo er ge shen - ka en  (Dorgesh-Kaan)  cheng li de qing kuang ma ？]

english: Of course!  *Ahem*
translation: 当然！  *咳咳* [dang ran ！  * hai hai *]

english: Before Dorgesh-Kaan, the Dorgeshuun lived on the surface with many other goblin tribes. All goblins were ruled over by an evil god whose name has been forgotten.
translation: 在多尔格什-卡恩之前，多格舒恩与许多其他地精部落一起生活在地表。所有妖精都被一位名字已被遗忘的邪神所统治。 [zai duo er ge shen - ka en zhi qian ， duo ge shu en yu xu duo qi ta di jing bu luo yi qi sheng huo zai di biao 。 suo you yao jing dou bei yi wei ming zi yi bei yi wang de xie shen suo tong zhi 。]

english: The gods became bored and decided to make the mortal races fight for their amusement. The goblins were sent to fight in many bloody battles against each other and other races.
translation: 诸神感到无聊，决定让凡人种族打斗来取乐。地精们被派去参加许多与彼此和其他种族的血腥战斗。 [zhu shen gan dao wu liao ， jue ding rang fan ren zhong zu da dou lai qu le 。 di jing men bei pai qu can jia xu duo yu bi ci he qi ta zhong zu de xue xing zhan dou 。]

english: The war lasted for thousands of years, and millions of goblins died. Eventually, the evil god sent the Dorgeshuun tribe to fight a battle that they could not win.
translation: 战争持续了数千年，数以百万计的哥布林死去。最终，邪神派多格舒恩部落进行了一场他们无法获胜的战斗。 [zhan zheng chi xu le shu qian nian ， shu yi bai wan ji di ge bu lin si qu 。 zui zhong ， xie shen pai duo ge shu en bu luo jin xing le yi chang ta men wu fa huo sheng de zhan dou 。]

english: But General Bloodfist of the Dorgeshuun refused to fight in this battle. Instead, he commanded the Dorgeshuun army to march down into a fissure in the ground.
translation: 但多格舒恩的血拳将军拒绝参加这场战斗。相反，他命令多尔格舒恩军队深入地面裂缝。 [dan duo ge shu en de xue quan jiang jun ju jue can jia zhe chang zhan dou 。 xiang fan ， ta ming ling duo er ge shu en jun dui shen ru di mian lie feng 。]

english: General Bloodfist stood at the mouth of the fissure and defied the might of the evil god.
translation: 血拳将军站在裂缝口，反抗着邪神的威力。 [xue quan jiang jun zhan zai lie feng kou ， fan kang zhe xie shen de wei li 。]

english: The evil god smote him with a mighty blast that shook the earth, but that blast also closed the fissure, sealing the Dorgeshuun away from the reach of the gods.
translation: 邪神用震撼大地的强大冲击波击中了他，但那股冲击波也封闭了裂缝，将多尔格舒恩封印在众神的触及范围之外。 [xie shen yong zhen han da di de qiang da chong ji bo ji zhong le ta ， dan na gu chong ji bo ye feng bi le lie feng ， jiang duo er ge shu en feng yin zai zhong shen de chu ji fan wei zhi wai 。]

english: Lieutenant Strongaxe, now the leader of the Dorgeshuun, led the tribe deeper into the caves. They found this cavern, and here they founded Dorgesh- Kaan, city of the Dorgeshuun.
translation: 强斧中尉现在是多格舒恩的领袖，他带领部落深入洞穴。他们发现了这个洞穴，并在这里建立了多尔格什卡恩（Dorgesh-Kaan），也就是多尔格舒恩人的城市。 [qiang fu zhong wei xian zai shi duo ge shu en de ling xiu ， ta dai ling bu luo shen ru dong xue 。 ta men fa xian le zhe ge dong xue ， bing zai zhe li jian li le duo er ge shen ka en （Dorgesh-Kaan）， ye jiu shi duo er ge shu en ren de cheng shi 。]

english: The god Zamorak attacked the other gods, starting a great war. The goblins were sent to fight in many bloody battles against each other and other races.
translation: 萨莫拉克神攻击其他神，引发了一场大战。地精们被派去参加许多与彼此和其他种族的血腥战斗。 [sa mo la ke shen gong ji qi ta shen ， yin fa le yi chang da zhan 。 di jing men bei pai qu can jia xu duo yu bi ci he qi ta zhong zu de xue xing zhan dou 。]

english: The other gods decided to remove the great god Zaros from power, and started a great war. The goblins were sent to fight in many bloody battles against each other and other races.
translation: 其他诸神决定推翻大神扎罗斯的权力，并开始了一场大战。地精们被派去参加许多与彼此和其他种族的血腥战斗。 [qi ta zhu shen jue ding tui fan da shen zha luo si de quan li ， bing kai shi le yi chang da zhan 。 di jing men bei pai qu can jia xu duo yu bi ci he qi ta zhong zu de xue xing zhan dou 。]

english: In order to preserve balance, the god Guthix made the other gods fight against one another. The goblins were sent to fight in many bloody battles against each other and other races.
translation: 为了保持平衡，古提克斯神让其他神明互相争斗。地精们被派去参加许多与彼此和其他种族的血腥战斗。 [wei le bao chi ping heng ， gu ti ke si shen rang qi ta shen ming hu xiang zheng dou 。 di jing men bei pai qu can jia xu duo yu bi ci he qi ta zhong zu de xue xing zhan dou 。]

english: Before Dorgesh-Kaan, the Dorgeshuun lived on the surface with many other goblin tribes. All goblins were ruled over by an evil god called Big High War God.
translation: 在多尔格什-卡恩之前，多格舒恩与许多其他地精部落一起生活在地表。所有的哥布林都被一位名叫“大高战神”的邪神所统治。 [zai duo er ge shen - ka en zhi qian ， duo ge shu en yu xu duo qi ta di jing bu luo yi qi sheng huo zai di biao 。 suo you di ge bu lin dou bei yi wei ming jiao “ da gao zhan shen ” de xie shen suo tong zhi 。]

english: Before Dorgesh-Kaan, the Dorgeshuun lived on the surface with many other goblin tribes. All goblins were ruled over by an evil god called Zamorak.
translation: 在多尔格什-卡恩之前，多格舒恩与许多其他地精部落一起生活在地表。所有的妖精都被一个名叫萨莫拉克的邪神所统治。 [zai duo er ge shen - ka en zhi qian ， duo ge shu en yu xu duo qi ta di jing bu luo yi qi sheng huo zai di biao 。 suo you de yao jing dou bei yi ge ming jiao sa mo la ke de xie shen suo tong zhi 。]

english: Before Dorgesh-Kaan, the Dorgeshuun lived on the surface with many other goblin tribes. All goblins were ruled over by an evil god called Guthix.
translation: 在多尔格什-卡恩之前，多格舒恩与许多其他地精部落一起生活在地表。所有的妖精都被一个名叫古斯克斯的邪神所统治。 [zai duo er ge shen - ka en zhi qian ， duo ge shu en yu xu duo qi ta di jing bu luo yi qi sheng huo zai di biao 。 suo you de yao jing dou bei yi ge ming jiao gu si ke si de xie shen suo tong zhi 。]

english: Before Dorgesh-Kaan, the Dorgeshuun lived on the surface with many other goblin tribes. All goblins were ruled over by an evil god called Saradomin.
translation: 在多尔格什-卡恩之前，多格舒恩与许多其他地精部落一起生活在地表。所有的哥布林都被一个名叫萨拉多明的邪神所统治。 [zai duo er ge shen - ka en zhi qian ， duo ge shu en yu xu duo qi ta di jing bu luo yi qi sheng huo zai di biao 。 suo you di ge bu lin dou bei yi ge ming jiao sa la duo ming de xie shen suo tong zhi 。]

english: Before Dorgesh-Kaan, the Dorgeshuun lived on the surface with many other goblin tribes. All goblins were ruled over by an evil god called [player name].
translation: 在多尔格什-卡恩之前，多格舒恩与许多其他地精部落一起生活在地表。所有的妖精都被一个名叫[玩家名字]的邪神所统治。 [zai duo er ge shen - ka en zhi qian ， duo ge shu en yu xu duo qi ta di jing bu luo yi qi sheng huo zai di biao 。 suo you de yao jing dou bei yi ge ming jiao [ wan jia ming zi ] de xie shen suo tong zhi 。]

english: Can you tell me about the Dorgeshuun civil war?
translation: 你能告诉我多尔格舒恩内战的情况吗？ [ni neng gao su wo duo er ge shu en nei zhan de qing kuang ma ？]

english: Certainly!  *Ahem*
translation: 当然！  *咳咳* [dang ran ！  * hai hai *]

english: At first, Dorgesh-Kaan was ruled over by generals, just as the tribe had been when it was on the surface. Each general succeeded the last by defeating him in combat.
translation: 起初，多尔格什-卡恩由将军统治，就像部落在地表时一样。每位将军都在战斗中击败了最后一位将军，取得了成功。 [qi chu ， duo er ge shen - ka en you jiang jun tong zhi ， jiu xiang bu luo zai di biao shi yi yang 。 mei wei jiang jun dou zai zhan dou zhong ji bai le zui hou yi wei jiang jun ， qu de le cheng gong 。]

english: The generals were advised by a council of elders, but the Dorgeshuun were no longer an army, and many of the people felt that the Council should have authority.
translation: 将军们接受长老会议的建议，但多格舒恩不再是一支军队，许多人认为长老会议应该拥有权威。 [jiang jun men jie shou zhang lao hui yi de jian yi ， dan duo ge shu en bu zai shi yi zhi jun dui ， xu duo ren ren wei zhang lao hui yi ying gai yong you quan wei 。]

english: The people voted to become a republic, but General Bonehelm refused to give up power, and so the Dorgeshuun Civil War began.
translation: 人民投票建立共和国，但博内赫姆将军拒绝放弃权力，于是多尔格顺内战开始了。 [ren min tou piao jian li gong he guo ， dan bo nei he mu jiang jun ju jue fang qi quan li ， yu shi duo er ge shun nei zhan kai shi le 。]

english: The republican faction was larger, but the military faction contained most of the trained warriors and controlled the magical equipment that the tribe had brought from the surface.

translation: 你能告诉我我在哪里吗？ [ni neng gao su wo wo zai na li ma ？]

english: You're in The Golden Field. There's a bank to the south and my grandfather's fruit farm is south-east near the beach. Fancy a drink now?
translation: 你在金色领域。南边有一座银行，我祖父的果园在东南靠近海滩的地方。现在想喝一杯吗？ [ni zai jin se ling yu 。 nan bian you yi zuo yin hang ， wo zu fu de guo yuan zai dong nan kao jin hai tan de di fang 。 xian zai xiang he yi bei ma ？]

english: Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: 你在这里听到过什么谣言吗？ [ni zai zhe li ting dao guo shen me yao yan ma ？]

english: Apparently Veos is looking for some help with something. He hangs around the docks of Port Piscarilius.
translation: 显然 Veos 正在寻求一些帮助。他在皮斯卡利留斯港的码头附近闲逛。 [xian ran  Veos  zheng zai xun qiu yi xie bang zhu 。 ta zai pi si ka li liu si gang de ma tou fu jin xian guang 。]

english: They say there's trouble in Port Piscarilius. Something about gangs uniting. Might be worth looking into.
translation: 他们说皮斯卡利留斯港有麻烦。一些关于帮派联合的事情。可能值得研究一下。 [ta men shuo pi si ka li liu si gang you ma fan 。 yi xie guan yu bang pai lian he de shi qing 。 ke neng zhi de yan jiu yi xia 。]

english: I hear that Lord Hosidius has misplaced one of his sons. The Hosidius family might pay a lot to see him returned safely.
translation: 我听说霍西迪乌斯勋爵失去了他的一个儿子。霍西迪乌斯家族可能会付出很多代价才能让他安全归来。 [wo ting shuo huo xi di wu si xun jue shi qu le ta de yi ge er zi 。 huo xi di wu si jia zu ke neng hui fu chu hen duo dai jia cai neng rang ta an quan gui lai 。]

english: Phileas Rimor has supposedly been looking for some assistance with something in Shayzien. Maybe worth investigating.
translation: 据说菲利亚斯·里莫一直在向 Shayzien 寻求一些帮助。也许值得调查。 [ju shuo fei li ya si · li mo yi zhi zai xiang  Shayzien  xun qiu yi xie bang zhu 。 ye xu zhi de diao cha 。]

english: I hear that the rulers of Lovakengj have some work available. You'll find them in the Lovakengj Assembly.
translation: 我听说洛瓦肯杰的统治者有一些工作要做。您可以在洛瓦肯吉议会找到它们。 [wo ting shuo luo wa ken jie de tong zhi zhe you yi xie gong zuo yao zuo 。 nin ke yi zai luo wa ken ji yi hui zhao dao ta men 。]

english: Apparently there's been some commotion in the middle of Arceuus. Might be worth checking out.
translation: 阿尔宙斯的中央显然发生了一些骚动。可能值得一看。 [a er zhou si de zhong yang xian ran fa sheng le yi xie sao dong 。 ke neng zhi de yi kan 。]

english: That protest outside Kourend Castle is starting to attract some attention. Could be worth taking a look.
translation: 库伦德城堡外的抗议活动开始引起一些关注。可能值得一看。 [ku lun de cheng bao wai de kang yi huo dong kai shi yin qi yi xie guan zhu 。 ke neng zhi de yi kan 。]

english: No, it hasn't been very busy lately.
translation: 不，最近不太忙。 [bu ， zui jin bu tai mang 。]

english: I'm okay, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。 [wo mei shi ， xie xie 。]

english: With some of these drinks inside you, you could be far more than merely okay!
translation: 如果您喝了一些这些饮料，您的健康将不仅仅是好起来！ [ru guo nin he le yi xie zhe xie yin liao ， nin de jian kang jiang bu jin jin shi hao qi lai ！]

english: What are you serving?
translation: 你在服务什么？ [ni zai fu wu shen me ？]

english: Can you tell me where I am?
translation: 你能告诉我我在哪里吗？ [ni neng gao su wo wo zai na li ma ？]

english: I'm okay, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。 [wo mei shi ， xie xie 。]

english: Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: 你在这里听到过什么谣言吗？ [ni zai zhe li ting dao guo shen me yao yan ma ？]

english: What are you doing down here? Leave before you get yourself into trouble.
translation: 你在下面做什么？在你给自己惹上麻烦之前离开。 [ni zai xia mian zuo shen me ？ zai ni gei zi ji re shang ma fan zhi qian li kai 。]

english: Hello, are you okay?
translation: 你好，你还好吗？ [ni hao ， ni hai hao ma ？]

english: It's just those blasted hob-gobs. I locked myself in here for protection. But I've left the key somewhere and now I'm stuck.
translation: 就是那些该死的滚蛋。我把自己锁在这里以求保护。但我把钥匙落在某处了，现在我被困住了。 [jiu shi na xie gai si de gun dan 。 wo ba zi ji suo zai zhe li yi qiu bao hu 。 dan wo ba yao shi luo zai mou chu le ， xian zai wo bei kun zhu le 。]

english: Okay... I'll have a look for a key.
translation: 好吧...我去找找钥匙。 [hao ba ... wo qu zhao zhao yao shi 。]

english: Hello, who are you?
translation: 你好，你是谁？ [ni hao ， ni shi shui ？]

english: I am Golrie, I've been stuck here for ages, those hob-gobs are trying to steal my family's heirlooms. My grandad gave me all sorts of old junk.
translation: 我是戈尔里，我已经被困在这里很多年了，那些混蛋正试图偷走我家族的传家宝。我的祖父给了我各种各样的旧垃圾。 [wo shi ge er li ， wo yi jing bei kun zai zhe li hen duo nian le ， na xie hun dan zheng shi tu tou zou wo jia zu de chuan jia bao 。 wo de zu fu gei le wo ge zhong ge yang de jiu la ji 。]

english: Do you mind if I have a look?
translation: 你介意我看一下吗？ [ni jie yi wo kan yi xia ma ？]

english: No, of course not.
translation: 不，当然不是。 [bu ， dang ran bu shi 。]

english: You look amongst the junk on the floor and find Glarial's pebble.
translation: 你在地板上的垃圾中寻找，找到了格拉里尔的卵石。 [ni zai di ban shang de la ji zhong xun zhao ， zhao dao le ge la li er de luan shi 。]

english: Could I take this old pebble?
translation: 我可以拿走这块旧鹅卵石吗？ [wo ke yi na zou zhe kuai jiu e luan shi ma ？]

english: Oh that, yes have it, it's just some old elven junk I believe.
translation: 哦，是的，我相信这只是一些古老的精灵垃圾。 [o ， shi de ， wo xiang xin zhe zhi shi yi xie gu lao de jing ling la ji 。]

english: Thanks for the key traveller. I think I'll wait in here until those hob-gobs get bored and leave.
translation: 感谢关键的旅行者。我想我会在这里等，直到那些小混蛋感到无聊并离开。 [gan xie guan jian de lv xing zhe 。 wo xiang wo hui zai zhe li deng ， zhi dao na xie xiao hun dan gan dao wu liao bing li kai 。]

english: Okay, take care Golrie.
translation: 好吧，保重戈尔里。 [hao ba ， bao zhong ge er li 。]

english: Hello Golrie.
translation: 你好戈尔里。 [ni hao ge er li 。]

english: Hello again.
translation: 又好。 [you hao 。]

english: Do you mind if I have another look through this stuff?
translation: 你介意我再看一下这些东西吗？ [ni jie yi wo zai kan yi xia zhe xie dong xi ma ？]

english: You look amongst the junk on the floor but find nothing of interest.
translation: 你在地板上的垃圾中寻找，但没有发现任何有趣的东西。 [ni zai di ban shang de la ji zhong xun zhao ， dan mei you fa xian ren he you qu de dong xi 。]

english: Hello, Golrie. How's it going?
translation: 你好，戈尔里。怎么样了？ [ni hao ， ge er li 。 zen me yang le ？]

english: Better now I'm on the right side of these bars.
translation: 现在好多了，我在这些酒吧的右侧。 [xian zai hao duo le ， wo zai zhe xie jiu ba de you ce 。]

english: Found anything interesting recently?
translation: 最近发现什么有趣的事了吗？ [zui jin fa xian shen me you qu de shi le ma ？]

english: It just so happens I have. Take a look at this book.
translation: 碰巧我也有这样的情况。看看这本书。 [peng qiao wo ye you zhe yang de qing kuang 。 kan kan zhe ben shu 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: I managed to find that device.
translation: 我设法找到了那个设备。 [wo she fa zhao dao le na ge she bei 。]

english: Wonderful! Though you know, I don't think you ever actually mentioned what the device does.
translation: 精彩的！尽管您知道，但我认为您从未真正提到过该设备的用途。 [jing cai de ！ jin guan nin zhi dao ， dan wo ren wei nin cong wei zhen zheng ti dao guo gai she bei de yong tu 。]

english: It counteracts illusion magic in the surrounding area. This one should cover the whole of the Tree Gnome Village. It might be useful for someone to remember that in case it's needed again.
translation: 它可以抵消周围区域的幻象魔法。这个应该覆盖整个树侏儒村。如果有人再次需要它，记住这一点可能会很有用。 [ta ke yi di xiao zhou wei qu yu de huan xiang mo fa 。 zhe ge ying gai fu gai zheng ge shu zhu ru cun 。 ru guo you ren zai ci xu yao ta ， ji zhu zhe yi dian ke neng hui hen you yong 。]

english: Oh, well I'll be sure to keep that in mind.
translation: 哦，好吧，我一定会记住这一点。 [o ， hao ba ， wo yi ding hui ji zhu zhe yi dian 。]

english: I found Bolrie's diary. Do you know anything about it?
translation: 我找到了博利的日记。你知道吗？ [wo zhao dao le bo li de ri ji 。 ni zhi dao ma ？]

english: Of course! Bolrie is my grandfather... assuming he's still alive, at least.
translation: 当然！博尔里是我的祖父……至少假设他还活着。 [dang ran ！ bo er li shi wo de zu fu …… zhi shao jia she ta hai huo zhe 。]

english: Bolrie... Golrie... I should have guessed. You seem to like giving your children similar names, just to be confusing.
translation: Bolrie...Golrie...我应该猜到的。你似乎喜欢给你的孩子取相似的名字，只是为了让人困惑。 [Bolrie...Golrie... wo ying gai cai dao de 。 ni si hu xi huan gei ni de hai zi qu xiang si de ming zi ， zhi shi wei le rang ren kun huo 。]

english: Certainly, in our family that's true. King Bolren is also Bolrie's younger brother, in case you didn't know.
translation: 当然，在我们家里确实如此。如果你不知道的话，博伦国王也是博里的弟弟。 [dang ran ， zai wo men jia li que shi ru ci 。 ru guo ni bu zhi dao de hua ， bo lun guo wang ye shi bo li de di di 。]

english: So that means you're King Bolren's grand-nephew, right?
translation: 那么这意味着你是博伦国王的侄孙，对吗？ [na me zhe yi wei zhe ni shi bo lun guo wang de zhi sun ， dui ma ？]

english: That's right.
translation: 这是正确的。 [zhe shi zheng que de 。]

english: Does that mean that you're in line for the throne?
translation: 这是否意味着你有资格继承王位？ [zhe shi fou yi wei zhe ni you zi ge ji cheng wang wei ？]

english: Gnomes don't have a hereditary monarchy. We have a democratic monarchy. We vote for our kings.
translation: 侏儒没有世袭君主制。我们有一个民主君主制。我们投票给我们的国王。 [zhu ru mei you shi xi jun zhu zhi 。 wo men you yi ge min zhu jun zhu zhi 。 wo men tou piao gei wo men de guo wang 。]

english: Oh, that's unusual. So you've never thought about being the King?
translation: 哦，这很不寻常。所以你从来没有想过当国王吗？ [o ， zhe hen bu xun chang 。 suo yi ni cong lai mei you xiang guo dang guo wang ma ？]

english: That might be fun. I wouldn't want to be like gramps though. He liked wars a bit too much. I do sometimes discuss the Khazard War with the hobgobbos, but they don't have a particularly sharp political sense.
translation: 那可能很有趣。但我不想成为像爷爷那样的人。他有点太喜欢战争了。我有时确实会与霍布哥博讨论卡扎尔战争，但他们没有特别敏锐的政治意识。 [na ke neng hen you qu 。 dan wo bu xiang cheng wei xiang ye ye na yang de ren 。 ta you dian tai xi huan zhan zheng le 。 wo you shi que shi hui yu huo bu ge bo tao lun ka zha er zhan zheng ， dan ta men mei you te bie min rui de zheng zhi yi shi 。]

english: Personally, I don't think we should fight his troops head- on. We're smarter than that. We should come up with some ingenious method of defeating Khazard, like they did at the Battle of Atarisundri!
translation: 就我个人而言，我认为我们不应该与他的军队正面作战。我们比那更聪明。我们应该想出一些巧妙的方法来击败卡扎德，就像他们在阿塔里桑德里战役中所做的那样！ [jiu wo ge ren er yan ， wo ren wei wo men bu ying gai yu ta de jun dui zheng mian zuo zhan 。 wo men bi na geng cong ming 。 wo men ying gai xiang chu yi xie qiao miao de fang fa lai ji bai ka zha de ， jiu xiang ta men zai a ta li sang de li zhan yi zhong suo zuo de na yang ！]

english: You're very well informed for a gnome in a cave. Most gnomes I've talked to have forgotten most of their own history.
translation: 对于洞穴里的侏儒来说，你消息灵通。我交谈过的大多数侏儒都忘记了自己的大部分历史。 [dui yu dong xue li de zhu ru lai shuo ， ni xiao xi ling tong 。 wo jiao tan guo de da duo shu zhu ru dou wang ji le zi ji de da bu fen li shi 。]

english: Gnomes don't tend to dwell on the past, but I suppose I'm not a typical gnome. I get lots of time to think and read in here.
translation: 侏儒不倾向于沉溺于过去，但我想我不是一个典型的侏儒。我在这里有很多时间思考和阅读。 [zhu ru bu qing xiang yu chen ni yu guo qu ， dan wo xiang wo bu shi yi ge dian xing de zhu ru 。 wo zai zhe li you hen duo shi jian si kao he yue du 。]

english: So have you heard from Bolrie recently?
translation: 那么您最近有收到 Bolrie 的消息吗？ [na me nin zui jin you shou dao  Bolrie  de xiao xi ma ？]

english: No, the parcels stopped arriving a few years ago. I guess he's either found what he was looking for, or has died in the attempt.
translation: 不，包裹几年前就停止送达了。我猜他要么找到了他要找的东西，要么就死在了尝试中。 [bu ， bao guo ji nian qian jiu ting zhi song da le 。 wo cai ta yao me zhao dao le ta yao zhao de dong xi ， yao me jiu si zai le chang shi zhong 。]

english: What was he looking for?
translation: 他在寻找什么？ [ta zai xun zhao shen me ？]

english: I'm not sure. He was definitely obsessed with finding out as much as he could about elven magic. He also seemed to have a bit of a grudge against Glouphrie.
translation: 我不知道。他绝对痴迷于尽可能多地了解精灵魔法。他似乎对格卢弗里也有一点怨恨。 [wo bu zhi dao 。 ta jue dui chi mi yu jin ke neng duo di liao jie jing ling mo fa 。 ta si hu dui ge lu fu li ye you yi dian yuan hen 。]

english: Maybe he's looking for Glouphrie.
translation: 也许他正在寻找格卢弗里。 [ye xu ta zheng zai xun zhao ge lu fu li 。]

english: Who knows, eh? Who knows?
translation: 谁知道，嗯？谁知道？ [shui zhi dao ， n ？ shui zhi dao ？]

english: Where did that crystal bowl come from?
translation: 那个水晶碗是从哪里来的？ [na ge shui jing wan shi cong na li lai de ？]

english: A huge battle tortoise arrived a while back carrying a crate with it in. Sent by gramps, of course. It looks pretty, doesn't it? Would probably look great with some plants in it.
translation: 不久前，一只巨大的战龟带着一个板条箱来到了这里。当然，是爷爷送来的。它看起来很漂亮，不是吗？里面放一些植物可能会看起来很棒。 [bu jiu qian ， yi zhi ju da de zhan gui dai zhe yi ge ban tiao xiang lai dao le zhe li 。 dang ran ， shi ye ye song lai de 。 ta kan qi lai hen piao liang ， bu shi ma ？ li mian fang yi xie zhi wu ke neng hui kan qi lai hen bang 。]

english: I don't think it's meant to be used as a plant pot.
translation: 我认为它不适合用作花盆。 [wo ren wei ta bu shi he yong zuo hua pen 。]

english: Well, what's it for then?
translation: 嗯，那它有什么用呢？ [n ， na ta you shen me yong ne ？]

english: It's a singing bowl. You can use it to shape elven crystal.
translation: 这是一个颂钵。你可以用它来塑造精灵水晶。 [zhe shi yi ge song bo 。 ni ke yi yong ta lai su zao jing ling shui jing 。]

english: Ohh... How exciting!
translation: 哦……多么令人兴奋啊！ [o …… duo me ling ren xing fen a ！]

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: See you later.
translation: 稍后见。 [shao hou jian 。]

english: I have a question about your storeroom.
translation: 我有一个关于你的储藏室的问题。 [wo you yi ge guan yu ni de chu cang shi de wen ti 。]

english: I lost that pebble.
translation: 我把那块鹅卵石弄丢了。 [wo ba na kuai e luan shi nong diu le 。]

english: Not to worry. It turned up here again.
translation: 不用担心。它又出现在这里了。 [bu yong dan xin 。 ta you chu xian zai zhe li le 。]

english: Can I use your key?
translation: 我可以使用你的钥匙吗？ [wo ke yi shi yong ni de yao shi ma ？]

english: If you wanna go in there with them hob-gobs, that's your business.
translation: 如果你想和他们一起去那里，那是你的事。 [ru guo ni xiang he ta men yi qi qu na li ， na shi ni de shi 。]

english: I'll leave you to it.
translation: 我就让你去吧。 [wo jiu rang ni qu ba 。]

english: Yes, lots to do. Them hob-gobs left my stuff out here in a right mess. Until next time.
translation: 是的，有很多事情要做。他们把我的东西乱七八糟地丢在这里了。直到下次。 [shi de ， you hen duo shi qing yao zuo 。 ta men ba wo de dong xi luan qi ba zao di diu zai zhe li le 。 zhi dao xia ci 。]

english: Found anything interesting recently?
translation: 最近发现什么有趣的事了吗？ [zui jin fa xian shen me you qu de shi le ma ？]

english: I managed to find that device.
translation: 我设法找到了那个设备。 [wo she fa zhao dao le na ge she bei 。]

english: I found Bolrie's diary. Do you know anything about it?
translation: 我找到了博利的日记。你知道吗？ [wo zhao dao le bo li de ri ji 。 ni zhi dao ma ？]

english: Where did that crystal bowl come from?
translation: 那个水晶碗是从哪里来的？ [na ge shui jing wan shi cong na li lai de ？]

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: I have a question about your storeroom.
translation: 我有一个关于你的储藏室的问题。 [wo you yi ge guan yu ni de chu cang shi de wen ti 。]

english: I lost that pebble.
translation: 我把那块鹅卵石弄丢了。 [wo ba na kuai e luan shi nong diu le 。]

english: Can I use your key?
translation: 我可以使用你的钥匙吗？ [wo ke yi shi yong ni de yao shi ma ？]

english: I'll leave you to it.
translation: 我就让你去吧。 [wo jiu rang ni qu ba 。]

english: *HONK*
translation: *鸣喇叭* [* ming la ba *]

english: Of course, you honk. I don't know what I was expecting.
translation: 当然，你按喇叭。我不知道我在期待什么。 [dang ran ， ni an la ba 。 wo bu zhi dao wo zai qi dai shen me 。]

english: That is one large, loud chicken.
translation: 那是一只又大又响亮的鸡。 [na shi yi zhi you da you xiang liang de ji 。]

english: I take it that stealth is not your speciality.
translation: 我认为潜行不是你的专长。 [wo ren wei qian xing bu shi ni de zhuan chang 。]

english: The goose looks at you knowingly. It remembers all of your Christmas Achievements!
translation: 鹅会意地看着你。它会记住您所有的圣诞节成就！ [e hui yi di kan zhe ni 。 ta hui ji zhu nin suo you de sheng dan jie cheng jiu ！]

english: ...Six Geese a-laying...
translation: ...六只鹅正在产蛋... [... liu zhi e zheng zai chan dan ...]

english: That's a loud honk.
translation: 那是响亮的喇叭声。 [na shi xiang liang de la ba sheng 。]

english: Ha, HONK right back at you.
translation: 哈，就向你鸣喇叭。 [ha ， jiu xiang ni ming la ba 。]

english: What would a goose want with a pub?
translation: 鹅想要酒吧做什么？ [e xiang yao jiu ba zuo shen me ？]

english: Looking closer at the Goose's hat. It's got the name 'Wolfy' written on it.
translation: 仔细观察鹅的帽子。上面写着“狼”这个名字。 [zi xi guan cha e de mao zi 。 shang mian xie zhe “ lang ” zhe ge ming zi 。]

english: You're actually pretty cute with that little hat.
translation: 其实你戴着那顶小帽子很可爱。 [qi shi ni dai zhe na ding xiao mao zi hen ke ai 。]

english: Looking closer at the goose's hat, it's got the name 'Wolfy' written on it.
translation: 仔细一看，鹅的帽子上写着“狼”这个名字。 [zi xi yi kan ， e de mao zi shang xie zhe “ lang ” zhe ge ming zi 。]

english: I wonder where you came from?
translation: 我想知道你从哪里来？ [wo xiang zhi dao ni cong na li lai ？]

english: Hello. Who are you?
translation: 你好。你是谁？ [ni hao 。 ni shi shui ？]

english: The name's Gordon. Good day to you.
translation: 我的名字叫戈登。祝你有美好的一天。 [wo de ming zi jiao ge deng 。 zhu ni you mei hao de yi tian 。]

english: It's a nice farm you've got here.
translation: 你这里有一个很好的农场。 [ni zhe li you yi ge hen hao de nong chang 。]

english: Thank you. We built it ourselves.
translation: 谢谢。我们自己建造的。 [xie xie 。 wo men zi ji jian zao de 。]

english: Really? So you haven't been here long?
translation: 真的吗？那么你来这里没多久？ [zhen de ma ？ na me ni lai zhe li mei duo jiu ？]

english: Nope. Not too long ago you couldn't safely travel around these parts. Too many lizardmen. But then some Hosidius explorers discovered how fertile this land was.
translation: 没有。不久前，您还无法安全地在这些地区旅行。蜥蜴人太多了但后来一些霍西迪乌斯探险家发现这片土地是多么肥沃。 [mei you 。 bu jiu qian ， nin hai wu fa an quan di zai zhe xie di qu lv xing 。 xi yi ren tai duo le dan hou lai yi xie huo xi di wu si tan xian jia fa xian zhe pian tu di shi duo me fei wo 。]

english: Lord Hosidius made a deal with Lord Shayzien and the lizardmen were cleared out to make room for the Farming Guild.
translation: 霍西迪乌斯勋爵与谢齐恩勋爵达成了一项协议，蜥蜴人被清除，为农业公会腾出空间。 [huo xi di wu si xun jue yu xie qi en xun jue da cheng le yi xiang xie yi ， xi yi ren bei qing chu ， wei nong ye gong hui teng chu kong jian 。]

english: When we heard, we decided to come up here and start up our own farm.
translation: 当我们听说后，我们决定来这里开办我们自己的农场。 [dang wo men ting shuo hou ， wo men jue ding lai zhe li kai ban wo men zi ji de nong chang 。]

english: Need a hand with anything?
translation: 需要帮忙吗？ [xu yao bang mang ma ？]

english: Very nice. Well I hope it goes well for you.
translation: 很不错。好吧，我希望你一切顺利。 [hen bu cuo 。 hao ba ， wo xi wang ni yi qie shun li 。]

english: Thank you friend. See you later.
translation: 谢谢你的朋友。稍后见。 [xie xie ni de peng you 。 shao hou jian 。]

english: Hello again. How are things?
translation: 又好。最近怎么样？ [you hao 。 zui jin zen me yang ？]

english: Hello there. Not too bad, thanks.
translation: 你好呀。还不错，谢谢。 [ni hao ya 。 hai bu cuo ， xie xie 。]

english: Great to hear. All the best.
translation: 很高兴听到。一切顺利。 [hen gao xing ting dao 。 yi qie shun li 。]

english: Hello again. Thank you for dealing with that beast.
translation: 又好。谢谢你对付那头野兽。 [you hao 。 xie xie ni dui fu na tou ye shou 。]

english: Hello again. Thank you for dealing with that beast. As promised, here's your reward.
translation: 又好。谢谢你对付那头野兽。正如所承诺的，这是你的奖励。 [you hao 。 xie xie ni dui fu na tou ye shou 。 zheng ru suo cheng nuo de ， zhe shi ni de jiang li 。]

english: It's my pleasure.
translation: 这是我的荣幸。 [zhe shi wo de rong xing 。]

english: Need a hand with anything?
translation: 需要帮忙吗？ [xu yao bang mang ma ？]

english: Very nice. Well I hope it goes well for you.
translation: 很不错。好吧，我希望你一切顺利。 [hen bu cuo 。 hao ba ， wo xi wang ni yi qie shun li 。]

english: Great to hear. All the best.
translation: 很高兴听到。一切顺利。 [hen gao xing ting dao 。 yi qie shun li 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Good day, can I help you?
translation: 美好的一天，我能为您效劳吗？ [mei hao de yi tian ， wo neng wei nin xiao lao ma ？]

english: No thanks I'm just watching the world go by.
translation: 不，谢谢，我只是看着这个世界过去。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo zhi shi kan zhe zhe ge shi jie guo qu 。]

english: Well I can think of no better place to do it, it is beautiful here is it not?
translation: 好吧，我想不出更好的地方了，这里很漂亮，不是吗？ [hao ba ， wo xiang bu chu geng hao de di fang le ， zhe li hen piao liang ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Indeed it is.
translation: 确实如此。 [que shi ru ci 。]

english: Well this was once the best place to do it, it used to be beautiful here.
translation: 嗯，这曾经是最好的地方，这里曾经很美丽。 [n ， zhe ceng jing shi zui hao de di fang ， zhe li ceng jing hen mei li 。]

english: Will you repair the damage?
translation: 你会修复损坏吗？ [ni hui xiu fu sun huai ma ？]

english: In time, once the war is over, assuming we survive it.
translation: 假以时日，一旦战争结束，假设我们能幸存下来。 [jia yi shi ri ， yi dan zhan zheng jie shu ， jia she wo men neng xing cun xia lai 。]

english: Here, solve this.
translation: 来，解决这个问题。 [lai ， jie jue zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Goreu hands you a [light/puzzle] box.
translation: 戈雷递给你一个[灯光/拼图]盒子。 [ge lei di gei ni yi ge [ deng guang / pin tu ] he zi 。]

english: That doesn't look solved to me.
translation: 在我看来这并没有解决。 [zai wo kan lai zhe bing mei you jie jue 。]

english: Well done [player name]. Here you go.
translation: 干得好[玩家姓名]。干得好。 [gan de hao [ wan jia xing ming ]。 gan de hao 。]

english: You've been given a [new clue/casket]!
translation: 你已经获得了[新线索/棺材]！ [ni yi jing huo de le [ xin xian suo / guan cai ]！]

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你认为你在做什么？ [ni ren wei ni zai zuo shen me ？]

english: Greetings human.
translation: 问候人类。 [wen hou ren lei 。]

english: Hello. What is this place?
translation: 你好。这是什么地方？ [ni hao 。 zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This is one of your human banks. We set it up here to help your kind serve the balance with us.
translation: 这是你们的人类银行之一。我们将其设置在这里是为了帮助你们与我们保持平衡。 [zhe shi ni men de ren lei yin hang zhi yi 。 wo men jiang qi she zhi zai zhe li shi wei le bang zhu ni men yu wo men bao chi ping heng 。]

english: Do you not use it yourself?
translation: 你自己不用吗？ [ni zi ji bu yong ma ？]

english: No. We have no need for it. We have no possessions. We only have our cause.
translation: 不，我们不需要它。我们没有财产。我们只有我们的事业。 [bu ， wo men bu xu yao ta 。 wo men mei you cai chan 。 wo men zhi you wo men de shi ye 。]

english: To serve the balance?
translation: 为了平衡？ [wei le ping heng ？]

english: To serve the balance.
translation: 服务于平衡。 [fu wu yu ping heng 。]

english: Well, this has certainly been exciting! The Sinclairs under house arrest, Morgan Le Faye attempting yet again to interfere with King Arthur and Merlin, and even the Black Knights sticking their noses into it.
translation: 嗯，这确实令人兴奋！辛克莱家族被软禁，摩根勒法伊再次试图干涉亚瑟王和梅林，甚至黑骑士也插手其中。 [n ， zhe que shi ling ren xing fen ！ xin ke lai jia zu bei ruan jin ， mo gen lei fa yi zai ci shi tu gan she ya se wang he mei lin ， shen zhi hei qi shi ye cha shou qi zhong 。]

english: How do you know all that? It only just happened, and you weren't there!
translation: 你怎么知道这一切？事情才刚刚发生，而你却不在场！ [ni zen me zhi dao zhe yi qie ？ shi qing cai gang gang fa sheng ， er ni que bu zai chang ！]

english: I have my sources. No secret is safe as long as I'm around!
translation: 我有我的消息来源。只要有我在，没有什么秘密是安全的！ [wo you wo de xiao xi lai yuan 。 zhi yao you wo zai ， mei you shen me mi mi shi an quan de ！]

english: Could I ask you about the Sinclair family again?
translation: 我可以再问一下辛克莱家族的事吗？ [wo ke yi zai wen yi xia xin ke lai jia zu de shi ma ？]

english: Well, I'm not one to gossip, but as it's for your investigation... What would you like to know?
translation: 好吧，我不是一个喜欢八卦的人，但因为这是为了你的调查……你想知道什么？ [hao ba ， wo bu shi yi ge xi huan ba gua de ren ， dan yin wei zhe shi wei le ni de diao cha …… ni xiang zhi dao shen me ？]

english: Tell me about the family.
translation: 告诉我关于家庭的事情。 [gao su wo guan yu jia ting de shi qing 。]

english: I've heard plenty about each of them...but I'll try to keep it as short as I can.
translation: 我对他们每个人都听说过很多……但我会尽量保持简短。 [wo dui ta men mei ge ren dou ting shuo guo hen duo …… dan wo hui jin liang bao chi jian duan 。]

english: Old Lord Sinclair was a well respected man this side of White Wolf. He was great friends with King Ulthas and did many good works for the kingdom.
translation: 老辛克莱勋爵在白狼这边是一位受人尊敬的人。他与乌尔萨斯国王是好朋友，并为王国做出了许多善事。 [lao xin ke lai xun jue zai bai lang zhe bian shi yi wei shou ren zun jing de ren 。 ta yu wu er sa si guo wang shi hao peng you ， bing wei wang guo zuo chu le xu duo shan shi 。]

english: His children on the other hand were spoiled and horrid. They cared for no one but themselves and gave themselves such aires. Each had their own vice, but I didn't expect any of them would be driven to murder!
translation: 另一方面，他的孩子们被宠坏了，而且很可怕。他们只关心自己，不关心任何人，摆出一副架子。各有各的恶习，没想到竟然有人被逼到杀人的地步！ [ling yi fang mian ， ta de hai zi men bei chong huai le ， er qie hen ke pa 。 ta men zhi guan xin zi ji ， bu guan xin ren he ren ， bai chu yi fu jia zi 。 ge you ge de e xi ， mei xiang dao jing ran you ren bei bi dao sha ren de di bu ！]

english: What have they been up to since the arrest of their sibling?
translation: 自从他们的兄弟被捕后，他们在做什么？ [zi cong ta men de xiong di bei bu hou ， ta men zai zuo shen me ？]

english: They've been living very quietly, a nice change from the norm. But almost too quietly. I always thought they'd get into more trouble. No good will come from them, let me tell you!
translation: 他们一直过着平静的生活，这与平常相比是一个很好的改变。但几乎太安静了。我总觉得他们会遇到更多麻烦。他们不会带来任何好处，让我告诉你！ [ta men yi zhi guo zhe ping jing de sheng huo ， zhe yu ping chang xiang bi shi yi ge hen hao de gai bian 。 dan ji hu tai an jing le 。 wo zong jue de ta men hui yu dao geng duo ma fan 。 ta men bu hui dai lai ren he hao chu ， rang wo gao su ni ！]

english: Tell me about the mansion.
translation: 告诉我关于豪宅的事。 [gao su wo guan yu hao zhai de shi 。]

english: The mansion? The mansion is quite new. Originally, the Sinclair family lived in Camelot, although it went under a different name then.
translation: 豪宅？豪宅很新。最初，辛克莱家族居住在卡米洛特，尽管当时使用了不同的名称。 [hao zhai ？ hao zhai hen xin 。 zui chu ， xin ke lai jia zu ju zhu zai ka mi luo te ， jin guan dang shi shi yong le bu tong de ming cheng 。]

english: But when King Arthur and his knights appeared, old Lord Sinclair agreed with King Ulthas that the knights had greater need for the castle than the Sinclair family.
translation: 但当亚瑟王和他的骑士们出现时，老辛克莱勋爵同意了乌尔萨斯国王的观点，即骑士们比辛克莱家族更需要这座城堡。 [dan dang ya se wang he ta de qi shi men chu xian shi ， lao xin ke lai xun jue tong yi le wu er sa si guo wang de guan dian ， ji qi shi men bi xin ke lai jia zu geng xu yao zhe zuo cheng bao 。]

english: So, Lord Sinclair had the mansion built, packed his family up and vacated. His children were furious with him for doing it.
translation: 于是，辛克莱勋爵下令建造了这座宅邸，并收拾好家人并搬出。他的孩子们对他这样做感到愤怒。 [yu shi ， xin ke lai xun jue xia ling jian zao le zhe zuo zhai di ， bing shou shi hao jia ren bing ban chu 。 ta de hai zi men dui ta zhe yang zuo gan dao fen nu 。]

english: They felt themselves far better than the knights and felt insulted at having to live in a stuffy mansion.
translation: 他们觉得自己比骑士们好得多，并因为不得不住在闷热的宅邸中而感到受到侮辱。 [ta men jue de zi ji bi qi shi men hao de duo ， bing yin wei bu de bu zhu zai men re de zhai di zhong er gan dao shou dao wu ru 。]

english: What happened next?
translation: 接下来发生了什么？ [jie xia lai fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: Well, you should know best... Anna killed her father. Poor man.
translation: 好吧，你应该最清楚……安娜杀了她的父亲。可怜的人。 [hao ba ， ni ying gai zui qing chu …… an na sha le ta de fu qin 。 ke lian de ren 。]

english: Tell me about Anna Sinclair.
translation: 跟我说说安娜·辛克莱吧。 [gen wo shuo shuo an na · xin ke lai ba 。]

english: Anna? The guards are keeping her in the jail in the courthouse in Seers' Village. I hear she's been acting like a royal pain.
translation: 安娜？警卫将她关押在先知村法院的监狱里。我听说她表现得像个皇家痛苦者。 [an na ？ jing wei jiang ta guan ya zai xian zhi cun fa yuan de jian yu li 。 wo ting shuo ta biao xian de xiang ge huang jia tong ku zhe 。]

english: But what is she like? Can she be reasoned with?
translation: 但她到底是什么样的人呢？能跟她讲道理吗？ [dan ta dao di shi shen me yang de ren ne ？ neng gen ta jiang dao li ma ？]

english: Reasoned with? She killed her own father!
translation: 推理与？她杀了自己的父亲！ [tui li yu ？ ta sha le zi ji de fu qin ！]

english: I hear she's being so unreasonable that no lawyer in Gielinor will represent her. She's going to get a guilty verdict for sure.
translation: 我听说她太不讲理了，以至于吉林诺没有律师愿意代表她。她肯定会被判有罪。 [wo ting shuo ta tai bu jiang li le ， yi zhi yu ji lin nuo mei you lv shi yuan yi dai biao ta 。 ta ken ding hui bei pan you zui 。]

english: Still, I go and visit her at the Seers' Village courthouse sometimes to try and keep her spirits up.
translation: 尽管如此，我有时还是会去先知村法院看望她，试图让她振作起来。 [jin guan ru ci ， wo you shi hai shi hui qu xian zhi cun fa yuan kan wang ta ， shi tu rang ta zhen zuo qi lai 。]

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: Where is Anna Sinclair being held?
translation: 安娜·辛克莱被关押在哪里？ [an na · xin ke lai bei guan ya zai na li ？]

english: At the Seers' Village courthouse.
translation: 在先知村法院。 [zai xian zhi cun fa yuan 。]

translation: 告诉我安娜·辛克莱被关押在哪里。 [gao su wo an na · xin ke lai bei guan ya zai na li 。]

english: What can I do for you?
translation: 我能为你做什么？ [wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: I don't know. What can you do for me?
translation: 我不知道。你能为我做什么？ [wo bu zhi dao 。 ni neng wei wo zuo shen me ？]

english: A good question indeed! I'm selling special clothing for Agility enthusiasts.
translation: 确实是个好问题！我正在为敏捷爱好者销售特殊服装。 [que shi shi ge hao wen ti ！ wo zheng zai wei min jie ai hao zhe xiao shou te shu fu zhuang 。]

english: Sometimes, when you're exploring the hidden rooftops of our cities, you'll find one of my Marks.
translation: 有时，当您探索我们城市的隐蔽屋顶时，您会发现我的标记之一。 [you shi ， dang nin tan suo wo men cheng shi de yin bi wu ding shi ， nin hui fa xian wo de biao ji zhi yi 。]

english: Once you've got enough Marks, I'll exchange them for my Graceful clothing. So, does that interest you?
translation: 一旦你获得了足够的标记，我就会用它们来交换我的优雅服装。那么，你对此感兴趣吗？ [yi dan ni huo de le zu gou de biao ji ， wo jiu hui yong ta men lai jiao huan wo de you ya fu zhuang 。 na me ， ni dui ci gan xing qu ma ？]

english: Can I see what you're selling?
translation: 我可以看看你卖什么吗？ [wo ke yi kan kan ni mai shen me ma ？]

english: Can I see how many laps I've completed?
translation: 我可以看到我已经完成了多少圈吗？ [wo ke yi kan dao wo yi jing wan cheng le duo shao quan ma ？]

english: Can I toggle my lap counter?
translation: 我可以切换圈数计数器吗？ [wo ke yi qie huan quan shu ji shu qi ma ？]

english: Sure, I've disabled your lap counter messages, if you want to turn it back on, so you can see your total laps after you finish one, speak to me again.
translation: 当然，我已经禁用了你的圈数计数器消息，如果你想重新打开它，这样你就可以在完成一圈后看到你的总圈数，请再次与我联系。 [dang ran ， wo yi jing jin yong le ni de quan shu ji shu qi xiao xi ， ru guo ni xiang chong xin da kai ta ， zhe yang ni jiu ke yi zai wan cheng yi quan hou kan dao ni de zong quan shu ， qing zai ci yu wo lian xi 。]

english: Sure, I've turned on your lap counter, you'll get a message when you complete a lap on a rooftop course. To help you keep track.
translation: 当然，我已经打开了您的计圈器，当您在屋顶球场上完成一圈时，您会收到一条消息。帮助您跟踪。 [dang ran ， wo yi jing da kai le nin de ji quan qi ， dang nin zai wu ding qiu chang shang wan cheng yi quan shi ， nin hui shou dao yi tiao xiao xi 。 bang zhu nin gen zong 。]

english: I'm alright, thanks.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。 [wo mei shi ， xie xie 。]

translation: 我可以切换圈数计数器吗？ [wo ke yi qie huan quan shu ji shu qi ma ？]

english: Ting-a-ling-a-ling!
translation: 叮叮叮叮叮叮叮！ [ding ding ding ding ding ding ding ！]

english: Welcome to the Grail castle. You should come inside, it's cold out here.
translation: 欢迎来到圣杯城堡。你应该进去吧，外面很冷。 [huan ying lai dao sheng bei cheng bao 。 ni ying gai jin qu ba ， wai mian hen leng 。]

english: Somehow you are now inside the castle.
translation: 不知怎的，你现在已经在城堡里了。 [bu zhi zen de ， ni xian zai yi jing zai cheng bao li le 。]

english: Welcome to the Grail castle.
translation: 欢迎来到圣杯城堡。 [huan ying lai dao sheng bei cheng bao 。]

english: Welcome to the Grand Exchange. Would you like to trade now, or exchange item sets?
translation: 欢迎来到大交易所。您想立即进行交易或交换物品套装吗？ [huan ying lai dao da jiao yi suo 。 nin xiang li ji jin xing jiao yi huo jiao huan wu pin tao zhuang ma ？]

english: I have this voucher for completing the combat Adventure Path, it says to come talk to you about claiming my Adventure Path reward.
translation: 我有这张完成战斗冒险之路的凭证，上面写着来和你谈谈领取我的冒险之路奖励的事情。 [wo you zhe zhang wan cheng zhan dou mao xian zhi lu de ping zheng ， shang mian xie zhe lai he ni tan tan ling qu wo de mao xian zhi lu jiang li de shi qing 。]

english: Why yes, here is your reward.
translation: 为什么是的，这是你的奖励。 [wei shen me shi de ， zhe shi ni de jiang li 。]

english: If you wanted to, you could store the coins in the bank next to me.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，你可以把硬币存到我旁边的银行里。 [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， ni ke yi ba ying bi cun dao wo pang bian de yin hang li 。]

english: Is there anything else I can do for you?
translation: 我还能为您做些什么吗？ [wo hai neng wei nin zuo xie shen me ma ？]

english: How do I use the Grand Exchange?
translation: 如何使用大汇兑？ [ru he shi yong da hui dui ？]

english: My colleague and I can let you set up trade offers. You can offer to Sell items or Buy items.
translation: 我和我的同事可以让您设置贸易报价。您可以提出出售物品或购买物品。 [wo he wo de tong shi ke yi rang nin she zhi mao yi bao jia 。 nin ke yi ti chu chu shou wu pin huo gou mai wu pin 。]

english: When you want to sell something, you give us the items and tell us how much money you want for them.
translation: 当您想卖东西时，您可以将物品交给我们并告诉我们您想要多少钱。 [dang nin xiang mai dong xi shi ， nin ke yi jiang wu pin jiao gei wo men bing gao su wo men nin xiang yao duo shao qian 。]

english: We'll look for someone who wants to buy those items at your price, and we'll perform the trade. You can then collect the cash here, or at any bank.
translation: 我们将寻找愿意以您的价格购买这些物品的人，然后我们将进行交易。然后您可以在这里或任何银行领取现金。 [wo men jiang xun zhao yuan yi yi nin de jia ge gou mai zhe xie wu pin de ren ， ran hou wo men jiang jin xing jiao yi 。 ran hou nin ke yi zai zhe li huo ren he yin hang ling qu xian jin 。]

english: When you want to buy something, you tell us what you want, and give us the cash you're willing to spend on it.
translation: 当您想买东西时，请告诉我们您想要什么，并向我们提供您愿意花的现金。 [dang nin xiang mai dong xi shi ， qing gao su wo men nin xiang yao shen me ， bing xiang wo men ti gong nin yuan yi hua de xian jin 。]

english: We'll look for someone who's selling those items at your price, and we'll perform the trade. You can then collect the items here, or at any bank, along with any left-over cash.
translation: 我们将寻找以您的价格出售这些物品的人，然后我们将进行交易。然后，您可以在这里或在任何银行领取物品以及剩余的现金。 [wo men jiang xun zhao yi nin de jia ge chu shou zhe xie wu pin de ren ， ran hou wo men jiang jin xing jiao yi 。 ran hou ， nin ke yi zai zhe li huo zai ren he yin hang ling qu wu pin yi ji sheng yu de xian jin 。]

english: Sometimes it takes a while to find a matching trade offer. If you change your mind, we'll let you cancel your trade offer, and we'll return your unused items and cash.
translation: 有时需要一段时间才能找到匹配的贸易报价。如果您改变主意，我们将允许您取消交易报价，并退还您未使用的物品和现金。 [you shi xu yao yi duan shi jian cai neng zhao dao pi pei de mao yi bao jia 。 ru guo nin gai bian zhu yi ， wo men jiang yun xu nin qu xiao jiao yi bao jia ， bing tui huan nin wei shi yong de wu pin he xian jin 。]

english: What do I have to do in this room?

english: Have you noticed all the bones around the room? These are teleported here from all over Gielinor to help clean up the landscape of countless bones left behind from combat. What better use for these bones than to convert them to nutritious fruit to be eaten by you mortals? You have to use your Bones to Bananas spell to convert the bones and then place them in the holes on the walls to earn Graveyard Pizazz Points. Unluckily for you, your health will constantly decrease from getting hit by these dropping bones so you will probably want to eat some of the bananas yourself to increase your stay here.
translation: 你注意到房间周围都是骨头了吗？这些人从吉林诺各地传送到这里，帮助清理战斗中留下的无数白骨。对于这些骨头来说，还有什么比将它们转化为有营养的水果供你们凡人食用更好的用途呢？你必须使用骨头到香蕉咒语来转换骨头，然后将它们放入墙上的洞中以获得墓地披萨点。对你来说不幸的是，你的健康状况会因受到这些掉落的骨头的打击而不断下降，所以你可能会想自己吃一些香蕉来增加在这里的停留时间。 [ni zhu yi dao fang jian zhou wei dou shi gu tou le ma ？ zhe xie ren cong ji lin nuo ge di chuan song dao zhe li ， bang zhu qing li zhan dou zhong liu xia de wu shu bai gu 。 dui yu zhe xie gu tou lai shuo ， hai you shen me bi jiang ta men zhuan hua wei you ying yang de shui guo gong ni men fan ren shi yong geng hao de yong tu ne ？ ni bi xu shi yong gu tou dao xiang jiao zhou yu lai zhuan huan gu tou ， ran hou jiang ta men fang ru qiang shang de dong zhong yi huo de mu di pi sa dian 。 dui ni lai shuo bu xing de shi ， ni de jian kang zhuang kuang hui yin shou dao zhe xie diao luo de gu tou de da ji er bu duan xia jiang ， suo yi ni ke neng hui xiang zi ji chi yi xie xiang jiao lai zeng jia zai zhe li de ting liu shi jian 。]

translation: 你将从将骨头变成香蕉咒语中获得经验，当你将香蕉穿过墙壁时，你将获得墓地乐趣点。有时，你还会获得一块符文石，以帮助你将来施展法术。 [ni jiang cong jiang gu tou bian cheng xiang jiao zhou yu zhong huo de jing yan ， dang ni jiang xiang jiao chuan guo qiang bi shi ， ni jiang huo de mu di le qu dian 。 you shi ， ni hai hui huo de yi kuai fu wen shi ， yi bang zhu ni jiang lai shi zhan fa shu 。]

english: Got any tips that may help me?
translation: 有什么建议可以帮助我吗？ [you shen me jian yi ke yi bang zhu wo ma ？]

english: Different bones will provide you with different numbers of bananas, so try to find the best type. Collect enough points and you will be able to buy a 'Bones to Peaches' spell from my fellow guardian above the entrance hall. This spell can be used here just like the bones to bananas spell, except this spell will give you even more experience and the peaches will restore more health!
translation: 不同的骨头会给你提供不同数量的香蕉，所以尽量找到最好的类型。收集足够的积分，你就可以从入口大厅上方我的同伴监护人那里购买“骨头到桃子”咒语。这个法术可以在这里使用，就像骨头到香蕉法术一样，只不过这个法术会给你更多的经验，桃子会恢复更多的生命值！ [bu tong de gu tou hui gei ni ti gong bu tong shu liang de xiang jiao ， suo yi jin liang zhao dao zui hao de lei xing 。 shou ji zu gou de ji fen ， ni jiu ke yi cong ru kou da ting shang fang wo de tong ban jian hu ren na li gou mai “ gu tou dao tao zi ” zhou yu 。 zhe ge fa shu ke yi zai zhe li shi yong ， jiu xiang gu tou dao xiang jiao fa shu yi yang ， zhi bu guo zhe ge fa shu hui gei ni geng duo de jing yan ， tao zi hui hui fu geng duo de sheng ming zhi ！]

english: I see.
translation: 我懂了。 [wo dong le 。]

english: Oh, and a word of warning: should you decide to leave this room by a method other than the exit portals, you will be teleported to the entrance and have any items that you picked up in the room removed.
translation: 哦，还有一句警告：如果你决定通过出口以外的方式离开这个房间，你将被传送到入口，并移除你在房间里捡到的任何物品。 [o ， hai you yi ju jing gao ： ru guo ni jue ding tong guo chu kou yi wai de fang shi li kai zhe ge fang jian ， ni jiang bei chuan song dao ru kou ， bing yi chu ni zai fang jian li jian dao de ren he wu pin 。]

english: Thanks, bye!
translation: 谢谢，再见！ [xie xie ， zai jian ！]

english: Use what you've learned, young one.
translation: 年轻人，运用你所学到的知识。 [nian qing ren ， yun yong ni suo xue dao de zhi shi 。]

english: What do I have to do in this room?
translation: 我必须在这个房间里做什么？ [wo bi xu zai zhe ge fang jian li zuo shen me ？]

english: What are the rewards?
translation: 有什么奖励？ [you shen me jiang li ？]

english: Got any tips that may help me?
translation: 有什么建议可以帮助我吗？ [you shen me jian yi ke yi bang zhu wo ma ？]

english: Thanks, bye!
translation: 谢谢，再见！ [xie xie ， zai jian ！]

english: Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
translation: 呜呜呜呜呜呜 [wu wu wu wu wu wu]

english: You cannot understand the ghost.
translation: 你无法理解鬼魂。 [ni wu fa li jie gui hun 。]

english: Why are you still protesting? I have commanded Necrovarus to let you and your friends do as you like! There's no need for this anymore!
translation: 为什么你还在抗议？我已经命令涅克瓦鲁斯让你和你的朋友们为所欲为！不再需要这个了！ [wei shen me ni hai zai kang yi ？ wo yi jing ming ling nie ke wa lu si rang ni he ni de peng you men wei suo yu wei ！ bu zai xu yao zhe ge le ！]

english: There's always a need for a healthy interest in politics.
translation: 对政治始终需要有健康的兴趣。 [dui zheng zhi shi zhong xu yao you jian kang de xing qu 。]

english: Okay, suit yourself then.
translation: 好吧，那就适合自己吧。 [hao ba ， na jiu shi he zi ji ba 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Shush! I'm concentrating.
translation: 嘘！我正在集中注意力。 [xu ！ wo zheng zai ji zhong zhu yi li 。]

english: Oh, sorry.
translation: 哦，抱歉。 [o ， bao qian 。]

english: Cook, cook, cook!
translation: 做饭，做饭，做饭！ [zuo fan ， zuo fan ， zuo fan ！]

english: I'm so hungry!
translation: 我好饿啊！ [wo hao e a ！]

english: This is gonna taste sooo good
translation: 这味道会很好 [zhe wei dao hui hen hao]

english: Welcome, [Sir/Madam]. I sell only the finest and freshest vegetables!
translation: 欢迎，[先生/女士]。我只卖最好最新鲜的蔬菜！ [huan ying ，[ xian sheng / nv shi ]。 wo zhi mai zui hao zui xin xian de shu cai ！]

english: Welcome, Your Royal Highness. I sell only the finest and freshest vegetables!
translation: 欢迎您，殿下。我只卖最好最新鲜的蔬菜！ [huan ying nin ， dian xia 。 wo zhi mai zui hao zui xin xian de shu cai ！]

english: Hello [Fremennik name]. You've come to the right place for yer greens!
translation: 你好[弗里曼尼克名字]。您来对地方了！ [ni hao [ fu li man ni ke ming zi ]。 nin lai dui di fang le ！]

english: *sigh* Hi there... Happy Easter... I guess...
translation: *叹气*嗨，复活节快乐...我想... [* tan qi * hai ， fu huo jie kuai le ... wo xiang ...]

english: Happy? You don't sound too happy about it?
translation: 快乐的？听起来你对此不太高兴？ [kuai le de ？ ting qi lai ni dui ci bu tai gao xing ？]

english: I'm just tired of Easter, really.
translation: 我只是厌倦了复活节，真的。 [wo zhi shi yan juan le fu huo jie ， zhen de 。]

english: Easter just seems to be about rabbits, so whenever a rabbit shows up all anyone can think of is 'Ooh look at the Easter Rabbit!'.
translation: 复活节似乎就是关于兔子的，所以每当兔子出现时，所有人都会想到“哦，看看复活节兔子！”。 [fu huo jie si hu jiu shi guan yu tu zi de ， suo yi mei dang tu zi chu xian shi ， suo you ren du hui xiang dao “ o ， kan kan fu huo jie tu zi ！”。]

english: I want to go out and explore Gielinor, but nobody takes me seriously enough to let me travel.
translation: 我想出去探索吉利诺，但没有人认真对待我让我旅行。 [wo xiang chu qu tan suo ji li nuo ， dan mei you ren ren zhen dui dai wo rang wo lv xing 。]

english: Meanwhile, all the other holidays have a bunch of cool stuff associated with them so nobody bats an eyelid when a zombie shambles through town.
translation: 与此同时，所有其他节日都有很多很酷的东西与之相关，所以当僵尸在城镇里蹒跚而行时，没有人会眨眼。 [yu ci tong shi ， suo you qi ta jie ri dou you hen duo hen ku de dong xi yu zhi xiang guan ， suo yi dang jiang shi zai cheng zhen li pan shan er xing shi ， mei you ren hui zha yan 。]

english: The goblins even got to keep their stupid sled track from Christmas!
translation: 小妖精们甚至在圣诞节期间还保留了他们愚蠢的雪橇轨道！ [xiao yao jing men shen zhi zai sheng dan jie qi jian hai bao liu le ta men yu chun de xue qiao gui dao ！]

english: That sledding course is pretty fun, actually.
translation: 事实上，那个雪橇课程非常有趣。 [shi shi shang ， na ge xue qiao ke cheng fei chang you qu 。]

english: *sigh* I'm sure it is, human. I tried to go on it myself but the goblins kept mobbing me about Easter eggs.
translation: *叹气*我确定是这样，人类。我试图自己继续下去，但妖精们一直围攻我关于复活节彩蛋的事情。 [* tan qi * wo que ding shi zhe yang ， ren lei 。 wo shi tu zi ji ji xu xia qu ， dan yao jing men yi zhi wei gong wo guan yu fu huo jie cai dan de shi qing 。]

english: I told them they'd have to wait until Easter like everybody else, but they wouldn't have any of it!
translation: 我告诉他们他们必须像其他人一样等到复活节，但他们不会有任何东西！ [wo gao su ta men ta men bi xu xiang qi ta ren yi yang deng dao fu huo jie ， dan ta men bu hui you ren he dong xi ！]

english: I dunno. I just feel like as long as I live, I'm gonna be an advertisement for Easter and nothing more.
translation: 我不知道。我只是觉得只要我还活着，我就会成为复活节的广告，仅此而已。 [wo bu zhi dao 。 wo zhi shi jue de zhi yao wo hai huo zhe ， wo jiu hui cheng wei fu huo jie de guang gao ， jin ci er yi 。]

english: Poor guy. Can't be nice having life's doors slammed in your face all the time.
translation: 可怜的家伙。生活的大门总是在你面前关上，这可不太好。 [ke lian de jia huo 。 sheng huo de da men zong shi zai ni mian qian guan shang ， zhe ke bu tai hao 。]

english: *sigh* Yeah...
translation: *叹气*是的... [* tan qi * shi de ...]

english: ... Wait a second...
translation: ...等一下... [... deng yi xia ...]

english: Doors... Easter.... Doors... East... Doors... Eastdo-
translation: 门...复活节...门...东...门...Eastdo- [men ... fu huo jie ... men ... dong ... men ...Eastdo-]

english: Human! I've got it! Eastdoor!
translation: 人类！我明白了！东门！ [ren lei ！ wo ming bai le ！ dong men ！]

english: ... What?
translation: ... 什么？ [...  shen me ？]

english: Humans only care about rabbits for Easter decorations, right? Well, what if we give these people something else to celebrate with?
translation: 人类只关心兔子作为复活节装饰品，对吗？好吧，如果我们给这些人一些其他的东西来庆祝呢？ [ren lei zhi guan xin tu zi zuo wei fu huo jie zhuang shi pin ， dui ma ？ hao ba ， ru guo wo men gei zhe xie ren yi xie qi ta de dong xi lai qing zhu ne ？]

english: Then you can have your Easter and I can be a rabbit!
translation: 然后你就可以过你的复活节了，我就可以变成一只兔子了！ [ran hou ni jiu ke yi guo ni de fu huo jie le ， wo jiu ke yi bian cheng yi zhi tu zi le ！]

english: And you plan to do this with... doors?
translation: 你打算用……门来做到这一点吗？ [ni da suan yong …… men lai zuo dao zhe yi dian ma ？]

english: Eastdoors!
translation: 东门！ [dong men ！]

english: Joke names aside, are you sure this will work?
translation: 抛开笑话名称不谈，你确定这会起作用吗？ [pao kai xiao hua ming cheng bu tan ， ni que ding zhe hui qi zuo yong ma ？]

english: Well... no, not really.
translation: 嗯...不，不是真的。 [n ... bu ， bu shi zhen de 。]

english: But hey, anything that takes the spotlight off us rabbits can't hurt! Plus, it could be fun!
translation: 但是，嘿，任何能让我们兔子远离聚光灯的东西都不会造成伤害！另外，这可能很有趣！ [dan shi ， hei ， ren he neng rang wo men tu zi yuan li ju guang deng de dong xi dou bu hui zao cheng shang hai ！ ling wai ， zhe ke neng hen you qu ！]

english: What do you say, human? Do you want to help?
translation: 你说什么，人类？你想帮忙吗？ [ni shuo shen me ， ren lei ？ ni xiang bang mang ma ？]

english: ... Oh. Well, I'll be here if you change your mind, I guess.
translation: ... 哦。好吧，我想如果你改变主意我就会在这里。 [...  o 。 hao ba ， wo xiang ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi wo jiu hui zai zhe li 。]

english: Have you changed your mind, human?
translation: 你改变主意了吗，人类？ [ni gai bian zhu yi le ma ， ren lei ？]

english: Eggcellent! This is going to be the best Easter ever! Now, where to start...
translation: 蛋蛋！这将是有史以来最棒的复活节！现在，从哪里开始...... [dan dan ！ zhe jiang shi you shi yi lai zui bang de fu huo jie ！ xian zai ， cong na li kai shi ......]

english: Hmm... all these brown doors aren't particularly Eastery... We should probably start by painting them.
translation: 嗯...所有这些棕色的门都不是特别具有复活节气息...我们可能应该从给它们上漆开始。 [n ... suo you zhe xie zong se de men dou bu shi te bie ju you fu huo jie qi xi ... wo men ke neng ying gai cong gei ta men shang qi kai shi 。]

english: I think I have all of my supplies on me... brushes... pallette... safety goggles...
translation: 我想我所有的用品都在我身上……刷子……调色板……护目镜…… [wo xiang wo suo you de yong pin dou zai wo shen shang …… shua zi …… tiao se ban …… hu mu jing ……]

english: Oh, ghosh darn, I'm fresh out of paint!
translation: 噢，该死，我刚刚没油漆过！ [o ， gai si ， wo gang gang mei you qi guo ！]

english: I think there's a witch nearby who makes dyes. Maybe she has some paint?
translation: 我认为附近有一个制作染料的女巫。也许她有一些油漆？ [wo ren wei fu jin you yi ge zhi zuo ran liao de nv wu 。 ye xu ta you yi xie you qi ？]

english: Couldn't hurt to ask, I guess. If I give you some flowers to use as ingredients, can you ask her for some paint?
translation: 我想问一下也没什么坏处。如果我给你一些花作为原料，你可以向她要一些油漆吗？ [wo xiang wen yi xia ye mei shen me huai chu 。 ru guo wo gei ni yi xie hua zuo wei yuan liao ， ni ke yi xiang ta yao yi xie you qi ma ？]

english: I'll speak to Aggie, give me the ingredients.
translation: 我会和阿吉说话，给我原料。 [wo hui he a ji shuo hua ， gei wo yuan liao 。]

english: Hmm... Human, I don't think you have enough room in your pockets for more things.
translation: 嗯...人类，我认为你的口袋里没有足够的空间容纳更多的东西。 [n ... ren lei ， wo ren wei ni de kou dai li mei you zu gou de kong jian rong na geng duo de dong xi 。]

english: There's a Bank just south down the road. You can go there to drop off a few items if you want to make space.
translation: 沿着路往南走就有一家银行。如果您想腾出空间，可以去那里放下一些物品。 [yan zhe lu wang nan zou jiu you yi jia yin hang 。 ru guo nin xiang teng chu kong jian ， ke yi qu na li fang xia yi xie wu pin 。]

english: Bank? I've never been so insulted in my entire life!
translation: 银行？我这辈子从来没有受过这样的侮辱！ [yin hang ？ wo zhe bei zi cong lai mei you shou guo zhe yang de wu ru ！]

english: Gregg hands you a bunch of pastel-coloured flowers and an IOU for 5 coins.
translation: 格雷格递给你一束柔和颜色的鲜花和一张 5 个硬币的欠条。 [ge lei ge di gei ni yi shu rou he yan se de xian hua he yi zhang  5  ge ying bi de qian tiao 。]

english: This is... a piece of paper?
translation: 这是……一张纸？ [zhe shi …… yi zhang zhi ？]

english: It's an IOU. We rabbits don't usually carry cash on us, I'm afraid.
translation: 这是一张欠条。恐怕我们兔子一般不带现金。 [zhe shi yi zhang qian tiao 。 kong pa wo men tu zi yi ban bu dai xian jin 。]

english: If you have the ingredients on you, why not go ask her yourself?
translation: 如果你身上有原料，为什么不亲自去问她呢？ [ru guo ni shen shang you yuan liao ， wei shen me bu qin zi qu wen ta ne ？]

english: I... Human, I honestly don't think I could stomach going.
translation: 我……人类，老实说我觉得我无法忍受。 [wo …… ren lei ， lao shi shuo wo jue de wo wu fa ren shou 。]

english: Witches aren't that scary. I'm sure Aggie is lovely once you get to know her.
translation: 女巫并没有那么可怕。我确信一旦你了解了阿吉，她就会很可爱。 [nv wu bing mei you na me ke pa 。 wo que xin yi dan ni liao jie le a ji ， ta jiu hui hen ke ai 。]

english: It's not that, it's... I just don't want to be ridiculed for being an Easter bunny.
translation: 不是那个，而是……我只是不想因为是复活节兔子而被嘲笑。 [bu shi na ge ， er shi …… wo zhi shi bu xiang yin wei shi fu huo jie tu zi er bei chao xiao 。]

english: I've put up with being the 'cute widdle wabbit' my whole life. I don't think I can take much more of it.
translation: 我一生都在忍受“可爱的野兔”的生活。我不认为我能承受更多。 [wo yi sheng dou zai ren shou “ ke ai de ye tu ” de sheng huo 。 wo bu ren wei wo neng cheng shou geng duo 。]

english: Poor guy.
translation: 可怜的家伙。 [ke lian de jia huo 。]

english: So, uh... what am I meant to be doing again?
translation: 那么，呃...我又该做什么呢？ [na me ， e ... wo you gai zuo shen me ne ？]

english: You've forgotten already? Silly human!
translation: 你已经忘记了吗？愚蠢的人类！ [ni yi jing wang ji le ma ？ yu chun de ren lei ！]

english: You were about to take some ingredients off me to give to the nice dye-making witch in exchange for some paint!
translation: 你正要从我身上拿走一些原料，送给漂亮的染料女巫，以换取一些油漆！ [ni zheng yao cong wo shen shang na zou yi xie yuan liao ， song gei piao liang de ran liao nv wu ， yi huan qu yi xie you qi ！]

english: You were about to take the ingredients from me to that nice dye-making witch in the house down that alley behind the wheelbarrow!
translation: 你正要把我的原料带到独轮车后面那条小巷里房子里那个漂亮的染料制造女巫那里！ [ni zheng yao ba wo de yuan liao dai dao du lun che hou mian na tiao xiao xiang li fang zi li na ge piao liang de ran liao zhi zao nv wu na li ！]

english: We were going to use it to decorate some doors in the spirit of Easter so people associate it less with rabbits!
translation: 我们打算用它来装饰一些具有复活节精神的门，这样人们就不会把它与兔子联系起来！ [wo men da suan yong ta lai zhuang shi yi xie ju you fu huo jie jing shen de men ， zhe yang ren men jiu bu hui ba ta yu tu zi lian xi qi lai ！]

english: This seems... awfully convoluted.
translation: 这看起来……非常复杂。 [zhe kan qi lai …… fei chang fu za 。]

english: Yep!
translation: 是的！ [shi de ！]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: So long, human! I'll be here if you need anything.
translation: 再见，人类！如果你需要什么我就在这里。 [zai jian ， ren lei ！ ru guo ni xu yao shen me wo jiu zai zhe li 。]

english: I do, but you'd need to make more space in your pockets first.
translation: 我愿意，但你需要先在口袋里腾出更多空间。 [wo yuan yi ， dan ni xu yao xian zai kou dai li teng chu geng duo kong jian 。]

english: I can give you more flowers, but you'd need to make more space in your pockets first.
translation: 我可以给你更多的花，但你得先在口袋里腾出更多空间。 [wo ke yi gei ni geng duo de hua ， dan ni de xian zai kou dai li teng chu geng duo kong jian 。]

english: I can give you another IOU, but you'd need to make more space in your pockets first.
translation: 我可以再给你一张欠条，但你得先在口袋里腾出更多空间。 [wo ke yi zai gei ni yi zhang qian tiao ， dan ni de xian zai kou dai li teng chu geng duo kong jian 。]

english: Gregg quickly scratches up a new IOU for 5 coins.
translation: 格雷格很快就刮开了一张新的 5 个硬币的欠条。 [ge lei ge hen kuai jiu gua kai le yi zhang xin de  5  ge ying bi de qian tiao 。]

english: Gregg hands you another bunch of pastel-coloured flowers.
translation: 格雷格递给你另一束柔和颜色的花朵。 [ge lei ge di gei ni ling yi shu rou he yan se de hua duo 。]

english: Gregg hands you another bunch of pastel-coloured flowers and an IOU for 5 coins.
translation: 格雷格递给你另一束柔和颜色的鲜花和一张 5 个硬币的欠条。 [ge lei ge di gei ni ling yi shu rou he yan se de xian hua he yi zhang  5  ge ying bi de qian tiao 。]

english: Try not to lose these ones. If people find my IOUs, I'm gonna have quite the bill to pay!
translation: 尽量不要丢失这些。如果人们找到了我的欠条，我就得付一大笔钱了！ [jin liang bu yao diu shi zhe xie 。 ru guo ren men zhao dao le wo de qian tiao ， wo jiu de fu yi da bi qian le ！]

english: Silly human! You have the ingredients on you already!
translation: 愚蠢的人类！配料你已经准备好了！ [yu chun de ren lei ！ pei liao ni yi jing zhun bei hao le ！]

english: You need to take them to the witch who makes dyes you mentioned. Aggie, I think her name.
translation: 你需要把它们带到你提到的制造染料的女巫那里。阿吉，我想她的名字。 [ni xu yao ba ta men dai dao ni ti dao de zhi zao ran liao de nv wu na li 。 a ji ， wo xiang ta de ming zi 。]

english: I just thought you might like more than one load of paint.
translation: 我只是觉得你可能喜欢不止一批油漆。 [wo zhi shi jue de ni ke neng xi huan bu zhi yi pi you qi 。]

english: Hmmm... maybe, but let's get one first and see how we get on.
translation: 嗯……也许吧，但我们先买一个，看看进展如何。 [n …… ye xu ba ， dan wo men xian mai yi ge ， kan kan jin zhan ru he 。]

english: Silly human, you're meant to give that to the nice witch down the road, not me!
translation: 愚蠢的人类，你应该把它交给路上的好女巫，而不是我！ [yu chun de ren lei ， ni ying gai ba ta jiao gei lu shang de hao nv wu ， er bu shi wo ！]

english: Could I have some coins instead?
translation: 可以给我一些硬币吗？ [ke yi gei wo yi xie ying bi ma ？]

english: Human, if I had coins to give you, I wouldn't have given you an IOU in the first place!
translation: 人类啊，我要是有硬币给你，我就不会给你欠条了！ [ren lei a ， wo yao shi you ying bi gei ni ， wo jiu bu hui gei ni qian tiao le ！]

english: Which witch, sorry?
translation: 抱歉，哪个女巫？ [bao qian ， na ge nv wu ？]

english: I think she's just down that street there, in the house with the wheelbarrow in front of it.
translation: 我想她就在那条街上，在房子里，前面放着独轮手推车。 [wo xiang ta jiu zai na tiao jie shang ， zai fang zi li ， qian mian fang zhe du lun shou tui che 。]

english: Gregg, I have something we can use as paint!
translation: 格雷格，我有一些可以用作油漆的东西！ [ge lei ge ， wo you yi xie ke yi yong zuo you qi de dong xi ！]

english: Really? Let me see!
translation: 真的吗？让我看看！ [zhen de ma ？ rang wo kan kan ！]

english: Wait... gah, I could have sworn I had it on me!
translation: 等等……啊，我可以发誓我带着它！ [deng deng …… a ， wo ke yi fa shi wo dai zhe ta ！]

english: Maybe Aggie knows where it is? You should ask her.
translation: 也许阿吉知道它在哪里？你应该问她。 [ye xu a ji zhi dao ta zai na li ？ ni ying gai wen ta 。]

english: You give Gregg the thickened dye.
translation: 你给格雷格加了浓稠的染料。 [ni gei ge lei ge jia le nong chou de ran liao 。]

english: Oh! Human, this is perfect!
translation: 哦！人类，这太完美了！ [o ！ ren lei ， zhe tai wan mei le ！]

english: Now we just need a door to paint...
translation: 现在我们只需要一扇门来画...... [xian zai wo men zhi xu yao yi shan men lai hua ......]

english: There's one right there. Maybe we can use it?
translation: 那里就有一个。也许我们可以使用它？ [na li jiu you yi ge 。 ye xu wo men ke yi shi yong ta ？]

english: Do you think the owner will mind?
translation: 你觉得楼主会介意吗？ [ni jue de lou zhu hui jie yi ma ？]

english: I've worked with Ned in the past; he's a nice guy. I'm sure he won't mind.
translation: 我过去曾与内德共事过；他是个好人。我确信他不会介意。 [wo guo qu ceng yu nei de gong shi guo ； ta shi ge hao ren 。 wo que xin ta bu hui jie yi 。]

english: Aggie mentioned people in Draynor could use some cheer. I'm sure he won't mind.
translation: 阿吉提到德雷诺的人们需要一些欢呼。我确信他不会介意。 [a ji ti dao de lei nuo de ren men xu yao yi xie huan hu 。 wo que xin ta bu hui jie yi 。]

english: Let me get my brushes and...
translation: 让我拿起我的刷子然后... [rang wo na qi wo de shua zi ran hou ...]

english: The camera fades to black. Sounds of painting are heard. The camera fades back in, and Ned's house door is painted cyan.
translation: 相机逐渐变黑。可以听到绘画的声音。镜头逐渐拉近，内德的门被漆成青色。 [xiang ji zhu jian bian hei 。 ke yi ting dao hui hua de sheng yin 。 jing tou zhu jian la jin ， nei de de men bei qi cheng qing se 。]

english: The Cook can now be asked about the Easter event.
translation: 现在可以向厨师询问有关复活节事件的信息。 [xian zai ke yi xiang chu shi xun wen you guan fu huo jie shi jian de xin xi 。]

english: I don't mean to be a critic, but I had imagined it looking more... inspired.
translation: 我无意成为批评家，但我想象它看起来更......受到启发。 [wo wu yi cheng wei pi ping jia ， dan wo xiang xiang ta kan qi lai geng ...... shou dao qi fa 。]

english: Maybe if I had more colours...
translation: 也许如果我有更多的颜色...... [ye xu ru guo wo you geng duo de yan se ......]

english: Well, Aggie only mentioned the one colour of dye so we're stuck there.
translation: 好吧，阿吉只提到了一种颜色的染料，所以我们被困在那里。 [hao ba ， a ji zhi ti dao le yi zhong yan se de ran liao ， suo yi wo men bei kun zai na li 。]

english: Blast! Looks like there's only one thing for it, then.
translation: 爆炸！那么看来只有一件事了。 [bao zha ！ na me kan lai zhi you yi jian shi le 。]

english: What's that?
translation: 那是什么？ [na shi shen me ？]

english: We'll just have to decorate it ourselves! But first, we need something to decorate it with.
translation: 我们只需要自己装饰它！但首先，我们需要一些东西来装饰它。 [wo men zhi xu yao zi ji zhuang shi ta ！ dan shou xian ， wo men xu yao yi xie dong xi lai zhuang shi ta 。]

english: You humans like Easter eggs, don't you? Do you know where we could get some good eggs?
translation: 你们人类喜欢复活节彩蛋，不是吗？你知道哪里可以买到好鸡蛋吗？ [ni men ren lei xi huan fu huo jie cai dan ， bu shi ma ？ ni zhi dao na li ke yi mai dao hao ji dan ma ？]

english: Hmm... I don't, but I think I might know someone who does.
translation: 嗯...我不知道，但我想我可能认识一个这样做的人。 [n ... wo bu zhi dao ， dan wo xiang wo ke neng ren shi yi ge zhe yang zuo de ren 。]

english: There's a Cook in Lumbridge that everyone gives eggs to. He's bound to have some fancy eggs for us.
translation: 伦布里奇有一位厨师，每个人都给他鸡蛋。他一定会给我们一些精美的鸡蛋。 [lun bu li qi you yi wei chu shi ， mei ge ren dou gei ta ji dan 。 ta yi ding hui gei wo men yi xie jing mei de ji dan 。]

english: Sounds great! I can either teleport us there now, or I can meet you there if you'd prefer.
translation: 听起来很棒！我现在可以将我们传送到那里，或者如果你愿意的话我可以在那里见到你。 [ting qi lai hen bang ！ wo xian zai ke yi jiang wo men chuan song dao na li ， huo zhe ru guo ni yuan yi de hua wo ke yi zai na li jian dao ni 。]

english: Gregg can now be found at the kitchen, and the Cook talks sense again.
translation: 现在可以在厨房找到格雷格，厨师又讲道理了。 [xian zai ke yi zai chu fang zhao dao ge lei ge ， chu shi you jiang dao li le 。]

english: Ok! Hold on to your hat!
translation: 好的！抓紧你的帽子！ [hao de ！ zhua jin ni de mao zi ！]

english: But I'm not wearing a...
translation: 但我没穿... [dan wo mei chuan ...]

english: The player is seen casting an uninterruptable self-teleport (not tele-other by the rabbit) behind the Lumbridge castle (location in proximity of 3201, 3214, 0).
translation: 可以看到玩家在朗布里奇城堡（位置靠近 3201, 3214, 0）后面施放不间断的自我传送（不是兔子的远程传送）。 [ke yi kan dao wan jia zai lang bu li qi cheng bao （ wei zhi kao jin  3201, 3214, 0） hou mian shi fang bu jian duan de zi wo chuan song （ bu shi tu zi de yuan cheng chuan song ）。]

english: ... hat!
translation: ...帽子！ [... mao zi ！]

english: The player is seen casting an uninterruptable self-teleport (not tele-other by the rabbit) behind the Lumbridge castle (location in proximity of 3201, 3215, 0).
translation: 可以看到玩家在朗布里奇城堡（位置靠近 3201, 3215, 0）后面施放不间断的自我传送（不是兔子的远程传送）。 [ke yi kan dao wan jia zai lang bu li qi cheng bao （ wei zhi kao jin  3201, 3215, 0） hou mian shi fang bu jian duan de zi wo chuan song （ bu shi tu zi de yuan cheng chuan song ）。]

english: Ok! I'm gonna hang around here for a little bit, so come talk to me if you change your mind. Otherwise, I'll see you there!
translation: 好的！我会在这里待一会儿，所以如果你改变主意的话可以跟我谈谈。不然的话，我就在那里见！ [hao de ！ wo hui zai zhe li dai yi hui er ， suo yi ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi de hua ke yi gen wo tan tan 。 bu ran de hua ， wo jiu zai na li jian ！]

english: Have you changed your mind about teleporting to Lumbridge with me?
translation: 你改变主意要和我一起传送到朗布里奇了吗？ [ni gai bian zhu yi yao he wo yi qi chuan song dao lang bu li qi le ma ？]

english: Wait, you're a rabbit. How can you even teleport?
translation: 等等，你是一只兔子。你怎么能传送？ [deng deng ， ni shi yi zhi tu zi 。 ni zen me neng chuan song ？]

english: Well, you're a human. How can you teleport?
translation: 好吧，你是一个人。你怎么能传送？ [hao ba ， ni shi yi ge ren 。 ni zen me neng chuan song ？]

english: I just use magic.
translation: 我只是使用魔法。 [wo zhi shi shi yong mo fa 。]

english: And rabbits can't use magic?
translation: 兔子不能使用魔法？ [tu zi bu neng shi yong mo fa ？]

english: I didn't know rabbits could use magic!
translation: 我不知道兔子会使用魔法！ [wo bu zhi dao tu zi hui shi yong mo fa ！]

english: Of course we can! How else do you think we make Easter happen each year?
translation: 我们当然可以！您认为我们每年如何举办复活节？ [wo men dang ran ke yi ！ nin ren wei wo men mei nian ru he ju ban fu huo jie ？]

english: You make a good point...
translation: 你说得很好... [ni shuo de hen hao ...]

english: We were about to go to Lumbridge to speak to a Cook there who has a lot of eggs!
translation: 我们正要去伦布里奇和那里有很多鸡蛋的厨师交谈！ [wo men zheng yao qu lun bu li qi he na li you hen duo ji dan de chu shi jiao tan ！]

english: We were going to use them to decorate some doors in the spirit of Easter so people associate it less with rabbits!
translation: 我们打算用它们来装饰一些具有复活节精神的门，这样人们就不会把它与兔子联系起来！ [wo men da suan yong ta men lai zhuang shi yi xie ju you fu huo jie jing shen de men ， zhe yang ren men jiu bu hui ba ta yu tu zi lian xi qi lai ！]

english: So long, human! I'll be here a little while longer if you want a teleport. Otherwise I'll see you in Lumbridge!
translation: 再见，人类！如果你想要传送的话我会在这里多呆一会儿。否则我会在伦布里奇见到你！ [zai jian ， ren lei ！ ru guo ni xiang yao chuan song de hua wo hui zai zhe li duo dai yi hui er 。 fou ze wo hui zai lun bu li qi jian dao ni ！]

english: Hello human!
translation: 你好人类！ [ni hao ren lei ！]

english: Wait, aren't I supposed to be meeting you somewhere else?
translation: 等等，我不是应该在别的地方遇见你吗？ [deng deng ， wo bu shi ying gai zai bie de di fang yu jian ni ma ？]

english: Yep! But I'm taking a bit of a break, and it would appear you are too, human!
translation: 是的！但我要休息一下，看来你也是人类！ [shi de ！ dan wo yao xiu xi yi xia ， kan lai ni ye shi ren lei ！]

english: Can you remind me where I'm meant to be meeting you?
translation: 你能提醒我在哪里和你见面吗？ [ni neng ti xing wo zai na li he ni jian mian ma ？]

english: I think we were going to the Lumbridge Kitchens to talk to a cook about some eggs.
translation: 我想我们要去伦布里奇厨房和厨师谈论一些鸡蛋。 [wo xiang wo men yao qu lun bu li qi chu fang he chu shi tan lun yi xie ji dan 。]

english: Oh, what a cute bunny! I didn't realize it was Easter already!
translation: 噢，多么可爱的小兔子啊！没想到已经是复活节了！ [o ， duo me ke ai de xiao tu zi a ！ mei xiang dao yi jing shi fu huo jie le ！]

english: Cute?! I'll give you cute! I'll...
translation: 可爱的？！我给你可爱！患病的... [ke ai de ？！ wo gei ni ke ai ！ huan bing de ...]

english: *AHEM*
translation: *咳咳* [* hai hai *]

english: Sorry.
translation: 对不起。 [dui bu qi 。]

english: Cook, we're looking for some fancy eggs that we can use as decorations. You wouldn't happen to have anything, would you?
translation: 库克，我们正在寻找一些精美的鸡蛋，可以用作装饰。你不会碰巧什么都没有吧？ [ku ke ， wo men zheng zai xun zhao yi xie jing mei de ji dan ， ke yi yong zuo zhuang shi 。 ni bu hui peng qiao shen me dou mei you ba ？]

english: Hmm... Well, I do have a large collection of eggs, but most of them are regular old chicken eggs for making cakes.
translation: 嗯……嗯，我确实收集了大量的鸡蛋，但其中大部分都是用来做蛋糕的普通老鸡蛋。 [n …… n ， wo que shi shou ji le da liang de ji dan ， dan qi zhong da bu fen dou shi yong lai zuo dan gao de pu tong lao ji dan 。]

english: Though come to think of it, I might have something...
translation: 不过仔细想想，我可能有一些东西...... [bu guo zi xi xiang xiang ， wo ke neng you yi xie dong xi ......]

english: Go on...
translation: 继续... [ji xu ...]

english: I have a... 'special' collection of eggs that I keep in the... well... back of my cupboards for very... 'special' occasions.
translation: 我有一个……“特殊”的鸡蛋收藏，我把它们放在……呃……我的橱柜后面，以备非常……“特殊”的场合使用。 [wo you yi ge ……“ te shu ” de ji dan shou cang ， wo ba ta men fang zai …… e …… wo de chu gui hou mian ， yi bei fei chang ……“ te shu ” de chang he shi yong 。]

english: I don't know if this occasion is special enough, though.
