translation: 但我不知道这个场合是否足够特别。 [dan wo bu zhi dao zhe ge chang he shi fou zu gou te bie 。]

english: Hey! I'll have you know Easter is a very special occasion!
translation: 嘿！我会让你知道复活节是一个非常特别的时刻！ [hei ！ wo hui rang ni zhi dao fu huo jie shi yi ge fei chang te bie de shi ke ！]

english: Well, that's me convinced! Let me dig them out for you!
translation: 嗯，这就是我所确信的！让我给你挖出来吧！ [n ， zhe jiu shi wo suo que xin de ！ rang wo gei ni wa chu lai ba ！]

english: The Cook digs around the back of his cupboards and produces several colourful eggs, giving them to Gregg.
translation: 厨师在他的橱柜后面挖了挖，挖出了几个彩色的鸡蛋，把它们交给了格雷格。 [chu shi zai ta de chu gui hou mian wa le wa ， wa chu le ji ge cai se de ji dan ， ba ta men jiao gei le ge lei ge 。]

english: Ooh! These are perfect! Thanks a lot!
translation: 哦！这些太完美了！多谢！ [o ！ zhe xie tai wan mei le ！ duo xie ！]

english: Don't mention it!
translation: 别提了！ [bie ti le ！]

english: Seriously, don't mention it.
translation: 说真的，别提了。 [shuo zhen de ， bie ti le 。]

english: Well, we have some eggs now. What's next?
translation: 好吧，我们现在有一些鸡蛋了。接下来怎么办？ [hao ba ， wo men xian zai you yi xie ji dan le 。 jie xia lai zen me ban ？]

english: Hmm... I think some nice fluffy wool could look quite nice...
translation: 嗯...我觉得一些漂亮的蓬松羊毛看起来会很漂亮... [n ... wo jue de yi xie piao liang de peng song yang mao kan qi lai hui hen piao liang ...]

english: There's a sheep pen not too far north of here. You could get some fresh wool if you wanted.
translation: 离这里北面不远有一个羊圈。如果你愿意的话，你可以买一些新鲜的羊毛。 [li zhe li bei mian bu yuan you yi ge yang juan 。 ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， ni ke yi mai yi xie xin xian de yang mao 。]

english: That sounds perfect! I'll meet you there, human!
translation: 听起来很完美！我会在那里见到你，人类！ [ting qi lai hen wan mei ！ wo hui zai na li jian dao ni ， ren lei ！]

english: Gregg can now be found in the sheep pen north of Lumbridge.
translation: 现在可以在朗布里奇北部的羊圈中找到格雷格。 [xian zai ke yi zai lang bu li qi bei bu de yang juan zhong zhao dao ge lei ge 。]

english: Yes, go to the sheep pen and out of my kitchen...
translation: 是的，去羊圈，然后离开我的厨房…… [shi de ， qu yang juan ， ran hou li kai wo de chu fang ……]

english: Oh, you're still here.
translation: 哦，你还在这里。 [o ， ni hai zai zhe li 。]

english: Yep! Just passing the time, you know!
translation: 是的！只是打发时间而已，你懂的！ [shi de ！ zhi shi da fa shi jian er yi ， ni dong de ！]

english: Didn't you say you were off to the sheep pen north of here?
translation: 你不是说要去北面的羊圈吗？ [ni bu shi shuo yao qu bei mian de yang juan ma ？]

english: We're not in a hurry. The sheep are in a pen, so it's not like they can go anywhere.
translation: 我们不着急。羊被关在围栏里，所以它们哪儿也去不了。 [wo men bu zhao ji 。 yang bei guan zai wei lan li ， suo yi ta men na er ye qu bu liao 。]

english: Actually, while you're still here, there's something else you can do.
translation: 事实上，当你还在这里的时候，你还可以做点别的事情。 [shi shi shang ， dang ni hai zai zhe li de shi hou ， ni hai ke yi zuo dian bie de shi qing 。]

english: It's the Duke's birthday soon, and I'm running low on ingredients.
translation: 马上就要到公爵的生日了，我的食材快用完了。 [ma shang jiu yao dao gong jue de sheng ri le ， wo de shi cai kuai yong wan le 。]

english: I think we were going to the sheep pen north of Lumbridge to get some wool.
translation: 我想我们是要去朗布里奇以北的羊圈去取一些羊毛。 [wo xiang wo men shi yao qu lang bu li qi yi bei de yang juan qu qu yi xie yang mao 。]

english: Human, what is that?
translation: 人类，那是什么？ [ren lei ， na shi shen me ？]

english: Gregg can no longer be found at the kitchen.
translation: 厨房里再也找不到格雷格了。 [chu fang li zai ye zhao bu dao ge lei ge le 。]

english: That's a sheep.
translation: 那是一只羊。 [na shi yi zhi yang 。]

english: I know what a sheep is, human!
translation: 我知道什么是羊，人类！ [wo zhi dao shen me shi yang ， ren lei ！]

english: But what is that thing doing in the middle of all of them?
translation: 但是那个东西在他们中间做什么呢？ [dan shi na ge dong xi zai ta men zhong jian zuo shen me ne ？]

english: Hm?
That's clearly just two penguins in a sheep costume!
translation: 那显然只是两只穿着羊服装的企鹅！ [na xian ran zhi shi liang zhi chuan zhe yang fu zhuang de qi e ！]

english: Hmm... I'm not entirely sure why that's there.
translation: 嗯...我不完全确定为什么会在那里。 [n ... wo bu wan quan que ding wei shen me hui zai na li 。]

english: Do you think the farmer knows about it?
translation: 你认为农民知道这件事吗？ [ni ren wei nong min zhi dao zhe jian shi ma ？]

english: I'd hope so, maybe I'll ask him about it later.
translation: 我希望如此，也许我稍后会问他这件事。 [wo xi wang ru ci ， ye xu wo shao hou hui wen ta zhe jian shi 。]

english: Oh, that's The Thing.
translation: 哦，那就是那个东西。 [o ， na jiu shi na ge dong xi 。]

english: We've tried explaining this to Fred the Farmer, but he thinks it's some kind of chicken-eating shapeshifting demon.
translation: 我们试图向农民弗雷德解释这一点，但他认为这是某种吃鸡的变形恶魔。 [wo men shi tu xiang nong min fu lei de jie shi zhe yi dian ， dan ta ren wei zhe shi mou zhong chi ji de bian xing e mo 。]

english: The man won't shear his own sheep!
translation: 这个人不会给自己剪羊毛的！ [zhe ge ren bu hui gei zi ji jian yang mao de ！]

english: Really? Who shears them for him?
translation: 真的吗？谁帮他剪毛？ [zhen de ma ？ shui bang ta jian mao ？]

english: Whichever advernturerswalk by that he can talk into doing it.
translation: 无论哪个冒险者路过，他都可以说服他去做。 [wu lun na ge mao xian zhe lu guo ， ta dou ke yi shuo fu ta qu zuo 。]

english: That would include you, I guess?
translation: 我猜这其中也包括你吧？ [wo cai zhe qi zhong ye bao kuo ni ba ？]

english: ... Yes.
translation: ... 是的。 [...  shi de 。]

english: Those agents are still there...?
translation: 那些特工还在吗……？ [na xie te gong hai zai ma ……？]

english: You know them?
translation: 你认识他们吗？ [ni ren shi ta men ma ？]

english: They're KGP agents sent from the Iceberg to collect information on Farmer Fred and his sheep.
translation: 他们是 KGP 特工，从冰山派来收集有关农夫弗雷德和他的羊的信息。 [ta men shi  KGP  te gong ， cong bing shan pai lai shou ji you guan nong fu fu lei de he ta de yang de xin xi 。]

english: Why would penguins need to spy on sheep?
translation: 为什么企鹅需要监视绵羊？ [wei shen me qi e xu yao jian shi mian yang ？]

english: They thought the sheep were also secret agents placed to stop them taking over Gielinor.
translation: 他们认为这些羊也是特工，被派来阻止他们占领吉利诺。 [ta men ren wei zhe xie yang ye shi te gong ， bei pai lai zu zhi ta men zhan ling ji li nuo 。]

english: Penguins are trying to take over Gielinor?
translation: 企鹅正试图接管吉利诺？ [qi e zheng shi tu jie guan ji li nuo ？]

english: Yeah, they have war machines built up and everything.
translation: 是的，他们建造了战争机器等等。 [shi de ， ta men jian zao le zhan zheng ji qi deng deng 。]

english: ... Human, are you feeling alright?
translation: ……人类，你感觉还好吗？ […… ren lei ， ni gan jue hai hao ma ？]

english: Never felt better, actually.
translation: 事实上，从来没有感觉更好过。 [shi shi shang ， cong lai mei you gan jue geng hao guo 。]

english: Well, anyway, we need to get some wool. I think three pieces would be enough.
translation: 好吧，无论如何，我们需要一些羊毛。我觉得三块就够了。 [hao ba ， wu lun ru he ， wo men xu yao yi xie yang mao 。 wo jue de san kuai jiu gou le 。]

english: I tried to get it myself but these shears aren't really designed with rabbits in mind.
translation: 我试着自己去拿，但这些剪刀并不是真正为兔子设计的。 [wo shi zhe zi ji qu na ， dan zhe xie jian dao bing bu shi zhen zheng wei tu zi she ji de 。]

english: I could shear the sheep for you if you'd like?
translation: 如果你愿意的话我可以帮你剪羊毛？ [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua wo ke yi bang ni jian yang mao ？]

english: Oh, thank you so much human!
translation: 噢，非常感谢人类！ [o ， fei chang gan xie ren lei ！]

english: I'd give you these shears but you appear to be a little overloaded.
translation: 我会给你这些剪刀，但你似乎有点超载了。 [wo hui gei ni zhe xie jian dao ， dan ni si hu you dian chao zai le 。]

english: If you don't mind running back to Lumbridge Castle, there should be a Bank on the top floor for you to put your stuff away!
translation: 如果你不介意跑回朗布里奇城堡，顶楼应该有一家银行供你存放东西！ [ru guo ni bu jie yi pao hui lang bu li qi cheng bao ， ding lou ying gai you yi jia yin hang gong ni cun fang dong xi ！]

english: I've gotten this far without those good-for-nothing bankers, thank you very much!
translation: 我能走到这一步，离不开那些无用的银行家，非常感谢你们！ [wo neng zou dao zhe yi bu ， li bu kai na xie wu yong de yin hang jia ， fei chang gan xie ni men ！]

english: Gregg hands you a pair of shears.
translation: 格雷格递给你一把剪刀。 [ge lei ge di gei ni yi ba jian dao 。]

english: I see you brought your own shears. Wonderful!
translation: 我看到你带了自己的剪刀。精彩的！ [wo kan dao ni dai le zi ji de jian dao 。 jing cai de ！]

english: You know how to shear sheep, right human? You just walk up to them and give them a good snip!
translation: 你知道怎么剪羊毛吗，对吗？你只要走到他们面前，好好地剪一剪！ [ni zhi dao zen me jian yang mao ma ， dui ma ？ ni zhi yao zou dao ta men mian qian ， hao hao di jian yi jian ！]

english: Just be careful - I'm fairly sure there's a ram in here and he might not appreciate it so much.
translation: 请小心——我相当确定这里有一只公羊，但他可能不会那么欣赏它。 [qing xiao xin —— wo xiang dang que ding zhe li you yi zhi gong yang ， dan ta ke neng bu hui na me xin shang ta 。]

english: Oh, you'll also want to make yourself some inventory space to keep the wool in. I think there's a Bank at the top of Lumbridge Castle.
translation: 哦，你还需要给自己留一些库存空间来存放羊毛。我认为朗布里奇城堡的顶部有一家银行。 [o ， ni hai xu yao gei zi ji liu yi xie ku cun kong jian lai cun fang yang mao 。 wo ren wei lang bu li qi cheng bao de ding bu you yi jia yin hang 。]

english: I'm very aware of the state of my inventory, thank you.
translation: 我非常清楚我的库存状况，谢谢。 [wo fei chang qing chu wo de ku cun zhuang kuang ， xie xie 。]

english: Could I have some shears, please?
translation: 请给我一些剪刀好吗？ [qing gei wo yi xie jian dao hao ma ？]

english: Gregg hands you another pair of shears.
translation: 格雷格递给你另一把剪刀。 [ge lei ge di gei ni ling yi ba jian dao 。]

english: It's a good thing I grabbed a bunch of these before I headed out!
translation: 还好我在出发前买了一堆这样的东西！ [hai hao wo zai chu fa qian mai le yi dui zhe yang de dong xi ！]

english: How are you doing?
translation: 你好吗？ [ni hao ma ？]

english: Pretty good, human. How are you?
translation: 很好，人类。你好吗？ [hen hao ， ren lei 。 ni hao ma ？]

english: Not too bad, actually.
translation: 事实上，还不错。 [shi shi shang ， hai bu cuo 。]

english: This isn't the best conversation ever, I have to say.
translation: 我不得不说，这不是最好的谈话。 [wo bu de bu shuo ， zhe bu shi zui hao de tan hua 。]

english: I'm gonna go back to sheep shearing.
translation: 我要回去剪羊毛了。 [wo yao hui qu jian yang mao le 。]

english: I think that's wise, human.
translation: 我认为这是明智的，人类。 [wo ren wei zhe shi ming zhi de ， ren lei 。]

english: Your hint is; you had some shears, and we're stood inside a sheep pen.
translation: 你的提示是；你有一把剪刀，我们站在羊圈里。 [ni de ti shi shi ； ni you yi ba jian dao ， wo men zhan zai yang juan li 。]

english: So... I should be shearing some sheep?
translation: 那么……我应该剪一些羊毛吗？ [na me …… wo ying gai jian yi xie yang mao ma ？]

english: Yep! Bring me the wool after you're done! We need [3/2/1] more piece[s]!
translation: 是的！完成后把羊毛给我拿来！我们还需要 [3/2/1] 块！ [shi de ！ wan cheng hou ba yang mao gei wo na lai ！ wo men hai xu yao  [3/2/1]  kuai ！]

english: Your hint is; you have some shears, and we're stood inside a sheep pen.
translation: 你的提示是；你有一些剪刀，我们站在羊圈里。 [ni de ti shi shi ； ni you yi xie jian dao ， wo men zhan zai yang juan li 。]

english: Speak to you soon, human!
translation: 很快就和你说话了，人类！ [hen kuai jiu he ni shuo hua le ， ren lei ！]

english: Human, I don't think that wool is fresh.
translation: 人类，我认为羊毛不新鲜。 [ren lei ， wo ren wei yang mao bu xin xian 。]

english: Does it matter?
translation: 有关系吗？ [you guan xi ma ？]

english: Of course it matters! Everybody knows fresh wool is softer and shinier!
translation: 当然重要！大家都知道新鲜的羊毛更柔软、更闪亮！ [dang ran zhong yao ！ da jia dou zhi dao xin xian de yang mao geng rou ruan 、 geng shan liang ！]

english: I didn't know that!
translation: 我不知道！ [wo bu zhi dao ！]

english: Well, now you do! So now you can go and get some fresh wool!
translation: 好吧，现在你知道了！所以现在你可以去买一些新鲜的羊毛了！ [hao ba ， xian zai ni zhi dao le ！ suo yi xian zai ni ke yi qu mai yi xie xin xian de yang mao le ！]

english: You hand Gregg [1/2/3] piece[s] of wool.
translation: 你递给 Gregg [1/2/3] 块羊毛。 [ni di gei  Gregg [1/2/3]  kuai yang mao 。]

english: Thanks, human! But we still need [2/1] more wool!
translation: 谢谢，人类！但我们还需要 [2/1] 更多羊毛！ [xie xie ， ren lei ！ dan wo men hai xu yao  [2/1]  geng duo yang mao ！]

english: That's all the wool we need! Thanks a lot, human! You're a big help.
translation: 这就是我们需要的所有羊毛！非常感谢，人类！你是一个很大的帮助。 [zhe jiu shi wo men xu yao de suo you yang mao ！ fei chang gan xie ， ren lei ！ ni shi yi ge hen da de bang zhu 。]

english: And you're a small rabbit.
translation: 而你是一只小兔子。 [er ni shi yi zhi xiao tu zi 。]

english: If you think I'm small, you should see the rabbits in Tirannwn. They're so small most people don't even look at them.
translation: 如果你认为我很小，你应该看看蒂兰温的兔子。它们太小了，大多数人甚至都不会看它们。 [ru guo ni ren wei wo hen xiao ， ni ying gai kan kan di lan wen de tu zi 。 ta men tai xiao le ， da duo shu ren shen zhi dou bu hui kan ta men 。]

english: Where...?
translation: 在哪里...？ [zai na li ...？]

english: Anyway, we've got all the wool, so we should probably move on. What else do we need?
translation: 无论如何，我们已经有了所有的羊毛，所以我们应该继续前进。我们还需要什么？ [wu lun ru he ， wo men yi jing you le suo you de yang mao ， suo yi wo men ying gai ji xu qian jin 。 wo men hai xu yao shen me ？]

english: Hmm... some ribbons might look nice.
translation: 嗯...一些丝带可能看起来不错。 [n ... yi xie si dai ke neng kan qi lai bu cuo 。]

english: Ribbons would be perfect, human! Do you know where we could get some?
translation: 丝带将是完美的，人类！你知道我们在哪里可以得到一些吗？ [si dai jiang shi wan mei de ， ren lei ！ ni zhi dao wo men zai na li ke yi de dao yi xie ma ？]

english: Uh... not really. The only place I can think of that does any kind of fabrics is Thessalia's Fine Clothes in Varrock.
translation: 呃……不是真的。我能想到的唯一提供任何种类面料的地方是位于 Varrock 的 Thessalia's Fine Clothes。 [e …… bu shi zhen de 。 wo neng xiang dao de wei yi ti gong ren he zhong lei mian liao de di fang shi wei yu  Varrock  de  Thessalia's Fine Clothes。]

english: Thanks, human, but I don't think we need any more wool.
translation: 谢谢，人类，但我认为我们不需要更多的羊毛了。 [xie xie ， ren lei ， dan wo ren wei wo men bu xu yao geng duo de yang mao le 。]

english: Well, that's better than nothing! We'll go to Thessalia's!
translation: 嗯，那总比没有好！我们要去色萨利！ [n ， na zong bi mei you hao ！ wo men yao qu se sa li ！]

english: Wait, aren't there scary dark mages at the front of Varrock? I should probably teleport in... Would you like me to take you along, human?
translation: 等等，瓦罗克前面不是有可怕的黑暗法师吗？我也许应该传送进去……你愿意我带你一起去吗，人类？ [deng deng ， wa luo ke qian mian bu shi you ke pa de hei an fa shi ma ？ wo ye xu ying gai chuan song jin qu …… ni yuan yi wo dai ni yi qi qu ma ， ren lei ？]

english: Ok! Hold on to your boots!
translation: 好的！抓紧你的靴子！ [hao de ！ zhua jin ni de xue zi ！]

english: But I'm not wearing any...
translation: 但我没穿任何... [dan wo mei chuan ren he ...]

english: The player is seen casting an uninterruptable self-teleport (not tele-other by the rabbit) between the Varrock general store and Thessalia's Fine Clothes store (location in proximity of 3212, 3416, 0).
translation: 可以看到玩家在 Varrock 杂货店和塞萨利亚的精美服装店（位置靠近 3212, 3416, 0）之间施放不间断的自我传送（不是兔子的远程传送）。 [ke yi kan dao wan jia zai  Varrock  za huo dian he sai sa li ya de jing mei fu zhuang dian （ wei zhi kao jin  3212, 3416, 0） zhi jian shi fang bu jian duan de zi wo chuan song （ bu shi tu zi de yuan cheng chuan song ）。]

english: ... boots!
translation: ... 靴子！ [...  xue zi ！]

english: Gregg can no longer be found in the sheep pen north of Lumbridge.
translation: 在朗布里奇以北的羊圈里再也找不到格雷格了。 [zai lang bu li qi yi bei de yang juan li zai ye zhao bu dao ge lei ge le 。]

english: Ok, human! I'll wait here for a little bit just in case you change your mind, or you can meet me there!
translation: 好吧，人类！我会在这里等一会儿，以防万一你改变主意，或者你可以在那里见我！ [hao ba ， ren lei ！ wo hui zai zhe li deng yi hui er ， yi fang wan yi ni gai bian zhu yi ， huo zhe ni ke yi zai na li jian wo ！]

english: Are you ready to go to Varrock, human?
translation: 人类，你准备好去瓦罗克了吗？ [ren lei ， ni zhun bei hao qu wa luo ke le ma ？]

english: What do you know about the dark wizards?
translation: 关于黑巫师你了解多少？ [guan yu hei wu shi ni liao jie duo shao ？]

english: Most of what I know is second hand knowledge, but none of it is good!
translation: 我知道的大部分都是二手知识，但没有一个是好的！ [wo zhi dao de da bu fen dou shi er shou zhi shi ， dan mei you yi ge shi hao de ！]

english: Last year one of my mates walked by too close and they nearly had him for rabbit stew!
translation: 去年，我的一个朋友走得太近，差点把他当作炖兔肉！ [qu nian ， wo de yi ge peng you zou de tai jin ， cha dian ba ta dang zuo dun tu rou ！]

english: From what I've heard, they're trying to summon a demon to attack Varrock!
translation: 据我所知，他们正试图召唤恶魔来攻击瓦罗克！ [ju wo suo zhi ， ta men zheng shi tu zhao huan e mo lai gong ji wa luo ke ！]

english: A demon? Outside of Varrock? Surely the King should do something about that?
translation: 恶魔？在瓦罗克之外？国王当然应该对此做点什么吗？ [e mo ？ zai wa luo ke zhi wai ？ guo wang dang ran ying gai dui ci zuo dian shen me ma ？]

english: You'd think so, but apparently he hasn't done a thing about anything going on outside his walls for years!
translation: 你可能会这么认为，但显然他已经很多年没有对墙外发生的任何事情采取任何行动了！ [ni ke neng hui zhe me ren wei ， dan xian ran ta yi jing hen duo nian mei you dui qiang wai fa sheng de ren he shi qing cai qu ren he xing dong le ！]

english: So what are we going to do about it?
translation: 那么我们该怎么办呢？ [na me wo men gai zen me ban ne ？]

english: Conventientlyignore the problem by teleporting around it!
translation: 通过传送绕过它，可以轻松忽略该问题！ [tong guo chuan song rao guo ta ， ke yi qing song hu lve gai wen ti ！]

english: That does sound like a good plan, to be fair.
translation: 公平地说，这听起来确实是一个好计划。 [gong ping di shuo ， zhe ting qi lai que shi shi yi ge hao ji hua 。]

english: They're still there? I thought they would have cleared off after I killed their demon...
translation: 他们还在吗？我以为我杀了他们的恶魔后他们就会消失…… [ta men hai zai ma ？ wo yi wei wo sha le ta men de e mo hou ta men jiu hui xiao shi ……]

english: Wait, they actually summoned a demon?! And you killed it?!
translation: 等等，他们居然召唤出了恶魔？！而你却杀了它？！ [deng deng ， ta men ju ran zhao huan chu le e mo ？！ er ni que sha le ta ？！]

english: Yeah, I managed to banish him again with some help from the gypsy in town.
translation: 是的，在镇上吉普赛人的帮助下，我再次成功驱逐了他。 [shi de ， zai zhen shang ji pu sai ren de bang zhu xia ， wo zai ci cheng gong qu zhu le ta 。]

english: Wow! Human, that's incredible!
translation: 哇！人类，太不可思议了！ [wa ！ ren lei ， tai bu ke si yi le ！]

english: I bet everyone knows you as one of the greatest heroes of all time!
translation: 我敢打赌每个人都知道您是有史以来最伟大的英雄之一！ [wo gan da du mei ge ren dou zhi dao nin shi you shi yi lai zui wei da de ying xiong zhi yi ！]

english: Eh, most shopkeepers don't seem to care that you managed to save the world.
translation: 呃，大多数店主似乎并不关心你拯救了世界。 [e ， da duo shu dian zhu si hu bing bu guan xin ni zheng jiu le shi jie 。]

english: We were about to go to Thlessia's... Thasselio's... Thlessaloa's...
translation: 我们正要去Thlessia's...Thasselio's...Thlessaloa's... [wo men zheng yao qu Thlessia's...Thasselio's...Thlessaloa's...]

english: Thessalia's Fine Clothes?
translation: 塞萨利娅的精美衣服？ [sai sa li ya de jing mei yi fu ？]

english: Yes! Thessalia's shop in Varrock! We were going to get some nice ribbons for decorations!
translation: 是的！瓦罗克的色萨莉亚商店！我们要买一些漂亮的丝带来装饰！ [shi de ！ wa luo ke de se sa li ya shang dian ！ wo men yao mai yi xie piao liang de si dai lai zhuang shi ！]

english: Are you sure this is a good idea?
translation: 你确定这是个好主意吗？ [ni que ding zhe shi ge hao zhu yi ma ？]

english: Why wouldn't it be?
translation: 为什么不会呢？ [wei shen me bu hui ne ？]

english: Isn't she just going to make some Easter reference that you'll get upset about?
translation: 她不是会提到一些你会感到不安的复活节吗？ [ta bu shi hui ti dao yi xie ni hui gan dao bu an de fu huo jie ma ？]

english: ... Thanks for putting that thought into my head, human.
translation: ……谢谢你把这个想法放进我的脑海里，人类。 […… xie xie ni ba zhe ge xiang fa fang jin wo de nao hai li ， ren lei 。]

english: Hey, cheer up! At least you're making other people feel happy.
translation: 嘿，加油！至少你让别人感到快乐。 [hei ， jia you ！ zhi shao ni rang bie ren gan dao kuai le 。]

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你是什​​么意思？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: You're an Easter bunny, so obviously you remind people of Easter, which is a great time for a lot of people.
translation: 你是一只复活节兔子，所以显然你让人们想起了复活节，这对很多人来说都是一个美好的时光。 [ni shi yi zhi fu huo jie tu zi ， suo yi xian ran ni rang ren men xiang qi le fu huo jie ， zhe dui hen duo ren lai shuo dou shi yi ge mei hao de shi guang 。]

english: Even if you don't like it, you being around makes people think of festive times and is a surefire way to get smiles on faces.
translation: 即使您不喜欢它，您的存在也会让人们想起节日时光，并且肯定会让人脸上露出笑容。 [ji shi nin bu xi huan ta ， nin de cun zai ye hui rang ren men xiang qi jie ri shi guang ， bing qie ken ding hui rang ren lian shang lu chu xiao rong 。]

english: ... Huh, I never thought of it like that.
translation: ……呃，我从来没有这么想过。 […… e ， wo cong lai mei you zhe me xiang guo 。]

english: Thanks a lot, human! I'm still not gonna like it, but I can at least put up with being a cute Easter bunny for the rest of the year!
translation: 非常感谢，人类！我仍然不会喜欢它，但我至少可以忍受在今年剩下的时间里做一只可爱的复活节兔子！ [fei chang gan xie ， ren lei ！ wo reng ran bu hui xi huan ta ， dan wo zhi shao ke yi ren shou zai jin nian sheng xia de shi jian li zuo yi zhi ke ai de fu huo jie tu zi ！]

english: If you change your mind about wanting a teleport I'll be here. Otherwise, I'll see you in Varrock, human!
translation: 如果你改变主意想要传送，我会在这里。否则，我会在瓦罗克见到你，人类！ [ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi xiang yao chuan song ， wo hui zai zhe li 。 fou ze ， wo hui zai wa luo ke jian dao ni ， ren lei ！]

english: I think we were going to the clothes shop in the middle of Varrock to get some ribbons.
translation: 我想我们是要去瓦罗克市中心的服装店买一些丝带。 [wo xiang wo men shi yao qu wa luo ke shi zhong xin de fu zhuang dian mai yi xie si dai 。]

english: Oh my, aren't you just the cutest little thing!
translation: 天哪，你不是最可爱的小东西吗！ [tian na ， ni bu shi zui ke ai de xiao dong xi ma ！]

english: *grumble grumble grumble*
translation: *咕咕咕咕* [* gu gu gu gu *]

english: He doesn't seem too happy. What's wrong?
translation: 他看起来不太高兴。怎么了？ [ta kan qi lai bu tai gao xing 。 zen me le ？]

english: Oh, uh... I'm sure it's nothing.
translation: 哦，呃……我确定没什么。 [o ， e …… wo que ding mei shen me 。]

english: Anyway, we were hoping you could help us with something.
translation: 不管怎样，我们希望你能帮助我们做点什么。 [bu guan zen yang ， wo men xi wang ni neng bang zhu wo men zuo dian shen me 。]

english: Certainly, what can I do for you?
translation: 当然可以，我能为您做什么？ [dang ran ke yi ， wo neng wei nin zuo shen me ？]

english: We were hoping you might have some ribbons that we could use as decorations.
translation: 我们希望您有一些丝带可以用作装饰品。 [wo men xi wang nin you yi xie si dai ke yi yong zuo zhuang shi pin 。]

english: Oh yes. It's Easter soon, isn't it?
translation: 哦是的。复活节快到了，不是吗？ [o shi de 。 fu huo jie kuai dao le ， bu shi ma ？]

english: We don't have any ribbons as such, but we do have some offcuts you could make some out of.
translation: 我们没有这样的丝带，但我们有一些边角料，你可以用它们来做一些。 [wo men mei you zhe yang de si dai ， dan wo men you yi xie bian jiao liao ， ni ke yi yong ta men lai zuo yi xie 。]

english: Excellent! I'm glad I brought my scissors along!
translation: 出色的！我很高兴我带了剪刀！ [chu se de ！ wo hen gao xing wo dai le jian dao ！]

english: Didn't you just have trouble using shears?
translation: 您刚刚使用剪刀时没有遇到麻烦吗？ [nin gang gang shi yong jian dao shi mei you yu dao ma fan ma ？]

english: Yep, but these are rabbit scissors!
translation: 是的，但这些是兔子剪刀！ [shi de ， dan zhe xie shi tu zi jian dao ！]

english: Sounds like you have a plan, then. I'll get these offcuts together for you...
translation: 那么听起来你有一个计划。我会把这些边角料收集起来给你... [na me ting qi lai ni you yi ge ji hua 。 wo hui ba zhe xie bian jiao liao shou ji qi lai gei ni ...]

english: Thessalia starts gathering up several offcuts of fabric.
translation: 塞萨莉亚开始收集一些布料边角料。 [sai sa li ya kai shi shou ji yi xie bu liao bian jiao liao 。]

english: Wait a second... what's that?!
translation: 等一下……那是什么？！ [deng yi xia …… na shi shen me ？！]

english: Gregg's attention is grabbed by an extremely silly hat.
translation: 格雷格的注意力被一顶极其愚蠢的帽子吸引了。 [ge lei ge de zhu yi li bei yi ding ji qi yu chun de mao zi xi yin le 。]

english: Oh yes... that hat.
translation: 哦，是的……那顶帽子。 [o ， shi de …… na ding mao zi 。]

english: *sigh* An intern made it a few months ago. We've been trying to sell it ever since, but nobody seems to want it on account of its... stupidity.
translation: *叹息*几个月前，一名实习生成功了。从那时起我们就一直试图卖掉它，但似乎没有人想要它，因为它……愚蠢。 [* tan xi * ji ge yue qian ， yi ming shi xi sheng cheng gong le 。 cong na shi qi wo men jiu yi zhi shi tu mai diao ta ， dan si hu mei you ren xiang yao ta ， yin wei ta …… yu chun 。]

english: It's so shoddily made, it doesn't even spin properly!
translation: 做工太粗劣了，根本就不能正常转动！ [zuo gong tai cu lie le ， gen ben jiu bu neng zheng chang zhuan dong ！]

english: I love it! Can I have it!
translation: 我喜欢它！我可以拥有吗！ [wo xi huan ta ！ wo ke yi yong you ma ！]

english: Wait... you actually want that thing?
translation: 等等……你真的想要那个东西吗？ [deng deng …… ni zhen de xiang yao na ge dong xi ma ？]

english: Yeah! Look how colourful it is! It's great!
translation: 是的！看看它多么丰富多彩！这很棒！ [shi de ！ kan kan ta duo me feng fu duo cai ！ zhe hen bang ！]

english: Well, you're more than welcome to take it. It's not like we can sell it anyway.
translation: 好吧，非常欢迎您接受它。反正我们也不能卖。 [hao ba ， fei chang huan ying nin jie shou ta 。 fan zheng wo men ye bu neng mai 。]

english: Yay! Just let me get this...
translation: 耶！让我得到这个... [ye ！ rang wo de dao zhe ge ...]

english: ... over the ears and...
translation: ...在耳朵上并且... [... zai er duo shang bing qie ...]

english: ... hmph. Can't seem to get it on.
translation: ……哼。好像打不开啊 […… heng 。 hao xiang da bu kai a]

english: Well, it was designed for humans, not rabbits.
translation: 嗯，它是为人类而不是兔子设计的。 [n ， ta shi wei ren lei er bu shi tu zi she ji de 。]

english: Ah well, I'll figure it out later.
translation: 啊，好吧，我稍后会弄清楚。 [a ， hao ba ， wo shao hou hui nong qing chu 。]

english: Gregg puts the hat away.
translation: 格雷格把帽子收起来。 [ge lei ge ba mao zi shou qi lai 。]

english: Anyway, here are the offcuts.
translation: 无论如何，这是边角料。 [wu lun ru he ， zhe shi bian jiao liao 。]

english: Thessalia hands Gregg a box full of offcuts and spare fabric.
translation: 塞萨莉亚递给格雷格一个盒子，里面装满了边角料和备用布料。 [sai sa li ya di gei ge lei ge yi ge he zi ， li mian zhuang man le bian jiao liao he bei yong bu liao 。]

english: This is perfect! Thanks a lot, miss!
translation: 这太完美了！非常感谢，小姐！ [zhe tai wan mei le ！ fei chang gan xie ， xiao jie ！]

english: No problem, I'm glad I could be of help.
translation: 没问题，我很高兴能为您提供帮助。 [mei wen ti ， wo hen gao xing neng wei nin ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: So what do we do now?
translation: 那么我们现在该怎么办呢？ [na me wo men xian zai gai zen me ban ne ？]

english: Hmm... I think we have all the decorations we need, but I had an idea.
translation: 嗯...我想我们已经有了我们需要的所有装饰品，但我有一个主意。 [n ... wo xiang wo men yi jing you le wo men xu yao de suo you zhuang shi pin ， dan wo you yi ge zhu yi 。]

english: It's going to be really annoying trying to put all these decorations on a door while it's still in a frame.
translation: 当门还在框架中时，试图将所有这些装饰品放在门上真的很烦人。 [dang men hai zai kuang jia zhong shi ， shi tu jiang suo you zhe xie zhuang shi pin fang zai men shang zhen de hen fan ren 。]

english: So I was thinking - why not make a new door, decorate it, and simply swap the doors out!
translation: 所以我在想 - 为什么不制作一扇新门，装饰它，然后简单地将门换掉！ [suo yi wo zai xiang  -  wei shen me bu zhi zuo yi shan xin men ， zhuang shi ta ， ran hou jian dan di jiang men huan diao ！]

english: That doesn't sound too ridiculous, actually. What do we need?
translation: 事实上，这听起来并不太荒谬。我们需要什么？ [shi shi shang ， zhe ting qi lai bing bu tai huang miu 。 wo men xu yao shen me ？]

english: I think if we had some planks, I have all the nails and fixings to make the thing...
translation: 我想如果我们有一些木板，我就有了所有的钉子和固定装置来制作这个东西...... [wo xiang ru guo wo men you yi xie mu ban ， wo jiu you le suo you de ding zi he gu ding zhuang zhi lai zhi zuo zhe ge dong xi ......]

english: If you want planks, your best bestis heading to the lumberyard and talking to the sawmill operator.
translation: 如果您想要木板，最好是前往伐木场并与锯木厂操作员交谈。 [ru guo nin xiang yao mu ban ， zui hao shi qian wang fa mu chang bing yu ju mu chang cao zuo yuan jiao tan 。]

english: Sounds like a plan, human! The lumberyard is to the north-east of here, I'll see you out in front of it!
translation: 听起来像是一个计划，人类！伐木场就在这儿的东北方，我在它前面见！ [ting qi lai xiang shi yi ge ji hua ， ren lei ！ fa mu chang jiu zai zhe er de dong bei fang ， wo zai ta qian mian jian ！]

english: Can I help you with anything else?
translation: 我还可以帮您做其他事吗？ [wo hai ke yi bang nin zuo qi ta shi ma ？]

english: No thanks. We'll be on our way to the lumberyard in a bit.
translation: 不，谢谢。一会儿我们就要去伐木场了。 [bu ， xie xie 。 yi hui er wo men jiu yao qu fa mu chang le 。]

english: Thanks again for the hat!
translation: 再次感谢你的帽子！ [zai ci gan xie ni de mao zi ！]

english: I'm just glad someone actually likes it.
translation: 我只是很高兴有人真正喜欢它。 [wo zhi shi hen gao xing you ren zhen zheng xi huan ta 。]

english: How could you not like it? It's so colorful!
translation: 你怎么能不喜欢呢？真是丰富多彩啊！ [ni zen me neng bu xi huan ne ？ zhen shi feng fu duo cai a ！]

english: I think that's part of the problem.
translation: 我认为这是问题的一部分。 [wo ren wei zhe shi wen ti de yi bu fen 。]

english: I think we were going to the lumberyard to the north-east of Varrock to get some planks.
translation: 我想我们要去瓦罗克东北部的伐木场拿一些木板。 [wo xiang wo men yao qu wa luo ke dong bei bu de fa mu chang na yi xie mu ban 。]

english: Hey, I got you this...
translation: 嘿，我给你这个... [hei ， wo gei ni zhe ge ...]

english: The sudden thought of XP waste prevents you from handing over the plank to Gregg.
translation: 突然想到 XP 浪费，你就不敢把木板交给格雷格了。 [tu ran xiang dao  XP  lang fei ， ni jiu bu gan ba mu ban jiao gei ge lei ge le 。]

english: Are you alright, human? You appear to be in intense physical pain.
translation: 你还好吗，人类？您的身体似乎正承受着剧烈的疼痛。 [ni hai hao ma ， ren lei ？ nin de shen ti si hu zheng cheng shou zhe ju lie de teng tong 。]

english: Well, here we are. Now all we need to do is get some planks.
translation: 好吧，我们到了。现在我们需要做的就是找一些木板。 [hao ba ， wo men dao le 。 xian zai wo men xu yao zuo de jiu shi zhao yi xie mu ban 。]

english: Should be easy enough.
translation: 应该很容易。 [ying gai hen rong yi 。]

english: Wait... where's the sawmill operator?
translation: 等等...锯木厂操作员在哪里？ [deng deng ... ju mu chang cao zuo yuan zai na li ？]

english: Come to think of it, I've never actually seen anyone working in there...
translation: 想想看，我从来没有见过有人在那里工作...... [xiang xiang kan ， wo cong lai mei you jian guo you ren zai na li gong zuo ......]

english: So how do you get your planks then?
translation: 那么你如何获得木板呢？ [na me ni ru he huo de mu ban ne ？]

english: I dunno, probably off the Grand Exchange.
translation: 我不知道，可能是在大交易所附近。 [wo bu zhi dao ， ke neng shi zai da jiao yi suo fu jin 。]

english: The Grand Exchange! I don't have that kind of money!
translation: 大交换！我没有那么多钱！ [da jiao huan ！ wo mei you na me duo qian ！]

english: No, we need a better plan.
translation: 不，我们需要一个更好的计划。 [bu ， wo men xu yao yi ge geng hao de ji hua 。]

english: I was just going to run screaming into the Wilderness and hope for the best.
translation: 我正要尖叫着跑进荒野，并希望得到最好的结果。 [wo zheng yao jian jiao zhe pao jin huang ye ， bing xi wang de dao zui hao de jie guo 。]

english: That sounds awfully dangerous, human!
translation: 这听起来非常危险，人类！ [zhe ting qi lai fei chang wei xian ， ren lei ！]

english: Eh, it beats hanging around the Grand Exchange all day.
translation: 呃，总比整天在大交易所闲逛要好。 [e ， zong bi zheng tian zai da jiao yi suo xian guang yao hao 。]

english: Well, I'm not risking my hide running around the Wilderness! We need a better plan.
translation: 好吧，我不会冒着在荒野里乱跑的危险！我们需要一个更好的计划。 [hao ba ， wo bu hui mao zhe zai huang ye li luan pao de wei xian ！ wo men xu yao yi ge geng hao de ji hua 。]

english: Huh... I could've sworn there was someone in there at some point.
translation: 呃...我可以发誓里面某个时候有人。 [e ... wo ke yi fa shi li mian mou ge shi hou you ren 。]

english: Well, they're not in there now!
translation: 好吧，他们现在不在里面！ [hao ba ， ta men xian zai bu zai li mian ！]

english: There might be a bell, have a look.
translation: 可能有铃声，你看一下。 [ke neng you ling sheng ， ni kan yi xia 。]

english: Are you kidding me? There's no bell to ring! No, we need a better plan.
translation: 你在开玩笑吧？没有铃声可响！不，我们需要一个更好的计划。 [ni zai kai wan xiao ba ？ mei you ling sheng ke xiang ！ bu ， wo men xu yao yi ge geng hao de ji hua 。]

english: Wait... gosh darn it, I forgot to grab my piggy bank!
translation: 等等...天哪，我忘记拿我的存钱罐了！ [deng deng ... tian na ， wo wang ji na wo de cun qian guan le ！]

english: Human, would you mind buyi-
translation: 人类，你介意买- [ren lei ， ni jie yi mai -]

english: Do you know how expensive planks are? If I'm buying planks, they're exclusively for repairing the furniture I plan on breaking!
translation: 你知道木板有多贵吗？如果我买木板，它们专门用于修理我打算损坏的家具！ [ni zhi dao mu ban you duo gui ma ？ ru guo wo mai mu ban ， ta men zhuan men yong yu xiu li wo da suan sun huai de jia ju ！]

english: ... What?
translation: ... 什么？ [...  shen me ？]

english: Well if you find a better way of constructiontraining, let me know.
translation: 如果您找到更好的施工培训方式，请告诉我。 [ru guo nin zhao dao geng hao de shi gong pei xun fang shi ， qing gao su wo 。]

english: ... At any rate, it looks like we need a better plan...
translation: ……无论如何，看来我们需要一个更好的计划…… […… wu lun ru he ， kan lai wo men xu yao yi ge geng hao de ji hua ……]

english: Oh wait, look! There's a break in the fence there!
translation: 哦等等，看！那里的栅栏有一个缺口！ [o deng deng ， kan ！ na li de zha lan you yi ge que kou ！]

english: I bet I can just sneak right in and grab a few planks without anyone noticing!
translation: 我敢打赌我可以偷偷溜进去，在没有人注意到的情况下抓起几块木板！ [wo gan da du wo ke yi tou tou liu jin qu ， zai mei you ren zhu yi dao de qing kuang xia zhua qi ji kuai mu ban ！]

english: Are you sure you don't want me to go?
translation: 你确定不想让我走吗？ [ni que ding bu xiang rang wo zou ma ？]

english: No thank you, Human. You've done enough already. You sit back and relax. I'll be back in a moment!
translation: 不，谢谢你，人类。你已经做的够多了。你坐下来放松一下。我一会儿就回来！ [bu ， xie xie ni ， ren lei 。 ni yi jing zuo de gou duo le 。 ni zuo xia lai fang song yi xia 。 wo yi hui er jiu hui lai ！]

english: The camera fades to black. In a cutscene, Gregg is seen hopping inside the fenced lumberyard.
translation: 相机逐渐变黑。在过场动画中，可以看到格雷格在有围栏的伐木场内跳跃。 [xiang ji zhu jian bian hei 。 zai guo chang dong hua zhong ， ke yi kan dao ge lei ge zai you wei lan de fa mu chang nei tiao yue 。]

english: Ok, let's find some planks...
translation: 好吧，让我们找一些木板...... [hao ba ， rang wo men zhao yi xie mu ban ......]

english: A sound of a cat purring is heard. A brown adult cat comes from behind a wall two tiles right (east) of Gregg.
translation: 听到猫咕噜咕噜的声音。一只棕色的成年猫从格雷格右（东）两格的墙后出现。 [ting dao mao gu lu gu lu de sheng yin 。 yi zhi zong se de cheng nian mao cong ge lei ge you （ dong ） liang ge de qiang hou chu xian 。]

english: Meow!
translation: 喵！ [miao ！]

english: Aha! There we go!
translation: 啊哈！我们开始吧！ [a ha ！ wo men kai shi ba ！]

english: A sound of the cat meowing is heard.
translation: 听到猫的喵喵声。 [ting dao mao de miao miao sheng 。]

english: Meow.
translation: 喵。 [miao 。]

english: Oh! A kitty cat!
translation: 哦！一只小猫！ [o ！ yi zhi xiao mao ！]

english: Sorry, kitty, I don't have any treats.
translation: 抱歉，小猫，我没有任何零食。 [bao qian ， xiao mao ， wo mei you ren he ling shi 。]

english: Would you like pets instead? I can do pets!
translation: 你想要宠物吗？我可以养宠物！ [ni xiang yao chong wu ma ？ wo ke yi yang chong wu ！]

english: Gregg moves closer to pet the cat. The cat makes an audible hiss and scratches towards Gregg.
translation: 格雷格走近去抚摸猫。猫发出嘶嘶声，并向格雷格抓挠。 [ge lei ge zou jin qu fu mo mao 。 mao fa chu si si sheng ， bing xiang ge lei ge zhua nao 。]

english: Hissss!
translation: 嘶嘶！ [si si ！]

english: Aaaah!
translation: 啊啊啊！ [a a a ！]

english: Nice kitty...?
translation: 漂亮的小猫...? [piao liang de xiao mao ...?]

english: The cat makes an audible hiss and scratches towards Gregg again. Gregg starts fleeing left (west), while the adult cat chases him.
translation: 猫发出嘶嘶声，再次向格雷格抓挠。格雷格开始向左（向西）逃跑，而成年猫则追赶他。 [mao fa chu si si sheng ， zai ci xiang ge lei ge zhua nao 。 ge lei ge kai shi xiang zuo （ xiang xi ） tao pao ， er cheng nian mao ze zhui gan ta 。]

english: Not nice kitty! Not nice kitty!
translation: 不是什么好猫！不是什么好猫！ [bu shi shen me hao mao ！ bu shi shen me hao mao ！]

english: The camera pans right and fades to black again. After a fade-out, the camera is set back to the world in front of the lumberyard with the player and Gregg.
translation: 摄像机向右平移并再次淡入黑色。淡出后，镜头回到伐木场前的世界，其中有玩家和格雷格。 [she xiang ji xiang you ping yi bing zai ci dan ru hei se 。 dan chu hou ， jing tou hui dao fa mu chang qian de shi jie ， qi zhong you wan jia he ge lei ge 。]

english: Woah, are you alright?
translation: 哇哦，你还好吗？ [wa o ， ni hai hao ma ？]

english: I'm fine, just... let me catch my breath...
translation: 我很好，只是……让我喘口气…… [wo hen hao ， zhi shi …… rang wo chuan kou qi ……]

english: I didn't know... that cats could be... so violent!
translation: 我不知道……猫可以……这么暴力！ [wo bu zhi dao …… mao ke yi …… zhe me bao li ！]

english: I didn't even know there were cats in there to begin with!
translation: 我什至不知道那里有猫！ [wo shen zhi bu zhi dao na li you mao ！]

english: I guess the lumberyard is a popular spot for cats...
translation: 我猜伐木场是猫喜欢去的地方...... [wo cai fa mu chang shi mao xi huan qu de di fang ......]

english: ... Ok, I think I'm gonna be alright. I got the planks out, at the very least.
translation: ...好吧，我想我会没事的。至少我把木板拿出来了。 [... hao ba ， wo xiang wo hui mei shi de 。 zhi shao wo ba mu ban na chu lai le 。]

english: So we can make the door now?
translation: 那么我们现在可以开门了吗？ [na me wo men xian zai ke yi kai men le ma ？]

english: Exactly! Now, hold this nail for me...
translation: 确切地！现在，帮我握住这颗钉子…… [que qie di ！ xian zai ， bang wo wo zhu zhe ke ding zi ……]

english: Time passes...
translation: 时间流逝... [shi jian liu shi ...]

english: The camera fades to black. Sounds of nails being hit with a hammer are heard.
translation: 相机逐渐变黑。听到用锤子敲钉子的声音。 [xiang ji zhu jian bian hei 。 ting dao yong chui zi qiao ding zi de sheng yin 。]

english: The camera fades back to view.
translation: 摄像机逐渐淡出视野。 [she xiang ji zhu jian dan chu shi ye 。]

english: ... And I think we're done!
translation: ...我想我们已经完成了！ [... wo xiang wo men yi jing wan cheng le ！]

english: Gregg shows off the completed door.
translation: 格雷格展示了完成的门。 [ge lei ge zhan shi le wan cheng de men 。]

english: That looks... surprisinggood, actually.
translation: 实际上，这看起来……令人惊讶。 [shi ji shang ， zhe kan qi lai …… ling ren jing ya 。]

english: Well if you like it, it's bound to go down well! Let's head back to Draynor and get this put up!
translation: 好吧，如果你喜欢它，它一定会很受欢迎！让我们回到德雷诺并把这个放好！ [hao ba ， ru guo ni xi huan ta ， ta yi ding hui hen shou huan ying ！ rang wo men hui dao de lei nuo bing ba zhe ge fang hao ！]

english: Draynor becomes decorated with Easter eggs on the ground, festive poles, and seven colourful doors.
translation: 德雷诺的地面上装饰着复活节彩蛋、节日柱子和七扇色彩缤纷的门。 [de lei nuo de di mian shang zhuang shi zhe fu huo jie cai dan 、 jie ri zhu zi he qi shan se cai bin fen de men 。]

english: It's a bit of a trek. I'm going to teleport again. Would you like me to take you along?
translation: 这有点长途跋涉。我又要传送了你愿意我带你一起去吗？ [zhe you dian chang tu ba she 。 wo you yao chuan song le ni yuan yi wo dai ni yi qi qu ma ？]

english: Ok! Hold on to your ammo!
translation: 好的！抓紧你的弹药！ [hao de ！ zhua jin ni de dan yao ！]

english: But that doesn't make any...
translation: 但这并不能说明任何... [dan zhe bing bu neng shuo ming ren he ...]

english: The player is seen casting an uninterruptable self-teleport (not tele-other by the rabbit) north-east of Ned's house at Draynor (location in proximity of 3105, 3262, 0).
translation: 可以看到玩家在 Draynor 的 Ned 房子东北部（位置靠近 3105, 3262, 0）施放不间断的自我传送（不是兔子的远程传送）。 [ke yi kan dao wan jia zai  Draynor  de  Ned  fang zi dong bei bu （ wei zhi kao jin  3105, 3262, 0） shi fang bu jian duan de zi wo chuan song （ bu shi tu zi de yuan cheng chuan song ）。]

english: ... sense!
translation: ... 感觉！ [...  gan jue ！]

english: Gregg can no longer be found at the lumberyard. Thessalia can now instruct the player to look for Gregg at where the event started.
translation: 在伐木场再也找不到格雷格了。塞萨莉亚现在可以指示玩家在事件开始的地方寻找格雷格。 [zai fa mu chang zai ye zhao bu dao ge lei ge le 。 sai sa li ya xian zai ke yi zhi shi wan jia zai shi jian kai shi de di fang xun zhao ge lei ge 。]

english: The player is seen casting an uninterruptable self-teleport (not tele-other by the rabbit) north-east of Ned's house at Draynor (location in proximity of 3104, 3263, 0).
translation: 可以看到玩家在 Draynor 的 Ned 房子东北部（位置靠近 3104, 3263, 0）施放不间断的自我传送（不是兔子的远程传送）。 [ke yi kan dao wan jia zai  Draynor  de  Ned  fang zi dong bei bu （ wei zhi kao jin  3104, 3263, 0） shi fang bu jian duan de zi wo chuan song （ bu shi tu zi de yuan cheng chuan song ）。]

english: Ok human! Let me know if you change your mind. Otherwise, I'll see you there!
translation: 好吧人类！如果您改变主意，请告诉我。不然的话，我就在那里见！ [hao ba ren lei ！ ru guo nin gai bian zhu yi ， qing gao su wo 。 bu ran de hua ， wo jiu zai na li jian ！]

english: Hey human! Are you ready to go to Draynor?
translation: 嘿人类！你准备好去德拉诺了吗？ [hei ren lei ！ ni zhun bei hao qu de la nuo le ma ？]

english: Are you alright after that cat attacked you?
translation: 那只猫袭击你之后你还好吗？ [na zhi mao xi ji ni zhi hou ni hai hao ma ？]

english: I'll be fine, I didn't get scratched too badly. Plus at least I have a cool story to tell my friends.
translation: 我会没事的，我没有被划伤太严重。另外，至少我有一个很酷的故事可以告诉我的朋友。 [wo hui mei shi de ， wo mei you bei hua shang tai yan zhong 。 ling wai ， zhi shao wo you yi ge hen ku de gu shi ke yi gao su wo de peng you 。]

english: I'm just sad I didn't get to pet the cute cat...
translation: 可惜没能摸摸这只可爱的猫…… [ke xi mei neng mo mo zhe zhi ke ai de mao ……]

english: Not so nice being called cute, is it...?
translation: 被人说可爱不太好吧……？ [bei ren shuo ke ai bu tai hao ba ……？]

english: Hey, everyone knows cats love being petted!
translation: 嘿，大家都知道猫喜欢被抚摸！ [hei ， da jia dou zhi dao mao xi huan bei fu mo ！]

english: That one just seemed mad about something else... I wonder what.
translation: 那个人似乎只是因为别的事情而生气……我想知道是什么。 [na ge ren si hu zhi shi yin wei bie de shi qing er sheng qi …… wo xiang zhi dao shi shen me 。]

english: Hmm... Based on past experienced with cats in the lumberyard, I bet it's hungry, thristy or looking for its kitten.
translation: 嗯……根据过去在伐木场处理猫的经验，我敢打赌它是饿了、渴了或者在寻找它的小猫。 [n …… gen ju guo qu zai fa mu chang chu li mao de jing yan ， wo gan da du ta shi e le 、 ke le huo zhe zai xun zhao ta de xiao mao 。]

english: Aww, if I didn't feel mad at it for trying to scratch out my eyes, I'd want to go help it...
translation: 哇哦，如果我不因为它试图挖出我的眼睛而感到生气的话，我想去帮助它...... [wa o ， ru guo wo bu yin wei ta shi tu wa chu wo de yan jing er gan dao sheng qi de hua ， wo xiang qu bang zhu ta ......]

english: Well, we have the door completed, so now all that's left to do is to put it up in Draynor.
translation: 好吧，我们已经完成了门，所以现在剩下要做的就是把它放在德拉诺。 [hao ba ， wo men yi jing wan cheng le men ， suo yi xian zai sheng xia yao zuo de jiu shi ba ta fang zai de la nuo 。]

english: How many doors are there in Draynor?
translation: 德雷诺有多少扇门？ [de lei nuo you duo shao shan men ？]

english: There's... six or seven, I think. Why?
translation: 我想有……六七个。为什么？ [wo xiang you …… liu qi ge 。 wei shen me ？]

english: We're not going to need to go through this six or seven times, are we?
translation: 我们不需要经历六七次，不是吗？ [wo men bu xu yao jing li liu qi ci ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Hah, silly human! No, I thought this through.
translation: 哈哈，愚蠢的人类！ No, I thought this through. [ha ha ， yu chun de ren lei ！ No, I thought this through.]

english: I got enough decorations for all of Draynor going around.
translation: 我有足够的装饰品供所有德雷诺人使用。 [wo you zu gou de zhuang shi pin gong suo you de lei nuo ren shi yong 。]

english: The plan is, we swap out that first door we painted for this one. Then we decorate that first door, swap it out for another one, decorate, swap, repeat!
translation: 计划是，我们把我们画的第一扇门换成这扇门。然后我们装饰第一扇门，将其换成另一扇，装饰，交换，重复！ [ji hua shi ， wo men ba wo men hua de di yi shan men huan cheng zhe shan men 。 ran hou wo men zhuang shi di yi shan men ， jiang qi huan cheng ling yi shan ， zhuang shi ， jiao huan ， chong fu ！]

english: That way I only need to lug one door all the way down to Draynor.
translation: 这样我只需要拖着一扇门一直到德雷诺。 [zhe yang wo zhi xu yao tuo zhe yi shan men yi zhi dao de lei nuo 。]

english: That's... actually pretty smart.
translation: 这……其实很聪明。 [zhe …… qi shi hen cong ming 。]

english: Yeah, when you do Easter decorations for a few years you get pretty good at logistics.
translation: 是的，当你做了几年复活节装饰后，你就会非常擅长物流。 [shi de ， dang ni zuo le ji nian fu huo jie zhuang shi hou ， ni jiu hui fei chang shan chang wu liu 。]

english: See you in Draynor, human! Talk to me again if you want a teleport there!
translation: 人类，德拉诺见！如果你想传送到那里，请再跟我说话！ [ren lei ， de la nuo jian ！ ru guo ni xiang chuan song dao na li ， qing zai gen wo shuo hua ！]

english: Draynor Village is decorated with Easter eggs on the ground, festive poles, and seven colourful doors.
translation: 德拉诺村的地面上装饰着复活节彩蛋、节日柱子和七扇色彩缤纷的门。 [de la nuo cun de di mian shang zhuang shi zhe fu huo jie cai dan 、 jie ri zhu zi he qi shan se cai bin fen de men 。]

english: Oh, I see you put the door in already.
translation: 哦，我看到你已经把门关上了。 [o ， wo kan dao ni yi jing ba men guan shang le 。]

english: Gregg can no longer be found at the lumberyard. (Thessalia's beliefs about Gregg's presence in the lumberyard are not changed.)
translation: 在伐木场再也找不到格雷格了。 （瑟萨莉亚对格雷格在伐木场的存在的信念没有改变。） [zai fa mu chang zai ye zhao bu dao ge lei ge le 。 （ se sa li ya dui ge lei ge zai fa mu chang de cun zai de xin nian mei you gai bian 。）]

english: I... Human, I didn't do this..
translation: 我……人类，我没有这么做…… [wo …… ren lei ， wo mei you zhe me zuo ……]

english: Wait, someone else decorated this door?
translation: 等等，这扇门还有人装饰过吗？ [deng deng ， zhe shan men hai you ren zhuang shi guo ma ？]

english: The camera fades to black and a cutscene begins.
translation: 镜头逐渐变黑，过场动画开始。 [jing tou zhu jian bian hei ， guo chang dong hua kai shi 。]

english: I have no idea. I just came back and this door's been fully decorated without us!
translation: 我不知道。我刚回来，这门已经装修完了，没有我们！ [wo bu zhi dao 。 wo gang hui lai ， zhe men yi jing zhuang xiu wan le ， mei you wo men ！]

english: The Wise Old Man starts walking from his house to in front of the bank in the background.
translation: 智者老人开始从他的房子走到背景中的银行前。 [zhi zhe lao ren kai shi cong ta de fang zi zou dao bei jing zhong de yin hang qian 。]

english: Look around - it looks like the whole has been decorated too!
translation: 环顾四周，好像整个都被装饰过了！ [huan gu si zhou ， hao xiang zheng ge dou bei zhuang shi guo le ！]

english: The Wise Old Man starts walking towards the crossroad.
translation: 智者开始向十字路口走去。 [zhi zhe kai shi xiang shi zi lu kou zou qu 。]

english: I wonder who could have decorated an entire village so quickly...?
translation: 不知道谁能这么快就把整个村庄装饰得漂漂亮亮的……？ [bu zhi dao shui neng zhe me kuai jiu ba zheng ge cun zhuang zhuang shi de piao piao liang liang de ……？]

english: Perhaps I can answer to that question.
translation: 也许我可以回答这个问题。 [ye xu wo ke yi hui da zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Wise Old Man leaves, walks back towards his house. The camera fades to black, and the cutscene ends.
translation: 贤老离开，朝自家走去。镜头逐渐变黑，过场动画结束。 [xian lao li kai ， chao zi jia zou qu 。 jing tou zhu jian bian hei ， guo chang dong hua jie shu 。]

english: The player can now ask Wise Old Man more about the Easter event, while he's at home in his house.
translation: 玩家现在可以在智者家里向他询问有关复活节活动的更多信息。 [wan jia xian zai ke yi zai zhi zhe jia li xiang ta xun wen you guan fu huo jie huo dong de geng duo xin xi 。]

english: I feel like he kind of glossed over the part where three people decorated an entire village in 10 minutes...
translation: 我觉得他有点掩盖了三个人在 10 分钟内装饰整个村庄的部分...... [wo jue de ta you dian yan gai le san ge ren zai  10  fen zhong nei zhuang shi zheng ge cun zhuang de bu fen ......]

english: Human, did you hear that...?
translation: 人类，你听到了吗……？ [ren lei ， ni ting dao le ma ……？]

english: The part where we trekked all across Misthalin for nothing?
translation: 我们徒劳地穿越米沙林的那部分？ [wo men tu lao di chuan yue mi sha lin de na bu fen ？]

english: No, not that!
translation: 不，不是那样！ [bu ， bu shi na yang ！]

english: Though I suppose we did do that as well, didn't we...
translation: 虽然我想我们也这么做了，不是吗…… [sui ran wo xiang wo men ye zhe me zuo le ， bu shi ma ……]

english: But no, right at the end!
translation: 但不，就在最后！ [dan bu ， jiu zai zui hou ！]

english: He called you a... strange rabbit?
translation: 他称你为……奇怪的兔子？ [ta cheng ni wei …… qi guai de tu zi ？]

english: Exactly! He didn't call me an Easter bunny or a cute rabbit or anything like that!
translation: 确切地！他没有叫我复活节兔子或可爱的兔子或类似的东西！ [que qie di ！ ta mei you jiao wo fu huo jie tu zi huo ke ai de tu zi huo lei si de dong xi ！]

english: He was so focused on Eastdoor he didn't make the connection!
translation: 他太专注于东门，以至于没有意识到其中的联系！ [ta tai zhuan zhu yu dong men ， yi zhi yu mei you yi shi dao qi zhong de lian xi ！]

english: So your plan... worked?
translation: 那么你的计划……成功了吗？ [na me ni de ji hua …… cheng gong le ma ？]

english: Yep! Though admittedly, not how I thought it would.
translation: 是的！虽然不可否认，但不是我想象的那样。 [shi de ！ sui ran bu ke fou ren ， dan bu shi wo xiang xiang de na yang 。]

english: Well, I'm glad I could try and help at least.
translation: 嗯，我很高兴至少可以尝试提供帮助。 [n ， wo hen gao xing zhi shao ke yi chang shi ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: Thanks for everything, human!
translation: 感谢你所做的一切，人类！ [gan xie ni suo zuo de yi qie ， ren lei ！]

english: I'd like to give you a reward, but you don't have the space. Could you free up one space in your inventory?
translation: 我想给你奖励，但你没有空间。您可以释放库存中的一个空间吗？ [wo xiang gei ni jiang li ， dan ni mei you kong jian 。 nin ke yi shi fang ku cun zhong de yi ge kong jian ma ？]

english: I'll tell you what - seeing as we don't need it any more, how would you like to keep this door?
translation: 我告诉你——既然我们不再需要它了，你想保留这扇门吗？ [wo gao su ni —— ji ran wo men bu zai xu yao ta le ， ni xiang bao liu zhe shan men ma ？]

english: I'm... not entirely sure what I'm going to do with it, but thanks.
translation: 我……不完全确定我要用它做什么，但是谢谢。 [wo …… bu wan quan que ding wo yao yong ta zuo shen me ， dan shi xie xie 。]

english: Any time! Oh, that reminds me - you can have the hat that nice lady gave to me as well!
translation: 任何时间！哦，这让我想起了——你也可以拥有那位好女士送给我的帽子！ [ren he shi jian ！ o ， zhe rang wo xiang qi le —— ni ye ke yi yong you na wei hao nv shi song gei wo de mao zi ！]

english: Didn't you want it?
translation: 你不想要吗？ [ni bu xiang yao ma ？]

english: Well, yes, but I don't think I can actually wear it.
translation: 嗯，是的，但我想我实际上不能穿它。 [n ， shi de ， dan wo xiang wo shi ji shang bu neng chuan ta 。]

english: Gregg gives you the decorated door and his garish hat.
translation: 格雷格给了你装饰好的门和他花哨的帽子。 [ge lei ge gei le ni zhuang shi hao de men he ta hua shao de mao zi 。]

english: Merry Easter, human!
translation: 复活节快乐，人类！ [fu huo jie kuai le ， ren lei ！]

english: Merry Easter, human! Did you want anything?
translation: 复活节快乐，人类！你想要什么吗？ [fu huo jie kuai le ， ren lei ！ ni xiang yao shen me ma ？]

english: What will you do now?
translation: 你现在要做什么？ [ni xian zai yao zuo shen me ？]

english: Hmmm... I haven't put too much thought into it, actually.
translation: 嗯……其实我并没有考虑太多。 [n …… qi shi wo bing mei you kao lv tai duo 。]

english: I was meant to be helping the people of Draynor with Easter, but seeing as they helped themselves, I have some time on my hands!
translation: 我本打算在复活节帮助德雷诺人民，但看到他们自助了，我还有时间！ [wo ben da suan zai fu huo jie bang zhu de lei nuo ren min ， dan kan dao ta men zi zhu le ， wo hai you shi jian ！]

english: I might just use it to relax a little bit. It's not often rabbits get time off.
translation: 我可能只是用它来放松一下。兔子很少有休息时间。 [wo ke neng zhi shi yong ta lai fang song yi xia 。 tu zi hen shao you xiu xi shi jian 。]

english: Time off? But I only see you around Easter!
translation: 休息时间？但我只在复活节前后见到你！ [xiu xi shi jian ？ dan wo zhi zai fu huo jie qian hou jian dao ni ！]

english: Oh, you don't know the half of it, human...
translation: 噢，你连一半都不知道，人类…… [o ， ni lian yi ban dou bu zhi dao ， ren lei ……]

english: You know, it just occuredto me I never actually asked what your name is.
translation: 你知道，我突然想到我从来没有真正问过你叫什么名字。 [ni zhi dao ， wo tu ran xiang dao wo cong lai mei you zhen zheng wen guo ni jiao shen me ming zi 。]

english: My name is Gregg!
translation: 我的名字是格雷格！ [wo de ming zi shi ge lei ge ！]

english: Greg?
translation: 格雷格？ [ge lei ge ？]

english: No, with 3 gs.
translation: 不，有 3 g。 [bu ， you  3 g。]

english: Greggg?
translation: 格雷格？ [ge lei ge ？]

english: Now you're just being silly, human.
translation: 现在你只是愚蠢，人类。 [xian zai ni zhi shi yu chun ， ren lei 。]

english: Sorry.
translation: 对不起。 [dui bu qi 。]

english: I don't actually know your name, either. I've just been calling you human this whole time.
translation: 其实我也不知道你的名字。我一直以来都称你为人类。 [qi shi wo ye bu zhi dao ni de ming zi 。 wo yi zhi yi lai dou cheng ni wei ren lei 。]

english: I'm [name].
translation: 我是[名字]。 [wo shi [ ming zi ]。]

english: [name]? I'm not a fan, honestly.
translation: [姓名]？老实说，我不是粉丝。 [[ xing ming ]？ lao shi shuo ， wo bu shi fen si 。]

english: I'm going to keep calling you human, human!
translation: 我会继续称你为人类，人类！ [wo hui ji xu cheng ni wei ren lei ， ren lei ！]

english: Will you be around next year?
translation: 明年你还会在吗？ [ming nian ni hai hui zai ma ？]

english: Hmm... I don't know, human. We don't usually start making plans for Easter until at least halfway through the year.
translation: 嗯...我不知道，人类。我们通常至少要到年中才开始制定复活节计划。 [n ... wo bu zhi dao ， ren lei 。 wo men tong chang zhi shao yao dao nian zhong cai kai shi zhi ding fu huo jie ji hua 。]

english: But if I am around, I hope I get to talk to you again!
translation: 但如果我在的话，我希望能再次与你交谈！ [dan ru guo wo zai de hua ， wo xi wang neng zai ci yu ni jiao tan ！]

english: So long, human!
translation: 再见，人类！ [zai jian ， ren lei ！]

english: Wow, human, that hat looks great on you!
translation: 哇，人类，这顶帽子戴在你身上真好看！ [wa ， ren lei ， zhe ding mao zi dai zai ni shen shang zhen hao kan ！]

english: Really? I thought it looked a bit silly.
translation: 真的吗？我觉得这看起来有点傻。 [zhen de ma ？ wo jue de zhe kan qi lai you dian sha 。]

english: Well, I think it looks amazing! Really suits you. Anyway, did you want anything?
translation: 嗯，我觉得它看起来棒极了！真的很适合你。无论如何，你想要什么吗？ [n ， wo jue de ta kan qi lai bang ji le ！ zhen de hen shi he ni 。 wu lun ru he ， ni xiang yao shen me ma ？]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: I'll speak to Aggie, give me the ingredients.
translation: 我会和阿吉说话，给我原料。 [wo hui he a ji shuo hua ， gei wo yuan liao 。]

english: Why don't you go?
translation: 你为什么不走？ [ni wei shen me bu zou ？]

english: What am I meant to be doing again?
translation: 我又该做什么？ [wo you gai zuo shen me ？]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Do you have more ingredients?
translation: 你还有更多的配料吗？ [ni hai you geng duo de pei liao ma ？]

english: Yes, take me to Lumbridge.
translation: 是的，带我去伦布里奇。 [shi de ， dai wo qu lun bu li qi 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: How can you even teleport?
translation: 你怎么能传送？ [ni zen me neng chuan song ？]

english: I need a new pair of shears.
translation: 我需要一把新剪刀。 [wo xu yao yi ba xin jian dao 。]

english: How are you doing?
translation: 你好吗？ [ni hao ma ？]

english: What am I meant to be doing?
translation: 我到底要做什么？ [wo dao di yao zuo shen me ？]

english: Yes, teleport me to Varrock.
translation: 是的，将我传送到瓦罗克。 [shi de ， jiang wo chuan song dao wa luo ke 。]

english: What do you know about the dark wizards?
translation: 关于黑巫师你了解多少？ [guan yu hei wu shi ni liao jie duo shao ？]

english: Yes, take me to Draynor.
translation: 是的，带我去德雷诺。 [shi de ， dai wo qu de lei nuo 。]

english: Are you alright after that cat attacked you?
translation: 那只猫袭击你之后你还好吗？ [na zhi mao xi ji ni zhi hou ni hai hao ma ？]

english: What will you do now?
translation: 你现在要做什么？ [ni xian zai yao zuo shen me ？]

english: I never actually asked what your name is.
translation: 我从来没有真正问过你叫什么名字。 [wo cong lai mei you zhen zheng wen guo ni jiao shen me ming zi 。]

english: Will you be around next year?
translation: 明年你还会在吗？ [ming nian ni hai hui zai ma ？]

english: What are you drinking?
translation: 你喝什么？ [ni he shen me ？]

english: Blood!
translation: 血！ [xue ！]

english: How are you getting drunk on blood?
translation: 怎么会喝醉了血呢？ [zen me hui he zui le xue ne ？]

english: They keep some of the tithes drunk all the time and then take it from them.
translation: 他们把一些十分之一的钱一直喝在酒里，然后从他们那里拿走。 [ta men ba yi xie shi fen zhi yi de qian yi zhi he zai jiu li ， ran hou cong ta men na li na zou 。]

english: How very creative.
translation: 多么有创意啊。 [duo me you chuang yi a 。]

english: I know right! Bloody brilliant!
translation: 我知道，对吧！太棒了！ [wo zhi dao ， dui ba ！ tai bang le ！]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: I'll have a pint please.
translation: 请给我一品脱。 [qing gei wo yi pin tuo 。]

english: I don't work here.
translation: 我不在这里工作。 [wo bu zai zhe li gong zuo 。]

english: Sure you do!
translation: 当然可以！ [dang ran ke yi ！]

english: No, I really don't.
translation: 不，我真的不知道。 [bu ， wo zhen de bu zhi dao 。]

english: Well clear off then.
