english: These are the stairs down to the mining caves. There are rich veins of many types down there, and miners too. Though be careful; some of the trolls occasionally sneak into the far end of the cave.
translation: 这些是通往采矿洞穴的楼梯。那里有多种类型的丰富矿脉，也有矿工。虽然要小心；一些巨魔偶尔会潜入洞穴的尽头。 [zhe xie shi tong wang cai kuang dong xue de lou ti 。 na li you duo zhong lei xing de feng fu kuang mai ， ye you kuang gong 。 sui ran yao xiao xin ； yi xie ju mo ou er hui qian ru dong xue de jin tou 。]

english: Thanks. I'll look out for them.
translation: 谢谢。我会照顾他们的。 [xie xie 。 wo hui zhao gu ta men de 。]

english: Party! Party!
translation: 派对！派对！ [pai dui ！ pai dui ！]

english: Something's happening in the party room!
translation: 宴会厅里出事了！ [yan hui ting li chu shi le ！]

english: Everyone get to the party room!
translation: 大家都到宴会厅去吧！ [da jia dou dao yan hui ting qu ba ！]

english: What's happening in the party room?
translation: 宴会厅里发生了什么？ [yan hui ting li fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: Someone's having a big party!
translation: 有人要举办盛大的聚会！ [you ren yao ju ban sheng da de ju hui ！]

english: Get to the party room NOW!
translation: 立即前往派对室！ [li ji qian wang pai dui shi ！]

english: Get to the party room!
translation: 快去宴会厅吧！ [kuai qu yan hui ting ba ！]

english: Get to the party room quick!
translation: 快去聚会室吧！ [kuai qu ju hui shi ba ！]

english: Big value items in the party room now!
translation: 现在派对房间里有超值物品！ [xian zai pai dui fang jian li you chao zhi wu pin ！]

english: Quick! Get to the party room!
translation: 快的！快去宴会厅吧！ [kuai de ！ kuai qu yan hui ting ba ！]

english: Woah, what's happened to me?!
translation: 哇哦，我这是怎么了？！ [wa o ， wo zhe shi zen me le ？！]

english: Oi you! What are you doing on this side of the portal?
translation: 哎呀你！你在门户的这一边做什么？ [ai ya ni ！ ni zai men hu de zhe yi bian zuo shen me ？]

english: Go report to the Duke in the castle, the greater yolk didn't tell you to return.
translation: 去城堡里向公爵报告吧，大蛋黄并没有叫你回去。 [qu cheng bao li xiang gong jue bao gao ba ， da dan huang bing mei you jiao ni hui qu 。]

english: Why are you talking to me, go report to the Duke in the castle, the egg will find a way to deal with you.
translation: 你跟我说话干嘛，去城堡里向公爵报告吧，蛋会想办法对付你的。 [ni gen wo shuo hua gan ma ， qu cheng bao li xiang gong jue bao gao ba ， dan hui xiang ban fa dui fu ni de 。]

english: You're free to do as you wish, but I'll be keeping my ears on you.
translation: 你可以随心所欲，但我会密切关注你的动向。 [ni ke yi sui xin suo yu ， dan wo hui mi qie guan zhu ni de dong xiang 。]

english: Be on your way.
translation: 上路吧。 [shang lu ba 。]

english: You don't want to mess with me, human.
translation: 你不想惹我，人类。 [ni bu xiang re wo ， ren lei 。]

english: If you're thinking of trying anything, you'll quickly find yourself regretting it.
translation: 如果你想尝试任何事情，你很快就会发现自己后悔。 [ru guo ni xiang chang shi ren he shi qing ， ni hen kuai jiu hui fa xian zi ji hou hui 。]

english: I'm watching you, human.
translation: 我正在看着你，人类。 [wo zheng zai kan zhe ni ， ren lei 。]

english: Move along.
translation: 继续前进。 [ji xu qian jin 。]

english: What do you think you're doing, human?
translation: 你认为你在做什么，人类？ [ni ren wei ni zai zuo shen me ， ren lei ？]

english: Oh... I was just going to check out the inside of this house.
translation: 哦……我只是想看看这房子的内部。 [o …… wo zhi shi xiang kan kan zhe fang zi de nei bu 。]

english: This isn't a house, it's a... Actually, human, it's none of your business!
translation: 这不是房子，这是……其实，人类，不关你的事！ [zhe bu shi fang zi ， zhe shi …… qi shi ， ren lei ， bu guan ni de shi ！]

english: Well now you've just made me curious. What's in there?
translation: 好吧，现在你让我很好奇。里面有什么？ [hao ba ， xian zai ni rang wo hen hao qi 。 li mian you shen me ？]

english: Go away!
translation: 离开！ [li kai ！]

english: Is it a really large anvil?
translation: 它真的是一个大铁砧吗？ [ta zhen de shi yi ge da tie zhen ma ？]

english: Final warning!
translation: 最后警告！ [zui hou jing gao ！]

english: Is it a dwarf with a really long beard?
translation: 这是一个留着很长胡子的侏儒吗？ [zhe shi yi ge liu zhe hen zhang hu zi de zhu ru ma ？]

english: Why don't you ask me again?!
translation: 你为什么不再问我一次？！ [ni wei shen me bu zai wen wo yi ci ？！]

english: If you insist...
translation: 如果你坚持... [ru guo ni jian chi ...]

english: Ask me another question! I dare you!
translation: 再问我一个问题！我赌你！ [zai wen wo yi ge wen ti ！ wo du ni ！]

english: Okay, okay! I'm leaving.
translation: 好吧好吧！我要走了。 [hao ba hao ba ！ wo yao zou le 。]

english: Is it a dwarf with a really long beard?
translation: 这是一个留着很长胡子的侏儒吗？ [zhe shi yi ge liu zhe hen zhang hu zi de zhu ru ma ？]

english: If you insist...
translation: 如果你坚持... [ru guo ni jian chi ...]

english: Okay, okay! I'm leaving.
translation: 好吧好吧！我要走了。 [hao ba hao ba ！ wo yao zou le 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello there. I haven't seen you around here before. If you've come to admire the Carnillean family home, I must warn you not to cause any trouble.
translation: 你好呀。我以前没在这附近见过你。如果你是来欣赏卡尼尔家族的宅邸的，我必须警告你不要惹出任何麻烦。 [ni hao ya 。 wo yi qian mei zai zhe fu jin jian guo ni 。 ru guo ni shi lai xin shang ka ni er jia zu de zhai di de ， wo bi xu jing gao ni bu yao re chu ren he ma fan 。]

english: Due to recent criminal activities against such prominent Ardougnians, I have been sent here on special guard duty to ensure the Carnilleans' security.
translation: 由于最近针对这些著名的阿杜尼亚人的犯罪活动，我被派到这里执行特别警卫任务，以确保卡尼利亚人的安全。 [you yu zui jin zhen dui zhe xie zhu ming de a du ni ya ren de fan zui huo dong ， wo bei pai dao zhe li zhi xing te bie jing wei ren wu ， yi que bao ka ni li ya ren de an quan 。]

english: Anyone caught interfering with the person or possessions of any Carnilleans will be taken to jail so quickly that their feet won't even touch the floor!
translation: 任何人如果被发现干扰卡尼利亚人的人身或财产，很快就会被送进监狱，以至于他们的脚甚至不会接触地板！ [ren he ren ru guo bei fa xian gan rao ka ni li ya ren de ren shen huo cai chan ， hen kuai jiu hui bei song jin jian yu ， yi zhi yu ta men de jiao shen zhi bu hui jie chu di ban ！]

english: Well, I wasn't actually planning on doing anything like that...
translation: 好吧，我其实并没有打算做那样的事情...... [hao ba ， wo qi shi bing mei you da suan zuo na yang de shi qing ......]

english: Glad to hear it.
translation: 很高兴听到这个消息。 [hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi 。]

english: Well well well... if it isn't our very own local hero. Good to see you managed to clear your name I always had faith in you!
translation: 好吧好吧……如果这不是我们当地的英雄的话。很高兴看到你成功洗清罪名，我一直对你有信心！ [hao ba hao ba …… ru guo zhe bu shi wo men dang di de ying xiong de hua 。 hen gao xing kan dao ni cheng gong xi qing zui ming ， wo yi zhi dui ni you xin xin ！]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Hello, adventurer. It's a shame you never found that cult. We have a horrible suspicion that there's been another burglary.
translation: 你好，冒险家。很遗憾你从未发现这个邪教。我们非常怀疑又发生了入室盗窃案。 [ni hao ， mao xian jia 。 hen yi han ni cong wei fa xian zhe ge xie jiao 。 wo men fei chang huai yi you fa sheng le ru shi dao qie an 。]

english: That's worrying.
translation: 这令人担忧。 [zhe ling ren dan you 。]

english: Yes, it is. The thing is, we can't even work out what they've taken! It's all very odd.
translation: 是的。问题是，我们甚至无法弄清楚他们拿走了什么！这一切都很奇怪。 [shi de 。 wen ti shi ， wo men shen zhi wu fa nong qing chu ta men na zou le shen me ！ zhe yi qie dou hen qi guai 。]

english: Is there anything more I can do to help?
translation: 还有什么我可以帮忙的吗？ [hai you shen me wo ke yi bang mang de ma ？]

english: I don't think so. Sir Ceril says you've done enough.
translation: 我不这么认为。塞里尔爵士说你已经做得足够了。 [wo bu zhe me ren wei 。 sai li er jue shi shuo ni yi jing zuo de zu gou le 。]

english: Don't you try anything, surface-dweller. I'm keeping an eye on you.
translation: 不要尝试任何事情，地表居民。我正在关注你。 [bu yao chang shi ren he shi qing ， di biao ju min 。 wo zheng zai guan zhu ni 。]

english: Welcome, surface-dweller, to the hidden city of Dorgesh-Kaan!
translation: 欢迎，地表居民，来到隐藏的城市多尔格什-卡恩！ [huan ying ， di biao ju min ， lai dao yin cang de cheng shi duo er ge shen - ka en ！]

english: Surface-dweller!
translation: 地表居民！ [di biao ju min ！]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: Have a nice day!
translation: 祝你今天过得愉快！ [zhu ni jin tian guo de yu kuai ！]

english: I don't want to be unfriendly, but I can't help noticing that since surface-dwellers started coming into the city there has been an increase in CRIME!
translation: 我不想表现得不友好，但我不禁注意到，自从地表居民开始进入城市以来，犯罪率一直在增加！ [wo bu xiang biao xian de bu you hao ， dan wo bu jin zhu yi dao ， zi cong di biao ju min kai shi jin ru cheng shi yi lai ， fan zui lv yi zhi zai zeng jia ！]

english: Surface-dweller! I don't know how you got into the city, but you will never escape!
translation: 地表居民！我不知道你是怎么进城的，但你永远也逃不掉！ [di biao ju min ！ wo bu zhi dao ni shi zen me jin cheng de ， dan ni yong yuan ye tao bu diao ！]

english: But... I thought I was allowed into the city!
translation: 但是……我以为我被允许进城了！ [dan shi …… wo yi wei wo bei yun xu jin cheng le ！]

english: You are. I just wanted to say that. And now that you're allowed into the city, I'll never be able to!
translation: 你是。我只是想说这个。现在你被允许进城了，我就永远不能进了！ [ni shi 。 wo zhi shi xiang shuo zhe ge 。 xian zai ni bei yun xu jin cheng le ， wo jiu yong yuan bu neng jin le ！]

english: Hello soldier.
translation: 你好，士兵。 [ni hao ， shi bing 。]

english: I'm more of an adventurer really.
translation: 我实际上更像是一个冒险家。 [wo shi ji shang geng xiang shi yi ge mao xian jia 。]

english: In this day and age we're all soldiers. No time to waste gassing, Fight! Fight! Fight!
translation: 在这个时代，我们都是士兵。没时间浪费气了，战斗吧！斗争！斗争！ [zai zhe ge shi dai ， wo men dou shi shi bing 。 mei shi jian lang fei qi le ， zhan dou ba ！ dou zheng ！ dou zheng ！]

english: Well hello brave warrior. These ogres have been terrorising the area, they've eaten four children this week alone.
translation: 好吧，勇敢的战士你好。这些食人魔一直在这个地区制造恐怖，仅本周他们就吃掉了四个孩子。 [hao ba ， yong gan de zhan shi ni hao 。 zhe xie shi ren mo yi zhi zai zhe ge di qu zhi zao kong bu ， jin ben zhou ta men jiu chi diao le si ge hai zi 。]

english: Brutes!
translation: 畜生！ [chu sheng ！]

english: So we decided to use them for target practice. A fair punishment.
translation: 所以我们决定用它们来进行打靶练习。公平的惩罚。 [suo yi wo men jue ding yong ta men lai jin xing da ba lian xi 。 gong ping de cheng fa 。]

english: Indeed.
translation: 的确。 [di que 。]

english: What do you want? Leave us be!
translation: 你想要什么？让我们去吧！ [ni xiang yao shen me ？ rang wo men qu ba ！]

english: Welcome to the Seers' Village courthouse. Court is not in session today, so you're not allowed downstairs.
translation: 欢迎来到先知村法院。法庭今天不开庭，所以你不能下楼。 [huan ying lai dao xian zhi cun fa yuan 。 fa ting jin tian bu kai ting ， suo yi ni bu neng xia lou 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: The Seers' Village courthouse. We give all criminals a fair trial, by a jury of their peers. Or whoever we can round up from the pub.
translation: 先知村法院。我们由同行组成的陪审团对所有罪犯进行公平审判。或者我们能从酒吧里找到的任何人。 [xian zhi cun fa yuan 。 wo men you tong hang zu cheng de pei shen tuan dui suo you zui fan jin xing gong ping shen pan 。 huo zhe wo men neng cong jiu ba li zhao dao de ren he ren 。]

english: You're a long way out from the city.
translation: 你离城市很远。 [ni li cheng shi hen yuan 。]

english: I know. We guards usually stay by banks and shops, but I got sent all the way out here to keep an eye on the brigands loitering just south of here.
translation: 我知道。我们的警卫通常呆在银行和商店附近，但我被派到这里监视南边徘徊的强盗。 [wo zhi dao 。 wo men de jing wei tong chang dai zai yin hang he shang dian fu jin ， dan wo bei pai dao zhe li jian shi nan bian pai huai de qiang dao 。]

english: It sounds more exciting than standing around guarding banks and shops.
translation: 这听起来比守卫银行和商店更令人兴奋。 [zhe ting qi lai bi shou wei yin hang he shang dian geng ling ren xing fen 。]

english: It's not too bad. At least I don't get attacked so often out here. Guards in the cities get killed all the time.
translation: 还不错。至少我在这里不会经常受到攻击。城市里的守卫经常被杀。 [hai bu cuo 。 zhi shao wo zai zhe li bu hui jing chang shou dao gong ji 。 cheng shi li de shou wei jing chang bei sha 。]

english: Honestly, people these days just don't know how to behave!
translation: 老实说，现在的人就是不知道如何做人！ [lao shi shuo ， xian zai de ren jiu shi bu zhi dao ru he zuo ren ！]

english: Don't distract me while I'm on duty! This mine has to be protected!
translation: 我值班的时候别打扰我！这个矿井必须保护！ [wo zhi ban de shi hou bie da rao wo ！ zhe ge kuang jing bi xu bao hu ！]

english: What's going to attack a mine?
translation: 什么会攻击地雷？ [shen me hui gong ji di lei ？]

english: Goblins! They wander everywhere, attacking anyone they think is small enough to be an easy victim. We need more cannons to fight them off properly.
translation: 哥布林！它们到处游荡，攻击任何它们认为小到容易成为受害者的人。我们需要更多的大炮来有效地击退他们。 [ge bu lin ！ ta men dao chu you dang ， gong ji ren he ta men ren wei xiao dao rong yi cheng wei shou hai zhe de ren 。 wo men xu yao geng duo de da pao lai you xiao di ji tui ta men 。]

english: Cannons? Those sound expensive.
translation: 大炮？那些听起来很贵。 [da pao ？ na xie ting qi lai hen gui 。]

english: A new cannon can cost 750,000 coins, and the ammo isn't easy to get, but they do up to 30 hitpoints of damage with each shot. When you've got an important mine like this one to protect, it's worth the expense.
translation: 一门新大炮要花费 750,000 金币，弹药也不容易获得，但每次射击最多造成 30 点伤害。当你有像这样的重要矿井需要保护时，付出的代价是值得的。 [yi men xin da pao yao hua fei  750,000  jin bi ， dan yao ye bu rong yi huo de ， dan mei ci she ji zui duo zao cheng  30  dian shang hai 。 dang ni you xiang zhe yang de zhong yao kuang jing xu yao bao hu shi ， fu chu de dai jia shi zhi de de 。]

english: Thanks for the information.
translation: 感谢您提供信息。 [gan xie nin ti gong xin xi 。]

english: You're welcome. Now please let me get on with my guard duties.
translation: 不客气。现在请让我继续我的警卫职责。 [bu ke qi 。 xian zai qing rang wo ji xu wo de jing wei zhi ze 。]

english: Well, I've done my bit to help with that.
translation: 嗯，我已经尽力帮助解决这个问题了。 [n ， wo yi jing jin li bang zhu jie jue zhe ge wen ti le 。]

english: Yes, I heard. Now please let me get on with my guard duties.
translation: 是的，我听说了。现在请让我继续我的警卫职责。 [shi de ， wo ting shuo le 。 xian zai qing rang wo ji xu wo de jing wei zhi ze 。]

english: Alright, I'll leave you alone now.
translation: 好吧，我现在就不打扰你了。 [hao ba ， wo xian zai jiu bu da rao ni le 。]

english: Please don't disturb me, I've got to keep any eye out for suspicious individuals.
translation: 请不要打扰我，我必须留意可疑人员。 [qing bu yao da rao wo ， wo bi xu liu yi ke yi ren yuan 。]

english: I'm surprised you managed to get out of there without breaking any bones.
translation: 我很惊讶你竟然能在没有骨折的情况下离开那里。 [wo hen jing ya ni jing ran neng zai mei you gu zhe de qing kuang xia li kai na li 。]

english: Still, the Queen says it should be safe, and I'm to let you go back down if you want.
translation: 尽管如此，女王说这里应该是安全的，如果你愿意的话我会让你回去。 [jin guan ru ci ， nv wang shuo zhe li ying gai shi an quan de ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua wo hui rang ni hui qu 。]

english: Stand back. This area is restricted.
translation: 退后一点。该区域受到限制。 [tui hou yi dian 。 gai qu yu shou dao xian zhi 。]

english: What's so special about it?
translation: 它有什么特别之处？ [ta you shen me te bie zhi chu ？]

english: That's none of your business.
translation: 那不关你的事。 [na bu guan ni de shi 。]

english: I think I've left some of my loot in there. Can I get it quick?
translation: 我想我把一些战利品留在那里了。我能快点拿到吗？ [wo xiang wo ba yi xie zhan li pin liu zai na li le 。 wo neng kuai dian na dao ma ？]

english: Nice try, Rookie.
translation: 不错的尝试，菜鸟。 [bu cuo de chang shi ， cai niao 。]

english: What if I share some of it with you?
translation: 如果我与你分享一些怎么样？ [ru guo wo yu ni fen xiang yi xie zen me yang ？]

english: I do not care for wealth. Now move along.
translation: 我不关心财富。现在继续前进。 [wo bu guan xin cai fu 。 xian zai ji xu qian jin 。]

english: May I pass?
translation: 我可以通过吗？ [wo ke yi tong guo ma ？]

english: You shall not... *cough*
translation: 你不应该... *咳嗽* [ni bu ying gai ... * ke sou *]

english: No one is allowed past I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕没有人可以过去。 [kong pa mei you ren ke yi guo qu 。]

english: How suspicious...
translation: 多么可疑... [duo me ke yi ...]

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你认为你在做什么？ [ni ren wei ni zai zuo shen me ？]

english: Welcome, [Fremennik name].
translation: 欢迎，[弗雷曼尼克名字]。 [huan ying ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。]

english: Are you all right? Leftie?
translation: 你还好吗？左撇子？ [ni hai hao ma ？ zuo pie zi ？]

english: No, I'm on the left.
translation: 不，我在左边。 [bu ， wo zai zuo bian 。]

english: Only from your perspective. Someone entering the gate should call you Rightie, right Leftie?
translation: 仅从您的角度来看。进门的人应该叫你Rightie，对Leftie吗？ [jin cong nin de jiao du lai kan 。 jin men de ren ying gai jiao ni Rightie， dui Leftie ma ？]

english: That's right Leftie, that's right.
translation: 没错，左撇子，没错。 [mei cuo ， zuo pie zi ， mei cuo 。]

english: No, Rightie's fine Leftie.
translation: 不，右撇子很好左撇子。 [bu ， you pie zi hen hao zuo pie zi 。]

english: Aaagh! Enough! If either of you mention left or right in my presence I'll have to scream! Can I come through the gate?
translation: 啊啊！足够的！如果你们中的任何一个在我面前提到左或右，我就得尖叫！我可以进门吗？ [a a ！ zu gou de ！ ru guo ni men zhong de ren he yi ge zai wo mian qian ti dao zuo huo you ， wo jiu de jian jiao ！ wo ke yi jin men ma ？]

english: Don't let us stop you.
translation: 别让我们阻止你。 [bie rang wo men zu zhi ni 。]

english: Yes, head right on in, sir.
translation: 是的，请直接进去，先生。 [shi de ， qing zhi jie jin qu ， xian sheng 。]

english: You said it! You said it! ARRRRRRRRGGH!
translation: 你说的是！你说的是！啊啊啊啊！ [ni shuo de shi ！ ni shuo de shi ！ a a a a ！]

english: You're free to go into the dungeons, your Highness.
translation: 您可以自由进入地牢了，殿下。 [nin ke yi zi you jin ru di lao le ， dian xia 。]

english: Try not to get eaten by those monsters.
translation: 尽量不要被那些怪物吃掉。 [jin liang bu yao bei na xie guai wu chi diao 。]

english: Halt! Are you here to sabotage the Motherlode Mine?
translation: 停止！你来这里是为了破坏母矿矿吗？ [ting zhi ！ ni lai zhe li shi wei le po huai mu kuang kuang ma ？]

english: What's the Motherlode Mine?
translation: 什么是母矿矿？ [shen me shi mu kuang kuang ？]

english: Prospector Percy discovered unusual mineral veins in this cave. Now he's built a machine to let us extract useful ores.
translation: 勘探员珀西在这个洞穴中发现了不寻常的矿脉。现在他建造了一台机器来让我们提取有用的矿石。 [kan tan yuan po xi zai zhe ge dong xue zhong fa xian le bu xun chang de kuang mai 。 xian zai ta jian zao le yi tai ji qi lai rang wo men ti qu you yong de kuang shi 。]

english: Percy calls it the Motherlode. I don't know why, and I'm not asking - that's between him and his mother.
translation: 珀西称之为母矿脉。我不知道为什么，我也不想问——那是他和他母亲之间的事。 [po xi cheng zhi wei mu kuang mai 。 wo bu zhi dao wei shen me ， wo ye bu xiang wen —— na shi ta he ta mu qin zhi jian de shi 。]

english: Dwarves don't normally let humans claim areas of the mine like this, but Percy's machine is really useful, so we struck a deal.
translation: 矮人通常不会让人类占领这样的矿区，但珀西的机器确实很有用，所以我们达成了协议。 [ai ren tong chang bu hui rang ren lei zhan ling zhe yang de kuang qu ， dan po xi de ji qi que shi hen you yong ， suo yi wo men da cheng le xie yi 。]

english: No, I'm not.
translation: 不，我不是。 [bu ， wo bu shi 。]

english: That's a relief. Have a nice day.
translation: 这真是一种解脱。祝你今天过得愉快。 [zhe zhen shi yi zhong jie tuo 。 zhu ni jin tian guo de yu kuai 。]

english: What would you do if I said 'yes'?
translation: 如果我说“是”你会怎么做？ [ru guo wo shuo “ shi ” ni hui zen me zuo ？]

english: I'd ask you not to.
translation: 我会要求你不要这样做。 [wo hui yao qiu ni bu yao zhe yang zuo 。]

english: What's the Motherlode Mine?
translation: 什么是母矿矿？ [shen me shi mu kuang kuang ？]

english: No, I'm not.
translation: 不，我不是。 [bu ， wo bu shi 。]

english: What would you do if I said 'yes'?
translation: 如果我说“是”你会怎么做？ [ru guo wo shuo “ shi ” ni hui zen me zuo ？]

english: You stay right there, outerlander.
translation: 你就待在那里，外地人。 [ni jiu dai zai na li ， wai di ren 。]

english: Don't worry, I'm not an outerlander, I am [Fremennik name], a Fremennik!
translation: 别担心，我不是外地人，我是[弗里曼尼克名字]，一个弗里曼尼克！ [bie dan xin ， wo bu shi wai di ren ， wo shi [ fu li man ni ke ming zi ]， yi ge fu li man ni ke ！]

english: I said stay there, outerlander! You are not welcome in our camp.
translation: 我说呆在那里，外地人！我们的营地不欢迎你。 [wo shuo dai zai na li ， wai di ren ！ wo men de ying di bu huan ying ni 。]

english: Why, what's beyond here?
translation: 为什么，这里外面是什么？ [wei shen me ， zhe li wai mian shi shen me ？]

english: Our camp, outerlander, and we don't want any trouble there.
translation: 我们的营地，外来者，我们不想在那里遇到任何麻烦。 [wo men de ying di ， wai lai zhe ， wo men bu xiang zai na li yu dao ren he ma fan 。]

english: I suppose I might as well let you pass now, since I can't seem to stop you anyway.
translation: 我想我现在还是让你过去吧，因为我似乎无论如何也无法阻止你。 [wo xiang wo xian zai hai shi rang ni guo qu ba ， yin wei wo si hu wu lun ru he ye wu fa zu zhi ni 。]

english: Just remember that I'm watching you.
translation: 只要记住我在看着你。 [zhi yao ji zhu wo zai kan zhe ni 。]

english: Go, outerlander, and do not hurry back.
translation: 走吧，外地人，别急着回来。 [zou ba ， wai di ren ， bie ji zhe hui lai 。]

english: You may pass freely, outerlander.
translation: 你可以自由通过，外地人。 [ni ke yi zi you tong guo ， wai di ren 。]

english: Hey, how did you get here?
translation: 嘿，你怎么到这里来了？ [hei ， ni zen me dao zhe li lai le ？]

english: Can you come and help me? The chieftain's daughter -
translation: 你能过来帮我吗？酋长的女儿—— [ni neng guo lai bang wo ma ？ qiu zhang de nv er ——]

english: No, outerlander, I'm guarding this mountain pass from trolls and inquisitive people like you.
translation: 不，外来者，我正在守卫这座山口，免受巨魔和像你这样好奇的人的侵害。 [bu ， wai lai zhe ， wo zheng zai shou wei zhe zuo shan kou ， mian shou ju mo he xiang ni zhe yang hao qi de ren de qin hai 。]

english: Doesn't look like you were very successful in the last regard.
translation: 看起来你在最后方面不太成功。 [kan qi lai ni zai zui hou fang mian bu tai cheng gong 。]

english: If the chieftain would let me, I would correct that oversight.
translation: 如果酋长允许的话，我会纠正这个疏忽。 [ru guo qiu zhang yun xu de hua ， wo hui jiu zheng zhe ge shu hu 。]

english: You may pass freely.
translation: 你可以自由通过。 [ni ke yi zi you tong guo 。]

english: Thanks... and try to lighten up a bit, alright?
translation: 谢谢...试着减轻一点，好吗？ [xie xie ... shi zhe jian qing yi dian ， hao ma ？]

english: Don't press your luck, outerlander.
translation: 别碰运气了，外地人。 [bie peng yun qi le ， wai di ren 。]

english: Feel free to come in and see the highlight of our culture, outerlander.
translation: 请随意进来看看我们文化的亮点，外地人。 [qing sui yi jin lai kan kan wo men wen hua de liang dian ， wai di ren 。]

english: HALT! Who goes there?
translation: 停止！谁去那里？ [ting zhi ！ shui qu na li ？]

english: Don't worry, I'm not going to cause trouble.
translation: 别担心，我不会惹麻烦的。 [bie dan xin ， wo bu hui re ma fan de 。]

english: But you shouldn't be here - be off with you!
translation: 但你不应该在这里——走吧！ [dan ni bu ying gai zai zhe li —— zou ba ！]

english: I was going anyway.
translation: 无论如何我还是要去的。 [wu lun ru he wo hai shi yao qu de 。]

english: I am [player name] the Mighty!
translation: 我是[玩家名称]全能者！ [wo shi [ wan jia ming cheng ] quan neng zhe ！]

english: Mighty? You look like another of those silly adventurers who thinks they're the bee's knees just because they've done a few lousy quests!
translation: 强大吗？你看起来就像又一个愚蠢的冒险家，仅仅因为做了一些糟糕的任务就认为自己很卑鄙！ [qiang da ma ？ ni kan qi lai jiu xiang you yi ge yu chun de mao xian jia ， jin jin yin wei zuo le yi xie zao gao de ren wu jiu ren wei zi ji hen bei bi ！]

english: Well it sounds better than sitting on this rooftop all day looking at trees!
translation: 嗯，这听起来比整天坐在屋顶上看树要好！ [n ， zhe ting qi lai bi zheng tian zuo zai wu ding shang kan shu yao hao ！]

english: I'll have you know it's a very important job guarding this jail!
translation: 我会让你知道看守这座监狱是一项非常重要的工作！ [wo hui rang ni zhi dao kan shou zhe zuo jian yu shi yi xiang fei chang zhong yao de gong zuo ！]

english: If anyone comes sneaking in here to mess around with the prisoners, the lads downstairs will make mincemeat of them, and I'll be here to pick them off if they try to escape.
translation: 如果有人偷偷溜进来捣乱囚犯，楼下的小伙子会把他们剁成肉末，如果他们想逃跑，我会在这里把他们干掉。 [ru guo you ren tou tou liu jin lai dao luan qiu fan ， lou xia de xiao huo zi hui ba ta men duo cheng rou mo ， ru guo ta men xiang tao pao ， wo hui zai zhe li ba ta men gan diao 。]

english: You mean people aren't meant to be able to shoot the prisoners in the cells?
translation: 你的意思是人们不应该能够射杀牢房里的囚犯？ [ni de yi si shi ren men bu ying gai neng gou she sha lao fang li de qiu fan ？]

english: Yes, that's right.
translation: 是的，没错。 [shi de ， mei cuo 。]

english: Okay, it's been nice talking to you.
translation: 好的，很高兴与你交谈。 [hao de ， hen gao xing yu ni jiao tan 。]

english: No-one, there's no-one here.
translation: 没人，这里没人。 [mei ren ， zhe li mei ren 。]

english: What? I can see you!
translation: 什么？我能看见你！ [shen me ？ wo neng kan jian ni ！]

english: No, you're just imagining it. Perhaps you've been up here in the sun for too long?
translation: 不，你只是想象而已。也许你在阳光下待得太久了？ [bu ， ni zhi shi xiang xiang er yi 。 ye xu ni zai yang guang xia dai de tai jiu le ？]

english: So who am I talking to?
translation: 那么我在跟谁说话呢？ [na me wo zai gen shui shuo hua ne ？]

english: Oh dear, you've started talking to yourself. That's a common sign that you're going mad!
translation: 哦，亲爱的，你已经开始自言自语了。这是你要疯了的常见迹象！ [o ， qin ai de ， ni yi jing kai shi zi yan zi yu le 。 zhe shi ni yao feng le de chang jian ji xiang ！]

english: But... but... you're standing right there...
translation: 但是……但是……你就站在那里…… [dan shi …… dan shi …… ni jiu zhan zai na li ……]

english: Maybe you should leave him alone now.
translation: 也许你现在应该让他一个人静一静。 [ye xu ni xian zai ying gai rang ta yi ge ren jing yi jing 。]

english: Don't worry, I'm not going to cause trouble.
translation: 别担心，我不会惹麻烦的。 [bie dan xin ， wo bu hui re ma fan de 。]

english: I am [player name] the Mighty!
translation: 我是[玩家名称]全能者！ [wo shi [ wan jia ming cheng ] quan neng zhe ！]

english: No-one, there's no-one here.
translation: 没人，这里没人。 [mei ren ， zhe li mei ren 。]

english: Guh... mwww... zzzzz...
translation: 呃...呜呜...zzzzz... [e ... wu wu ...zzzzz...]

english: Hmph... heh heh heh...
translation: 哼……嘿嘿嘿…… [heng …… hei hei hei ……]

english: Mmmm... big pint of beer... kebab...
translation: 嗯...大品脱啤酒...烤肉串... [n ... da pin tuo pi jiu ... kao rou chuan ...]

english: Mmmmmm... donuts...
translation: 嗯嗯……甜甜圈…… [n n …… tian tian quan ……]

english: Maybe I should let him sleep.
translation: 也许我应该让他睡觉。 [ye xu wo ying gai rang ta shui jiao 。]

english: Hello, can I go in?
translation: 你好，我可以进去吗？ [ni hao ， wo ke yi jin qu ma ？]

english: I'm afraid not. The city is on lockdown until the rebel elves are dealt with.
translation: 恐怕不是。这座城市处于封锁状态，直到叛军精灵被解决为止。 [kong pa bu shi 。 zhe zuo cheng shi chu yu feng suo zhuang tai ， zhi dao pan jun jing ling bei jie jue wei zhi 。]

english: Please, I won't cause any trouble.
translation: 拜托，我不会惹出任何麻烦。 [bai tuo ， wo bu hui re chu ren he ma fan 。]

english: Rules are rules. No one enters until the criminals are gone.
translation: 规则就是规则。在罪犯消失之前，没有人可以进入。 [gui ze jiu shi gui ze 。 zai zui fan xiao shi zhi qian ， mei you ren ke yi jin ru 。]

english: Fine, doesn't look very exciting anyway, it's just an empty field.
translation: 好吧，反正看起来也不怎么令人兴奋，只是一片空地。 [hao ba ， fan zheng kan qi lai ye bu zen me ling ren xing fen ， zhi shi yi pian kong di 。]

english: Mind your tongue human. Our great city may be lost to us but that doesn't give you an excuse to talk like that.
translation: 人类，注意你的舌头。我们可能会失去这座伟大的城市，但这并不能成为你这样说话的借口。 [ren lei ， zhu yi ni de she tou 。 wo men ke neng hui shi qu zhe zuo wei da de cheng shi ， dan zhe bing bu neng cheng wei ni zhe yang shuo hua de jie kou 。]

english: Welcome, adventurer.
translation: 欢迎，冒险家。 [huan ying ， mao xian jia 。]

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
translation: 嘿！把你的手拿开！ [hei ！ ba ni de shou na kai ！]

english: Greetings, traveller. Enjoy your time at the Ranging Guild.
translation: 你好，旅行者。享受您在测距公会的时光。 [ni hao ， lv xing zhe 。 xiang shou nin zai ce ju gong hui de shi guang 。]

english: *Whistles*
translation: *口哨声* [* kou shao sheng *]

english: Exciting new post he said.
translation: 他说，新帖子令人兴奋。 [ta shuo ， xin tie zi ling ren xing fen 。]

translation: 等不及周末了。 [deng bu ji zhou mo liao 。]

translation: 为什么是我？ [wei shen me shi wo ？]

translation: 我愿意为了烤肉串杀人。 [wo yuan yi wei le kao rou chuan sha ren 。]

translation: 咚咚咚咚咚咚嘿！ [dong dong dong dong dong dong hei ！]

english: Why isn't it 6 already?
translation: 怎么还没有6呢？ [zen me hai mei you 6 ne ？]

english: These night shifts just go on and on.
translation: 这些夜班一直持续着。 [zhe xie ye ban yi zhi chi xu zhe 。]

english: I'm hungry.
translation: 我饿了。 [wo e le 。]

english: *sings* If I had 3 wil....
translation: *唱歌*如果我有3个愿望...... [* chang ge * ru guo wo you 3 ge yuan wang ......]

english: Halt thief!
translation: 拦住小偷！ [lan zhu xiao tou ！]

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
translation: 嘿！把你的手拿开！ [hei ！ ba ni de shou na kai ！]

english: The Sinclairs are under house arrest for crimes against a crown, and it's all thanks to you.
translation: 辛克莱家族因危害王室罪而被软禁，这全都是你的功劳。 [xin ke lai jia zu yin wei hai wang shi zui er bei ruan jin ， zhe quan dou shi ni de gong lao 。]

english: It's more luxury than they deserve.
translation: 这比他们应得的更奢侈。 [zhe bi ta men ying de de geng she chi 。]

english: The guard stares at you suspiciously.
translation: 警卫疑惑地看着你。 [jing wei yi huo di kan zhe ni 。]

english: Excuse me...
translation: 打扰一下... [da rao yi xia ...]

english: I don' need a hand drinkin me beer, go 'way!
translation: 我不需要帮我喝啤酒，走吧！ [wo bu xu yao bang wo he pi jiu ， zou ba ！]

english: But...
Talk to tha' hand coz thish face ain't lishtnin'!
translation: 和你的手说话，因为这张脸不好看！ [he ni de shou shuo hua ， yin wei zhe zhang lian bu hao kan ！]

english: Yeeeuuuch! I hatesh that shtuff, jusht bring ush a beer! Mmmmm beer!
translation: 耶耶耶！我讨厌那种东西，就给我们拿瓶啤酒吧！嗯嗯啤酒！ [ye ye ye ！ wo tao yan na zhong dong xi ， jiu gei wo men na ping pi jiu ba ！ n n pi jiu ！]

english: Need more beer...
translation: 需要更多啤酒... [xu yao geng duo pi jiu ...]

english: Sir? I have some more beer for you...
translation: 先生？我还有一些啤酒给你... [xian sheng ？ wo hai you yi xie pi jiu gei ni ...]

english: Ahh... jus' wha' I need, now, wha' did you wanna know?
translation: 啊...我现在需要什么，你想知道什么？ [a ... wo xian zai xu yao shen me ， ni xiang zhi dao shen me ？]

english: I've come to report that Bert, the sandman, found a hand in the sand pit.
translation: 我来报告沙人伯特在沙坑里发现了一只手。 [wo lai bao gao sha ren bo te zai sha keng li fa xian le yi zhi shou 。]

english: Lucky for him, means he can get even more work done.
translation: 对他来说幸运的是，这意味着他可以完成更多的工作。 [dui ta lai shuo xing yun de shi ， zhe yi wei zhe ta ke yi wan cheng geng duo de gong zuo 。]

english: But aren't you going to find out who it ... belonged to?
translation: 但你不想知道它...属于谁吗？ [dan ni bu xiang zhi dao ta ... shu yu shui ma ？]

english: Oops, No 'arm done. S'prob'ly a wizard, i's always the wizards fault, go ask them, jus' ring the bell outshide the guild and talk to the first pointy hatted ninny you shee!

english: Err... ok, I'll go ring the bell and talk to a wizard then.
translation: 呃……好吧，我去按铃然后和巫师谈谈。 [e …… hao ba ， wo qu an ling ran hou he wu shi tan tan 。]

english: Hello Sir!
translation: 你好先生！ [ni hao xian sheng ！]

english: Go 'way! This pint'sh nearly finished! Unlessh you got more that ish....? Wizards, s'all the wizard's fault...prob'ly that Zavistic one, he'sh the worsht!
translation: 走吧！这品脱啤酒快喝完了！除非你有更多的东西......？巫师们，都是巫师的错……可能是扎维派的人，他是最糟糕的！ [zou ba ！ zhe pin tuo pi jiu kuai he wan le ！ chu fei ni you geng duo de dong xi ......？ wu shi men ， dou shi wu shi de cuo …… ke neng shi zha wei pai de ren ， ta shi zui zao gao de ！]

english: E're, you left this 'and in me beer!
translation: 是的，你把这个和啤酒留在我里面了！ [shi de ， ni ba zhe ge he pi jiu liu zai wo li mian le ！]

english: The Guard Captain fished the hand out of his beer and hands it to you.
translation: 警卫队长从啤酒里抽出手，递给你。 [jing wei dui zhang cong pi jiu li chou chu shou ， di gei ni 。]

english: *HIC*
What are you doing here? You're not one of the guards.
translation: 你在这里做什么？你不是守卫之一。 [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？ ni bu shi shou wei zhi yi 。]

english: I was just exploring. Is that okay?
translation: 我只是在探索。可以吗？ [wo zhi shi zai tan suo 。 ke yi ma ？]

english: I suppose, but why would you want to explore down here?
translation: 我想，但是你为什么要探索这里呢？ [wo xiang ， dan shi ni wei shen me yao tan suo zhe li ne ？]

english: Well why not?
translation: 那么为什么不呢？ [na me wei shen me bu ne ？]

english: It's cold for a start.
translation: 一开始就很冷。 [yi kai shi jiu hen leng 。]

english: I'd say it's still pretty warm compared to some places I've been.
translation: 我想说，与我去过的一些地方相比，这里仍然相当温暖。 [wo xiang shuo ， yu wo qu guo de yi xie di fang xiang bi ， zhe li reng ran xiang dang wen nuan 。]

english: If you say so. Just don't go causing any trouble.
translation: 如果你这么说的话。只是别去引起任何麻烦。 [ru guo ni zhe me shuo de hua 。 zhi shi bie qu yin qi ren he ma fan 。]

english: Good day. What are you up to?
translation: 再会。你要做什么？ [zai hui 。 ni yao zuo shen me ？]

english: My job is to ensure that everyone can use the bank safely. Shifty types always hang around banks, you know.
translation: 我的工作是确保每个人都能安全地使用银行。你知道，银行里总是有狡猾的人。 [wo de gong zuo shi que bao mei ge ren dou neng an quan di shi yong yin hang 。 ni zhi dao ， yin hang li zong shi you jiao hua de ren 。]

english: You're not shifty, are you?
translation: 你并不狡猾，是吗？ [ni bing bu jiao hua ， shi ma ？]

english: No, of course not.
translation: 不，当然不是。 [bu ， dang ran bu shi 。]

english: Jolly good. Carry on then.
translation: 好极了。那就继续吧。 [hao ji le 。 na jiu ji xu ba 。]

english: Please help me with this!
translation: 请帮我解决这个问题！ [qing bang wo jie jue zhe ge wen ti ！]

english: Woof! Woof! Woof!
translation: 纬！纬！纬！ [wei ！ wei ！ wei ！]

english: Woof Woof Bark!
translation: 汪汪叫！ [wang wang jiao ！]

english: *sigh* Not another one.
translation: *叹气*不是另一个。 [* tan qi * bu shi ling yi ge 。]

english: Another what?
translation: 另一个什么？ [ling yi ge shen me ？]

english: Another 'archaeologist'.
translation: 又一位“考古学家”。 [you yi wei “ kao gu xue jia ”。]

english: I'm not going to let you plunder my Master's tomb you know.
translation: 我不会让你抢夺我主人的坟墓的，你知道的。 [wo bu hui rang ni qiang duo wo zhu ren de fen mu de ， ni zhi dao de 。]

english: That's a shame, have you got anything else I could do while I'm here?
translation: 太可惜了，我在这儿的时候你还有什么可以帮我做的吗？ [tai ke xi le ， wo zai zhe er de shi hou ni hai you shen me ke yi bang wo zuo de ma ？]

english: If it will keep you out of mischief I suppose I could set something up for you...
translation: 如果这能让你免受恶作剧，我想我可以为你做点什么...... [ru guo zhe neng rang ni mian shou e zuo ju ， wo xiang wo ke yi wei ni zuo dian shen me ......]

english: I have a few rooms full of some things you humans might consider valuable, do you want to give it a go?
translation: 我有几个房间，里面装满了一些你们人类可能认为有价值的东西，你想尝试一下吗？ [wo you ji ge fang jian ， li mian zhuang man le yi xie ni men ren lei ke neng ren wei you jia zhi de dong xi ， ni xiang chang shi yi xia ma ？]

english: What should I do?
translation: 我应该怎么办？ [wo ying gai zen me ban ？]

english: You have five minutes to explore the treasure rooms and collect as many artefacts as you can.
translation: 您有五分钟的时间探索宝藏室并收集尽可能多的文物。 [nin you wu fen zhong de shi jian tan suo bao zang shi bing shou ji jin ke neng duo de wen wu 。]

english: The artefacts are in the urns, chests and sarcophagi found in each room.
translation: 这些文物位于每个房间的瓮、箱子和石棺中。 [zhe xie wen wu wei yu mei ge fang jian de weng 、 xiang zi he shi guan zhong 。]

english: There are eight treasure rooms, each subsequent room requires higher thieving skills to both enter the room and thieve from the urns and other containers.
translation: 有八个宝藏室，每个后续房间都需要更高的盗窃技能才能进入房间并从瓮和其他容器中进行盗窃。 [you ba ge bao zang shi ， mei ge hou xu fang jian dou xu yao geng gao de dao qie ji neng cai neng jin ru fang jian bing cong weng he qi ta rong qi zhong jin xing dao qie 。]

english: The rewards also become more lucrative the further into the tomb you go.
translation: 越深入坟墓，奖励就越丰厚。 [yue shen ru fen mu ， jiang li jiu yue feng hou 。]

english: You will also have to deactivate a trap in order to enter the main part of each room.
translation: 您还必须停用陷阱才能进入每个房间的主要部分。 [nin hai bi xu ting yong xian jing cai neng jin ru mei ge fang jian de zhu yao bu fen 。]

english: When you want to move onto the next room you need to find the correct door first.
translation: 当你想进入下一个房间时，你需要先找到正确的门。 [dang ni xiang jin ru xia yi ge fang jian shi ， ni xu yao xian zhao dao zheng que de men 。]

english: There are four possible exits, you must open the door before finding out whether it is the exit or not.
translation: 有四个可能的出口，必须打开门才能确定是否是出口。 [you si ge ke neng de chu kou ， bi xu da kai men cai neng que ding shi fou shi chu kou 。]

english: Opening the doors require picking their locks. Having a lockpick will make this easier.
translation: 打开门需要撬锁。有撬锁器会让这件事变得更容易。 [da kai men xu yao qiao suo 。 you qiao suo qi hui rang zhe jian shi bian de geng rong yi 。]

english: How do I leave the game?
translation: 我如何离开游戏？ [wo ru he li kai you xi ？]

english: If at any point you decide you need to leave just use a glowing door.
translation: 如果您在任何时候决定需要离开，只需使用发光门即可。 [ru guo nin zai ren he shi hou jue ding xu yao li kai ， zhi xu shi yong fa guang men ji ke 。]

english: The game will end and you will be taken out of the pyramid.
translation: 游戏将结束，你将被带出金字塔。 [you xi jiang jie shu ， ni jiang bei dai chu jin zi ta 。]

english: What about the chests and sarcophagi?
translation: 箱子和石棺呢？ [xiang zi he shi guan ne ？]

english: The artefacts are in the urns, chests and sarcophagi.
translation: 这些文物位于瓮、箱子和石棺中。 [zhe xie wen wu wei yu weng 、 xiang zi he shi guan zhong 。]

english: Urns contain snakes that guard them.
translation: 瓮里有蛇守护着它们。 [weng li you she shou hu zhe ta men 。]

english: The sarcophagi take some strength to open. They take a while to open.
translation: 石棺需要一些力量才能打开。他们需要一段时间才能打开。 [shi guan xu yao yi xie li liang cai neng da kai 。 ta men xu yao yi duan shi jian cai neng da kai 。]

english: Of course, Mummies have been known to take a nap in the sarcophagi, so beware.
translation: 当然，木乃伊会在石棺里小睡，所以要小心。 [dang ran ， mu nai yi hui zai shi guan li xiao shui ， suo yi yao xiao xin 。]

english: The golden chests generally contain better artefacts, but are also trapped with scarabs!
translation: 金色宝箱通常包含更好的文物，但也被圣甲虫困住！ [jin se bao xiang tong chang bao han geng hao de wen wu ， dan ye bei sheng jia chong kun zhu ！]

english: Tell me more about these artefacts.
translation: 告诉我更多关于这些文物的信息。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu zhe xie wen wu de xin xi 。]

english: There are a number of different artefacts, of three main types. The least valuable are the pottery statuettes and scarabs, and the ivory combs.
translation: 有许多不同的文物，分为三种主要类型。最不值钱的是陶器小雕像、圣甲虫和象牙梳子。 [you xu duo bu tong de wen wu ， fen wei san zhong zhu yao lei xing 。 zui bu zhi qian de shi tao qi xiao diao xiang 、 sheng jia chong he xiang ya shu zi 。]

english: Next are the stone scarabs, statuettes and seals, and finally the gold versions of those artefacts.
translation: 接下来是石制圣甲虫、小雕像和印章，最后是这些文物的黄金版本。 [jie xia lai shi shi zhi sheng jia chong 、 xiao diao xiang he yin zhang ， zui hou shi zhe xie wen wu de huang jin ban ben 。]

english: They are not old, but are well made.
translation: 它们并不旧，但制作精良。 [ta men bing bu jiu ， dan zhi zuo jing liang 。]

english: What do I do with artefacts once I've collected them?
translation: 收集完文物后我该如何处理它们？ [shou ji wan wen wu hou wo gai ru he chu li ta men ？]

english: That Simon Simpleton, I mean Templeton, will probably give you some money for them.
translation: 西蒙·简单顿（Simon Simpleton），我是说坦普尔顿（Templeton），可能会给你一些钱买它们。 [xi meng · jian dan dun （Simon Simpleton）， wo shi shuo tan pu er dun （Templeton）， ke neng hui gei ni yi xie qian mai ta men 。]

english: He couldn't spot a real artefact if it came up to him and bit him in the face.
translation: 如果真品走到他面前咬到他的脸，他就无法辨认出来。 [ru guo zhen pin zou dao ta mian qian yao dao ta de lian ， ta jiu wu fa bian ren chu lai 。]

english: He usually slinks about near the pyramid north-east of Sophanem. I expect he's trying to get some poor fools to steal things from that pyramid as well.
translation: 他通常在索法尼姆东北部的金字塔附近潜行。我估计他也在试图让一些可怜的傻瓜也从金字塔里偷东西。 [ta tong chang zai suo fa ni mu dong bei bu de jin zi ta fu jin qian xing 。 wo gu ji ta ye zai shi tu rang yi xie ke lian de sha gua ye cong jin zi ta li tou dong xi 。]

english: I expect he'll give you more gold for some than others.
translation: 我预计他会为某些人提供比其他人更多的黄金。 [wo yu ji ta hui wei mou xie ren ti gong bi qi ta ren geng duo de huang jin 。]

english: What's this I've heard about a Golden Sceptre?
translation: 我听说过金权杖是什么？ [wo ting shuo guo jin quan zhang shi shen me ？]

english: Where did you hear about that?
translation: 你从哪里听说的？ [ni cong na li ting shuo de ？]

english: I couldn't possibly say.
translation: 我不可能说。 [wo bu ke neng shuo 。]

english: It's the only genuinely valuable artefact in this place.
translation: 这是这个地方唯一真正有价值的文物。 [zhe shi zhe ge di fang wei yi zhen zheng you jia zhi de wen wu 。]

english: It links all the great pyramids in the area, and can be used to travel between them.
translation: 它连接该地区所有的大金字塔，并可用于在它们之间旅行。 [ta lian jie gai di qu suo you de da jin zi ta ， bing ke yong yu zai ta men zhi jian lv xing 。]

english: It requires charging with offerings of fine craftsmanship, that's why we have so many spare artefacts lying around.
translation: 它需要提供精美的工艺品，这就是为什么我们周围有这么多闲置的文物。 [ta xu yao ti gong jing mei de gong yi pin ， zhe jiu shi wei shen me wo men zhou wei you zhe me duo xian zhi de wen wu 。]

english: Anyway, I won't let you get your grubby little hands on the sceptre.
translation: 无论如何，我不会让你那脏兮兮的小手拿到权杖的。 [wu lun ru he ， wo bu hui rang ni na zang xi xi de xiao shou na dao quan zhang de 。]

english: How do I get the artefacts?
translation: 我如何获得文物？ [wo ru he huo de wen wu ？]

english: What do I do with the artefacts I collect?
translation: 我该如何处理我收集的文物？ [wo gai ru he chu li wo shou ji de wen wu ？]

english: Player is put in the Pyramid Plunder minigame.
translation: 玩家被置于金字塔掠夺迷你游戏中。 [wan jia bei zhi yu jin zi ta lve duo mi ni you xi zhong 。]

english: Not right now.
translation: 现在不行。 [xian zai bu xing 。]

english: Well, get out of here then.
translation: 好吧，那就离开这里吧。 [hao ba ， na jiu li kai zhe li ba 。]

english: I know what I'm doing - let's get on with it.
translation: 我知道我在做什么——让我们继续吧。 [wo zhi dao wo zai zuo shen me —— rang wo men ji xu ba 。]

english: Fine, I'll take you to the first room now...
translation: 好吧，我现在带你去第一个房间…… [hao ba ， wo xian zai dai ni qu di yi ge fang jian ……]

english: Player is put in the Pyramid Plunder minigame
translation: 玩家被置于金字塔掠夺迷你游戏中 [wan jia bei zhi yu jin zi ta lve duo mi ni you xi zhong]

english: I want to charge my sceptre.
translation: 我想给我的权杖充能。 [wo xiang gei wo de quan zhang chong neng 。]

english: What sceptre?
translation: 什么权杖？ [shen me quan zhang ？]

english: Er... I don't know.
translation: 呃……我不知道。 [e …… wo bu zhi dao 。]

english: Right...
translation: 正确的... [zheng que de ...]

english: You shouldn't have that thing in the first place, thief!
translation: 你一开始就不应该拥有那东西，小偷！ [ni yi kai shi jiu bu ying gai yong you na dong xi ， xiao tou ！]

english: Hmm... If I give you back some of the artefacts I've taken from the tomb, will you recharge the sceptre for me?
translation: 嗯……如果我把从坟墓里拿走的一些文物还给你，你会帮我充能权杖吗？ [n …… ru guo wo ba cong fen mu li na zou de yi xie wen wu huan gei ni ， ni hui bang wo chong neng quan zhang ma ？]

english: No! Why would I waste the King's magic when it's already fully charged?
translation: 不！既然国王的​​魔法已经充满了，我为什么要浪费它呢？ [bu ！ ji ran guo wang de ​​ mo fa yi jing chong man le ， wo wei shen me yao lang fei ta ne ？]

english: *sigh* Oh alright, but this is such a waste of the King's magic...
translation: *叹气*哦，好吧，但这太浪费国王的魔法了…… [* tan qi * o ， hao ba ， dan zhe tai lang fei guo wang de mo fa le ……]

english: You need to have 6 gold artefacts to recharge your sceptre.
translation: 您需要拥有 6 件黄金神器来充能您的权杖。 [nin xu yao yong you  6  jian huang jin shen qi lai chong neng nin de quan zhang 。]

english: Right, you already had [x] charge[s], and I don't give discounts. That means 6 artefacts gives you [y] charge[s]. Now be on your way.
translation: 是的，您已经支付了 [x] 笔费用，而且我不提供折扣。这意味着 6 件文物会给你 [y] 点费用。现在就上路吧。 [shi de ， nin yi jing zhi fu le  [x]  bi fei yong ， er qie wo bu ti gong zhe kou 。 zhe yi wei zhe  6  jian wen wu hui gei ni  [y]  dian fei yong 。 xian zai jiu shang lu ba 。]

english: Right, 6 artefacts gives you [x] charges. Now be on your way.
translation: 是的，6 件文物会给你 [x] 点费用。现在就上路吧。 [shi de ，6  jian wen wu hui gei ni  [x]  dian fei yong 。 xian zai jiu shang lu ba 。]

english: You need to have 12 stone artefacts to recharge your sceptre.
translation: 您需要拥有 12 件石制品才能给您的权杖充能。 [nin xu yao yong you  12  jian shi zhi pin cai neng gei nin de quan zhang chong neng 。]

english: Right, you already had [x] charge[s], and I don't give discounts. That means 12 artefacts gives you [y] charge[s]. Now be on your way.
translation: 是的，您已经支付了 [x] 笔费用，而且我不提供折扣。这意味着 12 件文物会给你 [y] 个费用。现在就上路吧。 [shi de ， nin yi jing zhi fu le  [x]  bi fei yong ， er qie wo bu ti gong zhe kou 。 zhe yi wei zhe  12  jian wen wu hui gei ni  [y]  ge fei yong 。 xian zai jiu shang lu ba 。]

english: Right, 12 artefacts gives you [x] charges. Now be on your way.
translation: 是的，12 件文物会给你 [x] 点费用。现在就上路吧。 [shi de ，12  jian wen wu hui gei ni  [x]  dian fei yong 。 xian zai jiu shang lu ba 。]

english: You need to have 24 pottery or ivory artefacts to recharge your sceptre.
translation: 您需要拥有 24 件陶器或象牙制品才能为您的权杖充能。 [nin xu yao yong you  24  jian tao qi huo xiang ya zhi pin cai neng wei nin de quan zhang chong neng 。]

english: Right, you already had [x] charge[s], and I don't give discounts. That means 24 artefacts gives you [y] charge[s]. Now be on your way.
translation: 是的，您已经支付了 [x] 笔费用，而且我不提供折扣。这意味着 24 件文物会给你 [y] 份费用。现在就上路吧。 [shi de ， nin yi jing zhi fu le  [x]  bi fei yong ， er qie wo bu ti gong zhe kou 。 zhe yi wei zhe  24  jian wen wu hui gei ni  [y]  fen fei yong 。 xian zai jiu shang lu ba 。]

english: Right, 24 artefacts gives you [x] charges. Now be on your way.
translation: 是的，24 件文物会给你 [x] 点费用。现在就上路吧。 [shi de ，24  jian wen wu hui gei ni  [x]  dian fei yong 。 xian zai jiu shang lu ba 。]

english: You've had your five minutes of plundering. Now be off with you!
translation: 你已经经历了五分钟的掠夺。现在就跟你走吧！ [ni yi jing jing li le wu fen zhong de lve duo 。 xian zai jiu gen ni zou ba ！]

english: Right, you already had [amount] charge[s], and I don't give discounts. That means 6 artefacts gives you [amount] charge[s]. Now be on your way.
translation: 是的，您已经支付了[金额]费用，而且我不提供折扣。这意味着 6 件文物会给您带来 [金额] 费用。现在就上路吧。 [shi de ， nin yi jing zhi fu le [ jin e ] fei yong ， er qie wo bu ti gong zhe kou 。 zhe yi wei zhe  6  jian wen wu hui gei nin dai lai  [ jin e ]  fei yong 。 xian zai jiu shang lu ba 。]

english: Right, 6 artefacts gives you [amount] charges. Now be on your way.
translation: 是的，6 件文物会给你[金额]的费用。现在就上路吧。 [shi de ，6  jian wen wu hui gei ni [ jin e ] de fei yong 。 xian zai jiu shang lu ba 。]

english: Actually, I've changed my mind.
translation: 事实上，我已经改变主意了。 [shi shi shang ， wo yi jing gai bian zhu yi le 。]

english: Then clear off!
translation: 然后清除！ [ran hou qing chu ！]

english: Can you remind me what I am supposed to do with these?
translation: 你能提醒我该怎么处理这些吗？ [ni neng ti xing wo gai zen me chu li zhe xie ma ？]

english: Thank you!
translation: 谢谢你！ [xie xie ni ！]

english: You have found my Master's Sceptre - You have been here long enough. Begone.
translation: 你已经找到了我主人的权杖——你已经在这里呆得够久了。走吧。 [ni yi jing zhao dao le wo zhu ren de quan zhang —— ni yi jing zai zhe li dai de gou jiu le 。 zou ba 。]

english: Grrr! Someone has found the Pharaoh's sceptre!
translation: 咕噜！有人找到了法老的权杖！ [gu lu ！ you ren zhao dao le fa lao de quan zhang ！]

english: Right! That's it. I'm clearing all the urns and refilling them now.
translation: 正确的！就是这样。我现在正在清理所有的骨灰盒并重新装满它们。 [zheng que de ！ jiu shi zhe yang 。 wo xian zai zheng zai qing li suo you de gu hui he bing zhong xin zhuang man ta men 。]

english: You're not done yet! Do this for me!
translation: 你还没有完成！为我做这个！ [ni hai mei you wan cheng ！ wei wo zuo zhe ge ！]

english: The guardian mummy has given you a puzzle box!
translation: 守护木乃伊给了你一个拼图盒！ [shou hu mu nai yi gei le ni yi ge pin tu he ！]

english: Scarabs can do puzzles better than that!
translation: 圣甲虫的拼图能力比这更好！ [sheng jia chong de pin tu neng li bi zhe geng hao ！]

english: Excellent work!
translation: 佳作！ [jia zuo ！]

english: The guardian mummy has given you another clue scroll!/You've obtained a casket!
translation: 守护者木乃伊给了你另一张线索卷轴！/你获得了一个棺材！ [shou hu zhe mu nai yi gei le ni ling yi zhang xian suo juan zhou ！/ ni huo de le yi ge guan cai ！]

english: That sounds like fun, what do I do?
translation: 听起来很有趣，我该怎么办？ [ting qi lai hen you qu ， wo gai zen me ban ？]

english: Not right now.
translation: 现在不行。 [xian zai bu xing 。]

english: I know what I'm doing - let's get on with it.
translation: 我知道我在做什么——让我们继续吧。 [wo zhi dao wo zai zuo shen me —— rang wo men ji xu ba 。]

english: I want to charge my sceptre.
translation: 我想给我的权杖充能。 [wo xiang gei wo de quan zhang chong neng 。]

english: What should I do?
translation: 我应该怎么办？ [wo ying gai zen me ban ？]

english: How do I leave the game?
translation: 我如何离开游戏？ [wo ru he li kai you xi ？]

english: What about the chests and sarcophagi?
translation: 箱子和石棺呢？ [xiang zi he shi guan ne ？]

english: Tell me more about these artefacts.
translation: 告诉我更多关于这些文物的信息。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu zhe xie wen wu de xin xi 。]

english: I'm ready to give it a go now.
translation: 我现在准备尝试一下。 [wo xian zai zhun bei chang shi yi xia 。]

english: What's this I hear about a Golden Sceptre?
translation: 我听说金权杖是什么？ [wo ting shuo jin quan zhang shi shen me ？]

english: How do I get the artefacts?
translation: 我如何获得文物？ [wo ru he huo de wen wu ？]

english: What do I do with the artefacts I collect?
translation: 我该如何处理我收集的文物？ [wo gai ru he chu li wo shou ji de wen wu ？]

english: Gold artefacts.
translation: 黄金文物。 [huang jin wen wu 。]

english: Stone artefacts.
translation: 石制品。 [shi zhi pin 。]

english: Pottery and ivory artefacts.
translation: 陶器和象牙工艺品。 [tao qi he xiang ya gong yi pin 。]

english: Actually, I'm more interested in plundering the tombs.
translation: 其实我更感兴趣的是盗墓。 [qi shi wo geng gan xing qu de shi dao mu 。]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: Hello there. I have a message for you.
translation: 你好呀。我有话要给你。 [ni hao ya 。 wo you hua yao gei ni 。]

english: Sorry, I don't have anything for you right now.
translation: 抱歉，我现在没有什么可以给你的。 [bao qian ， wo xian zai mei you shen me ke yi gei ni de 。]

english: [player name]?
translation: [玩家姓名]？ [[ wan jia xing ming ]？]

english: Are you there [player name]?

translation: 如果谣言是关于月光羚羊的： [ru guo yao yan shi guan yu yue guang ling yang de ：]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: Oh, hello there newcomer. I'm Guild Scribe Verity. Do you need me to explain the work we do here?
translation: 噢，新人你好。我是公会抄写员维瑞蒂。您需要我解释一下我们在这里所做的工作吗？ [o ， xin ren ni hao 。 wo shi gong hui chao xie yuan wei rui di 。 nin xu yao wo jie shi yi xia wo men zai zhe li suo zuo de gong zuo ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: So it's nice and simple. Just chat to any of the hunters in here to help them out. They're all following reports that I've split up amongst them.
translation: 所以它很好而且简单。只需与这里的任何猎人聊天即可帮助他们。他们都在关注我把他们分开的报道。 [suo yi ta hen hao er qie jian dan 。 zhi xu yu zhe li de ren he lie ren liao tian ji ke bang zhu ta men 。 ta men dou zai guan zhu wo ba ta men fen kai de bao dao 。]

english: Reports?
translation: 报告？ [bao gao ？]

english: Indeed. There are all sorts of interesting creatures to hunt out there. Sometimes we get reports of a particularly unique example. When that happens, one of the hunters will set out to find it.
translation: 的确。那里有各种有趣的生物可供狩猎。有时我们会收到一个特别独特的例子的报告。当这种情况发生时，其中一名猎人就会出发去寻找它。 [di que 。 na li you ge zhong you qu de sheng wu ke gong shou lie 。 you shi wo men hui shou dao yi ge te bie du te de li zi de bao gao 。 dang zhe zhong qing kuang fa sheng shi ， qi zhong yi ming lie ren jiu hui chu fa qu xun zhao ta 。]

english: If you do decide to take a job from any of the hunters, they'll tell you what type of creature they're looking into. Hunt that creature until you encounter the unique specimen.
translation: 如果你决定接受任何猎人的工作，他们会告诉你他们正在调查什么类型的生物。追捕该生物，直到遇到独特的标本。 [ru guo ni jue ding jie shou ren he lie ren de gong zuo ， ta men hui gao su ni ta men zheng zai diao cha shen me lei xing de sheng wu 。 zhui bu gai sheng wu ， zhi dao yu dao du te de biao ben 。]

english: Once you've caught it, bring some proof back to the hunter that sent you out in the first place. I'm sure they'll reward you for your time.
translation: 一旦你抓住了它，就把一些证据带回给最初派你出去的猎人。我相信他们会奖励你的时间。 [yi dan ni zhua zhu le ta ， jiu ba yi xie zheng ju dai hui gei zui chu pai ni chu qu de lie ren 。 wo xiang xin ta men hui jiang li ni de shi jian 。]

english: I see. Thanks for the information.
translation: 我懂了。感谢您提供信息。 [wo dong le 。 gan xie nin ti gong xin xi 。]

english: Nilsal, hunter. Anything to report?
translation: 尼尔萨尔，猎人。有什么要报告的吗？ [ni er sa er ， lie ren 。 you shen me yao bao gao de ma ？]

english: Nothing abnormal today.
translation: 今天没有任何异常。 [jin tian mei you ren he yi chang 。]

english: What does a scribe do?
translation: 抄写员做什么的？ [chao xie yuan zuo shen me de ？]

english: I'm the primary record-keeper here. I organise all of our reports and write up anything important to be sent back to the city.
translation: 我是这里的主要记录员。我整理所有的报告并写下所有重要的内容并发回城市。 [wo shi zhe li de zhu yao ji lu yuan 。 wo zheng li suo you de bao gao bing xie xia suo you zhong yao de nei rong bing fa hui cheng shi 。]

english: Do you go out on any hunts with the others?
translation: 你和其他人一起出去打猎吗？ [ni he qi ta ren yi qi chu qu da lie ma ？]

english: I wouldn't know what to do with myself out there, so I like to stay back here with my scrolls.
translation: 我不知道自己在外面该怎么办，所以我喜欢带着我的卷轴呆在这儿。 [wo bu zhi dao zi ji zai wai mian gai zen me ban ， suo yi wo xi huan dai zhe wo de juan zhou dai zai zhe er 。]

english: How many rumours have I completed?
translation: 我完成了多少谣言？ [wo wan cheng le duo shao yao yan ？]

english: Our records suggest you've managed to complete [number of completed rumours] rumours for us!
translation: 我们的记录表明您已成功为我们完成[已完成的谣言数量]个谣言！ [wo men de ji lu biao ming nin yi cheng gong wei wo men wan cheng [ yi wan cheng de yao yan shu liang ] ge yao yan ！]

english: I have this spare hunter gear, is there anything I can do with it?
translation: 我有这个备用猎人装备，我能用它做什么吗？ [wo you zhe ge bei yong lie ren zhuang bei ， wo neng yong ta zuo shen me ma ？]

english: Spare, you say? Hmmm.... I'm sure one of the other hunters could benefit from it if you're sure. If you hand it over to me, I can give you some spare supplies in return.
translation: 你说备用？嗯……如果你确定的话，我确信其他猎人之一可以从中受益。如果你把它交给我，我可以给你一些备用物资作为回报。 [ni shuo bei yong ？ n …… ru guo ni que ding de hua ， wo que xin qi ta lie ren zhi yi ke yi cong zhong shou yi 。 ru guo ni ba ta jiao gei wo ， wo ke yi gei ni yi xie bei yong wu zi zuo wei hui bao 。]

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。 [wo de zou le 。]

english: Would you like me to filter the rumour information a little more than I am right now?
translation: 你希望我比现在多过滤一下谣言信息吗？ [ni xi wang wo bi xian zai duo guo lv yi xia yao yan xin xi ma ？]

english: Would you like me to filter the rumour information a little less than I am right now?
translation: 您希望我过滤谣言信息的程度比现在少一点吗？ [nin xi wang wo guo lv yao yan xin xi de cheng du bi xian zai shao yi dian ma ？]

english: What does a scribe do?
translation: 抄写员做什么的？ [chao xie yuan zuo shen me de ？]

english: How many rumours have I completed?
translation: 我完成了多少谣言？ [wo wan cheng le duo shao yao yan ？]

english: I have this spare hunter gear...
translation: 我有这个备用的猎人装备... [wo you zhe ge bei yong de lie ren zhuang bei ...]

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。 [wo de zou le 。]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Yes please!
translation: 是的，请！ [shi de ， qing ！]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Greetings!
translation: 问候！ [wen hou ！]

english: This is the Champions' Guild. Only adventurers who have proved themselves worthy by gaining influence from quests are allowed in here.
translation: 这里是冠军公会。只有通过任务影响力证明了自己的价值的冒险者才可以进入这里。 [zhe li shi guan jun gong hui 。 zhi you tong guo ren wu ying xiang li zheng ming liao zi ji de jia zhi de mao xian zhe cai ke yi jin ru zhe li 。]

english: Let me see what you've got there. Ah, yes, one of the champions. Just head downstairs and you'll find your challenge waiting in the arena. Hand that scroll to the doorman to get in.
translation: 让我看看你那里有什么。啊，是的，冠军之一。只要下楼，您就会发现竞技场中等待着您的挑战。将卷轴交给门卫即可进入。 [rang wo kan kan ni na li you shen me 。 a ， shi de ， guan jun zhi yi 。 zhi yao xia lou ， nin jiu hui fa xian jing ji chang zhong deng dai zhe nin de tiao zhan 。 jiang juan zhou jiao gei men wei ji ke jin ru 。]

english: Of course! Here you go.
translation: 当然！干得好。 [dang ran ！ gan de hao 。]

english: I think you've already got a key. Maybe you should check your key ring.
translation: 我想你已经拿到钥匙了。也许你应该检查一下你的钥匙圈。 [wo xiang ni yi jing na dao yao shi le 。 ye xu ni ying gai jian cha yi xia ni de yao shi quan 。]

english: I think you've already got a key somewhere.
translation: 我想你已经在某处拿到了钥匙。 [wo xiang ni yi jing zai mou chu na dao le yao shi 。]

english: You have not proved yourself worthy to enter here yet.
translation: 你还没有证明自己值得进入这里。 [ni hai mei you zheng ming zi ji zhi de jin ru zhe li 。]

english: The door won't open - you need at least 32 Quest Points.
translation: 门打不开 - 您至少需要 32 任务点。 [men da bu kai  -  nin zhi shao xu yao  32  ren wu dian 。]

english: Greetings bold adventurer. Welcome to the guild of Champions.
translation: 问候大胆的冒险家。欢迎来到冠军公会。 [wen hou da dan de mao xian jia 。 huan ying lai dao guan jun gong hui 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: I've been given a challenge. What now?
translation: 我受到了挑战。现在怎么办？ [wo shou dao le tiao zhan 。 xian zai zen me ban ？]

english: Can I have another key to Melzar's Maze?
translation: 我能给我另一把梅尔扎迷宫的钥匙吗？ [wo neng gei wo ling yi ba mei er zha mi gong de yao shi ma ？]

english: Oh, you're a new face around here, aren't you?
translation: 哦，你是这里的新面孔，不是吗？ [o ， ni shi zhe li de xin mian kong ， bu shi ma ？]

english: I am indeed. Just exploring the savannah.
translation: 我确实是。只是探索大草原。 [wo que shi shi 。 zhi shi tan suo da cao yuan 。]

english: Well, I'm Apatura. Let me welcome you to our small corner of Varlamore.
translation: 嗯，我是阿帕图拉。欢迎您来到我们位于瓦尔拉莫尔的小角落。 [n ， wo shi a pa tu la 。 huan ying nin lai dao wo men wei yu wa er la mo er de xiao jiao luo 。]

english: Nilsal, hunter.
translation: 尼尔萨尔，猎人。 [ni er sa er ， lie ren 。]

english: Nilsal, Apatura.
translation: 尼尔萨尔，阿帕图拉。 [ni er sa er ， a pa tu la 。]

english: I see you've been doing a lot of work for the guild of late. Would you like to learn a bit more about our history?
translation: 我发现你最近为公会做了很多工作。您想更多地了解我们的历史吗？ [wo fa xian ni zui jin wei gong hui zuo le hen duo gong zuo 。 nin xiang geng duo di liao jie wo men de li shi ma ？]

english: Absolutely.
translation: 绝对地。 [jue dui di 。]

english: Here's a little snippet about our original construction, from right back when we were first established.
translation: 以下是关于我们最初建立时的原始结构的一些片段。 [yi xia shi guan yu wo men zui chu jian li shi de yuan shi jie gou de yi xie pian duan 。]

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Alright. You can grab it from my bookshelf upstairs whenever you want to read it.
translation: 好吧。你想看的时候可以从我楼上的书架上拿来。 [hao ba 。 ni xiang kan de shi hou ke yi cong wo lou shang de shu jia shang na lai 。]

english: Your commitment to helping our guild is commendable, iknami.
translation: 你对帮助我们公会的承诺值得赞扬，iknami。 [ni dui bang zhu wo men gong hui de cheng nuo zhi de zan yang ，iknami。]

english: It's good to be helping, guildmaster.
translation: 能帮忙真是太好了，公会长。 [neng bang mang zhen shi tai hao le ， gong hui zhang 。]

english: If you want to learn about our history, I have a document here you can read if you'd like.
translation: 如果您想了解我们的历史，我这里有一份文档，您可以根据需要阅读。 [ru guo nin xiang liao jie wo men de li shi ， wo zhe li you yi fen wen dang ， nin ke yi gen ju xu yao yue du 。]

english: That would be interesting.
translation: 那会很有趣。 [na hui hen you qu 。]

english: You can take it from my shelves when you're ready to read it. Just head up that ladder over there.
translation: 当你准备好阅读时，可以从我的书架上取出它。爬上那边的梯子就可以了。 [dang ni zhun bei hao yue du shi ， ke yi cong wo de shu jia shang qu chu ta 。 pa shang na bian de ti zi jiu ke yi le 。]

english: You have proven yourself a true ally of our guild, iknami.
translation: 你已经证明自己是我们公会真正的盟友，iknami。 [ni yi jing zheng ming zi ji shi wo men gong hui zhen zheng de meng you ，iknami。]

english: As a personal reward for your help, you can have this key to open the chest on the floor above.
translation: 作为对你的帮助的个人奖励，你可以用这把钥匙打开楼上的箱子。 [zuo wei dui ni de bang zhu de ge ren jiang li ， ni ke yi yong zhe ba yao shi da kai lou shang de xiang zi 。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: We're mostly here to keep an eye on the local animal populations, and provide animal parts to the city.
translation: 我们来这里主要是为了关注当地的动物种群，并向城市提供动物器官。 [wo men lai zhe li zhu yao shi wei le guan zhu dang di de dong wu zhong qun ， bing xiang cheng shi ti gong dong wu qi guan 。]

english: As for me personally, I'm the current master of this guild.
translation: 就我个人而言，我是这个公会现任的会长。 [jiu wo ge ren er yan ， wo shi zhe ge gong hui xian ren de hui zhang 。]

english: Current master?
translation: 现任师傅？ [xian ren shi fu ？]

english: A hunter's work is dangerous. We tend to go through members faster than other guilds. That said, I'm usually too busy with politics and paperwork to go out hunting these days.
translation: 猎人的工作是危险的。我们往往比其他公会更快地筛选成员。也就是说，这些天我通常忙于政治和文书工作，没有时间出去打猎。 [lie ren de gong zuo shi wei xian de 。 wo men wang wang bi qi ta gong hui geng kuai di shai xuan cheng yuan 。 ye jiu shi shuo ， zhe xie tian wo tong chang mang yu zheng zhi he wen shu gong zuo ， mei you shi jian chu qu da lie 。]

english: I'd better be off.
translation: 我最好还是离开吧 [wo zui hao hai shi li kai ba]

english: Is that a skillcape you have with you?
translation: 这是你随身携带的技能披风吗？ [zhe shi ni sui shen xie dai de ji neng pi feng ma ？]

english: It is.
translation: 这是。 [zhe shi 。]

english: Would you like me to enhance it with the ability to teleport directly to the guild?
translation: 你想让我增强它直接传送到公会的能力吗？ [ni xiang rang wo zeng qiang ta zhi jie chuan song dao gong hui de neng li ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Kuani! That should be done for you now.
translation: 夸尼！现在应该为您完成此操作。 [kua ni ！ xian zai ying gai wei nin wan cheng ci cao zuo 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Absolutely.
translation: 绝对地。 [jue dui di 。]

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: That would be interesting.
translation: 那会很有趣。 [na hui hen you qu 。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'd better be off.
translation: 我最好还是离开吧 [wo zui hao hai shi li kai ba]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Welcome to the farming guild. How may I help you?
translation: 欢迎来到农业公会。我可以怎样帮助您？ [huan ying lai dao nong ye gong hui 。 wo ke yi zen yang bang zhu nin ？]

english: Tell me about the guild.
translation: 说说公会的事吧 [shuo shuo gong hui de shi ba]

english: After the Shayzien Army cleared out the lizardmen in this area, I founded this guild with some fellow Hosidius farmers.
translation: 在 Shayzien 军队清除了该地区的蜥蜴人后，我和一些 Hosidius 农民同伴创立了这个公会。 [zai  Shayzien  jun dui qing chu le gai di qu de xi yi ren hou ， wo he yi xie  Hosidius  nong min tong ban chuang li le zhe ge gong hui 。]

english: Why here? Why not within the safety of Kourend?
translation: 为什么在这里？为什么不在库伦德的安全范围内呢？ [wei shen me zai zhe li ？ wei shen me bu zai ku lun de de an quan fan wei nei ne ？]

english: The heat of the volcano allows us to grow things here that would never survive in the climate of Kourend. The discoveries we have made are worth the extra risk.
translation: 火山的热量使我们能够在这里种植在库伦德气候下无法生存的植物。我们的发现值得冒额外的风险。 [huo shan de re liang shi wo men neng gou zai zhe li zhong zhi zai ku lun de qi hou xia wu fa sheng cun de zhi wu 。 wo men de fa xian zhi de mao e wai de feng xian 。]

english: Fair enough, anything else I should know about the guild?
translation: 公平地说，关于公会我还有什么应该知道的吗？ [gong ping di shuo ， guan yu gong hui wo hai you shen me ying gai zhi dao de ma ？]

english: The guild is split into three tiers, with only advanced farmers being allowed access to the upper echelons.
translation: 公会分为三层，只有高级农民才能进入上层。 [gong hui fen wei san ceng ， zhi you gao ji nong min cai neng jin ru shang ceng 。]

english: Would you like to hear more about one of the tiers?
translation: 您想了解有关其中某一层级的更多信息吗？ [nin xiang liao jie you guan qi zhong mou yi ceng ji de geng duo xin xi ma ？]

english: Tell me about the beginner tier.
translation: 说说初级阶段吧 [shuo shuo chu ji jie duan ba]

english: In the beginner tier you can access farming patches for cacti, allotments, bushes and flowers. You'll also find some shops with useful farming supplies.
translation: 在初级阶段，你可以进入种植仙人掌、土地、灌木和花卉的农田。您还会发现一些出售有用农业用品的商店。 [zai chu ji jie duan ， ni ke yi jin ru zhong zhi xian ren zhang 、 tu di 、 guan mu he hua hui de nong tian 。 nin hai hui fa xian yi xie chu shou you yong nong ye yong pin de shang dian 。]

english: Would you like to hear more about another tier?
translation: 您想了解更多有关另一级别的信息吗？ [nin xiang liao jie geng duo you guan ling yi ji bie de xin xi ma ？]

english: Tell me about the intermediate tier.
translation: 说说中级吧。 [shuo shuo zhong ji ba 。]

english: In the intermediate tier you can access farming patches for herbs and trees. You'll also find the anima and hespori patches which are unique to this guild.
translation: 在中间层，您可以访问种植药草和树木的农田。您还可以找到该公会独有的阿尼玛和赫斯波里补丁。 [zai zhong jian ceng ， nin ke yi fang wen zhong zhi yao cao he shu mu de nong tian 。 nin hai ke yi zhao dao gai gong hui du you de a ni ma he he si bo li bu ding 。]

english: Tell me about the advanced tier.
translation: 说说高级的吧 [shuo shuo gao ji de ba]

english: In the advanced tier you can access farming patches for fruit trees and spirit trees. You'll also find the redwood and celastrus patches which are unique to this guild.
translation: 在高级层中，您可以访问果树和灵树的农田。您还会发现该行会独有的红木和南藤属植物。 [zai gao ji ceng zhong ， nin ke yi fang wen guo shu he ling shu de nong tian 。 nin hai hui fa xian gai hang hui du you de hong mu he nan teng shu zhi wu 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: My name is Jane, and I am the founder of the Farming Guild.
translation: 我叫简，是农业公会的创始人。 [wo jiao jian ， shi nong ye gong hui de chuang shi ren 。]

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 还有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [hai you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

english: That's all, thanks.
translation: “就这些了，谢谢。” [“ jiu zhe xie le ， xie xie 。”]

english: Do you have any jobs for me?
translation: 你有什么工作可以给我吗？ [ni you shen me gong zuo ke yi gei wo ma ？]

english: Well we always need to rotate the crops we're growing to stop the soil from tiring due to lack of nutrients. It would be great if you could help out with that.
translation: 我们总是需要轮作我们正在种植的作物，以防止土壤因缺乏养分而疲劳。如果你能帮忙的话那就太好了。 [wo men zong shi xu yao lun zuo wo men zheng zai zhong zhi de zuo wu ， yi fang zhi tu rang yin que fa yang fen er pi lao 。 ru guo ni neng bang mang de hua na jiu tai hao le 。]

english: What would I need to do?

translation: 啊，这不是美好的一天吗？ [a ， zhe bu shi mei hao de yi tian ma ？]

english: It's not bad. What puts you in such a good mood?
translation: 这还不错。是什么让你心情这么好？ [zhe hai bu cuo 。 shi shen me rang ni xin qing zhe me hao ？]

english: Oh, I just love my job. The smell of the sea breeze, the smell of the arctic pine sap, the smell of the yaks. I find it all so bracing.
translation: 哦，我只是热爱我的工作。海风的味道，北极松树液的味道，牦牛的味道。我发现这一切都是那么令人振奋。 [o ， wo zhi shi re ai wo de gong zuo 。 hai feng de wei dao ， bei ji song shu ye de wei dao ， mao niu de wei dao 。 wo fa xian zhe yi qie dou shi na me ling ren zhen fen 。]

english: Bracing? Hmmm. I think I might have chosen a different word.
translation: 支撑？嗯。我想我可能选择了不同的词。 [zhi cheng ？ n 。 wo xiang wo ke neng xuan ze le bu tong de ci 。]

english: Haha welcome to my obstacle course. Have fun, but remember this isn't a child's playground. People have died here.
translation: 哈哈欢迎来到我的障碍训练场。玩得开心，但请记住这不是儿童游乐场。人们已经死在这里。 [ha ha huan ying lai dao wo de zhang ai xun lian chang 。 wan de kai xin ， dan qing ji zhu zhe bu shi er tong you le chang 。 ren men yi jing si zai zhe li 。]

english: The best way to train, is to go round the course in a clockwise direction.
translation: 最好的训练方法是沿顺时针方向绕赛道走一圈。 [zui hao de xun lian fang fa shi yan shun shi zhen fang xiang rao sai dao zou yi quan 。]

english: Please solve this for me. I have other things to be thinking about.
translation: 请为我解决这个问题。我还有其他事情要考虑。 [qing wei wo jie jue zhe ge wen ti 。 wo hai you qi ta shi qing yao kao lv 。]

translation: Gunnjorn 给了你一个拼图盒！ [Gunnjorn  gei le ni yi ge pin tu he ！]

english: Sorry but you haven't solved the puzzle yet.
translation: 抱歉，您还没有解决这个难题。 [bao qian ， nin hai mei you jie jue zhe ge nan ti 。]

english: I don't have the puzzle box with me.
translation: 我没有带拼图盒。 [wo mei you dai pin tu he 。]

translation: 那没什么用，去拿吧！ [na mei shen me yong ， qu na ba ！]
