translation: 谢谢[玩家姓名]！ [xie xie [ wan jia xing ming ]！]

english: What can I interest you in? We have something of everything here!
translation: 我能对什么感兴趣？我们这里什么都有！ [wo neng dui shen me gan xing qu ？ wo men zhe li shen me dou you ！]

english: Oh good!
translation: 哦，好！ [o ， hao ！]

english: Nothing, thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。]

english: Oh good!
translation: 哦，好！ [o ， hao ！]

english: Nothing, thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。]

english: Ah, you've come for fight!
translation: 啊，你是来打架的！ [a ， ni shi lai da jia de ！]

english: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？ [ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: What are you offering?
translation: 你提供什么？ [ni ti gong shen me ？]

english: A fight!
translation: 一场战斗！ [yi chang zhan dou ！]

english: You look funny!
translation: 你看起来很有趣！ [ni kan qi lai hen you qu ！]

english: Wanna fight?
translation: 想打架吗？ [xiang da jia ma ？]

english: Grrr!
translation: 咕噜！ [gu lu ！]

english: Go away!
translation: 离开！ [li kai ！]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Hello sir, it's Christmas!
translation: 先生您好，圣诞节到了！ [xian sheng nin hao ， sheng dan jie dao le ！]

english: Merry Christmas!
translation: 圣诞快乐！ [sheng dan kuai le ！]

english: Hello Buoy and Gurl!
translation: 你好，浮标和古尔！ [ni hao ， fu biao he gu er ！]

english: Hello sir!
translation: 你好先生！ [ni hao xian sheng ！]

english: How do you know our names?
translation: 你怎么知道我们的名字？ [ni zen me zhi dao wo men de ming zi ？]

english: I had a chat with your dad. He's super busy, so he's asked me to help you build a snowman!
translation: 我和你爸爸聊过他太忙了，所以他让我帮你堆雪人！ [wo he ni ba ba liao guo ta tai mang le ， suo yi ta rang wo bang ni dui xue ren ！]

english: Really? We get to make a snowman?
translation: 真的吗？我们可以堆雪人吗？ [zhen de ma ？ wo men ke yi dui xue ren ma ？]

english: Yes! And I'm going to build whatever snowman you want!
translation: 是的！我会堆你想要的任何雪人！ [shi de ！ wo hui dui ni xiang yao de ren he xue ren ！]

english: Yay! Can it be three snowballs tall?
translation: 耶！能有三个雪球那么高吗？ [ye ！ neng you san ge xue qiu na me gao ma ？]

english: But I want it to be five tall!
translation: 但我希望它有五高！ [dan wo xi wang ta you wu gao ！]

english: Five is a bad number, it should be three tall!
translation: 五是个不好的数字，应该是三高！ [wu shi ge bu hao de shu zi ， ying gai shi san gao ！]

english: You're a bad number. Five is so much better.
translation: 你这个号码不好。五个就好多了。 [ni zhe ge hao ma bu hao 。 wu ge jiu hao duo le 。]

english: Okay, okay, wait a second. Why don't we meet in the middle. How about four snowballs tall?
translation: 好吧好吧，等一下。为什么我们不在中间见面呢？四个雪球高怎么样？ [hao ba hao ba ， deng yi xia 。 wei shen me wo men bu zai zhong jian jian mian ne ？ si ge xue qiu gao zen me yang ？]

english: Fine, it can be four tall.
translation: 好吧，它可以有四高。 [hao ba ， ta ke yi you si gao 。]

english: Yes, four tall is okay.
translation: 是的，四高就可以了。 [shi de ， si gao jiu ke yi le 。]

english: Great. Now, we need to pick what size snowballs we want for each tier. Why don't you take it in turns? You can do two each.
translation: 伟大的。现在，我们需要为每一层选择我们想要的雪球大小。为什么不轮流做呢？你们每人可以做两个。 [wei da de 。 xian zai ， wo men xu yao wei mei yi ceng xuan ze wo men xiang yao de xue qiu da xiao 。 wei shen me bu lun liu zuo ne ？ ni men mei ren ke yi zuo liang ge 。]

english: The bottom one should be a huge snowball!
translation: 最下面的应该是一个巨大的雪球！ [zui xia mian de ying gai shi yi ge ju da de xue qiu ！]

english: The next one should be big!
translation: 下一篇应该会很大！ [xia yi pian ying gai hui hen da ！]

english: This is working nicely, we're half way! What about the top two parts?
translation: 效果很好，我们已经成功一半了！上面两部分呢？ [xiao guo hen hao ， wo men yi jing cheng gong yi ban le ！ shang mian liang bu fen ne ？]

english: The next one should be a small snowball!
translation: 下一个应该是一个小雪球！ [xia yi ge ying gai shi yi ge xiao xue qiu ！]

english: No, it should be little!
translation: 不，应该很小！ [bu ， ying gai hen xiao ！]

english: But it needs to be small, little would look bad.
translation: 但一定要小，太小了就不好看了。 [dan yi ding yao xiao ， tai xiao le jiu bu hao kan le 。]

english: It wouldn't look bad. Small is better for decorations.
translation: 看起来不会很糟糕。小的更适合装饰。 [kan qi lai bu hui hen zao gao 。 xiao de geng shi he zhuang shi 。]

english: My decorations will fit on a little one.
translation: 我的装饰品适合一只小家伙。 [wo de zhuang shi pin shi he yi zhi xiao jia huo 。]

english: Why do you always ruin everything?
translation: 为什么你总是毁掉一切？ [wei shen me ni zong shi hui diao yi qie ？]

english: You ruin everything with your silly ideas!
translation: 你用你愚蠢的想法毁了一切！ [ni yong ni yu chun de xiang fa hui le yi qie ！]

english: Okay, okay, wait. This clearly isn't working, and I don't want you two to fall out. It's Christmas, we shouldn't be arguing!
translation: 好吧好吧，等等。这显然行不通，我不想让你们两个闹翻。今天是圣诞节，我们不应该吵架！ [hao ba hao ba ， deng deng 。 zhe xian ran xing bu tong ， wo bu xiang rang ni men liang ge nao fan 。 jin tian shi sheng dan jie ， wo men bu ying gai chao jia ！]

english: How about I make you both a snowman? It can be whatever height and size you like. One each!
translation: 我给你们堆个雪人怎么样？它可以是您喜欢的任何高度和尺寸。各一个！ [wo gei ni men dui ge xue ren zen me yang ？ ta ke yi shi nin xi huan de ren he gao du he chi cun 。 ge yi ge ！]

english: So mine can be five snowballs tall?
translation: 那么我的雪球可以有五个雪球高吗？ [na me wo de xue qiu ke yi you wu ge xue qiu gao ma ？]

english: And mine can be three snowballs tall?
translation: 我的可以有三个雪球高吗？ [wo de ke yi you san ge xue qiu gao ma ？]

english: Yes, I'll make you both whatever snowman you like!
translation: 是的，我会给你们堆任何你们喜欢的雪人！ [shi de ， wo hui gei ni men dui ren he ni men xi huan de xue ren ！]

english: What would you both like?
translation: 你们俩想要什么？ [ni men lia xiang yao shen me ？]

english: I'd like mine to be three snowballs tall please! And I want the bottom one to be small, the middle one big, and the top one huge!
translation: 我希望我的雪球能有三个雪球那么高！我希望底部的一个小，中间的一个大，顶部的一个巨大！ [wo xi wang wo de xue qiu neng you san ge xue qiu na me gao ！ wo xi wang di bu de yi ge xiao ， zhong jian de yi ge da ， ding bu de yi ge ju da ！]

english: I'd like mine to be five snowballs tall please! I want the bottom one to be humongous, then large, then normal, then big, and then a little one for the top!
translation: 我希望我的雪球能有五个雪球那么高！我希望底部的一个巨大，然后大，然后正常，然后大，然后顶部一个小！ [wo xi wang wo de xue qiu neng you wu ge xue qiu na me gao ！ wo xi wang di bu de yi ge ju da ， ran hou da ， ran hou zheng chang ， ran hou da ， ran hou ding bu yi ge xiao ！]

english: That's two very different snowmen, I see why this didn't work before!
translation: 这是两个截然不同的雪人，我明白为什么这以前不起作用了！ [zhe shi liang ge jie ran bu tong de xue ren ， wo ming bai wei shen me zhe yi qian bu qi zuo yong le ！]

english: What do all these different sizes mean? Humongous? Normal? Little? How big are those?
translation: 所有这些不同的尺寸意味着什么？巨大吗？普通的？小的？那些有多大？ [suo you zhe xie bu tong de chi cun yi wei zhe shen me ？ ju da ma ？ pu tong de ？ xiao de ？ na xie you duo da ？]

english: You silly billy! Humongous is the biggest snowball of course!
translation: 你这个傻比利！ Humongous当然是最大的雪球！ [ni zhe ge sha bi li ！ Humongous dang ran shi zui da de xue qiu ！]

english: Normal is the normal size that you get when you make a snowball normally. It's easy!
translation: 正常是正常制作雪球时得到的正常大小。这很容易！ [zheng chang shi zheng chang zhi zuo xue qiu shi de dao de zheng chang da xiao 。 zhe hen rong yi ！]

english: Right, thank you for clearing that up. I'll figure something out.
translation: 好的，谢谢你澄清这一点。我会想办法的。 [hao de ， xie xie ni cheng qing zhe yi dian 。 wo hui xiang ban fa de 。]

english: What are you two going to do for decorations?
translation: 你们两个要做什么装饰？ [ni men liang ge yao zuo shen me zhuang shi ？]

english: I already know what I want mine to look like!
translation: 我已经知道我想要我的是什么样子了！ [wo yi jing zhi dao wo xiang yao wo de shi shen me yang zi le ！]

english: Me too!
translation: 我也是！ [wo ye shi ！]

english: Why don't you guys find some decorations while I build the snowmen? Then you can add them once I'm done.
translation: 我堆雪人的时候你们为什么不找一些装饰品呢？然后您可以在我完成后添加它们。 [wo dui xue ren de shi hou ni men wei shen me bu zhao yi xie zhuang shi pin ne ？ ran hou nin ke yi zai wo wan cheng hou tian jia ta men 。]

english: Okay sir!
translation: 好的，先生！ [hao de ， xian sheng ！]

english: We will do that!
translation: 我们会这么做的！ [wo men hui zhe me zuo de ！]

english: Well, that seems sorted. I should speak to Larry again, and see if he has any advice about building the snowmen.
translation: 嗯，看来已经解决了。我应该再和拉里谈谈，看看他对堆雪人是否有什么建议。 [n ， kan lai yi jing jie jue le 。 wo ying gai zai he la li tan tan ， kan kan ta dui dui xue ren shi fou you shen me jian yi 。]

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好呀！ [ni hao ya ！]

english: Have you started making the snowmen yet?
translation: 你开始堆雪人了吗？ [ni kai shi dui xue ren le ma ？]

english: You should talk to dad if you need some help, he knows how to make snowmen!
translation: 如果你需要帮助，你应该告诉爸爸，他知道如何堆雪人！ [ru guo ni xu yao bang zhu ， ni ying gai gao su ba ba ， ta zhi dao ru he dui xue ren ！]

english: Yeah, he always used to make really big ones with us!
translation: 是的，他总是和我们一起做一些非常大的事情！ [shi de ， ta zong shi he wo men yi qi zuo yi xie fei chang da de shi qing ！]

english: Maybe I'll go talk to him and see what advice he has.
translation: 也许我会去和他谈谈，看看他有什么建议。 [ye xu wo hui qu he ta tan tan ， kan kan ta you shen me jian yi 。]

english: He'll say, make them really tall!
translation: 他会说，让它们长得很高！ [ta hui shuo ， rang ta men zhang de hen gao ！]

english: He'll say make them shorter, because that's better!
translation: 他会说把它们弄短一点，因为这样更好！ [ta hui shuo ba ta men nong duan yi dian ， yin wei zhe yang geng hao ！]

english: I should go and speak to Larry. I'm sure he has some handy advice for me!
translation: 我应该去和拉里谈谈。我相信他会给我一些有用的建议！ [wo ying gai qu he la li tan tan 。 wo xiang xin ta hui gei wo yi xie you yong de jian yi ！]

english: That looks good! It needs a [size] snowball next!
translation: 看起来不错！接下来需要一个[大小]的雪球！ [kan qi lai bu cuo ！ jie xia lai xu yao yi ge [ da xiao ] de xue qiu ！]

english: They're done! They're so cool!
translation: 他们完成了！他们太酷了！ [ta men wan cheng le ！ ta men tai ku le ！]

english: Yay! Can we decorate them now?
translation: 耶！我们现在可以装饰它们吗？ [ye ！ wo men xian zai ke yi zhuang shi ta men ma ？]

english: Yes! Can we decorate them now please [player name]?
translation: 是的！ [玩家姓名]我们现在可以装饰它们吗？ [shi de ！ [ wan jia xing ming ] wo men xian zai ke yi zhuang shi ta men ma ？]

english: Of course you can. Are they what you wanted?
translation: 当然可以。他们是你想要的吗？ [dang ran ke yi 。 ta men shi ni xiang yao de ma ？]

english: Mine is perfect!
translation: 我的很完美！ [wo de hen wan mei ！]

english: Mine too. It's just how I wanted it.
translation: 我的也是。这正是我想要的。 [wo de ye shi 。 zhe zheng shi wo xiang yao de 。]

english: I am happy to hear that. It was harder work than I thought.
translation: 我很高兴听到这个消息。这比我想象的要辛苦。 [wo hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi 。 zhe bi wo xiang xiang de yao xin ku 。]

english: You did a good job. Thank you very much [sir/madam].
translation: 你做得很好。非常感谢您[先生/女士]。 [ni zuo de hen hao 。 fei chang gan xie nin [ xian sheng / nv shi ]。]

english: Yes, thank you [sir/madam]!
translation: 是的，谢谢你[先生/女士]！ [shi de ， xie xie ni [ xian sheng / nv shi ]！]

english: It was no problem. Merry Christmas to you both!
translation: 没问题。祝你们俩圣诞快乐！ [mei wen ti 。 zhu ni men lia sheng dan kuai le ！]

english: I should go and speak to Larry. Hopefully he has that festive white wine ready for me.
translation: 我应该去和拉里谈谈。希望他为我准备了节日白葡萄酒。 [wo ying gai qu he la li tan tan 。 xi wang ta wei wo zhun bei le jie ri bai pu tao jiu 。]

english: Those snowmen look amazing!
translation: 这些雪人看起来棒极了！ [zhe xie xue ren kan qi lai bang ji le ！]

english: Thank you! Decorating them was quite hard!
translation: 谢谢你！装饰它们相当困难！ [xie xie ni ！ zhuang shi ta men xiang dang kun nan ！]

english: Yeah, they took ages to do! Do you like mine?
translation: 是的，他们花了很长时间才完成！你喜欢我的吗？ [shi de ， ta men hua le hen zhang shi jian cai wan cheng ！ ni xi huan wo de ma ？]

english: It's really good! Reminds me of something actually.
translation: 真是太好了！其实让我想起一件事。 [zhen shi tai hao le ！ qi shi rang wo xiang qi yi jian shi 。]

english: What about mine? Do you like it?
translation: 我的呢？你喜欢它？ [wo de ne ？ ni xi huan ta ？]

english: I like yours too. They both remind me of something!
translation: 我也喜欢你的。他们都让我想起了一件事！ [wo ye xi huan ni de 。 ta men dou rang wo xiang qi le yi jian shi ！]

english: Mine is Thermy! My favourite monster! She's so big and scary, makes me go woah!
translation: 我的是Thermy！我最喜欢的怪物！她又大又吓人，让我哇哦！ [wo de shi Thermy！ wo zui xi huan de guai wu ！ ta you da you xia ren ， rang wo wa o ！]

english: Mine is Tempy! My favourite monster! He lives in the water, a huge mass of angry wet!
translation: 我的是临时的！我最喜欢的怪物！他生活在水中，一团愤怒的湿气！ [wo de shi lin shi de ！ wo zui xi huan de guai wu ！ ta sheng huo zai shui zhong ， yi tuan fen nu de shi qi ！]

english: They're both amazing! I didn't know you guys would be so good at decorating.
translation: 他们都很棒！没想到你们装修这么好。 [ta men dou hen bang ！ mei xiang dao ni men zhuang xiu zhe me hao 。]

english: Dad lets us decorate every year. We get a lot of practice!
translation: 爸爸每年都会让我们装饰。我们得到很多练习！ [ba ba mei nian du hui rang wo men zhuang shi 。 wo men de dao hen duo lian xi ！]

english: Last year we made them into the Fragment of Seren and the King Black Dragon!
translation: 去年我们把他们做成了塞伦和黑龙王的碎片！ [qu nian wo men ba ta men zuo cheng le sai lun he hei long wang de sui pian ！]

english: What... really??? I'd like to have seen that. Those sound even more difficult than these two!
translation: 什么……真的吗？？？我希望看到这一点。这听起来比这两个还要难！ [shen me …… zhen de ma ？？？ wo xi wang kan dao zhe yi dian 。 zhe ting qi lai bi zhe liang ge hai yao nan ！]

english: How do you know all these monsters anyway? There is no way your dad would let you anywhere near them!
translation: 你怎么认识这些怪物的？你爸爸绝对不会让你靠近他们！ [ni zen me ren shi zhe xie guai wu de ？ ni ba ba jue dui bu hui rang ni kao jin ta men ！]

english: Dad reads us lots of stories, and we hear about them from passing adventurers, like you.
translation: 爸爸给我们读了很多故事，我们也从像你一样路过的冒险家那里听到了这些故事。 [ba ba gei wo men du le hen duo gu shi ， wo men ye cong xiang ni yi yang lu guo de mao xian jia na li ting dao le zhe xie gu shi 。]

english: You must meet some interesting and cool adventurers!
translation: 你一定会遇到一些有趣又酷的冒险家！ [ni yi ding hui yu dao yi xie you qu you ku de mao xian jia ！]

english: Not as cool as you though; none of them helped us make our snowmen!
translation: 虽然没有你那么酷；他们都没有帮我们堆雪人！ [sui ran mei you ni na me ku ； ta men dou mei you bang wo men dui xue ren ！]

english: Yes, you're the first to help us make them!
translation: 是的，你是第一个帮助我们制作它们的人！ [shi de ， ni shi di yi ge bang zhu wo men zhi zuo ta men de ren ！]

english: Well, you're welcome. I really enjoyed it. What are you guys going to do now you're finished?
translation: 好吧，不客气。我真的很喜欢它。完成后你们打算做什么？ [hao ba ， bu ke qi 。 wo zhen de hen xi huan ta 。 wan cheng hou ni men da suan zuo shen me ？]

english: We're going to go and play! And maybe visit the festival. Will you be there?
translation: 我们要去玩啦！也许还可以参观这个节日。你会在那里吗？ [wo men yao qu wan la ！ ye xu hai ke yi can guan zhe ge jie ri 。 ni hui zai na li ma ？]

english: I sure will be. Maybe see you there!
translation: 我肯定会的。也许在那里见到你！ [wo ken ding hui de 。 ye xu zai na li jian dao ni ！]

english: Bye sir, Merry Christmas.
translation: 再见先生，圣诞快乐。 [zai jian xian sheng ， sheng dan kuai le 。]

english: Merry Christmas, have fun!
translation: 圣诞快乐，玩得开心！ [sheng dan kuai le ， wan de kai xin ！]

english: There's not much time left.
translation: 剩下的时间不多了。 [sheng xia de shi jian bu duo le 。]

english: Maybe I'll... No, stupid idea Guss!
translation: 也许我会……不，愚蠢的想法，格斯！ [ye xu wo hui …… bu ， yu chun de xiang fa ， ge si ！]

english: What am I going to do?
translation: 我要做什么？ [wo yao zuo shen me ？]

english: Are you okay?
translation: 你还好吗？ [ni hai hao ma ？]

english: Hmm, I wonder... I could use a hand with something actually.
translation: 嗯，我想知道……我实际上可以用一只手来拿东西。 [n ， wo xiang zhi dao …… wo shi ji shang ke yi yong yi zhi shou lai na dong xi 。]

english: Oh yeah? What exactly do you need help with?
translation: 哦，是吗？您到底需要什么帮助？ [o ， shi ma ？ nin dao di xu yao shen me bang zhu ？]

english: You're willing to help? Great stuff.
translation: 你愿意帮忙吗？很棒的东西。 [ni yuan yi bang mang ma ？ hen bang de dong xi 。]

english: I didn't say y-
translation: 我没说你- [wo mei shuo ni -]

english: The name is Guss, Guss Mistletoad. You see that portal over there?
translation: 我的名字叫格斯，格斯槲蟾蜍。你看到那边那个传送门了吗？ [wo de ming zi jiao ge si ， ge si hu chan chu 。 ni kan dao na bian na ge chuan song men le ma ？]

english: I see it.
translation: 我看到了。 [wo kan dao le 。]

english: That's the portal to The Nutcracker pub. It's been a dream of mine to get inside.
translation: 那是胡桃夹子酒吧的门户。进入里面一直是我的梦想。 [na shi hu tao jia zi jiu ba de men hu 。 jin ru li mian yi zhi shi wo de meng xiang 。]

english: I swear I didn't see that pub on my bar crawl card.
translation: 我发誓我在酒吧爬行卡上没有看到那家酒吧。 [wo fa shi wo zai jiu ba pa xing ka shang mei you kan dao na jia jiu ba 。]

english: I've never seen this portal or heard of this pub before.
translation: 我以前从未见过这个门户网站或听说过这个酒吧。 [wo yi qian cong wei jian guo zhe ge men hu wang zhan huo ting shuo guo zhe ge jiu ba 。]

english: Why don't you just walk in?
translation: 你为什么不直接走进去呢？ [ni wei shen me bu zhi jie zou jin qu ne ？]

english: Poor innocent Player, you can't just do that! It's Santa's prized pub, only a select few can enter.
translation: 可怜无辜的玩家，你不能这么做！这是圣诞老人珍贵的酒吧，只有少数人可以进入。 [ke lian wu gu de wan jia ， ni bu neng zhe me zuo ！ zhe shi sheng dan lao ren zhen gui de jiu ba ， zhi you shao shu ren ke yi jin ru 。]

english: So what exactly are the criteria for entry?
translation: 那么具体的准入标准是什么呢？ [na me ju ti de zhun ru biao zhun shi shen me ne ？]

english: You have to win the Festive Games of course. It's a series of games to determine who is the most festive in the land.
translation: 当然，你必须赢得节日运动会。这是一系列游戏，旨在确定谁是这片土地上最有节日气氛的人。 [dang ran ， ni bi xu ying de jie ri yun dong hui 。 zhe shi yi xi lie you xi ， zhi zai que ding shui shi zhe pian tu di shang zui you jie ri qi fen de ren 。]

english: So you're familiar with these games?
translation: 那么你对这些游戏很熟悉吗？ [na me ni dui zhe xie you xi hen shu xi ma ？]

english: Yes! But I'm not good at them. I can never get past the final. That's where I'm hoping you can help! Let's rig it.
translation: 是的！但我不擅长这些。我永远无法闯过决赛。这就是我希望你能提供帮助的地方！让我们来装备它吧。 [shi de ！ dan wo bu shan chang zhe xie 。 wo yong yuan wu fa chuang guo jue sai 。 zhe jiu shi wo xi wang ni neng ti gong bang zhu de di fang ！ rang wo men lai zhuang bei ta ba 。]

english: By 'rig the games' you mean I carry you through them?
translation: 你所说的“操纵游戏”是指我带领你完成这些游戏吗？ [ni suo shuo de “ cao zong you xi ” shi zhi wo dai ling ni wan cheng zhe xie you xi ma ？]

english: Absolutely.
translation: 绝对地。 [jue dui di 。]

english: Shall we begin?
translation: 我们开始吧？ [wo men kai shi ba ？]

english: Sure, as long as you'll bring me some beer from the pub when you win.
translation: 当然可以，只要你赢了之后从酒吧给我带点啤酒就可以了。 [dang ran ke yi ， zhi yao ni ying le zhi hou cong jiu ba gei wo dai dian pi jiu jiu ke yi le 。]

english: If there's any left after I'm done!
translation: 如果我完成后还有剩余的话！ [ru guo wo wan cheng hou hai you sheng yu de hua ！]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: How do we enter these games then?
translation: 那么我们如何进入这些游戏呢？ [na me wo men ru he jin ru zhe xie you xi ne ？]

english: First off we need to nab ourselves some game times from Santa.
translation: 首先，我们需要从圣诞老人那里获得一些游戏时间。 [shou xian ， wo men xu yao cong sheng dan lao ren na li huo de yi xie you xi shi jian 。]

english: You've got to do this Player, but be very vague as to why you need two entry times.
translation: 您必须执行此播放器，但要非常模糊地说明为什么需要两次进入时间。 [nin bi xu zhi xing ci bo fang qi ， dan yao fei chang mo hu di shuo ming wei shen me xu yao liang ci jin ru shi jian 。]

english: Why do I need to be vague?
translation: 为什么我需要含糊其辞？ [wei shen me wo xu yao han hu qi ci ？]

english: As I mentioned before, I've taken part in these games many times before. Failing every single time.
translation: 正如我之前提到的，我以前多次参加过这些比赛。每次都失败。 [zheng ru wo zhi qian ti dao de ， wo yi qian duo ci can jia guo zhe xie bi sai 。 mei ci dou shi bai 。]

english: Let's say I'm not exactly on the nice list at the moment.
translation: 假设我目前并不在好名单上。 [jia she wo mu qian bing bu zai hao ming dan shang 。]

english: I'll do my best.
translation: 我会尽力的。 [wo hui jin li de 。]

english: Thanks Player, I'm so excited for an all-I-can-drink beer-fest.
translation: 谢谢玩家，我对畅饮啤酒节感到非常兴奋。 [xie xie wan jia ， wo dui chang yin pi jiu jie gan dao fei chang xing fen 。]

english: Tell me a bit about yourself, Guss.
translation: 告诉我一些关于你自己的事，格斯。 [gao su wo yi xie guan yu ni zi ji de shi ， ge si 。]

english: What a lovely person you are Player! I do love a backstory!
translation: 你是一个多么可爱的人啊玩家！我真的很喜欢背景故事！ [ni shi yi ge duo me ke ai de ren a wan jia ！ wo zhen de hen xi huan bei jing gu shi ！]

english: Let's paint a picture for you...
translation: 让我们为您画一幅画... [rang wo men wei nin hua yi fu hua ...]

english: It was a frosty morning in the month of Bennath, around twenty one years go...
translation: 那是本纳特月的一个寒冷的早晨，距今大约二十一年了…… [na shi ben na te yue de yi ge han leng de zao chen ， ju jin da yue er shi yi nian le ……]

english: I'd just left my friend Doric's house after 'borrowing' some ore to take back to the mines.
translation: 在“借”了一些矿石带回矿井后，我刚刚离开朋友多里克的家。 [zai “ jie ” le yi xie kuang shi dai hui kuang jing hou ， wo gang gang li kai peng you duo li ke de jia 。]

english: Off to work I go.. Hi ho, h-
translation: 我去上班了..嗨，h- [wo qu shang ban le .. hai ，h-]

english: No that's not right.
translation: 不，那是不对的。 [bu ， na shi bu dui de 。]

english: Anyway, I went to work and as you can probably tell, I work in the Dwarven Mines.
translation: 不管怎样，我去上班了，正如你可能知道的那样，我在矮人矿井工作。 [bu guan zen yang ， wo qu shang ban le ， zheng ru ni ke neng zhi dao de na yang ， wo zai ai ren kuang jing gong zuo 。]

english: One day I got really thirsty, I hadn't consumed an alcoholic beverage in over five minutes.
translation: 有一天，我真的很渴，我已经五分钟多没有喝任何酒精饮料了。 [you yi tian ， wo zhen de hen ke ， wo yi jing wu fen zhong duo mei you he ren he jiu jing yin liao le 。]

english: I was getting reckless.
translation: 我变得鲁莽了。 [wo bian de lu mang le 。]

english: So I went out in search of the nearest pub.
translation: 于是我出去寻找最近的酒吧。 [yu shi wo chu qu xun zhao zui jin de jiu ba 。]

english: For some unknown reason I saw this portal, same as you see it today.
translation: 由于某种未知的原因，我看到了这个门户，就像你今天看到的一样。 [you yu mou zhong wei zhi de yuan yin ， wo kan dao le zhe ge men hu ， jiu xiang ni jin tian kan dao de yi yang 。]

english: It's the middle of Bennath, why does it look so Christmassy? I thought to myself.
translation: 都在Bennath的中间了，为什么看起来这么有圣诞气氛呢？我心想。 [dou zai Bennath de zhong jian le ， wei shen me kan qi lai zhe me you sheng dan qi fen ne ？ wo xin xiang 。]

english: Turns out there'd been a mix up...
translation: 原来是搞混了…… [yuan lai shi gao hun le ……]

english: Long story short, I got chatting to Santa and he told me about the games and the amazing Nutcracker pub.
translation: 长话短说，我和圣诞老人​​聊天，他告诉我有关游戏和令人惊叹的胡桃夹子酒吧的信息。 [chang hua duan shuo ， wo he sheng dan lao ren ​​ liao tian ， ta gao su wo you guan you xi he ling ren jing tan de hu tao jia zi jiu ba de xin xi 。]

english: From that day on I was determined to gain access to this pub!
translation: 从那天起我就下定决心要进入这家酒吧！ [cong na tian qi wo jiu xia ding jue xin yao jin ru zhe jia jiu ba ！]

english: So in a nutshell, you got thirsty and wanted to go to a pub?
translation: 简而言之，您口渴了，想去酒吧吗？ [jian er yan zhi ， nin kou ke le ， xiang qu jiu ba ma ？]

english: Yup.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: You know there is a pub just south-west of here? In Falador?
translation: 你知道这里西南方向有一家酒吧吗？在法拉多？ [ni zhi dao zhe li xi nan fang xiang you yi jia jiu ba ma ？ zai fa la duo ？]

english: Oh, there's one finite detail I missed out.
translation: 哦，我错过了一个有限的细节。 [o ， wo cuo guo le yi ge you xian de xi jie 。]

english: The Nutcracker has a FREE BAR!
translation: 胡桃夹子有一个免费酒吧！ [hu tao jia zi you yi ge mian fei jiu ba ！]

english: Of course it has.
translation: 当然有。 [dang ran you 。]

english: Some of the folk passing through felt a bit sorry for me after all these years, so they made me this cool jumper and hat to keep me warm.
translation: 这些年来，一些路过的人对我感到有点遗憾，所以他们给我做了一件很酷的毛衣和帽子来保暖。 [zhe xie nian lai ， yi xie lu guo de ren dui wo gan dao you dian yi han ， suo yi ta men gei wo zuo le yi jian hen ku de mao yi he mao zi lai bao nuan 。]

english: They do look great.
translation: 他们看起来确实很棒。 [ta men kan qi lai que shi hen bang 。]

english: So you've done these games before Guss?
translation: 那么你在 Guss 之前就做过这些游戏了？ [na me ni zai  Guss  zhi qian jiu zuo guo zhe xie you xi le ？]

english: That's correct, yeah.
translation: 这是正确的，是的。 [zhe shi zheng que de ， shi de 。]

english: This will be easy then. You can just tell me how to win each game.
translation: 那么这会很容易。你可以告诉我如何赢得每场比赛。 [na me zhe hui hen rong yi 。 ni ke yi gao su wo ru he ying de mei chang bi sai 。]

english: Annoyingly, the games change every year.
translation: 令人烦恼的是，游戏每年都在变化。 [ling ren fan nao de shi ， you xi mei nian dou zai bian hua 。]

english: But I can tell you what I know.
translation: 但我可以告诉你我所知道的。 [dan wo ke yi gao su ni wo suo zhi dao de 。]

english: Santa runs these games like a tournament. You win one, you move onto the next game.
translation: 圣诞老人像举办锦标赛一样举办这些游戏。你赢了一场，你就进入下一场比赛。 [sheng dan lao ren xiang ju ban jin biao sai yi yang ju ban zhe xie you xi 。 ni ying le yi chang ， ni jiu jin ru xia yi chang bi sai 。]

english: There are two games total, and then the final!
translation: 总共有两场比赛，然后是决赛！ [zong gong you liang chang bi sai ， ran hou shi jue sai ！]

english: What were the games like before? Were they hard?
translation: 之前的比赛是什么样的？他们辛苦吗？ [zhi qian de bi sai shi shen me yang de ？ ta men xin ku ma ？]

english: For a small dwarf like me, the hardest thing I've ever played.
translation: 对于像我这样的小矮人来说，这是我玩过的最难的事情。 [dui yu xiang wo zhe yang de xiao ai ren lai shuo ， zhe shi wo wan guo de zui nan de shi qing 。]

english: But for you it'll be a piece of cake!
translation: 但对你来说，这只是小菜一碟！ [dan dui ni lai shuo ， zhe zhi shi xiao cai yi die ！]

english: Well, I hope so.
translation: 嗯，我希望如此。 [n ， wo xi wang ru ci 。]

english: I better be off.
translation: 我最好还是离开吧 [wo zui hao hai shi li kai ba]

english: Bye Player!
translation: 玩家再见！ [wan jia zai jian ！]

english: Right, I've got two times for us.
translation: 是的，我有两次机会。 [shi de ， wo you liang ci ji hui 。]

english: Amazing, Santa didn't suspect a thing?
translation: 太神奇了，圣诞老人一点儿都没有怀疑吗？ [tai shen qi le ， sheng dan lao ren yi dian er dou mei you huai yi ma ？]

english: No, but you may have to re-home a few kittens.
translation: 不，但您可能需要重新安置几只小猫。 [bu ， dan nin ke neng xu yao chong xin an zhi ji zhi xiao mao 。]

english: Uhhh, I'm not s-
translation: 呃呃，我不是—— [e e ， wo bu shi ——]

english: But that's not important right now.
translation: 但现在这并不重要。 [dan xian zai zhe bing bu zhong yao 。]

english: Actually, there is a bit of a snag. Our times are different for entering the games.
translation: 事实上，有一点障碍。我们进入游戏的时代不同。 [shi shi shang ， you yi dian zhang ai 。 wo men jin ru you xi de shi dai bu tong 。]

english: Oh no, this can't be happening. That puts a right spanner in the works.
translation: 哦不，这不可能发生。这就为工作注入了一把合适的扳手。 [o bu ， zhe bu ke neng fa sheng 。 zhe jiu wei gong zuo zhu ru le yi ba he shi de ban shou 。]

english: Well, by the sounds of it you said it's a tournament format right?
translation: 嗯，听上去你说这是一种锦标赛形式，对吗？ [n ， ting shang qu ni shuo zhe shi yi zhong jin biao sai xing shi ， dui ma ？]

english: I did say that, yes.
translation: 我确实说过，是的。 [wo que shi shuo guo ， shi de 。]

english: So maybe everyone gets pulled in for one big final?
translation: 那么也许每个人都会参加一场重要的决赛？ [na me ye xu mei ge ren du hui can jia yi chang zhong yao de jue sai ？]

english: Of course! How silly of me, you'd have thought I would remember that after twenty one years of playing these games.
translation: 当然！我真是太傻了，你以为我玩这些游戏二十一年后还会记得这一点。 [dang ran ！ wo zhen shi tai sha le ， ni yi wei wo wan zhe xie you xi er shi yi nian hou hai hui ji de zhe yi dian 。]

english: How confident are you in getting to the final?
translation: 你对进入决赛有多大信心？ [ni dui jin ru jue sai you duo da xin xin ？]

english: Oh it's impossible for me.
translation: 哦，这对我来说是不可能的。 [o ， zhe dui wo lai shuo shi bu ke neng de 。]

english: What?!
translation: 什么？！ [shen me ？！]

english: Silly [player name], I'll cheat of course. I gave up my festive games morals long ago.
translation: 愚蠢的[玩家名字]，我当然会作弊。我很早就放弃了节日游戏道德。 [yu chun de [ wan jia ming zi ]， wo dang ran hui zuo bi 。 wo hen zao jiu fang qi le jie ri you xi dao de 。]

english: Suit yourself.
translation: 适合自己。 [shi he zi ji 。]

english: Looks like my time is first, so I'll hopefully see you in the final!
translation: 看来我的时间是第一，所以希望能在决赛中见到你！ [kan lai wo de shi jian shi di yi ， suo yi xi wang neng zai jue sai zhong jian dao ni ！]

english: Good luck [player name] I've got snow doubts you'll do great!
translation: 祝你好运[玩家姓名] 我非常怀疑你会做得很好！ [zhu ni hao yun [ wan jia xing ming ]  wo fei chang huai yi ni hui zuo de hen hao ！]

english: Did you just-
translation: 你刚刚是不是—— [ni gang gang shi bu shi ——]

english: Until we meet again!
translation: 直到我们再次见面！ [zhi dao wo men zai ci jian mian ！]

english: So, this is the finale?
translation: 那么，这就是大结局了吗？ [na me ， zhe jiu shi da jie ju le ma ？]

english: Yes indeed [player name].
translation: 是的，确实是[玩家姓名]。 [shi de ， que shi shi [ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Amazing job getting here so far by the way. I had absolute faith in you!
translation: 顺便说一句，到目前为止，工作进展顺利。我对你有绝对的信心！ [shun bian shuo yi ju ， dao mu qian wei zhi ， gong zuo jin zhan shun li 。 wo dui ni you jue dui de xin xin ！]

english: This last game is a blood bath.
translation: 最后一场比赛是一场血战。 [zui hou yi chang bi sai shi yi chang xue zhan 。]

english: How do you know so much about the final game, you haven't even played it yet?
translation: 你怎么对最后一场比赛这么了解，你还没玩过呢？ [ni zen me dui zui hou yi chang bi sai zhe me liao jie ， ni hai mei wan guo ne ？]

translation: 我坚信非怪物政策......我们真的应该摆脱它们......如果这意味着我必须像怪物一样住在山洞里，那就这样吧！ [wo jian xin fei guai wu zheng ce ...... wo men zhen de ying gai bai tuo ta men ...... ru guo zhe yi wei zhe wo bi xu xiang guai wu yi yang zhu zai shan dong li ， na jiu zhe yang ba ！]

english: What do you think you're going to achieve?
translation: 您认为您将实现什么目标？ [nin ren wei nin jiang shi xian shen me mu biao ？]

english: We want a world without monsters, to live in safety and without fear of being attacked by these ferocious beasts.
translation: 我们想要一个没有怪物的世界，安全地生活，不用担心被这些凶猛的野兽袭击。 [wo men xiang yao yi ge mei you guai wu de shi jie ， an quan di sheng huo ， bu yong dan xin bei zhe xie xiong meng de ye shou xi ji 。]

english: But there aren't that many ferocious beasts in the towns and cities.
translation: 但城镇里并没有那么多凶猛的野兽。 [dan cheng zhen li bing mei you na me duo xiong meng de ye shou 。]

english: That's not enough, we want to get rid of them totally, we want to enjoy the surrounding lands and not worry about our children playing in caves and so on.
translation: 这还不够，我们想完全摆脱它们，我们想享受周围的土地，而不是担心我们的孩子在洞穴里玩耍等等。 [zhe hai bu gou ， wo men xiang wan quan bai tuo ta men ， wo men xiang xiang shou zhou wei de tu di ， er bu shi dan xin wo men de hai zi zai dong xue li wan shua deng deng 。]

english: Where did all you people come from?
translation: 你们都是从哪里来的？ [ni men dou shi cong na li lai de ？]

english: Most of us came from small towns that had been attacked by monsters. We all got fed up with it and so decided to join this movement. We're hoping to return to the towns and cities when we've cleaned up the areas
translation: 我们大多数人都来自遭受怪物袭击的小镇。我们都厌倦了它，所以决定加入这个运动。我们希望在清理完这些地区后能够返回城镇 [wo men da duo shu ren dou lai zi zao shou guai wu xi ji de xiao zhen 。 wo men dou yan juan le ta ， suo yi jue ding jia ru zhe ge yun dong 。 wo men xi wang zai qing li wan zhe xie di qu hou neng gou fan hui cheng zhen]

english: that these monsters live in.
translation: 这些怪物居住的地方。 [zhe xie guai wu ju zhu de di fang 。]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: I hear you brother...
translation: 听说你兄弟... [ting shuo ni xiong di ...]

english: You speak the truth brother...
translation: 你说的是实话兄弟... [ni shuo de shi shi hua xiong di ...]

english: Well said brother...
translation: 兄弟说得好... [xiong di shuo de hao ...]

english: What are all you people doing here?
translation: 你们都在这里做什么？ [ni men dou zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Who are you and what do you do here?
translation: 你是谁？你在这里做什么？ [ni shi shui ？ ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: What do you think you're going to achieve?
translation: 您认为您将实现什么目标？ [nin ren wei nin jiang shi xian shen me mu biao ？]

english: Where did all you people come from?
translation: 你们都是从哪里来的？ [ni men dou shi cong na li lai de ？]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello cat.
translation: 你好猫。 [ni hao mao 。]

english: Meow!
translation: 喵！ [miao ！]

english: One does not wish to be disturbed.
translation: 一个人不希望被打扰。 [yi ge ren bu xi wang bei da rao 。]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: Guard, who is this outlander?
translation: 守卫，这个外地人是谁？ [shou wei ， zhe ge wai di ren shi shui ？]

english: This is [Fremennik name] your majesty.
translation: 这是[弗雷曼尼克名字]陛下。 [zhe shi [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ] bi xia 。]

english: Is this true? You are the outlander who has been given a Fremennik name?
translation: 这是真的吗？你是那个被赋予弗雷曼尼克名字的外来者吗？ [zhe shi zhen de ma ？ ni shi na ge bei fu yu fu lei man ni ke ming zi de wai lai zhe ma ？]

english: Indeed I am.
translation: 确实我是。 [que shi wo shi 。]

english: Excellent.
translation: 出色的。 [chu se de 。]

english: How may I assist your Highness?
translation: 我该如何协助殿下？ [wo gai ru he xie zhu dian xia ？]

english: Behave Hrafn!
translation: 赫拉芬要乖！ [he la fen yao guai ！]

english: I have a task that requires your unique-
translation: 我有一项任务需要你的独特—— [wo you yi xiang ren wu xu yao ni de du te ——]

english: Not now, Hrafn. Now where was I?
translation: 现在不行，赫拉芬。现在我在哪里？ [xian zai bu xing ， he la fen 。 xian zai wo zai na li ？]

english: You mentioned a task requiring my unique-
translation: 你提到了一项需要我独特的任务—— [ni ti dao le yi xiang xu yao wo du te de ren wu ——]

english: Ah, yes. Your unique position among Fremennik-
translation: 啊，是的。您在 Fremennik 中的独特地位 - [a ， shi de 。 nin zai  Fremennik  zhong de du te di wei  -]

english: Hrafn! Oh, alright, alright, I give in.
translation: 赫拉芬！哦，好吧，好吧，我屈服了。 [he la fen ！ o ， hao ba ， hao ba ， wo qu fu le 。]

english: Look, could you fetch my cat some fish? Then we can finish our conversation in peace.
translation: 听着，你能给我的猫拿点鱼吗？然后我们就可以平静地结束我们的谈话了。 [ting zhe ， ni neng gei wo de mao na dian yu ma ？ ran hou wo men jiu ke yi ping jing di jie shu wo men de tan hua le 。]

english: Yes, that's probably a good idea.
translation: 是的，这可能是个好主意。 [shi de ， zhe ke neng shi ge hao zhu yi 。]

english: Thank you. Hrafn will only eat raw tuna.
translation: 谢谢。 Hrafn 只吃生金枪鱼。 [xie xie 。 Hrafn  zhi chi sheng jin qiang yu 。]

english: Will any raw tuna do?
translation: 生金枪鱼可以吗？ [sheng jin qiang yu ke yi ma ？]

english: Yes, fussy though Hrafn is, he doesn't care where the tuna comes from. If you don't already have any, you can catch some down by the docks, or you can buy some from my fishmonger, Flosi Dalksson.
translation: 是的，虽然赫拉芬很挑剔，但他并不关心金枪鱼来自哪里。如果你还没有，你可以在码头抓一些，或者你可以从我的鱼贩弗洛西·达尔克森那里买一些。 [shi de ， sui ran he la fen hen tiao ti ， dan ta bing bu guan xin jin qiang yu lai zi na li 。 ru guo ni hai mei you ， ni ke yi zai ma tou zhua yi xie ， huo zhe ni ke yi cong wo de yu fan fu luo xi · da er ke sen na li mai yi xie 。]

english: Hello again, [Fremennik name]. Do you have a piece of raw tuna for Hrafn?
translation: 再次你好，[弗雷曼尼克名字]。你有一块给赫拉芬吃的生金枪鱼吗？ [zai ci ni hao ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 ni you yi kuai gei he la fen chi de sheng jin qiang yu ma ？]

english: Yes, I have your pet's fish.
translation: 是的，我有你宠物的鱼。 [shi de ， wo you ni chong wu de yu 。]

english: You feed Hrafn the tuna.
translation: 你给赫拉芬喂金枪鱼。 [ni gei he la fen wei jin qiang yu 。]

english: Thanks [Fremennik name], you are the first person to stand up to the King's bullying in many a year. Maybe he learnt something today?
translation: 谢谢[弗雷曼尼克名字]，你是多年来第一个勇敢地面对国王欺凌的人。也许他今天学到了什么？ [xie xie [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]， ni shi duo nian lai di yi ge yong gan di mian dui guo wang qi ling de ren 。 ye xu ta jin tian xue dao le shen me ？]

english: We can but hope Thorkel.
translation: 我们只能希望托克尔。 [wo men zhi neng xi wang tuo ke er 。]

english: Fare thee well brave warrior, fare thee well.
translation: 再见，勇敢的战士，再见。 [zai jian ， yong gan de zhan shi ， zai jian 。]

english: Purrrrz! (One wishes the tuna-bearing outlander well. One would prefer for him to stay.)
translation: 呜呜！ （人们祝愿这位产金枪鱼的外地人一切顺利。人们更希望他留下来。） [wu wu ！ （ ren men zhu yuan zhe wei chan jin qiang yu de wai di ren yi qie shun li 。 ren men geng xi wang ta liu xia lai 。）]

english: Useless, disloyal cat.
translation: 没用的、不忠诚的猫。 [mei yong de 、 bu zhong cheng de mao 。]

english: Here you go, enjoy your fish.
translation: 来吧，享受你的鱼吧。 [lai ba ， xiang shou ni de yu ba 。]

english: What is the meaning of this serf? One specifically asked for RAW tuna, not fish defiled by human fire!
translation: 这个农奴的意义是什么？其中一位特别要求吃生金枪鱼，而不是被人火玷污的鱼！ [zhe ge nong nu de yi yi shi shen me ？ qi zhong yi wei te bie yao qiu chi sheng jin qiang yu ， er bu shi bei ren huo dian wu de yu ！]

english: Here you go. Enjoy your fish.
translation: 干得好。尽情享受你的鱼吧。 [gan de hao 。 jin qing xiang shou ni de yu ba 。]

english: What is the meaning of this serf? How is one supposed to eat a piece of paper?
translation: 这个农奴的意义是什么？人怎么能吃掉一张纸呢？ [zhe ge nong nu de yi yi shi shen me ？ ren zen me neng chi diao yi zhang zhi ne ？]

english: Here you go. enjoy your fish!
translation: 干得好。享受你的鱼吧！ [gan de hao 。 xiang shou ni de yu ba ！]

english: Purrrrrrrrrr (One is satisfied with the freshness of the tuna. The humans have acted satisfactorily in this matter.)
translation: 呜呜呜（对金枪鱼的新鲜度很满意，人类在这件事上表现得还算满意。） [wu wu wu （ dui jin qiang yu de xin xian du hen man yi ， ren lei zai zhe jian shi shang biao xian de hai suan man yi 。）]

english: Hopefully Hrafn won't disturb your discussion with the King now.
translation: 希望赫拉芬现在不会打扰您与国王的讨论。 [xi wang he la fen xian zai bu hui da rao nin yu guo wang de tao lun 。]

english: How's life now the curse has been lifted?
translation: 诅咒解除了，现在生活怎么样？ [zu zhou jie chu le ， xian zai sheng huo zen me yang ？]

english: Much better thanks to you. We're all very impressed.
translation: 多亏了你，好多了。我们都很感动。 [duo kui le ni ， hao duo le 。 wo men dou hen gan dong 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Well hello, come in, come in, my name's Hadley, I'm head of tourism here. There's some of the most unspoilt wildlife and scenery in Gielinor here. People come from miles around to fish in the clear lakes or to wander the
translation: 嗯，你好，请进，请进，我叫哈德利，我是这里的旅游主管。这里拥有吉林诺一些未受破坏的野生动物和风景。人们从数英里外赶来，在清澈的湖水中钓鱼或漫步在 [n ， ni hao ， qing jin ， qing jin ， wo jiao ha de li ， wo shi zhe li de lv you zhu guan 。 zhe li yong you ji lin nuo yi xie wei shou po huai de ye sheng dong wu he feng jing 。 ren men cong shu ying li wai gan lai ， zai qing che de hu shui zhong diao yu huo man bu zai]

english: beautiful hillsides.
translation: 美丽的山坡。 [mei li de shan po 。]

english: It is quite pretty.
translation: 非常漂亮。 [fei chang piao liang 。]

english: Surely pretty is an understatement kind [sir/lady]. Beautiful, amazing or possibly life-changing would be more suitable wording. Have you seen Baxtorian Falls? Named after the elven king who was buried beneath
translation: 当然，漂亮是一种轻描淡写的说法[先生/女士]。美丽、令人惊奇或可能改变生活是更合适的措辞。你见过巴克斯托里安瀑布吗？以埋葬在地下的精灵国王命名 [dang ran ， piao liang shi yi zhong qing miao dan xie de shuo fa [ xian sheng / nv shi ]。 mei li 、 ling ren jing qi huo ke neng gai bian sheng huo shi geng he shi de cuo ci 。 ni jian guo ba ke si tuo li an pu bu ma ？ yi mai zang zai di xia de jing ling guo wang ming ming]

english: them.
translation: 他们。 [ta men 。]

english: What happened to the elven king?
translation: 精灵王怎么了？ [jing ling wang zen me le ？]

english: Baxtorian? I guess he died a long long time ago, it's quite sad really. After leaving his kingdom to deal with invading forces, Baxtorian returned to find his wife Glarial had been captured by the enemy.
translation: 巴克斯托里安？我想他已经死了很久很久了，真的很悲伤。离开王国对付入侵军队后，巴克斯托里安回来时发现他的妻子格拉里尔已被敌人俘虏。 [ba ke si tuo li an ？ wo xiang ta yi jing si le hen jiu hen jiu le ， zhen de hen bei shang 。 li kai wang guo dui fu ru qin jun dui hou ， ba ke si tuo li an hui lai shi fa xian ta de qi zi ge la li er yi bei di ren fu lu 。]

english: This destroyed Baxtorian, after years of searching he became a recluse. He went into the secret home he had made for Glarial under the waterfall and sealed himself in. To this day, no one has managed to enter.
translation: 这摧毁了巴克斯托里安，经过多年的寻找，他成了隐士。他走进自己在瀑布下为格拉瑞尔建造的秘密家园，并将自己封闭起来。直到今天，还没有人能够进入。 [zhe cui hui le ba ke si tuo li an ， jing guo duo nian de xun zhao ， ta cheng le yin shi 。 ta zou jin zi ji zai pu bu xia wei ge la rui er jian zao de mi mi jia yuan ， bing jiang zi ji feng bi qi lai 。 zhi dao jin tian ， hai mei you ren neng gou jin ru 。]

english: Where else is worth visiting around here?
translation: 这周边还有哪些地方值得一去呢？ [zhe zhou bian hai you na xie di fang zhi de yi qu ne ？]

english: Well, there's a wide variety of wildlife, although unfortunately most of it's quite dangerous. Please don't feed the goblins.
translation: 嗯，这里有各种各样的野生动物，但不幸的是大多数都非常危险。请不要喂妖精。 [n ， zhe li you ge zhong ge yang de ye sheng dong wu ， dan bu xing de shi da duo shu dou fei chang wei xian 。 qing bu yao wei yao jing 。]

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。 [hao de 。]

english: There is a lovely spot for a picnic on the hill to the north east, there's a monument to the elven queen Glarial. It really is quite pretty.
translation: 东北部的山上有一个适合野餐的好地方，那里有一座精灵女王格拉瑞尔的纪念碑。确实非常漂亮。 [dong bei bu de shan shang you yi ge shi he ye can de hao di fang ， na li you yi zuo jing ling nv wang ge la rui er de ji nian bei 。 que shi fei chang piao liang 。]

english: I don't like nature, it gives me a rash!
translation: 我不喜欢大自然，它让我出疹子！ [wo bu xi huan da zi ran ， ta rang wo chu zhen zi ！]

english: That's just silly talk.
translation: 这只是废话。 [zhe zhi shi fei hua 。]

english: Thanks, goodbye.
translation: 谢谢，再见。 [xie xie ， zai jian 。]

english: Enjoy your visit.
translation: 祝您访问愉快。 [zhu nin fang wen yu kuai 。]

english: Are you on holiday? If so you've come to the right place. I'm Hadley the tourist guide, anything you need to know just ask me. We have some of the most unspoilt wildlife and scenery in Gielinor.
translation: 你在度假吗？如果是这样，您就来对地方了。我是导游哈德利，有什么需要知道的都可以问我。吉利诺拥有一些未受破坏的野生动物和风景。 [ni zai du jia ma ？ ru guo shi zhe yang ， nin jiu lai dui di fang le 。 wo shi dao you ha de li ， you shen me xu yao zhi dao de dou ke yi wen wo 。 ji li nuo yong you yi xie wei shou po huai de ye sheng dong wu he feng jing 。]

english: People come from miles around to fish in the clear lakes or to wander the beautiful hillsides.
translation: 人们从几英里外赶来，在清澈的湖水中钓鱼，或者在美丽的山坡上漫步。 [ren men cong ji ying li wai gan lai ， zai qing che de hu shui zhong diao yu ， huo zhe zai mei li de shan po shang man bu 。]

english: Surely pretty is an understatement kind [sir/lady]. Beautiful, amazing or possibly life-changing would be more suitable wording. Have you seen Baxtorian Falls? Named after the elven king who was buried beneath them.
translation: 当然，漂亮是一种轻描淡写的说法[先生/女士]。美丽、令人惊奇或可能改变生活是更合适的措辞。你见过巴克斯托里安瀑布吗？以埋葬在其下方的精灵国王命名。 [dang ran ， piao liang shi yi zhong qing miao dan xie de shuo fa [ xian sheng / nv shi ]。 mei li 、 ling ren jing qi huo ke neng gai bian sheng huo shi geng he shi de cuo ci 。 ni jian guo ba ke si tuo li an pu bu ma ？ yi mai zang zai qi xia fang de jing ling guo wang ming ming 。]

english: Can you tell me what happened to the elven king?
translation: 你能告诉我精灵王发生了什么事吗？ [ni neng gao su wo jing ling wang fa sheng le shen me shi ma ？]

english: Anyway, I believe we have a book on him upstairs if you want to learn more.
translation: 不管怎样，我相信如果你想了解更多的话，我们楼上有一本关于他的书。 [bu guan zen yang ， wo xiang xin ru guo ni xiang liao jie geng duo de hua ， wo men lou shang you yi ben guan yu ta de shu 。]

english: Who was Glarial?
translation: 格拉里尔是谁？ [ge la li er shi shui ？]

english: Baxtorian's wife, the only other person who could also enter the waterfall apart from him. She was queen when this land was inhabited by elven kind.
translation: 巴克斯托里安的妻子，除了他之外，唯一一个也能进入瀑布的人。当这片土地上有精灵居住时，她是女王。 [ba ke si tuo li an de qi zi ， chu le ta zhi wai ， wei yi yi ge ye neng jin ru pu bu de ren 。 dang zhe pian tu di shang you jing ling ju zhu shi ， ta shi nv wang 。]

english: Glarial was kidnapped while Baxtorian was away, but they eventually recovered her body and brought her home to rest.
translation: 格拉里尔在巴克斯托里安不在时被绑架，但他们最终找到了她的尸体并将她带回家休息。 [ge la li er zai ba ke si tuo li an bu zai shi bei bang jia ， dan ta men zui zhong zhao dao le ta de shi ti bing jiang ta dai hui jia xiu xi 。]

english: That's sad.
translation: 太悲伤了。 [tai bei shang le 。]

english: True, I believe we have a book on Baxtorian and Glarial upstairs if you want to learn more.
translation: 确实，如果您想了解更多信息，我相信楼上有一本关于 Baxtorian 和 Glarial 的书。 [que shi ， ru guo nin xiang liao jie geng duo xin xi ， wo xiang xin lou shang you yi ben guan yu  Baxtorian  he  Glarial  de shu 。]

english: Is there treasure under the waterfall?
translation: 瀑布下面有宝藏吗？ [pu bu xia mian you bao zang ma ？]

english: Ha ha... Another treasure hunter. Well if there is no one's been able to get to it. They've been searching that river for decades, all to no avail.
translation: 哈哈……又一个寻宝者。好吧，如果没有人能够做到这一点。几十年来，他们一直在这条河上寻找，但一无所获。 [ha ha …… you yi ge xun bao zhe 。 hao ba ， ru guo mei you ren neng gou zuo dao zhe yi dian 。 ji shi nian lai ， ta men yi zhi zai zhe tiao he shang xun zhao ， dan yi wu suo huo 。]

english: I don't suppose you know anything about some kind of diamond nearby here, do you?
translation: 我想你对附近的某种钻石一无所知，是吗？ [wo xiang ni dui fu jin de mou zhong zuan shi yi wu suo zhi ， shi ma ？]

english: I am afraid not [Sir/Madam]. But isn't our waterfall very pretty?
translation: 恐怕不是[先生/女士]。但是我们的瀑布不是很漂亮吗？ [kong pa bu shi [ xian sheng / nv shi ]。 dan shi wo men de pu bu bu shi hen piao liang ma ？]

english: Um... yeah, I guess.
translation: 嗯...是的，我想。 [n ... shi de ， wo xiang 。]

english: There was a very scruffy looking merchant in here the other day, perhaps he might have the item you are looking for?
translation: 那天这里有一个看起来很邋遢的商人，也许他有你要找的东西？ [na tian zhe li you yi ge kan qi lai hen la ta de shang ren ， ye xu ta you ni yao zhao de dong xi ？]

english: I don't suppose you've ever heard of someone named Damis, have you?
translation: 我想你从来没有听说过一个叫达米斯的人，是吗？ [wo xiang ni cong lai mei you ting shuo guo yi ge jiao da mi si de ren ， shi ma ？]

english: I heard a rumour many years ago, that there was a warrior by that name who had a secret hideout somewhere in these parts, but I have never seen it myself.
translation: 我很多年前就听过一个传闻，说有一个叫这个名字的战士在这些地方的某个地方有一个秘密藏身之处，但我从未亲眼见过。 [wo hen duo nian qian jiu ting guo yi ge chuan wen ， shuo you yi ge jiao zhe ge ming zi de zhan shi zai zhe xie di fang de mou ge di fang you yi ge mi mi cang shen zhi chu ， dan wo cong wei qin yan jian guo 。]

english: And why would you be looking for such a criminal element when you could be admiring the tranquil beauty of the waterfall, anyway?
translation: 当你可以欣赏瀑布的宁静之美时，为什么还要寻找这样的犯罪元素呢？ [dang ni ke yi xin shang pu bu de ning jing zhi mei shi ， wei shen me hai yao xun zhao zhe yang de fan zui yuan su ne ？]

english: Tell me, I have reason to believe there is some kind of invisible hideout nearby... As a tourist guide, you might have heard someone mention it before...?
translation: 告诉我，我有理由相信附近有某种看不见的藏身处……作为导游的你可能听人提过……？ [gao su wo ， wo you li you xiang xin fu jin you mou zhong kan bu jian de cang shen chu …… zuo wei dao you de ni ke neng ting ren ti guo ……？]

english: You're asking me if I've seen something invisible? How ridiculous.
translation: 你问我是否看到了看不见的东西？多么可笑啊。 [ni wen wo shi fou kan dao le kan bu jian de dong xi ？ duo me ke xiao a 。]

english: Anything out of the ordinary then?
translation: 那有什么不寻常的吗？ [na you shen me bu xun chang de ma ？]

english: Hmmm... Well, we did have a report of a young couplespicnic being interrupted when a skeleton mysteriously appeared out of thin air...
translation: 嗯……好吧，我们确实收到了一份报告，一对年轻夫妇的野餐被一具神秘的骷髅凭空出现而打断…… [n …… hao ba ， wo men que shi shou dao le yi fen bao gao ， yi dui nian qing fu fu de ye can bei yi ju shen mi de ku lou ping kong chu xian er da duan ……]

english: And where was this?
translation: 这是哪里？ [zhe shi na li ？]

english: At the picnic tables just east of here. We investigated of course, this kind of thing is bad for tourism, but could find no evidence of their claims.
translation: 就在这儿东边的野餐桌上。我们当然进行了调查，这种事情对旅游业不利，但找不到任何证据证明他们的说法。 [jiu zai zhe er dong bian de ye can zhuo shang 。 wo men dang ran jin xing le diao cha ， zhe zhong shi qing dui lv you ye bu li ， dan zhao bu dao ren he zheng ju zheng ming ta men de shuo fa 。]

english: Thank you very much, you have been most helpful.
translation: 非常感谢你，你给了我最大的帮助。 [fei chang gan xie ni ， ni gei le wo zui da de bang zhu 。]

english: Did you find your mysterious invisible hideout then?
translation: 那么你找到你神秘的隐形藏身之处了吗？ [na me ni zhao dao ni shen mi de yin xing cang shen zhi chu le ma ？]

english: Yes, actually I did. Thanks for the help!
translation: 是的，实际上我做到了。感谢您的帮助！ [shi de ， shi ji shang wo zuo dao le 。 gan xie nin de bang zhu ！]

english: What happened to the elven king?
translation: 精灵王怎么了？ [jing ling wang zen me le ？]

english: Where else is worth visiting around here?
translation: 这周边还有哪些地方值得一去呢？ [zhe zhou bian hai you na xie di fang zhi de yi qu ne ？]

english: I don't like nature, it gives me a rash!
translation: 我不喜欢大自然，它让我出疹子！ [wo bu xi huan da zi ran ， ta rang wo chu zhen zi ！]

english: Thanks, goodbye.
translation: 谢谢，再见。 [xie xie ， zai jian 。]

english: Can you tell me what happened to the elven king?
translation: 你能告诉我精灵王发生了什么事吗？ [ni neng gao su wo jing ling wang fa sheng le shen me shi ma ？]

english: Is there treasure under the waterfall?
translation: 瀑布下面有宝藏吗？ [pu bu xia mian you bao zang ma ？]

english: Ask about Desert Treasure Quest
translation: 询问关于 沙漠寻宝 的问题 [xun wen guan yu   sha mo xun bao   de wen ti]

english: What are you doing in our home?
translation: 你在我们家做什么？ [ni zai wo men jia zuo shen me ？]

english: I just came to ask you a question.
translation: 我只是来问你一个问题。 [wo zhi shi lai wen ni yi ge wen ti 。]

english: Hegir, why did you let this human into our home?
translation: 海吉尔，你为什么让这个人类进入我们家？ [hai ji er ， ni wei shen me rang zhe ge ren lei jin ru wo men jia ？]

english: I didn't let him in, he let himself in!
translation: 不是我让他进来的，是他自己进来的！ [bu shi wo rang ta jin lai de ， shi ta zi ji jin lai de ！]

english: Now what do you want, human? Speak up, speak up!
translation: 现在你想要什么，人类？说出来，说出来！ [xian zai ni xiang yao shen me ， ren lei ？ shuo chu lai ， shuo chu lai ！]

english: I ehm, just wanted some information.
translation: 我嗯，只是想要一些信息。 [wo n ， zhi shi xiang yao yi xie xin xi 。]

english: Well go ask someone else instead of barging into people's homes!
translation: 好吧，去问别人吧，而不是闯入别人家！ [hao ba ， qu wen bie ren ba ， er bu shi chuang ru bie ren jia ！]

english: There's no need to be rude to the human, Haera dear.
translation: 亲爱的哈拉，没有必要对人类无礼。 [qin ai de ha la ， mei you bi yao dui ren lei wu li 。]

english: Now don't you dear me. I'll do whatever I please.
translation: 现在你不要亲爱的我。我会做任何我想做的事。 [xian zai ni bu yao qin ai de wo 。 wo hui zuo ren he wo xiang zuo de shi 。]

english: I think this is my cue to leave...
translation: 我想这是我离开的信号... [wo xiang zhe shi wo li kai de xin hao ...]

english: That's the last straw!
translation: 那是最后一根稻草！ [na shi zui hou yi gen dao cao ！]

english: Do your chores!
translation: 做你的家务事吧！ [zuo ni de jia wu shi ba ！]

english: Useless... completely useless.
translation: 没用……完全没用。 [mei yong …… wan quan mei yong 。]

english: Don't talk to me like that!
translation: 别这样跟我说话！ [bie zhe yang gen wo shuo hua ！]

english: You're no good!
translation: 你不好！ [ni bu hao ！]

english: I'm warning you, Hegir!
translation: 我警告你，赫吉尔！ [wo jing gao ni ， he ji er ！]

english: I don't know what you think you are doing here human, but I do know that you will not live long enough to leave this place.
translation: 我不知道你认为你在这里做什么，人类，但我确实知道你不会活到离开这个地方。 [wo bu zhi dao ni ren wei ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ， ren lei ， dan wo que shi zhi dao ni bu hui huo dao li kai zhe ge di fang 。]

english: Welcome to the temple of Marimbo, child. In less busy times I would bless you, but I have not the luxury of free time at the moment.
translation: 欢迎来到马林波神庙，孩子。在不那么忙碌的时候我会祝福你，但我现在没有空闲的时间。 [huan ying lai dao ma lin bo shen miao ， hai zi 。 zai bu na me mang lu de shi hou wo hui zhu fu ni ， dan wo xian zai mei you kong xian de shi jian 。]

english: However, feel free to stay here as long as you need.
translation: 不过，您可以根据需要随时留在这里。 [bu guo ， nin ke yi gen ju xu yao sui shi liu zai zhe li 。]

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Shaz berith an-gor f-
translation: 沙兹·贝里斯·安戈尔 f- [sha zi · bei li si · an ge er  f-]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Shaz berith an-gor fo gah-
translation: Shaz berith an-gor fo gah- [Shaz berith an-gor fo gah-]

english: Hey!
translation: 嘿！ [hei ！]

english: Shaz. Berith. An-
translation: 沙兹。贝里斯。一个- [sha zi 。 bei li si 。 yi ge -]

english: Can you hear me?
translation: 你能听到我吗？ [ni neng ting dao wo ma ？]

english: What?! What do you want?
translation: 什么？！你想要什么？ [shen me ？！ ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: I just wanted to say hello. I didn't expect to find anyone here.
translation: 我只是想打个招呼。没想到会在这里找到人。 [wo zhi shi xiang da ge zhao hu 。 mei xiang dao hui zai zhe li zhao dao ren 。]

english: Well, you found me. I'm here. And I was just in the middle of a very important conversation!
translation: 嗯，你找到了我。我在这儿。我正在进行一场非常重要的谈话！ [n ， ni zhao dao le wo 。 wo zai zhe er 。 wo zheng zai jin xing yi chang fei chang zhong yao de tan hua ！]

english: With who? There's no one else here...
translation: 与谁？这里没有其他人了... [yu shui ？ zhe li mei you qi ta ren le ...]

english: With Hagus.
translation: 与哈格斯。 [yu ha ge si 。]

english: Who's Hagus?
translation: 海格斯是谁？ [hai ge si shi shui ？]

english: I'm Hagus!
translation: 我是海格斯！ [wo shi hai ge si ！]

english: Right...
translation: 正确的... [zheng que de ...]

english: Whoa, no need to be rude.
translation: 呵呵，没必要这么粗鲁。 [he he ， mei bi yao zhe me cu lu 。]

english: You just interrupted a very important conversation!
translation: 你刚刚打断了一场非常重要的谈话！ [ni gang gang da duan le yi chang fei chang zhong yao de tan hua ！]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Why should I tell you? You could be one of them.
translation: 我为什么要告诉你？你可能是其中之一。 [wo wei shen me yao gao su ni ？ ni ke neng shi qi zhong zhi yi 。]

english: One of them? What are you talking about?
translation: 其中之一？你在说什么？ [qi zhong zhi yi ？ ni zai shuo shen me ？]

english: An abyssal creature, of course!
translation: 当然是深渊生物！ [dang ran shi shen yuan sheng wu ！]

english: Last time I checked I was not an abyssal creature.
translation: 上次我检查过我不是深渊生物。 [shang ci wo jian cha guo wo bu shi shen yuan sheng wu 。]

english: Hmph. We'll see about that.
translation: 哼。我们将会看到这一点。 [heng 。 wo men jiang hui kan dao zhe yi dian 。]

english: So will you tell me where we are?
translation: 那么你能告诉我我们在哪里吗？ [na me ni neng gao su wo wo men zai na li ma ？]

english: This is the Abyss.
translation: 这就是深渊。 [zhe jiu shi shen yuan 。]

english: I know that. Though I've never been to this part of it before.
translation: 我知道。虽然我以前从未去过这部分。 [wo zhi dao 。 sui ran wo yi qian cong wei qu guo zhe bu fen 。]

english: Have you heard of the Scar?
translation: 你听说过疤痕吗？ [ni ting shuo guo ba hen ma ？]

english: Well yes, I just came through there-
translation: 嗯，是的，我刚刚经过那里- [n ， shi de ， wo gang gang jing guo na li -]

english: Well then you know where we are.
translation: 那么你就知道我们在哪里了。 [na me ni jiu zhi dao wo men zai na li le 。]

english: What is that thing over there?
translation: 那边那个东西是什么？ [na bian na ge dong xi shi shen me ？]

english: That's Ventriculus.
translation: 那是心室。 [na shi xin shi 。]

english: Ventriculus? That thing has a name?
translation: 脑室？那东西有名字吗？ [nao shi ？ na dong xi you ming zi ma ？]

english: Yes, it's my friend.
translation: 是的，这是我的朋友。 [shi de ， zhe shi wo de peng you 。]

english: I... I can't tell if you're joking or not.
translation: 我……我不知道你是不是在开玩笑。 [wo …… wo bu zhi dao ni shi bu shi zai kai wan xiao 。]

english: Ventriculus is an extractor. Feed it and you'll see.
translation: 心室是一个提取器。喂它，你就会看到。 [xin shi shi yi ge ti qu qi 。 wei ta ， ni jiu hui kan dao 。]

english: Feed it?
translation: 喂它吗？ [wei ta ma ？]

english: Yes. Just put your arm in.
translation: 是的。只要把你的手臂放进去。 [shi de 。 zhi yao ba ni de shou bi fang jin qu 。]

english: That doesn't sound safe.
translation: 这听起来并不安全。 [zhe ting qi lai bing bu an quan 。]

english: It likes the tainted essence you can find in here.
translation: 它喜欢你可以在这里找到的被污染的精华。 [ta xi huan ni ke yi zai zhe li zhao dao de bei wu ran de jing hua 。]

english: A pickaxe can help you split off the essence from the amalgamations.
translation: 镐可以帮助你从混合物中分离出本质。 [gao ke yi bang zhu ni cong hun he wu zhong fen li chu ben zhi 。]

english: Right... So I mine tainted essence from amalgamations, then feed it to this Ventriculus.
translation: 对……所以我从融合中开采污染的精华，然后将其喂给这个心室。 [dui …… suo yi wo cong rong he zhong kai cai wu ran de jing hua ， ran hou jiang qi wei gei zhe ge xin shi 。]

english: But why should I do that?
translation: 但我为什么要这么做呢？ [dan wo wei shen me yao zhe me zuo ne ？]

english: Remember how I said it's an extractor?
translation: 还记得我说过它是提取器吗？ [hai ji de wo shuo guo ta shi ti qu qi ma ？]

english: Ventriculus will remove excess parts from the essence, chew it up a little, and spit out the rest.
translation: 脑室会去除精华液中多余的部分，稍微咀嚼一下，然后吐出剩余的部分。 [nao shi hui qu chu jing hua ye zhong duo yu de bu fen ， shao wei ju jue yi xia ， ran hou tu chu sheng yu de bu fen 。]

english: So you're saying it refines the essence?
translation: 所以你说它提炼了本质？ [suo yi ni shuo ta ti lian le ben zhi ？]

english: Yes, it can refine it into pure essence. However, it can also give you extracts.
translation: 是的，它可以将其炼化为纯粹的精华。但是，它也可以为您提供提取物。 [shi de ， ta ke yi jiang qi lian hua wei chun cui de jing hua 。 dan shi ， ta ye ke yi wei nin ti gong ti qu wu 。]

english: What is an 'extract'?
translation: 什么是“提取物”？ [shen me shi “ ti qu wu ”？]

english: Extracts are powerful, condensed runes. They function as catalysts to make more runes.
translation: 提取物是强大的、浓缩的符文。它们充当制造更多符文的催化剂。 [ti qu wu shi qiang da de 、 nong suo de fu wen 。 ta men chong dang zhi zao geng duo fu wen de cui hua ji 。]

english: Make more runes? How exactly does that work?
translation: 制作更多符文？具体是如何运作的？ [zhi zuo geng duo fu wen ？ ju ti shi ru he yun zuo de ？]

english: If you bring an extract when you runecraft, it multiplies the amount of runes you make.
translation: 如果您在制作符文时携带提取物，它会使您制作的符文数量成倍增加。 [ru guo nin zai zhi zuo fu wen shi xie dai ti qu wu ， ta hui shi nin zhi zuo de fu wen shu liang cheng bei zeng jia 。]

english: That's neat! I can make so much money from selling these runes!
translation: 太整洁了！卖这些符文我能赚这么多钱！ [tai zheng jie le ！ mai zhe xie fu wen wo neng zhuan zhe me duo qian ！]

english: Now hold on. I didn't say this was free.
translation: 现在坚持一下。我没说这是免费的。 [xian zai jian chi yi xia 。 wo mei shuo zhe shi mian fei de 。]

english: Ah... I suppose that makes sense.
translation: 啊……我想这是有道理的。 [a …… wo xiang zhe shi you dao li de 。]

english: I don't care about pure essence. You can extract as much as you want of that.
translation: 我不在乎纯粹的本质。您可以提取任意数量的内容。 [wo bu zai hu chun cui de ben zhi 。 nin ke yi ti qu ren yi shu liang de nei rong 。]

english: But for extracts, you've got to pay up. There's a coffer over there. Leave some money and I'll charge you for the extract you want.
translation: 但对于提取物，你必须付费。那边有一个保险箱。留下一些钱，我会收取你想要的提取物的费用。 [dan dui yu ti qu wu ， ni bi xu fu fei 。 na bian you yi ge bao xian xiang 。 liu xia yi xie qian ， wo hui shou qu ni xiang yao de ti qu wu de fei yong 。]

english: Can you explain the Ventriculus again?
translation: 您能再解释一下脑室吗？ [nin neng zai jie shi yi xia nao shi ma ？]

english: Ventriculus is an extractor. You can feed it essence from the amalgamations here.
translation: 心室是一个提取器。你可以从这里的融合中汲取精华。 [xin shi shi yi ge ti qu qi 。 ni ke yi cong zhe li de rong he zhong ji qu jing hua 。]

english: Once fed, it churns away, picking apart the essence, leftover runes and flesh.
translation: 一旦被喂食，它就会翻腾起来，将精华、剩余的符文和血肉分解开来。 [yi dan bei wei shi ， ta jiu hui fan teng qi lai ， jiang jing hua 、 sheng yu de fu wen he xue rou fen jie kai lai 。]

english: The final product is either pure essence or dense rune extracts.
translation: 最终产品要么是纯净的精华，要么是浓密的符文提取物。 [zui zhong chan pin yao me shi chun jing de jing hua ， yao me shi nong mi de fu wen ti qu wu 。]

english: And how do the extracts work?
translation: 提取物如何发挥作用？ [ti qu wu ru he fa hui zuo yong ？]

english: Extracts function as catalysts to make more runes.
translation: 提取物可作为制造更多符文的催化剂。 [ti qu wu ke zuo wei zhi zao geng duo fu wen de cui hua ji 。]

english: However, extracts are valuable. I'll demand some payment for those.
translation: 然而，提取物是有价值的。我会要求支付一些费用。 [ran er ， ti qu wu shi you jia zhi de 。 wo hui yao qiu zhi fu yi xie fei yong 。]

english: Thanks for explaining.
translation: 谢谢你的解释。 [xie xie ni de jie shi 。]

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm hanging out with my friend.
translation: 我正在和我的朋友出去玩。 [wo zheng zai he wo de peng you chu qu wan 。]

english: The... Ventriculus? It's really your friend?
translation: ……脑室？这真的是你的朋友吗？ […… nao shi ？ zhe zhen de shi ni de peng you ma ？]

english: It's helping me search for knowledge on powerful runes.
translation: 它帮助我寻找有关强大符文的知识。 [ta bang zhu wo xun zhao you guan qiang da fu wen de zhi shi 。]

english: I guess you could just... not answer my question.
translation: 我想你可能只是...不回答我的问题。 [wo xiang ni ke neng zhi shi ... bu hui da wo de wen ti 。]

english: Hagus' eyes peer at the Ventriculus.
translation: 海格斯的眼睛凝视着脑室。 [hai ge si de yan jing ning shi zhe nao shi 。]

english: We heard rumours of a strong one... but the altar was nowhere to be found.
translation: 我们听说有一位强大的传言……但祭坛却无处可寻。 [wo men ting shuo you yi wei qiang da de chuan yan …… dan ji tan que wu chu ke xun 。]

english: You're not really talking to me at all, are you.
translation: 你根本就没有在跟我说话，是吗？ [ni gen ben jiu mei you zai gen wo shuo hua ， shi ma ？]

english: Herbert, Finnigan and I... We were all assigned important missions. I must fulfill mine.
translation: 赫伯特、芬尼根和我……我们都被分配了重要的任务。我必须完成我的任务。 [he bo te 、 fen ni gen he wo …… wo men dou bei fen pei le zhong yao de ren wu 。 wo bi xu wan cheng wo de ren wu 。]

english: What mission? Who's Finnigan?
translation: 什么使命？芬尼根是谁？ [shen me shi ming ？ fen ni gen shi shui ？]

english: Hagus snaps out of it.
translation: 哈格斯猛然清醒过来。 [ha ge si meng ran qing xing guo lai 。]

english: Ah, where were we. Did you feed Ventriculus yet? We need more-
translation: 啊，我们在哪里。你喂Ventriculus了吗？我们需要更多—— [a ， wo men zai na li 。 ni wei Ventriculus le ma ？ wo men xu yao geng duo ——]

english: I mean. I'm sure you'd like some extracts.
translation: 我是说。我确信您想要一些摘录。 [wo shi shuo 。 wo que xin nin xiang yao yi xie zhai lu 。]

english: Can you tell me more about yourself?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于你自己的事吗？ [ni neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu ni zi ji de shi ma ？]

english: My name is Hagus.
translation: 我的名字是哈格斯。 [wo de ming zi shi ha ge si 。]

english: Yes... So you've said. Where are you from?
translation: 是的...你也这么说过。你从哪来？ [shi de ... ni ye zhe me shuo guo 。 ni cong na lai ？]

english: My upbringing is none of your concern.
translation: 我的成长与你无关。 [wo de cheng zhang yu ni wu guan 。]
