translation: 你能告诉我一些关于城堡的事情吗？ [ni neng gao su wo yi xie guan yu cheng bao de shi qing ma ？]

english: There aren't many guards in it.
translation: 里面的守卫并不多。 [li mian de shou wei bing bu duo 。]

english: We don't have an army, you see.
translation: 你看，我们没有军队。 [ni kan ， wo men mei you jun dui 。]

english: How's the weather doing?
translation: 天气怎么样？ [tian qi zen me yang ？]

english: Could be better.
translation: 可能会更好。 [ke neng hui geng hao 。]

english: How's life in Etceteria?
translation: Etceteria 的生活怎么样？ [Etceteria  de sheng huo zen me yang ？]

english: *sigh* Times are tough.
translation: *叹息*时代很艰难。 [* tan xi * shi dai hen jian nan 。]

english: Though they're getting better.
translation: 尽管他们的情况正在好转。 [jin guan ta men de qing kuang zheng zai hao zhuan 。]

english: What's it like being an Etceterian?
translation: 成为 Etceterian 是什么感觉？ [cheng wei  Etceterian  shi shen me gan jue ？]

english: Fairly pleasant, though it gets cold in the winter.
translation: 相当愉快，虽然冬天会很冷。 [xiang dang yu kuai ， sui ran dong tian hui hen leng 。]

english: Nice town you have here.
translation: 你这里的小镇真好。 [ni zhe li de xiao zhen zhen hao 。]

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Thank you for finding my plates for me. Did you find everyone's belongings?
translation: 谢谢你帮我找到了我的盘子。大家的财物都找到了吗？ [xie xie ni bang wo zhao dao le wo de pan zi 。 da jia de cai wu dou zhao dao le ma ？]

english: I did! Thank you for the reward.
translation: 我做到了！谢谢你的奖励。 [wo zuo dao le ！ xie xie ni de jiang li 。]

english: You're more than welcome to it, for getting our belongings back.
translation: 非常欢迎你来取回我们的东西。 [fei chang huan ying ni lai qu hui wo men de dong xi 。]

english: Can you tell me how the kingdom approves of me?
translation: 你能告诉我王国对我的认可度如何吗？ [ni neng gao su wo wang guo dui wo de ren ke du ru he ma ？]

english: Kingdom? Etceteria is ruled by a Queen and we don't approve of you.
translation: 王国？等等都是由女王统治的，我们不赞成你。 [wang guo ？ deng deng dou shi you nv wang tong zhi de ， wo men bu zan cheng ni 。]

english: [amount]% of people approve of you.
translation: [数量]％的人赞同你。 [[ shu liang ]％ de ren zan tong ni 。]

english: Have you coin?
translation: 你有硬币吗？ [ni you ying bi ma ？]

english: It seems I'm all out.
translation: 看来我已经全部out了 [kan lai wo yi jing quan bu out le]

english: Then we have nothing to discuss.
translation: 那我们就没什么可讨论的了。 [na wo men jiu mei shen me ke tao lun de le 。]

english: Umm, just a little, why?
translation: 嗯，就一点点，为什么呢？ [n ， jiu yi dian dian ， wei shen me ne ？]

english: Not nearly enough, we have nothing to discuss.
translation: 还不够，我们没有什么可讨论的。 [hai bu gou ， wo men mei you shen me ke tao lun de 。]

english: I'd rather not waste time in conversation with someone who can't pay for information.
translation: 我宁愿不浪费时间与无法支付信息费用的人交谈。 [wo ning yuan bu lang fei shi jian yu wu fa zhi fu xin xi fei yong de ren jiao tan 。]

english: Who said I need information?
translation: 谁说我需要信息？ [shui shuo wo xu yao xin xi ？]

english: You travelling types, all you have is questions.
translation: 你们这些旅行类型的人，你们有的只是问题。 [ni men zhe xie lv xing lei xing de ren ， ni men you de zhi shi wen ti 。]

english: I guess I'm a little curious about your companion.
translation: 我想我对你的同伴有点好奇。 [wo xiang wo dui ni de tong ban you dian hao qi 。]

english: The jester? The journey has put him off performing, for the better, I'd say.
translation: 小丑？我想说，这段旅程让他不再继续表演，而是为了变得更好。 [xiao chou ？ wo xiang shuo ， zhe duan lv cheng rang ta bu zai ji xu biao yan ， er shi wei le bian de geng hao 。]

english: The thief takes a handful of coins from your pack.
translation: 小偷从你的包里拿走了一把硬币。 [xiao tou cong ni de bao li na zou le yi ba ying bi 。]

english: That was hardly worth it.
translation: 这几乎不值得。 [zhe ji hu bu zhi de 。]

english: I never promised worthwhile information.
translation: 我从未承诺提供有价值的信息。 [wo cong wei cheng nuo ti gong you jia zhi de xin xi 。]

english: Do you know much about the Painted One in the town center?
translation: 你对镇中心的彩绘一了解很多吗？ [ni dui zhen zhong xin de cai hui yi liao jie hen duo ma ？]

english: Oh yes, he came with us. He tends to find himself in strange situations, but he can handle himself.
translation: 哦，是的，他和我们一起来的。他经常发现自己处于奇怪的境地，但他能处理好自己。 [o ， shi de ， ta he wo men yi qi lai de 。 ta jing chang fa xian zi ji chu yu qi guai de jing di ， dan ta neng chu li hao zi ji 。]

english: Do you care more for gold than you do your friend?
translation: 你比你的朋友更关心黄金吗？ [ni bi ni de peng you geng guan xin huang jin ma ？]

english: Apparently.
translation: 显然。 [xian ran 。]

english: I'm not giving you my money.
translation: 我不会给你我的钱。 [wo bu hui gei ni wo de qian 。]

english: I guess I'm a little curious about your companion.
translation: 我想我对你的同伴有点好奇。 [wo xiang wo dui ni de tong ban you dian hao qi 。]

english: Do you know much about the Painted One in the town center?
translation: 你对镇中心的彩绘一了解很多吗？ [ni dui zhen zhong xin de cai hui yi liao jie hen duo ma ？]

english: I'm not giving you my money.
translation: 我不会给你我的钱。 [wo bu hui gei ni wo de qian 。]

english: Excuse me, Hannibal.
translation: 对不起，汉尼拔。 [dui bu qi ， han ni ba 。]

english: Hello, Hannibal.
translation: 你好，汉尼拔。 [ni hao ， han ni ba 。]

english: Hello there, Hannibal.
translation: 你好，汉尼拔。 [ni hao ， han ni ba 。]

english: Hi there, Hannibal.
translation: 你好，汉尼拔。 [ni hao ， han ni ba 。]

english: He appears to be sleeping peacefully, so you decide to leave him be.
translation: 他看起来睡得很安稳，所以你决定不理会他。 [ta kan qi lai shui de hen an wen ， suo yi ni jue ding bu li hui ta 。]

english: Hi [player name]. You woke me up, I was fast asleep!
translation: 你好[玩家姓名]。你吵醒了我，我睡得很熟！ [ni hao [ wan jia xing ming ]。 ni chao xing le wo ， wo shui de hen shu ！]

english: I'm sorry, I didn't realise you were sleeping. I just wanted to say hello.
translation: 对不起，我没意识到你正在睡觉。我只是想打个招呼。 [dui bu qi ， wo mei yi shi dao ni zheng zai shui jiao 。 wo zhi shi xiang da ge zhao hu 。]

english: Hello then. Can I help you with anything?
translation: 那么你好。我可以帮你什么忙吗？ [na me ni hao 。 wo ke yi bang ni shen me mang ma ？]

english: No, that's it. You can go back to sleep, sorry to have disturbed you.
translation: 不，就是这样。你可以回去睡觉了，抱歉打扰你了。 [bu ， jiu shi zhe yang 。 ni ke yi hui qu shui jiao le ， bao qian da rao ni le 。]

english: It's no problem.
translation: 没问题。 [mei wen ti 。]

english: Hannibal snuggles back down and is fast asleep in an instant.
translation: 汉尼拔重新躺下，瞬间就睡着了。 [han ni ba chong xin tang xia ， shun jian jiu shui zhao le 。]

english: Hello [player name]. Did you need something?
translation: 你好[玩家姓名]。你需要什么吗？ [ni hao [ wan jia xing ming ]。 ni xu yao shen me ma ？]

english: Nothing important. I'd like to ask you a question if that is okay?
translation: 没什么重要的。我想问你一个问题，这样可以吗？ [mei shen me zhong yao de 。 wo xiang wen ni yi ge wen ti ， zhe yang ke yi ma ？]

english: Ask away.
translation: 问走吧。 [wen zou ba 。]

english: Why did you pick the kitchen as your spot to sleep? It must get quite noisy sometimes?
translation: 你为什么选择厨房作为睡觉的地方？有时候一定会很吵吧？ [ni wei shen me xuan ze chu fang zuo wei shui jiao de di fang ？ you shi hou yi ding hui hen chao ba ？]

english: It does during meal times, but it's also lovely and warm near the fire, and look at all the food!
translation: 用餐时间确实如此，但靠近火炉也很可爱和温暖，看看所有的食物！ [yong can shi jian que shi ru ci ， dan kao jin huo lu ye hen ke ai he wen nuan ， kan kan suo you de shi wu ！]

english: Good point. Now it seems like the best spot in the house!
translation: 好点。现在它似乎是房子里最好的地方！ [hao dian 。 xian zai ta si hu shi fang zi li zui hao de di fang ！]

english: You catch on quickly, for a human! Now I am going to go back to sleep, unless there is something else I can help you with?
translation: 作为一个人，你很快就能明白！现在我要回去睡觉了，除非还有什么可以帮你的？ [zuo wei yi ge ren ， ni hen kuai jiu neng ming bai ！ xian zai wo yao hui qu shui jiao le ， chu fei hai you shen me ke yi bang ni de ？]

english: That was all I wanted to ask, thank you.
translation: 这就是我想问的，谢谢。 [zhe jiu shi wo xiang wen de ， xie xie 。]

english: Hannibal curls up on the stool and goes back to sleep.
translation: 汉尼拔蜷缩在凳子上，继续睡觉。 [han ni ba quan suo zai deng zi shang ， ji xu shui jiao 。]

english: Oh, hello [player name]. Did I hear a bark?
translation: 哦，你好[玩家姓名]。我听到狗叫声了吗？ [o ， ni hao [ wan jia xing ming ]。 wo ting dao gou jiao sheng le ma ？]

english: A bark? Is there a dog here?
translation: 树皮？这里有狗吗？ [shu pi ？ zhe li you gou ma ？]

english: There is, sometimes...
translation: 有，有时... [you ， you shi ...]

english: It always wakes me up with its barking.
translation: 它总是用吠叫叫醒我。 [ta zong shi yong fei jiao jiao xing wo 。]

english: It seems to come and go. I can't figure out why or how.
translation: 似乎来来去去。我不明白为什么或如何。 [si hu lai lai qu qu 。 wo bu ming bai wei shen me huo ru he 。]

english: That is indeed strange. I'll keep an eye out for it.
translation: 这确实很奇怪。我会留意的。 [zhe que shi hen qi guai 。 wo hui liu yi de 。]

english: There it is again, did you hear it?
translation: 又来了，你听到了吗？ [you lai le ， ni ting dao le ma ？]

english: I can't say I did.
translation: 我不能说我做到了。 [wo bu neng shuo wo zuo dao le 。]

english: Maybe I'm imagining it.
translation: 也许是我想象的吧。 [ye xu shi wo xiang xiang de ba 。]

english: Hannibal settles back down and is sleeping in moments.
translation: 汉尼拔重新坐下，很快就睡着了。 [han ni ba chong xin zuo xia ， hen kuai jiu shui zhao le 。]

english: Hi [player name].
translation: 你好[玩家姓名]。 [ni hao [ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: How are you doing?
translation: 你好吗？ [ni hao ma ？]

english: I'm okay, thank you. I've been enjoying the piano playing. Was it you playing earlier?
translation: 我没事，谢谢。我一直很享受弹钢琴的乐趣。是你之前玩的吗？ [wo mei shi ， xie xie 。 wo yi zhi hen xiang shou tan gang qin de le qu 。 shi ni zhi qian wan de ma ？]

english: Oh, that wasn't me.
translation: 哦，那不是我。 [o ， na bu shi wo 。]

english: Must have been Gem then. She often plays the piano when she thinks nobody is listening.
translation: 那时一定是宝石。当她认为没有人在听时，她经常弹钢琴。 [na shi yi ding shi bao shi 。 dang ta ren wei mei you ren zai ting shi ， ta jing chang tan gang qin 。]

english: She's actually quite good.
translation: 她其实人挺好的。 [ta qi shi ren ting hao de 。]

english: I'll have to keep an ear out.
translation: 我得留心听。 [wo de liu xin ting 。]

english: Hannibal stretches and goes back to sleep.
translation: 汉尼拔伸了个懒腰，又回去睡觉了。 [han ni ba shen le ge lan yao ， you hui qu shui jiao le 。]

english: Hi there, [player name].
translation: 你好，[玩家姓名]。 [ni hao ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: I have another question for you, if that is okay?
translation: 我还有一个问题要问你，可以吗？ [wo hai you yi ge wen ti yao wen ni ， ke yi ma ？]

english: Go ahead.
translation: 前进。 [qian jin 。]

english: Do you ever leave the hall? I've only ever seen you in here.
translation: 你离开过大厅吗？我只在这里见过你。 [ni li kai guo da ting ma ？ wo zhi zai zhe li jian guo ni 。]

english: I do sometimes. If I do go out, it's normally at night.
translation: 我有时会这样做。如果我出去的话，通常是在晚上。 [wo you shi hui zhe yang zuo 。 ru guo wo chu qu de hua ， tong chang shi zai wan shang 。]

english: I much prefer it in here though. Nice and warm with good food. There is even a bank, if I ever needed a bank for anything.
translation: 不过我更喜欢这里。美好而温暖，有美味的食物。如果我需要银行做任何事，甚至还有一家银行。 [bu guo wo geng xi huan zhe li 。 mei hao er wen nuan ， you mei wei de shi wu 。 ru guo wo xu yao yin hang zuo ren he shi ， shen zhi hai you yi jia yin hang 。]

english: That's fair enough. The world can be a pretty scary place out there anyway.
translation: 这很公平。无论如何，世界可能是一个非常可怕的地方。 [zhe hen gong ping 。 wu lun ru he ， shi jie ke neng shi yi ge fei chang ke pa de di fang 。]

english: Exactly. It's much nicer to relax here, even with the occasional adventurer disturbing me.
translation: 确切地。即使偶尔有冒险家打扰我，在这里放松也更好。 [que qie di 。 ji shi ou er you mao xian jia da rao wo ， zai zhe li fang song ye geng hao 。]

english: That'll be me! Sorry, I'll let you get back to sleep.
translation: 那就是我！抱歉，我会让你再睡一会。 [na jiu shi wo ！ bao qian ， wo hui rang ni zai shui yi hui 。]

english: Hannibal goes back to sleep, enjoying the warmth of the fire.
translation: 汉尼拔回去睡觉，享受着火的温暖。 [han ni ba hui qu shui jiao ， xiang shou zhao huo de wen nuan 。]

english: You pet Hannibal...
translation: 你宠爱汉尼拔... [ni chong ai han ni ba ...]

english: He lets out a quiet purr before going back to resting.
translation: 他发出一声轻柔的呼噜声，然后继续休息。 [ta fa chu yi sheng qing rou de hu lu sheng ， ran hou ji xu xiu xi 。]

english: You scratch Hannibal behind the ears...
translation: 你挠汉尼拔耳后…… [ni nao han ni ba er hou ……]

english: He purrs contentedly before going back to sleep.
translation: 在回去睡觉之前，他心满意足地发出咕噜声。 [zai hui qu shui jiao zhi qian ， ta xin man yi zu di fa chu gu lu sheng 。]

english: I should give him some fish from my inventory!
translation: 我应该从我的库存里给他一些鱼！ [wo ying gai cong wo de ku cun li gei ta yi xie yu ！]

english: Dialogue 1
translation: 对话1 [dui hua 1]

english: Dialogue 2
translation: 对话2 [dui hua 2]

english: Dialogue 3
translation: 对话3 [dui hua 3]

english: Hannibal gobbles up the fish, then settles back down to rest.
translation: 汉尼拔狼吞虎咽地吃掉了鱼，然后坐下来休息。 [han ni ba lang tun hu yan di chi diao le yu ， ran hou zuo xia lai xiu xi 。]

english: Thank you [player name]. That's very tasty, though it would be even more tasty if it was cooked.
translation: 谢谢你[玩家姓名]。非常好吃，不过如果煮熟的话会更美味。 [xie xie ni [ wan jia xing ming ]。 fei chang hao chi ， bu guo ru guo zhu shu de hua hui geng mei wei 。]

english: You prefer cooked food?
translation: 你更喜欢熟食吗？ [ni geng xi huan shu shi ma ？]

english: I do. Why do you think I'm in the kitchen? All this lovely food being cooked all the time!
translation: 我愿意。你为什么认为我在厨房？所有这些可爱的食物一直在煮！ [wo yuan yi 。 ni wei shen me ren wei wo zai chu fang ？ suo you zhe xie ke ai de shi wu yi zhi zai zhu ！]

english: That is a good point. I will see if I can find you something cooked.
translation: 这是一个很好的观点。我看看能不能给你找到一些煮熟的东西。 [zhe shi yi ge hen hao de guan dian 。 wo kan kan neng bu neng gei ni zhao dao yi xie zhu shu de dong xi 。]

english: I look forward to it. You know where to find me.
translation: 我很期待。你知道在哪里可以找到我。 [wo hen qi dai 。 ni zhi dao zai na li ke yi zhao dao wo 。]

english: Hannibal settles back down to sleep.
translation: 汉尼拔重新坐下来睡觉。 [han ni ba chong xin zuo xia lai shui jiao 。]

english: Thank you [player name]. That was lovely! Do you have any more?
translation: 谢谢你[玩家姓名]。太可爱了！你还有吗？ [xie xie ni [ wan jia xing ming ]。 tai ke ai le ！ ni hai you ma ？]

english: You just ate the entire thing, and you're still hungry?
translation: 刚刚吃完了，还饿吗？ [gang gang chi wan le ， hai e ma ？]

english: Sleeping is hungry work.
translation: 睡觉是一项饥饿的工作。 [shui jiao shi yi xiang ji e de gong zuo 。]

english: I do often wake up hungry, maybe you're on to something.
translation: 我经常饿着肚子醒来，也许你正在做某件事。 [wo jing chang e zhe du zi xing lai ， ye xu ni zheng zai zuo mou jian shi 。]

english: I'll see if I can find you something else.
translation: 我看看能不能给你找点别的东西。 [wo kan kan neng bu neng gei ni zhao dian bie de dong xi 。]

english: Lovely, I'll be right here, working hard.
translation: 可爱的，我会在这里，努力工作。 [ke ai de ， wo hui zai zhe li ， nu li gong zuo 。]

english: Hello. What are you doing here?
translation: 你好。你在这里做什么？ [ni hao 。 ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm looking for whoever is in charge of this place.
translation: 我正在寻找负责这个地方的人。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao fu ze zhe ge di fang de ren 。]

english: Who, the Duke? He's in his study, on the first floor.
translation: 谁，公爵？他在一楼的书房里。 [shui ， gong jue ？ ta zai yi lou de shu fang li 。]

english: I have come to kill everyone in this castle!
translation: 我是来杀掉这座城堡里的所有人的！ [wo shi lai sha diao zhe zuo cheng bao li de suo you ren de ！]

english: Hans runs away from the player screaming
translation: 汉斯尖叫着逃离玩家 [han si jian jiao zhe tao li wan jia]

english: Help! Help!
translation: 帮助！帮助！ [bang zhu ！ bang zhu ！]

english: I don't know. I'm lost. Where am I?
translation: 我不知道。我迷路了。我在哪里？ [wo bu zhi dao 。 wo mi lu le 。 wo zai na li ？]

english: You are in Lumbridge Castle.
translation: 您现在位于朗布里奇城堡。 [nin xian zai wei yu lang bu li qi cheng bao 。]

english: Can you tell me how long I've been here?
translation: 你能告诉我我来这里多久了吗？ [ni neng gao su wo wo lai zhe li duo jiu le ma ？]

english: Ahh, I see all the newcomers arriving in Lumbridge, fresh-faced and eager for adventure. I remember you...
translation: 啊，我看到所有抵达朗布里奇的新来者，都面容新鲜，渴望冒险。我记得你... [a ， wo kan dao suo you di da lang bu li qi de xin lai zhe ， dou mian rong xin xian ， ke wang mao xian 。 wo ji de ni ...]

english: You've spent [amount] days, [amount] hours, [amount] minutes in the world since you arrived [amount] days ago.
translation: 自从您几天前到达以来，您已在这个世界上度过了 [数量] 天、[数量] 小时、[数量] 分钟。 [zi cong nin ji tian qian dao da yi lai ， nin yi zai zhe ge shi jie shang du guo le  [ shu liang ]  tian 、[ shu liang ]  xiao shi 、[ shu liang ]  fen zhong 。]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: Hiya.
translation: 嗨。 [hai 。]

english: Oooh! Who are you?
translation: 噢！你是谁？ [o ！ ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm a brave knight! I am coming to kill anyone in the vicinity of Lumbridge Castle!
translation: 我是勇敢的骑士！我要杀掉朗布里奇城堡附近的所有人！ [wo shi yong gan de qi shi ！ wo yao sha diao lang bu li qi cheng bao fu jin de suo you ren ！]

english: Aaaaargh! Run away, run away!
translation: 啊啊啊！逃吧，逃吧！ [a a a ！ tao ba ， tao ba ！]

english: Hehe. Fool!
translation: 呵呵。傻子！ [he he 。 sha zi ！]

english: Hans! Hans! You've been walking around this courtyard since we were two dimensional, have you seen the Gnome Child's hat? He has lost it.
translation: 汉斯！汉斯！自从我们进入二维以来，你就一直在这个院子里走来走去，你看到侏儒小孩的帽子了吗？他已经失去了它。 [han si ！ han si ！ zi cong wo men jin ru er wei yi lai ， ni jiu yi zhi zai zhe ge yuan zi li zou lai zou qu ， ni kan dao zhu ru xiao hai de mao zi le ma ？ ta yi jing shi qu le ta 。]

english: Ummm... a little green hat? Yes, a seagull picked it up and flew off.
translation: 嗯……一顶小绿帽子？是的，一只海鸥叼起它飞走了。 [n …… yi ding xiao lv mao zi ？ shi de ， yi zhi hai ou diao qi ta fei zou le 。]

english: Really? A seagull picked up a hat? Can they do that?
translation: 真的吗？海鸥捡起了帽子？他们能做到吗？ [zhen de ma ？ hai ou jian qi le mao zi ？ ta men neng zuo dao ma ？]

english: So it seems! I'm afraid I didn't happen to see which way it went.
translation: 看来是这样！恐怕我没有碰巧看到它往哪个方向走。 [kan lai shi zhe yang ！ kong pa wo mei you peng qiao kan dao ta wang na ge fang xiang zou 。]

english: I should probably go somewhere that Hans might actually see me.
translation: 我也许应该去一个汉斯可能真正见到我的地方。 [wo ye xu ying gai qu yi ge han si ke neng zhen zheng jian dao wo de di fang 。]

english: You place the chair on the ground and wait for Hans to notice you...
translation: 你把椅子放在地上，等待汉斯注意到你…… [ni ba yi zi fang zai di shang ， deng dai han si zhu yi dao ni ……]

english: Oh my aching feet! A chair! Just what I've been needing! I'm going to go sit by the fountain, so pretty this time of year.
translation: 噢，我的脚好痛！一把椅子！这正是我一直需要的！我要去喷泉边坐坐，每年的这个时候都很漂亮。 [o ， wo de jiao hao tong ！ yi ba yi zi ！ zhe zheng shi wo yi zhi xu yao de ！ wo yao qu pen quan bian zuo zuo ， mei nian de zhe ge shi hou dou hen piao liang 。]

english: Hans takes the chair and teleports away with it.
translation: 汉斯拿起椅子并瞬移离开。 [han si na qi yi zi bing shun yi li kai 。]

english: I think he hasn't sat down for a while!
translation: 我想他已经有一段时间没有坐下来了！ [wo xiang ta yi jing you yi duan shi jian mei you zuo xia lai le ！]

english: Well done.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: You've [found a new clue/obtained a casket]!
translation: 你[发现了新线索/获得了棺材]！ [ni [ fa xian le xin xian suo / huo de le guan cai ]！]

english: Well done, here you go.
translation: 干得好，给你。 [gan de hao ， gei ni 。]

english: Hey Hans, you look like you're enjoying the party!
translation: 嘿汉斯，你看起来很享受这个聚会！ [hei han si ， ni kan qi lai hen xiang shou zhe ge ju hui ！]

english: Of course *hic* I love a good *hic* party.
translation: 当然*hic*我喜欢一个好的*hic*聚会。 [dang ran *hic* wo xi huan yi ge hao de *hic* ju hui 。]

english: I have a *hic* great party trick *hic*
translation: 我有一个 *hic* 很棒的派对技巧 *hic* [wo you yi ge  *hic*  hen bang de pai dui ji qiao  *hic*]

english: Does it include guessing my age?
translation: 它包括猜测我的年龄吗？ [ta bao kuo cai ce wo de nian ling ma ？]

english: Exactly *burp* that!
translation: 正是*打嗝*那个！ [zheng shi * da ge * na ge ！]

english: You've probably spent *hic* [amount] days, [amount] hours, [amount] minutes in the world since you arrived [amount] days ago.
translation: 自从您几天前到达以来，您可能已经在这个世界上度过了 *hic* [amount] 天、[amount] 小时、[amount] 分钟。 [zi cong nin ji tian qian dao da yi lai ， nin ke neng yi jing zai zhe ge shi jie shang du guo le  *hic* [amount]  tian 、[amount]  xiao shi 、[amount]  fen zhong 。]

english: I'm looking for whoever is in charge of this place.
translation: 我正在寻找负责这个地方的人。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao fu ze zhe ge di fang de ren 。]

english: I have come to kill everyone in this castle!
translation: 我是来杀掉这座城堡里的所有人的！ [wo shi lai sha diao zhe zuo cheng bao li de suo you ren de ！]

english: I don't know. I'm lost. Where am I?
translation: 我不知道。我迷路了。我在哪里？ [wo bu zhi dao 。 wo mi lu le 。 wo zai na li ？]

english: Can you tell me how long I've been here?
translation: 你能告诉我我来这里多久了吗？ [ni neng gao su wo wo lai zhe li duo jiu le ma ？]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: Gnomechild's missing hat.
translation: 侏儒之子丢失的帽子。 [zhu ru zhi zi diu shi de mao zi 。]

english: Talk about something else.
translation: 说点别的吧。 [shuo dian bie de ba 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: My name is Hari.
translation: 我叫哈里。 [wo jiao ha li 。]

english: And what are you doing here Hari?
translation: 哈里你来这里做什么？ [ha li ni lai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Like most people who come to Edgeville, I am here to seek adventure in the Wilderness.
translation: 像大多数来到埃奇维尔的人一样，我来这里是为了在荒野中寻求冒险。 [xiang da duo shu lai dao ai qi wei er de ren yi yang ， wo lai zhe li shi wei le zai huang ye zhong xun qiu mao xian 。]

english: I found a secret underground river that will take me quite a long way north.
translation: 我发现了一条秘密的地下河，它将带我向北走很长一段路。 [wo fa xian le yi tiao mi mi de di xia he ， ta jiang dai wo xiang bei zou hen zhang yi duan lu 。]

english: Underground river? Where does it come out?
translation: 暗河？它从哪里出来？ [an he ？ ta cong na li chu lai ？]

english: It comes out in a pond located deep in the Wilderness.
translation: 它出现在荒野深处的一个池塘里。 [ta chu xian zai huang ye shen chu de yi ge chi tang li 。]

english: I had to find a very special type of canoe to get me up the river though, would you like to know more?
translation: 不过，我必须找到一种非常特殊类型的独木舟才能带我逆流而上，您想了解更多吗？ [bu guo ， wo bi xu zhao dao yi zhong fei chang te shu lei xing de du mu zhou cai neng dai wo ni liu er shang ， nin xiang liao jie geng duo ma ？]

english: Could you teach me about canoes?
translation: 你能教我独木舟吗？ [ni neng jiao wo du mu zhou ma ？]

english: Well, you don't look like you have the skill to make a canoe.
translation: 嗯，你看起来不像有造独木舟的技能。 [n ， ni kan qi lai bu xiang you zao du mu zhou de ji neng 。]

english: You need to have at least level 12 woodcutting.
translation: 你需要至少有 12 级木刻。 [ni xu yao zhi shao you  12  ji mu ke 。]

english: Once you are able to make a canoe it makes travel along the river much quicker!
translation: 一旦您能够制作独木舟，沿河旅行就会更快！ [yi dan nin neng gou zhi zuo du mu zhou ， yan he lv xing jiu hui geng kuai ！]

english: It's really quite simple. Just walk down to that tree on the bank and chop it down.
translation: 这真的很简单。只要走到岸边那棵树那里，把它砍倒就可以了。 [zhe zhen de hen jian dan 。 zhi yao zou dao an bian na ke shu na li ， ba ta kan dao jiu ke yi le 。]

english: When you have done that you can shape the log further with your axe to make a canoe.
translation: 完成后，您可以用斧头进一步塑造原木以制作独木舟。 [wan cheng hou ， nin ke yi yong fu tou jin yi bu su zao yuan mu yi zhi zuo du mu zhou 。]

english: I can sense you're still a novice woodcutter, you will only be able to make a log canoe at present.
translation: 我看得出你还是个伐木新手，目前只会制作独木舟。 [wo kan de chu ni hai shi ge fa mu xin shou ， mu qian zhi hui zhi zuo du mu zhou 。]

english: Is that good?
translation: 这样好吗？ [zhe yang hao ma ？]

english: A log will take you one stop along the river. But you won't be able to travel into the Wilderness on it.
translation: 一根圆木将带你沿着河走一站。但你将无法乘坐它进入荒野。 [yi gen yuan mu jiang dai ni yan zhe he zou yi zhan 。 dan ni jiang wu fa cheng zuo ta jin ru huang ye 。]

english: You are an average woodcutter. You should be able to make a Dugout canoe quite easily. It will take you 2 stops along the river.
translation: 你是一个普通的樵夫。你应该能够很容易地制作独木舟。沿河行驶 2 站即可到达。 [ni shi yi ge pu tong de qiao fu 。 ni ying gai neng gou hen rong yi di zhi zuo du mu zhou 。 yan he xing shi  2  zhan ji ke dao da 。]

english: Can I take a dugout canoe to reach the Wilderness?
translation: 我可以乘坐独木舟前往荒野吗？ [wo ke yi cheng zuo du mu zhou qian wang huang ye ma ？]

english: You would never make it there alive.
translation: 你永远不可能活着到达那里。 [ni yong yuan bu ke neng huo zhe dao da na li 。]

english: Best not to try then.
translation: 那最好不要尝试。 [na zui hao bu yao chang shi 。]

english: You seem to be an accomplished woodcutter. You will easily be able to make a Stable Dugout
translation: 看来你是一位技艺高超的樵夫。您将能够轻松地建造一个稳定的防空洞 [kan lai ni shi yi wei ji yi gao chao de qiao fu 。 nin jiang neng gou qing song di jian zao yi ge wen ding de fang kong dong]

english: They are reliable enough to get you anywhere on this river, except to the Wilderness of course.
translation: 他们足够可靠，可以带您到这条河上的任何地方，当然除了荒野。 [ta men zu gou ke kao ， ke yi dai nin dao zhe tiao he shang de ren he di fang ， dang ran chu le huang ye 。]

english: Only a Waka can take you there.
translation: 只有 Waka 可以带你去那里。 [zhi you  Waka  ke yi dai ni qu na li 。]

english: A Waka? What's that?
translation: 瓦卡？那是什么？ [wa ka ？ na shi shen me ？]

english: Come and ask me when you have improved your skills as a woodcutter.
translation: 你的樵夫技术什么时候提高了，就来问我吧。 [ni de qiao fu ji shu shen me shi hou ti gao le ， jiu lai wen wo ba 。]

english: Your skills rival mine friend. You will certainly be able to build a Waka.
translation: 你的技术可以与我的朋友媲美。你一定能够建造一个 Waka。 [ni de ji shu ke yi yu wo de peng you pi mei 。 ni yi ding neng gou jian zao yi ge  Waka。]

english: A Waka is an invention of my people, it's an incredible strong and fast canoe and will carry you safely to any destination on the river.
translation: 瓦卡 (Waka) 是我国人民的发明，它是一种令人难以置信的坚固且快速的独木舟，可将您安全地带到河上的任何目的地。 [wa ka  (Waka)  shi wo guo ren min de fa ming ， ta shi yi zhong ling ren nan yi zhi xin de jian gu qie kuai su de du mu zhou ， ke jiang nin an quan di dai dao he shang de ren he mu di di 。]

english: Any destination?
translation: 有目的地吗？ [you mu di di ma ？]

english: Yes, you can take a waka north through the underground portion of this river.
translation: 是的，您可以乘坐瓦卡向北穿过这条河的地下部分。 [shi de ， nin ke yi cheng zuo wa ka xiang bei chuan guo zhe tiao he de di xia bu fen 。]

english: It will bring you out at a pond in the heart of the Wilderness. Be careful up there, many have lost more than their lives in that dark and twisted place.
translation: 它将带您来到荒野中心的一个池塘。在那里要小心，许多人在那个黑暗而扭曲的地方失去的不仅仅是生命。 [ta jiang dai nin lai dao huang ye zhong xin de yi ge chi tang 。 zai na li yao xiao xin ， xu duo ren zai na ge hei an er niu qu de di fang shi qu de bu jin jin shi sheng ming 。]

english: No thanks, not right now.
translation: 不，谢谢，现在不行。 [bu ， xie xie ， xian zai bu xing 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Can you teach me about Canoeing?
translation: 你能教我独木舟吗？ [ni neng jiao wo du mu zhou ma ？]

english: Welcome, Effendi!
translation: 欢迎，阿芬迪！ [huan ying ， a fen di ！]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Can I go in?
translation: 我可以进去吗？ [wo ke yi jin qu ma ？]

english: Come now Effendi, to pass you must tell me a story, one of grand heroics!
translation: 来吧，阿芬迪，为了通过，你必须给我讲一个故事，一个伟大的英雄事迹！ [lai ba ， a fen di ， wei le tong guo ， ni bi xu gei wo jiang yi ge gu shi ， yi ge wei da de ying xiong shi ji ！]

english: You tell the tale of how you bested a goblin, it lacks heroics and sounds more like senseless murder.
translation: 你讲述了你如何击败妖精的故事，它缺乏英雄气概，听起来更像是毫无意义的谋杀。 [ni jiang shu le ni ru he ji bai yao jing de gu shi ， ta que fa ying xiong qi gai ， ting qi lai geng xiang shi hao wu yi yi de mou sha 。]

english: You thought that was a story of heroics?! Come back when you have something worth telling.
translation: 你以为这是英雄故事？！当你有值得讲述的事情时再回来。 [ni yi wei zhe shi ying xiong gu shi ？！ dang ni you zhi de jiang shu de shi qing shi zai hui lai 。]

english: To gain entrance to the resource area, you must first complete the quest 'Dragon Slayer'.
translation: 要进入资源区，您必须首先完成任务“屠龙者”。 [yao jin ru zi yuan qu ， nin bi xu shou xian wan cheng ren wu “ tu long zhe ”。]

english: You tell the tale of how you bested the legendary dragon Elvarg in combat.
translation: 你讲述了你如何在战斗中击败传奇巨龙埃尔瓦格的故事。 [ni jiang shu le ni ru he zai zhan dou zhong ji bai chuan qi ju long ai er wa ge de gu shi 。]

english: ...And then I cut her head off, so as to make sure she was dead!
translation: ......然后我砍下了她的头，以确保她死了！ [...... ran hou wo kan xia le ta de tou ， yi que bao ta si le ！]

english: Amazing! A story well worth telling! Please Effendi, enter at your leisure.
translation: 惊人的！一个很值得讲的故事！请阿芬迪，请您闲暇时进入。 [jing ren de ！ yi ge hen zhi de jiang de gu shi ！ qing a fen di ， qing nin xian xia shi jin ru 。]

english: Of course Effendi! You have proved yourself worthy!
translation: 当然是阿芬迪！你已经证明了自己的价值！ [dang ran shi a fen di ！ ni yi jing zheng ming liao zi ji de jia zhi ！]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Me? I am Haris! Owner of the area north of here, it is has great resources, I assure you.
translation: 我？我是哈里斯！我向你保证，这里北部地区的业主拥有丰富的资源。 [wo ？ wo shi ha li si ！ wo xiang ni bao zheng ， zhe li bei bu di qu de ye zhu yong you feng fu de zi yuan 。]

english: You own the land? Who did you buy it from?
translation: 你拥有土地吗？你从谁那里买的？ [ni yong you tu di ma ？ ni cong shui na li mai de ？]

english: Buy? Oh no no no. Do you see this sword, Effendi?
translation: 买？哦不不不。你看到这把剑了吗，阿芬迪？ [mai ？ o bu bu bu 。 ni kan dao zhe ba jian le ma ， a fen di ？]

english: I do.
translation: 我愿意。 [wo yuan yi 。]

english: Well then, that is why it is mine! Hahaha.
translation: 那么，这就是为什么它是我的！哈哈哈。 [na me ， zhe jiu shi wei shen me ta shi wo de ！ ha ha ha 。]

english: Oh, so do I pay a toll? 10 coins should do, right?
translation: 哦，那我要交过路费吗？ 10个金币应该够了吧？ [o ， na wo yao jiao guo lu fei ma ？ 10 ge jin bi ying gai gou le ba ？]

english: Not quite, while gold can get you to many places, I seek stories of heroics, for my land is only for the worthy.
translation: 不完全是这样，虽然黄金可以带你去很多地方，但我寻找英雄故事，因为我的土地只属于有价值的人。 [bu wan quan shi zhe yang ， sui ran huang jin ke yi dai ni qu hen duo di fang ， dan wo xun zhao ying xiong gu shi ， yin wei wo de tu di zhi shu yu you jia zhi de ren 。]

english: Is the story behind your sword one of heroics?
translation: 你的剑背后的故事是英雄事迹吗？ [ni de jian bei hou de gu shi shi ying xiong shi ji ma ？]

english: I promise you, the monkey I took it from was big! Hahaha!
translation: 我向你保证，我拿走的那只猴子很大！哈哈哈！ [wo xiang ni bao zheng ， wo na zou de na zhi hou zi hen da ！ ha ha ha ！]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Farewell, Effendi!
translation: 再见，阿芬迪！ [zai jian ， a fen di ！]

english: Hey! I didn't say you could go in there!
translation: 嘿！我又没说你可以进去啊！ [hei ！ wo you mei shuo ni ke yi jin qu a ！]

english: Can I go in?
translation: 我可以进去吗？ [wo ke yi jin qu ma ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: I'm rather busy right...
translation: 我比较忙吧... [wo bi jiao mang ba ...]

english: ... Wait a minute... you're that adventurer that has been taking on the Colosseum!
translation: ……等一下……你就是那个一直在斗兽场上冒险的冒险家！ […… deng yi xia …… ni jiu shi na ge yi zhi zai dou shou chang shang mao xian de mao xian jia ！]

english: The Champion!
translation: 冠军！ [guan jun ！]

english: The Grand Champion!
translation: 总冠军！ [zong guan jun ！]

english: That's me.
translation: 这就是我。 [zhe jiu shi wo 。]

english: Wow, what are the chances you'd run into a simple farmer like me.
translation: 哇，你遇到像我这样的简单农民的机会有多大。 [wa ， ni yu dao xiang wo zhe yang de jian dan nong min de ji hui you duo da 。]

english: Quite high actually...
translation: 其实蛮高的... [qi shi man gao de ...]

english: I suppose you might be needing a reliable herb supply if you're planning to continue fighting in the Colosseum?
translation: 我想如果你打算继续在斗兽场战斗，你可能需要可靠的草药供应？ [wo xiang ru guo ni da suan ji xu zai dou shou chang zhan dou ， ni ke neng xu yao ke kao de cao yao gong ying ？]

english: I suppose so?
translation: 我想是这样吧？ [wo xiang shi zhe yang ba ？]

english: I'll keep an eye on any herbs you plant here. It's the least I can do for someone like you.
translation: 我会留意你在这里种植的任何草药。这是我能为你这样的人做的最起码的事情。 [wo hui liu yi ni zai zhe li zhong zhi de ren he cao yao 。 zhe shi wo neng wei ni zhe yang de ren zuo de zui qi ma de shi qing 。]

english: That's a really kind gesture, but aren't you meant to be focusing on growing your own food?
translation: 这确实是一个善意的举动，但你不是应该专注于自己种植食物吗？ [zhe que shi shi yi ge shan yi de ju dong ， dan ni bu shi ying gai zhuan zhu yu zi ji zhong zhi shi wu ma ？]

english: It's no trouble. The soil around here is very rich, so it won't need much attention at all. I might even get a reward from the palace for helping such a valiant contender!
translation: 这不是什么麻烦事。这里的土壤非常肥沃，根本不需要太多的照顾。帮助如此勇猛的竞争者，说不定还能得到宫里的赏赐呢！ [zhe bu shi shen me ma fan shi 。 zhe li de tu rang fei chang fei wo ， gen ben bu xu yao tai duo de zhao gu 。 bang zhu ru ci yong meng de jing zheng zhe ， shuo bu ding hai neng de dao gong li de shang ci ne ！]

english: That's very kind of you.
translation: 谢谢您的好意。 [xie xie nin de hao yi 。]

english: Best of luck on your journey, Champion!
translation: 祝你旅途顺利，冠军！ [zhu ni lv tu shun li ， guan jun ！]

english: Best of luck on your journey, Grand Champion!
translation: 祝您旅途顺利，总冠军！ [zhu nin lv tu shun li ， zong guan jun ！]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: You're the guard that was on duty last night?
translation: 你是昨晚值班的警卫吗？ [ni shi zuo wan zhi ban de jing wei ma ？]

english: Yeah.

translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: It's the meddler! The one who blew Jones' cover! I don't know why you came to this place but it is here that you will die.
translation: 原来是管闲事的人啊！就是那个揭穿琼斯身份的人！我不知道你为什么来到这个地方，但你会死在这里。 [yuan lai shi guan xian shi de ren a ！ jiu shi na ge jie chuan qiong si shen fen de ren ！ wo bu zhi dao ni wei shen me lai dao zhe ge di fang ， dan ni hui si zai zhe li 。]

english: The adventurer returns! Glory to you for your efforts in bringing about the return of Lord Hazeel!
translation: 冒险家归来！荣耀归于你们为哈兹尔勋爵的回归所做的努力！ [mao xian jia gui lai ！ rong yao gui yu ni men wei ha zi er xun jue de hui gui suo zuo de nu li ！]

english: The mage starts to speak but all you hear is:
translation: 法师开始说话，但你听到的只是： [fa shi kai shi shuo hua ， dan ni ting dao de zhi shi ：]

english: Blah. Blah, blah, blah, blah...blah!
translation: 废话。巴拉、巴拉、巴拉、巴拉……巴拉！ [fei hua 。 ba la 、 ba la 、 ba la 、 ba la …… ba la ！]

english: You feel very strange - as if Hazelmere has started poking around in your head.
translation: 你感觉很奇怪——好像黑泽尔米尔已经开始在你的脑海里游荡。 [ni gan jue hen qi guai —— hao xiang hei ze er mi er yi jing kai shi zai ni de nao hai li you dang 。]

english: Well, I never expected to be impressed by a human, but you have done a good deed for the gnomes - even if most gnomes won't recognise it.  You humans are not as stupid as I first thought...
translation: 好吧，我从没想过会对人类留下深刻的印象，但你为侏儒做了一件好事 - 即使大多数侏儒不会认识到它。  你们人类并不像我最初想象的那么愚蠢...... [hao ba ， wo cong mei xiang guo hui dui ren lei liu xia shen ke de yin xiang ， dan ni wei zhu ru zuo le yi jian hao shi  -  ji shi da duo shu zhu ru bu hui ren shi dao ta 。   ni men ren lei bing bu xiang wo zui chu xiang xiang de na me yu chun ......]

english: So you want to know what your crystal seed does?
translation: 那么您想知道您的水晶种子有什么作用吗？ [na me nin xiang zhi dao nin de shui jing zhong zi you shen me zuo yong ma ？]

english: How did you.. ? Oh I forgot about this mind meld thing.
translation: 你怎么..？哦，我忘了这个心灵融合的事了。 [ni zen me ..？ o ， wo wang le zhe ge xin ling rong he de shi le 。]

english: The seed is a piece of elven magic, all elven magic comes from the manipulation of seeds of crystal. The elves give it divine properties. Elves sing to their crystals and they form into the desired shape.
translation: 种子是精灵魔法的一块，所有的精灵魔法都来自于对水晶种子的操控。精灵赋予它神圣的属性。精灵们对着水晶唱歌，水晶就会变成想要的形状。 [zhong zi shi jing ling mo fa de yi kuai ， suo you de jing ling mo fa dou lai zi yu dui shui jing zhong zi de cao kong 。 jing ling fu yu ta shen sheng de shu xing 。 jing ling men dui zhe shui jing chang ge ， shui jing jiu hui bian cheng xiang yao de xing zhuang 。]

english: So how do I turn it into something useful?
translation: 那么如何将其变成有用的东西呢？ [na me ru he jiang qi bian cheng you yong de dong xi ne ？]

english: Either talk to an elf or find some other way to sing the crystal. If this came from Oaknock, he must have found a way...
translation: 要么与精灵交谈，要么找到其他方式来唱歌水晶。如果这是来自奥克诺克的话，他一定找到了办法…… [yao me yu jing ling jiao tan ， yao me zhao dao qi ta fang shi lai chang ge shui jing 。 ru guo zhe shi lai zi ao ke nuo ke de hua ， ta yi ding zhao dao le ban fa ……]

english: Thanks, I'll have a look round Oaknock's old workshop. I can have a chat with Brimstail while I'm at it! Thanks!
translation: 谢谢，我去看看奥克诺克的旧作坊。我可以一边做一边和 Brimstail 聊天！谢谢！ [xie xie ， wo qu kan kan ao ke nuo ke de jiu zuo fang 。 wo ke yi yi bian zuo yi bian he  Brimstail  liao tian ！ xie xie ！]

english: So you want to know what your crystal saw does?
translation: 那么您想知道您的水晶锯有什么作用吗？ [na me nin xiang zhi dao nin de shui jing ju you shen me zuo yong ma ？]

english: Well, I do remember seeing Oaknock using the saw. He said it allowed him to build devices more complicated that even he was capable of constructing. The device he built must have been very complicated indeed.
translation: 嗯，我确实记得看到奥克诺克使用锯子。他说这让他能够制造出更复杂的设备，甚至连他自己也有能力建造。他建造的装置确实非常复杂。 [n ， wo que shi ji de kan dao ao ke nuo ke shi yong ju zi 。 ta shuo zhe rang ta neng gou zhi zao chu geng fu za de she bei ， shen zhi lian ta zi ji ye you neng li jian zao 。 ta jian zao de zhuang zhi que shi fei chang fu za 。]

english: I'd say! Anyway, the saw looks like it could be pretty useful. Thanks.
translation: 我想说！不管怎样，锯子看起来很有用。谢谢。 [wo xiang shuo ！ bu guan zen yang ， ju zi kan qi lai hen you yong 。 xie xie 。]

english: Hello, Hazelmere.
translation: 你好，黑泽尔米尔。 [ni hao ， hei ze er mi er 。]

english: You're back. Come to disturb me, have you?
translation: 你回来了。你是来打扰我的吗？ [ni hui lai le 。 ni shi lai da rao wo de ma ？]

english: Ah, good old Hazelmere. Glad to see you're back to your grumpy self.
translation: 啊，好老的黑兹米尔。很高兴看到你又恢复了脾气暴躁的样子。 [a ， hao lao de hei zi mi er 。 hen gao xing kan dao ni you hui fu le pi qi bao zao de yang zi 。]

english: Do you actually want something from me, or are you simply making my life a misery again?
translation: 你真的想从我这里得到什么吗，还是你只是让我的生活再次变得痛苦？ [ni zhen de xiang cong wo zhe li de dao shen me ma ， hai shi ni zhi shi rang wo de sheng huo zai ci bian de tong ku ？]

english: I just wanted to have a chat. You know, just check how you're doing.
translation: 我只是想聊聊。你知道，只要检查一下你的表现就知道了。 [wo zhi shi xiang liao liao 。 ni zhi dao ， zhi yao jian cha yi xia ni de biao xian jiu zhi dao le 。]

english: Well I'm fine, thank you. Now leave me in peace.
translation: 嗯，我很好，谢谢。现在就让我安静吧。 [n ， wo hen hao ， xie xie 。 xian zai jiu rang wo an jing ba 。]

english: You give the bark sample to Hazelmere.
translation: 你把树皮样本交给黑泽尔米尔。 [ni ba shu pi yang ben jiao gei hei ze er mi er 。]

english: (The bark sample is removed from the player's inventory)
translation: （树皮样本已从玩家的库存中移除） [（ shu pi yang ben yi cong wan jia de ku cun zhong yi chu ）]

english: The mage carefully studies the sample.
translation: 法师仔细研究样本。 [fa shi zi xi yan jiu yang ben 。]

english: Blah, blah...Daconia...blah, blah.
translation: 巴拉，巴拉……达科尼亚……巴拉，巴拉。 [ba la ， ba la …… da ke ni ya …… ba la ， ba la 。]

english: Can you write this down and I'll try and translate it?
translation: 你能把这个写下来，我会试着翻译它吗？ [ni neng ba zhe ge xie xia lai ， wo hui shi zhe fan yi ta ma ？]

english: Blah, blah?
translation: 巴拉，巴拉？ [ba la ， ba la ？]

english: You make a writing motion. The mage scribbles something down on a scroll.
translation: 你做出一个书写动作。法师在卷轴上写下了一些东西。 [ni zuo chu yi ge shu xie dong zuo 。 fa shi zai juan zhou shang xie xia le yi xie dong xi 。]

english: Hazelmere has given you the scroll.
translation: 黑泽米尔给了你卷轴。 [hei ze mi er gei le ni juan zhou 。]

english: You still can't understand Hazelmere. The mage wrote it down for you on a scroll.
translation: 你还是无法理解Hazelmere。法师把它写在卷轴上。 [ni hai shi wu fa li jie Hazelmere。 fa shi ba ta xie zai juan zhou shang 。]

english: Blah, blah, blah...blah!
translation: 巴拉，巴拉，巴拉……巴拉！ [ba la ， ba la ， ba la …… ba la ！]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: Blah, blah.
translation: 巴拉，巴拉。 [ba la ， ba la 。]

english: Hazelmere has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 海兹米尔给了你一张挑战卷轴！ [hai zi mi er gei le ni yi zhang tiao zhan juan zhou ！]

english: Blah!
translation: 废话！ [fei hua ！]

english: Blah, blah, blah!
translation: 巴拉，巴拉，巴拉！ [ba la ， ba la ， ba la ！]

english: Hazelmere has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
translation: 海兹米尔给了你[另一条线索卷轴/一个棺材]！ [hai zi mi er gei le ni [ ling yi tiao xian suo juan zhou / yi ge guan cai ]！]

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 尽管您找到了顾客，但您似乎没有带来正确的食物！你需要[一个/一些][订购的侏儒食物/饮料]！ [jin guan nin zhao dao le gu ke ， dan nin si hu mei you dai lai zheng que de shi wu ！ ni xu yao [ yi ge / yi xie ][ ding gou de zhu ru shi wu / yin liao ]！]

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜肴不行。对于 Aluft Aloft 的顾客来说，只有手工制作的 Gnome Cuisine 才足够好。 [kong pa yu zhi cai yao bu xing 。 dui yu  Aluft Aloft  de gu ke lai shuo ， zhi you shou gong zhi zuo de  Gnome Cuisine  cai zu gou hao 。]

english: You hand over your delivery of [item] to Hazelmere
translation: 您将[物品]的交付交给Hazelmere [nin jiang [ wu pin ] de jiao fu jiao gei Hazelmere]

english: *Hazelmere nods his thanks*
translation: *黑泽尔米尔点头致谢* [* hei ze er mi er dian tou zhi xie *]

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 你一定是走了很远的路才把这个交给我的。这里有一些额外的东西作为提示。 [ni yi ding shi zou le hen yuan de lu cai ba zhe ge jiao gei wo de 。 zhe li you yi xie e wai de dong xi zuo wei ti shi 。]

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 您有 [number] 个积分用于免费送货令牌。您还没有资格获得侏儒食物。 [nin you  [number]  ge ji fen yong yu mian fei song huo ling pai 。 nin hai mei you zi ge huo de zhu ru shi wu 。]

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 您有 [number] 个积分用于免费送货令牌。您可能会收到 [number] 块侏儒食物。 [nin you  [number]  ge ji fen yong yu mian fei song huo ling pai 。 nin ke neng hui shou dao  [number]  kuai zhu ru shi wu 。]

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 不要忘记从 Aluft Gianne jnr 领取免费送货代币。 [bu yao wang ji cong  Aluft Gianne jnr  ling qu mian fei song huo dai bi 。]

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 你的交货太晚了！返回 Aluft jnr。以获得另一个订单。您丢弃了送货箱，因为您不再需要它了。 [ni de jiao huo tai wan le ！ fan hui  Aluft jnr。 yi huo de ling yi ge ding dan 。 nin diu qi le song huo xiang ， yin wei nin bu zai xu yao ta le 。]

english: After all that, are you sure I can't convince you to join the union?
translation: 说了这么多，你确定我不能说服你加入工会吗？ [shuo le zhe me duo ， ni que ding wo bu neng shuo fu ni jia ru gong hui ma ？]

english: Actually, I was wondering if...
translation: 其实我想知道是否... [qi shi wo xiang zhi dao shi fou ...]

english: Kuani! I'll need to run and grab my forms, but if you wait there just a moment...
translation: 夸尼！我需要跑去拿我的表格，但是如果你在那里等一会儿...... [kua ni ！ wo xu yao pao qu na wo de biao ge ， dan shi ru guo ni zai na li deng yi hui er ......]

english: I was going to ask if you had any spare equipment...
translation: 我想问一下你们有没有备用设备... [wo xiang wen yi xia ni men you mei you bei yong she bei ...]

english: Spare equipment?
translation: 备用设备？ [bei yong she bei ？]

english: I may have a need to mask my identity again in the future... or perhaps carry a tray around.
translation: 将来我可能需要再次掩盖自己的身份……或者可能随身携带一个托盘。 [jiang lai wo ke neng xu yao zai ci yan gai zi ji de shen fen …… huo zhe ke neng sui shen xie dai yi ge tuo pan 。]

english: You're certain you don't want to join the union as well?
translation: 您确定您也不想加入工会吗？ [nin que ding nin ye bu xiang jia ru gong hui ma ？]

english: I'm sure.
translation: 我敢肯定。 [wo gan ken ding 。]

english: I see. In that case, which equipment would you like?
translation: 我懂了。那么，您想要什么装备呢？ [wo dong le 。 na me ， nin xiang yao shen me zhuang bei ne ？]

english: The ram mask.
translation: 公羊面具。 [gong yang mian ju 。]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: The wolf mask.
translation: 狼面具。 [lang mian ju 。]

english: The bird mask.
translation: 鸟面具。 [niao mian ju 。]

english: The jaguar mask.
translation: 美洲虎面具。 [mei zhou hu mian ju 。]

english: The snake mask.
translation: 蛇面具。 [she mian ju 。]

english: The butler's tray.
translation: 管家的托盘。 [guan jia de tuo pan 。]

english: None of them.
translation: 没有一个。 [mei you yi ge 。]

english: Very well.
translation: 很好。 [hen hao 。]

english: Changed your mind about joining the union? Or are you just after more equipment?
translation: 您改变了加入工会的想法吗？或者您只是想要更多设备？ [nin gai bian le jia ru gong hui de xiang fa ma ？ huo zhe nin zhi shi xiang yao geng duo she bei ？]

english: Just the equipment please.
translation: 只求装备。 [zhi qiu zhuang bei 。]

english: I see. In that case, what do you need?
translation: 我懂了。在这种情况下，你需要什么？ [wo dong le 。 zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， ni xu yao shen me ？]

english: The ram mask.
translation: 公羊面具。 [gong yang mian ju 。]

english: The wolf mask.
translation: 狼面具。 [lang mian ju 。]

english: The bird mask.
translation: 鸟面具。 [niao mian ju 。]

english: The jaguar mask.
translation: 美洲虎面具。 [mei zhou hu mian ju 。]

english: More options...
translation: 更多选择... [geng duo xuan ze ...]

english: The snake mask.
translation: 蛇面具。 [she mian ju 。]

english: The butler's tray.
translation: 管家的托盘。 [guan jia de tuo pan 。]

english: None of them.
translation: 没有一个。 [mei you yi ge 。]

english: Previous options...
translation: 之前的选项... [zhi qian de xuan xiang ...]

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你认为你在做什么？ [ni ren wei ni zai zuo shen me ？]

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
translation: 嘿！把你的手拿开！ [hei ！ ba ni de shou na kai ！]

english: Hello, welcome to the Cooking Guild. Only accomplished chefs and cooks are allowed in here. Feel free to use any of our facilities.
translation: 您好，欢迎来到烹饪公会。只有熟练的厨师和厨师才可以进入这里。请随意使用我们的任何设施。 [nin hao ， huan ying lai dao peng ren gong hui 。 zhi you shu lian de chu shi he chu shi cai ke yi jin ru zhe li 。 qing sui yi shi yong wo men de ren he she shi 。]

english: Nice cape, you're wearing!
translation: 好斗篷，你穿的！ [hao dou peng ， ni chuan de ！]

english: Thank you! It's my most prized possession, it's a Skillcape of Cooking; it shows that I've achieved level 99 Cooking and am one of the best chefs in the land!
translation: 谢谢你！这是我最珍贵的财产，它是烹饪技能；这表明我的烹饪水平已经达到 99 级，并且是这个国家最好的厨师之一！ [xie xie ni ！ zhe shi wo zui zhen gui de cai chan ， ta shi peng ren ji neng ； zhe biao ming wo de peng ren shui ping yi jing da dao  99  ji ， bing qie shi zhe ge guo jia zui hao de chu shi zhi yi ！]

english: If you ever achieve level 99 cookingyou'll get to wear one too and doing so means you'll never burn any food!
translation: 如果您的烹饪达到 99 级，您也可以佩戴一件，这意味着您永远不会烧焦任何食物！ [ru guo nin de peng ren da dao  99  ji ， nin ye ke yi pei dai yi jian ， zhe yi wei zhe nin yong yuan bu hui shao jiao ren he shi wu ！]

english: Thanks, bye.
translation: 谢谢，再见。 [xie xie ， zai jian 。]

english: Hello, welcome to the Cooking Guild. It's always great to have such an accomplished chef visit us. Say, would you be interested in a Skillcape of Cooking? They're only available to master chefs.
translation: 您好，欢迎来到烹饪公会。有如此多才多艺的厨师来访我们真是太好了。比如说，您对烹饪技能感兴趣吗？它们只有大厨才能享用。 [nin hao ， huan ying lai dao peng ren gong hui 。 you ru ci duo cai duo yi de chu shi lai fang wo men zhen shi tai hao le 。 bi ru shuo ， nin dui peng ren ji neng gan xing qu ma ？ ta men zhi you da chu cai neng xiang yong 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Okay, come back to me if you change your mind.
translation: 好吧，如果你改变主意就回来找我。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi jiu hui lai zhao wo 。]

english: Can I buy a Skillcape of Cooking from you?
translation: 我可以向你们购买烹饪技能吗？ [wo ke yi xiang ni men gou mai peng ren ji neng ma ？]

english: Most certainly, by wearing this cape you'll never burn any food, I will have to ask for 99000 gold coins for such a privilege.
translation: 毫无疑问，穿上这件斗篷你就永远不会烧掉任何食物，我需要99000金币才能获得这样的特权。 [hao wu yi wen ， chuan shang zhe jian dou peng ni jiu yong yuan bu hui shao diao ren he shi wu ， wo xu yao 99000 jin bi cai neng huo de zhe yang de te quan 。]

english: That's much too expensive.
translation: 那太贵了。 [na tai gui le 。]

english: I'm sorry you feel that way.
translation: 我很抱歉你有这样的感觉。 [wo hen bao qian ni you zhe yang de gan jue 。]

english: Sure.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 但不幸的是，我身上没有足够的钱。 [dan bu xing de shi ， wo shen shang mei you zu gou de qian 。]

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 好吧，等你回来了就回来见我吧。 [hao ba ， deng ni hui lai le jiu hui lai jian wo ba 。]

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 不幸的是，所有技能斗篷都只提供免费兜帽，这是技能升级交易的一部分；买一送一，你懂的。因此，在我向您出售一件之前，您需要释放一些库存空间。 [bu xing de shi ， suo you ji neng dou peng dou zhi ti gong mian fei dou mao ， zhe shi ji neng sheng ji jiao yi de yi bu fen ； mai yi song yi ， ni dong de 。 yin ci ， zai wo xiang nin chu shou yi jian zhi qian ， nin xu yao shi fang yi xie ku cun kong jian 。]

english: Now you can use the title Master Chef.
translation: 现在您可以使用主厨这个头衔了。 [xian zai nin ke yi shi yong zhu chu zhe ge tou xian le 。]

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: 请问我可以再给我的披风戴上兜帽吗？ [qing wen wo ke yi zai gei wo de pi feng dai shang dou mao ma ？]

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
translation: 毫无疑问，而且免费！ [hao wu yi wen ， er qie mian fei ！]

english: The head chef hands you another hood for your skillcape.
translation: 主厨为你的技能披风提供了另一顶兜帽。 [zhu chu wei ni de ji neng pi feng ti gong le ling yi ding dou mao 。]

english: You can't come in here unless you're wearing a chef's hat, or something like that.

english: Sometimes you can be such a bore...
translation: 有时候你可能会很无聊...... [you shi hou ni ke neng hui hen wu liao ......]

english: When I was a young HERBIBOAR!!
translation: 当我还是个年轻的草猪的时候！！ [dang wo hai shi ge nian qing de cao zhu de shi hou ！！]

english: I'm standing right next to you, no need to shout...
translation: 我就站在你身边，不用喊…… [wo jiu zhan zai ni shen bian ， bu yong han ……]

english: I was trying to sing you a song...
translation: 我本来想给你唱首歌... [wo ben lai xiang gei ni chang shou ge ...]

english: Ever tried a butterfly before?
translation: 以前尝试过蝴蝶吗？ [yi qian chang shi guo hu die ma ？]

english: I've never been able to catch one, they've always eluded me.
translation: 我从来没能抓住它们，它们总是躲着我。 [wo cong lai mei neng zhua zhu ta men ， ta men zong shi duo zhe wo 。]

english: Herbi chomps excitedly on the butterfly, he seems pleased.
translation: 赫比兴奋地咀嚼蝴蝶，他看起来很高兴。 [he bi xing fen di ju jue hu die ， ta kan qi lai hen gao xing 。]

english: Woah! You should try those, they're amazing.
translation: 哇哦！你应该尝试一下，它们太棒了。 [wa o ！ ni ying gai chang shi yi xia ， ta men tai bang le 。]

english: I got you some grubs!
translation: 我给你带了一些虫子！ [wo gei ni dai le yi xie chong zi ！]

english: My favorite!
translation: 我最喜欢的！ [wo zui xi huan de ！]

english: Herbi munches happily on the grubs. It's rather gross.
translation: 赫比愉快地咀嚼着幼虫。实在是太恶心了 [he bi yu kuai di ju jue zhe you chong 。 shi zai shi tai e xin le]

english: How about some wyrms?
translation: 一些龙怎么样？ [yi xie long zen me yang ？]

english: I assume you mean worms, not sure I could stomach a wyrm, far too big.
translation: 我猜你指的是蠕虫，但我不确定我能不能吃下一条巨龙，它太大了。 [wo cai ni zhi de shi ru chong ， dan wo bu que ding wo neng bu neng chi xia yi tiao ju long ， ta tai da le 。]

english: Oh yeah, those words don't even sound the same.
translation: 哦，是的，这些词听起来根本不一样。 [o ， shi de ， zhe xie ci ting qi lai gen ben bu yi yang 。]

english: I don't judge you, now hand over those worms!
translation: 我不会评判你，现在把那些虫子交出来！ [wo bu hui ping pan ni ， xian zai ba na xie chong zi jiao chu lai ！]

english: Herbi hungrily devours the worms, you regret watching him do it.
translation: 赫比如饥似渴地吞食着虫子，你后悔看到他这么做了。 [he bi ru ji si ke di tun shi zhe chong zi ， ni hou hui kan dao ta zhe me zuo le 。]

english: Slimy, yet satisfying.
translation: 粘糊糊的，但令人满意。 [zhan hu hu de ， dan ling ren man yi 。]

english: I got you a spider carcass!
translation: 我给你找到了蜘蛛尸体！ [wo gei ni zhao dao le zhi zhu shi ti ！]

english: Not really an insect, but admittedly I'm not too fussy.
translation: 不是真正的昆虫，但不可否认我不太挑剔。 [bu shi zhen zheng de kun chong ， dan bu ke fou ren wo bu tai tiao ti 。]

english: Herbi gobbles the spider down, several legs fall to the ground around him.
translation: 赫比吞下了蜘蛛，几条腿落在了他周围的地上。 [he bi tun xia le zhi zhu ， ji tiao tui luo zai le ta zhou wei de di shang 。]

english: You missed a bit.
translation: 你错过了一点。 [ni cuo guo le yi dian 。]

english: I'll save them for later.
translation: 我会把它们留着以后用。 [wo hui ba ta men liu zhe yi hou yong 。]

english: Oink!
translation: 哎哟！ [ai yo ！]

english: THEY CALL ME MR. PIIIG!
translation: 他们叫我先生。猪八戒！ [ta men jiao wo xian sheng 。 zhu ba jie ！]

english: I'll show you a bacon salad!
translation: 我给你看一份培根沙拉！ [wo gei ni kan yi fen pei gen sha la ！]

english: Hiya Hermie!
translation: 嗨赫米！ [hai he mi ！]

english: Ah, [player name]! How's the fishing going?
translation: 啊，[玩家姓名]！钓鱼怎么样了？ [a ，[ wan jia xing ming ]！ diao yu zen me yang le ？]

english: Still working on it. How's the Colony?
translation: 仍在努力。殖民地怎么样？ [reng zai nu li 。 zhi min di zen me yang ？]

english: Flourishing, now that the colonists are coming back! Soon all the finest restaurants will be serving monkfish!
translation: 殖民者回来了，繁荣昌盛！很快所有最好的餐厅都将供应安康鱼！ [zhi min zhe hui lai le ， fan rong chang sheng ！ hen kuai suo you zui hao de can ting dou jiang gong ying an kang yu ！]

english: It's a pity those skeletons you brought here haven't gone away again, though. They're in the dormitories, which is rather annoying! So please take a little time to kick 'em around a bit.
translation: 可惜你带来的那些骷髅并没有再消失。都在宿舍里，真是烦人啊！所以请花一点时间来踢他们一下。 [ke xi ni dai lai de na xie ku lou bing mei you zai xiao shi 。 dou zai su she li ， zhen shi fan ren a ！ suo yi qing hua yi dian shi jian lai ti ta men yi xia 。]

english: Oh, and please don't call me Hermie.
translation: 哦，请不要叫我赫米。 [o ， qing bu yao jiao wo he mi 。]

english: Whatever you like, Hermie!
translation: 不管你喜欢什么，赫米！ [bu guan ni xi huan shen me ， he mi ！]

english: Hop inside my mouth if you want to live!
translation: 如果你想活命就跳进我嘴里吧！ [ru guo ni xiang huo ming jiu tiao jin wo zui li ba ！]

english: I'm not falling for that... I'm not a fish! I've got more foresight than that.
translation: 我不会上当的……我不是鱼！我比这更有先见之明。 [wo bu hui shang dang de …… wo bu shi yu ！ wo bi zhe geng you xian jian zhi ming 。]

english: Got any Spirit flakes?
translation: 有灵片吗？ [you ling pian ma ？]

english: I think you may have a problem.
translation: 我想你可能有问题。 [wo xiang ni ke neng you wen ti 。]

english: I agree, you don't give me anywhere enough of those. So get to it.
translation: 我同意，你给我的这些还不够。所以开始吧。 [wo tong yi ， ni gei wo de zhe xie hai bu gou 。 suo yi kai shi ba 。]

english: Right.
translation: 正确的。 [zheng que de 。]

english: Those look tasty. But I'm looking for a proper feast. Come back to me with 3000 of them.
translation: 那些看起来很好吃。但我正在寻找一场合适的盛宴。带着 3000 个回来找我。 [na xie kan qi lai hen hao chi 。 dan wo zheng zai xun zhao yi chang he shi de sheng yan 。 dai zhe  3000  ge hui lai zhao wo 。]

english: 3000!? Are you insane?!
translation: 3000！？你疯了吗？！ [3000！？ ni feng le ma ？！]

english: Not really, I'm just a little bit peckish.
translation: 其实也不是，我只是有点饿了。 [qi shi ye bu shi ， wo zhi shi you dian e le 。]

english: Good thing you have a beak then!
translation: 幸好你有喙！ [xing hao ni you hui ！]

english: Touché.
translation: 触摸。 [chu mo 。]

english: No thanks. I'm craving a Spirit flake right now.
translation: 不，谢谢。我现在很想吃精神片。 [bu ， xie xie 。 wo xian zai hen xiang chi jing shen pian 。]

english: You really love those things.
translation: 你真的很喜欢那些东西。 [ni zhen de hen xi huan na xie dong xi 。]

english: Yup. So get to it.
translation: 是的。所以开始吧。 [shi de 。 suo yi kai shi ba 。]

english: Righto.
translation: 对了。 [dui le 。]

english: Transmogrify your Heron?
translation: 变形你的苍鹭？ [bian xing ni de cang lu ？]

english: Your pet Heron gobbles up a Spirit flake and turns royal blue.
translation: 你的宠物苍鹭吞下一片精灵片并变成宝蓝色。 [ni de chong wu cang lu tun xia yi pian jing ling pian bing bian cheng bao lan se 。]

english: What's the big idea? If you're going to offer me a Spirit flake, at least have one to hand!
translation: 有什么大创意？如果你要给我一块灵片，至少手头上有一块！ [you shen me da chuang yi ？ ru guo ni yao gei wo yi kuai ling pian ， zhi shao shou tou shang you yi kuai ！]

english: You can unlock the pet Heron transmogrification for 3000 x Spirit flakes.
translation: 您可以用 3000 x 灵片解锁宠物苍鹭幻化。 [nin ke yi yong  3000 x  ling pian jie suo chong wu cang lu huan hua 。]

english: Where's the fish? You don't have any!
translation: 鱼在哪儿？你一个都没有！ [yu zai na er ？ ni yi ge dou mei you ！]

english: *slap*
translation: *拍击* [* pai ji *]

english: Grrr!
translation: 咕噜！ [gu lu ！]

english: Grrrr!
translation: 咕噜！ [gu lu ！]

english: Grarrr!
translation: 嘎嘎！ [ga ga ！]

english: Got any raw fish?
translation: 有生鱼吗？ [you sheng yu ma ？]

english: Haven't you already eaten enough Spirit flakes?
translation: 灵片还没吃够吗？ [ling pian hai mei chi gou ma ？]

english: Yes, I have. That's why I'm asking you for raw fish.
translation: 是的，我有。这就是为什么我向你要生鱼。 [shi de ， wo you 。 zhe jiu shi wei shen me wo xiang ni yao sheng yu 。]

english: Sometimes I wonder whether getting stuck with you was my good luck or yours.
translation: 有时候我在想，和你在一起是我的运气还是你的运气。 [you shi hou wo zai xiang ， he ni zai yi qi shi wo de yun qi hai shi ni de yun qi 。]

english: In a remarkable display of gluttony, your pet Heron consumes 3000 Spirit flakes. It turns blue in front of your very eyes.
translation: 您的宠物苍鹭在一次惊人的暴食中消耗了 3000 个灵片。它在你眼前变成蓝色。 [nin de chong wu cang lu zai yi ci jing ren de bao shi zhong xiao hao le  3000  ge ling pian 。 ta zai ni yan qian bian cheng lan se 。]

english: That really hit the spot! Though I feel a little blue now that there are none left.
translation: 这真是恰到好处！虽然我现在感觉有点忧郁，因为已经没有了。 [zhe zhen shi qia dao hao chu ！ sui ran wo xian zai gan jue you dian you yu ， yin wei yi jing mei you le 。]

english: You offer your pet Heron a Spirit flake, which it quickly gobbles up.
translation: 你给你的宠物苍鹭一片精神片，它很快就把它吃掉了。 [ni gei ni de chong wu cang lu yi pian jing shen pian ， ta hen kuai jiu ba ta chi diao le 。]

english: Oops! That was a mistake, you're already blue. If you give it back, I'll give you a raw fish?
translation: 哎呀！那是一个错误，你已经是蓝色的了。如果你还给我，我就送你一条生鱼？ [ai ya ！ na shi yi ge cuo wu ， ni yi jing shi lan se de le 。 ru guo ni huan gei wo ， wo jiu song ni yi tiao sheng yu ？]

english: Sorry, no can do. They're just too tasty. You should try one sometime!
translation: 抱歉，没有办法。它们实在是太好吃了。你应该找个时间尝试一下！ [bao qian ， mei you ban fa 。 ta men shi zai shi tai hao chi le 。 ni ying gai zhao ge shi jian chang shi yi xia ！]

english: I'll pass.
translation: 我会通过。 [wo hui tong guo 。]

english: Your pet Heron gobbles up your [fish name] and turns a magnificent white.
translation: 你的宠物苍鹭吞掉了你的[鱼名]并变成了华丽的白色。 [ni de chong wu cang lu tun diao le ni de [ yu ming ] bing bian cheng le hua li de bai se 。]

english: Are you trying to annoy me?
translation: 你是想惹恼我吗？ [ni shi xiang re nao wo ma ？]

english: I put in a lot of effort cooking this for you.
translation: 我花了很多功夫为你做这道菜。 [wo hua le hen duo gong fu wei ni zuo zhe dao cai 。]

english: Exactly, you've cooked it! You've ruined a fine delicacy, now go and uncook it!
translation: 没错，你已经煮熟了！你毁了一道美味佳肴，现在就去把它拆开吧！ [mei cuo ， ni yi jing zhu shu le ！ ni hui le yi dao mei wei jia yao ， xian zai jiu qu ba ta chai kai ba ！]

english: Uncook? That's not even possible!
translation: 未煮熟？这根本就不可能啊！ [wei zhu shu ？ zhe gen ben jiu bu ke neng a ！]

english: I once knew a cat who mastered uncooking. Nice guy, actually. Enough talk, go and get me some more raw fish!
translation: 我曾经认识一只擅长做饭的猫。事实上，好人。废话不多说了，去给我买点生鱼吧！ [wo ceng jing ren shi yi zhi shan chang zuo fan de mao 。 shi shi shang ， hao ren 。 fei hua bu duo shuo le ， qu gei wo mai dian sheng yu ba ！]

english: What is wrong with you?
translation: 你怎么了？ [ni zen me le ？]

english: I'm giving you some fish..
translation: 我给你一些鱼.. [wo gei ni yi xie yu ..]

english: And you think that I can do anything with something charred to the bone?
translation: 你以为我能用烧焦的东西做任何事吗？ [ni yi wei wo neng yong shao jiao de dong xi zuo ren he shi ma ？]

english: In my culture, these well-cooked fish are considered pretty valuable.
translation: 在我的文化中，这些煮熟的鱼被认为非常有价值。 [zai wo de wen hua zhong ， zhe xie zhu shu de yu bei ren wei fei chang you jia zhi 。]

english: It's burnt, you dancing donkey!
translation: 烧焦了，你这跳舞的驴子！ [shao jiao le ， ni zhe tiao wu de lv zi ！]

english: Dancing donkey...?
translation: 跳舞的驴子……？ [tiao wu de lv zi ……？]

english: Sushi? Do I look like a commoner to you?
translation: 寿司？在你眼里我像个平民吗？ [shou si ？ zai ni yan li wo xiang ge ping min ma ？]

english: In Dorgeshuun culture, this is considered a delicacy.
translation: 在 Dorgeshuun 文化中，这被认为是美味佳肴。 [zai  Dorgeshuun  wen hua zhong ， zhe bei ren wei shi mei wei jia yao 。]

english: In bird culture, this is considered an insult. Get it out of my face at once!
translation: 在鸟类文化中，这被认为是一种侮辱。立刻把它从我脸上拿走！ [zai niao lei wen hua zhong ， zhe bei ren wei shi yi zhong wu ru 。 li ke ba ta cong wo lian shang na zou ！]

english: How could a member of my own house say something so horrible?
translation: 我自己家族的成员怎么能说出如此可怕的话？ [wo zi ji jia zu de cheng yuan zen me neng shuo chu ru ci ke pa de hua ？]

english: Great blue heron - 1 x Spirit flakes
translation: 大蓝鹭 - 1 x 精神片 [da lan lu  - 1 x  jing shen pian]

english: Heron - 1 x Raw fish
translation: 苍鹭 - 1 x 生鱼 [cang lu  - 1 x  sheng yu]

english: Not right now.
translation: 现在不行。 [xian zai bu xing 。]

english: Yes, it could use a nice snack.
translation: 是的，它可以用一顿美味的零食。 [shi de ， ta ke yi yong yi dun mei wei de ling shi 。]

english: No, I'm not shelling that out for a snack.
translation: 不，我不会把它花在零食上。 [bu ， wo bu hui ba ta hua zai ling shi shang 。]

english: Do you wish to trade?
translation: 您想进行交易吗？ [nin xiang jin xing jiao yi ma ？]

english: Why yes, this a jewel shop after all.
translation: 为什么是的，这毕竟是一家珠宝店。 [wei shen me shi de ， zhe bi jing shi yi jia zhu bao dian 。]

english: Sorry I don't want to talk to you actually.
translation: 抱歉，我其实不想和你说话。 [bao qian ， wo qi shi bu xiang he ni shuo hua 。]

english: Huh! Charming!
translation: 哈！迷人！ [ha ！ mi ren ！]

english: You've done it! Have this.
translation: 你已经做到了！有这个。 [ni yi jing zuo dao le ！ you zhe ge 。]

english: Do you wish to trade?
translation: 您想进行交易吗？ [nin xiang jin xing jiao yi ma ？]

english: Sorry I don't want to talk to you actually.
translation: 抱歉，我其实不想和你说话。 [bao qian ， wo qi shi bu xiang he ni shuo hua 。]

english: Greetings, human... can I interest you in some fine gems?
translation: 你好，人类……我可以给你一些精美的宝石吗？ [ni hao ， ren lei …… wo ke yi gei ni yi xie jing mei de bao shi ma ？]

english: Show me the wares!
translation: 给我看看商品！ [gei wo kan kan shang pin ！]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello! I've got a little quest for you, are you interested?
translation: 你好！我有一个小任务想问你，你有兴趣吗？ [ni hao ！ wo you yi ge xiao ren wu xiang wen ni ， ni you xing qu ma ？]

english: Yes, I love quests!
translation: 是的，我喜欢任务！ [shi de ， wo xi huan ren wu ！]

english: That's the spirit! Now, what I need is [3—5] pieces of [clay/copper ore/tine ore/iron ore/silver ore/coal/gold ore/mithril ore]. And I need them within [13—15] minutes as well.
translation: 这就是精神！现在，我需要的是[3-5]块[粘土/铜矿/锡矿/铁矿/银矿/煤/金矿/秘银矿]。我也在 [13-15] 分钟内需要它们。 [zhe jiu shi jing shen ！ xian zai ， wo xu yao de shi [3-5] kuai [ nian tu / tong kuang / xi kuang / tie kuang / yin kuang / mei / jin kuang / mi yin kuang ]。 wo ye zai  [13-15]  fen zhong nei xu yao ta men 。]

english: Not much of a quest, but I'll do it. Just [3—5] pieces of [clay/copper ore/tine ore/iron ore/silver ore/coal/gold ore/mithril ore] in [13—15] minutes.
translation: 任务并不多，但我会做到的。在[13-15]分钟内只需[3-5]块[粘土/铜矿石/锡矿石/铁矿石/银矿石/煤炭/金矿石/秘银矿石]。 [ren wu bing bu duo ， dan wo hui zuo dao de 。 zai [13-15] fen zhong nei zhi xu [3-5] kuai [ nian tu / tong kuang shi / xi kuang shi / tie kuang shi / yin kuang shi / mei tan / jin kuang shi / mi yin kuang shi ]。]

english: No, quests are dull and boring.
translation: 不，任务是枯燥乏味的。 [bu ， ren wu shi ku zao fa wei de 。]

english: Don't be so dismissive, you didn't even hear what I wanted to ask you!
translation: 别这么不屑一顾，你根本没听清我想问你什么！ [bie zhe me bu xie yi gu ， ni gen ben mei ting qing wo xiang wen ni shen me ！]

english: I don't want to! I just want to kill things!
translation: 我不想！我只想杀东西！ [wo bu xiang ！ wo zhi xiang sha dong xi ！]

english: Are my [3—5] pieces of [clay/copper ore/tine ore/iron ore/silver ore/coal/gold ore/mithril ore] arriving anytime soon?
translation: 我的[3-5]块[粘土/铜矿石/锡矿石/铁矿石/银矿石/煤炭/金矿石/秘银矿石]很快就会到达吗？ [wo de [3-5] kuai [ nian tu / tong kuang shi / xi kuang shi / tie kuang shi / yin kuang shi / mei tan / jin kuang shi / mi yin kuang shi ] hen kuai jiu hui dao da ma ？]

english: Not anytime soon. Or at all. I've given up on looking for them.
translation: 不会很快。或者根本没有。我已经放弃寻找他们了。 [bu hui hen kuai 。 huo zhe gen ben mei you 。 wo yi jing fang qi xun zhao ta men le 。]

english: Couldn't you decide that in advance? You're certainly lacking in manners!
translation: 你就不能提前决定一下吗？你确实缺乏礼貌！ [ni jiu bu neng ti qian jue ding yi xia ma ？ ni que shi que fa li mao ！]

english: Soon, yes, I hope so.
translation: 很快，是的，我希望如此。 [hen kuai ， shi de ， wo xi wang ru ci 。]

english: Good, soon can't be soon enough for me!
translation: 很好，很快对我来说还不够快！ [hen hao ， hen kuai dui wo lai shuo hai bu gou kuai ！]

english: Good news, I got you [3—5] pieces of [clay/copper ore/tine ore/iron ore/silver ore/coal/gold ore/mithril ore]!
translation: 好消息，我给你找到了[3-5]块[粘土/铜矿/锡矿/铁矿/银矿/煤/金矿/秘银矿]！ [hao xiao xi ， wo gei ni zhao dao le [3-5] kuai [ nian tu / tong kuang / xi kuang / tie kuang / yin kuang / mei / jin kuang / mi yin kuang ]！]

english: And not a minute too late! Great!
translation: 而且一分钟也不晚！伟大的！ [er qie yi fen zhong ye bu wan ！ wei da de ！]

english: Do you want me to pay you in gold or would you prefer me to teach you a bit about how you can mine more efficiently?
translation: 您希望我用黄金支付给您，还是希望我教您一些如何更有效地开采的知识？ [nin xi wang wo yong huang jin zhi fu gei nin ， hai shi xi wang wo jiao nin yi xie ru he geng you xiao di kai cai de zhi shi ？]

english: I'd like the gold.
translation: 我想要金子。 [wo xiang yao jin zi 。]

english: Please teach me that.
translation: 请教我这个。 [qing jiao wo zhe ge 。]

english: That's the spirit! Now, what I need is [3—5] bars of [bronze/iron/silver/steel/gold/mithril]. And I need them within [18—20] minutes as well.
translation: 这就是精神！现在，我需要的是 [3-5] 条 [青铜/铁/银/钢/金/秘银]。我也在 [18-20] 分钟内需要它们。 [zhe jiu shi jing shen ！ xian zai ， wo xu yao de shi  [3-5]  tiao  [ qing tong / tie / yin / gang / jin / mi yin ]。 wo ye zai  [18-20]  fen zhong nei xu yao ta men 。]

english: Player: Not much of a quest, but I'll do it. Just [3—5] bars of [bronze/iron/silver/steel/gold/mithril] in [18—20] minutes.
translation: 玩家：虽然任务不多，但我会做的。 [18-20] 分钟内仅需 [3-5] 条 [青铜/铁/银/钢/金/秘银]。 [wan jia ： sui ran ren wu bu duo ， dan wo hui zuo de 。 [18-20]  fen zhong nei jin xu  [3-5]  tiao  [ qing tong / tie / yin / gang / jin / mi yin ]。]

english: Are my [3—5] bars of [bronze/iron/silver/steel/gold/mithril] arriving anytime soon?
translation: 我的 [3-5] 块 [青铜/铁/银/钢/金/秘银] 很快就会到达吗？ [wo de  [3-5]  kuai  [ qing tong / tie / yin / gang / jin / mi yin ]  hen kuai jiu hui dao da ma ？]

english: Good news, I got you [3—5] bars of [bronze/iron/silver/steel/gold/mithril]!
translation: 好消息，我给你找到了 [3-5] 块 [青铜/铁/银/钢/金/秘银]！ [hao xiao xi ， wo gei ni zhao dao le  [3-5]  kuai  [ qing tong / tie / yin / gang / jin / mi yin ]！]

english: Do you want me to pay you in gold or would you like me to show you some smithing tricks?
translation: 你想要我付给你金子还是想要我向你展示一些锻造技巧？ [ni xiang yao wo fu gei ni jin zi hai shi xiang yao wo xiang ni zhan shi yi xie duan zao ji qiao ？]

english: Hands off those gems!
translation: 放开那些宝石！ [fang kai na xie bao shi ！]

english: You're the thief! Stop!
translation: 你就是小偷！停止！ [ni jiu shi xiao tou ！ ting zhi ！]

english: Guards, get this filthy human!
translation: 卫兵们，抓住这个肮脏的人类！ [wei bing men ， zhua zhu zhe ge ang zang de ren lei ！]

english: Show me the wares!
translation: 给我看看商品！ [gei wo kan kan shang pin ！]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Yes, I love quests!
translation: 是的，我喜欢任务！ [shi de ， wo xi huan ren wu ！]

english: No, quests are dull and boring.
translation: 不，任务是枯燥乏味的。 [bu ， ren wu shi ku zao fa wei de 。]

english: Not anytime soon. Or at all.
translation: 不会很快。或者根本没有。 [bu hui hen kuai 。 huo zhe gen ben mei you 。]

english: Soon, yes, I hope so.
translation: 很快，是的，我希望如此。 [hen kuai ， shi de ， wo xi wang ru ci 。]

english: I'd like the gold.
translation: 我想要金子。 [wo xiang yao jin zi 。]

english: Please teach me that.
translation: 请教我这个。 [qing jiao wo zhe ge 。]

english: Even with everything we're going through, I have to admit, that was an impressive fight to behold! I wish I could have joined you, friend. Now, let us return to the Nexus.
translation: 尽管我们正在经历一切，但我不得不承认，那是一场令人印象深刻的战斗！我希望我能加入你，朋友。现在，让我们回到枢纽。 [jin guan wo men zheng zai jing li yi qie ， dan wo bu de bu cheng ren ， na shi yi chang ling ren yin xiang shen ke de zhan dou ！ wo xi wang wo neng jia ru ni ， peng you 。 xian zai ， rang wo men hui dao shu niu 。]

english: Amascut! She's always been a monster, but she's doing things now I never believed her to be capable of! Had I not let my guard down, she'd surely be regretting her choices by now.
translation: 阿马斯切！她一直是个怪物，但她现在正在做一些我从来不相信她有能力做到的事情！如果我没有放松警惕，她现在肯定会后悔自己的选择。 [a ma si qie ！ ta yi zhi shi ge guai wu ， dan ta xian zai zheng zai zuo yi xie wo cong lai bu xiang xin ta you neng li zuo dao de shi qing ！ ru guo wo mei you fang song jing ti ， ta xian zai ken ding hui hou hui zi ji de xuan ze 。]

english: I guess we're lucky you came along when you did, my friend. I think you might have just given us a fighting chance!
translation: 我想我们很幸运你能来，我的朋友。我想你可能刚刚给了我们一个战斗的机会！ [wo xiang wo men hen xing yun ni neng lai ， wo de peng you 。 wo xiang ni ke neng gang gang gei le wo men yi ge zhan dou de ji hui ！]

english: I'm glad to have helped, but it's not over yet.
translation: 我很高兴能帮上忙，但事情还没有结束。 [wo hen gao xing neng bang shang mang ， dan shi qing hai mei you jie shu 。]

english: Indeed. Were I not still weak, I would gladly deal with her myself, but I fear you will have to face Amascut without me.
translation: 的确。如果我不是还很虚弱，我很乐意亲自对付她，但我担心你将不得不在没有我的情况下面对阿马斯库特。 [di que 。 ru guo wo bu shi hai hen xu ruo ， wo hen le yi qin zi dui fu ta ， dan wo dan xin ni jiang bu de bu zai mei you wo de qing kuang xia mian dui a ma si ku te 。]

english: You'll find her on the level below. If you can free the others, we should be able to open the way for you.
translation: 你会在下面一层找到她。如果你能释放其他人，我们应该就能为你打开道路。 [ni hui zai xia mian yi ceng zhao dao ta 。 ru guo ni neng shi fang qi ta ren ， wo men ying gai jiu neng wei ni da kai dao lu 。]

english: We have opened the way for you, my friend. Any other day, I would have joined you in the fight against Amascut, but this one is up to you. Go now, and show her the error of her ways!
translation: 我们已经为你开辟了道路，我的朋友。换做哪一天，我都会和你们一起对抗阿马斯库特，但这一次取决于你们。现在就去，让她看看她的错误！ [wo men yi jing wei ni kai pi le dao lu ， wo de peng you 。 huan zuo na yi tian ， wo du hui he ni men yi qi dui kang a ma si ku te ， dan zhe yi ci qu jue yu ni men 。 xian zai jiu qu ， rang ta kan kan ta de cuo wu ！]

english: Here he is!
translation: 他在这里！ [ta zai zhe li ！]

english: My friend, you managed what few have ever achieved. You overcame Amascut herself! I wish I could have been there to see it!
translation: 我的朋友，你取得了很少有人能取得的成就。你战胜了阿马斯库特本人！我希望我能去那里看到它！ [wo de peng you ， ni qu de le hen shao you ren neng qu de de cheng jiu 。 ni zhan sheng le a ma si ku te ben ren ！ wo xi wang wo neng qu na li kan dao ta ！]

english: Well I couldn't have done it alone. Speaking of which, where's Scabaras?
translation: 好吧，我一个人是做不到的。说到这里，斯卡巴拉斯在哪里？ [hao ba ， wo yi ge ren shi zuo bu dao de 。 shuo dao zhe li ， si ka ba la si zai na li ？]

english: Scabaras walks his own path. Do not consider his absence an insult. This is his way.
translation: 斯卡拉斯走自己的路。不要认为他的缺席是一种侮辱。这是他的方式。 [si ka la si zou zi ji de lu 。 bu yao ren wei ta de que xi shi yi zhong wu ru 。 zhe shi ta de fang shi 。]

english: Not to mention that he was under Amascut's control far longer than the rest of us. It will take him time to come to terms with his role in her plots.
translation: 更不用说他受阿马斯卡特控制的时间比我们其他人要长得多。他需要一段时间才能接受自己在她的情节中所扮演的角色。 [geng bu yong shuo ta shou a ma si ka te kong zhi de shi jian bi wo men qi ta ren yao zhang de duo 。 ta xu yao yi duan shi jian cai neng jie shou zi ji zai ta de qing jie zhong suo ban yan de jue se 。]

english: Don't worry, he'll be okay. He always is.
translation: 别担心，他会没事的。他总是这样。 [bie dan xin ， ta hui mei shi de 。 ta zong shi zhe yang 。]

english: Before we go any further... We didn't have much time for conversation back in the tomb. I'm sure you have some questions for us.
translation: 在我们继续之前……我们在坟墓里没有太多时间交谈。我确信您有一些问题想问我们。 [zai wo men ji xu zhi qian …… wo men zai fen mu li mei you tai duo shi jian jiao tan 。 wo que xin nin you yi xie wen ti xiang wen wo men 。]

english: If you do, now is the time to ask them.
translation: 如果您这样做，现在是时候询问他们了。 [ru guo nin zhe yang zuo ， xian zai shi shi hou xun wen ta men le 。]

english: I have a question for Apmeken.
translation: 我有一个问题要问阿普梅肯。 [wo you yi ge wen ti yao wen a pu mei ken 。]

english: What's your role in the Menaphite Pantheon?
translation: 你在梅纳菲特万神殿中的角色是什么？ [ni zai mei na fei te wan shen dian zhong de jue se shi shen me ？]

english: I'm Tumeken's avatar of companionship! Tumeken himself was always considered a bit cold, which is a tad ironic when you think about it.
translation: 我是图梅肯的陪伴化身！图梅肯本人一直被认为有点冷漠，想想就有点讽刺。 [wo shi tu mei ken de pei ban hua shen ！ tu mei ken ben ren yi zhi bei ren wei you dian leng mo ， xiang xiang jiu you dian feng ci 。]

english: A cold sun god?
translation: 寒冷的太阳神？ [han leng de tai yang shen ？]

english: Exactly! Bit odd, right? Still, although he wasn't exactly known for his social side, he still understood the importance of such things. That's why he made me!
translation: 确切地！有点奇怪，对吧？尽管如此，尽管他并不以其社交方面而闻名，但他仍然了解这些事情的重要性。这就是他创造我的原因！ [que qie di ！ you dian qi guai ， dui ba ？ jin guan ru ci ， jin guan ta bing bu yi qi she jiao fang mian er wen ming ， dan ta reng ran liao jie zhe xie shi qing de zhong yao xing 。 zhe jiu shi ta chuang zao wo de yuan yin ！]

english: My job is to make sure everyone remembers the importance of friendship. After all, we all need a friend or two, or ten, or maybe hundreds! Have as many as you want! I won't judge.
translation: 我的工作是确保每个人都记住友谊的重要性。毕竟，我们都需要一两个、十个、甚至数百个朋友！你想要多少就拥有多少！我不会评判。 [wo de gong zuo shi que bao mei ge ren dou ji zhu you yi de zhong yao xing 。 bi jing ， wo men dou xu yao yi liang ge 、 shi ge 、 shen zhi shu bai ge peng you ！ ni xiang yao duo shao jiu yong you duo shao ！ wo bu hui ping pan 。]

english: Why aren't there more monkeys or apes in the desert?
translation: 为什么沙漠里没有更多的猴子或猿类？ [wei shen me sha mo li mei you geng duo de hou zi huo yuan lei ？]

english: Ah, you can thank Amascut for that. The desert used to be home to thousands of apes and monkeys, but she targeted them to try and get to me.
translation: 啊，你可以为此感谢阿马斯卡特。沙漠曾经是数千只猿类和猴子的家园，但她却以它们为目标，试图接近我。 [a ， ni ke yi wei ci gan xie a ma si ka te 。 sha mo ceng jing shi shu qian zhi yuan lei he hou zi de jia yuan ， dan ta que yi ta men wei mu biao ， shi tu jie jin wo 。]

english: I'm sorry.
translation: 对不起。 [dui bu qi 。]

english: Don't be! Now that I'm back, I know we can turn things around!
translation: 别这样！现在我回来了，我知道我们可以扭转局面！ [bie zhe yang ！ xian zai wo hui lai le ， wo zhi dao wo men ke yi niu zhuan ju mian ！]

english: Actually, I've changed my mind.
translation: 事实上，我已经改变主意了。 [shi shi shang ， wo yi jing gai bian zhu yi le 。]

english: Fair enough.
translation: 很公平。 [hen gong ping 。]

english: I'll be back soon.
translation: 我很快就会回来。 [wo hen kuai jiu hui hui lai 。]

english: We'll be here when you're ready.
translation: 当您准备好时我们会在这里。 [dang nin zhun bei hao shi wo men hui zai zhe li 。]

english: I have a question for Crondis.
translation: 我有一个问题要问克朗迪斯。 [wo you yi ge wen ti yao wen ke lang di si 。]

english: I am Tumeken's avatar of resourcefulness.
translation: 我是图梅肯足智多谋的化身。 [wo shi tu mei ken zu zhi duo mou de hua shen 。]

english: Meaning?
translation: 意义？ [yi yi ？]

english: Meaning my job is to guide the people of the desert not to live lives of excess.
translation: 这意味着我的工作是引导沙漠人民不要过着奢侈的生活。 [zhe yi wei zhe wo de gong zuo shi yin dao sha mo ren min bu yao guo zhe she chi de sheng huo 。]

english: Guessing you're not a fan of Menaphos then?
translation: 猜猜你不是梅纳福斯的粉丝？ [cai cai ni bu shi mei na fu si de fen si ？]

english: Much of the desert has forgotten the importance of modesty in my absence, but the situation in Menaphos is definitely the most concerning. Let us hope it can soon be rectified.
translation: 在我不在的情况下，沙漠中的大部分人都忘记了谦虚的重要性，但米纳福斯的情况绝对是最令人担忧的。让我们希望它能够尽快得到纠正。 [zai wo bu zai de qing kuang xia ， sha mo zhong de da bu fen ren dou wang ji le qian xu de zhong yao xing ， dan mi na fu si de qing kuang jue dui shi zui ling ren dan you de 。 rang wo men xi wang ta neng gou jin kuai de dao jiu zheng 。]

english: Why are crocodiles so rude?
translation: 鳄鱼为何如此粗鲁？ [e yu wei he ru ci cu lu ？]

english: Rude? How so.
translation: 粗鲁的？为何如此。 [cu lu de ？ wei he ru ci 。]

english: Well they always try to eat me when I go near them.
translation: 好吧，当我靠近它们时，它们总是想吃掉我。 [hao ba ， dang wo kao jin ta men shi ， ta men zong shi xiang chi diao wo 。]

english: The life of a crocodile is not an easy one. They must seek food wherever it is available.
translation: 鳄鱼的生活并不轻松。他们必须在任何有食物的地方寻找食物。 [e yu de sheng huo bing bu qing song 。 ta men bi xu zai ren he you shi wu de di fang xun zhao shi wu 。]

english: Besides, I sense you do not speak the whole truth. Did you not befriend a crocodile yourself in times past?
translation: 此外，我感觉你没有说出全部真相。你过去没有和鳄鱼交过朋友吗？ [ci wai ， wo gan jue ni mei you shuo chu quan bu zhen xiang 。 ni guo qu mei you he e yu jiao guo peng you ma ？]

english: You mean Roger! I guess he was quite friendly.
translation: 你说的是罗杰！我猜他是相当友好的。 [ni shuo de shi luo jie ！ wo cai ta shi xiang dang you hao de 。]

english: Then perhaps crocodiles are not as rude as you think.
translation: 那么也许鳄鱼并不像你想象的那么粗鲁。 [na me ye xu e yu bing bu xiang ni xiang xiang de na me cu lu 。]

english: As you wish.
translation: 如你所愿。 [ru ni suo yuan 。]
