english: We will be here.
translation: 我们会在这里。 [wo men hui zai zhe li 。]

english: I have a question for Het.
translation: 我有一个问题要问Het。 [wo you yi ge wen ti yao wen Het。]

english: I am Tumeken's avatar of health, both physical and mental.
translation: 我是图梅肯健康的化身，无论是身体上还是精神上。 [wo shi tu mei ken jian kang de hua shen ， wu lun shi shen ti shang hai shi jing shen shang 。]

english: You talk about strength and fighting a lot. Surely fighting isn't good for someone's health.
translation: 你经常谈论力量和战斗。打架肯定不利于某人的健康。 [ni jing chang tan lun li liang he zhan dou 。 da jia ken ding bu li yu mou ren de jian kang 。]

english: Well when it comes to health, is strength not the ultimate goal? The strongest individual is one who is healthy in both body and mind, and what better way to celebrate that strength than in combat!
translation: 那么说到健康，力量不就是终极目标吗？最坚强的人是身体和精神都健康的人，还有什么比战斗更好的方式来庆祝这种力量呢！ [na me shuo dao jian kang ， li liang bu jiu shi zhong ji mu biao ma ？ zui jian qiang de ren shi shen ti he jing shen dou jian kang de ren ， hai you shen me bi zhan dou geng hao de fang shi lai qing zhu zhe zhong li liang ne ！]

english: I guess, but what about those who aren't strong?
translation: 我想，但是那些实力不强的人呢？ [wo xiang ， dan shi na xie shi li bu qiang de ren ne ？]

english: Well health is not something to be hoarded, is it? Most weaknesses can be overcome, and it is the duty of the strong to help those less fortunate.
translation: 健康不是可以囤积的东西，不是吗？大多数弱点都是可以克服的，强者有责任帮助那些不幸的人。 [jian kang bu shi ke yi tun ji de dong xi ， bu shi ma ？ da duo shu ruo dian dou shi ke yi ke fu de ， qiang zhe you ze ren bang zhu na xie bu xing de ren 。]

english: So they can become strong and healthy themselves?
translation: 那么他们自己就能变得强壮和健康吗？ [na me ta men zi ji jiu neng bian de qiang zhuang he jian kang ma ？]

english: Exactly!
translation: 确切地！ [que qie di ！]

english: An interesting question. Why do you ask?
translation: 一个有趣的问题。你为什么问？ [yi ge you qu de wen ti 。 ni wei shen me wen ？]

english: Considering you have a human appearance, I wondered if that might resonate more with people.
translation: 考虑到你有人类的外表，我想知道这是否会更能引起人们的共鸣。 [kao lv dao ni you ren lei de wai biao ， wo xiang zhi dao zhe shi fou hui geng neng yin qi ren men de gong ming 。]

english: Not as much as you might think. Believe it or not, in some ways, I'm actually considered a bit boring! Why follow the human when you have a baboon god?
translation: 没有你想象的那么多。不管你信不信，在某些方面，我实际上被认为有点无聊！既然有狒狒神，为什么还要追随人类呢？ [mei you ni xiang xiang de na me duo 。 bu guan ni xin bu xin ， zai mou xie fang mian ， wo shi ji shang bei ren wei you dian wu liao ！ ji ran you fei fei shen ， wei shen me hai yao zhui sui ren lei ne ？]

english: Especially when the baboon god is so fun to be around!
translation: 尤其是当狒狒神在身边真是太有趣了！ [you qi shi dang fei fei shen zai shen bian zhen shi tai you qu le ！]

english: Of course, people just following one of us was never really the intention anyway. We're a pantheon, and we all have a part to play.
translation: 当然，人们只是跟踪我们中的一个人从来都不是真正的意图。我们是万神殿，我们都有自己的职责。 [dang ran ， ren men zhi shi gen zong wo men zhong de yi ge ren cong lai dou bu shi zhen zheng de yi tu 。 wo men shi wan shen dian ， wo men dou you zi ji de zhi ze 。]

english: Now that Amascut is running with her tail between her legs, perhaps we can remind people of that.
translation: 现在阿马斯卡特夹着尾巴奔跑，也许我们可以提醒人们这一点。 [xian zai a ma si ka te jia zhe wei ba ben pao ， ye xu wo men ke yi ti xing ren men zhe yi dian 。]

english: Very well.
translation: 很好。 [hen hao 。]

english: We'll wait for you to return.
translation: 我们会等你回来。 [wo men hui deng ni hui lai 。]

english: I have a question for all of you.
translation: 我有一个问题想问大家。 [wo you yi ge wen ti xiang wen da jia 。]

english: What will happen with Amascut?
translation: 阿马斯卡特会发生什么？ [a ma si ka te hui fa sheng shen me ？]

english: I'd say that's up to her. If she doesn't change her ways, her fate won't be pretty.
translation: 我想说这取决于她。如果她不改变自己的做法，她的命运就不会那么美好。 [wo xiang shuo zhe qu jue yu ta 。 ru guo ta bu gai bian zi ji de zuo fa ， ta de ming yun jiu bu hui na me mei hao 。]

english: But it's never too late for redemption. There might still be hope for her.
translation: 但救赎永远不会太晚。她或许还有希望。 [dan jiu shu yong yuan bu hui tai wan 。 ta huo xu hai you xi wang 。]

english: Whatever path she takes, we will be ready.
translation: 无论她走哪条路，我们都会做好准备。 [wu lun ta zou na tiao lu ， wo men du hui zuo hao zhun bei 。]

english: Do you really think she'd change her ways at this point?
translation: 你真的认为她现在会改变她的方式吗？ [ni zhen de ren wei ta xian zai hui gai bian ta de fang shi ma ？]

english: It seems unlikely, but there is one who might be able to change that.
translation: 这似乎不太可能，但有人可能能够改变这一状况。 [zhe si hu bu tai ke neng ， dan you ren ke neng neng gou gai bian zhe yi zhuang kuang 。]

english: Who?
translation: WHO？ [WHO？]

english: Icthlarin! If anyone can help Amascut find her way again, it's him!
translation: 异丙嗪！如果有人能帮助阿马斯卡特再次找到出路，那就是他了！ [yi bing qin ！ ru guo you ren neng bang zhu a ma si ka te zai ci zhao dao chu lu ， na jiu shi ta le ！]

english: He doesn't seem to have been doing much to help so far.
translation: 到目前为止，他似乎并没有提供太多帮助。 [dao mu qian wei zhi ， ta si hu bing mei you ti gong tai duo bang zhu 。]

english: Icthlarin is limited in what he can do. His duties to the dead require constant attention.
translation: Icthlarin 的能力有限。他对死者的职责需要持续关注。 [Icthlarin  de neng li you xian 。 ta dui si zhe de zhi ze xu yao chi xu guan zhu 。]

english: Not to mention the pact!
translation: 更不用说契约了！ [geng bu yong shuo qi yue le ！]

english: Pact?
translation: 协议？ [xie yi ？]

english: That is not for us to discuss.
translation: 这不是我们要讨论的。 [zhe bu shi wo men yao tao lun de 。]

english: Oh yes, sorry. Maybe we should talk about something else.
translation: 哦，是的，抱歉。也许我们应该谈谈别的事情。 [o ， shi de ， bao qian 。 ye xu wo men ying gai tan tan bie de shi qing 。]

english: Are you actually gods?
translation: 你们真的是神吗？ [ni men zhen de shi shen ma ？]

english: If you asked a citizen of these lands, I'm sure they'd probably say yes.
translation: 如果你问这些国家的公民，我相信他们可能会说是。 [ru guo ni wen zhe xie guo jia de gong min ， wo xiang xin ta men ke neng hui shuo shi 。]

english: Indeed, but they would not be truly correct.
translation: 确实如此，但他们并不是真正正确的。 [que shi ru ci ， dan ta men bing bu shi zhen zheng zheng que de 。]

english: How so?
translation: 为何如此？ [wei he ru ci ？]

english: Tumeken made us using his own divine essence! Each of us is a piece of him!
translation: 图梅肯用他自己的神性本质创造了我们！我们每个人都是他的一部分！ [tu mei ken yong ta zi ji de shen xing ben zhi chuang zao le wo men ！ wo men mei ge ren dou shi ta de yi bu fen ！]

english: But that does not make us gods. While great, our power is insignificant compared to a true god. That is why they are gone, and we remain.
translation: 但这并不能使我们成为神。我们的力量虽然伟大，但与真正的神相比，却显得微不足道。这就是为什么他们走了，而我们留下了。 [dan zhe bing bu neng shi wo men cheng wei shen 。 wo men de li liang sui ran wei da ， dan yu zhen zheng de shen xiang bi ， que xian de wei bu zu dao 。 zhe jiu shi wei shen me ta men zou le ， er wo men liu xia le 。]

english: So what are you really?
translation: 那么你到底是什么？ [na me ni dao di shi shen me ？]

english: You might hear some refer to us as the Avatars of Tumeken. We'd consider that a more fitting title.
translation: 您可能会听到有人将我们称为图梅肯的化身。我们认为这是一个更合适的标题。 [nin ke neng hui ting dao you ren jiang wo men cheng wei tu mei ken de hua shen 。 wo men ren wei zhe shi yi ge geng he shi de biao ti 。]

english: What about Icthlarin and Amascut?
translation: Icthlarin 和 Amascut 怎么样？ [Icthlarin  he  Amascut  zen me yang ？]

english: Tumeken made them too. Difference is, they also have some of Elidinis' divine essence, making them a lot more powerful!
translation: 图梅肯也制造了它们。不同的是，他们还拥有一些艾利迪尼斯的神性精华，让他们的实力更加强大！ [tu mei ken ye zhi zao le ta men 。 bu tong de shi ， ta men hai yong you yi xie ai li di ni si de shen xing jing hua ， rang ta men de shi li geng jia qiang da ！]

english: But again, they are not true gods.
translation: 但话又说回来，他们并不是真正的神。 [dan hua you shuo hui lai ， ta men bing bu shi zhen zheng de shen 。]

english: Amascut was hoping to change that today, but you showed her where to stick that plan!
translation: 阿马斯卡特今天希望改变这一点，但你向她展示了该计划的执行方向！ [a ma si ka te jin tian xi wang gai bian zhe yi dian ， dan ni xiang ta zhan shi le gai ji hua de zhi xing fang xiang ！]

english: So what happens now?
translation: 那么现在会发生什么呢？ [na me xian zai hui fa sheng shen me ne ？]

english: We are the Avatars of Tumeken, and the Kharidian Desert has been without guidance for too long. It is time we fixed that.
translation: 我们是图梅肯的化身，而哈里迪沙漠已经太久没有指引了。现在是我们解决这个问题的时候了。 [wo men shi tu mei ken de hua shen ， er ha li di sha mo yi jing tai jiu mei you zhi yin le 。 xian zai shi wo men jie jue zhe ge wen ti de shi hou le 。]

english: We're going to get started right away!
translation: 我们马上就开始吧！ [wo men ma shang jiu kai shi ba ！]

english: But don't worry, we don't intend to miss the fight against Amascut. I hope you'll stand alongside us when that day comes.
translation: 但别担心，我们不想错过与阿马斯卡特的战斗。我希望当那一天来临的时候，你能和我们站在一起。 [dan bie dan xin ， wo men bu xiang cuo guo yu a ma si ka te de zhan dou 。 wo xi wang dang na yi tian lai lin de shi hou ， ni neng he wo men zhan zai yi qi 。]

english: For now though, this is goodbye. We will meet again, human.
translation: 但现在，这是再见了。我们还会再见面的，人类。 [dan xian zai ， zhe shi zai jian le 。 wo men hai hui zai jian mian de ， ren lei 。]

english: It was great to meet you. Thank you for helping us!
translation: 很高兴见到你。感谢您帮助我们！ [hen gao xing jian dao ni 。 gan xie nin bang zhu wo men ！]

english: The avatars depart.
translation: 化身离开。 [hua shen li kai 。]

english: You're back!
translation: 你回来了！ [ni hui lai le ！]

english: If you have questions, now is the time to ask them.
translation: 如果您有疑问，现在是时候提问了。 [ru guo nin you yi wen ， xian zai shi shi hou ti wen le 。]

english: I have a question for Apmeken.
translation: 我有一个问题要问阿普梅肯。 [wo you yi ge wen ti yao wen a pu mei ken 。]

english: What's your role in the Menaphite Pantheon?
translation: 你在梅纳菲特万神殿中的角色是什么？ [ni zai mei na fei te wan shen dian zhong de jue se shi shen me ？]

english: Why aren't there more monkeys or apes in the desert?
translation: 为什么沙漠里没有更多的猴子或猿类？ [wei shen me sha mo li mei you geng duo de hou zi huo yuan lei ？]

english: Actually, I've changed my mind.
translation: 事实上，我已经改变主意了。 [shi shi shang ， wo yi jing gai bian zhu yi le 。]

english: I'll be back soon.
translation: 我很快就会回来。 [wo hen kuai jiu hui hui lai 。]

english: I have a question for Crondis.
translation: 我有一个问题要问克朗迪斯。 [wo you yi ge wen ti yao wen ke lang di si 。]

english: Why are crocodiles so rude?
translation: 鳄鱼为何如此粗鲁？ [e yu wei he ru ci cu lu ？]

english: I have a question for Het.
translation: 我有一个问题要问Het。 [wo you yi ge wen ti yao wen Het。]

english: Do you have more followers than the others?
translation: 你比其他人有更多的追随者吗？ [ni bi qi ta ren you geng duo de zhui sui zhe ma ？]

english: I have a question for all of you.
translation: 我有一个问题想问大家。 [wo you yi ge wen ti xiang wen da jia 。]

english: What will happen with Amascut?
translation: 阿马斯卡特会发生什么？ [a ma si ka te hui fa sheng shen me ？]

english: Are you actually gods?
translation: 你们真的是神吗？ [ni men zhen de shi shen ma ？]

english: So what happens now?
translation: 那么现在会发生什么呢？ [na me xian zai hui fa sheng shen me ne ？]

english: How's your magic coming along?
translation: 你的魔法进展如何了？ [ni de mo fa jin zhan ru he le ？]

english: I'm practicing and slowly getting better.
translation: 我正在练习并慢慢变得更好。 [wo zheng zai lian xi bing man man bian de geng hao 。]

english: Good, good.
translation: 好，好。 [hao ， hao 。]

english: Help! Help!
translation: 帮助！帮助！ [bang zhu ！ bang zhu ！]

english: What has happened here?
translation: 这里发生了什么？ [zhe li fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: We were invited to a house party on an island not far from here... Something felt wrong about the whole thing but we went anyway...
translation: 我们被邀请参加离这里不远的一个岛上的家庭聚会...整个事情感觉有些不对劲，但我们还是去了... [wo men bei yao qing can jia li zhe li bu yuan de yi ge dao shang de jia ting ju hui ... zheng ge shi qing gan jue you xie bu dui jin ， dan wo men hai shi qu le ...]

english: The house seemed pretty creepy, but everything was going fine, we were all having a good time...
translation: 房子看起来很令人毛骨悚然，但一切都很顺利，我们都玩得很开心...... [fang zi kan qi lai hen ling ren mao gu song ran ， dan yi qie dou hen shun li ， wo men dou wan de hen kai xin ......]

english: ...and that's when we got attacked...
translation: ……就在那时我们遭到了袭击…… […… jiu zai na shi wo men zao dao le xi ji ……]

english: I... I tried to save her...
translation: 我……我试图拯救她…… [wo …… wo shi tu zheng jiu ta ……]

english: Hewey bought me enough time to find an old boat. I went back to get him but it was too late. I'm scared that he won't make it.
translation: 休伊为我争取了足够的时间去寻找一艘旧船。我回去接他，但为时已晚。我怕他熬不过去 [xiu yi wei wo zheng qu le zu gou de shi jian qu xun zhao yi sou jiu chuan 。 wo hui qu jie ta ， dan wei shi yi wan 。 wo pa ta ao bu guo qu]

english: You have to do something... they can't get away with this!
translation: 你必须做点什么……他们逃不掉的！ [ni bi xu zuo dian shen me …… ta men tao bu diao de ！]

english: What do you want me to do?
translation: 你想让我做什么？ [ni xiang rang wo zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm not getting involved in this!
translation: 我不参与这件事！ [wo bu can yu zhe jian shi ！]

english: That psycho is still out there, you have to bring them to justice.
translation: 那个神经病仍然在那里，你必须将他们绳之以法。 [na ge shen jing bing reng ran zai na li ， ni bi xu jiang ta men sheng zhi yi fa 。]

english: The boat we escaped on is just over there, you can use it to get to the island.
translation: 我们逃亡的船就在那边，你可以乘它去岛上。 [wo men tao wang de chuan jiu zai na bian ， ni ke yi cheng ta qu dao shang 。]

english: Okay, I'll see what I can do.
translation: 好吧，我看看能做什么。 [hao ba ， wo kan kan neng zuo shen me 。]

english: Urgh...I think I may have underestimated you.
translation: 呃……我想我可能低估了你。 [e …… wo xiang wo ke neng di gu le ni 。]

english: You've lost at your own game. And now it is time to see who you really are under that mask!
translation: 你已经输掉了自己的游戏。现在是时候看看面具下的你到底是谁了！ [ni yi jing shu diao le zi ji de you xi 。 xian zai shi shi hou kan kan mian ju xia de ni dao di shi shui le ！]

english: The player unmasks the killer, revealing Abigale as the culprit.
translation: 玩家揭开了凶手的面纱，揭露了阿比盖尔就是罪魁祸首。 [wan jia jie kai le xiong shou de mian sha ， jie lu le a bi gai er jiu shi zui kui huo shou 。]

english: No! You!? But why!? Why on earth would you kill all your friends!? Why beg me to come here to help them!?
translation: 不！你！？但为什么！？你到底为什么要杀死你所有的朋友！？为什么求我来这里帮助他们！？ [bu ！ ni ！？ dan wei shen me ！？ ni dao di wei shen me yao sha si ni suo you de peng you ！？ wei shen me qiu wo lai zhe li bang zhu ta men ！？]

english: You just don't get it do you?
translation: 你只是不明白，是吗？ [ni zhi shi bu ming bai ， shi ma ？]

english: So big headed. So used to it all being about you. About you saving the day.
translation: 头好大啊So used to it all being about you. About you saving the day. [tou hao da a So used to it all being about you. About you saving the day.]

english: Well I'm sick of it!
translation: 好吧，我厌倦了！ [hao ba ， wo yan juan le ！]

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你是什​​么意思？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: Adventurers! You're all the same. Everything always has to be about you.
translation: 冒险家们！你们都一样。一切都必须以你为中心。 [mao xian jia men ！ ni men dou yi yang 。 yi qie dou bi xu yi ni wei zhong xin 。]

english: I don't understand?
translation: 我不明白？ [wo bu ming bai ？]

english: Of course you wouldn't! Because you can't see past yourself!
translation: 你当然不会！因为你看不到过去的自己！ [ni dang ran bu hui ！ yin wei ni kan bu dao guo qu de zi ji ！]

english: Believe it or not... I used to be like you.
translation: 不管你信不信……我以前也和你一样。 [bu guan ni xin bu xin …… wo yi qian ye he ni yi yang 。]

english: I'd hear about some damsel in distress and go to help. To have my moment. For me to be the hero, just for once.
translation: 我会听说某个女孩遇险并去帮忙。拥有我的时刻。对我来说，成为英雄，就一次。 [wo hui ting shuo mou ge nv hai yu xian bing qu bang mang 。 yong you wo de shi ke 。 dui wo lai shuo ， cheng wei ying xiong ， jiu yi ci 。]

english: But YOU! You and every other darned adventurer! Every time I get there to help, it's too late. Crisis solved. Disaster averted. Reward claimed. Every time you and those other adventurers steal my moment!
translation: 但是你！你和其他所有该死的冒险家！每次我去那里帮忙时，都为时已晚。危机解决了。灾难得以避免。奖励已领取。 Every time you and those other adventurers steal my moment! [dan shi ni ！ ni he qi ta suo you gai si de mao xian jia ！ mei ci wo qu na li bang mang shi ， dou wei shi yi wan 。 wei ji jie jue le 。 zai nan de yi bi mian 。 jiang li yi ling qu 。 Every time you and those other adventurers steal my moment!]

english: But not this time!
translation: 但这次不是！ [dan zhe ci bu shi ！]

english: This time, it is all about me! I'm the star of the show! ME ME ME ME ME!
translation: 这一次，一切都是为了我！我是节目的明星！我我我我我我！ [zhe yi ci ， yi qie dou shi wei le wo ！ wo shi jie mu de ming xing ！ wo wo wo wo wo wo ！]

english: Well not any longer. The show is over, and there will be no curtain call.
translation: 好吧，不再是了。演出结束了，不会有谢幕。 [hao ba ， bu zai shi le 。 yan chu jie shu le ， bu hui you xie mu 。]

english: Oh, but there is always a curtain call.
translation: 哦，但谢幕总是有的。 [o ， dan xie mu zong shi you de 。]

english: Another killer comes out of the closest near the door.
translation: 另一个杀手从最靠近门的地方出现。 [ling yi ge sha shou cong zui kao jin men de di fang chu xian 。]

english: What!? How!? There was another killer!?
translation: 什么！？如何！？还有一个杀手！？ [shen me ！？ ru he ！？ hai you yi ge sha shou ！？]

english: Of course. Every good show needs a good supporting actor. Now, take off your mask darling. Take a bow. You have earned it.
translation: 当然。每一部好剧都需要一个好的配角。现在，摘下你的面具吧，亲爱的。谢幕。你已经赢得了它。 [dang ran 。 mei yi bu hao ju dou xu yao yi ge hao de pei jue 。 xian zai ， zhai xia ni de mian ju ba ， qin ai de 。 xie mu 。 ni yi jing ying de le ta 。]

english: Of course, my love.
translation: 当然，我的爱人。 [dang ran ， wo de ai ren 。]

english: The killer unmasks himself, revealing Hewey as the culprit.
translation: 凶手揭开了自己的面纱，揭露了休伊的真凶。 [xiong shou jie kai le zi ji de mian sha ， jie lu le xiu yi de zhen xiong 。]

english: You!? But how!? You were almost dead when I saw you! I saw your wounds!
translation: 你！？但如何！？当我看到你的时候你就快死了！我看到你的伤口了！ [ni ！？ dan ru he ！？ dang wo kan dao ni de shi hou ni jiu kuai si le ！ wo kan dao ni de shang kou le ！]

english: No, what you watched was what we wanted you to watch. A masterful performance if I do say myself.
translation: 不，你看的就是我们想让你看的。如果我自己说的话，这是一场精湛的表演。 [bu ， ni kan de jiu shi wo men xiang rang ni kan de 。 ru guo wo zi ji shuo de hua ， zhe shi yi chang jing zhan de biao yan 。]

english: But what is in this for you?
translation: 但这对你来说有什么好处呢？ [dan zhe dui ni lai shuo you shen me hao chu ne ？]

english: Everyone loves the limelight, and who better to share it with than my beloved Abigale.
translation: 每个人都喜欢成为众人瞩目的焦点，还有谁比我心爱的阿比盖尔更适合与之分享。 [mei ge ren dou xi huan cheng wei zhong ren zhu mu di jiao dian ， hai you shui bi wo xin ai de a bi gai er geng shi he yu zhi fen xiang 。]

english: But your friends?
translation: 但你的朋友呢？ [dan ni de peng you ne ？]

english: They didn't deserve to die!
translation: 他们不该死！ [ta men bu gai si ！]

english: Perhaps not, but neither did I deserve to be cast back into the shadows when I deserve the spotlight!
translation: 也许不是，但当我值得成为聚光灯时，我也不应该回到阴影中！ [ye xu bu shi ， dan dang wo zhi de cheng wei ju guang deng shi ， wo ye bu ying gai hui dao yin ying zhong ！]

english: Yes, while we deserve the spotlight.
translation: 是的，虽然我们值得受到关注。 [shi de ， sui ran wo men zhi de shou dao guan zhu 。]

english: And now I have my starring role!
translation: 现在我有了我的主角！ [xian zai wo you le wo de zhu jue ！]

english: OUR starring role.
translation: 我们的主角。 [wo men de zhu jue 。]

english: Gielinor will forever remember this night and what I have done here.
translation: 吉林诺将永远记住这个夜晚和我在这里所做的一切。 [ji lin nuo jiang yong yuan ji zhu zhe ge ye wan he wo zai zhe li suo zuo de yi qie 。]

english: No, what WE have done!
translation: 不，我们做了什么！ [bu ， wo men zuo le shen me ！]

english: Quiet Hewey! This is my moment!
translation: 安静的休伊！这是我的时刻！ [an jing de xiu yi ！ zhe shi wo de shi ke ！]

english: No, this is supposed to be our moment! It isn't just all about you either! We were in this together!
translation: 不，这应该是我们的时刻！这也不只是你的事！我们在一起！ [bu ， zhe ying gai shi wo men de shi ke ！ zhe ye bu zhi shi ni de shi ！ wo men zai yi qi ！]

english: Stop ruining this Hewey! I have worked so hard for this and I'm not going to let you take it away from me!
translation: 别再毁了这个休伊了！我为此付出了巨大的努力，我不会让你把它从我身边夺走！ [bie zai hui le zhe ge xiu yi le ！ wo wei ci fu chu le ju da de nu li ， wo bu hui rang ni ba ta cong wo shen bian duo zou ！]

english: Well I'm not going to be pushed aside either, we were both in this as equals!
translation: 好吧，我也不会被推到一边，我们都是平等的！ [hao ba ， wo ye bu hui bei tui dao yi bian ， wo men dou shi ping deng de ！]

english: We were never equals! How could you possibly compare to me!?
translation: 我们从来就不是平等的！你怎么能和我比！？ [wo men cong lai jiu bu shi ping deng de ！ ni zen me neng he wo bi ！？]

english: You egotistical, selfish...
translation: 你这个自私的人，自私的人…… [ni zhe ge zi si de ren ， zi si de ren ……]

english: Abigale stabs Hewey.
translation: 阿比盖尔刺伤休伊。 [a bi gai er ci shang xiu yi 。]

english: No...my love...
translation: 不……我的爱…… [bu …… wo de ai ……]

english: Hewey dies.
translation: 休伊去世。 [xiu yi qu shi 。]

english: No....no...what have I done!?
translation: 不……不……我做了什么！？ [bu …… bu …… wo zuo le shen me ！？]

english: It wasn't supposed to be like this...but you just couldn't let me have my moment. WHY HEWEY WHY!? I loved you...
translation: 事情不应该是这样的……但你就是不让我拥有属于我的时刻。为什么休伊为什么！？我爱你... [shi qing bu ying gai shi zhe yang de …… dan ni jiu shi bu rang wo yong you shu yu wo de shi ke 。 wei shen me xiu yi wei shen me ！？ wo ai ni ...]

english: This could be my chance to take advantage of the situation...
translation: 这可能是我利用这种情况的机会...... [zhe ke neng shi wo li yong zhe zhong qing kuang de ji hui ......]

english: What has happened here?
translation: 这里发生了什么？ [zhe li fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: What do you want me to do?
translation: 你想让我做什么？ [ni xiang rang wo zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm not getting involved.
translation: 我不会参与其中。 [wo bu hui can yu qi zhong 。]

english: Welcome to Hickton's Archery Store. Do you want to see my wares?
translation: 欢迎来到希克顿射箭店。你想看看我的商品吗？ [huan ying lai dao xi ke dun she jian dian 。 ni xiang kan kan wo de shang pin ma ？]

english: Can you tell me about your cape?
translation: 你能告诉我你的斗篷吗？ [ni neng gao su wo ni de dou peng ma ？]

english: Certainly! Skillcapes are a symbol of achievement. Only people who have mastered a skill and reached level 99 can get their hands on them and gain the benefits they carry.
translation: 当然！技能斗篷是成就的象征。只有掌握了一项技能并达到99级的人才能获得它们并获得它们所带来的好处。 [dang ran ！ ji neng dou peng shi cheng jiu de xiang zheng 。 zhi you zhang wo le yi xiang ji neng bing da dao 99 ji de ren cai neng huo de ta men bing huo de ta men suo dai lai de hao chu 。]

english: The Cape of Fletching can be searched for a mithril grapple and crossbow three times every day. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 每天可以在箭羽海角搜寻秘银抓钩和十字弓 3 次。还有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [mei tian ke yi zai jian yu hai jiao sou xun mi yin zhua gou he shi zi gong  3  ci 。 hai you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: No, I prefer to bash things close up.
translation: 不，我更喜欢近距离地攻击事物。 [bu ， wo geng xi huan jin ju li di gong ji shi wu 。]

english: I have a question for you.
translation: 我有个问题要问你。 [wo you ge wen ti yao wen ni 。]

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。 [qing shu ru wen ti de da an 。]

english: No, try again.
translation: 不，再试一次。 [bu ， zai shi yi ci 。]

english: Correct!
translation: 正确的！ [zheng que de ！]

english: Can you tell me about your cape?
translation: 你能告诉我你的斗篷吗？ [ni neng gao su wo ni de dou peng ma ？]

english: I'd like to view your store please.
translation: 我想参观一下你们的商店。 [wo xiang can guan yi xia ni men de shang dian 。]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Yes, please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No, I prefer to bash things close up.
translation: 不，我更喜欢近距离地攻击事物。 [bu ， wo geng xi huan jin ju li di gong ji shi wu 。]

english: Hey, down there! What is it?
translation: 嘿，在下面！它是什么？ [hei ， zai xia mian ！ ta shi shen me ？]

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？ [ni wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: For the dragons, of course! I've always wanted to slay dragons. I've found they're a bit tough, though, even with all this kit I've got, but I'll slay them one day.
translation: 当然是为了龙！我一直想屠龙。不过，我发现它们有点难对付，尽管我有这么多装备，但总有一天我会杀死它们。 [dang ran shi wei le long ！ wo yi zhi xiang tu long 。 bu guo ， wo fa xian ta men you dian nan dui fu ， jin guan wo you zhe me duo zhuang bei ， dan zong you yi tian wo hui sha si ta men 。]

english: My little cousin is a Slayer Master, lucky girl. But one day I'll be a mighty dragon-slayer, and they'll give me a job like that too.
translation: 我的小表弟是杀手大师，幸运的女孩。但有一天我会成为一名强大的屠龙者，他们也会给我一份这样的工作。 [wo de xiao biao di shi sha shou da shi ， xing yun de nv hai 。 dan you yi tian wo hui cheng wei yi ming qiang da de tu long zhe ， ta men ye hui gei wo yi fen zhe yang de gong zuo 。]

english: My little brother became a Slayer Master recently. That job should have been mine - he's just a little brat! But one day I'll be a mighty dragon-slayer, and they'll give me a job like that too.
translation: 我的弟弟最近成为了杀手大师。那份工作本来应该是我的——他只是个小孩子！但有一天我会成为一名强大的屠龙者，他们也会给我一份这样的工作。 [wo de di di zui jin cheng wei le sha shou da shi 。 na fen gong zuo ben lai ying gai shi wo de —— ta zhi shi ge xiao hai zi ！ dan you yi tian wo hui cheng wei yi ming qiang da de tu long zhe ， ta men ye hui gei wo yi fen zhe yang de gong zuo 。]

english: Can I kill the dragons in here?
translation: 我可以杀掉这里的龙吗？ [wo ke yi sha diao zhe li de long ma ？]

english: Yes, certainly, since you've been assigned to do so.
translation: 是的，当然，因为你被指派这样做。 [shi de ， dang ran ， yin wei ni bei zhi pai zhe yang zuo 。]

english: No, you haven't got an assignment to slay these dragons. Go and train somewhere else.
translation: 不，你没有杀死这些龙的任务。去别的地方训练吧。 [bu ， ni mei you sha si zhe xie long de ren wu 。 qu bie de di fang xun lian ba 。]

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我就走了。 [wo jiu zou le 。]

english: I'm sure that's not what you're meant to be slaying.
translation: 我确信那不是你要杀的东西。 [wo que xin na bu shi ni yao sha de dong xi 。]

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？ [ni wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: Can I kill the dragons in here?
translation: 我可以杀掉这里的龙吗？ [wo ke yi sha diao zhe li de long ma ？]

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我就走了。 [wo jiu zou le 。]

english: Many greetings. Welcome to our fair island.
translation: 许多问候。欢迎来到我们美丽的岛屿。 [xu duo wen hou 。 huan ying lai dao wo men mei li de dao yu 。]

english: Enjoy your stay here. May it be spiritually uplifting!
translation: 祝您在这里住宿愉快。愿它在精神上得到提升！ [zhu nin zai zhe li zhu su yu kuai 。 yuan ta zai jing shen shang de dao ti sheng ！]

english: I've got a message for you from the Wise Old Man in Draynor Village.
translation: 我收到了德拉诺村智者老人给你的消息。 [wo shou dao le de la nuo cun zhi zhe lao ren gei ni de xiao xi 。]

english: How kind of you to bring me a message to this remote island!
translation: 你真是太好了，给我带来了这个偏远岛屿的消息！ [ni zhen shi tai hao le ， gei wo dai lai le zhe ge pian yuan dao yu de xiao xi ！]

english: I don't have much in the way of wealth, but I can spare you a few coins for your trouble.
translation: 我没有太多的财富，但我可以给你省点钱，以解你的麻烦。 [wo mei you tai duo de cai fu ， dan wo ke yi gei ni sheng dian qian ， yi jie ni de ma fan 。]

english: In the name of Saradomin I shall bless you...
translation: 以萨拉多明的名义我会祝福你…… [yi sa la duo ming de ming yi wo hui zhu fu ni ……]

english: Here, let me give you some herbs.
translation: 来，我给你一些草药。 [lai ， wo gei ni yi xie cao yao 。]

english: The beasts which dwell under this island occasionally drop gems when they die - please take this one as a sign of my gratitude.
translation: 居住在这座岛屿下的野兽在死亡时偶尔会掉落宝石——请收下这颗宝石以表达我的谢意。 [ju zhu zai zhe zuo dao yu xia de ye shou zai si wang shi ou er hui diao luo bao shi —— qing shou xia zhe ke bao shi yi biao da wo de xie yi 。]

english: Hi, I was wondering, can you quickly bless this for me?
translation: 嗨，我想知道，你能尽快为我祝福吗？ [hai ， wo xiang zhi dao ， ni neng jin kuai wei wo zhu fu ma ？]

english: A somewhat strange request, but I see no harm in... Wait a moment... is that BLOOD?
translation: 这是一个有点奇怪的请求，但我认为没有什么坏处……等一下……那是血吗？ [zhe shi yi ge you dian qi guai de qing qiu ， dan wo ren wei mei you shen me huai chu …… deng yi xia …… na shi xue ma ？]

english: Erm... yes...
translation: 呃……是的…… [e …… shi de ……]

english: Why do you want me to bless a pot full of someones blood???
translation: 为什么要我祝福一盆别人的血？？？ [wei shen me yao wo zhu fu yi pen bie ren de xue ？？？]

english: Oh, don't worry, it's not 'someones', it's my own!
translation: 哦，别担心，这不是‘别人’，是我自己的！ [o ， bie dan xin ， zhe bu shi ‘ bie ren ’， shi wo zi ji de ！]

english: I... see... Well it is an unusual thing, but I see no harm in it. Take this, and walk in peace with Saradomin.
translation: 我……明白了……嗯，这是一件不寻常的事情，但我认为这没有什么坏处。拿着这个，与萨拉多明和平同行。 [wo …… ming bai le …… n ， zhe shi yi jian bu xun chang de shi qing ， dan wo ren wei zhe mei you shen me huai chu 。 na zhe zhe ge ， yu sa la duo ming he ping tong hang 。]

english: If the player receives an uncut emerald:
translation: 如果玩家收到未切割的祖母绿： [ru guo wan jia shou dao wei qie ge de zu mu lv ：]

english: If the player receives an uncut diamond:
translation: 如果玩家收到未切割的钻石： [ru guo wan jia shou dao wei qie ge de zuan shi ：]

english: If the player receives an uncut red topaz:
translation: 如果玩家收到未切割的红色托帕石： [ru guo wan jia shou dao wei qie ge de hong se tuo pa shi ：]

english: If the player receives an uncut sapphire:
translation: 如果玩家收到未切割的蓝宝石： [ru guo wan jia shou dao wei qie ge de lan bao shi ：]

english: Hello again. How can I help you?
translation: 又好。我怎么帮你？ [you hao 。 wo zen me bang ni ？]

english: How are things going here?
translation: 这里进展如何？ [zhe li jin zhan ru he ？]

english: Things are slowly coming back to life in our city of the dead. The bank under the Temple of the Lesser Gods has been restored, and a number of our merchants have reopened their stalls.
translation: 我们的死亡之城的一切正在慢慢恢复生机。小神殿下的银行已经恢复，我们的一些商人也重新开起了摊位。 [wo men de si wang zhi cheng de yi qie zheng zai man man hui fu sheng ji 。 xiao shen dian xia de yin hang yi jing hui fu ， wo men de yi xie shang ren ye chong xin kai qi le tan wei 。]

english: What about the plagues?
translation: 瘟疫呢？ [wen yi ne ？]

english: We're making progress on them. With our citizens back, we had enough people to finally deal with the frogs and locusts that were filling the town up.
translation: 我们正在这些方面取得进展。随着我们的公民回来，我们终于有了足够的人手来对付充斥整个城镇的青蛙和蝗虫。 [wo men zheng zai zhe xie fang mian qu de jin zhan 。 sui zhe wo men de gong min hui lai ， wo men zhong yu you le zu gou de ren shou lai dui fu chong chi zheng ge cheng zhen de qing wa he huang chong 。]

english: We worried they'd just come back, but perhaps we have managed to appease whichever god sent them.
translation: 我们担心他们会回来，但也许我们已经设法安抚了派他们来的神。 [wo men dan xin ta men hui hui lai ， dan ye xu wo men yi jing she fa an fu le pai ta men lai de shen 。]

english: The infected cows have been handled as well. The only plague left now is this infuriating pox. Still, at least it isn't contagious.
translation: 受感染的奶牛也已得到处理。现在只剩下这令人恼火的痘痘了。不过，至少它不会传染。 [shou gan ran de nai niu ye yi de dao chu li 。 xian zai zhi sheng xia zhe ling ren nao huo de dou dou le 。 bu guo ， zhi shao ta bu hui chuan ran 。]

english: Any sign of Menaphos opening up again?
translation: 梅纳福斯有再次开放的迹象吗？ [mei na fu si you zai ci kai fang de ji xiang ma ？]

english: They are adamant that their city must remain closed until all the plagues have gone. Until we can get rid of the pox, I can't see their gates opening to us, or to anyone else.
translation: 他们坚持认为他们的城市必须保持关闭，直到所有瘟疫消失。在我们消灭痘之前，我看不到他们的大门向我们或其他任何人敞开。 [ta men jian chi ren wei ta men de cheng shi bi xu bao chi guan bi ， zhi dao suo you wen yi xiao shi 。 zai wo men xiao mie dou zhi qian ， wo kan bu dao ta men de da men xiang wo men huo qi ta ren he ren chang kai 。]

english: Well at least things are moving in the right direction.
translation: 好吧，至少事情正在朝着正确的方向发展。 [hao ba ， zhi shao shi qing zheng zai chao zhe zheng que de fang xiang fa zhan 。]

english: Indeed. Now, is there anything else I can do for you?
translation: 的确。现在，还有什么我可以为您做的吗？ [di que 。 xian zai ， hai you shen me wo ke yi wei nin zuo de ma ？]

english: Could I have another lamp?
translation: 我可以再要一盏灯吗？ [wo ke yi zai yao yi zhan deng ma ？]

english: I'm afraid I only had the one.
translation: 恐怕我只有一个。 [kong pa wo zhi you yi ge 。]

english: No. I should get going.
translation: 不，我该走了。 [bu ， wo gai zou le 。]

english: Hello again.
translation: 又好。 [you hao 。]

english: Wonderful! The city of the dead has fully come back to life, and it's all thanks to you!
translation: 精彩的！死亡之城已经完全复活，这全都是你的功劳！ [jing cai de ！ si wang zhi cheng yi jing wan quan fu huo ， zhe quan dou shi ni de gong lao ！]

english: Well I'm happy to have helped. Any news from Menaphos?
translation: 嗯，我很高兴能提供帮助。有梅纳福斯的消息吗？ [n ， wo hen gao xing neng ti gong bang zhu 。 you mei na fu si de xiao xi ma ？]

english: They are continuing their preparations. It will take some time, but the city will soon be open once more.
translation: 他们正在继续进行准备工作。这需要一些时间，但这座城市很快就会再次开放。 [ta men zheng zai ji xu jin xing zhun bei gong zuo 。 zhe xu yao yi xie shi jian ， dan zhe zuo cheng shi hen kuai jiu hui zai ci kai fang 。]

english: Great!
translation: 伟大的！ [wei da de ！]

english: Could I have another circlet?
translation: 我可以再要一个圆环吗？ [wo ke yi zai yao yi ge yuan huan ma ？]

english: Certainly, though it will cost you 10,000 coins.
translation: 当然可以，不过要花费 10,000 金币。 [dang ran ke yi ， bu guo yao hua fei  10,000  jin bi 。]

english: Here you go.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: You don't seem to have enough money for it.
translation: 看来你的钱还不够。 [kan lai ni de qian hai bu gou 。]

english: Oh...
That's too much.
translation: 那就太多了。 [na jiu tai duo le 。]

english: Fair enough. Let me know if you change your mind.
translation: 很公平。如果您改变主意，请告诉我。 [hen gong ping 。 ru guo nin gai bian zhu yi ， qing gao su wo 。]

english: I should get going.
translation: 我该走了。 [wo gai zou le 。]

english: Until next time.
translation: 直到下次。 [zhi dao xia ci 。]

english: Hey, hey, hey! What in the name of sweet suffering Icthlarin are you doing?
translation: 嘿嘿嘿！以甜蜜痛苦的名义，你在做什么？ [hei hei hei ！ yi tian mi tong ku de ming yi ， ni zai zuo shen me ？]

english: I thought this acne potion might clear up your spots.
translation: 我认为这种痤疮药水可以清除你的斑点。 [wo ren wei zhe zhong cuo chuang yao shui ke yi qing chu ni de ban dian 。]

english: All that you'll achieve by pouring that potion on me is to ruin my lovely robes.
translation: 你把那药水倒在我身上只会毁掉我可爱的长袍。 [ni ba na yao shui dao zai wo shen shang zhi hui hui diao wo ke ai de chang pao 。]

english: Sorry, I was just trying to help.
translation: 抱歉，我只是想帮忙。 [bao qian ， wo zhi shi xiang bang mang 。]

english: Hey there. I was wondering if you could do me a favour?
translation: 嘿。我想知道你能帮我一个忙吗？ [hei 。 wo xiang zhi dao ni neng bang wo yi ge mang ma ？]

english: Oh? What kind of favour?
translation: 哦？什么样的恩惠？ [o ？ shen me yang de en hui ？]

english: I know cremation isn't your way, but is there anything you could do with these ashes?
translation: 我知道火葬不是你的方式，但是你能用这些骨灰做些什么吗？ [wo zhi dao huo zang bu shi ni de fang shi ， dan shi ni neng yong zhe xie gu hui zuo xie shen me ma ？]

english: Well, like you say, it is not really our way. Still, with all you've done for us, I'm willing to try.
translation: 嗯，就像你说的，这不是我们的方式。尽管如此，尽管你为我们所做的一切，我还是愿意尝试。 [n ， jiu xiang ni shuo de ， zhe bu shi wo men de fang shi 。 jin guan ru ci ， jin guan ni wei wo men suo zuo de yi qie ， wo hai shi yuan yi chang shi 。]

english: That's all I ask. Thank you.
translation: 这就是我所问的。谢谢。 [zhe jiu shi wo suo wen de 。 xie xie 。]

english: Could I have another lamp?
translation: 我可以再要一盏灯吗？ [wo ke yi zai yao yi zhan deng ma ？]

english: No. I should get going.
translation: 不，我该走了。 [bu ， wo gai zou le 。]

english: How are things going here?
translation: 这里进展如何？ [zhe li jin zhan ru he ？]

english: Could I have another circlet?
translation: 我可以再要一个圆环吗？ [wo ke yi zai yao yi ge yuan huan ma ？]

english: Here you go.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: That's too much.
translation: 那就太多了。 [na jiu tai duo le 。]

english: I should get going.
translation: 我该走了。 [wo gai zou le 。]

english: Hello again.
translation: 又好。 [you hao 。]

english: Hello, adventurer. Thank you for freeing me from the Devourer. I would be alone now. Scabaras teaches us to remain isolated, and I have much to think about.
translation: 你好，冒险家。谢谢你把我从吞噬者手中解救出来。我现在会孤身一人。斯卡巴拉斯教导我们要保持孤立，我有很多事情要思考。 [ni hao ， mao xian jia 。 xie xie ni ba wo cong tun shi zhe shou zhong jie jiu chu lai 。 wo xian zai hui gu shen yi ren 。 si ka ba la si jiao dao wo men yao bao chi gu li ， wo you hen duo shi qing yao si kao 。]

english: Adventurer... what is this? It looks like a scarab egg, but is unlike any I've seen before.
translation: 冒险家……这是什么？它看起来像圣甲虫蛋，但与我以前见过的不同。 [mao xian jia …… zhe shi shen me ？ ta kan qi lai xiang sheng jia chong dan ， dan yu wo yi qian jian guo de bu tong 。]

english: To be honest, I'm not sure, but I think you should have it. It has more hope of hatching with you than with me.
translation: 老实说，我不确定，但我认为你应该拥有它。它和你一起孵化的希望比和我一起孵化的希望更大。 [lao shi shuo ， wo bu que ding ， dan wo ren wei ni ying gai yong you ta 。 ta he ni yi qi fu hua de xi wang bi he wo yi qi fu hua de xi wang geng da 。]

english: Thank you, adventurer. I know not what will come of this, but I feel you have done the right thing. May Scabaras continue to guide you.
translation: 谢谢你，冒险家。我不知道会发生什么，但我觉得你做了正确的事。愿斯卡巴拉斯继续指导您。 [xie xie ni ， mao xian jia 。 wo bu zhi dao hui fa sheng shen me ， dan wo jue de ni zuo le zheng que de shi 。 yuan si ka ba la si ji xu zhi dao nin 。]

english: Intruder! You are not welcome here!
translation: 入侵者！这里不欢迎你！ [ru qin zhe ！ zhe li bu huan ying ni ！]

english: Fear not! I am here to rescue you!
translation: 不要害怕！我是来救你的！ [bu yao hai pa ！ wo shi lai jiu ni de ！]

english: Kill him!
translation: 杀了他！ [sha le ta ！]

english: Wait! Majaan, Manand...
translation: 等待！马詹、马南德…… [deng dai ！ ma zhan 、 ma nan de ……]

english: Silence! Champion, protect your High Priest!
translation: 沉默！勇士，保护你的大祭司！ [chen mo ！ yong shi ， bao hu ni de da ji si ！]

english: Fine. We'll do it your way.
translation: 美好的。我们会按照你的方式去做。 [mei hao de 。 wo men hui an zhao ni de fang shi qu zuo 。]

english: Stay back!
translation: 退后！ [tui hou ！]

english: Majaan, Manand, Almuk.
translation: 马贾安、马南德、阿尔穆克。 [ma jia an 、 ma nan de 、 a er mu ke 。]

english: Argh!
What... What happened?
translation: 什么……发生什么事了？ [shen me …… fa sheng shen me shi le ？]

english: It's alright. You were being controlled by Amascut, but you're free now.
translation: 没关系。你之前被阿马斯卡特控制，但现在你自由了。 [mei guan xi 。 ni zhi qian bei a ma si ka te kong zhi ， dan xian zai ni zi you le 。]

english: I... I don't remember.
translation: 我……我不记得了。 [wo …… wo bu ji de le 。]

english: I've been in your position. Don't worry, your memories will come back in time. Familiar places and objects can help them come back faster.
translation: 我一直处于你的位置。别担心，你的记忆会及时恢复的。熟悉的地方和物体可以帮助他们更快地回来。 [wo yi zhi chu yu ni de wei zhi 。 bie dan xin ， ni de ji yi hui ji shi hui fu de 。 shu xi de di fang he wu ti ke yi bang zhu ta men geng kuai di hui lai 。]

english: This room is familiar... as I look around, I feel something stirring...
translation: 这个房间很熟悉……我环顾四周，感觉有什么东西在颤动…… [zhe ge fang jian hen shu xi …… wo huan gu si zhou ， gan jue you shen me dong xi zai chan dong ……]

english: Yes, I can see it now! There are a few gaps, but it's all coming back to me. Thank you, adventurer.
translation: 是的，我现在可以看到了！虽然有一些空白，但我都回想起了。谢谢你，冒险家。 [shi de ， wo xian zai ke yi kan dao le ！ sui ran you yi xie kong bai ， dan wo dou hui xiang qi le 。 xie xie ni ， mao xian jia 。]

english: There is much for me to set right. We have made some terrible mistakes.
translation: 我还有很多事情需要纠正。我们犯了一些可怕的错误。 [wo hai you hen duo shi qing xu yao jiu zheng 。 wo men fan le yi xie ke pa de cuo wu 。]

english: I know the feeling. What did she have you do?
translation: 我知道这种感觉。她让你做什么了？ [wo zhi dao zhe zhong gan jue 。 ta rang ni zuo shen me le ？]

english: Many things. I have been under her control my whole life. It was the same for my predecessor, and her predecessor as well. We were all slaves to the Devourer, even our lord himself.
translation: 很多事情。我一生都在她的掌控之下。我的前任也是如此，她的前任也是如此。我们都是吞噬者的奴隶，甚至我们的主人也是如此。 [hen duo shi qing 。 wo yi sheng dou zai ta de zhang kong zhi xia 。 wo de qian ren ye shi ru ci ， ta de qian ren ye shi ru ci 。 wo men dou shi tun shi zhe de nu li ， shen zhi wo men de zhu ren ye shi ru ci 。]

english: She controls Scabaras?
translation: 她控制着斯卡巴拉斯？ [ta kong zhi zhe si ka ba la si ？]

english: Yes. She used him as her puppet for centuries, but now she has a new plan for him.
translation: 是的。几个世纪以来，她一直把他当作自己的傀儡，但现在她对他有了新的计划。 [shi de 。 ji ge shi ji yi lai ， ta yi zhi ba ta dang zuo zi ji de kui lei ， dan xian zai ta dui ta you le xin de ji hua 。]

english: What new plan?
translation: 有什么新计划？ [you shen me xin ji hua ？]

english: I don't know. She took him into some tomb, along with the others.
translation: 我不知道。她把他和其他人一起带进了某个坟墓。 [wo bu zhi dao 。 ta ba ta he qi ta ren yi qi dai jin le mou ge fen mu 。]

english: Osmumten's tomb. Who are these others you speak of?
translation: 奥斯穆姆滕的坟墓。你所说的其他人是谁？ [ao si mu mu teng de fen mu 。 ni suo shuo de qi ta ren shi shui ？]

english: Apmeken, Crondis and Het. The other avatars of Tumeken.
translation: 阿普梅肯、克朗迪斯和赫特。图梅肯的其他化身。 [a pu mei ken 、 ke lang di si he he te 。 tu mei ken de qi ta hua shen 。]

english: She has them all?
translation: 她都有了？ [ta dou you le ？]

english: She does. We helped her capture them. It took many lifetimes, but she was able to fool them all.
translation: 她做到了。我们帮助她抓住了他们。这花了很多辈子的时间，但她却能骗过所有人。 [ta zuo dao le 。 wo men bang zhu ta zhua zhu le ta men 。 zhe hua le hen duo bei zi de shi jian ， dan ta que neng pian guo suo you ren 。]

english: This isn't good. There're weapons in that tomb that can transfer divine power between beings. She must be planning to use them on the lesser deities.
translation: 这不好。那个坟墓里有可以在生物之间传递神力的武器。她一定是打算用它们对付小神。 [zhe bu hao 。 na ge fen mu li you ke yi zai sheng wu zhi jian chuan di shen li de wu qi 。 ta yi ding shi da suan yong ta men dui fu xiao shen 。]

english: The four of them all came from Tumeken himself. Their power is his power. If she claims that power as her own, she will become a true goddess...
translation: 这四个人都是图梅肯本人出的。他们的力量就是他的力量。如果她将这份力量据为己有，她就会成为真正的女神…… [zhe si ge ren dou shi tu mei ken ben ren chu de 。 ta men de li liang jiu shi ta de li liang 。 ru guo ta jiang zhe fen li liang ju wei ji you ， ta jiu hui cheng wei zhen zheng de nv shen ……]

english: Don't worry, I'll make sure that doesn't happen.
translation: 别担心，我会确保这不会发生。 [bie dan xin ， wo hui que bao zhe bu hui fa sheng 。]

english: How can you hope to withstand her power?
translation: 你怎么能指望抵挡住她的力量呢？ [ni zen me neng zhi wang di dang zhu ta de li liang ne ？]

english: I'll find a way. Do you have any other information that can help me?
translation: 我会找到办法的。您还有其他信息可以帮助我吗？ [wo hui zhao dao ban fa de 。 nin hai you qi ta xin xi ke yi bang zhu wo ma ？]

english: We were not the only ones to fall to the Devourer. She has control over Pharaoh Kemesis of Menaphos.
translation: 我们并不是唯一落入吞噬者手中的人。她控制着梅纳福斯的法老凯麦西斯。 [wo men bing bu shi wei yi luo ru tun shi zhe shou zhong de ren 。 ta kong zhi zhe mei na fu si de fa lao kai mai xi si 。]

english: We feared as much. Do you know what she wants with him?
translation: 我们也同样担心。你知道她想和他在一起做什么吗？ [wo men ye tong yang dan xin 。 ni zhi dao ta xiang he ta zai yi qi zuo shen me ma ？]

english: She needed control over the city, but she kept the reason a secret. She even had us release locusts and frogs into Sophanem so she could have Menaphos locked down.
translation: 她需要控制这座城市，但她对原因保密。她甚至让我们将蝗虫和青蛙释放到索法奈姆，这样她就可以封锁梅纳福斯。 [ta xu yao kong zhi zhe zuo cheng shi ， dan ta dui yuan yin bao mi 。 ta shen zhi rang wo men jiang huang chong he qing wa shi fang dao suo fa nai mu ， zhe yang ta jiu ke yi feng suo mei na fu si 。]

english: You caused the plagues? The cows and the pox as well?
translation: 瘟疫是你造成的？还有牛和痘吗？ [wen yi shi ni zao cheng de ？ hai you niu he dou ma ？]

english: We did also poison the cows. I know nothing of this pox, though.
translation: 我们也确实给奶牛下了毒。不过我对这个痘一无所知。 [wo men ye que shi gei nai niu xia le du 。 bu guo wo dui zhe ge dou yi wu suo zhi 。]

english: Hmm... what will you do now?
translation: 嗯...你现在要做什么？ [n ... ni xian zai yao zuo shen me ？]

english: I fear many of my people are forever lost, but I will save as many as I can. Together, we will reform the Sect of Scabaras, and right the wrongs of the Devourer.
translation: 我担心我的许多人将永远迷失，但我会尽我所能拯救更多人。我们将共同改革斯卡巴拉教派，纠正吞噬者的错误。 [wo dan xin wo de xu duo ren jiang yong yuan mi shi ， dan wo hui jin wo suo neng zheng jiu geng duo ren 。 wo men jiang gong tong gai ge si ka ba la jiao pai ， jiu zheng tun shi zhe de cuo wu 。]

english: So you'll help me fight her?
translation: 那么你会帮我对抗她吗？ [na me ni hui bang wo dui kang ta ma ？]

english: In our own way. Before the Devourer, we were an isolated people, just as Scabaras taught us to be. We will go back to that way of life.
translation: 以我们自己的方式。在吞噬者出现之前，我们是一个孤立的民族，正如斯卡巴拉斯教导我们的那样。我们将回到那种生活方式。 [yi wo men zi ji de fang shi 。 zai tun shi zhe chu xian zhi qian ， wo men shi yi ge gu li de min zu ， zheng ru si ka ba la si jiao dao wo men de na yang 。 wo men jiang hui dao na zhong sheng huo fang shi 。]

english: We may go unseen, but we will be there, fighting the forces of the Devourer wherever they appear.
translation: 我们可能会被忽视，但我们会在那里，与吞噬者的力量战斗，无论它们出现在哪里。 [wo men ke neng hui bei hu shi ， dan wo men hui zai na li ， yu tun shi zhe de li liang zhan dou ， wu lun ta men chu xian zai na li 。]

english: Good to hear. Now, I'd better head over to Nardah. I have a friend there who needs to hear about all of this.
translation: 很高兴听到。现在，我最好去纳尔达。我在那里有一个朋友需要听听这一切。 [hen gao xing ting dao 。 xian zai ， wo zui hao qu na er da 。 wo zai na li you yi ge peng you xu yao ting ting zhe yi qie 。]

english: Good luck in your fight, adventurer. May Scabaras guide you.
translation: 祝你战斗顺利，冒险家。愿斯卡巴拉斯指引你。 [zhu ni zhan dou shun li ， mao xian jia 。 yuan si ka ba la si zhi yin ni 。]

english: You offered yourself to Zulrah as a sacrifice, yet here you stand before me. Did Zulrah reject you?
translation: 你把自己献给祖拉作为祭品，但你却站在我面前。祖拉拒绝了你吗？ [ni ba zi ji xian gei zu la zuo wei ji pin ， dan ni que zhan zai wo mian qian 。 zu la ju jue le ni ma ？]

english: I kinda left the shrine.
translation: 我就这样离开了神社。 [wo jiu zhe yang li kai le shen she 。]

english: Perhaps you should try offering yourself again, before the mighty Zulrah grows impatient.
translation: 也许你应该在强大的祖拉变得不耐烦之前再次尝试献身。 [ye xu ni ying gai zai qiang da de zu la bian de bu nai fan zhi qian zai ci chang shi xian shen 。]

english: I killed Zulrah.
translation: 我杀了祖拉。 [wo sha le zu la 。]

english: Very funny, human, but I find that hard to believe. Go and offer yourself as a sacrifice again, before the mighty Zulrah grows impatient.
translation: 非常有趣，人类，但我发现很难相信。在强大的祖拉变得不耐烦之前，再次去献上自己作为祭品。 [fei chang you qu ， ren lei ， dan wo fa xian hen nan xiang xin 。 zai qiang da de zu la bian de bu nai fan zhi qian ， zai ci qu xian shang zi ji zuo wei ji pin 。]

english: Have you any advice for surviving against Zulrah?
translation: 对于对抗祖拉的生存，你有什么建议吗？ [dui yu dui kang zu la de sheng cun ， ni you shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: I think you have misunderstood the nature of the sacrifice, human. Never mind, the mighty Zulrah will make the matter clear to you.
translation: 我认为你误解了牺牲的本质，人类。没关系，强大的祖拉会让你明白这件事的。 [wo ren wei ni wu jie le xi sheng de ben zhi ， ren lei 。 mei guan xi ， qiang da de zu la hui rang ni ming bai zhe jian shi de 。]

english: Tell me about Zulrah.
translation: 告诉我关于祖拉的事。 [gao su wo guan yu zu la de shi 。]

english: Zulrah is the all-powerful snake god of the southern wastes. He rises from the swamp to show his divine majesty and to accept our homage.
translation: 祖拉是南方荒原全能的蛇神。他从沼泽中站起来，展示他神圣的威严并接受我们的致敬。 [zu la shi nan fang huang yuan quan neng de she shen 。 ta cong zhao ze zhong zhan qi lai ， zhan shi ta shen sheng de wei yan bing jie shou wo men de zhi jing 。]

english: Long ago, our forebears came to this place, not realising that they were trespassing in Zulrah's domain. He arose from the swamp in wrath, and many were slain.
translation: 很久以前，我们的祖先来到了这个地方，却没有意识到他们正在侵入祖拉的领地。他愤怒地从沼泽中站起来，许多人被杀。 [hen jiu yi qian ， wo men de zu xian lai dao le zhe ge di fang ， que mei you yi shi dao ta men zheng zai qin ru zu la de ling di 。 ta fen nu di cong zhao ze zhong zhan qi lai ， xu duo ren bei sha 。]

english: But Zulrah, in his mercy, allowed some of those transgressors to live, sparing them the punishment they deserved, and allowing them the chance to repent.
translation: 但祖拉仁慈地允许其中一些违法者活下来，免除了他们应有的惩罚，并给了他们悔改的机会。 [dan zu la ren ci di yun xu qi zhong yi xie wei fa zhe huo xia lai ， mian chu le ta men ying you de cheng fa ， bing gei le ta men hui gai de ji hui 。]

english: Then my mother, oldest and wisest of the tribe, dared to intercede with the mighty Zulrah on behalf of her people, and thus a sacred contract was declared.
translation: 然后，我的母亲，部落中最年长、最聪明的人，敢于代表她的人民向强大的祖拉求情，从而宣布了一项神圣的契约。 [ran hou ， wo de mu qin ， bu luo zhong zui nian zhang 、 zui cong ming de ren ， gan yu dai biao ta de ren min xiang qiang da de zu la qiu qing ， cong er xuan bu le yi xiang shen sheng de qi yue 。]

english: Zulrah granted us the right to dwell in his lands, and to eat of their bounty. None shall ever drive us out, for Zulrah protects us.
translation: 祖拉授予我们居住在他的土地上并享受他们的恩赐的权利。没有人会驱逐我们，因为祖拉会保护我们。 [zu la shou yu wo men ju zhu zai ta de tu di shang bing xiang shou ta men de en ci de quan li 。 mei you ren hui qu zhu wo men ， yin wei zu la hui bao hu wo men 。]

english: All he asks in return is a periodic sacrifice at his sacred shrine. As long as the sacrifices continue, Zulrah will let us live peacefully in his lands.
translation: 他所要求的回报只是定期在他的神圣神殿进行献祭。只要牺牲继续下去，祖拉就会让我们在他的土地上和平生活。 [ta suo yao qiu de hui bao zhi shi ding qi zai ta de shen sheng shen dian jin xing xian ji 。 zhi yao xi sheng ji xu xia qu ， zu la jiu hui rang wo men zai ta de tu di shang he ping sheng huo 。]

english: Willing volunteers are never hard to find, for their sacrifice buys peace for the tribe, and I grant their families extra rations of food.
translation: 愿意的志愿者并不难找到，因为他们的牺牲为部落换来了和平，我会给他们的家人提供额外的食物。 [yuan yi de zhi yuan zhe bing bu nan zhao dao ， yin wei ta men de xi sheng wei bu luo huan lai le he ping ， wo hui gei ta men de jia ren ti gong e wai de shi wu 。]

english: Who are you all?
translation: 你们都是谁？ [ni men dou shi shui ？]

english: The southern wastes are a perilous place where travellers often become lost. Elves from the woodland villages, gnomes from the eastern caves, and many others.
translation: 南部荒原是一个危险的地方，旅行者经常迷路。来自林地村庄的精灵、来自东部洞穴的侏儒等等。 [nan bu huang yuan shi yi ge wei xian de di fang ， lv xing zhe jing chang mi lu 。 lai zi lin di cun zhuang de jing ling 、 lai zi dong bu dong xue de zhu ru deng deng 。]

english: Some find their way here, like my forebears did. They eat of the sacred swamp eels that Zulrah sends, and become one with the tribe.
translation: 有些人找到了来这里的路，就像我的祖先一样。他们吃祖拉送来的神圣沼泽鳗鱼，并与部落合而为一。 [you xie ren zhao dao le lai zhe li de lu ， jiu xiang wo de zu xian yi yang 。 ta men chi zu la song lai de shen sheng zhao ze man yu ， bing yu bu luo he er wei yi 。]

english: Their original families and tribes shun them as unclean creatures once they have tasted of the sacred swamp eels, so they remain here to worship Zulrah.
translation: 一旦他们尝到了神圣的沼泽鳗鱼的味道，他们的原生家庭和部落就会将他们视为不洁的生物而避开他们，因此他们留在这里崇拜祖拉。 [yi dan ta men chang dao le shen sheng de zhao ze man yu de wei dao ， ta men de yuan sheng jia ting he bu luo jiu hui jiang ta men shi wei bu jie de sheng wu er bi kai ta men ， yin ci ta men liu zai zhe li chong bai zu la 。]

english: I'm off.
translation: 我走了。 [wo zou le 。]

english: Do you wish me to tell you more of Zulrah, human?
translation: 你希望我告诉你更多关于祖拉的事吗，人类？ [ni xi wang wo gao su ni geng duo guan yu zu la de shi ma ， ren lei ？]

english: Why do you bother the High Priestess of Zulrah, human?
translation: 你为什么要打扰祖拉的高阶女祭司，人类？ [ni wei shen me yao da rao zu la de gao jie nv ji si ， ren lei ？]

english: How do people get chosen as a sacrifice to Zulrah?
translation: 人们如何被选为祖拉的祭品？ [ren men ru he bei xuan wei zu la de ji pin ？]

english: Volunteers offer themselves gladly, knowing that their sacrifice is for the good of the tribe. Also, I grant their families extra rations of food.
translation: 志愿者们很高兴地奉献自己，因为他们知道他们的牺牲是为了部落的利益。另外，我还给他们的家人额外配给食物。 [zhi yuan zhe men hen gao xing di feng xian zi ji ， yin wei ta men zhi dao ta men de xi sheng shi wei le bu luo de li yi 。 ling wai ， wo huan gei ta men de jia ren e wai pei ji shi wu 。]

english: The next sacrifice is a brave gnome who has just come of age. He waits by the boat now.
translation: 下一个牺牲品是一位刚刚成年的勇敢侏儒。他现在就在船边等着。 [xia yi ge xi sheng pin shi yi wei gang gang cheng nian de yong gan zhu ru 。 ta xian zai jiu zai chuan bian deng zhe 。]

english: I won't let you sacrifice him - take me instead!
translation: 我不会让你牺牲他——取而代之的是我！ [wo bu hui rang ni xi sheng ta —— qu er dai zhi de shi wo ！]

english: You would offer yourself as a sacrifice in his place? Your dedication to Zulrah must be truly profound to make such an offer...
translation: 你愿意代替他牺牲自己吗？您对祖拉的奉献一定是真正深刻的，才能提出这样的提议…… [ni yuan yi dai ti ta xi sheng zi ji ma ？ nin dui zu la de feng xian yi ding shi zhen zheng shen ke de ， cai neng ti chu zhe yang de ti yi ……]

english: ... and I accept. You shall be our next sacrifice. Board the boat when you are ready, and give glory to Zulrah through your death.
translation: ...我接受。你将成为我们的下一个牺牲品。准备好后就上船，通过你的死亡为祖拉带来荣耀。 [... wo jie shou 。 ni jiang cheng wei wo men de xia yi ge xi sheng pin 。 zhun bei hao hou jiu shang chuan ， tong guo ni de si wang wei zu la dai lai rong yao 。]

english: I see you have not yet offered yourself as a sacrifice to Zulrah, human. Climb into the boat, and the priestess will deliver you to the shrine.
translation: 我发现你还没有将自己作为祭品献给祖拉，人类。上船，女祭司会带你去神社。 [wo fa xian ni hai mei you jiang zi ji zuo wei ji pin xian gei zu la ， ren lei 。 shang chuan ， nv ji si hui dai ni qu shen she 。]

english: I kinda left the shrine.
translation: 我就这样离开了神社。 [wo jiu zhe yang li kai le shen she 。]

english: I killed Zulrah.
translation: 我杀了祖拉。 [wo sha le zu la 。]

english: Have you any advice for surviving against Zulrah?
translation: 对于对抗祖拉的生存，你有什么建议吗？ [dui yu dui kang zu la de sheng cun ， ni you shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: Tell me about Zulrah.
translation: 告诉我关于祖拉的事。 [gao su wo guan yu zu la de shi 。]

english: Who are you all?
translation: 你们都是谁？ [ni men dou shi shui ？]

english: I'm off.
translation: 我走了。 [wo zou le 。]

english: How do people get chosen as a sacrifice to Zulrah?
translation: 人们如何被选为祖拉的祭品？ [ren men ru he bei xuan wei zu la de ji pin ？]

english: I won't let you sacrifice him - take me instead!
translation: 我不会让你牺牲他——取而代之的是我！ [wo bu hui rang ni xi sheng ta —— qu er dai zhi de shi wo ！]

english: Stand and deliver!
translation: 站起来交付！ [zhan qi lai jiao fu ！]

english: Hi!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Let me at 'em!
translation: 让我来对付他们吧！ [rang wo lai dui fu ta men ba ！]

english: Trolls? Schmolls!
translation: 巨魔？施莫尔斯！ [ju mo ？ shi mo er si ！]

english: The trolls are coming!
translation: 巨魔来了！ [ju mo lai le ！]

english: The trolls took my baby son!
translation: 巨魔夺走了我的宝贝儿子！ [ju mo duo zou le wo de bao bei er zi ！]

english: Welcome to Burthorpe!
translation: 欢迎来到伯索普！ [huan ying lai dao bo suo pu ！]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: Trolls!
translation: 巨魔！ [ju mo ！]

english: Hello stranger.
translation: 你好陌生人。 [ni hao mo sheng ren 。]

english: Go away!
translation: 离开！ [li kai ！]

english: Run!
translation: 跑步！ [pao bu ！]

english: Hi!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: The Imperial Guard can no longer protect us!
translation: 禁军已经无法保护我们了！ [jin jun yi jing wu fa bao hu wo men le ！]

english: The White Knights will soon have control!
translation: 白骑士很快就会掌控局面！ [bai qi shi hen kuai jiu hui zhang kong ju mian ！]

english: I heard about what you did, thank you!
translation: 我听说了你的所作所为，谢谢！ [wo ting shuo le ni de suo zuo suo wei ， xie xie ！]

english: The White Knights are still going to take over.
translation: 白骑士仍将接管。 [bai qi shi reng jiang jie guan 。]

english: I hear the Imperial Guard are preparing an attack!
translation: 听说禁军准备进攻！ [ting shuo jin jun zhun bei jin gong ！]

english: Thank you so much!
translation: 太感谢了！ [tai gan xie le ！]

english: Surely we are safe now!
translation: 我们现在肯定安全了！ [wo men xian zai ken ding an quan le ！]

english: I've lost my enchanted Amulet of Catspeak.
translation: 我丢失了我的魔法猫语护身符。 [wo diu shi le wo de mo fa mao yu hu shen fu 。]

english: This can be rectified, simply bring me another Amulet of Catspeak and five death runes and I will enchant it for you.
translation: 这是可以纠正的，只需给我再带一个猫语护身符和五个死亡符文，我就会为你附魔。 [zhe shi ke yi jiu zheng de ， zhi xu gei wo zai dai yi ge mao yu hu shen fu he wu ge si wang fu wen ， wo jiu hui wei ni fu mo 。]

english: I don't have the five death runes on me.
translation: 我身上没有五个死亡符文。 [wo shen shang mei you wu ge si wang fu wen 。]

english: Come back to me when you have them.
translation: 当你拥有它们时，请回到我身边。 [dang ni yong you ta men shi ， qing hui dao wo shen bian 。]

english: I have the runes but don't have the amulet on me.
translation: 我有符文，但身上没有护身符。 [wo you fu wen ， dan shen shang mei you hu shen fu 。]

english: Bring me the amulet and I will enchant it for you.
translation: 把护身符拿给我，我会为你附魔。 [ba hu shen fu na gei wo ， wo hui wei ni fu mo 。]

english: I have the death runes with me now.
translation: 我现在带着死亡符文。 [wo xian zai dai zhe si wang fu wen 。]

english: Good. Give me the amulet so that I may perform the enchantment.
translation: 好的。给我护身符，以便我施展魔法。 [hao de 。 gei wo hu shen fu ， yi bian wo shi zhan mo fa 。]

english: Using the enchanted amulet is easy; open up the amulet and you'll see a cat's face, use the whiskers to rotate the cats nose. You'll see the nose move and the new direction highlighted. When the nose points in the
translation: 使用附魔护身符很容易；打开护身符，你会看到一张猫的脸，用胡须旋转猫的鼻子。您会看到鼻子移动并突出显示新方向。当鼻子指向 [shi yong fu mo hu shen fu hen rong yi ； da kai hu shen fu ， ni hui kan dao yi zhang mao de lian ， yong hu xu xuan zhuan mao de bi zi 。 nin hui kan dao bi zi yi dong bing tu chu xian shi xin fang xiang 。 dang bi zi zhi xiang]

english: direction that Bob is in, the eyes will light up and the mouth will open. You'll need to head in that direction and then check the direction again. If you are very close to Bob then the eyes and mouth will animate no
translation: 鲍勃所在的方向，眼睛会发亮，嘴巴会张开。您需要朝该方向行驶，然后再次检查方向。如果你离鲍勃很近，那么眼睛和嘴巴就会动起来 [bao bo suo zai de fang xiang ， yan jing hui fa liang ， zui ba hui zhang kai 。 nin xu yao chao gai fang xiang xing shi ， ran hou zai ci jian cha fang xiang 。 ru guo ni li bao bo hen jin ， na me yan jing he zui ba jiu hui dong qi lai]

english: matter which way the nose is pointing. That's all there is to it, good luck!
translation: 不管鼻子指向哪个方向。这就是全部内容了，祝你好运！ [bu guan bi zi zhi xiang na ge fang xiang 。 zhe jiu shi quan bu nei rong le ， zhu ni hao yun ！]

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好呀！ [ni hao ya ！]

english: Hello, what's in those boxes?
translation: 你好，请问这些盒子里装的是什么？ [ni hao ， qing wen zhe xie he zi li zhuang de shi shen me ？]

english: Aha, interested in my crossbows are you?
translation: 啊哈，你对我的弩感兴趣吗？ [a ha ， ni dui wo de nu gan xing qu ma ？]

english: Are they any good?
translation: 他们有什么好处吗？ [ta men you shen me hao chu ma ？]

english: They're dwarven engineering at its best. If you've got enough skill in crafting, smithing and fletching, you can even make them yourself. You can buy some of the parts here and make the rest yourself.
translation: 他们是最优秀的矮人工程学。如果您在制作、锻造和制箭方面有足够的技能，您甚至可以自己制作它们。您可以在这里购买一些零件，然后自己制作其余的零件。 [ta men shi zui you xiu de ai ren gong cheng xue 。 ru guo nin zai zhi zuo 、 duan zao he zhi jian fang mian you zu gou de ji neng ， nin shen zhi ke yi zi ji zhi zuo ta men 。 nin ke yi zai zhe li gou mai yi xie ling jian ， ran hou zi ji zhi zuo qi yu de ling jian 。]

english: How do I make one for myself?
translation: 我如何为自己制作一个？ [wo ru he wei zi ji zhi zuo yi ge ？]

english: Well, firstly you'll need to chop yourself some wood, then use a knife on the wood to whittle out a nice crossbow stock like these here.
translation: 好吧，首先你需要给自己砍一些木头，然后用刀在木头上削出像这里这样的漂亮的十字弓枪托。 [hao ba ， shou xian ni xu yao gei zi ji kan yi xie mu tou ， ran hou yong dao zai mu tou shang xue chu xiang zhe li zhe yang de piao liang de shi zi gong qiang tuo 。]

english: Wood fletched into stock... check.
translation: 木头羽毛进入库存......检查。 [mu tou yu mao jin ru ku cun ...... jian cha 。]

english: Then get yourself some metal and a hammer and smith yourself some limbs for the bow, mind that you use the right metals and woods though as some wood is too light to use with some metal and vice versa.
translation: 然后给自己准备一些金属和一把锤子，并为自己打造一些弓肢，请注意使用正确的金属和木材，因为有些木材太轻而无法与某些金属一起使用，反之亦然。 [ran hou gei zi ji zhun bei yi xie jin shu he yi ba chui zi ， bing wei zi ji da zao yi xie gong zhi ， qing zhu yi shi yong zheng que de jin shu he mu cai ， yin wei you xie mu cai tai qing er wu fa yu mou xie jin shu yi qi shi yong ， fan zhi yi ran 。]

english: Which goes with which?
translation: 哪个与哪个搭配？ [na ge yu na ge da pei ？]

english: Wood and Bronze as they're basic materials, Oak and Blurite, Willow and Iron, Steel and Teak, Mithril and Maple, Adamantite and Mahogany and finally Runite and Yew.
translation: 木材和青铜作为基本材料，橡木和蓝铁矿，柳树和铁，钢和柚木，秘银和枫木，精金和桃花心木，最后是符石和红豆杉。 [mu cai he qing tong zuo wei ji ben cai liao ， xiang mu he lan tie kuang ， liu shu he tie ， gang he you mu ， mi yin he feng mu ， jing jin he tao hua xin mu ， zui hou shi fu shi he hong dou shan 。]

english: Ok, so I have my stock and a pair of limbs... what now?
translation: 好吧，我有了我的枪托和一对肢体……现在怎么办？ [hao ba ， wo you le wo de qiang tuo he yi dui zhi ti …… xian zai zen me ban ？]

english: Simply take a hammer and smack the limbs firmly onto the stock. You'll then need a string, only they're not the same as normal bows. You'll need to dry some large animal's meat to get sinew, then spin that on a spinning
translation: 只需拿起一把锤子，将四肢牢牢地敲在枪托上即可。然后你需要一根弦，只是它们与普通的弓不同。你需要干燥一些大型动物的肉来获得肌腱，然后将其放在旋转的机器上旋转 [zhi xu na qi yi ba chui zi ， jiang si zhi lao lao di qiao zai qiang tuo shang ji ke 。 ran hou ni xu yao yi gen xian ， zhi shi ta men yu pu tong de gong bu tong 。 ni xu yao gan zao yi xie da xing dong wu de rou lai huo de ji jian ， ran hou jiang qi fang zai xuan zhuan de ji qi shang xuan zhuan]

english: wheel, it's the only thing we've found to be strong enough for a crossbow.
translation: 轮子，这是我们发现的唯一一个足够坚固的东西来制作十字弓。 [lun zi ， zhe shi wo men fa xian de wei yi yi ge zu gou jian gu de dong xi lai zhi zuo shi zi gong 。]

english: What about magic logs?
translation: 魔法日志呢？ [mo fa ri zhi ne ？]

english: Well.. I don't rightly know... us dwarves don't work with magic, we prefer gold and rock. Much more stable. I guess you could ask the humans at the rangers guild to see if they can do something but I don't want
translation: 嗯……我不太清楚……我们矮人不使用魔法，我们更喜欢黄金和岩石。稳定得多。我想你可以问问游侠公会的人类，看看他们是否可以做点什么，但我不想 [n …… wo bu tai qing chu …… wo men ai ren bu shi yong mo fa ， wo men geng xi huan huang jin he yan shi 。 wen ding de duo 。 wo xiang ni ke yi wen wen you xia gong hui de ren lei ， kan kan ta men shi fou ke yi zuo dian shen me ， dan wo bu xiang]

english: anything to do with it!
translation: 与它有任何关系！ [yu ta you ren he guan xi ！]

english: Thanks for telling me. Bye!
translation: 谢谢你告诉我。再见！ [xie xie ni gao su wo 。 zai jian ！]

english: Take care, straight shooting.
translation: 小心点，直接射击。 [xiao xin dian ， zhi jie she ji 。]

english: What about ammo?
translation: 弹药呢？ [dan yao ne ？]

english: You can smith yourself lots of different bolts, don't forget to flight them with feathers like you do arrows though. You can poison any untipped bolt but there's also the option of tipping them with gems then
translation: 你可以自己锻造很多不同的螺栓，但不要忘记像箭一样用羽毛来飞行它们。你可以对任何未尖头的螺栓下毒，但也可以选择用宝石来尖头它们 [ni ke yi zi ji duan zao hen duo bu tong de luo shuan ， dan bu yao wang ji xiang jian yi yang yong yu mao lai fei xing ta men 。 ni ke yi dui ren he wei jian tou de luo shuan xia du ， dan ye ke yi xuan ze yong bao shi lai jian tou ta men]

english: enchanting them with runes. This can have some pretty powerful effects.
translation: 用符文迷惑他们。这可以产生一些非常强大的效果。 [yong fu wen mi huo ta men 。 zhe ke yi chan sheng yi xie fei chang qiang da de xiao guo 。]

english: Oh my poor bank, how will I store all those?!
translation: 哦，我可怜的银行，我将如何存储所有这些？！ [o ， wo ke lian de yin hang ， wo jiang ru he cun chu suo you zhe xie ？！]

english: Don't you worry, I have just the thing here, a bolt pouch designed specially for holding 4 different types of crossbow bolt.
translation: 别担心，我这里有一个东西，一个专为容纳 4 种不同类型的弩箭而设计的弩箭袋。 [bie dan xin ， wo zhe li you yi ge dong xi ， yi ge zhuan wei rong na  4  zhong bu tong lei xing de nu jian er she ji de nu jian dai 。]

english: Wow, how much?
translation: 哇，多少钱？ [wa ， duo shao qian ？]

english: Hmm... didn't I see you down here buying one the other day? You can only have one at a time I'm afraid.
translation: 嗯...前几天我没看到你在这里买了一件吗？恐怕你一次只能拥有一个。 [n ... qian ji tian wo mei kan dao ni zai zhe li mai le yi jian ma ？ kong pa ni yi ci zhi neng yong you yi ge 。]

english: Well let's see now... for you? 1500 gold pieces should do the trick.
translation: 好吧，现在让我们看看...适合你吗？ 1500金币就可以了。 [hao ba ， xian zai rang wo men kan kan ... shi he ni ma ？ 1500 jin bi jiu ke yi le 。]

english: Yes I'll pay the 1500gp.
translation: 是的，我会支付 1500gp。 [shi de ， wo hui zhi fu  1500gp。]

english: Hand it over then.
translation: 那就交出来吧。 [na jiu jiao chu lai ba 。]

english: Oh, I don't have that much on me.
translation: 哦，我身上没有那么多。 [o ， wo shen shang mei you na me duo 。]

english: Best go make some money then, shouldn't take you too long.
translation: 最好先去赚点钱，不会花太长时间的。 [zui hao xian qu zhuan dian qian ， bu hui hua tai zhang shi jian de 。]

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
translation: 嘿！把你的手拿开！ [hei ！ ba ni de shou na kai ！]

english: Halt, thief!
translation: 站住，小偷！ [zhan zhu ， xiao tou ！]

english: Guards, catch that thief!
translation: 警卫们，抓住那个小偷！ [jing wei men ， zhua zhu na ge xiao tou ！]

english: How do I make one for myself?
translation: 我如何为自己制作一个？ [wo ru he wei zi ji zhi zuo yi ge ？]

english: What about magic logs?
translation: 魔法日志呢？ [mo fa ri zhi ne ？]

english: Thanks for telling me. Bye!
translation: 谢谢你告诉我。再见！ [xie xie ni gao su wo 。 zai jian ！]

english: What about ammo?
translation: 弹药呢？ [dan yao ne ？]

english: Yes I'll pay the 1500gp.
translation: 是的，我会支付 1500gp。 [shi de ， wo hui zhi fu  1500gp。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: What's through those broken bars?
translation: 那些断掉的铁条里有什么？ [na xie duan diao de tie tiao li you shen me ？]

english: Well, my intrepid friend, through those broken bars lies a most remarkable discovery! I named it Scurrius, The Rat King!
translation: 好吧，我勇敢的朋友，透过那些破碎的栅栏，有一个最了不起的发现！我把它命名为斯库里乌斯，鼠王！ [hao ba ， wo yong gan de peng you ， tou guo na xie po sui de zha lan ， you yi ge zui liao bu qi de fa xian ！ wo ba ta ming ming wei si ku li wu si ， shu wang ！]

english: This is no ordinary rat. It is a magnificent creature of evolution, forged by the unwitting contributions of adventurers who entered its cave.
translation: 这不是普通的老鼠。它是一种伟大的进化生物，是由进入其洞穴的冒险家在不知不觉中做出的贡献而形成的。 [zhe bu shi pu tong de lao shu 。 ta shi yi zhong wei da de jin hua sheng wu ， shi you jin ru qi dong xue de mao xian jia zai bu zhi bu jue zhong zuo chu de gong xian er xing cheng de 。]

english: It absorbed their combat abilities, transforming itself into an obscene monster. Nature's response to intrusion, you might say! How utterly fascinating!
translation: 它吸收了他们的战斗能力，将自己变成了一个淫秽的怪物。你可能会说，这是大自然对入侵的反应！多么令人着迷啊！ [ta xi shou le ta men de zhan dou neng li ， jiang zi ji bian cheng le yi ge yin hui de guai wu 。 ni ke neng hui shuo ， zhe shi da zi ran dui ru qin de fan ying ！ duo me ling ren zhao mi a ！]

english: Ahem, anyway you'll be absolutely fine, of course! Your victory awaits, I'm sure. I shall observe your progress with interest... for science, you know.
translation: 咳咳，无论如何，你当然会没事的！我确信你的胜利正在等待着。我将饶有兴趣地观察你的进步……为了科学，你知道。 [hai hai ， wu lun ru he ， ni dang ran hui mei shi de ！ wo que xin ni de sheng li zheng zai deng dai zhe 。 wo jiang rao you xing qu di guan cha ni de jin bu …… wei le ke xue ， ni zhi dao 。]

english: Oh, and if you happen to come across Scurrius' spine, please bring it to me.
translation: 哦，如果你碰巧发现了斯库里斯的脊椎，请把它带给我。 [o ， ru guo ni peng qiao fa xian le si ku li si de ji zhui ， qing ba ta dai gei wo 。]

english: Excuse me, can you tell me about Scurrius' spine?
translation: 打扰一下，你能告诉我斯库里乌斯的脊柱吗？ [da rao yi xia ， ni neng gao su wo si ku li wu si de ji zhu ma ？]

english: Of course! Scurrius spines are invaluable for my research.
translation: 当然！松鼠的刺对于我的研究来说是无价的。 [dang ran ！ song shu de ci dui yu wo de yan jiu lai shuo shi wu jia de 。]

english: I can use them to craft a potent bone weapon which will aid you when battling the Rat King.
translation: 我可以用它们制作一把强大的骨头武器，在你与鼠王战斗时可以帮助你。 [wo ke yi yong ta men zhi zuo yi ba qiang da de gu tou wu qi ， zai ni yu shu wang zhan dou shi ke yi bang zhu ni 。]

english: Although you can create the weapons yourself, provided you have the required expertise and appropriate materials.
translation: 尽管您可以自己制造武器，但前提是您拥有所需的专业知识和适当的材料。 [jin guan nin ke yi zi ji zhi zao wu qi ， dan qian ti shi nin yong you suo xu de zhuan ye zhi shi he shi dang de cai liao 。]

english: If you don't want a bone weapon, I can also trade you a lamp I found during my research expedition - one for every Scurrius spine you bring to me.
translation: 如果你不想要骨头武器，我也可以用我在研究探险中找到的一盏灯来交换你——你给我带来的每根斯库里乌斯脊柱一盏灯。 [ru guo ni bu xiang yao gu tou wu qi ， wo ye ke yi yong wo zai yan jiu tan xian zhong zhao dao de yi zhan deng lai jiao huan ni —— ni gei wo dai lai de mei gen si ku li wu si ji zhu yi zhan deng 。]

english: Can you make a bone weapon for me please?
translation: 可以给我做一把骨头武器吗？ [ke yi gei wo zuo yi ba gu tou wu qi ma ？]

english: You'll need to bring a Scurrius spine and either a Rune mace, a Yew shortbow, or a Battlestaff. An additional 1000 chaos runes are needed if you want to create a Bone staff.
translation: 你需要带上斯库里乌斯脊椎和符文狼牙棒、紫杉短弓或战杖。如果你想制作骨杖，还需要 1000 个混沌符文。 [ni xu yao dai shang si ku li wu si ji zhui he fu wen lang ya bang 、 zi shan duan gong huo zhan zhang 。 ru guo ni xiang zhi zuo gu zhang ， hai xu yao  1000  ge hun dun fu wen 。]

english: I'll also charge 50,000 coins to craft the weapon.
translation: 我还将收取 50,000 金币来制作武器。 [wo hai jiang shou qu  50,000  jin bi lai zhi zuo wu qi 。]

english: Come back when you have all the necessary materials.
translation: 当你拥有所有必要的材料时再回来。 [dang ni yong you suo you bi yao de cai liao shi zai hui lai 。]

english: Okay, I'll make you the Bone mace.
translation: 好吧，我给你做骨头狼牙棒。 [hao ba ， wo gei ni zuo gu tou lang ya bang 。]

english: Okay, I'll make you the Bone shortbow.
translation: 好吧，我会给你做骨头短弓。 [hao ba ， wo hui gei ni zuo gu tou duan gong 。]

english: Okay, I'll make you the Bone staff.
translation: 好吧，我会让你成为骨头员工。 [hao ba ， wo hui rang ni cheng wei gu tou yuan gong 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Ah, a Scurrius spine! A captivating subject indeed. I'll eagerly take them off your hands, and rest assured, you will be well rewarded.
translation: 啊，斯卡略脊柱！确实是一个令人着迷的主题。我会急切地把它们从你手中夺走，放心，你会得到丰厚的回报。 [a ， si ka lve ji zhu ！ que shi shi yi ge ling ren zhao mi de zhu ti 。 wo hui ji qie di ba ta men cong ni shou zhong duo zou ， fang xin ， ni hui de dao feng hou de hui bao 。]

english: Ah, I'll need one of Scurrius' spines to do that. Perhaps you could fetch me one?
translation: 啊，我需要斯库里乌斯的一根脊椎才能做到这一点。也许你可以给我拿一份？ [a ， wo xu yao si ku li wu si de yi gen ji zhui cai neng zuo dao zhe yi dian 。 ye xu ni ke yi gei wo na yi fen ？]

english: What's through those broken bars?
translation: 那些断掉的铁条里有什么？ [na xie duan diao de tie tiao li you shen me ？]

english: Can you tell me about Scurrius' spine?
translation: 你能告诉我斯库里斯的脊柱吗？ [ni neng gao su wo si ku li si de ji zhu ma ？]

english: Can you make a bone weapon for me please?
translation: 可以给我做一把骨头武器吗？ [ke yi gei wo zuo yi ba gu tou wu qi ma ？]

english: Bone mace.
translation: 骨头狼牙棒。 [gu tou lang ya bang 。]

english: Bone shortbow.
translation: 骨短弓。 [gu duan gong 。]

english: Bone staff.
translation: 骨杖。 [gu zhang 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Weapon.
translation: 武器。 [wu qi 。]

english: Combat lamp.
translation: 战斗灯。 [zhan dou deng 。]

english: Hello. What are you doing here?
translation: 你好。你在这里做什么？ [ni hao 。 ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Duffy's the name. I'm a natural historian from Varrock Museum. My team and I are here to explore this mountain.
translation: 达菲这个名字我是瓦罗克博物馆的自然历史学家。我和我的团队来这里探索这座山。 [da fei zhe ge ming zi wo shi wa luo ke bo wu guan de zi ran li shi xue jia 。 wo he wo de tuan dui lai zhe li tan suo zhe zuo shan 。]

english: It's just an old mountain isn't it? What natural history are you hoping to find here?
translation: 这只是一座古老的山不是吗？您希望在这里找到什么自然历史？ [zhe zhi shi yi zuo gu lao de shan bu shi ma ？ nin xi wang zai zhe li zhao dao shen me zi ran li shi ？]

english: Bahaha, you adventurers are all the same, never seeing past the fights and treasure...
translation: 哈哈哈，你们冒险家都一样，从来没有见过战斗和宝藏…… [ha ha ha ， ni men mao xian jia dou yi yang ， cong lai mei you jian guo zhan dou he bao zang ……]

english: This Mountain is steeped in natural history, but our main focus is to study the lizard creatures that surround this area.
translation: 这座山充满了自然历史，但我们的主要重点是研究该地区周围的蜥蜴生物。 [zhe zuo shan chong man le zi ran li shi ， dan wo men de zhu yao zhong dian shi yan jiu gai di qu zhou wei de xi yi sheng wu 。]

english: You're studying lizardmen?
translation: 你在研究蜥蜴人吗？ [ni zai yan jiu xi yi ren ma ？]

english: Indeed, they're a fascinating species! We're hoping to learn about their origins and how they've evolved.
translation: 确实，它们是一个令人着迷的物种！我们希望了解它们的起源以及它们是如何进化的。 [que shi ， ta men shi yi ge ling ren zhao mi de wu zhong ！ wo men xi wang liao jie ta men de qi yuan yi ji ta men shi ru he jin hua de 。]

english: However, we're not very familiar with this region so we've enlisted the help of the Kourend Grand Library to aid us in our research.
translation: 然而，我们对这个地区不是很熟悉，所以我们寻求库伦德大图书馆的帮助来帮助我们进行研究。 [ran er ， wo men dui zhe ge di qu bu shi hen shu xi ， suo yi wo men xun qiu ku lun de da tu shu guan de bang zhu lai bang zhu wo men jin xing yan jiu 。]

english: What have you learned so far?
translation: 到目前为止你学到了什么？ [dao mu qian wei zhi ni xue dao le shen me ？]

english: Well, we have a theory that lizard creatures aren't natural at all, but were created by dark magical experiments.
translation: 嗯，我们有一个理论，蜥蜴生物根本不是自然的，而是由黑暗魔法实验创造的。 [n ， wo men you yi ge li lun ， xi yi sheng wu gen ben bu shi zi ran de ， er shi you hei an mo fa shi yan chuang zao de 。]

english: Right now we're looking for evidence to prove this theory, but's it's proving somewhat difficult.
translation: 现在我们正在寻找证据来证明这一理论，但事实证明这有些困难。 [xian zai wo men zheng zai xun zhao zheng ju lai zheng ming zhe yi li lun ， dan shi shi zheng ming zhe you xie kun nan 。]

english: Can I help at all?
translation: 我能帮忙吗？ [wo neng bang mang ma ？]

english: No thanks adventurer, natural history studies are delicate and precise... but if we ever need something haphazardly destroyed we'll let you know.
translation: 不，谢谢冒险家，自然历史研究是微妙而精确的……但如果我们需要随意摧毁一些东西，我们会让你知道。 [bu ， xie xie mao xian jia ， zi ran li shi yan jiu shi wei miao er jing que de …… dan ru guo wo men xu yao sui yi cui hui yi xie dong xi ， wo men hui rang ni zhi dao 。]

english: Not all adventurers only care about fighting, you know... I was only offering to help.
translation: 并不是所有的冒险家都只关心战斗，你知道的……我只是提供帮助。 [bing bu shi suo you de mao xian jia dou zhi guan xin zhan dou ， ni zhi dao de …… wo zhi shi ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: We don't need your help. Run along now, go and play in the dungeons with the other adventurers. I hear they're full of monsters to fight!
translation: 我们不需要你的帮助。现在就跑吧，去地牢里和其他冒险家一起玩吧。我听说他们到处都是怪物要战斗！ [wo men bu xu yao ni de bang zhu 。 xian zai jiu pao ba ， qu di lao li he qi ta mao xian jia yi qi wan ba 。 wo ting shuo ta men dao chu dou shi guai wu yao zhan dou ！]

english: Try not to get yourself killed, it would be such a tragedy!
translation: 尽量不要让自己丧命，那将是一场悲剧！ [jin liang bu yao rang zi ji sang ming ， na jiang shi yi chang bei ju ！]

english: How are things going?
translation: 进展如何？ [jin zhan ru he ？]

english: Good thanks. Now that we've found this cave, we're learning more about the lizardmen than ever before.
translation: 很好，谢谢。现在我们找到了这个洞穴，我们对蜥蜴人的了解比以往任何时候都多。 [hen hao ， xie xie 。 xian zai wo men zhao dao le zhe ge dong xue ， wo men dui xi yi ren de liao jie bi yi wang ren he shi hou dou duo 。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Hello there, welcome to Varrock Museum! Can I help you?
translation: 您好，欢迎来到瓦罗克博物馆！我可以帮你吗？ [nin hao ， huan ying lai dao wa luo ke bo wu guan ！ wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: Tell me about the Museum.
translation: 跟我说说博物馆吧。 [gen wo shuo shuo bo wu guan ba 。]

english: Well, as you can see we have recently expanded a great deal to cope with the influx of finds from the Dig Site. Also, of course, to prepare for the new dig we're opening soon.
translation: 嗯，正如您所看到的，我们最近进行了大量扩展，以应对挖掘现场大量发现的情况。当然，也是为了为我们即将开放的新挖掘场做准备。 [n ， zheng ru nin suo kan dao de ， wo men zui jin jin xing le da liang kuo zhan ， yi ying dui wa jue xian chang da liang fa xian de qing kuang 。 dang ran ， ye shi wei le wei wo men ji jiang kai fang de xin wa jue chang zuo zhun bei 。]

english: Tell me about the new dig.
translation: 告诉我有关新挖掘的事情。 [gao su wo you guan xin wa jue de shi qing 。]

english: Well, we recently had a large chunk of funds donated to us, so we sent out all sorts of explorers - I'm sure you'll meet them as you go around the world. People like Simon down in the desert near the pyramid as well
translation: 嗯，最近我们收到了一大笔资金捐赠给我们，所以我们派出了各种各样的探险家 - 我相信当你环游世界时你会遇到他们。像西蒙这样的人也在金字塔附近的沙漠里 [n ， zui jin wo men shou dao le yi da bi zi jin juan zeng gei wo men ， suo yi wo men pai chu le ge zhong ge yang de tan xian jia  -  wo xiang xin dang ni huan you shi jie shi ni hui yu dao ta men 。 xiang xi meng zhe yang de ren ye zai jin zi ta fu jin de sha mo li]

english: as Aristarchus in Pollnivneach, Varmen and, of course, Anna Jones. Anyway, we think we have discovered an island that has massive archaeological significance. We can't say much beyond that at this point, as we haven't
translation: 《波尼尼奇》中的阿里斯塔克斯、瓦尔门，当然还有安娜·琼斯。不管怎样，我们认为我们发现了一个具有巨大考古意义的岛屿。目前我们不能说太多，因为我们还没有 [《 bo ni ni qi 》 zhong de a li si ta ke si 、 wa er men ， dang ran hai you an na · qiong si 。 bu guan zen yang ， wo men ren wei wo men fa xian le yi ge ju you ju da kao gu yi yi de dao yu 。 mu qian wo men bu neng shuo tai duo ， yin wei wo men hai mei you]

english: researched it. If you have the qualifications and help us out around the museum, I'm sure we could offer you a place on the dig when we're ready to go.
translation: 研究了一下。如果您有资格并帮助我们参观博物馆，我相信当我们准备好出发时，我们可以为您提供一个挖掘位置。 [yan jiu le yi xia 。 ru guo nin you zi ge bing bang zhu wo men can guan bo wu guan ， wo xiang xin dang wo men zhun bei hao chu fa shi ， wo men ke yi wei nin ti gong yi ge wa jue wei zhi 。]

english: That would be very nice.
translation: 那太好了。 [na tai hao le 。]

english: I have some information that might be of use in your displays.
