translation: 我有一些信息可能对您的展示有用。 [wo you yi xie xin xi ke neng dui nin de zhan shi you yong 。]

english: That's grand! We're always glad to have more facts. Now, tell me what you know...
translation: 太棒了！我们总是很高兴了解更多事实。现在，告诉我你知道什么…… [tai bang le ！ wo men zong shi hen gao xing liao jie geng duo shi shi 。 xian zai ， gao su wo ni zhi dao shen me ……]

english: Well, I recently defeated Delrith, a demon! I did it by using a sword called Silverlight, which is apparently the only sword that could do it. I can give you a description if you want?
translation: 嗯，我最近打败了恶魔德里斯！我通过使用名为 Silverlight 的剑来做到这一点，这显然是唯一可以做到这一点的剑。如果你愿意的话我可以给你描述一下？ [n ， wo zui jin da bai le e mo de li si ！ wo tong guo shi yong ming wei  Silverlight  de jian lai zuo dao zhe yi dian ， zhe xian ran shi wei yi ke yi zuo dao zhe yi dian de jian 。 ru guo ni yuan yi de hua wo ke yi gei ni miao shu yi xia ？]

english: Delrith! Incredible! I am grateful to you for letting me know. Please tell me more about Silverlight and I'll get a display erected. Display number 25, 5th Age, year 20.
translation: 德里斯！极好的！我很感谢你让我知道。请告诉我更多有关 Silverlight 的信息，我会安装一个显示器。显示编号 25，第五纪元，20 年。 [de li si ！ ji hao de ！ wo hen gan xie ni rang wo zhi dao 。 qing gao su wo geng duo you guan  Silverlight  de xin xi ， wo hui an zhuang yi ge xian shi qi 。 xian shi bian hao  25， di wu ji yuan ，20  nian 。]

english: Well, I infiltrated one of the gangs here in Varrock...
translation: 嗯，我潜入了瓦罗克的一个帮派…… [n ， wo qian ru le wa luo ke de yi ge bang pai ……]

english: We have gangs?
translation: 我们有帮派吗？ [wo men you bang pai ma ？]

english: Erm, yes...anyway, I managed to get half the shield back.
translation: 嗯，是的……总之，我成功拿回了一半的护盾。 [n ， shi de …… zong zhi ， wo cheng gong na hui le yi ban de hu dun 。]

english: Only half?
translation: 只有一半？ [zhi you yi ban ？]

english: Yes. The gangs had a bit of a tiff, you see. A friend helped me get the other half and I returned it here to get my reward.
translation: 是的。你看，帮派之间有点争执。一个朋友帮我拿到了另一半，我把它还在这里以获得我的奖励。 [shi de 。 ni kan ， bang pai zhi jian you dian zheng zhi 。 yi ge peng you bang wo na dao le ling yi ban ， wo ba ta hai zai zhe li yi huo de wo de jiang li 。]

english: Yes, yes, we were most pleased to have the shield returned - as was the King, I imagine. This is wonderful news, I shall make sure the display is updated at once! Display number 24, 5th Age, year 700-800.
translation: 是的，是的，我们非常高兴盾牌归还——我想国王也是如此。这是个好消息，我将确保立即更新显示！显示编号 24，第 5 纪元，700-800 年。 [shi de ， shi de ， wo men fei chang gao xing dun pai gui huan —— wo xiang guo wang ye shi ru ci 。 zhe shi ge hao xiao xi ， wo jiang que bao li ji geng xin xian shi ！ xian shi bian hao  24， di  5  ji yuan ，700-800  nian 。]

english: Oh, and before I forget, we found this old lamp lying around...and since you've done such a sterling job, we'd like you to have it.
translation: 哦，在我忘记之前，我们发现这盏旧灯就在附近……既然你做得这么出色，我们希望你能拥有它。 [o ， zai wo wang ji zhi qian ， wo men fa xian zhe zhan jiu deng jiu zai fu jin …… ji ran ni zuo de zhe me chu se ， wo men xi wang ni neng yong you ta 。]

english: Oh, random bits of tat, thank you very much.
translation: 哦，随机的一点点，非常感谢。 [o ， sui ji de yi dian dian ， fei chang gan xie 。]

english: You're welcome!
translation: 不客气！ [bu ke qi ！]

english: You receive an old lamp.
translation: 您收到一盏旧灯。 [nin shou dao yi zhan jiu deng 。]

english: I helped the Order of Wizards rediscover how to access the Rune Essence Mine.
translation: 我帮助巫师团重新发现了如何进入符文精华矿。 [wo bang zhu wu shi tuan chong xin fa xian le ru he jin ru fu wen jing hua kuang 。]

english: Ah, I heard about that. Tell me more.
translation: 啊，我听说过。告诉我更多。 [a ， wo ting shuo guo 。 gao su wo geng duo 。]

english: Hmm. I can't tell you much, but I do know that this mine is hidden away. You can only get there by teleportation.
translation: 唔。我不能告诉你太多，但我确实知道这个矿藏得很隐蔽。你只能通过传送到达那里。 [wu 。 wo bu neng gao su ni tai duo ， dan wo que shi zhi dao zhe ge kuang cang de hen yin bi 。 ni zhi neng tong guo chuan song dao da na li 。]

english: Sounds like magic to me! I'll get a display put up immediately. Display number 21, the first display of the 5th Age.
translation: 对我来说听起来像魔法！我会立即布置一个显示器。显示器编号 21，第五纪元的第一个显示器。 [dui wo lai shuo ting qi lai xiang mo fa ！ wo hui li ji bu zhi yi ge xian shi qi 。 xian shi qi bian hao  21， di wu ji yuan de di yi ge xian shi qi 。]

english: I helped to rebuild the Observatory near Ardougne. I had to fight to do it, and learn how to use the telescope too. I can draw you a diagram of the Observatory if it would help.
translation: 我帮助重建了阿杜涅附近的天文台。我必须努力做到这一点，并学习如何使用望远镜。如果有帮助的话我可以给你画一张天文台的图。 [wo bang zhu chong jian le a du nie fu jin de tian wen tai 。 wo bi xu nu li zuo dao zhe yi dian ， bing xue xi ru he shi yong wang yuan jing 。 ru guo you bang zhu de hua wo ke yi gei ni hua yi zhang tian wen tai de tu 。]

english: That would help immensely. Restored it, eh? And it works, you say? Excellent, perhaps we can get to some real stargazing now! Display number 17, 5th Age, year 70.
translation: 这会有很大帮助。恢复了吧？你说它有效吗？太好了，也许我们现在可以进行真正的观星活动了！显示编号 17，第五纪元，70 年。 [zhe hui you hen da bang zhu 。 hui fu le ba ？ ni shuo ta you xiao ma ？ tai hao le ， ye xu wo men xian zai ke yi jin xing zhen zheng de guan xing huo dong le ！ xian shi bian hao  17， di wu ji yuan ，70  nian 。]

english: I helped to free the wizard, Merlin, by using Excalibur...
translation: 我使用 Excalibur 帮助释放了巫师梅林…… [wo shi yong  Excalibur  bang zhu shi fang le wu shi mei lin ……]

english: Is that some kind of spell?
translation: 这是某种咒语吗？ [zhe shi mou zhong zhou yu ma ？]

english: No, it's a sword. King Arthur's sword.
translation: 不，这是一把剑。亚瑟王的剑。 [bu ， zhe shi yi ba jian 。 ya se wang de jian 。]

english: What kingdom does he rule then?
translation: 那么他统治着哪个王国呢？ [na me ta tong zhi zhe na ge wang guo ne ？]

english: Britain...
translation: 英国... [ying guo ...]

english: Where on Gielinor is that?
translation: 那是在吉林诺的什么地方？ [na shi zai ji lin nuo de shen me di fang ？]

english: It's not! That's what I've been trying to tell you. I found that King Arthur and his knights are really biding their time here in Gielinor until they are called back to their own world, when they are needed!
translation: 它不是！这就是我一直想告诉你的。我发现亚瑟王和他的骑士们真的在吉林诺等待时机，直到需要他们的时候被召回自己的世界！ [ta bu shi ！ zhe jiu shi wo yi zhi xiang gao su ni de 。 wo fa xian ya se wang he ta de qi shi men zhen de zai ji lin nuo deng dai shi ji ， zhi dao xu yao ta men de shi hou bei zhao hui zi ji de shi jie ！]

english: That's amazing! So he's really from another world! Well, this is interesting, I'll make sure a display is put up immediately. Well done, [player name]! Display number 9, 5th Age, year 132.
translation: 太棒了！所以他真的是来自另一个世界！嗯，这很有趣，我会确保立即进行展示。干得好，[玩家姓名]！显示编号 9，第五纪元，132 年。 [tai bang le ！ suo yi ta zhen de shi lai zi ling yi ge shi jie ！ n ， zhe hen you qu ， wo hui que bao li ji jin xing zhan shi 。 gan de hao ，[ wan jia xing ming ]！ xian shi bian hao  9， di wu ji yuan ，132  nian 。]

english: I helped to save the gnomes' Grand Tree!
translation: 我帮助拯救了侏儒的大树！ [wo bang zhu zheng jiu le zhu ru de da shu ！]

english: Oh? You mean those little green fellows with their gliders?
translation: 哦？你是说那些带着滑翔机的绿色小家伙吗？ [o ？ ni shi shuo na xie dai zhe hua xiang ji de lv se xiao jia huo ma ？]

english: Yes. I uncovered this nasty character called Glough and ended up being ambushed by a black demon...
translation: 是的。我发现了这个叫格洛的邪恶角色，结果遭到了黑色恶魔的伏击…… [shi de 。 wo fa xian le zhe ge jiao ge luo de xie e jue se ， jie guo zao dao le hei se e mo de fu ji ……]

english: A black demon! How did you survive!?
translation: 黑色恶魔！你是怎么活下来的！？ [hei se e mo ！ ni shi zen me huo xia lai de ！？]

english: Oh, I was fine. After the demon it was downhill all the way, and King Narnode allowed me to use the mine under the Tree, and free passage on gnome gliders.
translation: 哦，我很好。过了恶魔之后，一路都是下坡路，纳诺德国王允许我使用树下的地雷，并允许侏儒滑翔机自由通行。 [o ， wo hen hao 。 guo le e mo zhi hou ， yi lu dou shi xia po lu ， na nuo de guo wang yun xu wo shi yong shu xia de di lei ， bing yun xu zhu ru hua xiang ji zi you tong xing 。]

english: You mean that those flimsy things can fly with more than a gnome in? That is unexpected. I shall update the display immediately. Display number 10, upstairs in the middle of the room!
translation: 你的意思是那些脆弱的东西比侏儒还可以飞？这是出乎意料的。我将立即更新显示。显示数字 10，在楼上房间中间！ [ni de yi si shi na xie cui ruo de dong xi bi zhu ru hai ke yi fei ？ zhe shi chu hu yi liao de 。 wo jiang li ji geng xin xian shi 。 xian shi shu zi  10， zai lou shang fang jian zhong jian ！]

english: Some disturbing and heroic news from Morytania, concerning the River Salve and the Temple Knights.
translation: 来自莫里塔尼亚的一些令人不安的英雄消息，涉及萨尔维河和圣殿骑士团。 [lai zi mo li ta ni ya de yi xie ling ren bu an de ying xiong xiao xi ， she ji sa er wei he he sheng dian qi shi tuan 。]

english: Ahh, the Temple Knights...little is known of them.
translation: 啊，圣殿骑士团……人们对他们知之甚少。 [a ， sheng dian qi shi tuan …… ren men dui ta men zhi zhi shen shao 。]

english: Yes, it seems that these seven knights drove back the nasty things coming out of Morytania, and Saradomin blessed the Salve to stop them getting back.
translation: 是的，看来这七位骑士击退了来自莫里塔尼亚的讨厌的东西，而萨拉多明祝福了药膏以阻止他们回来。 [shi de ， kan lai zhe qi wei qi shi ji tui le lai zi mo li ta ni ya de tao yan de dong xi ， er sa la duo ming zhu fu le yao gao yi zu zhi ta men hui lai 。]

english: Quite worrying that it's just a bit of water keeping them there, but Saradomin will protect us I've no doubt. Thank you for the information, I'll get a display put up. Display number 23, 4th Age, year 1100-1200.
translation: 非常令人担忧的是，只是一点水让他们留在那里，但我毫不怀疑萨拉多明会保护我们。谢谢你提供的信息，我去拿个显示器。显示编号 23，第四纪，1100-1200 年。 [fei chang ling ren dan you de shi ， zhi shi yi dian shui rang ta men liu zai na li ， dan wo hao bu huai yi sa la duo ming hui bao hu wo men 。 xie xie ni ti gong de xin xi ， wo qu na ge xian shi qi 。 xian shi bian hao  23， di si ji ，1100-1200  nian 。]

english: Some disturbing and heroic news from Morytania concerning the River Salve and the seven priests.
translation: 来自莫里塔尼亚的一些关于萨尔维河和七名牧师的令人不安和英雄的消息。 [lai zi mo li ta ni ya de yi xie guan yu sa er wei he he qi ming mu shi de ling ren bu an he ying xiong de xiao xi 。]

english: Oh?
Yes, it seems that these seven priests were also warriors and drove back the nasty things coming out of Morytania. Then Saradomin blessed the Salve to stop them getting back.
translation: 是的，看来这七名牧师也是战士，将来自莫里塔尼亚的那些讨厌的东西击退了。然后萨拉多明祝福了药膏以阻止他们回来。 [shi de ， kan lai zhe qi ming mu shi ye shi zhan shi ， jiang lai zi mo li ta ni ya de na xie tao yan de dong xi ji tui le 。 ran hou sa la duo ming zhu fu le yao gao yi zu zhi ta men hui lai 。]

english: Quite worrying that it's just a bit of water keeping them there, but Saradomin will protect us, I've no doubt. Thank you for the information, I'll get a display put up. Display number 23, 4th Age, year 1100-1200.
translation: 非常令人担忧的是，只是一点水让他们留在那里，但萨拉多明会保护我们，我毫不怀疑。谢谢你提供的信息，我去拿个显示器。显示编号 23，第四纪，1100-1200 年。 [fei chang ling ren dan you de shi ， zhi shi yi dian shui rang ta men liu zai na li ， dan sa la duo ming hui bao hu wo men ， wo hao bu huai yi 。 xie xie ni ti gong de xin xi ， wo qu na ge xian shi qi 。 xian shi bian hao  23， di si ji ，1100-1200  nian 。]

english: You know Bob the Cat?
translation: 你认识猫鲍勃吗？ [ni ren shi mao bao bo ma ？]

english: The little black cat that used to wander around sometimes? Sure, I remember him.
translation: 以前偶尔闲逛的小黑猫？当然，我记得他。 [yi qian ou er xian guang de xiao hei mao ？ dang ran ， wo ji de ta 。]

english: I found out a lot about his background...turns out he was once human and helped to defeat a dragonkin once!
translation: 我了解了很多关于他的背景……原来他曾经是人类，并且曾经帮助击败过龙族！ [wo liao jie le hen duo guan yu ta de bei jing …… yuan lai ta ceng jing shi ren lei ， bing qie ceng jing bang zhu ji bai guo long zu ！]

english: Dragonkin?
translation: 龙族？ [long zu ？]

english: Tell me more!
translation: 告诉我更多！ [gao su wo geng duo ！]

english: Well, you see, it started when Bob went missing...and involved a big sphinx in Sophanem, the City of the Dead, and me taking care of Unferth...
translation: 好吧，你看，事情是从鲍勃失踪开始的……并涉及死亡之城索法纳姆的一个大狮身人面像，而我则负责照顾恩弗斯…… [hao ba ， ni kan ， shi qing shi cong bao bo shi zong kai shi de …… bing she ji si wang zhi cheng suo fa na mu de yi ge da shi shen ren mian xiang ， er wo ze fu ze zhao gu en fu si ……]

english: This is starting to sound familiar...
translation: 这听起来开始有点熟悉了…… [zhe ting qi lai kai shi you dian shu xi le ……]

english: It must...you know Reldo, the Varrock librarian - he knows all about Robert the Strong.
translation: 一定是……你认识瓦罗克图书管理员雷尔多——他了解强者罗伯特的一切。 [yi ding shi …… ni ren shi wa luo ke tu shu guan li yuan lei er duo —— ta liao jie qiang zhe luo bo te de yi qie 。]

english: You mean that was Bob? Wow... I will get a display erected immediately about the history of this brave warrior. Display number 20, 4th Age, year 1-100.
translation: 你是说那是鲍勃？哇...我会立即竖起一个展览，讲述这位勇敢战士的历史。显示数字 20，第四纪元，1-100 年。 [ni shi shuo na shi bao bo ？ wa ... wo hui li ji shu qi yi ge zhan lan ， jiang shu zhe wei yong gan zhan shi de li shi 。 xian shi shu zi  20， di si ji yuan ，1-100  nian 。]

english: I found out more about King Lathas's ancestors.
translation: 我对拉萨斯国王的祖先有了更多的了解。 [wo dui la sa si guo wang de zu xian you le geng duo de liao jie 。]

english: Oh? I'd be interested to hear this, we have a painting of him upstairs.
translation: 哦？我很想听听这个，我们楼上有一幅他的画。 [o ？ wo hen xiang ting ting zhe ge ， wo men lou shang you yi fu ta de hua 。]

english: Indeed, it turns out that there was a big battle in the year 98 of the 5th Age. One of his ancestors became king because he survived it...
translation: 果然，第五纪元98年，发生了一场大战。他的一位祖先成为国王，因为他幸存下来...... [guo ran ， di wu ji yuan 98 nian ， fa sheng le yi chang da zhan 。 ta de yi wei zu xian cheng wei guo wang ， yin wei ta xing cun xia lai ......]

english: Ahh, is this relating to that small museum near Ardougne?
translation: 啊，这和阿杜涅附近的那个小博物馆有关吗？ [a ， zhe he a du nie fu jin de na ge xiao bo wu guan you guan ma ？]

english: Yes!
translation: 是的！ [shi de ！]

english: Ahh yes, we've been meaning to make a display on that for some time. They sent us some information, too; I'm glad you reminded me, I'll get that done now. Display number 46, 5th Age, year 98.
translation: 啊，是的，我们一直想对此进行展示一段时间了。他们也给我们发了一些信息；很高兴你提醒了我，我现在就去完成这件事。显示编号 46，第五纪元，98 年。 [a ， shi de ， wo men yi zhi xiang dui ci jin xing zhan shi yi duan shi jian le 。 ta men ye gei wo men fa le yi xie xin xi ； hen gao xing ni ti xing le wo ， wo xian zai jiu qu wan cheng zhe jian shi 。 xian shi bian hao  46， di wu ji yuan ，98  nian 。]

english: Well, I was asked to retrieve the Staff of Armadyl, from the Temple of Ikov, by Lucien, but instead, I helped the guardians of the staff and banished Lucien from this plane of existence, so that he could never again return.
translation: 好吧，路西恩要求我从伊科夫神殿取回阿玛迪尔权杖，但相反，我帮助了权杖的守护者，并将路西恩驱逐出了这个存在位面，这样他就再也不能回来了。 [hao ba ， lu xi en yao qiu wo cong yi ke fu shen dian qu hui a ma di er quan zhang ， dan xiang fan ， wo bang zhu le quan zhang de shou hu zhe ， bing jiang lu xi en qu zhu chu le zhe ge cun zai wei mian ， zhe yang ta jiu zai ye bu neng hui lai le 。]

english: I saw the staff and can describe it to you if you want?
translation: 我看到了工作人员，如果您愿意的话可以向您描述一下吗？ [wo kan dao le gong zuo ren yuan ， ru guo nin yuan yi de hua ke yi xiang nin miao shu yi xia ma ？]

english: Well, I was asked to retrieve the Staff of Armadyl, from the Temple of Ikov, by Lucien. When I returned it he grew in power unimaginably. I held the staff and can describe it to you if you want?
translation: 好吧，卢西恩要求我从伊科夫神庙取回阿玛迪尔权杖。当我归还它时，他的权力以难以想象的方式增长。我拿着法杖，如果你愿意的话可以给你描述一下吗？ [hao ba ， lu xi en yao qiu wo cong yi ke fu shen miao qu hui a ma di er quan zhang 。 dang wo gui huan ta shi ， ta de quan li yi nan yi xiang xiang de fang shi zeng zhang 。 wo na zhao fa zhang ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ke yi gei ni miao shu yi xia ma ？]

english: Yes! Please do!
translation: 是的！请这样做！ [shi de ！ qing zhe yang zuo ！]

english: You describe the staff in detail while the historian takes notes.
translation: 您详细描述工作人员，而历史学家则做笔记。 [nin xiang xi miao shu gong zuo ren yuan ， er li shi xue jia ze zuo bi ji 。]

english: That's excellent, I'll get a display put up straight away! Display number 28, end of the 2nd Age.
translation: 太好了，我马上就放一个显示器！显示编号 28，第二纪元结束。 [tai hao le ， wo ma shang jiu fang yi ge xian shi qi ！ xian shi bian hao  28， di er ji yuan jie shu 。]

english: Well, I found out more about the Staff of Armadyl from a ghost. It seems that Zamorak was a mortal when he got hold of the staff, and he used it to, well...spear Zaros, and somehow ended up becoming a god. It was
translation: 好吧，我从一个幽灵那里了解到了更多关于阿玛迪尔权杖的信息。看来萨莫拉克在拿到这根手杖时还是一个凡人，他用它来，呃……刺向扎罗斯，并以某种方式最终成为了神。原来是 [hao ba ， wo cong yi ge you ling na li liao jie dao le geng duo guan yu a ma di er quan zhang de xin xi 。 kan lai sa mo la ke zai na dao zhe gen shou zhang shi hai shi yi ge fan ren ， ta yong ta lai ， e …… ci xiang zha luo si ， bing yi mou zhong fang shi zui zhong cheng wei le shen 。 yuan lai shi]

english: a bit confusing.
translation: 有点混乱。 [you dian hun luan 。]

english: Now that is what you call a story. Tell me more so that I can put it up on the display.
translation: 这就是你所谓的故事。请告诉我更多信息，以便我可以将其显示在屏幕上。 [zhe jiu shi ni suo wei de gu shi 。 qing gao su wo geng duo xin xi ， yi bian wo ke yi jiang qi xian shi zai ping mu shang 。]

english: You recount the tale of the battle between Zaros and Zamorak as you heard it from the ghostly swordsman.
translation: 你从幽灵剑客那里听到了扎罗斯和萨莫拉克之间的战斗故事。 [ni cong you ling jian ke na li ting dao le zha luo si he sa mo la ke zhi jian de zhan dou gu shi 。]

english: This is wonderful, I shall have a display made immediately to go with the staff model. Display number 28, end of the 2nd Age.
translation: 这太棒了，我将立即制作一个与员工模型相匹配的展示。显示编号 28，第二纪元结束。 [zhe tai bang le ， wo jiang li ji zhi zuo yi ge yu yuan gong mo xing xiang pi pei de zhan shi 。 xian shi bian hao  28， di er ji yuan jie shu 。]

english: I discovered the truth behind the Carnillean family fortune!
translation: 我发现了卡尼尔家族财富的真相！ [wo fa xian le ka ni er jia zu cai fu de zhen xiang ！]

english: Oh? Is that the family over near Ardougne?
translation: 哦？那是阿杜涅附近的一家人吗？ [o ？ na shi a du nie fu jin de yi jia ren ma ？]

english: Yes. I got a bit involved in family business...
translation: 是的。我涉足了家族生意... [shi de 。 wo she zu le jia zu sheng yi ...]

english: And?
translation: 和？ [he ？]

english: I found a secret cult in Ardougne and found that the Carnillean family started building the city of Ardougne from a house they'd captured from a Zamorkian lord.
translation: 我在阿杜涅发现了一个秘密邪教，并发现卡尼勒家族开始用他们从萨莫尔克领主手中夺取的房屋建造阿杜涅市。 [wo zai a du nie fa xian le yi ge mi mi xie jiao ， bing fa xian ka ni lei jia zu kai shi yong ta men cong sa mo er ke ling zhu shou zhong duo qu de fang wu jian zao a du nie shi 。]

english: The historian pulls out his writing implements and listens while you explain the whole story....
translation: 历史学家拿出他的书写工具，听你解释整个故事…… [li shi xue jia na chu ta de shu xie gong ju ， ting ni jie shi zheng ge gu shi ……]

english: How exciting, I'll get a display put up immediately. Display number 7, 5th Age, year 7.
translation: 太令人兴奋了，我马上就放一个显示器。显示数字 7，第 5 时代，第 7 年。 [tai ling ren xing fen le ， wo ma shang jiu fang yi ge xian shi qi 。 xian shi shu zi  7， di  5  shi dai ， di  7  nian 。]

english: I discovered a tunnel and a cult of chaos mages here in Varrock!
translation: 我在瓦罗克发现了一条隧道和一群混沌法师！ [wo zai wa luo ke fa xian le yi tiao sui dao he yi qun hun dun fa shi ！]

english: Oh! Whatever can we do!
translation: 哦！我们能做什么就做什么吧！ [o ！ wo men neng zuo shen me jiu zuo shen me ba ！]

english: Calm down, I have arrested the ringleader.
translation: 冷静点，我已经逮捕了头目。 [leng jing dian ， wo yi jing dai bu le tou mu 。]

english: Oh, thank Saradomin for that. So, tell me the story!
translation: 哦，谢谢萨拉多明。那么，告诉我这个故事吧！ [o ， xie xie sa la duo ming 。 na me ， gao su wo zhe ge gu shi ba ！]

english: Well, I met Rat and he asked me to fill his folder, and I got mixed up with Surok....
translation: 好吧，我遇到了 Rat，他让我填写他的文件夹，然后我就和 Surok 搞混了…… [hao ba ， wo yu dao le  Rat， ta rang wo tian xie ta de wen jian jia ， ran hou wo jiu he  Surok  gao hun le ……]

english: A rat asked you to fill a folder?
translation: 一只老鼠让你填一个文件夹？ [yi zhi lao shu rang ni tian yi ge wen jian jia ？]

english: No, no, no - Rat Burgiss. But anyway, it turns out that this cult has been trying to get to the King, but I stopped them.
translation: 不，不，不——拉特·伯吉斯。但无论如何，事实证明这个邪教一直试图接近国王，但我阻止了他们。 [bu ， bu ， bu —— la te · bo ji si 。 dan wu lun ru he ， shi shi zheng ming zhe ge xie jiao yi zhi shi tu jie jin guo wang ， dan wo zu zhi le ta men 。]

english: The historian looks a little overwhelmed, but also skeptical.
translation: 历史学家看起来有点不知所措，但也有些怀疑。 [li shi xue jia kan qi lai you dian bu zhi suo cuo ， dan ye you xie huai yi 。]

english: I don't suppose you have any evidence of this cult?
translation: 我想你没有任何关于这个邪教的证据吧？ [wo xiang ni mei you ren he guan yu zhe ge xie jiao de zheng ju ba ？]

english: Not with me, but there is a book I can get you from the library.
translation: 不在我身边，但我可以从图书馆给你借一本书。 [bu zai wo shen bian ， dan wo ke yi cong tu shu guan gei ni jie yi ben shu 。]

english: That sounds good - bring me that and we'll create a display.
translation: 听起来不错 - 把它带给我，我们将创建一个显示器。 [ting qi lai bu cuo  -  ba ta dai gei wo ， wo men jiang chuang jian yi ge xian shi qi 。]

english: The historian is scribbling furiously on his pad, and finally turns to you.
translation: 历史学家在他的本子上疯狂地写着，最后转向你。 [li shi xue jia zai ta de ben zi shang feng kuang di xie zhe ， zui hou zhuan xiang ni 。]

english: Actually, to save you some writing, I have this book here that has lots of information. You can have it if you want...
translation: 事实上，为了节省你的写作时间，我这里有这本书，里面有很多信息。如果你想要的话，你可以拥有它... [shi shi shang ， wei le jie sheng ni de xie zuo shi jian ， wo zhe li you zhe ben shu ， li mian you hen duo xin xi 。 ru guo ni xiang yao de hua ， ni ke yi yong you ta ...]

english: Why, thank you... Yes, this is a bit of a revelation! I'll get a display put up immediately. Display number 3, 5th Age, year 70.
translation: 为什么，谢谢……是的，这有点启示！我会立即布置一个显示器。显示编号 3，第 5 时代，70 年。 [wei shen me ， xie xie …… shi de ， zhe you dian qi shi ！ wo hui li ji bu zhi yi ge xian shi qi 。 xian shi bian hao  3， di  5  shi dai ，70  nian 。]

english: Well, we got rid of the marauding zombies.
translation: 好吧，我们摆脱了掠夺的僵尸。 [hao ba ， wo men bai tuo le lve duo de jiang shi 。]

english: That's handy. Zombies do tend to leave horrible muddy footprints around the place. So what actually happened with them?
translation: 这很方便。僵尸确实会在周围留下可怕的泥泞脚印。那么他们到底发生了什么？ [zhe hen fang bian 。 jiang shi que shi hui zai zhou wei liu xia ke pa de ni ning jiao yin 。 na me ta men dao di fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: Well, Zemouregal the Mahjarrat sent his zombie army against Varrock. However, we figured out how to stop him.
translation: 好吧，马哈拉特人泽穆雷加尔派遣他的僵尸军队对抗瓦罗克。然而，我们想出了如何阻止他。 [hao ba ， ma ha la te ren ze mu lei jia er pai qian ta de jiang shi jun dui dui kang wa luo ke 。 ran er ， wo men xiang chu le ru he zu zhi ta 。]

english: I found out that the descendant of the founder of Varrock could use the shield to stop the zombie army. It turns out that Dimintheis was that descendant, so he was able to defeat the zombies.
translation: 我发现瓦洛克创始人的后裔可以用盾牌来阻止僵尸大军。原来迪敏泰斯就是那个后裔，所以他才能够打败丧尸。 [wo fa xian wa luo ke chuang shi ren de hou yi ke yi yong dun pai lai zu zhi jiang shi da jun 。 yuan lai di min tai si jiu shi na ge hou yi ， suo yi ta cai neng gou da bai sang shi 。]

english: My, my, that is all very interesting. I shall make sure the display is updated at once! Display number 24, 4th Age, year 700-800.
translation: 我的，我的，这一切都很有趣。我会确保显示立即更新！显示编号 24，第四纪元，700-800 年。 [wo de ， wo de ， zhe yi qie dou hen you qu 。 wo hui que bao xian shi li ji geng xin ！ xian shi bian hao  24， di si ji yuan ，700-800  nian 。]

english: Oh, and before I forget, we found this old lamp lying around. Since you've done such a sterling job, we'd like you to have it.
translation: 哦，在我忘记之前，我们发现这盏旧灯就在附近。既然你已经完成了如此出色的工作，我们希望你能拥有它。 [o ， zai wo wang ji zhi qian ， wo men fa xian zhe zhan jiu deng jiu zai fu jin 。 ji ran ni yi jing wan cheng le ru ci chu se de gong zuo ， wo men xi wang ni neng yong you ta 。]

english: On second thoughts, you seem to have everything I know covered here!
translation: 转念一想，你似乎已经涵盖了我所知道的一切！ [zhuan nian yi xiang ， ni si hu yi jing han gai le wo suo zhi dao de yi qie ！]

english: No matter. I'm sure you'll find more. Look around the Museum, explore the city and maybe do some quests, and I'm sure you'll find out something worth telling.
translation: 不管。我相信你会发现更多。环顾博物馆，探索这座城市，也许做一些任务，我相信你会发现一些值得讲述的东西。 [bu guan 。 wo xiang xin ni hui fa xian geng duo 。 huan gu bo wu guan ， tan suo zhe zuo cheng shi ， ye xu zuo yi xie ren wu ， wo xiang xin ni hui fa xian yi xie zhi de jiang shu de dong xi 。]

english: Yes, I'll go do some quests or something...
translation: 是的，我会去做一些任务什么的... [shi de ， wo hui qu zuo yi xie ren wu shen me de ...]

english: Tell me about other sections of the Museum.
translation: 告诉我博物馆的其他部分。 [gao su wo bo wu guan de qi ta bu fen 。]

english: I'd be delighted to; which areas are you interested in?
translation: 我很乐意；您对哪些领域感兴趣？ [wo hen le yi ； nin dui na xie ling yu gan xing qu ？]

english: Tell me about the Natural History exhibit.
translation: 告诉我有关自然历史展览的信息。 [gao su wo you guan zi ran li shi zhan lan de xin xi 。]

english: Ahh, our newest expansion. The Natural History exhibit in the basement was set up to inform our citizens of the weird and wonderful diversity in our environment today. Indeed, I am sure you will recognise some of
translation: 啊，我们最新的扩展包。地下室的自然历史展览是为了让我们的公民了解当今环境中奇怪而奇妙的多样性。事实上，我相信您会认出其中的一些 [a ， wo men zui xin de kuo zhan bao 。 di xia shi de zi ran li shi zhan lan shi wei le rang wo men de gong min liao jie dang jin huan jing zhong qi guai er qi miao de duo yang xing 。 shi shi shang ， wo xiang xin nin hui ren chu qi zhong de yi xie]

english: the creatures down there. Hopefully, our lectures will teach you some things you didn't know about them!
translation: 下面的生物。希望我们的讲座能教给您一些您不知道的事情！ [xia mian de sheng wu 。 xi wang wo men de jiang zuo neng jiao gei nin yi xie nin bu zhi dao de shi qing ！]

english: So where does the 'history' bit come in?
translation: 那么“历史”部分从何而来呢？ [na me “ li shi ” bu fen cong he er lai ne ？]

english: Ahh, I see. The 'history' refers to that of the species - it doesn't necessarily mean it's died out. After all, we have human history and we're still here!
translation: 啊，我明白了。 “历史”指的是该物种的历史——它并不一定意味着它已经灭绝。毕竟，我们有人类历史，而且我们还在这里！ [a ， wo ming bai le 。 “ li shi ” zhi de shi gai wu zhong de li shi —— ta bing bu yi ding yi wei zhe ta yi jing mie jue 。 bi jing ， wo men you ren lei li shi ， er qie wo men hai zai zhe li ！]

english: I guess that makes sense.
translation: 我想这是有道理的。 [wo xiang zhe shi you dao li de 。]

english: Tell me about the Dig Site exhibit.
translation: 告诉我有关挖掘现场展览的信息。 [gao su wo you guan wa jue xian chang zhan lan de xin xi 。]

english: Ahh, those. We're slowly filling them up with the help of people who have their Earth Sciences exams completed at the Dig Site. If you have, feel free to give us a hand. We'd appreciate it.
translation: 啊，那些。在挖掘现场完成地球科学考试的人们的帮助下，我们正在慢慢地填补这些空缺。如果您有，请随时帮助我们。我们将不胜感激。 [a ， na xie 。 zai wa jue xian chang wan cheng di qiu ke xue kao shi de ren men de bang zhu xia ， wo men zheng zai man man di tian bu zhe xie kong que 。 ru guo nin you ， qing sui shi bang zhu wo men 。 wo men jiang bu sheng gan ji 。]

english: Tell me about the Dig Site find cleaning area.
translation: 告诉我有关挖掘现场寻找清洁区域的信息。 [gao su wo you guan wa jue xian chang xun zhao qing jie qu yu de xin xi 。]

english: The cleaning area, yes. Well, we have some really good archaeologists on site right now. They're cleaning up the finds that are shipped over from the Dig Site to the east of here. If you have the right qualifications, you can help them clean the finds.
translation: 清洁区，是的。嗯，我们现在有一些非常优秀的考古学家在现场。他们正在清理从挖掘场运到这里东边的发现物。如果您有适当的资格，您可以帮助他们清理发现的物品。 [qing jie qu ， shi de 。 n ， wo men xian zai you yi xie fei chang you xiu de kao gu xue jia zai xian chang 。 ta men zheng zai qing li cong wa jue chang yun dao zhe li dong bian de fa xian wu 。 ru guo nin you shi dang de zi ge ， nin ke yi bang zhu ta men qing li fa xian de wu pin 。]

english: What qualifications?
translation: 有什么资格？ [you shen me zi ge ？]

english: Level 3 Earth Science exams. You can take them over at the Exam Centre on the Dig Site.
translation: 3 级地球科学考试。您可以在挖掘现场的考试中心接管它们。 [3  ji di qiu ke xue kao shi 。 nin ke yi zai wa jue xian chang de kao shi zhong xin jie guan ta men 。]

english: Oh, I don't have those.
translation: 哦，我没有那些。 [o ， wo mei you na xie 。]

english: I'm sure you can get them easily enough. Just pop over to the Exam Centre on the Dig Site and speak to one of the examiners there.
translation: 我相信你可以很容易地得到它们。只需前往挖掘现场的考试中心并与那里的一位考官交谈即可。 [wo xiang xin ni ke yi hen rong yi di de dao ta men 。 zhi xu qian wang wa jue xian chang de kao shi zhong xin bing yu na li de yi wei kao guan jiao tan ji ke 。]

english: Oh, I'm already working towards those!
translation: 哦，我已经在朝这些方向努力了！ [o ， wo yi jing zai chao zhe xie fang xiang nu li le ！]

english: That's excellent. Keep up the good work and soon you'll be cleaning finds with the best of them.
translation: 那太好了。继续努力，很快您就会用最好的东西来清理发现的东西。 [na tai hao le 。 ji xu nu li ， hen kuai nin jiu hui yong zui hao de dong xi lai qing li fa xian de dong xi 。]

english: Oh, I already have those!
translation: 哦，我已经有了！ [o ， wo yi jing you le ！]

english: That's excellent. If you feel like helping us out, pop downstairs and clean up some finds for us.
translation: 那太好了。如果您想帮助我们，请下楼为我们清理一些发现的东西。 [na tai hao le 。 ru guo nin xiang bang zhu wo men ， qing xia lou wei wo men qing li yi xie fa xian de dong xi 。]

english: Tell me about the Timeline exhibit.
translation: 告诉我有关时间轴展览的信息。 [gao su wo you guan shi jian zhou zhan lan de xin xi 。]

english: Ahh, my speciality. Being a historian, matters of the past are my passion. Collated on this floor and the one above are just part of my life's work. I am still working on updating and finding out more everyday, so if you find
translation: 啊，我的专长。作为一名历史学家，过去的事情是我的热情所在。这一层楼和上面一层的整理只是我一生工作的一部分。我仍在努力每天更新和了解更多信息，所以如果您发现 [a ， wo de zhuan chang 。 zuo wei yi ming li shi xue jia ， guo qu de shi qing shi wo de re qing suo zai 。 zhe yi ceng lou he shang mian yi ceng de zheng li zhi shi wo yi sheng gong zuo de yi bu fen 。 wo reng zai nu li mei tian geng xin hu le jie geng duo xin xi ， suo yi ru guo nin fa xian]

english: any information on your travels that may be useful, please do let me know.
translation: 关于您的旅行的任何可能有用的信息，请告诉我。 [guan yu nin de lv xing de ren he ke neng you yong de xin xi ， qing gao su wo 。]

english: You can follow the timeline of the history of Gielinor from the creation of the world to the present day, simply by walking around this display. A wondrous journey, I think you'll agree!
translation: 只需绕着这个展览走一圈，您就可以了解吉林诺从创世到今天的历史时间表。一次奇妙的旅程，我想你会同意的！ [zhi xu rao zhe zhe ge zhan lan zou yi quan ， nin jiu ke yi liao jie ji lin nuo cong chuang shi dao jin tian de li shi shi jian biao 。 yi ci qi miao de lv cheng ， wo xiang ni hui tong yi de ！]

english: Wow, that's a lot of information. I'm sure in my travels and quests I'll pick up a few bits of information for you.
translation: 哇，信息量很大。我确信在我的旅行和任务中我会为你收集一些信息。 [wa ， xin xi liang hen da 。 wo que xin zai wo de lv xing he ren wu zhong wo hui wei ni shou ji yi xie xin xi 。]

english: Tell me about the Museum.
translation: 跟我说说博物馆吧。 [gen wo shuo shuo bo wu guan ba 。]

english: Tell me about the new dig.
translation: 告诉我有关新挖掘的事情。 [gao su wo you guan xin wa jue de shi qing 。]

english: I have some information which might be of use in your displays.
translation: 我有一些信息可能对您的展示有用。 [wo you yi xie xin xi ke neng dui nin de zhan shi you yong 。]

english: Tell me about other sections of the Museum.
translation: 告诉我博物馆的其他部分。 [gao su wo bo wu guan de qi ta bu fen 。]

english: Natural History exhibit
translation: 自然历史展览 [zi ran li shi zhan lan]

english: Dig Site exhibit
translation: 挖掘现场展览 [wa jue xian chang zhan lan]

english: Dig Site find cleaning area
translation: 挖掘现场寻找清洁区域 [wa jue xian chang xun zhao qing jie qu yu]

english: Timeline exhibit
translation: 时间轴展览 [shi jian zhou zhan lan]

english: Can you tell me why you're here?
translation: 你能告诉我你为什么来这里吗？ [ni neng gao su wo ni wei shen me lai zhe li ma ？]

english: Of course. I plan to assist the forces of Saradomin who will come to our aid, and fight against the legions of vampyres that infest this foul place. These brave mercenaries shall need a guide.
translation: 当然。我计划协助萨拉多明的军队来援助我们，并与侵扰这个肮脏地方的吸血鬼军团作战。这些勇敢的雇佣兵需要一个向导。 [dang ran 。 wo ji hua xie zhu sa la duo ming de jun dui lai yuan zhu wo men ， bing yu qin rao zhe ge ang zang di fang de xi xue gui jun tuan zuo zhan 。 zhe xie yong gan de gu yong bing xu yao yi ge xiang dao 。]

english: When a guide arrives, I will aid the mercenary by holding their wealth for their eventual return. The mercenary will repay the guide by giving him a token for items which I am holding.
translation: 当向导到达时，我将帮助雇佣兵，保留他们的财富，以供他们最终返回。雇佣兵将用我所持有的物品的代币来回报向导。 [dang xiang dao dao da shi ， wo jiang bang zhu gu yong bing ， bao liu ta men de cai fu ， yi gong ta men zui zhong fan hui 。 gu yong bing jiang yong wo suo chi you de wu pin de dai bi lai hui bao xiang dao 。]

english: I shall give such items to the guide as payment for their services once I'm handed the token.
translation: 一旦我收到代币，我将把这些物品交给导游作为他们服务的报酬。 [yi dan wo shou dao dai bi ， wo jiang ba zhe xie wu pin jiao gei dao you zuo wei ta men fu wu de bao chou 。]

english: What items will you hold?
translation: 您将持有哪些物品？ [nin jiang chi you na xie wu pin ？]

english: Oh, the range of items is very varied. Mercenaries tend to hold raw materials in high esteem and so will deposit those with me. They also seem to be good bartering items.
translation: 噢，物品的范围非常广泛。雇佣兵往往非常尊重原材料，因此会将它们存放在我这里。它们似乎也是很好的物物交换物品。 [o ， wu pin de fan wei fei chang guang fan 。 gu yong bing wang wang fei chang zun zhong yuan cai liao ， yin ci hui jiang ta men cun fang zai wo zhe li 。 ta men si hu ye shi hen hao de wu wu jiao huan wu pin 。]

english: Generally, things like uncooked lobsters, coal, silver bars, bow strings. Things which are useful! Plus the odd tome of experience, which are considered incredibly useful.
translation: 一般来说，像生龙虾、煤炭、银条、弓弦之类的东西。有用的东西！再加上一些奇怪的经验，被认为非常有用。 [yi ban lai shuo ， xiang sheng long xia 、 mei tan 、 yin tiao 、 gong xian zhi lei de dong xi 。 you yong de dong xi ！ zai jia shang yi xie qi guai de jing yan ， bei ren wei fei chang you yong 。]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello friend. What can I do for you?
translation: 朋友你好。我能为你做什么？ [peng you ni hao 。 wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: Could you exchange my tokens for me?
translation: 你能帮我交换代币吗？ [ni neng bang wo jiao huan dai bi ma ？]

english: No need, friend. You can do that yourself.
translation: 不需要，朋友。你可以自己做。 [bu xu yao ， peng you 。 ni ke yi zi ji zuo 。]

english: Do you know what these nail beast nails are used for?
translation: 你知道这些钉兽钉子是做什么用的吗？ [ni zhi dao zhe xie ding shou ding zi shi zuo shen me yong de ma ？]

english: Hmmm, not really sure. They do look disgusting though..oh, actually, I remember some other adventurers taking some of these to Sanfew now...something about being able to make a potion with them.
translation: 嗯，不太确定。不过它们看起来确实很恶心……哦，实际上，我记得其他一些冒险家现在把其中一些带到了桑菲……关于能够用它们制作药剂的事情。 [n ， bu tai que ding 。 bu guo ta men kan qi lai que shi hen e xin …… o ， shi ji shang ， wo ji de qi ta yi xie mao xian jia xian zai ba qi zhong yi xie dai dao le sang fei …… guan yu neng gou yong ta men zhi zuo yao ji de shi qing 。]

english: Ok, so perhaps Sanfew knows then?
translation: 好吧，那么也许 Sanfew 就知道了？ [hao ba ， na me ye xu  Sanfew  jiu zhi dao le ？]

english: Maybe. It's worth a try. Next time you're in Taverley, pop in and ask him. I think I remember some adventurers saying something about a serum though, some sort of potion that can be made with them.
translation: 或许。值得一试。下次你来泰弗利的时候，顺便去问问他。我想我记得一些冒险家说过一些关于血清的事情，某种可以用它们制成的药水。 [huo xu 。 zhi de yi shi 。 xia ci ni lai tai fu li de shi hou ， shun bian qu wen wen ta 。 wo xiang wo ji de yi xie mao xian jia shuo guo yi xie guan yu xue qing de shi qing ， mou zhong ke yi yong ta men zhi cheng de yao shui 。]

english: Of course. These mercenaries are here waiting for someone to take them down to Burgh de Rott. They want to do their bit against the vampyres.
translation: 当然。这些雇佣兵在这里等待有人将他们带到德罗特堡。他们想为对抗吸血鬼尽自己的一份力量。 [dang ran 。 zhe xie gu yong bing zai zhe li deng dai you ren jiang ta men dai dao de luo te bao 。 ta men xiang wei dui kang xi xue gui jin zi ji de yi fen li liang 。]

english: I hold some items for these good hearted souls so that the guide can be recompensed when the job is done.
translation: 我为这些好心人保留了一些物品，以便导游在工作完成后可以得到报酬。 [wo wei zhe xie hao xin ren bao liu le yi xie wu pin ， yi bian dao you zai gong zuo wan cheng hou ke yi de dao bao chou 。]

english: Do you know what these are? Or what they're used for?
translation: 你知道这些是什么吗？或者说它们是用来做什么的？ [ni zhi dao zhe xie shi shen me ma ？ huo zhe shuo ta men shi yong lai zuo shen me de ？]

english: Maybe? It's worth a try. Next time you're in Taverley, pop in and ask him. I think I remember some adventurers saying something about a serum though, some sort of potion that can be made with them.
translation: 或许？值得一试。下次你来泰弗利的时候，顺便去问问他。我想我记得一些冒险家说过一些关于血清的事情，某种可以用它们制成的药水。 [huo xu ？ zhi de yi shi 。 xia ci ni lai tai fu li de shi hou ， shun bian qu wen wen ta 。 wo xiang wo ji de yi xie mao xian jia shuo guo yi xie guan yu xue qing de shi qing ， mou zhong ke yi yong ta men zhi cheng de yao shui 。]

english: Oh well done! Thank you for aiding our citizens.
translation: 哦，干得好！感谢您帮助我们的公民。 [o ， gan de hao ！ gan xie nin bang zhu wo men de gong min 。]

english: Can you tell me why you're here?
translation: 你能告诉我你为什么来这里吗？ [ni neng gao su wo ni wei shen me lai zhe li ma ？]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Could you exchange my tokens for me?
translation: 你能帮我交换代币吗？ [ni neng bang wo jiao huan dai bi ma ？]

english: Do you know what these nail beast nails are used for?
translation: 你知道这些钉兽钉子是做什么用的吗？ [ni zhi dao zhe xie ding shou ding zi shi zuo shen me yong de ma ？]

english: Thank you for all your help in solving the murder.
translation: 感谢您为侦破谋杀案提供的所有帮助。 [gan xie nin wei zhen po mou sha an ti gong de suo you bang zhu 。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: What? Oh, hello. I was deep in thought. Did you want me to show you the prices of weapons and armour?
translation: 什么？哦，你好。我陷入了沉思。你想让我给你看看武器和防具的价格吗？ [shen me ？ o ， ni hao 。 wo xian ru le chen si 。 ni xiang rang wo gei ni kan kan wu qi he fang ju de jia ge ma ？]

english: You seem a bit flustered.
translation: 你看起来有点慌张。 [ni kan qi lai you dian huang zhang 。]

english: Sorry, I'm just deep in thought. I'm waiting for many deals to complete today.
translation: 抱歉，我只是陷入沉思。我正在等待今天完成许多交易。 [bao qian ， wo zhi shi xian ru chen si 。 wo zheng zai deng dai jin tian wan cheng xu duo jiao yi 。]

english: What sort of things are you selling?
translation: 你卖什么类型的东西？ [ni mai shen me lei xing de dong xi ？]

english: Good old weapons and armour! My people - dwarves, you understand - are hoping I can trade with humans.
translation: 好旧的武器和盔甲！我的人民——矮人，你懂的——希望我能与人类进行贸易。 [hao jiu de wu qi he kui jia ！ wo de ren min —— ai ren ， ni dong de —— xi wang wo neng yu ren lei jin xing mao yi 。]

english: It looks like you've come to the right place for that.
translation: 看来您来对地方了。 [kan lai nin lai dui di fang le 。]

english: I have indeed, my friend. Now, can I help you?
translation: 我确实有，我的朋友。现在，我可以帮你吗？ [wo que shi you ， wo de peng you 。 xian zai ， wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: Yes, show me the prices of weapons and armour.
translation: 是的，给我看看武器和盔甲的价格。 [shi de ， gei wo kan kan wu qi he kui jia de jia ge 。]

english: Can you tell me about the bank's auto-charging services?
translation: 您能介绍一下银行的自动扣费服务吗？ [nin neng jie shao yi xia yin hang de zi dong kou fei fu wu ma ？]

english: Hm? Oh, yes. If you don't want to charge your items yourself, you can have the bank attendant do it for you on withdrawal.
translation: 嗯？哦是的。如果您不想自己充值，可以让银行服务员在提款时为您充值。 [n ？ o shi de 。 ru guo nin bu xiang zi ji chong zhi ， ke yi rang yin hang fu wu yuan zai ti kuan shi wei nin chong zhi 。]

english: How do they know how many charges to add?
translation: 他们如何知道要添加多少费用？ [ta men ru he zhi dao yao tian jia duo shao fei yong ？]

english: You can tell them how many you would like for each item. Or if you'd like, I can let them know a minimum threshold for all items.
translation: 您可以告诉他们每件商品您想要多少。或者，如果您愿意，我可以让他们知道所有项目的最低阈值。 [nin ke yi gao su ta men mei jian shang pin nin xiang yao duo shao 。 huo zhe ， ru guo nin yuan yi ， wo ke yi rang ta men zhi dao suo you xiang mu di zui di yu zhi 。]

english: What would you like the withdrawal threshold to be?
translation: 您希望提款门槛是多少？ [nin xi wang ti kuan men kan shi duo shao ？]

english: Your chargeable items will be charged with up to [value] charges on withdrawal. You can edit this value for individual items by toggling 'Bank item options' on in the bank settings menu, and right clicking the item.
translation: 提款时，您的收费项目将被收取最多 [value] 的费用。您可以通过在银行设置菜单中打开“银行项目选项”并右键单击该项目来编辑单个项目的该值。 [ti kuan shi ， nin de shou fei xiang mu jiang bei shou qu zui duo  [value]  de fei yong 。 nin ke yi tong guo zai yin hang she zhi cai dan zhong da kai “ yin hang xiang mu xuan xiang ” bing you jian dan ji gai xiang mu lai bian ji dan ge xiang mu di gai zhi 。]

english: I don't think that's necessary, but thank you for offering.
translation: 我认为没有必要，但谢谢你的提供。 [wo ren wei mei you bi yao ， dan xie xie ni de ti gong 。]

english: Alright then. Where was I...?
translation: 那么好吧。我刚才在哪里……？ [na me hao ba 。 wo gang cai zai na li ……？]

english: I'll leave you alone.
translation: 我会让你独自一人。 [wo hui rang ni du zi yi ren 。]

english: Thank you, I have much on my mind.
translation: 谢谢你，我心里有很多话。 [xie xie ni ， wo xin li you hen duo hua 。]

english: Wow, that's cheap.
translation: 哇，真便宜。 [wa ， zhen pian yi 。]

english: Oh. That didn't sell so well.
translation: 哦。那卖得不太好。 [o 。 na mai de bu tai hao 。]

english: Hmmm. If I spend twenty thousand on that, then...
translation: 嗯。如果我花两万的话... [n 。 ru guo wo hua liang wan de hua ...]

english: Jackpot! I'm in the money now!
translation: 大奖！我现在有钱了！ [da jiang ！ wo xian zai you qian le ！]

english: Hahaha! Trading the likes of which I have never seen.
translation: 哈哈哈！进行我从未见过的交易。 [ha ha ha ！ jin xing wo cong wei jian guo de jiao yi 。]

english: You seem a bit flustered.
translation: 你看起来有点慌张。 [ni kan qi lai you dian huang zhang 。]

english: Yes, show me the prices of weapons and armour.
translation: 是的，给我看看武器和盔甲的价格。 [shi de ， gei wo kan kan wu qi he kui jia de jia ge 。]

english: I'll leave you alone.
translation: 我会让你独自一人。 [wo hui rang ni du zi yi ren 。]

english: Can you tell me about the bank's auto-charging services?
translation: 您能介绍一下银行的自动扣费服务吗？ [nin neng jie shao yi xia yin hang de zi dong kou fei fu wu ma ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: Yes, I'm ok with this.
translation: 是的，我对此表示同意。 [shi de ， wo dui ci biao shi tong yi 。]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
translation: 呜呜呜呜呜呜 [wu wu wu wu wu wu]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: How are you doing?
translation: 你好吗？ [ni hao ma ？]

english: Wait. You can understand me?
translation: 等待。你能理解我吗？ [deng dai 。 ni neng li jie wo ma ？]

english: Yes, I can understand ghosts.
translation: 是的，我能理解鬼魂。 [shi de ， wo neng li jie gui hun 。]

english: Oh how splendid! Every time I come back here I try to talk to people, but no one seems to understand.
translation: 噢，多么美妙啊！每次我回到这里，我都会尝试与人们交谈，但似乎没有人理解。 [o ， duo me mei miao a ！ mei ci wo hui dao zhe li ， wo du hui chang shi yu ren men jiao tan ， dan si hu mei you ren li jie 。]

english: I was telling my friend Bob this the other day in the afterlife. At least he can relate to the struggle of people not understanding.
translation: 前几天我在来世告诉我的朋友鲍勃这件事。至少他能体会到那些不理解的人们的挣扎。 [qian ji tian wo zai lai shi gao su wo de peng you bao bo zhe jian shi 。 zhi shao ta neng ti hui dao na xie bu li jie de ren men de zheng zha 。]

english: That must be frustrating.
translation: 这一定很令人沮丧。 [zhe yi ding hen ling ren ju sang 。]

english: Yes, it really is.
translation: 是的，确实如此。 [shi de ， que shi ru ci 。]

english: Wait a second. Your friend Bob... does he happen to be a cat?
translation: 等一下。你的朋友鲍勃……他碰巧是一只猫吗？ [deng yi xia 。 ni de peng you bao bo …… ta peng qiao shi yi zhi mao ma ？]

english: Why, yes, he is! Do you know Bob?
translation: 为什么，是的，他是！你认识鲍勃吗？ [wei shen me ， shi de ， ta shi ！ ni ren shi bao bo ma ？]

english: I do! How is he doing?
translation: 我愿意！他怎么样？ [wo yuan yi ！ ta zen me yang ？]

english: He's alright, all things considered. He did speak of a human friend he misses though. I suspect that's you.
translation: 考虑到所有事情，他没事。不过他确实谈到了他想念的一位人类朋友。我怀疑那就是你。 [kao lv dao suo you shi qing ， ta mei shi 。 bu guo ta que shi tan dao le ta xiang nian de yi wei ren lei peng you 。 wo huai yi na jiu shi ni 。]

english: I miss him too. Could you tell him I said hi? And tell him I'm sorry he got killed. I wish I could have saved him.
translation: 我也想念他。你能告诉他我打过招呼吗？并告诉他我很抱歉他被杀了。我希望我能救他。 [wo ye xiang nian ta 。 ni neng gao su ta wo da guo zhao hu ma ？ bing gao su ta wo hen bao qian ta bei sha le 。 wo xi wang wo neng jiu ta 。]

english: I will tell him that you miss him. Regarding his death, he said it was necessary, so please don't feel bad about it.
translation: 我会告诉他你想念他。对于他的死，他说这是必要的，所以请不要难过。 [wo hui gao su ta ni xiang nian ta 。 dui yu ta de si ， ta shuo zhe shi bi yao de ， suo yi qing bu yao nan guo 。]

english: Necessary? What do you mean?
translation: 必要的？你是什​​么意思？ [bi yao de ？ ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: He never explained why, only said that it had to be that way.
translation: 他从来没有解释过为什么，只是说事情必须如此。 [ta cong lai mei you jie shi guo wei shen me ， zhi shi shuo shi qing bi xu ru ci 。]

english: What can you tell me about Eve?
translation: 关于伊芙，你能告诉我什么吗？ [guan yu yi fu ， ni neng gao su wo shen me ma ？]

english: Eve? One of the greatest witches I know. Also the oldest person I know. She's been around for practically forever.
translation: 前夕？我认识的最伟大的女巫之一。也是我认识的最年长的人。她几乎已经存在了很久了。 [qian xi ？ wo ren shi de zui wei da de nv wu zhi yi 。 ye shi wo ren shi de zui nian zhang de ren 。 ta ji hu yi jing cun zai le hen jiu le 。]

english: It is said that when she was alive she was a hard working witch, mastering advanced spells at a very young age.
translation: 据说，她生前是一位勤奋的女巫，很小的时候就掌握了高级法术。 [ju shuo ， ta sheng qian shi yi wei qin fen de nv wu ， hen xiao de shi hou jiu zhang wo le gao ji fa shu 。]

english: Unfortunately she died while still a young adult. That's why she looks so young now, despite being centuries old.
translation: 不幸的是，她在年轻时就去世了。这就是为什么她现在看起来如此年轻，尽管她已经有数百岁了。 [bu xing de shi ， ta zai nian qing shi jiu qu shi le 。 zhe jiu shi wei shen me ta xian zai kan qi lai ru ci nian qing ， jin guan ta yi jing you shu bai sui le 。]

english: How can she still be around after all these years?
translation: 这么多年了，她怎么还能存在？ [zhe me duo nian le ， ta zen me hai neng cun zai ？]

english: Like I said, she mastered spells at a very young age. She took some of that magic with her into the afterlife.
translation: 就像我说的，她很小的时候就掌握了咒语。她将一些魔法带到了来世。 [jiu xiang wo shuo de ， ta hen xiao de shi hou jiu zhang wo le zhou yu 。 ta jiang yi xie mo fa dai dao le lai shi 。]

english: The sad truth about Eve is that she spent all her life working and striving to achieve great things.
translation: 关于夏娃的一个可悲的事实是，她一生都在努力工作，以实现伟大的目标。 [guan yu xia wa de yi ge ke bei de shi shi shi ， ta yi sheng dou zai nu li gong zuo ， yi shi xian wei da de mu biao 。]

english: But she never got to relax and appreciate how far she had come. That is why she is so obsessed with partying now.
translation: 但她从未放松下来并欣赏自己已经走了多远。这就是为什么她现在如此沉迷于派对。 [dan ta cong wei fang song xia lai bing xin shang zi ji yi jing zou le duo yuan 。 zhe jiu shi wei shen me ta xian zai ru ci chen mi yu pai dui 。]

english: I understand. That really makes you think, doesn't it.
translation: 我明白。这确实让你思考，不是吗？ [wo ming bai 。 zhe que shi rang ni si kao ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Indeed. Enjoy the moment while you can, because you may not get another. Take it from me, I'm a ghost.
translation: 的确。趁你还可以的时候享受这一刻，因为你可能不会再有另一个了。把它从我身上拿走，我是一个幽灵。 [di que 。 chen ni hai ke yi de shi hou xiang shou zhe yi ke ， yin wei ni ke neng bu hui zai you ling yi ge le 。 ba ta cong wo shen shang na zou ， wo shi yi ge you ling 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: What can you tell me about Eve?
translation: 关于伊芙，你能告诉我什么吗？ [guan yu yi fu ， ni neng gao su wo shen me ma ？]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello m'hearty.
translation: 你好，我的心。 [ni hao ， wo de xin 。]

english: I would like a ride on your boat to the fishing platform.
translation: 我想乘坐你们的船去钓鱼平台。 [wo xiang cheng zuo ni men de chuan qu diao yu ping tai 。]

english: I'm afraid it isn't sea worthy, it's full of holes. To fill the holes I'll need some swamp paste.
translation: 恐怕它不适合出海，它布满了洞。为了填补这些洞，我需要一些沼泽膏。 [kong pa ta bu shi he chu hai ， ta bu man le dong 。 wei le tian bu zhe xie dong ， wo xu yao yi xie zhao ze gao 。]

english: Swamp paste?
translation: 沼泽粘贴？ [zhao ze zhan tie ？]

english: Yes, swamp tar mixed with flour and heated over a fire.
translation: 是的，沼泽焦油与面粉混合并在火上加热。 [shi de ， zhao ze jiao you yu mian fen hun he bing zai huo shang jia re 。]

english: Where can I find swamp tar?
translation: 在哪里可以找到沼泽焦油？ [zai na li ke yi zhao dao zhao ze jiao you ？]

english: Unfortunately the only supply of swamp tar is in the swamps below Lumbridge. It's too far for an old man like me to travel.
translation: 不幸的是，沼泽焦油的唯一供应是在朗布里奇下面的沼泽中。对于我这样的老人来说，旅行太远了。 [bu xing de shi ， zhao ze jiao you de wei yi gong ying shi zai lang bu li qi xia mian de zhao ze zhong 。 dui yu wo zhe yang de lao ren lai shuo ， lv xing tai yuan le 。]

english: If you make me some swamp paste I'll give you a ride in my boat.
translation: 如果你给我做一些沼泽糊，我就带你坐我的船。 [ru guo ni gei wo zuo yi xie zhao ze hu ， wo jiu dai ni zuo wo de chuan 。]

english: I'll see what I can do.
translation: 我会看看我能做什么。 [wo hui kan kan wo neng zuo shen me 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Well hello. Beautiful day isn't it.
translation: 嗯，你好。美好的一天不是吗。 [n ， ni hao 。 mei hao de yi tian bu shi ma 。]

english: Not bad I suppose.
translation: 我想还不错。 [wo xiang hai bu cuo 。]

english: Just smell that sea air... beautiful.
translation: 闻一下大海的空气……很美。 [wen yi xia da hai de kong qi …… hen mei 。]

english: Hmm... lovely...
translation: 嗯……可爱…… [n …… ke ai ……]

english: I don't know what to do without my boat.
translation: 我不知道没有船我该怎么办。 [wo bu zhi dao mei you chuan wo gai zen me ban 。]

english: Oh, hello.
translation: 哦，你好。 [o ， ni hao 。]

english: Hello, what's in those boxes?
translation: 你好，请问这些盒子里装的是什么？ [ni hao ， qing wen zhe xie he zi li zhuang de shi shen me ？]

english: Crossbows, are you interested?
translation: 十字弓，你有兴趣吗？ [shi zi gong ， ni you xing qu ma ？]

english: Maybe, are they any good?
translation: 也许，他们有什么好处吗？ [ye xu ， ta men you shen me hao chu ma ？]

english: Are they any good?! They're dwarven engineering at its best!
translation: 他们有什么好处吗？！他们是最优秀的矮人工程学！ [ta men you shen me hao chu ma ？！ ta men shi zui you xiu de ai ren gong cheng xue ！]

english: How do I make one for myself?
translation: 我如何为自己制作一个？ [wo ru he wei zi ji zhi zuo yi ge ？]

english: Well, firstly you'll need to chop yourself some wood, then use a knife on the wood to whittle out a nice crossbow stock like these here.
translation: 好吧，首先你需要给自己砍一些木头，然后用刀在木头上削出像这里这样的漂亮的十字弓枪托。 [hao ba ， shou xian ni xu yao gei zi ji kan yi xie mu tou ， ran hou yong dao zai mu tou shang xue chu xiang zhe li zhe yang de piao liang de shi zi gong qiang tuo 。]

english: Wood fletched into stock... check.
translation: 木头羽毛进入库存......检查。 [mu tou yu mao jin ru ku cun ...... jian cha 。]

english: Then get yourself some metal and a hammer and smith yourself some limbs for the bow, mind that you use the right metals and woods though as some wood is too light to use with some metal and vice versa.
translation: 然后给自己准备一些金属和一把锤子，并为自己打造一些弓肢，请注意使用正确的金属和木材，因为有些木材太轻而无法与某些金属一起使用，反之亦然。 [ran hou gei zi ji zhun bei yi xie jin shu he yi ba chui zi ， bing wei zi ji da zao yi xie gong zhi ， qing zhu yi shi yong zheng que de jin shu he mu cai ， yin wei you xie mu cai tai qing er wu fa yu mou xie jin shu yi qi shi yong ， fan zhi yi ran 。]

english: Which goes with which?
translation: 哪个与哪个搭配？ [na ge yu na ge da pei ？]

english: Wood and Bronze as they're basic materials, Oak and Blurite, Willow and Iron, Steel and Teak, Mithril and Maple, Adamantite and Mahogany and finally Runite and Yew.
translation: 木材和青铜作为基本材料，橡木和蓝铁矿，柳树和铁，钢和柚木，秘银和枫木，精金和桃花心木，最后是符石和红豆杉。 [mu cai he qing tong zuo wei ji ben cai liao ， xiang mu he lan tie kuang ， liu shu he tie ， gang he you mu ， mi yin he feng mu ， jing jin he tao hua xin mu ， zui hou shi fu shi he hong dou shan 。]

english: Ok, so I have my stock and a pair of limbs... what now?
translation: 好吧，我有了我的枪托和一对肢体……现在怎么办？ [hao ba ， wo you le wo de qiang tuo he yi dui zhi ti …… xian zai zen me ban ？]

english: Simply take a hammer and smack the limbs firmly onto the stock. You'll then need a string, only they're not the same as normal bows. You'll need to dry some large animal's meat to get sinew, then spin that on a spinning
translation: 只需拿起一把锤子，将四肢牢牢地敲在枪托上即可。然后你需要一根弦，只是它们与普通的弓不同。你需要干燥一些大型动物的肉来获得肌腱，然后将其放在旋转的机器上旋转 [zhi xu na qi yi ba chui zi ， jiang si zhi lao lao di qiao zai qiang tuo shang ji ke 。 ran hou ni xu yao yi gen xian ， zhi shi ta men yu pu tong de gong bu tong 。 ni xu yao gan zao yi xie da xing dong wu de rou lai huo de ji jian ， ran hou jiang qi fang zai xuan zhuan de ji qi shang xuan zhuan]

english: wheel, it's the only thing we've found to be strong enough for a crossbow.
translation: 轮子，这是我们发现的唯一一个足够坚固的东西来制作十字弓。 [lun zi ， zhe shi wo men fa xian de wei yi yi ge zu gou jian gu de dong xi lai zhi zuo shi zi gong 。]

english: What about magic logs?
translation: 魔法日志呢？ [mo fa ri zhi ne ？]

english: Well.. I don't rightly know... us dwarves don't work with magic, we prefer gold and rock. Much more stable. I guess you could ask the humans at the rangers guild to see if they can do something but I don't want
translation: 嗯……我不太清楚……我们矮人不使用魔法，我们更喜欢黄金和岩石。稳定得多。我想你可以问问游侠公会的人类，看看他们是否可以做点什么，但我不想 [n …… wo bu tai qing chu …… wo men ai ren bu shi yong mo fa ， wo men geng xi huan huang jin he yan shi 。 wen ding de duo 。 wo xiang ni ke yi wen wen you xia gong hui de ren lei ， kan kan ta men shi fou ke yi zuo dian shen me ， dan wo bu xiang]

english: anything to do with it!
translation: 与它有任何关系！ [yu ta you ren he guan xi ！]

english: Thanks for telling me. Bye!
translation: 谢谢你告诉我。再见！ [xie xie ni gao su wo 。 zai jian ！]

english: Take care, straight shooting.
translation: 小心点，直接射击。 [xiao xin dian ， zhi jie she ji 。]

english: What about ammo?
translation: 弹药呢？ [dan yao ne ？]

english: You can smith yourself lots of different bolts, don't forget to flight them with feathers like you do arrows though. You can poison any untipped bolt but there's also the option of tipping them with gems then
translation: 你可以自己锻造很多不同的螺栓，但不要忘记像箭一样用羽毛来飞行它们。你可以对任何未尖头的螺栓下毒，但也可以选择用宝石来尖头它们 [ni ke yi zi ji duan zao hen duo bu tong de luo shuan ， dan bu yao wang ji xiang jian yi yang yong yu mao lai fei xing ta men 。 ni ke yi dui ren he wei jian tou de luo shuan xia du ， dan ye ke yi xuan ze yong bao shi lai jian tou ta men]

english: enchanting them with runes. This can have some pretty powerful effects.
translation: 用符文迷惑他们。这可以产生一些非常强大的效果。 [yong fu wen mi huo ta men 。 zhe ke yi chan sheng yi xie fei chang qiang da de xiao guo 。]

english: Oh my poor bank, how will I store all those?!
translation: 哦，我可怜的银行，我将如何存储所有这些？！ [o ， wo ke lian de yin hang ， wo jiang ru he cun chu suo you zhe xie ？！]

english: Find Hirko in Keldagrim, he also sells crossbow parts and I'm sure he has something you can use to store bolts in.
translation: 在凯尔达格林找到希尔科，他还出售十字弓零件，我确信他有一些可以用来存放弩箭的东西。 [zai kai er da ge lin zhao dao xi er ke ， ta hai chu shou shi zi gong ling jian ， wo que xin ta you yi xie ke yi yong lai cun fang nu jian de dong xi 。]

english: Thanks for the info.
translation: 谢谢你的信息。 [xie xie ni de xin xi 。]

english: How do I make one for myself?
translation: 我如何为自己制作一个？ [wo ru he wei zi ji zhi zuo yi ge ？]

english: What about magic logs?
translation: 魔法日志呢？ [mo fa ri zhi ne ？]

english: Thanks for telling me. Bye!
translation: 谢谢你告诉我。再见！ [xie xie ni gao su wo 。 zai jian ！]

english: What about ammo?
translation: 弹药呢？ [dan yao ne ？]

english: Hi there, you mentioned something about creating monsters...?
translation: 你好，你提到了一些关于创造怪物的事情......？ [ni hao ， ni ti dao le yi xie guan yu chuang zao guai wu de shi qing ......？]

english: Good! I gain know from alchemists and builders. Me make beings.
translation: 好的！我从炼金术士和建筑商那里获得了知识。我造众生。 [hao de ！ wo cong lian jin shu shi he jian zhu shang na li huo de le zhi shi 。 wo zao zhong sheng 。]

english: Interesting. Tell me if I'm right. By the alchemists and builders creating you, you have inherited their combined knowledge in much the same way that a child might inherit the looks of their parents.
translation: 有趣的。告诉我我是否正确。通过炼金术士和建造者创造你，你继承了他们的综合知识，就像孩子继承父母的容貌一样。 [you qu de 。 gao su wo wo shi fou zheng que 。 tong guo lian jin shu shi he jian zao zhe chuang zao ni ， ni ji cheng le ta men de zong he zhi shi ， jiu xiang hai zi ji cheng fu mu de rong mao yi yang 。]

english: Yes, you right!
translation: 是的，你说得对！ [shi de ， ni shuo de dui ！]

english: So what do you need me to do?
translation: 那你需要我做什么？ [na ni xu yao wo zuo shen me ？]

english: Inspect symbol of life altars around dungeon. You see item give. Use item on altar. Activate altar to create, you fight.
translation: 检查地牢周围生命祭坛的象征。你看到物品给了。使用祭坛上的物品。激活祭坛创造，你来战斗。 [jian cha di lao zhou wei sheng ming ji tan de xiang zheng 。 ni kan dao wu pin gei le 。 shi yong ji tan shang de wu pin 。 ji huo ji tan chuang zao ， ni lai zhan dou 。]

english: Okay. Sounds like a challenge.
translation: 好的。听起来像是一个挑战。 [hao de 。 ting qi lai xiang shi yi ge tiao zhan 。]

english: You no haveee the two materials need.
translation: 你不需要这两种材料。 [ni bu xu yao zhe liang zhong cai liao 。]

english: You haveee materials need. Here goes!
translation: 您有需要的材料。开始吧！ [nin you xu yao de cai liao 。 kai shi ba ！]

english: You here for the...stuff?
translation: 你来这里是为了……东西吗？ [ni lai zhe li shi wei le …… dong xi ma ？]

english: What stuff?
translation: 什么东西？ [shen me dong xi ？]

english: Look [miss/pal] I got the goods if you have the cash.
translation: 瞧[小姐/朋友]如果你有现金的话我就收到货了。 [qiao [ xiao jie / peng you ] ru guo ni you xian jin de hua wo jiu shou dao huo le 。]

english: We talkin' the same language yet?
translation: 我们说的是同一种语言吗？ [wo men shuo de shi tong yi zhong yu yan ma ？]

english: What stuff is this again?
translation: 这又是什么东东？ [zhe you shi shen me dong dong ？]

english: The sort of stuff you use in brewing.
translation: 酿造时使用的那种东西。 [niang zao shi shi yong de na zhong dong xi 。]

english: The sort of stuff the Cooking Guild banned last year.
translation: 烹饪协会去年禁止的那种东西。 [peng ren xie hui qu nian jin zhi de na zhong dong xi 。]

english: The sort of stuff that (if added to a vat of brewing ingredients just before the hops) has a higher chance of producin' a mature batch of whatever ale you wanted to make.
translation: 这种东西（如果在啤酒花之前添加到一桶酿造原料中）更有可能生产出一批成熟的啤酒，无论您想生产什么啤酒。 [zhe zhong dong xi （ ru guo zai pi jiu hua zhi qian tian jia dao yi tong niang zao yuan liao zhong ） geng you ke neng sheng chan chu yi pi cheng shu de pi jiu ， wu lun nin xiang sheng chan shen me pi jiu 。]

english: That sort of stuff.
translation: 之类的东西。 [zhi lei de dong xi 。]

english: What was that bit about adding it to something?
translation: 将其添加到某些东西中是什么意思？ [jiang qi tian jia dao mou xie dong xi zhong shi shen me yi si ？]

english: I said, it's the sort of Stuff you add to a brewing vat after you have put the water and barley malt in.
translation: 我说，这是一种在你放入水和大麦麦芽后添加到酿造桶中的东西。 [wo shuo ， zhe shi yi zhong zai ni fang ru shui he da mai mai ya hou tian jia dao niang zao tong zhong de dong xi 。]

english: THEN you add the sort of stuff I'm talking about, followed by the hops and the yeast.
translation: 然后你添加我正在谈论的那种东西，然后是啤酒花和酵母。 [ran hou ni tian jia wo zheng zai tan lun de na zhong dong xi ， ran hou shi pi jiu hua he jiao mu 。]

english: Then, when whatever you are making brews it will have a higher chance of being a mature batch of ale.
translation: 然后，无论你酿造什么，它都有更高的机会成为一批成熟的麦芽酒。 [ran hou ， wu lun ni niang zao shen me ， ta dou you geng gao de ji hui cheng wei yi pi cheng shu de mai ya jiu 。]

english: That clear enough for you or am I going to have to start drawin' pictures on the wall of the hut?
translation: 这对你来说已经足够清楚了，还是我必须开始在小屋的墙上画画？ [zhe dui ni lai shuo yi jing zu gou qing chu le ， hai shi wo bi xu kai shi zai xiao wu de qiang shang hua hua ？]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Then sling yer 'ook!
translation: 然后吊起你的吧！ [ran hou diao qi ni de ba ！]

english: I hear you are the man to talk to about maps.
translation: 我听说你是最适合谈论地图的人。 [wo ting shuo ni shi zui shi he tan lun di tu de ren 。]

english: I might be, you got something for me?
translation: 我可能是，你有东西给我吗？ [wo ke neng shi ， ni you dong xi gei wo ma ？]

english: Like what?
translation: 比如什么？ [bi ru shen me ？]

english: Like...5000 Pieces of Eight?
translation: 比如……5000块八块？ [bi ru ……5000 kuai ba kuai ？]

english: I might have 5000 Pieces of Eight with your name on them if you have a map for me.
translation: 如果你有地图给我的话，我可能有 5000 个八块，上面有你的名字。 [ru guo ni you di tu gei wo de hua ， wo ke neng you  5000  ge ba kuai ， shang mian you ni de ming zi 。]

english: Look, I might have a little something for you for that amount of cash, but I'll have to check.
translation: 听着，我可能会用这笔钱给你一些东西，但我得检查一下。 [ting zhe ， wo ke neng hui yong zhe bi qian gei ni yi xie dong xi ， dan wo de jian cha yi xia 。]

english: You sure you want in on this?
translation: 你确定你想参与这个吗？ [ni que ding ni xiang can yu zhe ge ma ？]

english: Ok, there you go, now try and keep this to yourself, ok?
translation: 好吧，就这样，现在试着把这件事保密，好吗？ [hao ba ， jiu zhe yang ， xian zai shi zhe ba zhe jian shi bao mi ， hao ma ？]

english: Well, no but...
translation: 嗯，不，但是…… [n ， bu ， dan shi ……]

english: Look, you want something or not?
translation: 听着，你想要还是不想要什么？ [ting zhe ， ni xiang yao hai shi bu xiang yao shen me ？]

english: I have no idea what you are talking about.
translation: 我不知道你在说什么。 [wo bu zhi dao ni zai shuo shen me 。]

english: Sorry, no hats allowed. Shove it in the deposit box if you want to play.
translation: 抱歉，不允许戴帽子。如果你想玩的话就把它塞进保险箱里。 [bao qian ， bu yun xu dai mao zi 。 ru guo ni xiang wan de hua jiu ba ta sai jin bao xian xiang li 。]

english: Why not?
translation: 为什么不呢？ [wei shen me bu ne ？]

english: Cos it's one of the rules, you got a problem with rules?
translation: 因为这是规则之一，你对规则有疑问吗？ [yin wei zhe shi gui ze zhi yi ， ni dui gui ze you yi wen ma ？]

english: Yes, I am sort of a pirate after all.
translation: 是的，我毕竟是个海盗。 [shi de ， wo bi jing shi ge hai dao 。]

english: Good answer!
translation: 好答案！ [hao da an ！]

english: But still, no hats. They give you a hat to show what team you are on, and if you got a hat on, it might get nicked, see?
translation: 但仍然没有帽子。他们会给你一顶帽子来表明你属于哪支球队，如果你戴上帽子，帽子可能会被划破，明白吗？ [dan reng ran mei you mao zi 。 ta men hui gei ni yi ding mao zi lai biao ming ni shu yu na zhi qiu dui ， ru guo ni dai shang mao zi ， mao zi ke neng hui bei hua po ， ming bai ma ？]

english: Oh, ok.
translation: 哦，好吧。 [o ， hao ba 。]

english: Might want to dump that stuff yer holdin'.
translation: 可能想把你手里的东西扔掉。 [ke neng xiang ba ni shou li de dong xi reng diao 。]

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你是什​​么意思？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: Well, if you are carrying anything in there, then it might get damaged. Burned up, that kind of thing.
translation: 好吧，如果你在里面携带任何东西，那么它可能会被损坏。烧起来了之类的。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni zai li mian xie dai ren he dong xi ， na me ta ke neng hui bei sun huai 。 shao qi lai le zhi lei de 。]

english: You might want to put it in the bank, nice and safe like.
translation: 你可能想把它存入银行，这样又好又安全。 [ni ke neng xiang ba ta cun ru yin hang ， zhe yang you hao you an quan 。]

english: No cats.
translation: 没有猫。 [mei you mao 。]

english: Are you sure?
translation: 你确定吗？ [ni que ding ma ？]

english: Yep, they might get into the brew, and I know a few pirates that are allergic to them.
translation: 是的，他们可能会喝啤酒，而且我知道一些海盗对他们过敏。 [shi de ， ta men ke neng hui he pi jiu ， er qie wo zhi dao yi xie hai dao dui ta men guo min 。]

english: You cannot take your follower into the game.
translation: 你不能带你的追随者进入游戏。 [ni bu neng dai ni de zhui sui zhe jin ru you xi 。]

english: Hah!
translation: 哈！ [ha ！]

english: This minigame is unavailable on this world.
translation: 这个小游戏在这个世界上是不可用的。 [zhe ge xiao you xi zai zhe ge shi jie shang shi bu ke yong de 。]

english: You a good cook?
translation: 你是个好厨师吗？ [ni shi ge hao chu shi ma ？]

english: Well, not very...
translation: 嗯，不是很... [n ， bu shi hen ...]

english: Then you don't get in. Cooking 40 or over, Cooking Guild regulations, if you catch my drift.
translation: 那你就别进去了。烹饪40岁或以上，烹饪协会规定，如果你明白我的意思的话。 [na ni jiu bie jin qu le 。 peng ren 40 sui huo yi shang ， peng ren xie hui gui ding ， ru guo ni ming bai wo de yi si de hua 。]

english: Hello?
translation: 你好？ [ni hao ？]

english: Huh, who's there?
translation: 呃，谁在那儿？ [e ， shui zai na er ？]

english: It's [player name]. I'm using my magic to communicate to you. Don't worry.
translation: 这是[玩家姓名]。我正在用我的魔法与你交流。不用担心。 [zhe shi [ wan jia xing ming ]。 wo zheng zai yong wo de mo fa yu ni jiao liu 。 bu yong dan xin 。]

english: Well, I'm not sayin' anything to anyone unless they have decent cookin' skills.
translation: 好吧，我不会对任何人说什么，除非他们有不错的烹饪技巧。 [hao ba ， wo bu hui dui ren he ren shuo shen me ， chu fei ta men you bu cuo de peng ren ji qiao 。]

english: I figured, seeing as I can see you over there! I don't make deals like this.
translation: 我想，既然我能在那边看到你！我不做这样的交易。 [wo xiang ， ji ran wo neng zai na bian kan dao ni ！ wo bu zuo zhe yang de jiao yi 。]

english: The sooner you get out of my head the better. So, you here for the... information?
translation: 你越早从我的脑海里消失越好。那么，你来这里是为了……信息吗？ [ni yue zao cong wo de nao hai li xiao shi yue hao 。 na me ， ni lai zhe li shi wei le …… xin xi ma ？]

english: The information?
translation: 信息？ [xin xi ？]

english: Look [miss/pal], you interrupted me for a reason, you must be after something.
translation: 听着[小姐/朋友]，你打断我是有原因的，你一定是在追求什么。 [ting zhe [ xiao jie / peng you ]， ni da duan wo shi you yuan yin de ， ni yi ding shi zai zhui qiu shen me 。]

english: How much time till the next game of Trouble Brewing starts?
translation: 距离下一场 Trouble Brewing 比赛开始还有多久？ [ju li xia yi chang  Trouble Brewing  bi sai kai shi hai you duo jiu ？]

english: Ah, that's information I can help yer with.
translation: 啊，这就是我可以帮助你的信息。 [a ， zhe jiu shi wo ke yi bang zhu ni de xin xi 。]

english: A game is ready to start just as soon as there are enough people.
translation: 一旦有足够的人，游戏就可以开始了。 [yi dan you zu gou de ren ， you xi jiu ke yi kai shi le 。]

english: And how many people are there?
translation: 还有多少人？ [hai you duo shao ren ？]

english: There are [X] people on Dan's team, and [X] on San's. There needs to be one on each in order for a game to start!
translation: Dan 的团队有 [X] 人，San 的团队有 [X] 人。每人都需要有一个才能开始游戏！ [Dan  de tuan dui you  [X]  ren ，San  de tuan dui you  [X]  ren 。 mei ren dou xu yao you yi ge cai neng kai shi you xi ！]

english: Oh, ok. Thanks.
translation: 哦，好吧。谢谢。 [o ， hao ba 。 xie xie 。]

english: Anything else?
translation: 还要别的吗？ [hai yao bie de ma ？]

english: There's a game on at the moment, and another will be starting in [X] minutes time!
translation: 目前有一场比赛正在进行，另一场比赛将在 [X] 分钟后开始！ [mu qian you yi chang bi sai zheng zai jin xing ， ling yi chang bi sai jiang zai  [X]  fen zhong hou kai shi ！]

english: A game has just ended, and another will be starting in [X] minutes time!
translation: 一场比赛刚刚结束，[X] 分钟后另一场比赛将开始！ [yi chang bi sai gang gang jie shu ，[X]  fen zhong hou ling yi chang bi sai jiang kai shi ！]

english: How many people are waiting for a game to start?
translation: 有多少人在等待比赛开始？ [you duo shao ren zai deng dai bi sai kai shi ？]

english: No-one's waiting at the moment. Perhaps you can get some people interested.
translation: 目前没有人在等待。也许你可以让一些人感兴趣。 [mu qian mei you ren zai deng dai 。 ye xu ni ke yi rang yi xie ren gan xing qu 。]

english: Hmmm... maybe.
translation: 嗯……也许吧。 [n …… ye xu ba 。]

english: There [is/are]] [no one/one person/X people] on Dan's team...
translation: Dan 的团队中有[是]][没有人/一个人/X 人]... [Dan  de tuan dui zhong you [ shi ]][ mei you ren / yi ge ren /X  ren ]...]

english: ... and there [is/are]] [no one/one person/X people] on San's team. Anything else?
translation: ... San 的团队中有[是]][没有人/一个人/X 人]。还要别的吗？ [... San  de tuan dui zhong you [ shi ]][ mei you ren / yi ge ren /X  ren ]。 hai yao bie de ma ？]

english: All ready to go, anyone want to join in?
translation: 一切准备就绪，有人想加入吗？ [yi qie zhun bei jiu xu ， you ren xiang jia ru ma ？]

english: Get a move on, these two aim to start in [1-3] minute(s)
translation: 继续前进，这两个人的目标是在 [1-3] 分钟内开始 [ji xu qian jin ， zhe liang ge ren de mu biao shi zai  [1-3]  fen zhong nei kai shi]

english: Yes, I am here for the stuff.
translation: 是的，我是来找东西的。 [shi de ， wo shi lai zhao dong xi de 。]

english: What stuff is this again?
translation: 这又是什么东东？ [zhe you shi shen me dong dong ？]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: I hear you are the man to talk to about maps.
translation: 我听说你是最适合谈论地图的人。 [wo ting shuo ni shi zui shi he tan lun di tu de ren 。]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Yes, what are you selling?
translation: 是的，你卖什么？ [shi de ， ni mai shen me ？]

english: I have no idea what you mean.
translation: 我不知道你的意思。 [wo bu zhi dao ni de yi si 。]

english: How much time till the next game of Trouble Brewing starts?
translation: 距离下一场 Trouble Brewing 比赛开始还有多久？ [ju li xia yi chang  Trouble Brewing  bi sai kai shi hai you duo jiu ？]

english: How many people are waiting for a game to start?
translation: 有多少人在等待比赛开始？ [you duo shao ren zai deng dai bi sai kai shi ？]

english: I have no idea what you're talking about.
translation: 我不知道你在说什么。 [wo bu zhi dao ni zai shuo shen me 。]

english: Good day!
translation: 再会！ [zai hui ！]

english: Can't talk now, I'm on duty.
translation: 现在不能说话，我正在值班。 [xian zai bu neng shuo hua ， wo zheng zai zhi ban 。]

english: Hail, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 万岁，[弗雷曼尼克名字]！ [wan sui ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！]

english: Good day! How are you doing?
translation: 再会！你好吗？ [zai hui ！ ni hao ma ？]

english: Pretty good. It's nice to have a day off from troll- killing duty.
translation: 不错。能从杀戮巨魔的任务中休息一天真是太好了。 [bu cuo 。 neng cong sha lu ju mo de ren wu zhong xiu xi yi tian zhen shi tai hao le 。]

english: Have you killed many trolls?
translation: 你杀过很多巨魔吗？ [ni sha guo hen duo ju mo ma ？]

english: Of course. It's all part of growing up around here. You get used to it.
translation: 当然。这是在这里成长的一部分。你会习惯的。 [dang ran 。 zhe shi zai zhe li cheng zhang de yi bu fen 。 ni hui xi guan de 。]

english: See you later.
translation: 稍后见。 [shao hou jian 。]

english: Good day, jester! Got any new jokes?
translation: 美好的一天，小丑！有什么新笑话吗？ [mei hao de yi tian ， xiao chou ！ you shen me xin xiao hua ma ？]

english: No. I only use old, recycled jokes. It's better for the environment.
translation: 不，我只使用旧的、循环使用的笑话。这对环境更好。 [bu ， wo zhi shi yong jiu de 、 xun huan shi yong de xiao hua 。 zhe dui huan jing geng hao 。]

english: HaHa!
translation: 哈哈！ [ha ha ！]

english: Are you here to help with the trolls?
translation: 你是来帮助对付巨魔的吗？ [ni shi lai bang zhu dui fu ju mo de ma ？]

english: I'm afraid not, I have other things to do.
translation: 恐怕不行，我还有别的事要做。 [kong pa bu xing ， wo hai you bie de shi yao zuo 。]

english: Well, watch yourself. Those rocks that the trolls throw can take your arm off.
translation: 嗯，小心点。巨魔扔出的那些石头可能会夺走你的手臂。 [n ， xiao xin dian 。 ju mo reng chu de na xie shi tou ke neng hui duo zou ni de shou bi 。]

english: Hey jester, this area is not a suitable place for civilians to wander about in. Trolls everywhere.
translation: 嘿，小丑，这个地区不适合平民闲逛。到处都是巨魔。 [hei ， xiao chou ， zhe ge di qu bu shi he ping min xian guang 。 dao chu dou shi ju mo 。]

english: Right you are. I'll be careful.
translation: 你是对的。我会小心的。 [ni shi dui de 。 wo hui xiao xin de 。]

english: I hope you're not heading north. There are lots of trolls, very dangerous.
translation: 我希望你不要往北走。有很多巨魔，非常危险。 [wo xi wang ni bu yao wang bei zou 。 you hen duo ju mo ， fei chang wei xian 。]

english: Thanks for the warning. I'll keep my eyes peeled.
translation: 谢谢你的警告。我会擦亮眼睛。 [xie xie ni de jing gao 。 wo hui ca liang yan jing 。]

english: Haha!
translation: 哈哈！ [ha ha ！]

english: Hello! Are you Hooknosed Jack?
translation: 你好！你是鹰钩鼻杰克吗？ [ni hao ！ ni shi ying gou bi jie ke ma ？]

english: Depends who's asking. What do you want?
translation: 取决于谁在问。你想要什么？ [qu jue yu shui zai wen 。 ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Jimmy Dazzler sent me. He said you could help train my grown cat to catch rats.
translation: 吉米·达兹勒发给我的。他说你可以帮助训练我的成年猫捉老鼠。 [ji mi · da zi lei fa gei wo de 。 ta shuo ni ke yi bang zhu xun lian wo de cheng nian mao zhuo lao shu 。]

english: I expect he wants me to do that for free, does he?
translation: 我想他希望我免费做这件事，是吗？ [wo xiang ta xi wang wo mian fei zuo zhe jian shi ， shi ma ？]

english: Well, I'm an adventurer. There must be something I can do for you in return.
translation: 嗯，我是一个冒险家。我一定能为你做点什么作为回报。 [n ， wo shi yi ge mao xian jia 。 wo yi ding neng wei ni zuo dian shen me zuo wei hui bao 。]

english: Forget it.
translation: 忘了它。 [wang le ta 。]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: I'm too busy to babysit you and your moggy.
translation: 我太忙了，没空照顾你和你的小猫。 [wo tai mang le ， mei kong zhao gu ni he ni de xiao mao 。]

english: Oh, come on.
translation: 哦，来吧。 [o ， lai ba 。]

english: No, really. Me and Pox have too much going on.
translation: 不，真的。我和波克斯发生了太多事情。 [bu ， zhen de 。 wo he bo ke si fa sheng le tai duo shi qing 。]

english: We've got a big job to finish today, I can't teach you how to catch rats on top of that.
translation: 今天我们有一项艰巨的任务要完成，除此之外我无法教你如何捉老鼠。 [jin tian wo men you yi xiang jian ju de ren wu yao wan cheng ， chu ci zhi wai wo wu fa jiao ni ru he zhuo lao shu 。]

english: Well I could be your apprentice! I've already got hands-on experience.
translation: 好吧，我可以成为你的徒弟！我已经有了实践经验。 [hao ba ， wo ke yi cheng wei ni de tu di ！ wo yi jing you le shi jian jing yan 。]

english: Oh yes? What sort of experience?
translation: 哦是的？什么样的体验？ [o shi de ？ shen me yang de ti yan ？]

english: I helped the Grime Sisters catch loads of rats in the sewers, and I cleared out a whole mansion in Ardougne for Jimmy Dazzler.
translation: 我帮助格莱姆姐妹在下水道里抓了很多老鼠，我还为吉米·达兹勒清理了阿杜涅的一整座豪宅。 [wo bang zhu ge lai mu jie mei zai xia shui dao li zhua le hen duo lao shu ， wo hai wei ji mi · da zi lei qing li le a du nie de yi zheng zuo hao zhai 。]

english: I bet you did. Typical Jimmy, leaving the hard work to everyone else.
translation: 我打赌你做到了。典型的吉米，把辛苦的工作留给其他人。 [wo da du ni zuo dao le 。 dian xing de ji mi ， ba xin ku de gong zuo liu gei qi ta ren 。]

english: So what do you say? Can me and my cat help you out?
translation: 那你说呢？我和我的猫可以帮助你吗？ [na ni shuo ne ？ wo he wo de mao ke yi bang zhu ni ma ？]

english: Oh, alright then. But you'd better not give me or Pox any trouble!
translation: 哦，那好吧。但你最好别给我和波克斯带来任何麻烦！ [o ， na hao ba 。 dan ni zui hao bie gei wo he bo ke si dai lai ren he ma fan ！]

english: We won't!
translation: 我们不会！ [wo men bu hui ！]

english: I'd better not regret this...
translation: 我最好不要后悔... [wo zui hao bu yao hou hui ...]

english: Right, your first task is to clear out a warehouse south of here.
translation: 对了，你的首要任务就是清理这里南边的一个仓库。 [dui le ， ni de shou yao ren wu jiu shi qing li zhe li nan bian de yi ge cang ku 。]

english: All you need to do is poison the rat holes with some bait. Can you handle that?
translation: 你所需要做的就是用一些诱饵在老鼠洞里投毒。你能处理吗？ [ni suo xu yao zuo de jiu shi yong yi xie you er zai lao shu dong li tou du 。 ni neng chu li ma ？]

english: I think so. Will any type of poison do?
translation: 我想是的。任何类型的毒药都可以吗？ [wo xiang shi de 。 ren he lei xing de du yao dou ke yi ma ？]

english: Are you daft? You need rat poison to kill rats!
translation: 你傻吗？你需要老鼠药才能杀死老鼠！ [ni sha ma ？ ni xu yao lao shu yao cai neng sha si lao shu ！]

english: If you can't mix a batch up for yourself, there's sure to be some lying around here somewhere.
translation: 如果你不能自己混合一批，那么肯定有一些躺在这里的某个地方。 [ru guo ni bu neng zi ji hun he yi pi ， na me ken ding you yi xie tang zai zhe li de mou ge di fang 。]

english: Would this stuff do?
translation: 这东西能行吗？ [zhe dong xi neng xing ma ？]

english: It certainly will! There's hope for you yet.
translation: 肯定会的！你还有希望。 [ken ding hui de ！ ni hai you xi wang 。]

english: Right, to poison the rats you'll need some tasty bait.
translation: 是的，要毒死老鼠，你需要一些美味的诱饵。 [shi de ， yao du si lao shu ， ni xu yao yi xie mei wei de you er 。]

english: They love a bit of cheese, so pour some poison on that and then leave it in the rat holes.
translation: 他们喜欢吃一点奶酪，所以在上面倒一些毒药，然后把它留在老鼠洞里。 [ta men xi huan chi yi dian nai lao ， suo yi zai shang mian dao yi xie du yao ， ran hou ba ta liu zai lao shu dong li 。]

english: Okay, can do.
translation: 好的，可以做。 [hao de ， ke yi zuo 。]

english: Report back to me when you're done.
translation: 完成后向我报告。 [wan cheng hou xiang wo bao gao 。]

english: And no slacking!
translation: 而且丝毫不偷懒！ [er qie si hao bu tou lan ！]

english: Hey!
translation: 嘿！ [hei ！]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: Can you make me some rat poison?
translation: 你能为我配制一些老鼠药吗？ [ni neng wei wo pei zhi yi xie lao shu yao ma ？]

english: Have you got the ingredients for me yet?
translation: 你给我准备好材料了吗？ [ni gei wo zhun bei hao cai liao le ma ？]

english: Get some Kwuarm, Red SpiderEggs and an empty vial. Bring them to me, and I'll make a batch of rat poison for you.
translation: 获取一些库阿姆、红蜘蛛蛋和一个空瓶子。把它们拿来给我，我给你配制一批老鼠​​药。 [huo qu yi xie ku a mu 、 hong zhi zhu dan he yi ge kong ping zi 。 ba ta men na lai gei wo ， wo gei ni pei zhi yi pi lao shu ​​ yao 。]

english: Do you see that bar to the south of here? Well, behind that is the warehouse. The rats are on the first floor.
translation: 你看到这里南边的那个酒吧了吗？嗯，后面就是仓库了。老鼠在一楼。 [ni kan dao zhe li nan bian de na ge jiu ba le ma ？ n ， hou mian jiu shi cang ku le 。 lao shu zai yi lou 。]

english: I've finished the job. Now will you teach me more about ratcatching?
translation: 我已经完成工作了。现在你能教我更多关于捕鼠的知识吗？ [wo yi jing wan cheng gong zuo le 。 xian zai ni neng jiao wo geng duo guan yu bu shu de zhi shi ma ？]

english: You're pulling my leg!
translation: 你在拉我的腿！ [ni zai la wo de tui ！]

english: Who, me?
translation: 谁，我？ [shui ， wo ？]

english: Yes, you! You think I can't tell you're lying? Now get back to the warehouse and kill those rats!
translation: 是的，就是你！你以为我看不出你在撒谎吗？现在回到仓库去杀死那些老鼠！ [shi de ， jiu shi ni ！ ni yi wei wo kan bu chu ni zai sa huang ma ？ xian zai hui dao cang ku qu sha si na xie lao shu ！]

english: I poisoned the rats in the warehouse! Do you have time to teach me about grown cats yet?
translation: 我毒死了仓库里的老鼠！你有时间教我有关成年猫的知识吗？ [wo du si le cang ku li de lao shu ！ ni you shi jian jiao wo you guan cheng nian mao de zhi shi ma ？]

english: Not right now, [player name].
translation: 现在不行，[玩家姓名]。 [xian zai bu xing ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Are you serious? I've gone and done a job for you, the least you could do is say thanks.
translation: 你是认真的？我已经为你做了一份工作，你至少可以说声谢谢。 [ni shi ren zhen de ？ wo yi jing wei ni zuo le yi fen gong zuo ， ni zhi shao ke yi shuo sheng xie xie 。]
