english: Can't you see I'm upset?
translation: 你没看到我很生气吗？ [ni mei kan dao wo hen sheng qi ma ？]

english: It's my cat, Pox. She's half dead, bless her.
translation: 这是我的猫，波克斯。她已经半死了，祝福她。 [zhe shi wo de mao ， bo ke si 。 ta yi jing ban si le ， zhu fu ta 。]

english: Oh no! What happened?
translation: 哦不！发生了什么？ [o bu ！ fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: They found her at the warehouse you were working at. She must have eaten some of the rats you poisoned.
translation: 他们在你工作的仓库找到了她。她肯定吃了一些你毒死的老鼠。 [ta men zai ni gong zuo de cang ku zhao dao le ta 。 ta ken ding chi le yi xie ni du si de lao shu 。]

english: Oh no...
Can I help? I feel somewhat responsible...
translation: 我可以帮忙吗？我觉得有点责任... [wo ke yi bang mang ma ？ wo jue de you dian ze ren ...]

english: That's kind of you, [player name].
translation: 你真是太好了，[玩家名字]。 [ni zhen shi tai hao le ，[ wan jia ming zi ]。]

english: There's an apothecary here in town, he could help. Tell him that the poison was made from red spiderseggs and kwuarm. He should know what to do. Go quickly.
translation: 镇上有一个药剂师，他可以帮忙。告诉他毒药是由红色蜘蛛网和夸阿姆制成的。他应该知道该怎么做。快点走吧。 [zhen shang you yi ge yao ji shi ， ta ke yi bang mang 。 gao su ta du yao shi you hong se zhi zhu wang he kua a mu zhi cheng de 。 ta ying gai zhi dao gai zen me zuo 。 kuai dian zou ba 。]

english: Have you got the anti-poison?
translation: 你有解毒药吗？ [ni you jie du yao ma ？]

english: Yes, I've got it right here.
translation: 是的，我就在这里。 [shi de ， wo jiu zai zhe li 。]

english: You hand the vial of cat anti-poison to Jack.
translation: 你把一瓶猫抗毒剂交给了杰克。 [ni ba yi ping mao kang du ji jiao gei le jie ke 。]

english: Thank you [player name]. Thank you so much.
translation: 谢谢你[玩家姓名]。太感谢了。 [xie xie ni [ wan jia xing ming ]。 tai gan xie le 。]

english: No worries there, I'd be sorry to see poor Pox come to harm.
translation: 不用担心，看到可怜的波克斯受到伤害我会很遗憾。 [bu yong dan xin ， kan dao ke lian de bo ke si shou dao shang hai wo hui hen yi han 。]

english: Well, thanks to you, she'll live to see another day.
translation: 好吧，多亏了你，她才能活到新的一天。 [hao ba ， duo kui le ni ， ta cai neng huo dao xin de yi tian 。]

english: I have to have a word with you about the job you did in the warehouse.
translation: 我得和你谈谈你在仓库里所做的工作。 [wo de he ni tan tan ni zai cang ku li suo zuo de gong zuo 。]

english: I did a good job, didn't I?
translation: 我做得很好，不是吗？ [wo zuo de hen hao ， bu shi ma ？]

english: The thing is, you didn't quite finish the warehouse job.
translation: 问题是，你还没有完全完成仓库的工作。 [wen ti shi ， ni hai mei you wan quan wan cheng cang ku de gong zuo 。]

english: Wait, but I poisoned all the rat holes just like you said.
translation: 等等，但正如你所说，我在所有老鼠洞里都下了毒。 [deng deng ， dan zheng ru ni suo shuo ， wo zai suo you lao shu dong li dou xia le du 。]

english: You did, but one rat survived... the biggest, nastiest one of the lot.
translation: 你做到了，但一只老鼠活了下来……是这群老鼠中最大、最肮脏的一只。 [ni zuo dao le ， dan yi zhi lao shu huo le xia lai …… shi zhe qun lao shu zhong zui da 、 zui ang zang de yi zhi 。]

english: Well, I'm not scared of big, nasty rats.
translation: 嗯，我并不害怕又大又讨厌的老鼠。 [n ， wo bing bu hai pa you da you tao yan de lao shu 。]

english: I hope not, because someone's got to get rid of it, and me and Pox are out of action.
translation: 我希望不会，因为必须有人除掉它，而我和 Pox 已经无法行动了。 [wo xi wang bu hui ， yin wei bi xu you ren chu diao ta ， er wo he  Pox  yi jing wu fa xing dong le 。]

english: Don't worry - we're on the case.
translation: 别担心——我们正在处理这个案子。 [bie dan xin —— wo men zheng zai chu li zhe ge an zi 。]

english: I really underestimated you, [player name]. Best of luck.
translation: 我真的低估了你，[玩家名字]。祝你好运。 [wo zhen de di gu le ni ，[ wan jia ming zi ]。 zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Have you killed the King Rat yet?
translation: 你杀死鼠王了吗？ [ni sha si shu wang le ma ？]

english: Umm... no.
Look, you did me and Pox a big favour, but that's not an excuse to slack off.
translation: 听着，你帮了我和波克斯一个大忙，但这不是偷懒的借口。 [ting zhe ， ni bang le wo he bo ke si yi ge da mang ， dan zhe bu shi tou lan de jie kou 。]

english: How's Pox doing anyway?
translation: 痘痘现在怎么样了？ [dou dou xian zai zen me yang le ？]

english: Oh, she's doing alright...
translation: 噢，她过得还好…… [o ， ta guo de hai hao ……]

english: Oi! You can't distract me like that. Get on with you, and get rid of that rat!
translation: 哎呀！你不能这样分散我的注意力。继续吧，除掉那只老鼠！ [ai ya ！ ni bu neng zhe yang fen san wo de zhu yi li 。 ji xu ba ， chu diao na zhi lao shu ！]

english: They say you've killed the King Rat.
translation: 他们说你杀死了鼠王。 [ta men shuo ni sha si le shu wang 。]

english: Just barely! I was getting worried for my cat, but we pulled through.
translation: 就勉强了！我很担心我的猫，但我们还是挺过来了。 [jiu mian qiang le ！ wo hen dan xin wo de mao ， dan wo men hai shi ting guo lai le 。]

english: Your cat?
translation: 你的猫？ [ni de mao ？]

english: Yes! The King Rat was holed up behind a wall, so I had to send my cat in to get it.
translation: 是的！鼠王躲在墙后，所以我不得不派我的猫去拿它。 [shi de ！ shu wang duo zai qiang hou ， suo yi wo bu de bu pai wo de mao qu na ta 。]

english: Well, imagine that. You two must have a great bond. Perhaps I can show you a thing or two after all.
translation: 好吧，想象一下。你们两个一定有很好的关系。也许我最终可以向你展示一两件事。 [hao ba ， xiang xiang yi xia 。 ni men liang ge yi ding you hen hao de guan xi 。 ye xu wo zui zhong ke yi xiang ni zhan shi yi liang jian shi 。]

english: See that manhole over there? Climb down it to enter the Varrock Rat Pits.
translation: 看到那边的沙井了吗？爬下来进入 Varrock Rat Pits。 [kan dao na bian de sha jing le ma ？ pa xia lai jin ru  Varrock Rat Pits。]

english: Thank you so much! I imagine my cat will learn a lot in there.
translation: 太感谢了！我想我的猫会在那里学到很多东西。 [tai gan xie le ！ wo xiang wo de mao hui zai na li xue dao hen duo dong xi 。]

english: Just you look after it.
translation: 只要你照顾它。 [zhi yao ni zhao gu ta 。]

english: Say, if you want to know more about the ratcatching business, you should seek out Smokin' Joe in Keldagrim. He was a skilled ratcatcher, back in the day.
translation: 比如说，如果你想了解更多关于捕鼠生意的知识，你应该去凯尔达格林寻找吸烟乔。过去，他是一名熟练的捕鼠者。 [bi ru shuo ， ru guo ni xiang liao jie geng duo guan yu bu shu sheng yi de zhi shi ， ni ying gai qu kai er da ge lin xun zhao xi yan qiao 。 guo qu ， ta shi yi ming shu lian de bu shu zhe 。]

english: Can you tell me where I could find Phingspet and Grimesquit?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪里可以找到 Phingspet 和 Grimesquit 吗？ [ni neng gao su wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao  Phingspet  he  Grimesquit  ma ？]

english: The sisters Grime? You'll find them down in the sewers here in Varrock.
translation: 格莱姆姐妹？你会在瓦罗克的下水道里找到它们。 [ge lai mu jie mei ？ ni hui zai wa luo ke de xia shui dao li zhao dao ta men 。]

english: Can you tell me where I could find Jimmy Dazzler?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪里可以找到吉米·达兹勒吗？ [ni neng gao su wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao ji mi · da zi lei ma ？]

english: Pah! There's nothing else he can teach you, I'll tell you that.
translation: 呸！他没有什么可以教你的，我会告诉你。 [pei ！ ta mei you shen me ke yi jiao ni de ， wo hui gao su ni 。]

english: But where would I find him?
translation: 但我到哪里才能找到他呢？ [dan wo dao na li cai neng zhao dao ta ne ？]

english: Probably cosying up to the nobles over in Ardougne.
translation: 可能是在讨好阿尔杜涅的贵族。 [ke neng shi zai tao hao a er du nie de gui zu 。]

english: What's your problem with Jimmy, anyway?
translation: 无论如何，你和吉米有什么问题吗？ [wu lun ru he ， ni he ji mi you shen me wen ti ma ？]

english: He reckons he's too good for the likes of us.
translation: 他认为他对我们这样的人来说太好了。 [ta ren wei ta dui wo men zhe yang de ren lai shuo tai hao le 。]

english: Are you sure? He spoke very highly of you.
translation: 你确定吗？他对你评价很高。 [ni que ding ma ？ ta dui ni ping jia hen gao 。]

english: I'll believe it when I see it.
translation: 当我看到它时我会相信它。 [dang wo kan dao ta shi wo hui xiang xin ta 。]

english: Anyway. The Flying Horse, Ardougne. You'll find him there.
translation: 反正。飞马，阿杜涅。你会在那里找到他。 [fan zheng 。 fei ma ， a du nie 。 ni hui zai na li zhao dao ta 。]

english: Can you tell me where I could find Smokin' Joe?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪里可以找到吸烟乔吗？ [ni neng gao su wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao xi yan qiao ma ？]

english: He should be in Keldagrim, the city of the dwarves.
translation: 他应该在矮人之城凯尔达格林。 [ta ying gai zai ai ren zhi cheng kai er da ge lin 。]

english: Tell him I said hello, will you? I've been meaning to catch up.
translation: 告诉他我向他打招呼，好吗？我一直想追上去。 [gao su ta wo xiang ta da zhao hu ， hao ma ？ wo yi zhi xiang zhui shang qu 。]

english: Can you tell me where I could find 'The Face'?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪里可以找到“面孔”吗？ [ni neng gao su wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao “ mian kong ” ma ？]

english: She'll be in Port Sarim, scaring people away from the entrance to the pits.
translation: 她将出现在沙里姆港，将人们从维修站入口处吓跑。 [ta jiang chu xian zai sha li mu gang ， jiang ren men cong wei xiu zhan ru kou chu xia pao 。]

english: Can you tell me where I could find Felkrash?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪里可以找到菲尔克拉什吗？ [ni neng gao su wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao fei er ke la shen ma ？]

english: Her nibs? She'll be in the rat pits at Port Sarim. Good luck getting in there, though.
translation: 她的笔尖？她将在萨里姆港的老鼠坑里。不过，祝你好运。 [ta de bi jian ？ ta jiang zai sa li mu gang de lao shu keng li 。 bu guo ， zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Can you tell me more about the pits?
translation: 能告诉我更多关于坑的事情吗？ [neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu keng de shi qing ma ？]

english: Here take this, you might find it useful.
translation: 拿走这个，你可能会发现它很有用。 [na zou zhe ge ， ni ke neng hui fa xian ta hen you yong 。]

english: What do you want to know?
translation: 你想知道什么？ [ni xiang zhi dao shen me ？]

english: Do you have any pointers for me and my cat?
translation: 您对我和我的猫有什么建议吗？ [nin dui wo he wo de mao you shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: You should wear an Amulet of Catspeak. It will allow you to organise tactics with your cat.
translation: 你应该佩戴猫语护身符。它可以让你和你的猫一起制定策略。 [ni ying gai pei dai mao yu hu shen fu 。 ta ke yi rang ni he ni de mao yi qi zhi ding ce lve 。]

english: What would be the best tactic to adopt then?
translation: 那么采取什么策略最好呢？ [na me cai qu shen me ce lve zui hao ne ？]

english: Well, that depends on your outlook, whether you're ready to risk your cat's life or not and how defensive or aggressive you want your cat to be.
translation: 嗯，这取决于您的看法，您是否准备好冒猫的生命危险，以及您希望猫的防御性或攻击性如何。 [n ， zhe qu jue yu nin de kan fa ， nin shi fou zhun bei hao mao mao de sheng ming wei xian ， yi ji nin xi wang mao de fang yu xing huo gong ji xing ru he 。]

english: I will not risk my cat's life.
translation: 我不会拿我的猫的生命冒险。 [wo bu hui na wo de mao de sheng ming mao xian 。]

english: Well if that's the case then you're left with two choices.
translation: 好吧，如果是这样的话，那么你有两个选择。 [hao ba ， ru guo shi zhe yang de hua ， na me ni you liang ge xuan ze 。]

english: You can adopt an ultra defensive strategy, which increases your cat's hitpoints and defence but causes it to flee sooner.
translation: 您可以采取超防御策略，这会增加猫的生命值和防御力，但会使其更快逃跑。 [nin ke yi cai qu chao fang yu ce lve ， zhe hui zeng jia mao de sheng ming zhi he fang yu li ， dan hui shi qi geng kuai tao pao 。]

english: Or you can adopt a less defensive strategy, which will allow your cat to stay in the pit for longer.
translation: 或者您可以采取较少防御的策略，这将使您的猫在坑中停留更长时间。 [huo zhe nin ke yi cai qu jiao shao fang yu de ce lve ， zhe jiang shi nin de mao zai keng zhong ting liu geng zhang shi jian 。]

english: I think I would adopt a very defensive strategy
translation: 我想我会采取非常防守的策略 [wo xiang wo hui cai qu fei chang fang shou de ce lve]

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'Just take care of yourself cat.'
translation: 在这种情况下，您应该告诉您的猫：“猫，照顾好自己。” [zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， nin ying gai gao su nin de mao ：“ mao ， zhao gu hao zi ji 。”]

english: Thanks for your help.
translation: 感谢您的帮助。 [gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]

english: Do you have any other questions about the pits?
translation: 关于坑你还有其他疑问吗？ [guan yu keng ni hai you qi ta yi wen ma ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: I think I would adopt a less defensive strategy.
translation: 我想我会采取较少防御的策略。 [wo xiang wo hui cai qu jiao shao fang yu de ce lve 。]

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'Stay in for as long as you can.'
translation: 在这种情况下，您应该告诉您的猫：“尽可能呆在家里。” [zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， nin ying gai gao su nin de mao ：“ jin ke neng dai zai jia li 。”]

english: I am willing to risk my cat, if it increases my chances of victory.
translation: 如果我的猫能增加我获胜的机会，我愿意拿它冒险。 [ru guo wo de mao neng zeng jia wo huo sheng de ji hui ， wo yuan yi na ta mao xian 。]

english: In that case you are left with two choices.
translation: 在这种情况下，你有两个选择。 [zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， ni you liang ge xuan ze 。]

english: You could go for all out attack which will boost your cat's attack and strength, but weaken it.
translation: 你可以全力攻击，这会增强你的猫的攻击力和力量，但会削弱它。 [ni ke yi quan li gong ji ， zhe hui zeng qiang ni de mao de gong ji li he li liang ， dan hui xue ruo ta 。]

english: Or, go for a less aggressive stance, which will increase your cat's strength and attack to a lesser degree, but carries no defensive penalties.
translation: 或者，采取不那么激进的姿势，这会增加猫的力量和攻击力，但不会带来防御惩罚。 [huo zhe ， cai qu bu na me ji jin de zi shi ， zhe hui zeng jia mao de li liang he gong ji li ， dan bu hui dai lai fang yu cheng fa 。]

english: I think I would adopt a very aggressive strategy
translation: 我想我会采取非常激进的策略 [wo xiang wo hui cai qu fei chang ji jin de ce lve]

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'Go berserk!'
translation: 在这种情况下，你应该告诉你的猫：“发疯吧！” [zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， ni ying gai gao su ni de mao ：“ fa feng ba ！”]

english: I think I would adopt a less aggressive strategy.
translation: 我想我会采取不那么激进的策略。 [wo xiang wo hui cai qu bu na me ji jin de ce lve 。]

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'No guts, no glory!'
translation: 在这种情况下，你应该告诉你的猫：“没有勇气，就没有荣耀！” [zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， ni ying gai gao su ni de mao ：“ mei you yong qi ， jiu mei you rong yao ！”]

english: What benefits does my cat get from training in the pits?
translation: 我的猫从训练区训练中得到什么好处？ [wo de mao cong xun lian qu xun lian zhong de dao shen me hao chu ？]

english: It depends on what kind of cat you have.
translation: 这取决于你养的是什么类型的猫。 [zhe qu jue yu ni yang de shi shen me lei xing de mao 。]

english: In the Varrock pits, your cat will grow up faster by gaining more experience.
translation: 在 Varrock 坑中，你的猫会通过获得更多经验而更快成长。 [zai  Varrock  keng zhong ， ni de mao hui tong guo huo de geng duo jing yan er geng kuai cheng zhang 。]

english: Can you show me to the rat pits?
translation: 你能带我参观一下老鼠坑吗？ [ni neng dai wo can guan yi xia lao shu keng ma ？]

english: Didn't you hear me? They're through that manhole over there. You can't miss it!
translation: 你没听到我说话吗？他们是通过那边的那个沙井。你不能错过它！ [ni mei ting dao wo shuo hua ma ？ ta men shi tong guo na bian de na ge sha jing 。 ni bu neng cuo guo ta ！]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Actually I've got no time for this. I don't want to talk to you.
translation: 事实上我没有时间做这些。我不想和你说话。 [shi shi shang wo mei you shi jian zuo zhe xie 。 wo bu xiang he ni shuo hua 。]

english: Oh the girls? You'll find them down in the sewers here in Varrock.
translation: 哦，女孩们？你会在瓦罗克的下水道里找到它们。 [o ， nv hai men ？ ni hui zai wa luo ke de xia shui dao li zhao dao ta men 。]

english: Can you tell me where I could find Smokin Joe?

translation: 你能告诉我在哪里可以找到“The Face”吗？ [ni neng gao su wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao “The Face” ma ？]

translation: 她将在沙里姆港，用她的脸把人们从维修站入口处吓跑。 [ta jiang zai sha li mu gang ， yong ta de lian ba ren men cong wei xiu zhan ru kou chu xia pao 。]

translation: 她的笔尖？她将在萨里姆港的维修站。 [ta de bi jian ？ ta jiang zai sa li mu gang de wei xiu zhan 。]

english: Here take this, you might find it useful
translation: 拿走这个，你可能会发现它很有用 [na zou zhe ge ， ni ke neng hui fa xian ta hen you yong]

english: Well what do you want to know?
translation: 那么你想知道什么？ [na me ni xiang zhi dao shen me ？]

english: You should wear an amulet of catspeak. It will allow you to organise tactics with your cat.
translation: 你应该佩戴猫语护身符。它可以让你和你的猫一起制定策略。 [ni ying gai pei dai mao yu hu shen fu 。 ta ke yi rang ni he ni de mao yi qi zhi ding ce lve 。]

english: Well if that's the case then your are left with two choices.
translation: 好吧，如果是这样的话，那么你就有两个选择。 [hao ba ， ru guo shi zhe yang de hua ， na me ni jiu you liang ge xuan ze 。]

english: You can adopt an ultra defensive strategy, which increases your cat's hitpoints and defence, the drawback to this is that your cat will flee sooner.
translation: 你可以采取超防御策略，这会增加你的猫的生命值和防御力，这样做的缺点是你的猫会更快逃跑。 [ni ke yi cai qu chao fang yu ce lve ， zhe hui zeng jia ni de mao de sheng ming zhi he fang yu li ， zhe yang zuo de que dian shi ni de mao hui geng kuai tao pao 。]

english: Your other option is to adopt a less defensive strategy which will allow your cat to stay in the pit for longer.
translation: 您的另一个选择是采取较少防御的策略，这将使您的猫在坑中停留更长时间。 [nin de ling yi ge xuan ze shi cai qu jiao shao fang yu de ce lve ， zhe jiang shi nin de mao zai keng zhong ting liu geng zhang shi jian 。]

english: In that case you should tell your cat, 'Just take care of yourself cat.'
translation: 在这种情况下，您应该告诉您的猫：“猫，照顾好自己。” [zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， nin ying gai gao su nin de mao ：“ mao ， zhao gu hao zi ji 。”]

english: In that case you should tell your cat, 'Stay in for as long as you can.'
translation: 在这种情况下，你应该告诉你的猫，“尽可能呆在家里。” [zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， ni ying gai gao su ni de mao ，“ jin ke neng dai zai jia li 。”]

english: You could go for all out attack which will boost your cat's attack and strength, but weaken it
translation: 你可以全力攻击，这会增强你的猫的攻击力和力量，但会削弱它 [ni ke yi quan li gong ji ， zhe hui zeng qiang ni de mao de gong ji li he li liang ， dan hui xue ruo ta]

english: or go for a less aggressive stance which will increase your cat's strength and attack to a lesser degree, but carries no defensive penalties.
translation: 或者采取不那么激进的姿势，这会增加猫的力量和攻击力，但不会带来防御惩罚。 [huo zhe cai qu bu na me ji jin de zi shi ， zhe hui zeng jia mao de li liang he gong ji li ， dan bu hui dai lai fang yu cheng fa 。]

english: In that case you should tell your cat, 'Go berserk!'
translation: 在这种情况下，你应该告诉你的猫，“发疯吧！” [zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， ni ying gai gao su ni de mao ，“ fa feng ba ！”]

english: In that case you should tell this to your cat, 'No guts, no glory!'
translation: 在这种情况下，你应该告诉你的猫：“没有勇气，就没有荣耀！” [zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， ni ying gai gao su ni de mao ：“ mei you yong qi ， jiu mei you rong yao ！”]

english: Argh you just don't listen do you? See that manhole yonder? Well climb down and you'll find the pits.
translation: 唉，你就是不听，是吗？看到那边的沙井了吗？爬下来你就会发现坑。 [ai ， ni jiu shi bu ting ， shi ma ？ kan dao na bian de sha jing le ma ？ pa xia lai ni jiu hui fa xian keng 。]

english: My name is Horacio Dobson. I'm the gardener to Lord Handelmort. Take a look around this beautiful garden, all of this is my handiwork.

english: Ah, I'm used to all that. I have my keys, the guard dogs know me, and I know the combination to the door lock. It's rather easy, it's his middle name.

english: moving south in search of new places. They eventually settled here and built this village, finding that the old nomadic traditions were no longer needed.

translation: 简直就是愚蠢，但不管怎样，他们似乎有一半的时间让自己陷入陷阱。 [jian zhi jiu shi yu chun ， dan bu guan zen yang ， ta men si hu you yi ban de shi jian rang zi ji xian ru xian jing 。]

english: What sort of traps should I use?
translation: 我应该使用什么样的陷阱？ [wo ying gai shi yong shen me yang de xian jing ？]

english: Just use a standard bird snare and you'll be fine. You can get them in any decent shop that sells Hunter gear.
translation: 只要使用标准的捕鸟器就可以了。你可以在任何一家出售猎人装备的正规商店买到它们。 [zhi yao shi yong biao zhun de bu niao qi jiu ke yi le 。 ni ke yi zai ren he yi jia chu shou lie ren zhuang bei de zheng gui shang dian mai dao ta men 。]

english: How do they work, then?
translation: 那么它们是如何工作的呢？ [na me ta men shi ru he gong zuo de ne ？]

english: Well, they're kind of sneaky, really. You've got a tall post with what appears to be a little perch sticking out the side. Now, the bird will see this as somewhere to sit, but the perch is actually rigged such that when the bird
translation: 嗯，他们确实有点狡猾。你有一个很高的柱子，旁边似乎有一个小鲈鱼伸出来。现在，鸟会认为这是一个可以坐下的地方，但栖息处实际上是经过操纵的，这样当鸟 [n ， ta men que shi you dian jiao hua 。 ni you yi ge hen gao de zhu zi ， pang bian si hu you yi ge xiao lu yu shen chu lai 。 xian zai ， niao hui ren wei zhe shi yi ge ke yi zuo xia de di fang ， dan qi xi chu shi ji shang shi jing guo cao zong de ， zhe yang dang niao]

english: lands on it, it'll drop away.
translation: 落在它上面，它就会掉下来。 [luo zai ta shang mian ， ta jiu hui diao xia lai 。]

english: Further, as the perch drops, it releases a noose that tightens around the bird's feet and captures it. Neat huh?
translation: 此外，当栖息处下降时，它会释放一个套索，将鸟的脚收紧并将其捕获。整洁吧？ [ci wai ， dang qi xi chu xia jiang shi ， ta hui shi fang yi ge tao suo ， jiang niao de jiao shou jin bing jiang qi bu huo 。 zheng jie ba ？]

english: So, was there anything else you wanted to ask about?
translation: 那么，您还有什么想问的吗？ [na me ， nin hai you shen me xiang wen de ma ？]

english: Thanks for your help.
translation: 感谢您的帮助。 [gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]

english: Not a problem, any time.
translation: 任何时候都不是问题。 [ren he shi hou dou bu shi wen ti 。]

english: What sort of things are there to catch around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可抓的东西？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke zhua de dong xi ？]

english: What're you interested in? You've got anything from birds for beginners up to larupias for the pros, not to mention weasels, butterflies, barb-tails and chinchompas.
translation: 你对什么感兴趣？从适合初学者的鸟类到适合专业人士的拉鲁皮亚，您可以找到各种鸟类，更不用说黄鼠狼、蝴蝶、倒钩尾鸟和金雀鼠了。 [ni dui shen me gan xing qu ？ cong shi he chu xue zhe de niao lei dao shi he zhuan ye ren shi de la lu pi ya ， nin ke yi zhao dao ge zhong niao lei ， geng bu yong shuo huang shu lang 、 hu die 、 dao gou wei niao he jin que shu le 。]

english: How would I go about catching birds?
translation: 我该如何去抓鸟呢？ [wo gai ru he qu zhua niao ne ？]

english: There are a couple of varieties that you can try your hand at catching around here, but the technique for both is essentially the same. You need to set up a bird snare.
translation: 您可以在这里尝试捕捉几种品种，但两者的技术本质上是相同的。你需要设置一个捕鸟网。 [nin ke yi zai zhe li chang shi bu zhuo ji zhong pin zhong ， dan liang zhe de ji shu ben zhi shang shi xiang tong de 。 ni xu yao she zhi yi ge bu niao wang 。]

english: Further, as the perch drops, it releases a noose that tightens around the bird's feet and captures it. Neat, huh?
translation: 此外，当栖息处下降时，它会释放一个套索，将鸟的脚收紧并将其捕获。整洁吧？ [ci wai ， dang qi xi chu xia jiang shi ， ta hui shi fang yi ge tao suo ， jiang niao de jiao shou jin bing jiang qi bu huo 。 zheng jie ba ？]

english: How do I get hold of a weasel?
translation: 我怎样才能抓住黄鼠狼？ [wo zen yang cai neng zhua zhu huang shu lang ？]

english: Not with large quantities of rice and treacle as many people would have you believe. Besides, the Feldip weasel isn't technically a weasel, but, as is typical with any sort of colloquial name, it's been called that often enough
translation: 不像许多人想让你相信的那样，需要大量的大米和糖蜜。此外，从技术上讲，费尔迪普黄鼠狼并不是黄鼠狼，但是，正如任何一种口语名称的典型特征一样，它经常被这样称呼 [bu xiang xu duo ren xiang rang ni xiang xin de na yang ， xu yao da liang de da mi he tang mi 。 ci wai ， cong ji shu shang jiang ， fei er di pu huang shu lang bing bu shi huang shu lang ， dan shi ， zheng ru ren he yi zhong kou yu ming cheng de dian xing te zheng yi yang ， ta jing chang bei zhe yang cheng hu]

english: now that it's stuck.
translation: 现在它被卡住了。 [xian zai ta bei ka zhu le 。]

english: Anyway, the Feldip weasel's main survival technique is in hiding; other than that, it's pretty stupid. So, if you can actually find one, then you've probably got a fairly good chance of catching one.
translation: 无论如何，费尔迪普黄鼠狼的主要生存技巧是躲藏；除此之外，这是相当愚蠢的。所以，如果你真的能找到一个，那么你可能就有很大的机会抓住一个。 [wu lun ru he ， fei er di pu huang shu lang de zhu yao sheng cun ji qiao shi duo cang ； chu ci zhi wai ， zhe shi xiang dang yu chun de 。 suo yi ， ru guo ni zhen de neng zhao dao yi ge ， na me ni ke neng jiu you hen da de ji hui zhua zhu yi ge 。]

english: And how would I actually go about finding one?
translation: 我该如何找到一个呢？ [wo gai ru he zhao dao yi ge ne ？]

english: The best place to start would probably be just south of here. You'll find lots of kebbit burrows there. Take a close look at some of them, follow the trails and you can't go far wrong.
translation: 最好的起点可能就在此处的南部。你会在那里发现很多烤肉串洞穴。仔细看看其中的一些，沿着小路走，你就不会走错太远。 [zui hao de qi dian ke neng jiu zai ci chu de nan bu 。 ni hui zai na li fa xian hen duo kao rou chuan dong xue 。 zi xi kan kan qi zhong de yi xie ， yan zhe xiao lu zou ， ni jiu bu hui zou cuo tai yuan 。]

english: Well, seeing as you seem to like larupias so much...
translation: 嗯，看来你很喜欢拉鲁皮亚斯…… [n ， kan lai ni hen xi huan la lu pi ya si ……]

english: Ah yes, yes, larupias are fun; just think of them as big kittens.
translation: 啊，是的，是的，larupias 很有趣；只要把它们想象成大猫就可以了。 [a ， shi de ， shi de ，larupias  hen you qu ； zhi yao ba ta men xiang xiang cheng da mao jiu ke yi le 。]

english: Uh huh, big kittens that just want to rip your throat out!
translation: 呃呃，大猫只想撕断你的喉咙！ [e e ， da mao zhi xiang si duan ni de hou long ！]

english: Indeed, and you can use this to your advantage. If a larupia is keen to chase you then let it; that way you can happily lead it straight into your trap without any fuss or waiting around.
translation: 事实上，您可以利用这一点来发挥自己的优势。如果拉鲁皮亚鸟热衷于追你，那就让它追吧；这样你就可以愉快地把它直接引入你的陷阱，而无需大惊小怪或等待。 [shi shi shang ， nin ke yi li yong zhe yi dian lai fa hui zi ji de you shi 。 ru guo la lu pi ya niao re zhong yu zhui ni ， na jiu rang ta zhui ba ； zhe yang ni jiu ke yi yu kuai di ba ta zhi jie yin ru ni de xian jing ， er wu xu da jing xiao guai huo deng dai 。]

english: Into what sort of trap should I lead it?
translation: 我该把它引入什么样的陷阱呢？ [wo gai ba ta yin ru shen me yang de xian jing ne ？]

english: A pit trap should do you. There are some appropriate pits to the east of here that you can use. Cover one with a few logs and branches, tease the kitty and then lead it to the pit. Simple.
translation: 一个坑陷阱应该可以帮助你。这里的东边有一些合适的坑可供你使用。用几根木头和树枝盖住一只小猫，逗弄小猫，然后把它带到坑里。简单的。 [yi ge keng xian jing ying gai ke yi bang zhu ni 。 zhe li de dong bian you yi xie he shi de keng ke gong ni shi yong 。 yong ji gen mu tou he shu zhi gai zhu yi zhi xiao mao ， dou nong xiao mao ， ran hou ba ta dai dao keng li 。 jian dan de 。]

english: Barb-tails sound interesting.
translation: 倒刺尾巴听起来很有趣。 [dao ci wei ba ting qi lai hen you qu 。]

english: They do sound interesting, don't they? Unfortunately, they're actually just another type of kebbit; those things get everywhere. Still, the tails of these particular kebbits can be useful for fishing.
translation: 它们听起来确实很有趣，不是吗？不幸的是，它们实际上只是烤肉串的另一种类型。这些东西到处都是。尽管如此，这些特殊的烤肉串的尾巴仍然可以用于钓鱼。 [ta men ting qi lai que shi hen you qu ， bu shi ma ？ bu xing de shi ， ta men shi ji shang zhi shi kao rou chuan de ling yi zhong lei xing 。 zhe xie dong xi dao chu dou shi 。 jin guan ru ci ， zhe xie te shu de kao rou chuan de wei ba reng ran ke yi yong yu diao yu 。]

english: So, how would I go about catching one them?
translation: 那么，我该如何去捕捉它们呢？ [na me ， wo gai ru he qu bu zhuo ta men ne ？]

english: Just squash them with a boulder, quick and simple.
translation: 只需用一块巨石压碎它们即可，快速而简单。 [zhi xu yong yi kuai ju shi ya sui ta men ji ke ， kuai su er jian dan 。]

english: What, you mean just pick up some boulders and start throwing them at kebbits? That doesn't sound simple.
translation: 什么，你的意思是捡起一些巨石然后开始把它们扔到烤肉串上？这听起来并不简单。 [shen me ， ni de yi si shi jian qi yi xie ju shi ran hou kai shi ba ta men reng dao kao rou chuan shang ？ zhe ting qi lai bing bu jian dan 。]

english: No silly, you let the creature squash itself. Just use some sticks to hold a boulder in a nice precarious position, place some bait underneath and let the creature knock itself out.
translation: 不傻，你让这个生物压扁了自己。只需用一些棍子将一块巨石固定在一个危险的位置，在下面放一些诱饵，然后让生物将自己撞倒。 [bu sha ， ni rang zhe ge sheng wu ya bian le zi ji 。 zhi xu yong yi xie gun zi jiang yi kuai ju shi gu ding zai yi ge wei xian de wei zhi ， zai xia mian fang yi xie you er ， ran hou rang sheng wu jiang zi ji zhuang dao 。]

english: What on earth is a chinchompa?
translation: chinchompa 到底是什么？ [chinchompa  dao di shi shen me ？]

english: Awwww, chinchompas are great. They're highly volatile little balls of fluff. Cute as you like, but for some reason they do have this tendency to spontaneously combust.
translation: 哇哦，chinchompas 太棒了。它们是高度不稳定的小绒毛球。可爱如你，但由于某种原因，它们确实有自燃的倾向。 [wa o ，chinchompas  tai bang le 。 ta men shi gao du bu wen ding de xiao rong mao qiu 。 ke ai ru ni ， dan you yu mou zhong yuan yin ， ta men que shi you zi ran de qing xiang 。]

english: What? Why?
translation: 什么？为什么？ [shen me ？ wei shen me ？]

english: Probably something to do with the fact they'll eat anything and everything, especially spicy food.
translation: 可能与他们什么都吃，尤其是辛辣食物有关。 [ke neng yu ta men shen me dou chi ， you qi shi xin la shi wu you guan 。]

english: Anyways, if you want to capture a chinchompa, I suggest using a box trap. That way, if the little fluffball does explode, then at least most of the blast will be contained within the box.
translation: 不管怎样，如果你想捕捉龙猫，我建议使用盒子陷阱。这样，如果小绒球确实爆炸，那么至少大部分爆炸将被限制在盒子内。 [bu guan zen yang ， ru guo ni xiang bu zhuo long mao ， wo jian yi shi yong he zi xian jing 。 zhe yang ， ru guo xiao rong qiu que shi bao zha ， na me zhi shao da bu fen bao zha jiang bei xian zhi zai he zi nei 。]

english: Somehow butterflies don't strike me as your sort of thing.
translation: 不知何故，蝴蝶对我来说并不像你这种东西。 [bu zhi he gu ， hu die dui wo lai shuo bing bu xiang ni zhe zhong dong xi 。]

english: Not really, but some people like them. The ones around here are at least vaguely interesting, though. The black ones are supposedly magical butterflies.
translation: 不是真的，但有些人喜欢它们。不过，这里周围的人至少有点有趣。黑色的蝴蝶据说是神奇的蝴蝶。 [bu shi zhen de ， dan you xie ren xi huan ta men 。 bu guo ， zhe li zhou wei de ren zhi shao you dian you qu 。 hei se de hu die ju shuo shi shen qi de hu die 。]

english: Doesn't that make them harder to catch?
translation: 这不是让他们更难被抓吗？ [zhe bu shi rang ta men geng nan bei zhua ma ？]

english: Not particularly; you can still catch them using an ordinary butterfly net. Oh, and you'll probably need some butterfly jars in which to keep them as well.
translation: 不特别；您仍然可以使用普通的蝴蝶网捕捉它们。哦，你可能还需要一些蝴蝶罐来存放它们。 [bu te bie ； nin reng ran ke yi shi yong pu tong de hu die wang bu zhuo ta men 。 o ， ni ke neng hai xu yao yi xie hu die guan lai cun fang ta men 。]

english: How can I improve my chances of making a capture?
translation: 如何提高捕获的机会？ [ru he ti gao bu huo de ji hui ？]

english: There are four key factors that will affect your chances: what bait you use, how close to the trap you are, your appearance and your smell.
translation: 有四个关键因素会影响你的机会：你使用的诱饵、你离陷阱的距离、你的外表和你的气味。 [you si ge guan jian yin su hui ying xiang ni de ji hui ： ni shi yong de you er 、 ni li xian jing de ju li 、 ni de wai biao he ni de qi wei 。]

english: How does bait help?
translation: 诱饵有何帮助？ [you er you he bang zhu ？]

english: Unfortunately, creatures don't just jump into traps for the fun of it nearly as often as we as Hunters might like. However, it is possible to improve those odds. If you can find the right bait to use on your trap,
translation: 不幸的是，生物并不像我们猎人所希望的那样经常为了好玩而跳入陷阱。然而，提高这些几率是有可能的。如果你能找到合适的诱饵来使用你的陷阱， [bu xing de shi ， sheng wu bing bu xiang wo men lie ren suo xi wang de na yang jing chang wei le hao wan er tiao ru xian jing 。 ran er ， ti gao zhe xie ji lv shi you ke neng de 。 ru guo ni neng zhao dao he shi de you er lai shi yong ni de xian jing ，]

english: something your prey really craves, then hunger overrides fear and the creature is just that little bit more likely to bounce to its furry little doom.
translation: 你的猎物真正渴望的东西，那么饥饿就会压倒恐惧，而这种生物就更有可能反弹到它毛茸茸的小厄运。 [ni de lie wu zhen zheng ke wang de dong xi ， na me ji e jiu hui ya dao kong ju ， er zhe zhong sheng wu jiu geng you ke neng fan tan dao ta mao rong rong de xiao e yun 。]

english: Why is it important how close I am to the trap?
translation: 为什么我离陷阱有多远很重要？ [wei shen me wo li xian jing you duo yuan hen zhong yao ？]

english: However well you might be blending in, if you're standing with your nose pressed right up against your own trap, the poor little critters ain't going to go anywhere near it. So, you need to make sure you put
translation: 无论你融入得有多好，如果你站着用鼻子抵住自己的陷阱，这些可怜的小动物就不会靠近它。所以，你需要确保你把 [wu lun ni rong ru de you duo hao ， ru guo ni zhan zhe yong bi zi di zhu zi ji de xian jing ， zhe xie ke lian de xiao dong wu jiu bu hui kao jin ta 。 suo yi ， ni xu yao que bao ni ba]

english: a sensible distance - I'd say at least four strides - between yourself and your trap.
translation: 你和你的陷阱之间有一个合理的距离——我想说至少四步。 [ni he ni de xian jing zhi jian you yi ge he li de ju li —— wo xiang shuo zhi shao si bu 。]

english: Why would the creatures care about my appearance?
translation: 为什么那些生物会在意我的外表？ [wei shen me na xie sheng wu hui zai yi wo de wai biao ？]

english: You're a human. From the point of view of a lot of creatures, you're big and scary. So, it'd be best if the furry little monsters didn't notice you. You need to blend in like the creatures themselves.
translation: 你是一个人。从很多生物的角度来看，你又大又可怕。所以，最好不要让毛茸茸的小怪物注意到你。你需要像生物本身一样融入其中。 [ni shi yi ge ren 。 cong hen duo sheng wu de jiao du lai kan ， ni you da you ke pa 。 suo yi ， zui hao bu yao rang mao rong rong de xiao guai wu zhu yi dao ni 。 ni xu yao xiang sheng wu ben shen yi yang rong ru qi zhong 。]

english: And how do I do that?
translation: 我该怎么做？ [wo gai zen me zuo ？]

english: Easy, dress up like one of them. Even easier, dress up using the furs of the creatures themselves; then you're bound to get the colour right. And, I suppose, if you don't fancy just slinging a dead fur over your
translation: 很简单，打扮得像他们中的一员。更简单的是，使用生物本身的毛皮来打扮；那么你一定会得到正确的颜色。而且，我想，如果你不喜欢在你的衣服上挂上一块死毛皮的话 [hen jian dan ， da ban de xiang ta men zhong de yi yuan 。 geng jian dan de shi ， shi yong sheng wu ben shen de mao pi lai da ban ； na me ni yi ding hui de dao zheng que de yan se 。 er qie ， wo xiang ， ru guo ni bu xi huan zai ni de yi fu shang gua shang yi kuai si mao pi de hua]

english: shoulders, you can probably get them made into something more appealing. I hear there are tailors in Varrock who are good at that sort of thing.
translation: 肩膀，你也许可以把它们做成更有吸引力的东西。我听说瓦罗克有裁缝很擅长做这种事。 [jian bang ， ni ye xu ke yi ba ta men zuo cheng geng you xi yin li de dong xi 。 wo ting shuo wa luo ke you cai feng hen shan chang zuo zhe zhong shi 。]

english: What's wrong with my smell!?
translation: 我的气味怎么了！？ [wo de qi wei zen me le ！？]

english: I'm sure there's nothing wrong with your smell...from a human point of view. But to your prey, any trap that you've set up will reek of human, and that's going to work against you if you don't do anything about it.
translation: 我确信你的气味没有任何问题……从人类的角度来看。但对于你的猎物来说，你设置的任何陷阱都会散发出人类的味道，如果你不采取任何行动，这就会对你产生不利影响。 [wo que xin ni de qi wei mei you ren he wen ti …… cong ren lei de jiao du lai kan 。 dan dui yu ni de lie wu lai shuo ， ni she zhi de ren he xian jing du hui san fa chu ren lei de wei dao ， ru guo ni bu cai qu ren he xing dong ， zhe jiu hui dui ni chan sheng bu li ying xiang 。]

english: So what should I do?
translation: 那我该怎么办呢？ [na wo gai zen me ban ne ？]

english: You need to mask that lovely human scent of yours with something else. Smoke works well. Take a lit torch and waft it around the trap a bit. You'll quickly overpower most of the other smells around the trap.
translation: 你需要用别的东西来掩盖你那可爱的人类气味。烟效果很好。拿一根点燃的火把，在陷阱周围晃动一下。你很快就会压倒陷阱周围的大多数其他气味。 [ni xu yao yong bie de dong xi lai yan gai ni na ke ai de ren lei qi wei 。 yan xiao guo hen hao 。 na yi gen dian ran de huo ba ， zai xian jing zhou wei huang dong yi xia 。 ni hen kuai jiu hui ya dao xian jing zhou wei de da duo shu qi ta qi wei 。]

english: Where can I get clothes and equipment like yours?
translation: 我在哪里可以买到像你这样的衣服和装备？ [wo zai na li ke yi mai dao xiang ni zhe yang de yi fu he zhuang bei ？]

english: Well, the equipment isn't too hard to get hold of. You've got specialist shops like Aleck's in Yanille that'll see you right. He's a bit pricey, mind, but it's pretty decent kit.
translation: 嗯，装备并不难获得。 Yanille 的 Aleck's 等专卖店一定会满足您的需求。请注意，他的价格有点贵，但这是相当不错的装备。 [n ， zhuang bei bing bu nan huo de 。 Yanille  de  Aleck's  deng zhuan mai dian yi ding hui man zu nin de xu qiu 。 qing zhu yi ， ta de jia ge you dian gui ， dan zhe shi xiang dang bu cuo de zhuang bei 。]

english: The clothing is a tad trickier to get hold of, the materials required being rather difficult to seperate from their reluctant owners.
translation: 这些衣服的获取有点困难，所需的材料很难从不情愿的主人手中分离出来。 [zhe xie yi fu de huo qu you dian kun nan ， suo xu de cai liao hen nan cong bu qing yuan de zhu ren shou zhong fen li chu lai 。]

english: But, if you can get the furs, there are shops like the tailor's in east Varrock that can help you.
translation: 但是，如果您能买到皮草，东瓦罗克的裁缝店等商店可以为您提供帮助。 [dan shi ， ru guo nin neng mai dao pi cao ， dong wa luo ke de cai feng dian deng shang dian ke yi wei nin ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: I think I'll give it a miss right now, thanks.
translation: 我想我现在就放弃它，谢谢。 [wo xiang wo xian zai jiu fang qi ta ， xie xie 。]

english: Suit yourself!
translation: 适合自己！ [shi he zi ji ！]

english: What's a larupia?
translation: 什么是拉鲁皮亚？ [shen me shi la lu pi ya ？]

english: What's a larupia? You don't know? You mean you really don't recognise the significance of these clothes I'm wearing?
translation: 什么是拉鲁皮亚？你不知道吗？你的意思是你真的不认识我穿的这些衣服的意义吗？ [shen me shi la lu pi ya ？ ni bu zhi dao ma ？ ni de yi si shi ni zhen de bu ren shi wo chuan de zhe xie yi fu de yi yi ma ？]

english: Well, they're certainly decorative...what about them?
translation: 嗯，它们确实具有装饰性……那它们呢？ [n ， ta men que shi ju you zhuang shi xing …… na ta men ne ？]

english: Well, these are the furs from a larupia. Caught the creature myself I did, and these make me blend in better, see?
translation: 嗯，这些是拉鲁皮亚的毛皮。我自己抓住了这个生物，这让我更好地融入，明白吗？ [n ， zhe xie shi la lu pi ya de mao pi 。 wo zi ji zhua zhu le zhe ge sheng wu ， zhe rang wo geng hao di rong ru ， ming bai ma ？]

english: If you want to be successful as a hunter you've got to be as stealthy as a kyatt, as quiet as a mouse and blend in like a, well, like a larupia, I guess!
translation: 如果你想成为一名成功的猎人，你必须像凯亚特一样隐秘，像老鼠一样安静，并且像，嗯，像拉鲁皮亚一样融入，我猜！ [ru guo ni xiang cheng wei yi ming cheng gong de lie ren ， ni bi xu xiang kai ya te yi yang yin mi ， xiang lao shu yi yang an jing ， bing qie xiang ， n ， xiang la lu pi ya yi yang rong ru ， wo cai ！]

english: What is that cool cape you're wearing?
translation: 你穿的那件很酷的斗篷是什么？ [ni chuan de na jian hen ku de dou peng shi shen me ？]

english: This? It's a Hunter's Skillcape. It shows that I am a true master of the art of Hunting and provides five daily teleports to either the Feldip Hills or Wilderness Hunter areas. If you ever manage to train your
translation: 这？这是猎人的技能斗篷。它表明我是真正的狩猎艺术大师，并提供五次每日传送到费尔迪普山或荒野猎人区域。如果你曾经设法训练你的 [zhe ？ zhe shi lie ren de ji neng dou peng 。 ta biao ming wo shi zhen zheng de shou lie yi shu da shi ， bing ti gong wu ci mei ri chuan song dao fei er di pu shan huo huang ye lie ren qu yu 。 ru guo ni ceng jing she fa xun lian ni de]

english: Hunter skill to its maximum level then I could sell you one.
translation: 猎人技能达到最高水平我就可以卖给你一个。 [lie ren ji neng da dao zui gao shui ping wo jiu ke yi mai gei ni yi ge 。]

english: Ahh, leave me alone you crazy killing person.
translation: 啊啊，放开我吧，你这个杀人狂。 [a a ， fang kai wo ba ， ni zhe ge sha ren kuang 。]

english: Heh, well I guess it's not everyone's thing.
translation: 呵呵，我想这不是每个人的事。 [he he ， wo xiang zhe bu shi mei ge ren de shi 。]

english: Can I buy a Hunter's Skillcape from you?
translation: 我可以向你购买猎人的技能斗篷吗？ [wo ke yi xiang ni gou mai lie ren de ji neng dou peng ma ？]

english: I would be delighted to recognise you as a master hunter, the cape provides five daily teleports to either the Feldip Hills or Wilderness Hunter areas. I will need 99000 coins to cover the expense of making such a
translation: 我很高兴认识到您是一名猎人大师，海角每天提供五次传送到费尔迪普山或荒野猎人区域。我需要 99000 个硬币来支付制作这样一个的费用 [wo hen gao xing ren shi dao nin shi yi ming lie ren da shi ， hai jiao mei tian ti gong wu ci chuan song dao fei er di pu shan huo huang ye lie ren qu yu 。 wo xu yao  99000  ge ying bi lai zhi fu zhi zuo zhe yang yi ge de fei yong]

english: costly item!
translation: 昂贵的物品！ [ang gui de wu pin ！]

english: 99000! That seems a bit expensive.
translation: 99000！那就好像有点贵了。 [99000！ na jiu hao xiang you dian gui le 。]

english: Actually it's quite reasonable; it's made from the fur of the nearly extinct Raharni wildcat. Well, if you change your mind you know where to find me.
translation: 其实这是很有道理的；它是由几乎灭绝的拉哈尼野猫的毛皮制成的。好吧，如果你改变主意，你就知道在哪里可以找到我。 [qi shi zhe shi hen you dao li de ； ta shi you ji hu mie jue de la ha ni ye mao de mao pi zhi cheng de 。 hao ba ， ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， ni jiu zhi dao zai na li ke yi zhao dao wo 。]

english: Certainly, I'm happy to pay that.
translation: 当然，我很乐意支付这笔费用。 [dang ran ， wo hen le yi zhi fu zhe bi fei yong 。]

english: But it seems that I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 但我身上的钱好像不够。 [dan wo shen shang de qian hao xiang bu gou 。]

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 好吧，等你回来了就回来见我吧。 [hao ba ， deng ni hui lai le jiu hui lai jian wo ba 。]

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 不幸的是，所有技能斗篷都只提供免费兜帽，这是技能升级交易的一部分；买一送一，你懂的。因此，在我向您出售一件之前，您需要释放一些库存空间。 [bu xing de shi ， suo you ji neng dou peng dou zhi ti gong mian fei dou mao ， zhe shi ji neng sheng ji jiao yi de yi bu fen ； mai yi song yi ， ni dong de 。 yin ci ， zai wo xiang nin chu shou yi jian zhi qian ， nin xu yao shi fang yi xie ku cun kong jian 。]

english: Now you look like a true hunter!
translation: 现在你看起来像一个真正的猎人了！ [xian zai ni kan qi lai xiang yi ge zhen zheng de lie ren le ！]

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Okay, where's a good place to start?
translation: 好吧，从哪里开始比较好呢？ [hao ba ， cong na li kai shi bi jiao hao ne ？]

english: What other sorts of things are there to catch around here?
translation: 这里还有哪些其他值得捕捉的东西？ [zhe li hai you na xie qi ta zhi de bu zhuo de dong xi ？]

english: Thanks for your help.
translation: 感谢您的帮助。 [gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]

english: What sort of things are there to catch around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可抓的东西？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke zhua de dong xi ？]

english: How would I go about catching birds?
translation: 我该如何去抓鸟呢？ [wo gai ru he qu zhua niao ne ？]

english: I'd like to ask about another creature...
translation: 我想问一下另一种生物... [wo xiang wen yi xia ling yi zhong sheng wu ...]

english: How can I improve my chances of making a capture?
translation: 如何提高捕获的机会？ [ru he ti gao bu huo de ji hui ？]

english: Where can I get clothes and equipment like yours?
translation: 我在哪里可以买到像你这样的衣服和装备？ [wo zai na li ke yi mai dao xiang ni zhe yang de yi fu he zhuang bei ？]

english: How do I get hold of a weasel?
translation: 我怎样才能抓住黄鼠狼？ [wo zen yang cai neng zhua zhu huang shu lang ？]

english: Well, seeing as you seem to like larupias so much...
translation: 嗯，看来你很喜欢拉鲁皮亚斯…… [n ， kan lai ni hen xi huan la lu pi ya si ……]

english: More...
translation: 更多的... [geng duo de ...]

english: Barb-tails sound interesting.
translation: 倒刺尾巴听起来很有趣。 [dao ci wei ba ting qi lai hen you qu 。]

english: What on earth is a chinchompa?
translation: chinchompa 到底是什么？ [chinchompa  dao di shi shen me ？]

english: Somehow butterflies don't strike me as your sort of thing.
translation: 不知何故，蝴蝶对我来说并不像你这种东西。 [bu zhi he gu ， hu die dui wo lai shuo bing bu xiang ni zhe zhong dong xi 。]

english: Back...
translation: 后退... [hou tui ...]

english: How does bait help?
translation: 诱饵有何帮助？ [you er you he bang zhu ？]

english: Why is it important how close I am to the trap?
translation: 为什么我离陷阱有多远很重要？ [wei shen me wo li xian jing you duo yuan hen zhong yao ？]

english: Why would the creatures care about my appearance?
translation: 为什么那些生物会在意我的外表？ [wei shen me na xie sheng wu hui zai yi wo de wai biao ？]

english: What's wrong with my smell!?
translation: 我的气味怎么了！？ [wo de qi wei zen me le ！？]

english: I think I'll give it a miss right now.
translation: 我想我现在就放弃它。 [wo xiang wo xian zai jiu fang qi ta 。]

english: What's a larupia?
translation: 什么是拉鲁皮亚？ [shen me shi la lu pi ya ？]

english: So, what's good to hunt around here?
translation: 那么，这里有什么好玩的呢？ [na me ， zhe li you shen me hao wan de ne ？]

english: What is that cool cape you're wearing?
translation: 你穿的那件很酷的斗篷是什么？ [ni chuan de na jian hen ku de dou peng shi shen me ？]

english: Ahh, leave me alone you crazy killing person.
translation: 啊啊，放开我吧，你这个杀人狂。 [a a ， fang kai wo ba ， ni zhe ge sha ren kuang 。]

english: Skillcape of Hunter.
translation: 猎人的技能斗篷。 [lie ren de ji neng dou peng 。]

english: 99000! That seems a bit expensive.
translation: 99000！那就好像有点贵了。 [99000！ na jiu hao xiang you dian gui le 。]

english: Certainly, I'm happy to pay that.
translation: 当然，我很乐意支付这笔费用。 [dang ran ， wo hen le yi zhi fu zhe bi fei yong 。]

english: Hunting.
translation: 打猎。 [da lie 。]

english: What is this cave here for?
translation: 这里的这个山洞是做什么用的？ [zhe li de zhe ge shan dong shi zuo shen me yong de ？]

english: Ah, a few of the most hunted creatures around here have been captured and secured in this cave to allow the most esteemed hunters to catch them with ease.
translation: 啊，这里有一些最受猎杀的生物被捕获并固定在这个洞穴里，以便最受尊敬的猎人能够轻松捕获它们。 [a ， zhe li you yi xie zui shou lie sha de sheng wu bei bu huo bing gu ding zai zhe ge dong xue li ， yi bian zui shou zun jing de lie ren neng gou qing song bu huo ta men 。]

english: Can I use the cave?
translation: 我可以使用这个洞穴吗？ [wo ke yi shi yong zhe ge dong xue ma ？]

english: Yes, you can. Head inside to hunt in peace.
translation: 是的，你可以。走进去安静地打猎。 [shi de ， ni ke yi 。 zou jin qu an jing di da lie 。]

english: Unfortunately not. Only those who have completed the hard tier of the Western Provinces achievement diary may enter.
translation: 不幸的是没有。只有完成了西域成就日记硬层的人才可以进入。 [bu xing de shi mei you 。 zhi you wan cheng le xi yu cheng jiu ri ji ying ceng de ren cai ke yi jin ru 。]

english: Come back when you have and I shall allow you entry.
translation: 当你回来的时候，我会允许你进入。 [dang ni hui lai de shi hou ， wo hui yun xu ni jin ru 。]

english: Sorry, but only those who've completed the hard set of the Western Provinces tasks may enter my private hunting ground.
translation: 抱歉，只有完成了西域艰辛任务的人才可以进入我的私人猎场。 [bao qian ， zhi you wan cheng le xi yu jian xin ren wu de ren cai ke yi jin ru wo de si ren lie chang 。]

english: Ah, this is a wonderful area for a spot of hunting, don't you think?
translation: 啊，这是一个狩猎的好地方，你不觉得吗？ [a ， zhe shi yi ge shou lie de hao di fang ， ni bu jue de ma ？]

english: I don't know, is it?
translation: 我不知道，是吗？ [wo bu zhi dao ， shi ma ？]

english: Oh absolutely; there's a huge variety of creatures to catch around here. You've got butterflies, polar kebbits, sabre-toothed kebbits, birds and even kyatts! Surely one of those piques your interest?
translation: 噢，绝对；这里有各种各样的生物可供捕捉。你有蝴蝶、极地烤肉串、剑齿烤肉串、鸟类，甚至还有凯亚特！其中之一肯定引起了您的兴趣吗？ [o ， jue dui ； zhe li you ge zhong ge yang de sheng wu ke gong bu zhuo 。 ni you hu die 、 ji di kao rou chuan 、 jian chi kao rou chuan 、 niao lei ， shen zhi hai you kai ya te ！ qi zhong zhi yi ken ding yin qi le nin de xing qu ma ？]

english: Where would I find polar kebbits?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到极地烤肉串？ [wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao ji di kao rou chuan ？]

english: Funnily enough, you've just put your finger right on the problem. With polar kebbits, finding them is the hardest part! You'll have to track them down.
translation: 有趣的是，你刚刚把手指放在了问题上。对于极地烤肉串来说，找到它们是最困难的部分！你必须追踪他们。 [you qu de shi ， ni gang gang ba shou zhi fang zai le wen ti shang 。 dui yu ji di kao rou chuan lai shuo ， zhao dao ta men shi zui kun nan de bu fen ！ ni bi xu zhui zong ta men 。]

english: How would I go about doing that, then?
translation: 那我该怎么做呢？ [na wo gai zen me zuo ne ？]

english: The easiest way to get started is by looking somewhere you can be sure a kebbit will have been and then working from there. You see the holes around here leading down into the ice? They're kebbit burrows!
translation: 最简单的开始方法是寻找一个你可以确定有烤肉串的地方，然后从那里开始工作。你看到这里周围通向冰层的洞了吗？它们是烤肉串洞穴！ [zui jian dan de kai shi fang fa shi xun zhao yi ge ni ke yi que ding you kao rou chuan de di fang ， ran hou cong na li kai shi gong zuo 。 ni kan dao zhe li zhou wei tong xiang bing ceng de dong le ma ？ ta men shi kao rou chuan dong xue ！]

english: You'll be hard pressed to catch a polar kebbit in its home, but if you search around the entrance to a burrow then you might be able to find a trail.
translation: 你很难在极地烤肉串的家中捕捉到它，但如果你在洞穴的入口周围搜索，你也许能找到一条踪迹。 [ni hen nan zai ji di kao rou chuan de jia zhong bu zhuo dao ta ， dan ru guo ni zai dong xue de ru kou zhou wei sou suo ， ni ye xu neng zhao dao yi tiao zong ji 。]

english: Now, kebbit trails are usually fairly easy to follow once you've found them, but if the trail does peter out, you should try inspecting the surrounding scenery for clues as to where the creature may have gone.
translation: 现在，一旦你找到了烤肉串踪迹，通常很容易追踪，但如果踪迹逐渐消失，你应该尝试检查周围的风景，寻找有关该生物可能去了哪里的线索。 [xian zai ， yi dan ni zhao dao le kao rou chuan zong ji ， tong chang hen rong yi zhui zong ， dan ru guo zong ji zhu jian xiao shi ， ni ying gai chang shi jian cha zhou wei de feng jing ， xun zhao you guan gai sheng wu ke neng qu le na li de xian suo 。]

english: Good places to look for clues include hollow logs in which the kebbit may have hidden or vegetation which may have been chewed or damaged.
translation: 寻找线索的好地方包括可能藏有烤肉串的中空原木，或者可能已被咀嚼或损坏的植被。 [xun zhao xian suo de hao di fang bao kuo ke neng cang you kao rou chuan de zhong kong yuan mu ， huo zhe ke neng yi bei ju jue huo sun huai de zhi bei 。]

english: There are also tunnels running through the ice here that the kebbits use, so you should check those out as well.
translation: 这里还有穿过冰面的隧道，供烤肉串使用，所以您也应该检查一下。 [zhe li hai you chuan guo bing mian de sui dao ， gong kao rou chuan shi yong ， suo yi nin ye ying gai jian cha yi xia 。]

english: What's more, these tunnels can often help to shelter a trail from further snow, making it even easier for you to pick them up again.
translation: 更重要的是，这些隧道通常可以帮助保护小道免受更多积雪的影响，让您更容易再次拾取它们。 [geng zhong yao de shi ， zhe xie sui dao tong chang ke yi bang zhu bao hu xiao dao mian shou geng duo ji xue de ying xiang ， rang nin geng rong yi zai ci shi qu ta men 。]

english: Eventually, of course, the kebbit will have probably hidden somewhere. Polar kebbits don't hang about in the open for long for fear of their natural predators.
translation: 当然，最终，烤肉串可能会藏在某个地方。由于害怕天敌，极地烤肉串不会在露天停留太久。 [dang ran ， zui zhong ， kao rou chuan ke neng hui cang zai mou ge di fang 。 you yu hai pa tian di ， ji di kao rou chuan bu hui zai lu tian ting liu tai jiu 。]

english: If you suspect a kebbit is close by, try looking around for signs of disturbed snow. Polar kebbits will often bury themselves in snow drifts as a means of hiding.
translation: 如果您怀疑附近有烤肉串，请尝试四处寻找雪被扰乱的迹象。极地烤肉串经常将自己埋在雪堆中作为隐藏的手段。 [ru guo nin huai yi fu jin you kao rou chuan ， qing chang shi si chu xun zhao xue bei rao luan de ji xiang 。 ji di kao rou chuan jing chang jiang zi ji mai zai xue dui zhong zuo wei yin cang de shou duan 。]

english: If you think you've found a kebbit, use a noose wand to haul the creature out from the snow.
translation: 如果你认为你找到了一条烤肉串，请使用绞索魔杖将其从雪中拖出来。 [ru guo ni ren wei ni zhao dao le yi tiao kao rou chuan ， qing shi yong jiao suo mo zhang jiang qi cong xue zhong tuo chu lai 。]

english: Wow, that's quite a lot to remember.
translation: 哇，有很多值得记住的事情。 [wa ， you hen duo zhi de ji zhu de shi qing 。]

english: Don't worry; if you find yourself struggling to follow a trail, just come and ask me and I'll see if I can help.
translation: 不用担心;如果您发现自己在追踪路线时遇到困难，请来问我，我会看看是否可以提供帮助。 [bu yong dan xin ; ru guo nin fa xian zi ji zai zhui zong lu xian shi yu dao kun nan ， qing lai wen wo ， wo hui kan kan shi fou ke yi ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: But remember, the best place to start is by searching around their burrows.
translation: 但请记住，最好的起点是搜索它们的洞穴。 [dan qing ji zhu ， zui hao de qi dian shi sou suo ta men de dong xue 。]

english: Great, thanks.
translation: 太好了，谢谢。 [tai hao le ， xie xie 。]

english: How do you hunt birds?
translation: 你如何捕鸟？ [ni ru he bu niao ？]

english: Ah, you can get cunning little bird snares for just that. You should be able to find them in specialist Hunter shops. Try to lay them in fairly open areas with lots of birds.
translation: 啊，你就可以得到狡猾的小鸟陷阱。您应该能够在专门的猎人商店中找到它们。尝试将它们放置在有很多鸟类的相当开放的区域。 [a ， ni jiu ke yi de dao jiao hua de xiao niao xian jing 。 nin ying gai neng gou zai zhuan men de lie ren shang dian zhong zhao dao ta men 。 chang shi jiang ta men fang zhi zai you hen duo niao lei de xiang dang kai fang de qu yu 。]

english: Do I need to place any bait on these traps?
translation: 我需要在这些陷阱上放置任何诱饵吗？ [wo xu yao zai zhe xie xian jing shang fang zhi ren he you er ma ？]

english: No, that's not necessary. The idea is that the bird will see the trap as somewhere to perch. If the bird lands on the trigger stick, it should drop away and a small loop of wire should close around the bird's feet.
translation: 不，那没有必要。这个想法是，鸟会将陷阱视为栖息的地方。如果小鸟落在扳机杆上，它应该会掉落，并且小鸟的脚周围应该有一个小环。 [bu ， na mei you bi yao 。 zhe ge xiang fa shi ， niao hui jiang xian jing shi wei qi xi de di fang 。 ru guo xiao niao luo zai ban ji gan shang ， ta ying gai hui diao luo ， bing qie xiao niao de jiao zhou wei ying gai you yi ge xiao huan 。]

english: And remember, it's important to collect any captures from your traps fairly quickly; otherwise, you risk losing them to various wild scavengers.
translation: 请记住，快速收集陷阱中的捕获物非常重要；否则，您可能会面临被各种野生食腐动物夺走的风险。 [qing ji zhu ， kuai su shou ji xian jing zhong de bu huo wu fei chang zhong yao ； fou ze ， nin ke neng hui mian lin bei ge zhong ye sheng shi fu dong wu duo zou de feng xian 。]

english: How can I improve my chances of capturing a creature?
translation: 如何提高捕捉生物的机会？ [ru he ti gao bu zhuo sheng wu de ji hui ？]

english: Ah, the key there is concealment, both of yourself and your traps.
translation: 啊，关键是隐藏，包括你自己和你的陷阱。 [a ， guan jian shi yin cang ， bao kuo ni zi ji he ni de xian jing 。]

english: The most obvious point is to stay out of sight of your own traps. If possible, hide around a wall, hedge or similar. Failing that, make sure you're a good few feet away from your trap.
translation: 最明显的一点是要远离自己的陷阱。如果可能的话，躲在墙壁、树篱或类似物周围。如果做不到这一点，请确保您距离陷阱几英尺远。 [zui ming xian de yi dian shi yao yuan li zi ji de xian jing 。 ru guo ke neng de hua ， duo zai qiang bi 、 shu li huo lei si wu zhou wei 。 ru guo zuo bu dao zhe yi dian ， qing que bao nin ju li xian jing ji ying chi yuan 。]

english: You can hide yourself even better by wearing clothing appropriate to the area in which you are hunting.
translation: 通过穿着适合您狩猎区域的衣服，您可以更好地隐藏自己。 [tong guo chuan zhe shi he nin shou lie qu yu de yi fu ， nin ke yi geng hao di yin cang zi ji 。]

english: Your best bet is to use the skins of creatures native to the area. There is a very good tailor in east Varrock who may be able to help you with making clothing out of such skins.
translation: 最好的选择是使用该地区本地生物的皮。东瓦罗克有一位非常好的裁缝，他也许可以帮助你用这种兽皮制作衣服。 [zui hao de xuan ze shi shi yong gai di qu ben di sheng wu de pi 。 dong wa luo ke you yi wei fei chang hao de cai feng ， ta ye xu ke yi bang zhu ni yong zhe zhong shou pi zhi zuo yi fu 。]

english: Finally, a lot of creatures may avoid your traps if they can smell a human scent on them. This is where smoking a trap can be useful.
translation: 最后，如果许多生物能闻到人类的气味，它们可能会避开你的陷阱。这就是吸烟陷阱有用的地方。 [zui hou ， ru guo xu duo sheng wu neng wen dao ren lei de qi wei ， ta men ke neng hui bi kai ni de xian jing 。 zhe jiu shi xi yan xian jing you yong de di fang 。]

english: It takes a bit of practice, but by using the smoke from a torch, you can mask any other scents that may surround a trap.
translation: 这需要一些练习，但是通过使用火把产生的烟雾，您可以掩盖陷阱周围可能存在的任何其他气味。 [zhe xu yao yi xie lian xi ， dan shi tong guo shi yong huo ba chan sheng de yan wu ， nin ke yi yan gai xian jing zhou wei ke neng cun zai de ren he qi ta qi wei 。]

english: Wow, thanks for your help.
translation: 哇，谢谢你的帮助。 [wa ， xie xie ni de bang zhu 。]

english: You're welcome, good luck with the hunting.
translation: 不客气，祝狩猎顺利。 [bu ke qi ， zhu shou lie shun li 。]

english: What's so special about butterflies?
translation: 蝴蝶有什么特别之处？ [hu die you shen me te bie zhi chu ？]

english: That depends entirely on the butterfly.
translation: 这完全取决于蝴蝶。 [zhe wan quan qu jue yu hu die 。]

english: I'll admit that the activities of many butterflies may be of no interest at all. However, we are lucky in having around here some fine examples of rare thaumic butterflies.
translation: 我承认，许多蝴蝶的活动可能根本不感兴趣。然而，我们很幸运，这里有一些稀有奇术蝴蝶的精美例子。 [wo cheng ren ， xu duo hu die de huo dong ke neng gen ben bu gan xing qu 。 ran er ， wo men hen xing yun ， zhe li you yi xie xi you qi shu hu die de jing mei li zi 。]

english: These butterflies reputedly have magical powers that, when released, can make a person stronger or heal otherwise critical wounds.
translation: 据说这些蝴蝶具有神奇的力量，释放后可以使人变得更坚强或治愈其他严重的伤口。 [ju shuo zhe xie hu die ju you shen qi de li liang ， shi fang hou ke yi shi ren bian de geng jian qiang huo zhi yu qi ta yan zhong de shang kou 。]

english: At this point, I should offer a note of caution, however: it is also said that these powers will not manifest themselves if the butterflies are captured for selfish purposes.
translation: 然而，在这一点上，我应该提出警告：据说，如果出于自私目的捕获蝴蝶，这些力量就不会显现出来。 [ran er ， zai zhe yi dian shang ， wo ying gai ti chu jing gao ： ju shuo ， ru guo chu yu zi si mu di bu huo hu die ， zhe xie li liang jiu bu hui xian xian chu lai 。]

english: Rather, they are gifts that must be used by one person to aid another. Of course, you'll have to catch them first.
translation: 相反，它们是一个人必须用来帮助另一个人的礼物。当然，你必须先抓住他们。 [xiang fan ， ta men shi yi ge ren bi xu yong lai bang zhu ling yi ge ren de li wu 。 dang ran ， ni bi xu xian zhua zhu ta men 。]

english: Why, with a butterfly net of course! You should also carry some empty butterfly jars with you in which to keep the butterflies.
translation: 为什么，当然是用蝴蝶网！您还应该随身携带一些空的蝴蝶罐，用来饲养蝴蝶。 [wei shen me ， dang ran shi yong hu die wang ！ nin hai ying gai sui shen xie dai yi xie kong de hu die guan ， yong lai si yang hu die 。]

english: How can I capture a sabre-toothed kebbit?
translation: 如何捕获剑齿科比特犬？ [ru he bu huo jian chi ke bi te quan ？]

english: Ah, now for these creatures I would recommend using a deadfall trap. Deadfalls are quite easy to set up, and yet you can catch some very reasonably sized creatures with them.
translation: 啊，现在对于这些生物我建议使用死亡陷阱。死亡瀑布很容易设置，但你可以用它们捕捉一些非常合理大小的生物。 [a ， xian zai dui yu zhe xie sheng wu wo jian yi shi yong si wang xian jing 。 si wang pu bu hen rong yi she zhi ， dan ni ke yi yong ta men bu zhuo yi xie fei chang he li da xiao de sheng wu 。]

english: Deadfall traps basically work by having a large dead weight, such as a boulder, positioned so as to be delicately balanced above some form of bait.
translation: 死落陷阱的工作原理基本上是通过将较大的自重（例如巨石）放置在某种形式的诱饵上方，以保持微妙的平衡。 [si luo xian jing de gong zuo yuan li ji ben shang shi tong guo jiang jiao da de zi zhong （ li ru ju shi ） fang zhi zai mou zhong xing shi de you er shang fang ， yi bao chi wei miao de ping heng 。]

english: You will need to make sure you have a knife and some wood with you to create appropriate supports and a trigger for this sort trap.
translation: 您需要确保随身携带一把刀和一些木头，以便为此类陷阱创建适当的支撑和触发器。 [nin xu yao que bao sui shen xie dai yi ba dao he yi xie mu tou ， yi bian wei ci lei xian jing chuang jian shi dang de zhi cheng he chu fa qi 。]

english: In the case of sabre-toothed kebbits you should use some form of raw meat to bait your trap, but other animals may prefer other baits, such as fish or vegetables.
translation: 对于剑齿烤肉串，您应该使用某种形式的生肉来作为陷阱的诱饵，但其他动物可能更喜欢其他诱饵，例如鱼或蔬菜。 [dui yu jian chi kao rou chuan ， nin ying gai shi yong mou zhong xing shi de sheng rou lai zuo wei xian jing de you er ， dan qi ta dong wu ke neng geng xi huan qi ta you er ， li ru yu huo shu cai 。]

english: Oooh, kyatts soundsinteresting. I want to catch one of those.
translation: 哦，基亚听起来很有趣。我想抓住其中一只。 [o ， ji ya ting qi lai hen you qu 。 wo xiang zhua zhu qi zhong yi zhi 。]

english: Well, you've set your sights high, kyatts are incredibly fearsome creatures, but with determination like that I'm sure you'll make it.
translation: 好吧，你的眼光很高，凯亚特是令人难以置信的可怕生物，但有了这样的决心，我相信你会成功的。 [hao ba ， ni de yan guang hen gao ， kai ya te shi ling ren nan yi zhi xin de ke pa sheng wu ， dan you le zhe yang de jue xin ， wo xiang xin ni hui cheng gong de 。]

english: Now, you're not going to be able to catch a kyatt with just a small box or a noose on a stick. You need a much bigger trap.
translation: 现在，仅靠一个小盒子或一根棍子上的绞索是不可能钓到一元的。你需要一个更大的陷阱。 [xian zai ， jin kao yi ge xiao he zi huo yi gen gun zi shang de jiao suo shi bu ke neng diao dao yi yuan de 。 ni xu yao yi ge geng da de xian jing 。]

english: Pit traps are a good bet. You'd be best off finding a natural dip in the ground as the basis for your trap. If you dig a pit yourself, you risk creatures noticing the disturbed ground nearby.
translation: 坑陷阱是一个不错的选择。你最好在地面上找到一个自然的洼地作为你的陷阱的基础。如果你自己挖坑，你就有可能被生物注意到附近被扰动的地面。 [keng xian jing shi yi ge bu cuo de xuan ze 。 ni zui hao zai di mian shang zhao dao yi ge zi ran de wa di zuo wei ni de xian jing de ji chu 。 ru guo ni zi ji wa keng ， ni jiu you ke neng bei sheng wu zhu yi dao fu jin bei rao dong de di mian 。]

english: Once you've found an appropriate spot, you'll need some logs and a knife. The logs serve two purposes.
translation: 找到合适的地点后，您将需要一些原木和一把刀。日志有两个目的。 [zhao dao he shi de di dian hou ， nin jiang xu yao yi xie yuan mu he yi ba dao 。 ri zhi you liang ge mu di 。]

english: Some can be carved into sharp skewers for the bottom of the pit; hopefully the kyatt will die when it falls onto these. Others can be used to conceal the trap.
translation: 有的可以刻成锋利的串，用于坑底；希望凯亚特掉到这些东西上时会死。其他的可以用来隐藏陷阱。 [you de ke yi ke cheng feng li de chuan ， yong yu keng di ； xi wang kai ya te diao dao zhe xie dong xi shang shi hui si 。 qi ta de ke yi yong lai yin cang xian jing 。]

english: Of course, even then the pit is going to look suspicious, so you're going to need to lure the kyatt onto the branches in some way. What actually tends to work best for this is, well, yourself!
translation: 当然，即使这样，坑也会看起来很可疑，所以你需要以某种方式将凯亚特引诱到树枝上。实际上最有效的方法就是你自己！ [dang ran ， ji shi zhe yang ， keng ye hui kan qi lai hen ke yi ， suo yi ni xu yao yi mou zhong fang shi jiang kai ya te yin you dao shu zhi shang 。 shi ji shang zui you xiao de fang fa jiu shi ni zi ji ！]

english: What? I don't like the sound of that.
translation: 什么？我不喜欢那样的声音。 [shen me ？ wo bu xi huan na yang de sheng yin 。]

english: Yes, that's the normal response, but I kid you not. If you really want a kyatt to follow you over that pit then just give it a good poke!
translation: 是的，这是正常的反应，但我没有骗你。如果你真的想让凯亚特跟着你穿过那个坑，那就用力戳它吧！ [shi de ， zhe shi zheng chang de fan ying ， dan wo mei you pian ni 。 ru guo ni zhen de xiang rang kai ya te gen zhe ni chuan guo na ge keng ， na jiu yong li chuo ta ba ！]

english: Of course, I suggest you use something long to poke it with. Poking a kyatt with your finger is likely to end in unfortunate limb loss.
translation: 当然，我建议你用长的东西来戳它。用手指戳一吉亚特很可能会导致不幸的肢体丧失。 [dang ran ， wo jian yi ni yong zhang de dong xi lai chuo ta 。 yong shou zhi chuo yi ji ya te hen ke neng hui dao zhi bu xing de zhi ti sang shi 。]

english: Fortunately, you can get very good sticks for poking from most Hunter shops.
translation: 幸运的是，您可以从大多数猎人商店买到非常好的戳戳棍子。 [xing yun de shi ， nin ke yi cong da duo shu lie ren shang dian mai dao fei chang hao de chuo chuo gun zi 。]

english: Once you have...got the creature's attention, try to lead it to one of your traps. Make sure to jump the branches when you reach the trap yourself, of course; it would be embarrassing to fall into your own trap.
translation: 一旦你……引起了该生物的注意，尝试将其引向你的陷阱之一。当然，当你自己到达陷阱时，一定要跳过树枝；掉进自己的陷阱就很尴尬了。 [yi dan ni …… yin qi le gai sheng wu de zhu yi ， chang shi jiang qi yin xiang ni de xian jing zhi yi 。 dang ran ， dang ni zi ji dao da xian jing shi ， yi ding yao tiao guo shu zhi ； diao jin zi ji de xian jing jiu hen gan ga le 。]

english: Then, if the kyatt is giving you all of its attention, hopefully it won't notice the trap, and with any luck, it will stumble right into the pit.
translation: 然后，如果凯亚特把所有的注意力都集中在你身上，希望它不会注意到陷阱，如果运气好的话，它会直接掉进坑里。 [ran hou ， ru guo kai ya te ba suo you de zhu yi li dou ji zhong zai ni shen shang ， xi wang ta bu hui zhu yi dao xian jing ， ru guo yun qi hao de hua ， ta hui zhi jie diao jin keng li 。]

english: That sounds a bit hit or miss, and kind of suicidal too!
translation: 这听起来有点碰运气，也有点自杀倾向！ [zhe ting qi lai you dian peng yun qi ， ye you dian zi sha qing xiang ！]

english: Well that's what makes it exciting, isn't it? But honestly, if you want to capture a kyatt, that's your best bet.
translation: 嗯，这就是令人兴奋的原因，不是吗？但老实说，如果你想赚到一元，那是你最好的选择。 [n ， zhe jiu shi ling ren xing fen de yuan yin ， bu shi ma ？ dan lao shi shuo ， ru guo ni xiang zhuan dao yi yuan ， na shi ni zui hao de xuan ze 。]

english: Can you teach me how to hunt?
translation: 你能教我如何打猎吗？ [ni neng jiao wo ru he da lie ma ？]

english: Why certainly. I reached the peak of my abilities some time ago, but I'm more than happy to help newcomers to the field. Was there anything in particular you had in mind?
translation: 为什么当然。我不久前就达到了自己能力的顶峰，但我非常乐意帮助该领域的新人。您有什么特别的想法吗？ [wei shen me dang ran 。 wo bu jiu qian jiu da dao le zi ji neng li de ding feng ， dan wo fei chang le yi bang zhu gai ling yu de xin ren 。 nin you shen me te bie de xiang fa ma ？]

english: Where's the best place to start?
translation: 最好从哪里开始？ [zui hao cong na li kai shi ？]

english: I always say a good starting point is to learn how to follow the creatures you want to capture. Around here, that means practicing on polar kebbits.
translation: 我总是说一个好的起点是学习如何跟随你想要捕捉的生物。在这里，这意味着练习极地烤肉串。 [wo zong shi shuo yi ge hao de qi dian shi xue xi ru he gen sui ni xiang yao bu zhuo de sheng wu 。 zai zhe li ， zhe yi wei zhe lian xi ji di kao rou chuan 。]

english: So how do I track them down, then?
translation: 那么我该如何追踪他们呢？ [na me wo gai ru he zhui zong ta men ne ？]

english: What sort of creatures are there to hunt around here?
translation: 这里有什么生物可以狩猎？ [zhe li you shen me sheng wu ke yi shou lie ？]

english: Well, there's pretty much anything you could want to hunt. You've got butterflies, polar kebbits, sabre-toothed kebbits, birds and even kyatts! Surely one of those interests you?
translation: 好吧，这里几乎有你想要狩猎的任何东西。你有蝴蝶、极地烤肉串、剑齿烤肉串、鸟类，甚至还有凯亚特！您肯定对其中之一感兴趣吗？ [hao ba ， zhe li ji hu you ni xiang yao shou lie de ren he dong xi 。 ni you hu die 、 ji di kao rou chuan 、 jian chi kao rou chuan 、 niao lei ， shen zhi hai you kai ya te ！ nin ken ding dui qi zhong zhi yi gan xing qu ma ？]

english: Sorry, I'm not that keen on hunting.
translation: 抱歉，我不太热衷于打猎。 [bao qian ， wo bu tai re zhong yu da lie 。]

english: Really? What a shame, you looked like someone who could have had some promise.
translation: 真的吗？真可惜，你看起来像是一个可以有前途的人。 [zhen de ma ？ zhen ke xi ， ni kan qi lai xiang shi yi ge ke yi you qian tu de ren 。]

english: I don't know, is it?
translation: 我不知道，是吗？ [wo bu zhi dao ， shi ma ？]

english: Where would I find polar kebbits?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到极地烤肉串？ [wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao ji di kao rou chuan ？]

english: How do you hunt birds?
translation: 你如何捕鸟？ [ni ru he bu niao ？]

english: I'd like to ask about another creature.
translation: 我想问一下另一种生物。 [wo xiang wen yi xia ling yi zhong sheng wu 。]

english: How can I improve my chances of capturing a creature?
translation: 如何提高捕捉生物的机会？ [ru he ti gao bu zhuo sheng wu de ji hui ？]

english: What's so special about butterflies?
translation: 蝴蝶有什么特别之处？ [hu die you shen me te bie zhi chu ？]

english: How can I capture a sabre-toothed kebbit?
translation: 如何捕获剑齿科比特犬？ [ru he bu huo jian chi ke bi te quan ？]

english: Oooh, kyatts sounds interesting.
translation: 哦，基亚听起来很有趣。 [o ， ji ya ting qi lai hen you qu 。]

english: Can you teach me how to hunt?
translation: 你能教我如何打猎吗？ [ni neng jiao wo ru he da lie ma ？]

english: Where's the best place to start?
translation: 最好从哪里开始？ [zui hao cong na li kai shi ？]

english: What sort of creatures are there to hunt around here?
translation: 这里有什么生物可以狩猎？ [zhe li you shen me sheng wu ke yi shou lie ？]

english: Sorry, I'm not that keen on hunting.
translation: 抱歉，我不太热衷于打猎。 [bao qian ， wo bu tai re zhong yu da lie 。]

english: Greetings, fellow hunter. How can I be of help?
translation: 你好，猎人同伴。我能提供什么帮助吗？ [ni hao ， lie ren tong ban 。 wo neng ti gong shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: What kinds of food and drink do you serve?
translation: 你们提供什么类型的食物和饮料？ [ni men ti gong shen me lei xing de shi wu he yin liao ？]

english: In terms of drinks, we've got a Trapper's Tipple, and for food, a simple hearty stew.
translation: 饮料方面，我们提供了 Trapper's Tipple；食物方面，我们提供了简单丰盛的炖菜。 [yin liao fang mian ， wo men ti gong le  Trapper's Tipple； shi wu fang mian ， wo men ti gong le jian dan feng sheng de dun cai 。]

english: But you don't have room to hold either of them, so you'll have to come back later.
translation: 但你没有空间容纳他们中的任何一个，所以你必须稍后再回来。 [dan ni mei you kong jian rong na ta men zhong de ren he yi ge ， suo yi ni bi xu shao hou zai hui lai 。]

english: Couldn't you just leave it on the ground for me?
translation: 你就不能把它留在地上给我吗？ [ni jiu bu neng ba ta liu zai di shang gei wo ma ？]

english: We don't tend to just... leave things like that around here.
translation: 我们不倾向于只是……把这样的东西留在这里。 [wo men bu qing xiang yu zhi shi …… ba zhe yang de dong xi liu zai zhe li 。]

english: I'd love a Trapper's Tipple!
translation: 我想要一杯陷阱酒！ [wo xiang yao yi bei xian jing jiu ！]

english: That'll be three coins then.
translation: 那就三枚硬币吧。 [na jiu san mei ying bi ba 。]

english: Oh, I can't afford one right now.
translation: 哦，我现在买不起。 [o ， wo xian zai mai bu qi 。]

english: Could I grab a stew?
translation: 我可以吃一份炖菜吗？ [wo ke yi chi yi fen dun cai ma ？]

english: Absolutely! They're 20 coins these days.
translation: 绝对地！现在是20个硬币。 [jue dui di ！ xian zai shi 20 ge ying bi 。]

english: Oh, I can't afford that right now.
translation: 哦，我现在买不起。 [o ， wo xian zai mai bu qi 。]

english: I'll pass, thanks.
translation: 我会过去的，谢谢。 [wo hui guo qu de ， xie xie 。]

english: Can we talk about rumours?
