translation: 这是韦斯。几年前，在我们被从更南边的洞穴里赶出来之后，巨魔们建造了它。现在Weiss是我们的家。 [zhe shi wei si 。 ji nian qian ， zai wo men bei cong geng nan bian de dong xue li gan chu lai zhi hou ， ju mo men jian zao le ta 。 xian zai Weiss shi wo men de jia 。]

english: We done pretty good here. Got lots of goat and wolf to eat - they taste kinda boring after all this time, but there not much other choice.
translation: 我们在这里做得很好。有很多山羊和狼可以吃——这么长时间以来它们尝起来有点无聊，但没有太多其他选择。 [wo men zai zhe li zuo de hen hao 。 you hen duo shan yang he lang ke yi chi —— zhe me zhang shi jian yi lai ta men chang qi lai you dian wu liao ， dan mei you tai duo qi ta xuan ze 。]

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it. In fact My Arm is an expert on growing the stuff.
translation: 尝试过古古草吗？我知道喜欢它的巨魔。事实上，我的手臂是种植这些东西的专家。 [chang shi guo gu gu cao ma ？ wo zhi dao xi huan ta de ju mo 。 shi shi shang ， wo de shou bi shi zhong zhi zhe xie dong xi de zhuan jia 。]

english: Never heard of no gouty weed, no. But it sound like a vegetable, an' Mother not like eating those, so we probably not gonna try it.
translation: 从来没有听说过没有痛风草，没有。但它听起来像一种蔬菜，妈妈不喜欢吃那些，所以我们可能不会尝试。 [cong lai mei you ting shuo guo mei you tong feng cao ， mei you 。 dan ta ting qi lai xiang yi zhong shu cai ， ma ma bu xi huan chi na xie ， suo yi wo men ke neng bu hui chang shi 。]

english: Mother not like new ideas much, but he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: 妈妈不太喜欢新想法，但他真的很大，而且是老板，所以我们就照他说的做。 [ma ma bu tai xi huan xin xiang fa ， dan ta zhen de hen da ， er qie shi lao ban ， suo yi wo men jiu zhao ta shuo de zuo 。]

english: I see.
translation: 我懂了。 [wo dong le 。]

english: Do you like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这里吗？ [ni xi huan zhe li ma ？]

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it our home. Odd Mushroom say he can make it nicer with fancy fires what he invented, but Mother not interested in that, so Odd Mushroom not allowed to do it.
translation: 呃，虽然有点简陋，但那是我们的家。奇蘑菇说他可以用他发明的奇特的火把它做得更好，但妈妈对此不感兴趣，所以奇蘑菇不被允许这样做。 [e ， sui ran you dian jian lou ， dan na shi wo men de jia 。 qi mo gu shuo ta ke yi yong ta fa ming de qi te de huo ba ta zuo de geng hao ， dan ma ma dui ci bu gan xing qu ， suo yi qi mo gu bu bei yun xu zhe yang zuo 。]

english: Mother only care about stuff to help him fight better. An he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: 母亲只关心帮助他更好地战斗的东西。他真的很大，他是老板，所以我们就按他说的做。 [mu qin zhi guan xin bang zhu ta geng hao di zhan dou de dong xi 。 ta zhen de hen da ， ta shi lao ban ， suo yi wo men jiu an ta shuo de zuo 。]

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我就走了。 [wo jiu zou le 。]

english: Hey, friend of Snowflake!
translation: 嘿，雪花的朋友！ [hei ， xue hua de peng you ！]

english: Just a guard. If sneaky human come in here without permission, I chuck rocks at 'em, knock 'em out and chuck 'em out of Weiss.
translation: 只是一个守卫。如果偷偷摸摸的人类未经允许进入这里，我会向他们扔石头，将他们击倒，然后将他们从韦斯身上扔出去。 [zhi shi yi ge shou wei 。 ru guo tou tou mo mo de ren lei wei jing yun xu jin ru zhe li ， wo hui xiang ta men reng shi tou ， jiang ta men ji dao ， ran hou jiang ta men cong wei si shen shang reng chu qu 。]

english: It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: 这里太棒了，现在雪花和她丈夫巨魔教我们种植古风草。现在食物好多了。 [zhe li tai bang le ， xian zai xue hua he ta zhang fu ju mo jiao wo men zhong zhi gu feng cao 。 xian zai shi wu hao duo le 。]

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: 嗯，虽然有点粗糙，但是正在好起来。雪花，她教我们种植古风草。山羊、狼、人类的味道都因加入了古藤而变得更加美味。 [n ， sui ran you dian cu cao ， dan shi zheng zai hao qi lai 。 xue hua ， ta jiao wo men zhong zhi gu feng cao 。 shan yang 、 lang 、 ren lei de wei dao dou yin jia ru le gu teng er bian de geng jia mei wei 。]

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: 所以，是的，韦斯是一个很好的居住地，现在由雪花负责。所有的巨魔都像雪花一样。她的丈夫巨魔有点奇怪，但这不是我们的问题。 [suo yi ， shi de ， wei si shi yi ge hen hao de ju zhu di ， xian zai you xue hua fu ze 。 suo you de ju mo dou xiang xue hua yi yang 。 ta de zhang fu ju mo you dian qi guai ， dan zhe bu shi wo men de wen ti 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 告诉我这个地方。 [gao su wo zhe ge di fang 。]

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it.
translation: 尝试过古古草吗？我知道喜欢它的巨魔。 [chang shi guo gu gu cao ma ？ wo zhi dao xi huan ta de ju mo 。]

english: I see.
translation: 我懂了。 [wo dong le 。]

english: Do you like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这里吗？ [ni xi huan zhe li ma ？]

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我就走了。 [wo jiu zou le 。]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 你知道，打招呼的方式有很多种。你好，你好，你好…… [ni zhi dao ， da zhao hu de fang shi you hen duo zhong 。 ni hao ， ni hao ， ni hao ……]

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 那还是只能算一个！ [na hai shi zhi neng suan yi ge ！]

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。你今天怎么样？ [ni hao 。 ni jin tian zen me yang ？]

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很棒，谢谢你！ [wo hen bang ， xie xie ni ！]

english: Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 你好！水晶城里今天过得怎么样啊？ [ni hao ！ shui jing cheng li jin tian guo de zen me yang a ？]

english: Indeed.
translation: 的确。 [di que 。]

english: What can I do for ya?
translation: 我能为你做什么？ [wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 各种各样的事情！这些塔楼是一个美妙的景观。 [ge zhong ge yang de shi qing ！ zhe xie ta lou shi yi ge mei miao de jing guan 。]

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 在像今天这样的日子，我建议您参观市场。 [zai xiang jin tian zhe yang de ri zi ， wo jian yi nin can guan shi chang 。]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你认为你在做什么？ [ni ren wei ni zai zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: Halt human! What are you doing here?
translation: 人类住手！你在这里做什么？ [ren lei zhu shou ！ ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Wait! What was that? What the...
translation: 等待！那是什么？什么... [deng dai ！ na shi shen me ？ shen me ...]

english: Would you like to buy or sell anything?
translation: 您想购买或出售任何东西吗？ [nin xiang gou mai huo chu shou ren he dong xi ma ？]

english: Yes, please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Yes, please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello Iffie!
translation: 你好伊菲！ [ni hao yi fei ！]

english: Sorry, dearie, if I stop to chat I'll lose count. Talk to my sister instead; she likes to chat. You'll find her upstairs in the church.
translation: 抱歉，亲爱的，如果我停下来聊天，我就会数不清了。而是和我姐姐谈谈；她喜欢聊天。你会在教堂楼上找到她。 [bao qian ， qin ai de ， ru guo wo ting xia lai liao tian ， wo jiu hui shu bu qing le 。 er shi he wo jie jie tan tan ； ta xi huan liao tian 。 ni hui zai jiao tang lou shang zhao dao ta 。]

english: Hello Iffie, remember our adventure?
translation: 你好，伊菲，还记得我们的冒险吗？ [ni hao ， yi fei ， hai ji de wo men de mao xian ma ？]

english: Me, forget? Never! I still hear the ringing in my head when I go to sleep sometimes!
translation: 我，忘了吗？绝不！有时候睡觉的时候脑子里还会有嗡嗡声！ [wo ， wang le ma ？ jue bu ！ you shi hou shui jiao de shi hou nao zi li hai hui you weng weng sheng ！]

english: From the rolling pin and saucepan?
translation: 来自擀面杖和平底锅？ [lai zi gan mian zhang he ping di guo ？]

english: Yes, it was surprisingly loud doing that.
translation: 是的，这样做的声音令人惊讶。 [shi de ， zhe yang zuo de sheng yin ling ren jing ya 。]

english: I don't know if it is that surprising. You were banging a metal saucepan on your head!
translation: 我不知道这是否有那么令人惊讶。你用金属平底锅敲你的头！ [wo bu zhi dao zhe shi fou you na me ling ren jing ya 。 ni yong jin shu ping di guo qiao ni de tou ！]

english: Hello dearie, of course I remember it!
translation: 你好，亲爱的，我当然记得！ [ni hao ， qin ai de ， wo dang ran ji de ！]

english: I dream about it sometimes, especially sneaking into the Blue Moon Inn kitchens for the rolling pin and saucepan!
translation: 我有时会梦见它，尤其是偷偷溜进蓝月旅馆的厨房拿擀面杖和平底锅！ [wo you shi hui meng jian ta ， you qi shi tou tou liu jin lan yue lv guan de chu fang na gan mian zhang he ping di guo ！]

english: Although probably best I don't do that again, I still feel bad for the chef.
translation: 虽然我最好不要再这样做了，但我仍然为厨师感到难过。 [sui ran wo zui hao bu yao zai zhe yang zuo le ， dan wo reng ran wei chu shi gan dao nan guo 。]

english: Yes, probably best we don't!
translation: 是的，我们最好不要这样做！ [shi de ， wo men zui hao bu yao zhe yang zuo ！]

english: I don't only remember it, I remember it fondly, I loved it!
translation: 我不仅记得它，我还记得它，我喜欢它！ [wo bu jin ji de ta ， wo hai ji de ta ， wo xi huan ta ！]

english: It was a good adventure wasn't it!
translation: 这是一次很好的冒险不是吗！ [zhe shi yi ci hen hao de mao xian bu shi ma ！]

english: Yes, very. I'm so happy that you picked me to help you.
translation: 是的，非常。我很高兴你选择我来帮助你。 [shi de ， fei chang 。 wo hen gao xing ni xuan ze wo lai bang zhu ni 。]

english: I couldn't have picked anyone else, you were the perfect accomplice!
translation: 我不可能选择其他人，你就是完美的同谋！ [wo bu ke neng xuan ze qi ta ren ， ni jiu shi wan mei de tong mou ！]

english: Thank you, dearie!
translation: 谢谢你，亲爱的！ [xie xie ni ， qin ai de ！]

english: Of course dearie! How could I ever forget it? I had such a great time.
translation: 当然啦亲爱的！我怎么可能忘记呢？我度过了一段美好的时光。 [dang ran la qin ai de ！ wo zen me ke neng wang ji ne ？ wo du guo le yi duan mei hao de shi guang 。]

english: Are you still adventuring?
translation: 你还在冒险吗？ [ni hai zai mao xian ma ？]

english: I am doing my best to adventure. There are just so many things to do!
translation: 我正在尽我最大的努力去冒险。有很多事情要做！ [wo zheng zai jin wo zui da de nu li qu mao xian 。 you hen duo shi qing yao zuo ！]

english: Well keep it up, don't let an old lady like me distract you. I've had my fill of adventure now!
translation: 好吧，坚持下去，别让像我这样的老太太分散你的注意力。我现在已经完成了冒险！ [hao ba ， jian chi xia qu ， bie rang xiang wo zhe yang de lao tai tai fen san ni de zhu yi li 。 wo xian zai yi jing wan cheng le mao xian ！]

english: There is no way I could forget it. Thank you for letting me come on such an adventure!
translation: 我不可能忘记它。谢谢你让我经历这样的冒险！ [wo bu ke neng wang ji ta 。 xie xie ni rang wo jing li zhe yang de mao xian ！]

english: It was my pleasure, maybe we could do it again some day!
translation: 这是我的荣幸，也许有一天我们可以再做一次！ [zhe shi wo de rong xing ， ye xu you yi tian wo men ke yi zai zuo yi ci ！]

english: That would be lovely dearie, but maybe we go on one that doesn't involve climbing trees?
translation: 那会很可爱，亲爱的，但也许我们会继续做一个不涉及爬树的活动？ [na hui hen ke ai ， qin ai de ， dan ye xu wo men hui ji xu zuo yi ge bu she ji pa shu de huo dong ？]

english: I'm getting a bit old for that!
translation: 我已经有点老了！ [wo yi jing you dian lao le ！]

english: How could I not? It was amazing! I see you're still wearing that jumper I knitted you.
translation: 我怎么能不呢？太棒了！我看到你还穿着我给你织的那件毛衣。 [wo zen me neng bu ne ？ tai bang le ！ wo kan dao ni hai chuan zhe wo gei ni zhi de na jian mao yi 。]

english: It's lovely, very versatile. Even keeps me warm in the coldest of places!
translation: 它很可爱，非常多才多艺。即使在最冷的地方也能让我感到温暖！ [ta hen ke ai ， fei chang duo cai duo yi 。 ji shi zai zui leng de di fang ye neng rang wo gan dao wen nuan ！]

english: That is good to hear. Do you have a favourite way to wear it?
translation: 很高兴听到这个消息。你有最喜欢的穿搭方式吗？ [hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi 。 ni you zui xi huan de chuan da fang shi ma ？]

english: I like the orange version the best!
translation: 我最喜欢橙色版本！ [wo zui xi huan cheng se ban ben ！]

english: I like it too! It reminds me of pumpkins and spooky things, just like our adventure!
translation: 我也喜欢！它让我想起南瓜和怪异的东西，就像我们的冒险一样！ [wo ye xi huan ！ ta rang wo xiang qi nan gua he guai yi de dong xi ， jiu xiang wo men de mao xian yi yang ！]

english: I like the black version the best!
translation: 我最喜欢黑色版本！ [wo zui xi huan hei se ban ben ！]

english: I like it too! It's pretty scary looking, just like how we saw Death in our adventure!
translation: 我也喜欢！它看起来非常可怕，就像我们在冒险中看到的死亡一样！ [wo ye xi huan ！ ta kan qi lai fei chang ke pa ， jiu xiang wo men zai mao xian zhong kan dao de si wang yi yang ！]

english: Sorry, dearie, if I stop to chat I'll lose count.
translation: 抱歉，亲爱的，如果我停下来聊天，我就会数不清了。 [bao qian ， qin ai de ， ru guo wo ting xia lai liao tian ， wo jiu hui shu bu qing le 。]

english: Hello Iffie!
translation: 你好伊菲！ [ni hao yi fei ！]

english: Hello Iffie, remember our adventure?
translation: 你好，伊菲，还记得我们的冒险吗？ [ni hao ， yi fei ， hai ji de wo men de mao xian ma ？]

english: Orange.
translation: 橙子。 [cheng zi 。]

english: Black.
translation: 黑色的。 [hei se de 。]

english: Can I help you at all?
translation: 我可以帮助你吗？ [wo ke yi bang zhu ni ma ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: My name is Ignatius Vulcan. Once I was - like you - an adventurer, but that was before I realised the beauty and power of flame! Just look at this...
translation: 我的名字是伊格纳修斯·瓦肯。曾经我和你一样是一名冒险家，但那是在我意识到火焰的美丽和力量之前！看看这个... [wo de ming zi shi yi ge na xiu si · wa ken 。 ceng jing wo he ni yi yang shi yi ming mao xian jia ， dan na shi zai wo yi shi dao huo yan de mei li he li liang zhi qian ！ kan kan zhe ge ...]

english: Yeeouch!
translation: 哎呀！ [ai ya ！]

english: Stare into the flame and witness the purity and power of fire! As my attraction to flame grew, so did my skills at firelighting. I began to neglect my combat skills, my Mining skills and my questing. Who needs such
translation: 凝视火焰，见证火焰的纯粹与力量！随着我对火焰的兴趣不断增强，我的生火技能也随之增强。我开始忽视我的战斗技能、采矿技能和探索技能。谁需要这样的 [ning shi huo yan ， jian zheng huo yan de chun cui yu li liang ！ sui zhe wo dui huo yan de xing qu bu duan zeng qiang ， wo de sheng huo ji neng ye sui zhi zeng qiang 。 wo kai shi hu shi wo de zhan dou ji neng 、 cai kuang ji neng he tan suo ji neng 。 shui xu yao zhe yang de]

english: mundane skills when one can harness the power of fire? After years of practice I am now the acknowledged Master of Flame! Everything must be purified by fire!
translation: 当一个人能够驾驭火的力量时，这是多么平凡的技能呢？经过多年的练习，我现在是公认的火焰大师！一切都必须用火来净化！ [dang yi ge ren neng gou jia yu huo de li liang shi ， zhe shi duo me ping fan de ji neng ne ？ jing guo duo nian de lian xi ， wo xian zai shi gong ren de huo yan da shi ！ yi qie dou bi xu yong huo lai jing hua ！]

english: Okaaaay! Err, I'll be going now. Umm, get better soon.
translation: 好吧！呃，我现在就走。嗯，快点好起来吧。 [hao ba ！ e ， wo xian zai jiu zou 。 n ， kuai dian hao qi lai ba 。]

english: What is that cape you're wearing?
translation: 你穿的那件斗篷是什么？ [ni chuan de na jian dou peng shi shen me ？]

english: This is a Skillcape of Firemaking, so bright that wearing it lights up caves! I was given it in recognition of my skill as the greatest firemaker in the lands! I AM the Master of Flame!
translation: 这是制火技能斗篷，穿上它可以照亮洞穴！我被授予这个称号是为了表彰我作为这片土地上最伟大的点火者的技能！我是火焰之主！ [zhe shi zhi huo ji neng dou peng ， chuan shang ta ke yi zhao liang dong xue ！ wo bei shou yu zhe ge cheng hao shi wei le biao zhang wo zuo wei zhe pian tu di shang zui wei da de dian huo zhe de ji neng ！ wo shi huo yan zhi zhu ！]

english: Hmm, I'll be going now. Keep a sharp look out for those men with their white jackets!
translation: 嗯，我现在就去。留意那些穿着白色夹克的男人！ [n ， wo xian zai jiu qu 。 liu yi na xie chuan zhe bai se jia ke de nan ren ！]

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Okay, keep the fire burning.
translation: 好吧，让火继续燃烧。 [hao ba ， rang huo ji xu ran shao 。]

english: Can I buy a Skillcape of Firemaking?
translation: 我可以购买制火技能斗篷吗？ [wo ke yi gou mai zhi huo ji neng dou peng ma ？]

english: Of course you can. You are already a master of fire, you just need the cape to prove it. The cape is so bright that wearing it will light up dark caves. That'll be 99000 coins, please.
translation: 当然可以。你已经是火焰大师了，你只需要披风来证明这一点。斗篷非常明亮，穿上它可以照亮黑暗的洞穴。请给我 99000 个硬币。 [dang ran ke yi 。 ni yi jing shi huo yan da shi le ， ni zhi xu yao pi feng lai zheng ming zhe yi dian 。 dou peng fei chang ming liang ， chuan shang ta ke yi zhao liang hei an de dong xue 。 qing gei wo  99000  ge ying bi 。]

english: No thanks, that's too much.
translation: 不，谢谢，这太多了。 [bu ， xie xie ， zhe tai duo le 。]

english: Sorry to hear that, I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 很遗憾听到这个消息，如果你改变主意，我会在这里。 [hen yi han ting dao zhe ge xiao xi ， ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， wo hui zai zhe li 。]

english: Okay, that seems reasonable.
translation: 好吧，这似乎很合理。 [hao ba ， zhe si hu hen he li 。]

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 但不幸的是，我身上没有足够的钱。 [dan bu xing de shi ， wo shen shang mei you zu gou de qian 。]

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 好吧，等你回来了就回来见我吧。 [hao ba ， deng ni hui lai le jiu hui lai jian wo ba 。]

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 不幸的是，所有技能斗篷都只提供免费兜帽，这是技能升级交易的一部分；买一送一，你懂的。因此，在我向您出售一件之前，您需要释放一些库存空间。 [bu xing de shi ， suo you ji neng dou peng dou zhi ti gong mian fei dou mao ， zhe shi ji neng sheng ji jiao yi de yi bu fen ； mai yi song yi ， ni dong de 。 yin ci ， zai wo xiang nin chu shou yi jian zhi qian ， nin xu yao shi fang yi xie ku cun kong jian 。]

english: I'm sure you'll look hot in that cape.
translation: 我相信你穿上那件斗篷会看起来很性感。 [wo xiang xin ni chuan shang na jian dou peng hui kan qi lai hen xing gan 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: 请问我可以再给我的披风戴上兜帽吗？ [qing wen wo ke yi zai gei wo de pi feng dai shang dou mao ma ？]

english: You don't appear to have enough space in your inventory, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 您的库存似乎没有足够的空间，当您有足够的空间时请回来见我。 [nin de ku cun si hu mei you zu gou de kong jian ， dang nin you zu gou de kong jian shi qing hui lai jian wo 。]

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
translation: 毫无疑问，而且免费！ [hao wu yi wen ， er qie mian fei ！]

english: What is that cape you're wearing?
translation: 你穿的那件斗篷是什么？ [ni chuan de na jian dou peng shi shen me ？]

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Can I buy a Skillcape of Firemaking?
translation: 我可以购买制火技能斗篷吗？ [wo ke yi gou mai zhi huo ji neng dou peng ma ？]

english: No thanks, that's too much.
translation: 不，谢谢，这太多了。 [bu ， xie xie ， zhe tai duo le 。]

english: Okay, that seems reasonable.
translation: 好吧，这似乎很合理。 [hao ba ， zhe si hu hen he li 。]

english: Skillcape
translation: 技能角 [ji neng jiao]

english: Hood
translation: 兜帽 [dou mao]

english: Welcome, [brother/sister/my child].
translation: 欢迎，[兄弟/姐妹/我的孩子]。 [huan ying ，[ xiong di / jie mei / wo de hai zi ]。]

english: Er... Are we related?
translation: 呃……我们有关系吗？ [e …… wo men you guan xi ma ？]

english: We are all related, [brother/sister/my child], for we are all children of the flame.
translation: 我们都是相关的，[兄弟/姐妹/我的孩子]，因为我们都是火焰之子。 [wo men dou shi xiang guan de ，[ xiong di / jie mei / wo de hai zi ]， yin wei wo men dou shi huo yan zhi zi 。]

english: Okayyy...
translation: 好吧... [hao ba ...]

english: So what is this place?
translation: 那么这个地方是什么？ [na me zhe ge di fang shi shen me ？]

english: You stand before the Doors of Dinh. Behind them lies the prison of the Wintertodt.
translation: 你站在丁之门前。他们身后是温特托特的监狱。 [ni zhan zai ding zhi men qian 。 ta men shen hou shi wen te tuo te de jian yu 。]

english: What's a Wintertodt?
translation: 什么是温特托？ [shen me shi wen te tuo ？]

english: We do not know what it is. All we know is that it threatens to snuff out every flame in this land and plunge the world into eternal darkness.
translation: 我们不知道它是什么。我们所知道的是，它有可能扑灭这片土地上的每一缕火焰，让世界陷入永恒的黑暗。 [wo men bu zhi dao ta shi shen me 。 wo men suo zhi dao de shi ， ta you ke neng pu mie zhe pian tu di shang de mei yi lv huo yan ， rang shi jie xian ru yong heng de hei an 。]

english: Oh dear... We should probably do something about that.
translation: 哦天哪...我们也许应该对此做点什么。 [o tian na ... wo men ye xu ying gai dui ci zuo dian shen me 。]

english: That is why we are here, [brother/sister/my child]. Ever since the Wintertodt was imprisoned, members of the Order of the Sacred Flame, or Pyromancers as we're often known, have stood vigil over this place.
translation: 这就是我们在这里的原因，[兄弟/姐妹/我的孩子]。自从温特托特被囚禁以来，圣火骑士团（或者我们常说的火术士）的成员就一直在这个地方守夜。 [zhe jiu shi wo men zai zhe li de yuan yin ，[ xiong di / jie mei / wo de hai zi ]。 zi cong wen te tuo te bei qiu jin yi lai ， sheng huo qi shi tuan （ huo zhe wo men chang shuo de huo shu shi ） de cheng yuan jiu yi zhi zai zhe ge di fang shou ye 。]

english: But alas, despite our best efforts, the Wintertodt is growing in power again.
translation: 但遗憾的是，尽管我们尽了最大努力，温特托特的力量却再次增强。 [dan yi han de shi ， jin guan wo men jin le zui da nu li ， wen te tuo te de li liang que zai ci zeng qiang 。]

english: Well that's just no good. Is there anything I can do to help?
translation: 好吧，那是不行的。有什么我可以帮忙的吗？ [hao ba ， na shi bu xing de 。 you shen me wo ke yi bang mang de ma ？]

english: Our order searches tirelessly for a way to defeat the Wintertodt. Until we discover it, the Wintertodt must be held at bay.
translation: 我们的命令不知疲倦地寻找击败温特托特的方法。在我们发现它之前，必须阻止温特托特。 [wo men de ming ling bu zhi pi juan di xun zhao ji bai wen te tuo te de fang fa 。 zai wo men fa xian ta zhi qian ， bi xu zu zhi wen te tuo te 。]

english: However, I fear your abilities are not great enough to withstand the cold of the Wintertodt. Learn the ways of the sacred flame and then return to me.
translation: 不过，我担心你的能力还不足以抵御温特托特的寒冷。学习神圣火焰之道，然后回到我身边。 [bu guo ， wo dan xin ni de neng li hai bu zu yi di yu wen te tuo te de han leng 。 xue xi shen sheng huo yan zhi dao ， ran hou hui dao wo shen bian 。]

english: You require at least 50 Firemaking to take on the Wintertodt.
translation: 您需要至少 50 点生火才能对抗 Wintertodt。 [nin xu yao zhi shao  50  dian sheng huo cai neng dui kang  Wintertodt。]

english: Pass through the Doors of Dinh to the prison within. You will find the finest of our order channeling the power of the sacred flame into the Wintertodt.
translation: 穿过 Dinh 之门，到达里面的监狱。你会发现我们骑士团中最优秀的人将神圣火焰的力量引入温特托特。 [chuan guo  Dinh  zhi men ， dao da li mian de jian yu 。 ni hui fa xian wo men qi shi tuan zhong zui you xiu de ren jiang shen sheng huo yan de li liang yin ru wen te tuo te 。]

english: Help them keep the holy fires lit so that they can keep the Wintertodt subdued.
translation: 帮助他们点燃圣火，这样就能制服温特托特。 [bang zhu ta men dian ran sheng huo ， zhe yang jiu neng zhi fu wen te tuo te 。]

english: How can I do that?
translation: 我怎样才能做到这一点？ [wo zen yang cai neng zuo dao zhe yi dian ？]

english: You will find the roots of the great Bruma tree have crept into the prison. Chop the roots and use them to keep the sacred flame alive.
translation: 你会发现巨大的布鲁玛树的根部已经爬进了监狱。砍掉根部并用它们来保持神圣火焰的活力。 [ni hui fa xian ju da de bu lu ma shu de gen bu yi jing pa jin le jian yu 。 kan diao gen bu bing yong ta men lai bao chi shen sheng huo yan de huo li 。]

english: Anything else?
translation: 还要别的吗？ [hai yao bie de ma ？]

english: You can use the herbs of the Bruma tree to make Rejuvenation potions. Give these to any of our order who fall to the cold of the Wintertodt before they succumb to the darkness.
translation: 您可以使用布鲁玛树的草药来制作回春药水。在我们的教团成员屈服于黑暗之前，将这些东西交给那些在温特托特的寒冷中倒下的人。 [nin ke yi shi yong bu lu ma shu de cao yao lai zhi zuo hui chun yao shui 。 zai wo men de jiao tuan cheng yuan qu fu yu hei an zhi qian ， jiang zhe xie dong xi jiao gei na xie zai wen te tuo te de han leng zhong dao xia de ren 。]

english: How else may I be of assistance?
translation: 我还能提供什么帮助？ [wo hai neng ti gong shen me bang zhu ？]

english: Tell me about the Wintertodt.
translation: 告诉我关于温特托特的事。 [gao su wo guan yu wen te tuo te de shi 。]

english: Do you feel the winds of winter as they lick across the land? This is the power of the Wintertodt. We know not what it is nor from where it came. Only that it wields the power of Winter itself.
translation: 当冬天的风吹过大地时，你感受到了吗？这就是Wintertodt的力量。我们不知道它是什么，也不知道它来自哪里。只是它掌握着冬天本身的力量。 [dang dong tian de feng chui guo da di shi ， ni gan shou dao le ma ？ zhe jiu shi Wintertodt de li liang 。 wo men bu zhi dao ta shi shen me ， ye bu zhi dao ta lai zi na li 。 zhi shi ta zhang wo zhe dong tian ben shen de li liang 。]

english: The ground on which we stand was once full of light, full of life. But then the Wintertodt came. Now the fires of these lands burn no more.
translation: 我们脚下的土地曾经充满光明，充满生机。但后来温特托来了。现在这些土地上的火不再燃烧了。 [wo men jiao xia de tu di ceng jing chong man guang ming ， chong man sheng ji 。 dan hou lai wen te tuo lai le 。 xian zai zhe xie tu di shang de huo bu zai ran shao le 。]

english: Tell me about the Pyromancers.
translation: 告诉我关于火法师的事。 [gao su wo guan yu huo fa shi de shi 。]

english: We are the Order of the Sacred Flame, formed over a thousand years ago when the Wintertodt first threatened Great Kourend.
translation: 我们是圣火骑士团，成立于一千多年前，当时温特托特第一次威胁大库伦德。 [wo men shi sheng huo qi shi tuan ， cheng li yu yi qian duo nian qian ， dang shi wen te tuo te di yi ci wei xie da ku lun de 。]

english: We fought against the Wintertodt until we managed to lure it behind Dinh's great Doors. Our task did not end there though, for we always knew that the Wintertodt would rise again.
translation: 我们与温特托特作战，直到我们成功地将它引诱到丁的大门后面。但我们的任务并没有就此结束，因为我们一直知道温特托特会再次崛起。 [wo men yu wen te tuo te zuo zhan ， zhi dao wo men cheng gong di jiang ta yin you dao ding de da men hou mian 。 dan wo men de ren wu bing mei you jiu ci jie shu ， yin wei wo men yi zhi zhi dao wen te tuo te hui zai ci jue qi 。]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: I am Ignisia, Grand Master of the Order of the Sacred Flame. I have served our Order faithfully since I passed the Trials of Fire before the Ascent of Arceuus.
translation: 我是伊格尼西亚，圣火骑士团的最高团长。自从我在阿尔宙斯登顶之前通过了火焰试炼以来，我就一直忠实地服务于我们的骑士团。 [wo shi yi ge ni xi ya ， sheng huo qi shi tuan de zui gao tuan zhang 。 zi cong wo zai a er zhou si deng ding zhi qian tong guo le huo yan shi lian yi lai ， wo jiu yi zhi zhong shi di fu wu yu wo men de qi shi tuan 。]

english: What can I do to help?
translation: 我能提供什么帮助吗？ [wo neng ti gong shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: You are not currently strong enough to face the Wintertodt. Learn the ways of the sacred flame and then return here.
translation: 你目前的实力还不足以面对 Wintertodt。学习神圣火焰之道，然后返回这里。 [ni mu qian de shi li hai bu zu yi mian dui  Wintertodt。 xue xi shen sheng huo yan zhi dao ， ran hou fan hui zhe li 。]

english: We must hold back the Wintertodt until we can find a way to defeat it. Head into the prison and keep the holy fires lit so that our order may keep the evil at bay.
translation: 我们必须阻止温特托特，直到找到击败它的方法。前往监狱并点燃圣火，以便我们的命令能够阻止邪恶。 [wo men bi xu zu zhi wen te tuo te ， zhi dao zhao dao ji bai ta de fang fa 。 qian wang jian yu bing dian ran sheng huo ， yi bian wo men de ming ling neng gou zu zhi xie e 。]

english: The Wintertodt is no longer growing in strength but it still needs to be held back. Head into the prison and keep the holy fires lit so that our order may keep the evil at bay.
translation: 温特托特的力量不再增长，但仍然需要遏制。前往监狱并点燃圣火，以便我们的命令能够阻止邪恶。 [wen te tuo te de li liang bu zai zeng zhang ， dan reng ran xu yao e zhi 。 qian wang jian yu bing dian ran sheng huo ， yi bian wo men de ming ling neng gou zu zhi xie e 。]

english: I'm fine thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: May the sacred flame guide you, [brother/sister/my child].
translation: 愿神圣的火焰引导你，[兄弟/姐妹/我的孩子]。 [yuan shen sheng de huo yan yin dao ni ，[ xiong di / jie mei / wo de hai zi ]。]

english: Welcome back, [brother/sister/my child]. How may I be of assistance?
translation: 欢迎回来，[兄弟/姐妹/我的孩子]。我可以如何提供帮助？ [huan ying hui lai ，[ xiong di / jie mei / wo de hai zi ]。 wo ke yi ru he ti gong bang zhu ？]

english: I get hayfever. Please take those flowers away.
translation: 我得了花粉热。请把那些花拿走。 [wo de le hua fen re 。 qing ba na xie hua na zou 。]

english: I would not appreciate your traps near the bank. Please take them away.
translation: 我不喜欢你在银行附近设置陷阱。请把它们带走。 [wo bu xi huan ni zai yin hang fu jin she zhi xian jing 。 qing ba ta men dai zou 。]

english: Tell me about the Wintertodt.
translation: 告诉我关于温特托特的事。 [gao su wo guan yu wen te tuo te de shi 。]

english: Tell me about the Pyromancers.
translation: 告诉我关于火法师的事。 [gao su wo guan yu huo fa shi de shi 。]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: What can I do to help?
translation: 我能提供什么帮助吗？ [wo neng ti gong shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: I'm fine thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: So... you're alchemical; does that mean I can turn you into gold?
translation: 所以...你是炼金术士；这是否意味着我可以将你变成金子？ [suo yi ... ni shi lian jin shu shi ； zhe shi fou yi wei zhe wo ke yi jiang ni bian cheng jin zi ？]

english: No, I like my form as it is.
translation: 不，我喜欢我现在的样子。 [bu ， wo xi huan wo xian zai de yang zi 。]

english: But... I love gold.
translation: 但是...我喜欢黄金。 [dan shi ... wo xi huan huang jin 。]

english: I'll turn to gold when drakes fly.
translation: 当龙飞翔时，我会变成黄金。 [dang long fei xiang shi ， wo hui bian cheng huang jin 。]

english: How do you ever agree on what to do?
translation: 你们如何就该做什么达成一致？ [ni men ru he jiu gai zuo shen me da cheng yi zhi ？]

english: Well I’m in charge.
translation: 好吧，我负责。 [hao ba ， wo fu ze 。]

english: No, I am.
translation: 不，我是。 [bu ， wo shi 。]

english: Nope, I say what we do.
translation: 不，我说我们做什么。 [bu ， wo shuo wo men zuo shen me 。]

english: Really I control everything!
translation: 真的是我掌控一切！ [zhen de shi wo zhang kong yi qie ！]

english: Ok then!
translation: 那么好吧！ [na me hao ba ！]

english: So how was that chemical bath?!
translation: 那么化学浴怎么样？ [na me hua xue yu zen me yang ？]

english: Nasty! I don't want to do that again
translation: 可恶的！我不想再这样做了 [ke wu de ！ wo bu xiang zai zhe yang zuo le]

english: Which creature is cooler, Drakes, Hydras or Wyrms?
translation: 龙、九头蛇和巨龙哪个生物更酷？ [long 、 jiu tou she he ju long na ge sheng wu geng ku ？]

english: I may be biased in this situation... bit silly to ask me isn't it?
translation: 在这种情况下我可能有偏见……问我有点傻，不是吗？ [zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia wo ke neng you pian jian …… wen wo you dian sha ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Alright alright... don't lose your head.
translation: 好吧好吧……别失去理智。 [hao ba hao ba …… bie shi qu li zhi 。]

english: Grrr!
translation: 咕噜！ [gu lu ！]

english: Grrrr!
translation: 咕噜！ [gu lu ！]

english: Grarrr!
translation: 嘎嘎！ [ga ga ！]

english: *slap*
translation: *拍击* [* pai ji *]

english: Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: 嘿，这是英雄！哇！你太厉害了，你到底是怎么对付那两个少年和加德兰克的？这个小镇很可爱，你做得很好！ [hei ， zhe shi ying xiong ！ wa ！ ni tai li hai le ， ni dao di shi zen me dui fu na liang ge shao nian he jia de lan ke de ？ zhe ge xiao zhen hen ke ai ， ni zuo de hen hao ！]

english: You're more than welcome.
translation: 非常欢迎您。 [fei chang huan ying nin 。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Oh, my name's Ileana, I just help out around here, you know, look for food and so on.
translation: 哦，我叫伊莱安娜，我只是在这附近帮忙，你知道，寻找食物等等。 [o ， wo jiao yi lai an na ， wo zhi shi zai zhe fu jin bang mang ， ni zhi dao ， xun zhao shi wu deng deng 。]

english: How do you like your town?
translation: 你喜欢你的城市吗？ [ni xi huan ni de cheng shi ma ？]

english: It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
translation: 非常完美，非常感谢您的努力。 [fei chang wan mei ， fei chang gan xie nin de nu li 。]

english: What's happening around here?
translation: 这附近发生了什么事？ [zhe fu jin fa sheng le shen me shi ？]

english: Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: 哦，其实也没什么，我们都还在躲避吸血鬼，在这个可怕的地方勉强维持生计，希望很快我们就能足够强大，踏上前往圣殿的旅程。 [o ， qi shi ye mei shen me ， wo men dou hai zai duo bi xi xue gui ， zai zhe ge ke pa de di fang mian qiang wei chi sheng ji ， xi wang hen kuai wo men jiu neng zu gou qiang da ， ta shang qian wang sheng dian de lv cheng 。]

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang mang de ma ？]

english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: 据我所知，我们现在有一些非常有用的基本设施，我们都非常感谢您。我以前从未真正见过或认识英雄，所以我没有什么可以与之比较的，但我怀疑 [ju wo suo zhi ， wo men xian zai you yi xie fei chang you yong de ji ben she shi ， wo men dou fei chang gan xie nin 。 wo yi qian cong wei zhen zheng jian guo huo ren shi ying xiong ， suo yi wo mei you shen me ke yi yu zhi bi jiao de ， dan wo huai yi]

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: 大多数人的判断，你就是其中之一！我很高兴见到你。 [da duo shu ren de pan duan ， ni jiu shi qi zhong zhi yi ！ wo hen gao xing jian dao ni 。]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: How do you like your town?
translation: 你喜欢你的城市吗？ [ni xi huan ni de cheng shi ma ？]

english: What's happening around here?
translation: 这附近发生了什么事？ [zhe fu jin fa sheng le shen me shi ？]

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang mang de ma ？]

english: Ok, thanks.

english: I'm just wandering, it's a lovely day for a walk in the woods.

translation: 当然！年轻的侏儒怎么样了？我比较喜欢他，他声音很大，但他有一颗善良的灵魂，并且对精灵魔法很感兴趣。 [dang ran ！ nian qing de zhu ru zen me yang le ？ wo bi jiao xi huan ta ， ta sheng yin hen da ， dan ta you yi ke shan liang de ling hun ， bing qie dui jing ling mo fa hen gan xing qu 。]

english: I think Oaknock died of old age some time ago. He must have visited you a few hundred years ago though...
translation: 我认为奥克诺克不久前就因年老而去世了。不过他一定在几百年前拜访过你…… [wo ren wei ao ke nuo ke bu jiu qian jiu yin nian lao er qu shi le 。 bu guo ta yi ding zai ji bai nian qian bai fang guo ni ……]

english: I keep forgetting, a hundred years is a long time for you. He was very interested in illusion magic, and how to prevent it. I gave him some advice and a few bits of equipment to help him.
translation: 我总是忘记，一百年对你来说是一段很长的时间。他对幻象魔法以及如何预防幻象魔法非常感兴趣。我给了他一些建议和一些设备来帮助他。 [wo zong shi wang ji ， yi bai nian dui ni lai shuo shi yi duan hen zhang de shi jian 。 ta dui huan xiang mo fa yi ji ru he yu fang huan xiang mo fa fei chang gan xing qu 。 wo gei le ta yi xie jian yi he yi xie she bei lai bang zhu ta 。]

english: A seed?
translation: 一颗种子？ [yi ke zhong zi ？]

translation: 当然。它长成了一把斧头。我希望他觉得这很有用。 [dang ran 。 ta zhang cheng le yi ba fu tou 。 wo xi wang ta jue de zhe hen you yong 。]

english: I think he did! Thanks.
translation: 我想他做到了！谢谢。 [wo xiang ta zuo dao le ！ xie xie 。]

english: Ilfeen smiles serenely.
translation: 伊尔芬平静地微笑着。 [yi er fen ping jing di wei xiao zhe 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hey ya, you're the human that helped my friend Islwyn, aren't you? He told me that he'd given you some crystal equipment.
translation: 嘿，你是帮助我朋友伊斯文的人，不是吗？他告诉我他给了你一些水晶装备。 [hei ， ni shi bang zhu wo peng you yi si wen de ren ， bu shi ma ？ ta gao su wo ta gei le ni yi xie shui jing zhuang bei 。]

english: That's right, why?
translation: 没错，为什么呢？ [mei cuo ， wei shen me ne ？]

english: When it reverts to seed, bring it to me and I'll chant it for you.
translation: 当它恢复为种子时，把它带给我，我会为你念诵它。 [dang ta hui fu wei zhong zi shi ， ba ta dai gei wo ， wo hui wei ni nian song ta 。]

english: It just happens I have a seed here, what can you do with it?
translation: 碰巧我这里有一颗种子，你能用它做什么？ [peng qiao wo zhe li you yi ke zhong zi ， ni neng yong ta zuo shen me ？]

english: I can only make shields and bows. I've been trying halberds but so far only Islwyn has succeeded.
translation: 我只能做盾牌和弓。我一直在尝试使用戟，但到目前为止只有伊斯文成功了。 [wo zhi neng zuo dun pai he gong 。 wo yi zhi zai chang shi shi yong ji ， dan dao mu qian wei zhi zhi you yi si wen cheng gong le 。]

english: How much for a shield?

translation: 因为这是我为你制作的第一个，所以需要 750,000 个硬币。当我了解你的共鸣时，费用应该会更便宜。 [yin wei zhe shi wo wei ni zhi zuo de di yi ge ， suo yi xu yao  750,000  ge ying bi 。 dang wo liao jie ni de gong ming shi ， fei yong ying gai hui geng pian yi 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: If it helps I have a book here that will tell you about crystal chanting.
translation: 如果有帮助的话，我这里有一本书会告诉你有关水晶念诵的知识。 [ru guo you bang zhu de hua ， wo zhe li you yi ben shu hui gao su ni you guan shui jing nian song de zhi shi 。]

english: As this is the first one I've made for you it will be 900,000 coins. The cost should get cheaper as I get to know your resonance.
translation: 因为这是我为你制作的第一个，所以需要 900,000 个金币。当我了解你的共鸣时，费用应该会更便宜。 [yin wei zhe shi wo wei ni zhi zuo de di yi ge ， suo yi xu yao  900,000  ge jin bi 。 dang wo liao jie ni de gong ming shi ， fei yong ying gai hui geng pian yi 。]

english: Ilfeen hands you a crystal bow.
translation: 伊尔芬递给你一把水晶弓。 [yi er fen di gei ni yi ba shui jing gong 。]

english: Hello again.
translation: 又好。 [you hao 。]

english: Hey.
translation: 嘿。 [hei 。]

english: Are you still offering to chant seeds?
translation: 你还在提议念诵种子吗？ [ni hai zai ti yi nian song zhong zi ma ？]

english: I am, but you'll need to supply the seed.
translation: 我是，但你需要提供种子。 [wo shi ， dan ni xu yao ti gong zhong zi 。]

english: I see we have removed some defunct crystal equipment from you recently. I would be happy to replace them for you, unless you want to buy them of course.
translation: 我看到我们最近从你身上移除了一些失效的水晶装备。我很乐意为您更换它们，当然，除非您想购买它们。 [wo kan dao wo men zui jin cong ni shen shang yi chu le yi xie shi xiao de shui jing zhuang bei 。 wo hen le yi wei nin geng huan ta men ， dang ran ， chu fei nin xiang gou mai ta men 。]

english: I can replace for you [amount] crystal bow(s), [amount] crystal shield(s) and [amount] crystal halberd(s).
translation: 我可以给你更换【数量】水晶弓、【数量】水晶盾、【数量】水晶戟。 [wo ke yi gei ni geng huan 【 shu liang 】 shui jing gong 、【 shu liang 】 shui jing dun 、【 shu liang 】 shui jing ji 。]

english: Which crystal item would you like?
translation: 您想要哪种水晶制品？ [nin xiang yao na zhong shui jing zhi pin ？]

english: Siphon the ether into a Crystal bow please.
translation: 请把乙醚吸进水晶弓里。 [qing ba yi mi xi jin shui jing gong li 。]

english: Siphon the ether into a Crystal halberd please.
translation: 请把以太吸进水晶戟里。 [qing ba yi tai xi jin shui jing ji li 。]

english: Siphon the ether into a Crystal shield please.
translation: 请把以太吸进水晶盾里。 [qing ba yi tai xi jin shui jing dun li 。]

english: While I'm here, I have a question for you.
translation: 当我在这里的时候，我有一个问题要问你。 [dang wo zai zhe li de shi hou ， wo you yi ge wen ti yao wen ni 。]

english: Well ask away.
translation: 好吧，问走吧。 [hao ba ， wen zou ba 。]

translation: 你还记得奥克诺克吗？他是一名侏儒发明家。 [ni hai ji de ao ke nuo ke ma ？ ta shi yi ming zhu ru fa ming jia 。]

english: Of course! How is the young gnome? I rather liked him. He was rather loud, but he had a good soul, and was very interested in elven magic.
translation: 当然！年轻的侏儒怎么样了？我比较喜欢他。他声音很大，但灵魂很好，对精灵魔法很感兴趣。 [dang ran ！ nian qing de zhu ru zen me yang le ？ wo bi jiao xi huan ta 。 ta sheng yin hen da ， dan ling hun hen hao ， dui jing ling mo fa hen gan xing qu 。]

english: Including a seed?
translation: 包括种子吗？ [bao kuo zhong zi ma ？]

english: Of course. It grew into a saw. I hope he found it useful.
translation: 当然。它长成了一把锯子。我希望他觉得这很有用。 [dang ran 。 ta zhang cheng le yi ba ju zi 。 wo xi wang ta jue de zhe hen you yong 。]

english: That sounds great.
translation: 听起来很棒。 [ting qi lai hen bang 。]

english: You are handed a book
translation: 递给你一本书 [di gei ni yi ben shu]

english: Thanks, I'll read all about it.
translation: 谢谢，我会阅读所有内容。 [xie xie ， wo hui yue du suo you nei rong 。]

english: Well, good luck.
translation: 好吧，祝你好运。 [hao ba ， zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: See you later.
translation: 稍后见。 [shao hou jian 。]

english: I don't need it, thanks.
translation: 我不需要，谢谢。 [wo bu xu yao ， xie xie 。]

translation: 我要买它。 [wo yao mai ta 。]

english: I can't afford that.
translation: 我买不起。 [wo mai bu qi 。]

translation: 弓多少钱？ [gong duo shao qian ？]

english: Crystal bow.
translation: 水晶弓。 [shui jing gong 。]

translation: 水晶戟。 [shui jing ji 。]

translation: 水晶盾。 [shui jing dun 。]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: That sounds great.
translation: 听起来很棒。 [ting qi lai hen bang 。]

english: I don't need it, thanks.
translation: 我不需要，谢谢。 [wo bu xu yao ， xie xie 。]

english: Hi!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Ooh. This is exciting!
translation: 哦。这太令人兴奋了！ [o 。 zhe tai ling ren xing fen le ！]

english: Yup!
translation: 是的！ [shi de ！]

english: I wouldn't want to be the poor guy that has to clean up after the duels.
translation: 我不想成为决斗后必须清理的可怜人。 [wo bu xiang cheng wei jue dou hou bi xu qing li de ke lian ren 。]

english: Me neither.
translation: 我也不。 [wo ye bu 。]

english: My son just won his first duel!
translation: 我儿子刚刚赢得了他的第一次决斗！ [wo er zi gang gang ying de le ta de di yi ci jue dou ！]

english: Congratulations!
translation: 恭喜！ [gong xi ！]

english: He ripped his opponent in half!
translation: 他将对手撕成两半！ [ta jiang dui shou si cheng liang ban ！]

english: That's gotta hurt!
translation: 那一定很痛吧！ [na yi ding hen tong ba ！]

english: He's only 10 as well!
translation: 他也才10岁啊！ [ta ye cai 10 sui a ！]

english: You gotta start 'em young!
translation: 你必须从年轻开始！ [ni bi xu cong nian qing kai shi ！]

english: Hmph.
translation: 哼。 [heng 。]

english: My favourite fighter is Mubariz!
translation: 我最喜欢的战士是穆巴里斯！ [wo zui xi huan de zhan shi shi mu ba li si ！]

english: The guy at the information kiosk?
translation: 信息亭的那个人？ [xin xi ting de na ge ren ？]

english: Yeah! He rocks!
translation: 是的！他摇滚！ [shi de ！ ta yao gun ！]

english: Takes all sorts, I guess.
translation: 我想，各种各样的事情都有。 [wo xiang ， ge zhong ge yang de shi qing dou you 。]

english: Hi! I'm here to watch the duels!
translation: 你好！我是来看决斗的！ [ni hao ！ wo shi lai kan jue dou de ！]

english: Me too!
translation: 我也是！ [wo ye shi ！]

english: Did you know they think this place dates back to the second age?!
translation: 你知道他们认为这个地方可以追溯到第二纪元吗？！ [ni zhi dao ta men ren wei zhe ge di fang ke yi zhui su dao di er ji yuan ma ？！]

english: Really?
translation: 真的吗？ [zhen de ma ？]

english: Yeah. The guy at the information kiosk was telling me.
translation: 是的。信息亭的那个人告诉我的。 [shi de 。 xin xi ting de na ge ren gao su wo de 。]

english: Can't you see I'm watching the duels?
translation: 你没看到我在看决斗吗？ [ni mei kan dao wo zai kan jue dou ma ？]

english: I'm sorry!
translation: 对不起！ [dui bu qi ！]

english: Well. This beats doing the shopping!
translation: 出色地。这胜过购物！ [chu se di 。 zhe sheng guo gou wu ！]

english: Hi!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Knock knock!
translation: 敲敲门！ [qiao qiao men ！]

english: Who's there?
translation: 谁在那里？ [shui zai na li ？]

english: Boo.
translation: 嘘。 [xu 。]

english: Boo who?
translation: 嘘谁？ [xu shui ？]

english: Don't cry, it's just me!
translation: 别哭，只有我一个人！ [bie ku ， zhi you wo yi ge ren ！]

english: Why did the skeleton burp?
translation: 骷髅为什么打嗝？ [ku lou wei shen me da ge ？]

english: I don't know?
translation: 我不知道？ [wo bu zhi dao ？]

english: 'Cause it didn't have the guts to fart!
translation: 因为它没有胆量放屁！ [yin wei ta mei you dan liang fang pi ！]

english: Waaaaassssssuuuuupp?!.
translation: 哇啊啊啊ssssuuuuupp？！ [wa a a a ssssuuuuupp？！]

english: Hello. What do you do here?
translation: 你好。你在这里做什么？ [ni hao 。 ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Hello. My name is Imerominia and I'm the library horologist.
translation: 你好。我叫 Imerominia，是图书馆的钟表学家。 [ni hao 。 wo jiao  Imerominia， shi tu shu guan de zhong biao xue jia 。]

english: Horologist? What does that mean?
translation: 钟表学家？这意味着什么？ [zhong biao xue jia ？ zhe yi wei zhe shen me ？]

english: Horology is the study and measurement of time. Specifically, I study how time and dates have been historically recorded.
translation: 钟表学是对时间的研究和测量。具体来说，我研究历史上如何记录时间和日期。 [zhong biao xue shi dui shi jian de yan jiu he ce liang 。 ju ti lai shuo ， wo yan jiu li shi shang ru he ji lu shi jian he ri qi 。]

english: For example, the date convention in Great Kourend is to state the number of days and decades since the signing of the Royal Accord of Twill.
translation: 例如，Great Kourend 中的日期约定是说明自《斜纹皇家协议》签署以来的天数和几十年数。 [li ru ，Great Kourend  zhong de ri qi yue ding shi shuo ming zi 《 xie wen huang jia xie yi 》 qian shu yi lai de tian shu he ji shi nian shu 。]

english: Days and decades? That's a bit confusing.
translation: 几天还是几十年？这有点令人困惑。 [ji tian hai shi ji shi nian ？ zhe you dian ling ren kun huo 。]

english: Yes, it's an interesting convention. Truth be told, most in the kingdom prefer to use the same date format as you'll find used elsewhere.
translation: 是的，这是一个有趣的会议。说实话，王国中的大多数人更喜欢使用与其他地方相同的日期格式。 [shi de ， zhe shi yi ge you qu de hui yi 。 shuo shi hua ， wang guo zhong de da duo shu ren geng xi huan shi yong yu qi ta di fang xiang tong de ri qi ge shi 。]

english: However, as this is the Historical Archive, we stick to the dates used historically within Kourend.
translation: 然而，由于这是历史档案馆，我们坚持使用 Kourend 历史上使用的日期。 [ran er ， you yu zhe shi li shi dang an guan ， wo men jian chi shi yong  Kourend  li shi shang shi yong de ri qi 。]

english: Tell me more about the Royal Accord of Twill.
translation: 告诉我更多关于斜纹皇家协议的信息。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu xie wen huang jia xie yi de xin xi 。]

english: The Royal Accord of Twill was signed by the rulers of each of the houses 139 decades ago, following the great famine.
translation: 139 年前大饥荒之后，各家族的统治者签署了《特威尔皇家协议》。 [139  nian qian da ji huang zhi hou ， ge jia zu de tong zhi zhe qian shu le 《 te wei er huang jia xie yi 》。]

english: The Accord declared that each house will, in turn, rule the Kingdom of Great Kourend for one decade in rotation, based on lots drawn.
translation: 协议宣称，每个家族将根据抽签轮流统治大库伦德王国十年。 [xie yi xuan cheng ， mei ge jia zu jiang gen ju chou qian lun liu tong zhi da ku lun de wang guo shi nian 。]

english: You may find a book in the Grand Library with further information. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 您可以在大图书馆找到一本包含更多信息的书。还有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [nin ke yi zai da tu shu guan zhao dao yi ben bao han geng duo xin xi de shu 。 hai you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

english: Is the Royal Accord of Twill honoured today?
translation: 斜纹皇家协议今天兑现了吗？ [xie wen huang jia xie yi jin tian dui xian le ma ？]

english: Our kingdom has advanced somewhat over the many decades since the Accord. Though some parts of the Accord remain intact, the Kourend Council now rules Great Kourend.
translation: 自协议签订以来的几十年里，我们的王国取得了一些进步。尽管协议的某些部分仍然完好无损，但库伦德议会现在统治着大库伦德。 [zi xie yi qian ding yi lai de ji shi nian li ， wo men de wang guo qu de le yi xie jin bu 。 jin guan xie yi de mou xie bu fen reng ran wan hao wu sun ， dan ku lun de yi hui xian zai tong zhi zhe da ku lun de 。]

english: Was the Accord ever breached?
translation: 协议有被违反吗？ [xie yi you bei wei fan ma ？]

english: Indeed it was. In the 13th decade, King Shayzien III seized control of Kourend using the military under his command.
translation: 确实如此。 13世纪，沙伊恩三世国王利用其麾下的军队夺取了库伦德的控制权。 [que shi ru ci 。 13 shi ji ， sha yi en san shi guo wang li yong qi hui xia de jun dui duo qu le ku lun de de kong zhi quan 。]

english: The full set of laws within the Accord haven't been followed since. However, some of them were reinstated in the 47th decade, by King Byrne I.
translation: 此后，协议中的全套法律就没有得到遵守。然而，其中一些在 47 世纪由国王伯恩一世恢复。 [ci hou ， xie yi zhong de quan tao fa lv jiu mei you de dao zun shou 。 ran er ， qi zhong yi xie zai  47  shi ji you guo wang bo en yi shi hui fu 。]

english: Fascinating. What happened during that time?
translation: 迷人。那段时间发生了什么？ [mi ren 。 na duan shi jian fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: During the 20th decade, King Shayzien VI married the daughter of Lord Hosidius. Four decades later their son was crowned king.
translation: 20世纪20年代，沙伊辛六世国王与霍西迪乌斯勋爵的女儿结婚。四十年后，他们的儿子加冕为国王。 [20 shi ji 20 nian dai ， sha yi xin liu shi guo wang yu huo xi di wu si xun jue de nv er jie hun 。 si shi nian hou ， ta men de er zi jia mian wei guo wang 。]

english: He took the name King Hosidius IV in an attempt to distance the family from the breaking of the Royal Accord of Twill.
translation: 他取名为霍西迪乌斯四世国王，试图使家族远离破坏特维尔皇家协议的行为。 [ta qu ming wei huo xi di wu si si shi guo wang ， shi tu shi jia zu yuan li po huai te wei er huang jia xie yi de xing wei 。]

english: King Hosidius IV followed by his son, King Hosidius V ruled Kourend until the early days of the 33rd decade.
translation: 国王霍西迪乌斯四世及其子国王霍西迪乌斯五世统治库伦德，直到 33 世纪初期。 [guo wang huo xi di wu si si shi ji qi zi guo wang huo xi di wu si wu shi tong zhi ku lun de ， zhi dao  33  shi ji chu qi 。]

english: It was then that King Shayzien VII took control of the kingdom. His rule was a notably violent one.
translation: 就在那时，沙辛七世国王接管了王国。他的统治非常暴力。 [jiu zai na shi ， sha xin qi shi guo wang jie guan le wang guo 。 ta de tong zhi fei chang bao li 。]

english: King Shayzien VII was killed some five decades later during the Battle of the Concourse. He was succeeded by the dark mage, Xeric.
translation: 大约五年后，沙伊齐恩七世国王在广场之战中被杀。他的继任者是黑暗法师艾瑞克。 [da yue wu nian hou ， sha yi qi en qi shi guo wang zai guang chang zhi zhan zhong bei sha 。 ta de ji ren zhe shi hei an fa shi ai rui ke 。]

english: Xeric ruled Kourend for more than ten dark decades using an army of lizardmen. This time period was known as the Age of Strife.
translation: 埃里克利用一支蜥蜴人军队统治了库伦德长达十多年的黑暗十年。这个时期被称为冲突时代。 [ai li ke li yong yi zhi xi yi ren jun dui tong zhi le ku lun de zhang da shi duo nian de hei an shi nian 。 zhe ge shi qi bei cheng wei chong tu shi dai 。]

english: Xeric was eventually killed during the 47th decade and succeeded by King Byrne I.
translation: Xeric最终在47世纪被杀，由国王伯恩一世继位。 [Xeric zui zhong zai 47 shi ji bei sha ， you guo wang bo en yi shi ji wei 。]

english: Can you tell me more about Xeric?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于 Xeric 的事吗？ [ni neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu  Xeric  de shi ma ？]

english: Ah, I do not have much more information on him. You should speak to Ektheme, our Xerician expert.
translation: 啊，我没有更多关于他的信息。您应该咨询我们的 Xerician 专家 Ektheme。 [a ， wo mei you geng duo guan yu ta de xin xi 。 nin ying gai zi xun wo men de  Xerician  zhuan jia  Ektheme。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: The Royal Accord of Twill no longer plays much part in the rulership of Kourend. It was breached in the 13th decade when King Shayzien III seized control of the kingdom. It hasn't been honoured since.
translation: 特威尔皇家协议在库伦德的统治中不再发挥太大作用。公元 13 世纪，国王沙伊恩三世 (Shayzien III) 夺取王国控制权后，这一规则被打破。从那以后，它就没有受到过尊重。 [te wei er huang jia xie yi zai ku lun de de tong zhi zhong bu zai fa hui tai da zuo yong 。 gong yuan  13  shi ji ， guo wang sha yi en san shi  (Shayzien III)  duo qu wang guo kong zhi quan hou ， zhe yi gui ze bei da po 。 cong na yi hou ， ta jiu mei you shou dao guo zun zhong 。]

english: That said, it was the basis for Rose's Accord, which sets out how the kingdom is currently ruled today. As decreed in Rose's Accord, the Hosidius family are now the royal family of Kourend.
translation: 也就是说，这是《罗斯协议》的基础，它规定了王国目前的统治方式。根据《罗丝协议》的规定，霍西迪乌斯家族现在是库伦德的王室。 [ye jiu shi shuo ， zhe shi 《 luo si xie yi 》 de ji chu ， ta gui ding le wang guo mu qian de tong zhi fang shi 。 gen ju 《 luo si xie yi 》 de gui ding ， huo xi di wu si jia zu xian zai shi ku lun de de wang shi 。]

english: We have the original Royal Accord of Twill safely stored here. Although it's not available for public viewing, there are copies available within the Grand Library. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 我们将原始的斜纹皇家协议安全地存放在这里。虽然它不向公众开放，但大图书馆内有副本。还有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [wo men jiang yuan shi de xie wen huang jia xie yi an quan di cun fang zai zhe li 。 sui ran ta bu xiang gong zhong kai fang ， dan da tu shu guan nei you fu ben 。 hai you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

english: So what is today's date?
translation: 那么今天是几号？ [na me jin tian shi ji hao ？]

english: I'm afraid I lose track of which day it is... but we are in the 141st decade.
translation: 恐怕我忘记了今天是哪一天……但我们已经进入了第 141 个十年。 [kong pa wo wang ji le jin tian shi na yi tian …… dan wo men yi jing jin ru le di  141  ge shi nian 。]

english: So that means the Accord was signed almost 1,410 years ago?
translation: 那么这意味着该协议是在大约 1,410 年前签署的？ [na me zhe yi wei zhe gai xie yi shi zai da yue  1,410  nian qian qian shu de ？]

english: That is correct. You seem to have understood our time and date format well.
translation: 这是正确的。您似乎很了解我们的时间和日期格式。 [zhe shi zheng que de 。 nin si hu hen liao jie wo men de shi jian he ri qi ge shi 。]

english: What about the time before the Accord was signed?
translation: 那么协议签署之前的时间呢？ [na me xie yi qian shu zhi qian de shi jian ne ？]

english: Very little is known about those ancient times, but we refer to them as decades 'Before Accord', or 'BA' for short.
translation: 我们对那些远古时代知之甚少，但我们将其称为“雅阁之前”的几十年，简称“BA”。 [wo men dui na xie yuan gu shi dai zhi zhi shen shao ， dan wo men jiang qi cheng wei “ ya ge zhi qian ” de ji shi nian ， jian cheng “BA”。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Hello, what do you do here?
translation: 你好，你在这里做什么？ [ni hao ， ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Have you ever heard of Camorra?
translation: 你听说过卡莫拉吗？ [ni ting shuo guo ka mo la ma ？]

english: I can't say I have. Who is she?
translation: 我不能说我有。她是谁？ [wo bu neng shuo wo you 。 ta shi shui ？]

english: She's a hero from nearly two thousand years ago. I believe she travelled to Kourend during the Dragonkin Conflicts. I was hoping to learn more about her.
translation: 她是近两千多年前的英雄。我相信她在龙族冲突期间前往库伦德。我希望能更多地了解她。 [ta shi jin liang qian duo nian qian de ying xiong 。 wo xiang xin ta zai long zu chong tu qi jian qian wang ku lun de 。 wo xi wang neng geng duo di liao jie ta 。]

english: Two thousand years ago? That's long before the founding of Kourend. I'm afraid we have very few records from those times here.
translation: 两千多年前？那是在 Kourend 成立之前很久的事了。恐怕我们这里关于那个时代的记录很少。 [liang qian duo nian qian ？ na shi zai  Kourend  cheng li zhi qian hen jiu de shi le 。 kong pa wo men zhe li guan yu na ge shi dai de ji lu hen shao 。]

english: Oh. So you can't help me?
translation: 哦。所以你就不能帮我吗？ [o 。 suo yi ni jiu bu neng bang wo ma ？]

english: I can't but someone might be able to. The five cities of Kourend were founded long before the kingdom itself. Each city has their own historian who might have more information on the early days of their house.
translation: 我不能，但有人可以。库伦德的五座城市早在王国诞生之前就已建立。每个城市都有自己的历史学家，他们可能会提供有关其房屋早期的更多信息。 [wo bu neng ， dan you ren ke yi 。 ku lun de de wu zuo cheng shi zao zai wang guo dan sheng zhi qian jiu yi jian li 。 mei ge cheng shi dou you zi ji de li shi xue jia ， ta men ke neng hui ti gong you guan qi fang wu zao qi de geng duo xin xi 。]

english: Great. Is there a particular city you'd recommend?
translation: 伟大的。您有特别推荐的城市吗？ [wei da de 。 nin you te bie tui jian de cheng shi ma ？]

english: Hosidius and Shayzien were the two cities founded during the Dragonkin Conflicts. They might be the best ones to start with. The other cities were founded much earlier, during the God Wars.
translation: 霍西迪乌斯 (Hosidius) 和谢津 (Shayzien) 是龙族冲突期间建立的两座城市。他们可能是最好的开始。其他城市的建立要早得多，是在众神战争期间。 [huo xi di wu si  (Hosidius)  he xie jin  (Shayzien)  shi long zu chong tu qi jian jian li de liang zuo cheng shi 。 ta men ke neng shi zui hao de kai shi 。 qi ta cheng shi de jian li yao zao de duo ， shi zai zhong shen zhan zheng qi jian 。]

english: Where can I find the Hosidius and Shayzien historians?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到 Hosidius 和 Shayzien 历史学家？ [wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao  Hosidius  he  Shayzien  li shi xue jia ？]

english: Jonathan is the Hosidius historian. He lives west of the Hosidius General Store. Amelia is the Shayzien historian. She lives south west of the Shayzien Pub.
translation: 乔纳森是霍西迪乌斯的历史学家。他住在霍西迪乌斯杂货店西边。阿米莉亚（Amelia）是沙伊恩（Shayzien）历史学家。她住在 Shayzien 酒吧的西南部。 [qiao na sen shi huo xi di wu si de li shi xue jia 。 ta zhu zai huo xi di wu si za huo dian xi bian 。 a mi li ya （Amelia） shi sha yi en （Shayzien） li shi xue jia 。 ta zhu zai  Shayzien  jiu ba de xi nan bu 。]

english: Thanks for the help.
translation: 感谢您的帮助。 [gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]

translation: 这是我的家，凡人！你的口袋里有什么？有什么好吃的吗？ [zhe shi wo de jia ， fan ren ！ ni de kou dai li you shen me ？ you shen me hao chi de ma ？]

english: Of course I do!

english: Then you have something that implings want.
translation: 然后你就有了暗示想要的东西。 [ran hou ni jiu you le an shi xiang yao de dong xi 。]

english: Eh?
We want things you people want. They are tasty to us! The more you want them, the tastier they are!

english: Don't do that! That would be cruel. But chase us, yes! That is good. Implings are not easy to catch. Especially ones with really tasty food.
