translation: 您感觉自己对采矿和手工技能更加了解 [nin gan jue zi ji dui cai kuang he shou gong ji neng geng jia liao jie]

english: You feel more knowledgeable in the skills Crafting, Smithing, Slayer, Prayer and Hunter.
translation: 您感觉自己对手工、锻造、屠宰、祈祷和狩猎技能更加了解。 [nin gan jue zi ji dui shou gong 、 duan zao 、 tu zai 、 qi dao he shou lie ji neng geng jia liao jie 。]

english: You feel more knowledgeable in the skills Mining, Crafting, Smithing, Slayer, Prayer and Hunter.
translation: 您感觉自己对采矿、手工、锻造、屠宰、祈祷和猎人的技能更加了解。 [nin gan jue zi ji dui cai kuang 、 shou gong 、 duan zao 、 tu zai 、 qi dao he lie ren de ji neng geng jia liao jie 。]

english: Wow, thanks.
translation: 哇，谢谢。 [wa ， xie xie 。]

english: You're most welcome. Now, is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 非常欢迎您。现在，还有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [fei chang huan ying nin 。 xian zai ， hai you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: I'll come back later.
translation: 我以后会回来的。 [wo yi hou hui hui lai de 。]

english: Okay!
translation: 好的！ [hao de ！]

english: Welcome to Varrock Museum. How can I help you today?
translation: 欢迎来到瓦罗克博物馆。今天我能为您提供什么帮助？ [huan ying lai dao wa luo ke bo wu guan 。 jin tian wo neng wei nin ti gong shen me bang zhu ？]

english: You reach and take a map of the Museum.
translation: 您到达博物馆并拿了一张地图。 [nin dao da bo wu guan bing na le yi zhang di tu 。]

english: Could you tell me about the Dig Site exhibit please?
translation: 您能告诉我有关挖掘现场展览的信息吗？ [nin neng gao su wo you guan wa jue xian chang zhan lan de xin xi ma ？]

english: Of course. The Dig Site exhibit has several display cases of finds discovered on the Dig Site to the east of Varrock.
translation: 当然。挖掘现场展览有几个展示柜，展示在瓦罗克以东的挖掘现场发现的物品。 [dang ran 。 wa jue xian chang zhan lan you ji ge zhan shi gui ， zhan shi zai wa luo ke yi dong de wa jue xian chang fa xian de wu pin 。]

english: Unfortunately, you haven't passed your Earth Science exams, so you aren't qualified to help us on the dig. If you're interested, visit the Education Centre on the Dig Site to the east and talk to the examiners there.
translation: 不幸的是，你还没有通过地球科学考试，所以你没有资格帮助我们进行挖掘。如果您有兴趣，可以参观东边挖掘场的教育中心并与那里的考官交谈。 [bu xing de shi ， ni hai mei you tong guo di qiu ke xue kao shi ， suo yi ni mei you zi ge bang zhu wo men jin xing wa jue 。 ru guo nin you xing qu ， ke yi can guan dong bian wa jue chang de jiao yu zhong xin bing yu na li de kao guan jiao tan 。]

english: As you've passed your Earth Science exams at the Dig Site, you can go through into the cleaning area and clean off some finds. This will help our Dig Site display floor to give a more accurate view of life back in the
translation: 当您通过了挖掘现场的地球科学考试后，您可以进入清洁区域并清理一些发现物。这将有助于我们的挖掘现场展示地板更准确地了解当时的生活 [dang nin tong guo le wa jue xian chang de di qiu ke xue kao shi hou ， nin ke yi jin ru qing jie qu yu bing qing li yi xie fa xian wu 。 zhe jiang you zhu yu wo men de wa jue xian chang zhan shi di ban geng zhun que di liao jie dang shi de sheng huo]

english: 3rd and 4th Ages, as well as earning you Kudos. If you'd like to know more about cleaning finds, just ask the archaeologists.
translation: 第三和第四时代，并为您赢得荣誉。如果您想了解更多有关清理发现的信息，只需询问考古学家即可。 [di san he di si shi dai ， bing wei nin ying de rong yu 。 ru guo nin xiang liao jie geng duo you guan qing li fa xian de xin xi ， zhi xu xun wen kao gu xue jia ji ke 。]

english: I see you've already helped out in the Dig Site exhibit. Our picture of life back in the 3rd and 4th Ages in that old city is really becoming clearer. There are still a few displays that need updating, though. If you'd like to
translation: 我看到你已经在挖掘现场展览中提供了帮助。我们对这座古城第三和第四世纪生活的想象确实变得越来越清晰。不过，仍有一些显示器需要更新。如果你愿意 [wo kan dao ni yi jing zai wa jue xian chang zhan lan zhong ti gong le bang zhu 。 wo men dui zhe zuo gu cheng di san he di si shi ji sheng huo de xiang xiang que shi bian de yue lai yue qing xi 。 bu guo ， reng you yi xie xian shi qi xu yao geng xin 。 ru guo ni yuan yi]

english: know more about cleaning finds, just ask the archaeologists.
translation: 了解更多有关清理发现的信息，只需询问考古学家即可。 [liao jie geng duo you guan qing li fa xian de xin xi ， zhi xu xun wen kao gu xue jia ji ke 。]

english: You have really helped out a lot. I see all the nice clean finds with their information are in the once empty cases. I'm sure we'll get some more cases in soon for you to fill. For now, perhaps you should investigate the
translation: 你真的帮了很多忙。我看到所有干净整洁的发现及其信息都在曾经空的盒子里。我确信我们很快就会收到更多案例供您填写。现在，也许您应该调查一下 [ni zhen de bang le hen duo mang 。 wo kan dao suo you gan jing zheng jie de fa xian ji qi xin xi dou zai ceng jing kong de he zi li 。 wo que xin wo men hen kuai jiu hui shou dao geng duo an li gong nin tian xie 。 xian zai ， ye xu nin ying gai diao cha yi xia]

english: rest of the Museum.
translation: 博物馆的其余部分。 [bo wu guan de qi yu bu fen 。]

english: Bye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Have a good day!
translation: 祝你有美好的一天！ [zhu ni you mei hao de yi tian ！]

english: Could you tell me about the Timeline exhibit please?
translation: 您能告诉我有关时间线展览的信息吗？ [nin neng gao su wo you guan shi jian xian zhan lan de xin xi ma ？]

english: Why, yes. The Timeline exhibit has lots of display cases showing things from the beginning of time right up to the present day.
translation: 为什么，是的。时间轴展览有很多展示柜，展示从一开始到今天的事物。 [wei shen me ， shi de 。 shi jian zhou zhan lan you hen duo zhan shi gui ， zhan shi cong yi kai shi dao jin tian de shi wu 。]

english: You could help out in the Timeline exhibit upstairs. By providing information you may have gathered on your travels around the world, you can help to make our displays more comprehensive and earn yourself Kudos
translation: 你可以在楼上的时间线展览中帮忙。通过提供您在世界各地旅行时可能收集到的信息，您可以帮助我们使展示更加全面，并为您赢得荣誉 [ni ke yi zai lou shang de shi jian xian zhan lan zhong bang mang 。 tong guo ti gong nin zai shi jie ge di lv xing shi ke neng shou ji dao de xin xi ， nin ke yi bang zhu wo men shi zhan shi geng jia quan mian ， bing wei nin ying de rong yu]

english: too.
translation: 也。 [ye 。]

english: I know you've helped out a bit in the Timeline exhibit upstairs, but I'm sure you can help more. When you're out on your travels being a brave adventurer, remember that you can come back to the Museum
translation: 我知道您在楼上的时间轴展览中提供了一些帮助，但我相信您可以提供更多帮助。当您作为勇敢的冒险家外出旅行时，请记住您可以回到博物馆 [wo zhi dao nin zai lou shang de shi jian zhou zhan lan zhong ti gong le yi xie bang zhu ， dan wo xiang xin nin ke yi ti gong geng duo bang zhu 。 dang nin zuo wei yong gan de mao xian jia wai chu lv xing shi ， qing ji zhu nin ke yi hui dao bo wu guan]

english: after some quests to let us know important historical facts. This will help us to update the displays and make the Museum a more informative place! You'll earn yourself Kudos too.
translation: 经过一些探索让我们了解重要的历史事实。这将帮助我们更新展示并使博物馆成为一个提供更多信息的地方！您也会为自己赢得荣誉。 [jing guo yi xie tan suo rang wo men liao jie zhong yao de li shi shi shi 。 zhe jiang bang zhu wo men geng xin zhan shi bing shi bo wu guan cheng wei yi ge ti gong geng duo xin xi de di fang ！ nin ye hui wei zi ji ying de rong yu 。]

english: I see you have filled up the display cases we have, and given us large amounts of information for the Timeline exhibit. At the moment, you have left us nothing to do ourselves, but I'm sure we'll be getting some new cases
translation: 我看到您已经填满了我们的展示柜，并为我们提供了大量有关时间轴展览的信息。目前，您没有让我们自己做任何事，但我相信我们会收到一些新病例 [wo kan dao nin yi jing tian man le wo men de zhan shi gui ， bing wei wo men ti gong le da liang you guan shi jian zhou zhan lan de xin xi 。 mu qian ， nin mei you rang wo men zi ji zuo ren he shi ， dan wo xiang xin wo men hui shou dao yi xie xin bing li]

english: in soon for you to help us out with! For now, perhaps you should investigate the rest of the Museum.
translation: 很快您就会帮助我们！现在，也许您应该调查一下博物馆的其余部分。 [hen kuai nin jiu hui bang zhu wo men ！ xian zai ， ye xu nin ying gai diao cha yi xia bo wu guan de qi yu bu fen 。]

english: Okay, thanks. One more question: why are the display numbers all out of sequence?
translation: 好的，谢谢。还有一个问题：为什么显示的数字都是乱序的？ [hao de ， xie xie 。 hai you yi ge wen ti ： wei shen me xian shi de shu zi dou shi luan xu de ？]

english: Ahh, that's due to the numbering being done as we were constructing the cases and putting the displays in them, then shuffling them into the right places. We thought rather than renumbering them all - such a
translation: 啊，这是因为我们在构建箱子并将显示器放入其中，然后将它们拖放到正确的位置时进行了编号。我们认为，而不是重新编号它们 - 这样一个 [a ， zhe shi yin wei wo men zai gou jian xiang zi bing jiang xian shi qi fang ru qi zhong ， ran hou jiang ta men tuo fang dao zheng que de wei zhi shi jin xing le bian hao 。 wo men ren wei ， er bu shi chong xin bian hao ta men  -  zhe yang yi ge]

english: boring job, writing labels - we'd leave it. They all have unique numbers and future displays would mess up the consecutive numbering anyway.
translation: 无聊的工作，写标签——我们会放弃它。它们都有唯一的编号，未来的显示无论如何都会弄乱连续编号。 [wu liao de gong zuo ， xie biao qian —— wo men hui fang qi ta 。 ta men dou you wei yi de bian hao ， wei lai de xian shi wu lun ru he du hui nong luan lian xu bian hao 。]

english: Ahhh, I see.
translation: 啊哈，我明白了。 [a ha ， wo ming bai le 。]

english: Could you tell me about the Natural History exhibit please?
translation: 您能告诉我有关自然历史展览的信息吗？ [nin neng gao su wo you guan zi ran li shi zhan lan de xin xi ma ？]

english: Why, yes. The Natural History exhibit has displays of various creatures you can find around Gielinor.
translation: 为什么，是的。自然历史展览展示了吉林诺周围的各种生物。 [wei shen me ， shi de 。 zi ran li shi zhan lan zhan shi le ji lin nuo zhou wei de ge zhong sheng wu 。]

english: Downstairs, in the Natural History exhibit, you can answer quizzes about animals to show us your knowledge and earn Kudos at the same time. Talk to Orlando, I'm sure he'd appreciate your knowledge.
translation: 在楼下的自然历史展览中，您可以回答有关动物的测验，向我们展示您的知识，同时赢得荣誉。和奥兰多谈谈，我相信他会欣赏你的知识。 [zai lou xia de zi ran li shi zhan lan zhong ， nin ke yi hui da you guan dong wu de ce yan ， xiang wo men zhan shi nin de zhi shi ， tong shi ying de rong yu 。 he ao lan duo tan tan ， wo xiang xin ta hui xin shang ni de zhi shi 。]

english: I see you have already demonstrated some of your knowledge of the natural world in the Natural History exhibit, so why not pop down and do some more quizzes with Orlando! You can earn Kudos at the same time.
translation: 我看到您已经在自然历史展览中展示了您对自然世界的一些知识，所以为什么不和奥兰多一起做一些更多的测验呢！您可以同时获得荣誉。 [wo kan dao nin yi jing zai zi ran li shi zhan lan zhong zhan shi le nin dui zi ran shi jie de yi xie zhi shi ， suo yi wei shen me bu he ao lan duo yi qi zuo yi xie geng duo de ce yan ne ！ nin ke yi tong shi huo de rong yu 。]

english: You really know your stuff when it comes to animals, don't you! Orlando tells me you have exceeded his teachings. For now, perhaps you should investigate the rest of the Museum.
translation: 当谈到动物时，你真的很了解，不是吗！奥兰多告诉我你已经超越了他的教导。现在，也许您应该调查一下博物馆的其余部分。 [dang tan dao dong wu shi ， ni zhen de hen liao jie ， bu shi ma ！ ao lan duo gao su wo ni yi jing chao yue le ta de jiao dao 。 xian zai ， ye xu nin ying gai diao cha yi xia bo wu guan de qi yu bu fen 。]

english: But what's natural history got to do with existing animals?
translation: 但自然历史与现有动物有什么关系呢？ [dan zi ran li shi yu xian you dong wu you shen me guan xi ne ？]

english: The study of natural history is simply the study of the history of the species. The species doesn't necessarily need to be an extinct one.
translation: 自然历史的研究简单来说就是对物种历史的研究。该物种不一定是已经灭绝的物种。 [zi ran li shi de yan jiu jian dan lai shuo jiu shi dui wu zhong li shi de yan jiu 。 gai wu zhong bu yi ding shi yi jing mie jue de wu zhong 。]

english: What is Kudos?
translation: 什么是荣誉？ [shen me shi rong yu ？]

english: Kudos is a measure of how much you've assisted the Museum. The more information you give us, Dig Site finds that you clean and quizzes you solve, the higher your Kudos.
translation: 荣誉是衡量您为博物馆提供多少帮助的标准。您向我们提供的信息越多，Dig Site 就会发现您清理并解决的测验，您的荣誉就越高。 [rong yu shi heng liang nin wei bo wu guan ti gong duo shao bang zhu de biao zhun 。 nin xiang wo men ti gong de xin xi yue duo ，Dig Site  jiu hui fa xian nin qing li bing jie jue de ce yan ， nin de rong yu jiu yue gao 。]

english: But what's it for?
translation: 但它有什么用呢？ [dan ta you shen me yong ne ？]

english: Well, recently we found a rather interesting island to the north of Morytania. We believe that it may be of archaeological significance. I suspect we'll be looking for qualified archaeologists once we have constructed our
translation: 嗯，最近我们在莫里塔尼亚北部发现了一个相当有趣的岛屿。我们认为这可能具有考古意义。我怀疑一旦我们建造了我们的房子，我们就会寻找合格的考古学家 [n ， zui jin wo men zai mo li ta ni ya bei bu fa xian le yi ge xiang dang you qu de dao yu 。 wo men ren wei zhe ke neng ju you kao gu yi yi 。 wo huai yi yi dan wo men jian zao le wo men de fang zi ， wo men jiu hui xun zhao he ge de kao gu xue jia]

english: canal and barge. So, we're using Kudos as a measure of who is willing and able to help us here at the Museum, so they can then be invited on our dig on the new island.
translation: 运河和驳船。因此，我们使用“荣誉”来衡量谁愿意并且能够在博物馆为我们提供帮助，这样他们就可以被邀请参加我们在新岛上的挖掘活动。 [yun he he bo chuan 。 yin ci ， wo men shi yong “ rong yu ” lai heng liang shui yuan yi bing qie neng gou zai bo wu guan wei wo men ti gong bang zhu ， zhe yang ta men jiu ke yi bei yao qing can jia wo men zai xin dao shang de wa jue huo dong 。]

english: Would I qualify, then?
translation: 那我有资格吗？ [na wo you zi ge ma ？]

english: Unfortunately, you haven't earned enough Kudos yet, so you aren't qualified to help us on the dig. If you're interested in helping us out and getting that Kudos, simply help out around the Museum.
translation: 不幸的是，您还没有获得足够的荣誉，因此您没有资格帮助我们进行挖掘。如果您有兴趣帮助我们并获得荣誉，只需在博物馆周围帮忙即可。 [bu xing de shi ， nin hai mei you huo de zu gou de rong yu ， yin ci nin mei you zi ge bang zhu wo men jin xing wa jue 。 ru guo nin you xing qu bang zhu wo men bing huo de rong yu ， zhi xu zai bo wu guan zhou wei bang mang ji ke 。]

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Why yes! You've helped us so much around the Museum and you have the necessary qualifications from the Earth Sciences exams you took. When the canal is ready, we'll let you know.
translation: 为什么是的！ You've helped us so much around the Museum and you have the necessary qualifications from the Earth Sciences exams you took. When the canal is ready, we'll let you know. [wei shen me shi de ！ You've helped us so much around the Museum and you have the necessary qualifications from the Earth Sciences exams you took. When the canal is ready, we'll let you know.]

english: Thank you, I'll look forward to it!
translation: 谢谢，我会期待的！ [xie xie ， wo hui qi dai de ！]

english: Well done! I have new information to share with you.
translation: 干得好！我有新信息要与您分享。 [gan de hao ！ wo you xin xin xi yao yu nin fen xiang 。]

english: Yes, teach me something in those skills.
translation: 是的，教我一些这些技能。 [shi de ， jiao wo yi xie zhe xie ji neng 。]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Take a map of the Museum
translation: 拿一张博物馆地图 [na yi zhang bo wu guan di tu]

english: Find out about the Dig Site exhibit.
translation: 了解挖掘现场展览。 [liao jie wa jue xian chang zhan lan 。]

english: Ask about something else.
translation: 询问其他事情。 [xun wen qi ta shi qing 。]

english: Bye
translation: 再见 [zai jian]

english: Find out about the Timeline exhibit.
translation: 了解时间轴展览。 [liao jie shi jian zhou zhan lan 。]

english: Find out about the Natural History exhibit.
translation: 了解自然历史展览。 [liao jie zi ran li shi zhan lan 。]

english: But what's Natural History got to do with existing animals?
translation: 但自然历史与现有动物有什么关系呢？ [dan zi ran li shi yu xian you dong wu you shen me guan xi ne ？]

english: Find out about Kudos.
translation: 了解有关荣誉的信息。 [liao jie you guan rong yu de xin xi 。]

english: I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: 我不能和你这个外地人说话！与酋长布伦特交谈！ [wo bu neng he ni zhe ge wai di ren shuo hua ！ yu qiu zhang bu lun te jiao tan ！]

english: You stay away from me outerlander!
translation: 你这个外地人离我远点！ [ni zhe ge wai di ren li wo yuan dian ！]

english: They are too suspicious of you for you to get close enough to steal from them.
translation: 他们对你太怀疑了，你无法靠近他们去偷东西。 [ta men dui ni tai huai yi le ， ni wu fa kao jin ta men qu tou dong xi 。]

english: Hello. I'm looking for a member of the council of elders who will support my application to become an honorary Fremennik.
translation: 你好。我正在寻找一位长老会成员来支持我申请成为名誉弗里曼尼克。 [ni hao 。 wo zheng zai xun zhao yi wei zhang lao hui cheng yuan lai zhi chi wo shen qing cheng wei ming yu fu li man ni ke 。]

english: I'm a council member.
translation: 我是理事会成员。 [wo shi li shi hui cheng yuan 。]

english: So can I somehow persuade you to vote for me at the council of elders?
translation: 那么我能说服你在长老会议上投票给我吗？ [na me wo neng shuo fu ni zai zhang lao hui yi shang tou piao gei wo ma ？]

english: No. Frankly, I don't like you.
translation: 不，坦白说，我不喜欢你。 [bu ， tan bai shuo ， wo bu xi huan ni 。]

english: But you don't even know me!
translation: 但你根本不认识我！ [dan ni gen ben bu ren shi wo ！]

english: You also smell bad. And have stupid hair. And bad breath. And you walk a bit funny.
translation: 你也闻起来很臭。还有愚蠢的头发。还有口臭。而且你走路的样子有点滑稽。 [ni ye wen qi lai hen chou 。 hai you yu chun de tou fa 。 hai you kou chou 。 er qie ni zou lu de yang zi you dian hua ji 。]

english: I didn't come all the way up here just to be insulted!
translation: 我千里迢迢来到这里，不是为了受辱！ [wo qian li tiao tiao lai dao zhe li ， bu shi wei le shou ru ！]

english: No, I'm quite sure you could have found plenty of people to insult you wherever your home is.
translation: 不，我很确定无论你的家在哪里，你都会找到很多人来侮辱你。 [bu ， wo hen que ding wu lun ni de jia zai na li ， ni du hui zhao dao hen duo ren lai wu ru ni 。]

english: You know what? Forget you, you stupid barbarian! I don't need your stupid vote!
translation: 你知道吗？忘了你吧，你这个愚蠢的野蛮人！我不需要你愚蠢的投票！ [ni zhi dao ma ？ wang le ni ba ， ni zhe ge yu chun de ye man ren ！ wo bu xu yao ni yu chun de tou piao ！]

english: Tch, typical outerlander rudeness. I'm glad I didn't vote for you now.
translation: 切，典型的外地人粗鲁。我很高兴现在没有投票给你。 [qie ， dian xing de wai di ren cu lu 。 wo hen gao xing xian zai mei you tou piao gei ni 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: 再次你好[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]。今天你需要我做什么？您永远可以信赖我的帮助！ [zai ci ni hao [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 jin tian ni xu yao wo zuo shen me ？ nin yong yuan ke yi xin lai wo de bang zhu ！]

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。我只是想聊聊。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。 wo zhi shi xiang liao liao 。]

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: 如果您需要我的帮助[弗雷曼尼克名字]，我的门永远敞开。 [ru guo nin xu yao wo de bang zhu [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]， wo de men yong yuan chang kai 。]

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: [弗雷曼尼克名字]...我们已经很久没有见面了！ [[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]... wo men yi jing hen jiu mei you jian mian le ！]

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: 欢迎回来[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]。很高兴在这里见到您！ [huan ying hui lai [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 hen gao xing zai zhe li jian dao nin ！]

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: 我很抱歉[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]！我没时间陪你在这里！ [wo hen bao qian [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！ wo mei shi jian pei ni zai zhe li ！]

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
translation: 没关系，我其实什么都不想要。 [mei guan xi ， wo qi shi shen me dou bu xiang yao 。]

english: How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: 你[弗雷曼尼克名字]怎么样？我希望您这一天一切顺利！ [ni [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ] zen me yang ？ wo xi wang nin zhe yi tian yi qie shun li ！]

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
translation: 我很好，谢谢，你好吗？ [wo hen hao ， xie xie ， ni hao ma ？]

english: All is well with me also!
translation: 我也一切都好！ [wo ye yi qie dou hao ！]

english: Hello to you, too!
translation: 也向你问好！ [ye xiang ni wen hao ！]

english: Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你好。你想要什么东西[弗雷曼尼克名字]吗？ [ni hao 。 ni xiang yao shen me dong xi [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ] ma ？]

english: No, not really.
translation: 不，不是真的。 [bu ， bu shi zhen de 。]

english: Well... okay then!
translation: 嗯……那好吧！ [n …… na hao ba ！]

english: Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
translation: 很高兴见到你[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]。 [hen gao xing jian dao ni [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。]

english: You shame us, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你让我们感到羞耻，[弗雷曼尼克名字]！ [ni rang wo men gan dao xiu chi ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！]

english: How can you steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你怎么能偷我的东西，[弗雷曼尼克名字]？ [ni zen me neng tou wo de dong xi ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]？]

english: You have betrayed your heritage, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你背叛了你的传统，[弗雷曼尼克名字]！ [ni bei pan le ni de chuan tong ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！]

english: Why would you try to steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你为什么要偷我的东西，[弗雷曼尼克名字]？ [ni wei shen me yao tou wo de dong xi ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]？]

english: I think the locals are taking a liking to us! One of them hasn't stopped wearing those clothes Arnkel sold her. Much better than those piddly little things she was wearing before!
translation: 我觉得当地人很喜欢我们！其中一个人一直穿着阿恩克尔卖给她的衣服。比她之前穿的那些破烂的小东西好多了！ [wo jue de dang di ren hen xi huan wo men ！ qi zhong yi ge ren yi zhi chuan zhe a en ke er mai gei ta de yi fu 。 bi ta zhi qian chuan de na xie po lan de xiao dong xi hao duo le ！]

english: I think they're piddly because of how warm it is here...
translation: 我认为他们很冷淡是因为这里很温暖...... [wo ren wei ta men hen leng dan shi yin wei zhe li hen wen nuan ......]

english: Bah! A bit of heat never hurt anyone.
translation: 呸!一点点热度不会伤害任何人。 [pei ! yi dian dian re du bu hui shang hai ren he ren 。]

english: I don't think that's true.
translation: 我不认为这是真的。 [wo bu ren wei zhe shi zhen de 。]

english: Oh stop your whining, traveller! Now, I think it's time for a drink.
translation: 哦，停止你的抱怨吧，旅行者！现在，我想是时候喝一杯了。 [o ， ting zhi ni de bao yuan ba ， lv xing zhe ！ xian zai ， wo xiang shi shi hou he yi bei le 。]

english: Oh stop your whining, [Fremennik name]! Now, I think it's time for a drink.
translation: 哦，停止你的抱怨吧，[弗雷曼尼克名字]！现在，我想是时候喝一杯了。 [o ， ting zhi ni de bao yuan ba ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！ xian zai ， wo xiang shi shi hou he yi bei le 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Good day, your Royal Highness.
translation: 美好的一天，殿下。 [mei hao de yi tian ， dian xia 。]

english: Outlander, I have work to be getting on with... Please stop bothering me.
translation: 外乡人，我还有工作要做……请别再打扰我了。 [wai xiang ren ， wo hai you gong zuo yao zuo …… qing bie zai da rao wo le 。]

english: Good afternoon! How do you like our village?
translation: 下午好！你觉得我们村怎么样？ [xia wu hao ！ ni jue de wo men cun zen me yang ？]

english: It's lovely. You have a fine collection of goats.
translation: 很可爱。你收集了很多山羊。 [hen ke ai 。 ni shou ji le hen duo shan yang 。]

english: We polish them every day to get them nice and clean.
translation: 我们每天都会对它们进行抛光，使它们变得又漂亮又干净。 [wo men mei tian du hui dui ta men jin xing pao guang ， shi ta men bian de you piao liang you gan jing 。]

english: Hello again! Have you any word from my husband?
translation: 又好！你有我丈夫的消息吗？ [you hao ！ ni you wo zhang fu de xiao xi ma ？]

english: Err, no, not yet. It takes a while for the messages to reach me, you know.
translation: 呃，不，还没有。你知道，这些消息需要一段时间才能到达我手中。 [e ， bu ， hai mei you 。 ni zhi dao ， zhe xie xiao xi xu yao yi duan shi jian cai neng dao da wo shou zhong 。]

english: Well, when you do, tell him we'll be more than happy to see him again.
translation: 好吧，当你这样做时，告诉他我们会非常高兴再次见到他。 [hao ba ， dang ni zhe yang zuo shi ， gao su ta wo men hui fei chang gao xing zai ci jian dao ta 。]

english: Excuse me, but are you Ingrid? The same Ingrid that is married to Olaf Hradson?
translation: 打扰一下，您是英格丽德吗？与奥拉夫·赫拉德森 (Olaf Hradson) 结婚的同一个英格丽德 (Ingrid)？ [da rao yi xia ， nin shi ying ge li de ma ？ yu ao la fu · he la de sen  (Olaf Hradson)  jie hun de tong yi ge ying ge li de  (Ingrid)？]

english: Yes I am. Why do you ask?
translation: 我是。你为什么问？ [wo shi 。 ni wei shen me wen ？]

english: I am a friend of your husband. He sent me here with a gift for you.
translation: 我是你丈夫的朋友。他派我来这里给你带礼物。 [wo shi ni zhang fu de peng you 。 ta pai wo lai zhe li gei ni dai li wu 。]

english: An expensive, exotic gift from the far-flung and tropical shores of the Island of Obscurity.
translation: 来自遥远的默默无闻岛热带海岸的昂贵而异国情调的礼物。 [lai zi yao yuan de mo mo wu wen dao re dai hai an de ang gui er yi guo qing diao de li wu 。]

english: How wonderful! I assumed from the way the big oaf always referred to the rigging as 'big strings' that he couldn't navigate his way out of a soggy paper bag. So, can I see the gift he sent?
translation: 多么美妙啊！从那个大笨蛋总是把索具称为“大绳子”的方式来看，我猜想他无法从湿漉漉的纸袋中找到出路。那么，我可以看看他送的礼物吗？ [duo me mei miao a ！ cong na ge da ben dan zong shi ba suo ju cheng wei “ da sheng zi ” de fang shi lai kan ， wo cai xiang ta wu fa cong shi lu lu de zhi dai zhong zhao dao chu lu 。 na me ， wo ke yi kan kan ta song de li wu ma ？]

english: Certainly! Here it is. He sends his best wishes along with it.
translation: 当然！这里是。他也随之致以最美好的祝愿。 [dang ran ！ zhe li shi 。 ta ye sui zhi zhi yi zui mei hao de zhu yuan 。]

english: I see. It looks like a log with 'Olaf was here' carved in it.
translation: 我懂了。它看起来像一根木头，上面刻着“奥拉夫在这里”。 [wo dong le 。 ta kan qi lai xiang yi gen mu tou ， shang mian ke zhe “ ao la fu zai zhe li ”。]

english: It's tribal! Very tribal! I watched the natives carve it myself.
translation: 这是部落的！非常部落！我看着当地人自己雕刻它。 [zhe shi bu luo de ！ fei chang bu luo ！ wo kan zhe dang di ren zi ji diao ke ta 。]

english: Well, since you have come such a long way, you can have this. I baked it this morning, so it's still nice and fresh.
translation: 好吧，既然你走了这么远，这个就可以了。我今天早上烤的，所以它仍然很好很新鲜。 [hao ba ， ji ran ni zou le zhe me yuan ， zhe ge jiu ke yi le 。 wo jin tian zao shang kao de ， suo yi ta reng ran hen hao hen xin xian 。]

english: Oh, thank you! Enjoy your Obscurian Tribal Artefact(tm). It has a million-and-one uses!
translation: 哦，谢谢你！享受您的暗黑部落文物(tm)。它有百万零一种用途！ [o ， xie xie ni ！ xiang shou nin de an hei bu luo wen wu (tm)。 ta you bai wan ling yi zhong yong tu ！]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 你知道，打招呼的方式有很多种。你好，你好，你好…… [ni zhi dao ， da zhao hu de fang shi you hen duo zhong 。 ni hao ， ni hao ， ni hao ……]

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 那还是只能算一个！ [na hai shi zhi neng suan yi ge ！]

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。你今天怎么样？ [ni hao 。 ni jin tian zen me yang ？]

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很棒，谢谢你！ [wo hen bang ， xie xie ni ！]

english: Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 你好！水晶城里今天过得怎么样啊？ [ni hao ！ shui jing cheng li jin tian guo de zen me yang a ？]

english: Indeed.
translation: 的确。 [di que 。]

english: What can I do for ya?
translation: 我能为你做什么？ [wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 各种各样的事情！这些塔楼是一个美妙的景观。 [ge zhong ge yang de shi qing ！ zhe xie ta lou shi yi ge mei miao de jing guan 。]

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 在像今天这样的日子，我建议您参观市场。 [zai xiang jin tian zhe yang de ri zi ， wo jian yi nin can guan shi chang 。]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你认为你在做什么？ [ni ren wei ni zai zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 你知道，打招呼的方式有很多种。你好，你好，你好…… [ni zhi dao ， da zhao hu de fang shi you hen duo zhong 。 ni hao ， ni hao ， ni hao ……]

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 那还是只能算一个！ [na hai shi zhi neng suan yi ge ！]

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。你今天怎么样？ [ni hao 。 ni jin tian zen me yang ？]

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很棒，谢谢你！ [wo hen bang ， xie xie ni ！]

english: Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 你好！水晶城里今天过得怎么样啊？ [ni hao ！ shui jing cheng li jin tian guo de zen me yang a ？]

english: Indeed.
translation: 的确。 [di que 。]

english: What can I do for ya?
translation: 我能为你做什么？ [wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 各种各样的事情！这些塔楼是一个美妙的景观。 [ge zhong ge yang de shi qing ！ zhe xie ta lou shi yi ge mei miao de jing guan 。]

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 在像今天这样的日子，我建议您参观市场。 [zai xiang jin tian zhe yang de ri zi ， wo jian yi nin can guan shi chang 。]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你认为你在做什么？ [ni ren wei ni zai zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: Welcome to the King's Axe inn! What can I help you with?
translation: 欢迎来到王斧旅馆！我能为您提供什么帮助？ [huan ying lai dao wang fu lv guan ！ wo neng wei nin ti gong shen me bang zhu ？]

english: Can I have some beer please?
translation: 我可以喝点啤酒吗？ [wo ke yi he dian pi jiu ma ？]

english: Go to the bar downstairs. I only deal with residents.
translation: 去楼下的酒吧。我只和居民打交道。 [qu lou xia de jiu ba 。 wo zhi he ju min da jiao dao 。]

english: Residents? People live here?
translation: 居民？人们住在这里吗？ [ju min ？ ren men zhu zai zhe li ma ？]

english: No, just guests that stay the night.
translation: 不，只有过夜的客人。 [bu ， zhi you guo ye de ke ren 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: I can never catch Eoin, he is just too fast, I am always 'It'.
translation: 我永远追不上 Eoin，他太快了，我总是“它”。 [wo yong yuan zhui bu shang  Eoin， ta tai kuai le ， wo zong shi “ ta ”。]

english: You're the one that saved us, thank you.
translation: 是你救了我们，谢谢你。 [shi ni jiu le wo men ， xie xie ni 。]

english: Thanks so much for returning my daughter to me. I expect that she will go on another trip soon though. She is the adventurous type... a bit like yourself really! Okay, see you around then!
translation: 非常感谢您将我的女儿归还给我。我预计她很快就会再去一次旅行。她是喜欢冒险的类型……真的有点像你！好的，到时候见！ [fei chang gan xie nin jiang wo de nv er gui huan gei wo 。 wo yu ji ta hen kuai jiu hui zai qu yi ci lv xing 。 ta shi xi huan mao xian de lei xing …… zhen de you dian xiang ni ！ hao de ， dao shi hou jian ！]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello, my name is Irene. I'm a chemist.
translation: 你好，我叫艾琳。我是一名化学家。 [ni hao ， wo jiao ai lin 。 wo shi yi ming hua xue jia 。]

english: We're not entirely sure. I'm here to study it to find out just that.
translation: 我们并不完全确定。我来这里就是为了研究这个问题。 [wo men bing bu wan quan que ding 。 wo lai zhe li jiu shi wei le yan jiu zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Have you tried....
translation: 你试过吗.... [ni shi guo ma ....]

english: Well, someone drank it... that didn't turn out so well.
translation: 嗯，有人喝了……结果不太好。 [n ， you ren he le …… jie guo bu tai hao 。]

english: What happened? Who was it? Are they ok?
translation: 发生了什么？是谁？他们还好吗？ [fa sheng le shen me ？ shi shui ？ ta men hai hao ma ？]

english: Well, she's still alive at the moment. It was my mum, Marie. She's a better chemist than me, but she likes to do things practically. This time it didn't work out so well for her. Lucky I was on hand to help.
translation: 还好，她现在还活着。那是我的妈妈，玛丽。她是一个比我更好的化学家，但她喜欢做实际的事情。这一次她的表现不太好。幸运的是我在场提供帮助。 [hai hao ， ta xian zai hai huo zhe 。 na shi wo de ma ma ， ma li 。 ta shi yi ge bi wo geng hao de hua xue jia ， dan ta xi huan zuo shi ji de shi qing 。 zhe yi ci ta de biao xian bu tai hao 。 xing yun de shi wo zai chang ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: I hope she recovers soon.
translation: 我希望她早日康复。 [wo xi wang ta zao ri kang fu 。]

english: Me too.
translation: 我也是。 [wo ye shi 。]

english: Ahh yes. Taking samples. We've tried all the methods we can think of, but it seems to, well, change somehow.
translation: 啊，是的。取样。我们已经尝试了所有我们能想到的方法，但它似乎在某种程度上发生了变化。 [a ， shi de 。 qu yang 。 wo men yi jing chang shi le suo you wo men neng xiang dao de fang fa ， dan ta si hu zai mou zhong cheng du shang fa sheng le bian hua 。]

english: What changes?
translation: 有什么变化？ [you shen me bian hua ？]

english: The substance. It's almost like taking a finger off a human and assuming it will stay alive I guess. The sample sort of... goes inert once we take the sample from the main body of the pool.
translation: 物质。我想，这几乎就像把一个人的一根手指从人身上取下来，然后假设它会继续活着。一旦我们从水池主体中取出样本，样本就会变得惰性。 [wu zhi 。 wo xiang ， zhe ji hu jiu xiang ba yi ge ren de yi gen shou zhi cong ren shen shang qu xia lai ， ran hou jia she ta hui ji xu huo zhe 。 yi dan wo men cong shui chi zhu ti zhong qu chu yang ben ， yang ben jiu hui bian de duo xing 。]

english: How awkward.
translation: 多么尴尬啊。 [duo me gan ga a 。]

english: Yes, we've had a bit of progress there. We've tried adding in a lot of things with varying results. The accident was the best though.
translation: 是的，我们在这方面取得了一些进展。我们尝试添加很多东西，但结果各不相同。不过，事故是最好的。 [shi de ， wo men zai zhe fang mian qu de le yi xie jin zhan 。 wo men chang shi tian jia hen duo dong xi ， dan jie guo ge bu xiang tong 。 bu guo ， shi gu shi zui hao de 。]

english: Irene looks embarassed.
translation: 艾琳看起来很尴尬。 [ai lin kan qi lai hen gan ga 。]

english: What happened?
translation: 发生了什么？ [fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: Well, I slipped and dropped a fossilised leg bone from something in the pool. It... well it kind of ate it away.
translation: 好吧，我滑倒了，一块化石腿骨从池子里的什么东西上掉了下来。它……好吧，它把它吃掉了。 [hao ba ， wo hua dao le ， yi kuai hua shi tui gu cong chi zi li de shen me dong xi shang diao le xia lai 。 ta …… hao ba ， ta ba ta chi diao le 。]

english: Was there anything left?

translation: 它们将持续 6 个月，之后您的帐户将转移到主游戏，您可以在那里正常玩游戏。 [ta men jiang chi xu  6  ge yue ， zhi hou nin de zhang hu jiang zhuan yi dao zhu you xi ， nin ke yi zai na li zheng chang wan you xi 。]

english: There is a World First system, which are achievements only obtainable once on all worlds, so you can race against others for these!
translation: 有一个世界第一系统，这是在所有世界上只能获得一次的成就，因此您可以与其他人竞争以获得这些成就！ [you yi ge shi jie di yi xi tong ， zhe shi zai suo you shi jie shang zhi neng huo de yi ci de cheng jiu ， yin ci nin ke yi yu qi ta ren jing zheng yi huo de zhe xie cheng jiu ！]

english: If a global race is a bit too much, then there is also an Achievement Point system. You can compete against your friends to get the most points.
translation: 如果全球比赛有点太多，那么还有一个成就积分系统。您可以与您的朋友竞争以获得最多的积分。 [ru guo quan qiu bi sai you dian tai duo ， na me hai you yi ge cheng jiu ji fen xi tong 。 nin ke yi yu nin de peng you jing zheng yi huo de zui duo de ji fen 。]

english: Other than that, it's the same Old School experience you know and love, with all the same content as the main game.
translation: 除此之外，它还是您熟悉和喜爱的老式学校体验，内容与主游戏相同。 [chu ci zhi wai ， ta hai shi nin shu xi he xi ai de lao shi xue xiao ti yan ， nei rong yu zhu you xi xiang tong 。]

english: Do you still wish to proceed with selecting an Iron Man mode?
translation: 您仍然希望继续选择钢铁侠模式吗？ [nin reng ran xi wang ji xu xuan ze gang tie xia mo shi ma ？]

english: Yes, I'm not interested in Fresh Start Worlds.
translation: 是的，我对“全新开始世界”不感兴趣。 [shi de ， wo dui “ quan xin kai shi shi jie ” bu gan xing qu 。]

english: That's okay. If you change your mind you can find out more about Fresh Start Worlds by speaking to the Magic Instructor, assuming you're not an ironman.
translation: 没关系。如果您改变主意，假设您不是铁人三项，您可以通过与魔法教练交谈来了解有关“新鲜开始世界”的更多信息。 [mei guan xi 。 ru guo nin gai bian zhu yi ， jia she nin bu shi tie ren san xiang ， nin ke yi tong guo yu mo fa jiao lian jiao tan lai liao jie you guan “ xin xian kai shi shi jie ” de geng duo xin xi 。]

english: You'll have to remove any ironman status first by speaking to me.
translation: 你必须先跟我说话来取消任何铁人状态。 [ni bi xu xian gen wo shuo hua lai qu xiao ren he tie ren zhuang tai 。]

english: No, Fresh Start Worlds sound like my sort of thing!
translation: 不，全新的开始世界听起来像我喜欢的类型！ [bu ， quan xin de kai shi shi jie ting qi lai xiang wo xi huan de lei xing ！]

english: Lovely! You can talk to the Magic Instructor to find out more about Fresh Start Worlds.
translation: 迷人的！您可以与魔法导师交谈以了解有关“全新开始世界”的更多信息。 [mi ren de ！ nin ke yi yu mo fa dao shi jiao tan yi liao jie you guan “ quan xin kai shi shi jie ” de geng duo xin xi 。]

english: Ah! Here you go!
translation: 啊!干得好！ [a ! gan de hao ！]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: I need you to help me with this.
translation: 我需要你帮我解决这个问题。 [wo xu yao ni bang wo jie jue zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Please give me your answer!
translation: 请给我你的答案！ [qing gei wo ni de da an ！]

english: Correct - I despise snakes!
translation: 正确——我鄙视蛇！ [zheng que —— wo bi shi she ！]

english: Nope, not correct!
translation: 不，不正确！ [bu ， bu zheng que ！]

english: Tell me about Iron[men/women].
translation: 告诉我有关铁的事[男性/女性]。 [gao su wo you guan tie de shi [ nan xing / nv xing ]。]

english: I'd like to change my Iron[man/woman] mode.
translation: 我想改变我的钢铁[男人/女人]模式。 [wo xiang gai bian wo de gang tie [ nan ren / nv ren ] mo shi 。]

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Have you any armour for me, please?
translation: 请问你有给我的盔甲吗？ [qing wen ni you gei wo de kui jia ma ？]

english: I'd like to review my Iron[man/woman] mode.
translation: 我想回顾一下我的钢铁[男人/女人]模式。 [wo xiang hui gu yi xia wo de gang tie [ nan ren / nv ren ] mo shi 。]

english: What are Fresh Start Worlds?
translation: 什么是全新开始世界？ [shen me shi quan xin kai shi shi jie ？]

english: That's fine, I'm not interested in those.
translation: 没关系，我对这些不感兴趣。 [mei guan xi ， wo dui zhe xie bu gan xing qu 。]

english: Yes, I'm not interested in Fresh Start Worlds.
translation: 是的，我对“全新开始世界”不感兴趣。 [shi de ， wo dui “ quan xin kai shi shi jie ” bu gan xing qu 。]

english: No, Fresh Start Worlds sound like my sort of thing!
translation: 不，全新的开始世界听起来像我喜欢的类型！ [bu ， quan xin de kai shi shi jie ting qi lai xiang wo xi huan de lei xing ！]

english: Hey, what do you do here?
translation: 嘿，你在这里做什么？ [hei ， ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I help the main man over there. He can get a bit cantankerous. Every now and then he'll just start attacking people without warning. I act as a sort of home help...
translation: 我帮助那边的主要人物。他可能会变得有点脾气暴躁。有时他会在没有任何警告的情况下开始攻击别人。我充当家庭帮手的角色... [wo bang zhu na bian de zhu yao ren wu 。 ta ke neng hui bian de you dian pi qi bao zao 。 you shi ta hui zai mei you ren he jing gao de qing kuang xia kai shi gong ji bie ren 。 wo chong dang jia ting bang shou de jue se ...]

english: How do you mean, home help?
translation: 家庭帮助是什么意思？ [jia ting bang zhu shi shen me yi si ？]

english: Well, sometimes he'll fly right off the handle and just start, you know, 'raising the dead' to do his 'bidding'. That kind of activity is just so anti-social, so it tends to attract a lot of hero types, you know!
translation: 好吧，有时他会突然失控，然后开始，你知道，“复活死人”来执行他的“命令”。这种活动太反社会了，所以它往往会吸引很多英雄类型，你知道的！ [hao ba ， you shi ta hui tu ran shi kong ， ran hou kai shi ， ni zhi dao ，“ fu huo si ren ” lai zhi xing ta de “ ming ling ”。 zhe zhong huo dong tai fan she hui le ， suo yi ta wang wang hui xi yin hen duo ying xiong lei xing ， ni zhi dao de ！]

english: Yes, yes, I know the sort...full of themselves aren't they.
translation: 是的，是的，我知道那种人……他们自以为是，不是吗？ [shi de ， shi de ， wo zhi dao na zhong ren …… ta men zi yi wei shi ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Exactly! They come in all, 'Have at thee! ' and 'Death to you evil one', it's all a bit too dramatic for me to be honest.
translation: 确切地！他们一齐来，‘来吧！ ”和“你这个邪恶的家伙去死吧”，老实说，这对我来说有点太戏剧化了。 [que qie di ！ ta men yi qi lai ，‘ lai ba ！ ” he “ ni zhe ge xie e de jia huo qu si ba ”， lao shi shuo ， zhe dui wo lai shuo you dian tai xi ju hua le 。]

english: Anyway, he'll often end up getting killed and nothing get's done around the house while he's awaiting his mortal return.
translation: 不管怎样，在他等待凡人回归的过程中，他常常会被杀，家里什么也做不了。 [bu guan zen yang ， zai ta deng dai fan ren hui gui de guo cheng zhong ， ta chang chang hui bei sha ， jia li shen me ye zuo bu liao 。]

english: Mortal return? Sounds interesting.
translation: 凡人回归？听起来很有趣。 [fan ren hui gui ？ ting qi lai hen you qu 。]

english: Well, it's kind of interesting the first few times, but it's like falling off a bike...
translation: 嗯，前几次还挺有趣，但就像从自行车上摔下来一样…… [n ， qian ji ci hai ting you qu ， dan jiu xiang cong zi xing che shang shuai xia lai yi yang ……]

english: What, you graze your knees a lot?
translation: 什么，你经常擦伤膝盖吗？ [shen me ， ni jing chang ca shang xi gai ma ？]

english: I was going to say that you soon get fed-up with it. I guess it's one of those perks of the job though, ability to raise yourself from the dead.
translation: 我想说你很快就会厌倦它。我想这是这份工作的福利之一，让自己起死回生。 [wo xiang shuo ni hen kuai jiu hui yan juan ta 。 wo xiang zhe shi zhe fen gong zuo de fu li zhi yi ， rang zi ji qi si hui sheng 。]

english: You'd think he'd do better things with a gift like that, but all he tends to do is get angry at people who come into his house without being invited and then he's off again 'raising the dead'.
translation: 你可能会认为他有了这样的礼物会做得更好，但他所做的就是对未经邀请就进入他家的人感到愤怒，然后他再次“起死回生”。 [ni ke neng hui ren wei ta you le zhe yang de li wu hui zuo de geng hao ， dan ta suo zuo de jiu shi dui wei jing yao qing jiu jin ru ta jia de ren gan dao fen nu ， ran hou ta zai ci “ qi si hui sheng ”。]

english: I found this torn page, do you know anything about it?
translation: 我发现了这页撕破的纸，你知道吗？ [wo fa xian le zhe ye si po de zhi ， ni zhi dao ma ？]

english: Hey...I hope you didn't rip that page out of one of those books, they'll be trouble if it was.
translation: 嘿...我希望你没有从其中一本书中撕下那一页，如果是的话，他们会很麻烦。 [hei ... wo xi wang ni mei you cong qi zhong yi ben shu zhong si xia na yi ye ， ru guo shi de hua ， ta men hui hen ma fan 。]

english: No, it wasn't actually, I got it from somewhere else, do you recognise it?
translation: 不，实际上不是，我从别处得到的，你认得吗？ [bu ， shi ji shang bu shi ， wo cong bie chu de dao de ， ni ren de ma ？]

english: Hmm, well it certainly looks like text from one of the books. Have you checked at the wizards' guild in Yanille? We sometime loan books to them.
translation: 嗯，它看起来确实像其中一本书中的文字。你去亚尼尔的巫师公会查过了吗？我们有时借书给他们。 [n ， ta kan qi lai que shi xiang qi zhong yi ben shu zhong de wen zi 。 ni qu ya ni er de wu shi gong hui cha guo le ma ？ wo men you shi jie shu gei ta men 。]

english: Hi, do you know anything about this book?
translation: 你好，请问你对这本书有了解吗？ [ni hao ， qing wen ni dui zhe ben shu you liao jie ma ？]

english: Hey...that book has been loaned to the wizards' guild in Yanille, I hope you're not returning it in a damaged condition!
translation: 嘿...那本书已借给雅尼尔的巫师公会，我希望你不要在损坏的情况下归还它！ [hei ... na ben shu yi jie gei ya ni er de wu shi gong hui ， wo xi wang ni bu yao zai sun huai de qing kuang xia gui huan ta ！]

english: Well, I was just wondering where the book came from actually and try to get some more information about it.
translation: 好吧，我只是想知道这本书实际上来自哪里，并尝试获取更多有关它的信息。 [hao ba ， wo zhi shi xiang zhi dao zhe ben shu shi ji shang lai zi na li ， bing chang shi huo qu geng duo you guan ta de xin xi 。]

english: Well, that book looks as if it's been through the wars...you're not going to return it in that condition. You take it back to the wizards at Yanille, they borrowed it, so it's their responsibility.
translation: 嗯，那本书看起来好像经历过战争……你不会在这种情况下归还它。你把它带回亚尼尔的巫师那里，他们借用了它，所以这是他们的责任。 [n ， na ben shu kan qi lai hao xiang jing li guo zhan zheng …… ni bu hui zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia gui huan ta 。 ni ba ta dai hui ya ni er de wu shi na li ， ta men jie yong le ta ， suo yi zhe shi ta men de ze ren 。]

english: Be on your guard friend.
translation: 朋友，请保持警惕。 [peng you ， qing bao chi jing ti 。]

english: Tell me about the Wintertodt.
translation: 告诉我关于温特托特的事。 [gao su wo guan yu wen te tuo te de shi 。]

english: The Wintertodt terrorised Great Kourend many centuries ago. It destroyed much of this northern land over many years before it was finally driven back into this prison.
translation: 许多世纪前，温特托特人就曾对大库伦德进行过恐怖袭击。多年来它摧毁了这片北方土地的大部分，最后被赶回这座监狱。 [xu duo shi ji qian ， wen te tuo te ren jiu ceng dui da ku lun de jin xing guo kong bu xi ji 。 duo nian lai ta cui hui le zhe pian bei fang tu di de da bu fen ， zui hou bei gan hui zhe zuo jian yu 。]

english: Why did it attack Kourend?
translation: 为什么它要攻击库伦德？ [wei shen me ta yao gong ji ku lun de ？]

english: No one knows for sure but I have a theory...
translation: 没有人确切知道，但我有一个理论...... [mei you ren que qie zhi dao ， dan wo you yi ge li lun ......]

english: Which is?
translation: 哪个是？ [na ge shi ？]

english: The Dark Altar. It felt the altar's power and wanted to consume it for itself. It wouldn't be the first time...
translation: 黑暗祭坛。它感受到了祭坛的力量，想要将其吞噬为己有。这不是第一次了... [hei an ji tan 。 ta gan shou dao le ji tan de li liang ， xiang yao jiang qi tun shi wei ji you 。 zhe bu shi di yi ci le ...]

english: Interesting...
translation: 有趣的... [you qu de ...]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: I'm Ish, one of the navigators of Piscarilius.
translation: 我是伊什，皮斯卡利留斯的航海家之一。 [wo shi yi shen ， pi si ka li liu si de hang hai jia zhi yi 。]

english: What brings a navigator up here?
translation: 是什么让导航员来到这里？ [shi shen me rang dao hang yuan lai dao zhe li ？]

english: Lady Piscarilius has sent me here to keep an eye on the situation. She doesn't trust the other houses and believes something sinister is going on.
translation: 皮斯卡利留斯女士派我来这里监视事态。她不信任其他学院，并相信正在发生一些险恶的事情。 [pi si ka li liu si nv shi pai wo lai zhe li jian shi shi tai 。 ta bu xin ren qi ta xue yuan ， bing xiang xin zheng zai fa sheng yi xie xian e de shi qing 。]

english: Like what?
translation: 比如什么？ [bi ru shen me ？]

english: I don't know, but I intend to find out.
translation: 我不知道，但我想找出答案。 [wo bu zhi dao ， dan wo xiang zhao chu da an 。]

english: What do you think of the Pyromancers?
translation: 您对火法师有何看法？ [nin dui huo fa shi you he kan fa ？]

english: I've heard stories about them and the things they have done over the years. Be careful, they can't be trusted.
translation: 我听说过有关他们的故事以及他们多年来所做的事情。小心点，他们不可信。 [wo ting shuo guo you guan ta men de gu shi yi ji ta men duo nian lai suo zuo de shi qing 。 xiao xin dian ， ta men bu ke xin 。]

english: You seem a bit paranoid.
translation: 你看起来有点偏执。 [ni kan qi lai you dian pian zhi 。]

english: Better to be paranoid than a fool. Anyone with any sense knows that the Pyromancers are trouble. They say even Lord Arceuus doesn't trust them.
translation: 偏执总比傻瓜好。任何有理智的人都知道火法师是个麻烦。他们说连阿尔宙斯大人也不信任他们。 [pian zhi zong bi sha gua hao 。 ren he you li zhi de ren dou zhi dao huo fa shi shi ge ma fan 。 ta men shuo lian a er zhou si da ren ye bu xin ren ta men 。]

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。 [wo de zou le 。]

english: Stay vigilant friend.
translation: 保持警惕的朋友。 [bao chi jing ti de peng you 。]

english: Tell me about the Wintertodt.
translation: 告诉我关于温特托特的事。 [gao su wo guan yu wen te tuo te de shi 。]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: What do you think of the Pyromancers?
translation: 您对火法师有何看法？ [nin dui huo fa shi you he kan fa ？]

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。 [wo de zou le 。]

english: Hello, what do you do around here?
translation: 你好，请问你在这附近做什么？ [ni hao ， qing wen ni zai zhe fu jin zuo shen me ？]

english: The name's Ishmael. I sell fishing supplies, along with some of the local catch.
translation: 这个名字叫以实玛利。我出售钓鱼用品以及一些当地的渔获。 [zhe ge ming zi jiao yi shi ma li 。 wo chu shou diao yu yong pin yi ji yi xie dang di de yu huo 。]

english: Can I take a look at what you have in stock?
translation: 我可以看一下你们有什么库存吗？ [wo ke yi kan yi xia ni men you shen me ku cun ma ？]

english: Aye.
translation: 是啊。 [shi a 。]

english: Why did you set up shop around here? It seems a little run down.
translation: 为什么要在这附近开店？看起来有点破旧。 [wei shen me yao zai zhe fu jin kai dian ？ kan qi lai you dian po jiu 。]

english: Argh... run down it is! But since Tempoross showed up, seadogs from all across Gielinor have been coming to wrangle the beast. It only made sense to sell off our spare resources.
translation: 啊……破败了！但自从坦普罗斯出现后，来自吉林诺各地的水手们就纷纷前来与这头野兽搏斗。只有卖掉我们的闲置资源才有意义。 [a …… po bai le ！ dan zi cong tan pu luo si chu xian hou ， lai zi ji lin nuo ge di de shui shou men jiu fen fen qian lai yu zhe tou ye shou bo dou 。 zhi you mai diao wo men de xian zhi zi yuan cai you yi yi 。]

english: I think that's everything. Goodbye.
translation: 我想这就是全部了。再见。 [wo xiang zhe jiu shi quan bu le 。 zai jian 。]

english: Safe travels.
translation: 安全出行。 [an quan chu xing 。]

english: Can I take a look at what you have in stock?
translation: 我可以看一下你们有什么库存吗？ [wo ke yi kan yi xia ni men you shen me ku cun ma ？]

english: Why did you set up shop around here? Seems a little run down.
translation: 为什么要在这附近开店？看起来有点破旧。 [wei shen me yao zai zhe fu jin kai dian ？ kan qi lai you dian po jiu 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Welcome to the Grand Library Historical Archive.
translation: 欢迎来到大图书馆历史档案馆。 [huan ying lai dao da tu shu guan li shi dang an guan 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This is the Library Historical Archive. Here you'll find historical documents and texts from all eras of Great Kourend's history, dating all the way back to the first decade.
translation: 这是图书馆历史档案馆。在这里您可以找到大库伦德历史各个时期的历史文献和文本，可以追溯到第一个十年。 [zhe shi tu shu guan li shi dang an guan 。 zai zhe li nin ke yi zhao dao da ku lun de li shi ge ge shi qi de li shi wen xian he wen ben ， ke yi zhui su dao di yi ge shi nian 。]

english: Are you looking for something in particular?
translation: 您在寻找特别的东西吗？ [nin zai xun zhao te bie de dong xi ma ？]

english: What information do you have on Xeric?
translation: 您有哪些关于 Xeric 的信息？ [nin you na xie guan yu  Xeric  de xin xi ？]

english: Ah, Xeric. Our most infamous ruler... We do have extensive records regarding Xeric. You can examine some of the texts here or speak to Ektheme, our Xerician expert.
translation: 啊，谢里克。我们最臭名昭著的统治者……我们确实有关于 Xeric 的大量记录。您可以在此处查看一些文本或与我们的 Xerician 专家 Ektheme 交谈。 [a ， xie li ke 。 wo men zui chou ming zhao zhu de tong zhi zhe …… wo men que shi you guan yu  Xeric  de da liang ji lu 。 nin ke yi zai ci chu cha kan yi xie wen ben huo yu wo men de  Xerician  zhuan jia  Ektheme  jiao tan 。]

english: Is there something else I can help you with?
translation: 还有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [hai you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

english: What can you tell me about the Wintertodt?
translation: 关于 Wintertodt，你能告诉我什么吗？ [guan yu  Wintertodt， ni neng gao su wo shen me ma ？]

english: The Wintertodt, or the Winter beast as it was often known at the time, terrorised northern Kourend for five decades.
translation: 温特托特（Wintertodt），或者当时人们常说的冬兽，对库伦德北部造成了长达五十年的恐吓。 [wen te tuo te （Wintertodt）， huo zhe dang shi ren men chang shuo de dong shou ， dui ku lun de bei bu zao cheng le zhang da wu shi nian de kong he 。]

english: Logios is currently studying the Wintertodt Invasion, and we have various texts from that era.
translation: 洛吉奥斯目前正在研究温特托特入侵，我们有那个时代的各种文本。 [luo ji ao si mu qian zheng zai yan jiu wen te tuo te ru qin ， wo men you na ge shi dai de ge zhong wen ben 。]

english: What can you tell me about Mount Quidamortem?
translation: 关于奎达莫特姆山，你能告诉我什么吗？ [guan yu kui da mo te mu shan ， ni neng gao su wo shen me ma ？]

english: Our first records of the mountain date back to the 36th decade where a Shayzien patrol discovered the mountain during a survey of the Kebos Lowlands.
translation: 我们对这座山的最早记录可以追溯到 36 世纪，当时 Shayzien 巡逻队在勘察科博斯低地时发现了这座山。 [wo men dui zhe zuo shan de zui zao ji lu ke yi zhui su dao  36  shi ji ， dang shi  Shayzien  xun luo dui zai kan cha ke bo si di di shi fa xian le zhe zuo shan 。]

english: King Shayzien VII was keen on conquering more land for Kourend and demanded his people explore suitable territories.
translation: 国王沙伊恩七世热衷于为库伦德征服更多土地，并要求他的人民探索合适的领土。 [guo wang sha yi en qi shi re zhong yu wei ku lun de zheng fu geng duo tu di ， bing yao qiu ta de ren min tan suo he shi de ling tu 。]

english: The mountain became known as Mount Quidamortem after it was realised venturing towards the summit resulted in certain death.
translation: 当人们意识到冒险登顶必然会导致死亡后，这座山就被称为奎达莫特姆山。 [dang ren men yi shi dao mao xian deng ding bi ran hui dao zhi si wang hou ， zhe zuo shan jiu bei cheng wei kui da mo te mu shan 。]

english: Gnosi is our expert on Mount Quidamortem, but I'm afraid she's currently on an expedition to the temple near the summit of the mountain. However, we do have some texts available detailing the great expedition.
translation: 诺西是我们的奎达莫特姆山专家，但恐怕她目前正在山顶附近的寺庙探险。然而，我们确实有一些详细描述这次伟大探险的文字。 [nuo xi shi wo men de kui da mo te mu shan zhuan jia ， dan kong pa ta mu qian zheng zai shan ding fu jin de si miao tan xian 。 ran er ， wo men que shi you yi xie xiang xi miao shu zhe ci wei da tan xian de wen zi 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: My name is Istoria. I'm the chief historian and curator of the Library Historical Archive.
translation: 我叫伊斯托利亚。我是图书馆历史档案馆的首席历史学家和馆长。 [wo jiao yi si tuo li ya 。 wo shi tu shu guan li shi dang an guan de shou xi li shi xue jia he guan zhang 。]

english: How do I get out of here?
translation: 我怎样才能离开这里？ [wo zen yang cai neng li kai zhe li ？]

english: I can teleport you back to the Grand Library. Would you like to leave now?
translation: 我可以将你传送回大图书馆。您现在想离开吗？ [wo ke yi jiang ni chuan song hui da tu shu guan 。 nin xian zai xiang li kai ma ？]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: I have a question about King Shayzien VII.
translation: 我有一个关于沙辛七世国王的问题。 [wo you yi ge guan yu sha xin qi shi guo wang de wen ti 。]

english: Well you've come to the right place. What would you like to know?
translation: 那么您来对地方了。您想知道什么？ [na me nin lai dui di fang le 。 nin xiang zhi dao shen me ？]

english: I'm searching for information on an expedition to Mount Quidamortem during his reign.
translation: 我正在寻找有关他统治时期奎达莫特姆山探险的信息。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao you guan ta tong zhi shi qi kui da mo te mu shan tan xian de xin xi 。]

english: Ah yes, I know of that expedition. King Shayzien VII's reign was quite a violent one according to the history books. The expedition to Quidamortem was part of his aggressive plans to expand Kourend's territory.
translation: 啊，是的，我知道那次探险。根据史书记载，沙辛七世国王的统治是相当暴力的。对奎达莫特姆的远征是他扩张库伦德领土的侵略计划的一部分。 [a ， shi de ， wo zhi dao na ci tan xian 。 gen ju shi shu ji zai ， sha xin qi shi guo wang de tong zhi shi xiang dang bao li de 。 dui kui da mo te mu de yuan zheng shi ta kuo zhang ku lun de ling tu de qin lve ji hua de yi bu fen 。]

english: Unfortunately, the expedition was a failure and the entire party was killed. The king himself died a few years later and was succeeded by the tyrant Xeric. No more expeditions were ordered under his rule.
translation: 不幸的是，这次探险失败了，全员被杀。几年后国王本人去世，暴君埃里克继位。在他的统治下，没有再下令进行远征。 [bu xing de shi ， zhe ci tan xian shi bai le ， quan yuan bei sha 。 ji nian hou guo wang ben ren qu shi ， bao jun ai li ke ji wei 。 zai ta de tong zhi xia ， mei you zai xia ling jin xing yuan zheng 。]

english: Does that help you?
translation: 这对你有帮助吗？ [zhe dui ni you bang zhu ma ？]

english: No not really. I have reason to believe that not everyone was killed on that expedition.
translation: 不，不是真的。我有理由相信，并不是所有人都在那次探险中丧生。 [bu ， bu shi zhen de 。 wo you li you xiang xin ， bing bu shi suo you ren dou zai na ci tan xian zhong sang sheng 。]

english: I'm afraid I can't help you there, all the evidence we have tells us that the expedition had no survivors.
translation: 恐怕我帮不了你，我们掌握的所有证据都告诉我们，这次探险队没有幸存者。 [kong pa wo bang bu liao ni ， wo men zhang wo de suo you zheng ju dou gao su wo men ， zhe ci tan xian dui mei you xing cun zhe 。]

english: So I'm at a dead end?
translation: 那么我就陷入了死胡同吗？ [na me wo jiu xian ru le si hu tong ma ？]

english: It would seem that way. However, if you do want to learn more about King Shayzien VII it might be worth talking to Pagida. He's recently been investigating the kings' additions to the Tower of Magic.
translation: 看起来是这样。然而，如果您确实想了解更多有关 Shayzien 七世国王的信息，可能值得与 Pagida 交谈。他最近一直在调查国王对魔法塔的扩建。 [kan qi lai shi zhe yang 。 ran er ， ru guo nin que shi xiang liao jie geng duo you guan  Shayzien  qi shi guo wang de xin xi ， ke neng zhi de yu  Pagida  jiao tan 。 ta zui jin yi zhi zai diao cha guo wang dui mo fa ta de kuo jian 。]

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Do you know anything about Camorra? She was a hero who lived around two thousand years ago.
translation: 你了解卡莫拉吗？她是一位生活在两千多年前的英雄。 [ni liao jie ka mo la ma ？ ta shi yi wei sheng huo zai liang qian duo nian qian de ying xiong 。]

english: I have heard that name, though we have very few records from before the founding of Kourend. Perhaps Imerominia could help you? She is the Horologist of the library; such ancient topics may fall within her purview.
translation: 我听说过这个名字，尽管我们在库伦德成立之前的记录很少。也许 Imerominia 可以帮助您？她是图书馆的钟表学家；这些古老的话题可能属于她的职权范围。 [wo ting shuo guo zhe ge ming zi ， jin guan wo men zai ku lun de cheng li zhi qian de ji lu hen shao 。 ye xu  Imerominia  ke yi bang zhu nin ？ ta shi tu shu guan de zhong biao xue jia ； zhe xie gu lao de hua ti ke neng shu yu ta de zhi quan fan wei 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

translation: 您有哪些关于 Xeric 的信息？ [nin you na xie guan yu  Xeric  de xin xi ？]

He looks too sick to chat.

english: Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: 嘿，这是英雄！哇！你太厉害了，你到底是怎么对付那两个少年和加德兰克的？这个小镇很可爱，你做得很好！ [hei ， zhe shi ying xiong ！ wa ！ ni tai li hai le ， ni dao di shi zen me dui fu na liang ge shao nian he jia de lan ke de ？ zhe ge xiao zhen hen ke ai ， ni zuo de hen hao ！]

english: It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
translation: 非常完美，非常感谢您的努力。 [fei chang wan mei ， fei chang gan xie nin de nu li 。]

english: What's happening around here?
translation: 这附近发生了什么事？ [zhe fu jin fa sheng le shen me shi ？]

english: Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: 哦，其实也没什么，我们都还在躲避吸血鬼，在这个可怕的地方勉强维持生计，希望很快我们就能足够强大，踏上前往圣殿的旅程。 [o ， qi shi ye mei shen me ， wo men dou hai zai duo bi xi xue gui ， zai zhe ge ke pa de di fang mian qiang wei chi sheng ji ， xi wang hen kuai wo men jiu neng zu gou qiang da ， ta shang qian wang sheng dian de lv cheng 。]

english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: 据我所知，我们现在有一些非常有用的基本设施，我们都非常感谢您。我以前从未真正见过或认识英雄，所以我没有什么可以与之比较的，但我怀疑 [ju wo suo zhi ， wo men xian zai you yi xie fei chang you yong de ji ben she shi ， wo men dou fei chang gan xie nin 。 wo yi qian cong wei zhen zheng jian guo huo ren shi ying xiong ， suo yi wo mei you shen me ke yi yu zhi bi jiao de ， dan wo huai yi]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Is something new and exciting happening?
translation: 有什么新的、令人兴奋的事情发生吗？ [you shen me xin de 、 ling ren xing fen de shi qing fa sheng ma ？]

english: Maybe. Veliaf has asked me to do some work for him. Hopefully it will benefit you all.
translation: 或许。维利亚夫让我为他做一些工作。希望它能让大家受益。 [huo xu 。 wei li ya fu rang wo wei ta zuo yi xie gong zuo 。 xi wang ta neng rang da jia shou yi 。]

translation: 美好的。 [mei hao de 。]

english: Are you sure? You know I'm here if you need anything.
translation: 你确定吗？你知道如果你需要什么我就在这里。 [ni que ding ma ？ ni zhi dao ru guo ni xu yao shen me wo jiu zai zhe li 。]

english: I'm fine. Did you need something?
translation: 我很好。你需要什么吗？ [wo hen hao 。 ni xu yao shen me ma ？]

translation: 只是登记入住。我就不打扰你了。 [zhi shi deng ji ru zhu 。 wo jiu bu da rao ni le 。]

translation: 我这里有一些，还有其他一些东西。但这会让你付出代价。 [wo zhe li you yi xie ， hai you qi ta yi xie dong xi 。 dan zhe hui rang ni fu chu dai jia 。]

translation: 我需要另一个德拉坎勋章。 [wo xu yao ling yi ge de la kan xun zhang 。]

english: Sure.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

translation: [玩家姓名]。我这里有一本我认为属于你的书。 [[ wan jia xing ming ]。 wo zhe li you yi ben wo ren wei shu yu ni de shu 。]

translation: 谢谢你，伊万。 [xie xie ni ， yi wan 。]

translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: You look like a man that could use a mace. Finest weapons around! Want to take a look?
translation: 你看起来就像一个会使用狼牙棒的人。周围最好的武器！想看一下吗？ [ni kan qi lai jiu xiang yi ge hui shi yong lang ya bang de ren 。 zhou wei zui hao de wu qi ！ xiang kan yi xia ma ？]

english: Yes, please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: MMMGHGHGGMH!!!
translation: 嗯嗯嗯嗯！！！ [n n n n ！！！]

english: What's going on ARRGH!
translation: 到底发生了什么啊！ [dao di fa sheng le shen me a ！]

english: Arrgh! Human! Scary! Go away!
translation: 啊啊！人类！可怕的！离开！ [a a ！ ren lei ！ ke pa de ！ li kai ！]

english: Can I help you?
translation: 我可以帮你吗？ [wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: What's up with him?
translation: 他怎么了？ [ta zen me le ？]

english: Another gift from the sea. Found him on the shore a few days ago.
translation: 又是一份来自大海的礼物。几天前在岸边发现了他。 [you shi yi fen lai zi da hai de li wu 。 ji tian qian zai an bian fa xian le ta 。]

english: The moon... His face was the moon...
translation: 月亮……他的脸就是月亮…… [yue liang …… ta de lian jiu shi yue liang ……]

english: Is he going to be okay?
translation: 他会没事吗？ [ta hui mei shi ma ？]

english: Maybe. Maybe not. Only time will tell.
translation: 或许。也许不是。只有时间才能证明一切。 [huo xu 。 ye xu bu shi 。 zhi you shi jian cai neng zheng ming yi qie 。]

english: Okay... What are you going to do with him?
translation: 好吧...你打算对他做什么？ [hao ba ... ni da suan dui ta zuo shen me ？]

english: He'll get the same offer they all do. We don't need mouths to feed if they won't contribute. Once he's up, he can either stick around or ship out, but if he's staying, he has to help.
translation: 他会得到和他们一样的报价。如果他们不做出贡献，我们就不需要吃饭。一旦他站起来，他可以留下来，也可以离开，但如果他留下来，他就必须提供帮助。 [ta hui de dao he ta men yi yang de bao jia 。 ru guo ta men bu zuo chu gong xian ， wo men jiu bu xu yao chi fan 。 yi dan ta zhan qi lai ， ta ke yi liu xia lai ， ye ke yi li kai ， dan ru guo ta liu xia lai ， ta jiu bi xu ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: Help with what?
translation: 帮忙什么？ [bang mang shen me ？]

english: Salvage of course. We don't have the luxuries of Fortis out here. We have to make do with what we can find. Luckily for us, there's always plenty to be found thanks to all the wrecks.
translation: 当然是抢救。我们这里没有富通的奢侈品。我们必须凑合着用我们能找到的东西。对我们来说幸运的是，由于所有的沉船，总能找到很多东西。 [dang ran shi qiang jiu 。 wo men zhe li mei you fu tong de she chi pin 。 wo men bi xu cou he zhe yong wo men neng zhao dao de dong xi 。 dui wo men lai shuo xing yun de shi ， you yu suo you de chen chuan ， zong neng zhao dao hen duo dong xi 。]

translation: 你怎么认为？ [ni zen me ren wei ？]
