translation: 如果他没有康复会怎样？ [ru guo ta mei you kang fu hui zen yang ？]

english: The sea can have him back.
translation: 大海可以让他回来。 [da hai ke yi rang ta hui lai 。]

english: Harsh.
translation: 残酷的。 [can ku de 。]

english: I told you before, we don't have the luxuries of Fortis out here. The dead are not useful, nor are they worth anything.
translation: 我之前告诉过你，我们这里没有富通的奢侈品。死了的人没有任何用处，也没有任何价值。 [wo zhi qian gao su guo ni ， wo men zhe li mei you fu tong de she chi pin 。 si le de ren mei you ren he yong chu ， ye mei you ren he jia zhi 。]

english: If he does live, he will have an opportunity. If he desires, he can have a home here, provided he's willing to contribute.
translation: 如果他还活着，他就有机会。如果他愿意，只要他愿意做出贡献，他就可以在这里安家。 [ru guo ta hai huo zhe ， ta jiu you ji hui 。 ru guo ta yuan yi ， zhi yao ta yuan yi zuo chu gong xian ， ta jiu ke yi zai zhe li an jia 。]

english: Hi there. Would you like to buy a cape?
translation: 你好呀。你想买一件斗篷吗？ [ni hao ya 。 ni xiang mai yi jian dou peng ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Suit yourself.
translation: 适合自己。 [shi he zi ji 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Thanks so much for saving us from those stinky gublinch. They were awful! I hope Shanty gave you somefing cool for your efforts.
translation: 非常感谢你把我们从那些臭家伙手中救了出来。他们太糟糕了！我希望 Shanty 能够为你的努力带来一些酷炫的东西。 [fei chang gan xie ni ba wo men cong na xie chou jia huo shou zhong jiu le chu lai 。 ta men tai zao gao le ！ wo xi wang  Shanty  neng gou wei ni de nu li dai lai yi xie ku xuan de dong xi 。]

english: Ha Ha Ha  If it isn't Jack Frost. You look smaller than last time I saw you.
translation: 哈哈哈如果不是杰克·弗罗斯特。你看上去比我上次见到你时要小一些。 [ha ha ha ru guo bu shi jie ke · fu luo si te 。 ni kan shang qu bi wo shang ci jian dao ni shi yao xiao yi xie 。]

english: A-A-Anti Santa!? What are you doing here?
translation: 啊啊啊反圣诞老人！？你在这里做什么？ [a a a fan sheng dan lao ren ！？ ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Your father sent me. Apparently, you've been rather naughty this year.
translation: 你父亲派我来的。看来你今年过得很调皮。 [ni fu qin pai wo lai de 。 kan lai ni jin nian guo de hen tiao pi 。]

english: I'm here to sort you out.
translation: 我是来给你安排的。 [wo shi lai gei ni an pai de 。]

english: What? My dad sent you? No way, he put me in charge of Christmas.
translation: 什么？我爸派你来的？没办法，他让我负责圣诞节。 [shen me ？ wo ba pai ni lai de ？ mei ban fa ， ta rang wo fu ze sheng dan jie 。]

english: He did and apparently you're doing such an awful job of it, you've ruined it for everyone...
translation: 他做到了，显然你做得太糟糕了，你毁了每个人的一切...... [ta zuo dao le ， xian ran ni zuo de tai zao gao le ， ni hui le mei ge ren de yi qie ......]

english: When you think about it, are you sure you're not my son?
translation: 你想一想，你确定你不是我儿子吗？ [ni xiang yi xiang ， ni que ding ni bu shi wo er zi ma ？]

english: You're not my father, you're just an ugly bag of bones.
translation: 你不是我的父亲，你只是一具丑陋的骨头。 [ni bu shi wo de fu qin ， ni zhi shi yi ju chou lou de gu tou 。]

english: I won't let you stop me. Take this!
translation: 我不会让你阻止我。拿着这个！ [wo bu hui rang ni zu zhi wo 。 na zhe zhe ge ！]

english: Ha Ha Ha. Is that all you've got, Jack?
translation: 哈哈哈。这就是你的全部了，杰克？ [ha ha ha 。 zhe jiu shi ni de quan bu le ， jie ke ？]

english: Oh come on! How did that not hurt you?
translation: 哦来吧！那怎么没有伤害你？ [o lai ba ！ na zen me mei you shang hai ni ？]

english: You're weak just like your father.
translation: 你和你父亲一样软弱。 [ni he ni fu qin yi yang ruan ruo 。]

english: I'm gonna slap you back to Lumbridge!
translation: 我要把你扇回朗布里奇！ [wo yao ba ni shan hui lang bu li qi ！]

english: Argh!
You're going to need a lot worse to defeat me.
translation: 你需要比我更糟糕才能打败我。 [ni xu yao bi wo geng zao gao cai neng da bai wo 。]

english: Good thing I'm not done yet.
translation: 还好我还没做完。 [hai hao wo hai mei zuo wan 。]

english: I learned this from an old friend of mine.
translation: 这是我从一位老朋友那里得知的。 [zhe shi wo cong yi wei lao peng you na li de zhi de 。]

english: Ouch!
translation: 哎哟! [ai yo !]

english: You cannot stop me Jack.
translation: 你无法阻止我，杰克。 [ni wu fa zu zhi wo ， jie ke 。]

english: I'm not finished yet.
translation: 我还没说完。 [wo hai mei shuo wan 。]

english: Mummy!
translation: 木乃伊！ [mu nai yi ！]

english: I'm getting out of here. This isn't worth it!
translation: 我要离开这里。这不值得！ [wo yao li kai zhe li 。 zhe bu zhi de ！]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: So how's life as a pirate?
translation: 那么海贼的生活是怎样的呢？ [na me hai zei de sheng huo shi zen yang de ne ？]

english: What kind of question is that? How's life as a... I dunno. Whatever it is that you do for a living.
translation: 这是什么问题？生活怎么样……我不知道。无论你以什么为生。 [zhe shi shen me wen ti ？ sheng huo zen me yang …… wo bu zhi dao 。 wu lun ni yi shen me wei sheng 。]

english: I'm a freelance troubleshooter.
translation: 我是一名自由疑难解答者。 [wo shi yi ming zi you yi nan jie da zhe 。]

english: What does that entail then?
translation: 那么这意味着什么呢？ [na me zhe yi wei zhe shen me ne ？]

english: Mostly killing things for money and delivering items around the planet for people.
translation: 主要是为了钱而杀人，并为人们在地球各地运送物品。 [zhu yao shi wei le qian er sha ren ， bing wei ren men zai di qiu ge di yun song wu pin 。]

english: I collect stuff.
translation: 我收集东西。 [wo shou ji dong xi 。]

english: So how's that life?
translation: 那么这样的生活怎么样呢？ [na me zhe yang de sheng huo zen me yang ne ？]

english: Can't complain, can't complain...
translation: 不能抱怨，不能抱怨…… [bu neng bao yuan ， bu neng bao yuan ……]

english: Well, there you go.
translation: 好吧，就这样吧。 [hao ba ， jiu zhe yang ba 。]

english: Aren't you a little short for a pirate?
translation: 你对于海盗来说是不是有点矮了？ [ni dui yu hai dao lai shuo shi bu shi you dian ai le ？]

english: My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.
translation: 我的母亲是一个侏儒。显然这是一次非常痛苦的分娩。 [wo de mu qin shi yi ge zhu ru 。 xian ran zhe shi yi ci fei chang tong ku de fen mian 。]

english: More info than I wanted, thanks!
translation: 比我想要的更多信息，谢谢！ [bi wo xiang yao de geng duo xin xi ， xie xie ！]

english: Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.
translation: 抱歉，不能停下来，如果船长发现我偷懒地跟偷渡者说话，我的胆子会被吊袜带的。 [bao qian ， bu neng ting xia lai ， ru guo chuan zhang fa xian wo tou lan di gen tou du zhe shuo hua ， wo de dan zi hui bei diao wa dai de 。]

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard!
translation: 我不是偷渡者！我被邀请上船了！ [wo bu shi tou du zhe ！ wo bei yao qing shang chuan le ！]

english: Yeah, whatever [guy/lady], it doesn't really matter who you are I'll get in trouble!
translation: 是的，无论[男人/女人]，无论你是谁，我都会遇到麻烦！ [shi de ， wu lun [ nan ren / nv ren ]， wu lun ni shi shui ， wo du hui yu dao ma fan ！]

english: You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.
translation: 你知道，我一直想知道海盗的生活究竟意味着什么。 [ni zhi dao ， wo yi zhi xiang zhi dao hai dao de sheng huo jiu jing yi wei zhe shen me 。]

english: Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.
translation: 嗯，目前主要涉及偷渡者随机询问问题。 [n ， mu qian zhu yao she ji tou du zhe sui ji xun wen wen ti 。]

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard! By Lokar! Ask him!
translation: 我不是偷渡者！我被邀请上船了！洛卡写的！问他吧！ [wo bu shi tou du zhe ！ wo bei yao qing shang chuan le ！ luo ka xie de ！ wen ta ba ！]

english: Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.
translation: 嘿，无论如何[爱人/朋友]。只要确保船长没有抓住你，海盗不太喜欢偷渡者。 [hei ， wu lun ru he [ ai ren / peng you ]。 zhi yao que bao chuan zhang mei you zhua zhu ni ， hai dao bu tai xi huan tou du zhe 。]

english: Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?
translation: 啊，祝你有美好的一天[milady/sirrah]！你的脸很陌生，你是不是和我们一起登上了月岛的船？ [a ， zhu ni you mei hao de yi tian [milady/sirrah]！ ni de lian hen mo sheng ， ni shi bu shi he wo men yi qi deng shang le yue dao de chuan ？]

english: No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.
translation: 不，洛卡实际上让我在雷莱卡搭车。 [bu ， luo ka shi ji shang rang wo zai lei lai ka da che 。]

english: Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!
translation: 哦真的吗？在我看来你不像弗雷曼尼克人！ [o zhen de ma ？ zai wo kan lai ni bu xiang fu lei man ni ke ren ！]

english: Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
translation: 嗯……我有点是，又有点不是。这是一个很长的故事。 [n …… wo you dian shi ， you you dian bu shi 。 zhe shi yi ge hen zhang de gu shi 。]

english: Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a-fremennik!
translation: 抱歉我没时间听！再见，年轻的弗雷曼尼克，他不是真正的弗雷曼尼克！ [bao qian wo mei shi jian ting ！ zai jian ， nian qing de fu lei man ni ke ， ta bu shi zhen zheng de fu lei man ni ke ！]

english: 'Bye.
translation: '再见。 [' zai jian 。]

english: Brrrr! Its cold up here!
translation: 呜呜！这里很冷！ [wu wu ！ zhe li hen leng ！]

english: You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!
translation: 你觉得这很冷吗？到了 Acheron 那里，天气变得非常寒冷，当你说话时，你会看到话语冻结在你面前的空气中！ [ni jue de zhe hen leng ma ？ dao le  Acheron  na li ， tian qi bian de fei chang han leng ， dang ni shuo hua shi ， ni hui kan dao hua yu dong jie zai ni mian qian de kong qi zhong ！]

english: REALLY?
translation: 真的吗？ [zhen de ma ？]

english: Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!
translation: 不，不是真的。我为了达到幽默效果而夸张了。不过天气非常非常冷！ [bu ， bu shi zhen de 。 wo wei le da dao you mo xiao guo er kua zhang le 。 bu guo tian qi fei chang fei chang leng ！]

english: Hello to you too.
translation: 也向你问好。 [ye xiang ni wen hao 。]

english: Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
translation: 呀！我们是海盗，耶！阿瓦斯特，你们这些坏血病的陆生荔枝！ [ya ！ wo men shi hai dao ， ye ！ a wa si te ， ni men zhe xie huai xue bing de lu sheng li zhi ！]

english: Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
translation: 请不要这样说话，这太令人恼火了。 [qing bu yao zhe yang shuo hua ， zhe tai ling ren nao huo le 。]

english: Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
translation: 另外，请不要叫我荔枝，不管那是什么。 [ling wai ， qing bu yao jiao wo li zhi ， bu guan na shi shen me 。]

english: Oh. Okay. Sorry.
translation: 哦。好的。对不起。 [o 。 hao de 。 dui bu qi 。]

english: ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!
translation: 啊啊！拉响警报！船上偷渡者！船上偷渡者！ [a a ！ la xiang jing bao ！ chuan shang tou du zhe ！ chuan shang tou du zhe ！]

english: No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
translation: 不！我不是偷渡者！诚实的！我被邀请来到这里！ [bu ！ wo bu shi tou du zhe ！ cheng shi de ！ wo bei yao qing lai dao zhe li ！]

english: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
translation: 哦，抱歉，那是我的错误。 [o ， bao qian ， na shi wo de cuo wu 。]

english: You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.
translation: 但你必须承认你看起来确实很像一个偷渡者。 [dan ni bi xu cheng ren ni kan qi lai que shi hen xiang yi ge tou du zhe 。]

english: Why, what do they usually look like?
translation: 为什么，他们通常是什么样子？ [wei shen me ， ta men tong chang shi shen me yang zi ？]

english: Erm... I've never actually met one...
translation: 呃……我从来没有真正见过一个…… [e …… wo cong lai mei you zhen zheng jian guo yi ge ……]

english: Okay then...
translation: 好吧，那么... [hao ba ， na me ...]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: So... You're a pirate, huh?
translation: 那么...你是海盗，是吧？ [na me ... ni shi hai dao ， shi ba ？]

english: It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.
translation: 月底我的工资单上就是这么写的。 [yue di wo de gong zi dan shang jiu shi zhe me xie de 。]

english: How's that working out for you?
translation: 你感觉怎么样？ [ni gan jue zen me yang ？]

english: Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.
translation: 到目前为止还不错。我们可以掠夺的所有烈酒和战利品，再加上包括牙科在内的全套医疗服务。 [dao mu qian wei zhi hai bu cuo 。 wo men ke yi lve duo de suo you lie jiu he zhan li pin ， zai jia shang bao kuo ya ke zai nei de quan tao yi liao fu wu 。]

english: You mean you have insurance?
translation: 你是说你有保险？ [ni shi shuo ni you bao xian ？]

english: Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.
translation: 不是这样的。如果我们中的任何一个人生病了，我们就会绑架一名医生，直到我们病情好转之前不让他走。 [bu shi zhe yang de 。 ru guo wo men zhong de ren he yi ge ren sheng bing le ， wo men jiu hui bang jia yi ming yi sheng ， zhi dao wo men bing qing hao zhuan zhi qian bu rang ta zou 。]

english: You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.
translation: 您会惊讶地发现，这对于专家医疗保健来说是多么大的激励。 [nin hui jing ya di fa xian ， zhe dui yu zhuan jia yi liao bao jian lai shuo shi duo me da de ji li 。]

english: I can imagine.
translation: 我可以想象。 [wo ke yi xiang xiang 。]

english: Hello there. So what brings you aboard the Lady Zay?
translation: 你好呀。那么是什么让您登上了 Lady Zay 号呢？ [ni hao ya 。 na me shi shen me rang nin deng shang le  Lady Zay  hao ne ？]

english: Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.
translation: 嗯，我原本打算去拜访月族，但我不得不说你们的船非常令人印象深刻。 [n ， wo yuan ben da suan qu bai fang yue zu ， dan wo bu de bu shuo ni men de chuan fei chang ling ren yin xiang shen ke 。]

english: Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!
translation: 是啊，果然是个美女啊！扎伊女士酒店一直是我的家，度过了许多艰难的几个月，经历了暴风雨和阳光，她总是带我们到达我们要去的地方！ [shi a ， guo ran shi ge mei nv a ！ zha yi nv shi jiu dian yi zhi shi wo de jia ， du guo le xu duo jian nan de ji ge yue ， jing li le bao feng yu he yang guang ， ta zong shi dai wo men dao da wo men yao qu de di fang ！]

english: Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!
translation: 是的，她确实是我旅行中见过的最好的船之一！ [shi de ， ta que shi shi wo lv xing zhong jian guo de zui hao de chuan zhi yi ！]

english: That she is [lad/lass], that she is.
translation: 她是[小伙子/姑娘]，她就是。 [ta shi [ xiao huo zi / gu niang ]， ta jiu shi 。]

english: Arrr, matey!
translation: 啊，伙计！ [a ， huo ji ！]

english: I'm looking for Redbeard Frank.
translation: 我正在寻找红胡子弗兰克。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao hong hu zi fu lan ke 。]

english: Redbeard Frank ye say? He be outside. Says he likes the feel of the wind on his cheeks.
translation: 红胡子弗兰克你说呢？他在外面。说他喜欢风拂过脸颊的感觉。 [hong hu zi fu lan ke ni shuo ne ？ ta zai wai mian 。 shuo ta xi huan feng fu guo lian jia de gan jue 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Drinking.
translation: 喝。 [he 。]

english: Fair enough.
translation: 很公平。 [hen gong ping 。]

english: Have you got any quests I could do?
translation: 你有什么任务我可以做吗？ [ni you shen me ren wu wo ke yi zuo ma ？]

english: Nay, but the barkeep hears most of the news around here. Or Redbeard Frank, he's often spoken of buried treasure. Perhaps ye should be asking them for quests.
translation: 不，但这里的大部分新闻都是酒保听到的。或者红胡子弗兰克，他经常谈论埋藏的宝藏。也许你们应该向他们询问任务。 [bu ， dan zhe li de da bu fen xin wen dou shi jiu bao ting dao de 。 huo zhe hong hu zi fu lan ke ， ta jing chang tan lun mai cang de bao zang 。 ye xu ni men ying gai xiang ta men xun wen ren wu 。]

english: Nay, but Redbeard Frank has often spoken of buried treasure. Perhaps ye should be asking him for a quest.
translation: 不，但是红胡子弗兰克经常谈到埋藏的宝藏。也许你应该向他提出一个任务。 [bu ， dan shi hong hu zi fu lan ke jing chang tan dao mai cang de bao zang 。 ye xu ni ying gai xiang ta ti chu yi ge ren wu 。]

english: Nay, but the barkeep hears most of the news around here. Perhaps ye should be asking him for a quest.
translation: 不，但这里的大部分新闻都是酒保听到的。也许你应该向他提出一个任务。 [bu ， dan zhe li de da bu fen xin wen dou shi jiu bao ting dao de 。 ye xu ni ying gai xiang ta ti chu yi ge ren wu 。]

english: Nay, I've nothing for ye to do. But I hear there's an old landlubber in Draynor Village who's always a-looking for a lively [lad/lass] to do him a favour.
translation: 不，我没有什么可以让你做的。但我听说德拉诺村有一个旱鸭子，他总是在寻找一个活泼的[小伙子/姑娘]来帮他一个忙。 [bu ， wo mei you shen me ke yi rang ni zuo de 。 dan wo ting shuo de la nuo cun you yi ge han ya zi ， ta zong shi zai xun zhao yi ge huo po de [ xiao huo zi / gu niang ] lai bang ta yi ge mang 。]

english: Yo ho ho!
translation: 哟嗬嗬！ [yo he he ！]

english: So are you pirates?
translation: 那么你们是海盗吗？ [na me ni men shi hai dao ma ？]

english: Aye [laddie/lassie], that we are.
translation: 是的[小伙子/小姑娘]，我们就是。 [shi de [ xiao huo zi / xiao gu niang ]， wo men jiu shi 。]

english: Aye, that we be.
translation: 是的，我们就是这样。 [shi de ， wo men jiu shi zhe yang 。]

english: Nay, always ye say it wrong! Tis 'we are', not 'we be'.
translation: 不，你们总是说错！这是“我们是”，而不是“我们是”。 [bu ， ni men zong shi shuo cuo ！ zhe shi “ wo men shi ”， er bu shi “ wo men shi ”。]

english: I be a pirate, not a scurvy schoolmaster!
translation: 我是一名海盗，而不是一名坏血病校长！ [wo shi yi ming hai dao ， er bu shi yi ming huai xue bing xiao zhang ！]

english: Ye be a fool, and a disgrace to piracy.
translation: 你们是个傻瓜，是盗版的耻辱。 [ni men shi ge sha gua ， shi dao ban de chi ru 。]

english: Now ye be saying 'be' too!
translation: 现在你们也可以说“是”了！ [xian zai ni men ye ke yi shuo “ shi ” le ！]

translation: 哇，谢谢！ [wa ， xie xie ！]

english: If you ever lose your amulet, come back to me to reclaim it.
translation: 如果你丢失了护身符，请回来找我取回。 [ru guo ni diu shi le hu shen fu ， qing hui lai zhao wo qu hui 。]

english: I've completed all of the medium tasks in my Desert achievement diary!
translation: 我已经完成了沙漠成就日记中的所有中等任务！ [wo yi jing wan cheng le sha mo cheng jiu ri ji zhong de suo you zhong deng ren wu ！]

english: I've upgraded your Desert amulet for you. You can now charge a Pharaoh's sceptre with 25 charges and the amulet will teleport you to Nardah once per day.
translation: 我已经为你升级了你的沙漠护身符。你现在可以为法老的权杖充能 25 点，护身符每天会将你传送到纳尔达一次。 [wo yi jing wei ni sheng ji le ni de sha mo hu shen fu 。 ni xian zai ke yi wei fa lao de quan zhang chong neng  25  dian ， hu shen fu mei tian hui jiang ni chuan song dao na er da yi ci 。]

english: I've completed all of the hard tasks in my Desert achievement diary!
translation: 我已经完成了沙漠成就日记中的所有艰巨任务！ [wo yi jing wan cheng le sha mo cheng jiu ri ji zhong de suo you jian ju ren wu ！]

english: I've upgraded your Desert amulet for you. You can now charge a Pharaoh's sceptre with 50 charges, you can adjust your Camulet to teleport you above the temple and the Nardah herbalist will create unfinished
translation: 我已经为你升级了你的沙漠护身符。你现在可以为法老的权杖充能 50 点，你可以调整你的 Camulet 将你传送到神庙上方，Nardah 草药师将创造未完成的 [wo yi jing wei ni sheng ji le ni de sha mo hu shen fu 。 ni xian zai ke yi wei fa lao de quan zhang chong neng  50  dian ， ni ke yi tiao zheng ni de  Camulet  jiang ni chuan song dao shen miao shang fang ，Nardah  cao yao shi jiang chuang zao wei wan cheng de]

english: potions for you.
translation: 给你的药水。 [gei ni de yao shui 。]

english: All rides on a magic carpet are now free, and you can climb through the Al Kharid Palace southern window too, if your Agility level's up to it.
translation: 现在，魔毯上的所有游乐设施都是免费的，如果您的敏捷程度足够的话，您也可以爬过阿尔卡里德宫南窗。 [xian zai ， mo tan shang de suo you you le she shi dou shi mian fei de ， ru guo nin de min jie cheng du zu gou de hua ， nin ye ke yi pa guo a er ka li de gong nan chuang 。]

english: Can I have another amulet?
translation: 我可以再要一个护身符吗？ [wo ke yi zai yao yi ge hu shen fu ma ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I have a question about my Achievement Diary
translation: 我对我的成就日记有疑问 [wo dui wo de cheng jiu ri ji you yi wen]

english: What is the Achievement Diary?
translation: 什么是成就日记？ [shen me shi cheng jiu ri ji ？]

english: What are the rewards?
translation: 有什么奖励？ [you shen me jiang li ？]

english: Easy Rewards.
translation: 轻松奖励。 [qing song jiang li 。]

english: Medium Rewards.
translation: 中等奖励。 [zhong deng jiang li 。]

english: Hard Rewards.
translation: 艰苦的奖励。 [jian ku de jiang li 。]

english: Elite Rewards.
translation: 精英奖励。 [jing ying jiang li 。]

english: How do I claim the rewards?
translation: 我如何领取奖励？ [wo ru he ling qu jiang li ？]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: What do you want from me outerlander? It is our policy not to associate with those not of our tribe.
translation: 你想从我这个外地人那里得到什么？我们的政策是不与非我们部落的人交往。 [ni xiang cong wo zhe ge wai di ren na li de dao shen me ？ wo men de zheng ce shi bu yu fei wo men bu luo de ren jiao wang 。]

english: Where is your chieftain? I find it highly discriminatory to refuse to talk to someone on the grounds that they are not part of your tribe.
translation: 你们的酋长在哪里？我发现以某人不属于你的部落为由而拒绝与他们交谈是高度歧视的行为。 [ni men de qiu zhang zai na li ？ wo fa xian yi mou ren bu shu yu ni de bu luo wei you er ju jue yu ta men jiao tan shi gao du qi shi de xing wei 。]

english: I don't rightly understand your speech outerlander, but my loyalty is with Chieftain Brundt.
translation: 我不太明白你的讲话，外乡人，但我忠于布伦特酋长。 [wo bu tai ming bai ni de jiang hua ， wai xiang ren ， dan wo zhong yu bu lun te qiu zhang 。]

english: He resides in our longhall; it is the large building over there, you should speak to him for he speaks for us all.
translation: 他住在我们的长厅里；那边是一座大建筑，你应该和他说话，因为他代表我们所有人说话。 [ta zhu zai wo men de zhang ting li ； na bian shi yi zuo da jian zhu ， ni ying gai he ta shuo hua ， yin wei ta dai biao wo men suo you ren shuo hua 。]

english: So what are you doing here?
translation: 那么你在这里做什么？ [na me ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: This should not concern you, outerlander. I am awaiting other Fremenniks to join me on an expedition to Waterbirth Island.
translation: 这不应该让你担心，外地人。我正在等待其他弗雷曼尼克人和我一起去沃特出生岛探险。 [zhe bu ying gai rang ni dan xin ， wai di ren 。 wo zheng zai deng dai qi ta fu lei man ni ke ren he wo yi qi qu wo te chu sheng dao tan xian 。]

english: It is a small crescent-shaped island just north-west of here, outerlander.
translation: 这是一个新月形的小岛，位于这里的西北部，外地人。 [zhe shi yi ge xin yue xing de xiao dao ， wei yu zhe li de xi bei bu ， wai di ren 。]

english: We have many legends about it, such as the tale of the broken sky, and the day of the green seas.
translation: 关于它，我们有很多传说，比如破碎的天空的故事、绿海的日子。 [guan yu ta ， wo men you hen duo chuan shuo ， bi ru po sui de tian kong de gu shi 、 lv hai de ri zi 。]

english: The reason I am travelling there is more serious Fremennik business, however. I doubt an outerlander would be interested.
translation: 然而，我去那里旅行的原因是更重要的弗雷曼尼克事务。我怀疑外地人会感兴趣。 [ran er ， wo qu na li lv xing de yuan yin shi geng zhong yao de fu lei man ni ke shi wu 。 wo huai yi wai di ren hui gan xing qu 。]

english: Can I come?
translation: 我可以来吗？ [wo ke yi lai ma ？]

english: An outerlander join us on an honoured hunt???
translation: 一个外来者加入我们进行一次光荣的狩猎？？？ [yi ge wai lai zhe jia ru wo men jin xing yi ci guang rong de shou lie ？？？]

english: Well.... I guess... I might be able to allow you to join us, although it is a breach of many of our customs...
translation: 嗯……我想……我也许可以允许你加入我们，尽管这违反了我们的许多习俗…… [n …… wo xiang …… wo ye xu ke yi yun xu ni jia ru wo men ， jin guan zhe wei fan le wo men de xu duo xi su ……]

english: Oh, pleeeeease? I really LOVE killing stuff!
translation: 哦，拜托了？我真的很喜欢杀人！ [o ， bai tuo le ？ wo zhen de hen xi huan sha ren ！]

english: Well... I remain unconvinced that it would be wise to allow an outerlander to join us in such dangerous battle, but your enthusiasm seems genuine enough...
translation: 好吧……我仍然不相信让一个外来者加入我们参加如此危险的战斗是明智的，但你的热情似乎足够真诚…… [hao ba …… wo reng ran bu xiang xin rang yi ge wai lai zhe jia ru wo men can jia ru ci wei xian de zhan dou shi ming zhi de ， dan ni de re qing si hu zu gou zhen cheng ……]

english: I will allow you to escort us, but you must pay me a sum of money first.
translation: 我允许你护送我们，但是你必须先付给我一笔钱。 [wo yun xu ni hu song wo men ， dan shi ni bi xu xian fu gei wo yi bi qian 。]

english: What? That's outrageous, why charge me money? And, uh, how much does it cost me?
translation: 什么？太离谱了，为什么要收我钱？还有，呃，这要花我多少钱？ [shen me ？ tai li pu le ， wei shen me yao shou wo qian ？ hai you ， e ， zhe yao hua wo duo shao qian ？]

english: Ah, the outerlanders have stolen from my people for many years, in this way you can help my community with a small amount of money...
translation: 啊，外地人偷走了我的族人很多年了，这样你就可以用少量的钱来帮助我的社区了…… [a ， wai di ren tou zou le wo de zu ren hen duo nian le ， zhe yang ni jiu ke yi yong shao liang de qian lai bang zhu wo de she qu le ……]

english: Let us say... 1,000 coins. Payable in advance, of course.
translation: 假设... 1,000 个硬币。当然，要提前付款。 [jia she ... 1,000  ge ying bi 。 dang ran ， yao ti qian fu kuan 。]

english: For this I will take you to Waterbirth Island on my boat, and will bring you back here when you have had your fill of the hunt. Assuming you are still alive to wish to leave, of course.
translation: 为此，我会用我的船带你去水诞生岛，当你狩猎完毕后，我会带你回到这里。当然，假设您还活着并希望离开。 [wei ci ， wo hui yong wo de chuan dai ni qu shui dan sheng dao ， dang ni shou lie wan bi hou ， wo hui dai ni hui dao zhe li 。 dang ran ， jia she nin hai huo zhe bing xi wang li kai 。]

english: So do you have the 1,000 coins for my service, and are you ready to leave now?
translation: 那么，你有 1,000 个硬币来为我服务吗？你现在准备好离开了吗？ [na me ， ni you  1,000  ge ying bi lai wei wo fu wu ma ？ ni xian zai zhun bei hao li kai le ma ？]

english: The player sets sail for Waterbirth Island
translation: 玩家启航前往沃特产岛 [wan jia qi hang qian wang wo te chan dao]

english: I suggest you head to the cave with some urgency outerlander, the cold air out here might be too much for the likes of you…
translation: 我建议你和一些紧急的外地人一起前往洞穴，这里的冷空气可能对你这样的人来说太难受了…… [wo jian yi ni he yi xie jin ji de wai di ren yi qi qian wang dong xue ， zhe li de leng kong qi ke neng dui ni zhe yang de ren lai shuo tai nan shou le ……]

english: No, actually I have some stuff to do here first.
translation: 不，其实我先在这里有一些事情要做。 [bu ， qi shi wo xian zai zhe li you yi xie shi qing yao zuo 。]

english: As you wish. Come and see me when your bloodlust needs sating.
translation: 如你所愿。当你的嗜血欲望需要满足时就来见我吧。 [ru ni suo yuan 。 dang ni de shi xue yu wang xu yao man zu shi jiu lai jian wo ba 。]

english: Hey, I have to say, that's a fine looking hat you are wearing there.
translation: 嘿，我不得不说，你戴的帽子很漂亮。 [hei ， wo bu de bu shuo ， ni dai de mao zi hen piao liang 。]

english: It is actually a helm, outerlander, but the sentiment is appreciated nonetheless.
translation: 它实际上是一个掌舵者，外来者，但尽管如此，这种情感还是值得赞赏的。 [ta shi ji shang shi yi ge zhang duo zhe ， wai lai zhe ， dan jin guan ru ci ， zhe zhong qing gan hai shi zhi de zan shang de 。]

english: Wow, you Fremenniks sure know how to party. Well, see ya around.
translation: 哇，你们弗里曼尼克人真懂得如何聚会。好吧，再见。 [wa ， ni men fu li man ni ke ren zhen dong de ru he ju hui 。 hao ba ， zai jian 。]

english: Actually, I don't think I have anything to speak to you about…
translation: 其实我觉得我没什么可跟你说的…… [qi shi wo jue de wo mei shen me ke gen ni shuo de ……]

english: Ah, you live yet, outerlander!
translation: 啊，你还活着，外来者！ [a ， ni hai huo zhe ， wai lai zhe ！]

english: Have you had your fill of the hunt and wish to return, or are you still feeling the joy of the cull?
translation: 您是否已经玩够了狩猎并希望回来，或者您仍然感受到扑杀的乐趣吗？ [nin shi fou yi jing wan gou le shou lie bing xi wang hui lai ， huo zhe nin reng ran gan shou dao pu sha de le qu ma ？]

english: I wish to return to Rellekka.
translation: 我希望回到雷莱卡。 [wo xi wang hui dao lei lai ka 。]

english: Then let us away; There will be death to bring here another day!
translation: 那么就放我们走吧；又有一天，死亡将会降临到这里！ [na me jiu fang wo men zou ba ； you you yi tian ， si wang jiang hui jiang lin dao zhe li ！]

english: The player is sailed back to Rellekka
translation: 玩家被航行回雷莱卡 [wan jia bei hang xing hui lei lai ka]

english: I want to stay here.
translation: 我想留在这里。 [wo xiang liu zai zhe li 。]

english: Ha Ha Ha! A true huntsman at heart!
translation: 哈哈哈！内心真正的猎人！ [ha ha ha ！ nei xin zhen zheng de lie ren ！]

english: I myself have killed over a hundred of the dagger- mouths, and did not think it too many!
translation: 我自己就杀过一百多只刀口，也不算太多！ [wo zi ji jiu sha guo yi bai duo zhi dao kou ， ye bu suan tai duo ！]

english: Hi, I don't suppose you are a member of the council of elders are you?
translation: 你好，我想你应该不是长老会的成员吧？ [ni hao ， wo xiang ni ying gai bu shi zhang lao hui de cheng yuan ba ？]

english: No, outerlander, I have never had the honour to be asked.
translation: 不，外来者，我从未有幸被邀​​请。 [bu ， wai lai zhe ， wo cong wei you xing bei yao ​​ qing 。]

english: I am but a lowly warrior, fighting for my people wherever threats may appear against us...
translation: 我只是一个卑微的战士，在任何可能出现威胁的地方为我的人民而战…… [wo zhi shi yi ge bei wei de zhan shi ， zai ren he ke neng chu xian wei xie de di fang wei wo de ren min er zhan ……]

english: So what do you want from me, outerlander?
translation: 那么你想从我这里得到什么，外地人？ [na me ni xiang cong wo zhe li de dao shen me ， wai di ren ？]

english: (same as above)
translation: （同上） [（ tong shang ）]

english: Greetings, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你好，[弗里曼尼克名字]！ [ni hao ，[ fu li man ni ke ming zi ]！]

english: Ah, and what a glorious name that is! Worthy of only the finest warriors!
translation: 啊，这是一个多么荣耀的名字啊！只有最优秀的战士才配得上！ [a ， zhe shi yi ge duo me rong yao de ming zi a ！ zhi you zui you xiu de zhan shi cai pei de shang ！]

english: Heh. Yup, you're right there.
translation: 呵呵。是的，你就在那里。 [he he 。 shi de ， ni jiu zai na li 。]

english: So what brings you back to fair Rellekka? It has been too long since you have drunk in the longhall with us and sang of your battles!
translation: 那么是什么让您回到美丽的雷莱卡呢？你已经太久没有和我们一起在长廊里喝酒、歌唱你的战斗了！ [na me shi shen me rang nin hui dao mei li de lei lai ka ne ？ ni yi jing tai jiu mei you he wo men yi qi zai chang lang li he jiu 、 ge chang ni de zhan dou le ！]

english: You have not heard, [Fremennik name]? I am leading an expedition to Waterbirth Island!
translation: 你没听说过，[弗雷曼尼克名字]？我正在率领一支探险队前往水产岛！ [ni mei ting shuo guo ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]？ wo zheng zai shuai ling yi zhi tan xian dui qian wang shui chan dao ！]

english: You have not ever travelled to Waterbirth Island, [Fremennik name]? I am surprised, it is a place of outstanding natural beauty.
translation: [弗雷曼尼克名字]，你还没去过沃特出生岛吗？令我惊讶的是，这是一个自然风景优美的地方。 [[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]， ni hai mei qu guo wo te chu sheng dao ma ？ ling wo jing ya de shi ， zhe shi yi ge zi ran feng jing you mei de di fang 。]

english: Or at least it used to be! But things have now changed...
translation: 或者至少以前是这样！但现在情况发生了变化…… [huo zhe zhi shao yi qian shi zhe yang ！ dan xian zai qing kuang fa sheng le bian hua ……]

english: Changed? How do you mean, changed?
translation: 改变了？怎么说呢，变了？ [gai bian le ？ zen me shuo ne ， bian le ？]

english: It seems as though the sea-beasts known to us as the dagger-mouths have begun their hatching once again... And there may be others of their ilk there too.
translation: 似乎我们所熟知的匕首口海兽再次开始孵化……而且那里可能还有其他同类。 [si hu wo men suo shu zhi de bi shou kou hai shou zai ci kai shi fu hua …… er qie na li ke neng hai you qi ta tong lei 。]

english: Dagger-mouths?
translation: 匕首嘴？ [bi shou zui ？]

english: Aye, the dagger-mouths! The vile creatures lived near here once, but we had thought them all driven back to the ocean depths many moons past.
translation: 是啊，匕首嘴！这些邪恶的生物曾经生活在这附近，但我们原以为它们都被赶回了许多个月前的海洋深处。 [shi a ， bi shou zui ！ zhe xie xie e de sheng wu ceng jing sheng huo zai zhe fu jin ， dan wo men yuan yi wei ta men dou bei gan hui le xu duo ge yue qian de hai yang shen chu 。]

english: I can only imagine a dagger-mouth queen has nested somewhere nearby, and spawned her foul brood under the sea once more, and some of them have migrated to fair Waterbirth Island.
translation: 我只能想象有一只剑口女王在附近某处筑巢，并再次在海底产卵，其中一些已经迁移到美丽的水产岛。 [wo zhi neng xiang xiang you yi zhi jian kou nv wang zai fu jin mou chu zhu chao ， bing zai ci zai hai di chan luan ， qi zhong yi xie yi jing qian yi dao mei li de shui chan dao 。]

english: So you're scared they might attack Rellekka?
translation: 所以你害怕他们会攻击雷莱卡？ [suo yi ni hai pa ta men hui gong ji lei lai ka ？]

english: Scared? Ha ha ha!
translation: 害怕的？哈哈哈！ [hai pa de ？ ha ha ha ！]

english: You wound us with your questioning, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你的提问伤害了我们，[弗雷曼尼克名字]！ [ni de ti wen shang hai le wo men ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！]

english: We are glad the dagger-mouths have returned to these shores, for it means we will get the chance to hunt them once again as our ancestors did!
translation: 我们很高兴匕首嘴回到了这片海岸，因为这意味着我们将有机会像我们的祖先一样再次猎杀它们！ [wo men hen gao xing bi shou zui hui dao le zhe pian hai an ， yin wei zhe yi wei zhe wo men jiang you ji hui xiang wo men de zu xian yi yang zai ci lie sha ta men ！]

english: When treated in the correct manner, the creatures' remains can be used to make fine battleworthy armour!
translation: 如果以正确的方式处理，这些生物的遗骸可以用来制作精美的战斗盔甲！ [ru guo yi zheng que de fang shi chu li ， zhe xie sheng wu de yi hai ke yi yong lai zhi zuo jing mei de zhan dou kui jia ！]

english: Of course, [Fremennik name]! Your presence is more than welcome on this cull! You wish to leave now?
translation: 当然是[弗雷曼尼克名字]！本次淘汰赛非常欢迎您的光临！您现在想离开吗？ [dang ran shi [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！ ben ci tao tai sai fei chang huan ying nin de guang lin ！ nin xian zai xiang li kai ma ？]

english: Player is transported to Waterbirth Island
translation: 玩家被传送到 Waterbirth Island [wan jia bei chuan song dao  Waterbirth Island]

english: Aye, that it is [Fremennik name]! Skulgrimen fashioned it for me from the carcass of one of the monsters on Waterbirth Island after our last hunt!
translation: 是的，这是[弗雷曼尼克名字]！在我们上次狩猎后，斯库格里曼用水产岛上的一个怪物的尸体为我制作了它！ [shi de ， zhe shi [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！ zai wo men shang ci shou lie hou ， si ku ge li man yong shui chan dao shang de yi ge guai wu de shi ti wei wo zhi zuo le ta ！]

english: I hope to kill enough creatures to fashion some fine armour as well when next we leave!
translation: 我希望下次我们离开时能杀死足够多的生物来制作一些精美的盔甲！ [wo xi wang xia ci wo men li kai shi neng sha si zu gou duo de sheng wu lai zhi zuo yi xie jing mei de kui jia ！]

english: I picked up this, I was wondering if you could tell me about it...
translation: 我捡到了这个，我想知道你是否可以告诉我...... [wo jian dao le zhe ge ， wo xiang zhi dao ni shi fou ke yi gao su wo ......]

english: Ah yes... The dagger-mouths' skin makes a good basis for many types of armour!
translation: 啊，是的……匕首嘴的皮肤为多种类型的盔甲奠定了良好的基础！ [a ， shi de …… bi shou zui de pi fu wei duo zhong lei xing de kui jia dian ding le liang hao de ji chu ！]

english: Skulgrimen has made many sturdy helms from shells like that!
translation: Skulgrimen 用这样的贝壳制作了许多坚固的头盔！ [Skulgrimen  yong zhe yang de bei ke zhi zuo le xu duo jian gu de tou kui ！]

english: Skulgrimen once made a fine set of body armour from that kind of shell!
translation: Skulgrimen曾经用这种贝壳制作了一套精美的防弹衣！ [Skulgrimen ceng jing yong zhe zhong bei ke zhi zuo le yi tao jing mei de fang dan yi ！]

translation: 啊，祝你有美好的一天[milady/sirrah]！你的脸很陌生，你是不是和我们一起登上了月岛的船？ [a ， zhu ni you mei hao de yi tian [milady/sirrah]！ ni de lian hen mo sheng ， ni shi bu shi he wo men yi qi deng shang le yue dao de chuan ？]

english: No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.
translation: 不，洛卡实际上让我在雷莱卡搭车。 [bu ， luo ka shi ji shang rang wo zai lei lai ka da che 。]

english: Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!
translation: 哦真的吗？在我看来你不像弗雷曼尼克人！ [o zhen de ma ？ zai wo kan lai ni bu xiang fu lei man ni ke ren ！]

english: Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
translation: 嗯……我有点是，又有点不是。这是一个很长的故事。 [n …… wo you dian shi ， you you dian bu shi 。 zhe shi yi ge hen zhang de gu shi 。]

english: Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a-fremennik!
translation: 抱歉我没时间听！再见，年轻的弗雷曼尼克，他不是真正的弗雷曼尼克！ [bao qian wo mei shi jian ting ！ zai jian ， nian qing de fu lei man ni ke ， ta bu shi zhen zheng de fu lei man ni ke ！]

english: 'Bye.
translation: '再见。 [' zai jian 。]

english: Brrrr! Its cold up here!
translation: 呜呜！这里很冷！ [wu wu ！ zhe li hen leng ！]

english: You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!
translation: 你觉得这很冷吗？到了 Acheron 那里，天气变得非常寒冷，当你说话时，你会看到话语冻结在你面前的空气中！ [ni jue de zhe hen leng ma ？ dao le  Acheron  na li ， tian qi bian de fei chang han leng ， dang ni shuo hua shi ， ni hui kan dao hua yu dong jie zai ni mian qian de kong qi zhong ！]

english: REALLY?
translation: 真的吗？ [zhen de ma ？]

english: Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!
translation: 不，不是真的。我为了达到幽默效果而夸张了。不过天气非常非常冷！ [bu ， bu shi zhen de 。 wo wei le da dao you mo xiao guo er kua zhang le 。 bu guo tian qi fei chang fei chang leng ！]

english: Hello to you too.
translation: 也向你问好。 [ye xiang ni wen hao 。]

english: Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
translation: 呀！我们是海盗，耶！阿瓦斯特，你们这些坏血病的陆生荔枝！ [ya ！ wo men shi hai dao ， ye ！ a wa si te ， ni men zhe xie huai xue bing de lu sheng li zhi ！]

english: Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
translation: 请不要这样说话，这太令人恼火了。 [qing bu yao zhe yang shuo hua ， zhe tai ling ren nao huo le 。]

english: Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
translation: 另外，请不要叫我荔枝，不管那是什么。 [ling wai ， qing bu yao jiao wo li zhi ， bu guan na shi shen me 。]

english: Oh. Okay. Sorry.
translation: 哦。好的。对不起。 [o 。 hao de 。 dui bu qi 。]

english: ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!
translation: 啊啊！拉响警报！船上偷渡者！船上偷渡者！ [a a ！ la xiang jing bao ！ chuan shang tou du zhe ！ chuan shang tou du zhe ！]

english: No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
translation: 不！我不是偷渡者！诚实的！我被邀请来到这里！ [bu ！ wo bu shi tou du zhe ！ cheng shi de ！ wo bei yao qing lai dao zhe li ！]

english: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
translation: 哦，抱歉，那是我的错误。 [o ， bao qian ， na shi wo de cuo wu 。]

english: You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.
translation: 但你必须承认你看起来确实很像一个偷渡者。 [dan ni bi xu cheng ren ni kan qi lai que shi hen xiang yi ge tou du zhe 。]

english: Why, what do they usually look like?
translation: 为什么，他们通常是什么样子？ [wei shen me ， ta men tong chang shi shen me yang zi ？]

english: Erm... I've never actually met one...
translation: 呃……我从来没有真正见过一个…… [e …… wo cong lai mei you zhen zheng jian guo yi ge ……]

english: Okay then...
translation: 好吧，那么... [hao ba ， na me ...]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: So... You're a pirate, huh?
translation: 那么...你是海盗，是吧？ [na me ... ni shi hai dao ， shi ba ？]

english: It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.
translation: 月底我的工资单上就是这么写的。 [yue di wo de gong zi dan shang jiu shi zhe me xie de 。]

english: How's that working out for you?
translation: 你感觉怎么样？ [ni gan jue zen me yang ？]

english: Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.
translation: 到目前为止还不错。我们可以掠夺的所有烈酒和战利品，再加上包括牙科在内的全套医疗服务。 [dao mu qian wei zhi hai bu cuo 。 wo men ke yi lve duo de suo you lie jiu he zhan li pin ， zai jia shang bao kuo ya ke zai nei de quan tao yi liao fu wu 。]

english: You mean you have insurance?
translation: 你是说你有保险？ [ni shi shuo ni you bao xian ？]

english: Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.
translation: 不是这样的。如果我们中的任何一个人生病了，我们就会绑架一名医生，直到我们病情好转之前不让他走。 [bu shi zhe yang de 。 ru guo wo men zhong de ren he yi ge ren sheng bing le ， wo men jiu hui bang jia yi ming yi sheng ， zhi dao wo men bing qing hao zhuan zhi qian bu rang ta zou 。]

english: You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.
translation: 您会惊讶地发现，这对于专家医疗保健来说是多么大的激励。 [nin hui jing ya di fa xian ， zhe dui yu zhuan jia yi liao bao jian lai shuo shi duo me da de ji li 。]

english: I can imagine.
translation: 我可以想象。 [wo ke yi xiang xiang 。]

english: Hello there. So what brings you aboard the Lady Zay?
translation: 你好呀。那么是什么让您登上了 Lady Zay 号呢？ [ni hao ya 。 na me shi shen me rang nin deng shang le  Lady Zay  hao ne ？]

english: Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.
translation: 嗯，我原本打算去拜访月族，但我不得不说你们的船非常令人印象深刻。 [n ， wo yuan ben da suan qu bai fang yue zu ， dan wo bu de bu shuo ni men de chuan fei chang ling ren yin xiang shen ke 。]

english: Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!
translation: 是啊，果然是个美女啊！扎伊女士酒店一直是我的家，度过了许多艰难的几个月，经历了暴风雨和阳光，她总是带我们到达我们要去的地方！ [shi a ， guo ran shi ge mei nv a ！ zha yi nv shi jiu dian yi zhi shi wo de jia ， du guo le xu duo jian nan de ji ge yue ， jing li le bao feng yu he yang guang ， ta zong shi dai wo men dao da wo men yao qu de di fang ！]

english: Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!
translation: 是的，她确实是我旅行中见过的最好的船之一！ [shi de ， ta que shi shi wo lv xing zhong jian guo de zui hao de chuan zhi yi ！]

english: That she is [lad/lass], that she is.
translation: 她是[小伙子/姑娘]，她就是。 [ta shi [ xiao huo zi / gu niang ]， ta jiu shi 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: How's it going?
translation: 怎么样了？ [zen me yang le ？]

english: Good thanks. Just passing by.
translation: 很好，谢谢。只是路过而已。 [hen hao ， xie xie 。 zhi shi lu guo er yi 。]

english: Please excuse me, I'm rather busy.
translation: 请原谅我，我比较忙。 [qing yuan liang wo ， wo bi jiao mang 。]

english: Hey, I'm your contractor from Mahogany Homes, what did you want done?
translation: 嘿，我是 Mahogany Homes 的承包商，你想要做什么？ [hei ， wo shi  Mahogany Homes  de cheng bao shang ， ni xiang yao zuo shen me ？]

english: I'd like two Wooden drawers built.
translation: 我想要两个木制抽屉。 [wo xiang yao liang ge mu zhi chou ti 。]

english: I'd like two Wooden cabinets built.
translation: 我想要建造两个木柜。 [wo xiang yao jian zao liang ge mu gui 。]

english: I'd like a Wooden bed built.
translation: 我想要一张木床。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang mu chuang 。]

english: I'd like a Wooden table built.
translation: 我想要一张木桌。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang mu zhuo 。]

english: I'd like my clock fixed.
translation: 我想要修好我的时钟。 [wo xiang yao xiu hao wo de shi zhong 。]

english: I'd like my bath fixed.
translation: 我想修一下我的浴缸。 [wo xiang xiu yi xia wo de yu gang 。]

english: I'd like two Oak drawers built.
translation: 我想要两个橡木抽屉。 [wo xiang yao liang ge xiang mu chou ti 。]

english: I'd like two Oak cabinets built.
translation: 我想要建造两个橡木橱柜。 [wo xiang yao jian zao liang ge xiang mu chu gui 。]

english: I'd like a Oak bed built.
translation: 我想要一张橡木床。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang xiang mu chuang 。]

english: I'd like a Oak table built.
translation: 我想要一张橡木桌子。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang xiang mu zhuo zi 。]

english: I'd like two Teak drawers built.
translation: 我想要两个柚木抽屉。 [wo xiang yao liang ge you mu chou ti 。]

english: I'd like two Teak cabinets built.
translation: 我想要建造两个柚木橱柜。 [wo xiang yao jian zao liang ge you mu chu gui 。]

english: I'd like a Teak bed built.
translation: 我想要一张柚木床。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang you mu chuang 。]

english: I'd like a Teak table built.
translation: 我想要一张柚木桌子。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang you mu zhuo zi 。]

english: I'd like two Mahogany drawers built.
translation: 我想要两个桃花心木抽屉。 [wo xiang yao liang ge tao hua xin mu chou ti 。]

english: I'd like two Mahogany cabinets built.
translation: 我想要建造两个桃花心木柜子。 [wo xiang yao jian zao liang ge tao hua xin mu gui zi 。]

english: I'd like a Mahogany bed built.
translation: 我想要一张红木床。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang hong mu chuang 。]

english: I'd like a Mahogany table built.
translation: 我想要一张红木桌子。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang hong mu zhuo zi 。]

english: I've finished with the work you wanted.
translation: 我已经完成了你想要的工作。 [wo yi jing wan cheng le ni xiang yao de gong zuo 。]

english: Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: 太感谢了！走之前你想喝杯茶吗？ [tai gan xie le ！ zou zhi qian ni xiang he bei cha ma ？]

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
translation: 是的，我想要一杯茶。 [shi de ， wo xiang yao yi bei cha 。]

english: No thanks, I better be off.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我最好离开了。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo zui hao li kai le 。]

english: Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!
translation: 啊啊，没有什么比一杯美味的茶更好的了！ [a a ， mei you shen me bi yi bei mei wei de cha geng hao de le ！]

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
translation: 是的，我想要一杯茶。 [shi de ， wo xiang yao yi bei cha 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hey kid, what's all the shouting about?
translation: 嘿，孩子，喊什么？ [hei ， hai zi ， han shen me ？]

english: Christmas is ruined!
translation: 圣诞节被毁了！ [sheng dan jie bei hui le ！]

english: Again? What's happened this time?
translation: 再次？这次是怎么回事？ [zai ci ？ zhe ci shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: The man in the shop won't give us our Gingerbread Gnomes, he's keeping them for himself.
translation: 店里的那个人不会给我们姜饼侏儒，他自己留着它们。 [dian li de na ge ren bu hui gei wo men jiang bing zhu ru ， ta zi ji liu zhe ta men 。]

english: That doesn't sound right, are you sure that's really what he's doing?
translation: 这听起来不对，你确定那真的是他在做的吗？ [zhe ting qi lai bu dui ， ni que ding na zhen de shi ta zai zuo de ma ？]

english: Of course he is, why else won't he give us any?
translation: 当然是，不然他为什么不给我们呢？ [dang ran shi ， bu ran ta wei shen me bu gei wo men ne ？]

english: Something seems off, maybe I should go talk to Santa to find out what's happened.
translation: 好像有些不对劲，也许我应该去跟圣诞老人谈谈，看看发生了什么事。 [hao xiang you xie bu dui jin ， ye xu wo ying gai qu gen sheng dan lao ren tan tan ， kan kan fa sheng le shen me shi 。]

english: Do whatever you want, I want my Gingerbread Gnomes!
translation: 做你想做的事，我想要我的姜饼侏儒！ [zuo ni xiang zuo de shi ， wo xiang yao wo de jiang bing zhu ru ！]

english: Where are our Gingerbread Gnomes!
translation: 我们的姜饼侏儒在哪里！ [wo men de jiang bing zhu ru zai na li ！]

english: I'm working on it, I'm working on it.
translation: 我正在努力，我正在努力。 [wo zheng zai nu li ， wo zheng zai nu li 。]

english: Hurry up!
translation: 赶快！ [gan kuai ！]

english: You've ruined Christmas!
translation: 你毁了圣诞节！ [ni hui le sheng dan jie ！]

english: Give us the Gnomes!
translation: 给我们侏儒吧！ [gei wo men zhu ru ba ！]

english: Why are you still here? I saved Christmas, you can go home.
translation: 你怎么还在这里？我救了圣诞节，你可以回家了。 [ni zen me hai zai zhe li ？ wo jiu le sheng dan jie ， ni ke yi hui jia le 。]

english: We still have to wait for the delivery to come in, dummy.
translation: 我们还得等送货上门，傻瓜。 [wo men hai de deng song huo shang men ， sha gua 。]

english: I'll leave you to it then.
translation: 那我就把它留给你了。 [na wo jiu ba ta liu gei ni le 。]

english: Christmas is Saved!
translation: 圣诞节得救了！ [sheng dan jie de jiu le ！]

english: Hurry up with the delivery!
translation: 快点发货吧！ [kuai dian fa huo ba ！]

english: Nilsal, [player name]. How are things going?
translation: 尼尔萨尔，[玩家姓名]。进展如何？ [ni er sa er ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。 jin zhan ru he ？]

english: Pretty good, thanks. How about you? Made any more discoveries down here?
translation: 非常好，谢谢。你呢？这里还有更多发现吗？ [fei chang hao ， xie xie 。 ni ne ？ zhe li hai you geng duo fa xian ma ？]

english: More than you can count! I've found so much new information on the Old Ones and naguanil. The museum are hoping to include it all in some new exhibits soon!
translation: 多得你数不过来！我发现了很多关于旧日支配者和纳瓜尼的新信息。博物馆希望尽快将所有这些都包含在一些新的展览中！ [duo de ni shu bu guo lai ！ wo fa xian le hen duo guan yu jiu ri zhi pei zhe he na gua ni de xin xin xi 。 bo wu guan xi wang jin kuai jiang suo you zhe xie dou bao han zai yi xie xin de zhan lan zhong ！]

english: Sounds awesome! I'll be sure to keep an eye out for them. On that note, I'll let you get back to it.
translation: 听起来棒极了！我一定会留意他们的。关于这一点，我会让你回过头来。 [ting qi lai bang ji le ！ wo yi ding hui liu yi ta men de 。 guan yu zhe yi dian ， wo hui rang ni hui guo tou lai 。]

english: Hello friend.
translation: 朋友你好。 [peng you ni hao 。]

english: Hello, what are you doing here?
translation: 你好，你在这里做什么？ [ni hao ， ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: My name is Jessie. I help look after the forest.
translation: 我的名字是杰西。我帮忙照看森林。 [wo de ming zi shi jie xi 。 wo bang mang zhao kan sen lin 。]

english: Nice to meet you. You must know this area very well then.
translation: 很高兴见到你。那么你一定非常了解这个领域。 [hen gao xing jian dao ni 。 na me ni yi ding fei chang liao jie zhe ge ling yu 。]

english: I do. There're all sorts of interesting creatures around here. Be careful, some of them are not very friendly. A lot of travellers have become their victims.
translation: 我愿意。这里有各种各样有趣的生物。小心点，有些人不太友好。许多游客成为了他们的受害者。 [wo yuan yi 。 zhe li you ge zhong ge yang you qu de sheng wu 。 xiao xin dian ， you xie ren bu tai you hao 。 xu duo you ke cheng wei le ta men de shou hai zhe 。]

english: I see. Thanks for the warning.
translation: 我懂了。谢谢你的警告。 [wo dong le 。 xie xie ni de jing gao 。]

english: No problem! Safe travels my friend.
translation: 没问题！安全旅行我的朋友。 [mei wen ti ！ an quan lv xing wo de peng you 。]

english: Hello, I don't recognise you. We don't get many newcomers around here.
translation: 你好，我不认识你。我们这里没有多少新人。 [ni hao ， wo bu ren shi ni 。 wo men zhe li mei you duo shao xin ren 。]

english: How come?
translation: 怎么会？ [zen me hui ？]

english: The plague of course. Not many people want to come to a place like this and the few that do normally get stopped by the mourners.
translation: 当然是瘟疫。没有多少人愿意来这样的地方，少数人通常会被哀悼者拦住。 [dang ran shi wen yi 。 mei you duo shao ren yuan yi lai zhe yang de di fang ， shao shu ren tong chang hui bei ai dao zhe lan zhu 。]

english: All you'll find here now are the dead and the dying. Even our own king has abandoned us.
translation: 现在你在这里能找到的只有死者和垂死者。甚至我们自己的国王也抛弃了我们。 [xian zai ni zai zhe li neng zhao dao de zhi you si zhe he chui si zhe 。 shen zhi wo men zi ji de guo wang ye pao qi le wo men 。]

english: Your king?
translation: 你的国王？ [ni de guo wang ？]

english: Yes, King Tyras of West Ardougne. He's the brother of King Lathas, the ruler of East Ardougne.
translation: 是的，西阿杜涅的国王泰拉斯。他是东阿杜涅统治者拉萨斯国王的兄弟。 [shi de ， xi a du nie de guo wang tai la si 。 ta shi dong e du nie tong zhi zhe la sa si guo wang de xiong di 。]

english: So where is the king?
translation: 那么国王在哪里呢？ [na me guo wang zai na li ne ？]

english: Well he's always been a bit of an explorer. He's led multiple expeditions into the uncharted lands to the west.
translation: 嗯，他一直都是一位探险家。他曾多次带领探险队前往西部未知的土地。 [n ， ta yi zhi dou shi yi wei tan xian jia 。 ta ceng duo ci dai ling tan xian dui qian wang xi bu wei zhi de tu di 。]

english: The plague first started when he came back from one of these expeditions. More than a few suspect that some of his men caught it out there and brought it back with them.
translation: 当他从一次探险回来时，瘟疫首次爆发。不少人怀疑他的一些手下在外面抓到了它并把它带回来了。 [dang ta cong yi ci tan xian hui lai shi ， wen yi shou ci bao fa 。 bu shao ren huai yi ta de yi xie shou xia zai wai mian zhua dao le ta bing ba ta dai hui lai le 。]

english: The king didn't care though. He just left on another expedition to the west. He hasn't been seen since. He left the city warder Bravek in charge but he's no better.
translation: 不过国王并不在意。他刚刚出发去另一次西征。从那以后就再也没有见过他。他让城市看守布拉维克负责，但他也好不到哪儿去。 [bu guo guo wang bing bu zai yi 。 ta gang gang chu fa qu ling yi ci xi zheng 。 cong na yi hou jiu zai ye mei you jian guo ta 。 ta rang cheng shi kan shou bu la wei ke fu ze ， dan ta ye hao bu dao na er qu 。]

english: Anyway, you clearly didn't come here to talk about kings. So tell me, what brings you to West Ardougne?
translation: 不管怎样，你显然不是来这里谈论国王的。那么告诉我，是什么让你来到西阿杜涅？ [bu guan zen yang ， ni xian ran bu shi lai zhe li tan lun guo wang de 。 na me gao su wo ， shi shen me rang ni lai dao xi a du nie ？]

english: I'm looking for a woman from East Ardougne called Elena.
translation: 我正在寻找一位来自东阿杜涅的女士，名叫埃琳娜。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yi wei lai zi dong e du nie de nv shi ， ming jiao ai lin na 。]

english: East Ardougnian women are easier to find in East Ardougne. Not many would come to West Ardougne to find one. Although the name is familiar, what does she look like?
translation: 在东阿杜涅更容易找到东阿杜涅女性。没有多少人会来西阿杜涅寻找这样的人。虽然名字很熟悉，但是她长什么样呢？ [zai dong e du nie geng rong yi zhao dao dong e du nie nv xing 。 mei you duo shao ren hui lai xi a du nie xun zhao zhe yang de ren 。 sui ran ming zi hen shu xi ， dan shi ta zhang shen me yang ne ？]

english: Um... brown hair... in her twenties...
translation: 嗯……棕色头发……二十多岁…… [n …… zong se tou fa …… er shi duo sui ……]

english: Hmmm, that doesn't narrow it down a huge amount... I'll need to know more than that, or see a picture?
translation: 嗯，这并没有大大缩小范围……我需要了解更多，或者看图片？ [n ， zhe bing mei you da da suo xiao fan wei …… wo xu yao liao jie geng duo ， huo zhe kan tu pian ？]

english: Ah yes. She came over here to help the plague victims. I think she is staying over with the Rehnison family.
translation: 啊，是的。她来这里是为了帮助瘟疫受害者。我认为她和雷尼森一家住在一起。 [a ， shi de 。 ta lai zhe li shi wei le bang zhu wen yi shou hai zhe 。 wo ren wei ta he lei ni sen yi jia zhu zai yi qi 。]

english: They live in the small timbered building at the far north side of town. I've not seen her around here in a while, mind.
translation: 他们住在城镇最北边的一座小木结构建筑里。请注意，我已经有一段时间没在这里见过她了。 [ta men zhu zai cheng zhen zui bei bian de yi zuo xiao mu jie gou jian zhu li 。 qing zhu yi ， wo yi jing you yi duan shi jian mei zai zhe li jian guo ta le 。]

english: I don't suppose you could run me a little errand while you're over there? I borrowed this book from them, can you return it?
translation: 我想你在那儿的时候不能帮我办点事吧？我向他们借了这本书，你能归还吗？ [wo xiang ni zai na er de shi hou bu neng bang wo ban dian shi ba ？ wo xiang ta men jie le zhe ben shu ， ni neng gui huan ma ？]

english: Yes, I'll return it for you.
translation: 是的，我会为您退货。 [shi de ， wo hui wei nin tui huo 。]

english: Jethick gives you a book
translation: 杰西克给你一本书 [jie xi ke gei ni yi ben shu]

english: No, I don't have time for that.
translation: 不，我没有时间。 [bu ， wo mei you shi jian 。]

english: Hello. We don't get many newcomers around here.
translation: 你好。我们这里没有多少新人。 [ni hao 。 wo men zhe li mei you duo shao xin ren 。]

english: I'm surprised you're still here. Not many like to stick around this place if they have the choice.
translation: 我很惊讶你还在这里。如果有选择的话，没有多少人愿意留在这个地方。 [wo hen jing ya ni hai zai zhe li 。 ru guo you xuan ze de hua ， mei you duo shao ren yuan yi liu zai zhe ge di fang 。]

english: Good to see you friend.
translation: 很高兴见到你朋友。 [hen gao xing jian dao ni peng you 。]

english: Hey Jethick, how's things?
translation: 嘿，杰西克，怎么样？ [hei ， jie xi ke ， zen me yang ？]

english: Not bad, the city is still a mess but we've finally got the chance to change that now the mourners have gone.
translation: 还不错，这座城市仍然一片混乱，但我们终于有机会改变这一现状，现在哀悼者已经走了。 [hai bu cuo ， zhe zuo cheng shi reng ran yi pian hun luan ， dan wo men zhong yu you ji hui gai bian zhe yi xian zhuang ， xian zai ai dao zhe yi jing zou le 。]

english: Good to hear, all the best.
translation: 很高兴听到，祝一切顺利。 [hen gao xing ting dao ， zhu yi qie shun li 。]

english: Let's see if you have what it takes to answer this question.
translation: 让我们看看您是否有能力回答这个问题。 [rang wo men kan kan nin shi fou you neng li hui da zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: What question?
translation: 什么问题？ [shen me wen ti ？]

english: The one on this scroll.
translation: 就是这卷轴上的那个。 [jiu shi zhe juan zhou shang de na ge 。]

english: Jethick has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 杰西克给了你一个挑战卷轴！ [jie xi ke gei le ni yi ge tiao zhan juan zhou ！]

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。 [qing shu ru wen ti de da an 。]

english: Not even close!
translation: 甚至还没有接近！ [shen zhi hai mei you jie jin ！]

english: Spot on!
translation: 现货！ [xian huo ！]

english: Jethick has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
translation: 杰西克给了你[另一个线索卷轴/一个棺材]！ [jie xi ke gei le ni [ ling yi ge xian suo juan zhou / yi ge guan cai ]！]

english: Yes, I'll return it for you.
translation: 是的，我会为您退货。 [shi de ， wo hui wei nin tui huo 。]

english: No, I don't have time for that.
translation: 不，我没有时间。 [bu ， wo mei you shi jian 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello there. Welcome to the Temple of the Lesser Gods.
translation: 你好呀。欢迎来到小神殿。 [ni hao ya 。 huan ying lai dao xiao shen dian 。]

english: Could you tell me more about the lesser gods?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于小神的事吗？ [ni neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu xiao shen de shi ma ？]

english: Of course. The lesser gods, or avatars as some call them, were born from the dreams of Tumeken. They are Apmeken, Het, Crondis and Scabaras.
translation: 当然。小神，或者一些人所说的化身，是从图梅肯的梦想中诞生的。他们是阿普梅肯、赫特、克朗迪斯和斯卡巴拉斯。 [dang ran 。 xiao shen ， huo zhe yi xie ren suo shuo de hua shen ， shi cong tu mei ken de meng xiang zhong dan sheng de 。 ta men shi a pu mei ken 、 he te 、 ke lang di si he si ka ba la si 。]

english: Could you tell me more about Apmeken?
translation: 您能告诉我更多有关阿普梅肯的信息吗？ [nin neng gao su wo geng duo you guan a pu mei ken de xin xi ma ？]

english: Apmeken is the goddess of companionship. She is known to be the most mischievous, playful and unpredictable of the minor deities. I'd say she's my personal favourite.
translation: 阿普梅肯是陪伴女神。她被认为是小神中最顽皮、最顽皮、最难以捉摸的一位。我想说她是我个人最喜欢的。 [a pu mei ken shi pei ban nv shen 。 ta bei ren wei shi xiao shen zhong zui wan pi 、 zui wan pi 、 zui nan yi zhuo mo de yi wei 。 wo xiang shuo ta shi wo ge ren zui xi huan de 。]

english: So I shouldn't trust you then?
translation: 那我就不该相信你了？ [na wo jiu bu gai xiang xin ni le ？]

english: Apmeken can appeal to the most erudite scholar or the most barefaced liar. I'd like to be considered amongst the former category.
translation: 阿普梅肯可以吸引最博学的学者或最厚颜无耻的骗子。我希望被视为前一类。 [a pu mei ken ke yi xi yin zui bo xue de xue zhe huo zui hou yan wu chi de pian zi 。 wo xi wang bei shi wei qian yi lei 。]

english: I see. What does she look like?
translation: 我懂了。她长什么样？ [wo dong le 。 ta zhang shen me yang ？]

english: She has the head of a monkey, or sometimes an ape. It changes depending upon what nature she is displaying. For example, the orangutan represents wisdom, while the baboon represents mischief.
translation: 她有猴子的头，有时是猿猴的头。它会根据她所表现出的本性而变化。例如，猩猩代表智慧，而狒狒代表恶作剧。 [ta you hou zi de tou ， you shi shi yuan hou de tou 。 ta hui gen ju ta suo biao xian chu de ben xing er bian hua 。 li ru ， xing xing dai biao zhi hui ， er fei fei dai biao e zuo ju 。]

english: Could you tell me more about Het?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于Het的事吗？ [ni neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu Het de shi ma ？]

english: Het is the least strange of our deities to foreign eyes, for he looks just like us. I suspect this is why his shrines are particularly targeted by thieves like that infamous Templeton.
translation: 对于外国人来说，他是我们神灵中最不陌生的，因为他看起来和我们一样。我怀疑这就是为什么他的神社特别成为像臭名昭著的坦普尔顿这样的小偷的目标。 [dui yu wai guo ren lai shuo ， ta shi wo men shen ling zhong zui bu mo sheng de ， yin wei ta kan qi lai he wo men yi yang 。 wo huai yi zhe jiu shi wei shen me ta de shen she te bie cheng wei xiang chou ming zhao zhu de tan pu er dun zhe yang de xiao tou de mu biao 。]

english: What does he represent?
translation: 他代表什么？ [ta dai biao shen me ？]

english: Het is the god of health, both in mind and body. He is quite popular amongst soldiers as a result, especially up in Al Kharid.
translation: Het 是身心健康之神。因此，他在士兵中很受欢迎，尤其是在阿尔卡里德。 [Het  shi shen xin jian kang zhi shen 。 yin ci ， ta zai shi bing zhong hen shou huan ying ， you qi shi zai a er ka li de 。]

english: Just soldiers?
translation: 只是士兵吗？ [zhi shi shi bing ma ？]

english: Not at all! Like I said, the wellbeing of the mind is also key to Het. Many great orators also look to him for guidance. I imagine his teachings help with some of their strenuous speeches.
translation: 一点也不！正如我所说，心灵的健康也是 Het 的关键。许多伟大的演说家也向他寻求指导。我想他的教导对他们的一些艰苦的演讲有所帮助。 [yi dian ye bu ！ zheng ru wo suo shuo ， xin ling de jian kang ye shi  Het  de guan jian 。 xu duo wei da de yan shuo jia ye xiang ta xun qiu zhi dao 。 wo xiang ta de jiao dao dui ta men de yi xie jian ku de yan jiang you suo bang zhu 。]

english: How did his followers react to the plagues here?
translation: 他的追随者对这里的瘟疫有何反应？ [ta de zhui sui zhe dui zhe li de wen yi you he fan ying ？]

english: With many arguments. They really couldn't decide whether it was a punishment from Het, or an affront to him. I stayed out of that debate.
translation: 有很多论点。他们实在无法判断这到底是赫特的惩罚，还是对他的侮辱。我没有参与这场辩论。 [you hen duo lun dian 。 ta men shi zai wu fa pan duan zhe dao di shi he te de cheng fa ， hai shi dui ta de wu ru 。 wo mei you can yu zhe chang bian lun 。]

english: Could you tell me more about Crondis?
translation: 您能告诉我更多关于克朗迪斯的信息吗？ [nin neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu ke lang di si de xin xi ma ？]

english: Crondis is a ferocious lady with the head of a mighty crocodile.
translation: 克朗迪斯是一位凶猛的女士，有着强大的鳄鱼头。 [ke lang di si shi yi wei xiong meng de nv shi ， you zhe qiang da de e yu tou 。]

english: That must be awkward when buying helmets.
translation: 买头盔的时候肯定很尴尬。 [mai tou kui de shi hou ken ding hen gan ga 。]

english: Luckily for her, I don't think deities have much need for them.
translation: 对她来说幸运的是，我认为神灵对它们没有太大的需要。 [dui ta lai shuo xing yun de shi ， wo ren wei shen ling dui ta men mei you tai da de xu yao 。]

english: So what is she the goddess of?
translation: 那么她究竟是怎样的女神呢？ [na me ta jiu jing shi zen yang de nv shen ne ？]

english: Resourcefulness. A word which seems to be open to large interpretation.
translation: 足智多谋。这个词似乎可以有很大的解释。 [zu zhi duo mou 。 zhe ge ci si hu ke yi you hen da de jie shi 。]

english: How so?
translation: 为何如此？ [wei he ru ci ？]

english: Most consider her to be a teacher of modesty. They say we should be resourceful by only taking and using that which we absolutely need.
translation: 大多数人认为她是一位谦虚的老师。他们说我们应该足智多谋，只获取和使用我们绝对需要的东西。 [da duo shu ren ren wei ta shi yi wei qian xu de lao shi 。 ta men shuo wo men ying gai zu zhi duo mou ， zhi huo qu he shi yong wo men jue dui xu yao de dong xi 。]

english: But there's others with a different interpretation?
translation: 但还有其他人有不同的解释吗？ [dan hai you qi ta ren you bu tong de jie shi ma ？]

english: Some believe she is actually the goddess of pleasure. They claim that the idea of modesty came from a misinterpretation, and that to be resourceful is to take all that you can.
translation: 有些人认为她实际上是快乐女神。他们声称谦虚的观念来自于一种误解，而足智多谋就是尽你所能。 [you xie ren ren wei ta shi ji shang shi kuai le nv shen 。 ta men sheng cheng qian xu de guan nian lai zi yu yi zhong wu jie ， er zu zhi duo mou jiu shi jin ni suo neng 。]

english: That doesn't sound right.
translation: 这听起来不对。 [zhe ting qi lai bu dui 。]

english: No. It is a more recent take that I suspect was born in Menaphos. There are many in that city with more wealth than they'll ever need. Modesty is not an ideal they'll ever embody.
translation: 不。我怀疑这是在梅纳福斯诞生的最新作品。那个城市里有很多人拥有的财富超出了他们的需要。谦虚并不是他们所体现的理想。 [bu 。 wo huai yi zhe shi zai mei na fu si dan sheng de zui xin zuo pin 。 na ge cheng shi li you hen duo ren yong you de cai fu chao chu le ta men de xu yao 。 qian xu bing bu shi ta men suo ti xian de li xiang 。]

english: Could you tell me more about Scabaras?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于斯卡巴拉斯的事吗？ [ni neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu si ka ba la si de shi ma ？]

english: There are many opinions out there on Scabaras, but general knowledge isn't always the most accurate.
translation: 关于 Scabaras 有很多观点，但一般知识并不总是最准确的。 [guan yu  Scabaras  you hen duo guan dian ， dan yi ban zhi shi bing bu zong shi zui zhun que de 。]

english: Well what are the absolute facts then?
translation: 那么绝对的事实是什么呢？ [na me jue dui de shi shi shi shen me ne ？]

english: Scabaras is the god of isolation. He takes on the appearance of a man with the head of a scarab. Both he and his followers were driven into hiding long ago.
translation: 斯卡巴拉斯是孤立之神。他呈现出一个长着圣甲虫头的男人的样子。他和他的追随者很久以前就被迫躲藏起来。 [si ka ba la si shi gu li zhi shen 。 ta cheng xian chu yi ge zhang zhe sheng jia chong tou de nan ren de yang zi 。 ta he ta de zhui sui zhe hen jiu yi qian jiu bei po duo cang qi lai 。]

english: And?
translation: 和？ [he ？]

english: And that's it. You asked for the absolute facts. Anything beyond that is just speculation.
translation: 就是这样。你要求的是绝对的事实。除此之外的任何事情都只是猜测。 [jiu shi zhe yang 。 ni yao qiu de shi jue dui de shi shi 。 chu ci zhi wai de ren he shi qing dou zhi shi cai ce 。]

english: But there must be more. The High Priest told me that Scabaras tried to conquer these lands.
translation: 但一定还有更多。大祭司告诉我斯卡巴拉斯试图征服这些土地。 [dan yi ding hai you geng duo 。 da ji si gao su wo si ka ba la si shi tu zheng fu zhe xie tu di 。]

english: So it is said, but the written accounts that exist contain many inconsistencies when it comes to what role Scabaras actually played. Of course, most would not know that.
translation: 话是这么说，但关于斯卡巴拉斯实际扮演的角色，现有的书面记录存在许多不一致的地方。当然，大多数人不会知道这一点。 [hua shi zhe me shuo ， dan guan yu si ka ba la si shi ji ban yan de jue se ， xian you de shu mian ji lu cun zai xu duo bu yi zhi de di fang 。 dang ran ， da duo shu ren bu hui zhi dao zhe yi dian 。]

english: How come?
translation: 怎么会？ [zen me hui ？]

english: Many of the writings are only available to us priests. That does of course include the new High Priest, but perhaps he is yet to read them. They are definitely... illuminating.
translation: 许多著作只有我们神父才能读到。这当然包括新任大祭司，但也许他还没有读过它们。它们绝对……具有启发性。 [xu duo zhu zuo zhi you wo men shen fu cai neng du dao 。 zhe dang ran bao kuo xin ren da ji si ， dan ye xu ta hai mei you du guo ta men 。 ta men jue dui …… ju you qi fa xing 。]

english: Interesting...
translation: 有趣的... [you qu de ...]

english: Interesting. Thanks for the information.
translation: 有趣的。感谢您提供信息。 [you qu de 。 gan xie nin ti gong xin xi 。]

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: Hey! You don't have permission to go down there.
translation: 嘿！你没有权限去那里。 [hei ！ ni mei you quan xian qu na li 。]

english: Hello Jex.
translation: 你好，杰克斯。 [ni hao ， jie ke si 。]

english: Hello again.
translation: 又好。 [you hao 。]

english: Could you tell me more about the lesser gods?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于小神的事吗？ [ni neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu xiao shen de shi ma ？]

english: Could you tell me more about Apmeken?
translation: 您能告诉我更多有关阿普梅肯的信息吗？ [nin neng gao su wo geng duo you guan a pu mei ken de xin xi ma ？]

english: Could you tell me more about Het?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于Het的事吗？ [ni neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu Het de shi ma ？]

english: Could you tell me more about Crondis?
translation: 您能告诉我更多关于克朗迪斯的信息吗？ [nin neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu ke lang di si de xin xi ma ？]

english: Could you tell me more about Scabaras?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于斯卡巴拉斯的事吗？ [ni neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu si ka ba la si de shi ma ？]

english: Interesting. Thanks for the information.
translation: 有趣的。感谢您提供信息。 [you qu de 。 gan xie nin ti gong xin xi 。]

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: Thanks so much for saving us from those stinky gublinch. They were awful! I hope Shanty gave you somefing cool for your efforts.
translation: 非常感谢你把我们从那些臭家伙手中救了出来。他们太糟糕了！我希望 Shanty 能够为你的努力带来一些酷炫的东西。 [fei chang gan xie ni ba wo men cong na xie chou jia huo shou zhong jiu le chu lai 。 ta men tai zao gao le ！ wo xi wang  Shanty  neng gou wei ni de nu li dai lai yi xie ku xuan de dong xi 。]

english: Hello?
translation: 你好？ [ni hao ？]

english: Ah... Another wayward traveller.
translation: 啊……又一个任性的旅行者。 [a …… you yi ge ren xing de lv xing zhe 。]

english: Excuse me?
translation: 打扰一下？ [da rao yi xia ？]

english: You are not the first to make your way down here. Undoubtedly, you will not be the last.
translation: 你不是第一个来到这里的人。毫无疑问，你不会是最后一个。 [ni bu shi di yi ge lai dao zhe li de ren 。 hao wu yi wen ， ni bu hui shi zui hou yi ge 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: My aeternal name, given to me long ago, is Jimp.
translation: 我的永恒名字是吉普，很久以前就被赋予了。 [wo de yong heng ming zi shi ji pu ， hen jiu yi qian jiu bei fu yu le 。]

english: Jimp the imp?
translation: 吉姆普小鬼？ [ji mu pu xiao gui ？]

english: Yes, though my many centuries upon this realm have taught me that the newer tongues struggle with its pronounciation.
translation: 是的，尽管我在这个领域的许多世纪告诉我，新的语言在发音上遇到了困难。 [shi de ， jin guan wo zai zhe ge ling yu de xu duo shi ji gao su wo ， xin de yu yan zai fa yin shang yu dao le kun nan 。]

english: So you may call me Jim.
translation: 所以你可以叫我吉姆。 [suo yi ni ke yi jiao wo ji mu 。]

english: Okay...
translation: 好的... [hao de ...]

english: I see you still have questions. Before I answer them, I will need you to swear to secrecy.
translation: 我看你还有疑问。在我回答之前，我需要你发誓保守秘密。 [wo kan ni hai you yi wen 。 zai wo hui da zhi qian ， wo xu yao ni fa shi bao shou mi mi 。]

english: Hang on... why would I do that?
translation: 等等...我为什么要这么做？ [deng deng ... wo wei shen me yao zhe me zuo ？]

english: I believe you will find my cooperation helpful. Perhaps I shall find yours helpful one day too.
translation: 我相信我的合作会对您有所帮助。也许有一天我会发现你的也很有帮助。 [wo xiang xin wo de he zuo hui dui nin you suo bang zhu 。 ye xu you yi tian wo hui fa xian ni de ye hen you bang zhu 。]

english: I've already entered one dubious contract.
translation: 我已经签订了一份可疑的合同。 [wo yi jing qian ding le yi fen ke yi de he tong 。]

english: I'm not sure I should be signing any others.
translation: 我不确定我是否应该签其他任何人。 [wo bu que ding wo shi fou ying gai qian qi ta ren he ren 。]

english: You will find the nature of my contracts refreshing, then. My terms are simple: do not endanger me or take what is mine, and I shall do what I can to help you.
translation: 那么你会发现我的合同的性质令人耳目一新。我的条件很简单：不要危及我或夺走我的东西，我将尽我所能帮助你。 [na me ni hui fa xian wo de he tong de xing zhi ling ren er mu yi xin 。 wo de tiao jian hen jian dan ： bu yao wei ji wo huo duo zou wo de dong xi ， wo jiang jin wo suo neng bang zhu ni 。]

english: Okay then, why not.
translation: 好吧，那为什么不呢。 [hao ba ， na wei shen me bu ne 。]

english: Excellent. It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance, [player name].
translation: 出色的。很高兴认识你，[玩家姓名]。 [chu se de 。 hen gao xing ren shi ni ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Wait, how do you know my name? Was this a trick?
translation: 等等，你怎么知道我的名字？这是一个诡计吗？ [deng deng ， ni zen me zhi dao wo de ming zi ？ zhe shi yi ge gui ji ma ？]

english: No, friend, you signed it right here.
translation: 不，朋友，你就在这里签了字。 [bu ， peng you ， ni jiu zai zhe li qian le zi 。]

english: Oh, right.
translation: 哦，对了。 [o ， dui le 。]

english: Who are you really?
translation: 你到底是谁？ [ni dao di shi shui ？]

english: I suppose since you already know my name, you are asking who I am in the context of history and society.
translation: 我想既然你已经知道我的名字，你是在问我在历史和社会的背景下是谁。 [wo xiang ji ran ni yi jing zhi dao wo de ming zi ， ni shi zai wen wo zai li shi he she hui de bei jing xia shi shui 。]

english: Yes, let's go with that.
translation: 是的，我们就这样吧。 [shi de ， wo men jiu zhe yang ba 。]

english: I am afraid other agreements bar me from telling you much of my past. Nowadays, I am a humble servant of Yama, existing only to do as he pleases.
translation: 恐怕其他协议禁止我告诉你我的大部分过去。如今，我是阎罗王的一个卑微仆人，只是为了做他想做的事而存在。 [kong pa qi ta xie yi jin zhi wo gao su ni wo de da bu fen guo qu 。 ru jin ， wo shi yan luo wang de yi ge bei wei pu ren ， zhi shi wei le zuo ta xiang zuo de shi er cun zai 。]

english: And what is that?
translation: 那是什么？ [na shi shen me ？]

english: Mostly fetching records, and dying. When I am not doing that, I rest here. The features of this isle remind me of those I once knew.
translation: 主要是获取记录，然后死去。当我不这样做的时候，我就在这里休息。这个小岛的特色让我想起了我曾经认识的人。 [zhu yao shi huo qu ji lu ， ran hou si qu 。 dang wo bu zhe yang zuo de shi hou ， wo jiu zai zhe li xiu xi 。 zhe ge xiao dao de te se rang wo xiang qi le wo ceng jing ren shi de ren 。]

english: Who do you mean by 'those'?
translation: 你所说的“那些”指的是谁？ [ni suo shuo de “ na xie ” zhi de shi shui ？]

english: I already skirt as closely as I can to what I am disallowed from sharing. I apologise, but I cannot answer further.
translation: 我已经尽可能地回避那些我被禁止分享的事情。我很抱歉，但我无法进一步回答。 [wo yi jing jin ke neng di hui bi na xie wo bei jin zhi fen xiang de shi qing 。 wo hen bao qian ， dan wo wu fa jin yi bu hui da 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This isle is a small wonder. The rock formations here bear a slight resemblance to those from my own realm.
translation: 这座岛是一个小奇迹。这里的岩层与我家乡的岩层有些相似。 [zhe zuo dao shi yi ge xiao qi ji 。 zhe li de yan ceng yu wo jia xiang de yan ceng you xie xiang si 。]

english: The rock looks like it's crumbling.
translation: 岩石看起来像是要碎裂了。 [yan shi kan qi lai xiang shi yao sui lie le 。]

english: Yes, infernal shale is kept together largely by the pressure from above. Once a piece is broken off, it can easily be broken down with a hammer and chisel.
translation: 是的，地狱页岩主要是通过来自上方的压力保持在一起的。一旦一块被折断，就可以很容易地用锤子和凿子将其击碎。 [shi de ， di yu ye yan zhu yao shi tong guo lai zi shang fang de ya li bao chi zai yi qi de 。 yi dan yi kuai bei zhe duan ， jiu ke yi hen rong yi di yong chui zi he zao zi jiang qi ji sui 。]

english: That's good to know. What about the smithy?
translation: 很高兴知道这一点。那铁匠铺呢？ [hen gao xing zhi dao zhe yi dian 。 na tie jiang pu ne ？]

english: I can say nothing more than that it was not here when I arrived.
translation: 我只能说我到达时它不在这里。 [wo zhi neng shuo wo dao da shi ta bu zai zhe li 。]

english: So you brought it here?
translation: 所以你把它带到这里来了？ [suo yi ni ba ta dai dao zhe li lai le ？]

english: I cannot say.
translation: 我不能说。 [wo bu neng shuo 。]

english: It's rather hot here.
translation: 这里比较热。 [zhe li bi jiao re 。]

english: Yes, the unique composition of this chasm does create a warm environment.
translation: 是的，这个裂缝的独特构成确实创造了一个温暖的环境。 [shi de ， zhe ge lie feng de du te gou cheng que shi chuang zao le yi ge wen nuan de huan jing 。]

english: I can see my sweat turning to vapour as soon as it appears.
translation: 我可以看到我的汗水一出现就变成了蒸汽。 [wo ke yi kan dao wo de han shui yi chu xian jiu bian cheng le zheng qi 。]

english: Yes, water is an ineffective coolant at this temperature. Perhaps I could offer an alternative.
translation: 是的，在这个温度下水是无效的冷却剂。也许我可以提供一个替代方案。 [shi de ， zai zhe ge wen du xia shui shi wu xiao de leng que ji 。 ye xu wo ke yi ti gong yi ge ti dai fang an 。]

english: That would be handy.
translation: 那会很方便。 [na hui hen fang bian 。]

english: The liquid will only offer a brief respite from the heat, but I find it can help to apply it frequently between bursts of exertion.
translation: 这种液体只能提供短暂的缓解热量的作用，但我发现它可以帮助在剧烈运动之间经常使用它。 [zhe zhong ye ti zhi neng ti gong duan zan de huan jie re liang de zuo yong ， dan wo fa xian ta ke yi bang zhu zai ju lie yun dong zhi jian jing chang shi yong ta 。]

english: I see, thanks. I'll give that a try.
translation: 我明白了，谢谢。我会尝试一下。 [wo ming bai le ， xie xie 。 wo hui chang shi yi xia 。]

english: I can see you eyeing the liquid. It is best you do not ask.
translation: 我可以看到你盯着液体。你最好不要问。 [wo ke yi kan dao ni ding zhe ye ti 。 ni zui hao bu yao wen 。]

english: Have another cloth. Remember, it only offers a brief respite from the heat. You'll want to time bursts of exertion right after using it.
translation: 再准备一块布。请记住，它只能提供短暂的避暑喘息机会。使用后您需要立即计算一下剧烈运动的时间。 [zai zhun bei yi kuai bu 。 qing ji zhu ， ta zhi neng ti gong duan zan de bi shu chuan xi ji hui 。 shi yong hou nin xu yao li ji ji suan yi xia ju lie yun dong de shi jian 。]

english: Why is there a smithy down here?
translation: 这里怎么会有铁匠铺？ [zhe li zen me hui you tie jiang pu ？]

english: I cannot speak to the purpose the smithy has, but I might be able to shed some light on the purposes it could be given.
translation: 我无法说出铁匠铺的目的，但我也许能够阐明它可以实现的目的。 [wo wu fa shuo chu tie jiang pu de mu di ， dan wo ye xu neng gou chan ming ta ke yi shi xian de mu di 。]

english: Go on.
translation: 继续。 [ji xu 。]

english: The furnace is capable of extremely high temperatures. Whilst not very helpful for your ores, it can melt metal from our realm.
translation: 该炉能够承受极高的温度。虽然对你的矿石没有太大帮助，但它可以熔化我们领域的金属。 [gai lu neng gou cheng shou ji gao de wen du 。 sui ran dui ni de kuang shi mei you tai da bang zhu ， dan ta ke yi rong hua wo men ling yu de jin shu 。]

english: Like the rocks on this isle?
translation: 喜欢这个岛上的岩石吗？ [xi huan zhe ge dao shang de yan shi ma ？]

english: Not quite, though they are necessary to power the furnace. Nobody but Yama has access to the kinds of ores it was designed for.
translation: 不完全是，尽管它们是为熔炉提供动力所必需的。除了 Yama 之外，没有人能够获得它所设计的矿石种类。 [bu wan quan shi ， jin guan ta men shi wei rong lu ti gong dong li suo bi xu de 。 chu le  Yama  zhi wai ， mei you ren neng gou huo de ta suo she ji de kuang shi zhong lei 。]

english: But if I were to get my hands on some, I could work them here?
translation: 但如果我能得到一些，我可以在这里使用它们吗？ [dan ru guo wo neng de dao yi xie ， wo ke yi zai zhe li shi yong ta men ma ？]

english: Yes. The process is quite involved. Smaller shards must be melted into nuggets for stability, and then combined into chunks.
translation: 是的。这个过程相当复杂。为了稳定性，较小的碎片必须熔化成块，然后组合成块。 [shi de 。 zhe ge guo cheng xiang dang fu za 。 wei le wen ding xing ， jiao xiao de sui pian bi xu rong hua cheng kuai ， ran hou zu he cheng kuai 。]

english: I see. Maybe I can give that a go.
translation: 我懂了。也许我可以尝试一下。 [wo dong le 。 ye xu wo ke yi chang shi yi xia 。]

english: You're very friendly for a demon.
translation: 你对恶魔非常友好。 [ni dui e mo fei chang you hao 。]

english: I am not alone in this amongst my kind, but I understand that I am rare. I have my reasons for being this way.
translation: 在我的同类中，我并不孤单，但我知道我很罕见。我这样是有我的理由的。 [zai wo de tong lei zhong ， wo bing bu gu dan ， dan wo zhi dao wo hen han jian 。 wo zhe yang shi you wo de li you de 。]

english: Well, if there is anything I can do for you, let me know.
translation: 好吧，如果有什么我能为你做的，请告诉我。 [hao ba ， ru guo you shen me wo neng wei ni zuo de ， qing gao su wo 。]

english: Thank you. There is little I can ask of you given the nature of my other agreements, but watching you work on this isle does bring me some comfort.
translation: 谢谢。鉴于我其他协议的性质，我对你没什么要求，但看着你在这个岛上工作确实给我带来了一些安慰。 [xie xie 。 jian yu wo qi ta xie yi de xing zhi ， wo dui ni mei shen me yao qiu ， dan kan zhe ni zai zhe ge dao shang gong zuo que shi gei wo dai lai le yi xie an wei 。]

translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]
