translation: 仔细观察这张地图。 [zi xi guan cha zhe zhang di tu 。]

english: A client of mine, a merchant of some repute, is having a sorbet.
translation: 我的一位客户，一位颇有名气的商人，正在吃冰糕。 [wo de yi wei ke hu ， yi wei po you ming qi de shang ren ， zheng zai chi bing gao 。]

english: A what?
translation: 一个什么？ [yi ge shen me ？]

english: A soy - a fancy party. Don't interrupt me again.
translation: 大豆——一场盛大的派对。别再打扰我了。 [da dou —— yi chang sheng da de pai dui 。 bie zai da rao wo le 。]

english: This client of mine has a problem, a small furry one.
translation: 我的这位客户有一个问题，一个毛茸茸的小问题。 [wo de zhe wei ke hu you yi ge wen ti ， yi ge mao rong rong de xiao wen ti 。]

english: He'd be better off calling a doctor about that.
translation: 他最好还是请医生来解决这个问题。 [ta zui hao hai shi qing yi sheng lai jie jue zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: No, you fool! A rat problem.
translation: 不，你这个傻瓜！老鼠的问题。 [bu ， ni zhe ge sha gua ！ lao shu de wen ti 。]

english: So you want me to go to his place and kill some rats? That sounds easy enough.
translation: 所以你想让我去他那儿杀一些老鼠？这听起来很容易。 [suo yi ni xiang rang wo qu ta na er sha yi xie lao shu ？ zhe ting qi lai hen rong yi 。]

english: Ah, but it's not that simple. Here's your first lesson - we ratcatchers must be discreet.
translation: 啊，但事情没那么简单。这是你的第一课——我们捕鼠人必须谨慎。 [a ， dan shi qing mei na me jian dan 。 zhe shi ni de di yi ke —— wo men bu shu ren bi xu jin shen 。]

english: Our wealthier clients would be ruined if word got out that their fancy mansions were filled with vermin.
translation: 如果我们富有的客户的豪华豪宅里充满了害虫的消息传出去，他们就会破产。 [ru guo wo men fu you de ke hu de hao hua hao zhai li chong man le hai chong de xiao xi chuan chu qu ， ta men jiu hui po chan 。]

english: Oh, I see. So I have to do this covertly?
translation: 我懂了。所以我必须偷偷地做这件事吗？ [wo dong le 。 suo yi wo bi xu tou tou di zuo zhe jian shi ma ？]

english: Precisely!
translation: 恰恰！ [qia qia ！]

english: Now just in case, I'm going to cast a spell on you that will allow you carryout this task with some element of safety.
translation: 现在以防万一，我要对你施一个咒语，让你在安全的情况下完成这项任务。 [xian zai yi fang wan yi ， wo yao dui ni shi yi ge zhou yu ， rang ni zai an quan de qing kuang xia wan cheng zhe xiang ren wu 。]

english: Are you going to cast an invisibility spell on me? That should make it easy.
translation: 你要对我施隐形咒吗？这应该会让事情变得容易。 [ni yao dui wo shi yin xing zhou ma ？ zhe ying gai hui rang shi qing bian de rong yi 。]

english: Not quite. If you're spotted, this spell will teleport you a short distance away and render the last few seconds of your discoverer's memory blank.
translation: 不完全是。如果你被发现，这个法术会将你传送到一小段距离，并使发现者的最后几秒钟的记忆变成空白。 [bu wan quan shi 。 ru guo ni bei fa xian ， zhe ge fa shu hui jiang ni chuan song dao yi xiao duan ju li ， bing shi fa xian zhe de zui hou ji miao zhong de ji yi bian cheng kong bai 。]

english: That's really useful!
translation: 这真的很有用！ [zhe zhen de hen you yong ！]

english: Jimmy waves his hands about and mutters something under his breath.
translation: 吉米挥舞着双手，低声嘟囔着什么。 [ji mi hui wu zhe shuang shou ， di sheng du nang zhe shen me 。]

english: Where'd you learn that spell, anyway?
translation: 你从哪里学来这个咒语的？ [ni cong na li xue lai zhe ge zhou yu de ？]

english: That's a trade secret, m'afraid.
translation: 恐怕这是商业秘密。 [kong pa zhe shi shang ye mi mi 。]

english: Well, can you teach me?
translation: 嗯，你能教我吗？ [n ， ni neng jiao wo ma ？]

english: Oh my, no. Can you imagine if all the riffraff in Ardougne got wind of this?
translation: 天啊，不。你能想象如果阿杜涅所有的痞子都听到了这件事吗？ [tian a ， bu 。 ni neng xiang xiang ru guo a du nie suo you de pi zi dou ting dao le zhe jian shi ma ？]

english: We already have a serious crime problem.
translation: 我们已经面临严重的犯罪问题。 [wo men yi jing mian lin yan zhong de fan zui wen ti 。]

english: Oh, I see.
translation: 我懂了。 [wo dong le 。]

english: But there's plenty more I can teach you about ratcatching... if you complete the task I've set you.
translation: 但是我可以教你更多关于捕鼠的知识……如果你完成我给你的任务。 [dan shi wo ke yi jiao ni geng duo guan yu bu shu de zhi shi …… ru guo ni wan cheng wo gei ni de ren wu 。]

english: Do you have any tips for me now?
translation: 你现在有什么建议给我吗？ [ni xian zai you shen me jian yi gei wo ma ？]

english: Of course! Use a cat to catch the rats.
translation: 当然！用猫来捉老鼠。 [dang ran ！ yong mao lai zhuo lao shu 。]

english: That's it?
translation: 就是这样？ [jiu shi zhe yang ？]

english: Don't look a gilt horse in the mouth!
translation: 别看镀金马的嘴！ [bie kan du jin ma de zui ！]

english: You mean a gift horse?
translation: 你是说礼物马吗？ [ni shi shuo li wu ma ma ？]

english: I'll gift you no such thing! Now go on, get out of here!
translation: 我不会给你这样的礼物！现在走吧，离开这里！ [wo bu hui gei ni zhe yang de li wu ！ xian zai zou ba ， li kai zhe li ！]

english: Off I go then...
translation: 那我走了... [na wo zou le ...]

english: Ah, you're back. Have you completed your mission?
translation: 啊，你回来了。你完成你的使命了吗？ [a ， ni hui lai le 。 ni wan cheng ni de shi ming le ma ？]

english: What am I meant to do again?
translation: 我又该做什么呢？ [wo you gai zuo shen me ne ？]

english: Read the directions on the map to get to the manor. Once there, eliminate any rats you see with your cat and return to me unseen. Got it?
translation: 阅读地图上的路线即可到达庄园。到达那里后，消灭掉你在你的猫身上看到的所有老鼠，然后在不被发现的情况下回到我身边。知道了？ [yue du di tu shang de lu xian ji ke dao da zhuang yuan 。 dao da na li hou ， xiao mie diao ni zai ni de mao shen shang kan dao de suo you lao shu ， ran hou zai bu bei fa xian de qing kuang xia hui dao wo shen bian 。 zhi dao le ？]

english: Got it. Thanks for the reminder.
translation: 知道了。谢谢你的提醒。 [zhi dao le 。 xie xie ni de ti xing 。]

english: Good, good.
translation: 好，好。 [hao ， hao 。]

english: Ah [player name], aren't you just the ticket?
translation: 啊【玩家名】，你不就是一张票吗？ [a 【 wan jia ming 】， ni bu jiu shi yi zhang piao ma ？]

english: I am?
translation: 我是？ [wo shi ？]

english: A job well done. Confabulations!
translation: 干得好。胡言乱语！ [gan de hao 。 hu yan luan yu ！]

english: No, the job really is done!
translation: 不，工作真的完成了！ [bu ， gong zuo zhen de wan cheng le ！]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: Never mind. So you'll teach me all about ratcatching now?
translation: 没关系。那么你现在可以教我所有关于捕鼠的知识吗？ [mei guan xi 。 na me ni xian zai ke yi jiao wo suo you guan yu bu shu de zhi shi ma ？]

english: Of course! If you want to learn about ratcatching, get yourself to the Rat Pits here in Ardougne.
translation: 当然！如果您想了解捕鼠知识，请前往阿杜涅 (Ardougne) 的老鼠坑 (Rat Pits)。 [dang ran ！ ru guo nin xiang liao jie bu shu zhi shi ， qing qian wang a du nie  (Ardougne)  de lao shu keng  (Rat Pits)。]

english: It's a great place for training kittens. Just look at Bones here!
translation: 这里是训练小猫的好地方。看看这里的骨头就知道了！ [zhe li shi xun lian xiao mao de hao di fang 。 kan kan zhe li de gu tou jiu zhi dao le ！]

english: I think of nothing but murder all day!
translation: 我整天只想着杀人！ [wo zheng tian zhi xiang zhe sha ren ！]

english: He does look good at catching rats. But what about older cats?
translation: 他看起来确实很擅长抓老鼠。但是年纪大的猫呢？ [ta kan qi lai que shi hen shan chang zhua lao shu 。 dan shi nian ji da de mao ne ？]

english: Ah, well. My good friend Hooknosed Jack can tell you all about those.
translation: 啊，好吧。我的好朋友钩鼻杰克可以告诉你所有这些。 [a ， hao ba 。 wo de hao peng you gou bi jie ke ke yi gao su ni suo you zhe xie 。]

english: He has the oldest cat I've ever seen.
translation: 他有我见过的最古老的猫。 [ta you wo jian guo de zui gu lao de mao 。]

english: Where do I find this... Hooknosed Jack?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到这个……鹰钩鼻杰克？ [wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao zhe ge …… ying gou bi jie ke ？]

english: He hangs around in a rather unfashionable part of Varrock. He likes a good scrap, does Jack.
translation: 他在瓦罗克一个相当不流行的地方闲逛。他喜欢精彩的片段，杰克也是如此。 [ta zai wa luo ke yi ge xiang dang bu liu xing de di fang xian guang 。 ta xi huan jing cai de pian duan ， jie ke ye shi ru ci 。]

english: I'll tell him to look out for you.
translation: 我会告诉他要照顾你。 [wo hui gao su ta yao zhao gu ni 。]

english: Can you tell me more about the Rat Pits?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于老鼠坑的事情吗？ [ni neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu lao shu keng de shi qing ma ？]

english: The pits lie below this very pub.
translation: 坑就位于这家酒吧的下面。 [keng jiu wei yu zhe jia jiu ba de xia mian 。]

english: See that ladder there? That's the way in.
translation: 看到那里的梯子了吗？这就是进去的路。 [kan dao na li de ti zi le ma ？ zhe jiu shi jin qu de lu 。]

english: What goes on in these pits then?
translation: 那么这些坑里到底发生了什么？ [na me zhe xie keng li dao di fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: I'd have thought it was self-exploratory. Here, have a manual.
translation: 我本以为这是自我探索。在这里，有一本手册。 [wo ben yi wei zhe shi zi wo tan suo 。 zai zhe li ， you yi ben shou ce 。]

english: Here, take this, you might find it useful.
translation: 给你，拿着这个，你可能会发现它很有用。 [gei ni ， na zhe zhe ge ， ni ke neng hui fa xian ta hen you yong 。]

english: Ah, [player name]. Back for more intonation?
translation: 啊，[玩家姓名]。返回更多语调？ [a ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。 fan hui geng duo yu diao ？]

english: Can you tell me where I can find Phingspet and Grimesquit?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪里可以找到 Phingspet 和 Grimesquit 吗？ [ni neng gao su wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao  Phingspet  he  Grimesquit  ma ？]

english: They live in the sewers below Varrock.
translation: 他们住在瓦罗克下面的下水道里。 [ta men zhu zai wa luo ke xia mian de xia shui dao li 。]

english: Please don't say hello from me.
translation: 请不要跟我打招呼。 [qing bu yao gen wo da zhao hu 。]

english: Can you tell me where I can find Hooknosed Jack?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪里可以找到鹰钩鼻杰克吗？ [ni neng gao su wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao ying gou bi jie ke ma ？]

english: Can you tell me where I can find Smokin' Joe?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪里可以找到吸烟乔吗？ [ni neng gao su wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao xi yan qiao ma ？]

english: If the old rascal's lungs haven't given up yet, you should find him in Keldagrim.
translation: 如果老流氓的肺还没有衰竭，你应该在凯尔达格林找到他。 [ru guo lao liu mang de fei hai mei you shuai jie ， ni ying gai zai kai er da ge lin zhao dao ta 。]

english: Can you tell me where I might find 'The Face'?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪里可以找到“The Face”吗？ [ni neng gao su wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao “The Face” ma ？]

english: Port Sarim is your best bet.
translation: 沙里姆港是您最好的选择。 [sha li mu gang shi nin zui hao de xuan ze 。]

english: Can you tell me where I might find Felkrash?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪里可以找到菲尔克拉什吗？ [ni neng gao su wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao fei er ke la shen ma ？]

english: The Boss?
translation: 老板？ [lao ban ？]

english: You'll find her in Port Sarim, probably in the Rat Pits there.
translation: 你会在沙里姆港找到她，很可能在那里的老鼠坑里。 [ni hui zai sha li mu gang zhao dao ta ， hen ke neng zai na li de lao shu keng li 。]

english: She's your boss?
translation: 她是你的老板？ [ta shi ni de lao ban ？]

english: Well, sort of. She's the unofficial leader of the Ratcatchers.
translation: 嗯，有点像。她是捕鼠者组织的非官方领袖。 [n ， you dian xiang 。 ta shi bu shu zhe zu zhi de fei guan fang ling xiu 。]

english: Nobody elected her or anything.
translation: 没有人选她或其他任何人。 [mei you ren xuan ta huo qi ta ren he ren 。]

english: Got it. She's the boss.
translation: 知道了。她是老板。 [zhi dao le 。 ta shi lao ban 。]

english: Can you tell me more about the pits?
translation: 能告诉我更多关于坑的事情吗？ [neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu keng de shi qing ma ？]

english: Here take this, you might find it useful.
translation: 拿走这个，你可能会发现它很有用。 [na zou zhe ge ， ni ke neng hui fa xian ta hen you yong 。]

english: What do you want to know?
translation: 你想知道什么？ [ni xiang zhi dao shen me ？]

english: Do you have any pointers for me and my cat?
translation: 您对我和我的猫有什么建议吗？ [nin dui wo he wo de mao you shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: You should wear an Amulet of Catspeak. It will allow you to organise tactics with your cat.
translation: 你应该佩戴猫语护身符。它可以让你和你的猫一起制定策略。 [ni ying gai pei dai mao yu hu shen fu 。 ta ke yi rang ni he ni de mao yi qi zhi ding ce lve 。]

english: What would be the best tactic to adopt then?
translation: 那么采取什么策略最好呢？ [na me cai qu shen me ce lve zui hao ne ？]

english: Well, that depends on your outlook, whether you're ready to risk your cat's life or not and how defensive or aggressive you want your cat to be.
translation: 嗯，这取决于您的看法，您是否准备好冒猫的生命危险，以及您希望猫的防御性或攻击性如何。 [n ， zhe qu jue yu nin de kan fa ， nin shi fou zhun bei hao mao mao de sheng ming wei xian ， yi ji nin xi wang mao de fang yu xing huo gong ji xing ru he 。]

english: I will not risk my cat's life.
translation: 我不会拿我的猫的生命冒险。 [wo bu hui na wo de mao de sheng ming mao xian 。]

english: Well if that's the case then you're left with two choices.
translation: 好吧，如果是这样的话，那么你有两个选择。 [hao ba ， ru guo shi zhe yang de hua ， na me ni you liang ge xuan ze 。]

english: You can adopt an ultra defensive strategy, which increases your cat's hitpoints and defence but causes it to flee sooner.
translation: 您可以采取超防御策略，这会增加猫的生命值和防御力，但会使其更快逃跑。 [nin ke yi cai qu chao fang yu ce lve ， zhe hui zeng jia mao de sheng ming zhi he fang yu li ， dan hui shi qi geng kuai tao pao 。]

english: Or you can adopt a less defensive strategy, which will allow your cat to stay in the pit for longer.
translation: 或者您可以采取较少防御的策略，这将使您的猫在坑中停留更长时间。 [huo zhe nin ke yi cai qu jiao shao fang yu de ce lve ， zhe jiang shi nin de mao zai keng zhong ting liu geng zhang shi jian 。]

english: I think I would adopt a very defensive strategy
translation: 我想我会采取非常防守的策略 [wo xiang wo hui cai qu fei chang fang shou de ce lve]

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'Just take care of yourself, cat.'
translation: 在这种情况下，您应该告诉您的猫：“照顾好自己，猫。” [zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， nin ying gai gao su nin de mao ：“ zhao gu hao zi ji ， mao 。”]

english: Thanks for your help.
translation: 感谢您的帮助。 [gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]

english: Do you have any other questions about the pits?
translation: 关于坑你还有其他疑问吗？ [guan yu keng ni hai you qi ta yi wen ma ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: I think I would adopt a less defensive strategy.
translation: 我想我会采取较少防御的策略。 [wo xiang wo hui cai qu jiao shao fang yu de ce lve 。]

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'Stay in for as long as you can.'
translation: 在这种情况下，您应该告诉您的猫：“尽可能呆在家里。” [zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， nin ying gai gao su nin de mao ：“ jin ke neng dai zai jia li 。”]

english: I am willing to risk my cat, if it increases my chances of victory.
translation: 如果我的猫能增加我获胜的机会，我愿意拿它冒险。 [ru guo wo de mao neng zeng jia wo huo sheng de ji hui ， wo yuan yi na ta mao xian 。]

english: In that case you are left with two choices.
translation: 在这种情况下，你有两个选择。 [zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， ni you liang ge xuan ze 。]

english: You could go for all out attack which will boost your cat's attack and strength, but weaken it.
translation: 你可以全力攻击，这会增强你的猫的攻击力和力量，但会削弱它。 [ni ke yi quan li gong ji ， zhe hui zeng qiang ni de mao de gong ji li he li liang ， dan hui xue ruo ta 。]

english: Or, go for a less aggressive stance, which will increase your cat's strength and attack to a lesser degree, but carries no defensive penalties.
translation: 或者，采取不那么激进的姿势，这会增加猫的力量和攻击力，但不会带来防御惩罚。 [huo zhe ， cai qu bu na me ji jin de zi shi ， zhe hui zeng jia mao de li liang he gong ji li ， dan bu hui dai lai fang yu cheng fa 。]

english: I think I would adopt a very aggressive strategy.
translation: 我想我会采取非常激进的策略。 [wo xiang wo hui cai qu fei chang ji jin de ce lve 。]

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'Go berserk!'
translation: 在这种情况下，你应该告诉你的猫：“发疯吧！” [zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， ni ying gai gao su ni de mao ：“ fa feng ba ！”]

english: I think I would adopt a less aggressive strategy.
translation: 我想我会采取不那么激进的策略。 [wo xiang wo hui cai qu bu na me ji jin de ce lve 。]

english: In that case you should tell your cat: 'No guts, no glory!'
translation: 在这种情况下，你应该告诉你的猫：“没有勇气，就没有荣耀！” [zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， ni ying gai gao su ni de mao ：“ mei you yong qi ， jiu mei you rong yao ！”]

english: What benefits does my cat get from training in the pits?
translation: 我的猫从训练区训练中得到什么好处？ [wo de mao cong xun lian qu xun lian zhong de dao shen me hao chu ？]

english: It depends on what kind of cat you have.
translation: 这取决于你养的是什么类型的猫。 [zhe qu jue yu ni yang de shi shen me lei xing de mao 。]

english: In the Ardougne pits, your kitten will grow up faster whether it wins or loses.
translation: 在阿杜涅坑中，你的小猫无论输赢都会成长得更快。 [zai a du nie keng zhong ， ni de xiao mao wu lun shu ying du hui cheng zhang de geng kuai 。]

english: What if it wins then?
translation: 到时候如果赢了怎么办？ [dao shi hou ru guo ying le zen me ban ？]

english: It will gain more experience, it'll be happier, and it'll be fed, too.
translation: 它会获得更多的经验，会更快乐，而且也会得到食物。 [ta hui huo de geng duo de jing yan ， hui geng kuai le ， er qie ye hui de dao shi wu 。]

english: Can you show me to the Rat Pits?
translation: 你能带我去老鼠坑吗？ [ni neng dai wo qu lao shu keng ma ？]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Good luck!
translation: 祝你好运！ [zhu ni hao yun ！]

english: How do you spell your name again?
translation: 你的名字又怎么拼写？ [ni de ming zi you zen me pin xie ？]

english: J-I-M-M-Y D-A-Z-Z-L-E-R.

english: Newish certainly.
translation: 当然是新的。 [dang ran shi xin de 。]

english: Well, if ye wants te hear the story, here goes.
translation: 好吧，如果你想听这个故事，就来吧。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni xiang ting zhe ge gu shi ， jiu lai ba 。]

english: See, I was walkin' along the docks one day, and this fierce storm blew up.
translation: 看，有一天我沿着码头散步，突然刮起了一场猛烈的风暴。 [kan ， you yi tian wo yan zhe ma tou san bu ， tu ran gua qi le yi chang meng lie de feng bao 。]

english: All of a sudden I turn an there, bearin' down on me is this albatross...
translation: 突然我转身，那只信天翁正向我袭来…… [tu ran wo zhuan shen ， na zhi xin tian weng zheng xiang wo xi lai ……]

english: Sorry to interrupt, but I would just like to clear something up.
translation: 抱歉打扰，但我只是想澄清一些事情。 [bao qian da rao ， dan wo zhi shi xiang cheng qing yi xie shi qing 。]

english: What? I was just gettin' to the good bit.
translation: 什么？我刚刚开始讲好话了。 [shen me ？ wo gang gang kai shi jiang hao hua le 。]

english: When I said 'I wanted to know where you got that harpoon hand', I meant where did you get it made, or buy it from?
translation: 当我说“我想知道你的鱼叉手是从哪里得到的”时，我的意思是你是在哪里制造的，或者从哪里购买的？ [dang wo shuo “ wo xiang zhi dao ni de yu cha shou shi cong na li de dao de ” shi ， wo de yi si shi ni shi zai na li zhi zao de ， huo zhe cong na li gou mai de ？]

english: If ye don't wants to hear the story then I ain't gonna tell ye!
translation: 如果你们不想听这个故事那我就不会告诉你们！ [ru guo ni men bu xiang ting zhe ge gu shi na wo jiu bu hui gao su ni men ！]

english: Whadda ya got?
translation: 你得到了什么？ [ni de dao le shen me ？]

english: Nothing! Honest!
translation: 没有什么！诚实的！ [mei you shen me ！ cheng shi de ！]

english: I wanted to know where you got that harpoon hand.
translation: 我想知道你的鱼叉手是从哪里来的 [wo xiang zhi dao ni de yu cha shou shi cong na li lai de]

english: Hi, I'm Joe, door guard for Lady Keli.
translation: 嗨，我是乔，科利女士的门卫。 [hai ， wo shi qiao ， ke li nv shi de men wei 。]

english: Hi, who are you guarding here?
translation: 嗨，你在这里守护着谁？ [hai ， ni zai zhe li shou hu zhe shui ？]

english: Can't say, all very secret. You should get out of here. I am not supposed to talk while I guard.
translation: 不能说，一切都很秘密。你应该离开这里。我不应该在防守时说话。 [bu neng shuo ， yi qie dou hen mi mi 。 ni ying gai li kai zhe li 。 wo bu ying gai zai fang shou shi shuo hua 。]

english: Halt! Who goes there? Friend or foe?
translation: 停止！谁去那里？是朋友还是敌人？ [ting zhi ！ shui qu na li ？ shi peng you hai shi di ren ？]

english: Hi friend, I am just checking out things here.
translation: 你好，朋友，我只是来看看这里的东西。 [ni hao ， peng you ， wo zhi shi lai kan kan zhe li de dong xi 。]

english: The Prince got away, I am in trouble. I better not talk to you, they are not sure I was drunk.
translation: 王子逃走了，我有麻烦了。我最好别和你说话，他们不确定我喝醉了。 [wang zi tao zou le ， wo you ma fan le 。 wo zui hao bie he ni shuo hua ， ta men bu que ding wo he zui le 。]

english: I won't say anything, your secret is safe with me.
translation: 我不会说什么，你的秘密对我来说是安全的。 [wo bu hui shuo shen me ， ni de mi mi dui wo lai shuo shi an quan de 。]

english: Hello there. Would you like to see the goods I have for sale?
translation: 你好呀。您想看看我出售的商品吗？ [ni hao ya 。 nin xiang kan kan wo chu shou de shang pin ma ？]

english: Yes please, Jofridr.
translation: 是的，请，乔弗里德。 [shi de ， qing ， qiao fu li de 。]

english: No thank you, Jofridr.
translation: 不，谢谢你，乔弗里德。 [bu ， xie xie ni ， qiao fu li de 。]

english: Fairthee well.
translation: 好吧。 [hao ba 。]

english: Why do you have so much wool in your store? I haven't seen any sheep anywhere.
translation: 你们店里为什么有这么多羊毛？我在任何地方都没有看到羊。 [ni men dian li wei shen me you zhe me duo yang mao ？ wo zai ren he di fang dou mei you kan dao yang 。]

english: Ah, I have contacts on the mainland. I have a sailor friend who brings me crates of wool on a regular basis.
translation: 啊，我在大陆有联系的。我有一个水手朋友，他定期给我带来一箱箱羊毛。 [a ， wo zai da lu you lian xi de 。 wo you yi ge shui shou peng you ， ta ding qi gei wo dai lai yi xiang xiang yang mao 。]

english: What do you trade for it?
translation: 你用它来交换什么？ [ni yong ta lai jiao huan shen me ？]

english: Rope of course! What else can we sell? Fish would go off before it got so far south.
translation: 当然是绳子！我们还能卖什么？鱼在到达如此遥远的南方之前就会消失。 [dang ran shi sheng zi ！ wo men hai neng mai shen me ？ yu zai dao da ru ci yao yuan de nan fang zhi qian jiu hui xiao shi 。]

english: Where does all this rope go?
translation: 这些绳子都去哪儿了？ [zhe xie sheng zi dou qu na er le ？]

english: Err, I don't remember the name of the place very well. Dreinna? Drennor? Something like that.
translation: 呃，我不太记得那个地方的名字了。德雷娜？德伦诺？类似的事情。 [e ， wo bu tai ji de na ge di fang de ming zi le 。 de lei na ？ de lun nuo ？ lei si de shi qing 。]

english: That's very interesting. Thanks Jofridr.
translation: 这很有趣。谢谢乔弗里德。 [zhe hen you qu 。 xie xie qiao fu li de 。]

english: Would you like to see the goods I have for sale?
translation: 您想看看我出售的商品吗？ [nin xiang kan kan wo chu shou de shang pin ma ？]

english: Yes please, Jofridr
translation: 是的，请，乔弗里德 [shi de ， qing ， qiao fu li de]

english: No thank you, Jofridr
translation: 不，谢谢你，乔弗里德 [bu ， xie xie ni ， qiao fu li de]

english: Why do you have so much wool in your store?
translation: 你们店里为什么有这么多羊毛？ [ni men dian li wei shen me you zhe me duo yang mao ？]

english: Welcome [Brother/Sister]...to our organisation...ours is a fight for humanity in all its shapes and forms...and to rid mankind of the monsters that exist in our world. We have no quarrel with a fellow [brother/sister].
translation: 欢迎[兄弟/姐妹]...加入我们的组织...我们的任务是为各种形态和形式的人类而战...并消除人类世界上存在的怪物。我们与同胞[兄弟/姐妹]没有争吵。 [huan ying [ xiong di / jie mei ]... jia ru wo men de zu zhi ... wo men de ren wu shi wei ge zhong xing tai he xing shi de ren lei er zhan ... bing xiao chu ren lei shi jie shang cun zai de guai wu 。 wo men yu tong bao [ xiong di / jie mei ] mei you zheng chao 。]

english: What kind of organisation is this?
translation: 这是一个什么样的组织？ [zhe shi yi ge shen me yang de zu zhi ？]

english: We're a proactive organisation working towards the cessation of monsters in normal civilised human society. There seems to be no backbone in this land so we're stepping up to the challenge.
translation: 我们是一个积极主动的组织，致力于消灭正常文明人类社会中的怪物。这片土地似乎没有脊梁，所以我们正在迎接挑战。 [wo men shi yi ge ji ji zhu dong de zu zhi ， zhi li yu xiao mie zheng chang wen ming ren lei she hui zhong de guai wu 。 zhe pian tu di si hu mei you ji liang ， suo yi wo men zheng zai ying jie tiao zhan 。]

english: Hmm, how do you propose to do that? I mean, I see people everyday killing goblins around here!
translation: 嗯，你打算怎么做？我的意思是，我每天都看到人们在这里杀妖精！ [n ， ni da suan zen me zuo ？ wo de yi si shi ， wo mei tian dou kan dao ren men zai zhe li sha yao jing ！]

english: We're mobilising people and we're starting our own society...cleaning out the caves once inhabited by these foul creatures and defending them so that they can never again shelter sub human species.
translation: 我们正在动员人们，我们正在建立我们自己的社会……清理这些邪恶生物曾经居住的洞穴并保护它们，使它们永远无法再庇护亚人类物种。 [wo men zheng zai dong yuan ren men ， wo men zheng zai jian li wo men zi ji de she hui …… qing li zhe xie xie e sheng wu ceng jing ju zhu de dong xue bing bao hu ta men ， shi ta men yong yuan wu fa zai bi hu ya ren lei wu zhong 。]

english: That sounds kind of strange, but hey it's your choice.
translation: 这听起来有点奇怪，但嘿，这是你的选择。 [zhe ting qi lai you dian qi guai ， dan hei ， zhe shi ni de xuan ze 。]

english: Who are you and what do you do here?
translation: 你是谁？你在这里做什么？ [ni shi shui ？ ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: My name is Johanhus and I lead these glorious people on a courageous mission called, 'Humans against Monsters', we mean to make this land free of monsters so we can all live in peace.
translation: 我的名字叫约翰胡斯，我带领这些光荣的人们执行一项名为“人类对抗怪物”的勇敢使命，我们的目标是让这片土地上没有怪物，这样我们就能和平相处。 [wo de ming zi jiao yue han hu si ， wo dai ling zhe xie guang rong de ren men zhi xing yi xiang ming wei “ ren lei dui kang guai wu ” de yong gan shi ming ， wo men de mu biao shi rang zhe pian tu di shang mei you guai wu ， zhe yang wo men jiu neng he ping xiang chu 。]

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Hey, I've found this, do you know anything about it?
translation: 嘿，我发现了这个，你知道吗？ [hei ， wo fa xian le zhe ge ， ni zhi dao ma ？]

english: Yes, in fact I do. I wrote many essays for this book, it was a great seller, many people are stirred by the words and feelings in such a tome.
translation: 是的，事实上我愿意。我为这本书写了很多文章，它很畅销，很多人都被这本书的文字和感受所感动。 [shi de ， shi shi shang wo yuan yi 。 wo wei zhe ben shu xie le hen duo wen zhang ， ta hen chang xiao ， hen duo ren dou bei zhe ben shu de wen zi he gan shou suo gan dong 。]

english: Are you planning to do anything about the cave goblins?
translation: 你打算对洞穴妖精采取什么措施吗？ [ni da suan dui dong xue yao jing cai qu shen me cuo shi ma ？]

english: You should know, [brother/sister]...we don't let ordinary members in on all our plans...but rest assured those foul creatures will be dealt with very soon!
translation: 你应该知道，[兄弟/姐妹]……我们的一切计划不会让普通会员知道……不过放心，那些肮脏的生物很快就会被处理掉！ [ni ying gai zhi dao ，[ xiong di / jie mei ]…… wo men de yi qie ji hua bu hui rang pu tong hui yuan zhi dao …… bu guo fang xin ， na xie ang zang de sheng wu hen kuai jiu hui bei chu li diao ！]

english: Can't you please tell me?
translation: 不能请你告诉我吗？ [bu neng qing ni gao su wo ma ？]

english: No! That kind of information is for...only senior members of the group. Ordinary members like you must learn to...trust your leaders.
translation: 不！此类信息仅适用于该团体的高级成员。像您这样的普通成员必须学会……信任您的领导者。 [bu ！ ci lei xin xi jin shi yong yu gai tuan ti de gao ji cheng yuan 。 xiang nin zhe yang de pu tong cheng yuan bi xu xue hui …… xin ren nin de ling dao zhe 。]

english: No! That kind of information is for...only senior members of the group. Why should I tell it to an...outsider?
translation: 不！此类信息仅适用于该团体的高级成员。我为什么要告诉一个……外人？ [bu ！ ci lei xin xi jin shi yong yu gai tuan ti de gao ji cheng yuan 。 wo wei shen me yao gao su yi ge …… wai ren ？]

english: Is it really necessary?
translation: 真的有必要吗？ [zhen de you bi yao ma ？]

english: How can you even...ask that? Right beneath Lumbridge is a whole cave system full of those creatures! They've got a passage leading right up into the castle kitchen!
translation: 你怎么能……问这个？朗布里奇正下方是一个充满这些生物的完整洞穴系统！他们有一条通道直接通向城堡厨房！ [ni zen me neng …… wen zhe ge ？ lang bu li qi zheng xia fang shi yi ge chong man zhe xie sheng wu de wan zheng dong xue xi tong ！ ta men you yi tiao tong dao zhi jie tong xiang cheng bao chu fang ！]

english: And I've heard that there's a whole city of those things down there, not that anyone has ever seen it. What have they got in there? What are they planning?
translation: 我听说下面有一整座这样的东西，但没有人见过它。他们里面有什么？他们在计划什么？ [wo ting shuo xia mian you yi zheng zuo zhe yang de dong xi ， dan mei you ren jian guo ta 。 ta men li mian you shen me ？ ta men zai ji hua shen me ？]

english: We've got to get them before they get us!
translation: 我们必须在他们抓住我们之前抓住他们！ [wo men bi xu zai ta men zhua zhu wo men zhi qian zhua zhu ta men ！]

english: That's good.
translation: 那挺好的。 [na ting hao de 。]

english: So, you got out of the cell? No matter...your goblin friend has already been dealt with...and Sigmund is on his way to deal with the rest of her foul brood!
translation: 那么，你从牢房里出来了吗？不管怎样...你的妖精朋友已经被处理掉了...而西格蒙德正在路上去处理她剩下的邪恶后代！ [na me ， ni cong lao fang li chu lai le ma ？ bu guan zen yang ... ni de yao jing peng you yi jing bei chu li diao le ... er xi ge meng de zheng zai lu shang qu chu li ta sheng xia de xie e hou dai ！]

english: I can't hear anything.
translation: 我什么也听不到。 [wo shen me ye ting bu dao 。]

english: Shh! I can hear them.
translation: 嘘！我能听到他们的声音。 [xu ！ wo neng ting dao ta men de sheng yin 。]

english: Good news, brothers! Our tunnel from the water mill cellar has reached the cave goblin tunnels, and the last shipment of machinery is on its way from Keldagrim.
translation: 好消息，兄弟们！我们从水磨地窖的隧道已经到达洞穴地精隧道，最后一批机械正在从凯尔达格林运来。 [hao xiao xi ， xiong di men ！ wo men cong shui mo di jiao de sui dao yi jing dao da dong xue di jing sui dao ， zui hou yi pi ji xie zheng zai cong kai er da ge lin yun lai 。]

english: Do we have to deal with the dwarves? They may not exactly be monsters but they're still not human.
translation: 我们必须对付矮人吗？他们可能不完全是怪物，但他们仍然不是人类。 [wo men bi xu dui fu ai ren ma ？ ta men ke neng bu wan quan shi guai wu ， dan ta men reng ran bu shi ren lei 。]

english: If it wasn't for the King's tolerance of monsters, we humans would have a better industry than the dwarves!
translation: 如果不是国王对怪物的宽容，我们人类的产业会比矮人更好！ [ru guo bu shi guo wang dui guai wu de kuan rong ， wo men ren lei de chan ye hui bi ai ren geng hao ！]

english: Well said, brother!
translation: 说得好，兄弟！ [shuo de hao ， xiong di ！]

english: I'll need to take some of the low-level members to help unload the machinery at the Lumbridge water mill.
translation: 我需要带一些低级成员帮忙卸下朗布里奇水磨坊的机器。 [wo xu yao dai yi xie di ji cheng yuan bang mang xie xia lang bu li qi shui mo fang de ji qi 。]

english: By all means. It's about time that lot made themselves useful.
translation: 无论如何。是时候让很多人让自己变得有用了。 [wu lun ru he 。 shi shi hou rang hen duo ren rang zi ji bian de you yong le 。]

english: Soon the mighty River Lum will wash away those evil goblins forever!
translation: 很快，强大的卢姆河就会永远冲走那些邪恶的妖精！ [hen kuai ， qiang da de lu mu he jiu hui yong yuan chong zou na xie xie e de yao jing ！]

english: Saradomin will surely bless us for destroying those abominations!
translation: 萨拉多明一定会祝福我们消灭这些可憎之物！ [sa la duo ming yi ding hui zhu fu wo men xiao mie zhe xie ke zeng zhi wu ！]

english: Death to the Dorgeshuun!
translation: 多格舒恩之死！ [duo ge shu en zhi si ！]

english: Death to the Dorgeshuun!
translation: 多格舒恩之死！ [duo ge shu en zhi si ！]

english: Death to the Dorgeshuun!
translation: 多格舒恩之死！ [duo ge shu en zhi si ！]

english: Death to the Dorgeshuun!
translation: 多格舒恩之死！ [duo ge shu en zhi si ！]

english: Death to the Dorgeshuun!
translation: 多格舒恩之死！ [duo ge shu en zhi si ！]

english: What kind of organisation is this?
translation: 这是一个什么样的组织？ [zhe shi yi ge shen me yang de zu zhi ？]

english: Who are you and what do you do here?
translation: 你是谁？你在这里做什么？ [ni shi shui ？ ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Are you planning to do anything about the cave goblins?
translation: 你打算对洞穴妖精采取什么措施吗？ [ni da suan dui dong xue yao jing cai qu shen me cuo shi ma ？]

english: Can't you please tell me?
translation: 不能请你告诉我吗？ [bu neng qing ni gao su wo ma ？]

english: Is it really necessary?
translation: 真的有必要吗？ [zhen de you bi yao ma ？]

english: That's good.
translation: 那挺好的。 [na ting hao de 。]

english: ZzzzZzzZZzzZZzz.
translation: 滋滋滋滋滋滋滋。 [zi zi zi zi zi zi zi 。]

english: He's sleeping peacefully. Loudly, but peacefully.
translation: 他睡得很安稳。声音很大，但很平静。 [ta shui de hen an wen 。 sheng yin hen da ， dan hen ping jing 。]

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好呀！ [ni hao ya ！]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm John, I specialise in archaeology and there's some very interesting ruins in this area.
translation: 我是约翰，我的专业是考古学，这个地区有一些非常有趣的遗址。 [wo shi yue han ， wo de zhuan ye shi kao gu xue ， zhe ge di qu you yi xie fei chang you qu de yi zhi 。]

english: Is that like fossils and stuff?
translation: 是不是像化石之类的东西？ [shi bu shi xiang hua shi zhi lei de dong xi ？]

english: Oh my word no. Archaeology is the study of sentient races history through study of artefacts and ruins.
translation: 哦，我的话不。考古学是通过研究文物和废墟来研究有感知力的种族历史。 [o ， wo de hua bu 。 kao gu xue shi tong guo yan jiu wen wu he fei xu lai yan jiu you gan zhi li de zhong zu li shi 。]

english: Weren't fossils sentient?
translation: 难道化石没有知觉吗？ [nan dao hua shi mei you zhi jue ma ？]

english: Well... we have no proof to suggest such.
translation: 嗯……我们没有证据表明这样的建议。 [n …… wo men mei you zheng ju biao ming zhe yang de jian yi 。]

english: What is going on here?
translation: 这是怎么回事？ [zhe shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: This is our base camp for exploration of this wonderful island.
translation: 这是我们探索这个奇妙岛屿的大本营。 [zhe shi wo men tan suo zhe ge qi miao dao yu de da ben ying 。]

english: Anything I can do to help?
translation: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang mang de ma ？]

english: No, no. You've already helped admirably. Our lives are much more comfortable thank you.
translation: 不，不。你已经提供了令人钦佩的帮助。我们的生活更加舒适，谢谢。 [bu ， bu 。 ni yi jing ti gong le ling ren qin pei de bang zhu 。 wo men de sheng huo geng jia shu shi ， xie xie 。]

english: What should I do?
translation: 我应该怎么办？ [wo ying gai zen me ban ？]

english: Explore! There's so much here we don't understand.
translation: 探索！这里有太多我们不明白的事情。 [tan suo ！ zhe li you tai duo wo men bu ming bai de shi qing 。]

english: But where?
translation: 但在哪里呢？ [dan zai na li ne ？]

english: I've heard there's a pretty spectacular structure up near the mountain, but I haven't gone there yet.
translation: 听说山上有一座很壮观的建筑，但我还没去过。 [ting shuo shan shang you yi zuo hen zhuang guan de jian zhu ， dan wo hai mei qu guo 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: What is going on here?
translation: 这是怎么回事？ [zhe shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: What should I do?
translation: 我应该怎么办？ [wo ying gai zen me ban ？]

english: I am so very tired... Leave me be... to rest...
translation: 我好累……让我……休息一下…… [wo hao lei …… rang wo …… xiu xi yi xia ……]

english: Hello again. My family now considers you a hero.
translation: 又好。我的家人现在认为你是英雄。 [you hao 。 wo de jia ren xian zai ren wei ni shi ying xiong 。]

english: Maybe because... I am.
translation: 也许是因为……我是。 [ye xu shi yin wei …… wo shi 。]

english: Yes well... Is there anything I can help you with?
translation: 是的，好吧...有什么可以帮您的吗？ [shi de ， hao ba ... you shen me ke yi bang nin de ma ？]

english: Can you change my gauntlets for me?
translation: 你能帮我换一下手套吗？ [ni neng bang wo huan yi xia shou tao ma ？]

english: Yes certainly, though it will cost you 25,000 coins.
translation: 当然可以，不过要花费 25,000 个金币。 [dang ran ke yi ， bu guo yao hua fei  25,000  ge jin bi 。]

english: Great thanks!
translation: 非常感谢！ [fei chang gan xie ！]

english: Johnathon takes your gauntlets from you, and begins a low chant over them. You see them begin to glow and sparkle, before he returns them to you.
translation: 乔纳森从你手中接过手套，开始低声吟唱。在他把它们还给你之前，你会看到它们开始发光。 [qiao na sen cong ni shou zhong jie guo shou tao ， kai shi di sheng yin chang 。 zai ta ba ta men huan gei ni zhi qian ， ni hui kan dao ta men kai shi fa guang 。]

english: No that's okay thanks.
translation: 不，没关系，谢谢。 [bu ， mei guan xi ， xie xie 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: I have received word from my father that you assisted us again! I get the feeling you weren't going to stop trying until you did though.
translation: 我收到我父亲的消息，你又帮助了我们！我感觉你不会停止尝试，除非你这样做了。 [wo shou dao wo fu qin de xiao xi ， ni you bang zhu le wo men ！ wo gan jue ni bu hui ting zhi chang shi ， chu fei ni zhe yang zuo le 。]

english: If you want, I'll provide you with as many pairs of Chaos gauntlets as you wish to say thanks!
translation: 如果你愿意的话，我可以为你提供尽可能多的混沌手套，以示感谢！ [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi wei ni ti gong jin ke neng duo de hun dun shou tao ， yi shi gan xie ！]

english: You will find the power of bolt spells increases substantially whilst wearing these gauntlets.
translation: 你会发现戴着这些护手时闪电法术的力量会大大增加。 [ni hui fa xian dai zhe zhe xie hu shou shi shan dian fa shu de li liang hui da da zeng jia 。]

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Here you go!
translation: 干得好！ [gan de hao ！]

english: You're welcome.
translation: 不客气。 [bu ke qi 。]

english: Can you change my gauntlets for me?
translation: 你能帮我换一下手套吗？ [ni neng bang wo huan yi xia shou tao ma ？]

english: Great thanks!
translation: 非常感谢！ [fei chang gan xie ！]

english: No that's okay thanks.
translation: 不，没关系，谢谢。 [bu ， mei guan xi ， xie xie 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Could I have another pair of Chaos gauntlets?
translation: 我可以再要一双混沌手套吗？ [wo ke yi zai yao yi shuang hun dun shou tao ma ？]

english: You're welcome.
translation: 不客气。 [bu ke qi 。]

english: You are unusually helpful for an outerlander, Darkal Dräpare.
translation: 你对一个外来者来说非常有帮助，Darkal Dräpare。 [ni dui yi ge wai lai zhe lai shuo fei chang you bang zhu ，Darkal Dräpare。]

english: Ehm, thanks... I guess.
translation: 嗯，谢谢...我想。 [n ， xie xie ... wo xiang 。]

english: This dish turned out horrendously.
translation: 这道菜结果很糟糕。 [zhe dao cai jie guo hen zao gao 。]

english: How come?
translation: 怎么会？ [zen me hui ？]

english: It... tastes like nothing...
translation: 就是……没什么味道…… [jiu shi …… mei shen me wei dao ……]

english: Jon shows you an empty bowl.
translation: 乔恩给你看了一个空碗。 [qiao en gei ni kan le yi ge kong wan 。]

english: Isn't that bowl empty?
translation: 那个碗不是空的吗？ [na ge wan bu shi kong de ma ？]

english: So nothing tastes the same cause nothing is never there?
translation: 那么没有什么味道是一样的，因为没有什么是永远存在的？ [na me mei you shen me wei dao shi yi yang de ， yin wei mei you shen me shi yong yuan cun zai de ？]

english: I'll be going...
translation: 我会去... [wo hui qu ...]

english: That's probably for the best.
translation: 这可能是最好的。 [zhe ke neng shi zui hao de 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Hello, lovely day we're having.
translation: 你好，我们度过了美好的一天。 [ni hao ， wo men du guo le mei hao de yi tian 。]

english: Same as every day really, the weather is very consistent around here.
translation: 和每天一样，这里的天气非常稳定。 [he mei tian yi yang ， zhe li de tian qi fei chang wen ding 。]

english: Hello there. Have you heard of Camorra?
translation: 你好呀。你听说过卡莫拉吗？ [ni hao ya 。 ni ting shuo guo ka mo la ma ？]

english: Who?
translation: WHO？ [WHO？]

english: Camorra. She was a great hero who fought in the Dragonkin Conflicts. I think she travelled to Kourend during the war. I'm trying to find out what happened to her.
translation: 卡莫拉。她是在龙族冲突中战斗的伟大英雄。我认为她在战争期间去过库伦德。我正试图找出她身上发生了什么事。 [ka mo la 。 ta shi zai long zu chong tu zhong zhan dou de wei da ying xiong 。 wo ren wei ta zai zhan zheng qi jian qu guo ku lun de 。 wo zheng shi tu zhao chu ta shen shang fa sheng le shen me shi 。]

english: A hero? Well she wouldn't have had much to do with Hosidius. The early Hosidius settlers were all pacificts, they'd have stayed away from people like her.
translation: 英雄？好吧，她不会和霍西迪乌斯有太多关系。早期的霍西迪乌斯定居者都是和平主义者，他们会远离像她这样的人。 [ying xiong ？ hao ba ， ta bu hui he huo xi di wu si you tai duo guan xi 。 zao qi de huo xi di wu si ding ju zhe dou shi he ping zhu yi zhe ， ta men hui yuan li xiang ta zhe yang de ren 。]

english: Oh well. Thanks for the help.
translation: 那好吧。感谢您的帮助。 [na hao ba 。 gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]

english: Can't stop to talk human. Lady Lovakengj might need me.
translation: 无法停下来谈论人类。洛瓦肯吉女士可能需要我。 [wu fa ting xia lai tan lun ren lei 。 luo wa ken ji nv shi ke neng xu yao wo 。]

english: Hi there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: All is lost!
translation: 一切都失去了！ [yi qie dou shi qu le ！]

english: Sorry?
translation: 对不起？ [dui bu qi ？]

english: Don't bother, you're not experienced enough to help me!
translation: 别麻烦了，你的经验还不够，帮不了我！ [bie ma fan le ， ni de jing yan hai bu gou ， bang bu liao wo ！]

english: Just look around you! This great building will soon be in ruin.
translation: 只要看看你周围！这座伟大的建筑很快就会成为废墟。 [zhi yao kan kan ni zhou wei ！ zhe zuo wei da de jian zhu hen kuai jiu hui cheng wei fei xu 。]

english: Great building?
translation: 伟大的建筑？ [wei da de jian zhu ？]

english: Of course! This building has a history spanning generations!
translation: 当然！这座建筑已经有几代人的历史了！ [dang ran ！ zhe zuo jian zhu yi jing you ji dai ren de li shi le ！]

english: Ah, I see, a great history. But why will it be in ruin?
translation: 啊，我明白了，一段伟大的历史。但为什么会毁掉呢？ [a ， wo ming bai le ， yi duan wei da de li shi 。 dan wei shen me hui hui diao ne ？]

english: It's to be ripped apart to make way for King Lathas' new alchemists' lab.
translation: 它将被拆毁，为拉萨斯国王的新炼金术士实验室让路。 [ta jiang bei chai hui ， wei la sa si guo wang de xin lian jin shu shi shi yan shi rang lu 。]

english: Does the king not respect the outpost's GREAT history?
translation: 难道国王不尊重前哨站的伟大历史吗？ [nan dao guo wang bu zun zhong qian shao zhan de wei da li shi ma ？]

english: Well, actually nobody knows what the history is. But there must be something.
translation: 好吧，实际上没有人知道历史是什么。但一定有什么。 [hao ba ， shi ji shang mei you ren zhi dao li shi shi shen me 。 dan yi ding you shen me 。]

english: Wait a minute. You could help me!
translation: 等一下。你可以帮助我！ [deng yi xia 。 ni ke yi bang zhu wo ！]

english: Me?
translation: 我？ [wo ？]

english: Yes! Uncover the history of this building to convince King Lathas to leave it alone. Do you want to know more?
translation: 是的！揭开这座建筑的历史，说服拉萨斯国王不要管它。您想了解更多吗？ [shi de ！ jie kai zhe zuo jian zhu de li shi ， shuo fu la sa si guo wang bu yao guan ta 。 nin xiang liao jie geng duo ma ？]

english: Tell me more.
translation: 告诉我更多。 [gao su wo geng duo 。]

english: A cutscene appears.
translation: 出现过场动画。 [chu xian guo chang dong hua 。]

english: With many occupants over the years...
translation: 多年来，许多住户... [duo nian lai ， xu duo zhu hu ...]

english: ...the building has seen much action.
translation: ...这座建筑发生了很多变化。 [... zhe zuo jian zhu fa sheng le hen duo bian hua 。]

english: It started life as an outpost...
translation: 它开始于一个前哨基地...... [ta kai shi yu yi ge qian shao ji di ......]

english: ... its sole purpose being to see invading armies...
translation: ...它的唯一目的是看到入侵的军队... [... ta de wei yi mu di shi kan dao ru qin de jun dui ...]

english: ... before they saw the city of Ardougne.
translation: ...在他们看到阿杜涅市之前。 [... zai ta men kan dao a du nie shi zhi qian 。]

english: The cutscene disappears.
translation: 过场动画消失。 [guo chang dong hua xiao shi 。]

english: If all goes well, I hope to be able to turn it into a museum as a monument to the area's history. What do you think?
translation: 如果一切顺利的话，我希望能够把它变成一个博物馆，作为该地区历史的纪念碑。你怎么认为？ [ru guo yi qie shun li de hua ， wo xi wang neng gou ba ta bian cheng yi ge bo wu guan ， zuo wei gai di qu li shi de ji nian bei 。 ni zen me ren wei ？]

english: OK, I will make a stand for history!
translation: 好吧，我会为历史辩护的！ [hao ba ， wo hui wei li shi bian hu de ！]

english: Oh thank you so much, you really are my saviour!
translation: 哦，太感谢你了，你真是我的救星！ [o ， tai gan xie ni le ， ni zhen shi wo de jiu xing ！]

english: But where should I start?
translation: 但我应该从哪里开始呢？ [dan wo ying gai cong na li kai shi ne ？]

english: What do I need to do now?
translation: 我现在需要做什么？ [wo xian zai xu yao zuo shen me ？]

english: There are three people that may be able to help:
translation: 有三个人可能能够提供帮助： [you san ge ren ke neng neng gou ti gong bang zhu ：]

english: There is a silver trader in East Ardougne called Erin, who I believe can help.
translation: 东阿杜涅有一位名叫艾琳的白银商人，我相信她可以提供帮助。 [dong e du nie you yi wei ming jiao ai lin de bai yin shang ren ， wo xiang xin ta ke yi ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: In what way can he help?
translation: 他能以什么方式提供帮助？ [ta neng yi shen me fang shi ti gong bang zhu ？]

english: His Great Grandfather lived in this outpost according to the records. He must know something!
translation: 据记载，他的曾祖父就住在这个前哨站。他一定知道些什么！ [ju ji zai ， ta de zeng zu fu jiu zhu zai zhe ge qian shao zhan 。 ta yi ding zhi dao xie shen me ！]

english: OK, I'll see what he has to say.
translation: 好吧，我看看他要说什么。 [hao ba ， wo kan kan ta yao shuo shen me 。]

english: I've been told that there's a ghost far off in Port Phasmatys that moans of losing his life to this place.
translation: 有人告诉我，在遥远的法斯马蒂斯港有一个鬼魂，呻吟着要在这个地方失去生命。 [you ren gao su wo ， zai yao yuan de fa si ma di si gang you yi ge gui hun ， shen yin zhe yao zai zhe ge di fang shi qu sheng ming 。]

english: Sounds ominous. Does he have a name?
translation: 听起来不祥。他有名字吗？ [ting qi lai bu xiang 。 ta you ming zi ma ？]

english: He does indeed. It's Droalak.
translation: 他确实这么做了。这是德罗拉克。 [ta que shi zhe me zuo le 。 zhe shi de luo la ke 。]

english: I'll track him down.
translation: 我会追踪他的。 [wo hui zhui zong ta de 。]

english: It might not be so simple! You'll need an amulet of ghostspeak to talk to him!
translation: 事情可能没那么简单！你需要鬼语护身符才能与他交谈！ [shi qing ke neng mei na me jian dan ！ ni xu yao gui yu hu shen fu cai neng yu ta jiao tan ！]

english: I've conversed with the dead before, that shouldn't be too much of a problem.
translation: 我以前曾与死者交谈过，这应该不是什么大问题。 [wo yi qian ceng yu si zhe jiao tan guo ， zhe ying gai bu shi shen me da wen ti 。]

english: Up near the mountains, in Rellekka is a warrior called Dron whom I have spoken to in the past. He is always on the lookout for information that can improve his fighting and commanding skills.
translation: 在雷莱卡的山脉附近，有一位名叫德隆的战士，我过去曾与他交谈过。他总是在寻找可以提高他的战斗和指挥技能的信息。 [zai lei lai ka de shan mai fu jin ， you yi wei ming jiao de long de zhan shi ， wo guo qu ceng yu ta jiao tan guo 。 ta zong shi zai xun zhao ke yi ti gao ta de zhan dou he zhi hui ji neng de xin xi 。]

english: And how's he related to this outpost?
translation: 他和这个前哨站又是什么关系？ [ta he zhe ge qian shao zhan you shi shen me guan xi ？]

english: He isn't directly, but he's studied many wars, and as this used to be an outpost it should have been involved in some war.
translation: 他不是直接的，但他研究过很多战争，而且这里曾经是一个前哨基地，应该参与过一些战争。 [ta bu shi zhi jie de ， dan ta yan jiu guo hen duo zhan zheng ， er qie zhe li ceng jing shi yi ge qian shao ji di ， ying gai can yu guo yi xie zhan zheng 。]

english: That sounds simple enough.
translation: 这听起来很简单。 [zhe ting qi lai hen jian dan 。]

english: He isn't the easiest person to talk to, so you may need to speak to his brother, Blanin, first.
translation: 他不是最容易交谈的人，因此您可能需要首先与他的兄弟布兰宁交谈。 [ta bu shi zui rong yi jiao tan de ren ， yin ci nin ke neng xu yao shou xian yu ta de xiong di bu lan ning jiao tan 。]

english: What's the story so far?
translation: 到目前为止有什么故事吗？ [dao mu qian wei zhi you shen me gu shi ma ？]

english: What do you mean? You've discovered nothing!
translation: 你是什​​么意思？你什么也没发现！ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？ ni shen me ye mei fa xian ！]

english: Got to go, bye!
translation: 该走了，再见！ [gai zou le ， zai jian ！]

english: I don't care about some dusty building.
translation: 我不在乎一些布满灰尘的建筑。 [wo bu zai hu yi xie bu man hui chen de jian zhu 。]

english: It's doomed. DOOMED!
translation: 这是注定的。注定了！ [zhe shi zhu ding de 。 zhu ding le ！]

english: Thanks for the help again. Feel free to browse the room next door!
translation: 再次感谢您的帮助。有空去隔壁房间看看吧！ [zai ci gan xie nin de bang zhu 。 you kong qu ge bi fang jian kan kan ba ！]

english: Hello there, I have this master clue he...
translation: 你好，我有这个主要线索，他... [ni hao ， wo you zhe ge zhu yao xian suo ， ta ...]

english: Stop! I can't help you unless you help me out first.
translation: 停止！除非你先帮我，否则我帮不了你。 [ting zhi ！ chu fei ni xian bang wo ， fou ze wo bang bu liao ni 。]

english: Okay then, moving on...
translation: 好吧，那么，继续... [hao ba ， na me ， ji xu ...]

english: Hi Jorral, I have come to ask you to help with something.
translation: 你好，Jorral，我来找你帮忙有件事。 [ni hao ，Jorral， wo lai zhao ni bang mang you jian shi 。]

english: What can I do for you [Player name]?
translation: 我能为您[玩家姓名]做什么？ [wo neng wei nin [ wan jia xing ming ] zuo shen me ？]

english: Ah! Remember that enchanted key you had to use previously?
translation: 啊!还记得您之前必须使用的那把魔法钥匙吗？ [a ! hai ji de nin zhi qian bi xu shi yong de na ba mo fa yao shi ma ？]

english: Yes, I do.
translation: 是的，我愿意。 [shi de ， wo yuan yi 。]

english: Well this should function much the same, the deeper magic of the key itself is stored within this strange device.
translation: 嗯，这应该功能大致相同，钥匙本身的更深层次的魔力存储在这个奇怪的设备中。 [n ， zhe ying gai gong neng da zhi xiang tong ， yao shi ben shen de geng shen ceng ci de mo li cun chu zai zhe ge qi guai de she bei zhong 。]

english: You should feel it, and it will guide you to where you need to go.
translation: 你应该感觉到它，它会引导你到达你需要去的地方。 [ni ying gai gan jue dao ta ， ta hui yin dao ni dao da ni xu yao qu de di fang 。]

english: You should make some room for it before I can give you it.
translation: 在我给你之前，你应该先腾出一些空间。 [zai wo gei ni zhi qian ， ni ying gai xian teng chu yi xie kong jian 。]

english: Be careful with it, the raw magic can damage you unexpectedly when you feel it.
translation: 小心一点，当你感受到原始魔法时，它可能会对你造成意想不到的伤害。 [xiao xin yi dian ， dang ni gan shou dao yuan shi mo fa shi ， ta ke neng hui dui ni zao cheng yi xiang bu dao de shang hai 。]

english: No, I don't.
translation: 不，我不。 [bu ， wo bu 。]

english: Ah, well the enchanted key can lead you to treasure. The magical nature of the key heats it up or cools it down, depending on your proximity to the treasure.
translation: 啊，那把魔法钥匙可以带你找到宝藏。钥匙的神奇性质会使其升温或降温，具体取决于您与宝藏的距离。 [a ， na ba mo fa yao shi ke yi dai ni zhao dao bao zang 。 yao shi de shen qi xing zhi hui shi qi sheng wen huo jiang wen ， ju ti qu jue yu nin yu bao zang de ju li 。]

english: Hey Jorral, I have one of those clue scrolls again, do you have any advice?
translation: 嘿，乔拉尔，我又拿到了其中一张线索卷轴，你有什么建议吗？ [hei ， qiao la er ， wo you na dao le qi zhong yi zhang xian suo juan zhou ， ni you shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: That strange device will guide you in the same way the key did. Feel it, but be careful as it is very powerful. Good luck.
translation: 这个奇怪的装置会像钥匙一样引导你。感受它，但要小心，因为它非常强大。祝你好运。 [zhe ge qi guai de zhuang zhi hui xiang yao shi yi yang yin dao ni 。 gan shou ta ， dan yao xiao xin ， yin wei ta fei chang qiang da 。 zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Tell me more.
translation: 告诉我更多。 [gao su wo geng duo 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: A trader in Ardougne
translation: 阿尔杜涅的一名商人 [a er du nie de yi ming shang ren]

english: A ghost in Port Phasmatys
translation: 法斯马蒂斯港的鬼魂 [fa si ma di si gang de gui hun]

english: A warrior in Rellekka
translation: 雷莱卡的战士 [lei lai ka de zhan shi]

english: What's the story so far?
translation: 到目前为止有什么故事吗？ [dao mu qian wei zhi you shen me gu shi ma ？]

english: What do I need to do now?
translation: 我现在需要做什么？ [wo xian zai xu yao zuo shen me ？]

english: Got to go, bye!
translation: 该走了，再见！ [gai zou le ， zai jian ！]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]
