translation: 我不在乎一些布满灰尘的建筑 [wo bu zai hu yi xie bu man hui chen de jian zhu]

english: Yes, I do.
translation: 是的，我愿意。 [shi de ， wo yuan yi 。]

english: No, I don't.
translation: 不，我不。 [bu ， wo bu 。]

english: Do you want to trade?
translation: 你想交易吗？ [ni xiang jiao yi ma ？]

english: What are you selling?
translation: 你卖什么？ [ni mai shen me ？]

english: The finest smiths from all over Gielinor come here to work, and I buy the fruit of their craft. Armour made from the higher metals!
translation: 来自吉林诺各地最优秀的铁匠来这里工作，我购买他们的手艺成果。高级金属打造的铠甲！ [lai zi ji lin nuo ge di zui you xiu de tie jiang lai zhe li gong zuo ， wo gou mai ta men de shou yi cheng guo 。 gao ji jin shu da zao de kai jia ！]

english: Let's have a look then.
translation: 那我们就来看看吧。 [na wo men jiu lai kan kan ba 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: You just don't appreciate the beauty of fine metalwork.
translation: 你只是不欣赏精美金属制品的美感。 [ni zhi shi bu xin shang jing mei jin shu zhi pin de mei gan 。]

english: Only the top smiths are allowed in there!
translation: 只有顶级的铁匠才可以进去！ [zhi you ding ji de tie jiang cai ke yi jin qu ！]

english: What are you selling?
translation: 你卖什么？ [ni mai shen me ？]

english: Let's have a look then.
translation: 那我们就来看看吧。 [na wo men jiu lai kan kan ba 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 我要是像你那么丑我就不敢在大庭广众之下露脸了！ [wo yao shi xiang ni na me chou wo jiu bu gan zai da ting guang zhong zhi xia lou lian le ！]

english: Out of my way, punk.
translation: 别挡我的路，朋克。 [bie dang wo de lu ， peng ke 。]

english: Hmm... you smell strange...
translation: 嗯……你闻起来很奇怪…… [n …… ni wen qi lai hen qi guai ……]

english: Strange how?
translation: 奇怪怎么办？ [qi guai zen me ban ？]

english: Like a human!
translation: 像人一样！ [xiang ren yi yang ！]

english: Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 哦！呃……我刚吃了一个就是为什么！ [o ！ e …… wo gang chi le yi ge jiu shi wei shen me ！]

english: Leave me alone.
translation: 请别打扰我。 [qing bie da rao wo 。]

english: Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 如果你珍惜你的生命，就不要再跟我说话了！ [ru guo ni zhen xi ni de sheng ming ， jiu bu yao zai gen wo shuo hua le ！]

english: Get lost!
translation: 迷路！ [mi lu ！]

english: I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 我没有什么可以给你，所以让我一个人呆着吧，托钵僧。 [wo mei you shen me ke yi gei ni ， suo yi rang wo yi ge ren dai zhe ba ， tuo bo seng 。]

english: Have you no manners?
translation: 你没有礼貌吗？ [ni mei you li mao ma ？]

english: I don't have time for this right now.
translation: 我现在没有时间做这个。 [wo xian zai mei you shi jian zuo zhe ge 。]

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 我没有兴趣和像你这样的可怜虫说话。 [wo mei you xing qu he xiang ni zhe yang de ke lian chong shuo hua 。]

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
translation: 我打赌你有一双很棒的爪子。 [wo da du ni you yi shuang hen bang de zhua zi 。]

english: A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 非常痛苦的一天，总的来说……趁它持续的时候好好享受吧。 [fei chang tong ku de yi tian ， zong de lai shuo …… chen ta chi xu de shi hou hao hao xiang shou ba 。]

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: 如果你抓到任何人，答应我你会分享。 [ru guo ni zhua dao ren he ren ， da ying wo ni hui fen xiang 。]

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 我以前没在这儿闻过你的味道…… [wo yi qian mei zai zhe er wen guo ni de wei dao ……]

english: You smell familiar...
translation: 你闻起来很熟悉... [ni wen qi lai hen shu xi ...]

english: Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 看到这附近有人类吗？我饿了。 [kan dao zhe fu jin you ren lei ma ？ wo e le 。]

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 在我看来，你就像一个对血液有健康品味的人。 [zai wo kan lai ， ni jiu xiang yi ge dui xue ye you jian kang pin wei de ren 。]

english: Good day to you, my friend.
translation: 祝你美好的一天，我的朋友。 [zhu ni mei hao de yi tian ， wo de peng you 。]

english: Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
translation: 想去城堡吃点小吃吗？ [xiang qu cheng bao chi dian xiao chi ma ？]

english: Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: 等一下，我的牙齿里有一点东西卡住了…… [deng yi xia ， wo de ya chi li you yi dian dong xi ka zhu le ……]

english: I see you managed to escape from those monsters intact!
translation: 我看你竟然毫发无伤地从那些怪物的手中逃脱了！ [wo kan ni jing ran hao fa wu shang di cong na xie guai wu de shou zhong tao tuo le ！]

english: It seems I was not as injured as I thought I was after all! I must thank you again for all of your help! Now, about that casket you found on that monster's corpse...
translation: 看来我的伤毕竟没有想象中的那么严重！我必须再次感谢你们的帮助！现在，关于你在怪物尸体上发现的那个棺材…… [kan lai wo de shang bi jing mei you xiang xiang zhong de na me yan zhong ！ wo bi xu zai ci gan xie ni men de bang zhu ！ xian zai ， guan yu ni zai guai wu shi ti shang fa xian de na ge guan cai ……]

english: I have it here. You said you might be able to tell me something about it...
translation: 我这里有。你说你也许可以告诉我一些事情...... [wo zhe li you 。 ni shuo ni ye xu ke yi gao su wo yi xie shi qing ......]

english: I can indeed! Here, let me have a closer look... Yes! There is something written on it!
translation: 我确实可以！来，让我仔细看看……是的！上面写着什么东西！ [wo que shi ke yi ！ lai ， rang wo zi xi kan kan …… shi de ！ shang mian xie zhe shen me dong xi ！]

english: It is very faint, however... Can you read it?
translation: 然而，它非常微弱……你能读懂吗？ [ran er ， ta fei chang wei ruo …… ni neng du dong ma ？]

english: I think it says... Saradomin...
translation: 我认为它说的是……萨拉多明…… [wo ren wei ta shuo de shi …… sa la duo ming ……]

english: Are you sure? I mean, are you REALLY sure? Maybe you'd better look again...
translation: 你确定吗？我的意思是，你真的确定吗？也许你最好再看看... [ni que ding ma ？ wo de yi si shi ， ni zhen di que ding ma ？ ye xu ni zui hao zai kan kan ...]

english: Nope, it definitely says Saradomin.
translation: 不，上面肯定写着萨拉多明。 [bu ， shang mian ken ding xie zhe sa la duo ming 。]

english: I think you're right! Hand it here, and let's see what's inside!
translation: 我认为你是对的！把它递过来，让我们看看里面有什么！ [wo ren wei ni shi dui de ！ ba ta di guo lai ， rang wo men kan kan li mian you shen me ！]

english: Wow! It's a Holy Book of Saradomin! I thought these things had all vanished! Well, it's all yours, I hope you appreciate it.
translation: 哇！这是萨拉多明的圣书！我以为这些东西都消失了！好吧，这一切都是你的，希望你能珍惜。 [wa ！ zhe shi sa la duo ming de sheng shu ！ wo yi wei zhe xie dong xi dou xiao shi le ！ hao ba ， zhe yi qie dou shi ni de ， xi wang ni neng zhen xi 。]

english: Nope, it definitely says Zamorak.
translation: 不，上面肯定写着萨莫拉克。 [bu ， shang mian ken ding xie zhe sa mo la ke 。]

english: Wow! It's an Unholy Book of Zamorak! I thought these things had all vanished! Well, it's all yours, I hope you appreciate it.
translation: 哇！这是萨莫拉克的邪恶之书！我以为这些东西都消失了！好吧，这一切都是你的，希望你能珍惜。 [wa ！ zhe shi sa mo la ke de xie e zhi shu ！ wo yi wei zhe xie dong xi dou xiao shi le ！ hao ba ， zhe yi qie dou shi ni de ， xi wang ni neng zhen xi 。]

english: Nope, it definitely says Guthix.
translation: 不，上面肯定写着 Guthix。 [bu ， shang mian ken ding xie zhe  Guthix。]

english: Wow! It's Guthix's Book of Balance! I thought these things had all vanished! Well, it's all yours, I hope you appreciate it.
translation: 哇！这是古西克斯的平衡之书！我以为这些东西都消失了！好吧，这一切都是你的，希望你能珍惜。 [wa ！ zhe shi gu xi ke si de ping heng zhi shu ！ wo yi wei zhe xie dong xi dou xiao shi le ！ hao ba ， zhe yi qie dou shi ni de ， xi wang ni neng zhen xi 。]

english: I wish it were one of the other gods. I'd prefer my reward to be aligned to a different god, not Saradomin, Zamorak or Guthix.
translation: 我希望它是其他神之一。我更希望我的奖励与不同的神保持一致，而不是萨拉多明、萨莫拉克或古西克斯。 [wo xi wang ta shi qi ta shen zhi yi 。 wo geng xi wang wo de jiang li yu bu tong de shen bao chi yi zhi ， er bu shi sa la duo ming 、 sa mo la ke huo gu xi ke si 。]

english: The sea's always washing up interesting stuff around my lighthouse. Perhaps I'll find something more suitable for you in future.
translation: 大海总是冲刷我灯塔周围有趣的东西。也许以后我会找到更适合你的东西。 [da hai zong shi chong shua wo deng ta zhou wei you qu de dong xi 。 ye xu yi hou wo hui zhao dao geng shi he ni de dong xi 。]

english: For now, this casket definitely says Saradomin, Zamorak or Guthix. Which do you think it is?
translation: 目前，这个棺材上肯定写着萨拉多明（Saradomin）、萨莫拉克（Zamorak）或古蒂克斯（Guthix）。你认为是哪一个？ [mu qian ， zhe ge guan cai shang ken ding xie zhe sa la duo ming （Saradomin）、 sa mo la ke （Zamorak） huo gu di ke si （Guthix）。 ni ren wei shi na yi ge ？]

english: I think it says... Zamorak...
translation: 我认为它说的是……萨莫拉克…… [wo ren wei ta shuo de shi …… sa mo la ke ……]

english: I think it says... Guthix...
translation: 我认为它说的是……古蒂克斯…… [wo ren wei ta shuo de shi …… gu di ke si ……]

english: Guthix
translation: 古蒂克斯 [gu di ke si]

english: I never had any casket from that monster...?
translation: 我从来没有得到过那个怪物的棺材……？ [wo cong lai mei you de dao guo na ge guai wu de guan cai ……？]

english: Why, of course you did! You dropped it and I picked it up! Now, free up some inventory space so we can see what's inside it.
translation: 为什么，你当然做到了！你把它掉了，我把它捡起来！现在，释放一些库存空间，以便我们可以看到里面有什么。 [wei shen me ， ni dang ran zuo dao le ！ ni ba ta diao le ， wo ba ta jian qi lai ！ xian zai ， shi fang yi xie ku cun kong jian ， yi bian wo men ke yi kan dao li mian you shen me 。]

english: Why, of course you did! You dropped it and I picked it up! I have it right here!
translation: 为什么，你当然做到了！你把它掉了，我把它捡起来！我这里就有！ [wei shen me ， ni dang ran zuo dao le ！ ni ba ta diao le ， wo ba ta jian qi lai ！ wo zhe li jiu you ！]

english: Now let's have a look at it... There is some writing on it, but it is very faint... Can you make it out?
translation: 现在我们看一下……上面有一些字，但是很淡……你看得出来吗？ [xian zai wo men kan yi xia …… shang mian you yi xie zi ， dan shi hen dan …… ni kan de chu lai ma ？]

english: I have it stored safely.
translation: 我已将其安全存放。 [wo yi jiang qi an quan cun fang 。]

english: Well, bring it here and let's take a look at it!
translation: 好啦，拿过来我们一起看看吧！ [hao la ， na guo lai wo men yi qi kan kan ba ！]

english: Ah yes, I wanted to talk to you about the casket you found on that monster's corpse...
translation: 啊，是的，我想和你谈谈你在怪物尸体上发现的棺材…… [a ， shi de ， wo xiang he ni tan tan ni zai guai wu shi ti shang fa xian de guan cai ……]

english: Hello again, adventurer. What brings you this way?
translation: 你好，冒险家。是什么让你走上这条路？ [ni hao ， mao xian jia 。 shi shen me rang ni zou shang zhe tiao lu ？]

english: Can I see your wares?
translation: 我可以看看你们的商品吗？ [wo ke yi kan kan ni men de shang pin ma ？]

english: Sure thing! I think you'll find my prices are remarkable!
translation: 当然可以！我想您会发现我的价格非常优惠！ [dang ran ke yi ！ wo xiang nin hui fa xian wo de jia ge fei chang you hui ！]

english: Have you found any more prayerbooks?
translation: 你找到更多的祈祷书了吗？ [ni zhao dao geng duo de qi dao shu le ma ？]

english: Have you found any more prayerbooks?
translation: 你找到更多的祈祷书了吗？ [ni zhao dao geng duo de qi dao shu le ma ？]

english: It's amazing how things like that keep washing up on the shore in caskets. Take a look at what I've got...
translation: 令人惊奇的是，像这样的东西总是装在棺材里被冲上岸。看看我有什么... [ling ren jing qi de shi ， xiang zhe yang de dong xi zong shi zhuang zai guan cai li bei chong shang an 。 kan kan wo you shen me ...]

english: Nothing, really. Good bye.
translation: 没什么，真的。再见。 [mei shen me ， zhen de 。 zai jian 。]

english: Saradomin
translation: 萨拉多明 [sa la duo ming]

english: Zamorak
translation: 萨莫拉克 [sa mo la ke]

english: I wish it were one of the other gods.
translation: 我希望它是其他神之一。 [wo xi wang ta shi qi ta shen zhi yi 。]

english: Can I see your wares?
translation: 我可以看看你们的商品吗？ [wo ke yi kan kan ni men de shang pin ma ？]

english: Nothing, really. Good bye.
translation: 没什么，真的。再见。 [mei shen me ， zhen de 。 zai jian 。]

english: Hello there. What do you need?
translation: 你好呀。你需要什么？ [ni hao ya 。 ni xu yao shen me ？]

english: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这附近做什么？ [ni zai zhe fu jin zuo shen me ？]

english: I mostly look after the lab equipment and make sure things run as they should.
translation: 我主要负责管理实验室设备并确保一切正常运行。 [wo zhu yao fu ze guan li shi yan shi she bei bing que bao yi qie zheng chang yun xing 。]

english: These days, I'm not much into the production side of things... All that moving up and down, pulling levers, carrying vials... These old bones ain't what they used to be.
translation: 这些天，我对生产方面的事情不太感兴趣……所有这些上下移动、拉动杠杆、搬运小瓶……这些老骨头已经不再是以前的样子了。 [zhe xie tian ， wo dui sheng chan fang mian de shi qing bu tai gan xing qu …… suo you zhe xie shang xia yi dong 、 la dong gang gan 、 ban yun xiao ping …… zhe xie lao gu tou yi jing bu zai shi yi qian de yang zi le 。]

english: Thanks! I'd better be going now.
translation: 谢谢！我最好现在就走。 [xie xie ！ wo zui hao xian zai jiu zou 。]

english: You alchemists sure wear a lot of safety gear.
translation: 你们炼金术士肯定穿戴很多安全装备。 [ni men lian jin shu shi ken ding chuan dai hen duo an quan zhuang bei 。]

english: Of course! Some of the mixtures down here can get pretty nasty in their raw form. Safety first!
translation: 当然！这里的一些混合物在其原始形式下可能会变得非常令人讨厌。安全第一！ [dang ran ！ zhe li de yi xie hun he wu zai qi yuan shi xing shi xia ke neng hui bian de fei chang ling ren tao yan 。 an quan di yi ！]

english: Although between you and me... I'm not sure if anything this lab produces can be considered truly safe for human consumption.
translation: 尽管在你我之间……我不确定这个实验室生产的任何东西是否可以被认为是真正安全的供人类食用。 [jin guan zai ni wo zhi jian …… wo bu que ding zhe ge shi yan shi sheng chan de ren he dong xi shi fou ke yi bei ren wei shi zhen zheng an quan de gong ren lei shi yong 。]

english: Yikes! I guess I'll not be trying anything then!
translation: 哎呀！我想那时我不会尝试任何事情！ [ai ya ！ wo xiang na shi wo bu hui chang shi ren he shi qing ！]

english: Nothing. I'll be going now.
translation: 没有什么。我现在就走。 [mei you shen me 。 wo xian zai jiu zou 。]

english: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这附近做什么？ [ni zai zhe fu jin zuo shen me ？]

english: Thanks! I'd better be going now.
translation: 谢谢！我最好现在就走。 [xie xie ！ wo zui hao xian zai jiu zou 。]

english: You alchemists sure wear a lot of safety gear.
translation: 你们炼金术士肯定穿戴很多安全装备。 [ni men lian jin shu shi ken ding chuan dai hen duo an quan zhuang bei 。]

english: Nothing. I'll be going now.
translation: 没有什么。我现在就走。 [mei you shen me 。 wo xian zai jiu zou 。]

english: You'll need a weapon to try and attack this beast.
translation: 你需要一件武器来尝试攻击这只野兽。 [ni xu yao yi jian wu qi lai chang shi gong ji zhe zhi ye shou 。]

english: The Jubbly Bird is too quick for your melee weapon.
translation: 对于你的近战武器来说，朱比鸟的速度太快了。 [dui yu ni de jin zhan wu qi lai shuo ， zhu bi niao de su du tai kuai le 。]

english: Magic simply won't affect this beast!
translation: 魔法根本无法影响这头野兽！ [mo fa gen ben wu fa ying xiang zhe tou ye shou ！]

english: Your ranged weapon isn't powerful enough to hurt the Jubbly bird.
translation: 你的远程武器威力不足以伤害朱比鸟。 [ni de yuan cheng wu qi wei li bu zu yi shang hai zhu bi niao 。]

english: Sqwark!
translation: 嘎嘎！ [ga ga ！]

english: Screech!
translation: 尖叫！ [jian jiao ！]

english: !!Croak!!
translation: ！！发牢骚！！ [！！ fa lao sao ！！]

english: Gobble!
translation: 狼吞虎咽！ [lang tun hu yan ！]

english: Rawk!
translation: 拉克！ [la ke ！]

english: Dragon swords! Here, Dragon swords! Straight from Frenaskrae!
translation: 龙剑！来了，龙剑！直接来自 Frenaskrae！ [long jian ！ lai le ， long jian ！ zhi jie lai zi  Frenaskrae！]

english: Yes please!
translation: 是的，请！ [shi de ， qing ！]

english: No thanks, I'm just browsing.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我只是浏览一下。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo zhi shi liu lan yi xia 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks, I'm just browsing.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我只是浏览一下。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo zhi shi liu lan yi xia 。]

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm blending in. Scopin' out the place.
translation: 我正在融入其中。观察这个地方。 [wo zheng zai rong ru qi zhong 。 guan cha zhe ge di fang 。]

english: Are you preparing for a heist? You're only a kid.
translation: 你准备好抢劫了吗？你只是个孩子。 [ni zhun bei hao qiang jie le ma ？ ni zhi shi ge hai zi 。]

english: Let's just say there are some wealthy people about, with full pockets.
translation: 假设有一些有钱人，口袋里装满了钱。 [jia she you yi xie you qian ren ， kou dai li zhuang man le qian 。]

english: Any tips? I'm not having much luck myself.
translation: 有什么建议吗？我自己的运气并不好。 [you shen me jian yi ma ？ wo zi ji de yun qi bing bu hao 。]

english: I'm quite sneaky. Every now and then I'll get their attention so their pockets aren't being so carefully watched.
translation: 我真是太狡猾了。我会时不时地引起他们的注意，这样他们的口袋就不会受到如此仔细的监视。 [wo zhen shi tai jiao hua le 。 wo hui shi bu shi di yin qi ta men de zhu yi ， zhe yang ta men de kou dai jiu bu hui shou dao ru ci zi xi de jian shi 。]

english: That is sneaky. I'll keep an eye out for your... distractions.
translation: 那是偷偷摸摸的。我会留意你的……干扰因素。 [na shi tou tou mo mo de 。 wo hui liu yi ni de …… gan rao yin su 。]

english: Now leave me be. I'm already distracting!
translation: 现在别管我了。我已经分散注意力了！ [xian zai bie guan wo le 。 wo yi jing fen san zhu yi li le ！]

english: Oh dear! Oh dear! I don't have time to chat!
translation: 哦亲爱的！哦亲爱的！我没时间聊天！ [o qin ai de ！ o qin ai de ！ wo mei shi jian liao tian ！]

english: Please leave my husband alone. He's very sick, and I don't want anyone bothering him.
translation: 请放过我丈夫吧。他病得很重，我不想让任何人打扰他。 [qing fang guo wo zhang fu ba 。 ta bing de hen zhong ， wo bu xiang rang ren he ren da rao ta 。]

english: I'm sorry to hear that. Is there anything I can do?
translation: 听到这个消息我很遗憾。有什么我可以做的吗？ [ting dao zhe ge xiao xi wo hen yi han 。 you shen me wo ke yi zuo de ma ？]

english: Thank you, but I just want him to see a priest.
translation: 谢谢你，但我只想让他见见牧师。 [xie xie ni ， dan wo zhi xiang rang ta jian jian mu shi 。]

english: A priest? Hmmm...
translation: 牧师？嗯... [mu shi ？ n ...]

english: Romeo, Romeo, wherefore art thou Romeo? Bold adventurer, have you seen Romeo on your travels? Skinny guy, a bit wishy washy, head full of poetry.
translation: 罗密欧，罗密欧，你为什么是罗密欧？勇敢的冒险家，你在旅途中见过罗密欧吗？瘦小的家伙，有点软弱无力，脑子里充满了诗意。 [luo mi ou ， luo mi ou ， ni wei shen me shi luo mi ou ？ yong gan de mao xian jia ， ni zai lv tu zhong jian guo luo mi ou ma ？ shou xiao de jia huo ， you dian ruan ruo wu li ， nao zi li chong man le shi yi 。]

english: Yes I've met him. He seemed a bit depressed.
translation: 是的，我见过他。他看上去有点郁闷。 [shi de ， wo jian guo ta 。 ta kan shang qu you dian yu men 。]

english: Yes, that sounds like Romeo. I'd be very grateful if you could deliver a message to him?
translation: 是的，这听起来像罗密欧。如果你能帮我转个口信给他，我将不胜感激。 [shi de ， zhe ting qi lai xiang luo mi ou 。 ru guo ni neng bang wo zhuan ge kou xin gei ta ， wo jiang bu sheng gan ji 。]

english: Certainly, I'll do so straight away.
translation: 当然，我会立即这样做。 [dang ran ， wo hui li ji zhe yang zuo 。]

english: Many thanks! Oh, I'm so very grateful. You may be our only hope.
translation: 非常感谢！哦，我真是太感激了。你可能是我们唯一的希望。 [fei chang gan xie ！ o ， wo zhen shi tai gan ji le 。 ni ke neng shi wo men wei yi de xi wang 。]

english: No, he was a little too weird for me.
translation: 不，他对我来说有点太奇怪了。 [bu ， ta dui wo lai shuo you dian tai qi guai le 。]

english: Oh dear, that will be the ruin of our love. Well, I will just stay here and worry. You unromantic soul.
translation: 噢，亲爱的，那将毁掉我们的爱情。好吧，我就留在这里担心吧。你这个不浪漫的灵魂。 [o ， qin ai de ， na jiang hui diao wo men de ai qing 。 hao ba ， wo jiu liu zai zhe li dan xin ba 。 ni zhe ge bu lang man de ling hun 。]

english: No, I think I'd have remembered if I'd met him.
translation: 不，我想如果我遇见他我就会记得。 [bu ， wo xiang ru guo wo yu jian ta wo jiu hui ji de 。]

english: Oh, well that's a shame, I was hoping that you might deliver a message to him for me.
translation: 噢，真可惜，我本来希望你能帮我给他捎个口信。 [o ， zhen ke xi ， wo ben lai xi wang ni neng bang wo gei ta shao ge kou xin 。]

english: Sorry, but I don't even know what he looks like or where he is?
translation: 抱歉，但我什至不知道他长什么样，也不知道他在哪里？ [bao qian ， dan wo shen zhi bu zhi dao ta zhang shen me yang ， ye bu zhi dao ta zai na li ？]

english: Oh, he's so lovely...in his own soppy and confused way. You should spot him easily! He's usually fending off the advances of the Varrockian market women. Are you sure I couldn't persuade you to deliver my itsy bitsty
translation: 哦，他真是太可爱了……以他自己的悲伤和困惑的方式。你应该很容易发现他！他通常会抵御瓦罗克市场女性的求爱。你确定我不能说服你交付我的小东西吗 [o ， ta zhen shi tai ke ai le …… yi ta zi ji de bei shang he kun huo de fang shi 。 ni ying gai hen rong yi fa xian ta ！ ta tong chang hui di yu wa luo ke shi chang nv xing de qiu ai 。 ni que ding wo bu neng shuo fu ni jiao fu wo de xiao dong xi ma]

english: widdle message to my Romeo?
translation: 给我的罗密欧发什么信息？ [gei wo de luo mi ou fa shen me xin xi ？]

english: No, sorry, I have better things to do.
translation: 不，抱歉，我还有更重要的事情要做。 [bu ， bao qian ， wo hai you geng zhong yao de shi qing yao zuo 。]

english: Then, I will not keep you from them. Goodbye.
translation: 那么，我不会阻止你远离他们。再见。 [na me ， wo bu hui zu zhi ni yuan li ta men 。 zai jian 。]

english: I guess I could look for him for you.
translation: 我想我可以帮你找他。 [wo xiang wo ke yi bang ni zhao ta 。]

english: Oh, that would be so wonderful of you! I'd be most grateful if you could please deliver a message to him?
translation: 哦，你要是那样那就太好了！如果您能帮我转个口信给他，我将不胜感激。 [o ， ni yao shi na yang na jiu tai hao le ！ ru guo nin neng bang wo zhuan ge kou xin gei ta ， wo jiang bu sheng gan ji 。]

english: I think you could do better than Romeo!
translation: 我认为你可以比罗密欧做得更好！ [wo ren wei ni ke yi bi luo mi ou zuo de geng hao ！]

english: He has his good points, he's not obsessed with fighting, magic and ranging at least.
translation: 他有他的优点，至少他不沉迷于战斗、魔法和射程。 [ta you ta de you dian ， zhi shao ta bu chen mi yu zhan dou 、 mo fa he she cheng 。]

english: I sat in that cold crypt for ages waiting for Romeo.
translation: 我在那个寒冷的地窖里坐了很长时间等待罗密欧。 [wo zai na ge han leng de di jiao li zuo le hen zhang shi jian deng dai luo mi ou 。]

english: That useless fool never showed up.
translation: 那个无用的傻瓜始终没有出现。 [na ge wu yong de sha gua shi zhong mei you chu xian 。]

english: And all I got was indigestion. I am done with men like him.
translation: 我得到的只是消化不良。我受够了像他这样的男人。 [wo de dao de zhi shi xiao hua bu liang 。 wo shou gou le xiang ta zhe yang de nan ren 。]

english: Now go away before I call my father!
translation: 现在在我打电话给我父亲之前走开！ [xian zai zai wo da dian hua gei wo fu qin zhi qian zou kai ！]

english: Juliet, I come from Romeo. He begs me to tell you that he cares still.
translation: 朱丽叶，我来自罗密欧。他恳求我告诉你他仍然在乎。 [zhu li ye ， wo lai zi luo mi ou 。 ta ken qiu wo gao su ni ta reng ran zai hu 。]

english: Oh how my heart soars to hear this news! Please take this message to him with great haste.
translation: 噢，听到这个消息我的心多么激动啊！请尽快将此消息带给他。 [o ， ting dao zhe ge xiao xi wo de xin duo me ji dong a ！ qing jin kuai jiang ci xiao xi dai gei ta 。]

english: Well, I hope it's good news...he was quite upset when I left him.
translation: 好吧，我希望这是个好消息……当我离开他时，他很沮丧。 [hao ba ， wo xi wang zhe shi ge hao xiao xi …… dang wo li kai ta shi ， ta hen ju sang 。]

english: He's quite often upset...the poor sensitive soul. But I don't think he's going to take this news very well, however, all is not lost.
translation: 他经常心烦意乱……可怜的敏感的灵魂。但我认为他不会很好地接受这个消息，不过，一切还没有结束。 [ta jing chang xin fan yi luan …… ke lian de min gan de ling hun 。 dan wo ren wei ta bu hui hen hao di jie shou zhe ge xiao xi ， bu guo ， yi qie hai mei you jie shu 。]

english: Everything is explained in the letter, would you be so kind and deliver it to him please?
translation: 信中已经解释了一切，请您将信转交给他好吗？ [xin zhong yi jing jie shi le yi qie ， qing nin jiang xin zhuan jiao gei ta hao ma ？]

english: Hello Juliet!
translation: 你好朱丽叶！ [ni hao zhu li ye ！]

english: Hello there...have you delivered the message to Romeo yet? What news do you have from my loved one?
translation: 您好...您已将消息传递给罗密欧了吗？你从我所爱的人那里得到了什么消息？ [nin hao ... nin yi jiang xiao xi chuan di gei luo mi ou le ma ？ ni cong wo suo ai de ren na li de dao le shen me xiao xi ？]

english: Oh, sorry, I've not had chance to deliver it yet!
translation: 哦，抱歉，我还没来得及送呢！ [o ， bao qian ， wo hai mei lai de ji song ne ！]

english: Oh, that's a shame. I've been waiting so patiently to hear some word from him.
translation: 噢，真可惜。我一直耐心地等待着他的消息。 [o ， zhen ke xi 。 wo yi zhi nai xin di deng dai zhe ta de xiao xi 。]

english: Hmmm, that's the thing about messages...they're so easy to misplace...
translation: 嗯，这就是消息的问题……它们很容易放错地方…… [n ， zhe jiu shi xiao xi de wen ti …… ta men hen rong yi fang cuo di fang ……]

english: How could you lose that message? It was incredibly important...and it took me an age to write! I used joined up writing and everything!
translation: 你怎么会丢失这条消息呢？这非常重要……我花了很长时间才写出来！我用了联合写作和一切！ [ni zen me hui diu shi zhe tiao xiao xi ne ？ zhe fei chang zhong yao …… wo hua le hen zhang shi jian cai xie chu lai ！ wo yong le lian he xie zuo he yi qie ！]

english: Please, take this new message to him, and please don't lose it.
translation: 请将此新消息带给他，请不要丢失。 [qing jiang ci xin xiao xi dai gei ta ， qing bu yao diu shi 。]

english: Hi Juliet, I have passed your message on to Romeo..he's scared half out of his wits at the news that your father wants to kill him.
translation: 嗨，朱丽叶，我已将你的信息转达给罗密欧……听到你父亲想要杀了他的消息，他吓得魂飞魄散。 [hai ， zhu li ye ， wo yi jiang ni de xin xi zhuan da gei luo mi ou …… ting dao ni fu qin xiang yao sha le ta de xiao xi ， ta xia de hun fei po san 。]

english: Yes, unfortunately my father is quite the hunter, you may have seen some the animal head trophies on the wall. And it would be so awful to see Romeo's head up there with them!
translation: 是的，不幸的是我的父亲是个猎人，你可能见过墙上的一些兽头战利品。如果看到罗密欧的头和他们在一起，那就太可怕了！ [shi de ， bu xing de shi wo de fu qin shi ge lie ren ， ni ke neng jian guo qiang shang de yi xie shou tou zhan li pin 。 ru guo kan dao luo mi ou de tou he ta men zai yi qi ， na jiu tai ke pa le ！]

english: I know what you mean...
translation: 我知道你的意思... [wo zhi dao ni de yi si ...]

english: ...his hair colour will clash terribly with the rest of the decoration.
translation: ...他的头发颜色会与其他装饰严重冲突。 [... ta de tou fa yan se hui yu qi ta zhuang shi yan zhong chong tu 。]

english: That's not what I was suggesting at all...
translation: 我根本不是这么建议的…… [wo gen ben bu shi zhe me jian yi de ……]

english: I know, I know...I was just kidding.
translation: 我知道，我知道……我只是开玩笑。 [wo zhi dao ， wo zhi dao …… wo zhi shi kai wan xiao 。]

english: Anyway, don't worry because I'm on the case. I'm going to get some help from Father Lawrence.
translation: 无论如何，别担心，因为我正在处理这个案子。我要从劳伦斯神父那里得到一些帮助。 [wu lun ru he ， bie dan xin ， yin wei wo zheng zai chu li zhe ge an zi 。 wo yao cong lao lun si shen fu na li de dao yi xie bang zhu 。]

english: Oh yes, I'm sure that Father Lawrence will come up with a solution. I hope you find him soon.
translation: 哦，是的，我确信劳伦斯神父会想出一个解决办法。我希望你尽快找到他。 [o ， shi de ， wo que xin lao lun si shen fu hui xiang chu yi ge jie jue ban fa 。 wo xi wang ni jin kuai zhao dao ta 。]

english: Hi Juliet!
translation: 嗨朱丽叶！ [hai zhu li ye ！]

english: Hi [player name], how close am I to being with my true love Romeo?
translation: 嗨[玩家姓名]，我离我的真爱罗密欧有多远？ [hai [ wan jia xing ming ]， wo li wo de zhen ai luo mi ou you duo yuan ？]

english: Sorry, I still have to get a special potion for you.
translation: 抱歉，我还得给你找一种特殊的药剂。 [bao qian ， wo hai de gei ni zhao yi zhong te shu de yao ji 。]

english: Oh, I hope it isn't a love potion because you would be wasting your time. My love for Romeo grows stronger every minute...
translation: 哦，我希望这不是爱情药水，因为你会浪费时间。我对罗密欧的爱每分钟都在加深…… [o ， wo xi wang zhe bu shi ai qing yao shui ， yin wei ni hui lang fei shi jian 。 wo dui luo mi ou de ai mei fen zhong dou zai jia shen ……]

english: That must be because you're not with him...
translation: 那一定是因为你不在他身边... [na yi ding shi yin wei ni bu zai ta shen bian ...]

english: Oh no! I long to be close to my true love Romeo!
translation: 哦不！我渴望靠近我的真爱罗密欧！ [o bu ！ wo ke wang kao jin wo de zhen ai luo mi ou ！]

english: Well, ok then...I'll set about getting this potion as quickly as I can!
translation: 好吧，那么……我会尽快去获取这瓶药剂！ [hao ba ， na me …… wo hui jin kuai qu huo qu zhe ping yao ji ！]

english: Fair luck to you, the end is close.
translation: 祝你好运，结局已经接近了。 [zhu ni hao yun ， jie ju yi jing jie jin le 。]

english: Hi Juliet! I have an interesting proposition for you...suggested by Father Lawrence. It may be the only way you'll be able to escape from this house and be with Romeo.
translation: 嗨朱丽叶！我有一个有趣的建议给你……由劳伦斯神父建议。这可能是你逃离这座房子并与罗密欧在一起的唯一方法。 [hai zhu li ye ！ wo you yi ge you qu de jian yi gei ni …… you lao lun si shen fu jian yi 。 zhe ke neng shi ni tao li zhe zuo fang zi bing yu luo mi ou zai yi qi de wei yi fang fa 。]

english: Go on....
I have a Cadava potion here, suggested by Father Lawrence. If you drink it, it will make you appear dead!
translation: 我这里有劳伦斯神父建议的卡达瓦药水。如果你喝了它，你就会像死了一样！ [wo zhe li you lao lun si shen fu jian yi de ka da wa yao shui 。 ru guo ni he le ta ， ni jiu hui xiang si le yi yang ！]

english: Yes...
translation: 是的... [shi de ...]

english: And when you appear dead...your still and lifeless corpse will be removed to the crypt!
translation: 当你出现死亡时......你毫无生气的尸体将被移至地窖！ [dang ni chu xian si wang shi ...... ni hao wu sheng qi de shi ti jiang bei yi zhi di jiao ！]

english: Oooooh, a cold dark creepy crypt...
translation: 哦哦，一个寒冷、黑暗、令人毛骨悚然的地窖…… [o o ， yi ge han leng 、 hei an 、 ling ren mao gu song ran de di jiao ……]

english: ...sounds just peachy!
translation: ...听起来很桃子！ [... ting qi lai hen tao zi ！]

english: Then...Romeo can steal into the crypt and rescue you just as you wake up!
translation: 然后...罗密欧可以潜入地窖并在你醒来时救出你！ [ran hou ... luo mi ou ke yi qian ru di jiao bing zai ni xing lai shi jiu chu ni ！]

english: ...and this is the great idea for getting me out of here?
translation: ……这是让我离开这里的好主意吗？ […… zhe shi rang wo li kai zhe li de hao zhu yi ma ？]

english: To be fair, I can't take all the credit...in fact...it was all Father Lawrence's suggestion...
translation: 公平地说，我不能把所有的功劳都归功于我……事实上……这都是劳伦斯神父的建议…… [gong ping di shuo ， wo bu neng ba suo you de gong lao dou gui gong yu wo …… shi shi shang …… zhe dou shi lao lun si shen fu de jian yi ……]

english: Ok...if this is the best we can do...hand over the potion!
translation: 好吧...如果这是我们能做的最好的事情...交出药剂！ [hao ba ... ru guo zhe shi wo men neng zuo de zui hao de shi qing ... jiao chu yao ji ！]

english: You pass the suspicious potion to Juliet.
translation: 你把可疑的药水交给了朱丽叶。 [ni ba ke yi de yao shui jiao gei le zhu li ye 。]

english: Wonderful! I just hope Romeo can remember to get me from the crypt.
translation: 精彩的！我只希望罗密欧能记得把我从地窖里救出来。 [jing cai de ！ wo zhi xi wang luo mi ou neng ji de ba wo cong di jiao li jiu chu lai 。]

english: Please go to Romeo and make sure he understands. Although I love his gormless, lovelorn soppy ways, he can be a bit dense sometimes and I don't want to wake up in that crypt on my own.
translation: 请去找罗密欧并确保他明白。虽然我喜欢他天真烂漫、失恋的伤感，但他有时会有点笨拙，我不想独自在那个地窖里醒来。 [qing qu zhao luo mi ou bing que bao ta ming bai 。 sui ran wo xi huan ta tian zhen lan man 、 shi lian de shang gan ， dan ta you shi hui you dian ben zhuo ， wo bu xiang du zi zai na ge di jiao li xing lai 。]

english: A cutscene starts
translation: 过场动画开始 [guo chang dong hua kai shi]

english: Oh, here's Phillipa, my cousin...she's in on the plot too!
translation: 哦，这是菲利帕，我的表弟……她也参与了阴谋！ [o ， zhe shi fei li pa ， wo de biao di …… ta ye can yu le yin mou ！]

english: She's going to make it seem even more convincing!
translation: 她会让这一切看起来更有说服力！ [ta hui rang zhe yi qie kan qi lai geng you shuo fu li ！]

english: Yes, I'm quite the actress! Good luck dear cousin!
translation: 是的，我就是演员！祝亲爱的表弟好运！ [shi de ， wo jiu shi yan yuan ！ zhu qin ai de biao di hao yun ！]

english: Right...bottoms up!
translation: 对了……自下而上！ [dui le …… zi xia er shang ！]

english: Urk!
translation: 乌尔克！ [wu er ke ！]

english: Oh no...Juliet has...died!
translation: 哦不……朱丽叶……死了！ [o bu …… zhu li ye …… si le ！]

english: You might be more believable if you're not smiling when you say it...
translation: 如果你说这句话的时候没有微笑，你可能会更可信...... [ru guo ni shuo zhe ju hua de shi hou mei you wei xiao ， ni ke neng hui geng ke xin ......]

english: Oh yeah...you might be right...ok, let's try again.
translation: 哦，是的...你可能是对的...好吧，让我们再试一次。 [o ， shi de ... ni ke neng shi dui de ... hao ba ， rang wo men zai shi yi ci 。]

english: Oh no...Juliet has...died?
translation: 哦不……朱丽叶……死了？ [o bu …… zhu li ye …… si le ？]

english: Perhaps a bit louder, like you're upset...that your cousin has died!
translation: 也许大声一点，就像你很沮丧……你的表弟去世了！ [ye xu da sheng yi dian ， jiu xiang ni hen ju sang …… ni de biao di qu shi le ！]

english: Right...yes...Ok, ok, I think I'm getting my motivation now. Ok, let's try this again!
translation: 是的...是的...好吧，好吧，我想我现在有了动力。好吧，让我们再试一次！ [shi de ... shi de ... hao ba ， hao ba ， wo xiang wo xian zai you le dong li 。 hao ba ， rang wo men zai shi yi ci ！]

english: OH NO...JULIET HAS...DIED?.... Oooooohhhhhh....(sob), (sob).Juliet...my poor dead cousin!
translation: 哦不...朱丽叶已经...死了？...哦哦哦......（抽泣），（抽泣）。朱丽叶...我可怜的死去的表弟！ [o bu ... zhu li ye yi jing ... si le ？... o o o ......（ chou qi ），（ chou qi ）。 zhu li ye ... wo ke lian de si qu de biao di ！]

english: What's all that screaming?
translation: 到底在尖叫什么？ [dao di zai jian jiao shen me ？]

english: Oh no! My poor daughter...what has become of you?
translation: 哦不！我可怜的女儿……你怎么了？ [o bu ！ wo ke lian de nv er …… ni zen me le ？]

english: Poor Juliet...make preparations for her body to be placed in the Crypt...
translation: 可怜的朱丽叶……准备好将她的尸体放入地穴…… [ke lian de zhu li ye …… zhun bei hao jiang ta de shi ti fang ru di xue ……]

english: A cutscene ends
translation: 一段过场动画结束 [yi duan guo chang dong hua jie shu]

english: Oh, I just can't be bothered.
translation: 哦，我就是懒得打扰。 [o ， wo jiu shi lan de da rao 。]

english: What's the matter Juliet?
translation: 朱丽叶怎么了？ [zhu li ye zen me le ？]

english: I've been told I have to throw the birthday party at my place this year, but I don't feel like it, my life is just tragic.
translation: 有人告诉我今年必须在我家举办生日聚会，但我不喜欢，我的生活真是悲惨。 [you ren gao su wo jin nian bi xu zai wo jia ju ban sheng ri ju hui ， dan wo bu xi huan ， wo de sheng huo zhen shi bei can 。]

english: I don't care about this party.
translation: 我不关心这个聚会。 [wo bu guan xin zhe ge ju hui 。]

english: Sometimes I think my life's nothing but a comedy, but I don't let it get me down. Why so glum chum?
translation: 有时我认为我的生活只不过是一部喜剧，但我不会让它让我失望。为什么这么闷闷不乐？ [you shi wo ren wei wo de sheng huo zhi bu guo shi yi bu xi ju ， dan wo bu hui rang ta rang wo shi wang 。 wei shen me zhe me men men bu le ？]

english: Romeo doesn't care for me anymore, the minute he saw Phillipa, he's been all over her. I have no one anymore.
translation: 罗密欧不再关心我了，从他看到菲利帕的那一刻起，他就迷上了她。我已经没有人了。 [luo mi ou bu zai guan xin wo le ， cong ta kan dao fei li pa de na yi ke qi ， ta jiu mi shang le ta 。 wo yi jing mei you ren le 。]

english: Oh come on, it can't be that bad. Is Romeo really worth getting this upset over? He's a bit empty headed if you ask me.
translation: 哦，得了吧，事情不可能那么糟糕。罗密欧真的值得为此烦恼吗？如果你问我的话，他有点头脑空虚。 [o ， de le ba ， shi qing bu ke neng na me zao gao 。 luo mi ou zhen de zhi de wei ci fan nao ma ？ ru guo ni wen wo de hua ， ta you dian tou nao kong xu 。]

english: He was all I had, now the only thing keeping me going is the soft sounds of Gertrude's Cats.
translation: 他是我的一切，现在唯一让我继续前进的就是格特鲁德猫的柔和声音。 [ta shi wo de yi qie ， xian zai wei yi rang wo ji xu qian jin de jiu shi ge te lu de mao de rou he sheng yin 。]

english: I have no-one in my life, I can't be with my love, Romeo. There is nothing for me to wake up to each day, I feel like my life is a repeat of the same day over and over.
translation: 我的生命中没有人，我无法和我的爱人在一起，罗密欧。我每天都没有什么可以醒来的，我觉得我的生活是同一天的一遍又一遍的重复。 [wo de sheng ming zhong mei you ren ， wo wu fa he wo de ai ren zai yi qi ， luo mi ou 。 wo mei tian dou mei you shen me ke yi xing lai de ， wo jue de wo de sheng huo shi tong yi tian de yi bian you yi bian de chong fu 。]

english: You need to get out and enjoy life Juliet, slay some dragons and explore the world.
translation: 你需要出去享受生活，朱丽叶，杀死一些龙并探索世界。 [ni xu yao chu qu xiang shou sheng huo ， zhu li ye ， sha si yi xie long bing tan suo shi jie 。]

english: I wouldn't go that far! I'm just tired of being locked in this house with just my cousin, Phillipa.
translation: 我不会走那么远！我只是厌倦了和我的表弟菲利帕一起被锁在这所房子里。 [wo bu hui zou na me yuan ！ wo zhi shi yan juan le he wo de biao di fei li pa yi qi bei suo zai zhe suo fang zi li 。]

english: The only thing that cheers me up is looking over to Gertrude's house and seeing her kittens playing.
translation: 唯一让我高兴的是看着格特鲁德的房子，看到她的小猫在玩耍。 [wei yi rang wo gao xing de shi kan zhe ge te lu de de fang zi ， kan dao ta de xiao mao zai wan shua 。]

english: Sounds like you need a new friend, would you like me to see if Gertrude will give you one of her kittens?
translation: 听起来你需要一个新朋友，你想让我看看格特鲁德是否会给你她的一只小猫吗？ [ting qi lai ni xu yao yi ge xin peng you ， ni xiang rang wo kan kan ge te lu de shi fou hui gei ni ta de yi zhi xiao mao ma ？]

english: I've asked her before, but we aren't on good standing anymore, ever since I planted lilies in our garden.
translation: 我以前问过她，但自从我在花园里种了百合花后，我们的关系就不再好了。 [wo yi qian wen guo ta ， dan zi cong wo zai hua yuan li zhong le bai he hua hou ， wo men de guan xi jiu bu zai hao le 。]

english: Why would she be upset about lilies?
translation: 为什么她会对百合感到不安？ [wei shen me ta hui dui bai he gan dao bu an ？]

english: They're quite poisonous to cats, how was I supposed to know, I'm not a cat doctor...
translation: 它们对猫来说有毒，我怎么知道，我不是猫医生...... [ta men dui mao lai shuo you du ， wo zen me zhi dao ， wo bu shi mao yi sheng ......]

english: Maybe getting you a pet isn't a good idea then, perhaps I should go talk to your cousin for some ideas.
translation: 也许给你养一只宠物不是一个好主意，也许我应该去和你表弟谈谈一些想法。 [ye xu gei ni yang yi zhi chong wu bu shi yi ge hao zhu yi ， ye xu wo ying gai qu he ni biao di tan tan yi xie xiang fa 。]

english: I'll be here...alone, waiting for the next adventurer to come along and try to help.
translation: 我会在这里……独自一人，等待下一个冒险家的出现并尝试提供帮助。 [wo hui zai zhe li …… du zi yi ren ， deng dai xia yi ge mao xian jia de chu xian bing chang shi ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: Did my heart love till now? Forswear it, sight! For I ne'er saw true beauty till this night.
translation: 我的心到现在还爱着吗？放弃吧，瞧！因为直到今晚我才看到真正的美丽。 [wo de xin dao xian zai hai ai zhe ma ？ fang qi ba ， qiao ！ yin wei zhi dao jin wan wo cai kan dao zhen zheng de mei li 。]

english: All that glitters is not platinum.
translation: 闪闪发光的并非都是铂金。 [shan shan fa guang de bing fei dou shi bo jin 。]

english: All the world's a stage, And all the men and women merely players. They have their exits and their entrances. And one man in his time plays many parts,
translation: 全世界都是一个舞台，所有的男人女人都只是演员。他们有出口和入口。一个人在他那个时代扮演许多角色， [quan shi jie dou shi yi ge wu tai ， suo you de nan ren nv ren dou zhi shi yan yuan 。 ta men you chu kou he ru kou 。 yi ge ren zai ta na ge shi dai ban yan xu duo jue se ，]

english: His acts being seven ages.
translation: 他的行为有七个时代。 [ta de xing wei you qi ge shi dai 。]

english: Doubt thou the stars are fire. Doubt that the sun doth move. Doubt truth to be a liar. But never doubt I love.
translation: 你怀疑星星是火吗？怀疑太阳是否移动。怀疑真相就是骗子。但永远不要怀疑我爱。 [ni huai yi xing xing shi huo ma ？ huai yi tai yang shi fou yi dong 。 huai yi zhen xiang jiu shi pian zi 。 dan yong yuan bu yao huai yi wo ai 。]

english: Double, double, toil and trouble. Fire burn, and cauldron bubble!
translation: 双倍，双倍，辛劳和麻烦。火燃烧，锅冒泡！ [shuang bei ， shuang bei ， xin lao he ma fan 。 huo ran shao ， guo mao pao ！]

english: Love's stories written in love's richest books. To fan the moonbeams from his sleeping eyes.
translation: 爱情的故事写在爱情最丰富的书中。扇动他睡眼中的月光。 [ai qing de gu shi xie zai ai qing zui feng fu de shu zhong 。 shan dong ta shui yan zhong de yue guang 。]

english: What are you mumbling to yourself Juliet?
translation: 朱丽叶，你在自言自语什么？ [zhu li ye ， ni zai zi yan zi yu shen me ？]

english: Oh, I've just been reading a book, it helps me get through the day.
translation: 哦，我刚刚读了一本书，它可以帮助我度过这一天。 [o ， wo gang gang du le yi ben shu ， ta ke yi bang zhu wo du guo zhe yi tian 。]

english: I need to find a way to cheer her up, Phillipa should be able to help, I just can't stand to see her like this.
translation: 我需要想办法让她高兴起来，菲利帕应该能帮上忙，我只是无法忍受看到她这样。 [wo xu yao xiang ban fa rang ta gao xing qi lai ， fei li pa ying gai neng bang shang mang ， wo zhi shi wu fa ren shou kan dao ta zhe yang 。]

english: Hello again Juliet, I've got a surprise that might cheer you up.
translation: 朱丽叶，你好，我有一个惊喜，可能会让你高兴起来。 [zhu li ye ， ni hao ， wo you yi ge jing xi ， ke neng hui rang ni gao xing qi lai 。]

english: Where is it? I don't see anything?
translation: 它在哪里？我什么也没看到？ [ta zai na li ？ wo shen me ye mei kan dao ？]

english: Oh damn, where did I put them?
translation: 哦该死，我把它们放在哪里了？ [o gai si ， wo ba ta men fang zai na li le ？]

english: Come back when you have something for me...
translation: 等你有事给我就回来吧…… [deng ni you shi gei wo jiu hui lai ba ……]

english: Juliet, I've got something for you.
translation: 朱丽叶，我有东西给你。 [zhu li ye ， wo you dong xi gei ni 。]

english: Oh my! What's that on your head?
translation: 天啊！你头上那是什么？ [tian a ！ ni tou shang na shi shen me ？]

english: Since you can't have a cat, I thought I'd be one for you. Meeeeooow...
translation: 既然你不能养猫，我想我会为你养一只。喵呜... [ji ran ni bu neng yang mao ， wo xiang wo hui wei ni yang yi zhi 。 miao wu ...]

english: Oh wonderful! Are you going to dance for me then?
translation: 哦，太棒了！那你要为我跳舞吗？ [o ， tai bang le ！ na ni yao wei wo tiao wu ma ？]

english: Of course!
translation: 当然！ [dang ran ！]

english: Wow...
Wow shred it dude!
translation: 哇，撕碎它，伙计！ [wa ， si sui ta ， huo ji ！]

english: Oh that's absolutely marvellous!
translation: 哦，那真是太棒了！ [o ， na zhen shi tai bang le ！]

english: That's really impressive! You must oftrained very hard to pull that off.
translation: 这真是令人印象深刻！你必须经过非常刻苦的训练才能做到这一点。 [zhe zhen shi ling ren yin xiang shen ke ！ ni bi xu jing guo fei chang ke ku de xun lian cai neng zuo dao zhe yi dian 。]

english: That's cute, but sorry, you're not my type.
translation: 很可爱，但抱歉，你不是我喜欢的类型。 [hen ke ai ， dan bao qian ， ni bu shi wo xi huan de lei xing 。]

english: Yawn, you just did that...
translation: 哈欠，你刚刚这么做了…… [ha qian ， ni gang gang zhe me zuo le ……]

english: Don't do that.
translation: 不要那样做。 [bu yao na yang zuo 。]

english: Interesting.
translation: 有趣的。 [you qu de 。]

english: Uhm...
You're so silly.
translation: 你真傻。 [ni zhen sha 。]

english: I love it!
translation: 我喜欢它！ [wo xi huan ta ！]

english: Wonderful.
translation: 精彩的。 [jing cai de 。]

english: That's delightful.
translation: 那真是令人愉快。 [na zhen shi ling ren yu kuai 。]

english: Hehehe.
translation: 呵呵。 [he he 。]

english: Why would you do that?
translation: 你为什么要这么做？ [ni wei shen me yao zhe me zuo ？]

english: Please Stop.
translation: 请停止。 [qing ting zhi 。]

english: That was weird.
translation: 这很奇怪。 [zhe hen qi guai 。]

english: Please don't do that again.
translation: 请不要再这样做了。 [qing bu yao zai zhe yang zuo le 。]

english: Wow, thanks [player name], I feel a lot better.
translation: 哇，谢谢[玩家姓名]，我感觉好多了。 [wa ， xie xie [ wan jia xing ming ]， wo gan jue hao duo le 。]

english: Oh Saradomin, that was embarrassing
translation: 哦萨拉多明，这太尴尬了 [o sa la duo ming ， zhe tai gan ga le]

english: Don't be embarrassed, you've made me feel better. I'm going to throw a big party to say thanks.
translation: 别害羞，你让我感觉好多了。我要举办一个盛大的聚会来表达谢意。 [bie hai xiu ， ni rang wo gan jue hao duo le 。 wo yao ju ban yi ge sheng da de ju hui lai biao da xie yi 。]

english: Maybe I don't need Romeo after all.
translation: 也许我根本不需要罗密欧。 [ye xu wo gen ben bu xu yao luo mi ou 。]

english: Head downstairs when you're ready. Oh, you can keep the ears as well.
translation: 准备好后就下楼吧。哦，你也可以保留耳朵。 [zhun bei hao hou jiu xia lou ba 。 o ， ni ye ke yi bao liu er duo 。]

english: Hi Juliet, why aren't you downstairs enjoying the party?
translation: 嗨，朱丽叶，你为什么不在楼下享受聚会呢？ [hai ， zhu li ye ， ni wei shen me bu zai lou xia xiang shou ju hui ne ？]

english: It's a little too loud for me down there, I'd rather stay up here and relax.
translation: 下面对我来说有点太吵了，我宁愿呆在这里放松一下。 [xia mian dui wo lai shuo you dian tai chao le ， wo ning yuan dai zai zhe li fang song yi xia 。]

english: To each their own, you've thrown a truly amazing party this year.
translation: 对于每个人来说，今年你们举办了一场真正令人惊叹的派对。 [dui yu mei ge ren lai shuo ， jin nian ni men ju ban le yi chang zhen zheng ling ren jing tan de pai dui 。]

english: Yes I've met him.
translation: 是的，我见过他。 [shi de ， wo jian guo ta 。]

english: Certainly, I'll do so straight away.
translation: 当然，我会立即这样做。 [dang ran ， wo hui li ji zhe yang zuo 。]

english: No, he was a little too weird for me.
translation: 不，他对我来说有点太奇怪了。 [bu ， ta dui wo lai shuo you dian tai qi guai le 。]

english: No, I think I'd have remembered if I'd met him.
translation: 不，我想如果我遇见他我就会记得。 [bu ， wo xiang ru guo wo yu jian ta wo jiu hui ji de 。]

english: Certainly, I will do so straight away.
translation: 当然，我会立即这样做。 [dang ran ， wo hui li ji zhe yang zuo 。]

english: No, sorry, I have better things to do.
translation: 不，抱歉，我还有更重要的事情要做。 [bu ， bao qian ， wo hai you geng zhong yao de shi qing yao zuo 。]

english: I guess I could look for him for you.
translation: 我想我可以帮你找他。 [wo xiang wo ke yi bang ni zhao ta 。]

english: I think you could do better than Romeo!
translation: 我认为你可以比罗密欧做得更好！ [wo ren wei ni ke yi bi luo mi ou zuo de geng hao ！]

english: Ask about the birthday party.
translation: 询问生日聚会的情况。 [xun wen sheng ri ju hui de qing kuang 。]

english: Something else.
translation: 还有别的事。 [hai you bie de shi 。]

english: Good day, how may I help you?
translation: 美好的一天，我能为您做些什么吗？ [mei hao de yi tian ， wo neng wei nin zuo xie shen me ma ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This is the Marim branch of the Bank of Gielinor. Now that our people have more contact with the lands overseas, we have new business opportunities. Can I help you?
translation: 这是吉林诺银行的马林分行。现在我们人民与海外土地的接触越来越多，我们有了新的商机。我可以帮你吗？ [zhe shi ji lin nuo yin hang de ma lin fen hang 。 xian zai wo men ren min yu hai wai tu di de jie chu yue lai yue duo ， wo men you le xin de shang ji 。 wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: I'd like to buy more bank slots.
translation: 我想购买更多的银行插槽。 [wo xiang gou mai geng duo de yin hang cha cao 。]

english: Why? You don't use the bank.
translation: 为什么？你不使用银行。 [wei shen me ？ ni bu shi yong yin hang 。]

english: Oh yeah... Never mind then.
translation: 哦，是的...那没关系。 [o ， shi de ... na mei guan xi 。]

english: I can sell you up to [number] additional bank slots in sets of 40. How many are you interested in buying?
translation: 我可以向您出售最多 [number] 个额外的银行插槽，每组 40 个。您有兴趣购买多少个？ [wo ke yi xiang nin chu shou zui duo  [number]  ge e wai de yin hang cha cao ， mei zu  40  ge 。 nin you xing qu gou mai duo shao ge ？]

english: [number] slots please.
translation: 请[数量]个插槽。 [qing [ shu liang ] ge cha cao 。]

english: Buying [number] additional bank slots will cost [number] coins. Be warned, this purchase is not reversible. Are you happy to proceed?
translation: 购买 [number] 个额外的银行槽位将花费 [number] 个硬币。请注意，此购买不可撤销。您乐意继续吗？ [gou mai  [number]  ge e wai de yin hang cao wei jiang hua fei  [number]  ge ying bi 。 qing zhu yi ， ci gou mai bu ke che xiao 。 nin le yi ji xu ma ？]

english: Oh... I don't seem to have enough money for that. Never mind.
translation: 哦……我好像没有足够的钱。没关系。 [o …… wo hao xiang mei you zu gou de qian 。 mei guan xi 。]

english: Yes, I'm happy with that.
translation: 是的，我对此很满意。 [shi de ， wo dui ci hen man yi 。]

english: Your additional bank slots have been added.
translation: 您的额外银行插槽已添加。 [nin de e wai yin hang cha cao yi tian jia 。]

english: Actually, I've changed my mind.
translation: 事实上，我已经改变主意了。 [shi shi shang ， wo yi jing gai bian zhu yi le 。]

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: I'd like to access my bank account, please.
translation: 我想访问我的银行帐户。 [wo xiang fang wen wo de yin hang zhang hu 。]

english: I'd like to check my PIN settings.
translation: 我想检查我的 PIN 设置。 [wo xiang jian cha wo de  PIN  she zhi 。]

english: I'd like to collect items.
translation: 我想收集物品。 [wo xiang shou ji wu pin 。]

english: I'd like to buy more bank slots.
translation: 我想购买更多的银行插槽。 [wo xiang gou mai geng duo de yin hang cha cao 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Tell me... a story...
translation: 告诉我……一个故事…… [gao su wo …… yi ge gu shi ……]

english: Okay...
translation: 好的... [hao de ...]

english: Perhaps you should empty your hands before you begin.
translation: 也许你应该在开始之前清空双手。 [ye xu ni ying gai zai kai shi zhi qian qing kong shuang shou 。]

english: You tell Juna some stories of your adventures.
translation: 你给朱娜讲了一些你的冒险故事。 [ni gei zhu na jiang le yi xie ni de mao xian gu shi 。]

english: Your story has entertained me. But it is a poor sort of adventurer who only tells stories of the past and does not find new stories to tell. I will not let you into the cave again until you have had more adventures!
translation: 你的故事让我很开心。但这是一种可怜的冒险家，只讲述过去的故事，而不寻找新的故事可讲。在你经历更多冒险之前，我不会再让你进入山洞！ [ni de gu shi rang wo hen kai xin 。 dan zhe shi yi zhong ke lian de mao xian jia ， zhi jiang shu guo qu de gu shi ， er bu xun zhao xin de gu shi ke jiang 。 zai ni jing li geng duo mao xian zhi qian ， wo bu hui zai rang ni jin ru shan dong ！]

english: You cannot enter the cave again until you have gained either one quest point or [experience due] total XP.
translation: 在获得 1 个任务点或 [到期经验] 总 XP 之前，您无法再次进入洞穴。 [zai huo de  1  ge ren wu dian huo  [ dao qi jing yan ]  zong  XP  zhi qian ， nin wu fa zai ci jin ru dong xue 。]

english: It has not been long since your last visit. Come back [tomorrow/in [amount] days].
translation: 距离您上次来访并没有多久。 [明天/[数量]天后]回来。 [ju li nin shang ci lai fang bing mei you duo jiu 。 [ ming tian /[ shu liang ] tian hou ] hui lai 。]

english: I fear you will have no new stories to tell me. Come again when you have had more adventures.
translation: 我担心你不会有新的故事可以告诉我。当你经历了更多的冒险之后再来吧。 [wo dan xin ni bu hui you xin de gu shi ke yi gao su wo 。 dang ni jing li le geng duo de mao xian zhi hou zai lai ba 。]

english: I fear you will have no new stories to tell me. Come again [tomorrow/in [amount] days] if you have had more adventures by then.
translation: 我担心你不会有新的故事可以告诉我。如果到那时您经历了更多冒险，请再来[明天/[数量]天]。 [wo dan xin ni bu hui you xin de gu shi ke yi gao su wo 。 ru guo dao na shi nin jing li le geng duo mao xian ， qing zai lai [ ming tian /[ shu liang ] tian ]。]

english: Your stories have entertained me. I will let you into the cave for a short time.
translation: 你的故事让我很开心。我会让你进入山洞一段时间。 [ni de gu shi rang wo hen kai xin 。 wo hui rang ni jin ru shan dong yi duan shi jian 。]

english: Collect as much as you can from the blue streams. If you let in water from the green streams, it will take away from the blue. For Guthix is god of balance, and balance lies in the juxtaposition of opposites.
translation: 从蓝色溪流中收集尽可能多的东西。如果你让绿色溪流中的水流入，蓝色溪流中的水就会被带走。因为古蒂克斯是平衡之神，平衡在于对立面的并置。 [cong lan se xi liu zhong shou ji jin ke neng duo de dong xi 。 ru guo ni rang lv se xi liu zhong de shui liu ru ， lan se xi liu zhong de shui jiu hui bei dai zou 。 yin wei gu di ke si shi ping heng zhi shen ， ping heng zai yu dui li mian de bing zhi 。]

english: The player enters the Tears of Guthix cave
translation: 玩家进入古斯克斯之泪洞穴 [wan jia jin ru gu si ke si zhi lei dong xue]

english: You tell me a story.
translation: 你给我讲一个故事。 [ni gei wo jiang yi ge gu shi 。]

english: The Third Age of the world was a time of great conflict, of destruction never seen before or since, when all the gods save Guthix warred for control.
translation: 世界的第三纪元是一个充满巨大冲突和毁灭的时期，这是前所未见的，除古西克斯之外的所有神明都为了控制权而战。 [shi jie de di san ji yuan shi yi ge chong man ju da chong tu he hui mie de shi qi ， zhe shi qian suo wei jian de ， chu gu xi ke si zhi wai de suo you shen ming dou wei le kong zhi quan er zhan 。]

english: The colossal Wyrms, of whom today's dragons are a pale reflection, turned all the sky to fire, while on the ground armies of foot soldiers, goblins and trolls and humans, filled the valleys and plains with blood.
translation: 巨大的巨龙——今天的龙只是其苍白的倒影——将整个天空变成了火焰，而地面上的步兵、妖精、巨魔和人类军队则让山谷和平原充满了鲜血。 [ju da de ju long —— jin tian de long zhi shi qi cang bai de dao ying —— jiang zheng ge tian kong bian cheng le huo yan ， er di mian shang de bu bing 、 yao jing 、 ju mo he ren lei jun dui ze rang shan gu he ping yuan chong man le xian xue 。]

english: In time the noise of the conflict woke Guthix from His deep slumber, and He rose and stood in the centre of the battlefield so that the splendour of His wrath filled the world, and He called for the conflict to cease!
translation: 随着时间的推移，冲突的喧嚣将古提克斯从沉睡中唤醒，他站了起来，站在战场中央，他的愤怒之光充满了世界，他呼吁停止冲突！ [sui zhe shi jian de tui yi ， chong tu de xuan xiao jiang gu ti ke si cong chen shui zhong huan xing ， ta zhan le qi lai ， zhan zai zhan chang zhong yang ， ta de fen nu zhi guang chong man le shi jie ， ta hu yu ting zhi chong tu ！]

english: Silence fell, for the gods knew that none could challenge the power of the mighty Guthix -- for His power is that of nature itself, to which all other things are subject, in the end.
translation: 沉默降临，众神知道没有人能够挑战强大的古提克斯的力量——因为他的力量就是自然本身的力量，所有其他事物最终都服从于自然本身。 [chen mo jiang lin ， zhong shen zhi dao mei you ren neng gou tiao zhan qiang da de gu ti ke si de li liang —— yin wei ta de li liang jiu shi zi ran ben shen de li liang ， suo you qi ta shi wu zui zhong dou fu cong yu zi ran ben shen 。]

english: Guthix reclaimed that which had been stolen from Him, and went back underground to return to His sleep and continue to draw the world's power into Himself.
translation: 古西克斯夺回了从他身上被偷走的东西，并回到地下，回到他的睡眠中，继续将世界的力量吸引到他自己身上。 [gu xi ke si duo hui le cong ta shen shang bei tou zou de dong xi ， bing hui dao di xia ， hui dao ta de shui mian zhong ， ji xu jiang shi jie de li liang xi yin dao ta zi ji shen shang 。]

english: But on His way into the depths of the earth He sat and rested in this cave; and, thinking of the battle-scarred desert that now stretched from one side of His world to the other, He wept.
translation: 但在进入大地深处的路上，他坐在这个山洞里休息。想到现在从他的世界的一侧延伸到另一侧的伤痕累累的沙漠，他哭了。 [dan zai jin ru da di shen chu de lu shang ， ta zuo zai zhe ge shan dong li xiu xi 。 xiang dao xian zai cong ta de shi jie de yi ce yan shen dao ling yi ce de shang hen lei lei de sha mo ， ta ku le 。]

english: And so great was His sorrow, and so great was His life- giving power, that the rocks themselves began to weep with Him.
translation: 他的悲伤如此之大，他赋予生命的能力如此之大，以至于岩石也开始与他一起哭泣。 [ta de bei shang ru ci zhi da ， ta fu yu sheng ming de neng li ru ci zhi da ， yi zhi yu yan shi ye kai shi yu ta yi qi ku qi 。]

english: Later, Guthix noticed that the rocks continued to weep, and that their tears were infused with a small part of His power.
translation: 后来，古西克斯注意到岩石还在流泪，它们的眼泪中注入了一小部分他的力量。 [hou lai ， gu xi ke si zhu yi dao yan shi hai zai liu lei ， ta men de yan lei zhong zhu ru le yi xiao bu fen ta de li liang 。]

english: So He set me, His servant, to guard the cave, and He entrusted to me the task of judging who was and was not worthy to access the tears.
translation: 因此，他派我，他的仆人，看守这个山洞，并把判断谁值得、不值得接触眼泪的任务交给我。 [yin ci ， ta pai wo ， ta de pu ren ， kan shou zhe ge shan dong ， bing ba pan duan shui zhi de 、 bu zhi de jie chu yan lei de ren wu jiao gei wo 。]

english: Tell me about the Tears of Guthix.
translation: 告诉我关于古斯克斯之泪的事。 [gao su wo guan yu gu si ke si zhi lei de shi 。]

english: I will tell you the story of the light-creatures.
translation: 我会告诉你光生物的故事。 [wo hui gao su ni guang sheng wu de gu shi 。]

english: Myriad and beautiful were the creatures and civilizationsof the early ages of the world. Gielinor was a work of art, shaped lovingly over the millennia by the creative mind of Guthix.
translation: 世界早期的生物和文明无数而美丽。 Gielinor 是一件艺术品，是 Guthix 的创意思维在数千年的时间里精心塑造而成的。 [shi jie zao qi de sheng wu he wen ming wu shu er mei li 。 Gielinor  shi yi jian yi shu pin ， shi  Guthix  de chuang yi si wei zai shu qian nian de shi jian li jing xin su zao er cheng de 。]

english: Only the sturdiest races survived the Godwars, and even then only by abandoning their high culture and gearing their societies towards war. Of the more delicate races there is now no trace, and almost no memory.
translation: 只有最坚强的种族才能在神战中幸存下来，即使如此，也只能通过放弃他们的高雅文化并使他们的社会走向战争。对于那些更微妙的种族，现在已经没有任何踪迹，也几乎没有记忆。 [zhi you zui jian qiang de zhong zu cai neng zai shen zhan zhong xing cun xia lai ， ji shi ru ci ， ye zhi neng tong guo fang qi ta men de gao ya wen hua bing shi ta men de she hui zou xiang zhan zheng 。 dui yu na xie geng wei miao de zhong zu ， xian zai yi jing mei you ren he zong ji ， ye ji hu mei you ji yi 。]

english: One such race had bodies as fragile as snowflakes, yet they built crystal cities that stood for a thousand years.
translation: 其中一个种族的身体像雪花一样脆弱，但他们却建造了屹立一千年的水晶城市。 [qi zhong yi ge zhong zu de shen ti xiang xue hua yi yang cui ruo ， dan ta men que jian zao le yi li yi qian nian de shui jing cheng shi 。]

english: The wind would whisper through the spires and fill them with sweet harmonies, and the rising sun would shine through the precious gems that studded the towers and create inter plays of light as if rainbows were dancing.
translation: 风会吹过尖塔，让它们充​​满甜蜜的和谐，冉冉升起的太阳会透过镶嵌在塔楼上的珍贵宝石，创造出光线的相互作用，仿佛彩虹在跳舞。 [feng hui chui guo jian ta ， rang ta men chong ​​ man tian mi de he xie ， ran ran sheng qi de tai yang hui tou guo xiang qian zai ta lou shang de zhen gui bao shi ， chuang zao chu guang xian de xiang hu zuo yong ， fang fu cai hong zai tiao wu 。]

english: Indeed, so marvellous was this light-show at its height that the patterns of light themselves became alive, and great flocks of luminous creatures rode along the gem- cast beams, each drawn to its own colour.
translation: 事实上，这场灯光秀的高潮是如此奇妙，以至于光的图案本身变得生动起来，大群的发光生物沿着宝石铸造的光束骑行，每一个都被自己的颜色所吸引。 [shi shi shang ， zhe chang deng guang xiu de gao chao shi ru ci qi miao ， yi zhi yu guang de tu an ben shen bian de sheng dong qi lai ， da qun de fa guang sheng wu yan zhe bao shi zhu zao de guang shu qi xing ， mei yi ge dou bei zi ji de yan se suo xi yin 。]

english: The creatures you see floating in this chasm are the last sorry remnants of that age. I do not know how they made their way here and survived to this time, but I am grateful for their company.
translation: 你所看到的漂浮在这个裂缝中的生物是那个时代最后的令人遗憾的残余。我不知道他们是如何来到这里并存活至今的，但我很感谢他们的陪伴。 [ni suo kan dao de piao fu zai zhe ge lie feng zhong de sheng wu shi na ge shi dai zui hou de ling ren yi han de can yu 。 wo bu zhi dao ta men shi ru he lai dao zhe li bing cun huo zhi jin de ， dan wo hen gan xie ta men de pei ban 。]

english: Tell me about the light-creatures.
translation: 告诉我关于光生物的事。 [gao su wo guan yu guang sheng wu de shi 。]

english: Not long after the start of my vigil a party of goblins happened on my cave. These were the ugly brutes of the gods' armies, but their armour bore a faded patch where the symbol of a god had been removed.
translation: 在我开始守夜后不久，一群妖精出现在我的洞穴里。这些是众神军队中丑陋的野兽，但他们的盔甲上有一块褪色的补丁，神的标志已被移除。 [zai wo kai shi shou ye hou bu jiu ， yi qun yao jing chu xian zai wo de dong xue li 。 zhe xie shi zhong shen jun dui zhong chou lou de ye shou ， dan ta men de kui jia shang you yi kuai tui shai de bu ding ， shen de biao zhi yi bei yi chu 。]

english: They looked around hesitantly, squinting in the light of crude torches, but as soon as they saw me they raised their spears and charged.
translation: 他们犹豫地环顾四周，在简陋的火把的光芒下眯起眼睛，但一看到我，就举起长矛冲锋。 [ta men you yu di huan gu si zhou ， zai jian lou de huo ba de guang mang xia mi qi yan jing ， dan yi kan dao wo ， jiu ju qi chang mao chong feng 。]

english: No one may access the Tears of Guthix by force. I sent them tumbling into the chasm.
translation: 任何人都不得通过武力获取古斯克斯之泪。我让他们跌入深渊。 [ren he ren dou bu de tong guo wu li huo qu gu si ke si zhi lei 。 wo rang ta men die ru shen yuan 。]

english: Two hundred years later another goblin found me. This one was unarmed, and although she was very wary I succeeded in engaging her in conversation.
translation: 两百年后，另一个妖精找到了我。这个人手无寸铁，尽管她非常警惕，我还是成功地与她交谈。 [liang bai nian hou ， ling yi ge yao jing zhao dao le wo 。 zhe ge ren shou wu cun tie ， jin guan ta fei chang jing ti ， wo hai shi cheng gong di yu ta jiao tan 。]

english: Since then I have had many more visits from the descendants of those lost warriors, and over the centuries I have seen them change.
translation: 从那时起，那些失落的战士的后裔就多次来访，几个世纪以来，我见证了他们的变化。 [cong na shi qi ， na xie shi luo de zhan shi de hou yi jiu duo ci lai fang ， ji ge shi ji yi lai ， wo jian zheng le ta men de bian hua 。]

english: They have become timid rather than aggressive, and I have seen the light of intelligence grow in their bulging eyes.
translation: 他们变得胆怯而不是好斗，我看到他们凸出的眼睛里闪烁着智慧的光芒。 [ta men bian de dan qie er bu shi hao dou ， wo kan dao ta men tu chu de yan jing li shan shuo zhe zhi hui de guang mang 。]

english: Their stories are repetitive and grim, of scraping a living out of the harsh rock and through ingenuity and toil shaping it into a home.
translation: 他们的故事重复而残酷，从坚硬的岩石中勉强维持生计，并通过聪明才智和辛劳将其塑造成一个家。 [ta men de gu shi chong fu er can ku ， cong jian ying de yan shi zhong mian qiang wei chi sheng ji ， bing tong guo cong ming cai zhi he xin lao jiang qi su zao cheng yi ge jia 。]

english: I have followed the progress of their race, but their individual stories hold little interest for me.
translation: 我关注着他们种族的进展，但他们个人的故事对我来说没什么兴趣。 [wo guan zhu zhe ta men zhong zu de jin zhan ， dan ta men ge ren de gu shi dui wo lai shuo mei shen me xing qu 。]

english: Tell me about the Cave Goblins.
translation: 告诉我关于洞穴哥布林的事。 [gao su wo guan yu dong xue ge bu lin de shi 。]

english: I'd like to receive messages prompting me to return here.
translation: 我希望收到提示我返回此处的消息。 [wo xi wang shou dao ti shi wo fan hui ci chu de xiao xi 。]

english: Very well, when you are eligible to drink from the Tears, you shall be reminded daily.
translation: 很好，当你有资格喝下眼泪时，你会被每天提醒。 [hen hao ， dang ni you zi ge he xia yan lei shi ， ni hui bei mei tian ti xing 。]

english: I don't want any messages reminding me to return here.
translation: 我不希望有任何消息提醒我返回这里。 [wo bu xi wang you ren he xiao xi ti xing wo fan hui zhe li 。]

english: Very well, it will be up to you to remember when you can return. It is good that you are willing to take responsibility for yourself in this way.
translation: 很好，你什么时候能回来就由你自己决定了。你愿意以这种方式为自己负责，这是件好事。 [hen hao ， ni shen me shi hou neng hui lai jiu you ni zi ji jue ding le 。 ni yuan yi yi zhe zhong fang shi wei zi ji fu ze ， zhe shi jian hao shi 。]

english: Can you do something with this icon?
translation: 你能用这个图标做点什么吗？ [ni neng yong zhe ge tu biao zuo dian shen me ma ？]

english: So many aeons have passed since these were made. So many mortals have been born, lived their lives, then died as Balancerequires. What stories they must have known!
translation: 自从这些东西被创造出来以来，已经过去了很多亿年。如此多的凡人按照平衡的要求出生、生活、然后死去。他们一定知道多少故事！ [zi cong zhe xie dong xi bei chuang zao chu lai yi lai ， yi jing guo qu le hen duo yi nian 。 ru ci duo de fan ren an zhao ping heng de yao qiu chu sheng 、 sheng huo 、 ran hou si qu 。 ta men yi ding zhi dao duo shao gu shi ！]

english: I would be happy to honour the dead by combining such an icon with your Staff of the Dead. Give the items to me, if you wish.
translation: 我很乐意通过将这样的图标与你的亡灵之杖结合起来来纪念死者。如果你愿意的话，把物品给我吧。 [wo hen le yi tong guo jiang zhe yang de tu biao yu ni de wang ling zhi zhang jie he qi lai lai ji nian si zhe 。 ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， ba wu pin gei wo ba 。]

english: Okay, here you go...
translation: 好吧，给你... [hao ba ， gei ni ...]

english: I would happily honour the dead, and all the stories they must have known, by combining your Staff of the Dead with your icon of my master, Guthix. But this cannot be undone; they will be bound forever.
translation: 我很乐意通过将你们的亡灵之杖与我的主人古西克斯的圣像结合起来，向死者以及他们必须知道的所有故事致敬。但这是无法挽回的；他们将永远被束缚。 [wo hen le yi tong guo jiang ni men de wang ling zhi zhang yu wo de zhu ren gu xi ke si de sheng xiang jie he qi lai ， xiang si zhe yi ji ta men bi xu zhi dao de suo you gu shi zhi jing 。 dan zhe shi wu fa wan hui de ； ta men jiang yong yuan bei shu fu 。]

english: Combine them. I understand it can't be undone.
translation: 将它们结合起来。我明白这一切无法挽回。 [jiang ta men jie he qi lai 。 wo ming bai zhe yi qie wu fa wan hui 。]

english: Juna will offer to make multiple Staves of balance
translation: 朱娜将提出制作多根平衡法杖 [zhu na jiang ti chu zhi zuo duo gen ping heng fa zhang]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Maybe another time.
translation: 也许下次吧。 [ye xu xia ci ba 。]

english: I would be happy to honour the dead by combining such an icon with a Staff of the Dead, if you bring one to me.
translation: 如果你能带一个给我的话，我很乐意将这样的图标与亡灵之杖结合起来，以纪念死者。 [ru guo ni neng dai yi ge gei wo de hua ， wo hen le yi jiang zhe yang de tu biao yu wang ling zhi zhang jie he qi lai ， yi ji nian si zhe 。]

english: My weapon is sort of like a Staff of the Dead, don't you think?
translation: 我的武器有点像死亡之杖，你不觉得吗？ [wo de wu qi you dian xiang si wang zhi zhang ， ni bu jue de ma ？]

english: It was, but I appear to have combined it with an icon already.
translation: 是的，但我似乎已经将它与图标结合起来了。 [shi de ， dan wo si hu yi jing jiang ta yu tu biao jie he qi lai le 。]

english: I cannot combine it with that.
translation: 我无法将其与此结合起来。 [wo wu fa jiang qi yu ci jie he qi lai 。]

english: I've got a weapon in my inventory that's sort of like a Staff of the Dead.
translation: 我的库存中有一件武器，有点像死亡之杖。 [wo de ku cun zhong you yi jian wu qi ， you dian xiang si wang zhi zhang 。]

english: It is not what I seek.
translation: 这不是我所寻求的。 [zhe bu shi wo suo xun qiu de 。]

english: A Staff of the Dead, you say? Okay, thanks.
translation: 你说死者法杖？好的，谢谢。 [ni shuo si zhe fa zhang ？ hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Not now.
translation: 现在不要。 [xian zai bu yao 。]

english: I will not permit you to be in the cave for long. Collect as many tears as you can.
translation: 我不会允许你在山洞里呆太久的。收集尽可能多的眼泪。 [wo bu hui yun xu ni zai shan dong li dai tai jiu de 。 shou ji jin ke neng duo de yan lei 。]

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。 [hao de 。]

english: I want to get out now.
translation: 我现在就想出去。 [wo xian zai jiu xiang chu qu 。]

english: The player leaves the Tears of Guthix cave
translation: 玩家离开古斯克斯之泪洞穴 [wan jia li kai gu si ke si zhi lei dong xue]

english: If you wish to tell me more stories, come out here first.
translation: 如果你想告诉我更多的故事，就先到这里来吧。 [ru guo ni xiang gao su wo geng duo de gu shi ， jiu xian dao zhe li lai ba 。]

english: A Staff of the Dead! I would happily honour the dead, and all the stories they must have known, by combining your staff with an icon of my master, Guthix.
translation: 死者法杖！我很乐意将你们的法杖与我主人古西克斯的肖像结合起来，以纪念死者以及他们必须知道的所有故事。 [si zhe fa zhang ！ wo hen le yi jiang ni men de fa zhang yu wo zhu ren gu xi ke si de xiao xiang jie he qi lai ， yi ji nian si zhe yi ji ta men bi xu zhi dao de suo you gu shi 。]

english: Perhaps you can find such an icon and bring it to me.
translation: 也许你可以找到这样的图标并把它带给我。 [ye xu ni ke yi zhao dao zhe yang de tu biao bing ba ta dai gei wo 。]

english: I would happily honour the dead by combining such an icon with a Staff of the Dead, if you bring one to me.
translation: 如果你能给我带来一个，我很乐意将这样的图标与亡灵之杖结合起来以纪念死者。 [ru guo ni neng gei wo dai lai yi ge ， wo hen le yi jiang zhe yang de tu biao yu wang ling zhi zhang jie he qi lai yi ji nian si zhe 。]

english: I can do nothing more with that.
translation: 我对此无能为力。 [wo dui ci wu neng wei li 。]

english: I cannot combine your icon with that weapon.
translation: 我无法将你的图标与那把武器结合起来。 [wo wu fa jiang ni de tu biao yu na ba wu qi jie he qi lai 。]

english: I do not need that from you.
translation: 我不需要你那样做。 [wo bu xu yao ni na yang zuo 。]

english: Hey, I have something for you but you don't have any space for it!
translation: 嘿，我有东西给你，但你没有地方放！ [hei ， wo you dong xi gei ni ， dan ni mei you di fang fang ！]

english: Your dedication to balance is astounding adventurer.
translation: 您对平衡的奉献精神令人惊叹的冒险家。 [nin dui ping heng de feng xian jing shen ling ren jing tan de mao xian jia 。]

english: Here you go.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: Okay...
translation: 好的... [hao de ...]

english: You tell me a story.
translation: 你给我讲一个故事。 [ni gei wo jiang yi ge gu shi 。]

english: Tell me about the Tears of Guthix
translation: 告诉我关于古西克斯之泪的事 [gao su wo guan yu gu xi ke si zhi lei de shi]

english: Tell me a new story.
translation: 给我讲一个新故事。 [gei wo jiang yi ge xin gu shi 。]

english: Tell me about the light-creatures
translation: 告诉我关于光生物的事 [gao su wo guan yu guang sheng wu de shi]

english: Tell me about the Cave Goblins
translation: 告诉我关于洞穴哥布林的事 [gao su wo guan yu dong xue ge bu lin de shi]

english: I'd like to receive messages prompting me to return here.
translation: 我希望收到提示我返回此处的消息。 [wo xi wang shou dao ti shi wo fan hui ci chu de xiao xi 。]

english: I don't want any messages reminding me to return here.
translation: 我不希望有任何消息提醒我返回这里。 [wo bu xi wang you ren he xiao xi ti xing wo fan hui zhe li 。]

english: Can you do something with this icon?
translation: 你能用这个图标做点什么吗？ [ni neng yong zhe ge tu biao zuo dian shen me ma ？]

english: Okay, here you go...
translation: 好吧，给你... [hao ba ， gei ni ...]

english: Combine them. I understand it can't be undone.
translation: 将它们结合起来。我明白这一切无法挽回。 [jiang ta men jie he qi lai 。 wo ming bai zhe yi qie wu fa wan hui 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Maybe another time.
translation: 也许下次吧。 [ye xu xia ci ba 。]

english: Not now.
translation: 现在不要。 [xian zai bu yao 。]

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。 [hao de 。]

english: I want to get out now.
translation: 我现在就想出去。 [wo xian zai jiu xiang chu qu 。]

english: Hello friend. You're a long way from Lumbridge!
translation: 朋友你好。你离伦布里奇还很远！ [peng you ni hao 。 ni li lun bu li qi hai hen yuan ！]

english: How do I get into the Kharazi Jungle?
translation: 我如何进入卡拉兹丛林？ [wo ru he jin ru ka la zi cong lin ？]

english: Well, I don't recommend just walking in! The last guy I saw try that barely escaped with his life.
translation: 嗯，我不建议直接走进去！我看到的最后一个尝试的人勉强逃脱了他的生命。 [n ， wo bu jian yi zhi jie zou jin qu ！ wo kan dao de zui hou yi ge chang shi de ren mian qiang tao tuo le ta de sheng ming 。]

english: Apparently he was on a mission to map the area. How foolish is that?
translation: 显然他的任务是绘制该地区的地图。这有多愚蠢？ [xian ran ta de ren wu shi hui zhi gai di qu de di tu 。 zhe you duo yu chun ？]

english: Actually, I plan to map the jungle myself.
translation: 事实上，我打算自己绘制丛林地图。 [shi shi shang ， wo da suan zi ji hui zhi cong lin di tu 。]

english: Oh. Oops. Sorry if I sounded rude, it just seems like a really bad idea.
translation: 哦。哎呀。抱歉，如果我听起来很粗鲁，这似乎是一个非常糟糕的主意。 [o 。 ai ya 。 bao qian ， ru guo wo ting qi lai hen cu lu ， zhe si hu shi yi ge fei chang zao gao de zhu yi 。]

english: I mean it's a noble calling. Lots of people around here could use a proper map to navigate with. But, you know... there's something not quite right about that jungle.
translation: 我的意思是这是一个崇高的使命。这里的很多人都可以使用合适的地图来导航。但是，你知道……那个丛林有些不太对劲。 [wo de yi si shi zhe shi yi ge chong gao de shi ming 。 zhe li de hen duo ren dou ke yi shi yong he shi de di tu lai dao hang 。 dan shi ， ni zhi dao …… na ge cong lin you xie bu tai dui jin 。]

english: Best of luck though... Guthix knows, you'll need it.
translation: 不过祝你好运...Guthix 知道，你会需要它。 [bu guo zhu ni hao yun ...Guthix  zhi dao ， ni hui xu yao ta 。]

english: Do you have any other tips about the Kharazi Jungle?
translation: 您对卡拉兹丛林还有其他建议吗？ [nin dui ka la zi cong lin hai you qi ta jian yi ma ？]

english: Not really. Just be careful - there's a lot of weird stuff going on in there lately.
translation: 并不真地。请小心——最近那​​里发生了很多奇怪的事情。 [bing bu zhen di 。 qing xiao xin —— zui jin na ​​ li fa sheng le hen duo qi guai de shi qing 。]

english: Are you calling me foolish?
translation: 你是在骂我傻吗？ [ni shi zai ma wo sha ma ？]

english: Er... maybe? I'll just be on my way...
translation: 呃……也许？我马上就上路了... [e …… ye xu ？ wo ma shang jiu shang lu le ...]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm a forester, and I specialise in exotic woods. I haven't gone into the Kharazi myself, but I've found some interesting tree specimens out here.
translation: 我是一名林务员，专门研究异国木材。我本人没有去过卡拉兹，但我在这里发现了一些有趣的树木标本。 [wo shi yi ming lin wu yuan ， zhuan men yan jiu yi guo mu cai 。 wo ben ren mei you qu guo ka la zi ， dan wo zai zhe li fa xian le yi xie you qu de shu mu biao ben 。]

english: If you do find a safe path into the jungle, do come and let me know. I'd love to have a nose around in there.
translation: 如果您确实找到了进入丛林的安全路径，请过来告诉我。我很想在那里有一个鼻子。 [ru guo nin que shi zhao dao le jin ru cong lin de an quan lu jing ， qing guo lai gao su wo 。 wo hen xiang zai na li you yi ge bi zi 。]

english: Have you seen any Kharazi tribespeople in the jungle?
translation: 你在丛林中见过卡拉兹部落的人吗？ [ni zai cong lin zhong jian guo ka la zi bu luo de ren ma ？]

english: Oh yes, I've met loads of them! Lovely lot. I haven't seen many about recently, though.
translation: 哦，是的，我见过很多这样的人！可爱的很多。不过最近我没见过太多。 [o ， shi de ， wo jian guo hen duo zhe yang de ren ！ ke ai de hen duo 。 bu guo zui jin wo mei jian guo tai duo 。]

english: If you're looking to say hello, you'll need a Bullroarer. If you swing it above your head it makes a loud noise - that should attract someone's attention.
translation: 如果您想打个招呼，您需要一个 Bullroarer。如果你将它摇过头顶，它会发出很大的声音——这应该会引起别人的注意。 [ru guo nin xiang da ge zhao hu ， nin xu yao yi ge  Bullroarer。 ru guo ni jiang ta yao guo tou ding ， ta hui fa chu hen da de sheng yin —— zhe ying gai hui yin qi bie ren de zhu yi 。]

english: Do you have a Bullroarer I could borrow?
translation: 你有 Bullroarer 可以借给我吗？ [ni you  Bullroarer  ke yi jie gei wo ma ？]

english: I wish I did! But I just have the one, and I've grown fond of it. Besides, I might need it if I ever get lost in the jungle.
translation: 我希望我做到了！但我只有一个，而且我已经越来越喜欢它了。此外，如果我在丛林中迷路，我可能会需要它。 [wo xi wang wo zuo dao le ！ dan wo zhi you yi ge ， er qie wo yi jing yue lai yue xi huan ta le 。 ci wai ， ru guo wo zai cong lin zhong mi lu ， wo ke neng hui xu yao ta 。]

english: Will you trade something for it?
translation: 你会用什么东西来换取它吗？ [ni hui yong shen me dong xi lai huan qu ta ma ？]

english: Hmm, maybe. Tell you what, you show me something interesting and I'll see if it's worth my Bullroarer. How about that?
translation: 嗯，也许吧。告诉你吧，你给我看一些有趣的东西，我会看看它是否值得我的 Bullroarer。怎么样？ [n ， ye xu ba 。 gao su ni ba ， ni gei wo kan yi xie you qu de dong xi ， wo hui kan kan ta shi fou zhi de wo de  Bullroarer。 zen me yang ？]

english: It's a deal!
translation: 这是一笔交易！ [zhe shi yi bi jiao yi ！]

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: You're welcome! See you around...
translation: 不客气！再见... [bu ke qi ！ zai jian ...]

english: I have a question about my Achievement Diary.
translation: 我对我的成就日记有疑问。 [wo dui wo de cheng jiu ri ji you yi wen 。]

english: Sorry, I don't do that kind of thing any more. You should go and talk to Pirate Jackie in Brimhaven instead.
translation: 抱歉，我不再做那样的事了。你应该去布里姆港与海盗杰基交谈。 [bao qian ， wo bu zai zuo na yang de shi le 。 ni ying gai qu bu li mu gang yu hai dao jie ji jiao tan 。]

english: Ugh, it's still raw! You can't serve me that. Take it away!
translation: 呃，还是生的！你不能为我服务。把它拿走！ [e ， hai shi sheng de ！ ni bu neng wei wo fu wu 。 ba ta na zou ！]

english: I lost my Bullroarer, can I swap this delicious wrap for yours?
translation: 我的 Bullroarer 丢了，我可以把这个美味的卷纸换成你的吗？ [wo de  Bullroarer  diu le ， wo ke yi ba zhe ge mei wei de juan zhi huan cheng ni de ma ？]

english: Go on then. Forestry is hungry work.
translation: 那就继续吧。林业是一项饥饿的工作。 [na jiu ji xu ba 。 lin ye shi yi xiang ji e de gong zuo 。]

english: On second thoughts, I might get hungry.
translation: 转念一想，我可能会饿。 [zhuan nian yi xiang ， wo ke neng hui e 。]

english: Sorry, but I have no use for that.
translation: 抱歉，但我没有这个用处。 [bao qian ， dan wo mei you zhe ge yong chu 。]

english: How do I get into the Kharazi Jungle?
translation: 我如何进入卡拉兹丛林？ [wo ru he jin ru ka la zi cong lin ？]

english: Actually, I plan to map the jungle myself.
translation: 事实上，我打算自己绘制丛林地图。 [shi shi shang ， wo da suan zi ji hui zhi cong lin di tu 。]

english: Do you have any other tips about the Kharazi Jungle?
translation: 您对卡拉兹丛林还有其他建议吗？ [nin dui ka la zi cong lin hai you qi ta jian yi ma ？]

english: Have you seen any Kharazi Tribesmen in the jungle?
translation: 您在丛林中见过卡拉兹部落成员吗？ [nin zai cong lin zhong jian guo ka la zi bu luo cheng yuan ma ？]

english: Ok thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Are you calling me foolish?
translation: 你是在骂我傻吗？ [ni shi zai ma wo sha ma ？]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Have you seen any Kharazi tribespeople in the jungle?
translation: 你在丛林中见过卡拉兹部落的人吗？ [ni zai cong lin zhong jian guo ka la zi bu luo de ren ma ？]

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Do you have a Bullroarer I could borrow?
translation: 你有 Bullroarer 可以借给我吗？ [ni you  Bullroarer  ke yi jie gei wo ma ？]

english: Will you trade something for it?
translation: 你会用什么东西来换取它吗？ [ni hui yong shen me dong xi lai huan qu ta ma ？]
