translation: 如何进入卡拉兹丛林？ [ru he jin ru ka la zi cong lin ？]

english: I have a question about my Achievement Diary.
translation: 我对我的成就日记有疑问。 [wo dui wo de cheng jiu ri ji you yi wen 。]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Hey, I'm Justine. I've got some rewards here for fighters who've done well in Lisa's Last Man Standing game. Wanna see?
translation: 嘿，我是贾斯汀。我在这里为在《丽莎的最后一人站立》游戏中表现出色的战士提供了一些奖励。想看吗？ [hei ， wo shi jia si ting 。 wo zai zhe li wei zai 《 li sha de zui hou yi ren zhan li 》 you xi zhong biao xian chu se de zhan shi ti gong le yi xie jiang li 。 xiang kan ma ？]

english: What have you got?
translation: 你有什么？ [ni you shen me ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Sorry, I don't offer refunds on items that people can trade with each other.
translation: 抱歉，对于人们可以互相交易的物品，我不提供退款。 [bao qian ， dui yu ren men ke yi hu xiang jiao yi de wu pin ， wo bu ti gong tui kuan 。]

english: Hey, that door's for staff only!
translation: 嘿，那扇门仅供工作人员使用！ [hei ， na shan men jin gong gong zuo ren yuan shi yong ！]

english: Sorry, shop's closed.
translation: 抱歉，商店关门了。 [bao qian ， shang dian guan men le 。]

english: What have you got?
translation: 你有什么？ [ni you shen me ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: C'mon, almost got it...
translation: 来吧，差不多明白了... [lai ba ， cha bu duo ming bai le ...]

english: Having problems?
translation: 有问题吗？ [you wen ti ma ？]

english: Agh! You scared me! Now I've lost my lockpick.
translation: 啊啊！你吓到我了！现在我的开锁器丢了。 [a a ！ ni xia dao wo le ！ xian zai wo de kai suo qi diu le 。]

english: Oh, sorry about that. Do you want one of mine?
translation: 哦，对此感到抱歉。你想要我的一份吗？ [o ， dui ci gan dao bao qian 。 ni xiang yao wo de yi fen ma ？]

english: Oh, sorry about that. I'm afraid I don't have one for you.
translation: 哦，对此感到抱歉。恐怕我没有给你的。 [o ， dui ci gan dao bao qian 。 kong pa wo mei you gei ni de 。]

english: Don't worry about it, I brought an extra just in case. Lockpicks really do help with disarming these traps.
translation: 别担心，我多带了一些以防万一。开锁器确实有助于解除这些陷阱。 [bie dan xin ， wo duo dai le yi xie yi fang wan yi 。 kai suo qi que shi you zhu yu jie chu zhe xie xian jing 。]

english: Oh, that's good to know, thanks for the tip! Out of curiosity, what outfit is that?
translation: 哦，很高兴知道，谢谢你的提示！出于好奇，这是什么衣服？ [o ， hen gao xing zhi dao ， xie xie ni de ti shi ！ chu yu hao qi ， zhe shi shen me yi fu ？]

english: It's called the Rogue's outfit. I got it from the Rogue's Den in Burthorpe. I've found it helps me blend in when pickpocketing people, allowing me to steal more coins from them.
translation: 这就是所谓的盗贼服装。我是从伯索普的盗贼巢穴得到的。我发现它可以帮助我在扒窃时融入其中，让我从他们那里偷更多的硬币。 [zhe jiu shi suo wei de dao zei fu zhuang 。 wo shi cong bo suo pu de dao zei chao xue de dao de 。 wo fa xian ta ke yi bang zhu wo zai pa qie shi rong ru qi zhong ， rang wo cong ta men na li tou geng duo de ying bi 。]

english: It looks cool. Does it also help here?
translation: 看起来很酷。这里也有帮助吗？ [kan qi lai hen ku 。 zhe li ye you bang zhu ma ？]

english: Ha ha ha, of course not! I don't think the coffin cares whether or not I blend in.
translation: 哈哈哈，当然不是！我认为棺材并不关心我是否融入其中。 [ha ha ha ， dang ran bu shi ！ wo ren wei guan cai bing bu guan xin wo shi fou rong ru qi zhong 。]

english: Good point. Why are you wearing it though if it doesn't help you get more loot?
translation: 好点。如果它不能帮助你获得更多战利品，你为什么还要戴着它呢？ [hao dian 。 ru guo ta bu neng bang zhu ni huo de geng duo zhan li pin ， ni wei shen me hai yao dai zhe ta ne ？]

english: Honestly, I just really like how it looks. You've got to look your best while travelling right?
translation: 老实说，我真的很喜欢它的外观。旅行时你必须保持最佳状态，对吗？ [lao shi shuo ， wo zhen de hen xi huan ta de wai guan 。 lv xing shi ni bi xu bao chi zui jia zhuang tai ， dui ma ？]

english: Each to their own I suppose. I'll be off. Best of luck down here.
translation: 我想每个人都有自己的。我就走了。祝你好运。 [wo xiang mei ge ren dou you zi ji de 。 wo jiu zou le 。 zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: And the same to you.
translation: 对你也一样。 [dui ni ye yi yang 。]

english: Agh, thought I had it that time!
translation: 啊，我以为我当时就拥有了！ [a ， wo yi wei wo dang shi jiu yong you le ！]

english: The world begins to fade...
translation: 世界开始黯淡…… [shi jie kai shi an dan ……]

english: What happened? I rubbed that coin and everything went black!
translation: 发生了什么？我擦了擦那枚硬币，一切都变黑了！ [fa sheng le shen me ？ wo ca le ca na mei ying bi ， yi qie dou bian hei le ！]

english: Who are you? You're not the hero I gave my token to!
translation: 你是谁？你不是我授予令牌的英雄！ [ni shi shui ？ ni bu shi wo shou yu ling pai de ying xiong ！]

english: How did you get that coin you used to summon me?
translation: 你是怎么得到召唤我的硬币的？ [ni shi zen me de dao zhao huan wo de ying bi de ？]

english: I took it from the dead body of a black dragon.
translation: 我从黑龙的尸体上取下来的。 [wo cong hei long de shi ti shang qu xia lai de 。]

english: I didn't realise what it would do if I rubbed it.
translation: 我没有意识到如果我摩擦它会发生什么。 [wo mei you yi shi dao ru guo wo mo ca ta hui fa sheng shen me 。]

english: Who, or what, are you anyway?
translation: 你到底是谁，或者是什么？ [ni dao di shi shui ， huo zhe shi shen me ？]

english: My name is K'klik. I am a Fairy Dragon.
translation: 我的名字是克克里克。我是仙龙。 [wo de ming zi shi ke ke li ke 。 wo shi xian long 。]

english: One of the last surviving members of my race, I fear.
translation: 我担心，他是我们种族中最后幸存的成员之一。 [wo dan xin ， ta shi wo men zhong zu zhong zui hou xing cun de cheng yuan zhi yi 。]

english: Enough of that: you summoned me, so how can I help?
translation: 够了：你召唤了我，那么我能帮忙吗？ [gou le ： ni zhao huan le wo ， na me wo neng bang mang ma ？]

english: I'm afraid I don't understand.
translation: 恐怕我听不懂。 [kong pa wo ting bu dong 。]

english: The person who holds my token can summon me by rubbing it.
translation: 持有我令牌的人可以通过摩擦来召唤我。 [chi you wo ling pai de ren ke yi tong guo mo ca lai zhao huan wo 。]

english: They then have the right to request one thing of me before returning my token.
translation: 然后他们有权在归还我的令牌之前要求我做一件事。 [ran hou ta men you quan zai gui huan wo de ling pai zhi qian yao qiu wo zuo yi jian shi 。]

english: So I can ask one thing of you?
translation: 那我可以问你一件事吗？ [na wo ke yi wen ni yi jian shi ma ？]

english: That's right. What do you want?
translation: 这是正确的。你想要什么？ [zhe shi zheng que de 。 ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: I'd like a horse, please.
translation: 请给我一匹马。 [qing gei wo yi pi ma 。]

english: No horses in Gielinor. Try again.
translation: 吉林诺没有马。再试一次。 [ji lin nuo mei you ma 。 zai shi yi ci 。]

english: Can I wish for some xp?
translation: 我可以想要一些xp吗？ [wo ke yi xiang yao yi xie xp ma ？]

english: Sorry, can't help. You'll have to ask the genie for that.
translation: 抱歉，帮不上忙。这个你得去问精灵。 [bao qian ， bang bu shang mang 。 zhe ge ni de qu wen jing ling 。]

english: Could I just keep your token for when I really need it, please?
translation: 我可以保留您的令牌以供我真正需要时使用吗？ [wo ke yi bao liu nin de ling pai yi gong wo zhen zheng xu yao shi shi yong ma ？]

english: I suppose that seems fair. Alright, just call me when you need me.
translation: 我想这似乎很公平。好吧，需要我的时候就给我打电话。 [wo xiang zhe si hu hen gong ping 。 hao ba ， xu yao wo de shi hou jiu gei wo da dian hua 。]

english: Please flambe this creme brulee for me.
translation: 请为我点燃这焦糖布丁。 [qing wei wo dian ran zhe jiao tang bu ding 。]

english: Sure, that's easy.
translation: 当然，这很容易。 [dang ran ， zhe hen rong yi 。]

english: That brûlée needs some more work before it's ready for flambéing.
translation: 布丁在准备好燃烧之前还需要做更多的工作。 [bu ding zai zhun bei hao ran shao zhi qian hai xu yao zuo geng duo de gong zuo 。]

english: Call me again when it's ready.
translation: 准备好后再给我打电话。 [zhun bei hao hou zai gei wo da dian hua 。]

english: I'd like a horse, please.
translation: 请给我一匹马。 [qing gei wo yi pi ma 。]

english: Can I wish for some xp?
translation: 我可以想要一些xp吗？ [wo ke yi xiang yao yi xie xp ma ？]

english: Could I just keep your token for when I really need it, please?
translation: 我可以保留您的令牌以供我真正需要时使用吗？ [wo ke yi bao liu nin de ling pai yi gong wo zhen zheng xu yao shi shi yong ma ？]

english: Please flambe this creme brulee for me.
translation: 请为我点燃这焦糖布丁。 [qing wei wo dian ran zhe jiao tang bu ding 。]

english: Human, I disconnected and lost my plastic plate of whatever food you call this. I want my items returned, now!
translation: 人类，我断开连接并丢失了我的塑料盘，里面装着你所说的任何食物。我希望立即退回我的物品！ [ren lei ， wo duan kai lian jie bing diu shi le wo de su liao pan ， li mian zhuang zhe ni suo shuo de ren he shi wu 。 wo xi wang li ji tui hui wo de wu pin ！]

english: Woah hold on big fella' I can't do that.
translation: 哇哦，坚持住，大家伙，我做不到。 [wa o ， jian chi zhu ， da jia huo ， wo zuo bu dao 。]

english: Well then, I'll just unsubscribe from the dungeon and stop playing all together. Hrmph....
translation: 那么，我就取消地牢订阅并停止一起玩。哼哼…… [na me ， wo jiu qu xiao di lao ding yue bing ting zhi yi qi wan 。 heng heng ……]

english: Oh please, you were never really a popular boss anyway. You had to be given extra drops just to incentivise people to find you. Even then, I doubt anyone would notice if you disappeared.
translation: 哦拜托，无论如何你从来都不是一个真正受欢迎的老板。你必须获得额外的奖励才能激励人们找到你。即便如此，如果你失踪了，我怀疑没有人会注意到。 [o bai tuo ， wu lun ru he ni cong lai dou bu shi yi ge zhen zheng shou huan ying de lao ban 。 ni bi xu huo de e wai de jiang li cai neng ji li ren men zhao dao ni 。 ji bian ru ci ， ru guo ni shi zong le ， wo huai yi mei you ren hui zhu yi dao 。]

english: *growls* Enjoy the party... mortal.
translation: *咆哮*享受聚会......凡人。 [* pao xiao * xiang shou ju hui ...... fan ren 。]

english: Kill them, you cowards!
translation: 杀了他们，你们这些胆小鬼！ [sha le ta men ， ni men zhe xie dan xiao gui ！]

english: Zamorak curse them!
translation: 萨莫拉克诅咒他们！ [sa mo la ke zu zhou ta men ！]

english: Death to Saradomin's dogs!
translation: 萨拉多明的狗去死吧！ [sa la duo ming de gou qu si ba ！]

english: Rend them limb from limb!
translation: 将他们肢解！ [jiang ta men zhi jie ！]

english: Flay them all!
translation: 把他们全部剥皮！ [ba ta men quan bu bao pi ！]

english: Attack them, you dogs!
translation: 攻击他们，你们这些狗！ [gong ji ta men ， ni men zhe xie gou ！]

english: Forward!
translation: 向前！ [xiang qian ！]

english: Attack!
translation: 攻击！ [gong ji ！]

english: The Dark One will have their souls!
translation: 黑暗势力将拥有他们的灵魂！ [hei an shi li jiang yong you ta men de ling hun ！]

english: No retreat!
translation: 没有退路！ [mei you tui lu ！]

english: YARRRRRRR!
translation: 啊啊啊啊！ [a a a a ！]

english: How's life in the light?
translation: 光明中的生活怎么样？ [guang ming zhong de sheng huo zen me yang ？]

english: Burns slightly.
translation: 轻微燃烧。 [qing wei ran shao 。]

english: You seem much nicer than your father. He's mean.
translation: 你看起来比你父亲好得多。他很刻薄。 [ni kan qi lai bi ni fu qin hao de duo 。 ta hen ke bo 。]

english: If you were stuck in a very dark cave for centuries you'd be pretty annoyed too.
translation: 如果你被困在一个非常黑暗的洞穴里几个世纪，你也会很恼火。 [ru guo ni bei kun zai yi ge fei chang hei an de dong xue li ji ge shi ji ， ni ye hui hen nao huo 。]

english: I guess.
translation: 我猜。 [wo cai 。]

english: He's actually quite mellow really.
translation: 其实他真的很温柔。 [qi shi ta zhen de hen wen rou 。]

english: Uh.... Yeah.
translation: 呃……是的。 [e …… shi de 。]

english: Cower before my evil might!
translation: 在我的邪恶力量面前畏缩吧！ [zai wo de xie e li liang mian qian wei suo ba ！]

english: Zamorak will show you no mercy!
translation: 萨莫拉克不会对你手下留情！ [sa mo la ke bu hui dui ni shou xia liu qing ！]

english: For Zamorak!
translation: 为了萨莫拉克！ [wei le sa mo la ke ！]

english: *slap*
translation: *拍击* [* pai ji *]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: How do you feel about all the more powerful monsters?
translation: 您对所有更强大的怪物有何看法？ [nin dui suo you geng qiang da de guai wu you he kan fa ？]

english: There are no monsters more powerful than us!
translation: 没有比我们更强大的怪物了！ [mei you bi wo men geng qiang da de guai wu le ！]

english: We're the top monster of all Gielinor!
translation: 我们是吉林人中最顶尖的怪物！ [wo men shi ji lin ren zhong zui ding jian de guai wu ！]

english: No you're not. The Kalphite Queen is more powerful than you!
translation: 不，你不是。卡菲特女王比你更强大！ [bu ， ni bu shi 。 ka fei te nv wang bi ni geng qiang da ！]

english: Kalphite Queen? What's that?
translation: 卡菲特女王？那是什么？ [ka fei te nv wang ？ na shi shen me ？]

english: She's a giant insect who lives in the desert.
translation: 她是一只生活在沙漠中的巨型昆虫。 [ta shi yi zhi sheng huo zai sha mo zhong de ju xing kun chong 。]

english: An insect?
translation: 昆虫？ [kun chong ？]

english: Ha ha ha ha!
translation: 哈哈哈哈！ [ha ha ha ha ！]

english: No insect could be tougher than us! We're the best!
translation: 没有任何昆虫比我们更坚强！我们是最棒的！ [mei you ren he kun chong bi wo men geng jian qiang ！ wo men shi zui bang de ！]

english: No, she's way tougher than you!
translation: 不，她比你强多了！ [bu ， ta bi ni qiang duo le ！]

english: I don't believe it!
translation: 我不相信！ [wo bu xiang xin ！]

english: And even if this Kalphite Queen is real, which I doubt, second best isn't bad, is it?
translation: 即使这个卡尔菲特女王是真实存在的（我对此表示怀疑），第二好的也不错，不是吗？ [ji shi zhe ge ka er fei te nv wang shi zhen shi cun zai de （ wo dui ci biao shi huai yi ）， di er hao de ye bu cuo ， bu shi ma ？]

english: But it's not just the Kalphite Queen. What about the TzTok-Jad?
translation: 但这不仅仅是卡尔菲特女王。 TzTok-Jad 怎么样？ [dan zhe bu jin jin shi ka er fei te nv wang 。 TzTok-Jad  zen me yang ？]

english: Never heard of it!
translation: 从来没有听说过！ [cong lai mei you ting shuo guo ！]

english: Or the Dagannoth Rex?
translation: 还是达甘诺斯霸王龙？ [hai shi da gan nuo si ba wang long ？]

english: You're making it up!
translation: 你正在弥补！ [ni zheng zai mi bu ！]

english: Or the Chaos Elemental?
translation: 还是混沌元素？ [hai shi hun dun yuan su ？]

english: Now then, how do you know you're not just making all these monsters up to demoralise us?
translation: 那么，你怎么知道你编造这些怪物不是为了让我们士气低落呢？ [na me ， ni zen me zhi dao ni bian zao zhe xie guai wu bu shi wei le rang wo men shi qi di luo ne ？]

english: All right then, what about me?
translation: 好吧，那我呢？ [hao ba ， na wo ne ？]

english: Puny human! You're not a fearsome monster!
translation: 微不足道的人类！你不是一个可怕的怪物！ [wei bu zu dao de ren lei ！ ni bu shi yi ge ke pa de guai wu ！]

english: I defeated you, didn't I? So I must be stronger than you!
translation: 我打败了你，不是吗？所以我一定比你强！ [wo da bai le ni ， bu shi ma ？ suo yi wo yi ding bi ni qiang ！]

english: You got lucky! I'll get you next time!
translation: 你很幸运！下次我来找你！ [ni hen xing yun ！ xia ci wo lai zhao ni ！]

english: Now that you're a stuffed head? I don't think so!
translation: 现在你已经是一个塞满了脑袋的​​人了吗？我不这么认为！ [xian zai ni yi jing shi yi ge sai man le nao dai de ​​ ren le ma ？ wo bu zhe me ren wei ！]

english: Which of you heads is...
translation: 你们谁的头是... [ni men shei de tou shi ...]

english: I am!
translation: 我是！ [wo shi ！]

english: Shut up! I am!
translation: 住口！我是！ [zhu kou ！ wo shi ！]

english: Don't be silly! It's obvious that I am!
translation: 别傻了！很明显我就是这样！ [bie sha le ！ hen ming xian wo jiu shi zhe yang ！]

english: But you don't even know what I was going to say!
translation: 但你根本不知道我要说什么！ [dan ni gen ben bu zhi dao wo yao shuo shen me ！]

english: It doesn't matter. I'm the strongest, cleverest, and most attractive. Whatever it is, I am the most of it!
translation: 没关系。我是最坚强、最聪明、最有魅力的。不管怎样，我是最重要的！ [mei guan xi 。 wo shi zui jian qiang 、 zui cong ming 、 zui you mei li de 。 bu guan zen yang ， wo shi zui zhong yao de ！]

english: Just a minute. What if it's something bad?
translation: 请等一下。如果有什么不好的事情怎么办？ [qing deng yi xia 。 ru guo you shen me bu hao de shi qing zen me ban ？]

english: Good point. What is it you were going to say? Because if it's something good, I'm it, but if it's something bad then it's one of these two ugly mugs.
translation: 好点。你要说什么？因为如果它是好东西，我就是它，但如果它是坏东西，那么它就是这两个丑陋的杯子之一。 [hao dian 。 ni yao shuo shen me ？ yin wei ru guo ta shi hao dong xi ， wo jiu shi ta ， dan ru guo ta shi huai dong xi ， na me ta jiu shi zhe liang ge chou lou de bei zi zhi yi 。]

english: I've forgotten what I was going to ask now.
translation: 我现在已经忘记我要问什么了。 [wo xian zai yi jing wang ji wo yao wen shen me le 。]

english: Me! I am!
translation: 我！我是！ [wo ！ wo shi ！]

english: Sorry, just said that on reflex.
translation: 抱歉，我只是条件反射才这么说。 [bao qian ， wo zhi shi tiao jian fan she cai zhe me shuo 。]

english: Hey, [House owner] killed the King Black Dragon!
translation: 喂，【房主】杀了黑龙王！ [wei ，【 fang zhu 】 sha le hei long wang ！]

english: No [he/she] didn't!
translation: 不，[他/她]没有！ [bu ，[ ta / ta ] mei you ！]

english: What? Oh, ah, no, of course [he/she] didn't. We're actually an artificial likeness of the King Black Dragon. No one could really kill the King Black Dragon!
translation: 什么？哦，啊，不，当然没有。我们实际上是黑龙王的人造肖像。没有人能够真正杀死黑龙王！ [shen me ？ o ， a ， bu ， dang ran mei you 。 wo men shi ji shang shi hei long wang de ren zao xiao xiang 。 mei you ren neng gou zhen zheng sha si hei long wang ！]

english: No! We're - I mean, it's - far too powerful!
translation: 不！我们——我的意思是，它——太强大了！ [bu ！ wo men —— wo de yi si shi ， ta —— tai qiang da le ！]

english: What are you talking about? Of course we're the King Black Dragon!
translation: 你在说什么？我们当然是黑龙王！ [ni zai shuo shen me ？ wo men dang ran shi hei long wang ！]

english: Shut up, you idiot!
translation: 闭嘴，你这个白痴！ [bi zui ， ni zhe ge bai chi ！]

english: How do you feel about all the more powerful monsters?
translation: 您对所有更强大的怪物有何看法？ [nin dui suo you geng qiang da de guai wu you he kan fa ？]

english: Which of you heads is...
translation: 你们谁的头是... [ni men shei de tou shi ...]

english: Anyone there?
translation: 有人在吗？ [you ren zai ma ？]

english: INTRUDER! Red alert! Batten down the hatches! DIVE, DIVE, DIVE!
translation: 入侵者！红色警报！关闭舱门！潜水，潜水，潜水！ [ru qin zhe ！ hong se jing bao ！ guan bi cang men ！ qian shui ， qian shui ， qian shui ！]

english: Err, maybe I'll call back later.
translation: 呃，也许我稍后再打电话。 [e ， ye xu wo shao hou zai da dian hua 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: The fish cannot ride the gravy train.
translation: 鱼不能乘坐肉汁列车。 [yu bu neng cheng zuo rou zhi lie che 。]

english: Sorry?
translation: 对不起？ [dui bu qi ？]

english: The cyclops cannot see his inner walrus?
translation: 独眼巨人看不到他内心的海象？ [du yan ju ren kan bu dao ta nei xin de hai xiang ？]

english: Is this code?
translation: 这是代码吗？ [zhe shi dai ma ma ？]

english: Waddle into a sunset of flaking mackerel?
translation: 摇摇晃晃地走进落日余晖中，鲭鱼片剥落？ [yao yao huang huang di zou jin luo ri yu hui zhong ， qing yu pian bo luo ？]

english: I'm going now.
translation: 我现在就走。 [wo xian zai jiu zou 。]

english: The sardine is leaving the tin?
translation: 沙丁鱼要离开罐头了吗？ [sha ding yu yao li kai guan tou le ma ？]

english: There's been a breach! Red alert!
translation: 出现了突破口！红色警报！ [chu xian le tu po kou ！ hong se jing bao ！]

english: The KGP thinks you are a threat.
translation: KGP 认为你是一个威胁。 [KGP  ren wei ni shi yi ge wei xie 。]

english: Phew, that was a close call.
translation: 唷，那真是千钧一发。 [yo ， na zhen shi qian jun yi fa 。]

english: Urrrrgh!
translation: 呃呃！ [e e ！]

english: Human.
translation: 人类。 [ren lei 。]

english: Leave us.
translation: 离开我们。 [li kai wo men 。]

english: Your presence is not desired.
translation: 不需要你的存在。 [bu xu yao ni de cun zai 。]

english: How friendly.
translation: 多么友好啊。 [duo me you hao a 。]

english: But I need your help! I was sent by Asteros Arceuus, son of Lord Trobin Arceuus.
translation: 但我需要你的帮助！我是特罗宾·阿尔修斯领主的儿子阿斯特罗斯·阿尔修斯派来的。 [dan wo xu yao ni de bang zhu ！ wo shi te luo bin · a er xiu si ling zhu de er zi a si te luo si · a er xiu si pai lai de 。]

english: Arceuus.
translation: 阿尔宙斯。 [a er zhou si 。]

english: We know that name.
translation: 我们知道这个名字。 [wo men zhi dao zhe ge ming zi 。]

english: The name of a liar.
translation: 骗子的名字。 [pian zi de ming zi 。]

english: Liar?
translation: 说谎者？ [shuo huang zhe ？]

english: They came to us. Two of them.
translation: 他们来找我们。其中两个。 [ta men lai zhao wo men 。 qi zhong liang ge 。]

english: The brother and the husband.
translation: 兄弟和丈夫。 [xiong di he zhang fu 。]

english: Her time was running out. They wanted to give her more.
translation: 她的时间已经不多了。他们想给她更多。 [ta de shi jian yi jing bu duo le 。 ta men xiang gei ta geng duo 。]

english: We granted them knowledge. To give her more time.
translation: 我们授予他们知识。为了给她更多的时间。 [wo men shou yu ta men zhi shi 。 wei le gei ta geng duo de shi jian 。]

english: But they misused it. And the world suffered.
translation: 但他们滥用了它。世界遭受苦难。 [dan ta men lan yong le ta 。 shi jie zao shou ku nan 。]

english: This knowledge? You mean immortality?
translation: 这些知识？你是说不朽吗？ [zhe xie zhi shi ？ ni shi shuo bu xiu ma ？]

english: In a way. But it was not meant for that.
translation: 在某种程度上。但这并不是为了这个目的。 [zai mou zhong cheng du shang 。 dan zhe bing bu shi wei le zhe ge mu di 。]

english: Time was what it was meant for. But time still runs out.
translation: 时间就是它的意义所在。但时间仍然不多了。 [shi jian jiu shi ta de yi yi suo zai 。 dan shi jian reng ran bu duo le 。]

english: They put an end to time. They endagered the balance.
translation: 他们结束了时间。他们破坏了平衡。 [ta men jie shu le shi jian 。 ta men po huai le ping heng 。]

english: What balance?
translation: 什么平衡？ [shen me ping heng ？]

english: For every death, there must be life.
translation: 对于每一次死亡，都必须有生命。 [dui yu mei yi ci si wang ， dou bi xu you sheng ming 。]

english: For every life, there must be death.
translation: 每一个生命，都必然有死亡。 [mei yi ge sheng ming ， dou bi ran you si wang 。]

english: Perfectly balanced.
translation: 完美平衡。 [wan mei ping heng 。]

english: As all things should be.
translation: 一切事情都应该如此。 [yi qie shi qing dou ying gai ru ci 。]

english: We serve this balance.
translation: 我们服务于这种平衡。 [wo men fu wu yu zhe zhong ping heng 。]

english: For without balance, the world burns.
translation: 因为没有平衡，世界就会燃烧。 [yin wei mei you ping heng ， shi jie jiu hui ran shao 。]

english: You're very confusing, you know that right?
translation: 你很混乱，你知道吗？ [ni hen hun luan ， ni zhi dao ma ？]

english: Perhaps.
translation: 也许。 [ye xu 。]

english: Perhaps our knowledge is beyond your understanding.
translation: 也许我们的知识超出了你的理解。 [ye xu wo men de zhi shi chao chu le ni de li jie 。]

english: Well thankfully I didn't come here for knowledge. I came here for help. The Dark Altar is failing and the people of Arceuus are in danger. I need you to help me find the cause.
translation: 幸亏我来这里不是为了求知。我来这里寻求帮助。黑暗祭坛正在崩溃，阿尔宙斯的人民正处于危险之中。我需要你帮我找出原因。 [xing kui wo lai zhe li bu shi wei le qiu zhi 。 wo lai zhe li xun qiu bang zhu 。 hei an ji tan zheng zai beng kui ， a er zhou si de ren min zheng chu yu wei xian zhi zhong 。 wo xu yao ni bang wo zhao chu yuan yin 。]

english: The people of Arceuus have had their time.
translation: 阿尔宙斯的人民已经度过了他们的时光。 [a er zhou si de ren min yi jing du guo le ta men de shi guang 。]

english: This will restore balance.
translation: 这将恢复平衡。 [zhe jiang hui fu ping heng 。]

english: Why should we help them?
translation: 我们为什么要帮助他们？ [wo men wei shen me yao bang zhu ta men ？]

english: *sigh* It can never be easy can it.
translation: *叹息*这永远都不容易，不是吗。 [* tan xi * zhe yong yuan dou bu rong yi ， bu shi ma 。]

english: Fine. If you help me save the people of Arceuus, then I will help you.
translation: 美好的。如果你帮我拯救阿尔宙斯的人民，那么我也会帮助你。 [mei hao de 。 ru guo ni bang wo zheng jiu a er zhou si de ren min ， na me wo ye hui bang zhu ni 。]

english: You assume we need help.
translation: 你认为我们需要帮助。 [ni ren wei wo men xu yao bang zhu 。]

english: I've done this enough times to know that everyone wants something, even the masters of life and death.
translation: 我已经做过很多次这样的事情了，我知道每个人都想要一些东西，即使是生死主宰。 [wo yi jing zuo guo hen duo ci zhe yang de shi qing le ， wo zhi dao mei ge ren dou xiang yao yi xie dong xi ， ji shi shi sheng si zhu zai 。]

english: Interesting. Maybe the human is not as stupid as it looks.
translation: 有趣的。也许人类并不像看上去那么愚蠢。 [you qu de 。 ye xu ren lei bing bu xiang kan shang qu na me yu chun 。]

english: Well I've been known to have my moments.
translation: 众所周知，我也有过自己的时刻。 [zhong suo zhou zhi ， wo ye you guo zi ji de shi ke 。]

english: Very well human.
translation: 非常人性化。 [fei chang ren xing hua 。]

english: We admit, the Arceuus people do have their uses.
translation: 我们承认，阿尔宙斯人确实有他们的用处。 [wo men cheng ren ， a er zhou si ren que shi you ta men de yong chu 。]

english: Their work with souls has been useful in helping to maintain the balance.
translation: 他们对灵魂的工作有助于维持平衡。 [ta men dui ling hun de gong zuo you zhu yu wei chi ping heng 。]

english: We will help them. But first, you will serve us.
translation: 我们会帮助他们。但首先，你要为我们服务。 [wo men hui bang zhu ta men 。 dan shou xian ， ni yao wei wo men fu wu 。]

english: Excellent. What do you need from me?
translation: 出色的。你需要我做什么？ [chu se de 。 ni xu yao wo zuo shen me ？]

english: To the south lies a battlefront.
translation: 南面是战线。 [nan mian shi zhan xian 。]

english: There is a grave there. Within it lies a soul, trapped inside a corpse.
translation: 那里有一个坟墓。里面有一个灵魂，被困在尸体里。 [na li you yi ge fen mu 。 li mian you yi ge ling hun ， bei kun zai shi ti li 。]

english: Free this soul. In return, we will provide our help.
translation: 释放这个灵魂。作为回报，我们将提供帮助。 [shi fang zhe ge ling hun 。 zuo wei hui bao ， wo men jiang ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: So you just want me to kill a zombie?
