translation: 为什么你好！我是卡姆弗里娜。喜欢我的宠物的样子吗？我认为他们正在注视着你。 [wei shen me ni hao ！ wo shi ka mu fu li na 。 xi huan wo de chong wu de yang zi ma ？ wo ren wei ta men zheng zai zhu shi zhe ni 。]

english: That was a really bad pun.
translation: 这是一个非常糟糕的双关语。 [zhe shi yi ge fei chang zao gao de shuang guan yu 。]

english: Sorry... I don't get to see the rest of the guild much, stuck up here. The Cyclopes don't talk much you see.
translation: 抱歉……我不能经常见到公会的其他成员，他们被困在这里。你看，独眼巨人不怎么说话。 [bao qian …… wo bu neng jing chang jian dao gong hui de qi ta cheng yuan ， ta men bei kun zai zhe li 。 ni kan ， du yan ju ren bu zen me shuo hua 。]

english: Shouldn't that be cyclopses?
translation: 那不应该是独眼巨人吗？ [na bu ying gai shi du yan ju ren ma ？]

english: Nope! Cyclopes is the plural of cyclops. One cyclops, many cyclopes.
translation: 没有！独眼巨人是独眼巨人的复数形式。一名独眼巨人，许多独眼巨人。 [mei you ！ du yan ju ren shi du yan ju ren de fu shu xing shi 。 yi ming du yan ju ren ， xu duo du yan ju ren 。]

english: Oh, right, thanks.
translation: 哦，对了，谢谢。 [o ， dui le ， xie xie 。]

english: Where are they from?
translation: 他们来自哪里？ [ta men lai zi na li ？]

english: They're from the far east lands.
translation: 他们来自远东地区。 [ta men lai zi yuan dong di qu 。]

english: How did they get here?
translation: 他们是怎么来到这里的？ [ta men shi zen me lai dao zhe li de ？]

english: Ahh.. our guildmaster, Harrallak, went on an expedition there. He brought them back with him.
translation: 啊..我们的公会长哈拉拉克去那里探险了。他把它们带回来了。 [a .. wo men de gong hui zhang ha la la ke qu na li tan xian le 。 ta ba ta men dai hui lai le 。]

english: Why are they here?
translation: 他们为什么在这里？ [ta men wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: For the warriors to train on of course! They also drop a rather nice blade.
translation: 当然是为了战士们的训练！他们还掉落了一把相当漂亮的刀片。 [dang ran shi wei le zhan shi men de xun lian ！ ta men hai diao la le yi ba xiang dang piao liang de dao pian 。]

english: Oh? What would that be?
translation: 哦？那会是什么？ [o ？ na hui shi shen me ？]

english: Defenders.
translation: 防守者。 [fang shou zhe 。]

english: Err what are they?
translation: 呃，它们是什么？ [e ， ta men shi shen me ？]

english: It's a blade you can defend with using your shield hand, like I have.
translation: 这是一把你可以用你的盾手来防御的剑，就像我一样。 [zhe shi yi ba ni ke yi yong ni de dun shou lai fang yu de jian ， jiu xiang wo yi yang 。]

english: Wow!
translation: 哇！ [wa ！]

english: For every 10 tokens you collect around the guild, you can spend one minute in with my pets. As you get defenders you can show them to me to earn even better ones... but remember if you lose them you'll have
translation: 您在公会中每收集 10 个代币，就可以与我的宠物相处一分钟。当你获得防守者时，你可以向我展示他们以获得更好的防守者......但请记住，如果你失去他们，你将拥有 [nin zai gong hui zhong mei shou ji  10  ge dai bi ， jiu ke yi yu wo de chong wu xiang chu yi fen zhong 。 dang ni huo de fang shou zhe shi ， ni ke yi xiang wo zhan shi ta men yi huo de geng hao de fang shou zhe ...... dan qing ji zhu ， ru guo ni shi qu ta men ， ni jiang yong you]

english: to start at bronze again. I'd advise keeping a spare in your bank.
translation: 再次从青铜开始。我建议您在银行保留备用。 [zai ci cong qing tong kai shi 。 wo jian yi nin zai yin hang bao liu bei yong 。]

english: Okay!
translation: 好的！ [hao de ！]

english: Oh, by the way, you'll need to earn 100 tokens before I'll let you in!
translation: 哦，顺便说一句，你需要赚到 100 个代币，我才会放你进去！ [o ， shun bian shuo yi ju ， ni xu yao zhuan dao  100  ge dai bi ， wo cai hui fang ni jin qu ！]

english: Right, I'd better go play some games then!
translation: 好吧，那我还是去玩游戏吧！ [hao ba ， na wo hai shi qu wan you xi ba ！]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: See you back here soon I hope!
translation: 我希望很快就能回到这里！ [wo xi wang hen kuai jiu neng hui dao zhe li ！]

english: Well, since you haven't shown me a defender to prove your prowess as a warrior,
translation: 好吧，既然你没有向我展示一名后卫来证明你作为战士的实力， [hao ba ， ji ran ni mei you xiang wo zhan shi yi ming hou wei lai zheng ming ni zuo wei zhan shi de shi li ，]

english: I'll release some cyclopes which might drop bronze defenders for you to start off with, unless you show me another. Have fun in there.
translation: 我会释放一些独眼巨人，它们可能会为你掉落青铜防御者，除非你向我展示另一个。在那里玩得开心。 [wo hui shi fang yi xie du yan ju ren ， ta men ke neng hui wei ni diao luo qing tong fang yu zhe ， chu fei ni xiang wo zhan shi ling yi ge 。 zai na li wan de kai xin 。]

english: Ahh I see that you have one of the defenders already! Well done.
translation: 啊啊我看到你已经有一名防守者了！干得好。 [a a wo kan dao ni yi jing you yi ming fang shou zhe le ！ gan de hao 。]

english: I'll release some cyclopes which might drop the next defender for you. Have fun in there.
translation: 我会释放一些独眼巨人，这可能会为你放下下一个防守者。在那里玩得开心。 [wo hui shi fang yi xie du yan ju ren ， zhe ke neng hui wei ni fang xia xia yi ge fang shou zhe 。 zai na li wan de kai xin 。]

english: Your time is up, please make your way to the exit.
translation: 时间到了，请前往出口。 [shi jian dao le ， qing qian wang chu kou 。]

english: Next time, please leave as soon as your time is up.
translation: 下次，请一到时间就离开。 [xia ci ， qing yi dao shi jian jiu li kai 。]

english: You must keep your attack skillcape or max cape equipped to stay in the area.
translation: 您必须装备好攻击技能斗篷或最大斗篷才能留在该区域。 [nin bi xu zhuang bei hao gong ji ji neng dou peng huo zui da dou peng cai neng liu zai gai qu yu 。]

english: I remember you....
translation: 我记得你.... [wo ji de ni ....]

english: You don't have the defender you earned last time.
translation: 你没有上次赢得的防守者了。 [ni mei you shang ci ying de de fang shou zhe le 。]

english: Err... no, don't have it on me. I kind of... lost it.
translation: 呃……不，别把它带在我身上。我有点……失去了它。 [e …… bu ， bie ba ta dai zai wo shen shang 。 wo you dian …… shi qu le ta 。]

english: Sorry, but as you've lost any that you earned before I can only let you in to kill the cyclopes that drop the bronze defenders. Go on in when you're ready.
translation: 抱歉，但由于你已经失去了之前赚到的钱，所以我只能让你进去杀死掉青铜防御者的独眼巨人。准备好后就进去吧。 [bao qian ， dan you yu ni yi jing shi qu le zhi qian zhuan dao de qian ， suo yi wo zhi neng rang ni jin qu sha si diao qing tong fang yu zhe de du yan ju ren 。 zhun bei hao hou jiu jin qu ba 。]

english: I have a Bronze defender, please let me in to kill some more Cyclopes!
translation: 我有一个青铜防御者，请让我进去杀更多的独眼巨人！ [wo you yi ge qing tong fang yu zhe ， qing rang wo jin qu sha geng duo de du yan ju ren ！]

english: Bronze eh? The next cyclopes are ready, toddle in when you're ready.
translation: 青铜吧？下一个独眼巨人已经准备好了，准备好后就可以蹒跚而行了。 [qing tong ba ？ xia yi ge du yan ju ren yi jing zhun bei hao le ， zhun bei hao hou jiu ke yi pan shan er xing le 。]

english: I have a Iron defender, please let me in to kill some more Cyclopes!
translation: 我有一个钢铁防御者，请让我进去杀更多的独眼巨人！ [wo you yi ge gang tie fang yu zhe ， qing rang wo jin qu sha geng duo de du yan ju ren ！]

english: Wow, iron eh? The next cyclopes are ready, toddle in when you're ready.
translation: 哇，铁吧？下一个独眼巨人已经准备好了，准备好后就可以蹒跚而行了。 [wa ， tie ba ？ xia yi ge du yan ju ren yi jing zhun bei hao le ， zhun bei hao hou jiu ke yi pan shan er xing le 。]

english: I have a Steel defender, please let me in to kill some more Cyclopes!
translation: 我有一个钢铁防御者，请让我进去杀死更多独眼巨人！ [wo you yi ge gang tie fang yu zhe ， qing rang wo jin qu sha si geng duo du yan ju ren ！]

english: Strong as steel eh? The next cyclopes are ready, toddle in when you're ready.
translation: 坚如钢铁吧？下一个独眼巨人已经准备好了，准备好后就可以蹒跚而行了。 [jian ru gang tie ba ？ xia yi ge du yan ju ren yi jing zhun bei hao le ， zhun bei hao hou jiu ke yi pan shan er xing le 。]

english: I have a Black defender, please let me in to kill some more Cyclopes!
translation: 我有一个黑人防守者，请让我进去杀更多的独眼巨人！ [wo you yi ge hei ren fang shou zhe ， qing rang wo jin qu sha geng duo de du yan ju ren ！]

english: Black, hmmm, about half way to Rune then! Keep going! Cyclopes have been released. Enter when you're ready.
translation: 黑色，嗯，大约到符文的一半了！继续前进！独眼巨人已被释放。准备好后输入。 [hei se ， n ， da yue dao fu wen de yi ban le ！ ji xu qian jin ！ du yan ju ren yi bei shi fang 。 zhun bei hao hou shu ru 。]

english: I have a Mithril defender, please let me in to kill some more Cyclopes!
translation: 我有一个秘银防御者，请让我进去杀死更多独眼巨人！ [wo you yi ge mi yin fang yu zhe ， qing rang wo jin qu sha si geng duo du yan ju ren ！]

english: Mithril? Getting good at this aren't you! Okay, I've released those cyclopes that sometimes drop adamant defenders. Enter when you're ready.
translation: 秘银？擅长这个不是你吗！好吧，我已经释放了那些有时会击倒顽固防守者的独眼巨人。准备好后输入。 [mi yin ？ shan chang zhe ge bu shi ni ma ！ hao ba ， wo yi jing shi fang le na xie you shi hui ji dao wan gu fang shou zhe de du yan ju ren 。 zhun bei hao hou shu ru 。]

english: I have an Adamant defender, please let me in to kill some more Cyclopes!
translation: 我有一个坚定的防守者，请让我进去杀死更多的独眼巨人！ [wo you yi ge jian ding de fang shou zhe ， qing rang wo jin qu sha si geng duo de du yan ju ren ！]

english: An adamant defender eh? Trying for the Rune defender I'm betting. Okay, I've released those cyclopes. Enter when you're ready.
translation: 一个坚定的防守者吧？我敢打赌，我正在努力争取符文防守者。好吧，我已经释放了那些独眼巨人。准备好后输入。 [yi ge jian ding de fang shou zhe ba ？ wo gan da du ， wo zheng zai nu li zheng qu fu wen fang shou zhe 。 hao ba ， wo yi jing shi fang le na xie du yan ju ren 。 zhun bei hao hou shu ru 。]

english: I have a Rune defender, please let me in to kill some more Cyclopes!
translation: 我有一个符文防御者，请让我进去杀死更多独眼巨人！ [wo you yi ge fu wen fang yu zhe ， qing rang wo jin qu sha si geng duo du yan ju ren ！]

english: Well done, you truly are a brilliant warrior! You should speak to my apprentice Lorelai in the basement for an additional challenge.
translation: 干得好，你确实是一位出色的战士！你应该在地下室与我的学徒罗蕾莱交谈，接受额外的挑战。 [gan de hao ， ni que shi shi yi wei chu se de zhan shi ！ ni ying gai zai di xia shi yu wo de xue tu luo lei lai jiao tan ， jie shou e wai de tiao zhan 。]

english: If you'd rather stay up here, I've released the cyclopes. Enter when you're ready.
translation: 如果你愿意留在这里，我已经释放了独眼巨人。准备好后输入。 [ru guo ni yuan yi liu zai zhe li ， wo yi jing shi fang le du yan ju ren 。 zhun bei hao hou shu ru 。]

english: Ahh I see that you've collected the highest defender I can offer you. Well done.
translation: 啊，我看到你已经收集了我可以为你提供的最高防守者。干得好。 [a ， wo kan dao ni yi jing shou ji le wo ke yi wei ni ti gong de zui gao fang shou zhe 。 gan de hao 。]

english: There's an old friend of mine named Lorelai in the guild basement. You should go visit her and maybe she'll let you search for a dragon defender.
translation: 公会地下室里有我的一个老朋友，名叫罗蕾莱。你应该去拜访她，也许她会让你寻找龙卫士。 [gong hui di xia shi li you wo de yi ge lao peng you ， ming jiao luo lei lai 。 ni ying gai qu bai fang ta ， ye xu ta hui rang ni xun zhao long wei shi 。]

english: Ahh I see that you have one of the rune defenders already! Well done.
translation: 啊啊我看到你已经有了一名符文防御者了！干得好。 [a a wo kan dao ni yi jing you le yi ming fu wen fang yu zhe le ！ gan de hao 。]

english: You should speak to my apprentice Lorelai in the basement and test yourself against even stronger Cyclopes!
translation: 你应该在地下室与我的学徒罗蕾莱交谈，并测试自己对抗更强大的独眼巨人！ [ni ying gai zai di xia shi yu wo de xue tu luo lei lai jiao tan ， bing ce shi zi ji dui kang geng qiang da de du yan ju ren ！]

english: The Cyclopes up here will continue to have a chance of dropping rune defenders. Have fun in there.
translation: 这里的独眼巨人将继续有机会掉落符文防御者。在那里玩得开心。 [zhe li de du yan ju ren jiang ji xu you ji hui diao luo fu wen fang yu zhe 。 zai na li wan de kai xin 。]

english: I have a Dragon defender, please let me in to kill some more Cyclopes!
translation: 我有龙卫士，请让我进去杀更多独眼巨人！ [wo you long wei shi ， qing rang wo jin qu sha geng duo du yan ju ren ！]

english: Well done! You can only get more Dragon defenders from the basement.
translation: 干得好！你只能从地下室得到更多的龙卫士。 [gan de hao ！ ni zhi neng cong di xia shi de dao geng duo de long wei shi 。]

english: If you'd rather stay up here, I've released the cyclopes that can drop rune defenders. Enter when you're ready.
translation: 如果你想留在这里，我已经释放了可以掉落符文防御者的独眼巨人。准备好后输入。 [ru guo ni xiang liu zai zhe li ， wo yi jing shi fang le ke yi diao luo fu wen fang yu zhe de du yan ju ren 。 zhun bei hao hou shu ru 。]

english: I see you have one of the dragon defenders already! Well done, but you can only get more dragon defenders from the basement.
translation: 我看到你已经有了一名龙卫士了！干得好，但你只能从地下室得到更多的龙卫士。 [wo kan dao ni yi jing you le yi ming long wei shi le ！ gan de hao ， dan ni zhi neng cong di xia shi de dao geng duo de long wei shi 。]

english: May I claim my tokens please?
translation: 我可以领取我的代币吗？ [wo ke yi ling qu wo de dai bi ma ？]

english: May I claim my tokens please?
translation: 我可以领取我的代币吗？ [wo ke yi ling qu wo de dai bi ma ？]

english: You don't have space to carry them.
translation: 你没有空间来携带它们。 [ni mei you kong jian lai xie dai ta men 。]

english: Of course! Here you go, you've earned [number] token[s]!
translation: 当然！在这里，您已经赢得了 [number] 个代币！ [dang ran ！ zai zhe li ， nin yi jing ying de le  [number]  ge dai bi ！]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: I'm afraid you have not earned any tokens yet. Try some of the activities around the guild to earn some.
translation: 恐怕您还没有获得任何代币。尝试公会周围的一些活动来赚取一些钱。 [kong pa nin hai mei you huo de ren he dai bi 。 chang shi gong hui zhou wei de yi xie huo dong lai zhuan qu yi xie qian 。]

english: Ok, I'll go see what I can find.
translation: 好吧，我去看看我能找到什么。 [hao ba ， wo qu kan kan wo neng zhao dao shen me 。]

english: Life isn't fair, that doesn't mean you can't win.
translation: 生活并不公平，但这并不意味着你不能获胜。 [sheng huo bing bu gong ping ， dan zhe bing bu yi wei zhe ni bu neng huo sheng 。]

english: Be masterof your mind rather than master by your mind.
translation: 成为你的思想的主人，而不是被你的思想所主宰。 [cheng wei ni de si xiang de zhu ren ， er bu shi bei ni de si xiang suo zhu zai 。]

english: A reflection on a pool of water does not reveal its depth.
translation: 水池上的倒影并不能显示其深度。 [shui chi shang de dao ying bing bu neng xian shi qi shen du 。]

english: When you aim for perfection, you discover it's a moving target.
translation: 当你追求完美时，你会发现它是一个不断变化的目标。 [dang ni zhui qiu wan mei shi ， ni hui fa xian ta shi yi ge bu duan bian hua de mu biao 。]

english: He who speaks in anger makes his anger heard, but his words forgotten.
translation: 怒气说话的人，虽然听到了他的怒气，却忘记了他的话。 [nu qi shuo hua de ren ， sui ran ting dao le ta de nu qi ， que wang ji le ta de hua 。]

english: Patience and persistence can bring down the tallest trees.
translation: 耐心和坚持可以推倒最高的树。 [nai xin he jian chi ke yi tui dao zui gao de shu 。]

english: I don't need that.
translation: 我不需要那个。 [wo bu xu yao na ge 。]

english: Here, have this.
translation: 给，这个。 [gei ， zhe ge 。]

english: Where are they from?
translation: 他们来自哪里？ [ta men lai zi na li ？]

english: How did they get here?
translation: 他们是怎么来到这里的？ [ta men shi zen me lai dao zhe li de ？]

english: Why are they here?
translation: 他们为什么在这里？ [ta men wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Hello youngster!
translation: 年轻人你好！ [nian qing ren ni hao ！]

english: The child is too busy playing to take any notice.
translation: 孩子正忙着玩耍，没有注意到。 [hai zi zheng mang zhe wan shua ， mei you zhu yi dao 。]

english: Hello. I Kangai Mau of the Rantuki tribe.
translation: 你好。我是 Rantuki 部落的 Kangai Mau。 [ni hao 。 wo shi  Rantuki  bu luo de  Kangai Mau。]

english: I looking for someone brave to go on important mission for me. Someone skilled in thievery and sneaking about. I am told I can find such people in Brimhaven.
translation: 我正在寻找勇敢的人来为我执行重要的使命。擅长偷窃和偷偷摸摸的人。有人告诉我在布里姆黑文可以找到这样的人。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yong gan de ren lai wei wo zhi xing zhong yao de shi ming 。 shan chang tou qie he tou tou mo mo de ren 。 you ren gao su wo zai bu li mu hei wen ke yi zhao dao zhe yang de ren 。]

english: Tell me of this mission.
translation: 告诉我这个任务。 [gao su wo zhe ge ren wu 。]

english: I need someone to go on a mission to the city of Ardougne. There you will find the house of Lord Handelmort. In his house he has our tribal totem.
translation: 我需要有人去阿尔杜涅市执行任务。在那里您会发现汉德尔莫特勋爵的宅邸。他的家里有我们的部落图腾。 [wo xu yao you ren qu a er du nie shi zhi xing ren wu 。 zai na li nin hui fa xian han de er mo te xun jue de zhai di 。 ta de jia li you wo men de bu luo tu teng 。]

english: We need it back.
translation: 我们需要它回来。 [wo men xu yao ta hui lai 。]

english: Why does he have it?
translation: 为什么他有它？ [wei shen me ta you ta ？]

english: Lord Handelmort is an Ardougnese explorer which means he think he have the right to come to my tribal home, steal our stuff and put in his private museum.
translation: 汉德尔莫特勋爵是一位阿杜涅探险家，这意味着他认为他有权来到我的部落家园，偷走我们的东西并放入他的私人博物馆。 [han de er mo te xun jue shi yi wei a du nie tan xian jia ， zhe yi wei zhe ta ren wei ta you quan lai dao wo de bu luo jia yuan ， tou zou wo men de dong xi bing fang ru ta de si ren bo wu guan 。]

english: Ok, I will get it back.
translation: 好的，我会把它拿回来。 [hao de ， wo hui ba ta na hui lai 。]

english: Best of luck with that adventurer.
translation: 祝那个冒险家好运。 [zhu na ge mao xian jia hao yun 。]

english: How can I find Handelmort's house? Ardougne is a big place...
translation: 我怎样才能找到汉德尔莫特的房子？阿杜涅是个很大的地方... [wo zen yang cai neng zhao dao han de er mo te de fang zi ？ a du nie shi ge hen da de di fang ...]

english: I don't know Ardougne. You tell me.
translation: 我不认识阿杜涅。你告诉我。 [wo bu ren shi a du nie 。 ni gao su wo 。]

english: Well good luck with that.
translation: 祝你好运。 [zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Let's hope I find some help soon.
translation: 希望我能尽快找到一些帮助。 [xi wang wo neng jin kuai zhao dao yi xie bang zhu 。]

english: I'm in search of adventure!
translation: 我正在寻找冒险！ [wo zheng zai xun zhao mao xian ！]

english: Adventure is something I may be able to give.
translation: 冒险是我可以给予的。 [mao xian shi wo ke yi ji yu de 。]

english: Who are the Rantuki tribe?
translation: 兰图基部落是谁？ [lan tu ji bu luo shi shui ？]

english: A proud and noble tribe of Karamja. But now we are few, as men come from across sea, steal our land, and settle on our hunting grounds.
translation: 一个骄傲而高贵的卡拉姆贾部落。但现在我们已经很少了，因为有人从大洋彼岸来到这里，偷走了我们的土地，定居在我们的狩猎场上。 [yi ge jiao ao er gao gui de ka la mu jia bu luo 。 dan xian zai wo men yi jing hen shao le ， yin wei you ren cong da yang bi an lai dao zhe li ， tou zou le wo men de tu di ， ding ju zai wo men de shou lie chang shang 。]

english: And what are you doing in Brimhaven?
translation: 你在布里姆黑文做什么？ [ni zai bu li mu hei wen zuo shen me ？]

english: Have you got our totem back?
translation: 你把我们的图腾拿回来了吗？ [ni ba wo men de tu teng na hui lai le ma ？]

english: No, it's not that easy.
translation: 不，这并不那么容易。 [bu ， zhe bing bu na me rong yi 。]

english: Bah, you no good.
translation: 呸，你不好。 [pei ， ni bu hao 。]

english: Yes I have.
translation: 是的，我有。 [shi de ， wo you 。]

english: You have??? Many thanks brave adventurer! Here, have some freshly cooked Karamjan fish, caught specially by my tribe.
translation: 你有？？？非常感谢勇敢的冒险家！来尝尝我部落特意捕获的新鲜烹制的卡拉姆江鱼。 [ni you ？？？ fei chang gan xie yong gan de mao xian jia ！ lai chang chang wo bu luo te yi bu huo de xin xian peng zhi de ka la mu jiang yu 。]

english: You hand over the Tribal Totem.
translation: 你交出部落图腾。 [ni jiao chu bu luo tu teng 。]

english: Congratulations! Quest complete!
translation: 恭喜！任务完成！ [gong xi ！ ren wu wan cheng ！]

english: Many greetings esteemed thief.
translation: 多多问候尊敬的小偷。 [duo duo wen hou zun jing de xiao tou 。]

english: Hey.
translation: 嘿。 [hei 。]

english: Congrats. Here!
translation: 恭喜。这里！ [gong xi 。 zhe li ！]

english: And what are you doing in Brimhaven?
translation: 你在布里姆黑文做什么？ [ni zai bu li mu hei wen zuo shen me ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: I'm in search of adventure!
translation: 我正在寻找冒险！ [wo zheng zai xun zhao mao xian ！]

english: Who are the Rantuki tribe?
translation: 兰图基部落是谁？ [lan tu ji bu luo shi shui ？]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: What brings you to our holy monument?
translation: 是什么让您来到我们的神圣纪念碑？ [shi shen me rang nin lai dao wo men de shen sheng ji nian bei ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: We are the druids of Guthix. We worship our god at our famous stone circles. You will find them located throughout these lands.
translation: 我们是古斯克斯的德鲁伊。我们在著名的石圈上敬拜我们的神。你会发现它们遍布这些土地。 [wo men shi gu si ke si de de lu yi 。 wo men zai zhu ming de shi quan shang jing bai wo men de shen 。 ni hui fa xian ta men bian bu zhe xie tu di 。]

english: What about the stone circle full of dark wizards?
translation: 那充满黑暗巫师的石圈呢？ [na chong man hei an wu shi de shi quan ne ？]

english: That used to be OUR stone circle. Unfortunately, many many years ago, dark wizards cast a wicked spell upon it so that they could corrupt its power for their own evil ends.
translation: 那曾经是我们的石圈。不幸的是，许多年前，黑巫师对它施下了邪恶的咒语，以便他们可以为了自己的邪恶目的而腐蚀它的力量。 [na ceng jing shi wo men de shi quan 。 bu xing de shi ， xu duo nian qian ， hei wu shi dui ta shi xia le xie e de zhou yu ， yi bian ta men ke yi wei le zi ji de xie e mu di er fu shi ta de li liang 。]

english: When they cursed the rocks for their rituals they made them useless to us and our magics. We require a brave adventurer to go on a quest for us to help purify the circle of Varrock.
translation: 当他们因为仪式而诅咒岩石时，他们就让它们对我们和我们的魔法变得毫无用处。我们需要一位勇敢的冒险家来帮助我们净化瓦罗克圈子。 [dang ta men yin wei yi shi er zu zhou yan shi shi ， ta men jiu rang ta men dui wo men he wo men de mo fa bian de hao wu yong chu 。 wo men xu yao yi wei yong gan de mao xian jia lai bang zhu wo men jing hua wa luo ke quan zi 。]

english: So what's so good about Guthix?
translation: 那么 Guthix 有什么好处呢？ [na me  Guthix  you shen me hao chu ne ？]

english: Guthix is the oldest and most powerful god in Gielinor. His existence is vital to this world. He is the god of balance, and nature; he is also a very part of this world.
translation: 古蒂克斯是吉林诺最古老、最强大的神。他的存在对于这个世界来说至关重要。他是平衡之神和自然之神；他也是这个世界的一部分。 [gu di ke si shi ji lin nuo zui gu lao 、 zui qiang da de shen 。 ta de cun zai dui yu zhe ge shi jie lai shuo zhi guan zhong yao 。 ta shi ping heng zhi shen he zi ran zhi shen ； ta ye shi zhe ge shi jie de yi bu fen 。]

english: He exists in the trees, and the flowers, the water and the rocks. He is everywhere. His purpose is to ensure balance in everything in this world, and as such we worship him.
translation: 他存在于树木、花朵、水和岩石中。他无处不在。他的目的是确保这个世界上一切的平衡，因此我们崇拜他。 [ta cun zai yu shu mu 、 hua duo 、 shui he yan shi zhong 。 ta wu chu bu zai 。 ta de mu di shi que bao zhe ge shi jie shang yi qie de ping heng ， yin ci wo men chong bai ta 。]

english: He sounds kind of boring...
translation: 他听起来有点无聊…… [ta ting qi lai you dian wu liao ……]

english: Some day when your mind achieves enlightenment you will see the true beauty of his power.
translation: 有一天，当你的心开悟时，你会看到他力量的真正美丽。 [you yi tian ， dang ni de xin kai wu shi ， ni hui kan dao ta li liang de zhen zheng mei li 。]

english: Well, I'll be on my way now.
translation: 嗯，我现在就上路。 [n ， wo xian zai jiu shang lu 。]

english: Goodbye adventurer. I feel we shall meet again.
translation: 再见冒险家。我感觉我们还会再见面的。 [zai jian mao xian jia 。 wo gan jue wo men hai hui zai jian mian de 。]

english: I'm in search of a quest.
translation: 我正在寻找一个任务。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yi ge ren wu 。]

english: Hmm. I think I may have a worthwhile quest for you actually. I don't know if you are familiar with the stone circle south of Varrock or not, but...
translation: 唔。我想我对你可能有一个有价值的追求。我不知道你是否熟悉瓦罗克以南的石圈，但是…… [wu 。 wo xiang wo dui ni ke neng you yi ge you jia zhi de zhui qiu 。 wo bu zhi dao ni shi fou shu xi wa luo ke yi nan de shi quan ， dan shi ……]

english: Okay, I will try and help.
translation: 好的，我会尽力提供帮助。 [hao de ， wo hui jin li ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: Excellent. Go to the village south of this place and speak to my fellow druid, Sanfew, who is working on the purification ritual. He knows what is required to complete it.
translation: 出色的。去这个地方南边的村庄，和我的德鲁伊同伴桑菲说话，他正在做净化仪式。他知道完成它需要什么。 [chu se de 。 qu zhe ge di fang nan bian de cun zhuang ， he wo de de lu yi tong ban sang fei shuo hua ， ta zheng zai zuo jing hua yi shi 。 ta zhi dao wan cheng ta xu yao shen me 。]

english: Will do.
translation: 会做。 [hui zuo 。]

english: No, that doesn't sound very interesting.
translation: 不，这听起来不太有趣。 [bu ， zhe ting qi lai bu tai you qu 。]

english: I will not try and change your mind adventurer. Some day when you have matured you may reconsider your position. We will wait until then.
translation: 我不会试图改变你冒险家的想法。有一天，当你成熟时，你可能会重新考虑你的立场。我们会等到那时。 [wo bu hui shi tu gai bian ni mao xian jia de xiang fa 。 you yi tian ， dang ni cheng shu shi ， ni ke neng hui chong xin kao lv ni de li chang 。 wo men hui deng dao na shi 。]

english: Did you build this?
translation: 这是你建的吗？ [zhe shi ni jian de ma ？]

english: What, personally? No, of course I didn't. However, our forefathers did. The first Druids of Guthix built many stone circles across these lands over eight hundred years ago.
translation: 什么，个人？不，我当然没有。然而，我们的祖先做到了。八百多年前，古西克斯的第一批德鲁伊在这片土地上建造了许多石圈。 [shen me ， ge ren ？ bu ， wo dang ran mei you 。 ran er ， wo men de zu xian zuo dao le 。 ba bai duo nian qian ， gu xi ke si de di yi pi de lu yi zai zhe pian tu di shang jian zao le xu duo shi quan 。]

english: Unfortunately we only know of two remaining, and of those only one is usable by us anymore.
translation: 不幸的是，我们只知道剩下两个，而其中只有一个可供我们使用。 [bu xing de shi ， wo men zhi zhi dao sheng xia liang ge ， er qi zhong zhi you yi ge ke gong wo men shi yong 。]

english: Hello again. How is the Herblore going?
translation: 又好。 Herblore 进展如何？ [you hao 。 Herblore  jin zhan ru he ？]

english: Very well, thank you.
translation: 很好，谢谢。 [hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: That is good to hear.
translation: 很高兴听到这个消息。 [hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi 。]

english: I need more practice at it...
translation: 我需要更多练习... [wo xu yao geng duo lian xi ...]

english: Persistence is key to success.
translation: 坚持是成功的关键。 [jian chi shi cheng gong de guan jian 。]

english: Can you explain the fundamentals again?
translation: 你能再解释一下基本原理吗？ [ni neng zai jie shi yi xia ji ben yuan li ma ？]

english: Indeed I will...
translation: 确实我会... [que shi wo hui ...]

english: Herblore is the skill of working with herbs and other ingredients, to make useful potions and poison.
translation: Herblore是一种使用草药和其他成分来制造有用的药水和毒药的技能。 [Herblore shi yi zhong shi yong cao yao he qi ta cheng fen lai zhi zao you yong de yao shui he du yao de ji neng 。]

english: First you will need a vial, which can be found or made with the crafting skill.
translation: 首先，您需要一个小瓶，可以通过制作技能找到或制作它。 [shou xian ， nin xu yao yi ge xiao ping ， ke yi tong guo zhi zuo ji neng zhao dao huo zhi zuo ta 。]

english: Then you must gather the herbs needed to make the potion you want.
translation: 然后你必须收集制作你想要的药水所需的草药。 [ran hou ni bi xu shou ji zhi zuo ni xiang yao de yao shui suo xu de cao yao 。]

english: You must fill your vial with water and add the ingredients you need. There are normally 2 ingredients to each type of potion.
translation: 您必须将小瓶装满水并添加所需的成分。每种药水通常有 2 种成分。 [nin bi xu jiang xiao ping zhuang man shui bing tian jia suo xu de cheng fen 。 mei zhong yao shui tong chang you  2  zhong cheng fen 。]

english: Bear in mind, you must first clean each herb before you can use it.
translation: 请记住，您必须先清洁每种草药才能使用它。 [qing ji zhu ， nin bi xu xian qing jie mei zhong cao yao cai neng shi yong ta 。]

english: You may also have to grind some ingredients before you can use them. You will need a pestle and mortar in order to do this.
translation: 您可能还需要先研磨一些成分才能使用它们。为此，您需要杵和研钵。 [nin ke neng hai xu yao xian yan mo yi xie cheng fen cai neng shi yong ta men 。 wei ci ， nin xu yao chu he yan bo 。]

english: Herbs can be found on the ground, and are also dropped by some monsters when you kill them.
translation: 草药可以在地面上找到，并且当你杀死一些怪物时也会掉落草药。 [cao yao ke yi zai di mian shang zhao dao ， bing qie dang ni sha si yi xie guai wu shi ye hui diao luo cao yao 。]

english: Let's try an example Attack potion: The first ingredient is Guam leaf; the next is Eye of Newt.
translation: 我们来尝试一下攻击药水：第一个成分是关岛叶；下一个是蝾螈之眼。 [wo men lai chang shi yi xia gong ji yao shui ： di yi ge cheng fen shi guan dao ye ； xia yi ge shi rong yuan zhi yan 。]

english: Mix these in your water-filled vial, and you will produce an Attack potion. Drink this potion to increase your Attack level.
translation: 将它们混合在装满水的小瓶中，你就会生产出攻击药水。喝下此药水可以提高你的攻击等级。 [jiang ta men hun he zai zhuang man shui de xiao ping zhong ， ni jiu hui sheng chan chu gong ji yao shui 。 he xia ci yao shui ke yi ti gao ni de gong ji deng ji 。]

english: Different potions also require different Herblore levels before you can make them.
translation: 不同的药水还需要不同的 Herblore 等级才能制作。 [bu tong de yao shui hai xu yao bu tong de  Herblore  deng ji cai neng zhi zuo 。]

english: Good luck with your Herblore practices, and a good day to you.
translation: 祝您 Herblore 练习顺利，祝您有美好的一天。 [zhu nin  Herblore  lian xi shun li ， zhu nin you mei hao de yi tian 。]

english: Thanks for your help.
translation: 感谢您的帮助。 [gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]

english: What must I do to wear a Herblore skillcape?
translation: 我必须做什么才能穿戴 Herblore 技能斗篷？ [wo bi xu zuo shen me cai neng chuan dai  Herblore  ji neng dou peng ？]

english: To earn the right to wear any skillcape you need to have mastered that skill to the highest level possible and it is no different for Herblore.
translation: 要获得穿着任何技能斗篷的权利，您需要将该技能掌握到尽可能高的水平，对于 Herblore 来说也不例外。 [yao huo de chuan zhe ren he ji neng dou peng de quan li ， nin xu yao jiang gai ji neng zhang wo dao jin ke neng gao de shui ping ， dui yu  Herblore  lai shuo ye bu li wai 。]

english: With the cape equipped the Nardah Herbalist will create unfinished potions for you and you may search the cape for a pestle and mortar. When you have achieved a level of 99, come back and talk to me again.
translation: 装备好斗篷后，纳尔达草药师将为您制作未完成的药剂，您可以在斗篷中寻找杵和研钵。等你达到99级了，再回来跟我说话。 [zhuang bei hao dou peng hou ， na er da cao yao shi jiang wei nin zhi zuo wei wan cheng de yao ji ， nin ke yi zai dou peng zhong xun zhao chu he yan bo 。 deng ni da dao 99 ji le ， zai hui lai gen wo shuo hua 。]

english: Most certainly; the Nardah Herbalist will recognize this cape and create unfinished potions for you and it may be searched for a pestle and mortar.
translation: 最肯定的是；纳尔达草药师会认出这件披风，并为你制作未完成的药剂，并且可能会在其中寻找杵和研钵。 [zui ken ding de shi ； na er da cao yao shi hui ren chu zhe jian pi feng ， bing wei ni zhi zuo wei wan cheng de yao ji ， bing qie ke neng hui zai qi zhong xun zhao chu he yan bo 。]

english: It has been a pleasure to watch you grow as a herbalist. I am privileged to have been instrumental in your learning, but I must ask for a donation of 99,000 coins to cover the expense of the cape.
translation: 很高兴看到您成长为一名草药师。我很荣幸能为您的学习提供帮助，但我必须请求捐赠 99,000 个硬币来支付海角的费用。 [hen gao xing kan dao nin cheng zhang wei yi ming cao yao shi 。 wo hen rong xing neng wei nin de xue xi ti gong bang zhu ， dan wo bi xu qing qiu juan zeng  99,000  ge ying bi lai zhi fu hai jiao de fei yong 。]

english: I'm afraid that's too much money for me.
translation: 恐怕这钱对我来说太多了。 [kong pa zhe qian dui wo lai shuo tai duo le 。]

english: Not at all; there are many other adventurers who would love the opportunity to purchase such a prestigious item. You can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: 一点也不;还有许多其他冒险家希望有机会购买如此享有盛誉的物品。如果你改变主意，可以在这里找到我。 [yi dian ye bu ; hai you xu duo qi ta mao xian jia xi wang you ji hui gou mai ru ci xiang you sheng yu de wu pin 。 ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， ke yi zai zhe li zhao dao wo 。]

english: Okay, here's 99,000 coins.
translation: 好的，这是 99,000 个硬币。 [hao de ， zhe shi  99,000  ge ying bi 。]

english: Good luck to you, [player name].
translation: 祝你好运，[玩家姓名]。 [zhu ni hao yun ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Most certainly, but I must ask for a donation of 99,000 coins to cover the expense of the cape.
translation: 当然可以，但我必须请求捐赠 99,000 个硬币来支付斗篷的费用。 [dang ran ke yi ， dan wo bi xu qing qiu juan zeng  99,000  ge ying bi lai zhi fu dou peng de fei yong 。]

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood; it's part of a skill promotion deal - buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 不幸的是，所有的 Skillcapes 都只提供免费的兜帽；这是技能提升交易的一部分——买一送一，你知道的。因此，在我向您出售一件之前，您需要释放一些库存空间。 [bu xing de shi ， suo you de  Skillcapes  dou zhi ti gong mian fei de dou mao ； zhe shi ji neng ti sheng jiao yi de yi bu fen —— mai yi song yi ， ni zhi dao de 。 yin ci ， zai wo xiang nin chu shou yi jian zhi qian ， nin xu yao shi fang yi xie ku cun kong jian 。]

english: Can I get a hood for my skillcape, please?
translation: 我可以为我的技能斗篷买一个兜帽吗？ [wo ke yi wei wo de ji neng dou peng mai yi ge dou mao ma ？]

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
translation: 毫无疑问，而且免费！ [hao wu yi wen ， er qie mian fei ！]

english: You don't appear to have enough space in your inventory, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 您的库存似乎没有足够的空间，当您有足够的空间时请回来见我。 [nin de ku cun si hu mei you zu gou de kong jian ， dang nin you zu gou de kong jian shi qing hui lai jian wo 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: What about the stone circle full of dark wizards?
translation: 那充满黑暗巫师的石圈呢？ [na chong man hei an wu shi de shi quan ne ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: So what's so good about Guthix?
translation: 那么 Guthix 有什么好处呢？ [na me  Guthix  you shen me hao chu ne ？]

english: Well, I'll be on my way now.
translation: 嗯，我现在就上路。 [n ， wo xian zai jiu shang lu 。]

english: I'm in search of a quest.
translation: 我正在寻找一个任务。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yi ge ren wu 。]

english: Did you build this?
translation: 这是你建的吗？ [zhe shi ni jian de ma ？]

english: I'm in search of a quest
translation: 我正在寻找一个任务 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yi ge ren wu]

english: Very well, thank you.
translation: 很好，谢谢。 [hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: I need more practice at it...
translation: 我需要更多练习... [wo xu yao geng duo lian xi ...]

english: Can you explain the fundamentals again?
translation: 你能再解释一下基本原理吗？ [ni neng zai jie shi yi xia ji ben yuan li ma ？]

english: What must I do to wear a Herblore skillcape?
translation: 我必须做什么才能穿戴 Herblore 技能斗篷？ [wo bi xu zuo shen me cai neng chuan dai  Herblore  ji neng dou peng ？]

english: May I buy a Herblore skillcape, please
translation: 我可以买一件 Herblore 技能斗篷吗 [wo ke yi mai yi jian  Herblore  ji neng dou peng ma]

english: I'm afraid that's too much money for me.
translation: 恐怕这钱对我来说太多了。 [kong pa zhe qian dui wo lai shuo tai duo le 。]

english: Okay, here's 99,000 coins.
translation: 好的，这是 99,000 个硬币。 [hao de ， zhe shi  99,000  ge ying bi 。]

english: Can I get a hood for my skillcape, please?
translation: 我可以为我的技能斗篷买一个兜帽吗？ [wo ke yi wei wo de ji neng dou peng mai yi ge dou mao ma ？]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Oh, I'm a fisherman by trade and I sometimes help out my father, Safta Doc.
translation: 哦，我是一名渔民，有时我会帮助我的父亲 Safta Doc。 [o ， wo shi yi ming yu min ， you shi wo hui bang zhu wo de fu qin  Safta Doc。]

english: Is there anything interesting to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么好玩的吗？ [zhe fu jin you shen me hao wan de ma ？]

english: Bwana, if anyone else asks me that question today, I'll explode! Go and ask someone else!
translation: Bwana，如果今天还有人问我这个问题，我会爆炸的！你去问问别人吧！ [Bwana， ru guo jin tian hai you ren wen wo zhe ge wen ti ， wo hui bao zha de ！ ni qu wen wen bie ren ba ！]

english: Not that I'm aware of, just sit back and enjoy the sunshine bwana!
translation: 我不知道，只是坐下来享受阳光 bwana！ [wo bu zhi dao ， zhi shi zuo xia lai xiang shou yang guang  bwana！]

english: Sorry Bwana, I'm already busy, why not go and talk to Murcaily! He's around the village somewhere.
translation: 抱歉 Bwana，我已经很忙了，为什么不去和 Murcaily 谈谈呢！他就在村子附近的某个地方。 [bao qian  Bwana， wo yi jing hen mang le ， wei shen me bu qu he  Murcaily  tan tan ne ！ ta jiu zai cun zi fu jin de mou ge di fang 。]

english: Well, I think that there's some work to be done...perhaps Murcaily can help you. He usually tends to the hardwood grove to the east of Trufitus's hut.
translation: 嗯，我认为还有一些工作要做……也许 Murcaily 可以帮助你。他通常照料特鲁菲特斯小屋东边的硬木树林。 [n ， wo ren wei hai you yi xie gong zuo yao zuo …… ye xu  Murcaily  ke yi bang zhu ni 。 ta tong chang zhao liao te lu fei te si xiao wu dong bian de ying mu shu lin 。]

english: It's just village life as normal around here Bwana, always something interesting to find to occupy your time if you look hard enough.
translation: 布瓦纳（Bwana）这里的乡村生活一如往常，只要您仔细观察，总能找到一些有趣的东西来打发您的时间。 [bu wa na （Bwana） zhe li de xiang cun sheng huo yi ru wang chang ， zhi yao nin zi xi guan cha ， zong neng zhao dao yi xie you qu de dong xi lai da fa nin de shi jian 。]

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 我一直在村里做一些工作。 [wo yi zhi zai cun li zuo yi xie gong zuo 。]

english: I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: 我已经给了你一些交易棒，现在我身上没有了。为什么不去和其他一些村民谈谈并获得一些捐款呢？ [wo yi jing gei le ni yi xie jiao yi bang ， xian zai wo shen shang mei you le 。 wei shen me bu qu he qi ta yi xie cun min tan tan bing huo de yi xie juan kuan ne ？]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Hey, I've seen you working around the village. You've been doing a lot of good work around here for us. Let me give you something for your trouble.
translation: 嘿，我见过你在村子里干活。你在这里为我们做了很多出色的工作。让我给你一些东西来缓解你的麻烦。 [hei ， wo jian guo ni zai cun zi li gan huo 。 ni zai zhe li wei wo men zuo le hen duo chu se de gong zuo 。 rang wo gei ni yi xie dong xi lai huan jie ni de ma fan 。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: 这里有什么有趣的事情可以做吗？ [zhe li you shen me you qu de shi qing ke yi zuo ma ？]

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 我一直在村里做一些工作。 [wo yi zhi zai cun li zuo yi xie gong zuo 。]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: You dare disturb my rest!
translation: 你居然敢打扰我休息！ [ni ju ran gan da rao wo xiu xi ！]

english: You dare steal from us!
translation: 你竟然敢偷我们的东西！ [ni jing ran gan tou wo men de dong xi ！]

english: Would you like to buy a nice kebab? Only one gold.
translation: 你想买一个好吃的烤肉串吗？只有一枚金牌。 [ni xiang mai yi ge hao chi de kao rou chuan ma ？ zhi you yi mei jin pai 。]

english: I think I'll give it a miss.
translation: 我想我会错过它。 [wo xiang wo hui cuo guo ta 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Oops, I forgot to bring any money with me.
translation: 糟糕，我忘记带钱了。 [zao gao ， wo wang ji dai qian le 。]

english: Come back when you have some.
translation: 当你有一些的时候就回来吧。 [dang ni you yi xie de shi hou jiu hui lai ba 。]

english: What do you think of Ali Morrisane?
translation: 你觉得阿里·莫里森怎么样？ [ni jue de a li · mo li sen zen me yang ？]

english: I don't like him. He makes all these claims about being the best salesman in Gielinor, and he even has some thugs that he's hired to threaten us.
translation: 我不喜欢他。他声称自己是吉利诺最好的推销员，甚至还雇了一些暴徒来威胁我们。 [wo bu xi huan ta 。 ta sheng cheng zi ji shi ji li nuo zui hao de tui xiao yuan ， shen zhi hai gu le yi xie bao tu lai wei xie wo men 。]

english: One of them came round here and threatened to cut my head off if I didn't cooperate with them!
translation: 其中一个来到这里并威胁如果我不配合他们就砍掉我的头！ [qi zhong yi ge lai dao zhe li bing wei xie ru guo wo bu pei he ta men jiu kan diao wo de tou ！]

english: I've also heard some rumours about them from my friend Ali in Pollnivneach...
translation: 我还从我在 Pollnivneach 的朋友 Ali 那里听到了一些关于他们的谣言...... [wo hai cong wo zai  Pollnivneach  de peng you  Ali  na li ting dao le yi xie guan yu ta men de yao yan ......]

english: What sort of rumours?
translation: 什么样的谣言？ [shen me yang de yao yan ？]

english: Apparently he has men there as well, who have also been threatening people.
translation: 显然他那里也有手下，他们也一直在威胁人们。 [xian ran ta na li ye you shou xia ， ta men ye yi zhi zai wei xie ren men 。]

english: And it's said that they even intend to steal from the ruler of Al-Kharid himself!
translation: 据说他们甚至打算从哈利德的统治者本人那里偷东西！ [ju shuo ta men shen zhi da suan cong ha li de de tong zhi zhe ben ren na li tou dong xi ！]

english: Really?
translation: 真的吗？ [zhen de ma ？]

english: That's what I've heard. Anyway, are you sure you wouldn't like a kebab?
translation: 这就是我所听到的。无论如何，你确定你不喜欢烤肉串吗？ [zhe jiu shi wo suo ting dao de 。 wu lun ru he ， ni que ding ni bu xi huan kao rou chuan ma ？]

english: I've got a little problem for you to solve.
translation: 我有一个小问题需要你解决。 [wo you yi ge xiao wen ti xu yao ni jie jue 。]

english: The salesman has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 推销员给了你一张挑战卷轴！ [tui xiao yuan gei le ni yi zhang tiao zhan juan zhou ！]

english: Please enter the answer to the riddle.
translation: 请输入谜语的答案。 [qing shu ru mi yu de da an 。]

english: No that's not right, think again.
translation: 不，这是不对的，再想一想。 [bu ， zhe shi bu dui de ， zai xiang yi xiang 。]

english: Correct!
translation: 正确的！ [zheng que de ！]

english: The salesman has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 推销员给了你另一张线索卷轴！ [tui xiao yuan gei le ni ling yi zhang xian suo juan zhou ！]

english: I think I'll give it a miss.
translation: 我想我会错过它。 [wo xiang wo hui cuo guo ta 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: What do you think of Ali Morrisane?
translation: 你觉得阿里·莫里森怎么样？ [ni jue de a li · mo li sen zen me yang ？]

english: Hello there, human! Come in, come in!
translation: 你好，人类！进来吧，进来吧！ [ni hao ， ren lei ！ jin lai ba ， jin lai ba ！]

english: Hi, nice to see you!
translation: 你好，很高兴见到你！ [ni hao ， hen gao xing jian dao ni ！]

english: Tell me, what brings you here?
translation: 告诉我，是什么风把你吹到这里来的？ [gao su wo ， shi shen me feng ba ni chui dao zhe li lai de ？]

english: Well, first I came to this city just for the adventure and excitement, but then I knocked over this statue, you see. Well, I didn't really knock it over myself, I was on this boat.
translation: 嗯，一开始我来到这座城市只是为了冒险和刺激，但后来我撞倒了这座雕像，你看。好吧，我自己并没有真正把事情搞砸，我就在这条船上。 [n ， yi kai shi wo lai dao zhe zuo cheng shi zhi shi wei le mao xian he ci ji ， dan hou lai wo zhuang dao le zhe zuo diao xiang ， ni kan 。 hao ba ， wo zi ji bing mei you zhen zheng ba shi qing gao za ， wo jiu zai zhe tiao chuan shang 。]

english: A boat! Fascinating, go on!
translation: 一条船！迷人，继续！ [yi tiao chuan ！ mi ren ， ji xu ！]

english: Yes, well, this boatman was a bit rubbish, or there was something wrong with the ship, I don't know. And then I got arrested by the Black Guard.
translation: 是啊，好吧，这个船夫有点垃圾，还是船出了问题，我不知道。然后我就被黑卫逮捕了。 [shi a ， hao ba ， zhe ge chuan fu you dian la ji ， hai shi chuan chu le wen ti ， wo bu zhi dao 。 ran hou wo jiu bei hei wei dai bu le 。]

english: Not the Black Guard!
translation: 不是黑卫！ [bu shi hei wei ！]

english: Yes, and they took me to this Veldaban person, who pretended to be really angry but actually he was really nice and he asked me for my help.
translation: 是的，他们带我去见这个维达班人，他假装很生气，但实际上他真的很好，他向我寻求帮助。 [shi de ， ta men dai wo qu jian zhe ge wei da ban ren ， ta jia zhuang hen sheng qi ， dan shi ji shang ta zhen de hen hao ， ta xiang wo xun qiu bang zhu 。]

english: And after a whole lot of running around, I finally managed to get the statue to be rebuilt.
translation: 经过一番奔走，我终于设法重建了雕像。 [jing guo yi fan ben zou ， wo zhong yu she fa chong jian le diao xiang 。]

english: Such an interesting tale!
translation: 多么有趣的故事啊！ [duo me you qu de gu shi a ！]

english: Now how did you come to be in Keldagrim again?
translation: 现在你怎么又来到凯尔达格林了？ [xian zai ni zen me you lai dao kai er da ge lin le ？]

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: Well? Who are you?
translation: 出色地？你是谁？ [chu se di ？ ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm player, and you are?
translation: 我是玩家，你是吗？ [wo shi wan jia ， ni shi ma ？]

english: I think you already know the answer to that.
translation: 我想你已经知道答案了。 [wo xiang ni yi jing zhi dao da an le 。]

english: Er... Do I?
translation: 呃……我是吗？ [e …… wo shi ma ？]

english: Shaw. Kasonde Shaw. Don't go acting like you haven't been following me for some time now.
translation: 肖.卡松德·肖.别表现得好像你已经有一段时间没有关注我了。 [xiao . ka song de · xiao . bie biao xian de hao xiang ni yi jing you yi duan shi jian mei you guan zhu wo le 。]

english: Ah, of course. Those old ruins.
translation: 啊，当然。那些古老的废墟。 [a ， dang ran 。 na xie gu lao de fei xu 。]

english: Exactly. Perhaps you took me for a fool, but I was on to you from the start. Considering what we learnt, I knew it was only a matter of time before you showed up.
translation: 确切地。也许你把我当成了傻瓜，但我从一开始就对你了如指掌。考虑到我们所了解到的情况，我知道你出现只是时间问题。 [que qie di 。 ye xu ni ba wo dang cheng le sha gua ， dan wo cong yi kai shi jiu dui ni liao ru zhi zhang 。 kao lv dao wo men suo liao jie dao de qing kuang ， wo zhi dao ni chu xian zhi shi shi jian wen ti 。]

english: You mean soul transference? Not actually something that interests me, to be honest.
translation: 你说的是灵魂转移？老实说，实际上并不是我感兴趣的东西。 [ni shuo de shi ling hun zhuan yi ？ lao shi shuo ， shi ji shang bing bu shi wo gan xing qu de dong xi 。]

english: Don't take me for a fool! If you had no interest in the Old Ones' secrets, why would you have followed me to those ruins? And why would you have come here?
translation: 别把我当傻子了！如果你对古圣的秘密不感兴趣，你为什么要跟着我去那些废墟？你为什么要来这里？ [bie ba wo dang sha zi le ！ ru guo ni dui gu sheng de mi mi bu gan xing qu ， ni wei shen me yao gen zhe wo qu na xie fei xu ？ ni wei shen me yao lai zhe li ？]

english: To be honest, I didn't even know what an Old One was. I still don't really. I was just exploring when I found your camp.
translation: 说实话，我什至不知道什么是老者。我还是不太明白。当我发现你的营地时，我正在探索。 [shuo shi hua ， wo shen zhi bu zhi dao shen me shi lao zhe 。 wo hai shi bu tai ming bai 。 dang wo fa xian ni de ying di shi ， wo zheng zai tan suo 。]

english: As for why I'm here, I'm looking for information about someone called Vardorvis.
translation: 至于我来这里的原因，是为了寻找有关一个名叫瓦多维斯的人的信息。 [zhi yu wo lai zhe li de yuan yin ， shi wei le xun zhao you guan yi ge ming jiao wa duo wei si de ren de xin xi 。]

english: Really? You want me to believe that all of this is a coincidence?
translation: 真的吗？你想让我相信这一切都是巧合吗？ [zhen de ma ？ ni xiang rang wo xiang xin zhe yi qie dou shi qiao he ma ？]

english: Well... yes.
translation: 嗯...是的。 [n ... shi de 。]

english: You're lying! You're lying and...
translation: 你在撒谎！你在撒谎而且... [ni zai sa huang ！ ni zai sa huang er qie ...]

english: Hang on... do you hear that?
translation: 等等……你听到了吗？ [deng deng …… ni ting dao le ma ？]

english: Hear what?
translation: 听到什么？ [ting dao shen me ？]

english: The Strangled! Did you disturb any tendrils on your way in here?
translation: 被勒死的！你来这里的路上有没有打扰到任何卷须？ [bei lei si de ！ ni lai zhe li de lu shang you mei you da rao dao ren he juan xu ？]

english: I may have...?
translation: 我可能有……？ [wo ke neng you ……？]

english: They'll be coming. We've got no chance up here. Head down below! Now!
translation: 他们会来的。我们在这里没有机会。低头往下看！现在！ [ta men hui lai de 。 wo men zai zhe li mei you ji hui 。 di tou wang xia kan ！ xian zai ！]

english: That's the lot of them. Let's head back up.
translation: 这就是他们中的很多人。我们回去吧。 [zhe jiu shi ta men zhong de hen duo ren 。 wo men hui qu ba 。]

english: That was too close. You nearly got us both killed!
translation: 那太近了。你差点害死我们俩！ [na tai jin le 。 ni cha dian hai si wo men lia ！]

english: I don't understand... What are those things? Are they zombies?
translation: 我不明白……那些东西是什么？他们是僵尸吗？ [wo bu ming bai …… na xie dong xi shi shen me ？ ta men shi jiang shi ma ？]

english: You really want me to believe that you don't know anything about this place?
translation: 你真的想让我相信你对这个地方一无所知吗？ [ni zhen de xiang rang wo xiang xin ni dui zhe ge di fang yi wu suo zhi ma ？]

english: I already told you, I wasn't lying.
translation: 我已经告诉过你了，我没有说谎。 [wo yi jing gao su guo ni le ， wo mei you shuo huang 。]

english: Well I don't have any reason to trust that.
translation: 好吧，我没有任何理由相信这一点。 [hao ba ， wo mei you ren he li you xiang xin zhe yi dian 。]

english: With how dangerous this place is, do you really have a choice?
translation: 这里如此危险，你真的有选择吗？ [zhe li ru ci wei xian ， ni zhen de you xuan ze ma ？]

english: Hmm...
Alright, fine. But I have no desire to see you get us killed, so you'd better wisen up fast.
translation: 好吧，好吧。但我不想看到你害死我们，所以你最好快点醒悟。 [hao ba ， hao ba 。 dan wo bu xiang kan dao ni hai si wo men ， suo yi ni zui hao kuai dian xing wu 。]

english: I'm listening.
translation: 我在听。 [wo zai ting 。]

english: It all starts with the Old Ones. They lived here long before humans came to these lands, and these ruins here were once their home.
translation: 一切都从旧日​​之人开始。早在人类来到这片土地之前，他们就生活在这里，这里的这些废墟也曾经是他们的家园。 [yi qie dou cong jiu ri ​​ zhi ren kai shi 。 zao zai ren lei lai dao zhe pian tu di zhi qian ， ta men jiu sheng huo zai zhe li ， zhe li de zhe xie fei xu ye ceng jing shi ta men de jia yuan 。]

english: And these Old Ones discovered soul transference?
translation: 而这些古圣们竟然发现了灵魂转移？ [er zhe xie gu sheng men jing ran fa xian le ling hun zhuan yi ？]

english: They did, and they did so long before House Arceuus even existed. It was their final attempt to overcome their extinction, but they failed.
translation: 他们做到了，而且早在阿尔宙斯家族存在之前他们就做到了。这是他们克服灭绝的最后尝试，但他们失败了。 [ta men zuo dao le ， er qie zao zai a er zhou si jia zu cun zai zhi qian ta men jiu zuo dao le 。 zhe shi ta men ke fu mie jue de zui hou chang shi ， dan ta men shi bai le 。]

english: What you see around you is the result of their failure. It's known as the Strangler.
translation: 你在周围看到的一切都是他们失败的结果。它被称为绞杀者。 [ni zai zhou wei kan dao de yi qie dou shi ta men shi bai de jie guo 。 ta bei cheng wei jiao sha zhe 。]

english: The Strangler?
translation: 绞杀者？ [jiao sha zhe ？]

english: It's some sort of parasite. It was presumably meant to play a role in their transference rituals, but instead it destroyed them. It has remained here ever since.
translation: 这是某种寄生虫。它可能是为了在他们的移情仪式中发挥作用，但它却摧毁了他们。从那时起它就一直留在这里。 [zhe shi mou zhong ji sheng chong 。 ta ke neng shi wei le zai ta men de yi qing yi shi zhong fa hui zuo yong ， dan ta que cui hui le ta men 。 cong na shi qi ta jiu yi zhi liu zai zhe li 。]

english: Hence the Strangled?
translation: 因此是被勒死的？ [yin ci shi bei lei si de ？]

english: Exactly. Plenty of unwary fools have fallen victim to the Strangler. If you don't take care, you will share their fate.
translation: 确切地。许多粗心的傻瓜都成为了绞杀者的受害者。如果你不小心，你将与他们同命运。 [que qie di 。 xu duo cu xin de sha gua dou cheng wei le jiao sha zhe de shou hai zhe 。 ru guo ni bu xiao xin ， ni jiang yu ta men tong ming yun 。]

english: So how do we deal with them?
translation: 那么我们该如何对待他们呢？ [na me wo men gai ru he dui dai ta men ne ？]

english: The trick is to maintain your distance. They're relatively passive unless you get too close, but if you disturb one, the rest will quickly come running.
translation: 诀窍是保持距离。它们相对被动，除非你离得太近，但如果你打扰其中一只，其余的很快就会跑过来。 [jue qiao shi bao chi ju li 。 ta men xiang dui bei dong ， chu fei ni li de tai jin ， dan ru guo ni da rao qi zhong yi zhi ， qi yu de hen kuai jiu hui pao guo lai 。]

english: If you need to fight one, try to do it away from the rest!
translation: 如果你需要与一个人战斗，请尽量远离其他人！ [ru guo ni xu yao yu yi ge ren zhan dou ， qing jin liang yuan li qi ta ren ！]

english: And stay off of the tendrils! You'll alert the lot of them to your location! It's like a network.
translation: 并远离卷须！您将提醒他们很多人您的位置！它就像一个网络。 [bing yuan li juan xu ！ nin jiang ti xing ta men hen duo ren nin de wei zhi ！ ta jiu xiang yi ge wang luo 。]

english: Keep my distance and stay off the tendrils. I can do that. So what's our next move?
translation: 保持距离并远离卷须。我能做到。那么我们的下一步行动是什么？ [bao chi ju li bing yuan li juan xu 。 wo neng zuo dao 。 na me wo men de xia yi bu xing dong shi shen me ？]

english: The fact that you're still alive tells me you broke into my home and stole some of the potion I made.
translation: 你还活着的事实告诉我你闯入了我的家并偷走了我制作的一些药剂。 [ni hai huo zhe de shi shi gao su wo ni chuang ru le wo de jia bing tou zou le wo zhi zuo de yi xie yao ji 。]

english: 'Broke in' is maybe a bit strong...
translation: “闯入”可能有点强... [“ chuang ru ” ke neng you dian qiang ...]

english: Call it what you want, it's not important now. What is important is that I believe I can make a more powerful potion using ingredients found here.
translation: 你想怎么称呼就怎么称呼吧，现在这并不重要。重要的是，我相信我可以使用这里找到的原料制作出更强大的药剂。 [ni xiang zen me cheng hu jiu zen me cheng hu ba ， xian zai zhe bing bu zhong yao 。 zhong yao de shi ， wo xiang xin wo ke yi shi yong zhe li zhao dao de yuan liao zhi zuo chu geng qiang da de yao ji 。]

english: If all goes well, this potion will provide increased immunity against the Strangler. If either of us are to find what we want here, it will be essential.
translation: 如果一切顺利，这种药水将提高对绞杀者的免疫力。如果我们中的任何一个人想在这里找到我们想要的东西，这将是至关重要的。 [ru guo yi qie shun li ， zhe zhong yao shui jiang ti gao dui jiao sha zhe de mian yi li 。 ru guo wo men zhong de ren he yi ge ren xiang zai zhe li zhao dao wo men xiang yao de dong xi ， zhe jiang shi zhi guan zhong yao de 。]

english: So what ingredients do we need?
translation: 那么我们需要什么成分呢？ [na me wo men xu yao shen me cheng fen ne ？]

english: As you've no doubt seen, the Strangler infects plant life as well. However, I've come across a small number of plants that seem to have developed immunity.
translation: 正如您无疑所看到的，绞杀者也会感染植物。然而，我发现少数植物似乎已经产生了免疫力。 [zheng ru nin wu yi suo kan dao de ， jiao sha zhe ye hui gan ran zhi wu 。 ran er ， wo fa xian shao shu zhi wu si hu yi jing chan sheng le mian yi li 。]

english: First, there's a herb growing atop the cliff just north west of the temple. Second, there are some berries in an old camp on the coast to the south west.
translation: 首先，寺庙西北角的悬崖顶上生长着一种药草。其次，西南海岸的一个旧营地里有一些浆果。 [shou xian ， si miao xi bei jiao de xuan ya ding shang sheng zhang zhe yi zhong yao cao 。 qi ci ， xi nan hai an de yi ge jiu ying di li you yi xie jiang guo 。]

english: Alright, I can gather those.
translation: 好吧，我可以收集这些。 [hao ba ， wo ke yi shou ji zhe xie 。]

english: I need to gather some additional ingredients from within the temple. I will meet you back here once I'm done.
translation: 我需要从神殿内收集一些额外的材料。工作完成后我会回到这里与你会面。 [wo xu yao cong shen dian nei shou ji yi xie e wai de cai liao 。 gong zuo wan cheng hou wo hui hui dao zhe li yu ni hui mian 。]

english: Kasonde! Are you okay?
translation: 卡松德！你还好吗？ [ka song de ！ ni hai hao ma ？]

english: Damn it! Damn it! This can't happen! It can't!
translation: 该死的！该死的！这不可能发生！不可以！ [gai si de ！ gai si de ！ zhe bu ke neng fa sheng ！ bu ke yi ！]

english: Kasonde?
translation: 卡松德？ [ka song de ？]

english: Kasonde shows you his arm. There's a large bite from one of the Strangled.
translation: 卡松德向你展示了他的手臂。被勒死者咬了一大口。 [ka song de xiang ni zhan shi le ta de shou bi 。 bei lei si zhe yao le yi da kou 。]

english: Kasonde...
translation: 卡松德... [ka song de ...]

english: It's fine! This doesn't change anything.
translation: 没关系！这不会改变任何事情。 [mei guan xi ！ zhe bu hui gai bian ren he shi qing 。]

english: But the infection...
translation: 但感染... [dan gan ran ...]

english: The infection means nothing!
translation: 感染没有任何意义！ [gan ran mei you ren he yi yi ！]

english: I was a dead man either way...
translation: 无论如何，我已经是一个死人了…… [wu lun ru he ， wo yi jing shi yi ge si ren le ……]

english: What are you on about?
translation: 你在忙什么？ [ni zai mang shen me ？]

english: Koreps Syndrome. Common among botanists apparently. You'd have thought we'd have put some effort into finding a cure, but I guess no one ever thinks they'll be the unlucky one.
translation: 科雷普斯综合症。显然在植物学家中很常见。你可能会认为我们会付出一些努力来寻找治疗方法，但我想没有人会认为他们会是不幸的人。 [ke lei pu si zong he zheng 。 xian ran zai zhi wu xue jia zhong hen chang jian 。 ni ke neng hui ren wei wo men hui fu chu yi xie nu li lai xun zhao zhi liao fang fa ， dan wo xiang mei you ren hui ren wei ta men hui shi bu xing de ren 。]

english: Kasonde, I...
translation: 卡松德，我... [ka song de ， wo ...]

english: Don't. Whatever you have to say, I don't want to hear it. Do you know how many times I've heard the word 'sorry'? Do you know how many times people have told me they understand?
translation: 不。不管你要说什么，我都不想听。你知道我听过多少次“对不起”这个词吗？你知道人们有多少次告诉我他们明白吗？ [bu 。 bu guan ni yao shuo shen me ， wo dou bu xiang ting 。 ni zhi dao wo ting guo duo shao ci “ dui bu qi ” zhe ge ci ma ？ ni zhi dao ren men you duo shao ci gao su wo ta men ming bai ma ？]

english: Well they don't. I spent every day working away, telling myself that one day I'd finally be able to live my life, but it was all a lie. That was my life, and it was all so... meaningless!
translation: 好吧，他们没有。我每天都在努力工作，告诉自己有一天我终于可以过上自己的生活了，但这都是谎言。这就是我的生活，而这一切都是那么……毫无意义！ [hao ba ， ta men mei you 。 wo mei tian dou zai nu li gong zuo ， gao su zi ji you yi tian wo zhong yu ke yi guo shang zi ji de sheng huo le ， dan zhe dou shi huang yan 。 zhe jiu shi wo de sheng huo ， er zhe yi qie dou shi na me …… hao wu yi yi ！]

english: I tried everything. I went to every healer, ever mage, every priest.
translation: 我尝试了一切。我去找了每一个治疗师、法师、牧师。 [wo chang shi le yi qie 。 wo qu zhao le mei yi ge zhi liao shi 、 fa shi 、 mu shi 。]

english: I went to House Arceuus, and they turned me away! What gives them the right?!
translation: 我去了阿尔宙斯家族，但他们拒绝了我！他们有什么权利？！ [wo qu le a er zhou si jia zu ， dan ta men ju jue le wo ！ ta men you shen me quan li ？！]

english: So no, this doesn't change anything. The Old Ones are my last hope. I either find their secrets, or...
translation: 所以不，这不会改变任何事情。旧日支配者是我最后的希望。我要么找到他们的秘密，要么…… [suo yi bu ， zhe bu hui gai bian ren he shi qing 。 jiu ri zhi pei zhe shi wo zui hou de xi wang 。 wo yao me zhao dao ta men de mi mi ， yao me ……]

english: Look, we're wasting time here! There's a ritual site to the west. Presumably it's where the Strangler was unleashed. It's my best hope now, and it may well be where you'll find what you're after as well.
translation: 瞧，我们在这里浪费时间！西边有祭祀场所。想必这里就是绞杀者被释放的地方。这是我现在最大的希望，而且很可能你也会找到你所追求的东西。 [qiao ， wo men zai zhe li lang fei shi jian ！ xi bian you ji si chang suo 。 xiang bi zhe li jiu shi jiao sha zhe bei shi fang de di fang 。 zhe shi wo xian zai zui da de xi wang ， er qie hen ke neng ni ye hui zhao dao ni suo zhui qiu de dong xi 。]

english: Take this potion and add those ingredients you gathered to it. It should strengthen your immunity against the Strangler. Now go!
translation: 拿起这瓶药水，加入你收集到的材料。它应该会增强你对绞杀者的免疫力。现在走吧！ [na qi zhe ping yao shui ， jia ru ni shou ji dao de cai liao 。 ta ying gai hui zeng qiang ni dui jiao sha zhe de mian yi li 。 xian zai zou ba ！]

english: Hello, you must be a traveller.
translation: 你好，你一定是一位旅行者。 [ni hao ， ni yi ding shi yi wei lv xing zhe 。]

english: Well guessed, adventurer.
translation: 猜对了，冒险家。 [cai dui le ， mao xian jia 。]

english: Are you from Lovakengj?
translation: 您来自洛瓦肯杰吗？ [nin lai zi luo wa ken jie ma ？]

english: You are wrong this time, adventurer. I'm actually from Ice Mountain.
translation: 冒险家，这次你错了。其实我是冰山人。 [mao xian jia ， zhe ci ni cuo le 。 qi shi wo shi bing shan ren 。]

english: I always wanted to visit Lovakengj to see the Blast Mine. This year I finally saved up enough to travel here.
translation: 我一直想去洛瓦肯杰参观高爆矿井。今年终于攒够了来这里旅游的钱。 [wo yi zhi xiang qu luo wa ken jie can guan gao bao kuang jing 。 jin nian zhong yu zan gou le lai zhe li lv you de qian 。]

english: However, the war with the lizardmen means Lovakengj is dangerous to get to from here. I'll need to go the long way round.
translation: 然而，与蜥蜴人的战争意味着从这里前往洛瓦肯杰很危险。我需要走很远的路。 [ran er ， yu xi yi ren de zhan zheng yi wei zhe cong zhe li qian wang luo wa ken jie hen wei xian 。 wo xu yao zou hen yuan de lu 。]

english: What do you think about this place?
translation: 你觉得这个地方怎么样？ [ni jue de zhe ge di fang zen me yang ？]

english: To be honest, Shayzien is a bit boring for visitors. It's all about war and military things.
translation: 说实话，Shayzien 对于游客来说有点无聊。这都是关于战争和军事的事情。 [shuo shi hua ，Shayzien  dui yu you ke lai shuo you dian wu liao 。 zhe dou shi guan yu zhan zheng he jun shi de shi qing 。]

english: The only place I would recommend is the Cloak and Stagger. You'll find some pretty good drinks there.
translation: 我唯一推荐的地方是斗篷和交错。你会在那里找到一些非常好的饮料。 [wo wei yi tui jian de di fang shi dou peng he jiao cuo 。 ni hui zai na li zhao dao yi xie fei chang hao de yin liao 。]

english: See you later.
translation: 稍后见。 [shao hou jian 。]

english: Are you from Lovakengj?
translation: 您来自洛瓦肯杰吗？ [nin lai zi luo wa ken jie ma ？]

english: How do you feel about this place?
translation: 您对这个地方感觉如何？ [nin dui zhe ge di fang gan jue ru he ？]

english: See you later.
translation: 稍后见。 [shao hou jian 。]

english: Oh dear, oh dear, oh dear...
translation: 哦亲爱的，哦亲爱的，哦亲爱的…… [o qin ai de ， o qin ai de ， o qin ai de ……]

english: Oh dear?
translation: 哦亲爱的？ [o qin ai de ？]

english: It's terrible!
translation: 太可怕了！ [tai ke pa le ！]

english: What's terrible?
translation: 有什么可怕的？ [you shen me ke pa de ？]

english: Oh, never mind, dearie. What can I do for you?
translation: 哦，没关系，亲爱的。我能为你做什么？ [o ， mei guan xi ， qin ai de 。 wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: Can you take me downstream in your boat?
translation: 你能用你的船带我顺流而下吗？ [ni neng yong ni de chuan dai wo shun liu er xia ma ？]

english: Ooh, it's dangerous up there at the moment!
translation: 哦，现在那里很危险！ [o ， xian zai na li hen wei xian ！]

english: I'm not afraid - let's go!
translation: 我不害怕——我们走吧！ [wo bu hai pa —— wo men zou ba ！]

english: It's dangerous up there for me too, dearie.
translation: 亲爱的，那里对我来说也很危险。 [qin ai de ， na li dui wo lai shuo ye hen wei xian 。]

english: Would it help if I gave you some money?
translation: 如果我给你一些钱会有帮助吗？ [ru guo wo gei ni yi xie qian hui you bang zhu ma ？]

english: Ooh, that's better! I'll take you up north for 50 shiny coins.
translation: 哦，那更好了！我会带你去北方，花 50 枚闪亮的硬币。 [o ， na geng hao le ！ wo hui dai ni qu bei fang ， hua  50  mei shan liang de ying bi 。]

english: Alright, I'll pay.
translation: 好吧，我付钱。 [hao ba ， wo fu qian 。]

english: Kathy Corkat rows you down the river to the sea...
translation: 凯西·科卡特 (Kathy Corkat) 划船带您顺河而下，直至大海…… [kai xi · ke ka te  (Kathy Corkat)  hua chuan dai nin shun he er xia ， zhi zhi da hai ……]

english: Not a chance!
translation: 没有机会！ [mei you ji hui ！]

english: Then you can find your own way north, dearie!
translation: 然后你就可以找到自己的北路了，亲爱的！ [ran hou ni jiu ke yi zhao dao zi ji de bei lu le ， qin ai de ！]

english: Dangerous? Nah, forget it!
translation: 危险的？算了，算了！ [wei xian de ？ suan le ， suan le ！]

english: I don't think I want anything, thanks.
translation: 我想我什么都不想要，谢谢。 [wo xiang wo shen me dou bu xiang yao ， xie xie 。]

english: Everybody wants something, dearie!
translation: 每个人都想要一些东西，亲爱的！ [mei ge ren dou xiang yao yi xie dong xi ， qin ai de ！]

english: Huh? Oh, forget it!
translation: 啊？哦，算了！ [a ？ o ， suan le ！]

english: I'll be glad to get away from this place, dearie! Fancy a lift up the river?
translation: 我会很高兴离开这个地方，亲爱的！想乘电梯上河吗？ [wo hui hen gao xing li kai zhe ge di fang ， qin ai de ！ xiang cheng dian ti shang he ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Kathy Corkat rows you up the river...
translation: 凯西·科凯特（Kathy Corkat）划船带你逆流而上…… [kai xi · ke kai te （Kathy Corkat） hua chuan dai ni ni liu er shang ……]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello dearie. Heading up north to the Fishing Colony, are we?
translation: 你好亲爱的。我们向北前往钓鱼区，是吗？ [ni hao qin ai de 。 wo men xiang bei qian wang diao yu qu ， shi ma ？]

english: Are ye wantin' a lift up the river, dearie?
translation: 亲爱的，你想搭便车到河上去吗？ [qin ai de ， ni xiang da bian che dao he shang qu ma ？]

english: Why don't you row right into the Colony? It'd make it much easier to get in there.
translation: 你为什么不直接划船进入殖民地呢？这会让进入那里变得更加容易。 [ni wei shen me bu zhi jie hua chuan jin ru zhi min di ne ？ zhe hui rang jin ru na li bian de geng jia rong yi 。]

english: Oh, Franklin doesn't like it if I take my boat too close. He says I'll damage the nets and scare the fish. But were you wanting a lift up to the river?
translation: 哦，富兰克林不喜欢我把船靠得太近。他说我会损坏网并吓跑鱼。但是您想乘电梯到河边吗？ [o ， fu lan ke lin bu xi huan wo ba chuan kao de tai jin 。 ta shuo wo hui sun huai wang bing xia pao yu 。 dan shi nin xiang cheng dian ti dao he bian ma ？]

english: Can you take me downstream in your boat?
translation: 你能用你的船带我顺流而下吗？ [ni neng yong ni de chuan dai wo shun liu er xia ma ？]

english: I'm not afraid - let's go!
translation: 我不害怕——我们走吧！ [wo bu hai pa —— wo men zou ba ！]

english: Alright, I'll pay.
translation: 好吧，我付钱。 [hao ba ， wo fu qian 。]

english: Not a chance!
translation: 没有机会！ [mei you ji hui ！]

english: Dangerous? Nah, forget it!
translation: 危险的？算了，算了！ [wei xian de ？ suan le ， suan le ！]

english: I don't think I want anything, thanks.
translation: 我想我什么都不想要，谢谢。 [wo xiang wo shen me dou bu xiang yao ， xie xie 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Why don't you row right into the Colony?
translation: 你为什么不直接划船进入殖民地呢？ [ni wei shen me bu zhi jie hua chuan jin ru zhi min di ne ？]

english: Heya! What can I get you?
translation: 嘿嘿！我能给你什么？ [hei hei ！ wo neng gei ni shen me ？]

english: What ales are you serving?
translation: 你们提供什么啤酒？ [ni men ti gong shen me pi jiu ？]

english: Well, we've got Asgarnian Ale, Wizard's Mind Bomb and Dwarven Stout, all for only 3 coins.
translation: 好吧，我们有阿斯加尼亚啤酒、巫师心灵炸弹和矮人烈性啤酒，全部只需 3 个硬币。 [hao ba ， wo men you a si jia ni ya pi jiu 、 wu shi xin ling zha dan he ai ren lie xing pi jiu ， quan bu zhi xu  3  ge ying bi 。]

english: One Asgarnian Ale, please.
translation: 请喝一杯阿斯加尼亚啤酒。 [qing he yi bei a si jia ni ya pi jiu 。]

english: I said 3 coins! You haven't got 3 coins!
translation: 我说3个币！你还没有3个金币！ [wo shuo 3 ge bi ！ ni hai mei you 3 ge jin bi ！]

english: Sorry, I'll come back another day.
translation: 抱歉，我改天再来。 [bao qian ， wo gai tian zai lai 。]

english: Thanks, Kaylee.
translation: 谢谢，凯莉。 [xie xie ， kai li 。]

english: I'll try the Mind Bomb.
translation: 我会尝试心灵炸弹。 [wo hui chang shi xin ling zha dan 。]

english: Can I have a Dwarven Stout?
translation: 我可以喝一瓶矮人世涛吗？ [wo ke yi he yi ping ai ren shi tao ma ？]

english: I don't feel like any of those.
translation: 我不喜欢其中任何一个。 [wo bu xi huan qi zhong ren he yi ge 。]

english: I've got this beer glass...
translation: 我有这个啤酒杯... [wo you zhe ge pi jiu bei ...]

english: We'll buy it for a couple of coins if you're interested.
translation: 如果您有兴趣，我们会花几个硬币购买它。 [ru guo nin you xing qu ， wo men hui hua ji ge ying bi gou mai ta 。]

english: Okay, sure.
translation: 好吧，当然。 [hao ba ， dang ran 。]

english: There you go.
translation: 就这样吧。 [jiu zhe yang ba 。]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: No thanks, I like empty beer glasses.
translation: 不，谢谢，我喜欢空啤酒杯。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo xi huan kong pi jiu bei 。]

english: I've got these beer glasses...
translation: 我有这个啤酒杯... [wo you zhe ge pi jiu bei ...]

english: Ooh, we'll buy those off you if you're interested. 2 coins per glass.
translation: 哦，如果你有兴趣的话，我们会从你那里买的。每杯 2 枚硬币。 [o ， ru guo ni you xing qu de hua ， wo men hui cong ni na li mai de 。 mei bei  2  mei ying bi 。]

english: What's this about the party room?
translation: 宴会厅这是怎么回事？ [yan hui ting zhe shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: Have you heard? Someone's planning a big party!
translation: 你听说过吗？有人正在策划一场盛大的聚会！ [ni ting shuo guo ma ？ you ren zheng zai ce hua yi chang sheng da de ju hui ！]

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你是什​​么意思？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: Someone's put something very valuable into the party room drop chest! If you go to the party room and pull the lever you might have a chance to get it!
translation: 有人在聚会室的掉落箱里放了一些非常贵重的东西！如果你去聚会室拉动控制杆，你就有机会得到它！ [you ren zai ju hui shi de diao luo xiang li fang le yi xie fei chang gui zhong de dong xi ！ ru guo ni qu ju hui shi la dong kong zhi gan ， ni jiu you ji hui de dao ta ！]

english: It could be your lucky day!
translation: 这可能是你的幸运日！ [zhe ke neng shi ni de xing yun ri ！]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: I have a question for you.
translation: 我有个问题要问你。 [wo you ge wen ti yao wen ni 。]

english: Kaylee has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 凯莉给了你一个挑战卷轴！ [kai li gei le ni yi ge tiao zhan juan zhou ！]

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。 [qing shu ru wen ti de da an 。]

english: No, try again.

translation: 是的，来自奈蒂兹诺特的间谍。他们无处不在。显然。无论如何，国王也是这么说的。 [shi de ， lai zi nai di zi nuo te de jian die 。 ta men wu chu bu zai 。 xian ran 。 wu lun ru he ， guo wang ye shi zhe me shuo de 。]

english: Me? I'm a cook. Fish dishes a speciality. I hate fish. But fish is about all we have. Except for yak. But we're not allowed to eat yak.
translation: 我？我是一名厨师。鱼类菜肴是特色菜。我讨厌鱼。但鱼是我们拥有的一切。除了牦牛。但我们不可以吃牦牛。 [wo ？ wo shi yi ming chu shi 。 yu lei cai yao shi te se cai 。 wo tao yan yu 。 dan yu shi wo men yong you de yi qie 。 chu le mao niu 。 dan wo men bu ke yi chi mao niu 。]

translation: 为什么不呢，牦牛肉对你有害吗？ [wei shen me bu ne ， mao niu rou dui ni you hai ma ？]

english: Certainly not! Yak meat is both sweet and delicately flavoured. Yak is juicier than buffalo and elk - but never gamey. It goes wonderfully well with a glass of red wine, and it's healthy too!

english: So why aren't you allowed to eat it?
translation: 那为什么不让你吃呢？ [na wei shen me bu rang ni chi ne ？]

translation: 不，反正只是鱼。你为什么想吃鱼？ [bu ， fan zheng zhi shi yu 。 ni wei shen me xiang chi yu ？]

english: Great mister! Thanks again for rescuing me.
translation: 伟大的先生！再次感谢你救了我。 [wei da de xian sheng ！ zai ci gan xie ni jiu le wo 。]

translation: 你好，肯特。 [ni hao ， ken te 。]

english: I never did get the chance to thank you properly for saving Kennith and myself.
translation: 我一直没有机会好好感谢你拯救了肯尼斯和我自己。 [wo yi zhi mei you ji hui hao hao gan xie ni zheng jiu le ken ni si he wo zi ji 。]

english: Oh, don't be silly, it was nothing really.
translation: 哦，别傻了，其实没什么。 [o ， bie sha le ， qi shi mei shen me 。]

english: Play it down if you will. It was a truly brave thing you did.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，可以慢慢来。你所做的这件事确实很勇敢。 [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， ke yi man man lai 。 ni suo zuo de zhe jian shi que shi hen yong gan 。]
