english: What do you mean they changed you?
translation: 他们改变了你是什么意思？ [ta men gai bian le ni shi shen me yi si ？]

english: I was once a free man, powerful and wealthy. I owned several apothecaries across Kourend and sold the tastiest potions in the land.
translation: 我曾经是一个自由人，有权有势，富有。我在库伦德拥有几家药剂师，出售这片土地上最美味的药剂。 [wo ceng jing shi yi ge zi you ren ， you quan you shi ， fu you 。 wo zai ku lun de yong you ji jia yao ji shi ， chu shou zhe pian tu di shang zui mei wei de yao ji 。]

english: What happened?
translation: 发生了什么？ [fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: One of my greatest inventions, it was going so well. I spent days finding the right herbs, I travelled across all of Kourend to find the most exotic weeds. Once I had gathered them all, I put them in a potion and mixed in
translation: 我最伟大的发明之一，进展顺利。我花了几天时间寻找合适的草药，我走遍了整个库伦德寻找最奇异的杂草。一旦我把它们全部收集起来，我就把它们放入药剂中并混合在其中 [wo zui wei da de fa ming zhi yi ， jin zhan shun li 。 wo hua le ji tian shi jian xun zhao he shi de cao yao ， wo zou bian le zheng ge ku lun de xun zhao zui qi yi de za cao 。 yi dan wo ba ta men quan bu shou ji qi lai ， wo jiu ba ta men fang ru yao ji zhong bing hun he zai qi zhong]

english: the final ingredient.
translation: 最终成分。 [zui zhong cheng fen 。]

english: Kourend? Interesting...
translation: 库伦德？有趣的... [ku lun de ？ you qu de ...]

english: Kourend? Oh yeah, I've been there.
translation: 库伦德？哦，是的，我去过那里。 [ku lun de ？ o ， shi de ， wo qu guo na li 。]

english: Yes, yes... The potion tasted delicious but it was missing a tiny something so I added Magic roots to the potion. It started to pulsate and glow! I took a sip and I felt like a million gold! A few seconds later my eye sight
translation: 是的，是的……药水味道很好，但缺少了一点东西，所以我在药水中添加了魔法根。它开始脉动并发光！我喝了一口，感觉自己像百万金子一样！几秒钟后我的视线 [shi de ， shi de …… yao shui wei dao hen hao ， dan que shao le yi dian dong xi ， suo yi wo zai yao shui zhong tian jia le mo fa gen 。 ta kai shi mai dong bing fa guang ！ wo he le yi kou ， gan jue zi ji xiang bai wan jin zi yi yang ！ ji miao zhong hou wo de shi xian]

english: began to blur, my brain was throbbing. I fell and hit my head on my worktop, then it all went black.
translation: 开始变得模糊，我的大脑在抽痛。我摔倒了，头撞到了工作台上，然后一切都变黑了。 [kai shi bian de mo hu ， wo de da nao zai chou tong 。 wo shuai dao le ， tou zhuang dao le gong zuo tai shang ， ran hou yi qie dou bian hei le 。]

english: Ouch! But, you still haven't said who changed you?
translation: 哎哟!但是，你还没说是谁改变了你？ [ai yo ! dan shi ， ni hai mei shuo shi shui gai bian le ni ？]

english: Will you let me finish?
translation: 你能让我说完吗？ [ni neng rang wo shuo wan ma ？]

english: I woke up screaming in pain. Blue foam streaming out of my mouth, my eye sight worse than before, the only things I could make out were 3 tall figures with green banners - they were of the Arceuus Elders. They
translation: 我醒来时痛苦地尖叫。蓝色的泡沫从我的嘴里流出，我的视力比以前更差了，我只能看到三个高大的身影，举着绿色的旗帜——他们是阿尔宙斯长老的成员。他们 [wo xing lai shi tong ku di jian jiao 。 lan se de pao mo cong wo de zui li liu chu ， wo de shi li bi yi qian geng cha le ， wo zhi neng kan dao san ge gao da de shen ying ， ju zhe lv se de qi zhi —— ta men shi a er zhou si zhang lao de cheng yuan 。 ta men]

english: muttered to each other in Archaic Language after trying to get up several times. I lost hope and stared at the sky. I had given up when the tallest of the figures bent over and brought his face right to mine and spoke
translation: 几次想站起来后，用古语互相嘀咕着。我失去了希望，凝视着天空。当最高的人物弯下腰，将脸凑到我面前说话时，我已经放弃了 [ji ci xiang zhan qi lai hou ， yong gu yu hu xiang di gu zhe 。 wo shi qu le xi wang ， ning shi zhe tian kong 。 dang zui gao de ren wu wan xia yao ， jiang lian cou dao wo mian qian shuo hua shi ， wo yi jing fang qi le]

english: very softly 'We can save you, but it will come at a cost'.
translation: 非常轻柔地说道“我们可以拯救你，但这需要付出代价”。 [fei chang qing rou di shuo dao “ wo men ke yi zheng jiu ni ， dan zhe xu yao fu chu dai jia ”。]

english: So they saved you?
translation: 所以他们救了你？ [suo yi ta men jiu le ni ？]

english: Yes of course they saved me but look at the cost! I have horns coming out of my head and I'm still blind and stuck here... forever alone.
translation: 是的，他们当然救了我，但看看代价！我的头上长出了角，但我仍然是盲目的，被困在这里……永远孤独。 [shi de ， ta men dang ran jiu le wo ， dan kan kan dai jia ！ wo de tou shang zhang chu le jiao ， dan wo reng ran shi mang mu di ， bei kun zai zhe li …… yong yuan gu du 。]

english: What was the curse?
translation: 诅咒是什么？ [zu zhou shi shen me ？]

english: I have been charged to stay here to prevent the Monstrosity from escaping. Those gates and the winches that operate them are the only thing that stops it breaking free.
translation: 我被命令留在这里防止怪物逃跑。那些门和操作它们的绞车是唯一阻止它挣脱束缚的东西。 [wo bei ming ling liu zai zhe li fang zhi guai wu tao pao 。 na xie men he cao zuo ta men de jiao che shi wei yi zu zhi ta zheng tuo shu fu de dong xi 。]

english: What monstrosity? What's behind those gates?
translation: 什么怪物？这些门后面是什么？ [shen me guai wu ？ zhe xie men hou mian shi shen me ？]

english: You really do not want to know. Leave this place human.
translation: 你真的不想知道。让这个地方充满人性吧。 [ni zhen de bu xiang zhi dao 。 rang zhe ge di fang chong man ren xing ba 。]

english: Hey now, I'm no wimp. What's to stop me from just turning the winch to open the gate and going in?
translation: 嘿，现在，我不是懦夫了。是什么阻止我转动绞车打开大门并进去？ [hei ， xian zai ， wo bu shi nuo fu le 。 shi shen me zu zhi wo zhuan dong jiao che da kai da men bing jin qu ？]

english: Me. And of course your quick demise at the mercy of Cerberus, guardian of the river of souls.
translation: 我。当然，你也会在灵魂之河的守护者塞伯鲁斯的摆布下迅速死去。 [wo 。 dang ran ， ni ye hui zai ling hun zhi he de shou hu zhe sai bo lu si de bai bu xia xun su si qu 。]

english: But I can do it!
translation: 但我能做到！ [dan wo neng zuo dao ！]

english: You are obviously passionate at trying. But only those with great skill at slaying these types of beast may enter.
translation: 显然你热衷于尝试。但只有那些擅长杀死此类野兽的人才能进入。 [xian ran ni re zhong yu chang shi 。 dan zhi you na xie shan chang sha si ci lei ye shou de ren cai neng jin ru 。]

english: THE VOICES! AAAHHHHH! Leave this place human!
translation: 声音！啊啊啊啊！让这个地方充满人性吧！ [sheng yin ！ a a a a ！ rang zhe ge di fang chong man ren xing ba ！]

english: I have been charged by the slayer masters to eliminate this type of threat.
translation: 杀手大师委托我消除这种威胁。 [sha shou da shi wei tuo wo xiao chu zhe zhong wei xie 。]

english: Then you may pass... may your soul not end up consumed and forever condemned to the-
translation: 然后你就可以过去了……愿你的灵魂最终不会被消耗并永远被判处—— [ran hou ni jiu ke yi guo qu le …… yuan ni de ling hun zui zhong bu hui bei xiao hao bing yong yuan bei pan chu ——]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Aretha said you might be able to repair the soul bearer for me.
translation: 艾瑞莎说你也许可以帮我修复灵魂承载者。 [ai rui sha shuo ni ye xu ke yi bang wo xiu fu ling hun cheng zai zhe 。]

english: The soul bearer! You have the soul bearer! The voices speak of it often. It is from this place, yet it is not of this place.
translation: 灵魂的承载者！你有灵魂承载者！声音经常谈到它。它来自这个地方，但又不属于这个地方。 [ling hun de cheng zai zhe ！ ni you ling hun cheng zai zhe ！ sheng yin jing chang tan dao ta 。 ta lai zi zhe ge di fang ， dan you bu shu yu zhe ge di fang 。]

english: Will you repair it?
translation: 你会修复它吗？ [ni hui xiu fu ta ma ？]

english: The voices tell me I can. They speak to me!
translation: 声音告诉我我可以。他们跟我说话！ [sheng yin gao su wo wo ke yi 。 ta men gen wo shuo hua ！]

english: The Key Master repairs your soul bearer.
translation: 钥匙大师修复你的灵魂承载者。 [yao shi da shi xiu fu ni de ling hun cheng zai zhe 。]

english: The voices say you must use it wisely.
translation: 声音说你必须明智地使用它。 [sheng yin shuo ni bi xu ming zhi di shi yong ta 。]

english: Thanks, I will.
translation: 谢谢，我会的。 [xie xie ， wo hui de 。]

english: Here you go.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.
translation: 你会收到线索卷轴的撕破部分。 [ni hui shou dao xian suo juan zhou de si po bu fen 。]

english: What do you mean they changed you?
translation: 他们改变了你是什么意思？ [ta men gai bian le ni shi shen me yi si ？]

english: What was the curse?
translation: 诅咒是什么？ [zu zhou shi shen me ？]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: What voices?
translation: 什么声音？ [shen me sheng yin ？]

english: Thanks, I will.
translation: 谢谢，我会的。 [xie xie ， wo hui de 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!
translation: 呜？  呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜！ [wu ？   wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu ！]

english: You don't say?
translation: 你不说？ [ni bu shuo ？]

english: Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
translation: 哇！呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜！ [wa ！ wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu ！]

english: You don't say!
translation: 你不说！ [ni bu shuo ！]

english: Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
translation: 呜呜呜……呜呜呜？呜呜呜呜呜呜呜！ [wu wu wu …… wu wu wu ？ wu wu wu wu wu wu wu ！]

english: Well, I guess you didn't say.
translation: 嗯，我猜你没说。 [n ， wo cai ni mei shuo 。]

english: Yeah, I don't want to brag, but seriously: I am SOOOO rich....
translation: 是的，我不想吹牛，但说真的：我太有钱了…… [shi de ， wo bu xiang chui niu ， dan shuo zhen de ： wo tai you qian le ……]

english: Yeah, I know they say money doesn't bring you happiness, but sometimes I just like to open my bank account and look at all of the stuff I own and just think to myself:
translation: 是的，我知道他们说金钱不会给你带来幸福，但有时我只是喜欢打开我的银行账户，看看我拥有的所有东西，然后心里想： [shi de ， wo zhi dao ta men shuo jin qian bu hui gei ni dai lai xing fu ， dan you shi wo zhi shi xi huan da kai wo de yin hang zhang hu ， kan kan wo yong you de suo you dong xi ， ran hou xin li xiang ：]

english: Wow. I am soooooo rich.
translation: 哇。我太有钱了。 [wa 。 wo tai you qian le 。]

english: Well, us rich alive people don't want to waste all day spending time with you poor dead people, because I'm just sooooo rich I have to go now, and very possibly make myself even richer.
translation: 好吧，我们活着的富人不想浪费一整天的时间和你们这些可怜的死人在一起，因为我太富有了，我现在必须走了，而且很可能让自己变得更富有。 [hao ba ， wo men huo zhe de fu ren bu xiang lang fei yi zheng tian de shi jian he ni men zhe xie ke lian de si ren zai yi qi ， yin wei wo tai fu you le ， wo xian zai bi xu zou le ， er qie hen ke neng rang zi ji bian de geng fu you 。]

english: See ya around ghosty!
translation: 幽灵见！ [you ling jian ！]

english: Yeah, I heard about that, ha-ha-ha!
translation: 是的，我听说过，哈哈哈！ [shi de ， wo ting shuo guo ， ha ha ha ！]

english: With a MACKEREL? Ouch!
translation: 和鲭鱼一起？哎哟! [he qing yu yi qi ？ ai yo !]

english: Well, it was fun. Let's do it again sometime.
translation: 嗯，很有趣。我们找个时间再做一次吧。 [n ， hen you qu 。 wo men zhao ge shi jian zai zuo yi ci ba 。]

english: Why, thank you very much!
translation: 为什么，非常感谢！ [wei shen me ， fei chang gan xie ！]

english: I know, but what are you going to do?
translation: 我知道，但是你要做什么？ [wo zhi dao ， dan shi ni yao zuo shen me ？]

english: Well, I guess that's always true in the long run. See you around, weird invisible dead person!
translation: 嗯，我想从长远来看这总是正确的。再见，奇怪的隐形死人！ [n ， wo xiang cong chang yuan lai kan zhe zong shi zheng que de 。 zai jian ， qi guai de yin xing si ren ！]

english: Yeah it's not bad, but I prefer cooked chicken.
translation: 是的，不错，但我更喜欢煮熟的鸡肉。 [shi de ， bu cuo ， dan wo geng xi huan zhu shu de ji rou 。]

english: Maybe, but nothing beats a home cooked pie!
translation: 也许吧，但没有什么比自制的馅饼更好的了！ [ye xu ba ， dan mei you shen me bi zi zhi de xian bing geng hao de le ！]

english: Man, I love pie!
translation: 伙计，我喜欢馅饼！ [huo ji ， wo xi huan xian bing ！]

english: You don't say? I never knew that. Well, I must be going, see you around.
translation: 你不说？我从来不知道这一点。好吧，我得走了，回头见。 [ni bu shuo ？ wo cong lai bu zhi dao zhe yi dian 。 hao ba ， wo de zou le ， hui tou jian 。]

english: We get signal!
translation: 我们收到信号了！ [wo men shou dao xin hao le ！]

english: Somebody set up us the bomb!
translation: 有人给我们安放了炸弹！ [you ren gei wo men an fang le zha dan ！]

english: You have no chance to survive make your time.
translation: 你没有机会生存，请腾出时间。 [ni mei you ji hui sheng cun ， qing teng chu shi jian 。]

english: Woo?
translation: 呜？ [wu ？]

english: All your base are belong to us.
translation: 你所有的基地都属于我们。 [ni suo you de ji di dou shu yu wo men 。]

english: Hey, don't think you can talk to me like that!
translation: 嘿，别以为你可以这样跟我说话！ [hei ， bie yi wei ni ke yi zhe yang gen wo shuo hua ！]

english: Are you threatening me?
translation: 你在威胁我吗？ [ni zai wei xie wo ma ？]

english: Just because you're already dead, doesn't mean I can't find a way to hurt you ghosty!
translation: 你已经死了，并不代表我就找不到办法伤害你！ [ni yi jing si le ， bing bu dai biao wo jiu zhao bu dao ban fa shang hai ni ！]

english: No, I've never been there in my life and CERTAINLY didn't steal anything when I was!
translation: 不，我这辈子从来没有去过那里，当然也没有偷过任何东西！ [bu ， wo zhe bei zi cong lai mei you qu guo na li ， dang ran ye mei you tou guo ren he dong xi ！]

english: Are you calling me a liar?!?! I have never stolen a thing in my life, and I resent the implication that I am the kind of morally depraved individual that would steal someone else's hard earned
translation: 你骂我是骗子吗？！？！我一生中从未偷过任何东西，而且我很讨厌别人说我是那种道德败坏的人，会偷别人辛苦赚来的东西。 [ni ma wo shi pian zi ma ？！？！ wo yi sheng zhong cong wei tou guo ren he dong xi ， er qie wo hen tao yan bie ren shuo wo shi na zhong dao de bai huai de ren ， hui tou bie ren xin ku zhuan lai de dong xi 。]

english: money from their very pockets!
translation: 钱是从他们的口袋里掏出来的！ [qian shi cong ta men de kou dai li tao chu lai de ！]

english: Or cakes. Or fur. Repeatedly. For long periods at a time.
translation: 或者蛋糕。或者毛皮。反复。一次持续很长时间。 [huo zhe dan gao 。 huo zhe mao pi 。 fan fu 。 yi ci chi xu hen zhang shi jian 。]

english: Well if you are going to take that attitude, then I have nothing further to say on the matter, and bid you good day!
translation: 好吧，如果您打算采取这种态度，那么我对此事无话可说，祝您早安！ [hao ba ， ru guo nin da suan cai qu zhe zhong tai du ， na me wo dui ci shi wu hua ke shuo ， zhu nin zao an ！]

english: Hello. So you must be Kharrim the messenger.
translation: 你好。所以你一定是卡里姆的使者。 [ni hao 。 suo yi ni yi ding shi ka li mu de shi zhe 。]

english: How do you know my name, stranger?
translation: 你怎么知道我的名字，陌生人？ [ni zen me zhi dao wo de ming zi ， mo sheng ren ？]

english: Well now... I had a very interesting chat with Rennard the thief.
translation: 好吧，现在……我和小偷雷纳德进行了一次非常有趣的交谈。 [hao ba ， xian zai …… wo he xiao tou lei na de jin xing le yi ci fei chang you qu de jiao tan 。]

english: It seems you redirected his message regarding a certain god-weapon for your own ends.
translation: 看来你为了自己的目的而转发了他关于某种神器的信息。 [kan lai ni wei le zi ji de mu di er zhuan fa le ta guan yu mou zhong shen qi de xin xi 。]

english: So THAT is what this is about... I should have known the deal was too good to have no repercussions...
translation: 这就是问题所在...我应该知道这笔交易太好了，不会产生任何影响... [zhe jiu shi wen ti suo zai ... wo ying gai zhi dao zhe bi jiao yi tai hao le ， bu hui chan sheng ren he ying xiang ...]

english: It seems as though you might be responsible for this curse that has befallen you by not delivering Rennard's message to the correct person.
translation: 看来你可能要为降临在你身上的诅咒负责，因为你没有将雷纳德的信息传递给正确的人。 [kan lai ni ke neng yao wei jiang lin zai ni shen shang de zu zhou fu ze ， yin wei ni mei you jiang lei na de de xin xi chuan di gei zheng que de ren 。]

english: Ha! That is not a truthful assessment of the story... You might think differently if you had heard my side of events.
translation: 哈!这不是对这个故事的真实评价……如果你听过我对事件的看法，你可能会有不同的想法。 [ha ! zhe bu shi dui zhe ge gu shi de zhen shi ping jia …… ru guo ni ting guo wo dui shi jian de kan fa ， ni ke neng hui you bu tong de xiang fa 。]

english: Please let me hear your side of the story then...
translation: 那么请让我听听你的故事...... [na me qing rang wo ting ting ni de gu shi ......]

english: Well, if you have spoken to Rennard, then you will know that he had somehow managed to obtain a very valuable weapon, and was looking for buyers.
translation: 好吧，如果你和雷纳德交谈过，那么你就会知道他以某种方式设法获得了一件非常有价值的武器，并且正在寻找买家。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni he lei na de jiao tan guo ， na me ni jiu hui zhi dao ta yi mou zhong fang shi she fa huo de le yi jian fei chang you jia zhi de wu qi ， bing qie zheng zai xun zhao mai jia 。]

english: What he probably didn't tell you, was that he met me in a drunken stupor in some smoke filled tavern, and I offered to arrange a purchaser for his item, in exchange for a small finders fee.
translation: 他可能没有告诉你的是，他在一家烟雾缭绕的小酒馆里醉酒昏迷时遇见了我，我提出为他的物品安排一个购买者，以换取一小笔发现者费用。 [ta ke neng mei you gao su ni de shi ， ta zai yi jia yan wu liao rao de xiao jiu guan li zui jiu hun mi shi yu jian le wo ， wo ti chu wei ta de wu pin an pai yi ge gou mai zhe ， yi huan qu yi xiao bi fa xian zhe fei yong 。]

english: So you knew what the staff was?
translation: 那么你知道员工是什么吗？ [na me ni zhi dao yuan gong shi shen me ma ？]

english: The god-staff of Armadyl? Well, of course I did.
translation: Armadyl 的神杖？嗯，我当然这么做了。 [Armadyl  de shen zhang ？ n ， wo dang ran zhe me zuo le 。]

english: Honestly, you would have to be pretty slow-witted to not recognise a legendary artefact such as that.
translation: 老实说，如果你不认识这样的传奇文物，那你一定是太迟钝了。 [lao shi shuo ， ru guo ni bu ren shi zhe yang de chuan qi wen wu ， na ni yi ding shi tai chi dun le 。]

english: Wait, I don't understand, Rennard said that he had a buyer already in mind, and that you diverted his message to a General Zamorak instead?
translation: 等等，我不明白，雷纳德说他已经有了买家，而你把他的消息转给了萨莫拉克将军？ [deng deng ， wo bu ming bai ， lei na de shuo ta yi jing you le mai jia ， er ni ba ta de xiao xi zhuan gei le sa mo la ke jiang jun ？]

english: Ha! Here is a word of advice for you adventurer; Never trust the words of a drunk.
translation: 哈!这是给冒险家的一条建议：永远不要相信醉汉的话。 [ha ! zhe shi gei mao xian jia de yi tiao jian yi ： yong yuan bu yao xiang xin zui han de hua 。]

english: Whatever he might have thought he was doing with it, in the end all that happened was he left me to arrange a purchaser for the item.
translation: 无论他可能认为他会用它做什么，最终发生的只是他让我为该物品安排一个购买者。 [wu lun ta ke neng ren wei ta hui yong ta zuo shen me ， zui zhong fa sheng de zhi shi ta rang wo wei gai wu pin an pai yi ge gou mai zhe 。]

english: So you thought you would offer it to General Zamorak?
translation: 所以你认为你会把它送给萨莫拉克将军？ [suo yi ni ren wei ni hui ba ta song gei sa mo la ke jiang jun ？]

english: Ah yes, Lord Zamorak. He was merely a mortal back then, you know?
translation: 啊，是的，萨莫拉克勋爵。那时他还只是一个凡人，你知道吗？ [a ， shi de ， sa mo la ke xun jue 。 na shi ta hai zhi shi yi ge fan ren ， ni zhi dao ma ？]

english: Yet I could see great things in store for him even then. He had a kind of brilliant ruthlessness... And that special kind of vicious streak you see so rarely...
translation: 但即使在那时，我也能预见到他将迎来伟大的事情。他有一种绝妙的冷酷无情……还有那种你很少见到的特殊的恶毒倾向…… [dan ji shi zai na shi ， wo ye neng yu jian dao ta jiang ying lai wei da de shi qing 。 ta you yi zhong jue miao de leng ku wu qing …… hai you na zhong ni hen shao jian dao de te shu de e du qing xiang ……]

english: Well anyway, when given the task of selling a weapon forged by the very gods themselves, I naturally thought of Zamorak as a potential buyer.
translation: 好吧，无论如何，当我接到出售神灵亲自铸造的武器的任务时，我自然而然地将萨莫拉克视为潜在买家。 [hao ba ， wu lun ru he ， dang wo jie dao chu shou shen ling qin zi zhu zao de wu qi de ren wu shi ， wo zi ran er ran di jiang sa mo la ke shi wei qian zai mai jia 。]

english: I was a messenger in his employ anyway, so it was a mere trifle to find him and deliver the news, and I knew of his particular interest in armour and weaponry of all kinds.
translation: 无论如何，我是他雇用的信使，所以找到他并传递消息只是小事一桩，而且我知道他对各种盔甲和武器特别感兴趣。 [wu lun ru he ， wo shi ta gu yong de xin shi ， suo yi zhao dao ta bing chuan di xiao xi zhi shi xiao shi yi zhuang ， er qie wo zhi dao ta dui ge zhong kui jia he wu qi te bie gan xing qu 。]

english: Yes, he was always quite the connoisseur when it came to weaponry...
translation: 是的，他在武器装备方面一直是个行家…… [shi de ， ta zai wu qi zhuang bei fang mian yi zhi shi ge hang jia ……]

english: But I digress. I let Lord Zamorak know that there was some drunken fool with an artefact of incredible power that could probably be bought off with a few jewels and trinkets,
translation: 但我离题了。我让萨莫拉克勋爵知道，有一个醉酒的傻瓜拥有一件具有令人难以置信的力量的神器，可能可以用一些珠宝和小饰品来买走， [dan wo li ti le 。 wo rang sa mo la ke xun jue zhi dao ， you yi ge zui jiu de sha gua yong you yi jian ju you ling ren nan yi zhi xin de li liang de shen qi ， ke neng ke yi yong yi xie zhu bao he xiao shi pin lai mai zou ，]

english: and he escorted me to the tavern and made the purchase there and then.
translation: 他护送我到小酒馆，当场就买了东西。 [ta hu song wo dao xiao jiu guan ， dang chang jiu mai le dong xi 。]

english: It was a satisfactory deal all around, I got a share of the sale price from Rennard, and I greatly increased my prestige amongst Zamorak and his followers.
translation: 这是一笔令人满意的交易，我从雷纳德那里得到了销售价格的一部分，并且大大提高了我在萨莫拉克和他的追随者中的威望。 [zhe shi yi bi ling ren man yi de jiao yi ， wo cong lei na de na li de dao le xiao shou jia ge de yi bu fen ， bing qie da da ti gao le wo zai sa mo la ke he ta de zhui sui zhe zhong de wei wang 。]

english: But maybe... Perhaps the events that followed were responsible for my cursed state...
translation: 但也许……也许接下来发生的事情导致了我被诅咒的状态…… [dan ye xu …… ye xu jie xia lai fa sheng de shi qing dao zhi le wo bei zu zhou de zhuang tai ……]

english: Events that followed?
translation: 随后发生的事件？ [sui hou fa sheng de shi jian ？]

english: I can not tell you of them precisely, for I myself was not there to witness them.
translation: 我无法准确地告诉你这些事，因为我本人并没有亲眼目睹它们。 [wo wu fa zhun que di gao su ni zhe xie shi ， yin wei wo ben ren bing mei you qin yan mu du ta men 。]

english: I am after all, simply a messenger. When... 'it' happened, I was busy elsewhere delivering a message from Zamorak to the rest of his Mahjarrat ilk.
translation: 我终究只是一个使者。当……“这件事”发生时，我正忙于其他地方，将萨莫拉克的消息传递给他的马吉拉特家族的其他人。 [wo zhong jiu zhi shi yi ge shi zhe 。 dang ……“ zhe jian shi ” fa sheng shi ， wo zheng mang yu qi ta di fang ， jiang sa mo la ke de xiao xi chuan di gei ta de ma ji la te jia zu de qi ta ren 。]

english: When 'it' happened? What was 'it'?
translation: ‘它’什么时候发生的？ “它”是什么？ [‘ ta ’ shen me shi hou fa sheng de ？ “ ta ” shi shen me ？]

english: As I have explained, I was not there, and I do not know what Zamorak did with the staff, but whatever it was resulted in his banishment by the other gods for many years.
translation: 正如我所解释的，我当时并不在那里，我也不知道萨莫拉克对这根手杖做了什么，但无论是什么，都导致他被其他神祇驱逐了很多年。 [zheng ru wo suo jie shi de ， wo dang shi bing bu zai na li ， wo ye bu zhi dao sa mo la ke dui zhe gen shou zhang zuo le shen me ， dan wu lun shi shen me ， dou dao zhi ta bei qi ta shen qi qu zhu le hen duo nian 。]

english: The very strange thing was that Saradomin must have known about it, whatever it was, before it even happened...
translation: 非常奇怪的是，萨拉多明一定在事情发生之前就知道了这件事，不管它是什么…… [fei chang qi guai de shi ， sa la duo ming yi ding zai shi qing fa sheng zhi qian jiu zhi dao le zhe jian shi ， bu guan ta shi shen me ……]

english: Really? Why do you say that?
translation: 真的吗？为什么这么说？ [zhen de ma ？ wei shen me zhe me shuo ？]

english: Well, it was the contents of the message I was returning to Zamorak;
translation: 嗯，这就是我要返回萨莫拉克的消息的内容； [n ， zhe jiu shi wo yao fan hui sa mo la ke de xiao xi de nei rong ；]

english: Lucien seemed quite certain that there was a spy for Saradomin somewhere amongst his followers named Lennissa.
translation: 路西恩似乎相当肯定萨拉多明的追随者中有一个名叫莱尼萨的间谍。 [lu xi en si hu xiang dang ken ding sa la duo ming de zhui sui zhe zhong you yi ge ming jiao lai ni sa de jian die 。]

english: If whatever happened to the staff caused this curse to befall me, then it is certain that she too would have been afflicted, because she would have been in the very heart of the action.
translation: 如果工作人员发生了什么事导致这个诅咒降临到我身上，那么肯定她也会受到折磨，因为她会处于这次行动的核心位置。 [ru guo gong zuo ren yuan fa sheng le shen me shi dao zhi zhe ge zu zhou jiang lin dao wo shen shang ， na me ken ding ta ye hui shou dao zhe mo ， yin wei ta hui chu yu zhe ci xing dong de he xin wei zhi 。]

english: Hmmm....
You have given me much to think on adventurer. I would like to reward you with my sturdy messenger boots, may they aid you in your travels.
translation: 你让我对冒险家有了很多思考。我想奖励您一双坚固的邮差靴，愿它们在您的旅途中为您提供帮助。 [ni rang wo dui mao xian jia you le hen duo si kao 。 wo xiang jiang li nin yi shuang jian gu de you chai xue ， yuan ta men zai nin de lv tu zhong wei nin ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: But where can I find this Lennissa?
translation: 但是我在哪里可以找到这个Lennissa？ [dan shi wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao zhe ge Lennissa？]

english: Ah yes, the whereabouts of the treacherous Lennissa...
translation: 啊，是的，奸诈的莲妮莎的下落…… [a ， shi de ， jian zha de lian ni sha de xia luo ……]

english: Well, we knew little about her or she would have been caught and exposed as a traitor and a spy, but Lucien did mention that he had evidence that she was a great fan of ball games...
translation: 好吧，我们对她知之甚少，否则她会被抓获并暴露为叛徒和间谍，但卢西安确实提到他有证据表明她是球类运动的忠实粉丝...... [hao ba ， wo men dui ta zhi zhi shen shao ， fou ze ta hui bei zhua huo bing bao lu wei pan tu he jian die ， dan lu xi an que shi ti dao ta you zheng ju biao ming ta shi qiu lei yun dong de zhong shi fen si ......]

english: Okay, well I'll try and find him for you then.
translation: 好吧，那我会尽力帮你找到他。 [hao ba ， na wo hui jin li bang ni zhao dao ta 。]

english: Well, she was always sickeningly obedient to Saradomin, so I would expect her to have run to some great place of worship of him if she was affected by the curse to try and gain his blessing.
translation: 好吧，她总是令人作呕地服从萨拉多明，所以如果她受到诅咒的影响，我希望她会跑到一些伟大的崇拜他的地方去尝试获得他的祝福。 [hao ba ， ta zong shi ling ren zuo ou di fu cong sa la duo ming ， suo yi ru guo ta shou dao zu zhou de ying xiang ， wo xi wang ta hui pao dao yi xie wei da de chong bai ta de di fang qu chang shi huo de ta de zhu fu 。]

english: According to Lucien's intelligence report, she had been uncovered as a spy by her constant use of ships to ferry information...
translation: 根据路西恩的情报报告，她因不断利用船只运送情报而被揭露为间谍…… [gen ju lu xi en de qing bao bao gao ， ta yin bu duan li yong chuan zhi yun song qing bao er bei jie lu wei jian die ……]

english: It is entirely possible she would be located somewhere coastal to this day!
translation: 时至今日，她完全有可能位于沿海某个地方！ [shi zhi jin ri ， ta wan quan you ke neng wei yu yan hai mou ge di fang ！]

english: Well, that's all fascinating, but I just don't particularly care. Bye-bye.
translation: 嗯，这一切都很有趣，但我并不特别关心。再见。 [n ， zhe yi qie dou hen you qu ， dan wo bing bu te bie guan xin 。 zai jian 。]

english: Hello again Kharrim.
translation: 哈林，你好。 [ha lin ， ni hao 。]

english: Can you remind me where to find Lennissa?
translation: 你能提醒我在哪里可以找到Lennissa吗？ [ni neng ti xing wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao Lennissa ma ？]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Could I have more of those ghostly robes you gave me?
translation: 我可以再要一件你送我的幽灵长袍吗？ [wo ke yi zai yao yi jian ni song wo de you ling chang pao ma ？]

english: It seems as though the curse that keeps me here extends to my very clothing... which piece do you want?
translation: 似乎让我留在这里的诅咒延伸到了我的衣服上……你想要哪一件？ [si hu rang wo liu zai zhe li de zu zhou yan shen dao le wo de yi fu shang …… ni xiang yao na yi jian ？]

english: Here you go.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: Tell me your story
translation: 告诉我你的故事 [gao su wo ni de gu shi]

english: Goodbye then
translation: 那么再见 [na me zai jian]

english: Ask about Lennissa.
translation: 询问关于莱尼萨的事情。 [xun wen guan yu lai ni sa de shi qing 。]

english: Ask for more ghostly robes.
translation: 要求更多的幽灵长袍。 [yao qiu geng duo de you ling chang pao 。]

english: Hello again. Do you need anything?
translation: 又好。你需要什么吗？ [you hao 。 ni xu yao shen me ma ？]

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Well in that case, all the best.
translation: 那么，在这种情况下，一切顺利。 [na me ， zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， yi qie shun li 。]

english: Those damn broavs! Now I'll need to start over again!
translation: 这些该死的兄弟们！现在我需要重新开始！ [zhe xie gai si de xiong di men ！ xian zai wo xu yao chong xin kai shi ！]

english: Er... Hello?
translation: 呃……喂？ [e …… wei ？]

english: Oh, sorry, I didn't see you come in.
translation: 哦，抱歉，我没看到你进来。 [o ， bao qian ， wo mei kan dao ni jin lai 。]

english: Is something wrong?
translation: 有什么问题吗？ [you shen me wen ti ma ？]

english: Just the usual sort of nonsense you get around here. One of the guards bought some broavs for tracking, but they keep getting distracted by my laundry and making a mess of it!
translation: 这只是你在这里常见的胡言乱语。一名警卫买了一些衣服来追踪，但他们总是被我洗的衣服分散注意力，把它弄得一团糟！ [zhe zhi shi ni zai zhe li chang jian de hu yan luan yu 。 yi ming jing wei mai le yi xie yi fu lai zhui zong ， dan ta men zong shi bei wo xi de yi fu fen san zhu yi li ， ba ta nong de yi tuan zao ！]

english: Right... Anyway, you don't happen to know someone called Darve do you? Or maybe someone called Movario?
translation: 是的……不管怎样，你碰巧不认识一个叫达夫的人吧？或者也许有人叫莫瓦里奥？ [shi de …… bu guan zen yang ， ni peng qiao bu ren shi yi ge jiao da fu de ren ba ？ huo zhe ye xu you ren jiao mo wa li ao ？]

english: Movario? Oh yes I... Well, actually, I shouldn't really divulge client details. Times are tough enough as it is without me losing customers through gossiping!
translation: 莫瓦里奥？哦，是的，我……嗯，实际上，我不应该透露客户的详细信息。日子已经够艰难了，就算我不因八卦而失去客户！ [mo wa li ao ？ o ， shi de ， wo …… n ， shi ji shang ， wo bu ying gai tou lu ke hu de xiang xi xin xi 。 ri zi yi jing gou jian nan le ， jiu suan wo bu yin ba gua er shi qu ke hu ！]

english: Would 500 coins change your mind?
translation: 500金币会改变你的想法吗？ [500 jin bi hui gai bian ni de xiang fa ma ？]

english: Oh... well I suppose so.
translation: 哦……好吧，我想是这样。 [o …… hao ba ， wo xiang shi zhe yang 。]

english: Okay, I'll be back shortly with the money.
translation: 好的，我很快就会带着钱回来。 [hao de ， wo hen kuai jiu hui dai zhe qian hui lai 。]

english: Now, what can you tell me about Movario?
translation: 现在，您能告诉我有关 Movario 的哪些信息吗？ [xian zai ， nin neng gao su wo you guan  Movario  de na xie xin xi ma ？]

english: Well he's a fairly regular customer of mine. In fact, I have some of his clothes here right now.
translation: 嗯，他是我的常客。事实上，我现在这里有他的一些衣服。 [n ， ta shi wo de chang ke 。 shi shi shang ， wo xian zai zhe li you ta de yi xie yi fu 。]

english: So does he live somewhere nearby?
translation: 那么他住在附近吗？ [na me ta zhu zai fu jin ma ？]

english: I assume so, but I don't know where.
translation: 我猜是这样，但我不知道在哪里。 [wo cai shi zhe yang ， dan wo bu zhi dao zai na li 。]

english: Hmm... I need some way of tracking him down...
translation: 嗯...我需要一些方法来追踪他... [n ... wo xu yao yi xie fang fa lai zhui zong ta ...]

english: Hang on... What was it you were saying earlier about those broavs?
translation: 等等……你之前说那些兄弟们是什么意思？ [deng deng …… ni zhi qian shuo na xie xiong di men shi shen me yi si ？]

english: Broavs? Well one of the guards bought some for tracking, but they keep getting distracted by the laundry.
translation: 布罗夫斯？一名警卫买了一些用于追踪，但他们总是被洗好的衣服分散注意力。 [bu luo fu si ？ yi ming jing wei mai le yi xie yong yu zhui zong ， dan ta men zong shi bei xi hao de yi fu fen san zhu yi li 。]

english: You don't think I'd be able to use one to track Movario, do you?
translation: 你认为我不能用它来追踪莫瓦里奥，是吗？ [ni ren wei wo bu neng yong ta lai zhui zong mo wa li ao ， shi ma ？]

english: I guess so, but they track using smell, so you'd need something that smells like him.
translation: 我想是的，但他们是用气味来追踪的，所以你需要一些闻起来像他的东西。 [wo xiang shi de ， dan ta men shi yong qi wei lai zhui zong de ， suo yi ni xu yao yi xie wen qi lai xiang ta de dong xi 。]

english: Like his dirty laundry, perhaps?
translation: 也许就像他的脏衣服？ [ye xu jiu xiang ta de zang yi fu ？]

english: Oh, I see... I really shouldn't be giving out clothes belonging to customers.
translation: 哦，原来如此……我真的不应该把属于顾客的衣服送出去。 [o ， yuan lai ru ci …… wo zhen de bu ying gai ba shu yu gu ke de yi fu song chu qu 。]

english: Surely you have something he won't miss.
translation: 你肯定有一些他不会错过的东西。 [ni ken ding you yi xie ta bu hui cuo guo de dong xi 。]

english: Well... I was thinking that one of his shirts wouldn't last the cleaning process. I suppose you can have it, but Movario can't find out!
translation: 嗯...我在想他的一件衬衫无法承受清洗过程。我想你可以得到它，但莫瓦里奥找不到！ [n ... wo zai xiang ta de yi jian chen shan wu fa cheng shou qing xi guo cheng 。 wo xiang ni ke yi de dao ta ， dan mo wa li ao zhao bu dao ！]

english: Thanks. So how would I go about getting myself one of those broavs?
translation: 谢谢。那么我该如何让自己成为这些兄弟中的一员呢？ [xie xie 。 na me wo gai ru he rang zi ji cheng wei zhe xie xiong di zhong de yi yuan ne ？]

english: I think they came from the Feldip Hills. Apparently there's some hunting expert down there who knows how to catch them.
translation: 我认为他们来自费尔迪普山。显然那里有一些狩猎专家知道如何捕捉它们。 [wo ren wei ta men lai zi fei er di pu shan 。 xian ran na li you yi xie shou lie zhuan jia zhi dao ru he bu zhuo ta men 。]

english: Perfect! Thanks for all the help.
translation: 完美的！感谢您的所有帮助。 [wan mei de ！ gan xie nin de suo you bang zhu 。]

english: Okay, fair enough.
translation: 好吧，很公平。 [hao ba ， hen gong ping 。]

english: You can trust me.
translation: 你可以相信我。 [ni ke yi xiang xin wo 。]

english: Oh... yes, I suppose I can.
translation: 哦...是的，我想我可以。 [o ... shi de ， wo xiang wo ke yi 。]

english: Great! So what can you tell me about Movario?
translation: 伟大的！那么关于 Movario 你能告诉我些什么吗？ [wei da de ！ na me guan yu  Movario  ni neng gao su wo xie shen me ma ？]

english: Hello again. Could you remind me where I can get one of those broavs?
translation: 又好。你能提醒我哪里可以买到那种布丁吗？ [you hao 。 ni neng ti xing wo na li ke yi mai dao na zhong bu ding ma ？]

english: Perfect! Thanks for the help.
translation: 完美的！感谢您的帮助。 [wan mei de ！ gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]

english: Would 500 coins change your mind?
translation: 500金币会改变你的想法吗？ [500 jin bi hui gai bian ni de xiang fa ma ？]

english: Okay, fair enough.
translation: 好吧，很公平。 [hao ba ， hen gong ping 。]

english: [Charm] You can trust me.
translation: [魅力]你可以相信我。 [[ mei li ] ni ke yi xiang xin wo 。]

english: What? How did you manage to get in here.
translation: 什么？你是怎么进来的。 [shen me ？ ni shi zen me jin lai de 。]

english: I've come for the orb.
translation: 我是为了宝珠而来的。 [wo shi wei le bao zhu er lai de 。]

english: I'll never let you take it.
translation: 我永远不会让你拿走它。 [wo yong yuan bu hui rang ni na zou ta 。]

english: Oi! You! Get out of there.
translation: 哎呀！你！离开那里。 [ai ya ！ ni ！ li kai na li 。]

english: Get off me, ya little pest!
translation: 滚开我，你这个小害虫！ [gun kai wo ， ni zhe ge xiao hai chong ！]

english: Argh, get the gnome!
translation: 啊啊，抓住侏儒！ [a a ， zhua zhu zhu ru ！]

english: You'll regret that!
translation: 你会后悔的！ [ni hui hou hui de ！]

english: Hello, how are you?

translation: 它们是赃物，现在把它们还给我！ [ta men shi zang wu ， xian zai ba ta men huan gei wo ！]

english: Ha, you really think you stand a chance? I'll crush you.
translation: 哈，你真的认为你有机会吗？我会压垮你。 [ha ， ni zhen de ren wei ni you ji hui ma ？ wo hui ya kua ni 。]

translation: 傻瓜，受到卡萨德祝福的战士不会死。你不能杀死已经死了的东西。不过我可以杀了你！ [sha gua ， shou dao ka sa de zhu fu de zhan shi bu hui si 。 ni bu neng sha si yi jing si le de dong xi 。 bu guo wo ke yi sha le ni ！]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

translation: 哦哦，嘿嘿！像我这样的聪明小矮人可以帮助你吗？ [o o ， hei hei ！ xiang wo zhe yang de cong ming xiao ai ren ke yi bang zhu ni ma ？]

english: The only thing you can help me with is finding the nearest place to get a drink, I think...
translation: 你唯一能帮我的就是找到最近的喝一杯的地方，我想…… [ni wei yi neng bang wo de jiu shi zhao dao zui jin de he yi bei de di fang ， wo xiang ……]

english: Haha, yesh, I have jusht the shing!

english: I've been working on thish deshign for quite a while now!

english: Never got to test it, love to shee it shoot a real human!

english: Well, can you give them to me? I'd be willing to try the experiment.
translation: 嗯，你能把它们给我吗？我愿意尝试这个实验。 [n ， ni neng ba ta men gei wo ma ？ wo yuan yi chang shi zhe ge shi yan 。]

english: Oooh, shure, shure... I've only got one part left, though, I gave all the other parts away.
translation: 哦，舒尔，舒尔……我只剩下一部分了，不过，我把其他部分都送走了。 [o ， shu er ， shu er …… wo zhi sheng xia yi bu fen le ， bu guo ， wo ba qi ta bu fen dou song zou le 。]

translation: 通常，他们实际上想要一种非常特殊的饮料，这种饮料只能在下一个城镇或更远的地方才能买到。 [tong chang ， ta men shi ji shang xiang yao yi zhong fei chang te shu de yin liao ， zhe zhong yin liao zhi neng zai xia yi ge cheng zhen huo geng yuan de di fang cai neng mai dao 。]

english: And what is wrong with all you people anyway? Sometimes it seems as if half the population of Gielinor are alcoholics!
translation: 你们到底出了什么问题？有时，吉林诺似乎有一半人口都是酗酒者！ [ni men dao di chu le shen me wen ti ？ you shi ， ji lin nuo si hu you yi ban ren kou dou shi xu jiu zhe ！]

english: So, no, I won't do it anymore, you can get your own drink for once, and I'm just going to stay right here until you've done so!
translation: 所以，不，我不会再这样做了，你可以自己喝一次，我会一直待在这里，直到你这样做为止！ [suo yi ， bu ， wo bu hui zai zhe yang zuo le ， ni ke yi zi ji he yi ci ， wo hui yi zhi dai zai zhe li ， zhi dao ni zhe yang zuo wei zhi ！]

english: Pffft, I only wanted a dwarven shtout from that table over there.

translation: 谢谢你的原理图。 [xie xie ni de yuan li tu 。]

translation: 你看起来很值得信赖，我告诉你一个秘密。 [ni kan qi lai hen zhi de xin lai ， wo gao su ni yi ge mi mi 。]

translation: 哈!为您服务就对了！无论如何，牧师只有足够的材料来制造一种诅咒，所以当他试图阻止我们所有人告诉任何人配方时，我们每个人都只得到了诅咒的一部分。这就是为什么我现在听不到任何声音。 [ha ! wei nin fu wu jiu dui le ！ wu lun ru he ， mu shi zhi you zu gou de cai liao lai zhi zao yi zhong zu zhou ， suo yi dang ta shi tu zu zhi wo men suo you ren gao su ren he ren pei fang shi ， wo men mei ge ren dou zhi de dao le zu zhou de yi bu fen 。 zhe jiu shi wei shen me wo xian zai ting bu dao ren he sheng yin 。]

translation: 哈，当着你的面，你这个蒙面怪人！ [ha ， dang zhe ni de mian ， ni zhe ge meng mian guai ren ！]

english: Oh Lacey, Lacey, Lacey. I did tell you to think hard about your answer.
translation: 哦，莱西，莱西，莱西。我确实告诉过你要认真考虑你的答案。 [o ， lai xi ， lai xi ， lai xi 。 wo que shi gao su guo ni yao ren zhen kao lv ni de da an 。]

english: Count Draynor is in fact a vampyre, and he does reside in his manor in Misthalin.
translation: 德雷诺伯爵实际上是一个吸血鬼，他确实居住在米斯哈林的庄园里。 [de lei nuo bo jue shi ji shang shi yi ge xi xue gui ， ta que shi ju zhu zai mi si ha lin de zhuang yuan li 。]

english: But that manor is in WEST Misthalin! I was talking about Count Check! Thanks for playing!
translation: 但那个庄园在西米斯哈林！我说的是计数检查！感谢您的参与！ [dan na ge zhuang yuan zai xi mi si ha lin ！ wo shuo de shi ji shu jian cha ！ gan xie nin de can yu ！]

english: No, no you tricked me! This isn't fair, ask me another...
translation: 不不不，你骗我的！这不公平，请再问我... [bu bu bu ， ni pian wo de ！ zhe bu gong ping ， qing zai wen wo ...]

english: Lacey dies.
translation: 莱西死了。 [lai xi si le 。]

english: The killer slips a note through the fence, and walks away.
translation: 凶手从栅栏里塞出一张纸条，然后走开。 [xiong shou cong zha lan li sai chu yi zhang zhi tiao ， ran hou zou kai 。]

english: That monster! I have to stop them! Let's see what that new note says.
translation: 那个怪物！我必须阻止他们！让我们看看新注释说了什么。 [na ge guai wu ！ wo bi xu zu zhi ta men ！ rang wo men kan kan xin zhu shi shuo le shen me 。]

english: Why am I the one who is always left clearing up after everyone?
translation: 为什么我是那个总是在大家后面清理的人？ [wei shen me wo shi na ge zong shi zai da jia hou mian qing li de ren ？]

english: Hello? Anyone there?
translation: 你好？有人在吗？ [ni hao ？ you ren zai ma ？]

english: Hello? Lacey? Sid?
translation: 你好？莱西？席德？ [ni hao ？ lai xi ？ xi de ？]

english: Hmm, well I guess I should go check it out. No point staying in this nice, locked room when I could go outside into the creepy darkness.
translation: 嗯，我想我应该去看看。当我可以走出去进入令人毛骨悚然的黑暗时，呆在这个漂亮的、上锁的房间里毫无意义。 [n ， wo xiang wo ying gai qu kan kan 。 dang wo ke yi zou chu qu jin ru ling ren mao gu song ran de hei an shi ， dai zai zhe ge piao liang de 、 shang suo de fang jian li hao wu yi yi 。]

english: Seriously!?
translation: 严重地！？ [yan zhong di ！？]

english: The walls and door seem too thick for Mandy to be able to hear you.
translation: 墙壁和门似乎太厚，曼迪听不到你说话。 [qiang bi he men si hu tai hou ， man di ting bu dao ni shuo hua 。]

english: Oh, and I don't think there is any need to take this big, shiny weapon with me in order to defend myself. Nothing bad ever happens when people go check out noises in the dark outside of houses!
translation: 哦，我认为没有必要随身携带这个又大又闪亮的武器来保护自己。当人们在屋外黑暗中检查噪音时，不会发生任何坏事！ [o ， wo ren wei mei you bi yao sui shen xie dai zhe ge you da you shan liang de wu qi lai bao hu zi ji 。 dang ren men zai wu wai hei an zhong jian cha zao yin shi ， bu hui fa sheng ren he huai shi ！]

english: You have got to be kidding...
translation: 你一定是在开玩笑…… [ni yi ding shi zai kai wan xiao ……]

english: Ok, well, here I go!
translation: 好吧，好吧，我开始了！ [hao ba ， hao ba ， wo kai shi le ！]

english: Mandy goes outside to investigate the noises.
translation: 曼迪出去调查噪音。 [man di chu qu diao cha zao yin 。]

english: Hello, anyone out here?
translation: 你好，有人在吗？ [ni hao ， you ren zai ma ？]

english: Mandy looks around.
translation: 曼迪环顾四周。 [man di huan gu si zhou 。]

english: See, I knew nothing would happen! Must have just been a squirrel or something running about.
translation: 看，我知道不会发生任何事情！一定是一只松鼠或者什么东西在跑来跑去。 [kan ， wo zhi dao bu hui fa sheng ren he shi qing ！ yi ding shi yi zhi song shu huo zhe shen me dong xi zai pao lai pao qu 。]

english: Mandy goes back into the kitchen.
translation: 曼迪回到厨房。 [man di hui dao chu fang 。]

english: Oh well, back to the dishes.
translation: 哦，好吧，回到菜肴。 [o ， hao ba ， hui dao cai yao 。]

english: Phew, that was lucky!
translation: 唷，真幸运！ [yo ， zhen xing yun ！]

english: The killer comes out of the closet near the exit and stabs Mandy.
translation: 凶手从出口附近的衣柜里出来，刺伤了曼迪。 [xiong shou cong chu kou fu jin de yi gui li chu lai ， ci shang le man di 。]

english: No...why...me...
translation: 不……为什么……我…… [bu …… wei shen me …… wo ……]

english: Mandy dies.
translation: 曼迪死了。 [man di si le 。]

english: That psycho! He was just toying with her!
translation: 那个神经病！他只是在玩弄她而已！ [na ge shen jing bing ！ ta zhi shi zai wan nong ta er yi ！]

english: Another note. This guy really likes playing games, but this is going to be a game he won't win!
translation: 另一个注意事项。这家伙很喜欢玩游戏，但这将是一场他赢不了的游戏！ [ling yi ge zhu yi shi xiang 。 zhe jia huo hen xi huan wan you xi ， dan zhe jiang shi yi chang ta ying bu liao de you xi ！]

english: Show yourself you coward!
translation: 让你自己看看你是个胆小鬼！ [rang ni zi ji kan kan ni shi ge dan xiao gui ！]

english: So we meet at last. I have to say, I'm impressed you worked out my riddles.
translation: 所以我们终于见面了。我不得不说，你解答了我的谜语，给我留下了深刻的印象。 [suo yi wo men zhong yu jian mian le 。 wo bu de bu shuo ， ni jie da le wo de mi yu ， gei wo liu xia le shen ke de yin xiang 。]

english: Well maybe you aren't as smart as you think you are.
translation: 好吧，也许你并不像你想象的那么聪明。 [hao ba ， ye xu ni bing bu xiang ni xiang xiang de na me cong ming 。]

english: Oh really? All the dead bodies suggest otherwise. And what did you do to stop them?
translation: 哦真的吗？所有尸体都表明情况并非如此。你做了什么来阻止他们？ [o zhen de ma ？ suo you shi ti dou biao ming qing kuang bing fei ru ci 。 ni zuo le shen me lai zu zhi ta men ？]

english: NOTHING!
translation: 没有什么！ [mei you shen me ！]

english: People think you are some big hero but you're not. All you adventurers are the same. Nothing but opportunists!
translation: 人们认为你是大英雄，但你不是。你们冒险家都是一样的。除了机会主义者，什么都没有！ [ren men ren wei ni shi da ying xiong ， dan ni bu shi 。 ni men mao xian jia dou shi yi yang de 。 chu le ji hui zhu yi zhe ， shen me dou mei you ！]

english: What are you going on about?
translation: 你到底在忙什么？ [ni dao di zai mang shen me ？]

english: Well, I did have this big speech planned out but quite frankly I don't think you are worth the effort it would take to deliver it.
translation: 嗯，我确实计划了这次大型演讲，但坦率地说，我认为你不值得付出努力来演讲。 [n ， wo que shi ji hua le zhe ci da xing yan jiang ， dan tan shuai di shuo ， wo ren wei ni bu zhi de fu chu nu li lai yan jiang 。]

english: So, this is the end of the line for you. It is time for the final act. The showdown. The finale. Let's see if you are up to the challenge!
translation: 所以，这就是您的终点。现在是最后一幕的时候了。对决。结局。让我们看看您是否能应对挑战！ [suo yi ， zhe jiu shi nin de zhong dian 。 xian zai shi zui hou yi mu de shi hou le 。 dui jue 。 jie ju 。 rang wo men kan kan nin shi fou neng ying dui tiao zhan ！]

english: Urgh...I think I may have underestimated you.
translation: 呃……我想我可能低估了你。 [e …… wo xiang wo ke neng di gu le ni 。]

english: You've lost at your own game. And now it is time to see who you really are under that mask!
translation: 你已经输掉了自己的游戏。现在是时候看看面具下的你到底是谁了！ [ni yi jing shu diao le zi ji de you xi 。 xian zai shi shi hou kan kan mian ju xia de ni dao di shi shui le ！]

english: The player unmasks the killer, revealing Abigale as the culprit.
translation: 玩家揭开了凶手的面纱，揭露了阿比盖尔就是罪魁祸首。 [wan jia jie kai le xiong shou de mian sha ， jie lu le a bi gai er jiu shi zui kui huo shou 。]

english: No! You!? But why!? Why on earth would you kill all your friends!? Why beg me to come here to help them!?
translation: 不！你！？但为什么！？你到底为什么要杀死你所有的朋友！？为什么求我来这里帮助他们！？ [bu ！ ni ！？ dan wei shen me ！？ ni dao di wei shen me yao sha si ni suo you de peng you ！？ wei shen me qiu wo lai zhe li bang zhu ta men ！？]

english: You just don't get it do you?
translation: 你只是不明白，是吗？ [ni zhi shi bu ming bai ， shi ma ？]

english: So big headed. So used to it all being about you. About you saving the day.
translation: 头好大啊So used to it all being about you. About you saving the day. [tou hao da a So used to it all being about you. About you saving the day.]

english: Well I'm sick of it!
translation: 好吧，我厌倦了！ [hao ba ， wo yan juan le ！]

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你是什​​么意思？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: Adventurers! You're all the same. Everything always has to be about you.
translation: 冒险家们！你们都一样。一切都必须以你为中心。 [mao xian jia men ！ ni men dou yi yang 。 yi qie dou bi xu yi ni wei zhong xin 。]

english: I don't understand?
translation: 我不明白？ [wo bu ming bai ？]

english: Of course you wouldn't! Because you can't see past yourself!
translation: 你当然不会！因为你看不到过去的自己！ [ni dang ran bu hui ！ yin wei ni kan bu dao guo qu de zi ji ！]

english: Believe it or not... I used to be like you.
translation: 不管你信不信……我以前也和你一样。 [bu guan ni xin bu xin …… wo yi qian ye he ni yi yang 。]

english: I'd hear about some damsel in distress and go to help. To have my moment. For me to be the hero, just for once.
translation: 我会听说某个女孩遇险并去帮忙。拥有我的时刻。对我来说，成为英雄，就一次。 [wo hui ting shuo mou ge nv hai yu xian bing qu bang mang 。 yong you wo de shi ke 。 dui wo lai shuo ， cheng wei ying xiong ， jiu yi ci 。]

english: But YOU! You and every other darned adventurer! Every time I get there to help, it's too late. Crisis solved. Disaster averted. Reward claimed. Every time you and those other adventurers steal my moment!
translation: 但是你！你和其他所有该死的冒险家！每次我去那里帮忙时，都为时已晚。危机解决了。灾难得以避免。奖励已领取。 Every time you and those other adventurers steal my moment! [dan shi ni ！ ni he qi ta suo you gai si de mao xian jia ！ mei ci wo qu na li bang mang shi ， dou wei shi yi wan 。 wei ji jie jue le 。 zai nan de yi bi mian 。 jiang li yi ling qu 。 Every time you and those other adventurers steal my moment!]

english: But not this time!
translation: 但这次不是！ [dan zhe ci bu shi ！]

english: This time, it is all about me! I'm the star of the show! ME ME ME ME ME!
translation: 这一次，一切都是为了我！我是节目的明星！我我我我我我！ [zhe yi ci ， yi qie dou shi wei le wo ！ wo shi jie mu de ming xing ！ wo wo wo wo wo wo ！]

english: Well not any longer. The show is over, and there will be no curtain call.
translation: 好吧，不再是了。演出结束了，不会有谢幕。 [hao ba ， bu zai shi le 。 yan chu jie shu le ， bu hui you xie mu 。]

english: Oh, but there is always a curtain call.
translation: 哦，但谢幕总是有的。 [o ， dan xie mu zong shi you de 。]

english: Another killer comes out of the closest near the door.
translation: 另一个杀手从最靠近门的地方出现。 [ling yi ge sha shou cong zui kao jin men de di fang chu xian 。]

english: What!? How!? There was another killer!?
translation: 什么！？如何！？还有一个杀手！？ [shen me ！？ ru he ！？ hai you yi ge sha shou ！？]

english: Of course. Every good show needs a good supporting actor. Now, take off your mask darling. Take a bow. You have earned it.
translation: 当然。每一部好剧都需要一个好的配角。现在，摘下你的面具吧，亲爱的。谢幕。你已经赢得了它。 [dang ran 。 mei yi bu hao ju dou xu yao yi ge hao de pei jue 。 xian zai ， zhai xia ni de mian ju ba ， qin ai de 。 xie mu 。 ni yi jing ying de le ta 。]

english: Of course, my love.
translation: 当然，我的爱人。 [dang ran ， wo de ai ren 。]

english: The killer unmasks himself, revealing Hewey as the culprit.
translation: 凶手揭开了自己的面纱，揭露了休伊的真凶。 [xiong shou jie kai le zi ji de mian sha ， jie lu le xiu yi de zhen xiong 。]

english: You!? But how!? You were almost dead when I saw you! I saw your wounds!
translation: 你！？但如何！？当我看到你的时候你就快死了！我看到你的伤口了！ [ni ！？ dan ru he ！？ dang wo kan dao ni de shi hou ni jiu kuai si le ！ wo kan dao ni de shang kou le ！]

english: No, what you watched was what we wanted you to watch. A masterful performance if I do say myself.
translation: 不，你看的就是我们想让你看的。如果我自己说的话，这是一场精湛的表演。 [bu ， ni kan de jiu shi wo men xiang rang ni kan de 。 ru guo wo zi ji shuo de hua ， zhe shi yi chang jing zhan de biao yan 。]

english: But what is in this for you?
translation: 但这对你来说有什么好处呢？ [dan zhe dui ni lai shuo you shen me hao chu ne ？]

english: Everyone loves the limelight, and who better to share it with than my beloved Abigale.
translation: 每个人都喜欢成为众人瞩目的焦点，还有谁比我心爱的阿比盖尔更适合与之分享。 [mei ge ren dou xi huan cheng wei zhong ren zhu mu di jiao dian ， hai you shui bi wo xin ai de a bi gai er geng shi he yu zhi fen xiang 。]

english: But your friends?
translation: 但你的朋友呢？ [dan ni de peng you ne ？]

english: They didn't deserve to die!
translation: 他们不该死！ [ta men bu gai si ！]

english: Perhaps not, but neither did I deserve to be cast back into the shadows when I deserve the spotlight!
translation: 也许不是，但当我值得成为聚光灯时，我也不应该回到阴影中！ [ye xu bu shi ， dan dang wo zhi de cheng wei ju guang deng shi ， wo ye bu ying gai hui dao yin ying zhong ！]

english: Yes, while we deserve the spotlight.
translation: 是的，虽然我们值得受到关注。 [shi de ， sui ran wo men zhi de shou dao guan zhu 。]

english: And now I have my starring role!
translation: 现在我有了我的主角！ [xian zai wo you le wo de zhu jue ！]

english: OUR starring role.
translation: 我们的主角。 [wo men de zhu jue 。]

english: Gielinor will forever remember this night and what I have done here.
translation: 吉林诺将永远记住这个夜晚和我在这里所做的一切。 [ji lin nuo jiang yong yuan ji zhu zhe ge ye wan he wo zai zhe li suo zuo de yi qie 。]

english: No, what WE have done!
translation: 不，我们做了什么！ [bu ， wo men zuo le shen me ！]

english: Quiet Hewey! This is my moment!
translation: 安静的休伊！这是我的时刻！ [an jing de xiu yi ！ zhe shi wo de shi ke ！]

english: No, this is supposed to be our moment! It isn't just all about you either! We were in this together!
translation: 不，这应该是我们的时刻！这也不只是你的事！我们在一起！ [bu ， zhe ying gai shi wo men de shi ke ！ zhe ye bu zhi shi ni de shi ！ wo men zai yi qi ！]

english: Stop ruining this Hewey! I have worked so hard for this and I'm not going to let you take it away from me!
translation: 别再毁了这个休伊了！我为此付出了巨大的努力，我不会让你把它从我身边夺走！ [bie zai hui le zhe ge xiu yi le ！ wo wei ci fu chu le ju da de nu li ， wo bu hui rang ni ba ta cong wo shen bian duo zou ！]

english: Well I'm not going to be pushed aside either, we were both in this as equals!
translation: 好吧，我也不会被推到一边，我们都是平等的！ [hao ba ， wo ye bu hui bei tui dao yi bian ， wo men dou shi ping deng de ！]

english: We were never equals! How could you possibly compare to me!?
translation: 我们从来就不是平等的！你怎么能和我比！？ [wo men cong lai jiu bu shi ping deng de ！ ni zen me neng he wo bi ！？]

english: You egotistical, selfish...
translation: 你这个自私的人，自私的人…… [ni zhe ge zi si de ren ， zi si de ren ……]

english: Abigale stabs Hewey.
translation: 阿比盖尔刺伤休伊。 [a bi gai er ci shang xiu yi 。]

english: No...my love...
translation: 不……我的爱…… [bu …… wo de ai ……]

english: Hewey dies.
translation: 休伊去世。 [xiu yi qu shi 。]

english: No....no...what have I done!?
translation: 不……不……我做了什么！？ [bu …… bu …… wo zuo le shen me ！？]

english: It wasn't supposed to be like this...but you just couldn't let me have my moment. WHY HEWEY WHY!? I loved you...
translation: 事情不应该是这样的……但你就是不让我拥有属于我的时刻。为什么休伊为什么！？我爱你... [shi qing bu ying gai shi zhe yang de …… dan ni jiu shi bu rang wo yong you shu yu wo de shi ke 。 wei shen me xiu yi wei shen me ！？ wo ai ni ...]

english: This could be my chance to take advantage of the situation...
translation: 这可能是我利用这种情况的机会...... [zhe ke neng shi wo li yong zhe zhong qing kuang de ji hui ......]

english: I'll find the light, that will see me through.
translation: 我会找到光明，它会带我渡过难关。 [wo hui zhao dao guang ming ， ta hui dai wo du guo nan guan 。]

translation: 好吧，那么我就去探索一下。 [hao ba ， na me wo jiu qu tan suo yi xia 。]

translation: 黑暗中的果冻碎片。 [hei an zhong de guo dong sui pian 。]

english: Welcome to my court. I am King Arthur of the Knights of the Round Table.
translation: 欢迎来到我的法庭。我是圆桌骑士团的亚瑟王。 [huan ying lai dao wo de fa ting 。 wo shi yuan zhuo qi shi tuan de ya se wang 。]

translation: 我要成为圆桌骑士！ [wo yao cheng wei yuan zhuo qi shi ！]

english: Really? Well then you will need to go on a quest to prove yourself worthy. My knights all appreciate a good quest.
translation: 真的吗？那么你需要继续追求来证明自己的价值。我的骑士们都欣赏美好的任务。 [zhen de ma ？ na me ni xu yao ji xu zhui qiu lai zheng ming zi ji de jia zhi 。 wo de qi shi men dou xin shang mei hao de ren wu 。]

english: Unfortunately, our current quest is to rescue Merlin. He recently got himself trapped in some sort of magical crystal. We've moved him from the cave we found him in and now he's upstairs in his tower.
translation: 不幸的是，我们当前的任务是营救梅林。他最近被困在某种魔法水晶中。我们已经把他从发现他的山洞里移了出来，现在他在塔楼的楼上。 [bu xing de shi ， wo men dang qian de ren wu shi ying jiu mei lin 。 ta zui jin bei kun zai mou zhong mo fa shui jing zhong 。 wo men yi jing ba ta cong fa xian ta de shan dong li yi le chu lai ， xian zai ta zai ta lou de lou shang 。]

english: I will see what I can do then.
translation: 我会看看我能做什么。 [wo hui kan kan wo neng zuo shen me 。]

english: Talk to my knights if you need any help.
translation: 如果您需要任何帮助，请与我的骑士们联系。 [ru guo nin xu yao ren he bang zhu ， qing yu wo de qi shi men lian xi 。]

english: I may come back and try that later.
translation: 我可能会稍后回来尝试。 [wo ke neng hui shao hou hui lai chang shi 。]

english: Be sure that you come speak to me soon then.
translation: 那么请务必尽快来跟我说话。 [na me qing wu bi jin kuai lai gen wo shuo hua 。]

english: So what are you doing in Gielinor?
translation: 那么你在吉林诺做什么呢？ [na me ni zai ji lin nuo zuo shen me ne ？]

english: Well legend says we will return to Britain in its time of greatest need. But that's not for quite a while yet.
translation: 传说我们会在英国最需要的时候返回英国。但这还不是很长一段时间。 [chuan shuo wo men hui zai ying guo zui xu yao de shi hou fan hui ying guo 。 dan zhe hai bu shi hen zhang yi duan shi jian 。]

english: So we've moved the whole outfit here for now.
translation: 所以我们现在把整套衣服都搬到这里了。 [suo yi wo men xian zai ba zheng tao yi fu dou ban dao zhe li le 。]

english: We're passing the time in Gielinor!
translation: 我们正在吉林诺打发时间！ [wo men zheng zai ji lin nuo da fa shi jian ！]

english: Thank you very much.
translation: 非常感谢。 [fei chang gan xie 。]

english: Now I am a knight of the round table, do you have any more quests for me?
translation: 现在我已经是圆桌骑士了，你还有什么任务要交给我吗？ [xian zai wo yi jing shi yuan zhuo qi shi le ， ni hai you shen me ren wu yao jiao gei wo ma ？]

english: Aha! I'm glad you are here! I am sending out various knights on an important quest. I was wondering if you too would like to take up this quest?
translation: 啊哈！我很高兴你在这里！我正在派遣各种骑士执行一项重要任务。我想知道你是否也愿意接受这个任务？ [a ha ！ wo hen gao xing ni zai zhe li ！ wo zheng zai pai qian ge zhong qi shi zhi xing yi xiang zhong yao ren wu 。 wo xiang zhi dao ni shi fou ye yuan yi jie shou zhe ge ren wu ？]

english: Tell me of this quest.
translation: 告诉我这个任务。 [gao su wo zhe ge ren wu 。]

english: Well, we recently found out that the Holy Grail has passed into Gielinor.
translation: 嗯，我们最近发现圣杯已经传到了吉利诺。 [n ， wo men zui jin fa xian sheng bei yi jing zhuan dao le ji li nuo 。]

english: This is most fortuitous!
translation: 这是最偶然的！ [zhe shi zui ou ran de ！]

english: None of my knights ever did return with it last time. Now we have the opportunity to give it another go, maybe this time we will have more luck!
translation: 上次我的骑士们都没有带着它回来。现在我们有机会再试一次，也许这一次我们会有更多的运气！ [shang ci wo de qi shi men dou mei you dai zhe ta hui lai 。 xian zai wo men you ji hui zai shi yi ci ， ye xu zhe yi ci wo men hui you geng duo de yun qi ！]

english: Before starting this quest, be aware that your combat level is lower than the recommended level of 50.
translation: 在开始此任务之前，请注意您的战斗等级低于推荐等级 50。 [zai kai shi ci ren wu zhi qian ， qing zhu yi nin de zhan dou deng ji di yu tui jian deng ji  50。]

english: I'd enjoy trying that.
translation: 我很乐意尝试。 [wo hen le yi chang shi 。]

english: Go speak to Merlin. He may be able to give a better clue as to where it is now you have freed him from that crystal.
translation: 去和梅林说话吧。他也许能够提供更好的线索，了解你现在把他从水晶中解救出来的位置。 [qu he mei lin shuo hua ba 。 ta ye xu neng gou ti gong geng hao de xian suo ， liao jie ni xian zai ba ta cong shui jing zhong jie jiu chu lai de wei zhi 。]

english: He has set up his workshop in the room next to the library.
translation: 他在图书馆旁边的房间里设立了自己的工作室。 [ta zai tu shu guan pang bian de fang jian li she li le zi ji de gong zuo shi 。]

english: I am weary of questing for the time being...
translation: 我暂时厌倦了追寻...... [wo zan shi yan juan le zhui xun ......]

english: I am weary of questing for the time being...
translation: 我暂时厌倦了追寻...... [wo zan shi yan juan le zhui xun ......]

english: Maybe later then?
translation: 也许稍后？ [ye xu shao hou ？]

english: Maybe so.
translation: 也许是这样。 [ye xu shi zhe yang 。]

english: Welcome, brave knight. I am always happy to see you back at my court. Please feel free to roam the castle and make use of the training grounds.
translation: 欢迎，勇敢的骑士。我总是很高兴见到你回到我的法庭。请随意在城堡内漫步并利用训练场。 [huan ying ， yong gan de qi shi 。 wo zong shi hen gao xing jian dao ni hui dao wo de fa ting 。 qing sui yi zai cheng bao nei man bu bing li yong xun lian chang 。]

english: I want to become a Knight of the Round Table!
translation: 我要成为圆桌骑士！ [wo yao cheng wei yuan zhuo qi shi ！]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: So what are you doing in Gielinor?
translation: 那么你在吉林诺做什么呢？ [na me ni zai ji lin nuo zuo shen me ne ？]

english: Thank you very much.
translation: 非常感谢。 [fei chang gan xie 。]

english: Tell me of this quest.
translation: 告诉我这个任务。 [gao su wo zhe ge ren wu 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Well hello stranger. My name's Bolren, I'm the king of the tree gnomes.
translation: 好吧，你好陌生人。我的名字叫博伦，我是树侏儒之王。 [hao ba ， ni hao mo sheng ren 。 wo de ming zi jiao bo lun ， wo shi shu zhu ru zhi wang 。]

english: I'm surprised you made it in, maybe I made the maze too easy.
translation: 我很惊讶你能进去，也许是我把迷宫弄得太简单了。 [wo hen jing ya ni neng jin qu ， ye xu shi wo ba mi gong nong de tai jian dan le 。]

english: Maybe.
translation: 或许。 [huo xu 。]

english: I'm afraid I have more serious concerns at the moment. Very serious.
translation: 恐怕我现在有更严重的担忧。非常严重。 [kong pa wo xian zai you geng yan zhong de dan you 。 fei chang yan zhong 。]

english: I'll leave you to it then.
translation: 那我就把它留给你了。 [na wo jiu ba ta liu gei ni le 。]

english: Ok, take care.
translation: 好的，保重。 [hao de ， bao zhong 。]

english: Can I help at all?
translation: 我能帮忙吗？ [wo neng bang mang ma ？]

english: I'm glad you asked.
translation: 我很高兴你问了。 [wo hen gao xing ni wen le 。]

english: The truth is my people are in grave danger. We have always been protected by the Spirit Tree. No creature of dark can harm us while its three orbs are in place.
translation: 事实是我的人民正处于严重危险之中。我们一直受到灵树的保护。当黑暗生物的三个球就位时，任何黑暗生物都无法伤害我们。 [shi shi shi wo de ren min zheng chu yu yan zhong wei xian zhi zhong 。 wo men yi zhi shou dao ling shu de bao hu 。 dang hei an sheng wu de san ge qiu jiu wei shi ， ren he hei an sheng wu dou wu fa shang hai wo men 。]

english: We are not a violent race, but we fight when we must. Many gnomes have fallen battling the dark forces of Khazard to the North.
translation: 我们不是一个暴力的种族，但我们会在必要时战斗。许多侏儒在北方卡扎德黑暗势力的战斗中阵亡。 [wo men bu shi yi ge bao li de zhong zu ， dan wo men hui zai bi yao shi zhan dou 。 xu duo zhu ru zai bei fang ka zha de hei an shi li de zhan dou zhong zhen wang 。]

english: We became desperate, so we took one orb of protection to the battlefield. It was a foolish move.
translation: 我们绝望了，于是带着一颗防护球来到了战场。这是一个愚蠢的举动。 [wo men jue wang le ， yu shi dai zhe yi ke fang hu qiu lai dao le zhan chang 。 zhe shi yi ge yu chun de ju dong 。]

english: Khazard troops seized the orb. Now we are completely defenceless.
translation: 卡扎德军队夺取了这颗球体。现在我们完全毫无防备。 [ka zha de jun dui duo qu le zhe ke qiu ti 。 xian zai wo men wan quan hao wu fang bei 。]

english: How can I help?
translation: 我能提供什么帮助吗？ [wo neng ti gong shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: You would be a huge benefit on the battlefield. If you would go there and try to retrieve the orb, my people and I will be forever grateful.
translation: 你将在战场上获得巨大的好处。如果你愿意去那里尝试取回球体，我和我的人民将永远感激不已。 [ni jiang zai zhan chang shang huo de ju da de hao chu 。 ru guo ni yuan yi qu na li chang shi qu hui qiu ti ， wo he wo de ren min jiang yong yuan gan ji bu yi 。]

english: I would be glad to help.
translation: 我很乐意提供帮助。 [wo hen le yi ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: Thank you. The battlefield is to the north of the maze. Commander Montai will inform you of their current situation.
translation: 谢谢。战场在迷宫的北边。蒙泰指挥官将向您通报他们目前的情况。 [xie xie 。 zhan chang zai mi gong de bei bian 。 meng tai zhi hui guan jiang xiang nin tong bao ta men mu qian de qing kuang 。]

english: That is if he's still alive.
translation: 那就是如果他还活着的话。 [na jiu shi ru guo ta hai huo zhe de hua 。]

english: My assistant shall guide you out. Good luck friend, try your best to return the orb.
translation: 我的助理会带你出去的。祝你好运，朋友，尽力归还宝珠。 [wo de zhu li hui dai ni chu qu de 。 zhu ni hao yun ， peng you ， jin li gui huan bao zhu 。]

english: The player is placed at the entrance of the maze.
translation: 玩家被放置在迷宫的入口处。 [wan jia bei fang zhi zai mi gong de ru kou chu 。]

english: We're out of the maze now. Please hurry, we must have the orb if we are to survive.
translation: 现在我们已经走出迷宫了。请快点，如果我们要生存，就必须拥有球体。 [xian zai wo men yi jing zou chu mi gong le 。 qing kuai dian ， ru guo wo men yao sheng cun ， jiu bi xu yong you qiu ti 。]

english: I'm sorry but I won't be involved.
translation: 抱歉，但我不会参与其中。 [bao qian ， dan wo bu hui can yu qi zhong 。]

english: Ok then, travel safe.
translation: 好吧，那就安全出行吧。 [hao ba ， na jiu an quan chu xing ba 。]

english: Hello Bolren.
translation: 你好，博伦。 [ni hao ， bo lun 。]

english: Hello traveller, we must retrieve the orb. It's being held by Khazard troops north of here.
translation: 你好旅行者，我们必须取回球体。它被北边的卡扎尔军队控制着。 [ni hao lv xing zhe ， wo men bi xu qu hui qiu ti 。 ta bei bei bian de ka zha er jun dui kong zhi zhe 。]

english: Ok, I'll try my best.
translation: 好的，我会尽力的。 [hao de ， wo hui jin li de 。]

english: The orb is being held at the battlefield north of the maze.
translation: 该球体被保存在迷宫北面的战场上。 [gai qiu ti bei bao cun zai mi gong bei mian de zhan chang shang 。]

english: Do you have the orb?
translation: 你有宝珠吗？ [ni you bao zhu ma ？]

english: No, I'm afraid not.
translation: 不，恐怕不是。 [bu ， kong pa bu shi 。]

english: Please, we must have the orb if we are to survive.
translation: 拜托，如果我们要生存，就必须拥有球体。 [bai tuo ， ru guo wo men yao sheng cun ， jiu bi xu yong you qiu ti 。]

english: I have the orb.
translation: 我有宝珠。 [wo you bao zhu 。]

english: Oh my... The misery, the horror!
translation: 哦天啊……痛苦，恐怖！ [o tian a …… tong ku ， kong bu ！]

english: King Bolren, are you OK?
translation: 博伦国王，你还好吗？ [bo lun guo wang ， ni hai hao ma ？]

english: Thank you traveller, but it's too late. We're all doomed.
translation: 谢谢你的旅行者，但已经太晚了。我们都注定了。 [xie xie ni de lv xing zhe ， dan yi jing tai wan le 。 wo men dou zhu ding le 。]

english: What happened?
translation: 发生了什么？ [fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: They came in the night. I don't know how many, but enough.
translation: 他们是晚上来的。我不知道有多少，但足够了。 [ta men shi wan shang lai de 。 wo bu zhi dao you duo shao ， dan zu gou le 。]

english: Who?
translation: WHO？ [WHO？]

english: Khazard troops. They slaughtered anyone who got in their way. Women, children, my wife.
translation: 卡扎尔军队。他们屠杀任何阻碍他们的人。女人，孩子，我的妻子。 [ka zha er jun dui 。 ta men tu sha ren he zu ai ta men de ren 。 nv ren ， hai zi ， wo de qi zi 。]

english: I'm sorry.
translation: 对不起。 [dui bu qi 。]

english: They took the other orbs, now we are defenceless.
translation: 他们拿走了其他的球体，现在我们毫无防御能力。 [ta men na zou le qi ta de qiu ti ， xian zai wo men hao wu fang yu neng li 。]

english: Where did they take them?
translation: 他们把他们带到哪里去了？ [ta men ba ta men dai dao na li qu le ？]

english: They headed north of the stronghold. A warlord carries the orbs.
translation: 他们向要塞北边走去。军阀携带着这些球体。 [ta men xiang yao sai bei bian zou qu 。 jun fa xie dai zhe zhe xie qiu ti 。]

english: I will find the warlord and bring back the orbs.
translation: 我会找到军阀并带回宝珠。 [wo hui zhao dao jun fa bing dai hui bao zhu 。]

english: You are brave, but this task will be tough even for you. I wish you the best of luck. Once again you are our only hope.
translation: 你很勇敢，但这项任务对你来说也很艰巨。祝你好运。你再次成为我们唯一的希望。 [ni hen yong gan ， dan zhe xiang ren wu dui ni lai shuo ye hen jian ju 。 zhu ni hao yun 。 ni zai ci cheng wei wo men wei yi de xi wang 。]

english: I will safeguard this orb and pray for your safe return. My assistant will guide you out.
translation: 我会守护这颗宝珠，祈祷你平安归来。我的助理会带你出去。 [wo hui shou hu zhe ke bao zhu ， qi dao ni ping an gui lai 。 wo de zhu li hui dai ni chu qu 。]

english: Good luck friend.
translation: 祝你好运朋友。 [zhu ni hao yun peng you 。]

english: I'm sorry but I can't help.
translation: 抱歉，但我无能为力。 [bao qian ， dan wo wu neng wei li 。]

english: I understand, this isn't your battle.
translation: 我明白，这不是你的战斗。 [wo ming bai ， zhe bu shi ni de zhan dou 。]

english: The orbs are gone, taken north of the battlefield by a Khazard warlord. We're all doomed.
translation: 球体消失了，被卡扎尔军阀带到了战场以北。我们都注定了。 [qiu ti xiao shi le ， bei ka zha er jun fa dai dao le zhan chang yi bei 。 wo men dou zhu ding le 。]

english: Bolren, I have returned.
translation: 博伦，我回来了。 [bo lun ， wo hui lai le 。]

english: You made it back! Do you have the orbs?
translation: 你回来了！你有球体吗？ [ni hui lai le ！ ni you qiu ti ma ？]

english: Please, we must have the orbs if we are to survive.
translation: 拜托，如果我们要生存，就必须拥有球体。 [bai tuo ， ru guo wo men yao sheng cun ， jiu bi xu yong you qiu ti 。]

english: I have them here.
translation: 我这里有。 [wo zhe li you 。]

english: Hooray, you're amazing. I didn't think it was possible but you've saved us.
translation: 万岁，你太棒了。我认为这是不可能的，但你救了我们。 [wan sui ， ni tai bang le 。 wo ren wei zhe shi bu ke neng de ， dan ni jiu le wo men 。]

english: Once the orbs are replaced we will be safe once more. We must begin the ceremony immediately.
translation: 一旦球体被更换，我们将再次安全。我们必须立即开始仪式。 [yi dan qiu ti bei geng huan ， wo men jiang zai ci an quan 。 wo men bi xu li ji kai shi yi shi 。]

english: What does the ceremony involve?
translation: 仪式涉及什么？ [yi shi she ji shen me ？]

english: The spirit tree has looked over us for centuries. Now we must pay our respects.
translation: 几个世纪以来，灵树一直守护着我们。现在我们必须表达敬意。 [ji ge shi ji yi lai ， ling shu yi zhi shou hu zhe wo men 。 xian zai wo men bi xu biao da jing yi 。]

english: The orbs appear above the spirit tree, while the local gnomes alternate paying their respects.
translation: 球体出现在灵树上方，而当地的侏儒则轮流表达敬意。 [qiu ti chu xian zai ling shu shang fang ， er dang di de zhu ru ze lun liu biao da jing yi 。]

english: Su tana.
translation: 苏塔那。 [su ta na 。]

english: En tania.
translation: 恩塔尼亚。 [en ta ni ya 。]

english: Now at last my people are safe once more. We can live in peace again.
translation: 现在我的人民终于再次安全了。我们又可以和平生活了。 [xian zai wo de ren min zhong yu zai ci an quan le 。 wo men you ke yi he ping sheng huo le 。]

english: I'm pleased I could help.
translation: 我很高兴能提供帮助。 [wo hen gao xing neng ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: You are modest brave traveller.
translation: 你是谦虚勇敢的旅行者。 [ni shi qian xu yong gan de lv xing zhe 。]

english: Please, for your efforts take this amulet. It's made from the same sacred stone as the orbs of protection. It will help keep you safe on your journeys.
translation: 为了你的努力，请收下这个护身符。它是由与保护球相同的神圣石头制成的。它将帮助您确保旅途安全。 [wei le ni de nu li ， qing shou xia zhe ge hu shen fu 。 ta shi you yu bao hu qiu xiang tong de shen sheng shi tou zhi cheng de 。 ta jiang bang zhu nin que bao lv tu an quan 。]

english: Thank you King Bolren.
translation: 谢谢博伦国王。 [xie xie bo lun guo wang 。]

english: The tree has many other powers, some of which I cannot reveal. As a friend of the gnome people, I can now allow you to use the tree's magic to teleport to other trees grown from related seeds.
translation: 这棵树还有许多其他的力量，其中一些我无法透露。作为侏儒人民的朋友，我现在可以允许你使用这棵树的魔法传送到其他由相关种子长成的树上。 [zhe ke shu hai you xu duo qi ta de li liang ， qi zhong yi xie wo wu fa tou lu 。 zuo wei zhu ru ren min de peng you ， wo xian zai ke yi yun xu ni shi yong zhe ke shu de mo fa chuan song dao qi ta you xiang guan zhong zi zhang cheng de shu shang 。]

english: Congratulations! Quest complete!
translation: 恭喜！任务完成！ [gong xi ！ ren wu wan cheng ！]

english: Hello again Bolren.
translation: 博伦，你好。 [bo lun ， ni hao 。]

english: Well hello, it's good to see you again.
translation: 嗯，你好，很高兴再次见到你。 [n ， ni hao ， hen gao xing zai ci jian dao ni 。]

english: I've lost my amulet.
translation: 我的护身符丢了。 [wo de hu shen fu diu le 。]

english: Oh dear. Here, take another. We truly are indebted to you.
translation: 哦亲爱的。来，再拿一个。我们真的很感激你。 [o qin ai de 。 lai ， zai na yi ge 。 wo men zhen de hen gan ji ni 。]

english: Here, I think this belongs to you.
translation: 在这里，我想这是属于你的。 [zai zhe li ， wo xiang zhe shi shu yu ni de 。]

english: Hello there. Any luck in the quest for Arposandra?
translation: 你好呀。寻找阿波斯桑德拉有运气吗？ [ni hao ya 。 xun zhao a bo si sang de la you yun qi ma ？]

english: Sort of. I think I've worked out where Arposandra is, but my attempt to enter didn't go well. There seems to be quite an extensive set of defences.
translation: 有点像。我想我已经弄清楚了阿波桑德拉在哪里，但我进入的尝试并不顺利。似乎有相当广泛的防御措施。 [you dian xiang 。 wo xiang wo yi jing nong qing chu le a bo sang de la zai na li ， dan wo jin ru de chang shi bing bu shun li 。 si hu you xiang dang guang fan de fang yu cuo shi 。]

english: Ah, that is a problem. I wish I could offer more help, but the Khazard Army already poses a major threat to us. We can't afford to split ourselves fighting two different enemies.
translation: 啊，这是一个问题。我希望能够提供更多帮助，但卡扎德军已经对我们构成了重大威胁。我们不能分裂自己去对抗两个不同的敌人。 [a ， zhe shi yi ge wen ti 。 wo xi wang neng gou ti gong geng duo bang zhu ， dan ka zha de jun yi jing dui wo men gou cheng le zhong da wei xie 。 wo men bu neng fen lie zi ji qu dui kang liang ge bu tong de di ren 。]

english: So we do nothing?
translation: 那么我们什么都不做？ [na me wo men shen me dou bu zuo ？]

english: For now, I'm afraid so. Glouphrie is a foe that must be dealt with one day, but that day is not today.
translation: 目前看来，恐怕是这样。格卢弗里是一个终有一天必须对付的敌人，但那一天不是今天。 [mu qian kan lai ， kong pa shi zhe yang 。 ge lu fu li shi yi ge zhong you yi tian bi xu dui fu de di ren ， dan na yi tian bu shi jin tian 。]

english: Hello again.
translation: 又好。 [you hao 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: How are things here?
translation: 这里怎么样？ [zhe li zen me yang ？]

english: I fear the war against the Khazard Army is set to outlive us all. We keep making progress, but for every foe we defeat, Khazard sends two more.
translation: 我担心针对卡扎德军的战争将会比我们所有人都更长久。我们不断取得进步，但每击败一个敌人，卡扎德就会再派出两个敌人。 [wo dan xin zhen dui ka zha de jun de zhan zheng jiang hui bi wo men suo you ren dou geng chang jiu 。 wo men bu duan qu de jin bu ， dan mei ji bai yi ge di ren ， ka zha de jiu hui zai pai chu liang ge di ren 。]

english: Still, we thankfully haven't had any more Glouphrie problems at least.
translation: 不过，值得庆幸的是，我们至少没有再遇到任何 Glouphrie 问题。 [bu guo ， zhi de qing xing de shi ， wo men zhi shao mei you zai yu dao ren he  Glouphrie  wen ti 。]

english: That's good to hear. All the best.
translation: 很高兴听到这个消息。一切顺利。 [hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi 。 yi qie shun li 。]

english: Congratulations, human!
translation: 恭喜你，人类！ [gong xi ni ， ren lei ！]

english: The king has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 国王给了你另一张线索卷轴！ [guo wang gei le ni ling yi zhang xian suo juan zhou ！]

english: Option: I'll leave you to it then.
translation: 选项：那我就交给你了。 [xuan xiang ： na wo jiu jiao gei ni le 。]

english: Can I help at all?
translation: 我能帮忙吗？ [wo neng bang mang ma ？]

english: I would be glad to help.
translation: 我很乐意提供帮助。 [wo hen le yi ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: I'm sorry but I won't be involved.
translation: 抱歉，但我不会参与其中。 [bao qian ， dan wo bu hui can yu qi zhong 。]

english: I will find the warlord and bring back the orbs.
translation: 我会找到军阀并带回宝珠。 [wo hui zhao dao jun fa bing dai hui bao zhu 。]

english: I'm sorry but I can't help.
translation: 抱歉，但我无能为力。 [bao qian ， dan wo wu neng wei li 。]

english: Good day.
translation: 再会。 [zai hui 。]

english: What are you doing here? All Mourners should know that if they need to contact me, they need to use the proper channels!
translation: 你在这里做什么？所有哀悼者都应该知道，如果他们需要联系我，他们需要使用正确的渠道！ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？ suo you ai dao zhe dou ying gai zhi dao ， ru guo ta men xu yao lian xi wo ， ta men xu yao shi yong zheng que de qu dao ！]

english: Sorry, I'm a new recruit.
translation: 抱歉，我是新人。 [bao qian ， wo shi xin ren 。]

english: Well do not let it happen again.
translation: 好吧，不要让它再次发生。 [hao ba ， bu yao rang ta zai ci fa sheng 。]

english: Adventurer! It is good to see you again.
translation: 冒险家！很高兴再次见到你。 [mao xian jia ！ hen gao xing zai ci jian dao ni 。]

english: And you too, King. How fares the tree?
translation: 还有你，国王。这棵树的情况如何？ [hai you ni ， guo wang 。 zhe ke shu de qing kuang ru he ？]

english: The tree? It is fine, as it has always been since we foiled Glough's plans.
translation: 树？没关系，自从我们挫败了格洛的计划以来一直都是这样。 [shu ？ mei guan xi ， zi cong wo men cuo bai le ge luo de ji hua yi lai yi zhi dou shi zhe yang 。]

english: Good. What ever did happen to Glough?
translation: 好的。格洛到底发生了什么？ [hao de 。 ge luo dao di fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: Oh, I forced him to resign. I have now appointed a new Head Tree Guardian, Daero. He is learning quickly and serves me well.
translation: 哦，我强迫他辞职。我现在任命了新的主树守护者，Daero。他学得很快并且为我服务很好。 [o ， wo qiang po ta ci zhi 。 wo xian zai ren ming le xin de zhu shu shou hu zhe ，Daero。 ta xue de hen kuai bing qie wei wo fu wu hen hao 。]

english: King, you look worried. Is anything the matter?
translation: 国王，你看起来很担心。有什么事吗？ [guo wang ， ni kan qi lai hen dan xin 。 you shen me shi ma ？]

english: Nothing in particular ... Well actually, yes - there is.
translation: 没什么特别的......实际上，是的 - 有。 [mei shen me te bie de ...... shi ji shang ， shi de  -  you 。]

english: What is it?
translation: 它是什么？ [ta shi shen me ？]

english: Well, do you remember Glough's ship building facilities in Karamja?
translation: 那么，您还记得格洛在卡拉姆贾的造船设施吗？ [na me ， nin hai ji de ge luo zai ka la mu jia de zao chuan she shi ma ？]

english: Yes, they were on the eastern coast. What of them?
translation: 是的，他们在东海岸。他们呢？ [shi de ， ta men zai dong hai an 。 ta men ne ？]

english: After you defeated Glough's demon I sent an envoy of my Royal Guard, the 10th squad, to oversee the decommission of the shipyard. They were ordered to use force if necessary.
translation: 在你击败了格洛夫的恶魔之后，我派遣了我的皇家卫队第十小队的特使去监督造船厂的退役。他们被命令在必要时使用武力。 [zai ni ji bai le ge luo fu de e mo zhi hou ， wo pai qian le wo de huang jia wei dui di shi xiao dui de te shi qu jian du zao chuan chang de tui yi 。 ta men bei ming ling zai bi yao shi shi yong wu li 。]

english: I see ... Were they successful?
translation: 我明白了……他们成功了吗？ [wo ming bai le …… ta men cheng gong le ma ？]

english: I ... I don't know. I have heard nothing from them. I do not even know if they reached the shipyard!
translation: 我……我不知道。我没有收到他们的任何消息。我什至不知道他们是否到达了造船厂！ [wo …… wo bu zhi dao 。 wo mei you shou dao ta men de ren he xiao xi 。 wo shen zhi bu zhi dao ta men shi fou dao da le zao chuan chang ！]

english: It is a long way...
translation: 这是一个很长的路... [zhe shi yi ge hen zhang de lu ...]

english: But I need to know what happened. These are elite soldiers - their disappearance cannot simply be ignored. I cannot wait any longer.
translation: 但我需要知道发生了什么。这些都是精锐士兵——他们的失踪不能简单地被忽视。我不能再等了。 [dan wo xu yao zhi dao fa sheng le shen me 。 zhe xie dou shi jing rui shi bing —— ta men de shi zong bu neng jian dan di bei hu shi 。 wo bu neng zai deng le 。]

english: And so I ask you: would you visit Glough's old shipyard in Karamja and find out if the 10th squad ever managed to reach?
translation: 所以我问你：你会去参观格洛在卡拉姆贾的旧造船厂，看看第十小队是否成功到达了吗？ [suo yi wo wen ni ： ni hui qu can guan ge luo zai ka la mu jia de jiu zao chuan chang ， kan kan di shi xiao dui shi fou cheng gong dao da le ma ？]

english: Ok, I'll do it.
translation: 好的，我会做的。 [hao de ， wo hui zuo de 。]

english: Thank you very much. You may need this Royal Seal to identify yourself as my envoy.
translation: 非常感谢。你可能需要这枚皇家印章来证明你是我的特使。 [fei chang gan xie 。 ni ke neng xu yao zhe mei huang jia yin zhang lai zheng ming ni shi wo de te shi 。]

english: Please report to me as soon as you have any information.
translation: 一旦有任何消息请立即向我报告。 [yi dan you ren he xiao xi qing li ji xiang wo bao gao 。]

english: I'm afraid I am too busy right now.
translation: 恐怕我现在太忙了。 [kong pa wo xian zai tai mang le 。]

english: As you wish. Return to me when you have the time.
translation: 如你所愿。当你有时间的时候就回来找我吧。 [ru ni suo yuan 。 dang ni you shi jian de shi hou jiu hui lai zhao wo ba 。]

english: Are you ready to investigate the shipyard for me?
translation: 你准备好帮我调查造船厂了吗？ [ni zhun bei hao bang wo diao cha zao chuan chang le ma ？]

english: What do I have to do?
translation: 我必须做什么？ [wo bi xu zuo shen me ？]

english: Go to Glough's old shipyard on the eastern coast of Karamja. Find out what happened to the 10th squad of my Royal Guard.
translation: 前往卡拉姆贾东海岸的格洛旧造船厂。看看我的皇家卫队第十小队发生了什么事。 [qian wang ka la mu jia dong hai an de ge luo jiu zao chuan chang 。 kan kan wo de huang jia wei dui di shi xiao dui fa sheng le shen me shi 。]

english: As I said, they were sent to oversee the decommission of the ship building facilities, but I have heard nothing from them.
translation: 正如我所说，他们被派去监督造船设施的退役，但我没有收到他们的任何消息。 [zheng ru wo suo shuo ， ta men bei pai qu jian du zao chuan she shi de tui yi ， dan wo mei you shou dao ta men de ren he xiao xi 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: (same as above)
translation: （同上） [（ tong shang ）]

translation: 欢迎回来，冒险家。 [huan ying hui lai ， mao xian jia 。]

translation: 第十小队的行程如何？ [di shi xiao dui de xing cheng ru he ？]

translation: 他们每人都会驾驶一架侏儒滑翔机。 [ta men mei ren du hui jia shi yi jia zhu ru hua xiang ji 。]

english: (previous)
translation: （以前的） [（ yi qian de ）]
