translation: 我丢失了皇家印章副本... [wo diu shi le huang jia yin zhang fu ben ...]

english: I've lost my copy of the Royal Seal...
translation: 我丢失了皇家印章副本... [wo diu shi le huang jia yin zhang fu ben ...]

english: What?! Do you realise the consequences if it falls into the wrong hands?
translation: 什么？！如果它落入坏人之手，您是否意识到后果？ [shen me ？！ ru guo ta luo ru huai ren zhi shou ， nin shi fou yi shi dao hou guo ？]

english: However, this mission is of paramount importance. I shall give you a spare in the meantime.
translation: 然而，这一使命至关重要。在此期间我会给你一个备用的。 [ran er ， zhe yi shi ming zhi guan zhong yao 。 zai ci qi jian wo hui gei ni yi ge bei yong de 。]

english: (other options)
translation: （其他选项） [（ qi ta xuan xiang ）]

english: I'll be back later.
translation: 我稍后会回来。 [wo shao hou hui hui lai 。]

english: I'll be back later.
translation: 我稍后会回来。 [wo shao hou hui hui lai 。]

english: Hello, King Narnode.
translation: 你好，纳诺德国王。 [ni hao ， na nuo de guo wang 。]

english: Good to see you again, [player name].
translation: 很高兴再次见到你，[玩家姓名]。 [hen gao xing zai ci jian dao ni ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Have you any more Royal Seed Pods?
translation: 您还有更多皇家种子荚吗？ [nin hai you geng duo huang jia zhong zi jia ma ？]

english: How fares the kingdom today?
translation: 今天王国的情况如何？ [jin tian wang guo de qing kuang ru he ？]

english: All is well in the Stronghold thanks to you, [player name].
translation: 感谢你，[玩家名字]，要塞一切顺利。 [gan xie ni ，[ wan jia ming zi ]， yao sai yi qie shun li 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: What am I meant to do?
translation: 我到底要做什么？ [wo dao di yao zuo shen me ？]

translation: 您还有更多皇家种子荚吗？ [nin hai you geng duo huang jia zhong zi jia ma ？]

translation: 今天王国的情况如何？ [jin tian wang guo de qing kuang ru he ？]

english: Greetings, your majesty.
translation: 您好，陛下。 [nin hao ， bi xia 。]

english: Do you have anything of importance to say?
translation: 你有什么重要的话要说吗？ [ni you shen me zhong yao de hua yao shuo ma ？]

english: ...Not really.
translation: ...并不真地。 [... bing bu zhen di 。]

english: You will have to excuse me, then. I am very busy as I have a kingdom to run!
translation: 那么你就得原谅我了。我很忙，因为我有一个王国要经营！ [na me ni jiu de yuan liang wo le 。 wo hen mang ， yin wei wo you yi ge wang guo yao jing ying ！]

english: Well hello there. What do you want?
translation: 嗯，你好。你想要什么？ [n ， ni hao 。 ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Ah, it's you again. Hello there.
translation: 啊，又是你。你好呀。 [a ， you shi ni 。 ni hao ya 。]

english: Is there a reason for you being here?
translation: 你来这里有理由吗？ [ni lai zhe li you li you ma ？]

english: Well, I'm on a treasure trail...
translation: 嗯，我正走在一条宝藏之路上…… [n ， wo zheng zou zai yi tiao bao zang zhi lu shang ……]

english: Oh! Good, then you can answer this question for me!
translation: 哦！好，那你就来回答我这个问题吧！ [o ！ hao ， na ni jiu lai hui da wo zhe ge wen ti ba ！]

english: King Roald has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 罗尔德国王给了你一张挑战卷轴！ [luo er de guo wang gei le ni yi zhang tiao zhan juan zhou ！]

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。 [qing shu ru wen ti de da an 。]

english: Err, that sounds a little wrong to me.
translation: 呃，这对我来说听起来有点不对劲。 [e ， zhe dui wo lai shuo ting qi lai you dian bu dui jin 。]

english: Correct!
translation: 正确的！ [zheng que de ！]

english: King Roald has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 罗尔德国王给了你另一张线索卷轴！ [luo er de guo wang gei le ni ling yi zhang xian suo juan zhou ！]

english: Hello there. Would you like to follow me for a minute?
translation: 你好呀。你愿意跟着我一分钟吗？ [ni hao ya 。 ni yuan yi gen zhe wo yi fen zhong ma ？]

english: Follow you?! I am the King! I am the followed, not the follower!!
translation: 跟着你？！我是国王！我是被追随者，不是追随者！！ [gen zhe ni ？！ wo shi guo wang ！ wo shi bei zhui sui zhe ， bu shi zhui sui zhe ！！]

english: Well, if you can't be bothered then neither can I.
translation: 好吧，如果你不被打扰，那么我也不能。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni bu bei da rao ， na me wo ye bu neng 。]

english: Suit yourself.
translation: 适合自己。 [shi he zi ji 。]

english: No, you suit yourself.
translation: 不，你适合你自己。 [bu ， ni shi he ni zi ji 。]

english: You're quite argumentative for a peasant.
translation: 作为一个农民，你真是好争论。 [zuo wei yi ge nong min ， ni zhen shi hao zheng lun 。]

english: I'm not the one arguing, you are.
translation: 争论的不是我，而是你。 [zheng lun de bu shi wo ， er shi ni 。]

english: Then why do you keep answering me back?
translation: 那你为什么还要回复我？ [na ni wei shen me hai yao hui fu wo ？]

english: No, you're answering me back.
translation: 不，你正在回复我。 [bu ， ni zheng zai hui fu wo 。]

english: Well, stop talking and I'll stop answering.
translation: 好吧，别说话了，我就不回答了。 [hao ba ， bie shuo hua le ， wo jiu bu hui da le 。]

english: No, you stop talking.
translation: 不，你别说话了。 [bu ， ni bie shuo hua le 。]

english: I have stopped talking.
translation: 我已经不再说话了。 [wo yi jing bu zai shuo hua le 。]

english: No you haven't, you're doing it now.
translation: 不，你还没有，你现在正在这样做。 [bu ， ni hai mei you ， ni xian zai zheng zai zhe yang zuo 。]

english: No, I'm just answering what you're saying.
translation: 不，我只是回答你所说的。 [bu ， wo zhi shi hui da ni suo shuo de 。]

english: Okay, so if I don't say anything, you won't answer me back.
translation: 好吧，如果我什么都不说，你就不会回复我。 [hao ba ， ru guo wo shen me dou bu shuo ， ni jiu bu hui hui fu wo 。]

english: Suits me.
translation: 适合我。 [shi he wo 。]

english: Go on, then.
translation: 那么，继续吧。 [na me ， ji xu ba 。]

english: No, you first.
translation: 不，你先。 [bu ， ni xian 。]

english: King Roald doesn't say anything to you.
translation: 罗尔德国王什么也没对你说。 [luo er de guo wang shen me ye mei dui ni shuo 。]

english: You don't say anything back.
translation: 你什么也不说。 [ni shen me ye bu shuo 。]

english: See, that's better.
translation: 瞧，这样好多了。 [qiao ， zhe yang hao duo le 。]

english: Yes, much better.
translation: 是的，好多了。 [shi de ， hao duo le 。]

english: What were you saying about me following you somewhere?
translation: 你刚才说我跟着你去什么地方？ [ni gang cai shuo wo gen zhe ni qu shen me di fang ？]

english: I can't remember, it was such a long time ago.
translation: 我不记得了，那是很久以前的事了。 [wo bu ji de le ， na shi hen jiu yi qian de shi le 。]

english: Ah, that's a shame - I could have done with a breath of fresh air.
translation: 啊，真可惜——我本来可以呼吸新鲜空气的。 [a ， zhen ke xi —— wo ben lai ke yi hu xi xin xian kong qi de 。]

english: Oh well.
translation: 那好吧。 [na hao ba 。]

english: Yes, never mind.
translation: 是的，没关系。 [shi de ， mei guan xi 。]

english: See you around.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Yes, see you later.
translation: 是的，稍后见。 [shi de ， shao hou jian 。]

english: I thought you were going.
translation: 我以为你要走了。 [wo yi wei ni yao zou le 。]

english: I was until you spoke to me again.
translation: 我一直这样，直到你再次跟我说话。 [wo yi zhi zhe yang ， zhi dao ni zai ci gen wo shuo hua 。]

english: I'm sorry, I'll stop speaking to you then.
translation: 对不起，那我就不跟你说话了。 [dui bu qi ， na wo jiu bu gen ni shuo hua le 。]

english: On behalf of everyone in Ardougne, I thank you for your help adventurer. I'm afraid I don't have time to talk, my predecessor has left me with a lot of work to do.
translation: 我代表阿杜涅的所有人，感谢冒险家的帮助。恐怕我没有时间说话，我的前任给我留下了很多工作要做。 [wo dai biao a du nie de suo you ren ， gan xie mao xian jia de bang zhu 。 kong pa wo mei you shi jian shuo hua ， wo de qian ren gei wo liu xia le hen duo gong zuo yao zuo 。]

english: Thank you for your work in bringing peace back to these islands, [Fremennik name].
translation: 感谢您为使这些岛屿恢复和平所做的工作，[弗里曼尼克名字]。 [gan xie nin wei shi zhe xie dao yu hui fu he ping suo zuo de gong zuo ，[ fu li man ni ke ming zi ]。]

english: I hear that the Etceterians have also pledged to give you some of their resources, as thanks for preventing war once again.
translation: 我听说埃塞特人也承诺向你提供一些资源，以感谢你再次阻止了战争。 [wo ting shuo ai sai te ren ye cheng nuo xiang ni ti gong yi xie zi yuan ， yi gan xie ni zai ci zu zhi le zhan zheng 。]

english: How is the kingdom faring?

translation: 我只是厌倦了你，你太需要了！你就不能照顾一下自己吗？ [wo zhi shi yan juan le ni ， ni tai xu yao le ！ ni jiu bu neng zhao gu yi xia zi ji ma ？]

english: Meeeeow, don't leave me master, I'm sorry, I'll be a good kitty from now on meoooww.
translation: 喵喵，不要离开我，主人，对不起，我以后要做一只乖猫喵喵喵。 [miao miao ， bu yao li kai wo ， zhu ren ， dui bu qi ， wo yi hou yao zuo yi zhi guai mao miao miao miao 。]

english: No I've really had it with you, now scat!
translation: 不，我真的受够了你，现在滚吧！ [bu ， wo zhen de shou gou le ni ， xian zai gun ba ！]

english: Go on puss...kill that rat!
translation: 继续吧……杀了那只老鼠！ [ji xu ba …… sha le na zhi lao shu ！]

english: Your cat cannot get to its prey.
translation: 你的猫无法接近它的猎物。 [ni de mao wu fa jie jin ta de lie wu 。]

english: Meeooow!
translation: 喵呜！ [miao wu ！]

english: Miaow!
translation: 咪! [mi !]

english: I think it's hungry!
translation: 我觉得它饿了！ [wo jue de ta e le ！]

english: Your kitten is hungry.
translation: 你的小猫饿了。 [ni de xiao mao e le 。]

english: I think it wants some attention.
translation: 我认为它需要一些关注。 [wo ren wei ta xu yao yi xie guan zhu 。]

english: Your kitten wants attention.
translation: 您的小猫需要关注。 [nin de xiao mao xu yao guan zhu 。]

english: Meeeooow!
translation: 喵呜！ [miao wu ！]

english: Your kitten has grown into a healthy cat that can hunt for itself.
translation: 您的小猫已经长成一只健康的猫，可以自己捕猎。 [nin de xiao mao yi jing zhang cheng yi zhi jian kang de mao ， ke yi zi ji bu lie 。]

english: The kitten gobbles up the fish.
translation: 小猫狼吞虎咽地吃掉了鱼。 [xiao mao lang tun hu yan di chi diao le yu 。]

english: Purr!
translation: 咕噜！ [gu lu ！]

english: That kitten loves to play with that ball of wool. I think it is its favourite.
translation: 那只小猫喜欢玩那个毛线球。我认为这是它的最爱。 [na zhi xiao mao xi huan wan na ge mao xian qiu 。 wo ren wei zhe shi ta de zui ai 。]

english: How are you doing?
translation: 你好吗？ [ni hao ma ？]

english: How old are you now?
translation: 你现在几岁了？ [ni xian zai ji sui le ？]

english: Where do you want to go?
translation: 你想去哪里？ [ni xiang qu na li ？]

english: What do you want to do now?
translation: 你现在想做什么？ [ni xian zai xiang zuo shen me ？]

english: Stroke
translation: 中风 [zhong feng]

english: Chase Vermin
translation: 追逐害虫 [zhui zhu hai chong]

english: Guess age
translation: 猜猜年龄 [cai cai nian ling]

english: Shoo away
translation: 赶走 [gan zou]

english: Yes I am.
translation: 我是。 [wo shi 。]

english: No I'm not.
translation: 不，我不是。 [bu ， wo bu shi 。]

english: Stroke (prior to August 2024)
translation: 中风（2024 年 8 月之前） [zhong feng （2024  nian  8  yue zhi qian ）]

english: Stroke (as of August 2024)
translation: 中风（截至 2024 年 8 月） [zhong feng （ jie zhi  2024  nian  8  yue ）]

english: Ho, [Fremennik name]! The brave warrior returns!
translation: 嗬，[弗雷曼尼克名字]！勇敢的战士归来！ [he ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！ yong gan de zhan shi gui lai ！]

english: It was a hard-fought battle, but we Fremennik prevailed!
translation: 这是一场艰苦的战斗，但我们弗雷曼尼克人取得了胜利！ [zhe shi yi chang jian ku de zhan dou ， dan wo men fu lei man ni ke ren qu de le sheng li ！]

english: I expect we'll be hearing songs about the 'Slayer of the Troll King' for many years to come.
translation: 我预计在未来的许多年里我们都会听到有关“巨魔之王的杀手”的歌曲。 [wo yu ji zai wei lai de xu duo nian li wo men du hui ting dao you guan “ ju mo zhi wang de sha shou ” de ge qu 。]

english: It would be an honour to be remembered in such a way! Thanks.
translation: 如果能以这样的方式被铭记，那将是一种荣幸！谢谢。 [ru guo neng yi zhe yang de fang shi bei ming ji ， na jiang shi yi zhong rong xing ！ xie xie 。]

english: Kebabs! Get your kebabs here! One gold each!
translation: 烤肉串！来这里吃烤肉串吧！每人一金！ [kao rou chuan ！ lai zhe li chi kao rou chuan ba ！ mei ren yi jin ！]

english: Sure, one kebab please.
translation: 当然，请来一份烤肉串。 [dang ran ， qing lai yi fen kao rou chuan 。]

english: Yes? Are you going to give me that one gold coin then?
translation: 是的？那你要给我那一枚金币吗？ [shi de ？ na ni yao gei wo na yi mei jin bi ma ？]

english: Sorry, I don't seem to have any money on me.
translation: 抱歉，我身上好像没带钱。 [bao qian ， wo shen shang hao xiang mei dai qian 。]

english: The bank is Keldagrim-West. Hurry back!
translation: 该银行是 Keldagrim-West。快点回来吧！ [gai yin hang shi  Keldagrim-West。 kuai dian hui lai ba ！]

english: I'm looking for a drunken dwarf.
translation: 我正在寻找一个醉酒的矮人。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yi ge zui jiu de ai ren 。]

english: Just go out in the streets, they can't be hard to find!
translation: 只要走在街上，就不难找到！ [zhi yao zou zai jie shang ， jiu bu nan zhao dao ！]

english: No, a specific drunken dwarf, he keeps harassing me.
translation: 不，是一个特定的醉酒矮人，他一直骚扰我。 [bu ， shi yi ge te ding de zui jiu ai ren ， ta yi zhi sao rao wo 。]

english: That's still not very helpful. But let me see. There is one particularly drunken dwarf just to the northeast of here.
translation: 这仍然不是很有帮助。但让我看看。就在这儿的东北方，有一个特别醉的矮人。 [zhe reng ran bu shi hen you bang zhu 。 dan rang wo kan kan 。 jiu zai zhe er de dong bei fang ， you yi ge te bie zui de ai ren 。]

english: He's scaring away my customers, he says there's something wrong with my kebabs. Quite annoying fellow.
translation: 他吓跑了我的顾客，他说我的烤肉串有问题。真是个烦人的家伙。 [ta xia pao le wo de gu ke ， ta shuo wo de kao rou chuan you wen ti 。 zhen shi ge fan ren de jia huo 。]

english: I don't think that's who I mean.
translation: 我不认为这就是我的意思。 [wo bu ren wei zhe jiu shi wo de yi si 。]

english: Well, he does have a relative who wanders all over Gielinor. Comes back from time to time to buy more kebabs. Don't see him very often though.
translation: 嗯，他确实有一个亲戚，在吉林诺各地流浪。时不时回来买更多的烤肉串。不过不常见到他。 [n ， ta que shi you yi ge qin qi ， zai ji lin nuo ge di liu lang 。 shi bu shi hui lai mai geng duo de kao rou chuan 。 bu guo bu chang jian dao ta 。]

english: Do you think I'll have any chance of catching him here?
translation: 你认为我有机会在这里抓住他吗？ [ni ren wei wo you ji hui zai zhe li zhua zhu ta ma ？]

english: I think he was back here quite recently, so I doubt he'll be back any time soon.
translation: 我认为他最近才回到这里，所以我怀疑他很快就会回来。 [wo ren wei ta zui jin cai hui dao zhe li ， suo yi wo huai yi ta hen kuai jiu hui hui lai 。]

english: I thought you would know plenty!
translation: 我以为你会知道很多！ [wo yi wei ni hui zhi dao hen duo ！]

english: How do you mean?
translation: 你是什​​么意思？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: Oh come on! You in the Laughing Miner? The whole city knows about you and your dwarven drinking buddies!
translation: 哦来吧！ 《大笑的矿工》里有你吗？整个城市都知道你和你的矮人酒友！ [o lai ba ！ 《 da xiao de kuang gong 》 li you ni ma ？ zheng ge cheng shi dou zhi dao ni he ni de ai ren jiu you ！]

english: Right, right.
translation: 对，对。 [dui ， dui 。]

english: Do you have any quests?
translation: 你有什么任务吗？ [ni you shen me ren wu ma ？]

english: Not really! I have a steady supply of meat coming in through the carts and I don't really need anything else!
translation: 并不真地！我有通过推车稳定供应的肉，我真的不需要任何其他东西！ [bing bu zhen di ！ wo you tong guo tui che wen ding gong ying de rou ， wo zhen de bu xu yao ren he qi ta dong xi ！]

english: Sure, one kebab please.
translation: 当然，请来一份烤肉串。 [dang ran ， qing lai yi fen kao rou chuan 。]

english: I'm looking for a drunken dwarf.
translation: 我正在寻找一个醉酒的矮人。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yi ge zui jiu de ai ren 。]

english: Do you have any quests?
translation: 你有什么任务吗？ [ni you shen me ren wu ma ？]

english: Hello my good man.
translation: 你好，我的好人。 [ni hao ， wo de hao ren 。]

english: Good day to you outsider. You should be careful down here. We're the only ones that haven't yet turned.
translation: 祝你这个局外人美好的一天。你在下面一定要小心。我们是唯一还没有转身的人。 [zhu ni zhe ge ju wai ren mei hao de yi tian 。 ni zai xia mian yi ding yao xiao xin 。 wo men shi wei yi hai mei you zhuan shen de ren 。]

english: If you're not careful you'll become one of them too!
translation: 一不小心你也会成为他们中的一员！ [yi bu xiao xin ni ye hui cheng wei ta men zhong de yi yuan ！]

english: Who? Iban's followers?
translation: WHO？伊班人的追随者？ [WHO？ yi ban ren de zhui sui zhe ？]

english: They're not followers, they're slaves, they're the soulless...
translation: 他们不是追随者，他们是奴隶，他们是没有灵魂的人…… [ta men bu shi zhui sui zhe ， ta men shi nu li ， ta men shi mei you ling hun de ren ……]

english: What happened to them?
translation: 他们怎么了？ [ta men zen me le ？]

english: They were normal once, adventurers, treasure hunters. But men are weak, they couldn't ignore the voices.
translation: 他们曾经是普通人，冒险家，寻宝者。但男人是软弱的，他们不能忽视这些声音。 [ta men ceng jing shi pu tong ren ， mao xian jia ， xun bao zhe 。 dan nan ren shi ruan ruo de ， ta men bu neng hu shi zhe xie sheng yin 。]

english: Now they all seem to think with one conscience... As if they're being controlled by one being...
translation: 现在他们似乎都在用一种良心思考……就像被一个存在控制一样…… [xian zai ta men si hu dou zai yong yi zhong liang xin si kao …… jiu xiang bei yi ge cun zai kong zhi yi yang ……]

english: Iban?
translation: 伊班人？ [yi ban ren ？]

english: Maybe... maybe Zamorak himself. Those who try and fight it are locked in cages, until their minds are too weak to resist.
translation: 也许……也许是萨莫拉克本人。那些试图与之抗争的人会被关在笼子里，直到他们的心智太弱而无法抵抗。 [ye xu …… ye xu shi sa mo la ke ben ren 。 na xie shi tu yu zhi kang zheng de ren hui bei guan zai long zi li ， zhi dao ta men de xin zhi tai ruo er wu fa di kang 。]

english: Eventually they all fall to his control...
translation: 最终，所有人都落入了他的掌控之中…… [zui zhong ， suo you ren dou luo ru le ta de zhang kong zhi zhong ……]

english: No wonder their breath is so bad!
translation: 难怪他们的气息这么难闻！ [nan guai ta men de qi xi zhe me nan wen ！]

english: You think this is funny... Eh?
translation: 你觉得这很有趣……呃？ [ni jue de zhe hen you qu …… e ？]

english: Not really, just trying to lighten up the conversation.
translation: 并不是真的，只是想让谈话变得轻松一些。 [bing bu shi zhen de ， zhi shi xiang rang tan hua bian de qing song yi xie 。]

english: Anyway, I have something that might help you. I crafted these to protect myself from the teeth of the soulless, their bite is vicious.
translation: 无论如何，我有一些东西可能会帮助你。我制作这些是为了保护自己免受无灵魂的牙齿的伤害，它们的咬伤是恶毒的。 [wu lun ru he ， wo you yi xie dong xi ke neng hui bang zhu ni 。 wo zhi zuo zhe xie shi wei le bao hu zi ji mian shou wu ling hun de ya chi de shang hai ， ta men de yao shang shi e du de 。]

english: I haven't seen another pair which can withstand their jaws...
translation: 我还没有见过另一对能够承受他们的下巴...... [wo hai mei you jian guo ling yi dui neng gou cheng shou ta men de xia ba ......]

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: No problem traveller. Good luck.
translation: 没问题的旅行者。祝你好运。 [mei wen ti de lv xing zhe 。 zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Hello Klank.
translation: 你好，克兰克。 [ni hao ， ke lan ke 。]

english: Hello again adventurer, so you're still around?
translation: 你好，冒险家，你还在吗？ [ni hao ， mao xian jia ， ni hai zai ma ？]

english: Still here!
translation: 还在这里！ [hai zai zhe li ！]

english: Have you any more gauntlets?
translation: 你还有更多的手套吗？ [ni hai you geng duo de shou tao ma ？]

english: Well..yes, but they're not cheap to make. I'll have to sell you a pair...
translation: 嗯..是的，但它们的制造成本并不便宜。我得卖给你一双... [n .. shi de ， dan ta men de zhi zao cheng ben bing bu bian yi 。 wo de mai gei ni yi shuang ...]

english: How much?
translation: 多少？ [duo shao ？]

english: 5,000 coins.
translation: 5,000枚金币。 [5,000 mei jin bi 。]

english: 5,000, you must be joking!
translation: 5000，你一定是在开玩笑吧！ [5000， ni yi ding shi zai kai wan xiao ba ！]

english: We don't joke down here friend...
translation: 我们不在这里开玩笑朋友... [wo men bu zai zhe li kai wan xiao peng you ...]

english: Okay then, I'll take a pair.
translation: 好吧，那我就买一双。 [hao ba ， na wo jiu mai yi shuang 。]

english: There you go... I hope they help.
translation: 就这样...我希望他们能有所帮助。 [jiu zhe yang ... wo xi wang ta men neng you suo bang zhu 。]

english: I'll see you around Klank.
translation: 我们在克兰克附近见。 [wo men zai ke lan ke fu jin jian 。]

english: Oh dear, I haven't got enough money...
translation: 哎呀，我的钱还不够…… [ai ya ， wo de qian hai bu gou ……]

english: Sorry, I can't sell them any cheaper than that.
translation: 抱歉，我卖不出比这更便宜的价格了。 [bao qian ， wo mai bu chu bi zhe geng pian yi de jia ge le 。]

english: Take care Klank.
translation: 照顾好克兰克。 [zhao gu hao ke lan ke 。]

english: You too adventurer...
translation: 你也是冒险家... [ni ye shi mao xian jia ...]

english: What happened to them?
translation: 他们怎么了？ [ta men zen me le ？]

english: No wonder their breath is so bad!
translation: 难怪他们的气息这么难闻！ [nan guai ta men de qi xi zhe me nan wen ！]

english: Have you anymore gauntlets?
translation: 你还有手套吗？ [ni hai you shou tao ma ？]

english: 5,000, you must be joking!
translation: 5000，你一定是在开玩笑吧！ [5000， ni yi ding shi zai kai wan xiao ba ！]

english: Okay then, I'll take a pair.
translation: 好吧，那我就买一双。 [hao ba ， na wo jiu mai yi shuang 。]

english: Take care Klank.
translation: 照顾好克兰克。 [zhao gu hao ke lan ke 。]

english: So, are you interested in buying a ship? Now, I'll be straight with you: she's not quite seaworthy right now, but give her a bit of work and she'll be the nippiest ship this side of Port Khazard.
translation: 那么，您有兴趣购买一艘船吗？现在，我会直接告诉你：她现在不太适合航海，但是给她一些工作，她将成为卡扎德港这一侧最敏捷的船。 [na me ， nin you xing qu gou mai yi sou chuan ma ？ xian zai ， wo hui zhi jie gao su ni ： ta xian zai bu tai shi he hang hai ， dan shi gei ta yi xie gong zuo ， ta jiang cheng wei ka zha de gang zhe yi ce zui min jie de chuan 。]

english: Do you know when she will be seaworthy?
translation: 你知道她什么时候可以出海吗？ [ni zhi dao ta shen me shi hou ke yi chu hai ma ？]

english: No, not really. Port Sarim's shipbuilders aren't very efficient so it could be quite a while.
translation: 不，不是真的。沙里姆港的造船厂效率不高，因此可能需要相当长的时间。 [bu ， bu shi zhen de 。 sha li mu gang de zao chuan chang xiao lv bu gao ， yin ci ke neng xu yao xiang dang zhang de shi jian 。]

english: Would you take me to Crandor when she's ready?
translation: 当她准备好时你能带我去克兰多吗？ [dang ta zhun bei hao shi ni neng dai wo qu ke lan duo ma ？]

english: Crandor? You're joking, right?
translation: 克兰多？你在开玩笑吧？ [ke lan duo ？ ni zai kai wan xiao ba ？]

english: Yes. Ha ha ha!
translation: 是的。哈哈哈！ [shi de 。 ha ha ha ！]

english: Crandor's not something we sailors joke about. You can't sail from here to Catherby, or Entrana, or Ardougne without going past that accursed island.
translation: 克兰多不是我们水手开玩笑的对象。如果不经过那个被诅咒的岛屿，你就无法从这里航行到凯瑟比、恩特拉纳或阿杜涅。 [ke lan duo bu shi wo men shui shou kai wan xiao de dui xiang 。 ru guo bu jing guo na ge bei zu zhou de dao yu ， ni jiu wu fa cong zhe li hang xing dao kai se bi 、 en te la na huo a du nie 。]

english: You can't get close to it because of the reefs, but you can always see it.
translation: 因为有礁石的缘故，你无法靠近它，但你总能看到它。 [yin wei you jiao shi de yuan gu ， ni wu fa kao jin ta ， dan ni zong neng kan dao ta 。]

english: Sometimes you can see a dark shape in the sky, circling the island. That's when you have to sail on as quick as you can and pray it's not hungry. Every year, more ships are lost to that dragon.
translation: 有时你可以看到天空中有一个黑色的形状，绕着岛屿转。那时你必须尽快航行并祈祷它不饿。每年，都有更多的船只被那条龙夺去。 [you shi ni ke yi kan dao tian kong zhong you yi ge hei se de xing zhuang ， rao zhe dao yu zhuan 。 na shi ni bi xu jin kuai hang xing bing qi dao ta bu e 。 mei nian ， dou you geng duo de chuan zhi bei na tiao long duo qu 。]

english: No. I want to go to Crandor.
translation: 不，我想去克兰多。 [bu ， wo xiang qu ke lan duo 。]

english: Then you must be crazy.
translation: 那你一定是疯了。 [na ni yi ding shi feng le 。]

english: That island is surrounded by reefs that would rip this ship to shreds. Even if you found a map, you'd need an experienced captain to stand a chance of getting through
translation: 那个岛周围都是珊瑚礁，会把这艘船撕成碎片。即使你找到了地图，你也需要有经验丰富的船长才能有机会通过 [na ge dao zhou wei dou shi shan hu jiao ， hui ba zhe sou chuan si cheng sui pian 。 ji shi ni zhao dao le di tu ， ni ye xu yao you jing yan feng fu de chuan zhang cai neng you ji hui tong guo]

english: and, even if I could get to it, there's no way I'm going any closer to that dragon than I have to. They say it can destroy whole ships with one bite.
translation: 而且，即使我能到达那里，我也无法比必须的更接近那条龙。他们说它一口就能摧毁整艘船。 [er qie ， ji shi wo neng dao da na li ， wo ye wu fa bi bi xu de geng jie jin na tiao long 。 ta men shuo ta yi kou jiu neng cui hui zheng sou chuan 。]

english: Why is she damaged?
translation: 她为何受伤？ [ta wei he shou shang ？]

english: Oh, there was no particular accident. It's just years of wear and tear.
translation: 哦，没有什么特别的意外。这只是多年的磨损。 [o ， mei you shen me te bie de yi wai 。 zhe zhi shi duo nian de mo sun 。]

english: The Lady Lumbridge is an old Crandorian fishing ship - the last one of her kind, as far as I know. That kind of ship was always mightily maneuverable, but not too tough.
translation: 拉姆布里奇夫人号是一艘古老的克兰多渔船——据我所知，这是她同类中的最后一艘。这种船总是具有很强的机动性，但又不太坚固。 [la mu bu li qi fu ren hao shi yi sou gu lao de ke lan duo yu chuan —— ju wo suo zhi ， zhe shi ta tong lei zhong de zui hou yi sou 。 zhe zhong chuan zong shi ju you hen qiang de ji dong xing ， dan you bu tai jian gu 。]

english: She happened to be somewhere else when Crandor was destroyed, and she's had several owners since then. Not all of them have looked after her too well,
translation: 当克兰多被摧毁时，她碰巧在其他地方，从那以后她有过好几个主人。并不是所有人都把她照顾得很好， [dang ke lan duo bei cui hui shi ， ta peng qiao zai qi ta di fang ， cong na yi hou ta you guo hao ji ge zhu ren 。 bing bu shi suo you ren dou ba ta zhao gu de hen hao ，]

english: but once she's patched up, she'll be good as new!
translation: 但一旦修好，她就会焕然一新！ [dan yi dan xiu hao ， ta jiu hui huan ran yi xin ！]

english: I'd like to buy her.
translation: 我想买她的 [wo xiang mai ta de]

english: Of course! I'm sure the work needed to do on it wouldn't be too expensive.
translation: 当然！我确信所需的工作不会太昂贵。 [dang ran ！ wo que xin suo xu de gong zuo bu hui tai ang gui 。]

english: How does 2,000 gold sound? I'll even throw in my cabin boy, Jenkins, for free! He'll swab the decks and splice the mainsails for you!
translation: 2000金币听起来怎么样？我什至会免费让我的机舱侍者詹金斯加入！他会为您擦拭甲板并拼接主帆！ [2000 jin bi ting qi lai zen me yang ？ wo shen zhi hui mian fei rang wo de ji cang shi zhe zhan jin si jia ru ！ ta hui wei nin ca shi jia ban bing pin jie zhu fan ！]

english: Yep, sounds good.
translation: 是的，听起来不错。 [shi de ， ting qi lai bu cuo 。]

english: Okey dokey, she's all yours!
translation: 好吧，傻瓜，她都是你的了！ [hao ba ， sha gua ， ta dou shi ni de le ！]

english: (Klarense takes 2000 gp from the player)
translation: （克拉伦斯从玩家那里拿走 2000 gp） [（ ke la lun si cong wan jia na li na zou  2000 gp）]

english: ...except I don't have that kind of money on me...
translation: ……不过我身上没有那么多钱…… […… bu guo wo shen shang mei you na me duo qian ……]

english: I'm not paying that much for a broken boat!
translation: 我不会为一艘破船付那么多钱！ [wo bu hui wei yi sou po chuan fu na me duo qian ！]

english: That's fair enough, I suppose.
translation: 我想这很公平。 [wo xiang zhe hen gong ping 。]

english: Ah well, never mind.
translation: 啊好吧，没关系。 [a hao ba ， mei guan xi 。]

english: Hello, captain! Here to inspect your new ship? Just a little work and she'll be seaworthy again.
translation: 你好，队长！来这里检查你的新船？只需做一点工作，她就会再次适合航海。 [ni hao ， dui zhang ！ lai zhe li jian cha ni de xin chuan ？ zhi xu zuo yi dian gong zuo ， ta jiu hui zai ci shi he hang hai 。]

english: So, what needs fixing on this ship?
translation: 那么，这艘船需要修复什么？ [na me ， zhe sou chuan xu yao xiu fu shen me ？]

english: Well, the big gaping hole in the hold is the problem. You'll need a few wooden planks hammered in with steel nails to fix it.
translation: 好吧，船舱里的大洞就是问题所在。你需要一些用钢钉钉入的木板来固定它。 [hao ba ， chuan cang li de da dong jiu shi wen ti suo zai 。 ni xu yao yi xie yong gang ding ding ru de mu ban lai gu ding ta 。]

english: So would you like to sail this ship to Crandor for me?
translation: 那么你愿意帮我驾驶这艘船前往克兰多吗？ [na me ni yuan yi bang wo jia shi zhe sou chuan qian wang ke lan duo ma ？]

english: What are you going to do now you don't have a ship?
translation: 现在没有船你要做什么？ [xian zai mei you chuan ni yao zuo shen me ？]

english: Oh, I'll be fine. I've got work as Port Sarim's first lifeguard!
translation: 哦，我会没事的。我找到了沙里姆港第一位救生员的工作！ [o ， wo hui mei shi de 。 wo zhao dao le sha li mu gang di yi wei jiu sheng yuan de gong zuo ！]

english: Can I board the ship now?
translation: 我现在可以登船吗？ [wo xian zai ke yi deng chuan ma ？]

english: Sure thing, she's all yours.
translation: 当然可以，她就是你的了。 [dang ran ke yi ， ta jiu shi ni de le 。]

english: Wow! You sure are lucky! Seems the Lady Lumbridge just washed right up into the dock by herself!
translation: 哇！你确实很幸运！看来朗布里奇女士刚刚独自冲上码头！ [wa ！ ni que shi hen xing yun ！ kan lai lang bu li qi nv shi gang gang du zi chong shang ma tou ！]

english: She's pretty badly damaged, though...
translation: 虽然她的伤势相当严重…… [sui ran ta de shang shi xiang dang yan zhong ……]

english: Hey, that's my ship!
translation: 嘿，那是我的船！ [hei ， na shi wo de chuan ！]

english: No, it's not. It may, to the untrained eye, at first appear to be the Lady Lumbridge, but it is definitely not. It's my new ship. It just happens to look slightly similar, is all.
translation: 不，不是。对于未经训练的人来说，乍一看它可能看起来像是朗布里奇女士，但它绝对不是。这是我的新船。只是看起来有点相似，仅此而已。 [bu ， bu shi 。 dui yu wei jing xun lian de ren lai shuo ， zha yi kan ta ke neng kan qi lai xiang shi lang bu li qi nv shi ， dan ta jue dui bu shi 。 zhe shi wo de xin chuan 。 zhi shi kan qi lai you dian xiang si ， jin ci er yi 。]

english: It has Lady Lumbridge painted out and 'Klarense's Cruiser' painted over it!
translation: 它涂有伦布里奇女士，上面涂有“克拉伦斯巡洋舰”！ [ta tu you lun bu li qi nv shi ， shang mian tu you “ ke la lun si xun yang jian ”！]

english: Nope, you're mistaken. It's my new boat.
translation: 不，你错了。这是我的新船。 [bu ， ni cuo le 。 zhe shi wo de xin chuan 。]

english: Well will you at least take me to Crandor in it?
translation: 好吧，你至少能带我去克兰多吗？ [hao ba ， ni zhi shao neng dai wo qu ke lan duo ma ？]

english: Nope. I don't take passengers on my ship.
translation: 没有。我的船上不载客。 [mei you 。 wo de chuan shang bu zai ke 。]

english: Argh!
Hey, stay off my ship! That's private property!
translation: 嘿，别靠近我的船！那是私有财产！ [hei ， bie kao jin wo de chuan ！ na shi si you cai chan ！]

english: Do you know when she will be seaworthy?
translation: 你知道她什么时候可以出海吗？ [ni zhi dao ta shen me shi hou ke yi chu hai ma ？]

english: Would you take me to Crandor when she's ready?
translation: 当她准备好时你能带我去克兰多吗？ [dang ta zhun bei hao shi ni neng dai wo qu ke lan duo ma ？]

english: Yes. Ha ha ha!
translation: 是的。哈哈哈！ [shi de 。 ha ha ha ！]

english: No. I want to go to Crandor.
translation: 不，我想去克兰多。 [bu ， wo xiang qu ke lan duo 。]

english: Why is she damaged?
translation: 她为何受伤？ [ta wei he shou shang ？]

english: I'd like to buy her.
translation: 我想买她的 [wo xiang mai ta de]

english: Yep, sounds good.
translation: 是的，听起来不错。 [shi de ， ting qi lai bu cuo 。]

english: I'm not paying that much for a broken boat!
translation: 我不会为一艘破船付那么多钱！ [wo bu hui wei yi sou po chuan fu na me duo qian ！]

english: Ah well, never mind.
translation: 啊好吧，没关系。 [a hao ba ， mei guan xi 。]

english: So, what needs fixing on the ship?
translation: 那么，船上需要修理什么？ [na me ， chuan shang xu yao xiu li shen me ？]

english: Would you sail this ship to Crandor for me?
translation: 你愿意帮我驾驶这艘船去克兰多吗？ [ni yuan yi bang wo jia shi zhe sou chuan qu ke lan duo ma ？]

english: What are you going to do now you don't have a ship?
translation: 现在没有船你要做什么？ [xian zai mei you chuan ni yao zuo shen me ？]

english: Can I board the ship now?
translation: 我现在可以登船吗？ [wo xian zai ke yi deng chuan ma ？]

english: Thank you, adventurer. You have given my soul some respite.
translation: 谢谢你，冒险家。你给了我的灵魂一些喘息的机会。 [xie xie ni ， mao xian jia 。 ni gei le wo de ling hun yi xie chuan xi de ji hui 。]

english: Wait! I want to ask you a question...
translation: 等待！我想问你一个问题... [deng dai ！ wo xiang wen ni yi ge wen ti ...]

english: Klenter disappears before you can ask him anything.
translation: 在你问他任何问题之前，克伦特就消失了。 [zai ni wen ta ren he wen ti zhi qian ， ke lun te jiu xiao shi le 。]

english: He is too busy dancing to talk!
translation: 他忙着跳舞没时间说话！ [ta mang zhe tiao wu mei shi jian shuo hua ！]

english: We're Knights of the Party Room
translation: 我们是派对室的骑士 [wo men shi pai dui shi de qi shi]

english: We dance round and round like a loon
translation: 我们像潜鸟一样绕圈跳舞 [wo men xiang qian niao yi yang rao quan tiao wu]

english: Quite often we like to sing
translation: 很多时候我们喜欢唱歌 [hen duo shi hou wo men xi huan chang ge]

english: Unfortunately we make a din
translation: 不幸的是我们吵闹了 [bu xing de shi wo men chao nao le]

english: Do you like our helmet plumes?
translation: 您喜欢我们的头盔羽毛吗？ [nin xi huan wo men de tou kui yu mao ma ？]

english: Everyone's happy now we can move
translation: 现在大家都很高兴我们可以搬家了 [xian zai da jia dou hen gao xing wo men ke yi ban jia le]

english: Like a party animal in the groove
translation: 就像最时髦的派对动物 [jiu xiang zui shi mao de pai dui dong wu]

english: The party room is a silly place!
translation: 聚会室是个愚蠢的地方！ [ju hui shi shi ge yu chun de di fang ！]

english: Who are you? What are you doing here in the snow?
translation: 你是谁？你在雪地里做什么？ [ni shi shui ？ ni zai xue di li zuo shen me ？]

english: My name is...Sir Gerry. I am...a member of a secret...society of knights. My time is short and I need...your help.
translation: 我的名字是……格里爵士。我是……一个秘密……骑士团的成员。我的时间很短，我需要……你的帮助。 [wo de ming zi shi …… ge li jue shi 。 wo shi …… yi ge mi mi …… qi shi tuan de cheng yuan 。 wo de shi jian hen duan ， wo xu yao …… ni de bang zhu 。]

english: A secret society of knights? What a surprise! Is there an old charter or decree that says if you're a knight you have to belong to a secret order?
translation: 秘密骑士团？真是一个惊喜！是否有一个古老的宪章或法令规定，如果你是一名骑士，你必须属于一个秘密组织？ [mi mi qi shi tuan ？ zhen shi yi ge jing xi ！ shi fou you yi ge gu lao de xian zhang huo fa ling gui ding ， ru guo ni shi yi ming qi shi ， ni bi xu shu yu yi ge mi mi zu zhi ？]

english: I'm sorry, my friend... I do not understand your meaning. Please, time is short... Take this scroll to Sir Tiffy. You will find him in Falador park... You should not...read it... It contains information for his eyes only.
translation: 对不起，我的朋友……我不明白你的意思。拜托，时间紧迫……把这个卷轴交给蒂菲爵士。您会在法拉多公园找到他...您不应该...阅读它...它包含仅供他查看的信息。 [dui bu qi ， wo de peng you …… wo bu ming bai ni de yi si 。 bai tuo ， shi jian jin po …… ba zhe ge juan zhou jiao gei di fei jue shi 。 nin hui zai fa la duo gong yuan zhao dao ta ... nin bu ying gai ... yue du ta ... ta bao han jin gong ta cha kan de xin xi 。]

english: A secret society of knights? You don't mean the Temple Knights, do you?
translation: 秘密骑士团？你不是说圣殿骑士团吧？ [mi mi qi shi tuan ？ ni bu shi shuo sheng dian qi shi tuan ba ？]

english: Yes! Praise Saradomin! You...have been sent in...my hour of need. Please, take...this scroll to Sir Tiffy in Falador park... You should not...read it.
translation: 是的！赞美萨拉多明！你……被派来……在我需要的时候。请将此卷轴带到法拉多公园的蒂菲爵士那里...您不应该...阅读它。 [shi de ！ zan mei sa la duo ming ！ ni …… bei pai lai …… zai wo xu yao de shi hou 。 qing jiang ci juan zhou dai dao fa la duo gong yuan de di fei jue shi na li ... nin bu ying gai ... yue du ta 。]

english: Cough... Hey, over here.
translation: 咳咳……嘿，这里。 [hai hai …… hei ， zhe li 。]

english: He's still alive, but in no condition to talk. He appears to be almost comatose.
translation: 他还活着，但已经无法说话了。他看起来几乎处于昏迷状态。 [ta hai huo zhe ， dan yi jing wu fa shuo hua le 。 ta kan qi lai ji hu chu yu hun mi zhuang tai 。]

english: Good day.
translation: 再会。 [zai hui 。]

english: Hello there citizen. What can I do for you?
translation: 公民你好。我能为你做什么？ [gong min ni hao 。 wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: What's down these stairs?
translation: 这些楼梯下面有什么？ [zhe xie lou ti xia mian you shen me ？]

english: These stairs lead to the Ardougne Prison. It's home to thieves, murderers and everything in between.
translation: 这些楼梯通向阿杜涅监狱。这里是小偷、杀人犯以及介于两者之间的一切人的家园。 [zhe xie lou ti tong xiang a du nie jian yu 。 zhe li shi xiao tou 、 sha ren fan yi ji jie yu liang zhe zhi jian de yi qie ren de jia yuan 。]

english: Sounds lovely. Can I go in?
translation: 听起来很可爱。我可以进去吗？ [ting qi lai hen ke ai 。 wo ke yi jin qu ma ？]

english: I'm afraid not citizen. Only the Knights of Ardougne are allowed into the prison and I can see that you are no knight.
translation: 恐怕不是公民。只有阿杜涅骑士团才允许进入监狱，我看得出你不是骑士。 [kong pa bu shi gong min 。 zhi you a du nie qi shi tuan cai yun xu jin ru jian yu ， wo kan de chu ni bu shi qi shi 。]

english: Hello there fellow knight. Isn't today a wonderful day to be a Knight of Ardougne?
translation: 各位骑士朋友大家好。今天对于成为阿杜涅骑士来说不是美好的一天吗？ [ge wei qi shi peng you da jia hao 。 jin tian dui yu cheng wei a du nie qi shi lai shuo bu shi mei hao de yi tian ma ？]

english: I mean it's okay I suppose. The constant fear of some random adventurer murdering you and the fact that people are constantly picking your pockets isn't great. But hey ho, at least the benefits are good.
translation: 我的意思是我想没关系。持续担心某个随机的冒险家会谋杀你，以及人们不断地扒你的口袋，这并不好。但嘿嘿，至少好处是好的。 [wo de yi si shi wo xiang mei guan xi 。 chi xu dan xin mou ge sui ji de mao xian jia hui mou sha ni ， yi ji ren men bu duan di ba ni de kou dai ， zhe bing bu hao 。 dan hei hei ， zhi shao hao chu shi hao de 。]

english: That they are fellow knight, that they are.
translation: 他们是骑士同胞，他们确实是。 [ta men shi qi shi tong bao ， ta men que shi shi 。]

english: Anyway, can I go down these stairs?
translation: 不管怎样，我可以走下楼梯吗？ [bu guan zen yang ， wo ke yi zou xia lou ti ma ？]

english: Of course you can! You're a Knight of Ardougne! There is no place where you can't go.
translation: 当然可以！你是阿杜涅的骑士！没有你不能去的地方。 [dang ran ke yi ！ ni shi a du nie de qi shi ！ mei you ni bu neng qu de di fang 。]

english: Yeah... Thanks.
translation: 是的...谢谢。 [shi de ... xie xie 。]

english: Good to see you [Tim/Sue].
translation: 很高兴见到你[蒂姆/苏]。 [hen gao xing jian dao ni [ di mu / su ]。]

english: Who's [Tim/Sue]?
translation: [蒂姆/苏]是谁？ [[ di mu / su ] shi shui ？]

english: You are?
translation: 你是？ [ni shi ？]

english: Ah yes, I am [Tim/Sue].
translation: 啊，是的，我是[蒂姆/苏]。 [a ， shi de ， wo shi [ di mu / su ]。]

english: Hmm... Is your head working okay today [Tim/Sue]?
translation: 嗯...今天你的头脑还好吗 [Tim/Sue]？ [n ... jin tian ni de tou nao hai hao ma  [Tim/Sue]？]

english: Of course, my head has never been better.
translation: 当然，我的头脑从来没有这么好过。 [dang ran ， wo de tou nao cong lai mei you zhe me hao guo 。]

english: If you say so...
translation: 如果你这么说的话... [ru guo ni zhe me shuo de hua ...]

english: Ah, nilsal! Hello!
translation: 啊，尼尔萨尔！你好！ [a ， ni er sa er ！ ni hao ！]

english: Ah, hello again!
translation: 啊，又好！ [a ， you hao ！]

english: Hello to you too!
translation: 也向你问好！ [ye xiang ni wen hao ！]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: I'm a Knight of Varlamore, the Kingdom of Sun. I venture to Kourend on a mission, one I can say very little of.
translation: 我是太阳王国瓦拉摩尔的骑士。我冒险前往库伦德是为了执行一项任务，但我对此只能说得很少。 [wo shi tai yang wang guo wa la mo er de qi shi 。 wo mao xian qian wang ku lun de shi wei le zhi xing yi xiang ren wu ， dan wo dui ci zhi neng shuo de hen shao 。]

english: How come?
translation: 怎么会？ [zen me hui ？]

english: I'm afraid you must accept my secrecy adventurer, for who knows what the future holds.
translation: 恐怕你必须接受我的秘密冒险家，因为谁知道未来会怎样。 [kong pa ni bi xu jie shou wo de mi mi mao xian jia ， yin wei shui zhi dao wei lai hui zen yang 。]

english: I found an ancient sun temple.
translation: 我发现了一座古老的太阳神庙。 [wo fa xian le yi zuo gu lao de tai yang shen miao 。]

english: Oh, pray tell, where is this temple?
translation: 哦，请问，这座寺庙在哪里？ [o ， qing wen ， zhe zuo si miao zai na li ？]

english: In a place called the Forthos Ruin to the south-east. I was exploring and discovered symbology to an entity called Ralos.
translation: 东南方一个名为弗索斯遗迹的地方。我正在探索并发现了一个名为 Ralos 的实体的符号系统。 [dong nan fang yi ge ming wei fu suo si yi ji de di fang 。 wo zheng zai tan suo bing fa xian le yi ge ming wei  Ralos  de shi ti de fu hao xi tong 。]

english: I see. I think I shall check out this Ruin. Thank you for letting me know adventurer.
translation: 我懂了。我想我应该去看看这个废墟。谢谢你让我认识了冒险家。 [wo dong le 。 wo xiang wo ying gai qu kan kan zhe ge fei xu 。 xie xie ni rang wo ren shi le mao xian jia 。]

english: No problem... Oh, I don't know your name.
translation: 没问题...哦，我不知道你的名字。 [mei wen ti ... o ， wo bu zhi dao ni de ming zi 。]

english: Call me Astra! Now, I must see to this discovery as it may indeed help my mission. May the light shine upon you!
translation: 叫我阿斯特拉吧！现在，我必须关注这一发现，因为它确实可能有助于我的使命。愿光明照耀你！ [jiao wo a si te la ba ！ xian zai ， wo bi xu guan zhu zhe yi fa xian ， yin wei ta que shi ke neng you zhu yu wo de shi ming 。 yuan guang ming zhao yao ni ！]

english: Where's the Kingdom of Varlamore?
translation: 瓦尔拉摩尔王国在哪里？ [wa er la mo er wang guo zai na li ？]

english: To the south, beyond Mount Quidamortem. It's a glorious land where the sun forever shines.
translation: 向南，在奎达莫特姆山之外。这是一片阳光永远普照的灿烂土地。 [xiang nan ， zai kui da mo te mu shan zhi wai 。 zhe shi yi pian yang guang yong yuan pu zhao de can lan tu di 。]

english: Sounds wonderful!
translation: 听起来棒极了！ [ting qi lai bang ji le ！]

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。 [wo de zou le 。]

english: Stay vigilant, friend.
translation: 保持警惕，朋友。 [bao chi jing ti ， peng you 。]

english: Oh... nilsal, adventurer.
translation: 噢……尼尔萨尔，冒险家。 [o …… ni er sa er ， mao xian jia 。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: How are you, Astra?
translation: 你好吗，阿斯特拉？ [ni hao ma ， a si te la ？]

english: Not great... Can you believe what they've done?
translation: 不太好...你能相信他们做了什么吗？ [bu tai hao ... ni neng xiang xin ta men zuo le shen me ma ？]

english: Done what?
translation: 做了什么？ [zuo le shen me ？]

english: Are you blind? Look what they've done to the altar of Ralos!
translation: 你是瞎子吗？看看他们对拉洛斯祭坛做了什么！ [ni shi xia zi ma ？ kan kan ta men dui la luo si ji tan zuo le shen me ！]

english: Oh... I guess it has seen better days.
translation: 哦...我想它已经有更好的日子了。 [o ... wo xiang ta yi jing you geng hao de ri zi le 。]

english: It was those others! Those undead druids. Blind moon worshippers...
translation: 是其他人！那些不死德鲁伊。盲目的月亮崇拜者... [shi qi ta ren ！ na xie bu si de lu yi 。 mang mu di yue liang chong bai zhe ...]

english: Do you see what they've become? That's what turning your back on the light does. Even as I stand here in this desecrated temple, I feel the light fading from me.
translation: 你看到他们变成什么样了吗？这就是背对灯光的作用。即使我站在这座被亵渎的寺庙里，我仍感到光芒从我身上消失。 [ni kan dao ta men bian cheng shen me yang le ma ？ zhe jiu shi bei dui deng guang de zuo yong 。 ji shi wo zhan zai zhe zuo bei xie du de si miao li ， wo reng gan dao guang mang cong wo shen shang xiao shi 。]

english: I suppose it is quite spooky down here.
translation: 我想这里一定很恐怖。 [wo xiang zhe li yi ding hen kong bu 。]

english: So you feel it too? A shadow hangs over this place.
translation: 那么你也有感觉吗？阴影笼罩着这个地方。 [na me ni ye you gan jue ma ？ yin ying long zhao zhe zhe ge di fang 。]

english: What will you do now?
translation: 你现在要做什么？ [ni xian zai yao zuo shen me ？]

english: My mission is still a secret, adventurer. Perhaps I'll share it with you one day.
translation: 我的任务仍然是秘密，冒险家。也许有一天我会与你分享。 [wo de ren wu reng ran shi mi mi ， mao xian jia 。 ye xu you yi tian wo hui yu ni fen xiang 。]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: I found an ancient sun temple.
translation: 我发现了一座古老的太阳神庙。 [wo fa xian le yi zuo gu lao de tai yang shen miao 。]

english: Where's the Kingdom of Varlamore?
translation: 瓦尔拉摩尔王国在哪里？ [wa er la mo er wang guo zai na li ？]

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。 [wo de zou le 。]

english: How are you, Astra?
translation: 你好吗，阿斯特拉？ [ni hao ma ， a si te la ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Woo wooo!
translation: 呜呜！ [wu wu ！]

english: Don't you know? I am a proud Knight of the Lion, serving under the Justiciar of the Lion.
translation: 你不知道吗？我是一名骄傲的雄狮骑士，在雄狮审判官手下服役。 [ni bu zhi dao ma ？ wo shi yi ming jiao ao de xiong shi qi shi ， zai xiong shi shen pan guan shou xia fu yi 。]

english: And you are the adventurer who disturbed my rest!
translation: 而你就是那个打扰我休息的冒险者！ [er ni jiu shi na ge da rao wo xiu xi de mao xian zhe ！]

english: Yeah... I'm not really all that sorry about that. I was searching for Hallowed marks. Although I didn't actually intend to disturb you if that's any consolation.
translation: 是的...我对此并没有那么抱歉。我一直在寻找神圣印记。虽然我其实并不想打扰你，如果这能给你一点安慰的话。 [shi de ... wo dui ci bing mei you na me bao qian 。 wo yi zhi zai xun zhao shen sheng yin ji 。 sui ran wo qi shi bing bu xiang da rao ni ， ru guo zhe neng gei ni yi dian an wei de hua 。]

english: Hallowed marks? That currency is reserved only for the devout followers of holy Saradomin. Are you a follower, adventurer?
translation: 神圣印记？这种货币只为神圣萨拉多明的虔诚追随者保留。你是追随者、冒险家吗？ [shen sheng yin ji ？ zhe zhong huo bi zhi wei shen sheng sa la duo ming de qian cheng zhui sui zhe bao liu 。 ni shi zhui sui zhe 、 mao xian jia ma ？]

english: Yes, I follow Saradomin.
translation: 是的，我关注萨拉多明。 [shi de ， wo guan zhu sa la duo ming 。]

english: I see! Yes, I can sense that you at least carry some items bearing his symbol. Well met fellow follower! Do tell, what is the Justiciar of the Lion up to these days?
translation: 我懂了！是的，我能感觉到你至少带着一些带有他标志的物品。很高兴见到各位追随者！请告诉我，狮王审判官最近在忙什么？ [wo dong le ！ shi de ， wo neng gan jue dao ni zhi shao dai zhe yi xie dai you ta biao zhi de wu pin 。 hen gao xing jian dao ge wei zhui sui zhe ！ qing gao su wo ， shi wang shen pan guan zui jin zai mang shen me ？]

english: The Justiciar of the Lion? I've never heard of them.
translation: 狮子的审判官？我从没听说过他们。 [shi zi de shen pan guan ？ wo cong mei ting shuo guo ta men 。]

english: By Saradomin's mercy! Are you serious adventurer? You've never heard of her glory?
translation: 感谢萨拉多明的仁慈！你是认真的冒险家吗？你没听说过她的荣耀吗？ [gan xie sa la duo ming de ren ci ！ ni shi ren zhen de mao xian jia ma ？ ni mei ting shuo guo ta de rong yao ma ？]

english: The statue in the south east bears her resemblance. I remember the day it was built in her honour.
translation: 东南方的雕像与她相似。我记得为纪念她而建造的那一天。 [dong nan fang de diao xiang yu ta xiang si 。 wo ji de wei ji nian ta er jian zao de na yi tian 。]

english: The Justiciar of the Lion is a title bestowed upon the most powerful wizard of our order. She was capable of wiping out an entire army of Zamorakian demons with a single spell!
translation: 雄狮审判官是授予我们骑士团中最强大法师的头衔。她能够用一个咒语消灭掉整个萨莫拉克恶魔大军！ [xiong shi shen pan guan shi shou yu wo men qi shi tuan zhong zui qiang da fa shi de tou xian 。 ta neng gou yong yi ge zhou yu xiao mie diao zheng ge sa mo la ke e mo da jun ！]

english: I lament that I could not learn more from her in life but I do not regret for a single instant following her to my grave.
translation: 我感叹一生无法从她身上学到更多，但我不后悔有一刻跟随她走向坟墓。 [wo gan tan yi sheng wu fa cong ta shen shang xue dao geng duo ， dan wo bu hou hui you yi ke gen sui ta zou xiang fen mu 。]

english: I see, she sounds like an inspirational figure indeed. Do you know where I can find her?
translation: 我明白了，她听起来确实是一个鼓舞人心的人物。你知道我在哪里可以找到她吗？ [wo ming bai le ， ta ting qi lai que shi shi yi ge gu wu ren xin de ren wu 。 ni zhi dao wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao ta ma ？]

english: I was hoping that you could tell me. Last I heard, she was residing in the college here in Hallowvale.
translation: 我希望你能告诉我。我上次听说，她住在哈洛韦尔的学院里。 [wo xi wang ni neng gao su wo 。 wo shang ci ting shuo ， ta zhu zai ha luo wei er de xue yuan li 。]

english: Oh dear...
translation: 哦亲爱的... [o qin ai de ...]

english: Is something wrong adventurer?
translation: 冒险者有什么问题吗？ [mao xian zhe you shen me wen ti ma ？]

english: Never mind, you don't want to know.
translation: 没关系，你不想知道。 [mei guan xi ， ni bu xiang zhi dao 。]

english: You lie adventurer. I do not sense a single item of holy Saradomin on your person.
translation: 你是个撒谎的冒险家。我在你身上没有感觉到任何神圣的萨拉多明物品。 [ni shi ge sa huang de mao xian jia 。 wo zai ni shen shang mei you gan jue dao ren he shen sheng de sa la duo ming wu pin 。]

english: To think that our currency is being handled by non- followers. It's a disgrace! If I weren't dead, I'd incinerate you where you stand for your impudence!
translation: 认为我们的货币是由非追随者处理的。这是一种耻辱！如果我没死，我一定会把你当场烧死！ [ren wei wo men de huo bi shi you fei zhui sui zhe chu li de 。 zhe shi yi zhong chi ru ！ ru guo wo mei si ， wo yi ding hui ba ni dang chang shao si ！]

english: Yeah well, you are dead and I have your currency so you're going to have to... live with that!
translation: 是的，好吧，你死了，我有你的货币，所以你将不得不......忍受它！ [shi de ， hao ba ， ni si le ， wo you ni de huo bi ， suo yi ni jiang bu de bu ...... ren shou ta ！]

english: I don't appreciate your attempts at humour, non- follower.
translation: 我不欣赏你的幽默，非追随者。 [wo bu xin shang ni de you mo ， fei zhui sui zhe 。]

english: No, I follow another god.
translation: 不，我追随另一个神。 [bu ， wo zhui sui ling yi ge shen 。]

english: Woo? Woo wooooooooo!
translation: 呜？呜呜呜！ [wu ？ wu wu wu ！]

english: You dare defile this sacred place? That treasure doesn't belong to you!
translation: 你竟然敢玷污这神圣的地方？那宝物不属于你！ [ni jing ran gan dian wu zhe shen sheng de di fang ？ na bao wu bu shu yu ni ！]

english: Yes, I follow Saradomin.
translation: 是的，我关注萨拉多明。 [shi de ， wo guan zhu sa la duo ming 。]

english: No, I follow another god.
translation: 不，我追随另一个神。 [bu ， wo zhui sui ling yi ge shen 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Woo wooo?
translation: 呜呜？ [wu wu ？]

english: Who indeed? I am a wise Knight of the Owl. I serve the Justiciar of the Owl.
translation: 到底是谁？我是一位睿智的猫头鹰骑士。我为猫头鹰审判官服务。 [dao di shi shui ？ wo shi yi wei rui zhi de mao tou ying qi shi 。 wo wei mao tou ying shen pan guan fu wu 。]

english: Who's this Justiciar of the Owl?
translation: 这位猫头鹰审判官是谁？ [zhe wei mao tou ying shen pan guan shi shui ？]

english: Saradomin's wisest of servants. It surprises me that you've not heard of his many feats.
translation: 萨拉多明最聪明的仆人。令我惊讶的是你竟然没有听说过他的许多功绩。 [sa la duo ming zui cong ming de pu ren 。 ling wo jing ya de shi ni jing ran mei you ting shuo guo ta de xu duo gong ji 。]

english: Do you know any?
translation: 你知道吗？ [ni zhi dao ma ？]

english: I know them all.
translation: 我认识他们所有人。 [wo ren shi ta men suo you ren 。]

english: Care to share?
translation: 愿意分享吗？ [yuan yi fen xiang ma ？]

english: Of course. Do you see the foliage around you, adventurer?
translation: 当然。冒险家，你看到周围的树叶了吗？ [dang ran 。 mao xian jia ， ni kan dao zhou wei de shu ye le ma ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: For it to be in such a state means that there is unimaginable evil nearby. These plants were grown personally by Zachariah, the Justiciar of the Owl.
translation: 变成这样的状态，就意味着附近有难以想象的邪恶存在。这些植物是猫头鹰审判者撒迦利亚亲自种植的。 [bian cheng zhe yang de zhuang tai ， jiu yi wei zhe fu jin you nan yi xiang xiang de xie e cun zai 。 zhe xie zhi wu shi mao tou ying shen pan zhe sa jia li ya qin zi zhong zhi de 。]

english: Anything he plants blossoms with unimaginable vigour. You may have noticed that he has a love for lilies. Perhaps he knew they'd serve multiple purposes in a place like this.
translation: 他种下的任何东西都会以难以想象的活力绽放。您可能已经注意到他非常喜欢百合花。也许他知道它们在这样的地方有多种用途。 [ta zhong xia de ren he dong xi du hui yi nan yi xiang xiang de huo li zhan fang 。 nin ke neng yi jing zhu yi dao ta fei chang xi huan bai he hua 。 ye xu ta zhi dao ta men zai zhe yang de di fang you duo zhong yong tu 。]

english: Hmm. Hopefully I'll meet him one day.
translation: 唔。希望有一天我能见到他。 [wu 。 xi wang you yi tian wo neng jian dao ta 。]

english: If you do, send my regards.
translation: 如果你这样做，请转达我的问候。 [ru guo ni zhe yang zuo ， qing zhuan da wo de wen hou 。]

english: Do you have a name?
translation: 你有名字吗？ [ni you ming zi ma ？]

english: I'm but a loyal watcher, that is all.
translation: 我只是一个忠实的观察者，仅此而已。 [wo zhi shi yi ge zhong shi de guan cha zhe ， jin ci er yi 。]

english: So, was there anything else?
translation: 那么，还有其他事情吗？ [na me ， hai you qi ta shi qing ma ？]

english: Wait...
translation: 等待... [deng dai ...]

english: Your helmet looks familiar. I defeated a knight who wore one with a similar design.
translation: 你的头盔看起来很熟悉。我打败了一位穿着类似设计的骑士。 [ni de tou kui kan qi lai hen shu xi 。 wo da bai le yi wei chuan zhe lei si she ji de qi shi 。]

english: This helmet? It is based on the one worn by the Justiciar of the Owl. You mean to say you fought the great Zachariah and lived to tell the tale?
translation: 这个头盔？它是根据猫头鹰审判官所佩戴的那一款设计的。你的意思是说你与伟大的撒迦利亚战斗并活着讲述了这个故事？ [zhe ge tou kui ？ ta shi gen ju mao tou ying shen pan guan suo pei dai de na yi kuan she ji de 。 ni de yi si shi shuo ni yu wei da de sa jia li ya zhan dou bing huo zhe jiang shu le zhe ge gu shi ？]

english: Well, I suppose so.
translation: 嗯，我想是这样。 [n ， wo xiang shi zhe yang 。]

english: This can't be... You killed the great Zachariah?
translation: 这不可能是……你杀了伟大的撒迦利亚？ [zhe bu ke neng shi …… ni sha le wei da de sa jia li ya ？]

english: Hmm, he didn't really die. He just sort of faded away and left behind a glowing magical hand.
translation: 嗯，他并没有真的死。他就这样消失了，留下了一只发光的魔法手。 [n ， ta bing mei you zhen de si 。 ta jiu zhe yang xiao shi le ， liu xia le yi zhi fa guang de mo fa shou 。]

english: Strange, when I saw him last he had no magical hand to speak of... I suppose time has changed the world above beyond my recollection...
translation: 奇怪的是，当我最后一次见到他时，他并没有什么神奇的手可言……我想时间已经改变了上面的世界，超出了我的记忆…… [qi guai de shi ， dang wo zui hou yi ci jian dao ta shi ， ta bing mei you shen me shen qi de shou ke yan …… wo xiang shi jian yi jing gai bian le shang mian de shi jie ， chao chu le wo de ji yi ……]

english: Yep, it probably has.
translation: 是的，可能有。 [shi de ， ke neng you 。]

english: What's with the owls?
translation: 猫头鹰怎么了？ [mao tou ying zen me le ？]

english: They are a symbol of the wise. You see, owls can see the light in the darkest of places. Their presence within the sepulchre is one of grave importance.
translation: 他们是智者的象征。你看，猫头鹰可以在最黑暗的地方看到光明。他们在坟墓中的存在是非常重要的之一。 [ta men shi zhi zhe de xiang zheng 。 ni kan ， mao tou ying ke yi zai zui hei an de di fang kan dao guang ming 。 ta men zai fen mu zhong de cun zai shi fei chang zhong yao de zhi yi 。]

english: Yes, I saw some down there. They seemed incorporeal in some way, as if they were ghosts...
translation: 是的，我在那里看到了一些。从某种程度上来说，他们似乎是无形的，就好像他们是幽灵一样…… [shi de ， wo zai na li kan dao le yi xie 。 cong mou zhong cheng du shang lai shuo ， ta men si hu shi wu xing de ， jiu hao xiang ta men shi you ling yi yang ……]

english: Indeed. These creatures have the blessing of Saradomin and the wisdom of ages long past. They are the watchers of the Hallowed Sepulchre. The last defence against unseen evils.
translation: 的确。这些生物拥有萨拉多明的祝福和远古的智慧。他们是圣墓的守护者。抵御看不见的邪恶的最后一道防线。 [di que 。 zhe xie sheng wu yong you sa la duo ming de zhu fu he yuan gu de zhi hui 。 ta men shi sheng mu de shou hu zhe 。 di yu kan bu jian de xie e de zui hou yi dao fang xian 。]

english: Err... past the wolves?
translation: 呃……超越狼群？ [e …… chao yue lang qun ？]

english: The third floor... Home.
translation: 三楼……家。 [san lou …… jia 。]

english: Thank you for freeing me, adventurer. If the owls have already retreated that far back, it's best that I reside here. From this position I can more effectively watch for evil.
translation: 谢谢你释放了我，冒险家。如果猫头鹰已经退到那么远了，我还是住在这里比较好。从这个位置我可以更有效地监视邪恶。 [xie xie ni shi fang le wo ， mao xian jia 。 ru guo mao tou ying yi jing tui dao na me yuan le ， wo hai shi zhu zai zhe li bi jiao hao 。 cong zhe ge wei zhi wo ke yi geng you xiao di jian shi xie e 。]

english: Hmm... Perhaps I should steal from graves more often?
translation: 嗯...也许我应该更频繁地从坟墓里偷东西？ [n ... ye xu wo ying gai geng pin fan di cong fen mu li tou dong xi ？]

english: Excuse me?
translation: 打扰一下？ [da rao yi xia ？]

english: Oh, nothing.
translation: 哦，没什么。 [o ， mei shen me 。]

english: I'm off now, goodbye.
translation: 我先走了，再见。 [wo xian zou le ， zai jian 。]

english: Stay watchful.
translation: 保持警惕。 [bao chi jing ti 。]

english: Woo? Woo wooooooooo!
translation: 呜？呜呜呜！ [wu ？ wu wu wu ！]

english: You dare defile this sacred place? That treasure doesn't belong to you!
translation: 你竟然敢玷污这神圣的地方？那宝物不属于你！ [ni jing ran gan dian wu zhe shen sheng de di fang ？ na bao wu bu shu yu ni ！]

english: Who's this Justiciar of the Owl?
translation: 这位猫头鹰审判官是谁？ [zhe wei mao tou ying shen pan guan shi shui ？]

english: What's with the owls?
translation: 猫头鹰怎么了？ [mao tou ying zen me le ？]

english: I'm off now, goodbye.
translation: 我先走了，再见。 [wo xian zou le ， zai jian 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Woo wooo!
translation: 呜呜！ [wu wu ！]

english: I am a holy Knight of the Unicorn. I served under the Archpriest of this place who himself served under the Justiciar of the Unicorn.
translation: 我是独角兽圣骑士。我在这个地方的大祭司手下任职，而他本人则在独角兽审判官手下任职。 [wo shi du jiao shou sheng qi shi 。 wo zai zhe ge di fang de da ji si shou xia ren zhi ， er ta ben ren ze zai du jiao shou shen pan guan shou xia ren zhi 。]

english: You don't look like a knight... Don't knights wear plate armour and wield swords and lances and stuff?
translation: 你看起来不像骑士……骑士不是穿着板甲、挥舞着剑和长矛之类的东西吗？ [ni kan qi lai bu xiang qi shi …… qi shi bu shi chuan zhe ban jia 、 hui wu zhe jian he chang mao zhi lei de dong xi ma ？]

english: The title of knight perhaps has a different meaning to you adventurer. In fact, all of the knights of my order are priests who serve under Saradomin.
translation: 骑士这个称号对于冒险者来说或许有着不同的意义。事实上，我骑士团的所有骑士都是在萨拉多明麾下服役的牧师。 [qi shi zhe ge cheng hao dui yu mao xian zhe lai shuo huo xu you zhe bu tong de yi yi 。 shi shi shang ， wo qi shi tuan de suo you qi shi dou shi zai sa la duo ming hui xia fu yi de mu shi 。]

english: During my life, I spent my time here consecrating the fallen followers of holy Saradomin. I would perform their final rites before laying them to rest within this place.
translation: 在我的一生中，我在这里度过了奉献神圣萨拉多明阵亡追随者的时光。在将他们安葬在这个地方之前，我会为他们举行最后的仪式。 [zai wo de yi sheng zhong ， wo zai zhe li du guo le feng xian shen sheng sa la duo ming zhen wang zhui sui zhe de shi guang 。 zai jiang ta men an zang zai zhe ge di fang zhi qian ， wo hui wei ta men ju xing zui hou de yi shi 。]

english: I see. So does this place only contain the bodies of these 'knights' who followed Saradomin?
translation: 我懂了。那么这里难道只是这些追随萨拉多明的‘骑士’的尸体吗？ [wo dong le 。 na me zhe li nan dao zhi shi zhe xie zhui sui sa la duo ming de ‘ qi shi ’ de shi ti ma ？]

english: Not at all. We also provided these rites for all the citizens of Hallowvale. They were mostly laid to rest on the first two floors.
translation: 一点也不。我们还为万圣节谷的所有公民提供了这些仪式。他们大多安息在前两层楼。 [yi dian ye bu 。 wo men hai wei wan sheng jie gu de suo you gong min ti gong le zhe xie yi shi 。 ta men da duo an xi zai qian liang ceng lou 。]

english: Interesting. So who is this Justiciar of the Unicorn you spoke of?
translation: 有趣的。那么你说的这位独角兽审判官是谁呢？ [you qu de 。 na me ni shuo de zhe wei du jiao shou shen pan guan shi shui ne ？]

english: The Justiciar of the Unicorn? Why this title is only bestowed upon the holiest priest of Saradomin.
translation: 独角兽的审判官？为什么这个称号只授予萨拉多明的至圣祭司。 [du jiao shou de shen pan guan ？ wei shen me zhe ge cheng hao zhi shou yu sa la duo ming de zhi sheng ji si 。]

english: The justiciar I followed would spread the teachings of Saradomin everywhere he went, converting the masses to our religion.
translation: 我跟随的司法官会在他所到之处传播萨拉多明的教义，使群众皈依我们的宗教。 [wo gen sui de si fa guan hui zai ta suo dao zhi chu chuan bo sa la duo ming de jiao yi ， shi qun zhong gui yi wo men de zong jiao 。]

english: The statue in the north east of this room was created in his likeness when the place was built. I must say though, it does concern me that this is the first you've heard of him and his feats.
translation: 这个房间东北方的雕像是在建造这个地方时按照他的肖像建造的。但我必须说，这是你第一次听说他和他的功绩，这确实让我担心。 [zhe ge fang jian dong bei fang de diao xiang shi zai jian zao zhe ge di fang shi an zhao ta de xiao xiang jian zao de 。 dan wo bi xu shuo ， zhe shi ni di yi ci ting shuo ta he ta de gong ji ， zhe que shi rang wo dan xin 。]

english: Well I've certainly heard of the word justiciar, but nothing about the Justiciar of the Unicorn.
translation: 好吧，我当然听说过正义者这个词，但对独角兽正义者一无所知。 [hao ba ， wo dang ran ting shuo guo zheng yi zhe zhe ge ci ， dan dui du jiao shou zheng yi zhe yi wu suo zhi 。]

english: That saddens me greatly. I do hope that he is still carrying out Saradomin's will.
translation: 这让我非常难过。我确实希望他仍然执行萨拉多明的遗嘱。 [zhe rang wo fei chang nan guo 。 wo que shi xi wang ta reng ran zhi xing sa la duo ming de yi zhu 。]

english: Anyway, do tell me adventurer, what brings you to the Hallowed Sepulchre?
translation: 无论如何，请告诉我冒险家，是什么让你来到了圣墓？ [wu lun ru he ， qing gao su wo mao xian jia ， shi shen me rang ni lai dao le sheng mu ？]

english: I found this place within the city of Darkmeyer and that mysterious stranger over there asked me to acquire some Hallowed marks which you and your bretherenwere buried with.
translation: 我在达克迈耶城内找到了这个地方，那边那个神秘的陌生人要求我获取一些神圣的标记，你和你的兄弟们都埋葬着这些标记。 [wo zai da ke mai ye cheng nei zhao dao le zhe ge di fang ， na bian na ge shen mi de mo sheng ren yao qiu wo huo qu yi xie shen sheng de biao ji ， ni he ni de xiong di men dou mai zang zhe zhe xie biao ji 。]

english: I see. Did you say Darkmeyer? An interesting name, especially when this region is so bright and full of life.
translation: 我懂了。你说的是达克梅耶吗？一个有趣的名字，尤其是当这个地区如此明亮且充满生机时。 [wo dong le 。 ni shuo de shi da ke mei ye ma ？ yi ge you qu de ming zi ， you qi shi dang zhe ge di qu ru ci ming liang qie chong man sheng ji shi 。]

english: When I was alive this place was known as Hallowvale. Do you know why the queen decided to change the name?
translation: 当我还活着的时候，这个地方被称为万圣节谷。你知道女王为什么决定改名吗？ [dang wo hai huo zhe de shi hou ， zhe ge di fang bei cheng wei wan sheng jie gu 。 ni zhi dao nv wang wei shen me jue ding gai ming ma ？]

english: Erm, simply put, the land here is... under new management.
translation: 嗯，简单来说，这里的土地……处于新的管理之下。 [n ， jian dan lai shuo ， zhe li de tu di …… chu yu xin de guan li zhi xia 。]

english: Hmm, interesting. I wish I could see for myself but unfortunately, I am unable to leave this place. I do wonder if this new 'management' is the reason my spirit did not pass on to the afterlife.
translation: 嗯，有趣。我希望我能亲眼看看，但不幸的是，我无法离开这个地方。我确实想知道这种新的“管理”是否是我的灵魂没有传到来世的原因。 [n ， you qu 。 wo xi wang wo neng qin yan kan kan ， dan bu xing de shi ， wo wu fa li kai zhe ge di fang 。 wo que shi xiang zhi dao zhe zhong xin de “ guan li ” shi fou shi wo de ling hun mei you chuan dao lai shi de yuan yin 。]

english: Perhaps so. However, it's probably best that you can't leave this place. I'm not sure you'd like what you'd find.
translation: 也许是这样。不过，你最好不要离开这个地方。我不确定你会喜欢你所找到的东西。 [ye xu shi zhe yang 。 bu guo ， ni zui hao bu yao li kai zhe ge di fang 。 wo bu que ding ni hui xi huan ni suo zhao dao de dong xi 。]

english: I fear you may be right adventurer. The last instruction I was given was to help protect this place from invaders by placing magical enchantments on the statues within.
translation: 我担心你可能是正确的冒险家。我得到的最后指示是通过在里面的雕像上施加魔法结界来帮助保护这个地方免受入侵者的侵害。 [wo dan xin ni ke neng shi zheng que de mao xian jia 。 wo de dao de zui hou zhi shi shi tong guo zai li mian de diao xiang shang shi jia mo fa jie jie lai bang zhu bao hu zhe ge di fang mian shou ru qin zhe de qin hai 。]

english: I admit, I never dared ask who or what we were protecting it from.
translation: 我承认，我从来不敢问我们是在保护它免受谁或什么的侵害。 [wo cheng ren ， wo cong lai bu gan wen wo men shi zai bao hu ta mian shou shui huo shen me de qin hai 。]

english: If it's any consolation, the enchantments you placed did prevent the 'invaders' from entering. It's only us human adventurers who enter the Sepulchre.
translation: 如果有什么安慰的话，你放置的咒语确实阻止了“入侵者”进入。只有我们人类冒险家才能进入坟墓。 [ru guo you shen me an wei de hua ， ni fang zhi de zhou yu que shi zu zhi le “ ru qin zhe ” jin ru 。 zhi you wo men ren lei mao xian jia cai neng jin ru fen mu 。]

english: Although we have been stealing some of your stuff... Sorry about that.
translation: 虽然我们偷了你的一些东西……对此感到抱歉。 [sui ran wo men tou le ni de yi xie dong xi …… dui ci gan dao bao qian 。]

english: It's not like I have any use for my stuff anymore. Thanks adventurer, your words do lighten my spirits somewhat.
translation: 我的东西已经没有任何用处了。谢谢冒险家，你的话让我的精神稍微放松了一些。 [wo de dong xi yi jing mei you ren he yong chu le 。 xie xie mao xian jia ， ni de hua rang wo de jing shen shao wei fang song le yi xie 。]

english: Aren't you all spirit?
translation: 你们都没有精神吗？ [ni men dou mei you jing shen ma ？]

english: Woo? Woo wooooooooo!
translation: 呜？呜呜呜！ [wu ？ wu wu wu ！]

english: You dare defile this sacred place? That treasure doesn't belong to you!
translation: 你竟然敢玷污这神圣的地方？那宝物不属于你！ [ni jing ran gan dian wu zhe shen sheng de di fang ？ na bao wu bu shu yu ni ！]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Woo wooo?
translation: 呜呜？ [wu wu ？]

english: Me? I am a Knight of the Wolf. I serve the fierce Justiciar of the Wolf!
translation: 我？我是狼骑士。我侍奉凶猛的恶狼审判官！ [wo ？ wo shi lang qi shi 。 wo shi feng xiong meng de e lang shen pan guan ！]

english: Of the Wolf?
translation: 狼的？ [lang de ？]

english: Aye, the most loyal and fiercest of Saradomin's followers! We are the bastion against all that is evil.
translation: 是的，萨拉多明最忠诚、最凶猛的追随者！我们是抵御一切邪恶的堡垒。 [shi de ， sa la duo ming zui zhong cheng 、 zui xiong meng de zhui sui zhe ！ wo men shi di yu yi qie xie e de bao lei 。]

english: Who's this Justiciar of the Wolf?
translation: 这位狼之审判官是谁？ [zhe wei lang zhi shen pan guan shi shui ？]

english: You haven't heard of...
translation: 你没听说过... [ni mei ting shuo guo ...]

english: What happened to her?
translation: 她怎么了？ [ta zen me le ？]

english: I was hoping you could tell me... Ah, the white wolf we called her... For she had the brightest hair you'd ever seen. A silver so bright it could blind. Some said she had icyene blood, but those close to her knew better.
translation: 我希望你能告诉我……啊，我们叫她白狼……因为她有一头你见过的最亮的头发。银色如此明亮，足以让人失明。有人说她有冰蓝血统，但与她关系密切的人更清楚。 [wo xi wang ni neng gao su wo …… a ， wo men jiao ta bai lang …… yin wei ta you yi tou ni jian guo de zui liang de tou fa 。 yin se ru ci ming liang ， zu yi rang ren shi ming 。 you ren shuo ta you bing lan xue tong ， dan yu ta guan xi mi qie de ren geng qing chu 。]

english: I take it you were close?
translation: 我想你很接近吧？ [wo xiang ni hen jie jin ba ？]

english: Close enough. The white wolf was but a mere human, albeit with astounding prowess on the battlefield... She vied for Saradomin's attention the most out of all the justiciars.
translation: 足够接近。白狼只是一个人类，却在战场上有着惊人的威力……她是所有正义者中最争夺萨拉多明注意力的。 [zu gou jie jin 。 bai lang zhi shi yi ge ren lei ， que zai zhan chang shang you zhe jing ren de wei li …… ta shi suo you zheng yi zhe zhong zui zheng duo sa la duo ming zhu yi li de 。]

english: Hmm... Why do you think that was?
translation: 嗯...你认为这是为什么？ [n ... ni ren wei zhe shi wei shen me ？]

english: Ah, well... She always wanted to be stronger and never seemed happy with what she had. There was always more.
translation: 啊，好吧……她总是想变得更坚强，但似乎对自己所拥有的一切都不感到满意。总是有更多。 [a ， hao ba …… ta zong shi xiang bian de geng jian qiang ， dan si hu dui zi ji suo yong you de yi qie dou bu gan dao man yi 。 zong shi you geng duo 。]

english: Was there anything else you wanted?
translation: 你还有什么想要的吗？ [ni hai you shen me xiang yao de ma ？]

english: Any great battles to speak of?
translation: 有什么伟大的战斗值得一提吗？ [you shen me wei da de zhan dou zhi de yi ti ma ？]

english: There was this time a great evil swept over Hallowvale...
translation: 这一次，一场巨大的邪恶席卷了万圣节…… [zhe yi ci ， yi chang ju da de xie e xi juan le wan sheng jie ……]

english: Ah! The vampyres?
translation: 啊!吸血鬼？ [a ! xi xue gui ？]

english: The what?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: Y'know? The ones with the wings and all the blood sucking?
translation: 你知道吗？那些长着翅膀、吸血的？ [ni zhi dao ma ？ na xie zhang zhe chi bang 、 xi xue de ？]

english: No, don't be so ridiculous. As I was saying... A great evil...
translation: 不，别这么可笑。正如我所说...一个巨大的邪恶... [bu ， bie zhe me ke xiao 。 zheng ru wo suo shuo ... yi ge ju da de xie e ...]

english: The common folk called it the Egregore. They said it could shift and change shape at a moments notice into creatures from the deepest abyss...
translation: 老百姓称其为Egregore。他们说它可以瞬间改变形状，变成来自最深渊的生物...... [lao bai xing cheng qi wei Egregore。 ta men shuo ta ke yi shun jian gai bian xing zhuang ， bian cheng lai zi zui shen yuan de sheng wu ......]

english: Sounds terrifying.
translation: 听起来很可怕。 [ting qi lai hen ke pa 。]

english: These folk, they tend to exaggerate. It wasn't until the nobles started spreading word of its ghoulish features, each more horrible than the last...
translation: 这些人往往夸大其词。直到贵族们开始散布关于它的恐怖特征的消息，一个比一个更可怕…… [zhe xie ren wang wang kua da qi ci 。 zhi dao gui zu men kai shi san bu guan yu ta de kong bu te zheng de xiao xi ， yi ge bi yi ge geng ke pa ……]

english: That was when we took an interest in killing the thing. We are Knights of the Wolf after all! Our duty is to eradicate all evil.
translation: 就在那时我们对杀死这个东西产生了兴趣。我们毕竟是狼骑士啊！我们的职责是消除一切邪恶。 [jiu zai na shi wo men dui sha si zhe ge dong xi chan sheng le xing qu 。 wo men bi jing shi lang qi shi a ！ wo men de zhi ze shi xiao chu yi qie xie e 。]

english: Woah! How does one vanquish such a foe?
translation: 哇哦！怎样才能战胜这样的敌人呢？ [wa o ！ zen yang cai neng zhan sheng zhe yang de di ren ne ？]

english: Well, we made short work of it. That is what we do.
translation: 好吧，我们很快就完成了。这就是我们所做的。 [hao ba ， wo men hen kuai jiu wan cheng le 。 zhe jiu shi wo men suo zuo de 。]

english: But, how?
translation: 但是，怎么样？ [dan shi ， zen me yang ？]

english: With a big sword of course!
translation: 当然是用大剑啦！ [dang ran shi yong da jian la ！]

english: Ah... A favorite method of mine.
translation: 啊...我最喜欢的方法。 [a ... wo zui xi huan de fang fa 。]

english: Ah... I prefer a carefully placed arrow myself. Each to their own though.
translation: 啊……我自己更喜欢小心放置的箭头。不过各有各的。 [a …… wo zi ji geng xi huan xiao xin fang zhi de jian tou 。 bu guo ge you ge de 。]

english: It does the job! Once we had shown the head of the beast to the masses, talk of the Egregore soon died down. At least... for a while.
translation: 它完成了工作！一旦我们向大众展示了这头野兽的头，关于埃格雷戈尔的讨论很快就消失了。至少……有一段时间。 [ta wan cheng le gong zuo ！ yi dan wo men xiang da zhong zhan shi le zhe tou ye shou de tou ， guan yu ai ge lei ge er de tao lun hen kuai jiu xiao shi le 。 zhi shao …… you yi duan shi jian 。]

english: It returned?
translation: 它回来了？ [ta hui lai le ？]

english: Yes. It was strange... As soon as the small folk had forgotten about the Egregore, rumours started to arise that it had returned. And so it had! That was the nature of this beast.
translation: 是的。很奇怪……当小人们忘记了埃格雷戈尔之后，关于它回来了的谣言就开始出现。确实如此！这就是这只野兽的本性。 [shi de 。 hen qi guai …… dang xiao ren men wang ji le ai ge lei ge er zhi hou ， guan yu ta hui lai le de yao yan jiu kai shi chu xian 。 que shi ru ci ！ zhe jiu shi zhe zhi ye shou de ben xing 。]

english: So it was truly undying?
translation: 那么它真的是不朽的吗？ [na me ta zhen de shi bu xiu de ma ？]

english: Does the Egregore still haunt these lands, human?
translation: 人类，埃格雷戈尔是否仍然在这片土地上出没？ [ren lei ， ai ge lei ge er shi fou reng ran zai zhe pian tu di shang chu mo ？]

english: Hmm, I can't say I've seen it...
translation: 嗯，我不能说我见过…… [n ， wo bu neng shuo wo jian guo ……]

english: Then you must assume we were quite successful! At least by the time of my passing, the beast hadn't returned. Although, who knows? It could have taken any form by now.
translation: 那么你一定认为我们非常成功！至少在我去世的时候，那头野兽还没有回来。虽然，谁知道呢？现在它可以采取任何形式。 [na me ni yi ding ren wei wo men fei chang cheng gong ！ zhi shao zai wo qu shi de shi hou ， na tou ye shou hai mei you hui lai 。 sui ran ， shui zhi dao ne ？ xian zai ta ke yi cai qu ren he xing shi 。]

english: Well I can't say for certain, but you look pretty old.
translation: 好吧，我不能肯定，但你看起来很老。 [hao ba ， wo bu neng ken ding ， dan ni kan qi lai hen lao 。]

english: Your humour is wasted on me.
translation: 你的幽默对我来说是浪费了。 [ni de you mo dui wo lai shuo shi lang fei le 。]

english: I'm off now, goodbye.
translation: 我先走了，再见。 [wo xian zou le ， zai jian 。]

english: May the light of Saradomin guide you, adventurer.
translation: 愿萨​​拉多明之光指引你，冒险家。 [yuan sa ​​ la duo ming zhi guang zhi yin ni ， mao xian jia 。]

english: Woo? Woo wooooooooo!
translation: 呜？呜呜呜！ [wu ？ wu wu wu ！]

english: You dare defile this sacred place? That treasure doesn't belong to you!
translation: 你竟然敢玷污这神圣的地方？那宝物不属于你！ [ni jing ran gan dian wu zhe shen sheng de di fang ？ na bao wu bu shu yu ni ！]

english: Who's this Justiciar of the Wolf?
translation: 这位狼之审判官是谁？ [zhe wei lang zhi shen pan guan shi shui ？]

english: Any great battles to speak of?
translation: 有什么伟大的战斗值得一提吗？ [you shen me wei da de zhan dou zhi de yi ti ma ？]

english: I'm off now, goodbye.
translation: 我先走了，再见。 [wo xian zou le ， zai jian 。]

english: Hey, how's it go...
translation: 嘿，怎么样了... [hei ， zen me yang le ...]

english: Sorry my friend, the Skipper has been grindin' me up the wrong way lately. If ye need anythin', talk t' Cap'ain Pudi over by the dock.
translation: 抱歉，我的朋友，船长最近一直在以错误的方式折磨我。如果您需要任何东西，请与码头边的普迪船长交谈。 [bao qian ， wo de peng you ， chuan zhang zui jin yi zhi zai yi cuo wu de fang shi zhe mo wo 。 ru guo nin xu yao ren he dong xi ， qing yu ma tou bian de pu di chuan zhang jiao tan 。]

english: That ungrateful Skipper. How dare he blame me for that freak storm?
translation: 那个忘恩负义的船长。他怎么敢把这场怪异的风暴归咎于我？ [na ge wang en fu yi de chuan zhang 。 ta zen me gan ba zhe chang guai yi de feng bao gui jiu yu wo ？]

english: Why are you angry at the Skipper?
translation: 你为什么对船长生气？ [ni wei shen me dui chuan zhang sheng qi ？]

english: It be a long story.
translation: 这将是一个很长的故事。 [zhe jiang shi yi ge hen zhang de gu shi 。]

english: I've got time. I would love to hear it.
translation: 我有时间。我很想听听。 [wo you shi jian 。 wo hen xiang ting ting 。]

english: Fine, 'ere be me tale of misfortune.
translation: 好吧，这就是我的不幸故事。 [hao ba ， zhe jiu shi wo de bu xing gu shi 。]

english: About a half moon ago, we set sail on our fortnightly fishin' trip. 'Twas smooth sailin' all the way t' our spot.
translation: 大约半个月前，我们开始了每两周一次的钓鱼之旅。到达我们的地点一路都很顺利。 [da yue ban ge yue qian ， wo men kai shi le mei liang zhou yi ci de diao yu zhi lv 。 dao da wo men de di dian yi lu dou hen shun li 。]

english: Caught a load of manta ray an' snappers.
translation: 捕获了大量蝠鲼和鲷鱼。 [bu huo le da liang fu fen he diao yu 。]

english: What's a snapper?
translation: 什么是鲷鱼？ [shen me shi diao yu ？]

english: Ah, I should'a realised you were a landlubber. We on the ship call them snappers, but you lot call 'em lobsters.
translation: 啊，我早该意识到你是个旱鸭子。我们在船上称它们为鲷鱼，但你们却称它们为龙虾。 [a ， wo zao gai yi shi dao ni shi ge han ya zi 。 wo men zai chuan shang cheng ta men wei diao yu ， dan ni men que cheng ta men wei long xia 。]

english: Anyway, back to me tale.
translation: 无论如何，回到我的故事。 [wu lun ru he ， hui dao wo de gu shi 。]

english: After a couple o' days, we pulled up the anchor an' sailed closer t' the Karamjan coast. There is where the big'ns are.
translation: 几天后，我们起锚，驶向卡拉姆詹海岸附近。这就是大人物所在的地方。 [ji tian hou ， wo men qi mao ， shi xiang ka la mu zhan hai an fu jin 。 zhe jiu shi da ren wu suo zai de di fang 。]

english: What's a big'n?
translation: 什么是大n？ [shen me shi da n？]

english: You landlubbers... It be a shark.
translation: 你们这些旱鸭子……是鲨鱼。 [ni men zhe xie han ya zi …… shi sha yu 。]

english: Oh, how was I supposed to know?
translation: 哦，我怎么知道？ [o ， wo zen me zhi dao ？]

english: CAN YOU STOP INTERRUPTIN' ME TALE?
translation: 你能别打断我的故事吗？ [ni neng bie da duan wo de gu shi ma ？]

english: Ok...
translation: 好的... [hao de ...]

english: Good, now where was I...
translation: 很好，现在我在哪里... [hen hao ， xian zai wo zai na li ...]

english: When we arrived at the spot, the Skipper saw a lack of fish swimmin' in the waters.
translation: 当我们到达现场时，船长发现水域里没有鱼在游动。 [dang wo men dao da xian chang shi ， chuan zhang fa xian shui yu li mei you yu zai you dong 。]

english: I looked yonder onto the horizon an' noticed a storm was a brewin', so we adjusted our course accordin'.
translation: 我望向远处的地平线，注意到一场风暴正在酝酿，所以我们相应地调整了航线。 [wo wang xiang yuan chu de di ping xian ， zhu yi dao yi chang feng bao zheng zai yun niang ， suo yi wo men xiang ying di tiao zheng le hang xian 。]

english: As if by magic, winds started a blowin' an' the storm started movin' in our direction.
translation: 就像变魔术一样，风开始吹起来，风暴开始朝我们的方向移动。 [jiu xiang bian mo shu yi yang ， feng kai shi chui qi lai ， feng bao kai shi chao wo men de fang xiang yi dong 。]

english: Lightnin' struck the boat, an' a piece of wood holdin' up the sail fell an' struck me on the 'ead.
translation: 闪电击中了船，一块撑住船帆的木头掉落下来，击中了我的船头。 [shan dian ji zhong le chuan ， yi kuai cheng zhu chuan fan de mu tou diao la xia lai ， ji zhong le wo de chuan tou 。]

english: I woke up in a bed an' the Skipper started on me, tellin' me I ruined his ship an' I need t' pay him back.
translation: 我在床上醒来，船长开始攻击我，告诉我我毁了他的船，我需要偿还他。 [wo zai chuang shang xing lai ， chuan zhang kai shi gong ji wo ， gao su wo wo hui le ta de chuan ， wo xu yao chang huan ta 。]

english: That's awful. He does not sound like a nice man.
translation: 太糟糕了。他听起来不像一个好人。 [tai zao gao le 。 ta ting qi lai bu xiang yi ge hao ren 。]

english: Nay, he usually is. He be upset about his ship, is all.
translation: 不，他通常都是这样。他对他的船感到不安，仅此而已。 [bu ， ta tong chang dou shi zhe yang 。 ta dui ta de chuan gan dao bu an ， jin ci er yi 。]

english: Can I help ye with anythin' else?
translation: 我还能帮你做点什么吗？ [wo hai neng bang ni zuo dian shen me ma ？]

english: Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
translation: 你有对抗 Tempoross 的建议吗？ [ni you dui kang  Tempoross  de jian yi ma ？]

english: Watch out for the waves. If ye get hit by that you could end up lost at sea.
translation: 小心海浪。如果你被它击中，你可能会在海上迷路。 [xiao xin hai lang 。 ru guo ni bei ta ji zhong ， ni ke neng hui zai hai shang mi lu 。]

english: Ye might find tying yourself t' somethin' using a rope t' be a life saver.
translation: 你可能会发现用绳子把自己绑在某个东西上可以救命。 [ni ke neng hui fa xian yong sheng zi ba zi ji bang zai mou ge dong xi shang ke yi jiu ming 。]

english: Or if ye manage to get yer hands on one of them there fancy Spirity Angler outfits, it comes with a built- in rope harness.
translation: 或者，如果您设法获得其中一套精美的 Spirity Angler 服装，它会配有内置绳索。 [huo zhe ， ru guo nin she fa huo de qi zhong yi tao jing mei de  Spirity Angler  fu zhuang ， ta hui pei you nei zhi sheng suo 。]

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。 [wo de zou le 。]

english: Have a good'n. I know I won't.
translation: 祝你好运。我知道我不会。 [zhu ni hao yun 。 wo zhi dao wo bu hui 。]

english: Would you care for an egg in this difficult time?
translation: 在这个困难时期，你会关心鸡蛋吗？ [zai zhe ge kun nan shi qi ， ni hui guan xin ji dan ma ？]

english: Oh, a damp egg! Yes, please!
translation: 哦，湿鸡蛋！是的，请！ [o ， shi ji dan ！ shi de ， qing ！]

english: Wait, really?
translation: 等等，真的吗？ [deng deng ， zhen de ma ？]

english: Aye, I'll add it t' me collection!
translation: 是的，我会把它添加到我的收藏中！ [shi de ， wo hui ba ta tian jia dao wo de shou cang zhong ！]

english: You know there's a crate of them you could just help yourself t'...
translation: 你知道有一箱它们你可以自己拿…… [ni zhi dao you yi xiang ta men ni ke yi zi ji na ……]

english: Hush! Don't let Timallus hear ye speak o' the damp egg crate. It'll set 'im off!
translation: 嘘！别让蒂马勒斯听到你们对潮湿的蛋箱说话。这会让他兴奋不已！ [xu ！ bie rang di ma le si ting dao ni men dui chao shi de dan xiang shuo hua 。 zhe hui rang ta xing fen bu yi ！]

english: Just pass me the egg.
translation: 把鸡蛋递给我吧。 [ba ji dan di gei wo ba 。]

english: Thank ye kindly!
translation: 谢谢你们！ [xie xie ni men ！]

english: ...You're welcome.
translation: ...不客气。 [... bu ke qi 。]

english: Oh, thanks.
translation: 哦，谢谢。 [o ， xie xie 。]

english: This is some comfort to be sure.
translation: 这确实是一种安慰。 [zhe que shi shi yi zhong an wei 。]

english: Why are you angry at the Skipper?
translation: 你为什么对船长生气？ [ni wei shen me dui chuan zhang sheng qi ？]

english: Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
translation: 你有对抗 Tempoross 的建议吗？ [ni you dui kang  Tempoross  de jian yi ma ？]

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。 [wo de zou le 。]

english: Hello. What are you up to?
translation: 你好。你要做什么？ [ni hao 。 ni yao zuo shen me ？]

english: Nothing exciting, just keeping an eye out.
translation: 没什么令人兴奋的，只是留意一下。 [mei shen me ling ren xing fen de ， zhi shi liu yi yi xia 。]

english: Hello there, you must be Koftik.
translation: 你好，你一定是Koftik。 [ni hao ， ni yi ding shi Koftik。]

english: That I am adventurer. King Lathas told me to expect you. I assume he has told you our goal?
translation: 说我是冒险家。拉萨斯国王让我等你。我猜他已经告诉你我们的目标了？ [shuo wo shi mao xian jia 。 la sa si guo wang rang wo deng ni 。 wo cai ta yi jing gao su ni wo men de mu biao le ？]
