english: He said we need to find a way through the Underground Pass. Shouldn't be too bad, I've travelled through many a cave in my time.
translation: 他说我们需要找到一条穿过地下通道的路。应该不会太糟糕，我这段时间走过很多洞穴。 [ta shuo wo men xu yao zhao dao yi tiao chuan guo di xia tong dao de lu 。 ying gai bu hui tai zao gao ， wo zhe duan shi jian zou guo hen duo dong xue 。]

english: These caves are different... There is a darkness in there unlike any other. You can feel it as you wind your way round the stalagmites... an icy chill that penetrates the very fabric of your being...
translation: 这些洞穴是不同的……那里有一种不同于其他洞穴的黑暗。当你绕着石笋蜿蜒前行时，你可以感觉到……一股冰冷的寒气渗透到你的身体里…… [zhe xie dong xue shi bu tong de …… na li you yi zhong bu tong yu qi ta dong xue de hei an 。 dang ni rao zhe shi sun wan yan qian xing shi ， ni ke yi gan jue dao …… yi gu bing leng de han qi shen tou dao ni de shen ti li ……]

english: You've been in before?
translation: 你以前来过吗？ [ni yi qian lai guo ma ？]

english: I have. I didn't go far though, nor did I stay for long. People change in these caves...
translation: 我有。但我并没有走多远，也没有停留太久。人们在这些洞穴里发生了变化…… [wo you 。 dan wo bing mei you zou duo yuan ， ye mei you ting liu tai jiu 。 ren men zai zhe xie dong xue li fa sheng le bian hua ……]

english: I'll take my chances.
translation: 我会抓住机会的。 [wo hui zhua zhu ji hui de 。]

english: Okay traveller, I'll catch up with you by the bridge.
translation: 好吧，旅行者，我会在桥上接你的。 [hao ba ， lv xing zhe ， wo hui zai qiao shang jie ni de 。]

english: Tell me more...
translation: 告诉我更多... [gao su wo geng duo ...]

english: I remember one warrior. His name was Randas. He stood tall and proud like an elven king...
translation: 我记得有一位战士。他的名字叫兰达斯。他昂首挺胸，傲然如精灵王…… [wo ji de you yi wei zhan shi 。 ta de ming zi jiao lan da si 。 ta ang shou ting xiong ， ao ran ru jing ling wang ……]

english: That same pride made him vulnerable. Randas' worthy desire to be a great and mighty warrior also made him corruptible.
translation: 同样的骄傲使他变得脆弱。兰达斯渴望成为一名伟大而强大的战士，这也让他变得腐败。 [tong yang de jiao ao shi ta bian de cui ruo 。 lan da si ke wang cheng wei yi ming wei da er qiang da de zhan shi ， zhe ye rang ta bian de fu bai 。]

english: Within the cave, he heard the voice of Zamorak himself...
translation: 山洞内，他听到了萨莫拉克本人的声音…… [shan dong nei ， ta ting dao le sa mo la ke ben ren de sheng yin ……]

english: Zamorak showed him a way to achieve his goals by appealing to that most base and dark nature... One that resides in all of us.
translation: 萨莫拉克向他展示了一种通过诉诸我们所有人内心最卑鄙和黑暗的本性来实现目标的方法。 [sa mo la ke xiang ta zhan shi le yi zhong tong guo su zhu wo men suo you ren nei xin zui bei bi he hei an de ben xing lai shi xian mu biao de fang fa 。]

english: What happened to him?
translation: 他怎么了？ [ta zen me le ？]

english: No one knows...
translation: 没有人知道... [mei you ren zhi dao ...]

english: Anyway, head on in when you're ready. You'll soon come to a bridge, I will catch up with you there.
translation: 不管怎样，当你准备好后就出发吧。你很快就会到达一座桥，我会在那里追上你。 [bu guan zen yang ， dang ni zhun bei hao hou jiu chu fa ba 。 ni hen kuai jiu hui dao da yi zuo qiao ， wo hui zai na li zhui shang ni 。]

english: Hi, Koftik.
translation: 嗨，科菲克。 [hai ， ke fei ke 。]

english: Hello adventurer. We seem to have a bit of an issue ahead of us. The bridge is up and I can't see another way across.
translation: 你好冒险家。我们似乎遇到了一些问题。桥已经建成了，我看不到另一条路。 [ni hao mao xian jia 。 wo men si hu yu dao le yi xie wen ti 。 qiao yi jing jian cheng le ， wo kan bu dao ling yi tiao lu 。]

english: Do you know how to get the bridge down?
translation: 你知道怎么把桥拆下来吗？ [ni zhi dao zen me ba qiao chai xia lai ma ？]

english: I'm afraid not. This is the furthest I've ever been. It does look like someone was here before us though, there's the remains of a camp.
translation: 恐怕不是。这是我去过的最远的地方。不过看起来确实有人在我们之前来过，那里有一个营地的遗迹。 [kong pa bu shi 。 zhe shi wo qu guo de zui yuan de di fang 。 bu guo kan qi lai que shi you ren zai wo men zhi qian lai guo ， na li you yi ge ying di de yi ji 。]

english: I had a look through their things and found some cloth along with the charred remains of some arrows.
translation: 我检查了他们的东西，发现了一些布和一些烧焦的箭头残骸。 [wo jian cha le ta men de dong xi ， fa xian le yi xie bu he yi xie shao jiao de jian tou can hai 。]

english: Charred arrows? They must have been trying to burn something. Or someone!
translation: 烧焦的箭头？他们一定是想烧掉什么东西。或者某人！ [shao jiao de jian tou ？ ta men yi ding shi xiang shao diao shen me dong xi 。 huo zhe mou ren ！]

english: Koftik gives you some cloth. It's coated in an oil substance.
translation: 科夫提克给了你一些布。它涂有一层油状物质。 [ke fu ti ke gei le ni yi xie bu 。 ta tu you yi ceng you zhuang wu zhi 。]

english: There's plenty more cloth by the fire. I also found the remains of a book...
translation: 火边还有很多布。我还发现了一本书的残骸…… [huo bian hai you hen duo bu 。 wo hai fa xian le yi ben shu de can hai ……]

english: Probably just litter.
translation: 或许只是乱扔垃圾。 [huo xu zhi shi luan reng la ji 。]

english: Well... maybe?
translation: 嗯……也许？ [n …… ye xu ？]

english: What does it say?
translation: 它说什么？ [ta shuo shen me ？]

english: It seems to be written by the adventurer Randas. Have a look.
translation: 好像是冒险家兰达斯写的。看看吧。 [hao xiang shi mao xian jia lan da si xie de 。 kan kan ba 。]

english: Hello Koftik.
translation: 你好，科菲克。 [ni hao ， ke fei ke 。]

english: Do you hear them? The voices tell me things.
translation: 你听到他们的声音了吗？声音告诉我一些事情。 [ni ting dao ta men de sheng yin le ma ？ sheng yin gao su wo yi xie shi qing 。]

english: Are you OK?
translation: 你还好吗？ [ni hai hao ma ？]

english: The path of the righteous man is beset on all sides by the iniquitiesof the selfish and the tyranny of evil men.
translation: 义人的道路四面受自私者的罪孽和恶人的暴政所困扰。 [yi ren de dao lu si mian shou zi si zhe de zui nie he e ren de bao zheng suo kun rao 。]

english: Tyranny of the righteous? What?
translation: 正义者的暴政？什么？ [zheng yi zhe de bao zheng ？ shen me ？]

english: So many paths to choose... Here we must all take our own path.
translation: 这么多的道路可供选择……在这里，我们都必须走自己的路。 [zhe me duo de dao lu ke gong xuan ze …… zai zhe li ， wo men dou bi xu zou zi ji de lu 。]

english: The voices, they've been telling me things...
translation: 这些声音，他们一直在告诉我一些事情...... [zhe xie sheng yin ， ta men yi zhi zai gao su wo yi xie shi qing ......]

english: Koftik, is everything okay? You're getting me worried.
translation: 科菲克，一切还好吗？你让我很担心。 [ke fei ke ， yi qie hai hao ma ？ ni rang wo hen dan xin 。]

english: Don't be, friend. Anyway, do you know the definition of insanity?
translation: 别这样，朋友。无论如何，你知道疯狂的定义吗？ [bie zhe yang ， peng you 。 wu lun ru he ， ni zhi dao feng kuang de ding yi ma ？]

english: Err... what?
translation: 呃……什么？ [e …… shen me ？]

english: The definition of insanity is doing the same thing over and over, expecting things to change.
translation: 疯狂的定义是一遍又一遍地做同样的事情，期望事情会改变。 [feng kuang de ding yi shi yi bian you yi bian di zuo tong yang de shi qing ， qi wang shi qing hui gai bian 。]

english: I spent years doing the same thing, day in and day out. I always wanted more but I never got it. Now, I finally see why...
translation: 我花了很多年的时间日复一日地做同样的事情。我总是想要更多，但我从来没有得到过。现在，我终于明白为什么了…… [wo hua le hen duo nian de shi jian ri fu yi ri di zuo tong yang de shi qing 。 wo zong shi xiang yao geng duo ， dan wo cong lai mei you de dao guo 。 xian zai ， wo zhong yu ming bai wei shen me le ……]

english: You see, once I was insane. But now... now I am finally free...
translation: 你看，曾经我疯狂过。但现在……现在我终于自由了…… [ni kan ， ceng jing wo feng kuang guo 。 dan xian zai …… xian zai wo zhong yu zi you le ……]

english: Ah, you've arrived. We've been waiting for you.
translation: 啊，你来了。我们一直在等你。 [a ， ni lai le 。 wo men yi zhi zai deng ni 。]

english: Koftik, you're still here? You should leave.
translation: 科夫提克，你还在吗？你应该离开。 [ke fu ti ke ， ni hai zai ma ？ ni ying gai li kai 。]

english: Leave? But this is my home now. Home with my lord. He talks to me, he's my friend.
translation: 离开？但现在这里是我的家了。与主同归。他跟我说话，他是我的朋友。 [li kai ？ dan xian zai zhe li shi wo de jia le 。 yu zhu tong gui 。 ta gen wo shuo hua ， ta shi wo de peng you 。]

english: Koftik, you really should leave these caverns.
translation: Koftik，你真的应该离开这些洞穴。 [Koftik， ni zhen de ying gai li kai zhe xie dong xue 。]

english: Not now, we're all the same down here.  There's just you and those dwarves left.
translation: 不是现在，我们在这里都一样。  只剩下你和那些矮人了。 [bu shi xian zai ， wo men zai zhe li dou yi yang 。   zhi sheng xia ni he na xie ai ren le 。]

english: Dwarves?
translation: 矮人？ [ai ren ？]

english: Foolish dwarves, still believing that they can resist. No one resists Iban.
translation: 愚蠢的矮人，还相信自己可以抵抗。没有人抗拒伊班族。 [yu chun de ai ren ， hai xiang xin zi ji ke yi di kang 。 mei you ren kang ju yi ban zu 。]

english: You could help! Deep down you know you want it! I know you already dealt with those Paladins. Now you just need to kill the dwarves!
translation: 你可以帮忙！你内心深处知道你想要它！我知道你已经和那些圣骑士打交道了。现在你只需要杀死矮人！ [ni ke yi bang mang ！ ni nei xin shen chu zhi dao ni xiang yao ta ！ wo zhi dao ni yi jing he na xie sheng qi shi da jiao dao le 。 xian zai ni zhi xu yao sha si ai ren ！]

english: Head south and through the tunnel. You'll find the dwarves at the other end. Go slay them. Slay them for our lord!
translation: 向南行驶并穿过隧道。你会在另一端找到矮人。去杀掉他们吧。为了我们的主宰杀掉他们！ [xiang nan xing shi bing chuan guo sui dao 。 ni hui zai ling yi duan zhao dao ai ren 。 qu sha diao ta men ba 。 wei le wo men de zhu zai sha diao ta men ！]

english: Nice job killing those Paladins. You're much closer to his side now. Perhaps you could kill those dwarves as well. That would really please him.
translation: 干得好，杀死那些圣骑士。你现在离他的身边更近了。也许你也可以杀死那些矮人。这真的会让他很高兴。 [gan de hao ， sha si na xie sheng qi shi 。 ni xian zai li ta de shen bian geng jin le 。 ye xu ni ye ke yi sha si na xie ai ren 。 zhe zhen de hui rang ta hen gao xing 。]

english: Adventurer, where am I? I can't remember a thing!
translation: 冒险家，我在哪里？我什么都不记得了！ [mao xian jia ， wo zai na li ？ wo shen me dou bu ji de le ！]

english: We were losing you to Iban's influence.
translation: 我们正在因伊班的影响而失去你。 [wo men zheng zai yin yi ban de ying xiang er shi qu ni 。]

english: What? Of course, the voices... But they've stopped. What happened?
translation: 什么？当然，那些声音……但它们已经停止了。发生了什么？ [shen me ？ dang ran ， na xie sheng yin …… dan ta men yi jing ting zhi le 。 fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: Iban's dead, I destroyed him.
translation: 伊班死了，我毁了他。 [yi ban si le ， wo hui le ta 。]

english: You've done well! Thanks for saving me.
translation: 你做得很好！谢谢你救了我。 [ni zuo de hen hao ！ xie xie ni jiu le wo 。]

english: But what about you, adventurer? Did the voices not affect you?
translation: 但你呢，冒险家？这些声音没有影响到你吗？ [dan ni ne ， mao xian jia ？ zhe xie sheng yin mei you ying xiang dao ni ma ？]

english: Your mind is filled with strange images. A unicorn. A boulder. Some paladins. They seem real... but were they?
translation: 你的脑海里充满了奇怪的画面。一只独角兽。一块巨石。一些圣骑士。它们看起来是真实的……但它们是真的吗？ [ni de nao hai li chong man le qi guai de hua mian 。 yi zhi du jiao shou 。 yi kuai ju shi 。 yi xie sheng qi shi 。 ta men kan qi lai shi zhen shi de …… dan ta men shi zhen de ma ？]

english: I... I don't think so...
translation: 我……我不这么认为…… [wo …… wo bu zhe me ren wei ……]

english: I see. We must now inform the king. Follow me, I'll lead you out.
translation: 我懂了。我们现在必须通知国王。跟我来，我带你出去。 [wo dong le 。 wo men xian zai bi xu tong zhi guo wang 。 gen wo lai ， wo dai ni chu qu 。]

english: At last! I've had enough of these caves.
translation: 终于！我已经受够了这些洞穴。 [zhong yu ！ wo yi jing shou gou le zhe xie dong xue 。]

english: Koftik leads you back through the winding caverns to the entrance. But it feels like part of you has been left behind...
translation: Koftik 将带您穿过蜿蜒的洞穴回到入口。但感觉就像你的一部分被抛在了后面...... [Koftik  jiang dai nin chuan guo wan yan de dong xue hui dao ru kou 。 dan gan jue jiu xiang ni de yi bu fen bei pao zai le hou mian ......]

english: Thanks for showing me the way out Koftik.
translation: 谢谢你给我指明了离开 Koftik 的出路。 [xie xie ni gei wo zhi ming liao li kai  Koftik  de chu lu 。]

english: Always a pleasure. Have you informed the king about Iban?
translation: 总是一种乐趣。你向国王通报了伊班人的事吗？ [zong shi yi zhong le qu 。 ni xiang guo wang tong bao le yi ban ren de shi ma ？]

english: No, not yet.
translation: 不，还没有。 [bu ， hai mei you 。]

english: This is no time to linger. The king must know that Iban is dead. This is a truly historical event for Ardougne.
translation: 现在不是徘徊的时间。国王一定知道伊班已经死了。对于阿杜涅来说，这是一个真正的历史事件。 [xian zai bu shi pai huai de shi jian 。 guo wang yi ding zhi dao yi ban yi jing si le 。 dui yu a du nie lai shuo ， zhe shi yi ge zhen zheng de li shi shi jian 。]

english: Hello adventurer, how's things?
translation: 你好，冒险家，怎么样？ [ni hao ， mao xian jia ， zen me yang ？]

english: Not bad, yourself?
translation: 你自己也不错吧？ [ni zi ji ye bu cuo ba ？]

english: I'm good... just keeping an eye out.
translation: 我很好……只是留意一下。 [wo hen hao …… zhi shi liu yi yi xia 。]

english: I found this by the way. I guess you'll be wanting it back.
translation: 我顺便发现了这个。我想你会想要回来的。 [wo shun bian fa xian le zhe ge 。 wo xiang ni hui xiang yao hui lai de 。]

english: Thanks Koftik.
translation: 谢谢科菲克。 [xie xie ke fei ke 。]

english: Hello [player name], how's things?
translation: 你好[玩家姓名]，怎么样？ [ni hao [ wan jia xing ming ]， zen me yang ？]

english: These traps don't get any easier. But I'm alright, thanks.
translation: 这些陷阱不会变得更容易。但我没事，谢谢。 [zhe xie xian jing bu hui bian de geng rong yi 。 dan wo mei shi ， xie xie 。]

english: Good to hear.
translation: 很高兴听到。 [hen gao xing ting dao 。]

english: I'll take my chances.
translation: 我会抓住机会的。 [wo hui zhua zhu ji hui de 。]

english: Tell me more...
translation: 告诉我更多... [gao su wo geng duo ...]

english: Probably just litter.
translation: 或许只是乱扔垃圾。 [huo xu zhi shi luan reng la ji 。]

english: What does it say?
translation: 它说什么？ [ta shuo shen me ？]

english: Hello there. What is this place?
translation: 你好呀。这是什么地方？ [ni hao ya 。 zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Do not waste my time with trivial questions. I am the Great Kolodion, master of battle magic. I have an arena to run.
translation: 不要在琐碎的问题上浪费我的时间。我是伟大的科罗迪恩，战斗魔法的大师。我有一个可以奔跑的竞技场。 [bu yao zai suo sui de wen ti shang lang fei wo de shi jian 。 wo shi wei da de ke luo di en ， zhan dou mo fa de da shi 。 wo you yi ge ke yi ben pao de jing ji chang 。]

english: Can I enter?
translation: 我可以进去吗？ [wo ke yi jin qu ma ？]

english: Hah! A wizard of your level? Don't be absurd.
translation: 哈！你级别的巫师？别荒唐了。 [ha ！ ni ji bie de wu shi ？ bie huang tang le 。]

english: I am the great Kolodion, master of battle magic, and this is my battle arena. Top wizards travel from all over Gielinor to fight here.
translation: 我是伟大的科洛迪恩，战斗魔法的大师，这里就是我的战斗竞技场。顶级巫师从吉林各地赶来，来到这里战斗。 [wo shi wei da de ke luo di en ， zhan dou mo fa de da shi ， zhe li jiu shi wo de zhan dou jing ji chang 。 ding ji wu shi cong ji lin ge di gan lai ， lai dao zhe li zhan dou 。]

english: Can I fight here?
translation: 我可以在这里战斗吗？ [wo ke yi zai zhe li zhan dou ma ？]

english: My arena is open to any high level wizard, but this is no game. Many wizards fall in this arena, never to rise again. The strongest mages have been destroyed.
translation: 我的竞技场对任何高级巫师开放，但这不是游戏。许多巫师在这个竞技场上倒下，再也没有站起来。最强的法师都被消灭了。 [wo de jing ji chang dui ren he gao ji wu shi kai fang ， dan zhe bu shi you xi 。 xu duo wu shi zai zhe ge jing ji chang shang dao xia ， zai ye mei you zhan qi lai 。 zui qiang de fa shi dou bei xiao mie le 。]

english: If you're sure you want in?
translation: 如果你确定要进去？ [ru guo ni que ding yao jin qu ？]

english: Yes indeedy.
translation: 是的，确实如此。 [shi de ， que shi ru ci 。]

english: Good, good. You have a healthy sense of competition.
translation: 好，好。你有健康的竞争意识。 [hao ， hao 。 ni you jian kang de jing zheng yi shi 。]

english: Remember, traveller - in my arena, hand-to-hand combat is useless. Your strength will diminish as you enter the arena, but the spells you can learn are amongst the most powerful in all of Gielinor.
translation: 记住，旅行者——在我的竞技场里，肉搏战是没有用的。当你进入竞技场时，你的力量会减弱，但你可以学习的法术是整个吉林诺最强大的法术之一。 [ji zhu ， lv xing zhe —— zai wo de jing ji chang li ， rou bo zhan shi mei you yong de 。 dang ni jin ru jing ji chang shi ， ni de li liang hui jian ruo ， dan ni ke yi xue xi de fa shu shi zheng ge ji lin nuo zui qiang da de fa shu zhi yi 。]

english: Before I can accept you in, we must duel.
translation: 在我接受你之前，我们必须决斗。 [zai wo jie shou ni zhi qian ， wo men bi xu jue dou 。]

english: Okay, let's fight.
translation: 好吧，我们来战斗吧。 [hao ba ， wo men lai zhan dou ba 。]

english: I must first check that you are up to scratch.
translation: 我必须首先检查你是否符合标准。 [wo bi xu shou xian jian cha ni shi fou fu he biao zhun 。]

english: You don't need to worry about that.
translation: 你不需要担心这个。 [ni bu xu yao dan xin zhe ge 。]

english: Not just any magician can enter - only the most powerful and most feared. Before you can use the power of this arena, you must prove yourself against me.
translation: 并非任何魔法师都可以进入——只有最强大和最令人恐惧的魔法师才能进入。在你能够使用这个竞技场的力量之前，你必须向我证明你自己。 [bing fei ren he mo fa shi dou ke yi jin ru —— zhi you zui qiang da he zui ling ren kong ju de mo fa shi cai neng jin ru 。 zai ni neng gou shi yong zhe ge jing ji chang de li liang zhi qian ， ni bi xu xiang wo zheng ming ni zi ji 。]

english: The player is teleported to the Mage Arena to fight against Kolodion
translation: 玩家被传送到法师竞技场与科洛迪恩战斗 [wan jia bei chuan song dao fa shi jing ji chang yu ke luo di en zhan dou]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: No I don't.
translation: 不，我不。 [bu ， wo bu 。]

english: Your loss.
translation: 你的损失。 [ni de sun shi 。]

english: What's the point of that?
translation: 那有什么意义呢？ [na you shen me yi yi ne ？]

english: We learn how to use our magic to its fullest and how to channel the forces of the cosmos into our world...
translation: 我们学习如何充分利用我们的魔法，以及如何将宇宙的力量引导到我们的世界...... [wo men xue xi ru he chong fen li yong wo men de mo fa ， yi ji ru he jiang yu zhou de li liang yin dao dao wo men de shi jie ......]

english: But mainly, I just like blasting people into dust.
translation: 但最主要的是，我只是喜欢把人炸成灰尘。 [dan zui zhu yao de shi ， wo zhi shi xi huan ba ren zha cheng hui chen 。]

english: That's barbaric!
translation: 这太野蛮了！ [zhe tai ye man le ！]

english: Nope, it's magic. But I know what you mean. So do you want to join us?
translation: 不，这是魔法。但我知道你的意思。那么你想加入我们吗？ [bu ， zhe shi mo fa 。 dan wo zhi dao ni de yi si 。 na me ni xiang jia ru wo men ma ？]

english: You must prove yourself... now!
translation: 你必须证明自己……现在！ [ni bi xu zheng ming zi ji …… xian zai ！]

english: This is only the beginning; you can't beat me!
translation: 这仅仅是开始；你打不过我！ [zhe jin jin shi kai shi ； ni da bu guo wo ！]

english: Foolish mortal; I am unstoppable.
translation: 愚蠢的凡人；我势不可挡。 [yu chun de fan ren ； wo shi bu ke dang 。]

english: Now you feel it... The dark energy.
translation: 现在你感受到了……黑暗能量。 [xian zai ni gan shou dao le …… hei an neng liang 。]

english: Aaaaaaaarrgghhhh! The power!
translation: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！力量！ [a a a a a a a ！ li liang ！]

english: The player is teleported back to the safe zone after defeating Kolodion's final form
translation: 击败科洛迪恩的最终形态后，玩家被传送回安全区 [ji bai ke luo di en de zui zhong xing tai hou ， wan jia bei chuan song hui an quan qu]

english: Well done, young adventurer; you truly are a worthy battle mage.
translation: 干得好，年轻的冒险家；你确实是一个值得尊敬的战斗法师。 [gan de hao ， nian qing de mao xian jia ； ni que shi shi yi ge zhi de zun jing de zhan dou fa shi 。]

english: What now?
translation: 现在怎么办？ [xian zai zen me ban ？]

english: Step into the magic pool. It will take you to a chamber. There, you must decide which god you will represent in the arena.
translation: 步入魔法池。它会带你到一个房间。在那里，你必须决定你将在竞技场中代表哪位神。 [bu ru mo fa chi 。 ta hui dai ni dao yi ge fang jian 。 zai na li ， ni bi xu jue ding ni jiang zai jing ji chang zhong dai biao na wei shen 。]

english: Thanks, Kolodion.
translation: 谢谢，科洛迪恩。 [xie xie ， ke luo di en 。]

english: That's what I'm here for.
translation: 这就是我来这里的目的。 [zhe jiu shi wo lai zhe li de mu di 。]

english: Hello, Kolodion.
translation: 你好，科洛迪恩。 [ni hao ， ke luo di en 。]

english: Hello, young mage. You're a tough one.
translation: 你好，年轻的法师。你是一个强硬的人。 [ni hao ， nian qing de fa shi 。 ni shi yi ge qiang ying de ren 。]

english: You're not allowed in there. Come downstairs if you want to enter my arena.
translation: 你不被允许进入那里。如果你想进入我的竞技场，请下楼来。 [ni bu bei yun xu jin ru na li 。 ru guo ni xiang jin ru wo de jing ji chang ， qing xia lou lai 。]

english: Can I fight here?
translation: 我可以在这里战斗吗？ [wo ke yi zai zhe li zhan dou ma ？]

english: Yes indeedy.
translation: 是的，确实如此。 [shi de ， que shi ru ci 。]

english: Okay, let's fight.
translation: 好吧，我们来战斗吧。 [hao ba ， wo men lai zhan dou ba 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: No I don't.
translation: 不，我不。 [bu ， wo bu 。]

english: What's the point of that?
translation: 那有什么意义呢？ [na you shen me yi yi ne ？]

english: That's barbaric!
translation: 这太野蛮了！ [zhe tai ye man le ！]

english: I see we have a new arrival. A bringer of death. Tell me, have you come to serve the balance?
translation: 我看到我们有新来的人。死亡使者。告诉我，你是来平衡的吗？ [wo kan dao wo men you xin lai de ren 。 si wang shi zhe 。 gao su wo ， ni shi lai ping heng de ma ？]

english: Bringer of death, have you come to serve the balance?
translation: 死亡使者，你是来维护平衡的吗？ [si wang shi zhe ， ni shi lai wei hu ping heng de ma ？]

english: I need another assignment.
translation: 我需要另一项任务。 [wo xu yao ling yi xiang ren wu 。]

english: You are to bring balance to [amount] [monster] in [area].
translation: 你要使[区域]的[数量][怪物]保持平衡。 [ni yao shi [ qu yu ] de [ shu liang ][ guai wu ] bao chi ping heng 。]

english: Got any tips for me?
translation: 有什么建议给我吗？ [you shen me jian yi gei wo ma ？]

english: Great, thanks!
translation: 太好了，谢谢！ [tai hao le ， xie xie ！]

english: Can I cancel that task?
translation: 我可以取消那个任务吗？ [wo ke yi qu xiao na ge ren wu ma ？]

english: Your task has been cancelled.
translation: 您的任务已被取消。 [nin de ren wu yi bei qu xiao 。]

english: Okay, great!
translation: 好的，太好了！ [hao de ， tai hao le ！]

english: Once the balance has been served, return to me.
translation: 余额用完后，请返回给我。 [yu e yong wan hou ， qing fan hui gei wo 。]

english: Where is that area?
translation: 那个区域在哪里？ [na ge qu yu zai na li ？]

english: You're still bringing balance to [task monster]; you have [amount] to go. Come back when you're finished.
translation: 你仍在为[任务怪物]带来平衡；你还有[金额]要走。完成后就回来。 [ni reng zai wei [ ren wu guai wu ] dai lai ping heng ； ni hai you [ jin e ] yao zou 。 wan cheng hou jiu hui lai 。]

english: You're still meant to be bringing balance to [monster] in [area], with [amount] to go.
translation: 你仍然需要为[区域]的[怪物]带来平衡，还有[数量]。 [ni reng ran xu yao wei [ qu yu ] de [ guai wu ] dai lai ping heng ， hai you [ shu liang ]。]

english: Bringer of death, I do not feel you are ready for your current task. If you wish, I can cancel it. This will not wipe your task streaks.
translation: 死亡使者，我觉得你还没有准备好完成当前的任务。如果你愿意的话我可以取消。这不会消除您的任务连续记录。 [si wang shi zhe ， wo jue de ni hai mei you zhun bei hao wan cheng dang qian de ren wu 。 ru guo ni yuan yi de hua wo ke yi qu xiao 。 zhe bu hui xiao chu nin de ren wu lian xu ji lu 。]

english: Yes, please cancel it.
translation: 是的，请取消。 [shi de ， qing qu xiao 。]

english: Very well. If you still wish to maintain the balance, you can get a new assignment.
translation: 很好。如果您仍然希望保持平衡，您可以接受新的任务。 [hen hao 。 ru guo nin reng ran xi wang bao chi ping heng ， nin ke yi jie shou xin de ren wu 。]

english: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
translation: 不，谢谢，我想尝试一下。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo xiang chang shi yi xia 。]

english: Then I wish you well, bringer of death.
translation: 那么我祝你一切顺利，死亡使者。 [na me wo zhu ni yi qie shun li ， si wang shi zhe 。]

english: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: 你有什么奖励给我，或者有什么可以交易的吗？ [ni you shen me jiang li gei wo ， huo zhe you shen me ke yi jiao yi de ma ？]

english: Those who serve the balance are always rewarded. I can grant these rewards. I can also grant you the equipment needed to serve the balance, for a price of course.
translation: 那些为平衡做出贡献的人总是会得到回报。我可以给予这些奖励。我还可以为您提供维持平衡所需的设备，当然是有代价的。 [na xie wei ping heng zuo chu gong xian de ren zong shi hui de dao hui bao 。 wo ke yi ji yu zhe xie jiang li 。 wo hai ke yi wei nin ti gong wei chi ping heng suo xu de she bei ， dang ran shi you dai jia de 。]

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: 说说我的作业的难度吧。 [shuo shuo wo de zuo ye de nan du ba 。]

english: When tasking you to serve the balance, I do not currently consider your combat level.
translation: 当任务你保持平衡时，我目前不考虑你的战斗水平。 [dang ren wu ni bao chi ping heng shi ， wo mu qian bu kao lv ni de zhan dou shui ping 。]

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
translation: 没关系——我可以处理任何任务。 [mei guan xi —— wo ke yi chu li ren he ren wu 。]

english: Your zeal is to be commended. Use it well when serving the balance.
translation: 你的热心值得赞扬。服务天平时请充分利用它。 [ni de re xin zhi de zan yang 。 fu wu tian ping shi qing chong fen li yong ta 。]

english: In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: 以后，请不要给任何太艰难的事情。 [yi hou ， qing bu yao gei ren he tai jian nan de shi qing 。]

english: As you wish. From now on, your combat level will be taken into account when tasks are assigned.
translation: 如你所愿。从现在开始，分配任务时将考虑你的战斗水平。 [ru ni suo yuan 。 cong xian zai kai shi ， fen pei ren wu shi jiang kao lv ni de zhan dou shui ping 。]

english: When tasking you to serve the balance, I consider your combat level, so you shouldn't get anything too challenging.
translation: 当任务你保持平衡时，我会考虑你的战斗水平，所以你不应该遇到任何太有挑战性的事情。 [dang ren wu ni bao chi ping heng shi ， wo hui kao lv ni de zhan dou shui ping ， suo yi ni bu ying gai yu dao ren he tai you tiao zhan xing de shi qing 。]

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: 没关系——我不想要太难的东西。 [mei guan xi —— wo bu xiang yao tai nan de dong xi 。]

english: Then we will continue on our current path.
translation: 然后我们将继续我们目前的道路。 [ran hou wo men jiang ji xu wo men mu qian de dao lu 。]

english: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: 别再检查我的战斗水平了——我可以承受任何事情！ [bie zai jian cha wo de zhan dou shui ping le —— wo ke yi cheng shou ren he shi qing ！]

english: Your zeal is to be commended. From now on, your combat level will not be considered when tasks are assigned.
translation: 你的热心值得赞扬。今后分配任务时不再考虑你的战斗等级。 [ni de re xin zhi de zan yang 。 jin hou fen pei ren wu shi bu zai kao lv ni de zhan dou deng ji 。]

english: I'd rather not.
translation: 我宁愿不。 [wo ning yuan bu 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: A guardian of life, and a bringer of death. There must always be a balance. My people and I serve this balance. You could serve the balance as well, but you'll need some practice first.
translation: 生命的守护者，死亡的使者。必须始终保持平衡。我和我的人民致力于实现这种平衡。您也可以保持平衡，但首先需要一些练习。 [sheng ming de shou hu zhe ， si wang de shi zhe 。 bi xu shi zhong bao chi ping heng 。 wo he wo de ren min zhi li yu shi xian zhe zhong ping heng 。 nin ye ke yi bao chi ping heng ， dan shou xian xu yao yi xie lian xi 。]

english: There is a Slayer Master in Burthorpe, he goes by the name of Turael. Learn from him, and you will soon be ready to serve.
translation: 伯索普有一位杀手大师，他的名字叫图瑞尔。向他学习，你很快就能做好服务的准备。 [bo suo pu you yi wei sha shou da shi ， ta de ming zi jiao tu rui er 。 xiang ta xue xi ， ni hen kuai jiu neng zuo hao fu wu de zhun bei 。]

english: A bringer of death calls from afar. What do you desire?
translation: 死亡使者从远方呼唤。你想要什么？ [si wang shi zhe cong yuan fang hu huan 。 ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Err... Nothing...
translation: 呃……没什么…… [e …… mei shen me ……]

english: Bringer of death, why do you insist on using such magic when I'm right next to you? Come and talk to me.
translation: 死亡使者，为什么当我就在你身边时，你却坚持使用这样的魔法？过来跟我说话吧。 [si wang shi zhe ， wei shen me dang wo jiu zai ni shen bian shi ， ni que jian chi shi yong zhe yang de mo fa ？ guo lai gen wo shuo hua ba 。]

english: How am I doing so far?
translation: 到目前为止我做得怎么样？ [dao mu qian wei zhi wo zuo de zen me yang ？]

english: You're currently assigned to bring balance to [monster] in [area]; you have [amount] more to go. Your reward point tally is [amount].
translation: 您当前的任务是为[区域]的[怪物]带来平衡；您还有 [数量] 的事情要做。您的奖励积分为[金额]。 [nin dang qian de ren wu shi wei [ qu yu ] de [ guai wu ] dai lai ping heng ； nin hai you  [ shu liang ]  de shi qing yao zuo 。 nin de jiang li ji fen wei [ jin e ]。]

english: I am Konar quo Maten. Like you, I am a bringer of death. Together, we can serve the balance.
translation: 我是科纳尔·科·马滕。和你一样，我也是死亡使者。只要我们齐心协力，就能实现平衡。 [wo shi ke na er · ke · ma teng 。 he ni yi yang ， wo ye shi si wang shi zhe 。 zhi yao wo men qi xin xie li ， jiu neng shi xian ping heng 。]

english: Where are you?
translation: 你在哪里？ [ni zai na li ？]

english: You'll find me on Mount Karuulm. I'll be here when you need a new purpose.
translation: 你会在卡鲁尔姆山找到我。当你需要新的目标时我会在这里。 [ni hui zai ka lu er mu shan zhao dao wo 。 dang ni xu yao xin de mu biao shi wo hui zai zhe li 。]

english: Nothing really.
translation: 真的没什么。 [zhen de mei shen me 。]

english: I need another assignment.
translation: 我需要另一项任务。 [wo xu yao ling yi xiang ren wu 。]

english: Got any tips for me?
translation: 有什么建议给我吗？ [you shen me jian yi gei wo ma ？]

english: Can I cancel that task? (30 Points)
translation: 我可以取消那个任务吗？ （30 分） [wo ke yi qu xiao na ge ren wu ma ？ （30  fen ）]

english: Where is that area?

translation: 恐怕我现在没有这些。 [kong pa wo xian zai mei you zhe xie 。]

english: Well, I'm not wasting my time for free.
translation: 好吧，我不会免费浪费时间。 [hao ba ， wo bu hui mian fei lang fei shi jian 。]

english: I'm afraid I don't have enough of those at the moment.
translation: 恐怕我现在还没有足够的东西。 [kong pa wo xian zai hai mei you zu gou de dong xi 。]

english: Okay, it's a deal.
translation: “好吧，成交。” [“ hao ba ， cheng jiao 。”]

english: That'll do nicely, [sir/madam]. Leave it with me - I'll make sure that patch grows for you.
translation: 那就太好了，[先生/女士]。把它留给我吧——我会确保这个补丁适合你。 [na jiu tai hao le ，[ xian sheng / nv shi ]。 ba ta liu gei wo ba —— wo hui que bao zhe ge bu ding shi he ni 。]

english: No, that's too much.
translation: 不，那太多了。 [bu ， na tai duo le 。]

english: If you like, but I want one sack of potatoes for that.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，但我想要一袋土豆。 [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， dan wo xiang yao yi dai tu dou 。]

english: If you like, but I want one sack of onions for that.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，但我想要一袋洋葱。 [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， dan wo xiang yao yi dai yang cong 。]

english: If you like, but I want 2 sacks of cabbages for that.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，但我想要两袋卷心菜。 [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， dan wo xiang yao liang dai juan xin cai 。]

english: If you like, but I want 10 jute fibres for that.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，但我想要 10 根黄麻纤维。 [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， dan wo xiang yao  10  gen huang ma xian wei 。]

english: If you like, but I want one basket of apples for that.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，但我想要一篮子苹果。 [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， dan wo xiang yao yi lan zi ping guo 。]

english: If you like, but I want 10 curry leaves for that.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，但我想要 10 片咖喱叶。 [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， dan wo xiang yao  10  pian ga li ye 。]

english: If you like, but I want 5 jangerberries for that.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，但我想要 5 个姜莓。 [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， dan wo xiang yao  5  ge jiang mei 。]

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 你能给我一些农业建议吗？ [ni neng gei wo yi xie nong ye jian yi ma ？]

english: The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
translation: 治愈灌木或树木疾病的唯一方法是用剪刀剪掉患病的叶子。对于所有其他作物，我只会使用一些植物疗法。 [zhi yu guan mu huo shu mu ji bing de wei yi fang fa shi yong jian dao jian diao huan bing de ye zi 。 dui yu suo you qi ta zuo wu ， wo zhi hui shi yong yi xie zhi wu liao fa 。]

english: Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
translation: 树木种子必须在土壤花盆中长成树苗，然后转移到树丛中继续生长直至成年。 [shu mu zhong zi bi xu zai tu rang hua pen zhong chang cheng shu miao ， ran hou zhuan yi dao shu cong zhong ji xu sheng zhang zhi zhi cheng nian 。]

english: You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
translation: 您最多可以在蔬菜袋中放入十个土豆、卷心菜或洋葱，但不能将它们混合放在同一个袋子中。 [nin zui duo ke yi zai shu cai dai zhong fang ru shi ge tu dou 、 juan xin cai huo yang cong ， dan bu neng jiang ta men hun he fang zai tong yi ge dai zi zhong 。]

english: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
translation: 您可以从农田商店购买所有农具，农田商店位于耕地附近。 [nin ke yi cong nong tian shang dian gou mai suo you nong ju ， nong tian shang dian wei yu geng di fu jin 。]

english: Bittercap mushrooms can only be grown in a special patch in Morytania, near the Mort Myre swamp. There the ground is especially dank and suited to growing poisonous fungii.
translation: 苦蘑菇只能生长在莫里塔尼亚莫特迈尔沼泽附近的一块特殊土地上。那里的地面特别潮湿，适合有毒真菌的生长。 [ku mo gu zhi neng sheng zhang zai mo li ta ni ya mo te mai er zhao ze fu jin de yi kuai te shu tu di shang 。 na li de di mian te bie chao shi ， shi he you du zhen jun de sheng zhang 。]

english: Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
translation: 超级堆肥比普通堆肥好得多，但制造成本更高。你需要腐烂正确类型的物品；给我看一个物品，我会告诉你它是否超级可堆肥。 [chao ji dui fei bi pu tong dui fei hao de duo ， dan zhi zao cheng ben geng gao 。 ni xu yao fu lan zheng que lei xing de wu pin ； gei wo kan yi ge wu pin ， wo hui gao su ni ta shi fou chao ji ke dui fei 。]

english: There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
translation: 有一块专门种植颠茄的土地——我相信它就在德雷诺庄园附近的某个地方，那里的土地有点“不被祝福”。 [you yi kuai zhuan men zhong zhi dian jia de tu di —— wo xiang xin ta jiu zai de lei nuo zhuang yuan fu jin de mou ge di fang ， na li de tu di you dian “ bu bei zhu fu ”。]

english: Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
translation: 在一块土地上施用堆肥不仅可以减少农作物患病的机会，而且还可以种植更多的农作物来收获。 [zai yi kuai tu di shang shi yong dui fei bu jin ke yi jian shao nong zuo wu huan bing de ji hui ， er qie hai ke yi zhong zhi geng duo de nong zuo wu lai shou huo 。]

english: If you want to grow fruit trees you could try a few places: Catherby, Brimhaven, Gnome Stronghold and the Farming Guild all have fruit tree patches.
translation: 如果你想种植果树，你可以尝试几个地方：Catherby、Brimhaven、Gnome Stronghold 和 Farming Guild 都有果树。 [ru guo ni xiang zhong zhi guo shu ， ni ke yi chang shi ji ge di fang ：Catherby、Brimhaven、Gnome Stronghold  he  Farming Guild  dou you guo shu 。]

english: You can fill plantpots with soil from any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.
translation: 如果你有园艺抹子，你可以用任何空地的土壤填满花盆。 [ru guo ni you yuan yi mo zi ， ni ke yi yong ren he kong di de tu rang tian man hua pen 。]

english: Hops are good for brewing ales. I believe there's a brewery up in Keldagrim somewhere, and I've heard rumours that a place called Phasmatys used to be good for that type of thing. 'Fore they all died, of course.
translation: 啤酒花适合酿造啤酒。我相信凯尔达格里姆的某个地方有一家啤酒厂，而且我听说过一个叫做 Phasmatys 的地方曾经适合做这种事情。 “当然，他们都死了。 [pi jiu hua shi he niang zao pi jiu 。 wo xiang xin kai er da ge li mu de mou ge di fang you yi jia pi jiu chang ， er qie wo ting shuo guo yi ge jiao zuo  Phasmatys  de di fang ceng jing shi he zuo zhe zhong shi qing 。 “ dang ran ， ta men dou si le 。]

english: Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
translation: 蔬菜、啤酒花和花卉需要不断浇水——如果你忽视我的建议，你迟早会发现自己拥有一片枯死的农田。 [shu cai 、 pi jiu hua he hua hui xu yao bu duan jiao shui —— ru guo ni hu shi wo de jian yi ， ni chi zao hui fa xian zi ji yong you yi pian ku si de nong tian 。]

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: 您最多可以将五个西红柿、草莓、苹果、香蕉或橙子放入一个水果篮中，但不能将它们混合放在同一个篮子中。 [nin zui duo ke yi jiang wu ge xi hong shi 、 cao mei 、 ping guo 、 xiang jiao huo cheng zi fang ru yi ge shui guo lan zhong ， dan bu neng jiang ta men hun he fang zai tong yi ge lan zi zhong 。]

english: Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
translation: 耙完一块杂草后，不要只是扔掉杂草 - 将它们放入堆肥箱中并制作一些堆肥。 [ba wan yi kuai za cao hou ， bu yao zhi shi reng diao za cao  -  jiang ta men fang ru dui fei xiang zhong bing zhi zuo yi xie dui fei 。]

english: There are five other Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius and Alan's area in the Farming Guild.
translation: 还有其他五个与此类似的农业区域 - 法拉多附近的埃尔斯坦区域、凯瑟比附近的丹塔拉区域、莫里塔尼亚的莱拉区域、霍西迪乌斯的马里西区域和农业公会的艾伦区域。 [hai you qi ta wu ge yu ci lei si de nong ye qu yu  -  fa la duo fu jin de ai er si tan qu yu 、 kai se bi fu jin de dan ta la qu yu 、 mo li ta ni ya de lai la qu yu 、 huo xi di wu si de ma li xi qu yu he nong ye gong hui de ai lun qu yu 。]

english: There are fiveother Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius, Alan's area in the Farming Guild and Oswallt's
translation: 还有五个其他农业区域与此类似 - 法拉多附近的埃尔斯坦区域、凯瑟比附近的丹塔拉区域、莫里塔尼亚的莱拉区域、霍西迪乌斯的马里西区域、农业行会的艾伦区域和奥斯瓦尔特区域 [hai you wu ge qi ta nong ye qu yu yu ci lei si  -  fa la duo fu jin de ai er si tan qu yu 、 kai se bi fu jin de dan ta la qu yu 、 mo li ta ni ya de lai la qu yu 、 huo xi di wu si de ma li xi qu yu 、 nong ye hang hui de ai lun qu yu he ao si wa er te qu yu]

english: area in Prifddinas.
translation: 普里夫迪纳斯地区。 [pu li fu di na si di qu 。]

english: If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're a good enough [craftsman/craftswoman], that is.
translation: 如果您想自己制作麻袋和篮子，则需要使用法拉多农业商店附近的织布机。如果你是一个足够好的[工匠/女工匠]，那就是。 [ru guo nin xiang zi ji zhi zuo ma dai he lan zi ， ze xu yao shi yong fa la duo nong ye shang dian fu jin de zhi bu ji 。 ru guo ni shi yi ge zu gou hao de [ gong jiang / nv gong jiang ]， na jiu shi 。]

english: You don't have to buy all your plantpots you know, you can make them yourself on a pottery wheel. If you're a good enough [craftsman/craftswoman], that is.
translation: 您不必购买所有您知道的花盆，您可以自己在陶轮上制作它们。如果你是一个足够好的[工匠/女工匠]，那就是。 [nin bu bi gou mai suo you nin zhi dao de hua pen ， nin ke yi zi ji zai tao lun shang zhi zuo ta men 。 ru guo ni shi yi ge zu gou hao de [ gong jiang / nv gong jiang ]， na jiu shi 。]

english: Can you sell me something?
translation: 你能卖给我东西吗？ [ni neng mai gei wo dong xi ma ？]

english: That depends on whether I have it to sell. What is it that you're looking for?
translation: 这取决于我是否有它可以卖。您在寻找什么？ [zhe qu jue yu wo shi fou you ta ke yi mai 。 nin zai xun zhao shen me ？]

english: Some plant cure.
translation: 一些植物治疗。 [yi xie zhi wu zhi liao 。]

english: Plant cure, eh? I might have some put aside for myself. Tell you what, I'll sell you some plant cure for 25 coins if you like.
translation: 植物疗法，嗯？我可能会留一些给自己。告诉你吧，如果你愿意的话，我可以花 25 个硬币卖给你一些植物疗法。 [zhi wu liao fa ， n ？ wo ke neng hui liu yi xie gei zi ji 。 gao su ni ba ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi hua  25  ge ying bi mai gei ni yi xie zhi wu liao fa 。]

english: I don't have enough money for that, I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕我没有足够的钱。 [kong pa wo mei you zu gou de qian 。]

english: Actually, I don't think I'd be able to carry it.
translation: 事实上，我认为我无法携带它。 [shi shi shang ， wo ren wei wo wu fa xie dai ta 。]

english: Yes, that sounds like a fair price.
translation: 是的，这听起来像是一个公平的价格。 [shi de ， zhe ting qi lai xiang shi yi ge gong ping de jia ge 。]

english: No thanks, I can get that much cheaper elsewhere.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我在其他地方可以买到便宜得多的东西。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo zai qi ta di fang ke yi mai dao pian yi de duo de dong xi 。]

english: A bucket of compost.
translation: 一桶堆肥。 [yi tong dui fei 。]

english: A bucket of compost, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 35 coins if you like.
translation: 一桶堆肥，是吗？我可能还有一个备用的……告诉你吧，如果你愿意的话，我可以以 35 个硬币的价格卖给你。 [yi tong dui fei ， shi ma ？ wo ke neng hai you yi ge bei yong de …… gao su ni ba ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi yi  35  ge ying bi de jia ge mai gei ni 。]

english: A rake.
translation: 一把耙子。 [yi ba pa zi 。]

english: A rake, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: 耙子，嗯？我可能还有一个备用的……告诉你吧，如果你愿意的话，我可以以 15 个硬币的价格卖给你。 [pa zi ， n ？ wo ke neng hai you yi ge bei yong de …… gao su ni ba ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi yi  15  ge ying bi de jia ge mai gei ni 。]

english: A plant pot.
translation: 一个花盆。 [yi ge hua pen 。]

english: Eh, I suppose I can spare you a plant pot, but I'll want 40 coins for it.
translation: 呃，我想我可以给你一个花盆，但我要 40 个硬币。 [e ， wo xiang wo ke yi gei ni yi ge hua pen ， dan wo yao  40  ge ying bi 。]

english: A watering can.
translation: 一个喷壶。 [yi ge pen hu 。]

english: A watering can, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 25 coins if you like.
translation: 喷壶，嗯？我可能还有一个备用的……告诉你吧，如果你愿意的话，我可以以 25 个硬币的价格卖给你。 [pen hu ， n ？ wo ke neng hai you yi ge bei yong de …… gao su ni ba ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi yi  25  ge ying bi de jia ge mai gei ni 。]

english: A gardening trowel.
translation: 园艺抹子。 [yuan yi mo zi 。]

english: A gardening trowel, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: 园艺抹子，是吗？我可能还有一个备用的……告诉你吧，如果你愿意的话，我可以以 15 个硬币的价格卖给你。 [yuan yi mo zi ， shi ma ？ wo ke neng hai you yi ge bei yong de …… gao su ni ba ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi yi  15  ge ying bi de jia ge mai gei ni 。]

english: A seed dibber.
translation: 播种机。 [bo zhong ji 。]

english: A seed dibber, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: 种子播种者，是吗？我可能还有一个备用的……告诉你吧，如果你愿意的话，我可以以 15 个硬币的价格卖给你。 [zhong zi bo zhong zhe ， shi ma ？ wo ke neng hai you yi ge bei yong de …… gao su ni ba ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi yi  15  ge ying bi de jia ge mai gei ni 。]

english: Forget it, you don't have anything I need.
translation: 算了，你没有我需要的东西。 [suan le ， ni mei you wo xu yao de dong xi 。]

english: I'll come back another time.
translation: 我下次再来。 [wo xia ci zai lai 。]

english: I'm already looking after that patch for you.
translation: 我已经在为你处理那个补丁了。 [wo yi jing zai wei ni chu li na ge bu ding le 。]

english: I want 2 buckets of compost for that.
translation: 我想要两桶堆肥。 [wo xiang yao liang tong dui fei 。]

english: I want one sack of potatoes for that.
translation: 我想要一袋土豆。 [wo xiang yao yi dai tu dou 。]

english: I want one sack of onions for that.
translation: 我想要一袋洋葱。 [wo xiang yao yi dai yang cong 。]

english: I want 2 sacks of cabbages for that.
translation: 我想要两袋卷心菜。 [wo xiang yao liang dai juan xin cai 。]

english: I want 10 jute fibres for that.
translation: 我需要 10 根黄麻纤维。 [wo xu yao  10  gen huang ma xian wei 。]

english: I want one basket of apples for that.
translation: 我想要一篮子苹果。 [wo xiang yao yi lan zi ping guo 。]

english: I want 10 curry leaves for that.
translation: 我想要 10 片咖喱叶。 [wo xiang yao  10  pian ga li ye 。]

english: I want 5 jangerberries for that.
translation: 我想要 5 个姜莓。 [wo xiang yao  5  ge jiang mei 。]

english: That looks like something that you can make normal compost out of. Fill up the compost bin with stuff like that, and you'll eventually have a bin full of compost.
translation: 这看起来像是可以用来制作普通堆肥的东西。用这样的东西填满堆肥箱，你最终会得到一个装满堆肥的箱。 [zhe kan qi lai xiang shi ke yi yong lai zhi zuo pu tong dui fei de dong xi 。 yong zhe yang de dong xi tian man dui fei xiang ， ni zui zhong hui de dao yi ge zhuang man dui fei de xiang 。]

english: That looks like something that you can make supercompost out of. Fill up the compost bin with stuff like that, and you'll eventually have a bin full of supercompost.
translation: 这看起来像是可以用来制作超级堆肥的东西。用这样的东西填满堆肥箱，你最终会得到一个装满超级堆肥的箱子。 [zhe kan qi lai xiang shi ke yi yong lai zhi zuo chao ji dui fei de dong xi 。 yong zhe yang de dong xi tian man dui fei xiang ， ni zui zhong hui de dao yi ge zhuang man chao ji dui fei de xiang zi 。]

english: Do you have any snowdrop seeds to spare?
translation: 你还有多余的雪花莲种子吗？ [ni hai you duo yu de xue hua lian zhong zi ma ？]

english: No I don't, as it happens. Sorry.
translation: 不，我不知道，碰巧的是。对不起。 [bu ， wo bu zhi dao ， peng qiao de shi 。 dui bu qi 。]

english: But I was told that you did!
translation: 但我听说你做到了！ [dan wo ting shuo ni zuo dao le ！]

english: Well, you were told wrong then!
translation: 好吧，那你就被告知错了！ [hao ba ， na ni jiu bei gao zhi cuo le ！]

english: Goodbye!!
translation: 再见！！ [zai jian ！！]

english: You seem to be a little irritable, my friend.
translation: 你看起来有点烦躁，我的朋友。 [ni kan qi lai you dian fan zao ， wo de peng you 。]

english: Oh, you think so?!? And what concern is it of yours?
translation: 哦，你也这么认为吗？！？你关心什么？ [o ， ni ye zhe me ren wei ma ？！？ ni guan xin shen me ？]

english: I'm not concerned, I just want you to give me some snowdrop seeds.
translation: 我不担心，我只是想让你给我一些雪花莲种子。 [wo bu dan xin ， wo zhi shi xiang rang ni gei wo yi xie xue hua lian zhong zi 。]

english: Is that right?!? Well, I do actually have some snowdrop seeds, but you would be the last person I would give them to.
translation: 是这样吗？！？好吧，我确实有一些雪花莲种子，但你是我最后一个给的人。 [shi zhe yang ma ？！？ hao ba ， wo que shi you yi xie xue hua lian zhong zi ， dan ni shi wo zui hou yi ge gei de ren 。]

english: I don't like to see a fellow human being so upset.
translation: 我不喜欢看到人类同胞如此沮丧。 [wo bu xi huan kan dao ren lei tong bao ru ci ju sang 。]

english: I must say, you don't often meet people who show concern the way you have done.
translation: 我必须说，像你这样关心的人并不常见。 [wo bi xu shuo ， xiang ni zhe yang guan xin de ren bing bu chang jian 。]

english: I can't take it anymore - just give me the seeds.
translation: 我再也受不了了——把种子给我吧。 [wo zai ye shou bu liao le —— ba zhong zi gei wo ba 。]

english: And to think I listened to you! I was right after all - there is no kindness between human beings anymore.
translation: 想想我都听你的了！我终究是对的——人与人之间已经没有善意了。 [xiang xiang wo dou ting ni de le ！ wo zhong jiu shi dui de —— ren yu ren zhi jian yi jing mei you shan yi le 。]

english: So what ails you, my friend?
translation: 那么你怎么了，我的朋友？ [na me ni zen me le ， wo de peng you ？]

english: All these people, asking me to look after their crops! And no-one ever asking me how I feel, or if there's something they can do for me!
translation: 所有这些人都要求我照看他们的庄稼！没有人问我感觉如何，或者他们是否可以为我做些什么！ [suo you zhe xie ren dou yao qiu wo zhao kan ta men de zhuang jia ！ mei you ren wen wo gan jue ru he ， huo zhe ta men shi fou ke yi wei wo zuo xie shen me ！]

english: Oh stop whining, it's not like you do it for free.
translation: 噢，别抱怨了，这可不是免费的。 [o ， bie bao yuan le ， zhe ke bu shi mian fei de 。]

english: Well, is there anything I can do for you?
translation: 嗯，有什么我能为您效劳的吗？ [n ， you shen me wo neng wei nin xiao lao de ma ？]

english: Oh, that's very kind of you! And there I was, thinking of giving it all up and heading off across the seas to find my fortune!
translation: 哦，你真是太好了！我当时就想放弃一切，漂洋过海去寻找我的财富！ [o ， ni zhen shi tai hao le ！ wo dang shi jiu xiang fang qi yi qie ， piao yang guo hai qu xun zhao wo de cai fu ！]

english: Don't let me stop you, there are plenty of ships missing cabin boys.
translation: 别让我阻止你，有很多船都缺少船员。 [bie rang wo zu zhi ni ， you hen duo chuan dou que shao chuan yuan 。]

english: If you carry on speaking to me like that I might just put this spade to good use, and I'm not talking about digging!
translation: 如果你继续这样对我说话，我可能会充分利用这把铲子，而且我不是在谈论挖掘！ [ru guo ni ji xu zhe yang dui wo shuo hua ， wo ke neng hui chong fen li yong zhe ba chan zi ， er qie wo bu shi zai tan lun wa jue ！]

english: So what can I do for you?
translation: 那么我能为您做些什么呢？ [na me wo neng wei nin zuo xie shen me ne ？]

english: I'd like just for once for somebody to grow something for me. Just something simple; some vegetables would be nice.
translation: 我只希望有人为我种植一些东西。只是一些简单的事情；一些蔬菜会很好。 [wo zhi xi wang you ren wei wo zhong zhi yi xie dong xi 。 zhi shi yi xie jian dan de shi qing ； yi xie shu cai hui hen hao 。]

english: How about some potatoes?
translation: 来点土豆怎么样？ [lai dian tu dou zen me yang ？]

english: Nah, there's a whole field of them over to the west. I don't have any particular use for onions, so how about cabbages, then?
translation: 不，西边有一整片田野。我对洋葱没有任何特殊用途，那么卷心菜怎么样？ [bu ， xi bian you yi zheng pian tian ye 。 wo dui yang cong mei you ren he te shu yong tu ， na me juan xin cai zen me yang ？]

english: Cabbages? Sounds good to me. Where do you want me to grow them?
translation: 卷心菜？对我来说听起来不错。你想让我在哪里种植它们？ [juan xin cai ？ dui wo lai shuo ting qi lai bu cuo 。 ni xiang rang wo zai na li zhong zhi ta men ？]

english: Oh, in one of these allotments here. Plant them from seed, and when they're ready for harvesting let me know, I'll give you your seeds.
translation: 哦，在这些分配之一中。从种子开始种植它们，当它们准备好收获时请告诉我，我会给你种子。 [o ， zai zhe xie fen pei zhi yi zhong 。 cong zhong zi kai shi zhong zhi ta men ， dang ta men zhun bei hao shou huo shi qing gao su wo ， wo hui gei ni zhong zi 。]

english: That's a deal - I'll let you know when your cabbages are ready.
translation: 就这样吧——你的卷心菜准备好了我会通知你。 [jiu zhe yang ba —— ni de juan xin cai zhun bei hao le wo hui tong zhi ni 。]

english: I'm not wasting my time growing cabbages.
translation: 我不会浪费时间种卷心菜。 [wo bu hui lang fei shi jian zhong juan xin cai 。]

english: And I'm not wasting my seeds on an upstart like you!
translation: 我不会把我的种子浪费在像你这样的暴发户身上！ [wo bu hui ba wo de zhong zi lang fei zai xiang ni zhe yang de bao fa hu shen shang ！]

english: Aarrrrrghhhh! I hate cabbages!!!! Give me the seeds!!!!!
translation: 啊啊啊啊！我讨厌白菜！！！！给我种子！！！！ [a a a a ！ wo tao yan bai cai ！！！！ gei wo zhong zi ！！！！]

english: Give ... you ... the ...
... yes I should ...
translation: ...是的，我应该... [... shi de ， wo ying gai ...]

english: ... no I won't ...
translation: ...不，我不会... [... bu ， wo bu hui ...]

english: Not after speaking to me like that you upstart!!! Is it a deal or not?!?
translation: 不是在跟我那样说话之后你这个暴发户！到底是成交还是没成交？！？ [bu shi zai gen wo na yang shuo hua zhi hou ni zhe ge bao fa hu ！ dao di shi cheng jiao huan shi mei cheng jiao ？！？]

english: What did you ask me to do?
translation: 你让我做什么？ [ni rang wo zuo shen me ？]

english: You said that you would grow me some cabbages in one of these allotments. When they're ready for harvest come and talk to me, and I'll give you those snowdrop seeds that you're after.
translation: 你说过要在其中一块土地上给我种一些卷心菜。当它们准备好收获时，来跟我说话，我会给你你想要的雪花莲种子。 [ni shuo guo yao zai qi zhong yi kuai tu di shang gei wo zhong yi xie juan xin cai 。 dang ta men zhun bei hao shou huo shi ， lai gen wo shuo hua ， wo hui gei ni ni xiang yao de xue hua lian zhong zi 。]

english: I can't believe you're asking me to do that! I asked you to grow some cabbages for me, not for me to look after them for you! No, I won't look after them!
translation: 我不敢相信你要我这么做！我让你给我种点白菜，不是让我替你照顾的！不，我不会照顾他们！ [wo bu gan xiang xin ni yao wo zhe me zuo ！ wo rang ni gei wo zhong dian bai cai ， bu shi rang wo ti ni zhao gu de ！ bu ， wo bu hui zhao gu ta men ！]

english: Okay, I've grown those cabbages like you asked.
translation: 好的，我按照你的要求种了那些卷心菜。 [hao de ， wo an zhao ni de yao qiu zhong le na xie juan xin cai 。]

english: Yes, I saw - what fine farming prowess! Nobody has ever done anything like that for me before; here you go, these are the seeds you were after I believe.
translation: 是的，我看到了——多么优秀的农耕技术！以前从来没有人为我做过这样的事；给你，我相信这些就是你想要的种子。 [shi de ， wo kan dao le —— duo me you xiu de nong geng ji shu ！ yi qian cong lai mei you ren wei wo zuo guo zhe yang de shi ； gei ni ， wo xiang xin zhe xie jiu shi ni xiang yao de zhong zi 。]

english: I would give you some, but you don't appear to have room to carry them.
translation: 我本来想给你一些，但你似乎没有空间携带它们。 [wo ben lai xiang gei ni yi xie ， dan ni si hu mei you kong jian xie dai ta men 。]

english: Yes, here you go - I hope they grow for you.
translation: 是的，给你 - 我希望他们为你成长。 [shi de ， gei ni  -  wo xi wang ta men wei ni cheng zhang 。]

english: Are you a member of the Group of Advanced Gardeners?
translation: 您是高级园丁小组的成员吗？ [nin shi gao ji yuan ding xiao zu de cheng yuan ma ？]

english: Why, yes I am. Why do you ask?
translation: 为什么，是的，我是。你为什么问？ [wei shen me ， shi de ， wo shi 。 ni wei shen me wen ？]

english: Martin has asked me to investigate why all the crops are failing.
translation: 马丁让我调查为什么所有庄稼都歉收。 [ma ding rang wo diao cha wei shen me suo you zhuang jia dou qian shou 。]

english: I've already told you everything I suspect.
translation: 我已经告诉你我怀疑的一切了。 [wo yi jing gao su ni wo huai yi de yi qie le 。]

english: Ah, Martin sent you, why didn't you say so? I personally think that our problems are all down to the fact that we haven't had enough rain of late. It's plain to see - just look at the levels of the rivers.
translation: 啊，马丁派你来的，你为什么不说呢？我个人认为我们的问题都是因为最近雨水不够。这是显而易见的——只要看看河流的水位就知道了。 [a ， ma ding pai ni lai de ， ni wei shen me bu shuo ne ？ wo ge ren ren wei wo men de wen ti dou shi yin wei zui jin yu shui bu gou 。 zhe shi xian er yi jian de —— zhi yao kan kan he liu de shui wei jiu zhi dao le 。]

english: We need more rain. I don't suppose you can do anything about that?
translation: 我们需要更多的雨。我想你对此无能为力吧？ [wo men xu yao geng duo de yu 。 wo xiang ni dui ci wu neng wei li ba ？]

english: No, I'm afraid not.
translation: 不，恐怕不是。 [bu ， kong pa bu shi 。]

english: Well there you go then. Until you find out how to make it rain you're going to have a hard time solving our problems.
translation: 好吧，那你就去吧。在你找到如何下雨之前，你将很难解决我们的问题。 [hao ba ， na ni jiu qu ba 。 zai ni zhao dao ru he xia yu zhi qian ， ni jiang hen nan jie jue wo men de wen ti 。]

english: Insects! That's what you can tell him! Insects! Stop the insects from eating so many of our crops and we'd get maximum yield, I tell you!
translation: 昆虫！这就是你可以告诉他的！昆虫！我告诉你，阻止昆虫吃掉我们这么多的农作物，我们就能获得最大的产量！ [kun chong ！ zhe jiu shi ni ke yi gao su ta de ！ kun chong ！ wo gao su ni ， zu zhi kun chong chi diao wo men zhe me duo de nong zuo wu ， wo men jiu neng huo de zui da de chan liang ！]

english: How can you ask such a thing? It's obvious! It's all you adventurers. Every time I get a crop planted, some adventurer comes along and digs it up and plants crops of their own, as if they owned my farming patch!
translation: 你怎么能问这样的事呢？很明显！都是你们冒险家。每当我种下农作物时，就会有一些冒险家过来把它挖出来并种植自己的农作物，就好像他们拥有我的农田一样！ [ni zen me neng wen zhe yang de shi ne ？ hen ming xian ！ dou shi ni men mao xian jia 。 mei dang wo zhong xia nong zuo wu shi ， jiu hui you yi xie mao xian jia guo lai ba ta wa chu lai bing zhong zhi zi ji de nong zuo wu ， jiu hao xiang ta men yong you wo de nong tian yi yang ！]

english: It's really annoying! You should speak to your friends about their rude behaviour!
translation: 实在是太烦人了！您应该与您的朋友谈论他们的粗鲁行为！ [shi zai shi tai fan ren le ！ nin ying gai yu nin de peng you tan lun ta men de cu lu xing wei ！]

english: But...but...they're not my friends! I've never even spoken to most of them!
translation: 但是……但是……他们不是我的朋友！我什至从未和他们中的大多数人说过话！ [dan shi …… dan shi …… ta men bu shi wo de peng you ！ wo shen zhi cong wei he ta men zhong de da duo shu ren shuo guo hua ！]

english: Don't give me that! You're an adventurer, they're all adventurers. I bet you have some sort of secret guild and you gather there and say things like 'let's annoy the gardeners this week', don't you?
translation: 别给我那个！你是冒险家，他们都是冒险家。我打赌你们有某种秘密公会，你们聚集在那里说“这周我们来惹恼园丁吧”之类的话，不是吗？ [bie gei wo na ge ！ ni shi mao xian jia ， ta men dou shi mao xian jia 。 wo da du ni men you mou zhong mi mi gong hui ， ni men ju ji zai na li shuo “ zhe zhou wo men lai re nao yuan ding ba ” zhi lei de hua ， bu shi ma ？]

english: No, I mean yes. There is a heroes guild, but ...!
translation: 不，我的意思是是的。虽然有英雄公会，但是……！ [bu ， wo de yi si shi shi de 。 sui ran you ying xiong gong hui ， dan shi ……！]

english: Aha, so you admit it then! You should be ashamed of yourselves!
translation: 啊哈哈，那你就承认吧！你应该为自己感到羞耻！ [a ha ha ， na ni jiu cheng ren ba ！ ni ying gai wei zi ji gan dao xiu chi ！]

english: Oh, I give up!
translation: 哦，我放弃了！ [o ， wo fang qi le ！]

english: Well obviously it's the seasons. They all seem to be out- of-wack these days. Summer comes earlier and earlier each year, but then it simply rushes by!
translation: 嗯，显然是季节。这些天他们似乎都有些古怪。夏天每年都来得越来越早，但很快就过去了！ [n ， xian ran shi ji jie 。 zhe xie tian ta men si hu dou you xie gu guai 。 xia tian mei nian dou lai de yue lai yue zao ， dan hen kuai jiu guo qu le ！]

english: If you find out what is upsetting the seasons you'll find out what is causing the harvest to fail.
translation: 如果你找出了季节失调的原因，你就会找出导致收成歉收的原因。 [ru guo ni zhao chu le ji jie shi tiao de yuan yin ， ni jiu hui zhao chu dao zhi shou cheng qian shou de yuan yin 。]

english: I don't suppose you have any ideas about what could cause the seasons to be mixed up?
translation: 我想您不知道什么会导致季节混淆？ [wo xiang nin bu zhi dao shen me hui dao zhi ji jie hun xiao ？]

english: No, sorry, but find that out and you'll get to the root of our problems.
translation: 不，抱歉，但是弄清楚这一点，你就会找到我们问题的根源。 [bu ， bao qian ， dan shi nong qing chu zhe yi dian ， ni jiu hui zhao dao wo men wen ti de gen yuan 。]

english: Well I can tell by the look on your face that I'm not the first person you've asked. Why don't you tell me what you've heard from other members of the group so far?
translation: 好吧，从你脸上的表情我就知道我不是你第一个问的人。你为什么不告诉我到目前为止你从小组其他成员那里听到了什么？ [hao ba ， cong ni lian shang de biao qing wo jiu zhi dao wo bu shi ni di yi ge wen de ren 。 ni wei shen me bu gao su wo dao mu qian wei zhi ni cong xiao zu qi ta cheng yuan na li ting dao le shen me ？]

english: Why not? They all seem to be a bunch of loonies anyway.
translation: 为什么不呢？无论如何，他们似乎都是一群疯子。 [wei shen me bu ne ？ wu lun ru he ， ta men si hu dou shi yi qun feng zi 。]

english: I've been told that it's the lack of rain, plagues of insects and recently I was told that the entire order of seasons is confused!
translation: 有人告诉我，这是因为缺雨、虫灾，最近我又被告知，整个季节的顺序都混乱了！ [you ren gao su wo ， zhe shi yin wei que yu 、 chong zai ， zui jin wo you bei gao zhi ， zheng ge ji jie de shun xu dou hun luan le ！]

english: I have no idea what to do about any of it. I'm an adventurer, not a weather controller!
translation: 我不知道该怎么办。我是冒险家，不是天气控制者！ [wo bu zhi dao gai zen me ban 。 wo shi mao xian jia ， bu shi tian qi kong zhi zhe ！]

english: Did you ever consider that all those theories might be correct?
translation: 你有没有想过所有这些理论可能都是正确的？ [ni you mei you xiang guo suo you zhe xie li lun ke neng dou shi zheng que de ？]

english: But they're all different, how could they all be correct?
translation: 但它们都是不同的，怎么可能都是正确的呢？ [dan ta men dou shi bu tong de ， zen me ke neng dou shi zheng que de ne ？]

english: I'll let you into a little secret that'll explain it all to you. In a word - fairies!
translation: 我会让你知道一个小秘密，它会向你解释一切。一句话简介：仙女们！ [wo hui rang ni zhi dao yi ge xiao mi mi ， ta hui xiang ni jie shi yi qie 。 yi ju hua jian jie ： xian nv men ！]

english: Oh no! Not another crack-pot theory!
translation: 哦不！这不是另一个疯狂的理论！ [o bu ！ zhe bu shi ling yi ge feng kuang de li lun ！]

english: I'm serious!
translation: 我是认真的！ [wo shi ren zhen de ！]

english: Think it through. There are fairies who control everything natural from the weather to the seasons.
translation: 想清楚了。有些仙女可以控制从天气到季节的一切自然事物。 [xiang qing chu le 。 you xie xian nv ke yi kong zhi cong tian qi dao ji jie de yi qie zi ran shi wu 。]

english: Surely if all of those things have been mentioned as catalysts to our problems it stands to reason that the fairies are actually the cause?
translation: 当然，如果所有这些事情都被认为是我们问题的催化剂，那么仙女实际上就是原因，这是理所当然的吗？ [dang ran ， ru guo suo you zhe xie shi qing dou bei ren wei shi wo men wen ti de cui hua ji ， na me xian nv shi ji shang jiu shi yuan yin ， zhe shi li suo dang ran de ma ？]

english: Right, well thanks for your input. I'll think over what you said.
translation: 好的，谢谢您的意见。我会考虑一下你说的话。 [hao de ， xie xie nin de yi jian 。 wo hui kao lv yi xia ni shuo de hua 。]

english: I don't think the crops ARE failing, now leave me alone, I have work to do.
translation: 我不认为庄稼歉收，现在别管我了，我还有工作要做。 [wo bu ren wei zhuang jia qian shou ， xian zai bie guan wo le ， wo hai you gong zuo yao zuo 。]

english: Hello. Could you help me with a quest, please?
translation: 你好。你能帮我做一个任务吗？ [ni hao 。 ni neng bang wo zuo yi ge ren wu ma ？]

english: Yes, certainly. I'll help if I can. Which quest would you like help with?
translation: 是的，当然。如果可以的话我会帮忙的。您需要哪个任务的帮助？ [shi de ， dang ran 。 ru guo ke yi de hua wo hui bang mang de 。 nin xu yao na ge ren wu de bang zhu ？]

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
translation: 你愿意帮我照料我的庄稼吗？ [ni yuan yi bang wo zhao liao wo de zhuang jia ma ？]

english: The northern allotment
translation: 北部分配地 [bei bu fen pei di]

english: Okay, it's a deal.
translation: “好吧，成交。” [“ hao ba ， cheng jiao 。”]

english: No, that's too much.
translation: 不，那太多了。 [bu ， na tai duo le 。]

english: The southern allotment
translation: 南部分配地 [nan bu fen pei di]

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 你能给我一些农业建议吗？ [ni neng gei wo yi xie nong ye jian yi ma ？]

english: Can you sell me something?
translation: 你能卖给我东西吗？ [ni neng mai gei wo dong xi ma ？]

english: Some plant cure.
translation: 一些植物治疗。 [yi xie zhi wu zhi liao 。]

english: Yes, that sounds like a fair price.
translation: 是的，这听起来像是一个公平的价格。 [shi de ， zhe ting qi lai xiang shi yi ge gong ping de jia ge 。]

english: No thanks, I can get that much cheaper elsewhere.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我在其他地方可以买到便宜得多的东西。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo zai qi ta di fang ke yi mai dao pian yi de duo de dong xi 。]

english: A bucket of compost.
translation: 一桶堆肥。 [yi tong dui fei 。]

english: A rake.
translation: 一把耙子。 [yi ba pa zi 。]

english: A plant pot.
translation: 一个花盆。 [yi ge hua pen 。]

english: (See more items)
translation: （查看更多项目） [（ cha kan geng duo xiang mu ）]

english: A watering can.
translation: 一个喷壶。 [yi ge pen hu 。]

english: A gardening trowel.
translation: 园艺抹子。 [yuan yi mo zi 。]

english: A seed dibber.
translation: 播种机。 [bo zhong ji 。]

english: (See previous items)
translation: （参见之前的项目） [（ can jian zhi qian de xiang mu ）]

english: Forget it.
translation: 忘了它。 [wang le ta 。]

english: I'll come back another time.
translation: 我下次再来。 [wo xia ci zai lai 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Do you have any snowdrop seeds to spare?
translation: 你还有多余的雪花莲种子吗？ [ni hai you duo yu de xue hua lian zhong zi ma ？]

english: But I was told that you did!
translation: 但我听说你做到了！ [dan wo ting shuo ni zuo dao le ！]

english: [Charm] You seem to be a little irritable, my friend.
translation: [魅力]你似乎有点烦躁，我的朋友。 [[ mei li ] ni si hu you dian fan zao ， wo de peng you 。]

english: I'm not concerned, I just want you to give me some snowdrop seeds.
translation: 我不担心，我只是想让你给我一些雪花莲种子。 [wo bu dan xin ， wo zhi shi xiang rang ni gei wo yi xie xue hua lian zhong zi 。]

english: [Charm] I don't like to see a fellow human being so upset.
translation: [魅力]我不喜欢看到人类同胞如此沮丧。 [[ mei li ] wo bu xi huan kan dao ren lei tong bao ru ci ju sang 。]

english: I can't take it anymore - just give me the seeds.
translation: 我再也受不了了——把种子给我吧。 [wo zai ye shou bu liao le —— ba zhong zi gei wo ba 。]

english: [Charm] So what ails you, my friend?

translation: 这是图书馆历史档案馆。在这里您可以找到大库伦德历史各个时期的历史文献和文本，可以追溯到第一个十年。 [zhe shi tu shu guan li shi dang an guan 。 zai zhe li nin ke yi zhao dao da ku lun de li shi ge ge shi qi de li shi wen xian he wen ben ， ke yi zhui su dao di yi ge shi nian 。]

translation: 太好了，谢谢！ [tai hao le ， xie xie ！]

translation: 呃……这很奇怪……我以为这会是个大新闻。 [e …… zhe hen qi guai …… wo yi wei zhe hui shi ge da xin wen 。]

english: Well there seems to be an absence of a certain ornithological piece: a headline regarding mass awareness of a certain avian variety.
translation: 好吧，似乎缺少某种鸟类学文章：关于大众对某种鸟类品种的认识的标题。 [hao ba ， si hu que shao mou zhong niao lei xue wen zhang ： guan yu da zhong dui mou zhong niao lei pin zhong de ren shi de biao ti 。]

english: Oh have you not heard? It was my understanding that everyone had heard....
translation: 哦，你没听说过吗？我的理解是大家都听过...... [o ， ni mei ting shuo guo ma ？ wo de li jie shi da jia dou ting guo ......]

english: Heard wha...... OH NO!!!!?!?!!?!
translation: 听到什么……哦不！！！！！！？！？！？！ [ting dao shen me …… o bu ！！！！！！？！？！？！]

english: OH WELL THE BIRD, BIRD, BIRD, BIRD BIRD IS THE WORD. OH WELL THE BIRD, BIRD, BIRD, BIRD BIRD IS THE WORD.
translation: 哦，好吧，鸟，鸟，鸟，鸟，鸟就是这个词。哦，好吧，鸟，鸟，鸟，鸟，鸟就是这个词。 [o ， hao ba ， niao ， niao ， niao ， niao ， niao jiu shi zhe ge ci 。 o ， hao ba ， niao ， niao ， niao ， niao ， niao jiu shi zhe ge ci 。]

english: Armadyl's law rules!
translation: 阿玛迪法则规则！ [a ma di fa ze gui ze ！]

english: The bird's the word!
translation: 鸟就是这个词！ [niao jiu shi zhe ge ci ！]

english: For Armadyl!
translation: 为了阿玛迪尔！ [wei le a ma di er ！]

english: SQUAWK!
translation: 发牢骚！ [fa lao sao ！]

english: Hell-

translation: 别分散我的注意力！这个公式非常不稳定！ [bie fen san wo de zhu yi li ！ zhe ge gong shi fei chang bu wen ding ！]

english: Cool, what are you making?
translation: 酷，你在做什么？ [ku ， ni zai zuo shen me ？]

english: Ugh, look around you, what does it look like?
translation: 呃，看看你的周围，它是什么样子的？ [e ， kan kan ni de zhou wei ， ta shi shen me yang zi de ？]

english: A magic potion?! Can I have some?
translation: 魔法药剂？！我可以要一些吗？ [mo fa yao ji ？！ wo ke yi yao yi xie ma ？]

english: No, human. This isn't designed for your race, it could have unforeseen consequences.
translation: 不，人类。这不是为您的比赛而设计的，它可能会产生不可预见的后果。 [bu ， ren lei 。 zhe bu shi wei nin de bi sai er she ji de ， ta ke neng hui chan sheng bu ke yu jian de hou guo 。]

english: I can deal with them, I promise.
translation: 我可以对付他们，我保证。 [wo ke yi dui fu ta men ， wo bao zheng 。]

english: You can deal with death?
translation: 你能应对死亡吗？ [ni neng ying dui si wang ma ？]

english: Hmm, perhaps a rain check?
translation: 嗯，也许是雨天检查？ [n ， ye xu shi yu tian jian cha ？]

english: Wise choice. Now please, I'm working a deadline here.
translation: 明智的选择。现在拜托，我在这里工作的最后期限。 [ming zhi de xuan ze 。 xian zai bai tuo ， wo zai zhe li gong zuo de zui hou qi xian 。]

english: See you around!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Doubtful.
translation: 疑。 [yi 。]

english: Yeah? What do you want?
translation: 是的？你想要什么？ [shi de ？ ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: I need another assignment.
translation: 我需要另一项任务。 [wo xu yao ling yi xiang ren wu 。]

english: Before I assign you anything, I want to make something clear. My tasks have to be done in the Wilderness. Only kills inside the Wilderness will count.
translation: 在我给你分配任何事情之前，我想澄清一些事情。我的任务必须在荒野中完成。只有在荒野内击杀才算数。 [zai wo gei ni fen pei ren he shi qing zhi qian ， wo xiang cheng qing yi xie shi qing 。 wo de ren wu bi xu zai huang ye zhong wan cheng 。 zhi you zai huang ye nei ji sha cai suan shu 。]

english: I don't check combat levels when choosing tasks, either. So even if other masters won't assign you 'tough' monsters, I'll pick anything for which you have the Slayer level, provided you can physically get to it.
translation: 我在选择任务时也不检查战斗等级。因此，即使其他大师不会为你分配“强硬”的怪物，我也会选择任何你具有毁灭者等级的怪物，只要你能够物理接触到它。 [wo zai xuan ze ren wu shi ye bu jian cha zhan dou deng ji 。 yin ci ， ji shi qi ta da shi bu hui wei ni fen pei “ qiang ying ” de guai wu ， wo ye hui xuan ze ren he ni ju you hui mie zhe deng ji de guai wu ， zhi yao ni neng gou wu li jie chu dao ta 。]

english: If you don't like my tasks, go and see Aya in Burthorpe, and ask her to assign you something else. She won't argue.
translation: 如果你不喜欢我的任务，就去伯索普见阿雅，让她给你分配别的事情。她不会争论。 [ru guo ni bu xi huan wo de ren wu ， jiu qu bo suo pu jian a ya ， rang ta gei ni fen pei bie de shi qing 。 ta bu hui zheng lun 。]

english: You might get a few unusual loot drops while you're on my assignments, if you're lucky. So, do you want me to assign you something?
translation: 如果你幸运的话，在执行我的任务时，你可能会得到一些不寻常的战利品。那么，你需要我给你分配一些东西吗？ [ru guo ni xing yun de hua ， zai zhi xing wo de ren wu shi ， ni ke neng hui de dao yi xie bu xun chang de zhan li pin 。 na me ， ni xu yao wo gei ni fen pei yi xie dong xi ma ？]

english: Your new task is to kill [number] [monster].
translation: 你的新任务是杀死[数量][怪物]。 [ni de xin ren wu shi sha si [ shu liang ][ guai wu ]。]

english: Got any tips for me?
translation: 有什么建议给我吗？ [you shen me jian yi gei wo ma ？]

english: You've got to do the task in the Wilderness.
translation: 你必须在荒野中完成任务。 [ni bi xu zai huang ye zhong wan cheng ren wu 。]

english: Great, thanks!
translation: 太好了，谢谢！ [tai hao le ， xie xie ！]

english: Okay, great!
translation: 好的，太好了！ [hao de ， tai hao le ！]

english: Good luck! Don't forget to come back when you need a new assignment.
translation: 祝你好运！当您需要新的任务时，请不要忘记回来。 [zhu ni hao yun ！ dang nin xu yao xin de ren wu shi ， qing bu yao wang ji hui lai 。]

english: No thanks, I don't want tasks from you.
translation: 不，谢谢，我不需要你的任务。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo bu xu yao ni de ren wu 。]

english: You're still meant to be slaying [monster] in the Wilderness; you have [number] to go. Come back when you've finished your task.
translation: 你仍然应该在荒野中杀死[怪物]；你还有 [number] 条路要走。完成任务后就回来。 [ni reng ran ying gai zai huang ye zhong sha si [ guai wu ]； ni hai you  [number]  tiao lu yao zou 。 wan cheng ren wu hou jiu hui lai 。]

english: You've already been assigned something.
translation: 你已经被分配了一些事情。 [ni yi jing bei fen pei le yi xie shi qing 。]

english: You're still hunting [monster]; you have [number] to go. Come back when you've finished your task.
translation: 你还在狩猎[怪物]；你还有 [number] 条路要走。完成任务后就回来。 [ni hai zai shou lie [ guai wu ]； ni hai you  [number]  tiao lu yao zou 。 wan cheng ren wu hou jiu hui lai 。]

english: You're still hunting [monster], with [amount] to go.
translation: 你仍在狩猎[怪物]，还有[数量]。 [ni reng zai shou lie [ guai wu ]， hai you [ shu liang ]。]

english: I don't think that's a suitable task for you. Shall I cancel it? This will not wipe your task streaks.
translation: 我认为这不适合你。我要取消它吗？这不会消除您的任务连续记录。 [wo ren wei zhe bu shi he ni 。 wo yao qu xiao ta ma ？ zhe bu hui xiao chu nin de ren wu lian xu ji lu 。]

english: Yes, please cancel it.
translation: 是的，请取消。 [shi de ， qing qu xiao 。]

english: Alright, consider the task cancelled. You can now get a new assignment when you want one.
translation: 好吧，考虑任务被取消了。现在，您可以在需要时获得新的任务。 [hao ba ， kao lv ren wu bei qu xiao le 。 xian zai ， nin ke yi zai xu yao shi huo de xin de ren wu 。]

english: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
translation: 不，谢谢，我想尝试一下。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo xiang chang shi yi xia 。]

english: Good luck with that.
translation: 祝你好运。 [zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: 你有什么奖励给我，或者有什么可以交易的吗？ [ni you shen me jiang li gei wo ， huo zhe you shen me ke yi jiao yi de ma ？]

english: I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.
translation: 我有很多你可以获得的奖励，还有各种各样的杀手装备可供出售。 [wo you hen duo ni ke yi huo de de jiang li ， hai you ge zhong ge yang de sha shou zhuang bei ke gong chu shou 。]

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: 说说我的作业的难度吧。 [shuo shuo wo de zuo ye de nan du ba 。]

english: All the Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 目前，所有杀手大师都可以向您分配我们列表中的任何任务，无论您的战斗水平如何。 [mu qian ， suo you sha shou da shi dou ke yi xiang nin fen pei wo men lie biao zhong de ren he ren wu ， wu lun nin de zhan dou shui ping ru he 。]

english: Other Slayer Masters take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so they won't set you anything too hard. But I don't do that - if you get a task from me, it could be anything for which you
translation: 其他杀手大师在为你选择任务时会考虑你的战斗水平，所以他们不会给你设置太难的任务。但我不会那样做——如果你从我这里得到一个任务，它可以是你想要完成的任何任务。 [qi ta sha shou da shi zai wei ni xuan ze ren wu shi hui kao lv ni de zhan dou shui ping ， suo yi ta men bu hui gei ni she zhi tai nan de ren wu 。 dan wo bu hui na yang zuo —— ru guo ni cong wo zhe li de dao yi ge ren wu ， ta ke yi shi ni xiang yao wan cheng de ren he ren wu 。]

english: have the Slayer level, provided you can physically get to it.
translation: 拥有杀手级别，前提是你可以在身体上达到它。 [yong you sha shou ji bie ， qian ti shi ni ke yi zai shen ti shang da dao ta 。]

english: What can you do apart from Slayer Master stuff?
translation: 除了杀戮大师的东西你还能做什么？ [chu le sha lu da shi de dong xi ni hai neng zuo shen me ？]

english: Quite a lot! Those stupid guards think they've trapped me here for causing trouble, but I can get back out to the Wilderness for some fun anytime I like.
translation: 相当多！那些愚蠢的守卫以为他们把我困在这里是因为我惹了麻烦，但我可以随时回到荒野去找点乐子。 [xiang dang duo ！ na xie yu chun de shou wei yi wei ta men ba wo kun zai zhe li shi yin wei wo re le ma fan ， dan wo ke yi sui shi hui dao huang ye qu zhao dian le zi 。]

english: Well, normally, I can fix it so that you respawn in Edgeville whenever you die. However, I don't seem to be able to do so right now...
translation: 好吧，通常情况下，我可以修复它，以便你在死亡时会在埃奇维尔重生。不过，我现在好像还做不到…… [hao ba ， tong chang qing kuang xia ， wo ke yi xiu fu ta ， yi bian ni zai si wang shi hui zai ai qi wei er chong sheng 。 bu guo ， wo xian zai hao xiang hai zuo bu dao ……]

english: This feature is not currently available on a Leagues world.
translation: 此功能目前在联赛世界中不可用。 [ci gong neng mu qian zai lian sai shi jie zhong bu ke yong 。]

english: Hey, perhaps you'd like me to fix it so that you respawn in Edgeville whenever you die. If you love the Wilderness as much as I do, you might enjoy that.
translation: 嘿，也许你希望我修复它，以便你在死亡时能够在埃奇维尔重生。如果你和我一样热爱荒野，你可能会喜欢它。 [hei ， ye xu ni xi wang wo xiu fu ta ， yi bian ni zai si wang shi neng gou zai ai qi wei er chong sheng 。 ru guo ni he wo yi yang re ai huang ye ， ni ke neng hui xi huan ta 。]

english: Tell me more.
translation: 告诉我更多。 [gao su wo geng duo 。]

english: Alright, here's the deal: Whenever you drop dead, I'll try to make you reappear in Edgeville, down by the southern ruins. You'll lose your items as normal.
translation: 好吧，协议是这样的：无论何时你死了，我都会尽力让你重新出现在埃奇维尔，靠近南部废墟。像往常一样，您会丢失物品。 [hao ba ， xie yi shi zhe yang de ： wu lun he shi ni si le ， wo du hui jin li rang ni chong xin chu xian zai ai qi wei er ， kao jin nan bu fei xu 。 xiang wang chang yi yang ， nin hui diu shi wu pin 。]

english: My magic won't affect you if you die in some fancy place like Castle Wars or the Emir's Arena; those places have their own magic trying to make you 'safe'.
translation: 如果你死在城堡战争或埃米尔竞技场等奇特的地方，我的魔法不会影响你；这些地方有自己的魔力，试图让你“安全”。 [ru guo ni si zai cheng bao zhan zheng huo ai mi er jing ji chang deng qi te de di fang ， wo de mo fa bu hui ying xiang ni ； zhe xie di fang you zi ji de mo li ， shi tu rang ni “ an quan ”。]

english: This will apply on members' worlds and non-members' worlds alike.
translation: 这将同样适用于会员世界和非会员世界。 [zhe jiang tong yang shi yong yu hui yuan shi jie he fei hui yuan shi jie 。]

english: I'll want a one-off payment of 5 million coins. If you get your respawn changed later, and then need me to set it back to Edgeville, I won't bill you again.
translation: 我想要一次性支付 500 万枚硬币。如果您稍后更改重生，然后需要我将其设置回埃奇维尔，我不会再向您收费。 [wo xiang yao yi ci xing zhi fu  500  wan mei ying bi 。 ru guo nin shao hou geng gai chong sheng ， ran hou xu yao wo jiang qi she zhi hui ai qi wei er ， wo bu hui zai xiang nin shou fei 。]

english: I'm not carrying that much money.
translation: 我没带那么多钱。 [wo mei dai na me duo qian 。]

english: Scared of dropping it? Hah!
translation: 害怕掉落吗？哈！ [hai pa diao luo ma ？ ha ！]

english: Okay, switch my spawn to Edgeville.
translation: 好的，将我的重生点切换到埃奇维尔。 [hao de ， jiang wo de chong sheng dian qie huan dao ai qi wei er 。]

english: That doesn't interest me.
translation: 我对此不感兴趣。 [wo dui ci bu gan xing qu 。]

english: Maybe you just can't handle Edgeville!
translation: 也许你就是无法应对《埃奇维尔》！ [ye xu ni jiu shi wu fa ying dui 《 ai qi wei er 》！]

english: So do you want to respawn in Edgeville infuture?

english: For many years I used my position to fight against the crime and corruption in this city. No matter what I did it was never enough though. I realised that to defeat my enemies I needed to act as they do.
translation: 多年来，我利用自己的职位与这座城市的犯罪和腐败作斗争。但无论我做什么都还不够。我意识到，要打败我的敌人，我需要像他们一样行事。 [duo nian lai ， wo li yong zi ji de zhi wei yu zhe zuo cheng shi de fan zui he fu bai zuo dou zheng 。 dan wu lun wo zuo shen me dou hai bu gou 。 wo yi shi dao ， yao da bai wo de di ren ， wo xu yao xiang ta men yi yang xing shi 。]

english: That's why I formed the Saviours of Kourend. We take the laws into our own hands and fight against all who would damage this city, no matter who they are.
translation: 这就是我组建库伦德救世主的原因。我们将法律掌握在自己手中，并与所有破坏这座城市的人作斗争，无论他们是谁。 [zhe jiu shi wo zu jian ku lun de jiu shi zhu de yuan yin 。 wo men jiang fa lv zhang wo zai zi ji shou zhong ， bing yu suo you po huai zhe zuo cheng shi de ren zuo dou zheng ， wu lun ta men shi shui 。]

english: Port Piscarilius is home to Kourend's fishermen and traders. We are the first port of call for any visitors to Kourend which means Port Piscarilius is home to a wide variety of individuals.
translation: 皮斯卡利留斯港是库伦德渔民和商人的家园。我们是任何游客到库伦德的第一个停靠港，这意味着皮斯卡利留斯港是各种各样的人的家园。 [pi si ka li liu si gang shi ku lun de yu min he shang ren de jia yuan 。 wo men shi ren he you ke dao ku lun de de di yi ge ting kao gang ， zhe yi wei zhe pi si ka li liu si gang shi ge zhong ge yang de ren de jia yuan 。]

english: All people and goods coming to or from Kourend go through Port Piscarilius. This unfortunatly means that we are a centre point for the majority of crime within the city.

english: For many years I appealed to the Kourend Council for help in fighting this crime, but they cared little for us. Instead, I decided to beat them at their own game and fight fire with fire.
translation: 多年来，我一直向库伦德委员会请求帮助打击这一犯罪行为，但他们对我们漠不关心。相反，我决定在他们自己的游戏中击败他们，并以毒攻毒。 [duo nian lai ， wo yi zhi xiang ku lun de wei yuan hui qing qiu bang zhu da ji zhe yi fan zui xing wei ， dan ta men dui wo men mo bu guan xin 。 xiang fan ， wo jue ding zai ta men zi ji de you xi zhong ji bai ta men ， bing yi du gong du 。]

english: Lovakengj is a city of dwarves. It's the only non-human city in Kourend.
translation: 洛瓦肯吉是一座矮人之城。它是库伦德唯一的非人类城市。 [luo wa ken ji shi yi zuo ai ren zhi cheng 。 ta shi ku lun de wei yi de fei ren lei cheng shi 。]

english: Lovakengj is very important you know. The resources mined here are used throughout the kingdom. Weapons, armour, tools, buildings...
translation: 你知道，Lovakenj 非常重要。这里开采的资源用于整个王国。武器、盔甲、工具、建筑…… [ni zhi dao ，Lovakenj  fei chang zhong yao 。 zhe li kai cai de zi yuan yong yu zheng ge wang guo 。 wu qi 、 kui jia 、 gong ju 、 jian zhu ……]

english: All sorts of things come out of Lovakengj.

english: Hello, I'm Laidee. Welcome to the Warriors' Guild.
translation: 你好，我是莱迪。欢迎来到勇士公会。 [ni hao ， wo shi lai di 。 huan ying lai dao yong shi gong hui 。]

english: What are you doing out here?
translation: 你在这儿做什么？ [ni zai zhe er zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm here to guard the Warrior's Guild and determine who's qualified to enter.
