english: So you're Ghommal's replacement?
translation: 所以你是戈马尔的替代者？ [suo yi ni shi ge ma er de ti dai zhe ？]

english: That I am. Ghommal and I used to adventure together before we joined the Guild. It felt only right that I take over from him. It is... strange not having him around.
translation: 我就是这样。在加入公会之前，戈马尔和我经常一起冒险。我感觉由我接替他是正确的。没有他在身边真是……奇怪。 [wo jiu shi zhe yang 。 zai jia ru gong hui zhi qian ， ge ma er he wo jing chang yi qi mao xian 。 wo gan jue you wo jie ti ta shi zheng que de 。 mei you ta zai shen bian zhen shi …… qi guai 。]

english: I'm sorry for your loss. He was a great warrior.
translation: 我对你的损失感到抱歉。他是一位伟大的战士。 [wo dui ni de sun shi gan dao bao qian 。 ta shi yi wei wei da de zhan shi 。]

english: And an even greater friend.
translation: 还有一个更伟大的朋友。 [hai you yi ge geng wei da de peng you 。]

english: I'm here to talk about Combat Achievements.
translation: 我是来谈谈战斗成就的。 [wo shi lai tan tan zhan dou cheng jiu de 。]

english: Could you explain what they are?
translation: 你能解释一下它们是什么吗？ [ni neng jie shi yi xia ta men shi shen me ma ？]

english: Combat Achievements are a set of tasks for all adventurers to try and accomplish. They range from simple missions to kill various creatures, to challenges that will push you to your limits.
translation: 战斗成就是所有冒险家都需要尝试并完成的一组任务。它们的范围从杀死各种生物的简单任务到将你推向极限的挑战。 [zhan dou cheng jiu shi suo you mao xian jia dou xu yao chang shi bing wan cheng de yi zu ren wu 。 ta men de fan wei cong sha si ge zhong sheng wu de jian dan ren wu dao jiang ni tui xiang ji xian de tiao zhan 。]

english: The purpose of these tasks is for you to grow and improve, experience all that Gielinor has to offer, and become stronger in the process.
translation: 这些任务的目的是让你成长和进步，体验 Gielinor 所提供的一切，并在这个过程中变得更强。 [zhe xie ren wu de mu di shi rang ni cheng zhang he jin bu ， ti yan  Gielinor  suo ti gong de yi qie ， bing zai zhe ge guo cheng zhong bian de geng qiang 。]

english: Is this something that sounds interesting to you?
translation: 这对你来说听起来很有趣吗？ [zhe dui ni lai shuo ting qi lai hen you qu ma ？]

english: Yes, tell me about Combat Achievements.
translation: 是的，请告诉我有关战斗成就的信息。 [shi de ， qing gao su wo you guan zhan dou cheng jiu de xin xi 。]

english: Combat Achievements are broken down into six tiers: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite, Master and Grandmaster.
translation: 战斗成就分为六个等级：简单、中等、困难、精英、大师和宗师。 [zhan dou cheng jiu fen wei liu ge deng ji ： jian dan 、 zhong deng 、 kun nan 、 jing ying 、 da shi he zong shi 。]

english: As you complete tasks, you'll earn points. Tasks in higher tiers give more points than easier tasks. Your rank depends on how many points you've earned.
translation: 完成任务后，您将获得积分。较高级别的任务比较简单的任务可以获得更多积分。您的排名取决于您获得的积分数量。 [wan cheng ren wu hou ， nin jiang huo de ji fen 。 jiao gao ji bie de ren wu bi jiao jian dan de ren wu ke yi huo de geng duo ji fen 。 nin de pai ming qu jue yu nin huo de de ji fen shu liang 。]

english: Whenever new tasks are added to the list, there are more points available to earn, so the threshold needed for each rank will increase. Keep completing tasks to maintain your rank!
translation: 每当列表中添加新任务时，可以获得更多积分，因此每个等级所需的门槛也会增加。不断完成任务来保持你的排名！ [mei dang lie biao zhong tian jia xin ren wu shi ， ke yi huo de geng duo ji fen ， yin ci mei ge deng ji suo xu de men kan ye hui zeng jia 。 bu duan wan cheng ren wu lai bao chi ni de pai ming ！]

english: I'd recommend you go kill some monsters. Come back to me when you've completed a tier or two. I'll reward you for your efforts.
translation: 我建议你去杀一些怪物。当你完成一两级后回来找我。我会奖励你的努力。 [wo jian yi ni qu sha yi xie guai wu 。 dang ni wan cheng yi liang ji hou hui lai zhao wo 。 wo hui jiang li ni de nu li 。]

english: Actually, I'm not after your golden apples. I was wondering if I could have some golden wool; I need it to string a lyre.
translation: 事实上，我并不是在追求你的金苹果。我想知道是否可以得到一些金色的羊毛；我需要它来给竖琴上弦。 [shi shi shang ， wo bing bu shi zai zhui qiu ni de jin ping guo 。 wo xiang zhi dao shi fou ke yi de dao yi xie jin se de yang mao ； wo xu yao ta lai gei shu qin shang xian 。]

english: Ha! You not fool me human! Me am smart! Other trolls so jealous of how brainy I are, they kick me out of camp and make me live down here in cave! But me have last funny!
translation: 哈!你别骗我人类！我很聪明！其他巨魔非常嫉妒我的聪明才智，他们把我踢出营地，让我住在下面的山洞里！但我还有最后的搞笑！ [ha ! ni bie pian wo ren lei ！ wo hen cong ming ！ qi ta ju mo fei chang ji du wo de cong ming cai zhi ， ta men ba wo ti chu ying di ， rang wo zhu zai xia mian de shan dong li ！ dan wo hai you zui hou de gao xiao ！]

english: Me find golden apples on tree and me build wall to stop anyone who not Lalli eating lovely golden apples! Did me not tell you I are smart?
translation: 我在树上找到了金苹果，我筑起围墙来阻止除了拉利之外的任何人吃可爱的金苹果！我不是告诉过你我很聪明吗？ [wo zai shu shang zhao dao le jin ping guo ， wo zhu qi wei qiang lai zu zhi chu le la li zhi wai de ren he ren chi ke ai de jin ping guo ！ wo bu shi gao su guo ni wo hen cong ming ma ？]

english: Yes, yes, you are incredibly clever. Now please can I have some golden wool?
translation: 是的，是的，你非常聪明。现在可以给我一些金色的羊毛吗？ [shi de ， shi de ， ni fei chang cong ming 。 xian zai ke yi gei wo yi xie jin se de yang mao ma ？]

english: Hum, me think you not really think I are clever. Me think you is trying trick Lalli. Me not like you as much as other human. He give me present. I give him wool.
translation: 嗯，我想你并不是真的认为我很聪明。我认为你在尝试欺骗拉利。我不像其他人那样喜欢你。他给我礼物。我给他羊毛。 [n ， wo xiang ni bing bu shi zhen de ren wei wo hen cong ming 。 wo ren wei ni zai chang shi qi pian la li 。 wo bu xiang qi ta ren na yang xi huan ni 。 ta gei wo li wu 。 wo gei ta yang mao 。]

english: Other human? You mean someone else has been there and you gave them wool?
translation: 其他人类？你的意思是其他人去过那里，你给了他们羊毛？ [qi ta ren lei ？ ni de yi si shi qi ta ren qu guo na li ， ni gei le ta men yang mao ？]

english: Human call itself Askeladden! It not trick Lalli, Lalli do good deal with human! Stupid human get some dumb wool, but did not get golden apples!
translation: 人类称自己为阿斯凯拉登！这不是欺骗拉利，拉利与人类打交道很好！愚蠢的人类得到了一些愚蠢的羊毛，却没有得到金苹果！ [ren lei cheng zi ji wei a si kai la deng ！ zhe bu shi qi pian la li ， la li yu ren lei da jiao dao hen hao ！ yu chun de ren lei de dao le yi xie yu chun de yang mao ， que mei you de dao jin ping guo ！]

english: I see... okay, well, bye!
translation: 我明白了……好吧，好吧，再见！ [wo ming bai le …… hao ba ， hao ba ， zai jian ！]

english: No, honest, you're REALLY clever. Why, I could not contemplate a mere chicanery with an advanced intellect such as you currently present.
translation: 不，老实说，你真的很聪明。为什么，我无法考虑像你现在这样具有先进智慧的纯粹的欺骗行为。 [bu ， lao shi shuo ， ni zhen de hen cong ming 。 wei shen me ， wo wu fa kao lv xiang ni xian zai zhe yang ju you xian jin zhi hui de chun cui de qi pian xing wei 。]

english: Grrr! Why you insult me stupid human? Me know it are because you jealous of Lalli's huge brain and you try steal apples!
translation: 咕噜！为什么你要侮辱我这个愚蠢的人类？我知道这是因为你嫉妒拉利的巨大大脑而试图偷苹果！ [gu lu ！ wei shen me ni yao wu ru wo zhe ge yu chun de ren lei ？ wo zhi dao zhe shi yin wei ni ji du la li de ju da da nao er shi tu tou ping guo ！]

english: Can I give you a present? Or maybe exchange you something for some wool?
translation: 我可以送你一件礼物吗？或者也许可以用一些东西换一些羊毛？ [wo ke yi song ni yi jian li wu ma ？ huo zhe ye xu ke yi yong yi xie dong xi huan yi xie yang mao ？]

english: Ha! You stupid human! You think you trick Lalli? Me know you want my golden apples Well! You not get them! HAHAHA!
translation: 哈!你这个愚蠢的人类！你认为你欺骗了拉利？我知道你想要我的金苹果 好吧！你得不到它们！哈哈哈！ [ha ! ni zhe ge yu chun de ren lei ！ ni ren wei ni qi pian le la li ？ wo zhi dao ni xiang yao wo de jin ping guo   hao ba ！ ni de bu dao ta men ！ ha ha ha ！]

english: Erm... okay then.
translation: 呃……好吧。 [e …… hao ba 。]

english: Wait! I have something that might interest you... a pet rock!
translation: 等待！我有一些你可能感兴趣的东西……一块宠物石头！ [deng dai ！ wo you yi xie ni ke neng gan xing qu de dong xi …… yi kuai chong wu shi tou ！]

english: Hah! You think me stupid or something human? Me already got one! Me don't want lotta baby rocks either, so me don't want another one around the place!
translation: 哈！你认为我是愚蠢的还是人类？我已经有一个了！我也不想要很多婴儿摇滚，所以我不想在这个地方再放一个！ [ha ！ ni ren wei wo shi yu chun de hai shi ren lei ？ wo yi jing you yi ge le ！ wo ye bu xiang yao hen duo ying er yao gun ， suo yi wo bu xiang zai zhe ge di fang zai fang yi ge ！]

english: Please... all I want is some of your golden wool...
translation: 拜托...我想要的只是你的一些金色羊毛... [bai tuo ... wo xiang yao de zhi shi ni de yi xie jin se yang mao ...]

english: Stupid human think he can trick me into giving away some golden apples! Hah! Golden apples is all me got to eat, you not get them, no way!
translation: 愚蠢的人类以为他可以骗我送一些金苹果！哈！我只能吃金苹果，你不吃，不行！ [yu chun de ren lei yi wei ta ke yi pian wo song yi xie jin ping guo ！ ha ！ wo zhi neng chi jin ping guo ， ni bu chi ， bu xing ！]

english: Hmm... So you're hungry? I think I will have the perfect thing for you to eat... I just need to get myself an onion, a potato and a cabbage...
translation: 嗯……所以你饿了？我想我会有完美的东西给你吃......我只需要给自己买一个洋葱，一个土豆和一个卷心菜...... [n …… suo yi ni e le ？ wo xiang wo hui you wan mei de dong xi gei ni chi ...... wo zhi xu yao gei zi ji mai yi ge yang cong ， yi ge tu dou he yi ge juan xin cai ......]

english: Unless you got tasty food for Lalli. Then I might trade you for it.
translation: 除非你给拉利准备了美味的食物。那我可能会用你来交换。 [chu fei ni gei la li zhun bei le mei wei de shi wu 。 na wo ke neng hui yong ni lai jiao huan 。]

english: As a matter of fact I do!
translation: 事实上我就是这么做的！ [shi shi shang wo jiu shi zhe me zuo de ！]

english: So tell me, Lalli. Have you ever tried a human delicacy known as stone soup?
translation: 所以告诉我吧，拉利。你尝过一种被称为“石头汤”的人类美食吗？ [suo yi gao su wo ba ， la li 。 ni chang guo yi zhong bei cheng wei “ shi tou tang ” de ren lei mei shi ma ？]

english: What? Me am not stupid human! Everyone know cannot make food from stone!
translation: 什么？我不是愚蠢的人类！大家都知道石头不能做食物！ [shen me ？ wo bu shi yu chun de ren lei ！ da jia dou zhi dao shi tou bu neng zuo shi wu ！]

english: Well, that is where you are wrong. I will now put this rock, into your cauldron over there, and make soup from it.
translation: 嗯，这就是你错的地方。我现在就把这块石头放进你那边的大锅里，用它做汤。 [n ， zhe jiu shi ni cuo de di fang 。 wo xian zai jiu ba zhe kuai shi tou fang jin ni na bian de da guo li ， yong ta zuo tang 。]

english: Why you need other stuff too then?
translation: 那为什么你还需要其他东西呢？ [na wei shen me ni hai xu yao qi ta dong xi ne ？]

english: Ah, that is simply seasoning. Stone soup is delicious by itself, but the taste is really brought out if you use onion, potato and cabbage too.
translation: 啊，那只是调味料。石头汤本身就很美味，但如果加上洋葱、土豆和卷心菜，味道就更明显了。 [a ， na zhi shi tiao wei liao 。 shi tou tang ben shen jiu hen mei wei ， dan ru guo jia shang yang cong 、 tu dou he juan xin cai ， wei dao jiu geng ming xian le 。]

english: Me have to try this! Me will swap you your wool if you not trick me and really can make soup out of a stone.
translation: 我必须尝试这个！如果你不骗我，而且真的会石头做汤，我就把你的羊毛换给你。 [wo bi xu chang shi zhe ge ！ ru guo ni bu pian wo ， er qie zhen de hui shi tou zuo tang ， wo jiu ba ni de yang mao huan gei ni 。]

english: Actually I don't...
translation: 其实我不... [qi shi wo bu ...]

english: Hah! Me knew it! You human just try trick Lalli into giving away golden apple! Me not as stupid as you look!
translation: 哈！我就知道！你们这些人类就试试骗拉利送出金苹果吧！我可没你看上去那么傻！ [ha ！ wo jiu zhi dao ！ ni men zhe xie ren lei jiu shi shi pian la li song chu jin ping guo ba ！ wo ke mei ni kan shang qu na me sha ！]

english: It am ready now?
translation: 现在准备好了吗？ [xian zai zhun bei hao le ma ？]

english: Not just yet...
translation: 还没有... [hai mei you ...]

english: Indeed it is. Try it and see.
translation: 确实如此。尝试一下看看。 [que shi ru ci 。 chang shi yi xia kan kan 。]

english: Hmm... YUM! That are delicious! Me never know human know to make soup out of stone? It some special stone?
translation: 嗯...嗯！那真好吃！我从来不知道人类会用石头做汤？是一些特殊的石头吗？ [n ... n ！ na zhen hao chi ！ wo cong lai bu zhi dao ren lei hui yong shi tou zuo tang ？ shi yi xie te shu de shi tou ma ？]

english: Indeed it is. But I'm willing to trade it.
translation: 确实如此。但我愿意用它来交换。 [que shi ru ci 。 dan wo yuan yi yong ta lai jiao huan 。]

english: Let me think about that, me like to think.
translation: 让我想想，我喜欢思考。 [rang wo xiang xiang ， wo xi huan si kao 。]

english: Your soup very tasty, human! But me still not want trade golden apples for your stone. Me think pet rock get jealous.
translation: 你的汤非常美味，人类！但我还是不想用金苹果换你的石头。我认为宠物摇滚会嫉妒。 [ni de tang fei chang mei wei ， ren lei ！ dan wo hai shi bu xiang yong jin ping guo huan ni de shi tou 。 wo ren wei chong wu yao gun hui ji du 。]

english: I. DON'T. WANT. ANY. GOLDEN. APPLES. ALL. I. WANT. IS. A. GOLDEN. FLEECE.
translation: 我，不。想。任何。金的。苹果。全部。我想。是。 A. 金色。羊毛。 [wo ， bu 。 xiang 。 ren he 。 jin de 。 ping guo 。 quan bu 。 wo xiang 。 shi 。 A.  jin se 。 yang mao 。]

english: Gee, sorry human, all you have do is ask, me not need you to shout. You act like you think Lalli am stupid or something...
translation: 哎呀，对不起人类，你所要做的就是问，我不需要你喊。你表现得好像你认为拉利是个傻子什么的…… [ai ya ， dui bu qi ren lei ， ni suo yao zuo de jiu shi wen ， wo bu xu yao ni han 。 ni biao xian de hao xiang ni ren wei la li shi ge sha zi shen me de ……]

english: Here you go. Hah! Me trick you human! All you got is worthless golden fleece! Me got very rare soup-making stone!
translation: 干得好。哈！我欺骗你这个人类！你得到的只是一文不值的金羊毛！我得到了非常稀有的熬汤石！ [gan de hao 。 ha ！ wo qi pian ni zhe ge ren lei ！ ni de dao de zhi shi yi wen bu zhi de jin yang mao ！ wo de dao le fei chang xi you de ao tang shi ！]

english: Glad you're happy Lalli!
translation: 很高兴你快乐拉利！ [hen gao xing ni kuai le la li ！]

english: Me would give you golden fleece if me think you have enough room in your invetinary.
translation: 如果我认为你的投资有足够的空间，我会给你金羊毛。 [ru guo wo ren wei ni de tou zi you zu gou de kong jian ， wo hui gei ni jin yang mao 。]

english: Ha! Stupid human! You no get any golden apples! Even though me much like stone soup!
translation: 哈!愚蠢的人类！你得不到任何金苹果！虽然我很喜欢石头汤！ [ha ! yu chun de ren lei ！ ni de bu dao ren he jin ping guo ！ sui ran wo hen xi huan shi tou tang ！]

english: Can I please have some more golden wool?
translation: 可以再给我一些金色的羊毛吗？ [ke yi zai gei wo yi xie jin se de yang mao ma ？]

english: Me will sell you some golden wool, but me not sell you any golden apples!
translation: 我会卖给你一些金羊毛，但我不会卖给你金苹果！ [wo hui mai gei ni yi xie jin yang mao ， dan wo bu hui mai gei ni jin ping guo ！]

english: How much for the golden wool?
translation: 金色羊毛要多少钱？ [jin se yang mao yao duo shao qian ？]

english: Me want 1000 coins! You pay or go!
translation: 我要1000金币！你要么付钱，要么走！ [wo yao 1000 jin bi ！ ni yao me fu qian ， yao me zou ！]

english: Is that all? Here you go!
translation: 这就是全部吗？干得好！ [zhe jiu shi quan bu ma ？ gan de hao ！]

english: Ha! Stupid human think he buy golden apples, but actually get stupid wool! Hahaha!
translation: 哈!愚蠢的人类以为自己买了金苹果，实际上却得到了愚蠢的羊毛！哈哈哈！ [ha ! yu chun de ren lei yi wei zi ji mai le jin ping guo ， shi ji shang que de dao le yu chun de yang mao ！ ha ha ha ！]

english: I don't have that much cash on me...
translation: 我身上没有那么多现金... [wo shen shang mei you na me duo xian jin ...]

english: Well stupid bad trade human don't get no wool then! Or any golden apples!
translation: 那么愚蠢的坏贸易人类就得不到羊毛了！或者任何金苹果！ [na me yu chun de huai mao yi ren lei jiu de bu dao yang mao le ！ huo zhe ren he jin ping guo ！]

english: You no pay, then you go! You no get any golden apples!
translation: 不给钱你就走吧！你得不到任何金苹果！ [bu gei qian ni jiu zou ba ！ ni de bu dao ren he jin ping guo ！]

english: Hey human! You not go back on deal! Me know you stupid at trades but that stone mine now! All soup mine!
translation: 嘿人类！你不能反悔协议！我知道你在交易方面很愚蠢，但现在那块石头是我的！都是我的汤！ [hei ren lei ！ ni bu neng fan hui xie yi ！ wo zhi dao ni zai jiao yi fang mian hen yu chun ， dan xian zai na kuai shi tou shi wo de ！ dou shi wo de tang ！]

english: Other human?
translation: 其他人类？ [qi ta ren lei ？]

english: No, honest, you're REALLY clever.
translation: 不，老实说，你真的很聪明。 [bu ， lao shi shuo ， ni zhen de hen cong ming 。]

english: Can I give you a present?
translation: 我可以送你一件礼物吗？ [wo ke yi song ni yi jian li wu ma ？]

english: Pay
translation: 支付 [zhi fu]

english: Don't pay
translation: 不付钱 [bu fu qian]

english: Are you a member of the Group of Advanced Gardeners?
translation: 您是高级园丁小组的成员吗？ [nin shi gao ji yuan ding xiao zu de cheng yuan ma ？]

english: Why, yes I am. Why do you ask?
translation: 为什么，是的，我是。你为什么问？ [wei shen me ， shi de ， wo shi 。 ni wei shen me wen ？]

english: Martin has asked me to investigate why all the crops are failing.
translation: 马丁让我调查为什么所有庄稼都歉收。 [ma ding rang wo diao cha wei shen me suo you zhuang jia dou qian shou 。]

english: No, I'm afraid I don't know anything about that.
translation: 不，恐怕我对此一无所知。 [bu ， kong pa wo dui ci yi wu suo zhi 。]

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
translation: 你愿意帮我照料我的庄稼吗？ [ni yuan yi bang wo zhao liao wo de zhuang jia ma ？]

english: You don't have a sapling planted in that patch. Plant one and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: 你那块地里没有种树苗。种一棵，我可能会同意帮你照顾它。 [ni na kuai di li mei you zhong shu miao 。 zhong yi ke ， wo ke neng hui tong yi bang ni zhao gu ta 。]

english: That patch is already fully grown! I don't know what you want me to do with it!
translation: 那块补丁已经完全长大了！我不知道你想让我用它做什么！ [na kuai bu ding yi jing wan quan zhang da le ！ wo bu zhi dao ni xiang rang wo yong ta zuo shen me ！]

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 你能给我一些农业建议吗？ [ni neng gei wo yi xie nong ye jian yi ma ？]

english: Can you sell me something?
translation: 你能卖给我东西吗？ [ni neng mai gei wo dong xi ma ？]

english: That depends on whether I have it to sell. What is it that you're looking for?
translation: 这取决于我是否有它可以卖。您在寻找什么？ [zhe qu jue yu wo shi fou you ta ke yi mai 。 nin zai xun zhao shen me ？]

english: I'll come back another time.
translation: 我下次再来。 [wo xia ci zai lai 。]

english: I'm too busy with my crops to work on this! Please solve it for me.
translation: 我忙着种庄稼，无暇做这件事！请帮我解决一下。 [wo mang zhe zhong zhuang jia ， wu xia zuo zhe jian shi ！ qing bang wo jie jue yi xia 。]

english: Lammy Langle has given you a puzzle box!
translation: 拉米·兰格尔给了你一个拼图盒！ [la mi · lan ge er gei le ni yi ge pin tu he ！]

english: Sorry but you haven't solved the puzzle yet.
translation: 抱歉，您还没有解决这个难题。 [bao qian ， nin hai mei you jie jue zhe ge nan ti 。]

english: Thanks [player name]!
translation: 谢谢[玩家姓名]！ [xie xie [ wan jia xing ming ]！]

english: Lammy Langle has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 拉米·兰格尔给了你另一条线索卷轴！ [la mi · lan ge er gei le ni ling yi tiao xian suo juan zhou ！]

english: Are you a member of the Group of Advanced Gardeners?
translation: 您是高级园丁小组的成员吗？ [nin shi gao ji yuan ding xiao zu de cheng yuan ma ？]

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
translation: 你愿意帮我照料我的庄稼吗？ [ni yuan yi bang wo zhao liao wo de zhuang jia ma ？]

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 你能给我一些农业建议吗？ [ni neng gei wo yi xie nong ye jian yi ma ？]

english: Can you sell me something?
translation: 你能卖给我东西吗？ [ni neng mai gei wo dong xi ma ？]

english: I'll come back another time.
translation: 我下次再来。 [wo xia ci zai lai 。]

english: What d'ya want?
translation: 你想要什么？ [ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Just exploring the far reaches of this wonderful land.
translation: 只是探索这片美妙土地的遥远角落。 [zhi shi tan suo zhe pian mei miao tu di de yao yuan jiao luo 。]

english: Why?
translation: 为什么？ [wei shen me ？]

english: For gold! For glory!
translation: 为了黄金！为了荣耀！ [wei le huang jin ！ wei le rong yao ！]

english: You got gold?
translation: 你有金子吗？ [ni you jin zi ma ？]

english: Maybe a little...
translation: 也许有一点... [ye xu you yi dian ...]

english: Well, I'm a butcher, I'll be 'appy to perhaps trade you, that I would.
translation: 好吧，我是个屠夫，我很乐意也许可以交易你，我愿意。 [hao ba ， wo shi ge tu fu ， wo hen le yi ye xu ke yi jiao yi ni ， wo yuan yi 。]

english: I don't see any product around here...
translation: 我在这里没有看到任何产品... [wo zai zhe li mei you kan dao ren he chan pin ...]

english: Heh, o' course not. I keep it down in the basement, that I do.
translation: 呵呵，当然不是。我把它放在地下室里，我确实这么做了。 [he he ， dang ran bu shi 。 wo ba ta fang zai di xia shi li ， wo que shi zhe me zuo le 。]

english: What basement?
translation: 什么地下室？ [shen me di xia shi ？]

english: I think I'll be leaving now.
translation: 我想我现在就要走了。 [wo xiang wo xian zai jiu yao zou le 。]

english: Heh heh heh, that you should.
translation: 哈哈哈哈，你应该这样。 [ha ha ha ha ， ni ying gai zhe yang 。]

english: Good day, how may I help you?
translation: 美好的一天，我能为您做些什么吗？ [mei hao de yi tian ， wo neng wei nin zuo xie shen me ma ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This is the great Castle Wars arena! Here you can fight for the glory of Saradomin or Zamorak.
translation: 这就是伟大的城堡战争竞技场！在这里你可以为萨拉多明或萨莫拉克的荣耀而战。 [zhe jiu shi wei da de cheng bao zhan zheng jing ji chang ！ zai zhe li ni ke yi wei sa la duo ming huo sa mo la ke de rong yao er zhan 。]

english: Really, how do I do that?
translation: 真的，我该怎么做呢？ [zhen de ， wo gai zen me zuo ne ？]

english: Easy, you just step through one of the three portals. To join Zamorak, pass through the red portal. To join Saradomin, pass through the blue portal. If you don't mind then pass through the green portal.
translation: 很简单，您只需穿过三个门户之一即可。要加入萨莫拉克，请穿过红色传送门。要加入萨拉多明，请穿过蓝色传送门。如果您不介意，请通过绿色门户。 [hen jian dan ， nin zhi xu chuan guo san ge men hu zhi yi ji ke 。 yao jia ru sa mo la ke ， qing chuan guo hong se chuan song men 。 yao jia ru sa la duo ming ， qing chuan guo lan se chuan song men 。 ru guo nin bu jie yi ， qing tong guo lv se men hu 。]

english: Are there any rules?
translation: 有什么规则吗？ [you shen me gui ze ma ？]

english: Of course, there are always rules. Firstly you can't wear a cape as you enter the portal, you'll be given your team colours to wear while in the arena. You're also prohibited from taking non-combat related items in with you. So you should only have equipment, potions, and runes on you. Secondly, attacking your own team or your team's defences isn't allowed. You don't want to be angering your patron god, do you? Other than that, just have fun and enjoy it!
translation: 当然，总是有规则的。首先，当你进入门户时，你不能穿斗篷，你会在竞技场中获得你的团队颜色。您还被禁止携带与战斗无关的物品。所以你身上应该只有装备、药剂和符文。其次，不允许攻击自己的球队或球队的防守。你不想激怒你的守护神吧？除此之外，只要玩得开心并享受它！ [dang ran ， zong shi you gui ze de 。 shou xian ， dang ni jin ru men hu shi ， ni bu neng chuan dou peng ， ni hui zai jing ji chang zhong huo de ni de tuan dui yan se 。 nin hai bei jin zhi xie dai yu zhan dou wu guan de wu pin 。 suo yi ni shen shang ying gai zhi you zhuang bei 、 yao ji he fu wen 。 qi ci ， bu yun xu gong ji zi ji de qiu dui huo qiu dui de fang shou 。 ni bu xiang ji nu ni de shou hu shen ba ？ chu ci zhi wai ， zhi yao wan de kai xin bing xiang shou ta ！]

english: Great! Oh, how do I win the game?
translation: 伟大的！哦，我怎样才能赢得比赛呢？ [wei da de ！ o ， wo zen yang cai neng ying de bi sai ne ？]

english: The aim is to get into your opponents' castle and take their team standard. Then bring that back and capture it on your team's standard.
translation: 目的是进入对手的城堡并采取他们的团队标准。然后将其带回来并按照您团队的标准捕获它。 [mu di shi jin ru dui shou de cheng bao bing cai qu ta men de tuan dui biao zhun 。 ran hou jiang qi dai hui lai bing an zhao nin tuan dui de biao zhun bu huo ta 。]

english: What can I win?
translation: 我能赢得什么？ [wo neng ying de shen me ？]

english: Players on the winning team will receive 2 Castle Wars Tickets which you can trade back to me for other items. In the event of a draw every player will get 1 ticket.
translation: 获胜队伍的玩家将收到 2 张城堡战争门票，您可以将其兑换给我以换取其他物品。如果出现平局，每位玩家将获得 1 张门票。 [huo sheng dui wu de wan jia jiang shou dao  2  zhang cheng bao zhan zheng men piao ， nin ke yi jiang qi dui huan gei wo yi huan qu qi ta wu pin 。 ru guo chu xian ping ju ， mei wei wan jia jiang huo de  1  zhang men piao 。]

english: Take a look at this dead chicken I've got.
translation: 看看我手里的这只死鸡。 [kan kan wo shou li de zhe zhi si ji 。]

english: ... I'm looking at the dead chicken. Why am I looking at the dead chicken?
translation: ……我正在看着那只死鸡。我为什么要看着死鸡？ […… wo zheng zai kan zhe na zhi si ji 。 wo wei shen me yao kan zhe si ji ？]

english: It's a special device, invented by a friend of mine. If I'm wearing it while ranging, it uses magnets to retrieve some of my ammunition.
translation: 这是一种特殊的装置，是我的一个朋友发明的。如果我在测距时佩戴它，它会使用磁铁来回收我的一些弹药。 [zhe shi yi zhong te shu de zhuang zhi ， shi wo de yi ge peng you fa ming de 。 ru guo wo zai ce ju shi pei dai ta ， ta hui shi yong ci tie lai hui shou wo de yi xie dan yao 。]

english: Oh. Gosh. That's clever. So are you wanting to take it into Castle Wars? The gods expect people to fight in the team capes.
translation: 哦。天哪。这很聪明。那么你想把它带入城堡战争吗？诸神期望人们穿着团队斗篷战斗。 [o 。 tian na 。 zhe hen cong ming 。 na me ni xiang ba ta dai ru cheng bao zhan zheng ma ？ zhu shen qi wang ren men chuan zhe tuan dui dou peng zhan dou 。]

english: Can they be a bit more flexible, please?
translation: 请问他们可以更灵活一点吗？ [qing wen ta men ke yi geng ling huo yi dian ma ？]

english: I'll ask. Hold on a minute...
translation: 我会问。等一下... [wo hui wen 。 deng yi xia ...]

english: ... (Lanthus communes with the gods.)
translation: ...（兰瑟斯与众神交流。） [...（ lan se si yu zhong shen jiao liu 。）]

english: The gods say they'll protect your ammunition in the same way that the chicken would, while you're fighting in Castle Wars. You won't need to wear the chicken here.
translation: 诸神说，当你在城堡战争中战斗时，他们会像鸡一样保护你的弹药。你不需要在这里戴鸡肉。 [zhu shen shuo ， dang ni zai cheng bao zhan zheng zhong zhan dou shi ， ta men hui xiang ji yi yang bao hu ni de dan yao 。 ni bu xu yao zai zhe li dai ji rou 。]

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: I remember you! You showed me this dead chicken device before, but this one is better is it!?
translation: 我记得你！你之前给我看过这个死鸡装置，但是这个更好不是吗！？ [wo ji de ni ！ ni zhi qian gei wo kan guo zhe ge si ji zhuang zhi ， dan shi zhe ge geng hao bu shi ma ！？]

english: That's right!
translation: 这是正确的！ [zhe shi zheng que de ！]

english: Hold on...
translation: 坚持，稍等... [jian chi ， shao deng ...]

english: The gods say they'll protect your ammunition in the same way that this better chicken would, while you're fighting in Castle Wars.
translation: 诸神说，当你在城堡战争中战斗时，他们会像这只更好的鸡一样保护你的弹药。 [zhu shen shuo ， dang ni zai cheng bao zhan zheng zhong zhan dou shi ， ta men hui xiang zhe zhi geng hao de ji yi yang bao hu ni de dan yao 。]

english: I remember you. You said your dead chicken could help you save ammunition. The gods agreed that you could have the same bonus in Castle Wars without needing to wear the chicken.
translation: 我记得你。你说你的死鸡可以帮你节省弹药。众神同意你可以在城堡战争中获得相同的奖励，而无需佩戴鸡。 [wo ji de ni 。 ni shuo ni de si ji ke yi bang ni jie sheng dan yao 。 zhong shen tong yi ni ke yi zai cheng bao zhan zheng zhong huo de xiang tong de jiang li ， er wu xu pei dai ji 。]

english: Yes, that's right.
translation: 是的，没错。 [shi de ， mei cuo 。]

english: So you don't need to keep showing me the dead chicken, do you? Take it away!
translation: 所以你不需要一直给我看那只死鸡，是吗？把它拿走！ [suo yi ni bu xu yao yi zhi gei wo kan na zhi si ji ， shi ma ？ ba ta na zou ！]

english: Do you have a manual? I'd like to learn how to play!
translation: 你有手册吗？我想学习怎么玩！ [ni you shou ce ma ？ wo xiang xue xi zen me wan ！]

english: Sure, here you go.
translation: 当然，给你。 [dang ran ， gei ni 。]

english: Is there something I can do with these bracelets?
translation: 我可以用这些手镯做点什么吗？ [wo ke yi yong zhe xie shou zhuo zuo dian shen me ma ？]

english: Yes, if you're wearing one when you enter a game of Castle Wars, it will use one charge to empower your attacks against flag bearers and give you increased healing from bandages.
translation: 是的，如果你在进入《城堡战争》游戏时佩戴一个，它会使用一次充能来增强你对旗手的攻击，并增加你从绷带中获得的治疗效果。 [shi de ， ru guo ni zai jin ru 《 cheng bao zhan zheng 》 you xi shi pei dai yi ge ， ta hui shi yong yi ci chong neng lai zeng qiang ni dui qi shou de gong ji ， bing zeng jia ni cong beng dai zhong huo de de zhi liao xiao guo 。]

english: Bear in mind that you only need to be wearing it when you enter the game to get the benefit.
translation: 请记住，您只需在进入游戏时佩戴它即可获得福利。 [qing ji zhu ， nin zhi xu zai jin ru you xi shi pei dai ta ji ke huo de fu li 。]

english: If you'd prefer, if you give the bracelet to me, I can grant you the buff instead, but I'll only do it once for each charge you give me.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，如果你把手镯给我，我可以给你增益效果，但你给我的每次费用我只会做一次。 [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， ru guo ni ba shou zhuo gei wo ， wo ke yi gei ni zeng yi xiao guo ， dan ni gei wo de mei ci fei yong wo zhi hui zuo yi ci 。]

english: Just show me the bracelet and I'll take it off your hands.
translation: 只要给我看手镯，我就把它从你手上拿下来。 [zhi yao gei wo kan shou zhuo ， wo jiu ba ta cong ni shou shang na xia lai 。]

english: How many bracelet charges do I have stored?
translation: 我手环里存了多少电量？ [wo shou huan li cun le duo shao dian liang ？]

english: Currently, I'm storing [#] charges for you. If you hand me more bracelets, I can store more charges for you.
translation: 目前，我正在为您存储 [#] 笔费用。如果你给我更多的手镯，我可以为你储存更多的费用。 [mu qian ， wo zheng zai wei nin cun chu  [#]  bi fei yong 。 ru guo ni gei wo geng duo de shou zhuo ， wo ke yi wei ni chu cun geng duo de fei yong 。]

english: Can I stop using my stored bracelet charges?
translation: 我可以停止使用手环中储存的电量吗？ [wo ke yi ting zhi shi yong shou huan zhong chu cun de dian liang ma ？]

english: That seems like a strange thing to ask for, but very well, I'll stop using your stored bracelet charges on you. Talk to me if you want to start using them again.
translation: 这似乎是一个奇怪的要求，但很好，我会停止使用你存储的手镯费用。如果您想再次开始使用它们，请与我联系。 [zhe si hu shi yi ge qi guai de yao qiu ， dan hen hao ， wo hui ting zhi shi yong ni cun chu de shou zhuo fei yong 。 ru guo nin xiang zai ci kai shi shi yong ta men ， qing yu wo lian xi 。]

english: I'd like to use my stored bracelet charges again.
translation: 我想再次使用我存储的手环电量。 [wo xiang zai ci shi yong wo cun chu de shou huan dian liang 。]

english: Ah, that's more like it! Yes, I'll start using your stored bracelet charges on you if you don't have a Castle Wars bracelet equipped when a game starts. Talk to me again if you decide you'd rather not have me do that.
translation: 啊，这更像了！是的，如果您在游戏开始时没有配备《城堡战争》手环，我将开始使用您存储的手环费用。如果您决定不让我这样做，请再次与我交谈。 [a ， zhe geng xiang le ！ shi de ， ru guo nin zai you xi kai shi shi mei you pei bei 《 cheng bao zhan zheng 》 shou huan ， wo jiang kai shi shi yong nin cun chu de shou huan fei yong 。 ru guo nin jue ding bu rang wo zhe yang zuo ， qing zai ci yu wo jiao tan 。]

english: Nothing interesting happens.
translation: 没有什么有趣的事情发生。 [mei you shen me you qu de shi qing fa sheng 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Really, how do I do that?
translation: 真的，我该怎么做呢？ [zhen de ， wo gai zen me zuo ne ？]

english: Are there any rules?
translation: 有什么规则吗？ [you shen me gui ze ma ？]

english: What can I win?
translation: 我能赢得什么？ [wo neng ying de shen me ？]

english: Take a look at this dead chicken I've got.
translation: 看看我手里的这只死鸡。 [kan kan wo shou li de zhe zhi si ji 。]

english: What do you have for trade?
translation: 你有什么可以交易的？ [ni you shen me ke yi jiao yi de ？]

english: Do you have a manual? I'd like to learn how to play!
translation: 你有手册吗？我想学习怎么玩！ [ni you shou ce ma ？ wo xiang xue xi zen me wan ！]

english: Is there something I can do with these bracelets?
translation: 我可以用这些手镯做点什么吗？ [wo ke yi yong zhe xie shou zhuo zuo dian shen me ma ？]

english: How many bracelet charges do I have stored?
translation: 我手环里存了多少电量？ [wo shou huan li cun le duo shao dian liang ？]

english: Can I stop using my stored bracelet charges?
translation: 我可以停止使用手环中储存的电量吗？ [wo ke yi ting zhi shi yong shou huan zhong chu cun de dian liang ma ？]

english: I'd like to use my stored bracelet charges again.
translation: 我想再次使用我存储的手环电量。 [wo xiang zai ci shi yong wo cun chu de shou huan dian liang 。]

english: I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: 我不能和你这个外地人说话！与酋长布伦特交谈！ [wo bu neng he ni zhe ge wai di ren shuo hua ！ yu qiu zhang bu lun te jiao tan ！]

english: You stay away from me outerlander!
translation: 你这个外地人离我远点！ [ni zhe ge wai di ren li wo yuan dian ！]

english: They are too suspicious of you for you to get close enough to steal from them.
translation: 他们对你太怀疑了，你无法靠近他们去偷东西。 [ta men dui ni tai huai yi le ， ni wu fa kao jin ta men qu tou dong xi 。]

english: Hello, are you a member of the council?
translation: 你好，请问你是理事会成员吗？ [ni hao ， qing wen ni shi li shi hui cheng yuan ma ？]

english: I am afraid not outerlander. Goodbye.
translation: 恐怕不是外地人。再见。 [kong pa bu shi wai di ren 。 zai jian 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: 再次你好[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]。今天你需要我做什么？您永远可以信赖我的帮助！ [zai ci ni hao [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 jin tian ni xu yao wo zuo shen me ？ nin yong yuan ke yi xin lai wo de bang zhu ！]

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。我只是想聊聊。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。 wo zhi shi xiang liao liao 。]

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: 如果您需要我的帮助[弗雷曼尼克名字]，我的门永远敞开。 [ru guo nin xu yao wo de bang zhu [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]， wo de men yong yuan chang kai 。]

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: [弗雷曼尼克名字]...我们已经很久没有见面了！ [[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]... wo men yi jing hen jiu mei you jian mian le ！]

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: 欢迎回来[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]。很高兴在这里见到您！ [huan ying hui lai [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 hen gao xing zai zhe li jian dao nin ！]

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: 我很抱歉[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]！我没时间陪你在这里！ [wo hen bao qian [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！ wo mei shi jian pei ni zai zhe li ！]

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
translation: 没关系，我其实什么都不想要。 [mei guan xi ， wo qi shi shen me dou bu xiang yao 。]

english: How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: 你[弗雷曼尼克名字]怎么样？我希望您这一天一切顺利！ [ni [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ] zen me yang ？ wo xi wang nin zhe yi tian yi qie shun li ！]

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
translation: 我很好，谢谢，你好吗？ [wo hen hao ， xie xie ， ni hao ma ？]

english: All is well with me also!
translation: 我也一切都好！ [wo ye yi qie dou hao ！]

english: Hello to you, too!
translation: 也向你问好！ [ye xiang ni wen hao ！]

english: Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你好。你想要什么东西[弗雷曼尼克名字]吗？ [ni hao 。 ni xiang yao shen me dong xi [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ] ma ？]

english: No, not really.
translation: 不，不是真的。 [bu ， bu shi zhen de 。]

english: Well... okay then!
translation: 嗯……那好吧！ [n …… na hao ba ！]

english: Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
translation: 很高兴见到你[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]。 [hen gao xing jian dao ni [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。]

english: You shame us, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你让我们感到羞耻，[弗雷曼尼克名字]！ [ni rang wo men gan dao xiu chi ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！]

english: How can you steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你怎么能偷我的东西，[弗雷曼尼克名字]？ [ni zen me neng tou wo de dong xi ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]？]

english: You have betrayed your heritage, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你背叛了你的传统，[弗雷曼尼克名字]！ [ni bei pan le ni de chuan tong ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！]

english: Why would you try to steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你为什么要偷我的东西，[弗雷曼尼克名字]？ [ni wei shen me yao tou wo de dong xi ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]？]

english: Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
translation: 呜呜呜呜呜呜 [wu wu wu wu wu wu]

english: Do you want something, mortal?
translation: 你想要什么吗，凡人？ [ni xiang yao shen me ma ， fan ren ？]

english: Who are you and why are you here?
translation: 你是谁，为什么在这里？ [ni shi shui ， wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: Once I was a merchant. I worked hard and became wealthy, very wealthy. I was brave too, storing my possessions in two great chests here, where few would dare to interfere with them.
translation: 曾经我是一名商人。我努力工作，变得富有，非常富有。我也很勇敢，把我的财产存放在这里的两个大箱子里，很少有人敢干涉。 [ceng jing wo shi yi ming shang ren 。 wo nu li gong zuo ， bian de fu you ， fei chang fu you 。 wo ye hen yong gan ， ba wo de cai chan cun fang zai zhe li de liang ge da xiang zi li ， hen shao you ren gan gan she 。]

english: But I was not strong enough. One day a witch allied with the pirates of the north; between their strength and her magic, they killed me. The pirates carried one of my chests away to their ship.
translation: 但我还不够坚强。有一天，一位女巫与北方海盗结盟；在他们的力量和她的魔法的帮助下，他们杀了我。海盗们把我的一个箱子搬到了他们的船上。 [dan wo hai bu gou jian qiang 。 you yi tian ， yi wei nv wu yu bei fang hai dao jie meng ； zai ta men de li liang he ta de mo fa de bang zhu xia ， ta men sha le wo 。 hai dao men ba wo de yi ge xiang zi ban dao le ta men de chuan shang 。]

english: I keep vigil here now, as it interests me to watch adventurers come to raid this little chest, whenever they can find one of my keys.
translation: 我现在在这里保持警惕，因为我感兴趣的是看着冒险者来袭击这个小箱子，只要他们能找到我的一把钥匙。 [wo xian zai zai zhe li bao chi jing ti ， yin wei wo gan xing qu de shi kan zhe mao xian zhe lai xi ji zhe ge xiao xiang zi ， zhi yao ta men neng zhao dao wo de yi ba yao shi 。]

english: My bigger chest was taken north to the pirates' ship - a brave adventurer may like to raid that one instead, if they can handle the perils of the north. I kept more wealth in that one.
translation: 我的大箱子被带到了北方的海盗船上——如果勇敢的冒险家能够应对北方的危险，他们可能会想袭击那艘船。我在那里保留了更多的财富。 [wo de da xiang zi bei dai dao le bei fang de hai dao chuan shang —— ru guo yong gan de mao xian jia neng gou ying dui bei fang de wei xian ， ta men ke neng hui xiang xi ji na sou chuan 。 wo zai na li bao liu le geng duo de cai fu 。]

english: I've got your key.
translation: 我有你的钥匙。 [wo you ni de yao shi 。]

english: Well done, adventurer. I have two chests, containing my wealth from the days when I was alive. The smaller one is here, and the bigger one was taken far to the north, to the pirates' ship.
translation: 干得好，冒险家。我有两个箱子，里面装着我生前的财富。较小的一艘在这里，较大的一艘被带到遥远的北方，海盗的船上。 [gan de hao ， mao xian jia 。 wo you liang ge xiang zi ， li mian zhuang zhe wo sheng qian de cai fu 。 jiao xiao de yi sou zai zhe li ， jiao da de yi sou bei dai dao yao yuan de bei fang ， hai dao de chuan shang 。]

english: You can use the key to open either of them. The bigger one, in the pirates' ship, contains more wealth than this small one.
translation: 您可以使用钥匙打开其中一个。海盗船上较大的那艘比这艘小船所载的财富更多。 [nin ke yi shi yong yao shi da kai qi zhong yi ge 。 hai dao chuan shang jiao da de na sou bi zhe sou xiao chuan suo zai de cai fu geng duo 。]

english: Can you give me anything?
translation: 你能给我什么吗？ [ni neng gei wo shen me ma ？]

english: If you want my worldly goods, open my chests with my keys. Adventurers occasionally find my keys while slaying monsters in the Wilderness, on assignment from the witch Krystilia.
translation: 如果你想要我的世俗物品，就用我的钥匙打开我的箱子。冒险家们在接受女巫克里斯蒂莉亚的指派，在荒野中杀死怪物时偶尔会找到我的钥匙。 [ru guo ni xiang yao wo de shi su wu pin ， jiu yong wo de yao shi da kai wo de xiang zi 。 mao xian jia men zai jie shou nv wu ke li si di li ya de zhi pai ， zai huang ye zhong sha si guai wu shi ou er hui zhao dao wo de yao shi 。]

english: I do not know why Krystilia sends adventurers to find my keys instead of looting the chest herself. Perhaps it amuses her to send people into this land to risk their lives.
translation: 我不知道为什么克里斯蒂莉亚派冒险者来寻找我的钥匙而不是亲自抢劫箱子。也许她觉得把人们送入这片土地冒着生命危险很有趣。 [wo bu zhi dao wei shen me ke li si di li ya pai mao xian zhe lai xun zhao wo de yao shi er bu shi qin zi qiang jie xiang zi 。 ye xu ta jue de ba ren men song ru zhe pian tu di mao zhe sheng ming wei xian hen you qu 。]

english: I'll leave you to it.
translation: 我就让你去吧。 [wo jiu rang ni qu ba 。]

english: I will be here if you return.
translation: 如果你回来我会在这里。 [ru guo ni hui lai wo hui zai zhe li 。]

english: Who are you and why are you here?
translation: 你是谁，为什么在这里？ [ni shi shui ， wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: I've got your key.
translation: 我有你的钥匙。 [wo you ni de yao shi 。]

english: Can you give me anything?
translation: 你能给我什么吗？ [ni neng gei wo shen me ma ？]

english: I'll leave you to it.
translation: 我就让你去吧。 [wo jiu rang ni qu ba 。]

english: Oh, thank Armadyl! I am in such a worry... please help me!
translation: 哦，谢谢阿玛迪尔！我很担心...请帮助我！ [o ， xie xie a ma di er ！ wo hen dan xin ... qing bang zhu wo ！]

english: With what?
translation: 用什么？ [yong shen me ？]

english: Oh... it is terrible... horrible... My boyfriend lives here in this lighthouse, but I haven't seen him the last few days! I think something terrible has happened!
translation: 哦...太可怕了...太可怕了...我的男朋友住在这座灯塔里，但我最近几天没见到他！我觉得发生了可怕的事情！ [o ... tai ke pa le ... tai ke pa le ... wo de nan peng you zhu zai zhe zuo deng ta li ， dan wo zui jin ji tian mei jian dao ta ！ wo jue de fa sheng le ke pa de shi qing ！]

english: Look, you can see for yourself that the light has gone out, and the front door is locked up tight! He would NEVER do that!
translation: 你看，你亲眼看到，灯已经灭了，前门也锁得紧紧的！他永远不会那样做！ [ni kan ， ni qin yan kan dao ， deng yi jing mie le ， qian men ye suo de jin jin de ！ ta yong yuan bu hui na yang zuo ！]

english: With the light off this coastline is terribly dangerous to ships! And to lock the front door so that nobody can turn the light back on?
translation: 由于灯光关闭，这条海岸线对船只来说非常危险！并锁上前门，这样就没有人可以重新打开灯了？ [you yu deng guang guan bi ， zhe tiao hai an xian dui chuan zhi lai shuo fei chang wei xian ！ bing suo shang qian men ， zhe yang jiu mei you ren ke yi chong xin da kai deng le ？]

english: Maybe he just went on holiday or something? Must be pretty boring living in a lighthouse.
translation: 也许他只是去度假什么的？住在灯塔里一定很无聊。 [ye xu ta zhi shi qu du jia shen me de ？ zhu zai deng ta li yi ding hen wu liao 。]

english: That is terribly irresponsible! He is far too thoughtful for that! He would never leave it unattended! He would also never leave without telling me!
translation: 这实在是太不负责任了！他想得太周到了！他绝对不会让它无人看管！他也绝对不会不告诉我就走！ [zhe shi zai shi tai bu fu ze ren le ！ ta xiang de tai zhou dao le ！ ta jue dui bu hui rang ta wu ren kan guan ！ ta ye jue dui bu hui bu gao su wo jiu zou ！]

english: Please, I know something terrible has happened to him... I can sense it! Please... please help me adventurer!
translation: 拜托，我知道他发生了一些可怕的事情……我能感觉到！拜托……请帮助我冒险者！ [bai tuo ， wo zhi dao ta fa sheng le yi xie ke pa de shi qing …… wo neng gan jue dao ！ bai tuo …… qing bang zhu wo mao xian zhe ！]

english: But how can I help?
translation: 但我能提供什么帮助呢？ [dan wo neng ti gong shen me bang zhu ne ？]

english: Well, we have to do something to get the lighthouse working again! Also, as you may have noticed, the storm that knocked the bridge out
translation: 好吧，我们必须做点什么让灯塔重新工作！另外，正如您可能已经注意到的，摧毁桥梁的暴风雨 [hao ba ， wo men bi xu zuo dian shen me rang deng ta chong xin gong zuo ！ ling wai ， zheng ru nin ke neng yi jing zhu yi dao de ， cui hui qiao liang de bao feng yu]

english: has trapped me on this causeway! You seem to have got here okay somehow, so if you could go and visit my cousin and get the spare key I left him,
translation: 把我困在这条堤道上了！你似乎已经顺利到达这里了，所以如果你能去拜访我的表弟并拿到我留给他的备用钥匙， [ba wo kun zai zhe tiao di dao shang le ！ ni si hu yi jing shun li dao da zhe li le ， suo yi ru guo ni neng qu bai fang wo de biao di bing na dao wo liu gei ta de bei yong yao shi ，]

english: as well as fix the bridge enough so that I can go and speak to my family in Rellekka and tell them whats happened, I will be eternally grateful!
translation: 以及把桥修好，这样我就可以去和我在雷莱卡的家人说话，告诉他们发生了什么事，我将永远感激不已！ [yi ji ba qiao xiu hao ， zhe yang wo jiu ke yi qu he wo zai lei lai ka de jia ren shuo hua ， gao su ta men fa sheng le shen me shi ， wo jiang yong yuan gan ji bu yi ！]

english: Okay, I'll help!
translation: 好的，我来帮忙！ [hao de ， wo lai bang mang ！]

english: OH! THANK YOU SO MUCH! I know my darling would never have left with the lighthouse lights off and without even telling me where he's gone!
translation: 哦！太感谢了！我知道我亲爱的永远不会在灯塔灯熄灭的情况下离开，甚至不告诉我他去了哪里！ [o ！ tai gan xie le ！ wo zhi dao wo qin ai de yong yuan bu hui zai deng ta deng xi mie de qing kuang xia li kai ， shen zhi bu gao su wo ta qu le na li ！]

english: Where is your cousin?
translation: 你的表弟在哪里？ [ni de biao di zai na li ？]

english: My cousin was always interested in agility. He left our home in Rellekka many moons ago, so that he could pursue this interest.
translation: 我的表弟一直对敏捷性很感兴趣。许多个月前，他离开了我们在雷莱卡的家，以便他能够追求这一兴趣。 [wo de biao di yi zhi dui min jie xing hen gan xing qu 。 xu duo ge yue qian ， ta li kai le wo men zai lei lai ka de jia ， yi bian ta neng gou zhui qiu zhe yi xing qu 。]

english: I don't exactly know where he has gone, but I am sure he went somewhere to practise his agility. If you see him, his name is Gunnjorn. Mention my name, he will recognise it.
translation: 我不知道他去了哪里，但我确信他去了某个地方练习敏捷。如果你看到他，他的名字叫 Gunnjorn。提到我的名字，他就会认出来。 [wo bu zhi dao ta qu le na li ， dan wo que xin ta qu le mou ge di fang lian xi min jie 。 ru guo ni kan dao ta ， ta de ming zi jiao  Gunnjorn。 ti dao wo de ming zi ， ta jiu hui ren chu lai 。]

english: How can I fix the bridge?
translation: 我怎样才能修好这座桥？ [wo zen yang cai neng xiu hao zhe zuo qiao ？]

english: Well, I am not just some helpless girl! I have pretty good agility, so you will only need to use two planks to make a ledge that I can balance along.
translation: 好吧，我不只是一个无助的女孩！我有很好的敏捷性，所以你只需要用两块木板做一个我可以平衡的壁架。 [hao ba ， wo bu zhi shi yi ge wu zhu de nv hai ！ wo you hen hao de min jie xing ， suo yi ni zhi xu yao yong liang kuai mu ban zuo yi ge wo ke yi ping heng de bi jia 。]

english: Just use a plank on each side of the bridge. You will need a hammer, and thirty steel nails for each plank you use as well. I believe there are some planks near here...
translation: 只需在桥的每一侧使用一块木板即可。您还需要一把锤子和三十颗钢钉来对应您使用的每块木板。我相信这附近有一些木板...... [zhi xu zai qiao de mei yi ce shi yong yi kuai mu ban ji ke 。 nin hai xu yao yi ba chui zi he san shi ke gang ding lai dui ying nin shi yong de mei kuai mu ban 。 wo xiang xin zhe fu jin you yi xie mu ban ......]

english: I'll see what I can do.
translation: 我会看看我能做什么。 [wo hui kan kan wo neng zuo shen me 。]

english: Thank you so much!
translation: 太感谢了！ [tai gan xie le ！]

translation: 抱歉，只是路过。 [bao qian ， zhi shi lu guo 。]

english: Oh... my poor darling Jossik... I just know something terrible has happened...
translation: 哦...我可怜的亲爱的乔西克...我只知道发生了一些可怕的事情... [o ... wo ke lian de qin ai de qiao xi ke ... wo zhi zhi dao fa sheng le yi xie ke pa de shi qing ...]

english: Oh! Thank you so much for all of your help in rescuing my darling Jossik!
translation: 哦！非常感谢您为拯救我亲爱的乔西克提供的所有帮助！ [o ！ fei chang gan xie nin wei zheng jiu wo qin ai de qiao xi ke ti gong de suo you bang zhu ！]

english: I do not know what would have happened to him had you not chanced along this path!
translation: 我不知道如果你没有走上这条路，他会发生什么！ [wo bu zhi dao ru guo ni mei you zou shang zhe tiao lu ， ta hui fa sheng shen me ！]

english: Don't worry about it, I was glad to help out.
translation: 别担心，我很高兴能帮上忙。 [bie dan xin ， wo hen gao xing neng bang shang mang 。]

english: With what?
translation: 用什么？ [yong shen me ？]

english: But how can I help?
translation: 但我能提供什么帮助呢？ [dan wo neng ti gong shen me bang zhu ne ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: Where is your cousin?
translation: 你的表弟在哪里？ [ni de biao di zai na li ？]

english: How can I fix the bridge?
translation: 我怎样才能修好这座桥？ [wo zen yang cai neng xiu hao zhe zuo qiao ？]

english: I'll see what I can do
translation: 我看看我能做什么 [wo kan kan wo neng zuo shen me]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

translation: 抱歉，只是路过 [bao qian ， zhi shi lu guo]

english: I'm looking for an experienced adventurer and you're not it. Come back when you are more capable.
translation: 我正在寻找一位经验丰富的冒险家，但你不是。等你有能力了再回来吧。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yi wei jing yan feng fu de mao xian jia ， dan ni bu shi 。 deng ni you neng li le zai hui lai ba 。]

english: Hello. Do you need any help? I'm looking for a quest.
translation: 你好。您需要帮助吗？我正在寻找一个任务。 [ni hao 。 nin xu yao bang zhu ma ？ wo zheng zai xun zhao yi ge ren wu 。]

english: Are you working for them?
translation: 你在为他们工作吗？ [ni zai wei ta men gong zuo ma ？]

english: Uh, I'm not sure. Who are they?
translation: 呃，我不确定。他们是谁？ [e ， wo bu que ding 。 ta men shi shui ？]

english: EXACTLY!
translation: 确切地！ [que qie di ！]

english: Seriously, what are you talking about?
translation: 说真的，你在说什么？ [shuo zhen de ， ni zai shuo shen me ？]

english: I think you can be trusted. What do you know about...
translation: 我认为你是可以信任的。你知道什么... [wo ren wei ni shi ke yi xin ren de 。 ni zhi dao shen me ...]

english: penguins?
translation: 企鹅？ [qi e ？]

english: Uh...they live in the cold? That's about all.
translation: 呃……他们生活在寒冷中吗？这就是全部了。 [e …… ta men sheng huo zai han leng zhong ma ？ zhe jiu shi quan bu le 。]

english: Would you like to learn more about them? I'm conducting a, uh, research project, to, uh, learn about their social habits in their natural environment.
translation: 您想更多地了解他们吗？我正在进行一个，呃，研究项目，呃，了解他们在自然环境中的社交习惯。 [nin xiang geng duo di liao jie ta men ma ？ wo zheng zai jin xing yi ge ， e ， yan jiu xiang mu ， e ， liao jie ta men zai zi ran huan jing zhong de she jiao xi guan 。]

english: What do you need my help for?
translation: 你需要我的帮助做什么？ [ni xu yao wo de bang zhu zuo shen me ？]

english: Well, I need to build a shelter to hide from view, and it's always useful to have an extra pair of eyes, you know, for, uh, observing...Penguins.
translation: 好吧，我需要建造一个避难所来躲避视线，而且拥有一双额外的眼睛总是有用的，你知道，为了，呃，观察……企鹅。 [hao ba ， wo xu yao jian zao yi ge bi nan suo lai duo bi shi xian ， er qie yong you yi shuang e wai de yan jing zong shi you yong de ， ni zhi dao ， wei le ， e ， guan cha …… qi e 。]

english: So, are you up for it?
translation: 那么，你准备好了吗？ [na me ， ni zhun bei hao le ma ？]

english: Okay, why not! But first, who are you and why are you researching penguins?
translation: 好吧，为什么不呢！但首先，你是谁，为什么要研究企鹅？ [hao ba ， wei shen me bu ne ！ dan shou xian ， ni shi shui ， wei shen me yao yan jiu qi e ？]

english: I, uh, was a zoo keeper here. But, I, uh, am on leave to go research penguins in their native habitat.
translation: 我，呃，是这里的动物园管理员。但是，我，呃，正在休假，去企鹅的原生栖息地研究企鹅。 [wo ， e ， shi zhe li de dong wu yuan guan li yuan 。 dan shi ， wo ， e ， zheng zai xiu jia ， qu qi e de yuan sheng qi xi di yan jiu qi e 。]

english: Ok! Okay then. So, what did you need me to do?
translation: 好的！那么好吧。那么，你需要我做什么？ [hao de ！ na me hao ba 。 na me ， ni xu yao wo zuo shen me ？]

english: Right. I need you to gather materials for the bird hide, while I arrange for our transport.
translation: 正确的。我需要你收集鸟皮的材料，同时我安排我们的交通。 [zheng que de 。 wo xu yao ni shou ji niao pi de cai liao ， tong shi wo an pai wo men de jiao tong 。]

english: You need to get 10 oak planks, 10 steel nails, a hammer, and a spade so that we can build a bird hide.
translation: 你需要 10 块橡木板、10 个钢钉、一把锤子和一把铲子，这样我们才能建造一个鸟皮。 [ni xu yao  10  kuai xiang mu ban 、10  ge gang ding 、 yi ba chui zi he yi ba chan zi ， zhe yang wo men cai neng jian zao yi ge niao pi 。]

english: Once you have those, meet me up by the entrance to Keldagrim, east of Rellekka. I'll be there with a boat to take us to our destination.
translation: 一旦你拿到了这些，就在雷莱卡以东的凯尔达格林入口处与我会面。我会带我们去目的地的船。 [yi dan ni na dao le zhe xie ， jiu zai lei lai ka yi dong de kai er da ge lin ru kou chu yu wo hui mian 。 wo hui dai wo men qu mu di di de chuan 。]

english: Right, oak planks, steel nails, hammer, spade, east of Rellekka. Got it.
translation: 右图，橡木板、钢钉、锤子、铲子，位于雷莱卡以东。知道了。 [you tu ， xiang mu ban 、 gang ding 、 chui zi 、 chan zi ， wei yu lei lai ka yi dong 。 zhi dao le 。]

english: You've started a new quest: Cold War
translation: 你已经开始了一个新的任务：冷战 [ni yi jing kai shi le yi ge xin de ren wu ： leng zhan]

english: I don't think so.
translation: 我不这么认为。 [wo bu zhe me ren wei 。]

english: What? Did you come to tell me I'm crazy too?
translation: 什么？你是来告诉我我也疯了吗？ [shen me ？ ni shi lai gao su wo wo ye feng le ma ？]

english: No, I...
Oh, I don't have time for your lies. Go away
translation: 哦，我没时间听你的谎言。离开 [o ， wo mei shi jian ting ni de huang yan 。 li kai]

english: Sorry, you can't use this boat.
translation: 抱歉，您不能使用这艘船。 [bao qian ， nin bu neng shi yong zhe sou chuan 。]

english: I can't speak right now. I have too much to do. I will contact you when the time is right.
translation: 我现在不能说话。我有太多事情要做。我会在适当的时候与您联系。 [wo xian zai bu neng shuo hua 。 wo you tai duo shi qing yao zuo 。 wo hui zai shi dang de shi hou yu nin lian xi 。]

english: On the way I'll tell you the 42 ways penguins can torture you using a feather...
translation: 在路上我会告诉你企鹅用羽毛折磨你的 42 种方式...... [zai lu shang wo hui gao su ni qi e yong yu mao zhe mo ni de  42  zhong fang shi ......]

english: I've lost the clockwork book, could I have another?
translation: 我把发条书丢了，能给我一本吗？ [wo ba fa tiao shu diu le ， neng gei wo yi ben ma ？]

english: Well, lucky for you I did make another copy. But be more careful!
translation: 好吧，你很幸运，我又复印了一份。但要更加小心！ [hao ba ， ni hen xing yun ， wo you fu yin le yi fen 。 dan yao geng jia xiao xin ！]

english: Can I transport My Arm in your boat?
translation: 我可以在你们的船上运送我的手臂吗？ [wo ke yi zai ni men de chuan shang yun song wo de shou bi ma ？]

english: Well, yes, I'm sure you've transported your arm every time you've used my boat. Isn't it always attached to the rest of your body?
translation: 嗯，是的，我确信您每次使用我的船时都会移动您的手臂。它不是总是附着在你身体的其他部分吗？ [n ， shi de ， wo que xin nin mei ci shi yong wo de chuan shi du hui yi dong nin de shou bi 。 ta bu shi zong shi fu zhuo zai ni shen ti de qi ta bu fen ma ？]

english: Never mind, I just need to borrow your boat.
translation: 没关系，我只是想借用你的船。 [mei guan xi ， wo zhi shi xiang jie yong ni de chuan 。]

english: Sorry, I distinctly heard you say you wanted to transport your arm in it. Have you had your brain shrunk into a penguin suit too many times? I don't lend my boat to mad people.
translation: 抱歉，我清楚地听到你说你想把你的手臂放进去。你是否曾多次将大脑缩进企鹅服中？我不会把我的船借给疯子。 [bao qian ， wo qing chu di ting dao ni shuo ni xiang ba ni de shou bi fang jin qu 。 ni shi fou ceng duo ci jiang da nao suo jin qi e fu zhong ？ wo bu hui ba wo de chuan jie gei feng zi 。]

english: This kind of thing happens a lot when I take My Arm out to places.
translation: 当我把我的手臂带到一些地方时，这种事情经常发生。 [dang wo ba wo de shou bi dai dao yi xie di fang shi ， zhe zhong shi qing jing chang fa sheng 。]

english: You take your arm out to places? And what the heck is THAT?
translation: 你把手臂伸出去别的地方吗？那到底是什么？ [ni ba shou bi shen chu qu bie de di fang ma ？ na dao di shi shen me ？]

english: My Arm approaches the pier.
translation: 我的手臂接近码头。 [wo de shou bi jie jin ma tou 。]

english: My Arm: My Arm here!
translation: 我的手臂：我的手臂在这里！ [wo de shou bi ： wo de shou bi zai zhe li ！]

english: What are we going to do about the penguins?
translation: 面对企鹅，我们该怎么办？ [mian dui qi e ， wo men gai zen me ban ？]

english: I can't speak right now. I have too much to do. I will contact you when the time is right.**
translation: 我现在不能说话。我有太多事情要做。我会在合适的时候与您联系。** [wo xian zai bu neng shuo hua 。 wo you tai duo shi qing yao zuo 。 wo hui zai he shi de shi hou yu nin lian xi 。**]

english: Um... I think I must have misheard you, but the only thing I'll let my boat do is travel here to Rellekka, with me in it. I'm not risking getting marooned here.
translation: 嗯……我想我一定是听错了，但我唯一能让我的船做的就是和我一起前往雷莱卡。我不会冒被困在这里的风险。 [n …… wo xiang wo yi ding shi ting cuo le ， dan wo wei yi neng rang wo de chuan zuo de jiu shi he wo yi qi qian wang lei lai ka 。 wo bu hui mao bei kun zai zhe li de feng xian 。]

english: Okay, why not!
translation: 好吧，为什么不呢！ [hao ba ， wei shen me bu ne ！]

english: I don't think so.
translation: 我不这么认为。 [wo bu zhe me ren wei 。]

english: I'd like to travel to the iceberg.
translation: 我想去冰山旅行。 [wo xiang qu bing shan lv xing 。]

english: I've lost the clockwork book, could I have another?
translation: 我把发条书丢了，能给我一本吗？ [wo ba fa tiao shu diu le ， neng gei wo yi ben ma ？]

english: Can I transport My Arm in your boat?
translation: 我可以在你们的船上运送我的手臂吗？ [wo ke yi zai ni men de chuan shang yun song wo de shou bi ma ？]

english: My Arm is a troll.
translation: 我的手臂是巨魔。 [wo de shou bi shi ju mo 。]

english: Never mind, I just need to borrow your boat.
translation: 没关系，我只是想借用你的船。 [mei guan xi ， wo zhi shi xiang jie yong ni de chuan 。]

english: What are we going to do about the penguins?
translation: 面对企鹅，我们该怎么办？ [mian dui qi e ， wo men gai zen me ban ？]

english: Please excuse me, I'm rather busy.
translation: 请原谅我，我比较忙。 [qing yuan liang wo ， wo bi jiao mang 。]

english: Hey, I'm your contractor from Mahogany Homes, what did you want done?
translation: 嘿，我是 Mahogany Homes 的承包商，你想要做什么？ [hei ， wo shi  Mahogany Homes  de cheng bao shang ， ni xiang yao zuo shen me ？]

english: I'd like my range fixed.
translation: 我希望我的范围是固定的。 [wo xi wang wo de fan wei shi gu ding de 。]

english: I'd like two Wooden drawers built.
translation: 我想要两个木制抽屉。 [wo xiang yao liang ge mu zhi chou ti 。]

english: I'd like a Wooden table built.
translation: 我想要一张木桌。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang mu zhuo 。]

english: I'd like my hat stand fixed.
translation: 我想把我的帽架修好。 [wo xiang ba wo de mao jia xiu hao 。]

english: I'd like my clock fixed.
translation: 我想要修好我的时钟。 [wo xiang yao xiu hao wo de shi zhong 。]

english: I'd like two Oak drawers built.
translation: 我想要两个橡木抽屉。 [wo xiang yao liang ge xiang mu chou ti 。]

english: I'd like a Oak table built.
translation: 我想要一张橡木桌子。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang xiang mu zhuo zi 。]

english: I'd like two Teak drawers built.
translation: 我想要两个柚木抽屉。 [wo xiang yao liang ge you mu chou ti 。]

english: I'd like a Teak table built.
translation: 我想要一张柚木桌子。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang you mu zhuo zi 。]

english: I'd like two Mahogany drawers built.
translation: 我想要两个桃花心木抽屉。 [wo xiang yao liang ge tao hua xin mu chou ti 。]

english: I'd like a Mahogany table built.
translation: 我想要一张红木桌子。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang hong mu zhuo zi 。]

english: I've finished with the work you wanted.
translation: 我已经完成了你想要的工作。 [wo yi jing wan cheng le ni xiang yao de gong zuo 。]

english: Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: 太感谢了！走之前你想喝杯茶吗？ [tai gan xie le ！ zou zhi qian ni xiang he bei cha ma ？]

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
translation: 是的，我想要一杯茶。 [shi de ， wo xiang yao yi bei cha 。]

english: No thanks, I better be off.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我最好离开了。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo zui hao li kai le 。]

english: Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!
translation: 啊啊，没有什么比一杯美味的茶更好的了！ [a a ， mei you shen me bi yi bei mei wei de cha geng hao de le ！]

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
translation: 是的，我想要一杯茶。 [shi de ， wo xiang yao yi bei cha 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello there, are you interested in buying one of my special capes?
translation: 您好，您有兴趣购买我的一件特别斗篷吗？ [nin hao ， nin you xing qu gou mai wo de yi jian te bie dou peng ma ？]

english: What's so special about your capes?
translation: 你的斗篷有什么特别之处？ [ni de dou peng you shen me te bie zhi chu ？]

english: Ahh well they make it less likely that you'll accidently attack anyone wearing the same cape as you and easier to attack everyone else. They also make it easier to distinguish people who're wearing the same cape as you
translation: 啊，好吧，它们使你不太可能意外攻击任何穿着与你相同斗篷的人，并且更容易攻击其他人。它们还可以让您更轻松地区分与您穿着相同斗篷的人 [a ， hao ba ， ta men shi ni bu tai ke neng yi wai gong ji ren he chuan zhe yu ni xiang tong dou peng de ren ， bing qie geng rong yi gong ji qi ta ren 。 ta men hai ke yi rang nin geng qing song di qu fen yu nin chuan zhe xiang tong dou peng de ren]

english: from everyone else. They're very useful when out in the wilderness with friends or anyone else you don't want to harm.
translation: 来自其他人。当您与朋友或您不想伤害的其他人一起在荒野中时，它们非常有用。 [lai zi qi ta ren 。 dang nin yu peng you huo nin bu xiang shang hai de qi ta ren yi qi zai huang ye zhong shi ， ta men fei chang you yong 。]

english: So would you like to buy one?
translation: 那么您想买一个吗？ [na me nin xiang mai yi ge ma ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: What's so special about your capes?
translation: 你的斗篷有什么特别之处？ [ni de dou peng you shen me te bie zhi chu ？]

english: Yes please!
translation: 是的，请！ [shi de ， qing ！]

english: Is there something I can help you with?
translation: 有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

english: I was given a challenge, what now?
translation: 我收到了挑战，现在怎么办？ [wo shou dao le tiao zhan ， xian zai zen me ban ？]

english: Hand it to me, and we'll get you started.
translation: 将其交给我，我们将帮助您开始。 [jiang qi jiao gei wo ， wo men jiang bang zhu nin kai shi 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This is the champions' arena. The champions of various races use it to duel those they deem worthy of the honour. If you find a challenge scroll in your travels, bring it here to face your challenger.
translation: 这里是冠军的主场。各种比赛的冠军用它来与他们认为值得荣誉的人决斗。如果你在旅途中发现了挑战卷轴，请将其带到这里来面对你的挑战者。 [zhe li shi guan jun de zhu chang 。 ge zhong bi sai de guan jun yong ta lai yu ta men ren wei zhi de rong yu de ren jue dou 。 ru guo ni zai lv tu zhong fa xian le tiao zhan juan zhou ， qing jiang qi dai dao zhe li lai mian dui ni de tiao zhan zhe 。]

english: Have you any rewards for me?
translation: 你有什么奖励给我吗？ [ni you shen me jiang li gei wo ma ？]

english: No, you've not earned any.
translation: 不，你还没有赚到任何钱。 [bu ， ni hai mei you zhuan dao ren he qian 。]

english: Have a look in the chest by the Wall of Defeated Champions, on the north side of this gallery. I think you'll find something in there for you.
translation: 看看这个画廊北侧的失利冠军墙旁边的箱子。我想你会在那里找到适合你的东西。 [kan kan zhe ge hua lang bei ce de shi li guan jun qiang pang bian de xiang zi 。 wo xiang ni hui zai na li zhao dao shi he ni de dong xi 。]

english: You're holding it already. Go and rub your lamp.
translation: 你已经拿着它了。去擦你的灯吧。 [ni yi jing na zhe ta le 。 qu ca ni de deng ba 。]

english: I don't think I've got anything more for you.
translation: 我想我已经没有什么可以给你的了。 [wo xiang wo yi jing mei you shen me ke yi gei ni de le 。]

english: Nothing thanks.

translation: 我能为你们做什么？我的文书工作很忙。 [wo neng wei ni men zuo shen me ？ wo de wen shu gong zuo hen mang 。]

english: I heard about your ship. Can you tell me what happened?
translation: 我听说过你的船。你能告诉我发生了什么事吗？ [wo ting shuo guo ni de chuan 。 ni neng gao su wo fa sheng le shen me shi ma ？]

english: Aye, I can tell ye what happened.
translation: 是的，我可以告诉你发生了什么事。 [shi de ， wo ke yi gao su ni fa sheng le shen me shi 。]

english: We be out on our fortnightly fishin' trip, I was doin' me normal work. Setting up the nets, swabbing the deck and the like.
translation: 我们每两周出去钓鱼一次，我正在做正常的工作。架设渔网、擦拭甲板等。 [wo men mei liang zhou chu qu diao yu yi ci ， wo zheng zai zuo zheng chang de gong zuo 。 jia she yu wang 、 ca shi jia ban deng 。]

english: 'Twas a good hawl t' start, plenty of manta ray and snappers. But we would be movin' on the next day to our deep sea fishin' spot.
translation: “这是一个很好的开始”，有很多蝠鲼和笛鲷。但第二天我们就会前往深海钓鱼点。 [“ zhe shi yi ge hen hao de kai shi ”， you hen duo fu fen he di diao 。 dan di er tian wo men jiu hui qian wang shen hai diao yu dian 。]

english: 'Twas nothin' but smooth sailin' to our deep sea spot near Karamja, but on the way I noticed more debris in the water than usual.
translation: 前往卡拉姆贾附近的深海地点“一帆风顺”，但在途中我注意到水中的碎片比平时更多。 [qian wang ka la mu jia fu jin de shen hai di dian “ yi fan feng shun ”， dan zai tu zhong wo zhu yi dao shui zhong de sui pian bi ping shi geng duo 。]

english: What kind of debris? Was it ship debris?
translation: 什么样的碎片？是船舶残骸吗？ [shen me yang de sui pian ？ shi chuan bo can hai ma ？]

english: Aye, 'twas. Most of the time, it be nets or items people throw off ships that they don't need. This had me worried a bit.
translation: 是的，是的。大多数时候，人们从船上扔掉的都是他们不需要的网或物品。这让我有点担心。 [shi de ， shi de 。 da duo shu shi hou ， ren men cong chuan shang reng diao de dou shi ta men bu xu yao de wang huo wu pin 。 zhe rang wo you dian dan xin 。]

english: There was a lack of fish in the water, 'twas kind of... eerie.
translation: 水里没有鱼，这有点……怪异。 [shui li mei you yu ， zhe you dian …… guai yi 。]

english: The next day, Koanee changed the ship's course, but that be because of a storm on the horizon.
translation: 第二天，科阿尼改变了船的航线，但那是因为地平线上有一场风暴。 [di er tian ， ke a ni gai bian le chuan de hang xian ， dan na shi yin wei di ping xian shang you yi chang feng bao 。]

english: But the storm seemed t' be... following us. As if it had a mind of its own.
translation: 但风暴似乎并没有……跟随我们。就好像它有自己的想法一样。 [dan feng bao si hu bing mei you …… gen sui wo men 。 jiu hao xiang ta you zi ji de xiang fa yi yang 。]

english: The wind started a blowin' and the fog started a showin', huge waves crashing against the boat.
translation: 风起，雾起，巨浪拍打着小船。 [feng qi ， wu qi ， ju lang pai da zhe xiao chuan 。]

english: The ship started fallin' apart. I rushed to the cook's quarters and found 'im layin' on the floor with a plank over 'im.
translation: 船开始分崩离析。我冲到厨师的住处，发现我躺在地板上，上面盖着一块木板。 [chuan kai shi fen beng li xi 。 wo chong dao chu shi de zhu chu ， fa xian wo tang zai di ban shang ， shang mian gai zhe yi kuai mu ban 。]

english: I brought 'im up to the top deck and tied 'im to a piece of loose wood. I did the same t' the Skipper and Navigator.
translation: 我把它带到顶层甲板上，把它绑在一块松木上。我对船长和领航员也做了同样的事情。 [wo ba ta dai dao ding ceng jia ban shang ， ba ta bang zai yi kuai song mu shang 。 wo dui chuan zhang he ling hang yuan ye zuo le tong yang de shi qing 。]

english: Oh my, that's awful! You're very lucky you didn't get hit.
translation: 天哪，太糟糕了！你很幸运没有被击中。 [tian na ， tai zao gao le ！ ni hen xing yun mei you bei ji zhong 。]

english: Aye, it be lucky indeed. But that not be the end of it. As the ship finished sinking, I balanced out the wood so we did not slip.
translation: 是啊，确实很幸运。但这还不是结束。当船完全下沉时，我平衡了木头，这样我们就没有滑倒。 [shi a ， que shi hen xing yun 。 dan zhe hai bu shi jie shu 。 dang chuan wan quan xia chen shi ， wo ping heng le mu tou ， zhe yang wo men jiu mei you hua dao 。]

english: In the distance I saw glowing eyes and a large monster sorta thing in the fog movin' t'wards us.
translation: 在远处，我看到发光的眼睛和雾中一个巨大的怪物向我们移动。 [zai yuan chu ， wo kan dao fa guang de yan jing he wu zhong yi ge ju da de guai wu xiang wo men yi dong 。]

english: But all of a sudden, it vanished. I then had to keep us afloat 'till we made it t' shore by Al Kharid.
translation: 但突然间，它就消失了。然后我必须让我们保持漂浮，直到我们到达阿尔卡里德海岸。 [dan tu ran jian ， ta jiu xiao shi le 。 ran hou wo bi xu rang wo men bao chi piao fu ， zhi dao wo men dao da a er ka li de hai an 。]

english: Pudi gathered us up and we went t' the Chancellor as soon as we could stand.
translation: 普迪把我们召集起来，我们一站起来就去找总理。 [pu di ba wo men zhao ji qi lai ， wo men yi zhan qi lai jiu qu zhao zong li 。]

english: These ruins turned out t' be a great base to research the beast from undisturbed! Bit close to Menaphos though, aye?
translation: 事实证明，这些废墟是不受干扰地研究野兽的绝佳基地！不过离梅纳福斯有点近，是吗？ [shi shi zheng ming ， zhe xie fei xu shi bu shou gan rao di yan jiu ye shou de jue jia ji di ！ bu guo li mei na fu si you dian jin ， shi ma ？]

english: That be the end of me story. Can I help ye with anything else?
translation: 我的故事就这样结束了。我还能帮您做其他事吗？ [wo de gu shi jiu zhe yang jie shu le 。 wo hai neng bang nin zuo qi ta shi ma ？]

english: A pirate doing paperwork, that's new.
translation: 海盗在做文书工作，这很新鲜。 [hai dao zai zuo wen shu gong zuo ， zhe hen xin xian 。]

english: Let me guess, ye thought we be doin' nothing but pluderin' and pillagin'?
translation: 让我猜猜，你们以为我们除了掠夺和掠夺之外什么也没做吗？ [rang wo cai cai ， ni men yi wei wo men chu le lve duo he lve duo zhi wai shen me ye mei zuo ma ？]

english: Is that not what pirates do?
translation: 这不是海盗干的事吗？ [zhe bu shi hai dao gan de shi ma ？]

english: Ye be a funny one.
translation: 你是一个有趣的人。 [ni shi yi ge you qu de ren 。]

english: Glad you can still smile after what happened.
translation: 很高兴事情发生后你还能微笑。 [hen gao xing shi qing fa sheng hou ni hai neng wei xiao 。]

english: I'm not goin' t' let one bit of bad luck keep me down.
translation: 我不会让一点点坏运气让我沮丧。 [wo bu hui rang yi dian dian huai yun qi rang wo ju sang 。]

english: Can I help ye with anything else?
translation: 我还能帮您做其他事吗？ [wo hai neng bang nin zuo qi ta shi ma ？]

english: Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
translation: 你有对抗 Tempoross 的建议吗？ [ni you dui kang  Tempoross  de jian yi ma ？]

english: Tempoross can summon clouds that shoot lightnin'. They can cause fires that will block ye from movin' about as freely.
translation: Tempoross可以召唤发射闪电的云。它们会引起火灾，从而阻碍您自由活动。 [Tempoross ke yi zhao huan fa she shan dian de yun 。 ta men hui yin qi huo zai ， cong er zu ai nin zi you huo dong 。]

english: Ye best be ready to grab a bucket and douse the fire before it spreads!
translation: 你们最好准备好拿一个水桶，在火势蔓延之前将其扑灭！ [ni men zui hao zhun bei hao na yi ge shui tong ， zai huo shi man yan zhi qian jiang qi pu mie ！]

english: Can I help ye with anythin' else?
translation: 我还能帮你做点什么吗？ [wo hai neng bang ni zuo dian shen me ma ？]

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。 [wo de zou le 。]

english: Stay safe, ye hear?
translation: 注意安全，听到了吗？ [zhu yi an quan ， ting dao le ma ？]

english: Would you care for an egg in this difficult time?
translation: 在这个困难时期，你会关心鸡蛋吗？ [zai zhe ge kun nan shi qi ， ni hui guan xin ji dan ma ？]

english: Um... no, I don't want your damp egg, thanks...
translation: 嗯...不，我不需要你的湿鸡蛋，谢谢... [n ... bu ， wo bu xu yao ni de shi ji dan ， xie xie ...]

english: I'll take my eggs elsewhere then.
translation: 那我会把鸡蛋带到别处去。 [na wo hui ba ji dan dai dao bie chu qu 。]

english: A damp egg? No thanks.
translation: 湿鸡蛋？不，谢谢。 [shi ji dan ？ bu ， xie xie 。]

english: I'd rather not. Thanks, though.
translation: 我宁愿不。不过还是谢谢。 [wo ning yuan bu 。 bu guo hai shi xie xie 。]

english: Oh, thanks.
translation: 哦，谢谢。 [o ， xie xie 。]

english: This is some comfort to be sure.
translation: 这确实是一种安慰。 [zhe que shi shi yi zhong an wei 。]

english: I heard about your ship, can you tell me what happened?
translation: 我听说过你的船，你能告诉我发生了什么事吗？ [wo ting shuo guo ni de chuan ， ni neng gao su wo fa sheng le shen me shi ma ？]

english: A pirate doing paperwork, that's new.
translation: 海盗在做文书工作，这很新鲜。 [hai dao zai zuo wen shu gong zuo ， zhe hen xin xian 。]

english: Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
translation: 你有对抗 Tempoross 的建议吗？ [ni you dui kang  Tempoross  de jian yi ma ？]

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。 [wo de zou le 。]

english: Have I seen you before?
translation: 我以前见过你吗？ [wo yi qian jian guo ni ma ？]

english: I don't think so... I've just got one of those faces.
translation: 我不这么认为...我只是拥有其中一张面孔。 [wo bu zhe me ren wei ... wo zhi shi yong you qi zhong yi zhang mian kong 。]

english: You're probably right.
translation: 你可能是对的。 [ni ke neng shi dui de 。]

english: I'm rather busy at the moment. I've got to organise my cupboards of jewels.
translation: 我现在比较忙。我必须整理我的珠宝柜。 [wo xian zai bi jiao mang 。 wo bi xu zheng li wo de zhu bao gui 。]

english: Want any help?
translation: 需要任何帮助吗？ [xu yao ren he bang zhu ma ？]

english: Absolutely not! You stay away from my jewels.
translation: 绝对不是！你离我的珠宝远点。 [jue dui bu shi ！ ni li wo de zhu bao yuan dian 。]

english: Interested in buying a house like mine?
translation: 有兴趣买像我这样的房子吗？ [you xing qu mai xiang wo zhe yang de fang zi ma ？]

english: Not sure I've got enough coins to do that.
translation: 不确定我是否有足够的硬币来做到这一点。 [bu que ding wo shi fou you zu gou de ying bi lai zuo dao zhe yi dian 。]

english: Silly me! I mistook you for one of us wealthy folk.
translation: 傻我啊！我误以为你是我们当中的一位富人。 [sha wo a ！ wo wu yi wei ni shi wo men dang zhong de yi wei fu ren 。]

english: Well that's rude.
translation: 嗯，这很粗鲁。 [n ， zhe hen cu lu 。]

english: You'll catch on.
translation: 你会明白的。 [ni hui ming bai de 。]

english: Hello there. Are you liking the city?
translation: 你好呀。你喜欢这座城市吗？ [ni hao ya 。 ni xi huan zhe zuo cheng shi ma ？]

english: It's beautiful!
translation: 很美丽！ [hen mei li ！]

english: It really is.
translation: 确实如此。 [que shi ru ci 。]

english: Huh? Are you an encyclopediasalesman?
translation: 啊？您是百科全书推销员吗？ [a ？ nin shi bai ke quan shu tui xiao yuan ma ？]

english: No, madam, I'm a burglar. I burgle people.
translation: 不，女士，我是小偷。我偷窃别人。 [bu ， nv shi ， wo shi xiao tou 。 wo tou qie bie ren 。]

english: Hmm... I think you're an encyclopediasalesman?
translation: 嗯...我认为你是一名百科全书推销员？ [n ... wo ren wei ni shi yi ming bai ke quan shu tui xiao yuan ？]

english: Not at all. I just want to ransack the place. Honestly.
translation: 一点也不。我只是想搜查一下这个地方。诚实地。 [yi dian ye bu 。 wo zhi shi xiang sou cha yi xia zhe ge di fang 。 cheng shi di 。]

english: Hmm... Alright then.
translation: 嗯……那好吧。 [n …… na hao ba 。]

english: I've just spent so much money!
translation: 我刚刚花了这么多钱！ [wo gang gang hua le zhe me duo qian ！]

english: Good for you.
translation: 对你有好处。 [dui ni you hao chu 。]

english: Sorry, but I don't have time to chat. I've got important errands to run.
translation: 抱歉，我没有时间聊天。我有重要的事情要处理。 [bao qian ， wo mei you shi jian liao tian 。 wo you zhong yao de shi qing yao chu li 。]

english: I've got something in the back of my mind telling me I should go back home.
translation: 我心里有件事告诉我我应该回家。 [wo xin li you jian shi gao su wo wo ying gai hui jia 。]

english: You don't say...
translation: 你不说... [ni bu shuo ...]

english: Lovely day for a stroll, wouldn't you say?
translation: 这是散步的好日子，你说呢？ [zhe shi san bu de hao ri zi ， ni shuo ne ？]

english: It is!
translation: 这是！ [zhe shi ！]

english: Time to go check how rich I am!
translation: 是时候去看看我有多富有了！ [shi shi hou qu kan kan wo you duo fu you le ！]

english: Lovely day for a stroll.
translation: 美好的一天，适合散步。 [mei hao de yi tian ， shi he san bu 。]

english: Time to see what's at the bazaar!
translation: 是时候看看集市上有什么了！ [shi shi hou kan kan ji shi shang you shen me le ！]

english: You are escorted out of the house as the owner has locked the door.
translation: 由于房主锁上了门，您将被护送出房子。 [you yu fang zhu suo shang le men ， nin jiang bei hu song chu fang zi 。]

english: You hear someone outside spot the homeowner coming back!
translation: 你听到外面有人发现房主回来了！ [ni ting dao wai mian you ren fa xian fang zhu hui lai le ！]

english: Now where did I put my keys...
translation: 现在我把钥匙放在哪里了... [xian zai wo ba yao shi fang zai na li le ...]

english: Ah, there they are!
translation: 啊，他们在那里！ [a ， ta men zai na li ！]

english: It smells funny in here...
translation: 这里的味道很奇怪... [zhe li de wei dao hen qi guai ...]

english: There's mud all over the floor!
translation: 地板上全都是泥！ [di ban shang quan dou shi ni ！]

english: Something isn't right here...
translation: 这里有些不对劲... [zhe li you xie bu dui jin ...]

english: How did you get in here?
translation: 你是怎么进来的？ [ni shi zen me jin lai de ？]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Oh, I just walk around a bit...I have to help my Mum and Dad a lot though because I'm still only young. I'd love to visit the mainland one day though and get out of this boring village.
translation: 哦，我只是四处走走……但我必须帮助我的妈妈和爸爸很多，因为我还很年轻。不过，我很想有一天能去大陆看看，离开这个无聊的村庄。 [o ， wo zhi shi si chu zou zou …… dan wo bi xu bang zhu wo de ma ma he ba ba hen duo ， yin wei wo hai hen nian qing 。 bu guo ， wo hen xiang you yi tian neng qu da lu kan kan ， li kai zhe ge wu liao de cun zhuang 。]

english: Is there anything interesting to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么好玩的吗？ [zhe fu jin you shen me hao wan de ma ？]

english: Not that I'm aware of, just sit back and enjoy the sunshine bwana!
translation: 我不知道，只是坐下来享受阳光 bwana！ [wo bu zhi dao ， zhi shi zuo xia lai xiang shou yang guang  bwana！]

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 我一直在村里做一些工作。 [wo yi zhi zai cun li zuo yi xie gong zuo 。]

english: Yeah, you've been doing a lot of good work around here. Let me give you something for your time and effort.
translation: 是的，你在这里做了很多出色的工作。让我给你一些东西来补偿你的时间和精力。 [shi de ， ni zai zhe li zuo le hen duo chu se de gong zuo 。 rang wo gei ni yi xie dong xi lai bu chang ni de shi jian he jing li 。]

english: You get [amount] trading sticks. You are left with [amount]% favour.
translation: 您将获得[数量]根交易棒。您还剩下[金额]%的恩惠。 [nin jiang huo de [ shu liang ] gen jiao yi bang 。 nin hai sheng xia [ jin e ]% de en hui 。]

english: I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: 我已经给了你一些交易棒，现在我身上没有了。为什么不去和其他一些村民谈谈并获得一些捐款呢？ [wo yi jing gei le ni yi xie jiao yi bang ， xian zai wo shen shang mei you le 。 wei shen me bu qu he qi ta yi xie cun min tan tan bing huo de yi xie juan kuan ne ？]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Ahhhhhhhh - Get away from me you beast!
translation: 啊啊啊——你这个畜生，离我远点！ [a a a —— ni zhe ge chu sheng ， li wo yuan dian ！]

english: What's the problem....oh, I'm wearing this big scary mask! I'd better take it off before I start talking to the natives.
translation: 有什么问题......哦，我戴着这个可怕的大面具！在我开始和当地人交谈之前我最好把它摘下来。 [you shen me wen ti ...... o ， wo dai zhe zhe ge ke pa de da mian ju ！ zai wo kai shi he dang di ren jiao tan zhi qian wo zui hao ba ta zhai xia lai 。]

english: Waahhhhh! - It's da evil broodoo beast come ta eat my very soul!
translation: 哇啊啊啊！ - 这是一只邪恶的母兽来吃掉我的灵魂！ [wa a a a ！ -  zhe shi yi zhi xie e de mu shou lai chi diao wo de ling hun ！]

english: Ahhhhhhhh - It's a monster!
translation: 啊啊啊——这是一个怪物！ [a a a —— zhe shi yi ge guai wu ！]

english: Ahhhhhhhh!!
translation: 啊啊啊啊！！ [a a a a ！！]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: 这里有什么有趣的事情可以做吗？ [zhe li you shen me you qu de shi qing ke yi zuo ma ？]

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 我一直在村里做一些工作。 [wo yi zhi zai cun li zuo yi xie gong zuo 。]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Well, thank you, adventurer. You've just deprived me of a wonderful chance to learn from one of Zamorak's first followers.
translation: 嗯，谢谢你，冒险家。你刚刚剥夺了我向萨莫拉克的第一批追随者之一学习的绝佳机会。 [n ， xie xie ni ， mao xian jia 。 ni gang gang bo duo le wo xiang sa mo la ke de di yi pi zhui sui zhe zhi yi xue xi de jue jia ji hui 。]

english: What? What about that treasure you were looking for?
translation: 什么？你要找的那个宝藏呢？ [shen me ？ ni yao zhao de na ge bao zang ne ？]

english: You utter imbecile! Did you think I was looking for gold?
translation: 你真是个无赖啊！你以为我是在寻找金子吗？ [ni zhen shi ge wu lai a ！ ni yi wei wo shi zai xun zhao jin zi ma ？]

english: Um... sorry.
translation: 嗯...抱歉。 [n ... bao qian 。]

english: 'Sorry' won't bring those Mahjarrat back.
translation: “对不起”不会让那些马吉拉特回来。 [“ dui bu qi ” bu hui rang na xie ma ji la te hui lai 。]
