translation: 如果你改变主意，你知道在哪里可以找到我。 [ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， ni zhi dao zai na li ke yi zhao dao wo 。]

english: Would you like me to take you to Varlamore's mainland?
translation: 你想让我带你去瓦拉莫大陆吗？ [ni xiang rang wo dai ni qu wa la mo da lu ma ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Hello there. Do you have any questions about Leagues?
translation: 你好呀。您对联赛有任何疑问吗？ [ni hao ya 。 nin dui lian sai you ren he yi wen ma ？]

english: What's a League?
translation: 什么是联盟？ [shen me shi lian meng ？]

english: Leagues are time-limited challenges that provide a unique twist on the world you know and love.
translation: 联赛是限时挑战，为您所熟悉和喜爱的世界带来独特的变化。 [lian sai shi xian shi tiao zhan ， wei nin suo shu xi he xi ai de shi jie dai lai du te de bian hua 。]

english: With each League, you start afresh, with a limited amount of time to progress through the League.
translation: 在每个联赛中，您都需要重新开始，并在有限的时间内完成联赛。 [zai mei ge lian sai zhong ， nin dou xu yao chong xin kai shi ， bing zai you xian de shi jian nei wan cheng lian sai 。]

english: A fresh start? Why would I want that?
translation: 一个新的开始？我为什么想要那个？ [yi ge xin de kai shi ？ wo wei shen me xiang yao na ge ？]

english: Glory, rewards, and the chance to do things in a different way!
translation: 荣耀、奖励和以不同方式做事的机会！ [rong yao 、 jiang li he yi bu tong fang shi zuo shi de ji hui ！]

english: First up, the glory. Within a League, you can earn League Points by completing various tasks.
translation: 首先，荣耀。在联盟内，您可以通过完成各种任务来赚取联盟积分。 [shou xian ， rong yao 。 zai lian meng nei ， nin ke yi tong guo wan cheng ge zhong ren wu lai zhuan qu lian meng ji fen 。]

english: The more points you have, the better League Rank you will be given.
translation: 您拥有的积分越多，您获得的联赛排名就越高。 [nin yong you de ji fen yue duo ， nin huo de de lian sai pai ming jiu yue gao 。]

english: Each League Rank will unlock a trophy for you. These trophies can be used to show off your accomplishments.
translation: 每个联赛排名都会为您解锁一个奖杯。这些奖杯可以用来炫耀您的成就。 [mei ge lian sai pai ming du hui wei nin jie suo yi ge jiang bei 。 zhe xie jiang bei ke yi yong lai xuan yao nin de cheng jiu 。]

english: If that doesn't interest you, perhaps another reward might be more appealing? League Points can be used to buy things from the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: 如果您对此不感兴趣，也许其他奖励可能更有吸引力？联盟积分可以用来从联盟奖励商店购买东西。 [ru guo nin dui ci bu gan xing qu ， ye xu qi ta jiang li ke neng geng you xi yin li ？ lian meng ji fen ke yi yong lai cong lian meng jiang li shang dian gou mai dong xi 。]

english: You can keep these purchases for yourself or sell them on to others!
translation: 您可以自己保留这些购买的物品或将其出售给其他人！ [nin ke yi zi ji bao liu zhe xie gou mai de wu pin huo jiang qi chu shou gei qi ta ren ！]

english: And if glory and rewards don't interest me?
translation: 如果荣耀和奖励我不感兴趣呢？ [ru guo rong yao he jiang li wo bu gan xing qu ne ？]

english: Every League has unique rules and features. It's a very different world from the one you're used to.
translation: 每个联赛都有独特的规则和特点。这是一个与你习惯的世界截然不同的世界。 [mei ge lian sai dou you du te de gui ze he te dian 。 zhe shi yi ge yu ni xi guan de shi jie jie ran bu tong de shi jie 。]

english: For one thing, within the Leagues, you can unlock powerful artefacts known as Relics which completely change the way you progress.
translation: 一方面，在联盟中，您可以解锁被称为遗物的强大文物，这将彻底改变您的进步方式。 [yi fang mian ， zai lian meng zhong ， nin ke yi jie suo bei cheng wei yi wu de qiang da wen wu ， zhe jiang che di gai bian nin de jin bu fang shi 。]

english: So even if glory and rewards aren't your thing, you'll still find Leagues to be a whole lot of fun!
translation: 因此，即使荣耀和奖励不是你的菜，你仍然会发现联赛充满乐趣！ [yin ci ， ji shi rong yao he jiang li bu shi ni de cai ， ni reng ran hui fa xian lian sai chong man le qu ！]

english: I see, thanks for the information.
translation: 我明白了，谢谢你的信息。 [wo ming bai le ， xie xie ni de xin xi 。]

english: My pleasure!
translation: 我的荣幸！ [wo de rong xing ！]

english: Is there currently a League running?
translation: 目前有联赛在进行吗？ [mu qian you lian sai zai jin xing ma ？]

english: Yes! The current League is Leagues IV: Trailblazer Reloaded.
translation: 是的！目前的联赛是联赛 IV：开拓者重装上阵。 [shi de ！ mu qian de lian sai shi lian sai  IV： kai tuo zhe zhong zhuang shang zhen 。]

english: Within this League you are restricted to certain regions around Gielinor - although you'll get to choose which ones.
translation: 在这个联盟中，你被限制在吉林诺周围的某些地区 - 尽管你可以选择哪些地区。 [zai zhe ge lian meng zhong ， ni bei xian zhi zai ji lin nuo zhou wei de mou xie di qu  -  jin guan ni ke yi xuan ze na xie di qu 。]

english: You can also collect powerful artefacts known as Relics. Each one provides a different buff to your League experience.
translation: 您还可以收集被称为遗物的强大文物。每一种都为您的联盟体验提供不同的增益。 [nin hai ke yi shou ji bei cheng wei yi wu de qiang da wen wu 。 mei yi zhong dou wei nin de lian meng ti yan ti gong bu tong de zeng yi 。]

english: I heard there's one that lets you note items wherever you want, and one that makes shops free!
translation: 我听说有一种可以让你在任何地方记下物品，还有一种可以让商店免费！ [wo ting shuo you yi zhong ke yi rang ni zai ren he di fang ji xia wu pin ， hai you yi zhong ke yi rang shang dian mian fei ！]

english: One other thing. You must participate as an Iron Man. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.
translation: 另一件事。您必须以钢铁侠的身份参加。这意味着您是孤立的，无法与其他参与者进行交易。 [ling yi jian shi 。 nin bi xu yi gang tie xia de shen fen can jia 。 zhe yi wei zhe nin shi gu li de ， wu fa yu qi ta can yu zhe jin xing jiao yi 。]

english: Interesting. Maybe I should take part!
translation: 有趣的。也许我应该参加！ [you qu de 。 ye xu wo ying gai can jia ！]

english: I'd highly recommend it!
translation: 我强烈推荐它！ [wo qiang lie tui jian ta ！]

english: Can I purchase some League rewards?
translation: 我可以购买一些联赛奖励吗？ [wo ke yi gou mai yi xie lian sai jiang li ma ？]

english: Certainly! I have a number of unique rewards which you might be interested in.
translation: 当然！我有许多您可能感兴趣的独特奖励。 [dang ran ！ wo you xu duo nin ke neng gan xing qu de du te jiang li 。]

english: Can we talk about League Trophies?
translation: 我们能谈谈联赛奖杯吗？ [wo men neng tan tan lian sai jiang bei ma ？]

english: Of course! What would you like to know?
translation: 当然！您想知道什么？ [dang ran ！ nin xiang zhi dao shen me ？]

english: How do League Trophies work?
translation: 联赛奖杯如何运作？ [lian sai jiang bei ru he yun zuo ？]

english: League Trophies are a representation of how well you did in a specific League. Performance is judged on the number of League Points you earned.
translation: 联赛奖杯代表了您在特定联赛中的表现。表现是根据您获得的联赛积分来判断的。 [lian sai jiang bei dai biao le nin zai te ding lian sai zhong de biao xian 。 biao xian shi gen ju nin huo de de lian sai ji fen lai pan duan de 。]

english: There are seven tiers of League Trophy: Bronze, Iron, Steel, Mithril, Adamant, Rune and Dragon.
translation: 联盟奖杯有七个等级：青铜、铁、钢、秘银、精金、符文和龙。 [lian meng jiang bei you qi ge deng ji ： qing tong 、 tie 、 gang 、 mi yin 、 jing jin 、 fu wen he long 。]

translation: 联赛 I：扭曲。 [lian sai  I： niu qu 。]

translation: 铜杯的分数线为 10 分。铁奖杯的分数线是80分。钢铁奖杯的分数线是510分。 [tong bei de fen shu xian wei  10  fen 。 tie jiang bei de fen shu xian shi 80 fen 。 gang tie jiang bei de fen shu xian shi 510 fen 。]

english: The Mithril Trophy cut-off is 1,770 points. The Adamant Trophy cut-off is 5,270 points. The Rune Trophy cut-off is 10,820 points.
translation: 秘银奖杯的分数线是 1,770 点。 Adamant Trophy 的分数线为 5,270 分。符文奖杯的截止点是 10,820 点。 [mi yin jiang bei de fen shu xian shi  1,770  dian 。 Adamant Trophy  de fen shu xian wei  5,270  fen 。 fu wen jiang bei de jie zhi dian shi  10,820  dian 。]

translation: 最后，龙奖杯的截止点是20,830分。 [zui hou ， long jiang bei de jie zhi dian shi 20,830 fen 。]

translation: 您在联赛 I：Twisted 中获得了 [number] 联赛积分。遗憾的是，这意味着您没有资格获得任何扭曲奖杯。 [nin zai lian sai  I：Twisted  zhong huo de le  [number]  lian sai ji fen 。 yi han de shi ， zhe yi wei zhe nin mei you zi ge huo de ren he niu qu jiang bei 。]

translation: 您在联赛 I：Twisted 中获得了 [number] 联赛积分。这使您有资格获得[奖杯]及其下的所有扭曲奖杯！ [nin zai lian sai  I：Twisted  zhong huo de le  [number]  lian sai ji fen 。 zhe shi nin you zi ge huo de [ jiang bei ] ji qi xia de suo you niu qu jiang bei ！]

translation: 联赛 II：开拓者。 [lian sai  II： kai tuo zhe 。]

translation: 铜杯的分数线是100分。铁奖杯的分数线是510分。钢铁奖杯的分数线为 2,000 分。 [tong bei de fen shu xian shi 100 fen 。 tie jiang bei de fen shu xian shi 510 fen 。 gang tie jiang bei de fen shu xian wei  2,000  fen 。]

english: The Mithril Trophy cut-off is 6,480 points. The Adamant Trophy cut-off is 18,720 points. The Rune Trophy cut-off is 35,680 points.
translation: 秘银奖杯的分数线是 6,480 点。 Adamant Trophy 的分数线为 18,720 分。符文奖杯的截止点是 35,680 点。 [mi yin jiang bei de fen shu xian shi  6,480  dian 。 Adamant Trophy  de fen shu xian wei  18,720  fen 。 fu wen jiang bei de jie zhi dian shi  35,680  dian 。]

english: Finally, the Dragon Trophy cut-off is 56,310 points.
translation: 最后，龙奖杯的截止点是56,310分。 [zui hou ， long jiang bei de jie zhi dian shi 56,310 fen 。]

translation: 您在联赛 II：开拓者中获得了 [number] 个联赛积分。遗憾的是，这意味着您没有资格获得任何开拓者奖杯。 [nin zai lian sai  II： kai tuo zhe zhong huo de le  [number]  ge lian sai ji fen 。 yi han de shi ， zhe yi wei zhe nin mei you zi ge huo de ren he kai tuo zhe jiang bei 。]

english: You earned [number] League Points in Leagues II: Trailblazer. That makes you eligible for the [trophy] and all Trailblazer Trophies under it!
translation: 您在联赛 II：开拓者中获得了 [number] 个联赛积分。这使您有资格获得[奖杯]及其下的所有开拓者奖杯！ [nin zai lian sai  II： kai tuo zhe zhong huo de le  [number]  ge lian sai ji fen 。 zhe shi nin you zi ge huo de [ jiang bei ] ji qi xia de suo you kai tuo zhe jiang bei ！]

english: The Mithril Trophy cut-off is 5,475 points. The Adamant Trophy cut-off is 15,575 points. The Rune Trophy cut-off is 31,980 points.
translation: 秘银奖杯的分数线是 5,475 分。 Adamant Trophy 的分数线为 15,575 分。符文奖杯的截止点是 31,980 点。 [mi yin jiang bei de fen shu xian shi  5,475  fen 。 Adamant Trophy  de fen shu xian wei  15,575  fen 。 fu wen jiang bei de jie zhi dian shi  31,980  dian 。]

translation: 最后，龙杯的截止点是52,545分。 [zui hou ， long bei de jie zhi dian shi 52,545 fen 。]

english: Leagues IV: Trailblazer Reloaded.
translation: 联赛 IV：开拓者重装上阵。 [lian sai  IV： kai tuo zhe zhong zhuang shang zhen 。]

translation: 铜杯的分数线为 2,500 分。铁奖杯的分数线为 5,000 分。钢铁奖杯的分数线为 10,000 分。 [tong bei de fen shu xian wei  2,500  fen 。 tie jiang bei de fen shu xian wei  5,000  fen 。 gang tie jiang bei de fen shu xian wei  10,000  fen 。]

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello there. I'm the Leagues Assistant. I help the Leagues Tutor out. You'll find him just outside of Lumbridge Castle if you want to speak to him.
translation: 你好呀。我是联盟助理。我帮助联赛导师。如果您想与他交谈，您可以在朗布里奇城堡外找到他。 [ni hao ya 。 wo shi lian meng zhu li 。 wo bang zhu lian sai dao shi 。 ru guo nin xiang yu ta jiao tan ， nin ke yi zai lang bu li qi cheng bao wai zhao dao ta 。]

english: You can find the Leagues Tutor by looking for his icon on your map.
translation: 您可以通过在地图上查找联赛导师的图标来找到他。 [nin ke yi tong guo zai di tu shang cha zhao lian sai dao shi de tu biao lai zhao dao ta 。]

english: Hello there. Do you have any questions about Leagues?
translation: 你好呀。您对联赛有任何疑问吗？ [ni hao ya 。 nin dui lian sai you ren he yi wen ma ？]

english: What's a League?
translation: 什么是联盟？ [shen me shi lian meng ？]

english: Leagues are time-limited challenges that provide a unique twist on the world you know and love.
translation: 联赛是限时挑战，为您所熟悉和喜爱的世界带来独特的变化。 [lian sai shi xian shi tiao zhan ， wei nin suo shu xi he xi ai de shi jie dai lai du te de bian hua 。]

english: With each League, you start afresh, with a limited amount of time to progress through the League.
translation: 在每个联赛中，您都需要重新开始，并在有限的时间内完成联赛。 [zai mei ge lian sai zhong ， nin dou xu yao chong xin kai shi ， bing zai you xian de shi jian nei wan cheng lian sai 。]

english: A fresh start? Why would I want that?
translation: 一个新的开始？我为什么想要那个？ [yi ge xin de kai shi ？ wo wei shen me xiang yao na ge ？]

english: Glory, gold, and the chance to do things in a different way!
translation: 荣耀、黄金和以不同方式做事的机会！ [rong yao 、 huang jin he yi bu tong fang shi zuo shi de ji hui ！]

english: First up, the glory. Within a League, you can earn League Points by completing various tasks.
translation: 首先，荣耀。在联盟内，您可以通过完成各种任务来赚取联盟积分。 [shou xian ， rong yao 。 zai lian meng nei ， nin ke yi tong guo wan cheng ge zhong ren wu lai zhuan qu lian meng ji fen 。]

english: The more points you have at the end of the League, the better League Rank you will be given.
translation: 联赛结束时您拥有的积分越多，您获得的联赛排名就越高。 [lian sai jie shu shi nin yong you de ji fen yue duo ， nin huo de de lian sai pai ming jiu yue gao 。]

english: Each League Rank will unlock a trophy for you. These trophies can be used to show off your accomplishments.
translation: 每个联赛排名都会为您解锁一个奖杯。这些奖杯可以用来炫耀您的成就。 [mei ge lian sai pai ming du hui wei nin jie suo yi ge jiang bei 。 zhe xie jiang bei ke yi yong lai xuan yao nin de cheng jiu 。]

english: If that doesn't interest you, how about gold! League Points can be used to buy things from the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: 如果您对此不感兴趣，那么黄金怎么样？联盟积分可以用来从联盟奖励商店购买东西。 [ru guo nin dui ci bu gan xing qu ， na me huang jin zen me yang ？ lian meng ji fen ke yi yong lai cong lian meng jiang li shang dian gou mai dong xi 。]

english: You can keep these purchases for yourself or sell them on to others!
translation: 您可以自己保留这些购买的物品或将其出售给其他人！ [nin ke yi zi ji bao liu zhe xie gou mai de wu pin huo jiang qi chu shou gei qi ta ren ！]

english: And if glory and gold don't interest me?
translation: 如果荣耀和黄金对我不感兴趣呢？ [ru guo rong yao he huang jin dui wo bu gan xing qu ne ？]

english: Every League has unique rules and features. It's a very different world from the one you're used to.
translation: 每个联赛都有独特的规则和特点。这是一个与你习惯的世界截然不同的世界。 [mei ge lian sai dou you du te de gui ze he te dian 。 zhe shi yi ge yu ni xi guan de shi jie jie ran bu tong de shi jie 。]

english: For one thing, within the Leagues, you can unlock powerful artefacts known as Relics which completely change the way you progress.
translation: 一方面，在联盟中，您可以解锁被称为遗物的强大文物，这将彻底改变您的进步方式。 [yi fang mian ， zai lian meng zhong ， nin ke yi jie suo bei cheng wei yi wu de qiang da wen wu ， zhe jiang che di gai bian nin de jin bu fang shi 。]

english: I see, thanks for the information.
translation: 我明白了，谢谢你的信息。 [wo ming bai le ， xie xie ni de xin xi 。]

english: My pleasure!
translation: 我的荣幸！ [wo de rong xing ！]

english: Is there currently a League running?
translation: 目前有联赛在进行吗？ [mu qian you lian sai zai jin xing ma ？]

english: There is currently no League running.
translation: 目前没有联赛正在运行。 [mu qian mei you lian sai zheng zai yun xing 。]

english: Can I purchase some League rewards?
translation: 我可以购买一些联赛奖励吗？ [wo ke yi gou mai yi xie lian sai jiang li ma ？]

english: Certainly! I have a number of unique rewards which you might be interested in.
translation: 当然！我有许多您可能感兴趣的独特奖励。 [dang ran ！ wo you xu duo nin ke neng gan xing qu de du te jiang li 。]

english: Can we talk about League Trophies?
translation: 我们能谈谈联赛奖杯吗？ [wo men neng tan tan lian sai jiang bei ma ？]

english: Of course! What would you like to know?
translation: 当然！您想知道什么？ [dang ran ！ nin xiang zhi dao shen me ？]

english: How do League Trophies work?
translation: 联赛奖杯如何运作？ [lian sai jiang bei ru he yun zuo ？]

english: League Trophies are a representation of how well you did in a specific League. Performance is judged on the number of League Points you earned.
translation: 联赛奖杯代表了您在特定联赛中的表现。表现是根据您获得的联赛积分来判断的。 [lian sai jiang bei dai biao le nin zai te ding lian sai zhong de biao xian 。 biao xian shi gen ju nin huo de de lian sai ji fen lai pan duan de 。]

english: There are seven tiers of League Trophy: Bronze, Iron, Steel, Mithril, Adamant, Rune and Dragon.
translation: 联盟奖杯有七个等级：青铜、铁、钢、秘银、精金、符文和龙。 [lian meng jiang bei you qi ge deng ji ： qing tong 、 tie 、 gang 、 mi yin 、 jing jin 、 fu wen he long 。]

english: I'd like to claim some League Trophies.
translation: 我想获得一些联赛奖杯。 [wo xiang huo de yi xie lian sai jiang bei 。]

english: What are the League Point cut-offs for the League Trophies?
translation: 联赛奖杯的联赛积分截止点是多少？ [lian sai jiang bei de lian sai ji fen jie zhi dian shi duo shao ？]

english: Which League do you want to know about?
translation: 您想了解哪个联赛？ [nin xiang liao jie na ge lian sai ？]

english: Leagues I - Twisted.
translation: 联赛 I - 扭曲。 [lian sai  I -  niu qu 。]

english: The Bronze Trophy cut-off is 10 points. The Iron Trophy cut-off is 80 points. The Steel Trophy cut-off is 510 points.
translation: 铜杯的分数线为 10 分。铁奖杯的分数线是80分。钢铁奖杯的分数线是510分。 [tong bei de fen shu xian wei  10  fen 。 tie jiang bei de fen shu xian shi 80 fen 。 gang tie jiang bei de fen shu xian shi 510 fen 。]

english: The Mithril Trophy cut-off is 1,770 points. The Adamant Trophy cut-off is 5,270 points. The Rune Trophy cut-off is 10,820 points.
translation: 秘银奖杯的分数线是 1,770 点。 Adamant Trophy 的分数线为 5,270 分。符文奖杯的截止点是 10,820 点。 [mi yin jiang bei de fen shu xian shi  1,770  dian 。 Adamant Trophy  de fen shu xian wei  5,270  fen 。 fu wen jiang bei de jie zhi dian shi  10,820  dian 。]

english: Finally, the Dragon Trophy cut-off is 20,830 points.
translation: 最后，龙奖杯的截止点是20,830分。 [zui hou ， long jiang bei de jie zhi dian shi 20,830 fen 。]

english: You earned 0 League Points in Leagues I: Twisted. Sadly, that means you are not eligible for any Twisted Trophies.
translation: 您在联赛 I：Twisted 中获得 0 联赛积分。遗憾的是，这意味着您没有资格获得任何扭曲奖杯。 [nin zai lian sai  I：Twisted  zhong huo de  0  lian sai ji fen 。 yi han de shi ， zhe yi wei zhe nin mei you zi ge huo de ren he niu qu jiang bei 。]

english: You earned [number] League Points in Leagues I - Twisted. That makes you eligible for the Twisted [type] Trophy and all Twisted Trophies under it!
translation: 您在联赛 I - Twisted 中获得了 [number] 联赛积分。这使您有资格获得扭曲[类型]奖杯以及其下的所有扭曲奖杯！ [nin zai lian sai  I - Twisted  zhong huo de le  [number]  lian sai ji fen 。 zhe shi nin you zi ge huo de niu qu [ lei xing ] jiang bei yi ji qi xia de suo you niu qu jiang bei ！]

english: Leagues II - Trailblazer.
translation: 联赛 II - 开拓者。 [lian sai  II -  kai tuo zhe 。]

english: The Bronze Trophy cut-off is 100 points. The Iron Trophy cut-off is 510 points. The Steel Trophy cut-off is 2,000 points.
translation: 铜杯的分数线是100分。铁奖杯的分数线是510分。钢铁奖杯的分数线为 2,000 分。 [tong bei de fen shu xian shi 100 fen 。 tie jiang bei de fen shu xian shi 510 fen 。 gang tie jiang bei de fen shu xian wei  2,000  fen 。]

english: The Mithril Trophy cut-off is 6,480 points. The Adamant Trophy cut-off is 18,720 points. The Rune Trophy cut-off is 35,680 points.
translation: 秘银奖杯的分数线是 6,480 点。 Adamant Trophy 的分数线为 18,720 分。符文奖杯的截止点是 35,680 点。 [mi yin jiang bei de fen shu xian shi  6,480  dian 。 Adamant Trophy  de fen shu xian wei  18,720  fen 。 fu wen jiang bei de jie zhi dian shi  35,680  dian 。]

english: Finally, the Dragon Trophy cut-off is 56,310 points.
translation: 最后，龙奖杯的截止点是56,310分。 [zui hou ， long jiang bei de jie zhi dian shi 56,310 fen 。]

english: You earned 0 League Points in Leagues II: Trailblazer. Sadly, that means you are not eligible for any Trailblazer Trophies.
translation: 您在联赛 II：开拓者中获得 0 联赛积分。遗憾的是，这意味着您没有资格获得任何开拓者奖杯。 [nin zai lian sai  II： kai tuo zhe zhong huo de  0  lian sai ji fen 。 yi han de shi ， zhe yi wei zhe nin mei you zi ge huo de ren he kai tuo zhe jiang bei 。]

english: You earned [number] League Points in Leagues II - Trailblazer. That makes you eligible for the Trailblazer [type] Trophy and all Trailblazer Trophies under it!
translation: 您在联赛 II - 开拓者中获得了 [number] 联赛积分。这使您有资格获得开拓者[类型]奖杯以及其下的所有开拓者奖杯！ [nin zai lian sai  II -  kai tuo zhe zhong huo de le  [number]  lian sai ji fen 。 zhe shi nin you zi ge huo de kai tuo zhe [ lei xing ] jiang bei yi ji qi xia de suo you kai tuo zhe jiang bei ！]

english: Leagues III: Shattered Relics.
translation: 联赛 III：破碎的遗迹。 [lian sai  III： po sui de yi ji 。]

english: The Bronze Trophy cut-off is 100 points. The Iron Trophy cut-off is 480 points. The Steel Trophy cut-off is 1,660 points.
translation: 铜杯的分数线是100分。铁奖杯的分数线是480分。钢铁奖杯的分数线为 1,660 分。 [tong bei de fen shu xian shi 100 fen 。 tie jiang bei de fen shu xian shi 480 fen 。 gang tie jiang bei de fen shu xian wei  1,660  fen 。]

english: The Mithril Trophy cut-off is 5,475 points. The Adamant Trophy cut-off is 15,575 points. The Rune Trophy cut-off is 31,980 points.
translation: 秘银奖杯的分数线是 5,475 分。 Adamant Trophy 的分数线为 15,575 分。符文奖杯的截止点是 31,980 点。 [mi yin jiang bei de fen shu xian shi  5,475  fen 。 Adamant Trophy  de fen shu xian wei  15,575  fen 。 fu wen jiang bei de jie zhi dian shi  31,980  dian 。]

english: Finally, the Dragon Trophy cut-off is 52,545 points.
translation: 最后，龙杯的截止点是52,545分。 [zui hou ， long bei de jie zhi dian shi 52,545 fen 。]

english: You earned 0 League Points in Leagues III: Shattered Relics. Sadly, that means you are not eligible for any Shattered Relics Trophies.
translation: 您在联赛 III：破碎遗迹中获得 0 联赛积分。遗憾的是，这意味着您没有资格获得任何破碎文物奖杯。 [nin zai lian sai  III： po sui yi ji zhong huo de  0  lian sai ji fen 。 yi han de shi ， zhe yi wei zhe nin mei you zi ge huo de ren he po sui wen wu jiang bei 。]

english: Leagues IV: Trailblazer Reloaded.
translation: 联赛 IV：开拓者重装上阵。 [lian sai  IV： kai tuo zhe zhong zhuang shang zhen 。]

english: The Bronze Trophy cut-off is 2,500 points. The Iron Trophy cut-off is 5,000 points. The Steel Trophy cut- off is 10,000 points.
translation: 铜杯的分数线为 2,500 分。铁奖杯的分数线为 5,000 分。钢铁奖杯的分数线为 10,000 分。 [tong bei de fen shu xian wei  2,500  fen 。 tie jiang bei de fen shu xian wei  5,000  fen 。 gang tie jiang bei de fen shu xian wei  10,000  fen 。]

english: The Mithril Trophy cut-off is 18,000 points. The Adamant Trophy cut-off is 28,000 points. The Rune Trophy cut-off is 42,000 points.
translation: 秘银奖杯的截止点是 18,000 点。 Adamant Trophy 的分数线为 28,000 分。符文奖杯的截止点是 42,000 点。 [mi yin jiang bei de jie zhi dian shi  18,000  dian 。 Adamant Trophy  de fen shu xian wei  28,000  fen 。 fu wen jiang bei de jie zhi dian shi  42,000  dian 。]

english: You earned 0 League Points in Leagues IV: Trailblazer Reloaded. Sadly, that means you are not eligible for any Trailblazer Reloaded Trophies.
translation: 您在联赛 IV：开拓者重装上阵中获得 0 联赛积分。遗憾的是，这意味着您没有资格获得任何开拓者重装上阵奖杯。 [nin zai lian sai  IV： kai tuo zhe zhong zhuang shang zhen zhong huo de  0  lian sai ji fen 。 yi han de shi ， zhe yi wei zhe nin mei you zi ge huo de ren he kai tuo zhe zhong zhuang shang zhen jiang bei 。]

english: Actually, let's talk about something else.
translation: 其实我们还是聊点别的吧。 [qi shi wo men hai shi liao dian bie de ba 。]

english: Very well.
translation: 很好。 [hen hao 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: All the best.
translation: 一切顺利。 [yi qie shun li 。]

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Very well. I'll be here if you ever need to know anything more.
translation: 很好。如果您需要了解更多信息，我会在这里。 [hen hao 。 ru guo nin xu yao liao jie geng duo xin xi ， wo hui zai zhe li 。]

english: Glory, rewards, and the chance to do things in a different way!
translation: 荣耀、奖励和以不同方式做事的机会！ [rong yao 、 jiang li he yi bu tong fang shi zuo shi de ji hui ！]

english: The more points you have, the better League Rank you will be given.
translation: 您拥有的积分越多，您获得的联赛排名就越高。 [nin yong you de ji fen yue duo ， nin huo de de lian sai pai ming jiu yue gao 。]

english: If that doesn't interest you, perhaps another reward might be more appealing? League Points can be used to buy things from the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: 如果您对此不感兴趣，也许其他奖励可能更有吸引力？联盟积分可以用来从联盟奖励商店购买东西。 [ru guo nin dui ci bu gan xing qu ， ye xu qi ta jiang li ke neng geng you xi yin li ？ lian meng ji fen ke yi yong lai cong lian meng jiang li shang dian gou mai dong xi 。]

english: And if glory and rewards don't interest me?
translation: 如果荣耀和奖励我不感兴趣呢？ [ru guo rong yao he jiang li wo bu gan xing qu ne ？]

english: So even if glory and rewards aren't your thing, you'll still find Leagues to be a whole lot of fun!
translation: 因此，即使荣耀和奖励不是你的菜，你仍然会发现联赛充满乐趣！ [yin ci ， ji shi rong yao he jiang li bu shi ni de cai ， ni reng ran hui fa xian lian sai chong man le qu ！]

english: I see. So how do I take part?
translation: 我懂了。那么我该如何参加呢？ [wo dong le 。 na me wo gai ru he can jia ne ？]

english: Well sadly, only Members are eligible to take part in Leagues. I'll be happy to help once you become one.
translation: 遗憾的是，只有会员才有资格参加联赛。一旦您成为其中一员，我将很乐意为您提供帮助。 [yi han de shi ， zhi you hui yuan cai you zi ge can jia lian sai 。 yi dan nin cheng wei qi zhong yi yuan ， wo jiang hen le yi wei nin ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: Do you have anything to trade?
translation: 你有什么东西可以交易吗？ [ni you shen me dong xi ke yi jiao yi ma ？]

english: Unfortunately I'm unable to trade with non-members. I'll be happy to help once you are one.
translation: 不幸的是，我无法与非会员进行交易。一旦你成为其中一员，我将很乐意为你提供帮助。 [bu xing de shi ， wo wu fa yu fei hui yuan jin xing jiao yi 。 yi dan ni cheng wei qi zhong yi yuan ， wo jiang hen le yi wei ni ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: Yes! The current League is Leagues V: Raging Echoes.
translation: 是的！目前的联赛是联赛 V：狂怒回响。 [shi de ！ mu qian de lian sai shi lian sai  V： kuang nu hui xiang 。]

english: This League features powerful boss variants in each region, and Combat Masteries to enhance your chosen combat style's strengths.
translation: 该联盟在每个地区都有强大的头目变体，并且战斗精通可以增强您选择的战斗风格的优势。 [gai lian meng zai mei ge di qu dou you qiang da de tou mu bian ti ， bing qie zhan dou jing tong ke yi zeng qiang nin xuan ze de zhan dou feng ge de you shi 。]

english: As usual, you are restricted to certain regions around Gielinor - although you'll get to choose which ones.
translation: 像往常一样，你被限制在吉林诺周围的某些区域 - 尽管你可以选择哪些区域。 [xiang wang chang yi yang ， ni bei xian zhi zai ji lin nuo zhou wei de mou xie qu yu  -  jin guan ni ke yi xuan ze na xie qu yu 。]

english: You can also collect powerful artifacts known as Relics. Each one provides a different buff to your League experience.
translation: 您还可以收集被称为遗物的强大文物。每一种都为您的联盟体验提供不同的增益。 [nin hai ke yi shou ji bei cheng wei yi wu de qiang da wen wu 。 mei yi zhong dou wei nin de lian meng ti yan ti gong bu tong de zeng yi 。]

english: There's one that lets you keep a kingdom in your pocket, and one that lets you become a Slayer Master!
translation: 有一个可以让你把一个王国装在口袋里，还有一个可以让你成为一名杀手大师！ [you yi ge ke yi rang ni ba yi ge wang guo zhuang zai kou dai li ， hai you yi ge ke yi rang ni cheng wei yi ming sha shou da shi ！]

english: One other thing. You must participate as an Ironman. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.
translation: 另一件事。您必须以铁人三项身份参加。这意味着您是孤立的，无法与其他参与者进行交易。 [ling yi jian shi 。 nin bi xu yi tie ren san xiang shen fen can jia 。 zhe yi wei zhe nin shi gu li de ， wu fa yu qi ta can yu zhe jin xing jiao yi 。]

english: Interesting. Maybe I should take part!
translation: 有趣的。也许我应该参加！ [you qu de 。 ye xu wo ying gai can jia ！]

english: I'd highly recommend it!
translation: 我强烈推荐它！ [wo qiang lie tui jian ta ！]

english: What's a League?
translation: 什么是联盟？ [shen me shi lian meng ？]

english: Is there currently a League running?
translation: 目前有联赛在进行吗？ [mu qian you lian sai zai jin xing ma ？]

translation: 我可以购买一些联赛奖励吗？ [wo ke yi gou mai yi xie lian sai jiang li ma ？]

translation: 我们能谈谈联赛奖杯吗？ [wo men neng tan tan lian sai jiang bei ma ？]

translation: 联赛奖杯如何运作？ [lian sai jiang bei ru he yun zuo ？]

translation: 我想获得一些联赛奖杯。 [wo xiang huo de yi xie lian sai jiang bei 。]

english: What are the League Point cut-offs for the League Trophies?
translation: 联赛奖杯的联赛积分截止点是多少？ [lian sai jiang bei de lian sai ji fen jie zhi dian shi duo shao ？]

english: Leagues I - Twisted.
translation: 联赛 I - 扭曲。 [lian sai  I -  niu qu 。]

english: Leagues II - Trailblazer.
translation: 联赛 II - 开拓者。 [lian sai  II -  kai tuo zhe 。]

english: Leagues III: Shattered Relics
translation: 联赛 III：破碎的遗迹 [lian sai  III： po sui de yi ji]

english: Leagues IV: Trailblazer Reloaded.
translation: 联赛 IV：开拓者重装上阵。 [lian sai  IV： kai tuo zhe zhong zhuang shang zhen 。]

english: Actually, let's talk about something else.
translation: 其实我们还是聊点别的吧。 [qi shi wo men hai shi liao dian bie de ba 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello! Do you have any questions for me?
translation: 你好！你有什么问题要问我吗？ [ni hao ！ ni you shen me wen ti yao wen wo ma ？]

english: What changes have been made for this League?
translation: 本次联赛有哪些变化？ [ben ci lian sai you na xie bian hua ？]

english: All sorts of things! I can't recount all of the information for you, but I can give you the basics though.
translation: 各种各样的事情！我无法为您重述所有信息，但我可以为您提供基础知识。 [ge zhong ge yang de shi qing ！ wo wu fa wei nin chong shu suo you xin xi ， dan wo ke yi wei nin ti gong ji chu zhi shi 。]

english: During this League, you are initially restricted to the Kingdom of Misthalin. However, as you progress, you'll be able to unlock new areas of your choosing.
translation: 在此联盟期间，您最初被限制在米沙林王国。然而，随着你的进步，你将能够解锁你选择的新领域。 [zai ci lian meng qi jian ， nin zui chu bei xian zhi zai mi sha lin wang guo 。 ran er ， sui zhe ni de jin bu ， ni jiang neng gou jie suo ni xuan ze de xin ling yu 。]

english: Be warned though - you won't be able to unlock every area, so choose wisely.
translation: 但请注意 - 您将无法解锁每个区域，因此请明智地选择。 [dan qing zhu yi  -  nin jiang wu fa jie suo mei ge qu yu ， yin ci qing ming zhi di xuan ze 。]

english: Now, for the entire League, you must participate as an Iron Man. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.
translation: 现在，对于整个联盟，你必须以钢铁侠的身份参与。这意味着您是孤立的，无法与其他参与者进行交易。 [xian zai ， dui yu zheng ge lian meng ， ni bi xu yi gang tie xia de shen fen can yu 。 zhe yi wei zhe nin shi gu li de ， wu fa yu qi ta can yu zhe jin xing jiao yi 。]

english: And that's not all. Training skills during the League will grant you substantially more experience than you'd normally expect!
translation: 这还不是全部。联赛期间的技能训练将为您提供比您通常预期更多的经验！ [zhe hai bu shi quan bu 。 lian sai qi jian de ji neng xun lian jiang wei nin ti gong bi nin tong chang yu qi geng duo de jing yan ！]

english: Finally, some quests have been completed for you automatically. Further quests will be completed as you unlock the relevant areas.
translation: 最后，一些任务已经自动为你完成。当您解锁相关区域时，将完成更多任务。 [zui hou ， yi xie ren wu yi jing zi dong wei ni wan cheng 。 dang nin jie suo xiang guan qu yu shi ， jiang wan cheng geng duo ren wu 。]

english: I think that covers the basics. Would you like to see some more in-depth information?
translation: 我认为这涵盖了基础知识。您想查看一些更深入的信息吗？ [wo ren wei zhe han gai le ji chu zhi shi 。 nin xiang cha kan yi xie geng shen ru de xin xi ma ？]

english: Yes, please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Not right now.
translation: 现在不行。 [xian zai bu xing 。]

english: Fair enough. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 很公平。还有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [hen gong ping 。 hai you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

english: How do tasks work?
translation: 任务如何进行？ [ren wu ru he jin xing ？]

english: In every League, there are a number of tasks for you to complete. Each task has a level of difficulty: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite and Master.
translation: 在每个联赛中，都有许多任务等待您完成。每个任务都有一个难度级别：简单、中等、困难、精英和大师。 [zai mei ge lian sai zhong ， dou you xu duo ren wu deng dai nin wan cheng 。 mei ge ren wu dou you yi ge nan du ji bie ： jian dan 、 zhong deng 、 kun nan 、 jing ying he da shi 。]

english: Completing tasks allows you to access new areas. The more tasks completed, the more areas available to unlock.
translation: 完成任务可以让你进入新的领域。完成的任务越多，可解锁的区域就越多。 [wan cheng ren wu ke yi rang ni jin ru xin de ling yu 。 wan cheng de ren wu yue duo ， ke jie suo de qu yu jiu yue duo 。]

english: Not only that, completing tasks also earns you League Points. The number of points earned is dependent on the difficulty of the task.
translation: 不仅如此，完成任务还可以获得联盟积分。获得的积分数量取决于任务的难度。 [bu jin ru ci ， wan cheng ren wu hai ke yi huo de lian meng ji fen 。 huo de de ji fen shu liang qu jue yu ren wu de nan du 。]

english: What do these points do?
translation: 这些点有什么作用呢？ [zhe xie dian you shen me zuo yong ne ？]

english: Once you have achieved a certain amount of League Points you can unlock a new Relic! These are powerful artefacts to help you in the League.
translation: 一旦您获得一定数量的联盟积分，您就可以解锁新的遗物！这些都是强大的神器，可以在联盟中帮助你。 [yi dan nin huo de yi ding shu liang de lian meng ji fen ， nin jiu ke yi jie suo xin de yi wu ！ zhe xie dou shi qiang da de shen qi ， ke yi zai lian meng zhong bang zhu ni 。]

english: League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: 联盟积分还可用于从联盟奖励商店购买奖励。 [lian meng ji fen hai ke yong yu cong lian meng jiang li shang dian gou mai jiang li 。]

english: Right now, you are playing on your Leagues profile. The Leagues Reward Shop can only be opened on your main profile.
translation: 现在，您正在使用您的联赛个人资料进行比赛。联赛奖励商店只能在您的主要个人资料上打开。 [xian zai ， nin zheng zai shi yong nin de lian sai ge ren zi liao jin xing bi sai 。 lian sai jiang li shang dian zhi neng zai nin de zhu yao ge ren zi liao shang da kai 。]

english: You can access your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.
translation: 您可以通过切换到任何正常的 Old School RuneScape 世界来访问您的主要个人资料。注销菜单中的世界切换器可用于切换世界。 [nin ke yi tong guo qie huan dao ren he zheng chang de  Old School RuneScape  shi jie lai fang wen nin de zhu yao ge ren zi liao 。 zhu xiao cai dan zhong de shi jie qie huan qi ke yong yu qie huan shi jie 。]

english: So how many tasks are there?
translation: 那么有多少个任务呢？ [na me you duo shao ge ren wu ne ？]

english: More than you'll ever be able to complete, most likely. With so many to choose from, it's up to you which ones you go for.
translation: 很可能比你能够完成的还要多。有这么多可供选择，选择哪一个取决于您。 [hen ke neng bi ni neng gou wan cheng de hai yao duo 。 you zhe me duo ke gong xuan ze ， xuan ze na yi ge qu jue yu nin 。]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: Not a problem. Now, would you like to take a look at the tasks for this League?
translation: 不是问题。现在，您想看一下本次联赛的任务吗？ [bu shi wen ti 。 xian zai ， nin xiang kan yi xia ben ci lian sai de ren wu ma ？]

english: How does the area system work?
translation: 区域系统如何运作？ [qu yu xi tong ru he yun zuo ？]

english: In this League, you are initially locked to the Kingdom of Misthalin and the island of Karamja. However, as you progress, you can unlock more areas.
translation: 在这个联盟中，你最初被锁定在米沙林王国和卡拉姆贾岛。然而，随着你的进步，你可以解锁更多区域。 [zai zhe ge lian meng zhong ， ni zui chu bei suo ding zai mi sha lin wang guo he ka la mu jia dao 。 ran er ， sui zhe ni de jin bu ， ni ke yi jie suo geng duo qu yu 。]

english: There are nine different areas in total. However, you can only unlock a maximum of five, including Misthalin and Karamja, so choose wisely.
translation: 总共有九个不同的区域。然而，你最多只能解锁五个，包括 Misthalin 和 Karamja，所以请明智地选择。 [zong gong you jiu ge bu tong de qu yu 。 ran er ， ni zui duo zhi neng jie suo wu ge ， bao kuo  Misthalin  he  Karamja， suo yi qing ming zhi di xuan ze 。]

english: The first two area unlocks are given to everyone. However, the other three unlocks are unavailable to begin with.
translation: 前两个区域解锁已授予所有人。然而，其他三个解锁一开始就无法使用。 [qian liang ge qu yu jie suo yi shou yu suo you ren 。 ran er ， qi ta san ge jie suo yi kai shi jiu wu fa shi yong 。]

english: You can access these additional area unlocks by completing tasks. The more tasks you've completed, the more areas you can unlock.
translation: 您可以通过完成任务来解锁这些额外的区域。您完成的任务越多，可以解锁的区域就越多。 [nin ke yi tong guo wan cheng ren wu lai jie suo zhe xie e wai de qu yu 。 nin wan cheng de ren wu yue duo ， ke yi jie suo de qu yu jiu yue duo 。]

english: I see. Thanks!
translation: 我懂了。谢谢！ [wo dong le 。 xie xie ！]

english: Would you like to take a look at the available areas now?
translation: 您现在想看看可用的区域吗？ [nin xian zai xiang kan kan ke yong de qu yu ma ？]

english: Relics, or Trailblazer Relics to give them their full name, are powerful artefacts that grant unique abilities for the entire League!
translation: 遗物，或者全称开拓者遗物，是强大的文物，赋予整个联盟独特的能力！ [yi wu ， huo zhe quan cheng kai tuo zhe yi wu ， shi qiang da de wen wu ， fu yu zheng ge lian meng du te de neng li ！]

english: There are eighteen separate Relics, split across six different tiers. You can only have one Relic from each tier though.
translation: 有十八个独立的遗物，分为六个不同的层。不过，每一层你只能拥有一件遗物。 [you shi ba ge du li de yi wu ， fen wei liu ge bu tong de ceng 。 bu guo ， mei yi ceng ni zhi neng yong you yi jian yi wu 。]

english: The first Relic tier is available to everyone. However, the higher tiers are locked to begin with.
translation: 第一级遗物可供所有人使用。然而，较高层一开始就被锁定。 [di yi ji yi wu ke gong suo you ren shi yong 。 ran er ， jiao gao ceng yi kai shi jiu bei suo ding 。]

english: You can unlock these higher tiers by earning League Points. League Points are earned by completing tasks.
translation: 您可以通过赚取联盟积分来解锁这些更高的级别。联盟积分是通过完成任务获得的。 [nin ke yi tong guo zhuan qu lian meng ji fen lai jie suo zhe xie geng gao de ji bie 。 lian meng ji fen shi tong guo wan cheng ren wu huo de de 。]

english: Be warned, you'll need to choose carefully when picking a Relic. Once you have selected a Relic, your choice can't be changed for the rest of the League.
translation: 请注意，在挑选遗物时您需要仔细选择。一旦您选择了遗物，您的选择就无法为联盟的其他成员更改。 [qing zhu yi ， zai tiao xuan yi wu shi nin xu yao zi xi xuan ze 。 yi dan nin xuan ze le yi wu ， nin de xuan ze jiu wu fa wei lian meng de qi ta cheng yuan geng gai 。]

english: Anyway, it looks like you have a Relic available for selection right now! Would you like to take a look?
translation: 不管怎样，看起来你现在有一个遗物可供选择！您想看一下吗？ [bu guan zen yang ， kan qi lai ni xian zai you yi ge yi wu ke gong xuan ze ！ nin xiang kan yi xia ma ？]

english: Tell me about League rewards.
translation: 告诉我有关联赛奖励的信息。 [gao su wo you guan lian sai jiang li de xin xi 。]

english: As well as letting you unlock new areas, completing tasks in the League will earn you League Points. The more League Points you have, the more Trailblazer Relic tiers you have available.
translation: 除了让您解锁新区域之外，完成联盟中的任务还将为您赢得联盟积分。您拥有的联盟积分越多，您可用的开拓者遗物等级就越多。 [chu le rang nin jie suo xin qu yu zhi wai ， wan cheng lian meng zhong de ren wu hai jiang wei nin ying de lian meng ji fen 。 nin yong you de lian meng ji fen yue duo ， nin ke yong de kai tuo zhe yi wu deng ji jiu yue duo 。]

english: However, alongside allowing you to unlock Trailblazer Relics, League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: 然而，除了允许您解锁开拓者遗物之外，联盟积分还可以用于从联盟奖励商店购买奖励。 [ran er ， chu le yun xu nin jie suo kai tuo zhe yi wu zhi wai ， lian meng ji fen hai ke yi yong yu cong lian meng jiang li shang dian gou mai jiang li 。]

english: What rewards can I buy?
translation: 我可以购买什么奖励？ [wo ke yi gou mai shen me jiang li ？]

english: All sorts of things! There's some new furniture for your house, an alternate animation for your Home Teleport spell and some new stylish outfits, just to name a few.
translation: 各种各样的事情！你的房子有一些新家具，你的家庭传送咒语的替代动画和一些新的时尚服装，仅举几例。 [ge zhong ge yang de shi qing ！ ni de fang zi you yi xie xin jia ju ， ni de jia ting chuan song zhou yu de ti dai dong hua he yi xie xin de shi shang fu zhuang ， jin ju ji li 。]

english: Most of the rewards can be traded with others, so if you want, you can earn some money by selling them on. Of course, you might prefer to keep them for yourself instead.
translation: 大多数奖励都可以与其他人进行交易，所以如果你愿意，你可以通过出售它们来赚取一些钱。当然，您可能更愿意自己保留它们。 [da duo shu jiang li dou ke yi yu qi ta ren jin xing jiao yi ， suo yi ru guo ni yuan yi ， ni ke yi tong guo chu shou ta men lai zhuan qu yi xie qian 。 dang ran ， nin ke neng geng yuan yi zi ji bao liu ta men 。]

english: I see. That all sounds good to me.
translation: 我懂了。这一切对我来说听起来不错。 [wo dong le 。 zhe yi qie dui wo lai shuo ting qi lai bu cuo 。]

english: One thing to be aware of is that the Trailblazer rewards won't be available until the League has ended. You can still buy rewards from previous Leagues though.
translation: 需要注意的一件事是，开拓者奖励要等到联赛结束后才能获得。不过，您仍然可以购买以前联赛的奖励。 [xu yao zhu yi de yi jian shi shi ， kai tuo zhe jiang li yao deng dao lian sai jie shu hou cai neng huo de 。 bu guo ， nin reng ran ke yi gou mai yi qian lian sai de jiang li 。]

english: Now, alongside the rewards in the Leagues Reward Shop, there's also League Ranks.
translation: 现在，除了联赛奖励商店的奖励之外，还有联赛排名。 [xian zai ， chu le lian sai jiang li shang dian de jiang li zhi wai ， hai you lian sai pai ming 。]

english: League Ranks? How do they work?
translation: 联赛排名？它们如何工作？ [lian sai pai ming ？ ta men ru he gong zuo ？]

english: At the end of the League, you will be given a League Rank. This is based upon the number of League Points you have earned compared to the other participants.
translation: 联赛结束后，您将获得联赛排名。这是基于您与其他参与者相比获得的联盟积分数量。 [lian sai jie shu hou ， nin jiang huo de lian sai pai ming 。 zhe shi ji yu nin yu qi ta can yu zhe xiang bi huo de de lian meng ji fen shu liang 。]

english: Anyone who earns at least 100 League Points will be eligible for the Bronze rank. The top 80% of participants get the Iron rank. The top 60% get Steel.
translation: 任何获得至少 100 联盟积分的人都将有资格获得铜级。前80%的参与者获得铁级。前 60% 的人获得钢铁。 [ren he huo de zhi shao  100  lian meng ji fen de ren dou jiang you zi ge huo de tong ji 。 qian 80% de can yu zhe huo de tie ji 。 qian  60%  de ren huo de gang tie 。]

english: The top 40% get Mithril. The top 20% get Adamant. The top 5% get Rune. The best participants, those who make it to the top 1%, get the Dragon rank!
translation: 前 40% 的人可以获得秘银。前 20% 的人获得 Adamant。前 5% 获得符文。最优秀的参与者，进入前1%的人，将获得龙级！ [qian  40%  de ren ke yi huo de mi yin 。 qian  20%  de ren huo de  Adamant。 qian  5%  huo de fu wen 。 zui you xiu de can yu zhe ， jin ru qian 1% de ren ， jiang huo de long ji ！]

english: When the League ends, your rank will determine what trophy you get. These trophies symbolise your performance in the League.
translation: 当联赛结束时，你的排名将决定你获得的奖杯。这些奖杯象征着你在联赛中的表现。 [dang lian sai jie shu shi ， ni de pai ming jiang jue ding ni huo de de jiang bei 。 zhe xie jiang bei xiang zheng zhe ni zai lian sai zhong de biao xian 。]

english: Trophies?
translation: 奖杯？ [jiang bei ？]

english: That's right. Trophies are items that are given to you after the League. You can use them to show off your League Rank!
translation: 这是正确的。奖杯是联赛结束后给予您的物品。你可以用它们来炫耀你的联赛排名！ [zhe shi zheng que de 。 jiang bei shi lian sai jie shu hou ji yu nin de wu pin 。 ni ke yi yong ta men lai xuan yao ni de lian sai pai ming ！]

english: Connected to League Ranks are the League to League rewards. These are unlocked in the next League based upon the League Rank you earn in this one!
translation: 与联赛排名相关的是联赛之间的奖励。这些将根据您在本赛季中获得的联赛排名在下一个联赛中解锁！ [yu lian sai pai ming xiang guan de shi lian sai zhi jian de jiang li 。 zhe xie jiang gen ju nin zai ben sai ji zhong huo de de lian sai pai ming zai xia yi ge lian sai zhong jie suo ！]

english: League Starter Outfits and League Icons are some of things you can unlock for the next League. Also, any pets you earn in this League will transfer over to the next one.
translation: 联赛首发服装和联赛图标是您可以为下一个联赛解锁的一些东西。此外，您在本联赛中获得的任何宠物都将转移到下一个联赛。 [lian sai shou fa fu zhuang he lian sai tu biao shi nin ke yi wei xia yi ge lian sai jie suo de yi xie dong xi 。 ci wai ， nin zai ben lian sai zhong huo de de ren he chong wu dou jiang zhuan yi dao xia yi ge lian sai 。]

english: Finally, on top of the tasks for this League, there are some other activities for which I will recognise the first person who completes them.
translation: 最后，除了本联盟的任务之外，还有一些其他活动，我将表彰第一个完成这些活动的人。 [zui hou ， chu le ben lian meng de ren wu zhi wai ， hai you yi xie qi ta huo dong ， wo jiang biao zhang di yi ge wan cheng zhe xie huo dong de ren 。]

english: You can view the entire list of activities, as well as whether or not someone has completed them, by reading the board beside me.
translation: 您可以通过阅读我旁边的看板来查看整个活动列表，以及是否有人已完成这些活动。 [nin ke yi tong guo yue du wo pang bian de kan ban lai cha kan zheng ge huo dong lie biao ， yi ji shi fou you ren yi wan cheng zhe xie huo dong 。]

english: Not a problem. Now, is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 不是问题。现在，还有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [bu shi wen ti 。 xian zai ， hai you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

english: Let's talk about pets.
translation: 我们来谈谈宠物吧。 [wo men lai tan tan chong wu ba 。]

english: Can you tell me how pets work in Leagues?
translation: 你能告诉我宠物在联赛中的作用吗？ [ni neng gao su wo chong wu zai lian sai zhong de zuo yong ma ？]

english: Of course! If you're lucky enough to obtain a pet during a League, it will automatically be insured for you.
translation: 当然！如果您有幸在联赛期间获得一只宠物，它会自动为您投保。 [dang ran ！ ru guo nin you xing zai lian sai qi jian huo de yi zhi chong wu ， ta hui zi dong wei nin tou bao 。]

english: This means that if you were to ever lose it, you can talk to me and I'll give it back to you. Insurance and reclaiming is all free!
translation: 这意味着如果您丢失了它，您可以与我交谈，我会将其还给您。保险、理赔全部免费！ [zhe yi wei zhe ru guo nin diu shi le ta ， nin ke yi yu wo jiao tan ， wo hui jiang qi huan gei nin 。 bao xian 、 li pei quan bu mian fei ！]

english: Additionally, each pet you obtain will be transferred to the next League. It'll be waiting with me for you to reclaim it!
translation: 此外，您获得的每只宠物都将转移到下一个联盟。它会和我一起等你来夺回它！ [ci wai ， nin huo de de mei zhi chong wu dou jiang zhuan yi dao xia yi ge lian meng 。 ta hui he wo yi qi deng ni lai duo hui ta ！]

english: Okay! Thank you.
translation: 好的！谢谢。 [hao de ！ xie xie 。]

english: No worries. Come back to me once you have some pets and you can view your collection! Now, is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 不用担心。一旦你有了一些宠物，就回来找我，你就可以查看你的收藏了！现在，还有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [bu yong dan xin 。 yi dan ni you le yi xie chong wu ， jiu hui lai zhao wo ， ni jiu ke yi cha kan ni de shou cang le ！ xian zai ， hai you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

english: You receive some items from the Leagues Tutor.
translation: 您会从联赛导师那里收到一些物品。 [nin hui cong lian sai dao shi na li shou dao yi xie wu pin 。]

english: Very well. I'll be here if you ever need to know anything about Leagues.
translation: 很好。如果您需要了解有关联赛的任何信息，我会在这里。 [hen hao 。 ru guo nin xu yao liao jie you guan lian sai de ren he xin xi ， wo hui zai zhe li 。]

english: Every League has unique rules and features to set it aside from the world you're used to.
translation: 每个联盟都有独特的规则和功能，将其与您习惯的世界区分开来。 [mei ge lian meng dou you du te de gui ze he gong neng ， jiang qi yu nin xi guan de shi jie qu fen kai lai 。]

english: Not only that, but within this League, you can unlock powerful artefacts known as Fragments. Fragments completely change the way you progress through the League!
translation: 不仅如此，在这个联盟中，你还可以解锁被称为碎片的强大神器。碎片完全改变了你在联盟中前进的方式！ [bu jin ru ci ， zai zhe ge lian meng zhong ， ni hai ke yi jie suo bei cheng wei sui pian de qiang da shen qi 。 sui pian wan quan gai bian le ni zai lian meng zhong qian jin de fang shi ！]

english: So even if glory and gold are not for you, you'll still find Leagues to be a whole lot of fun!
translation: 因此，即使荣耀和黄金不适合您，您仍然会发现联赛充满乐趣！ [yin ci ， ji shi rong yao he huang jin bu shi he nin ， nin reng ran hui fa xian lian sai chong man le qu ！]

english: Well sadly you're not eligible to take part in a League right now. I'll be happy to help once you are though.
translation: 遗憾的是，您现在没有资格参加联赛。一旦您愿意，我将很乐意为您提供帮助。 [yi han de shi ， nin xian zai mei you zi ge can jia lian sai 。 yi dan nin yuan yi ， wo jiang hen le yi wei nin ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: Yes! The current League is Leagues III - Shattered Relics.
translation: 是的！目前的联赛是联赛 III - 破碎遗迹。 [shi de ！ mu qian de lian sai shi lian sai  III -  po sui yi ji 。]

english: Within this League you are restricted to three skills: Defence, Fishing and Thieving, you can unlock more skills by completing tasks to earn Sage's Renown.
translation: 在这个联盟中，你只能使用三种技能：防御、钓鱼和盗窃，你可以通过完成任务来解锁更多技能，以获得贤者的声望。 [zai zhe ge lian meng zhong ， ni zhi neng shi yong san zhong ji neng ： fang yu 、 diao yu he dao qie ， ni ke yi tong guo wan cheng ren wu lai jie suo geng duo ji neng ， yi huo de xian zhe de sheng wang 。]

english: Sage's Renown can be used to purchase access to Skills, Bosses and to Auto Complete Quests.
translation: 贤者的声望可用于购买技能、Boss 和自动完成任务的访问权。 [xian zhe de sheng wang ke yong yu gou mai ji neng 、Boss  he zi dong wan cheng ren wu de fang wen quan 。]

english: You can also collect powerful artifacts known as Fragments, each Fragment provides a different buff so be sure to collect them all.
translation: 您还可以收集称为碎片的强大神器，每个碎片都提供不同的增益，因此请务必将它们全部收集起来。 [nin hai ke yi shou ji cheng wei sui pian de qiang da shen qi ， mei ge sui pian dou ti gong bu tong de zeng yi ， yin ci qing wu bi jiang ta men quan bu shou ji qi lai 。]

english: You can level up these Fragments to make them even stronger, you can also bring together different Fragments to activate powerful buffs known as Set Effects.
translation: 您可以升级这些碎片以使其变得更加强大，您还可以将不同的碎片组合在一起以激活称为“套装效果”的强大增益效果。 [nin ke yi sheng ji zhe xie sui pian yi shi qi bian de geng jia qiang da ， nin hai ke yi jiang bu tong de sui pian zu he zai yi qi yi ji huo cheng wei “ tao zhuang xiao guo ” de qiang da zeng yi xiao guo 。]

english: I heard there's one that lets you swap between Magic spellbooks whenever you want!
translation: 我听说有一个可以让你随时在魔法咒语书之间交换！ [wo ting shuo you yi ge ke yi rang ni sui shi zai mo fa zhou yu shu zhi jian jiao huan ！]

english: Not only that, but you must participate as an Iron Man. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.
translation: 不仅如此，你还必须以钢铁侠的身份参加。这意味着您是孤立的，无法与其他参与者进行交易。 [bu jin ru ci ， ni hai bi xu yi gang tie xia de shen fen can jia 。 zhe yi wei zhe nin shi gu li de ， wu fa yu qi ta can yu zhe jin xing jiao yi 。]

english: Interesting. Maybe I should take part.
translation: 有趣的。也许我应该参加。 [you qu de 。 ye xu wo ying gai can jia 。]

english: I'd highly recommend it.
translation: 我强烈推荐它。 [wo qiang lie tui jian ta 。]

english: The Leagues Reward Shop is temporarily closed.
translation: 联赛奖励商店暂时关闭。 [lian sai jiang li shang dian zan shi guan bi 。]

english: League Trophies are a representation of how well you did in a specific League. Performance is judged on the number of League Points you earned compared to everyone else who participated.
translation: 联赛奖杯代表了您在特定联赛中的表现。表现的评判标准是您与其他参赛者相比所获得的联赛积分。 [lian sai jiang bei dai biao le nin zai te ding lian sai zhong de biao xian 。 biao xian de ping pan biao zhun shi nin yu qi ta can sai zhe xiang bi suo huo de de lian sai ji fen 。]

english: Of course!
translation: 当然！ [dang ran ！]

english: You have not earned any League trophies. If you want a League trophy you should participate next time a League comes around!
translation: 您尚未获得任何联赛奖杯。如果您想要联赛奖杯，您应该在下次联赛到来时参加！ [nin shang wei huo de ren he lian sai jiang bei 。 ru guo nin xiang yao lian sai jiang bei ， nin ying gai zai xia ci lian sai dao lai shi can jia ！]

english: You receive a League trophy from the Leagues Tutor.
translation: 您会从联赛导师那里收到一座联赛奖杯。 [nin hui cong lian sai dao shi na li shou dao yi zuo lian sai jiang bei 。]

english: You do not have enough space for all the League Trophies available to you. Come back to me when you do.
translation: 您没有足够的空间来容纳所有可用的联赛奖杯。当你这样做时，请回到我身边。 [nin mei you zu gou de kong jian lai rong na suo you ke yong de lian sai jiang bei 。 dang ni zhe yang zuo shi ， qing hui dao wo shen bian 。]

english: Ah! Looks like you have already claimed all of the League Trophies available to you.
translation: 啊!看起来您已经获得了所有可用的联赛奖杯。 [a ! kan qi lai nin yi jing huo de le suo you ke yong de lian sai jiang bei 。]

english: You earned 0 League points which does not qualify you for any trophy.
translation: 您获得了 0 联赛积分，这并不意味着您有资格获得任何奖杯。 [nin huo de le  0  lian sai ji fen ， zhe bing bu yi wei zhe nin you zi ge huo de ren he jiang bei 。]

english: Hi there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Hello. Who are you?
translation: 你好。你是谁？ [ni hao 。 ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm the Tutor for Leagues. If you have any questions about Leagues, I can help you out.
translation: 我是联赛的导师。如果您对联赛有任何疑问，我可以帮助您。 [wo shi lian sai de dao shi 。 ru guo nin dui lian sai you ren he yi wen ， wo ke yi bang zhu nin 。]

english: What changes have been made for this League?
translation: 本次联赛有哪些变化？ [ben ci lian sai you na xie bian hua ？]

english: Yes, please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Not right now.
translation: 现在不行。 [xian zai bu xing 。]

english: How do tasks work?
translation: 任务如何进行？ [ren wu ru he jin xing ？]

english: How does the area system work?
translation: 区域系统如何运作？ [qu yu xi tong ru he yun zuo ？]

english: What are Relics?
translation: 什么是遗物？ [shen me shi yi wu ？]

english: Tell me about League rewards.
translation: 告诉我有关联赛奖励的信息。 [gao su wo you guan lian sai jiang li de xin xi 。]

english: Let's talk about pets.
translation: 我们来谈谈宠物吧。 [wo men lai tan tan chong wu ba 。]

english: Do I have any League items to collect?
translation: 我有任何联盟物品可以收集吗？ [wo you ren he lian meng wu pin ke yi shou ji ma ？]

english: Hello! Welcome to the Twisted League. I see you are new here.
translation: 你好！欢迎来到扭曲联盟。我看到你是新来的。 [ni hao ！ huan ying lai dao niu qu lian meng 。 wo kan dao ni shi xin lai de 。]

english: Yes, this is my first League. Can you explain how they work?
translation: 是的，这是我的第一个联赛。你能解释一下它们是如何工作的吗？ [shi de ， zhe shi wo de di yi ge lian sai 。 ni neng jie shi yi xia ta men shi ru he gong zuo de ma ？]

english: I'd be happy to!
translation: 我很乐意！ [wo hen le yi ！]

english: First of all, I'm your Leagues Tutor. If you have any questions about how Leagues work, you can come to me for help.
translation: 首先，我是你们的联赛导师。如果您对联盟的运作方式有任何疑问，可以向我寻求帮助。 [shou xian ， wo shi ni men de lian sai dao shi 。 ru guo nin dui lian meng de yun zuo fang shi you ren he yi wen ， ke yi xiang wo xun qiu bang zhu 。]

english: Now, Leagues are time-limited modes that give you a new way to play the game. For this League, you are restricted to the Kourend and Kebos regions, and you play as an Iron Man.
translation: 现在，联赛是限时模式，为您提供玩游戏的新方式。在这个联盟中，你被限制在 Kourend 和 Kebos 地区，并且你扮演钢铁侠。 [xian zai ， lian sai shi xian shi mo shi ， wei nin ti gong wan you xi de xin fang shi 。 zai zhe ge lian meng zhong ， ni bei xian zhi zai  Kourend  he  Kebos  di qu ， bing qie ni ban yan gang tie xia 。]

english: Let's take a look at all of the information available about this League. There is a new section in the journal tab whilst on a Leagues world. Click on the flashing quest icon to take a look.
translation: 让我们看一下有关该联赛的所有可用信息。在联赛世界中，日记选项卡中有一个新部分。单击闪烁的任务图标即可查看。 [rang wo men kan yi xia you guan gai lian sai de suo you ke yong xin xi 。 zai lian sai shi jie zhong ， ri ji xuan xiang ka zhong you yi ge xin bu fen 。 dan ji shan shuo de ren wu tu biao ji ke cha kan 。]

english: Now that you have your journal open, click on the flashing Leagues icon.
translation: 现在您已打开日记，单击闪烁的联赛图标。 [xian zai nin yi da kai ri ji ， dan ji shan shuo de lian sai tu biao 。]

english: This is the Leagues menu. Here you can view your progress through the current League. You can also open the various Leagues interfaces from here.
translation: 这是联赛菜单。在这里您可以查看当前联赛的进度。您还可以从这里打开各种联赛界面。 [zhe shi lian sai cai dan 。 zai zhe li nin ke yi cha kan dang qian lian sai de jin du 。 nin hai ke yi cong zhe li da kai ge zhong lian sai jie mian 。]

english: Your objective in each League is to complete tasks and earn League Points.
translation: 您在每个联赛中的目标是完成任务并赚取联赛积分。 [nin zai mei ge lian sai zhong de mu biao shi wan cheng ren wu bing zhuan qu lian sai ji fen 。]

english: Tasks are split into five difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite and Master. The harder the task, the more points awarded.
translation: 任务分为五个难度级别：简单、中等、困难、精英和大师。任务越难，获得的积分就越多。 [ren wu fen wei wu ge nan du ji bie ： jian dan 、 zhong deng 、 kun nan 、 jing ying he da shi 。 ren wu yue nan ， huo de de ji fen jiu yue duo 。]

english: Let's have a look at the tasks interface now. Click on the flashing button to open it.
translation: 现在让我们看一下任务界面。单击闪烁的按钮将其打开。 [xian zai rang wo men kan yi xia ren wu jie mian 。 dan ji shan shuo de an niu jiang qi da kai 。]

english: This is the tasks interface. Here you can see all the tasks available to you in this League. When you are ready to continue, close the interface by clicking on the cross in the corner of it.
translation: 这是任务界面。在这里你可以看到这个联盟中所有可供你完成的任务。当您准备好继续时，请单击界面一角的叉号来关闭界面。 [zhe shi ren wu jie mian 。 zai zhe li ni ke yi kan dao zhe ge lian meng zhong suo you ke gong ni wan cheng de ren wu 。 dang nin zhun bei hao ji xu shi ， qing dan ji jie mian yi jiao de cha hao lai guan bi jie mian 。]

english: Earning points during the League will allow you to unlock powerful Twisted Relics. The more League Points you have, the more Relics available to you.
translation: 在联赛期间赚取积分将使您能够解锁强大的扭曲遗物。您拥有的联盟积分越多，您可以使用的圣物就越多。 [zai lian sai qi jian zhuan qu ji fen jiang shi nin neng gou jie suo qiang da de niu qu yi wu 。 nin yong you de lian meng ji fen yue duo ， nin ke yi shi yong de sheng wu jiu yue duo 。]

english: League Points are also transferred over to your main profile. There, they can be spent on rewards in the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: 联盟积分也会转移到您的主要个人资料中。在那里，他们可以在联赛奖励商店中购买奖励。 [lian meng ji fen ye hui zhuan yi dao nin de zhu yao ge ren zi liao zhong 。 zai na li ， ta men ke yi zai lian sai jiang li shang dian zhong gou mai jiang li 。]

english: Now let's have a look at the Twisted Relics. Click on the flashing button to take a look at the Relics interface.
translation: 现在让我们看看扭曲的遗物。单击闪烁的按钮查看遗迹界面。 [xian zai rang wo men kan kan niu qu de yi wu 。 dan ji shan shuo de an niu cha kan yi ji jie mian 。]

english: This is the Relics interface. Here you can unlock new Twisted Relics to be used during this League. When you are ready to continue, close the interface by clicking on the cross in the corner of it.
translation: 这是遗迹界面。在这里您可以解锁在本联赛期间使用的新扭曲遗物。当您准备好继续时，请单击界面一角的叉号来关闭界面。 [zhe shi yi ji jie mian 。 zai zhe li nin ke yi jie suo zai ben lian sai qi jian shi yong de xin niu qu yi wu 。 dang nin zhun bei hao ji xu shi ， qing dan ji jie mian yi jiao de cha hao lai guan bi jie mian 。]

english: There are a few changes to Kourend and Kebos which you may not be used to. You can view all of these changes on the information interface.
translation: Kourend 和 Kebos 有一些您可能不习惯的更改。您可以在信息界面上查看所有这些变化。 [Kourend  he  Kebos  you yi xie nin ke neng bu xi guan de geng gai 。 nin ke yi zai xin xi jie mian shang cha kan suo you zhe xie bian hua 。]

english: Right, I think that's everything. If you need reminding of any of this information, you can either talk to me or read the information interface.
translation: 是的，我想这就是一切。如果您需要提醒任何这些信息，您可以与我交谈或阅读信息界面。 [shi de ， wo xiang zhe jiu shi yi qie 。 ru guo nin xu yao ti xing ren he zhe xie xin xi ， nin ke yi yu wo jiao tan huo yue du xin xi jie mian 。]

english: Before you head off though, it's time to pick your first Relic! Choose carefully though, once you've picked a Relic you can't go back and change your decision.
translation: 在你出发之前，是时候挑选你的第一个圣物了！不过，请谨慎选择，一旦您选择了遗物，您就无法返回并更改您的决定。 [zai ni chu fa zhi qian ， shi shi hou tiao xuan ni de di yi ge sheng wu le ！ bu guo ， qing jin shen xuan ze ， yi dan nin xuan ze le yi wu ， nin jiu wu fa fan hui bing geng gai nin de jue ding 。]

english: Hi there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Hello, who are you?
translation: 你好，你是谁？ [ni hao ， ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm the Tutor for Old School Leagues.
translation: 我是老学校联盟的导师。 [wo shi lao xue xiao lian meng de dao shi 。]

english: Old School Leagues are time-limited game modes that are separate from your main profile.
translation: 老派联赛是有时间限制的游戏模式，与您的主要个人资料分开。 [lao pai lian sai shi you shi jian xian zhi de you xi mo shi ， yu nin de zhu yao ge ren zi liao fen kai 。]

english: With each League, you start afresh, with a limited amount of time to progress through the game mode.
translation: 在每个联赛中，您都需要重新开始，并在有限的时间内完成游戏模式。 [zai mei ge lian sai zhong ， nin dou xu yao chong xin kai shi ， bing zai you xian de shi jian nei wan cheng you xi mo shi 。]

english: So it's a fresh start? Why would I want that?
translation: 那么这是一个新的开始吗？我为什么想要那个？ [na me zhe shi yi ge xin de kai shi ma ？ wo wei shen me xiang yao na ge ？]

english: Glory, gold, and the chance to play the game in a different way!
translation: 荣耀、黄金以及以不同方式玩游戏的机会！ [rong yao 、 huang jin yi ji yi bu tong fang shi wan you xi de ji hui ！]

english: Each League Rank will unlock a trophy for you. These trophies can be used to show off how well you did.
translation: 每个联赛排名都会为您解锁一个奖杯。这些奖杯可以用来展示您的表现。 [mei ge lian sai pai ming du hui wei nin jie suo yi ge jiang bei 。 zhe xie jiang bei ke yi yong lai zhan shi nin de biao xian 。]

english: If that doesn't interest you, how about gold! When you earn League Points, they will be transferred over to your main profile.
translation: 如果您对此不感兴趣，那么黄金怎么样？当您赚取联盟积分时，它们将转移到您的主要个人资料中。 [ru guo nin dui ci bu gan xing qu ， na me huang jin zen me yang ？ dang nin zhuan qu lian meng ji fen shi ， ta men jiang zhuan yi dao nin de zhu yao ge ren zi liao zhong 。]

english: These points can be used to buy things from the Leagues Reward Shop. You can keep these purchases for yourself or sell them on to other players!
translation: 这些积分可以用来从联赛奖励商店购买东西。您可以自己保留这些购买的物品或将其出售给其他玩家！ [zhe xie ji fen ke yi yong lai cong lian sai jiang li shang dian gou mai dong xi 。 nin ke yi zi ji bao liu zhe xie gou mai de wu pin huo jiang qi chu shou gei qi ta wan jia ！]

english: Leagues aren't just a copy of the normal game. Every League has unique rules and features to set it aside from the game you're used to.
translation: 联赛不仅仅是普通游戏的翻版。每个联盟都有独特的规则和功能，使其与您习惯的游戏有所不同。 [lian sai bu jin jin shi pu tong you xi de fan ban 。 mei ge lian meng dou you du te de gui ze he gong neng ， shi qi yu nin xi guan de you xi you suo bu tong 。]

english: Not only that, but within each League, you can unlock powerful artefacts known as Relics. These Relics completely change the way you play the game!
translation: 不仅如此，在每个联盟中，您都可以解锁被称为遗物的强大文物。这些遗迹彻底改变了你玩游戏的方式！ [bu jin ru ci ， zai mei ge lian meng zhong ， nin dou ke yi jie suo bei cheng wei yi wu de qiang da wen wu 。 zhe xie yi ji che di gai bian le ni wan you xi de fang shi ！]

english: No, The most recent League was the Twisted League. You can now claim your trophies from the Twisted League and purchase rewards using your League points.
