translation: 那么你用这些钱来支付我们的费用吗？ [na me ni yong zhe xie qian lai zhi fu wo men de fei yong ma ？]

english: Exactly. For us to serve the balance, we must trade with your people. That is what the money is for.
translation: 确切地。为了实现平衡，我们必须与你们的人民进行贸易。这就是钱的用途。 [que qie di 。 wei le shi xian ping heng ， wo men bi xu yu ni men de ren min jin xing mao yi 。 zhe jiu shi qian de yong tu 。]

english: Anyway, would you like to purchase some weapons?
translation: 无论如何，你想购买一些武器吗？ [wu lun ru he ， ni xiang gou mai yi xie wu qi ma ？]

english: I'm good thanks.
translation: 我很好谢谢。 [wo hen hao xie xie 。]

english: Let's see what you have.
translation: 让我们看看你有什么。 [rang wo men kan kan ni you shen me 。]

english: Do you make a lot of money selling weapons?
translation: 卖武器能赚很多钱吗？ [mai wu qi neng zhuan hen duo qian ma ？]

english: I'm good thanks.
translation: 我很好谢谢。 [wo hen hao xie xie 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!
translation: 呜？  呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜！ [wu ？   wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu ！]

english: You don't say?
translation: 你不说？ [ni bu shuo ？]

english: Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
translation: 哇！呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜！ [wa ！ wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu ！]

english: You don't say!
translation: 你不说！ [ni bu shuo ！]

english: Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
translation: 呜呜呜……呜呜呜？呜呜呜呜呜呜呜！ [wu wu wu …… wu wu wu ？ wu wu wu wu wu wu wu ！]

english: Well, I guess you didn't say.
translation: 嗯，我猜你没说。 [n ， wo cai ni mei shuo 。]

english: Yeah, I don't want to brag, but seriously: I am SOOOO rich....
translation: 是的，我不想吹牛，但说真的：我太有钱了…… [shi de ， wo bu xiang chui niu ， dan shuo zhen de ： wo tai you qian le ……]

english: Yeah, I know they say money doesn't bring you happiness, but sometimes I just like to open my bank account and look at all of the stuff I own and just think to myself:
translation: 是的，我知道他们说金钱不会给你带来幸福，但有时我只是喜欢打开我的银行账户，看看我拥有的所有东西，然后心里想： [shi de ， wo zhi dao ta men shuo jin qian bu hui gei ni dai lai xing fu ， dan you shi wo zhi shi xi huan da kai wo de yin hang zhang hu ， kan kan wo yong you de suo you dong xi ， ran hou xin li xiang ：]

english: Wow. I am soooooo rich.
translation: 哇。我太有钱了。 [wa 。 wo tai you qian le 。]

english: Well, us rich alive people don't want to waste all day spending time with you poor dead people, because I'm just sooooo rich I have to go now, and very possibly make myself even richer.
translation: 好吧，我们活着的富人不想浪费一整天的时间和你们这些可怜的死人在一起，因为我太富有了，我现在必须走了，而且很可能让自己变得更富有。 [hao ba ， wo men huo zhe de fu ren bu xiang lang fei yi zheng tian de shi jian he ni men zhe xie ke lian de si ren zai yi qi ， yin wei wo tai fu you le ， wo xian zai bi xu zou le ， er qie hen ke neng rang zi ji bian de geng fu you 。]

english: See ya around ghosty!
translation: 幽灵见！ [you ling jian ！]

english: Yeah, I heard about that, ha-ha-ha!
translation: 是的，我听说过，哈哈哈！ [shi de ， wo ting shuo guo ， ha ha ha ！]

english: With a MACKEREL? Ouch!
translation: 和鲭鱼一起？哎哟! [he qing yu yi qi ？ ai yo !]

english: Well, it was fun. Let's do it again sometime.
translation: 嗯，很有趣。我们找个时间再做一次吧。 [n ， hen you qu 。 wo men zhao ge shi jian zai zuo yi ci ba 。]

english: Why, thank you very much!
translation: 为什么，非常感谢！ [wei shen me ， fei chang gan xie ！]

english: I know, but what are you going to do?
translation: 我知道，但是你要做什么？ [wo zhi dao ， dan shi ni yao zuo shen me ？]

english: Well, I guess that's always true in the long run. See you around, weird invisible dead person!
translation: 嗯，我想从长远来看这总是正确的。再见，奇怪的隐形死人！ [n ， wo xiang cong chang yuan lai kan zhe zong shi zheng que de 。 zai jian ， qi guai de yin xing si ren ！]

english: Yeah it's not bad, but I prefer cooked chicken.
translation: 是的，不错，但我更喜欢煮熟的鸡肉。 [shi de ， bu cuo ， dan wo geng xi huan zhu shu de ji rou 。]

english: Maybe, but nothing beats a home cooked pie!
translation: 也许吧，但没有什么比自制的馅饼更好的了！ [ye xu ba ， dan mei you shen me bi zi zhi de xian bing geng hao de le ！]

english: Man, I love pie!
translation: 伙计，我喜欢馅饼！ [huo ji ， wo xi huan xian bing ！]

english: You don't say? I never knew that. Well, I must be going, see you around.
translation: 你不说？我从来不知道这一点。好吧，我得走了，回头见。 [ni bu shuo ？ wo cong lai bu zhi dao zhe yi dian 。 hao ba ， wo de zou le ， hui tou jian 。]

english: We get signal!
translation: 我们收到信号了！ [wo men shou dao xin hao le ！]

english: Somebody set up us the bomb!
translation: 有人给我们安放了炸弹！ [you ren gei wo men an fang le zha dan ！]

english: You have no chance to survive make your time.
translation: 你没有机会生存，请腾出时间。 [ni mei you ji hui sheng cun ， qing teng chu shi jian 。]

english: Woo?
translation: 呜？ [wu ？]

english: All your base are belong to us.
translation: 你所有的基地都属于我们。 [ni suo you de ji di dou shu yu wo men 。]

english: Hey, don't think you can talk to me like that!
translation: 嘿，别以为你可以这样跟我说话！ [hei ， bie yi wei ni ke yi zhe yang gen wo shuo hua ！]

english: Are you threatening me?
translation: 你在威胁我吗？ [ni zai wei xie wo ma ？]

english: Just because you're already dead, doesn't mean I can't find a way to hurt you ghosty!
translation: 你已经死了，并不代表我就找不到办法伤害你！ [ni yi jing si le ， bing bu dai biao wo jiu zhao bu dao ban fa shang hai ni ！]

english: No, I've never been there in my life and CERTAINLY didn't steal anything when I was!
translation: 不，我这辈子从来没有去过那里，当然也没有偷过任何东西！ [bu ， wo zhe bei zi cong lai mei you qu guo na li ， dang ran ye mei you tou guo ren he dong xi ！]

english: Are you calling me a liar?!?! I have never stolen a thing in my life, and I resent the implication that I am the kind of morally depraved individual that would steal someone else's hard earned
translation: 你骂我是骗子吗？！？！我一生中从未偷过任何东西，而且我很讨厌别人说我是那种道德败坏的人，会偷别人辛苦赚来的东西。 [ni ma wo shi pian zi ma ？！？！ wo yi sheng zhong cong wei tou guo ren he dong xi ， er qie wo hen tao yan bie ren shuo wo shi na zhong dao de bai huai de ren ， hui tou bie ren xin ku zhuan lai de dong xi 。]

english: money from their very pockets!
translation: 钱是从他们的口袋里掏出来的！ [qian shi cong ta men de kou dai li tao chu lai de ！]

english: Or cakes. Or fur. Repeatedly. For long periods at a time.
translation: 或者蛋糕。或者毛皮。反复。一次持续很长时间。 [huo zhe dan gao 。 huo zhe mao pi 。 fan fu 。 yi ci chi xu hen zhang shi jian 。]

english: Well if you are going to take that attitude, then I have nothing further to say on the matter, and bid you good day!
translation: 好吧，如果您打算采取这种态度，那么我对此事无话可说，祝您早安！ [hao ba ， ru guo nin da suan cai qu zhe zhong tai du ， na me wo dui ci shi wu hua ke shuo ， zhu nin zao an ！]

english: Hello. You would be Lennissa, I take it?
translation: 你好。我想你会是莱尼莎吧？ [ni hao 。 wo xiang ni hui shi lai ni sha ba ？]

english: Who are you? Where did you hear that name? How comes it that you can see and speak to me?
translation: 你是谁？你从哪里听到这个名字的？你怎么能看到我并跟我说话？ [ni shi shui ？ ni cong na li ting dao zhe ge ming zi de ？ ni zen me neng kan dao wo bing gen wo shuo hua ？]

english: Well, a ghost called Kharrim directed me towards you.
translation: 好吧，一个叫卡里姆的鬼魂指引我走向你。 [hao ba ， yi ge jiao ka li mu de gui hun zhi yin wo zou xiang ni 。]

english: So that weasel Kharrim has been blighted by this curse too?
translation: 那么黄鼠狼卡里姆也受到了这个诅咒的影响吗？ [na me huang shu lang ka li mu ye shou dao le zhe ge zu zhou de ying xiang ma ？]

english: Ha, a good thing too. If anybody deserved such a fate it would be one such as him.
translation: 哈，也是好事。如果有人应该遭受这样的命运，那一定是像他这样的人。 [ha ， ye shi hao shi 。 ru guo you ren ying gai zao shou zhe yang de ming yun ， na yi ding shi xiang ta zhe yang de ren 。]

english: I guess you didn't get along then?
translation: 我想你们当时并没有相处吧？ [wo xiang ni men dang shi bing mei you xiang chu ba ？]

english: No, evil scum such as he should never have been allowed to walk this world.
translation: 不，像他这样的邪恶败类，根本不应该出现在这个世界上。 [bu ， xiang ta zhe yang de xie e bai lei ， gen ben bu ying gai chu xian zai zhe ge shi jie shang 。]

english: What lies has he told you to come here? Have you come to try and kill me?
translation: 他到底撒了什么谎让你来这里？你是来杀我的吗？ [ta dao di sa le shen me huang rang ni lai zhe li ？ ni shi lai sha wo de ma ？]

english: Well, I'm not sure I could if I tried, but that is not why I have come to you.
translation: 好吧，我不确定是否可以尝试，但这不是我来找你的原因。 [hao ba ， wo bu que ding shi fou ke yi chang shi ， dan zhe bu shi wo lai zhao ni de yuan yin 。]

english: Then speak, and speak well, for I may yet be dead, but am still a danger to those who cross me.
translation: 那么就说吧，说得好，因为我可能还没有死，但对那些冒犯我的人来说仍然是一个危险。 [na me jiu shuo ba ， shuo de hao ， yin wei wo ke neng hai mei you si ， dan dui na xie mao fan wo de ren lai shuo reng ran shi yi ge wei xian 。]

english: Actually, I'm trying to work out why all of you invisible ghosts seem to have been cursed.
translation: 事实上，我想弄清楚为什么你们所有的隐形鬼魂似乎都被诅咒了。 [shi shi shang ， wo xiang nong qing chu wei shen me ni men suo you de yin xing gui hun si hu dou bei zu zhou le 。]

english: I'm not sure how exactly, but the trail seems to have led me to you...
translation: 我不知道到底是怎么回事，但这条线索似乎把我引向了你…… [wo bu zhi dao dao di shi zen me hui shi ， dan zhe tiao xian suo si hu ba wo yin xiang le ni ……]

english: That makes no sense... I served Saradomin faithfully my entire life, then all of a sudden I find myself reduced to this state!
translation: 这没道理……我一生都忠实地侍奉着萨拉多明，突然发现自己沦落到这个地步！ [zhe mei dao li …… wo yi sheng dou zhong shi di shi feng zhe sa la duo ming ， tu ran fa xian zi ji lun luo dao zhe ge di bu ！]

english: Well, it seems as though that may have been the cause...
translation: 嗯，看来这可能是原因...... [n ， kan lai zhe ke neng shi yuan yin ......]

english: What? Explain yourself.
translation: 什么？解释一下你自己。 [shen me ？ jie shi yi xia ni zi ji 。]

english: As I understand it, it was something to do with the Staff of Armadyl, and your refusal to tell Saradomin that it had been stolen...
translation: 据我了解，这与阿玛迪尔法杖有关，而你拒绝告诉萨拉多明它被偷了…… [ju wo liao jie ， zhe yu a ma di er fa zhang you guan ， er ni ju jue gao su sa la duo ming ta bei tou le ……]

english: What? But... But that is not how it happened at all!
translation: 什么？但是……但是事情根本不是这样的！ [shen me ？ dan shi …… dan shi shi qing gen ben bu shi zhe yang de ！]

english: Then please, go ahead and tell me the events of that day in your own words...
translation: 那么请用你自己的话告诉我那天发生的事情…… [na me qing yong ni zi ji de hua gao su wo na tian fa sheng de shi qing ……]

english: Let me see... I had been working as a spy for my Lord Saradomin, amongst the forces of... the Empty Lord.
translation: 让我想想……我一直在为我的萨拉多明勋爵当间谍，在……虚空领主的势力之中。 [rang wo xiang xiang …… wo yi zhi zai wei wo de sa la duo ming xun jue dang jian die ， zai …… xu kong ling zhu de shi li zhi zhong 。]

english: 'The Empty Lord'? Who is that?
translation: ‘空主’？那是谁？ [‘ kong zhu ’？ na shi shui ？]

english: I will not give you his name, for to do so would give him power here.
translation: 我不会告诉你他的名字，因为这样做会给他带来这里的权力。 [wo bu hui gao su ni ta de ming zi ， yin wei zhe yang zuo hui gei ta dai lai zhe li de quan li 。]

english: Let us just say that he was a fearsome deity, whose strength was greater than all the gods we knew of on this realm at the time.
translation: 只能说，他是一位可怕的神灵，其力量比我们当时所知的这个领域的所有神灵都要强大。 [zhi neng shuo ， ta shi yi wei ke pa de shen ling ， qi li liang bi wo men dang shi suo zhi de zhe ge ling yu de suo you shen ling dou yao qiang da 。]

english: It is probably worth mentioning that at this time we had no knowledge of the mysterious nature god Guthix.
translation: 也许值得一提的是，此时我们对神秘的自然神古蒂克斯一无所知。 [ye xu zhi de yi ti de shi ， ci shi wo men dui shen mi de zi ran shen gu di ke si yi wu suo zhi 。]

english: So he was stronger than Saradomin?
translation: 那么他比萨拉多明更强？ [na me ta bi sa la duo ming geng qiang ？]

english: As Saradomin was, yes. As Saradomin is now? Who can say?
translation: 就像萨拉多明一样，是的。就像现在的萨拉多明一样？谁能说一下？ [jiu xiang sa la duo ming yi yang ， shi de 。 jiu xiang xian zai de sa la duo ming yi yang ？ shui neng shuo yi xia ？]

english: I see... Please, continue.
translation: 我明白了……请继续。 [wo ming bai le …… qing ji xu 。]

english: As I say, I was working as a spy within the very camp of my Lord's enemies.
translation: 正如我所说，我是在我主敌人的阵营中担任间谍。 [zheng ru wo suo shuo ， wo shi zai wo zhu di ren de zhen ying zhong dan ren jian die 。]

english: I knew that should I have been caught, I risked being killed upon the spot, but my combat skills were always formidable, and if truth be told, there was a fair amount of dissent amongst... 'his' followers anyway.
translation: 我知道如果我被抓住，我就有被当场杀死的危险，但我的战斗技巧总是令人敬畏的，而且说实话，无论如何，“他的”追随者之间也有相当多的异议。 [wo zhi dao ru guo wo bei zhua zhu ， wo jiu you bei dang chang sha si de wei xian ， dan wo de zhan dou ji qiao zong shi ling ren jing wei de ， er qie shuo shi hua ， wu lun ru he ，“ ta de ” zhui sui zhe zhi jian ye you xiang dang duo de yi yi 。]

english: How do you mean 'dissent'?
translation: 你怎么理解“异议”？ [ni zen me li jie “ yi yi ”？]

english: Ah, to not understand this, you must have led a sheltered life...
translation: 啊，不明白这一点，你一定过着受庇护的生活…… [a ， bu ming bai zhe yi dian ， ni yi ding guo zhe shou bi hu de sheng huo ……]

english: Let me tell you this: Evil will always breed more evil, and will never be satisfied with what it has.
translation: 让我告诉你：邪恶总是会滋生更多的邪恶，并且永远不会满足于它所拥有的。 [rang wo gao su ni ： xie e zong shi hui zi sheng geng duo de xie e ， bing qie yong yuan bu hui man zu yu ta suo yong you de 。]

english: The Empty Lord chose to ally himself with the dark creatures of this world, fully aware that their own natures would cause them to rally against his rule, and take every opportunity they could to betray him.
translation: 空之主选择与这个世界的黑暗生物结盟，充分意识到他们自己的本性会导致他们联合起来反对他的统治，并利用一切可能的机会背叛他。 [kong zhi zhu xuan ze yu zhe ge shi jie de hei an sheng wu jie meng ， chong fen yi shi dao ta men zi ji de ben xing hui dao zhi ta men lian he qi lai fan dui ta de tong zhi ， bing li yong yi qie ke neng de ji hui bei pan ta 。]

english: This has always been the nature of evil. Perhaps he thought his power could prevent such treachery?
translation: 这一直是邪恶的本质。也许他认为他的力量可以阻止这种背叛？ [zhe yi zhi shi xie e de ben zhi 。 ye xu ta ren wei ta de li liang ke yi zu zhi zhe zhong bei pan ？]

english: This allowed me freedom amongst their camp, for it was always easy to point the finger of suspicion at some unsuspecting necromancer or foolish Mahjarrat if it seemed as though my activities had been discovered.
translation: 这让我可以在他们的营地中自由活动，因为如果我的活动似乎被发现了，那么总是很容易将怀疑的矛头指向一些毫无戒心的死灵法师或愚蠢的马吉拉特。 [zhe rang wo ke yi zai ta men de ying di zhong zi you huo dong ， yin wei ru guo wo de huo dong si hu bei fa xian le ， na me zong shi hen rong yi jiang huai yi de mao tou zhi xiang yi xie hao wu jie xin de si ling fa shi huo yu chun de ma ji la te 。]

english: Similarly, should I ever be caught in the act of my sabotage, it was all too easy to bribe whoever found me or persuade them into believing it was just some minor treachery of my own, rather than my work for my
translation: 同样，如果我的破坏行为被发现，我很容易贿赂任何发现我的人，或者说服他们相信这只是我自己的一些小背叛，而不是我为我的工作所做的工作。 [tong yang ， ru guo wo de po huai xing wei bei fa xian ， wo hen rong yi hui lu ren he fa xian wo de ren ， huo zhe shuo fu ta men xiang xin zhe zhi shi wo zi ji de yi xie xiao bei pan ， er bu shi wo wei wo de gong zuo suo zuo de gong zuo 。]

english: Lord Saradomin.
translation: 萨拉多明勋爵。 [sa la duo ming xun jue 。]

english: Okay... Well, that makes sense, but I don't understand what the Staff of Armadyl had to do with this...?
translation: 好吧...嗯，这是有道理的，但我不明白Armadyl 的权杖与此有什么关系...？ [hao ba ... n ， zhe shi you dao li de ， dan wo bu ming bai Armadyl  de quan zhang yu ci you shen me guan xi ...？]

english: As I have told you, the Empty Lord was extremely powerful, but not so powerful that he could rule over the other deities of this world without opposition.
translation: 正如我告诉过你的，虚空之主非常强大，但还没有强大到可以毫无反抗地统治这个世界的其他神灵。 [zheng ru wo gao su guo ni de ， xu kong zhi zhu fei chang qiang da ， dan hai mei you qiang da dao ke yi hao wu fan kang di tong zhi zhe ge shi jie de qi ta shen ling 。]

english: Should he have made a move against any other god, then he could still have been easily brought down by the combined efforts of the others.
translation: 如果他对其他神灵出手，那么在其他人的联手下，他也能轻易被击倒。 [ru guo ta dui qi ta shen ling chu shou ， na me zai qi ta ren de lian shou xia ， ta ye neng qing yi bei ji dao 。]

english: The theft of Armadyl's staff changed this however.
translation: 然而，阿玛迪尔的手杖失窃改变了这一点。 [ran er ， a ma di er de shou zhang shi qie gai bian le zhe yi dian 。]

english: If he had taken possession of this god-weapon, then his power would have been so great that he could have overthrown all on this world, and made it into his own image!
translation: 如果他拥有了这件神器，那么他的力量将会强大到足以推翻这个世界的一切，将这个世界塑造成他自己的形象！ [ru guo ta yong you le zhe jian shen qi ， na me ta de li liang jiang hui qiang da dao zu yi tui fan zhe ge shi jie de yi qie ， jiang zhe ge shi jie su zao cheng ta zi ji de xing xiang ！]

english: I could not allow such a thing to happen!
translation: 我不能允许这样的事情发生！ [wo bu neng yun xu zhe yang de shi qing fa sheng ！]

english: I went immediately to my comrade Dhalak, the mage, and told him that a message had come to the lair offering this weapon for sale!
translation: 我立即去找我的法师战友达拉克，告诉他巢穴收到了一条消息，出售这把武器！ [wo li ji qu zhao wo de fa shi zhan you da la ke ， gao su ta chao xue shou dao le yi tiao xiao xi ， chu shou zhe ba wu qi ！]

english: I knew that as soon as my Lord Saradomin heard this, he would contact Armadyl to inform them of the theft, and the matter would have been resolved quickly and discreetly.
translation: 我知道，萨拉多明大人一听到这件事，一定会联系阿玛迪尔，告知他们这起盗窃事件，这样事情就会迅速而谨慎地得到解决。 [wo zhi dao ， sa la duo ming da ren yi ting dao zhe jian shi ， yi ding hui lian xi a ma di er ， gao zhi ta men zhe qi dao qie shi jian ， zhe yang shi qing jiu hui xun su er jin shen di de dao jie jue 。]

english: So you passed this information to Dhalak instead of taking it to Saradomin yourself?
translation: 所以你把这个信息传递给了达拉克而不是自己交给萨拉多明？ [suo yi ni ba zhe ge xin xi chuan di gei le da la ke er bu shi zi ji jiao gei sa la duo ming ？]

english: To my eternal shame, I indeed failed my Lord Saradomin...
translation: 让我永远羞愧的是，我确实辜负了萨拉多明大人…… [rang wo yong yuan xiu kui de shi ， wo que shi gu fu le sa la duo ming da ren ……]

english: I could not risk taking the message directly, for I feared my disguise had been uncovered.
translation: 我不能冒险直接接受这个信息，因为我担心我的伪装被揭穿。 [wo bu neng mao xian zhi jie jie shou zhe ge xin xi ， yin wei wo dan xin wo de wei zhuang bei jie chuan 。]

english: Lucien particularly had been taking an unhealthy interest in my activities, and I had a gut feeling that to make any obvious moves against the Empty Lord would have been my undoing.
translation: 尤其是路西恩对我的活动产生了不健康的兴趣，我有一种直觉，如果对虚空之主做出任何明显的举动，就会导致我的灭亡。 [you qi shi lu xi en dui wo de huo dong chan sheng le bu jian kang de xing qu ， wo you yi zhong zhi jue ， ru guo dui xu kong zhi zhu zuo chu ren he ming xian de ju dong ， jiu hui dao zhi wo de mie wang 。]

english: But Dhalak was a noble man! I cannot believe that he would not have taken my message immediately to Lord Saradomin!
translation: 但达拉克是一个高贵的人！我不敢相信他不会立即将我的信息传达给萨拉多明勋爵！ [dan da la ke shi yi ge gao gui de ren ！ wo bu gan xiang xin ta bu hui li ji jiang wo de xin xi chuan da gei sa la duo ming xun jue ！]

english: Well, it seems like he didn't, but I don't know why not...
translation: 嗯，好像他没有，但我不知道为什么…… [n ， hao xiang ta mei you ， dan wo bu zhi dao wei shen me ……]

english: Please adventurer, discover what foul fate must have befallen him for him to have neglected his duty!
translation: 请冒险家，看看他到底遭遇了怎样的厄运，才导致了他的失职！ [qing mao xian jia ， kan kan ta dao di zao yu le zen yang de e yun ， cai dao zhi le ta de shi zhi ！]

english: I have not much to offer as reward, but for these spare robes I wore while on assignment...
translation: 我没有什么可以作为奖励，但为了我执行任务时穿的这些备用长袍…… [wo mei you shen me ke yi zuo wei jiang li ， dan wei le wo zhi xing ren wu shi chuan de zhe xie bei yong chang pao ……]

english: Please find him and discover why I am cursed like this!
translation: 请找到他，看看我为什么会受到这样的诅咒！ [qing zhao dao ta ， kan kan wo wei shen me hui shou dao zhe yang de zu zhou ！]

english: Where would I be able to find this Dhalak then?
translation: 那么我到哪里才能找到这个达拉克呢？ [na me wo dao na li cai neng zhao dao zhe ge da la ke ne ？]

english: Dhalak? I know not where, but he would try and make the most of his situation if he has been cursed, and find a place to lift his spirits!
translation: 达拉克？我不知道在哪里，但如果他被诅咒了，他会尽力利用自己的处境，找一个地方振奋精神！ [da la ke ？ wo bu zhi dao zai na li ， dan ru guo ta bei zu zhou le ， ta hui jin li li yong zi ji de chu jing ， zhao yi ge di fang zhen fen jing shen ！]

english: Okay, well I'll try and find him for you then.
translation: 好吧，那我会尽力帮你找到他。 [hao ba ， na wo hui jin li bang ni zhao dao ta 。]

english: Dhalak? Well, he was always a knowlegeable mage, so if this curse has befallen him as well, I would suspect he would be researching how to free himself of it.
translation: 达拉克？好吧，他一直是一个知识渊博的法师，所以如果这个诅咒也降临到他身上，我怀疑他会研究如何摆脱它。 [da la ke ？ hao ba ， ta yi zhi shi yi ge zhi shi yuan bo de fa shi ， suo yi ru guo zhe ge zu zhou ye jiang lin dao ta shen shang ， wo huai yi ta hui yan jiu ru he bai tuo ta 。]

english: I would look for a library to find him if I were you.
translation: 如果我是你，我会去图书馆找到他。 [ru guo wo shi ni ， wo hui qu tu shu guan zhao dao ta 。]

english: Dhalak? He was always a loyal follower of Saradomin... I think he would have found an altar to Saradomin so that he may pray for this curse to be lifted.
translation: 达拉克？他一直是萨拉多明的忠实追随者……我想他会为萨拉多明找到一座祭坛，这样他就可以祈祷解除这个诅咒。 [da la ke ？ ta yi zhi shi sa la duo ming de zhong shi zhui sui zhe …… wo xiang ta hui wei sa la duo ming zhao dao yi zuo ji tan ， zhe yang ta jiu ke yi qi dao jie chu zhe ge zu zhou 。]

english: Well, that's all fascinating, but I just don't particularly care. Bye-bye.
translation: 嗯，这一切都很有趣，但我并不特别关心。再见。 [n ， zhe yi qie dou hen you qu ， dan wo bing bu te bie guan xin 。 zai jian 。]

english: Hello Lennissa. Can you remind me where to find Dhalak?
translation: 你好，莱尼萨。你能提醒我在哪里可以找到 Dhalak 吗？ [ni hao ， lai ni sa 。 ni neng ti xing wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao  Dhalak  ma ？]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Could I have more of those ghostly robes you gave me?
translation: 我可以再要一件你送我的幽灵长袍吗？ [wo ke yi zai yao yi jian ni song wo de you ling chang pao ma ？]

english: It seems as though the curse that keeps me here extends to my very clothing... which piece do you want?
translation: 似乎让我留在这里的诅咒延伸到了我的衣服上……你想要哪一件？ [si hu rang wo liu zai zhe li de zu zhou yan shen dao le wo de yi fu shang …… ni xiang yao na yi jian ？]

english: Here you go.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: Tell me your story
translation: 告诉我你的故事 [gao su wo ni de gu shi]

english: Goodbye then
translation: 那么再见 [na me zai jian]

english: Ask about Dhalak.
translation: 询问达拉克。 [xun wen da la ke 。]

english: Ask for more ghostly robes.
translation: 要求更多的幽灵长袍。 [yao qiu geng duo de you ling chang pao 。]

english: As you approach Lenny, he takes something out of his pocket.
translation: 当你走近莱尼时，他从口袋里掏出一样东西。 [dang ni zou jin lai ni shi ， ta cong kou dai li tao chu yi yang dong xi 。]

english: What'd you take out of that pocket?
translation: 你从那个口袋里拿出了什么？ [ni cong na ge kou dai li na chu le shen me ？]

english: Ain't a thing in my pocket...
translation: 我口袋里什么都没有... [wo kou dai li shen me dou mei you ...]

english: I know there ain't. You got it in your hand...
translation: 我知道没有。你已经拿到手了... [wo zhi dao mei you 。 ni yi jing na dao shou le ...]

english: I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: 我不能和你这个外地人说话！与酋长布伦特交谈！ [wo bu neng he ni zhe ge wai di ren shuo hua ！ yu qiu zhang bu lun te jiao tan ！]

english: You stay away from me outerlander!
translation: 你这个外地人离我远点！ [ni zhe ge wai di ren li wo yuan dian ！]

english: They are too suspicious of you for you to get close enough to steal from them.
translation: 他们对你太怀疑了，你无法靠近他们去偷东西。 [ta men dui ni tai huai yi le ， ni wu fa kao jin ta men qu tou dong xi 。]

english: Hello, are you a member of the council?
translation: 你好，请问你是理事会成员吗？ [ni hao ， qing wen ni shi li shi hui cheng yuan ma ？]

english: I am afraid not outerlander. Goodbye.
translation: 恐怕不是外地人。再见。 [kong pa bu shi wai di ren 。 zai jian 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: 再次你好[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]。今天你需要我做什么？您永远可以信赖我的帮助！ [zai ci ni hao [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 jin tian ni xu yao wo zuo shen me ？ nin yong yuan ke yi xin lai wo de bang zhu ！]

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。我只是想聊聊。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。 wo zhi shi xiang liao liao 。]

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: 如果您需要我的帮助[弗雷曼尼克名字]，我的门永远敞开。 [ru guo nin xu yao wo de bang zhu [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]， wo de men yong yuan chang kai 。]

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: [弗雷曼尼克名字]...我们已经很久没有见面了！ [[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]... wo men yi jing hen jiu mei you jian mian le ！]

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: 欢迎回来[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]。很高兴在这里见到您！ [huan ying hui lai [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 hen gao xing zai zhe li jian dao nin ！]

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: 我很抱歉[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]！我没时间陪你在这里！ [wo hen bao qian [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！ wo mei shi jian pei ni zai zhe li ！]

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
translation: 没关系，我其实什么都不想要。 [mei guan xi ， wo qi shi shen me dou bu xiang yao 。]

english: How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: 你[弗雷曼尼克名字]怎么样？我希望您这一天一切顺利！ [ni [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ] zen me yang ？ wo xi wang nin zhe yi tian yi qie shun li ！]

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
translation: 我很好，谢谢，你好吗？ [wo hen hao ， xie xie ， ni hao ma ？]

english: All is well with me also!
translation: 我也一切都好！ [wo ye yi qie dou hao ！]

english: Hello to you, too!
translation: 也向你问好！ [ye xiang ni wen hao ！]

english: Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你好。你想要什么东西[弗雷曼尼克名字]吗？ [ni hao 。 ni xiang yao shen me dong xi [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ] ma ？]

english: No, not really.
translation: 不，不是真的。 [bu ， bu shi zhen de 。]

english: Well... okay then!
translation: 嗯……那好吧！ [n …… na hao ba ！]

english: Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
translation: 很高兴见到你[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]。 [hen gao xing jian dao ni [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。]

english: You shame us, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你让我们感到羞耻，[弗雷曼尼克名字]！ [ni rang wo men gan dao xiu chi ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！]

english: How can you steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你怎么能偷我的东西，[弗雷曼尼克名字]？ [ni zen me neng tou wo de dong xi ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]？]

english: You have betrayed your heritage, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你背叛了你的传统，[弗雷曼尼克名字]！ [ni bei pan le ni de chuan tong ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！]

english: Why would you try to steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你为什么要偷我的东西，[弗雷曼尼克名字]？ [ni wei shen me yao tou wo de dong xi ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]？]

english: How are you today?
translation: 你今天怎么样？ [ni jin tian zen me yang ？]

english: **sigh**
That good? Everyone around here seems a little depressed.
translation: 那好？这里的每个人似乎都有些沮丧。 [na hao ？ zhe li de mei ge ren si hu dou you xie ju sang 。]

english: And not particularly talkative.
translation: 而且也不是特别爱说话。 [er qie ye bu shi te bie ai shuo hua 。]

english: I'll leave you to your sighing. It looks like you have plenty to do.
translation: 我会让你叹息。看起来你有很多事情要做。 [wo hui rang ni tan xi 。 kan qi lai ni you hen duo shi qing yao zuo 。]

english: It's a bit grey round here, isn't it?
translation: 这里有点灰色，不是吗？ [zhe li you dian hui se ， bu shi ma ？]

english: It gets you down after a while, you know. There are 273 shades of grey, you know, and we have them all.
translation: 一段时间后它会让你情绪低落，你知道。你知道，有 273 种灰色，我们都有。 [yi duan shi jian hou ta hui rang ni qing xu di luo ， ni zhi dao 。 ni zhi dao ， you  273  zhong hui se ， wo men dou you 。]

english: That's grey-t.
translation: 那是灰色-t。 [na shi hui se -t。]

english: That attempt at humour merely made me more depressed. Leave me alone.
translation: 这种幽默的尝试只会让我更加沮丧。请别打扰我。 [zhe zhong you mo de chang shi zhi hui rang wo geng jia ju sang 。 qing bie da rao wo 。]

english: How's the King treating you then?
translation: 那么国王对你怎么样？ [na me guo wang dui ni zen me yang ？]

english: Like serfs.
translation: 就像农奴一样。 [jiu xiang nong nu yi yang 。]

english: Serf?
translation: 农奴？ [nong nu ？]

english: Yes, you know - peons, plebs, the downtrodden. He treats us like his own personal possessions.
translation: 是的，你知道的——苦工、平民、受压迫者。他对待我们就像对待自己的私人财产一样。 [shi de ， ni zhi dao de —— ku gong 、 ping min 、 shou ya po zhe 。 ta dui dai wo men jiu xiang dui dai zi ji de si ren cai chan yi yang 。]

english: You should leave this place.
translation: 你应该离开这个地方。 [ni ying gai li kai zhe ge di fang 。]

english: I keep trying to save up enough to leave, but the King keeps taxing us! We have no money left.
translation: 我一直想攒够钱离开，但国王却一直向我们征税！我们已经没有钱了。 [wo yi zhi xiang zan gou qian li kai ， dan guo wang que yi zhi xiang wo men zheng shui ！ wo men yi jing mei you qian le 。]

english: Oh dear.
translation: 哦亲爱的。 [o qin ai de 。]

english: Cheer up! It's not the end of the world.
translation: 开心点！这不是世界末日。 [kai xin dian ！ zhe bu shi shi jie mo ri 。]

english: I'd prefer that, if it meant I didn't have to talk to people as inanely happy as you.
translation: 我更喜欢这样，如果这意味着我不必和像你一样快乐的人说话。 [wo geng xi huan zhe yang ， ru guo zhe yi wei zhe wo bu bi he xiang ni yi yang kuai le de ren shuo hua 。]

english: Whoa! I think you need to get out more.
translation: 哇！我觉得你需要多出去走走。 [wa ！ wo jue de ni xu yao duo chu qu zou zou 。]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 你知道，打招呼的方式有很多种。你好，你好，你好…… [ni zhi dao ， da zhao hu de fang shi you hen duo zhong 。 ni hao ， ni hao ， ni hao ……]

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 那还是只能算一个！ [na hai shi zhi neng suan yi ge ！]

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。你今天怎么样？ [ni hao 。 ni jin tian zen me yang ？]

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很棒，谢谢你！ [wo hen bang ， xie xie ni ！]

english: Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 你好！水晶城里今天过得怎么样啊？ [ni hao ！ shui jing cheng li jin tian guo de zen me yang a ？]

english: Indeed.
translation: 的确。 [di que 。]

english: What can I do for ya?
translation: 我能为你做什么？ [wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 各种各样的事情！这些塔楼是一个美妙的景观。 [ge zhong ge yang de shi qing ！ zhe xie ta lou shi yi ge mei miao de jing guan 。]

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 在像今天这样的日子，我建议您参观市场。 [zai xiang jin tian zhe yang de ri zi ， wo jian yi nin can guan shi chang 。]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你认为你在做什么？ [ni ren wei ni zai zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: Looking for a bit of meat?
translation: 寻找一点肉吗？ [xun zhao yi dian rou ma ？]

english: I beg your pardon?
translation: 请再说一遍？ [qing zai shuo yi bian ？]

english: Meat! We've got all the good stuff here.
translation: 肉！我们这里有所有好东西。 [rou ！ wo men zhe li you suo you hao dong xi 。]

english: Show me what you've got.
translation: 告诉我你有什么。 [gao su wo ni you shen me 。]

english: Why do you have all this meat?
translation: 你为什么有这么多肉？ [ni wei shen me you zhe me duo rou ？]

english: Some prefer solids to go with their blood. That, and the werewolf visitors need something to eat too.
translation: 有些人更喜欢固体食物来补充血液。那，狼人访客也需要吃点东西。 [you xie ren geng xi huan gu ti shi wu lai bu chong xue ye 。 na ， lang ren fang ke ye xu yao chi dian dong xi 。]

english: Where does it all come from?
translation: 这一切从何而来？ [zhe yi qie cong he er lai ？]

english: Look around you! There's no shortage of meat in these parts.
translation: 看看你的周围！这些地方不缺肉。 [kan kan ni de zhou wei ！ zhe xie di fang bu que rou 。]

english: You know what, I think I've heard enough.
translation: 你知道吗，我想我已经听够了。 [ni zhi dao ma ， wo xiang wo yi jing ting gou le 。]

english: Whatever you say. So, want some meat?
translation: 不管你说什么。那么，要吃肉吗？ [bu guan ni shuo shen me 。 na me ， yao chi rou ma ？]

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Come back if you ever want some meat!
translation: 想吃肉就回来吧！ [xiang chi rou jiu hui lai ba ！]

english: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 人类！在我叫守卫之前回到奴隶围栏！ [ren lei ！ zai wo jiao shou wei zhi qian hui dao nu li wei lan ！]

english: Show me what you've got.
translation: 告诉我你有什么。 [gao su wo ni you shen me 。]

english: Why do you have all this meat?
translation: 你为什么有这么多肉？ [ni wei shen me you zhe me duo rou ？]

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Can you come and help me, [player name]? I've got a problem with some graves.
translation: 你能过来帮我吗，[玩家姓名]？我对一些坟墓有疑问。 [ni neng guo lai bang wo ma ，[ wan jia xing ming ]？ wo dui yi xie fen mu you yi wen 。]

english: Okay, I'll help with your graves.
translation: 好吧，我来帮你修坟。 [hao ba ， wo lai bang ni xiu fen 。]

english: Player is teleported to Leo's graveyard
translation: 玩家被传送到里奥的墓地 [wan jia bei chuan song dao li ao de mu di]

english: Sorry, I'm busy.
translation: 抱歉，我很忙。 [bao qian ， wo hen mang 。]

english: You have to help me, [player name]! I've put the wrong coffins into these graves.
translation: 你必须帮助我，[玩家名字]！我把错误的棺材放进了这些坟墓里。 [ni bi xu bang zhu wo ，[ wan jia ming zi ]！ wo ba cuo wu de guan cai fang jin le zhe xie fen mu li 。]

english: I need you to pick up the coffin from each grave, see who's inside it, and bury it in the grave with the correct gravestone.
translation: 我需要你从每个坟墓里捡起棺材，看看里面有谁，然后把它埋在有正确墓碑的坟墓里。 [wo xu yao ni cong mei ge fen mu li jian qi guan cai ， kan kan li mian you shui ， ran hou ba ta mai zai you zheng que mu bei de fen mu li 。]

english: I think I've finished!
translation: 我想我已经完成了！ [wo xiang wo yi jing wan cheng le ！]

english: That's a good attempt, but it's just not right. Try looking in the coffins to learn who is in them, and read the gravestones to see who is supposed to be buried there.
translation: 这是一个很好的尝试，但它是不对的。尝试查看棺材以了解里面的人，并阅读墓碑以了解谁应该被埋在那里。 [zhe shi yi ge hen hao de chang shi ， dan ta shi bu dui de 。 chang shi cha kan guan cai yi liao jie li mian de ren ， bing yue du mu bei yi liao jie shui ying gai bei mai zai na li 。]

english: All right, I'll give it another shot.
translation: 好吧，我再试一次。 [hao ba ， wo zai shi yi ci 。]

english: Wonderful! That's taken care of them. I'll take you back, and give you your reward.
translation: 精彩的！这已经照顾到他们了。我会带你回去，并给你奖励。 [jing cai de ！ zhe yi jing zhao gu dao ta men le 。 wo hui dai ni hui qu ， bing gei ni jiang li 。]

english: Remind me what I'm supposed to do.
translation: 提醒我我应该做什么。 [ti xing wo wo ying gai zuo shen me 。]

english: Pick up the coffins.
translation: 把棺材捡起来。 [ba guan cai jian qi lai 。]

english: Check the body inside.
translation: 检查里面的尸体。 [jian cha li mian de shi ti 。]

english: Find out where they need to be buried.
translation: 找出他们需要埋在哪里。 [zhao chu ta men xu yao mai zai na li 。]

english: Put all five coffins in the correct graves.
translation: 将所有五口棺材放入正确的坟墓中。 [jiang suo you wu kou guan cai fang ru zheng que de fen mu zhong 。]

english: You can store items in the mausoleum if you need more
translation: 如果您需要更多物品，可以将物品存放在陵墓中 [ru guo nin xu yao geng duo wu pin ， ke yi jiang wu pin cun fang zai ling mu zhong]

english: inventory space.
translation: 库存空间。 [ku cun kong jian 。]

english: I want to leave now.
translation: 我现在就想离开。 [wo xian zai jiu xiang li kai 。]

english: In that case, I'll take you back to where I found you.
translation: 既然如此，我就带你回到我找到你的地方。 [ji ran ru ci ， wo jiu dai ni hui dao wo zhao dao ni de di fang 。]

english: Player is teleported to back to the previous location
translation: 玩家被传送回到之前的位置 [wan jia bei chuan song hui dao zhi qian de wei zhi]

english: Welcome back!
translation: 欢迎回来！ [huan ying hui lai ！]

english: What? But how am I still here?
translation: 什么？但我怎么还在这里？ [shen me ？ dan wo zen me hai zai zhe li ？]

english: You died, and now you are in a graveyard.
translation: 你死了，现在你在墓地里。 [ni si le ， xian zai ni zai mu di li 。]

english: Where did you think you would go?
translation: 你以为你会去哪里？ [ni yi wei ni hui qu na li ？]

english: Sorry, I need help from [player name].
translation: 抱歉，我需要[玩家姓名]的帮助。 [bao qian ， wo xu yao [ wan jia xing ming ] de bang zhu 。]

english: Hello, [player name]?
translation: 你好，[玩家姓名]？ [ni hao ，[ wan jia xing ming ]？]

english: Please help me, [player name].
translation: 请帮助我，[玩家姓名]。 [qing bang zhu wo ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: I need your help, [player name]!
translation: 我需要你的帮助，[玩家姓名]！ [wo xu yao ni de bang zhu ，[ wan jia xing ming ]！]

english: Can I borrow you for a minute, [player name]?
translation: 我可以借你一分钟吗，[玩家姓名]？ [wo ke yi jie ni yi fen zhong ma ，[ wan jia xing ming ]？]

english: Maybe later.
translation: 也许以后吧。 [ye xu yi hou ba 。]

english: Okay, I'll help with your graves.
translation: 好吧，我来帮你修坟。 [hao ba ， wo lai bang ni xiu fen 。]

english: Sorry, I'm busy.
translation: 抱歉，我很忙。 [bao qian ， wo hen mang 。]

english: I think I've finished!
translation: 我想我已经完成了！ [wo xiang wo yi jing wan cheng le ！]

english: Remind me what I'm supposed to do.
translation: 提醒我我应该做什么。 [ti xing wo wo ying gai zuo shen me 。]

english: I want to leave now.
translation: 我现在就想离开。 [wo xian zai jiu xiang li kai 。]

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm blending in. Scopin' out the place.
translation: 我正在融入其中。观察这个地方。 [wo zheng zai rong ru qi zhong 。 guan cha zhe ge di fang 。]

english: Are you preparing for a heist? You're only a kid.
translation: 你准备好抢劫了吗？你只是个孩子。 [ni zhun bei hao qiang jie le ma ？ ni zhi shi ge hai zi 。]

english: Let's just say there are some wealthy people about, with full pockets.
translation: 假设有一些有钱人，口袋里装满了钱。 [jia she you yi xie you qian ren ， kou dai li zhuang man le qian 。]

english: Any tips? I'm not having much luck myself.
translation: 有什么建议吗？我自己的运气并不好。 [you shen me jian yi ma ？ wo zi ji de yun qi bing bu hao 。]

english: I'm quite sneaky. Every now and then I'll get their attention so their pockets aren't being so carefully watched.
translation: 我真是太狡猾了。我会时不时地引起他们的注意，这样他们的口袋就不会受到如此仔细的监视。 [wo zhen shi tai jiao hua le 。 wo hui shi bu shi di yin qi ta men de zhu yi ， zhe yang ta men de kou dai jiu bu hui shou dao ru ci zi xi de jian shi 。]

english: That is sneaky. I'll keep an eye out for your... distractions.
translation: 那是偷偷摸摸的。我会留意你的……干扰因素。 [na shi tou tou mo mo de 。 wo hui liu yi ni de …… gan rao yin su 。]

english: Now leave me be. I'm already distracting!
translation: 现在别管我了。我已经分散注意力了！ [xian zai bie guan wo le 。 wo yi jing fen san zhu yi li le ！]

english: You notice an urchin distract a wealthy citizen nearby.
translation: 您注意到一个顽童分散了附近一位富有公民的注意力。 [nin zhu yi dao yi ge wan tong fen san le fu jin yi wei fu you gong min de zhu yi li 。]

english: I've been robbed!
translation: 我被抢了！ [wo bei qiang le ！]

english: *Sobbing*
translation: *抽泣* [* chou qi *]

english: My parents are gonna be so mad!
translation: 我爸妈一定会生气的！ [wo ba ma yi ding hui sheng qi de ！]

english: Oh gosh!
translation: 天啊！ [tian a ！]

english: What can I do?
translation: 我能做些什么？ [wo neng zuo xie shen me ？]

english: That's awful!
translation: 太糟糕了！ [tai zao gao le ！]

english: I'll keep you company for a moment.
translation: 我会陪你一会儿。 [wo hui pei ni yi hui er 。]

english: Silly me! I had it in my pocket all along!
translation: 傻我啊！我一直把它放在口袋里！ [sha wo a ！ wo yi zhi ba ta fang zai kou dai li ！]

english: I can't stop crying!
translation: 我无法停止哭泣！ [wo wu fa ting zhi ku qi ！]

english: Wahhhh!
translation: 哇哈哈哈！ [wa ha ha ha ！]

english: I've lost my parents!
translation: 我失去了父母！ [wo shi qu le fu mu ！]

english: I hope you're okay.
translation: 我希望你没事。 [wo xi wang ni mei shi 。]

english: Oh you really brightened my day!
translation: 哦，你真的让我的一天变得美好！ [o ， ni zhen de rang wo de yi tian bian de mei hao ！]

english: I'm so lost! Someone help!
translation: 我很失落！有人帮忙！ [wo hen shi luo ！ you ren bang mang ！]

english: I can't find my friends
translation: 我找不到我的朋友 [wo zhao bu dao wo de peng you]

english: I'm all alone!
translation: 我一个人！ [wo yi ge ren ！]

english: I think I see my friends!!
translation: 我想我看到了我的朋友们！！ [wo xiang wo kan dao le wo de peng you men ！！]

english: No one can dance like me!
translation: 没有人能像我一样跳舞！ [mei you ren neng xiang wo yi yang tiao wu ！]

english: I could do this all day!
translation: 我可以这样做一整天！ [wo ke yi zhe yang zuo yi zheng tian ！]

english: Any tips?
translation: 有什么建议吗？ [you shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: Who taught you to move like that?
translation: 谁教你这样移动的？ [shui jiao ni zhe yang yi dong de ？]

english: I wish I had moves like that!
translation: 我希望我也有这样的动作！ [wo xi wang wo ye you zhe yang de dong zuo ！]

english: I'm all danced out!
translation: 我都跳出来了！ [wo dou tiao chu lai le ！]

english: My leg! Someone please!
translation: 我的腿！请有人！ [wo de tui ！ qing you ren ！]

english: Gah! It hurts!
translation: 嘎！好痛！ [ga ！ hao tong ！]

english: It burns like an inferno!
translation: 它像地狱一样燃烧！ [ta xiang di yu yi yang ran shao ！]

english: I think I've broken something!
translation: 我想我打破了一些东西！ [wo xiang wo da po le yi xie dong xi ！]

english: Woah! My leg has healed!
translation: 哇哦！我的腿已经痊愈了！ [wa o ！ wo de tui yi jing quan yu le ！]

english: That was strange.
translation: 这很奇怪。 [zhe hen qi guai 。]

english: Dialoge 1
translation: 对话1 [dui hua 1]

english: Dialoge 2
translation: 对话2 [dui hua 2]

english: Dialoge 3
translation: 对话3 [dui hua 3]

english: Dialoge 4
translation: 对话4 [dui hua 4]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This is Aleck's Hunter Emporium. Basically, it's just a shop with a fancy name; you can buy various weapons and traps here.
translation: 这是亚历克的猎人商场。基本上，这只是一家名字很花哨的商店；你可以在这里购买各种武器和陷阱。 [zhe shi ya li ke de lie ren shang chang 。 ji ben shang ， zhe zhi shi yi jia ming zi hen hua shao de shang dian ； ni ke yi zai zhe li gou mai ge zhong wu qi he xian jing 。]

english: Can I buy some equipment from the shop then?
translation: 那么我可以从商店购买一些装备吗？ [na me wo ke yi cong shang dian gou mai yi xie zhuang bei ma ？]

english: Oh, this isn't my shop; the owner is Aleck over there behind the counter.
translation: 哦，这不是我的店；店主是柜台后面的阿莱克。 [o ， zhe bu shi wo de dian ； dian zhu shi gui tai hou mian de a lai ke 。]

english: I experiment with weapon designs. I'm here because I've been trying to convince people to back my research and maybe sell some of my products - like this one I'm holding - in their shops.
translation: 我尝试武器设计。我来这里是因为我一直试图说服人们支持我的研究，也许还可以在他们的商店里出售我的一些产品——就像我手里拿着的这个产品。 [wo chang shi wu qi she ji 。 wo lai zhe li shi yin wei wo yi zhi shi tu shuo fu ren men zhi chi wo de yan jiu ， ye xu hai ke yi zai ta men de shang dian li chu shou wo de yi xie chan pin —— jiu xiang wo shou li na zhe de zhe ge chan pin 。]

english: Aleck doesn't seem to be interested, though.
translation: 不过，阿莱克似乎并不感兴趣。 [bu guo ， a lai ke si hu bing bu gan xing qu 。]

english: Can you tell me about your crossbow?
translation: 你能告诉我你的十字弓吗？ [ni neng gao su wo ni de shi zi gong ma ？]

english: It's good, isn't it? I designed it to incorporate the bones of various animals in its construction.
translation: 这很好，不是吗？我设计它时将各种动物的骨头融入到其结构中。 [zhe hen hao ， bu shi ma ？ wo she ji ta shi jiang ge zhong dong wu de gu tou rong ru dao qi jie gou zhong 。]

english: It's a fair bit faster than an ordinary crossbow too; it'll take you far less time to reload between shots.
translation: 它也比普通弩快一点；两次射击之间重新装弹所需的时间会少得多。 [ta ye bi pu tong nu kuai yi dian ； liang ci she ji zhi jian chong xin zhuang dan suo xu de shi jian hui shao de duo 。]

english: That's crazy, it'll never work!
translation: 这太疯狂了，它永远不会起作用！ [zhe tai feng kuang le ， ta yong yuan bu hui qi zuo yong ！]

english: That's what they said about my wind-powered mouse traps, too.
translation: 他们也是这么评价我的风力捕鼠器的。 [ta men ye shi zhe me ping jia wo de feng li bu shu qi de 。]

english: And did they work?
translation: 它们起作用了吗？ [ta men qi zuo yong le ma ？]

english: Well, they only ran into problems because people kept insisting on trying to use them indoors.
translation: 好吧，它们只是遇到了问题，因为人们一直坚持尝试在室内使用它们。 [hao ba ， ta men zhi shi yu dao le wen ti ， yin wei ren men yi zhi jian chi chang shi zai shi nei shi yong ta men 。]

english: Anyway, I think my crossbow invention is showing a lot more promise.
translation: 不管怎样，我认为我的弩发明显示出了更多的希望。 [bu guan zen yang ， wo ren wei wo de nu fa ming xian shi chu le geng duo de xi wang 。]

english: That sounds good. Let's trade.
translation: 听起来很好。我们来交易吧。 [ting qi lai hen hao 。 wo men lai jiao yi ba 。]

english: Tell me about the ammo for your crossbow.
translation: 告诉我你的十字弓的弹药。 [gao su wo ni de shi zi gong de dan yao 。]

english: Ah, I admit as a result of its... er... unique construction, it won't take just any old bolts.
translation: 啊，我承认由于其......呃......独特的结构，它不会只需要任何旧螺栓。 [a ， wo cheng ren you yu qi ...... e ...... du te de jie gou ， ta bu hui zhi xu yao ren he jiu luo shuan 。]

english: If you can supply the materials and a token fee, I'd be happy to make some for you.
translation: 如果您能提供材料和象征性费用，我很乐意为您制作一些。 [ru guo nin neng ti gong cai liao he xiang zheng xing fei yong ， wo hen le yi wei nin zhi zuo yi xie 。]

english: I need kebbit spikes, lots of 'em. Not all kebbits have spikes, mind you. You'll be wanting prickly kebbits or, even better, razor-backed kebbits to get material hard enough.
translation: 我需要烤肉串，很多。请注意，并非所有烤肉串都有尖刺。你会想要带刺的烤肉串，或者更好的是，剃刀背的烤肉串来获得足够坚硬的材料。 [wo xu yao kao rou chuan ， hen duo 。 qing zhu yi ， bing fei suo you kao rou chuan dou you jian ci 。 ni hui xiang yao dai ci de kao rou chuan ， huo zhe geng hao de shi ， ti dao bei de kao rou chuan lai huo de zu gou jian ying de cai liao 。]

english: Can't I just make my own?
translation: 我不能自己做吗？ [wo bu neng zi ji zuo ma ？]

english: Yes, I suppose you could, although you'll need a steady hand with a knife and a chisel.
translation: 是的，我想你可以，尽管你需要一只稳定的手，拿着刀和凿子。 [shi de ， wo xiang ni ke yi ， jin guan ni xu yao yi zhi wen ding de shou ， na zhe dao he zao zi 。]

english: The bolts have an unusual diameter, but basically you'll just need to be able to carve kebbit spikes into straight shafts.
translation: 螺栓的直径不寻常，但基本上您只需要能够将kebbit尖刺雕刻成直轴即可。 [luo shuan de zhi jing bu xun chang ， dan ji ben shang nin zhi xu yao neng gou jiang kebbit jian ci diao ke cheng zhi zhou ji ke 。]

english: Meanwhile, since you're here, I can make some for you if you have the materials.
translation: 同时，既然你来了，如果你有材料的话我可以给你做一些。 [tong shi ， ji ran ni lai le ， ru guo ni you cai liao de hua wo ke yi gei ni zuo yi xie 。]

english: Okay, can you make ammo for me?
translation: 好吧，你能为我制造弹药吗？ [hao ba ， ni neng wei wo zhi zao dan yao ma ？]

english: I'll be off now, excuse me.
translation: 我现在要走了，请原谅。 [wo xian zai yao zou le ， qing yuan liang 。]

english: Well, if you ever find yourself in need of that innovative edge, you can always find me here.
translation: 好吧，如果您发现自己需要这种创新优势，您随时可以在这里找到我。 [hao ba ， ru guo nin fa xian zi ji xu yao zhe zhong chuang xin you shi ， nin sui shi ke yi zai zhe li zhao dao wo 。]

english: ... thanks.
translation: ... 谢谢。 [...  xie xie 。]

english: Oh, hey, you have one of my crossbows! How's it working for you?
translation: 哦，嘿，你有我的一把弩！对你来说效果如何？ [o ， hei ， ni you wo de yi ba nu ！ dui ni lai shuo xiao guo ru he ？]

english: It's okay, thanks.
translation: 没关系，谢谢。 [mei guan xi ， xie xie 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Can I buy some equipment from the shop then?
translation: 那么我可以从商店购买一些装备吗？ [na me wo ke yi cong shang dian gou mai yi xie zhuang bei ma ？]

english: Can you tell me about your crossbow?
translation: 你能告诉我你的十字弓吗？ [ni neng gao su wo ni de shi zi gong ma ？]

english: Tell me about the ammo for your crossbow.
translation: 告诉我你的十字弓的弹药。 [gao su wo ni de shi zi gong de dan yao 。]

english: I'll be off now, excuse me.
translation: 我现在要走了，请原谅。 [wo xian zai yao zou le ， qing yuan liang 。]

english: That's crazy, it'll never work!
translation: 这太疯狂了，它永远不会起作用！ [zhe tai feng kuang le ， ta yong yuan bu hui qi zuo yong ！]

english: That sounds good. Let's trade.
translation: 听起来很好。我们来交易吧。 [ting qi lai hen hao 。 wo men lai jiao yi ba 。]

english: Can't I just make my own?
translation: 我不能自己做吗？ [wo bu neng zi ji zuo ma ？]

english: Okay, can you make ammo for me?
translation: 好吧，你能为我制造弹药吗？ [hao ba ， ni neng wei wo zhi zao dan yao ma ？]

english: (1) 6 kebbit bolts
translation: (1) 6 个 kebbit 螺栓 [(1) 6  ge  kebbit  luo shuan]

english: (2) 6 long kebbit bolts
translation: (2) 6 个长 kebbit 螺栓 [(2) 6  ge zhang  kebbit  luo shuan]

english: It's okay, thanks.
translation: 没关系，谢谢。 [mei guan xi ， xie xie 。]

english: You have done well brave adventurer, but I would test your mettle now. You may arrange the fight with Larxus at your leisure.
translation: 你勇敢的冒险家做得很好，但我现在要考验你的勇气。您可以在闲暇时安排与拉克萨斯的战斗。 [ni yong gan de mao xian jia zuo de hen hao ， dan wo xian zai yao kao yan ni de yong qi 。 nin ke yi zai xian xia shi an pai yu la ke sa si de zhan dou 。]

english: Adventurer, you have defeated me in battle! For this, I congratulate you. Please accept my cape as a sign of your accomplishment.
translation: 冒险家，你在战斗中击败了我！为此，我向你表示祝贺。请接受我的斗篷作为你成就的标志。 [mao xian jia ， ni zai zhan dou zhong ji bai le wo ！ wei ci ， wo xiang ni biao shi zhu he 。 qing jie shou wo de dou peng zuo wei ni cheng jiu de biao zhi 。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Can I have another sword?
translation: 我可以再要一把剑吗？ [wo ke yi zai yao yi ba jian ma ？]

english: Jeffery gives you another sword.
translation: 杰弗里又给了你一把剑。 [jie fu li you gei le ni yi ba jian 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm Jeffery, the taskmaster for the Wilderness Achievement Diary.
translation: 我是杰弗里，荒野成就日记的监工。 [wo shi jie fu li ， huang ye cheng jiu ri ji de jian gong 。]

english: What is the Achievement Diary?
translation: 什么是成就日记？ [shen me shi cheng jiu ri ji ？]

translation: 哦，它们有很大不同，而且大部分都发生在第四纪元。 [o ， ta men you hen da bu tong ， er qie da bu fen dou fa sheng zai di si ji yuan 。]

english: Since we dwarves hid underground for a long time to sit out the wars that raged above the ground our history books differ slightly from those written by humans.
translation: 由于我们矮人长期躲在地下，以躲避地面上肆虐的战争，因此我们的历史书与人类所写的略有不同。 [you yu wo men ai ren chang qi duo zai di xia ， yi duo bi di mian shang si nve de zhan zheng ， yin ci wo men de li shi shu yu ren lei suo xie de lve you bu tong 。]

english: Thanks for the information!
translation: 感谢您的信息！ [gan xie nin de xin xi ！]

english: What do you know about impenetrable rocks?
translation: 关于无法穿透的岩石，你了解多少？ [guan yu wu fa chuan tou de yan shi ， ni liao jie duo shao ？]

english: You're confusing me, what rock exactly are you talking about?
translation: 你让我困惑了，你到底在说什么石头？ [ni rang wo kun huo le ， ni dao di zai shuo shen me shi tou ？]

english: The big one in the mines south of the city. Dondakan's big rock.
translation: 最大的一个在城南的矿井里。唐达坎的大石头。 [zui da de yi ge zai cheng nan de kuang jing li 。 tang da kan de da shi tou 。]

english: I see, I see.
translation: 我明白了，我明白了。 [wo ming bai le ， wo ming bai le 。]

english: I heard there was a demon inside there that you banished.
translation: 我听说里面有一个恶魔，被你驱逐了。 [wo ting shuo li mian you yi ge e mo ， bei ni qu zhu le 。]

english: Yes, what exactly does that mean anyway?
translation: 是的，这究竟意味着什么？ [shi de ， zhe jiu jing yi wei zhe shen me ？]

english: There are some demons that we cannot see properly as mortals. They also cannot be fought with normal weapons.
translation: 有些恶魔是我们作为凡人无法正确看待的。他们也无法用普通武器战斗。 [you xie e mo shi wo men zuo wei fan ren wu fa zheng que kan dai de 。 ta men ye wu fa yong pu tong wu qi zhan dou 。]

english: But sometimes these creatures manifest themselves in a solid form in our world. Their avatar.
translation: 但有时这些生物会以实体的形式出现在我们的世界中。他们的头像。 [dan you shi zhe xie sheng wu hui yi shi ti de xing shi chu xian zai wo men de shi jie zhong 。 ta men de tou xiang 。]

english: When you defeat an avatar, you defeat the actual demon behind it. But they don't die, they are banished to where they came from originally.
translation: 当你击败一个化身时，你就击败了它背后真正的恶魔。但他们并没有死，而是被放逐到原来的地方。 [dang ni ji bai yi ge hua shen shi ， ni jiu ji bai le ta bei hou zhen zheng de e mo 。 dan ta men bing mei you si ， er shi bei fang zhu dao yuan lai de di fang 。]

english: Does that mean I will have to deal with this demon again some time?
translation: 那是不是意味着我以后又要和这个恶魔打交道了呢？ [na shi bu shi yi wei zhe wo yi hou you yao he zhe ge e mo da jiao dao le ne ？]

english: Doubtful. He will grow stronger and stronger over time, but that's a process that will take a thousand years at least.
translation: 疑。随着时间的推移，他会变得越来越强，但这个过程至少需要一千年的时间。 [yi 。 sui zhe shi jian de tui yi ， ta hui bian de yue lai yue qiang ， dan zhe ge guo cheng zhi shao xu yao yi qian nian de shi jian 。]

english: Even dwarves don't live so long.
translation: 即使是矮人也没有那么长寿。 [ji shi shi ai ren ye mei you na me chang shou 。]

english: No, we won't see him again and the mines are safe to dig for gold now. Of course, that might lead to other problems eventually...
translation: 不，我们不会再见到他了，现在可以安全地开采金矿了。当然，这最终可能会导致其他问题...... [bu ， wo men bu hui zai jian dao ta le ， xian zai ke yi an quan di kai cai jin kuang le 。 dang ran ， zhe zui zhong ke neng hui dao zhi qi ta wen ti ......]

english: Can you tell me more about the library?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于图书馆的信息吗？ [ni neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu tu shu guan de xin xi ma ？]

english: What do you know about impenetrable rocks?
translation: 关于无法穿透的岩石，你了解多少？ [guan yu wu fa chuan tou de yan shi ， ni liao jie duo shao ？]

english: Greetings warrior, how can I fill your stomach today?
translation: 你好，勇士，今天要怎么填饱你的肚子呢？ [ni hao ， yong shi ， jin tian yao zen me tian bao ni de du zi ne ？]

english: With food preferably.
translation: 最好与食物一起。 [zui hao yu shi wu yi qi 。]

english: Come try my lovely pizza or maybe some fish!
translation: 来尝尝我可爱的披萨或者一些鱼吧！ [lai chang chang wo ke ai de pi sa huo zhe yi xie yu ba ！]

english: Stew to fill the belly, on sale here!
translation: 炖菜填饱肚子，这里有卖！ [dun cai tian bao du zi ， zhe li you mai ！]

english: Potatoes are filling and healthy too!
translation: 土豆既能填饱肚子，又健康！ [tu dou ji neng tian bao du zi ， you jian kang ！]

english: Move into position lads! eh? Who are you and what do you want?
translation: 小伙子们就位吧！嗯？你是谁，你想要什么？ [xiao huo zi men jiu wei ba ！ n ？ ni shi shui ， ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Who are you then?
translation: 那你是谁？ [na ni shi shui ？]

english: Lieutenant Shepbur, commanding officer of the new Armoured Tortoise Regiment.
translation: 谢普布尔中尉，新装甲龟团的指挥官。 [xie pu bu er zhong wei ， xin zhuang jia gui tuan de zhi hui guan 。]

english: There's only two tortoises here, that's hardly a regiment.
translation: 这里只有两只乌龟，根本算不上一个团。 [zhe li zhi you liang zhi wu gui ， gen ben suan bu shang yi ge tuan 。]

english: This is just the beginning! Gnome breeders and trainers are already working to expand the number of units. Soon we'll have hundreds of these beauties, nay thousands! And they will not only carry mages and
translation: 这只是开始！侏儒饲养员和训练师已经在努力扩大单位数量。很快我们就会有数百名这样的美女，甚至数千名！而且他们不仅会携带法师 [zhe zhi shi kai shi ！ zhu ru si yang yuan he xun lian shi yi jing zai nu li kuo da dan wei shu liang 。 hen kuai wo men jiu hui you shu bai ming zhe yang de mei nv ， shen zhi shu qian ming ！ er qie ta men bu jin hui xie dai fa shi]

english: archers but other fiendish weapons of destruction of gnome devising. An army of giant tortoises will march upon this battlefield and rain the fire of our wrath upon all our enemies! Nothing will be able to stop us!
translation: 弓箭手也是侏儒设计的其他恶魔般的毁灭性武器。一支巨龟大军将进军这个战场，向我们所有的敌人倾泻我们的愤怒之火！没有什么能够阻止我们！ [gong jian shou ye shi zhu ru she ji de qi ta e mo ban de hui mie xing wu qi 。 yi zhi ju gui da jun jiang jin jun zhe ge zhan chang ， xiang wo men suo you de di ren qing xie wo men de fen nu zhi huo ！ mei you shen me neng gou zu zhi wo men ！]

english: Oooookayy...... I'll leave you to it then....
translation: Oooookayy……那我就让你自己做吧…… [Oooookayy…… na wo jiu rang ni zi ji zuo ba ……]

english: *hic* G'day! Do ya... ... well, do ya need any help with yer trident? *buuurrrp*
translation: *嗨*你好！你……嗯，你的三叉戟需要任何帮助吗？ *buuurrrp* [* hai * ni hao ！ ni …… n ， ni de san cha ji xu yao ren he bang zhu ma ？ *buuurrrp*]

english: Bit early to be drinking, isn't it?
translation: 喝酒有点早，不是吗？ [he jiu you dian zao ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Why?! What time *hic* is it?
translation: 为什么？！现在 *hic* 几点了？ [wei shen me ？！ xian zai  *hic*  ji dian le ？]

english: Hmm, I've no idea.
translation: 嗯，我不知道。 [n ， wo bu zhi dao 。]

english: I can drink to that!
translation: 我可以为此干杯！ [wo ke yi wei ci gan bei ！]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: What!? Why I'm the infamous pirate Lieve McCracken! You've not heard of me?
translation: 什么！？为什么我是臭名昭著的海盗利夫·麦克拉肯！你没听说过我吗？ [shen me ！？ wei shen me wo shi chou ming zhao zhu de hai dao li fu · mai ke la ken ！ ni mei ting shuo guo wo ma ？]

english: Hmm, can't say I have.
translation: 嗯，不能说我有。 [n ， bu neng shuo wo you 。]

english: I'm wanted in several *hic* kingdoms - murder, armed robbery and even *hic* flag desecration!
translation: 我在几个 *hic* 王国被通缉 - 谋杀、武装抢劫，甚至 *hic* 旗帜亵渎！ [wo zai ji ge  *hic*  wang guo bei tong ji  -  mou sha 、 wu zhuang qiang jie ， shen zhi  *hic*  qi zhi xie du ！]

english: Shouldn't you be in hiding?
translation: 你不应该躲起来吗？ [ni bu ying gai duo qi lai ma ？]

english: I'm sorry, but *hic* do ya see anyone here?
translation: 抱歉，*呃*你在这里看到有人吗？ [bao qian ，* e * ni zai zhe li kan dao you ren ma ？]

english: I guess you could call this hiding. If you're some famous pirate, where's you ship?
translation: 我想你可以称之为隐藏。如果你是某个著名的海盗，你的船在哪里？ [wo xiang ni ke yi cheng zhi wei yin cang 。 ru guo ni shi mou ge zhu ming de hai dao ， ni de chuan zai na li ？]

english: *hic* My last expedition didn't end too well for my boat... or crew *hic*.
translation: *hic* 我的最后一次探险对于我的船...或船员 *hic* 来说结局不太好。 [*hic*  wo de zui hou yi ci tan xian dui yu wo de chuan ... huo chuan yuan  *hic*  lai shuo jie ju bu tai hao 。]

english: So, what's in the cave?
translation: 那么，山洞里有什么呢？ [na me ， shan dong li you shen me ne ？]

english: The fruits o' my labour... and some waterfiends, those were a surprise *hic* to be sure, but a welcome one.
translation: 我的劳动成果……还有一些水魔，这些当然是令人惊讶的*希奇*，但也是受欢迎的。 [wo de lao dong cheng guo …… hai you yi xie shui mo ， zhe xie dang ran shi ling ren jing ya de * xi qi *， dan ye shi shou huan ying de 。]

english: Umm, fruits?
translation: 嗯，水果？ [n ， shui guo ？]

english: Oh, not *hic* actual fruits, silly! A relative o' mine wanted a cave full o' Krakens, so here *hic* I am.
translation: 哦，不是 *hic* 真正的水果，愚蠢！我的一个亲戚想要一个充满海妖的洞穴，所以我在这里*急*。 [o ， bu shi  *hic*  zhen zheng de shui guo ， yu chun ！ wo de yi ge qin qi xiang yao yi ge chong man hai yao de dong xue ， suo yi wo zai zhe li * ji *。]

english: And why are you so drunk?
translation: 还有你为什么喝醉了？ [hai you ni wei shen me he zui le ？]

english: Well, the Krakens destroyed m' ship, killed m' crew, the rum it's... all I 'ave left.
translation: 好吧，海妖摧毁了我的船，杀死了我的船员，朗姆酒……我只剩下这些了。 [hao ba ， hai yao cui hui le wo de chuan ， sha si le wo de chuan yuan ， lang mu jiu …… wo zhi sheng xia zhe xie le 。]

english: Sorry about that, so... Can I kill some Krakens?
translation: 抱歉，所以...我可以杀死一些海妖吗？ [bao qian ， suo yi ... wo ke yi sha si yi xie hai yao ma ？]

english: If you've been assigned some by a slayer master, I don't see *hic* why not.
translation: 如果杀手大师给你分配了一些任务，我不明白*hic*为什么不这样做。 [ru guo sha shou da shi gei ni fen pei le yi xie ren wu ， wo bu ming bai *hic* wei shen me bu zhe yang zuo 。]

english: And if I havn't been?
translation: 如果我没有去过呢？ [ru guo wo mei you qu guo ne ？]

english: Then ya can leave m' Krakens *hic* alone.
translation: 然后你就可以别管我的海妖*hic*了。 [ran hou ni jiu ke yi bie guan wo de hai yao *hic* le 。]

english: Umm... ok then.
translation: 嗯...好吧。 [n ... hao ba 。]

english: Let's talk about tridents.
translation: 我们来谈谈三叉戟。 [wo men lai tan tan san cha ji 。]

english: If ya brings me a trident, I can enhance it for ya. It'll store 20,000 charges, not just 2,500. But I wants payin' fer the job.
translation: 如果你给我带来三叉戟，我可以为你增强它。它将存储 20,000 笔费用，而不仅仅是 2,500 笔。但我想要为这份工作付钱。 [ru guo ni gei wo dai lai san cha ji ， wo ke yi wei ni zeng qiang ta 。 ta jiang cun chu  20,000  bi fei yong ， er bu jin jin shi  2,500  bi 。 dan wo xiang yao wei zhe fen gong zuo fu qian 。]

english: Give me 10 kraken tentacles first. I'll hold onto 'em for ya. Then ya can bring me a trident to enhance, an' I'll get to work for ya.
translation: 先给我10条海怪触手。我会为你保留它们。然后你可以给我带来一把三叉戟来增强，然后我就开始为你工作。 [xian gei wo 10 tiao hai guai chu shou 。 wo hui wei ni bao liu ta men 。 ran hou ni ke yi gei wo dai lai yi ba san cha ji lai zeng qiang ， ran hou wo jiu kai shi wei ni gong zuo 。]

english: If ya brings me a trident, I can enhance it for ya. It'll store 20,000 charges, not just 2,500. Ya brought me one tentacle so far, but I'll want 10 of 'em to do the job.
translation: 如果你给我带来三叉戟，我可以为你增强它。它将存储 20,000 笔费用，而不仅仅是 2,500 笔。到目前为止，你给我带来了一根触手，但我需要 10 根才能完成这项工作。 [ru guo ni gei wo dai lai san cha ji ， wo ke yi wei ni zeng qiang ta 。 ta jiang cun chu  20,000  bi fei yong ， er bu jin jin shi  2,500  bi 。 dao mu qian wei zhi ， ni gei wo dai lai le yi gen chu shou ， dan wo xu yao  10  gen cai neng wan cheng zhe xiang gong zuo 。]

english: Just pass me 9 more tentacles, then give me yer trident an' I'll get to work for ya.
translation: 只要再给我 9 根触手，然后把你的三叉戟给我，我就可以为你工作了。 [zhi yao zai gei wo  9  gen chu shou ， ran hou ba ni de san cha ji gei wo ， wo jiu ke yi wei ni gong zuo le 。]

translation: 只要递给我[数量]更多的触手，然后给我你的三叉戟，我就可以为你工作了。 [zhi yao di gei wo [ shu liang ] geng duo de chu shou ， ran hou gei wo ni de san cha ji ， wo jiu ke yi wei ni gong zuo le 。]

translation: 如果你给我带来三叉戟，我可以为你增强它。它将存储 20,000 笔费用，而不仅仅是 2,500 笔。到目前为止，你给我带来了 9 个触手，但我想要 10 个来完成这项工作。 [ru guo ni gei wo dai lai san cha ji ， wo ke yi wei ni zeng qiang ta 。 ta jiang cun chu  20,000  bi fei yong ， er bu jin jin shi  2,500  bi 。 dao mu qian wei zhi ， ni gei wo dai lai le  9  ge chu shou ， dan wo xiang yao  10  ge lai wan cheng zhe xiang gong zuo 。]

english: If ya brings me a trident, I can enhance it for ya. It'll store 20,000 charges, not just 2,500. Ya brought me [number] tentacles; I'll use up 10 of 'em to do the job.
translation: 如果你给我带来三叉戟，我可以为你增强它。它将存储 20,000 笔费用，而不仅仅是 2,500 笔。你给我带来了[数量]条触手；我会用掉 10 个来完成这项工作。 [ru guo ni gei wo dai lai san cha ji ， wo ke yi wei ni zeng qiang ta 。 ta jiang cun chu  20,000  bi fei yong ， er bu jin jin shi  2,500  bi 。 ni gei wo dai lai le [ shu liang ] tiao chu shou ； wo hui yong diao  10  ge lai wan cheng zhe xiang gong zuo 。]

english: Just pass me yer trident an' I'll get to work for ya.
translation: 只要把你的三叉戟递给我，我就可以为你工作。 [zhi yao ba ni de san cha ji di gei wo ， wo jiu ke yi wei ni gong zuo 。]

english: I'll be, heh, leaving you now...
translation: 我会，嘿，现在离开你...... [wo hui ， hei ， xian zai li kai ni ......]

english: Wow, so original.
translation: 哇，太原创了。 [wa ， tai yuan chuang le 。]

translation: 喂，我是 Lieve McCracken，我说别打扰我的 Kraken！ [wei ， wo shi  Lieve McCracken， wo shuo bie da rao wo de  Kraken！]

translation: 利夫·麦克拉肯希望你坚持完成你的杀手任务。 [li fu · mai ke la ken xi wang ni jian chi wan cheng ni de sha shou ren wu 。]

translation: 哎呀，我是 Lieve，我说别管它了！ [ai ya ， wo shi  Lieve， wo shuo bie guan ta le ！]

translation: 你得给我带来 10 根触手，然后我才能为你增强你的三叉戟。到目前为止你给我带来了一个。 [ni de gei wo dai lai  10  gen chu shou ， ran hou wo cai neng wei ni zeng qiang ni de san cha ji 。 dao mu qian wei zhi ni gei wo dai lai le yi ge 。]

translation: 你得给我带来 10 根触手，然后我才能为你增强你的三叉戟。到目前为止，你给我带来了[号码]。 [ni de gei wo dai lai  10  gen chu shou ， ran hou wo cai neng wei ni zeng qiang ni de san cha ji 。 dao mu qian wei zhi ， ni gei wo dai lai le [ hao ma ]。]

english: That trident's already been enhanced, ya ninny!
translation: 那三叉戟已经被强化了，你这个笨蛋！ [na san cha ji yi jing bei qiang hua le ， ni zhe ge ben dan ！]

english: I see ya got a tentacle there. Do ya want me to hold onto it for ya? For every 10 ya gives me, I'll enhance a trident for ya.

english: Remember, I won't give 'em back. Once ya gives me a tentacle, I keep it.

english: Hang on, did you just answer my question before I asked it?
translation: 等等，你是在我问问题之前就回答了我的问题吗？ [deng deng ， ni shi zai wo wen wen ti zhi qian jiu hui da le wo de wen ti ma ？]

english: Absolutely not!
translation: 绝对不是！ [jue dui bu shi ！]

english: Are you a little... mad?
translation: 你是不是有点……生气了？ [ni shi bu shi you dian …… sheng qi le ？]

english: Uh..... hi... didn't see you there. Can.... I help?
translation: 呃...嗨...没在那里看到你。我可以……我帮忙吗？ [e ... hai ... mei zai na li kan dao ni 。 wo ke yi …… wo bang mang ma ？]

english: Umm... do you sell potions?
translation: 嗯……你们卖药剂吗？ [n …… ni men mai yao ji ma ？]

english: Erm... yes. When I'm not drinking them.
translation: 嗯...是的。当我不喝它们的时候。 [n ... shi de 。 dang wo bu he ta men de shi hou 。]

english: I'd like to see what you have for sale.
translation: 我想看看你们有什么待售的。 [wo xiang kan kan ni men you shen me dai shou de 。]

english: Of course...
translation: 当然... [dang ran ...]

english: That's a pretty wall hanging.
translation: 这是一个漂亮的壁挂。 [zhe shi yi ge piao liang de bi gua 。]

english: Do you think so? I made it myself.
translation: 你这样认为吗？我自己做的。 [ni zhe yang ren wei ma ？ wo zi ji zuo de 。]

english: Really? Is that why there's all this cloth and dye around?
translation: 真的吗？这就是周围有这么多布料和染料的原因吗？ [zhen de ma ？ zhe jiu shi zhou wei you zhe me duo bu liao he ran liao de yuan yin ma ？]

english: Yes, it's a hobby of mine when I'm.... relaxing.
translation: 是的，当我……放松的时候，这是我的一个爱好。 [shi de ， dang wo …… fang song de shi hou ， zhe shi wo de yi ge ai hao 。]

english: Bye!

english: Have fun and come back soon!
translation: 玩得开心并尽快回来！ [wan de kai xin bing jin kuai hui lai ！]

english: Pink bananas... mmmmmm.
translation: 粉红香蕉……嗯嗯嗯。 [fen hong xiang jiao …… n n n 。]

english: It's not an optical illusion, it just looks like one.
translation: 这不是一种视错觉，只是看起来像一种错觉。 [zhe bu shi yi zhong shi cuo jue ， zhi shi kan qi lai xiang yi zhong cuo jue 。]

english: Don't look back, they might be gaining on you.
translation: 别回头，他们可能会追上你。 [bie hui tou ， ta men ke neng hui zhui shang ni 。]

english: If you don't care where you are, then you ain't lost.
translation: 如果你不在乎自己身在何处，那么你就不会迷路。 [ru guo ni bu zai hu zi ji shen zai he chu ， na me ni jiu bu hui mi lu 。]

english: Madness takes its toll. Please have exact change.
translation: 疯狂会造成损失。请准备准确的零钱。 [feng kuang hui zao cheng sun shi 。 qing zhun bei zhun que de ling qian 。]

english: I'd like to see what you have for sale.

english: That's a pretty wall hanging.

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 你知道，打招呼的方式有很多种。你好，你好，你好…… [ni zhi dao ， da zhao hu de fang shi you hen duo zhong 。 ni hao ， ni hao ， ni hao ……]

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 那还是只能算一个！ [na hai shi zhi neng suan yi ge ！]

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。你今天怎么样？ [ni hao 。 ni jin tian zen me yang ？]

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很棒，谢谢你！ [wo hen bang ， xie xie ni ！]

english: Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 你好！水晶城里今天过得怎么样啊？ [ni hao ！ shui jing cheng li jin tian guo de zen me yang a ？]

english: Indeed.
translation: 的确。 [di que 。]

english: What can I do for ya?
translation: 我能为你做什么？ [wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 各种各样的事情！这些塔楼是一个美妙的景观。 [ge zhong ge yang de shi qing ！ zhe xie ta lou shi yi ge mei miao de jing guan 。]

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 在像今天这样的日子，我建议您参观市场。 [zai xiang jin tian zhe yang de ri zi ， wo jian yi nin can guan shi chang 。]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你认为你在做什么？ [ni ren wei ni zai zuo shen me ？]

english: Welcome, are you looking to take part in a game of Last Man Standing?
translation: 欢迎，您想参加“Last Man Standing”游戏吗？ [huan ying ， nin xiang can jia “Last Man Standing” you xi ma ？]

english: Tell me more.
translation: 告诉我更多。 [gao su wo geng duo 。]

english: It's simple. Anyone looking to participate enters the relevant waiting area. Once the waiting area has enough people, they are taken to the arena.
translation: 这很简单。任何想要参加的人都进入相关的等候区。一旦等候区有足够的人，他们就会被带到竞技场。 [zhe hen jian dan 。 ren he xiang yao can jia de ren dou jin ru xiang guan de deng hou qu 。 yi dan deng hou qu you zu gou de ren ， ta men jiu hui bei dai dao jing ji chang 。]

english: Arena?
translation: 竞技场？ [jing ji chang ？]

english: Indeed. We have set up two arenas on another plane. When a game starts, we pick one at random. Once everyone arrives in the arena, the fight for survival begins.
translation: 的确。我们在另一架飞机上搭建了两个竞技场。当游戏开始时，我们随机选择一个。当所有人都到达竞技场后，生存之战就开始了。 [di que 。 wo men zai ling yi jia fei ji shang da jian le liang ge jing ji chang 。 dang you xi kai shi shi ， wo men sui ji xuan ze yi ge 。 dang suo you ren dou dao da jing ji chang hou ， sheng cun zhi zhan jiu kai shi le 。]

english: Now, there's a few important things to be aware of. While in an arena, your physical and mental abilities will be boosted. Also, praying to the gods will not cost you any precious energies.
translation: 现在，有一些重要的事情需要注意。在竞技场中，你的身体和心理能力都会得到提升。而且，向神灵祈祷不会花费你任何宝贵的能量。 [xian zai ， you yi xie zhong yao de shi qing xu yao zhu yi 。 zai jing ji chang zhong ， ni de shen ti he xin li neng li du hui de dao ti sheng 。 er qie ， xiang shen ling qi dao bu hui hua fei ni ren he bao gui de neng liang 。]

english: After a game has started, lethal fog will soon start filling the arena. This forces contenders to a designated safe zone and ensures no one escapes the fighting.
translation: 比赛开始后，致命的雾气很快就会开始充满竞技场。这迫使竞争者进入指定的安全区域，并确保没有人逃脱战斗。 [bi sai kai shi hou ， zhi ming de wu qi hen kuai jiu hui kai shi chong man jing ji chang 。 zhe po shi jing zheng zhe jin ru zhi ding de an quan qu yu ， bing que bao mei you ren tao tuo zhan dou 。]

english: Be aware, you can't take any of your own belongings into the game. Instead, you can use only what you find in the arena, including anything we give you on arrival.
translation: 请注意，您不能携带任何自己的物品进入游戏。相反，您只能使用您在竞技场中找到的东西，包括我们在抵达时为您提供的任何东西。 [qing zhu yi ， nin bu neng xie dai ren he zi ji de wu pin jin ru you xi 。 xiang fan ， nin zhi neng shi yong nin zai jing ji chang zhong zhao dao de dong xi ， bao kuo wo men zai di da shi wei nin ti gong de ren he dong xi 。]

english: Regarding what you are given on arrival, you have a few options to pick from. Use my supply chest to configure your load-outs for the different battle styles.
translation: 关于您抵达时所获得的物品，您有多种选择。使用我的补给箱来配置不同战斗风格的负载。 [guan yu nin di da shi suo huo de de wu pin ， nin you duo zhong xuan ze 。 shi yong wo de bu ji xiang lai pei zhi bu tong zhan dou feng ge de fu zai 。]

english: Remember, this is a solo competition! Anyone attempting to form teams for an unfair advantage will be banished from further participation.
translation: 请记住，这是一场个人比赛！任何试图组建团队以获取不公平优势的人都将被禁止进一步参与。 [qing ji zhu ， zhe shi yi chang ge ren bi sai ！ ren he shi tu zu jian tuan dui yi huo qu bu gong ping you shi de ren dou jiang bei jin zhi jin yi bu can yu 。]

english: Now that you know more, would you like to take part in a game of Last Man Standing?
translation: 现在您了解了更多，您想参加“Last Man Standing”游戏吗？ [xian zai nin liao jie le geng duo ， nin xiang can jia “Last Man Standing” you xi ma ？]

english: Not right now.
translation: 现在不行。 [xian zai bu xing 。]

english: No problem, come back if you happen to change your mind.
translation: 没问题，如果您改变主意，请回来。 [mei wen ti ， ru guo nin gai bian zhu yi ， qing hui lai 。]

english: I'd like to play.
translation: 我想玩。 [wo xiang wan 。]

english: Which mode would you like to play?
translation: 您想玩哪种模式？ [nin xiang wan na zhong mo shi ？]

english: You do not have enough money in your coffer.
translation: 你的金库里没有足够的钱。 [ni de jin ku li mei you zu gou de qian 。]

english: I'm afraid you can't take part in Last Man Standing on this world.
translation: 恐怕你不能参加《这个世界上最后的站立者》。 [kong pa ni bu neng can jia 《 zhe ge shi jie shang zui hou de zhan li zhe 》。]

translation: 休闲游戏将在接下来的 [60 - 5x] 秒内开始！ [xiu xian you xi jiang zai jie xia lai de  [60 - 5x]  miao nei kai shi ！]

translation: 来吧，我们需要 [2-24] 个高额参与者！ [lai ba ， wo men xu yao  [2-24]  ge gao e can yu zhe ！]

translation: 高风险（500,000 个硬币） [gao feng xian （500,000  ge ying bi ）]

translation: 有竞争力（免费入场） [you jing zheng li （ mian fei ru chang ）]

translation: 随意的 [sui yi de]
