translation: 取消 [qu xiao]

english: Hello, visitor!
translation: 访客您好！ [fang ke nin hao ！]

english: Hello. What are you up to?
translation: 你好。你要做什么？ [ni hao 。 ni yao zuo shen me ？]

english: Ah, I was about to collect some yak's milk to make yak cheese.
translation: 啊，我正准备收集一些牦牛奶来做牦牛奶酪呢。 [a ， wo zheng zhun bei shou ji yi xie mao niu nai lai zuo mao niu nai lao ne 。]

english: Eughr! Though I am curious. Can I try some?
translation: 哎呀！虽然我很好奇。我可以尝试一些吗？ [ai ya ！ sui ran wo hen hao qi 。 wo ke yi chang shi yi xie ma ？]

english: Sorry, no. The last outlander who ate my cheese was ill for a month.
translation: 抱歉，没有。最后一个吃我奶酪的外地人病了一个月。 [bao qian ， mei you 。 zui hou yi ge chi wo nai lao de wai di ren bing le yi ge yue 。]

english: So why don't you get ill as well?
translation: 那你为什么不也生病呢？ [na ni wei shen me bu ye sheng bing ne ？]

english: Well, we eat yak milk products every day, from when we're born. So I suppose we're used to it. Anyway I should stop yakking - haha - and get on with my work.
translation: 嗯，从我们出生起，我们每天都吃牦牛奶制品。所以我想我们已经习惯了。不管怎样，我应该停止叫嚷——哈哈——继续我的工作。 [n ， cong wo men chu sheng qi ， wo men mei tian dou chi mao niu nai zhi pin 。 suo yi wo xiang wo men yi jing xi guan le 。 bu guan zen yang ， wo ying gai ting zhi jiao rang —— ha ha —— ji xu wo de gong zuo 。]

english: I'm glad to see that puns are common everywhere in Gielinor; even here.
translation: 我很高兴看到双关语在吉林诺随处可见；即使在这里。 [wo hen gao xing kan dao shuang guan yu zai ji lin nuo sui chu ke jian ； ji shi zai zhe li 。]

english: I need your help with this!
translation: 我需要你的帮助！ [wo xu yao ni de bang zhu ！]

english: Thank you, well done!
translation: 谢谢，干得好！ [xie xie ， gan de hao ！]

english: You've [been given a new clue/obtained a casket]!
translation: 你[得到了新的线索/获得了一个棺材]！ [ni [ de dao le xin de xian suo / huo de le yi ge guan cai ]！]

english: Hello there. You look lost, are you okay?
translation: 你好呀。你看起来很失落，你还好吗？ [ni hao ya 。 ni kan qi lai hen shi luo ， ni hai hao ma ？]

english: I'm looking for a stronghold or something...
translation: 我正在寻找据点什么的... [wo zheng zai xun zhao ju dian shen me de ...]

english: Ahh... the Stronghold of Security. It's down there.
translation: 啊……安全要塞。它就在那里。 [a …… an quan yao sai 。 ta jiu zai na li 。]

english: Litara point's on the hole in the ground that looks like you could squeeze through.
translation: 利塔拉点位于地面上的洞上，看起来你可以挤过去。 [li ta la dian wei yu di mian shang de dong shang ， kan qi lai ni ke yi ji guo qu 。]

english: Looks kind of... deep and dark.
translation: 看起来有点……深沉而黑暗。 [kan qi lai you dian …… shen chen er hei an 。]

english: Yeah... tell that to my brother, he still hasn't come back.
translation: 是啊……告诉我哥哥吧，他还没回来。 [shi a …… gao su wo ge ge ba ， ta hai mei hui lai 。]

english: Your brother?
translation: 你的兄弟？ [ni de xiong di ？]

english: He's an explorer too. When the miner fell down that hole he'd made and came back babbling about doors, questions and treasure, my brother went to explore. No-one has seen him since.
translation: 他也是一位探险家。当矿工从他挖的洞里掉下来，回来时喋喋不休地谈论门、问题和宝藏时，我哥哥就去探索了。从那以后就没人见过他。 [ta ye shi yi wei tan xian jia 。 dang kuang gong cong ta wa de dong li diao xia lai ， hui lai shi die die bu xiu di tan lun men 、 wen ti he bao zang shi ， wo ge ge jiu qu tan suo le 。 cong na yi hou jiu mei ren jian guo ta 。]

english: Oh... that's not good.
translation: 哦……这样不好。 [o …… zhe yang bu hao 。]

english: Lots of people have been down there, but none of them have seen him, Let me know if you do, will you?
translation: 很多人都去过那里，但没有一个人见过他，如果你看到了请告诉我，好吗？ [hen duo ren dou qu guo na li ， dan mei you yi ge ren jian guo ta ， ru guo ni kan dao le qing gao su wo ， hao ma ？]

english: I'll certainly keep my eyes open.
translation: 我一定会擦亮眼睛的。 [wo yi ding hui ca liang yan jing de 。]

english: I'm fine, just passing through.
translation: 我没事，只是路过而已。 [wo mei shi ， zhi shi lu guo er yi 。]

english: I travelled to the bottom of the stronghold, and I emerge victorious!
translation: 我走到了据点的最底层，我胜利了！ [wo zou dao le ju dian de zui di ceng ， wo sheng li le ！]

english: Well done! You didn't happen to find my brother?
translation: 干得好！你不是碰巧找到我兄弟了吗？ [gan de hao ！ ni bu shi peng qiao zhao dao wo xiong di le ma ？]

english: About that...
translation: 关于那个... [guan yu na ge ...]

english: I sense bad news. It's okay, he's been gone so long. I believe I've moved on.
translation: 我感觉到了坏消息。没关系，他已经离开这么久了。我相信我已经继续前进了。 [wo gan jue dao le huai xiao xi 。 mei guan xi ， ta yi jing li kai zhe me jiu le 。 wo xiang xin wo yi jing ji xu qian jin le 。]

english: Well, at least he died doing what he loved.
translation: 好吧，至少他死时是在做他喜欢的事。 [hao ba ， zhi shao ta si shi shi zai zuo ta xi huan de shi 。]

english: True, I will raise a drink for him tonight, he was a good man, even if he was a pacifist.
translation: 确实，今晚我会为他敬一杯酒，他是一个好人，即使他是一个和平主义者。 [que shi ， jin wan wo hui wei ta jing yi bei jiu ， ta shi yi ge hao ren ， ji shi ta shi yi ge he ping zhu yi zhe 。]

english: As will I. See you around, Litara.
translation: 我也一样。再见，利塔拉。 [wo ye yi yang 。 zai jian ， li ta la 。]

english: Goodbye, [player name].
translation: 再见，[玩家姓名]。 [zai jian ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: I am glad the challenges of the stronghold have been overcome; it feels like my brother has somehow been avenged.
translation: 我很高兴据点的挑战已经被克服；感觉就像我的兄弟以某种方式报了仇。 [wo hen gao xing ju dian de tiao zhan yi jing bei ke fu ； gan jue jiu xiang wo de xiong di yi mou zhong fang shi bao le chou 。]

english: I'm looking for a stronghold or something...
translation: 我正在寻找据点什么的... [wo zheng zai xun zhao ju dian shen me de ...]

english: I'm fine, just passing through.
translation: 我没事，只是路过而已。 [wo mei shi ， zhi shi lu guo er yi 。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Greetings, human.
translation: 你好，人类。 [ni hao ， ren lei 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm Lithil. Haven't you heard of me?
translation: 我是莉希尔。你没听说过我吗？ [wo shi li xi er 。 ni mei ting shuo guo wo ma ？]

english: Can't say I have...
translation: 不能说我有... [bu neng shuo wo you ...]

english: ...Oh, well that's no good.
translation: ……哦，这样不行。 […… o ， zhe yang bu xing 。]

english: Should I? Did I miss some glorious feat of yours?
translation: 我应该吗？我是否错过了你的一些辉煌业绩？ [wo ying gai ma ？ wo shi fou cuo guo le ni de yi xie hui huang ye ji ？]

english: You must run in all the wrong circles. It's fine, I won't hold it against you.
translation: 你一定是跑错了圈子。没关系，我不会记恨你的。 [ni yi ding shi pao cuo le quan zi 。 mei guan xi ， wo bu hui ji hen ni de 。]

english: You're a demon! Usually I'm kill-
translation: 你是恶魔！通常我会被杀- [ni shi e mo ！ tong chang wo hui bei sha -]

english: Yes?
translation: 是的？ [shi de ？]

english: Nothing... You're right, wrong circles and all that.

english: The Wintertodt is a fiercely cold being, capable of freezing entire areas with its mere presence. We do not know what exactly the Wintertodt is, nor where it came from.
translation: 温特托是一种极度寒冷的存在，只要它的存在就能冻结整个区域。我们不知道 Wintertodt 到底是什么，也不知道它来自哪里。 [wen te tuo shi yi zhong ji du han leng de cun zai ， zhi yao ta de cun zai jiu neng dong jie zheng ge qu yu 。 wo men bu zhi dao  Wintertodt  dao di shi shen me ， ye bu zhi dao ta lai zi na li 。]

english: When the Wintertodt first attacked, it was feared that all of Kourend would be lost. Fortunately, the Order of the Sacred Flame and Dinh the Master Smith were able to stop it.

english: Dinh was a great smith and engineer. He uncovered the power of the Bruma tree. Using bark from the tree and various metal compounds, Dinh forged the doors of the prison that hold the Wintertodt.

english: More than 137 decades ago, seemingly from nowhere, the Wintertodt began terrorising the lands north of Kourend, freezing everything within its path.
translation: 137 多年前，温特托特似乎不知从何而来，开始对库伦德以北的土地进行恐怖袭击，冻结了其路径范围内的一切。 [137  duo nian qian ， wen te tuo te si hu bu zhi cong he er lai ， kai shi dui ku lun de yi bei de tu di jin xing kong bu xi ji ， dong jie le qi lu jing fan wei nei de yi qie 。]

english: After five decades of this terror, the people of Kourend were able to quell the beast, containing it in an icy prison.
translation: 在经历了五年的恐怖之后，库伦德的人们终于平息了这头野兽，将它关进了一座冰冷的监狱。 [zai jing li le wu nian de kong bu zhi hou ， ku lun de de ren men zhong yu ping xi le zhe tou ye shou ， jiang ta guan jin le yi zuo bing leng de jian yu 。]

english: The Wintertodt remained subdued until very recently, when it began to threaten Kourend once more.

translation: 你也可以拥有我发现的这本书。 [ni ye ke yi yong you wo fa xian de zhe ben shu 。]

english: You hand Logosia the tome.
translation: 你把这本书交给了Logosia。 [ni ba zhe ben shu jiao gei le Logosia。]

english: You can have these tomes which I discovered aswell.
translation: 你也可以拥有我发现的这些书。 [ni ye ke yi yong you wo fa xian de zhe xie shu 。]

english: You hand Logosia the tomes.
translation: 你把这些书交给Logosia。 [ni ba zhe xie shu jiao gei Logosia。]

english: Again, your donation to the library is appreciated
translation: 再次感谢您对图书馆的捐赠 [zai ci gan xie nin dui tu shu guan de juan zeng]

english: Your contributions to the library have been noticed. We would like to reward you for your assistance.
translation: 您对图书馆的贡献已被注意到。我们谨对您的帮助给予奖励。 [nin dui tu shu guan de gong xian yi bei zhu yi dao 。 wo men jin dui nin de bang zhu ji yu jiang li 。]

english: You receive an experience lamp as a reward.
translation: 您会收到一盏体验灯作为奖励。 [nin hui shou dao yi zhan ti yan deng zuo wei jiang li 。]

english: If you find any spare pages for these books I would be willing to give you 1,000 gold for each one. Duplicate sources of information are always useful.
translation: 如果你找到这些书的剩余页数，我愿意每本给你 1000 金币。重复的信息源总是有用的。 [ru guo ni zhao dao zhe xie shu de sheng yu ye shu ， wo yuan yi mei ben gei ni  1000  jin bi 。 chong fu de xin xi yuan zong shi you yong de 。]

english: I'll keep an eye out.
translation: 我会留意的。 [wo hui liu yi de 。]

english: Enough talk now, Shhhh!
translation: 现在说得够多了，嘘！ [xian zai shuo de gou duo le ， xu ！]

english: Here you go.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: I'm going to stop looking for temple, sun and moon pages.
translation: 我将不再寻找寺庙、太阳和月亮的页面。 [wo jiang bu zai xun zhao si miao 、 tai yang he yue liang de ye mian 。]

english: I'm going to start looking for temple, sun and moon pages.
translation: 我要开始寻找寺庙、太阳和月亮的页面。 [wo yao kai shi xun zhao si miao 、 tai yang he yue liang de ye mian 。]

english: Something else.
translation: 还有别的事。 [hai you bie de shi 。]

english: Tell me about the Library.
translation: 告诉我关于图书馆的事。 [gao su wo guan yu tu shu guan de shi 。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Do you help people find books?
translation: 你帮助人们找书吗？ [ni bang zhu ren men zhao shu ma ？]

english: Can you stop shushing me?
translation: 你能别再嘘我了吗？ [ni neng bie zai xu wo le ma ？]

english: Do you do anything useful at all?
translation: 你有做任何有用的事情吗？ [ni you zuo ren he you yong de shi qing ma ？]

english: What is wrong with you?
translation: 你怎么了？ [ni zen me le ？]

english: What is the point in you being here?
translation: 你来这里有什么意义？ [ni lai zhe li you shen me yi yi ？]

english: How can I get a job like yours?
translation: 我怎样才能找到像你这样的工作？ [wo zen yang cai neng zhao dao xiang ni zhe yang de gong zuo ？]

english: You're an utterly useless person.
translation: 你就是一个完全没用的人。 [ni jiu shi yi ge wan quan mei yong de ren 。]

english: HOW ABOUT I SHOUT REALLY LOUD THEN.
translation: 那我大声喊一下怎么样？ [na wo da sheng han yi xia zen me yang ？]

english: Sorry.
translation: 对不起。 [dui bu qi 。]

english: Can I help you today?
translation: 今天我可以帮你吗？ [jin tian wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: Can I go for a ride?
translation: 我可以去兜风吗？ [wo ke yi qu dou feng ma ？]

english: Minecart rides are 20 coins.
translation: 乘坐矿车需要 20 个金币。 [cheng zuo kuang che xu yao  20  ge jin bi 。]

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this.
translation: 作为 Lovakengj 矿车网络的忠实客户，您有权享受这一点。 [zuo wei  Lovakengj  kuang che wang luo de zhong shi ke hu ， nin you quan xiang shou zhe yi dian 。]

english: Now, can I help you today?
translation: 现在，今天我可以帮你吗？ [xian zai ， jin tian wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: You're already here, human.
translation: 你已经在这里了，人类。 [ni yi jing zai zhe li le ， ren lei 。]

english: Can I go for a ride?
translation: 我可以去兜风吗？ [wo ke yi qu dou feng ma ？]

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Don't talk to me! I don't have time for the likes of you!
translation: 别跟我说话！我没时间理你这种人！ [bie gen wo shuo hua ！ wo mei shi jian li ni zhe zhong ren ！]

english: You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Lunar Diplomacy quest.
translation: 您不满足开始月球外交任务的所有要求。 [nin bu man zu kai shi yue qiu wai jiao ren wu de suo you yao qiu 。]

english: Hey! Don't call me outerlander! I'm known as the mighty [Fremennik name]!
translation: 嘿！别叫我外地人！我被称为强大的[弗雷曼尼克名字]！ [hei ！ bie jiao wo wai di ren ！ wo bei cheng wei qiang da de [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！]

english: Can't say I've heard of you. So they let your sort into the clan nowadays? Wow. Things have really changed since I've been gone...
translation: 不能说我听说过你。所以现在他们让你加入部落了？哇。自从我离开后，事情真的发生了变化…… [bu neng shuo wo ting shuo guo ni 。 suo yi xian zai ta men rang ni jia ru bu luo le ？ wa 。 zi cong wo li kai hou ， shi qing zhen de fa sheng le bian hua ……]

english: You don't look like a Fremennik yourself...
translation: 你自己看起来不像弗雷曼尼克人…… [ni zi ji kan qi lai bu xiang fu lei man ni ke ren ……]

english: Yes, I suppose that's true... I have been gone such a long time...
translation: 是的，我想这是真的……我已经离开这么久了…… [shi de ， wo xiang zhe shi zhen de …… wo yi jing li kai zhe me jiu le ……]

english: (shows previous options)
translation: （显示以前的选项） [（ xian shi yi qian de xuan xiang ）]

english: You've been away from these parts a while?
translation: 您离开这些地方已经有一段时间了？ [nin li kai zhe xie di fang yi jing you yi duan shi jian le ？]

english: Oh, you haven't heard of the infamous Lokar, scourge of the northern seas?
translation: 哦，你还没听说过臭名昭著的洛卡（Lokar），北海的祸害吗？ [o ， ni hai mei ting shuo guo chou ming zhao zhu de luo ka （Lokar）， bei hai de huo hai ma ？]

english: Erm... no... That's you then, is it?
translation: 呃……不……那就是你，是吗？ [e …… bu …… na jiu shi ni ， shi ma ？]

english: Forgotten already? Tch! I have no regrets about why I left!
translation: 已经忘记了吗？切！对于我离开的原因，我并不后悔！ [yi jing wang ji le ma ？ qie ！ dui yu wo li kai de yuan yin ， wo bing bu hou hui ！]

english: Why did you leave?
translation: 你为什么离开？ [ni wei shen me li kai ？]

english: As a young man, I learnt that the Fremennik way of life was too slow for me...
translation: 作为一个年轻人，我了解到弗雷曼尼克的生活方式对我来说太慢了…… [zuo wei yi ge nian qing ren ， wo liao jie dao fu lei man ni ke de sheng huo fang shi dui wo lai shuo tai man le ……]

english: Oh, sure, every so often we got to go on big raiding parties, looting and pillaging the weaker islands around here for food and profit, but...
translation: 哦，当然，我们时不时地要参加大型袭击派对，为了食物和利润而抢劫和掠夺周围较弱的岛屿，但是...... [o ， dang ran ， wo men shi bu shi di yao can jia da xing xi ji pai dui ， wei le shi wu he li run er qiang jie he lve duo zhou wei jiao ruo de dao yu ， dan shi ......]

english: Well, after a while, that was all I looked forward to doing.
translation: 好吧，过了一段时间，这就是我所期待的。 [hao ba ， guo le yi duan shi jian ， zhe jiu shi wo suo qi dai de 。]

english: Growing crops, milking cows, catching and cooking food, the day to day activities of our life...
translation: 种植庄稼、挤奶、捕捉和烹饪食物，这些都是我们生活中的日常活动…… [zhong zhi zhuang jia 、 ji nai 、 bu zhuo he peng ren shi wu ， zhe xie dou shi wo men sheng huo zhong de ri chang huo dong ……]

english: THEY'RE SO BORING!
translation: 他们太无聊了！ [ta men tai wu liao le ！]

english: No, I knew what I wanted to do, and that was attack innocent people going about their daily business, steal all their money, then spend it on wine, women and song!
translation: 不，我知道我想做什么，那就是攻击那些正在做日常事务的无辜者，偷走他们所有的钱，然后把它花在酒、女人和歌曲上！ [bu ， wo zhi dao wo xiang zuo shen me ， na jiu shi gong ji na xie zheng zai zuo ri chang shi wu de wu gu zhe ， tou zou ta men suo you de qian ， ran hou ba ta hua zai jiu 、 nv ren he ge qu shang ！]

english: Oh.... Kaaaaay....
translation: 哦……卡啊啊啊…… [o …… ka a a a ……]

english: So I ran away from Rellekka to become a PIRATE! It's way more fun. Plus you get to see the world!
translation: 所以我逃离了Rellekka，成为了一名海盗！这更有趣。另外，你还可以看看世界！ [suo yi wo tao li le Rellekka， cheng wei le yi ming hai dao ！ zhe geng you qu 。 ling wai ， ni hai ke yi kan kan shi jie ！]

english: Was the world good then? Only, you seem to have returned to Rellekka after all.
translation: 那时的世界好吗？只是，你好像终于回到了雷莱卡了。 [na shi de shi jie hao ma ？ zhi shi ， ni hao xiang zhong yu hui dao le lei lai ka le 。]

english: Yes, I have returned here, but that's only because we're short on supplies.
translation: 是的，我回到了这里，但这只是因为我们的物资短缺。 [shi de ， wo hui dao le zhe li ， dan zhe zhi shi yin wei wo men de wu zi duan que 。]

english: I see. So where are you and your scurvy sea-dogs headed to next? Arrr shiver-me timbers!
translation: 我懂了。那么你和你的坏血病水手下一步要去哪里呢？啊，木材让我颤抖！ [wo dong le 。 na me ni he ni de huai xue bing shui shou xia yi bu yao qu na li ne ？ a ， mu cai rang wo chan dou ！]

english: You're trying my patience...
translation: 你这是在考验我的耐心... [ni zhe shi zai kao yan wo de nai xin ...]

english: Sorry, got caught up in the moment.
translation: 抱歉，一时陷入困境。 [bao qian ， yi shi xian ru kun jing 。]

english: Indeed. Well, the rest of the group are at Lunar Isle at the moment. It's where the Moon Clan live.
translation: 的确。嗯，剩下的人现在都在月岛了。这里是月族居住的地方。 [di que 。 n ， sheng xia de ren xian zai dou zai yue dao le 。 zhe li shi yue zu ju zhu de di fang 。]

english: The Moon Clan... I think I've heard of them...
translation: 月族……我好像听说过他们…… [yue zu …… wo hao xiang ting shuo guo ta men ……]

english: I'd be surprised if you hadn't, they're the Fremenniks' most hated enemy!
translation: 如果你没有的话我会感到惊讶，他们是弗雷曼尼克人最讨厌的敌人！ [ru guo ni mei you de hua wo hui gan dao jing ya ， ta men shi fu lei man ni ke ren zui tao yan de di ren ！]

english: They've been at war with them for hundreds of years!
translation: 他们已经和他们交战了几百年了！ [ta men yi jing he ta men jiao zhan le ji bai nian le ！]

english: Hmmm. Actually, that might be a problem for you then.
translation: 嗯。事实上，这对你来说可能是个问题。 [n 。 shi shi shang ， zhe dui ni lai shuo ke neng shi ge wen ti 。]

english: A problem?
translation: 有问题吗？ [you wen ti ma ？]

english: Yeah, they're a really powerful race of mages. They'd read your mind and see that you're a Fremennik straight away, then probably turn you inside out and feed you to the birds.
translation: 是的，他们是一个非常强大的法师种族。他们会读懂你的心思，立刻看出你是弗雷曼尼克人，然后可能会把你翻个底朝天，然后把你喂给鸟儿吃。 [shi de ， ta men shi yi ge fei chang qiang da de fa shi zhong zu 。 ta men hui du dong ni de xin si ， li ke kan chu ni shi fu lei man ni ke ren ， ran hou ke neng hui ba ni fan ge di chao tian ， ran hou ba ni wei gei niao er chi 。]

english: Cosmic.
translation: 宇宙的。 [yu zhou de 。]

english: But you went there okay?
translation: 但你去了那里好吗？ [dan ni qu le na li hao ma ？]

english: Yeah, but I think the Fremenniks are a bunch of losers. They probably picked up on that.
translation: 是的，但我认为弗雷曼尼克队是一群失败者。他们可能注意到了这一点。 [shi de ， dan wo ren wei fu lei man ni ke dui shi yi qun shi bai zhe 。 ta men ke neng zhu yi dao le zhe yi dian 。]

english: Look, I know a way you'll be able to travel there without, you know, getting killed and that, if you fancy a trip!
translation: 听着，我知道一种方法，让你可以去那里旅行，而不会被杀，如果你喜欢旅行的话！ [ting zhe ， wo zhi dao yi zhong fang fa ， rang ni ke yi qu na li lv xing ， er bu hui bei sha ， ru guo ni xi huan lv xing de hua ！]

english: Why not, I've always wondered what the state of my innards are!
translation: 为什么不呢，我一直想知道我的内脏是什么样的！ [wei shen me bu ne ， wo yi zhi xiang zhi dao wo de nei zang shi shen me yang de ！]

english: That's the spirit!
translation: 这就是精神！ [zhe jiu shi jing shen ！]

english: Well, what you want to do is go and talk to Brundt the Chieftain and get a Seal of Passage from him.
translation: 好吧，你要做的就是去与酋长布伦特交谈并从他那里得到通行印章。 [hao ba ， ni yao zuo de jiu shi qu yu qiu zhang bu lun te jiao tan bing cong ta na li de dao tong xing yin zhang 。]

english: A Seal of Passage? What's that?
translation: 通道印记？那是什么？ [tong dao yin ji ？ na shi shen me ？]

english: Well, it shows that you're a diplomat for the Fremennik, so you'll have immunity from being killed and stuff.
translation: 好吧，这表明你是弗里曼尼克的外交官，所以你将免受杀害之类的事情的影响。 [hao ba ， zhe biao ming ni shi fu li man ni ke de wai jiao guan ， suo yi ni jiang mian shou sha hai zhi lei de shi qing de ying xiang 。]

english: It's an ancient tradition not to attack anyone bearing a Seal of Passage, because they're probably on a diplomatic mission. Or well connected with powerful allies. Either way, killing them is usually a bad idea.
translation: 不攻击任何带有通行印章的人是一个古老的传统，因为他们可能正在执行外交任务。或者与强大的盟友有良好的联系。不管怎样，杀死他们通常都是一个坏主意。 [bu gong ji ren he dai you tong xing yin zhang de ren shi yi ge gu lao de chuan tong ， yin wei ta men ke neng zheng zai zhi xing wai jiao ren wu 。 huo zhe yu qiang da de meng you you liang hao de lian xi 。 bu guan zen yang ， sha si ta men tong chang dou shi yi ge huai zhu yi 。]

english: So I have to try and bring peace to two warring nations who have been fighting for centuries?!?!
translation: 所以我必须努力为两个已经战斗了几个世纪的交战国家带来和平？！？！ [suo yi wo bi xu nu li wei liang ge yi jing zhan dou le ji ge shi ji de jiao zhan guo jia dai lai he ping ？！？！]

english: What? I never said you had to bother trying to do that, you just have to pretend like you might.
translation: 什么？我从来没有说过你必须费心去尝试这样做，你只需假装你可能会这样做。 [shen me ？ wo cong lai mei you shuo guo ni bi xu fei xin qu chang shi zhe yang zuo ， ni zhi xu jia zhuang ni ke neng hui zhe yang zuo 。]

english: No skin off my nose if those losers want to get slaughtered by the Moon Clan, just more stuff for me to loot when they're all dead.
translation: 如果那些失败者想要被月族屠杀，我不会从鼻子上剥下来的，只是当他们都死了之后我可以掠夺更多的东西。 [ru guo na xie shi bai zhe xiang yao bei yue zu tu sha ， wo bu hui cong bi zi shang bo xia lai de ， zhi shi dang ta men dou si le zhi hou wo ke yi lve duo geng duo de dong xi 。]

english: Well I will try. I am the mighty [Fremennik name] after all!
translation: 好吧，我会尝试的。毕竟我是强大的[弗雷曼尼克名字]！ [hao ba ， wo hui chang shi de 。 bi jing wo shi qiang da de [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！]

english: Yes....
translation: 是的.... [shi de ....]

english: So I just have to go talk to Brundt the Chieftain and tell him I want a Seal of Passage?
translation: 所以我只需要去和酋长布伦特谈谈并告诉他我想要一个通道印章？ [suo yi wo zhi xu yao qu he qiu zhang bu lun te tan tan bing gao su ta wo xiang yao yi ge tong dao yin zhang ？]

english: That's it? Because in my experience simple tasks like that always seem to take longer than I expect...
translation: 就是这样？因为根据我的经验，像这样的简单任务似乎总是比我预期花费的时间更长...... [jiu shi zhe yang ？ yin wei gen ju wo de jing yan ， xiang zhe yang de jian dan ren wu si hu zong shi bi wo yu qi hua fei de shi jian geng zhang ......]

english: Yeah, just go over and talk to the chief loser. You might have to tell him some rubbish he wants to hear, but that's it.
translation: 是的，过去和主要失败者谈谈吧。你可能不得不告诉他一些他想听的废话，但仅此而已。 [shi de ， guo qu he zhu yao shi bai zhe tan tan ba 。 ni ke neng bu de bu gao su ta yi xie ta xiang ting de fei hua ， dan jin ci er yi 。]

english: Come back here when you got it, my supplies are loaded and I'm good to head back to our ship.
translation: 收到货后就回来吧，我的补给品已经装好了，我可以回到我们的船上了。 [shou dao huo hou jiu hui lai ba ， wo de bu ji pin yi jing zhuang hao le ， wo ke yi hui dao wo men de chuan shang le 。]

english: Okay, I'll be right back.
translation: 好的，我马上回来。 [hao de ， wo ma shang hui lai 。]

english: No thanks, I'd like to live.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我想活下去。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo xiang huo xia qu 。]

english: Oh, so you're a loser like the rest of the Fremenniks then? See ya around, loser.
translation: 哦，那么你和其他弗雷曼尼克人一样都是失败者吗？再见，失败者。 [o ， na me ni he qi ta fu lei man ni ke ren yi yang dou shi shi bai zhe ma ？ zai jian ， shi bai zhe 。]

english: Well, 'bye then.
translation: 好吧，那么再见。 [hao ba ， na me zai jian 。]

english: You won't make many friends on Lunar Isle without your Seal of Passage.
translation: 如果没有通道印章，你在月岛上不会结交很多朋友。 [ru guo mei you tong dao yin zhang ， ni zai yue dao shang bu hui jie jiao hen duo peng you 。]

english: That's fine, I'm just going to Pirates' Cove.
translation: 没关系，我只是去海盗湾。 [mei guan xi ， wo zhi shi qu hai dao wan 。]

english: Player is transported to Pirates' cove
translation: 玩家被传送到海盗湾 [wan jia bei chuan song dao hai dao wan]

english: Oh, I'd better go back and get it.
translation: 哦，我还是回去拿吧。 [o ， wo hai shi hui qu na ba 。]

english: Hi Lokar, can you take me back to your ship?
translation: 嗨，Lokar，你能带我回你的船吗？ [hai ，Lokar， ni neng dai wo hui ni de chuan ma ？]

english: Sheesh, make your mind up [pal/lady], I'm not a taxi service!
translation: 哎呀，你拿定主意吧[朋友/女士]，我不是出租车服务公司！ [ai ya ， ni na ding zhu yi ba [ peng you / nv shi ]， wo bu shi chu zu che fu wu gong si ！]

english: Actually, I've changed my mind. Again. I don't want to go.
translation: 事实上，我已经改变主意了。再次。我不想去。 [shi shi shang ， wo yi jing gai bian zhu yi le 。 zai ci 。 wo bu xiang qu 。]

english: You are possibly the most indecisive person I have ever met...
translation: 你可能是我见过的最优柔寡断的人了…… [ni ke neng shi wo jian guo de zui you rou gua duan de ren le ……]

english: Hello again Lokar.
translation: 你好，洛卡。 [ni hao ， luo ka 。]

english: Hi again [Fremennik name]! What can I do for you?
translation: 再次嗨[弗雷曼尼克名字]！我能为你做什么？ [zai ci hai [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！ wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: Do I still need the Seal of Passage?
translation: 我还需要通行印章吗？ [wo hai xu yao tong xing yin zhang ma ？]

english: Yeah, why?
translation: 是啊，为什么？ [shi a ， wei shen me ？]

english: I lost it.
translation: 我把它弄丢了。 [wo ba ta nong diu le 。]

english: Silly you. You'll have to go back to Brundt the Chieftain to get another before you can go on to Lunar Isle.
translation: 愚蠢的你。在前往月岛之前，你必须先回到酋长布伦特那里再拿一份。 [yu chun de ni 。 zai qian wang yue dao zhi qian ， ni bi xu xian hui dao qiu zhang bu lun te na li zai na yi fen 。]

english: Can you take me back to Rellekka please?
translation: 你能带我回雷莱卡吗？ [ni neng dai wo hui lei lai ka ma ？]

english: Hey, if you want to go back to loserville with all the losers, who am I to stop you?
translation: 嘿，如果你想和所有失败者一起回洛瑟维尔，我有什么资格阻止你？ [hei ， ru guo ni xiang he suo you shi bai zhe yi qi hui luo se wei er ， wo you shen me zi ge zu zhi ni ？]

english: Player is transported to Rellekka
translation: 玩家被传送到雷莱卡 [wan jia bei chuan song dao lei lai ka]

english: Nothing thanks! I just saw you here and thought I'd say hello!
translation: 没什么，谢谢！我刚刚在这里看到你，我想打个招呼！ [mei shen me ， xie xie ！ wo gang gang zai zhe li kan dao ni ， wo xiang da ge zhao hu ！]

english: Hey, I knew you seemed cool when I met you [Fremennik name]!
translation: 嘿，当我见到你[弗雷曼尼克名字]时我就知道你看起来很酷！ [hei ， dang wo jian dao ni [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ] shi wo jiu zhi dao ni kan qi lai hen ku ！]

english: You don't look like a Fremennik yourself...
translation: 你自己看起来不像弗雷曼尼克人…… [ni zi ji kan qi lai bu xiang fu lei man ni ke ren ……]

english: You've been away from these parts a while?
translation: 您离开这些地方已经有一段时间了？ [nin li kai zhe xie di fang yi jing you yi duan shi jian le ？]

english: Why did you leave?
translation: 你为什么离开？ [ni wei shen me li kai ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: 'Bye then.
translation: '那么再见。 [' na me zai jian 。]

english: That's fine, I'm just going to Pirates' Cove.
translation: 没关系，我只是去海盗湾。 [mei guan xi ， wo zhi shi qu hai dao wan 。]

english: Oh, I'd better go back and get it.
translation: 哦，我还是回去拿吧。 [o ， wo hai shi hui qu na ba 。]

english: Go now.
translation: 现在就去吧。 [xian zai jiu qu ba 。]

english: Don't go.
translation: 别走。 [bie zou 。]

english: Can you take me back to Rellekka?
translation: 你能带我回雷莱卡吗？ [ni neng dai wo hui lei lai ka ma ？]

english: Nothing thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。]

english: Greetings human.
translation: 问候人类。 [wen hou ren lei 。]

english: Hello, who are you?
translation: 你好，你是谁？ [ni hao ， ni shi shui ？]

english: Lokraa quo Sihar. I am one of the mystics of the Kahlith. Are you here to serve the balance?
translation: Lokraa quo Sihar。我是卡利斯的神秘主义者之一。你来这里是为了平衡吗？ [Lokraa quo Sihar。 wo shi ka li si de shen mi zhu yi zhe zhi yi 。 ni lai zhe li shi wei le ping heng ma ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: Then you should speak to Konar quo Maten. She will guide you.
translation: 那么你应该和Konar quo Maten 谈谈。她会指导你。 [na me ni ying gai he Konar quo Maten  tan tan 。 ta hui zhi dao ni 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: A shame. You are a bringer of death, you could be of great use to the balance.
translation: 丢人现眼。你是死亡使者，你对平衡有很大的用处。 [diu ren xian yan 。 ni shi si wang shi zhe ， ni dui ping heng you hen da de yong chu 。]

english: I'm not sure.
translation: 我不知道。 [wo bu zhi dao 。]

english: Then you should speak with Xorrah quo Sihar. He will show you the way.
translation: 那么你应该和 Xorrah quo Sihar 谈谈。他会给你指路。 [na me ni ying gai he  Xorrah quo Sihar  tan tan 。 ta hui gei ni zhi lu 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: I'm not sure.
translation: 我不知道。 [wo bu zhi dao 。]

english: Arrr, matey!
translation: 啊，伙计！ [a ， huo ji ！]

english: I'm looking for Redbeard Frank.
translation: 我正在寻找红胡子弗兰克。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao hong hu zi fu lan ke 。]

english: Redbeard Frank ye say? He be outside. Says he likes the feel of the wind on his cheeks.
translation: 红胡子弗兰克你说呢？他在外面。说他喜欢风拂过脸颊的感觉。 [hong hu zi fu lan ke ni shuo ne ？ ta zai wai mian 。 shuo ta xi huan feng fu guo lian jia de gan jue 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Why are you called Longbow Ben?
translation: 为什么叫长弓本？ [wei shen me jiao zhang gong ben ？]

english: Arrr, that's a strange yarn.
translation: 呃，这是一个奇怪的故事。 [e ， zhe shi yi ge qi guai de gu shi 。]

english: I was to be marooned, ye see. A scurvy troublemaker had taken my ship, and he put me ashore on a little island.
translation: 你看，我将被困在困境中。一个坏血病的麻烦制造者夺走了我的船，他把我带到了一个小岛上。 [ni kan ， wo jiang bei kun zai kun jing zhong 。 yi ge huai xue bing de ma fan zhi zao zhe duo zou le wo de chuan ， ta ba wo dai dao le yi ge xiao dao shang 。]

english: Gosh, how did you escape?
translation: 天哪，你是怎么逃出来的？ [tian na ， ni shi zen me tao chu lai de ？]

english: Arrr, ye see, he made one mistake! Before he sailed away, he gave me a bow and one arrow so that I wouldn't have to die slowly.
translation: 哎呀，你看，他犯了一个错误！在他扬帆离开之前，他给了我一张弓和一支箭，这样我就不会慢慢死去。 [ai ya ， ni kan ， ta fan le yi ge cuo wu ！ zai ta yang fan li kai zhi qian ， ta gei le wo yi zhang gong he yi zhi jian ， zhe yang wo jiu bu hui man man si qu 。]

english: So I shot him and took my ship back.
translation: 所以我开枪打死了他并拿回了我的船。 [suo yi wo kai qiang da si le ta bing na hui le wo de chuan 。]

english: Right...
translation: 正确的... [zheng que de ...]

english: Have you got any quests I could do?
translation: 你有什么任务我可以做吗？ [ni you shen me ren wu wo ke yi zuo ma ？]

english: Nay, but the barkeep hears most of the news around here. Or Redbeard Frank, he's often spoken of buried treasure. Perhaps ye should be asking them for quests.
translation: 不，但这里的大部分新闻都是酒保听到的。或者红胡子弗兰克，他经常谈论埋藏的宝藏。也许你们应该向他们询问任务。 [bu ， dan zhe li de da bu fen xin wen dou shi jiu bao ting dao de 。 huo zhe hong hu zi fu lan ke ， ta jing chang tan lun mai cang de bao zang 。 ye xu ni men ying gai xiang ta men xun wen ren wu 。]

english: Nay, but Redbeard Frank has often spoken of buried treasure. Perhaps ye should be asking him for a quest.
translation: 不，但是红胡子弗兰克经常谈到埋藏的宝藏。也许你应该向他提出一个任务。 [bu ， dan shi hong hu zi fu lan ke jing chang tan dao mai cang de bao zang 。 ye xu ni ying gai xiang ta ti chu yi ge ren wu 。]

english: Nay, but the barkeep hears most of the news around here. Perhaps ye should be asking him for a quest.
translation: 不，但这里的大部分新闻都是酒保听到的。也许你应该向他提出一个任务。 [bu ， dan zhe li de da bu fen xin wen dou shi jiu bao ting dao de 。 ye xu ni ying gai xiang ta ti chu yi ge ren wu 。]

english: Nay, I've nothing for ye to do. But I hear there's an old landlubber in Draynor Village who's always a-looking for a lively [lad/lass] to do him a favour.
translation: 不，我没有什么可以让你做的。但我听说德拉诺村有一个旱鸭子，他总是在寻找一个活泼的[小伙子/姑娘]来帮他一个忙。 [bu ， wo mei you shen me ke yi rang ni zuo de 。 dan wo ting shuo de la nuo cun you yi ge han ya zi ， ta zong shi zai xun zhao yi ge huo po de [ xiao huo zi / gu niang ] lai bang ta yi ge mang 。]

english: Arrr, matey!
translation: 啊，伙计！ [a ， huo ji ！]

english: Yo ho ho!
translation: 哟嗬嗬！ [yo he he ！]

english: So are you pirates?
translation: 那么你们是海盗吗？ [na me ni men shi hai dao ma ？]

english: Aye laddie, that we are.
translation: 是的，小伙子，我们就是。 [shi de ， xiao huo zi ， wo men jiu shi 。]

english: Aye, that we be.
translation: 是的，我们就是这样。 [shi de ， wo men jiu shi zhe yang 。]

english: Nay, always ye say it wrong! Tis 'we are', not 'we be'.
translation: 不，你们总是说错！这是“我们是”，而不是“我们是”。 [bu ， ni men zong shi shuo cuo ！ zhe shi “ wo men shi ”， er bu shi “ wo men shi ”。]

english: I be a pirate, not a scurvy schoolmaster!
translation: 我是一名海盗，而不是一名坏血病校长！ [wo shi yi ming hai dao ， er bu shi yi ming huai xue bing xiao zhang ！]

english: Ye be a fool, and a disgrace to piracy.
translation: 你们是个傻瓜，是盗版的耻辱。 [ni men shi ge sha gua ， shi dao ban de chi ru 。]

english: Now ye be saying 'be' too!
translation: 现在你们也可以说“是”了！ [xian zai ni men ye ke yi shuo “ shi ” le ！]

english: Arrr! Tis thy fault.
translation: 啊！这是你的错。 [a ！ zhe shi ni de cuo 。]

english: I think I'll leave you two to sort it out.
translation: 我想我会让你们两个来解决这个问题。 [wo xiang wo hui rang ni men liang ge lai jie jue zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: I'm looking for Redbeard Frank.
translation: 我正在寻找红胡子弗兰克。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao hong hu zi fu lan ke 。]

english: Why are you called Longbow Ben?
translation: 为什么叫长弓本？ [wei shen me jiao zhang gong ben ？]

english: Have you got any quests I could do?
translation: 你有什么任务我可以做吗？ [ni you shen me ren wu wo ke yi zuo ma ？]

english: Hey, outerlander. You can't go through there. Talent only, backstage.
translation: 嘿，外地人。你不能从那里经过。只有人才，后台。 [hei ， wai di ren 。 ni bu neng cong na li jing guo 。 zhi you ren cai ， hou tai 。]

english: Get lost, outerlander. Performers only past this point.
translation: 迷路吧，外地人。表演者只过了这一点。 [mi lu ba ， wai di ren 。 biao yan zhe zhi guo le zhe yi dian 。]

english: But I am a performer!
translation: 但我是一个表演者！ [dan wo shi yi ge biao yan zhe ！]

english: Oh, really? So where's your instrument?
translation: 哦真的吗？那么你的乐器在哪里？ [o zhen de ma ？ na me ni de yue qi zai na li ？]

english: Um... I'm an acapella bard?
translation: 嗯...我是阿卡贝拉吟游诗人？ [n ... wo shi a ka bei la yin you shi ren ？]

english: Oh, really? You won't mind singing me a quick song then.
translation: 哦真的吗？那你不介意给我唱一首快歌吧。 [o zhen de ma ？ na ni bu jie yi gei wo chang yi shou kuai ge ba 。]

english: Tie me chompy bird down, Rantz Tie me chompy bird down! Me stickers don't get no quicker, So tie me chompy bird down!
translation: 把我的小鸟绑起来，兰兹把我的小鸟绑起来！我的贴纸不能再快点了，所以把我那只嚼劲的鸟绑起来吧！ [ba wo de xiao niao bang qi lai ， lan zi ba wo de xiao niao bang qi lai ！ wo de tie zhi bu neng zai kuai dian le ， suo yi ba wo na zhi jue jin de niao bang qi lai ba ！]

english: (continues below)
translation: （下面继续） [（ xia mian ji xu ）]

english: Murphy row the boat ashore... We are siiiiinking...
translation: 墨菲把船划到岸上……我们正在思考…… [mo fei ba chuan hua dao an shang …… wo men zheng zai si kao ……]

english: My old man's a miner, Spends all day mining ore, He wears a dragon ammy, And lives in Falador - Oi!
translation: 我的老人是一名矿工，整天都在开采矿石，他戴着龙盔，住在法拉多 - 哎呀！ [wo de lao ren shi yi ming kuang gong ， zheng tian dou zai kai cai kuang shi ， ta dai zhe long kui ， zhu zai fa la duo  -  ai ya ！]

english: Elvarg the magic dragon... Lives by the sea... He spends all his days eating folk, And dies occasionally...
translation: 魔龙埃尔瓦格...住在海边...他整天吃人，偶尔会死... [mo long ai er wa ge ... zhu zai hai bian ... ta zheng tian chi ren ， ou er hui si ...]

english: That was a pile of tosh. Get lost, outerlander. You're a bard like I'm a goblin. Do I look stupid to you?
translation: 那是一堆垃圾。迷路吧，外地人。你是个吟游诗人，就像我是个妖精一样。我在你眼里看起来很蠢吗？ [na shi yi dui la ji 。 mi lu ba ， wai di ren 。 ni shi ge yin you shi ren ， jiu xiang wo shi ge yao jing yi yang 。 wo zai ni yan li kan qi lai hen chun ma ？]

english: Well, actually...
translation: 嗯，实际上... [n ， shi ji shang ...]

english: I said, get lost.
translation: 我说，滚吧。 [wo shuo ， gun ba 。]

english: You have an instrument now, huh? Go on through the door.
translation: 你现在有乐器了吧？穿过门继续走。 [ni xian zai you yue qi le ba ？ chuan guo men ji xu zou 。]

english: Yeah, you're good to go through. Olaf tells me you're some kind of outerlander bard here on tour. I doubt you're worse than Olaf is.
translation: 是的，你能通过就很好了。奥拉夫告诉我，你是来这里巡演的外地吟游诗人。我怀疑你比奥拉夫还糟糕。 [shi de ， ni neng tong guo jiu hen hao le 。 ao la fu gao su wo ， ni shi lai zhe li xun yan de wai di yin you shi ren 。 wo huai yi ni bi ao la fu hai zao gao 。]

english: You can't go through there. Talent only, backstage.
translation: 你不能从那里经过。只有人才，后台。 [ni bu neng cong na li jing guo 。 zhi you ren cai ， hou tai 。]

english: But I'm a Bard!
translation: 但我是吟游诗人！ [dan wo shi yin you shi ren ！]

english: No you're not. I saw your performance. I was paid well to keep you from ever setting foot on stage here again.
translation: 不，你不是。我看到了你的表演。我得到了丰厚的报酬，就是为了阻止你再次踏上这里的舞台。 [bu ， ni bu shi 。 wo kan dao le ni de biao yan 。 wo de dao le feng hou de bao chou ， jiu shi wei le zu zhi ni zai ci ta shang zhe li de wu tai 。]

english: Tie Me Chompy Bird Down
translation: 把我的大嘴鸟绑起来 [ba wo de da zui niao bang qi lai]

english: Murphy Row The Boat Ashore
translation: 墨菲划船上岸 [mo fei hua chuan shang an]

english: My Old Man's A Miner
translation: 我的老人是一名矿工 [wo de lao ren shi yi ming kuang gong]

english: Elvarg The Magic Dragon
translation: 魔龙艾尔瓦格 [mo long ai er wa ge]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Hello, Longramble. How goes the hunt for the edge of the world?
translation: 你好，朗格兰布尔。寻找世界边缘的进展如何？ [ni hao ， lang ge lan bu er 。 xun zhao shi jie bian yuan de jin zhan ru he ？]

english: Truth be told, I've found myself getting a bit side- tracked. The potential discovery of Arposandra is quite an exciting one!
translation: 说实话，我发现自己有点走偏了。 Arposandra 的潜在发现是一件非常令人兴奋的事情！ [shuo shi hua ， wo fa xian zi ji you dian zou pian le 。 Arposandra  de qian zai fa xian shi yi jian fei chang ling ren xing fen de shi qing ！]

english: And also quite dangerous.
translation: 而且也相当危险。 [er qie ye xiang dang wei xian 。]

english: Yes, that's why I've not dared go inside again. It's much safer out here. Slightly less smelly as well.
translation: 是的，所以我不敢再进去了。这里安全多了。臭味也少了一些。 [shi de ， suo yi wo bu gan zai jin qu le 。 zhe li an quan duo le 。 chou wei ye shao le yi xie 。]

english: Slightly being the key word there.
translation: 稍微成为那里的关键词。 [shao wei cheng wei na li de guan jian ci 。]

english: Hello there. How goes the hunt for Arposandra?
translation: 你好呀。寻找阿波斯桑德拉的行动进展如何？ [ni hao ya 。 xun zhao a bo si sang de la de xing dong jin zhan ru he ？]

english: I think I've found an entrance to the city, but it's too well defended. There's all these traps, and some talking terrorbird guards!
translation: 我想我已经找到了这座城市的入口，但它的防守太严密了。这里有所有这些陷阱，还有一些会说话的恐怖鸟守卫！ [wo xiang wo yi jing zhao dao le zhe zuo cheng shi de ru kou ， dan ta de fang shou tai yan mi le 。 zhe li you suo you zhe xie xian jing ， hai you yi xie hui shuo hua de kong bu niao shou wei ！]

english: Talking terrorbirds? There must be some strange magic being practised in there. What do you plan to do?
translation: 会说话的恐怖鸟？那里一定正在施行某种奇怪的魔法。你打算做什么？ [hui shuo hua de kong bu niao ？ na li yi ding zheng zai shi xing mou zhong qi guai de mo fa 。 ni da suan zuo shen me ？]

english: I don't know. I think I've hit a dead end for now.
translation: 我不知道。我想我现在已经走进了死胡同。 [wo bu zhi dao 。 wo xiang wo xian zai yi jing zou jin le si hu tong 。]

english: That's a shame. Still, you've made a big discovery. It will be quite the tale to tell... assuming anyone believes a story about talking terrorbirds, that is.
translation: 太可惜了。尽管如此，你还是有了一个重大发现。这将是一个很值得讲述的故事……假设有人相信一个关于会说话的恐怖鸟的故事。 [tai ke xi le 。 jin guan ru ci ， ni hai shi you le yi ge zhong da fa xian 。 zhe jiang shi yi ge hen zhi de jiang shu de gu shi …… jia she you ren xiang xin yi ge guan yu hui shuo hua de kong bu niao de gu shi 。]

english: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？ [ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: What are you guarding?
translation: 你在守护什么？ [ni zai shou hu shen me ？]

english: This path leads to the Doors of Dinh. You should be careful if you wish to travel any further.
translation: 这条路通向丁之门。如果您想进一步旅行，请务必小心。 [zhe tiao lu tong xiang ding zhi men 。 ru guo nin xiang jin yi bu lv xing ， qing wu bi xiao xin 。]

english: Tell me about the Doors of Dinh.
translation: 告诉我关于丁之门的事。 [gao su wo guan yu ding zhi men de shi 。]

english: They're to keep the Wintertodt at bay. No-one knows what it really is, but centuries ago it came out of the northern wastes to terrorise the kingdom.
translation: 他们要阻止温特托特人。没有人知道它到底是什么，但几个世纪前，它从北方荒原中出现，对王国造成了恐怖。 [ta men yao zu zhi wen te tuo te ren 。 mei you ren zhi dao ta dao di shi shen me ， dan ji ge shi ji qian ， ta cong bei fang huang yuan zhong chu xian ， dui wang guo zao cheng le kong bu 。]

english: The Doors were created by Dinh, a master smither, to imprison the Wintertodt.
translation: 大门是由铁匠大师 Dinh 创建的，用于囚禁温特托特。 [da men shi you tie jiang da shi  Dinh  chuang jian de ， yong yu qiu jin wen te tuo te 。]

english: Now we keep a watch on the pass, so that the armies can be summoned if the Wintertodt ever escapes.
translation: 现在我们监视着山口，以便万一温特托特逃走，我们可以召集军队。 [xian zai wo men jian shi zhe shan kou ， yi bian wan yi wen te tuo te tao zou ， wo men ke yi zhao ji jun dui 。]

english: Okay, thanks for the warning.
translation: 好的，谢谢你的警告。 [hao de ， xie xie ni de jing gao 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm the duty look-out on the northern pass. It's the worst assignment there is.
translation: 我是北部山口的值班哨兵。这是最糟糕的任务。 [wo shi bei bu shan kou de zhi ban shao bing 。 zhe shi zui zao gao de ren wu 。]

english: As if the cold weren't bad enough, the snooty Arceuus magi always look down their noses at the Shayzien armies, just because we use muscle and steel rather than fancy magicks.
translation: 好像寒冷还不够糟糕，傲慢的阿尔宙斯法师总是瞧不起沙伊恩军队，只是因为我们使用的是肌肉和钢铁，而不是花哨的魔法。 [hao xiang han leng hai bu gou zao gao ， ao man de a er zhou si fa shi zong shi qiao bu qi sha yi en jun dui ， zhi shi yin wei wo men shi yong de shi ji rou he gang tie ， er bu shi hua shao de mo fa 。]

english: I'll leave you alone now.
translation: 我现在就让你一个人呆着吧。 [wo xian zai jiu rang ni yi ge ren dai zhe ba 。]

english: What are you guarding?
translation: 你在守护什么？ [ni zai shou hu shen me ？]

english: Tell me about the Doors of Dinh.
translation: 告诉我关于丁之门的事。 [gao su wo guan yu ding zhi men de shi 。]

english: Okay, thanks for the warning.
translation: 好的，谢谢你的警告。 [hao de ， xie xie ni de jing gao 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I'll leave you alone now.
translation: 我现在就让你一个人呆着吧。 [wo xian zai jiu rang ni yi ge ren dai zhe ba 。]

english: You! You're the one that lost me my tithes. Get out before I have you killed!
translation: 你！你就是那个让我失去什一税的人。在我杀掉你之前滚出去！ [ni ！ ni jiu shi na ge rang wo shi qu shen yi shui de ren 。 zai wo sha diao ni zhi qian gun chu qu ！]

english: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 人类！在我叫守卫之前回到奴隶围栏！ [ren lei ！ zai wo jiao shou wei zhi qian hui dao nu li wei lan ！]

english: You there. Who are you?
translation: 你在那里。你是谁？ [ni zai na li 。 ni shi shui ？]

english: [Vampyre Name]
translation: [吸血鬼名字] [[ xi xue gui ming zi ]]

english: Tell me, [player vampyre name], what blood tastes the best?
translation: 告诉我，[玩家吸血鬼名字]，什么血味道最好？ [gao su wo ，[ wan jia xi xue gui ming zi ]， shen me xue wei dao zui hao ？]

english: Err... Human?
translation: 呃……人类？ [e …… ren lei ？]

english: You misunderstand me, I mean what kind of human?
translation: 你误会我的意思了，我是说什么样的人？ [ni wu hui wo de yi si le ， wo shi shuo shen me yang de ren ？]

english: One with a face?
translation: 有脸的一个吗？ [you lian de yi ge ma ？]

english: What? I mean, yes. But what else?
translation: 什么？我的意思是，是的。但还有什么？ [shen me ？ wo de yi si shi ， shi de 。 dan hai you shen me ？]

english: I don't know... What's the actual answer?
translation: 我不知道......真正的答案是什么？ [wo bu zhi dao ...... zhen zheng de da an shi shen me ？]

english: Love. Blood tastes best when it comes from one who loves.
translation: 爱。当血液来自有爱的人时，味道最好。 [ai 。 dang xue ye lai zi you ai de ren shi ， wei dao zui hao 。]

english: Too many around here treat their tithes with discontentment. When they do, they miss out on the full potential blood has to offer.
translation: 这里有太多人对他们的什一税感到不满。当他们这样做时，他们就错过了血液所能提供的全部潜力。 [zhe li you tai duo ren dui ta men de shen yi shui gan dao bu man 。 dang ta men zhe yang zuo shi ， ta men jiu cuo guo le xue ye suo neng ti gong de quan bu qian li 。]

english: Treat your tithes with respect instead. They will come to love you, and their blood becomes so much better as a result.
translation: 相反，要尊重你的什一税。他们会爱上你，他们的血液也会因此变得更好。 [xiang fan ， yao zun zhong ni de shen yi shui 。 ta men hui ai shang ni ， ta men de xue ye ye hui yin ci bian de geng hao 。]

english: I see. I'll keep that in mind.
translation: 我懂了。我会记住这一点。 [wo dong le 。 wo hui ji zhu zhe yi dian 。]

english: Baxtorian.
translation: 巴克斯托里安。 [ba ke si tuo li an 。]

english: [player name].
translation: [玩家姓名]。 [[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: How are things?
translation: 最近怎么样？ [zui jin zen me yang ？]

english: The city is flourishing, largely thanks to you. There's still some mistrust for the Iorwerth clan, but overall I'd say it's been over a thousand years since our people were doing this well.
translation: 这座城市的繁荣，很大程度上归功于你们。人们对 Iorwerth 氏族仍然存在一些不信任，但总的来说，我想说我们的人民已经有一千多年没有做得这么好了。 [zhe zuo cheng shi de fan rong ， hen da cheng du shang gui gong yu ni men 。 ren men dui  Iorwerth  shi zu reng ran cun zai yi xie bu xin ren ， dan zong de lai shuo ， wo xiang shuo wo men de ren min yi jing you yi qian duo nian mei you zuo de zhe me hao le 。]

english: That's great to hear. What about you though?
translation: 很高兴听到这个消息。那么你呢？ [hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi 。 na me ni ne ？]

english: I still mourn Glarial every day, until the end of time a part of me will be missing, never to be replaced.
translation: 我仍然每天都在哀悼格拉瑞尔，直到时间的尽头，我的一部分将消失，永远无法被取代。 [wo reng ran mei tian dou zai ai dao ge la rui er ， zhi dao shi jian de jin tou ， wo de yi bu fen jiang xiao shi ， yong yuan wu fa bei qu dai 。]

english: But I know now that I can't let that impact the elves here. Many of them never even knew their former queen. My grief is mine alone, they need not bear it.
translation: 但我现在知道我不能让这影响到这里的精灵。他们中的许多人甚至从来不认识他们的前女王。我的悲伤是我一个人的，他们不需要承受。 [dan wo xian zai zhi dao wo bu neng rang zhe ying xiang dao zhe li de jing ling 。 ta men zhong de xu duo ren shen zhi cong lai bu ren shi ta men de qian nv wang 。 wo de bei shang shi wo yi ge ren de ， ta men bu xu yao cheng shou 。]

english: To them, I'm trying my best to be a leader they deserve, to correct the mistakes of the past. Lord Iorwerth believed we were nothing without Seren. We need to prove that we have a future with her gone.
translation: 对于他们来说，我正在尽力成为他们应得的领导者，纠正过去的错误。约沃斯勋爵相信，如果没有塞伦，我们就什么都不是。我们需要证明她走了后我们还有未来。 [dui yu ta men lai shuo ， wo zheng zai jin li cheng wei ta men ying de de ling dao zhe ， jiu zheng guo qu de cuo wu 。 yue wo si xun jue xiang xin ， ru guo mei you sai lun ， wo men jiu shen me dou bu shi 。 wo men xu yao zheng ming ta zou le hou wo men hai you wei lai 。]

english: Thankfully I have the other elders to help this time. Ruling is not as hard when you share out the responsiblities.
translation: 幸亏这次有其他长老帮忙。当你分担责任时，统治就不那么困难了。 [xing kui zhe ci you qi ta zhang lao bang mang 。 dang ni fen dan ze ren shi ， tong zhi jiu bu na me kun nan le 。]

english: Well I'm glad to hear things are going well.
translation: 嗯，我很高兴听到事情进展顺利。 [n ， wo hen gao xing ting dao shi qing jin zhan shun li 。]

english: And we are glad to have you here with us. None of this would have been possible without you.
translation: 我们很高兴您能和我们在一起。如果没有你，这一切都是不可能的。 [wo men hen gao xing nin neng he wo men zai yi qi 。 ru guo mei you ni ， zhe yi qie dou shi bu ke neng de 。]

english: Are you alright?
translation: 你还好吗？ [ni hai hao ma ？]

english: You may speak.
translation: 你可以说话。 [ni ke yi shuo hua 。]

english: Oh, yes yes, I'm fine.
translation: 哦，是的，我很好。 [o ， shi de ， wo hen hao 。]

english: You look a little beat up.
translation: 你看上去有点疲惫不堪。 [ni kan shang qu you dian pi bei bu kan 。]

english: These scratches? Don't worry, just a disagreement with a thorn bush.
translation: 这些划痕？别担心，只是与荆棘丛的分歧而已。 [zhe xie hua hen ？ bie dan xin ， zhi shi yu jing ji cong de fen qi er yi 。]

english: Sure...
translation: 当然... [dang ran ...]

english: Is there something you wanted, bloodbag?
translation: 血袋，你有什么想要的吗？ [xue dai ， ni you shen me xiang yao de ma ？]

english: Just looking around.
translation: 只是环顾四周。 [zhi shi huan gu si zhou 。]

english: Well, I'd prefer you did it elsewhere, Crombwick is busy entertaining his guests.
translation: 好吧，我希望你在别处做，克罗姆威克正忙着招待他的客人。 [hao ba ， wo xi wang ni zai bie chu zuo ， ke luo mu wei ke zheng mang zhe zhao dai ta de ke ren 。]

english: Strange bunch of guests...
translation: 一群奇怪的客人…… [yi qun qi guai de ke ren ……]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: What want you, with the Lord of the Kinshra? Speak!
translation: 你对 Kinshra 之主有什么要求？说话！ [ni dui  Kinshra  zhi zhu you shen me yao qiu ？ shuo hua ！]

english: Erm, nothing actually.
translation: 嗯，实际上什么也没有。 [n ， shi ji shang shen me ye mei you 。]

english: Then begone knave, before I have my Knights put you to the sword!
translation: 那么滚吧，无赖，在我让我的骑士们用剑杀死你之前！ [na me gun ba ， wu lai ， zai wo rang wo de qi shi men yong jian sha si ni zhi qian ！]

english: Greetings [player name].
translation: 你好[玩家姓名]。 [ni hao [ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Hey Iestin. So they made you the new Lord Iorwerth?
translation: 嘿伊斯坦。所以他们任命你为新任洛沃斯勋爵？ [hei yi si tan 。 suo yi ta men ren ming ni wei xin ren luo wo si xun jue ？]

english: Indeed. Apart from Morvran, I am the closest living relative of the previous Lord Iorwerth.
translation: 的确。除了莫尔夫兰之外，我是前任伊奥沃斯勋爵在世的最亲近的亲属。 [di que 。 chu le mo er fu lan zhi wai ， wo shi qian ren yi ao wo si xun jue zai shi de zui qin jin de qin shu 。]

english: Did Morvran not want the role?
translation: 莫尔夫兰不想要这个角色吗？ [mo er fu lan bu xiang yao zhe ge jue se ma ？]

english: No. That's probably for the best though. Morvran was very close to my predecessor. It would have made many uncomfortable if he had taken on the role.
translation: 不，但这可能是最好的。莫尔夫兰与我的前任非常接近。如果他担任这个角色，很多人都会感到不舒服。 [bu ， dan zhe ke neng shi zui hao de 。 mo er fu lan yu wo de qian ren fei chang jie jin 。 ru guo ta dan ren zhe ge jue se ， hen duo ren du hui gan dao bu shu fu 。]

english: How have things been since the city was reformed?
translation: 城市改革以来，情况如何？ [cheng shi gai ge yi lai ， qing kuang ru he ？]

english: The others still hold a lot of mistrust for our clan. It will take a long time for those rifts to be repaired. We are on the right path though.
translation: 其他人对我们家族仍然抱有很大的不信任。这些裂痕需要很长时间才能修复。但我们走在正确的道路上。 [qi ta ren dui wo men jia zu reng ran bao you hen da de bu xin ren 。 zhe xie lie hen xu yao hen zhang shi jian cai neng xiu fu 。 dan wo men zou zai zheng que de dao lu shang 。]

english: That's good to hear. All the best.
translation: 很高兴听到这个消息。一切顺利。 [hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi 。 yi qie shun li 。]

english: Likewise.
translation: 同样地。 [tong yang di 。]

english: Good day [player name]. Have you come to hear the song of the elves?
translation: 美好的一天[玩家姓名]。你是来听精灵之歌的吗？ [mei hao de yi tian [ wan jia xing ming ]。 ni shi lai ting jing ling zhi ge de ma ？]

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你是什​​么意思？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: Do you not hear it? The sounds of a city in harmony. It is the song of the elves, the story of our people.
translation: 你没听见吗？城市的声音和谐。这是精灵的歌声，是我们人民的故事。 [ni mei ting jian ma ？ cheng shi de sheng yin he xie 。 zhe shi jing ling de ge sheng ， shi wo men ren min de gu shi 。]

english: The last few verses were dark and quiet, but now our city is restored, we find ourselves singing a new verse, one of joy and light.
translation: 最后几首诗是黑暗而安静的，但现在我们的城市已经恢复，我们发现自己在唱一首新的诗，一首欢乐和光明的诗。 [zui hou ji shou shi shi hei an er an jing de ， dan xian zai wo men de cheng shi yi jing hui fu ， wo men fa xian zi ji zai chang yi shou xin de shi ， yi shou huan le he guang ming de shi 。]

english: I see. I guess I've never been the type to reflect on that sort of thing.
translation: 我懂了。我想我从来都不是那种会反思这类事情的人。 [wo dong le 。 wo xiang wo cong lai dou bu shi na zhong hui fan si zhe lei shi qing de ren 。]

english: More of a fighter? We have a song for that too. If you wish to sing it, head to the Gauntlet and put yourself to the test.
translation: 更像一个战士？我们也为此准备了一首歌。如果您想唱这首歌，请前往挑战并接受考验。 [geng xiang yi ge zhan shi ？ wo men ye wei ci zhun bei le yi shou ge 。 ru guo nin xiang chang zhe shou ge ， qing qian wang tiao zhan bing jie shou kao yan 。]

english: I might just give it a shot. Thanks.
translation: 我可能会尝试一下。谢谢。 [wo ke neng hui chang shi yi xia 。 xie xie 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: I am Kandur Hosidius and I am the lord of Hosidius, the city of farmers and chefs. I live here with my wife, Elena, and my two sons, Artur and Pandur.
translation: 我是坎杜尔·霍西迪乌斯，我是霍西迪乌斯这座农民和厨师之城的领主。我和我的妻子埃琳娜以及我的两个儿子阿图尔和潘德住在这里。 [wo shi kan du er · huo xi di wu si ， wo shi huo xi di wu si zhe zuo nong min he chu shi zhi cheng de ling zhu 。 wo he wo de qi zi ai lin na yi ji wo de liang ge er zi a tu er he pan de zhu zai zhe li 。]

english: My family and I have a peaceful existence here. That's mainly because I care not for the politics of the other houses. I instead devote my time to more meaningful pursuits.
translation: 我和我的家人在这里过着平静的生活。这主要是因为我不关心其他议院的政治。相反，我把时间投入到更有意义的追求上。 [wo he wo de jia ren zai zhe li guo zhe ping jing de sheng huo 。 zhe zhu yao shi yin wei wo bu guan xin qi ta yi yuan de zheng zhi 。 xiang fan ， wo ba shi jian tou ru dao geng you yi yi de zhui qiu shang 。]

english: Such as?
translation: 例如？ [li ru ？]

english: Ensuring that Kourend is well fed. We may live in gentle times now but who knows how long it will be that way. Sooner or later another war or long winter will hit us. History has proven that.
translation: 确保库伦德吃饱。我们现在可能生活在温和的时代，但谁知道这种状态会持续多久。迟早另一场战争或漫长的冬天将会袭击我们。历史已经证明了这一点。 [que bao ku lun de chi bao 。 wo men xian zai ke neng sheng huo zai wen he de shi dai ， dan shui zhi dao zhe zhong zhuang tai hui chi xu duo jiu 。 chi zao ling yi chang zhan zheng huo man chang de dong tian jiang hui xi ji wo men 。 li shi yi jing zheng ming liao zhe yi dian 。]

english: Anything else I can help you with?
translation: 还有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [hai you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

english: Tell me about Hosidius.
translation: 告诉我关于霍西迪乌斯的事。 [gao su wo guan yu huo xi di wu si de shi 。]

english: Hosidius is home to the farmers and chefs of Kourend. We are the main food supplier to the kingdom and we ensure that her people are fed.
translation: 霍西迪乌斯 (Hosidius) 是库伦德 (Kourend) 农民和厨师的家园。我们是王国的主要粮食供应商，我们确保她的人民有饭吃。 [huo xi di wu si  (Hosidius)  shi ku lun de  (Kourend)  nong min he chu shi de jia yuan 。 wo men shi wang guo de zhu yao liang shi gong ying shang ， wo men que bao ta de ren min you fan chi 。]

english: We also own more land than the other Kourend houses. We need the extra space for all of our crops.
translation: 我们还比其他库伦德家族拥有更多的土地。我们需要额外的空间来种植所有农作物。 [wo men hai bi qi ta ku lun de jia zu yong you geng duo de tu di 。 wo men xu yao e wai de kong jian lai zhong zhi suo you nong zuo wu 。]

english: Do the other houses not get annoyed at how much land you have?
translation: 难道其他家族不会因为你有这么多土地而生气吗？ [nan dao qi ta jia zu bu hui yin wei ni you zhe me duo tu di er sheng qi ma ？]

english: Sometimes. They know it is necessary though. There was once a time when the land was shared equally. But then the great famine came, and Kourend did not have the food to last through it.
translation: 有时。但他们知道这是必要的。曾经有一段时间，土地是平均分配的。但后来大饥荒来了，库伦德没有足够的食物来度过。 [you shi 。 dan ta men zhi dao zhe shi bi yao de 。 ceng jing you yi duan shi jian ， tu di shi ping jun fen pei de 。 dan hou lai da ji huang lai le ， ku lun de mei you zu gou de shi wu lai du guo 。]

english: After that, more space was given to Hosidius. We've had the most land ever since.
translation: 之后，更多的空间被给予了霍西迪乌斯。从那时起我们就拥有了最多的土地。 [zhi hou ， geng duo de kong jian bei ji yu le huo xi di wu si 。 cong na shi qi wo men jiu yong you le zui duo de tu di 。]

english: Tell me about your plans.
translation: 告诉我你的计划。 [gao su wo ni de ji hua 。]

english: Plans? My only plan is to keep providing food to this kingdom.
translation: 计划？我唯一的计划就是继续为这个王国提供食物。 [ji hua ？ wo wei yi de ji hua jiu shi ji xu wei zhe ge wang guo ti gong shi wu 。]

english: But what of the Royal Accord of Twill? You must have kept it for a reason.
translation: 但斜纹皇家协议又如何呢？你保留它一定是有原因的。 [dan xie wen huang jia xie yi you ru he ne ？ ni bao liu ta yi ding shi you yuan yin de 。]

english: I did. The Accord has the potential to be a powerful weapon, for words cut deeper than a blade ever can. However, I have no need to use this weapon, not unless the other houses give me reason to.
translation: 我做到了。协议有可能成为一种强大的武器，因为言语比刀片更能切人。然而，我没有必要使用这个武器，除非其他学院给我理由。 [wo zuo dao le 。 xie yi you ke neng cheng wei yi zhong qiang da de wu qi ， yin wei yan yu bi dao pian geng neng qie ren 。 ran er ， wo mei you bi yao shi yong zhe ge wu qi ， chu fei qi ta xue yuan gei wo li you 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Until next time.
translation: 直到下次。 [zhi dao xia ci 。]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: Tell me about Hosidius.
translation: 告诉我关于霍西迪乌斯的事。 [gao su wo guan yu huo xi di wu si de shi 。]

english: Tell me about your plans.
translation: 告诉我你的计划。 [gao su wo ni de ji hua 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Good day!
translation: 再会！ [zai hui ！]

english: Isn't it just!
translation: 不就是吗！ [bu jiu shi ma ！]

english: What brings you down here?
translation: 是什么让你来到这里？ [shi shen me rang ni lai dao zhe li ？]

english: This and that... But mostly, I'm looking for a good place to mobilise my army.
translation: 这个那个……但最重要的是，我正在寻找一个好地方来动员我的军队。 [zhe ge na ge …… dan zui zhong yao de shi ， wo zheng zai xun zhao yi ge hao di fang lai dong yuan wo de jun dui 。]

english: That's awfully specific, you sure this is a good place for it?
translation: 这是非常具体的，你确定这是一个好地方吗？ [zhe shi fei chang ju ti de ， ni que ding zhe shi yi ge hao di fang ma ？]

english: I don't see why not!
translation: 我不明白为什么不！ [wo bu ming bai wei shen me bu ！]

english: I'm not sure there's enough land, to be honest.
translation: 老实说，我不确定是否有足够的土地。 [lao shi shuo ， wo bu que ding shi fou you zu gou de tu di 。]

english: Tish tosh! I'm importing sand from Al Kharid, there'll be a base camp here in no time, do not fret!
translation: 哎呀哎呀！我正在从阿尔卡里德进口沙子，很快这里就会有一个大本营，别担心！ [ai ya ai ya ！ wo zheng zai cong a er ka li de jin kou sha zi ， hen kuai zhe li jiu hui you yi ge da ben ying ， bie dan xin ！]

english: Oh. Okay then.
translation: 哦。那么好吧。 [o 。 na me hao ba 。]

english: The tithes are growing weak. That werewolf needs to do a better job of keeping them fed.
translation: 什一税越来越弱。那个狼人需要更好地让他们吃饱。 [shen yi shui yue lai yue ruo 。 na ge lang ren xu yao geng hao di rang ta men chi bao 。]

english: What do you feed them?
translation: 你给他们吃什么？ [ni gei ta men chi shen me ？]

english: There's no shortage of corpses around here. The dead can still have some uses.
translation: 这里不乏尸体。死人还是有一些用处的。 [zhe li bu fa shi ti 。 si ren hai shi you yi xie yong chu de 。]

english: You're feeding them corpses? No wonder they're becoming weak. That meat must have all sorts of problems.
translation: 你给他们喂尸体？难怪他们会变得虚弱。那块肉肯定有各种各样的问题。 [ni gei ta men wei shi ti ？ nan guai ta men hui bian de xu ruo 。 na kuai rou ken ding you ge zhong ge yang de wen ti 。]

english: What else would you have me feed them? If I give them nicer food, I'm wasting more money than if I were to just kill them and buy some more.
translation: 你还要我给他们吃什么？如果我给他们更好的食物，我会比杀掉他们再买更多的钱浪费更多的钱。 [ni hai yao wo gei ta men chi shen me ？ ru guo wo gei ta men geng hao de shi wu ， wo hui bi sha diao ta men zai mai geng duo de qian lang fei geng duo de qian 。]

english: I... I suppose.
translation: 我……我想。 [wo …… wo xiang 。]

english: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 人类！在我叫守卫之前回到奴隶围栏！ [ren lei ！ zai wo jiao shou wei zhi qian hui dao nu li wei lan ！]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello there young one. Interested in getting your hands dirty?
translation: 你好，年轻人。有兴趣亲自动手吗？ [ni hao ， nian qing ren 。 you xing qu qin zi dong shou ma ？]

english: Err... maybe?
translation: 呃……也许？ [e …… ye xu ？]

english: Ah don't worry, it's nothing sinister. We leave that kind of thing to clan Iorwerth. I speak in a more literal sense, of the ground beneath us and the trees over us.
translation: 啊，别担心，这没什么危险的。我们把这种事情留给 Iorwerth 氏族。我从更字面的意义上讲，是指我们脚下的地面和我们上方的树木。 [a ， bie dan xin ， zhe mei shen me wei xian de 。 wo men ba zhe zhong shi qing liu gei  Iorwerth  shi zu 。 wo cong geng zi mian de yi yi shang jiang ， shi zhi wo men jiao xia de di mian he wo men shang fang de shu mu 。]

english: Oh, I see. So it's your clan that looks after the plants of the city?
translation: 我懂了。那么是你的家族负责照顾城市里的植物吗？ [wo dong le 。 na me shi ni de jia zu fu ze zhao gu cheng shi li de zhi wu ma ？]

english: Indeed. We maintain the farms and manage the trees. The produce we grow goes to the Meilyr clan to feed the city and the wood we provide is used by the Ithell clan in construction.
translation: 的确。我们维护农场并管理树木。我们种植的农产品被送往 Meil​​yr 部落来养活城市，而我们提供的木材则被 Ithell 部落用于建筑。 [di que 。 wo men wei hu nong chang bing guan li shu mu 。 wo men zhong zhi de nong chan pin bei song wang  Meil​​yr  bu luo lai yang huo cheng shi ， er wo men ti gong de mu cai ze bei  Ithell  bu luo yong yu jian zhu 。]

english: Feel free to join us. Our farming patches are open to you, as is our sawmill.
translation: 欢迎加入我们。我们的农田和锯木厂都向您开放。 [huan ying jia ru wo men 。 wo men de nong tian he ju mu chang dou xiang nin kai fang 。]

english: Awesome, thank you.
translation: 太棒了，谢谢。 [tai bang le ， xie xie 。]

english: How goes it, friend?
translation: 怎么样，朋友？ [zen me yang ， peng you ？]

english: I stole the Ring of Charos from Fenkenstrain.
translation: 我从 Fenkenstrain 那里偷了 Charos 之戒。 [wo cong  Fenkenstrain  na li tou le  Charos  zhi jie 。]

english: I saw him climb up into the Tower to hide it. It doesn't matter - soon the werewolves will come for him, and his experiments will be forever ceased.
translation: 我看到他爬进塔里隐藏它。没关系——很快狼人就会来抓他，他的实验将永远停止。 [wo kan dao ta pa jin ta li yin cang ta 。 mei guan xi —— hen kuai lang ren jiu hui lai zhua ta ， ta de shi yan jiang yong yuan ting zhi 。]

english: Do you want the ring back? It is yours after all.
translation: 你想要回戒指吗？毕竟它是你的。 [ni xiang yao hui jie zhi ma ？ bi jing ta shi ni de 。]

english: No, you keep it, my friend. Werewolves hunger for the scent of live flesh - I have no need for the ring. I have my castle back, if not my soul.
translation: 不，你留着它，我的朋友。狼人渴望活肉的气味——我不需要戒指。我已经拿回了我的城堡，即使不是我的灵魂。 [bu ， ni liu zhe ta ， wo de peng you 。 lang ren ke wang huo rou de qi wei —— wo bu xu yao jie zhi 。 wo yi jing na hui le wo de cheng bao ， ji shi bu shi wo de ling hun 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: Well citizen, you are speaking to Lord Shiro Shayzien. I am the ruler of Shayzien and the commander-in-chief of the Shayzien Army.
translation: 好吧，公民，你正在和 Shiro Shayzien 勋爵说话。我是沙伊恩的统治者，也是沙伊恩军队的总司令。 [hao ba ， gong min ， ni zheng zai he  Shiro Shayzien  xun jue shuo hua 。 wo shi sha yi en de tong zhi zhe ， ye shi sha yi en jun dui de zong si ling 。]

english: How long have you held this position?
translation: 您担任这个职位多久了？ [nin dan ren zhe ge zhi wei duo jiu le ？]

english: Since my father passed away four years ago. He was a good man who took the defence of Kourend very seriously. I have been working hard to continue his legacy.
translation: 自从我父亲四年前去世以来。他是一个非常重视库伦德防守的好人。我一直在努力延续他的遗产。 [zi cong wo fu qin si nian qian qu shi yi lai 。 ta shi yi ge fei chang zhong shi ku lun de fang shou de hao ren 。 wo yi zhi zai nu li yan xu ta de yi chan 。]

english: Anything else I can help you with citizen?
translation: 关于公民，我还能为您提供什么帮助吗？ [guan yu gong min ， wo hai neng wei nin ti gong shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: Tell me about Shayzien.
translation: 告诉我关于沙伊恩的事。 [gao su wo guan yu sha yi en de shi 。]

english: Most citizens of Shayzien are part of the Shayzien Army in some form or other. We are responsible for defending Kourend against external and internal threats.
translation: 大多数 Shayzien 公民都以某种形式加入 Shayzien 军队。我们有责任保护 Kourend 免受外部和内部威胁。 [da duo shu  Shayzien  gong min dou yi mou zhong xing shi jia ru  Shayzien  jun dui 。 wo men you ze ren bao hu  Kourend  mian shou wai bu he nei bu wei xie 。]

english: What are the current threats against Kourend?
translation: 目前针对 Kourend 的威胁有哪些？ [mu qian zhen dui  Kourend  de wei xie you na xie ？]

english: Externally, we have recently beingdealing with increased lizardman activity. We've also been keeping a close eye on Varlamore to the south, just in case they try anything.
translation: 从外部来看，我们最近正在应对蜥蜴人活动增加的问题。我们还一直密切关注南部的瓦拉莫尔，以防他们尝试任何行动。 [cong wai bu lai kan ， wo men zui jin zheng zai ying dui xi yi ren huo dong zeng jia de wen ti 。 wo men hai yi zhi mi qie guan zhu nan bu de wa la mo er ， yi fang ta men chang shi ren he xing dong 。]

english: Internally, we have seen a rise in gang crime across the kingdom. It seems to be especially prevalent in Port Piscarilius.
translation: 在国内，我们看到整个王国的帮派犯罪有所增加。它似乎在皮斯卡利留斯港尤其盛行。 [zai guo nei ， wo men kan dao zheng ge wang guo de bang pai fan zui you suo zeng jia 。 ta si hu zai pi si ka li liu si gang you qi sheng xing 。]

english: How do you tackle these issues?
translation: 您如何解决这些问题？ [nin ru he jie jue zhe xie wen ti ？]

english: By doing what we do best citizen. There's no threat that can't be defeated by a Shayzien soldier with a sword in their hand.
translation: 通过做我们所做的最好的公民。没有任何威胁是手持剑的沙吉恩士兵无法击败的。 [tong guo zuo wo men suo zuo de zui hao de gong min 。 mei you ren he wei xie shi shou chi jian de sha ji en shi bing wu fa ji bai de 。]

english: Tell me about your plans.
translation: 告诉我你的计划。 [gao su wo ni de ji hua 。]

english: Our war plans? I'm afraid most of that is confidential.
translation: 我们的战争计划？恐怕大部分内容都是保密的。 [wo men de zhan zheng ji hua ？ kong pa da bu fen nei rong dou shi bao mi de 。]

english: What I can tell you is that our main focus right now is the lizardman threat. We've moved a great number of troops into the Kebos Lowlands to combat the issue.
translation: 我可以告诉你的是，我们现在的主要焦点是蜥蜴人的威胁。我们已向科博斯低地派遣了大量部队来解决这个问题。 [wo ke yi gao su ni de shi ， wo men xian zai de zhu yao jiao dian shi xi yi ren de wei xie 。 wo men yi xiang ke bo si di di pai qian le da liang bu dui lai jie jue zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Is that going well?
translation: 进展顺利吗？ [jin zhan shun li ma ？]

english: Absolutely, we've pushed the lizardmen back to the point where we're finally able to allow citizens such as yourself into the region.
translation: 当然，我们已经把蜥蜴人赶回到了我们最终能够允许像你这样的公民进入该地区的地步。 [dang ran ， wo men yi jing ba xi yi ren gan hui dao le wo men zui zhong neng gou yun xu xiang ni zhe yang de gong min jin ru gai di qu de di bu 。]

english: Apart from the lizardman, we are also preparing to support the King in the hunt for his father's killer. Once we know who they are, they will face the full might of the Shayzien Army.
translation: 除了蜥蜴人之外，我们还准备支持国王追捕杀害他父亲的凶手。一旦我们知道他们是谁，他们将面对 Shayzien 军队的全部力量。 [chu le xi yi ren zhi wai ， wo men hai zhun bei zhi chi guo wang zhui bu sha hai ta fu qin de xiong shou 。 yi dan wo men zhi dao ta men shi shui ， ta men jiang mian dui  Shayzien  jun dui de quan bu li liang 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Farewell citizen.
translation: 再见公民。 [zai jian gong min 。]

english: Can't talk right now citizen. I'm very busy.
translation: 现在不能说话公民。我很忙。 [xian zai bu neng shuo hua gong min 。 wo hen mang 。]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: Tell me about Shayzien.
translation: 告诉我关于沙伊恩的事。 [gao su wo guan yu sha yi en de shi 。]

english: Tell me about your plans.
translation: 告诉我你的计划。 [gao su wo ni de ji hua 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Good day friend.
translation: 美好的一天朋友。 [mei hao de yi tian peng you 。]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: I am Trobin Arceuus, lord of Arceuus. It's a position I've held for a thousand years, ever since the Ascent of Arceuus.
translation: 我是特罗宾·阿尔修斯，阿尔修斯的领主。自从阿尔宙斯登临以来，我已经坚持这个立场一千年了。 [wo shi te luo bin · a er xiu si ， a er xiu si de ling zhu 。 zi cong a er zhou si deng lin yi lai ， wo yi jing jian chi zhe ge li chang yi qian nian le 。]

english: That's a long time. I guess you've seen quite a bit.
translation: 那是很长一段时间了。我想你已经见过不少了。 [na shi hen zhang yi duan shi jian le 。 wo xiang ni yi jing jian guo bu shao le 。]

english: Indeed. I've been present at some of the most notable moments in Kourend's history.
translation: 的确。我见证了库伦德历史上一些最重要的时刻。 [di que 。 wo jian zheng le ku lun de li shi shang yi xie zui zhong yao de shi ke 。]

english: I was there when King Agata IV was deposed, I was there when Kharedst the Builder opened Kourend Castle and I was there when Emperor Imafore was executed.
translation: 阿加塔四世国王被废黜时我在场，建造者卡雷斯特开放库伦德城堡时我在场，伊玛福皇帝被处决时我也在场。 [a jia ta si shi guo wang bei fei chu shi wo zai chang ， jian zao zhe ka lei si te kai fang ku lun de cheng bao shi wo zai chang ， yi ma fu huang di bei chu jue shi wo ye zai chang 。]

english: I tend to keep out of public affairs these days though. My presence is often more of a distraction than a benefit. It also means I can focus on my work in peace.
translation: 不过，这些天我倾向于回避公共事务。我的存在往往更多的是分散注意力而不是带来好处。这也意味着我可以安心地专注于我的工作。 [bu guo ， zhe xie tian wo qing xiang yu hui bi gong gong shi wu 。 wo de cun zai wang wang geng duo de shi fen san zhu yi li er bu shi dai lai hao chu 。 zhe ye yi wei zhe wo ke yi an xin di zhuan zhu yu wo de gong zuo 。]

english: Your work?
translation: 你的工作？ [ni de gong zuo ？]

english: The freeing of souls. There are many souls that find themselves trapped here after death. My people and I do our best to release them.
translation: 灵魂的解放。有许多灵魂在死后发现自己被困在这里。我和我的人民尽最大努力释放他们。 [ling hun de jie fang 。 you xu duo ling hun zai si hou fa xian zi ji bei kun zai zhe li 。 wo he wo de ren min jin zui da nu li shi fang ta men 。]

english: Tell me about Arceuus.
translation: 告诉我关于阿尔宙斯的事。 [gao su wo guan yu a er zhou si de shi 。]

english: If you find something magical in Kourend, chances are it came from Arceuus. Our people have lived for a thousand years. The knowledge we've gained in that time has resulted in many a magical discovery.
translation: 如果你在 Kourend 中发现了一些神奇的东西，那么它很可能来自 Arceuus。我们的人民已经活了一千年了。我们在那段时间获得的知识带来了许多神奇的发现。 [ru guo ni zai  Kourend  zhong fa xian le yi xie shen qi de dong xi ， na me ta hen ke neng lai zi  Arceuus。 wo men de ren min yi jing huo le yi qian nian le 。 wo men zai na duan shi jian huo de de zhi shi dai lai le xu duo shen qi de fa xian 。]

english: Most of our discoveries start with the Dark Altar. It is the source of our immortality and our people dedicate their lives to studying it.
translation: 我们的大部分发现都是从黑暗祭坛开始的。它是我们不朽的源泉，我们的人民毕生致力于研究它。 [wo men de da bu fen fa xian dou shi cong hei an ji tan kai shi de 。 ta shi wo men bu xiu de yuan quan ， wo men de ren min bi sheng zhi li yu yan jiu ta 。]

english: Our people also serves an important role in the wider world. We work to free trapped souls so that they may pass on to the next world. It is a crucial task that the Dark Altar helps us to perform.
translation: 我们的人民还在更广阔的世界中发挥着重要作用。我们致力于释放被困的灵魂，以便他们可以前往下一个世界。这是黑暗祭坛帮助我们完成的一项至关重要的任务。 [wo men de ren min hai zai geng guang kuo de shi jie zhong fa hui zhuo zhong yao zuo yong 。 wo men zhi li yu shi fang bei kun de ling hun ， yi bian ta men ke yi qian wang xia yi ge shi jie 。 zhe shi hei an ji tan bang zhu wo men wan cheng de yi xiang zhi guan zhong yao de ren wu 。]

english: Was the Dark Altar always here?
translation: 黑暗祭坛一直都在这里吗？ [hei an ji tan yi zhi dou zai zhe li ma ？]

english: Impossible to say. The Dark Altar has been mentioned in records dating back to the earliest days of Kourend. Before then, who knows.
translation: 不可能说。黑暗祭坛在库伦德早期的记录中就已被提及。在那之前，谁知道呢。 [bu ke neng shuo 。 hei an ji tan zai ku lun de zao qi de ji lu zhong jiu yi bei ti ji 。 zai na zhi qian ， shui zhi dao ne 。]

english: You weren't around back then?
translation: 那时你不在吗？ [na shi ni bu zai ma ？]

english: No. The Ascent of Arceuus didn't occur until after Xeric's Age of Strife, hundreds of years after Kourend was formed.
translation: 不。阿尔宙斯的崛起直到 Xeric 的冲突时代之后才发生，也就是 Kourend 形成数百年后。 [bu 。 a er zhou si de jue qi zhi dao  Xeric  de chong tu shi dai zhi hou cai fa sheng ， ye jiu shi  Kourend  xing cheng shu bai nian hou 。]

english: Tell me about the Ascent of Arceuus.
translation: 告诉我有关阿尔宙斯上升的事。 [gao su wo you guan a er zhou si shang sheng de shi 。]

english: It was a thousand years ago, during the time of King Byrne II. I went to my people and shared the secrets of immortality with them.
translation: 那是一千年前，伯恩二世国王在位的时候。我去找我的人民，与他们分享永生的秘密。 [na shi yi qian nian qian ， bo en er shi guo wang zai wei de shi hou 。 wo qu zhao wo de ren min ， yu ta men fen xiang yong sheng de mi mi 。]

english: Not all of them accepted this gift of course, as was their right. Those that did, were granted new bodies to house their souls. These bodies are sustained by the Dark Altar.
translation: 当然，并不是所有人都接受了这份礼物，这是他们的权利。那些这样做的人，被授予了新的身体来容纳他们的灵魂。这些尸体是由黑暗祭坛支撑的。 [dang ran ， bing bu shi suo you ren dou jie shou le zhe fen li wu ， zhe shi ta men de quan li 。 na xie zhe yang zuo de ren ， bei shou yu le xin de shen ti lai rong na ta men de ling hun 。 zhe xie shi ti shi you hei an ji tan zhi cheng de 。]

english: It wasn't you that discovered this secret though was it?
translation: 这个秘密不是你发现的吗？ [zhe ge mi mi bu shi ni fa xian de ma ？]

english: No. It was granted to us by the Tasakaal. They are ancient beings, ones that make us seem like mere children.
translation: 不。这是塔萨卡尔授予我们的。他们是古老的生物，让我们看起来就像小孩子一样。 [bu 。 zhe shi ta sa ka er shou yu wo men de 。 ta men shi gu lao de sheng wu ， rang wo men kan qi lai jiu xiang xiao hai zi yi yang 。]

english: Their age and experience have granted them knowledge over life and death that we can only dream of.
translation: 他们的年龄和经验赋予了他们关于生与死的知识，这是我们只能梦想的。 [ta men de nian ling he jing yan fu yu le ta men guan yu sheng yu si de zhi shi ， zhe shi wo men zhi neng meng xiang de 。]

english: The Tasakaal don't like you very much. They called you a liar and claimed you misused the knowledge.
translation: 塔萨卡尔人不太喜欢你。他们称你为骗子，并声称你滥用了知识。 [ta sa ka er ren bu tai xi huan ni 。 ta men cheng ni wei pian zi ， bing sheng cheng ni lan yong le zhi shi 。]

english: The events that led to the Ascent of Arceuus are more complicated than even the Tasakaal know. But that is a story for another day.
translation: 导致阿尔宙斯上升的事件比塔萨卡尔人所知的还要复杂。但这是另一回事了。 [dao zhi a er zhou si shang sheng de shi jian bi ta sa ka er ren suo zhi de hai yao fu za 。 dan zhe shi ling yi hui shi le 。]

english: Tell me about your plans.
translation: 告诉我你的计划。 [gao su wo ni de ji hua 。]

english: I had one of my people recover the remains of that device. The one that was absorbing the Dark Altars power.
translation: 我让我的一个人找回了那个装置的残骸。吸收黑暗祭坛力量的那一个。 [wo rang wo de yi ge ren zhao hui le na ge zhuang zhi de can hai 。 xi shou hei an ji tan li liang de na yi ge 。]

english: We're performing tests to see if we can learn more about it. We haven't made any meaningful progress yet though.
translation: 我们正在进行测试，看看是否可以了解更多信息。但我们还没有取得任何有意义的进展。 [wo men zheng zai jin xing ce shi ， kan kan shi fou ke yi liao jie geng duo xin xi 。 dan wo men hai mei you qu de ren he you yi yi de jin zhan 。]

english: Once we've learnt more about it, we'll be in a better position to determine our next move.
translation: 一旦我们了解了更多信息，我们就能更好地确定下一步行动。 [yi dan wo men liao jie le geng duo xin xi ， wo men jiu neng geng hao di que ding xia yi bu xing dong 。]

english: I admit, the idea of someone sabotaging the Altar is more than a bit concerning. I hope we can make some progress soon.
translation: 我承认，有人破坏祭坛的想法确实令人担忧。 I hope we can make some progress soon. [wo cheng ren ， you ren po huai ji tan de xiang fa que shi ling ren dan you 。 I hope we can make some progress soon.]

english: Now that we know Xamphur was responsible for the device that was absorbing power from the Dark Altar, we're hoping we can use it to help locate him.
translation: 现在我们知道 Xamphur 负责从黑暗祭坛吸收能量的装置，我们希望我们可以用它来帮助找到他。 [xian zai wo men zhi dao  Xamphur  fu ze cong hei an ji tan xi shou neng liang de zhuang zhi ， wo men xi wang wo men ke yi yong ta lai bang zhu zhao dao ta 。]

english: Alas, so far we've had no luck. We're also scanning for energy that matches what we observed during that earthquake he caused, but again, nothing has been discovered so far.
translation: 唉，到目前为止我们还没有运气。我们还在扫描与我们在他引起的地震中观察到的能量相匹配的能量，但到目前为止，还没有发现任何东西。 [ai ， dao mu qian wei zhi wo men hai mei you yun qi 。 wo men hai zai sao miao yu wo men zai ta yin qi de di zhen zhong guan cha dao de neng liang xiang pi pei de neng liang ， dan dao mu qian wei zhi ， hai mei you fa xian ren he dong xi 。]

english: It seems this work will take time. I assure you though, we will find him and his master.
translation: 看来这项工作需要时间。不过我向你保证，我们会找到他和他的主人。 [kan lai zhe xiang gong zuo xu yao shi jian 。 bu guo wo xiang ni bao zheng ， wo men hui zhao dao ta he ta de zhu ren 。]

english: What about that Pyromancer?
translation: 那个火法师呢？ [na ge huo fa shi ne ？]

english: We've begun an investigation into their order, but we have little to go on. Hopefully we find a good lead soon.
translation: 我们已经开始对他们的订单进行调查，但没有什么进展。希望我们很快就能找到好的线索。 [wo men yi jing kai shi dui ta men de ding dan jin xing diao cha ， dan mei you shen me jin zhan 。 xi wang wo men hen kuai jiu neng zhao dao hao de xian suo 。]

english: Well just let me know if you need my help.
translation: 如果您需要我的帮助，请告诉我。 [ru guo nin xu yao wo de bang zhu ， qing gao su wo 。]

english: I will, thank you.
translation: 我会的，谢谢。 [wo hui de ， xie xie 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Farewell.
translation: 告别。 [gao bie 。]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: Tell me about Arceuus.
translation: 告诉我关于阿尔宙斯的事。 [gao su wo guan yu a er zhou si de shi 。]

english: Tell me about the Ascent of Arceuus.
translation: 告诉我有关阿尔宙斯上升的事。 [gao su wo you guan a er zhou si shang sheng de shi 。]

english: Tell me about your plans.
translation: 告诉我你的计划。 [gao su wo ni de ji hua 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Hello! I'm Lorelai. Welcome to the Warriors' Guild basement!
translation: 你好！我是罗蕾莱。欢迎来到勇士公会地下室！ [ni hao ！ wo shi luo lei lai 。 huan ying lai dao yong shi gong hui di xia shi ！]

english: What are you doing down here?
translation: 你在下面做什么？ [ni zai xia mian zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm training this group of special Cyclopes to be stronger and more powerful for Kamfreena.
translation: 我正在训练这群特殊的独眼巨人，让他们变得更强大，为卡姆弗利娜服务。 [wo zheng zai xun lian zhe qun te shu de du yan ju ren ， rang ta men bian de geng qiang da ， wei ka mu fu li na fu wu 。]

english: What's special about these Cyclopes?
translation: 这些独眼巨人有什么特别之处？ [zhe xie du yan ju ren you shen me te bie zhi chu ？]
