english: They have a chance of dropping a new, more powerful defender. Kamfreena doesn't want just anyone getting their hands on one so she moved them down here and tasked me with training them.
translation: 他们有机会放弃一名新的、更强大的后卫。卡姆弗里娜不想让任何人都接触到它，所以她把它们搬到了这里，并指派我训练它们。 [ta men you ji hui fang qi yi ming xin de 、 geng qiang da de hou wei 。 ka mu fu li na bu xiang rang ren he ren dou jie chu dao ta ， suo yi ta ba ta men ban dao le zhe li ， bing zhi pai wo xun lian ta men 。]

english: With a punishing routine of combat, fighting and the odd death!
translation: 充满惩罚性的战斗、战斗和奇怪的死亡！ [chong man cheng fa xing de zhan dou 、 zhan dou he qi guai de si wang ！]

english: So, you just let them fight each other and hope they get stronger?
translation: 所以，你就让他们互相争斗，希望他们变得更强？ [suo yi ， ni jiu rang ta men hu xiang zheng dou ， xi wang ta men bian de geng qiang ？]

english: Of course not, that would just be cruel! Kamfreena and I only allow the most worthy of adventurers to fight these cyclopes.
translation: 当然不是，那样就太残忍了！卡姆弗利娜和我只允许最值得的冒险家去对抗这些独眼巨人。 [dang ran bu shi ， na yang jiu tai can ren le ！ ka mu fu li na he wo zhi yun xu zui zhi de de mao xian jia qu dui kang zhe xie du yan ju ren 。]

english: I am a mighty adventurer! Can I fight them?
translation: 我是一个强大的冒险家！我可以和他们战斗吗？ [wo shi yi ge qiang da de mao xian jia ！ wo ke yi he ta men zhan dou ma ？]

english: You'll need to display your skills as a Warrior before I can allow you to enter the room.
translation: 在我允许你进入房间之前，你需要展示你作为战士的技能。 [zai wo yun xu ni jin ru fang jian zhi qian ， ni xu yao zhan shi ni zuo wei zhan shi de ji neng 。]

english: How can I do that?
translation: 我怎样才能做到这一点？ [wo zen yang cai neng zuo dao zhe yi dian ？]

english: Bring me a Rune Defender and I shall unlock the door for you, this shows me you have dedicated enough time to fighting the Cyclops upstairs.
translation: 给我一个符文防御者，我会为你开门，这表明你有足够的时间来对抗楼上的独眼巨人。 [gei wo yi ge fu wen fang yu zhe ， wo hui wei ni kai men ， zhe biao ming ni you zu gou de shi jian lai dui kang lou shang de du yan ju ren 。]

english: I have a Rune Defender here, please let me in!
translation: 我这里有符文防御者，请让我进去！ [wo zhe li you fu wen fang yu zhe ， qing rang wo jin qu ！]

english: And the Wise Old Man is my Dad... come back when you have the Rune Defender!
translation: 智者老人就是我爸爸……当你拥有符文防御者时就回来吧！ [zhi zhe lao ren jiu shi wo ba ba …… dang ni yong you fu wen fang yu zhe shi jiu hui lai ba ！]

english: Very well, I've unlocked the door but you'll still need 100 tokens from upstairs before you can enter as well as 10 for every minute you want to stay inside. Have fun in there!
translation: 很好，我已经把门锁打开了，但是你仍然需要楼上的 100 个代币才能进入，并且每想在里面待一分钟就需要 10 个代币。在那里玩得开心！ [hen hao ， wo yi jing ba men suo da kai le ， dan shi ni reng ran xu yao lou shang de  100  ge dai bi cai neng jin ru ， bing qie mei xiang zai li mian dai yi fen zhong jiu xu yao  10  ge dai bi 。 zai na li wan de kai xin ！]

english: Yes, you have already proved yourself to me, the door is unlocked.
translation: 是的，你已经向我证明了自己，门没锁。 [shi de ， ni yi jing xiang wo zheng ming liao zi ji ， men mei suo 。]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: See you around.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: I see you have a worthy defender! I'll release some cyclops to help you get an upgrade. They are quite mean and strong though...
translation: 我看到你有一个值得尊敬的后卫！我会释放一些独眼巨人来帮助你升级。虽然他们很卑鄙而且很坚强...... [wo kan dao ni you yi ge zhi de zun jing de hou wei ！ wo hui shi fang yi xie du yan ju ren lai bang zhu ni sheng ji 。 sui ran ta men hen bei bi er qie hen jian qiang ......]

english: You've already proved yourself to me, the door is unlocked.
translation: 你已经向我证明了自己，门没锁。 [ni yi jing xiang wo zheng ming liao zi ji ， men mei suo 。]

english: Congratulations you've found a Dragon defender! You're welcome to go back inside and try to get more.
translation: 恭喜您找到了龙卫士！欢迎您回到里面并尝试获得更多。 [gong xi nin zhao dao le long wei shi ！ huan ying nin hui dao li mian bing chang shi huo de geng duo 。]

english: Your time is up, please make your way to the exit.
translation: 时间到了，请前往出口。 [shi jian dao le ， qing qian wang chu kou 。]

english: Next time, please leave as soon as your time is up.
translation: 下次，请一到时间就离开。 [xia ci ， qing yi dao shi jian jiu li kai 。]

english: You must keep your attack skillcape or max cape equipped to stay in the area.
translation: 您必须装备好攻击技能斗篷或最大斗篷才能留在该区域。 [nin bi xu zhuang bei hao gong ji ji neng dou peng huo zui da dou peng cai neng liu zai gai qu yu 。]

english: May I claim my tokens please?
translation: 我可以领取我的代币吗？ [wo ke yi ling qu wo de dai bi ma ？]

english: You don't have space to carry them.
translation: 你没有空间来携带它们。 [ni mei you kong jian lai xie dai ta men 。]

english: Of course! Here you go, you've earned [number] token[s]!
translation: 当然！在这里，您已经赢得了 [number] 个代币！ [dang ran ！ zai zhe li ， nin yi jing ying de le  [number]  ge dai bi ！]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: I'm afraid you have not earned any tokens yet. Try some of the activities around the guild to earn some.
translation: 恐怕您还没有获得任何代币。尝试公会周围的一些活动来赚取一些钱。 [kong pa nin hai mei you huo de ren he dai bi 。 chang shi gong hui zhou wei de yi xie huo dong lai zhuan qu yi xie qian 。]

english: Ok, I'll go see what I can find.
translation: 好吧，我去看看我能找到什么。 [hao ba ， wo qu kan kan wo neng zhao dao shen me 。]

english: Ahh I see you've met Rory. As a young Cyclops he's not ready for combat yet so he keeps me company.
translation: 啊，我看到你见过罗里。作为一个年轻的独眼巨人，他还没有准备好战斗，所以他一直陪伴着我。 [a ， wo kan dao ni jian guo luo li 。 zuo wei yi ge nian qing de du yan ju ren ， ta hai mei you zhun bei hao zhan dou ， suo yi ta yi zhi pei ban zhe wo 。]

english: What's special about these Cyclopes?
translation: 这些独眼巨人有什么特别之处？ [zhe xie du yan ju ren you shen me te bie zhi chu ？]

english: How exactly are you training them?
translation: 你到底是如何训练他们的？ [ni dao di shi ru he xun lian ta men de ？]

english: Can I fight them?
translation: 我可以和他们战斗吗？ [wo ke yi he ta men zhan dou ma ？]

english: I have a Rune Defender here.
translation: 我这里有一个符文防御者。 [wo zhe li you yi ge fu wen fang yu zhe 。]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: I can't believe we've finally arrived, I can't wait to explore!
translation: 我不敢相信我们终于到达了，我迫不及待地想探索！ [wo bu gan xiang xin wo men zhong yu dao da le ， wo po bu ji dai di xiang tan suo ！]

english: So much to see, I don't know where to start!
translation: 太多东西要看，我不知道从哪里开始！ [tai duo dong xi yao kan ， wo bu zhi dao cong na li kai shi ！]

english: A whole new continent to explore... what a time to be
translation: 等待探索的全新大陆……美好时光 [deng dai tan suo de quan xin da lu …… mei hao shi guang]

english: Are you the tour guide?
translation: 你是导游吗？ [ni shi dao you ma ？]

english: Nope, I'm just as lost as you.
translation: 不，我和你一样迷失。 [bu ， wo he ni yi yang mi shi 。]

english: I overheard someone mention there are pirates and thieves here, be careful!
translation: 我无意中听到有人说这里有海盗和小偷，要小心！ [wo wu yi zhong ting dao you ren shuo zhe li you hai dao he xiao tou ， yao xiao xin ！]

english: Hey, wanna buy some armour?
translation: 嘿，想买一些盔甲吗？ [hei ， xiang mai yi xie kui jia ma ？]

english: What have you got?
translation: 你有什么？ [ni you shen me ？]

english: I provide items to help you keep your legs!
translation: 我提供物品来帮助您保持双腿！ [wo ti gong wu pin lai bang zhu nin bao chi shuang tui ！]

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: This is just what I needed for my special secret... err... I've said too much! Take this and get out of here quickly!
translation: 这正是我的特殊秘密所需要的……呃……我说得太多了！带着这个赶紧离开这里吧！ [zhe zheng shi wo de te shu mi mi suo xu yao de …… e …… wo shuo de tai duo le ！ dai zhe zhe ge gan jin li kai zhe li ba ！]

english: Hi! I have this money off voucher!
translation: 你好！我有这张优惠券！ [ni hao ！ wo you zhe zhang you hui quan ！]

english: So I see! Unfortunately it seems to have expired yesterday! Nevermind.
translation: 所以我明白了！不幸的是昨天好像已经过期了！没关系。 [suo yi wo ming bai le ！ bu xing de shi zuo tian hao xiang yi jing guo qi le ！ mei guan xi 。]

english: But I only just got it!
translation: 但我才刚刚得到它！ [dan wo cai gang gang de dao ta ！]

english: I'm sorry, there's nothing I can do.
translation: 对不起，我无能为力。 [dui bu qi ， wo wu neng wei li 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: What have you got?
translation: 你有什么？ [ni you shen me ？]

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Thank you for all your help in solving the murder.
translation: 感谢您为侦破谋杀案提供的所有帮助。 [gan xie nin wei zhen po mou sha an ti gong de suo you bang zhu 。]

english: Hello again. How are you?
translation: 又好。你好吗？ [you hao 。 ni hao ma ？]

english: What's that? How do I chew? With my teeth of course. You humans are odd.
translation: 那是什么？我该如何咀嚼？当然是用我的牙齿。你们人类真奇怪。 [na shi shen me ？ wo gai ru he ju jue ？ dang ran shi yong wo de ya chi 。 ni men ren lei zhen qi guai 。]

english: No, no I said HOW ARE YOU?
translation: 不，不，我说你好吗？ [bu ， bu ， wo shuo ni hao ma ？]

english: No need to shout, I'm not deaf. I'm good thank you.
translation: 不用喊，我没聋。我很好谢谢你。 [bu yong han ， wo mei long 。 wo hen hao xie xie ni 。]

english: Here you go.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: Hey, I have something for you but you don't have any space for it!
translation: 嘿，我有东西给你，但你没有地方放！ [hei ， wo you dong xi gei ni ， dan ni mei you di fang fang ！]

english: Welcome to Lowe's Archery Emporium. Do you want to see my wares?
translation: 欢迎来到劳氏射箭商场。你想看看我的商品吗？ [huan ying lai dao lao shi she jian shang chang 。 ni xiang kan kan wo de shang pin ma ？]

english: I have this voucher for completing the combat Adventure Path, it says to come talk to you about claiming my Adventure Path reward.
translation: 我有这张完成战斗冒险之路的凭证，上面写着来和你谈谈领取我的冒险之路奖励的事情。 [wo you zhe zhang wan cheng zhan dou mao xian zhi lu de ping zheng ， shang mian xie zhe lai he ni tan tan ling qu wo de mao xian zhi lu jiang li de shi qing 。]

english: I will be able to give you your reward when you have some space for it.
translation: 当你有空间的时候我可以给你奖励。 [dang ni you kong jian de shi hou wo ke yi gei ni jiang li 。]

english: Why yes, here are some high-quality iron arrows.
translation: 为什么是的，这里有一些高质量的铁箭。 [wei shen me shi de ， zhe li you yi xie gao zhi liang de tie jian 。]

english: I do have more rewards for you, but you need to be on a members world for me to give you the reward. Maybe there is something else I can help you with.
translation: 我确实有更多的奖励给你，但是你需要在会​​员世界我才能给你奖励。或许还有其他事情我可以帮助你。 [wo que shi you geng duo de jiang li gei ni ， dan shi ni xu yao zai hui ​​ yuan shi jie wo cai neng gei ni jiang li 。 huo xu hai you qi ta shi qing wo ke yi bang zhu ni 。]

english: Since you are a member, I'll also give you extra arrows and one of my finest bows.
translation: 既然你是会员，我还会给你额外的箭和我最好的弓之一。 [ji ran ni shi hui yuan ， wo hai hui gei ni e wai de jian he wo zui hao de gong zhi yi 。]

english: I sell a variety of range equipment in my shop if you wanted to take a look.
translation: 如果您想看一下，我的商店里出售各种范围设备。 [ru guo nin xiang kan yi xia ， wo de shang dian li chu shou ge zhong fan wei she bei 。]

english: Is there anything else I can do for you?
translation: 我还能为您做些什么吗？ [wo hai neng wei nin zuo xie shen me ma ？]

english: I do have more rewards for you, but you need some free space for me to give you the rewards.
translation: 我确实有更多的奖励给你，但是你需要一些自由空间让我给你奖励。 [wo que shi you geng duo de jiang li gei ni ， dan shi ni xu yao yi xie zi you kong jian rang wo gei ni jiang li 。]

english: Can I help you with anything else?
translation: 我还可以帮您做其他事吗？ [wo hai ke yi bang nin zuo qi ta shi ma ？]

english: Why yes, here is one of my finest bows and some high- quality iron arrows.
translation: 是的，这是我最好的弓之一和一些高品质的铁箭。 [shi de ， zhe shi wo zui hao de gong zhi yi he yi xie gao pin zhi di tie jian 。]

english: No, I prefer to bash things close up.
translation: 不，我更喜欢近距离地攻击事物。 [bu ， wo geng xi huan jin ju li di gong ji shi wu 。]

english: Humph, philistine.
translation: 哼，市侩。 [heng ， shi kuai 。]

english: Here you go!
translation: 干得好！ [gan de hao ！]

english: Yes, please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No, I prefer to bash things close up.
translation: 不，我更喜欢近距离地攻击事物。 [bu ， wo geng xi huan jin ju li di gong ji shi wu 。]

english: Watch where you're going, young whippersnapper!
translation: 小心你要去的地方，年轻的自吹自擂者！ [xiao xin ni yao qu de di fang ， nian qing de zi chui zi lei zhe ！]

english: I wasn't going anywhere...
translation: 我哪儿也不去... [wo na er ye bu qu ...]

english: Well then go away from here!
translation: 那就离开这里吧！ [na jiu li kai zhe li ba ！]

english: What's a whippersnapper?
translation: 什么是自吹自擂者？ [shen me shi zi chui zi lei zhe ？]

english: It's a whip. Which snaps. Like me. Now leave!
translation: 这是一根鞭子。哪个快照。像我这样的。现在离开！ [zhe shi yi gen bian zi 。 na ge kuai zhao 。 xiang wo zhe yang de 。 xian zai li kai ！]

english: I am Lubufu - the only fisherman who knows the secret of the Karambwan!
translation: 我是 Lubufu - 唯一知道 Karambwan 秘密的渔夫！ [wo shi  Lubufu -  wei yi zhi dao  Karambwan  mi mi de yu fu ！]

english: What's a Karambwan?
translation: 什么是卡拉姆万？ [shen me shi ka la mu wan ？]

english: What a foolish question! Now leave!
translation: 多么愚蠢的问题啊！现在离开！ [duo me yu chun de wen ti a ！ xian zai li kai ！]

english: I said go away!
translation: 我说走开！ [wo shuo zou kai ！]

english: Ok, I'm going...
translation: 好吧，我这就去…… [hao ba ， wo zhe jiu qu ……]

english: You deceived me you confoundering dolt! Because of you, my entire business is ruined! Get out of my sight!
translation: 你骗我你这个混蛋！因为你，我的事业全毁了！滚出我的视线！ [ni pian wo ni zhe ge hun dan ！ yin wei ni ， wo de shi ye quan hui le ！ gun chu wo de shi xian ！]

english: I wasn't going anywhere...
translation: 我哪儿也不去... [wo na er ye bu qu ...]

english: What's a whippersnapper?
translation: 什么是自吹自擂者？ [shen me shi zi chui zi lei zhe ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Greetings, adventurer. I am Phileas, the Lumbridge Guide. I am here to give information and directions to new players. Is there anything I can help you with?
translation: 你好，冒险家。我是菲利亚斯，朗布里奇指南。我来这里是为了向新玩家提供信息和指导。有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [ni hao ， mao xian jia 。 wo shi fei li ya si ， lang bu li qi zhi nan 。 wo lai zhe li shi wei le xiang xin wan jia ti gong xin xi he zhi dao 。 you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

translation: 我在哪里可以找到继续进行的任务？ [wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao ji xu jin xing de ren wu ？]

english: I'm afraid I can't think of any more quests for you. Don't worry though, there'll be plenty more out there. You'll just need to find them.
translation: 恐怕我无法为你想出更多的任务了。不过不用担心，那里还会有更多。你只需要找到他们。 [kong pa wo wu fa wei ni xiang chu geng duo de ren wu le 。 bu guo bu yong dan xin ， na li hai hui you geng duo 。 ni zhi xu yao zhao dao ta men 。]

english: Well, I heard that Father Aereck could use a hand. You'll find him in the church just here. Talk to him and he'll give you the details.
translation: 嗯，我听说艾瑞克神父会用手。你会在这儿的教堂里找到他。和他谈谈，他会给你详细信息。 [n ， wo ting shuo ai rui ke shen fu hui yong shou 。 ni hui zai zhe er de jiao tang li zhao dao ta 。 he ta tan tan ， ta hui gei ni xiang xi xin xi 。]

english: Well, I heard that a chap called Veos needs help finding some treasure. Last I heard, he was looking for assistance in the pub just north of here. Talk to him and see if you can help.
translation: 嗯，我听说一个叫 Veos 的小伙子需要帮助寻找一些宝藏。我上次听说，他正在北边的酒吧里寻求帮助。和他谈谈，看看你是否能提供帮助。 [n ， wo ting shuo yi ge jiao  Veos  de xiao huo zi xu yao bang zhu xun zhao yi xie bao zang 。 wo shang ci ting shuo ， ta zheng zai bei bian de jiu ba li xun qiu bang zhu 。 he ta tan tan ， kan kan ni shi fou neng ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: Well, I heard that Farmer Fred could use some help. You'll find him on the farm just north of here. Talk to him and see if he needs a hand.
translation: 嗯，我听说农夫弗雷德需要一些帮助。你会在北边的农场里找到他。与他交谈，看看他是否需要帮助。 [n ， wo ting shuo nong fu fu lei de xu yao yi xie bang zhu 。 ni hui zai bei bian de nong chang li zhao dao ta 。 yu ta jiao tan ， kan kan ta shi fou xu yao bang zhu 。]

translation: 嗯，我听说南边的沼泽地里发生了一些骚动。可能值得研究一下。 [n ， wo ting shuo nan bian de zhao ze di li fa sheng le yi xie sao dong 。 ke neng zhi de yan jiu yi xia 。]

english: Well, I believe the Duke of Lumbridge requires an errand running for him. You can find him upstairs in the castle. Just talk to him to get the details.
translation: 嗯，我相信朗布里奇公爵需要为他办事。你可以在城堡的楼上找到他。只需与他交谈即可了解详细信息。 [n ， wo xiang xin lang bu li qi gong jue xu yao wei ta ban shi 。 ni ke yi zai cheng bao de lou shang zhao dao ta 。 zhi xu yu ta jiao tan ji ke liao jie xiang xi xin xi 。]

translation: 没有武器的话，与怪物战斗将是一场艰苦的战斗。我建议你先找到其中一个。 [mei you wu qi de hua ， yu guai wu zhan dou jiang shi yi chang jian ku de zhan dou 。 wo jian yi ni xian zhao dao qi zhong yi ge 。]

translation: 那么你可以制作它们、找到它们或购买它们。 [na me ni ke yi zhi zuo ta men 、 zhao dao ta men huo gou mai ta men 。]

translation: 我在哪里可以找到武器？ [wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao wu qi ？]

english: If you visit the combat tutors south of the general store they may be able to help you with that. Failing that there are a few cheap weapons lying around in the world. For example, you can get an iron dagger if you

english: Well, what would you like to know?
translation: 那么，您想知道什么？ [na me ， nin xiang zhi dao shen me ？]

english: How do I make a weapon?
translation: 我该如何制作武器？ [wo gai ru he zhi zuo wu qi ？]

english: You already have a reasonable Smithing level, so I think you know that already.
translation: 你已经有一个合理的史密斯水平，所以我想你已经知道了。 [ni yi jing you yi ge he li de shi mi si shui ping ， suo yi wo xiang ni yi jing zhi dao le 。]

english: The Smithing skill allows you to make armour and weapons. Talk to the boy who smelts metal in the furnace, I'm sure he can help.
translation: 史密斯技能可以让你制造盔甲和武器。与在熔炉中冶炼金属的男孩交谈，我相信他能提供帮助。 [shi mi si ji neng ke yi rang ni zhi zao kui jia he wu qi 。 yu zai rong lu zhong ye lian jin shu de nan hai jiao tan ， wo xiang xin ta neng ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: Where can I smith?
translation: 哪里可以锻造？ [na li ke yi duan zao ？]

english: You will find a helpful Smithing tutor in the west of Varrock - that's north of here. Follow the path across the river and head north.
translation: 你会在瓦罗克的西部找到一位乐于助人的史密斯导师——那就是这里的北部。沿着河对岸的小路向北行驶。 [ni hui zai wa luo ke de xi bu zhao dao yi wei le yu zhu ren de shi mi si dao shi —— na jiu shi zhe li de bei bu 。 yan zhe he dui an de xiao lu xiang bei xing shi 。]

english: I suggest you go and mine some ore; find the Mining symbol - with the guide symbol near it - in the swamp south of here. The Mining guide there can teach you how to mine ore.
translation: 我建议你去开采一些矿石；找到采矿符号 - 附近有引导符号 - 位于此处南部的沼泽中。那里的采矿指南可以教你如何开采矿石。 [wo jian yi ni qu kai cai yi xie kuang shi ； zhao dao cai kuang fu hao  -  fu jin you yin dao fu hao  -  wei yu ci chu nan bu de zhao ze zhong 。 na li de cai kuang zhi nan ke yi jiao ni ru he kai cai kuang shi 。]

english: Where can I buy a weapon?
translation: 哪里可以买到武器？ [na li ke yi mai dao wu qi ？]

english: You can get a weapon free from the combat tutors if they think you need it. Failing that, the nearest shop that would sell you something of that nature is Bob's Brilliant Axes in this very town. If you want a bigger
translation: 如果战斗导师认为您需要武器，您可以免费获得武器。如果做不到这一点，最近能卖给你这种东西的商店就是这个镇上的 Bob's Brilliant Axes。如果你想要更大的 [ru guo zhan dou dao shi ren wei nin xu yao wu qi ， nin ke yi mian fei huo de wu qi 。 ru guo zuo bu dao zhe yi dian ， zui jin neng mai gei ni zhe zhong dong xi de shang dian jiu shi zhe ge zhen shang de  Bob's Brilliant Axes。 ru guo ni xiang yao geng da de]

english: choice I suggest you head to one of the big cities. If you follow the road east over the bridge and then head north you will eventually reach Varrock, where you can buy all manner of things. You can use the world map
translation: 选择我建议你前往大城市之一。如果你沿着路向东过桥，然后向北走，你最终会到达瓦罗克，在那里你可以买到各种各样的东西。您可以使用世界地图 [xuan ze wo jian yi ni qian wang da cheng shi zhi yi 。 ru guo ni yan zhe lu xiang dong guo qiao ， ran hou xiang bei zou ， ni zui zhong hui dao da wa luo ke ， zai na li ni ke yi mai dao ge zhong ge yang de dong xi 。 nin ke yi shi yong shi jie di tu]

english: to help you find your way.
translation: 帮助您找到方向。 [bang zhu nin zhao dao fang xiang 。]

english: Could I get a staff like yours?
translation: 我可以找一个像你这样的员工吗？ [wo ke yi zhao yi ge xiang ni zhe yang de yuan gong ma ？]

english: There is no other staff like this in all the land. It's a very important staff. It shows who holds the job as the Lumbridge Guide, and that's me.
translation: 整个土地上没有其他员工像这样。这是一个非常重要的员工。它显示了谁担任 Lumbridge 指南的职位，那就是我。 [zheng ge tu di shang mei you qi ta yuan gong xiang zhe yang 。 zhe shi yi ge fei chang zhong yao de yuan gong 。 ta xian shi le shui dan ren  Lumbridge  zhi nan de zhi wei ， na jiu shi wo 。]

english: Yes, but what should I fight once I have got a weapon?
translation: 是的，但是有了武器之后我该怎么打呢？ [shi de ， dan shi you le wu qi zhi hou wo gai zen me da ne ？]

english: There's lots of beasts to fight in the woods around here, especially to the west. There are certainly some goblins and spiders that are pests and could do with being cleared out. There's also a chicken farm or two up the
translation: 这附近的树林里有很多野兽可以战斗，尤其是在西边。当然有一些妖精和蜘蛛是害虫，需要清除掉。上面还有一两个养鸡场 [zhe fu jin de shu lin li you hen duo ye shou ke yi zhan dou ， you qi shi zai xi bian 。 dang ran you yi xie yao jing he zhi zhu shi hai chong ， xu yao qing chu diao 。 shang mian hai you yi liang ge yang ji chang]

english: road for some fairly easy pickings. Non-player characters usually appear as yellow dots on your minimap, although there are some that you won't be able to fight, such as myself. A monster's combat level is

english: shown next to their 'Attack' option. If that level is coloured green it means the monster is weaker than you. If it is red, it means that the monster is tougher than you.
translation: 显示在“攻击”选项旁边。如果该等级是绿色的，则意味着怪物比你弱。如果是红色的，就说明这个怪物比你更强。 [xian shi zai “ gong ji ” xuan xiang pang bian 。 ru guo gai deng ji shi lv se de ， ze yi wei zhe guai wu bi ni ruo 。 ru guo shi hong se de ， jiu shuo ming zhe ge guai wu bi ni geng qiang 。]

english: Remember, you will do better if you have better armour and weapons and it's always worth carrying a bit of food to heal yourself.
translation: 请记住，如果你有更好的盔甲和武器，你会做得更好，并且携带一些食物来治愈自己总是值得的。 [qing ji zhu ， ru guo ni you geng hao de kui jia he wu qi ， ni hui zuo de geng hao ， bing qie xie dai yi xie shi wu lai zhi yu zi ji zong shi zhi de de 。]

english: Where can I get food to heal myself?
translation: 我在哪里可以获得食物来治愈自己？ [wo zai na li ke yi huo de shi wu lai zhi yu zi ji ？]

english: There are many different foods in the game such as cabbage, fish, meat and many more. Which do you wish to hear about?
translation: 游戏中有许多不同的食物，如卷心菜、鱼、肉等等。您想听哪一个？ [you xi zhong you xu duo bu tong de shi wu ， ru juan xin cai 、 yu 、 rou deng deng 。 nin xiang ting na yi ge ？]

english: How do I get cabbages?
translation: 我如何获得卷心菜？ [wo ru he huo de juan xin cai ？]

english: There is a field a little distance to the north of here packed full of cabbages which are there for the picking.
translation: 北边不远的地方有一块田地，里面长满了白菜，等待采摘。 [bei bian bu yuan de di fang you yi kuai tian di ， li mian zhang man le bai cai ， deng dai cai zhai 。]

english: You could also farm your own cabbages; there's a Farming patch just south of Falador.
translation: 你也可以自己种植卷心菜；法拉多以南有一块农田。 [ni ye ke yi zi ji zhong zhi juan xin cai ； fa la duo yi nan you yi kuai nong tian 。]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: How do I fish?
translation: 我如何钓鱼？ [wo ru he diao yu ？]

english: I am confused. You are already an experienced fisher. You should know the answer to that already.
translation: 我很困惑。您已经是一位经验丰富的钓鱼者了。你应该已经知道答案了。 [wo hen kun huo 。 nin yi jing shi yi wei jing yan feng fu de diao yu zhe le 。 ni ying gai yi jing zhi dao da an le 。]

english: Fishing spots require different levels and equipment to use. To start Fishing, you'll want to talk to the Fishing tutor who can be found in the swamps south of here. He will also give you a small fishing net if you don't
translation: 钓鱼点需要不同的级别和设备来使用。要开始钓鱼，您需要与位于南部沼泽地的钓鱼导师交谈。如果你不这样做他还会给你一个小渔网 [diao yu dian xu yao bu tong de ji bie he she bei lai shi yong 。 yao kai shi diao yu ， nin xu yao yu wei yu nan bu zhao ze di de diao yu dao shi jiao tan 。 ru guo ni bu zhe yang zuo ta hai hui gei ni yi ge xiao yu wang]

english: own one already.
translation: 已经拥有一个了。 [yi jing yong you yi ge le 。]

english: Where could I find one of those?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到其中之一？ [wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao qi zhong zhi yi ？]

english: You can get them from a Fishing shop or our Fishing Tutor south of here in the swamp. There is a Fishing shop in Port Sarim; you can find it on the world map. Port Sarim is some way to the west of here, beyond
translation: 您可以从沼泽以南的钓鱼店或我们的钓鱼导师那里获得它们。沙里姆港有一家钓鱼店；你可以在世界地图上找到它。萨里姆港就在这儿西边一段距离 [nin ke yi cong zhao ze yi nan de diao yu dian huo wo men de diao yu dao shi na li huo de ta men 。 sha li mu gang you yi jia diao yu dian ； ni ke yi zai shi jie di tu shang zhao dao ta 。 sa li mu gang jiu zai zhe er xi bian yi duan ju li]

english: the village of Draynor.
translation: 德雷诺村。 [de lei nuo cun 。]

english: Where can I find meat?
translation: 哪里可以找到肉？ [na li ke yi zhao dao rou ？]

english: I suggest you go and kill some chickens. The roads on either side of this river eventually go past a chicken farm. When you have killed some chickens, cook them. You could either make a fire or use a range.
translation: 我建议你去杀一些鸡。这条河两岸的道路最终都会经过一个养鸡场。当你杀了一些鸡后，把它们煮熟。您可以生火或使用炉灶。 [wo jian yi ni qu sha yi xie ji 。 zhe tiao he liang an de dao lu zui zhong du hui jing guo yi ge yang ji chang 。 dang ni sha le yi xie ji hou ， ba ta men zhu shu 。 nin ke yi sheng huo huo shi yong lu zao 。]

english: There is a range at the southern end in this town and a Cooking tutor in south Lumbridge near Bob's Brilliant Axes shop.
translation: 这个镇的南端有一个牧场，在朗布里奇南部靠近鲍勃的辉煌斧头店的地方有一个烹饪导师。 [zhe ge zhen de nan duan you yi ge mu chang ， zai lang bu li qi nan bu kao jin bao bo de hui huang fu tou dian de di fang you yi ge peng ren dao shi 。]

english: Well, you can make them, buy them or talk to the combat tutors just west of here.
translation: 好吧，你可以制作它们、购买它们或与这里西边的战斗导师交谈。 [hao ba ， ni ke yi zhi zuo ta men 、 gou mai ta men huo yu zhe li xi bian de zhan dou dao shi jiao tan 。]

english: Okay, thanks, I will go and kill things.
translation: 好的，谢谢，我这就去杀东西。 [hao de ， xie xie ， wo zhe jiu qu sha dong xi 。]

english: Can I kill other players?
translation: 我可以杀死其他玩家吗？ [wo ke yi sha si qi ta wan jia ma ？]

english: Well, you can go to the Wilderness. That is the area for killing other players. Just keep heading north and eventually you will be bound to reach it. Be very careful, though. Player-killing is not for the unprepared.
translation: 好吧，你可以去荒野。那是杀死其他玩家的区域。只要继续向北走，最终你一定会到达那里。不过要非常小心。玩家杀戮不适合毫无准备的人。 [hao ba ， ni ke yi qu huang ye 。 na shi sha si qi ta wan jia de qu yu 。 zhi yao ji xu xiang bei zou ， zui zhong ni yi ding hui dao da na li 。 bu guo yao fei chang xiao xin 。 wan jia sha lu bu shi he hao wu zhun bei de ren 。]

english: I'd suggest that you leave any items you don't want to lose in the bank and take a good supply of food with you.
translation: 我建议您将不想丢失的物品留在银行，并随身携带充足的食物。 [wo jian yi nin jiang bu xiang diu shi de wu pin liu zai yin hang ， bing sui shen xie dai chong zu de shi wu 。]

english: You're strong enough to work out what monsters to fight for yourself now, but the combat tutors might help you with any questions you have about the skills; they're just over there to the south of the general store.
translation: 你现在已经足够强大，可以弄清楚要为自己战斗的怪物了，但是战斗导师可能会帮助你解决有关技能的任何问题；他们就在杂货店南边。 [ni xian zai yi jing zu gou qiang da ， ke yi nong qing chu yao wei zi ji zhan dou de guai wu le ， dan shi zhan dou dao shi ke neng hui bang zhu ni jie jue you guan ji neng de ren he wen ti ； ta men jiu zai za huo dian nan bian 。]

english: Where can I make money?
translation: 我在哪里可以赚钱？ [wo zai na li ke yi zhuan qian ？]

english: There are many ways to make money in the game. I would suggest either killing monsters or doing a trade skill such as Smithing or Fishing.
translation: 游戏中有很多赚钱的方法。我建议要么杀死怪物，要么做一些贸易技能，比如锻造或钓鱼。 [you xi zhong you hen duo zhuan qian de fang fa 。 wo jian yi yao me sha si guai wu ， yao me zuo yi xie mao yi ji neng ， bi ru duan zao huo diao yu 。]

english: Please don't try to get money by begging off other players. It will make you unpopular. Nobody likes a beggar. It is very irritating to have other players asking for your hard-earned cash.
translation: 请不要试图通过乞讨其他玩家来获取金钱。这会让你不受欢迎。没有人喜欢乞丐。让其他玩家索要你辛苦赚来的钱是非常令人恼火的。 [qing bu yao shi tu tong guo qi tao qi ta wan jia lai huo qu jin qian 。 zhe hui rang ni bu shou huan ying 。 mei you ren xi huan qi gai 。 rang qi ta wan jia suo yao ni xin ku zhuan lai de qian shi fei chang ling ren nao huo de 。]

english: Where can I find more information?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到更多信息？ [wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao geng duo xin xi ？]

english: What you'll want is the OSRS Wiki! I've taken the liberty of opening the useful links section of the account management tab for you. Here you can find a link to the wiki. There's information and guides on almost
translation: 您需要的是 OSRS Wiki！我冒昧地为您打开了帐户管理选项卡的有用链接部分。在这里您可以找到 wiki 的链接。几乎有关于的信息和指南 [nin xu yao de shi  OSRS Wiki！ wo mao mei di wei nin da kai le zhang hu guan li xuan xiang ka de you yong lian jie bu fen 。 zai zhe li nin ke yi zhao dao  wiki  de lian jie 。 ji hu you guan yu de xin xi he zhi nan]

english: everything, all easily searched and it's even written and maintained by players.
translation: 所有内容都可以轻松搜索，甚至由玩家编写和维护。 [suo you nei rong dou ke yi qing song sou suo ， shen zhi you wan jia bian xie he wei hu 。]

english: I'd like to know more about security.
translation: 我想了解更多有关安全的信息。 [wo xiang liao jie geng duo you guan an quan de xin xi 。]

english: First I must warn you to take every precaution to keep your RuneScape password and PIN secure. The most important thing to remember is to never give your password to, or share your account with, anyone.
translation: 首先，我必须警告您采取一切预防措施来保证您的 RuneScape 密码和 PIN 的安全。最重要的是要记住，切勿将您的密码提供给任何人，或与任何人共享您的帐户。 [shou xian ， wo bi xu jing gao nin cai qu yi qie yu fang cuo shi lai bao zheng nin de  RuneScape  mi ma he  PIN  de an quan 。 zui zhong yao de shi yao ji zhu ， qie wu jiang nin de mi ma ti gong gei ren he ren ， huo yu ren he ren gong xiang nin de zhang hu 。]

english: I can also tell you about password security, avoiding item scamming and in-game moderation. I can also tell you about a place called the Stronghold of Security, where you can learn more about account security and
translation: 我还可以告诉您有关密码安全、避免物品诈骗和游戏内审核的信息。我还可以告诉你一个叫做安全要塞的地方，在那里你可以了解更多关于账户安全和 [wo hai ke yi gao su nin you guan mi ma an quan 、 bi mian wu pin zha pian he you xi nei shen he de xin xi 。 wo hai ke yi gao su ni yi ge jiao zuo an quan yao sai de di fang ， zai na li ni ke yi liao jie geng duo guan yu zhang hu an quan he]

english: have a bit of an adventure at the same time.
translation: 同时也有一点冒险。 [tong shi ye you yi dian mao xian 。]

english: I'd like to know about password security.
translation: 我想了解密码安全性。 [wo xiang liao jie mi ma an quan xing 。]

translation: 嗯，关于密码安全，首先要记住的一点是，永远不要将您的密码、银行 PIN 码或验证器详细信息告诉任何人，即使他们自称是 Jagex 员工，这一点我再怎么强调也不为过。真实的 [n ， guan yu mi ma an quan ， shou xian yao ji zhu de yi dian shi ， yong yuan bu yao jiang nin de mi ma 、 yin hang  PIN  ma huo yan zheng qi xiang xi xin xi gao su ren he ren ， ji shi ta men zi cheng shi  Jagex  yuan gong ， zhe yi dian wo zai zen me qiang diao ye bu wei guo 。 zhen shi de]

english: Jagex staff will NEVER ask for your password. Sharing your account is a very bad idea, even if you think that you know and trust the person you are sharing with. Players have lost items and even their
translation: Jagex 工作人员绝不会询问您的密码。即使您认为自己了解并信任与您共享帐户的人，共享您的帐户也是一个非常糟糕的主意。玩家丢失了物品，甚至他们的 [Jagex  gong zuo ren yuan jue bu hui xun wen nin de mi ma 。 ji shi nin ren wei zi ji liao jie bing xin ren yu nin gong xiang zhang hu de ren ， gong xiang nin de zhang hu ye shi yi ge fei chang zao gao de zhu yi 。 wan jia diu shi le wu pin ， shen zhi ta men de]

english: account this way. Sharing accounts is also against the rules.
translation: 就这样记账。共享帐户也违反规则。 [jiu zhe yang ji zhang 。 gong xiang zhang hu ye wei fan gui ze 。]

english: Is there anything else to be aware of?
translation: 还有什么需要注意的吗？ [hai you shen me xu yao zhu yi de ma ？]

english: Yes, also be careful where you enter your password. Be aware that fake Old School RuneScape websites exist. These are sites that claim to give things such as item/stat upgrades, free items, beta testing and
translation: 是的，输入密码时也要小心。请注意，存在假冒的 Old School RuneScape 网站。这些网站声称提供物品/统计升级、免费物品、Beta 测试和 [shi de ， shu ru mi ma shi ye yao xiao xin 。 qing zhu yi ， cun zai jia mao de  Old School RuneScape  wang zhan 。 zhe xie wang zhan sheng cheng ti gong wu pin / tong ji sheng ji 、 mian fei wu pin 、Beta  ce shi he]

english: moderator applications. Jagex do not offer any of these services.
translation: 主持人应用程序。 Jagex 不提供任何此类服务。 [zhu chi ren ying yong cheng xu 。 Jagex  bu ti gong ren he ci lei fu wu 。]

english: Also be aware of trojans and keyloggers. These nasty programs can send everything you type into your device back to the computers of malicious people, so you can lose more than just your Old School RuneScape
translation: 还要注意木马和键盘记录程序。这些讨厌的程序可以将您在设备中输入的所有内容发送回恶意人员的计算机，因此您失去的不仅仅是您的 Old School RuneScape [hai yao zhu yi mu ma he jian pan ji lu cheng xu 。 zhe xie tao yan de cheng xu ke yi jiang nin zai she bei zhong shu ru de suo you nei rong fa song hui e yi ren yuan de ji suan ji ， yin ci nin shi qu de bu jin jin shi nin de  Old School RuneScape]

english: password in this way. To avoid getting these on your device, be very wary of what you download, especially when it comes to downloading third party software. Also be very wary of email attachments and instant
translation: 密码就这样。为了避免在您的设备上获取这些内容，请务必小心您下载的内容，尤其是在下载第三方软件时。还要非常警惕电子邮件附件和即时信息 [mi ma jiu zhe yang 。 wei le bi mian zai nin de she bei shang huo qu zhe xie nei rong ， qing wu bi xiao xin nin xia zai de nei rong ， you qi shi zai xia zai di san fang ruan jian shi 。 hai yao fei chang jing ti dian zi you jian fu jian he ji shi xin xi]

english: messenger file transfers, which can contain such things.
translation: 信使文件传输，其中可以包含此类内容。 [xin shi wen jian chuan shu ， qi zhong ke yi bao han ci lei nei rong 。]

english: Finally, remember the game doesn't censor your password or bank PIN when you type them; anyone who tells you otherwise is probably trying to steal your character or items.
translation: 最后，请记住，当您输入密码或银行 PIN 码时，游戏不会对其进行审查。任何告诉你其他情况的人都可能试图窃取你的角色或物品。 [zui hou ， qing ji zhu ， dang nin shu ru mi ma huo yin hang  PIN  ma shi ， you xi bu hui dui qi jin xing shen cha 。 ren he gao su ni qi ta qing kuang de ren dou ke neng shi tu qie qu ni de jue se huo wu pin 。]

english: I'd like to know more about avoiding item scamming.
translation: 我想了解更多有关避免商品诈骗的信息。 [wo xiang liao jie geng duo you guan bi mian shang pin zha pian de xin xi 。]

english: There are many nice and helpful players in Old School RuneScape; unfortunately, as in real life, there are some who aren't so honest. Some people may try to trick you out of your items. Try not to fall for this as
translation: Old School RuneScape 中有很多友善且乐于助人的玩家；不幸的是，就像在现实生活中一样，有些人并不那么诚实。有些人可能会试图骗取您的物品。尽量不要上当 [Old School RuneScape  zhong you hen duo you shan qie le yu zhu ren de wan jia ； bu xing de shi ， jiu xiang zai xian shi sheng huo zhong yi yang ， you xie ren bing bu na me cheng shi 。 you xie ren ke neng hui shi tu pian qu nin de wu pin 。 jin liang bu yao shang dang]

english: Jagex policy is to never return lost items to players that have been scammed. Doing so just encourages users to claim they lost items they never had to gain an unfair advantage. However, people carrying out such
translation: Jagex 的政策是绝不将丢失的物品退还给被骗的玩家。这样做只会鼓励用户声称他们丢失了他们本来不必获得不公平优势的物品。然而，人们进行这样的 [Jagex  de zheng ce shi jue bu jiang diu shi de wu pin tui huan gei bei pian de wan jia 。 zhe yang zuo zhi hui gu li yong hu sheng cheng ta men diu shi le ta men ben lai bu bi huo de bu gong ping you shi de wu pin 。 ran er ， ren men jin xing zhe yang de]

english: scams will get banned as it is against the rules.
translation: 诈骗将被禁止，因为它违反了规则。 [zha pian jiang bei jin zhi ， yin wei ta wei fan le gui ze 。]

english: When trading, you have a second trade confirmation screen. Always double check that you are getting the items you expect on this page as some people may try and change what they are trading at the last minute on
translation: 交易时，您有第二个交易确认屏幕。请务必仔细检查您是否在此页面上获得了您期望的商品，因为有些人可能会尝试在最后一刻更改他们在该页面上交易的商品 [jiao yi shi ， nin you di er ge jiao yi que ren ping mu 。 qing wu bi zi xi jian cha nin shi fou zai ci ye mian shang huo de le nin qi wang de shang pin ， yin wei you xie ren ke neng hui chang shi zai zui hou yi ke geng gai ta men zai gai ye mian shang jiao yi de shang pin]

english: the first trade screen. Remember when you have clicked accept on the second trade screen, the trade is not reversible.
translation: 第一个交易屏幕。请记住，当您在第二个交易屏幕上单击“接受”时，交易不可逆转。 [di yi ge jiao yi ping mu 。 qing ji zhu ， dang nin zai di er ge jiao yi ping mu shang dan ji “ jie shou ” shi ， jiao yi bu ke ni zhuan 。]

english: Try and find out from someone else what an item is before spending a lot of money on it. Not all merchants are honest about the rarity or the uses of their wares. For example, some people try to pass off spinach rolls as
translation: 在花很多钱购买某件物品之前，先尝试从别人那里了解它是什么。并非所有商人都诚实地对待他们的商品的稀有性或用途。例如，有些人试图将菠菜卷冒充为 [zai hua hen duo qian gou mai mou jian wu pin zhi qian ， xian chang shi cong bie ren na li liao jie ta shi shen me 。 bing fei suo you shang ren dou cheng shi di dui dai ta men de shang pin de xi you xing huo yong tu 。 li ru ， you xie ren shi tu jiang bo cai juan mao chong wei]

english: rare when in fact they're as common as cabbages!
translation: 很少见，但事实上它们和卷心菜一样常见！ [hen shao jian ， dan shi shi shang ta men he juan xin cai yi yang chang jian ！]

english: Be wary of people offering to improve your items. For example, some people will claim they can add a trim to your armour or upgrade your sword to a more powerful one. This is not possible and they are trying
translation: 警惕那些提出改进你的物品的人。例如，有些人会声称他们可以为你的盔甲添加装饰或将你的剑升级为更强大的剑。这是不可能的，他们正在尝试 [jing ti na xie ti chu gai jin ni de wu pin de ren 。 li ru ， you xie ren hui sheng cheng ta men ke yi wei ni de kui jia tian jia zhuang shi huo jiang ni de jian sheng ji wei geng qiang da de jian 。 zhe shi bu ke neng de ， ta men zheng zai chang shi]

english: to steal your hard-earned equipment.
translation: 偷走你辛苦赚来的装备。 [tou zou ni xin ku zhuan lai de zhuang bei 。]

english: I'd like to know more about in-game moderation.
translation: 我想了解更多有关游戏内审核的信息。 [wo xiang liao jie geng duo you guan you xi nei shen he de xin xi 。]

english: You will, from time to time, see moderator characters in game. Remember: a real staff member will never ask for your password or any other personal information. There are two types of moderator. You may see Jagex
translation: 您会时不时地在游戏中看到主持人角色。请记住：真正的员工绝不会询问您的密码或任何其他个人信息。主持人有两种类型。你可能会看到Jagex [nin hui shi bu shi di zai you xi zhong kan dao zhu chi ren jue se 。 qing ji zhu ： zhen zheng de yuan gong jue bu hui xun wen nin de mi ma huo ren he qi ta ge ren xin xi 。 zhu chi ren you liang zhong lei xing 。 ni ke neng hui kan dao Jagex]

english: staff characters in game - these can be identified by a gold crown next to their name and are the people who work in the Jagex offices. They might be from Customer Support, or they might be a tester or a
translation: 游戏中的员工角色 - 这些人可以通过名字旁边的金色皇冠来识别，他们是在 Jagex 办公室工作的人。他们可能来自客户支持，或者他们可能是测试人员或 [you xi zhong de yuan gong jue se  -  zhe xie ren ke yi tong guo ming zi pang bian de jin se huang guan lai shi bie ， ta men shi zai  Jagex  ban gong shi gong zuo de ren 。 ta men ke neng lai zi ke hu zhi chi ， huo zhe ta men ke neng shi ce shi ren yuan huo]

english: programmer. You may also see player moderators - these can be identified by a silver crown next to their name. Player moderators are trusted players of Old School RuneScape that help keep in-game behaviour in
translation: 程序员。您还可能会看到玩家版主 - 这些可以通过他们名字旁边的银色王冠来识别。玩家版主是 Old School RuneScape 值得信赖的玩家，有助于保持游戏中的行为 [cheng xu yuan 。 nin hai ke neng hui kan dao wan jia ban zhu  -  zhe xie ke yi tong guo ta men ming zi pang bian de yin se wang guan lai shi bie 。 wan jia ban zhu shi  Old School RuneScape  zhi de xin lai de wan jia ， you zhu yu bao chi you xi zhong de xing wei]

english: line with the Old School RuneScape rules.
translation: 符合 Old School RuneScape 规则。 [fu he  Old School RuneScape  gui ze 。]

english: How do I become a player moderator?
translation: 我如何成为玩家版主？ [wo ru he cheng wei wan jia ban zhu ？]

english: The only way to become a player moderator is to know and play by the rules laid down by Jagex. Report those who break the rules, help players who need it and one day you might find an invite to become a moderator in
translation: 成为玩家管理员的唯一方法是了解并遵守 Jagex 制定的规则。举报那些违反规则的人，帮助有需要的玩家，有一天您可能会收到邀请成为一名版主 [cheng wei wan jia guan li yuan de wei yi fang fa shi liao jie bing zun shou  Jagex  zhi ding de gui ze 。 ju bao na xie wei fan gui ze de ren ， bang zhu you xu yao de wan jia ， you yi tian nin ke neng hui shou dao yao qing cheng wei yi ming ban zhu]

english: your Old School RuneScape inbox. Note that Jagex will never contact you in game or by email to become a player moderator.
translation: 您的 Old School RuneScape 收件箱。请注意，Jagex 绝不会在游戏中或通过电子邮件与您联系以成为玩家管理员。 [nin de  Old School RuneScape  shou jian xiang 。 qing zhu yi ，Jagex  jue bu hui zai you xi zhong huo tong guo dian zi you jian yu nin lian xi yi cheng wei wan jia guan li yuan 。]

english: I'd like to know about the Stronghold of Security.
translation: 我想了解一下安全要塞的情况。 [wo xiang liao jie yi xia an quan yao sai de qing kuang 。]

english: An exciting new discovery has been made in the Barbarian Village. Soon after they started mining in the middle of the village, one of the miners got caught in a cave.
translation: 野蛮人村庄有了令人兴奋的新发现。他们在村子中间开始采矿后不久，一名矿工被困在一个山洞里。 [ye man ren cun zhuang you le ling ren xing fen de xin fa xian 。 ta men zai cun zi zhong jian kai shi cai kuang hou bu jiu ， yi ming kuang gong bei kun zai yi ge shan dong li 。]

english: Sounds painful, did he fall on his head?
translation: 听起来很痛苦，他是不是头朝下摔倒了？ [ting qi lai hen tong ku ， ta shi bu shi tou chao xia shuai dao le ？]

english: No, but it turned out that he had discovered a place unlike any other.
translation: 不，但事实证明，他发现了一个与众不同的地方。 [bu ， dan shi shi zheng ming ， ta fa xian le yi ge yu zhong bu tong de di fang 。]

english: How so?
translation: 为何如此？ [wei he ru ci ？]

english: Well an explorer went to look down there, it's full of new and exciting creatures and other surprises on top of that. It turns out this place can also help you to secure your account more effectively.
translation: 一位探险家去那里看看，那里充满了新的、令人兴奋的生物，除此之外还有其他惊喜。事实证明，这个地方还可以帮助您更有效地保护您的帐户。 [yi wei tan xian jia qu na li kan kan ， na li chong man le xin de 、 ling ren xing fen de sheng wu ， chu ci zhi wai hai you qi ta jing xi 。 shi shi zheng ming ， zhe ge di fang hai ke yi bang zhu nin geng you xiao di bao hu nin de zhang hu 。]

english: Wow, that sounds good. Where can I find the explorer to learn more?
translation: 哇，听起来不错。我在哪里可以找到探索者以了解更多信息？ [wa ， ting qi lai bu cuo 。 wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao tan suo zhe yi liao jie geng duo xin xi ？]

english: Sadly the explorer went missing and has not been found. However, here is some information to get you started on securing your account. You can find the Barbarian Village north of Falador and west of Varrock.
translation: 不幸的是，这位探险家失踪了，至今未被找到。不过，这里有一些信息可以帮助您开始保护您的帐户。你可以在法拉多以北、瓦罗克以西找到野蛮人村庄。 [bu xing de shi ， zhe wei tan xian jia shi zong le ， zhi jin wei bei zhao dao 。 bu guo ， zhe li you yi xie xin xi ke yi bang zhu nin kai shi bao hu nin de zhang hu 。 ni ke yi zai fa la duo yi bei 、 wa luo ke yi xi zhao dao ye man ren cun zhuang 。]

english: Where can I find a bank?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到银行？ [wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao yin hang ？]

english: You'll find a bank upstairs in Lumbridge Castle - go right to the top.
translation: 您会在朗布里奇城堡的楼上找到一家银行 - 向右走到顶部。 [nin hui zai lang bu li qi cheng bao de lou shang zhao dao yi jia yin hang  -  xiang you zou dao ding bu 。]

english: The minimap in the top right corner of the game screen has various icons showing the locations of things. This icon to the left shows where banks are.
translation: 游戏屏幕右上角的小地图有各种图标，显示事物的位置。左侧的此图标显示银行的位置。 [you xi ping mu you shang jiao de xiao di tu you ge zhong tu biao ， xian shi shi wu de wei zhi 。 zuo ce de ci tu biao xian shi yin hang de wei zhi 。]

english: No, I can find things myself thank you.
translation: 不，我可以自己找东西，谢谢。 [bu ， wo ke yi zi ji zhao dong xi ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: What, who's that?
translation: 什么，那是谁？ [shen me ， na shi shui ？]

english: Hehe... ahem...
translation: 呵呵……咳咳…… [he he …… hai hai ……]

english: This is the voice of your conscience! You've been a very naughty boy haven't you?
translation: 这是你良心的声音！你一直是个很调皮的孩子，不是吗？ [zhe shi ni liang xin de sheng yin ！ ni yi zhi shi ge hen tiao pi de hai zi ， bu shi ma ？]

english: What? No I haven't!
translation: 什么？不，我没有！ [shen me ？ bu ， wo mei you ！]

english: You know what I'm talking about! Don't lie!
translation: 你知道我在说什么！别说谎！ [ni zhi dao wo zai shuo shen me ！ bie shuo huang ！]

english: Okay, okay! I'm sorry, I'll never do it again!
translation: 好吧好吧！对不起，我再也不会这么做了！ [hao ba hao ba ！ dui bu qi ， wo zai ye bu hui zhe me zuo le ！]

english: If you do it again, you'll be in deep trouble.
translation: 如果你再这样做，你就会陷入大麻烦。 [ru guo ni zai zhe yang zuo ， ni jiu hui xian ru da ma fan 。]

english: I'm supposed to be the local source of knowledge, but I cannot even solve this puzzle! Do me a favour and solve it for me.
translation: 我应该是当地的知识来源，但我却连这个谜题都解不开！帮我一个忙，帮我解决这个问题。 [wo ying gai shi dang di de zhi shi lai yuan ， dan wo que lian zhe ge mi ti dou jie bu kai ！ bang wo yi ge mang ， bang wo jie jue zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Sorry but you haven't solved the puzzle yet.
translation: 抱歉，您还没有解决这个难题。 [bao qian ， nin hai mei you jie jue zhe ge nan ti 。]

english: Thanks [player name]!
translation: 谢谢[玩家姓名]！ [xie xie [ wan jia xing ming ]！]

english: Does the name 'Philly' mean anything to you by chance?
translation: “费城”这个名字对你来说有什么偶然的意义吗？ [“ fei cheng ” zhe ge ming zi dui ni lai shuo you shen me ou ran de yi yi ma ？]

english: That locket! Where did you get it?
translation: 那个挂坠盒！你从哪里得到的？ [na ge gua zhui he ！ ni cong na li de dao de ？]

english: I found it in a magical rift. Does it belong to you?
translation: 我在魔法裂缝中发现了它。它属于你吗？ [wo zai mo fa lie feng zhong fa xian le ta 。 ta shu yu ni ma ？]

english: Not exactly... It's a long and sad story.
translation: 不完全是……这是一个漫长而悲伤的故事。 [bu wan quan shi …… zhe shi yi ge man chang er bei shang de gu shi 。]

english: It's okay, I have time to listen.
translation: 没关系，我有时间听听。 [mei guan xi ， wo you shi jian ting ting 。]

english: Well, if you're sure then.
translation: 好吧，如果你确定的话。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni que ding de hua 。]

english: It all started in my youth when I was part of the Order of Wizards. I frequently spent time travelling across Gielinor, which kept me away from my beloved who worked here in Lumbridge.
translation: 这一切都始于我年轻时，当时我还是巫师团的一员。我经常花时间穿越吉利诺，这使我远离了在朗布里奇工作的挚爱。 [zhe yi qie dou shi yu wo nian qing shi ， dang shi wo hai shi wu shi tuan de yi yuan 。 wo jing chang hua shi jian chuan yue ji li nuo ， zhe shi wo yuan li le zai lang bu li qi gong zuo de zhi ai 。]

english: Due to being apart, I would often send her gifts. This locket was one of them.
translation: 因为分开，我经常给她送礼物。这个挂坠盒就是其中之一。 [yin wei fen kai ， wo jing chang gei ta song li wu 。 zhe ge gua zhui he jiu shi qi zhong zhi yi 。]

english: I see... I'm not sure I like where this story is going. How come I found the locket in a magic rift then?
translation: 我明白了……我不确定我喜欢这个故事的走向。那我怎么会在魔法裂缝中找到挂坠盒呢？ [wo ming bai le …… wo bu que ding wo xi huan zhe ge gu shi de zou xiang 。 na wo zen me hui zai mo fa lie feng zhong zhao dao gua zhui he ne ？]

english: As I said, my research often kept me away from home. During one of my trips away, our house was robbed. My dear Thenia tried to stop them, but they took her life in return. The locket was taken in the robbery.
translation: 正如我所说，我的研究经常让我远离家乡。在我一次外出旅行期间，我们的房子被抢劫了。我亲爱的塞尼娅试图阻止他们，但他们却夺走了她的生命。挂坠盒在抢劫中被夺走。 [zheng ru wo suo shuo ， wo de yan jiu jing chang rang wo yuan li jia xiang 。 zai wo yi ci wai chu lv xing qi jian ， wo men de fang zi bei qiang jie le 。 wo qin ai de sai ni ya shi tu zu zhi ta men ， dan ta men que duo zou le ta de sheng ming 。 gua zhui he zai qiang jie zhong bei duo zou 。]

english: Oh my... I'm so sorry for your loss.
translation: 哦天啊...我对你的损失感到非常抱歉。 [o tian a ... wo dui ni de sun shi gan dao fei chang bao qian 。]

english: I appreciate your kind words, but this was a long time ago. The pain of losing a loved one never fades, but in time you come to live with it.
translation: 我很感谢你的客气话，但那是很久以前的事了。失去亲人的痛苦永远不会消失，但随着时间的推移，你会接受它。 [wo hen gan xie ni de ke qi hua ， dan na shi hen jiu yi qian de shi le 。 shi qu qin ren de tong ku yong yuan bu hui xiao shi ， dan sui zhe shi jian de tui yi ， ni hui jie shou ta 。]

english: Anyway, after that I stepped down from the Order of Wizards. I now spend my days offering guidance to those who come through Lumbridge.
translation: 无论如何，在那之后我退出了巫师团。现在，我每天都在为那些来自朗布里奇的人提供指导。 [wu lun ru he ， zai na zhi hou wo tui chu le wu shi tuan 。 xian zai ， wo mei tian dou zai wei na xie lai zi lang bu li qi de ren ti gong zhi dao 。]

english: I'm still curious to know how it ended up in some rift. Do you have any theories?
translation: 我仍然很好奇它是如何导致裂痕的。你有什么理论吗？ [wo reng ran hen hao qi ta shi ru he dao zhi lie hen de 。 ni you shen me li lun ma ？]

english: Well... where was this rift?
translation: 嗯……这个裂痕在哪里？ [n …… zhe ge lie hen zai na li ？]

english: In an ancient temple. Most things in the rift came from the Abyss.
translation: 一座古老的寺庙内。裂缝中的大部分东西都来自深渊。 [yi zuo gu lao de si miao nei 。 lie feng zhong de da bu fen dong xi dou lai zi shen yuan 。]

english: The Abyss? I wasn't aware anyone had ever been to the Abyss.
translation: 深渊？我不知道有人去过深渊。 [shen yuan ？ wo bu zhi dao you ren qu guo shen yuan 。]

english: They hadn't until recently, but the Z.M.I. found a way there.
translation: 直到最近他们才这么做，但是 Z.M.I.在那里找到了一条路。 [zhi dao zui jin ta men cai zhe me zuo ， dan shi  Z.M.I. zai na li zhao dao le yi tiao lu 。]

english: The Z.M.I.? But could that mean...
translation: Z.M.I.？但这是否意味着... [Z.M.I.？ dan zhe shi fou yi wei zhe ...]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: Oh, nothing to worry about. Just me being a silly old man. Tell me more about this temple.
translation: 哦，没什么可担心的。就我一个傻老头。告诉我更多关于这座寺庙的信息。 [o ， mei shen me ke dan xin de 。 jiu wo yi ge sha lao tou 。 gao su wo geng duo guan yu zhe zuo si miao de xin xi 。]

english: It's called the Temple of the Eye. It was built by Saradominist wizards long ago to house a powerful artefact.
translation: 它被称为“眼殿”。它是很久以前由萨拉多明主义巫师建造的，用来存放一件强大的神器。 [ta bei cheng wei “ yan dian ”。 ta shi hen jiu yi qian you sa la duo ming zhu yi wu shi jian zao de ， yong lai cun fang yi jian qiang da de shen qi 。]

english: The Eye?
translation: 眼睛？ [yan jing ？]

english: You've heard of it?
translation: 你听说过吗？ [ni ting shuo guo ma ？]

english: Only stories, of which there are very few. Still, I always believed them to be real. After all, why else would an eye be the symbol of the Order of Wizards?
translation: 只是故事，而且数量很少。尽管如此，我始终相信它们是真实的。毕竟，为什么眼睛会成为巫师团的象征呢？ [zhi shi gu shi ， er qie shu liang hen shao 。 jin guan ru ci ， wo shi zhong xiang xin ta men shi zhen shi de 。 bi jing ， wei shen me yan jing hui cheng wei wu shi tuan de xiang zheng ne ？]

english: Ah, but that reminds me, I was not the first in my family to join the order. This amulet was passed down from generation to generation.
translation: 啊，不过这提醒了我，我并不是我们家族中第一个加入这个组织的。此护身符代代相传。 [a ， bu guo zhe ti xing le wo ， wo bing bu shi wo men jia zu zhong di yi ge jia ru zhe ge zu zhi de 。 ci hu shen fu dai dai xiang chuan 。]

english: That looks just like the amulet that led us to the temple!
translation: 这看起来就像带我们去寺庙的护身符一样！ [zhe kan qi lai jiu xiang dai wo men qu si miao de hu shen fu yi yang ！]

english: As soon as you mentioned it, I wondered if there might be a connection.
translation: 你一提到这件事，我就想知道这之间是否有联系。 [ni yi ti dao zhe jian shi ， wo jiu xiang zhi dao zhe zhi jian shi fou you lian xi 。]

english: The origin of this amulet was something I spent much time puzzling over when I was younger. I'm glad you have answered the question I couldn't.
translation: 这个护身符的来历是我年轻时花了很多时间思考的问题。我很高兴你回答了我无法回答的问题。 [zhe ge hu shen fu de lai li shi wo nian qing shi hua le hen duo shi jian si kao de wen ti 。 wo hen gao xing ni hui da le wo wu fa hui da de wen ti 。]

english: I'd be happy to give you this amulet in return for that locket. I have no use for it, but that locket is something which holds a lot of sentimental value to me.
translation: 我很乐意给你这个护身符来换取那个挂坠盒。我没有用它，但那个挂坠盒对我来说有很多情感价值。 [wo hen le yi gei ni zhe ge hu shen fu lai huan qu na ge gua zhui he 。 wo mei you yong ta ， dan na ge gua zhui he dui wo lai shuo you hen duo qing gan jia zhi 。]

english: Of course you can have the locket.
translation: 当然，你可以拥有挂坠盒。 [dang ran ， ni ke yi yong you gua zhui he 。]

english: Thank you for returning this to me. I wish you the best of luck on the rest of your adventures.
translation: 谢谢你把这个还给我。祝您在接下来的冒险中一切顺利。 [xie xie ni ba zhe ge huan gei wo 。 zhu nin zai jie xia lai de mao xian zhong yi qie shun li 。]

english: Thanks, Phileas. I wish you luck also.
translation: 谢谢，菲利斯。我也祝你好运。 [xie xie ， fei li si 。 wo ye zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Oh, I see. I guess I can't really force you to hand it over. The offer still stands if you ever change your mind.
translation: 我懂了。我想我真的不能强迫你交出它。如果您改变主意，此优惠仍然有效。 [wo dong le 。 wo xiang wo zhen de bu neng qiang po ni jiao chu ta 。 ru guo nin gai bian zhu yi ， ci you hui reng ran you xiao 。]

english: Never mind then. I have to go.
translation: 那就别介意了。我得走了。 [na jiu bie jie yi le 。 wo de zou le 。]

english: You're back. Would you consider giving me that locket? It holds a lot of sentimental value to me. I'll give you that amulet in return.
translation: 你回来了。你能考虑把那个挂坠盒给我吗？它对我来说具有很大的情感价值。作为回报，我会把那个护身符还给你。 [ni hui lai le 。 ni neng kao lv ba na ge gua zhui he gei wo ma ？ ta dui wo lai shuo ju you hen da de qing gan jia zhi 。 zuo wei hui bao ， wo hui ba na ge hu shen fu huan gei ni 。]

english: Ask about the Amulet of the Eye
translation: 询问关于眼睛护身符的问题 [xun wen guan yu yan jing hu shen fu de wen ti]

english: Something else
translation: 其他的东西 [qi ta de dong xi]

english: Where can I find a quest to go on?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到继续进行的任务？ [wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao ji xu jin xing de ren wu ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: I want another quest.
translation: 我想要另一个任务。 [wo xiang yao ling yi ge ren wu 。]

english: What monsters should I fight?
translation: 我应该对抗什么怪物？ [wo ying gai dui kang shen me guai wu ？]

english: How can I get a weapon?
translation: 我怎样才能获得武器？ [wo zen yang cai neng huo de wu qi ？]

english: Where can I find a weapon?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到武器？ [wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao wu qi ？]

english: I'd like to know more about getting weapons.
translation: 我想了解更多关于获取武器的信息。 [wo xiang liao jie geng duo guan yu huo qu wu qi de xin xi 。]

english: I’d like to know about something else.
translation: 我想了解其他事情。 [wo xiang liao jie qi ta shi qing 。]

english: How do I make a weapon?
translation: 我该如何制作武器？ [wo gai ru he zhi zuo wu qi ？]

english: Where can I buy a weapon?
translation: 哪里可以买到武器？ [na li ke yi mai dao wu qi ？]

english: Could I get a staff like yours?
translation: 我可以找一个像你这样的员工吗？ [wo ke yi zhao yi ge xiang ni zhe yang de yuan gong ma ？]

english: Yes, but what should I fight once I have got a weapon?
translation: 是的，但是有了武器之后我该怎么打呢？ [shi de ， dan shi you le wu qi zhi hou wo gai zen me da ne ？]

english: Where can I get food to heal myself?
translation: 我在哪里可以获得食物来治愈自己？ [wo zai na li ke yi huo de shi wu lai zhi yu zi ji ？]

english: How do I get cabbages?

translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello I'm Luthas, I run the banana plantation here.
translation: 大家好，我是 Luthas，我在这里经营香蕉种植园。 [da jia hao ， wo shi  Luthas， wo zai zhe li jing ying xiang jiao zhong zhi yuan 。]

english: Could you offer me employment on your plantation?
translation: 你能为我提供在你的种植园工作的机会吗？ [ni neng wei wo ti gong zai ni de zhong zhi yuan gong zuo de ji hui ma ？]

english: Yes, I can sort something out. There's a crate ready to be loaded onto the ship.
translation: 是的，我可以解决一些问题。有一个板条箱准备装上船。 [shi de ， wo ke yi jie jue yi xie wen ti 。 you yi ge ban tiao xiang zhun bei zhuang shang chuan 。]

english: You wouldn't believe the demand for bananas from Wydin's shop over in Port Sarim. I think this is the third crate I've shipped him this month..
translation: 您无法相信沙里姆港 Wydin 商店对香蕉的需求量。我想这是我这个月给他寄的第三个箱子了。 [nin wu fa xiang xin sha li mu gang  Wydin  shang dian dui xiang jiao de xu qiu liang 。 wo xiang zhe shi wo zhe ge yue gei ta ji de di san ge xiang zi le 。]

english: If you could fill it up with bananas, I'll pay you 30 gold.
translation: 如果你能装满香蕉，我就付给你 30 金币。 [ru guo ni neng zhuang man xiang jiao ， wo jiu fu gei ni  30  jin bi 。]

english: That customs officer is annoying isn't she?
translation: 那个海关官员很烦人吧？ [na ge hai guan guan yuan hen fan ren ba ？]

english: Well I know her pretty well. She doesn't cause me any trouble any more.
translation: 嗯，我很了解她。她不会再给我带来任何麻烦了。 [n ， wo hen liao jie ta 。 ta bu hui zai gei wo dai lai ren he ma fan le 。]

english: She doesn't even search my export crates any more. She knows they only contain bananas.
translation: 她甚至不再搜查我的出口板条箱。她知道它们只含有香蕉。 [ta shen zhi bu zai sou cha wo de chu kou ban tiao xiang 。 ta zhi dao ta men zhi han you xiang jiao 。]

english: Really? How interesting. Whereabouts do you send those to?
translation: 真的吗？多么有趣啊。您将这些发送到哪里？ [zhen de ma ？ duo me you qu a 。 nin jiang zhe xie fa song dao na li ？]

english: There is a little shop over in Port Sarim that buys them up by the crate. I believe it is run by a man called Wydin.
translation: 沙里姆港有一家小商店，按箱购买它们。我相信它是由一个叫 Wydin 的人经营的。 [sha li mu gang you yi jia xiao shang dian ， an xiang gou mai ta men 。 wo xiang xin ta shi you yi ge jiao  Wydin  de ren jing ying de 。]

english: Have you completed your task yet?
translation: 你完成你的任务了吗？ [ni wan cheng ni de ren wu le ma ？]

english: What did I have to do again?
translation: 我还需要做什么？ [wo hai xu yao zuo shen me ？]

english: There's a crate ready to be loaded onto the ship. If you could fill it up with bananas, I'll pay you 30 gold.
translation: 有一个板条箱准备装上船。如果你能装满香蕉，我就付给你 30 金币。 [you yi ge ban tiao xiang zhun bei zhuang shang chuan 。 ru guo ni neng zhuang man xiang jiao ， wo jiu fu gei ni  30  jin bi 。]

english: No, the crate isn't full yet...
translation: 不，箱子还没满…… [bu ， xiang zi hai mei man ……]

english: Well come back when it is.
translation: 好吧，到时候就回来吧。 [hao ba ， dao shi hou jiu hui lai ba 。]

english: So where are these bananas going to be delivered to?
translation: 那么这些香蕉要运到哪里呢？ [na me zhe xie xiang jiao yao yun dao na li ne ？]

english: I sell them to Wydin who runs a grocery store in Port Sarim.
translation: 我把它们卖给了威丁，他在沙里姆港经营一家杂货店。 [wo ba ta men mai gei le wei ding ， ta zai sha li mu gang jing ying yi jia za huo dian 。]

english: I've filled a crate with bananas.
translation: 我已经把香蕉装满了一个箱子。 [wo yi jing ba xiang jiao zhuang man le yi ge xiang zi 。]

english: Well done, here's your payment.
translation: 干得好，这是您的付款。 [gan de hao ， zhe shi nin de fu kuan 。]

english: Will you pay me for another crate full?
translation: 你愿意付钱给我再买一个装满的箱子吗？ [ni yuan yi fu qian gei wo zai mai yi ge zhuang man de xiang zi ma ？]

english: Yes certainly.
translation: 是的，当然。 [shi de ， dang ran 。]

english: If you go outside you should see the old crate has been loaded on to the ship, and there is another empty crate in its place.
translation: 如果你走到外面，你应该会看到旧板条箱已经被装上船，并且在它的位置上还有另一个空板条箱。 [ru guo ni zou dao wai mian ， ni ying gai hui kan dao jiu ban tiao xiang yi jing bei zhuang shang chuan ， bing qie zai ta de wei zhi shang hai you ling yi ge kong ban tiao xiang 。]

english: Thank you, I'll be on my way.
translation: 谢谢你，我这就上路了。 [xie xie ni ， wo zhe jiu shang lu le 。]

english: Congratulations.
translation: 恭喜。 [gong xi 。]

english: Could you offer me employment on your plantation?
translation: 你能为我提供在你的种植园工作的机会吗？ [ni neng wei wo ti gong zai ni de zhong zhi yuan gong zuo de ji hui ma ？]

english: That customs officer is annoying isn't she?
translation: 那个海关官员很烦人吧？ [na ge hai guan guan yuan hen fan ren ba ？]

english: What did I have to do again?
translation: 我还需要做什么？ [wo hai xu yao zuo shen me ？]

english: No, the crate isn't full yet.
translation: 不，箱子还没有满。 [bu ， xiang zi hai mei you man 。]

english: So where are these bananas going to be delivered to?
translation: 那么这些香蕉要运到哪里呢？ [na me zhe xie xiang jiao yao yun dao na li ne ？]

english: Will you pay me for another crate full?
translation: 你愿意付钱给我再买一个装满的箱子吗？ [ni yuan yi fu qian gei wo zai mai yi ge zhuang man de xiang zi ma ？]

english: Thank you, I'll be on my way
translation: 谢谢你，我会上路的 [xie xie ni ， wo hui shang lu de]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Greetings.
translation: 问候。 [wen hou 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Well, friend, I'm Arls Lutwidge of the Moonlight Broadsword! Renowned all over Gielinor!
translation: 好吧，朋友，我是月光大剑的阿尔斯·路特维奇！闻名全吉林诺！ [hao ba ， peng you ， wo shi yue guang da jian de a er si · lu te wei qi ！ wen ming quan ji lin nuo ！]

english: Can't say I've heard of you before.
translation: 我不能说我以前听说过你。 [wo bu neng shuo wo yi qian ting shuo guo ni 。]

english: You haven't... heard of... That's madness!
translation: 你还没……听说过……那太疯狂了！ [ni hai mei …… ting shuo guo …… na tai feng kuang le ！]

english: Surely you've heard of my feats, but perhaps not the name?
translation: 你肯定听说过我的事迹，但也许没有听说过我的名字？ [ni ken ding ting shuo guo wo de shi ji ， dan ye xu mei you ting shuo guo wo de ming zi ？]

english: Perhaps.
translation: 也许。 [ye xu 。]

english: And yourself?
translation: 而你自己呢？ [er ni zi ji ne ？]

english: An adventurer mostly, but I've slain some dragons and I've conquered some nightmares.
translation: 主要是一个冒险家，但我已经杀死了一些龙并且征服了一些噩梦。 [zhu yao shi yi ge mao xian jia ， dan wo yi jing sha si le yi xie long bing qie zheng fu le yi xie e meng 。]

english: Very good, young one! Very good indeed!
translation: 非常好，年轻人！确实非常好！ [fei chang hao ， nian qing ren ！ que shi fei chang hao ！]

english: So... where's this famous sword of yours?
translation: 那么……你的这把名剑呢？ [na me …… ni de zhe ba ming jian ne ？]

english: Gone. I gave it to a fledgling when I retired and the damned fool went and died fighting some great monster in a far off land.
translation: 走了。当我退休时，我把它给了一个羽翼未丰的人，而那个该死的傻瓜却在遥远的土地上与一些巨大的怪物战斗而死。 [zou le 。 dang wo tui xiu shi ， wo ba ta gei le yi ge yu yi wei feng de ren ， er na ge gai si de sha gua que zai yao yuan de tu di shang yu yi xie ju da de guai wu zhan dou er si 。]

english: Say... if you find it, could you bring it to me? I won't pay you, as holding such a magnificent weapon should be payment enough.
translation: 比如说……如果你找到了，能带给我吗？我不会付钱给你，因为拥有如此华丽的武器就足够付钱了。 [bi ru shuo …… ru guo ni zhao dao le ， neng dai gei wo ma ？ wo bu hui fu qian gei ni ， yin wei yong you ru ci hua li de wu qi jiu zu gou fu qian le 。]

english: I think you need to work on your bartering skills.
translation: 我认为你需要锻炼你的易货技巧。 [wo ren wei ni xu yao duan lian ni de yi huo ji qiao 。]

english: Perhaps.
translation: 也许。 [ye xu 。]

english: What grand feats are you known for?
translation: 您因哪些伟大事迹而闻名？ [nin yin na xie wei da shi ji er wen ming ？]

english: I peaked rather early and most know me for my first act of heroism when I defeated the Moonfly. It may sound cute, but it killed many of the smallfolk and their livestock, for it was a vile creature.
translation: 我很早就达到了顶峰，大多数人都知道我是因为我击败月蝇时的第一次英雄行为。它听起来可能很可爱，但它杀死了许多平民和他们的牲畜，因为它是一种邪恶的生物。 [wo hen zao jiu da dao le ding feng ， da duo shu ren dou zhi dao wo shi yin wei wo ji bai yue ying shi de di yi ci ying xiong xing wei 。 ta ting qi lai ke neng hen ke ai ， dan ta sha si le xu duo ping min he ta men de sheng chu ， yin wei ta shi yi zhong xie e de sheng wu 。]

english: Where'd it come from?
translation: 它从哪里来？ [ta cong na li lai ？]

english: It was I that discovered the creature. I pulled it from the Lum during a fishing trip of mine.
translation: 是我发现了这个生物。我在一次钓鱼之旅中从 Lum 拉了它。 [shi wo fa xian le zhe ge sheng wu 。 wo zai yi ci diao yu zhi lv zhong cong  Lum  la le ta 。]

english: As young and foolish as I was, I dropped it down a dried up well and went for help. However, upon my return, the creature was gone.
translation: 尽管我年轻又愚蠢，我还是把它扔进了一口干涸的井里，然后去寻求帮助。然而，当我回来时，那个生物却消失了。 [jin guan wo nian qing you yu chun ， wo hai shi ba ta reng jin le yi kou gan he de jing li ， ran hou qu xun qiu bang zhu 。 ran er ， dang wo hui lai shi ， na ge sheng wu que xiao shi le 。]

english: And then what happened?
translation: 然后发生了什么？ [ran hou fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: Many years passed until suddenly there were sightings of a winged demon around the River Lum. Some claimed it was an overly large heron and that it was nothing to be worried about.
translation: 许多年过去了，直到人们突然在卢姆河附近目击到一只长着翅膀的恶魔。一些人声称这是一只太大的苍鹭，没有什么可担心的。 [xu duo nian guo qu le ， zhi dao ren men tu ran zai lu mu he fu jin mu ji dao yi zhi zhang zhe chi bang de e mo 。 yi xie ren sheng cheng zhe shi yi zhi tai da de cang lu ， mei you shen me ke dan xin de 。]

english: As time went on, folk started to go missing and I knew I had to return home and face this demon.
translation: 随着时间的推移，人们开始失踪，我知道我必须回家面对这个恶魔。 [sui zhe shi jian de tui yi ， ren men kai shi shi zong ， wo zhi dao wo bi xu hui jia mian dui zhe ge e mo 。]

english: You left?
translation: 你走了吗？ [ni zou le ma ？]

english: I had wars to fight, glory to be won and all that rubbish. Upon my return I spoke to an old crone who lived in the swamps and she gave me some advice.
translation: 我有战争要打，有荣耀要赢得，还有所有这些垃圾。回来后，我与一位住在沼泽地的老太婆交谈，她给了我一些建议。 [wo you zhan zheng yao da ， you rong yao yao ying de ， hai you suo you zhe xie la ji 。 hui lai hou ， wo yu yi wei zhu zai zhao ze di de lao tai po jiao tan ， ta gei le wo yi xie jian yi 。]

english: She told me to spike my armour and described how to lure the creature toward me.
translation: 她让我钉住我的盔甲，并描述了如何引诱这个生物靠近我。 [ta rang wo ding zhu wo de kui jia ， bing miao shu le ru he yin you zhe ge sheng wu kao jin wo 。]

english: And you defeated it? The Moonfly?
translation: 而你打败了它？月蝇？ [er ni da bai le ta ？ yue ying ？]

english: Some bard wrote a poem of the events. The telling of the battle is a little embellished and rife with errors. The poem can be found in this library somewhere, providing it has been returned.
translation: 一些吟游诗人为这些事件写了一首诗。这场战斗的叙述有些修饰，而且充满了错误。这首诗可以在这个图书馆的某个地方找到，只要它已经归还。 [yi xie yin you shi ren wei zhe xie shi jian xie le yi shou shi 。 zhe chang zhan dou de xu shu you xie xiu shi ， er qie chong man le cuo wu 。 zhe shou shi ke yi zai zhe ge tu shu guan de mou ge di fang zhao dao ， zhi yao ta yi jing gui huan 。]

english: And did I defeat the creature? I wouldn't be here if I hadn't!
translation: 我打败了那个生物吗？如果我没有的话我就不会在这里！ [wo da bai le na ge sheng wu ma ？ ru guo wo mei you de hua wo jiu bu hui zai zhe li ！]

english: I'll be sure to keep an eye out.
translation: 我一定会留意的。 [wo yi ding hui liu yi de 。]

english: Please do! And come to me if you have any burning questions about it.
translation: 请这样做！如果您对此有任何紧迫的问题，请来找我。 [qing zhe yang zuo ！ ru guo nin dui ci you ren he jin po de wen ti ， qing lai zhao wo 。]

english: Sure thing.
translation: 当然可以。 [dang ran ke yi 。]

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？ [ni wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: I've grown old, friend. Heroes need to know when to throw in the towel, so they say. I've always enjoyed a good book, so it seemed fitting to stay here as librarian for the guild.
translation: 我已经老了，朋友。他们说，英雄需要知道何时认输。我一直很喜欢一本好书，所以留在这里担任公会的图书管理员似乎很合适。 [wo yi jing lao le ， peng you 。 ta men shuo ， ying xiong xu yao zhi dao he shi ren shu 。 wo yi zhi hen xi huan yi ben hao shu ， suo yi liu zai zhe li dan ren gong hui de tu shu guan li yuan si hu hen he shi 。]

english: Hmm... the books are very interesting. I thought there would be more though...
translation: 嗯……这些书很有趣。我以为还会有更多... [n …… zhe xie shu hen you qu 。 wo yi wei hai hui you geng duo ...]

english: Well, that's why I'm here! So many of you adventurers help yourself to any old book and never return the damn things!
translation: 嗯，这就是我来这里的原因！你们中的许多冒险家随便拿了一本旧书，却从不归还那些该死的东西！ [n ， zhe jiu shi wo lai zhe li de yuan yin ！ ni men zhong de xu duo mao xian jia sui bian na le yi ben jiu shu ， que cong bu gui huan na xie gai si de dong xi ！]

english: If I could have it my way, you wouldn't be allowed to wander off with them, but I'm not the guildmaster, as Alec likes to remind me.
translation: 如果我能按照自己的方式行事，就不会允许你和他们一起流浪，但正如亚历克喜欢提醒我的那样，我不是公会会长。 [ru guo wo neng an zhao zi ji de fang shi xing shi ， jiu bu hui yun xu ni he ta men yi qi liu lang ， dan zheng ru ya li ke xi huan ti xing wo de na yang ， wo bu shi gong hui hui zhang 。]

english: Certainly sounds like you have a problem.
translation: 当然听起来你有问题。 [dang ran ting qi lai ni you wen ti 。]

english: Well fear not. I'm working on it!
translation: 好吧，不用担心。我正在努力！ [hao ba ， bu yong dan xin 。 wo zheng zai nu li ！]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: I'll see you around.
translation: 我会再见的。 [wo hui zai jian de 。]

english: Yes! Fantastic! Did you enjoy it?
translation: 是的！极好的！你喜欢吗？ [shi de ！ ji hao de ！ ni xi huan ma ？]

english: Yeah it was alright. Some of these words are a bit odd though. Did you really cover your sword in sheep blood?
translation: 是的，没关系。不过，其中有些词有点奇怪。你的剑真的沾满了羊血吗？ [shi de ， mei guan xi 。 bu guo ， qi zhong you xie ci you dian qi guai 。 ni de jian zhen de zhan man le yang xue ma ？]

english: Ah, a slight misunderstanding... I soaked it in sap from a yew tree, but I guess blood is a bit more dramatic.
translation: 啊，有点误会……我把它浸泡在紫杉树的汁液里，但我猜血更戏剧化一点。 [a ， you dian wu hui …… wo ba ta jin pao zai zi shan shu de zhi ye li ， dan wo cai xue geng xi ju hua yi dian 。]

english: Why?
translation: 为什么？ [wei shen me ？]

english: The crone, long dead now, I suppose... She claimed to be from the same world as the creature and knew of the ritual to summon it.
translation: 我想那个老太婆现在已经死了很久了……她声称自己与这个生物来自同一个世界，并且知道召唤它的仪式。 [wo xiang na ge lao tai po xian zai yi jing si le hen jiu le …… ta sheng cheng zi ji yu zhe ge sheng wu lai zi tong yi ge shi jie ， bing qie zhi dao zhao huan ta de yi shi 。]

english: The poem does mention sheep though, at the end?
translation: 这首诗最后确实提到了羊？ [zhe shou shi zui hou que shi ti dao le yang ？]

english: Perhaps some locals claimed to have lost some sheep, but my guess is that the bard was searching for a rhyme. Either way, I doubt it's a detail worth fretting over.
translation: 也许一些当地人声称失去了一些羊，但我猜测吟游诗人正在寻找押韵。不管怎样，我怀疑这是一个值得担心的细节。 [ye xu yi xie dang di ren sheng cheng shi qu le yi xie yang ， dan wo cai ce yin you shi ren zheng zai xun zhao ya yun 。 bu guan zen yang ， wo huai yi zhe shi yi ge zhi de dan xin de xi jie 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: What grand feats are you known for?
translation: 您因哪些伟大事迹而闻名？ [nin yin na xie wei da shi ji er wen ming ？]

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？ [ni wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: The man glances at you and grunts something unintelligible.
translation: 男人看了你一眼，咕哝了一些听不懂的话。 [nan ren kan le ni yi yan ， gu nong le yi xie ting bu dong de hua 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Mac. What's it to you?
translation: 苹果。关你什么事？ [ping guo 。 guan ni shen me shi ？]

english: Only trying to be friendly.
translation: 只是试图表现得友好。 [zhi shi shi tu biao xian de you hao 。]

english: What do you have in your sack?
translation: 你的袋子里有什么？ [ni de dai zi li you shen me ？]

english: None of yer bis'ness.
translation: 没有你的本事。 [mei you ni de ben shi 。]

english: How rude! I was only being curious.
translation: 多么粗鲁啊！我只是好奇而已。 [duo me cu lu a ！ wo zhi shi hao qi er yi 。]

english: S'me cape.
translation: 是我的斗篷。 [shi wo de dou peng 。]

english: Your cape?
translation: 你的斗篷？ [ni de dou peng ？]

english: What does your cape do?
translation: 你的斗篷有什么作用？ [ni de dou peng you shen me zuo yong ？]

english: All the things other skillcapes do.
translation: 其他技能可以做的所有事情。 [qi ta ji neng ke yi zuo de suo you shi qing 。]

english: Can you tell me what they are?
translation: 你能告诉我它们是什么吗？ [ni neng gao su wo ta men shi shen me ma ？]

english: Fine... Ajjat gave me unlimited teleports to his Warrior's guild and Kamfreena lets me fight her Cyclopes without needing those annoying tokens.
translation: 好吧... Ajjat 给了我无限传送到他的战士公会的能力，而 Kamfreena 让我可以与她的独眼巨人战斗，而不需要那些烦人的令牌。 [hao ba ... Ajjat  gei le wo wu xian chuan song dao ta de zhan shi gong hui de neng li ， er  Kamfreena  rang wo ke yi yu ta de du yan ju ren zhan dou ， er bu xu yao na xie fan ren de ling pai 。]

english: Melee combat tutor added a ring of life function and the armour salesman at the Ranging guild added a magnet and undead chicken thing.
translation: 近战导师增加了生命之环功能，游骑兵公会的盔甲推销员增加了磁铁和不死鸡的东西。 [jin zhan dao shi zeng jia le sheng ming zhi huan gong neng ， you qi bing gong hui de kui jia tui xiao yuan zeng jia le ci tie he bu si ji de dong xi 。]

english: Brother Jered attached a holy wrench and Wizard Sinina enchanted the cape so I can change me spellbook.
translation: 杰里德兄弟附上了一把神圣的扳手，巫师西尼娜对斗篷施了魔法，这样我就可以改变我的咒语书。 [jie li de xiong di fu shang le yi ba shen sheng de ban shou ， wu shi xi ni na dui dou peng shi le mo fa ， zhe yang wo jiu ke yi gai bian wo de zhou yu shu 。]

english: Aubury attached all of the runecrafting tiaras, an estate agent sold me some teleports and one of the nurses at the Emir's Arena made it give me faster hitpoints.
translation: 奥伯里附上了所有的符文制作头饰，一位房地产经纪人向我出售了一些传送装置，埃米尔竞技场的一位护士让我获得了更快的生命值。 [ao bo li fu shang le suo you de fu wen zhi zuo tou shi ， yi wei fang di chan jing ji ren xiang wo chu shou le yi xie chuan song zhuang zhi ， ai mi er jing ji chang de yi wei hu shi rang wo huo de le geng kuai de sheng ming zhi 。]

english: Agility Arena guy with a Parrot pet made it lighter for me and Kaqemeex convinced the Nardah herbalist to make potions for me if I wear it and he attached a pestle and mortar, toos.
translation: Agility Arena 的家伙养了一只鹦鹉宠物，让我觉得它更轻，Kaqemeex 说服了 Nardah 草药师，如果我戴上它，他就会为我配制药剂，他还附上了杵和研钵。 [Agility Arena  de jia huo yang le yi zhi ying wu chong wu ， rang wo jue de ta geng qing ，Kaqemeex  shuo fu le  Nardah  cao yao shi ， ru guo wo dai shang ta ， ta jiu hui wei wo pei zhi yao ji ， ta hai fu shang le chu he yan bo 。]

english: Martin Thwait made the cape better for being sneaky and the Master Crafter added a teleport to his guild before Hickton attached some grapples and a crossbow.
translation: 马丁·思韦特（Martin Thwait）使斗篷变得更加狡猾，在希克顿（Hickton）安装了一些抓斗和十字弓之前，工匠大师为他的公会添加了传送功能。 [ma ding · si wei te （Martin Thwait） shi dou peng bian de geng jia jiao hua ， zai xi ke dun （Hickton） an zhuang le yi xie zhua dou he shi zi gong zhi qian ， gong jiang da shi wei ta de gong hui tian jia le chuan song gong neng 。]

english: Duradel convinced all Slayer masters to give me a chance at repeating an assignment and the Hunting Expert added some useful teleports, too.
translation: 杜拉德尔说服所有杀手大师给我一个重复任务的机会，狩猎专家也添加了一些有用的传送。 [du la de er shuo fu suo you sha shou da shi gei wo yi ge chong fu ren wu de ji hui ， shou lie zhuan jia ye tian jia le yi xie you yong de chuan song 。]

english: A dwarf gave it a chance to give me extra ores and another dwarf made it give more experience when making gold bars and the Master Chef stopped it from burning any food.
translation: 一个矮人给了它一个给我额外矿石的机会，另一个矮人让它在制作金条时提供了更多经验，主厨阻止了它燃烧任何食物。 [yi ge ai ren gei le ta yi ge gei wo e wai kuang shi de ji hui ， ling yi ge ai ren rang ta zai zhi zuo jin tiao shi ti gong le geng duo jing yan ， zhu chu zu zhi le ta ran shao ren he shi wu 。]

english: Ignatius Vulcan added a torch for lighting up caves and the Woodcutting tutor made it easier to find bird's nests and Martin the Master Farmer made it yield more herbs.
translation: 伊格纳修斯·瓦肯 (Ignatius Vulcan) 添加了火把来照亮洞穴，伐木导师让寻找燕窝变得更加容易，农夫大师马丁 (Martin) 让它产出更多草药。 [yi ge na xiu si · wa ken  (Ignatius Vulcan)  tian jia le huo ba lai zhao liang dong xue ， fa mu dao shi rang xun zhao yan wo bian de geng jia rong yi ， nong fu da shi ma ding  (Martin)  rang ta chan chu geng duo cao yao 。]

english: So yeah all of that.
translation: 是的，所有这些。 [shi de ， suo you zhe xie 。]

english: Can I have it?
translation: 我可以拥有吗？ [wo ke yi yong you ma ？]

english: Nah. Not got space.
translation: 不。没有空间。 [bu 。 mei you kong jian 。]

english: Mebe.
translation: 梅贝。 [mei bei 。]

english: I'm sure I could make it worth your while.
translation: 我相信我能让你的时间值得。 [wo xiang xin wo neng rang ni de shi jian zhi de 。]

english: How much?
translation: 多少？ [duo shao ？]

english: How about [amount of coins in inventory] gold?
translation: [库存中的硬币数量]金币怎么样？ [[ ku cun zhong de ying bi shu liang ] jin bi zen me yang ？]

english: S'not enuff.
translation: 还不够。 [hai bu gou 。]

english: How about 2277000 gold?
translation: 2277000金币怎么样？ [2277000 jin bi zen me yang ？]

english: Hello?
translation: 你好？ [ni hao ？]

english: Huh, who's there?
translation: 呃，谁在那儿？ [e ， shui zai na er ？]

english: It's Dionysius here. I'm using my magic to communicate to you. Don't worry.
translation: 这里是狄奥尼修斯。我正在用我的魔法与你交流。不用担心。 [zhe li shi di ao ni xiu si 。 wo zheng zai yong wo de mo fa yu ni jiao liu 。 bu yong dan xin 。]

english: What are you doing in my head?
translation: 你在我脑子里做什么？ [ni zai wo nao zi li zuo shen me ？]

english: I just wanted to say congratulations [player name]. I've been watching you in your adventures - very well done.
translation: 我只是想说恭喜[玩家姓名]。我一直在观察你的冒险经历——干得很好。 [wo zhi shi xiang shuo gong xi [ wan jia xing ming ]。 wo yi zhi zai guan cha ni de mao xian jing li —— gan de hen hao 。]

english: Oh very well done [player name]. Taken you a while, but I knew you could do it.
translation: 哦，做得很好[玩家姓名]。花了你一段时间，但我知道你能做到。 [o ， zuo de hen hao [ wan jia xing ming ]。 hua le ni yi duan shi jian ， dan wo zhi dao ni neng zuo dao 。]

english: Ahhh [player name], I knew you had potential when I first met you. My compliments on reaching the pinnacle of your achievements.
translation: 啊啊[玩家名字]，我第一次见到你的时候就知道你有潜力。我对您达到成就的顶峰表示祝贺。 [a a [ wan jia ming zi ]， wo di yi ci jian dao ni de shi hou jiu zhi dao ni you qian li 。 wo dui nin da dao cheng jiu de ding feng biao shi zhu he 。]

english: Meow!
translation: 喵！ [miao ！]

english: Oh most excellently done old chap!
translation: 噢，干得最出色的老家伙！ [o ， gan de zui chu se de lao jia huo ！]

english: Why do you keep it in a sack?
translation: 你为什么把它放在袋子里？ [ni wei shen me ba ta fang zai dai zi li ？]

english: Get it dirty.
translation: 把它弄脏。 [ba ta nong zang 。]

english: Why are you so dirty?
translation: 你为什么这么脏？ [ni wei shen me zhe me zang ？]

english: Bath XP waste.
translation: 洗澡XP浪费。 [xi zao XP lang fei 。]

english: Bye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Yip. Show me the goods. I pay 80%.
translation: 是的。给我看看货物。我付80%。 [shi de 。 gei wo kan kan huo wu 。 wo fu 80%。]

english: Nah. Need more space.
translation: 不。需要更多空间。 [bu 。 xu yao geng duo kong jian 。]

english: Yip. No cost. What cape do you want a hood for?
translation: 是的。没有成本。您想要什么斗篷？ [shi de 。 mei you cheng ben 。 nin xiang yao shen me dou peng ？]

english: You don't have that cape. Choose another.
translation: 你没有那件斗篷。选择另一个。 [ni mei you na jian dou peng 。 xuan ze ling yi ge 。]

english: Mac hands you another hood for your cape.
translation: 麦克给了你另一顶斗篷兜帽。 [mai ke gei le ni ling yi ding dou peng dou mao 。]

english: Show cape.
translation: 显示斗篷。 [xian shi dou peng 。]

english: That's XP waste.
translation: 那是 XP 浪费。 [na shi  XP  lang fei 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: What do you have in your sack?
translation: 你的袋子里有什么？ [ni de dai zi li you shen me ？]
