english: What does your cape do?
translation: 你的斗篷有什么作用？ [ni de dou peng you shen me zuo yong ？]

english: Can you tell me what they are?
translation: 你能告诉我它们是什么吗？ [ni neng gao su wo ta men shi shen me ma ？]

english: Can I have it?
translation: 我可以拥有吗？ [wo ke yi yong you ma ？]

english: Why do you keep it in a sack?
translation: 你为什么把它放在袋子里？ [ni wei shen me ba ta fang zai dai zi li ？]

english: Yes, pay the man.
translation: 是的，付钱给男人。 [shi de ， fu qian gei nan ren 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Why are you so dirty?
translation: 你为什么这么脏？ [ni wei shen me zhe me zang ？]

english: Bye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Can I sell my max cape back to you?
translation: 我可以把我的最大斗篷卖回给你吗？ [wo ke yi ba wo de zui da dou peng mai hui gei ni ma ？]

english: Yes - receive 1,821,600gp.
translation: 是的 - 收到 1,821,600gp。 [shi de  -  shou dao  1,821,600gp。]

english: No, I've changed my mind.
translation: 不，我改变主意了。 [bu ， wo gai bian zhu yi le 。]

english: Can I have another hood for my cape?
translation: 我可以为我的斗篷再买一个兜帽吗？ [wo ke yi wei wo de dou peng zai mai yi ge dou mao ma ？]

english: Hey there! Do you have a grapple I can borrow?
translation: 嘿！你有抓斗我可以借用吗？ [hei ！ ni you zhua dou wo ke yi jie yong ma ？]

english: I might have one, but I need it myself. Why do you need a grapple?
translation: 我可能有一个，但我自己也需要它。为什么需要抓斗？ [wo ke neng you yi ge ， dan wo zi ji ye xu yao ta 。 wei shen me xu yao zhua dou ？]

english: I need it to grapple to that pillar over there and get some treasure of course. What else could I need it for?
translation: 我需要它来抓住那边的柱子并获得一些宝藏。我还需要它做什么？ [wo xu yao ta lai zhua zhu na bian de zhu zi bing huo de yi xie bao zang 。 wo hai xu yao ta zuo shen me ？]

english: I mean that makes sense I suppose. How did you end up here?
translation: I mean that makes sense I suppose.你怎么到这里来了？ [I mean that makes sense I suppose. ni zen me dao zhe li lai le ？]

english: Well, I made my way to Morytania in search of a place called the Ba... Barlows? I've heard it's a great way to earn gold.
translation: 好吧，我前往莫里塔尼亚寻找一个叫巴……巴洛斯的地方？我听说这是赚取金币的好方法。 [hao ba ， wo qian wang mo li ta ni ya xun zhao yi ge jiao ba …… ba luo si de di fang ？ wo ting shuo zhe shi zhuan qu jin bi de hao fang fa 。]

english: Barrows.
translation: 巴罗斯。 [ba luo si 。]

english: Yeah, that's what I said!
translation: 是的，我就是这么说的！ [shi de ， wo jiu shi zhe me shuo de ！]

english: Anyways, I got lost on the way here and was abducted by some vampyres! However, I'm so sneaky I managed to escape and find this place.
translation: 反正我在来这里的路上迷路了，还被吸血鬼绑架了！然而，我太狡猾了，我设法逃脱并找到了这个地方。 [fan zheng wo zai lai zhe li de lu shang mi lu le ， hai bei xi xue gui bang jia le ！ ran er ， wo tai jiao hua le ， wo she fa tao tuo bing zhao dao le zhe ge di fang 。]

english: The weird hooded guy at the top said that if I get him some hollow marks, he'll help me escape.
translation: 顶部那个戴着兜帽的奇怪家伙说，如果我给他一些空心标记，他就会帮助我逃跑。 [ding bu na ge dai zhe dou mao de qi guai jia huo shuo ， ru guo wo gei ta yi xie kong xin biao ji ， ta jiu hui bang zhu wo tao pao 。]

english: You mean Hallowed marks.
translation: 你说的是神圣印记。 [ni shuo de shi shen sheng yin ji 。]

english: Yeah, that's what I said. Don't you listen?
translation: 是的，我就是这么说的。你不听吗？ [shi de ， wo jiu shi zhe me shuo de 。 ni bu ting ma ？]

english: *sigh*
translation: *叹* [* tan *]

english: So, can I borrow a grapple?
translation: 那么，我可以借个抓斗吗？ [na me ， wo ke yi jie ge zhua dou ma ？]

english: No, I don't have a grapple on me.
translation: 不，我身上没有抓斗。 [bu ， wo shen shang mei you zhua dou 。]

english: Well, you're clearly a noob then.
translation: 好吧，那你显然是个菜鸟。 [hao ba ， na ni xian ran shi ge cai niao 。]

english: Yes, I do have a spare grapple. I'm not sure you'd be able to use it to get across that gap though, what is your Ranged level?
translation: 是的，我确实有一个备用的抓斗。我不确定你是否能够用它来跨越这个差距，你的远程水平是多少？ [shi de ， wo que shi you yi ge bei yong de zhua dou 。 wo bu que ding ni shi fou neng gou yong ta lai kua yue zhe ge cha ju ， ni de yuan cheng shui ping shi duo shao ？]

english: Pfft,I'm level 50 Ranged. Over half-way to 99, getting over there will be a breeze.
translation: 噗，我远程已经50级了。到99已经过半了，到达那里会轻而易举。 [pu ， wo yuan cheng yi jing 50 ji le 。 dao 99 yi jing guo ban le ， dao da na li hui qing er yi ju 。]

english: You need 62 Ranged to make it across that gap.
translation: 你需要 62 远程才能跨越这个差距。 [ni xu yao  62  yuan cheng cai neng kua yue zhe ge cha ju 。]

english: Maybe you do with that attitude.
translation: 也许你就是以这种态度去做的。 [ye xu ni jiu shi yi zhe zhong tai du qu zuo de 。]

english: Yes, I do have a spare grapple, although I spent a lot of Hallowed marks to obtain it so you can't have it.
translation: 是的，我确实有一个备用的抓斗，尽管我花了很多神圣标记才获得它，所以你无法拥有它。 [shi de ， wo que shi you yi ge bei yong de zhua dou ， jin guan wo hua le hen duo shen sheng biao ji cai huo de ta ， suo yi ni wu fa yong you ta 。]

english: Keep your grapple then noob. I can make that jump without it anyway.
translation: 保持你的抓斗，然后菜鸟。无论如何，我可以在没有它的情况下进行跳跃。 [bao chi ni de zhua dou ， ran hou cai niao 。 wu lun ru he ， wo ke yi zai mei you ta de qing kuang xia jin xing tiao yue 。]

english: Oh yeah? What's your agility level?
translation: 哦，是吗？你的敏捷程度是多少？ [o ， shi ma ？ ni de min jie cheng du shi duo shao ？]

english: None of your business.
translation: 关你屁事。 [guan ni pi shi 。]

english: What, you gots the crystal...
translation: 什么，你得到了水晶... [shen me ， ni de dao le shui jing ...]

english: Oh, okay then.
translation: 哦，好吧。 [o ， hao ba 。]

english: You be on your way, then.
translation: 那么你就上路吧。 [na me ni jiu shang lu ba 。]

english: Ah, greetings. What can I do for you?
translation: 啊，问候。我能为你做什么？ [a ， wen hou 。 wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm Madam Sikaro.
translation: 我是西卡罗女士。 [wo shi xi ka luo nv shi 。]

english: ...Is that it?
translation: ……是这样吗？ […… shi zhe yang ma ？]

english: Why shouldn't it be? You asked who I was, and I answered.
translation: 为什么不应该这样呢？你问我是谁，我回答。 [wei shen me bu ying gai zhe yang ne ？ ni wen wo shi shui ， wo hui da 。]

english: I was hoping to learn something about you, like what you were doing here...!
translation: 我希望了解一些关于你的事情，就像你在这里所做的那样......！ [wo xi wang liao jie yi xie guan yu ni de shi qing ， jiu xiang ni zai zhe li suo zuo de na yang ......！]

english: Well, perhaps next time you'll ask a more direct question.
translation: 好吧，也许下次你会问一个更直接的问题。 [hao ba ， ye xu xia ci ni hui wen yi ge geng zhi jie de wen ti 。]

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Making a wizard hideout.
translation: 建造一个巫师藏身处。 [jian zao yi ge wu shi cang shen chu 。]

english: A wizard... hideout?
translation: 一个巫师……藏身之处？ [yi ge wu shi …… cang shen zhi chu ？]

english: A wizard hideout! You know how some wizards have their own towers? Think that but underground.
translation: 巫师藏身处！你知道有些巫师是如何拥有自己的塔的吗？想想，但在地下。 [wu shi cang shen chu ！ ni zhi dao you xie wu shi shi ru he yong you zi ji de ta de ma ？ xiang xiang ， dan zai di xia 。]

english: So why not just get a tower?
translation: 那么为什么不直接建一座塔呢？ [na me wei shen me bu zhi jie jian yi zuo ta ne ？]

english: Land price. Kingdoms want you to pay an extortionate amount of money to build on 'their' land, it turns out.
translation: 土地价格。事实证明，王国希望你支付巨额金钱在“他们的”土地上进行建设。 [tu di jia ge 。 shi shi zheng ming ， wang guo xi wang ni zhi fu ju e jin qian zai “ ta men de ” tu di shang jin xing jian she 。]

english: So instead you ended up in the basement of a tavern.
translation: 所以你最终来到了一家小酒馆的地下室。 [suo yi ni zui zhong lai dao le yi jia xiao jiu guan de di xia shi 。]

english: Yep. Camarst said I could have it as long as I don't hurt any of his customers too badly.
translation: 是的。卡马斯特说，只要我不严重伤害他的任何顾客，我就可以拥有它。 [shi de 。 ka ma si te shuo ， zhi yao wo bu yan zhong shang hai ta de ren he gu ke ， wo jiu ke yi yong you ta 。]

english: Not that I actually plan to hurt any of his customers.
translation: 我并不是真的打算伤害他的任何顾客。 [wo bing bu shi zhen de da suan shang hai ta de ren he gu ke 。]

english: I have this part that looks like it's from a weapon...
translation: 我有这个部件，看起来像是来自武器...... [wo you zhe ge bu jian ， kan qi lai xiang shi lai zi wu qi ......]

english: Ah yes, that does look like a part of a particularly powerful weapon.
translation: 啊，是的，这看起来确实像是一种特别强大的武器的一部分。 [a ， shi de ， zhe kan qi lai que shi xiang shi yi zhong te bie qiang da de wu qi de yi bu fen 。]

english: Can I do anything with it?
translation: 我可以用它做点什么吗？ [wo ke yi yong ta zuo dian shen me ma ？]

english: You? Perhaps not, though if you could bring me all three pieces, I suspect I could put it back together for you.
translation: 你？也许不会，不过如果你能把这三块都带给我，我想我可以帮你把它们重新组装起来。 [ni ？ ye xu bu hui ， bu guo ru guo ni neng ba zhe san kuai dou dai gei wo ， wo xiang wo ke yi bang ni ba ta men chong xin zu zhuang qi lai 。]

english: There should be a hilt, a blade and a conduit gemstone. Oh, and I'll want 500,000 coins as payment as well. Good hunting!
translation: 应该有剑柄、刀片和导管宝石。哦，我还想要五十万金币作为付款。狩猎顺利！ [ying gai you jian bing 、 dao pian he dao guan bao shi 。 o ， wo hai xiang yao wu shi wan jin bi zuo wei fu kuan 。 shou lie shun li ！]

english: Do you know where I could find the other parts?
translation: 你知道我在哪里可以找到其他零件吗？ [ni zhi dao wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao qi ta ling jian ma ？]

english: I suspect the Wilderness would be a good place to start. There are monsters out there that have grown immense over time.
translation: 我怀疑荒野将是一个很好的起点。那里有随着时间的推移而变得巨大的怪物。 [wo huai yi huang ye jiang shi yi ge hen hao de qi dian 。 na li you sui zhe shi jian de tui yi er bian de ju da de guai wu 。]

english: Seeking out the strongest of them is where I'd start, anyway.
translation: 无论如何，寻找他们中最强的人是我的起点。 [wu lun ru he ， xun zhao ta men zhong zui qiang de ren shi wo de qi dian 。]

english: I have these parts of a weapon, do you think you could assemble it for me?
translation: 我有这些武器零件，你能帮我组装一下吗？ [wo you zhe xie wu qi ling jian ， ni neng bang wo zu zhuang yi xia ma ？]

english: Hmm... yes, these are the parts of a particularly powerful weapon indeed. I can reassemble it... for a fee, of course. 500,000 coins, no less.
translation: 嗯……是的，这些确实是一种特别强大的武器的部件。我可以重新组装它……当然要付费。五十万金币，不能少。 [n …… shi de ， zhe xie que shi shi yi zhong te bie qiang da de wu qi de bu jian 。 wo ke yi chong xin zu zhuang ta …… dang ran yao fu fei 。 wu shi wan jin bi ， bu neng shao 。]

english: I don't have that much on me...
translation: 我身上没有那么多... [wo shen shang mei you na me duo ...]

english: Well, if you come across some more, come find me again.
translation: 好吧，如果你遇到更多，再来找我吧。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni yu dao geng duo ， zai lai zhao wo ba 。]

english: Actually, I've changed my mind.
translation: 事实上，我已经改变主意了。 [shi shi shang ， wo yi jing gai bian zhu yi le 。]

english: Curious, you come to me with all of the parts and the coin, yet you change your mind at the last second.
translation: 出于好奇，你带着所有零件和硬币来找我，但你在最后一秒改变了主意。 [chu yu hao qi ， ni dai zhe suo you ling jian he ying bi lai zhao wo ， dan ni zai zui hou yi miao gai bian le zhu yi 。]

english: I do rather get the feeling you're toying with me. Very well, I shall do my part in playing with you.
translation: 我确实感觉你在玩弄我。很好，我会尽力和你一起玩。 [wo que shi gan jue ni zai wan nong wo 。 hen hao ， wo hui jin li he ni yi qi wan 。]

english: You feel the contents of your inventory shift slightly.
translation: 您感觉库存内容发生了轻微变化。 [nin gan jue ku cun nei rong fa sheng le qing wei bian hua 。]

english: Now, do talk to me again if you'd like to proceed more sensibly.
translation: 现在，如果您想更明智地进行，请再次与我交谈。 [xian zai ， ru guo nin xiang geng ming zhi di jin xing ， qing zai ci yu wo jiao tan 。]

english: What are you doing with the money from combining the Voidwaker?
translation: 你用合并虚空唤醒者的钱做什么？ [ni yong he bing xu kong huan xing zhe de qian zuo shen me ？]

english: I'll spend some of it improving the hideout. The rest on general expenses.
translation: 我会花一些钱改善藏身处。其余的一般费用。 [wo hui hua yi xie qian gai shan cang shen chu 。 qi yu de yi ban fei yong 。]

english: What kind of expenses?
translation: 什么样的费用？ [shen me yang de fei yong ？]

english: Living isn't free, you know? A woman my age has expenses. Food, clothing, protection... It all adds up.
translation: 生活不是免费的，你知道吗？我这个年纪的女人有开支。食物、衣服、保护……这一切加在一起。 [sheng huo bu shi mian fei de ， ni zhi dao ma ？ wo zhe ge nian ji de nv ren you kai zhi 。 shi wu 、 yi fu 、 bao hu …… zhe yi qie jia zai yi qi 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: You walked up to me just to say goodbye? Ok, sure, goodbye.
translation: 你走到我面前只是为了跟我说再见吗？好的，当然，再见。 [ni zou dao wo mian qian zhi shi wei le gen wo shuo zai jian ma ？ hao de ， dang ran ， zai jian 。]

english: So what exactly is this sword, anyway?
translation: 那么这把剑到底是什么？ [na me zhe ba jian dao di shi shen me ？]

english: Well, that largely depends on who you ask and when you ask it. The sword is not unique, but many like it have been referenced in folktales.
translation: 嗯，这很大程度上取决于你问谁以及什么时候问。这把剑并不是独一无二的，但许多类似的剑都在民间故事中被提及。 [n ， zhe hen da cheng du shang qu jue yu ni wen shui yi ji shen me shi hou wen 。 zhe ba jian bing bu shi du yi wu er de ， dan xu duo lei si de jian dou zai min jian gu shi zhong bei ti ji 。]

english: Some tell of great and prideful warriors roaming the lands, cutting down all who oppose them in great crashes of lightning.
translation: 有些人讲述了伟大而自豪的战士在这片土地上漫游，用巨大的闪电击倒了所有反对他们的人。 [you xie ren jiang shu le wei da er zi hao de zhan shi zai zhe pian tu di shang man you ， yong ju da de shan dian ji dao le suo you fan dui ta men de ren 。]

english: Others tell of lovers, one bound by oath, the other free as the wind, cruely torn apart by fate.
translation: 另一些则讲述恋人的故事，其中一方被誓言束缚，另一方如风般自由，却被命运残酷地撕裂。 [ling yi xie ze jiang shu lian ren de gu shi ， qi zhong yi fang bei shi yan shu fu ， ling yi fang ru feng ban zi you ， que bei ming yun can ku di si lie 。]

english: Others still tell of three great beasts that alone were powerful, but combined could destroy Gielinor.
translation: 其他人仍然讲述着三头巨兽，它们单独强大，但联合起来可以摧毁吉林诺。 [qi ta ren reng ran jiang shu zhe san tou ju shou ， ta men dan du qiang da ， dan lian he qi lai ke yi cui hui ji lin nuo 。]

english: Are we still talking about the sword?
translation: 我们还在谈论剑吗？ [wo men hai zai tan lun jian ma ？]

english: Amazingly, yes. In all of these tales, the sword is there, potential shining through the metal, thunder rolling in its wake.
translation: 令人惊讶的是，是的。在所有这些故事中，剑都在那里，潜力透过金属闪耀，雷霆滚滚。 [ling ren jing ya de shi ， shi de 。 zai suo you zhe xie gu shi zhong ， jian dou zai na li ， qian li tou guo jin shu shan yao ， lei ting gun gun 。]

english: Are any of these tales... true?
translation: 这些故事都是真的吗？ [zhe xie gu shi dou shi zhen de ma ？]

english: Oh, I'm sure there are elements of the truth buried in there, but folklore being what it is, I'm inclined to not believe any of it.
translation: 哦，我确信其中埋藏着一些真相，但民间传说就是这样，我倾向于不相信其中的任何一个。 [o ， wo que xin qi zhong mai cang zhe yi xie zhen xiang ， dan min jian chuan shuo jiu shi zhe yang ， wo qing xiang yu bu xiang xin qi zhong de ren he yi ge 。]

english: Aside from the bit where it can summon lightning. It can absolutely do that.
translation: 除了可以召唤闪电的那一点之外。它绝对可以做到这一点。 [chu le ke yi zhao huan shan dian de na yi dian zhi wai 。 ta jue dui ke yi zuo dao zhe yi dian 。]

english: What about the name? You called it Voidwaker?
translation: 那名字呢？你称它为虚空唤醒者？ [na ming zi ne ？ ni cheng ta wei xu kong huan xing zhe ？]

english: Well, in a lot of these tales, it's only ever refferedto as someone's sword. Like, [player name]'s sword.
translation: 嗯，在很多这样的故事中，它只被称为某人的剑。比如，[玩家名字]的剑。 [n ， zai hen duo zhe yang de gu shi zhong ， ta zhi bei cheng wei mou ren de jian 。 bi ru ，[ wan jia ming zi ] de jian 。]

english: So, I chose a name for it.
translation: 所以，我为它选择了一个名字。 [suo yi ， wo wei ta xuan ze le yi ge ming zi 。]

english: And you chose... Voidwaker? Why?
translation: 而你选择了……虚空觉醒者？为什么？ [er ni xuan ze le …… xu kong jue xing zhe ？ wei shen me ？]

english: There are multiple reasons. I suppose you could say the sword is so powerful that it leaves a void in its wake.
translation: 原因有多种。我想你可能会说这把剑是如此强大，以至于它的尾迹留下了虚空。 [yuan yin you duo zhong 。 wo xiang ni ke neng hui shuo zhe ba jian shi ru ci qiang da ， yi zhi yu ta de wei ji liu xia le xu kong 。]

english: That makes sense.
translation: 这是有道理的。 [zhe shi you dao li de 。]

english: No thank you, I'm currently on a diet.
translation: 不，谢谢，我目前正在节食。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo mu qian zheng zai jie shi 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I have this part that looks like it's from a weapon...
translation: 我有这个部件，看起来像是来自武器...... [wo you zhe ge bu jian ， kan qi lai xiang shi lai zi wu qi ......]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: What are you doing with the money?
translation: 你用这些钱做什么？ [ni yong zhe xie qian zuo shen me ？]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Good morrow, adventurer.
translation: 早上好，冒险家。 [zao shang hao ， mao xian jia 。]

english: I guess so.
translation: 大概吧。 [da gai ba 。]

english: You guess? The sun is shining, the sea breeze is salty, what's not to enjoy?
translation: 你猜？阳光明媚，海风咸咸，何乐而不为呢？ [ni cai ？ yang guang ming mei ， hai feng xian xian ， he le er bu wei ne ？]

english: I don't know... The sand? It's coarse and rough and irritating, and it gets everywhere.
translation: 我不知道...沙子？它粗俗、粗糙、令人恼火，而且到处都是。 [wo bu zhi dao ... sha zi ？ ta cu su 、 cu cao 、 ling ren nao huo ， er qie dao chu dou shi 。]

english: Hmm, well my spa isn't quite ready yet, but when it is, I'm sure that'll solve all of your sand related issues!
translation: 嗯，我的水疗中心还没有准备好，但当它准备好时，我相信这会解决您所有与沙子相关的问题！ [n ， wo de shui liao zhong xin hai mei you zhun bei hao ， dan dang ta zhun bei hao shi ， wo xiang xin zhe hui jie jue nin suo you yu sha zi xiang guan de wen ti ！]

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。 [hao de 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I am Madame Caldarium! A pirate's life was for me, but lately I've been looking to expand my business, I'm getting old, ya see.
translation: 我是卡尔达瑞姆夫人！海盗的生活适合我，但最近我一直在寻求扩大我的生意，我变老了，你看。 [wo shi ka er da rui mu fu ren ！ hai dao de sheng huo shi he wo ， dan zui jin wo yi zhi zai xun qiu kuo da wo de sheng yi ， wo bian lao le ， ni kan 。]

english: A spa business? Do you really think these Corsairs are the washing type?
translation: 水疗业务？你真以为这些海盗船是水洗型的吗？ [shui liao ye wu ？ ni zhen yi wei zhe xie hai dao chuan shi shui xi xing de ma ？]

english: Ha! That's what the Rum is for!
translation: 哈!这就是朗姆酒的用途！ [ha ! zhe jiu shi lang mu jiu de yong tu ！]

english: I'm more concerned of their laziness, 'Can't work today Madame, I'm cursed!'. Bunch of idiots, the lot of 'em.
translation: 我更担心他们的懒惰，“今天不能工作，女士，我被诅咒了！”。一群白痴，他们中的很多人。 [wo geng dan xin ta men de lan duo ，“ jin tian bu neng gong zuo ， nv shi ， wo bei zu zhou le ！”。 yi qun bai chi ， ta men zhong de hen duo ren 。]

english: Surely you never expected this lot to be any different... They're either stealing, killing or both!
translation: 你肯定没想到这群人会有什么不同……他们要么偷窃，要么杀人，要么两者兼而有之！ [ni ken ding mei xiang dao zhe qun ren hui you shen me bu tong …… ta men yao me tou qie ， yao me sha ren ， yao me liang zhe jian er you zhi ！]

english: Yes... I have plans adventurer, the local cave dwelling population are... Let's say, sorting something out.
translation: 是的...我有计划冒险家，当地的洞穴居民正在...比方说，正在整理一些东西。 [shi de ... wo you ji hua mao xian jia ， dang di de dong xue ju min zheng zai ... bi fang shuo ， zheng zai zheng li yi xie dong xi 。]

english: Interesting, I'm sure that'll be an entertaining turn of events.
translation: 有趣的是，我相信这将是一个有趣的转折点。 [you qu de shi ， wo xiang xin zhe jiang shi yi ge you qu de zhuan zhe dian 。]

english: We'll see...
translation: 我们会看到... [wo men hui kan dao ...]

english: Goodbye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Farewell, adventurer.
translation: 再见了，冒险家。 [zai jian le ， mao xian jia 。]

english: I have a question for you.
translation: 我有个问题要问你。 [wo you ge wen ti yao wen ni 。]

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。 [qing shu ru wen ti de da an 。]

english: No, try again.
translation: 不，再试一次。 [bu ， zai shi yi ci 。]

english: Correct!
translation: 正确的！ [zheng que de ！]

english: I guess so.
translation: 大概吧。 [da gai ba 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Goodbye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。你今天怎么样？ [ni hao 。 ni jin tian zen me yang ？]

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很棒，谢谢你！ [wo hen bang ， xie xie ni ！]

english: Isn't it wonderful? So many books, so much knowledge to be absorbed!
translation: 是不是很美妙？这么多的书，这么多的知识需要吸收！ [shi bu shi hen mei miao ？ zhe me duo de shu ， zhe me duo de zhi shi xu yao xi shou ！]

english: You're right, it is.
translation: 你说得对，确实如此。 [ni shuo de dui ， que shi ru ci 。]

english: Where did I see that book? It can't be far...
translation: 我在哪里看到那本书？不可能很远... [wo zai na li kan dao na ben shu ？ bu ke neng hen yuan ...]

english: Uh... Hello?
translation: 呃……喂？ [e …… wei ？]

english: I'm sure it was around here somewhere...
translation: 我确信它就在这附近的某个地方...... [wo que xin ta jiu zai zhe fu jin de mou ge di fang ......]

english: Okay... Maybe later...
translation: 好吧...也许以后... [hao ba ... ye xu yi hou ...]

english: What can I do for ya?
translation: 我能为你做什么？ [wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: Got any good books to recommend?
translation: 有什么好书推荐吗？ [you shen me hao shu tui jian ma ？]

english: I've always found Prifddinas' History to be fascinating!
translation: 我一直觉得普里夫迪纳斯的历史很迷人！ [wo yi zhi jue de pu li fu di na si de li shi hen mi ren ！]

english: I've always found The Journal of Randas to be fascinating!
translation: 我一直觉得《兰达斯杂志》很有趣！ [wo yi zhi jue de 《 lan da si za zhi 》 hen you qu ！]

english: I've always found Big Book of Bangs to be fascinating!
translation: 我一直觉得《Big Book of Bangs》很有趣！ [wo yi zhi jue de 《Big Book of Bangs》 hen you qu ！]

english: I've always found The Great Divide to be fascinating!
translation: 我一直觉得《大鸿沟》很迷人！ [wo yi zhi jue de 《 da hong gou 》 hen mi ren ！]

english: I've always found Ode to Eternity to be fascinating!
translation: 我一直觉得《永恒颂》很有趣！ [wo yi zhi jue de 《 yong heng song 》 hen you qu ！]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: Got any good books to recommend?
translation: 有什么好书推荐吗？ [you shen me hao shu tui jian ma ？]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 你知道，打招呼的方式有很多种。你好，你好，你好…… [ni zhi dao ， da zhao hu de fang shi you hen duo zhong 。 ni hao ， ni hao ， ni hao ……]

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 那还是只能算一个！ [na hai shi zhi neng suan yi ge ！]

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。你今天怎么样？ [ni hao 。 ni jin tian zen me yang ？]

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很棒，谢谢你！ [wo hen bang ， xie xie ni ！]

english: Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 你好！水晶城里今天过得怎么样啊？ [ni hao ！ shui jing cheng li jin tian guo de zen me yang a ？]

english: Indeed.
translation: 的确。 [di que 。]

english: What can I do for ya?
translation: 我能为你做什么？ [wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 各种各样的事情！这些塔楼是一个美妙的景观。 [ge zhong ge yang de shi qing ！ zhe xie ta lou shi yi ge mei miao de jing guan 。]

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 在像今天这样的日子，我建议您参观市场。 [zai xiang jin tian zhe yang de ri zi ， wo jian yi nin can guan shi chang 。]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你认为你在做什么？ [ni ren wei ni zai zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Hello friend. I wish to slay evil and avail them of their loot! Take me to Burgh de Rott!
translation: 朋友你好。我希望消灭邪恶并利用他们的战利品！带我去德罗特堡！ [peng you ni hao 。 wo xi wang xiao mie xie e bing li yong ta men de zhan li pin ！ dai wo qu de luo te bao ！]

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: 你准备好与那里的邪恶作斗争了吗？ [ni zhun bei hao yu na li de xie e zuo dou zheng le ma ？]

english: I think so? At least my heart knows courage and that should be sufficient for the meantime. I expect that when we get to Burgh de Rott, we'll be able to purchase suitable provisions.
translation: 我想是这样吗？至少我的心知道勇气，这应该足够了。我预计当我们到达罗特堡时，我们就能购买到合适的食物。 [wo xiang shi zhe yang ma ？ zhi shao wo de xin zhi dao yong qi ， zhe ying gai zu gou le 。 wo yu ji dang wo men dao da luo te bao shi ， wo men jiu neng gou mai dao he shi de shi wu 。]

english: But you do realise that the vampyres in Morytania are immune to everything except silver?
translation: 但你确实意识到莫里塔尼亚的吸血鬼对除了银以外的一切都免疫吗？ [dan ni que shi yi shi dao mo li ta ni ya de xi xue gui dui chu le yin yi wai de yi qie dou mian yi ma ？]

english: Er...well, I've not heard mention of that fact, but I have faith that Saradomin will provide the means to furnish me with suitable weapons when I reach Burgh de Rott.
translation: 呃……好吧，我没有听说过这个事实，但我相信萨拉多明会在我到达罗特堡时为我提供合适的武器。 [e …… hao ba ， wo mei you ting shuo guo zhe ge shi shi ， dan wo xiang xin sa la duo ming hui zai wo dao da luo te bao shi wei wo ti gong he shi de wu qi 。]

english: And if we happen to run into some vampyres on the journey down there?
translation: 如果我们在那儿的旅途中碰巧遇到吸血鬼怎么办？ [ru guo wo men zai na er de lv tu zhong peng qiao yu dao xi xue gui zen me ban ？]

english: I trust that you will help us to avoid them. You are a guide after all, aren't you? Anyway, you look like you can handle yourself. I presume you've fought such creatures before and won? How hard can it be?
translation: 我相信你会帮助我们避免它们。毕竟你是一个向导，不是吗？无论如何，你看上去能应付自如。我想你以前曾与这些生物战斗过并获胜吧？这有多难？ [wo xiang xin ni hui bang zhu wo men bi mian ta men 。 bi jing ni shi yi ge xiang dao ， bu shi ma ？ wu lun ru he ， ni kan shang qu neng ying fu zi ru 。 wo xiang ni yi qian ceng yu zhe xie sheng wu zhan dou guo bing huo sheng ba ？ zhe you duo nan ？]

english: It can be pretty difficult, actually. But you're right, I'll be your guide so I should be able to handle the situation.
translation: 实际上，这可能相当困难。但你是对的，我会成为你的向导，所以我应该能够处理这种情况。 [shi ji shang ， zhe ke neng xiang dang kun nan 。 dan ni shi dui de ， wo hui cheng wei ni de xiang dao ， suo yi wo ying gai neng gou chu li zhe zhong qing kuang 。]

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 你为什么想去 Burgh de Rott？ [ni wei shen me xiang qu  Burgh de Rott？]

english: I'm going down there to teach those vampyres a lesson or two. I've heard about the terrible conditions down there and I intend to put a stop to it.
translation: 我要去那里给那些吸血鬼一两个教训。我听说那里的情况很糟糕，我打算阻止它。 [wo yao qu na li gei na xie xi xue gui yi liang ge jiao xun 。 wo ting shuo na li de qing kuang hen zao gao ， wo da suan zu zhi ta 。]

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 如果我们在去罗特城堡的路上遇到敌人，你能保护自己吗？ [ru guo wo men zai qu luo te cheng bao de lu shang yu dao di ren ， ni neng bao hu zi ji ma ？]

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of enemies. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: 这么说吧，我有点经验，而且我很乐意对抗我的敌人。你不需要担心这个。 [zhe me shuo ba ， wo you dian jing yan ， er qie wo hen le yi dui kang wo de di ren 。 ni bu xu yao dan xin zhe ge 。]

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 我可以带你去伯格德罗特。 [wo ke yi dai ni qu bo ge de luo te 。]

english: Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: 嗯嗯，看来你有追随者了。我想如果让它独自徘徊的话，它可能会在这段旅程中迷路。等你的追随者安全了我们就离开吧。 [n n ， kan lai ni you zhui sui zhe le 。 wo xiang ru guo rang ta du zi pai huai de hua ， ta ke neng hui zai zhe duan lv cheng zhong mi lu 。 deng ni de zhui sui zhe an quan le wo men jiu li kai ba 。]

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: 哦真的吗？那太好了！到达目的地后我会给你一个小奖励。 [o zhen de ma ？ na tai hao le ！ dao da mu di di hou wo hui gei ni yi ge xiao jiang li 。]

english: Burgh de Rott Ramble begins
translation: Burgh de Rott 漫步开始 [Burgh de Rott  man bu kai shi]

english: Ok, which route should we take?
translation: 好的，我们应该走哪条路？ [hao de ， wo men ying gai zou na tiao lu ？]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: 啊，所以你想给我一些物资，嗯？让我打开背包。 [a ， suo yi ni xiang gei wo yi xie wu zi ， n ？ rang wo da kai bei bao 。]

english: This place is a bit grim. How can people live here?
translation: 这个地方有点严峻。人们怎么能住在这里？ [zhe ge di fang you dian yan jun 。 ren men zen me neng zhu zai zhe li ？]

english: Do you visit Burgh de Rott often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: 您经常访问 Burgh de Rott 吗？看来你很熟悉这条路。 [nin jing chang fang wen  Burgh de Rott  ma ？ kan lai ni hen shu xi zhe tiao lu 。]

english: When are we going to get to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 我们什么时候去 Burgh de Rott？ [wo men shen me shi hou qu  Burgh de Rott？]

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on. I have loot to get.
translation: 我们没有一整天的时间站着聊天；让我们继续努力吧。我有战利品要拿。 [wo men mei you yi zheng tian de shi jian zhan zhe liao tian ； rang wo men ji xu nu li ba 。 wo you zhan li pin yao na 。]

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than the opulet life styles forced on us adventurer types. I'd much rather be up to my eyes in mud and having a good fight!
translation: 哦，我讨厌这次旅行，但它比强加给我们冒险家类型的奥普莱特生活方式要好。我宁愿在泥里睁大眼睛，痛痛快快地打一场！ [o ， wo tao yan zhe ci lv xing ， dan ta bi qiang jia gei wo men mao xian jia lei xing de ao pu lai te sheng huo fang shi yao hao 。 wo ning yuan zai ni li zheng da yan jing ， tong tong kuai kuai di da yi chang ！]

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...
translation: 你没看到我正在被攻击吗... [ni mei kan dao wo zheng zai bei gong ji ma ...]

english: Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
translation: 谢谢，我会把这个放在脖子上。 [xie xie ， wo hui ba zhe ge fang zai bo zi shang 。]

english: Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Paterdomus. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: 天啊！看来我们得回帕特多莫斯了。我们过不了那座桥！ [tian a ！ kan lai wo men de hui pa te duo mo si le 。 wo men guo bu liao na zuo qiao ！]

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
translation: 哦，我相信我们能找到办法！ [o ， wo xiang xin wo men neng zhao dao ban fa ！]

english: Player completes the bridge event
translation: 玩家完成桥牌事件 [wan jia wan cheng qiao pai shi jian]

english: Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Paterdomus.
translation: 好吧，这已经被撕裂了……看起来我们无法越过这个沼泽。我们必须回到帕特多莫斯。 [hao ba ， zhe yi jing bei si lie le …… kan qi lai wo men wu fa yue guo zhe ge zhao ze 。 wo men bi xu hui dao pa te duo mo si 。]

english: Player completes the bog event
translation: 玩家完成沼泽事件 [wan jia wan cheng zhao ze shi jian]

english: Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: 嘿……太好了……你做得很好……我会关注你的。 [hei …… tai hao le …… ni zuo de hen hao …… wo hui guan zhu ni de 。]

english: Whahay...that was great!
translation: 哇……那太好了！ [wa …… na tai hao le ！]

english: But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 但我们现在真的应该出发了。 [dan wo men xian zai zhen de ying gai chu fa le 。]

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
translation: 哦，我相信我们能找到办法！ [o ， wo xiang xin wo men neng zhao dao ban fa ！]

english: Player completes the river event
translation: 玩家完成河牌事件 [wan jia wan cheng he pai shi jian]

english: That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: 太棒了！我也必须这样做。 [tai bang le ！ wo ye bi xu zhe yang zuo 。]

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 哇哈！那很棒！但我们现在真的应该出发了。 [wa ha ！ na hen bang ！ dan wo men xian zai zhen de ying gai chu fa le 。]

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
translation: 呃……那些气泡是什么？ [e …… na xie qi pao shi shen me ？]

english: This is scary!
translation: 这太可怕了！ [zhe tai ke pa le ！]

english: Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
translation: 啊啊啊，那应该是触手吧…… [a a a ， na ying gai shi chu shou ba ……]

english: Ahhh, two tentacles!
translation: 啊啊啊，两条触手！ [a a a ， liang tiao chu shou ！]

english: ...three tentacles!
translation: ……三根触手！ […… san gen chu shou ！]

english: I think I'm going to faint!
translation: 我想我要晕倒了！ [wo xiang wo yao yun dao le ！]

english: Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: 天啊！看看那只野兽！你得自己解决这件事！ [tian a ！ kan kan na zhi ye shou ！ ni de zi ji jie jue zhe jian shi ！]

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the Burgh de Rott. Here's your reward.
translation: 非常感谢您让我安全抵达 Burgh de Rott。这是你的奖励。 [fei chang gan xie nin rang wo an quan di da  Burgh de Rott。 zhe shi ni de jiang li 。]

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: 你准备好与那里的邪恶作斗争了吗？ [ni zhun bei hao yu na li de xie e zuo dou zheng le ma ？]

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 你为什么想去 Burgh de Rott？ [ni wei shen me xiang qu  Burgh de Rott？]

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
translation: 如果我们遇到敌人，你能保护自己吗……？ [ru guo wo men yu dao di ren ， ni neng bao hu zi ji ma ……？]

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 我可以带你去伯格德罗特。 [wo ke yi dai ni qu bo ge de luo te 。]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: This isn't the place to talk. Visit me in Varrock's Chaos Temple if you have something to discuss. Unless you're here to teleport or buy something?
translation: 这里不是说话的地方。如果你有什么事情要讨论的话，可以到瓦罗克的混沌神殿来找我。除非你来这里传送或买东西？ [zhe li bu shi shuo hua de di fang 。 ru guo ni you shen me shi qing yao tao lun de hua ， ke yi dao wa luo ke de hun dun shen dian lai zhao wo 。 chu fei ni lai zhe li chuan song huo mai dong xi ？]

english: Let's see what you're selling.
translation: 让我们看看你卖什么。 [rang wo men kan kan ni mai shen me 。]

english: Could you teleport me to the Abyss?
translation: 你能把我传送到深渊吗？ [ni neng ba wo chuan song dao shen yuan ma ？]

english: Veniens! Sallakar! Rinnesset!
translation: 维尼恩斯！萨拉卡！林尼塞特！ [wei ni en si ！ sa la ka ！ lin ni sai te ！]

english: Player is teleported to the Abyss.
translation: 玩家被传送到深渊。 [wan jia bei chuan song dao shen yuan 。]

english: Alright, I'll go.
translation: 好吧，我这就去。 [hao ba ， wo zhe jiu qu 。]

english: Ah, you again. What do you want?
translation: 啊，又是你。你想要什么？ [a ， you shi ni 。 ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: About that incantation your initiate gave me...
translation: 关于你的入门者给我的那个咒语…… [guan yu ni de ru men zhe gei wo de na ge zhou yu ……]

english: Ah yes, the one to trace that amulet. Don't think I didn't notice that you modified the transmission spell I put on it. Next time you need help, we might not be so willing.
translation: 啊，是的，就是追踪那个护身符的人。别以为我没注意到你修改了我施加的传送咒语。下次你需要帮助的时候，我们可能不会那么愿意了。 [a ， shi de ， jiu shi zhui zong na ge hu shen fu de ren 。 bie yi wei wo mei zhu yi dao ni xiu gai le wo shi jia de chuan song zhou yu 。 xia ci ni xu yao bang zhu de shi hou ， wo men ke neng bu hui na me yuan yi le 。]

english: Well maybe you should have asked first! Besides, you wouldn't have got anything useful out of it. In tracing that amulet, we accidently managed to open an uncontrollable rift to the Abyss.
translation: 好吧，也许你应该先问一下！此外，你不会从中得到任何有用的东西。在追踪那个护身符的过程中，我们意外地打开了一条通往深渊的无法控制的裂缝。 [hao ba ， ye xu ni ying gai xian wen yi xia ！ ci wai ， ni bu hui cong zhong de dao ren he you yong de dong xi 。 zai zhui zong na ge hu shen fu de guo cheng zhong ， wo men yi wai di da kai le yi tiao tong wang shen yuan de wu fa kong zhi de lie feng 。]

english: And does this 'we' include the Order of Wizards?
translation: 这个“我们”包括巫师团吗？ [zhe ge “ wo men ” bao kuo wu shi tuan ma ？]

english: Maybe...
translation: 或许... [huo xu ...]

english: I knew it! It's just like them to play with magic they don't understand. First they burnt down the Wizards' Tower, now they're opening uncontrollable abyssal rifts!
translation: 我就知道！就像他们在玩弄自己不懂的魔法一样。首先他们烧毁了巫师塔，现在他们又打开了无法控制的深渊裂缝！ [wo jiu zhi dao ！ jiu xiang ta men zai wan nong zi ji bu dong de mo fa yi yang 。 shou xian ta men shao hui le wu shi ta ， xian zai ta men you da kai liao wu fa kong zhi de shen yuan lie feng ！]

english: Perhaps the fools should leave the dangerous magic to us next time!
translation: 也许傻瓜们下次应该把危险的魔法留给我们吧！ [ye xu sha gua men xia ci ying gai ba wei xian de mo fa liu gei wo men ba ！]

english: Oh, that reminds me. That incantation didn't appear to be written on parchment. What was it?
translation: 哦，这让我想起了。那个咒语似乎不是写在羊皮纸上的。那是什么？ [o ， zhe rang wo xiang qi le 。 na ge zhou yu si hu bu shi xie zai yang pi zhi shang de 。 na shi shen me ？]

english: Hmm... probably the flesh of an abyssal creature. Why do you ask?
translation: 嗯……大概是深渊生物的肉。你为什么问？ [n …… da gai shi shen yuan sheng wu de rou 。 ni wei shen me wen ？]

english: Oh, I just thought it might be human flesh. I'm relieved it wasn't!
translation: 哦，我只是觉得这可能是人肉。我放心了，事实并非如此！ [o ， wo zhi shi jue de zhe ke neng shi ren rou 。 wo fang xin le ， shi shi bing fei ru ci ！]

english: You've been spending too much time with your friends in the Order of Wizards! I know that we Zamorakians have a bad reputation, but do you really think we'd be so barbaric?
translation: 你在巫师团里和你的朋友们一起度过了太多的时间！我知道我们萨莫拉克人名声不好，但你真的认为我们会如此野蛮吗？ [ni zai wu shi tuan li he ni de peng you men yi qi du guo le tai duo de shi jian ！ wo zhi dao wo men sa mo la ke ren ming sheng bu hao ， dan ni zhen de ren wei wo men hui ru ci ye man ma ？]

english: Ah yes, the one that led those fools in the Order of Wizards to open an uncontrollable abyssal rift! Perhaps they should leave the dangerous magic to us next time!
translation: 啊，是的，就是那个带领巫师团的那些蠢货打开了无法控制的深渊裂痕的人！或许下次他们应该把危险的魔法留给我们吧！ [a ， shi de ， jiu shi na ge dai ling wu shi tuan de na xie chun huo da kai liao wu fa kong zhi de shen yuan lie hen de ren ！ huo xu xia ci ta men ying gai ba wei xian de mo fa liu gei wo men ba ！]

english: Not to mention that they tried to convince you that we wrote that incantation on human flesh! Their lies never cease to amaze me!
translation: 更不用说他们试图让你相信我们在人肉上写下了那个咒语！他们的谎言总是让我感到惊讶！ [geng bu yong shuo ta men shi tu rang ni xiang xin wo men zai ren rou shang xie xia le na ge zhou yu ！ ta men de huang yan zong shi rang wo gan dao jing ya ！]

english: Right...
translation: 正确的... [zheng que de ...]

english: Can you tell me more about the Abyss?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于深渊的事吗？ [ni neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu shen yuan de shi ma ？]

english: It is a hard place to describe. We often refer to it as another plane, but that isn't quite accurate. If anything, it is more like a plane that sits between all other planes.
translation: 这是一个很难描述的地方。我们经常将其称为另一架飞机，但这不太准确。如果有什么不同的话，那就是它更像是一架位于所有其他飞机之间的飞机。 [zhe shi yi ge hen nan miao shu de di fang 。 wo men jing chang jiang qi cheng wei ling yi jia fei ji ， dan zhe bu tai zhun que 。 ru guo you shen me bu tong de hua ， na jiu shi ta geng xiang shi yi jia wei yu suo you qi ta fei ji zhi jian de fei ji 。]

english: Right... And what does it have to do with runecrafting?
translation: 对了……那和符文制作有什么关系呢？ [dui le …… na he fu wen zhi zuo you shen me guan xi ne ？]

english: In truth, nothing at all. However, it has everything to do with teleportation. You see, time and space work differently in the Abyss.
translation: 事实上，什么也没有。然而，它与传送有关。你看，时间和空间在深渊中的运作方式是不同的。 [shi shi shang ， shen me ye mei you 。 ran er ， ta yu chuan song you guan 。 ni kan ， shi jian he kong jian zai shen yuan zhong de yun zuo fang shi shi bu tong de 。]

english: For example, you can travel to the Abyss, walk a few steps and then exit, only to find yourself somewhere completely different from where you entered. You might even find yourself on a different plane.
translation: 例如，你可以前往深渊，走几步然后退出，却发现自己身处与进入的地方完全不同的地方。您甚至可能会发现自己在不同的飞机上。 [li ru ， ni ke yi qian wang shen yuan ， zou ji bu ran hou tui chu ， que fa xian zi ji shen chu yu jin ru de di fang wan quan bu tong de di fang 。 nin shen zhi ke neng hui fa xian zi ji zai bu tong de fei ji shang 。]

english: You can also enter the Abyss and spend days there, but on your return, only moments have passed.
translation: 你也可以进入深渊并在那里度过几天，但当你回来时，只过去了片刻。 [ni ye ke yi jin ru shen yuan bing zai na li du guo ji tian ， dan dang ni hui lai shi ， zhi guo qu le pian ke 。]

english: This is why the Abyss is so useful. It can be used as an effective hub for teleportation. In fact, all teleportation that we know of uses the Abyss, you just don't realise it.
translation: 这就是深渊如此有用的原因。它可以用作传送的有效枢纽。事实上，我们所知道的所有传送都使用深渊，只是你没有意识到而已。 [zhe jiu shi shen yuan ru ci you yong de yuan yin 。 ta ke yi yong zuo chuan song de you xiao shu niu 。 shi shi shang ， wo men suo zhi dao de suo you chuan song dou shi yong shen yuan ， zhi shi ni mei you yi shi dao er yi 。]

english: Wait... So when I teleport, I'm actually travelling through the Abyss?
translation: 等等……那么当我传送时，我实际上是在穿越深渊？ [deng deng …… na me dang wo chuan song shi ， wo shi ji shang shi zai chuan yue shen yuan ？]

english: In some ways, I suppose you are. Whenever you use a teleport spell, that spell is actually travelling through the Abyss and using it to link two places together.
translation: 从某些方面来说，我想你是的。每当你使用传送法术时，该法术实际上是在穿越深渊并用它来将两个地方连接在一起。 [cong mou xie fang mian lai shuo ， wo xiang ni shi de 。 mei dang ni shi yong chuan song fa shu shi ， gai fa shu shi ji shang shi zai chuan yue shen yuan bing yong ta lai jiang liang ge di fang lian jie zai yi qi 。]

english: So did you discover the Abyss?
translation: 那么你发现深渊了吗？ [na me ni fa xian shen yuan le ma ？]

english: No. Knowledge of the Abyss has existed for a long time, hence it being used for teleportation. However, we believe we may be the first to have properly gained access in centuries.
translation: 不，深渊知识已经存在很长时间了，因此它被用于传送。然而，我们相信我们可能是几个世纪以来第一个正确获得访问权限的人。 [bu ， shen yuan zhi shi yi jing cun zai hen zhang shi jian le ， yin ci ta bei yong yu chuan song 。 ran er ， wo men xiang xin wo men ke neng shi ji ge shi ji yi lai di yi ge zheng que huo de fang wen quan xian de ren 。]

english: How did you manage it?
translation: 你是怎么做到的？ [ni shi zen me zuo dao de ？]

english: By complete accident. One of our initiates was performing a routine teleportation experiment when something went wrong. Instead of ending up at their destination, they found themselves in the Abyss.
translation: 完全是偶然。我们的一位同修在进行例行的隐形传送实验时，出现了问题。他们没有到达目的地，而是发现自己身处深渊。 [wan quan shi ou ran 。 wo men de yi wei tong xiu zai jin xing li xing de yin xing chuan song shi yan shi ， chu xian le wen ti 。 ta men mei you dao da mu di di ， er shi fa xian zi ji shen chu shen yuan 。]

english: Now, did you want something else?
translation: 现在，你还想要别的东西吗？ [xian zai ， ni hai xiang yao bie de dong xi ma ？]

english: Can you tell me more about your group?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于你的团队的信息吗？ [ni neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu ni de tuan dui de xin xi ma ？]

english: I suppose you have proven yourself trustworthy. We are a group of mages in service to Zamorak. Our group is called the Zamorak Magical Institute, or Z.M.I. for short.
translation: 我想你已经证明了自己是值得信赖的。我们是一群为萨莫拉克服务的法师。我们的团体称为萨莫拉克魔法学院，或 Z.M.I.简而言之。 [wo xiang ni yi jing zheng ming liao zi ji shi zhi de xin lai de 。 wo men shi yi qun wei sa mo la ke fu wu de fa shi 。 wo men de tuan ti cheng wei sa mo la ke mo fa xue yuan ， huo  Z.M.I. jian er yan zhi 。]

english: Few actually know of us. Saradominist groups like the Order of Wizards hold sway over these lands, so we are forced to work in the shadows. However, make no mistake, our power far exceeds theirs.
translation: 很少有人真正了解我们。像巫师团这样的萨拉多米主义团体统治着这片土地，所以我们被迫在暗处工作。不过，别误会，我们的力量远远超过他们。 [hen shao you ren zhen zheng liao jie wo men 。 xiang wu shi tuan zhe yang de sa la duo mi zhu yi tuan ti tong zhi zhe zhe pian tu di ， suo yi wo men bei po zai an chu gong zuo 。 bu guo ， bie wu hui ， wo men de li liang yuan yuan chao guo ta men 。]

english: You don't seem to like the Order of Wizards very much.
translation: 你似乎不太喜欢巫师团。 [ni si hu bu tai xi huan wu shi tuan 。]

english: And why would we? Did you know that the Order of Wizards wasn't always a Saradominist group? Once they allowed mages of all faiths to study with them, but they became greedy.
translation: 我们为什么要这样做？你知道巫师团并不总是萨拉​​多米主义团体吗？曾经他们允许所有信仰的法师跟他们学习，但他们变得贪婪了。 [wo men wei shen me yao zhe yang zuo ？ ni zhi dao wu shi tuan bing bu zong shi sa la ​​ duo mi zhu yi tuan ti ma ？ ceng jing ta men yun xu suo you xin yang de fa shi gen ta men xue xi ， dan ta men bian de tan lan le 。]

english: What happened?
translation: 发生了什么？ [fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: They started to desire more control. They banned Zamorakian wizards from certain areas of study, claiming them to be too dangerous. In reality, they just wanted that knowledge for themselves.
translation: 他们开始渴望更多的控制权。他们禁止萨莫拉克巫师进入某些研究领域，声称他们太危险了。事实上，他们只是想自己掌握这些知识。 [ta men kai shi ke wang geng duo de kong zhi quan 。 ta men jin zhi sa mo la ke wu shi jin ru mou xie yan jiu ling yu ， sheng cheng ta men tai wei xian le 。 shi shi shang ， ta men zhi shi xiang zi ji zhang wo zhe xie zhi shi 。]

english: It all went wrong for them, of course. A Zamorakian wizard made a great breakthrough in teleportation magic, but the Saradominists stole his research.
translation: 当然，这一切对他们来说都是错误的。一名萨莫拉克巫师在传送魔法方面取得了重大突破，但萨拉多米主义者窃取了他的研究成果。 [dang ran ， zhe yi qie dui ta men lai shuo dou shi cuo wu de 。 yi ming sa mo la ke wu shi zai chuan song mo fa fang mian qu de le zhong da tu po ， dan sa la duo mi zhu yi zhe qie qu le ta de yan jiu cheng guo 。]

english: They used it to perform a ritual, but their lack of understanding caused it to go wrong. The entire Wizards' Tower burnt down. Many were killed, and years of research was destroyed.
translation: 他们用它来进行仪式，但由于缺乏理解而导致了错误。整个巫师塔都被烧毁了。许多人被杀，多年的研究成果被毁。 [ta men yong ta lai jin xing yi shi ， dan you yu que fa li jie er dao zhi le cuo wu 。 zheng ge wu shi ta dou bei shao hui le 。 xu duo ren bei sha ， duo nian de yan jiu cheng guo bei hui 。]

english: Naturally, they blamed the Zamorakians. Claimed we intentionally burnt the tower down. After the tower was rebuilt, we were banished from the Order of Wizards and forced underground.
translation: 自然地，他们指责萨莫拉克人。声称我们故意烧毁这座塔。高塔重建后，我们被逐出巫师团并被迫转入地下。 [zi ran di ， ta men zhi ze sa mo la ke ren 。 sheng cheng wo men gu yi shao hui zhe zuo ta 。 gao ta chong jian hou ， wo men bei zhu chu wu shi tuan bing bei po zhuan ru di xia 。]

english: And that's how the Z.M.I. was formed?
translation: 这就是 Z.M.I. 的方式。成立了？ [zhe jiu shi  Z.M.I.  de fang shi 。 cheng li le ？]

english: Exactly.
translation: 确切地。 [que qie di 。]

english: Nothing. I'm just looking around.
translation: 没有什么。我只是看看。 [mei you shen me 。 wo zhi shi kan kan 。]

english: Very well.
translation: 很好。 [hen hao 。]

english: Here you go.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.
translation: 你会收到线索卷轴的撕破部分。 [ni hui shou dao xian suo juan zhou de si po bu fen 。]

english: Ah! You have chosen some quite fantastic attire. Maybe you are not such a fool after all.
translation: 啊!你选择了一些非常棒的服装。也许你毕竟不是那么傻的人。 [a ! ni xuan ze le yi xie fei chang bang de fu zhuang 。 ye xu ni bi jing bu shi na me sha de ren 。]

english: Let's see what you're selling.
translation: 让我们看看你卖什么。 [rang wo men kan kan ni mai shen me 。]

english: Could you teleport me to the Abyss?
translation: 你能把我传送到深渊吗？ [ni neng ba wo chuan song dao shen yuan ma ？]

english: Alright, I'll go.
translation: 好吧，我这就去。 [hao ba ， wo zhe jiu qu 。]

english: About that incantation your initiate gave me...
translation: 关于你的入门者给我的那个咒语…… [guan yu ni de ru men zhe gei wo de na ge zhou yu ……]

english: Can you tell me more about the Abyss?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于深渊的事吗？ [ni neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu shen yuan de shi ma ？]

english: Can you tell me more about your group?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于你的团队的信息吗？ [ni neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu ni de tuan dui de xin xi ma ？]

english: Nothing. I'm just looking around.
translation: 没有什么。我只是看看。 [mei you shen me 。 wo zhi shi kan kan 。]

english: What's that ladder next to the altar for?
translation: 祭坛旁边的梯子是做什么用的？ [ji tan pang bian de ti zi shi zuo shen me yong de ？]

english: An...archeological dig. Yeah, a dig.
translation: 一次……考古挖掘。是的，挖。 [yi ci …… kao gu wa jue 。 shi de ， wa 。]

english: Why?
translation: 为什么？ [wei shen me ？]

english: Next to a Chaos Altar? That's a bit odd. Can I go down and have a look?
translation: 混沌祭坛旁边？这有点奇怪。我可以下去看看吗？ [hun dun ji tan pang bian ？ zhe you dian qi guai 。 wo ke yi xia qu kan kan ma ？]

english: Well...I suppose. See, we found this ancient altar, but it was pretty broken so the Z.M.I. sent some of its researchers to try and repair it.
translation: 嗯……我想。看，我们发现了这座古老的祭坛，但它已经很破烂了，所以 Z.M.I.派了一些研究人员尝试修复它。 [n …… wo xiang 。 kan ， wo men fa xian le zhe zuo gu lao de ji tan ， dan ta yi jing hen po lan le ， suo yi  Z.M.I. pai le yi xie yan jiu ren yuan chang shi xiu fu ta 。]

english: How'd that work out for them?
translation: 他们结果如何？ [ta men jie guo ru he ？]

english: Pretty well - only one died. Still, they got it working...sort of. This ancient technology can be tricky.
translation: 还好——只有一个人死了。尽管如此，他们还是让它发挥了作用......有点。这项古老的技术可能很棘手。 [hai hao —— zhi you yi ge ren si le 。 jin guan ru ci ， ta men hai shi rang ta fa hui le zuo yong ...... you dian 。 zhe xiang gu lao de ji shu ke neng hen ji shou 。]

english: What do you mean, 'sort of'? Altars either work or don't work.
translation: 你是什​​么意思，“有点”？祭坛要么起作用，要么不起作用。 [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ，“ you dian ”？ ji tan yao me qi zuo yong ， yao me bu qi zuo yong 。]

english: This one works, just not as you'd expect. You put pure essence in, but get random runes back. Some of them we don't even know how to craft!
translation: 这个有效，只是不像你想象的那样。你把纯粹的精华放进去，但会得到随机的符文。其中一些我们甚至不知道如何制作！ [zhe ge you xiao ， zhi shi bu xiang ni xiang xiang de na yang 。 ni ba chun cui de jing hua fang jin qu ， dan hui de dao sui ji de fu wen 。 qi zhong yi xie wo men shen zhi bu zhi dao ru he zhi zuo ！]

english: Sounds like a pretty good deal. Can I give it a go?
translation: 听起来很划算。我可以尝试一下吗？ [ting qi lai hen hua suan 。 wo ke yi chang shi yi xia ma ？]

english: I don't think so. The mages don't like outsiders going in; they'll probably attack you. They only patrol the short path, though, so if you used the long path, through a tunnel near the entrance, you'd probably be safe.
translation: 我不这么认为。法师们不喜欢外人进来；他们可能会攻击你。不过，他们只巡逻短路，所以如果你走长路，穿过入口附近的隧道，你可能会安全。 [wo bu zhe me ren wei 。 fa shi men bu xi huan wai ren jin lai ； ta men ke neng hui gong ji ni 。 bu guo ， ta men zhi xun luo duan lu ， suo yi ru guo ni zou zhang lu ， chuan guo ru kou fu jin de sui dao ， ni ke neng hui an quan 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Good day, newcomer. My name is Terrova. I'm here to tell you about Magic. Let's start by opening your magic interface.
translation: 美好的一天，新人。我叫特罗娃。我来这里是为了告诉你关于魔法的事情。让我们首先打开您的神奇界面。 [mei hao de yi tian ， xin ren 。 wo jiao te luo wa 。 wo lai zhe li shi wei le gao su ni guan yu mo fa de shi qing 。 rang wo men shou xian da kai nin de shen qi jie mian 。]

english: All you have to do is open the magic interface by clicking on the flashing icon.
translation: 您所要做的就是通过单击闪烁的图标打开神奇的界面。 [nin suo yao zuo de jiu shi tong guo dan ji shan shuo de tu biao da kai shen qi de jie mian 。]

english: Currently you can only cast one offensive spell called Wind Strike. Let's try it out on one of those chickens.
translation: 目前你只能施放一种名为“风击”的攻击性法术。让我们在其中一只鸡上尝试一下。 [mu qian ni zhi neng shi fang yi zhong ming wei “ feng ji ” de gong ji xing fa shu 。 rang wo men zai qi zhong yi zhi ji shang chang shi yi xia 。]

english: Sorry, I don't have any more runes just now. But I see you have plenty.
translation: 抱歉，我现在没有符文了。但我看你有很多。 [bao qian ， wo xian zai mei you fu wen le 。 dan wo kan ni you hen duo 。]

english: Well, you're all finished here now. I'll give you a reasonable number of runes when you leave.
translation: 好了，现在你们都完成了。当你离开时我会给你合理数量的符文。 [hao le ， xian zai ni men dou wan cheng le 。 dang ni li kai shi wo hui gei ni he li shu liang de fu wen 。]

english: When you get to the mainland you will find yourself in the town of Lumbridge. If you want some ideas on where to go next, talk to my friend Adventurer Jon. You can't miss him; he's wearing light blue armour with
translation: 当您到达大陆时，您会发现自己身处朗布里奇镇。如果您想知道下一步该去哪里，请与我的朋友冒险家乔恩谈谈。你不能错过他；他穿着浅蓝色的盔甲 [dang nin dao da da lu shi ， nin hui fa xian zi ji shen chu lang bu li qi zhen 。 ru guo nin xiang zhi dao xia yi bu gai qu na li ， qing yu wo de peng you mao xian jia qiao en tan tan 。 ni bu neng cuo guo ta ； ta chuan zhe qian lan se de kui jia]

english: a huge sword. There are also many tutors willing to teach you about the many skills you could learn.
translation: 一把巨大的剑。还有很多导师愿意教你可以学到的许多技能。 [yi ba ju da de jian 。 hai you hen duo dao shi yuan yi jiao ni ke yi xue dao de xu duo ji neng 。]

english: Prepare yourself!
translation: 做好准备！ [zuo hao zhun bei ！]

english: Were you planning to become an Iron[man/woman], by the way?
translation: 顺便问一下，你打算成为一名钢铁[男人/女人]吗？ [shun bian wen yi xia ， ni da suan cheng wei yi ming gang tie [ nan ren / nv ren ] ma ？]

english: What's an Iron[man/woman]?
translation: 什么是铁[男/女]？ [shen me shi tie [ nan / nv ]？]

english: If you're interested in that, you should go and ask the Iron[man/woman] tutor before you leave this island. He's standing outside my house.
translation: 如果你对此感兴趣，你应该在离开这个岛之前去询问钢铁[男/女]导师。他就站在我家门外。 [ru guo ni dui ci gan xing qu ， ni ying gai zai li kai zhe ge dao zhi qian qu xun wen gang tie [ nan / nv ] dao shi 。 ta jiu zhan zai wo jia men wai 。]

english: Thanks, I'd better go and find him.
translation: 谢谢，我还是去找他吧。 [xie xie ， wo hai shi qu zhao ta ba 。]

english: Yes, I do want to become an Iron[man/woman].
translation: 是的，我确实想成为一名铁人[男人/女人]。 [shi de ， wo que shi xiang cheng wei yi ming tie ren [ nan ren / nv ren ]。]

english: No, I'm not planning to do that.
translation: 不，我不打算这样做。 [bu ， wo bu da suan zhe yang zuo 。]

english: When you get to the mainland you will find yourself in the town of Lumbridge. If you want some ideas on where to go next, talk to my friend the Lumbridge Guide. You can't miss him; he's holding a big staff with
translation: 当您到达大陆时，您会发现自己身处朗布里奇镇。如果您想知道下一步该去哪里，请与我的朋友 Lumbridge Guide 交谈。你不能错过他；他手握着一支大手杖 [dang nin dao da da lu shi ， nin hui fa xian zi ji shen chu lang bu li qi zhen 。 ru guo nin xiang zhi dao xia yi bu gai qu na li ， qing yu wo de peng you  Lumbridge Guide  jiao tan 。 ni bu neng cuo guo ta ； ta shou wo zhe yi zhi da shou zhang]

english: a question mark on the end. He also has a white beard and carries a rucksack full of scrolls. There are also many tutors willing to teach you about the many skills you could learn.
translation: 末尾有一个问号。他还留着白胡子，背着一个装满卷轴的背包。还有很多导师愿意教你可以学到的许多技能。 [mo wei you yi ge wen hao 。 ta hai liu zhe bai hu zi ， bei zhe yi ge zhuang man juan zhou de bei bao 。 hai you hen duo dao shi yuan yi jiao ni ke yi xue dao de xu duo ji neng 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: What's an Iron[man/woman]?
translation: 什么是铁[男/女]？ [shen me shi tie [ nan / nv ]？]

english: Yes, I do want to become an Iron[man/woman].
translation: 是的，我确实想成为一名铁人[男人/女人]。 [shi de ， wo que shi xiang cheng wei yi ming tie ren [ nan ren / nv ren ]。]

english: No, I'm not planning to do that.
translation: 不，我不打算这样做。 [bu ， wo bu da suan zhe yang zuo 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Hello there adventurer, I am the Magic combat tutor. Would you like to learn about magic combat, or perhaps how to make runes?
translation: 冒险家大家好，我是魔法战斗导师。您想了解魔法战斗，或者如何制作符文吗？ [mao xian jia da jia hao ， wo shi mo fa zhan dou dao shi 。 nin xiang liao jie mo fa zhan dou ， huo zhe ru he zhi zuo fu wen ma ？]

english: Tell me about magic combat please.
translation: 请告诉我有关魔法战斗的事情。 [qing gao su wo you guan mo fa zhan dou de shi qing 。]

english: This is your spell book, this contains all the spells you can cast. To cast a spell, you will need to have the required magic level and have the right amount of the runes used to cast the spell.
translation: 这是你的咒语书，其中包含你可以施展的所有咒语。要施展法术，你需要达到所需的魔法等级，并拥有适量的符文来施展法术。 [zhe shi ni de zhou yu shu ， qi zhong bao han ni ke yi shi zhan de suo you zhou yu 。 yao shi zhan fa shu ， ni xu yao da dao suo xu de mo fa deng ji ， bing yong you shi liang de fu wen lai shi zhan fa shu 。]

english: To check the level and runes required to cast a spell, hover your mouse cursor over the spell.
translation: 要检查施展法术所需的等级和符文，请将鼠标光标悬停在该法术上。 [yao jian cha shi zhan fa shu suo xu de deng ji he fu wen ， qing jiang shu biao guang biao xuan ting zai gai fa shu shang 。]

english: If you have the right amount of runes and the magic level the spell will light up, meaning you will be able to cast it.
translation: 如果你有正确数量的符文和魔法等级，法术就会亮起，这意味着你将能够施展它。 [ru guo ni you zheng que shu liang de fu wen he mo fa deng ji ， fa shu jiu hui liang qi ， zhe yi wei zhe ni jiang neng gou shi zhan ta 。]

english: When you have a combat spell available, click on it once, then select your target. A good target would be a monster that is below your combat level.
translation: 当您有可用的战斗法术时，单击它一次，然后选择您的目标。一个好的目标是低于你战斗等级的怪物。 [dang nin you ke yong de zhan dou fa shu shi ， dan ji ta yi ci ， ran hou xuan ze nin de mu biao 。 yi ge hao de mu biao shi di yu ni zhan dou deng ji de guai wu 。]

english: Try rats in the castle or, if you're feeling brave, the goblins to the west have been causing a nuisance of themselves.
translation: 尝试一下城堡里的老鼠，或者，如果你够勇敢的话，西边的妖精们也一直在制造麻烦。 [chang shi yi xia cheng bao li de lao shu ， huo zhe ， ru guo ni gou yong gan de hua ， xi bian de yao jing men ye yi zhi zai zhi zao ma fan 。]

english: Nemarti, the Ranged Combat tutor and I both give out items every 30 minutes, however you must choose whether you want runes or ranged equipment.
translation: Nemarti、远程战斗导师和我都每 30 分钟分发一次物品，但是你必须选择是想要符文还是远程装备。 [Nemarti、 yuan cheng zhan dou dao shi he wo dou mei  30  fen zhong fen fa yi ci wu pin ， dan shi ni bi xu xuan ze shi xiang yao fu wen hai shi yuan cheng zhuang bei 。]

english: To claim runes, right-click on me and choose Claim, to claim ranged equipment right-click on the Ranged Combat tutor and select Claim.
translation: 要领取符文，请右键单击我并选择领取，要领取远程装备，请右键单击远程战斗导师并选择领取。 [yao ling qu fu wen ， qing you jian dan ji wo bing xuan ze ling qu ， yao ling qu yuan cheng zhuang bei ， qing you jian dan ji yuan cheng zhan dou dao shi bing xuan ze ling qu 。]

english: If you need some more advice, you should talk to Adventurer Jon about Adventure paths. He may even have a handy starter kit you can use.
translation: 如果您需要更多建议，您应该与冒险家乔恩讨论冒险路径。他甚至可能有一个方便的入门套件供您使用。 [ru guo nin xu yao geng duo jian yi ， nin ying gai yu mao xian jia qiao en tao lun mao xian lu jing 。 ta shen zhi ke neng you yi ge fang bian de ru men tao jian gong nin shi yong 。]

english: Is there anything else you would like to know?
translation: 您还有什么想知道的吗？ [nin hai you shen me xiang zhi dao de ma ？]

english: Of course [player name]! As a rule of thumb, if you cast the highest spell of which you're capable, you'll get the best experience possible.
translation: 当然是[玩家姓名]！根据经验，如果您施展了自己能力范围内的最高法术，您将获得尽可能最好的体验。 [dang ran shi [ wan jia xing ming ]！ gen ju jing yan ， ru guo nin shi zhan le zi ji neng li fan wei nei de zui gao fa shu ， nin jiang huo de jin ke neng zui hao de ti yan 。]

english: Superheat Item and the Alchemy spells are good ways to level magic if you are not interested in the combat aspect of magic.
translation: 如果你对魔法的战斗方面不感兴趣，过热物品和炼金术法术是升级魔法的好方法。 [ru guo ni dui mo fa de zhan dou fang mian bu gan xing qu ， guo re wu pin he lian jin shu fa shu shi sheng ji mo fa de hao fang fa 。]

english: There's always the Magic Training Arena. You can find it north of the Emir's Arena, north-east of Al Kharid. You will be able to earn some special rewards there by practicing your magic there.
translation: 总有魔法训练场。您可以在埃米尔竞技场以北、阿尔卡里德东北部找到它。通过在那里练习魔法，你将能够获得一些特殊的奖励。 [zong you mo fa xun lian chang 。 nin ke yi zai ai mi er jing ji chang yi bei 、 a er ka li de dong bei bu zhao dao ta 。 tong guo zai na li lian xi mo fa ， ni jiang neng gou huo de yi xie te shu de jiang li 。]

english: If you want a challenge, Kolodion, the master of battle magic, has set up an arena deep in the Wilderness. There you will have the chance to learn some extremely powerful spells.
translation: 如果你想要挑战，战斗魔法大师科洛迪恩在荒野深处设立了一个竞技场。在那里你将有机会学习一些极其强大的法术。 [ru guo ni xiang yao tiao zhan ， zhan dou mo fa da shi ke luo di en zai huang ye shen chu she li le yi ge jing ji chang 。 zai na li ni jiang you ji hui xue xi yi xie ji qi qiang da de fa shu 。]

english: You should investigate the treasure in the desert, you may find great benefit to your magic.
translation: 你应该调查一下沙漠中的宝藏，你可能会发现对你的魔法有很大的好处。 [ni ying gai diao cha yi xia sha mo zhong de bao zang ， ni ke neng hui fa xian dui ni de mo fa you hen da de hao chu 。]

english: Speak to the Archaeologist in the Bedabin Camp, south- west of the Shantay Pass. But be careful, this quest is not for the faint of heart and can be very dangerous.
translation: 与尚泰山口西南边的贝达宾营地的考古学家交谈。但要小心，这个任务不适合胆小的人，而且可能非常危险。 [yu shang tai shan kou xi nan bian de bei da bin ying di de kao gu xue jia jiao tan 。 dan yao xiao xin ， zhe ge ren wu bu shi he dan xiao de ren ， er qie ke neng fei chang wei xian 。]

english: I see you already have access to the ancient magicks. Well done, these will aid you greatly.
translation: 我看到你已经可以使用古老的魔法了。干得好，这些会对你有很大帮助。 [wo kan dao ni yi jing ke yi shi yong gu lao de mo fa le 。 gan de hao ， zhe xie hui dui ni you hen da bang zhu 。]

english: I see you have already met Kolodion, you should keep practicing those spells. Maybe you will be able to use them outside the arena after practicing them enough times.
translation: 我看你已经遇到了科洛迪恩，你应该继续练习那些法术。也许在练习足够多的次数后，你就能在竞技场之外使用它们。 [wo kan ni yi jing yu dao le ke luo di en ， ni ying gai ji xu lian xi na xie fa shu 。 ye xu zai lian xi zu gou duo de ci shu hou ， ni jiu neng zai jing ji chang zhi wai shi yong ta men 。]

english: How do I make runes?
translation: 我如何制作符文？ [wo ru he zhi zuo fu wen ？]

english: There are a couple of things you will need to make runes, rune essence and a talisman to enter the temple ruins.
translation: 制作符文、符文精华和护身符需要一些东西才能进入神庙遗址。 [zhi zuo fu wen 、 fu wen jing hua he hu shen fu xu yao yi xie dong xi cai neng jin ru shen miao yi zhi 。]

english: To get rune essence you will need to gather them somehow. You should talk to the Duke of Lumbridge, he may be able to help you with that. Alternatively, other players may sell you the essence.
translation: 要获得符文精华，您需要以某种方式收集它们。你应该和朗布里奇公爵谈谈，他也许能帮助你。或者，其他玩家可能会向您出售精华。 [yao huo de fu wen jing hua ， nin xu yao yi mou zhong fang shi shou ji ta men 。 ni ying gai he lang bu li qi gong jue tan tan ， ta ye xu neng bang zhu ni 。 huo zhe ， qi ta wan jia ke neng hui xiang nin chu shou jing hua 。]

english: As you're fairly new to runecrafting you should start with air runes and mind runes.
translation: 由于您对符文制作相当陌生，因此您应该从空气符文和心灵符文开始。 [you yu nin dui fu wen zhi zuo xiang dang mo sheng ， yin ci nin ying gai cong kong qi fu wen he xin ling fu wen kai shi 。]

english: You will need a talisman for the rune you would like to create. You can right-click on it and select the Locate option. This will tell you the rough location of the altar.
translation: 您将需要一个用于您想要创建的符文的护身符。您可以右键单击它并选择“查找”选项。这会告诉你祭坛的大致位置。 [nin jiang xu yao yi ge yong yu nin xiang yao chuang jian de fu wen de hu shen fu 。 nin ke yi you jian dan ji ta bing xuan ze “ cha zhao ” xuan xiang 。 zhe hui gao su ni ji tan de da zhi wei zhi 。]

english: When you find the ruined altar, use the talisman on it to be transported to a temple where you can craft your runes.
translation: 当你找到被毁的祭坛时，使用上面的护身符将其运送到一座寺庙，在那里你可以制作你的符文。 [dang ni zhao dao bei hui de ji tan shi ， shi yong shang mian de hu shen fu jiang qi yun song dao yi zuo si miao ， zai na li ni ke yi zhi zuo ni de fu wen 。]

english: Clicking on the temple's altar will imbue your rune essence with the altar's magical property.
translation: 点击神庙的祭坛将使你的符文精华充满祭坛的魔法属性。 [dian ji shen miao de ji tan jiang shi ni de fu wen jing hua chong man ji tan de mo fa shu xing 。]

english: If you want to save yourself an inventory space, you could always try binding the talisman to a tiara.
translation: 如果你想节省库存空间，你可以尝试将护身符绑在头饰上。 [ru guo ni xiang jie sheng ku cun kong jian ， ni ke yi chang shi jiang hu shen fu bang zai tou shi shang 。]

english: To make one, take a tiara and talisman to the ruins and use the tiara on the temple altar. This will bind the talisman to your tiara.
translation: 要制作一个，请将头饰和护身符带到废墟，然后在寺庙祭坛上使用头饰。这会将护身符绑定到您的头饰上。 [yao zhi zuo yi ge ， qing jiang tou shi he hu shen fu dai dao fei xu ， ran hou zai si miao ji tan shang shi yong tou shi 。 zhe hui jiang hu shen fu bang ding dao nin de tou shi shang 。]

english: I see you have some experience already in Runecrafting. Perhaps you should try crafting some runes which you can then use in magic.
translation: 我发现你在符文制作方面已经有一些经验了。也许你应该尝试制作一些符文，然后可以在魔法中使用它们。 [wo fa xian ni zai fu wen zhi zuo fang mian yi jing you yi xie jing yan le 。 ye xu ni ying gai chang shi zhi zuo yi xie fu wen ， ran hou ke yi zai mo fa zhong shi yong ta men 。]

english: Check the skill guide to see which runes you can craft.
translation: 查看技能指南，了解您可以制作哪些符文。 [cha kan ji neng zhi nan ， liao jie nin ke yi zhi zuo na xie fu wen 。]

english: To get rune essence you will need to gather them in the essence mine. You can get to the mine by talking to Aubury who owns the runes shop in south east Varrock.
translation: 要获得符文精华，您需要将它们收集到精华矿井中。你可以通过与奥伯里交谈来到达矿井，奥伯里在瓦罗克东南部拥有符文商店。 [yao huo de fu wen jing hua ， nin xu yao jiang ta men shou ji dao jing hua kuang jing zhong 。 ni ke yi tong guo yu ao bo li jiao tan lai dao da kuang jing ， ao bo li zai wa luo ke dong nan bu yong you fu wen shang dian 。]

english: Let's discuss how my runes act when I pick them up.
translation: 让我们讨论一下当我拿起符文时它们会如何表现。 [rang wo men tao lun yi xia dang wo na qi fu wen shi ta men hui ru he biao xian 。]

english: When you pick up runes from the ground, if you're carrying a rune pouch that contains matching runes, I can make the runes you've picked up go straight into the pouch, provided there's space.
translation: 当你从地上捡起符文时，如果你带着一个包含匹配符文的符文袋，我可以让你捡到的符文直接放入袋中，只要有空间。 [dang ni cong di shang jian qi fu wen shi ， ru guo ni dai zhe yi ge bao han pi pei fu wen de fu wen dai ， wo ke yi rang ni jian dao de fu wen zhi jie fang ru dai zhong ， zhi yao you kong jian 。]

english: Alternatively, you can let them go into your inventory like normal.
translation: 或者，您可以让它们像平常一样进入您的库存。 [huo zhe ， nin ke yi rang ta men xiang ping chang yi yang jin ru nin de ku cun 。]

english: Certainly! Runes will go straight to your rune pouch when you pick them up, if it contains matching runes.
translation: 当然！当你拿起符文袋时，如果其中包含匹配的符文，符文将直接进入你的符文袋。 [dang ran ！ dang ni na qi fu wen dai shi ， ru guo qi zhong bao han pi pei de fu wen ， fu wen jiang zhi jie jin ru ni de fu wen dai 。]

english: Certainly! Runes will go to your inventory when you pick them up, rather than going into a rune pouch.
translation: 当然！当你拿起符文时，它们会进入你的库存，而不是进入符文袋。 [dang ran ！ dang ni na qi fu wen shi ， ta men hui jin ru ni de ku cun ， er bu shi jin ru fu wen dai 。]

english: You can also control this option via the Settings menu, rather than having to return to this Tutor in future.
translation: 您还可以通过“设置”菜单控制此选项，而不必将来返回到此导师。 [nin hai ke yi tong guo “ she zhi ” cai dan kong zhi ci xuan xiang ， er bu bi jiang lai fan hui dao ci dao shi 。]

english: Is there anything else I can do for you?
translation: 我还能为您做些什么吗？ [wo hai neng wei nin zuo xie shen me ma ？]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Can you teach me the basics please?
translation: 你能教我基础知识吗？ [ni neng jiao wo ji chu zhi shi ma ？]

english: Why certainly! You already know a little about creating runes I see.
translation: 为什么当然！我看你已经对创建符文有所了解了。 [wei shen me dang ran ！ wo kan ni yi jing dui chuang jian fu wen you suo liao jie le 。]

english: You can cast different spells according to what runes you have in your inventory. To begin, you'll need mind runes and air runes. These will allow you to cast Wind Strike like you did in the tutorial.
translation: 您可以根据库存中的符文施放不同的法术。首先，你需要心灵符文和空气符文。这些将允许您像教程中那样施放风击。 [nin ke yi gen ju ku cun zhong de fu wen shi fang bu tong de fa shu 。 shou xian ， ni xu yao xin ling fu wen he kong qi fu wen 。 zhe xie jiang yun xu nin xiang jiao cheng zhong na yang shi fang feng ji 。]

english: Check the spellbook side-panel to see which spells you can cast. If you have the correct runes for a spell, it will light up.
translation: 检查法术书侧面板，看看你可以施展哪些法术。如果你有正确的咒语符文，它就会亮起。 [jian cha fa shu shu ce mian ban ， kan kan ni ke yi shi zhan na xie fa shu 。 ru guo ni you zheng que de zhou yu fu wen ， ta jiu hui liang qi 。]

english: Nemarti, the Ranged Combat tutor and I both give out items every 30 minutes, however you must choose whether you want runes or ranged equipment. To claim runes, right-click on me and choose Claim, to claim
translation: Nemarti、远程战斗导师和我都每 30 分钟分发一次物品，但是你必须选择是想要符文还是远程装备。要领取符文，请右键单击我并选择“领取”，以领取 [Nemarti、 yuan cheng zhan dou dao shi he wo dou mei  30  fen zhong fen fa yi ci wu pin ， dan shi ni bi xu xuan ze shi xiang yao fu wen hai shi yuan cheng zhuang bei 。 yao ling qu fu wen ， qing you jian dan ji wo bing xuan ze “ ling qu ”， yi ling qu]

english: ranged equipment right-click on the Ranged Combat tutor and select Claim.
translation: 远程装备右键单击远程战斗导师并选择领取。 [yuan cheng zhuang bei you jian dan ji yuan cheng zhan dou dao shi bing xuan ze ling qu 。]

english: Teach me about making runes.
translation: 教我制作符文。 [jiao wo zhi zuo fu wen 。]

english: I see that you've already found out about the Rune Essence mines from my friend Aubury in Varrock. So you need to turn that essence into runes, eh?
translation: 我发现你已经从我在瓦罗克的朋友奥伯里那里了解到了符文精华矿。所以你需要将其本质转化为符文，是吗？ [wo fa xian ni yi jing cong wo zai wa luo ke de peng you ao bo li na li liao jie dao le fu wen jing hua kuang 。 suo yi ni xu yao jiang qi ben zhi zhuan hua wei fu wen ， shi ma ？]

english: You'll need a mind or air talisman before you can begin. This will enable you to find and use the ruins of the altars.
translation: 在开始之前，你需要一个心灵护身符或空气护身符。这将使您能够找到并使用祭坛废墟。 [zai kai shi zhi qian ， ni xu yao yi ge xin ling hu shen fu huo kong qi hu shen fu 。 zhe jiang shi nin neng gou zhao dao bing shi yong ji tan fei xu 。]

english: I heard that goblins occasionally drop air talismans when they die - they must be stealing them from somewhere!
translation: 我听说哥布林死后偶尔会掉落空气符——他们一定是从什么地方偷来的！ [wo ting shuo ge bu lin si hou ou er hui diao luo kong qi fu —— ta men yi ding shi cong shen me di fang tou lai de ！]

english: Mind talismans can occasionally be found on imps, if you can kill such a fast-moving creature.
translation: 如果你能杀死这种快速移动的生物，偶尔可以在小恶魔身上找到心灵护身符。 [ru guo ni neng sha si zhe zhong kuai su yi dong de sheng wu ， ou er ke yi zai xiao e mo shen shang zhao dao xin ling hu shen fu 。]

english: When you have your talisman, right-click on it and select the Locate option. It will point you in the direction of the ruined altar.
translation: 获得护身符后，右键单击它并选择“定位”选项。它会指引你走向被毁坏的祭坛的方向。 [huo de hu shen fu hou ， you jian dan ji ta bing xuan ze “ ding wei ” xuan xiang 。 ta hui zhi yin ni zou xiang bei hui huai de ji tan de fang xiang 。]

english: You'll need some Rune Essence with you before you go looking. When you find the ruined altar, use the talisman on it to be transported to a temple where you can craft your runes.
translation: 在你去寻找之前，你需要携带一些符文精华。当你找到被毁的祭坛时，使用上面的护身符将其运送到一座寺庙，在那里你可以制作你的符文。 [zai ni qu xun zhao zhi qian ， ni xu yao xie dai yi xie fu wen jing hua 。 dang ni zhao dao bei hui de ji tan shi ， shi yong shang mian de hu shen fu jiang qi yun song dao yi zuo si miao ， zai na li ni ke yi zhi zuo ni de fu wen 。]

english: You have some mind runes in your bank.
translation: 你的银行里有一些心灵符文。 [ni de yin hang li you yi xie xin ling fu wen 。]

english: You have some air runes in your bank.
translation: 你的银行里有一些空气符文。 [ni de yin hang li you yi xie kong qi fu wen 。]

english: You have some runes in your bank. Climb the stairs in Lumbridge Castle until you see this icon on your minimap. There you will find a bank.
translation: 你的银行里有一些符文。爬上朗布里奇城堡的楼梯，直到您在小地图上看到此图标。在那里你会找到一家银行。 [ni de yin hang li you yi xie fu wen 。 pa shang lang bu li qi cheng bao de lou ti ， zhi dao nin zai xiao di tu shang kan dao ci tu biao 。 zai na li ni hui zhao dao yi jia yin hang 。]

english: You already have some air runes.
translation: 你已经有一些空气符文了。 [ni yi jing you yi xie kong qi fu wen le 。]

english: If you had enough space in your inventory I'd give you some air runes, come back when you do.
translation: 如果你的物品栏里有足够的空间，我会给你一些空气符文，当你这样做时再回来。 [ru guo ni de wu pin lan li you zu gou de kong jian ， wo hui gei ni yi xie kong qi fu wen ， dang ni zhe yang zuo shi zai hui lai 。]

english: Mikasi gives you 30 air runes.
translation: 米卡西给你 30 个空气符文。 [mi ka xi gei ni  30  ge kong qi fu wen 。]

english: You already have some mind runes.
translation: 你已经有了一些心灵符文。 [ni yi jing you le yi xie xin ling fu wen 。]

english: If you had enough space in your inventory I'd give you some mind runes, come back when you do.
translation: 如果你的物品栏里有足够的空间，我会给你一些心灵符文，当你这样做时再回来。 [ru guo ni de wu pin lan li you zu gou de kong jian ， wo hui gei ni yi xie xin ling fu wen ， dang ni zhe yang zuo shi zai hui lai 。]

english: Mikasi gives you 30 mind runes.
translation: 米卡西给你 30 个心灵符文。 [mi ka xi gei ni  30  ge xin ling fu wen 。]

english: I work with the Ranged Combat tutor to give out consumable items that you may need for combat such as arrows and runes. However we have had some cheeky people try to take both!
translation: 我与远程战斗导师合作，提供战斗中可能需要的消耗品，例如箭头和符文。然而，我们有一些厚脸皮的人试图两者兼得！ [wo yu yuan cheng zhan dou dao shi he zuo ， ti gong zhan dou zhong ke neng xu yao de xiao hao pin ， li ru jian tou he fu wen 。 ran er ， wo men you yi xie hou lian pi de ren shi tu liang zhe jian de ！]

english: So, every half an hour, you may come back and claim either arrows OR runes, but not both. Come back in a while for runes, or simply make your own.
translation: 因此，每半小时，您可以回来领取箭或符文，但不能两者兼而有之。过段时间再回来寻找符文，或者干脆自己制作符文。 [yin ci ， mei ban xiao shi ， nin ke yi hui lai ling qu jian huo fu wen ， dan bu neng liang zhe jian er you zhi 。 guo duan shi jian zai hui lai xun zhao fu wen ， huo zhe gan cui zi ji zhi zuo fu wen 。]

english: I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun! Pleased to meet you!
translation: 我是多格舒恩的扎尼克！很高兴认识你！ [wo shi duo ge shu en de zha ni ke ！ hen gao xing ren shi ni ！]

english: Greetings Zanik! You look like someone who might know something about spells!
translation: 问候扎尼克！你看起来像是一个可能懂得咒语的人！ [wen hou zha ni ke ！ ni kan qi lai xiang shi yi ge ke neng dong de zhou yu de ren ！]

english: Actually I don't know anything about spells.
translation: 其实我对法术一无所知。 [qi shi wo dui fa shu yi wu suo zhi 。]

english: Well, if you have some air runes and mind runes you can cast Wind Strike...
translation: 好吧，如果你有一些空气符文和心灵符文，你可以施放风击…… [hao ba ， ru guo ni you yi xie kong qi fu wen he xin ling fu wen ， ni ke yi shi fang feng ji ……]

english: How?
translation: 如何？ [ru he ？]

english: You can't even cast Wind Strike?
translation: 连风击都施展不了？ [lian feng ji dou shi zhan bu liao ？]

english: We Dorgeshuun don't have any magical knowledge at all.
translation: 我们多格舒恩根本没有任何魔法知识。 [wo men duo ge shu en gen ben mei you ren he mo fa zhi shi 。]

english: Well, if you don't know the basics at all it'll take a long time to teach you...
translation: 好吧，如果你根本不了解基础知识，那么就需要很长时间来教你...... [hao ba ， ru guo ni gen ben bu liao jie ji chu zhi shi ， na me jiu xu yao hen zhang shi jian lai jiao ni ......]

english: Perhaps some other time then.
translation: 也许其他时间吧。 [ye xu qi ta shi jian ba 。]

english: How about you, [player name]? Do you want any help?
translation: 你呢，[玩家姓名]？您需要帮助吗？ [ni ne ，[ wan jia xing ming ]？ nin xu yao bang zhu ma ？]

english: Tell me about magic combat please.
translation: 请告诉我有关魔法战斗的事情。 [qing gao su wo you guan mo fa zhan dou de shi qing 。]

english: How do I make runes?
translation: 我如何制作符文？ [wo ru he zhi zuo fu wen ？]

english: Let's discuss how my runes act when I pick them up.
translation: 让我们讨论一下当我拿起符文时它们会如何表现。 [rang wo men tao lun yi xia dang wo na qi fu wen shi ta men hui ru he biao xian 。]

english: Automatically send to rune pouch.
translation: 自动发送至符文袋。 [zi dong fa song zhi fu wen dai 。]

english: Place them in my inventory.
translation: 将它们放入我的库存中。 [jiang ta men fang ru wo de ku cun zhong 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Can you toggle my runes to equip when I pick them up please?
translation: 当我拿起符文时，你能切换它们来装备吗？ [dang wo na qi fu wen shi ， ni neng qie huan ta men lai zhuang bei ma ？]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 你知道，打招呼的方式有很多种。你好，你好，你好…… [ni zhi dao ， da zhao hu de fang shi you hen duo zhong 。 ni hao ， ni hao ， ni hao ……]

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 那还是只能算一个！ [na hai shi zhi neng suan yi ge ！]

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。你今天怎么样？ [ni hao 。 ni jin tian zen me yang ？]

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很棒，谢谢你！ [wo hen bang ， xie xie ni ！]

english: Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 你好！水晶城里今天过得怎么样啊？ [ni hao ！ shui jing cheng li jin tian guo de zen me yang a ？]
