translation: 不管怎样，你想让我改变你的身体形态吗？为了你，我免费做！ [bu guan zen yang ， ni xiang rang wo gai bian ni de shen ti xing tai ma ？ wei le ni ， wo mian fei zuo ！]

english: No way! That's far too expensive.
translation: 决不！那太贵了。 [jue bu ！ na tai gui le 。]

english: That's fair enough, my jewellery is not to everyone's taste.
translation: 这很公平，我的珠宝并不适合每个人的口味。 [zhe hen gong ping ， wo de zhu bao bing bu shi he mei ge ren de kou wei 。]

english: Sure, here you go.
translation: 当然，给你。 [dang ran ， gei ni 。]

english: I don't have room to hold it. Maybe another time.
translation: 我没有空间容纳它。也许下次吧。 [wo mei you kong jian rong na ta 。 ye xu xia ci ba 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Ehhh... suit yourself.
translation: 呃……适合自己吧。 [e …… shi he zi ji ba 。]

english: Ahah!
translation: 啊哈！ [a ha ！]

english: Ooh!
Tell me more about this 'make-over'.
translation: 告诉我更多关于这个“改造”的信息。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu zhe ge “ gai zao ” de xin xi 。]

english: Sure, I'll have a makeover.
translation: 当然，我会整容一下。 [dang ran ， wo hui zheng rong yi xia 。]

english: Cool amulet! Can I have one?
translation: 酷护身符！我可以拥有一个吗？ [ku hu shen fu ！ wo ke yi yong you yi ge ma ？]

english: Sure, here you go.
translation: 当然，给你。 [dang ran ， gei ni 。]

english: No way! That's far too expensive.
translation: 决不！那太贵了。 [jue bu ！ na tai gui le 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Be lucky I have let you live, meat. Our deal is done, I wish no further dealing with you.
translation: 幸运的是我让你活了下来，肉。我们的交易已经完成，我不想再和你打交道了。 [xing yun de shi wo rang ni huo le xia lai ， rou 。 wo men de jiao yi yi jing wan cheng ， wo bu xiang zai he ni da jiao dao le 。]

english: M-my lord Malak, what brings you here?
translation: 马拉克大人，您为何来到这里？ [ma la ke da ren ， nin wei he lai dao zhe li ？]

english: Hmmm? You know very well that your tithe is due, Roavar.
translation: 嗯？你很清楚你的什一税该交了，罗瓦。 [n ？ ni hen qing chu ni de shen yi shui gai jiao le ， luo wa 。]

english: I am here to collect it this time.
translation: 我这次是来收集的。 [wo zhe ci shi lai shou ji de 。]

english: Y-yes of course, sire, but surely your graciousness is too important to perform such menial duties such as this himself?
translation: 是——是的，当然，陛下，但是您的仁慈确实太重要了，以至于不能亲自履行这样的卑微职责吗？ [shi —— shi de ， dang ran ， bi xia ， dan shi nin de ren ci que shi tai zhong yao le ， yi zhi yu bu neng qin zi lv xing zhe yang de bei wei zhi ze ma ？]

english: Is this not Gadderanks job, your most high beneficence?
translation: 这不是加德兰克的工作，也是您最高的仁慈吗？ [zhe bu shi jia de lan ke de gong zuo ， ye shi nin zui gao de ren ci ma ？]

english: Indeed it is Roavar, but I cannot find that incompetent fool. And assuming you are not the one who wishes to tell Lord Drakan that his tithe has not been collected, I saw
translation: 确实是罗阿瓦尔，但我找不到那个无能的傻瓜。假设你不是那个想告诉 Drakan 勋爵他的什一税尚未征收的人，我看到 [que shi shi luo a wa er ， dan wo zhao bu dao na ge wu neng de sha gua 。 jia she ni bu shi na ge xiang gao su  Drakan  xun jue ta de shen yi shui shang wei zheng shou de ren ， wo kan dao]

english: fit to take on the duty myself this time.
translation: 这次我适合自己承担这个职责。 [zhe ci wo shi he zi ji cheng dan zhe ge zhi ze 。]

english: Of course my lord, I meant no disrespect.
translation: 当然，陛下，我并无不敬之意。 [dang ran ， bi xia ， wo bing wu bu jing zhi yi 。]

english: So you have the tithe ready for me?
translation: 那么你已经为我准备好什一税了吗？ [na me ni yi jing wei wo zhun bei hao shen yi shui le ma ？]

english: Of course my lord, I trust you will find it all there and in good order.
translation: 当然，大人，我相信您会在那里找到一切并且井然有序。 [dang ran ， da ren ， wo xiang xin nin hui zai na li zhao dao yi qie bing qie jing ran you xu 。]

english: Hmmm. Well, for your sake you had better hope that indeed it is.
translation: 嗯。好吧，为了你的缘故，你最好希望事实确实如此。 [n 。 hao ba ， wei le ni de yuan gu ， ni zui hao xi wang shi shi que shi ru ci 。]

english: The mood I am in for having to come to this wolfen cesspit means any shortfall is coming from you directly.
translation: 我不得不来到这个狼坑的心情意味着任何短缺都直接来自于你。 [wo bu de bu lai dao zhe ge lang keng de xin qing yi wei zhe ren he duan que dou zhi jie lai zi yu ni 。]

english: Then again... perhaps this was not a total waste of my time after all.
translation: 话又说回来……也许这毕竟不是完全浪费我的时间。 [hua you shuo hui lai …… ye xu zhe bi jing bu shi wan quan lang fei wo de shi jian 。]

english: You there!
translation: 你在那里！ [ni zai na li ！]

english: M-me?
translation: M-我？ [M- wo ？]

english: Yes, you. Your bearing suggests you are not one of the usual peasants, and your stench suggests you are not one of these filthy wolfen folk.
translation: 是的，你。你的举止表明你不是普通的农民之一，你的恶臭表明你不是这些肮脏的狼人中的一员。 [shi de ， ni 。 ni de ju zhi biao ming ni bu shi pu tong de nong min zhi yi ， ni de e chou biao ming ni bu shi zhe xie ang zang de lang ren zhong de yi yuan 。]

english: Come here, I would like to know what you are doing in these lands.
translation: 来这里，我想知道你在这片土地上做什么。 [lai zhe li ， wo xiang zhi dao ni zai zhe pian tu di shang zuo shen me 。]

english: A human, eh? Don't think that silly little ring of yours will fool me. Give me one good reason why I should not just take you to Lord Drakan now.
translation: 一个人类，是吗？别以为你那枚愚蠢的小戒指能骗过我。请给我一个充分的理由，为什么我现在不应该带你去见德拉坎勋爵。 [yi ge ren lei ， shi ma ？ bie yi wei ni na mei yu chun de xiao jie zhi neng pian guo wo 。 qing gei wo yi ge chong fen de li you ， wei shen me wo xian zai bu ying gai dai ni qu jian de la kan xun jue 。]

english: A human, eh? Give me one good reason why I should not just take you to Lord Drakan now.
translation: 一个人类，是吗？请给我一个充分的理由，为什么我现在不应该带你去见德拉坎勋爵。 [yi ge ren lei ， shi ma ？ qing gei wo yi ge chong fen de li you ， wei shen me wo xian zai bu ying gai dai ni qu jian de la kan xun jue 。]

english: You had better make it a good one too, or you will not survive the night, I'll wager.
translation: 我敢打赌，你最好也把它做好，否则你今晚就活不下去了。 [wo gan da du ， ni zui hao ye ba ta zuo hao ， fou ze ni jin wan jiu huo bu xia qu le 。]

english: I am here to worship the almighty Zamorak! Yay! Go Zamorak!
translation: 我来这里是为了崇拜全能的萨莫拉克！耶！萨莫拉克加油！ [wo lai zhe li shi wei le chong bai quan neng de sa mo la ke ！ ye ！ sa mo la ke jia you ！]

english: I see. You are a moron. You have probably settled right in with the rest of the idiots in this pathetic excuse for a village.
translation: 我懂了。你是个白痴。你可能已经和其他白痴一起以这个可悲的村庄借口安顿下来了。 [wo dong le 。 ni shi ge bai chi 。 ni ke neng yi jing he qi ta bai chi yi qi yi zhe ge ke bei de cun zhuang jie kou an dun xia lai le 。]

english: Unfortunately for you, that is not a good enough reason to explain your presence here.
translation: 对你来说不幸的是，这并不足以解释你在这里的理由。 [dui ni lai shuo bu xing de shi ， zhe bing bu zu yi jie shi ni zai zhe li de li you 。]

english: Now tell me the reason for your coming here, or I will ensure you suffer a horrible fate indeed.
translation: 现在告诉我你来这里的原因，否则我会确保你遭受可怕的命运。 [xian zai gao su wo ni lai zhe li de yuan yin ， fou ze wo hui que bao ni zao shou ke pa de ming yun 。]

english: I am here only to serve the mighty Drakan. Yup, Drakan, he's the man.
translation: 我来这里只是为了服务强大的德拉坎。是的，Drakan，他就是那个人。 [wo lai zhe li zhi shi wei le fu wu qiang da de de la kan 。 shi de ，Drakan， ta jiu shi na ge ren 。]

english: I see. I would perhaps be more inclined to believe you if I could not smell the death blood of his brother Draynor upon you.
translation: 我懂了。如果我不能在你身上闻到他兄弟德雷纳的死亡血迹，我也许会更愿意相信你。 [wo dong le 。 ru guo wo bu neng zai ni shen shang wen dao ta xiong di de lei na de si wang xue ji ， wo ye xu hui geng yuan yi xiang xin ni 。]

english: What are your real intentions here?
translation: 你来这里的真正意图是什么？ [ni lai zhe li de zhen zheng yi tu shi shen me ？]

english: Really? That is interesting, that you would want to give your life by trespassing in this land for such an unbelievable reason.
translation: 真的吗？这很有趣，你会因为如此令人难以置信的原因而愿意通过侵入这片土地来献出自己的生命。 [zhen de ma ？ zhe hen you qu ， ni hui yin wei ru ci ling ren nan yi zhi xin de yuan yin er yuan yi tong guo qin ru zhe pian tu di lai xian chu zi ji de sheng ming 。]

english: Now speak, what is your purpose in coming here?
translation: 现在说吧，你来这里的目的是什么？ [xian zai shuo ba ， ni lai zhe li de mu di shi shen me ？]

english: I came here looking for you, oh mighty Malak, so that I might serve your glory!
translation: 我来这里是为了寻找你，强大的马拉克，这样我才能为你的荣耀服务！ [wo lai zhe li shi wei le xun zhao ni ， qiang da de ma la ke ， zhe yang wo cai neng wei ni de rong yao fu wu ！]

english: Please. Do not think that I am so vain and foolish as to allow you to avoid my question with such obvious sycophancy.
translation: 请。别以为我是那么虚荣和愚蠢，竟然允许你用如此明显的阿谀奉承来回避我的问题。 [qing 。 bie yi wei wo shi na me xu rong he yu chun ， jing ran yun xu ni yong ru ci ming xian de e yu feng cheng lai hui bi wo de wen ti 。]

english: Now tell me the reason behind your being here, or I will ensure that you suffer.
translation: 现在告诉我你来这里的原因，否则我会让你受苦。 [xian zai gao su wo ni lai zhe li de yuan yin ， fou ze wo hui rang ni shou ku 。]

english: I am here to kill Lord Drakan, and every stinking one of his vampyre brood!
translation: 我来这里是为了杀死德拉坎大人，以及他的每一个臭吸血鬼！ [wo lai zhe li shi wei le sha si de la kan da ren ， yi ji ta de mei yi ge chou xi xue gui ！]

english: Hah! Most entertaining, human!
translation: 哈！最有趣的是，人类！ [ha ！ zui you qu de shi ， ren lei ！]

english: Now tell me the reason you are here, or we shall soon see who will be killing whom.
translation: 现在告诉我你来这里的原因，否则我们很快就会看到谁会杀死谁。 [xian zai gao su wo ni lai zhe li de yuan yin ， fou ze wo men hen kuai jiu hui kan dao shui hui sha si shui 。]

english: I am here looking for a special diamond... I have reason to believe it is somewhere in this vicinity, and it is probably in the possession of a warrior of Zamorak.
translation: 我来这里是为了寻找一颗特殊的钻石……我有理由相信它就在这附近的某个地方，而且可能是萨莫拉克战士的拥有者。 [wo lai zhe li shi wei le xun zhao yi ke te shu de zuan shi …… wo you li you xiang xin ta jiu zai zhe fu jin de mou ge di fang ， er qie ke neng shi sa mo la ke zhan shi de yong you zhe 。]

english: I'm fairly sure it will have some kind of magical aura or something too. I don't suppose you've seen it, or know where it might be?
translation: 我相当确定它也会有某种魔法光环之类的东西。我想你没有见过它，或者不知道它在哪里？ [wo xiang dang que ding ta ye hui you mou zhong mo fa guang huan zhi lei de dong xi 。 wo xiang ni mei you jian guo ta ， huo zhe bu zhi dao ta zai na li ？]

english: Interesting... Well perhaps we can come to a little... arrangement, human.
translation: 有趣……好吧，也许我们可以达成一些……安排，人类。 [you qu …… hao ba ， ye xu wo men ke yi da cheng yi xie …… an pai ， ren lei 。]

english: I may have information that may assist you, but you in turn will have to do something for me. What do you say? Do you think we could come to some form of
translation: 我可能有可以帮助你的信息，但你也必须为我做点什么。你怎么说？你认为我们可以达成某种形式 [wo ke neng you ke yi bang zhu ni de xin xi ， dan ni ye bi xu wei wo zuo dian shen me 。 ni zen me shuo ？ ni ren wei wo men ke yi da cheng mou zhong xing shi]

english: agreement?
translation: 协议？ [xie yi ？]

english: Well, what kind of something? No offence, but you're not exactly the trustworthy type...
translation: 嗯，什么样的东西？无意冒犯，但你并不是那种值得信赖的人…… [n ， shen me yang de dong xi ？ wu yi mao fan ， dan ni bing bu shi na zhong zhi de xin lai de ren ……]

english: Ah, you have a healthy sense of paranoia, I see. It is not a particularly unfair request on my part...
translation: 啊，我明白了，你有一种健康的偏执感。对我来说这并不是一个特别不公平的要求...... [a ， wo ming bai le ， ni you yi zhong jian kang de pian zhi gan 。 dui wo lai shuo zhe bing bu shi yi ge te bie bu gong ping de yao qiu ......]

english: All I ask is that you ensure that the current owner of the diamond is killed. For my part, I will let you know his whereabouts, and how exactly to kill him.
translation: 我所要求的只是你确保钻石的当前所有者被杀死。就我而言，我会让你知道他的下落，以及到底如何杀死他。 [wo suo yao qiu de zhi shi ni que bao zuan shi di dang qian suo you zhe bei sha si 。 jiu wo er yan ， wo hui rang ni zhi dao ta de xia luo ， yi ji dao di ru he sha si ta 。]

english: When he is dead, you may take the diamond from his corpse and do with it what you will. I have no interest in such baubles.
translation: 当他死后，你可以从他的尸体上取出钻石，并用它做你想做的事。我对这种小玩意没兴趣。 [dang ta si hou ， ni ke yi cong ta de shi ti shang qu chu zuan shi ， bing yong ta zuo ni xiang zuo de shi 。 wo dui zhe zhong xiao wan yi mei xing qu 。]

english: So what say you? A life for a diamond. As a mark of good faith, I will give you some information free:
translation: 那你怎么说呢？钻石的一生。作为诚意的标志，我将免费向您提供一些信息： [na ni zen me shuo ne ？ zuan shi de yi sheng 。 zuo wei cheng yi de biao zhi ， wo jiang mian fei xiang nin ti gong yi xie xin xi ：]

english: The current owner of this diamond is named Dessous.
translation: 这颗钻石的现任所有者名叫 Dessous。 [zhe ke zuan shi de xian ren suo you zhe ming jiao  Dessous。]

english: I don't trust you, or anything you say. I'm afraid I have to decline.
translation: 我不相信你，也不相信你说的任何话。恐怕我不得不拒绝。 [wo bu xiang xin ni ， ye bu xiang xin ni shuo de ren he hua 。 kong pa wo bu de bu ju jue 。]

english: As you wish human. I doubt anybody near here knows of the diamond you seek, however.
translation: 如你所愿的人类。不过，我怀疑附近有人知道您要找的钻石。 [ru ni suo yuan de ren lei 。 bu guo ， wo huai yi fu jin you ren zhi dao nin yao zhao de zuan shi 。]

english: If you wish to claim it as your own, you have little choice but to accept my bargain. I will wait here until such time as you change your mind.
translation: 如果你想把它据为己有，你别无选择，只能接受我的讨价还价。我会在这里等你改变主意。 [ru guo ni xiang ba ta ju wei ji you ， ni bie wu xuan ze ， zhi neng jie shou wo de tao jia huan jia 。 wo hui zai zhe li deng ni gai bian zhu yi 。]

english: Well... I can't see any drawback. Okay, I accept your offer. Now tell me what you know.
translation: 嗯……我看不出有什么缺点。好的，我接受你的提议。现在告诉我你所知道的。 [n …… wo kan bu chu you shen me que dian 。 hao de ， wo jie shou ni de ti yi 。 xian zai gao su wo ni suo zhi dao de 。]

english: What I know? Hah! After you have been alive for as long as I, the things I know are enough to fill a library.
translation: 我知道什么？哈！你活了和我一样长之后，我所知道的东西就足够装满一个图书馆了。 [wo zhi dao shen me ？ ha ！ ni huo le he wo yi yang zhang zhi hou ， wo suo zhi dao de dong xi jiu zu gou zhuang man yi ge tu shu guan le 。]

english: I'm afraid you will need to be a little more specific.
translation: 恐怕你需要说得更具体一点。 [kong pa ni xu yao shuo de geng ju ti yi dian 。]

english: I don't see exactly how this bargain benefits you... Why exactly do you want Dessous killed anyway?
translation: 我不明白这笔交易到底对你有什么好处……你到底为什么要杀掉黛索？ [wo bu ming bai zhe bi jiao yi dao di dui ni you shen me hao chu …… ni dao di wei shen me yao sha diao dai suo ？]

english: That is an impertinent question to demand from myself.
translation: 这是对我自己提出的一个无礼的问题。 [zhe shi dui wo zi ji ti chu de yi ge wu li de wen ti 。]

english: However, if it will help seal our deal, I will let you know some of the details.
translation: 不过，如果这有助于达成我们的协议，我会让您了解一些细节。 [bu guo ， ru guo zhe you zhu yu da cheng wo men de xie yi ， wo hui rang nin liao jie yi xie xi jie 。]

english: As you may or may not know, myself and my blood kin are the rulers of this land, all serving under Lord Drakan. However, we tend not to die of old age or similar
translation: 你可能知道，也可能不知道，我和我的血亲是这片土地的统治者，都在德拉坎勋爵的领导下服役。然而，我们往往不会死于年老或类似的情况 [ni ke neng zhi dao ， ye ke neng bu zhi dao ， wo he wo de xue qin shi zhe pian tu di de tong zhi zhe ， dou zai de la kan xun jue de ling dao xia fu yi 。 ran er ， wo men wang wang bu hui si yu nian lao huo lei si de qing kuang]

english: natural causes, which means that to gain another Lords title or land, there often need to be...
translation: 自然原因，这意味着要获得另一个领主的头衔或土地，通常需要...... [zi ran yuan yin ， zhe yi wei zhe yao huo de ling yi ge ling zhu de tou xian huo tu di ， tong chang xu yao ......]

english: Unnatural causes of death involved. Let us just say, that Dessous is in control of some land that I myself would like some say in, and that it is not in my interest to be seen to be responsible for the
translation: 涉及非自然死亡原因。让我们这么说吧，德索斯控制着一些我自己希望有人拥有发言权的土地，而被视为对这片土地负责并不符合我的利益。 [she ji fei zi ran si wang yuan yin 。 rang wo men zhe me shuo ba ， de suo si kong zhi zhe yi xie wo zi ji xi wang you ren yong you fa yan quan de tu di ， er bei shi wei dui zhe pian tu di fu ze bing bu fu he wo de li yi 。]

english: death of a fellow Lord.
translation: 一位主同伴的死亡。 [yi wei zhu tong ban de si wang 。]

english: It would however be extremely advantageous to myself should some random human adventurer take it upon themself to remove this rival for me... Do you understand?
translation: 然而，如果某个随机的人类冒险家亲自为我除掉这个对手，那对我来说是极其有利的……你明白吗？ [ran er ， ru guo mou ge sui ji de ren lei mao xian jia qin zi wei wo chu diao zhe ge dui shou ， na dui wo lai shuo shi ji qi you li de …… ni ming bai ma ？]

english: Yes... I think so...
translation: 是的……我想是的…… [shi de …… wo xiang shi de ……]

english: Good, we understand each other then. We will both benefit from the death of Dessous.
translation: 好吧，那我们就互相理解了。我们都将从 Dessous 的去世中受益。 [hao ba ， na wo men jiu hu xiang li jie le 。 wo men dou jiang cong  Dessous  de qu shi zhong shou yi 。]

english: Where can I find this Dessous?
translation: 哪里可以找到这个黛丝？ [na li ke yi zhao dao zhe ge dai si ？]

english: He currently resides in a graveyard to the South-East of here. You will not be able to move the gravestone which he lies beneath however, you will need to find some way to
translation: 他目前居住在东南方的一个墓地里。你将无法移动他下面的墓碑，但是，你需要找到一些方法来移动他下面的墓碑。 [ta mu qian ju zhu zai dong nan fang de yi ge mu di li 。 ni jiang wu fa yi dong ta xia mian de mu bei ， dan shi ， ni xu yao zhao dao yi xie fang fa lai yi dong ta xia mian de mu bei 。]

english: lure him out from his tomb.
translation: 将他从坟墓中引诱出来。 [jiang ta cong fen mu zhong yin you chu lai 。]

english: And how exactly would I go about doing that?
translation: 我到底该怎么做呢？ [wo dao di gai zen me zuo ne ？]

english: Well, he is a vampyre, so fresh blood would almost certainly entice him out.
translation: 好吧，他是吸血鬼，所以新鲜的血液几乎肯定会引诱他出去。 [hao ba ， ta shi xi xue gui ， suo yi xin xian de xue ye ji hu ken ding hui yin you ta chu qu 。]

english: However, even though he is a frail and decrepit example of our species, he will be able to kill a weakling human such as yourself extremely easily. Having him in a bloodlust as he does so, will not make
translation: 不过，尽管他是我们人类中的一个弱者，但他却能够轻而易举地杀死你这样的弱者。让他如此嗜血，不会使 [bu guo ， jin guan ta shi wo men ren lei zhong de yi ge ruo zhe ， dan ta que neng gou qing er yi ju di sha si ni zhe yang de ruo zhe 。 rang ta ru ci shi xue ， bu hui shi]

english: your job any easier.
translation: 您的工作变得更加轻松。 [nin de gong zuo bian de geng jia qing song 。]

english: So what advice can you give me on killing Dessous?
translation: 那么关于杀死 Dessous，你能给我什么建议呢？ [na me guan yu sha si  Dessous， ni neng gei wo shen me jian yi ne ？]

english: As ancient and weak as Dessous is, he is still more than a match for the likes of you.
translation: 尽管德苏斯年老体弱，但他仍然比你们这些人更胜一筹。 [jin guan de su si nian lao ti ruo ， dan ta reng ran bi ni men zhe xie ren geng sheng yi chou 。]

english: That is, assuming you were to fight him fairly.
translation: 也就是说，假设你要公平地与他战斗。 [ye jiu shi shuo ， jia she ni yao gong ping di yu ta zhan dou 。]

english: My proposal would be for you to even the odds up a little bit...
translation: 我的建议是让你的赔率稍微增加一点…… [wo de jian yi shi rang ni de pei lv shao wei zeng jia yi dian ……]

english: How would I go about doing that?
translation: 我该怎么做呢？ [wo gai zen me zuo ne ？]

english: Well, my plan would be as follows. First, take a silver bar to the man living in the sewers in Draynor. He was an assistant to Count Draynor in some of his...
translation: 嗯，我的计划如下。首先，给住在德雷诺下水道里的人拿一根银条。他是德雷诺伯爵的一些助手…… [n ， wo de ji hua ru xia 。 shou xian ， gei zhu zai de lei nuo xia shui dao li de ren na yi gen yin tiao 。 ta shi de lei nuo bo jue de yi xie zhu shou ……]

english: more interesting experiments many years past. Tell him you need a sacrificial offering pot. He will know what you speak of, it is a unique type of container used in various ancient vampiric ceremonies.
translation: 许多年前更有趣的实验。告诉他你需要一个祭祀盆。他会知道你说的是什么，这是各种古代吸血鬼仪式中使用的一种独特的容器。 [xu duo nian qian geng you qu de shi yan 。 gao su ta ni xu yao yi ge ji si pen 。 ta hui zhi dao ni shuo de shi shen me ， zhe shi ge zhong gu dai xi xue gui yi shi zhong shi yong de yi zhong du te de rong qi 。]

english: Then take that pot to Entrana, and get it blessed by the Head Monk. This will lend the pot some holy power.
translation: 然后把那个罐子带到恩特拉纳，并接受首席僧人的加持。这会给锅带来一些神圣的力量。 [ran hou ba na ge guan zi dai dao en te la na ， bing jie shou shou xi seng ren de jia chi 。 zhe hui gei guo dai lai yi xie shen sheng de li liang 。]

english: If you then bring that silver pot back to me, I will provide you with some fresh blood, to put into it. To that pot of blood, you will add some crushed garlic, and some spice to disguise the smell.
translation: 如果你把那个银壶带回来给我，我会给你一些新鲜的血液，放进去。在那锅血中，您将添加一些压碎的大蒜和一些香料来掩盖气味。 [ru guo ni ba na ge yin hu dai hui lai gei wo ， wo hui gei ni yi xie xin xian de xue ye ， fang jin qu 。 zai na guo xue zhong ， nin jiang tian jia yi xie ya sui de da suan he yi xie xiang liao lai yan gai qi wei 。]

english: Use that pot of blood upon Dessous' tomb, and he will be unable to resist rising and drinking from it.
translation: 将那一壶血放在德苏斯的坟墓上，他将无法抗拒地站起来喝它。 [jiang na yi hu xue fang zai de su si de fen mu shang ， ta jiang wu fa kang ju di zhan qi lai he ta 。]

english: The combination of garlic, silver, and blessings from Saradomin will act upon him as a poison, and allow you to kill him.
translation: 大蒜、银和萨拉多明的祝福的组合会对他产生毒药，让你杀死他。 [da suan 、 yin he sa la duo ming de zhu fu de zu he hui dui ta chan sheng du yao ， rang ni sha si ta 。]

english: This is just my suggestion of course, you may ignore it if you wish, although I offer no guarantees of your ability to defeat him otherwise.
translation: 当然，这只是我的建议，如果你愿意，你可以忽略它，尽管我不保证你有能力击败他。 [dang ran ， zhe zhi shi wo de jian yi ， ru guo ni yuan yi ， ni ke yi hu lve ta ， jin guan wo bu bao zheng ni you neng li ji bai ta 。]

english: Was there anything else you wanted?
translation: 你还有什么想要的吗？ [ni hai you shen me xiang yao de ma ？]

english: Never mind, I will figure out all I need to know by myself.
translation: 没关系，我会自己弄清楚我需要知道的一切。 [mei guan xi ， wo hui zi ji nong qing chu wo xu yao zhi dao de yi qie 。]

english: As you wish. Come and see me when you have managed to kill Dessous.
translation: 如你所愿。当你成功杀死黛苏斯后来见我。 [ru ni suo yuan 。 dang ni cheng gong sha si dai su si hou lai jian wo 。]

english: I found Ruantun in Draynorssewers. He made me this pot, now where can I get some fresh blood to fill it with?
translation: 我在Draynorssewers找到了Ruantun。他给我做了这个锅，现在哪里可以得到新鲜的血液来填充呢？ [wo zai Draynorssewers zhao dao le Ruantun。 ta gei wo zuo le zhe ge guo ， xian zai na li ke yi de dao xin xian de xue ye lai tian chong ne ？]

english: Malak bites the player, dealing light non-lethal damage.
translation: 马拉克咬住玩家，造成轻微的非致命伤害。 [ma la ke yao zhu wan jia ， zao cheng qing wei de fei zhi ming shang hai 。]

english: Ow!
There you go.As fresh as it gets.
translation: 就这样吧。尽可能新鲜。 [jiu zhe yang ba 。 jin ke neng xin xian 。]

english: Thanks for nothing.
translation: 谢天谢地什么也没有。 [xie tian xie di shen me ye mei you 。]

english: Come and speak to me again when you have managed to kill Dessous.
translation: 当你成功杀死黛苏斯后，再来跟我说话。 [dang ni cheng gong sha si dai su si hou ， zai lai gen wo shuo hua 。]

english: Why are you still here?I notice Dessous still lives.
translation: 你为什么还在这里？我注意到黛苏还活着。 [ni wei shen me hai zai zhe li ？ wo zhu yi dao dai su hai huo zhe 。]

english: Ah, the wandering hero returns! I take it you have dispatched poor old Dessous for me?
translation: 啊，流浪的英雄回来了！我想你已经派了可怜的老德苏斯来接我吧？ [a ， liu lang de ying xiong hui lai le ！ wo xiang ni yi jing pai le ke lian de lao de su si lai jie wo ba ？]

english: Quit playing games with me, Malak. I want that diamond, and I want it now!
translation: 别跟我玩游戏了，马拉克。我想要那颗钻石，我现在就想要！ [bie gen wo wan you xi le ， ma la ke 。 wo xiang yao na ke zuan shi ， wo xian zai jiu xiang yao ！]

english: Do not take that tone of voice with me, meat. You should be thankful I have allowed you your life.
translation: 别用那种语气跟我说话，肉。你应该感谢我给了你生命。 [bie yong na zhong yu qi gen wo shuo hua ， rou 。 ni ying gai gan xie wo gei le ni sheng ming 。]

english: Here, take your precious little bauble.
translation: 来，带上你珍贵的小玩意。 [lai ， dai shang ni zhen gui de xiao wan yi 。]

english: I will take that silver pot from you as well, humans are not meant to possess such artefacts. Now get out of my sight, our deal is complete, and if I see you here again I will not hesitate to take you to
translation: 你那银壶我也拿走，人类不该拥有这样的东西。现在滚出我的视线，我们的交易完成了，如果我再次在这里见到你，我会毫不犹豫地带你去 [ni na yin hu wo ye na zou ， ren lei bu gai yong you zhe yang de dong xi 。 xian zai gun chu wo de shi xian ， wo men de jiao yi wan cheng le ， ru guo wo zai ci zai zhe li jian dao ni ， wo hui hao bu you yu di dai ni qu]

english: Lord Drakan.
translation: 德拉坎勋爵。 [de la kan xun jue 。]

english: He will be extremely pleased to meet the murderer of poor Dessous, I suspect.
translation: 我怀疑，他会非常高兴见到杀害可怜的德索斯的凶手。 [wo huai yi ， ta hui fei chang gao xing jian dao sha hai ke lian de de suo si de xiong shou 。]

english: I am here to worship Zamorak
translation: 我来这里是为了崇拜萨莫拉克 [wo lai zhe li shi wei le chong bai sa mo la ke]

english: I am here to praise Lord Drakan
translation: 我来这里是为了赞美 Drakan 勋爵 [wo lai zhe li shi wei le zan mei  Drakan  xun jue]

english: I am here to worship you, oh mighty Malak
translation: 我来这里是为了崇拜你，哦，强大的马拉克 [wo lai zhe li shi wei le chong bai ni ， o ， qiang da de ma la ke]

english: I am here to kill Lord Drakan
translation: 我来这里是为了杀死德拉坎勋爵 [wo lai zhe li shi wei le sha si de la kan xun jue]

english: I am looking for a special Diamond...
translation: 我正在寻找一颗特殊的钻石... [wo zheng zai xun zhao yi ke te shu de zuan shi ...]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: Why do you want Dessous dead?
translation: 你为什么要让黛丝死？ [ni wei shen me yao rang dai si si ？]

english: Where can I find Dessous?
translation: 在哪里可以找到黛丝？ [zai na li ke yi zhao dao dai si ？]

english: How can I kill Dessous?
translation: 我怎样才能杀死德苏斯？ [wo zen yang cai neng sha si de su si ？]

english: Actually, I don't need to know anything.
translation: 其实我什么都不需要知道。 [qi shi wo shen me dou bu xu yao zhi dao 。]

english: Your animals don't look too healthy.
translation: 你的动物看起来不太健康。 [ni de dong wu kan qi lai bu tai jian kang 。]

english: It's that fountain thingy in the temple to the east. It's turned them all into zombies.
translation: 就是东边寺庙里的那个喷泉。它把他们都变成了僵尸。 [jiu shi dong bian si miao li de na ge pen quan 。 ta ba ta men dou bian cheng le jiang shi 。]

english: What use are zombie animals?
translation: 僵尸动物有什么用？ [jiang shi dong wu you shen me yong ？]

english: None at all, mate, except that those worshippers at that temple keep comin' and killin' 'em all for their bones. Don't ask me why.
translation: 一点也没有，伙计，除了那座寺庙里的那些崇拜者不断前来并为了他们的骨头而杀掉他们。别问我为什么。 [yi dian ye mei you ， huo ji ， chu le na zuo si miao li de na xie chong bai zhe bu duan qian lai bing wei le ta men de gu tou er sha diao ta men 。 bie wen wo wei shen me 。]

english: But you're a ghost - surely you know something about it.
translation: 但你是一个幽灵——你肯定知道一些事情。 [dan ni shi yi ge you ling —— ni ken ding zhi dao yi xie shi qing 。]

english: I don't know nuthin' about nuthin'. Oim a simple ghost with simple needs. All I know is, years ago, that temple started glowing green and, a few months later, I woke up dead. That's all there is to it.
translation: 我什么都不知道。 Oim 是一个有着简单需求的简单幽灵。我只知道，几年前，那座寺庙开始发出绿光，几个月后，我醒来时已经死了。这就是全部内容了。 [wo shen me dou bu zhi dao 。 Oim  shi yi ge you zhe jian dan xu qiu de jian dan you ling 。 wo zhi zhi dao ， ji nian qian ， na zuo si miao kai shi fa chu lv guang ， ji ge yue hou ， wo xing lai shi yi jing si le 。 zhe jiu shi quan bu nei rong le 。]

english: Hey leave me alone, can't you see that I'm busy?
translation: 嘿，别打扰我，你没看到我很忙吗？ [hei ， bie da rao wo ， ni mei kan dao wo hen mang ma ？]

english: Oohh, my arms.
translation: 哦，我的手臂。 [o ， wo de shou bi 。]

english: Work, work, work, that's all I ever do.
translation: 工作，工作，工作，这就是我所做的一切。 [gong zuo ， gong zuo ， gong zuo ， zhe jiu shi wo suo zuo de yi qie 。]

english: I feel so weak, I could faint.
translation: 我感觉很虚弱，我可能会晕倒。 [wo gan jue hen xu ruo ， wo ke neng hui yun dao 。]

english: I'm so tired, I could sleep standing up.
translation: 我太累了，我可以站着睡觉。 [wo tai lei le ， wo ke yi zhan zhe shui jiao 。]

english: What I wouldn't give for a good night's rest.
translation: 为了一夜安眠，我愿意付出一切。 [wei le yi ye an mian ， wo yuan yi fu chu yi qie 。]

english: Ooh, my back.
translation: 哦，我的背。 [o ， wo de bei 。]

english: I'm rich in experience, poor in wealth.
translation: 我经验丰富，财富贫乏。 [wo jing yan feng fu ， cai fu pin fa 。]

english: I can't think straight I'm so tired.
translation: 我无法正常思考我太累了。 [wo wu fa zheng chang si kao wo tai lei le 。]

english: I'm sick of this place.
translation: 我厌倦了这个地方。 [wo yan juan le zhe ge di fang 。]

english: Beware the rowdies, they're spoiling for a fight.
translation: 小心那些吵闹的人，他们很想打架。 [xiao xin na xie chao nao de ren ， ta men hen xiang da jia 。]

english: One day I'm gonna get out of here.
translation: 有一天我会离开这里。 [you yi tian wo hui li kai zhe li 。]

english: I need a new pick axe.
translation: 我需要一把新镐。 [wo xu yao yi ba xin gao 。]

english: Work, work work, that's all I ever do!
translation: 工作，工作，这就是我所做的一切！ [gong zuo ， gong zuo ， zhe jiu shi wo suo zuo de yi qie ！]

english: Good luck to ya, you're gonna need it.
translation: 祝你好运，你会需要它。 [zhu ni hao yun ， ni hui xu yao ta 。]

english: So, [player name], your curiosity leads you to speak to me?
translation: 那么，[玩家姓名]，你的好奇心促使你和我说话吗？ [na me ，[ wan jia xing ming ]， ni de hao qi xin cu shi ni he wo shuo hua ma ？]

english: About those enchanted secateurs again...
translation: 再次关于那些迷人的修枝剪...... [zai ci guan yu na xie mi ren de xiu zhi jian ......]

english: What now, [player name], can't you just leave me alone to practice my art?
translation: 现在怎么办，[玩家名字]，你就不能让我一个人练习我的艺术吗？ [xian zai zen me ban ，[ wan jia ming zi ]， ni jiu bu neng rang wo yi ge ren lian xi wo de yi shu ma ？]

english: Can I get another set of enchanted secateurs?
translation: 我可以再买一套附魔修枝剪吗？ [wo ke yi zai mai yi tao fu mo xiu zhi jian ma ？]

english: Well I guess it's your lucky day! Since your last visit I've been thinking, I never use my enchanted secateurs anymore, I could sell them to you, if you like.
translation: 好吧，我想今天是你的幸运日！自从你上次来访后，我一直在想，我再也不用我的魔法剪枝刀了，如果你愿意的话，我可以把它们卖给你。 [hao ba ， wo xiang jin tian shi ni de xing yun ri ！ zi cong ni shang ci lai fang hou ， wo yi zhi zai xiang ， wo zai ye bu yong wo de mo fa jian zhi dao le ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi ba ta men mai gei ni 。]

english: That's great!
translation: 那太棒了！ [na tai bang le ！]

english: How much would they cost?
translation: 他们要花多少钱？ [ta men yao hua duo shao qian ？]

english: I could let you have them for a mere 40,000 gp.
translation: 我只要 40,000 gp 就可以让你拥有它们。 [wo zhi yao  40,000 gp  jiu ke yi rang ni yong you ta men 。]

english: 40,000! That's outrageous!
translation: 4万！太离谱了！ [4 wan ！ tai li pu le ！]

english: Well, that's my price. If you change your mind, you can come back and talk to me. Good day.
translation: 嗯，这就是我的价格。如果你改变主意，可以回来跟我谈谈。再会。 [n ， zhe jiu shi wo de jia ge 。 ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， ke yi hui lai gen wo tan tan 。 zai hui 。]

english: That's too expensive for me I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕这对我来说太贵了。 [kong pa zhe dui wo lai shuo tai gui le 。]

english: Ok, great.
translation: 好的，太好了。 [hao de ， tai hao le 。]

english: A pleasure doing business with you, [player name].
translation: 很高兴与您开展业务，[玩家姓名]。 [hen gao xing yu nin kai zhan ye wu ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: You don't have room to hold them. Stop wasting my time.
translation: 你没有空间容纳它们。别再浪费我的时间了。 [ni mei you kong jian rong na ta men 。 bie zai lang fei wo de shi jian le 。]

english: You don't have 40,000 gp with you! Do you take me for a fool?
translation: 你身上没有 40,000 gp！你当我是傻子吗？ [ni shen shang mei you  40,000 gp！ ni dang wo shi sha zi ma ？]

english: Sorry, I didn't realise. I'll have to visit a bank.
translation: 抱歉，我没意识到。我得去趟银行。 [bao qian ， wo mei yi shi dao 。 wo de qu tang yin hang 。]

english: Fine, I might see you later then.
translation: 好吧，那我也许稍后会见到你。 [hao ba ， na wo ye xu shao hou hui jian dao ni 。]

english: Sorry to have bothered you.
translation: 抱歉打扰您了。 [bao qian da rao nin le 。]

english: That's ok, I shouldn't have been so abrupt with you.
translation: 没关系，我不该对你这么唐突的。 [mei guan xi ， wo bu gai dui ni zhe me tang tu de 。]

english: Could you spare me a brown apron?
translation: 你能给我一条棕色围裙吗？ [ni neng gei wo yi tiao zong se wei qun ma ？]

english: Oh, if you must.
translation: 哦，如果你一定要的话。 [o ， ru guo ni yi ding yao de hua 。]

english: Can I have some more bone seeds?
translation: 我可以再要一些骨籽吗？ [wo ke yi zai yao yi xie gu zi ma ？]

english: You fetch me a pot with a lid first.
translation: 你先给我拿一个有盖的锅。 [ni xian gei wo na yi ge you gai de guo 。]

english: Fortunately I do have another pot with a lid.
translation: 幸运的是我还有另一个带盖的锅。 [xing yun de shi wo hai you ling yi ge dai gai de guo 。]

english: Yes, yes, have fun with them!
translation: 是啊是啊，和他们一起玩吧！ [shi a shi a ， he ta men yi qi wan ba ！]

english: Who are you and what are you doing here?
translation: 你是谁，你在这里做什么？ [ni shi shui ， ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I am the great Malignius Mortifer, wielder of strange and terrible powers. These lowly followers of mine are dedicated students of the magical arts. Their business is to follow me and learn all they can.
translation: 我是伟大的马里尼乌斯·莫蒂弗，拥有奇怪而可怕的力量。我的这些卑微的追随者都是魔法艺术的热心学生。他们的任务就是跟随我并学习他们能学到的一切。 [wo shi wei da de ma li ni wu si · mo di fu ， yong you qi guai er ke pa de li liang 。 wo de zhe xie bei wei de zhui sui zhe dou shi mo fa yi shu de re xin xue sheng 。 ta men de ren wu jiu shi gen sui wo bing xue xi ta men neng xue dao de yi qie 。]

english: They don't look very tough.
translation: 他们看上去并不十分坚韧。 [ta men kan shang qu bing bu shi fen jian ren 。]

english: You may believe that, but even if you strike one down, another will rise up within minutes.
translation: 你可能相信这一点，但即使你击倒了一个，另一个也会在几分钟之内崛起。 [ni ke neng xiang xin zhe yi dian ， dan ji shi ni ji dao le yi ge ， ling yi ge ye hui zai ji fen zhong zhi nei jue qi 。]

english: Yeah, right.
translation: 是的，对。 [shi de ， dui 。]

english: Each of my followers is a master of his chosen element. His life becomes bound to that element in a way you could not hope to understand.
translation: 我的每个追随者都是他所选择的元素的大师。他的生命以一种你无法理解的方式与那个元素紧密相连。 [wo de mei ge zhui sui zhe dou shi ta suo xuan ze de yuan su de da shi 。 ta de sheng ming yi yi zhong ni wu fa li jie de fang shi yu na ge yuan su jin mi xiang lian 。]

english: And what do you do?
translation: 你做什么？ [ni zuo shen me ？]

english: I am mastering a branch of magic that few dare to attempt: Necromancy! The fools in the Guild of Wizards shun anyone who practices this art, but there are a few in this land who know the rudiments.
translation: 我正在掌握一个很少有人敢于尝试的魔法分支：死灵术！巫师公会里的傻瓜们回避任何练习这种技艺的人，但在这片土地上却有少数人懂得这些基础知识。 [wo zheng zai zhang wo yi ge hen shao you ren gan yu chang shi de mo fa fen zhi ： si ling shu ！ wu shi gong hui li de sha gua men hui bi ren he lian xi zhe zhong ji yi de ren ， dan zai zhe pian tu di shang que you shao shu ren dong de zhe xie ji chu zhi shi 。]

english: Grayzag, Invrigar, Sithik... Even Melzar studied the methods of necromancy, until an accident affected his mind. Now his spells tend to result in...
translation: Grayzag、Invrigar、Sithik……就连梅尔扎也研究过死灵术的方法，直到一场意外影响了他的心智。现在他的咒语往往会导致…… [Grayzag、Invrigar、Sithik…… jiu lian mei er zha ye yan jiu guo si ling shu de fang fa ， zhi dao yi chang yi wai ying xiang le ta de xin zhi 。 xian zai ta de zhou yu wang wang hui dao zhi ……]

english: ... well, let us simply say that he does NOT raise armies of undead minions.
translation: ...好吧，让我们简单地说，他不会召集不死小兵的军队。 [... hao ba ， rang wo men jian dan di shuo ， ta bu hui zhao ji bu si xiao bing de jun dui 。]

english: Is this like Summoning? Can you teach me?
translation: 这就像召唤吗？你能教我吗？ [zhe jiu xiang zhao huan ma ？ ni neng jiao wo ma ？]

english: The obscure magical art of necromancy has nothing to do with Summoning.
translation: 死灵术这门晦涩难懂的魔法艺术与召唤术无关。 [si ling shu zhe men hui se nan dong de mo fa yi shu yu zhao huan shu wu guan 。]

english: Through necromancy, I may resurrect the bodies of those who have fallen, and bend them to my will, and even command them to tell me hidden knowledge.
translation: 通过死灵术，我可以复活那些倒下的人的身体，让他们屈服于我的意志，甚至命令他们告诉我隐藏的知识。 [tong guo si ling shu ， wo ke yi fu huo na xie dao xia de ren de shen ti ， rang ta men qu fu yu wo de yi zhi ， shen zhi ming ling ta men gao su wo yin cang de zhi shi 。]

english: I shall not pass on my secrets lightly to any passer-by!
translation: 我不会轻易将我的秘密透露给任何路人！ [wo bu hui qing yi jiang wo de mi mi tou lu gei ren he lu ren ！]

english: Even a mighty hero like me?
translation: 连我这样的大英雄都可以吗？ [lian wo zhe yang de da ying xiong dou ke yi ma ？]

english: Perhaps one day you shall learn ways to summon creatures to your side, but my own work is of a different sort.
translation: 也许有一天你会学会如何召唤生物到你身边，但我自己的工作是不同类型的。 [ye xu you yi tian ni hui xue hui ru he zhao huan sheng wu dao ni shen bian ， dan wo zi ji de gong zuo shi bu tong lei xing de 。]

english: What happened to Melzar?
translation: 梅尔扎尔怎么了？ [mei er zha er zen me le ？]

english: The forces required to wield power over the dead are very difficult to control. Melzar's concentration slipped, and his spell rebounded upon him.
translation: 对死者行使权力所需的力量非常难以控制。梅尔扎的注意力分散了，他的咒语又反弹到了他身上。 [dui si zhe xing shi quan li suo xu de li liang fei chang nan yi kong zhi 。 mei er zha de zhu yi li fen san le ， ta de zhou yu you fan tan dao le ta shen shang 。]

english: Although he did not die, his mind broke. Now he dwells amidst the beasts that fill his strange home, and when he attempts to do magic he gets... amusing results.
translation: 虽然他没有死，但他的心却崩溃了。现在，他住在充满了他奇怪的家的野兽中间，当他尝试施展魔法时，他得到了……有趣的结果。 [sui ran ta mei you si ， dan ta de xin que beng kui le 。 xian zai ， ta zhu zai chong man le ta qi guai de jia de ye shou zhong jian ， dang ta chang shi shi zhan mo fa shi ， ta de dao le …… you qu de jie guo 。]

english: Why do you keep making fungi appear?
translation: 为什么你总是让真菌出现？ [wei shen me ni zong shi rang zhen jun chu xian ？]

english: Necromancy is... still not fully understood. So few people dare to study it. Although my spells usually raise whichever undead creature I desire, they sometimes misfire. As Melzar has learnt!
translation: 死灵术……还没有被完全理解。所以很少有人敢去研究它。虽然我的法术通常会召唤出我想要的任何不死生物，但它们有时会失败。正如梅尔扎所学到的那样！ [si ling shu …… hai mei you bei wan quan li jie 。 suo yi hen shao you ren gan qu yan jiu ta 。 sui ran wo de fa shu tong chang hui zhao huan chu wo xiang yao de ren he bu si sheng wu ， dan ta men you shi hui shi bai 。 zheng ru mei er zha suo xue dao de na yang ！]

english: Thanks, I'll be off now.
translation: 谢谢，我现在就走了。 [xie xie ， wo xian zai jiu zou le 。]

english: I am sure your curiosity will eventually draw you to speak to me again, [player name].
translation: 我相信你的好奇心最终会吸引你再次与我交谈，[玩家姓名]。 [wo xiang xin ni de hao qi xin zui zhong hui xi yin ni zai ci yu wo jiao tan ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Can you teach me something about magic?
translation: 你能教我一些关于魔法的东西吗？ [ni neng jiao wo yi xie guan yu mo fa de dong xi ma ？]

english: Ah, you are an inquisitive fellow. I shall speak of the great Wizards' Tower, destroyed by fire many years ago...
translation: 啊，你是一个好奇心很强的人。我要谈谈伟大的巫师塔，它在很多年前被大火烧毁了…… [a ， ni shi yi ge hao qi xin hen qiang de ren 。 wo yao tan tan wei da de wu shi ta ， ta zai hen duo nian qian bei da huo shao hui le ……]

english: Many say it was the greatest building in the history of Gielinor, a magnificent monument to human ingenuity.
translation: 许多人说这是吉林诺历史上最伟大的建筑，是人类聪明才智的宏伟纪念碑。 [xu duo ren shuo zhe shi ji lin nuo li shi shang zui wei da de jian zhu ， shi ren lei cong ming cai zhi de hong wei ji nian bei 。]

english: Yet when humans are offered great power, they so often buy it at the cost of their principles.
translation: 然而，当人类获得强大的力量时，他们往往会以牺牲自己的原则为代价。 [ran er ， dang ren lei huo de qiang da de li liang shi ， ta men wang wang hui yi xi sheng zi ji de yuan ze wei dai jia 。]

english: Wizards who claimed allegiance to Saradomin began to insist that magic be restricted to the few they deemed 'worthy' of such powers.
translation: 声称效忠萨拉多明的巫师们开始坚持认为魔法仅限于他们认为“值得”拥有这种力量的少数人。 [sheng cheng xiao zhong sa la duo ming de wu shi men kai shi jian chi ren wei mo fa jin xian yu ta men ren wei “ zhi de ” yong you zhe zhong li liang de shao shu ren 。]

english: Before long, those who did not share their fatuous obsession with Saradomin were excluded from the Tower completely. This state of affairs could not continue.
translation: 不久之后，那些不认同萨拉多明的愚蠢迷恋的人就被完全排除在塔之外。这种状况不能再继续下去了。 [bu jiu zhi hou ， na xie bu ren tong sa la duo ming de yu chun mi lian de ren jiu bei wan quan pai chu zai ta zhi wai 。 zhe zhong zhuang kuang bu neng zai ji xu xia qu le 。]

english: One dark night, a brave band of magi loyal to the great Lord Zamorak stormed the Tower. Despite heavy losses, they fought their way up the levels until they reached the Great Library.
translation: 一个漆黑的夜晚，一群忠于伟大的萨莫拉克勋爵的勇敢的法师袭击了塔楼。尽管损失惨重，他们还是一路奋战，直到到达大图书馆。 [yi ge qi hei de ye wan ， yi qun zhong yu wei da de sa mo la ke xun jue de yong gan de fa shi xi ji le ta lou 。 jin guan sun shi can zhong ， ta men hai shi yi lu fen zhan ， zhi dao dao da da tu shu guan 。]

english: Alas, they were trapped and could not steal the precious records. But before they could be defeated, the bravest of them took it upon himself to blast the writings into nothingness, destroying the library.
translation: 可惜，他们被困住了，无法窃取珍贵的记录。但在他们被击败之前，他们中最勇敢的人亲自将这些文字炸成了虚无，摧毁了图书馆。 [ke xi ， ta men bei kun zhu le ， wu fa qie qu zhen gui de ji lu 。 dan zai ta men bei ji bai zhi qian ， ta men zhong zui yong gan de ren qin zi jiang zhe xie wen zi zha cheng le xu wu ， cui hui le tu shu guan 。]

english: The ensuing fire raced through the tower, and none escaped its fury. Some say that Lord Zamorak himself fanned the flames to ensure the destruction of his enemies!
translation: 随后的大火席卷了整个塔楼，没有人能逃脱其猛烈的攻击。有人说，萨莫拉克勋爵亲自煽风点火，以确保消灭他的敌人！ [sui hou de da huo xi juan le zheng ge ta lou ， mei you ren neng tao tuo qi meng lie de gong ji 。 you ren shuo ， sa mo la ke xun jue qin zi shan feng dian huo ， yi que bao xiao mie ta de di ren ！]

english: Much of that knowledge was lost, and some has never yet been rediscovered. Still, your efforts on behalf of my colleagues have not been wasted! Once again, the forces of Zamorak can create unlimited runestones!
translation: 其中大部分知识都丢失了，有些知识从未被重新发现。尽管如此，你们为我的同事所做的努力并没有白费！萨莫拉克的力量再次可以创造无限的符石！ [qi zhong da bu fen zhi shi dou diu shi le ， you xie zhi shi cong wei bei chong xin fa xian 。 jin guan ru ci ， ni men wei wo de tong shi suo zuo de nu li bing mei you bai fei ！ sa mo la ke de li liang zai ci ke yi chuang zao wu xian de fu shi ！]

english: May the world cower in its boots!
translation: 愿世界畏缩在靴子里！ [yuan shi jie wei suo zai xue zi li ！]

english: I see...
translation: 我懂了... [wo dong le ...]

english: I bid you farewell for now.
translation: 我暂时跟你告别了。 [wo zan shi gen ni gao bie le 。]

english: About those skeletal magi in the Colony - why don't they disappear now the Colony's safe?
translation: 关于殖民地里那些骷髅法师——现在殖民地安全了，他们为什么不消失呢？ [guan yu zhi min di li na xie ku lou fa shi —— xian zai zhi min di an quan le ， ta men wei shen me bu xiao shi ne ？]

english: HAHAHA! I never specified how long they'd stay there!
translation: 哈哈哈！我从未具体说明他们会在那里呆多久！ [ha ha ha ！ wo cong wei ju ti shuo ming ta men hui zai na li dai duo jiu ！]

english: So when will they go away? They're in the dormitories, and that's a real nuisance for the colonists!
translation: 那么他们什么时候会离开呢？他们在宿舍里，这对殖民者来说真是一个麻烦！ [na me ta men shen me shi hou hui li kai ne ？ ta men zai su she li ， zhe dui zhi min zhe lai shuo zhen shi yi ge ma fan ！]

english: HAHAHA!
translation: 哈哈哈！ [ha ha ha ！]

english: So you're not going to get rid of them?
translation: 所以你不打算摆脱他们吗？ [suo yi ni bu da suan bai tuo ta men ma ？]

english: Oh, forget I asked.
translation: 哦，忘记我问了。 [o ， wang ji wo wen le 。]

english: Where can I get clothes like those?
translation: 哪里可以买到这样的衣服？ [na li ke yi mai dao zhe yang de yi fu ？]

english: Bah! Our garments are an outward sign of our dominance of the magical arts. You cannot simply buy them in a shop!
translation: 呸!我们的服装是我们在魔法艺术中占据主导地位的外在标志。您不能简单地在商店购买它们！ [pei ! wo men de fu zhuang shi wo men zai mo fa yi shu zhong zhan ju zhu dao di wei de wai zai biao zhi 。 nin bu neng jian dan di zai shang dian gou mai ta men ！]

english: What happens if I kill you and take them?
translation: 如果我杀了你并带走他们会怎样？ [ru guo wo sha le ni bing dai zou ta men hui zen yang ？]

english: Try it and see!
translation: 尝试一下看看！ [chang shi yi xia kan kan ！]

english: How about if you teach me enough about magic so I can wear those clothes too?
translation: 如果你教我足够多的魔法知识，这样我也能穿那些衣服怎么样？ [ru guo ni jiao wo zu gou duo de mo fa zhi shi ， zhe yang wo ye neng chuan na xie yi fu zen me yang ？]

english: How about if I turn you into a mushroom to make you stop bothering me?
translation: 如果我把你变成蘑菇，让你不再打扰我怎么样？ [ru guo wo ba ni bian cheng mo gu ， rang ni bu zai da rao wo zen me yang ？]

english: MMMmmph!
translation: 嗯嗯！ [n n ！]

english: Actually, I don't want to talk to you.
translation: 其实我不想和你说话。 [qi shi wo bu xiang he ni shuo hua 。]

english: You should take that pot a bit further away from me before you open it!
translation: 你把那个罐子拿离我远一点再打开吧！ [ni ba na ge guan zi na li wo yuan yi dian zai da kai ba ！]

english: Da mihi potentiam!
translation: Da mihi 潜力！ [Da mihi  qian li ！]

english: Veni, cohortes malefici!
translation: 维尼，恶人同伙！ [wei ni ， e ren tong huo ！]

english: Curses - more fungi!
translation: 诅咒——更多真菌！ [zu zhou —— geng duo zhen jun ！]

english: Blast - fungi again!
translation: 再次爆炸——真菌！ [zai ci bao zha —— zhen jun ！]

english: DUUUHHH
translation: 嘟嘟嘟 [du du du]

english: OooOOOooooOOOOooo
translation: 噢噢噢噢噢噢噢 [o o o o o o o]

english: Krrrrsssss
translation: 咕噜咕噜 [gu lu gu lu]

english: Krrrrsssss
translation: 咕噜咕噜 [gu lu gu lu]

english: Oi - stop waving your items at me!
translation: 喂——别再向我挥舞你的东西了！ [wei —— bie zai xiang wo hui wu ni de dong xi le ！]

english: About those enchanted secateurs again...
translation: 再次关于那些迷人的修枝剪...... [zai ci guan yu na xie mi ren de xiu zhi jian ......]

english: Can I get another set of enchanted secateurs?
translation: 我可以再买一套附魔修枝剪吗？ [wo ke yi zai mai yi tao fu mo xiu zhi jian ma ？]

english: 40,000! That's outrageous!
translation: 4万！太离谱了！ [4 wan ！ tai li pu le ！]

english: That's too expensive for me I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕这对我来说太贵了。 [kong pa zhe dui wo lai shuo tai gui le 。]

english: Ok, great.
translation: 好的，太好了。 [hao de ， tai hao le 。]

english: Sorry to have bothered you.
translation: 抱歉打扰您了。 [bao qian da rao nin le 。]

english: Could you spare me a brown apron?
translation: 你能给我一条棕色围裙吗？ [ni neng gei wo yi tiao zong se wei qun ma ？]

english: Can I have some more bone seeds?
translation: 我可以再要一些骨籽吗？ [wo ke yi zai yao yi xie gu zi ma ？]

english: ... MORE ...
translation: ... 更多的 ... [...  geng duo de  ...]

english: Who are you and what are you doing here?
translation: 你是谁，你在这里做什么？ [ni shi shui ， ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Is this like Summoning?
translation: 这就像召唤吗？ [zhe jiu xiang zhao huan ma ？]

english: What happened to Melzar?
translation: 梅尔扎尔怎么了？ [mei er zha er zen me le ？]

english: Why do you keep making fungi appear?
translation: 为什么你总是让真菌出现？ [wei shen me ni zong shi rang zhen jun chu xian ？]

english: Thanks, I'll be off now.
translation: 谢谢，我现在就走了。 [xie xie ， wo xian zai jiu zou le 。]

english: Can you teach me something about magic?
translation: 你能教我一些关于魔法的东西吗？ [ni neng jiao wo yi xie guan yu mo fa de dong xi ma ？]

english: About those skeletal magi in the Colony...
translation: 关于殖民地里的那些骷髅法师…… [guan yu zhi min di li de na xie ku lou fa shi ……]

english: Where can I get clothes like those?
translation: 哪里可以买到这样的衣服？ [na li ke yi mai dao zhe yang de yi fu ？]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Arr? Be ye wantin' te go on account with our gang o' fillibusters?
translation: 啊？你想跟我们这帮煽动者算账吗？ [a ？ ni xiang gen wo men zhe bang shan dong zhe suan zhang ma ？]

english: The powder monkey be takin' a caulk after gettin' rowdy on bumboo, so there be plenty of room for ye.
translation: 粉猴在 bumboo 上吵闹后正在填缝，所以有足够的空间给你们。 [fen hou zai  bumboo  shang chao nao hou zheng zai tian feng ， suo yi you zu gou de kong jian gei ni men 。]

english: Riiiiight...
translation: 好吧... [hao ba ...]

english: I'll just be over here if you need me.
translation: 如果你需要我，我就在这里。 [ru guo ni xu yao wo ， wo jiu zai zhe li 。]

english: Hello stranger, you come for a drink?
translation: 你好，陌生人，你来喝一杯吗？ [ni hao ， mo sheng ren ， ni lai he yi bei ma ？]

english: What sort of drinks do you have?
translation: 你们有什么类型的饮料？ [ni men you shen me lei xing de yin liao ？]

english: We got some cold beers, some warm stews and some 'rum'.
translation: 我们喝了一些冰啤酒、一些热炖菜和一些“朗姆酒”。 [wo men he le yi xie bing pi jiu 、 yi xie re dun cai he yi xie “ lang mu jiu ”。]

english: Not, Captain Braindeath's 'rum'?
translation: 不是脑死亡船长的“朗姆酒”吗？ [bu shi nao si wang chuan zhang de “ lang mu jiu ” ma ？]

english: Yes! There was some sorta problem at the brewery, but they got it all sorted out now.
translation: 是的！啤酒厂出现了一些问题，但现在一切都解决了。 [shi de ！ pi jiu chang chu xian le yi xie wen ti ， dan xian zai yi qie dou jie jue le 。]

english: You wanna buy something?
translation: 你想买东西吗？ [ni xiang mai dong xi ma ？]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I's been cooking up some roasted spiders....I can show you how to make 'em if you like?
translation: 我一直在煮一些烤蜘蛛......如果你愿意的话我可以教你如何制作它们？ [wo yi zhi zai zhu yi xie kao zhi zhu ...... ru guo ni yuan yi de hua wo ke yi jiao ni ru he zhi zuo ta men ？]

english: Errrr..yuck, roasted spiders, that sounds gross!
translation: 呃……恶心，烤蜘蛛，听起来很恶心！ [e …… e xin ， kao zhi zhu ， ting qi lai hen e xin ！]

english: Well, you can suit yourself my friend, but I have to tell you they're delicious!
translation: 好吧，你可以适合自己，我的朋友，但我必须告诉你它们很好吃！ [hao ba ， ni ke yi shi he zi ji ， wo de peng you ， dan wo bi xu gao su ni ta men hen hao chi ！]

english: Mmmm, mmm, mmmmmm!
translation: 嗯嗯嗯嗯！ [n n n n ！]

english: Hmm, I guess it could be considered a delicacy, so yes please?
translation: 嗯，我想这可以算是一道美味佳肴，所以可以吗？ [n ， wo xiang zhe ke yi suan shi yi dao mei wei jia yao ， suo yi ke yi ma ？]

english: Ok my friend, you simply need to get a suitable stick to skewer the spider carcass on and then roast it on a fire!
translation: 好吧，我的朋友，你只需要找一根合适的棍子把蜘蛛尸体串起来，然后放在火上烤就可以了！ [hao ba ， wo de peng you ， ni zhi xu yao zhao yi gen he shi de gun zi ba zhi zhu shi ti chuan qi lai ， ran hou fang zai huo shang kao jiu ke yi le ！]

english: What sort of stick and where would I get one?
translation: 什么样的棍子以及在哪里可以得到一根？ [shen me yang de gun zi yi ji zai na li ke yi de dao yi gen ？]

english: Well, I prefer to use a skewer stick, you can make one from a thatching spar using a machete. Or, if you're stuck, you could always use an arrow shaft, though they tend to be useless once you've finished eating the
translation: 好吧，我更喜欢使用串肉棒，你可以用砍刀从茅草梁上制作一个。或者，如果你被卡住了，你总是可以使用箭杆，尽管一旦你吃完它们，它们往往就没用了。 [hao ba ， wo geng xi huan shi yong chuan rou bang ， ni ke yi yong kan dao cong mao cao liang shang zhi zuo yi ge 。 huo zhe ， ru guo ni bei ka zhu le ， ni zong shi ke yi shi yong jian gan ， jin guan yi dan ni chi wan ta men ， ta men wang wang jiu mei yong le 。]

english: spider.
translation: 蜘蛛。 [zhi zhu 。]

english: Ok, thanks!
translation: 好的，谢谢！ [hao de ， xie xie ！]

english: Sorry, I have to go.
translation: 抱歉，我得走了。 [bao qian ， wo de zou le 。]

english: Is there anything interesting to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么好玩的吗？ [zhe fu jin you shen me hao wan de ma ？]

english: Bwana, if anyone else asks me that question today, I'll explode! Go and ask someone else!
translation: Bwana，如果今天还有人问我这个问题，我会爆炸的！你去问问别人吧！ [Bwana， ru guo jin tian hai you ren wen wo zhe ge wen ti ， wo hui bao zha de ！ ni qu wen wen bie ren ba ！]

english: Not that I'm aware of, just sit back and enjoy the sunshine bwana!
translation: 我不知道，只是坐下来享受阳光 bwana！ [wo bu zhi dao ， zhi shi zuo xia lai xiang shou yang guang  bwana！]

english: Sorry Bwana, I'm already busy, why not go and talk to Murcaily! He's around the village somewhere.
translation: 抱歉 Bwana，我已经很忙了，为什么不去和 Murcaily 谈谈呢！他就在村子附近的某个地方。 [bao qian  Bwana， wo yi jing hen mang le ， wei shen me bu qu he  Murcaily  tan tan ne ！ ta jiu zai cun zi fu jin de mou ge di fang 。]

english: Well, I think that there's some work to be done...perhaps Murcaily can help you. He usually tends to the hardwood grove to the east of Trufitus's hut.
translation: 嗯，我认为还有一些工作要做……也许 Murcaily 可以帮助你。他通常照料特鲁菲特斯小屋东边的硬木树林。 [n ， wo ren wei hai you yi xie gong zuo yao zuo …… ye xu  Murcaily  ke yi bang zhu ni 。 ta tong chang zhao liao te lu fei te si xiao wu dong bian de ying mu shu lin 。]

english: It's just village life as normal around here Bwana, always something interesting to find to occupy your time if you look hard enough.
translation: 布瓦纳（Bwana）这里的乡村生活一如往常，只要您仔细观察，总能找到一些有趣的东西来打发您的时间。 [bu wa na （Bwana） zhe li de xiang cun sheng huo yi ru wang chang ， zhi yao nin zi xi guan cha ， zong neng zhao dao yi xie you qu de dong xi lai da fa nin de shi jian 。]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Errrr..yuck, roasted spiders, that sounds gross!
translation: 呃……恶心，烤蜘蛛，听起来很恶心！ [e …… e xin ， kao zhi zhu ， ting qi lai hen e xin ！]

english: Hmm, I guess it could be considered a delicacy, so yes please?
translation: 嗯，我想这可以算是一道美味佳肴，所以可以吗？ [n ， wo xiang zhe ke yi suan shi yi dao mei wei jia yao ， suo yi ke yi ma ？]

english: I'd like to ask another question.
translation: 我想问另一个问题。 [wo xiang wen ling yi ge wen ti 。]

english: Sorry, I have to go.
translation: 抱歉，我得走了。 [bao qian ， wo de zou le 。]

english: Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: 这里有什么有趣的事情可以做吗？ [zhe li you shen me you qu de shi qing ke yi zuo ma ？]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello, how's it going?
translation: 你好，怎么样？ [ni hao ， zen me yang ？]

translation: 还不错，不过最近哥布林的增加让我有点担心。 [hai bu cuo ， bu guo zui jin ge bu lin de zeng jia rang wo you dian dan xin 。]

english: Don't worry, I'll kill them.
translation: 别担心，我会杀了他们。 [bie dan xin ， wo hui sha le ta men 。]

translation: 我怎么帮你？ [wo zen me bang ni ？]

english: Do you want to trade?
translation: 你想交易吗？ [ni xiang jiao yi ma ？]

translation: 不，我没有什么想要摆脱的。如果您想做一些交易，周围有很多商店和市场摊位。 [bu ， wo mei you shen me xiang yao bai tuo de 。 ru guo nin xiang zuo yi xie jiao yi ， zhou wei you hen duo shang dian he shi chang tan wei 。]

translation: 听说地下有很多可怕的生物…… [ting shuo di xia you hen duo ke pa de sheng wu ……]

translation: 别挡我的路，我很着急！ [bie dang wo de lu ， wo hen zhao ji ！]

english: I'm fine, how are you?
translation: 我很好，你怎么样？ [wo hen hao ， ni zen me yang ？]

english: Very well thank you.
translation: 非常好，谢谢。 [fei chang hao ， xie xie 。]

translation: 你好呀！我们一直以来天气很好。 [ni hao ya ！ wo men yi zhi yi lai tian qi hen hao 。]

english: I'm very well thank you.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm a bold adventurer.
translation: 我是一个大胆的冒险家。 [wo shi yi ge da dan de mao xian jia 。]

translation: 啊，一个非常崇高的职业。 [a ， yi ge fei chang chong gao de zhi ye 。]

english: I think we need a new king. The one we've got isn't very good.
translation: 我认为我们需要一位新国王。我们现有的那个不是很好。 [wo ren wei wo men xu yao yi wei xin guo wang 。 wo men xian you de na ge bu shi hen hao 。]

english: Not too bad thanks.
translation: 还不错，谢谢。 [hai bu cuo ， xie xie 。]

translation: 你是在要求打架吗？ [ni shi zai yao qiu da jia ma ？]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

translation: 关你屁事。 [guan ni pi shi 。]

translation: 您想进行交易吗？ [nin xiang jin xing jiao yi ma ？]

translation: 不，我没有零钱。 [bu ， wo mei you ling qian 。]
