translation: 我有点担心——我听说有很多人到处乱杀公民。 [wo you dian dan xin —— wo ting shuo you hen duo ren dao chu luan sha gong min 。]

english: No, I don't want to buy anything!
translation: 不，我不想买任何东西！ [bu ， wo bu xiang mai ren he dong xi ！]

english: That is classified information.
translation: 那是机密信息。 [na shi ji mi xin xi 。]

english: Have this flyer...
translation: 有这张传单... [you zhe zhang chuan dan ...]

english: Yo, wassup!
translation: 哟，真是的！ [yo ， zhen shi de ！]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Excuse me!
translation: 打扰一下！ [da rao yi xia ！]

english: Oh sorry, what did I do?
translation: 哦，对不起，我做了什么？ [o ， dui bu qi ， wo zuo le shen me ？]

english: Can't you see I'm on the toilet?
translation: 你没看到我在上厕所吗？ [ni mei kan dao wo zai shang ce suo ma ？]

english: Wait a minute... a toilet?
translation: 等一下……厕所？ [deng yi xia …… ce suo ？]

english: Yeah. A toilet.
translation: 是的。一个厕所。 [shi de 。 yi ge ce suo 。]

english: Riiiight. Oh, man, you didn't wipe your hands?
translation: 对了。哎呀，你没擦手吗？ [dui le 。 ai ya ， ni mei ca shou ma ？]

english: Get over it.
translation: 克服它。 [ke fu ta 。]

english: What are you doing in my house?
translation: 你在我家做什么？ [ni zai wo jia zuo shen me ？]

english: I was just exploring.
translation: 我只是在探索。 [wo zhi shi zai tan suo 。]

english: You're exploring my house?
translation: 你在探索我的房子吗？ [ni zai tan suo wo de fang zi ma ？]

english: You don't mind, do you?
translation: 你不介意吧？ [ni bu jie yi ba ？]

english: But... why are you exploring in my house?
translation: 但是……你为什么要来我家探险？ [dan shi …… ni wei shen me yao lai wo jia tan xian ？]

english: Oh, I don't know, I just wandered in, saw you and thought it'd be fun to speak to you.
translation: 哦，我不知道，我只是闲逛进来，看到了你，觉得和你说话会很有趣。 [o ， wo bu zhi dao ， wo zhi shi xian guang jin lai ， kan dao le ni ， jue de he ni shuo hua hui hen you qu 。]

english: ... you are very strange...
translation: ……你很奇怪…… […… ni hen qi guai ……]

english: Perhaps I should go now.
translation: 也许我现在应该走了。 [ye xu wo xian zai ying gai zou le 。]

english: Yes, please go away now.
translation: 是的，请现在就走开。 [shi de ， qing xian zai jiu zou kai 。]

english: NPC backs away from the player
translation: NPC 远离玩家 [NPC  yuan li wan jia]

english: [Good day, sir/Good day, madam/Good day]. What brings you to this end of town?
translation: [美好的一天，先生/美好的一天，女士/美好的一天]。是什么让你来到城镇的这一端？ [[ mei hao de yi tian ， xian sheng / mei hao de yi tian ， nv shi / mei hao de yi tian ]。 shi shen me rang ni lai dao cheng zhen de zhe yi duan ？]

english: Well, what is there to do around here?
translation: 那么，这附近有什么可玩的呢？ [na me ， zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ne ？]

english: If you're into Mining, plenty! The dwarves have one of the largest mines in the world just under our feet. There's an entrance in the building just north-east of my house.
translation: 如果您喜欢采矿，那就足够了！矮人的地雷就在我们脚下，是世界上最大的地雷之一。我家东北方的大楼里有一个入口。 [ru guo nin xi huan cai kuang ， na jiu zu gou le ！ ai ren de di lei jiu zai wo men jiao xia ， shi shi jie shang zui da de di lei zhi yi 。 wo jia dong bei fang de da lou li you yi ge ru kou 。]

english: If you'd rather enjoy yourself, there's the party room just north of here! Or you might like to climb up onto the city wall - you can get a good view of Falador from there.
translation: 如果您想玩得开心，这里北边就有派对室！或者您可能想爬上城墙 - 您可以从那里欣赏法拉多的美景。 [ru guo nin xiang wan de kai xin ， zhe li bei bian jiu you pai dui shi ！ huo zhe nin ke neng xiang pa shang cheng qiang  -  nin ke yi cong na li xin shang fa la duo de mei jing 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: ... whassup?
translation: ……什么事？ […… shen me shi ？]

english: Are you alright?
translation: 你还好吗？ [ni hai hao ma ？]

english: ... see... two of you... why there two of you?
translation: ...看...你们两个...为什么是你们两个？ [... kan ... ni men liang ge ... wei shen me shi ni men liang ge ？]

english: There's only one of me, friend.
translation: 朋友，只有我一个人。 [peng you ， zhi you wo yi ge ren 。]

english: ... no, two of you... you can't count... ... maybe you drunk too much...
translation: ……不，你们两个……数不过来……也许你们喝太多了…… […… bu ， ni men liang ge …… shu bu guo lai …… ye xu ni men he tai duo le ……]

english: Whatever you say, friend.
translation: 不管你说什么，朋友。 [bu guan ni shuo shen me ， peng you 。]

english: ... giant hairy cabbages...
translation: ...巨型卷心菜... [... ju xing juan xin cai ...]

english: Molten lava! MOLTEN LAVA!
translation: 熔岩！熔岩！ [rong yan ！ rong yan ！]

english: Snakes! Snakes! Ohhhh, there are snakes!
translation: 蛇！蛇！呵呵，有蛇啊！ [she ！ she ！ he he ， you she a ！]

english: Why don't I have a 'Teleport Home to Lumbridge' button like everyone else?
translation: 为什么我没有像其他人一样有“传送家乡到朗布里奇”按钮？ [wei shen me wo mei you xiang qi ta ren yi yang you “ chuan song jia xiang dao lang bu li qi ” an niu ？]

english: Too many monkeys - I can't stand it!
translation: 猴子太多了——我受不了！ [hou zi tai duo le —— wo shou bu liao ！]

english: I should have stayed in Port Sarim.
translation: 我应该留在沙里姆港。 [wo ying gai liu zai sha li mu gang 。]

english: So... many... trees...
translation: 这么多……很多……树…… [zhe me duo …… hen duo …… shu ……]

english: I can't take the heat!
translation: 我受不了热气了！ [wo shou bu liao re qi le ！]

english: Party! Party!
translation: 派对！派对！ [pai dui ！ pai dui ！]

english: Something's happening in the party room!
translation: 宴会厅里出事了！ [yan hui ting li chu shi le ！]

english: Everyone get to the party room!
translation: 大家都到宴会厅去吧！ [da jia dou dao yan hui ting qu ba ！]

english: What's happening in the party room?
translation: 宴会厅里发生了什么？ [yan hui ting li fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: Someone's having a big party!
translation: 有人要举办盛大的聚会！ [you ren yao ju ban sheng da de ju hui ！]

english: Get to the party room NOW!
translation: 立即前往派对室！ [li ji qian wang pai dui shi ！]

english: Get to the party room!
translation: 快去宴会厅吧！ [kuai qu yan hui ting ba ！]

english: Get to the party room quick!
translation: 快去聚会室吧！ [kuai qu ju hui shi ba ！]

english: Big value items in the party room now!
translation: 现在派对房间里有超值物品！ [xian zai pai dui fang jian li you chao zhi wu pin ！]

english: Quick! Get to the party room!
translation: 快的！快去宴会厅吧！ [kuai de ！ kuai qu yan hui ting ba ！]

english: Do you want to trade?
translation: 你想交易吗？ [ni xiang jiao yi ma ？]

english: I'm in search of a quest.
translation: 我正在寻找一个任务。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yi ge ren wu 。]

english: I'm in search of enemies to kill.
translation: 我正在寻找要杀死的敌人。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yao sha si de di ren 。]

english: Can I get past please?
translation: 请问我可以过去吗？ [qing wen wo ke yi guo qu ma ？]

english: Not just yet. The swamp has flooded the roads again, it's unsafe to pass.
translation: 还不是现在。沼泽又淹没了道路，通过不安全。 [hai bu shi xian zai 。 zhao ze you yan mo le dao lu ， tong guo bu an quan 。]

english: So how long will the road be blocked for?
translation: 那么这条路会被堵多久呢？ [na me zhe tiao lu hui bei du duo jiu ne ？]

english: Who can tell? It's one of the drawbacks to living in a swamp. You get used to it after a while.
translation: 谁能告诉我？这是生活在沼泽中的缺点之一。一段时间后你就会习惯了。 [shui neng gao su wo ？ zhe shi sheng huo zai zhao ze zhong de que dian zhi yi 。 yi duan shi jian hou ni jiu hui xi guan le 。]

english: DON'T EAT ME!
translation: 别吃我！ [bie chi wo ！]

english: Umm, I'm not going to eat you. Are you ok?
translation: 嗯，我不会吃你的。你还好吗？ [n ， wo bu hui chi ni de 。 ni hai hao ma ？]

english: She said she would return after the second fork.
translation: 她说她会在第二次分叉后回来。 [ta shuo ta hui zai di er ci fen cha hou hui lai 。]

english: Fork?
translation: 叉？ [cha ？]

english: You can't eat jelly with a fork. Are you mad?
translation: 你不能用叉子吃果冻。你疯了？ [ni bu neng yong cha zi chi guo dong 。 ni feng le ？]

english: Ummm... no... I'll just leave you to it.
translation: 嗯...不...我就让你自己解决吧。 [n ... bu ... wo jiu rang ni zi ji jie jue ba 。]

english: Green tongue snakes.
translation: 绿舌蛇。 [lv she she 。]

english: Occupied!
translation: 占领！ [zhan ling ！]

english: I've seen that one before. It's yours now.
translation: 我以前见过那个。现在它是你的了。 [wo yi qian jian guo na ge 。 xian zai ta shi ni de le 。]

english: That's very kind of you, but no thanks.
translation: 你真是太好了，不过不用谢。 [ni zhen shi tai hao le ， bu guo bu yong xie 。]

english: I want the adventure to end.
translation: 我希望冒险结束。 [wo xi wang mao xian jie shu 。]

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: The man takes 99 damage, killing him.
translation: 该男子受到 99 点伤害并死亡。 [gai nan zi shou dao  99  dian shang hai bing si wang 。]

english: It stinks down here.
translation: 这里很臭。 [zhe li hen chou 。]

english: Can't you just leave me alone.
translation: 你就不能让我一个人呆着吗？ [ni jiu bu neng rang wo yi ge ren dai zhe ma ？]

english: I don't trust that fish monger.
translation: 我不相信那个鱼贩。 [wo bu xiang xin na ge yu fan 。]

english: Lighting fires in an enclosed space is probably not a good idea. Oh well.
translation: 在封闭空间内生火可能不是一个好主意。那好吧。 [zai feng bi kong jian nei sheng huo ke neng bu shi yi ge hao zhu yi 。 na hao ba 。]

english: I guess it's not all bad down here. At least we have a pub.
translation: 我想这里并不全是坏事。至少我们有一个酒吧。 [wo xiang zhe li bing bu quan shi huai shi 。 zhi shao wo men you yi ge jiu ba 。]

english: I'll leave this place one day. You'll see.
translation: 总有一天我会离开这个地方。你会看到的。 [zong you yi tian wo hui li kai zhe ge di fang 。 ni hui kan dao de 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Go away. People from the outside shut us in like animals. I have nothing to say to you.
translation: 离开。外面的人把我们像动物一样关在里面。我无话可说。 [li kai 。 wai mian de ren ba wo men xiang dong wu yi yang guan zai li mian 。 wo wu hua ke shuo 。]

english: An outsider! Can you get me out of this hell hole?
translation: 一个外人！你能带我离开这个地狱吗？ [yi ge wai ren ！ ni neng dai wo li kai zhe ge di yu ma ？]

english: Sorry, that's not what I'm here to do.
translation: 抱歉，我来这里不是为了这个。 [bao qian ， wo lai zhe li bu shi wei le zhe ge 。]

english: Nilsal.
translation: 尼尔萨尔。 [ni er sa er 。]

english: Hello there. You don't seem too happy.
translation: 你好呀。你看起来不太高兴。 [ni hao ya 。 ni kan qi lai bu tai gao xing 。]

english: It's far too cold up here. Ralos' Rise is cold, but this is something else! I have to be here though. If this beast has any connections to the Old Ones, it might also have connections to Ralos and Ranul!
translation: 这里太冷了。拉洛斯高地很冷，但这是另一回事！但我必须在这里。如果这头野兽与古圣有任何联系，它也可能与拉洛斯和拉努尔有联系！ [zhe li tai leng le 。 la luo si gao di hen leng ， dan zhe shi ling yi hui shi ！ dan wo bi xu zai zhe li 。 ru guo zhe tou ye shou yu gu sheng you ren he lian xi ， ta ye ke neng yu la luo si he la nu er you lian xi ！]

english: Me being here also keeps the dwarves a bit happier as well. They keep claiming they're the ones doing all the work and that there needs to be more humans up here helping.
translation: 我的存在也让矮人们更加高兴。他们一直声称他们是所有工作的负责人，并且需要更多的人在这里提供帮助。 [wo de cun zai ye rang ai ren men geng jia gao xing 。 ta men yi zhi sheng cheng ta men shi suo you gong zuo de fu ze ren ， bing qie xu yao geng duo de ren zai zhe li ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: Is that true?
translation: 这是真的吗？ [zhe shi zhen de ma ？]

english: I don't think so. I've seen plenty of people come up here and get involved. The dwarves don't actually do any of the fighting anyway. They just go in and do some mining once the danger has passed.
translation: 我不这么认为。我看到很多人来到这里参与其中。无论如何，矮人实际上并没有参与任何战斗。一旦危险过去，他们就会进去采矿。 [wo bu zhe me ren wei 。 wo kan dao hen duo ren lai dao zhe li can yu qi zhong 。 wu lun ru he ， ai ren shi ji shang bing mei you can yu ren he zhan dou 。 yi dan wei xian guo qu ， ta men jiu hui jin qu cai kuang 。]

english: I can't imagine they'd be happy to hear you say that.
translation: 我无法想象他们会很高兴听到你这么说。 [wo wu fa xiang xiang ta men hui hen gao xing ting dao ni zhe me shuo 。]

english: Good point. Forget I said anything.
translation: 好点。忘记我说过什么。 [hao dian 。 wang ji wo shuo guo shen me 。]

english: Who are you and what is this place?
translation: 你是谁？这是什么地方？ [ni shi shui ？ zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: My name is Mandrith.
translation: 我的名字是曼德里斯。 [wo de ming zi shi man de li si 。]

english: I collect valuable resources and pawn off access to them to foolish adventurers, like yourself.
translation: 我收集宝贵的资源，并将这些资源的使用权典当给像你这样的愚蠢的冒险家。 [wo shou ji bao gui de zi yuan ， bing jiang zhe xie zi yuan de shi yong quan dian dang gei xiang ni zhe yang de yu chun de mao xian jia 。]

english: You should take a look inside my arena. There's an abundance of valuable resources inside.
translation: 你应该看看我的竞技场里面。里面蕴藏着丰富的宝贵资源。 [ni ying gai kan kan wo de jing ji chang li mian 。 li mian yun cang zhe feng fu de bao gui zi yuan 。]

english: And I can take whatever I want?
translation: 我可以拿走我想要的任何东西吗？ [wo ke yi na zou wo xiang yao de ren he dong xi ma ？]

english: It's all yours. All I ask is you pay the upfront fee.
translation: 都是你的了。我只要求你支付预付费用。 [dou shi ni de le 。 wo zhi yao qiu ni zhi fu yu fu fei yong 。]

english: Will others be able to kill me inside?
translation: 别人能在里面杀掉我吗？ [bie ren neng zai li mian sha diao wo ma ？]

english: Yes. These walls will only hold them back for so long.
translation: 是的。这些墙只能阻挡他们这么久。 [shi de 。 zhe xie qiang zhi neng zu dang ta men zhe me jiu 。]

english: You'll stop them though, right?
translation: 不过你会阻止他们的，对吧？ [bu guo ni hui zu zhi ta men de ， dui ba ？]

english: Haha! For the right price, I won't deny any one access to my arena. Even if their intention is to kill you.
translation: 哈哈！只要价格合适，我不会拒绝任何人进入我的竞技场。即使他们的目的是要杀了你。 [ha ha ！ zhi yao jia ge he shi ， wo bu hui ju jue ren he ren jin ru wo de jing ji chang 。 ji shi ta men de mu di shi yao sha le ni 。]

english: Right...
translation: 正确的... [zheng que de ...]

english: My arena holds many treasures that I've acquired at great expense, adventurer. Their bounty can come at a price.
translation: 我的竞技场里有很多我花费重金获得的宝物，冒险者。他们的赏金是有代价的。 [wo de jing ji chang li you hen duo wo hua fei zhong jin huo de de bao wu ， mao xian zhe 。 ta men de shang jin shi you dai jia de 。]

english: One day, adventurer, I will boast ownership of a much larger, much more dangerous arena than this. Take advantage of this offer while it lasts.
translation: 有一天，冒险家，我会夸耀自己拥有一个比这里更大、更危险的竞技场。 Take advantage of this offer while it lasts. [you yi tian ， mao xian jia ， wo hui kua yao zi ji yong you yi ge bi zhe li geng da 、 geng wei xian de jing ji chang 。 Take advantage of this offer while it lasts.]

english: Answer this, please.
translation: 请回答这个问题。 [qing hui da zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Well done.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: You've been given a [new clue/casket]!
translation: 你已经获得了[新线索/棺材]！ [ni yi jing huo de le [ xin xian suo / guan cai ]！]

english: Here, solve this.
translation: 来，解决这个问题。 [lai ， jie jue zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Mandrith hands you a [light box/puzzlebox]!
translation: Mandrith递给你一个【灯箱/拼图盒】！ [Mandrith di gei ni yi ge 【 deng xiang / pin tu he 】！]

english: That doesn't look solved to me.
translation: 在我看来这并没有解决。 [zai wo kan lai zhe bing mei you jie jue 。]

english: Well done [player name]. Here you go.
translation: 干得好[玩家姓名]。干得好。 [gan de hao [ wan jia xing ming ]。 gan de hao 。]

english: Why am I the one who is always left clearing up after everyone?
translation: 为什么我是那个总是在大家后面清理的人？ [wei shen me wo shi na ge zong shi zai da jia hou mian qing li de ren ？]

english: Hello? Anyone there?
translation: 你好？有人在吗？ [ni hao ？ you ren zai ma ？]

english: Hello? Lacey? Sid?
translation: 你好？莱西？席德？ [ni hao ？ lai xi ？ xi de ？]

english: Hmm, well I guess I should go check it out. No point staying in this nice, locked room when I could go outside into the creepy darkness.
translation: 嗯，我想我应该去看看。当我可以走出去进入令人毛骨悚然的黑暗时，呆在这个漂亮的、上锁的房间里毫无意义。 [n ， wo xiang wo ying gai qu kan kan 。 dang wo ke yi zou chu qu jin ru ling ren mao gu song ran de hei an shi ， dai zai zhe ge piao liang de 、 shang suo de fang jian li hao wu yi yi 。]

english: Seriously!?
translation: 严重地！？ [yan zhong di ！？]

english: The walls and door seem too thick for Mandy to be able to hear you.
translation: 墙壁和门似乎太厚，曼迪听不到你说话。 [qiang bi he men si hu tai hou ， man di ting bu dao ni shuo hua 。]

english: Oh, and I don't think there is any need to take this big, shiny weapon with me in order to defend myself. Nothing bad ever happens when people go check out noises in the dark outside of houses!
translation: 哦，我认为没有必要随身携带这个又大又闪亮的武器来保护自己。当人们在屋外黑暗中检查噪音时，不会发生任何坏事！ [o ， wo ren wei mei you bi yao sui shen xie dai zhe ge you da you shan liang de wu qi lai bao hu zi ji 。 dang ren men zai wu wai hei an zhong jian cha zao yin shi ， bu hui fa sheng ren he huai shi ！]

english: You have got to be kidding...
translation: 你一定是在开玩笑…… [ni yi ding shi zai kai wan xiao ……]

english: Ok, well, here I go!
translation: 好吧，好吧，我开始了！ [hao ba ， hao ba ， wo kai shi le ！]

english: Mandy goes outside to investigate the noises.
translation: 曼迪出去调查噪音。 [man di chu qu diao cha zao yin 。]

english: Hello, anyone out here?
translation: 你好，有人在吗？ [ni hao ， you ren zai ma ？]

english: Mandy looks around.
translation: 曼迪环顾四周。 [man di huan gu si zhou 。]

english: See, I knew nothing would happen! Must have just been a squirrel or something running about.
translation: 看，我知道不会发生任何事情！一定是一只松鼠或者什么东西在跑来跑去。 [kan ， wo zhi dao bu hui fa sheng ren he shi qing ！ yi ding shi yi zhi song shu huo zhe shen me dong xi zai pao lai pao qu 。]

english: Mandy goes back into the kitchen.
translation: 曼迪回到厨房。 [man di hui dao chu fang 。]

english: Oh well, back to the dishes.
translation: 哦，好吧，回到菜肴。 [o ， hao ba ， hui dao cai yao 。]

english: Phew, that was lucky!
translation: 唷，真幸运！ [yo ， zhen xing yun ！]

english: The killer comes out of the closet near the exit and stabs Mandy.
translation: 凶手从出口附近的衣柜里出来，刺伤了曼迪。 [xiong shou cong chu kou fu jin de yi gui li chu lai ， ci shang le man di 。]

english: No...why...me...
translation: 不……为什么……我…… [bu …… wei shen me …… wo ……]

english: Mandy dies.
translation: 曼迪死了。 [man di si le 。]

english: That psycho! He was just toying with her!
translation: 那个神经病！他只是在玩弄她而已！ [na ge shen jing bing ！ ta zhi shi zai wan nong ta er yi ！]

english: The killer slips a note under the door, and escapes using the closet.
translation: 凶手在门下塞了一张纸条，然后利用壁橱逃跑了。 [xiong shou zai men xia sai le yi zhang zhi tiao ， ran hou li yong bi chu tao pao le 。]

english: Another note. This guy really likes playing games, but this is going to be a game he won't win!
translation: 另一个注意事项。这家伙很喜欢玩游戏，但这将是一场他赢不了的游戏！ [ling yi ge zhu yi shi xiang 。 zhe jia huo hen xi huan wan you xi ， dan zhe jiang shi yi chang ta ying bu liao de you xi ！]

english: You'll never escape me!
translation: 你永远都逃不出我的手掌心！ [ni yong yuan dou tao bu chu wo de shou zhang xin ！]

english: In the background, Mandy gets up.
translation: 在背景中，曼迪站了起来。 [zai bei jing zhong ， man di zhan le qi lai 。]

english: You dare try and ruin my moment!
translation: 你竟敢尝试毁掉我的时刻！ [ni jing gan chang shi hui diao wo de shi ke ！]

english: Mandy walks toward the Bandos godsword on the table.
translation: 曼迪走向桌上的班多斯神剑。 [man di zou xiang zhuo shang de ban duo si shen jian 。]

english: Hewey is dead because of you!
translation: 休伊因你而死！ [xiu yi yin ni er si ！]

english: Mandy picks up the Bandos godsword and enters the closet.
translation: 曼迪拿起班多斯神剑并进入壁橱。 [man di na qi ban duo si shen jian bing jin ru bi chu 。]

english: Now it is time for you to join him!
translation: 现在是你和他一起的时候了！ [xian zai shi ni he ta yi qi de shi hou le ！]

english: Mandy comes out of the closet behind Mandy.
translation: 曼迪从曼迪身后的衣柜里出来。 [man di cong man di shen hou de yi gui li chu lai 。]

english: You're not killing anyone else!
translation: 你又不杀别人！ [ni you bu sha bie ren ！]

english: Mandy uses the sword's special attack on Abigale.
translation: 曼迪对阿比盖尔使用剑的特殊攻击。 [man di dui a bi gai er shi yong jian de te shu gong ji 。]

english: No....this can't be it....
translation: 不……这不可能…… [bu …… zhe bu ke neng ……]

english: Abigale dies.
translation: 阿比盖尔去世。 [a bi gai er qu shi 。]

english: Wow, that was close!
translation: 哇，太接近了！ [wa ， tai jie jin le ！]

english: Mandy, how are you alive!? I watched you get stabbed through the heart!
translation: 曼迪，你怎么还活着！？我看着你的心被刺穿！ [man di ， ni zen me hai huo zhe ！？ wo kan zhe ni de xin bei ci chuan ！]

english: I did get stabbed, but I was born with a rare condition called Dextrocardia.
translation: 我确实被刺伤了，但我生来就患有一种罕见的疾病，叫做右位心症。 [wo que shi bei ci shang le ， dan wo sheng lai jiu huan you yi zhong han jian de ji bing ， jiao zuo you wei xin zheng 。]

english: Dextrowhat?
translation: 右旋什么？ [you xuan shen me ？]

english: Dextrocardia. It means that my heart is on the right side of my chest, not the left like most people.
translation: 右位心。这意味着我的心脏位于胸部的右侧，而不是像大多数人那样位于左侧。 [you wei xin 。 zhe yi wei zhe wo de xin zang wei yu xiong bu de you ce ， er bu shi xiang da duo shu ren na yang wei yu zuo ce 。]

english: So when the killer thought they stabbed you in the heart, they actually missed?
translation: 所以当凶手以为他们刺进了你的心脏时，他们实际上没有刺中？ [suo yi dang xiong shou yi wei ta men ci jin le ni de xin zang shi ， ta men shi ji shang mei you ci zhong ？]

english: Well, missed the heart yes.
translation: 好吧，错过了心是的。 [hao ba ， cuo guo le xin shi de 。]

english: I did still get stabbed though, and am actually feeling pretty woozy...
translation: 但我还是被刺伤了，而且我真的感觉很头晕…… [dan wo hai shi bei ci shang le ， er qie wo zhen de gan jue hen tou yun ……]

english: Oh, yes, right! You should go sort yourself out!
translation: 哦，对了，对了！你该去收拾一下自己了！ [o ， dui le ， dui le ！ ni gai qu shou shi yi xia zi ji le ！]

english: I will wait outside the house after seeing to this stab wound. You should come talk to me there.
translation: 处理好这个刺伤后，我会在屋外等候。你应该到那里来和我说话。 [chu li hao zhe ge ci shang hou ， wo hui zai wu wai deng hou 。 ni ying gai dao na li lai he wo shuo hua 。]

english: Oh hi, [player name].
translation: 哦嗨，[玩家姓名]。 [o hai ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Hi Mandy. How are you feeling now?
translation: 嗨曼迪。你现在感觉怎么样？ [hai man di 。 ni xian zai gan jue zen me yang ？]

english: Much better thanks, and lucky to be alive, thanks to you in no small part.
translation: 更好的是，谢谢你，很幸运能活着，这在很大程度上要感谢你。 [geng hao de shi ， xie xie ni ， hen xing yun neng huo zhe ， zhe zai hen da cheng du shang yao gan xie ni 。]

english: Well we saved the day as a team, so thank you too.
translation: 好吧，我们作为一个团队挽救了这一天，所以也谢谢你们。 [hao ba ， wo men zuo wei yi ge tuan dui wan jiu le zhe yi tian ， suo yi ye xie xie ni men 。]

english: I found some stuff in the wardrobe when I was seeing to my wound. You need [[3/2] more space(s)/another space] in your inventory to take it all.
translation: 当我检查伤口时，我在衣柜里发现了一些东西。您的库存中需要[[3/2]更多空间/另一个空间]才能拿走全部。 [dang wo jian cha shang kou shi ， wo zai yi gui li fa xian le yi xie dong xi 。 nin de ku cun zhong xu yao [[3/2] geng duo kong jian / ling yi ge kong jian ] cai neng na zou quan bu 。]

english: Here, I found these in the wardrobe when I was seeing to my wound. I don't want them so please, take them...
translation: 这是我在检查伤口时在衣柜里发现的。我不想要它们，所以请把它们带走…… [zhe shi wo zai jian cha shang kou shi zai yi gui li fa xian de 。 wo bu xiang yao ta men ， suo yi qing ba ta men dai zou ……]

english: Congratulations! Quest complete!
translation: 恭喜！任务完成！ [gong xi ！ ren wu wan cheng ！]

english: Thanks again for your help, [player name]. Stay safe.
translation: 再次感谢您的帮助，[玩家姓名]。保持安全。 [zai ci gan xie nin de bang zhu ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。 bao chi an quan 。]

english: You too, Mandy.
translation: 你也是，曼迪。 [ni ye shi ， man di 。]

english: *shuffle*
translation: *随机播放* [* sui ji bo fang *]

english: *rustle*
translation: *沙沙* [* sha sha *]

english: *scratch*
translation: *划痕* [* hua hen *]

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好呀！ [ni hao ya ！]

english: Do not think me rude outerlander, but our customs forbid me talking to you. All contact with outerlanders must be vetted by our chieftain, Brundt.
translation: 别以为我是粗鲁的外地人，但我们的习俗禁止我和你说话。所有与外地人的接触都必须经过我们的酋长布伦特的审查。 [bie yi wei wo shi cu lu de wai di ren ， dan wo men de xi su jin zhi wo he ni shuo hua 。 suo you yu wai di ren de jie chu dou bi xu jing guo wo men de qiu zhang bu lun te de shen cha 。]

english: Where is this Brundt?
translation: 这个布伦特在哪里？ [zhe ge bu lun te zai na li ？]

english: He is standing just over there. He will speak for the tribe.
translation: 他就站在那边。他将为部落说话。 [ta jiu zhan zai na bian 。 ta jiang wei bu luo shuo hua 。]

english: Hello outerlander. I overheard your conversation with Brundt just now. You wish to become a member of the Fremennik?
translation: 外地人你好。我刚才无意中听到了你和布伦特的谈话。您想成为自由党的一员吗？ [wai di ren ni hao 。 wo gang cai wu yi zhong ting dao le ni he bu lun te de tan hua 。 nin xiang cheng wei zi you dang de yi yuan ma ？]

english: That's right! Why, are you on the council?
translation: 这是正确的！为什么，你是理事会成员吗？ [zhe shi zheng que de ！ wei shen me ， ni shi li shi hui cheng yuan ma ？]

english: Do not let my drink-soused appearance fool you, I earnt my place on the council many years past. I am always glad to see new blood enter our tribe, and will happily vote for you.
translation: 别让我醉酒的外表欺骗了你，我在很多年前就赢得了在议会的一席之地。我总是很高兴看到新的血液进入我们的部落，并且很乐意为你投票。 [bie rang wo zui jiu de wai biao qi pian le ni ， wo zai hen duo nian qian jiu ying de le zai yi hui de yi xi zhi di 。 wo zong shi hen gao xing kan dao xin de xue ye jin ru wo men de bu luo ， bing qie hen le yi wei ni tou piao 。]

english: Great!
translation: 伟大的！ [wei da de ！]

english: ...Providing you can pass a little test for me. As a Fremennik, you will need to show cunning, stamina, fortitude, and an iron constitution. I know of only one way to test all of these.
translation: ……前提是你能帮我通过一个小测试。作为一名弗里曼尼克人，你需要表现出狡猾、耐力、刚毅和钢铁般的体质。我知道只有一种方法可以测试所有这些。 […… qian ti shi ni neng bang wo tong guo yi ge xiao ce shi 。 zuo wei yi ming fu li man ni ke ren ， ni xu yao biao xian chu jiao hua 、 nai li 、 gang yi he gang tie ban de ti zhi 。 wo zhi dao zhi you yi zhong fang fa ke yi ce shi suo you zhe xie 。]

english: And what's that?
translation: 那是什么？ [na shi shen me ？]

english: Why, a drinking contest!
translation: 哎呀，一场饮酒比赛！ [ai ya ， yi chang yin jiu bi sai ！]

english: The task is simple enough! You versus me, a stiff drink each, last man standing wins the trial. So what say you?
translation: 任务很简单！你对我，各喝一杯烈酒，最后站立的人获胜。那你怎么说呢？ [ren wu hen jian dan ！ ni dui wo ， ge he yi bei lie jiu ， zui hou zhan li de ren huo sheng 。 na ni zen me shuo ne ？]

english: A drinking contest? Easy. Set them up, and I'll knock them back.
translation: 饮酒比赛？简单的。把它们摆好，我会把它们击退。 [yin jiu bi sai ？ jian dan de 。 ba ta men bai hao ， wo hui ba ta men ji tui 。]

english: When you are ready to begin, go and pick up a keg from that table over there, and come back here.
translation: 当你准备好开始时，去那边桌子上拿起一个小桶，然后回到这里。 [dang ni zhun bei hao kai shi shi ， qu na bian zhuo zi shang na qi yi ge xiao tong ， ran hou hui dao zhe li 。]

english: We start when you have your keg of beer with you, and finish when one of us can drink no more and yields.
translation: 当你带着一桶啤酒时我们就开始了，当我们中的一个人不能再喝并且屈服时我们就结束了。 [dang ni dai zhe yi tong pi jiu shi wo men jiu kai shi le ， dang wo men zhong de yi ge ren bu neng zai he bing qie qu fu shi wo men jiu jie shu le 。]

english: I don't think drinking myself into a stupor is a very good way of testing my worthiness.
translation: 我不认为喝得酩酊大醉是检验自己价值的好方法。 [wo bu ren wei he de ming ding da zui shi jian yan zi ji jia zhi de hao fang fa 。]

english: Well, perhaps it's not, but it's my way. If you want my vote at the council, I'm afraid you're going to have to drink me under the table.
translation: 好吧，也许不是，但这是我的方式。如果你想让我在议会投票，恐怕你得在桌子底下把我喝醉了。 [hao ba ， ye xu bu shi ， dan zhe shi wo de fang shi 。 ru guo ni xiang rang wo zai yi hui tou piao ， kong pa ni de zai zhuo zi di xia ba wo he zui le 。]

english: I'm going to find someone else to vote for me then.
translation: 到时候我会去找其他人来投票给我。 [dao shi hou wo hui qu zhao qi ta ren lai tou piao gei wo 。]

english: As you wish, outerlander.
translation: 如你所愿，外地人。 [ru ni suo yuan ， wai di ren 。]

english: What do I have to do to earn your vote again?
translation: 我需要做什么才能再次赢得您的投票？ [wo xu yao zuo shen me cai neng zai ci ying de nin de tou piao ？]

english: Beat me in a drinking contest! Grab a keg of beer from that table near the bar, and come back here with it.
translation: 在饮酒比赛中击败我！从酒吧附近的桌子上拿一桶啤酒，然后带着它回到这里。 [zai yin jiu bi sai zhong ji bai wo ！ cong jiu ba fu jin de zhuo zi shang na yi tong pi jiu ， ran hou dai zhe ta hui dao zhe li 。]

english: Oh yeah. Okay, I will do.
translation: 哦，是的。好的，我会做的。 [o ， shi de 。 hao de ， wo hui zuo de 。]

english: Hey outerlander! I don't take kindly to people coming here and stealing my beer!
translation: 嘿，外地人！我不喜欢来这里偷我啤酒的人！ [hei ， wai di ren ！ wo bu xi huan lai zhe li tou wo pi jiu de ren ！]

english: You already have a keg of beer.
translation: 你已经有一桶啤酒了。 [ni yi jing you yi tong pi jiu le 。]

english: Ah, I see you have your keg of beer. Are we ready to drink against each other?
translation: 啊，我看到你有桶啤酒。我们准备好互相喝酒了吗？ [a ， wo kan dao ni you tong pi jiu 。 wo men zhun bei hao hu xiang he jiu le ma ？]

english: Yes, let's start this drinking contest!
translation: 是的，我们开始这场饮酒比赛吧！ [shi de ， wo men kai shi zhe chang yin jiu bi sai ba ！]

english: As you wish outerlander; I will drink first, then you will drink.
translation: 如你所愿，外乡人；我先喝，你再喝。 [ru ni suo yuan ， wai xiang ren ； wo xian he ， ni zai he 。]

english: (cutscene plays. The screen sways after your character drinks, but becomes stable after Manni talks about rematch.)
translation: （过场动画播放。角色喝酒后屏幕会晃动，但在曼尼谈到复赛后屏幕变得稳定。） [（ guo chang dong hua bo fang 。 jue se he jiu hou ping mu hui huang dong ， dan zai man ni tan dao fu sai hou ping mu bian de wen ding 。）]

english: The Fremennik drinks from his tankard first. He staggers a little bit.
translation: 弗雷曼尼克人首先从他的酒杯里喝水。他有点踉踉跄跄。 [fu lei man ni ke ren shou xian cong ta de jiu bei li he shui 。 ta you dian liang liang qiang qiang 。]

english: You drink from your keg. You feel extremely drunk...
translation: 你从你的小桶里喝。你感觉自己醉得很厉害... [ni cong ni de xiao tong li he 。 ni gan jue zi ji zui de hen li hai ...]

english: Ish no' fair! (hic) I canna drink another drop! I alsho feel veddy, veddy ill...
translation: 这不公平！ （呃）我不能再喝一滴了！我也觉得维迪，维迪病了...... [zhe bu gong ping ！ （ e ） wo bu neng zai he yi di le ！ wo ye jue de wei di ， wei di bing le ......]

english: I guessh I win then ouddaladder! (hic) Niche try, anyway!
translation: 我想我赢了，然后 ouddaladder！ （哈克）无论如何，利基尝试！ [wo xiang wo ying le ， ran hou  ouddaladder！ （ ha ke ） wu lun ru he ， li ji chang shi ！]

english: Come back if'n you fanshy a rematch! (hic) Jusht let me have a coffee firsht...
translation: 如果你喜欢重赛就回来吧！ （呃）先让我喝杯咖啡吧…… [ru guo ni xi huan zhong sai jiu hui lai ba ！ （ e ） xian rang wo he bei ka fei ba ……]

english: I'm not quite ready yet...
translation: 我还没准备好... [wo hai mei zhun bei hao ...]

english: Want to line your stomach with some food or something, huh outerlander? Come back to me when you're ready to drink.
translation: 想吃点东西填饱肚子吗，外地人？等你准备好喝的时候就回来找我吧。 [xiang chi dian dong xi tian bao du zi ma ， wai di ren ？ deng ni zhun bei hao he de shi hou jiu hui lai zhao wo ba 。]

english: Thinking of cheating my test, outerlander? I don't think so! You drink that keg fairly, or not at all! Don't let me catch you cheating!
translation: 想在考试中作弊吗，外乡人？我不这么认为！你可以公平地喝那桶酒，或者根本不喝！别让我发现你作弊！ [xiang zai kao shi zhong zuo bi ma ， wai xiang ren ？ wo bu zhe me ren wei ！ ni ke yi gong ping di he na tong jiu ， huo zhe gen ben bu he ！ bie rang wo fa xian ni zuo bi ！]

english: I'm going to have to find some way to distract this guy while I cheat...
translation: 我得想办法在我作弊的时候分散这个家伙的注意力…… [wo de xiang ban fa zai wo zuo bi de shi hou fen san zhe ge jia huo de zhu yi li ……]

english: (drinking ensues, but this time the player doesn't get drunk and finished the entire keg without any issues)
translation: （接着喝酒，但这一次玩家没有喝醉，并且没有任何问题地喝完了整个小桶） [（ jie zhe he jiu ， dan zhe yi ci wan jia mei you he zui ， bing qie mei you ren he wen ti di he wan le zheng ge xiao tong ）]

english: You drink from your keg. You don't feel drunk at all.
translation: 你从你的小桶里喝。你一点也不觉得醉。 [ni cong ni de xiao tong li he 。 ni yi dian ye bu jue de zui 。]

english: Aaaah, lovely stuff. So you want to get the next round in, or shall I? You don't look so good there!
translation: 啊啊啊，可爱的东西。那么你想参加下一轮，还是我参加？你那儿看起来不太好！ [a a a ， ke ai de dong xi 。 na me ni xiang can jia xia yi lun ， hai shi wo can jia ？ ni na er kan qi lai bu tai hao ！]

english: Wassha? Guh? You drank that whole keg! But it dinna affect you at all! I conshede! You can probably outdrink me!
translation: 瓦沙？呃？你把整桶都喝光了！但它根本不会影响你！我承认！你可能喝得比我多！ [wa sha ？ e ？ ni ba zheng tong dou he guang le ！ dan ta gen ben bu hui ying xiang ni ！ wo cheng ren ！ ni ke neng he de bi wo duo ！]

english: I jusht can't (hic) believe it! Thatsh shome mighty fine drinking legs you got! Anyone who can drink like THAT getsh my vote atta consh.. counsh... gets my vote!
translation: 我简直不敢（呃）相信！那就是你拥有的强大的饮酒腿！任何能像这样喝酒的人都会得到我的投票 atta consh.. counsh... 得到我的投票！ [wo jian zhi bu gan （ e ） xiang xin ！ na jiu shi ni yong you de qiang da de yin jiu tui ！ ren he neng xiang zhe yang he jiu de ren du hui de dao wo de tou piao  atta consh.. counsh...  de dao wo de tou piao ！]

english: Congratulations! You have completed the Revellers' trial
translation: 恭喜！您已完成狂欢者的审判 [gong xi ！ nin yi wan cheng kuang huan zhe de shen pan]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: (same as previously)
translation: （与之前相同） [（ yu zhi qian xiang tong ）]

english: So I can rely on your vote at the council?
translation: 那么我可以相信你在理事会的投票吗？ [na me wo ke yi xiang xin ni zai li shi hui de tou piao ma ？]

english: Absholutely! (hic) You're one mighty drinker!
translation: 绝对！ （哈克）你真是个酒鬼！ [jue dui ！ （ ha ke ） ni zhen shi ge jiu gui ！]

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a token to allow a seat at the champions table, do you?
translation: 我想你不知道我在哪里可以找到一个代币来获得冠军牌桌的席位，是吗？ [wo xiang ni bu zhi dao wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao yi ge dai bi lai huo de guan jun pai zhuo de xi wei ， shi ma ？]

english: As a matter of fact, I do. I have one right here. I earnt my place here at the longhall for surviving over 5000 battles and raiding parties.
translation: 事实上，我愿意。我这里有一个。我因在 5000 多次战斗和袭击中幸存下来而赢得了长厅的一席之地。 [shi shi shang ， wo yuan yi 。 wo zhe li you yi ge 。 wo yin zai  5000  duo ci zhan dou he xi ji zhong xing cun xia lai er ying de le zhang ting de yi xi zhi di 。]

english: Due to my contribution to the tribe, I am now permitted to spend my days here in the longhall listening to the epic tales of the bard, and drinking beer.
translation: 由于我对部落的贡献，我现在被允许在长厅里度过我的日子，聆听吟游诗人的史诗故事，喝啤酒。 [you yu wo dui bu luo de gong xian ， wo xian zai bei yun xu zai zhang ting li du guo wo de ri zi ， ling ting yin you shi ren de shi shi gu shi ， he pi jiu 。]

english: Cool. That sounds pretty sweet! So I guess you don't want to give it away?
translation: 凉爽的。听起来很甜蜜！所以我猜你不想放弃它？ [liang shuang de 。 ting qi lai hen tian mi ！ suo yi wo cai ni bu xiang fang qi ta ？]

english: I think it sounds better than it actually is outerlander. I miss my glory days of combat on the battlefield. And to tell you the truth, the beer here isn't great, and the bards' music is lousy.
translation: 我认为这听起来比实际上更好。我怀念在战场上战斗的辉煌岁月。说实话，这里的啤酒并不好，吟游诗人的音乐也很糟糕。 [wo ren wei zhe ting qi lai bi shi ji shang geng hao 。 wo huai nian zai zhan chang shang zhan dou de hui huang sui yue 。 shuo shi hua ， zhe li de pi jiu bing bu hao ， yin you shi ren de yin yue ye hen zao gao 。]

english: I would happily give up my token if it were not for the one thing that keeps me here. Our barkeep is one of the best in the world, and has worked in taverns across the land.
translation: 如果不是因为一件事让我留在这里，我会很乐意放弃我的代币。我们的酒保是世界上最好的酒保之一，曾在全国各地的酒馆工作过。 [ru guo bu shi yin wei yi jian shi rang wo liu zai zhe li ， wo hui hen le yi fang qi wo de dai bi 。 wo men de jiu bao shi shi jie shang zui hao de jiu bao zhi yi ， ceng zai quan guo ge di de jiu guan gong zuo guo 。]

english: When she was younger, she experimented a lot with her drinks, and invented a cocktail so alcoholic and tasty that it has become something of a legend to all who enjoy a drink.
translation: 当她年轻的时候，她对饮料进行了很多尝试，并发明了一种酒精度高、味道鲜美的鸡尾酒，它已经成为所有喜欢喝酒的人的传奇。 [dang ta nian qing de shi hou ， ta dui yin liao jin xing le hen duo chang shi ， bing fa ming liao yi zhong jiu jing du gao 、 wei dao xian mei de ji wei jiu ， ta yi jing cheng wei suo you xi huan he jiu de ren de chuan qi 。]

english: Unfortunately, she decided that cocktails were not a suitable drink for Fremennik warriors, and vowed to never again make it.
translation: 不幸的是，她认为鸡尾酒不适合弗雷曼尼克战士，并发誓不再制作鸡尾酒。 [bu xing de shi ， ta ren wei ji wei jiu bu shi he fu lei man ni ke zhan shi ， bing fa shi bu zai zhi zuo ji wei jiu 。]

english: I have been here every day since she returned, hoping that someday she might change her mind and I might try this legendary cocktail for myself. Alas, it has never come to pass...
translation: 自从她回来后，我每天都来这里，希望有一天她会改变主意，我也可以亲自尝试一下这种传奇的鸡尾酒。唉，这种事从来没有发生过…… [zi cong ta hui lai hou ， wo mei tian dou lai zhe li ， xi wang you yi tian ta hui gai bian zhu yi ， wo ye ke yi qin zi chang shi yi xia zhe zhong chuan qi de ji wei jiu 。 ai ， zhe zhong shi cong lai mei you fa sheng guo ……]

english: If you can persuade her to make me her legendary cocktail, I will be happy to never let another drop of alcohol pass my lips, and will give you my champions token.
translation: 如果你能说服她为我调制她传奇的鸡尾酒，我会很高兴不再让任何一滴酒精从我嘴里流过，并且会给你我的冠军令牌。 [ru guo ni neng shuo fu ta wei wo tiao zhi ta chuan qi de ji wei jiu ， wo hui hen gao xing bu zai rang ren he yi di jiu jing cong wo zui li liu guo ， bing qie hui gei ni wo de guan jun ling pai 。]

english: That's all?
translation: 就这样？ [jiu zhe yang ？]

english: That's all.
translation: 就这样。 [jiu zhe yang 。]

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find the longhall barkeeps' legendary cocktail, do you?
translation: 我想你不知道我在哪里可以找到长厅酒吧老板的传奇鸡尾酒，是吗？ [wo xiang ni bu zhi dao wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao zhang ting jiu ba lao ban de chuan qi ji wei jiu ， shi ma ？]

english: Uh... yes, the longhall barkeep has it. So could you get me my drink now please?
translation: 呃……是的，长廊酒吧的酒保有。那么现在可以给我拿一杯饮料吗？ [e …… shi de ， chang lang jiu ba de jiu bao you 。 na me xian zai ke yi gei wo na yi bei yin liao ma ？]

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a written promise from Askeladden to stay out of the Longhall?
translation: 我想你不知道我在哪里可以找到阿斯凯拉登的书面承诺，让我远离长厅？ [wo xiang ni bu zhi dao wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao a si kai la deng de shu mian cheng nuo ， rang wo yuan li zhang ting ？]

english: Uh... call it a crazy hunch, but did you even try asking Askeladden about that?
translation: 呃……称其为疯狂的预感，但你有没有尝试向阿斯凯拉登询问此事？ [e …… cheng qi wei feng kuang de yu gan ， dan ni you mei you chang shi xiang a si kai la deng xun wen ci shi ？]

english: Hey. I got your cocktail for you.
translation: 嘿。我为你准备了鸡尾酒。 [hei 。 wo wei ni zhun bei le ji wei jiu 。]

english: ...It is true! The legendary cocktail! I have waited for this day ever since I first started drinking!
translation: ...是真的！传说中的鸡尾酒！从我第一次喝酒开始，我就一直在等待这一天！ [... shi zhen de ！ chuan shuo zhong de ji wei jiu ！ cong wo di yi ci he jiu kai shi ， wo jiu yi zhi zai deng dai zhe yi tian ！]

english: Here outerlander, you may take my token. I will happily give up my place at the longhalls table of champions just for a taste of this exquisite beverage!
translation: 外地人，你可以拿走我的令牌。我很乐意放弃长厅冠军桌的位置，只为了品尝这种精致的饮料！ [wai di ren ， ni ke yi na zou wo de ling pai 。 wo hen le yi fang qi zhang ting guan jun zhuo de wei zhi ， zhi wei le pin chang zhe zhong jing zhi de yin liao ！]

english: It's just a drink...
translation: 这只是一杯饮料而已... [zhe zhi shi yi bei yin liao er yi ...]

english: No, it is an artform. A drink such as this should be appreciated, and admired. It is like a fine painting, or a tasteful sculpture.
translation: 不，这是一种艺术形式。像这样的饮料应该受到赞赏和钦佩。它就像一幅精美的画作，或者一件有品味的雕塑。 [bu ， zhe shi yi zhong yi shu xing shi 。 xiang zhe yang de yin liao ying gai shou dao zan shang he qin pei 。 ta jiu xiang yi fu jing mei de hua zuo ， huo zhe yi jian you pin wei de diao su 。]

english: If what I hear is true, then all other drinks become like unpalatable water in comparison to this!
translation: 如果我听到的属实的话，其他的饮料和这个比起来就都变得难喝了！ [ru guo wo ting dao de shu shi de hua ， qi ta de yin liao he zhe ge bi qi lai jiu dou bian de nan he le ！]

english: I guess you're happy with the trade then!
translation: 我猜你对这次交易很满意！ [wo cai ni dui zhe ci jiao yi hen man yi ！]

english: So it doesn't bother you at all that you just gave up your place here for one drink?
translation: 所以你为了喝一杯而放弃这里的位置一点也不困扰？ [suo yi ni wei le he yi bei er fang qi zhe li de wei zhi yi dian ye bu kun rao ？]

english: Ah, but it was not just any drink... It was the finest cocktail ever created! Now that I have tasted it, I need never drink again, for my tastebuds will never be so excited!
translation: 啊，但这不仅仅是任何饮料......这是有史以来最好的鸡尾酒！既然尝过了，我就不用再喝了，因为我的味蕾再也不会如此兴奋了！ [a ， dan zhe bu jin jin shi ren he yin liao ...... zhe shi you shi yi lai zui hao de ji wei jiu ！ ji ran chang guo le ， wo jiu bu yong zai he le ， yin wei wo de wei lei zai ye bu hui ru ci xing fen le ！]

english: So it was nice?
translation: 那么这很好吗？ [na me zhe hen hao ma ？]

english: It was... exquisite!
translation: 真是……精致！ [zhen shi …… jing zhi ！]

english: What did it taste of, then?
translation: 那它尝起来是什么味道呢？ [na ta chang qi lai shi shen me wei dao ne ？]

english: Mostly tomato juice.
translation: 主要是番茄汁。 [zhu yao shi fan qie zhi 。]

english: Howdy!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Hey! It's [Fremennik name]! Let me buy you a drink!
translation: 嘿！这是[弗雷曼尼克名字]！让我请您喝杯饮料！ [hei ！ zhe shi [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！ rang wo qing nin he bei yin liao ！]

english: There ya go! Anyone who can drink like you earns my respect!
translation: 就这样吧！像你这样能喝酒的人，值得我尊敬！ [jiu zhe yang ba ！ xiang ni zhe yang neng he jiu de ren ， zhi de wo zun jing ！]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: Ask about the Merchant's trial
translation: 询问商家试用情况 [xun wen shang jia shi yong qing kuang]

english: Ask about becoming a Fremennik
translation: 询问成为 Fremennik 的问题 [xun wen cheng wei  Fremennik  de wen ti]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: You! I bet you're with them!
translation: 你！我打赌你和他们在一起！ [ni ！ wo da du ni he ta men zai yi qi ！]

english: Them?
translation: 他们？ [ta men ？]

english: The frogs!
translation: 青蛙们！ [qing wa men ！]

english: Frogs? What are you on about?
translation: 青蛙？你在忙什么？ [qing wa ？ ni zai mang shen me ？]

english: Ah, I see. So you're going to play dumb are you? Well I won't fall for your lies!
translation: 啊，我明白了。所以你要装傻是吗？好吧，我不会相信你的谎言！ [a ， wo ming bai le 。 suo yi ni yao zhuang sha shi ma ？ hao ba ， wo bu hui xiang xin ni de huang yan ！]

english: I promise I have no idea what you're on about. If you explain, maybe I can help you?
translation: 我保证我不知道你在说什么。如果你解释一下，也许我可以帮助你？ [wo bao zheng wo bu zhi dao ni zai shuo shen me 。 ru guo ni jie shi yi xia ， ye xu wo ke yi bang zhu ni ？]

english: It's those frogs on the other side of the oasis! They're out to get us! All of us! If someone doesn't kill them all, we'll be living our lives as their slaves!
translation: 是绿洲另一边的那些青蛙！他们是来抓我们的！我们所有人！如果有人不把他们全部杀掉，我们就会像他们的奴隶一样生活！ [shi lv zhou ling yi bian de na xie qing wa ！ ta men shi lai zhua wo men de ！ wo men suo you ren ！ ru guo you ren bu ba ta men quan bu sha diao ， wo men jiu hui xiang ta men de nu li yi yang sheng huo ！]

english: I see... How about I head over there and take a look?
translation: 原来如此……我去那里看看怎么样？ [yuan lai ru ci …… wo qu na li kan kan zen me yang ？]

english: You want to go near them? Well then you're a fool! I will watch from a safe distance as they dine on your corpse!
translation: 你想靠近他们吗？那么你就是个傻瓜！我会在安全距离处看着它们吃你的尸体！ [ni xiang kao jin ta men ma ？ na me ni jiu shi ge sha gua ！ wo hui zai an quan ju li chu kan zhe ta men chi ni de shi ti ！]

english: Okay then... Well provided that doesn't happen, I'll be back shortly to let you know what I've found.
translation: 好吧……好吧，只要这种情况不会发生，我很快就会回来告诉你我的发现。 [hao ba …… hao ba ， zhi yao zhe zhong qing kuang bu hui fa sheng ， wo hen kuai jiu hui hui lai gao su ni wo de fa xian 。]

english: I think I'm just going to go now. You clearly have some... issues that you need to get on top of.
translation: 我想我现在就走了。您显然有一些...需要解决的问题。 [wo xiang wo xian zai jiu zou le 。 nin xian ran you yi xie ... xu yao jie jue de wen ti 。]

english: That's it! You walk away! Just remember, I know the truth!
translation: 就是这样！你走开！请记住，我知道真相！ [jiu shi zhe yang ！ ni zou kai ！ qing ji zhu ， wo zhi dao zhen xiang ！]

english: Hello again. You helped forge my alliance with the frogs against those disgusting flies. Please feel free to use my farming patch in return. It's the least I can do.
translation: 又好。你帮助我与青蛙结成联盟，对抗那些令人厌恶的苍蝇。请随意使用我的农田作为回报。这是我至少能做的。 [you hao 。 ni bang zhu wo yu qing wa jie cheng lian meng ， dui kang na xie ling ren yan wu de cang ying 。 qing sui yi shi yong wo de nong tian zuo wei hui bao 。 zhe shi wo zhi shao neng zuo de 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
translation: 你愿意帮我照料我的庄稼吗？ [ni yuan yi bang wo zhao liao wo de zhuang jia ma ？]

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 你能给我一些农业建议吗？ [ni neng gei wo yi xie nong ye jian yi ma ？]

english: Can you sell me something?
translation: 你能卖给我东西吗？ [ni neng mai gei wo dong xi ma ？]

english: I'll come back another time.
translation: 我下次再来。 [wo xia ci zai lai 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hi there. So much to see here!
translation: 你好呀。这里有太多值得一看的东西！ [ni hao ya 。 zhe li you tai duo zhi de yi kan de dong xi ！]

english: Yep, could be looking all day!
translation: 是的，可能会看一整天！ [shi de ， ke neng hui kan yi zheng tian ！]

english: Updated any displays yet?
translation: 更新了任何显示吗？ [geng xin le ren he xian shi ma ？]

english: Yes, I just learned more about some priestly warriors and a staff of the gods.
translation: 是的，我刚刚了解了更多关于一些祭司战士和神杖的信息。 [shi de ， wo gang gang liao jie le geng duo guan yu yi xie ji si zhan shi he shen zhang de xin xi 。]

english: Sounds fun, how did you do that?
translation: 听起来很有趣，你是怎么做到的？ [ting qi lai hen you qu ， ni shi zen me zuo dao de ？]

english: Ahh, I'm big on quests me, love questing. So when I've done one, I check here with 'Historian' Minas to see if I can help the Museum out with some information. Sometimes they already know it, or don't want to know,
translation: 啊，我很热衷于探索，喜欢探索。因此，当我完成一项工作后，我会与“历史学家”米纳斯联系，看看我是否可以帮助博物馆提供一些信息。有时他们已经知道，或者不想知道， [a ， wo hen re zhong yu tan suo ， xi huan tan suo 。 yin ci ， dang wo wan cheng yi xiang gong zuo hou ， wo hui yu “ li shi xue jia ” mi na si lian xi ， kan kan wo shi fou ke yi bang zhu bo wu guan ti gong yi xie xin xi 。 you shi ta men yi jing zhi dao ， huo zhe bu xiang zhi dao ，]

english: and sometimes it earns me a reward or two.
translation: 有时它会给我带来一两个奖励。 [you shi ta hui gei wo dai lai yi liang ge jiang li 。]

english: That sounds really good. Perhaps I should do the same!
translation: 听起来确实不错。也许我也应该这样做！ [ting qi lai que shi bu cuo 。 ye xu wo ye ying gai zhe yang zuo ！]

english: You should, as well as everything else there is here in the Museum. Did you know they have a really fun- looking display down in the basement? I love monkeys.
translation: 您应该，以及博物馆里的其他一切。你知道他们在地下室有一个看起来非常有趣的展示吗？我喜欢猴子。 [nin ying gai ， yi ji bo wu guan li de qi ta yi qie 。 ni zhi dao ta men zai di xia shi you yi ge kan qi lai fei chang you qu de zhan shi ma ？ wo xi huan hou zi 。]

english: I'll check it out. Got to get going now, nice talking to you.
translation: 我会检查一下。现在得走了，很高兴与你交谈。 [wo hui jian cha yi xia 。 xian zai de zou le ， hen gao xing yu ni jiao tan 。]

english: Have a good day!
translation: 祝你有美好的一天！ [zhu ni you mei hao de yi tian ！]

english: Hi there!
translation: 你好呀！ [ni hao ya ！]

english: Hello, what are you doing here?
translation: 你好，你在这里做什么？ [ni hao ， ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Oh, just taking a look at these displays. I'm a bit of a history buff.
translation: 哦，只是看看这些展示。我有点历史爱好者。 [o ， zhi shi kan kan zhe xie zhan shi 。 wo you dian li shi ai hao zhe 。]

english: Really? Tell me something I didn't know!
translation: 真的吗？告诉我一些我不知道的事情！ [zhen de ma ？ gao su wo yi xie wo bu zhi dao de shi qing ！]

english: Well, did you know that Bob the Cat is... no, no... you'd never believe me anyway.
translation: 好吧，你知道鲍勃猫是……不，不……无论如何你永远不会相信我。 [hao ba ， ni zhi dao bao bo mao shi …… bu ， bu …… wu lun ru he ni yong yuan bu hui xiang xin wo 。]

english: He's what? Tell me!
translation: 他是什么？告诉我！ [ta shi shen me ？ gao su wo ！]

english: No, no. Couldn't possibly ruin the surprise.
translation: 不，不。不可能破坏这个惊喜。 [bu ， bu 。 bu ke neng po huai zhe ge jing xi 。]

english: ARG! Tell me!
translation: ARG！告诉我！ [ARG！ gao su wo ！]

english: If you really want to know, go talk to Unferth in his house in Burthorpe.
translation: 如果你真的想知道，可以去 Unferth 位于 Burthorpe 的家里与他交谈。 [ru guo ni zhen de xiang zhi dao ， ke yi qu  Unferth  wei yu  Burthorpe  de jia li yu ta jiao tan 。]

english: Hi!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Oh, hello. I was just looking at this display here.
translation: 哦，你好。我只是在这里看这个展示。 [o ， ni hao 。 wo zhi shi zai zhe li kan zhe ge zhan shi 。]

english: Anything interesting?
translation: 有什么有趣的吗？ [you shen me you qu de ma ？]

english: Yes, one I just updated by talking to 'Historian' Minas. I'm a bit of a quester you see.
translation: 是的，我刚刚通过与“历史学家”米纳斯交谈而更新了这一点。你看，我有点像一个探索者。 [shi de ， wo gang gang tong guo yu “ li shi xue jia ” mi na si jiao tan er geng xin le zhe yi dian 。 ni kan ， wo you dian xiang yi ge tan suo zhe 。]

english: Okay, I'll let you get on then.
translation: 好吧，那我就让你上车了。 [hao ba ， na wo jiu rang ni shang che le 。]

english: Hmm, yes. Okay. Don't forget to check out the Natural History exhibit - you could learn a lot.
translation: 嗯，是的。好的。不要忘记参观自然历史展览 - 您可以学到很多东西。 [n ， shi de 。 hao de 。 bu yao wang ji can guan zi ran li shi zhan lan  -  nin ke yi xue dao hen duo dong xi 。]

english: Right, bye!
translation: 对了，再见！ [dui le ， zai jian ！]

english: Hmm... 3rd Age.... No, no...maybe 4th...
translation: 嗯...第三纪...不，不...也许是第四纪... [n ... di san ji ... bu ， bu ... ye xu shi di si ji ...]

english: Hello?
translation: 你好？ [ni hao ？]

english: Yes, that's it, just like that. Mustn't forget the map either....hmm...what else?
translation: 是的，就是这样，就这样。也不能忘记地图……嗯……还有什么？ [shi de ， jiu shi zhe yang ， jiu zhe yang 。 ye bu neng wang ji di tu …… n …… hai you shen me ？]

english: HELLO! Are you there?
translation: 你好！你在吗？ [ni hao ！ ni zai ma ？]

english: Oh, hello there. Sorry, was a bit engrosed in updating this display. I've just been out questing and thought I'd stop off here you see. It's quite rewarding too.
translation: 哦，你好。抱歉，我有点全神贯注于更新此显示。我刚刚出去探索，想在这里停下来，你瞧。也是相当有收获的。 [o ， ni hao 。 bao qian ， wo you dian quan shen guan zhu yu geng xin ci xian shi 。 wo gang gang chu qu tan suo ， xiang zai zhe li ting xia lai ， ni qiao 。 ye shi xiang dang you shou huo de 。]

english: Yes, well, no need to ignore me.
translation: 是的，好吧，没必要忽视我。 [shi de ， hao ba ， mei bi yao hu shi wo 。]

english: No offence intended, my dear chap. Just very interested in this history stuff, that's all.
translation: 无意冒犯，我亲爱的小伙子。只是对历史的东西很感兴趣，仅此而已。 [wu yi mao fan ， wo qin ai de xiao huo zi 。 zhi shi dui li shi de dong xi hen gan xing qu ， jin ci er yi 。]

english: Okay. Have you seen the Natural History exhibit in the basement?
translation: 好的。您看过地下室的自然历史展览吗？ [hao de 。 nin kan guo di xia shi de zi ran li shi zhan lan ma ？]

english: Oh, yes, marvellous isn't it! I particularly like the wyvern, very interesting considering they've never found a live specimen. And to think they could possibly have been flapping around at one time!
translation: 哦，是的，太棒了不是吗！我特别喜欢双足飞龙，考虑到它们从未发现过活体标本，这非常有趣。想想看，它们可能曾经在同一时间拍打翅膀！ [o ， shi de ， tai bang le bu shi ma ！ wo te bie xi huan shuang zu fei long ， kao lv dao ta men cong wei fa xian guo huo ti biao ben ， zhe fei chang you qu 。 xiang xiang kan ， ta men ke neng ceng jing zai tong yi shi jian pai da chi bang ！]

english: A bit like the crazy gnomes and their gliders. Have you seen the model they have upstairs?
translation: 有点像疯狂的侏儒和他们的滑翔机。楼上的模型你见过吗？ [you dian xiang feng kuang de zhu ru he ta men de hua xiang ji 。 lou shang de mo xing ni jian guo ma ？]

english: Yes, very intricate isn't it? Worrying to think some people risk their lives in them! You wouldn't catch me up in one. Had a chat with Jacques while I was up there, the art critic...he's a bit funny in the head.
translation: 是的，非常复杂不是吗？想想有些人冒着生命危险就很担心！你不会在其中追上我的。我在那里的时候和艺术评论家雅克聊过……他脑子里有点滑稽。 [shi de ， fei chang fu za bu shi ma ？ xiang xiang you xie ren mao zhe sheng ming wei xian jiu hen dan xin ！ ni bu hui zai qi zhong zhui shang wo de 。 wo zai na li de shi hou he yi shu ping lun jia ya ke liao guo …… ta nao zi li you dian hua ji 。]

english: That's not very nice!
translation: 这不太好！ [zhe bu tai hao ！]

english: Well, he thinks he's going to get an entire portrait gallery to himself!
translation: 好吧，他认为他将拥有整个肖像画廊！ [hao ba ， ta ren wei ta jiang yong you zheng ge xiao xiang hua lang ！]

english: Who knows, the Museum just got really big and appears to have cash. They might entertain him with his very own floor - we'll see.
translation: 谁知道呢，博物馆变得非常大，而且似乎有现金。他们可能会用他自己的地板来招待他——我们拭目以待。 [shui zhi dao ne ， bo wu guan bian de fei chang da ， er qie si hu you xian jin 。 ta men ke neng hui yong ta zi ji de di ban lai zhao dai ta —— wo men shi mu yi dai 。]

english: I guess so. Wonder what poetry he'll come up with then! Still, I must get on with this display. See you around I hope!
translation: 大概吧。不知道他会写出什么样的诗呢！尽管如此，我还是必须继续这个展示。我希望见到你！ [da gai ba 。 bu zhi dao ta hui xie chu shen me yang de shi ne ！ jin guan ru ci ， wo hai shi bi xu ji xu zhe ge zhan shi 。 wo xi wang jian dao ni ！]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Hi, have you seen the Dig Site displays?
translation: 你好，你看过挖掘现场的展示吗？ [ni hao ， ni kan guo wa jue xian chang de zhan shi ma ？]

english: Yes, good aren't they! Have you done the quest?
translation: 是的，他们不是很好吗！你完成任务了吗？ [shi de ， ta men bu shi hen hao ma ！ ni wan cheng ren wu le ma ？]

english: Not yet.
translation: 还没有。 [hai mei you 。]

english: Oh you should, it lets you get into that bit where they clean the finds, and you can join in!
translation: 哦，你应该这样做，它可以让你进入他们清理发现物的地方，你可以加入！ [o ， ni ying gai zhe yang zuo ， ta ke yi rang ni jin ru ta men qing li fa xian wu de di fang ， ni ke yi jia ru ！]

english: Sounds fun, I should probably check it out.
translation: 听起来很有趣，我应该去看看。 [ting qi lai hen you qu ， wo ying gai qu kan kan 。]

english: I do not speak to outlanders.
translation: 我不跟外地人说话。 [wo bu gen wai di ren shuo hua 。]

english: Maybe you should speak with Rellekka's Chieftain.
translation: 也许你应该和雷莱卡的酋长谈谈。 [ye xu ni ying gai he lei lai ka de qiu zhang tan tan 。]

english: Please excuse me, I'm rather busy.
translation: 请原谅我，我比较忙。 [qing yuan liang wo ， wo bi jiao mang 。]

english: Hey, I'm your contractor from Mahogany Homes, what did you want done?
translation: 嘿，我是 Mahogany Homes 的承包商，你想要做什么？ [hei ， wo shi  Mahogany Homes  de cheng bao shang ， ni xiang yao zuo shen me ？]

english: I'd like a Wooden table built.
translation: 我想要一张木桌。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang mu zhuo 。]

english: I'd like my sink fixed.
translation: 我想修一下我的水槽。 [wo xiang xiu yi xia wo de shui cao 。]

english: I'd like a Wooden shelf built.
translation: 我想要一个木架子。 [wo xiang yao yi ge mu jia zi 。]

english: I'd like a Wooden cupboard built.
translation: 我想要一个木柜子。 [wo xiang yao yi ge mu gui zi 。]

english: I'd like a Wooden bed built.
translation: 我想要一张木床。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang mu chuang 。]

english: I'd like two Wooden small tables built.
translation: 我想要两张木制小桌子。 [wo xiang yao liang zhang mu zhi xiao zhuo zi 。]

english: I'd like my hat stand fixed.
translation: 我想把我的帽架修好。 [wo xiang ba wo de mao jia xiu hao 。]

english: I'd like a Oak table built.
translation: 我想要一张橡木桌子。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang xiang mu zhuo zi 。]

english: I'd like a Oak shelf built.
translation: 我想要一个橡木架子。 [wo xiang yao yi ge xiang mu jia zi 。]

english: I'd like a Oak cupboard built.
translation: 我想要一个橡木橱柜。 [wo xiang yao yi ge xiang mu chu gui 。]

english: I'd like a Oak bed built.
translation: 我想要一张橡木床。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang xiang mu chuang 。]

english: I'd like two Oak small tables built.
translation: 我想要两张橡木小桌子。 [wo xiang yao liang zhang xiang mu xiao zhuo zi 。]

english: I'd like a Teak table built.
translation: 我想要一张柚木桌子。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang you mu zhuo zi 。]

english: I'd like a Teak shelf built.
translation: 我想要一个柚木架子。 [wo xiang yao yi ge you mu jia zi 。]

english: I'd like a Teak cupboard built.
translation: 我想要一个柚木橱柜。 [wo xiang yao yi ge you mu chu gui 。]

english: I'd like a Teak bed built.
translation: 我想要一张柚木床。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang you mu chuang 。]

english: I'd like two Teak small tables built.
translation: 我想要两张柚木小桌子。 [wo xiang yao liang zhang you mu xiao zhuo zi 。]

english: I'd like a Mahogany table built.
translation: 我想要一张红木桌子。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang hong mu zhuo zi 。]

english: I'd like a Mahogany shelf built.
translation: 我想要一个桃花心木架子。 [wo xiang yao yi ge tao hua xin mu jia zi 。]

english: I'd like a Mahogany cupboard built.
translation: 我想要一个桃花心木橱柜。 [wo xiang yao yi ge tao hua xin mu chu gui 。]

english: I'd like a Mahogany bed built.
translation: 我想要一张红木床。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang hong mu chuang 。]

english: I'd like two Mahogany small tables built.
translation: 我想要两张桃花心木小桌子。 [wo xiang yao liang zhang tao hua xin mu xiao zhuo zi 。]

english: I've finished with the work you wanted.
translation: 我已经完成了你想要的工作。 [wo yi jing wan cheng le ni xiang yao de gong zuo 。]

english: Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: 太感谢了！走之前你想喝杯茶吗？ [tai gan xie le ！ zou zhi qian ni xiang he bei cha ma ？]

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
translation: 是的，我想要一杯茶。 [shi de ， wo xiang yao yi bei cha 。]

english: No thanks, I better be off.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我最好离开了。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo zui hao li kai le 。]

english: Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!
translation: 啊啊，没有什么比一杯美味的茶更好的了！ [a a ， mei you shen me bi yi bei mei wei de cha geng hao de le ！]

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
translation: 是的，我想要一杯茶。 [shi de ， wo xiang yao yi bei cha 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Are you a member of the Group of Advanced Gardeners?
translation: 您是高级园丁小组的成员吗？ [nin shi gao ji yuan ding xiao zu de cheng yuan ma ？]

english: Why, yes I am. Why do you ask?
translation: 为什么，是的，我是。你为什么问？ [wei shen me ， shi de ， wo shi 。 ni wei shen me wen ？]

english: Martin has asked me to investigate why all the crops are failing.
translation: 马丁让我调查为什么所有庄稼都歉收。 [ma ding rang wo diao cha wei shen me suo you zhuang jia dou qian shou 。]

english: No, I'm afraid I don't know anything about that.
translation: 不，恐怕我对此一无所知。 [bu ， kong pa wo dui ci yi wu suo zhi 。]

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
translation: 你愿意帮我照料我的庄稼吗？ [ni yuan yi bang wo zhao liao wo de zhuang jia ma ？]

english: I might - which patch were you thinking of?
translation: 我可能 - 你想到的是哪个补丁？ [wo ke neng  -  ni xiang dao de shi na ge bu ding ？]

english: You don't have any seeds planted in that patch. Plant some and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: 你在那块土地上没有种下任何种子。种一些，我可能会同意帮你照顾它。 [ni zai na kuai tu di shang mei you zhong xia ren he zhong zi 。 zhong yi xie ， wo ke neng hui tong yi bang ni zhao gu ta 。]

english: That patch is already fully grown! I don't know what you want me to do with it!
translation: 那块补丁已经完全长大了！我不知道你想让我用它做什么！ [na kuai bu ding yi jing wan quan zhang da le ！ wo bu zhi dao ni xiang rang wo yong ta zuo shen me ！]

english: That patch is dead - it's too late for me to do anything about it now.
translation: 那个补丁已经死了——现在对我来说做任何事情都太晚了。 [na ge bu ding yi jing si le —— xian zai dui wo lai shuo zuo ren he shi qing dou tai wan le 。]

english: That patch is diseased - you should cure it before asking me to be responsible for it!.
translation: 那个补丁有病——你应该先治愈它，然后再要求我对它负责！ [na ge bu ding you bing —— ni ying gai xian zhi yu ta ， ran hou zai yao qiu wo dui ta fu ze ！]

english: I don't know what you're talking about - I'm already looking after that patch for you.
translation: 我不知道你在说什么 - 我已经在为你处理那个补丁了。 [wo bu zhi dao ni zai shuo shen me  -  wo yi jing zai wei ni chu li na ge bu ding le 。]

english: Oh sorry, I forgot.
translation: 哦，抱歉，我忘了。 [o ， bao qian ， wo wang le 。]

english: I want 2 buckets of compost for that.
translation: 我想要两桶堆肥。 [wo xiang yao liang tong dui fei 。]

english: I want one sack of potatoes for that.
translation: 我想要一袋土豆。 [wo xiang yao yi dai tu dou 。]

english: I want one sack of onions for that.
translation: 我想要一袋洋葱。 [wo xiang yao yi dai yang cong 。]

english: I want 2 sacks of cabbages for that.
translation: 我想要两袋卷心菜。 [wo xiang yao liang dai juan xin cai 。]

english: I want 10 jute fibers for that.
translation: 我需要 10 根黄麻纤维。 [wo xu yao  10  gen huang ma xian wei 。]

english: I want one basket of apples for that.
translation: 我想要一篮子苹果。 [wo xiang yao yi lan zi ping guo 。]

english: I want 10 curry leaves for that.
translation: 我想要 10 片咖喱叶。 [wo xiang yao  10  pian ga li ye 。]

english: I want 5 jangerberries for that.
translation: 我想要 5 个姜莓。 [wo xiang yao  5  ge jiang mei 。]

english: I'm afraid I don't have any of those at the moment.
translation: 恐怕我现在没有这些。 [kong pa wo xian zai mei you zhe xie 。]

english: Well I'm not wasting my time for free.
translation: 好吧，我不会免费浪费时间。 [hao ba ， wo bu hui mian fei lang fei shi jian 。]

english: I'm afraid I don't have enough of those at the moment.
translation: 恐怕我现在还没有足够的东西。 [kong pa wo xian zai hai mei you zu gou de dong xi 。]

english: Okay, it's a deal.
translation: “好吧，成交。” [“ hao ba ， cheng jiao 。”]

english: That'll do nicely, [sir/madam]. Leave it with me - I'll make sure that patch grows for you.
translation: 那就太好了，[先生/女士]。把它留给我吧——我会确保这个补丁适合你。 [na jiu tai hao le ，[ xian sheng / nv shi ]。 ba ta liu gei wo ba —— wo hui que bao zhe ge bu ding shi he ni 。]

english: No, that's too much.
translation: 不，那太多了。 [bu ， na tai duo le 。]

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 你能给我一些农业建议吗？ [ni neng gei wo yi xie nong ye jian yi ma ？]

english: The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
translation: 治愈灌木或树木疾病的唯一方法是用剪刀剪掉患病的叶子。对于所有其他作物，我只会使用一些植物疗法。 [zhi yu guan mu huo shu mu ji bing de wei yi fang fa shi yong jian dao jian diao huan bing de ye zi 。 dui yu suo you qi ta zuo wu ， wo zhi hui shi yong yi xie zhi wu liao fa 。]

english: Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
translation: 树木种子必须在土壤花盆中长成树苗，然后转移到树丛中继续生长直至成年。 [shu mu zhong zi bi xu zai tu rang hua pen zhong chang cheng shu miao ， ran hou zhuan yi dao shu cong zhong ji xu sheng zhang zhi zhi cheng nian 。]

english: You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
translation: 您最多可以在蔬菜袋中放入十个土豆、卷心菜或洋葱，但不能将它们混合放在同一个袋子中。 [nin zui duo ke yi zai shu cai dai zhong fang ru shi ge tu dou 、 juan xin cai huo yang cong ， dan bu neng jiang ta men hun he fang zai tong yi ge dai zi zhong 。]

english: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
translation: 您可以从农田商店购买所有农具，农田商店位于耕地附近。 [nin ke yi cong nong tian shang dian gou mai suo you nong ju ， nong tian shang dian wei yu geng di fu jin 。]

english: Bittercap mushrooms can only be grown in a special patch in Morytania, near the Mort Myre swamp. There the ground is especially dank and suited to growing poisonous fungii.
translation: 苦蘑菇只能生长在莫里塔尼亚莫特迈尔沼泽附近的一块特殊土地上。那里的地面特别潮湿，适合有毒真菌的生长。 [ku mo gu zhi neng sheng zhang zai mo li ta ni ya mo te mai er zhao ze fu jin de yi kuai te shu tu di shang 。 na li de di mian te bie chao shi ， shi he you du zhen jun de sheng zhang 。]

english: Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
translation: 超级堆肥比普通堆肥好得多，但制造成本更高。你需要腐烂正确类型的物品；给我看一个物品，我会告诉你它是否超级可堆肥。 [chao ji dui fei bi pu tong dui fei hao de duo ， dan zhi zao cheng ben geng gao 。 ni xu yao fu lan zheng que lei xing de wu pin ； gei wo kan yi ge wu pin ， wo hui gao su ni ta shi fou chao ji ke dui fei 。]

english: There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
translation: 有一块专门种植颠茄的土地——我相信它就在德雷诺庄园附近的某个地方，那里的土地有点“不被祝福”。 [you yi kuai zhuan men zhong zhi dian jia de tu di —— wo xiang xin ta jiu zai de lei nuo zhuang yuan fu jin de mou ge di fang ， na li de tu di you dian “ bu bei zhu fu ”。]

english: Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.

english: If you want to grow fruit trees you could try a few places: Catherby, Brimhaven, Gnome Stronghold and the Farming Guild all have fruit tree patches.
translation: 如果你想种植果树，你可以尝试几个地方：Catherby、Brimhaven、Gnome Stronghold 和 Farming Guild 都有果树。 [ru guo ni xiang zhong zhi guo shu ， ni ke yi chang shi ji ge di fang ：Catherby、Brimhaven、Gnome Stronghold  he  Farming Guild  dou you guo shu 。]

english: Hops are good for brewing ales. I believe there's a brewery up in Keldagrim somewhere, and I've heard rumours that a place called Phasmatys used to be good for that type of thing. 'Fore they all died, of course.
translation: 啤酒花适合酿造啤酒。我相信凯尔达格里姆的某个地方有一家啤酒厂，而且我听说过一个叫做 Phasmatys 的地方曾经适合做这种事情。 “当然，他们都死了。 [pi jiu hua shi he niang zao pi jiu 。 wo xiang xin kai er da ge li mu de mou ge di fang you yi jia pi jiu chang ， er qie wo ting shuo guo yi ge jiao zuo  Phasmatys  de di fang ceng jing shi he zuo zhe zhong shi qing 。 “ dang ran ， ta men dou si le 。]

english: Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.

english: Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
translation: 耙完一块杂草后，不要只是扔掉杂草 - 将它们放入堆肥箱中并制作一些堆肥。 [ba wan yi kuai za cao hou ， bu yao zhi shi reng diao za cao  -  jiang ta men fang ru dui fei xiang zhong bing zhi zuo yi xie dui fei 。]

translation: 还有其他五个与此类似的农业区域 - 法拉多附近的埃尔斯坦区域、凯瑟比附近的丹塔拉区域、莫里塔尼亚的莱拉区域、霍西迪乌斯的马里西区域和农业公会的艾伦区域。 [hai you qi ta wu ge yu ci lei si de nong ye qu yu  -  fa la duo fu jin de ai er si tan qu yu 、 kai se bi fu jin de dan ta la qu yu 、 mo li ta ni ya de lai la qu yu 、 huo xi di wu si de ma li xi qu yu he nong ye gong hui de ai lun qu yu 。]
