translation: 门口传来爆炸声。淡出。 [men kou chuan lai bao zha sheng 。 dan chu 。]

english: Fade in to a broken door blocked with debris
translation: 淡入一扇被碎片堵住的破门 [dan ru yi shan bei sui pian du zhu de po men]

english: Bloomin' 'eck, Burntof!
translation: 布鲁明'埃克，伯恩托夫！ [bu lu ming ' ai ke ， bo en tuo fu ！]

english: That was a tad too explosive I think.
translation: 我认为这有点太爆炸了。 [wo ren wei zhe you dian tai bao zha le 。]

english: My ears are still ringing!
translation: 我的耳朵还在响！ [wo de er duo hai zai xiang ！]

english: Quit yer moanin', it did the job didnae it?
translation: 别再抱怨了，它完成了任务吗？ [bie zai bao yuan le ， ta wan cheng le ren wu ma ？]

english: He's right, the rock's been broken up. Checkal, it's your turn.
translation: 他是对的，岩石已经破碎了。检查一下，轮到你了。 [ta shi dui de ， yan shi yi jing po sui le 。 jian cha yi xia ， lun dao ni le 。]

english: Of course ma'am, I will get to work.
translation: 当然，女士，我要去工作了。 [dang ran ， nv shi ， wo yao qu gong zuo le 。]

english: Checkal picks up and removes all of the debris. Fade out.
translation: 检查捡起并清除所有碎片。淡出。 [jian cha jian qi bing qing chu suo you sui pian 。 dan chu 。]

english: Checkal sets to work clearing out the rubble...
translation: 检查开始清理瓦砾...... [jian cha kai shi qing li wa li ......]

english: Fade in.
translation: 淡入。 [dan ru 。]

english: The work is done, Willow. My apologies if it took too long.
translation: 工作完成了，威洛。如果花了太长时间，我深表歉意。 [gong zuo wan cheng le ， wei luo 。 ru guo hua le tai zhang shi jian ， wo shen biao qian yi 。]

english: Don't be sorry, Checkal. Gotta put those muscles to use somehow.
translation: 别抱歉，切卡尔。必须以某种方式使用这些肌肉。 [bie bao qian ， qie ka er 。 bi xu yi mou zhong fang shi shi yong zhe xie ji rou 。]

english: Alright Marley, in you go. Let us know if you find anything.
translation: 好吧，马利，你走了。如果您有任何发现，请告诉我们。 [hao ba ， ma li ， ni zou le 。 ru guo nin you ren he fa xian ， qing gao su wo men 。]

english: Right, in I go. Wish me luck [player name].
translation: 对了，我进去了。祝我好运[玩家姓名]。 [dui le ， wo jin qu le 。 zhu wo hao yun [ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Try not to die...
translation: 尽量不要死... [jin liang bu yao si ...]

english: Fade out, then in to the inside of the dungeon to Marley disarming traps.
translation: 淡出，然后进入地牢内部，让马利解除陷阱。 [dan chu ， ran hou jin ru di lao nei bu ， rang ma li jie chu xian jing 。]

english: Right, let's see what hidden surprises you have in store for me.
translation: 好吧，看看你还给我准备了哪些隐藏的惊喜。 [hao ba ， kan kan ni huan gei wo zhun bei le na xie yin cang de jing xi 。]

english: Hmm...
That would have been nasty.
translation: 那会很糟糕。 [na hui hen zao gao 。]

english: Is that it? I thought this place would be better protected.
translation: 是这样吗？我认为这个地方会得到更好的保护。 [shi zhe yang ma ？ wo ren wei zhe ge di fang hui de dao geng hao de bao hu 。]

english: Now to disarm it...
translation: 现在要解除它的武装... [xian zai yao jie chu ta de wu zhuang ...]

english: Maybe this will work?
translation: 也许这会起作用？ [ye xu zhe hui qi zuo yong ？]

english: That got it!
translation: 明白了！ [ming bai le ！]

english: Alright guys! It's safe to come in! I think...
translation: 好吧伙计们！进来就安全了！我认为... [hao ba huo ji men ！ jin lai jiu an quan le ！ wo ren wei ...]

english: Fade out, then in to everyone inside of the dungeon.
translation: 淡出，然后进入地牢内的每个人。 [dan chu ， ran hou jin ru di lao nei de mei ge ren 。]

english: Wow, this place is amazing. I can't believe this was hidden away.
translation: 哇，这个地方太棒了。我不敢相信这被隐藏起来了。 [wa ， zhe ge di fang tai bang le 。 wo bu gan xiang xin zhe bei yin cang qi lai le 。]

english: I wonder how long it's been left untouched for.
translation: 我想知道它已经有多久没有动过了。 [wo xiang zhi dao ta yi jing you duo jiu mei you dong guo le 。]

english: You're impressed? There's nothing here but dust and fallen rocks.
translation: 你印象深刻吗？这里除了灰尘和落石之外什么都没有。 [ni yin xiang shen ke ma ？ zhe li chu le hui chen he luo shi zhi wai shen me dou mei you 。]

english: Yaaa*hic*aawn
translation: 呀*hic*aawn [ya *hic*aawn]

english: You don't find it exciting? As an archaeologist, I thought you would be thrilled at this discovery?
translation: 你不觉得令人兴奋吗？作为一名考古学家，我想你会对这个发现感到兴奋吧？ [ni bu jue de ling ren xing fen ma ？ zuo wei yi ming kao gu xue jia ， wo xiang ni hui dui zhe ge fa xian gan dao xing fen ba ？]

english: Thrilled? What's there to be excited about? I don't see any gold, diamonds, rare gems or piles of lost treasure!
translation: 激动吗？有什么值得兴奋的呢？我没有看到任何黄金、钻石、稀有宝石或成堆的丢失宝藏！ [ji dong ma ？ you shen me zhi de xing fen de ne ？ wo mei you kan dao ren he huang jin 、 zuan shi 、 xi you bao shi huo cheng dui de diu shi bao zang ！]

english: It's not about the money though, right? We've potentially discovered the long lost ruins of an ancient civilisation!
translation: 但这不是钱的问题，对吧？我们有可能发现失落已久的古代文明遗址！ [dan zhe bu shi qian de wen ti ， dui ba ？ wo men you ke neng fa xian shi luo yi jiu de gu dai wen ming yi zhi ！]

english: Of course it's about the money. It's always been about money, you fool.
translation: 当然是钱的问题。一切都是为了钱，你这个傻瓜。 [dang ran shi qian de wen ti 。 yi qie dou shi wei le qian ， ni zhe ge sha gua 。]

english: I don't understand...
translation: 我不明白... [wo bu ming bai ...]

english: Burntof walks over to the undisturbed golem.
translation: 伯恩托夫走向未受干扰的傀儡。 [bo en tuo fu zou xiang wei shou gan rao de kui lei 。]

english: Theshe markings look familiar...
translation: 这些标记看起来很熟悉…… [zhe xie biao ji kan qi lai hen shu xi ……]

english: We're not a team of archaeologist, you idiot. We're grave robbers looking for their next score.
translation: 我们不是考古学家团队，你这个白痴。我们是盗墓贼，正在寻找下一个分数。 [wo men bu shi kao gu xue jia tuan dui ， ni zhe ge bai chi 。 wo men shi dao mu zei ， zheng zai xun zhao xia yi ge fen shu 。]

english: So this entire time, you've just been using me to help break into these ruins in hopes of finding someone else's treasures.
translation: 所以一直以来，你只是利用我来帮助闯入这些废墟，希望找到别人的宝藏。 [suo yi yi zhi yi lai ， ni zhi shi li yong wo lai bang zhu chuang ru zhe xie fei xu ， xi wang zhao dao bie ren de bao zang 。]

english: Yep, and you were surprisingly easy to convince. I'll admit, you have been a tremendous help, [player name].
translation: 是的，而且你出奇地容易被说服。我承认，你给了我很大的帮助，[玩家名字]。 [shi de ， er qie ni chu qi di rong yi bei shuo fu 。 wo cheng ren ， ni gei le wo hen da de bang zhu ，[ wan jia ming zi ]。]

english: But your usefulness has come to an end I'm afraid. I can't simply let you leave here.
translation: 但恐怕你的用处已经到头了。我不能就这样让你离开这里。 [dan kong pa ni de yong chu yi jing dao tou le 。 wo bu neng jiu zhe yang rang ni li kai zhe li 。]

english: Why not?
translation: 为什么不呢？ [wei shen me bu ne ？]

english: Burntof walks away from the undisturbed golem to a different wall.
translation: 伯恩托夫离开未受干扰的傀儡，走到另一堵墙上。 [bo en tuo fu li kai wei shou gan rao de kui lei ， zou dao ling yi du qiang shang 。]

english: I've sheen thish before...
translation: 我以前见过这个... [wo yi qian jian guo zhe ge ...]

english: I can't risk you running to the authorities and telling them about our little gang. We're wanted in quite a few large cities across Gielinor.
translation: 我不能冒险让你跑到当局那里告诉他们我们这个小团伙的事。吉林诺不少大城市都在通缉我们。 [wo bu neng mao xian rang ni pao dao dang ju na li gao su ta men wo men zhe ge xiao tuan huo de shi 。 ji lin nuo bu shao da cheng shi dou zai tong ji wo men 。]

english: I'm afraid this is the end of the road for you, [player name]. This ruin is about to become your tomb.
translation: 恐怕这就是你这条路的尽头了，[玩家名字]。这个废墟即将成为你的坟墓。 [kong pa zhe jiu shi ni zhe tiao lu de jin tou le ，[ wan jia ming zi ]。 zhe ge fei xu ji jiang cheng wei ni de fen mu 。]

english: Burntof walks into the centre yellow-marked stone trap.
translation: 伯恩托夫走进中央黄色标记的石头陷阱。 [bo en tuo fu zou jin zhong yang huang se biao ji de shi tou xian jing 。]

english: *hic* Woops...
translation: *呃*哎哟... [* e * ai yo ...]

english: What was that noise?
translation: 那是什么声音？ [na shi shen me sheng yin ？]

english: Uh... it wasn't me!
translation: 呃……不是我！ [e …… bu shi wo ！]

english: The dungeon begins to quake, with rocks falling from the ceiling.
translation: 地牢开始震动，岩石从天花板上落下。 [di lao kai shi zhen dong ， yan shi cong tian hua ban shang la xia 。]

english: Whats happening?!
translation: 发生什么事了？！ [fa sheng shen me shi le ？！]

english: It feels like the quaking has finally stopped...
translation: 感觉震动终于停止了…… [gan jue zhen dong zhong yu ting zhi le ……]

english: The golem stands up.
translation: 傀儡站了起来。 [kui lei zhan le qi lai 。]

english: Holy Zamorak! What is that thing?! Checkal, take it down!
translation: 圣萨莫拉克！那是什么东西？！检查一下，把它拿下来！ [sheng sa mo la ke ！ na shi shen me dong xi ？！ jian cha yi xia ， ba ta na xia lai ！]

english: I'm a muscle man, not a fighter.
translation: 我是肌肉男，不是战士。 [wo shi ji rou nan ， bu shi zhan shi 。]

english: I think we should get out of here, Willow!
translation: 我想我们应该离开这里，威洛！ [wo xiang wo men ying gai li kai zhe li ， wei luo ！]

english: You're right, Marley. Burntof, we're leaving!
translation: 你是对的，马利。伯恩托夫，我们要走了！ [ni shi dui de ， ma li 。 bo en tuo fu ， wo men yao zou le ！]

english: Fade out.
translation: 淡出。 [dan chu 。]

english: I can't believe they ran so quickly. I suppose I should take care of this thing.
translation: 我不敢相信他们跑得这么快。我想我应该处理这件事。 [wo bu gan xiang xin ta men pao de zhe me kuai 。 wo xiang wo ying gai chu li zhe jian shi 。]

english: I need a little bit more time to prepare.
translation: 我需要多一点时间来准备。 [wo xu yao duo yi dian shi jian lai zhun bei 。]

english: Hurry up then! We've waited long enough.
translation: 那就快点吧！我们已经等得够久了。 [na jiu kuai dian ba ！ wo men yi jing deng de gou jiu le 。]

english: Wow, the desert really suits you Marley.
translation: 哇，沙漠真适合你，马利。 [wa ， sha mo zhen shi he ni ， ma li 。]

english: [player name] my old pal! How are you doing?
translation: [玩家名称]我的老朋友！你好吗？ [[ wan jia ming cheng ] wo de lao peng you ！ ni hao ma ？]

english: Better now I don't have to deal with you. Enjoying life in the desert?
translation: 现在好多了，我不用再和你打交道了。享受沙漠生活吗？ [xian zai hao duo le ， wo bu yong zai he ni da jiao dao le 。 xiang shou sha mo sheng huo ma ？]

english: Not really. I'm not suited to such harsh climates. No steak sandwiches here either...
translation: 并不真地。我不适应这么恶劣的气候。这里也没有牛排三明治... [bing bu zhen di 。 wo bu shi ying zhe me e lie de qi hou 。 zhe li ye mei you niu pai san ming zhi ...]

english: Oh what a shame! Poor Marley's going to starve as he doesn't have anyone to make his sandwiches... So sad.
translation: 哦，真可惜！可怜的马利快要饿死了，因为没有人给他做三明治……太悲伤了。 [o ， zhen ke xi ！ ke lian de ma li kuai yao e si le ， yin wei mei you ren gei ta zuo san ming zhi …… tai bei shang le 。]

english: Tsssss...
translation: 嘶嘶…… [si si ……]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Aye? Who's that, what do you want?
translation: 是吗？那人是谁，你想要什么？ [shi ma ？ na ren shi shui ， ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Marten.
translation: 貂。 [diao 。]

english: Oh, straight to the point.
translation: 哦，直接进入正题吧。 [o ， zhi jie jin ru zheng ti ba 。]

english: I got betta' things to do than waste my time talkin' to you.
translation: 我还有事要做，而不是浪费时间和你说话。 [wo hai you shi yao zuo ， er bu shi lang fei shi jian he ni shuo hua 。]

english: You're rather rude aren't you?
translation: 你太粗鲁了不是吗？ [ni tai cu lu le bu shi ma ？]

english: Fine, wanna know more 'bout canoes?
translation: 好吧，想了解更多关于独木舟的信息吗？ [hao ba ， xiang liao jie geng duo guan yu du mu zhou de xin xi ma ？]

english: No thanks, not from you at least.
translation: 不，谢谢，至少不是你的。 [bu ， xie xie ， zhi shao bu shi ni de 。]

english: Then get out of here and stop botherin' me.
translation: 那你就离开这里，别再烦我了。 [na ni jiu li kai zhe li ， bie zai fan wo le 。]

english: Could you teach me about canoes?
translation: 你能教我独木舟吗？ [ni neng jiao wo du mu zhou ma ？]

english: Hahaha! Sorry mate, you'll not be able to make any canoes outta that tree there. You'll need to get a bit more skilled at the craft of Woodcuttin'.
translation: 哈哈哈！抱歉，伙计，你无法从那棵树上造出任何独木舟。您需要更加熟练地掌握伐木工艺。 [ha ha ha ！ bao qian ， huo ji ， ni wu fa cong na ke shu shang zao chu ren he du mu zhou 。 nin xu yao geng jia shu lian di zhang wo fa mu gong yi 。]

english: But once you get a bit betta', you'll be able to make a canoe and ride the river.
translation: 但一旦你掌握了一些技巧，你就可以制作独木舟并在河上航行。 [dan yi dan ni zhang wo le yi xie ji qiao ， ni jiu ke yi zhi zuo du mu zhou bing zai he shang hang xing 。]

english: It's not 'ard mate, you just gotta chop that tree o'er there down.
translation: 这不是老伙计，你只需要把那里的那棵树砍倒就可以了。 [zhe bu shi lao huo ji ， ni zhi xu yao ba na li de na ke shu kan dao jiu ke yi le 。]

english: Then cut it down into a canoe. So simple a gobbo could do it.
translation: 然后把它砍成独木舟。这么简单，一个 gobbo 就能做到。 [ran hou ba ta kan cheng du mu zhou 。 zhe me jian dan ， yi ge  gobbo  jiu neng zuo dao 。]

english: But you got no chance of turning it into a beautiful canoe.
translation: 但你没有机会把它变成一艘漂亮的独木舟。 [dan ni mei you ji hui ba ta bian cheng yi sou piao liang de du mu zhou 。]

english: Why's that?
translation: 这是为什么呢？ [zhe shi wei shen me ne ？]

english: I can tell by lookin' at ya! You ain't a woodcutter, most you'd be able to do is sail to the next stop on a log.
translation: 我看你就知道了！你不是伐木工，你能做的最多就是在一根圆木上航行到下一站。 [wo kan ni jiu zhi dao le ！ ni bu shi fa mu gong ， ni neng zuo de zui duo jiu shi zai yi gen yuan mu shang hang xing dao xia yi zhan 。]

english: Hmm, s'pose you could make a decent canoe with your skills. you'll be able to make a dugout, I reckons.
translation: 嗯，假设你可以用你的技能制作一艘像样的独木舟。我想你可以建造一个防空洞。 [n ， jia she ni ke yi yong ni de ji neng zhi zuo yi sou xiang yang de du mu zhou 。 wo xiang ni ke yi jian zao yi ge fang kong dong 。]

english: How far will I be able to go in a dugout canoe?
translation: 我能乘坐独木舟走多远？ [wo neng cheng zuo du mu zhou zou duo yuan ？]

english: Err, probably about two stops before it sinks on ya.
translation: 呃，大概两站之后它就会沉到你身上。 [e ， da gai liang zhan zhi hou ta jiu hui chen dao ni shen shang 。]

english: Could that take me back to Lumbridge?
translation: 那可以带我回到朗布里奇吗？ [na ke yi dai wo hui dao lang bu li qi ma ？]

english: Pah, I don't think so. You'll be lucky to make it past Varrock.
translation: 呸，我不这么认为。你能通过瓦罗克就很幸运了。 [pei ， wo bu zhe me ren wei 。 ni neng tong guo wa luo ke jiu hen xing yun le 。]

english: Well bless me axe, you're almost as good a woodchopper as meself! You'll have no issue craftin' the best of the best, the waka canoe.
translation: 好吧，斧头，你几乎和我一样优秀的伐木工！你可以毫无问题地打造出最好的瓦卡独木舟。 [hao ba ， fu tou ， ni ji hu he wo yi yang you xiu de fa mu gong ！ ni ke yi hao wu wen ti di da zao chu zui hao de wa ka du mu zhou 。]

english: One of those beauties can take you up further in the Wilderness. Beautiful place that.
translation: 其中一位美女可以带你在荒野中走得更远。那个美丽的地方。 [qi zhong yi wei mei nv ke yi dai ni zai huang ye zhong zou de geng yuan 。 na ge mei li de di fang 。]

english: Great, thank you.
translation: 太好了，谢谢。 [tai hao le ， xie xie 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Can you teach me about canoes?
translation: 你能教我独木舟吗？ [ni neng jiao wo du mu zhou ma ？]

english: Hi, I hear a woman called Elena is staying here.
translation: 嗨，我听说一位名叫埃琳娜的女士住在这里。 [hai ， wo ting shuo yi wei ming jiao ai lin na de nv shi zhu zai zhe li 。]

english: Yes she was staying here, but slightly over a week ago she was getting ready to go back. However she never managed to leave.
translation: 是的，她住在这里，但一周多前她正准备回去。然而她始终没能离开。 [shi de ， ta zhu zai zhe li ， dan yi zhou duo qian ta zheng zhun bei hui qu 。 ran er ta shi zhong mei neng li kai 。]

english: My daughter Milli was playing near the west wall when she saw some shadowy figures jump out and grab her. Milli is upstairs if you wish to speak to her.
translation: 我女儿米莉正在西墙附近玩耍，突然看到一些黑影跳出来抓住了她。如果你想和米莉说话，她就在楼上。 [wo nv er mi li zheng zai xi qiang fu jin wan shua ， tu ran kan dao yi xie hei ying tiao chu lai zhua zhu le ta 。 ru guo ni xiang he mi li shuo hua ， ta jiu zai lou shang 。]

english: Any luck finding Elena yet?
translation: 找到埃琳娜还有运气吗？ [zhao dao ai lin na hai you yun qi ma ？]

english: Not yet...
translation: 还没有... [hai mei you ...]

english: I wish you luck, she did a lot for us.
translation: 祝你好运，她为我们做了很多。 [zhu ni hao yun ， ta wei wo men zuo le hen duo 。]

english: Yes, she is safe at home now.
translation: 是的，她现在安全在家。 [shi de ， ta xian zai an quan zai jia 。]

english: That's good to hear, she helped us a lot.
translation: 很高兴听到这个消息，她帮助了我们很多。 [hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi ， ta bang zhu le wo men hen duo 。]

english: Good day friend.
translation: 美好的一天朋友。 [mei hao de yi tian peng you 。]

english: What's all this about?
translation: 这到底是怎么回事？ [zhe dao di shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: Ah, hello and welcome. I'm Martin Holt, leader of Kourend's Royal Society. This is our little protest against the Kourend Council.
translation: 啊，你好，欢迎。我是马丁·霍尔特，库伦德皇家学会的领导人。这是我们对库伦德议会的一点抗议。 [a ， ni hao ， huan ying 。 wo shi ma ding · huo er te ， ku lun de huang jia xue hui de ling dao ren 。 zhe shi wo men dui ku lun de yi hui de yi dian kang yi 。]

english: Pleased to meet you. I'm [player name]. So, what's wrong with the Council?
translation: 很高兴认识你。我是[玩家姓名]。那么，安理会到底出了什么问题呢？ [hen gao xing ren shi ni 。 wo shi [ wan jia xing ming ]。 na me ， an li hui dao di chu le shen me wen ti ne ？]

english: Now there's a question! I have a better one. What's right with the Council?
translation: 现在有一个问题！我有一个更好的。理事会怎么了？ [xian zai you yi ge wen ti ！ wo you yi ge geng hao de 。 li shi hui zen me le ？]

english: I bet you didn't know that the Council was originally only temporary. After the last King died, they were only supposed to rule until his daughter came of age.
translation: 我打赌你不知道这个委员会本来只是临时的。最后一位国王去世后，他们只能统治到他的女儿成年为止。 [wo da du ni bu zhi dao zhe ge wei yuan hui ben lai zhi shi lin shi de 。 zui hou yi wei guo wang qu shi hou ， ta men zhi neng tong zhi dao ta de nv er cheng nian wei zhi 。]

english: However, according to the Council, the King's daughter went mad. Such a wonderful convenience for them of course. With her out of the picture, the Council became permanent.
translation: 然而，根据议会的说法，国王的女儿疯了。当然，这对他们来说真是太方便了。随着她的退出，理事会成为永久性的。 [ran er ， gen ju yi hui de shuo fa ， guo wang de nv er feng le 。 dang ran ， zhe dui ta men lai shuo zhen shi tai fang bian le 。 sui zhe ta de tui chu ， li shi hui cheng wei yong jiu xing de 。]

english: Interesting. What else don't you like about the Council?
translation: 有趣的。您对理事会还有什么不满意的地方？ [you qu de 。 nin dui li shi hui hai you shen me bu man yi de di fang ？]

english: Democracy! That's meant to be the big thing for the Council. Funny thing is, although they're meant to be elected by the people, the same four people have won every single election. Little odd, no?
translation: 民主！这对安理会来说是一件大事。有趣的是，尽管他们本应由人民选举产生，但每次选举都是同样的四个人获胜。有点奇怪，不是吗？ [min zhu ！ zhe dui an li hui lai shuo shi yi jian da shi 。 you qu de shi ， jin guan ta men ben ying you ren min xuan ju chan sheng ， dan mei ci xuan ju dou shi tong yang de si ge ren huo sheng 。 you dian qi guai ， bu shi ma ？]

english: That is a bit suspicious, I suppose.
translation: 我想这有点可疑。 [wo xiang zhe you dian ke yi 。]

english: Indeed it is. So, do you want to join our protest?
translation: 确实如此。那么，你想加入我们的抗议吗？ [que shi ru ci 。 na me ， ni xiang jia ru wo men de kang yi ma ？]

english: Not right now. But thanks for the information.
translation: 现在不行。但谢谢你的信息。 [xian zai bu xing 。 dan xie xie ni de xin xi 。]

english: You do not meet all of the requirements to start the A Kingdom Divided quest.
translation: 您不满足开始“王国分裂”任务的所有要求。 [nin bu man zu kai shi “ wang guo fen lie ” ren wu de suo you yao qiu 。]

english: Good to see you friend.
translation: 很高兴见到你朋友。 [hen gao xing jian dao ni peng you 。]

english: Hello Martin. Now here's somewhere I wouldn't have expected to find you.
translation: 你好马丁。现在我没想到会在某个地方找到你。 [ni hao ma ding 。 xian zai wo mei xiang dao hui zai mou ge di fang zhao dao ni 。]

english: Indeed. I never thought I'd be back here.
translation: 的确。我从没想过我会回到这里。 [di que 。 wo cong mei xiang guo wo hui hui dao zhe li 。]

english: So why are you here?
translation: 那么你为什么在这里？ [na me ni wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: We won! The Council are out, and we have what Kourend really needed. We have a king!
translation: 我们赢了！委员会已经退出，我们得到了库伦德真正需要的东西。我们有一个国王！ [wo men ying le ！ wei yuan hui yi jing tui chu ， wo men de dao le ku lun de zhen zheng xu yao de dong xi 。 wo men you yi ge guo wang ！]

english: Of course, King Artur ended up taking the throne from his father a little faster than anyone expected, so he needs plenty of guidance. That's where I come in!
translation: 当然，阿图尔国王最终从他父亲手中夺取王位的速度比任何人预期的都要快，所以他需要大量的指导。这就是我进来的地方！ [dang ran ， a tu er guo wang zui zhong cong ta fu qin shou zhong duo qu wang wei de su du bi ren he ren yu qi de dou yao kuai ， suo yi ta xu yao da liang de zhi dao 。 zhe jiu shi wo jin lai de di fang ！]

english: So you're helping to advise the King?
translation: 所以你是在帮国王出谋划策？ [suo yi ni shi zai bang guo wang chu mou hua ce ？]

english: Exactly! When the people voted on Rose's Accord, they voted for the Hosidius family to become the new royal family. From a technical standpoint that means they voted for King Artur.
translation: 确切地！当人民投票通过罗斯协议时，他们投票支持霍西迪乌斯家族成为新王室。从技术角度来看，这意味着他们投票给了阿图尔国王。 [que qie di ！ dang ren min tou piao tong guo luo si xie yi shi ， ta men tou piao zhi chi huo xi di wu si jia zu cheng wei xin wang shi 。 cong ji shu jiao du lai kan ， zhe yi wei zhe ta men tou piao gei le a tu er guo wang 。]

english: But in reality it was his father they expected to rule.
translation: 但实际上，他们期望的是他的父亲来统治。 [dan shi ji shang ， ta men qi wang de shi ta de fu qin lai tong zhi 。]

english: Precisely. My job is to advise King Artur and ensure his actions have a positive impact on the people that he now rules.
translation: 恰恰。我的工作是为阿图尔国王提供建议，并确保他的行为对他现在统治的人民产生积极影响。 [qia qia 。 wo de gong zuo shi wei a tu er guo wang ti gong jian yi ， bing que bao ta de xing wei dui ta xian zai tong zhi de ren min chan sheng ji ji ying xiang 。]

english: And how's that going?
translation: 进展如何？ [jin zhan ru he ？]

english: Not too bad. While he lacks experience, the King has a good heart. He wants to do the right thing, and he has the support needed to do it.
translation: 还不错。虽然国王缺乏经验，但他有一颗善良的心。他想做正确的事，并且他拥有做到这一点所需的支持。 [hai bu cuo 。 sui ran guo wang que fa jing yan ， dan ta you yi ke shan liang de xin 。 ta xiang zuo zheng que de shi ， bing qie ta yong you zuo dao zhe yi dian suo xu de zhi chi 。]

english: Mind you, he could do with listening to his mother less. She's always whispering things in his ear. She forgets that he's the one in charge, not her.
translation: 请注意，他可以少听他母亲的话。她总是在他耳边低语。她忘记了负责的人是他，而不是她。 [qing zhu yi ， ta ke yi shao ting ta mu qin de hua 。 ta zong shi zai ta er bian di yu 。 ta wang ji le fu ze de ren shi ta ， er bu shi ta 。]

english: Still, I'm sure he just needs time to adjust. I have no doubt that under King Artur, Kourend will prosper like never before.
translation: 不过，我确信他只是需要时间来调整。我毫不怀疑，在阿图尔国王的领导下，库伦德将获得前所未有的繁荣。 [bu guo ， wo que xin ta zhi shi xu yao shi jian lai tiao zheng 。 wo hao bu huai yi ， zai a tu er guo wang de ling dao xia ， ku lun de jiang huo de qian suo wei you de fan rong 。]

english: I'm sure you're right. See you around Martin.
translation: 我确信你是对的。马丁身边见。 [wo que xin ni shi dui de 。 ma ding shen bian jian 。]

english: Until next time.
translation: 直到下次。 [zhi dao xia ci 。]

english: Only a king can right the wrongs of the Council! And only you can make that happen!
translation: 只有国王才能纠正议会的错误！只有你才能实现这一目标！ [zhi you guo wang cai neng jiu zheng yi hui de cuo wu ！ zhi you ni cai neng shi xian zhe yi mu biao ！]

english: How long will you keep your eyes closed? Their corruption surrounds you!
translation: 你还要闭上眼睛多久？他们的腐败就在你身边！ [ni hai yao bi shang yan jing duo jiu ？ ta men de fu bai jiu zai ni shen bian ！]

english: This kingdom will never be safe while the Council rule!
translation: 只要议会统治，这个王国就永远不会安全！ [zhi yao yi hui tong zhi ， zhe ge wang guo jiu yong yuan bu hui an quan ！]

english: You deserve the truth! They won't give it to you!
translation: 你值得知道真相！他们不会给你的！ [ni zhi de zhi dao zhen xiang ！ ta men bu hui gei ni de ！]

english: The Council have wronged you! It's time to make things right!
translation: 市议会冤枉你了！是时候把事情改正了！ [shi yi hui yuan wang ni le ！ shi shi hou ba shi qing gai zheng le ！]

english: Together, we can bring an end to the treachery of the Council!
translation: 只要我们齐心协力，就能制止议会的背叛行为！ [zhi yao wo men qi xin xie li ， jiu neng zhi zhi yi hui de bei pan xing wei ！]

english: The Council care only for themselves! It's time for a ruler who cares for you!
translation: 理事会只关心自己！是时候有一个关心你的统治者了！ [li shi hui zhi guan xin zi ji ！ shi shi hou you yi ge guan xin ni de tong zhi zhe le ！]

english: Kourend is a kingdom! A kingdom needs a king, not a council!
translation: 库伦德是一个王国！一个王国需要的是国王，而不是议会！ [ku lun de shi yi ge wang guo ！ yi ge wang guo xu yao de shi guo wang ， er bu shi yi hui ！]

english: Democracy? What democracy? It's all a façade!
translation: 民主？什么民主？这一切都是表面现象！ [min zhu ？ shen me min zhu ？ zhe yi qie dou shi biao mian xian xiang ！]

english: People of Kourend, you have been lied to!
translation: 库伦德的人们，你们被骗了！ [ku lun de de ren men ， ni men bei pian le ！]

english: You know it's sometimes funny how things work out, I lose some gold but find an item, or I lose an item and find some gold... no-one ever knows what's gone where ya know.
translation: 你知道事情的发展有时很有趣，我失去了一些金子但找到了一件物品，或者我失去了一件物品却找到了一些金子……没有人知道你所知道的地方发生了什么。 [ni zhi dao shi qing de fa zhan you shi hen you qu ， wo shi qu le yi xie jin zi dan zhao dao le yi jian wu pin ， huo zhe wo shi qu le yi jian wu pin que zhao dao le yi xie jin zi …… mei you ren zhi dao ni suo zhi dao de di fang fa sheng le shen me 。]

english: Sorry, mate. Train up your Thieving skill to at least 50 and I might be able to help you out.
translation: 对不起，伙计。将你的盗贼技能训练到至少 50，我也许可以帮助你。 [dui bu qi ， huo ji 。 jiang ni de dao zei ji neng xun lian dao zhi shao  50， wo ye xu ke yi bang zhu ni 。]

english: Sorry, mate. Train up your Agility skill to at least 50 and I might be able to help you out.
translation: 对不起，伙计。将你的敏捷技能训练到至少 50，我也许可以帮助你。 [dui bu qi ， huo ji 。 jiang ni de min jie ji neng xun lian dao zhi shao  50， wo ye xu ke yi bang zhu ni 。]

english: Can you tell me about your cape?
translation: 你能告诉我你的斗篷吗？ [ni neng gao su wo ni de dou peng ma ？]

english: Certainly! Skillcapes are a symbol of achievement. Only people who have mastered a skill and reached level 99 can get their hands on them and gain the benefits they carry.
translation: 当然！技能斗篷是成就的象征。只有掌握了一项技能并达到99级的人才能获得它们并获得它们所带来的好处。 [dang ran ！ ji neng dou peng shi cheng jiu de xiang zheng 。 zhi you zhang wo le yi xiang ji neng bing da dao 99 ji de ren cai neng huo de ta men bing huo de ta men suo dai lai de hao chu 。]

english: The Cape of Thieving provides a nice boost to your chances of pickpocketing when worn. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 佩戴盗贼斗篷可以大大增加你的扒窃机会。还有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [pei dai dao zei dou peng ke yi da da zeng jia ni de pa qie ji hui 。 hai you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Okay... I'll be going now.
translation: 好吧……我现在就走。 [hao ba …… wo xian zai jiu zou 。]

english: Ah! Here you go!
translation: 啊!干得好！ [a ! gan de hao ！]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: I need you to answer this for me.
translation: 我需要你帮我回答这个问题。 [wo xu yao ni bang wo hui da zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。 [qing shu ru wen ti de da an 。]

english: How can that be? Go check again!
translation: 怎么可能呢？再去检查一下吧！ [zen me ke neng ne ？ zai qu jian cha yi xia ba ！]

english: Spot on!
translation: 现货！ [xian huo ！]

english: Yeah I know what you mean, found anything recently?
translation: 是的，我知道你的意思，最近发现了什么吗？ [shi de ， wo zhi dao ni de yi si ， zui jin fa xian le shen me ma ？]

english: Can you tell me about your cape?
translation: 你能告诉我你的斗篷吗？ [ni neng gao su wo ni de dou peng ma ？]

english: Have you found anything recently?
translation: 你最近有发现什么吗？ [ni zui jin you fa xian shen me ma ？]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Okay... I'll be going now.
translation: 好吧……我现在就走。 [hao ba …… wo xian zai jiu zou 。]

english: What is that cape you're wearing?
translation: 你穿的那件斗篷是什么？ [ni chuan de na jian dou peng shi shen me ？]

english: This is a Skillcape of Farming, isn't it incredible? It's a symbol of my ability as the finest farmer in the land and wearing it increases my herb yield!
translation: 这就是农耕技能，是不是很不可思议？它是我作为这片土地上最优秀农民的能力的象征，佩戴它可以增加我的草药产量！ [zhe jiu shi nong geng ji neng ， shi bu shi hen bu ke si yi ？ ta shi wo zuo wei zhe pian tu di shang zui you xiu nong min de neng li de xiang zheng ， pei dai ta ke yi zeng jia wo de cao yao chan liang ！]

english: Can I buy a Skillcape of Farming from you?
translation: 我可以向你们购买农业技能吗？ [wo ke yi xiang ni men gou mai nong ye ji neng ma ？]

english: Of course, fellow farmer. If you wear this cape you'll receive increased yields from your herbs. That'll be 99000 coins.
translation: 当然，农民朋友。如果你穿上这件斗篷，你的草药产量将会增加。那将是 99000 个硬币。 [dang ran ， nong min peng you 。 ru guo ni chuan shang zhe jian dou peng ， ni de cao yao chan liang jiang hui zeng jia 。 na jiang shi  99000  ge ying bi 。]

english: I'm not paying that.
translation: 我不付那个钱。 [wo bu fu na ge qian 。]

english: No skin off my teeth, but if you change your mind, the price will still be the same.
translation: 我的牙齿没有掉皮，但如果你改变主意，价格仍然是一样的。 [wo de ya chi mei you diao pi ， dan ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， jia ge reng ran shi yi yang de 。]

english: Sure, not many people own one.
translation: 当然，拥有它的人并不多。 [dang ran ， yong you ta de ren bing bu duo 。]

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 但不幸的是，我身上没有足够的钱。 [dan bu xing de shi ， wo shen shang mei you zu gou de qian 。]

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 好吧，等你回来了就回来见我吧。 [hao ba ， deng ni hui lai le jiu hui lai jian wo ba 。]

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 不幸的是，所有技能斗篷都只提供免费兜帽，这是技能升级交易的一部分；买一送一，你懂的。因此，在我向您出售一件之前，您需要释放一些库存空间。 [bu xing de shi ， suo you ji neng dou peng dou zhi ti gong mian fei dou mao ， zhe shi ji neng sheng ji jiao yi de yi bu fen ； mai yi song yi ， ni dong de 。 yin ci ， zai wo xiang nin chu shou yi jian zhi qian ， nin xu yao shi fang yi xie ku cun kong jian 。]

english: That's true; us Master Farmers are a unique breed.
translation: 这是真的;我们农民大师是一个独特的品种。 [zhe shi zhen de ; wo men nong min da shi shi yi ge du te de pin zhong 。]

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: 请问我可以再给我的披风戴上兜帽吗？ [qing wen wo ke yi zai gei wo de pi feng dai shang dou mao ma ？]

english: Martin hands you another hood for your skillcape.
translation: 马丁为你的技能斗篷提供了另一顶兜帽。 [ma ding wei ni de ji neng dou peng ti gong le ling yi ding dou mao 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: I can't chat right now, I have too many things to worry about.
translation: 我现在不能聊天，我有太多事情要担心。 [wo xian zai bu neng liao tian ， wo you tai duo shi qing yao dan xin 。]

english: You do not meet the requirements to start the Fairytale I - Growing Pains quest.
translation: 您不符合开始童话 I - 成长的烦恼任务的要求。 [nin bu fu he kai shi tong hua  I -  cheng zhang de fan nao ren wu de yao qiu 。]

english: Anything I can help with?
translation: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang mang de ma ？]

english: I certainly could do with some help.
translation: 我当然需要一些帮助。 [wo dang ran xu yao yi xie bang zhu 。]

english: So tell me about your problems.
translation: 那么请告诉我你的问题。 [na me qing gao su wo ni de wen ti 。]

english: It all seemed to start about a month ago. I grow roses, you know?
translation: 这一切似乎要从一个月前开始。我种玫瑰，你知道吗？ [zhe yi qie si hu yao cong yi ge yue qian kai shi 。 wo zhong mei gui ， ni zhi dao ma ？]

english: Um, you seem to be getting side-tracked already.
translation: 嗯，看来你已经走上歧途了。 [n ， kan lai ni yi jing zou shang qi tu le 。]

english: What? Oh sorry.
translation: 什么？哦，对不起。 [shen me ？ o ， dui bu qi 。]

english: As I was saying about a month ago I noticed that the yield on my prize rose bushes had dropped slightly. I immediately suspected Crown Gall, a disease that can be fatal to a Mister Lincoln.
translation: 正如我大约一个月前所说，我注意到我的珍贵玫瑰丛的产量略有下降。我立刻怀疑是冠瘿病，这种病对于林肯先生来说可能是致命的。 [zheng ru wo da yue yi ge yue qian suo shuo ， wo zhu yi dao wo de zhen gui mei gui cong de chan liang lve you xia jiang 。 wo li ke huai yi shi guan ying bing ， zhe zhong bing dui yu lin ken xian sheng lai shuo ke neng shi zhi ming de 。]

english: You're not making much sense. Who's Mister Lincoln?
translation: 你没有多大意义。林肯先生是谁？ [ni mei you duo da yi yi 。 lin ken xian sheng shi shui ？]

english: Sorry, Mister Lincoln's are the variety of roses that I specialise in. None of the plants showed any other symptoms of the disease though. Then I noticed a reduced yield occurring in most of my other crops too.
translation: 抱歉，林肯先生的玫瑰是我专门种植的玫瑰品种。不过，这些植物都没有表现出任何其他疾病症状。然后我注意到我的大多数其他作物的产量也出现了下降。 [bao qian ， lin ken xian sheng de mei gui shi wo zhuan men zhong zhi de mei gui pin zhong 。 bu guo ， zhe xie zhi wu dou mei you biao xian chu ren he qi ta ji bing zheng zhuang 。 ran hou wo zhu yi dao wo de da duo shu qi ta zuo wu de chan liang ye chu xian le xia jiang 。]

english: I spoke to other gardeners that I know, and they had all noticed similar problems.
translation: 我和我认识的其他园丁交谈过，他们都注意到了类似的问题。 [wo he wo ren shi de qi ta yuan ding jiao tan guo ， ta men dou zhu yi dao le lei si de wen ti 。]

english: Vegetable patches are growing fewer vegetables, bushes are producing fewer berries and everything that is planted seems to be more prone to disease!
translation: 菜地种植的蔬菜越来越少，灌木丛生产的浆果越来越少，种植的所有东西似乎都更容易生病！ [cai di zhong zhi de shu cai yue lai yue shao ， guan mu cong sheng chan de jiang guo yue lai yue shao ， zhong zhi de suo you dong xi si hu dou geng rong yi sheng bing ！]

english: You've done some farming, haven't you noticed a decrease in the amount of produce you are getting lately?
translation: 你干过一些农活，有没有发现最近收获的农产品数量减少了？ [ni gan guo yi xie nong huo ， you mei you fa xian zui jin shou huo de nong chan pin shu liang jian shao le ？]

english: Now that I think about it, you're right!
translation: 现在想来，你说得对！ [xian zai xiang lai ， ni shuo de dui ！]

english: I know I am. Depressing isn't it?
translation: 我知道我是。郁闷不是吗？ [wo zhi dao wo shi 。 yu men bu shi ma ？]

english: No, can't say that I have.
translation: 不，不能说我有。 [bu ， bu neng shuo wo you 。]

english: That's not very observant of you.
translation: 那是你不太细心。 [na shi ni bu tai xi xin 。]

english: So what do you want me to do?
translation: 那你想让我做什么？ [na ni xiang rang wo zuo shen me ？]

english: I'd like you to find out what is causing this terrible problem and to try and rectify whatever the problem is.
translation: 我希望您找出导致这个可怕问题的原因，并尝试纠正问题所在。 [wo xi wang nin zhao chu dao zhi zhe ge ke pa wen ti de yuan yin ， bing chang shi jiu zheng wen ti suo zai 。]

english: Do you have any ideas where I should start?
translation: 您有什么想法我应该从哪里开始吗？ [nin you shen me xiang fa wo ying gai cong na li kai shi ma ？]

english: If I were you I would start by speaking to some of the other gardeners.
translation: 如果我是你，我会首先与其他一些园丁交谈。 [ru guo wo shi ni ， wo hui shou xian yu qi ta yi xie yuan ding jiao tan 。]

english: This doesn't sound like something I can help with. Good luck.
translation: 这听起来不像是我能帮忙的事。祝你好运。 [zhe ting qi lai bu xiang shi wo neng bang mang de shi 。 zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Oh dear. I hope you can sort them out by yourself.
translation: 哦亲爱的。我希望你能自己解决它们。 [o qin ai de 。 wo xi wang ni neng zi ji jie jue ta men 。]

english: I'm not sure if I can, but I guess I have to try.
translation: 我不确定我是否可以，但我想我必须尝试一下。 [wo bu que ding wo shi fou ke yi ， dan wo xiang wo bi xu chang shi yi xia 。]

english: What is the banner for?
translation: 横幅有什么用？ [heng fu you shen me yong ？]

english: That banner is the emblem of the Group of Advanced Gardeners. We're a loosely affiliated group of gardeners that are united in our concern for declining vegetable production.
translation: 那面旗帜是高级园丁小组的徽章。我们是一个松散的园丁团体，他们团结一致，共同关注蔬菜产量下降的问题。 [na mian qi zhi shi gao ji yuan ding xiao zu de hui zhang 。 wo men shi yi ge song san de yuan ding tuan ti ， ta men tuan jie yi zhi ， gong tong guan zhu shu cai chan liang xia jiang de wen ti 。]

english: Err, of course you are.
translation: 呃，你当然是。 [e ， ni dang ran shi 。]

english: Say, you're a brave adventurer, would you be interested in trying to get to the root of our woes? There would be a cash reward if you could help us.
translation: 假设，你是一位勇敢的冒险家，你有兴趣尝试找出我们困境的根源吗？如果您能帮助我们，我们将有现金奖励。 [jia she ， ni shi yi wei yong gan de mao xian jia ， ni you xing qu chang shi zhao chu wo men kun jing de gen yuan ma ？ ru guo nin neng bang zhu wo men ， wo men jiang you xian jin jiang li 。]

english: Of course I'll help.
translation: 我当然会帮忙。 [wo dang ran hui bang mang 。]

english: I'm so glad to hear it.
translation: 我很高兴听到这个消息。 [wo hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi 。]

english: You don't look it.
translation: 你不看看。 [ni bu kan kan 。]

english: Sorry, what was that?
translation: 抱歉，那是什么？ [bao qian ， na shi shen me ？]

english: Oh, nothing. Don't worry about it.
translation: 哦，没什么。别担心。 [o ， mei shen me 。 bie dan xin 。]

english: Sorry, I have better things to do.
translation: 抱歉，我还有更重要的事情要做。 [bao qian ， wo hai you geng zhong yao de shi qing yao zuo 。]

english: Oh. Oh dear. Oh well, if there's nothing I can do to make you change your mind...
translation: 哦。哦亲爱的。哦，好吧，如果我无能为力让你改变主意的话…… [o 。 o qin ai de 。 o ， hao ba ， ru guo wo wu neng wei li rang ni gai bian zhu yi de hua ……]

english: No, nothing. My mind is made up.
translation: 不，没什么。我的心意已决。 [bu ， mei shen me 。 wo de xin yi yi jue 。]

english: Well come back and chat to me if you change it.
translation: 如果你改变了，那就回来和我聊天吧。 [ru guo ni gai bian le ， na jiu hui lai he wo liao tian ba 。]

english: Have you spoken to any other members of the Gardening Group yet?
translation: 您与园艺小组的其他成员交谈过吗？ [nin yu yuan yi xiao zu de qi ta cheng yuan jiao tan guo ma ？]

english: No, I haven't had a chance yet.
translation: 不，我还没有机会。 [bu ， wo hai mei you ji hui 。]

english: Well please hurry, otherwise I won't be able to make enough produce to feed my 13 children soon.
translation: 好吧，请快点，否则我很快就无法生产足够的农产品来养活我的 13 个孩子。 [hao ba ， qing kuai dian ， fou ze wo hen kuai jiu wu fa sheng chan zu gou de nong chan pin lai yang huo wo de  13  ge hai zi 。]

english: I have spoken to one of your members and they reckon that it's the lack of rain that we've had recently.
translation: 我曾与你们的一位成员交谈过，他们认为这是因为我们最近没有下雨。 [wo ceng yu ni men de yi wei cheng yuan jiao tan guo ， ta men ren wei zhe shi yin wei wo men zui jin mei you xia yu 。]

english: I'm afraid that can't be the problem. It never rains on the farming patches, that's why we have to water the crops.
translation: 恐怕这不是问题。农田从来不下雨，这就是为什么我们必须给庄稼浇水。 [kong pa zhe bu shi wen ti 。 nong tian cong lai bu xia yu ， zhe jiu shi wei shen me wo men bi xu gei zhuang jia jiao shui 。]

english: Oh yeah. I hadn't thought of that.
translation: 哦，是的。我没想到这一点。 [o ， shi de 。 wo mei xiang dao zhe yi dian 。]

english: Go chat to some other group members. Maybe somebody has a different idea.
translation: 去和其他一些小组成员聊天。也许有人有不同的想法。 [qu he qi ta yi xie xiao zu cheng yuan liao tian 。 ye xu you ren you bu tong de xiang fa 。]

english: Hello again, [player]. How are you getting on with solving the Gardening Group's problems?
translation: 再次问好，[玩家]。您解决园艺小组的问题进展如何？ [zai ci wen hao ，[ wan jia ]。 nin jie jue yuan yi xiao zu de wen ti jin zhan ru he ？]

english: (Same as above, the player goes through what the gardeners have told them.)
translation: （与上面相同，玩家会仔细阅读园丁告诉他们的内容。） [（ yu shang mian xiang tong ， wan jia hui zi xi yue du yuan ding gao su ta men de nei rong 。）]

english: To be honest I'm worried about the sort of person you let join your organisation.
translation: 老实说，我担心你让什么样的人加入你的组织。 [lao shi shuo ， wo dan xin ni rang shen me yang de ren jia ru ni de zu zhi 。]

english: Why is that?
translation: 这是为什么？ [zhe shi wei shen me ？]

english: I've heard theories ranging from climate change to fairies from your members.
translation: 我从你们的成员那里听到了从气候变化到仙女等各种各样的理论。 [wo cong ni men de cheng yuan na li ting dao le cong qi hou bian hua dao xian nv deng ge zhong ge yang de li lun 。]

english: Hmm, that's an interesting idea. Now that I think about it that does make some sense. Yes, maybe you should talk to a fairy about it.
translation: 嗯，这是一个有趣的想法。现在想来，确实有几分道理。是的，也许你应该和仙女谈谈这件事。 [n ， zhe shi yi ge you qu de xiang fa 。 xian zai xiang lai ， que shi you ji fen dao li 。 shi de ， ye xu ni ying gai he xian nv tan tan zhe jian shi 。]

english: O-kay! You're the boss, any idea which flower I should look under to find a fairy?
translation: 好的！你是老板，你知道我应该在哪朵花下寻找仙女吗？ [hao de ！ ni shi lao ban ， ni zhi dao wo ying gai zai na duo hua xia xun zhao xian nv ma ？]

english: No, sorry, but I did hear that there were some adventurers with a similar problem in the swamps near Lumbridge. Just don't mention my name if you talk to them, they're trying to keep it a secret, but everybody
translation: 不，抱歉，但我确实听说在朗布里奇附近的沼泽里有一些冒险家也有类似的问题。如果你和他们说话，请不要提及我的名字，他们试图保守秘密，但每个人 [bu ， bao qian ， dan wo que shi ting shuo zai lang bu li qi fu jin de zhao ze li you yi xie mao xian jia ye you lei si de wen ti 。 ru guo ni he ta men shuo hua ， qing bu yao ti ji wo de ming zi ， ta men shi tu bao shou mi mi ， dan mei ge ren]

english: actually knows what they're up to.
translation: 实际上知道他们在做什么。 [shi ji shang zhi dao ta men zai zuo shen me 。]

english: Yes, I've spoken to them before.
translation: 是的，我以前和他们谈过。 [shi de ， wo yi qian he ta men tan guo 。]

english: Hello again, [player]. Our crops are still failing. Please do something fast or we will all go out of business.
translation: 再次问好，[玩家]。我们的庄稼仍然歉收。请快点做点什么，否则我们都会破产。 [zai ci wen hao ，[ wan jia ]。 wo men de zhuang jia reng ran qian shou 。 qing kuai dian zuo dian shen me ， fou ze wo men du hui po chan 。]

english: Don't worry, I'm working on it.
translation: 别担心，我正在努力。 [bie dan xin ， wo zheng zai nu li 。]

english: Please hurry. Things are getting dire!
translation: 请快点。事情变得越来越可怕了！ [qing kuai dian 。 shi qing bian de yue lai yue ke pa le ！]

english: I've solved your problems! I've returned the Fairy Queen's magical essence!
translation: 你的问题我已经解决了！我把精灵女王的魔法精华还回来了！ [ni de wen ti wo yi jing jie jue le ！ wo ba jing ling nv wang de mo fa jing hua hai hui lai le ！]

english: What are you talking about?
translation: 你在说什么？ [ni zai shuo shen me ？]

english: The Fairy Queen was in an enchanted sleep, because the Tanglefoot had taken the secateurs that contained her magic. I fought and killed it the Tanglefoot and have given the Godfather the Fairy Queen's secateurs. She'll
translation: 仙后正在沉睡中，因为缠足拿走了蕴含她魔法的剪枝刀。我与它战斗并杀死了缠足，并将仙女女王的剪枝器交给了教父。壳 [xian hou zheng zai chen shui zhong ， yin wei chan zu na zou le yun han ta mo fa de jian zhi dao 。 wo yu ta zhan dou bing sha si le chan zu ， bing jiang xian nv nv wang de jian zhi qi jiao gei le jiao fu 。 ke]

english: wake up now and everything will get back to normal.
translation: 现在醒来，一切都会恢复正常。 [xian zai xing lai ， yi qie du hui hui fu zheng chang 。]

english: I'm glad to hear it, but if you don't mind I'll go and plant some seeds now and wait until they grow before I give you the reward that I promised.
translation: 我很高兴听到这个消息，但如果你不介意的话，我现在就去种下一些种子，等它们长大后再给你我承诺的奖励。 [wo hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi ， dan ru guo ni bu jie yi de hua ， wo xian zai jiu qu zhong xia yi xie zhong zi ， deng ta men zhang da hou zai gei ni wo cheng nuo de jiang li 。]

english: I guess it does sound rather far-fetched. Ok, I'll come back and see you after your crops have had a chance to grow.
translation: 我想这听起来确实相当牵强。好吧，等你的庄稼长出来了，我再来看你。 [wo xiang zhe ting qi lai que shi xiang dang qian qiang 。 hao ba ， deng ni de zhuang jia zhang chu lai le ， wo zai lai kan ni 。]

english: Great! I'll see you soon then.
translation: 伟大的！那我很快就会见到你。 [wei da de ！ na wo hen kuai jiu hui jian dao ni 。]

english: So, have your vegetables grown yet?
translation: 那么，你的蔬菜长好了吗？ [na me ， ni de shu cai zhang hao le ma ？]

english: Stop being so impatient, [player]. They'll grow in their own good time - come back later.
translation: 别这么不耐烦了，[玩家]。他们会在自己的美好时光里成长——稍后再回来。 [bie zhe me bu nai fan le ，[ wan jia ]。 ta men hui zai zi ji de mei hao shi guang li cheng zhang —— shao hou zai hui lai 。]

english: Hello Martin, you must be the slowest gardener in the world! I don't suppose those crops have grown yet?
translation: 你好马丁，你一定是世界上最慢的园丁！我想那些庄稼还没长出来吧？ [ni hao ma ding ， ni yi ding shi shi jie shang zui man de yuan ding ！ wo xiang na xie zhuang jia hai mei zhang chu lai ba ？]

english: Well, you've got a nerve showing up around here again!
translation: 好吧，你居然又出现在这儿了！ [hao ba ， ni ju ran you chu xian zai zhe er le ！]

english: What? What are you talking about?
translation: 什么？你在说什么？ [shen me ？ ni zai shuo shen me ？]

english: You told me that you'd solved the problems of the Gardening Group's members, well I've planted loads of seeds since then and there's no doubt that even more plants are dying!
translation: 你告诉我你已经解决了园艺小组成员的问题，从那时起我已经种下了很多种子，毫无疑问更多的植物正在死去！ [ni gao su wo ni yi jing jie jue le yuan yi xiao zu cheng yuan de wen ti ， cong na shi qi wo yi jing zhong xia le hen duo zhong zi ， hao wu yi wen geng duo de zhi wu zheng zai si qu ！]

english: But I gave Fairy Queen's secateurs back to Godfather, things should be growing again.
translation: 不过我把精灵女王的剪枝器还给了教父，东西应该又会长起来了。 [bu guo wo ba jing ling nv wang de jian zhi qi huan gei le jiao fu ， dong xi ying gai you hui zhang qi lai le 。]

english: Yeah, sure, whatever. You know, I didn't believe you when you told me a story about 'the fairies' in the first place. You'd just better solve this problem, when people get hungry, they get angry and when you're the
translation: 是的，当然，无论如何。你知道，当你一开始给我讲一个关于“仙女”的故事时，我并不相信你。你最好解决这个问题，当人们挨饿时，他们就会生气，而当你是 [shi de ， dang ran ， wu lun ru he 。 ni zhi dao ， dang ni yi kai shi gei wo jiang yi ge guan yu “ xian nv ” de gu shi shi ， wo bing bu xiang xin ni 。 ni zui hao jie jue zhe ge wen ti ， dang ren men ai e shi ， ta men jiu hui sheng qi ， er dang ni shi]

english: person who said that everything would be all right, so you're the person who they'll get angry with!
translation: 说一切都会好起来的人，所以你就是他们会生气的人！ [shuo yi qie du hui hao qi lai de ren ， suo yi ni jiu shi ta men hui sheng qi de ren ！]

english: I suppose I'd better go and see what the problem is then.
translation: 我想我最好去看看问题出在哪里。 [wo xiang wo zui hao qu kan kan wen ti chu zai na li 。]

english: I've done enough for you, sort it out yourself!
translation: 我为你做的已经够多了，你自己解决吧！ [wo wei ni zuo de yi jing gou duo le ， ni zi ji jie jue ba ！]

english: Hello again, [player]. Our crops are still failing. Please do something fast, the food reserves are starting to fail. People will start to realise that there is an imminent food crisis soon!
translation: 再次问好，[玩家]。我们的庄稼仍然歉收。请快点采取行动，食物储备开始耗尽。人们很快就会开始意识到粮食危机迫在眉睫！ [zai ci wen hao ，[ wan jia ]。 wo men de zhuang jia reng ran qian shou 。 qing kuai dian cai qu xing dong ， shi wu chu bei kai shi hao jin 。 ren men hen kuai jiu hui kai shi yi shi dao liang shi wei ji po zai mei jie ！]

english: Okay, this time I've really solved your problems! I've woken up the Fairy Queen!
translation: 好吧，这次我真的解决了你的问题！我唤醒了精灵女王！ [hao ba ， zhe ci wo zhen de jie jue le ni de wen ti ！ wo huan xing le jing ling nv wang ！]

english: Hmm, right. You'll forgive me if I reserve judgement on this until I actually have some crops grow.
translation: 嗯，对。如果我保留对此事的判断，直到我真正长出一些庄稼，你会原谅我的。 [n ， dui 。 ru guo wo bao liu dui ci shi de pan duan ， zhi dao wo zhen zheng zhang chu yi xie zhuang jia ， ni hui yuan liang wo de 。]

english: Of course. The problem was the Godfather, he wanted to take control of Zanaris himself, so he didn't give Fairy Nuff the Queen's secateurs!
translation: 当然。问题是教父，他想亲自控制扎纳里斯，所以他没有给仙女纳夫女王的剪枝器！ [dang ran 。 wen ti shi jiao fu ， ta xiang qin zi kong zhi zha na li si ， suo yi ta mei you gei xian nv na fu nv wang de jian zhi qi ！]

english: Godfather...Fairy Nuff...the Queen, I don't know what you're talking about and I don't care. I just want my crops to start growing again. Come back and claim your reward once they've had a chance to grow.
translation: 教父……仙女纳夫……女王，我不知道你在说什么，但我不在乎。我只是想让我的庄稼重新开始生长。一旦他们有机会成长，就回来领取你的奖励。 [jiao fu …… xian nv na fu …… nv wang ， wo bu zhi dao ni zai shuo shen me ， dan wo bu zai hu 。 wo zhi shi xiang rang wo de zhuang jia chong xin kai shi sheng zhang 。 yi dan ta men you ji hui cheng zhang ， jiu hui lai ling qu ni de jiang li 。]

english: Cor blimey mate, what are ye doing in me pockets?
translation: 老兄，你在我口袋里做什么？ [lao xiong ， ni zai wo kou dai li zuo shen me ？]

english: You're the thief who stole from me!
translation: 你就是偷我东西的小偷！ [ni jiu shi tou wo dong xi de xiao tou ！]

english: Guards, guards!
translation: 卫兵，卫兵！ [wei bing ， wei bing ！]

english: Ask about the Skillcape of Farming.
translation: 询问农业技能。 [xun wen nong ye ji neng 。]

english: Skillcape
translation: 技能角 [ji neng jiao]

english: I'm not paying that!
translation: 我不付那个钱！ [wo bu fu na ge qian ！]

english: Sure, not many people own one.
translation: 当然，拥有它的人并不多。 [dang ran ， yong you ta de ren bing bu duo 。]

english: Hood
translation: 兜帽 [dou mao]

english: Ask about the quest.
translation: 询问任务。 [xun wen ren wu 。]

english: Anything I can help with?
translation: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang mang de ma ？]

english: Now that I think about it, you're right!
translation: 现在想来，你说得对！ [xian zai xiang lai ， ni shuo de dui ！]

english: No, can't say that I have.
translation: 不，不能说我有。 [bu ， bu neng shuo wo you 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Oh dear. I hope you can sort them out by yourself.
translation: 哦亲爱的。我希望你能自己解决它们。 [o qin ai de 。 wo xi wang ni neng zi ji jie jue ta men 。]

english: What is the banner for?
translation: 横幅有什么用？ [heng fu you shen me yong ？]

english: Of course I'll help.
translation: 我当然会帮忙。 [wo dang ran hui bang mang 。]

english: Sorry, I have better things to do.
translation: 抱歉，我还有更重要的事情要做。 [bao qian ， wo hai you geng zhong yao de shi qing yao zuo 。]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello! What can I do for you today?
translation: 你好！今天我能为您做什么？ [ni hao ！ jin tian wo neng wei nin zuo shen me ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm Marwolaeth, bringer of prophecy.
translation: 我是玛沃莱斯，预言使者。 [wo shi ma wo lai si ， yu yan shi zhe 。]

english: It's nice to meet you Marwolaeth, I'm [player name].
translation: 很高兴认识你，Marwolaeth，我是[玩家姓名]。 [hen gao xing ren shi ni ，Marwolaeth， wo shi [ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: And it's great to meet you, [player name].
translation: 很高兴见到你，[玩家姓名]。 [hen gao xing jian dao ni ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm the local wisdom, my dreams are those of prophecy. Would you care for a reading?
translation: 我是当地的智慧，我的梦想是预言。你愿意读书吗？ [wo shi dang di de zhi hui ， wo de meng xiang shi yu yan 。 ni yuan yi du shu ma ？]

english: Yes, tell me of my future...
translation: 是的，告诉我我的未来...... [shi de ， gao su wo wo de wei lai ......]

english: I see a blinding light! A fire so big the heavens can see it; all those who look upon the great flame struggle to look away.
translation: 我看到一道刺眼的光芒！火大得连天都看得见；所有看到这伟大火焰的人都挣扎着将目光移开。 [wo kan dao yi dao ci yan de guang mang ！ huo da de lian tian dou kan de jian ； suo you kan dao zhe wei da huo yan de ren dou zheng zha zhe jiang mu guang yi kai 。]

english: I see a darkness so thick, light fails to escape it - A shadow world where up is down and right is wrong.
translation: 我看到一片黑暗，如此浓重，光无法逃脱——这是一个阴影世界，上有下，对有错。 [wo kan dao yi pian hei an ， ru ci nong zhong ， guang wu fa tao tuo —— zhe shi yi ge yin ying shi jie ， shang you xia ， dui you cuo 。]

english: I see peace and prosperity - The air is filled with wonderous bird song and the scent of earth and river.
translation: 我看到了和平与繁荣——空气中充满了美妙的鸟鸣声以及泥土和河流的气味。 [wo kan dao le he ping yu fan rong —— kong qi zhong chong man le mei miao de niao ming sheng yi ji ni tu he he liu de qi wei 。]

english: What's that supposed to mean?
translation: 那是什么意思？ [na shi shen me yi si ？]

english: It isn't my place to derive meaning. Allow my foretelling to guide your future but do not rely upon it happening all by itself. We are the arbiters of our own destiny.
translation: 这不是我获取意义的地方。让我的预言来指导你的未来，但不要依赖它自己发生。我们是自己命运的仲裁者。 [zhe bu shi wo huo qu yi yi de di fang 。 rang wo de yu yan lai zhi dao ni de wei lai ， dan bu yao yi lai ta zi ji fa sheng 。 wo men shi zi ji ming yun de zhong cai zhe 。]

english: That's really quite vague, do you just say this to everyone?
translation: 这确实很模糊，你就这么对所有人说吗？ [zhe que shi hen mo hu ， ni jiu zhe me dui suo you ren shuo ma ？]

english: It's your choice to believe, not mine.
translation: 相信是你的选择，不是我的。 [xiang xin shi ni de xuan ze ， bu shi wo de 。]

english: Oh, alright... Thanks, I suppose.
translation: 哦，好吧...谢谢，我想。 [o ， hao ba ... xie xie ， wo xiang 。]

english: You're most welcome, [player name].
translation: 不客气，[玩家姓名]。 [bu ke qi ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Was there anything else you wanted?
translation: 你还有什么想要的吗？ [ni hai you shen me xiang yao de ma ？]

english: Hmm, no thanks...
translation: 嗯，不用了，谢谢... [n ， bu yong le ， xie xie ...]

english: Are you sure?
translation: 你确定吗？ [ni que ding ma ？]

english: I'd prefer to stay ignorant... Who knows what that knowledge could do to a person...
translation: 我宁愿保持无知......谁知道这些知识会对一个人产生什么...... [wo ning yuan bao chi wu zhi ...... shui zhi dao zhe xie zhi shi hui dui yi ge ren chan sheng shen me ......]

english: A blissful existence may be the correct path.
translation: 幸福的存在也许才是正确的道路。 [xing fu de cun zai ye xu cai shi zheng que de dao lu 。]

english: Can you tell me about this place?
translation: 你能告诉我这个地方吗？ [ni neng gao su wo zhe ge di fang ma ？]

english: I can! This is the quaint town of Gwenith. All those who have been granted access to the great crystal city of Prifddinas are welcome here.
translation: 我可以！这就是古雅的格温尼斯小镇。欢迎所有获准进入伟大水晶城市普里夫迪纳斯的人来到这里。 [wo ke yi ！ zhe jiu shi gu ya de ge wen ni si xiao zhen 。 huan ying suo you huo zhun jin ru wei da shui jing cheng shi pu li fu di na si de ren lai dao zhe li 。]

english: What's with that creepy mountain?
translation: 这座令人毛骨悚然的山是怎么回事？ [zhe zuo ling ren mao gu song ran de shan shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: Ah... It is expected for an outsider like yourself to notice the mountain wonder how we exist in its shadow.
translation: 啊……像你这样的局外人应该会注意到这座山，想知道我们如何存在于它的阴影下。 [a …… xiang ni zhe yang de ju wai ren ying gai hui zhu yi dao zhe zuo shan ， xiang zhi dao wo men ru he cun zai yu ta de yin ying xia 。]

english: We leave the mountain alone and it lets us live peacefully, out of sight of any passing boats.
translation: 我们离开这座山，它让我们平静地生活，远离任何过往船只的视线。 [wo men li kai zhe zuo shan ， ta rang wo men ping jing di sheng huo ， yuan li ren he guo wang chuan zhi de shi xian 。]

english: It? The mountain is conscious?
translation: 它？山有意识吗？ [ta ？ shan you yi shi ma ？]

english: Of course! At the very top of the mountain sits a ruin. Whatever calamity happened there; their ghosts remain.
translation: 当然！山顶上有一片废墟。无论那里发生了什么灾难；他们的鬼魂依然存在。 [dang ran ！ shan ding shang you yi pian fei xu 。 wu lun na li fa sheng le shen me zai nan ； ta men de gui hun yi ran cun zai 。]

english: G-g-ghosts?!
translation: 鬼、鬼、鬼？！ [gui 、 gui 、 gui ？！]

english: Yes. Explore at your own peril, [player name]. There are those who have looked for answers from these mynydd spirits. They never return.
translation: 是的。探索的危险由你自己承担，[玩家姓名]。有些人一直在从这些 mynydd 的灵魂那里寻找答案。他们再也没有回来。 [shi de 。 tan suo de wei xian you ni zi ji cheng dan ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。 you xie ren yi zhi zai cong zhe xie  mynydd  de ling hun na li xun zhao da an 。 ta men zai ye mei you hui lai 。]

english: That doesn't necessarily mean they died... They may have found the meaning that they desired and have gone elsewhere.
translation: 这并不一定意味着他们死了……他们可能已经找到了他们想要的意义并去了其他地方。 [zhe bing bu yi ding yi wei zhe ta men si le …… ta men ke neng yi jing zhao dao le ta men xiang yao de yi yi bing qu le qi ta di fang 。]

english: Elsewhere? Indeed... As I said, [player name], explore at your own peril. Was there anything else you wanted?
translation: 别处？确实...正如我所说，[玩家姓名]，探索后果自负。你还有什么想要的吗？ [bie chu ？ que shi ... zheng ru wo suo shuo ，[ wan jia xing ming ]， tan suo hou guo zi fu 。 ni hai you shen me xiang yao de ma ？]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Farewell, adventurer.
translation: 再见了，冒险家。 [zai jian le ， mao xian jia 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Yes, tell me of my future...
translation: 是的，告诉我我的未来...... [shi de ， gao su wo wo de wei lai ......]

english: Hmm, no thanks...
translation: 嗯，不用了，谢谢... [n ， bu yong le ， xie xie ...]

english: Can you tell me about this place?
translation: 你能告诉我这个地方吗？ [ni neng gao su wo zhe ge di fang ma ？]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Is it over?
translation: 结束了吗？ [jie shu le ma ？]

english: I can't hear anything? It might be?
translation: 我什么也听不到？可能是吗？ [wo shen me ye ting bu dao ？ ke neng shi ma ？]

english: Is someone in there?
translation: 里面有人吗？ [li mian you ren ma ？]

english: N-n-n-no... go away...
translation: 不不不……走开…… [bu bu bu …… zou kai ……]

english: Oh okay, fair enough.
translation: 哦，好吧，很公平。 [o ， hao ba ， hen gong ping 。]

english: Wait! Come back, we need your help.
translation: 等待！回来吧，我们需要你的帮助。 [deng dai ！ hui lai ba ， wo men xu yao ni de bang zhu 。]

english: Jack Frost locked us in here when he stormed into our bakery. We tried to stop him from messing up our production, but he got grumpy.
translation: 杰克·弗罗斯特冲进我们的面包店时把我们锁在了这里。我们试图阻止他搞砸我们的制作，但他脾气暴躁。 [jie ke · fu luo si te chong jin wo men de mian bao dian shi ba wo men suo zai le zhe li 。 wo men shi tu zu zhi ta gao za wo men de zhi zuo ， dan ta pi qi bao zao 。]

english: I ran into one of your bakers outside, he said you were in trouble.
translation: 我在外面遇到了你们的一位面包师，他说你们有麻烦了。 [wo zai wai mian yu dao le ni men de yi wei mian bao shi ， ta shuo ni men you ma fan le 。]

english: Oh Remy is still alive! We thought Jack fed him to the Icelord.
translation: 噢，雷米还活着！我们以为杰克把他喂给了冰王。 [o ， lei mi hai huo zhe ！ wo men yi wei jie ke ba ta wei gei le bing wang 。]

english: Where's the key? The door looks locked to me.
translation: 钥匙在哪里？门看起来对我来说是锁着的。 [yao shi zai na li ？ men kan qi lai dui wo lai shuo shi suo zhe de 。]

english: I thought you had it, Mary.
translation: 我以为你有它，玛丽。 [wo yi wei ni you ta ， ma li 。]

english: Well I thought you had it, Paul.
translation: 好吧，我以为你已经做到了，保罗。 [hao ba ， wo yi wei ni yi jing zuo dao le ， bao luo 。]

english: Don't you think I'd have opened the door if I had it?
translation: 你不觉得如果我有门的话我会开门吗？ [ni bu jue de ru guo wo you men de hua wo hui kai men ma ？]

english: Don't you think I would have opened the door as well!
translation: 你不觉得我也会开门吗！ [ni bu jue de wo ye hui kai men ma ！]

english: Great, now I'm locked in here with you for the rest of my life.
translation: 太好了，现在我的余生都被锁在这里和你在一起了。 [tai hao le ， xian zai wo de yu sheng dou bei suo zai zhe li he ni zai yi qi le 。]

english: Woah calm down! If it's not in there, it must be out here. Let me look for it.
translation: 哇冷静点！如果它不在里面，它一定在外面。让我找找看。 [wa leng jing dian ！ ru guo ta bu zai li mian ， ta yi ding zai wai mian 。 rang wo zhao zhao kan 。]

english: RAAAAAAAAAAAWR
translation: 啊啊啊啊啊啊 [a a a a a a]

english: The Icelord sees you trying to enter their cage and blasts you backwards.
translation: 寒冰领主看到你试图进入他们的笼子，然后将你向后轰飞。 [han bing ling zhu kan dao ni shi tu jin ru ta men de long zi ， ran hou jiang ni xiang hou hong fei 。]

english: Ooooh that sounds like it hurt!
translation: 哦哦，听起来很疼！ [o o ， ting qi lai hen teng ！]

english: Are you okay dear? That sounded quite nasty.
translation: 亲爱的你还好吗？这听起来很令人讨厌。 [qin ai de ni hai hao ma ？ zhe ting qi lai hen ling ren tao yan 。]

english: Well, I found the key.
translation: 嗯，我找到了钥匙。 [n ， wo zhao dao le yao shi 。]

english: That's great, come on let us out then.
translation: 那太好了，那就让我们出去吧。 [na tai hao le ， na jiu rang wo men chu qu ba 。]

english: Yes hurry up, we need to get back on schedule.
translation: 是的，快点，我们需要按计划恢复。 [shi de ， kuai dian ， wo men xu yao an ji hua hui fu 。]

english: That's going to be a problem, it's in the cage with the Icelord.
translation: 这将是一个问题，它和冰王一起关在笼子里。 [zhe jiang shi yi ge wen ti ， ta he bing wang yi qi guan zai long zi li 。]

english: I've got no way to get it with the Icelord there.
translation: 我没有办法用冰领主那里得到它。 [wo mei you ban fa yong bing ling zhu na li de dao ta 。]

english: Did you try telegrabbing it?
translation: 你尝试过电抢吗？ [ni chang shi guo dian qiang ma ？]

english: I'm stumped, I can't find the key.
translation: 我很困惑，找不到钥匙。 [wo hen kun huo ， zhao bu dao yao shi 。]

english: You've looked around the bakery and no luck?
translation: 您环视了面包店，但没有找到运气？ [nin huan shi le mian bao dian ， dan mei you zhao dao yun qi ？]

english: If it's not in here or in the back room, it must be in the cage with the Icelord.
translation: 如果它不在这儿或后面的房间里，它一定是和冰王一起在笼子里。 [ru guo ta bu zai zhe er huo hou mian de fang jian li ， ta yi ding shi he bing wang yi qi zai long zi li 。]

english: It wouldn't be safe to go in there.
translation: 进去那里不安全。 [jin qu na li bu an quan 。]

english: Could you try telegrabbing it?
translation: 你能尝试一下电抢吗？ [ni neng chang shi yi xia dian qiang ma ？]

english: That won't work, the Icelord's magic will interfere.
translation: 那不行，冰王的魔法会干扰。 [na bu xing ， bing wang de mo fa hui gan rao 。]

english: Hmm... You're going to need a way to protect yourself from the Icelord.
translation: 嗯...你需要一种方法来保护自己免受冰王的侵害。 [n ... ni xu yao yi zhong fang fa lai bao hu zi ji mian shou bing wang de qin hai 。]

english: Don't suppose you have an Anti-Icelord Shield lying around here then?
translation: 你不认为这里有反冰领之盾吗？ [ni bu ren wei zhe li you fan bing ling zhi dun ma ？]

english: I don't, do you Paul?
translation: 我不这么认为，保罗你呢？ [wo bu zhe me ren wei ， bao luo ni ne ？]

english: No I don't...
translation: 不，我不... [bu ， wo bu ...]

english: But I do have a genius idea, we'll use Gingerbread!
translation: 但我确实有一个天才的主意，我们将使用姜饼！ [dan wo que shi you yi ge tian cai de zhu yi ， wo men jiang shi yong jiang bing ！]

english: Before Jack locked us up, I saw him using the Icelord to ice his Gingerbread Gnomes. They did a great job of absorbing his breath.
translation: 在杰克把我们关起来之前，我看到他用冰领主来冰冻他的姜饼侏儒。他们很好地吸收了他的呼吸。 [zai jie ke ba wo men guan qi lai zhi qian ， wo kan dao ta yong bing ling zhu lai bing dong ta de jiang bing zhu ru 。 ta men hen hao di xi shou le ta de hu xi 。]

english: You'll need to make a Gingerbread Gnome big enough to absorb the Icelord's breath.
translation: 你需要制作一个足够大的姜饼侏儒来吸收冰王的气息。 [ni xu yao zhi zuo yi ge zu gou da de jiang bing zhu ru lai xi shou bing wang de qi xi 。]

english: How am I going to do that?
translation: 我该怎么做呢？ [wo gai zen me zuo ne ？]

english: Our usual recipe uses: one cinnamon, one ginger, one flour and one egg, we put them into that big machine you see to your left.
translation: 我们通常的食谱使用：一颗肉桂，一颗生姜，一颗面粉和一颗鸡蛋，我们把它们放进你左边看到的那个大机器里。 [wo men tong chang de shi pu shi yong ： yi ke rou gui ， yi ke sheng jiang ， yi ke mian fen he yi ke ji dan ， wo men ba ta men fang jin ni zuo bian kan dao de na ge da ji qi li 。]

english: Try using more of each ingredient till you get the right combination? Possibly tripling the amount of each ingredient might work.
translation: 尝试使用更多的每种成分，直到获得正确的组合？也许将每种成分的量增加三倍可能会起作用。 [chang shi shi yong geng duo de mei zhong cheng fen ， zhi dao huo de zheng que de zu he ？ ye xu jiang mei zhong cheng fen de liang zeng jia san bei ke neng hui qi zuo yong 。]

english: This is such a ridiculous idea, guess I have no choice....
translation: 这是一个多么可笑的想法，我想我别无选择...... [zhe shi yi ge duo me ke xiao de xiang fa ， wo xiang wo bie wu xuan ze ......]

english: Come back to us if you need some more help.
translation: 如果您需要更多帮助，请回到我们这里。 [ru guo nin xu yao geng duo bang zhu ， qing hui dao wo men zhe li 。]

english: I found the key!
translation: 我找到了钥匙！ [wo zhao dao le yao shi ！]

english: That's great! Now hurry up and open the door.
translation: 那太棒了！现在赶紧把门打开。 [na tai bang le ！ xian zai gan jin ba men da kai 。]

english: You release the bakers and give back their key...
translation: 你释放面包师并归还他们的钥匙...... [ni shi fang mian bao shi bing gui huan ta men de yao shi ......]

english: There you go, unlocked without an issue.
translation: 就这样，解锁没问题。 [jiu zhe yang ， jie suo mei wen ti 。]

english: Wow, you managed to do that so quickly! Without any help from us.
translation: 哇，你这么快就做到了！没有我们的任何帮助。 [wa ， ni zhe me kuai jiu zuo dao le ！ mei you wo men de ren he bang zhu 。]

english: You're very impressive, what a coincidence that you knew to make a giant piece of gingerbread to protect yourself.
translation: 你真了不起，真巧，你竟然知道做一块巨大的姜饼来保护自己。 [ni zhen liao bu qi ， zhen qiao ， ni jing ran zhi dao zuo yi kuai ju da de jiang bing lai bao hu zi ji 。]

english: Ha ha, yeah, it was no problem.
translation: 哈哈，是啊，没问题。 [ha ha ， shi a ， mei wen ti 。]

english: Well, thanks for freeing us!
translation: 好吧，谢谢你释放了我们！ [hao ba ， xie xie ni shi fang le wo men ！]

english: I can't believe that actually worked....
translation: 我不敢相信这真的有效...... [wo bu gan xiang xin zhe zhen de you xiao ......]

english: ...Me too, I thought you'd be turned into icing for sure.
translation: ……我也是，我以为你肯定会变成糖霜。 […… wo ye shi ， wo yi wei ni ken ding hui bian cheng tang shuang 。]

english: So you're telling me you weren't even sure it would!?
translation: 所以你告诉我你甚至不确定会这样！？ [suo yi ni gao su wo ni shen zhi bu que ding hui zhe yang ！？]

english: It worked out didn't it? We're free to continue making Gingerbread Gnomes.
translation: 成功了不是吗？我们可以继续制作姜饼侏儒。 [cheng gong le bu shi ma ？ wo men ke yi ji xu zhi zuo jiang bing zhu ru 。]

english: That was extremely reckless, Paul, but you're right, it did work out in the end.
translation: 这太鲁莽了，保罗，但你是对的，最终确实成功了。 [zhe tai lu mang le ， bao luo ， dan ni shi dui de ， zui zhong que shi cheng gong le 。]

english: ...fine. I should go tell Santa the good news, the bakery is back in operation.
translation: ...美好的。我应该去告诉圣诞老人这个好消息，面包店恢复营业了。 [... mei hao de 。 wo ying gai qu gao su sheng dan lao ren zhe ge hao xiao xi ， mian bao dian hui fu ying ye le 。]

english: We'll be back in full production in no time!
translation: 我们很快就会恢复全面生产！ [wo men hen kuai jiu hui hui fu quan mian sheng chan ！]

english: What do we do about the Icelord in the cage?
translation: 笼子里的冰领主我们该怎么办？ [long zi li de bing ling zhu wo men gai zen me ban ？]

english: Maybe Jack was onto something by using it to ice the Gingerbread Gnomes.
translation: 也许杰克用它来给姜饼侏儒冰冻是有道理的。 [ye xu jie ke yong ta lai gei jiang bing zhu ru bing dong shi you dao li de 。]

english: You should take the giant piece of gingerbread you made and show it to Santa, he'll know we're back in business then.
translation: 你应该把你做的那块巨大的姜饼拿给圣诞老人看，他就会知道我们又开始营业了。 [ni ying gai ba ni zuo de na kuai ju da de jiang bing na gei sheng dan lao ren kan ， ta jiu hui zhi dao wo men you kai shi ying ye le 。]

english: Alright, time for you to go, we need to get back into production.
translation: 好吧，你该走了，我们需要恢复生产。 [hao ba ， ni gai zou le ， wo men xu yao hui fu sheng chan 。]

english: Hello there. Is this your home?
translation: 你好呀。这是你家吗？ [ni hao ya 。 zhe shi ni jia ma ？]

english: It is. What brings you here?
translation: 这是。是什么风把你吹到这里来的？ [zhe shi 。 shi shen me feng ba ni chui dao zhe li lai de ？]

english: I'm just looking around.
translation: 我只是看看。 [wo zhi shi kan kan 。]

english: Well you won't find anything too exciting here I'm afraid. Just farming.
translation: 恐怕你不会在这里发现任何太令人兴奋的东西。只是种田而已。 [kong pa ni bu hui zai zhe li fa xian ren he tai ling ren xing fen de dong xi 。 zhi shi zhong tian er yi 。]

english: Well you have fun with it.
translation: 好吧，你玩得很开心。 [hao ba ， ni wan de hen kai xin 。]

english: Well I have to say that mounted head looks awful.
translation: 好吧，我不得不说安装头看起来很糟糕。 [hao ba ， wo bu de bu shuo an zhuang tou kan qi lai hen zao gao 。]

english: Sorry.
translation: 对不起。 [dui bu qi 。]

english: Not to worry. If it keeps Gordon happy, so be it. Anyway, thank you for keeping our farm safe. With the beast dealt with, I've been able to get back to tanning again.
translation: 不用担心。如果这能让戈登开心，那就这样吧。不管怎样，谢谢你保护我们农场的安全。处理完这头野兽后，我又可以继续晒黑了。 [bu yong dan xin 。 ru guo zhe neng rang ge deng kai xin ， na jiu zhe yang ba 。 bu guan zen yang ， xie xie ni bao hu wo men nong chang de an quan 。 chu li wan zhe tou ye shou hou ， wo you ke yi ji xu shai hei le 。]

translation: 你能为我晒点东西吗？ [ni neng wei wo shai dian dong xi ma ？]

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: Happy to have helped. All the best.
translation: 很高兴能提供帮助。一切顺利。 [hen gao xing neng ti gong bang zhu 。 yi qie shun li 。]

english: Good to see you again! Anything I can do for you?
translation: 很高兴再次见到你！有什么我能为您做的吗？ [hen gao xing zai ci jian dao ni ！ you shen me wo neng wei nin zuo de ma ？]
