translation: 很高兴能提供帮助。一切顺利。 [hen gao xing neng ti gong bang zhu 。 yi qie shun li 。]

english: I'm good.
translation: 我很好。 [wo hen hao 。]

english: Thank you for all your help in solving the murder.
translation: 感谢您为侦破谋杀案提供的所有帮助。 [gan xie nin wei zhen po mou sha an ti gong de suo you bang zhu 。]

english: Ah! Welcome, newcomer. I am the Master Chef, Lev. It is here that I will teach you how to cook food truly fit for a king.
translation: 啊!欢迎，新人。我是主厨，列夫。在这里，我将教您如何烹饪真正适合国王的食物。 [a ! huan ying ， xin ren 。 wo shi zhu chu ， lie fu 。 zai zhe li ， wo jiang jiao nin ru he peng ren zhen zheng shi he guo wang de shi wu 。]

english: I already know how to cook. Brynna taught me just now.
translation: 我已经知道怎么做饭了。布琳娜刚才教了我。 [wo yi jing zhi dao zen me zuo fan le 。 bu lin na gang cai jiao le wo 。]

english: Hahahahahaha! You call THAT cooking? Some shrimp on an open log fire? Oh, no, no, no. I am going to teach you the fine art of cooking bread.
translation: 哈哈哈哈哈哈！你管这叫做饭？一些虾放在明火上？哦，不，不，不。我将教你烹饪面包的艺术。 [ha ha ha ha ha ha ！ ni guan zhe jiao zuo fan ？ yi xie xia fang zai ming huo shang ？ o ， bu ， bu ， bu 。 wo jiang jiao ni peng ren mian bao de yi shu 。]

english: Time for you to learn the fine art of cooking bread.
translation: 是时候让你学习烹饪面包的艺术了。 [shi shi hou rang ni xue xi peng ren mian bao de yi shu le 。]

english: Do you need something?
translation: 你需要什么东西吗？ [ni xu yao shen me dong xi ma ？]

english: Tell me about making dough again.
translation: 告诉我再做面团的事。 [gao su wo zai zuo mian tuan de shi 。]

english: It's quite simple. Just use a pot of flour on a bucket of water, or vice versa, and you'll make dough. You can fill a bucket with water at any sink.
translation: 这很简单。只需将一锅面粉放在一桶水中，反之亦然，你就可以制作面团。您可以在任何水槽处将水桶装满水。 [zhe hen jian dan 。 zhi xu jiang yi guo mian fen fang zai yi tong shui zhong ， fan zhi yi ran ， ni jiu ke yi zhi zuo mian tuan 。 nin ke yi zai ren he shui cao chu jiang shui tong zhuang man shui 。]

english: Do you need anything else?
translation: 您还需要什么吗？ [nin hai xu yao shen me ma ？]

english: Tell me about range cooking again.
translation: 再告诉我有关炉灶烹饪的事。 [zai gao su wo you guan lu zao peng ren de shi 。]

english: The range is the only place you can cook a lot of the more complex foods in Gielinor. To cook on a range, all you need to do is click on it. You'll need to make sure you have the required items in your inventory though.
translation: 该系列是吉林诺唯一可以烹饪许多更复杂食物的地方。要在炉灶上做饭，您只需点击它即可。不过，您需要确保库存中有所需的物品。 [gai xi lie shi ji lin nuo wei yi ke yi peng ren xu duo geng fu za shi wu de di fang 。 yao zai lu zao shang zuo fan ， nin zhi xu dian ji ta ji ke 。 bu guo ， nin xu yao que bao ku cun zhong you suo xu de wu pin 。]

english: Nothing thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。]

english: Tell me about making dough again.
translation: 告诉我再做面团的事。 [gao su wo zai zuo mian tuan de shi 。]

english: Tell me about range cooking again.
translation: 再告诉我有关炉灶烹饪的事。 [zai gao su wo you guan lu zao peng ren de shi 。]

english: Nothing thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello, and welcome to the Crafting Guild. Accomplished crafters from all over the land come here to use our top notch workshops.
translation: 您好，欢迎来到工艺公会。来自全国各地的优秀工匠来到这里使用我们一流的工作室。 [nin hao ， huan ying lai dao gong yi gong hui 。 lai zi quan guo ge di de you xiu gong jiang lai dao zhe li shi yong wo men yi liu de gong zuo shi 。]

english: Hey, what is that cape you're wearing? I don't recognise it.
translation: 嘿，你穿的那件斗篷是什么？我不认识它。 [hei ， ni chuan de na jian dou peng shi shen me ？ wo bu ren shi ta 。]

english: This? This is a Skillcape of Crafting. It is a symbol of my ability as master of the Crafting Guild and it provides unlimited teleports here.
translation: 这？这是一个制作技能。它是我作为工艺公会大师的能力的象征，它在这里提供无限的传送。 [zhe ？ zhe shi yi ge zhi zuo ji neng 。 ta shi wo zuo wei gong yi gong hui da shi de neng li de xiang zheng ， ta zai zhe li ti gong wu xian de chuan song 。]

english: If you should ever achieve level 99 Crafting come and talk to me and we'll see if we can sort you out with one.
translation: 如果你的制作达到了 99 级，请来找我谈谈，我们看看能否为你找到一个。 [ru guo ni de zhi zuo da dao le  99  ji ， qing lai zhao wo tan tan ， wo men kan kan neng fou wei ni zhao dao yi ge 。]

english: Are you the person I need to talk to about buying a Skillcape of Crafting?
translation: 您是我需要与您讨论购买工艺技能斗篷的人吗？ [nin shi wo xu yao yu nin tao lun gou mai gong yi ji neng dou peng de ren ma ？]

english: I certainly am, and I can see that you are definitely talented enough to own one! The cape has a built-in teleport back to us at the guild too!
translation: 我当然是，而且我看得出你绝对有足够的才华来拥有一个！斗篷也有内置传送回公会的功能！ [wo dang ran shi ， er qie wo kan de chu ni jue dui you zu gou de cai hua lai yong you yi ge ！ dou peng ye you nei zhi chuan song hui gong hui de gong neng ！]

english: Unfortunately, being such a prestigious item, they are appropriately expensive. I'm afraid I must ask you for 99000 gold.
translation: 不幸的是，作为如此享有盛誉的物品，它们的价格相当昂贵。恐怕我必须向你要99000金币。 [bu xing de shi ， zuo wei ru ci xiang you sheng yu de wu pin ， ta men de jia ge xiang dang ang gui 。 kong pa wo bi xu xiang ni yao 99000 jin bi 。]

english: 99000 gold! Are you mad?
translation: 99000金币！你疯了？ [99000 jin bi ！ ni feng le ？]

english: Not at all; there are many other adventurers who would love the opportunity to purchase such a prestigious item! You can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: 一点也不;还有许多其他冒险家希望有机会购买如此享有盛誉的物品！如果你改变主意，可以在这里找到我。 [yi dian ye bu ; hai you xu duo qi ta mao xian jia xi wang you ji hui gou mai ru ci xiang you sheng yu de wu pin ！ ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， ke yi zai zhe li zhao dao wo 。]

english: That's fine.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 但不幸的是，我身上没有足够的钱。 [dan bu xing de shi ， wo shen shang mei you zu gou de qian 。]

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 好吧，等你回来了就回来见我吧。 [hao ba ， deng ni hui lai le jiu hui lai jian wo ba 。]

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 不幸的是，所有技能斗篷都只提供免费兜帽，这是技能升级交易的一部分；买一送一，你懂的。因此，在我向您出售一件之前，您需要释放一些库存空间。 [bu xing de shi ， suo you ji neng dou peng dou zhi ti gong mian fei dou mao ， zhe shi ji neng sheng ji jiao yi de yi bu fen ； mai yi song yi ， ni dong de 。 yin ci ， zai wo xiang nin chu shou yi jian zhi qian ， nin xu yao shi fang yi xie ku cun kong jian 。]

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: 出色的！我的朋友，自豪地穿上那件斗篷。 [chu se de ！ wo de peng you ， zi hao di chuan shang na jian dou peng 。]

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: 请问我可以再给我的披风戴上兜帽吗？ [qing wen wo ke yi zai gei wo de pi feng dai shang dou mao ma ？]

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
translation: 毫无疑问，而且免费！ [hao wu yi wen ， er qie mian fei ！]

english: Where's your brown apron? You can't come in here unless you're wearing one.
translation: 你的棕色围裙在哪里？除非你穿着一件衣服，否则你不能进来。 [ni de zong se wei qun zai na li ？ chu fei ni chuan zhe yi jian yi fu ， fou ze ni bu neng jin lai 。]

english: Err... I haven't got one.
translation: 呃……我没有。 [e …… wo mei you 。]

english: Welcome to the Guild of Master Craftsmen.
translation: 欢迎来到工匠大师公会。 [huan ying lai dao gong jiang da shi gong hui 。]

english: Yeah?
translation: 是的？ [shi de ？]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Whassup?
translation: 什么事？ [shen me shi ？]

english: So... are you here to give crafting tips?
translation: 那么...您来这里是为了提供制作技巧吗？ [na me ... nin lai zhe li shi wei le ti gong zhi zuo ji qiao ma ？]

english: Dude, do I look like I wanna talk to you?
translation: 伙计，我看起来像是想和你说话吗？ [huo ji ， wo kan qi lai xiang shi xiang he ni shuo hua ma ？]

english: I suppose not.
translation: 我想不会。 [wo xiang bu hui 。]

english: Right on!
translation: 就在！ [jiu zai ！]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Skillcape
translation: 技能角 [ji neng jiao]

english: 99000 gold! Are you mad?
translation: 99000金币！你疯了？ [99000 jin bi ！ ni feng le ？]

english: That's fine.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: Hood
translation: 兜帽 [dou mao]

english: Cor blimey mate, what are ye doing in me pockets?
translation: 老兄，你在我口袋里做什么？ [lao xiong ， ni zai wo kou dai li zuo shen me ？]

english: Stuns the player, dealing 3 damage.
translation: 击晕玩家，造成 3 点伤害。 [ji yun wan jia ， zao cheng  3  dian shang hai 。]

english: Hello there. How's it going?
translation: 你好呀。怎么样了？ [ni hao ya 。 zen me yang le ？]

english: Well the work is going well, so I'm very good, thank you.
translation: 嗯，工作进展顺利，所以我很好，谢谢。 [n ， gong zuo jin zhan shun li ， suo yi wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Not too bad thanks.
translation: 还不错，谢谢。 [hai bu cuo ， xie xie 。]

english: I'm fine, how are you?
translation: 我很好，你怎么样？ [wo hen hao ， ni zen me yang ？]

english: Very well, thank you.
translation: 很好，谢谢。 [hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Nilsal! I'm pretty good, thank you. It's always nice to be out in the sun.
translation: 尼尔萨尔！我很好，谢谢。出去晒太阳总是很好的。 [ni er sa er ！ wo hen hao ， xie xie 。 chu qu shai tai yang zong shi hen hao de 。]

english: Hello there! Nice weather we've been having. Perfect for a day outdoors!
translation: 你好呀！我们一直以来天气很好。非常适合户外一天！ [ni hao ya ！ wo men yi zhi yi lai tian qi hen hao 。 fei chang shi he hu wai yi tian ！]

english: Hey newbie! I'm the Master Navigator - let's teach you how to get around.
translation: 嘿新手！我是导航大师 - 让我们来教你如何出行。 [hei xin shou ！ wo shi dao hang da shi  -  rang wo men lai jiao ni ru he chu xing 。]

english: I can already walk around...
translation: 我已经可以四处走动了... [wo yi jing ke yi si chu zou dong le ...]

english: Ha. You've worked your way around to me, but this island is bigger than you think! I will show you by teaching you how to use the world map. First things first, you will need to open your world map.
translation: 哈。你已经想尽了办法来对付我，但这个岛比你想象的要大！我将通过教您如何使用世界地图来向您展示。首先，您需要打开世界地图。 [ha 。 ni yi jing xiang jin le ban fa lai dui fu wo ， dan zhe ge dao bi ni xiang xiang de yao da ！ wo jiang tong guo jiao nin ru he shi yong shi jie di tu lai xiang nin zhan shi 。 shou xian ， nin xu yao da kai shi jie di tu 。]

english: You can find this in the top right side of the screen, look for the flashing globe icon.
translation: 您可以在屏幕的右上角找到它，寻找闪烁的地球图标。 [nin ke yi zai ping mu de you shang jiao zhao dao ta ， xun zhao shan shuo de di qiu tu biao 。]

english: Well done, you have found your world map.
translation: 干得好，你已经找到了你的世界地图。 [gan de hao ， ni yi jing zhao dao le ni de shi jie di tu 。]

english: The world map can show where you are in the world, as well as where other places are. You can find where you are by looking for the yellow X icon.
translation: 世界地图可以显示您在世界上的哪个位置，以及其他地方在哪里。您可以通过寻找黄色 X 图标来找到您所在的位置。 [shi jie di tu ke yi xian shi nin zai shi jie shang de na ge wei zhi ， yi ji qi ta di fang zai na li 。 nin ke yi tong guo xun zhao huang se  X  tu biao lai zhao dao nin suo zai de wei zhi 。]

english: You may have noticed all the icons on the map, these icons have a meaning behind each one. You can find out what the icon means by looking at the map key.
translation: 您可能已经注意到地图上的所有图标，这些图标背后都有一个含义。您可以通过查看地图键了解该图标的含义。 [nin ke neng yi jing zhu yi dao di tu shang de suo you tu biao ， zhe xie tu biao bei hou dou you yi ge han yi 。 nin ke yi tong guo cha kan di tu jian liao jie gai tu biao di han yi 。]

english: To open or close the map key you will have to click the scroll looking icon in the bottom left part of the map.
translation: 要打开或关闭地图键，您必须单击地图左下角的滚动图标。 [yao da kai huo guan bi di tu jian ， nin bi xu dan ji di tu zuo xia jiao de gun dong tu biao 。]

english: Once opened, you will see a list of all the different icons on the map, as well as some text next to the icon telling you what the icon is. You can click on an icon in the key.
translation: 打开后，您将看到地图上所有不同图标的列表，以及图标旁边的一些文本，告诉您该图标是什么。您可以单击按键中的图标。 [da kai hou ， nin jiang kan dao di tu shang suo you bu tong tu biao di lie biao ， yi ji tu biao pang bian de yi xie wen ben ， gao su nin gai tu biao shi shen me 。 nin ke yi dan ji an jian zhong de tu biao 。]

english: Every icon that is the same as the one you just selected, will start to flash.
translation: 每个与您刚刚选择的图标相同的图标都会开始闪烁。 [mei ge yu nin gang gang xuan ze de tu biao xiang tong de tu biao du hui kai shi shan shuo 。]

english: Lastly, next to the key you will see there is a search bar. You can click on the search bar and type in a location. You can then press enter and the map will move to the specified location.
translation: 最后，在按键旁边您会看到一个搜索栏。您可以单击搜索栏并输入位置。然后您可以按 Enter 键，地图将移动到指定位置。 [zui hou ， zai an jian pang bian nin hui kan dao yi ge sou suo lan 。 nin ke yi dan ji sou suo lan bing shu ru wei zhi 。 ran hou nin ke yi an  Enter  jian ， di tu jiang yi dong dao zhi ding wei zhi 。]

english: Now you know the basics of the world map, I am going to task you with making your way to the Quest Guide. You can find him just north of here. Go out the door to the west and follow the path.
translation: 现在您已经了解了世界地图的基础知识，我将要求您完成任务指南。你可以在这儿北边找到他。出了门向西，顺着小路走。 [xian zai nin yi jing liao jie le shi jie di tu de ji chu zhi shi ， wo jiang yao qiu nin wan cheng ren wu zhi nan 。 ni ke yi zai zhe er bei bian zhao dao ta 。 chu le men xiang xi ， shun zhe xiao lu zou 。]

english: Remember that your world map is just a larger version of your mininmap, with the difference that you can click on your minimap to navigate around. You will also see icons on your minimap as well, just like the world map.
translation: 请记住，您的世界地图只是小地图的放大版本，不同之处在于您可以单击小地图进行导航。就像世界地图一样，您还会在小地图上看到图标。 [qing ji zhu ， nin de shi jie di tu zhi shi xiao di tu de fang da ban ben ， bu tong zhi chu zai yu nin ke yi dan ji xiao di tu jin xing dao hang 。 jiu xiang shi jie di tu yi yang ， nin hai hui zai xiao di tu shang kan dao tu biao 。]

english: Thanks for the lesson, I'll go find the Quest Guide now.
translation: 谢谢你的教训，我现在就去找任务指南。 [xie xie ni de jiao xun ， wo xian zai jiu qu zhao ren wu zhi nan 。]

english: Hey newbie, can I help you at all?
translation: 嘿，新手，我可以帮助你吗？ [hei ， xin shou ， wo ke yi bang zhu ni ma ？]

english: Tell me about the world map again.
translation: 再给我讲讲世界地图。 [zai gei wo jiang jiang shi jie di tu 。]

english: Why do you have a meat cleaver?
translation: 为什么你有切肉刀？ [wei shen me ni you qie rou dao ？]

english: *Sigh*
translation: *叹* [* tan *]

english: That's kind of a sore subject. But if you must know, I used to be a chef here on the island.
translation: 这是一个令人痛苦的话题。但如果你一定知道的话，我曾经是岛上的一名厨师。 [zhe shi yi ge ling ren tong ku de hua ti 。 dan ru guo ni yi ding zhi dao de hua ， wo ceng jing shi dao shang de yi ming chu shi 。]

english: But people thought that learning how to cook bread after cooking shrimp was useless. So now I teach players how to navigate the world instead.
translation: 但人们认为煮完虾再学煮面包是没有用的。所以现在我教玩家如何探索世界。 [dan ren men ren wei zhu wan xia zai xue zhu mian bao shi mei you yong de 。 suo yi xian zai wo jiao wan jia ru he tan suo shi jie 。]

english: Is there anything else you would like to grill me on?
translation: 你还有什么想烤我的吗？ [ni hai you shen me xiang kao wo de ma ？]

english: Nope, I'm ready to move on!
translation: 不，我已经准备好继续前进了！ [bu ， wo yi jing zhun bei hao ji xu qian jin le ！]

english: Get moving then.
translation: 那就行动起来吧。 [na jiu xing dong qi lai ba 。]

english: Tell me about the world map again.
translation: 再给我讲讲世界地图。 [zai gei wo jiang jiang shi jie di tu 。]

english: Why do you have a meat cleaver?
translation: 为什么你有切肉刀？ [wei shen me ni you qie rou dao ？]

english: Nope, I'm ready to move on!
translation: 不，我已经准备好继续前进了！ [bu ， wo yi jing zhun bei hao ji xu qian jin le ！]

english: Hello, I'm afraid only the top fishers are allowed to use our premier fishing facilities.
translation: 您好，恐怕只有顶级渔民才可以使用我们一流的钓鱼设施。 [nin hao ， kong pa zhi you ding ji yu min cai ke yi shi yong wo men yi liu de diao yu she shi 。]

english: Hello, welcome to the fishing guild.  Please feel free to make use of any of our facilities.
translation: 您好，欢迎来到钓鱼公会。  请随时使用我们的任何设施。 [nin hao ， huan ying lai dao diao yu gong hui 。   qing sui shi shi yong wo men de ren he she shi 。]

english: Can you tell me about that skillcape you're wearing?
translation: 你能告诉我你穿的那件技能斗篷吗？ [ni neng gao su wo ni chuan de na jian ji neng dou peng ma ？]

english: I'm happy to, my friend. This beautiful cape was presented to me in recognition of my skills and experience as a fisherman and I was asked to be the head of this guild at the same time.
translation: 我很高兴，我的朋友。这件美丽的斗篷送给我是为了表彰我作为渔夫的技能和经验，同时我也被邀请担任这个行会的会长。 [wo hen gao xing ， wo de peng you 。 zhe jian mei li de dou peng song gei wo shi wei le biao zhang wo zuo wei yu fu de ji neng he jing yan ， tong shi wo ye bei yao qing dan ren zhe ge hang hui de hui zhang 。]

english: As the best fisherman in the guild it is my duty to control who has access to the guild and to say who can buy similar skillcapes and the cape can even teleport you right inside the guild.
translation: 作为公会中最好的渔夫，我有责任控制谁有权进入公会，并规定谁可以购买类似的技能披风，而披风甚至可以将你传送到公会内部。 [zuo wei gong hui zhong zui hao de yu fu ， wo you ze ren kong zhi shui you quan jin ru gong hui ， bing gui ding shui ke yi gou mai lei si de ji neng pi feng ， er pi feng shen zhi ke yi jiang ni chuan song dao gong hui nei bu 。]

english: I'm happy to say that being such a fine fisher yourself, I'm happy to offer you the opportunity to purchase a fine skillcape just like this one, it can even teleport you right inside the guild. Are you interested? It would cost
translation: 我很高兴地说，作为一名优秀的钓鱼者，我很高兴为您提供购买像这样的优质技能斗篷的机会，它甚至可以将您传送到公会内部。你有兴趣吗？这将花费 [wo hen gao xing di shuo ， zuo wei yi ming you xiu de diao yu zhe ， wo hen gao xing wei nin ti gong gou mai xiang zhe yang de you zhi ji neng dou peng de ji hui ， ta shen zhi ke yi jiang nin chuan song dao gong hui nei bu 。 ni you xing qu ma ？ zhe jiang hua fei]

english: 99000 coins.
Yes, please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 但不幸的是，我身上没有足够的钱。 [dan bu xing de shi ， wo shen shang mei you zu gou de qian 。]

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 好吧，等你回来了就回来见我吧。 [hao ba ， deng ni hui lai le jiu hui lai jian wo ba 。]

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 不幸的是，所有技能斗篷都只提供免费兜帽，这是技能升级交易的一部分；买一送一，你懂的。因此，在我向您出售一件之前，您需要释放一些库存空间。 [bu xing de shi ， suo you ji neng dou peng dou zhi ti gong mian fei dou mao ， zhe shi ji neng sheng ji jiao yi de yi bu fen ； mai yi song yi ， ni dong de 。 yin ci ， zai wo xiang nin chu shou yi jian zhi qian ， nin xu yao shi fang yi xie ku cun kong jian 。]

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: 出色的！我的朋友，自豪地穿上那件斗篷。 [chu se de ！ wo de peng you ， zi hao di chuan shang na jian dou peng 。]

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Okay, suit yourself.
translation: 好吧，适合你自己。 [hao ba ， shi he ni zi ji 。]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Well met! Are you interested in hearing about the art of smithing?
translation: 好遇见！您有兴趣了解锻造艺术吗？ [hao yu jian ！ nin you xing qu liao jie duan zao yi shu ma ？]

english: How can I train my smithing?
translation: 我该如何训练我的锻造？ [wo gai ru he xun lian wo de duan zao ？]

english: To be able to smith anything, you're going to need one of these beauties.
translation: 为了能够锻造任何东西，你将需要这些美女之一。 [wei le neng gou duan zao ren he dong xi ， ni jiang xu yao zhe xie mei nv zhi yi 。]

english: I see you already have a hammer. Nice one.
translation: 我看到你已经有锤子了。好一个。 [wo kan dao ni yi jing you chui zi le 。 hao yi ge 。]

english: You're going to need to get your hand on some metal bars. You could do this by mining your own ores and smelting them at a furnace.
translation: 你需要把手放在一些金属棒上。您可以通过开采自己的矿石并在熔炉中熔炼它们来做到这一点。 [ni xu yao ba shou fang zai yi xie jin shu bang shang 。 nin ke yi tong guo kai cai zi ji de kuang shi bing zai rong lu zhong rong lian ta men lai zuo dao zhe yi dian 。]

english: There is a furnace located in Lumbridge, just north of the castle opposite the general store.
translation: 朗布里奇有一个熔炉，位于城堡北面，杂货店对面。 [lang bu li qi you yi ge rong lu ， wei yu cheng bao bei mian ， za huo dian dui mian 。]

english: If you are looking for some ore, there is a mine east of Varrock. There you can find some copper and tin ore. Don't forget to bring a pickaxe.
translation: 如果您正在寻找矿石，瓦罗克以东有一个矿场。在那里你可以找到一些铜矿和锡矿。别忘了带镐。 [ru guo nin zheng zai xun zhao kuang shi ， wa luo ke yi dong you yi ge kuang chang 。 zai na li ni ke yi zhao dao yi xie tong kuang he xi kuang 。 bie wang le dai gao 。]

english: When you have your bars, bring them to an anvil to open the smithing interface. If the item name is in black, this means you do not have the level to smith the item.
translation: 当您拥有金属棒后，将它们放在铁砧上以打开锻造界面。如果物品名称为黑色，则表示您没有锻造该物品的等级。 [dang nin yong you jin shu bang hou ， jiang ta men fang zai tie zhen shang yi da kai duan zao jie mian 。 ru guo wu pin ming cheng wei hei se ， ze biao shi nin mei you duan zao gai wu pin de deng ji 。]

english: If the item name is in white, this means you do have the level to smith the item. You will see the bars required to smith the item underneath the name of the item.
translation: 如果物品名称是白色的，这意味着你确实有锻造该物品的等级。您将在物品名称下方看到锻造物品所需的栏。 [ru guo wu pin ming cheng shi bai se de ， zhe yi wei zhe ni que shi you duan zao gai wu pin de deng ji 。 nin jiang zai wu pin ming cheng xia fang kan dao duan zao wu pin suo xu de lan 。]

english: If the number of bars is in orange, this means you do not have enough bars to smith the item. If it is in green, this means you have enough bars for the item.
translation: 如果金条数量为橙色，则意味着您没有足够的金条来锻造该物品。如果它是绿色的，这意味着您有足够的栏来容纳该项目。 [ru guo jin tiao shu liang wei cheng se ， ze yi wei zhe nin mei you zu gou de jin tiao lai duan zao gai wu pin 。 ru guo ta shi lv se de ， zhe yi wei zhe nin you zu gou de lan lai rong na gai xiang mu 。]

english: Thanks for the advice.
translation: 谢谢你的建议。 [xie xie ni de jian yi 。]

english: Is there anything else you would like to know?
translation: 您还有什么想知道的吗？ [nin hai you shen me xiang zhi dao de ma ？]

english: You might find it beneficial to keep a nice stack of bars in your bank before you start smithing. Unless you like to jump from task to task of course.
translation: 您可能会发现，在开始锻造之前，在银行中保留一堆金条是有好处的。当然，除非你喜欢从一个任务跳到另一个任务。 [nin ke neng hui fa xian ， zai kai shi duan zao zhi qian ， zai yin hang zhong bao liu yi dui jin tiao shi you hao chu de 。 dang ran ， chu fei ni xi huan cong yi ge ren wu tiao dao ling yi ge ren wu 。]

english: If you want to smith something that you may not have the level for, you could try gaining some temporary knowledge in smithing from a boost.
translation: 如果你想锻造一些你可能没有等级的东西，你可以尝试通过提升获得一些锻造方面的临时知识。 [ru guo ni xiang duan zao yi xie ni ke neng mei you deng ji de dong xi ， ni ke yi chang shi tong guo ti sheng huo de yi xie duan zao fang mian de lin shi zhi shi 。]

english: You can buy a Dwarven stout at the Rising Sun Inn in Falador.
translation: 您可以在法拉多的旭日旅馆购买矮人黑啤酒。 [nin ke yi zai fa la duo de xu ri lv guan gou mai ai ren hei pi jiu 。]

english: If you are looking for a quest, you should talk to the squire in the courtyard of the white knight's castle. He is looking for a bit of help with something. I would recommend you be a little experienced with combat
translation: 如果你正在寻找任务，你应该与白骑士城堡庭院中的乡绅交谈。他正在寻求一些帮助。我建议你有一点战斗经验 [ru guo ni zheng zai xun zhao ren wu ， ni ying gai yu bai qi shi cheng bao ting yuan zhong de xiang shen jiao tan 。 ta zheng zai xun qiu yi xie bang zhu 。 wo jian yi ni you yi dian zhan dou jing yan]

english: though.
translation: 尽管。 [jin guan 。]

english: Cor blimey, I don't think there is anything I can teach you, but I'll do my best.
translation: 天哪，我不认为我能教你什么，但我会尽力而为。 [tian na ， wo bu ren wei wo neng jiao ni shen me ， dan wo hui jin li er wei 。]

english: As you get better you'll find you will be able to smith Mithril and eventually Adamantite and even Runite. This can be very lucrative but very expensive on the coal front.
translation: 当你变得更好时，你会发现你将能够锻造秘银，最终能够锻造精金，甚至符文。这可能非常有利可图，但在煤炭方面却非常昂贵。 [dang ni bian de geng hao shi ， ni hui fa xian ni jiang neng gou duan zao mi yin ， zui zhong neng gou duan zao jing jin ， shen zhi fu wen 。 zhe ke neng fei chang you li ke tu ， dan zai mei tan fang mian que fei chang ang gui 。]

english: It may be worth you stockpiling coal for a while before attempting these difficult metals or even sticking to good old reliable iron by the bucket load.
translation: 在尝试这些难加工的金属之前，您可能值得先储存一段时间的煤炭，甚至坚持使用桶装的优质老式可靠的铁。 [zai chang shi zhe xie nan jia gong de jin shu zhi qian ， nin ke neng zhi de xian chu cun yi duan shi jian de mei tan ， shen zhi jian chi shi yong tong zhuang de you zhi lao shi ke kao de tie 。]

english: If you want to stop yourself from failing to smith iron, I suggest purchasing some rings of forging. Be aware that they will break after a certain number of bars are smelted.
translation: 如果你想阻止自己锻造铁失败，我建议购买一些锻造戒指。请注意，在熔炼一定数量的金条后，它们会破裂。 [ru guo ni xiang zu zhi zi ji duan zao tie shi bai ， wo jian yi gou mai yi xie duan zao jie zhi 。 qing zhu yi ， zai rong lian yi ding shu liang de jin tiao hou ， ta men hui po lie 。]

english: If you want to save on coal, you could try smithing your bars over at the Blast Furnace in Keldagrim.
translation: 如果你想节省煤炭，你可以尝试在凯尔达格林的高炉里锻造你的金条。 [ru guo ni xiang jie sheng mei tan ， ni ke yi chang shi zai kai er da ge lin de gao lu li duan zao ni de jin tiao 。]

english: If you are looking for something more interesting to smith, you could talk to Otto Godblessed about smithing hastae.
translation: 如果您正在寻找对锻造更感兴趣的东西，您可以与奥托·上帝保佑谈论锻造哈斯塔。 [ru guo nin zheng zai xun zhao dui duan zao geng gan xing qu de dong xi ， nin ke yi yu ao tuo · shang di bao you tan lun duan zao ha si ta 。]

english: Though he may ask you to complete some tasks for him. You can find him south of the barbarian outpost and west of the whirlpool.
translation: 尽管他可能会要求你为他完成一些任务。你可以在野蛮人前哨站以南、漩涡以西找到他。 [jin guan ta ke neng hui yao qiu ni wei ta wan cheng yi xie ren wu 。 ni ke yi zai ye man ren qian shao zhan yi nan 、 xuan wo yi xi zhao dao ta 。]

english: What kind of things can I smith?
translation: 我可以锻造什么样的东西？ [wo ke yi duan zao shen me yang de dong xi ？]

english: There are many things you can make, from weapons to your good old fashioned armour.
translation: 你可以制作很多东西，从武器到老式盔甲。 [ni ke yi zhi zuo hen duo dong xi ， cong wu qi dao lao shi kui jia 。]

english: Weapons are the cheapest to smith. They range from a measly one bar, all the way to three bars.
translation: 武器是锻造最便宜的。它们的范围从区区一格一直到三格。 [wu qi shi duan zao zui pian yi de 。 ta men de fan wei cong qu qu yi ge yi zhi dao san ge 。]

english: Armour can be the costliest item to smith, the cost of each item ranges from a measly one bar all the way up to a whopping five bars.
translation: 盔甲可能是锻造成本最高的物品，每件物品的成本从区区一格一直到高达五格不等。 [kui jia ke neng shi duan zao cheng ben zui gao de wu pin ， mei jian wu pin de cheng ben cong qu qu yi ge yi zhi dao gao da wu ge bu deng 。]

english: Some weapons and armour, such as darts, will require you to have gained knowledge on how to smith them. This is due to the complex nature of the weapon.
translation: 有些武器和盔甲，例如飞镖，需要您掌握如何锻造它们的知识。这是由于武器的复杂性。 [you xie wu qi he kui jia ， li ru fei biao ， xu yao nin zhang wo ru he duan zao ta men de zhi shi 。 zhe shi you yu wu qi de fu za xing 。]

english: You might find that other items don't require conventional bars you would gather. Some may require you to piece blades back together or even infuse a crystal into a piece of armour.
translation: 您可能会发现其他物品不需要您收集的传统金条。有些可能需要你将刀片重新组装在一起，甚至将水晶注入一件盔甲中。 [nin ke neng hui fa xian qi ta wu pin bu xu yao nin shou ji de chuan tong jin tiao 。 you xie ke neng xu yao ni jiang dao pian chong xin zu zhuang zai yi qi ， shen zhi jiang shui jing zhu ru yi jian kui jia zhong 。]

english: Is there anything else you want to know?
translation: 您还有什么想知道的吗？ [nin hai you shen me xiang zhi dao de ma ？]

english: Not right now, thank you.
translation: 现在不行，谢谢。 [xian zai bu xing ， xie xie 。]

english: Well, just come back any time you want to know anything!
translation: 好吧，你想知道什么就随时回来吧！ [hao ba ， ni xiang zhi dao shen me jiu sui shi hui lai ba ！]

english: How can I train my smithing?
translation: 我该如何训练我的锻造？ [wo gai ru he xun lian wo de duan zao ？]

english: What kind of things can I smith?
translation: 我可以锻造什么样的东西？ [wo ke yi duan zao shen me yang de dong xi ？]

english: Not right now, thank you.
translation: 现在不行，谢谢。 [xian zai bu xing ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello. Are you Josef's replacement?
translation: 你好。你是约瑟夫的替代者吗？ [ni hao 。 ni shi yue se fu de ti dai zhe ma ？]

english: Yes, I suppose I am.
translation: 是的，我想我是。 [shi de ， wo xiang wo shi 。]

english: It just goes to show how little Denath values us.
translation: 这只是表明德纳斯有多么不重视我们。 [zhe zhi shi biao ming de na si you duo me bu zhong shi wo men 。]

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你是什​​么意思？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: Denath told us we would learn the secrets of demonic magic, but all we've done is memorize one incantation. And now he replaces poor Josef with the next person who comes along!
translation: 德纳斯告诉我们，我们会学习恶魔魔法的秘密，但我们所做的只是记住一个咒语。现在他用下一个出现的人取代了可怜的约瑟夫！ [de na si gao su wo men ， wo men hui xue xi e mo mo fa de mi mi ， dan wo men suo zuo de zhi shi ji zhu yi ge zhou yu 。 xian zai ta yong xia yi ge chu xian de ren qu dai le ke lian de yue se fu ！]

english: Do you have the demonic sigil mould?
translation: 你有恶魔印记模具吗？ [ni you e mo yin ji mu ju ma ？]

english: No, I think Jennifer has it.
translation: 不，我认为詹妮弗有。 [bu ， wo ren wei zhan ni fu you 。]

english: Do you know what happened to Josef?
translation: 你知道约瑟夫出了什么事吗？ [ni zhi dao yue se fu chu le shen me shi ma ？]

english: Shh! Listen, Denath doesn't know this...
translation: 嘘！听着，德纳斯不知道这个…… [xu ！ ting zhe ， de na si bu zhi dao zhe ge ……]

english: When we joined him, Denath told us we were going to learn all the secrets of demonic magic, but we still don't know anything.
translation: 当我们加入他时，德纳斯告诉我们我们将学习恶魔魔法的所有秘密，但我们仍然一无所知。 [dang wo men jia ru ta shi ， de na si gao su wo men wo men jiang xue xi e mo mo fa de suo you mi mi ， dan wo men reng ran yi wu suo zhi 。]

english: The others, they just think they're terribly evil, with their sigils and the incantation they learned by rote. But Josef and I wanted more - we wanted to know how it worked.
translation: 其他人，他们只是认为自己是非常邪恶的，他们的印记和咒语都是死记硬背的。但约瑟夫和我想要更多——我们想知道它是如何运作的。 [qi ta ren ， ta men zhi shi ren wei zi ji shi fei chang xie e de ， ta men de yin ji he zhou yu dou shi si ji ying bei de 。 dan yue se fu he wo xiang yao geng duo —— wo men xiang zhi dao ta shi ru he yun zuo de 。]

english: Josef was more curious than me. Last night, he secretly read a book that Denath was keeping from us. He didn't know I was awake, but I saw what happened.
translation: 约瑟夫比我更好奇。昨晚，他偷偷地读了一本德纳斯瞒着我们的书。他不知道我醒了，但我看到了发生的事情。 [yue se fu bi wo geng hao qi 。 zuo wan ， ta tou tou di du le yi ben de na si man zhe wo men de shu 。 ta bu zhi dao wo xing le ， dan wo kan dao le fa sheng de shi qing 。]

english: I saw him read it, and then his face turned white, and he took the book and ran through the portal.
translation: 我看见他读完了，然后他的脸色就白了，他拿着书就跑进了传送门。 [wo kan jian ta du wan le ， ran hou ta de lian se jiu bai le ， ta na zhe shu jiu pao jin le chuan song men 。]

english: But Denath was waking up, and when he saw Josef was gone he went through the portal to look for him. A bit later Denath returned, without Josef or the book.
translation: 但德纳斯正在醒来，当他看到约瑟夫不见了时，他穿过传送门去找他。过了一会儿，德纳斯回来了，没有带约瑟夫，也没有带书。 [dan de na si zheng zai xing lai ， dang ta kan dao yue se fu bu jian le shi ， ta chuan guo chuan song men qu zhao ta 。 guo le yi hui er ， de na si hui lai le ， mei you dai yue se fu ， ye mei you dai shu 。]

english: Josef didn't have money for the magic carpet, and he can't have got far in the desert at night with that heavy book.
translation: 约瑟夫没有钱买魔毯，而且他带着那本厚重的书在晚上不可能在沙漠里走多远。 [yue se fu mei you qian mai mo tan ， er qie ta dai zhe na ben hou zhong de shu zai wan shang bu ke neng zai sha mo li zou duo yuan 。]

english: Josef must have hidden the book somewhere in the ruins, before Denath followed him. If you could find it, we'd know what it was that frightened him. We'd know what Denath is really up to!
translation: 在德纳斯跟踪他之前，约瑟夫一定把这本书藏在了废墟的某个地方。如果你能找到它，我们就会知道是什么让他害怕了。我们会知道德纳斯到底在做什么！ [zai de na si gen zong ta zhi qian ， yue se fu yi ding ba zhe ben shu cang zai le fei xu de mou ge di fang 。 ru guo ni neng zhao dao ta ， wo men jiu hui zhi dao shi shen me rang ta hai pa le 。 wo men hui zhi dao de na si dao di zai zuo shen me ！]

english: Did you find that book?
translation: 你找到那本书了吗？ [ni zhao dao na ben shu le ma ？]

english: I really want to know what's in it. I think Denath is hiding something from us, but we won't know what unless we read that book!
translation: 我真的很想知道里面有什么。我认为德纳斯向我们隐瞒了一些事情，但除非我们读那本书，否则我们不会知道什么！ [wo zhen de hen xiang zhi dao li mian you shen me 。 wo ren wei de na si xiang wo men yin man le yi xie shi qing ， dan chu fei wo men du na ben shu ， fou ze wo men bu hui zhi dao shen me ！]

english: Yes. The golem saw Josef hide it in one of the broken kilns in the city.
translation: 是的。傀儡看到约瑟夫把它藏在城里一个破烂的窑炉里。 [shi de 。 kui lei kan dao yue se fu ba ta cang zai cheng li yi ge po lan de yao lu li 。]

english: Did the golem see what happened to Josef?
translation: 魔像看到约瑟夫的遭遇了吗？ [mo xiang kan dao yue se fu de zao yu le ma ？]

english: It said Denath killed him.
translation: 据说德纳斯杀了他。 [ju shuo de na si sha le ta 。]

english: Oh no!
translation: 哦不！ [o bu ！]

english: I knew Denath was a dark wizard but I didn't think he'd kill one of his disciples.
translation: 我知道德纳斯是一名黑巫师，但我不认为他会杀死他的一个弟子。 [wo zhi dao de na si shi yi ming hei wu shi ， dan wo bu ren wei ta hui sha si ta de yi ge di zi 。]

english: Let me look at the book then.
translation: 那我看看书吧。 [na wo kan kan shu ba 。]

english: I don't understand. What's in here that Denath thought was worth killing over? Josef must have worked something out - but what?
translation: 我不明白。德纳斯认为这里有什么值得杀死？约瑟夫一定想出了一些办法——但是什么办法呢？ [wo bu ming bai 。 de na si ren wei zhe li you shen me zhi de sha si ？ yue se fu yi ding xiang chu le yi xie ban fa —— dan shi shen me ban fa ne ？]

english: But look at the incantation in the book. The words are in the reverse order to the order that Denath taught us.
translation: 但看书上的咒语。这些单词的顺序与德纳斯教我们的顺序相反。 [dan kan shu shang de zhou yu 。 zhe xie dan ci de shun xu yu de na si jiao wo men de shun xu xiang fan 。]

english: The incantation in the book is backwards?
translation: 书上的咒语是反的吗？ [shu shang de zhou yu shi fan de ma ？]

english: More likely the book has the correct incantation and the one Denath taught us was backwards. But what does that mean?
translation: 更有可能的是，这本书里有正确的咒语，而德纳斯教给我们的咒语是倒过来的。但这意味着什么？ [geng you ke neng de shi ， zhe ben shu li you zheng que de zhou yu ， er de na si jiao gei wo men de zhou yu shi dao guo lai de 。 dan zhe yi wei zhe shen me ？]

english: Player, I'm not happy about this ritual. I don't think Agrith-Naar is going to grant all our wishes, I think he's going to kill us all. But if I try to stop it, Denath will kill me like he did Josef!
translation: 玩家，我对这个仪式并不满意。我不认为阿格里斯-纳尔会满足我们所有的愿望，我认为他会杀掉我们所有人。但如果我试图阻止它，德纳斯就会杀了我，就像他杀了约瑟夫一样！ [wan jia ， wo dui zhe ge yi shi bing bu man yi 。 wo bu ren wei a ge li si - na er hui man zu wo men suo you de yuan wang ， wo ren wei ta hui sha diao wo men suo you ren 。 dan ru guo wo shi tu zu zhi ta ， de na si jiu hui sha le wo ， jiu xiang ta sha le yue se fu yi yang ！]

english: Don't worry. I'm here to kill the demon!
translation: 不用担心。我是来杀恶魔的！ [bu yong dan xin 。 wo shi lai sha e mo de ！]

english: This is the demon-slaying sword Silverlight, the only weapon that can kill Agrith-Naar!
translation: 这就是斩妖剑银光，唯一能够杀死阿格里斯纳尔的武器！ [zhe jiu shi zhan yao jian yin guang ， wei yi neng gou sha si a ge li si na er de wu qi ！]

english: Thank goodness! I think Denath is nearly ready for the ritual. We must prepare!
translation: 谢天谢地！我认为德纳斯已经为仪式做好了准备。我们必须做好准备！ [xie tian xie di ！ wo ren wei de na si yi jing wei yi shi zuo hao le zhun bei 。 wo men bi xu zuo hao zhun bei ！]

english: Oh my gods!
translation: 天哪！ [tian na ！]

english: He disappeared!
translation: 他消失了！ [ta xiao shi le ！]

english: Where'd he go?
translation: 他去哪儿了？ [ta qu na er le ？]

english: Of course! How could we be so stupid?
translation: 当然！我们怎么可以这么蠢呢？ [dang ran ！ wo men zen me ke yi zhe me chun ne ？]

english: What happened?
translation: 发生了什么？ [fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: What do you get when you perform a summoning ritual backwards?
translation: 当你反向进行召唤仪式时你会得到什么？ [dang ni fan xiang jin xing zhao huan yi shi shi ni hui de dao shen me ？]

english: Denath was Agrith-Naar all along! We've just helped him return to his own dimension!
translation: 德纳斯一直都是阿格里斯-纳尔！我们刚刚帮助他回到了自己的维度！ [de na si yi zhi dou shi a ge li si - na er ！ wo men gang gang bang zhu ta hui dao le zi ji de wei du ！]

english: What was that?!
translation: 那是什么？ [na shi shen me ？]

english: Look! The portal's closing!
translation: 看！门户关闭了！ [kan ！ men hu guan bi le ！]

english: I'm getting out of here!
translation: 我要离开这里！ [wo yao li kai zhe li ！]

english: No, don't leave!
translation: 不，不要离开！ [bu ， bu yao li kai ！]

english: Who knows what Denath could do now?
translation: 谁知道德纳斯现在能做什么？ [shui zhi dao de na si xian zai neng zuo shen me ？]

english: We've got to perform the ritual again so you can kill Agrith-Naar. But we need eight people!
translation: 我们必须再次执行仪式，这样你才能杀死阿格里斯纳尔。但我们需要八个人！ [wo men bi xu zai ci zhi xing yi shi ， zhe yang ni cai neng sha si a ge li si na er 。 dan wo men xu yao ba ge ren ！]

english: Quick, Player, you've got to get those three to come back! And you'd better take Denath's sigil and find one more person to help.
translation: 快点，玩家，你必须让那三个人回来！你最好拿走德纳斯的印记，再找一个人来帮忙。 [kuai dian ， wan jia ， ni bi xu rang na san ge ren hui lai ！ ni zui hao na zou de na si de yin ji ， zai zhao yi ge ren lai bang mang 。]

english: We've got to perform the ritual again, forwards this time, so you can kill Agrith-Naar. I'll prepare for it here while you find four more people.
translation: 我们必须再次执行仪式，这次向前推进，这样你就可以杀死阿格里斯-纳尔。当你再找到四个人时，我会在这里做好准备。 [wo men bi xu zai ci zhi xing yi shi ， zhe ci xiang qian tui jin ， zhe yang ni jiu ke yi sha si a ge li si - na er 。 dang ni zai zhao dao si ge ren shi ， wo hui zai zhe li zuo hao zhun bei 。]

english: I don't understand what happened!
translation: 我不明白发生了什么事！ [wo bu ming bai fa sheng le shen me shi ！]

english: Denath must have been Agrith-Naar all along!
translation: 德纳斯一定一直都是阿格里斯-纳尔！ [de na si yi ding yi zhi dou shi a ge li si - na er ！]

english: Ellemar's book said that Agrith-Naar can only use his powerful magics from the demon plane.
translation: 艾勒玛的书中说，阿格里斯-纳尔只能使用来自恶魔位面的强大魔法。 [ai lei ma de shu zhong shuo ， a ge li si - na er zhi neng shi yong lai zi e mo wei mian de qiang da mo fa 。]

english: Ellemar must have trapped him in human form to stop him using his magics. That must be what the last pages of the book said.
translation: 艾勒玛一定是把他困在人类形态中，以阻止他使用魔法。书的最后几页一定是这么说的。 [ai lei ma yi ding shi ba ta kun zai ren lei xing tai zhong ， yi zu zhi ta shi yong mo fa 。 shu de zui hou ji ye yi ding shi zhe me shuo de 。]

english: So the reason he assembled us was to send him back to his own plane, where he would be much more powerful! That's why the ritual was backwards!
translation: 所以他聚集我们的目的就是为了把他送回自己的位面，在那里他会更加强大！这就是为什么仪式是倒退的！ [suo yi ta ju ji wo men de mu di jiu shi wei le ba ta song hui zi ji de wei mian ， zai na li ta hui geng jia qiang da ！ zhe jiu shi wei shen me yi shi shi dao tui de ！]

english: He's already started to close the portal to trap us. Who knows what else he could do?
translation: 他已经开始关闭传送门来困住我们了。谁知道他还能做什么？ [ta yi jing kai shi guan bi chuan song men lai kun zhu wo men le 。 shui zhi dao ta hai neng zuo shen me ？]

english: But if we can perform the ritual forwards then you can kill him using Silverlight and end his evil magics once and for all!
translation: 但如果我们能够向前执行仪式，那么你就可以使用银光杀死他并一劳永逸地结束他的邪恶魔法！ [dan ru guo wo men neng gou xiang qian zhi xing yi shi ， na me ni jiu ke yi shi yong yin guang sha si ta bing yi lao yong yi di jie shu ta de xie e mo fa ！]

english: Okay!
translation: 好的！ [hao de ！]

english: Hurry!
translation: 匆忙！ [cong mang ！]

english: We've got eight people now. Are you ready to summon Agrith-Naar and slay him?
translation: 我们现在有八个人了。你准备好召唤阿格里斯纳尔并杀死他了吗？ [wo men xian zai you ba ge ren le 。 ni zhun bei hao zhao huan a ge li si na er bing sha si ta le ma ？]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Do hurry! We haven't got much time!
translation: 快点吧！我们的时间不多了！ [kuai dian ba ！ wo men de shi jian bu duo le ！]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: *gulp*  Okay, here we go...
translation: *吞咽*好吧，我们开始...... [* tun yan * hao ba ， wo men kai shi ......]

english: Yes, I suppose I am.
translation: 是的，我想我是。 [shi de ， wo xiang wo shi 。]

english: Do you have the demonic sigil mould?
translation: 你有恶魔印记模具吗？ [ni you e mo yin ji mu ju ma ？]

english: Do you know what happened to Josef?
translation: 你知道约瑟夫出了什么事吗？ [ni zhi dao yue se fu chu le shen me shi ma ？]

english: Not yet.
translation: 还没有。 [hai mei you 。]

english: I don't understand what happened!
translation: 我不明白发生了什么事！ [wo bu ming bai fa sheng le shen me shi ！]

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。 [hao de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Greetings. Can I help you at all?
translation: 问候。我可以帮助你吗？ [wen hou 。 wo ke yi bang zhu ni ma ？]

english: Do you have any quests I could do?
translation: 你有什么任务我可以做吗？ [ni you shen me ren wu wo ke yi zuo ma ？]

english: A quest? What a strange notion. Do you normally go around asking complete strangers for quests?
translation: 一个任务？多么奇怪的想法啊。你通常会到处向完全陌生的人询问任务吗？ [yi ge ren wu ？ duo me qi guai de xiang fa a 。 ni tong chang hui dao chu xiang wan quan mo sheng de ren xun wen ren wu ma ？]

english: Er, yes, now you come to mention it.
translation: 呃,对了,现在你就提起来了。 [e , dui le , xian zai ni jiu ti qi lai le 。]

english: Oh, ok then. Well, no, I don't; sorry.
translation: 哦，好吧。嗯，不，我不知道；对不起。 [o ， hao ba 。 n ， bu ， wo bu zhi dao ； dui bu qi 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: A good question; straight and to the point.
translation: 一个好问题；开门见山。 [yi ge hao wen ti ； kai men jian shan 。]

english: My name is Matthias, I am a falconer, and this is where I train my birds.
translation: 我叫马蒂亚斯，是一名驯鹰人，这里是我训练鸟类的地方。 [wo jiao ma di ya si ， shi yi ming xun ying ren ， zhe li shi wo xun lian niao lei de di fang 。]

english: That sounds like fun; could I have a go?
translation: 听起来很有趣；我可以尝试一下吗？ [ting qi lai hen you qu ； wo ke yi chang shi yi xia ma ？]

english: Training falcons is a lot of work and I doubt you're up to the task. However, I suppose I could let you try hunting with one.
translation: 训练猎鹰是一项繁重的工作，我怀疑你是否能胜任这项任务。不过，我想我可以让你尝试用一只狩猎。 [xun lian lie ying shi yi xiang fan zhong de gong zuo ， wo huai yi ni shi fou neng sheng ren zhe xiang ren wu 。 bu guo ， wo xiang wo ke yi rang ni chang shi yong yi zhi shou lie 。]

english: I have some tamer birds that I occasionally lend to rich noblemen who consider it a sufficiently refined sport for their tastes, and you look like the kind who might appreciate a good hunt.
translation: 我有一些比较驯服的鸟，偶尔会借给富有的贵族，他们认为这是一项符合他们口味的精致运动，而你看起来是那种喜欢好好打猎的人。 [wo you yi xie bi jiao xun fu de niao ， ou er hui jie gei fu you de gui zu ， ta men ren wei zhe shi yi xiang fu he ta men kou wei de jing zhi yun dong ， er ni kan qi lai shi na zhong xi huan hao hao da lie de ren 。]

english: I'd have to request a small fee, mind you; how does 500 gold pieces sound?
translation: 请注意，我需要收取少量费用； 500金币听起来怎么样？ [qing zhu yi ， wo xu yao shou qu shao liang fei yong ； 500 jin bi ting qi lai zen me yang ？]

english: I'm afraid I don't have that much with me.
translation: 恐怕我身上没有那么多东西。 [kong pa wo shen shang mei you na me duo dong xi 。]

english: Ok, that seems reasonable.
translation: 好吧，这似乎很合理。 [hao ba ， zhe si hu hen he li 。]

english: Good, however you really need both hands free. I'd suggest that you put away your weapons and gloves before we start.
translation: 很好，但是您确实需要腾出双手。我建议你在我们开始之前收起你的武器和手套。 [hen hao ， dan shi nin que shi xu yao teng chu shuang shou 。 wo jian yi ni zai wo men kai shi zhi qian shou qi ni de wu qi he shou tao 。]

english: Good, however you really need both hands free. I'd suggest that you take off some of that kit you're wearing before we start.
translation: 很好，但是您确实需要腾出双手。我建议你在开始之前脱掉一些你所穿的装备。 [hen hao ， dan shi nin que shi xu yao teng chu shuang shou 。 wo jian yi ni zai kai shi zhi qian tuo diao yi xie ni suo chuan de zhuang bei 。]

english: The falconer gives you a large leather glove and brings one of the smaller birds over to land on it.
translation: 驯鹰人会给你一只大皮手套，并把一只较小的鸟带到上面降落。 [xun ying ren hui gei ni yi zhi da pi shou tao ， bing ba yi zhi jiao xiao de niao dai dao shang mian jiang luo 。]

english: Don't worry; I'll keep an eye on you to make sure you don't upset it too much.
translation: 不用担心;我会留意你，确保你不会太难过。 [bu yong dan xin ; wo hui liu yi ni ， que bao ni bu hui tai nan guo 。]

english: I'm not interested then, thanks.
translation: 那我就没兴趣了，谢谢。 [na wo jiu mei xing qu le ， xie xie 。]

english: Well, you're welcome to come back if you change your mind.
translation: 好吧，如果你改变主意，欢迎你回来。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， huan ying ni hui lai 。]

english: Absolutely, are you ready?
translation: 绝对可以，你准备好了吗？ [jue dui ke yi ， ni zhun bei hao le ma ？]

english: I am!
translation: 我是！ [wo shi ！]

english: That doesn't sound like my sort of thing.
translation: 这听起来不像我的风格。 [zhe ting qi lai bu xiang wo de feng ge 。]

english: Fair enough; it does require a great deal of patience and skill, so I can understand if you might feel intimidated.
translation: 很公平;它确实需要很大的耐心和技巧，所以我可以理解您是否会感到害怕。 [hen gong ping ; ta que shi xu yao hen da de nai xin he ji qiao ， suo yi wo ke yi li jie nin shi fou hui gan dao hai pa 。]

english: What's this falconry thing all about then?
translation: 那么猎鹰到底是怎么回事呢？ [na me lie ying dao di shi zen me hui shi ne ？]

english: Well, some people see it as a sport, although such a term does not really convey the amount of patience and dedication required to be proficient at the task.
translation: 好吧，有些人将其视为一项运动，尽管这个术语并不能真正表达精通这项任务所需的耐心和奉献精神。 [hao ba ， you xie ren jiang qi shi wei yi xiang yun dong ， jin guan zhe ge shu yu bing bu neng zhen zheng biao da jing tong zhe xiang ren wu suo xu de nai xin he feng xian jing shen 。]

english: Putting it simply, it is the training and use of birds of prey in hunting quarry.
translation: 简单来说，就是在狩猎场中训练和使用猛禽。 [jian dan lai shuo ， jiu shi zai shou lie chang zhong xun lian he shi yong meng qin 。]

english: So it's like keeping a pet then?
translation: 那么这就像养宠物一样吗？ [na me zhe jiu xiang yang chong wu yi yang ma ？]

english: Not exactly, no. Such a bird can never really be considered tame in the same way that a dog can.
translation: 不完全是，不。这样的鸟永远不能像狗一样被认为是驯服的。 [bu wan quan shi ， bu 。 zhe yang de niao yong yuan bu neng xiang gou yi yang bei ren wei shi xun fu de 。]

english: They can be trained to associate people or places with food though, and, as such, a good falconer can get a trained bird to do as he wishes.
translation: 不过，它们可以接受训练，将人或地方与食物联系起来，因此，一个好的猎鹰人可以让训练有素的鸟做他想做的事。 [bu guo ， ta men ke yi jie shou xun lian ， jiang ren huo di fang yu shi wu lian xi qi lai ， yin ci ， yi ge hao de lie ying ren ke yi rang xun lian you su de niao zuo ta xiang zuo de shi 。]

english: Could I have a go with your bird?
translation: 我可以和你的鸟一起玩吗？ [wo ke yi he ni de niao yi qi wan ma ？]

english: Could I invest in your setup here?
translation: 我可以在这里投资你的设置吗？ [wo ke yi zai zhe li tou zi ni de she zhi ma ？]

english: If you'd like to put money forward for training more falcons, be my guest!
translation: 如果您想捐钱来训练更多猎鹰，请成为我的客人！ [ru guo nin xiang juan qian lai xun lian geng duo lie ying ， qing cheng wei wo de ke ren ！]

english: Would I get any benefit from this?
translation: 我能从中得到什么好处吗？ [wo neng cong zhong de dao shen me hao chu ma ？]

english: I suppose I could let you use my falcons for free if you stump up enough cash. How does 500,000 coins sound?
translation: 我想如果你掏出足够的现金我可以让你免费使用我的猎鹰。 500,000枚硬币听起来怎么样？ [wo xiang ru guo ni tao chu zu gou de xian jin wo ke yi rang ni mian fei shi yong wo de lie ying 。 500,000 mei ying bi ting qi lai zen me yang ？]

english: Ah, I don't have that much on me right now.
translation: 啊，我现在没有那么多。 [a ， wo xian zai mei you na me duo 。]

english: Hmm, that seems a little steep. I'll think on it.
translation: 嗯，看起来有点陡。我会考虑一下。 [n ， kan qi lai you dian dou 。 wo hui kao lv yi xia 。]

english: I appreciate that you want to invest more, but I really don't need it right now!
translation: 我很欣赏你想要更多的投资，但我现在真的不需要！ [wo hen xin shang ni xiang yao geng duo de tou zi ， dan wo xian zai zhen de bu xu yao ！]

english: Hello again.
translation: 又好。 [you hao 。]

english: Ah, you're back. How are you getting along with [him/her] then?
translation: 啊，你回来了。那你和[他/她]相处得怎么样？ [a ， ni hui lai le 。 na ni he [ ta / ta ] xiang chu de zen me yang ？]

english: It's certainly harder than it looks.
translation: 这肯定比看起来更难。 [zhe ken ding bi kan qi lai geng nan 。]

english: Sorry, but I was talking to the falcon, not you. But yes it is; have you had enough yet?
translation: 抱歉，我是在和猎鹰说话，不是在和你说话。但确实如此；你玩够了吗？ [bao qian ， wo shi zai he lie ying shuo hua ， bu shi zai he ni shuo hua 。 dan que shi ru ci ； ni wan gou le ma ？]

english: Actually, I'd like to keep trying a little longer.
translation: 其实我还想再努力一段时间。 [qi shi wo hai xiang zai nu li yi duan shi jian 。]

english: Ok then, just come talk to me when you're done.
translation: 好吧，等你忙完了再跟我说话。 [hao ba ， deng ni mang wan le zai gen wo shuo hua 。]

english: I think I'll leave it for now.
translation: 我想我现在就先把它放下吧。 [wo xiang wo xian zai jiu xian ba ta fang xia ba 。]

english: You give the falcon and glove back to Matthias.
translation: 你把猎鹰和手套还给马蒂亚斯。 [ni ba lie ying he shou tao huan gei ma di ya si 。]

english: Do you have any quests I could do?
translation: 你有什么任务我可以做吗？ [ni you shen me ren wu wo ke yi zuo ma ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: That sounds like fun; could I have a go?
translation: 听起来很有趣；我可以尝试一下吗？ [ting qi lai hen you qu ； wo ke yi chang shi yi xia ma ？]

english: Ok, that seems reasonable.

translation: 那我就没兴趣了，谢谢。 [na wo jiu mei xing qu le ， xie xie 。]

english: That doesn't sound like my sort of thing.
translation: 这听起来不像我的风格。 [zhe ting qi lai bu xiang wo de feng ge 。]

english: What's this falconry thing all about then?
translation: 那么猎鹰到底是怎么回事呢？ [na me lie ying dao di shi zen me hui shi ne ？]

english: Could I have a go with your bird?
translation: 我可以和你的鸟一起玩吗？ [wo ke yi he ni de niao yi qi wan ma ？]

english: Could I invest in your setup here?
translation: 我可以在这里投资你的设置吗？ [wo ke yi zai zhe li tou zi ni de she zhi ma ？]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Actually, I'd like to keep trying a little longer.
translation: 其实我还想再努力一段时间。 [qi shi wo hai xiang zai nu li yi duan shi jian 。]

english: I think I'll leave it for now.
translation: 我想我现在就先把它放下吧。 [wo xiang wo xian zai jiu xian ba ta fang xia ba 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hmm, yes... Hello!
translation: 嗯，是的...您好！ [n ， shi de ... nin hao ！]

english: ...Are you busy?
translation: ...你忙吗？ [... ni mang ma ？]

english: Oh umm, no and yes. I'm forever observing, you see.
translation: 哦，嗯，​​不，是的。我一直在观察，你看。 [o ， n ，​​ bu ， shi de 。 wo yi zhi zai guan cha ， ni kan 。]

english: Observing what?
translation: 观察什么？ [guan cha shen me ？]

english: Oh, erm, birds! Yes, those feathery little flittery things.
translation: 哦，呃，鸟儿！是的，那些羽毛般的小东西。 [o ， e ， niao er ！ shi de ， na xie yu mao ban de xiao dong xi 。]

english: Yes, I know what a bird is.
translation: 是的，我知道什么是鸟。 [shi de ， wo zhi dao shen me shi niao 。]

english: Do you though? The subtleties between different species of birds is quite incredible, you see-
translation: 你有吗？不同种类的鸟类之间的微妙之处是相当令人难以置信的，你看—— [ni you ma ？ bu tong zhong lei de niao lei zhi jian de wei miao zhi chu shi xiang dang ling ren nan yi zhi xin de ， ni kan ——]

english: But how could I attract them? Y'know, so I could observe them a little closer.
translation: 但我怎样才能吸引他们呢？你知道，这样我就可以更近地观察他们。 [dan wo zen yang cai neng xi yin ta men ne ？ ni zhi dao ， zhe yang wo jiu ke yi geng jin di guan cha ta men 。]

english: Ah yes, well, of course! I've travelled around this island and found the best spots for bird watching. I placed a ring of stones at these locations!
translation: 啊，是的，当然！我环游这个岛并找到了最佳观鸟地点。我在这些位置放了一圈石头！ [a ， shi de ， dang ran ！ wo huan you zhe ge dao bing zhao dao le zui jia guan niao di dian 。 wo zai zhe xie wei zhi fang le yi quan shi tou ！]

english: So those would be the best locations to place my traps...
translation: 所以那些将是放置我的陷阱的最佳位置...... [suo yi na xie jiang shi fang zhi wo de xian jing de zui jia wei zhi ......]

english: Traps?! Preposterous! These fine exotic Birds are to be watched and not harmed in any way!
translation: 陷阱？！荒谬！这些精美的奇异鸟类值得观赏，不要以任何方式受到伤害！ [xian jing ？！ huang miu ！ zhe xie jing mei de qi yi niao lei zhi de guan shang ， bu yao yi ren he fang shi shou dao shang hai ！]

english: Did I say traps? Oh, I meant, umm, feeding them! Yes! I could feed them.
translation: 我有说陷阱吗？哦，我的意思是，嗯，喂它们！是的！我可以喂它们。 [wo you shuo xian jing ma ？ o ， wo de yi si shi ， n ， wei ta men ！ shi de ！ wo ke yi wei ta men 。]

english: You should not interfere with the birds, just watch, no feeding them anything! Not even seeds!
translation: 你不应该干扰鸟儿，只是观察，不要给它们喂任何东西！连种子都没有！ [ni bu ying gai gan rao niao er ， zhi shi guan cha ， bu yao gei ta men wei ren he dong xi ！ lian zhong zi dou mei you ！]

english: Seeds you say...
translation: 你说的种子... [ni shuo de zhong zi ...]

english: You seem a little, twitchy...
translation: 你看起来有点紧张，有点紧张…… [ni kan qi lai you dian jin zhang ， you dian jin zhang ……]

english: Yes, well, perhaps a bit! There are new exotic birds everywhere on this island! I guess I'm getting a little over-excited.
translation: 是的，好吧，也许有一点！这个岛上到处都有新的奇异鸟类！我想我有点过于兴奋了。 [shi de ， hao ba ， ye xu you yi dian ！ zhe ge dao shang dao chu dou you xin de qi yi niao lei ！ wo xiang wo you dian guo yu xing fen le 。]

english: Yeah, there sure are a lot of birds... For now.
translation: 是的，确实有很多鸟......现在。 [shi de ， que shi you hen duo niao ...... xian zai 。]

english: It's my fathers fault entirely, constantly talking about falconry...
translation: 完全是我父亲的错，总是谈论猎鹰…… [wan quan shi wo fu qin de cuo ， zong shi tan lun lie ying ……]

english: Your father is a hunter? Does he know anything about hunting birds?
translation: 你父亲是猎人？他知道打鸟的事吗？ [ni fu qin shi lie ren ？ ta zhi dao da niao de shi ma ？]

english: Umm, well of course, falcons ARE hunting birds, they mostly catch varying types of kebbits, it's rather mundane.
translation: 嗯，当然，猎鹰是猎鸟，它们主要捕捉不同类型的烤肉串，这是相当平凡的。 [n ， dang ran ， lie ying shi lie niao ， ta men zhu yao bu zhuo bu tong lei xing de kao rou chuan ， zhe shi xiang dang ping fan de 。]

english: And mice?

english: Hmmm...
Goodbye.

english: ...Oh, you're still here. What was that? Oh yes, bye for now!
translation: ……哦，你还在这里。那是什么？哦，是的，现在再见了！ […… o ， ni hai zai zhe li 。 na shi shen me ？ o ， shi de ， xian zai zai jian le ！]

translation: 观察什么？ [guan cha shen me ？]

translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: I am proud that the helm of my ancestors will be worn in battle. I thank you on behalf of all my kinsmen, [Fremennik name].
translation: 我为我祖先的头盔将在战斗中佩戴而感到自豪。我代表我所有的亲戚[弗雷曼尼克名字]感谢你们。 [wo wei wo zu xian de tou kui jiang zai zhan dou zhong pei dai er gan dao zi hao 。 wo dai biao wo suo you de qin qi [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ] gan xie ni men 。]

english: I thank you again for presenting me with such a helm.
translation: 我再次感谢您为我提供了这样一个掌舵者。 [wo zai ci gan xie nin wei wo ti gong le zhe yang yi ge zhang duo zhe 。]

english: Have you got any more of those helms?
translation: 你还有那些头盔吗？ [ni hai you na xie tou kui ma ？]

english: What, the priceless heirloom that I gave to you as a sign of my trust and gratitude?
translation: 什么，我送给你的无价传家宝，以表示我的信任和感激？ [shen me ， wo song gei ni de wu jia chuan jia bao ， yi biao shi wo de xin ren he gan ji ？]

english: Err yes, that one. I may have mislaid it.
translation: 呃，是的，就是那个。我可能把它放错地方了。 [e ， shi de ， jiu shi na ge 。 wo ke neng ba ta fang cuo di fang le 。]

english: It's a good job I have alert and loyal men who notice when such a precious item is left laying around, and who pick it up.
translation: 这是一份好工作，我有警觉而忠诚的人，他们会注意到如此珍贵的物品被留在周围，并把它捡起来。 [zhe shi yi fen hao gong zuo ， wo you jing jue er zhong cheng de ren ， ta men hui zhu yi dao ru ci zhen gui de wu pin bei liu zai zhou wei ， bing ba ta jian qi lai 。]

english: I'm afraid I'm going to have to charge you a 50,000 coin handling cost.
translation: 恐怕我得向你收取 50,000 枚硬币的手续费。 [kong pa wo de xiang ni shou qu  50,000  mei ying bi de shou xu fei 。]

english: Well, yes, I do. But I'm going to have to charge you 50,000 coins - these are precious, you know!
translation: 嗯，是的，我愿意。但我要向你收取 50,000 个硬币 - 这些都很珍贵，你知道！ [n ， shi de ， wo yuan yi 。 dan wo yao xiang ni shou qu  50,000  ge ying bi  -  zhe xie dou hen zhen gui ， ni zhi dao ！]

english: Very well, I accept.
translation: 很好，我接受。 [hen hao ， wo jie shou 。]

english: I don't think I can afford that, sorry.
translation: 我想我负担不起，抱歉。 [wo xiang wo fu dan bu qi ， bao qian 。]

translation: 好吧，有空就回来吧。 [hao ba ， you kong jiu hui lai ba 。]

english: Those children are nothing but trouble - if I did not watch them all the time, Seren knows what trouble they would get in to!
translation: 那些孩子只不过是麻烦——如果我不一直看着他们，塞伦知道他们会惹上什么麻烦！ [na xie hai zi zhi bu guo shi ma fan —— ru guo wo bu yi zhi kan zhe ta men ， sai lun zhi dao ta men hui re shang shen me ma fan ！]

english: They look old enough to look after themselves.
translation: 他们看起来已经足够大了，可以照顾自己了。 [ta men kan qi lai yi jing zu gou da le ， ke yi zhao gu zi ji le 。]

english: They are only 34 and 38, far too young to be left unsupervised.
translation: 他们只有 34 岁和 38 岁，太年轻了，不能无人看管。 [ta men zhi you  34  sui he  38  sui ， tai nian qing le ， bu neng wu ren kan guan 。]

english: Only!?! How old does that make you?
translation: 仅有的！？！那你多大了？ [jin you de ！？！ na ni duo da le ？]

english: Has no one told you it is rude to ask a lady her age?
translation: 没有人告诉过你询问一位女士的年龄是不礼貌的吗？ [mei you ren gao su guo ni xun wen yi wei nv shi de nian ling shi bu li mao de ma ？]

english: Sorry, I wasn't thinking. Anyway... I'd better stop distracting you.
translation: 抱歉，我没有多想。无论如何……我最好别再打扰你了。 [bao qian ， wo mei you duo xiang 。 wu lun ru he …… wo zui hao bie zai da rao ni le 。]

english: Okay, See you some other time.
translation: 好的，下次再见。 [hao de ， xia ci zai jian 。]

english: I can't thank you enough for what you did. My children might be dead if not for you.
translation: 我对你所做的一切感激不尽。如果不是你，我的孩子们可能会死。 [wo dui ni suo zuo de yi qie gan ji bu jin 。 ru guo bu shi ni ， wo de hai zi men ke neng hui si 。]

english: It's not a problem.
translation: 这不是问题。 [zhe bu shi wen ti 。]

english: You're a hero and all of us here know it. Again, thank you.
translation: 你是一位英雄，我们这里所有人都知道这一点。再次感谢您。 [ni shi yi wei ying xiong ， wo men zhe li suo you ren dou zhi dao zhe yi dian 。 zai ci gan xie nin 。]

english: Here, have this.
translation: 给，这个。 [gei ， zhe ge 。]

english: You've obtained a [new clue/casket]!
translation: 你获得了[新线索/棺材]！ [ni huo de le [ xin xian suo / guan cai ]！]

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你认为你在做什么？ [ni ren wei ni zai zuo shen me ？]

english: 'Ello, and what are you after then?
translation: '艾洛，那你在追什么？ [' ai luo ， na ni zai zhui shen me ？]

english: I need another assignment.
translation: 我需要另一项任务。 [wo xu yao ling yi xiang ren wu 。]

english: You're actually very strong, are you sure you don't want Chaeldar in Zanaris to assign you a task?
translation: 你其实很强，你确定不想让扎纳里斯的查尔达给你分配任务吗？ [ni qi shi hen qiang ， ni que ding bu xiang rang zha na li si de cha er da gei ni fen pei ren wu ma ？]

english: No that's okay, I'll take a task from you.
translation: 不，没关系，我会接受你的任务。 [bu ， mei guan xi ， wo hui jie shou ni de ren wu 。]

english: Oh okay then, I'll go talk to Chaeldar.
translation: 哦，好吧，那我去跟 Chaeldar 谈谈。 [o ， hao ba ， na wo qu gen  Chaeldar  tan tan 。]

english: Excellent, you're doing great. Your new task is to kill [amount] [task monster].
translation: 太棒了，你做得很好。你的新任务是杀死[数量][任务怪物]。 [tai bang le ， ni zuo de hen hao 。 ni de xin ren wu shi sha si [ shu liang ][ ren wu guai wu ]。]

english: Got any tips for me?
translation: 有什么建议给我吗？ [you shen me jian yi gei wo ma ？]

english: Great, thanks!
translation: 太好了，谢谢！ [tai hao le ， xie xie ！]

english: Okay, great!
translation: 好的，太好了！ [hao de ， tai hao le ！]

english: Good luck! Don't forget to come back when you need a new assignment.
translation: 祝你好运！当您需要新的任务时，请不要忘记回来。 [zhu ni hao yun ！ dang nin xu yao xin de ren wu shi ， qing bu yao wang ji hui lai 。]

english: You're still hunting [task monster], you have [amount] to go. Come back when you've finished your task.
translation: 你仍在寻找[任务怪物]，你还有[数量]要做。完成任务后就回来。 [ni reng zai xun zhao [ ren wu guai wu ]， ni hai you [ shu liang ] yao zuo 。 wan cheng ren wu hou jiu hui lai 。]

english: You're still hunting [monster], with [amount] to go.
translation: 你仍在狩猎[怪物]，还有[数量]。 [ni reng zai shou lie [ guai wu ]， hai you [ shu liang ]。]

english: I don't think that's a suitable task for you. Shall I cancel it? This will not wipe your task streaks.
translation: 我认为这不适合你。我要取消它吗？这不会消除您的任务连续记录。 [wo ren wei zhe bu shi he ni 。 wo yao qu xiao ta ma ？ zhe bu hui xiao chu nin de ren wu lian xu ji lu 。]

english: Yes, please cancel it.
translation: 是的，请取消。 [shi de ， qing qu xiao 。]

english: Alright, consider the task cancelled. You can now get a new assignment when you want one.
translation: 好吧，考虑任务被取消了。现在，您可以在需要时获得新的任务。 [hao ba ， kao lv ren wu bei qu xiao le 。 xian zai ， nin ke yi zai xu yao shi huo de xin de ren wu 。]

english: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
translation: 不，谢谢，我想尝试一下。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo xiang chang shi yi xia 。]

english: Good luck with that.
translation: 祝你好运。 [zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: 你有什么奖励给我，或者有什么可以交易的吗？ [ni you shen me jiang li gei wo ， huo zhe you shen me ke yi jiao yi de ma ？]

english: I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.
translation: 我有很多你可以获得的奖励，还有各种各样的杀手装备可供出售。 [wo you hen duo ni ke yi huo de de jiang li ， hai you ge zhong ge yang de sha shou zhuang bei ke gong chu shou 。]

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: 说说我的作业的难度吧。 [shuo shuo wo de zuo ye de nan du ba 。]

english: The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 目前，杀戮大师可以为您分配我们列表中的任何任务，无论您的战斗水平如何。 [mu qian ， sha lu da shi ke yi wei nin fen pei wo men lie biao zhong de ren he ren wu ， wu lun nin de zhan dou shui ping ru he 。]

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
translation: 没关系——我可以处理任何任务。 [mei guan xi —— wo ke yi chu li ren he ren wu 。]

english: That's the spirit.
translation: 这就是精神。 [zhe jiu shi jing shen 。]

translation: 没关系——我不想要太难的东西。 [mei guan xi —— wo bu xiang yao tai nan de dong xi 。]

english: Okay, we'll keep checking your combat level.
translation: 好的，我们会继续检查你的战斗水平。 [hao de ， wo men hui ji xu jian cha ni de zhan dou shui ping 。]

translation: 别再检查我的战斗水平了——我可以承受任何事情！ [bie zai jian cha wo de zhan dou shui ping le —— wo ke yi cheng shou ren he shi qing ！]

translation: 好吧，从现在开始，所有的杀手大师都会从他们的列表中为你分配任何东西，无论你的战斗水平如何。 [hao ba ， cong xian zai kai shi ， suo you de sha shou da shi du hui cong ta men de lie biao zhong wei ni fen pei ren he dong xi ， wu lun ni de zhan dou shui ping ru he 。]

english: An unusual aspiration for a troll.
translation: 对巨魔的不同寻常的渴望。 [dui ju mo de bu tong xun chang de ke wang 。]

english: I like weather since I got my name. My first food gave me shiny weather number getter.
translation: 自从我有了我的名字以来，我就喜欢天气。我的第一顿食物给了我闪亮的天气数字获取器。 [zi cong wo you le wo de ming zi yi lai ， wo jiu xi huan tian qi 。 wo de di yi dun shi wu gei le wo shan liang de tian qi shu zi huo qu qi 。]

english: Goodbye!

english: Bye sail her!

english: Numbers so tasty. Weather here must be really good!
translation: 数字真好吃。这里的天气一定非常好！ [shu zi zhen hao chi 。 zhe li de tian qi yi ding fei chang hao ！]

english: Troll scientists really do operate on a higher level don't they?
translation: 巨魔科学家确实在更高的水平上运作，不是吗？ [ju mo ke xue jia que shi zai geng gao de shui ping shang yun zuo ， bu shi ma ？]

translation: 嘿！今天我能为你做什么？ [hei ！ jin tian wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm Meddwl, a simple forest dweller.
translation: 我是 Meddwl，一个简单的森林居民。 [wo shi  Meddwl， yi ge jian dan de sen lin ju min 。]

english: It's nice to meet you Meddwl, I'm [player name].
translation: 很高兴认识你 Meddwl，我是[玩家名字]。 [hen gao xing ren shi ni  Meddwl， wo shi [ wan jia ming zi ]。]

english: And it's great to meet you, [player name].
translation: 很高兴见到你，[玩家姓名]。 [hen gao xing jian dao ni ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm new here, I recently left my home of Gwenith.
translation: 我是新来的，我最近离开了格温尼斯的家。 [wo shi xin lai de ， wo zui jin li kai le ge wen ni si de jia 。]

english: How come?
translation: 怎么会？ [zen me hui ？]

english: Gwenith may be in the forest, it is not part of the forest. I desired to be closer to nature.
translation: 格温妮丝可能在森林里，但它并不是森林的一部分。我渴望更接近自然。 [ge wen ni si ke neng zai sen lin li ， dan ta bing bu shi sen lin de yi bu fen 。 wo ke wang geng jie jin zi ran 。]

english: A lovely idea, how's it going?
translation: 好主意，进展如何？ [hao zhu yi ， jin zhan ru he ？]

english: It's a harder living without the protection of four walls and a roof, but the peace is a wonderful thing to behold. Just listen...
translation: 没有四堵墙和一个屋顶的保护，生活会变得更加艰难，但和平是一件美妙的事情。听听... [mei you si du qiang he yi ge wu ding de bao hu ， sheng huo hui bian de geng jia jian nan ， dan he ping shi yi jian mei miao de shi qing 。 ting ting ...]

english: Isn't it lovely?
