translation: 那么你做什么呢？ [na me ni zuo shen me ne ？]

english: I breed Terrorbirds.
translation: 我饲养恐怖鸟。 [wo si yang kong bu niao 。]

english: Why are they called Terrorbirds?
translation: 为什么它们被称为恐怖鸟？ [wei shen me ta men bei cheng wei kong bu niao ？]

english: Well, they're supposed to look terrifying but I think they are rather cute.
translation: 嗯，他们应该看起来很可怕，但我认为他们相当可爱。 [n ， ta men ying gai kan qi lai hen ke pa ， dan wo ren wei ta men xiang dang ke ai 。]

english: I'm sure they are cute, unless they are biting your arm off.
translation: 我确信它们很可爱，除非它们把你的手臂咬掉。 [wo que xin ta men hen ke ai ， chu fei ta men ba ni de shou bi yao diao 。]

english: Oh they'd never do that - unless I tell them to, of course.
translation: 哦，他们永远不会那样做——当然，除非我告诉他们这样做。 [o ， ta men yong yuan bu hui na yang zuo —— dang ran ， chu fei wo gao su ta men zhe yang zuo 。]

english: I'd better stay on your good side then!
translation: 那我最好还是站在你这边吧！ [na wo zui hao hai shi zhan zai ni zhe bian ba ！]

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 尽管您找到了顾客，但您似乎没有带来正确的食物！你需要[一个/一些][订购的侏儒食物/饮料]！ [jin guan nin zhao dao le gu ke ， dan nin si hu mei you dai lai zheng que de shi wu ！ ni xu yao [ yi ge / yi xie ][ ding gou de zhu ru shi wu / yin liao ]！]

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜肴不行。对于 Aluft Aloft 的顾客来说，只有手工制作的 Gnome Cuisine 才足够好。 [kong pa yu zhi cai yao bu xing 。 dui yu  Aluft Aloft  de gu ke lai shuo ， zhi you shou gong zhi zuo de  Gnome Cuisine  cai zu gou hao 。]

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Dalila
translation: 您将[一份/一些][订购的侏儒食品/饮料项目]交给达丽拉 [nin jiang [ yi fen / yi xie ][ ding gou de zhu ru shi pin / yin liao xiang mu ] jiao gei da li la]

english: Ah, just in time for a break. Thank you.
translation: 啊，正好赶上休息时间。谢谢。 [a ， zheng hao gan shang xiu xi shi jian 。 xie xie 。]

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 您有 [number] 个积分用于免费送货令牌。您可能会收到 [number] 块侏儒食物。 [nin you  [number]  ge ji fen yong yu mian fei song huo ling pai 。 nin ke neng hui shou dao  [number]  kuai zhu ru shi wu 。]

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 不要忘记从 Aluft Gianne jnr 领取免费送货代币。 [bu yao wang ji cong  Aluft Gianne jnr  ling qu mian fei song huo dai bi 。]

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 你的交货太晚了！返回 Aluft jnr。以获得另一个订单。您丢弃了送货箱，因为您不再需要它了。 [ni de jiao huo tai wan le ！ fan hui  Aluft jnr。 yi huo de ling yi ge ding dan 。 nin diu qi le song huo xiang ， yin wei nin bu zai xu yao ta le 。]

english: Hi! I'm Megan. Welcome to the Party Room!
translation: 你好！我是梅根。欢迎来到派对室！ [ni hao ！ wo shi mei gen 。 huan ying lai dao pai dui shi ！]

english: One beer please Megan!
translation: 梅根，请喝一杯啤酒！ [mei gen ， qing he yi bei pi jiu ！]

english: Coming right up [sir/ma'am]! That's two gold please.
translation: 马上来[先生/女士]！拜托，这是两块金子。 [ma shang lai [ xian sheng / nv shi ]！ bai tuo ， zhe shi liang kuai jin zi 。]

english: I'm sorry but I don't have enough money!
translation: 对不起，我没有足够的钱！ [dui bu qi ， wo mei you zu gou de qian ！]

english: Can you dance, Megan?
translation: 梅根，你会跳舞吗？ [mei gen ， ni hui tiao wu ma ？]

english: Can I dance?!
translation: 我可以跳舞吗？！ [wo ke yi tiao wu ma ？！]

english: CAN I dance?!!
translation: 我可以跳舞吗？！ [wo ke yi tiao wu ma ？！]

english: Dance with me Megan!
translation: 梅根和我一起跳舞吧！ [mei gen he wo yi qi tiao wu ba ！]

english: The player and Megan simultaneously dance and cheer, then end in a bow.
translation: 玩家和梅根同时跳舞和欢呼，然后鞠躬结束。 [wan jia he mei gen tong shi tiao wu he huan hu ， ran hou ju gong jie shu 。]

english: Do you have any news?
translation: 你有什么消息吗？ [ni you shen me xiao xi ma ？]

english: Not at the moment. I've heard that the known world is expanding as new places are discovered.
translation: 目前还没有。我听说随着新地方的发现，已知的世界正在扩大。 [mu qian hai mei you 。 wo ting shuo sui zhe xin di fang de fa xian ， yi zhi de shi jie zheng zai kuo da 。]

english: These are exciting times indeed!
translation: 这确实是激动人心的时刻！ [zhe que shi shi ji dong ren xin de shi ke ！]

english: One beer please Megan!
translation: 梅根，请喝一杯啤酒！ [mei gen ， qing he yi bei pi jiu ！]

english: Can you dance, Megan?
translation: 梅根，你会跳舞吗？ [mei gen ， ni hui tiao wu ma ？]

english: Do you have any news?
translation: 你有什么消息吗？ [ni you shen me xiao xi ma ？]

english: Hello?
translation: 你好？ [ni hao ？]

english: The spirit looks at you for a moment, before you suddenly hear a voice echoing in your head.
translation: 灵魂看了你一会儿，然后你突然听到一个声音在你的脑海中回响。 [ling hun kan le ni yi hui er ， ran hou ni tu ran ting dao yi ge sheng yin zai ni de nao hai zhong hui xiang 。]

english: Curious... It has been a long time since I've spoken to another. The last time was when my body still had form. Tell me, stranger, what brings you to my tomb?
translation: 很好奇……我已经很久没有和别人说话了。上次是在我的身体还有形态的时候。告诉我，陌生人，你为什么来到我的坟墓？ [hen hao qi …… wo yi jing hen jiu mei you he bie ren shuo hua le 。 shang ci shi zai wo de shen ti hai you xing tai de shi hou 。 gao su wo ， mo sheng ren ， ni wei shen me lai dao wo de fen mu ？]

english: I was looking for some scabarites.
translation: 我正在寻找一些剑士。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yi xie jian shi 。]

english: Ah, yes. The fallen remnants of my once great sect. You will find plenty of them here. Why do you seek them?
translation: 啊，是的。我曾经伟大的教派的没落残余。您会在这里找到很多这样的东西。你为什么要寻找他们？ [a ， shi de 。 wo ceng jing wei da de jiao pai de mo luo can yu 。 nin hui zai zhe li zhao dao hen duo zhe yang de dong xi 。 ni wei shen me yao xun zhao ta men ？]

english: Do you know of Amascut, the Devourer?
translation: 你知道吞噬者阿马斯卡特吗？ [ni zhi dao tun shi zhe a ma si ka te ma ？]

english: All too well.
translation: 一切都太好了。 [yi qie dou tai hao le 。]

english: There's an old tomb south of here. Amascut has been excavating the entrance, and the scabarites have been helping her. She's looking for something inside, but I don't know what.
translation: 这里南边有一座古墓。阿马斯卡特一直在挖掘入口，而剑士们一直在帮助她。她在里面寻找什么东西，但我不知道是什么。 [zhe li nan bian you yi zuo gu mu 。 a ma si ka te yi zhi zai wa jue ru kou ， er jian shi men yi zhi zai bang zhu ta 。 ta zai li mian xun zhao shen me dong xi ， dan wo bu zhi dao shi shen me 。]

english: I see. If you are an enemy of the Devourer and her corrupt scabarites, then you are a friend to me. I am Mehhar, and I can help you.
translation: 我懂了。如果你是吞噬者和她腐败的剑客的敌人，那么你就是我的朋友。我是梅哈尔，我可以帮助你。 [wo dong le 。 ru guo ni shi tun shi zhe he ta fu bai de jian ke de di ren ， na me ni jiu shi wo de peng you 。 wo shi mei ha er ， wo ke yi bang zhu ni 。]

english: You can help? Do you know of this tomb?
translation: 你能帮忙吗？你知道这座坟墓吗？ [ni neng bang mang ma ？ ni zhi dao zhe zuo fen mu ma ？]

english: Even when I still lived, the desert hid many secrets. Now, centuries later, it hides even more. Of all those secrets, few are greater than the ones hidden in that tomb.
translation: 即使在我还活着的时候，沙漠也隐藏着许多秘密。几个世纪后的今天，它隐藏了更多。在所有这些秘密中，很少有比隐藏在那个坟墓中的秘密更大的了。 [ji shi zai wo hai huo zhe de shi hou ， sha mo ye yin cang zhe xu duo mi mi 。 ji ge shi ji hou de jin tian ， ta yin cang le geng duo 。 zai suo you zhe xie mi mi zhong ， hen shao you bi yin cang zai na ge fen mu zhong de mi mi geng da de le 。]

english: Whose tomb is it?
translation: 那是谁的坟墓？ [na shi shei de fen mu ？]

english: It is the resting place of my father, Osmumten. He was once Pharaoh of these lands. My destiny was to succeed him, but the usurpers saw an end to that.
translation: 这是我父亲奥斯蒙顿的安息之地。他曾经是这片土地的法老。我的命运是接替他，但篡位者看到了这一点的结束。 [zhe shi wo fu qin ao si meng dun de an xi zhi di 。 ta ceng jing shi zhe pian tu di de fa lao 。 wo de ming yun shi jie ti ta ， dan cuan wei zhe kan dao le zhe yi dian de jie shu 。]

english: And what are the secrets in his tomb?
translation: 而他的坟墓里又隐藏着什么秘密呢？ [er ta de fen mu li you yin cang zhe shen me mi mi ne ？]

english: Being a Pharaoh offers many luxuries, both in life and in death. Many strive only for these luxuries. They forget that being a Pharaoh also comes with responsibility.
translation: 作为法老，无论生前还是死后，都可以享受许多奢侈的享受。许多人只为这些奢侈品而奋斗。他们忘记了作为法老也伴随着责任。 [zuo wei fa lao ， wu lun sheng qian hai shi si hou ， dou ke yi xiang shou xu duo she chi de xiang shou 。 xu duo ren zhi wei zhe xie she chi pin er fen dou 。 ta men wang ji le zuo wei fa lao ye ban sui zhe ze ren 。]

english: My father had a responsibility greater than most. At the time of his rule, our people were locked in a great war. To hold back the Ruinous Powers, our gods granted us immensely powerful weapons.
translation: 我父亲的责任比大多数人都大。在他统治时期，我们的人民陷入了一场大战。为了阻止毁灭性的力量，我们的诸神赐予了我们极其强大的武器。 [wo fu qin de ze ren bi da duo shu ren dou da 。 zai ta tong zhi shi qi ， wo men de ren min xian ru le yi chang da zhan 。 wei le zu zhi hui mie xing de li liang ， wo men de zhu shen ci yu le wo men ji qi qiang da de wu qi 。]

english: When the war was over, my father was tasked with hiding those weapons, lest they fall into nefarious hands. Two of them were buried with him. They will be what the Devourer seeks.
translation: 战争结束后，我父亲的任务是隐藏这些武器，以免它们落入邪恶之手。其中两个与他合葬。他们将是吞噬者所寻找的。 [zhan zheng jie shu hou ， wo fu qin de ren wu shi yin cang zhe xie wu qi ， yi mian ta men luo ru xie e zhi shou 。 qi zhong liang ge yu ta he zang 。 ta men jiang shi tun shi zhe suo xun zhao de 。]

english: What are these weapons?
translation: 这些武器是什么？ [zhe xie wu qi shi shen me ？]

english: I trust you are aware of what the Devourer desires?
translation: 我相信你知道吞噬者的愿望是什么？ [wo xiang xin ni zhi dao tun shi zhe de yuan wang shi shen me ？]

english: Souls?
translation: 灵魂？ [ling hun ？]

english: Yes. When the war ended and the Devourer rose from the ashes, she did so with only one goal. She will not stop until every soul, living or dead, has been destroyed.
translation: 是的。当战争结束，吞噬者从灰烬中复活时，她只有一个目标。她不会停止，直到每一个灵魂，无论是活的还是死的，都被摧毁。 [shi de 。 dang zhan zheng jie shu ， tun shi zhe cong hui jin zhong fu huo shi ， ta zhi you yi ge mu biao 。 ta bu hui ting zhi ， zhi dao mei yi ge ling hun ， wu lun shi huo de hai shi si de ， dou bei cui hui 。]

english: And these weapons can help her?
translation: 而这些武器能帮到她吗？ [er zhe xie wu qi neng bang dao ta ma ？]

english: Many would call the Devourer a god, but they speak only half truths. She is a demi-goddess of limited power, and does not possess the means to devour souls on a mass scale.
translation: 许多人会称吞噬者为神，但他们只说一半真话。她是半女神，力量有限，不具备大规模吞噬灵魂的手段。 [xu duo ren hui cheng tun shi zhe wei shen ， dan ta men zhi shuo yi ban zhen hua 。 ta shi ban nv shen ， li liang you xian ， bu ju bei da gui mo tun shi ling hun de shou duan 。]

english: The weapons in my father's tomb can be used to drain a being of divine energy and transfer that energy to another. If used correctly, they would grant the Devourer true godhood.
translation: 我父亲坟墓里的武器可以用来吸取一个人的神圣能量并将其转移到另一个人身上。如果使用得当，它们将赋予吞噬者真正的神性。 [wo fu qin fen mu li de wu qi ke yi yong lai xi qu yi ge ren de shen sheng neng liang bing jiang qi zhuan yi dao ling yi ge ren shen shang 。 ru guo shi yong de dang ， ta men jiang fu yu tun shi zhe zhen zheng de shen xing 。]

english: Then I need to get into that tomb and stop her.
translation: 然后我需要进入那个坟墓并阻止她。 [ran hou wo xu yao jin ru na ge fen mu bing zu zhi ta 。]

english: Before you leave, I ask that you remember your original purpose here.
translation: 在你离开之前，我请你记住你来这里的初衷。 [zai ni li kai zhi qian ， wo qing ni ji zhu ni lai zhe li de chu zhong 。]

english: The scabarites?
translation: 剑客？ [jian ke ？]

english: Yes. They have made their home here in my tomb, disturbing my rest. From the chamber above, the High Priest of Scabaras commands them.
translation: 是的。他们在我的坟墓里安了家，扰乱了我的休息。斯卡巴拉斯大祭司在上面的房间里指挥着他们。 [shi de 。 ta men zai wo de fen mu li an le jia ， rao luan le wo de xiu xi 。 si ka ba la si da ji si zai shang mian de fang jian li zhi hui zhe ta men 。]

english: He believes he does so in the name of Scabaras. He does not realise that he is actually a puppet of the Devourer.
translation: 他相信他是以斯卡巴拉斯的名义这样做的。他没有意识到自己实际上是吞噬者的傀儡。 [ta xiang xin ta shi yi si ka ba la si de ming yi zhe yang zuo de 。 ta mei you yi shi dao zi ji shi ji shang shi tun shi zhe de kui lei 。]

english: Free him of her control, and the Devourer will be without a powerful resource. It will also allow me to rest once more.
translation: 将他从她的控制中解放出来，吞噬者将失去强大的资源。这也能让我再次休息。 [jiang ta cong ta de kong zhi zhong jie fang chu lai ， tun shi zhe jiang shi qu qiang da de zi yuan 。 zhe ye neng rang wo zai ci xiu xi 。]

english: He might also know more about what Amascut is planning. I did free a guard from Amascut's control through combat. I could try that again.
translation: 他可能还更多地了解阿马斯卡特的计划。我确实通过战斗将一名守卫从阿马斯卡特的控制下解放出来。我可以再试一次。 [ta ke neng hai geng duo di liao jie a ma si ka te de ji hua 。 wo que shi tong guo zhan dou jiang yi ming shou wei cong a ma si ka te de kong zhi xia jie fang chu lai 。 wo ke yi zai shi yi ci 。]

english: When the Devourer first emerged, Icthlarin himself taught us an incantation to free an individual from her control. I would suggest you use it, rather than risking harm to the High Priest.
translation: 当吞噬者第一次出现时，伊克拉琳亲自教了我们一个咒语，可以将一个人从她的控制中解放出来。我建议你使用它，而不是冒着伤害大祭司的风险。 [dang tun shi zhe di yi ci chu xian shi ， yi ke la lin qin zi jiao le wo men yi ge zhou yu ， ke yi jiang yi ge ren cong ta de kong zhi zhong jie fang chu lai 。 wo jian yi ni shi yong ta ， er bu shi mao zhe shang hai da ji si de feng xian 。]

english: Ah, that seems wise. What's this incantation?
translation: 啊，这似乎很明智。这是什么咒语？ [a ， zhe si hu hen ming zhi 。 zhe shi shen me zhou yu ？]

english: 'Majaan, Manand, Almuk.' Be warned, while it will work on those she has hypnotised, it will have no effect on her corrupted akhs. They are sadly beyond saving.
translation: “马贾安、马南德、阿尔穆克。”请注意，虽然它对她催眠的人有效，但对她腐败的阿赫没有影响。可悲的是，他们已经无法挽救了。 [“ ma jia an 、 ma nan de 、 a er mu ke 。” qing zhu yi ， sui ran ta dui ta cui mian de ren you xiao ， dan dui ta fu bai de a he mei you ying xiang 。 ke bei de shi ， ta men yi jing wu fa wan jiu le 。]

english: I see. Thank you, Mehhar.
translation: 我懂了。谢谢你，梅哈尔。 [wo dong le 。 xie xie ni ， mei ha er 。]

english: You will find a key to the upper chamber in an urn to the back of this room. Now go, with the blessing of Scabaras.
translation: 你会在这个房间后面的瓮里找到上层房间的钥匙。现在就带着斯卡巴拉斯的祝福出发吧。 [ni hui zai zhe ge fang jian hou mian de weng li zhao dao shang ceng fang jian de yao shi 。 xian zai jiu dai zhe si ka ba la si de zhu fu chu fa ba 。]

english: Tell me more about yourself.
translation: 告诉我更多关于你自己的信息。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu ni zi ji de xin xi 。]

english: In life I was Mehhar, son of Osmumten. To me, my death was mere moments ago. To you on the other hand, I am surely considered ancient.
translation: 生前我是奥斯穆顿的儿子梅哈尔。对我来说，我的死亡就在不久之前。另一方面，对你来说，我肯定被认为是古老的。 [sheng qian wo shi ao si mu dun de er zi mei ha er 。 dui wo lai shuo ， wo de si wang jiu zai bu jiu zhi qian 。 ling yi fang mian ， dui ni lai shuo ， wo ken ding bei ren wei shi gu lao de 。]

english: How ancient?
translation: 有多古老？ [you duo gu lao ？]

english: I sense that the gods have long since departed this world, but when I lived, they still walked among us.
translation: 我感觉诸神早已离开了这个世界，但在我活着的时候，他们仍然行走在我们中间。 [wo gan jue zhu shen zao yi li kai le zhe ge shi jie ， dan zai wo huo zhe de shi hou ， ta men reng ran xing zou zai wo men zhong jian 。]

english: And your father, Osmumten? You said he was the Pharaoh. What happened?
translation: 你的父亲奥斯穆滕呢？你说他是法老。发生了什么？ [ni de fu qin ao si mu teng ne ？ ni shuo ta shi fa lao 。 fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: My father ruled during the great war. While the war was eventually won, many considered the cost too great. My father led us with the support of the gods, yet he was the one people blamed.
translation: 我父亲在大战期间统治。虽然战争最终取得了胜利，但许多人认为代价太大。我的父亲在众神的支持下领导了我们，但人们却指责他。 [wo fu qin zai da zhan qi jian tong zhi 。 sui ran zhan zheng zui zhong qu de le sheng li ， dan xu duo ren ren wei dai jia tai da 。 wo de fu qin zai zhong shen de zhi chi xia ling dao le wo men ， dan ren men que zhi ze ta 。]

english: So they killed him?
translation: 所以他们杀了他？ [suo yi ta men sha le ta ？]

english: Him, and the rest of my family. I would have died as well, were it not for the bravery of my father's servants. They gave their lives, so that I might live.
translation: 他，还有我的家人。如果不是我父亲的仆人们的勇敢，我也可能会死。他们献出了自己的生命，这样我才能活下去。 [ta ， hai you wo de jia ren 。 ru guo bu shi wo fu qin de pu ren men de yong gan ， wo ye ke neng hui si 。 ta men xian chu le zi ji de sheng ming ， zhe yang wo cai neng huo xia qu 。]

english: And then you came here?
translation: 然后你就来这里了？ [ran hou ni jiu lai zhe li le ？]

english: To Ullek? Yes. I found solace here with a group dedicated to Scabaras. In time, I became their leader, and the Sect of Scabaras was formed.
translation: 去乌勒克？是的。我在这里与一群致力于斯卡巴拉斯的人一起找到了安慰。随着时间的推移，我成为了他们的领袖，斯卡巴拉斯教派成立了。 [qu wu lei ke ？ shi de 。 wo zai zhe li yu yi qun zhi li yu si ka ba la si de ren yi qi zhao dao le an wei 。 sui zhe shi jian de tui yi ， wo cheng wei le ta men de ling xiu ， si ka ba la si jiao pai cheng li le 。]

english: There's not much left of Ullek now, or the sect.
translation: 现在乌勒克或者教派已经所剩无几了。 [xian zai wu lei ke huo zhe jiao pai yi jing suo sheng wu ji le 。]

english: That is no surprise. Such is the fate of all things. Still, while the sect would have eventually decayed, it was the Devourer's corruption that quickened its demise.
translation: 这并不奇怪。这就是一切事物的命运。尽管如此，虽然这个教派最终会衰落，但吞噬者的腐败加速了它的灭亡。 [zhe bing bu qi guai 。 zhe jiu shi yi qie shi wu de ming yun 。 jin guan ru ci ， sui ran zhe ge jiao pai zui zhong hui shuai luo ， dan tun shi zhe de fu bai jia su le ta de mie wang 。]

english: I'm sorry.
translation: 对不起。 [dui bu qi 。]

english: Don't be. You have a chance to free the High Priest of Scabaras. If you do, the sect may yet be reborn.
translation: 别这样。你有机会释放斯卡巴拉斯的大祭司。如果这样做的话，宗派可能还会重生。 [bie zhe yang 。 ni you ji hui shi fang si ka ba la si de da ji si 。 ru guo zhe yang zuo de hua ， zong pai ke neng hai hui chong sheng 。]

english: What do you know about Amascut?
translation: 您对阿马斯卡特了解多少？ [nin dui a ma si ka te liao jie duo shao ？]

english: The one you call Amascut died long ago. In her place, the Devourer was born.
translation: 那个你称为阿马斯卡特的人很久以前就死了。在她的位置上，吞噬者诞生了。 [na ge ni cheng wei a ma si ka te de ren hen jiu yi qian jiu si le 。 zai ta de wei zhi shang ， tun shi zhe dan sheng le 。]

english: How did it happen?
translation: 它是怎么发生的？ [ta shi zen me fa sheng de ？]

english: Only Icthlarin himself knows the true answer to that question.
translation: 只有伊斯拉林本人知道这个问题的真正答案。 [zhi you yi si la lin ben ren zhi dao zhe ge wen ti de zhen zheng da an 。]

english: Okay... but you must have some idea?
translation: 好吧……但你一定有什么想法吧？ [hao ba …… dan ni yi ding you shen me xiang fa ba ？]

english: During the great war, our forces were decimated by the servants of the Ruinous Powers. To turn the tide, Icthlarin and Amascut sought powerful allies to aid us.
translation: 在大战期间，我们的军队被毁灭势力的仆从摧毁。为了扭转局势，伊斯拉林和阿马斯卡特寻求强大的盟友来帮助我们。 [zai da zhan qi jian ， wo men de jun dui bei hui mie shi li de pu cong cui hui 。 wei le niu zhuan ju shi ， yi si la lin he a ma si ka te xun qiu qiang da de meng you lai bang zhu wo men 。]

english: They found them far from here, in a place beyond this world. A powerful race of faceless ones. They became Icthlarin's Stern Judges.
translation: 他们发现他们远离这里，在这个世界之外的地方。一个由无面者组成的强大种族。他们成为了伊克拉林的严厉法官。 [ta men fa xian ta men yuan li zhe li ， zai zhe ge shi jie zhi wai de di fang 。 yi ge you wu mian zhe zu cheng de qiang da zhong zu 。 ta men cheng wei le yi ke la lin de yan li fa guan 。]

english: What's that got to do with Amascut?
translation: 这和阿马斯卡特有什么关系？ [zhe he a ma si ka te you shen me guan xi ？]

english: Upon her return, Amascut vanished. She played no further part in the war. Only when the fighting was over did she reappear, but it wasn't really her at all.
translation: 阿马斯卡特回来后就消失了。她没有再参与战争。直到战斗结束，她才重新出现，但那根本不是她。 [a ma si ka te hui lai hou jiu xiao shi le 。 ta mei you zai can yu zhan zheng 。 zhi dao zhan dou jie shu ， ta cai chong xin chu xian ， dan na gen ben bu shi ta 。]

english: So you think it had something to do with the Stern Judges?
translation: 那么你认为这与严厉的法官有关吗？ [na me ni ren wei zhe yu yan li de fa guan you guan ma ？]

english: It seems highly likely.
translation: 看来可能性很大。 [kan lai ke neng xing hen da 。]

english: Tell me more about the war you mentioned.
translation: 告诉我更多关于你提到的战争的信息。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu ni ti dao de zhan zheng de xin xi 。]

english: It started during the rule of my grandmother. An ever-expanding empire to the north set their sights on our lands. War soon broke out.
translation: 这要从我祖母统治时期开始。北方一个不断扩张的帝国将目光投向了我们的土地。战争很快爆发。 [zhe yao cong wo zu mu tong zhi shi qi kai shi 。 bei fang yi ge bu duan kuo zhang de di guo jiang mu guang tou xiang le wo men de tu di 。 zhan zheng hen kuai bao fa 。]

english: The armies of the Ruinous Powers were far stronger than our own. That was until Icthlarin's Stern Judges joined the fray. Thanks to them, the war was seemingly won.
translation: 毁灭之力的军队比我们的军队强大得多。直到伊斯拉林的严厉法官加入战斗。感谢他们，战争看似胜利了。 [hui mie zhi li de jun dui bi wo men de jun dui qiang da de duo 。 zhi dao yi si la lin de yan li fa guan jia ru zhan dou 。 gan xie ta men ， zhan zheng kan shi sheng li le 。]

english: It wasn't really though, was it?
translation: 但事实并非如此，不是吗？ [dan shi shi bing fei ru ci ， bu shi ma ？]

english: No. Among the Stern Judges, there was a serpent. After my father became Pharaoh, this serpent convinced the others to abandon us.
translation: 不，在严厉的法官中，有一条蛇。我父亲成为法老后，这条蛇说服了其他人抛弃我们。 [bu ， zai yan li de fa guan zhong ， you yi tiao she 。 wo fu qin cheng wei fa lao hou ， zhe tiao she shuo fu le qi ta ren pao qi wo men 。]

english: They joined the enemy?
translation: 他们加入敌人了吗？ [ta men jia ru di ren le ma ？]

english: They did. We were powerless against a force of that might. Nothing could stop their advance.
translation: 他们做到了。我们对这种力量无能为力。没有什么能够阻止他们的前进。 [ta men zuo dao le 。 wo men dui zhe zhong li liang wu neng wei li 。 mei you shen me neng gou zu zhi ta men de qian jin 。]

english: So how did the war end?
translation: 那么战争是如何结束的呢？ [na me zhan zheng shi ru he jie shu de ne ？]

english: It was Tumeken himself. He sacrificed himself to annihilate the enemy. The cost was great, but the war was won.
translation: 这是图梅肯本人。为了消灭敌人，他牺牲了自己。虽然付出了巨大的代价，但战争还是取得了胜利。 [zhe shi tu mei ken ben ren 。 wei le xiao mie di ren ， ta xi sheng le zi ji 。 sui ran fu chu le ju da de dai jia ， dan zhan zheng hai shi qu de le sheng li 。]

english: So Tumeken died?
translation: 所以图梅肯死了？ [suo yi tu mei ken si le ？]

english: That's a matter of perspective. I died long ago, and yet we are still having this conversation.
translation: 这是一个视角问题。我很久以前就去世了，但我们仍在进行这个对话。 [zhe shi yi ge shi jiao wen ti 。 wo hen jiu yi qian jiu qu shi le ， dan wo men reng zai jin xing zhe ge dui hua 。]

english: That doesn't really answer my question.
translation: 这并不能真正回答我的问题。 [zhe bing bu neng zhen zheng hui da wo de wen ti 。]

english: While Tumeken himself may be gone, he lives on through his four avatars. While they walk among us, Tumeken will always be at our side.
translation: 虽然图梅肯本人可能已经去世，但他通过四个化身继续存在。当他们行走在我们中间时，图梅肯将永远陪伴在我们身边。 [sui ran tu mei ken ben ren ke neng yi jing qu shi ， dan ta tong guo si ge hua shen ji xu cun zai 。 dang ta men xing zou zai wo men zhong jian shi ， tu mei ken jiang yong yuan pei ban zai wo men shen bian 。]

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: Scabaras be with you.
translation: 斯卡拉与你同在。 [si ka la yu ni tong zai 。]

english: Hello, Mehhar.
translation: 你好，梅哈尔。 [ni hao ， mei ha er 。]

english: I sense that the Devourer's corruption has been lessened. I trust you were successful?
translation: 我感觉到吞噬者的腐败已经减轻了。我相信你成功了？ [wo gan jue dao tun shi zhe de fu bai yi jing jian qing le 。 wo xiang xin ni cheng gong le ？]

english: The High Priest is free.
translation: 大祭司是免费的。 [da ji si shi mian fei de 。]

english: You have my thanks.
translation: 我对你表示感谢。 [wo dui ni biao shi gan xie 。]

english: Does this mean you can rest now?
translation: 这是否意味着你现在可以休息了？ [zhe shi fou yi wei zhe ni xian zai ke yi xiu xi le ？]

english: That was my hope, but while the High Priest is free, many scabarites have been lost to the Devourer. As you will have seen, they have descended on my tomb, hoping to reclaim it.
translation: 这是我的希望，但虽然大祭司获得了自由，但许多剑士却被吞噬者夺走了。正如你所看到的，他们降临到我的坟墓上，希望夺回它。 [zhe shi wo de xi wang ， dan sui ran da ji si huo de le zi you ， dan xu duo jian shi que bei tun shi zhe duo zou le 。 zheng ru ni suo kan dao de ， ta men jiang lin dao wo de fen mu shang ， xi wang duo hui ta 。]

english: Is there anything I can do to help?
translation: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang mang de ma ？]

english: Continue your fight against the Devourer. Only with her defeat, will we finally find freedom.
translation: 继续对抗吞噬者。只有打败她，我们才能最终找到自由。 [ji xu dui kang tun shi zhe 。 zhi you da bai ta ， wo men cai neng zui zhong zhao dao zi you 。]

english: Welcome back, adventurer.
translation: 欢迎回来，冒险家。 [huan ying hui lai ， mao xian jia 。]

english: Tell me more about yourself.
translation: 告诉我更多关于你自己的信息。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu ni zi ji de xin xi 。]

english: What do you know about Amascut?
translation: 您对阿马斯卡特了解多少？ [nin dui a ma si ka te liao jie duo shao ？]

english: Tell me more about the war you mentioned.
translation: 告诉我更多关于你提到的战争的信息。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu ni ti dao de zhan zheng de xin xi 。]

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: It can't be that hard can it?
translation: 不可能那么难吧？ [bu ke neng na me nan ba ？]

english: I guess this will be my last day of blood tithes, one way or another.
translation: 无论如何，我想这将是我缴纳血税的最后一天。 [wu lun ru he ， wo xiang zhe jiang shi wo jiao na xue shui de zui hou yi tian 。]

english: I will survive the Theatre! Just like Serafina did!
translation: 我会在剧院里活下去！就像塞拉菲娜那样！ [wo hui zai ju yuan li huo xia qu ！ jiu xiang sai la fei na na yang ！]

english: Soon I will be free!
translation: 很快我就会自由了！ [hen kuai wo jiu hui zi you le ！]

english: I'm starting to think I made a mistake coming here.
translation: 我开始觉得我来到这里犯了一个错误。 [wo kai shi jue de wo lai dao zhe li fan le yi ge cuo wu 。]

english: Can't talk. I need to prepare myself.
translation: 不能说话。我需要做好准备。 [bu neng shuo hua 。 wo xu yao zuo hao zhun bei 。]

english: What? What's wrong?
translation: 什么？怎么了？ [shen me ？ zen me le ？]

english: Nothing, I just need to ask a couple of questions.
translation: 没什么，我只是想问几个问题。 [mei shen me ， wo zhi shi xiang wen ji ge wen ti 。]

english: Oh, hello. How's everything?
translation: 哦，你好。一切怎么样？ [o ， ni hao 。 yi qie zen me yang ？]

english: Not too bad thanks, but I wanted to ask a question.
translation: 还不错，谢谢，但我想问一个问题。 [hai bu cuo ， xie xie ， dan wo xiang wen yi ge wen ti 。]

english: Hello?
translation: 你好？ [ni hao ？]

english: Hello, I wonder if I could ask some questions.
translation: 你好，我想知道是否可以问一些问题。 [ni hao ， wo xiang zhi dao shi fou ke yi wen yi xie wen ti 。]

english: Hey, don't sneak up on me like that!
translation: 喂，别这样偷袭我！ [wei ， bie zhe yang tou xi wo ！]

english: Sorry, didn't mean to scare you. I just wanted to ask a question.
translation: 抱歉，我不是故意吓唬你的。我只是想问一个问题。 [bao qian ， wo bu shi gu yi xia hu ni de 。 wo zhi shi xiang wen yi ge wen ti 。]

english: Well, I guess so.
translation: 嗯，我想是这样。 [n ， wo xiang shi zhe yang 。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm barely surviving...
translation: 我快活不下去了... [wo kuai huo bu xia qu le ...]

english: When I'm not being drained of blood, the vyrewatch force me to repair the walls.
translation: 当我的血没有被吸干时，守卫会强迫我修复墙壁。 [dang wo de xue mei you bei xi gan shi ， shou wei hui qiang po wo xiu fu qiang bi 。]

english: When I'm not being drained of blood I'm fixing up the ghetto.
translation: 当我的血没有被吸干时，我就开始修复贫民窟。 [dang wo de xue mei you bei xi gan shi ， wo jiu kai shi xiu fu pin min ku 。]

english: I just try to make a living the best way I can. You haven't got some food have you?
translation: 我只是尽力以最好的方式谋生。你没有吃的吧？ [wo zhi shi jin li yi zui hao de fang shi mou sheng 。 ni mei you chi de ba ？]

english: Like everyone else, I just survive here. Just try to keep alive till after the next blood tithe. That's when they feed us.
translation: 和其他人一样，我只是在这里生存。尽量活到下一次血税之后。那是他们喂我们的时候。 [he qi ta ren yi yang ， wo zhi shi zai zhe li sheng cun 。 jin liang huo dao xia yi ci xue shui zhi hou 。 na shi ta men wei wo men de shi hou 。]

english: Why do you wanna know?
translation: 你为什么想知道？ [ni wei shen me xiang zhi dao ？]

english: Just curious, that's all.
translation: 只是好奇，仅此而已。 [zhi shi hao qi ， jin ci er yi 。]

english: I dunno. I don't know if I can trust you...
translation: 我不知道。我不知道我是否可以相信你... [wo bu zhi dao 。 wo bu zhi dao wo shi fou ke yi xiang xin ni ...]

english: I'm lost... Can you help me?
translation: 我迷路了...你能帮我吗？ [wo mi lu le ... ni neng bang wo ma ？]

english: Well, you're in sector [one/two/three/four/five/six], but if you were hoping for any other help then I'm very sorry. I find it hard enough to help myself.
translation: 好吧，您在[一/二/三/四/五/六]区域，但如果您希望获得任何其他帮助，那么我很抱歉。我发现很难帮助自己。 [hao ba ， nin zai [ yi / er / san / si / wu / liu ] qu yu ， dan ru guo nin xi wang huo de ren he qi ta bang zhu ， na me wo hen bao qian 。 wo fa xian hen nan bang zhu zi ji 。]

english: Life's so very hard here. Before too long they'll be wanting to have another blood tithing and then I'll feel just awful again.
translation: 这里的生活是如此艰难。过不了多久，他们就会想要再次进行血液什一奉献，然后我又会感觉很糟糕。 [zhe li de sheng huo shi ru ci jian nan 。 guo bu liao duo jiu ， ta men jiu hui xiang yao zai ci jin xing xue ye shen yi feng xian ， ran hou wo you hui gan jue hen zao gao 。]

english: What's a blood tithing?
translation: 什么是血什一奉献？ [shen me shi xue shen yi feng xian ？]

english: You must be new here, else you'd know for sure. It's where we have to give a blood tithe to the vampyres. They do it on a weekly basis, a different sector each week so they don't kill us all off.
translation: 你一定是新来的，否则你肯定知道。这是我们必须向吸血鬼缴纳血税的地方。他们每周都会这样做，每周都有不同的部门，这样他们就不会把我们都杀掉。 [ni yi ding shi xin lai de ， fou ze ni ken ding zhi dao 。 zhe shi wo men bi xu xiang xi xue gui jiao na xue shui de di fang 。 ta men mei zhou du hui zhe yang zuo ， mei zhou dou you bu tong de bu men ， zhe yang ta men jiu bu hui ba wo men dou sha diao 。]

english: Do you know about the Myreque?
translation: 你知道迈瑞克吗？ [ni zhi dao mai rui ke ma ？]

english: It's probably best not to talk about that, friend.
translation: 朋友，最好不要谈论这个。 [peng you ， zui hao bu yao tan lun zhe ge 。]

english: I need to make contact with them. Please don't worry - I'm on their side.
translation: 我需要和他们取得联系。请别担心——我站在他们一边。 [wo xu yao he ta men qu de lian xi 。 qing bie dan xin —— wo zhan zai ta men yi bian 。]

english: As are we all, but I really can't talk about them. It's not a subject easily broached here.
translation: 和我们所有人一样，但我真的不能谈论他们。这不是一个容易在这里提出的话题。 [he wo men suo you ren yi yang ， dan wo zhen de bu neng tan lun ta men 。 zhe bu shi yi ge rong yi zai zhe li ti chu de hua ti 。]

english: The Myreque are gone. Do not speak of them, it will do you no good.
translation: 迈雷克人不见了。不要谈论它们，这对你没有好处。 [mai lei ke ren bu jian le 。 bu yao tan lun ta men ， zhe dui ni mei you hao chu 。]

english: Can you tell me about the Sanguinesti region?
translation: 您能告诉我有关桑吉内什蒂地区的情况吗？ [nin neng gao su wo you guan sang ji nei shen di di qu de qing kuang ma ？]

english: Yep, that's where we are at the moment. This place, Meiyerditch, is just one large ghetto.
translation: 是的，这就是我们目前所处的情况。梅耶迪奇这个地方只是一个大贫民窟。 [shi de ， zhe jiu shi wo men mu qian suo chu de qing kuang 。 mei ye di qi zhe ge di fang zhi shi yi ge da pin min ku 。]

english: The city is sectioned off so that the vampyres can collect blood tithes on a rotational basis. That way they don't kill us all off in one go.
translation: 这座城市被隔离开来，以便吸血鬼可以轮流收集血液什一税。这样他们就不会一口气把我们全部杀掉。 [zhe zuo cheng shi bei ge li kai lai ， yi bian xi xue gui ke yi lun liu shou ji xue ye shen yi shui 。 zhe yang ta men jiu bu hui yi kou qi ba wo men quan bu sha diao 。]

english: What do you know about the vampyres?
translation: 关于吸血鬼你了解多少？ [guan yu xi xue gui ni liao jie duo shao ？]

english: They're monsters, I know that much. I've never known anything else, but I have a feeling it might be nice to not have to live in fear the whole time. Worrying if I'm going to make the next blood tithe quota.
translation: 他们是怪物，我就知道这么多。我一无所知，但我有一种感觉，不必一直生活在恐惧中可能会很好。担心我是否能完成下一个血税配额。 [ta men shi guai wu ， wo jiu zhi dao zhe me duo 。 wo yi wu suo zhi ， dan wo you yi zhong gan jue ， bu bi yi zhi sheng huo zai kong ju zhong ke neng hui hen hao 。 dan xin wo shi fou neng wan cheng xia yi ge xue shui pei e 。]

english: I know that the juveniles are the lowest form of the vampyres. Apparently they were human once, converted by the vampyres.
translation: 我知道，少年是吸血鬼中最低等的形态。显然他们曾经是人类，后来被吸血鬼转变了。 [wo zhi dao ， shao nian shi xi xue gui zhong zui di deng de xing tai 。 xian ran ta men ceng jing shi ren lei ， hou lai bei xi xue gui zhuan bian le 。]

english: Then you have juvinates. They're initiated juveniles who've had some training and are starting to get some powers.
translation: 然后你就有了青少年。他们是接受过一些训练并开始获得一些力量的入门青少年。 [ran hou ni jiu you le qing shao nian 。 ta men shi jie shou guo yi xie xun lian bing kai shi huo de yi xie li liang de ru men qing shao nian 。]

english: After that you have the vyres. They're nasty... really nasty.
translation: 之后你就有了 vyres。他们太恶心了……真的太恶心了。 [zhi hou ni jiu you le  vyres。 ta men tai e xin le …… zhen de tai e xin le 。]

english: What do you know about Drakan?
translation: 你对德拉坎了解多少？ [ni dui de la kan liao jie duo shao ？]

english: Drakan? Which one: Ranis or Vanescula?
translation: 德拉坎？哪一个：拉尼斯还是瓦内斯库拉？ [de la kan ？ na yi ge ： la ni si hai shi wa nei si ku la ？]

english: Well, I was referring to the main Drakan, you know, the overlord of Morytania.
translation: 嗯，我指的是主要的德拉坎，你知道，莫里塔尼亚的霸主。 [n ， wo zhi de shi zhu yao de de la kan ， ni zhi dao ， mo li ta ni ya de ba zhu 。]

english: Hmm, nothing has been seen of him for many years now. Some people say they occasionally see Ranis or Vanescula flying about, but it's not too often.
translation: 嗯，已经很多年没有见过他了。有人说他们偶尔会看到拉尼斯或瓦内斯库拉飞来飞去，但这种情况并不常见。 [n ， yi jing hen duo nian mei you jian guo ta le 。 you ren shuo ta men ou er hui kan dao la ni si huo wa nei si ku la fei lai fei qu ， dan zhe zhong qing kuang bing bu chang jian 。]

english: Vanescula?
translation: 瓦内斯库拉？ [wa nei si ku la ？]

english: Hmm, nothing has been seen of him for many years now. Some people say they occasionally see Vanescula flying about, but it's not too often.
translation: 嗯，已经很多年没有见过他了。有人说他们偶尔会看到瓦内斯库拉飞来飞去，但这种情况并不常见。 [n ， yi jing hen duo nian mei you jian guo ta le 。 you ren shuo ta men ou er hui kan dao wa nei si ku la fei lai fei qu ， dan zhe zhong qing kuang bing bu chang jian 。]

english: No one had seen anything of him for years, they say he's back now though. We shouldn't talk of him any more though, the vyrewatch might not like it.
translation: 多年来没有人见过他，但他们说他现在回来了。不过我们不应该再谈论他了，维勒观察者可能不喜欢这样。 [duo nian lai mei you ren jian guo ta ， dan ta men shuo ta xian zai hui lai le 。 bu guo wo men bu ying gai zai tan lun ta le ， wei lei guan cha zhe ke neng bu xi huan zhe yang 。]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: To do? Around here? Survive! Eke out an existence and just live for another day, that's it really.
translation: 做什么？这附近？存活！勉强维持生存，然后再活一天，就是这样。 [zuo shen me ？ zhe fu jin ？ cun huo ！ mian qiang wei chi sheng cun ， ran hou zai huo yi tian ， jiu shi zhe yang 。]

english: The juvinates organise work crews to mine the daeyalt, fix the walls, the castles and so on. If we refuse to do the work, they put us on double tithes and you can't do that for long before you dry up.
translation: 少年们组织工作人员开采黛雅特，修复城墙、城堡等。如果我们拒绝做这项工作，他们就会让我们缴纳双倍的什一税，而你做不了多久就会枯竭。 [shao nian men zu zhi gong zuo ren yuan kai cai dai ya te ， xiu fu cheng qiang 、 cheng bao deng 。 ru guo wo men ju jue zuo zhe xiang gong zuo ， ta men jiu hui rang wo men jiao na shuang bei de shen yi shui ， er ni zuo bu liao duo jiu jiu hui ku jie 。]

english: If you want to escape, there's only one way. Anyone who survives in the theatre gets to leave. It's pointless though. No one survives.
translation: 想要逃的话，只有一个办法。任何在剧院幸存的人都可以离开。但这毫无意义。无一人幸存。 [xiang yao tao de hua ， zhi you yi ge ban fa 。 ren he zai ju yuan xing cun de ren dou ke yi li kai 。 dan zhe hao wu yi yi 。 wu yi ren xing cun 。]

english: Is there anything I can do to help?
translation: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang mang de ma ？]

english: It's very nice of you to offer, my friend, but I shouldn't expect that you could do anything. The vampyres are just too powerful to overcome.
translation: 我的朋友，你能提供帮助真是太好了，但我不应该指望你能做任何事。吸血鬼太强大了，难以克服。 [wo de peng you ， ni neng ti gong bang zhu zhen shi tai hao le ， dan wo bu ying gai zhi wang ni neng zuo ren he shi 。 xi xue gui tai qiang da le ， nan yi ke fu 。]

english: They say this place once had a Saradominist Queen. Even she could not withstand the vampyres. Anyone who has challenged their power in the past has come undone.
translation: 他们说这个地方曾经有一位萨拉多米主义女王。即使是她也无法抵挡吸血鬼。任何过去挑战过他们权力的人都失败了。 [ta men shuo zhe ge di fang ceng jing you yi wei sa la duo mi zhu yi nv wang 。 ji shi shi ta ye wu fa di dang xi xue gui 。 ren he guo qu tiao zhan guo ta men quan li de ren dou shi bai le 。]

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: What're you doin' in here? You don't belong here! Go back to where you came from, 'fore the vyrewatch sees ya.
translation: 你在这儿做什么？你不属于这里！在维勒守卫看到你之前，回到你来的地方。 [ni zai zhe er zuo shen me ？ ni bu shu yu zhe li ！ zai wei lei shou wei kan dao ni zhi qian ， hui dao ni lai de di fang 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Oh... Sorry, we're not meant to talk to the nobles.
translation: 哦……抱歉，我们不是要和贵族说话。 [o …… bao qian ， wo men bu shi yao he gui zu shuo hua 。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm lost... Can you help me?
translation: 我迷路了...你能帮我吗？ [wo mi lu le ... ni neng bang wo ma ？]

english: Do you know about the Myreque?
translation: 你知道迈瑞克吗？ [ni zhi dao mai rui ke ma ？]

english: - More questions -
translation: - 更多问题- [-  geng duo wen ti -]

english: Can you tell me about the Sanguinesti region?
translation: 您能告诉我有关桑吉内什蒂地区的情况吗？ [nin neng gao su wo you guan sang ji nei shen di di qu de qing kuang ma ？]

english: What do you know about the vampyres?
translation: 关于吸血鬼你了解多少？ [guan yu xi xue gui ni liao jie duo shao ？]

english: What do you know about Drakan?
translation: 你对德拉坎了解多少？ [ni dui de la kan liao jie duo shao ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: Is there anything I can do to help?
translation: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang mang de ma ？]

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: - Initial questions -
translation: - 最初的问题 - [-  zui chu de wen ti  -]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Oh, hello, you must be new here.
translation: 哦，你好，你一定是新来的。 [o ， ni hao ， ni yi ding shi xin lai de 。]

english: Where are we?
translation: 我们在哪里？ [wo men zai na li ？]

english: What, you can't tell from your surroundings that you're in a mine? You must have been hit hard on the head to not notice that.
translation: 什么，你无法从周围的环境中看出你是在矿井里？你一定是头部受到重击才没有注意到这一点。 [shen me ， ni wu fa cong zhou wei de huan jing zhong kan chu ni shi zai kuang jing li ？ ni yi ding shi tou bu shou dao zhong ji cai mei you zhu yi dao zhe yi dian 。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: We're miners, perhaps that might give you a clue! We're forced to mine for those stinking vyres. Once we've filled the cart, they sometimes let us go back to Meiyerditch, but then we get tithed. Don't know if I
translation: 我们是矿工，也许这可以给你一些线索！我们被迫开采那些臭气熏天的矿井。一旦我们装满了车，他们有时会让我们回到梅耶迪奇，但随后我们会得到什一税。不知道我是否 [wo men shi kuang gong ， ye xu zhe ke yi gei ni yi xie xian suo ！ wo men bei po kai cai na xie chou qi xun tian de kuang jing 。 yi dan wo men zhuang man le che ， ta men you shi hui rang wo men hui dao mei ye di qi ， dan sui hou wo men hui de dao shen yi shui 。 bu zhi dao wo shi fou]

english: prefer it in here or out there!
translation: 更喜欢在这里或外面！ [geng xi huan zai zhe li huo wai mian ！]

english: Do you have a spare pick?
translation: 你还有空余的选秀权吗？ [ni hai you kong yu de xuan xiu quan ma ？]

english: Sure, got one here you can use.
translation: 当然，这里有一个你可以使用。 [dang ran ， zhe li you yi ge ni ke yi shi yong 。]

english: The miner hands you a rustic-looking pickaxe.
translation: 矿工递给你一把看起来质朴的镐。 [kuang gong di gei ni yi ba kan qi lai zhi piao de gao 。]

english: How do you get out of here?
translation: 你怎么离开这里？ [ni zen me li kai zhe li ？]

english: They can't keep you in here forever because they have to tithe you, so once you've filled the cart, they let you go. Takes about fifteen loads to get the cart filled.
translation: 他们不能永远把你留在这里，因为他们必须向你缴纳什一税，所以一旦你装满了购物车，他们就会让你走。大约需要十五次装载才能装满推车。 [ta men bu neng yong yuan ba ni liu zai zhe li ， yin wei ta men bi xu xiang ni jiao na shen yi shui ， suo yi yi dan ni zhuang man le gou wu che ， ta men jiu hui rang ni zou 。 da yue xu yao shi wu ci zhuang zai cai neng zhuang man tui che 。]

english: What is it that you're mining?
translation: 你在开采什么？ [ni zai kai cai shen me ？]

english: We're mining for daeyalt. Don't rightly know what it does - we don't ask too many questions - but I've been doing it since I was a kid. The carts keep getting filled, and they keep going along the tracks. Goes to some
translation: 我们正在开采达雅特。我不太清楚它的作用——我们不会问太多问题——但我从小就开始这么做了。推车不断地装满东西，并继续沿着轨道行驶。去一些 [wo men zheng zai kai cai da ya te 。 wo bu tai qing chu ta de zuo yong —— wo men bu hui wen tai duo wen ti —— dan wo cong xiao jiu kai shi zhe me zuo le 。 tui che bu duan di zhuang man dong xi ， bing ji xu yan zhe gui dao heng shi 。 qu yi xie]

english: huge refinery place, it does - massive, like another city under the earth.
translation: 巨大的炼油厂，确实如此——巨大，就像地球下的另一座城市。 [ju da de lian you chang ， que shi ru ci —— ju da ， jiu xiang di qiu xia de ling yi zuo cheng shi 。]

english: What? Have you seen this place?
translation: 什么？你见过这个地方吗？ [shen me ？ ni jian guo zhe ge di fang ma ？]

english: Not myself, like, but other people I know of have seen it and they wouldn't lie!
translation: 不是我自己，而是我认识的其他人都看过，他们不会撒谎！ [bu shi wo zi ji ， er shi wo ren shi de qi ta ren dou kan guo ， ta men bu hui sa huang ！]

english: You two shut up and get back to work!
translation: 你们两个闭嘴，回去工作吧！ [ni men liang ge bi zui ， hui qu gong zuo ba ！]

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: I can't think strait, I'm so tired.
translation: 我无法思考，我太累了。 [wo wu fa si kao ， wo tai lei le 。]

translation: 我太累了，我可以站着睡觉。 [wo tai lei le ， wo ke yi zhan zhe shui jiao 。]

english: What I wouldn't give for a good night's rest.
translation: 为了一夜安眠，我愿意付出一切。 [wei le yi ye an mian ， wo yuan yi fu chu yi qie 。]

english: Where are we?
translation: 我们在哪里？ [wo men zai na li ？]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Do you have a spare pick?
translation: 你还有空余的选秀权吗？ [ni hai you kong yu de xuan xiu quan ma ？]

english: How do you get out of here?
translation: 你怎么离开这里？ [ni zen me li kai zhe li ？]

english: What is it that you're mining?
translation: 你在开采什么？ [ni zai kai cai shen me ？]

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Good to see you safe friend.
translation: 很高兴见到你安全的朋友。 [hen gao xing jian dao ni an quan de peng you 。]

english: Why wouldn't I be safe?
translation: 为什么我会不安全？ [wei shen me wo hui bu an quan ？]

english: The Vyrewatch are getting more ferocious by the day. You're doing well if you can get from one side of Meiyerditch to the other without getting attacked!
translation: 维勒守望者日益凶猛。如果你能从梅耶迪奇的一侧到达另一侧而不受到攻击，那你就做得很好了！ [wei lei shou wang zhe ri yi xiong meng 。 ru guo ni neng cong mei ye di qi de yi ce dao da ling yi ce er bu shou dao gong ji ， na ni jiu zuo de hen hao le ！]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Hi. Welcome to the general store. How might I help you?
translation: 你好。欢迎来到综合商店。我可以怎样帮助你？ [ni hao 。 huan ying lai dao zong he shang dian 。 wo ke yi zen yang bang zhu ni ？]

english: What can you sell me?
translation: 你能卖给我什么？ [ni neng mai gei wo shen me ？]

english: I have a question...
translation: 我有一个问题... [wo you yi ge wen ti ...]

english: About magic of course.
translation: 当然是关于魔法。 [dang ran shi guan yu mo fa 。]

english: Sorry?
translation: 对不起？ [dui bu qi ？]

english: I said about magic of course. You know, in response to your question.
translation: 我当然说的是魔法。你知道，回答你的问题。 [wo dang ran shuo de shi mo fa 。 ni zhi dao ， hui da ni de wen ti 。]

english: But I didn't ask anything yet.
translation: 但我还没问什么。 [dan wo hai mei wen shen me 。]

english: Yes, but you were thinking of asking me how I was floating.
translation: 是的，但你想问我是如何漂浮的。 [shi de ， dan ni xiang wen wo shi ru he piao fu de 。]

english: That's true!
translation: 这是真的！ [zhe shi zhen de ！]

english: How could you possibly know that?
translation: 你怎么可能知道？ [ni zen me ke neng zhi dao ？]

english: Don't you realise we can read your mind.
translation: 你难道没有意识到我们可以读懂你的想法吗？ [ni nan dao mei you yi shi dao wo men ke yi du dong ni de xiang fa ma ？]

english: Oh, of course. How do you manage to do that?
translation: 哦，当然。你是如何做到这一点的？ [o ， dang ran 。 ni shi ru he zuo dao zhe yi dian de ？]

english: It's quite simple, everyone has a resonance that is responded to by the moon. This resonance changes depending on what we are thinking. You can tune yourself in to listen to this resonance with practice - it's
translation: 很简单，每个人都有一种共鸣，月亮也会回应。这种共鸣会根据我们的想法而变化。你可以通过练习调整自己来聆听这种共鸣 - 它是 [hen jian dan ， mei ge ren dou you yi zhong gong ming ， yue liang ye hui hui ying 。 zhe zhong gong ming hui gen ju wo men de xiang fa er bian hua 。 ni ke yi tong guo lian xi tiao zheng zi ji lai ling ting zhe zhong gong ming  -  ta shi]

english: a life long quest for the members of the Moon Clan, but its especially easy to read with outsiders like yourself, as you are far louder and unguarded.
translation: 这是月族成员毕生的追求，但对于像你这样的外人来说，这尤其容易阅读，因为你的声音更大，而且毫无防备。 [zhe shi yue zu cheng yuan bi sheng de zhui qiu ， dan dui yu xiang ni zhe yang de wai ren lai shuo ， zhe you qi rong yi yue du ， yin wei ni de sheng yin geng da ， er qie hao wu fang bei 。]

english: I see. I best be careful with what I think of then.
translation: 我懂了。我最好小心我当时的想法。 [wo dong le 。 wo zui hao xiao xin wo dang shi de xiang fa 。]

english: That's disgusting!
translation: 太恶心了！ [tai e xin le ！]

english: Sorry.
translation: 对不起。 [dui bu qi 。]

english: I'm good thanks, bye.
translation: 我很好，谢谢，再见。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie ， zai jian 。]

english: What can you sell me?
translation: 你能卖给我什么？ [ni neng mai gei wo shen me ？]

english: I have a question...
translation: 我有一个问题... [wo you yi ge wen ti ...]

english: I'm good thanks, bye.
translation: 我很好，谢谢，再见。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie ， zai jian 。]

english: Greetings adventurer, I am the Melee combat tutor. Is there anything I can do for you?
translation: 各位冒险家大家好，我是近战格斗导师。有什么我可以为您做的吗？ [ge wei mao xian jia da jia hao ， wo shi jin zhan ge dou dao shi 。 you shen me wo ke yi wei nin zuo de ma ？]

english: Tell me about melee combat.
translation: 告诉我近战的事。 [gao su wo jin zhan de shi 。]

english: Well adventurer, the first thing you will need is a sword and a shield appropriate for your level.
translation: 好吧，冒险家，你首先需要的是适合你等级的剑和盾。 [hao ba ， mao xian jia ， ni shou xian xu yao de shi shi he ni deng ji de jian he dun 。]

english: Make sure to equip your sword and shield. Click on them in your inventory, they will disappear from your inventory and move to your worn items. You can see your worn items in the worn items tab here.
translation: 确保装备好你的剑和盾牌。在您的库存中点击它们，它们将从您的库存中消失并移至您的磨损物品中。您可以在此处的“磨损物品”选项卡中查看您的磨损物品。 [que bao zhuang bei hao ni de jian he dun pai 。 zai nin de ku cun zhong dian ji ta men ， ta men jiang cong nin de ku cun zhong xiao shi bing yi zhi nin de mo sun wu pin zhong 。 nin ke yi zai ci chu de “ mo sun wu pin ” xuan xiang ka zhong cha kan nin de mo sun wu pin 。]

english: When you are wielding your sword you will then be able to see the correct options in the combat interface.
translation: 当你挥舞你的剑时，你将能够在战斗界面中看到正确的选项。 [dang ni hui wu ni de jian shi ， ni jiang neng gou zai zhan dou jie mian zhong kan dao zheng que de xuan xiang 。]

english: There are four different melee styles. Accurate, aggressive, defensive and controlled. Not all weapons will have all four styles though.
translation: 有四种不同的近战风格。准确、侵略性、防御性和控制性。但并非所有武器都会具有所有四种样式。 [you si zhong bu tong de jin zhan feng ge 。 zhun que 、 qin lve xing 、 fang yu xing he kong zhi xing 。 dan bing fei suo you wu qi du hui ju you suo you si zhong yang shi 。]

english: Interesting, what does each style do?
translation: 有趣的是，每种风格都有什么作用？ [you qu de shi ， mei zhong feng ge dou you shen me zuo yong ？]

english: Well I am glad you asked. The accurate style will give you experience points in your Attack skill, you will also find you will deal damage more frequently as a result of being, well, more accurate.
translation: 嗯，我很高兴你问。准确的风格会给你的攻击技能带来经验值，你还会发现，由于更加准确，你会更频繁地造成伤害。 [n ， wo hen gao xing ni wen 。 zhun que de feng ge hui gei ni de gong ji ji neng dai lai jing yan zhi ， ni hai hui fa xian ， you yu geng jia zhun que ， ni hui geng pin fan di zao cheng shang hai 。]

english: Next we have the aggressive style. This style will give you experience points in your Strength skill. When using this style you will notice that your attacks will hit a little harder.
translation: 接下来我们有进攻风格。这种风格将为您的力量技能提供经验值。当使用这种风格时，你会发现你的攻击会更猛烈一些。 [jie xia lai wo men you jin gong feng ge 。 zhe zhong feng ge jiang wei nin de li liang ji neng ti gong jing yan zhi 。 dang shi yong zhe zhong feng ge shi ， ni hui fa xian ni de gong ji hui geng meng lie yi xie 。]

english: Now for the defensive style, this style will give you experience points in your Defensive skill. When using this style you will notice that you get hit less often.
translation: 现在是防守风格，这种风格会给你的防守技能带来经验值。当使用这种风格时，你会发现你被击中的频率减少了。 [xian zai shi fang shou feng ge ， zhe zhong feng ge hui gei ni de fang shou ji neng dai lai jing yan zhi 。 dang shi yong zhe zhong feng ge shi ， ni hui fa xian ni bei ji zhong de pin lv jian shao le 。]

english: Finally, we have the controlled style. This style will give you the same amount of experience as the other styles would but shared across all three of the combat skills.
translation: 最后，我们有受控的风格。这种风格将为您提供与其他风格相同的经验，但在所有三种战斗技能中共享。 [zui hou ， wo men you shou kong de feng ge 。 zhe zhong feng ge jiang wei nin ti gong yu qi ta feng ge xiang tong de jing yan ， dan zai suo you san zhong zhan dou ji neng zhong gong xiang 。]

english: If you were using the training sword for example, there are four different attack types. Stab, lunge, slash and block.
translation: 例如，如果您使用训练剑，则有四种不同的攻击类型。刺、刺、砍、格挡。 [li ru ， ru guo nin shi yong xun lian jian ， ze you si zhong bu tong de gong ji lei xing 。 ci 、 ci 、 kan 、 ge dang 。]

english: Each type uses one of the attack styles. Stab uses accurate, lunge and slash use aggressive and block uses defensive.
translation: 每种类型都使用一种攻击方式。刺击使用准确，弓步和斜砍使用攻击性，格挡使用防御性。 [mei zhong lei xing dou shi yong yi zhong gong ji fang shi 。 ci ji shi yong zhun que ， gong bu he xie kan shi yong gong ji xing ， ge dang shi yong fang yu xing 。]

english: To find out which style an attack type uses, hover your mouse cursor over the style button.
translation: 要找出攻击类型使用的样式，请将鼠标光标悬停在样式按钮上。 [yao zhao chu gong ji lei xing shi yong de yang shi ， qing jiang shu biao guang biao xuan ting zai yang shi an niu shang 。]

english: If you need some more advice, you should talk to Adventurer Jon about Adventure paths. He may even have a handy starter kit you can use.
translation: 如果您需要更多建议，您应该与冒险家乔恩讨论冒险路径。他甚至可能有一个方便的入门套件供您使用。 [ru guo nin xu yao geng duo jian yi ， nin ying gai yu mao xian jia qiao en tao lun mao xian lu jing 。 ta shen zhi ke neng you yi ge fang bian de ru men tao jian gong nin shi yong 。]

english: Is there anything else you would like to know?
translation: 您还有什么想知道的吗？ [nin hai you shen me xiang zhi dao de ma ？]

english: What if I wanted to fight something a bit more... human.
translation: 如果我想与更人类的东西战斗怎么办？ [ru guo wo xiang yu geng ren lei de dong xi zhan dou zen me ban ？]

english: Well adventurer, there are a few places you might be able to do this.
translation: 好吧，冒险家，有几个地方你可以做到这一点。 [hao ba ， mao xian jia ， you ji ge di fang ni ke yi zuo dao zhe yi dian 。]

english: You could try your luck at castle wars. Here, two teams fight each other to defend their respective flags. To win the game you will need to get the other team's flag and return it to your flag stand.
translation: 你可以在城堡战争中碰碰运气。在这里，两支队伍为了保卫各自的旗帜而互相战斗。要赢得比赛，您需要拿到对方球队的旗帜并将其放回自己的旗架上。 [ni ke yi zai cheng bao zhan zheng zhong peng peng yun qi 。 zai zhe li ， liang zhi dui wu wei le bao wei ge zi de qi zhi er hu xiang zhan dou 。 yao ying de bi sai ， nin xu yao na dao dui fang qiu dui de qi zhi bing jiang qi fang hui zi ji de qi jia shang 。]

english: Capture the flag, sounds like a lot of fun.
translation: 夺旗，听起来很有趣。 [duo qi ， ting qi lai hen you qu 。]

english: If you are in a clan, you should gather some clan members and try out clan wars. There you can see which clan is better than the other by fighting each other in an arena.
translation: 如果你在部落中，你应该聚集一些部落成员并尝试部落战争。在那里，你可以通过在竞技场中互相战斗来了解哪个部落比另一个部落更好。 [ru guo ni zai bu luo zhong ， ni ying gai ju ji yi xie bu luo cheng yuan bing chang shi bu luo zhan zheng 。 zai na li ， ni ke yi tong guo zai jing ji chang zhong hu xiang zhan dou lai liao jie na ge bu luo bi ling yi ge bu luo geng hao 。]

english: Both activities are safe minigame, which means if you die you will not loose any of your items. You can get to them by using the teleport option in your minigames tab.
translation: 这两项活动都是安全的迷你游戏，这意味着如果你死了，你不会失去任何物品。您可以使用迷你游戏选项卡中的传送选项来到达它们。 [zhe liang xiang huo dong dou shi an quan de mi ni you xi ， zhe yi wei zhe ru guo ni si le ， ni bu hui shi qu ren he wu pin 。 nin ke yi shi yong mi ni you xi xuan xiang ka zhong de chuan song xuan xiang lai dao da ta men 。]

english: There is also the wilderness. The wilderness is north of Varrock and you can fight other players there. But barein mind if you die to another player in the wilderness you will lose your stuff.
translation: 还有荒野。荒野位于 Varrock 的北部，你可以在那里与其他玩家战斗。但请记住，如果你在荒野中被其他玩家杀死，你就会失去你的东西。 [hai you huang ye 。 huang ye wei yu  Varrock  de bei bu ， ni ke yi zai na li yu qi ta wan jia zhan dou 。 dan qing ji zhu ， ru guo ni zai huang ye zhong bei qi ta wan jia sha si ， ni jiu hui shi qu ni de dong xi 。]

english: But this also means that if you kill another player you will be able to take their stuff too.
translation: 但这也意味着，如果你杀死另一个玩家，你也可以拿走他们的东西。 [dan zhe ye yi wei zhe ， ru guo ni sha si ling yi ge wan jia ， ni ye ke yi na zou ta men de dong xi 。]

english: Only go into the wilderness with items you are willing to lose and pay attention to the wilderness level you are in. The higher the level you go, more player will be able to attack you.
translation: 只带着你愿意失去的物品进入荒野，并注意你所在的荒野等级。你的等级越高，就会有更多的玩家能够攻击你。 [zhi dai zhe ni yuan yi shi qu de wu pin jin ru huang ye ， bing zhu yi ni suo zai de huang ye deng ji 。 ni de deng ji yue gao ， jiu hui you geng duo de wan jia neng gou gong ji ni 。]

english: You can find which player can attack you by checking your combat level.
translation: 你可以通过查看你的战斗等级来找到哪个玩家可以攻击你。 [ni ke yi tong guo cha kan ni de zhan dou deng ji lai zhao dao na ge wan jia ke yi gong ji ni 。]

english: Minus the wilderness level from your combat level to find the lowest level that you can attack, then add the wilderness level to your combat level to find the highest level that you can attack.
translation: 从你的战斗等级中减去荒野等级来找到你可以攻击的最低等级，然后将荒野等级添加到你的战斗等级中找到你可以攻击的最高等级。 [cong ni de zhan dou deng ji zhong jian qu huang ye deng ji lai zhao dao ni ke yi gong ji de zui di deng ji ， ran hou jiang huang ye deng ji tian jia dao ni de zhan dou deng ji zhong zhao dao ni ke yi gong ji de zui gao deng ji 。]

english: Tell me about different weapon types I can use.
translation: 告诉我我可以使用的不同武器类型。 [gao su wo wo ke yi shi yong de bu tong wu qi lei xing 。]

english: Tell me about different weapon types I can use
translation: 告诉我我可以使用的不同武器类型 [gao su wo wo ke yi shi yong de bu tong wu qi lei xing]

english: Well let me see now...There are stabbing type weapons such as daggers, then you have swords which are slashing, maces that have great crushing abilities, battle axes which are powerful.
translation: 好吧，现在让我看看......有刺击型武器，例如匕首，然后有可以砍杀的剑，有强大粉碎能力的狼牙棒，还有威力强大的战斧。 [hao ba ， xian zai rang wo kan kan ...... you ci ji xing wu qi ， li ru bi shou ， ran hou you ke yi kan sha de jian ， you qiang da fen sui neng li de lang ya bang ， hai you wei li qiang da de zhan fu 。]

english: It depends a lot on how you want to fight. Experiment and find out what is best for you. Never be scared to try out a new weapon; you never know, you might like it!
translation: 这在很大程度上取决于你想如何战斗。尝试并找出最适合您的方法。永远不要害怕尝试新武器；你永远不知道，你可能会喜欢它！ [zhe zai hen da cheng du shang qu jue yu ni xiang ru he zhan dou 。 chang shi bing zhao chu zui shi he nin de fang fa 。 yong yuan bu yao hai pa chang shi xin wu qi ； ni yong yuan bu zhi dao ， ni ke neng hui xi huan ta ！]

english: While I tried all of them for a while, I settled on this rather good sword.
translation: 虽然我尝试了所有这些剑一段时间，但我最终选择了这把相当不错的剑。 [sui ran wo chang shi le suo you zhe xie jian yi duan shi jian ， dan wo zui zhong xuan ze le zhe ba xiang dang bu cuo de jian 。]

english: You might also find that different weapon types are more accurate against different monsters.
translation: 您可能还会发现不同的武器类型针对不同的怪物更准确。 [nin ke neng hai hui fa xian bu tong de wu qi lei xing zhen dui bu tong de guai wu geng zhun que 。]

english: Tell me about skillcapes
translation: 告诉我有关技能角的信息 [gao su wo you guan ji neng jiao de xin xi]

english: Tell me about skillcapes.
translation: 告诉我有关技能披风的事。 [gao su wo you guan ji neng pi feng de shi 。]

english: Of course. Skillcapes are a symbol of achievement. Only people who have mastered a skill and reached level 99 can get their hands on them and gain the benefits they carry.
translation: 当然。技能斗篷是成就的象征。只有掌握了一项技能并达到99级的人才能获得它们并获得它们所带来的好处。 [dang ran 。 ji neng dou peng shi cheng jiu de xiang zheng 。 zhi you zhang wo le yi xiang ji neng bing da dao 99 ji de ren cai neng huo de ta men bing huo de ta men suo dai lai de hao chu 。]

english: The Cape of Defence will act as ring of life, saving you from combat if your hitpoints become low.
translation: 防御角将充当生命之环，在你的生命值变低时使你免于战斗。 [fang yu jiao jiang chong dang sheng ming zhi huan ， zai ni de sheng ming zhi bian di shi shi ni mian yu zhan dou 。]

english: I'd like a training sword and shield.
translation: 我想要一把训练剑和盾牌。 [wo xiang yao yi ba xun lian jian he dun pai 。]

english: You already have a training sword and shield. Save some for the other adventurers.
translation: 你已经有了训练剑和盾牌。留一些给其他冒险家。 [ni yi jing you le xun lian jian he dun pai 。 liu yi xie gei qi ta mao xian jia 。]

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 还有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [hai you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

english: There you go, use it well.
translation: 就这样吧，好好利用吧。 [jiu zhe yang ba ， hao hao li yong ba 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Ah, but I can see you're already a master in the fine art of Defence. Perhaps you have come to me to purchase a Skillcape of Defence, and thus join the elite few who have mastered this exacting skill?
translation: 啊，但我看得出你已经是防御艺术的大师了。也许你来找我是为了购买防御技能斗篷，从而加入掌握这项严格技能的少数精英行列？ [a ， dan wo kan de chu ni yi jing shi fang yu yi shu de da shi le 。 ye xu ni lai zhao wo shi wei le gou mai fang yu ji neng dou peng ， cong er jia ru zhang wo zhe xiang yan ge ji neng de shao shu jing ying hang lie ？]

english: In recognition of your defensive abilities, when you have it equipped it will act as ring of life, saving you from combat if your hitpoints become low.
translation: 为了识别你的防御能力，当你装备它时，它会充当生命之环，在你的生命值变低时使你免于战斗。 [wei le shi bie ni de fang yu neng li ， dang ni zhuang bei ta shi ， ta hui chong dang sheng ming zhi huan ， zai ni de sheng ming zhi bian di shi shi ni mian yu zhan dou 。]

english: May I buy a Skillcape of Defence, please?
translation: 请问我可以购买防御技能斗篷吗？ [qing wen wo ke yi gou mai fang yu ji neng dou peng ma ？]

english: You wish to join the elite defenders of this world? I'm afraid such things do not come cheaply - in fact they cost 99000 coins, to be precise!
translation: 您想加入这个世界的精英捍卫者行列吗？这样的东西恐怕不便宜，准确的说，要99000金币！ [nin xiang jia ru zhe ge shi jie de jing ying han wei zhe hang lie ma ？ zhe yang de dong xi kong pa bu bian yi ， zhun que de shuo ， yao 99000 jin bi ！]

english: 99000 coins? That's much too expensive.
translation: 99000金币？那太贵了。 [99000 jin bi ？ na tai gui le 。]

english: Not at all; there are many other adventurers who would love the opportunity to purchase such a prestigious item! You can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: 一点也不;还有许多其他冒险家希望有机会购买如此享有盛誉的物品！如果你改变主意，可以在这里找到我。 [yi dian ye bu ; hai you xu duo qi ta mao xian jia xi wang you ji hui gou mai ru ci xiang you sheng yu de wu pin ！ ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， ke yi zai zhe li zhao dao wo 。]

english: I think I have the money right here, actually.
translation: 我想我这里确实有钱。 [wo xiang wo zhe li que shi you qian 。]

english: But, unfortunately, I was mistaken.
translation: 但不幸的是，我错了。 [dan bu xing de shi ， wo cuo le 。]

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 好吧，等你回来了就回来见我吧。 [hao ba ， deng ni hui lai le jiu hui lai jian wo ba 。]

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 不幸的是，所有技能斗篷都只提供免费兜帽，这是技能升级交易的一部分；买一送一，你懂的。因此，在我向您出售一件之前，您需要释放一些库存空间。 [bu xing de shi ， suo you ji neng dou peng dou zhi ti gong mian fei dou mao ， zhe shi ji neng sheng ji jiao yi de yi bu fen ； mai yi song yi ， ni dong de 。 yin ci ， zai wo xiang nin chu shou yi jian zhi qian ， nin xu yao shi fang yi xie ku cun kong jian 。]

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: 出色的！我的朋友，自豪地穿上那件斗篷。 [chu se de ！ wo de peng you ， zi hao di chuan shang na jian dou peng 。]

english: Tell me about melee combat.
translation: 告诉我近战的事。 [gao su wo jin zhan de shi 。]

english: What if I wanted to fight something a bit more... human.
translation: 如果我想与更人类的东西战斗怎么办？ [ru guo wo xiang yu geng ren lei de dong xi zhan dou zen me ban ？]

english: Tell me about skillcapes.
translation: 告诉我有关技能披风的事。 [gao su wo you guan ji neng pi feng de shi 。]

english: I'd like a training sword and shield.
translation: 我想要一把训练剑和盾牌。 [wo xiang yao yi ba xun lian jian he dun pai 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Yes, please sell me a Skillcape of Defence.
translation: 是的，请卖给我一件防御技能斗篷。 [shi de ， qing mai gei wo yi jian fang yu ji neng dou peng 。]

english: 99000 coins? That's much too expensive.
translation: 99000金币？那太贵了。 [99000 jin bi ？ na tai gui le 。]

english: I think I have the money right here, actually.
translation: 我想我这里确实有钱。 [wo xiang wo zhe li que shi you qian 。]

english: Can you tell me about different weapon types I can use?
translation: 你能告诉我我可以使用的不同武器类型吗？ [ni neng gao su wo wo ke yi shi yong de bu tong wu qi lei xing ma ？]

english: Ssssh! I'm trying to study.
translation: 嘘！我正在努力学习。 [xu ！ wo zheng zai nu li xue xi 。]

english: Sorry, but could...
translation: 抱歉，但是可以... [bao qian ， dan shi ke yi ...]

english: Ssssh!
translation: 嘘！ [xu ！]

english: But I...
translation: 但我... [dan wo ...]

english: SSHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!
translation: 嘘哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！ [xu ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ！]

english: I can't believe we've finally arrived, I can't wait to explore!
translation: 我不敢相信我们终于到达了，我迫不及待地想探索！ [wo bu gan xiang xin wo men zhong yu dao da le ， wo po bu ji dai di xiang tan suo ！]

english: So much to see, I don't know where to start!
translation: 太多东西要看，我不知道从哪里开始！ [tai duo dong xi yao kan ， wo bu zhi dao cong na li kai shi ！]

english: A whole new continent to explore... what a time to be alive!
translation: 一个全新的大陆等待探索……多么美好的时光啊！ [yi ge quan xin de da lu deng dai tan suo …… duo me mei hao de shi guang a ！]

english: Are you the tour guide?
translation: 你是导游吗？ [ni shi dao you ma ？]

english: Nope, I'm just as lost as you.
translation: 不，我和你一样迷失。 [bu ， wo he ni yi yang mi shi 。]

english: I overheard someone mention there are pirates and thieves here, be careful!
translation: 我无意中听到有人说这里有海盗和小偷，要小心！ [wo wu yi zhong ting dao you ren shuo zhe li you hai dao he xiao tou ， yao xiao xin ！]

english: By the power of custard!
translation: 靠蛋奶冻的力量！ [kao dan nai dong de li liang ！]

english: Feel the wrath of my feet!
translation: 感受我脚下的愤怒吧！ [gan shou wo jiao xia de fen nu ba ！]

english: Let me drink my tea in peace.
translation: 让我安静地喝茶吧。 [rang wo an jing di he cha ba 。]

english: Leave me alone, I need to feed my pet rock.
translation: 别管我，我需要喂我的宠物石头。 [bie guan wo ， wo xu yao wei wo de chong wu shi tou 。]

english: I'll not get through these gates; they're too heavily boarded up!
translation: 我不会跨过这些大门；他们用木板封得太严了！ [wo bu hui kua guo zhe xie da men ； ta men yong mu ban feng de tai yan le ！]

english: ...And these walls don't look very climbable at all.
translation: ......而且这些墙看起来根本不适合攀爬。 [...... er qie zhe xie qiang kan qi lai gen ben bu shi he pan pa 。]

english: That's right, clear off. You're not welcome here!
translation: 没错，清除。这里不欢迎你！ [mei cuo ， qing chu 。 zhe li bu huan ying ni ！]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？ [ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Nothing really, I'm new to town and wanted to get to know the locals.
translation: 没什么，我是新来的，想认识当地人。 [mei shen me ， wo shi xin lai de ， xiang ren shi dang di ren 。]

english: I'm too busy for chitchat. Come back if you have some business to discuss with us.
translation: 我太忙了，没时间闲聊。如果您有事要与我们讨论，请回来。 [wo tai mang le ， mei shi jian xian liao 。 ru guo nin you shi yao yu wo men tao lun ， qing hui lai 。]

english: Yeah, what do you want?
translation: 是啊，你想要什么？ [shi a ， ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: It's none of your business now get lost.
translation: 现在迷路不关你的事。 [xian zai mi lu bu guan ni de shi 。]

english: Perhaps five gold coins will make it my business?
translation: 或许五枚金币就可以成为我的事了？ [huo xu wu mei jin bi jiu ke yi cheng wei wo de shi le ？]

english: Don't try to fool me, you don't have five gold coins! Before you try to bribe someone, make sure you have the money effendi!
translation: 别骗我，你没有五金币！在你试图贿赂某人之前，请确保你有钱！ [bie pian wo ， ni mei you wu jin bi ！ zai ni shi tu hui lu mou ren zhi qian ， qing que bao ni you qian ！]

english: Guards!! Guards!
translation: 卫兵！！卫兵！ [wei bing ！！ wei bing ！]

english: Let's see how good you are with Desert Survival techniques.
translation: 让我们看看您的沙漠生存技术有多好。 [rang wo men kan kan nin de sha mo sheng cun ji shu you duo hao 。]

english: You're bundled into the back of a cart and blindfolded...
translation: 你被绑在一辆手推车的后面，并被蒙住眼睛...... [ni bei bang zai yi liang shou tui che de hou mian ， bing bei meng zhu yan jing ......]

english: Sometime later you wake up in the desert.
translation: 过了一段时间，你在沙漠中醒来。 [guo le yi duan shi jian ， ni zai sha mo zhong xing lai 。]

english: You won't be needing that water anymore!
translation: 你将不再需要那些水了！ [ni jiang bu zai xu yao na xie shui le ！]

english: The guards move off leaving you stranded in the desert.
translation: 守卫离开，你被困在沙漠里。 [shou wei li kai ， ni bei kun zai sha mo li 。]

english: Well, it certainly will help...-- The guard takes the five gold coins. --Now then, what did you want to know?
translation: 嗯，肯定会有帮助的……—— 守卫拿走了五枚金币。 ——那么，你想知道什么？ [n ， ken ding hui you bang zhu de ……——  shou wei na zou le wu mei jin bi 。 —— na me ， ni xiang zhi dao shen me ？]

english: It's just a mining camp. Prisoners are sent here from Al-Kharid. They serve out their sentence by mining. Most prisoners will end their days here, surrounded by desert.
translation: 这只是一个采矿营地。囚犯从哈利德被送往这里。他们通过采矿来服刑。大多数囚犯将在这里结束他们的日子，周围都是沙漠。 [zhe zhi shi yi ge cai kuang ying di 。 qiu fan cong ha li de bei song wang zhe li 。 ta men tong guo cai kuang lai fu xing 。 da duo shu qiu fan jiang zai zhe li jie shu ta men de ri zi ， zhou wei dou shi sha mo 。]

english: So you could almost say that they got their ... 'Just Desserts'
translation: 所以你几乎可以说他们得到了他们的......“只是甜点” [suo yi ni ji hu ke yi shuo ta men de dao le ta men de ......“ zhi shi tian dian ”]

english: You could say that...-- There is an awkward pause --
translation: 你可以说……有一个尴尬的停顿—— [ni ke yi shuo …… you yi ge gan ga de ting dun ——]

english: But it wouldn't be very funny.
translation: 但这不会很有趣。 [dan zhe bu hui hen you qu 。]

english: When they talk about 'the silence of the desert', this must be what they mean.
translation: 当他们谈论“沙漠的寂静”时，他们想必就是这个意思。 [dang ta men tan lun “ sha mo de ji jing ” shi ， ta men xiang bi jiu shi zhe ge yi si 。]

english: Can I take a look around the place?
translation: 我可以参观一下这个地方吗？ [wo ke yi can guan yi xia zhe ge di fang ma ？]

english: Not really. The Captain won't let you in the compound. He's the only one who has the key to the gate. And if you talk to him, he'll probably just order us to kill you. Unless...
translation: 并不真地。队长不会让你进入大院的。他是唯一拥有大门钥匙的人。如果你跟他说话，他可能会命令我们杀了你。除非... [bing bu zhen di 。 dui zhang bu hui rang ni jin ru da yuan de 。 ta shi wei yi yong you da men yao shi de ren 。 ru guo ni gen ta shuo hua ， ta ke neng hui ming ling wo men sha le ni 。 chu fei ...]

english: Unless what?
translation: 除非什么？ [chu fei shen me ？]

english: Unless he has a use for you. He's been trying to track down someone called 'Al Zaba Bhasim'. You could offer to catch him and that might put you in his good books?
translation: 除非他对你有用。他一直在试图追踪一个名叫“Al Zaba Bhasim”的人。你可以主动提出去抓住他，这可能会让你列入他的好名单吗？ [chu fei ta dui ni you yong 。 ta yi zhi zai shi tu zhui zong yi ge ming jiao “Al Zaba Bhasim” de ren 。 ni ke yi zhu dong ti chu qu zhua zhu ta ， zhe ke neng hui rang ni lie ru ta de hao ming dan ma ？]

english: Where would I find this Al Zaba Bhasim?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到这个 Al Zaba Bhasim？ [wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao zhe ge  Al Zaba Bhasim？]

english: Well, he could be anywhere. He's a nomadic desert dweller. However, they say that he's frequently to be found to the west in the hospitality of the tenti's.
translation: 好吧，他可以在任何地方。他是一个沙漠游牧居民。然而，他们说，他经常在西方的坦蒂人的热情款待中被发现。 [hao ba ， ta ke yi zai ren he di fang 。 ta shi yi ge sha mo you mu ju min 。 ran er ， ta men shuo ， ta jing chang zai xi fang de tan di ren de re qing kuan dai zhong bei fa xian 。]

english: The Tenti's, who are they?
translation: 坦蒂一家，他们是谁？ [tan di yi jia ， ta men shi shui ？]

english: Well, we're not really sure what their proper name is. But they live in tents so we call them the 'Tenti's'.
translation: 好吧，我们不太确定他们的正确名字是什么。但他们住在帐篷里，所以我们称他们为“帐篷”。 [hao ba ， wo men bu tai que ding ta men de zheng que ming zi shi shen me 。 dan ta men zhu zai zhang peng li ， suo yi wo men cheng ta men wei “ zhang peng ”。]

english: Is Al Zaba Bhasim very tough?
translation: 扎巴·巴西姆（Al Zaba Bhasim）很强硬吗？ [zha ba · ba xi mu （Al Zaba Bhasim） hen qiang ying ma ？]

english: Well, I'm not sure, but by all accounts, he is a slippery fellow. The Captain has been trying to capture him for years. A bit of a waste of time if you ask me. Anyway, I have to get going, I do have work to do.
translation: 嗯，我不确定，但从各方面来看，他是个狡猾的家伙。多年来，船长一直试图抓住他。如果你问我的话，有点浪费时间。无论如何，我得走了，我还有工作要做。 [n ， wo bu que ding ， dan cong ge fang mian lai kan ， ta shi ge jiao hua de jia huo 。 duo nian lai ， chuan zhang yi zhi shi tu zhua zhu ta 。 ru guo ni wen wo de hua ， you dian lang fei shi jian 。 wu lun ru he ， wo de zou le ， wo hai you gong zuo yao zuo 。]

english: What are you guarding?
translation: 你在守护什么？ [ni zai shou hu shen me ？]

english: Well, if you have to know, we're making sure that no prisoners get out.-- The guard gives you a disapproving look. --And to make sure that unauthorised people don't get in.
translation: 好吧，如果你一定要知道的话，我们会确保没有囚犯逃出来。--看守给了你一个不赞成的眼神。 ——并确保未经授权的人无法进入。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni yi ding yao zhi dao de hua ， wo men hui que bao mei you qiu fan tao chu lai 。-- kan shou gei le ni yi ge bu zan cheng de yan shen 。 —— bing que bao wei jing shou quan de ren wu fa jin ru 。]

english: -- The guard looks around nervously. --You'd better go soon before the Captain orders us to kill you.
translation: ——警卫紧张地环顾四周。 ——你最好在船长命令我们杀掉你之前赶紧走。 [—— jing wei jin zhang di huan gu si zhou 。 —— ni zui hao zai chuan zhang ming ling wo men sha diao ni zhi qian gan jin zou 。]

english: Does the Captain order you to kill a lot of people?
translation: 队长命令你杀很多人吗？ [dui zhang ming ling ni sha hen duo ren ma ？]

english: -- The guard snorts. --*Snort* Just about anyone who talks to him.
translation: ——守卫哼了一声。 --*哼哼* 几乎所有与他交谈的人。 [—— shou wei heng le yi sheng 。 --* heng heng *  ji hu suo you yu ta jiao tan de ren 。]

english: Unless he has a use for you, he'll probably just order us to kill you. And it's such a horrible job cleaning up the mess afterwards.
translation: 除非他对你有用，否则他很可能会命令我们杀了你。而且事后清理烂摊子真是一项可怕的工作。 [chu fei ta dui ni you yong ， fou ze ta hen ke neng hui ming ling wo men sha le ni 。 er qie shi hou qing li lan tan zi zhen shi yi xiang ke pa de gong zuo 。]

english: Not to mention the senseless waste of human life.
translation: 更不用说毫无意义地浪费人的生命了。 [geng bu yong shuo hao wu yi yi di lang fei ren de sheng ming le 。]

english: Huh? Them's your words, not mine.
translation: 啊？这是你的话，不是我的。 [a ？ zhe shi ni de hua ， bu shi wo de 。]

english: It doesn't sound as if you respect your Captain much.
translation: 听起来你不太尊重你的队长。 [ting qi lai ni bu tai zun zhong ni de dui zhang 。]

english: -- The guard looks around conspiratorially. --
translation: ——守卫阴险地环顾四周。 -- [—— shou wei yin xian di huan gu si zhou 。 --]

english: Well, to be honest. We think he's not exactly as brave as he makes out. But we have to follow his orders. If someone called him a coward, or managed to trick him into a one-on-one duel many of us bet that he'd be
translation: 好吧，说实话。我们认为他并不像他表现的那么勇敢。但我们必须听从他的命令。如果有人称他为胆小鬼，或者设法诱骗他进行一对一决斗，我们很多人打赌他会是 [hao ba ， shuo shi hua 。 wo men ren wei ta bing bu xiang ta biao xian de na me yong gan 。 dan wo men bi xu ting cong ta de ming ling 。 ru guo you ren cheng ta wei dan xiao gui ， huo zhe she fa you pian ta jin xing yi dui yi jue dou ， wo men hen duo ren da du ta hui shi]

english: beaten.
translation: 殴打。 [ou da 。]

english: And how could I trick him into a one-on-one duel?
translation: 我怎样才能诱骗他进行一对一的决斗呢？ [wo zen yang cai neng you pian ta jin xing yi dui yi de jue dou ne ？]

english: Like all cowards, he likes to be made to feel important. If anyone insults him outright, he just gets us to do his dirty work. However, if he thinks he's better than you, if you compliment him, he may feel that he can defeat
translation: 像所有的懦夫一样，他喜欢被人认为自己很重要。如果有人公然侮辱他，他只会让我们做他肮脏的工作。但是，如果他认为自己比你强，你恭维他，他可能会觉得自己可以打败 [xiang suo you de nuo fu yi yang ， ta xi huan bei ren ren wei zi ji hen zhong yao 。 ru guo you ren gong ran wu ru ta ， ta zhi hui rang wo men zuo ta ang zang de gong zuo 。 dan shi ， ru guo ta ren wei zi ji bi ni qiang ， ni gong wei ta ， ta ke neng hui jue de zi ji ke yi da bai]

english: you. And if he initiated a duel, all the men agreed that they wouldn't intervene. We think he'd be slaughtered in double quick time.
translation: 你。如果他发起决斗，所有的人都同意他们不会介入。我们认为他会在双倍的时间内被屠杀。 [ni 。 ru guo ta fa qi jue dou ， suo you de ren dou tong yi ta men bu hui jie ru 。 wo men ren wei ta hui zai shuang bei de shi jian nei bei tu sha 。]

english: Can I have a bet on that?
translation: 我可以打赌吗？ [wo ke yi da du ma ？]

english: Sorry, we've already taken your bet, wouldn't want any cheating now. Anyway, I have to get back to work. See ya around...
translation: 抱歉，我们已经接受了您的赌注，现在不希望有任何作弊行为。无论如何，我必须回去工作。回头见... [bao qian ， wo men yi jing jie shou le nin de du zhu ， xian zai bu xi wang you ren he zuo bi xing wei 。 wu lun ru he ， wo bi xu hui qu gong zuo 。 hui tou jian ...]

english: Well, if you think you stand a chance, sure. But remember, if he gives us an order, we have to obey.
translation: 好吧，如果你认为你有机会，当然可以。但请记住，如果他向我们发出命令，我们就必须服从。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni ren wei ni you ji hui ， dang ran ke yi 。 dan qing ji zhu ， ru guo ta xiang wo men fa chu ming ling ， wo men jiu bi xu fu cong 。]

english: I'll bet 5 gold that I win.
translation: 我赌5金我赢了。 [wo du 5 jin wo ying le 。]

english: Huh! It looks like you're betting with money you don't have.
translation: 哈！看起来你是在用你没有的钱来投注。 [ha ！ kan qi lai ni shi zai yong ni mei you de qian lai tou zhu 。]

english: Great, I'll take that bet.
translation: 太好了，我愿意打赌。 [tai hao le ， wo yuan yi da du 。]

english: Ok, if you win, you'll get 6 gold back. Anyway, I have to get going, I do have work to do.-- The guard walks off. --
translation: 好吧，如果你赢了，你会得到6块金牌。不管怎样，我得走了，我还有工作要做。--警卫走开了。 -- [hao ba ， ru guo ni ying le ， ni hui de dao 6 kuai jin pai 。 bu guan zen yang ， wo de zou le ， wo hai you gong zuo yao zuo 。-- jing wei zou kai le 。 --]

english: I'll bet 10 gold that I win.
translation: 我赌10金我赢了。 [wo du 10 jin wo ying le 。]

english: Ok, if you win, you'll get 12 gold back. Anyway, I have to get going, I do have work to do.-- The guard walks off. --
