translation: 好吧，如果你赢了，你会得到30金币。不管怎样，我得走了，我还有工作要做。--警卫走开了。 -- [hao ba ， ru guo ni ying le ， ni hui de dao 30 jin bi 。 bu guan zen yang ， wo de zou le ， wo hai you gong zuo yao zuo 。-- jing wei zou kai le 。 --]

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Yeah, whatever!
translation: 是啊，无论如何！ [shi a ， wu lun ru he ！]

english: Get lost before I chop off your head!
translation: 在我砍下你的头之前滚开！ [zai wo kan xia ni de tou zhi qian gun kai ！]

english: Perhaps five gold coins will sweeten your mood?
translation: 也许五枚金币会让你的心情变得甜蜜？ [ye xu wu mei jin bi hui rang ni de xin qing bian de tian mi ？]

english: Well, it certainly will help!
translation: 嗯，这肯定会有帮助！ [n ， zhe ken ding hui you bang zhu ！]

english: Now then, what did you want to know?
translation: 那么，你想知道什么？ [na me ， ni xiang zhi dao shen me ？]

english: I'm looking for a woman called Ana, have you seen her?
translation: 我在找一个叫安娜的女人，你见过她吗？ [wo zai zhao yi ge jiao an na de nv ren ， ni jian guo ta ma ？]

english: Hmm, well, we get a lot of people in here. But not many women though... Saw one come in last week....
translation: 嗯，好吧，我们这里有很多人。但没有多少女性……上周看到一个进来…… [n ， hao ba ， wo men zhe li you hen duo ren 。 dan mei you duo shao nv xing …… shang zhou kan dao yi ge jin lai ……]

english: But I don't know if it's the woman you're looking for?
translation: 但不知道是不是你要找的女人？ [dan bu zhi dao shi bu shi ni yao zhao de nv ren ？]

english: No, now get lost!
translation: 不，现在就滚吧！ [bu ， xian zai jiu gun ba ！]

english: Perhaps five gold coins will help you remember?
translation: 也许五枚金币可以帮助你记住？ [ye xu wu mei jin bi ke yi bang zhu ni ji zhu ？]

english: This mercenary looks very fierce. Are you sure you want to attack him?
translation: 这个佣兵看起来非常凶猛。你确定要攻击他吗？ [zhe ge yong bing kan qi lai fei chang xiong meng 。 ni que ding yao gong ji ta ma ？]

english: You decide not to fight the Mercenary.
translation: 你决定不与雇佣兵作战。 [ni jue ding bu yu gu yong bing zuo zhan 。]

english: Hey, I've come to collect my bet!
translation: 嘿嘿，我是来收赌注的！ [hei hei ， wo shi lai shou du zhu de ！]

english: Well, I guess congratulations are in order.
translation: 好吧，我想恭喜你了。 [hao ba ， wo xiang gong xi ni le 。]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: And we'll only charge the paltry sum of... erm...
translation: 我们只会收取微不足道的费用...呃... [wo men zhi hui shou qu wei bu zu dao de fei yong ... e ...]

english: The guards starts to do some mental calculations. You can see his brow furrow and he starts to sweat profusely.
translation: 守卫们开始盘算起来。你可以看到他的眉头紧锁，他开始大汗淋漓。 [shou wei men kai shi pan suan qi lai 。 ni ke yi kan dao ta de mei tou jin suo ， ta kai shi da han lin li 。]

english: Five gold for cleaning up the mess. You have won 1 Gold piece! Well done..! Ha, ha, ha ha!-- The guards walk off chuckling to themselves. --
translation: 清理烂摊子五块钱。您赢得了 1 块金币！干得好..！哈哈哈哈！——守卫们咯咯地笑着走开。 -- [qing li lan tan zi wu kuai qian 。 nin ying de le  1  kuai jin bi ！ gan de hao ..！ ha ha ha ha ！—— shou wei men ge ge di xiao zhe zou kai 。 --]

english: 10 gold for cleaning up the mess. You have won 2 Gold pieces! Well done..! Ha, ha, ha ha!-- The guards walk off chuckling to themselves. --
translation: 10金币用于清理混乱。您已赢得 2 枚金币！干得好..！哈哈哈哈！——守卫们咯咯地笑着走开。 -- [10 jin bi yong yu qing li hun luan 。 nin yi ying de  2  mei jin bi ！ gan de hao ..！ ha ha ha ha ！—— shou wei men ge ge di xiao zhe zou kai 。 --]

english: 15 gold for cleaning up the mess. You have won 4 Gold pieces! Well done..! Ha, ha, ha ha!-- The guards walk off chuckling to themselves. --
translation: 15 gold for cleaning up the mess. You have won 4 Gold pieces!干得好..！哈哈哈哈！——守卫们咯咯地笑着走开。 -- [15 gold for cleaning up the mess. You have won 4 Gold pieces! gan de hao ..！ ha ha ha ha ！—— shou wei men ge ge di xiao zhe zou kai 。 --]

english: 20 gold for cleaning up the mess. You have won 10 Gold pieces! Well done..! Ha, ha, ha, ha!-- The guards walk off chuckling to themselves. --
translation: 20金币用于清理混乱。您已赢得 10 枚金币！干得好..！哈哈哈哈！——守卫们咯咯地笑着走开。 -- [20 jin bi yong yu qing li hun luan 。 nin yi ying de  10  mei jin bi ！ gan de hao ..！ ha ha ha ha ！—— shou wei men ge ge di xiao zhe zou kai 。 --]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Perhaps five gold coins will make it my business?
translation: 或许五枚金币就可以成为我的事了？ [huo xu wu mei jin bi jiu ke yi cheng wei wo de shi le ？]

english: Can I take a look around the place?
translation: 我可以参观一下这个地方吗？ [wo ke yi can guan yi xia zhe ge di fang ma ？]

english: Does the Captain order you to kill a lot of people?
translation: 队长命令你杀很多人吗？ [dui zhang ming ling ni sha hen duo ren ma ？]

english: Unless what?
translation: 除非什么？ [chu fei shen me ？]

english: Where would I find this Al Zaba Bhasim?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到这个 Al Zaba Bhasim？ [wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao zhe ge  Al Zaba Bhasim？]

english: The Tenti's, who are they?
translation: 坦蒂一家，他们是谁？ [tan di yi jia ， ta men shi shui ？]

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Is Al Zaba Bhasim very tough?
translation: 扎巴·巴西姆（Al Zaba Bhasim）很强硬吗？ [zha ba · ba xi mu （Al Zaba Bhasim） hen qiang ying ma ？]

english: What are you guarding?
translation: 你在守护什么？ [ni zai shou hu shen me ？]

english: Not to mention the senseless waste of human life.
translation: 更不用说毫无意义地浪费人的生命了。 [geng bu yong shuo hao wu yi yi di lang fei ren de sheng ming le 。]

english: It doesn't sound as if you respect your Captain much.
translation: 听起来你不太尊重你的队长。 [ting qi lai ni bu tai zun zhong ni de dui zhang 。]

english: Can I have a bet on that?
translation: 我可以打赌吗？ [wo ke yi da du ma ？]

english: I'll bet 5 gold that I win.
translation: 我赌5金我赢了。 [wo du 5 jin wo ying le 。]

english: I'll bet 10 gold that I win.
translation: 我赌10金我赢了。 [wo du 10 jin wo ying le 。]

english: I'll bet 15 gold that I win.
translation: 我赌15块金子我赢了。 [wo du 15 kuai jin zi wo ying le 。]

english: I'll bet 20 gold that I win.
translation: 我赌20金我赢了。 [wo du 20 jin wo ying le 。]

english: Perhaps these five gold coins will sweeten your mood?
translation: 或许这五枚金币会让你的心情变得甜蜜起来？ [huo xu zhe wu mei jin bi hui rang ni de xin qing bian de tian mi qi lai ？]

english: I'm looking for a woman called Ana, have you seen her?
translation: 我在找一个叫安娜的女人，你见过她吗？ [wo zai zhao yi ge jiao an na de nv ren ， ni jian guo ta ma ？]

english: Perhaps five gold coins will help you remember?
translation: 也许五枚金币可以帮助你记住？ [ye xu wu mei jin bi ke yi bang zhu ni ji zhu ？]

english: Yes, I can take him on!
translation: 是的，我可以对付他！ [shi de ， wo ke yi dui fu ta ！]

english: Er, no thanks, I've had second thoughts about it.
translation: 呃，不，谢谢，我已经重新考虑过了。 [e ， bu ， xie xie ， wo yi jing chong xin kao lv guo le 。]

english: Hand me a banknote, and I'll try to convert it to an item.
translation: 给我一张钞票，我会尝试将其转换为物品。 [gei wo yi zhang chao piao ， wo hui chang shi jiang qi zhuan huan wei wu pin 。]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: We're getting ready to test our mettle in the Theatre. Most people go in alone but if we do it as a team, we should have no problem.
translation: 我们正准备在剧院测试我们的勇气。大多数人都是单独进去，但如果我们作为一个团队去的话，应该没有问题。 [wo men zheng zhun bei zai ju yuan ce shi wo men de yong qi 。 da duo shu ren dou shi dan du jin qu ， dan ru guo wo men zuo wei yi ge tuan dui qu de hua ， ying gai mei you wen ti 。]

english: Well good luck with that.
translation: 祝你好运。 [zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Why, hello there, young'un. Did my boy Percy say you could come up here?
translation: 嗨，你好，年轻人。我儿子珀西说过你可以来这里吗？ [hai ， ni hao ， nian qing ren 。 wo er zi po xi shuo guo ni ke yi lai zhe li ma ？]

english: Yes, I had to pay him to get access to this area.
translation: 是的，我必须付钱给他才能进入这个区域。 [shi de ， wo bi xu fu qian gei ta cai neng jin ru zhe ge qu yu 。]

english: Ah, that's my Percy alright. I raised him well.
translation: 啊，那是我的珀西，好吧。我把他养大了。 [a ， na shi wo de po xi ， hao ba 。 wo ba ta yang da le 。]

english: You shouldn't be up here!
translation: 你不应该在这里！ [ni bu ying gai zai zhe li ！]

english: I don't think you should be using that without speaking to Percy first.
translation: 我认为你不应该在没有先与珀西交谈的情况下使用它。 [wo ren wei ni bu ying gai zai mei you xian yu po xi jiao tan de qing kuang xia shi yong ta 。]

english: Welcome to the Games Zone!
translation: 欢迎来到游戏专区！ [huan ying lai dao you xi zhuan qu ！]

english: How do I play board games?
translation: 我该如何玩棋盘游戏？ [wo gai ru he wan qi pan you xi ？]

english: You can challenge someone to a game anywhere in the Games Zone (except on a PvP or Deadman world) by using the right click option.
translation: 您可以使用右键单击选项，在游戏区的任何地方（PvP 或 Deadman 世界除外）向某人发起游戏挑战。 [nin ke yi shi yong you jian dan ji xuan xiang ， zai you xi qu de ren he di fang （PvP  huo  Deadman  shi jie chu wai ） xiang mou ren fa qi you xi tiao zhan 。]

english: Choose the type of game and then choose the options you want such as time per move.
translation: 选择游戏类型，然后选择您想要的选项，例如每次移动的时间。 [xuan ze you xi lei xing ， ran hou xuan ze nin xiang yao de xuan xiang ， li ru mei ci yi dong de shi jian 。]

english: If your opponent accepts the challenge you will be taken to one of the tables around where you will play your game of choice.
translation: 如果您的对手接受挑战，您将被带到您选择的游戏周围的一张桌子上。 [ru guo nin de dui shou jie shou tiao zhan ， nin jiang bei dai dao nin xuan ze de you xi zhou wei de yi zhang zhuo zi shang 。]

english: Once you have finished your game you will come back here where you can challenge again! We also have tables in a few pubs around the world!
translation: 完成游戏后，您将回到这里再次挑战！我们还在世界各地的一些酒吧设有餐桌！ [wan cheng you xi hou ， nin jiang hui dao zhe li zai ci tiao zhan ！ wo men hai zai shi jie ge di de yi xie jiu ba she you can zhuo ！]

english: What games can I play?
translation: 我可以玩什么游戏？ [wo ke yi wan shen me you xi ？]

english: Currently we offer Draughts, Runelink, Runesquares, and Runeversi.
translation: 目前我们提供跳棋、符文链接、符文方块和符文西。 [mu qian wo men ti gong tiao qi 、 fu wen lian jie 、 fu wen fang kuai he fu wen xi 。]

english: Draughts?
translation: 跳水？ [tiao shui ？]

english: Draughts uses standard rules, apart from: a draw is declared if no piece has been taken or promoted for forty moves.
translation: 跳棋使用标准规则，除此之外：如果四十步棋没有被吃或晋级，则宣布平局。 [tiao qi shi yong biao zhun gui ze ， chu ci zhi wai ： ru guo si shi bu qi mei you bei chi huo jin ji ， ze xuan bu ping ju 。]

english: Runelink?
translation: 符文链接？ [fu wen lian jie ？]

english: Yup, you have to get four runes in row.
translation: 是的，你必须排成四个符文。 [shi de ， ni bi xu pai cheng si ge fu wen 。]

english: Runesquares?
translation: 符文方块？ [fu wen fang kuai ？]

english: Yes, you take it in turns to add a line with the goal of making squares. Everytime you make a square you take another turn.
translation: 是的，你轮流添加一条线，目的是形成正方形。每次你形成一个正方形，你就需要再转一次。 [shi de ， ni lun liu tian jia yi tiao xian ， mu di shi xing cheng zheng fang xing 。 mei ci ni xing cheng yi ge zheng fang xing ， ni jiu xu yao zai zhuan yi ci 。]

english: Runeversi?
translation: 鲁内韦西？ [lu nei wei xi ？]

english: Yep, the aim is to have more of your runes on the board than your opponent. You can take your opponents pieces by trapping them between your own.
translation: 是的，我们的目标是让棋盘上的符文数量多于对手。你可以将对手的棋子夹在自己的棋子之间，从而将其夺走。 [shi de ， wo men de mu biao shi rang qi pan shang de fu wen shu liang duo yu dui shou 。 ni ke yi jiang dui shou de qi zi jia zai zi ji de qi zi zhi jian ， cong er jiang qi duo zou 。]

english: Can I buy a drink please?
translation: 请问我可以买一杯饮料吗？ [qing wen wo ke yi mai yi bei yin liao ma ？]

english: I'm afraid I don't sell drinks.
translation: 恐怕我不卖饮料。 [kong pa wo bu mai yin liao 。]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: Unfortunately we do not offer board game playing on this world. Try logging onto a non-PvP or Deadman world!
translation: 不幸的是，我们不提供在这个世界上玩的棋盘游戏。尝试登录非 PvP 或 Deadman 世界！ [bu xing de shi ， wo men bu ti gong zai zhe ge shi jie shang wan de qi pan you xi 。 chang shi deng lu fei  PvP  huo  Deadman  shi jie ！]

english: What games can I play?

english: Draughts?
translation: 跳水？ [tiao shui ？]

english: Runelink?
translation: 符文链接？ [fu wen lian jie ？]

english: Runesquares?
translation: 符文方块？ [fu wen fang kuai ？]

english: Runeversi?
translation: 鲁内韦西？ [lu nei wei xi ？]

english: Can I buy a drink please?
translation: 请问我可以买一杯饮料吗？ [qing wen wo ke yi mai yi bei yin liao ma ？]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: Hello. King Arthur has sent me on a quest for the Holy Grail. He thought you could offer some assistance.
translation: 你好。亚瑟王派我去寻找圣杯。他认为你可以提供一些帮助。 [ni hao 。 ya se wang pai wo qu xun zhao sheng bei 。 ta ren wei ni ke yi ti gong yi xie bang zhu 。]

english: Ah yes... the Holy Grail...
translation: 啊，是的……圣杯…… [a ， shi de …… sheng bei ……]

english: That is a powerful artefact indeed. Returning it here would help Camelot a lot.
translation: 这确实是一件强大的神器。把它送回这里对卡米洛特有很大帮助。 [zhe que shi shi yi jian qiang da de shen qi 。 ba ta song hui zhe li dui ka mi luo te you hen da bang zhu 。]

english: Due to its nature the Holy Grail is likely to reside in a holy place.
translation: 由于其性质，圣杯很可能位于一个圣地。 [you yu qi xing zhi ， sheng bei hen ke neng wei yu yi ge sheng di 。]

english: Any suggestions?
translation: 有什么建议吗？ [you shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: I believe there is a holy island somewhere not far away... I'm not entirely sure... I spent too long inside that crystal! Anyway, go and talk to someone over there.
translation: 我相信在不远处有一座圣岛……我不太确定……我在那块水晶里呆得太久了！不管怎样，先去和那边的人谈谈吧。 [wo xiang xin zai bu yuan chu you yi zuo sheng dao …… wo bu tai que ding …… wo zai na kuai shui jing li dai de tai jiu le ！ bu guan zen yang ， xian qu he na bian de ren tan tan ba 。]

english: I suppose you could try speaking to Sir Galahad?
translation: 我想你可以试着和加拉哈德爵士谈谈吗？ [wo xiang ni ke yi shi zhe he jia la ha de jue shi tan tan ma ？]

english: He returned from the quest many years after everyone else. He seems to know something about it, but he can only speak about those experiences cryptically.
translation: 他比其他人晚很多年才从探索中归来。他似乎知道一些事情，但他只能神秘地讲述那些经历。 [ta bi qi ta ren wan hen duo nian cai cong tan suo zhong gui lai 。 ta si hu zhi dao yi xie shi qing ， dan ta zhi neng shen mi di jiang shu na xie jing li 。]

english: Thank you for the advice.
translation: 谢谢你的建议。 [xie xie ni de jian yi 。]

english: Where can I find Sir Galahad?
translation: 在哪里可以找到加拉哈德爵士？ [zai na li ke yi zhao dao jia la ha de jue shi ？]

english: Galahad now lives a life of religious contemplation. He lives somewhere west of McGrubor's Wood I think.
translation: 加拉哈德现在过着宗教沉思的生活。我想他住在麦格鲁伯森林以西的某个地方。 [jia la ha de xian zai guo zhe zong jiao chen si de sheng huo 。 wo xiang ta zhu zai mai ge lu bo sen lin yi xi de mou ge di fang 。]

english: Oh dear, did Morgan capture you too?
translation: 天啊，摩根也抓到你了吗？ [tian a ， mo gen ye zhua dao ni le ma ？]

english: Err, no. It was all part of my brilliant plan. I allowed her to capture me so I could find out where she was keeping all of you.
translation: 呃，不。这都是我辉煌计划的一部分。我允许她抓住我，这样我就能找出她把你们所有人关在哪里。 [e ， bu 。 zhe dou shi wo hui huang ji hua de yi bu fen 。 wo yun xu ta zhua zhu wo ， zhe yang wo jiu neng zhao chu ta ba ni men suo you ren guan zai na li 。]

english: Eh, is that so? Very clever. Now that you've found us, what is your plan, oh brilliant leader?
translation: 呃，是这样吗？非常聪明。既然您找到了我们，那么您的计划是什么，哦，杰出的领导者？ [e ， shi zhe yang ma ？ fei chang cong ming 。 ji ran nin zhao dao le wo men ， na me nin de ji hua shi shen me ， o ， jie chu de ling dao zhe ？]

english: Hey, why do I have to do all the thinking here? You're the brilliant wizard.
translation: 嘿，为什么我必须在这里思考？你是才华横溢的巫师。 [hei ， wei shen me wo bi xu zai zhe li si kao ？ ni shi cai hua heng yi de wu shi 。]

english: Well, all great plans start with knowledge. Let me bring you up to speed with the situation. What do you want to know?
translation: 好吧，所有伟大的计划都始于知识。让我向您介绍一下最新情况。你想知道什么？ [hao ba ， suo you wei da de ji hua dou shi yu zhi shi 。 rang wo xiang nin jie shao yi xia zui xin qing kuang 。 ni xiang zhi dao shen me ？]

english: Where is King Arthur now? he's not in the jail cell with us.
translation: 亚瑟王现在在哪里？他没有和我们一起关在牢房里。 [ya se wang xian zai zai na li ？ ta mei you he wo men yi qi guan zai lao fang li 。]

english: As the final blow to our morale, Morgan turned Arthur into a granite statue before our very eyes. He was taken away by the Black Knights, for what purposes I know not.
translation: 作为对我们士气的最后一击，摩根在我们眼前将亚瑟变成了一座花岗岩雕像。他被黑骑士带走了，我不知道出于什么目的。 [zuo wei dui wo men shi qi de zui hou yi ji ， mo gen zai wo men yan qian jiang ya se bian cheng le yi zuo hua gang yan diao xiang 。 ta bei hei qi shi dai zou le ， wo bu zhi dao chu yu shen me mu di 。]

english: What is the connection between Morgan Le Faye and the Sinclairs?
translation: 摩根勒菲和辛克莱家族之间有何联系？ [mo gen lei fei he xin ke lai jia zu zhi jian you he lian xi ？]

english: Morgan le Faye has been itching to get revenge upon Arthur and myself for some time. When she heard of the murder of old Sinclair, she learned that she was not the only one with a vendetta against Camelot.
translation: 一段时间以来，摩根勒菲一直渴望向亚瑟和我复仇。当她听说老辛克莱被谋杀时，她得知自己并不是唯一一个对卡米洛特有仇的人。 [yi duan shi jian yi lai ， mo gen lei fei yi zhi ke wang xiang ya se he wo fu chou 。 dang ta ting shuo lao xin ke lai bei mou sha shi ， ta de zhi zi ji bing bu shi wei yi yi ge dui ka mi luo te you chou de ren 。]

english: The Sinclairs have wanted to get their slimy hands on Camelot since their father's death. With Morgan's cunning and their riches, they make a formidable team. They brought the services of the Black Knights from
translation: 自从他们的父亲去世后，辛克莱家族就一直想得到卡米洛特。凭借摩根的狡猾和财富，他们组成了一支强大的团队。他们带来了黑骑士的服务 [zi cong ta men de fu qin qu shi hou ， xin ke lai jia zu jiu yi zhi xiang de dao ka mi luo te 。 ping jie mo gen de jiao hua he cai fu ， ta men zu cheng le yi zhi qiang da de tuan dui 。 ta men dai lai le hei qi shi de fu wu]

english: Lord Daquarius and overran Camelot. We were outnumbered and taken by surprise.
translation: 达奎里厄斯勋爵并占领了卡米洛特。我们寡不敌众，措手不及。 [da kui li e si xun jue bing zhan ling le ka mi luo te 。 wo men gua bu di zhong ， cuo shou bu ji 。]

english: The Sinclairs stole our home, but Morgan struck the greater blow by stealing the Holy Grail, Arthur's most prized possession.
translation: 辛克莱家族偷走了我们的家，但摩根却偷走了亚瑟最珍贵的财产——圣杯，从而造成了更大的打击。 [xin ke lai jia zu tou zou le wo men de jia ， dan mo gen que tou zou le ya se zui zhen gui de cai chan —— sheng bei ， cong er zao cheng le geng da de da ji 。]

english: So what's the plan of escape? Are you going to teleport us all away? Turn us into fish and swim to sea?
translation: 那么逃跑计划是什么？你要把我们全部传送走吗？把我们变成鱼游到大海里？ [na me tao pao ji hua shi shen me ？ ni yao ba wo men quan bu chuan song zou ma ？ ba wo men bian cheng yu you dao da hai li ？]

english: During the battle at Camelot, Morgan cast a spell against me which appears to have stripped me of my powers. I must admit, the loss of my magic has left me befuddled, making it difficult to create a plan.
translation: 在卡米洛特之战期间，摩根对我施展了咒语，似乎剥夺了我的力量。我必须承认，魔法的丧失让我感到困惑，很难制定计划。 [zai ka mi luo te zhi zhan qi jian ， mo gen dui wo shi zhan le zhou yu ， si hu bo duo le wo de li liang 。 wo bi xu cheng ren ， mo fa de sang shi rang wo gan dao kun huo ， hen nan zhi ding ji hua 。]

english: Well, I'm sure if we put our heads together we will think of something.
translation: 好吧，我确信如果我们齐心协力，我们一定能想到一些办法。 [hao ba ， wo que xin ru guo wo men qi xin xie li ， wo men yi ding neng xiang dao yi xie ban fa 。]

english: Let's talk about a plan of escape.
translation: 我们来谈谈逃跑计划吧。 [wo men lai tan tan tao pao ji hua ba 。]

english: Escape is only a short-term plan. We should discuss the long-term goals as well.
translation: 逃跑只是一个短期计划。我们还应该讨论长期目标。 [tao pao zhi shi yi ge duan qi ji hua 。 wo men hai ying gai tao lun chang qi mu biao 。]

english: How will we go about reclaiming Camelot?
translation: 我们将如何夺回卡米洛特？ [wo men jiang ru he duo hui ka mi luo te ？]

english: I think I could reclaim Camelot from the Sinclairs on my own.
translation: 我想我可以凭一己之力从辛克莱家族手中夺回卡米洛特。 [wo xiang wo ke yi ping yi ji zhi li cong xin ke lai jia zu shou zhong duo hui ka mi luo te 。]

english: How do you plan to do that? You couldn't even defend it from them.
translation: 你打算如何做到这一点？你甚至无法抵御他们。 [ni da suan ru he zuo dao zhe yi dian ？ ni shen zhi wu fa di yu ta men 。]

english: They don't know I've lost my magic. Besides, I've got a few tricks up my sleeves. For all their snobberies, they're still just spoiled brats. It shouldn't be difficult, but time is of the essence. I need you to break me out
translation: 他们不知道我已经失去了魔法。此外，我还有一些小伎俩。尽管他们很势利，但他们仍然只是被宠坏的孩子。这应该不难，但时间至关重要。我需要你让我摆脱困境 [ta men bu zhi dao wo yi jing shi qu le mo fa 。 ci wai ， wo hai you yi xie xiao ji liang 。 jin guan ta men hen shi li ， dan ta men reng ran zhi shi bei chong huai de hai zi 。 zhe ying gai bu nan ， dan shi jian zhi guan zhong yao 。 wo xu yao ni rang wo bai tuo kun jing]

english: of here quickly and quietly, so Morgan cannot alert them.
translation: 快速而安静地离开这里，这样摩根就无法提醒他们。 [kuai su er an jing di li kai zhe li ， zhe yang mo gen jiu wu fa ti xing ta men 。]

english: So to reclaim Camelot, I need to break you out of jail quietly.
translation: 所以为了夺回卡米洛特，我需要悄悄地把你从监狱里救出来。 [suo yi wei le duo hui ka mi luo te ， wo xu yao qiao qiao di ba ni cong jian yu li jiu chu lai 。]

english: Precisely.
translation: 恰恰。 [qia qia 。]

english: How do I retrieve the Holy Grail? Do you know where it is?
translation: 如何取回圣杯？你知道它在哪里吗？ [ru he qu hui sheng bei ？ ni zhi dao ta zai na li ma ？]

english: Morgan always keeps things of power near her. So the grail will be somewhere in Keep Le Faye. However, it will most likely be disguised and booby-trapped. Morgan has a thing about transmogrifying.
translation: 摩根总是把权力之物放在她身边。所以圣杯会在Keep Le Faye 的某个地方。然而，它很可能是经过伪装和设置诱杀装置的。摩根对变形很感兴趣。 [mo gen zong shi ba quan li zhi wu fang zai ta shen bian 。 suo yi sheng bei hui zai Keep Le Faye  de mou ge di fang 。 ran er ， ta hen ke neng shi jing guo wei zhuang he she zhi you sha zhuang zhi de 。 mo gen dui bian xing hen gan xing qu 。]

english: The last time I was in Keep Le Faye, it was pretty well guarded. I don't think I'll be able to sneak in quietly.
translation: 上次我在Keep Le Faye时，那里守卫得很好。我想我不可能悄悄溜进去。 [shang ci wo zai Keep Le Faye shi ， na li shou wei de hen hao 。 wo xiang wo bu ke neng qiao qiao liu jin qu 。]

english: No, that won't work. Better to break out of the jail with all of the Round Table Knights. Let them deal with the guards while you retrieve the Grail.
translation: 不，那行不通。最好和所有圆桌骑士一起越狱。让他们在你取回圣杯的同时对付守卫。 [bu ， na xing bu tong 。 zui hao he suo you yuan zhuo qi shi yi qi yue yu 。 rang ta men zai ni qu hui sheng bei de tong shi dui fu shou wei 。]

english: So, I need to break eight knights out of jail? That could be troublesome.
translation: 那么，我需要把八名骑士从监狱里救出来吗？那可能会很麻烦。 [na me ， wo xu yao ba ba ming qi shi cong jian yu li jiu chu lai ma ？ na ke neng hui hen ma fan 。]

english: Often the most complicated things have the simplest answers. Try leaving through the door.
translation: 通常，最复杂的事情有最简单的答案。尝试从门离开。 [tong chang ， zui fu za de shi qing you zui jian dan de da an 。 chang shi cong men li kai 。]

english: But it's locked.
translation: 但它被锁了。 [dan ta bei suo le 。]

english: When has that ever stopped an intrepid adventurer such as yourself?
translation: 像你这样勇敢的冒险家什么时候曾遇到过这样的事情呢？ [xiang ni zhe yang yong gan de mao xian jia shen me shi hou ceng yu dao guo zhe yang de shi qing ne ？]

english: Assuming I can escape from this jail, how can I save King Arthur?
translation: 假设我能逃出这座监狱，我该如何拯救亚瑟王呢？ [jia she wo neng tao chu zhe zuo jian yu ， wo gai ru he zheng jiu ya se wang ne ？]

english: I believe he's been taken to the headquarters of the Black Knights. I'm afraid I'm not well travelled on that side of the world, so I don't know its exact location. However, it's trickier than just finding Arthur. You'll
translation: 我相信他已经被带到了黑骑士的总部。恐怕我不太熟悉世界的那一边，所以我不知道它的确切位置。然而，这比仅仅找到亚瑟更棘手。你会 [wo xiang xin ta yi jing bei dai dao le hei qi shi de zong bu 。 kong pa wo bu tai shu xi shi jie de na yi bian ， suo yi wo bu zhi dao ta di que qie wei zhi 。 ran er ， zhe bi jin jin zhao dao ya se geng ji shou 。 ni hui]

english: need to free him of the spell that turned him into a granite statue.
translation: 需要把他从把他变成花岗岩雕像的咒语中解救出来。 [xu yao ba ta cong ba ta bian cheng hua gang yan diao xiang de zhou yu zhong jie jiu chu lai 。]

english: And how do I go about doing that?
translation: 我该怎么做呢？ [wo gai zen me zuo ne ？]

english: I have no idea.
translation: 我不知道。 [wo bu zhi dao 。]

english: WHAT?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: Let me finish. I may have no idea, but a wizard friend of mine should. His name is Wizard Cromperty, and he's very experienced in freeing people from stone since he keeps teleporting them into it. Speak to him in East
translation: 让我说完。我可能不知道，但我的一个巫师朋友应该知道。他的名字叫巫师克朗珀蒂，他在将人们从石头中解放出来方面非​​常有经验，因为他不断将人们传送到石头中。在东部与他交谈 [rang wo shuo wan 。 wo ke neng bu zhi dao ， dan wo de yi ge wu shi peng you ying gai zhi dao 。 ta de ming zi jiao wu shi ke lang po di ， ta zai jiang ren men cong shi tou zhong jie fang chu lai fang mian fei ​​ chang you jing yan ， yin wei ta bu duan jiang ren men chuan song dao shi tou zhong 。 zai dong bu yu ta jiao tan]

english: Ardougne, he'll help you.
translation: 阿杜涅，他会帮助你的。 [a du nie ， ta hui bang zhu ni de 。]

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: Well done, young adventurer. You truly are a worthy knight.
translation: 干得好，年轻的冒险家。你确实是一位值得尊敬的骑士。 [gan de hao ， nian qing de mao xian jia 。 ni que shi shi yi wei zhi de zun jing de qi shi 。]

english: You receive access to the prayers Chivalry and Piety and 20,000 XP in your Hitpoints, Strength, Attack, and Defence skills. You may also speak to Merlin to set your respawn point to Camelot.
translation: 您可以获得骑士精神和虔诚祈祷以及生命值、力量、攻击和防御技能中的 20,000 XP。您也可以与梅林交谈，将您的重生点设置为卡米洛特。 [nin ke yi huo de qi shi jing shen he qian cheng qi dao yi ji sheng ming zhi 、 li liang 、 gong ji he fang yu ji neng zhong de  20,000 XP。 nin ye ke yi yu mei lin jiao tan ， jiang nin de chong sheng dian she zhi wei ka mi luo te 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Excuse me for rushing off like this, but I must get back to my workroom.
translation: 请原谅我这么匆忙，但我必须回到我的工作室。 [qing yuan liang wo zhe me cong mang ， dan wo bi xu hui dao wo de gong zuo shi 。]

english: Thank you for the advice.
translation: 谢谢你的建议。 [xie xie ni de jian yi 。]

english: Where can I find Sir Galahad?
translation: 在哪里可以找到加拉哈德爵士？ [zai na li ke yi zhao dao jia la ha de jue shi ？]

english: Tell me where King Arthur is.
translation: 告诉我亚瑟王在哪里。 [gao su wo ya se wang zai na li 。]

english: Tell me about Morgan Le Faye and the Sinclairs.
translation: 告诉我关于摩根·勒菲和辛克莱家族的事。 [gao su wo guan yu mo gen · lei fei he xin ke lai jia zu de shi 。]

english: What do we do now?
translation: 我们现在做什么？ [wo men xian zai zuo shen me ？]

english: Reclaim Camelot
translation: 收复卡米洛特 [shou fu ka mi luo te]

english: Retreive the Holy Grail
translation: 夺回圣杯 [duo hui sheng bei]

english: Save King Arthur
translation: 拯救亚瑟王 [zheng jiu ya se wang]

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: Oh, hello! Children, say hello to the surface-dweller.
translation: 哦，你好！孩子们，向地表居民问好。 [o ， ni hao ！ hai zi men ， xiang di biao ju min wen hao 。]

english: Haha! You look funny!
translation: 哈哈！你看起来很有趣！ [ha ha ！ ni kan qi lai hen you qu ！]

english: I'm sure you look just as funny to the surface-dweller!
translation: 我确信对于地表居民来说，你看起来也同样有趣！ [wo que xin dui yu di biao ju min lai shuo ， ni kan qi lai ye tong yang you qu ！]

english: You smell!
translation: 你闻起来！ [ni wen qi lai ！]

english: There's no need to be rude!
translation: 没必要粗鲁！ [mei bi yao cu lu ！]

english: I'm sorry about that, surface-dweller.
translation: 对此我很抱歉，地表居民。 [dui ci wo hen bao qian ， di biao ju min 。]

english: Are you really from the surface?
translation: 你真的是从表面来的吗？ [ni zhen de shi cong biao mian lai de ma ？]

english: Yes I am.
translation: 我是。 [wo shi 。]

english: Are you [player name]? Did you help Zanik save the city?
translation: 你是[玩家姓名]吗？你帮助扎尼克拯救了这座城市吗？ [ni shi [ wan jia xing ming ] ma ？ ni bang zhu zha ni ke zheng jiu le zhe zuo cheng shi ma ？]

english: Just because [he's/she's] a surface-dweller, doesn't mean [he's/she's] [player name]! There are lots of surface-dwellers!
translation: 仅仅因为[他/她]是地表居民，并不意味着[他/她]是[玩家姓名]！有很多地表居民！ [jin jin yin wei [ ta / ta ] shi di biao ju min ， bing bu yi wei zhe [ ta / ta ] shi [ wan jia xing ming ]！ you hen duo di biao ju min ！]

english: Actually I am [player name].
translation: 其实我是[玩家姓名]。 [qi shi wo shi [ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: [Player name]? Really?
translation: [玩家姓名]？真的吗？ [[ wan jia xing ming ]？ zhen de ma ？]

english: Zanik told me about you! I'm so pleased to meet you!
translation: 扎尼克告诉我关于你的事！我很高兴认识你！ [zha ni ke gao su wo guan yu ni de shi ！ wo hen gao xing ren shi ni ！]

english: Shan't!
translation: 不！ [bu ！]

english: Well don't blame me if he doesn't want to talk to you either!
translation: 如果他也不想和你说话，别怪我！ [ru guo ta ye bu xiang he ni shuo hua ， bie guai wo ！]

english: Sorry about that.
translation: 对此感到抱歉。 [dui ci gan dao bao qian 。]

english: I don't think I should just do that with no reasoning... perhaps they are going to try something sneaky. Then I can kick to my heart's content.
translation: 我不认为我应该毫无理由地这么做……也许他们会尝试一些鬼鬼祟祟的事情。然后我就可以尽情地踢球了。 [wo bu ren wei wo ying gai hao wu li you di zhe me zuo …… ye xu ta men hui chang shi yi xie gui gui sui sui de shi qing 。 ran hou wo jiu ke yi jin qing di ti qiu le 。]

english: Noo don't put that in there!
translation: 不，不要把它放在那里！ [bu ， bu yao ba ta fang zai na li ！]

english: I've got all the bad ones just for you!
translation: 我把所有不好的都给你了！ [wo ba suo you bu hao de dou gei ni le ！]

english: Curse you!
translation: 诅咒你！ [zu zhou ni ！]

english: How's life now the curse has been lifted?
translation: 诅咒解除了，现在生活怎么样？ [zu zhou jie chu le ， xian zai sheng huo zen me yang ？]

english: Much better thanks to you. We're all very impressed.
translation: 多亏了你，好多了。我们都很感动。 [duo kui le ni ， hao duo le 。 wo men dou hen gan dong 。]

english: Hello there. I have a message for you.
translation: 你好呀。我有话要给你。 [ni hao ya 。 wo you hua yao gei ni 。]

english: Hello there. I have a message for you, but you'll need to make some room for it.
translation: 你好呀。我有话要给你，但你需要腾出一些空间。 [ni hao ya 。 wo you hua yao gei ni ， dan ni xu yao teng chu yi xie kong jian 。]

english: Sorry, I don't have anything for you right now.
translation: 抱歉，我现在没有什么可以给你的。 [bao qian ， wo xian zai mei you shen me ke yi gei ni de 。]

english: [player name]?
translation: [玩家姓名]？ [[ wan jia xing ming ]？]

english: Are you there [player name]?
translation: 你在[玩家姓名]吗？ [ni zai [ wan jia xing ming ] ma ？]

english: [player name]? I have a message for you.
translation: [玩家姓名]？我有话要给你。 [[ wan jia xing ming ]？ wo you hua yao gei ni 。]

english: [player name]? You've been sent a message.
translation: [玩家姓名]？已向您发送消息。 [[ wan jia xing ming ]？ yi xiang nin fa song xiao xi 。]

english: Maybe another time.
translation: 也许下次吧。 [ye xu xia ci ba 。]

english: I have a letter for you. I'm told it's quite important. Please read it when you get a chance.
translation: 我有一封信给你。我听说这非常重要。当你有机会时请阅读它。 [wo you yi feng xin gei ni 。 wo ting shuo zhe fei chang zhong yao 。 dang ni you ji hui shi qing yue du ta 。]

english: Apparently you destroyed that last letter I gave you without reading it, or something like that. The sender doesn't appreciate that sort of thing, so I've got another one for you.
translation: 显然你没有读过我给你的最后一封信或者类似的东西就毁了它。发件人不喜欢这种事情，所以我给你准备了另一件。 [xian ran ni mei you du guo wo gei ni de zui hou yi feng xin huo zhe lei si de dong xi jiu hui le ta 。 fa jian ren bu xi huan zhe zhong shi qing ， suo yi wo gei ni zhun bei le ling yi jian 。]

english: Look, you can destroy that letter as many times as you want, but it won't change anything. The sender isn't the kind of individual who takes no for an answer, so for both of our sakes, please just read it.
translation: 你看，你可以随意销毁那封信，但它不会改变任何事情。发件人不是那种不接受拒绝的人，所以为了我们双方的利益，请阅读它。 [ni kan ， ni ke yi sui yi xiao hui na feng xin ， dan ta bu hui gai bian ren he shi qing 。 fa jian ren bu shi na zhong bu jie shou ju jue de ren ， suo yi wei le wo men shuang fang de li yi ， qing yue du ta 。]

english: Please... don't keep doing this. You don't know who you're dealing with...
translation: 拜托……不要再这样了。你不知道你在和谁打交道... [bai tuo …… bu yao zai zhe yang le 。 ni bu zhi dao ni zai he shui da jiao dao ...]

english: Take me to your leader.
translation: 带我去见你们的领导。 [dai wo qu jian ni men de ling dao 。]

english: Wot?
translation: 哇？ [wa ？]

translation: 迷路！ [mi lu ！]

english: I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 我没有什么可以给你，所以让我一个人呆着吧，托钵僧。 [wo mei you shen me ke yi gei ni ， suo yi rang wo yi ge ren dai zhe ba ， tuo bo seng 。]

english: Have you no manners?
translation: 你没有礼貌吗？ [ni mei you li mao ma ？]

english: I don't have time for this right now.
translation: 我现在没有时间做这个。 [wo xian zai mei you shi jian zuo zhe ge 。]

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 我没有兴趣和像你这样的可怜虫说话。 [wo mei you xing qu he xiang ni zhe yang de ke lian chong shuo hua 。]

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
translation: 我打赌你有一双很棒的爪子。 [wo da du ni you yi shuang hen bang de zhua zi 。]

english: A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 非常痛苦的一天，总的来说……趁它持续的时候好好享受吧。 [fei chang tong ku de yi tian ， zong de lai shuo …… chen ta chi xu de shi hou hao hao xiang shou ba 。]

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: 如果你抓到任何人，答应我你会分享。 [ru guo ni zhua dao ren he ren ， da ying wo ni hui fen xiang 。]

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 我以前没在这儿闻过你的味道…… [wo yi qian mei zai zhe er wen guo ni de wei dao ……]

english: You smell familiar...
translation: 你闻起来很熟悉... [ni wen qi lai hen shu xi ...]

english: Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 看到这附近有人类吗？我饿了。 [kan dao zhe fu jin you ren lei ma ？ wo e le 。]

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 在我看来，你就像一个对血液有健康品味的人。 [zai wo kan lai ， ni jiu xiang yi ge dui xue ye you jian kang pin wei de ren 。]

english: Good day to you, my friend.
translation: 祝你美好的一天，我的朋友。 [zhu ni mei hao de yi tian ， wo de peng you 。]

english: Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
translation: 想去城堡吃点小吃吗？ [xiang qu cheng bao chi dian xiao chi ma ？]

english: Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: 等一下，我的牙齿里有一点东西卡住了…… [deng yi xia ， wo de ya chi li you yi dian dong xi ka zhu le ……]

english: Hello. Your parents say you saw what happened to Elena...
translation: 你好。你的父母说你看到了埃琳娜的遭遇...... [ni hao 。 ni de fu mu shuo ni kan dao le ai lin na de zao yu ......]

english: *sniff* Yes I was near the south east corner when I saw Elena walking by. I was about to run to greet her when some men jumped out. They shoved a sack over her head and dragged her into a building.
translation: *闻一闻*是的，当我看到埃琳娜走过时，我正在东南角附近。我正要跑去迎接她，几个男人跳了出来。他们把麻袋套在她头上，然后把她拖进一栋大楼。 [* wen yi wen * shi de ， dang wo kan dao ai lin na zou guo shi ， wo zheng zai dong nan jiao fu jin 。 wo zheng yao pao qu ying jie ta ， ji ge nan ren tiao le chu lai 。 ta men ba ma dai tao zai ta tou shang ， ran hou ba ta tuo jin yi dong da lou 。]

english: Which building?
translation: 哪栋楼？ [na dong lou ？]

english: It was the boarded up building with no windows in the south east corner of West Ardougne.
translation: 这是西阿杜涅东南角那栋用木板封起来、没有窗户的建筑。 [zhe shi xi a du nie dong nan jiao na dong yong mu ban feng qi lai 、 mei you chuang hu de jian zhu 。]

english: Have you found Elena yet?
translation: 你找到埃琳娜了吗？ [ni zhao dao ai lin na le ma ？]

english: No, I'm still looking.
translation: 不，我还在寻找。 [bu ， wo hai zai xun zhao 。]

english: I hope you find her. She was nice.
translation: 我希望你能找到她。她人很好。 [wo xi wang ni neng zhao dao ta 。 ta ren hen hao 。]

english: Yes, she's safe at home.
translation: 是的，她在家很安全。 [shi de ， ta zai jia hen an quan 。]

english: I hope she comes and visits sometime.
translation: 我希望她有时间过来拜访。 [wo xi wang ta you shi jian guo lai bai fang 。]

english: Maybe.
translation: 或许。 [huo xu 。]

english: I hope Elena comes to visit soon.
translation: 我希望埃琳娜很快就能来拜访。 [wo xi wang ai lin na hen kuai jiu neng lai bai fang 。]

english: Hello Adventurer. Welcome to Mill Lane Mill. Can I help you?
translation: 你好冒险家。欢迎来到米尔巷米尔。我可以帮你吗？ [ni hao mao xian jia 。 huan ying lai dao mi er xiang mi er 。 wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm Miss Millicent Miller the Miller of Mill Lane Mill. Our family have been milling flour for generations.
translation: 我是米尔巷磨坊的磨坊主米莉森特·米勒小姐。我们家世代磨面粉。 [wo shi mi er xiang mo fang de mo fang zhu mi li sen te · mi lei xiao jie 。 wo men jia shi dai mo mian fen 。]

english: It's a good business to be in. People will always need flour.
translation: 这是一个很好的行业。人们总是需要面粉。 [zhe shi yi ge hen hao de hang ye 。 ren men zong shi xu yao mian fen 。]

english: How do I mill flour?
translation: 如何磨面粉？ [ru he mo mian fen ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This is Mill Lane Mill. Millers of the finest flour in Gielinor, and home to the Miller family for many generations
translation: 这是米尔巷米尔。吉利诺 (Gielinor) 生产最优质面粉的磨坊，也是磨坊家族世世代代居住的地方 [zhe shi mi er xiang mi er 。 ji li nuo  (Gielinor)  sheng chan zui you zhi mian fen de mo fang ， ye shi mo fang jia zu shi shi dai dai ju zhu de di fang]

english: We take grain from the field nearby and mill into flour.
translation: 我们从附近的田里采摘谷物，磨成面粉。 [wo men cong fu jin de tian li cai zhai gu wu ， mo cheng mian fen 。]

english: Making flour is pretty easy. First of all you need to get some grain. You can pick some from wheat fields. There is one just outside the Mill, but there are many others scattered across Gielinor. Feel free to pick wheat
translation: 制作面粉非常简单。首先你需要获得一些谷物。你可以从麦田里摘一些。磨坊外面就有一家，但吉林诺各处还散布着许多其他的。随意摘麦子 [zhi zuo mian fen fei chang jian dan 。 shou xian ni xu yao huo de yi xie gu wu 。 ni ke yi cong mai tian li zhai yi xie 。 mo fang wai mian jiu you yi jia ， dan ji lin nuo ge chu hai san bu zhe xu duo qi ta de 。 sui yi zhai mai zi]

english: from our field! There always seems to be plenty of wheat there.
translation: 来自我们的领域！那里似乎总是有很多小麦。 [lai zi wo men de ling yu ！ na li si hu zong shi you hen duo xiao mai 。]

english: Then I bring my wheat here?
translation: 那我把我的小麦带到这里来？ [na wo ba wo de xiao mai dai dao zhe li lai ？]

english: Yes, or one of the other mills in Gielinor. They all work the same way. Just take your grain to the top floor of the mill (up two ladders, there are three floors including this one) and then place some grain into the hopper.
translation: 是的，或者吉林诺的其他工厂之一。它们的工作方式都是一样的。只需将谷物带到磨坊的顶层（爬上两个梯子，包括这一层在内，共有三层），然后将一些谷物放入料斗中。 [shi de ， huo zhe ji lin nuo de qi ta gong chang zhi yi 。 ta men de gong zuo fang shi dou shi yi yang de 。 zhi xu jiang gu wu dai dao mo fang de ding ceng （ pa shang liang ge ti zi ， bao kuo zhe yi ceng zai nei ， gong you san ceng ）， ran hou jiang yi xie gu wu fang ru liao dou zhong 。]

english: Then you need to start the grinding process by pulling the hopper lever. You can add more grain, but each time you add grain you have to pull the hopper lever again.
translation: 然后，您需要拉动料斗杆来开始研磨过程。您可以添加更多谷物，但每次添加谷物时，您都必须再次拉动料斗杆。 [ran hou ， nin xu yao la dong liao dou gan lai kai shi yan mo guo cheng 。 nin ke yi tian jia geng duo gu wu ， dan mei ci tian jia gu wu shi ， nin dou bi xu zai ci la dong liao dou gan 。]

english: So where does the flour go then?
translation: 那么面粉去哪儿了呢？ [na me mian fen qu na er le ne ？]

english: The flour appears in this room here, you'll need a pot to put the flour into. One pot will hold the flour made by one load of grain
translation: 面粉出现在这个房间里，你需要一个锅来把面粉放进去。一锅能装一担谷物磨成的面粉 [mian fen chu xian zai zhe ge fang jian li ， ni xu yao yi ge guo lai ba mian fen fang jin qu 。 yi guo neng zhuang yi dan gu wu mo cheng de mian fen]

english: And that's it! You now have some pots of finely ground flour of the highest quality. Ideal for making tasty cakes or delicous bread. I'm not a cook so you'll have to ask a cook to find out how to bake things.
translation: 就是这样！现在您已经拥有了一些最优质的细磨面粉。非常适合制作美味的蛋糕或美味的面包。我不是厨师，所以你必须请厨师来了解如何烘烤东西。 [jiu shi zhe yang ！ xian zai nin yi jing yong you le yi xie zui you zhi di xi mo mian fen 。 fei chang shi he zhi zuo mei wei de dan gao huo mei wei de mian bao 。 wo bu shi chu shi ， suo yi ni bi xu qing chu shi lai liao jie ru he hong kao dong xi 。]

english: Great! Thanks for your help.
translation: 伟大的！感谢您的帮助。 [wei da de ！ gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello Adventurers. Welcome to Mill Lane Mill. Can I help you?
translation: 冒险家们大家好。欢迎来到米尔巷米尔。我可以帮你吗？ [mao xian jia men da jia hao 。 huan ying lai dao mi er xiang mi er 。 wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun! What is this place?
translation: 我是多格舒恩的扎尼克！这是什么地方？ [wo shi duo ge shu en de zha ni ke ！ zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: What's flour?
translation: 什么是面粉？ [shen me shi mian fen ？]

english: It's the stuff we get from milling the grain. We use it to make bread and cakes and things.
translation: 这是我们通过碾磨谷物得到的东西。我们用它来制作面包、蛋糕之类的东西。 [zhe shi wo men tong guo nian mo gu wu de dao de dong xi 。 wo men yong ta lai zhi zuo mian bao 、 dan gao zhi lei de dong xi 。]

english: We don't have any of those things in Dorgesh-Kaan! They sound so interesting!
translation: 我们多尔格什-卡恩没有这些东西！他们听起来很有趣！ [wo men duo er ge shen - ka en mei you zhe xie dong xi ！ ta men ting qi lai hen you qu ！]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: How do I mill flour?
translation: 如何磨面粉？ [ru he mo mian fen ？]

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Do you want to buy a lamp, surface-dweller?
translation: 地表居民，你想买台灯吗？ [di biao ju min ， ni xiang mai tai deng ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Suit yourself.
translation: 适合自己。 [shi he zi ji 。]

english: Can you fill a lamp with oil please?
translation: 请问可以给灯加满油吗？ [qing wen ke yi gei deng jia man you ma ？]

english: You can do that yourself! Just put some swamp tar in the lamp oil still here and then use the lamp on the still.
translation: 你可以自己做！只需将一些沼泽焦油放入蒸馏器中的灯油中，然后使用蒸馏器上的灯即可。 [ni ke yi zi ji zuo ！ zhi xu jiang yi xie zhao ze jiao you fang ru zheng liu qi zhong de deng you zhong ， ran hou shi yong zheng liu qi shang de deng ji ke 。]

english: How do the lamps around the city work?
translation: 城市周围的灯是如何工作的？ [cheng shi zhou wei de deng shi ru he gong zuo de ？]

english: They work by our very own Dorgeshuun magic!
translation: 它们通过我们自己的 Dorgeshuun 魔法发挥作用！ [ta men tong guo wo men zi ji de  Dorgeshuun  mo fa fa hui zuo yong ！]

english: Sometimes they don't work very well, though. The light orbs blow and they have to be replaced.
translation: 但有时它们的效果并不好。光球爆炸，必须更换。 [dan you shi ta men de xiao guo bing bu hao 。 guang qiu bao zha ， bi xu geng huan 。]

english: If you ever see a lamp that's gone out, you can fix it by replacing the light orb. You can make new light orbs out of glass, and use a piece of wire on them to add the filament.
translation: 如果您发现灯熄灭了，可以通过更换灯球来修复它。您可以用玻璃制作新的光球，并在其上使用一根金属丝来添加灯丝。 [ru guo nin fa xian deng xi mie le ， ke yi tong guo geng huan deng qiu lai xiu fu ta 。 nin ke yi yong bo li zhi zuo xin de guang qiu ， bing zai qi shang shi yong yi gen jin shu si lai tian jia deng si 。]

english: There's a machine in the south of the city that makes the wire you need.
translation: 城市南部有一台机器可以生产你需要的电线。 [cheng shi nan bu you yi tai ji qi ke yi sheng chan ni xu yao de dian xian 。]

english: Lamps!
translation: 灯！ [deng ！]

english: Lanterns!
translation: 灯笼！ [deng long ！]

english: Tinderboxes!
translation: 火药桶！ [huo yao tong ！]

english: Torches!
translation: 火把！ [huo ba ！]

english: Lamp oil!
translation: 灯油！ [deng you ！]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Can you fill a lamp with oil please?
translation: 请问可以给灯加满油吗？ [qing wen ke yi gei deng jia man you ma ？]

english: How do the lamps around the city work?
translation: 城市周围的灯是如何工作的？ [cheng shi zhou wei de deng shi ru he gong zuo de ？]

english: Gah! Trolls everywhere. There's no escape!
translation: 嘎！巨魔无处不在。无处可逃！ [ga ！ ju mo wu chu bu zai 。 wu chu ke tao ！]

english: You could just leave the mine.
translation: 你可以离开矿井。 [ni ke yi li kai kuang jing 。]

english: Oh, I'd never thought of that.
translation: 哦，我从没想过这一点。 [o ， wo cong mei xiang guo zhe yi dian 。]

english: This place rocks!
translation: 这个地方太棒了！ [zhe ge di fang tai bang le ！]

english: No it doesn't, it stays perfectly still.
translation: 不，它没有，它保持完全静止。 [bu ， ta mei you ， ta bao chi wan quan jing zhi 。]

english: Bah! Be quiet, pedant.
translation: 呸!安静点，学究。 [pei ! an jing dian ， xue jiu 。]

english: High hoe, high hoe!
translation: 高锄头，高锄头！ [gao chu tou ， gao chu tou ！]

english: Why are you singing about farming implements at altitude?
translation: 为什么要在高海拔地区歌唱农具？ [wei shen me yao zai gao hai ba di qu ge chang nong ju ？]

english: I don't know, I've never thought about it. Ask my Dad, he taught me the song.
translation: 我不知道，我从来没有想过。问我爸爸，他教我这首歌。 [wo bu zhi dao ， wo cong lai mei you xiang guo 。 wen wo ba ba ， ta jiao wo zhe shou ge 。]

english: How's your prospecting going?
translation: 你的勘探进展如何？ [ni de kan tan jin zhan ru he ？]

english: Mine's going pretty well.
translation: 我的进展顺利。 [wo de jin zhan shun li 。]

english: Mine? Mine...you get it?
translation: 矿？我的……你明白了吗？ [kuang ？ wo de …… ni ming bai le ma ？]

english: Oh, I got it. That doesn't make it funny though.
translation: 哦，我明白了。但这并不有趣。 [o ， wo ming bai le 。 dan zhe bing bu you qu 。]

english: Suit yourself.
translation: 适合自己。 [shi he zi ji 。]

english: I've been here for two days straight. When I close my eyes I see rocks.
translation: 我已经在这里连续两天了。当我闭上眼睛时，我看到岩石。 [wo yi jing zai zhe li lian xu liang tian le 。 dang wo bi shang yan jing shi ， wo kan dao yan shi 。]

english: Why would anyone stay here for so long?
translation: 为什么有人会在这里待这么久？ [wei shen me you ren hui zai zhe li dai zhe me jiu ？]

english: I fear the outside. I fear the big light.
translation: 我害怕外面。我害怕大光。 [wo hai pa wai mian 。 wo hai pa da guang 。]

english: Oh dear. Being underground for so long may have driven you mad.
translation: 哦亲爱的。在地下呆了这么久可能会让你发疯。 [o qin ai de 。 zai di xia dai le zhe me jiu ke neng hui rang ni fa feng 。]

english: My back is killing me!
translation: 我的背痛死我了！ [wo de bei tong si wo le ！]

english: Could be worse, it could be the trolls killing you.
translation: 更糟糕的是，可能是巨魔杀死了你。 [geng zao gao de shi ， ke neng shi ju mo sha si le ni 。]

english: How very droll.
translation: 多么滑稽啊。 [duo me hua ji a 。]

english: No, troll.
translation: 不，巨魔。 [bu ， ju mo 。]

english: Bah! I resist your attempts at jollity.
translation: 呸!我抵制你的欢乐行为。 [pei ! wo di zhi ni de huan le xing wei 。]

english: Pay-dirt!
translation: 支付污垢！ [zhi fu wu gou ！]

english: Ow!
Exchuse me... I am trying to tell my verrry good friends 'bout my uncle's bushy beard.
translation: 对不起……我正想告诉我的好朋友我叔叔的浓密胡须。 [dui bu qi …… wo zheng xiang gao su wo de hao peng you wo shu shu de nong mi hu xu 。]

english: Exchuse me... I am lishning to my good friend.
translation: 对不起……我正在向我的好朋友询问。 [dui bu qi …… wo zheng zai xiang wo de hao peng you xun wen 。]

english: He could hardly climb a ladder without tripping.
translation: 他爬梯子几乎不可能不被绊倒。 [ta pa ti zi ji hu bu ke neng bu bei ban dao 。]

english: Such a long beard it reached the floor!
translation: 胡子这么长，竟然长到地板上了！ [hu zi zhe me zhang ， jing ran zhang dao di ban shang le ！]

english: The beard wasn't so clean after meals.
translation: 饭后胡须不太干净。 [fan hou hu xu bu tai gan jing 。]

english: His beard used to get into everyone's dinner.
translation: 他的胡子曾经出现在每个人的晚餐上。 [ta de hu zi ceng jing chu xian zai mei ge ren de wan can shang 。]

english: It was like a jungle on his chin!
translation: 他的下巴就像一片丛林！ [ta de xia ba jiu xiang yi pian cong lin ！]

english: In the summer he didn't need clothes.
translation: 夏天他不需要衣服。 [xia tian ta bu xu yao yi fu 。]

english: I mean, he needed to clean it more.
translation: 我的意思是，他需要更多地清理它。 [wo de yi si shi ， ta xu yao geng duo di qing li ta 。]

english: He had the bushiest beard ever!
translation: 他有有史以来最浓密的胡子！ [ta you you shi yi lai zui nong mi de hu zi ！]

english: He was the hairiest dwarf in town.
translation: 他是镇上毛发最多的侏儒。 [ta shi zhen shang mao fa zui duo de zhu ru 。]

english: His wife could use it for a blanket.
translation: 他的妻子可以用它来做毯子。 [ta de qi zi ke yi yong ta lai zuo tan zi 。]

english: Pearls of wisdom!
translation: 智慧的珍珠！ [zhi hui de zhen zhu ！]

english: Ah, tell it!
translation: 啊，快说吧！ [a ， kuai shuo ba ！]

english: Best times ever!
translation: 有史以来最好的时光！ [you shi yi lai zui hao de shi guang ！]

english: Right you are.
translation: 你是对的。 [ni shi dui de 。]

english: Great days!
translation: 美好的日子！ [mei hao de ri zi ！]

english: I'm going to be sick!
translation: 我要生病了！ [wo yao sheng bing le ！]

english: You're right.
translation: 你说得对。 [ni shuo de dui 。]

english: You're so right.
translation: 你说得太对了。 [ni shuo de tai dui le 。]

english: Those were the days!
translation: 那些日子！ [na xie ri zi ！]

english: Not like nowadays.
translation: 不像现在。 [bu xiang xian zai 。]

english: Good day, Your Royal Highness.
translation: 美好的一天，殿下。 [mei hao de yi tian ， dian xia 。]

english: Good day. What are you doing?
translation: 再会。你在干什么？ [zai hui 。 ni zai gan shen me ？]

english: I'm mining coal. It's pretty tough going.
translation: 我正在开采煤炭。走起来相当艰难。 [wo zheng zai kai cai mei tan 。 zou qi lai xiang dang jian nan 。]

english: Good luck with that.
translation: 祝你好运。 [zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Thank you, Your Royal Highness.
translation: 谢谢您，殿下。 [xie xie nin ， dian xia 。]

english: Can you tell me how the kingdom approves of me?
translation: 你能告诉我王国对我的认可度如何吗？ [ni neng gao su wo wang guo dui wo de ren ke du ru he ma ？]

english: [amount]% of people approve of you.
translation: [数量]％的人赞同你。 [[ shu liang ]％ de ren zan tong ni 。]

english: The storerooms are full, your Highness. You should talk to Advisor Ghrim to collect what we've gathered for you.
translation: 殿下，储藏室已经满了。您应该与 Ghrim 顾问交谈以收集我们为您收集的信息。 [dian xia ， chu cang shi yi jing man le 。 nin ying gai yu  Ghrim  gu wen jiao tan yi shou ji wo men wei nin shou ji de xin xi 。]

english: Ah! Here you go!
translation: 啊!干得好！ [a ! gan de hao ！]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: I need you to answer this for me.
translation: 我需要你帮我回答这个问题。 [wo xu yao ni bang wo hui da zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Miner Magnus has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 矿工马格努斯给了你一个挑战卷轴！ [kuang gong ma ge nu si gei le ni yi ge tiao zhan juan zhou ！]

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。 [qing shu ru wen ti de da an 。]

english: How can that be? Go check again!
translation: 怎么可能呢？再去检查一下吧！ [zen me ke neng ne ？ zai qu jian cha yi xia ba ！]

english: Spot on!
translation: 现货！ [xian huo ！]

english: Miner Magnus has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 矿工马格努斯给了你另一个线索卷轴！ [kuang gong ma ge nu si gei le ni ling yi ge xian suo juan zhou ！]

english: Oi! Where d'you think you're going? Come and speak to me before you go wondering through there. You'll get yourself killed!
translation: 哎呀！你认为你要去哪里？在你去那里之前先来和我谈谈。你会害死自己的！ [ai ya ！ ni ren wei ni yao qu na li ？ zai ni qu na li zhi qian xian lai he wo tan tan 。 ni hui hai si zi ji de ！]

english: Oi, get yer hands off that! It's reserved for survivors of the Colosseum.
translation: 哎呀，把你的手拿开！它是为罗马斗兽场的幸存者保留的。 [ai ya ， ba ni de shou na kai ！ ta shi wei luo ma dou shou chang de xing cun zhe bao liu de 。]

english: You do not have enough Glory to use that.
translation: 你没有足够的荣耀来使用它。 [ni mei you zu gou de rong yao lai shi yong ta 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Welcome, Rookie.
translation: 欢迎，菜鸟。 [huan ying ， cai niao 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This place...? Why, This is the great Fortis Colosseum!
translation: 这个地方……？为什么，这就是伟大的富蒂斯斗兽场！ [zhe ge di fang ……？ wei shen me ， zhe jiu shi wei da de fu di si dou shou chang ！]

english: Adventurers come from near and far to test their might within these walls.
translation: 冒险家从四面八方赶来，在这些城墙内测试他们的力量。 [mao xian jia cong si mian ba fang gan lai ， zai zhe xie cheng qiang nei ce shi ta men de li liang 。]

english: That sounds exciting!
translation: 听起来很令人兴奋！ [ting qi lai hen ling ren xing fen ！]

english: Indeed it is. If you are victorious in the Colosseum, the whole of Varlamore shall hear of your name.
translation: 确实如此。如果你在斗兽场取得胜利，整个瓦拉莫尔都会听到你的名字。 [que shi ru ci 。 ru guo ni zai dou shou chang qu de sheng li ， zheng ge wa la mo er du hui ting dao ni de ming zi 。]

english: I imagine itsquite the challenge then?
translation: 我想这确实是一个挑战？ [wo xiang zhe que shi shi yi ge tiao zhan ？]

english: It'll put your skills to the test alright.
translation: 它会考验你的技能。 [ta hui kao yan ni de ji neng 。]

english: How do I participate?
translation: 我该如何参与？ [wo gai ru he can yu ？]

english: Just head through that tunnel behind me and we'll get the show started! Make sure you've got everything you need. Once you're in you can't leave until the end of a wave!
translation: 只要穿过我身后的隧道，我们就可以开始表演了！确保您已拥有所需的一切。一旦你进去了，直到一波结束之前你不能离开！ [zhi yao chuan guo wo shen hou de sui dao ， wo men jiu ke yi kai shi biao yan le ！ que bao nin yi yong you suo xu de yi qie 。 yi dan ni jin qu le ， zhi dao yi bo jie shu zhi qian ni bu neng li kai ！]

english: Come and ask if you have any other questions.
translation: 如果还有其他问题就过来问吧。 [ru guo hai you qi ta wen ti jiu guo lai wen ba 。]

english: Can you tell me about modifiers?
translation: 你能告诉我有关修改器的信息吗？ [ni neng gao su wo you guan xiu gai qi de xin xi ma ？]

english: Yes! After all, they were my idea...
translation: 是的！毕竟，它们是我的主意...... [shi de ！ bi jing ， ta men shi wo de zhu yi ......]

english: Oh...
Every time you complete a wave, I'll offer you a choice of three modifiers.
translation: 每次你完成一波，我都会为你提供三个修饰符的选择。 [mei ci ni wan cheng yi bo ， wo du hui wei ni ti gong san ge xiu shi fu de xuan ze 。]

english: Each modifier will increase the challenge for the rest of the run - So choose wisely!
translation: 每个修改器都会增加剩余跑步的挑战 - 所以明智地选择！ [mei ge xiu gai qi du hui zeng jia sheng yu pao bu de tiao zhan  -  suo yi ming zhi di xuan ze ！]

english: Some modifiers can be offered multiple times, with the effects then growing in power!
translation: 有些修饰符可以多次提供，效果会越来越强大！ [you xie xiu shi fu ke yi duo ci ti gong ， xiao guo hui yue lai yue qiang da ！]

english: Thanks for the heads up!
translation: 感谢您的提醒！ [gan xie nin de ti xing ！]

english: Was there anything else?
translation: 还有别的事吗？ [hai you bie de shi ma ？]

english: How do I get rewarded?
translation: 我如何获得奖励？ [wo ru he huo de jiang li ？]

english: Well it's a bit different to just killing monsters and picking up items, as I'm sure you're used to...
translation: 嗯，这与杀死怪物和拾取物品有点不同，因为我相信你已经习惯了...... [n ， zhe yu sha si guai wu he shi qu wu pin you dian bu tong ， yin wei wo xiang xin ni yi jing xi guan le ......]

english: How so?
translation: 为何如此？ [wei he ru ci ？]

english: After each wave inside the Colosseum, I'll show you the rewards you have earned, as well as what you'll earn from the next wave...
translation: 在斗兽场内的每一波之后，我都会向你展示你所获得的奖励，以及你将从下一波中获得的奖励...... [zai dou shou chang nei de mei yi bo zhi hou ， wo du hui xiang ni zhan shi ni suo huo de de jiang li ， yi ji ni jiang cong xia yi bo zhong huo de de jiang li ......]

english: If you aren't confident that you can complete the next wave, you can claim your existing rewards and exit early.
translation: 如果您对完成下一波没有信心，您可以领取现有奖励并提前退出。 [ru guo nin dui wan cheng xia yi bo mei you xin xin ， nin ke yi ling qu xian you jiang li bing ti qian tui chu 。]

english: However, if you're confident you can beat the next wave, you can risk your whole reward pile to get even more!
translation: 然而，如果您有信心能够击败下一波浪潮，您可以冒着失去全部奖励的风险来获得更多！ [ran er ， ru guo nin you xin xin neng gou ji bai xia yi bo lang chao ， nin ke yi mao zhe shi qu quan bu jiang li de feng xian lai huo de geng duo ！]

english: Be careful though. If you die or leave the arena before claiming your loot from me, you will lose all of the rewards you've earned.
translation: 不过要小心。如果你在向我领取战利品之前死亡或离开竞技场，你将失去你获得的所有奖励。 [bu guo yao xiao xin 。 ru guo ni zai xiang wo ling qu zhan li pin zhi qian si wang huo li kai jing ji chang ， ni jiang shi qu ni huo de de suo you jiang li 。]

english: So I'm guessing the higher the wave, the better the rewards?
translation: 所以我猜波浪越高，奖励就越好？ [suo yi wo cai bo lang yue gao ， jiang li jiu yue hao ？]

english: Oh, you're good. Exactly that!
translation: 哦，你很好。正是如此！ [o ， ni hen hao 。 zheng shi ru ci ！]

english: Even better - if you manage to finish all of the waves and the final challenge, then you'll be awarded with Dizana's Quiver.
translation: 更好的是 - 如果您成功完成所有波浪和最后的挑战，那么您将获得迪扎纳的箭袋。 [geng hao de shi  -  ru guo nin cheng gong wan cheng suo you bo lang he zui hou de tiao zhan ， na me nin jiang huo de di zha na de jian dai 。]

english: It's a handy piece of kit that you wear on your back to store extra bolts or arrows.
translation: 这是一个方便的套件，您可以将其戴在背上以存放额外的螺栓或箭头。 [zhe shi yi ge fang bian de tao jian ， nin ke yi jiang qi dai zai bei shang yi cun fang e wai de luo shuan huo jian tou 。]

english: That does sound handy! Thanks for explaining all of that.
translation: 听起来确实很方便！感谢您解释这一切。 [ting qi lai que shi hen fang bian ！ gan xie nin jie shi zhe yi qie 。]

english: Anytime, Rookie. Anything else?
translation: 任何时候，菜鸟。还要别的吗？ [ren he shi hou ， cai niao 。 hai yao bie de ma ？]

english: What is Glory?
translation: 什么是荣耀？ [shen me shi rong yao ？]

english: It's the measure of your progress inside the Colosseum.
translation: 这是衡量你在罗马斗兽场内的进度的指标。 [zhe shi heng liang ni zai luo ma dou shou chang nei de jin du de zhi biao 。]

english: Speak to Gloria over there if you want to know the details.
translation: 如果你想了解详情，请与那边的格洛丽亚交谈。 [ru guo ni xiang liao jie xiang qing ， qing yu na bian de ge luo li ya jiao tan 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这附近做什么？ [ni zai zhe fu jin zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm Minimus. It's not my real name of course, but it seems to have stuck. I started out competing here as a gladiator when I was a young'n. After that I became one of the lanistas.
translation: 我是米尼姆斯。这当然不是我的真名，但它似乎已经被保留下来了。当我年轻的时候，我就开始在这里作为角斗士参加比赛。从那以后我就成为了兰尼斯塔中的一员。 [wo shi mi ni mu si 。 zhe dang ran bu shi wo de zhen ming ， dan ta si hu yi jing bei bao liu xia lai le 。 dang wo nian qing de shi hou ， wo jiu kai shi zai zhe li zuo wei jue dou shi can jia bi sai 。 cong na yi hou wo jiu cheng wei le lan ni si ta zhong de yi yuan 。]

english: Lanistas?
translation: 拉尼斯塔斯？ [la ni si ta si ？]

english: The ones responsible for overseeing the selecting and training of the gladiators.
translation: 负责监督角斗士选拔和训练的人。 [fu ze jian du jue dou shi xuan ba he xun lian de ren 。]

english: Eventually, the kingdom gave me the role of Colosseum Master. I still make sure to fit some fighting in, but now I have the honorof managing the fights themselves.
translation: 最终，王国给了我斗兽场主人的职位。我仍然确保加入一些战斗，但现在我很荣幸能够自己管理战斗。 [zui zhong ， wang guo gei le wo dou shou chang zhu ren de zhi wei 。 wo reng ran que bao jia ru yi xie zhan dou ， dan xian zai wo hen rong xing neng gou zi ji guan li zhan dou 。]

english: So are you not training like the rest of the gladiators?
translation: 那么你没有像其他角斗士一样训练吗？ [na me ni mei you xiang qi ta jue dou shi yi yang xun lian ma ？]

english: I have no need! I'm already one of the greatest fighters to grace this arena.
translation: 我没有必要！我已经是这个竞技场上最伟大的战士之一了。 [wo mei you bi yao ！ wo yi jing shi zhe ge jing ji chang shang zui wei da de zhan shi zhi yi liao 。]

english: Are you at a disadvantage because of your height?
translation: 你是否因为身高而处于劣势？ [ni shi fou yin wei shen gao er chu yu lie shi ？]

english: No! How dare you even suggest that! Those spindly human bodies are unfit to go toe to toe with a fine dwarf like myself!
translation: 不！你怎么敢提出这样的建议！那些细长的人体根本不适合和我这样一个优秀的侏儒正面交锋！ [bu ！ ni zen me gan ti chu zhe yang de jian yi ！ na xie xi chang de ren ti gen ben bu shi he he wo zhe yang yi ge you xiu de zhu ru zheng mian jiao feng ！]

english: Now, did you need anything else?
translation: 现在，您还需要什么吗？ [xian zai ， nin hai xu yao shen me ma ？]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Farewell, Rookie.
translation: 再见，菜鸟。 [zai jian ， cai niao 。]

english: Welcome, [rank].
translation: 欢迎，[排名]。 [huan ying ，[ pai ming ]。]

english: A [rank] approaches!
translation: 【等级】逼近！ [【 deng ji 】 bi jin ！]

english: Let me know when you want to begin.
translation: 让我知道您想什么时候开始。 [rang wo zhi dao nin xiang shen me shi hou kai shi 。]

english: I have a spare Dizana's quiver (uncharged).
translation: 我有一个备用的迪扎娜箭袋（未充电）。 [wo you yi ge bei yong de di zha na jian dai （ wei chong dian ）。]

english: You want to offer it for some Sunfire splinters? I could also try to convince Smol Heredit to follow you.
translation: 你想用它来换取一些阳火碎片吗？我也可以尝试说服斯莫尔·赫雷迪特跟随你。 [ni xiang yong ta lai huan qu yi xie yang huo sui pian ma ？ wo ye ke yi chang shi shuo fu si mo er · he lei di te gen sui ni 。]

english: But be aware, you will not get the quiver back.
translation: 但要注意，你将无法拿回箭袋。 [dan yao zhu yi ， ni jiang wu fa na hui jian dai 。]

english: Very well, Grand Champion. Keep your trophy.
translation: 很好，总冠军。保留你的奖杯。 [hen hao ， zong guan jun 。 bao liu ni de jiang bei 。]

english: It doesn't actually look like you have enough space to carry 4,000 Sunfire splinters. Come back when you have room.
translation: 实际上看起来你没有足够的空间来携带 4,000 个阳火碎片。有空就回来吧。 [shi ji shang kan qi lai ni mei you zu gou de kong jian lai xie dai  4,000  ge yang huo sui pian 。 you kong jiu hui lai ba 。]

english: He doesn't want to go with you. Sorry.
translation: 他不想和你一起去。对不起。 [ta bu xiang he ni yi qi qu 。 dui bu qi 。]

english: He seems to like you. Smol heredit is yours.
translation: 他好像很喜欢你。 Smol 遗传是你的。 [ta hao xiang hen xi huan ni 。 Smol  yi chuan shi ni de 。]

english: You want to offer it for some Sunfire splinters?
translation: 你想用它来换取一些阳火碎片吗？ [ni xiang yong ta lai huan qu yi xie yang huo sui pian ma ？]

english: I'm afraid you can only offer spare uncharged versions of the quiver to me.
translation: 恐怕你只能向我提供备用的未充电版本的箭袋。 [kong pa ni zhi neng xiang wo ti gong bei yong de wei chong dian ban ben de jian dai 。]

english: Can you tell me about modifiers?
translation: 你能告诉我有关修改器的信息吗？ [ni neng gao su wo you guan xiu gai qi de xin xi ma ？]

english: How do I get rewarded?
translation: 我如何获得奖励？ [wo ru he huo de jiang li ？]

english: What is Glory?
translation: 什么是荣耀？ [shen me shi rong yao ？]

english: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这附近做什么？ [ni zai zhe fu jin zuo shen me ？]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Can we talk about modifiers?
translation: 我们可以谈谈修改器吗？ [wo men ke yi tan tan xiu gai qi ma ？]

english: How can I get rewards?
translation: 我怎样才能获得奖励？ [wo zen yang cai neng huo de jiang li ？]

english: Yes, Trade it for 4,000 Sunfire Splinters
translation: 是的，用它换取 4,000 个阳火碎片 [shi de ， yong ta huan qu  4,000  ge yang huo sui pian]

english: No, keep Dizana's quiver.
translation: 不，保留迪扎娜的箭袋。 [bu ， bao liu di zha na de jian dai 。]

english: Yes, exchange Dizana's quiver for 4,000 Sunfire splinters?
translation: 是的，用迪扎娜的箭袋换 4,000 个阳火碎片？ [shi de ， yong di zha na de jian dai huan  4,000  ge yang huo sui pian ？]

english: Gamble for a Smol Heredit.
translation: 赌一把斯莫尔遗传。 [du yi ba si mo er yi chuan 。]

english: Yes, gamble for a Smol Heredit?
translation: 是的，赌一把斯莫尔遗传？ [shi de ， du yi ba si mo er yi chuan ？]

english: No, keep it.
translation: 不，保留它。 [bu ， bao liu ta 。]

english: Hi there. You must be new around here. So what do I call you? 'Newcomer' seems so impersonal, and if we're going to be working together, I'd rather call you by name.
translation: 你好呀。你一定是新来的。那我该怎么称呼你呢？ “新人”这个词看起来太没有人情味了，如果我们要合作的话，我宁愿直呼你的名字。 [ni hao ya 。 ni yi ding shi xin lai de 。 na wo gai zen me cheng hu ni ne ？ “ xin ren ” zhe ge ci kan qi lai tai mei you ren qing wei le ， ru guo wo men yao he zuo de hua ， wo ning yuan zhi hu ni de ming zi 。]

english: You can call me [player name].
translation: 你可以叫我[玩家姓名]。 [ni ke yi jiao wo [ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Ok then, [player name]. My name is Dezzick and I'm a miner by trade. Let's teach you how to mine.
translation: 好的，[玩家姓名]。我叫 Dezzick，我是一名矿工。教你如何挖矿。 [hao de ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。 wo jiao  Dezzick， wo shi yi ming kuang gong 。 jiao ni ru he wa kuang 。]

english: Mining is very simple, all you need is a pickaxe. The rocks around here contain tin and copper. Why don't you get started by mining some?
translation: 挖矿非常简单，只需要一把镐即可。这里周围的岩石含有锡和铜。为什么不先开采一些呢？ [wa kuang fei chang jian dan ， zhi xu yao yi ba gao ji ke 。 zhe li zhou wei de yan shi han you xi he tong 。 wei shen me bu xian kai cai yi xie ne ？]

english: The rocks around here contain tin and copper. You should try mining some.
translation: 这里周围的岩石含有锡和铜。你应该尝试挖掘一些。 [zhe li zhou wei de yan shi han you xi he tong 。 ni ying gai chang shi wa jue yi xie 。]

english: Now that you have some ore, you should smelt it into a bronze bar. You can use the furnace over there to do so.
translation: 现在你有了一些矿石，你应该将其熔炼成青铜锭。你可以使用那边的熔炉来做到这一点。 [xian zai ni you le yi xie kuang shi ， ni ying gai jiang qi rong lian cheng qing tong ding 。 ni ke yi shi yong na bian de rong lu lai zuo dao zhe yi dian 。]

english: I have a bronze bar. What now?
translation: 我有一根青铜棒。现在怎么办？ [wo you yi gen qing tong bang 。 xian zai zen me ban ？]

english: Now that you've got a bar, you can smith it into a weapon. To smith something, you need a hammer and an anvil. There's some anvils just here that you can use. See if you can make a bronze dagger.
translation: 现在你已经有了一根锭，你可以将它锻造成武器。要锻造东西，您需要锤子和铁砧。这里有一些铁砧可供你使用。看看你能不能制作一把青铜匕首。 [xian zai ni yi jing you le yi gen ding ， ni ke yi jiang ta duan zao cheng wu qi 。 yao duan zao dong xi ， nin xu yao chui zi he tie zhen 。 zhe li you yi xie tie zhen ke gong ni shi yong 。 kan kan ni neng bu neng zhi zuo yi ba qing tong bi shou 。]

english: See if you can use the anvil here to make a bronze dagger.
translation: 看看你是否可以用这里的铁砧制作一把青铜匕首。 [kan kan ni shi fou ke yi yong zhe li de tie zhen zhi zuo yi ba qing tong bi shou 。]

english: Would you like me to recap anything?
translation: 你想让我重述一下吗？ [ni xiang rang wo chong shu yi xia ma ？]

english: Tell me about mining again.
translation: 再给我讲讲挖矿的事吧。 [zai gei wo jiang jiang wa kuang de shi ba 。]

english: Certainly. To mine you need a pickaxe. Different pickaxes let you mine more efficiently.
translation: 当然。要开采，你需要一把镐。不同的镐可以让您更有效地采矿。 [dang ran 。 yao kai cai ， ni xu yao yi ba gao 。 bu tong de gao ke yi rang nin geng you xiao di cai kuang 。]

english: Earlier I gave you a bronze pickaxe, which is the most inefficient pickaxe available, but is perfect for a beginner.
translation: 之前我给了你一把青铜镐，这是效率最低的镐，但非常适合初学者。 [zhi qian wo gei le ni yi ba qing tong gao ， zhe shi xiao lv zui di de gao ， dan fei chang shi he chu xue zhe 。]

english: To mine, simply click on a rock that contains ore while you have a pickaxe with you, and you will keep mining the rock until you manage to get some ore, or until it is empty.
translation: 要开采，只需在随身携带镐的情况下单击含有矿石的岩石，然后您将继续开采岩石，直到您设法获得一些矿石，或者直到它变空为止。 [yao kai cai ， zhi xu zai sui shen xie dai gao de qing kuang xia dan ji han you kuang shi de yan shi ， ran hou nin jiang ji xu kai cai yan shi ， zhi dao nin she fa huo de yi xie kuang shi ， huo zhe zhi dao ta bian kong wei zhi 。]

english: The better the pickaxe you use, the faster you will get ore from the rock you're mining.
translation: 您使用的镐越好，从正在开采的岩石中获取矿石的速度就越快。 [nin shi yong de gao yue hao ， cong zheng zai kai cai de yan shi zhong huo qu kuang shi de su du jiu yue kuai 。]

english: You will be able to buy better pickaxes from the Dwarven Mine when you reach the mainland, but they can be expensive.
translation: 当你到达大陆时，你可以从矮人矿井购买更好的镐，但它们可能很昂贵。 [dang ni dao da da lu shi ， ni ke yi cong ai ren kuang jing gou mai geng hao de gao ， dan ta men ke neng hen ang gui 。]

english: Also, the better the pickaxe the higher the Mining level required to use it will be. Was there anything else you wanted to hear?
translation: 此外，镐越好，使用它所需的采矿等级就越高。您还有什么想听的吗？ [ci wai ， gao yue hao ， shi yong ta suo xu de cai kuang deng ji jiu yue gao 。 nin hai you shen me xiang ting de ma ？]

english: Tell me about smelting again.
translation: 再说说熔炼的事吧。 [zai shuo shuo rong lian de shi ba 。]

english: Smelting is very easy. Simply take the ores required to make a metal to a furnace, then use the ores on the furnace to smelt them into a bar of metal.
translation: 冶炼非常容易。只需将制造金属所需的矿石放入熔炉中，然后使用熔炉上的矿石将它们熔炼成金属条即可。 [ye lian fei chang rong yi 。 zhi xu jiang zhi zao jin shu suo xu de kuang shi fang ru rong lu zhong ， ran hou shi yong rong lu shang de kuang shi jiang ta men rong lian cheng jin shu tiao ji ke 。]

english: Furnaces are expensive to build and maintain, so there are not that many scattered around the world. I suggest when you find one you remember its location for future use.
translation: 熔炉的建造和维护成本很高，因此分布在世界各地的熔炉并不多。我建议您找到一个后记住它的位置以供将来使用。 [rong lu de jian zao he wei hu cheng ben hen gao ， yin ci fen bu zai shi jie ge di de rong lu bing bu duo 。 wo jian yi nin zhao dao yi ge hou ji zhu ta de wei zhi yi gong jiang lai shi yong 。]

english: An alternative to using a furnace to smelt your ore is to use high-level magic to do it.
translation: 使用熔炉熔炼矿石的另一种方法是使用高级魔法。 [shi yong rong lu rong lian kuang shi de ling yi zhong fang fa shi shi yong gao ji mo fa 。]

english: As well as letting you smelt ore anywhere, it has a guaranteed success rate in smelting all ores.
translation: 除了让你可以在任何地方熔炼矿石之外，它还保证了熔炼所有矿石的成功率。 [chu le rang ni ke yi zai ren he di fang rong lian kuang shi zhi wai ， ta hai bao zheng le rong lian suo you kuang shi de cheng gong lv 。]

english: Some metals, such as iron, contain impurities and can be destroyed during the smelting process in a traditional furnace, but magical heat does not destroy them.
translation: 有些金属，例如铁，含有杂质，在传统熔炉的冶炼过程中可能会被破坏，但魔法热量不会破坏它们。 [you xie jin shu ， li ru tie ， han you za zhi ， zai chuan tong rong lu de ye lian guo cheng zhong ke neng hui bei po huai ， dan mo fa re liang bu hui po huai ta men 。]

english: Anything else?
translation: 还要别的吗？ [hai yao bie de ma ？]

english: Tell me about Smithing again.
translation: 再跟我说说史密斯的事吧。 [zai gen wo shuo shuo shi mi si de shi ba 。]

english: When you have acquired enough bars of the metal you wish to work with, you are ready to begin smithing.
translation: 当您获得了足够的您想要使用的金属条后，您就可以开始锻造了。 [dang nin huo de le zu gou de nin xiang yao shi yong de jin shu tiao hou ， nin jiu ke yi kai shi duan zao le 。]

english: Take the hammer I gave you, or buy a new one from a general store, and proceed to a nearby anvil.
translation: 拿起我给你的锤子，或者从杂货店买一把新的，然后前往附近的铁砧。 [na qi wo gei ni de chui zi ， huo zhe cong za huo dian mai yi ba xin de ， ran hou qian wang fu jin de tie zhen 。]

english: By using a metal bar on an anvil you will be presented with a screen showing the objects you are able to smith at your current level.
translation: 通过在铁砧上使用金属棒，您将看到一个屏幕，显示您在当前级别可以锻造的物体。 [tong guo zai tie zhen shang shi yong jin shu bang ， nin jiang kan dao yi ge ping mu ， xian shi nin zai dang qian ji bie ke yi duan zao de wu ti 。]

english: It's a pretty straightforward skill as I'm sure you discovered while making me that lovely bronze dagger.
translation: 这是一项非常简单的技能，我相信你在为我制作那把可爱的青铜匕首时发现了这一点。 [zhe shi yi xiang fei chang jian dan de ji neng ， wo xiang xin ni zai wei wo zhi zuo na ba ke ai de qing tong bi shou shi fa xian le zhe yi dian 。]

english: The higher Smithing level you are, the better quality the metal you can work with. You start off on bronze and work your way up as your smithing skills increase.
translation: 您的锻造水平越高，您可以加工的金属质量就越好。你从青铜开始，随着你的锻造技能的提高而逐步提升。 [nin de duan zao shui ping yue gao ， nin ke yi jia gong de jin shu zhi liang jiu yue hao 。 ni cong qing tong kai shi ， sui zhe ni de duan zao ji neng de ti gao er zhu bu ti sheng 。]

english: Anything else?
translation: 还要别的吗？ [hai yao bie de ma ？]

english: Nope, I'm ready to move on!
translation: 不，我已经准备好继续前进了！ [bu ， wo yi jing zhun bei hao ji xu qian jin le ！]

english: Okay then.
translation: 那么好吧。 [na me hao ba 。]

english: Tell me about Mining again.
translation: 再给我讲讲挖矿吧。 [zai gei wo jiang jiang wa kuang ba 。]

english: Tell me about smelting again.
translation: 再说说熔炼的事吧。 [zai shuo shuo rong lian de shi ba 。]

english: Tell me about Smithing again.
translation: 再跟我说说史密斯的事吧。 [zai gen wo shuo shuo shi mi si de shi ba 。]

english: Nope, I'm ready to move on!
translation: 不，我已经准备好继续前进了！ [bu ， wo yi jing zhun bei hao ji xu qian jin le ！]

english: Can you teach me the basics of mining please?
translation: 你能教我挖矿的基础知识吗？ [ni neng jiao wo wa kuang de ji chu zhi shi ma ？]

english: As you're already here, have a pick so that you can mine the rocks around me.
translation: 既然你已经在这里了，那就拿一把镐，这样你就可以开采我周围的岩石了。 [ji ran ni yi jing zai zhe li le ， na jiu na yi ba gao ， zhe yang ni jiu ke yi kai cai wo zhou wei de yan shi le 。]

english: I'd give you a pick to mine the rocks around me, but you don't have room in your inventory.
translation: 我会给你一个选择来开采我周围的岩石，但你的库存中没有空间。 [wo hui gei ni yi ge xuan ze lai kai cai wo zhou wei de yan shi ， dan ni de ku cun zhong mei you kong jian 。]

english: As you already have a pick, you can mine the rocks around me.
translation: 因为你已经有了镐，所以你可以开采我周围的岩石。 [yin wei ni yi jing you le gao ， suo yi ni ke yi kai cai wo zhou wei de yan shi 。]

english: You can tell the ore you'll get from a rock by looking at it. The colour of the rock helps, too.
translation: 您可以通过观察岩石来判断您将从岩石中获得的矿石。岩石的颜色也有帮助。 [nin ke yi tong guo guan cha yan shi lai pan duan nin jiang cong yan shi zhong huo de de kuang shi 。 yan shi de yan se ye you bang zhu 。]

english: To mine, simply click on the rock to mine it, while you've got a pickaxe with you.
translation: 要开采，只需在随身携带镐的情况下单击岩石即可开采。 [yao kai cai ， zhi xu zai sui shen xie dai gao de qing kuang xia dan ji yan shi ji ke kai cai 。]

english: When you have a full inventory, take it to the bank. There's a bank on the roof of the castle in Lumbridge.
translation: 当你有完整的库存时，将其带到银行。朗布里奇城堡的屋顶上有一家银行。 [dang ni you wan zheng de ku cun shi ， jiang qi dai dao yin hang 。 lang bu li qi cheng bao de wu ding shang you yi jia yin hang 。]

english: I already know about the basics of mining, got any tips?
translation: 我已经了解挖矿的基础知识，有什么建议吗？ [wo yi jing liao jie wa kuang de ji chu zhi shi ， you shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: You can get different rocks in different places throughout the land, explore and find them.
translation: 你可以在整个土地的不同地方获得不同的岩石，探索并找到它们。 [ni ke yi zai zheng ge tu di de bu tong di fang huo de bu tong de yan shi ， tan suo bing zhao dao ta men 。]

english: You could start by traveling to the Al Kharid mine. Follow the path north and pay the 10 coins toll to go through the gate. Head north after passing through the gate and you will find the mine.
translation: 您可以从前往 Al Kharid 矿开始。沿着小路向北走，缴纳10个硬币的路费就可以通过大门。穿过大门后向北走，你就会发现矿井。 [nin ke yi cong qian wang  Al Kharid  kuang kai shi 。 yan zhe xiao lu xiang bei zou ， jiao na 10 ge ying bi de lu fei jiu ke yi tong guo da men 。 chuan guo da men hou xiang bei zou ， ni jiu hui fa xian kuang jing 。]

english: Be careful though, the scorpions in the mine will attack you.
translation: 不过要小心，矿井里的蝎子会攻击你。 [bu guo yao xiao xin ， kuang jing li de xie zi hui gong ji ni 。]

english: I could show you where Al Kharid mine is on your map if you like?
translation: 如果您愿意的话，我可以告诉您卡里德矿山在您的地图上的位置？ [ru guo nin yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi gao su nin ka li de kuang shan zai nin de di tu shang de wei zhi ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Any advice for an advanced miner?
translation: 对高级矿工有什么建议吗？ [dui gao ji kuang gong you shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: Investigate the mining guild, the entrance to this is in the east of Falador down some steps. It could be most useful to you!
translation: 调查采矿公会，其入口位于法拉多东部的一些台阶下。它可能对您最有用！ [diao cha cai kuang gong hui ， qi ru kou wei yu fa la duo dong bu de yi xie tai jie xia 。 ta ke neng dui nin zui you yong ！]

english: You might also like to check out the coal mine west of Seers' village. This will enable you to use the coal trucks.
translation: 您可能还想参观西尔斯村西边的煤矿。这将使您能够使用煤炭卡车。 [nin ke neng hai xiang can guan xi er si cun xi bian de mei kuang 。 zhe jiang shi nin neng gou shi yong mei tan ka che 。]

english: Thank you, I'll remember that.
translation: 谢谢你，我会记住的。 [xie xie ni ， wo hui ji zhu de 。]

english: I could show you where either of the places are on your map if you like?
translation: 如果您愿意的话，我可以告诉您这两个地点在地图上的位置？ [ru guo nin yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi gao su nin zhe liang ge di dian zai di tu shang de wei zhi ？]

english: Can you show me where the mining guild is?
translation: 你能告诉我采矿公会在哪里吗？ [ni neng gao su wo cai kuang gong hui zai na li ma ？]

english: Can you show me where the coal mine is?
translation: 你能告诉我煤矿在哪里吗？ [ni neng gao su wo mei kuang zai na li ma ？]

english: I could show you where the mining guild is on your map if you like?
translation: 如果您愿意的话，我可以告诉您采矿公会在地图上的位置？ [ru guo nin yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi gao su nin cai kuang gong hui zai di tu shang de wei zhi ？]

english: Oh yes, if you haven't already, speak to Doric who can be found around the anvils north of Falador. I'm sure he can help you out.
translation: 哦，是的，如果你还没有的话，请与多里克交谈，他可以在法拉多北部的铁砧周围找到。我确信他能帮助你。 [o ， shi de ， ru guo ni hai mei you de hua ， qing yu duo li ke jiao tan ， ta ke yi zai fa la duo bei bu de tie zhen zhou wei zhao dao 。 wo que xin ta neng bang zhu ni 。]

english: You could investigate the Dig Site east of Varrock, I'm sure you'll find something rewarding there.
translation: 你可以调查瓦罗克东部的挖掘场，我相信你会在那里找到一些有价值的东西。 [ni ke yi diao cha wa luo ke dong bu de wa jue chang ， wo xiang xin ni hui zai na li zhao dao yi xie you jia zhi de dong xi 。]

english: Tell me about different rocks and picks.
translation: 告诉我有关不同岩石和镐的信息。 [gao su wo you guan bu tong yan shi he gao de xin xi 。]

english: Ok then.. here goes....
translation: 好吧……就这样吧…… [hao ba …… jiu zhe yang ba ……]

english: You can make all sorts of things from clay, if you have the crafting skill. Rune Essence is used for magic to cast spells.
translation: 如果你有制作技巧，你可以用粘土制作各种各样的东西。符文精华用于魔法施展法术。 [ru guo ni you zhi zuo ji qiao ， ni ke yi yong nian tu zhi zuo ge zhong ge yang de dong xi 。 fu wen jing hua yong yu mo fa shi zhan fa shu 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: I'm giving Zanik here a tour of Lumbridge.
translation: 我要带扎尼克参观一下朗布里奇。 [wo yao dai zha ni ke can guan yi xia lang bu li qi 。]

english: I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun! Pleased to meet you!
translation: 我是多格舒恩的扎尼克！很高兴认识你！ [wo shi duo ge shu en de zha ni ke ！ hen gao xing ren shi ni ！]

english: Hello there, Zanik! You look like you know your iron from your silver!
translation: 你好，扎尼克！看来你分得清铁银啊！ [ni hao ， zha ni ke ！ kan lai ni fen de qing tie yin a ！]

english: Of course I do! I've mined lots of iron and silver in the Dorgeshuun mines!
translation: 我当然知道！我在多格舒恩矿开采了很多铁和银！ [wo dang ran zhi dao ！ wo zai duo ge shu en kuang kai cai le hen duo tie he yin ！]

english: You don't look like you need any help, then. What about you, [player name]?
translation: 那么你看起来并不需要任何帮助。你呢，[玩家姓名]？ [na me ni kan qi lai bing bu xu yao ren he bang zhu 。 ni ne ，[ wan jia xing ming ]？]

english: Can you teach me the basics of mining please?
translation: 你能教我挖矿的基础知识吗？ [ni neng jiao wo wa kuang de ji chu zhi shi ma ？]

english: I already know about the basics of mining, got any tips?
translation: 我已经了解挖矿的基础知识，有什么建议吗？ [wo yi jing liao jie wa kuang de ji chu zhi shi ， you shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: Yes please.
