translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Any advice for an advanced miner?
translation: 对高级矿工有什么建议吗？ [dui gao ji kuang gong you shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: Can you show me where the mining guild is?
translation: 你能告诉我采矿公会在哪里吗？ [ni neng gao su wo cai kuang gong hui zai na li ma ？]

english: Can you show me where the coal mine is?
translation: 你能告诉我煤矿在哪里吗？ [ni neng gao su wo mei kuang zai na li ma ？]

english: Are there any mining related quests?
translation: 有采矿相关的任务吗？ [you cai kuang xiang guan de ren wu ma ？]

english: Tell me about different rocks and picks.
translation: 告诉我有关不同岩石和镐的信息。 [gao su wo you guan bu tong yan shi he gao de xin xi 。]

english: Rocks and Ores.
translation: 岩石和矿石。 [yan shi he kuang shi 。]

english: Clay and Rune Essence.
translation: 粘土和符文精华。 [nian tu he fu wen jing hua 。]

english: Teach me about mining.
translation: 教我挖矿。 [jiao wo wa kuang 。]

english: Teach me about different rocks.
translation: 教我认识不同的岩石。 [jiao wo ren shi bu tong de yan shi 。]

english: Copper and Tin.
translation: 铜和锡。 [tong he xi 。]

english: Iron and Coal.
translation: 铁和煤。 [tie he mei 。]

english: More...
translation: 更多的... [geng duo de ...]

english: Silver and Gold.
translation: 银和金。 [yin he jin 。]

english: Mithril, Adamantite and Runite.
translation: 秘银、精金和符文石。 [mi yin 、 jing jin he fu wen shi 。]

english: Back...
translation: 后退... [hou tui ...]

english: Pickaxes.
translation: 镐。 [gao 。]

english: Bronze, Iron and Steel.
translation: 青铜、钢铁。 [qing tong 、 gang tie 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Oh look, a human!
translation: 哦，看，一个人类！ [o ， kan ， yi ge ren lei ！]

english: A human? Can we eat it?
translation: 人类？我们可以吃吗？ [ren lei ？ wo men ke yi chi ma ？]

english: No, you rock brain! Humans are our friends!
translation: 不，你这个大脑！人类是我们的朋友！ [bu ， ni zhe ge da nao ！ ren lei shi wo men de peng you ！]

english: Hello, excuse me...
translation: 你好，请问... [ni hao ， qing wen ...]

english: Not sure if I would call them our friends... Not enemies either, of course.
translation: 不确定我是否会称他们为我们的朋友……当然，也不是敌人。 [bu que ding wo shi fou hui cheng ta men wei wo men de peng you …… dang ran ， ye bu shi di ren 。]

english: Not like the trolls. We hate trolls.
translation: 不像巨魔。我们讨厌巨魔。 [bu xiang ju mo 。 wo men tao yan ju mo 。]

english: Excuse me, I just want to-
translation: 对不起，我只是想—— [dui bu qi ， wo zhi shi xiang ——]

english: Nothing's worse than a troll.
translation: 没有什么比巨魔更糟糕的了。 [mei you shen me bi ju mo geng zao gao de le 。]

english: Except discovering that your pickaxe's gone blunt just as you-
translation: 除了发现你的镐变钝了，就像你一样—— [chu le fa xian ni de gao bian dun le ， jiu xiang ni yi yang ——]

english: Excuse me!!!
translation: 打扰一下！！！ [da rao yi xia ！！！]

english: Why, hello, yes, what is it?
translation: 为什么，你好，是的，那是什么？ [wei shen me ， ni hao ， shi de ， na shi shen me ？]

english: I er... well, who are you?
translation: 我呃……好吧，你是谁？ [wo e …… hao ba ， ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm Derni.
translation: 我是德尔尼。 [wo shi de er ni 。]

english: I'm Dernu.
translation: 我是德尔努。 [wo shi de er nu 。]

english: And I'm Miodvetnir. These are my brothers. And who might you be?
translation: 我是米奥德维特尼尔。这些是我的兄弟。你可能是谁？ [wo shi mi ao de wei te ni er 。 zhe xie shi wo de xiong di 。 ni ke neng shi shui ？]

english: My name is Player.
translation: 我的名字是玩家。 [wo de ming zi shi wan jia 。]

english: Pleased to meet you, Player!
translation: 很高兴认识你，玩家！ [hen gao xing ren shi ni ， wan jia ！]

english: I say, we don't get to see a hummon down here very often!
translation: 我说，我们在这里不常看到哈蒙！ [wo shuo ， wo men zai zhe li bu chang kan dao ha meng ！]

english: It's a human, you metal head! You should pay more attention!
translation: 这是一个人类，你这个金属头！你应该多加注意！ [zhe shi yi ge ren lei ， ni zhe ge jin shu tou ！ ni ying gai duo jia zhu yi ！]

english: So, can I ask you dwarves a few questions?
translation: 那么，我可以问你们矮人几个问题吗？ [na me ， wo ke yi wen ni men ai ren ji ge wen ti ma ？]

english: Of course, we love answering questions!
translation: 当然，我们喜欢回答问题！ [dang ran ， wo men xi huan hui da wen ti ！]

english: We're very good at answering questions!
translation: 我们很擅长回答问题！ [wo men hen shan chang hui da wen ti ！]

english: Fire away!
translation: 开火吧！ [kai huo ba ！]

english: Hello again, Player!
translation: 再次你好，玩家！ [zai ci ni hao ， wan jia ！]

english: Are you lost down here?
translation: 你在这里迷路了吗？ [ni zai zhe li mi lu le ma ？]

english: Or were you just stopping by for a chat?
translation: 或者您只是过来聊聊？ [huo zhe nin zhi shi guo lai liao liao ？]

english: Just stopping by for a chat.
translation: 只是停下来聊天。 [zhi shi ting xia lai liao tian 。]

english: What's down this river?
translation: 这条河下游有什么？ [zhe tiao he xia you you shen me ？]

english: Oh, you don't know?
translation: 哦，你不知道吗？ [o ， ni bu zhi dao ma ？]

english: [He/She] doesn't know?
translation: [他/她]不知道吗？ [[ ta / ta ] bu zhi dao ma ？]

english: [He/She] doesn't know!
translation: [他/她]不知道！ [[ ta / ta ] bu zhi dao ！]

english: Can't you just tell me?
translation: 你就不能告诉我吗？ [ni jiu bu neng gao su wo ma ？]

english: It is our glorious city!
translation: 这是我们光荣的城市！ [zhe shi wo men guang rong de cheng shi ！]

english: The grand city of the dwarves!
translation: 矮人的宏伟城市！ [ai ren de hong wei cheng shi ！]

english: Sparkling jewel of the mountain!
translation: 闪闪发光的山明珠！ [shan shan fa guang de shan ming zhu ！]

english: Keldagrim, our home!
translation: 凯尔达格林，我们的家！ [kai er da ge lin ， wo men de jia ！]

english: Can you take me there?
translation: 你能带我去那里吗？ [ni neng dai wo qu na li ma ？]

english: Oh no, we can't do that.
translation: 哦不，我们不能那样做。 [o bu ， wo men bu neng na yang zuo 。]

english: We're far too busy.
translation: 我们太忙了。 [wo men tai mang le 。]

english: You have to keep busy, you see.
translation: 你必须保持忙碌，你看。 [ni bi xu bao chi mang lu ， ni kan 。]

english: Always keep busy, is what our good father used to say.
translation: 永远保持忙碌，这是我们好父亲常说的。 [yong yuan bao chi mang lu ， zhe shi wo men hao fu qin chang shuo de 。]

english: Besides, there's been some weird going ons in the city.
translation: 除此之外，这座城市还发生了一些奇怪的事情。 [chu ci zhi wai ， zhe zuo cheng shi hai fa sheng le yi xie qi guai de shi qing 。]

english: Don't tell [him/her] that! None of [his/her] business!
translation: 不要告诉[他/她]这个！不关[他/她]的事！ [bu yao gao su [ ta / ta ] zhe ge ！ bu guan [ ta / ta ] de shi ！]

english: Only fair if [he/she] wants to go into the city.
translation: 只有[他/她]想进城才公平。 [zhi you [ ta / ta ] xiang jin cheng cai gong ping 。]

english: Oh yes, they only just cleaned up the mess from the last little incident.
translation: 哦，是的，他们刚刚清理了上次小事件造成的混乱。 [o ， shi de ， ta men gang gang qing li le shang ci xiao shi jian zao cheng de hun luan 。]

english: So watch out if you ever do manage to travel to the city! Weird things could happen!
translation: 因此，如果您确实能够前往这座城市，请注意！奇怪的事情可能会发生！ [yin ci ， ru guo nin que shi neng gou qian wang zhe zuo cheng shi ， qing zhu yi ！ qi guai de shi qing ke neng hui fa sheng ！]

english: Any good spots to fish around here?
translation: 这附近有什么钓鱼的好地方吗？ [zhe fu jin you shen me diao yu de hao di fang ma ？]

english: Fish?
translation: 鱼？ [yu ？]

english: Fish?
translation: 鱼？ [yu ？]

english: What are fish?
translation: 什么是鱼？ [shen me shi yu ？]

english: No fish around here.
translation: 这附近没有鱼。 [zhe fu jin mei you yu 。]

english: Say, you're the Fishing Champion, aren't you?
translation: 话说，你是钓鱼冠军，不是吗？ [hua shuo ， ni shi diao yu guan jun ， bu shi ma ？]

english: That must be why you were talking about fish then...
translation: 这一定就是你当时谈论鱼的原因...... [zhe yi ding jiu shi ni dang shi tan lun yu de yuan yin ......]

english: But this water here, you see, it comes dripping down from above.
translation: 但是这里的水，你看，是从上面滴下来的。 [dan shi zhe li de shui ， ni kan ， shi cong shang mian di xia lai de 。]

english: Molten snow, you see.
translation: 融化的雪，你看。 [rong hua de xue ， ni kan 。]

english: Oh, they're these small wriggly things that live in the water.
translation: 哦，它们是生活在水中的那些蠕动的小东西。 [o ， ta men shi sheng huo zai shui zhong de na xie ru dong de xiao dong xi 。]

english: But they're not all small! Some can be large!
translation: 但它们并不都是小！有些可能很大！ [dan ta men bing bu dou shi xiao ！ you xie ke neng hen da ！]

english: And they don't breathe air.
translation: 而且他们不呼吸空气。 [er qie ta men bu hu xi kong qi 。]

english: But [player name] could tell you all about it! After all, [he's/she's] the Fishing Champion!
translation: 但[玩家姓名]可以告诉你一切！毕竟，[他/她]是钓鱼冠军！ [dan [ wan jia xing ming ] ke yi gao su ni yi qie ！ bi jing ，[ ta / ta ] shi diao yu guan jun ！]

english: Maybe later...
translation: 也许以后... [ye xu yi hou ...]

english: What are these mines used for?
translation: 这些地雷有什么用？ [zhe xie di lei you shen me yong ？]

english: What does it look like they're used for?
translation: 它们看起来像是用来做什么的？ [ta men kan qi lai xiang shi yong lai zuo shen me de ？]

english: Isn't it obvious?
translation: 这不是很明显吗？ [zhe bu shi hen ming xian ma ？]

english: For mining of course!
translation: 当然是为了挖矿！ [dang ran shi wei le wa kuang ！]

english: These mines are actually the territory of one of the eight major companies of the mining Consortium.
translation: 这些矿山其实都是矿业财团八大公司之一的领地。 [zhe xie kuang shan qi shi dou shi kuang ye cai tuan ba da gong si zhi yi de ling di 。]

english: Mining companies? Where are they at then?
translation: 矿业公司？那他们在哪儿呢？ [kuang ye gong si ？ na ta men zai na er ne ？]

english: Oh, they all have their headquarters in the city.
translation: 哦，他们的总部都在城里。 [o ， ta men de zong bu dou zai cheng li 。]

english: First floor of the palace.
translation: 宫殿一楼。 [gong dian yi lou 。]

english: No need to give [him/her] directions.
translation: 无需给[他/她]指示。 [wu xu gei [ ta / ta ] zhi shi 。]

english: We haul all our goods to the city by ship, you see.
translation: 你看，我们用船把所有货物运到城里。 [ni kan ， wo men yong chuan ba suo you huo wu yun dao cheng li 。]

english: Since the mine carts don't come here.
translation: 因为矿车不来这里。 [yin wei kuang che bu lai zhe li 。]

english: But because the river goes right to the city, this is just as easy.
translation: 但由于河流直接流向城市，这也同样容易。 [dan you yu he liu zhi jie liu xiang cheng shi ， zhe ye tong yang rong yi 。]

english: Can you help me with this rock down in the mines?
translation: 你能帮我搬走矿井里的这块石头吗？ [ni neng bang wo ban zou kuang jing li de zhe kuai shi tou ma ？]

english: It seems to be unbreakable. I need to know why.
translation: 似乎是牢不可破的。我需要知道为什么。 [si hu shi lao bu ke po de 。 wo xu yao zhi dao wei shen me 。]

english: Say, is that Dondakan's rock?
translation: 请问，那是Dondakan 的岩石吗？ [qing wen ， na shi Dondakan  de yan shi ma ？]

english: That big unbreakable rock?
translation: 那块坚不可摧的大石头？ [na kuai jian bu ke cui de da shi tou ？]

english: That's what [he/she] said, isn't? Pay more attention!
translation: [他/她]就是这么说的，不是吗？多加注意！ [[ ta / ta ] jiu shi zhe me shuo de ， bu shi ma ？ duo jia zhu yi ！]

english: Yes, yes, that's the one.
translation: 是的，是的，就是这个。 [shi de ， shi de ， jiu shi zhe ge 。]

english: Oh, you're not going to get through there I'm afraid.
translation: 哦，恐怕你无法通过那里。 [o ， kong pa ni wu fa tong guo na li 。]

english: It's unbreakable, you see.
translation: 你看，它是牢不可破的。 [ni kan ， ta shi lao bu ke po de 。]

english: Dondakan's been there for...
translation: 唐达坎已经在那里... [tang da kan yi jing zai na li ...]

english: How long would you say he's been there, Miotvednir?
translation: Miotvednir，你说他在那里待了多久？ [Miotvednir， ni shuo ta zai na li dai le duo jiu ？]

english: Eighteen years, Derni, and not a year shorter!
translation: 德尔尼，十八年了，一年也没有短！ [de er ni ， shi ba nian le ， yi nian ye mei you duan ！]

english: That's some dedication!
translation: 这也算是一种奉献吧！ [zhe ye suan shi yi zhong feng xian ba ！]

english: But look at what it got him.
translation: 但看看这给他带来了什么。 [dan kan kan zhe gei ta dai lai le shen me 。]

english: Nothing, that's what.
translation: 没什么，就是这样。 [mei shen me ， jiu shi zhe yang 。]

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: What material would break that rock? You know, the impenetrable one?
translation: 什么材料可以打破那块岩石？你知道吗，坚不可摧的那个？ [shen me cai liao ke yi da po na kuai yan shi ？ ni zhi dao ma ， jian bu ke cui de na ge ？]

english: Well... have you tried a rune pickaxe?
translation: 嗯...你尝试过符文镐吗？ [n ... ni chang shi guo fu wen gao ma ？]

english: An adamantite tool?
translation: 精金工具？ [jing jin gong ju ？]

english: What about a bronze pickaxe?
translation: 青铜镐怎么样？ [qing tong gao zen me yang ？]

english: A bronze pickaxe??
translation: 青铜镐？？ [qing tong gao ？？]

english: What good would that do?
translation: 这样做有什么好处呢？ [zhe yang zuo you shen me hao chu ne ？]

english: Well, you never know...
translation: 好吧，你永远不知道... [hao ba ， ni yong yuan bu zhi dao ...]

english: Don't you think that's the first thing they tried?
translation: 你不认为这是他们尝试的第一件事吗？ [ni bu ren wei zhe shi ta men chang shi de di yi jian shi ma ？]

english: Hey, it was just a suggestion!
translation: 嘿，这只是一个建议！ [hei ， zhe zhi shi yi ge jian yi ！]

english: Do you know anyone named Rolad? Some kind of a dwarven scholar?
translation: 你认识一个叫罗拉德的人吗？某种矮人学者？ [ni ren shi yi ge jiao luo la de de ren ma ？ mou zhong ai ren xue zhe ？]

english: Sorry, doesn't ring a bell.
translation: 抱歉，没有按铃。 [bao qian ， mei you an ling 。]

english: Oh yes, I know Rolad!
translation: 哦，是的，我认识罗拉德！ [o ， shi de ， wo ren shi luo la de ！]

english: Oh, stop winding up the human, Dernu!
translation: 哦，别再给人类上瘾了，德尔努！ [o ， bie zai gei ren lei shang yin le ， de er nu ！]

english: Do you know where he is right now?
translation: 你知道他现在在哪里吗？ [ni zhi dao ta xian zai zai na li ma ？]

english: No idea, why?
translation: 不知道为什么？ [bu zhi dao wei shen me ？]

english: Dondakan wants to shoot me out of a cannon!
translation: 唐达坎想用大炮射我！ [tang da kan xiang yong da pao she wo ！]

english: Oh dear!
translation: 哦亲爱的！ [o qin ai de ！]

english: How awful!
translation: 多么可怕啊！ [duo me ke pa a ！]

english: That's terrible!
translation: 太可怕了！ [tai ke pa le ！]

english: He thinks I'm actually going to fly through it and land on the other side.
translation: 他认为我实际上会飞过它并降落在另一边。 [ta ren wei wo shi ji shang hui fei guo ta bing jiang luo zai ling yi bian 。]

english: That sounds a bit daft.
translation: 这听起来有点愚蠢。 [zhe ting qi lai you dian yu chun 。]

english: How would that work?
translation: 那会如何运作呢？ [na hui ru he yun zuo ne ？]

english: I think you're going to hurt your head.
translation: 我想你会伤到你的头。 [wo xiang ni hui shang dao ni de tou 。]

english: Old Dondakan might have finally lost it.
translation: 老唐达坎可能终于失去了它。 [lao tang da kan ke neng zhong yu shi qu le ta 。]

english: He was always obsessed with that rock.
translation: 他一直对那块石头很着迷。 [ta yi zhi dui na kuai shi tou hen zhao mi 。]

english: And gold.
translation: 还有黄金。 [hai you huang jin 。]

english: Right, and gold.
translation: 对了，还有黄金。 [dui le ， hai you huang jin 。]

english: Any tips on how to defeat an evil demon?
translation: 关于如何击败邪恶恶魔有什么秘诀吗？ [guan yu ru he ji bai xie e e mo you shen me mi jue ma ？]

english: An evil demon, you say?
translation: 你说是邪恶的恶魔？ [ni shuo shi xie e de e mo ？]

english: I'd run away if I ever ran into an evil demon.
translation: 如果我遇到邪恶的恶魔，我会逃跑。 [ru guo wo yu dao xie e de e mo ， wo hui tao pao 。]

english: Don't be such a coward, Dernu!
translation: 别这么胆小鬼，德尔努！ [bie zhe me dan xiao gui ， de er nu ！]

english: Well, what would you do then?
translation: 嗯，那么你会怎么做？ [n ， na me ni hui zen me zuo ？]

english: I don't know, I've never encountered an evil demon.
translation: 我不知道，我从来没有遇到过邪恶的恶魔。 [wo bu zhi dao ， wo cong lai mei you yu dao guo xie e de e mo 。]

english: I once met a good demon though.
translation: 不过我曾经遇到过一个善良的恶魔。 [bu guo wo ceng jing yu dao guo yi ge shan liang de e mo 。]

english: Oh yes, what did he say?
translation: 哦，是的，他说什么？ [o ， shi de ， ta shuo shen me ？]

english: He gave me a puzzle box and then went off again.
translation: 他给了我一个拼图盒，然后又走了。 [ta gei le wo yi ge pin tu he ， ran hou you zou le 。]

english: I think you must have had too much dwarven stout in you.
translation: 我想你一定是体内有太多矮人黑啤酒了。 [wo xiang ni yi ding shi ti nei you tai duo ai ren hei pi jiu le 。]

english: Could be, could be, but there's no telling, is there?
translation: 可能是，可能是，但是没有办法，不是吗？ [ke neng shi ， ke neng shi ， dan shi mei you ban fa ， bu shi ma ？]

english: I defeated the spirit of the rock!
translation: 我打败了岩石之魂！ [wo da bai le yan shi zhi hun ！]

english: That's amazing!
translation: 太棒了！ [tai bang le ！]

english: That's fantastic!
translation: 太棒了！ [tai bang le ！]

english: What rock was that again?
translation: 那又是什么岩石？ [na you shi shen me yan shi ？]

english: Pay attention for once, Dernu! It's Dondakan's rock!
translation: 请注意一次，德尔努！这是Dondakan 的岩石！ [qing zhu yi yi ci ， de er nu ！ zhe shi Dondakan  de yan shi ！]

english: That's quite impressive, Player. How did you manage to do that?
translation: 这真是令人印象深刻，玩家。你是怎么做到的？ [zhe zhen shi ling ren yin xiang shen ke ， wan jia 。 ni shi zen me zuo dao de ？]

english: Well, you see, I just-
translation: 好吧，你看，我只是—— [hao ba ， ni kan ， wo zhi shi ——]

english: What kind of question is that to ask? With [his/her/their] great might of course!
translation: 这是要问什么样的问题呢？当然是凭借[他/她/他们的]强大力量！ [zhe shi yao wen shen me yang de wen ti ne ？ dang ran shi ping jie [ ta / ta / ta men de ] qiang da li liang ！]

english: Or vast magical skills!
translation: 或者浩瀚的魔法技能！ [huo zhe hao han de mo fa ji neng ！]

english: No, you're more a ranger, aren't you Player?
translation: 不，你更像是一名游侠，不是玩家吗？ [bu ， ni geng xiang shi yi ming you xia ， bu shi wan jia ma ？]

english: Actually, I-
translation: 事实上，我—— [shi shi shang ， wo ——]

english: Anyway, this calls for a celebration.
translation: 无论如何，这需要庆祝。 [wu lun ru he ， zhe xu yao qing zhu 。]

english: Oh yes, we should go down into Keldagrim to celebrate.
translation: 哦，是的，我们应该去凯尔达格林庆祝一下。 [o ， shi de ， wo men ying gai qu kai er da ge lin qing zhu yi xia 。]

english: Tonight, of course, not now. We're on duty now.
translation: 当然是今晚，不是现在。我们现在正在值班。 [dang ran shi jin wan ， bu shi xian zai 。 wo men xian zai zheng zai zhi ban 。]

english: Right... and I'm sure traffic here will pick up soon with that rock broken.
translation: 是的……我相信随着那块岩石的破碎，这里的交通很快就会恢复。 [shi de …… wo xiang xin sui zhe na kuai yan shi de po sui ， zhe li de jiao tong hen kuai jiu hui hui fu 。]

english: I heard there's vast amount of gold inside!
translation: 听说里面有大量的金子！ [ting shuo li mian you da liang de jin zi ！]

english: The company is going to be rich!
translation: 公司要发财了！ [gong si yao fa cai le ！]

english: Now don't you go and discuss company business in front of this human, Dernu.
translation: 现在你别去在德尔努这个人类面前讨论公司事务了。 [xian zai ni bie qu zai de er nu zhe ge ren lei mian qian tao lun gong si shi wu le 。]

english: Right. Let's get back to work.
translation: 正确的。让我们回去工作吧。 [zheng que de 。 rang wo men hui qu gong zuo ba 。]

english: Anything else you wanted, Player?
translation: 玩家，你还有什么想要的吗？ [wan jia ， ni hai you shen me xiang yao de ma ？]

english: I need some help with this statue... King Alvis' statue, to be precise.
translation: 我需要一些帮助来处理这座雕像……准确地说，是阿尔维斯国王的雕像。 [wo xu yao yi xie bang zhu lai chu li zhe zuo diao xiang …… zhun que di shuo ， shi a er wei si guo wang de diao xiang 。]

english: Oh yes, what's the problem then?
translation: 哦，是的，那有什么问题呢？ [o ， shi de ， na you shen me wen ti ne ？]

english: It was knocked down, remember? Parts of it nearly landed on our heads?
translation: 被撞倒了，还记得吗？它的一部分差点就落在我们头上了？ [bei zhuang dao le ， hai ji de ma ？ ta de yi bu fen cha dian jiu luo zai wo men tou shang le ？]

english: A terrible noise it made too!
translation: 它还发出可怕的声音！ [ta hai fa chu ke pa de sheng yin ！]

english: This sculptor has got me looking for a lot of items, you see.
translation: 你看，这位雕塑家让我寻找了很多物品。 [ni kan ， zhe wei diao su jia rang wo xun zhao le hen duo wu pin 。]

english: Items eh?
translation: 物品啊？ [wu pin a ？]

english: We love items.
translation: 我们喜欢物品。 [wo men xi huan wu pin 。]

english: Can't get enough of them.
translation: 无法得到足够的他们。 [wu fa de dao zu gou de ta men 。]

english: Well, can you he-
translation: 好吧，你能—— [hao ba ， ni neng ——]

english: I got this puzzle box once, you know.
translation: 你知道，我曾经得到过这个拼图盒。 [ni zhi dao ， wo ceng jing de dao guo zhe ge pin tu he 。]

english: Oh, not that story again.
translation: 哦，不再是那个故事了。 [o ， bu zai shi na ge gu shi le 。]

english: You have told that story before, Dernu.
translation: 你以前已经讲过这个故事了，德尔努。 [ni yi qian yi jing jiang guo zhe ge gu shi le ， de er nu 。]

english: Well forget about it then. I'll shut up if you don't want to hear about it.
translation: 那么就忘记它吧。如果你不想听的话我就闭嘴。 [na me jiu wang ji ta ba 。 ru guo ni bu xiang ting de hua wo jiu bi zui 。]

english: Well, the sculptor only needs to build the head now. But I need to get the Consortium to help me with that.
translation: 好吧，雕塑家现在只需要制作头部即可。但我需要让财团帮助我解决这个问题。 [hao ba ， diao su jia xian zai zhi xu yao zhi zuo tou bu ji ke 。 dan wo xu yao rang cai tuan bang zhu wo jie jue zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: The Consortium, you say?
translation: 你说的是财团？ [ni shuo de shi cai tuan ？]

english: You're going to talk to the Consortium?
translation: 你要和财团谈谈吗？ [ni yao he cai tuan tan tan ma ？]

english: My, you're certainly moving up in the dwarven world, aren't you?
translation: 天啊，你肯定在矮人世界里进步了，不是吗？ [tian a ， ni ken ding zai ai ren shi jie li jin bu le ， bu shi ma ？]

english: What do you need us for then?
translation: 那你需要我们做什么？ [na ni xu yao wo men zuo shen me ？]

english: We are but simple dwarves.
translation: 我们只是简单的矮人。 [wo men zhi shi jian dan de ai ren 。]

english: Especially you, Dernu.
translation: 尤其是你，德尔努。 [you qi shi ni ， de er nu 。]

english: Now now, Derni, there was no need for that.
translation: 现在，德尔尼，没有必要这样做了。 [xian zai ， de er ni ， mei you bi yao zhe yang zuo le 。]

english: I have rebuilt the statue for the [company name]!
translation: 我已经为[公司名称]重建了雕像！ [wo yi jing wei [ gong si ming cheng ] chong jian le diao xiang ！]

english: What, really?
translation: 什么，真的吗？ [shen me ， zhen de ma ？]

english: Of course, really! Player wouldn't have said it otherwise, would [he/she/they]?
translation: 当然，真的！否则，玩家不会这么说，[他/她/他们]会吗？ [dang ran ， zhen de ！ fou ze ， wan jia bu hui zhe me shuo ，[ ta / ta / ta men ] hui ma ？]

english: And didn't you see Blasidar working on the statue?
translation: 你没看到布拉西达尔在雕像上工作吗？ [ni mei kan dao bu la xi da er zai diao xiang shang gong zuo ma ？]

english: Oh yes, he was out there for quite a while.
translation: 哦，是的，他在那里待了很长一段时间。 [o ， shi de ， ta zai na li dai le hen zhang yi duan shi jian 。]

english: That must have been a huge task.
translation: 这一定是一项艰巨的任务。 [zhe yi ding shi yi xiang jian ju de ren wu 。]

english: Nothing's too difficult for old Blasidar.
translation: 对于老布拉西达来说，没有什么是太困难的。 [dui yu lao bu la xi da lai shuo ， mei you shen me shi tai kun nan de 。]

english: He truly is a master builder.
translation: 他确实是一位建筑大师。 [ta que shi shi yi wei jian zhu da shi 。]

english: We can all take an example to his hard work and dedication.
translation: 我们都可以以他的努力和奉献精神为榜样。 [wo men dou ke yi yi ta de nu li he feng xian jing shen wei bang yang 。]

english: Speaking of, shouldn't we get back to work ourselves?
translation: 话说回来，我们自己回去工作不好吗？ [hua shuo hui lai ， wo men zi ji hui qu gong zuo bu hao ma ？]

english: Quite right. Anything else you wanted, Player?
translation: 完全正确。玩家，你还有什么想要的吗？ [wan quan zheng que 。 wan jia ， ni hai you shen me xiang yao de ma ？]

english: Do you know about this drunken dwarf...?
translation: 你知道这个喝醉的矮人吗？ [ni zhi dao zhe ge he zui de ai ren ma ？]

english: Drunken dwarf?
translation: 喝醉酒的矮人？ [he zui jiu de ai ren ？]

english: Yeah, we know a drunken dwarf!
translation: 是的，我们认识一个醉酒的矮人！ [shi de ， wo men ren shi yi ge zui jiu de ai ren ！]

english: In fact we know plenty!
translation: 事实上我们知道的很多！ [shi shi shang wo men zhi dao de hen duo ！]

english: There's this one really annoying dwarf though, he sometimes throws rocks at me for no reason.
translation: 不过，有一个非常烦人的矮人，他有时会无缘无故地向我扔石头。 [bu guo ， you yi ge fei chang fan ren de ai ren ， ta you shi hui wu yuan wu gu di xiang wo reng shi tou 。]

english: Yeah, tell me about it.
translation: 是的，告诉我吧。 [shi de ， gao su wo ba 。]

english: The one I mean is his relative, living in the northeast of Keldagrim. I wonder if you could help me with him.
translation: 我指的是他的亲戚，住在凯尔达格林的东北部。我想知道你是否可以帮助我对付他。 [wo zhi de shi ta de qin qi ， zhu zai kai er da ge lin de dong bei bu 。 wo xiang zhi dao ni shi fou ke yi bang zhu wo dui fu ta 。]

english: Ah yes, him.
translation: 啊，是的，他。 [a ， shi de ， ta 。]

english: Such a sad case, poor fellow.
translation: 这是多么悲惨的事啊，可怜的家伙。 [zhe shi duo me bei can de shi a ， ke lian de jia huo 。]

english: Who is he?
translation: 他是谁？ [ta shi shui ？]

english: Don't you know anything?
translation: 你什么都不知道吗？ [ni shen me dou bu zhi dao ma ？]

english: Now now, there's no reason to get angry.
translation: 现在，没有理由生气了。 [xian zai ， mei you li you sheng qi le 。]

english: I suppose you're right. Well, he's a drunk dwarf that talks about kebabs a lot.
translation: 我想你是对的。嗯，他是一个经常谈论烤肉串的醉酒矮人。 [wo xiang ni shi dui de 。 n ， ta shi yi ge jing chang tan lun kao rou chuan de zui jiu ai ren 。]

english: Has some pretty odd tales to tell too.
translation: 还有一些非常奇怪的故事要讲。 [hai you yi xie fei chang qi guai de gu shi yao jiang 。]

english: And I understand he's the relative of that dwarf I mentioned earlier.
translation: 我知道他是我之前提到的那个矮人的亲戚。 [wo zhi dao ta shi wo zhi qian ti dao de na ge ai ren de qin qi 。]

english: I hope that helped, Player?
translation: 我希望这有帮助，玩家？ [wo xi wang zhe you bang zhu ， wan jia ？]

english: I have this unforgettable tale to tell you!
translation: 我有一个难忘的故事要告诉你！ [wo you yi ge nan wang de gu shi yao gao su ni ！]

english: A tale!
translation: 一个故事！ [yi ge gu shi ！]

english: We love tales!
translation: 我们喜欢故事！ [wo men xi huan gu shi ！]

english: We live for tales!
translation: 我们为故事而生！ [wo men wei gu shi er sheng ！]

english: Like, there was this one time when I lost my spanner in the mines...
translation: 就像，有一次我在矿井里丢了扳手…… [jiu xiang ， you yi ci wo zai kuang jing li diu le ban shou ……]

english: Player wants to tell a tale!
translation: 玩家想要讲一个故事！ [wan jia xiang yao jiang yi ge gu shi ！]

english: But my spanner... it's a very interesting tale you know.
translation: 但是我的扳手...你知道这是一个非常有趣的故事。 [dan shi wo de ban shou ... ni zhi dao zhe shi yi ge fei chang you qu de gu shi 。]

english: I think we've heard it before.
translation: 我想我们以前听说过。 [wo xiang wo men yi qian ting shuo guo 。]

english: It was pretty forgettable.
translation: 这真是令人难忘。 [zhe zhen shi ling ren nan wang 。]

english: Excuse me, do you want to hear my tale or not?
translation: 打扰一下，你想不想听我的故事？ [da rao yi xia ， ni xiang bu xiang ting wo de gu shi ？]

english: Happy to.
translation: 很高兴。 [hen gao xing 。]

english: Would love to hear it.
translation: 很想听听。 [hen xiang ting ting 。]

english: As long as it's better than my spanner story.
translation: 只要它比我的扳手故事好就行。 [zhi yao ta bi wo de ban shou gu shi hao jiu xing 。]

english: So, what's your tale like?
translation: 那么，你的故事是什么样的？ [na me ， ni de gu shi shi shen me yang de ？]

english: Ah, I errrr...
translation: 啊，我错了... [a ， wo cuo le ...]

english: I seem to have forgotten.
translation: 我好像忘记了。 [wo hao xiang wang ji le 。]

english: Must have been pretty forgettable as well then.
translation: 那时一定也很容易被遗忘。 [na shi yi ding ye hen rong yi bei yi wang 。]

english: I must be off now, thanks for the chat.
translation: 我现在得走了，谢谢你的聊天。 [wo xian zai de zou le ， xie xie ni de liao tian 。]

english: No problem!
translation: 没问题！ [mei wen ti ！]

english: Glad to be of service!
translation: 很高兴为您服务！ [hen gao xing wei nin fu wu ！]

english: Come back any time!
translation: 随时回来！ [sui shi hui lai ！]

english: What's down this river?
translation: 这条河下游有什么？ [zhe tiao he xia you you shen me ？]

english: Any good spots to fish around here?
translation: 这附近有什么钓鱼的好地方吗？ [zhe fu jin you shen me diao yu de hao di fang ma ？]

english: What are these mines used for?
translation: 这些地雷有什么用？ [zhe xie di lei you shen me yong ？]

english: Can you help me with this rock?
translation: 你能帮我搬动这块石头吗？ [ni neng bang wo ban dong zhe kuai shi tou ma ？]

english: What material would break that rock?
translation: 什么材料可以打破那块岩石？ [shen me cai liao ke yi da po na kuai yan shi ？]

english: Do you know anyone named Rolad?
translation: 你认识一个叫罗拉德的人吗？ [ni ren shi yi ge jiao luo la de de ren ma ？]

english: Dondakan wants to shoot me out of a cannon!
translation: 唐达坎想用大炮射我！ [tang da kan xiang yong da pao she wo ！]

english: Any tips on how to defeat an evil demon?
translation: 关于如何击败邪恶恶魔有什么秘诀吗？ [guan yu ru he ji bai xie e e mo you shen me mi jue ma ？]

english: I defeated the spirit of the rock!
translation: 我打败了岩石之魂！ [wo da bai le yan shi zhi hun ！]

english: I need some help with this statue...
translation: 我需要一些帮助来处理这座雕像... [wo xu yao yi xie bang zhu lai chu li zhe zuo diao xiang ...]

english: I have rebuilt the statue for the [company name]!
translation: 我已经为[公司名称]重建了雕像！ [wo yi jing wei [ gong si ming cheng ] chong jian le diao xiang ！]

english: Do you know about this drunken dwarf...?
translation: 你知道这个喝醉的矮人吗？ [ni zhi dao zhe ge he zui de ai ren ma ？]

english: I have this unforgettable tale to tell you!
translation: 我有一个难忘的故事要告诉你！ [wo you yi ge nan wang de gu shi yao gao su ni ！]

english: I must be off now, thanks for the chat.
translation: 我现在得走了，谢谢你的聊天。 [wo xian zai de zou le ， xie xie ni de liao tian 。]

english: Can I help you today?
translation: 今天我可以帮你吗？ [jin tian wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: Can I go for a ride?
translation: 我可以去兜风吗？ [wo ke yi qu dou feng ma ？]

english: Minecart rides are 20 coins.
translation: 乘坐矿车需要 20 个金币。 [cheng zuo kuang che xu yao  20  ge jin bi 。]

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this.
translation: 作为 Lovakengj 矿车网络的忠实客户，您有权享受这一点。 [zuo wei  Lovakengj  kuang che wang luo de zhong shi ke hu ， nin you quan xiang shou zhe yi dian 。]

english: Now, can I help you today?
translation: 现在，今天我可以帮你吗？ [xian zai ， jin tian wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: You're already here, human.
translation: 你已经在这里了，人类。 [ni yi jing zai zhe li le ， ren lei 。]

english: Hello, human. Can I help you?
translation: 你好，人类。我可以帮你吗？ [ni hao ， ren lei 。 wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This is the principal station of the Lovakengj Minecart Network. Once it's running, our people will be able to travel rapidly all across the city.
translation: 这是 Lovakengj 矿车网络的主站。一旦运行，我们的人员将能够在整个城市快速出行。 [zhe shi  Lovakengj  kuang che wang luo de zhu zhan 。 yi dan yun xing ， wo men de ren yuan jiang neng gou zai zheng ge cheng shi kuai su chu xing 。]

english: Can I ride your minecart?
translation: 我可以乘坐你们的矿车吗？ [wo ke yi cheng zuo ni men de kuang che ma ？]

english: The network is for the citizens of Lovakengj only, though I'll let you use it if you help me first. Free up some inventory space if you're interested.
translation: 该网络仅供洛瓦肯吉居民使用，但如果你先帮助我，我会让你使用它。如果您有兴趣，请释放一些库存空间。 [gai wang luo jin gong luo wa ken ji ju min shi yong ， dan ru guo ni xian bang zhu wo ， wo hui rang ni shi yong ta 。 ru guo nin you xing qu ， qing shi fang yi xie ku cun kong jian 。]

english: The network is for the citizens of Lovakengj only, though I'll let you use it if you help me first.
translation: 该网络仅供洛瓦肯吉居民使用，但如果你先帮助我，我会让你使用它。 [gai wang luo jin gong luo wa ken ji ju min shi yong ， dan ru guo ni xian bang zhu wo ， wo hui rang ni shi yong ta 。]

english: Alright, what do you need me to do?
translation: 好吧，你需要我做什么？ [hao ba ， ni xu yao wo zuo shen me ？]

english: The workers at the other stations got incorrect versions of the control scrolls, so they can't operate the minecarts. Please take these updated scrolls to them.
translation: 其他车站的工作人员得到了错误版本的控制卷轴，因此他们无法操作矿车。请把这些更新的卷轴带给他们。 [qi ta che zhan de gong zuo ren yuan de dao le cuo wu ban ben de kong zhi juan zhou ， yin ci ta men wu fa cao zuo kuang che 。 qing ba zhe xie geng xin de juan zhou dai gei ta men 。]

english: That's one scroll each for the Arceuus station, the Shayzien station, the Hosidius station, the Piscarilius station and the Quidamortem station.
translation: Arceus 站、Shayzien 站、Hosidius 站、Piscarilius 站和 Quidamortem 站各有一张卷轴。 [Arceus  zhan 、Shayzien  zhan 、Hosidius  zhan 、Piscarilius  zhan he  Quidamortem  zhan ge you yi zhang juan zhou 。]

english: Where do I need to go?
translation: 我需要去哪里？ [wo xu yao qu na li ？]

english: The Arceuus station is just next to the Arceuus Library, in the north of the city.
translation: Arceuus 车站位于城市北部的 Arceuus 图书馆旁边。 [Arceuus  che zhan wei yu cheng shi bei bu de  Arceuus  tu shu guan pang bian 。]

english: The Shayzien station is east of the Shayzien Encampment.
translation: Shayzien 车站位于 Shayzien 营地以东。 [Shayzien  che zhan wei yu  Shayzien  ying di yi dong 。]

english: The Hosidius station is north of the Woodcutting Guild.
translation: 霍西迪乌斯站位于伐木行会的北面。 [huo xi di wu si zhan wei yu fa mu hang hui de bei mian 。]

english: The Piscarilius station is south of the city, next to a small mine.
translation: Piscarilius 车站位于城市南部，毗邻一个小矿井。 [Piscarilius  che zhan wei yu cheng shi nan bu ， pi lin yi ge xiao kuang jing 。]

english: The Quidamortem station is at the peak of the mountain, deep in the Kebos Lowlands.
translation: Quidamortem 站位于山顶，科博斯低地深处。 [Quidamortem  zhan wei yu shan ding ， ke bo si di di shen chu 。]

english: Can I go for a ride now?
translation: 我现在可以去兜风吗？ [wo xian zai ke yi qu dou feng ma ？]

english: No, you haven't unlocked any of the other stations yet.
translation: 不，您还没有解锁任何其他电台。 [bu ， nin hai mei you jie suo ren he qi ta dian tai 。]

english: Do I have to pay every time I use the carts?
translation: 每次使用购物车都需要付费吗？ [mei ci shi yong gou wu che dou xu yao fu fei ma ？]

english: Hmmm... We normally charge 50 coins per ride. For 100,000 coins, you'll never have to pay again.
translation: 嗯...我们通常每次乘车收取 50 个硬币。 100,000 个金币，您无需再次付费。 [n ... wo men tong chang mei ci cheng che shou qu  50  ge ying bi 。 100,000  ge jin bi ， nin wu xu zai ci fu fei 。]

english: 100,000 coins is a rip-off!
translation: 10万金币简直就是敲诈！ [10 wan jin bi jian zhi jiu shi qiao zha ！]

english: Take it or leave it, human! You may enjoy being about to ride our carts without having to carry coins every time.
translation: 要么接受，要么离开，人类！您可能会喜欢乘坐我们的手推车，而不必每次都携带硬币。 [yao me jie shou ， yao me li kai ， ren lei ！ nin ke neng hui xi huan cheng zuo wo men de shou tui che ， er bu bi mei ci dou xie dai ying bi 。]

english: I'd rather not, thanks.
translation: 我宁愿不，谢谢。 [wo ning yuan bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Can I do anything else for you, human?
translation: 我还能为你做点什么吗，人类？ [wo hai neng wei ni zuo dian shen me ma ， ren lei ？]

english: I'll get on with it.
translation: 我会继续做下去。 [wo hui ji xu zuo xia qu 。]

english: I'm not interested.
translation: 我对此不感兴趣。 [wo dui ci bu gan xing qu 。]

english: Some of my stations still require control scrolls.
translation: 我的一些站仍然需要控制卷轴。 [wo de yi xie zhan reng ran xu yao kong zhi juan zhou 。]

english: Have you got any more scrolls?
translation: 你还有更多的卷轴吗？ [ni hai you geng duo de juan zhou ma ？]

english: Yes, but you don't have room in your inventory.
translation: 是的，但是您的库存中没有空间。 [shi de ， dan shi nin de ku cun zhong mei you kong jian 。]

english: Here you go, human.
translation: 给你，人类。 [gei ni ， ren lei 。]

english: No thanks, I don't want it back.
translation: 不，谢谢，我不想把它拿回来。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo bu xiang ba ta na hui lai 。]

english: Thanks for delivering those control scrolls, human. What can I do for you today?
translation: 感谢您提供这些控制卷轴，人类。今天我能为您做什么？ [gan xie nin ti gong zhe xie kong zhi juan zhou ， ren lei 。 jin tian wo neng wei nin zuo shen me ？]

english: Can I go for a ride?
translation: 我可以去兜风吗？ [wo ke yi qu dou feng ma ？]

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Can I ride your minecart?
translation: 我可以乘坐你们的矿车吗？ [wo ke yi cheng zuo ni men de kuang che ma ？]

english: Alright, what do you need me to do?
translation: 好吧，你需要我做什么？ [hao ba ， ni xu yao wo zuo shen me ？]

english: Where do I need to go?
translation: 我需要去哪里？ [wo xu yao qu na li ？]

english: Can I go for a ride now?
translation: 我现在可以去兜风吗？ [wo xian zai ke yi qu dou feng ma ？]

english: Do I have to pay every time I use the carts?
translation: 每次使用购物车都需要付费吗？ [mei ci shi yong gou wu che dou xu yao fu fei ma ？]

english: 100,000 coins is a rip-off!
translation: 10万金币简直就是敲诈！ [10 wan jin bi jian zhi jiu shi qiao zha ！]

english: Okay, I'll pay.
translation: 好的，我付钱。 [hao de ， wo fu qian 。]

english: I'd rather not, thanks.
translation: 我宁愿不，谢谢。 [wo ning yuan bu ， xie xie 。]

english: I'll get on with it.
translation: 我会继续做下去。 [wo hui ji xu zuo xia qu 。]

english: I'm not interested.
translation: 我对此不感兴趣。 [wo dui ci bu gan xing qu 。]

english: Have you got any more scrolls?
translation: 你还有更多的卷轴吗？ [ni hai you geng duo de juan zhou ma ？]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 你知道，打招呼的方式有很多种。你好，你好，你好…… [ni zhi dao ， da zhao hu de fang shi you hen duo zhong 。 ni hao ， ni hao ， ni hao ……]

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 那还是只能算一个！ [na hai shi zhi neng suan yi ge ！]

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。你今天怎么样？ [ni hao 。 ni jin tian zen me yang ？]

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很棒，谢谢你！ [wo hen bang ， xie xie ni ！]

english: Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?

english: You flesh-temples always assume you can receive guidance merely by asking someone for it. But in this land there is a power that can teach us far more than any mere teacher could.
translation: 你们这些血肉圣殿总是认为只要向某人询问就可以得到指导。但这片土地上有一种力量，它能教给我们的东西远远超过任何老师所能教给我们的东西。 [ni men zhe xie xue rou sheng dian zong shi ren wei zhi yao xiang mou ren xun wen jiu ke yi de dao zhi dao 。 dan zhe pian tu di shang you yi zhong li liang ， ta neng jiao gei wo men de dong xi yuan yuan chao guo ren he lao shi suo neng jiao gei wo men de dong xi 。]

english: I speak of the Dark Altar. For generations our wisest scholars have studied it, yet still it has capacities beyond our comprehension.
translation: 我说的是黑暗祭坛。我们几代最聪明的学者都在研究它，但它的能力仍然超出我们的理解。 [wo shuo de shi hei an ji tan 。 wo men ji dai zui cong ming de xue zhe dou zai yan jiu ta ， dan ta de neng li reng ran chao chu wo men de li jie 。]

english: The Dark Altar can distort the dimensions, warping the fabric of reality as you perceive it, and even bridging the gap between life and death.
translation: 黑暗祭坛可以扭曲维度，扭曲你所感知的现实结构，甚至弥合生与死之间的差距。 [hei an ji tan ke yi niu qu wei du ， niu qu ni suo gan zhi de xian shi jie gou ， shen zhi mi he sheng yu si zhi jian de cha ju 。]

english: But you are still a flesh-temple; you require a corporeal body to house your soul, and you perform disgusting bodily functions to maintain it.
translation: 但你仍然是肉身的殿堂；你需要一个肉体来容纳你的灵魂，并且你执行令人厌恶的身体功能来维持它。 [dan ni reng ran shi rou shen de dian tang ； ni xu yao yi ge rou ti lai rong na ni de ling hun ， bing qie ni zhi xing ling ren yan wu de shen ti gong neng lai wei chi ta 。]

english: We of Arceuus have learnt, through the power of the Dark Altar, to move beyond the need for such a flesh- temple to house our souls.
translation: 我们阿尔宙斯已经学会，通过黑暗祭坛的力量，不再需要这样一个血肉圣殿来容纳我们的灵魂。 [wo men a er zhou si yi jing xue hui ， tong guo hei an ji tan de li liang ， bu zai xu yao zhe yang yi ge xue rou sheng dian lai rong na wo men de ling hun 。]

english: In the crypt below us, we freed our souls from the flesh-temples that had imprisoned them, and we took the form you see now.
translation: 在我们下面的地窖中，我们将灵魂从囚禁他们的血肉神殿中解放出来，我们采取了你现在看到的形式。 [zai wo men xia mian de di jiao zhong ， wo men jiang ling hun cong qiu jin ta men de xue rou shen dian zhong jie fang chu lai ， wo men cai qu le ni xian zai kan dao de xing shi 。]

english: Perhaps, if you allow the Dark Altar to work on your mind, one day you too will be able to ascend to our higher form.
translation: 也许，如果你允许黑暗祭坛在你的思想上发挥作用，有一天你也将能够提升到我们的更高形态。 [ye xu ， ru guo ni yun xu hei an ji tan zai ni de si xiang shang fa hui zuo yong ， you yi tian ni ye jiang neng gou ti sheng dao wo men de geng gao xing tai 。]

english: Thank you for explaining that.

translation: 你崇拜什么神？ [ni chong bai shen me shen ？]

english: You sound like the Saradominist peasants from Hosidius, always assuming they must serve one god above all others.
translation: 你听起来就像来自霍西迪乌斯的萨拉多米主义农民，总是认为他们必须崇拜一位高于一切的神。 [ni ting qi lai jiu xiang lai zi huo xi di wu si de sa la duo mi zhu yi nong min ， zong shi ren wei ta men bi xu chong bai yi wei gao yu yi qie de shen 。]

english: While the gods are useful for tedious matters such as granting prayers during combat, we of Arceuus have long moved beyond the need to pay them homage.
translation: 虽然众神对于诸如在战斗中进行祈祷等繁琐的事情很有用，但我们阿尔宙斯早已不再需要向他们致敬。 [sui ran zhong shen dui yu zhu ru zai zhan dou zhong jin xing qi dao deng fan suo de shi qing hen you yong ， dan wo men a er zhou si zao yi bu zai xu yao xiang ta men zhi jing 。]

english: This is a place of meditation, where a novice may contemplate the mysteries of the Dark Altar - without venturing too close to its power.
translation: 这是一个冥想的地方，新手可以在这里沉思黑暗祭坛的奥秘，而不必冒险太接近它的力量。 [zhe shi yi ge ming xiang de di fang ， xin shou ke yi zai zhe li chen si hei an ji tan de ao mi ， er bu bi mao xian tai jie jin ta de li liang 。]

english: Saradomin is popular with many uneducated citizens of Kourend, but you may use our church to worship any god you prefer. That would be an ecumenical matter.
translation: 萨拉多明深受库伦德许多未受过教育的公民的欢迎，但您可以使用我们的教堂来崇拜您喜欢的任何神。那将是一个普世主义的问题。 [sa la duo ming shen shou ku lun de xu duo wei shou guo jiao yu de gong min de huan ying ， dan nin ke yi shi yong wo men de jiao tang lai chong bai nin xi huan de ren he shen 。 na jiang shi yi ge pu shi zhu yi de wen ti 。]

english: Now, do you require anything of me?
translation: 现在，你需要我做什么吗？ [xian zai ， ni xu yao wo zuo shen me ma ？]

english: No, I'm fine.
translation: 不，我很好。 [bu ， wo hen hao 。]

english: Sure, gimme your best advice.
translation: 当然，给你最好的建议。 [dang ran ， gei ni zui hao de jian yi 。]

english: Thank you for explaining that.
translation: 谢谢你的解释。 [xie xie ni de jie shi 。]

english: No thanks, I like having a body. It's fun.
translation: 不，谢谢，我喜欢有身体。很有趣。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo xi huan you shen ti 。 hen you qu 。]

english: What god do you worship?
translation: 你崇拜什么神？ [ni chong bai shen me shen ？]

english: No, I'm fine.
translation: 不，我很好。 [bu ， wo hen hao 。]

english: Erm, what are you?
translation: 嗯，你是什么？ [n ， ni shi shen me ？]

english: Who are you.
translation: 你是谁。 [ni shi shui 。]

english: I'm [player name]. Nice to meet you.
translation: 我是[玩家姓名]。很高兴见到你。 [wo shi [ wan jia xing ming ]。 hen gao xing jian dao ni 。]

english: You misunderstand. Your question should've been 'who are you?', not 'what are you?'. The latter is significantly more offensive.
translation: 你误会了。你的问题应该是“你是谁？”，而不是“你是什么？”。后者显然更具攻击性。 [ni wu hui le 。 ni de wen ti ying gai shi “ ni shi shui ？”， er bu shi “ ni shi shen me ？”。 hou zhe xian ran geng ju gong ji xing 。]

english: Oh... erm.... I didn't mean to offend.
translation: 哦...呃...我无意冒犯。 [o ... e ... wo wu yi mao fan 。]

english: I see. Well I am Mofina, a citizen of Arceuus.
translation: 我懂了。我是莫菲娜，阿尔宙斯的公民。 [wo dong le 。 wo shi mo fei na ， a er zhou si de gong min 。]

english: Nice to meet you Mofina. Erm...
translation: 很高兴认识你莫菲娜。呃…… [hen gao xing ren shi ni mo fei na 。 e ……]

english: Yes?
translation: 是的？ [shi de ？]

english: Where exactly are you from, Mofina? I haven't heard of Arceuus and I haven't seen anyone else who is dressed like you around here.
translation: 莫菲娜，你到底来自哪里？我没听说过阿尔宙斯，也没有见过其他人像你一样穿着。 [mo fei na ， ni dao di lai zi na li ？ wo mei ting shuo guo a er zhou si ， ye mei you jian guo qi ta ren xiang ni yi yang chuan zhe 。]

english: You are learning. That question is significantly less offensive.
translation: 你正在学习。这个问题明显不那么令人反感。 [ni zheng zai xue xi 。 zhe ge wen ti ming xian bu na me ling ren fan gan 。]

english: Arceuus is one of five cities in the Kingdom of Great Kourend, found on the continent to the west.
translation: 阿尔宙斯是大库伦德王国的五个城市之一，位于西边的大陆上。 [a er zhou si shi da ku lun de wang guo de wu ge cheng shi zhi yi ， wei yu xi bian de da lu shang 。]

english: Okay, and how can I get to Kourend?
translation: 好的，我怎样才能到达 Kourend？ [hao de ， wo zen yang cai neng dao da  Kourend？]

english: I believe Veos, one of your portmasters in Port Sarim, can help assist in such matters.
translation: 我相信 Veos，您在沙里姆港的港口管理员之一，可以帮助解决此类问题。 [wo xiang xin  Veos， nin zai sha li mu gang de gang kou guan li yuan zhi yi ， ke yi bang zhu jie jue ci lei wen ti 。]

english: I never expected to see one of your kind outside of Kourend. I guess the Duke invited you to the party for the same reason he invited the others?
translation: 我没想到会在库伦德之外见到你们这样的人。我想公爵邀请你参加聚会的原因和他邀请其他人的原因是一样的吧？ [wo mei xiang dao hui zai ku lun de zhi wai jian dao ni men zhe yang de ren 。 wo xiang gong jue yao qing ni can jia ju hui de yuan yin he ta yao qing qi ta ren de yuan yin shi yi yang de ba ？]

english: We... never expected to see any of your kind from across the sea either, but yes, you would be correct. The Duke did ask for a representative from Kourend and I was selected to attend.
translation: 我们……也没想到会在大洋彼岸看到你们这种人，但是，是的，你是对的。公爵确实要求库伦德派遣一名代表，我被选中参加。 [wo men …… ye mei xiang dao hui zai da yang bi an kan dao ni men zhe zhong ren ， dan shi ， shi de ， ni shi dui de 。 gong jue que shi yao qiu ku lun de pai qian yi ming dai biao ， wo bei xuan zhong can jia 。]

english: Sorry, that came across a little ruder than I intended. I just wasn't entirely sure what term to use for citizens of Arceuus.
translation: 抱歉，这比我预想的要粗鲁一些。我只是不太确定该用什么术语来形容阿尔宙斯的公民。 [bao qian ， zhe bi wo yu xiang de yao cu lu yi xie 。 wo zhi shi bu tai que ding gai yong shen me shu yu lai xing rong a er zhou si de gong min 。]

english: Citizens of Arceuus would have been fine.
translation: 阿尔宙斯的公民应该没问题。 [a er zhou si de gong min ying gai mei wen ti 。]

english: Now if you excuse me, this conversation is... tiring. Being away from the Dark Altar has taken a greater toll on me than I expected.
translation: 现在请原谅我，这次谈话……很累。远离黑暗祭坛对我的伤害比我预想的要大。 [xian zai qing yuan liang wo ， zhe ci tan hua …… hen lei 。 yuan li hei an ji tan dui wo de shang hai bi wo yu xiang de yao da 。]

english: I hope you still enjoy the party!
translation: 我希望你仍然喜欢这个聚会！ [wo xi wang ni reng ran xi huan zhe ge ju hui ！]

english: Why, what brings you to my house, young [man/lady]?
translation: 为什么，是什么让你来到我家，年轻人[男士/女士]？ [wei shen me ， shi shen me rang ni lai dao wo jia ， nian qing ren [ nan shi / nv shi ]？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Me? Well, let's see... I live here. So I suppose I'm your host, as long as you're in my house.
translation: 我？好吧，让我们看看...我住在这里。所以我想只要你在我家，我就是你的主人。 [wo ？ hao ba ， rang wo men kan kan ... wo zhu zai zhe li 。 suo yi wo xiang zhi yao ni zai wo jia ， wo jiu shi ni de zhu ren 。]

english: I used to work down at the beach, running the charcoal furnaces, but I've handed all that business to my son now. He's a good boy.
translation: 我曾经在海滩工作，负责管理木炭炉，但现在我把所有的生意都交给了我的儿子。他是个好孩子。 [wo ceng jing zai hai tan gong zuo ， fu ze guan li mu tan lu ， dan xian zai wo ba suo you de sheng yi dou jiao gei le wo de er zi 。 ta shi ge hao hai zi 。]

english: Anyway, retiring isn't too bad. There's plenty of warmth from the lava pits, and my boy helps me carry my shopping from Munty's shop. I'll be alright.
translation: 无论如何，退休也不是一件坏事。熔岩坑里有充足的温暖，我的儿子帮我从蒙蒂的商店里搬东西。我会没事的。 [wu lun ru he ， tui xiu ye bu shi yi jian huai shi 。 rong yan keng li you chong zu de wen nuan ， wo de er zi bang wo cong meng di de shang dian li ban dong xi 。 wo hui mei shi de 。]

english: But you've never told me what you're doing in my house, young [man/lady]. Don't think I've forgotten!
translation: 但你从来没有告诉过我你在我家里做什么，年轻人[男士/女士]。别以为我忘记了！ [dan ni cong lai mei you gao su guo wo ni zai wo jia li zuo shen me ， nian qing ren [ nan shi / nv shi ]。 bie yi wei wo wang ji le ！]

english: Have you got anything to trade?
translation: 你有什么东西可以交易吗？ [ni you shen me dong xi ke yi jiao yi ma ？]

english: Oh, are you a door-to-door [salesman/saleswoman]? My boy said I shouldn't let people like you into the house, and to call the guards if you bothered me.
translation: 哦，你是上门推销员吗？我儿子说我不应该让像你这样的人进屋，如果你打扰我就打电话给警卫。 [o ， ni shi shang men tui xiao yuan ma ？ wo er zi shuo wo bu ying gai rang xiang ni zhe yang de ren jin wu ， ru guo ni da rao wo jiu da dian hua gei jing wei 。]

english: That won't be necessary.
translation: 那是没有必要的。 [na shi mei you bi yao de 。]

english: So why are you in my house anyway?
translation: 那么你为什么会在我家呢？ [na me ni wei shen me hui zai wo jia ne ？]

english: I'm just wandering around.
translation: 我只是到处闲逛。 [wo zhi shi dao chu xian guang 。]

english: Be a dear and just wander off now.
translation: 做个亲爱的，现在就走开吧。 [zuo ge qin ai de ， xian zai jiu zou kai ba 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Have you got anything to trade?
translation: 你有什么东西可以交易吗？ [ni you shen me dong xi ke yi jiao yi ma ？]

english: I'm just wandering around.
translation: 我只是到处闲逛。 [wo zhi shi dao chu xian guang 。]

english: Human scare all da fishies!
translation: 人类吓坏了所有的鱼！ [ren lei xia huai le suo you de yu ！]

english: I smack you good!
translation: 我好好打你一顿！ [wo hao hao da ni yi dun ！]

english: Da boom-boom kill all da fishies!
translation: 咚咚咚，杀死所有的鱼！ [dong dong dong ， sha si suo you de yu ！]

english: Tasty human!
translation: 美味的人类！ [mei wei de ren lei ！]

english: Smash stupid human!
translation: 粉碎愚蠢的人类！ [fen sui yu chun de ren lei ！]

english: I get you!
translation: 我明白你了！ [wo ming bai ni le ！]

english: Human hit me on the head!
translation: 人类打了我的头！ [ren lei da le wo de tou ！]

english: Silly fishy! You lookin' like likkle Mogre wid your likkle arms an' wid your likkle legs!
translation: 傻鱼！你的胳膊和腿看起来就像莫格雷一样！ [sha yu ！ ni de ge bo he tui kan qi lai jiu xiang mo ge lei yi yang ！]

english: Swim along silly round head fishy!
translation: 沿着傻圆头鱼游！ [yan zhe sha yuan tou yu you ！]

english: Dont let dem big skippies eat you!
translation: 别让这些大跳鱼吃掉你！ [bie rang zhe xie da tiao yu chi diao ni ！]

english: Hey! Nung says no fishies...
translation: 嘿！ Nung说没有鱼... [hei ！ Nung shuo mei you yu ...]

english: I just spoke to Nung, he said it was ok.
translation: 我刚刚和Nung谈过，他说没关系。 [wo gang gang he Nung tan guo ， ta shuo mei guan xi 。]

english: Well...if Nung say it ok, den go ahead.
translation: 好吧……如果 Nung 同意，那就继续吧。 [hao ba …… ru guo  Nung  tong yi ， na jiu ji xu ba 。]

english: The player enters the crab pen
translation: 玩家进入蟹圈 [wan jia jin ru xie quan]

english: Can I help you today?
translation: 今天我可以帮你吗？ [jin tian wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: Can I go for a ride?
translation: 我可以去兜风吗？ [wo ke yi qu dou feng ma ？]

english: Minecart rides are 20 coins.
translation: 乘坐矿车需要 20 个金币。 [cheng zuo kuang che xu yao  20  ge jin bi 。]

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this.
translation: 作为 Lovakengj 矿车网络的忠实客户，您有权享受这一点。 [zuo wei  Lovakengj  kuang che wang luo de zhong shi ke hu ， nin you quan xiang shou zhe yi dian 。]

english: Now, can I help you today?
translation: 现在，今天我可以帮你吗？ [xian zai ， jin tian wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: You're already here, human.
translation: 你已经在这里了，人类。 [ni yi jing zai zhe li le ， ren lei 。]

english: Sorry, human, you can't use the Lovakengj Minecart Network. Speak to Miriam, at the main station by the southern Lovakengj bank, if you've got any questions.
translation: 抱歉，人类，您无法使用 Lovakengj 矿车网络。如果您有任何疑问，请与 Lovakenj 银行南部总站的 Miriam 联系。 [bao qian ， ren lei ， nin wu fa shi yong  Lovakengj  kuang che wang luo 。 ru guo nin you ren he yi wen ， qing yu  Lovakenj  yin hang nan bu zong zhan de  Miriam  lian xi 。]

english: Sorry, human, the Lovakengj Minecart Network is for citizens of Lovakengj only.
translation: 抱歉，人类，洛瓦肯杰矿车网络仅适用于洛瓦肯杰公民。 [bao qian ， ren lei ， luo wa ken jie kuang che wang luo jin shi yong yu luo wa ken jie gong min 。]

english: I've got this control scroll for you.
translation: 我给你准备了这个控制卷轴。 [wo gei ni zhun bei le zhe ge kong zhi juan zhou 。]

english: Thanks, human. I guess it's okay for you to ride my carts after all. So, can I help you?
translation: 谢谢，人类。我想你还是可以坐我的车的。那么，我可以帮你吗？ [xie xie ， ren lei 。 wo xiang ni hai shi ke yi zuo wo de che de 。 na me ， wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: Thanks again for bringing me that control scroll. Can I help you today?
translation: 再次感谢您给我带来控制卷轴。今天我可以帮你吗？ [zai ci gan xie nin gei wo dai lai kong zhi juan zhou 。 jin tian wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: No thanks, you've already given me one of those.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，你已经给了我其中一份了。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， ni yi jing gei le wo qi zhong yi fen le 。]

english: Can I go for a ride?
translation: 我可以去兜风吗？ [wo ke yi qu dou feng ma ？]

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Wait! Do you know what you're doing here?
translation: 等待！你知道你在这里做什么吗？ [deng dai ！ ni zhi dao ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ma ？]

english: Yes, I know, I've been here before.
translation: 是的，我知道，我以前来过这里。 [shi de ， wo zhi dao ， wo yi qian lai guo zhe li 。]

english: Well good luck then!
translation: 那么祝你好运！ [na me zhu ni hao yun ！]

english: Erm, no I don't actually.
translation: 嗯，不，我实际上不知道。 [n ， bu ， wo shi ji shang bu zhi dao 。]

english: Well, come on over and I'll fill you in on what happened.
translation: 好吧，过来吧，我会告诉你发生了什么事。 [hao ba ， guo lai ba ， wo hui gao su ni fa sheng le shen me shi 。]

english: Thanks for coming!
translation: 感谢您的光临！ [gan xie nin de guang lin ！]

english: What's the problem then?
translation: 那有什么问题呢？ [na you shen me wen ti ne ？]

english: It's my evil twin sister! She's been galavanting around Gielinor committing crimes and now I'm getting the blame!
translation: 这是我邪恶的双胞胎妹妹！她一直在吉琳诺身边胡作非为，现在我却受到了指责！ [zhe shi wo xie e de shuang bao tai mei mei ！ ta yi zhi zai ji lin nuo shen bian hu zuo fei wei ， xian zai wo que shou dao le zhi ze ！]

english: Well what's all this got to do with me then?
translation: 那么这一切与我有什么关系呢？ [na me zhe yi qie yu wo you shen me guan xi ne ？]

english: I'm glad you asked!
translation: 我很高兴你问了！ [wo hen gao xing ni wen le ！]

english: Through that door is a room with a cage and a control panel that operates a giant mechanical claw.
translation: 穿过那扇门是一个房间，里面有一个笼子和一个控制面板，可以操作一个巨大的机械爪。 [chuan guo na shan men shi yi ge fang jian ， li mian you yi ge long zi he yi ge kong zhi mian ban ， ke yi cao zuo yi ge ju da de ji xie zhao 。]

english: I lured my sister into the room so I could imprison her in the cage by using the claw. The problem is my sister managed to herd some innocent civilians in there with her.
translation: 我把妹妹引诱到房间里，然后用爪子把她关在笼子里。问题是我姐姐设法把一些无辜的平民和她一起赶到那里。 [wo ba mei mei yin you dao fang jian li ， ran hou yong zhua zi ba ta guan zai long zi li 。 wen ti shi wo jie jie she fa ba yi xie wu gu de ping min he ta yi qi gan dao na li 。]

english: So what do you need me to do?
translation: 那你需要我做什么？ [na ni xu yao wo zuo shen me ？]

english: I need you to go next door and use the claw to catch my sister.
translation: 我需要你去隔壁用爪子抓住我的妹妹。 [wo xu yao ni qu ge bi yong zhua zi zhua zhu wo de mei mei 。]

english: Once she's in prison, she won't be causing me anymore bother!
translation: 等她进了监狱，就不会再给我添麻烦了！ [deng ta jin le jian yu ， jiu bu hui zai gei wo tian ma fan le ！]

english: Sounds easy enough to me.
translation: 对我来说听起来很容易。 [dui wo lai shuo ting qi lai hen rong yi 。]

english: Fabulous! Now take a good long look at me because the door will be locked behind you. My twin looks exactly like me, even her clothes!
translation: 太棒了！现在请仔细地看着我，因为门会在你身后锁上。我的双胞胎看起来和我一模一样，甚至她的衣服！ [tai bang le ！ xian zai qing zi xi di kan zhe wo ， yin wei men hui zai ni shen hou suo shang 。 wo de shuang bao tai kan qi lai he wo yi mu yi yang ， shen zhi ta de yi fu ！]

english: One more thing to make your life difficult; the magic powering the claw is running low so you'll only have two attempts to catch her.
translation: 还有一件事让你的生活变得困难；爪子的魔力即将耗尽，所以你只能尝试两次来抓住她。 [hai you yi jian shi rang ni de sheng huo bian de kun nan ； zhua zi de mo li ji jiang hao jin ， suo yi ni zhi neng chang shi liang ci lai zhua zhu ta 。]

english: I'll do my best then!
translation: 那我就尽力吧！ [na wo jiu jin li ba ！]

english: By the way, would you like me to run through the controls for you, or do you think you'll manage?
translation: 顺便问一下，您希望我为您完成控制吗？或者您认为您能做到吗？ [shun bian wen yi xia ， nin xi wang wo wei nin wan cheng kong zhi ma ？ huo zhe nin ren wei nin neng zuo dao ma ？]

english: Yes please. I mean, it's always best to be prepared, right?
translation: 是的，请。我的意思是，做好准备总是最好的，对吧？ [shi de ， qing 。 wo de yi si shi ， zuo hao zhun bei zong shi zui hao de ， dui ba ？]

english: Ok, when you turn the machine on you'll see the glowing mark on the floor where the claw is currently aiming, and you'll see a lever and button on the right hand side of your screen.

translation: 要移动爪子的当前位置，请单击您希望其移动的方向，如右侧面板所示。 [yao yi dong zhua zi di dang qian wei zhi ， qing dan ji nin xi wang qi yi dong de fang xiang ， ru you ce mian ban suo shi 。]

translation: 您会知道爪子会朝哪个方向移动，因为控制杆会向您显示该方向。 [nin hui zhi dao zhua zi hui chao na ge fang xiang yi dong ， yin wei kong zhi gan hui xiang nin xian shi gai fang xiang 。]

translation: 当您看到有人在发光标记上方时，请点击右侧面板上的按钮，因为这将使爪子向下移动以拾取他们。 [dang nin kan dao you ren zai fa guang biao ji shang fang shi ， qing dian ji you ce mian ban shang de an niu ， yin wei zhe jiang shi zhua zi xiang xia yi dong yi shi qu ta men 。]

english: Do be careful and make sure that there is someone on the mark, and not just walking past it.

translation: 真是无能啊！我不应该让像你这样的狒狒做这样复杂的任务！ [zhen shi wu neng a ！ wo bu ying gai rang xiang ni zhe yang de fei fei zuo zhe yang fu za de ren wu ！]

english: Come next door and talk to me.
translation: 到隔壁来和我说话吧。 [dao ge bi lai he wo shuo hua ba 。]

translation: 好吧，我已经设法把她关进笼子里了。 [hao ba ， wo yi jing she fa ba ta guan jin long zi li le 。]

english: Fantastic! For so many years I've had to put up with her and now she's locked up for good.
translation: 极好的！这么多年我不得不忍受她，现在她被永远关起来了。 [ji hao de ！ zhe me duo nian wo bu de bu ren shou ta ， xian zai ta bei yong yuan guan qi lai le 。]

translation: 只有我们教团的成员才能上去。如果您想进一步探索修道院，您需要与兰利修道院院长交谈。 [zhi you wo men jiao tuan de cheng yuan cai neng shang qu 。 ru guo nin xiang jin yi bu tan suo xiu dao yuan ， nin xu yao yu lan li xiu dao yuan yuan zhang jiao tan 。]

translation: 如果萨拉多明对你来说还不够好，那么那些来自阿尔宙斯的超凡脱俗的怪物可能就是你的同类。 [ru guo sa la duo ming dui ni lai shuo hai bu gou hao ， na me na xie lai zi a er zhou si de chao fan tuo su de guai wu ke neng jiu shi ni de tong lei 。]

english: They're always looking for hidden knowledge about souls and spirits, when any sensible person would just trust in Saradomin.
translation: 他们总是在寻找关于灵魂和精神的隐藏知识，而任何明智的人都会相信萨拉多明。 [ta men zong shi zai xun zhao guan yu ling hun he jing shen de yin cang zhi shi ， er ren he ming zhi de ren du hui xiang xin sa la duo ming 。]

english: You should talk to Brother Jered at the monastery. He's organising everything from there.
translation: 你应该和修道院的杰里德修士谈谈。他从那里组织一切。 [ni ying gai he xiu dao yuan de jie li de xiu shi tan tan 。 ta cong na li zu zhi yi qie 。]

translation: 叔叔，你有香蕉吗？ [shu shu ， ni you xiang jiao ma ？]

english: No, not yet. I'm still trying to get them.
translation: 不，还没有。我仍在努力争取他们。 [bu ， hai mei you 。 wo reng zai nu li zheng qu ta men 。]

english: Yes, I have some here.
translation: 是的，我这里有一些。 [shi de ， wo zhe li you yi xie 。]

english: That doesn't look like 20 bananas Uncle! Aunty will be so angry with me!
translation: 这看起来不像 20 根香蕉叔叔！阿姨一定会生我的气的！ [zhe kan qi lai bu xiang  20  gen xiang jiao shu shu ！ a yi yi ding hui sheng wo de qi de ！]

english: Don't worry, I'll get some more.
translation: 别担心，我会再去拿一些。 [bie dan xin ， wo hui zai qu na yi xie 。]

english: Wow that's a lot of bananas! Are there twenty?
translation: 哇，有很多香蕉！有二十个吗？ [wa ， you hen duo xiang jiao ！ you er shi ge ma ？]

english: Yes, of course there are.
translation: 是的，当然有。 [shi de ， dang ran you 。]

english: Has Aunty given you the toy yet?
translation: 阿姨给你玩具了吗？ [a yi gei ni wan ju le ma ？]

translation: 是的 - 真的很整洁！ [shi de  -  zhen de hen zheng jie ！]

english: Can I borrow it now then?

english: But I only just got it!

english: That's really sweet of her!

english: Wow - can I borrow it?

translation: 谢谢叔叔——我爱你！ [xie xie shu shu —— wo ai ni ！]

translation: 我不想那样——它看起来真的很可怕！ [wo bu xiang na yang —— ta kan qi lai zhen de hen ke pa ！]

english: I have no use for that.

english: How are you today?
translation: 你今天怎么样？ [ni jin tian zen me yang ？]

english: I've lost that toy you gave me...

english: That's really sweet of her!

english: Wow - can I borrow it?

english: Ok, I promise!
translation: 好吧，我保证！ [hao ba ， wo bao zheng ！]

english: Actually, I don't really need it.

translation: 哦哇你能理解我！ [o wa ni neng li jie wo ！]

english: I happen to be proficient in many languages... anyway, what are you doing here in Varrock?

english: Well my uncle Daga's shop has been a bit slow recently, and we just got some new stock in so I decided to help and advertise a bit.
translation: 嗯，我叔叔 Daga 的商店最近有点慢，我们刚刚进了一些新货，所以我决定帮忙做一下广告。 [n ， wo shu shu  Daga  de shang dian zui jin you dian man ， wo men gang gang jin le yi xie xin huo ， suo yi wo jue ding bang mang zuo yi xia guang gao 。]

english: What new stock's that then?

english: Oh just more scimitars, we got a few of there weird red ones too... dra-something...
translation: 哦，只是更多的弯刀，我们还有一些奇怪的红色弯刀……德拉-东西…… [o ， zhi shi geng duo de wan dao ， wo men hai you yi xie qi guai de hong se wan dao …… de la - dong xi ……]

english: Dragon?!
translation: 龙？！ [long ？！]

translation: 是的，就是这个，值钱吗？ [shi de ， jiu shi zhe ge ， zhi qian ma ？]

english: Um... no... not really... I'll be right back...
translation: 嗯...不...不是真的...我马上就回来... [n ... bu ... bu shi zhen de ... wo ma shang jiu hui lai ...]

english: Oh you bought one of those dra-whatever things, I was told they're not much good.
translation: 哦，你买了一件那些什么东西，我被告知它们不太好。 [o ， ni mai le yi jian na xie shen me dong xi ， wo bei gao zhi ta men bu tai hao 。]

english: Oh no it's excellent!
translation: 哦不，太棒了！ [o bu ， tai bang le ！]

english: Well I'll be a monkey's nephew, I'm such a noob!
translation: 好吧，我会成为猴子的侄子，我真是个菜鸟！ [hao ba ， wo hui cheng wei hou zi de zhi zi ， wo zhen shi ge cai niao ！]

english: Don't you think this is all a bit cruel?
translation: 你不觉得这一切有点残酷吗？ [ni bu jue de zhe yi qie you dian can ku ma ？]

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你是什​​么意思？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: Keeping so many monkeys locked up in that crowded pen. I bet they dream of being back in the jungle...
translation: 把这么多猴子关在那个拥挤的围栏里。我打赌他们梦想着回到丛林...... [ba zhe me duo hou zi guan zai na ge yong ji de wei lan li 。 wo da du ta men meng xiang zhe hui dao cong lin ......]

translation: 你从来不做梦吗？ [ni cong lai bu zuo meng ma ？]

english: I ... er ... used to dream to be a Monkey Minder when I was young boy...
translation: 我……呃……小时候曾经梦想成为一名护猴人…… [wo …… e …… xiao shi hou ceng jing meng xiang cheng wei yi ming hu hou ren ……]

english: And look at you now ... all grown up having achieved your dreams! Would you deny me my dreams? Would you deny a monkey its dreams?
translation: 看看现在的你……都长大了，实现了自己的梦想！你会否认我的梦想吗？你会否认猴子的梦想吗？ [kan kan xian zai de ni …… dou zhang da le ， shi xian le zi ji de meng xiang ！ ni hui fou ren wo de meng xiang ma ？ ni hui fou ren hou zi de meng xiang ma ？]

english: Er, look, stop wasting my time.
translation: 呃，听着，别再浪费我的时间了。 [e ， ting zhe ， bie zai lang fei wo de shi jian le 。]

english: I -
translation: 我 - [wo  -]

english: Leave me alone now. Some of us have work to do.
translation: 现在别管我了。我们中的一些人有工作要做。 [xian zai bie guan wo le 。 wo men zhong de yi xie ren you gong zuo yao zuo 。]

english: I've just thought of a way to solve your little monkey problem...
translation: 我刚刚想到一个办法来解决你的小猴子问题... [wo gang gang xiang dao yi ge ban fa lai jie jue ni de xiao hou zi wen ti ...]

english: Oh, what's that then?
translation: 哦，那是什么？ [o ， na shi shen me ？]

english: Well, you have too many monkeys, don't you?
translation: 嗯，你的猴子太多了，不是吗？ [n ， ni de hou zi tai duo le ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Yes...
translation: 是的... [shi de ...]

english: Well, you could give away your monkeys to people who would look after them. You could even start with me!
translation: 好吧，你可以把你的猴子送给愿意照顾它们的人。你甚至可以从我开始！ [hao ba ， ni ke yi ba ni de hou zi song gei yuan yi zhao gu ta men de ren 。 ni shen zhi ke yi cong wo kai shi ！]

english: I'm sorry, I don't think I'm allowed to do that. I've just been ordered to not let any monkeys escape.
translation: 抱歉，我认为我不被允许这样做。我刚刚接到命令不让任何猴子逃跑。 [bao qian ， wo ren wei wo bu bei yun xu zhe yang zuo 。 wo gang gang jie dao ming ling bu rang ren he hou zi tao pao 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Hello, sir.
translation: 你好先生。 [ni hao xian sheng 。]

english: I haven't seen Monkey Minders here before...
translation: 我以前没见过这里的猴子饲养员... [wo yi qian mei jian guo zhe li de hou zi si yang yuan ...]

english: Yes, you wouldn't have. We have newly been posted here.
translation: 是的，你不会的。我们刚刚被发布到这里。 [shi de ， ni bu hui de 。 wo men gang gang bei fa bu dao zhe li 。]

english: But why do we need Monkey Minders?
translation: 但为什么我们需要猴子看护者呢？ [dan wei shen me wo men xu yao hou zi kan hu zhe ne ？]

english: It's entirely necessary: just take a look at the monkeys. They've been multiplying out of control!
translation: 这是完全必要的：看看猴子就知道了。它们的繁殖已经失控了！ [zhe shi wan quan bi yao de ： kan kan hou zi jiu zhi dao le 。 ta men de fan zhi yi jing shi kong le ！]

english: Every time we turn our backs another one of them tries to break free. It's almost as if they're plotting to escape!
translation: 每当我们转身时，另一只动物就会试图挣脱束缚。简直就像是在密谋逃跑一样！ [mei dang wo men zhuan shen shi ， ling yi zhi dong wu jiu hui shi tu zheng tuo shu fu 。 jian zhi jiu xiang shi zai mi mou tao pao yi yang ！]

english: Why have the monkeys been multiplying?
translation: 猴子为何不断繁衍？ [hou zi wei he bu duan fan yan ？]

english: We just don't know. Perhaps it's the weather. Perhaps it's something in the food. Perhaps it's just that time of year.
translation: 我们只是不知道。也许是天气的原因。也许是食物中的某种东西。也许只是一年中的这个时候。 [wo men zhi shi bu zhi dao 。 ye xu shi tian qi de yuan yin 。 ye xu shi shi wu zhong de mou zhong dong xi 。 ye xu zhi shi yi nian zhong de zhe ge shi hou 。]

english: Your guess is as good as ours.
translation: 你的猜测和我们的一样好。 [ni de cai ce he wo men de yi yang hao 。]

english: What are you going to do about the monkeys?
translation: 你打算对猴子做什么？ [ni da suan dui hou zi zuo shen me ？]

english: We're going to post enough men here to be able to contain the monkeys in case they manage to escape.
translation: 我们将在这里派出足够的人员来控制猴子，以防它们成功逃脱。 [wo men jiang zai zhe li pai chu zu gou de ren yuan lai kong zhi hou zi ， yi fang ta men cheng gong tao tuo 。]

english: Is that very likely?
translation: 这种可能性很大吗？ [zhe zhong ke neng xing hen da ma ？]

english: Stranger things have happened in Ardougne.
translation: 阿杜涅发生了更奇怪的事情。 [a du nie fa sheng le geng qi guai de shi qing 。]

english: Why do you monkeys keep trying to escape? Good thing I've caught you before you got away, you little scoundrel.
translation: 你们猴子为什么老是想逃跑？还好我在你逃跑之前抓住了你，你这个小恶棍。 [ni men hou zi wei shen me lao shi xiang tao pao ？ hai hao wo zai ni tao pao zhi qian zhua zhu le ni ， ni zhe ge xiao e gun 。]

english: Ook!
translation: 好吧！ [hao ba ！]

english: Let's put you back in your cage where you belong...
translation: 让我们把你放回属于你的笼子里...... [rang wo men ba ni fang hui shu yu ni de long zi li ......]

english: Ok!
translation: 好的！ [hao de ！]

english: What??
translation: 什么？？ [shen me ？？]

english: Err ... Ook?
translation: 呃……好吧？ [e …… hao ba ？]

english: I must be imagining things ... monkeys can't talk.
translation: 我一定是在想象一些事情……猴子不会说话。 [wo yi ding shi zai xiang xiang yi xie shi qing …… hou zi bu hui shuo hua 。]

english: Player is relocated to the monkey cage
translation: 玩家被转移到猴笼 [wan jia bei zhuan yi dao hou long]

english: Ook Ook!
translation: 好吧好吧！ [hao ba hao ba ！]

english: I don't know what kind of monkey you think you are, but you're not getting anywhere near my monkeys!
translation: 我不知道你认为自己是哪种猴子，但你根本无法靠近我的猴子！ [wo bu zhi dao ni ren wei zi ji shi na zhong hou zi ， dan ni gen ben wu fa kao jin wo de hou zi ！]

english: Stop hassling me!
translation: 别再烦我了！ [bie zai fan wo le ！]

english: Be quiet, you monkey!
translation: 安静点，你这只猴子！ [an jing dian ， ni zhe zhi hou zi ！]

english: My word - what are you doing in there?
translation: 我的话——你在里面做什么？ [wo de hua —— ni zai li mian zuo shen me ？]

english: I ... er ... I don't know! One minute I was asleep, and the next minute I was here surrounded by monkeys!
translation: 我……呃……我不知道！前一分钟我还在睡觉，下一分钟我就被猴子包围了！ [wo …… e …… wo bu zhi dao ！ qian yi fen zhong wo hai zai shui jiao ， xia yi fen zhong wo jiu bei hou zi bao wei le ！]

english: Well, don't worry. We'll have you out of there shortly.
translation: 好吧，别担心。我们很快就会带你离开那里。 [hao ba ， bie dan xin 。 wo men hen kuai jiu hui dai ni li kai na li 。]

english: Player is relocated outside the monkey cage
translation: 玩家被转移到猴笼外 [wan jia bei zhuan yi dao hou long wai]

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: No problem.
translation: 没问题。 [mei wen ti 。]

english: Why have the monkeys been multiplying?
translation: 猴子为何不断繁衍？ [hou zi wei he bu duan fan yan ？]

english: What are you going to do about the monkeys?
translation: 你打算对猴子做什么？ [ni da suan dui hou zi zuo shen me ？]

english: Try to convince the minder to let the monkeys escape...
translation: 尝试说服看守人让猴子逃跑...... [chang shi shuo fu kan shou ren rang hou zi tao pao ......]

english: Ask the minder for a monkey...
translation: 向管理员询问一只猴子... [xiang guan li yuan xun wen yi zhi hou zi ...]

english: I do not speak to outlanders.
translation: 我不跟外地人说话。 [wo bu gen wai di ren shuo hua 。]

english: Maybe you should speak with Rellekka's Chieftain.
translation: 也许你应该和雷莱卡的酋长谈谈。 [ye xu ni ying gai he lei lai ka de qiu zhang tan tan 。]

english: Please please help us, bold adventurer!
translation: 请帮助我们，勇敢的冒险家！ [qing bang zhu wo men ， yong gan de mao xian jia ！]

english: What's the problem?
translation: 有什么问题吗？ [you shen me wen ti ma ？]

english: Our little village has been dreadfully ravaged by an evil vampyre! He lives in the basement of the manor to the north, we need someone to get rid of him once and for all!
translation: 我们的小村庄遭到了邪恶吸血鬼的可怕蹂躏！他住在北边庄园的地下室，我们需要有人把他彻底除掉！ [wo men de xiao cun zhuang zao dao le xie e xi xue gui de ke pa rou lin ！ ta zhu zai bei bian zhuang yuan de di xia shi ， wo men xu yao you ren ba ta che di chu diao ！]

english: Okay, I'm up for an adventure.
translation: 好吧，我准备去冒险了。 [hao ba ， wo zhun bei qu mao xian le 。]

translation: 我认为首先你应该寻求帮助。我有一个朋友，他是一位退休的吸血鬼猎人，他的名字叫哈洛博士。他也许可以给你一些建议。他通常可以在瓦罗克的蓝月旅店找到，他有点 [wo ren wei shou xian ni ying gai xun qiu bang zhu 。 wo you yi ge peng you ， ta shi yi wei tui xiu de xi xue gui lie ren ， ta de ming zi jiao ha luo bo shi 。 ta ye xu ke yi gei ni yi xie jian yi 。 ta tong chang ke yi zai wa luo ke de lan yue lv dian zhao dao ， ta you dian]

english: of an old soak these days. Mention his old friend Morgan, I'm sure he wouldn't want me killed by a vampyre.
