english: I'll look him up then.
translation: 那我就去找他吧。 [na wo jiu qu zhao ta ba 。]

english: No, vampyres are scary!
translation: 不，吸血鬼很可怕！ [bu ， xi xue gui hen ke pa ！]

english: I don't blame you.
translation: 我不怪你。 [wo bu guai ni 。]

english: I have slain the foul creature!
translation: 我已经杀死了这个邪恶的生物！ [wo yi jing sha si le zhe ge xie e de sheng wu ！]

english: Thank you, thank you! You will always be a hero in our village!
translation: 谢谢，谢谢！你永远是我们村的英雄！ [xie xie ， xie xie ！ ni yong yuan shi wo men cun de ying xiong ！]

english: Very well done, take this.
translation: 做得很好，收下这个。 [zuo de hen hao ， shou xia zhe ge 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Afternoon. I'm Morgiana, and by all means, let yourself in...
translation: 下午。我是莫吉安娜，无论如何，请让自己进来...... [xia wu 。 wo shi mo ji an na ， wu lun ru he ， qing rang zi ji jin lai ......]

english: Oh, hey! The door was open...
translation: 哦，嘿！门是开着的…… [o ， hei ！ men shi kai zhe de ……]

english: ... Yes?
translation: ... 是的？ [...  shi de ？]

english: That armour looks mighty fancy!
translation: 这套铠甲看起来非常华丽！ [zhe tao kai jia kan qi lai fei chang hua li ！]

english: Indeed! A family heirloom of mine, passed down from my father.
translation: 的确！我的传家宝，从我父亲那里传下来的。 [di que ！ wo de chuan jia bao ， cong wo fu qin na li chuan xia lai de 。]

english: Oh? Are you from a family of famous knights?
translation: 哦？您出身于著名的骑士世家吗？ [o ？ nin chu shen yu zhu ming de qi shi shi jia ma ？]

english: You could say that...
translation: 你可以说... [ni ke yi shuo ...]

english: What's wrong?
translation: 怎么了？ [zen me le ？]

english: Oh, nothing... it's just... old memories. I'm getting old, as you can probably see. My family have all died to war. This is meant to be my retirement.
translation: 哦，没什么……只是……旧的回忆。我正在变老，正如你所看到的。我的家人都死于战争。这本来就是我的退休生活。 [o ， mei shen me …… zhi shi …… jiu de hui yi 。 wo zheng zai bian lao ， zheng ru ni suo kan dao de 。 wo de jia ren dou si yu zhan zheng 。 zhe ben lai jiu shi wo de tui xiu sheng huo 。]

english: Retirement? Then why still wear the armour? Especially with how hot it is here.
translation: 退休？那为什么还穿着铠甲呢？尤其是这里有多热。 [tui xiu ？ na wei shen me hai chuan zhe kai jia ne ？ you qi shi zhe li you duo re 。]

english: I find it's best to be prepared in this region. Bandits regularly visit this fine oasis, and they ask fewer questions when they see me in armour.
translation: 我发现最好在这个地区做好准备。强盗经常造访这片美丽的绿洲，当他们看到我穿着盔甲时，他们会问更少的问题。 [wo fa xian zui hao zai zhe ge di qu zuo hao zhun bei 。 qiang dao jing chang zao fang zhe pian mei li de lv zhou ， dang ta men kan dao wo chuan zhe kui jia shi ， ta men hui wen geng shao de wen ti 。]

english: I see.
translation: 我懂了。 [wo dong le 。]

english: How's the tea here?
translation: 这里的茶怎么样？ [zhe li de cha zen me yang ？]

english: Hmm...
Umm...
Well... I think it's quite nice! I prefer a warm cup of Saradomin's Wisdom, a special recipe of mine.
translation: 嗯……我觉得挺好看的！我更喜欢一杯温热的萨拉多明智慧，这是我的特殊配方。 [n …… wo jue de ting hao kan de ！ wo geng xi huan yi bei wen re de sa la duo ming zhi hui ， zhe shi wo de te shu pei fang 。]

english: Oh? How's it made?
translation: 哦？是怎么做出来的呢？ [o ？ shi zen me zuo chu lai de ne ？]

english: Bit of a family secret. A fine blend of herbs that are quite magical.
translation: 有点家庭秘密。一种非常神奇的草药的精细混合物。 [you dian jia ting mi mi 。 yi zhong fei chang shen qi de cao yao de jing xi hun he wu 。]

english: Alright then. Keep your secrets.
translation: 那么好吧。保守你的秘密。 [na me hao ba 。 bao shou ni de mi mi 。]

english: I'd best be off.
translation: 我最好还是离开吧 [wo zui hao hai shi li kai ba]

english: Quite. Perhaps I'll see you around...
translation: 相当。也许我会在附近见到你... [xiang dang 。 ye xu wo hui zai fu jin jian dao ni ...]

english: Ah, hello again.
translation: 啊，又好。 [a ， you hao 。]

english: That armour looks mighty fancy!
translation: 这套铠甲看起来非常华丽！ [zhe tao kai jia kan qi lai fei chang hua li ！]

english: How's the tea here?
translation: 这里的茶怎么样？ [zhe li de cha zen me yang ？]

english: I'd best be off.
translation: 我最好还是离开吧 [wo zui hao hai shi li kai ba]

english: Hello Mori.
translation: 你好，森。 [ni hao ， sen 。]

english: Hello there. Thank you for helping us, you are a good friend to the people of Arceuus.
translation: 你好呀。感谢您帮助我们，您是阿尔宙斯人民的好朋友。 [ni hao ya 。 gan xie nin bang zhu wo men ， nin shi a er zhou si ren min de hao peng you 。]

english: It's not a problem. What brings you here?
translation: 这不是问题。是什么风把你吹到这里来的？ [zhe bu shi wen ti 。 shi shen me feng ba ni chui dao zhe li lai de ？]

english: I come here quite often now. This is a nice quiet place for me to think and reflect. It's my way of remembering Thana.
translation: 我现在经常来这里。这是一个适合我思考和反思的好安静的地方。这是我纪念塔纳的方式。 [wo xian zai jing chang lai zhe li 。 zhe shi yi ge shi he wo si kao he fan si de hao an jing de di fang 。 zhe shi wo ji nian ta na de fang shi 。]

english: I'll leave you in peace then.
translation: 那我就让你安静一下吧。 [na wo jiu rang ni an jing yi xia ba 。]

english: Thank you friend.
translation: 谢谢你的朋友。 [xie xie ni de peng you 。]

english: Hello there. Did you manage to get that device hidden?
translation: 你好呀。您设法隐藏该设备了吗？ [ni hao ya 。 nin she fa yin cang gai she bei le ma ？]

english: Oh yes. Got it all done with no problems at all.
translation: 哦是的。一切都完成了，没有任何问题。 [o shi de 。 yi qie dou wan cheng le ， mei you ren he wen ti 。]

english: Good. Hopefully Kourend will have no more issues with the Disciples of Yama.
translation: 好的。希望库伦德不会再与阎摩弟子有任何问题。 [hao de 。 xi wang ku lun de bu hui zai yu yan mo di zi you ren he wen ti 。]

english: Oh I feel much better for that super serum,  I really hate it when I'm afflicted!
translation: 哦，我对那种超级血清感觉好多了，当我受苦时我真的很讨厌它！ [o ， wo dui na zhong chao ji xue qing gan jue hao duo le ， dang wo shou ku shi wo zhen de hen tao yan ta ！]

english: The afflicted turns into a Mort'ton local
translation: 受折磨的人变成了莫顿当地人 [shou zhe mo de ren bian cheng le mo dun dang di ren]

english: Oh... thank you, you used the serum on me. Here have something for your trouble.
translation: 哦...谢谢你，你给我用了精华液。这里有一些东西可以解决你的麻烦。 [o ... xie xie ni ， ni gei wo yong le jing hua ye 。 zhe li you yi xie dong xi ke yi jie jue ni de ma fan 。]

english: The local gives you [reward].
translation: 当地人给你[奖励]。 [dang di ren gei ni [ jiang li ]。]

english: Oh... thank you, you used the permanent serum on me. Here have something for your trouble.
translation: 哦...谢谢你，你给我用了永久精华液。这里有一些东西可以解决你的麻烦。 [o ... xie xie ni ， ni gei wo yong le yong jiu jing hua ye 。 zhe li you yi xie dong xi ke yi jie jue ni de ma fan 。]

english: Good day to you.
translation: 祝你有美好的一天。 [zhu ni you mei hao de yi tian 。]

english: Hello. What are you up to?
translation: 你好。你要做什么？ [ni hao 。 ni yao zuo shen me ？]

english: Ah, today is a surströmming day! The herring I buried six months ago is ready to be dug up.
translation: 啊，今天是一个 surströmming 的日子！六个月前我埋的鲱鱼已经准备好被挖出来了。 [a ， jin tian shi yi ge  surströmming  de ri zi ！ liu ge yue qian wo mai de fei yu yi jing zhun bei hao bei wa chu lai le 。]

english: Eughr! What are you going to do with it?
translation: 哎呀！你打算用它做什么？ [ai ya ！ ni da suan yong ta zuo shen me ？]

english: Eat it, of course! It will be fermented just-right by now.
translation: 当然是吃啦！现在就发酵好了。 [dang ran shi chi la ！ xian zai jiu fa jiao hao le 。]

english: Fermented? You eat rotten fish?
translation: 发酵了？你吃的是烂鱼吗？ [fa jiao le ？ ni chi de shi lan yu ma ？]

english: Hmmm, tasty. I'm guessing you don't want to come round and try it?
translation: 嗯嗯，好吃。我猜你不想过来尝试一下？ [n n ， hao chi 。 wo cai ni bu xiang guo lai chang shi yi xia ？]

english: You guess correctly.
translation: 你猜对了。 [ni cai dui le 。]

english: Are you the human by the name of [player name]?
translation: 你是那个名叫[玩家名字]的人类吗？ [ni shi na ge ming jiao [ wan jia ming zi ] de ren lei ma ？]

english: Yes that's me.
translation: 是的，那就是我。 [shi de ， na jiu shi wo 。]

english: Good... We've been expecting you. King Lathas sent word of your coming.
translation: 很好...我们一直在等你。拉萨斯国王送来了你即将到来的消息。 [hen hao ... wo men yi zhi zai deng ni 。 la sa si guo wang song lai le ni ji jiang dao lai de xiao xi 。]

english: Well look who it is! The hero of Prifddinas!
translation: 好吧，看看是谁！普里夫迪纳斯的英雄！ [hao ba ， kan kan shi shui ！ pu li fu di na si de ying xiong ！]

english: Why do I feel like you're being sarcastic?
translation: 我怎么感觉你在讽刺呢？ [wo zen me gan jue ni zai feng ci ne ？]

english: That's likely due to the fact that I am being sarcastic.
translation: 这可能是因为我在讽刺。 [zhe ke neng shi yin wei wo zai feng ci 。]

english: Well you're no hero either. You blindly served Lord Iorwerth right to the very end. You're lucky the other elves pardoned you.
translation: 好吧，你也不是英雄。你一直盲目地侍奉着约沃斯勋爵，直到最后。你很幸运，其他精灵原谅了你。 [hao ba ， ni ye bu shi ying xiong 。 ni yi zhi mang mu di shi feng zhe yue wo si xun jue ， zhi dao zui hou 。 ni hen xing yun ， qi ta jing ling yuan liang le ni 。]

english: You seem upset by that. I served Lord Iorwerth because I didn't have a choice. The other elves realised that, hence the pardon.
translation: 你似乎对此感到不安。我侍奉约沃斯勋爵是因为我别无选择。其他精灵也意识到了这一点，因此得到了赦免。 [ni si hu dui ci gan dao bu an 。 wo shi feng yue wo si xun jue shi yin wei wo bie wu xuan ze 。 qi ta jing ling ye yi shi dao le zhe yi dian ， yin ci de dao le she mian 。]

english: We always have a choice.
translation: 我们总是有选择的。 [wo men zong shi you xuan ze de 。]

english: Do we?
translation: 我们有吗？ [wo men you ma ？]

english: I did.
translation: 我做到了。 [wo zuo dao le 。]

english: Yes, but you're a mercenary. You're lucky enough to be able to side with the highest bidder. Not all of us are so privileged.
translation: 是的，但你是一名雇佣兵。您很幸运能够站在出价最高者一边。并非我们所有人都享有如此特权。 [shi de ， dan ni shi yi ming gu yong bing 。 nin hen xing yun neng gou zhan zai chu jia zui gao zhe yi bian 。 bing fei wo men suo you ren dou xiang you ru ci te quan 。]

english: I was born into the Iorwerth clan, Lord Iorwerth was my uncle. Do you think I had a say in what my life would be? Do you think any of us did?
translation: 我出生于艾欧沃斯家族，艾欧沃斯勋爵是我的叔叔。你认为我对自己的生活有发言权吗？你认为我们中有人这样做过吗？ [wo chu sheng yu ai ou wo si jia zu ， ai ou wo si xun jue shi wo de shu shu 。 ni ren wei wo dui zi ji de sheng huo you fa yan quan ma ？ ni ren wei wo men zhong you ren zhe yang zuo guo ma ？]

english: We served Lord Iorwerth because he was our leader. We may not have agreed with all that he did, but that didn't matter. He was in charge and we were not.
translation: 我们侍奉约沃斯勋爵，因为他是我们的领袖。我们可能不同意他所做的一切，但这并不重要。他是负责人，而我们不是。 [wo men shi feng yue wo si xun jue ， yin wei ta shi wo men de ling xiu 。 wo men ke neng bu tong yi ta suo zuo de yi qie ， dan zhe bing bu zhong yao 。 ta shi fu ze ren ， er wo men bu shi 。]

english: Had I been born into the Cadarn clan, I'd be considered a hero right now. But I wasn't, so instead I am the villain.
translation: 如果我出生在卡达恩家族，我现在就会被视为英雄。但我不是，所以我才是恶棍。 [ru guo wo chu sheng zai ka da en jia zu ， wo xian zai jiu hui bei shi wei ying xiong 。 dan wo bu shi ， suo yi wo cai shi e gun 。]

english: You can make excuses, but Iestin served Lord Iorwerth and he switched sides.
translation: 你可以找借口，但伊斯廷为约沃斯勋爵服务，而他却改变了立场。 [ni ke yi zhao jie kou ， dan yi si ting wei yue wo si xun jue fu wu ， er ta que gai bian le li chang 。]

english: He did. Iestin was brave, I respect that. His bravery has rewarded him with leadership over our clan. But bravery comes easy when you have nothing left to lose.
translation: 他做到了。伊斯汀很勇敢，我尊重这一点。他的勇敢使他获得了对我们部落的领导权。但当你已经没有什么可以失去的时候，勇敢就变得容易了。 [ta zuo dao le 。 yi si ting hen yong gan ， wo zun zhong zhe yi dian 。 ta de yong gan shi ta huo de le dui wo men bu luo de ling dao quan 。 dan dang ni yi jing mei you shen me ke yi shi qu de shi hou ， yong gan jiu bian de rong yi le 。]

english: But I can see I will not change your mind. That's fine, I don't need to.
translation: 但我看得出我不会改变你的主意。没关系，我不需要。 [dan wo kan de chu wo bu hui gai bian ni de zhu yi 。 mei guan xi ， wo bu xu yao 。]

english: That said, you'd do well to remember that the actions of Lord Iorwerth should not be used to judge our entire clan.
translation: 也就是说，你最好记住，伊奥沃斯勋爵的行为不应该用来评判我们整个氏族。 [ye jiu shi shuo ， ni zui hao ji zhu ， yi ao wo si xun jue de xing wei bu ying gai yong lai ping pan wo men zheng ge shi zu 。]

english: Hmm.
translation: 唔。 [wu 。]

english: Stand back citizen, do not approach me.
translation: 公民，退后一步，不要接近我。 [gong min ， tui hou yi bu ， bu yao jie jin wo 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: What are you up to?
translation: 你要做什么？ [ni yao zuo shen me ？]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: I don't trust you.
translation: 我不信任你。 [wo bu xin ren ni 。]

english: You don't have to.
translation: 你不必这样做。 [ni bu bi zhe yang zuo 。]

english: If I find you attempting to cross the wall I'll make sure you never return.
translation: 如果我发现你试图翻墙，我会确保你永远不会回来。 [ru guo wo fa xian ni shi tu fan qiang ， wo hui que bao ni yong yuan bu hui hui lai 。]

english: Hmmm, how did you get over here? You're not one of this rabble. Ah well, you'll have to stay. Can't risk you going back now.
translation: 嗯嗯，你怎么到这里来了？你不是这帮乌合之众中的一员。啊，好吧，你必须留下来。现在不能冒险回去。 [n n ， ni zen me dao zhe li lai le ？ ni bu shi zhe bang wu he zhi zhong zhong de yi yuan 。 a ， hao ba ， ni bi xu liu xia lai 。 xian zai bu neng mao xian hui qu 。]

english: So what's a mourner?
translation: 那么什么是哀悼者呢？ [na me shen me shi ai dao zhe ne ？]

english: We're working for King Lathas of East Ardougne. He has tasked us with containing the accursed plague sweeping West Ardougne.
translation: 我们正在为东阿杜涅的拉萨斯国王工作。他责成我们遏制席卷西阿杜涅的可恶瘟疫。 [wo men zheng zai wei dong e du nie de la sa si guo wang gong zuo 。 ta ze cheng wo men e zhi xi juan xi a du nie de ke wu wen yi 。]

english: We also do our best to ease these people's suffering. We're nicknamed mourners because we spend a lot of time at plague victim funerals, no one else is allowed to risk attending.
translation: 我们也尽力减轻这些人的痛苦。我们被称为哀悼者，因为我们花了很多时间参加瘟疫受害者的葬礼，不允许其他人冒险参加。 [wo men ye jin li jian qing zhe xie ren de tong ku 。 wo men bei cheng wei ai dao zhe ， yin wei wo men hua le hen duo shi jian can jia wen yi shou hai zhe de zang li ， bu yun xu qi ta ren mao xian can jia 。]

english: It's a demanding job, and we get little thanks from the people here.
translation: 这是一项要求很高的工作，但我们并没有得到这里的人们的感谢。 [zhe shi yi xiang yao qiu hen gao de gong zuo ， dan wo men bing mei you de dao zhe li de ren men de gan xie 。]

english: I haven't got the plague though...
translation: 不过我还没得瘟疫... [bu guo wo hai mei de wen yi ...]

english: Can't risk you being a carrier. That protective clothing you have isn't regulation issue. It won't meet safety standards.
translation: 不能冒你成为携带者的风险。你拥有的防护服不是监管问题。它不符合安全标准。 [bu neng mao ni cheng wei xie dai zhe de feng xian 。 ni yong you de fang hu fu bu shi jian guan wen ti 。 ta bu fu he an quan biao zhun 。]

english: I'm looking for a woman named Elena.
translation: 我正在寻找一位名叫埃琳娜的女士。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yi wei ming jiao ai lin na de nv shi 。]

english: Ah yes, I've heard of her. A healer I believe. She must be mad coming over here voluntarily.
translation: 啊，是的，我听说过她。我相信是治疗师。她自愿来这里一定是生气了。 [a ， shi de ， wo ting shuo guo ta 。 wo xiang xin shi zhi liao shi 。 ta zi yuan lai zhe li yi ding shi sheng qi le 。]

english: I hear rumours she has probably caught the plague now. Very tragic, a stupid waste of life.
translation: 我听说她现在可能感染了瘟疫。 Very tragic, a stupid waste of life. [wo ting shuo ta xian zai ke neng gan ran le wen yi 。 Very tragic, a stupid waste of life.]

english: But I think a kidnap victim is in here.
translation: 但我认为这里有一名绑架受害者。 [dan wo ren wei zhe li you yi ming bang jia shou hai zhe 。]

english: Sounds unlikely, even kidnappers wouldn't go in there. Even if someone is in there, they're probably dead by now.
translation: 听起来不太可能，连绑匪都不敢进去。即使里面有人，现在也可能已经死了。 [ting qi lai bu tai ke neng ， lian bang fei dou bu gan jin qu 。 ji shi li mian you ren ， xian zai ye ke neng yi jing si le 。]

english: Good Point.
translation: 好点。 [hao dian 。]

english: I want to check anyway.
translation: 无论如何我都想检查一下。 [wu lun ru he wo dou xiang jian cha yi xia 。]

english: You don't have clearance to go in there.
translation: 你没有进入那里的许可。 [ni mei you jin ru na li de xu ke 。]

english: How do I get clearance?
translation: 我如何获得许可？ [wo ru he huo de xu ke ？]

english: Well you'd need to apply to the head mourner, or I suppose Bravek the city warder.
translation: 好吧，你需要向首席哀悼者提出申请，或者我想是城市看守布拉维克。 [hao ba ， ni xu yao xiang shou xi ai dao zhe ti chu shen qing ， huo zhe wo xiang shi cheng shi kan shou bu la wei ke 。]

english: I wouldn't get your hopes up though.
translation: 不过我不会让你抱有希望。 [bu guo wo bu hui rang ni bao you xi wang 。]

english: I fear not a mere plague.
translation: 我担心的不仅仅是一场瘟疫。 [wo dan xin de bu jin jin shi yi chang wen yi 。]

english: That's irrelevant. You don't have clearance to go in there.
translation: 那是无关紧要的。你没有进入那里的许可。 [na shi wu guan jin yao de 。 ni mei you jin ru na li de xu ke 。]

english: Thanks for the warning.
translation: 谢谢你的警告。 [xie xie ni de jing gao 。]

english: I'd stand away from there. That black cross means that house has been touched by the plague.
translation: 我会远离那里。那个黑色十字架意味着这所房子已经受到瘟疫的影响。 [wo hui yuan li na li 。 na ge hei se shi zi jia yi wei zhe zhe suo fang zi yi jing shou dao wen yi de ying xiang 。]

english: I have a warrant from Bravek to enter here.
translation: 我有布拉维克的授权令可以进入这里。 [wo you bu la wei ke de shou quan ling ke yi jin ru zhe li 。]

english: This is highly irregular. Please wait...
translation: 这是非常不规则的。请稍等... [zhe shi fei chang bu gui ze de 。 qing shao deng ...]

english: You wait until the mourner's back is turned and sneak into the building.
translation: 你等到哀悼者转身后偷偷溜进大楼。 [ni deng dao ai dao zhe zhuan shen hou tou tou liu jin da lou 。]

english: Hey... I've got someone here with a warrant from Bravek, what should we do?
translation: 嘿...我这里有人拿着布拉维克的逮捕令，我们该怎么办？ [hei ... wo zhe li you ren na zhe bu la wei ke de dai bu ling ， wo men gai zen me ban ？]

english: So what's a mourner?
translation: 那么什么是哀悼者呢？ [na me shen me shi ai dao zhe ne ？]

english: I haven't got the plague though...
translation: 不过我还没得瘟疫... [bu guo wo hai mei de wen yi ...]

english: I'm looking for a woman named Elena.
translation: 我正在寻找一位名叫埃琳娜的女士。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yi wei ming jiao ai lin na de nv shi 。]

english: But I think a kidnap victim is in here.
translation: 但我认为这里有一名绑架受害者。 [dan wo ren wei zhe li you yi ming bang jia shou hai zhe 。]

english: I want to check anyway.
translation: 无论如何我都想检查一下。 [wu lun ru he wo dou xiang jian cha yi xia 。]

english: I fear not a mere plague.
translation: 我担心的不仅仅是一场瘟疫。 [wo dan xin de bu jin jin shi yi chang wen yi 。]

english: Thanks for the warning.
translation: 谢谢你的警告。 [xie xie ni de jing gao 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Do you have a problem traveller?
translation: 您的旅行者有问题吗？ [nin de lv xing zhe you wen ti ma ？]

english: No, I just wondered why you're wearing that outfit... Is it fancy dress?
translation: 不，我只是想知道你为什么穿那件衣服……是化装舞会吗？ [bu ， wo zhi shi xiang zhi dao ni wei shen me chuan na jian yi fu …… shi hua zhuang wu hui ma ？]

english: No! It's for protection.
translation: 不！是为了保护。 [bu ！ shi wei le bao hu 。]

english: Protection from what?
translation: 防护什么？ [fang hu shen me ？]

english: The plague of course…
translation: 当然是瘟疫…… [dang ran shi wen yi ……]

english: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？ [ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm a mourner. It's my job to help heal the plague victims of West Ardougne and to make sure the disease is contained.
translation: 我是一个哀悼者。我的工作是帮助治愈西阿杜涅的鼠疫受害者并确保疾病得到控制。 [wo shi yi ge ai dao zhe 。 wo de gong zuo shi bang zhu zhi yu xi a du nie de shu yi shou hai zhe bing que bao ji bing de dao kong zhi 。]

english: Very noble of you.
translation: 你真是高尚。 [ni zhen shi gao shang 。]

english: If you come down with any symptoms such as flu or nightmares let me know immediately.
translation: 如果您出现任何症状，例如流感或噩梦，请立即告诉我。 [ru guo nin chu xian ren he zheng zhuang ， li ru liu gan huo e meng ， qing li ji gao su wo 。]

english: Nothing, just being polite.
translation: 没什么，只是礼貌而已。 [mei shen me ， zhi shi li mao er yi 。]

english: Hmmm, ok then. Be on your way.
translation: 嗯嗯，那就好吧。上路吧。 [n n ， na jiu hao ba 。 shang lu ba 。]

english: Are you ok?
translation: 你还好吗？ [ni hai hao ma ？]

english: Yes, I'm fine thanks.
translation: 是的，我很好，谢谢。 [shi de ， wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Have you experienced any plague symptoms?
translation: 您经历过任何鼠疫症状吗？ [nin jing li guo ren he shu yi zheng zhuang ma ？]

english: What are the symptoms?
translation: 有什么症状？ [you shen me zheng zhuang ？]

english: First you'll come down with heavy flu, this is usually followed by horrifying nightmares.
translation: 首先，您会患上严重流感，随后通常会做可怕的噩梦。 [shou xian ， nin hui huan shang yan zhong liu gan ， sui hou tong chang hui zuo ke pa de e meng 。]

english: I used to have nightmares when I was younger.
translation: 我小时候经常做噩梦。 [wo xiao shi hou jing chang zuo e meng 。]

english: Not like these I assure you. Soon after a thick black liquid will seep from your nose and eyes.
translation: 我向你保证，不是这样的。不久之后，一种浓稠的黑色液体就会从你的鼻子和眼睛中渗出。 [wo xiang ni bao zheng ， bu shi zhe yang de 。 bu jiu zhi hou ， yi zhong nong chou de hei se ye ti jiu hui cong ni de bi zi he yan jing zhong shen chu 。]

english: Yuck!
translation: 哎呀！ [ai ya ！]

english: When it gets to that stage there's nothing we can do for you.
translation: 当事情发展到这个阶段时，我们就无能为力了。 [dang shi qing fa zhan dao zhe ge jie duan shi ， wo men jiu wu neng wei li le 。]

english: No, I feel fine.
translation: 不，我感觉很好。 [bu ， wo gan jue hen hao 。]

english: Well if you take a turn for the worse let me know straight away.
translation: 好吧，如果你的情况变得更糟，请立即告诉我。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni de qing kuang bian de geng zao ， qing li ji gao su wo 。]

english: Can you cure it then?
translation: 那你能治好吗？ [na ni neng zhi hao ma ？]

english: No... But you will have to be treated.
translation: 不……但你必须接受治疗。 [bu …… dan ni bi xu jie shou zhi liao 。]

english: Treated?
translation: 治疗了吗？ [zhi liao le ma ？]

english: We have to take measures to contain the disease. That's why you must let us know immediately if you take a turn for the worse.
translation: 我们必须采取措施遏制这种疾病。这就是为什么如果您的情况出现恶化，您必须立即通知我们。 [wo men bi xu cai qu cuo shi e zhi zhe zhong ji bing 。 zhe jiu shi wei shen me ru guo nin de qing kuang chu xian e hua ， nin bi xu li ji tong zhi wo men 。]

english: No, but can you tell me where the plague came from?
translation: 没有，但是你能告诉我瘟疫是从哪里来的吗？ [mei you ， dan shi ni neng gao su wo wen yi shi cong na li lai de ma ？]

english: It all started when King Tyras of West Ardougne came back from one of his visits to the lands west of here.
translation: 这一切都始于西阿杜涅国王泰拉斯从这里西部的土地访问回来时。 [zhe yi qie dou shi yu xi a du nie guo wang tai la si cong zhe li xi bu de tu di fang wen hui lai shi 。]

english: Some of his men must have unknowingly caught it out there and brought it back with them
translation: 他的一些手下一定是在不知情的情况下发现了它并把它带回来的 [ta de yi xie shou xia yi ding shi zai bu zhi qing de qing kuang xia fa xian le ta bing ba ta dai hui lai de]

english: What are you up to with old man Edmond?
translation: 你和老埃德蒙有什么关系？ [ni he lao ai de meng you shen me guan xi ？]

english: Nothing, we've just been chatting.
translation: 没什么，我们只是闲聊而已。 [mei shen me ， wo men zhi shi xian liao er yi 。]

english: What about his daughter?
translation: 他的女儿呢？ [ta de nv er ne ？]

english: Oh, you know about that then?
translation: 哦，那你知道吗？ [o ， na ni zhi dao ma ？]

english: We know about everything that goes on in Ardougne. We have to if we are to contain the plague.
translation: 我们知道阿杜涅发生的一切。如果我们要遏制瘟疫，我们就必须这样做。 [wo men zhi dao a du nie fa sheng de yi qie 。 ru guo wo men yao e zhi wen yi ， wo men jiu bi xu zhe yang zuo 。]

english: Have you see his daughter recently?
translation: 你最近见过他女儿吗？ [ni zui jin jian guo ta nv er ma ？]

english: I imagine she's caught the plague. Either way she won't be allowed out of West Ardougne, the risk is too great.
translation: 我想她一定是染上了瘟疫。不管怎样，她都不会被允许离开西阿杜涅，风险太大了。 [wo xiang ta yi ding shi ran shang le wen yi 。 bu guan zen yang ， ta dou bu hui bei yun xu li kai xi a du nie ， feng xian tai da le 。]

english: Been digging have we?
translation: 我们挖过吗？ [wo men wa guo ma ？]

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你是什​​么意思？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: Your hands are covered in mud.
translation: 你的手沾满了泥。 [ni de shou zhan man le ni 。]

english: Oh that...
translation: 哦那个... [o na ge ...]

english: Funny, you don't look like the gardening type.
translation: 有趣的是，你看起来不像园艺类型。 [you qu de shi ， ni kan qi lai bu xiang yuan yi lei xing 。]

english: Oh no, I love gardening! It's my favorite pastime.
translation: 哦不，我喜欢园艺！这是我最喜欢的消遣。 [o bu ， wo xi huan yuan yi ！ zhe shi wo zui xi huan de xiao qian 。]

english: Can I help you?
translation: 我可以帮你吗？ [wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: What are you doing?
translation: 你在干什么？ [ni zai gan shen me ？]

english: I'm guarding the border to West Ardougne. No one except we mourners can pass through.
translation: 我负责守卫西阿杜涅的边境。除了我们哀悼者之外，没有人可以通过。 [wo fu ze shou wei xi a du nie de bian jing 。 chu le wo men ai dao zhe zhi wai ， mei you ren ke yi tong guo 。]

english: Why?
translation: 为什么？ [wei shen me ？]

english: The plague of course. We can't risk cross contamination.
translation: 当然是瘟疫。我们不能冒交叉污染的风险。 [dang ran shi wen yi 。 wo men bu neng mao jiao cha wu ran de feng xian 。]

english: What brought the plague to Ardougne?
translation: 是什么给阿杜涅带来了瘟疫？ [shi shen me gei a du nie dai lai le wen yi ？]

english: It's all down to King Tyras of West Ardougne. It started came back from one of his visits to the lands west of here.
translation: 这一切都归功于西阿杜涅国王泰拉斯。这是从他一次访问这里以西的土地开始的。 [zhe yi qie dou gui gong yu xi a du nie guo wang tai la si 。 zhe shi cong ta yi ci fang wen zhe li yi xi de tu di kai shi de 。]

english: Does he know how bad the situation is now?
translation: 他知道现在的情况有多糟糕吗？ [ta zhi dao xian zai de qing kuang you duo zao gao ma ？]

english: If he did he wouldn't care. I believe he wants his people to suffer, he's an evil man.
translation: 如果他这么做了，他就不会在意。我相信他希望他的人民受苦，他是一个邪恶的人。 [ru guo ta zhe me zuo le ， ta jiu bu hui zai yi 。 wo xiang xin ta xi wang ta de ren min shou ku ， ta shi yi ge xie e de ren 。]

english: Isn't that treason?
translation: 这不是叛国吗？ [zhe bu shi pan guo ma ？]

english: He's not my king.
translation: 他不是我的国王。 [ta bu shi wo de guo wang 。]

english: What are the symptoms of the plague?
translation: 鼠疫有哪些症状？ [shu yi you na xie zheng zhuang ？]

english: The first signs are typical flu symptoms. These tend to be followed by severe nightmares, horrifying hallucinations which drive many to madness.
translation: 第一个迹象是典型的流感症状。随之而来的往往是严重的噩梦和可怕的幻觉，使许多人发疯。 [di yi ge ji xiang shi dian xing de liu gan zheng zhuang 。 sui zhi er lai de wang wang shi yan zhong de e meng he ke pa de huan jue ， shi xu duo ren fa feng 。]

english: Sounds nasty.
translation: 听起来很恶心。 [ting qi lai hen e xin 。]

english: It gets worse. Next the victim's blood changes into a thick black tar-like liquid, at this point they're past help.
translation: 情况变得更糟。接下来受害者的血液变成浓稠的黑色焦油状液体，此时他们已经无药可救了。 [qing kuang bian de geng zao 。 jie xia lai shou hai zhe de xue ye bian cheng nong chou de hei se jiao you zhuang ye ti ， ci shi ta men yi jing wu yao ke jiu le 。]

english: Their skin is cold to the touch, the victim is now brain dead. Their body however lives on driven by the virus, roaming like a zombie, spreading itself further wherever possible.
translation: 他们的皮肤摸起来很冷，受害者现在已经脑死亡了。然而，他们的身体在病毒的驱动下继续生存，像僵尸一样四处游荡，尽可能地进一步传播。 [ta men de pi fu mo qi lai hen leng ， shou hai zhe xian zai yi jing nao si wang le 。 ran er ， ta men de shen ti zai bing du de qu dong xia ji xu sheng cun ， xiang jiang shi yi yang si chu you dang ， jin ke neng di jin yi bu chuan bo 。]

english: I think I've heard enough.
translation: 我想我已经听够了。 [wo xiang wo yi jing ting gou le 。]

english: Okay then, see you around.
translation: 好的，那么，再见。 [hao de ， na me ， zai jian 。]

english: Maybe…
translation: 或许… [huo xu …]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Nothing, just being polite.
translation: 没什么，只是礼貌而已。 [mei shen me ， zhi shi li mao er yi 。]

english: What are the symptoms?
translation: 有什么症状？ [you shen me zheng zhuang ？]

english: No, I feel fine.
translation: 不，我感觉很好。 [bu ， wo gan jue hen hao 。]

english: No, but can you tell me where the plague came from?
translation: 没有，但是你能告诉我瘟疫是从哪里来的吗？ [mei you ， dan shi ni neng gao su wo wen yi shi cong na li lai de ma ？]

english: What brought the plague to Ardougne?
translation: 是什么给阿杜涅带来了瘟疫？ [shi shen me gei a du nie dai lai le wen yi ？]

english: What are the symptoms of the plague?
translation: 鼠疫有哪些症状？ [shu yi you na xie zheng zhuang ？]

english: Okay then, see you around.
translation: 好的，那么，再见。 [hao de ， na me ， zai jian 。]

english: What's the device saying now?
translation: 设备现在说什么？ [she bei xian zai shuo shen me ？]

english: I don't know. It's giving strange readings...
translation: 我不知道。它给出了奇怪的读数...... [wo bu zhi dao 。 ta gei chu le qi guai de du shu ......]

english: I'm not even sure it's working any more.
translation: 我什至不确定它是否还能正常工作。 [wo shen zhi bu que ding ta shi fou hai neng zheng chang gong zuo 。]

english: This is a wild goose chase! We trek halfway across the world and there's nothing down here but this bunch of useless goblins!
translation: 这是一场徒劳的追逐！我们跋涉了半个地球，下面除了这群没用的妖精什么都没有！ [zhe shi yi chang tu lao de zhui zhu ！ wo men ba she le ban ge di qiu ， xia mian chu le zhe qun mei yong de yao jing shen me dou mei you ！]

english: I am sure my triangulation calculations indicated that the source of power was in this rough area...
translation: 我确信我的三角测量表明能量的来源就在这个粗糙的区域...... [wo que xin wo de san jiao ce liang biao ming neng liang de lai yuan jiu zai zhe ge cu cao de qu yu ......]

english: I find it encouraging that it's pointed to somewhere where there actually are caves.
translation: 我发现它指向确实有洞穴的地方，这令人鼓舞。 [wo fa xian ta zhi xiang que shi you dong xue de di fang ， zhe ling ren gu wu 。]

english: This part of the world is riddled with caves! It's hard not to hit a cave around here! Are you sure you're not just picking up these goblin lanterns or something stupid?
translation: 世界的这个地方充满了洞穴！这附近很难不撞到山洞！你确定你不是只是捡起这些妖精灯笼或其他愚蠢的东西吗？ [shi jie de zhe ge di fang chong man le dong xue ！ zhe fu jin hen nan bu zhuang dao shan dong ！ ni que ding ni bu shi zhi shi jian qi zhe xie yao jing deng long huo qi ta yu chun de dong xi ma ？]

english: You should have more faith in my skills as a mage! I've been working on this for years-
translation: 你应该更加相信我作为法师的实力！我多年来一直致力于这个—— [ni ying gai geng jia xiang xin wo zuo wei fa shi de shi li ！ wo duo nian lai yi zhi zhi li yu zhe ge ——]

english: Gah! We have an eavesdropper! Buzz off, adventurer - go talk to the goblins or something.
translation: 嘎！我们有窃听者！走开，冒险家——去和哥布林说话什么的。 [ga ！ wo men you qie ting zhe ！ zou kai ， mao xian jia —— qu he ge bu lin shuo hua shen me de 。]

english: Okay, I won't bother you.
translation: 好吧，我不打扰你了。 [hao ba ， wo bu da rao ni le 。]

english: That's what I like to see: a polite adventurer! Now, where was I...
translation: 这就是我喜欢看到的：一个有礼貌的冒险家！现在，我在哪里... [zhe jiu shi wo xi huan kan dao de ： yi ge you li mao de mao xian jia ！ xian zai ， wo zai na li ...]

english: What are you looking for?
translation: 你要买什么？ [ni yao mai shen me ？]

english: None of your business!
translation: 关你屁事！ [guan ni pi shi ！]

english: Hey, I'm one of you guys! See this pendant?
translation: 嘿，我是你们中的一员！看到这个吊坠了吗？ [hei ， wo shi ni men zhong de yi yuan ！ kan dao zhe ge diao zhui le ma ？]

english: Where did you come from? Who sent you? I'll have you know I'm the mage's bodyguard for this job. We don't need anyone else!
translation: 你从哪里来？谁派你来的？我会让你知道我是这项工作的法师的保镖。我们不需要其他人！ [ni cong na li lai ？ shui pai ni lai de ？ wo hui rang ni zhi dao wo shi zhe xiang gong zuo de fa shi de bao biao 。 wo men bu xu yao qi ta ren ！]

english: No one sent me, I'm just nosy.
translation: 没有人派我来，我只是多管闲事。 [mei you ren pai wo lai ， wo zhi shi duo guan xian shi 。]

english: Well stick your nose somewhere else!
translation: 好吧，把你的鼻子伸到别的地方吧！ [hao ba ， ba ni de bi zi shen dao bie de di fang ba ！]

english: I'm sorry, but pendant or no pendant, this is a secret. I'm sure you understand.
translation: 抱歉，无论有没有吊坠，这是一个秘密。我相信你明白。 [bao qian ， wu lun you mei you diao zhui ， zhe shi yi ge mi mi 。 wo xiang xin ni ming bai 。]

english: Lucien sent me.
translation: 吕西安派我来的。 [lv xi an pai wo lai de 。]

english: He did not! If he had, I would be aware of it!
translation: 他没有！如果他有的话，我会知道的！ [ta mei you ！ ru guo ta you de hua ， wo hui zhi dao de ！]

english: Don't try to lie to us! Now go away!
translation: 不要试图对我们撒谎！现在走开！ [bu yao shi tu dui wo men sa huang ！ xian zai zou kai ！]

english: I'm sure you're a much better bodyguard than me, but perhaps I can help in some non-bodyguarding way?
translation: 我确信你是一个比我更好的保镖，但也许我可以以某种非保镖的方式提供帮助？ [wo que xin ni shi yi ge bi wo geng hao de bao biao ， dan ye xu wo ke yi yi mou zhong fei bao biao de fang shi ti gong bang zhu ？]

english: Well, we don't know how big this thing is. If we find it, I suppose we might need someone else to help us carry it.
translation: 好吧，我们不知道这东西有多大。如果我们找到它，我想我们可能需要其他人来帮助我们搬运它。 [hao ba ， wo men bu zhi dao zhe dong xi you duo da 。 ru guo wo men zhao dao ta ， wo xiang wo men ke neng xu yao qi ta ren lai bang zhu wo men ban yun ta 。]

english: So, what are we looking for?
translation: 那么，我们在寻找什么？ [na me ， wo men zai xun zhao shen me ？]

english: You're not very well briefed, are you?
translation: 你的情况不太清楚，是吗？ [ni de qing kuang bu tai qing chu ， shi ma ？]

english: To be honest I'm still a bit hazy on that point too.
translation: 说实话，我对这一点也还有些模糊。 [shuo shi hua ， wo dui zhe yi dian ye hai you xie mo hu 。]

english: *sigh*
translation: *叹* [* tan *]

english: Lucien has asked us to search for artefacts that give off a very specific type of energy. After many years of research, I think I'm finally drawing near.
translation: 卢西安要求我们寻找能够散发出一种非常特殊的能量的文物。经过多年的研究，我想我终于接近了。 [lu xi an yao qiu wo men xun zhao neng gou san fa chu yi zhong fei chang te shu de neng liang de wen wu 。 jing guo duo nian de yan jiu ， wo xiang wo zhong yu jie jin le 。]

english: You don't sound very sure.
translation: 你听起来不太确定。 [ni ting qi lai bu tai que ding 。]

english: Bah! My detection device is totally shot. I don't understand it.
translation: 呸!我的探测装置完全失效了。我不明白。 [pei ! wo de tan ce zhuang zhi wan quan shi xiao le 。 wo bu ming bai 。]

english: I wouldn't hang around for now, adventurer. It could be a long while before I can get a clear reading.
translation: 我暂时不会闲逛，冒险者。我可能需要很长时间才能获得清晰的读数。 [wo zan shi bu hui xian guang ， mao xian zhe 。 wo ke neng xu yao hen zhang shi jian cai neng huo de qing xi de du shu 。]

english: Okay, I'll be on my way.
translation: 好的，我这就上路。 [hao de ， wo zhe jiu shang lu 。]

english: Okay, I won't bother you.
translation: 好吧，我不打扰你了。 [hao ba ， wo bu da rao ni le 。]

english: What are you looking for?
translation: 你要买什么？ [ni yao mai shen me ？]

english: Hey, I'm one of you guys! See this pendant?
translation: 嘿，我是你们中的一员！看到这个吊坠了吗？ [hei ， wo shi ni men zhong de yi yuan ！ kan dao zhe ge diao zhui le ma ？]

english: No one sent me, I'm just nosy.
translation: 没有人派我来，我只是多管闲事。 [mei you ren pai wo lai ， wo zhi shi duo guan xian shi 。]

english: Lucien sent me.
translation: 吕西安派我来的。 [lv xi an pai wo lai de 。]

english: (Charm) I'm sure you're a much better bodyguard than me...
translation: （魅力）我确信你是一个比我更好的保镖...... [（ mei li ） wo que xin ni shi yi ge bi wo geng hao de bao biao ......]

english: Euat ami! Euat chua tepat!
translation: 哎呀阿米！ Euat Chua tepat！ [ai ya a mi ！ Euat Chua tepat！]

english: Uh huh...
Zema ami iknil! Zema lini euat tal miki!
translation: 泽马阿米克尼尔！ Zema lini euat tal miki！ [ze ma a mi ke ni er ！ Zema lini euat tal miki！]

english: If you say so...
translation: 如果你这么说的话... [ru guo ni zhe me shuo de hua ...]

english: Zema ikam!
translation: 泽马伊卡姆！ [ze ma yi ka mu ！]

english: Zema ates! Euat achi!
translation: 泽玛吃了！埃阿阿奇！ [ze ma chi le ！ ai a a qi ！]

english: I'm listening, honest.
translation: 我在听，说实话。 [wo zai ting ， shuo shi hua 。]

english: Euat tepat antil! Euat tepat kuhu! Euat rani!
translation: Euat tepat antill！ Euat tepat kuhu！好啦！ [Euat tepat antill！ Euat tepat kuhu！ hao la ！]

english: That's very interesting...
translation: 这非常有趣... [zhe fei chang you qu ...]

english: Tepat!
translation: 特帕特！ [te pa te ！]

english: Euat!
translation: 哎呀！ [ai ya ！]

english: Ami!
translation: 阿米！ [a mi ！]

english: Ah, it's you [player name]. You've been slacking in your studies, so it's time for an exam.
translation: 啊，是你[玩家姓名]。你的学习一直在懈怠，现在是考试的时候了。 [a ， shi ni [ wan jia xing ming ]。 ni de xue xi yi zhi zai xie dai ， xian zai shi kao shi de shi hou le 。]

english: There are two types of question. One type requires you to find the next object in a pattern.
translation: 有两种类型的问题。一种类型要求您找到模式中的下一个对象。 [you liang zhong lei xing de wen ti 。 yi zhong lei xing yao qiu nin zhao dao mo shi zhong de xia yi ge dui xiang 。]

english: In the second type I will present you with fifteen cards and a hint. Discover three cards related to the hint, select them and confirm.
translation: 在第二种类型中，我将向您展示十五张卡片和一个提示。找到与提示相关的三张卡片，选择它们并确认。 [zai di er zhong lei xing zhong ， wo jiang xiang nin zhan shi shi wu zhang ka pian he yi ge ti shi 。 zhao dao yu ti shi xiang guan de san zhang ka pian ， xuan ze ta men bing que ren 。]

english: Let's continue your exam. There are two types of question: In one question you must discover the logical object to come next in a pattern.
translation: 让我们继续你的考试吧。有两种类型的问题： 在一个问题中，您必须发现模式中下一个的逻辑对象。 [rang wo men ji xu ni de kao shi ba 。 you liang zhong lei xing de wen ti ：  zai yi ge wen ti zhong ， nin bi xu fa xian mo shi zhong xia yi ge de luo ji dui xiang 。]

english: Pick the object that should come next in the pattern.
translation: 选择模式中下一个应该出现的对象。 [xuan ze mo shi zhong xia yi ge ying gai chu xian de dui xiang 。]

english: No. No, that's not right at all. Okay, next question.
translation: 不，不，这根本不对。好的，下一个问题。 [bu ， bu ， zhe gen ben bu dui 。 hao de ， xia yi ge wen ti 。]

english: Remember, the goal here is to find the pattern. Look for objects that would have a connection to each other.
translation: 请记住，这里的目标是找到模式。寻找彼此有联系的对象。 [qing ji zhu ， zhe li de mu biao shi zhao dao mo shi 。 xun zhao bi ci you lian xi de dui xiang 。]

english: That's WRONG. Take your time and think about the next question.
translation: 那是错误的。花点时间思考下一个问题。 [na shi cuo wu de 。 hua dian shi jian si kao xia yi ge wen ti 。]

english: No, no, no... That's WRONG! Okay, next question.
translation: 不，不，不……这是错误的！好的，下一个问题。 [bu ， bu ， bu …… zhe shi cuo wu de ！ hao de ， xia yi ge wen ti 。]

english: How unfortunate, you FAILED. You'd better hit the books and study up for next time.
translation: 多么不幸，你失败了。你最好好好读书，为下次做准备。 [duo me bu xing ， ni shi bai le 。 ni zui hao hao hao du shu ， wei xia ci zuo zhun bei 。]

english: To exit, use any of the doors in this room.
translation: 要退出，请使用该房间中的任意门。 [yao tui chu ， qing shi yong gai fang jian zhong de ren yi men 。]

english: Wonderful! Keep up the good work. Next question.
translation: 精彩的！继续做好工作。下一个问题。 [jing cai de ！ ji xu zuo hao gong zuo 。 xia yi ge wen ti 。]

english: Finally, a pupil using [his/her/their] brains rather than trying to eat them. Next question.
translation: 最后，学生使用[他/她/他们的]大脑而不是试图吃掉它们。下一个问题。 [zui hou ， xue sheng shi yong [ ta / ta / ta men de ] da nao er bu shi shi tu chi diao ta men 。 xia yi ge wen ti 。]

english: That's correct! Next question.
translation: 没错！下一个问题。 [mei cuo ！ xia yi ge wen ti 。]

english: WELL DONE! You've proven your aptitude for pattern recognition. You'll receive a book once you leave the classroom. It is a Book of Knowledge to further your education.
translation: 干得好！您已经证明了您的模式识别能力。离开教室后，您将收到一本书。这是一本帮助您继续深造的知识之书。 [gan de hao ！ nin yi jing zheng ming liao nin de mo shi shi bie neng li 。 li kai jiao shi hou ， nin jiang shou dao yi ben shu 。 zhe shi yi ben bang zhu nin ji xu shen zao de zhi shi zhi shu 。]

english: WELL DONE! You've proven your aptitude for pattern recognition.
translation: 干得好！您已经证明了您的模式识别能力。 [gan de hao ！ nin yi jing zheng ming liao nin de mo shi shi bie neng li 。]

english: Hmm, you already appear to have a Book of Knowledge. You should read that! Still, I will reward you for your work once you leave the room.
translation: 嗯，你似乎已经拥有一本知识之书了。你应该读一下！不过，一旦你离开房间，我就会奖励你的工作。 [n ， ni si hu yi jing yong you yi ben zhi shi zhi shu le 。 ni ying gai du yi xia ！ bu guo ， yi dan ni li kai fang jian ， wo jiu hui jiang li ni de gong zuo 。]

english: Examine the hint on the right and find three objects that are related to it.
translation: 检查右侧的提示并找到与其相关的三个对象。 [jian cha you ce de ti shi bing zhao dao yu qi xiang guan de san ge dui xiang 。]

english: Welcome to the Emir's Arena! What can I do for you?
translation: 欢迎来到埃米尔竞技场！我能为你做什么？ [huan ying lai dao ai mi er jing ji chang ！ wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This is the Emir's Arena, recently renovated with his coin. Here, you can fight for glory and prestige in individual duels and tournaments.
translation: 这是埃米尔竞技场，最近用他的硬币进行了翻修。在这里，您可以在个人决斗和锦标赛中为荣耀和声望而战。 [zhe shi ai mi er jing ji chang ， zui jin yong ta de ying bi jin xing le fan xiu 。 zai zhe li ， nin ke yi zai ge ren jue dou he jin biao sai zhong wei rong yao he sheng wang er zhan 。]

english: Where did this Arena come from?
translation: 这个竞技场是从哪里来的？ [zhe ge jing ji chang shi cong na li lai de ？]

english: The original building was excavated by the Varrock Museum a while ago. It dated back to the Second Age!
translation: 原建筑不久前被瓦罗克博物馆挖掘出来。它可以追溯到第二纪元！ [yuan jian zhu bu jiu qian bei wa luo ke bo wu guan wa jue chu lai 。 ta ke yi zhui su dao di er ji yuan ！]

english: When the archaeologists moved out, a group of warriors, headed by myself, bought the land and converted it to a set of arenas for duels. The best fighters from around the world would come here to fight!
translation: 当考古学家搬走时，以我为首的一群武士买下了这片土地，并将其改造成一套决斗场。全世界最优秀的拳手都会来这里战斗！ [dang kao gu xue jia ban zou shi ， yi wo wei shou de yi qun wu shi mai xia le zhe pian tu di ， bing jiang qi gai zao cheng yi tao jue dou chang 。 quan shi jie zui you xiu de quan shou du hui lai zhe li zhan dou ！]

english: More recently, the Emir of Al Kharid acquired the Arena and had it renovated to the state it's in now. He's kept me on to handle day-to-day running, though.
translation: 最近，阿尔卡里德的埃米尔收购了竞技场并将其翻新成现在的状态。不过，他让我继续处理日常跑步事宜。 [zui jin ， a er ka li de de ai mi er shou gou le jing ji chang bing jiang qi fan xin cheng xian zai de zhuang tai 。 bu guo ， ta rang wo ji xu chu li ri chang pao bu shi yi 。]

english: What would the Emir want to do with a bunch of fight pits?
translation: 埃米尔想用一堆斗坑做什么？ [ai mi er xiang yong yi dui dou keng zuo shen me ？]

english: Something about a rowdy group of match-fixers, so I heard. I think the guards would know more about it than I would.
translation: 据我所知，是关于一群吵闹的比赛操纵者的事情。我想看守们会比我更了解这件事。 [ju wo suo zhi ， shi guan yu yi qun chao nao de bi sai cao zong zhe de shi qing 。 wo xiang kan shou men hui bi wo geng liao jie zhe jian shi 。]

english: How do I get a fight?
translation: 我怎样才能打架？ [wo zen yang cai neng da jia ？]

english: You can participate in Duels and Tournaments. These may be ranked, if you want rewards and prestige, or unranked if you're just fighting your friends for fun.
translation: 您可以参加决斗和锦标赛。如果你想要奖励和声望，这些可能会被排名；如果你只是为了好玩而与朋友战斗，这些可能不会排名。 [nin ke yi can jia jue dou he jin biao sai 。 ru guo ni xiang yao jiang li he sheng wang ， zhe xie ke neng hui bei pai ming ； ru guo ni zhi shi wei le hao wan er yu peng you zhan dou ， zhe xie ke neng bu hui pai ming 。]

english: Ranked Duels and Tournaments take place on designated worlds, with stats and items provided to you on those worlds.
translation: 排名决斗和锦标赛在指定的世界中进行，并在这些世界中向您提供统计数据和物品。 [pai ming jue dou he jin biao sai zai zhi ding de shi jie zhong jin xing ， bing zai zhe xie shi jie zhong xiang nin ti gong tong ji shu ju he wu pin 。]

english: Win or lose, you'll earn Reward Points for taking part in ranked Duels and Tournaments. You can trade your points here for supplies that might help in the Wilderness, or such places.
translation: 无论输赢，您都可以通过参加排名决斗和锦标赛来获得奖励积分。你可以在这里用你的积分换取可能对荒野或类似地方有帮助的补给品。 [wu lun shu ying ， nin dou ke yi tong guo can jia pai ming jue dou he jin biao sai lai huo de jiang li ji fen 。 ni ke yi zai zhe li yong ni de ji fen huan qu ke neng dui huang ye huo lei si di fang you bang zhu de bu ji pin 。]

english: Now, if you want to choose your opponents, you can have an unranked Duel or Tournament instead, just for the fun of beating them.
translation: 现在，如果你想选择对手，你可以进行不排名的决斗或锦标赛，只是为了享受击败他们的乐趣。 [xian zai ， ru guo ni xiang xuan ze dui shou ， ni ke yi jin xing bu pai ming de jue dou huo jin biao sai ， zhi shi wei le xiang shou ji bai ta men de le qu 。]

english: Use the recruitment boards outside the hospital to set up your own unranked tournament, or to apply to an existing one.
translation: 使用医院外的招募委员会来举办您自己的未排名锦标赛，或申请参加现有的锦标赛。 [shi yong yi yuan wai de zhao mu wei yuan hui lai ju ban nin zi ji de wei pai ming jin biao sai ， huo shen qing can jia xian you de jin biao sai 。]

english: For an unranked Duel, look around the Arena for someone you wish to fight, and challenge them...
translation: 对于未排名的决斗，请在竞技场周围寻找您想要战斗的人，然后挑战他们...... [dui yu wei pai ming de jue dou ， qing zai jing ji chang zhou wei xun zhao nin xiang yao zhan dou de ren ， ran hou tiao zhan ta men ......]

english: You'll see a 'Challenge' option when you right-click other people around the Arena. Use that to set up an unranked Duel.
translation: 当您右键单击竞技场周围的其他人时，您会看到“挑战”选项。用它来安排一场未排名的决斗。 [dang nin you jian dan ji jing ji chang zhou wei de qi ta ren shi ， nin hui kan dao “ tiao zhan ” xuan xiang 。 yong ta lai an pai yi chang wei pai ming de jue dou 。]

english: On PvP Arena worlds the Arena will supply stats and items for your fight. You'll get to choose your load-out from a menu.
translation: 在 PvP 竞技场世界中，竞技场将为您的战斗提供统计数据和物品。您可以从菜单中选择您的负载。 [zai  PvP  jing ji chang shi jie zhong ， jing ji chang jiang wei nin de zhan dou ti gong tong ji shu ju he wu pin 。 nin ke yi cong cai dan zhong xuan ze nin de fu zai 。]

english: On other worlds, like this one, you must bring your own items, and fight with your own stats.
translation: 在其他世界，比如这个世界，你必须携带自己的物品，并用自己的统计数据进行战斗。 [zai qi ta shi jie ， bi ru zhe ge shi jie ， ni bi xu xie dai zi ji de wu pin ， bing yong zi ji de tong ji shu ju jin xing zhan dou 。]

english: I challenge you!
translation: 我挑战你！ [wo tiao zhan ni ！]

english: Ho! Ho! Ho!
translation: 嗬！嗬！嗬！ [he ！ he ！ he ！]

english: What kind of fights are happening today?
translation: 今天发生了什么样的战斗？ [jin tian fa sheng le shen me yang de zhan dou ？]

english: Every week, we'll rotate the active build, meaning you'll have access to a different set of stats and items. This week, the active build is [Zerker/1 Def Pure/Max/Med].
translation: 每周，我们都会轮换活动版本，这意味着您将可以访问一组不同的统计数据和项目。本周，活跃的构建是 [Zerker/1 Def Pure/Max/Med]。 [mei zhou ， wo men du hui lun huan huo dong ban ben ， zhe yi wei zhe nin jiang ke yi fang wen yi zu bu tong de tong ji shu ju he xiang mu 。 ben zhou ， huo yue de gou jian shi  [Zerker/1 Def Pure/Max/Med]。]

english: Can I see your shop?
translation: 我可以看看你的店吗？ [wo ke yi kan kan ni de dian ma ？]

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我就走了。 [wo jiu zou le 。]

english: See you in the Arena!
translation: 竞技场见！ [jing ji chang jian ！]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Where did this Arena come from?
translation: 这个竞技场是从哪里来的？ [zhe ge jing ji chang shi cong na li lai de ？]

english: How do I get a fight?
translation: 我怎样才能打架？ [wo zen yang cai neng da jia ？]

english: What kind of fights are happening today?
translation: 今天发生了什么样的战斗？ [jin tian fa sheng le shen me yang de zhan dou ？]

english: Can I see your shop?
translation: 我可以看看你的店吗？ [wo ke yi kan kan ni de dian ma ？]

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我就走了。 [wo jiu zou le 。]

english: I challenge you!
translation: 我挑战你！ [wo tiao zhan ni ！]

english: Who's the cutest little nightmare-spawn in all of Gielinor?
translation: 谁是吉林诺最可爱的小噩梦衍生者？ [shui shi ji lin nuo zui ke ai de xiao e meng yan sheng zhe ？]

english: Is it you?!
translation: 是你吗？！ [shi ni ma ？！]

english: Yes, it's you my little Muphin!
translation: 是的，就是你，我的小穆芬！ [shi de ， jiu shi ni ， wo de xiao mu fen ！]

english: Stop this at once.
translation: 立即停止这一切。 [li ji ting zhi zhe yi qie 。]

english: Can you teach me how to do that thing where you teleport around really quickly?
translation: 你能教我如何快速传送吗？ [ni neng jiao wo ru he kuai su chuan song ma ？]

english: That requires moving between realms... Your simple form would not withstand it.
translation: 这需要在不同领域之间移动……你简单的形态无法承受。 [zhe xu yao zai bu tong ling yu zhi jian yi dong …… ni jian dan de xing tai wu fa cheng shou 。]

english: You'd be surprised.
translation: 你会感到惊讶的。 [ni hui gan dao jing ya de 。]

english: You know... if you were bite-sized, I reckon you'd be quite nutritious.
translation: 你知道...如果你是一口大小的，我想你会很有营养。 [ni zhi dao ... ru guo ni shi yi kou da xiao de ， wo xiang ni hui hen you ying yang 。]

english: Do NOT eat me, human.
translation: 别吃我，人类。 [bie chi wo ， ren lei 。]

english: Bleugh!
translation: 布莱！ [bu lai ！]

english: Hisssss!
translation: 嘶嘶！ [si si ！]

english: Sssssssss!
translation: 嘶嘶嘶！ [si si si ！]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Well, I tend the hardwood grove nearby, you can enter if you like and harvest some of the very fine hardwood that grows within.
translation: 嗯，我在附近照料硬木林，如果你愿意的话，你可以进去采摘里面生长的一些非常好的硬木。 [n ， wo zai fu jin zhao liao ying mu lin ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， ni ke yi jin qu cai zhai li mian sheng zhang de yi xie fei chang hao de ying mu 。]

english: Apart from that I'm a simple Tai Bwo Wannai villager...I like to try and find out what's going on in the mainland and the rest of the known world.
translation: 除此之外，我是一个简单的 Tai Bwo Wannai 村民……我喜欢尝试了解大陆和已知世界的其他地方正在发生什么。 [chu ci zhi wai ， wo shi yi ge jian dan de  Tai Bwo Wannai  cun min …… wo xi huan chang shi liao jie da lu he yi zhi shi jie de qi ta di fang zheng zai fa sheng shen me 。]

english: Is there anything interesting to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么好玩的吗？ [zhe fu jin you shen me hao wan de ma ？]

english: Apart from cutting back the jungle and repairing the fence, I think we've got most things covered now Bwana.
translation: 除了砍伐丛林和修复围栏外，我认为我们现在已经完成了大部分事情。 [chu le kan fa cong lin he xiu fu wei lan wai ， wo ren wei wo men xian zai yi jing wan cheng le da bu fen shi qing 。]

english: Do I get anything for doing this?
translation: 我这样做能得到什么吗？ [wo zhe yang zuo neng de dao shen me ma ？]

english: Yes Bwana, you gain experience in woodcutting. In addition many members of the community will reward you with trading sticks, our local currency, for your efforts.
translation: 是的，布瓦纳，你获得了木刻经验。此外，社区的许多成员还会用交易棒（我们的当地货币）来奖励您的努力。 [shi de ， bu wa na ， ni huo de le mu ke jing yan 。 ci wai ， she qu de xu duo cheng yuan hai hui yong jiao yi bang （ wo men de dang di huo bi ） lai jiang li nin de nu li 。]

english: Trading sticks?
translation: 交易棒？ [jiao yi bang ？]

english: Correct Bwana, trading sticks! It's our form of local currency! Everything you do to help out in the village will give you some favour, but there's a maximum limit!
translation: 正确的布瓦纳，交易棒！这是我们当地货币的形式！你在村子里所做的一切都会给你带来一些好处，但有一个上限！ [zheng que de bu wa na ， jiao yi bang ！ zhe shi wo men dang di huo bi de xing shi ！ ni zai cun zi li suo zuo de yi qie du hui gei ni dai lai yi xie hao chu ， dan you yi ge shang xian ！]

english: When you've reached one hundred percent, you cannot gain any more favour, you need to cash in your favour for trading sticks before you can increase your favour again.
translation: 当你达到100%时，你就无法再获得任何好感度，你需要用你的好感度兑换交易棒，然后才能再次增加你的好感度。 [dang ni da dao 100% shi ， ni jiu wu fa zai huo de ren he hao gan du ， ni xu yao yong ni de hao gan du dui huan jiao yi bang ， ran hou cai neng zai ci zeng jia ni de hao gan du 。]

english: Who do I get trading sticks from?
translation: 我可以从谁那里得到交易棒？ [wo ke yi cong shui na li de dao jiao yi bang ？]

english: Well Bwana, there's a good ten villagers I know of who would show their appreciation for your effort. Who do you want to ask about?
translation: 嗯，布瓦纳，我认识的十个村民都会对你的努力表示赞赏。你想问谁？ [n ， bu wa na ， wo ren shi de shi ge cun min du hui dui ni de nu li biao shi zan shang 。 ni xiang wen shui ？]

english: Sharimika is married to Mamma Bufetta, Bwana. They live in the houses just in front of the tribal statue.
translation: 沙里米卡 (Sharimika) 的丈夫是布瓦纳 (Bwana) 妈妈布菲塔 (Mamma Bufetta)。他们住在部落雕像前面的房子里。 [sha li mi ka  (Sharimika)  de zhang fu shi bu wa na  (Bwana)  ma ma bu fei ta  (Mamma Bufetta)。 ta men zhu zai bu luo diao xiang qian mian de fang zi li 。]

english: Mamma Bufetta lives with her family in the building that faces the stone statue, she lives there with her husband Sharimika and her daughter Layleen.
translation: 布菲塔妈妈和她的家人住在石像对面的大楼里，她和丈夫莎里米卡和女儿莱琳住在那里。 [bu fei ta ma ma he ta de jia ren zhu zai shi xiang dui mian de da lou li ， ta he zhang fu sha li mi ka he nv er lai lin zhu zai na li 。]

english: Layleen is a young girl, the daughter of Mamma Bufetta and Sharimika, she lives with her parents.
translation: 莱琳是一个年轻的女孩，是妈妈布菲塔和莎莉米卡的女儿，她和父母住在一起。 [lai lin shi yi ge nian qing de nv hai ， shi ma ma bu fei ta he sha li mi ka de nv er ， ta he fu mu zhu zai yi qi 。]

english: Karaday is a young man and his chosen profession is fishing, he follows after his father Safta Doc in that respect. You can find him usually around the center of the village, that is when he's not off fishing.
translation: 卡拉迪是一个年轻人，他选择的职业是钓鱼，在这方面他追随了他的父亲萨夫塔·多克（Safta Doc）。你通常可以在村子中心附近找到他，那时他不钓鱼。 [ka la di shi yi ge nian qing ren ， ta xuan ze de zhi ye shi diao yu ， zai zhe fang mian ta zhui sui le ta de fu qin sa fu ta · duo ke （Safta Doc）。 ni tong chang ke yi zai cun zi zhong xin fu jin zhao dao ta ， na shi ta bu diao yu 。]

english: Safta Doc used to be a fisherman, but he's just about retired now. He has an interesting profession which you might like to talk to him about. You'll find him usually near the building with the anvil in it.
translation: Safta Doc 曾经是一名渔民，但他现在刚刚退休。他有一个有趣的职业，你可能想和他谈谈。你通常会在有铁砧的建筑物附近找到他。 [Safta Doc  ceng jing shi yi ming yu min ， dan ta xian zai gang gang tui xiu 。 ta you yi ge you qu de zhi ye ， ni ke neng xiang he ta tan tan 。 ni tong chang hui zai you tie zhen de jian zhu wu fu jin zhao dao ta 。]

english: It's just slightly north of the village statue.
translation: 它就在村庄雕像偏北的地方。 [ta jiu zai cun zhuang diao xiang pian bei de di fang 。]

english: Gabooty is a bit of a mystery, no one's sure where he came from! He's quite helpful though, you can find him in the middle of the village enclosure, to the south of Sharimika's house.
translation: Gabooty有点神秘，没有人知道他来自哪里！不过他还是很有帮助的，你可以在村庄围场的中间、沙里米卡房子的南边找到他。 [Gabooty you dian shen mi ， mei you ren zhi dao ta lai zi na li ！ bu guo ta hai shi hen you bang zhu de ， ni ke yi zai cun zhuang wei chang de zhong jian 、 sha li mi ka fang zi de nan bian zhao dao ta 。]

english: Fanellaman was a fisherman, he's retired now, but he'll try and regale you with tales of his salty sea dog days. He's often walking up and down the western beach.
translation: 法内拉曼是一名渔民，现在已经退休，但他会尽力向您讲述他咸咸的海狗时代的故事。他经常在西边的海滩上走来走去。 [fa nei la man shi yi ming yu min ， xian zai yi jing tui xiu ， dan ta hui jin li xiang nin jiang shu ta xian xian de hai gou shi dai de gu shi 。 ta jing chang zai xi bian de hai tan shang zou lai zou qu 。]

english: Jagbakoba is a wild hunter. He can be a bit aggressive but he'll reward anyone who helps to keep the village in good order. You'll find him to the south of the enclosure, near the fires.
translation: 贾格巴科巴是一名野生猎人。他可能有点咄咄逼人，但他会奖励任何帮助保持村庄良好秩序的人。你会在围场南边、靠近火堆的地方找到他。 [jia ge ba ke ba shi yi ming ye sheng lie ren 。 ta ke neng you dian duo duo bi ren ， dan ta hui jiang li ren he bang zhu bao chi cun zhuang liang hao zhi xu de ren 。 ni hui zai wei chang nan bian 、 kao jin huo dui de di fang zhao dao ta 。]

english: Ah Rionasta! He's an enterprising man! Had a very good idea and is now much in demand, you'll find him between the blacksmith's and Timfraku's hut.
translation: 啊里奥纳斯塔！他是一个有事业心的人！有一个非常好的主意，现在很受欢迎，你会在铁匠和提姆弗拉库的小屋之间找到他。 [a li ao na si ta ！ ta shi yi ge you shi ye xin de ren ！ you yi ge fei chang hao de zhu yi ， xian zai hen shou huan ying ， ni hui zai tie jiang he ti mu fu la ku de xiao wu zhi jian zhao dao ta 。]

english: Murcaily! That's me! Well, what do you want to know?! I look after the teak and mahogany trees and make sure that we get payment of anyone who uses the facility. And I'm usually standing just about here!
translation: 默凯利！这就是我！好吧，你想知道什么？我负责照顾柚木和桃花心木树，并确保使用该设施的任何人都能得到报酬。我通常就站在这里！ [mo kai li ！ zhe jiu shi wo ！ hao ba ， ni xiang zhi dao shen me ？ wo fu ze zhao gu you mu he tao hua xin mu shu ， bing que bao shi yong gai she shi de ren he ren dou neng de dao bao chou 。 wo tong chang jiu zhan zai zhe li ！]

english: Hey, I've seen you working around the village. You've been doing a lot of good work around here for us. Let me give you something for your trouble.
translation: 嘿，我见过你在村子里干活。你在这里为我们做了很多出色的工作。让我给你一些东西来缓解你的麻烦。 [hei ， wo jian guo ni zai cun zi li gan huo 。 ni zai zhe li wei wo men zuo le hen duo chu se de gong zuo 。 rang wo gei ni yi xie dong xi lai huan jie ni de ma fan 。]

english: Where can I get a machete from?
translation: 我从哪里可以获得砍刀？ [wo cong na li ke yi huo de kan dao ？]

english: You can purchase a standard machete from Jiminua's store. Gabooty has a selection of local items which you may like to purchase, including better machetes. Also, you may like to chat to Safta Doc, he may have a deal
translation: 您可以从 Jiminua 的商店购买标准砍刀。 Gabooty 有一系列您可能会喜欢购买的当地物品，包括更好的砍刀。另外，您可能想与 Safta Doc 聊天，他可能有一笔交易 [nin ke yi cong  Jiminua  de shang dian gou mai biao zhun kan dao 。 Gabooty  you yi xi lie nin ke neng hui xi huan gou mai di dang di wu pin ， bao kuo geng hao de kan dao 。 ling wai ， nin ke neng xiang yu  Safta Doc  liao tian ， ta ke neng you yi bi jiao yi]

english: you'll find interesting.
translation: 你会发现很有趣。 [ni hui fa xian hen you qu 。]

english: Where is this jungle?
translation: 这个丛林在哪里？ [zhe ge cong lin zai na li ？]

english: You'll find much of it to the southern end of Tai Bwo Wannai, outside of the village. Some is tougher than others so you may have difficulties cutting it back.
translation: 其中大部分位于村外 Tai Bwo Wannai 的南端。有些比其他的更难，所以你可能很难削减它。 [qi zhong da bu fen wei yu cun wai  Tai Bwo Wannai  de nan duan 。 you xie bi qi ta de geng nan ， suo yi ni ke neng hen nan xue jian ta 。]

english: Beware though Bwana, those bushes can conceal a great many dangers or trophies, it could be the death... or the making of you!
translation: 但要小心布瓦纳，这些灌木丛可能隐藏着大量的危险或战利品，它可能会导致你的死亡……或者造就你！ [dan yao xiao xin bu wa na ， zhe xie guan mu cong ke neng yin cang zhe da liang de wei xian huo zhan li pin ， ta ke neng hui dao zhi ni de si wang …… huo zhe zao jiu ni ！]

english: What do you mean by that?
translation: 你这是什么意思？ [ni zhe shi shen me yi si ？]

english: It means that you may find something you wish you hadn't but then discover something you never thought you could! If you find me too vague, go and have a chat with Sharimika about it!
translation: 这意味着您可能会发现一些您希望没有找到的东西，但随后会发现一些您从未想过能找到的东西！如果你觉得我太模糊了，那就去和Sharimika聊聊吧！ [zhe yi wei zhe nin ke neng hui fa xian yi xie nin xi wang mei you zhao dao de dong xi ， dan sui hou hui fa xian yi xie nin cong wei xiang guo neng zhao dao de dong xi ！ ru guo ni jue de wo tai mo hu le ， na jiu qu he Sharimika liao liao ba ！]

english: Where is the fence that needs to be repaired?
translation: 哪里的围栏需要修理？ [na li de wei lan xu yao xiu li ？]

english: This is to the South Bwana, you should see that there are sections which are rotten, but some other passers-by sometimes help out repairing it.
translation: 这是南布瓦纳，你应该看到有些部分已经腐烂了，但有时会有其他路人帮忙修复。 [zhe shi nan bu wa na ， ni ying gai kan dao you xie bu fen yi jing fu lan le ， dan you shi hui you qi ta lu ren bang mang xiu fu 。]

english: You'll need some thatching spars and a machete in order to repair the fence though Bwana.
translation: 你需要一些茅草梁和一把砍刀才能修复穿过布瓦纳的栅栏。 [ni xu yao yi xie mao cao liang he yi ba kan dao cai neng xiu fu chuan guo bu wa na de zha lan 。]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 我一直在村里做一些工作。 [wo yi zhi zai cun li zuo yi xie gong zuo 。]

english: I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: 我已经给了你一些交易棒，现在我身上没有了。为什么不去和其他一些村民谈谈并获得一些捐款呢？ [wo yi jing gei le ni yi xie jiao yi bang ， xian zai wo shen shang mei you le 。 wei shen me bu qu he qi ta yi xie cun min tan tan bing huo de yi xie juan kuan ne ？]

english: Hey there, you wanna go in there to chop da special wood, for you my friend, it's free!
translation: 嘿，你想进去砍特殊的木材，对你来说，我的朋友，这是免费的！ [hei ， ni xiang jin qu kan te shu de mu cai ， dui ni lai shuo ， wo de peng you ， zhe shi mian fei de ！]

english: The player enters the Hardwood Grove.
translation: 玩家进入硬木林。 [wan jia jin ru ying mu lin 。]

english: Nah thanks, I'll give it a miss at the moment I think.
translation: 不，谢谢，我想我现在会错过它。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo xiang wo xian zai hui cuo guo ta 。]

english: Fair enough, pop back if you change your mind.
translation: 公平地说，如果你改变主意，就回来吧。 [gong ping di shuo ， ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， jiu hui lai ba 。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: 这里有什么有趣的事情可以做吗？ [zhe li you shen me you qu de shi qing ke yi zuo ma ？]

english: Ask about cutting back the jungle.
translation: 询问有关削减丛林的问题。 [xun wen you guan xue jian cong lin de wen ti 。]

english: Do I get anything for doing this?
translation: 我这样做能得到什么吗？ [wo zhe yang zuo neng de dao shen me ma ？]

english: Who do I get trading sticks from?
translation: 我可以从谁那里得到交易棒？ [wo ke yi cong shui na li de dao jiao yi bang ？]
