english: Where can I get a machete from?
translation: 我从哪里可以获得砍刀？ [wo cong na li ke yi huo de kan dao ？]

english: Where is this jungle?
translation: 这个丛林在哪里？ [zhe ge cong lin zai na li ？]

english: Where is the fence that needs to be repaired?
translation: 哪里的围栏需要修理？ [na li de wei lan xu yao xiu li ？]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 我一直在村里做一些工作。 [wo yi zhi zai cun li zuo yi xie gong zuo 。]

english: I'll enter for free.
translation: 我将免费进入。 [wo jiang mian fei jin ru 。]

english: Nah thanks, I'll give it a miss at the moment I think.
translation: 不，谢谢，我想我现在会错过它。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo xiang wo xian zai hui cuo guo ta 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello, how can I help you?
translation: 您好，请问有什么可以帮您的吗？ [nin hao ， qing wen you shen me ke yi bang nin de ma ？]

english: What's in this cave?
translation: 这个山洞里有什么？ [zhe ge shan dong li you shen me ？]

english: Creatures known as ents inhabit the depths of the hills, rumour has it they reside there due to the presence of the ancient redwood trees on the hills.
translation: 被称为树人的生物栖息在山的深处，有传言说它们居住在那里是因为山上有古老的红杉树。 [bei cheng wei shu ren de sheng wu qi xi zai shan de shen chu ， you chuan yan shuo ta men ju zhu zai na li shi yin wei shan shang you gu lao de hong shan shu 。]

english: If you're as skilled a fighter as you are a woodcutter, you may enter the caves. You should find Kai once you are inside, he can give you some more information.
translation: 如果您是一名像伐木工一样熟练的战士，您就可以进入洞穴。进去后你应该找到凯，他可以给你更多信息。 [ru guo nin shi yi ming xiang fa mu gong yi yang shu lian de zhan shi ， nin jiu ke yi jin ru dong xue 。 jin qu hou ni ying gai zhao dao kai ， ta ke yi gei ni geng duo xin xi 。]

english: I was just passing through.
translation: 我只是路过而已。 [wo zhi shi lu guo er yi 。]

english: What's in the cave?
translation: 山洞里有什么？ [shan dong li you shen me ？]

english: I was just passing through.
translation: 我只是路过而已。 [wo zhi shi lu guo er yi 。]

english: Arrr, what is it that ye be wantin? I can tell ye all about the prices of runes, or perhaps I could combine the charges on yer teleport jewellery.
translation: 哎呀，你到底想要什么？我可以告诉你们符文的价格，或者我可以合并你们传送珠宝的费用。 [ai ya ， ni dao di xiang yao shen me ？ wo ke yi gao su ni men fu wen de jia ge ， huo zhe wo ke yi he bing ni men chuan song zhu bao de fei yong 。]

english: What's a pirate doing here?
translation: 海盗在这里做什么？ [hai dao zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: By my sea-blistered skin, I could ask the same of you!
translation: 以我的皮肤起泡，我也可以问你同样的问题！ [yi wo de pi fu qi pao ， wo ye ke yi wen ni tong yang de wen ti ！]

english: But... I'm not a pirate?
translation: 但是……我不是海贼？ [dan shi …… wo bu shi hai zei ？]

english: No? Then what's that smell? The smell o' someone spent too long at sea without a bath!
translation: 不？那么那是什么味道呢？某人在海上待太久而没有洗澡的气味！ [bu ？ na me na shi shen me wei dao ne ？ mou ren zai hai shang dai tai jiu er mei you xi zao de qi wei ！]

english: I think that's probably you.
translation: 我想那可能就是你。 [wo xiang na ke neng jiu shi ni 。]

english: Har har har! We've got a stern landlubber 'ere! Well, let me tell ye, I'm here for the Grand Exchange! Gonna cash in me loot!
translation: 哈哈哈！我们这里有一个严厉的旱鸭子！好吧，我告诉你们，我是来参加大交换的！要把我的战利品兑现！ [ha ha ha ！ wo men zhe li you yi ge yan li de han ya zi ！ hao ba ， wo gao su ni men ， wo shi lai can jia da jiao huan de ！ yao ba wo de zhan li pin dui xian ！]

english: Don't you just want to sell it in a shop or trade it to someone specific?
translation: 您不想只是想在商店中出售它或将其交易给特定的人吗？ [nin bu xiang zhi shi xiang zai shang dian zhong chu shou ta huo jiang qi jiao yi gei te ding de ren ma ？]

english: By my wave-battered bones! Not when I can sell to the whole world from this very spot!
translation: 以我饱受海浪摧残的骨头为证！当我可以从这个地方向全世界销售时就不会了！ [yi wo bao shou hai lang cui can de gu tou wei zheng ！ dang wo ke yi cong zhe ge di fang xiang quan shi jie xiao shou shi jiu bu hui le ！]

english: You pirates are nothing but trouble! Why, once I travelled to Lunar Isle with a bunch of your type, and spent days sailing around in circles!
translation: 你们这些海盗就是麻烦！哎呀，有一次我和一群你们这样的人一起去月岛旅行，花了好几天的时间兜圈子！ [ni men zhe xie hai dao jiu shi ma fan ！ ai ya ， you yi ci wo he yi qun ni men zhe yang de ren yi qi qu yue dao lv xing ， hua le hao ji tian de shi jian dou quan zi ！]

english: Then ye must know me brother! Murky Pat!
translation: 那你一定认识我兄弟吧！阴暗的帕特！ [na ni yi ding ren shi wo xiong di ba ！ yin an de pa te ！]

english: Hmmm. Not so sure I remember him.
translation: 嗯。不太确定我还记得他。 [n 。 bu tai que ding wo hai ji de ta 。]

english: Well, 'e be on that ship for sure. And I remember 'im tellin' me about some [guy/gal] like ye, getting all mixed up with curses and cabin boys.
translation: 好吧，我们肯定会在那艘船上。我记得我告诉过我一些像你们一样的[男人/女孩]，把诅咒和机舱男孩混在一起。 [hao ba ， wo men ken ding hui zai na sou chuan shang 。 wo ji de wo gao su guo wo yi xie xiang ni men yi yang de [ nan ren / nv hai ]， ba zu zhou he ji cang nan hai hun zai yi qi 。]

english: Yes! That was me!
translation: 是的！那是我！ [shi de ！ na shi wo ！]

english: Ye sure be a different character.
translation: 你肯定是一个不同的角色。 [ni ken ding shi yi ge bu tong de jue se 。]

english: Tell me about the prices of runes.
translation: 告诉我符文的价格。 [gao su wo fu wen de jia ge 。]

english: Combine the charges on my teleport jewellery, please.
translation: 请合并我的传送珠宝的费用。 [qing he bing wo de chuan song zhu bao de fei yong 。]

english: Arrr, ye've got nothing that I can combine.
translation: 哎呀，你没有什么我可以结合的。 [ai ya ， ni mei you shen me wo ke yi jie he de 。]

english: Arrr, ye've nothing I can combine. Maybe ye needs to take yer stuff up to the Wilderness and charge it on the Fountain of Rune. It be more powerful than me.
translation: 哎呀，你们没有什么我可以结合的。也许你需要把你的东西带到荒野并在符文喷泉上充能。一定比我还厉害吧 [ai ya ， ni men mei you shen me wo ke yi jie he de 。 ye xu ni xu yao ba ni de dong xi dai dao huang ye bing zai fu wen pen quan shang chong neng 。 yi ding bi wo hai li hai ba]

english: Arrr, I think ye be a bit short of inventory space.
translation: 呃，我想你们的库存空间有点不足。 [e ， wo xiang ni men de ku cun kong jian you dian bu zu 。]

english: Arr, all done.
translation: 呃，都完成了。 [e ， dou wan cheng le 。]

english: I hear you deal in rings of forging?
translation: 我听说你经营锻造戒指？ [wo ting shuo ni jing ying duan zao jie zhi ？]

english: Arrrr, bring me yer ruby rings to enchant.
translation: 哎呀，把你的红宝石戒指给我拿来施展吧。 [ai ya ， ba ni de hong bao shi jie zhi gei wo na lai shi zhan ba 。]

english: Arrrr, but they arrre 250gp per ring.
translation: Arrrrr，但他们每环 250gp。 [Arrrrr， dan ta men mei huan  250gp。]

english: Arrr, 250gp per ring. How many would ye like me to enchant?
translation: 哎呀，每环 250gp。你们想让我迷惑多少人？ [ai ya ， mei huan  250gp。 ni men xiang rang wo mi huo duo shao ren ？]

english: Arrr, be seeing ya.
translation: 嗯，再见。 [n ， zai jian 。]

english: Arrr, pleasure doin' business with ya.
translation: 嗯，很高兴与你做生意。 [n ， hen gao xing yu ni zuo sheng yi 。]

english: I got to go, erm, swab some decks! Yarr!
translation: 我得走了，呃，擦拭一些甲板！亚尔！ [wo de zou le ， e ， ca shi yi xie jia ban ！ ya er ！]

english: Defer your speech right there! Quit this derogatory and somewhat narrow-minded allusion that all folks of sea voyage are only concerned with washing the decks, looking after parrots and drinking rum. I'll have ye
translation: 就在那里推迟你的演讲！放弃这种贬义且有点狭隘的暗示，即所有海上航行的人只关心清洗甲板、照顾鹦鹉和喝朗姆酒。我要你 [jiu zai na li tui chi ni de yan jiang ！ fang qi zhe zhong bian yi qie you dian xia ai de an shi ， ji suo you hai shang hang xing de ren zhi guan xin qing xi jia ban 、 zhao gu ying wu he he lang mu jiu 。 wo yao ni]

english: know there is much more to a pirate than meets the eye.
translation: 知道海盗的面目远不止表面看上去的那么简单。 [zhi dao hai dao de mian mu yuan bu zhi biao mian kan shang qu de na me jian dan 。]

english: Aye-aye, captain!
translation: 是啊是啊，队长！ [shi a shi a ， dui zhang ！]

english: Oh, come on! Lighten up!
translation: 哦，来吧！减轻一点！ [o ， lai ba ！ jian qing yi dian ！]

english: Arrr, what is it that ye be wantin? I can tell ye all about the prices of runes.
translation: 哎呀，你到底想要什么？我可以告诉你们符文的价格。 [ai ya ， ni dao di xiang yao shen me ？ wo ke yi gao su ni men fu wen de jia ge 。]

english: No! Me prices, they be goin' down!
translation: 不！我的价格，他们会下降！ [bu ！ wo de jia ge ， ta men hui xia jiang ！]

english: Arrr! Another good sale!
translation: 啊！又一个好卖！ [a ！ you yi ge hao mai ！]

english: I'm lovin' this Grand Exchange! Arrr!
translation: 我喜欢这个盛大的交换！啊！ [wo xi huan zhe ge sheng da de jiao huan ！ a ！]

english: Sure be a busy place, today.
translation: 今天肯定是一个繁忙的地方。 [jin tian ken ding shi yi ge fan mang de di fang 。]

english: Yarrr! I'm gonna be rich, I tell ye!
translation: 呀！我要发财了，我告诉你们！ [ya ！ wo yao fa cai le ， wo gao su ni men ！]

english: What's a pirate doing here?
translation: 海盗在这里做什么？ [hai dao zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Tell me about the prices of runes.
translation: 告诉我符文的价格。 [gao su wo fu wen de jia ge 。]

english: Combine the charges on my teleport jewellery, please.
translation: 请合并我的传送珠宝的费用。 [qing he bing wo de chuan song zhu bao de fei yong 。]

english: I got to go, erm, swab some decks! Yarr!
translation: 我得走了，呃，擦拭一些甲板！亚尔！ [wo de zou le ， e ， ca shi yi xie jia ban ！ ya er ！]

english: I hear you deal in rings of forging?
translation: 我听说你经营锻造戒指？ [wo ting shuo ni jing ying duan zao jie zhi ？]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: So how's life as a pirate?
translation: 那么海贼的生活是怎样的呢？ [na me hai zei de sheng huo shi zen yang de ne ？]

english: What kind of question is that? How's life as a... I dunno. Whatever it is that you do for a living.
translation: 这是什么问题？生活怎么样……我不知道。无论你以什么为生。 [zhe shi shen me wen ti ？ sheng huo zen me yang …… wo bu zhi dao 。 wu lun ni yi shen me wei sheng 。]

english: I'm a freelance troubleshooter.
translation: 我是一名自由疑难解答者。 [wo shi yi ming zi you yi nan jie da zhe 。]

english: What does that entail then?
translation: 那么这意味着什么呢？ [na me zhe yi wei zhe shen me ne ？]

english: Mostly killing things for money and delivering items around the planet for people.
translation: 主要是为了钱而杀人，并为人们在地球各地运送物品。 [zhu yao shi wei le qian er sha ren ， bing wei ren men zai di qiu ge di yun song wu pin 。]

english: I collect stuff.
translation: 我收集东西。 [wo shou ji dong xi 。]

english: So how's that life?
translation: 那么这样的生活怎么样呢？ [na me zhe yang de sheng huo zen me yang ne ？]

english: Can't complain, can't complain...
translation: 不能抱怨，不能抱怨…… [bu neng bao yuan ， bu neng bao yuan ……]

english: Well, there you go.
translation: 好吧，就这样吧。 [hao ba ， jiu zhe yang ba 。]

english: Aren't you a little short for a pirate?
translation: 你对于海盗来说是不是有点矮了？ [ni dui yu hai dao lai shuo shi bu shi you dian ai le ？]

english: My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.
translation: 我的母亲是一个侏儒。显然这是一次非常痛苦的分娩。 [wo de mu qin shi yi ge zhu ru 。 xian ran zhe shi yi ci fei chang tong ku de fen mian 。]

english: More info than I wanted, thanks!
translation: 比我想要的更多信息，谢谢！ [bi wo xiang yao de geng duo xin xi ， xie xie ！]

english: Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.
translation: 抱歉，不能停下来，如果船长发现我偷懒地跟偷渡者说话，我的胆子会被吊袜带的。 [bao qian ， bu neng ting xia lai ， ru guo chuan zhang fa xian wo tou lan di gen tou du zhe shuo hua ， wo de dan zi hui bei diao wa dai de 。]

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard!
translation: 我不是偷渡者！我被邀请上船了！ [wo bu shi tou du zhe ！ wo bei yao qing shang chuan le ！]

english: Yeah, whatever [guy/lady], it doesn't really matter who you are I'll get in trouble!
translation: 是的，无论[男人/女人]，无论你是谁，我都会遇到麻烦！ [shi de ， wu lun [ nan ren / nv ren ]， wu lun ni shi shui ， wo du hui yu dao ma fan ！]

english: You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.
translation: 你知道，我一直想知道海盗的生活究竟意味着什么。 [ni zhi dao ， wo yi zhi xiang zhi dao hai dao de sheng huo jiu jing yi wei zhe shen me 。]

english: Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.
translation: 嗯，目前主要涉及偷渡者随机询问问题。 [n ， mu qian zhu yao she ji tou du zhe sui ji xun wen wen ti 。]

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard! By Lokar! Ask him!
translation: 我不是偷渡者！我被邀请上船了！洛卡写的！问他吧！ [wo bu shi tou du zhe ！ wo bei yao qing shang chuan le ！ luo ka xie de ！ wen ta ba ！]

english: Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.
translation: 嘿，无论如何[爱人/朋友]。只要确保船长没有抓住你，海盗不太喜欢偷渡者。 [hei ， wu lun ru he [ ai ren / peng you ]。 zhi yao que bao chuan zhang mei you zhua zhu ni ， hai dao bu tai xi huan tou du zhe 。]

english: Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?
translation: 啊，祝你有美好的一天[milady/sirrah]！你的脸很陌生，你是不是和我们一起登上了月岛的船？ [a ， zhu ni you mei hao de yi tian [milady/sirrah]！ ni de lian hen mo sheng ， ni shi bu shi he wo men yi qi deng shang le yue dao de chuan ？]

english: No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.
translation: 不，洛卡实际上让我在雷莱卡搭车。 [bu ， luo ka shi ji shang rang wo zai lei lai ka da che 。]

english: Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!
translation: 哦真的吗？在我看来你不像弗雷曼尼克人！ [o zhen de ma ？ zai wo kan lai ni bu xiang fu lei man ni ke ren ！]

english: Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
translation: 嗯……我有点是，又有点不是。这是一个很长的故事。 [n …… wo you dian shi ， you you dian bu shi 。 zhe shi yi ge hen zhang de gu shi 。]

english: Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a-fremennik!
translation: 抱歉我没时间听！再见，年轻的弗雷曼尼克，他不是真正的弗雷曼尼克！ [bao qian wo mei shi jian ting ！ zai jian ， nian qing de fu lei man ni ke ， ta bu shi zhen zheng de fu lei man ni ke ！]

english: 'Bye.
translation: '再见。 [' zai jian 。]

english: Brrrr! Its cold up here!
translation: 呜呜！这里很冷！ [wu wu ！ zhe li hen leng ！]

english: You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!
translation: 你觉得这很冷吗？到了 Acheron 那里，天气变得非常寒冷，当你说话时，你会看到话语冻结在你面前的空气中！ [ni jue de zhe hen leng ma ？ dao le  Acheron  na li ， tian qi bian de fei chang han leng ， dang ni shuo hua shi ， ni hui kan dao hua yu dong jie zai ni mian qian de kong qi zhong ！]

english: REALLY?
translation: 真的吗？ [zhen de ma ？]

english: Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!
translation: 不，不是真的。我为了达到幽默效果而夸张了。不过天气非常非常冷！ [bu ， bu shi zhen de 。 wo wei le da dao you mo xiao guo er kua zhang le 。 bu guo tian qi fei chang fei chang leng ！]

english: Hello to you too.
translation: 也向你问好。 [ye xiang ni wen hao 。]

english: Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
translation: 呀！我们是海盗，耶！阿瓦斯特，你们这些坏血病的陆生荔枝！ [ya ！ wo men shi hai dao ， ye ！ a wa si te ， ni men zhe xie huai xue bing de lu sheng li zhi ！]

english: Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
translation: 请不要这样说话，这太令人恼火了。 [qing bu yao zhe yang shuo hua ， zhe tai ling ren nao huo le 。]

english: Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
translation: 另外，请不要叫我荔枝，不管那是什么。 [ling wai ， qing bu yao jiao wo li zhi ， bu guan na shi shen me 。]

english: Oh. Okay. Sorry.
translation: 哦。好的。对不起。 [o 。 hao de 。 dui bu qi 。]

english: ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!
translation: 啊啊！拉响警报！船上偷渡者！船上偷渡者！ [a a ！ la xiang jing bao ！ chuan shang tou du zhe ！ chuan shang tou du zhe ！]

english: No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
translation: 不！我不是偷渡者！诚实的！我被邀请来到这里！ [bu ！ wo bu shi tou du zhe ！ cheng shi de ！ wo bei yao qing lai dao zhe li ！]

english: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
translation: 哦，抱歉，那是我的错误。 [o ， bao qian ， na shi wo de cuo wu 。]

english: You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.
translation: 但你必须承认你看起来确实很像一个偷渡者。 [dan ni bi xu cheng ren ni kan qi lai que shi hen xiang yi ge tou du zhe 。]

english: Why, what do they usually look like?
translation: 为什么，他们通常是什么样子？ [wei shen me ， ta men tong chang shi shen me yang zi ？]

english: Erm... I've never actually met one...
translation: 呃……我从来没有真正见过一个…… [e …… wo cong lai mei you zhen zheng jian guo yi ge ……]

english: Okay then...
translation: 好吧，那么... [hao ba ， na me ...]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: So... You're a pirate, huh?
translation: 那么...你是海盗，是吧？ [na me ... ni shi hai dao ， shi ba ？]

english: It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.
translation: 月底我的工资单上就是这么写的。 [yue di wo de gong zi dan shang jiu shi zhe me xie de 。]

english: How's that working out for you?
translation: 你感觉怎么样？ [ni gan jue zen me yang ？]

english: Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.
translation: 到目前为止还不错。我们可以掠夺的所有烈酒和战利品，再加上包括牙科在内的全套医疗服务。 [dao mu qian wei zhi hai bu cuo 。 wo men ke yi lve duo de suo you lie jiu he zhan li pin ， zai jia shang bao kuo ya ke zai nei de quan tao yi liao fu wu 。]

english: You mean you have insurance?
translation: 你是说你有保险？ [ni shi shuo ni you bao xian ？]

english: Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.
translation: 不是这样的。如果我们中的任何一个人生病了，我们就会绑架一名医生，直到我们病情好转之前不让他走。 [bu shi zhe yang de 。 ru guo wo men zhong de ren he yi ge ren sheng bing le ， wo men jiu hui bang jia yi ming yi sheng ， zhi dao wo men bing qing hao zhuan zhi qian bu rang ta zou 。]

english: You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.
translation: 您会惊讶地发现，这对于专家医疗保健来说是多么大的激励。 [nin hui jing ya di fa xian ， zhe dui yu zhuan jia yi liao bao jian lai shuo shi duo me da de ji li 。]

english: I can imagine.
translation: 我可以想象。 [wo ke yi xiang xiang 。]

english: Hello there. So what brings you aboard the Lady Zay?
translation: 你好呀。那么是什么让您登上了 Lady Zay 号呢？ [ni hao ya 。 na me shi shen me rang nin deng shang le  Lady Zay  hao ne ？]

english: Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.
translation: 嗯，我原本打算去拜访月族，但我不得不说你们的船非常令人印象深刻。 [n ， wo yuan ben da suan qu bai fang yue zu ， dan wo bu de bu shuo ni men de chuan fei chang ling ren yin xiang shen ke 。]

english: Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!
translation: 是啊，果然是个美女啊！扎伊女士酒店一直是我的家，度过了许多艰难的几个月，经历了暴风雨和阳光，她总是带我们到达我们要去的地方！ [shi a ， guo ran shi ge mei nv a ！ zha yi nv shi jiu dian yi zhi shi wo de jia ， du guo le xu duo jian nan de ji ge yue ， jing li le bao feng yu he yang guang ， ta zong shi dai wo men dao da wo men yao qu de di fang ！]

english: Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!
translation: 是的，她确实是我旅行中见过的最好的船之一！ [shi de ， ta que shi shi wo lv xing zhong jian guo de zui hao de chuan zhi yi ！]

english: That she is [lad/lass], that she is.
translation: 她是[小伙子/姑娘]，她就是。 [ta shi [ xiao huo zi / gu niang ]， ta jiu shi 。]

english: Good day to you Sir.
translation: 先生，美好的一天。 [xian sheng ， mei hao de yi tian 。]

english: Well hello my brave adventurer.
translation: 好吧，你好，我勇敢的冒险家。 [hao ba ， ni hao ， wo yong gan de mao xian jia 。]

english: What are you up to?
translation: 你要做什么？ [ni yao zuo shen me ？]

english: Getting ready to go fishing of course. There's no time to waste!
translation: 当然是准备去钓鱼了。没有时间可以浪费了！ [dang ran shi zhun bei qu diao yu le 。 mei you shi jian ke yi lang fei le ！]

english: I've got all the supplies I need from the shop at the end of the pier. They sell good rope, hammers and axes although their bailing buckets aren't too effective.
translation: 我从码头尽头的商店里拿到了我需要的所有物资。他们出售优质的绳索、锤子和斧头，尽管他们的舀水桶不太有效。 [wo cong ma tou jin tou de shang dian li na dao le wo xu yao de suo you wu zi 。 ta men chu shou you zhi di sheng suo 、 chui zi he fu tou ， jin guan ta men de yao shui tong bu tai you xiao 。]

english: What fish do you catch?
translation: 你钓到什么鱼？ [ni diao dao shen me yu ？]

english: I get all sorts, anything that lies on the sea bed, you never know what you're going to get until you pull up the net!
translation: 我得到了各种各样的东西，任何躺在海床上的东西，你永远不知道会得到什么，直到你拉起网！ [wo de dao le ge zhong ge yang de dong xi ， ren he tang zai hai chuang shang de dong xi ， ni yong yuan bu zhi dao hui de dao shen me ， zhi dao ni la qi wang ！]

english: Your boat doesn't look too safe.
translation: 你的船看起来不太安全。 [ni de chuan kan qi lai bu tai an quan 。]

english: That's because it's not, the darn thing's full of holes.
translation: 那是因为它不是，这该死的东西充满了漏洞。 [na shi yin wei ta bu shi ， zhe gai si de dong xi chong man le lou dong 。]

english: Oh, so I suppose you can't go out for a while?
translation: 哦，那我想你暂时不能出去吧？ [o ， na wo xiang ni zan shi bu neng chu qu ba ？]

english: Oh no, I don't let a few holes stop an experienced sailor like me. I could sail these seas in a barrel, I'll be going out soon enough.
translation: 哦，不，我不会让几个洞阻止像我这样经验丰富的水手。我可以在木桶里航行这些海洋，我很快就会出去。 [o ， bu ， wo bu hui rang ji ge dong zu zhi xiang wo zhe yang jing yan feng fu de shui shou 。 wo ke yi zai mu tong li hang xing zhe xie hai yang ， wo hen kuai jiu hui chu qu 。]

english: Could I help?
translation: 我可以帮忙吗？ [wo ke yi bang mang ma ？]

english: Well of course you can! I'll warn you though, the seas are merciless and without fishing experience you won't catch much.
translation: 当然可以！不过我要警告你，大海是无情的，没有钓鱼经验你是钓不到多少东西的。 [dang ran ke yi ！ bu guo wo yao jing gao ni ， da hai shi wu qing de ， mei you diao yu jing yan ni shi diao bu dao duo shao dong xi de 。]

english: You need a fishing level of 15 or above to catch any fish on the trawler.
translation: 您需要 15 级或以上的钓鱼等级才能在拖网渔船上捕获任何鱼。 [nin xu yao  15  ji huo yi shang de diao yu deng ji cai neng zai tuo wang yu chuan shang bu huo ren he yu 。]

english: On occasions the net rips, so you'll need some rope to repair it.
translation: 有时网会撕裂，因此您需要一些绳子来修复它。 [you shi wang hui si lie ， yin ci nin xu yao yi xie sheng zi lai xiu fu ta 。]

english: Repairing the net is difficult in the harsh conditions so you'll find it easier with a higher crafting level.
translation: 在恶劣的条件下修复网是很困难的，所以你会发现随着制作水平的提高，修复网会变得更容易。 [zai e lie de tiao jian xia xiu fu wang shi hen kun nan de ， suo yi ni hui fa xian sui zhe zhi zuo shui ping de ti gao ， xiu fu wang hui bian de geng rong yi 。]

english: Right...ok.
translation: 对……好吧。 [dui …… hao ba 。]

english: There's also a slight problem with leaks.
translation: 还有一点就是漏水的小问题。 [hai you yi dian jiu shi lou shui de xiao wen ti 。]

english: Leaks?!
translation: 泄漏？！ [xie lou ？！]

english: Nothing some swamp paste won't fix...
translation: 没有什么是沼泽膏解决不了的... [mei you shen me shi zhao ze gao jie jue bu liao de ...]

english: Swamp paste?
translation: 沼泽粘贴？ [zhao ze zhan tie ？]

english: Also, there's the small matter of the Kraken.
translation: 另外，还有海妖的小事。 [ling wai ， hai you hai yao de xiao shi 。]

english: You have got to be kidding me?
translation: 你一定是在开玩笑吧？ [ni yi ding shi zai kai wan xiao ba ？]

english: Occupational hazard. I usually whack it with an axe a few time and fix the damage with hammer once it's gone.
translation: 职业危害。我通常用斧头敲击它几次，然后在它消失后用锤子修复损坏。 [zhi ye wei hai 。 wo tong chang yong fu tou qiao ji ta ji ci ， ran hou zai ta xiao shi hou yong chui zi xiu fu sun huai 。]

english: Oh, and one more thing... I hope you're a good swimmer?
translation: 哦，还有一件事...我希望你是一名游泳好手？ [o ， hai you yi jian shi ... wo xi wang ni shi yi ming you yong hao shou ？]

english: Actually, I think I'll leave it.
translation: 事实上，我想我会离开它。 [shi shi shang ， wo xiang wo hui li kai ta 。]

english: Bloomin' land lovers!!!
translation: 开花之地爱好者！！！ [kai hua zhi di ai hao zhe ！！！]

english: I'll be fine, let's go.
translation: 我不会有事的，我们走吧。 [wo bu hui you shi de ， wo men zou ba 。]

english: Aye aye! Meet me on board the trawler. I just need to get a few things together.
translation: 是啊是啊！在拖网渔船上见我。我只需要整理一些东西。 [shi a shi a ！ zai tuo wang yu chuan shang jian wo 。 wo zhi xu yao zheng li yi xie dong xi 。]

english: Aye aye! Meet me on board the trawler.
translation: 是啊是啊！在拖网渔船上见我。 [shi a shi a ！ zai tuo wang yu chuan shang jian wo 。]

english: Oh hang on. I'm already on a fishing trip with someone. You'll have to try back in a few minutes.
translation: 哦，坚持住。我已经和某人一起去钓鱼了。您必须在几分钟后重试。 [o ， jian chi zhu 。 wo yi jing he mou ren yi qi qu diao yu le 。 nin bi xu zai ji fen zhong hou zhong shi 。]

english: How can you be here and on board the boat?!
translation: 你怎么会在这里并在船上？！ [ni zen me hui zai zhe li bing zai chuan shang ？！]

english: That's Game Magic, [lass/son].
translation: 这就是游戏魔法，[女孩/儿子]。 [zhe jiu shi you xi mo fa ，[ nv hai / er zi ]。]

english: What?!
translation: 什么？！ [shen me ？！]

english: Never mind. Just try back later OK?
translation: 没关系。请稍后再试好吗？ [mei guan xi 。 qing shao hou zai shi hao ma ？]

english: What's swamp paste?
translation: 什么是沼泽膏？ [shen me shi zhao ze gao ？]

english: Swamp tar mixed with flour which is then heated over a fire.
translation: 沼泽焦油与面粉混合，然后在火上加热。 [zhao ze jiao you yu mian fen hun he ， ran hou zai huo shang jia re 。]

english: Where can I find swamp tar?
translation: 在哪里可以找到沼泽焦油？ [zai na li ke yi zhao dao zhao ze jiao you ？]

english: Unfortunately the only supply of swamp tar is in the swamps below Lumbridge.
translation: 不幸的是，沼泽焦油的唯一供应是在朗布里奇下面的沼泽中。 [bu xing de shi ， zhao ze jiao you de wei yi gong ying shi zai lang bu li qi xia mian de zhao ze zhong 。]

english: Hello again Murphy.
translation: 墨菲，你好。 [mo fei ， ni hao 。]

english: Good day to you land lover. Fancy hitting the high seas again?
translation: 祝你土地爱好者美好的一天。想再次出海吗？ [zhu ni tu di ai hao zhe mei hao de yi tian 。 xiang zai ci chu hai ma ？]

english: No thanks, I still feel ill from last time.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我上次的感觉还是不舒服。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo shang ci de gan jue hai shi bu shu fu 。]

english: Hah! ...Softy.
translation: 哈！ ...软软的。 [ha ！ ... ruan ruan de 。]

english: We keep sinking! Can you give me some advice?
translation: 我们不断下沉！你能给我一些建议吗？ [wo men bu duan xia chen ！ ni neng gei wo yi xie jian yi ma ？]

english: Aye aye matey! We'll soon get you ship shape!
translation: 是啊，伙计！我们很快就会让您恢复状态！ [shi a ， huo ji ！ wo men hen kuai jiu hui rang nin hui fu zhuang tai ！]

english: Ah yes, got it.
translation: 啊，是的，明白了。 [a ， shi de ， ming bai le 。]

english: Don't say!
translation: 别说！ [bie shuo ！]

english: Also, bring a good axe and a hammer in case of Kraken attacks.
translation: 另外，请带上一把好斧头和一把锤子，以防海妖袭击。 [ling wai ， qing dai shang yi ba hao fu tou he yi ba chui zi ， yi fang hai yao xi ji 。]

english: I thought I'd heard it all!
translation: 我以为我都听到了！ [wo yi wei wo dou ting dao le ！]

english: Right so I need lots of swamp paste and plenty of rope, an axe and a hammer. Thanks Murphy!
translation: 是的，所以我需要大量的沼泽泥和大量的绳子、斧头和锤子。谢谢墨菲！ [shi de ， suo yi wo xu yao da liang de zhao ze ni he da liang de sheng zi 、 fu tou he chui zi 。 xie xie mo fei ！]

english: If all else fails use a bailing bucket or three!
translation: 如果所有其他方法都失败，请使用一个或三个舀水桶！ [ru guo suo you qi ta fang fa dou shi bai ， qing shi yong yi ge huo san ge yao shui tong ！]

english: Yes, let's do it!
translation: 是的，让我们开始吧！ [shi de ， rang wo men kai shi ba ！]

english: Murphy, what can you tell me about giant crabs?
translation: 墨菲，关于巨型螃蟹，你能告诉我什么吗？ [mo fei ， guan yu ju xing pang xie ， ni neng gao su wo shen me ma ？]

english: Giant Crabs? Why, I used to haul up a few of those whenever I set my nets around Rimmington.
translation: 巨蟹？哎呀，每当我在里明顿周围撒网时，我都会拉上一些这样的东西。 [ju xie ？ ai ya ， mei dang wo zai li ming dun zhou wei sa wang shi ， wo du hui la shang yi xie zhe yang de dong xi 。]

english: Why the interest?
translation: 为什么有兴趣？ [wei shen me you xing qu ？]

english: I need to get some Giant Crab Meat and Kelp. Can you tell me where I can get some?
translation: 我需要一些巨蟹肉和海带。你能告诉我哪里可以买到一些吗？ [wo xu yao yi xie ju xie rou he hai dai 。 ni neng gao su wo na li ke yi mai dao yi xie ma ？]

english: Well, the only thing I can think to do is to go down there and look to see if there are any left.
translation: 好吧，我唯一能想到的就是下去看看还有没有剩下的。 [hao ba ， wo wei yi neng xiang dao de jiu shi xia qu kan kan hai you mei you sheng xia de 。]

english: Go down there? What do you mean?
translation: 去那里吗？你是什​​么意思？ [qu na li ma ？ ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: As in under the water!
translation: 就像在水下一样！ [jiu xiang zai shui xia yi yang ！]

english: Tell me, can you get your hands on a fishbowl?
translation: 告诉我，你能拿到鱼缸吗？ [gao su wo ， ni neng na dao yu gang ma ？]

english: I'm sure I will be able to if I put my mind to it, why do you ask?
translation: 我相信只要我下定决心一定能做到，为什么还要问呢？ [wo xiang xin zhi yao wo xia ding jue xin yi ding neng zuo dao ， wei shen me hai yao wen ne ？]

english: Well, I know how to rig up a handy set of breathing gear that can allow you to keep air inside the fishbowl.
translation: 嗯，我知道如何安装一套方便的呼吸装置，可以让鱼缸内保持空气。 [n ， wo zhi dao ru he an zhuang yi tao fang bian de hu xi zhuang zhi ， ke yi rang yu gang nei bao chi kong qi 。]

english: You just put the barrel of air on your back, with the fishbowl over your head, and then dive over the side.
translation: 你只需将空气桶放在背上，将鱼缸放在头顶上，然后从侧面潜入即可。 [ni zhi xu jiang kong qi tong fang zai bei shang ， jiang yu gang fang zai tou ding shang ， ran hou cong ce mian qian ru ji ke 。]

english: It should hold enough air to keep you alive for quite some time.
translation: 它应该容纳足够的空气让你存活相当长的一段时间。 [ta ying gai rong na zu gou de kong qi rang ni cun huo xiang dang zhang de yi duan shi jian 。]

english: That sounds pretty dangerous...
translation: 听起来很危险... [ting qi lai hen wei xian ...]

english: Not at all. I'll even weigh anchor with the chain somewhere easy to reach so you can climb out easily enough if you run into trouble.
translation: 一点也不。我什至会用链条在容易触及的地方起锚，这样如果您遇到麻烦，您就可以轻松地爬出来。 [yi dian ye bu 。 wo shen zhi hui yong lian tiao zai rong yi chu ji de di fang qi mao ， zhe yang ru guo nin yu dao ma fan ， nin jiu ke yi qing song di pa chu lai 。]

english: I'm still not happy about this...
translation: 对此我还是不高兴…… [dui ci wo hai shi bu gao xing ……]

english: Well, I can't think of any other way to check. If you come up with a better plan then feel free to tell me.
translation: 好吧，我想不出任何其他方法来检查。如果您有更好的计划，请随时告诉我。 [hao ba ， wo xiang bu chu ren he qi ta fang fa lai jian cha 。 ru guo nin you geng hao de ji hua ， qing sui shi gao su wo 。]

english: In the meantime I'll wait, and if you want me to take you diving I'll be ready.
translation: 与此同时，我会等待，如果你想让我带你去潜水，我会做好准备的。 [yu ci tong shi ， wo hui deng dai ， ru guo ni xiang rang wo dai ni qu qian shui ， wo hui zuo hao zhun bei de 。]

english: By the way, why are you so interested in crabs all of a sudden?
translation: 对了，你怎么突然对螃蟹这么感兴趣了？ [dui le ， ni zen me tu ran dui pang xie zhe me gan xing qu le ？]

english: I can't tell you I'm afraid. The very fabric of space and time could collapse!
translation: 我不能告诉你我害怕。空间和时间的结构可能会崩溃！ [wo bu neng gao su ni wo hai pa 。 kong jian he shi jian de jie gou ke neng hui beng kui ！]
好的... [hao de ...]

english: Well, I guess some people will do anything for a bit of fresh seafood.
translation: 好吧，我想有些人会为了一点新鲜的海鲜而做任何事。 [hao ba ， wo xiang you xie ren hui wei le yi dian xin xian de hai xian er zuo ren he shi 。]

english: Ahoy there! All set for a dive?
translation: 哎哟！准备好潜水了吗？ [ai yo ！ zhun bei hao qian shui le ma ？]

english: I certainly am.
translation: 我当然是。 [wo dang ran shi 。]

english: Great! I'll sort that fishbowl out for you.
translation: 伟大的！我会帮你整理那个鱼缸的。 [wei da de ！ wo hui bang ni zheng li na ge yu gang de 。]

english: There you go.
translation: 就这样吧。 [jiu zhe yang ba 。]

english: Are you sure this is safe?
translation: 你确定这安全吗？ [ni que ding zhe an quan ma ？]

english: Sure! It's as sound as my ship!
translation: 当然！它和我的船一样健全！ [dang ran ！ ta he wo de chuan yi yang jian quan ！]

english: Want me to take you out now?
translation: 要我现在带你出去吗？ [yao wo xian zai dai ni chu qu ma ？]

english: Well I can't take you out until you are properly geared up.
translation: 好吧，在你做好充分准备之前我不能带你出去。 [hao ba ， zai ni zuo hao chong fen zhun bei zhi qian wo bu neng dai ni chu qu 。]

english: Ok, let's be off then.
translation: 好吧，那我们就出发吧。 [hao ba ， na wo men jiu chu fa ba 。]

english: Cutscene begins onboard the boat.
translation: 过场动画在船上开始。 [guo chang dong hua zai chuan shang kai shi 。]

english: Ok, see you soon Murphy!
translation: 好的，墨菲，很快再见！ [hao de ， mo fei ， hen kuai zai jian ！]

english: Good luck, I'll weigh anchor. Climb up the chain to get aboard.
translation: 祝你好运，我会起锚。爬上链条即可登上。 [zhu ni hao yun ， wo hui qi mao 。 pa shang lian tiao ji ke deng shang 。]

english: Not just yet.
translation: 还不是现在。 [hai bu shi xian zai 。]

english: Ok, well I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 好吧，如果你改变主意，我就在这里。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， wo jiu zai zhe li 。]

english: Murphy, can I get another diving helmet?
translation: 墨菲，我可以再买一个潜水头盔吗？ [mo fei ， wo ke yi zai mai yi ge qian shui tou kui ma ？]

english: Sure, here you go. Try not to lose this one, I'm not a very good glassblower.
translation: 当然，给你。尽量不要失去这个，我不是一个很好的玻璃吹制者。 [dang ran ， gei ni 。 jin liang bu yao shi qu zhe ge ， wo bu shi yi ge hen hao de bo li chui zhi zhe 。]

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你是什​​么意思？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: Well, the bowls I make tend to shatter under pressure into razor-sharp shards of lethal, face shredding shrapnel.
translation: 嗯，我做的碗在压力下往往会碎成锋利的致命碎片，撕碎脸部的弹片。 [n ， wo zuo de wan zai ya li xia wang wang hui sui cheng feng li de zhi ming sui pian ， si sui lian bu de dan pian 。]

english: Don't let it bother you, I think I know what I'm doing wrong now.
translation: 别让它打扰你，我想我现在知道我做错了什么。 [bie rang ta da rao ni ， wo xiang wo xian zai zhi dao wo zuo cuo le shen me 。]
好的… [hao de …]

english: Hello Murphy. Do you have a spare diving backpack?
translation: 你好，墨菲。您有备用的潜水背包吗？ [ni hao ， mo fei 。 nin you bei yong de qian shui bei bao ma ？]

english: Sure, I have plenty after the...little incident.
translation: 当然，在……小事件之后我有很多。 [dang ran ， zai …… xiao shi jian zhi hou wo you hen duo 。]

english: What 'little incident'?
translation: 什么“小事件”？ [shen me “ xiao shi jian ”？]

english: Nothing to worry yourself about.
translation: 没什么好担心的。 [mei shen me hao dan xin de 。]

english: Here, have this one. Only dropped once!
translation: 给，有这个。只掉落过一次！ [gei ， you zhe ge 。 zhi diao luo guo yi ci ！]

english: Is that blood?
translation: 那是血吗？ [na shi xue ma ？]

english: No, no.
translation: 不，不。 [bu ， bu 。]

english: Well, yes.
translation: 嗯，是的。 [n ， shi de 。]

english: But seriously, what are the chances of getting a jellyfish jammed in there again?
translation: 但说真的，水母再次卡在那里的可能性有多大？ [dan shuo zhen de ， shui mu zai ci ka zai na li de ke neng xing you duo da ？]

english: Yes, Let's go diving.
translation: 是的，我们去潜水吧。 [shi de ， wo men qu qian shui ba 。]

english: Well let's be...
translation: 好吧，让我们... [hao ba ， rang wo men ...]

english: Err, how do you plan on swimming with your hands full?
translation: 呃，你双手忙得不可开交，打算怎么去游泳呢？ [e ， ni shuang shou mang de bu ke kai jiao ， da suan zen me qu you yong ne ？]

english: Well, when you hit the water you will start swimming. If you can't free up your hands by putting everything away then you will sink like a stone.
translation: 好吧，当你落入水中时，你就会开始游泳。如果你不能把所有东西都收起来，解放双手，那么你就会像石头一样沉下去。 [hao ba ， dang ni luo ru shui zhong shi ， ni jiu hui kai shi you yong 。 ru guo ni bu neng ba suo you dong xi dou shou qi lai ， jie fang shuang shou ， na me ni jiu hui xiang shi tou yi yang chen xia qu 。]

english: All you have to do is have 2 spaces to store the items and you are good to go.
translation: 您所要做的就是有 2 个空间来存放物品，然后就可以出发了。 [nin suo yao zuo de jiu shi you  2  ge kong jian lai cun fang wu pin ， ran hou jiu ke yi chu fa le 。]

english: Even if you aren't carrying a shield or weapon it's always handy to have some free space for an emergency.
translation: 即使您没有携带盾牌或武器，在紧急情况下留出一些可用空间也总是很方便。 [ji shi nin mei you xie dai dun pai huo wu qi ， zai jin ji qing kuang xia liu chu yi xie ke yong kong jian ye zong shi hen fang bian 。]

english: See you then!
translation: 到时候见！ [dao shi hou jian ！]

english: Now, do you have a gomeball on you?
translation: 现在，你身上有球吗？ [xian zai ， ni shen shang you qiu ma ？]

english: Yes, I do, why do you ask?
translation: 是的，我知道，你为什么问？ [shi de ， wo zhi dao ， ni wei shen me wen ？]

english: Well you will need to leave them on the surface. They are so full of air that they will stop you diving properly.
translation: 那么你需要将它们留在表面上。它们充满了空气，会阻止你正确潜水。 [na me ni xu yao jiang ta men liu zai biao mian shang 。 ta men chong man le kong qi ， hui zu zhi ni zheng que qian shui 。]

english: Right, I'll go put it in the bank.
translation: 好的，我这就去存银行。 [hao de ， wo zhe jiu qu cun yin hang 。]

english: Now, do you have a hand egg on you?
translation: 现在，你手上有鸡蛋吗？ [xian zai ， ni shou shang you ji dan ma ？]

english: You want that cat of yours to drown or something?
translation: 你想让你的那只猫淹死还是怎么的？ [ni xiang rang ni de na zhi mao yan si hai shi zen me de ？]

english: You mean you can't make them an adorable set of tiny diving gear?
translation: 您的意思是您不能将它们制作成一套可爱的小型潜水装备？ [nin de yi si shi nin bu neng jiang ta men zhi zuo cheng yi tao ke ai de xiao xing qian shui zhuang bei ？]

english: No. Just...no.
translation: 不，只是……不。 [bu ， zhi shi …… bu 。]

english: I'm not taking you out for a dive with that cat following you.
translation: 我不会带你去潜水，那只猫跟着你。 [wo bu hui dai ni qu qian shui ， na zhi mao gen zhe ni 。]

english: I'm not a cat person, and it'd have to stay on the ship while you were down.
translation: 我不是一个爱猫的人，当你失落的时候它必须留在船上。 [wo bu shi yi ge ai mao de ren ， dang ni shi luo de shi hou ta bi xu liu zai chuan shang 。]

english: You know, I can see your cat right there.
translation: 你知道，我可以看到你的猫就在那里。 [ni zhi dao ， wo ke yi kan dao ni de mao jiu zai na li 。]

english: I'm looking right at it. See, it's just there in your bag!
translation: 我正看着它。看，它就在你的包里！ [wo zheng kan zhe ta 。 kan ， ta jiu zai ni de bao li ！]

english: I'm not taking you out with that cat. I'm not some sort of cat-sitter, so go and put it somewhere safe, then come back.
translation: 我不会带你和那只猫一起出去。我不是什么猫保姆，所以去把它放在安全的地方，然后再回来。 [wo bu hui dai ni he na zhi mao yi qi chu qu 。 wo bu shi shen me mao bao mu ， suo yi qu ba ta fang zai an quan de di fang ， ran hou zai hui lai 。]

english: O'kay...
translation: 好的... [hao de ...]

english: I still think I should get some cat-sized diving gear…
translation: 我仍然认为我应该买一些猫大小的潜水装备...... [wo reng ran ren wei wo ying gai mai yi xie mao da xiao de qian shui zhuang bei ......]

english: I'm not taking you out for a dive with that pet following you. It'll get wet.
translation: 我不会带你出去潜水，让那只宠物跟着你。它会被淋湿。 [wo bu hui dai ni chu qu qian shui ， rang na zhi chong wu gen zhe ni 。 ta hui bei lin shi 。]

english: I'm not taking you out for a dive with that pet in your bag. It'll get wet.
translation: 我不会带你带着那只宠物去潜水。它会被淋湿。 [wo bu hui dai ni dai zhe na zhi chong wu qu qian shui 。 ta hui bei lin shi 。]

english: We lost three diving parties that way!
translation: 我们就这样失去了三个跳水队！ [wo men jiu zhe yang shi qu le san ge tiao shui dui ！]

english: Ok, well I'll just put my diving helmet and diving backpack on.
translation: 好吧，我就戴上潜水头盔和潜水背包了。 [hao ba ， wo jiu dai shang qian shui tou kui he qian shui bei bao le 。]

english: Well that's the sort of spirit I like to see. However you are far too heavy to go diving right now.
translation: 嗯，这就是我喜欢看到的精神。然而，你现在太重了，无法去潜水。 [n ， zhe jiu shi wo xi huan kan dao de jing shen 。 ran er ， ni xian zai tai zhong le ， wu fa qu qian shui 。]

english: Well, I can't take you diving if you are carrying more than 27kg worth of equipment.
translation: 好吧，如果你携带的装备超过 27 公斤，我就不能带你潜水了。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni xie dai de zhuang bei chao guo  27  gong jin ， wo jiu bu neng dai ni qian shui le 。]

english: We arrived at that number through trial and error, and the errors were not pretty let me assure you.
translation: 我们通过反复试验得出了这个数字，而且我向你保证，这些错误并不完美。 [wo men tong guo fan fu shi yan de chu le zhe ge shu zi ， er qie wo xiang ni bao zheng ， zhe xie cuo wu bing bu wan mei 。]

english: So what can I do?
translation: 那我能做什么呢？ [na wo neng zuo shen me ne ？]

english: Well, if you pop over to a bank and leave all your heavy equipment behind then I'll take you out.
translation: 好吧，如果你去银行并留下所有重型设备，那么我会带你出去。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni qu yin hang bing liu xia suo you zhong xing she bei ， na me wo hui dai ni chu qu 。]

english: A brief cutscene plays of Murphy and the player standing on the trawler’s deck at sea.
translation: 墨菲和玩家站在海上拖网渔船甲板上的简短过场动画。 [mo fei he wan jia zhan zai hai shang tuo wang yu chuan jia ban shang de jian duan guo chang dong hua 。]

english: How did it go?
translation: 进展如何？ [jin zhan ru he ？]

english: Not too bad.
translation: 还不错。 [hai bu cuo 。]

english: Great, I'll take us back in.
translation: 太好了，我会带我们回去的。 [tai hao le ， wo hui dai wo men hui qu de 。]

english: The player is transported back to Port Khazard.
translation: 玩家被传送回卡扎德港。 [wan jia bei chuan song hui ka zha de gang 。]

english: The ship's ready to depart.

translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: Have you any advice to help me?
translation: 你有什么建议可以帮助我吗？ [ni you shen me jian yi ke yi bang zhu wo ma ？]

english: Go and buy teleport crystals.
translation: 去买传送水晶吧。 [qu mai chuan song shui jing ba 。]

english: Enter the Theatre without any teleport crystals.
translation: 在没有任何传送水晶的情况下进入剧院。 [zai mei you ren he chuan song shui jing de qing kuang xia jin ru ju yuan 。]

english: Very well, I'll do my best.
translation: 很好，我会尽力的。 [hen hao ， wo hui jin li de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Welcome adventurer, to the Hallowed Sepulchre. Are you here to claim some of the treasure within? It seems like the kind of activity one like you would appreciate.
translation: 欢迎冒险家，来到神圣坟墓。你来这里是为了索取里面的一些宝藏吗？这似乎是您喜欢的一种活动。 [huan ying mao xian jia ， lai dao shen sheng fen mu 。 ni lai zhe li shi wei le suo qu li mian de yi xie bao zang ma ？ zhe si hu shi nin xi huan de yi zhong huo dong 。]

english: Treasure? What treasure? And what do you mean by 'one like me'?
translation: 宝藏？什么宝物？ “像我这样的人”是什么意思？ [bao zang ？ shen me bao wu ？ “ xiang wo zhe yang de ren ” shi shen me yi si ？]

english: I mean you're not one of the inhabitants of this city. We could use someone of your talents.
translation: 我的意思是你不是这个城市的居民之一。我们可以利用像你这样有才华的人。 [wo de yi si shi ni bu shi zhe ge cheng shi de ju min zhi yi 。 wo men ke yi li yong xiang ni zhe yang you cai hua de ren 。]

english: I mean you're not one of the inhabitants of this city... although you do smell and look like one. We could use someone of your talents.
translation: 我的意思是，你不是这个城市的居民之一……尽管你闻起来、看起来都像这个城市的居民。我们可以利用像你这样有才华的人。 [wo de yi si shi ， ni bu shi zhe ge cheng shi de ju min zhi yi …… jin guan ni wen qi lai 、 kan qi lai dou xiang zhe ge cheng shi de ju min 。 wo men ke yi li yong xiang ni zhe yang you cai hua de ren 。]

english: Oh? I can't say I'm not interested. What do you propose?
translation: 哦？我不能说我不感兴趣。你有什么建议？ [o ？ wo bu neng shuo wo bu gan xing qu 。 ni you shen me jian yi ？]

english: This place was built long before the city of Darkmeyer existed, back when this land was known as Hallowvale.
translation: 这个地方早在达克梅尔城存在之前就已建成，当时这片土地还被称为万圣节谷。 [zhe ge di fang zao zai da ke mei er cheng cun zai zhi qian jiu yi jian cheng ， dang shi zhe pian tu di hai bei cheng wei wan sheng jie gu 。]

english: The Sepulchre was used as a resting place for Hallowvale's loyal followers of Saradomin.
translation: 坟墓被用作万圣节谷萨拉多明忠实追随者的安息之地。 [fen mu bei yong zuo wan sheng jie gu sa la duo ming zhong shi zhui sui zhe de an xi zhi di 。]

english: Before they were driven out by the vampyres, the Saradominists used their magic to safeguard this place.
translation: 在被吸血鬼赶走之前，萨拉多米尼派用他们的魔法保卫了这个地方。 [zai bei xi xue gui gan zou zhi qian ， sa la duo mi ni pai yong ta men de mo fa bao wei le zhe ge di fang 。]

english: Safeguard how?
translation: 怎么保障？ [zen me bao zhang ？]

english: The dead here were buried with the wealth they had in life. To protect these riches, the Saradominists enchanted the statues within the Sepulchre to create various defences.
translation: 这里的死者与生前拥有的财富一起埋葬。为了保护这些财富，萨拉多米主义者对坟墓内的雕像施了魔法，以建立各种防御设施。 [zhe li de si zhe yu sheng qian yong you de cai fu yi qi mai zang 。 wei le bao hu zhe xie cai fu ， sa la duo mi zhu yi zhe dui fen mu nei de diao xiang shi le mo fa ， yi jian li ge zhong fang yu she shi 。]

english: Many have tried and failed to obtain the prizes buried here.
translation: 许多人试图获得埋藏在这里的奖品，但都失败了。 [xu duo ren shi tu huo de mai cang zai zhe li de jiang pin ， dan dou shi bai le 。]

english: Okay... So I presume you want me to get some of this treasure for you? How should I go about doing it?
translation: 好吧……所以我想你希望我为你拿一些宝藏？我应该怎样去做呢？ [hao ba …… suo yi wo xiang ni xi wang wo wei ni na yi xie bao zang ？ wo ying gai zen yang qu zuo ne ？]

english: We don't care for a lot of what is kept here. We are only interested in the old currency of this land.
translation: 我们不关心这里保存的很多东西。我们只对这片土地上的旧货币感兴趣。 [wo men bu guan xin zhe li bao cun de hen duo dong xi 。 wo men zhi dui zhe pian tu di shang de jiu huo bi gan xing qu 。]

english: The mysterious stranger pulls a coin out of his pocket and shows it to you.
translation: 神秘的陌生人从口袋里掏出一枚硬币给你看。 [shen mi de mo sheng ren cong kou dai li tao chu yi mei ying bi gei ni kan 。]

english: If you find any of these Hallowed marks, I'd be willing to take them off your hands. In exchange, I can provide tools that can help you within the Hallowed Sepulchre.
translation: 如果你找到任何这些神圣标记，我愿意把它们从你手上拿下来。作为交换，我可以提供可以在圣墓中为你提供帮助的工具。 [ru guo ni zhao dao ren he zhe xie shen sheng biao ji ， wo yuan yi ba ta men cong ni shou shang na xia lai 。 zuo wei jiao huan ， wo ke yi ti gong ke yi zai sheng mu zhong wei ni ti gong bang zhu de gong ju 。]

english: You can keep whatever else you find for yourself.
translation: 您可以保留您自己找到的任何其他东西。 [nin ke yi bao liu nin zi ji zhao dao de ren he qi ta dong xi 。]

english: You should know, only the most agile of adventurers will have success down there. You'll need to use your reflexes to overcome the traps within.
translation: 要知道，只有最敏捷的冒险家才能在那里取得成功。你需要运用你的反应能力来克服其中的陷阱。 [yao zhi dao ， zhi you zui min jie de mao xian jia cai neng zai na li qu de cheng gong 。 ni xu yao yun yong ni de fan ying neng li lai ke fu qi zhong de xian jing 。]

english: The Sepulchre has five floors in total, each more dangerous than the last. I hope you prove competent enough to make it all the way down.
translation: 坟墓共有五层，一层比一层危险。我希望你能证明自己有足够的能力一路走下去。 [fen mu gong you wu ceng ， yi ceng bi yi ceng wei xian 。 wo xi wang ni neng zheng ming zi ji you zu gou de neng li yi lu zou xia qu 。]

english: Do you have any information about what kind of traps I can expect?
translation: 你知道我会遇到什么样的陷阱吗？ [ni zhi dao wo hui yu dao shen me yang de xian jing ma ？]

english: The statues have been enchanted to shoot fire, lightning and arrows. Some also throw swords. There are also tiles that when stepped on, will teleport you somewhere else.
translation: 这些雕像被施了魔法，可以发射火焰、闪电和箭。有的还投掷剑。还有一些瓷砖，当你踩到这些瓷砖时，会将你传送到其他地方。 [zhe xie diao xiang bei shi le mo fa ， ke yi fa she huo yan 、 shan dian he jian 。 you de hai tou zhi jian 。 hai you yi xie ci zhuan ， dang ni cai dao zhe xie ci zhuan shi ， hui jiang ni chuan song dao qi ta di fang 。]

english: Sounds like the perfect challenge for me! Is there anything else I should know?
translation: 听起来对我来说是完美的挑战！还有什么我应该知道的吗？ [ting qi lai dui wo lai shuo shi wan mei de tiao zhan ！ hai you shen me wo ying gai zhi dao de ma ？]

english: Yes... It seems that there is another safeguard which prevents anyone from spending too long within the Sepulchre.
translation: 是的……似乎还有另一种防护措施可以防止任何人在坟墓内停留太久。 [shi de …… si hu hai you ling yi zhong fang hu cuo shi ke yi fang zhi ren he ren zai fen mu nei ting liu tai jiu 。]

english: You'll only have so much time before the magic within seals both the coffins and the stairs leading to the next floor.
translation: 在里面的魔法密封棺材和通往下一层的楼梯之前，你只有这么多时间。 [zai li mian de mo fa mi feng guan cai he tong wang xia yi ceng de lou ti zhi qian ， ni zhi you zhe me duo shi jian 。]

english: Hang on a second... If the doors to the next floor close, then how will I escape?
translation: 等一下……如果下一层的门关上了，我该怎么逃？ [deng yi xia …… ru guo xia yi ceng de men guan shang le ， wo gai zen me tao ？]

english: The priests who built this place had a teleportation system. The magical obelisks they used can be found at the end of each floor. These obelisks can be used to transport you back here.
translation: 建造这个地方的祭司拥有传送系统。他们使用的魔法方尖碑可以在每层楼的尽头找到。这些方尖碑可以用来带你回到这里。 [jian zao zhe ge di fang de ji si yong you chuan song xi tong 。 ta men shi yong de mo fa fang jian bei ke yi zai mei ceng lou de jin tou zhao dao 。 zhe xie fang jian bei ke yi yong lai dai ni hui dao zhe li 。]

english: However, we have found that the obelisks only respond to those they perceive to be followers of Saradomin. I'd strongly advise against wearing items of any other god.
translation: 然而，我们发现方尖碑只对那些被它们认为是萨拉多明追随者的人做出反应。我强烈建议不要佩戴任何其他神的物品。 [ran er ， wo men fa xian fang jian bei zhi dui na xie bei ta men ren wei shi sa la duo ming zhui sui zhe de ren zuo chu fan ying 。 wo qiang lie jian yi bu yao pei dai ren he qi ta shen de wu pin 。]

english: I see, but what if I'm in the middle of a floor and can't make it to an obelisk?
translation: 我明白了，但是如果我在楼层中间而无法到达方尖碑怎么办？ [wo ming bai le ， dan shi ru guo wo zai lou ceng zhong jian er wu fa dao da fang jian bei zen me ban ？]

english: I see you are cautious adventurer. That is wise. You can use any teleport spell to escape from the Hallowed Sepulchre. However, you may also find these of use.
translation: 我看出你是个谨慎的冒险家。这是明智的。你可以使用任何传送法术逃离神圣坟墓。但是，您可能也会发现这些有用。 [wo kan chu ni shi ge jin shen de mao xian jia 。 zhe shi ming zhi de 。 ni ke yi shi yong ren he chuan song fa shu tao li shen sheng fen mu 。 dan shi ， nin ke neng ye hui fa xian zhe xie you yong 。]

english: These teleport crystals were enchanted using the magic of the obelisks. They can be used to teleport to this lobby. I can sell you more when you run out.
translation: 这些传送水晶被方尖碑的魔法所附魔。它们可以用来传送到这个大厅。当你用完的时候我可以卖给你更多。 [zhe xie chuan song shui jing bei fang jian bei de mo fa suo fu mo 。 ta men ke yi yong lai chuan song dao zhe ge da ting 。 dang ni yong wan de shi hou wo ke yi mai gei ni geng duo 。]

english: Thanks! I'll make sure to put them to good use.
translation: 谢谢！我一定会好好利用它们。 [xie xie ！ wo yi ding hui hao hao li yong ta men 。]

english: Thanks for the information. I'll keep an eye out for some of those Hallowed marks.
translation: 感谢您提供信息。我会留意其中一些神圣标记。 [gan xie nin ti gong xin xi 。 wo hui liu yi qi zhong yi xie shen sheng biao ji 。]

english: That would be... appreciated.
translation: 那将是……不胜感激。 [na jiang shi …… bu sheng gan ji 。]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: Like you, I am not from here. I represent a group who are very interested in the Hallowed marks found within the Hallowed Sepulchre.
translation: 和你一样，我也不是这里人。我代表一群对圣墓内发现的神圣标记非常感兴趣的人。 [he ni yi yang ， wo ye bu shi zhe li ren 。 wo dai biao yi qun dui sheng mu nei fa xian de shen sheng biao ji fei chang gan xing qu de ren 。]

english: You know, I helped out a very similar individual to yourself over at the Theatre of Blood. Any connection?
translation: 你知道，我在血腥剧院帮助了一个与你非常相似的人。有什么联系吗？ [ni zhi dao ， wo zai xue xing ju yuan bang zhu le yi ge yu ni fei chang xiang si de ren 。 you shen me lian xi ma ？]

english: So you're the one who the master spoke of. I am aware of your contributions. Helping us out here will earn yourself further favour with him.
translation: 原来你就是师父所说的那个人啊。我知道你的贡献。在这里帮助我们将为你赢得他的进一步好感。 [yuan lai ni jiu shi shi fu suo shuo de na ge ren a 。 wo zhi dao ni de gong xian 。 zai zhe li bang zhu wo men jiang wei ni ying de ta de jin yi bu hao gan 。]

english: How do I know that's something I even want?
translation: 我怎么知道这是我想要的东西？ [wo zen me zhi dao zhe shi wo xiang yao de dong xi ？]

english: That is for you to decide. I have told you all that I have to share.
translation: 这由你决定。我已经告诉了你们我必须分享的一切。 [zhe you ni jue ding 。 wo yi jing gao su le ni men wo bi xu fen xiang de yi qie 。]

english: That is all you need to know.
translation: 这就是您需要知道的全部。 [zhe jiu shi nin xu yao zhi dao de quan bu 。]

english: All right then, keep your secrets.
translation: 好吧，保守你的秘密。 [hao ba ， bao shou ni de mi mi 。]

english: I'd like to trade in some Hallowed marks.
translation: 我想用一些神圣标记进行交易。 [wo xiang yong yi xie shen sheng biao ji jin xing jiao yi 。]

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: Do you have any of my items?
translation: 你有我的物品吗？ [ni you wo de wu pin ma ？]

english: I do not. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: 我不知道。如果我确实拥有你的任何物品，但你在收集它们之前就死了，那么它们现在就会丢失。 [wo bu zhi dao 。 ru guo wo que shi yong you ni de ren he wu pin ， dan ni zai shou ji ta men zhi qian jiu si le ， na me ta men xian zai jiu hui diu shi 。]

english: I do have some of your items here. Try not to get hit by the traps next time.
translation: 我这里确实有你的一些物品。下次尽量不要被陷阱击中。 [wo zhe li que shi you ni de yi xie wu pin 。 xia ci jin liang bu yao bei xian jing ji zhong 。]

english: I'd like to access your tool storage.
translation: 我想访问您的工具存储空间。 [wo xiang fang wen nin de gong ju cun chu kong jian 。]

english: Is there any way I could have private access to the Sepulchre? The other adventurers in there keep activating traps and messing up my timing.
translation: 有什么办法可以让我私人进入坟墓吗？那里的其他冒险者不断激活陷阱并扰乱我的时机。 [you shen me ban fa ke yi rang wo si ren jin ru fen mu ma ？ na li de qi ta mao xian zhe bu duan ji huo xian jing bing rao luan wo de shi ji 。]

english: An interesting problem. But... I suppose I could grant you private access to the Hallowed Sepulchre... for a fee.
translation: 一个有趣的问题。但是……我想我可以授予你私人进入圣墓的权限……但需付费。 [yi ge you qu de wen ti 。 dan shi …… wo xiang wo ke yi shou yu ni si ren jin ru sheng mu de quan xian …… dan xu fu fei 。]

english: How much?
translation: 多少？ [duo shao ？]

english: 200 Hallowed marks.
translation: 200 神圣标记。 [200  shen sheng biao ji 。]

english: I don't have that many marks on me...
translation: 我身上没有那么多印记 [wo shen shang mei you na me duo yin ji]

english: Then I'm afraid that, for now, you will have to contend with your peers activating traps for you.
translation: 那么恐怕现在你就得和同伴为你启动陷阱而抗衡了。 [na me kong pa xian zai ni jiu de he tong ban wei ni qi dong xian jing er kang heng le 。]

english: Very well. You should now find that when you enter the Hallowed Sepulchre, you will end up in different chambers to your peers.
translation: 很好。你现在应该发现，当你进入神圣坟墓时，你最终会进入与你的同伴不同的房间。 [hen hao 。 ni xian zai ying gai fa xian ， dang ni jin ru shen sheng fen mu shi ， ni zui zhong hui jin ru yu ni de tong ban bu tong de fang jian 。]

english: Speak to me again if you like this effect rescinded.
translation: 如果您希望取消此效果，请再次与我联系。 [ru guo nin xi wang qu xiao ci xiao guo ， qing zai ci yu wo lian xi 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Very well. I shall be here if you change your mind.
translation: 很好。如果你改变主意我会在这里。 [hen hao 。 ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi wo hui zai zhe li 。]

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: I see you're still alive adventurer. Do you have any Hallowed marks for me?
translation: 我看到你还活着，冒险家。你有什么神圣标记要给我吗？ [wo kan dao ni hai huo zhe ， mao xian jia 。 ni you shen me shen sheng biao ji yao gei wo ma ？]

english: Tell me more about this place.
translation: 告诉我更多关于这个地方的信息。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu zhe ge di fang de xin xi 。]

english: Is there anything else you need?
translation: 您还需要什么吗？ [nin hai xu yao shen me ma ？]

english: Can I go back to looting with other people?
translation: 我可以回去和其他人一起抢劫吗？ [wo ke yi hui qu he qi ta ren yi qi qiang jie ma ？]

english: I can remove your private access for now, if you're sure.
translation: 如果您确定的话，我可以暂时删除您的私人访问权限。 [ru guo nin que ding de hua ， wo ke yi zan shi shan chu nin de si ren fang wen quan xian 。]

english: Very well. You should now find that when you enter the Hallowed Sepulchre, your peers will join you.
translation: 很好。你现在应该发现，当你进入神圣坟墓时，你的同伴会加入你。 [hen hao 。 ni xian zai ying gai fa xian ， dang ni jin ru shen sheng fen mu shi ， ni de tong ban hui jia ru ni 。]

english: Speak to me again if you would like this effect restored.
translation: 如果您希望恢复此效果，请再次与我联系。 [ru guo nin xi wang hui fu ci xiao guo ， qing zai ci yu wo lian xi 。]

english: On second thoughts, I've changed my mind.
translation: 转念一想，我改变了主意。 [zhuan nian yi xiang ， wo gai bian le zhu yi 。]

english: Can I go back to looting on my own?
translation: 我可以自己回去抢劫吗？ [wo ke yi zi ji hui qu qiang jie ma ？]

english: I can restore your private access for you, if you're sure.
translation: 如果您确定的话，我可以为您恢复私人访问权限。 [ru guo nin que ding de hua ， wo ke yi wei nin hui fu si ren fang wen quan xian 。]

english: Sorry, I need to go.
translation: 抱歉，我得走了。 [bao qian ， wo de zou le 。]

english: I do not have anything for you. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: 我没有什么可以给你的。如果我确实拥有你的任何物品，但你在收集它们之前就死了，那么它们现在就会丢失。 [wo mei you shen me ke yi gei ni de 。 ru guo wo que shi yong you ni de ren he wu pin ， dan ni zai shou ji ta men zhi qian jiu si le ， na me ta men xian zai jiu hui diu shi 。]

english: I have some of your things. You should come get them before you enter the Hallowed Sepulchre.
translation: 我有一些你的东西。你应该在进入圣墓之前来获取它们。 [wo you yi xie ni de dong xi 。 ni ying gai zai jin ru sheng mu zhi qian lai huo qu ta men 。]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: I'd like to trade in some Hallowed marks.
translation: 我想用一些神圣标记进行交易。 [wo xiang yong yi xie shen sheng biao ji jin xing jiao yi 。]

english: Do you have any of my items?
translation: 你有我的物品吗？ [ni you wo de wu pin ma ？]

english: I'd like to access your tool storage.
translation: 我想访问您的工具存储空间。 [wo xiang fang wen nin de gong ju cun chu kong jian 。]

english: Ask about private access.
translation: 询问私人访问。 [xun wen si ren fang wen 。]

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: Tell me more about this place.
translation: 告诉我更多关于这个地方的信息。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu zhe ge di fang de xin xi 。]

english: More options...
translation: 更多选择... [geng duo xuan ze ...]

english: Previous options...
translation: 之前的选项... [zhi qian de xuan xiang ...]

english: Sorry, I need to go.
translation: 抱歉，我得走了。 [bao qian ， wo de zou le 。]

english: What was I talking about, now?
translation: 我现在在说什么？ [wo xian zai zai shuo shen me ？]

english: Weren't you going to tell me about the rumour?
translation: 你不打算告诉我这个传闻吗？ [ni bu da suan gao su wo zhe ge chuan wen ma ？]

english: Oh yeah, that was it!
translation: 哦，是的，就是这样！ [o ， shi de ， jiu shi zhe yang ！]

english: Carry on.
translation: 继续。 [ji xu 。]

translation: 这不是我打算提供给人类的信息。 [zhe bu shi wo da suan ti gong gei ren lei de xin xi 。]

translation: 为什么？ [wei shen me ？]

english: Because before the Varlamorians decided to open their lands up to visitors, Cam Torum was the sole supplier of runes to the entire region.
translation: 因为在瓦拉莫里安人决定向游客开放他们的土地之前，卡姆托鲁姆是整个地区唯一的符文供应商。 [yin wei zai wa la mo li an ren jue ding xiang you ke kai fang ta men de tu di zhi qian ， ka mu tuo lu mu shi zheng ge di qu wei yi de fu wen gong ying shang 。]

english: Okay... But that's not the case anymore. With the kingdom open, they can just get their runes from the mainland.
translation: 好吧……但现在情况不再是这样了。王国开放后，他们就可以从大陆获取符文。 [hao ba …… dan xian zai qing kuang bu zai shi zhe yang le 。 wang guo kai fang hou ， ta men jiu ke yi cong da lu huo qu fu wen 。]

english: A fact I'm all too aware of, especially given the impact it is having on my prices.
translation: 我非常清楚这一事实，特别是考虑到它对我的价格的影响。 [wo fei chang qing chu zhe yi shi shi ， te bie shi kao lv dao ta dui wo de jia ge de ying xiang 。]

english: Nevertheless, there is still a benefit to having a source of runes closer to home, and I do not intend to share any information on that source.
translation: 尽管如此，拥有离家较近的符文来源仍然有好处，而且我不打算分享有关该来源的任何信息。 [jin guan ru ci ， yong you li jia jiao jin de fu wen lai yuan reng ran you hao chu ， er qie wo bu da suan fen xiang you guan gai lai yuan de ren he xin xi 。]

translation: 很公平。 [hen gong ping 。]

english: Now, are you in need of some runes?

translation: 你表现出了人类典型的傲慢。我是卡姆托鲁姆的矮人。我的人民同样掌握了锻造和魔法。 [ni biao xian chu le ren lei dian xing de ao man 。 wo shi ka mu tuo lu mu de ai ren 。 wo de ren min tong yang zhang wo le duan zao he mo fa 。]

english: That little trinket of yours may well work wonders on a lesser mind, but you will find it to be of little use here.
translation: 你的那个小饰品可能会对一个不那么聪明的人产生奇迹，但你会发现它在这里没什么用处。 [ni de na ge xiao shi pin ke neng hui dui yi ge bu na me cong ming de ren chan sheng qi ji ， dan ni hui fa xian ta zai zhe li mei shen me yong chu 。]

No thanks.

english: What is this place?

english: This is a branch of the Bank of Gielinor. We have branches in many towns.
translation: 这是吉林诺银行的一个分行。我们在很多城镇都有分店。 [zhe shi ji lin nuo yin hang de yi ge fen hang 。 wo men zai hen duo cheng zhen dou you fen dian 。]

english: And what do you do?
translation: 你做什么？ [ni zuo shen me ？]

english: We will look after your items and money for you. Leave your valuables with us if you want to keep them safe.
translation: 我们将为您保管您的物品和金钱。如果您想保证贵重物品的安全，请将其交给我们。 [wo men jiang wei nin bao guan nin de wu pin he jin qian 。 ru guo nin xiang bao zheng gui zhong wu pin de an quan ， qing jiang qi jiao gei wo men 。]

translation: 我想检查我的 PIN 设置。 [wo xiang jian cha wo de  PIN  she zhi 。]

english: I'd like to collect items.

english: What is this place?

english: Psst... wanna buy some weapons?
translation: 嘘……想买一些武器吗？ [xu …… xiang mai yi xie wu qi ma ？]

english: What have you got?
translation: 你有什么？ [ni you shen me ？]

english: Well, first up there's the normal bone club and bone spear. Good, solid frog-bone, and the spear has an iron tip. Can withstand a lot of punishment, if you know what I mean!
translation: 嗯，首先是普通的骨棍和骨矛。青蛙骨很好，很坚固，矛尖是铁的。可以承受很多惩罚，如果你明白我的意思的话！ [n ， shou xian shi pu tong de gu gun he gu mao 。 qing wa gu hen hao ， hen jian gu ， mao jian shi tie de 。 ke yi cheng shou hen duo cheng fa ， ru guo ni ming bai wo de yi si de hua ！]

english: But if you're after something a bit fancier, a bit more sophisticated, there's the bone crossbow and dagger.
translation: 但如果你想要一些更奇特、更复杂的东西，骨十字弓和匕首是不错的选择。 [dan ru guo ni xiang yao yi xie geng qi te 、 geng fu za de dong xi ， gu shi zi gong he bi shou shi bu cuo de xuan ze 。]

english: These are specially good for getting your prey unawares, but you're not going to get the best out of them unless you've been taught the special technique.
translation: 这些特别适合让你的猎物措手不及，但除非你学会了特殊的技术，否则你无法充分利用它们。 [zhe xie te bie shi he rang ni de lie wu cuo shou bu ji ， dan chu fei ni xue hui le te shu de ji shu ， fou ze ni wu fa chong fen li yong ta men 。]

english: So, you interested?
translation: 那么，你有兴趣吗？ [na me ， ni you xing qu ma ？]

english: I might be.
translation: 我可能是。 [wo ke neng shi 。]

english: What is this special technique?
translation: 这是什么特殊技术？ [zhe shi shen me te shu ji shu ？]

english: Special aiming technique. If you hit an enemy with it their defence will get weaker so you can hit them again!
translation: 特殊的瞄准技术。如果你用它击中敌人，他们的防御会变弱，所以你可以再次击中他们！ [te shu de miao zhun ji shu 。 ru guo ni yong ta ji zhong di ren ， ta men de fang yu hui bian ruo ， suo yi ni ke yi zai ci ji zhong ta men ！]

english: Plus, if you use this technique on an enemy who isn't expecting it, you'll always hit them! Pretty good, eh?
translation: 另外，如果你对出乎意料的敌人使用这种技术，你总是会击中他们！相当不错，是吗？ [ling wai ， ru guo ni dui chu hu yi liao de di ren shi yong zhe zhong ji shu ， ni zong shi hui ji zhong ta men ！ xiang dang bu cuo ， shi ma ？]

english: 'Course, there's only a few people who know it, so unless you can get someone to show you you won't be able to do it.
translation: 当然，只有少数人知道，所以除非你能找到人来告诉你，否则你将无法做到。 [dang ran ， zhi you shao shu ren zhi dao ， suo yi chu fei ni neng zhao dao ren lai gao su ni ， fou ze ni jiang wu fa zuo dao 。]

english: Zanik showed me how to do it!
translation: 扎尼克向我展示了如何做到这一点！ [zha ni ke xiang wo zhan shi le ru he zuo dao zhe yi dian ！]

english: Good for you! So, are you interested?
translation: 对你有好处！那么，你有兴趣吗？ [dui ni you hao chu ！ na me ， ni you xing qu ma ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Yeah, you stay out of trouble.
translation: 是的，你远离麻烦。 [shi de ， ni yuan li ma fan 。]

english: Well, y'know, it's not the most reputable profession, is it? Selling weapons?

english: Why not?
translation: 为什么不呢？ [wei shen me bu ne ？]

english: Well, they're used to hurt people, aren't they? That's not considered very, y'know, respectable. Even though the guards use them, and the hunters, they're still considered a bit, y'know, dirty.
translation: 好吧，他们习惯了伤害人，不是吗？你知道，这不被认为是非常值得尊敬的。尽管守卫和猎人都使用它们，但他们仍然被认为有点，你知道，肮脏。 [hao ba ， ta men xi guan le shang hai ren ， bu shi ma ？ ni zhi dao ， zhe bu bei ren wei shi fei chang zhi de zun jing de 。 jin guan shou wei he lie ren dou shi yong ta men ， dan ta men reng ran bei ren wei you dian ， ni zhi dao ， ang zang 。]

translation: 不，从表面上看，制造武器被认为是一个崇高的职业。 [bu ， cong biao mian shang kan ， zhi zao wu qi bei ren wei shi yi ge chong gao de zhi ye 。]

translation: 好一个！我有新信息要与您分享。 [hao yi ge ！ wo you xin xin xi yao yu nin fen xiang 。]

english: Yes?
translation: 是的？ [shi de ？]

english: What are you doing out here?
translation: 你在这儿做什么？ [ni zai zhe er zuo shen me ？]

english: Sometimes I like to take a walk out to these shores and look for losers to laugh at.
translation: 有时我喜欢到这些海岸散步，寻找可以嘲笑的失败者。 [you shi wo xi huan dao zhe xie hai an san bu ， xun zhao ke yi chao xiao de shi bai zhe 。]

english: And look, I found one!
translation: 看，我找到了一个！ [kan ， wo zhao dao le yi ge ！]

english: Hahahah!
translation: 哈哈哈！ [ha ha ha ！]

english: Charming.
translation: 迷人。 [mi ren 。]

translation: 你对我有任务吗？ [ni dui wo you ren wu ma ？]

english: Why, yes! I do have a quest for you! I've hidden some goodies around Varlamore! Haha!
translation: 为什么，是的！我确实有一个任务要找你！我在瓦拉莫尔周围藏了一些好东西！哈哈！ [wei shen me ， shi de ！ wo que shi you yi ge ren wu yao zhao ni ！ wo zai wa la mo er zhou wei cang le yi xie hao dong xi ！ ha ha ！]

english: Bring them all to me and I'll give you a nasty little surprise!
translation: 把它们全部带给我，我会给你一个令人讨厌的小惊喜！ [ba ta men quan bu dai gei wo ， wo hui gei ni yi ge ling ren tao yan de xiao jing xi ！]

english: A treasure hunt? That's exciting! Any tips to get me started?
translation: 寻宝？太令人兴奋了！有什么建议可以帮助我开始吗？ [xun bao ？ tai ling ren xing fen le ！ you shen me jian yi ke yi bang zhu wo kai shi ma ？]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Oh... I guess I'll be on my way then.
translation: 哦...我想我就上路了。 [o ... wo xiang wo jiu shang lu le 。]

english: I've found some strange tokens.
translation: 我发现了一些奇怪的标记。 [wo fa xian le yi xie qi guai de biao ji 。]

english: Oh, really? Show me.
translation: 哦真的吗？给我看看。 [o zhen de ma ？ gei wo kan kan 。]

translation: 你这个大傻瓜！你没能获得我想要的所有代币！现在赶紧离开这里吧，失败者！ [ni zhe ge da sha gua ！ ni mei neng huo de wo xiang yao de suo you dai bi ！ xian zai gan jin li kai zhe li ba ， shi bai zhe ！]

english: Would you like to trade them for a nasty little suprise? I bet you would, wouldn't you?!
translation: 你想用它们换取一个令人讨厌的小惊喜吗？我打赌你会的，不是吗？ [ni xiang yong ta men huan qu yi ge ling ren tao yan de xiao jing xi ma ？ wo da du ni hui de ， bu shi ma ？]

english: No, actually.
translation: 不，实际上。 [bu ， shi ji shang 。]

What? I don't want that.

translation: 嘿。你见过弗兰克吗？ [hei 。 ni jian guo fu lan ke ma ？]

english: Frank?
translation: 坦率？ [tan shuai ？]

english: Yes, Frank. He's my pet bloodveld. He runs off a lot so I was wondering if you'd seen him.
translation: 是的，弗兰克。他是我的宠物血域。他经常逃跑，所以我想知道你是否见过他。 [shi de ， fu lan ke 。 ta shi wo de chong wu xue yu 。 ta jing chang tao pao ， suo yi wo xiang zhi dao ni shi fou jian guo ta 。]

english: Frank doesn't seem like a very fitting name for a bloodveld.
translation: 弗兰克对于血原来说似乎不是一个非常合适的名字。 [fu lan ke dui yu xue yuan lai shuo si hu bu shi yi ge fei chang he shi de ming zi 。]

english: Oh, he was named after my last pet. That one wasn't a bloodveld though, that one was a human.
translation: 哦，他是以我最后一只宠物的名字命名的。不过那不是血原，那是人类。 [o ， ta shi yi wo zui hou yi zhi chong wu de ming zi ming ming de 。 bu guo na bu shi xue yuan ， na shi ren lei 。]

english: You had a pet human?
translation: 你养过人类宠物吗？ [ni yang guo ren lei chong wu ma ？]

english: Yes! A pet human called Frank.
translation: 是的！一个名叫弗兰克的人类宠物。 [shi de ！ yi ge ming jiao fu lan ke de ren lei chong wu 。]

english: Frank was great. He died though. Mother said it was my fault, that I didn't feed him properly. I'm not allowed pet humans now.
translation: 弗兰克很棒。但他还是死了。妈妈说是我的错，是我没有好好喂养他。我现在不允许养宠物了。 [fu lan ke hen bang 。 dan ta hai shi si le 。 ma ma shuo shi wo de cuo ， shi wo mei you hao hao wei yang ta 。 wo xian zai bu yun xu yang chong wu le 。]

english: It's okay though. Now I have Frank the bloodveld. He's great. I don't need to feed him. He feeds himself.
translation: 不过没关系。现在我有了血原弗兰克。他很棒。我不需要喂他。他自己吃饭。 [bu guo mei guan xi 。 xian zai wo you le xue yuan fu lan ke 。 ta hen bang 。 wo bu xu yao wei ta 。 ta zi ji chi fan 。]

english: What a nice happy ending.
translation: 多么美好的幸福结局啊。 [duo me mei hao de xing fu jie ju a 。]

english: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 人类！在我叫守卫之前回到奴隶围栏！ [ren lei ！ zai wo jiao shou wei zhi qian hui dao nu li wei lan ！]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Hello! You must be the adventurer that helped us get out of Menaphos. Thank you.
translation: 你好！你一定就是帮助我们逃离梅纳福斯的冒险家。谢谢。 [ni hao ！ ni yi ding jiu shi bang zhu wo men tao li mei na fu si de mao xian jia 。 xie xie 。]

english: Don't mention it.
translation: 别提了。 [bie ti le 。]

english: What do you have for sale?
translation: 你有什么待售？ [ni you shen me dai shou ？]

english: Take a look.
translation: 看看吧。 [kan kan ba 。]

english: What were things like in Menaphos?
translation: 米纳福斯 的情况怎么样？ [mi na fu si   de qing kuang zen me yang ？]

english: Not great. I'd just gone over there to purchase some goods from the market. When I got back to the gates, they'd been sealed shut.
translation: 不太好。我刚刚去那里从市场上购买一些商品。当我回到大门时，大门已经被封锁了。 [bu tai hao 。 wo gang gang qu na li cong shi chang shang gou mai yi xie shang pin 。 dang wo hui dao da men shi ， da men yi jing bei feng suo le 。]

english: So the guards wouldn't let you back?
translation: 那么看守就不让你回去了？ [na me kan shou jiu bu rang ni hui qu le ？]

english: They were still allowing citizens from Sophanem to return at that point, but I foolishly chose to stay. I was scared of catching the pox.
translation: 当时他们仍然允许索法纳姆的公民返回，但我愚蠢地选择留下来。我害怕染上水痘。 [dang shi ta men reng ran yun xu suo fa na mu de gong min fan hui ， dan wo yu chun di xuan ze liu xia lai 。 wo hai pa ran shang shui dou 。]

english: By the time I'd changed my mind, they'd stopped letting anyone through. Thankfully, I had some friends there with a spare bed.
translation: 当我改变主意时，他们已经不再让任何人通过了。值得庆幸的是，我有一些朋友在那里有一张空床。 [dang wo gai bian zhu yi shi ， ta men yi jing bu zai rang ren he ren tong guo le 。 zhi de qing xing de shi ， wo you yi xie peng you zai na li you yi zhang kong chuang 。]

english: I guess not everyone was as lucky?
translation: 我想不是每个人都那么幸运吧？ [wo xiang bu shi mei ge ren dou na me xing yun ba ？]

english: No. Many didn't have anywhere to go. Violence broke out in some parts of the city.
translation: 不，许多人无处可去。该市部分地区爆发暴力事件。 [bu ， xu duo ren wu chu ke qu 。 gai shi bu fen di qu bao fa bao li shi jian 。]

english: They quickly put a stop to it in the Imperial and Merchant quarters, but there was still some unrest in the Workers district when I was finally able to leave.
translation: 他们很快就在帝国区和商人区制止了这一切，但当我终于能够离开时，工人区仍然发生了一些骚乱。 [ta men hen kuai jiu zai di guo qu he shang ren qu zhi zhi le zhe yi qie ， dan dang wo zhong yu neng gou li kai shi ， gong ren qu reng ran fa sheng le yi xie sao luan 。]

english: I'm sorry you had go through all of that. Menaphos definitely took a hard stance on the plagues.
translation: 我很抱歉你经历了这一切。梅纳福斯对瘟疫采取了强硬立场。 [wo hen bao qian ni jing li le zhe yi qie 。 mei na fu si dui wen yi cai qu le qiang ying li chang 。]

english: They were brutal. They even shut off the port from the rest of the city over fears of the plague getting in that way. Many of their own citizens are still trapped there.
translation: 他们很残酷。由于担心瘟疫蔓延，他们甚至关闭了港口与城市其他地方的联系。他们的许多公民仍然被困在那里。 [ta men hen can ku 。 you yu dan xin wen yi man yan ， ta men shen zhi guan bi le gang kou yu cheng shi qi ta di fang de lian xi 。 ta men de xu duo gong min reng ran bei kun zai na li 。]

english: Anyway, let's not talk any more of this. Is there anything else I can do for you.
translation: 无论如何，我们不要再谈论这个了。还有什么我可以为您做的吗？ [wu lun ru he ， wo men bu yao zai tan lun zhe ge le 。 hai you shen me wo ke yi wei nin zuo de ma ？]

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: Until next time.
translation: 直到下次。 [zhi dao xia ci 。]

english: Hello again! It's so nice to be out of Menaphos. Once again, thank you.
translation: 又好！离开梅纳福斯真是太好了。再次感谢您。 [you hao ！ li kai mei na fu si zhen shi tai hao le 。 zai ci gan xie nin 。]

english: What do you have for sale?
translation: 你有什么待售？ [ni you shen me dai shou ？]

english: What were things like in Menaphos?
translation: 米纳福斯 的情况怎么样？ [mi na fu si   de qing kuang zen me yang ？]

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: I've lost my notes... Dufft, have you seen my notes?
translation: 我的笔记丢了……达夫特，你看到我的笔记了吗？ [wo de bi ji diu le …… da fu te ， ni kan dao wo de bi ji le ma ？]

english: My wife will kill me if I don't take her back a souvenir.
translation: 如果我不给我妻子带回纪念品，她就会杀了我。 [ru guo wo bu gei wo qi zi dai hui ji nian pin ， ta jiu hui sha le wo 。]

english: I've had such a terrible headache since we arrived on this mountain.
translation: 自从我们到达这座山以来，我就头痛得厉害。 [zi cong wo men dao da zhe zuo shan yi lai ， wo jiu tou tong de li hai 。]

english: Thank Saradomin for that mountain guide. We couldn't have made it here without him!
translation: 感谢萨拉多明提供的登山向导。没有他我们不可能到达这里！ [gan xie sa la duo ming ti gong de deng shan xiang dao 。 mei you ta wo men bu ke neng dao da zhe li ！]

english: I can't find my rock pick!
translation: 我找不到我的摇滚拨片！ [wo zhao bu dao wo de yao gun bo pian ！]

english: Hello there and welcome to the Natural History exhibit of the Varrock Museum!
translation: 您好，欢迎来到瓦罗克博物馆的自然历史展览！ [nin hao ， huan ying lai dao wa luo ke bo wu guan de zi ran li shi zhan lan ！]

english: Hello. So what is it you do here?
translation: 你好。那么你在这里做什么？ [ni hao 。 na me ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Well, we look after all of the research in this section.
translation: 好吧，我们负责本节的所有研究。 [hao ba ， wo men fu ze ben jie de suo you yan jiu 。]

english: When I'm not doing that, I'm teaching people like yourself about how wonderful the natural world is.
translation: 当我不这样做的时候，我会教像你这样的人自然世界是多么美妙。 [dang wo bu zhe yang zuo de shi hou ， wo hui jiao xiang ni zhe yang de ren zi ran shi jie shi duo me mei miao 。]

english: Nice. So then, I've got a few questions for you.
translation: 好的。那么，我有几个问题要问你。 [hao de 。 na me ， wo you ji ge wen ti yao wen ni 。]

english: Well, fire away and I'll give you an insight into the exciting world of animals.
translation: 好吧，开始吧，我将带您深入了解令人兴奋的动物世界。 [hao ba ， kai shi ba ， wo jiang dai nin shen ru liao jie ling ren xing fen de dong wu shi jie 。]

english: Hello again, [sir/madam], how can I help you on this fine day?
translation: 再次您好，[先生/女士]，在这个美好的日子里，有什么可以帮您的吗？ [zai ci nin hao ，[ xian sheng / nv shi ]， zai zhe ge mei hao de ri zi li ， you shen me ke yi bang nin de ma ？]

english: I was hoping you could tell me about something.
translation: 我希望你能告诉我一些事情。 [wo xi wang ni neng gao su wo yi xie shi qing 。]

english: Tell me about lizards.
translation: 告诉我有关蜥蜴的事。 [gao su wo you guan xi yi de shi 。]

english: Ahh lizards, the scaly carnivores.
translation: 啊，蜥蜴，有鳞的食肉动物。 [a ， xi yi ， you lin de shi rou dong wu 。]

english: If you just follow me to the display case I shall explain all about them.
translation: 如果您跟随我到展示柜，我将向您解释所有相关内容。 [ru guo nin gen sui wo dao zhan shi gui ， wo jiang xiang nin jie shi suo you xiang guan nei rong 。]

english: The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the lizard display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolboy.
translation: 玩家和自然历史学家传送到蜥蜴展示柜前的过场动画，其中有老师、学生和男学生。 [wan jia he zi ran li shi xue jia chuan song dao xi yi zhan shi gui qian de guo chang dong hua ， qi zhong you lao shi 、 xue sheng he nan xue sheng 。]

english: Contrary to popular belief, even though most lizards have a yellow belly, they are not in fact cowardly. Most Gielinor lizards will not shy away from a good fight and can be very tough.
translation: 与普遍的看法相反，尽管大多数蜥蜴都有黄色的腹部，但它们实际上并不胆怯。大多数吉林蜥蜴不会回避激烈的战斗，并且非常顽强。 [yu pu bian de kan fa xiang fan ， jin guan da duo shu xi yi dou you huang se de fu bu ， dan ta men shi ji shang bing bu dan qie 。 da duo shu ji lin xi yi bu hui hui bi ji lie de zhan dou ， bing qie fei chang wan qiang 。]

english: The natural historian poses as a lizard...
translation: 自然历史学家摆出一副蜥蜴的样子…… [zi ran li shi xue jia bai chu yi fu xi yi de yang zi ……]

english: This is due to a very thick and tough hide, made from thousands of thick scales. Most people who claim to be hunters have a very hard time trying to dispatch lizards.
translation: 这是由于由数千个厚鳞片制成的非常厚且坚韧的皮革。大多数自称猎人的人都很难消灭蜥蜴。 [zhe shi you yu you shu qian ge hou lin pian zhi cheng de fei chang hou qie jian ren de pi ge 。 da duo shu zi cheng lie ren de ren dou hen nan xiao mie xi yi 。]

english: In fact, the only people to successfully discern how to kill these tough little squamatas are the five legendary Slayer masters, although we assume they must have some kind of natural predator.
translation: 事实上，唯一能够成功地了解如何杀死这些顽强的小鳞片的人是五位传奇的杀手大师，尽管我们假设他们一定有某种天敌。 [shi shi shang ， wei yi neng gou cheng gong di liao jie ru he sha si zhe xie wan qiang de xiao lin pian de ren shi wu wei chuan qi de sha shou da shi ， jin guan wo men jia she ta men yi ding you mou zhong tian di 。]

english: Interestingly enough, these scales are made from the same substance that your hair is comprised of. This substance is called keratin.
translation: 有趣的是，这些鳞片的成分与头发的成分相同。这种物质称为角蛋白。 [you qu de shi ， zhe xie lin pian de cheng fen yu tou fa de cheng fen xiang tong 。 zhe zhong wu zhi cheng wei jiao dan bai 。]

english: Lizards have a very well developed sense of vision and hearing. Some people think that some lizards have a third eye!
translation: 蜥蜴有非常发达的视觉和听觉。有人认为有些蜥蜴有第三只眼！ [xi yi you fei chang fa da de shi jue he ting jue 。 you ren ren wei you xie xi yi you di san zhi yan ！]

english: A tiny, light-sensitive, transparent structure on top of the head that helps them regulate how long they stay in the sun.
translation: 头顶上有一个微小的、光敏的、透明的结构，可以帮助它们调节在阳光下停留的时间。 [tou ding shang you yi ge wei xiao de 、 guang min de 、 tou ming de jie gou ， ke yi bang zhu ta men tiao jie zai yang guang xia ting liu de shi jian 。]

english: This is vital for the cold-blooded lizards who have no means to regulate their internal temperature.
translation: 这对于无法调节内部温度的冷血蜥蜴来说至关重要。 [zhe dui yu wu fa tiao jie nei bu wen du de leng xue xi yi lai shuo zhi guan zhong yao 。]

english: Like many cold-blooded creatures, if they are subjected to a sudden decrease in temperature, they will become sluggish and sleepy.
translation: 和许多冷血生物一样，如果遇到温度突然降低的情况，它们就会变得呆滞、昏昏欲睡。 [he xu duo leng xue sheng wu yi yang ， ru guo yu dao wen du tu ran jiang di de qing kuang ， ta men jiu hui bian de dai zhi 、 hun hun yu shui 。]

english: And this concludes my short lecture on lizards. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: 我关于蜥蜴的简短讲座到此结束。我希望你玩得开心。 [wo guan yu xi yi de jian duan jiang zuo dao ci jie shu 。 wo xi wang ni wan de kai xin 。]

english: End cutscene
translation: 过场动画结束 [guo chang dong hua jie shu]

english: Tell me about the tortoises.
translation: 告诉我关于乌龟的事。 [gao su wo guan yu wu gui de shi 。]

english: Ahh tortoises, the armoured ancients.
translation: 啊，乌龟，铠甲古人。 [a ， wu gui ， kai jia gu ren 。]

english: The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the tortoise display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolgirl.
