translation: 玩家和自然历史学家传送到乌龟展示柜前的过场动画，其中有老师、学生和女学生。 [wan jia he zi ran li shi xue jia chuan song dao wu gui zhan shi gui qian de guo chang dong hua ， qi zhong you lao shi 、 xue sheng he nv xue sheng 。]

english: The tortoise is a very well defended beast. It uses an armoured shell just like its aquatic cousins the terrapin and the turtle.
translation: 乌龟是一种防守非常严密的野兽。它使用装甲外壳，就像它的水生表亲水龟和海龟一样。 [wu gui shi yi zhong fang shou fei chang yan mi de ye shou 。 ta shi yong zhuang jia wai ke ， jiu xiang ta de shui sheng biao qin shui gui he hai gui yi yang 。]

english: The natural historian poses as a tortoise...
translation: 自然历史学家摆出一副乌龟的样子…… [zi ran li shi xue jia bai chu yi fu wu gui de yang zi ……]

english: Tortoises can vary in size from about as long as your hand to as big as a unicorn. Most land tortoises eat nothing but plants in the wild.
translation: 乌龟的大小各不相同，从手掌那么长到独角兽那么大。大多数陆龟只吃野生植物。 [wu gui de da xiao ge bu xiang tong ， cong shou zhang na me zhang dao du jiao shou na me da 。 da duo shu lu gui zhi chi ye sheng zhi wu 。]

english: Did you know you can tell how old a tortoise is by the number of rings in its shell, just like a tree.
translation: 您知道吗，您可以通过龟壳上的环数来判断乌龟的年龄，就像一棵树一样。 [nin zhi dao ma ， nin ke yi tong guo gui ke shang de huan shu lai pan duan wu gui de nian ling ， jiu xiang yi ke shu yi yang 。]

english: Most land-based tortoises eat plants, feeding on grazing grasses, weeds, leafy greens, flowers, and cabbages.
translation: 大多数陆龟以植物为食，以草、杂草、绿叶蔬菜、花卉和卷心菜为食。 [da duo shu lu gui yi zhi wu wei shi ， yi cao 、 za cao 、 lv ye shu cai 、 hua hui he juan xin cai wei shi 。]

english: Tortoises generally live as long as people, and some individual ones are known to have lived longer than 300 years.
translation: 乌龟的寿命通常与人一样长，据了解，有些乌龟的寿命超过 300 岁。 [wu gui de shou ming tong chang yu ren yi yang zhang ， ju liao jie ， you xie wu gui de shou ming chao guo  300  sui 。]

english: Because of this, they symbolise longevity within some cultures, such as gnomes who also breed them for battle.
translation: 正因为如此，它们在某些文化中象征着长寿，例如侏儒也饲养它们用于战斗。 [zheng yin wei ru ci ， ta men zai mou xie wen hua zhong xiang zheng zhe chang shou ， li ru zhu ru ye si yang ta men yong yu zhan dou 。]

english: The oldest tortoise ever recorded was Mibbiwocket, who was presented to the King Healthorg the Great, by the famous explorer Admiral Bake, shortly after its birth.
translation: 有记录的最古老的乌龟是米比沃基特（Mibbiwocket），它在出生后不久就被著名探险家贝克海军上将赠送给国王赫希奥格大帝。 [you ji lu de zui gu lao de wu gui shi mi bi wo ji te （Mibbiwocket）， ta zai chu sheng hou bu jiu jiu bei zhu ming tan xian jia bei ke hai jun shang jiang zeng song gei guo wang he xi ao ge da di 。]

english: Mibbiwocket is still in the care of the gnomish royal family.
translation: 米比沃基特仍然由侏儒王室照顾。 [mi bi wo ji te reng ran you zhu ru wang shi zhao gu 。]

english: And this concludes my short lecture on tortoises. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: 我关于乌龟的简短讲座到此结束。我希望你玩得开心。 [wo guan yu wu gui de jian duan jiang zuo dao ci jie shu 。 wo xi wang ni wan de kai xin 。]

english: Tell me about dragons.
translation: 告诉我有关龙的事。 [gao su wo you guan long de shi 。]

english: Ahh dragons, the mighty hunters of the sky.
translation: 啊，龙，天空中强大的猎手。 [a ， long ， tian kong zhong qiang da de lie shou 。]

english: The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the dragon display case with a teacher and pupil.
translation: 玩家和自然历史学家传送到龙展示柜前的过场动画，还有老师和学生。 [wan jia he zi ran li shi xue jia chuan song dao long zhan shi gui qian de guo chang dong hua ， hai you lao shi he xue sheng 。]

english: The dragons of Gielinor are a most confusing species. Standing at approximately twelve feet tall, these imposing predators strike fear into the hearts and minds of most sane folk.
translation: 吉林诺的龙是最令人困惑的物种。这些威严的掠食者身高约十二英尺，让大多数理智正常的人感到恐惧。 [ji lin nuo de long shi zui ling ren kun huo de wu zhong 。 zhe xie wei yan de lve shi zhe shen gao yue shi er ying chi ， rang da duo shu li zhi zheng chang de ren gan dao kong ju 。]

english: The natural historian poses as a dragon...
translation: 自然历史学家摆出一副龙的样子…… [zi ran li shi xue jia bai chu yi fu long de yang zi ……]

english: However, if you delve a little deeper into their history and lifestyle, a few things stick out as very unusual.
translation: 然而，如果你更深入地研究他们的历史和生活方式，就会发现有些事情非常不寻常。 [ran er ， ru guo ni geng shen ru di yan jiu ta men de li shi he sheng huo fang shi ， jiu hui fa xian you xie shi qing fei chang bu xun chang 。]

english: With most species there is a line, an ancestry if you will, whereby you can track how a creature has come to be in its present form.
translation: 大多数物种都有一条血统，如果你愿意的话，也可以说是一个祖先，通过它你可以追踪一个生物是如何变成现在的形态的。 [da duo shu wu zhong dou you yi tiao xue tong ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， ye ke yi shuo shi yi ge zu xian ， tong guo ta ni ke yi zhui zong yi ge sheng wu shi ru he bian cheng xian zai de xing tai de 。]

english: For instance, you can trace the ancestry of the common house cat back to the same creature that became the sabre-toothed kyatt.
translation: 例如，你可以将普通家猫的祖先追溯到剑齿凯亚特的同一种生物。 [li ru ， ni ke yi jiang pu tong jia mao de zu xian zhui su dao jian chi kai ya te de tong yi zhong sheng wu 。]

english: However, with the dragon, no such root ancestor can be found.
translation: 然而，对于龙来说，却找不到这样的根源。 [ran er ， dui yu long lai shuo ， que zhao bu dao zhe yang de gen yuan 。]

english: There are many forms of dragon, such as the common coloured and the metallic, or ferrous, dragon.
translation: 龙有多种形式，例如普通彩色龙和金属龙或黑色龙。 [long you duo zhong xing shi ， li ru pu tong cai se long he jin shu long huo hei se long 。]

english: They colonise many areas of Gielinor, though most notably, sites of ancient battles and small dank caves.
translation: 他们在吉林诺的许多地区定居，但最引人注目的是古代战争遗址和潮湿的小洞穴。 [ta men zai ji lin nuo de xu duo di qu ding ju ， dan zui yin ren zhu mu di shi gu dai zhan zheng yi zhi he chao shi de xiao dong xue 。]

english: Eating habits tend to vary, with the majority of their food being meat. However, it has also been noted that they can consume metals just as easily, with runite being thought of as a delicacy.
translation: 饮食习惯往往有所不同，大部分食物都是肉类。然而，人们也注意到它们也可以轻松消耗金属，而符文石被认为是一种美味佳肴。 [yin shi xi guan wang wang you suo bu tong ， da bu fen shi wu dou shi rou lei 。 ran er ， ren men ye zhu yi dao ta men ye ke yi qing song xiao hao jin shu ， er fu wen shi bei ren wei shi yi zhong mei wei jia yao 。]

english: Throughout history, dragons have appeared in myth and legend as fearsome adversaries and cunning creatures.
translation: 纵观历史，龙在神话和传说中作为可怕的对手和狡猾的生物出现。 [zong guan li shi ， long zai shen hua he chuan shuo zhong zuo wei ke pa de dui shou he jiao hua de sheng wu chu xian 。]

english: However, modern evidence does not support this. Most young dragons are largely creatures of instinct with a strong vicious streak.
translation: 然而，现代证据并不支持这一点。大多数幼龙在很大程度上都是本能生物，具有强烈的邪恶倾向。 [ran er ， xian dai zheng ju bing bu zhi chi zhe yi dian 。 da duo shu you long zai hen da cheng du shang dou shi ben neng sheng wu ， ju you qiang lie de xie e qing xiang 。]

english: The lifespan of the common dragon is as yet unknown, as no dragon has ever been observed dying of old age.
translation: 普通龙的寿命尚不清楚，因为还没有观察到龙因年老而死亡。 [pu tong long de shou ming shang bu qing chu ， yin wei hai mei you guan cha dao long yin nian lao er si wang 。]

english: Although, it has been mooted that spontaneous combustion could be considered a natural cause of death for this species.
translation: 尽管如此，有人认为自燃可能被认为是该物种的自然死亡原因。 [jin guan ru ci ， you ren ren wei zi ran ke neng bei ren wei shi gai wu zhong de zi ran si wang yuan yin 。]

english: And this concludes my short lecture on dragons. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: 我关于龙的简短讲座到此结束。我希望你玩得开心。 [wo guan yu long de jian duan jiang zuo dao ci jie shu 。 wo xi wang ni wan de kai xin 。]

english: Tell me about the wyverns.
translation: 告诉我关于双足飞龙的事。 [gao su wo guan yu shuang zu fei long de shi 。]

english: Ahh, wyverns. The extinct lizards.
translation: 啊，双足飞龙。已经灭绝的蜥蜴。 [a ， shuang zu fei long 。 yi jing mie jue de xi yi 。]

english: The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the wyvern display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolgirl.
translation: 玩家和自然历史学家传送到双足飞龙展示柜前的过场动画，其中有老师、学生和女学生。 [wan jia he zi ran li shi xue jia chuan song dao shuang zu fei long zhan shi gui qian de guo chang dong hua ， qi zhong you lao shi 、 xue sheng he nv xue sheng 。]

english: The wyverns' tale is a sad one. This now extinct species is presumed in some way to be related to the dragon.
translation: 双足飞龙的故事是一个悲伤的故事。这种现已灭绝的物种被认为在某种程度上与龙有关。 [shuang zu fei long de gu shi shi yi ge bei shang de gu shi 。 zhe zhong xian yi mie jue de wu zhong bei ren wei zai mou zhong cheng du shang yu long you guan 。]

english: The natural historian poses as a wyvern...
translation: 自然历史学家摆出一副双足飞龙的样子…… [zi ran li shi xue jia bai chu yi fu shuang zu fei long de yang zi ……]

english: In that they are both large flying reptiles. The wyvern stands much shorter than the adult dragon and only has two legs as opposed to the dragon's four.
translation: 因为它们都是大型飞行爬行动物。双足飞龙比成年龙短得多，并且只有两条腿，而龙有四条腿。 [yin wei ta men dou shi da xing fei xing pa xing dong wu 。 shuang zu fei long bi cheng nian long duan de duo ， bing qie zhi you liang tiao tui ， er long you si tiao tui 。]

english: Much of the evidence for wyvern behaviour comes from the reconstruction of old bones in the icy mountains of Asgarnia.
translation: 双足飞龙行为的大部分证据来自于阿斯加尼亚冰冷山脉中旧骨头的重建。 [shuang zu fei long xing wei de da bu fen zheng ju lai zi yu a si jia ni ya bing leng shan mai zhong jiu gu tou de chong jian 。]

english: One is that Asgarnia was at one time a much more temperate climate than it is now. The other is that wyverns could generate fire internally in much the same way as dragons.
translation: 一是阿斯伽尼亚曾经的气候比现在温和得多。另一个是双足飞龙可以像龙一样在体内产生火焰。 [yi shi a si ga ni ya ceng jing de qi hou bi xian zai wen he de duo 。 ling yi ge shi shuang zu fei long ke yi xiang long yi yang zai ti nei chan sheng huo yan 。]

english: If they follow the dragon paradigm, then they would have been carnivores, feeding on cows, sheep and other livestock animals.
translation: 如果他们遵循龙的范式，那么他们就会是肉食动物，以牛、羊和其他牲畜为食。 [ru guo ta men zun xun long de fan shi ， na me ta men jiu hui shi rou shi dong wu ， yi niu 、 yang he qi ta sheng chu wei shi 。]

english: How and why the wyverns became extinct is something of a mystery. Though if you consider the theory that the climate of Asgarnia changed suddenly, then this could provide an explanation.
translation: 双足飞龙如何以及为何灭绝一直是个谜。不过，如果你考虑阿斯伽尼亚气候突然变化的理论，那么这可以提供一个解释。 [shuang zu fei long ru he yi ji wei he mie jue yi zhi shi ge mi 。 bu guo ， ru guo ni kao lv a si ga ni ya qi hou tu ran bian hua de li lun ， na me zhe ke yi ti gong yi ge jie shi 。]

english: There are some inconsistencies in the findings we have for the wyverns, such as the odd wear patterns of some of bones, which really could only have happened after the creature died.
translation: 我们对双足飞龙的发现存在一些不一致之处，例如一些骨头的奇怪磨损模式，这实际上只能在该生物死亡后发生。 [wo men dui shuang zu fei long de fa xian cun zai yi xie bu yi zhi zhi chu ， li ru yi xie gu tou de qi guai mo sun mo shi ， zhe shi ji shang zhi neng zai gai sheng wu si wang hou fa sheng 。]

english: Also the bones we have collected remain a little below room temperature wherever they are kept.
translation: 此外，我们收集的骨头无论存放在哪里，其温度都略低于室温。 [ci wai ， wo men shou ji de gu tou wu lun cun fang zai na li ， qi wen du dou lve di yu shi wen 。]

english: They have also been shown to radiate a very weak magical aura.
translation: 它们还被证明散发出非常微弱的魔法光环。 [ta men hai bei zheng ming san fa chu fei chang wei ruo de mo fa guang huan 。]

english: I'm sure that in due time, these mysteries will be solved.
translation: 我相信，在适当的时候，这些谜团将会被解开。 [wo xiang xin ， zai shi dang de shi hou ， zhe xie mi tuan jiang hui bei jie kai 。]

english: And this concludes my short lecture on wyverns. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: 我关于双足飞龙的简短讲座到此结束。我希望你玩得开心。 [wo guan yu shuang zu fei long de jian duan jiang zuo dao ci jie shu 。 wo xi wang ni wan de kai xin 。]

english: That's enough education for one day.
translation: 一天的教育就足够了。 [yi tian de jiao yu jiu zu gou le 。]

english: Nonsense! There's always room for more.
translation: 废话！总有更多空间。 [fei hua ！ zong you geng duo kong jian 。]

english: And remember, science isn't dull!
translation: 请记住，科学并不乏味！ [qing ji zhu ， ke xue bing bu fa wei ！]

english: Tell me about snails.
translation: 告诉我有关蜗牛的事。 [gao su wo you guan wo niu de shi 。]

english: Ahh snails, the gelatinous gastropods.
translation: 啊，蜗牛，胶状腹足动物。 [a ， wo niu ， jiao zhuang fu zu dong wu 。]

english: The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the snail display case with a schoolboy and schoolgirl.
translation: 玩家和自然历史学家传送到蜗牛展示柜前的过场动画，其中有男学生和女学生。 [wan jia he zi ran li shi xue jia chuan song dao wo niu zhan shi gui qian de guo chang dong hua ， qi zhong you nan xue sheng he nv xue sheng 。]

english: Snails move like worms by squishing up and stretching out, very, very slowly. They also make a lot of slime, in order to aid moving by reducing friction.
translation: 蜗牛像蠕虫一样通过挤压和伸展来移动，非常非常缓慢。它们还会产生大量粘液，以通过减少摩擦来帮助移动。 [wo niu xiang ru chong yi yang tong guo ji ya he shen zhan lai yi dong ， fei chang fei chang huan man 。 ta men hai hui chan sheng da liang nian ye ， yi tong guo jian shao mo ca lai bang zhu yi dong 。]

english: The natural historian poses as a snail...
translation: 自然历史学家摆出一副蜗牛的样子…… [zi ran li shi xue jia bai chu yi fu wo niu de yang zi ……]

english: They also use slime for protection. For instance, snails can use their slime to crawl over razor-blades without being hurt. It also helps keep away dangerous insects like ants.
translation: 他们还使用粘液进行保护。例如，蜗牛可以利用它们的粘液在剃须刀刀片上爬行而不会受伤。它还有助于远离蚂蚁等危险昆虫。 [ta men hai shi yong nian ye jin xing bao hu 。 li ru ， wo niu ke yi li yong ta men de nian ye zai ti xu dao dao pian shang pa xing er bu hui shou shang 。 ta hai you zhu yu yuan li ma yi deng wei xian kun chong 。]

english: When they hide in their shells, snails secrete a special type of slime, which dries to cover the entrance of their shells like a 'trapdoor'. This is called an operculum.
translation: 当蜗牛躲在壳里时，它们会分泌一种特殊的粘液，这种粘液干燥后会覆盖住壳的入口，就像“活板门”一样。这称为鳃盖。 [dang wo niu duo zai ke li shi ， ta men hui fen mi yi zhong te shu de nian ye ， zhe zhong nian ye gan zao hou hui fu gai zhu ke de ru kou ， jiu xiang “ huo ban men ” yi yang 。 zhe cheng wei sai gai 。]

english: The snails of Morytania are the most malignant molluscs ever to have been studied.
translation: 莫里塔尼亚的蜗牛是迄今为止研究过的最恶性的软体动物。 [mo li ta ni ya de wo niu shi qi jin wei zhi yan jiu guo de zui e xing de ruan ti dong wu 。]

english: They are broken down into two distinct species: achatina acidia and achatina acidia giganteus or, as they are more commonly known, the acid-spitting snail and the giant acid-spitting snail.
translation: 它们分为两个不同的物种：achatina Acidia 和 achatina Acidia giganteus，或者更常见的是，吐酸蜗牛和巨型吐酸蜗牛。 [ta men fen wei liang ge bu tong de wu zhong ：achatina Acidia  he  achatina Acidia giganteus， huo zhe geng chang jian de shi ， tu suan wo niu he ju xing tu suan wo niu 。]

english: Both of these varieties are voracious carnivores, using their mutated mouthpieces to spit a glob of powerful acid to kill their foe.
translation: 这两个品种都是贪婪的食肉动物，它们利用变异的口器吐出一团强酸来杀死敌人。 [zhe liang ge pin zhong dou shi tan lan de shi rou dong wu ， ta men li yong bian yi de kou qi tu chu yi tuan qiang suan lai sha si di ren 。]

english: They then simply have to wait, whilst the digestive juices make short work of the poor creature. Then, they simply slurp up what remains.
translation: 然后他们只需要等待，而消化液很快就能消化掉这个可怜的生物。然后，他们就把剩下的吃掉。 [ran hou ta men zhi xu yao deng dai ， er xiao hua ye hen kuai jiu neng xiao hua diao zhe ge ke lian de sheng wu 。 ran hou ， ta men jiu ba sheng xia de chi diao 。]

english: How these strange creatures came to be is still something of a mystery. The most prevalent theory suggests that they mutated, as a reaction to an 'as yet unknown' pollutant that has appeared in the swamps.
translation: 这些奇怪的生物是如何形成的仍然是一个谜。最流行的理论表明，它们发生了突变，是对沼泽中出现的“尚未知”污染物的反应。 [zhe xie qi guai de sheng wu shi ru he xing cheng de reng ran shi yi ge mi 。 zui liu xing de li lun biao ming ， ta men fa sheng le tu bian ， shi dui zhao ze zhong chu xian de “ shang wei zhi ” wu ran wu de fan ying 。]

english: The local populace has capitalised on the appearance of these strange species, using their shells to fashion a rudimentary helm that is fairly resistant to the snails acid.
translation: 当地民众利用这些奇怪物种的出现，用它们的壳制作了一种基本的头盔，该头盔对蜗牛酸具有相当的抵抗力。 [dang di min zhong li yong zhe xie qi guai wu zhong de chu xian ， yong ta men de ke zhi zuo le yi zhong ji ben de tou kui ， gai tou kui dui wo niu suan ju you xiang dang de di kang li 。]

english: Other known uses of snail by-products include a tasty local delicacy and a fireproof oil.
translation: 蜗牛副产品的其他已知用途包括美味的当地美食和防火油。 [wo niu fu chan pin de qi ta yi zhi yong tu bao kuo mei wei di dang di mei shi he fang huo you 。]

english: And this concludes my short lecture on snails. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: 我关于蜗牛的简短讲座到此结束。我希望你玩得开心。 [wo guan yu wo niu de jian duan jiang zuo dao ci jie shu 。 wo xi wang ni wan de kai xin 。]

english: Tell me about monkeys.
translation: 告诉我关于猴子的事。 [gao su wo guan yu hou zi de shi 。]

english: Ahh monkeys, the simian collective.
translation: 啊，猴子，猿猴集体。 [a ， hou zi ， yuan hou ji ti 。]

english: The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the monkey display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolboy.
translation: 玩家和自然历史学家传送到猴子展示柜前的过场动画，其中有老师、学生和男学生。 [wan jia he zi ran li shi xue jia chuan song dao hou zi zhan shi gui qian de guo chang dong hua ， qi zhong you lao shi 、 xue sheng he nan xue sheng 。]

english: A monkey is a member of either of two known groupings of simian primates. These two known groupings are the Karamja monkeys and the 'harmless' monkeys.
translation: 猴子是两个已知的猿猴灵长类动物中的一个成员。这两个已知的群体是卡拉姆贾猴和“无害”的猴子。 [hou zi shi liang ge yi zhi de yuan hou ling zhang lei dong wu zhong de yi ge cheng yuan 。 zhe liang ge yi zhi de qun ti shi ka la mu jia hou he “ wu hai ” de hou zi 。]

english: The natural historian poses as a monkey...
translation: 自然历史学家扮成一只猴子...... [zi ran li shi xue jia ban cheng yi zhi hou zi ......]

english: Because of their similarity to monkeys, apes such as chimpanzees and gibbons are often called monkeys by accident.
translation: 由于与猴子相似，黑猩猩和长臂猿等猿类经常被误称为猴子。 [you yu yu hou zi xiang si ， hei xing xing he chang bi yuan deng yuan lei jing chang bei wu cheng wei hou zi 。]

english: Though some natural historians don't consider them to be monkeys. Also, a few monkey species have the word 'ape' in their common name.
translation: 尽管一些自然历史学家并不认为它们是猴子。此外，一些猴子物种的俗名中含有“猿”一词。 [jin guan yi xie zi ran li shi xue jia bing bu ren wei ta men shi hou zi 。 ci wai ， yi xie hou zi wu zhong de su ming zhong han you “ yuan ” yi ci 。]

english: The Karamja monkeys are rumoured to be fairly cunning and intelligent creatures, although rumours that they have learned human speech is anecdotal at best.
translation: 据传，卡拉姆贾猴是相当狡猾和聪明的生物，尽管有关它们学会人类语言的传言充其量只是传闻。 [ju chuan ， ka la mu jia hou shi xiang dang jiao hua he cong ming de sheng wu ， jin guan you guan ta men xue hui ren lei yu yan de chuan yan chong qi liang zhi shi chuan wen 。]

english: In appearance, they stand much shorter than a human and tend to move in a hunched fashion. Karamja monkeys also sport a red mohawk, though it is unknown whether this is an affectation or not.
translation: 从外观上看，它们的站姿比人类短得多，并且往往以驼背的方式移动。卡拉姆贾猴也留有红色莫霍克发型，不过尚不清楚这是否是一种矫揉造作。 [cong wai guan shang kan ， ta men de zhan zi bi ren lei duan de duo ， bing qie wang wang yi tuo bei de fang shi yi dong 。 ka la mu jia hou ye liu you hong se mo huo ke fa xing ， bu guo shang bu qing chu zhe shi fou shi yi zhong jiao rou zao zuo 。]

english: They are very fond of bananas and bitternuts, eating them in huge quantities whenever they can get their paws on them.
translation: 它们非常喜欢香蕉和苦果，只要能拿到爪子，就会大量吃掉它们。 [ta men fei chang xi huan xiang jiao he ku guo ， zhi yao neng na dao zhua zi ， jiu hui da liang chi diao ta men 。]

english: The harmless monkeys of Mos Le'Harmless are a very similar, but in some ways entirely different, breed. They stand roughly the same size but are a lighter colour.
translation: 莫斯勒哈姆莱斯的无害猴子是一个非常相似但在某些方面完全不同的品种。它们的尺寸大致相同，但颜色较浅。 [mo si lei ha mu lai si de wu hai hou zi shi yi ge fei chang xiang si dan zai mou xie fang mian wan quan bu tong de pin zhong 。 ta men de chi cun da zhi xiang tong ， dan yan se jiao qian 。]

english: Interestingly, Karamaja monkeys have a deep dislike of seaweed, though this may stem from the actions of a number of irresponsible people.
translation: 有趣的是，卡拉马贾猴非常不喜欢海藻，尽管这可能源于一些不负责任的人的行为。 [you qu de shi ， ka la ma jia hou fei chang bu xi huan hai zao ， jin guan zhe ke neng yuan yu yi xie bu fu ze ren de ren de xing wei 。]

english: And this concludes my short lecture on monkeys. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: 我关于猴子的简短讲座到此结束。我希望你玩得开心。 [wo guan yu hou zi de jian duan jiang zuo dao ci jie shu 。 wo xi wang ni wan de kai xin 。]

english: Tell me about the sea slugs.
translation: 告诉我有关海蛞蝓的事。 [gao su wo you guan hai kuo yu de shi 。]

english: Ahh sea slugs, the cute crustaceans.
translation: 啊，海蛞蝓，可爱的甲壳类动物。 [a ， hai kuo yu ， ke ai de jia qiao lei dong wu 。]

english: The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the sea slug display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolgirl.
translation: 玩家和自然历史学家传送到海蛞蝓展示柜前的过场动画，其中有老师、学生和女学生。 [wan jia he zi ran li shi xue jia chuan song dao hai kuo yu zhan shi gui qian de guo chang dong hua ， qi zhong you lao shi 、 xue sheng he nv xue sheng 。]

english: The term 'sea slug' is something of a misnomer. Whilst these small creatures have a soft body like that of a slug, they also possess a very hard shell like a snail.
translation: “海蛞蝓”这个词有点用词不当。虽然这些小生物有像蛞蝓一样柔软的身体，但它们也有像蜗牛一样坚硬的外壳。 [“ hai kuo yu ” zhe ge ci you dian yong ci bu dang 。 sui ran zhe xie xiao sheng wu you xiang kuo yu yi yang rou ruan de shen ti ， dan ta men ye you xiang wo niu yi yang jian ying de wai ke 。]

english: The natural historian poses as a sea slug...
translation: 自然历史学家摆出一副海蛞蝓的样子…… [zi ran li shi xue jia bai chu yi fu hai kuo yu de yang zi ……]

english: Very little is actually known about the sea slug, as we have, as yet, been unable to procure a sample for observation and study.
translation: 实际上，人们对海蛞蝓知之甚少，因为我们迄今为止还无法获得用于观察和研究的样本。 [shi ji shang ， ren men dui hai kuo yu zhi zhi shen shao ， yin wei wo men qi jin wei zhi hai wu fa huo de yong yu guan cha he yan jiu de yang ben 。]

english: For some reason all expeditions we have sent have either vanished mysteriously, or those on the expedition have sent letters back announcing their desire to leave the Museum and go on to other things.
translation: 由于某种原因，我们派出的所有探险队要么神秘消失，要么探险队的人回信宣布他们希望离开博物馆并继续做其他事情。 [you yu mou zhong yuan yin ， wo men pai chu de suo you tan xian dui yao me shen mi xiao shi ， yao me tan xian dui de ren hui xin xuan bu ta men xi wang li kai bo wu guan bing ji xu zuo qi ta shi qing 。]

english: It is presumed that the species is native to the very deep waters around the eastern Ardougne coastline.
translation: 据推测，该物种原产于阿尔杜涅东部海岸线周围的深水区。 [ju tui ce ， gai wu zhong yuan chan yu a er du nie dong bu hai an xian zhou wei de shen shui qu 。]

english: There must be some natural resource in the area that the sea slugs are using, as the underwater habitat there is much the same around many coastal areas on Gielinor.
translation: 海蛞蝓所利用的地区必定存在某种自然资源，因为吉林诺许多沿海地区的水下栖息地大致相同。 [hai kuo yu suo li yong de di qu bi ding cun zai mou zhong zi ran zi yuan ， yin wei ji lin nuo xu duo yan hai di qu de shui xia qi xi di da zhi xiang tong 。]

english: Through looking at similar species we have determined that the sea slug is a harmless little creature. It spends much of its life grazing on seaweed and other plant life.
translation: 通过观察类似的物种，我们确定海蛞蝓是一种无害的小生物。它一生的大部分时间都在吃海藻和其他植物。 [tong guo guan cha lei si de wu zhong ， wo men que ding hai kuo yu shi yi zhong wu hai de xiao sheng wu 。 ta yi sheng de da bu fen shi jian dou zai chi hai zao he qi ta zhi wu 。]

english: There are reports that these reclusive animals have two large fangs at their front, though this is assumed to be either for decorative or defensive purposes.
translation: 有报道称，这些隐居动物的前面有两颗大尖牙，尽管这被认为是出于装饰或防御目的。 [you bao dao cheng ， zhe xie yin ju dong wu de qian mian you liang ke da jian ya ， jin guan zhe bei ren wei shi chu yu zhuang shi huo fang yu mu di 。]

english: If they do follow the same pattern as other similar creatures, the shell will be nigh on impervious to most attacks. The exposed soft skin may have a number of nematocysts, or stinging organs, similar to jellyfish.
translation: 如果它们确实遵循与其他类似生物相同的模式，那么它们的外壳将几乎不会受到大多数攻击。裸露的柔软皮肤可能有许多刺丝囊或刺器官，类似于水母。 [ru guo ta men que shi zun xun yu qi ta lei si sheng wu xiang tong de mo shi ， na me ta men de wai ke jiang ji hu bu hui shou dao da duo shu gong ji 。 luo lu de rou ruan pi fu ke neng you xu duo ci si nang huo ci qi guan ， lei si yu shui mu 。]

english: It is typical of prey animals such as these to develop some kind of unique defence mechanism that allows them to survive.
translation: 像这样的被捕食动物通常会发展出某种独特的防御机制，使它们能够生存。 [xiang zhe yang de bei bu shi dong wu tong chang hui fa zhan chu mou zhong du te de fang yu ji zhi ， shi ta men neng gou sheng cun 。]

english: If only we could acquire one for study. I'm sure we would find this mechanism to be truly unique.
translation: 如果我们能买一个来研究就好了。我确信我们会发现这种机制确实是独一无二的。 [ru guo wo men neng mai yi ge lai yan jiu jiu hao le 。 wo que xin wo men hui fa xian zhe zhong ji zhi que shi shi du yi wu er de 。]

english: And this concludes my short lecture on sea slugs. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: 我关于海蛞蝓的简短讲座到此结束。我希望你玩得开心。 [wo guan yu hai kuo yu de jian duan jiang zuo dao ci jie shu 。 wo xi wang ni wan de kai xin 。]

english: Tell me about snakes.
translation: 告诉我关于蛇的事。 [gao su wo guan yu she de shi 。]

english: Ahh snakes, the slithering squamata.
translation: 啊，蛇，滑行的有鳞。 [a ， she ， hua xing de you lin 。]

english: The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the snake display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolgirl.
translation: 玩家和自然历史学家传送到蛇展示柜前的过场动画，其中有老师、学生和女学生。 [wan jia he zi ran li shi xue jia chuan song dao she zhan shi gui qian de guo chang dong hua ， qi zhong you lao shi 、 xue sheng he nv xue sheng 。]

english: Serpentes, or ophidia, is the suborder under squamata that snakes belong to, like a big family.
translation: 蛇类（Serpentes）或蛇类（ophidia）是蛇所属的有鳞目下的亚目，就像一个大家族。 [she lei （Serpentes） huo she lei （ophidia） shi she suo shu de you lin mu xia de ya mu ， jiu xiang yi ge da jia zu 。]

english: The natural historian poses as a snake...
translation: 自然历史学家扮成一条蛇...... [zi ran li shi xue jia ban cheng yi tiao she ......]

english: Unlike lizards, snakes have no limbs whatsoever; not that this limits them. Snakes live in or near every habitat in the world.
translation: 与蜥蜴不同，蛇没有任何四肢；这并不是说这限制了他们。蛇生活在世界上每个栖息地或附近。 [yu xi yi bu tong ， she mei you ren he si zhi ； zhe bing bu shi shuo zhe xian zhi le ta men 。 she sheng huo zai shi jie shang mei ge qi xi di huo fu jin 。]

english: Found in nice tropical forests, temperate lattitudes and even in the ocean - some have adapted specialised stomach juices that they inject into their prey as venom, while others prefer to grab and crush their food.
translation: 它们生活在美丽的热带森林、温带纬度地区，甚至海洋中，有些适应了特殊的胃液，将其作为毒液注射到猎物体内，而另一些则喜欢抓住并压碎食物。 [ta men sheng huo zai mei li de re dai sen lin 、 wen dai wei du di qu ， shen zhi hai yang zhong ， you xie shi ying le te shu de wei ye ， jiang qi zuo wei du ye zhu she dao lie wu ti nei ， er ling yi xie ze xi huan zhua zhu bing ya sui shi wu 。]

english: While others still are fast hunters who use speed and strength to overcome their prey.
translation: 而其他人仍然是快速的猎人，他们利用速度和力量来战胜猎物。 [er qi ta ren reng ran shi kuai su de lie ren ， ta men li yong su du he li liang lai zhan sheng lie wu 。]

english: The sense of smell in snakes has been enhanced in an amazing way. With most animals, like you and me, tiny particles are filtered through the nose.
translation: 蛇的嗅觉以惊人的方式增强。对于大多数动物，比如你和我，微小的颗粒都会通过鼻子过滤。 [she de xiu jue yi jing ren de fang shi zeng qiang 。 dui yu da duo shu dong wu ， bi ru ni he wo ， wei xiao de ke li du hui tong guo bi zi guo lv 。]

english: However, instead of using just their nose, these animals use their tongues as well. When a lizard or a snake wants to smell it's surroundings, it will wave its tongue around and pick up the particles in the air.
translation: 然而，这些动物不仅使用鼻子，还使用舌头。当蜥蜴或蛇想要闻周围环境时，它会挥动舌头并拾取空气中的颗粒。 [ran er ， zhe xie dong wu bu jin shi yong bi zi ， hai shi yong she tou 。 dang xi yi huo she xiang yao wen zhou wei huan jing shi ， ta hui hui dong she tou bing shi qu kong qi zhong de ke li 。]

english: The tongue then returns to the mouth and the tips of the tongue are pushed up against two tiny pits in the roof of the snake's mouth.
translation: 然后舌头回到嘴里，舌尖被推到蛇嘴顶部的两个小凹坑上。 [ran hou she tou hui dao zui li ， she jian bei tui dao she zui ding bu de liang ge xiao ao keng shang 。]

english: Since these pits are split apart from each other, the tongue itself also has to split. This is why snakes have forked tongues.
translation: 由于这些凹坑彼此分开，舌头本身也必须分开。这就是蛇有分叉舌头的原因。 [you yu zhe xie ao keng bi ci fen kai ， she tou ben shen ye bi xu fen kai 。 zhe jiu shi she you fen cha she tou de yuan yin 。]

english: So the next time you see a snake sticking it's tongue out at you, remember, it's sniffing the air, not trying to bite you.
translation: 因此，下次当您看到蛇向您伸出舌头时，请记住，它是在嗅空气，而不是想咬您。 [yin ci ， xia ci dang nin kan dao she xiang nin shen chu she tou shi ， qing ji zhu ， ta shi zai xiu kong qi ， er bu shi xiang yao nin 。]

english: And this concludes my short lecture on snakes. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: 我关于蛇的简短讲座到此结束。我希望你玩得开心。 [wo guan yu she de jian duan jiang zuo dao ci jie shu 。 wo xi wang ni wan de kai xin 。]

english: Tell me about natural history.
translation: 告诉我有关自然历史的事情。 [gao su wo you guan zi ran li shi de shi qing 。]

english: Well, the field of natural history covers a wide range of sciences.
translation: 嗯，自然历史领域涵盖了广泛的科学领域。 [n ， zi ran li shi ling yu han gai le guang fan de ke xue ling yu 。]

english: So we use biology, the study of living things, botany, the study of plants and zoology, the study of animals.
translation: 所以我们利用生物学，对生物的研究，植物学，对植物的研究和动物学，对动物的研究。 [suo yi wo men li yong sheng wu xue ， dui sheng wu de yan jiu ， zhi wu xue ， dui zhi wu de yan jiu he dong wu xue ， dui dong wu de yan jiu 。]

english: Though the field is growing all the time and we're also using techniques from magic, astrology and numerology.
translation: 尽管这个领域一直在发展，我们也在使用魔法、占星术和命理学的技术。 [jin guan zhe ge ling yu yi zhi zai fa zhan ， wo men ye zai shi yong mo fa 、 zhan xing shu he ming li xue de ji shu 。]

english: A person interested in natural history is known as a naturalist.
translation: 对自然历史感兴趣的人被称为博物学家。 [dui zi ran li shi gan xing qu de ren bei cheng wei bo wu xue jia 。]

english: Tell me about the terrorbirds.
translation: 告诉我关于恐怖鸟的事。 [gao su wo guan yu kong bu niao de shi 。]

english: Ahh terrorbirds, the fastest bird on two legs.
translation: 啊，恐怖鸟，两条腿跑得最快的鸟。 [a ， kong bu niao ， liang tiao tui pao de zui kuai de niao 。]

english: The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the terrorbird display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolgirl.
translation: 玩家和自然历史学家传送到恐怖鸟展示柜前的过场动画，其中有老师、学生和女学生。 [wan jia he zi ran li shi xue jia chuan song dao kong bu niao zhan shi gui qian de guo chang dong hua ， qi zhong you lao shi 、 xue sheng he nv xue sheng 。]

english: Terrorbirds live in nomadic groups of between five and fifty birds that often travel together with other grazing animals.
translation: 恐怖鸟以五到五十只的游牧群体生活，经常与其他食草动物一起旅行。 [kong bu niao yi wu dao wu shi zhi de you mu qun ti sheng huo ， jing chang yu qi ta shi cao dong wu yi qi lv xing 。]

english: The natural historian poses as a terrorbird...
translation: 自然历史学家摆出一副恐怖鸟的样子…… [zi ran li shi xue jia bai chu yi fu kong bu niao de yang zi ……]

english: They mainly feed on seeds and other plants. They also eat insects such as locusts if they can catch them.
translation: 它们主要以种子和其他植物为食。如果它们能捕获蝗虫等昆虫，它们也会吃它们。 [ta men zhu yao yi zhong zi he qi ta zhi wu wei shi 。 ru guo ta men neng bu huo huang chong deng kun chong ， ta men ye hui chi ta men 。]

english: They have no teeth to chew with, so they swallow pebbles that help to grind the swallowed foods in the gizzard.
translation: 它们没有牙齿可以咀嚼，因此它们吞下卵石，以帮助磨碎砂囊中吞下的食物。 [ta men mei you ya chi ke yi ju jue ， yin ci ta men tun xia luan shi ， yi bang zhu mo sui sha nang zhong tun xia de shi wu 。]

english: They can go without water for a long time, exclusively living off the water in the plants. However, they enjoy water and frequently take baths when they can.
translation: 它们可以长时间不喝水，完全靠植物中的水生存。然而，他们喜欢水并经常洗澡。 [ta men ke yi zhang shi jian bu he shui ， wan quan kao zhi wu zhong de shui sheng cun 。 ran er ， ta men xi huan shui bing jing chang xi zao 。]

english: Terrorbirds are known to eat almost anything, particularly in captivity, where opportunity is increased.
translation: 众所周知，恐鸟几乎什么都吃，特别是在圈养环境中，这样机会就更大了。 [zhong suo zhou zhi ， kong niao ji hu shen me dou chi ， te bie shi zai quan yang huan jing zhong ， zhe yang ji hui jiu geng da le 。]

english: Terrorbirds usually weigh a little less than a small unicorn. The feathers of adult males are mostly green, with some white on the wings and tail.
translation: 恐怖鸟的重量通常比小型独角兽轻一点。成年雄性的羽毛大多是绿色的，翅膀和尾巴上有一些白色。 [kong bu niao de zhong liang tong chang bi xiao xing du jiao shou qing yi dian 。 cheng nian xiong xing de yu mao da duo shi lv se de ， chi bang he wei ba shang you yi xie bai se 。]

english: There are claws on two of the wings' fingers and their strong legs have no feathers. The bird stands on two toes, with the bigger one resembling a hoof. Its feet have no claws.
translation: 翅膀的两个手指上有爪子，它们强壮的腿没有羽毛。这只鸟用两个脚趾站立，较大的一个像蹄子。它的脚没有爪子。 [chi bang de liang ge shou zhi shang you zhua zi ， ta men qiang zhuang de tui mei you yu mao 。 zhe zhi niao yong liang ge jiao zhi zhan li ， jiao da de yi ge xiang ti zi 。 ta de jiao mei you zhua zi 。]

english: This is an adaptation unique to terrorbirds that appears to aid in running. Their legs are powerful enough to kill even large animals.
translation: 这是恐怖鸟特有的一种适应，似乎有助于奔跑。它们的腿强大到足以杀死大型动物。 [zhe shi kong bu niao te you de yi zhong shi ying ， si hu you zhu yu ben pao 。 ta men de tui qiang da dao zu yi sha si da xing dong wu 。]

english: The gnomes in particular, prize the terrorbird for its fast running speed, using them as mounts whenever possible.
translation: 侏儒们尤其看重恐怖鸟的快速奔跑速度，只要有可能就将它们用作坐骑。 [zhu ru men you qi kan zhong kong bu niao de kuai su ben pao su du ， zhi yao you ke neng jiu jiang ta men yong zuo zuo qi 。]

english: There are a number of recorded incidents of people being attacked and killed. Big males can be very territorial and aggressive, and can attack and kick very powerfully with their legs.
translation: 有许多记录在案的人员被袭击和杀害的事件。体型大的雄性具有很强的领地意识和攻击性，并且可以用腿进行强有力的攻击和踢击。 [you xu duo ji lu zai an de ren yuan bei xi ji he sha hai de shi jian 。 ti xing da de xiong xing ju you hen qiang de ling di yi shi he gong ji xing ， bing qie ke yi yong tui jin xing qiang you li de gong ji he ti ji 。]

english: A terrorbird is so fast, it can easily outrun any human athlete.
translation: 恐怖鸟的速度如此之快，它可以轻松超过任何人类运动员。 [kong bu niao de su du ru ci zhi kuai ， ta ke yi qing song chao guo ren he ren lei yun dong yuan 。]

english: And this concludes my short lecture on terrorbirds. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: 我关于恐怖鸟的简短讲座到此结束。我希望你玩得开心。 [wo guan yu kong bu niao de jian duan jiang zuo dao ci jie shu 。 wo xi wang ni wan de kai xin 。]

english: Tell me about the Kalphite Queen.
translation: 告诉我关于卡菲特女王的事。 [gao su wo guan yu ka fei te nv wang de shi 。]

english: Ahh kalphites, the insectoid eating machines.
translation: 啊，卡尔菲特斯，昆虫类进食机器。 [a ， ka er fei te si ， kun chong lei jin shi ji qi 。]

english: The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the Kalphite Queen display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolgirl.
translation: 玩家和自然历史学家传送到卡尔菲特女王展示柜前的过场动画，其中有老师、学生和女学生。 [wan jia he zi ran li shi xue jia chuan song dao ka er fei te nv wang zhan shi gui qian de guo chang dong hua ， qi zhong you lao shi 、 xue sheng he nv xue sheng 。]

english: The kalphites, otherwise known as the kalphiscarabeinae, are perhaps the largest species of insect on the face of Gielinor. Their queen is called kalphiscarabeinae pasha.
translation: 卡尔菲特虫（kalphites），也被称为卡尔菲斯卡拉贝亚科（kalphiscarabeinae），可能是吉林诺表面最大的昆虫种类。他们的女王被称为 kalphiscarabeinae pasha。 [ka er fei te chong （kalphites）， ye bei cheng wei ka er fei si ka la bei ya ke （kalphiscarabeinae）， ke neng shi ji lin nuo biao mian zui da de kun chong zhong lei 。 ta men de nv wang bei cheng wei  kalphiscarabeinae pasha。]

english: The natural historian poses as the Kalphite Queen...
translation: 自然历史学家冒充卡尔菲特女王…… [zi ran li shi xue jia mao chong ka er fei te nv wang ……]

english: Most of the early documentation and research on this fearsome predatory species was performed by the noted bug hunter Iqbar Ali-Abdula.
translation: 关于这种可怕的掠食性物种的大部分早期记录和研究都是由著名的昆虫猎人伊克巴尔·阿里·阿卜杜拉（Iqbar Ali-Abdula）完成的。 [guan yu zhe zhong ke pa de lve shi xing wu zhong de da bu fen zao qi ji lu he yan jiu dou shi you zhu ming de kun chong lie ren yi ke ba er · a li · a bo du la （Iqbar Ali-Abdula） wan cheng de 。]

english: This, of course, was before he was driven insane by his research and ran off into the desert, screaming.
translation: 当然，这是在他被自己的研究逼疯并尖叫着跑进沙漠之前。 [dang ran ， zhe shi zai ta bei zi ji de yan jiu bi feng bing jian jiao zhe pao jin sha mo zhi qian 。]

english: Kalphites are related to beetles and scorpions; they are mainly green in colour. Some have remarkable antennae which can detect the slightest movement. Their carapace is composed of armoured plates called lamellae.
translation: Kalphites 与甲虫和蝎子有亲缘关系。它们的颜色主要是绿色。有些具有非凡的触角，可以检测到最轻微的移动。它们的甲壳由称为薄片的装甲板组成。 [Kalphites  yu jia chong he xie zi you qin yuan guan xi 。 ta men de yan se zhu yao shi lv se 。 you xie ju you fei fan de chu jiao ， ke yi jian ce dao zui qing wei de yi dong 。 ta men de jia qiao you cheng wei bao pian de zhuang jia ban zu cheng 。]

english: This shell can be compressed into a ball or fanned out like leaves, in order to sense odours. The front legs are adapted for digging the enormous tunnel systems that serve as their nests.
translation: 这种外壳可以被压缩成球状或像叶子一样展开，以感知气味。前腿适合挖掘作为巢穴的巨大隧道系统。 [zhe zhong wai ke ke yi bei ya suo cheng qiu zhuang huo xiang ye zi yi yang zhan kai ， yi gan zhi qi wei 。 qian tui shi he wa jue zuo wei chao xue de ju da sui dao xi tong 。]

english: They exist in a caste-based society, with the soft shelled larvae at the bottom, up through the workers, soldiers and finally the queen.
translation: 它们存在于一个以种姓为基础的社会中，软壳幼虫处于最底层，向上经过工人、士兵，最后是蚁后。 [ta men cun zai yu yi ge yi zhong xing wei ji chu de she hui zhong ， ruan ke you chong chu yu zui di ceng ， xiang shang jing guo gong ren 、 shi bing ， zui hou shi yi hou 。]

english: Voracious carnivores, a pack of adult workers can strip the flesh from a full grown camel in a matter of seconds, leaving nothing but a few bones and strips of fur for other scavengers to pick over.
translation: 作为贪婪的食肉动物，一群成年工蚁可以在几秒钟内将一头成年骆驼的肉剥掉，只留下一些骨头和皮毛供其他食腐动物捡拾。 [zuo wei tan lan de shi rou dong wu ， yi qun cheng nian gong yi ke yi zai ji miao zhong nei jiang yi tou cheng nian luo tuo de rou bo diao ， zhi liu xia yi xie gu tou he pi mao gong qi ta shi fu dong wu jian shi 。]

english: They typically live in large nests marked by the rock hard pillars found in hot, arid deserts, such as the one south-west of Al Kharid, which rise out of the sands like the tombs of desert pharaohs.
translation: 它们通常生活在炎热、干旱的沙漠中以岩石坚硬的柱子为标志的大型巢穴中，例如阿尔卡里德西南部的巢穴，这些巢穴从沙子中升起，就像沙漠法老的坟墓一样。 [ta men tong chang sheng huo zai yan re 、 gan han de sha mo zhong yi yan shi jian ying de zhu zi wei biao zhi de da xing chao xue zhong ， li ru a er ka li de xi nan bu de chao xue ， zhe xie chao xue cong sha zi zhong sheng qi ， jiu xiang sha mo fa lao de fen mu yi yang 。]

english: Indeed, there is some relationship between the Kalphite Queen and the desert god Scabaras, but no one is really sure what.
translation: 确实，卡尔菲特女王和沙漠之神斯卡巴拉斯之间存在某种关系，但没有人真正确定是什么关系。 [que shi ， ka er fei te nv wang he sha mo zhi shen si ka ba la si zhi jian cun zai mou zhong guan xi ， dan mei you ren zhen zheng que ding shi shen me guan xi 。]

english: During the early part of the fourth age, Scabaras proclaimed himself omnipotent and outlawed worship of all other gods save him.
translation: 在第四纪元初期，斯卡巴拉斯宣称自己无所不能，并禁止崇拜除他以外的所有其他神祇。 [zai di si ji yuan chu qi ， si ka ba la si xuan cheng zi ji wu suo bu neng ， bing jin zhi chong bai chu ta yi wai de suo you qi ta shen qi 。]

english: When the people eventually revolted against his repressive rule and banished Scabaras, it is said his blood washed over the scarabs and transformed them into the kalphites we know today.
translation: 当人们最终反抗他的镇压统治并驱逐斯卡巴拉斯时，据说他的鲜血冲刷了圣甲虫，并将它们转化为我们今天所知的卡尔菲特。 [dang ren men zui zhong fan kang ta de zhen ya tong zhi bing qu zhu si ka ba la si shi ， ju shuo ta de xian xue chong shua le sheng jia chong ， bing jiang ta men zhuan hua wei wo men jin tian suo zhi de ka er fei te 。]

english: Of course, any right-minded scientist discounts these myths as mere stories, with no historical basis in fact.
translation: 当然，任何有正义感的科学家都会将这些神话视为纯粹的故事，没有事实依据。 [dang ran ， ren he you zheng yi gan de ke xue jia du hui jiang zhe xie shen hua shi wei chun cui de gu shi ， mei you shi shi yi ju 。]

english: And this concludes my short lecture on kalphites. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: 我关于卡尔菲特的简短讲座到此结束。我希望你玩得开心。 [wo guan yu ka er fei te de jian duan jiang zuo dao ci jie shu 。 wo xi wang ni wan de kai xin 。]

english: Tell me about camels.
translation: 告诉我关于骆驼的事。 [gao su wo guan yu luo tuo de shi 。]

english: Ahh camels, the ships of the desert.
translation: 啊，骆驼，沙漠的船只。 [a ， luo tuo ， sha mo de chuan zhi 。]

english: The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the camel display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolgirl.
translation: 玩家和自然历史学家传送到骆驼展示柜前的过场动画，其中有老师、学生和女学生。 [wan jia he zi ran li shi xue jia chuan song dao luo tuo zhan shi gui qian de guo chang dong hua ， qi zhong you lao shi 、 xue sheng he nv xue sheng 。]

english: The term camel refers to either of the two known species of camelid.
translation: 骆驼一词指的是两种已知的骆驼科动物中的任何一种。 [luo tuo yi ci zhi de shi liang zhong yi zhi de luo tuo ke dong wu zhong de ren he yi zhong 。]

english: The natural historian poses as a camel...
translation: 自然历史学家摆出一副骆驼的样子…… [zi ran li shi xue jia bai chu yi fu luo tuo de yang zi ……]

english: There is the bactrian, which has two humps and can be found throughout Al Kharid. It also refers to the Ugthanki, or one-humped camel.
translation: 双峰驼有两个驼峰，在整个阿尔卡里德都可以找到。它也指 Ugthanki，或单峰骆驼。 [shuang feng tuo you liang ge tuo feng ， zai zheng ge a er ka li de dou ke yi zhao dao 。 ta ye zhi  Ugthanki， huo dan feng luo tuo 。]

english: Camels are ill-tempered beasts at the best of times, requiring a great deal of time and effort to tame.
translation: 即使在最好的时候，骆驼也是脾气暴躁的野兽，需要花费大量的时间和精力来驯服。 [ji shi zai zui hao de shi hou ， luo tuo ye shi pi qi bao zao de ye shou ， xu yao hua fei da liang de shi jian he jing li lai xun fu 。]

english: This would explain why used camel salesmen are in such a hurry to be rid of them.
translation: 这可以解释为什么二手骆驼销售员如此急于处理掉它们。 [zhe ke yi jie shi wei shen me er shou luo tuo xiao shou yuan ru ci ji yu chu li diao ta men 。]

english: In the wild, camels have been known to lie in wait and ambush hapless travellers, before devouring them.
translation: 在野外，骆驼会埋伏伏击不幸的旅行者，然后将他们吞噬。 [zai ye wai ， luo tuo hui mai fu fu ji bu xing de lv xing zhe ， ran hou jiang ta men tun shi 。]

english: This is quite surprising, as most domestic camels are happy eating nothing but vegetables.
translation: 这是相当令人惊讶的，因为大多数家养骆驼只喜欢吃蔬菜。 [zhe shi xiang dang ling ren jing ya de ， yin wei da duo shu jia yang luo tuo zhi xi huan chi shu cai 。]

english: Camel milk is much more nutritious than cow milk and goes well in the strong desert drink akin to tea.
translation: 骆驼奶比牛奶更有营养，适合搭配类似于茶的浓烈沙漠饮料。 [luo tuo nai bi niu nai geng you ying yang ， shi he da pei lei si yu cha de nong lie sha mo yin liao 。]

english: Another useful camel by-product is dung. Their dung is very dry, due to the highly efficient metabolism of the camel.
translation: 另一种有用的骆驼副产品是粪便。由于骆驼新陈代谢的效率很高，它们的粪便非常干燥。 [ling yi zhong you yong de luo tuo fu chan pin shi fen bian 。 you yu luo tuo xin chen dai xie de xiao lv hen gao ， ta men de fen bian fei chang gan zao 。]

english: Scientific research has also shown that chilli has a disastrous effect on a camel's digestive system, which produces toxic dung.
translation: 科学研究还表明，辣椒对骆驼的消化系统有灾难性的影响，该系统会产生有毒的粪便。 [ke xue yan jiu hai biao ming ， la jiao dui luo tuo de xiao hua xi tong you zai nan xing de ying xiang ， gai xi tong hui chan sheng you du de fen bian 。]

english: And this concludes my short lecture on camels. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: 我关于骆驼的简短讲座到此结束。我希望你玩得开心。 [wo guan yu luo tuo de jian duan jiang zuo dao ci jie shu 。 wo xi wang ni wan de kai xin 。]

english: Tell me about leeches.
translation: 告诉我关于水蛭的事。 [gao su wo guan yu shui zhi de shi 。]

english: Ahh leeches, the haemophagic parasites.
translation: 啊，水蛭，食血寄生虫。 [a ， shui zhi ， shi xue ji sheng chong 。]

english: The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the leech display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolgirl.
translation: 玩家和自然历史学家传送到水蛭展示柜前的过场动画，其中有老师、学生和女学生。 [wan jia he zi ran li shi xue jia chuan song dao shui zhi zhan shi gui qian de guo chang dong hua ， qi zhong you lao shi 、 xue sheng he nv xue sheng 。]

english: Leeches are fascinating creatures and are very similar to worms in most respects.
translation: 水蛭是一种迷人的生物，在许多方面与蠕虫非常相似。 [shui zhi shi yi zhong mi ren de sheng wu ， zai xu duo fang mian yu ru chong fei chang xiang si 。]

english: The natural historian poses as a leech...
translation: 自然历史学家摆出一副水蛭的样子…… [zi ran li shi xue jia bai chu yi fu shui zhi de yang zi ……]

english: They like to inhabit streams, rivers and seas, but their preference is for stagnant pools of water.
translation: 它们喜欢栖息在溪流、河流和海洋中，但更喜欢死水池。 [ta men xi huan qi xi zai xi liu 、 he liu he hai yang zhong ， dan geng xi huan si shui chi 。]

english: One of the most common misconceptions is that all leeches feed on blood.
translation: 最常见的误解之一是所有水蛭都以血液为食。 [zui chang jian de wu jie zhi yi shi suo you shui zhi dou yi xue ye wei shi 。]

english: Most leeches are meat eaters, feeding on a variety of invertebrates such as worms, snails, insect larvae and snails.
translation: 大多数水蛭是肉食性动物，以多种无脊椎动物为食，如蠕虫、蜗牛、昆虫幼虫和蜗牛。 [da duo shu shui zhi shi rou shi xing dong wu ， yi duo zhong wu ji zhui dong wu wei shi ， ru ru chong 、 wo niu 、 kun chong you chong he wo niu 。]

english: Those that do feed on blood have developed an amazing method of doing so. Firstly they latch onto the skin using a ring of tiny teeth, before injecting their prey with an anaesthetic.
translation: 那些以血液为食的动物已经开发出了一种惊人的方法。首先，它们用一圈小牙齿咬住猎物的皮肤，然后给猎物注射麻醉剂。 [na xie yi xue ye wei shi de dong wu yi jing kai fa chu le yi zhong jing ren de fang fa 。 shou xian ， ta men yong yi quan xiao ya chi yao zhu lie wu de pi fu ， ran hou gei lie wu zhu she ma zui ji 。]

english: Then they bite into the skin using a Y-shaped mouthpiece and introducing a chemical that stops the blood from clotting.
translation: 然后，他们使用 Y 形咬嘴咬入皮肤，并引入一种阻止血液凝固的化学物质。 [ran hou ， ta men shi yong  Y  xing yao zui yao ru pi fu ， bing yin ru yi zhong zu zhi xue ye ning gu de hua xue wu zhi 。]

english: They will then feed until they are completely full, sometimes doubling in size!
translation: 然后它们会进食直到完全吃饱，有时体积会增加一倍！ [ran hou ta men hui jin shi zhi dao wan quan chi bao ， you shi ti ji hui zeng jia yi bei ！]

english: Most leeches are very small, measuring no more than the length of your middle finger. An exception to these are the leeches of Morytania, which can reach the size of a dog.
translation: 大多数水蛭都很小，不超过中指的长度。莫里塔尼亚的水蛭是个例外，它的体型可以达到狗的大小。 [da duo shu shui zhi dou hen xiao ， bu chao guo zhong zhi de chang du 。 mo li ta ni ya de shui zhi shi ge li wai ， ta de ti xing ke yi da dao gou de da xiao 。]

english: They are much more mobile than their smaller cousins and are able to jump rather high when attacking.
translation: 它们比体型较小的近亲更灵活，并且在攻击时能够跳得相当高。 [ta men bi ti xing jiao xiao de jin qin geng ling huo ， bing qie zai gong ji shi neng gou tiao de xiang dang gao 。]

english: Quite how these leeches came to be so big is something of a mystery.
translation: 这些水蛭如何变得如此之大仍然是一个谜。 [zhe xie shui zhi ru he bian de ru ci zhi da reng ran shi yi ge mi 。]

english: All we can assume is that there is some kind of environmental influence, which has governed their immense growth.
translation: 我们只能假设存在某种环境影响，这种影响控制了它们的巨大增长。 [wo men zhi neng jia she cun zai mou zhong huan jing ying xiang ， zhe zhong ying xiang kong zhi le ta men de ju da zeng zhang 。]

english: And this concludes my short lecture on leeches. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: 我关于水蛭的简短讲座到此结束。我希望你玩得开心。 [wo guan yu shui zhi de jian duan jiang zuo dao ci jie shu 。 wo xi wang ni wan de kai xin 。]

english: Tell me about moles.
translation: 告诉我关于痣的事。 [gao su wo guan yu zhi de shi 。]

english: Ahh moles, the mammalian mountain makers.
translation: 啊，鼹鼠，哺乳动物的山脉制造者。 [a ， yan shu ， bu ru dong wu de shan mai zhi zao zhe 。]

english: The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the mole display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolgirl.
translation: 玩家和自然历史学家传送到鼹鼠展示柜前的过场动画，其中有老师、学生和女学生。 [wan jia he zi ran li shi xue jia chuan song dao yan shu zhan shi gui qian de guo chang dong hua ， qi zhong you lao shi 、 xue sheng he nv xue sheng 。]

english: Now, moles are small mammals of the talpidae family. These subterranean burrowers mainly live on a diet of slugs, snails and insects.
translation: 现在，鼹鼠是鼹鼠科的小型哺乳动物。这些地下穴居动物主要以蛞蝓、蜗牛和昆虫为食。 [xian zai ， yan shu shi yan shu ke de xiao xing bu ru dong wu 。 zhe xie di xia xue ju dong wu zhu yao yi kuo yu 、 wo niu he kun chong wei shi 。]

english: The natural historian poses as a mole...
translation: 自然历史学家冒充鼹鼠...... [zi ran li shi xue jia mao chong yan shu ......]

english: They vary greatly in habitat and can be found in almost every part of Gielinor. Some species have even known to be aquatic!
translation: 它们的栖息地差异很大，几乎在吉林诺的每个地方都可以找到它们。有些物种甚至被认为是水生的！ [ta men de qi xi di cha yi hen da ， ji hu zai ji lin nuo de mei ge di fang dou ke yi zhao dao ta men 。 you xie wu zhong shen zhi bei ren wei shi shui sheng de ！]

english: Male moles are known as boars with the females called sows. Should you come across a group of moles, you would call them a labour.
translation: 雄性鼹鼠被称为野猪，雌性鼹鼠被称为母猪。如果你遇到一群鼹鼠，你会称他们为劳工。 [xiong xing yan shu bei cheng wei ye zhu ， ci xing yan shu bei cheng wei mu zhu 。 ru guo ni yu dao yi qun yan shu ， ni hui cheng ta men wei lao gong 。]

english: Moles are considered to be an agricultural pest in most places, digging up the ground and leaving molehills all over the place.
translation: 在大多数地方，鼹鼠被认为是一种农业害虫，它们会挖掉地面，并在各处留下鼹鼠丘。 [zai da duo shu di fang ， yan shu bei ren wei shi yi zhong nong ye hai chong ， ta men hui wa diao di mian ， bing zai ge chu liu xia yan shu qiu 。]

english: This has been highlighted in Falador by Wyson the Gardener who, after using some Malignus Mortifer's Super Ultra Flora Growth Potion, managed to create Gielinor's only known species of giant mole.
translation: 园丁 Wyson 在《法拉多》中强调了这一点，在使用了一些 Malignus Mortifer 的超级植物生长药水后，他成功地创造了吉林诺唯一已知的巨型鼹鼠物种。 [yuan ding  Wyson  zai 《 fa la duo 》 zhong qiang diao le zhe yi dian ， zai shi yong le yi xie  Malignus Mortifer  de chao ji zhi wu sheng zhang yao shui hou ， ta cheng gong di chuang zao le ji lin nuo wei yi yi zhi de ju xing yan shu wu zhong 。]

english: This fearsome beast has huge claws, wicked teeth and a penchant for shiny objects. It is a very tough animal with a thick protective hide and an ill temperament.
translation: 这种可怕的野兽有巨大的爪子、邪恶的牙齿和对闪亮物体的嗜好。它是一种非常坚韧的动物，有着厚厚的保护皮和坏脾气。 [zhe zhong ke pa de ye shou you ju da de zhua zi 、 xie e de ya chi he dui shan liang wu ti de shi hao 。 ta shi yi zhong fei chang jian ren de dong wu ， you zhe hou hou de bao hu pi he huai pi qi 。]

english: That said, they do benefit the soil by aerating and tilling it, adding to its fertility. Contrary to popular belief, moles don't eat plant roots.
translation: 也就是说，它们确实通过通气和耕耘土壤而使土壤受益，增加了土壤的肥力。与普遍的看法相反，鼹鼠不吃植物的根。 [ye jiu shi shuo ， ta men que shi tong guo tong qi he geng yun tu rang er shi tu rang shou yi ， zeng jia le tu rang de fei li 。 yu pu bian de kan fa xiang fan ， yan shu bu chi zhi wu de gen 。]

english: And this concludes my short lecture on moles. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: 我关于痣的简短讲座到此结束。我希望你玩得开心。 [wo guan yu zhi de jian duan jiang zuo dao ci jie shu 。 wo xi wang ni wan de kai xin 。]

english: Tell me about penguins.
translation: 告诉我关于企鹅的事。 [gao su wo guan yu qi e de shi 。]

english: Ahh penguins, the cunning birds of the sea.
translation: 啊，企鹅，狡猾的海鸟。 [a ， qi e ， jiao hua de hai niao 。]

english: The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the penguin display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolgirl.
translation: 玩家和自然历史学家传送到企鹅展示柜前的过场动画，其中有老师、学生和女学生。 [wan jia he zi ran li shi xue jia chuan song dao qi e zhan shi gui qian de guo chang dong hua ， qi zhong you lao shi 、 xue sheng he nv xue sheng 。]

english: This often-maligned aquatic bird is known to be native to the ice fields of Etceteria, although they have been known to live as far as the fields of Lumbridge.
translation: 这种经常被诟病的水鸟原产于 Etceteria 的冰原，尽管它们的栖息地远至 Lumbridge 的原野。 [zhe zhong jing chang bei gou bing de shui niao yuan chan yu  Etceteria  de bing yuan ， jin guan ta men de qi xi di yuan zhi  Lumbridge  de yuan ye 。]

english: The natural historian poses as a penguin...
translation: 自然历史学家扮成一只企鹅…… [zi ran li shi xue jia ban cheng yi zhi qi e ……]

english: These aquatic birds seem to spend the majority of their time eating and fostering their young.
translation: 这些水鸟似乎将大部分时间都花在进食和抚养幼鸟上。 [zhe xie shui niao si hu jiang da bu fen shi jian dou hua zai jin shi he fu yang you niao shang 。]

english: For creatures with such small brains, they do seem to have a disproportionate capacity for forward thinking and planning. As this serves no natural purpose, scholars are divided as to how this evolved.
translation: 对于大脑如此小的生物来说，它们似乎确实具有不成比例的前瞻性思维和计划能力。由于这没有任何自然目的，学者们对于它是如何演变的存在分歧。 [dui yu da nao ru ci xiao de sheng wu lai shuo ， ta men si hu que shi ju you bu cheng bi li de qian zhan xing si wei he ji hua neng li 。 you yu zhe mei you ren he zi ran mu di ， xue zhe men dui yu ta shi ru he yan bian de cun zai fen qi 。]

english: Their diet consists mainly of fish, squid and a small shrimp-like creature called krill. However, some have developed a taste for the mushrooms that grow around fairy rings.
translation: 它们的饮食主要包括鱼、鱿鱼和一种叫做磷虾的小虾状生物。然而，有些人已经对仙女环周围生长的蘑菇产生了兴趣。 [ta men de yin shi zhu yao bao kuo yu 、 you yu he yi zhong jiao zuo lin xia de xiao xia zhuang sheng wu 。 ran er ， you xie ren yi jing dui xian nv huan zhou wei sheng zhang de mo gu chan sheng le xing qu 。]

english: Penguins primarily rely on their vision while hunting. What we don't know is how penguins locate prey in the darkness, or at great depths.
translation: 企鹅在狩猎时主要依靠视力。我们不知道的是企鹅如何在黑暗或深渊中寻找猎物。 [qi e zai shou lie shi zhu yao yi kao shi li 。 wo men bu zhi dao de shi qi e ru he zai hei an huo shen yuan zhong xun zhao lie wu 。]

english: Some theories suggest that penguins are helped by some sort of extra sensory perception; perhaps even precognition.
translation: 一些理论认为，某种额外的感官知觉对企鹅有帮助。也许甚至是预知。 [yi xie li lun ren wei ， mou zhong e wai de gan guan zhi jue dui qi e you bang zhu 。 ye xu shen zhi shi yu zhi 。]

english: Penguins spend a long time going without food when they are breeding. In fact, they won't even leave their nests if they can help it.
translation: 企鹅在繁殖时需要很长一段时间没有食物。事实上，如果可以的话，它们甚至不会离开自己的巢穴。 [qi e zai fan zhi shi xu yao hen zhang yi duan shi jian mei you shi wu 。 shi shi shang ， ru guo ke yi de hua ， ta men shen zhi bu hui li kai zi ji de chao xue 。]

english: Fortunately, most penguins build up a layer of fat to keep them warm and provide energy until the moult is over.
translation: 幸运的是，大多数企鹅都会形成一层脂肪来保持温暖并提供能量，直到换毛结束。 [xing yun de shi ， da duo shu qi e du hui xing cheng yi ceng zhi fang lai bao chi wen nuan bing ti gong neng liang ， zhi dao huan mao jie shu 。]

english: And this concludes my short lecture on penguins. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: 我关于企鹅的简短讲座到此结束。我希望你玩得开心。 [wo guan yu qi e de jian duan jiang zuo dao ci jie shu 。 wo xi wang ni wan de kai xin 。]

english: Hmm, I'm afraid I don't allow pets in my lectures, the demonstrations can scare them.
translation: 嗯，恐怕我不允许宠物参加我的讲座，演示会吓到他们。 [n ， kong pa wo bu yun xu chong wu can jia wo de jiang zuo ， yan shi hui xia dao ta men 。]

english: Tell me about lizards.
translation: 告诉我有关蜥蜴的事。 [gao su wo you guan xi yi de shi 。]

english: Tell me about tortoises.
translation: 给我讲讲乌龟吧。 [gei wo jiang jiang wu gui ba 。]

english: Tell me about dragons.
translation: 告诉我有关龙的事。 [gao su wo you guan long de shi 。]

english: Tell me about wyverns.
translation: 告诉我关于双足飞龙的事。 [gao su wo guan yu shuang zu fei long de shi 。]

english: That's enough education for one day.
translation: 一天的教育就足够了。 [yi tian de jiao yu jiu zu gou le 。]

english: Tell me about snails.
translation: 告诉我有关蜗牛的事。 [gao su wo you guan wo niu de shi 。]

english: Tell me about monkeys.
translation: 告诉我关于猴子的事。 [gao su wo guan yu hou zi de shi 。]

english: Tell me about sea slugs.
translation: 告诉我有关海蛞蝓的事。 [gao su wo you guan hai kuo yu de shi 。]

english: Tell me about snakes.
translation: 告诉我关于蛇的事。 [gao su wo guan yu she de shi 。]

english: Tell me about natural history.
translation: 告诉我有关自然历史的事情。 [gao su wo you guan zi ran li shi de shi qing 。]

english: Tell me about terrorbirds.
translation: 告诉我关于恐怖鸟的事。 [gao su wo guan yu kong bu niao de shi 。]

english: Tell me about the Kalphite Queen.
translation: 告诉我关于卡菲特女王的事。 [gao su wo guan yu ka fei te nv wang de shi 。]

english: Tell me about camels.
translation: 告诉我关于骆驼的事。 [gao su wo guan yu luo tuo de shi 。]

english: Tell me about leeches.
translation: 告诉我关于水蛭的事。 [gao su wo guan yu shui zhi de shi 。]

english: Tell me about moles.
translation: 告诉我关于痣的事。 [gao su wo guan yu zhi de shi 。]

english: Tell me about penguins.
translation: 告诉我关于企鹅的事。 [gao su wo guan yu qi e de shi 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Speak to me again and I will rend the soul from your flesh.
translation: 再跟我说话，我就会把你的灵魂从你的肉体上撕下来。 [zai gen wo shuo hua ， wo jiu hui ba ni de ling hun cong ni de rou ti shang si xia lai 。]

english: Nobody speaks to me unless I speak to them!!!
translation: 除非我和他们说话，否则没有人跟我说话！ [chu fei wo he ta men shuo hua ， fou ze mei you ren gen wo shuo hua ！]

english: I do not answer questions, mortal fool!!
translation: 我不回答问题，白痴！！ [wo bu hui da wen ti ， bai chi ！！]

english: I will answer questions when you are dead!!
translation: 等你死了我再回答你的问题！！ [deng ni si le wo zai hui da ni de wen ti ！！]

english: You dare to speak to me??? Have you lost your wits????
translation: 你还敢跟我说话？？？你失去理智了吗？？？？ [ni hai gan gen wo shuo hua ？？？ ni shi qu li zhi le ma ？？？？]

english: What happened to everyone here?
translation: 这里的每个人都发生了什么？ [zhe li de mei ge ren dou fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: How do I get into the town?
translation: 我怎样才能进城？ [wo zen yang cai neng jin cheng ？]

english: Told you I'd defeat you, Necrovarus. My advice to you is to pass over to the next world yourself with everybody else.
translation: 告诉过你我会打败你，Necrovarus。我给你的建议是和其他人一起进入下一个世界。 [gao su guo ni wo hui da bai ni ，Necrovarus。 wo gei ni de jian yi shi he qi ta ren yi qi jin ru xia yi ge shi jie 。]

english: I should fry you for what you have done...
translation: 我应该为你所做的事把你炒了...... [wo ying gai wei ni suo zuo de shi ba ni chao le ......]

english: Quiet, evil priest!! If you try anything I will command you again, but this time it will be throw yourself into the Endless Void for the rest of eternity.
translation: 安静，邪恶的牧师！！如果你尝试任何事情，我会再次命令你，但这一次你将被扔进无尽的虚空，直到永远。 [an jing ， xie e de mu shi ！！ ru guo ni chang shi ren he shi qing ， wo hui zai ci ming ling ni ， dan zhe yi ci ni jiang bei reng jin wu jin de xu kong ， zhi dao yong yuan 。]

english: Please no! I will do whatever you say!!
translation: 请不要！你说什么我就做什么！！ [qing bu yao ！ ni shuo shen me wo jiu zuo shen me ！！]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: What happened to everyone here?
translation: 这里的每个人都发生了什么？ [zhe li de mei ge ren dou fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: How do I get into the town?
translation: 我怎样才能进城？ [wo zen yang cai neng jin cheng ？]

english: Hello there! Looking to take advantage of the Mistrock mines? If so, I'm happy to buy any ores from you. I can also sell you some tools if needed.
translation: 你好呀！想要利用 Mistrock 矿场的优势吗？如果是这样，我很乐意从您那里购买任何矿石。如果需要的话我还可以卖给你一些工具。 [ni hao ya ！ xiang yao li yong  Mistrock  kuang chang de you shi ma ？ ru guo shi zhe yang ， wo hen le yi cong nin na li gou mai ren he kuang shi 。 ru guo xu yao de hua wo hai ke yi mai gei ni yi xie gong ju 。]

english: Let's trade.
translation: 我们来交易吧。 [wo men lai jiao yi ba 。]

english: Great!
translation: 伟大的！ [wei da de ！]

english: What can you tell me about this place?
translation: 关于这个地方你能告诉我什么吗？ [guan yu zhe ge di fang ni neng gao su wo shen me ma ？]

english: Mistrock? It's a mining outpost. It was set up by Cam Torum after you humans went and had another of your wars. We lost some good mines and needed to find new ones.
translation: 迷雾岩？这是一个采矿前哨站。它是在你们人类进行另一场战争之后由卡姆托鲁姆建立的。我们失去了一些好的地雷，需要寻找新的。 [mi wu yan ？ zhe shi yi ge cai kuang qian shao zhan 。 ta shi zai ni men ren lei jin xing ling yi chang zhan zheng zhi hou you ka mu tuo lu mu jian li de 。 wo men shi qu le yi xie hao de di lei ， xu yao xun zhao xin de 。]

english: Why here?
translation: 为什么在这里？ [wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: It wasn't the first choice, but both humans and dwarves alike were pretty poor after the fighting ended, so we all had to learn lessons in how to compromise.
translation: 这不是第一选择，但战斗结束后，人类和矮人都非常贫穷，所以我们都必须吸取如何妥协的教训。 [zhe bu shi di yi xuan ze ， dan zhan dou jie shu hou ， ren lei he ai ren dou fei chang pin qiong ， suo yi wo men dou bi xu xi qu ru he tuo xie de jiao xun 。]

english: Still, it ended up not being too bad in the end. We found there was a reasonable supply of coal and iron here, along with some silver and gold.
translation: 不过，最终的结果并不算太糟糕。我们发现这里的煤炭和铁供应充足，还有一些白银和黄金。 [bu guo ， zui zhong de jie guo bing bu suan tai zao gao 。 wo men fa xian zhe li de mei tan he tie gong ying chong zu ， hai you yi xie bai yin he huang jin 。]

english: The location ended up being quite appealing for some as well. It makes for a nice change of scenery for those that appreciate that sort of thing.
translation: 这个位置最终对一些人来说也很有吸引力。对于那些欣赏此类事物的人来说，这会带来很好的风景变化。 [zhe ge wei zhi zui zhong dui yi xie ren lai shuo ye hen you xi yin li 。 dui yu na xie xin shang ci lei shi wu de ren lai shuo ， zhe hui dai lai hen hao de feng jing bian hua 。]

english: So what was here before Mistrock?
translation: 那么，在迷雾岩之前这里是什么？ [na me ， zai mi wu yan zhi qian zhe li shi shen me ？]

english: Nothing much of note. The land here was owned by the Moonrise Brewery and Winery, but they found it wasn't much good for growing grapes.
translation: 没什么值得注意的。这里的土地属于月出酿酒厂所有，但他们发现这里不太适合种植葡萄。 [mei shen me zhi de zhu yi de 。 zhe li de tu di shu yu yue chu niang jiu chang suo you ， dan ta men fa xian zhe li bu tai shi he zhong zhi pu tao 。]

english: So they were happy to give it up?
translation: 所以他们就乐意放弃了？ [suo yi ta men jiu le yi fang qi le ？]

english: Very happy. They saw an opportunity for a new business relationship. In return for giving us the land, we now give them favourable rates on what we mine here.
translation: 非常高兴。他们看到了建立新业务关系的机会。作为给予我们土地的回报，我们现在为他们提供我们在这里开采的优惠价格。 [fei chang gao xing 。 ta men kan dao le jian li xin ye wu guan xi de ji hui 。 zuo wei ji yu wo men tu di de hui bao ， wo men xian zai wei ta men ti gong wo men zai zhe li kai cai de you hui jia ge 。]

english: Does a winery have much need for metal?
translation: 酒厂对金属的需求量大吗？ [jiu chang dui jin shu de xu qiu liang da ma ？]

english: Apparently so. I guess they use it to make and maintain all their fancy brewing and winemaking equipment.
translation: 显然是这样。我猜他们用它来制造和维护所有精美的酿造和酿酒设备。 [xian ran shi zhe yang 。 wo cai ta men yong ta lai zhi zao he wei hu suo you jing mei de niang zao he niang jiu she bei 。]

english: But anyway, enough about that. Are you interested in buying or selling some ores?
translation: 但无论如何，已经足够了。您有兴趣购买或出售一些矿石吗？ [dan wu lun ru he ， yi jing zu gou le 。 nin you xing qu gou mai huo chu shou yi xie kuang shi ma ？]

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Well you know where I am if you change your mind.
translation: 好吧，如果你改变主意，你就知道我在哪里。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， ni jiu zhi dao wo zai na li 。]

english: Let's trade.
translation: 我们来交易吧。 [wo men lai jiao yi ba 。]

english: What can you tell me about this place?
translation: 关于这个地方你能告诉我什么吗？ [guan yu zhe ge di fang ni neng gao su wo shen me ma ？]

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello again, [lad/lass]. Something I can help you with? Want to buy some rope perhaps?
translation: 再次你好，[小伙子/姑娘]。有什么我可以帮你的吗？也许想买一些绳子？ [zai ci ni hao ，[ xiao huo zi / gu niang ]。 you shen me wo ke yi bang ni de ma ？ ye xu xiang mai yi xie sheng zi ？]

english: Well, I was a sailor. I've not been able to get work at sea these days, though. They say I'm too old.
translation: 嗯，我是一名水手。不过，这些天我一直没能在海上找到工作。他们说我太老了。 [n ， wo shi yi ming shui shou 。 bu guo ， zhe xie tian wo yi zhi mei neng zai hai shang zhao dao gong zuo 。 ta men shuo wo tai lao le 。]

english: Sorry, where was it you said you wanted to go?
translation: 抱歉，你刚才说要去哪里？ [bao qian ， ni gang cai shuo yao qu na li ？]

english: To the island of Crandor.
translation: 前往克兰多岛。 [qian wang ke lan duo dao 。]

english: Crandor?
translation: 克兰多？ [ke lan duo ？]

english: But... It would be a chance to sail a ship once more. I'd sail anywhere if it was a chance to sail again.
translation: 但是……这将是一次再次启航的机会。如果有机会再次航行，我愿意去任何地方航行。 [dan shi …… zhe jiang shi yi ci zai ci qi hang de ji hui 。 ru guo you ji hui zai ci hang xing ， wo yuan yi qu ren he di fang hang xing 。]

english: Then again, no captain in his right mind would sail to that island...
translation: 话又说回来，任何心智正常的船长都不会航行到那个岛…… [hua you shuo hui lai ， ren he xin zhi zheng chang de chuan zhang dou bu hui hang xing dao na ge dao ……]

english: Ah, you only live once! I'll do it!
translation: 啊，人的生命只有一次！我会做的！ [a ， ren de sheng ming zhi you yi ci ！ wo hui zuo de ！]

english: So, where's your ship?
translation: 那么，你的船在哪里？ [na me ， ni de chuan zai na li ？]

english: It's the Lady Lumbridge, in Port Sarim.
translation: 这是位于萨里姆港的朗布里奇夫人号。 [zhe shi wei yu sa li mu gang de lang bu li qi fu ren hao 。]

english: That old pile of junk? Last I heard, she wasn't seaworthy.
translation: 那堆旧垃圾？上次我听说她不适合航海。 [na dui jiu la ji ？ shang ci wo ting shuo ta bu shi he hang hai 。]

english: I fixed her up!
translation: 我把她收拾好了！ [wo ba ta shou shi hao le ！]

english: You did? Excellent!
translation: 你做到了吗？出色的！ [ni zuo dao le ma ？ chu se de ！]

english: Just show me the map and we can get ready to go!
translation: 只需给我看地图，我们就可以准备出发了！ [zhi xu gei wo kan di tu ， wo men jiu ke yi zhun bei chu fa le ！]

english: Here you go.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: Excellent! I'll meet you at the ship, then.
translation: 出色的！那我就去船上见吧。 [chu se de ！ na wo jiu qu chuan shang jian ba 。]

english: Will you take me to Crandor now, then?
translation: 那么你现在可以带我去克兰多吗？ [na me ni xian zai ke yi dai wo qu ke lan duo ma ？]

english: I said I would and old Ned is a man of his word! I'll meet you on board the Lady Lumbridge in Port Sarim.
translation: 我说过我会的，老内德是一个言出必行的人！我将在沙里姆港的朗布里奇女士号上与您见面。 [wo shuo guo wo hui de ， lao nei de shi yi ge yan chu bi xing de ren ！ wo jiang zai sha li mu gang de lang bu li qi nv shi hao shang yu nin jian mian 。]

english: Ah, it's good to be on board a ship again! No matter how long I live on land, a ship will always seem better. Are you ready to depart?
translation: 啊，又上船了真好！无论我在陆地上生活多久，船总是看起来更好。你准备好出发了吗？ [a ， you shang chuan le zhen hao ！ wu lun wo zai lu di shang sheng huo duo jiu ， chuan zong shi kan qi lai geng hao 。 ni zhun bei hao chu fa le ma ？]

english: Yes, let's go!
translation: 是的，我们走吧！ [shi de ， wo men zou ba ！]

english: No, I'm not quite ready yet.
translation: 不，我还没准备好。 [bu ， wo hai mei zhun bei hao 。]

english: Well, you go do whatever you need to do. I'll wait here for you until you're ready.
translation: 好吧，你去做你需要做的事吧。我会在这里等你，直到你准备好为止。 [hao ba ， ni qu zuo ni xu yao zuo de shi ba 。 wo hui zai zhe li deng ni ， zhi dao ni zhun bei hao wei zhi 。]

english: Ah, it's good to feel the salt spray on my face once again!
translation: 啊，再次感受到脸上的盐雾真是太好了！ [a ， zai ci gan shou dao lian shang de yan wu zhen shi tai hao le ！]

english: And this is a mighty fine ship. She don't look much, but she handles like a dream.
translation: 这是一艘非常优秀的船。她看起来并不多，但她的举止却像梦一样。 [zhe shi yi sou fei chang you xiu de chuan 。 ta kan qi lai bing bu duo ， dan ta de ju zhi que xiang meng yi yang 。]

english: How much longer until we reach Crandor?
translation: 我们还要多久才能到达克兰多？ [wo men hai yao duo jiu cai neng dao da ke lan duo ？]

english: Not long now! According to the chart, we'd be able to see Crandor if it wasn't for those clouds on the horizon.
translation: 现在没多久了！根据图表，如果没有地平线上的那些云，我们就能看到克兰多。 [xian zai mei duo jiu le ！ gen ju tu biao ， ru guo mei you di ping xian shang de na xie yun ， wo men jiu neng kan dao ke lan duo 。]

english: Clouds surround the ship.
translation: 云围绕着船。 [yun wei rao zhe chuan 。]

english: Looks like there's a storm coming up, cap'n. Soon we won't be able to see anything!
translation: 看来一场风暴要来了，船长。很快我们就什么也看不见了！ [kan lai yi chang feng bao yao lai le ， chuan zhang 。 hen kuai wo men jiu shen me ye kan bu jian le ！]

english: Oh, well. The weather had been so good up until now.
translation: 那好吧。到目前为止，天气一直很好。 [na hao ba 。 dao mu qian wei zhi ， tian qi yi zhi hen hao 。]

english: Did you see that?
translation: 你看到了吗？ [ni kan dao le ma ？]

english: See what?
translation: 看到什么？ [kan dao shen me ？]

english: I thought I saw something up above us.
translation: 我想我看到了我们上方的东西。 [wo xiang wo kan dao le wo men shang fang de dong xi 。]

english: It's the dragon!
translation: 这是龙！ [zhe shi long ！]

english: We're going to sink!
translation: 我们要沉了！ [wo men yao chen le ！]

english: Look! Land ahead!
translation: 看！前方落地！ [kan ！ qian fang luo di ！]

english: We're going to crash!
translation: 我们要崩溃了！ [wo men yao beng kui le ！]

english: CRASH!
translation: 碰撞！ [peng zhuang ！]

english: You are knocked unconscious and later awake on an ash-strewn beach.
translation: 你被打昏，随后在布满灰烬的海滩上醒来。 [ni bei da hun ， sui hou zai bu man hui jin de hai tan shang xing lai 。]

english: Now I see why all the other captains said I'd be mad to go near Crandor. It looks like we're stranded.
translation: 现在我明白为什么所有其他船长都说我接近克兰多会发疯。看来我们被困了。 [xian zai wo ming bai wei shen me suo you qi ta chuan zhang dou shuo wo jie jin ke lan duo hui fa feng 。 kan lai wo men bei kun le 。]

english: Don't worry about that. I found a secret passage in the dragon's lair that leads off the island!
translation: 不用担心这个。我在龙穴里发现了一条通往岛屿的秘密通道！ [bu yong dan xin zhe ge 。 wo zai long xue li fa xian le yi tiao tong wang dao yu de mi mi tong dao ！]

english: Oh, that's good. I'll be able to get back to Draynor somehow,
translation: 哦，那很好。我能以某种方式回到德雷诺 [o ， na hen hao 。 wo neng yi mou zhong fang shi hui dao de lei nuo]

english: if I can sneak past all the skeletons and demons on this island!
translation: 如果我能偷偷溜过这座岛上所有的骷髅和恶魔就好了！ [ru guo wo neng tou tou liu guo zhe zuo dao shang suo you de ku lou he e mo jiu hao le ！]

english: Hello again, lad. Something I can help you with? Want to buy some rope perhaps?
translation: 再次你好，小伙子。有什么我可以帮你的吗？也许想买一些绳子？ [zai ci ni hao ， xiao huo zi 。 you shen me wo ke yi bang ni de ma ？ ye xu xiang mai yi xie sheng zi ？]

english: How did you get back from Crandor?
translation: 你是怎么从克兰多回来的？ [ni shi zen me cong ke lan duo hui lai de ？]

english: I got towed back by a passing friendly whale.
translation: 我被一头路过的友善鲸鱼拖了回来。 [wo bei yi tou lu guo de you shan jing yu tuo le hui lai 。]

english: Anyway, would you like me to make some rope while you're here?
translation: 不管怎样，你在这儿的时候你想让我做一些绳子吗？ [bu guan zen yang ， ni zai zhe er de shi hou ni xiang rang wo zuo yi xie sheng zi ma ？]

english: Can you take me back to Crandor again?
translation: 你能带我再次回到克兰多吗？ [ni neng dai wo zai ci hui dao ke lan duo ma ？]

english: Aye, that I could. I'll meet you at the Port Sarim docks again. I'll try to steer a little better this time!
translation: 是的，我可以。我会在沙里姆港码头再次见到你。这次我会努力驾驭得更好一点！ [shi de ， wo ke yi 。 wo hui zai sha li mu gang ma tou zai ci jian dao ni 。 zhe ci wo hui nu li jia yu de geng hao yi dian ！]

english: Why, hello there, [lad/lass]. Me friends call me Ned. I was a man of the sea, but it's past me now. Could I be making or selling you some rope?
translation: 嗨，你好，[小伙子/姑娘]。我的朋友们叫我内德。我曾经是个航海者，但现在已经过去了。我可以制作或卖给你一些绳子吗？ [hai ， ni hao ，[ xiao huo zi / gu niang ]。 wo de peng you men jiao wo nei de 。 wo ceng jing shi ge hang hai zhe ， dan xian zai yi jing guo qu le 。 wo ke yi zhi zuo huo mai gei ni yi xie sheng zi ma ？]

english: Yes, I would like some rope.
translation: 是的，我想要一些绳子。 [shi de ， wo xiang yao yi xie sheng zi 。]

english: Well, I can sell you some rope for 15 coins. Or I can be making you some if you gets me 4 balls of wool. I strands them together I does, makes em strong.
translation: 好吧，我可以 15 个硬币卖给你一些绳子。或者，如果你给我 4 个羊毛球，我可以给你做一些。我确实把它们绑在一起，让它们变得坚强。 [hao ba ， wo ke yi  15  ge ying bi mai gei ni yi xie sheng zi 。 huo zhe ， ru guo ni gei wo  4  ge yang mao qiu ， wo ke yi gei ni zuo yi xie 。 wo que shi ba ta men bang zai yi qi ， rang ta men bian de jian qiang 。]

english: You make rope from wool?
translation: 你用羊毛做绳子吗？ [ni yong yang mao zuo sheng zi ma ？]

english: Of course you can!
translation: 当然可以！ [dang ran ke yi ！]

english: I thought you needed hemp or jute.
translation: 我以为你需要大麻或黄麻。 [wo yi wei ni xu yao da ma huo huang ma 。]

english: Do you want some rope or not?
translation: 你想要一些绳子吗？ [ni xiang yao yi xie sheng zi ma ？]

english: You don't have enough coins to buy any rope!
translation: 您没有足够的金币来购买任何绳子！ [nin mei you zu gou de jin bi lai gou mai ren he sheng zi ！]

english: Okay, please sell me some rope.
translation: 好的，请卖给我一些绳子。 [hao de ， qing mai gei wo yi xie sheng zi 。]

english: There you go, finest rope in Gielinor.
translation: 就是这样，吉林诺最好的绳索。 [jiu shi zhe yang ， ji lin nuo zui hao de sheng suo 。]

english: You hand Ned 15 coins. Ned gives you a coil of rope.
translation: 你递给内德 15 个硬币。内德给了你一卷绳子。 [ni di gei nei de  15  ge ying bi 。 nei de gei le ni yi juan sheng zi 。]

english: Thanks. Hmmm, do you know something? This rope has a funny smell.
translation: 谢谢。嗯嗯，你知道什么吗？这根绳子有股怪味。 [xie xie 。 n n ， ni zhi dao shen me ma ？ zhe gen sheng zi you gu guai wei 。]

english: Really?
translation: 真的吗？ [zhen de ma ？]

english: Yes, It reminds me of...yaks. I was travelling in the Fremennik Isles recently and, do you know what? They made rope out of yak's hair.
translation: 是的，它让我想起了……牦牛。我最近在弗雷曼尼克群岛旅行，你知道吗？他们用牦牛毛制成绳子。 [shi de ， ta rang wo xiang qi le …… mao niu 。 wo zui jin zai fu lei man ni ke qun dao lv xing ， ni zhi dao ma ？ ta men yong mao niu mao zhi cheng sheng zi 。]

english: What a coincidence?
translation: 何等巧合？ [he deng qiao he ？]

english: There was a lady over there who sold wool, she said she traded rope for the wool.
translation: 那边有一位卖羊毛的女士，她说她用绳子换羊毛。 [na bian you yi wei mai yang mao de nv shi ， ta shuo ta yong sheng zi huan yang mao 。]

english: Who would have thought it?
translation: 谁会想到呢？ [shui hui xiang dao ne ？]

english: I don't think you make rope at all. I think you trade balls of wool for rope.
translation: 我认为你根本不做绳子。我认为你用羊毛球换绳子。 [wo ren wei ni gen ben bu zuo sheng zi 。 wo ren wei ni yong yang mao qiu huan sheng zi 。]

english: Oh, I confess. You have found the truth. I used to make the rope myself, but my fingers aren't as nimble as they used to be and so many people wanted my rope. Demand was so high I had to find another
translation: 哦，我承认。你已经找到了真相。我以前自己做绳子，但我的手指不像以前那么灵活，所以很多人想要我的绳子。需求如此之高，我不得不寻找另一个 [o ， wo cheng ren 。 ni yi jing zhao dao le zhen xiang 。 wo yi qian zi ji zuo sheng zi ， dan wo de shou zhi bu xiang yi qian na me ling huo ， suo yi hen duo ren xiang yao wo de sheng zi 。 xu qiu ru ci zhi gao ， wo bu de bu xun zhao ling yi ge]

english: source. But I couldn't tell anyone since Ned's Handmade Rope (100% Wool) is a high profile brand now.
translation: 来源。但我不能告诉任何人，因为 Ned 的手工绳索（100% 羊毛）现在是一个高知名度的品牌。 [lai yuan 。 dan wo bu neng gao su ren he ren ， yin wei  Ned  de shou gong sheng suo （100%  yang mao ） xian zai shi yi ge gao zhi ming du de pin pai 。]

english: Yes, well, the wool is still pretty good, though yak hair makes fine rope. I don't suppose any harm will come of it.
translation: 是的，虽然牦牛毛可以制成细绳，但羊毛仍然相当不错。我认为它不会造成任何伤害。 [shi de ， sui ran mao niu mao ke yi zhi cheng xi sheng ， dan yang mao reng ran xiang dang bu cuo 。 wo ren wei ta bu hui zao cheng ren he shang hai 。]

english: Thanks. Here take this, a free sample! Please, don't tell anyone.
translation: 谢谢。拿着这个，免费样品！请不要告诉任何人。 [xie xie 。 na zhe zhe ge ， mian fei yang pin ！ qing bu yao gao su ren he ren 。]

english: Well, it's always good to keep on the good side of a sailor. Your secret is safe with me.
translation: 嗯，作为一个水手，保持好的一面总是好的。你的秘密对我来说是安全的。 [n ， zuo wei yi ge shui shou ， bao chi hao de yi mian zong shi hao de 。 ni de mi mi dui wo lai shuo shi an quan de 。]

english: Oh, if you're in the Isles again, tell Jofridr that her Neddie will be there soon.
translation: 哦，如果你再次来到群岛，请告诉乔弗里德，她的内迪很快就会到那里。 [o ， ru guo ni zai ci lai dao qun dao ， qing gao su qiao fu li de ， ta de nei di hen kuai jiu hui dao na li 。]

english: I will do that!
translation: 我会这么做的！ [wo hui zhe me zuo de ！]

english: I have some balls of wool. Could you make me some rope?
translation: 我有一些羊毛球。你能给我做一些绳子吗？ [wo you yi xie yang mao qiu 。 ni neng gei wo zuo yi xie sheng zi ma ？]

english: Sure I can.
translation: 我当然可以。 [wo dang ran ke yi 。]

english: You hand over 4 balls of wool. Ned gives you a coil of rope.
translation: 你交出 4 个羊毛球。内德给了你一卷绳子。 [ni jiao chu  4  ge yang mao qiu 。 nei de gei le ni yi juan sheng zi 。]

english: That's a little more than I want to pay.
translation: 这比我想要支付的要多一点。 [zhe bi wo xiang yao zhi fu de yao duo yi dian 。]

english: Well, if you ever need rope that's the price. Sorry. An old sailor needs money for a little drop o' rum.
translation: 好吧，如果你需要绳子，那就是价格。对不起。一位老水手需要钱买一点朗姆酒。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni xu yao sheng zi ， na jiu shi jia ge 。 dui bu qi 。 yi wei lao shui shou xu yao qian mai yi dian lang mu jiu 。]

english: I will go and get some wool.
translation: 我去拿一些羊毛。 [wo qu na yi xie yang mao 。]

english: Aye, you do that. Remember, it takes 4 balls of wool to make strong rope.
translation: 是的，你就这么做。请记住，需要 4 个羊毛球才能制成坚固的绳子。 [shi de ， ni jiu zhe me zuo 。 qing ji zhu ， xu yao  4  ge yang mao qiu cai neng zhi cheng jian gu de sheng zi 。]

english: No thanks Ned, I don't need any.
translation: 不，谢谢内德，我不需要。 [bu ， xie xie nei de ， wo bu xu yao 。]

english: Well, old Neddy is always here if you do. Tell your friends. I can always be using the business.
translation: 好吧，如果你愿意的话，老内迪总是在这里。告诉你的朋友。我可以一直使用该业务。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， lao nei di zong shi zai zhe li 。 gao su ni de peng you 。 wo ke yi yi zhi shi yong gai ye wu 。]

english: Well done!
