translation: 干得好！ [gan de hao ！]

english: You've been given another clue!
translation: 你已经得到了另一条线索！ [ni yi jing de dao le ling yi tiao xian suo ！]

english: Good work! I have new information to share with you. Listen carefully, now!
translation: 干得好！我有新信息要与您分享。仔细听，现在！ [gan de hao ！ wo you xin xin xi yao yu nin fen xiang 。 zi xi ting ， xian zai ！]

english: A place 65 steps forward and 17 to the right needs an inspection. The weather vane up high will guide you in the right direction.
translation: 向前 65 步、向右 17 步的地方需要检查。高高的风向标会引导你走向正确的方向。 [xiang qian  65  bu 、 xiang you  17  bu de di fang xu yao jian cha 。 gao gao de feng xiang biao hui yin dao ni zou xiang zheng que de fang xiang 。]

english: Under the ground lies the next clue you seek. Getting it out requires a little technique.
translation: 地下隐藏着您寻找的下一条线索。把它拿出来需要一点技巧。 [di xia yin cang zhe nin xun zhao de xia yi tiao xian suo 。 ba ta na chu lai xu yao yi dian ji qiao 。]

english: You're a sailor? Could you take me to Crandor?
translation: 你是一名水手？你能带我去克兰多吗？ [ni shi yi ming shui shou ？ ni neng dai wo qu ke lan duo ma ？]

english: Yes, I would like some rope.
translation: 是的，我想要一些绳子。 [shi de ， wo xiang yao yi xie sheng zi 。]

english: No thanks, Ned. I don't need any.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，内德。我不需要任何。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， nei de 。 wo bu xu yao ren he 。]

english: Will you take me to Crandor now, then?
translation: 那么你现在可以带我去克兰多吗？ [na me ni xian zai ke yi dai wo qu ke lan duo ma ？]

english: Yes, let's go!
translation: 是的，我们走吧！ [shi de ， wo men zou ba ！]

english: No, I'm not quite ready yet.
translation: 不，我还没准备好。 [bu ， wo hai mei zhun bei hao 。]

english: How did you get back from Crandor?
translation: 你是怎么从克兰多回来的？ [ni shi zen me cong ke lan duo hui lai de ？]

english: Can you take me to Crandor again?
translation: 你能再带我去克兰多吗？ [ni neng zai dai wo qu ke lan duo ma ？]

english: No thanks Ned, I don't need any.
translation: 不，谢谢内德，我不需要。 [bu ， xie xie nei de ， wo bu xu yao 。]

english: Okay, please sell me some rope.
translation: 好的，请卖给我一些绳子。 [hao de ， qing mai gei wo yi xie sheng zi 。]

english: I have some balls of wool. Could you make me some rope?
translation: 我有一些羊毛球。你能给我做一些绳子吗？ [wo you yi xie yang mao qiu 。 ni neng gei wo zuo yi xie sheng zi ma ？]

english: That's a little more than I want to pay.
translation: 这比我想要支付的要多一点。 [zhe bi wo xiang yao zhi fu de yao duo yi dian 。]

english: I will go and get some wool.
translation: 我去拿一些羊毛。 [wo qu na yi xie yang mao 。]

english: I'm sorry to bother you, but could you spare me a little dung?
translation: 很抱歉打扰你，但是你能给我一点粪便吗？ [hen bao qian da rao ni ， dan shi ni neng gei wo yi dian fen bian ma ？]

english: The camel didn't seem to appreciate that question.
translation: 骆驼似乎不喜欢这个问题。 [luo tuo si hu bu xi huan zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab.
translation: 嗯……看起来那只骆驼可以做一顿美味的烤肉串。 [n …… kan qi lai na zhi luo tuo ke yi zuo yi dun mei wei de kao rou chuan 。]

english: If I go near that camel, it'll probably bite my hand off.
translation: 如果我靠近那头骆驼，它可能会咬掉我的手。 [ru guo wo kao jin na tou luo tuo ， ta ke neng hui yao diao wo de shou 。]

english: I wonder if that camel has fleas...
translation: 我想知道那只骆驼有没有跳蚤... [wo xiang zhi dao na zhi luo tuo you mei you tiao zao ...]

english: The camel tries to stamp on your foot, but you pull it back quickly.
translation: 骆驼试图踩你的脚，但你很快就把它拉了回来。 [luo tuo shi tu cai ni de jiao ， dan ni hen kuai jiu ba ta la le hui lai 。]

english: The camel turns its head and glares at you.
translation: 骆驼转过头来瞪着你。 [luo tuo zhuan guo tou lai deng zhe ni 。]

english: The camel spits at you, and you jump back hurriedly.
translation: 骆驼向你吐口水，你赶紧向后跳去。 [luo tuo xiang ni tu kou shui ， ni gan jin xiang hou tiao qu 。]

english: Are you serious?
translation: 你是认真的？ [ni shi ren zhen de ？]

english: Oh yes. If you'd be so kind...
translation: 哦是的。如果你能这么善良的话... [o shi de 。 ru guo ni neng zhe me shan liang de hua ...]

english: Well, just you close your eyes first. I'm not doing it while you're watching me!
translation: 好吧，你先闭上眼睛。当你看着我的时候我不会这么做！ [hao ba ， ni xian bi shang yan jing 。 dang ni kan zhe wo de shi hou wo bu hui zhe me zuo ！]

english: I hope that's what you wanted!
translation: 我希望这就是你想要的！ [wo xi wang zhe jiu shi ni xiang yao de ！]

english: Ohhh yes. Lovely.
translation: 噢，是的。迷人的。 [o ， shi de 。 mi ren de 。]

english: What was that?
translation: 那是什么？ [na shi shen me ？]

english: Er, nothing important.
translation: 呃，没什么重要的。 [e ， mei shen me zhong yao de 。]

english: Wait, you're a human, aren't you? Have you come from outside this town?
translation: 等等，你是人类，不是吗？你是从这个镇外来的吗？ [deng deng ， ni shi ren lei ， bu shi ma ？ ni shi cong zhe ge zhen wai lai de ma ？]

english: Yes, I have.
translation: 是的，我有。 [shi de ， wo you 。]

english: Oh, how wonderful! Does that mean I can finally leave this place and see the world outside?
translation: 噢，多么美妙啊！这是不是意味着我终于可以离开这里，看看外面的世界了？ [o ， duo me mei miao a ！ zhe shi bu shi yi wei zhe wo zhong yu ke yi li kai zhe li ， kan kan wai mian de shi jie le ？]

english: Wouldn't your master have to take you?
translation: 难道你的主人不需要带你去吗？ [nan dao ni de zhu ren bu xu yao dai ni qu ma ？]

english: The plagues mean that my master isn't allowed to leave. It's so boring here, and I'd like to travel.
translation: 瘟疫意味着我的主人不能离开。这里太无聊了，我想去旅行。 [wen yi yi wei zhe wo de zhu ren bu neng li kai 。 zhe li tai wu liao le ， wo xiang qu lv xing 。]

english: My master has no interest in leaving. It's so boring here, and I'd like to travel.
translation: 我的主人没有兴趣离开。这里太无聊了，我想去旅行。 [wo de zhu ren mei you xing qu li kai 。 zhe li tai wu liao le ， wo xiang qu lv xing 。]

english: Travelling's what camels do best, you know.
translation: 你知道，旅行是骆驼最擅长的事情。 [ni zhi dao ， lv xing shi luo tuo zui shan chang de shi qing 。]

english: I don't suppose you could take me with you, could you?
translation: 我想你不能带我一起去，可以吗？ [wo xiang ni bu neng dai wo yi qi qu ， ke yi ma ？]

english: How do I know you're not ill as well?
translation: 我怎么知道你也没有病？ [wo zen me zhi dao ni ye mei you bing ？]

english: Well, I haven't turned funny colours yet, so I'm probably not. Will you take me with you?
translation: 好吧，我还没有变成有趣的颜色，所以我可能不会。你愿意带我一起去吗？ [hao ba ， wo hai mei you bian cheng you qu de yan se ， suo yi wo ke neng bu hui 。 ni yuan yi dai wo yi qi qu ma ？]

english: I don't really have space for a camel, sorry.
translation: 抱歉，我实在没有空间容纳骆驼。 [bao qian ， wo shi zai mei you kong jian rong na luo tuo 。]

english: Oh well. Come back some time, and bring me news of the rest of the world.
translation: 那好吧。找个时间回来吧，给我带来世界其他地方的消息。 [na hao ba 。 zhao ge shi jian hui lai ba ， gei wo dai lai shi jie qi ta di fang de xiao xi 。]

english: Ask the camel about its dung.
translation: 向骆驼询问它的粪便。 [xiang luo tuo xun wen ta de fen bian 。]

english: Say something unpleasant.
translation: 说一些不愉快的话。 [shuo yi xie bu yu kuai de hua 。]

english: Neither - I'm a polite person.
translation: 都不是——我是一个有礼貌的人。 [dou bu shi —— wo shi yi ge you li mao de ren 。]

english: Hello there, are you interested in buying one of my special capes?
translation: 您好，您有兴趣购买我的一件特别斗篷吗？ [nin hao ， nin you xing qu gou mai wo de yi jian te bie dou peng ma ？]

english: What's so special about your capes?
translation: 你的斗篷有什么特别之处？ [ni de dou peng you shen me te bie zhi chu ？]

english: Ahh well they make it less likely that you'll accidently attack anyone wearing the same cape as you and easier to attack everyone else. They also make it easier to distinguish people who're wearing the same cape as you
translation: 啊，好吧，它们使你不太可能意外攻击任何穿着与你相同斗篷的人，并且更容易攻击其他人。它们还可以让您更轻松地区分与您穿着相同斗篷的人 [a ， hao ba ， ta men shi ni bu tai ke neng yi wai gong ji ren he chuan zhe yu ni xiang tong dou peng de ren ， bing qie geng rong yi gong ji qi ta ren 。 ta men hai ke yi rang nin geng qing song di qu fen yu nin chuan zhe xiang tong dou peng de ren]

english: from everyone else. They're very useful when out in the wilderness with friends or anyone else you don't want to harm.
translation: 来自其他人。当您与朋友或您不想伤害的其他人一起在荒野中时，它们非常有用。 [lai zi qi ta ren 。 dang nin yu peng you huo nin bu xiang shang hai de qi ta ren yi qi zai huang ye zhong shi ， ta men fei chang you yong 。]

english: So would you like to buy one?
translation: 那么您想买一个吗？ [na me nin xiang mai yi ge ma ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: What's so special about your capes?
translation: 你的斗篷有什么特别之处？ [ni de dou peng you shen me te bie zhi chu ？]

english: Yes please!
translation: 是的，请！ [shi de ， qing ！]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello. What's your name?
translation: 你好。你叫什么名字？ [ni hao 。 ni jiao shen me ming zi ？]

english: I shouldn't talk to strangers.
translation: 我不应该和陌生人说话。 [wo bu ying gai he mo sheng ren shuo hua 。]

english: Well, my name is [player name] and I'm pleased to meet you. So, now that I'm not a stranger anymore, what's your name?
translation: 嗯，我的名字是[玩家姓名]，很高兴认识你。那么，现在我不再是陌生人了，你叫什么名字？ [n ， wo de ming zi shi [ wan jia xing ming ]， hen gao xing ren shi ni 。 na me ， xian zai wo bu zai shi mo sheng ren le ， ni jiao shen me ming zi ？]

english: Hmm... Nice to meet you, [player name]. I'm Neite.
translation: 嗯...很高兴认识你，[玩家姓名]。我是奈特 [n ... hen gao xing ren shi ni ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。 wo shi nai te]

english: How come you're the only cat around here?
translation: 为什么你是这里唯一的猫？ [wei shen me ni shi zhe li wei yi de mao ？]

english: Oh there's far more than just me. The others are just shy. We do also get visitors from outside the city sometimes, like that Bob. He's quite a handsome beast...
translation: 噢，远不止我一个人。其他人只是害羞而已。有时我们也会接待来自城外的访客，就像鲍勃一样。真是一头英俊的野兽啊…… [o ， yuan bu zhi wo yi ge ren 。 qi ta ren zhi shi hai xiu er yi 。 you shi wo men ye hui jie dai lai zi cheng wai de fang ke ， jiu xiang bao bo yi yang 。 zhen shi yi tou ying jun de ye shou a ……]

english: Oh, I see. Romance is in the air, is it?
translation: 我懂了。空气中弥漫着浪漫的气息，不是吗？ [wo dong le 。 kong qi zhong mi man zhe lang man de qi xi ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Well, life here in the desert can be a lonely existence, even with all my busy work... Still, to be honest, he worries me.
translation: 好吧，即使我的工作很忙，沙漠里的生活也可能是孤独的……不过，说实话，他还是让我担心。 [hao ba ， ji shi wo de gong zuo hen mang ， sha mo li de sheng huo ye ke neng shi gu du de …… bu guo ， shuo shi hua ， ta hai shi rang wo dan xin 。]

english: In what way?
translation: 以什么方式？ [yi shen me fang shi ？]

english: Well, I pride myself on my knowledge of the family lines of cats. Obviously, Bob features quite heavily in most family trees, but he himself has none!
translation: 嗯，我为自己对猫科系的了解而感到自豪。显然，鲍勃在大多数家谱中都占有重要地位，但他本人却没有！ [n ， wo wei zi ji dui mao ke xi de liao jie er gan dao zi hao 。 xian ran ， bao bo zai da duo shu jia pu zhong du zhan you zhong yao di wei ， dan ta ben ren que mei you ！]

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你是什​​么意思？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: Nobody is sure where he came from. Not even the Sphinx knows. It's just one of those mysteries.
translation: 没有人知道他来自哪里。就连狮身人面像也不知道。这只是这些谜团之一。 [mei you ren zhi dao ta lai zi na li 。 jiu lian shi shen ren mian xiang ye bu zhi dao 。 zhe zhi shi zhe xie mi tuan zhi yi 。]

english: Interesting...
translation: 有趣的... [you qu de ...]

english: What are you doing?
translation: 你在干什么？ [ni zai gan shen me ？]

english: I'm hunting frogs and locusts.
translation: 我正在捕青蛙和蝗虫。 [wo zheng zai bu qing wa he huang chong 。]

english: Why? Do they taste good?
translation: 为什么？它们味道好吗？ [wei shen me ？ ta men wei dao hao ma ？]

english: Yuck! No, I would never debase myself to eat such filth.
translation: 哎呀！不，我绝不会贬低自己去吃这种肮脏的东西。 [ai ya ！ bu ， wo jue bu hui bian di zi ji qu chi zhe zhong ang zang de dong xi 。]

english: I see you're a cat of taste then.
translation: 我看你是一只很有品味的猫。 [wo kan ni shi yi zhi hen you pin wei de mao 。]

english: I am a cat of high breeding! My family tree dates back before those of any ruler on Gielinor.
translation: 我是一只高素质的猫！我的家谱可以追溯到吉林诺任何统治者的家谱之前。 [wo shi yi zhi gao su zhi di mao ！ wo de jia pu ke yi zhui su dao ji lin nuo ren he tong zhi zhe de jia pu zhi qian 。]

english: What do you do with the frogs and locusts?
translation: 你如何处理青蛙和蝗虫？ [ni ru he chu li qing wa he huang chong ？]

english: What do you mean by 'do'?
translation: 你说的“做”是什么意思？ [ni shuo de “ zuo ” shi shen me yi si ？]

english: Well, seeing as you're hunting them, I thought you'd eat them too.
translation: 好吧，既然你在猎杀它们，我以为你也会吃掉它们。 [hao ba ， ji ran ni zai lie sha ta men ， wo yi wei ni ye hui chi diao ta men 。]

english: No, no, I just hunt them, play with them for a bit and then kill them.
translation: 不，不，我只是猎杀它们，和它们玩一会儿，然后杀掉它们。 [bu ， bu ， wo zhi shi lie sha ta men ， he ta men wan yi hui er ， ran hou sha diao ta men 。]

english: Isn't that a little evil?
translation: 这不是有点邪恶吗？ [zhe bu shi you dian xie e ma ？]

english: What's evil about a little destruction?
translation: 一点点的破坏有什么坏处呢？ [yi dian dian de po huai you shen me huai chu ne ？]

english: What isn't? You destroy and take away life. What good is there in that?
translation: 什么不是？你摧毁并夺走了生命。这有什么好处呢？ [shen me bu shi ？ ni cui hui bing duo zou le sheng ming 。 zhe you shen me hao chu ne ？]

english: Life can come from destruction too. Take a volcano. It will destroy all life that surrounds it, but it will also fertilise and enrich the surrounding earth.
translation: 生命也可以来自毁灭。拿一座火山来说。它会摧毁周围的所有生命，但也会使周围的地球变得肥沃和丰富。 [sheng ming ye ke yi lai zi hui mie 。 na yi zuo huo shan lai shuo 。 ta hui cui hui zhou wei de suo you sheng ming ， dan ye hui shi zhou wei de di qiu bian de fei wo he feng fu 。]

english: From that earth, more life will spring forth than there was in the first place.
translation: 从那个地球上，将会出现比最初更多的生命。 [cong na ge di qiu shang ， jiang hui chu xian bi zui chu geng duo de sheng ming 。]

english: How do you compare killing frogs to a volcano? A volcano has no choice about whether it explodes or not, but you do have a choice.
translation: 你如何将杀死青蛙与火山相比较？火山无法选择是否爆发，但你可以选择。 [ni ru he jiang sha si qing wa yu huo shan xiang bi jiao ？ huo shan wu fa xuan ze shi fou bao fa ， dan ni ke yi xuan ze 。]

english: I disagree. It's in my nature to prey on smaller life forms in the same way as it is in the volcanoes nature to explode.
translation: 我不同意。捕食较小的生命体是我的本性，就像火山爆发的本性一样。 [wo bu tong yi 。 bu shi jiao xiao de sheng ming ti shi wo de ben xing ， jiu xiang huo shan bao fa de ben xing yi yang 。]

english: Don't they sometimes call the Devourer the goddess of destruction? You seem to have a lot in common with a goddess that your kind oppose.
translation: 他们有时不是称吞噬者为毁灭女神吗？你似乎与你的种族所反对的女神有很多共同点。 [ta men you shi bu shi cheng tun shi zhe wei hui mie nv shen ma ？ ni si hu yu ni de zhong zu suo fan dui de nv shen you hen duo gong tong dian 。]

english: That is not too surprising. A long time ago, I served her. Her form has changed a lot since then, just as mine has.
translation: 这并不奇怪。很久以前，我就服侍过她。从那时起，她的形态发生了很大变化，就像我的一样。 [zhe bing bu qi guai 。 hen jiu yi qian ， wo jiu fu shi guo ta 。 cong na shi qi ， ta de xing tai fa sheng le hen da bian hua ， jiu xiang wo de yi yang 。]

english: You mean you weren't always a cat?
translation: 你的意思是你并不总是一只猫？ [ni de yi si shi ni bing bu zong shi yi zhi mao ？]

english: No, I used to be human. At the time when Amascut became the Devourer, I was one of her chief priestesses.
translation: 不，我曾经是人类。当阿马斯库特成为吞噬者时，我是她的首席女祭司之一。 [bu ， wo ceng jing shi ren lei 。 dang a ma si ku te cheng wei tun shi zhe shi ， wo shi ta de shou xi nv ji si zhi yi 。]

english: So you stopped serving her because of that change?
translation: 所以你因为这个改变就不再为她服务了？ [suo yi ni yin wei zhe ge gai bian jiu bu zai wei ta fu wu le ？]

english: Not initially. Many of us tolerated her new habits for some time. She went too far though, so we took action.
translation: 最初不是。我们中的许多人都容忍了她的新习惯一段时间。但她做得太过分了，所以我们采取了行动。 [zui chu bu shi 。 wo men zhong de xu duo ren dou rong ren le ta de xin xi guan yi duan shi jian 。 dan ta zuo de tai guo fen le ， suo yi wo men cai qu le xing dong 。]

english: What did you do?
translation: 你做了什么？ [ni zuo le shen me ？]

english: The last of her priestesses gathered and cursed her. Unfortunately, she also cast a spell of her own, condemning us to an eternity of walking Gielinor in her form.
translation: 她最后的女祭司聚集在一起诅咒她。不幸的是，她也施展了自己的咒语，让我们永远以她的形态行走在吉莉诺身上。 [ta zui hou de nv ji si ju ji zai yi qi zu zhou ta 。 bu xing de shi ， ta ye shi zhan le zi ji de zhou yu ， rang wo men yong yuan yi ta de xing tai xing zou zai ji li nuo shen shang 。]

english: So she's a cat then?
translation: 那么她是一只猫吗？ [na me ta shi yi zhi mao ma ？]

english: She's as much of a cat as Icthlarin is a dog.
translation: 她就像一只猫，就像伊克拉林是一只狗一样。 [ta jiu xiang yi zhi mao ， jiu xiang yi ke la lin shi yi zhi gou yi yang 。]

english: What curse did you cast upon her?
translation: 你对她下了什么诅咒？ [ni dui ta xia le shen me zu zhou ？]

english: We trapped her in a human form, limiting her power. We also cursed her to never be willing worshipped again, though I fear that curse has started to wane.
translation: 我们将她困在人类形态中，限制了她的力量。我们还诅咒她永远不再愿意被崇拜，尽管我担心诅咒已经开始减弱。 [wo men jiang ta kun zai ren lei xing tai zhong ， xian zhi le ta de li liang 。 wo men hai zu zhou ta yong yuan bu zai yuan yi bei chong bai ， jin guan wo dan xin zu zhou yi jing kai shi jian ruo 。]

english: So that's why she's scared of cats?
translation: 所以这就是她害怕猫的原因？ [suo yi zhe jiu shi ta hai pa mao de yuan yin ？]

english: Indeed. There are fewer of us priestesses left now, but we still hold enough power to be quite the problem for her.
translation: 的确。现在我们女祭司的人数已经很少了，但我们仍然拥有足够的力量，对她来说是一个很大的问题。 [di que 。 xian zai wo men nv ji si de ren shu yi jing hen shao le ， dan wo men reng ran yong you zu gou de li liang ， dui ta lai shuo shi yi ge hen da de wen ti 。]

english: Do you talk to the Sphinx much?
translation: 你和狮身人面像谈得很多吗？ [ni he shi shen ren mian xiang tan de hen duo ma ？]

english: Not really. She is normally too wrapped up in preserving her immortality to be making conversation.
translation: 并不真地。她通常太专注于保持自己的不朽，无法与人交谈。 [bing bu zhen di 。 ta tong chang tai zhuan zhu yu bao chi zi ji de bu xiu ， wu fa yu ren jiao tan 。]

english: So you don't like her then?
translation: 那你不喜欢她了？ [na ni bu xi huan ta le ？]

english: Nothing of the sorts. I have nothing but respect for her.
translation: 没什么。我除了尊重她什么都没有。 [mei shen me 。 wo chu le zun zhong ta shen me dou mei you 。]

english: Why is that?
translation: 这是为什么？ [zhe shi wei shen me ？]

english: Well, because her immortality is based on the fact that she keeps us cats safe. Her whole existence is dedicated to protecting us.
translation: 嗯，因为她的不朽是基于她保护我们猫的安全。她的整个存在都是为了保护我们。 [n ， yin wei ta de bu xiu shi ji yu ta bao hu wo men mao de an quan 。 ta de zheng ge cun zai dou shi wei le bao hu wo men 。]

english: That doesn't seem like much of a life.
translation: 这看起来不像是一种生活。 [zhe kan qi lai bu xiang shi yi zhong sheng huo 。]

english: True. Life shouldn't be hoarded, but lived. Of course, don't tell her I said that, otherwise I'd have to be on the lookout for a new guardian.
translation: 真的。生命不应该被囤积，而应该被活出。当然，不要告诉她我这么说过，否则我就得寻找新的监护人了。 [zhen de 。 sheng ming bu ying gai bei tun ji ， er ying gai bei huo chu 。 dang ran ， bu yao gao su ta wo zhe me shuo guo ， fou ze wo jiu de xun zhao xin de jian hu ren le 。]

english: Tell me about you and the Devourer.
translation: 告诉我关于你和吞噬者的事。 [gao su wo guan yu ni he tun shi zhe de shi 。]

english: Before she was the goddess of destruction, she was Amascut, the goddess of rebirth. Back then, I was human, and I served as one of her chief priestesses.
translation: 在她成为毁灭女神之前，她是重生女神阿马斯库特。那时，我是人类，担任她的女祭司长之一。 [zai ta cheng wei hui mie nv shen zhi qian ， ta shi chong sheng nv shen a ma si ku te 。 na shi ， wo shi ren lei ， dan ren ta de nv ji si zhang zhi yi 。]

english: When she became the Devourer, many of us tolerated her new habits for some time. After all, destruction was key to being the goddess of rebirth, so it was something we were comfortable with.
translation: 当她成为吞噬者后，我们中的许多人在一段时间内容忍了她的新习惯。毕竟，破坏是成为重生女神的关键，所以这是我们感到满意的事情。 [dang ta cheng wei tun shi zhe hou ， wo men zhong de xu duo ren zai yi duan shi jian nei rong ren le ta de xin xi guan 。 bi jing ， po huai shi cheng wei chong sheng nv shen de guan jian ， suo yi zhe shi wo men gan dao man yi de shi qing 。]

english: But she went too far?
translation: 但她太过分了吗？ [dan ta tai guo fen le ma ？]

english: Yes, so we took action. The last of her priestesses gathered and cursed her. Unfortunately, she also cast a spell of her own, condemning us to an eternity of walking Gielinor in her form.
translation: 是的，所以我们采取了行动。她最后的女祭司聚集在一起诅咒她。不幸的是，她也施展了自己的咒语，让我们永远以她的形态行走在吉莉诺身上。 [shi de ， suo yi wo men cai qu le xing dong 。 ta zui hou de nv ji si ju ji zai yi qi zu zhou ta 。 bu xing de shi ， ta ye shi zhan le zi ji de zhou yu ， rang wo men yong yuan yi ta de xing tai xing zou zai ji li nuo shen shang 。]

english: Our curse trapped her in a human form, limiting her power. We also cursed her to never be willing worshipped again, though I fear that curse has started to wane.
translation: 我们的诅咒将她困在人类形态中，限制了她的力量。我们还诅咒她永远不再愿意被崇拜，尽管我担心诅咒已经开始减弱。 [wo men de zu zhou jiang ta kun zai ren lei xing tai zhong ， xian zhi le ta de li liang 。 wo men hai zu zhou ta yong yuan bu zai yuan yi bei chong bai ， jin guan wo dan xin zu zhou yi jing kai shi jian ruo 。]

english: I'll leave you to it.
translation: 我就让你去吧。 [wo jiu rang ni qu ba 。]

english: Hello again, Neite.
translation: 再次你好，内特。 [zai ci ni hao ， nei te 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Where's Bob?
translation: 鲍勃在哪里？ [bao bo zai na li ？]

english: Out gallivanting. I think he's hunting noobs in the Wilderness this time. You know what he's like.
translation: 出去撒泼。我想他这次是在荒野里猎杀新手。你知道他是什么样的人。 [chu qu sa po 。 wo xiang ta zhe ci shi zai huang ye li lie sha xin shou 。 ni zhi dao ta shi shen me yang de ren 。]

english: So, why aren't you out there with him?
translation: 那么，你为什么不和他在一起呢？ [na me ， ni wei shen me bu he ta zai yi qi ne ？]

english: I like to roam as much as the next cat, but, every so often, I do like to come home.
translation: 我和其他猫一样喜欢闲逛，但是，时不时地，我确实喜欢回家。 [wo he qi ta mao yi yang xi huan xian guang ， dan shi ， shi bu shi di ， wo que shi xi huan hui jia 。]

english: So, you and Bob haven't had an argument?
translation: 那么，你和鲍勃没有吵架吗？ [na me ， ni he bao bo mei you chao jia ma ？]

english: Who told you that?
translation: 谁告诉你的？ [shui gao su ni de ？]

english: Er... nobody.
translation: 呃……没有人。 [e …… mei you ren 。]

english: He's meant to be with you. You haven't lost him have you?
translation: 他注定要和你在一起。你还没有失去他吧？ [ta zhu ding yao he ni zai yi qi 。 ni hai mei you shi qu ta ba ？]

english: I don't think so.
translation: 我不这么认为。 [wo bu zhe me ren wei 。]

english: Well keep an eye on him for me.
translation: 那就替我留意一下他吧。 [na jiu ti wo liu yi yi xia ta ba 。]

english: How come you're the only cat around here?
translation: 为什么你是这里唯一的猫？ [wei shen me ni shi zhe li wei yi de mao ？]

english: What are you doing?
translation: 你在干什么？ [ni zai gan shen me ？]

english: Do you talk to the Sphinx much?
translation: 你和狮身人面像谈得很多吗？ [ni he shi shen ren mian xiang tan de hen duo ma ？]

english: Where's Bob?
translation: 鲍勃在哪里？ [bao bo zai na li ？]

english: Tell me about you and the Devourer.
translation: 告诉我关于你和吞噬者的事。 [gao su wo guan yu ni he tun shi zhe de shi 。]

english: I'll leave you to it.
translation: 我就让你去吧。 [wo jiu rang ni qu ba 。]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 你知道，打招呼的方式有很多种。你好，你好，你好…… [ni zhi dao ， da zhao hu de fang shi you hen duo zhong 。 ni hao ， ni hao ， ni hao ……]

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 那还是只能算一个！ [na hai shi zhi neng suan yi ge ！]

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。你今天怎么样？ [ni hao 。 ni jin tian zen me yang ？]

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很棒，谢谢你！ [wo hen bang ， xie xie ni ！]

english: Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 你好！水晶城里今天过得怎么样啊？ [ni hao ！ shui jing cheng li jin tian guo de zen me yang a ？]

english: Indeed.
translation: 的确。 [di que 。]

english: What can I do for ya?
translation: 我能为你做什么？ [wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 各种各样的事情！这些塔楼是一个美妙的景观。 [ge zhong ge yang de shi qing ！ zhe xie ta lou shi yi ge mei miao de jing guan 。]

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 在像今天这样的日子，我建议您参观市场。 [zai xiang jin tian zhe yang de ri zi ， wo jian yi nin can guan shi chang 。]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你认为你在做什么？ [ni ren wei ni zai zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: Nilsal, traveller.
translation: 尼尔萨尔，旅行者。 [ni er sa er ， lv xing zhe 。]

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
translation: 你能治愈我吗？我受伤了。 [ni neng zhi yu wo ma ？ wo shou shang le 。]

english: Sorry, but I cannot.
translation: 抱歉，但我不能。 [bao qian ， dan wo bu neng 。]

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: The nelta whispers a prayer and you suddenly feel a bit better.
translation: 内尔塔低声祈祷，你突然感觉好一点了。 [nei er ta di sheng qi dao ， ni tu ran gan jue hao yi dian le 。]

english: So what do you do?
translation: 那么你做什么呢？ [na me ni zuo shen me ne ？]

english: I am a nelta in service to Ralos.
translation: 我是为拉洛斯服务的内尔塔人。 [wo shi wei la luo si fu wu de nei er ta ren 。]

english: What's a nelta?
translation: 什么是内尔塔？ [shen me shi nei er ta ？]

english: We are the faithful servants of Ralos. We serve in a variety of roles across the Church of Ralos.
translation: 我们是拉洛斯忠实的仆人。我们在拉洛斯教会扮演着各种角色。 [wo men shi la luo si zhong shi de pu ren 。 wo men zai la luo si jiao hui ban yan zhe ge zhong jue se 。]

english: So kind of like a priest?
translation: 这么像牧师？ [zhe me xiang mu shi ？]

english: Yes, I believe that would be the closest comparison to the Church of Saradomin, though I am no expert on their practices.
translation: 是的，我相信这将是与萨拉多明教堂最接近的比较，尽管我不是他们实践的专家。 [shi de ， wo xiang xin zhe jiang shi yu sa la duo ming jiao tang zui jie jin de bi jiao ， jin guan wo bu shi ta men shi jian de zhuan jia 。]

english: Above us mere neltas are the teoki, leaders of the key temples across the kingdom. And of course, above them you have the Teokan himself.
translation: 在我们之上的只是内尔塔斯，是泰奥基（teoki），他们是王国各地主要寺庙的领导者。当然，在他们之上还有 Teokan 本人。 [zai wo men zhi shang de zhi shi nei er ta si ， shi tai ao ji （teoki）， ta men shi wang guo ge di zhu yao si miao de ling dao zhe 。 dang ran ， zai ta men zhi shang hai you  Teokan  ben ren 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This is the Teomat, home to both the Church of Ralos and the Sect of Ranul. The first and only time that Ralos appeared to us, he did so here on Ralos' Rise. The Teomat was built here as a result.
translation: 这里是特奥马特 (Teomat)，是拉洛斯教堂和拉努尔教派的所在地。拉洛斯第一次也是唯一一次出现在我们面前，是在拉洛斯高地。因此，Teomat 就在这里建造。 [zhe li shi te ao ma te  (Teomat)， shi la luo si jiao tang he la nu er jiao pai de suo zai di 。 la luo si di yi ci ye shi wei yi yi ci chu xian zai wo men mian qian ， shi zai la luo si gao di 。 yin ci ，Teomat  jiu zai zhe li jian zao 。]

english: I'd best get going.
translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: May the sun light your way.
translation: 愿阳光照亮你的路。 [yuan yang guang zhao liang ni de lu 。]

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
translation: 你能治愈我吗？我受伤了。 [ni neng zhi yu wo ma ？ wo shou shang le 。]

english: So what do you do?
translation: 那么你做什么呢？ [na me ni zuo shen me ne ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: I'd best get going.
translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: Adventurer.
translation: 冒险家。 [mao xian jia 。]

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
translation: 你能治愈我吗？我受伤了。 [ni neng zhi yu wo ma ？ wo shou shang le 。]

english: I would suggest you seek out a member of the Church of Ralos for that sort of thing. We are more concerned with the dead than the living.
translation: 我建议你去找拉洛斯教会的成员来处理这类事情。我们更关心死者而不是生者。 [wo jian yi ni qu zhao la luo si jiao hui de cheng yuan lai chu li zhe lei shi qing 。 wo men geng guan xin si zhe er bu shi sheng zhe 。]

english: So what do you do?
translation: 那么你做什么呢？ [na me ni zuo shen me ne ？]

english: I am a nelta of the Sect of Ranul.
translation: 我是拉努尔教派的内尔塔人。 [wo shi la nu er jiao pai de nei er ta ren 。]

english: What's a nelta?
translation: 什么是内尔塔？ [shen me shi nei er ta ？]

english: Both the Church of Ralos and the Sect of Ranul has neltas. For those of us dedicated to Ranul, our primary duty is to care for the dead and prepare them for their journey through the Gates of Mictl.

english: What is Deadman mode?
translation: 什么是亡灵模式？ [shen me shi wang ling mo shi ？]

english: Deadman mode is an incredibly dangerous survival game mode. Anyone can attack anyone, anywhere. Death comes at a huge cost and killing other players can be extremely lucrative.
translation: 亡灵模式是一种极其危险的生存游戏模式。任何人都可以在任何地方攻击任何人。死亡需要付出巨大的代价，杀死其他玩家可能会带来巨大的利润。 [wang ling mo shi shi yi zhong ji qi wei xian de sheng cun you xi mo shi 。 ren he ren dou ke yi zai ren he di fang gong ji ren he ren 。 si wang xu yao fu chu ju da de dai jia ， sha si qi ta wan jia ke neng hui dai lai ju da de li run 。]

english: Lucrative, you say?
translation: 你说有利可图？ [ni shuo you li ke tu ？]

english: Killing a player will earn you all of the items they had on them, plus the 10 most valuable items from their bank. The unfortunate soul will also lose half of their experience in most skills, or a quarter if they were not skulled. Regardless, it's quite the set-back.
translation: 杀死一名玩家将为您赢得他们身上的所有物品，以及他们银行中的 10 件最有价值的物品。不幸的灵魂也会在大多数技能上失去一半的经验，如果他们没有被骷髅的话，就会失去四分之一。不管怎样，这确实是一个很大的挫折。 [sha si yi ming wan jia jiang wei nin ying de ta men shen shang de suo you wu pin ， yi ji ta men yin hang zhong de  10  jian zui you jia zhi de wu pin 。 bu xing de ling hun ye hui zai da duo shu ji neng shang shi qu yi ban de jing yan ， ru guo ta men mei you bei ku lou de hua ， jiu hui shi qu si fen zhi yi 。 bu guan zen yang ， zhe que shi shi yi ge hen da de cuo zhe 。]

english: Wow, that is brutal!
translation: 哇，这太残酷了！ [wa ， zhe tai can ku le ！]

english: It is, but it is no simple task to kill someone in Deadman mode.
translation: 确实如此，但在亡灵模式下杀死某人并不是一件简单的任务。 [que shi ru ci ， dan zai wang ling mo shi xia sha si mou ren bing bu shi yi jian jian dan de ren wu 。]

english: Very high level guards patrol every major city and bank. They will kill anyone who has a skull. Getting yourself a kill is only half the battle.
translation: 每个主要城市和银行都有高级警卫巡逻。他们会杀死任何有头骨的人。杀掉自己只是成功的一半。 [mei ge zhu yao cheng shi he yin hang dou you gao ji jing wei xun luo 。 ta men hui sha si ren he you tou gu de ren 。 sha diao zi ji zhi shi cheng gong de yi ban 。]

english: How do I play Deadman mode?
translation: 如何玩死人模式？ [ru he wan si ren mo shi ？]

english: You can log into Deadman mode by selecting a Deadman mode world from the world list before you log in.
translation: 您可以在登录前从世界列表中选择一个 Deadman 模式世界来登录 Deadman 模式。 [nin ke yi zai deng lu qian cong shi jie lie biao zhong xuan ze yi ge  Deadman  mo shi shi jie lai deng lu  Deadman  mo shi 。]

english: So I don't need a new account to play Deadman mode?
translation: 那么我不需要新帐户就可以玩Deadman模式吗？ [na me wo bu xu yao xin zhang hu jiu ke yi wan Deadman mo shi ma ？]

english: Nope! You can use your existing account on a Deadman world, providing you have membership.
translation: 没有！只要您拥有会员资格，您就可以在 Deadman 世界中使用您现有的帐户。 [mei you ！ zhi yao nin yong you hui yuan zi ge ， nin jiu ke yi zai  Deadman  shi jie zhong shi yong nin xian you de zhang hu 。]

english: Do my stats and items transfer over to Deadman mode?
translation: 我的统计数据和物品会转移到亡灵模式吗？ [wo de tong ji shu ju he wu pin hui zhuan yi dao wang ling mo shi ma ？]

english: No, they do not. Your Deadman mode progress is completely separate from normal Old School worlds.
translation: 不，他们没有。你的亡灵模式进度与普通的旧派世界完全不同。 [bu ， ta men mei you 。 ni de wang ling mo shi jin du yu pu tong de jiu pai shi jie wan quan bu tong 。]

english: What happens when I die in Deadman mode?
translation: 当我在亡灵模式中死亡时会发生什么？ [dang wo zai wang ling mo shi zhong si wang shi hui fa sheng shen me ？]

english: If you die to a player you will lose the 10 most valuable stacks of items from your bank, all items that you have on your person and half of the experience you have gained in any unprotected skills.
translation: 如果您死于玩家手中，您将失去银行中 10 堆最有价值的物品、您身上的所有物品以及您在任何不受保护的技能中获得的一半经验。 [ru guo nin si yu wan jia shou zhong ， nin jiang shi qu yin hang zhong  10  dui zui you jia zhi de wu pin 、 nin shen shang de suo you wu pin yi ji nin zai ren he bu shou bao hu de ji neng zhong huo de de yi ban jing yan 。]

english: If you die to a monster when you have a PK skull you will lose the 10 most valuable stacks of items from your bank, all items that you have on your person and half of the experience you have gained in any unprotected skills.
translation: 如果你在拥有 PK 头骨时死于怪物，你将失去银行中最有价值的 10 堆物品、你身上的所有物品以及你在任何不受保护的技能中获得的一半经验。 [ru guo ni zai yong you  PK  tou gu shi si yu guai wu ， ni jiang shi qu yin hang zhong zui you jia zhi de  10  dui wu pin 、 ni shen shang de suo you wu pin yi ji ni zai ren he bu shou bao hu de ji neng zhong huo de de yi ban jing yan 。]

english: If you die to a monster when you do not have a PK skull you will lose all of the items on your person except for the 3 most valuable. You will not lose experience or any items from your bank.
translation: 如果你在没有 PK 头骨的情况下死于怪物，你将失去身上的所有物品，除了 3 个最有价值的物品。您不会丢失经验或银行中的任何物品。 [ru guo ni zai mei you  PK  tou gu de qing kuang xia si yu guai wu ， ni jiang shi qu shen shang de suo you wu pin ， chu le  3  ge zui you jia zhi de wu pin 。 nin bu hui diu shi jing yan huo yin hang zhong de ren he wu pin 。]

english: What happens when I kill a player in Deadman mode?
translation: 当我在亡灵模式中杀死一名玩家时会发生什么？ [dang wo zai wang ling mo shi zhong sha si yi ming wan jia shi hui fa sheng shen me ？]

english: When you kill a player you will receive any items they have on their person and you will also be given a key. You can use this key on Deadman chests found in various banks across the map. Within the chest you will

english: find the 10 most valuable stacks of items from the bank of the player you struck down. From here you will be able to choose the items you would like to keep.
translation: 从你击倒的玩家的银行中找到 10 堆最有价值的物品。从这里您将能够选择您想要保留的项目。 [cong ni ji dao de wan jia de yin hang zhong zhao dao  10  dui zui you jia zhi de wu pin 。 cong zhe li nin jiang neng gou xuan ze nin xiang yao bao liu de xiang mu 。]

english: How can I protect my items in Deadman mode?
translation: 如何在 Deadman 模式下保护我的物品？ [ru he zai  Deadman  mo shi xia bao hu wo de wu pin ？]

english: You can protect up to 10 items by placing them in your safe deposit box. Items in your safe deposit box will not be lost to a player who kills you, unlike those found in your bank. Remember that you can only place 10 single items into your safe deposit box, no stacks.
translation: 您可以将最多 10 件物品放入保险箱中进行保护。与银行中的物品不同，你的保险箱中的物品不会因为杀死你的玩家而丢失。请记住，您只能将 10 件单件物品放入保险箱，不得堆叠。 [nin ke yi jiang zui duo  10  jian wu pin fang ru bao xian xiang zhong jin xing bao hu 。 yu yin hang zhong de wu pin bu tong ， ni de bao xian xiang zhong de wu pin bu hui yin wei sha si ni de wan jia er diu shi 。 qing ji zhu ， nin zhi neng jiang  10  jian dan jian wu pin fang ru bao xian xiang ， bu de dui die 。]

english: How can I protect my stats in Deadman mode?
translation: 如何在 Deadman 模式下保护我的统计数据？ [ru he zai  Deadman  mo shi xia bao hu wo de tong ji shu ju ？]

english: You can protect your levels in up to 2 combat skills and 3 non-combat skills. You can choose which by opening your items lost on death interface found in your equipment tab. Choose wisely!
translation: 您可以通过最多 2 种战斗技能和 3 种非战斗技能来保护您的等级。您可以通过打开设备选项卡中的死亡界面丢失的物品来选择哪个。明智地选择！ [nin ke yi tong guo zui duo  2  zhong zhan dou ji neng he  3  zhong fei zhan dou ji neng lai bao hu nin de deng ji 。 nin ke yi tong guo da kai she bei xuan xiang ka zhong de si wang jie mian diu shi de wu pin lai xuan ze na ge 。 ming zhi di xuan ze ！]

english: You should be warned however. If you get killed by a guard, you will lose a tenth of your experience in those skills too!
translation: 不过，您应该受到警告。如果你被守卫杀死，你的技能经验值也会损失十分之一！ [bu guo ， nin ying gai shou dao jing gao 。 ru guo ni bei shou wei sha si ， ni de ji neng jing yan zhi ye hui sun shi shi fen zhi yi ！]

english: Gelin over there also has some deals on insuring your hitpoints, speak to her to find out more about that.
translation: 那边的格林也有一些关于确保生命值的优惠，请与她交谈以了解更多信息。 [na bian de ge lin ye you yi xie guan yu que bao sheng ming zhi de you hui ， qing yu ta jiao tan yi liao jie geng duo xin xi 。]

english: What are safe zones in Deadman mode?
translation: Deadman 模式中的安全区是什么？ [Deadman  mo shi zhong de an quan qu shi shen me ？]

english: Safe zones are areas patrolled by very high level guards which can be found in various places across the map. The guards watch out for any player with a PK skull and will attack them if they're spotted. It is still possible to be attacked inside safe zones but the person doing the attacking will not stand a chance of making it out alive.
translation: 安全区是由非常高级的警卫巡逻的区域，可以在地图上的各个地方找到。守卫会留意任何带有 PK 头骨的玩家，如果被发现就会攻击他们。在安全区内仍然有可能受到攻击，但进行攻击的人没有机会活着出来。 [an quan qu shi you fei chang gao ji de jing wei xun luo de qu yu ， ke yi zai di tu shang de ge ge di fang zhao dao 。 shou wei hui liu yi ren he dai you  PK  tou gu de wan jia ， ru guo bei fa xian jiu hui gong ji ta men 。 zai an quan qu nei reng ran you ke neng shou dao gong ji ， dan jin xing gong ji de ren mei you ji hui huo zhe chu lai 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Aha, blood money, the currency of a warrior! You must be rewarded! What would you like?
translation: 啊哈，血钱，战士的货币！你必须得到奖励！你要什么？ [a ha ， xue qian ， zhan shi de huo bi ！ ni bi xu de dao jiang li ！ ni yao shen me ？]

english: More blood money! I commend you on your strength. What item would you like this time?

english: More blood money! Truly the blood lust is strong in you. Here, take this final item. You deserve it!
translation: 血汗钱多了！你的嗜血欲望确实很强烈。在这里，拿走最后一个项目。你值得拥有！ [xue han qian duo le ！ ni de shi xue yu wang que shi hen qiang lie 。 zai zhe li ， na zou zui hou yi ge xiang mu 。 ni zhi de yong you ！]

english: More blood money! I can only commend you on your prowess. Alas, I have no more armour to give to you at this time.

english: Good luck with that! If we knew how, we'd have slain him already.

english: Seek out the witch, his guide, his only confidante. Only she knows how to rid us of Iban.

english: As I can see.

translation: 如果需要的话我可以再给你演示一下？我还有一本可能有用的书。 [ru guo xu yao de hua wo ke yi zai gei ni yan shi yi xia ？ wo hai you yi ben ke neng you yong de shu 。]

english: Well I've given you the demonstration. Best thing now is to head into a waiting area and get started. That said, I can give you the demonstration again if you want? I also have a book that might be useful.
translation: 好吧，我已经给你演示了。现在最好的事情就是前往等候区并开始。也就是说，如果您愿意的话，我可以再给您演示一次？我还有一本可能有用的书。 [hao ba ， wo yi jing gei ni yan shi le 。 xian zai zui hao de shi qing jiu shi qian wang deng hou qu bing kai shi 。 ye jiu shi shuo ， ru guo nin yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi zai gei nin yan shi yi ci ？ wo hai you yi ben ke neng you yong de shu 。]

english: Could you give me the demonstration again?
translation: 你能再给我演示一下吗？ [ni neng zai gei wo yan shi yi xia ma ？]

english: Hmm, you're not looking so great. You should cure yourself of disease before I give you the demonstration.
translation: 嗯，你看起来不太好。在我给你演示之前，你应该先把自己的病治好。 [n ， ni kan qi lai bu tai hao 。 zai wo gei ni yan shi zhi qian ， ni ying gai xian ba zi ji de bing zhi hao 。]

english: Could I have the book?
translation: 我可以要这本书吗？ [wo ke yi yao zhe ben shu ma ？]

english: It looks like you already have one.
translation: 看来您已经拥有了一个。 [kan lai nin yi jing yong you le yi ge 。]

english: Oh, alright then.
translation: 哦，那好吧。 [o ， na hao ba 。]

english: Is there something else you need?
translation: 您还有其他需要吗？ [nin hai you qi ta xu yao ma ？]

english: Of course. Here you go.
translation: 当然。干得好。 [dang ran 。 gan de hao 。]

english: Nomad gives you a book.
translation: 游牧者给你一本书。 [you mu zhe gei ni yi ben shu 。]

english: Now, is there something else you need?
translation: 现在，您还需要什么吗？ [xian zai ， nin hai xu yao shen me ma ？]

english: I'm good.
translation: 我很好。 [wo hen hao 。]

english: So be it.
translation: 就这样吧。 [jiu zhe yang ba 。]

english: Can we talk about rewards?
translation: 我们可以谈谈奖励吗？ [wo men ke yi tan tan jiang li ma ？]

english: Certainly! I sell various rewards to those who have earned Zeal from Soul Wars battles.
translation: 当然！我向那些从《灵魂之战》战斗中获得热情的人出售各种奖励。 [dang ran ！ wo xiang na xie cong 《 ling hun zhi zhan 》 zhan dou zhong huo de re qing de ren chu shou ge zhong jiang li 。]

english: What kinds of rewards are there?
translation: 有哪些类型的奖励？ [you na xie lei xing de jiang li ？]

english: I can offer you some of my knowledge in various skills, I can use my abilities to imbue some of your items with additional power, and I also have some items I have found on my travels.
translation: 我可以为你提供一些我在各种技能方面的知识，我可以用我的能力为你的一些物品赋予额外的力量，我也有一些我在旅行中发现的物品。 [wo ke yi wei ni ti gong yi xie wo zai ge zhong ji neng fang mian de zhi shi ， wo ke yi yong wo de neng li wei ni de yi xie wu pin fu yu e wai de li liang ， wo ye you yi xie wo zai lv xing zhong fa xian de wu pin 。]

english: Would you like to see?
translation: 你想看吗？ [ni xiang kan ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Very well. Is there something else you need?
translation: 很好。您还有其他需要吗？ [hen hao 。 nin hai you qi ta xu yao ma ？]

english: Can we talk about ammunition?
translation: 我们可以谈谈弹药吗？ [wo men ke yi tan tan dan yao ma ？]

english: How are the new capes working out for you?
translation: 新斗篷对你来说怎么样？ [xin dou peng dui ni lai shuo zen me yang ？]

english: Just fine, thanks!
translation: 就好了，谢谢！ [jiu hao le ， xie xie ！]

english: Great, now get back in there and crush some souls!
translation: 太好了，现在回到那里并粉碎一些灵魂！ [tai hao le ， xian zai hui dao na li bing fen sui yi xie ling hun ！]

english: Yes, right away!
translation: 是的，马上！ [shi de ， ma shang ！]

english: Not bad. But I was wondering if they could be improved any further?
translation: 不错。但我想知道他们是否可以进一步改进？ [bu cuo 。 dan wo xiang zhi dao ta men shi fou ke yi jin yi bu gai jin ？]

english: Well if you show me a better device I might be able to sort something out for you.
translation: 好吧，如果您向我展示更好的设备，我也许可以为您解决一些问题。 [hao ba ， ru guo nin xiang wo zhan shi geng hao de she bei ， wo ye xu ke yi wei nin jie jue yi xie wen ti 。]

english: How about this one?
translation: 这个怎么样？ [zhe ge zen me yang ？]

english: You've already shown me this deadchicken. I don't really need to see it again. I might be able to do something if you show me a better one, though.
translation: 你已经给我看过这只死鸡了。我真的不需要再看一遍。不过，如果你给我展示一个更好的东西，我也许能做点什么。 [ni yi jing gei wo kan guo zhe zhi si ji le 。 wo zhen de bu xu yao zai kan yi bian 。 bu guo ， ru guo ni gei wo zhan shi yi ge geng hao de dong xi ， wo ye xu neng zuo dian shen me 。]

english: Hmm, very interesting. Let's see what we can do.
translation: 嗯，非常有趣。让我们看看我们能做什么。 [n ， fei chang you qu 。 rang wo men kan kan wo men neng zuo shen me 。]

english: There we go! It's not quite the same, but it should work out just fine for you.
translation: 我们开始吧！虽然不太一样，但应该对你来说效果很好。 [wo men kai shi ba ！ sui ran bu tai yi yang ， dan ying gai dui ni lai shuo xiao guo hen hao 。]

english: Bear in mind that the enchantment is bound to my power and so will only work for you while you are in a Soul Wars battle.
translation: 请记住，该结界与我的力量绑定，因此仅当您处于灵魂之战战斗时才对您起作用。 [qing ji zhu ， gai jie jie yu wo de li liang bang ding ， yin ci jin dang nin chu yu ling hun zhi zhan zhan dou shi cai dui nin qi zuo yong 。]

english: Great! Thanks for the help!
translation: 伟大的！感谢您的帮助！ [wei da de ！ gan xie nin de bang zhu ！]

english: I don't really have time to discuss the finer points of Fletching, you know.
translation: 你知道，我真的没有时间讨论箭术的细节。 [ni zhi dao ， wo zhen de mei you shi jian tao lun jian shu de xi jie 。]

english: No, not like that! You see, I helped create a device which returns my ammunition.
translation: 不，不是那样的！你看，我帮助创建了一个可以返回我的弹药的设备。 [bu ， bu shi na yang de ！ ni kan ， wo bang zhu chuang jian le yi ge ke yi fan hui wo de dan yao de she bei 。]

english: Really? If you could show it to me, I might be able to sort something out for you.
translation: 真的吗？如果你能把它给我看，我也许能为你解决一些问题。 [zhen de ma ？ ru guo ni neng ba ta gei wo kan ， wo ye xu neng wei ni jie jue yi xie wen ti 。]

english: I don't want to talk to you.
translation: 我不想和你说话。 [wo bu xiang he ni shuo hua 。]

english: Huh?
Yikes!
translation: 哎呀！ [ai ya ！]

english: Oh boy.
translation: 噢，孩子。 [o ， hai zi 。]

english: Welcome to Soul Wars! Let's get started.
translation: 欢迎来到灵魂之战！让我们开始吧。 [huan ying lai dao ling hun zhi zhan ！ rang wo men kai shi ba 。]

english: So, what's this place all about?
translation: 那么，这个地方到底是做什么的呢？ [na me ， zhe ge di fang dao di shi zuo shen me de ne ？]

english: To the south you will have seen an avatar. You must fight to protect your team's avatar, and defeat the opposing team's avatar.
translation: 在南边你会看到一个化身。你必须为保护自己队伍的化身而战，并击败对方队伍的化身。 [zai nan bian ni hui kan dao yi ge hua shen 。 ni bi xu wei bao hu zi ji dui wu de hua shen er zhan ， bing ji bai dui fang dui wu de hua shen 。]

english: Are you crazy? Have you seen the size of it?
translation: 你疯了？你见过它的大小吗？ [ni feng le ？ ni jian guo ta de da xiao ma ？]

english: You're here to fight, not whine.
translation: 你是来战斗的，不是来发牢骚的。 [ni shi lai zhan dou de ， bu shi lai fa lao sao de 。]

english: But how am I supposed to take on one of those?
translation: 但我该如何承担其中之一呢？ [dan wo gai ru he cheng dan qi zhong zhi yi ne ？]

english: By capturing the Soul Obelisk, which lies at the centre of the battleground, and offering it soul fragments.
translation: 夺取位于战场中央的灵魂方尖碑，并为其提供灵魂碎片。 [duo qu wei yu zhan chang zhong yang de ling hun fang jian bei ， bing wei qi ti gong ling hun sui pian 。]

english: Let's head towards the Obelisk now. I can point out some of the important landmarks on the way. Meet me to the north when you are ready to learn more.
translation: 现在让我们前往方尖碑吧。我可以指出途中的一些重要地标。当你准备好了解更多信息时，到北方来见我。 [xian zai rang wo men qian wang fang jian bei ba 。 wo ke yi zhi chu tu zhong de yi xie zhong yao di biao 。 dang ni zhun bei hao liao jie geng duo xin xi shi ， dao bei fang lai jian wo 。]

english: The screen fades to black and Nomad teleports northwards.
translation: 屏幕逐渐变黑，游牧者向北传送。 [ping mu zhu jian bian hei ， you mu zhe xiang bei chuan song 。]

english: Hey! Where are you going?
translation: 嘿！你要去哪里？ [hei ！ ni yao qu na li ？]

english: Only the red team may enter this graveyard.
translation: 只有红队可以进入这个墓地。 [zhi you hong dui ke yi jin ru zhe ge mu di 。]

english: Hey! You don't need those. You're not in a real battle yet.
translation: 嘿！你不需要那些。你还没有进入真正的战斗。 [hei ！ ni bu xu yao na xie 。 ni hai mei you jin ru zhen zheng de zhan dou 。]

english: You've got no reason to bother that poor imp.
translation: 你没有理由去打扰那个可怜的小鬼。 [ni mei you li you qu da rao na ge ke lian de xiao gui 。]

english: Hey! Don't attack those. You're not in a real battle yet.
translation: 嘿！不要攻击那些。你还没有进入真正的战斗。 [hei ！ bu yao gong ji na xie 。 ni hai mei you jin ru zhen zheng de zhan dou 。]

english: To continue the demonstration, come speak to me. I'm by the avatar in the south-west of the battleground.
translation: 要继续演示，请跟我说话。我在战场西南方的头像旁边。 [yao ji xu yan shi ， qing gen wo shuo hua 。 wo zai zhan chang xi nan fang de tou xiang pang bian 。]

english: This is one of the graveyards that your team can capture.
translation: 这是你的团队可以占领的墓地之一。 [zhe shi ni de tuan dui ke yi zhan ling de mu di zhi yi 。]

english: For the purposes of this demonstration, however, I have kept it inactive.
translation: 然而，为了演示的目的，我将其保持为非活动状态。 [ran er ， wei le yan shi de mu di ， wo jiang qi bao chi wei fei huo dong zhuang tai 。]

english: You might find this little area behind me useful for defending your avatar. There's one in the other team's base, too.
translation: 你可能会发现我身后的这个小区域对于保护你的化身很有用。另一队的基地里也有一个。 [ni ke neng hui fa xian wo shen hou de zhe ge xiao qu yu dui yu bao hu ni de hua shen hen you yong 。 ling yi dui de ji di li ye you yi ge 。]

english: During battle, you can gather supplies here to aid you and your teammates.
translation: 在战斗中，你可以在这里收集物资来帮助你和你的队友。 [zai zhan dou zhong ， ni ke yi zai zhe li shou ji wu zi lai bang zhu ni he ni de dui you 。]

english: The Soul Obelisk is just a little way from here. Let's continue on; I'll meet you to the east.
translation: 灵魂方尖碑距离这里不远。让我们继续；我会在东方遇见你。 [ling hun fang jian bei ju li zhe li bu yuan 。 rang wo men ji xu ； wo hui zai dong fang yu jian ni 。]

english: The screen fades to black and Nomad teleports eastwards.
translation: 屏幕逐渐变黑，游牧者向东传送。 [ping mu zhu jian bian hei ， you mu zhe xiang dong chuan song 。]

english: Now, to have a chance against an avatar, you are going to need souls. Lots of souls.
translation: 现在，为了有机会对抗化身，你需要灵魂。很多灵魂。 [xian zai ， wei le you ji hui dui kang hua shen ， ni xu yao ling hun 。 hen duo ling hun 。]

english: What am I going to do with souls?
translation: 我要对灵魂做什么？ [wo yao dui ling hun zuo shen me ？]

english: The Soul Obelisk is immensely powerful and, by channelling souls into it, you can weaken the enemy avatar.
translation: 灵魂方尖碑非常强大，通过将灵魂引导到其中，你可以削弱敌人的化身。 [ling hun fang jian bei fei chang qiang da ， tong guo jiang ling hun yin dao dao qi zhong ， ni ke yi xue ruo di ren de hua shen 。]

english: How does that work?
translation: 这是如何运作的？ [zhe shi ru he yun zuo de ？]

english: All I know is that it does, and that you should do it. Lots.
translation: 我只知道它确实如此，而且你应该这样做。很多。 [wo zhi zhi dao ta que shi ru ci ， er qie ni ying gai zhe yang zuo 。 hen duo 。]

english: So, where do I get these souls from?
translation: 那么，我从哪里得到这些灵魂呢？ [na me ， wo cong na li de dao zhe xie ling hun ne ？]

english: You can kill the souls that inhabit the arena ruins and harvest their soul fragments.
translation: 你可以杀死竞技场废墟中的灵魂并收获他们的灵魂碎片。 [ni ke yi sha si jing ji chang fei xu zhong de ling hun bing shou huo ta men de ling hun sui pian 。]

english: For the purposes of this demonstration however, we will use my minion Zimberfizz.
translation: 然而，为了演示的目的，我们将使用我的小黄人 Zimberfizz。 [ran er ， wei le yan shi de mu di ， wo men jiang shi yong wo de xiao huang ren  Zimberfizz。]

english: Zimberfizz! Heel!
translation: 津伯菲兹！脚跟！ [jin bo fei zi ！ jiao gen ！]

english: Zimberfizz appears.
translation: 津伯菲兹出现。 [jin bo fei zi chu xian 。]

english: When you kill a creature in Soul Wars, they will leave a soul fragment behind, which you can use to charge the Soul Obelisk.
translation: 当你在灵魂战争中杀死一个生物时，他们会留下一个灵魂碎片，你可以用它来冲锋灵魂方尖碑。 [dang ni zai ling hun zhan zheng zhong sha si yi ge sheng wu shi ， ta men hui liu xia yi ge ling hun sui pian ， ni ke yi yong ta lai chong feng ling hun fang jian bei 。]

english: Zimberfizz has such a soul fragment. Why don't you kill him and take it?
translation: 津伯菲兹就有这样的灵魂碎片。你为什么不杀了他然后拿走呢？ [jin bo fei zi jiu you zhe yang de ling hun sui pian 。 ni wei shen me bu sha le ta ran hou na zou ne ？]

english: You want me to kill him?
translation: 你想让我杀了他吗？ [ni xiang rang wo sha le ta ma ？]

english: Yes!
translation: 是的！ [shi de ！]

english: Come on! Kill him already and get that soul fragment.
translation: 快点！杀了他，得到灵魂碎片。 [kuai dian ！ sha le ta ， de dao ling hun sui pian 。]

english: Good job! Let's carry on to the Soul Obelisk and channel this soul fragment into it. It's just to the east, over a bridge and on a small island.
translation: 好工作！让我们继续前往灵魂方尖碑，将这个灵魂碎片导入其中。它就在东边，过了一座桥，就在一个小岛上。 [hao gong zuo ！ rang wo men ji xu qian wang ling hun fang jian bei ， jiang zhe ge ling hun sui pian dao ru qi zhong 。 ta jiu zai dong bian ， guo le yi zuo qiao ， jiu zai yi ge xiao dao shang 。]

english: Good job! Now, you've got that soul fragment, right?
translation: 好工作！现在，你已经得到了那个灵魂碎片，对吗？ [hao gong zuo ！ xian zai ， ni yi jing de dao le na ge ling hun sui pian ， dui ma ？]

english: About that...
translation: 关于那个... [guan yu na ge ...]

english: You've lost it? You're lucky you're not in a real battle yet!
translation: 你弄丢了吗？你很幸运，你还没有进入真正的战斗！ [ni nong diu le ma ？ ni hen xing yun ， ni hai mei you jin ru zhen zheng de zhan dou ！]

english: Here, have this one. Just look after it this time.
translation: 给，有这个。这次就照顾一下吧。 [gei ， you zhe ge 。 zhe ci jiu zhao gu yi xia ba 。]

english: Make some space and I'll give you one. Just look after it this time.
translation: 腾出一些空间，我给你一个。这次就照顾一下吧。 [teng chu yi xie kong jian ， wo gei ni yi ge 。 zhe ci jiu zhao gu yi xia ba 。]

english: I'll try...
translation: 我会尽力... [wo hui jin li ...]

english: Now! Let's carry on to the Soul Obelisk and channel this soul fragment into it. It's just to the east, over a bridge and on a small island.
translation: 现在！让我们继续前往灵魂方尖碑，将这个灵魂碎片导入其中。它就在东边，过了一座桥，就在一个小岛上。 [xian zai ！ rang wo men ji xu qian wang ling hun fang jian bei ， jiang zhe ge ling hun sui pian dao ru qi zhong 。 ta jiu zai dong bian ， guo le yi zuo qiao ， jiu zai yi ge xiao dao shang 。]

english: Here we are at the Soul Obelisk. Now, you've got that soul fragment, right?
translation: 我们来到了灵魂方尖碑。现在，你已经得到了那个灵魂碎片，对吗？ [wo men lai dao le ling hun fang jian bei 。 xian zai ， ni yi jing de dao le na ge ling hun sui pian ， dui ma ？]

english: Here we are at the Soul Obelisk. Now, to reap the full benefit of the soul fragment, you will need to first be in control of the Obelisk.
translation: 我们来到了灵魂方尖碑。现在，要充分利用灵魂碎片，您需要首先控制方尖碑。 [wo men lai dao le ling hun fang jian bei 。 xian zai ， yao chong fen li yong ling hun sui pian ， nin xu yao shou xian kong zhi fang jian bei 。]

english: How do I do that?
translation: 我该怎么做？ [wo gai zen me zuo ？]

english: Various areas of the battleground can come under your team's control. To gain control, you must have more team members than the opposing team in these areas.
translation: 战场的各个区域都可以在您的团队的控制之下。为了获得控制权，您在这些区域的团队成员必须多于对方团队。 [zhan chang de ge ge qu yu dou ke yi zai nin de tuan dui de kong zhi zhi xia 。 wei le huo de kong zhi quan ， nin zai zhe xie qu yu de tuan dui cheng yuan bi xu duo yu dui fang tuan dui 。]

english: If you outnumber the enemy, you will gradually take control. Let's try it out now.
translation: 如果你的人数多于敌人，你就会逐渐控制局面。现在让我们尝试一下。 [ru guo ni de ren shu duo yu di ren ， ni jiu hui zhu jian kong zhi ju mian 。 xian zai rang wo men chang shi yi xia 。]

english: We shall use Zimberfizz to represent an enemy team member.
translation: 我们将使用 Zimberfizz 来代表敌方团队成员。 [wo men jiang shi yong  Zimberfizz  lai dai biao di fang tuan dui cheng yuan 。]

english: Minion! Heel!
translation: 小黄人！脚跟！ [xiao huang ren ！ jiao gen ！]

english: Zimberfizz appears again.
translation: 津伯菲兹再次出现。 [jin bo fei zi zai ci chu xian 。]

english: Come on, give him a good kick.
translation: 来吧，狠狠地踢他一脚。 [lai ba ， hen hen di ti ta yi jiao 。]

english: I thought he was dead? Didn't we kill him earlier?
translation: 我以为他死了？我们不是早就杀了他了吗？ [wo yi wei ta si le ？ wo men bu shi zao jiu sha le ta le ma ？]

english: Ha! He wishes! No, his service to me is far from over.
translation: 哈!他愿意！不，他对我的服务还远没有结束。 [ha ! ta yuan yi ！ bu ， ta dui wo de fu wu hai yuan mei you jie shu 。]

english: Poor little guy.
translation: 可怜的小家伙。 [ke lian de xiao jia huo 。]

english: Ha! I'm sure he loves the attention, right Zimberfizz?
translation: 哈!我确信他喜欢受到关注，对吧 Zimberfizz？ [ha ! wo que xin ta xi huan shou dao guan zhu ， dui ba  Zimberfizz？]

english: Zimberfizz appears yet again.
translation: Zimberfizz 再次出现。 [Zimberfizz  zai ci chu xian 。]

english: Right, now that Zimberfizz is no longer in the Obelisk's capturable area, you outnumber the enemy! The Soul Obelisk will now begin to fall under your control.
translation: 对了，现在津伯菲兹已经不在方尖碑的占领范围内了，你的数量就多于敌人了！灵魂方尖碑现在将开始落入你的控制之下。 [dui le ， xian zai jin bo fei zi yi jing bu zai fang jian bei de zhan ling fan wei nei le ， ni de shu liang jiu duo yu di ren le ！ ling hun fang jian bei xian zai jiang kai shi luo ru ni de kong zhi zhi xia 。]

english: Right. Now, go and charge the Obelisk with that soul fragment and see what happens.
translation: 正确的。现在，去将灵魂碎片充入方尖碑，看看会发生什么。 [zheng que de 。 xian zai ， qu jiang ling hun sui pian chong ru fang jian bei ， kan kan hui fa sheng shen me 。]

english: Go on, use the soul fragment on the Obelisk.
translation: 继续，使用方尖碑上的灵魂碎片。 [ji xu ， shi yong fang jian bei shang de ling hun sui pian 。]

english: You charge the Soul Obelisk and weaken the enemy avatar.
translation: 你冲锋灵魂方尖碑并削弱敌人的化身。 [ni chong feng ling hun fang jian bei bing xue ruo di ren de hua shen 。]

english: Good job! Now that you have charged the Obelisk, the enemy avatar will have been weakened.
translation: 好工作！现在你已经冲锋了方尖碑，敌人的化身将会被削弱。 [hao gong zuo ！ xian zai ni yi jing chong feng le fang jian bei ， di ren de hua shen jiang hui bei xue ruo 。]

english: Note the display in the top-left of the screen. See how the red avatar's strength has decreased.
translation: 请注意屏幕左上角的显示。看看红色虚拟角色的实力是如何下降的。 [qing zhu yi ping mu zuo shang jiao de xian shi 。 kan kan hong se xu ni jue se de shi li shi ru he xia jiang de 。]

english: The number shown here represents the percentage of your damage that the avatar will block.
translation: 此处显示的数字代表化身将阻挡的伤害百分比。 [ci chu xian shi de shu zi dai biao hua shen jiang zu dang de shang hai bai fen bi 。]

english: So, once I've charged the Obelisk, can I just kick back and wait for the end of the game?
translation: 那么，一旦我完成了方尖碑的冲锋，我可以就这样等待游戏结束吗？ [na me ， yi dan wo wan cheng le fang jian bei de chong feng ， wo ke yi jiu zhe yang deng dai you xi jie shu ma ？]

english: Ha! I think not! I'm not about to reward those who don't put the effort in!
translation: 哈!我认为不是！我不会奖励那些不付出努力的人！ [ha ! wo ren wei bu shi ！ wo bu hui jiang li na xie bu fu chu nu li de ren ！]

english: Note the orange bar in the top-left of the screen. This bar represents how active you have been during the game.
translation: 请注意屏幕左上角的橙色条。该条代表您在游戏期间的活跃程度。 [qing zhu yi ping mu zuo shang jiao de cheng se tiao 。 gai tiao dai biao nin zai you xi qi jian de huo yue cheng du 。]

english: Over the course of the battle, the bar will slowly drain. Should the bar drain completely you will be removed from the game due to your inactivity.
translation: 在战斗过程中，能量条会慢慢耗尽。如果酒吧完全耗尽，您将因不活动而被从游戏中删除。 [zai zhan dou guo cheng zhong ， neng liang tiao hui man man hao jin 。 ru guo jiu ba wan quan hao jin ， nin jiang yin bu huo dong er bei cong you xi zhong shan chu 。]

english: You can refill the bar by performing actions in the game, such as dealing damage or charging the Obelisk.
translation: 您可以通过在游戏中执行操作来重新填充能量条，例如造成伤害或为方尖碑充电。 [nin ke yi tong guo zai you xi zhong zhi xing cao zuo lai chong xin tian chong neng liang tiao ， li ru zao cheng shang hai huo wei fang jian bei chong dian 。]

english: Oh well. Say, do you think the enemy avatar minds us weakening it like this?
translation: 那好吧。你说，你觉得敌人分身会介意我们这样削弱它吗？ [na hao ba 。 ni shuo ， ni jue de di ren fen shen hui jie yi wo men zhe yang xue ruo ta ma ？]

english: Hmm, why don't we go find out?
translation: 嗯，我们为什么不去了解一下呢？ [n ， wo men wei shen me bu qu liao jie yi xia ne ？]

english: The screen fades to black. The player and Nomad are now by the red team's avatar area.
translation: 屏幕逐渐变黑。玩家和Nomad现在都在红队的头像区域旁边。 [ping mu zhu jian bian hei 。 wan jia he Nomad xian zai dou zai hong dui de tou xiang qu yu pang bian 。]

translation: 所以，我们现在是在敌人的基地。 [suo yi ， wo men xian zai shi zai di ren de ji di 。]

english: Is that the enemy avatar over there?
translation: 那边是敌人的头像吗？ [na bian shi di ren de tou xiang ma ？]

english: Yeah, and it looks like you made it pretty mad.
translation: 是的，看来你让它很生气。 [shi de ， kan lai ni rang ta hen sheng qi 。]

english: What? You're the one that told me to weaken it!
translation: 什么？是你叫我削弱它的！ [shen me ？ shi ni jiao wo xue ruo ta de ！]

english: Ha! Don't worry - I won't let it kill you.
translation: 哈!别担心——我不会让它杀死你。 [ha ! bie dan xin —— wo bu hui rang ta sha si ni 。]

english: Phew!
translation: 唷！ [yo ！]

english: Of course, that doesn't mean I won't kill you.
translation: 当然，这并不意味着我不会杀你。 [dang ran ， zhe bing bu yi wei zhe wo bu hui sha ni 。]

english: What did you say?
translation: 你说什么？ [ni shuo shen me ？]

english: Argh!
Wooooooooooo!
translation: 呜呜呜！ [wu wu wu ！]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: Woooooo! Woooooo!
translation: 呜呜！呜呜！ [wu wu ！ wu wu ！]

english: Sorry, I don't speak ghost.
translation: 抱歉，我不会说鬼话。 [bao qian ， wo bu hui shuo gui hua 。]

english: There we go! Much better.
translation: 我们开始吧！好多了。 [wo men kai shi ba ！ hao duo le 。]

english: Hey! You killed me.
translation: 嘿！你杀了我。 [hei ！ ni sha le wo 。]

english: At least it wasn't permanent! Think of it as an opportunity to learn.
translation: 至少它不是永久的！将其视为学习的机会。 [zhi shao ta bu shi yong jiu de ！ jiang qi shi wei xue xi de ji hui 。]

english: How so?
translation: 为何如此？ [wei he ru ci ？]

english: The other team will be after you and any soul fragments you have collected, after all.
translation: 毕竟，另一支队伍会追捕你和你收集的任何灵魂碎片。 [bi jing ， ling yi zhi dui wu hui zhui bu ni he ni shou ji de ren he ling hun sui pian 。]

english: I needed to show you what happens when you fall in battle.
translation: 我需要向你展示当你在战斗中倒下时会发生什么。 [wo xu yao xiang ni zhan shi dang ni zai zhan dou zhong dao xia shi hui fa sheng shen me 。]

english: Did you turn me into a ghost?
translation: 你把我变成鬼了？ [ni ba wo bian cheng gui le ？]

english: Not exactly. The Soul Obelisk tried to claim your soul, as it does with all who perish in the battleground.
translation: 不完全是。灵魂方尖碑试图夺取你的灵魂，就像它对所有在战场上死去的人所做的那样。 [bu wan quan shi 。 ling hun fang jian bei shi tu duo qu ni de ling hun ， jiu xiang ta dui suo you zai zhan chang shang si qu de ren suo zuo de na yang 。]

english: Only my power brought you here, and returned you to life.
translation: 是我的力量把你带到了这里，让你复活了。 [shi wo de li liang ba ni dai dao le zhe li ， rang ni fu huo le 。]

english: Erm, thanks, I guess.
translation: 嗯，谢谢，我想。 [n ， xie xie ， wo xiang 。]

english: You're more useful to me alive... for now.
translation: 你活着对我来说更有用……现在。 [ni huo zhe dui wo lai shuo geng you yong …… xian zai 。]

english: Are there any other painful things to learn about this place?
translation: 关于这个地方还有什么其他痛苦的事情值得学习吗？ [guan yu zhe ge di fang hai you shen me qi ta tong ku de shi qing zhi de xue xi ma ？]

english: There is much more to this place, but you don't need to know about it yet.
translation: 这个地方还有很多事情，但您还不需要了解。 [zhe ge di fang hai you hen duo shi qing ， dan nin hai bu xu yao liao jie 。]

english: If you want to learn more, I can give you a Soul Wars guide upon our return to the waiting area.
translation: 如果您想了解更多信息，当我们返回等候区时，我可以给您一本《灵魂之战》指南。 [ru guo nin xiang liao jie geng duo xin xi ， dang wo men fan hui deng hou qu shi ， wo ke yi gei nin yi ben 《 ling hun zhi zhan 》 zhi nan 。]

english: Use the large blue portal at the back of this graveyard to return to the waiting area. Why not sign up for a battle while you're there?
translation: 使用墓地后面的蓝色大传送门返回等候区。为什么不在现场报名参加战斗呢？ [shi yong mu di hou mian de lan se da chuan song men fan hui deng hou qu 。 wei shen me bu zai xian chang bao ming can jia zhan dou ne ？]

english: Use the portal over there to return to the waiting area. I'll see you on the other side!
translation: 使用那边的传送门返回等候区。我会在另一边见到你！ [shi yong na bian de chuan song men fan hui deng hou qu 。 wo hui zai ling yi bian jian dao ni ！]

english: Here we are. The waiting areas are just south of here, but you won't be able to join a battle right now.
translation: 我们到了。等待区就在此处的南边，但你现在无法参加战斗。 [wo men dao le 。 deng dai qu jiu zai ci chu de nan bian ， dan ni xian zai wu fa can jia zhan dou 。]

english: Here we are. Just head south to the waiting areas if you want to join a battle.
translation: 我们到了。如果你想参加战斗，只需向南前往等待区即可。 [wo men dao le 。 ru guo ni xiang can jia zhan dou ， zhi xu xiang nan qian wang deng dai qu ji ke 。]

english: That's all well and good, but what do I get out of all of this?
translation: 这一切都很好，但是我能从这一切中得到什么呢？ [zhe yi qie dou hen hao ， dan shi wo neng cong zhe yi qie zhong de dao shen me ne ？]

english: I can offer you experience in various skills, and items I have found on my travels.
translation: 我可以为您提供各种技能的经验以及我在旅行中发现的物品。 [wo ke yi wei nin ti gong ge zhong ji neng de jing yan yi ji wo zai lv xing zhong fa xian de wu pin 。]

english: I have a copy of the Soul Wars guide here. It contains information that I didn't have time to cover.
translation: 我这里有一份灵魂战争指南。它包含我没有时间涵盖的信息。 [wo zhe li you yi fen ling hun zhan zheng zhi nan 。 ta bao han wo mei you shi jian han gai de xin xi 。]

english: You don't need to know it all to get started, but the section on burying bones could be useful.
translation: 您无需了解所有内容即可开始，但有关埋骨的部分可能会很有用。 [nin wu xu liao jie suo you nei rong ji ke kai shi ， dan you guan mai gu de bu fen ke neng hui hen you yong 。]

english: Did you want to take it and read it in your own time?
translation: 您想在自己的时间里阅读它吗？ [nin xiang zai zi ji de shi jian li yue du ta ma ？]

english: Yes,please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Hmm, it looks like you already have one.
translation: 嗯，看起来你已经有一个了。 [n ， kan qi lai ni yi jing you yi ge le 。]

english: Oh, alright then.
translation: 哦，那好吧。 [o ， na hao ba 。]

english: Here you go.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Check out this deadchicken!
translation: 看看这只死鸡！ [kan kan zhe zhi si ji ！]

english: You've already shown me this deadchicken. I don't really need to see it again.
translation: 你已经给我看过这只死鸡了。我真的不需要再看一遍。 [ni yi jing gei wo kan guo zhe zhi si ji le 。 wo zhen de bu xu yao zai kan yi bian 。]

english: Fair enough.
translation: 很公平。 [hen gong ping 。]

english: Nomad won't consider looking at Ava's devices until you've completed Animal Magnetism
translation: 在您完成动物磁力之前，Nomad 不会考虑查看 Ava 的设备 [zai nin wan cheng dong wu ci li zhi qian ，Nomad  bu hui kao lv cha kan  Ava  de she bei]

english: Hmm, very interesting.
translation: 嗯，非常有趣。 [n ， fei chang you qu 。]

english: I was wondering if you could maybe make your capes do something similar to what this does?
translation: 我想知道你是否可以让你的斗篷做一些类似的事情？ [wo xiang zhi dao ni shi fou ke yi rang ni de dou peng zuo yi xie lei si de shi qing ？]

english: Let's see what we can do.
translation: 让我们看看我们能做什么。 [rang wo men kan kan wo men neng zuo shen me 。]

english: Nomad mutters an incantation and enchants your Soul Wars capes!
translation: 游牧者低声念出咒语，并为你的《灵魂战争》斗篷附魔！ [you mu zhe di sheng nian chu zhou yu ， bing wei ni de 《 ling hun zhan zheng 》 dou peng fu mo ！]

english: There we go. It's not quite the same, but it should work out just fine for you.
translation: 我们开始吧。虽然不太一样，但应该对你来说效果很好。 [wo men kai shi ba 。 sui ran bu tai yi yang ， dan ying gai dui ni lai shuo xiao guo hen hao 。]

english: Hmm, very interesting. This one seems more powerful than the last one you showed me.
translation: 嗯，非常有趣。这个似乎比你给我展示的上一个更强大。 [n ， fei chang you qu 。 zhe ge si hu bi ni gei wo zhan shi de shang yi ge geng qiang da 。]

english: That's right. I was wondering if you could maybe upgrade your capes again?
translation: 这是正确的。我想知道你是否可以再次升级你的斗篷？ [zhe shi zheng que de 。 wo xiang zhi dao ni shi fou ke yi zai ci sheng ji ni de dou peng ？]

english: The time is now! Crush their souls!
translation: 现在就是时候了！粉碎他们的灵魂！ [xian zai jiu shi shi hou le ！ fen sui ta men de ling hun ！]

english: Well I'm still getting things set up right now. Once everything is ready, return to me and I'll give you a demonstration.
translation: 嗯，我现在还在安排事情。一切准备就绪后，回到我身边，我给你演示一下。 [n ， wo xian zai hai zai an pai shi qing 。 yi qie zhun bei jiu xu hou ， hui dao wo shen bian ， wo gei ni yan shi yi xia 。]

english: The Soul Wars minigame will be released on the 6th January 2021.
translation: 《灵魂之战》小游戏将于 2021 年 1 月 6 日发布。 [《 ling hun zhi zhan 》 xiao you xi jiang yu  2021  nian  1  yue  6  ri fa bu 。]

english: Here to crush some souls? Just head into a waiting area to the south to get started.
translation: 来这里粉碎一些灵魂？只需前往南边的等候区即可开始。 [lai zhe li fen sui yi xie ling hun ？ zhi xu qian wang nan bian de deng hou qu ji ke kai shi 。]

translation: 你能再给我演示一下吗？ [ni neng zai gei wo yan shi yi xia ma ？]

translation: 我可以要这本书吗？ [wo ke yi yao zhe ben shu ma ？]

translation: 我们可以谈谈奖励吗？ [wo men ke yi tan tan jiang li ma ？]

translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

translation: 是的，马上！ [shi de ， ma shang ！]

translation: 很公平。 [hen gong ping 。]

translation: 伟大的！感谢您的帮助！ [wei da de ！ gan xie nin de bang zhu ！]

translation: 我懂了。我稍后会回来。 [wo dong le 。 wo shao hou hui hui lai 。]

english: Was just trying to make light conversation, not trying to aggregate you.
translation: 只是想进行轻松的交谈，而不是试图聚集你们。 [zhi shi xiang jin xing qing song de jiao tan ， er bu shi shi tu ju ji ni men 。]

english: Metaphorically speaking, do you have a heart of stone?
translation: 打个比方，你的心是铁石心肠吗？ [da ge bi fang ， ni de xin shi tie shi xin chang ma ？]

translation: 好吧，[吸血鬼名字]，欢迎来到精华矿。 [hao ba ，[ xi xue gui ming zi ]， huan ying lai dao jing hua kuang 。]

translation: 这是正确的。在这里，我们利用奴隶来开采大雅特精华。 [zhe shi zheng que de 。 zai zhe li ， wo men li yong nu li lai kai cai da ya te jing hua 。]
