translation: 达亚特精华？这与大亚特矿石有关吗？ [da ya te jing hua ？ zhe yu da ya te kuang shi you guan ma ？]

english: Indeed it is. Daeyalt ore is a weaker form of daeyalt essence. It still has uses, hence why we have the slaves mine it. The essence here is far more powerful though.
translation: 确实如此。黛亚特矿石是黛亚特精华的较弱形式。它仍然有用途，因此我们让奴隶开采它。但这里的本质要强大得多。 [que shi ru ci 。 dai ya te kuang shi shi dai ya te jing hua de jiao ruo xing shi 。 ta reng ran you yong tu ， yin ci wo men rang nu li kai cai ta 。 dan zhe li de ben zhi yao qiang da de duo 。]

english: Where did it come from?
translation: 它从哪里来？ [ta cong na li lai ？]

english: They say that an object of great power was once stored in this very cave. Apparently, the presence of this object created the daeyalt deposits.
translation: 他们说这个洞穴里曾经存放过一件具有强大力量的物品。显然，这个物体的存在创造了黛雅特矿床。 [ta men shuo zhe ge dong xue li ceng jing cun fang guo yi jian ju you qiang da li liang de wu pin 。 xian ran ， zhe ge wu ti de cun zai chuang zao le dai ya te kuang chuang 。]

english: I see. What is the daeyalt used for?
translation: 我懂了。 daeyalt 是用来做什么的？ [wo dong le 。 daeyalt  shi yong lai zuo shen me de ？]

english: Its main use is as a key component in the vampyrification process. There's other uses though. It can be used to create runes, for example.
translation: 它的主要用途是作为吸血鬼化过程中的关键成分。不过还有其他用途。例如，它可以用来创建符文。 [ta de zhu yao yong tu shi zuo wei xi xue gui hua guo cheng zhong de guan jian cheng fen 。 bu guo hai you qi ta yong tu 。 li ru ， ta ke yi yong lai chuang jian fu wen 。]

english: Am I allowed some?
translation: 我可以吃一些吗？ [wo ke yi chi yi xie ma ？]

english: The essence mined by the slaves is reserved. If you want some, you'll have to mine your own.
translation: 奴隶开采的精华被保留。如果你想要一些，你就必须自己开采。 [nu li kai cai de jing hua bei bao liu 。 ru guo ni xiang yao yi xie ， ni jiu bi xu zi ji kai cai 。]

english: If you do choose to mine the deposits, you should know that the daeyalt shards you'll get are useless on their own. They'll need converting into essence to be used.
translation: 如果您确实选择开采矿藏，您应该知道您将获得的 Daeyalt 碎片本身是无用的。它们需要转化为精华才能使用。 [ru guo nin que shi xuan ze kai cai kuang cang ， nin ying gai zhi dao nin jiang huo de de  Daeyalt  sui pian ben shen shi wu yong de 。 ta men xu yao zhuan hua wei jing hua cai neng shi yong 。]

english: How do I do that?
translation: 我该怎么做？ [wo gai zen me zuo ？]

english: Luckily for you, I can provide that service.
translation: 幸运的是，我可以提供这项服务。 [xing yun de shi ， wo ke yi ti gong zhe xiang fu wu 。]

english: Whenever you have shards to convert, bring them to me. Normally I'd send the converted essence straight to your bank, but as you seem to carry all of your belongings yourself, I'll just give it right to you instead.
translation: 每当你有碎片需要兑换时，就把它们带给我。通常情况下我会把转换后的精华直接寄到你的银行，但由于你似乎自己携带了所有物品，所以我就直接把它交给你了。 [mei dang ni you sui pian xu yao dui huan shi ， jiu ba ta men dai gei wo 。 tong chang qing kuang xia wo hui ba zhuan huan hou de jing hua zhi jie ji dao ni de yin hang ， dan you yu ni si hu zi ji xie dai le suo you wu pin ， suo yi wo jiu zhi jie ba ta jiao gei ni le 。]

english: Whenever you have shards to convert, bring them to me. I will send the converted essence straight to your bank.
translation: 每当你有碎片需要兑换时，就把它们带给我。我会将转换后的精华直接发送到您的银行。 [mei dang ni you sui pian xu yao dui huan shi ， jiu ba ta men dai gei wo 。 wo hui jiang zhuan huan hou de jing hua zhi jie fa song dao nin de yin hang 。]

english: Great! Thanks for the help.
translation: 伟大的！感谢您的帮助。 [wei da de ！ gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]

english: Oh, one other thing. The daeyalt almost seems to have a mind of its own. Only one deposit will be active at a time. You'll need to pay attention to which one it is.
translation: 哦，还有一件事。黛雅特似乎有自己的想法。一次只有一笔存款处于活动状态。您需要注意它是哪一个。 [o ， hai you yi jian shi 。 dai ya te si hu you zi ji de xiang fa 。 yi ci zhi you yi bi cun kuan chu yu huo dong zhuang tai 。 nin xu yao zhu yi ta shi na yi ge 。]

english: I see. I'll bear that in mind.
translation: 我懂了。我会记住这一点。 [wo dong le 。 wo hui ji zhu zhe yi dian 。]

english: Need something?
translation: 需要东西吗？ [xu yao dong xi ma ？]

english: Could you convert some shards for me?
translation: 你能帮我转换一些碎片吗？ [ni neng bang wo zhuan huan yi xie sui pian ma ？]

english: As you wish. I'll give any shards I convert straight to you. How many would you like me to convert?
translation: 如你所愿。我会把我转换的碎片直接给你。您希望我转换多少？ [ru ni suo yuan 。 wo hui ba wo zhuan huan de sui pian zhi jie gei ni 。 nin xi wang wo zhuan huan duo shao ？]

english: As you wish. Once I convert these shards, I will send them to your bank. How many would you like me to convert?
translation: 如你所愿。一旦我转换了这些碎片，我会将它们发送到您的银行。您希望我转换多少？ [ru ni suo yuan 。 yi dan wo zhuan huan le zhe xie sui pian ， wo hui jiang ta men fa song dao nin de yin hang 。 nin xi wang wo zhuan huan duo shao ？]

english: No. You don't have any.
translation: 不，你没有。 [bu ， ni mei you 。]

english: Tell me about daeyalt.
translation: 告诉我有关戴雅特的事。 [gao su wo you guan dai ya te de shi 。]

english: It comes in two forms, essence and ores. Both have their uses, but the essence is far more powerful.
translation: 它有两种形式：精华和矿石。两者都有其用途，但其本质更为强大。 [ta you liang zhong xing shi ： jing hua he kuang shi 。 liang zhe dou you qi yong tu ， dan qi ben zhi geng wei qiang da 。]

english: And it's only found here?
translation: 而且只能在这里找到？ [er qie zhi neng zai zhe li zhao dao ？]

english: Yes. They say that an object of great power was once stored in this very cave. Apparently, the presence of this object created the daeyalt deposits.
translation: 是的。他们说这个洞穴里曾经存放过一件具有强大力量的物品。显然，这个物体的存在创造了黛雅特矿床。 [shi de 。 ta men shuo zhe ge dong xue li ceng jing cun fang guo yi jian ju you qiang da li liang de wu pin 。 xian ran ， zhe ge wu ti de cun zai chuang zao le dai ya te kuang chuang 。]

english: The main use of daeyalt is as a key component in the vampyrification process. There's other uses though. The essence can be used to create runes, for example.
translation: daeyalt 的主要用途是作为吸血鬼化过程中的关键成分。不过还有其他用途。例如，精华可以用来创建符文。 [daeyalt  de zhu yao yong tu shi zuo wei xi xue gui hua guo cheng zhong de guan jian cheng fen 。 bu guo hai you qi ta yong tu 。 li ru ， jing hua ke yi yong lai chuang jian fu wen 。]

english: And I'm allowed to mine it?
translation: 我可以开采它吗？ [wo ke yi kai cai ta ma ？]

english: Indeed. However, you should know that the daeyalt shards you'll get are useless on their own. They'll need converting into essence to be used. That is a service I can provide.
translation: 的确。然而，你应该知道，你得到的大亚特碎片本身是没有用的。它们需要转化为精华才能使用。这是我可以提供的服务。 [di que 。 ran er ， ni ying gai zhi dao ， ni de dao de da ya te sui pian ben shen shi mei you yong de 。 ta men xu yao zhuan hua wei jing hua cai neng shi yong 。 zhe shi wo ke yi ti gong de fu wu 。]

english: I see. Thanks for the information.
translation: 我懂了。感谢您提供信息。 [wo dong le 。 gan xie nin ti gong xin xi 。]

english: Do you need something else?
translation: 您还需要其他东西吗？ [nin hai xu yao qi ta dong xi ma ？]

english: I'm good.
translation: 我很好。 [wo hen hao 。]

english: You're not one of the slaves assigned to this mine! Go back to the pens before I call the guards!
translation: 你不是分配到这个矿井的奴隶之一！在我叫守卫之前先回围栏去！ [ni bu shi fen pei dao zhe ge kuang jing de nu li zhi yi ！ zai wo jiao shou wei zhi qian xian hui wei lan qu ！]

english: Could you convert some shards for me?
translation: 你能帮我转换一些碎片吗？ [ni neng bang wo zhuan huan yi xie sui pian ma ？]

english: Tell me about daeyalt.
translation: 告诉我有关戴雅特的事。 [gao su wo you guan dai ya te de shi 。]

english: I'm good.
translation: 我很好。 [wo hen hao 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Quickly, tell me - is it still there?
translation: 快点告诉我——它还在吗？ [kuai dian gao su wo —— ta hai zai ma ？]

english: Is what still where?
translation: 什么还在吗？ [shen me hai zai ma ？]

english: The THING, the THING! It was just outside my house! Has it gone away yet? Or is it still lurking out there, waiting for me to go outside?
translation: 事情，事情！就在我家外面！它已经消失了吗？还是它还潜伏在那里，等着我出去？ [shi qing ， shi qing ！ jiu zai wo jia wai mian ！ ta yi jing xiao shi le ma ？ hai shi ta hai qian fu zai na li ， deng zhe wo chu qu ？]

english: I didn't see any THING out there, just a couple of guards. What did it look like?
translation: 我没看到外面有什么东西，只有几个守卫。它看起来像什么？ [wo mei kan dao wai mian you shen me dong xi ， zhi you ji ge shou wei 。 ta kan qi lai xiang shen me ？]

english: Ohhhh, it was HORRIBLE! It was an enormous THING, with TEETH and EYES and... and... and THINGS!
translation: 哦哦，太可怕了！这是一个巨大的东西，有牙齿和眼睛，还有……还有……还有东西！ [o o ， tai ke pa le ！ zhe shi yi ge ju da de dong xi ， you ya chi he yan jing ， hai you …… hai you …… hai you dong xi ！]

english: Um... would you care to be more specific?
translation: 嗯……你愿意说得更具体一些吗？ [n …… ni yuan yi shuo de geng ju ti yi xie ma ？]

english: I can't. I only saw it in the dark.
translation: 我不能。我只是在黑暗中看到了它。 [wo bu neng 。 wo zhi shi zai hei an zhong kan dao le ta 。]

english: You only saw this THING in the dark?
translation: 你只在黑暗中看到这个东西？ [ni zhi zai hei an zhong kan dao zhe ge dong xi ？]

english: I was sleeping peacefully one night, when suddenly I woke up and saw it through the window. It was LOOKING at me! I haven't dared go out since then. It's had me trapped in here for days! I've packed my
translation: 一天晚上，我睡得很安稳，突然醒来，透过窗户看到了它。它正在看着我！从那以后我就不敢出门了。我已经被困在这里好几天了！我已经收拾好我的 [yi tian wan shang ， wo shui de hen an wen ， tu ran xing lai ， tou guo chuang hu kan dao le ta 。 ta zheng zai kan zhe wo ！ cong na yi hou wo jiu bu gan chu men le 。 wo yi jing bei kun zai zhe li hao ji tian le ！ wo yi jing shou shi hao wo de]

english: bags so I can escape, but the THING's still out there waiting for me to come out! If I have to stay in here much longer I'll go mad! MAD!! MAD!!!
translation: 袋子，这样我就可以逃脱，但那个东西仍然在那里等着我出来！如果我要在这里呆太久的话我会发疯的！疯狂的！！疯狂的！！！ [dai zi ， zhe yang wo jiu ke yi tao tuo ， dan na ge dong xi reng ran zai na li deng zhe wo chu lai ！ ru guo wo yao zai zhe li dai tai jiu de hua wo hui fa feng de ！ feng kuang de ！！ feng kuang de ！！！]

english: There's no THING outside. Just come out and get some fresh air before you go funny in the head.
translation: 外面什么也没有。在你的头脑变得有趣之前，先出来呼吸一下新鲜空气。 [wai mian shen me ye mei you 。 zai ni de tou nao bian de you qu zhi qian ， xian chu lai hu xi yi xia xin xian kong qi 。]

english: You want me to go outside?
translation: 你想让我出去吗？ [ni xiang rang wo chu qu ma ？]

english: I think you might just have dreamed about the THING.
translation: 我想你可能只是梦见了那个东西。 [wo xiang ni ke neng zhi shi meng jian le na ge dong xi 。]

english: You want me to believe that it's not real?
translation: 你想让我相信这不是真的吗？ [ni xiang rang wo xiang xin zhe bu shi zhen de ma ？]

english: Please come outside!
translation: 请到外面来！ [qing dao wai mian lai ！]

english: No! No! I know what you are! You're in league with the THING! It keeps sending people in here to trick me into going outside! They keep stealing from me too! GO AWAY!
translation: 不！不！我知道你是什么！你和那个东西结盟了！一直派人进来骗我出去！他们还不断地偷我的东西！离开！ [bu ！ bu ！ wo zhi dao ni shi shen me ！ ni he na ge dong xi jie meng le ！ yi zhi pai ren jin lai pian wo chu qu ！ ta men hai bu duan di tou wo de dong xi ！ li kai ！]

english: I'm not trying to trick you!
translation: 我不是想欺骗你！ [wo bu shi xiang qi pian ni ！]

english: Get thee gone, trickster!
translation: 滚开，骗子！ [gun kai ， pian zi ！]

english: Sheesh...
translation: 谢什... [xie shen ...]

english: Party! Party!
translation: 派对！派对！ [pai dui ！ pai dui ！]

english: Something's happening in the party room!
translation: 宴会厅里出事了！ [yan hui ting li chu shi le ！]

english: Everyone get to the party room!
translation: 大家都到宴会厅去吧！ [da jia dou dao yan hui ting qu ba ！]

english: What's happening in the party room?
translation: 宴会厅里发生了什么？ [yan hui ting li fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: Someone's having a big party!
translation: 有人要举办盛大的聚会！ [you ren yao ju ban sheng da de ju hui ！]

english: Get to the party room NOW!
translation: 立即前往派对室！ [li ji qian wang pai dui shi ！]

english: Get to the party room!
translation: 快去宴会厅吧！ [kuai qu yan hui ting ba ！]

english: Get to the party room quick!
translation: 快去聚会室吧！ [kuai qu ju hui shi ba ！]

english: Big value items in the party room now!
translation: 现在派对房间里有超值物品！ [xian zai pai dui fang jian li you chao zhi wu pin ！]

english: Quick! Get to the party room!
translation: 快的！快去宴会厅吧！ [kuai de ！ kuai qu yan hui ting ba ！]

english: Hey wanna trade? I'll give the best deals you can find.
translation: 嘿，想交易吗？我会为您提供最优惠的价格。 [hei ， xiang jiao yi ma ？ wo hui wei nin ti gong zui you hui de jia ge 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: How can you afford to give such good deals?
translation: 你怎么能提供这么好的优惠呢？ [ni zen me neng ti gong zhe me hao de you hui ne ？]

english: The general stores in Asgarnia and Misthalin are heavily taxed. It really makes it hard for them to run an effective business. For some reason taxmen don't visit my store.
translation: 阿斯伽尼亚和米沙林的杂货店征税很重。这确实让他们很难有效地经营业务。由于某种原因，税务员不来我的商店。 [a si ga ni ya he mi sha lin de za huo dian zheng shui hen zhong 。 zhe que shi rang ta men hen nan you xiao di jing ying ye wu 。 you yu mou zhong yuan yin ， shui wu yuan bu lai wo de shang dian 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: How can you afford to give such good deals?
translation: 你怎么能提供这么好的优惠呢？ [ni zen me neng ti gong zhe me hao de you hui ne ？]

english: Hi there!
translation: 你好呀！ [ni hao ya ！]

english: Greetings, iknami. It's good to see so many who are willing to contribute to the Final Dawn. The word of the Augur has changed everything. The time to act is now.
translation: 问候，伊克纳米。很高兴看到这么多人愿意为最终黎明做出贡献。占卜师的一句话改变了一切。现在是采取行动的时候了。 [wen hou ， yi ke na mi 。 hen gao xing kan dao zhe me duo ren yuan yi wei zui zhong li ming zuo chu gong xian 。 zhan bu shi de yi ju hua gai bian le yi qie 。 xian zai shi cai qu xing dong de shi hou le 。]

english: Augur?
translation: 占卜师？ [zhan bu shi ？]

english: You have not heard? She is the one who now leads the Emissaries. She has taken this once helpless collective and turned them into the ones who will guide us all to Mokhaiotl.
translation: 你没听说过吗？她是现在领导使者的人。她带领这个曾经无助的集体，将他们变成了引导我们所有人走向莫卡伊奥特尔的人。 [ni mei ting shuo guo ma ？ ta shi xian zai ling dao shi zhe de ren 。 ta dai ling zhe ge ceng jing wu zhu de ji ti ， jiang ta men bian cheng le yin dao wo men suo you ren zou xiang mo ka yi ao te er de ren 。]

english: How do you know all this? You're not even a member yet.
translation: 你怎么知道这一切？你还不是会员。 [ni zen me zhi dao zhe yi qie ？ ni hai bu shi hui yuan 。]

english: I was once. In my time of need, I turned to the Emissaries, but they were even more helpless than I was.
translation: 我曾经是。在我需要帮助的时候，我求助于使者，但他们比我更无助。 [wo ceng jing shi 。 zai wo xu yao bang zhu de shi hou ， wo qiu zhu yu shi zhe ， dan ta men bi wo geng wu zhu 。]

english: Now though, she has changed everything. Now it is my duty to rejoin their ranks so that we may bring about the Final Dawn.
translation: 然而现在，她改变了一切。现在我有责任重新加入他们的行列，以便我们能够带来最终的黎明。 [ran er xian zai ， ta gai bian le yi qie 。 xian zai wo you ze ren chong xin jia ru ta men de hang lie ， yi bian wo men neng gou dai lai zui zhong de li ming 。]

english: I see. Thanks for the information.
translation: 我懂了。感谢您提供信息。 [wo dong le 。 gan xie nin ti gong xin xi 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello traveller, how's things?
translation: 你好，旅行者，怎么样？ [ni hao ， lv xing zhe ， zen me yang ？]

english: Not bad thanks, yourself?
translation: 还不错，谢谢，你自己吗？ [hai bu cuo ， xie xie ， ni zi ji ma ？]

english: I'm good, just working hard as usual...
translation: 我很好，只是像往常一样努力工作...... [wo hen hao ， zhi shi xiang wang chang yi yang nu li gong zuo ......]

english: I was hoping you might sell me a cannon.
translation: 我希望你能卖给我一门大炮。 [wo xi wang ni neng mai gei wo yi men da pao 。]

english: Hmmmmmm...
translation: 嗯嗯…… [n n ……]

english: I shouldn't really, but as you helped us so much, well, I could sort something out. I'll warn you though, they don't come cheap!
translation: 我真的不应该，但是既然你帮了我们这么多，那么我可以解决一些问题。不过我要警告你，它们并不便宜！ [wo zhen de bu ying gai ， dan shi ji ran ni bang le wo men zhe me duo ， na me wo ke yi jie jue yi xie wen ti 。 bu guo wo yao jing gao ni ， ta men bing bu bian yi ！]

english: How much?
translation: 多少？ [duo shao ？]

english: For the full setup, 750,000 coins. Or I can sell you the separate parts... but it'll cost extra!
translation: 完整设置需要 750,000 个硬币。或者我可以把单独的零件卖给你......但需要额外付费！ [wan zheng she zhi xu yao  750,000  ge ying bi 。 huo zhe wo ke yi ba dan du de ling jian mai gei ni ...... dan xu yao e wai fu fei ！]

english: That's not cheap!
translation: 那可不便宜！ [na ke bu pian yi ！]

english: Okay, I'll take a cannon please.
translation: 好的，请我拿一门大炮。 [hao de ， qing wo na yi men da pao 。]

english: Okay then, but keep it quiet... This thing's top secret!
translation: 好吧，但是保持安静……这件事是最高机密！ [hao ba ， dan shi bao chi an jing …… zhe jian shi shi zui gao ji mi ！]

english: You give the Cannon engineer 750,000 coins...
translation: 你给加农工程师75万金币... [ni gei jia nong gong cheng shi 75 wan jin bi ...]

english: He gives you the four parts that make the cannon, plus an ammo mould and an instruction manual.
translation: 他给了你制造大炮的四个零件，再加上一个弹药模具和一本说明书。 [ta gei le ni zhi zao da pao de si ge ling jian ， zai jia shang yi ge dan yao mu ju he yi ben shuo ming shu 。]

english: There you go, you be careful with that thing.
translation: 就这样，你要小心那件事。 [jiu zhe yang ， ni yao xiao xin na jian shi 。]

english: Will do, take care mate.
translation: 会的，照顾好伙计。 [hui de ， zhao gu hao huo ji 。]

english: Take care adventurer.
translation: 小心冒险家。 [xiao xin mao xian jia 。]

english: Oops, I don't have enough money.
translation: 哎呀，我钱不够。 [ai ya ， wo qian bu gou 。]

english: Sorry, I can't go any lower than that.
translation: 抱歉，我不能再低于这个水平了。 [bao qian ， wo bu neng zai di yu zhe ge shui ping le 。]

english: Can I look at the separate parts please?
translation: 我可以看一下单独的部分吗？ [wo ke yi kan yi xia dan du de bu fen ma ？]

english: Of course!
translation: 当然！ [dang ran ！]

english: Sorry, that's too much for me.
translation: 抱歉，这对我来说太过分了。 [bao qian ， zhe dui wo lai shuo tai guo fen le 。]

english: Fair enough, it's too much for most of us.
translation: 公平地说，这对我们大多数人来说太多了。 [gong ping di shuo ， zhe dui wo men da duo shu ren lai shuo tai duo le 。]

english: Have you any ammo or instructions to sell?
translation: 您有弹药或出售说明吗？ [nin you dan yao huo chu shou shuo ming ma ？]

english: Well, take care of yourself then.
translation: 嗯，那就照顾好自己吧。 [n ， na jiu zhao gu hao zi ji ba 。]

english: Indeed I will adventurer.
translation: 确实我会冒险家。 [que shi wo hui mao xian jia 。]

english: I want to know more about the cannon.
translation: 我想更多地了解大炮。 [wo xiang geng duo di liao jie da pao 。]

english: There's only so much I can tell you, adventurer. We've been working on this little beauty for some time now.
translation: 我能告诉你的只有这么多，冒险家。我们为这个小美人而努力已经有一段时间了。 [wo neng gao su ni de zhi you zhe me duo ， mao xian jia 。 wo men wei zhe ge xiao mei ren er nu li yi jing you yi duan shi jian le 。]

english: Is it effective?
translation: 有效果吗？ [you xiao guo ma ？]

english: In short bursts it's very effective, the most destructive weapon to date. The cannon automatically targets monsters close by. You just have to make the ammo and let rip.
translation: 在短时间内爆发，它是非常有效的，是迄今为止最具破坏性的武器。大炮会自动瞄准附近的怪物。你只需要制造弹药并让它撕裂。 [zai duan shi jian nei bao fa ， ta shi fei chang you xiao de ， shi qi jin wei zhi zui ju po huai xing de wu qi 。 da pao hui zi dong miao zhun fu jin de guai wu 。 ni zhi xu yao zhi zao dan yao bing rang ta si lie 。]

english: I've lost my cannon.
translation: 我的大炮丢了。 [wo de da pao diu le 。]

english: That's unfortunate... but don't worry, I can sort you out.
translation: 这很不幸……不过别担心，我可以解决你的问题。 [zhe hen bu xing …… bu guo bie dan xin ， wo ke yi jie jue ni de wen ti 。]

english: Keep that quiet or I'll be in real trouble!
translation: 保持安静，否则我会遇到真正的麻烦！ [bao chi an jing ， fou ze wo hui yu dao zhen zheng de ma fan ！]

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: Oh dear, I'm only allowed to replace cannons that were stolen in action. I'm sorry, but you'll have to buy a new set.
translation: 哦天哪，我只被允许更换在行动中被偷的大炮。抱歉，你必须买一套新的。 [o tian na ， wo zhi bei yun xu geng huan zai hang dong zhong bei tou de da pao 。 bao qian ， ni bi xu mai yi tao xin de 。]

english: I was hoping you might sell me a cannon?
translation: 我希望你能卖给我一门大炮？ [wo xi wang ni neng mai gei wo yi men da pao ？]

english: Okay, I'll take a cannon please.
translation: 好的，请我拿一门大炮。 [hao de ， qing wo na yi men da pao 。]

english: Can I look at the separate parts please?
translation: 我可以看一下单独的部分吗？ [wo ke yi kan yi xia dan du de bu fen ma ？]

english: Sorry, that's too much for me.
translation: 抱歉，这对我来说太过分了。 [bao qian ， zhe dui wo lai shuo tai guo fen le 。]

english: Have you any ammo or instructions to sell?
translation: 您有弹药或出售说明吗？ [nin you dan yao huo chu shou shuo ming ma ？]

english: Well, take care of yourself then.
translation: 嗯，那就照顾好自己吧。 [n ， na jiu zhao gu hao zi ji ba 。]

english: I want to know more about the cannon.
translation: 我想更多地了解大炮。 [wo xiang geng duo di liao jie da pao 。]

english: I've lost my cannon.
translation: 我的大炮丢了。 [wo de da pao diu le 。]

english: What is it, human? I'm working.
translation: 这是什么，人类？我在工作。 [zhe shi shen me ， ren lei ？ wo zai gong zuo 。]

english: How do I use the furnace?
translation: 我该如何使用炉子？ [wo gai ru he shi yong lu zi ？]

english: Put your ore on the conveyor belt to get it smelted. We'll stoke the boiler and operate the rest of the machinery for you.
translation: 将矿石放在传送带上进行熔炼。我们将为您给锅炉加燃料并操作其余的机器。 [jiang kuang shi fang zai chuan song dai shang jin xing rong lian 。 wo men jiang wei nin gei guo lu jia ran liao bing cao zuo qi yu de ji qi 。]

english: You'll have to help repair the furnace whenever a pipe blows, though. Just hit it with a hammer - that usually works.
translation: 不过，每当管道爆炸时，你就必须帮忙修理炉子。只需用锤子敲击即可 - 通常会起作用。 [bu guo ， mei dang guan dao bao zha shi ， ni jiu bi xu bang mang xiu li lu zi 。 zhi xu yong chui zi qiao ji ji ke  -  tong chang hui qi zuo yong 。]

english: You'll have to put money in the coffer to pay for our services. We charge 72,000 coins per hour; money is deducted as long as you're in this room with us.
translation: 您必须将钱存入保险箱来支付我们的服务费用。我们每小时收费72,000个币；只要您和我们一起住在这个房间，就会扣除费用。 [nin bi xu jiang qian cun ru bao xian xiang lai zhi fu wo men de fu wu fei yong 。 wo men mei xiao shi shou fei 72,000 ge bi ； zhi yao nin he wo men yi qi zhu zai zhe ge fang jian ， jiu hui kou chu fei yong 。]

english: Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
translation: 天哪，你真是个大矮人。 [tian na ， ni zhen shi ge da ai ren 。]

english: My brothers and I have a rare genetic condition affecting our growth. Rather than treating us as freaks, you might like to appreciate how useful it is that we can operate the machinery.
translation: 我和我的兄弟患有一种影响我们成长的罕见遗传病。您可能不想把我们视为怪胎，而应该欣赏我们操作机器的有用性。 [wo he wo de xiong di huan you yi zhong ying xiang wo men cheng zhang de han jian yi chuan bing 。 nin ke neng bu xiang ba wo men shi wei guai tai ， er ying gai xin shang wo men cao zuo ji qi de you yong xing 。]

english: Sorry.
translation: 对不起。 [dui bu qi 。]

english: That's ok, human. You're not the first to comment on it. Now, did you need anything? I've got work to do here.
translation: 没关系，人类。你不是第一个对此发表评论的人。现在，你需要什么吗？我这里还有工作要做。 [mei guan xi ， ren lei 。 ni bu shi di yi ge dui ci fa biao ping lun de ren 。 xian zai ， ni xu yao shen me ma ？ wo zhe li hai you gong zuo yao zuo 。]

english: Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
translation: 你确定你真的是个侏儒吗？ [ni que ding ni zhen de shi ge zhu ru ma ？]

english: ... look, do you want help with something, or did you just come here to be rude? I've got work to do.
translation: ……听着，你是想寻求帮助，还是来这里只是为了无礼？我还有工作要做。 […… ting zhe ， ni shi xiang xun qiu bang zhu ， hai shi lai zhe li zhi shi wei le wu li ？ wo hai you gong zuo yao zuo 。]

english: I'll let you get on with it.
translation: 我会让你继续做下去。 [wo hui rang ni ji xu zuo xia qu 。]

english: How do I use the furnace?
translation: 我该如何使用炉子？ [wo gai ru he shi yong lu zi ？]

english: Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
translation: 天哪，你真是个大矮人。 [tian na ， ni zhen shi ge da ai ren 。]

english: Sorry.
translation: 对不起。 [dui bu qi 。]

english: I'll let you get on with it.
translation: 我会让你继续做下去。 [wo hui rang ni ji xu zuo xia qu 。]

english: Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
translation: 你确定你真的是个侏儒吗？ [ni que ding ni zhen de shi ge zhu ru ma ？]

english: Hey fishy. If you's a good fishy I might sell yous bitses of skippy skin clothes.
translation: 嘿，鱼腥味。如果你很狡猾，我可能会卖给你一些羊皮衣服。 [hei ， yu xing wei 。 ru guo ni hen jiao hua ， wo ke neng hui mai gei ni yi xie yang pi yi fu 。]

english: But Nung needs time to makes them first.
translation: 但 Nung 需要时间来先制作它们。 [dan  Nung  xu yao shi jian lai xian zhi zuo ta men 。]

english: Hey, silly fishy wit da round head!
translation: 嘿，圆头的傻鱼机智！ [hei ， yuan tou de sha yu ji zhi ！]

english: Ya! What kinda fishy you's tinkin you are?
translation: 呀！你觉得你是什么样的人？ [ya ！ ni jue de ni shi shen me yang de ren ？]

english: I'm not any kind of fishy, err, fish.
translation: 我不是什么鱼腥味，呃，鱼。 [wo bu shi shen me yu xing wei ， e ， yu 。]

english: Well what you doin' here if you's no a fishy?
translation: 如果你不可疑的话你来这里做什么？ [ru guo ni bu ke yi de hua ni lai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Well I'm trying to get some Giant Crab meat.
translation: 好吧，我正想买一些巨蟹肉。 [hao ba ， wo zheng xiang mai yi xie ju xie rou 。]

english: Dis fishy is a funny fishy!
translation: 这鱼腥味是一种有趣的鱼腥味！ [zhe yu xing wei shi yi zhong you qu de yu xing wei ！]

english: Whats this fishy wanting?
translation: 这有什么可疑的吗？ [zhe you shen me ke yi de ma ？]

english: You see those big crabs? I want one of those.
translation: 看到那些大螃蟹了吗？我想要其中之一。 [kan dao na xie da pang xie le ma ？ wo xiang yao qi zhong zhi yi 。]

english: You's here to stealin' my big crunchy claws?
translation: 你是来偷我的脆脆的大爪子的吗？ [ni shi lai tou wo de cui cui de da zhua zi de ma ？]

english: Nung should smash your stoopid round head!
translation: 农应该砸碎你这个呆呆的圆脑袋！ [nong ying gai za sui ni zhe ge dai dai de yuan nao dai ！]

english: Always the big nettings was taking my big crunchy claws, I put them in the cages, and now you's come to get them.
translation: 一直以来，大网都抓住了我脆脆的大爪子，我把它们放在笼子里，现在你来拿它们了。 [yi zhi yi lai ， da wang dou zhua zhu le wo cui cui de da zhua zi ， wo ba ta men fang zai long zi li ， xian zai ni lai na ta men le 。]

english: Swim away little fishy or I eat you till you's dead!
translation: 小鱼儿赶紧游走，不然我就把你吃了，直到你死为止！ [xiao yu er gan jin you zou ， bu ran wo jiu ba ni chi le ， zhi dao ni si wei zhi ！]

english: Wait, could I buy some of the crab meat?
translation: 等等，我可以买一些蟹肉吗？ [deng deng ， wo ke yi mai yi xie xie rou ma ？]

english: Silly round head fishy want to swaps big crunchy claws?
translation: 傻圆头腥想换成脆脆的大爪子？ [sha yuan tou xing xiang huan cheng cui cui de da zhua zi ？]

english: Naaah...you no real deal. I bet you no do Nung big favour.
translation: 不……你这不是真正的交易。我敢打赌你不会给Nung很大的帮助。 [bu …… ni zhe bu shi zhen zheng de jiao yi 。 wo gan da du ni bu hui gei Nung hen da de bang zhu 。]

english: Seriously, I need to get that meat. I'll do your big favour if you want.
translation: 说真的，我需要得到那块肉。如果你愿意的话我会帮你一个大忙。 [shuo zhen de ， wo xu yao de dao na kuai rou 。 ru guo ni yuan yi de hua wo hui bang ni yi ge da mang 。]

english: Hah! Silly round head fishy! If you get Nung 5 big skippy skins, den maybe Nung thinking you ok.
translation: 哈！傻圆头有鱼腥味！如果你得到 Nung 5 个大跳皮，也许 Nung 认为你还好。 [ha ！ sha yuan tou you yu xing wei ！ ru guo ni de dao  Nung 5  ge da tiao pi ， ye xu  Nung  ren wei ni hai hao 。]

english: Big skippy skins?
translation: 大跳皮？ [da tiao pi ？]

english: Ya, da big skippies live over dere.
translation: 是的，大船长就住在德雷那边。 [shi de ， da chuan zhang jiu zhu zai de lei na bian 。]

english: You need lotsa big big stones to get down dere. Den you kill da big skippies and bring da skins to Nung.
translation: 你需要很多大石头才能下来。你杀死了很多大跳鱼，并把这些皮给了农。 [ni xu yao hen duo da shi tou cai neng xia lai 。 ni sha si le hen duo da tiao yu ， bing ba zhe xie pi gei le nong 。]

english: You do dis, den maybe Nung let you swaps da big crunchy claws.
translation: 你这样做，也许Nung会让你交换大而脆的爪子。 [ni zhe yang zuo ， ye xu Nung hui rang ni jiao huan da er cui de zhua zi 。]

english: Nung, I have your mudskipper hides.
translation: 农，我有你的弹涂鱼皮。 [nong ， wo you ni de dan tu yu pi 。]

english: What you say? Has da silly round headed fishy got da big skippy skins?
translation: 你说的话？愚蠢的圆头鱼有大皮吗？ [ni shuo de hua ？ yu chun de yuan tou yu you da pi ma ？]

english: Sigh...
Yes, I have the big skippy skins.
translation: 是的，我有大跳皮。 [shi de ， wo you da tiao pi 。]

english: Silly round head fishy done good!  Gimme!
translation: 傻圆头腥做得好！  给我！ [sha yuan tou xing zuo de hao ！   gei wo ！]

english: Ya, da round head fishy does a good big favour for Nung.
translation: 是啊，大圆头鱼帮了 Nung 一个大忙。 [shi a ， da yuan tou yu bang le  Nung  yi ge da mang 。]

english: I am thinkin you's ok enough to swaps the giant crunchy claws now.
translation: 我想你现在可以换掉那只巨大的脆爪了。 [wo xiang ni xian zai ke yi huan diao na zhi ju da de cui zhao le 。]

english: Great! How much do you want for them?
translation: 伟大的！你想要他们多少钱？ [wei da de ！ ni xiang yao ta men duo shao qian ？]

english: You's gotta get me somefing to make dese hides to a cloak and flippers and hat, den I lets you have all the big crunchy claws you can get.
translation: 你得给我一些东西来制作斗篷、脚蹼和帽子，我让你拥有所有你能得到的大而脆的爪子。 [ni de gei wo yi xie dong xi lai zhi zuo dou peng 、 jiao pu he mao zi ， wo rang ni yong you suo you ni neng de dao de da er cui de zhua zi 。]

english: But it not be easy
translation: 但这并不容易 [dan zhe bing bu rong yi]

english: Well I'll do it. What do I need? An item of ancient power? Something from the deepest, darkest dungeon in the world?
translation: 好吧，我会做的。我需要什么？远古力量的物品？来自世界上最深、最黑暗的地牢的东西？ [hao ba ， wo hui zuo de 。 wo xu yao shen me ？ yuan gu li liang de wu pin ？ lai zi shi jie shang zui shen 、 zui hei an de di lao de dong xi ？]

english: What sort of monsters will I need to fight? I'd best grab myself some potions too.
translation: 我需要对抗什么样的怪物？我最好也给自己拿点药水。 [wo xu yao dui kang shen me yang de guai wu ？ wo zui hao ye gei zi ji na dian yao shui 。]

english: Will there be traps? Should I bring cakes?
translation: 会不会有陷阱？我应该带蛋糕吗？ [hui bu hui you xian jing ？ wo ying gai dai dan gao ma ？]

english: Ya, it real dangerous for a fishy.
translation: 是的，这对鱼来说真的很危险。 [shi de ， zhe dui yu lai shuo zhen de hen wei xian 。]

english: You's gotta go up to da topsies, and your gotta get a needly-thing and some wirey stuff.
translation: 你必须去搞那些乱七八糟的事，你必须得到一件必需品和一些金属丝的东西。 [ni bi xu qu gao na xie luan qi ba zao de shi ， ni bi xu de dao yi jian bi xu pin he yi xie jin shu si de dong xi 。]

english: A needle.
translation: 一根针。 [yi gen zhen 。]

english: Ya.
translation: 是啊。 [shi a 。]

english: And bronze wire.
translation: 还有青铜丝。 [hai you qing tong si 。]

english: Ya. Tree wirey stuffs.
translation: 是啊。树丝状的东西。 [shi a 。 shu si zhuang de dong xi 。]

english: So, all I have to do is bring you three rolls of bronze wire and a needle, and I can have all the Giant Crabs I can kill?
translation: 那么，我只要给你带来三卷铜丝和一根针，就能把我能杀死的巨蟹都占了？ [na me ， wo zhi yao gei ni dai lai san juan tong si he yi gen zhen ， jiu neng ba wo neng sha si de ju xie dou zhan le ？]

english: Ya, but be a sneaky round head fishy. Da topsies has not water for a little fishy like you to breathing.
translation: 是的，但要成为一个鬼鬼祟祟的圆头鱼。像你这样有点腥的人根本就没有水呼吸。 [shi de ， dan yao cheng wei yi ge gui gui sui sui de yuan tou yu 。 xiang ni zhe yang you dian xing de ren gen ben jiu mei you shui hu xi 。]

english: It REAL dangerous.
translation: 这真的很危险。 [zhe zhen de hen wei xian 。]

english: Yeah, sounds it.
translation: 是的，听起来是这样。 [shi de ， ting qi lai shi zhe yang 。]

english: Nung, I have the needle and wire.
translation: 农，我有针和线。 [nong ， wo you zhen he xian 。]

english: Nung thinks this is a useful fishy he finds. Gimme!
translation: Nung 认为这是他发现的有用的可疑之处。给我！ [Nung  ren wei zhe shi ta fa xian de you yong de ke yi zhi chu 。 gei wo ！]

english: Nung have all da wiry stuff and needly things he needs to make da biggestest skippy skin hat ever!
translation: Nung 拥有制作有史以来最大的皮帽所需的所有金属丝和必需品！ [Nung  yong you zhi zuo you shi yi lai zui da de pi mao suo xu de suo you jin shu si he bi xu pin ！]

english: You's a good little fishy, you eat as many big crunchy claws as you want.
translation: 你真是个小鱼儿，你想吃多少又大又脆的爪子就吃多少。 [ni zhen shi ge xiao yu er ， ni xiang chi duo shao you da you cui de zhua zi jiu chi duo shao 。]

english: Maybe you get big and strong like Nung!
translation: 也许你会像 Nung 一样变得又大又强壮！ [ye xu ni hui xiang  Nung  yi yang bian de you da you qiang zhuang ！]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: Greetings and welcome to my pickaxe shop. Do you want to buy my premium quality pickaxes?
translation: 问候并欢迎来到我的镐店。您想购买我的优质镐吗？ [wen hou bing huan ying lai dao wo de gao dian 。 nin xiang gou mai wo de you zhi gao ma ？]

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Are your pickaxes better than other pickaxes, then?
translation: 那么，您的镐比其他镐更好吗？ [na me ， nin de gao bi qi ta gao geng hao ma ？]

english: Of course they are! My pickaxes are made of higher grade metal than your ordinary bronze pickaxes, allowing you to mine that ore just a little bit faster than normal.
translation: 当然是！我的镐由比普通青铜镐更高等级的金属制成，使您可以比平常更快地开采矿石。 [dang ran shi ！ wo de gao you bi pu tong qing tong gao geng gao deng ji de jin shu zhi cheng ， shi nin ke yi bi ping chang geng kuai di kai cai kuang shi 。]

english: Hi Nurmof, I found this earlier...
translation: 嗨，努尔莫夫，我早些时候发现了这个...... [hai ， nu er mo fu ， wo zao xie shi hou fa xian le zhe ge ......]

english: Oh, a dragon pickaxe! And a broken one at that. I haven't seen one of those in a while.
translation: 哦，龙镐！还有一个坏了的。我有一段时间没见过其中一个了。 [o ， long gao ！ hai you yi ge huai le de 。 wo you yi duan shi jian mei jian guo qi zhong yi ge le 。]

english: Can you fix it for me? I was told you're the dwarf to see!
translation: 你能为我修好吗？我听说你是最值得一看的侏儒！ [ni neng wei wo xiu hao ma ？ wo ting shuo ni shi zui zhi de yi kan de zhu ru ！]

english: I did indeed fix pickaxes in the past, many years ago. They were a lot more common back then.
translation: 很多年前，我确实修过镐。当时它们更为常见。 [hen duo nian qian ， wo que shi xiu guo gao 。 dang shi ta men geng wei chang jian 。]

english: In fact, this is the first broken pickaxe I've seen in a very long time!
translation: 事实上，这是我很长一段时间以来第一次看到破损的镐！ [shi shi shang ， zhe shi wo hen zhang yi duan shi jian yi lai di yi ci kan dao po sun de gao ！]

english: Why were there so many broken pickaxes back then?
translation: 当年为什么有那么多断掉的镐子？ [dang nian wei shen me you na me duo duan diao de gao zi ？]

english: Ore rocks used to be quite unstable. They would randomly explode when you were mining them.
translation: 矿石曾经非常不稳定。当你开采它们时，它们会随机爆炸。 [kuang shi ceng jing fei chang bu wen ding 。 dang ni kai cai ta men shi ， ta men hui sui ji bao zha 。]

english: That sounds terrifying!
translation: 听起来很可怕！ [ting qi lai hen ke pa ！]

english: It was. But then one day, the explosions just... stopped. As if someone flipped an off switch somewhere.
translation: 是的。但有一天，爆炸……停止了。就好像有人在某处按下了关闭开关。 [shi de 。 dan you yi tian ， bao zha …… ting zhi le 。 jiu hao xiang you ren zai mou chu an xia le guan bi kai guan 。]

english: I've not seen a broken pickaxe since then!
translation: 从那以后我再也没有见过破损的镐！ [cong na yi hou wo zai ye mei you jian guo po sun de gao ！]

english: Will you still be able to fix mine for me?
translation: 你还能帮我修好我的吗？ [ni hai neng bang wo xiu hao wo de ma ？]

english: I should think so. I'll need to buy some new tools.
translation: 我应该这么认为。我需要购买一些新工具。 [wo ying gai zhe me ren wei 。 wo xu yao gou mai yi xie xin gong ju 。]

english: They're quite expensive, but they will get the job done. The pickaxe will be as good as new when I've finished with it.
translation: 它们相当昂贵，但它们会完成工作。当我用完后，镐就会像新的一样了。 [ta men xiang dang ang gui ， dan ta men hui wan cheng gong zuo 。 dang wo yong wan hou ， gao jiu hui xiang xin de yi yang le 。]

english: The cost will be about...
translation: 费用将约为... [fei yong jiang yue wei ...]

english: ...let me see. I need another one of these, and I can reuse that if I replace the drill bit from there...
translation: ...让我看看。我需要另一个，如果我更换那里的钻头，我可以重复使用它...... [... rang wo kan kan 。 wo xu yao ling yi ge ， ru guo wo geng huan na li de zuan tou ， wo ke yi chong fu shi yong ta ......]

english: ...hmm, and this needs a full clean, oh and I don't have one of those anymore...
translation: ...嗯，这需要彻底清洁，哦，我不再有这些了... [... n ， zhe xu yao che di qing jie ， o ， wo bu zai you zhe xie le ...]

english: ...okay! It'll cost about 2,500,000 GP, give or take a few coins. Would you like me to fix it for you?
translation: ...好的！大约花费 2,500,000 GP，给或拿一些硬币。您需要我帮您修好吗？ [... hao de ！ da yue hua fei  2,500,000 GP， gei huo na yi xie ying bi 。 nin xu yao wo bang nin xiu hao ma ？]

english: Yes, let's do it.
translation: 是的，让我们开始吧。 [shi de ， rang wo men kai shi ba 。]

english: Lovely! Okay, give me a moment. It may take a little while, it's a tough metal to work with.
translation: 迷人的！好的，请给我一点时间。这可能需要一些时间，它是一种很难加工的金属。 [mi ren de ！ hao de ， qing gei wo yi dian shi jian 。 zhe ke neng xu yao yi xie shi jian ， ta shi yi zhong hen nan jia gong de jin shu 。]

english: Nurmof goes into a nearby hidden room, and from within, you hear the sound of a hammer striking metal.
translation: 努尔莫夫走进附近的一个隐藏房间，从里面你听到锤子敲击金属的声音。 [nu er mo fu zou jin fu jin de yi ge yin cang fang jian ， cong li mian ni ting dao chui zi qiao ji jin shu de sheng yin 。]

english: ..he did say it would take a little while.
translation: ..他确实说过需要一段时间。 [.. ta que shi shuo guo xu yao yi duan shi jian 。]

english: There you go, good as new, just like I said!
translation: 就这样，就像新的一样，就像我说的！ [jiu zhe yang ， jiu xiang xin de yi yang ， jiu xiang wo shuo de ！]

english: Thank you very much. I'll take good care of it.
translation: 非常感谢。我会好好照顾它的。 [fei chang gan xie 。 wo hui hao hao zhao gu ta de 。]

english: Oh, I actually don't have enough coins on me! I'll come back with more.
translation: 哎呀，我身上的金币实在是不够啊！我会带更多回来的。 [ai ya ， wo shen shang de jin bi shi zai shi bu gou a ！ wo hui dai geng duo hui lai de 。]

english: I'll be here!
translation: 我会在这里！ [wo hui zai zhe li ！]

english: That's rather expensive...
translation: 那就比较贵了... [na jiu bi jiao gui le ...]

english: It is! But you can't cheap out on quality. If a job's worth doing, do it well.
translation: 这是！但你不能在质量上省钱。如果一项工作值得做，就做好它。 [zhe shi ！ dan ni bu neng zai zhi liang shang sheng qian 。 ru guo yi xiang gong zuo zhi de zuo ， jiu zuo hao ta 。]

english: I'm also the only one who can repair pickaxes these days, so you don't really have much choice!
translation: 我也是现在唯一一个能修理镐的人，所以你真的没有太多选择！ [wo ye shi xian zai wei yi yi ge neng xiu li gao de ren ， suo yi ni zhen de mei you tai duo xuan ze ！]

english: Okay then, let's do it.
translation: 好吧，那我们就开始吧。 [hao ba ， na wo men jiu kai shi ba 。]

english: I'll think about it.
translation: 我会考虑一下。 [wo hui kao lv yi xia 。]

english: Yes, please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Are your pickaxes better than other pickaxes, then?
translation: 那么，您的镐比其他镐更好吗？ [na me ， nin de gao bi qi ta gao geng hao ma ？]

english: Yes, let's do it.
translation: 是的，让我们开始吧。 [shi de ， rang wo men kai shi ba 。]

english: That's rather expensive...
translation: 那就比较贵了... [na jiu bi jiao gui le ...]

english: Okay then, let's do it.
translation: 好吧，那我们就开始吧。 [hao ba ， na wo men jiu kai shi ba 。]

english: I'll think about it.
translation: 我会考虑一下。 [wo hui kao lv yi xia 。]

english: Patients, patients everywhere! We need to get these soldiers up and fighting again!
translation: 病人，到处都是病人！我们需要让这些士兵站起来再次战斗！ [bing ren ， dao chu dou shi bing ren ！ wo men xu yao rang zhe xie shi bing zhan qi lai zai ci zhan dou ！]

english: I don't have time to chat, I have patients to attend to.
translation: 我没有时间聊天，我还有病人要照顾。 [wo mei you shi jian liao tian ， wo hai you bing ren yao zhao gu 。]

english: I can't take much more of this. As soon as we help one patient, another comes in!
translation: 我不能再忍受更多了。一旦我们帮助了一名患者，另一个患者就会进来！ [wo bu neng zai ren shou geng duo le 。 yi dan wo men bang zhu le yi ming huan zhe ， ling yi ge huan zhe jiu hui jin lai ！]

english: Patients, patients everywhere! We need all the help we can get to get these soldiers up and fighting again. Can you help us?
translation: 病人，到处都是病人！我们需要尽可能多的帮助来让这些士兵重新站起来并继续战斗。你能帮助我们吗？ [bing ren ， dao chu dou shi bing ren ！ wo men xu yao jin ke neng duo de bang zhu lai rang zhe xie shi bing chong xin zhan qi lai bing ji xu zhan dou 。 ni neng bang zhu wo men ma ？]

english: Sure, what do you need me to do?
translation: 当然可以，你需要我做什么？ [dang ran ke yi ， ni xu yao wo zuo shen me ？]

english: Firstly, you're going to need to gather some medpacks. There should be plenty of boxes around here with some in.
translation: 首先，你需要收集一些医疗包。这里应该有很多盒子，里面有一些。 [shou xian ， ni xu yao shou ji yi xie yi liao bao 。 zhe li ying gai you hen duo he zi ， li mian you yi xie 。]

english: After you've got some, we have several tents full of soldiers who've been hurt in the battle against the lizardmen.
translation: 当你得到一些之后，我们有几个帐篷，里面装满了在与蜥蜴人的战斗中受伤的士兵。 [dang ni de dao yi xie zhi hou ， wo men you ji ge zhang peng ， li mian zhuang man le zai yu xi yi ren de zhan dou zhong shou shang di shi bing 。]

english: Good, you have already found some medpacks. Now, we have several tents full of soldiers who've been hurt in the battle against the lizardmen.
translation: 很好，你已经找到了一些医疗包。现在，我们有几个帐篷，里面装满了在与蜥蜴人的战斗中受伤的士兵。 [hen hao ， ni yi jing zhao dao le yi xie yi liao bao 。 xian zai ， wo men you ji ge zhang peng ， li mian zhuang man le zai yu xi yi ren de zhan dou zhong shou shang di shi bing 。]

english: If you could help them out with those medpacks, that would be a massive help.
translation: 如果你能用这些医疗包帮助他们，那将是一个巨大的帮助。 [ru guo ni neng yong zhe xie yi liao bao bang zhu ta men ， na jiang shi yi ge ju da de bang zhu 。]

english: The people of Shayzien will thank you.
translation: Shayzien 的人民会感谢你的。 [Shayzien  de ren min hui gan xie ni de 。]

english: Thank you, I will get right to it.
translation: 谢谢你，我会马上开始做的。 [xie xie ni ， wo hui ma shang kai shi zuo de 。]

english: No, I'm sorry but I've got better things to be doing.
translation: 不，我很抱歉，但我还有更重要的事情要做。 [bu ， wo hen bao qian ， dan wo hai you geng zhong yao de shi qing yao zuo 。]

english: Sure, what do you need me to do?
translation: 当然可以，你需要我做什么？ [dang ran ke yi ， ni xu yao wo zuo shen me ？]

english: No, I'm sorry but I've got better things to be doing.
translation: 不，我很抱歉，但我还有更重要的事情要做。 [bu ， wo hen bao qian ， dan wo hai you geng zhong yao de shi qing yao zuo 。]

english: Patients, patients everywhere! We need to get these soldiers up and fighting again!
translation: 病人，到处都是病人！我们需要让这些士兵站起来再次战斗！ [bing ren ， dao chu dou shi bing ren ！ wo men xu yao rang zhe xie shi bing zhan qi lai zai ci zhan dou ！]

english: I don't have time to chat, I have patients to attend to.
translation: 我没有时间聊天，我还有病人要照顾。 [wo mei you shi jian liao tian ， wo hai you bing ren yao zhao gu 。]

english: I can't take much more of this. As soon as we help one patient, another comes in!
translation: 我不能再忍受更多了。一旦我们帮助了一名患者，另一个患者就会进来！ [wo bu neng zai ren shou geng duo le 。 yi dan wo men bang zhu le yi ming huan zhe ， ling yi ge huan zhe jiu hui jin lai ！]

english: I hope we can stop the lizardmen, I can't take much more of this. As soon as we help one patient, another comes in.
translation: 我希望我们能阻止蜥蜴人，我再也受不了了。一旦我们帮助了一名患者，另一名患者就会过来。 [wo xi wang wo men neng zu zhi xi yi ren ， wo zai ye shou bu liao le 。 yi dan wo men bang zhu le yi ming huan zhe ， ling yi ming huan zhe jiu hui guo lai 。]

english: Argh! Where are the bandages? I've got to get on with my job, please leave me be.
translation: 啊！绷带在哪里？我得继续我的工作，请别打扰我。 [a ！ beng dai zai na li ？ wo de ji xu wo de gong zuo ， qing bie da rao wo 。]

english: Either help out or get out of the way!
translation: 要么帮忙，要么滚开！ [yao me bang mang ， yao me gun kai ！]

english: Hello nurse.
translation: 你好护士。 [ni hao hu shi 。]

english: I don't know how much longer I can cope here.
translation: 我不知道我还能在这里忍受多久。 [wo bu zhi dao wo hai neng zai zhe li ren shou duo jiu 。]

english: What? Is the plague getting to you?
translation: 什么？瘟疫降临到你身上了吗？ [shen me ？ wen yi jiang lin dao ni shen shang le ma ？]

english: No, strangely enough the people here don't seem to be affected. It's just the awful living conditions that is making people ill.
translation: 不，奇怪的是这里的人似乎没有受到影响。正是糟糕的生活条件导致人们生病。 [bu ， qi guai de shi zhe li de ren si hu mei you shou dao ying xiang 。 zheng shi zao gao de sheng huo tiao jian dao zhi ren men sheng bing 。]

english: I was under the impression that everyone here was affected.
translation: 我的印象是这里的每个人都受到了影响。 [wo de yin xiang shi zhe li de mei ge ren dou shou dao le ying xiang 。]

english: Me too, but that doesn't seem to be the case.
translation: 我也是，不过好像不是这样的。 [wo ye shi ， bu guo hao xiang bu shi zhe yang de 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Hello my dear, how are you feeling?
translation: 你好，亲爱的，你感觉怎么样？ [ni hao ， qin ai de ， ni gan jue zen me yang ？]

english: I'm okay thanks.
translation: 我没事谢谢。 [wo mei shi xie xie 。]

english: Well in that case I'd better get back to work. Take care.
translation: 好吧，既然如此，我最好回去工作了。小心。 [hao ba ， ji ran ru ci ， wo zui hao hui qu gong zuo le 。 xiao xin 。]

english: You too.
translation: 你也是。 [ni ye shi 。]

english: Patients, patients everywhere! We need to get these soldiers up and fighting again!
translation: 病人，到处都是病人！我们需要让这些士兵站起来再次战斗！ [bing ren ， dao chu dou shi bing ren ！ wo men xu yao rang zhe xie shi bing zhan qi lai zai ci zhan dou ！]

english: I don't have time to chat, I have patients to attend to.
translation: 我没有时间聊天，我还有病人要照顾。 [wo mei you shi jian liao tian ， wo hai you bing ren yao zhao gu 。]

english: I can't take much more of this. As soon as we help one patient, another comes in!
translation: 我不能再忍受更多了。一旦我们帮助了一名患者，另一个患者就会进来！ [wo bu neng zai ren shou geng duo le 。 yi dan wo men bang zhu le yi ming huan zhe ， ling yi ge huan zhe jiu hui jin lai ！]

english: Please help me with this!
translation: 请帮我解决这个问题！ [qing bang wo jie jue zhe ge wen ti ！]

english: Well done!
translation: 干得好！ [gan de hao ！]

english: You've been given a [new clue/casket]!
translation: 你已经获得了[新线索/棺材]！ [ni yi jing huo de le [ xin xian suo / guan cai ]！]

english: I hope we can stop the lizardmen, I can't take much more of this. As soon as we help one patient, another comes in.
translation: 我希望我们能阻止蜥蜴人，我再也受不了了。一旦我们帮助了一名患者，另一名患者就会过来。 [wo xi wang wo men neng zu zhi xi yi ren ， wo zai ye shou bu liao le 。 yi dan wo men bang zhu le yi ming huan zhe ， ling yi ming huan zhe jiu hui guo lai 。]

english: Argh! Where are the bandages? I've got to get on with my job, please leave me be.
translation: 啊！绷带在哪里？我得继续我的工作，请别打扰我。 [a ！ beng dai zai na li ？ wo de ji xu wo de gong zuo ， qing bie da rao wo 。]

english: Either help out or get out of the way!
translation: 要么帮忙，要么滚开！ [yao me bang mang ， yao me gun kai ！]

english: Good day, adventurer.
translation: 美好的一天，冒险家。 [mei hao de yi tian ， mao xian jia 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I am Lord D'rows, leader of the Oathbreakers. Yourself?
translation: 我是德洛斯勋爵，破誓者的领袖。你自己？ [wo shi de luo si xun jue ， po shi zhe de ling xiu 。 ni zi ji ？]

english: I'm [player name]. That sounds pretty important.
translation: 我是[玩家姓名]。这听起来很重要。 [wo shi [ wan jia xing ming ]。 zhe ting qi lai hen zhong yao 。]

english: It is a job I do not take lightly.
translation: 这是一项我不会掉以轻心的工作。 [zhe shi yi xiang wo bu hui diao yi qing xin de gong zuo 。]

english: So what's this oath that you're all so proud of breaking?
translation: 那么你们如此自豪地打破的这个誓言是什么呢？ [na me ni men ru ci zi hao di da po de zhe ge shi yan shi shen me ne ？]

english: Pride? There is no pride in what we've done.
translation: 自豪？我们对所做的事情没有任何自豪感。 [zi hao ？ wo men dui suo zuo de shi qing mei you ren he zi hao gan 。]

english: Which was?
translation: 哪一个是？ [na yi ge shi ？]

english: We Oathbreakers were all once monks of Saradomin but have since seen that his light is false. The founder of this sanctuary had a similar story and that is why we follow in her footsteps.
translation: 我们背誓者都曾经是萨拉多明的僧侣，但后来发现他的光芒是虚假的。这个庇护所的创始人也有类似的故事，这就是为什么我们追随她的脚步。 [wo men bei shi zhe dou ceng jing shi sa la duo ming de seng lv ， dan hou lai fa xian ta de guang mang shi xu jia de 。 zhe ge bi hu suo de chuang shi ren ye you lei si de gu shi ， zhe jiu shi wei shen me wo men zhui sui ta de jiao bu 。]

english: What caused your faith in Saradomin to wane?
translation: 是什么导致您对萨拉多明的信心减弱？ [shi shen me dao zhi nin dui sa la duo ming de xin xin jian ruo ？]

english: How can order and wisdom prevail in a land where chaos and destruction reign supreme? That, and a few too many muggings during my travels. If you can't beat them, become them.
translation: 在一片混乱和破坏盛行的土地上，秩序和智慧如何能够盛行？还有我旅行期间发生的太多抢劫事件。如果你不能打败他们，那就成为他们。 [zai yi pian hun luan he po huai sheng xing de tu di shang ， zhi xu he zhi hui ru he neng gou sheng xing ？ hai you wo lv xing qi jian fa sheng de tai duo qiang jie shi jian 。 ru guo ni bu neng da bai ta men ， na jiu cheng wei ta men 。]

english: I see.
translation: 我懂了。 [wo dong le 。]

english: Was there anything else?
translation: 还有别的事吗？ [hai you bie de shi ma ？]

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？ [ni wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: We've been keeping an eye on Slepe lately. We could sense a darkness building as the citizens fell into their endless slumber.
translation: 我们最近一直在关注 Slepe。当公民陷入无尽的沉睡时，我们可以感觉到黑暗正在形成。 [wo men zui jin yi zhi zai guan zhu  Slepe。 dang gong min xian ru wu jin de chen shui shi ， wo men ke yi gan jue dao hei an zheng zai xing cheng 。]

english: Once we'd heard that the sanctuary had been broken into, we came here posthaste.
translation: 当我们听说圣所被闯入时，我们就匆忙赶到了这里。 [dang wo men ting shuo sheng suo bei chuang ru shi ， wo men jiu cong mang gan dao le zhe li 。]

english: Broken into?
translation: 闯入？ [chuang ru ？]

english: Indeed. This place was sealed, only to be reopened once Mother had awoken from her deep sleep.
translation: 的确。这里被封印了，只有等母亲从沉睡中醒来之后，才会重新开放。 [di que 。 zhe li bei feng yin le ， zhi you deng mu qin cong chen shui zhong xing lai zhi hou ， cai hui chong xin kai fang 。]

english: This nightmarish creature that the siren warned us of has made a home here. That was reason enough for her to unseal the entrance.
translation: 海妖警告我们的这种噩梦般的生物已经在这里安家了。这已经是她打开入口的足够理由了。 [hai yao jing gao wo men de zhe zhong e meng ban de sheng wu yi jing zai zhe li an jia le 。 zhe yi jing shi ta da kai ru kou de zu gou li you le 。]

english: Oh, um, whose mother? Yours?
translation: 哦，嗯，​​谁的妈妈？你的？ [o ， n ，​​ shei de ma ma ？ ni de ？]

english: Oh, not my actual mother, you fool. Phosani, the founder of this sanctuary went by the title of 'Mother' while her followers adopted the title of 'Sister'. I'm sure you've seen them around.
translation: 哦，不是我亲生母亲，你这个傻瓜。该庇护所的创始人福萨尼（Phosani）被称为“母亲”，而她的追随者则被称为“姐妹”。我相信你一定见过他们。 [o ， bu shi wo qin sheng mu qin ， ni zhe ge sha gua 。 gai bi hu suo de chuang shi ren fu sa ni （Phosani） bei cheng wei “ mu qin ”， er ta de zhui sui zhe ze bei cheng wei “ jie mei ”。 wo xiang xin ni yi ding jian guo ta men 。]

english: I have. I suspect you're quite bothered about the sudden influx of visitors?
translation: 我有。我猜你对突然涌入的游客感到很烦恼吧？ [wo you 。 wo cai ni dui tu ran yong ru de you ke gan dao hen fan nao ba ？]

english: Well, yes, but that fish woman claims every warrior is needed to defeat the Nightmare and that everyone asleep here is at risk.
translation: 嗯，是的，但是那个鱼女声称需要每个战士才能击败梦魇，并且这里睡着的每个人都处于危险之中。 [n ， shi de ， dan shi na ge yu nv sheng cheng xu yao mei ge zhan shi cai neng ji bai meng yan ， bing qie zhe li shui zhao de mei ge ren dou chu yu wei xian zhi zhong 。]

english: We must be strong, adventurer. Be strong for Mother.
translation: 我们必须坚强，冒险家。为了妈妈，要坚强。 [wo men bi xu jian qiang ， mao xian jia 。 wei le ma ma ， yao jian qiang 。]

english: Okay... Does this creature have treasure? That's kind of a sticking point for me.
translation: 好吧……这个生物有宝藏吗？这对我来说是一个症结所在。 [hao ba …… zhe ge sheng wu you bao zang ma ？ zhe dui wo lai shuo shi yi ge zheng jie suo zai 。]

english: Treasure? This sanctuary is full of old trinkets which the hag has claimed as her own. Kill her and take them, as is the Zamorakian way.
translation: 宝藏？这个圣所充满了老旧的小饰品，女巫声称这些小饰品是她自己的。杀掉她并带走他们，就像萨莫拉克人的方式一样。 [bao zang ？ zhe ge sheng suo chong man le lao jiu de xiao shi pin ， nv wu sheng cheng zhe xie xiao shi pin shi ta zi ji de 。 sha diao ta bing dai zou ta men ， jiu xiang sa mo la ke ren de fang shi yi yang 。]

english: Oh yes, the iron price. My specialty.
translation: 哦，对了，铁价。我的专长。 [o ， dui le ， tie jia 。 wo de zhuan chang 。]

english: Your friends are a quiet bunch.
translation: 你的朋友是一群安静的人。 [ni de peng you shi yi qun an jing de ren 。]

english: They took a vow of silence. I speak for them.
translation: 他们发誓保持沉默。我为他们说话。 [ta men fa shi bao chi chen mo 。 wo wei ta men shuo hua 。]

english: Oh, how come?
translation: 哦，怎么会呢？ [o ， zen me hui ne ？]

english: It is the way. When I fall, one of them will take my place as the Oath Lord.
translation: 这就是方法。当我倒下时，他们中的一位将取代我成为誓言之主。 [zhe jiu shi fang fa 。 dang wo dao xia shi ， ta men zhong de yi wei jiang qu dai wo cheng wei shi yan zhi zhu 。]

english: No disagreements, that must be nice.
translation: 没有任何分歧，那一定很好。 [mei you ren he fen qi ， na yi ding hen hao 。]

english: I never claimed that they can't communicate. They know a rudimentary hand-talk to vent their frustrations with my leadership. Making decisions is easier when no one can shout at you.
translation: 我从来没有说过他们无法沟通。他们懂得用基本的手势来发泄对我领导力的不满。当没有人可以对你大喊大叫时，做出决定就会更容易。 [wo cong lai mei you shuo guo ta men wu fa gou tong 。 ta men dong de yong ji ben de shou shi lai fa xie dui wo ling dao li de bu man 。 dang mei you ren ke yi dui ni da han da jiao shi ， zuo chu jue ding jiu hui geng rong yi 。]

english: Huh, I can imagine.
translation: 呵呵，我可以想象。 [he he ， wo ke yi xiang xiang 。]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Stay strong, adventurer.
translation: 保持坚强，冒险家。 [bao chi jian qiang ， mao xian jia 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？ [ni wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: Your friends are a quiet bunch.
translation: 你的朋友是一群安静的人。 [ni de peng you shi yi qun an jing de ren 。]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: They don't seem willing to talk.
translation: 他们似乎不愿意说话。 [ta men si hu bu yuan yi shuo hua 。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: They don't seem willing to talk.
translation: 他们似乎不愿意说话。 [ta men si hu bu yuan yi shuo hua 。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: They don't seem willing to talk.
translation: 他们似乎不愿意说话。 [ta men si hu bu yuan yi shuo hua 。]

english: Welcome to Obli's General Store Bwana! Would you like to see my items?
translation: 欢迎来到 Obli's General Store Bwana！您想看看我的物品吗？ [huan ying lai dao  Obli's General Store Bwana！ nin xiang kan kan wo de wu pin ma ？]

english: Yes please!
translation: 是的，请！ [shi de ， qing ！]

english: No, but thanks for the offer.
translation: 不，但谢谢你的提议。 [bu ， dan xie xie ni de ti yi 。]

english: I'm getting out of here Bwana, the place is infested with zombies.
translation: 我要离开这里，布瓦纳，这个地方到处都是僵尸。 [wo yao li kai zhe li ， bu wa na ， zhe ge di fang dao chu dou shi jiang shi 。]

english: Yes please!
translation: 是的，请！ [shi de ， qing ！]

english: No, but thanks for the offer.
translation: 不，但谢谢你的提议。 [bu ， dan xie xie ni de ti yi 。]

english: Hi, are you busy?
translation: 嗨，你忙吗？ [hai ， ni mang ma ？]

english: Me? I'm always busy.
translation: 我？我总是很忙。 [wo ？ wo zong shi hen mang 。]

english: See that man there? That's the professor. If he had his way, I think he'd never let me sleep!
translation: 看到那儿的那个人了吗？那是教授。如果他有他的办法，我想他永远不会让我睡觉！ [kan dao na er de na ge ren le ma ？ na shi jiao shou 。 ru guo ta you ta de ban fa ， wo xiang ta yong yuan bu hui rang wo shui jiao ！]

english: Anyway, how might I help you?
translation: 不管怎样，我能帮你什么忙？ [bu guan zen yang ， wo neng bang ni shen me mang ？]

english: I was wondering what you do here.
translation: 我想知道你在这里做什么。 [wo xiang zhi dao ni zai zhe li zuo shen me 。]

english: Glad you ask. This is the Observatory reception.
translation: 很高兴你问。这是天文台接待处。 [hen gao xing ni wen 。 zhe shi tian wen tai jie dai chu 。]

english: Up on the cliff is the Observatory dome, from which you can view the heavens.
translation: 悬崖上是天文台的圆顶，从那里可以看到天空。 [xuan ya shang shi tian wen tai de yuan ding ， cong na li ke yi kan dao tian kong 。]

english: Usually...
translation: 通常... [tong chang ...]

english: What do you mean, 'usually'?
translation: 你说的“通常”是什么意思？ [ni shuo de “ tong chang ” shi shen me yi si ？]

english: *Ahem*. Back to work, please.
translation: *咳咳*。请回去工作吧。 [* hai hai *。 qing hui qu gong zuo ba 。]

english: I'd speak with the professor. He'll explain.
translation: 我会和教授谈谈。他会解释的。 [wo hui he jiao shou tan tan 。 ta hui jie shi de 。]

english: What's that board for?
translation: 那个板子是做什么用的？ [na ge ban zi shi zuo shen me yong de ？]

english: The one behind me? We use it to keep track of fallen stars and those that find them.
translation: 我身后那个？我们用它来追踪坠落的星星以及那些找到它们的人。 [wo shen hou na ge ？ wo men yong ta lai zhui zong zhui luo de xing xing yi ji na xie zhao dao ta men de ren 。]

english: Fallen stars?
translation: 陨落的星星？ [yun luo de xing xing ？]

english: That's right. From time to time, stars fall from the sky and land somewhere in Gielinor.
translation: 这是正确的。时不时会有星星从天而降，落在吉林诺的某个地方。 [zhe shi zheng que de 。 shi bu shi hui you xing xing cong tian er jiang ， luo zai ji lin nuo de mou ge di fang 。]

english: Whenever one does, we make a note on the board. If someone finds it, we note their name as well.
translation: 每当有人这样做时，我们都会在黑板上做笔记。如果有人找到它，我们也会记下他们的名字。 [mei dang you ren zhe yang zuo shi ， wo men du hui zai hei ban shang zuo bi ji 。 ru guo you ren zhao dao ta ， wo men ye hui ji xia ta men de ming zi 。]

english: I see. And how do people find them?
translation: 我懂了。人们如何找到它们？ [wo dong le 。 ren men ru he zhao dao ta men ？]

english: There's a lot of amateur astronomers out there. Many of them have small telescopes in their homes. They use them to work out when a star is going to fall.
translation: 那里有很多业余天文学家。他们中的许多人家里都有小型望远镜。他们用它们来计算恒星何时会坠落。 [na li you hen duo ye yu tian wen xue jia 。 ta men zhong de xu duo ren jia li dou you xiao xing wang yuan jing 。 ta men yong ta men lai ji suan heng xing he shi hui zhui luo 。]

english: Could I do that?
translation: 我可以这样做吗？ [wo ke yi zhe yang zuo ma ？]

english: I imagine so. Just get yourself a telescope and look out for stars.
translation: 我想是这样。只要给自己买一个望远镜，寻找星星即可。 [wo xiang shi zhe yang 。 zhi yao gei zi ji mai yi ge wang yuan jing ， xun zhao xing xing ji ke 。]

english: Awesome. I might just give it a go.
translation: 惊人的。我可能会尝试一下。 [jing ren de 。 wo ke neng hui chang shi yi xia 。]

english: Good luck. If you're interested, I hear there's a dwarf at the Mining Guild who's keen on gathering stardust. If you find some, he might be willing to trade with you.
translation: 祝你好运。如果你有兴趣的话，我听说采矿公会里有一个矮人热衷于收集星尘。如果你找到一些，他可能愿意与你交易。 [zhu ni hao yun 。 ru guo ni you xing qu de hua ， wo ting shuo cai kuang gong hui li you yi ge ai ren re zhong yu shou ji xing chen 。 ru guo ni zhao dao yi xie ， ta ke neng yuan yi yu ni jiao yi 。]

english: Good to know. Thanks.
translation: 很高兴知道。谢谢。 [hen gao xing zhi dao 。 xie xie 。]

english: Oh yes. I've seen one of those before.
translation: 哦是的。我以前见过其中之一。 [o shi de 。 wo yi qian jian guo qi zhong zhi yi 。]

english: You're very lucky. They are quite rare. Anyway, whenever one falls, we make a note on the board. If someone finds it, we note their name as well.
translation: 你很幸运。它们非常罕见。不管怎样，每当有人跌倒时，我们都会在黑板上做笔记。如果有人找到它，我们也会记下他们的名字。 [ni hen xing yun 。 ta men fei chang han jian 。 bu guan zen yang ， mei dang you ren die dao shi ， wo men du hui zai hei ban shang zuo bi ji 。 ru guo you ren zhao dao ta ， wo men ye hui ji xia ta men de ming zi 。]

english: I'd better be off.
translation: 我最好还是离开吧 [wo zui hao hai shi li kai ba]

english: Just looking around, thanks.
translation: 随便看看，谢谢。 [sui bian kan kan ， xie xie 。]

english: Okay, just don't break anything. If you need any help, let me know.
translation: 好吧，只是不要破坏任何东西。如果您需要任何帮助，请告诉我。 [hao ba ， zhi shi bu yao po huai ren he dong xi 。 ru guo nin xu yao ren he bang zhu ， qing gao su wo 。]

english: Can I have a look through that telescope?
translation: 我可以用那个望远镜看看吗？ [wo ke yi yong na ge wang yuan jing kan kan ma ？]

english: You can. You won't see much though.
translation: 你可以。不过你不会看到太多。 [ni ke yi 。 bu guo ni bu hui kan dao tai duo 。]

english: And that's because?
translation: 那是因为？ [na shi yin wei ？]

english: Just talk to the professor. He'll fill you in.
translation: 只要和教授谈谈就可以了。他会给你填写。 [zhi yao he jiao shou tan tan jiu ke yi le 。 ta hui gei ni tian xie 。]

english: Hi assistant.
translation: 嗨，助理。 [hai ， zhu li 。]

english: Wait a minute, what's your real name?
translation: 等一下，你的真名是什么？ [deng yi xia ， ni de zhen ming shi shen me ？]

english: My real name?
translation: 我的真名？ [wo de zhen ming ？]

english: I only know you as the professor's assistant. What's your actual name?
translation: 我只知道你是教授的助理。你的真名是什么？ [wo zhi zhi dao ni shi jiao shou de zhu li 。 ni de zhen ming shi shen me ？]

english: Patrick.
translation: 帕特里克. [pa te li ke .]

english: Hi, Patrick, I'm [player name].
translation: 嗨，帕特里克，我是[玩家姓名]。 [hai ， pa te li ke ， wo shi [ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Well, hello again, and thanks for helping out the professor.
translation: 好吧，再次问好，感谢您为教授提供的帮助。 [hao ba ， zai ci wen hao ， gan xie nin wei jiao shou ti gong de bang zhu 。]

english: Oh, and, believe it or not, his name is Mambo-duna- roona, but don't tell him I told you.
translation: 哦，还有，不管你信不信，他的名字是 Mambo-duna-roona，但别告诉他是我告诉你的。 [o ， hai you ， bu guan ni xin bu xin ， ta de ming zi shi  Mambo-duna-roona， dan bie gao su ta shi wo gao su ni de 。]

english: You made that up!
translation: 你编的！ [ni bian de ！]

english: No, honest! Anyways, you've made my life much easier. Have a drink on me!
translation: 不，诚实！不管怎样，你让我的生活变得轻松多了。给我喝一杯吧！ [bu ， cheng shi ！ bu guan zen yang ， ni rang wo de sheng huo bian de qing song duo le 。 gei wo he yi bei ba ！]

english: Thanks very much.
translation: 非常感谢。 [fei chang gan xie 。]

english: No problem. Scorpius would be proud.
translation: 没问题。天蝎座会感到自豪。 [mei wen ti 。 tian xie zuo hui gan dao zi hao 。]

english: Sorry?
translation: 对不起？ [dui bu qi ？]

english: You may want to check out the book on the table, and perhaps look around for a grave...
translation: 你可能想看看桌子上的书，也许还想看看周围有没有坟墓…… [ni ke neng xiang kan kan zhuo zi shang de shu ， ye xu hai xiang kan kan zhou wei you mei you fen mu ……]

english: Oh, sorry, I can't carry anything else.
translation: 哦，抱歉，我不能带别的东西了。 [o ， bao qian ， wo bu neng dai bie de dong xi le 。]

english: Well, then, please come back when you do.
translation: 那么，到时候就请回来吧。 [na me ， dao shi hou jiu qing hui lai ba 。]

english: How was the wine?
translation: 酒怎么样？ [jiu zen me yang ？]

english: That was good stuff, *hic*! Wheresh the professher?
translation: 那是好东西，*呃*！教授在哪里？ [na shi hao dong xi ，* e *！ jiao shou zai na li ？]

english: The professor? He's up in the Observatory. Since the bridge was ruined, you will have to travel through the dungeon under the goblins' settlement.
translation: 教授？他在天文台上。由于桥梁被毁，你将不得不穿过妖精定居点下的地牢。 [jiao shou ？ ta zai tian wen tai shang 。 you yu qiao liang bei hui ， ni jiang bu de bu chuan guo yao jing ding ju dian xia de di lao 。]

english: That was good stuff! Where's the professor?
translation: 那是好东西！教授在哪里？ [na shi hao dong xi ！ jiao shou zai na li ？]

english: Look what I have.
translation: 看看我有什么。 [kan kan wo you shen me 。]

english: Good for you. As much as I want to admire your possessions, I do have work to do.
translation: 对你有好处。尽管我很想欣赏你的财产，但我确实有工作要做。 [dui ni you hao chu 。 jin guan wo hen xiang xin shang ni de cai chan ， dan wo que shi you gong zuo yao zuo 。]

english: Oh, right. Sorry.
translation: 哦，对了。对不起。 [o ， dui le 。 dui bu qi 。]

english: What do you think of this?
translation: 您对此有何看法？ [nin dui ci you he kan fa ？]

english: I'd rather you show me the actual item, as opposed to the note form.
translation: 我宁愿你给我看实际的项目，而不是注释表格。 [wo ning yuan ni gei wo kan shi ji de xiang mu ， er bu shi zhu shi biao ge 。]

english: I was wondering what you do here.
translation: 我想知道你在这里做什么。 [wo xiang zhi dao ni zai zhe li zuo shen me 。]

english: What's that board for?
translation: 那个板子是做什么用的？ [na ge ban zi shi zuo shen me yong de ？]

english: Can I have a look through that telescope?
translation: 我可以用那个望远镜看看吗？ [wo ke yi yong na ge wang yuan jing kan kan ma ？]

english: I'd better be off.
translation: 我最好还是离开吧 [wo zui hao hai shi li kai ba]

english: Just looking around, thanks.
translation: 随便看看，谢谢。 [sui bian kan kan ， xie xie 。]

english: Wait a minute, what's your real name?
translation: 等一下，你的真名是什么？ [deng yi xia ， ni de zhen ming shi shen me ？]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hi, I was...
translation: 嗨，我当时... [hai ， wo dang shi ...]

english: Welcome to the magnificent wonder of the Observatory, where wonder is all around you, where the stars can be clutched from the heavens!
translation: 欢迎来到天文台的壮丽奇观，这里的奇观就在您的周围，在这里可以从天上抓到星星！ [huan ying lai dao tian wen tai de zhuang li qi guan ， zhe li de qi guan jiu zai nin de zhou wei ， zai zhe li ke yi cong tian shang zhua dao xing xing ！]

english: Wow, nice intro.
translation: 哇，不错的介绍。 [wa ， bu cuo de jie shao 。]

english: Why, thanks! How might I help you?
translation: 为什么，谢谢！我可以怎样帮助你？ [wei shen me ， xie xie ！ wo ke yi zen yang bang zhu ni ？]

english: Lost? It must have been those pesky goblins that led you astray.
translation: 丢失的？肯定是那些讨厌的妖精让你误入歧途的。 [diu shi de ？ ken ding shi na xie tao yan de yao jing rang ni wu ru qi tu de 。]

english: Head north-east to find the city of Ardougne.
translation: 向东北方向行驶，找到阿杜涅市。 [xiang dong bei fang xiang xing shi ， zhao dao a du nie shi 。]

english: I'm sure I'll find the way.
translation: 我确信我会找到路的。 [wo que xin wo hui zhao dao lu de 。]

english: Thanks for all your help.
translation: 感谢您的帮助。 [gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]

english: No problem at all. Come and visit again!
translation: 完全没问题。再次光临！ [wan quan mei wen ti 。 zai ci guang lin ！]

english: The professor carries on with his studies.
translation: 教授继续他的研究。 [jiao shou ji xu ta de yan jiu 。]

english: An Observatory?
translation: 天文台？ [tian wen tai ？]

english: Of course. We have a superb telescope up in the Observatory, on the hill.
translation: 当然。我们在山上的天文台里有一架一流的望远镜。 [dang ran 。 wo men zai shan shang de tian wen tai li you yi jia yi liu de wang yuan jing 。]

english: A truly marvellous invention, the likes of which you'll never behold again.
translation: 这是一项真正了不起的发明，您将永远不会再看到这样的发明。 [zhe shi yi xiang zhen zheng liao bu qi de fa ming ， nin jiang yong yuan bu hui zai kan dao zhe yang de fa ming 。]

english: Well, it would be if it worked.
translation: 好吧，如果有效的话那就好了。 [hao ba ， ru guo you xiao de hua na jiu hao le 。]

english: Don't interrupt!
translation: 别打扰！ [bie da rao ！]

english: What? It doesn't work?
translation: 什么？不起作用？ [shen me ？ bu qi zuo yong ？]

english: Oh, no, no, no. Don't listen to him, he's joking. Aren't you, my FAITHFUL assistant?
translation: 哦，不，不，不。别听他的，他是在开玩笑。你不是吗，我忠实的助手？ [o ， bu ， bu ， bu 。 bie ting ta de ， ta shi zai kai wan xiao 。 ni bu shi ma ， wo zhong shi de zhu shou ？]

english: Nope, dead serious. Hasn't been working for a long time.
translation: 不，非常严重。已经很久没有工作了。 [bu ， fei chang yan zhong 。 yi jing hen jiu mei you gong zuo le 。]

english: Arghhh! Get back to work and stop sticking your nose in!
translation: 啊啊！回去工作吧，别再插手了！ [a a ！ hui qu gong zuo ba ， bie zai cha shou le ！]

english: So, it's broken. How come?
