translation: 伟大的。如果你能给我一根妖精、一只熊、一只大青蛙、一只公羊、一只独角兽、一只猴子、一只巨型老鼠和一只巨型蝙蝠的骨头，那么我就可以继续…… [wei da de 。 ru guo ni neng gei wo yi gen yao jing 、 yi zhi xiong 、 yi zhi da qing wa 、 yi zhi gong yang 、 yi zhi du jiao shou 、 yi zhi hou zi 、 yi zhi ju xing lao shu he yi zhi ju xing bian fu de gu tou ， na me wo jiu ke yi ji xu ……]

english: Displays...
translation: 显示... [xian shi ...]

english: So you just want me to bring you these bones and that will be that?
translation: 所以你只是想让我把这些骨头带给你就这样了？ [suo yi ni zhi shi xiang rang wo ba zhe xie gu tou dai gei ni jiu zhe yang le ？]

english: Well, I wouldn't mind you sticking them in a pot and boiling them in vinegar first, if you don't mind.
translation: 好吧，如果你不介意的话，我不介意你把它们放在锅里，然后先用醋煮。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni bu jie yi de hua ， wo bu jie yi ni ba ta men fang zai guo li ， ran hou xian yong cu zhu 。]

english: There is a Wine Merchant in Draynor called Fortunato that sells the stuff you'll need.
translation: 德拉诺有一个名叫福尔图纳托的葡萄酒商人，出售你需要的东西。 [de la nuo you yi ge ming jiao fu er tu na tuo de pu tao jiu shang ren ， chu shou ni xu yao de dong xi 。]

english: You can even use my pot-boiler if you want.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，你甚至可以使用我的煮锅。 [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， ni shen zhi ke yi shi yong wo de zhu guo 。]

english: Why do I need to boil them in vinegar?
translation: 为什么我需要用醋煮它们？ [wei shen me wo xu yao yong cu zhu ta men ？]

english: It gets them bright and sparking white.
translation: 它使它们变得明亮并闪闪发光。 [ta shi ta men bian de ming liang bing shan shan fa guang 。]

english: It's an archaeologist thing.
translation: 这是考古学家的事。 [zhe shi kao gu xue jia de shi 。]

english: Just put the bone in a pot of vinegar, throw some logs on the fire, put the pot in the holder and light the logs.
translation: 只需将骨头放入一锅醋中，将一些木头扔到火上，将锅放在支架上并点燃木头即可。 [zhi xu jiang gu tou fang ru yi guo cu zhong ， jiang yi xie mu tou reng dao huo shang ， jiang guo fang zai zhi jia shang bing dian ran mu tou ji ke 。]

english: It takes a while for the vinegar to evaporate, but the bone will be nice and clean in the end.
translation: 醋需要一段时间才能蒸发，但骨头最终会变得又漂亮又干净。 [cu xu yao yi duan shi jian cai neng zheng fa ， dan gu tou zui zhong hui bian de you piao liang you gan jing 。]

english: All right, I'll be back later.
translation: 好的，我稍后回来。 [hao de ， wo shao hou hui lai 。]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Oh...I see.
translation: 我懂了。 [wo dong le 。]

english: Well, never mind me young man, I'll just stagger over here under my massive burden, and continue my thankless task.
translation: 好吧，年轻人，别管我了，我就顶着沉重的负担摇摇晃晃地来到这里，继续我吃力不讨好的任务。 [hao ba ， nian qing ren ， bie guan wo le ， wo jiu ding zhe chen zhong de fu dan yao yao huang huang di lai dao zhe li ， ji xu wo chi li bu tao hao de ren wu 。]

english: Unaided and alone...
translation: 无助又孤独…… [wu zhu you gu du ……]

english: Wow, trying a guilt trip much?
translation: 哇，尝试一次内疚之旅吗？ [wa ， chang shi yi ci nei jiu zhi lv ma ？]

english: Well good luck with that!
translation: 祝你好运！ [zhu ni hao yun ！]

english: Thanks stranger!
translation: 谢谢陌生人！ [xie xie mo sheng ren ！]

english: What a polite young man...
translation: 多么有礼貌的年轻人啊…… [duo me you li mao de nian qing ren a ……]

english: Well, back to work!
translation: 好吧，回去工作吧！ [hao ba ， hui qu gong zuo ba ！]

english: Where is that mumbling coming from?
translation: 那咕哝声是从哪里来的？ [na gu nong sheng shi cong na li lai de ？]

english: What mumbling?
translation: 什么嘀咕？ [shen me di gu ？]

english: Anyway, I have enough problems of my own without dealing with a delusional adventurer.
translation: 不管怎样，我自己的问题已经够多了，不用再和一个妄想的冒险家打交道了。 [bu guan zen yang ， wo zi ji de wen ti yi jing gou duo le ， bu yong zai he yi ge wang xiang de mao xian jia da jiao dao le 。]

english: Sniggersnigger
translation: 斯尼格斯尼格 [si ni ge si ni ge]

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好呀！ [ni hao ya ！]

english: I was just passing and I wondered if you still needed someone to help with the bones?
translation: 我只是路过，我想知道你是否还需要有人帮忙处理骨头？ [wo zhi shi lu guo ， wo xiang zhi dao ni shi fou hai xu yao you ren bang mang chu li gu tou ？]

english: Have you brought me any bones?
translation: 你给我带来骨头了吗？ [ni gei wo dai lai gu tou le ma ？]

english: Not at the moment. Can you just give me a run down on which bones I have left to get?
translation: 目前还没有。你能告诉我还剩下哪些骨头吗？ [mu qian hai mei you 。 ni neng gao su wo hai sheng xia na xie gu tou ma ？]

english: Sure.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: You still need to bring me a Goblin bone.
translation: 你还得给我带一块哥布林骨头。 [ni hai de gei wo dai yi kuai ge bu lin gu tou 。]

english: Goblins are relatively common. I hear there is a house full of them around Lumbridge in fact.
translation: 哥布林比较常见。我听说朗布里奇周围有一所房子，里面装满了它们。 [ge bu lin bi jiao chang jian 。 wo ting shuo lang bu li qi zhou wei you yi suo fang zi ， li mian zhuang man le ta men 。]

english: You still need to bring me a Bear bone.
translation: 你还得给我带一块熊骨。 [ni hai de gei wo dai yi kuai xiong gu 。]

english: I heard that there are some Bears over by the Legends' Guild, near Ardougne.
translation: 我听说阿杜涅附近的传奇公会那边有一些熊。 [wo ting shuo a du nie fu jin de chuan qi gong hui na bian you yi xie xiong 。]

english: You still need to bring me a Big Frog bone.
translation: 你还得给我带一块大青蛙骨头。 [ni hai de gei wo dai yi kuai da qing wa gu tou 。]

english: This might be a little tricky as you will need to go into the Lumbridge Swamp caves. You will need a light source! Never forget your light source down there!
translation: 这可能有点棘手，因为您需要进入朗布里奇沼泽洞穴。你需要一个光源！永远不要忘记你的光源就在那里！ [zhe ke neng you dian ji shou ， yin wei nin xu yao jin ru lang bu li qi zhao ze dong xue 。 ni xu yao yi ge guang yuan ！ yong yuan bu yao wang ji ni de guang yuan jiu zai na li ！]

english: You still need to bring me a Ram bone.
translation: 你还得给我带一块羊骨。 [ni hai de gei wo dai yi kuai yang gu 。]

english: I'm sure you will be able to find a ram wherever there are sheep.
translation: 我相信只要有羊的地方就能找到公羊。 [wo xiang xin zhi yao you yang de di fang jiu neng zhao dao gong yang 。]

english: You still need to bring me a Unicorn bone.
translation: 你还得给我带来一块独角兽骨头。 [ni hai de gei wo dai lai yi kuai du jiao shou gu tou 。]

english: I seem to remember that there were Unicorns south of Varrock, I think they might be there still.
translation: 我似乎记得瓦罗克以南有独角兽，我想它们可能还在那里。 [wo si hu ji de wa luo ke yi nan you du jiao shou ， wo xiang ta men ke neng hai zai na li 。]

english: You still need to bring me a Monkey bone.
translation: 你还得给我带一根猴骨。 [ni hai de gei wo dai yi gen hou gu 。]

english: Monkeys tend to live in Jungle areas, like Karamja. I think they are pretty plentiful there if I remember correctly.
translation: 猴子往往生活在丛林地区，比如卡拉姆贾。如果我没记错的话，我想那里的东西相当多。 [hou zi wang wang sheng huo zai cong lin di qu ， bi ru ka la mu jia 。 ru guo wo mei ji cuo de hua ， wo xiang na li de dong xi xiang dang duo 。]

english: You still need to bring me a Giant Rat bone.
translation: 你还得给我带一块巨鼠骨头。 [ni hai de gei wo dai yi kuai ju shu gu tou 。]

english: If you can't find one in a sewer, then you might want to try looking in some caves.
translation: 如果您在下水道中找不到，那么您可能想尝试在一些洞穴中寻找。 [ru guo nin zai xia shui dao zhong zhao bu dao ， na me nin ke neng xiang chang shi zai yi xie dong xue zhong xun zhao 。]

english: You still need to bring me a Giant Bat bone.
translation: 你还得给我带一块巨型蝙蝠骨头。 [ni hai de gei wo dai yi kuai ju xing bian fu gu tou 。]

english: Giant bats tend to live underground, but I have heard there are a few near the Coal Pits.
translation: 巨型蝙蝠通常生活在地下，但我听说煤坑附近也有一些。 [ju xing bian fu tong chang sheng huo zai di xia ， dan wo ting shuo mei keng fu jin ye you yi xie 。]

english: Did you get all that?
translation: 这些你都明白了吗？ [zhe xie ni dou ming bai le ma ？]

english: Yes. I'll get right on it.
translation: 是的。我会马上处理的。 [shi de 。 wo hui ma shang chu li de 。]

english: Don't forget to boil them in vinegar first.
translation: 别忘了先用醋煮它们。 [bie wang le xian yong cu zhu ta men 。]

english: Just chuck some logs into the pit, put the bone in the pot of vinegar and drop it onto the pot-boiler. Then light the logs and wait for the the vinegar to boil away.
translation: 只需将一些木头放入坑中，将骨头放入醋锅中，然后将其放入锅中即可。然后点燃木头并等待醋沸腾。 [zhi xu jiang yi xie mu tou fang ru keng zhong ， jiang gu tou fang ru cu guo zhong ， ran hou jiang qi fang ru guo zhong ji ke 。 ran hou dian ran mu tou bing deng dai cu fei teng 。]

english: Ok, I'll remember.
translation: 好的，我会记住的。 [hao de ， wo hui ji zhu de 。]

english: I have some bones for you.
translation: 我有一些骨头给你。 [wo you yi xie gu tou gei ni 。]

english: Great! Let me take a look at them.
translation: 伟大的！让我看看它们。 [wei da de ！ rang wo kan kan ta men 。]

english: That's the last of them!
translation: 这是他们最后一个了！ [zhe shi ta men zui hou yi ge le ！]

english: The museum will be thrilled to know I've completed the collection.
translation: 博物馆会很高兴知道我已经完成了收藏。 [bo wu guan hui hen gao xing zhi dao wo yi jing wan cheng le shou cang 。]

english: Well I'm just glad I could help.
translation: 嗯，我很高兴能提供帮助。 [n ， wo hen gao xing neng ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: Well you've been a big help and no mistake.
translation: 嗯，你帮了很大的忙，没有错。 [n ， ni bang le hen da de mang ， mei you cuo 。]

english: I'm always on the lookout for fresh bones, so if you see some bring them right over.
translation: 我一直在寻找新鲜的骨头，所以如果你看到一些，就把它们带过来。 [wo yi zhi zai xun zhao xin xian de gu tou ， suo yi ru guo ni kan dao yi xie ， jiu ba ta men dai guo lai 。]

english: No problem, I'll be sure to bring anything you might like over if I find something.
translation: 没问题，如果我找到什么，我一定会把你喜欢的东西带过来。 [mei wen ti ， ru guo wo zhao dao shen me ， wo yi ding hui ba ni xi huan de dong xi dai guo lai 。]

english: I can't wait to see the displays once they are finished.
translation: 我迫不及待地想看到展示完成后的样子。 [wo po bu ji dai di xiang kan dao zhan shi wan cheng hou de yang zi 。]

english: Quest complete!
translation: 任务完成！ [ren wu wan cheng ！]

english: Can I have a replacement helm? I managed to lose the last one.
translation: 我可以更换头盔吗？我成功地失去了最后一个。 [wo ke yi geng huan tou kui ma ？ wo cheng gong di shi qu le zui hou yi ge 。]

english: No problem. I have plenty after all.
translation: 没问题。毕竟我还有很多。 [mei wen ti 。 bi jing wo hai you hen duo 。]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: Can I have a replacement bonesack? I managed to lose the last one.
translation: 我可以更换骨袋吗？我成功地失去了最后一个。 [wo ke yi geng huan gu dai ma ？ wo cheng gong di shi qu le zui hou yi ge 。]

english: How's the sorting going?
translation: 排序进行得怎么样了？ [pai xu jin xing de zen me yang le ？]

english: Oh, the 'sorting' is going very well, very well indeed.
translation: 哦，‘排序’进行得非常顺利，确实非常顺利。 [o ，‘ pai xu ’ jin xing de fei chang shun li ， que shi fei chang shun li 。]

english: I'm glad to hear it!
translation: 我很高兴听到这个消息！ [wo hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi ！]

english: Can I exchange this helm for the bonesack?
translation: 我可以用这个头盔换骨袋吗？ [wo ke yi yong zhe ge tou kui huan gu dai ma ？]

english: I don't see why not.
translation: 我不明白为什么不。 [wo bu ming bai wei shen me bu 。]

english: There you go.
translation: 就这样吧。 [jiu zhe yang ba 。]

english: Come up and see me if you want to swap back.
translation: 如果你想换回来就上来见我。 [ru guo ni xiang huan hui lai jiu shang lai jian wo 。]

english: Could I have a bonesack as well?
translation: 我也能有一个骨头包吗？ [wo ye neng you yi ge gu tou bao ma ？]

english: I... do have many of each. I suppose it wouldn't be a problem.
translation: 我……每种都有很多。我想这不会是一个问题。 [wo …… mei zhong dou you hen duo 。 wo xiang zhe bu hui shi yi ge wen ti 。]

english: Come up and see me if you lose it.
translation: 如果你丢了就过来找我。 [ru guo ni diu le jiu guo lai zhao wo 。]

english: Where was that mumbling coming from anyway?
translation: 到底那咕哝声是从哪里来的？ [dao di na gu nong sheng shi cong na li lai de ？]

english: You must be hearing things. I think you need to have a lie down.
translation: 你一定听到了什么。我认为你需要躺下。 [ni yi ding ting dao le shen me 。 wo ren wei ni xu yao tang xia 。]

english: Can I exchange this bonesack for the helm?
translation: 我可以用这个骨袋换头盔吗？ [wo ke yi yong zhe ge gu dai huan tou kui ma ？]

english: Could I have a helm as well?
translation: 我也能拥有一个头盔吗？ [wo ye neng yong you yi ge tou kui ma ？]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello?
translation: 你好？ [ni hao ？]

english: I found this amulet. Do you know what it is?
translation: 我找到了这个护身符。你知道它是什么吗？ [wo zhao dao le zhe ge hu shen fu 。 ni zhi dao ta shi shen me ma ？]

english: It doesn't look like anything I've seen in the past, I don't think I'll have a use for it.
translation: 它看起来不像我过去见过的任何东西，我认为我不会用它。 [ta kan qi lai bu xiang wo guo qu jian guo de ren he dong xi ， wo ren wei wo bu hui yong ta 。]

english: Ahem!
translation: 咳咳！ [hai hai ！]

english: Although actually, thinking about it, I can take it off your hands if you'd like?
translation: 不过事实上，想一想，如果你愿意的话，我可以把它从你手里夺走？ [bu guo shi shi shang ， xiang yi xiang ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi ba ta cong ni shou li duo zou ？]

english: For free? I've helped the museum enough, do you have anything I could exchange it for?
translation: 免费？我对博物馆的帮助已经够多了，你有什么可以换的吗？ [mian fei ？ wo dui bo wu guan de bang zhu yi jing gou duo le ， ni you shen me ke yi huan de ma ？]

english: I could give you 30 big bones per amulet, I've built up quite a collection recently.
translation: 每个护身符我可以给你 30 块大骨头，我最近已经收集了不少。 [mei ge hu shen fu wo ke yi gei ni  30  kuai da gu tou ， wo zui jin yi jing shou ji le bu shao 。]

english: Here's 30 big bones, come back if you find another amulet.
translation: 这里有三十块大骨头，如果你找到了别的护身符就回来吧。 [zhe li you san shi kuai da gu tou ， ru guo ni zhao dao le bie de hu shen fu jiu hui lai ba 。]

english: No thank you. maybeanother time.
translation: 不，谢谢。也许其他时间。 [bu ， xie xie 。 ye xu qi ta shi jian 。]

english: Here's [input * 30] big bones, come back if you find another amulet.
translation: 这里有[输入*30]块大骨头，如果找到其他护身符就回来。 [zhe li you [ shu ru *30] kuai da gu tou ， ru guo zhao dao qi ta hu shen fu jiu hui lai 。]

english: Anything I can do to help?
translation: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang mang de ma ？]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Well, good luck with that.
translation: 好吧，祝你好运。 [hao ba ， zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Where is that mumbling coming from?
translation: 那咕哝声是从哪里来的？ [na gu nong sheng shi cong na li lai de ？]

english: Could I exchange this helm for the bonesack?
translation: 我可以用这个头盔换骨袋吗？ [wo ke yi yong zhe ge tou kui huan gu dai ma ？]

english: Could I have a bonesack as well?
translation: 我也能有一个骨头包吗？ [wo ye neng you yi ge gu tou bao ma ？]

english: Where was that mumbling coming from anyway?
translation: 到底那咕哝声是从哪里来的？ [dao di na gu nong sheng shi cong na li lai de ？]

english: Could I exchange this bonesack for the helm?
translation: 我可以用这个骨袋换头盔吗？ [wo ke yi yong zhe ge gu dai huan tou kui ma ？]

english: Could I have a helm as well?
translation: 我也能拥有一个头盔吗？ [wo ye neng yong you yi ge tou kui ma ？]

english: Hey, human.
translation: 嘿，人类。 [hei ， ren lei 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I am Odd Stone. Got named after some odd stone thing I found in the snowfields south of Weiss.
translation: 我是奇石。以我在韦斯以南的雪原中发现的一些奇怪的石头物体命名。 [wo shi qi shi 。 yi wo zai wei si yi nan de xue yuan zhong fa xian de yi xie qi guai de shi tou wu ti ming ming 。]

english: An odd stone thing?
translation: 奇怪的石头东西？ [qi guai de shi tou dong xi ？]

english: Yeah, it were made of stone, and it were odd. Some weird bone-head human saw me trying to nibble it, an' he got really upset an' chased me away. He kinda scary.
translation: 是的，它是石头做的，而且很奇怪。一些奇怪的骨头人看到我试图咬它，他非常生气并把我赶走了。他有点可怕。 [shi de ， ta shi shi tou zuo de ， er qie hen qi guai 。 yi xie qi guai de gu tou ren kan dao wo shi tu yao ta ， ta fei chang sheng qi bing ba wo gan zou le 。 ta you dian ke pa 。]

english: Anyway, my parents they named me Odd Stone after that, and now we trolls not go anywhere near the place. Bone-head human was, like, really scary! And probably magic.
translation: 不管怎样，我的父母在那之后给我起名叫“奇怪的石头”，现在我们巨魔不会去那个地方附近的任何地方。骨头人，真是太可怕了！可能还有魔法。 [bu guan zen yang ， wo de fu mu zai na zhi hou gei wo qi ming jiao “ qi guai de shi tou ”， xian zai wo men ju mo bu hui qu na ge di fang fu jin de ren he di fang 。 gu tou ren ， zhen shi tai ke pa le ！ ke neng hai you mo fa 。]

english: Can I go looking for the odd stone?
translation: 我可以去找那块奇怪的石头吗？ [wo ke yi qu zhao na kuai qi guai de shi tou ma ？]

english: No, we trolls blocked all routes to snowfields from here. Don't want scary bone-head human coming to Weiss.
translation: 不，我们巨魔封锁了从这里通往雪原的所有路线。我不想让可怕的白骨人类来到韦斯身边。 [bu ， wo men ju mo feng suo le cong zhe li tong wang xue yuan de suo you lu xian 。 wo bu xiang rang ke pa de bai gu ren lei lai dao wei si shen bian 。]

english: Thanks, that's interesting.
translation: 谢谢，这很有趣。 [xie xie ， zhe hen you qu 。]

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 告诉我这个地方。 [gao su wo zhe ge di fang 。]

english: This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: 这是韦斯。几年前，在我们被从更南边的洞穴里赶出来之后，巨魔们建造了它。现在Weiss是我们的家。 [zhe shi wei si 。 ji nian qian ， zai wo men bei cong geng nan bian de dong xue li gan chu lai zhi hou ， ju mo men jian zao le ta 。 xian zai Weiss shi wo men de jia 。]

english: We done pretty good here. Got lots of goat and wolf to eat - they taste kinda boring after all this time, but there not much other choice.
translation: 我们在这里做得很好。有很多山羊和狼可以吃——这么长时间以来它们尝起来有点无聊，但没有太多其他选择。 [wo men zai zhe li zuo de hen hao 。 you hen duo shan yang he lang ke yi chi —— zhe me zhang shi jian yi lai ta men chang qi lai you dian wu liao ， dan mei you tai duo qi ta xuan ze 。]

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it. In fact My Arm is an expert on growing the stuff.
translation: 尝试过古古草吗？我知道喜欢它的巨魔。事实上，我的手臂是种植这些东西的专家。 [chang shi guo gu gu cao ma ？ wo zhi dao xi huan ta de ju mo 。 shi shi shang ， wo de shou bi shi zhong zhi zhe xie dong xi de zhuan jia 。]

english: Never heard of no gouty weed, no. But it sound like a vegetable, an' Mother not like eating those, so we probably not gonna try it.
translation: 从来没有听说过没有痛风草，没有。但它听起来像一种蔬菜，妈妈不喜欢吃那些，所以我们可能不会尝试。 [cong lai mei you ting shuo guo mei you tong feng cao ， mei you 。 dan ta ting qi lai xiang yi zhong shu cai ， ma ma bu xi huan chi na xie ， suo yi wo men ke neng bu hui chang shi 。]

english: Mother not like new ideas much, but he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: 妈妈不太喜欢新想法，但他真的很大，而且是老板，所以我们就照他说的做。 [ma ma bu tai xi huan xin xiang fa ， dan ta zhen de hen da ， er qie shi lao ban ， suo yi wo men jiu zhao ta shuo de zuo 。]

english: I see.
translation: 我懂了。 [wo dong le 。]

english: Do you like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这里吗？ [ni xi huan zhe li ma ？]

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it our home. Odd Mushroom say he can make it nicer with fancy fires what he invented, but Mother not interested in that, so Odd Mushroom not allowed to do it.
translation: 呃，虽然有点简陋，但那是我们的家。奇蘑菇说他可以用他发明的奇特的火把它做得更好，但妈妈对此不感兴趣，所以奇蘑菇不被允许这样做。 [e ， sui ran you dian jian lou ， dan na shi wo men de jia 。 qi mo gu shuo ta ke yi yong ta fa ming de qi te de huo ba ta zuo de geng hao ， dan ma ma dui ci bu gan xing qu ， suo yi qi mo gu bu bei yun xu zhe yang zuo 。]

english: Mother only care about stuff to help him fight better. An he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: 母亲只关心帮助他更好地战斗的东西。他真的很大，他是老板，所以我们就按他说的做。 [mu qin zhi guan xin bang zhu ta geng hao di zhan dou de dong xi 。 ta zhen de hen da ， ta shi lao ban ， suo yi wo men jiu an ta shuo de zuo 。]

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我就走了。 [wo jiu zou le 。]

english: Hey, friend of Snowflake!
translation: 嘿，雪花的朋友！ [hei ， xue hua de peng you ！]

english: I am Odd Stone. Got named after some odd stone thing I found in snowfields south of Weiss.
translation: 我是奇石。因我在韦斯以南的雪原中发现的一些奇怪的石头而得名。 [wo shi qi shi 。 yin wo zai wei si yi nan de xue yuan zhong fa xian de yi xie qi guai de shi tou er de ming 。]

english: Anyway, my parents, they named me Odd Stone after that, and now we trolls not go anywhere near the place. Bone-head human was, like, really scary! And probably magic.
translation: 无论如何，我的父母，在那之后他们给我起名叫“奇怪的石头”，现在我们巨魔不会去任何靠近这个地方的地方。骨头人，真是太可怕了！可能还有魔法。 [wu lun ru he ， wo de fu mu ， zai na zhi hou ta men gei wo qi ming jiao “ qi guai de shi tou ”， xian zai wo men ju mo bu hui qu ren he kao jin zhe ge di fang de di fang 。 gu tou ren ， zhen shi tai ke pa le ！ ke neng hai you mo fa 。]

english: It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: 这里太棒了，现在雪花和她丈夫巨魔教我们种植古风草。现在食物好多了。 [zhe li tai bang le ， xian zai xue hua he ta zhang fu ju mo jiao wo men zhong zhi gu feng cao 。 xian zai shi wu hao duo le 。]

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: 嗯，虽然有点粗糙，但是正在好起来。雪花，她教我们种植古风草。山羊、狼、人类的味道都因加入了古藤而变得更加美味。 [n ， sui ran you dian cu cao ， dan shi zheng zai hao qi lai 。 xue hua ， ta jiao wo men zhong zhi gu feng cao 。 shan yang 、 lang 、 ren lei de wei dao dou yin jia ru le gu teng er bian de geng jia mei wei 。]

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: 所以，是的，韦斯是一个很好的居住地，现在由雪花负责。所有的巨魔都像雪花一样。她的丈夫巨魔有点奇怪，但这不是我们的问题。 [suo yi ， shi de ， wei si shi yi ge hen hao de ju zhu di ， xian zai you xue hua fu ze 。 suo you de ju mo dou xiang xue hua yi yang 。 ta de zhang fu ju mo you dian qi guai ， dan zhe bu shi wo men de wen ti 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Can I go looking for the odd stone?
translation: 我可以去找那块奇怪的石头吗？ [wo ke yi qu zhao na kuai qi guai de shi tou ma ？]

english: Thanks, that's interesting.
translation: 谢谢，这很有趣。 [xie xie ， zhe hen you qu 。]

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 告诉我这个地方。 [gao su wo zhe ge di fang 。]

english: Ever tried goutweed?
translation: 尝试过古古草吗？ [chang shi guo gu gu cao ma ？]

english: I see.
translation: 我懂了。 [wo dong le 。]

english: Do you like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这里吗？ [ni xi huan zhe li ma ？]

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我就走了。 [wo jiu zou le 。]

english: What to buy? What to buy?
translation: 买什么？买什么？ [mai shen me ？ mai shen me ？]

english: Oh, hello human.
translation: 哦，你好人类。 [o ， ni hao ren lei 。]

english: Anything I can help you with?
translation: 有什么我可以帮你的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang ni de ma ？]

english: Only if you can help me make a suggestion on what to buy.
translation: 只要你能帮我提出买什么的建议。 [zhi yao ni neng bang wo ti chu mai shen me de jian yi 。]

english: I smell a quest!
translation: 我闻到了任务的味道！ [wo wen dao le ren wu de wei dao ！]

english: No, not really. I just need some advice on what to buy, that's all.
translation: 不，不是真的。我只需要一些关于买什么的建议，仅此而已。 [bu ， bu shi zhen de 。 wo zhi xu yao yi xie guan yu mai shen me de jian yi ， jin ci er yi 。]

english: You should buy some new clothes. You can't go around town wearing what you're wearing.
translation: 你应该买一些新衣服。你不能穿着现在的衣服在城里走来走去。 [ni ying gai mai yi xie xin yi fu 。 ni bu neng chuan zhe xian zai de yi fu zai cheng li zou lai zou qu 。]

english: You're right, this is a little drab. I shouldn't really go around Keldagrim-West wearing this, should I?
translation: 你是对的，这有点单调。我真的不应该穿着这个在凯尔达格林-韦斯特到处走，不是吗？ [ni shi dui de ， zhe you dian dan diao 。 wo zhen de bu ying gai chuan zhe zhe ge zai kai er da ge lin - wei si te dao chu zou ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Of course I still don't know what colour I should get. I don't want to accidentally offend the wrong company of course.
translation: 当然我还是不知道我应该买什么颜色。我当然不想无意中得罪错误的公司。 [dang ran wo hai shi bu zhi dao wo ying gai mai shen me yan se 。 wo dang ran bu xiang wu yi zhong de zui cuo wu de gong si 。]

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: You should get yourself a big mighty warhammer.
translation: 你应该给自己买一把强大的大战锤。 [ni ying gai gei zi ji mai yi ba qiang da de da zhan chui 。]

english: I don't think so. The warhammer shop is run by the Red Axe. I'd rather stay out of there.
translation: 我不这么认为。战锤商店由红斧经营。我宁愿呆在外面。 [wo bu zhe me ren wei 。 zhan chui shang dian you hong fu jing ying 。 wo ning yuan dai zai wai mian 。]

english: You don't like the Red Axe?
translation: 你不喜欢红斧吗？ [ni bu xi huan hong fu ma ？]

english: They're all a lot of bullies if you ask me.
translation: 如果你问我的话，他们都是恶霸。 [ru guo ni wen wo de hua ， ta men dou shi e ba 。]

english: But I thought they left the city?
translation: 但我以为他们离开了这座城市？ [dan wo yi wei ta men li kai le zhe zuo cheng shi ？]

english: They may have, but I still think that shopkeeper is in league with them, banners or no.
translation: 他们可能有，但我仍然认为店主与他们有勾结，无论是否有横幅。 [ta men ke neng you ， dan wo reng ran ren wei dian zhu yu ta men you gou jie ， wu lun shi fou you heng fu 。]

english: Get yourself a long piece of rope.
translation: 给自己找一根长绳子。 [gei zi ji zhao yi gen zhang sheng zi 。]

english: What would I do with a rope?
translation: 我要用绳子做什么？ [wo yao yong sheng zi zuo shen me ？]

english: I don't know. I generally find a rope useful while adventuring.
translation: 我不知道。我通常发现绳子在冒险时很有用。 [wo bu zhi dao 。 wo tong chang fa xian sheng zi zai mao xian shi hen you yong 。]

english: I don't do a lot of adventuring to be honest.
translation: 老实说，我并没有进行太多冒险。 [lao shi shuo ， wo bing mei you jin xing tai duo mao xian 。]

english: An oversized hat. In a ridiculous colour.
translation: 一顶超大的帽子。以一种可笑的颜色。 [yi ding chao da de mao zi 。 yi yi zhong ke xiao de yan se 。]

english: No one is selling hats here, that's not a very helpful suggestion at all.
translation: 这里没有人卖帽子，这根本不是一个很有帮助的建议。 [zhe li mei you ren mai mao zi ， zhe gen ben bu shi yi ge hen you bang zhu de jian yi 。]

english: Nothing. You should buy absolutely nothing.
translation: 没有什么。你绝对不应该买任何东西。 [mei you shen me 。 ni jue dui bu ying gai mai ren he dong xi 。]

english: Now that's the best idea I've heard all day.
translation: 这是我一整天听到的最好的主意。 [zhe shi wo yi zheng tian ting dao de zui hao de zhu yi 。]

english: I thought so! Now why don't you give me some of the money I saved you?
translation: 我是这么想的！现在你为什么不把我为你存的钱给我一些呢？ [wo shi zhe me xiang de ！ xian zai ni wei shen me bu ba wo wei ni cun de qian gei wo yi xie ne ？]

english: No, I don't think so. I think I'd rather buy something with my money after all.
translation: 不，我不这么认为。我想我还是宁愿用我的钱买东西。 [bu ， wo bu zhe me ren wei 。 wo xiang wo hai shi ning yuan yong wo de qian mai dong xi 。]

english: New clothes.
translation: 新衣服。 [xin yi fu 。]

english: A warhammer.
translation: 一把战锤。 [yi ba zhan chui 。]

english: A piece of rope.
translation: 一根绳子。 [yi gen sheng zi 。]

english: An oversized hat.
translation: 一顶超大的帽子。 [yi ding chao da de mao zi 。]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: Well met, fellow adventurer! How can I help you?
translation: 很高兴认识你，冒险家伙伴！我怎么帮你？ [hen gao xing ren shi ni ， mao xian jia huo ban ！ wo zen me bang ni ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: How frightfully rude of me, my dear [chap/girl]. My name is Odovacar and I work for that excellent enterprise, the Bank of Gielinor.
translation: 我亲爱的[小伙子/女孩]，我真是太粗鲁了。我的名字是 Odovacar，我在吉林诺银行这家优秀的企业工作。 [wo qin ai de [ xiao huo zi / nv hai ]， wo zhen shi tai cu lu le 。 wo de ming zi shi  Odovacar， wo zai ji lin nuo yin hang zhe jia you xiu de qi ye gong zuo 。]

english: If you work for the bank, what are you doing here?
translation: 如果你在银行工作，你在这里做什么？ [ru guo ni zai yin hang gong zuo ， ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: As part of our ongoing service to provide you, the customer, with an absolutely world-class banking experience, we are investigating the option of opening a chain of travelling banks. These will provide you, our
translation: 作为我们为您（客户）提供绝对世界一流的银行体验的持续服务的一部分，我们正在研究开设连锁旅行银行的选择。这些将为您提供我们的 [zuo wei wo men wei nin （ ke hu ） ti gong jue dui shi jie yi liu de yin hang ti yan de chi xu fu wu de yi bu fen ， wo men zheng zai yan jiu kai she lian suo lv xing yin hang de xuan ze 。 zhe xie jiang wei nin ti gong wo men de]

english: esteemed customer, with the convenience of having banking facilities where they will be of optimum use to you. Such as here!
translation: 尊敬的客户，您可以享受银行设施的便利，这些设施将最适合您。比如这里！ [zun jing de ke hu ， nin ke yi xiang shou yin hang she shi de bian li ， zhe xie she shi jiang zui shi he nin 。 bi ru zhe li ！]

english: Huh?
I am the first of a new generation of travelling bankers that will wander the perilous areas of the world to provide you, the valued customer, with a bank when you need it most!
translation: 我是新一代旅行银行家中的第一人，他们将漫游世界上的危险地区，在您最需要的时候为您（尊贵的客户）提供银行服务！ [wo shi xin yi dai lv xing yin hang jia zhong de di yi ren ， ta men jiang man you shi jie shang de wei xian di qu ， zai nin zui xu yao de shi hou wei nin （ zun gui de ke hu ） ti gong yin hang fu wu ！]

english: So I can access my bank account simply by talking to you?
translation: 那么我只需与您交谈就可以访问我的银行帐户吗？ [na me wo zhi xu yu nin jiao tan jiu ke yi fang wen wo de yin hang zhang hu ma ？]

english: Absolutely correct, dear [sir/lady]. I must warn you, however, that due to the significantly increased overheads of an enterprise such as this, there is a small bank charge of 100gp every time you want to access your account.
translation: 绝对正确，亲爱的[先生/女士]。然而，我必须警告您，由于像这样的企业的管理费用显着增加，每次您想要访问您的帐户时都会收取 100gp 的小额银行费用。 [jue dui zheng que ， qin ai de [ xian sheng / nv shi ]。 ran er ， wo bi xu jing gao nin ， you yu xiang zhe yang de qi ye de guan li fei yong xian zhe zeng jia ， mei ci nin xiang yao fang wen nin de zhang hu shi du hui shou qu  100gp  de xiao e yin hang fei yong 。]

english: I don't have the money. Can I get it from my bank?
translation: 我没有钱。我可以从银行获取吗？ [wo mei you qian 。 wo ke yi cong yin hang huo qu ma ？]

english: It's not that I don't trust you to pay afterwards, old [chap/girl], but as the old adage goes, 'money comes before friends'.
translation: 这并不是说我不相信你事后付款，老[小伙子/女孩]，但正如古老的格言所说，“钱先于朋友”。 [zhe bing bu shi shuo wo bu xiang xin ni shi hou fu kuan ， lao [ xiao huo zi / nv hai ]， dan zheng ru gu lao de ge yan suo shuo ，“ qian xian yu peng you ”。]

english: That's preposterous! I'm not paying to withdraw my own money!
translation: 这太荒谬了！我不会付钱来提取我自己的钱！ [zhe tai huang miu le ！ wo bu hui fu qian lai ti qu wo zi ji de qian ！]

english: I'm sorry to hear that, [sir/madam]. If you should reconsider, because I believe this service offers excellent value for money, do not hesitate to contact me.
translation: 听到这个消息我很遗憾，[先生/女士]。如果您应该重新考虑，因为我相信这项服务物超所值，请随时与我联系。 [ting dao zhe ge xiao xi wo hen yi han ，[ xian sheng / nv shi ]。 ru guo nin ying gai chong xin kao lv ， yin wei wo xiang xin zhe xiang fu wu wu chao suo zhi ， qing sui shi yu wo lian xi 。]

english: I'm afraid you don't have the necessary funds with you at this time so I can't allow you to access your account. Please come again, when you have 100 gold to cover the fee.
translation: 恐怕您目前没有必要的资金，因此我无法允许您访问您的帐户。当你有100金币来支付费用时，请再来。 [kong pa nin mu qian mei you bi yao de zi jin ， yin ci wo wu fa yun xu nin fang wen nin de zhang hu 。 dang ni you 100 jin bi lai zhi fu fei yong shi ， qing zai lai 。]

english: I'd like to check my PIN settings.
translation: 我想检查我的 PIN 设置。 [wo xiang jian cha wo de  PIN  she zhi 。]

english: I'd like to collect items.
translation: 我想收集物品。 [wo xiang shou ji wu pin 。]

english: I'm afraid you don't have the necessary funds with you at this time so I can't allow you to collect your items. Please come again, when you have 100 gold to cover the fee.
translation: 恐怕您目前没有必要的资金，所以我不能允许您领取物品。当你有100金币来支付费用时，请再来。 [kong pa nin mu qian mei you bi yao de zi jin ， suo yi wo bu neng yun xu nin ling qu wu pin 。 dang ni you 100 jin bi lai zhi fu fei yong shi ， qing zai lai 。]

english: How frightfully rude of me, my dear [chap/lady]. My name is Odovacar and I work for that excellent enterprise, the Bank of Gielinor.
translation: 我亲爱的[小伙子/女士]，我真是太粗鲁了。我的名字是 Odovacar，我在吉林诺银行这家优秀的企业工作。 [wo qin ai de [ xiao huo zi / nv shi ]， wo zhen shi tai cu lu le 。 wo de ming zi shi  Odovacar， wo zai ji lin nuo yin hang zhe jia you xiu de qi ye gong zuo 。]

english: My services will cost you 100 coins.
translation: 我的服务将花费你 100 个金币。 [wo de fu wu jiang hua fei ni  100  ge jin bi 。]

english: Here's 100 coins. Let me access my account now.
translation: 这是 100 个硬币。现在让我访问我的帐户。 [zhe shi  100  ge ying bi 。 xian zai rang wo fang wen wo de zhang hu 。]

english: As an Ultimate Iron [Man/Woman] you cannot use the bank.
translation: 作为终极钢铁[男人/女人]，你不能使用银行。 [zuo wei zhong ji gang tie [ nan ren / nv ren ]， ni bu neng shi yong yin hang 。]

english: Here's 100 coins. Let me collect my items now.
translation: 这是 100 个硬币。现在让我收集我的物品。 [zhe shi  100  ge ying bi 。 xian zai rang wo shou ji wo de wu pin 。]

english: I'd like to access my bank account, please.
translation: 我想访问我的银行帐户。 [wo xiang fang wen wo de yin hang zhang hu 。]

english: Sorry, I don't perform that service.
translation: 抱歉，我不提供这项服务。 [bao qian ， wo bu ti gong zhe xiang fu wu 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: If you work for the bank, what are you doing here?
translation: 如果你在银行工作，你在这里做什么？ [ru guo ni zai yin hang gong zuo ， ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I don't have the money. Can I get it from my bank?
translation: 我没有钱。我可以从银行获取吗？ [wo mei you qian 。 wo ke yi cong yin hang huo qu ma ？]

english: That's preposterous! I'm not paying to withdraw my own money!
translation: 这太荒谬了！我不会付钱来提取我自己的钱！ [zhe tai huang miu le ！ wo bu hui fu qian lai ti qu wo zi ji de qian ！]

english: I'd like to access my bank account, please.
translation: 我想访问我的银行帐户。 [wo xiang fang wen wo de yin hang zhang hu 。]

english: I'd like to check my PIN settings.
translation: 我想检查我的 PIN 设置。 [wo xiang jian cha wo de  PIN  she zhi 。]

english: I'd like to collect items.
translation: 我想收集物品。 [wo xiang shou ji wu pin 。]

english: Here's 100 coins. Let me access my account now.
translation: 这是 100 个硬币。现在让我访问我的帐户。 [zhe shi  100  ge ying bi 。 xian zai rang wo fang wen wo de zhang hu 。]

english: Here's 100 coins. Let me collect my items now.
translation: 这是 100 个硬币。现在让我收集我的物品。 [zhe shi  100  ge ying bi 。 xian zai rang wo shou ji wo de wu pin 。]

english: Dad says you can get a lift to Karamja with us if you want? But you's gives us two chompy first!
translation: 爸爸说如果你愿意的话可以和我们一起搭车去卡拉姆贾吗？但你先给我们两块嚼劲！ [ba ba shuo ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ke yi he wo men yi qi da che qu ka la mu jia ma ？ dan ni xian gei wo men liang kuai jue jin ！]

english: You's got no chompies...no boatsie trips!
translation: 你没有嚼劲……没有划船旅行！ [ni mei you jue jin …… mei you hua chuan lv xing ！]

english: Player is transported west of Tai Bwo Wannai.
translation: 玩家被传送至 Tai Bwo Wannai 以西。 [wan jia bei chuan song zhi  Tai Bwo Wannai  yi xi 。]

english: The barely sea-worthy log arrives at Karamja beach.
translation: 勉强适合海运的原木抵达卡拉姆贾海滩。 [mian qiang shi he hai yun de yuan mu di da ka la mu jia hai tan 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Dad says you can get a lift back with us if you want? But you's gives us two glug-glugs herbies first!
translation: 爸爸说如果你愿意的话可以搭我们的车回去吗？但你先给了我们两个咕咕咕的草！ [ba ba shuo ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ke yi da wo men de che hui qu ma ？ dan ni xian gei le wo men liang ge gu gu gu de cao ！]

english: Dad sez yous not bringin' da rummy stuff...das bad stuffsies un we get in big bads.
translation: 爸爸，你不会带来拉米纸牌的东西……这些东西很糟糕，我们会遇到大麻烦。 [ba ba ， ni bu hui dai lai la mi zhi pai de dong xi …… zhe xie dong xi hen zao gao ， wo men hui yu dao da ma fan 。]

english: You's got no glug-glugs herbies...no boatsie trips!
translation: 你没有咕噜咕噜的草本植物……没有划船旅行！ [ni mei you gu lu gu lu de cao ben zhi wu …… mei you hua chuan lv xing ！]

english: You hand over two herbs and accept a ride from Fycie and Bugs on the makeshift boat.
translation: 你交出两片草药，并接受 Fycie 和 Bugs 乘坐临时搭建的小船。 [ni jiao chu liang pian cao yao ， bing jie shou  Fycie  he  Bugs  cheng zuo lin shi da jian de xiao chuan 。]

english: Player is transported to eastern Feldip Hills.
translation: 玩家被传送到费尔迪普丘陵东部。 [wan jia bei chuan song dao fei er di pu qiu ling dong bu 。]

english: The barely sea-worthy log arrives at the Feldip Hills.
translation: 勉强适合航海的原木抵达费尔迪普山 (Feldip Hills)。 [mian qiang shi he hang hai de yuan mu di da fei er di pu shan  (Feldip Hills)。]

english: Yes please, I'll get a lift to Karamja with you.
translation: 是的，我会和你一起搭车去卡拉姆贾。 [shi de ， wo hui he ni yi qi da che qu ka la mu jia 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Yes please, I'll get a lift back with you.
translation: 是的，请，我会和你一起搭车回来。 [shi de ， qing ， wo hui he ni yi qi da che hui lai 。]

english: Hey yous tryin' not to get da sickies else yous be da sick-un and mebe get to be a dead-un if yous be da unlucky fing.
translation: 嘿，你尽量不要生病，否则你就会生病，如果你运气不好，我就会死掉。 [hei ， ni jin liang bu yao sheng bing ， fou ze ni jiu hui sheng bing ， ru guo ni yun qi bu hao ， wo jiu hui si diao 。]

english: Don't worry, I know how to take care of myself.
translation: 别担心，我知道如何照顾自己。 [bie dan xin ， wo zhi dao ru he zhao gu zi ji 。]

english: Yeah, whats yous wants creatures?
translation: 是的，你想要什么生物？ [shi de ， ni xiang yao shen me sheng wu ？]

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I's is guardin' da coffins-ies- make sure no fieves nick stuff from 'em. If dey's do, dey get's bashed and shoved down da big 'ole and get deaded by da zogries in da deadies place. So yous creature be wares...ok!
translation: 我负责看守棺材——确保他们不会留下任何划痕。如果他们这样做了，他们就会被殴打并被推倒在大的地方，并在死亡的地方被佐格里杀死。所以你这个生物要小心……好吧！ [wo fu ze kan shou guan cai —— que bao ta men bu hui liu xia ren he hua hen 。 ru guo ta men zhe yang zuo le ， ta men jiu hui bei ou da bing bei tui dao zai da de di fang ， bing zai si wang de di fang bei zuo ge li sha si 。 suo yi ni zhe ge sheng wu yao xiao xin …… hao ba ！]

english: What's going on around here?
translation: 这附近发生了什么事？ [zhe fu jin fa sheng le shen me shi ？]

english: Da Zogries comes from da deadies place - deys attacking all da jig-dancers wot do da god stuff... jiggin an all. Dem zogries gonna dead all on us wiv da sickies.
translation: Da Zogries 来自死亡之地 - 他们攻击所有不做上帝之事的吉格舞者……吉吉金等等。这些僵尸会和我们这些病态的人一起死掉的。 [Da Zogries  lai zi si wang zhi di  -  ta men gong ji suo you bu zuo shang di zhi shi de ji ge wu zhe …… ji ji jin deng deng 。 zhe xie jiang shi hui he wo men zhe xie bing tai de ren yi qi si diao de 。]

english: What are these coffins doing here?
translation: 这些棺材在这里做什么？ [zhe xie guan cai zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: We's grabbed da closes dead-uns to stop da zogries gettin' em..de'se dead-uns coffins got da old-uns boneses and older-stuff in 'em, Grish seys we's needs to guard 'em...I's does what Grish seys.
translation: 我们抓住了一些死人，以阻止那些僵尸进来。这些死人的棺材里有一些老人的骨头和更古老的东西，格里什认为我们需要保护他们...我会按照格里什所说的去做。 [wo men zhua zhu le yi xie si ren ， yi zu zhi na xie jiang shi jin lai 。 zhe xie si ren de guan cai li you yi xie lao ren de gu tou he geng gu lao de dong xi ， ge li shen ren wei wo men xu yao bao hu ta men ... wo hui an zhao ge li shen suo shuo de qu zuo 。]

english: Are you always angry?
translation: 你总是生气吗？ [ni zong shi sheng qi ma ？]

english: Me's was born angry....me's wantin' to dead many peples...is what ogries meant to do...
translation: 我生来就是愤怒的……我想要杀死很多人……这就是食人魔的本意…… [wo sheng lai jiu shi fen nu de …… wo xiang yao sha si hen duo ren …… zhe jiu shi shi ren mo de ben yi ……]

english: Sorry, I have to go.
translation: 抱歉，我得走了。 [bao qian ， wo de zou le 。]

english: Stop, creature! Only ogres and their friends allowed in this city. Show me a sign of companionship, like a lost relic or somefing, and you may pass.
translation: 停下来，生物！只有食人魔和他们的朋友才允许进入这座城市。向我展示一个陪伴的迹象，比如丢失的遗物或其他什么东西，你就可以过去。 [ting xia lai ， sheng wu ！ zhi you shi ren mo he ta men de peng you cai yun xu jin ru zhe zuo cheng shi 。 xiang wo zhan shi yi ge pei ban de ji xiang ， bi ru diu shi de yi wu huo qi ta shen me dong xi ， ni jiu ke yi guo qu 。]

english: Until then, back to whence you came!
translation: 到那时，就回到你来的地方吧！ [dao na shi ， jiu hui dao ni lai de di fang ba ！]

english: Halt! You cannot pass here.
translation: 停止！你不能通过这里。 [ting zhi ！ ni bu neng tong guo zhe li 。]

english: I am a friend to ogres.
translation: 我是食人魔的朋友。 [wo shi shi ren mo de peng you 。]

english: You will be my friend only with gold. Bring me a bar of pure gold and I will let you pass.
translation: 只有拥有黄金，你才能成为我的朋友。给我一块纯金，我就放你过去。 [zhi you yong you huang jin ， ni cai neng cheng wei wo de peng you 。 gei wo yi kuai chun jin ， wo jiu fang ni guo qu 。]

english: Creature, did you bring me the gold?
translation: 怪物，你给我带来了金子吗？ [guai wu ， ni gei wo dai lai le jin zi ma ？]

english: No, I don't have it.
translation: 不，我没有。 [bu ， wo mei you 。]

english: No gold, no passage. Get out of this city!
translation: 没有金子，就没有通道。离开这座城市！ [mei you jin zi ， jiu mei you tong dao 。 li kai zhe zuo cheng shi ！]

english: Here it is!
translation: 这里是！ [zhe li shi ！]

english: It's brought it! On your way.
translation: 它带来了！正在路上。 [ta dai lai le ！ zheng zai lu shang 。]

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: What's going on around here?
translation: 这附近发生了什么事？ [zhe fu jin fa sheng le shen me shi ？]

english: What are these coffins doing here?
translation: 这些棺材在这里做什么？ [zhe xie guan cai zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Are you always angry?
translation: 你总是生气吗？ [ni zong shi sheng qi ma ？]

english: Sorry, I have to go.
translation: 抱歉，我得走了。 [bao qian ， wo de zou le 。]

english: So much blood flows through these lands.
translation: 如此多的鲜血流经了这片土地。 [ru ci duo de xian xue liu jing le zhe pian tu di 。]

english: Where does the blood come from?
translation: 血液从哪里来？ [xue ye cong na li lai ？]

english: Throughout the generations, countless people of this land have perished in times of strife, with their bodies left to rot where they fell.
translation: 世世代代以来，这片土地上无数人在战乱中丧生，尸体就地腐烂。 [shi shi dai dai yi lai ， zhe pian tu di shang wu shu ren zai zhan luan zhong sang sheng ， shi ti jiu di fu lan 。]

english: Some were slain by the deadly creatures that roam the land; others perished at the hands of their fellow citizens during the wars of this land.
translation: 有些人被这片土地上的致命生物杀死；有些人则被这片土地上的致命生物杀死。其他人则在这片土地的战争中死于同胞之手。 [you xie ren bei zhe pian tu di shang de zhi ming sheng wu sha si ； you xie ren ze bei zhe pian tu di shang de zhi ming sheng wu sha si 。 qi ta ren ze zai zhe pian tu di de zhan zheng zhong si yu tong bao zhi shou 。]

english: Their blood flowed into the soil, pooling and percolating unseen in the dark, as the power of the Altar drew it to this sacred place to form the River.
translation: 他们的血液流入土壤，在黑暗中看不见地汇聚和渗透，祭坛的力量将其吸引到这个神圣的地方，形成河流。 [ta men de xue ye liu ru tu rang ， zai hei an zhong kan bu jian di hui ju he shen tou ， ji tan de li liang jiang qi xi yin dao zhe ge shen sheng de di fang ， xing cheng he liu 。]

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？ [ni wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: The blood is the blood of Kourend's citizens. It is fitting that we honour their memory.
translation: 鲜血是库伦德公民的鲜血。我们纪念他们是恰当的。 [xian xue shi ku lun de gong min de xian xue 。 wo men ji nian ta men shi qia dang de 。]

english: Also, it smells so good.
translation: 而且，它闻起来很好闻。 [er qie ， ta wen qi lai hen hao wen 。]

english: I'll leave you to enjoy the view.
translation: 我就留下你去欣赏风景。 [wo jiu liu xia ni qu xin shang feng jing 。]

english: I see the river foaming with much blood.
translation: 我看到河里泛着大量的血沫。 [wo kan dao he li fan zhe da liang de xue mo 。]

english: Where does the blood come from?
translation: 血液从哪里来？ [xue ye cong na li lai ？]

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？ [ni wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: I'll leave you to enjoy the view.
translation: 我就留下你去欣赏风景。 [wo jiu liu xia ni qu xin shang feng jing 。]

english: Hello there. So you're a bard?
translation: 你好呀。那么你是吟游诗人？ [ni hao ya 。 na me ni shi yin you shi ren ？]

english: I am afraid I cannot speak to outerlanders. Besides, I am busy composing an epic.
translation: 恐怕我无法与外地人交谈。此外，我正忙着创作一部史诗。 [kong pa wo wu fa yu wai di ren jiao tan 。 ci wai ， wo zheng mang zhe chuang zuo yi bu shi shi 。]

english: Hello? Yes? You want something, outerlander?
translation: 你好？是的？你想要什么吗，外地人？ [ni hao ？ shi de ？ ni xiang yao shen me ma ， wai di ren ？]

english: Are you a member of the council?
translation: 您是理事会成员吗？ [nin shi li shi hui cheng yuan ma ？]

english: Why, indeed I am, outerlander! My talents as an exemplary musician made it difficult for them not to accept me! Why do you wish to know this?
translation: 哎呀，我确实是个外地人！我作为模范音乐家的才华让他们很难不接受我！你为什么想知道这个？ [ai ya ， wo que shi shi ge wai di ren ！ wo zuo wei mo fan yin yue jia de cai hua rang ta men hen nan bu jie shou wo ！ ni wei shen me xiang zhi dao zhe ge ？]

english: Well, I ask because I am currently doing the Fremennik trials so as to join your clan. I need seven of the twelve council of elders to vote for me.
translation: 好吧，我问这个是因为我目前正在进行弗雷曼尼克试炼，以便加入你们的氏族。我需要十二位长老会中的七位投票给我。 [hao ba ， wo wen zhe ge shi yin wei wo mu qian zheng zai jin xing fu lei man ni ke shi lian ， yi bian jia ru ni men de shi zu 。 wo xu yao shi er wei zhang lao hui zhong de qi wei tou piao gei wo 。]

english: Ahhh... and you wish to earn my vote? I will gladly accept you as a Fremennik should you be able to prove yourself to have a little musical ability!
translation: 啊……你想赢得我的选票吗？如果你能够证明自己有一点音乐能力，我会很乐意接受你作为 Fremennik！ [a …… ni xiang ying de wo de xuan piao ma ？ ru guo ni neng gou zheng ming zi ji you yi dian yin yue neng li ， wo hui hen le yi jie shou ni zuo wei  Fremennik！]

english: So how would I do that?
translation: 那么我该怎么做呢？ [na me wo gai zen me zuo ne ？]

english: Why, by playing in our longhall! All you need to do is impress the revellers there with a few verses of an epic of your own creation!
translation: 哎呀，就在我们的长厅里玩吧！您所需要做的就是用您自己创作的史诗中的几句诗句给那里的狂欢者留下深刻的印象！ [ai ya ， jiu zai wo men de zhang ting li wan ba ！ nin suo xu yao zuo de jiu shi yong nin zi ji chuang zuo de shi shi zhong de ji ju shi ju gei na li de kuang huan zhe liu xia shen ke de yin xiang ！]

english: So what say you outerlander? Are you up for the challenge?
translation: 那你这个外地人怎么说呢？你准备好迎接挑战了吗？ [na ni zhe ge wai di ren zen me shuo ne ？ ni zhun bei hao ying jie tiao zhan le ma ？]

english: Sure! This certainly sounds pretty easy to accomplish - I'll have your vote in no time!
translation: 当然！这听起来确实很容易实现——我很快就会得到你的投票！ [dang ran ！ zhe ting qi lai que shi hen rong yi shi xian —— wo hen kuai jiu hui de dao ni de tou piao ！]

english: That is great news outerlander! We always need more music lovers here!
translation: 这是外地人的好消息！我们这里永远需要更多的音乐爱好者！ [zhe shi wai di ren de hao xiao xi ！ wo men zhe li yong yuan xu yao geng duo de yin yue ai hao zhe ！]

english: Forget it! This all sounds like way too much work for a stupid vote at a meeting! I'll find someone else instead.
translation: 忘了它！这一切听起来对于在会议上进行愚蠢的投票来说工作量太大了！我会找别人代替。 [wang le ta ！ zhe yi qie ting qi lai dui yu zai hui yi shang jin xing yu chun de tou piao lai shuo gong zuo liang tai da le ！ wo hui zhao bie ren dai ti 。]

english: So how would I go about writing this epic?
translation: 那么我该如何去写这部史诗呢？ [na me wo gai ru he qu xie zhe bu shi shi ne ？]

english: Well, first of all you are going to need an instrument. Like all true bards you are going to have to make this yourself.
translation: 好吧，首先你需要一个乐器。像所有真正的吟游诗人一样，你必须自己做这个。 [hao ba ， shou xian ni xu yao yi ge yue qi 。 xiang suo you zhen zheng de yin you shi ren yi yang ， ni bi xu zi ji zuo zhe ge 。]

english: How do I make an instrument?
translation: 如何制作乐器？ [ru he zhi zuo le qi ？]

english: Well, it is a long and drawn-out process. Just east of this village there is an unusually musical tree that can be used to make very high quality instruments.
translation: 嗯，这是一个漫长而漫长的过程。在这个村庄的东边有一棵不同寻常的音乐树，可以用来制作非常高质量的乐器。 [n ， zhe shi yi ge man chang er man chang de guo cheng 。 zai zhe ge cun zhuang de dong bian you yi ke bu tong xun chang de yin yue shu ， ke yi yong lai zhi zuo fei chang gao zhi liang de yue qi 。]

english: Cut a piece from it, and then carve it into a special shape that will allow you to string it. Using a knife as you would craft any other wooden object would be best for this.
translation: 从中切下一块，然后将其雕刻成特殊的形状，以便您可以将其串起来。像制作任何其他木制物品一样使用刀是最好的选择。 [cong zhong qie xia yi kuai ， ran hou jiang qi diao ke cheng te shu de xing zhuang ， yi bian nin ke yi jiang qi chuan qi lai 。 xiang zhi zuo ren he qi ta mu zhi wu pin yi yang shi yong dao shi zui hao de xuan ze 。]

english: Then what do I need to do?
translation: 那我需要做什么呢？ [na wo xu yao zuo shen me ne ？]

english: Next you will need to string your lyre. There is a troll to the South-east who has some golden wool. I would not recommend using anything else to string your lyre with.
translation: 接下来，您需要给里拉琴上弦。东南方有一个巨魔，他有一些金色的羊毛。我不建议使用其他任何东西来拉竖琴。 [jie xia lai ， nin xu yao gei li la qin shang xian 。 dong nan fang you yi ge ju mo ， ta you yi xie jin se de yang mao 。 wo bu jian yi shi yong qi ta ren he dong xi lai la shu qin 。]

english: Anything else?
translation: 还要别的吗？ [hai yao bie de ma ？]

english: Well, when you have crafted your lyre you will need the blessing of the Fossegrimen to tune your lyre to perfection before you even consider a public performance.
translation: 好吧，当你制作好你的竖琴后，在你考虑公开表演之前，你需要福斯格里曼的祝福来将你的竖琴调至完美。 [hao ba ， dang ni zhi zuo hao ni de shu qin hou ， zai ni kao lv gong kai biao yan zhi qian ， ni xu yao fu si ge li man de zhu fu lai jiang ni de shu qin diao zhi wan mei 。]

english: Who or what is Fossegrimen?
translation: Fossegrimen 是谁或是什么？ [Fossegrimen  shi shui huo shi shen me ？]

english: Fossegrimen is a lake spirit that lives just a little way South-west of this village. Make her an offering of fish, and you will then be ready for your performance.
translation: 福斯格里曼 (Fossegrimen) 是一种湖神，居住在这个村庄西南方向不远的地方。向她供奉鱼，然后你就可以准备表演了。 [fu si ge li man  (Fossegrimen)  shi yi zhong hu shen ， ju zhu zai zhe ge cun zhuang xi nan fang xiang bu yuan de di fang 。 xiang ta gong feng yu ， ran hou ni jiu ke yi zhun bei biao yan le 。]

english: Make sure you give her a suitable offering however. If the offering is found to be unworthy, then you may find yourself unable to play your lyre with any skill at all!
translation: 不过，请确保你给了她合适的礼物。如果发现供品不值得，那么您可能会发现自己根本无法用任何技巧来演奏竖琴！ [bu guo ， qing que bao ni gei le ta he shi de li wu 。 ru guo fa xian gong pin bu zhi de ， na me nin ke neng hui fa xian zi ji gen ben wu fa yong ren he ji qiao lai yan zou shu qin ！]

english: So what would be a worthy offering?
translation: 那么什么才是有价值的奉献呢？ [na me shen me cai shi you jia zhi de feng xian ne ？]

english: A raw shark, manta ray, or sea turtle should be sufficient as an offering.
translation: 生的鲨鱼、蝠鲼或海龟就足够作为祭品了。 [sheng de sha yu 、 fu fen huo hai gui jiu zu gou zuo wei ji pin le 。]

english: Okay, what else do I need to do?
translation: 好吧，我还需要做什么？ [hao ba ， wo hai xu yao zuo shen me ？]

english: When you have crafted your lyre and been blessed by Fossegrimen, then you will finally be ready to make your performance to the revellers at the longhall.
translation: 当您制作好竖琴并得到福斯格里曼的祝福后，您终于准备好在长厅向狂欢者表演了。 [dang nin zhi zuo hao shu qin bing de dao fu si ge li man de zhu fu hou ， nin zhong yu zhun bei hao zai zhang ting xiang kuang huan zhe biao yan le 。]

english: Head past the bouncers and onto the stage, and then begin to play. If all goes well, you should find the music spring to your mind and sing your own epic on the spot.
translation: 越过保镖，登上舞台，然后开始演奏。如果一切顺利，您应该会发现音乐浮现在您的脑海中，并当场唱出您自己的史诗。 [yue guo bao biao ， deng shang wu tai ， ran hou kai shi yan zou 。 ru guo yi qie shun li ， nin ying gai hui fa xian yin yue fu xian zai nin de nao hai zhong ， bing dang chang chang chu nin zi ji de shi shi 。]

english: I will observe both you and the audience, and if you show enough talent, I will happily vote in your favour at the council of elders.
translation: 我会观察你和观众，如果你表现出足够的才华，我会很乐意在长老会议上投票给你。 [wo hui guan cha ni he guan zhong ， ru guo ni biao xian chu zu gou de cai hua ， wo hui hen le yi zai zhang lao hui yi shang tou piao gei ni 。]

english: Is that clear enough, outerlander? Would you like me to repeat anything?
translation: 外地人，说得够清楚了吗？你想让我重复什么吗？ [wai di ren ， shuo de gou qing chu le ma ？ ni xiang rang wo chong fu shen me ma ？]

english: Can you remind me about making a lyre again, please Olaf?
translation: 奥拉夫，你能提醒我再做一把里拉琴吗？ [ao la fu ， ni neng ti xing wo zai zuo yi ba li la qin ma ？]

english: There are three parts to making the lyre; First you need to cut some special wood from the special musical tree which can be found just east of Rellekka.
translation: 制作竖琴分为三个部分：首先，你需要从雷莱卡东部的特殊音乐树上砍伐一些特殊的木材。 [zhi zuo shu qin fen wei san ge bu fen ： shou xian ， ni xu yao cong lei lai ka dong bu de te shu yin yue shu shang kan fa yi xie te shu de mu cai 。]

english: When you have the wood, you will need to use a knife to craft it into a Lyre. When you have an unstrung lyre, you will need to string it before you can play it.
translation: 当你拥有木材后，你需要用刀将其制作成竖琴。当您有一把未拉弦的竖琴时，您需要先拉弦才能演奏。 [dang ni yong you mu cai hou ， ni xu yao yong dao jiang qi zhi zuo cheng shu qin 。 dang nin you yi ba wei la xian de shu qin shi ， nin xu yao xian la xian cai neng yan zou 。]

english: I would not use anything other than the golden string of Lalli, a troll who lives in a cave just to the South-east.
translation: 除了拉利（Lalli）的金绳之外，我不会使用任何东西，拉利是一个住在东南方山洞里的巨魔。 [chu le la li （Lalli） de jin sheng zhi wai ， wo bu hui shi yong ren he dong xi ， la li shi yi ge zhu zai dong nan fang shan dong li de ju mo 。]

english: Can you remind me about getting a blessing from Fossegrimen again?
translation: 你能提醒我再次得到福斯格里曼的祝福吗？ [ni neng ti xing wo zai ci de dao fu si ge li man de zhu fu ma ？]

english: Certainly outerlander! Fossegrimen is a lake spirit who lives in the lake just to the South-west of here. She will bless you so that you may play your lyre,
translation: 当然是外地人了！福斯格里曼 (Fossegrimen) 是一种湖精，居住在此处西南部的湖中。她会祝福你，让你可以弹奏竖琴， [dang ran shi wai di ren le ！ fu si ge li man  (Fossegrimen)  shi yi zhong hu jing ， ju zhu zai ci chu xi nan bu de hu zhong 。 ta hui zhu fu ni ， rang ni ke yi dan zou shu qin ，]

english: if you give her a worthy offering. She will only accept raw fish, so place a raw fish on her pedestal, and she will bless you. The better the offering, the longer
translation: 如果你给她一份有价值的礼物。她只接受生鱼，所以在她的基座上放一条生鱼，她就会祝福你。提供的产品越好，时间越长 [ru guo ni gei ta yi fen you jia zhi de li wu 。 ta zhi jie shou sheng yu ， suo yi zai ta de ji zuo shang fang yi tiao sheng yu ， ta jiu hui zhu fu ni 。 ti gong de chan pin yue hao ， shi jian yue zhang]

english: the amount of time you will be blessed for. You will not be able to perform on stage without the blessing of the Fossegrimen.
translation: 你将受到祝福的时间。没有福斯格里曼的祝福，你将无法在舞台上表演。 [ni jiang shou dao zhu fu de shi jian 。 mei you fu si ge li man de zhu fu ， ni jiang wu fa zai wu tai shang biao yan 。]

english: (shows previous options)
translation: （显示以前的选项） [（ xian shi yi qian de xuan xiang ）]

english: Can you remind me about how to perform at the longhall again please?
translation: 你能再次提醒我如何在长厅表演吗？ [ni neng zai ci ti xing wo ru he zai zhang ting biao yan ma ？]

english: Not a problem outerlander. When you have your lyre and have been blessed, you will be able to pass the bouncer at the stage entrance of the longhall.
translation: 外地人这不是问题。当你拿到竖琴并受到祝福后，你将能够通过长厅舞台入口处的保镖。 [wai di ren zhe bu shi wen ti 。 dang ni na dao shu qin bing shou dao zhu fu hou ， ni jiang neng gou tong guo zhang ting wu tai ru kou chu de bao biao 。]

english: He will not let you pass unless he believes you are ready to perform on stage. Simply go past him and onto the stage and use your lyre, and you will
translation: 除非他相信你已经准备好在舞台上表演，否则他不会让你通过。只需越过他并登上舞台并使用你的竖琴，你就会 [chu fei ta xiang xin ni yi jing zhun bei hao zai wu tai shang biao yan ， fou ze ta bu hui rang ni tong guo 。 zhi xu yue guo ta bing deng shang wu tai bing shi yong ni de shu qin ， ni jiu hui]

english: begin to play to entertain the revellers. If all has gone well, you will feel the music come to your mind, unbidden, as you sing an epic of your exploits.
translation: 开始演奏来娱乐狂欢者。如果一切顺利，当您唱出一首史诗般的功绩时，您会感到音乐不请自来地出现在您的脑海中。 [kai shi yan zou lai yu le kuang huan zhe 。 ru guo yi qie shun li ， dang nin chang chu yi shou shi shi ban de gong ji shi ， nin hui gan dao yin yue bu qing zi lai di chu xian zai nin de nao hai zhong 。]

english: I will watch your performance from backstage, and also study how much the crowd likes you, and if I believe you have enough talent, then I will vote for you at the council.
translation: 我会在后台观看你的表演，也会研究观众对你的喜爱程度，如果我认为你有足够的才华，那么我会在理事会投票给你。 [wo hui zai hou tai guan kan ni de biao yan ， ye hui yan jiu guan zhong dui ni de xi ai cheng du ， ru guo wo ren wei ni you zu gou de cai hua ， na me wo hui zai li shi hui tou piao gei ni 。]

english: No thanks, I think that's all pretty straight forward. I'll go and make my lyre now.
translation: 不，谢谢，我认为这一切都很简单。我现在就去制作我的竖琴。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo ren wei zhe yi qie dou hen jian dan 。 wo xian zai jiu qu zhi zuo wo de shu qin 。]

english: Congratulations! You have completed the Bard's Trial!
translation: 恭喜！你已经完成了吟游诗人的试炼！ [gong xi ！ ni yi jing wan cheng le yin you shi ren de shi lian ！]

english: As you finished playing you felt Fossegrimen's power leave you...
translation: 当你玩完之后，你感觉到 Fossegrimen 的力量离开了你...... [dang ni wan wan zhi hou ， ni gan jue dao  Fossegrimen  de li liang li kai le ni ......]

english: Wow! That was awesome! You are one of the greatest bards I have ever had the pleasure of watching performing!
translation: 哇！太棒了！你是我有幸观看表演的最伟大的吟游诗人之一！ [wa ！ tai bang le ！ ni shi wo you xing guan kan biao yan de zui wei da de yin you shi ren zhi yi ！]

english: You have certainly earned my vote! I hope we can duet together soon!
translation: 你确实赢得了我的选票！我希望我们很快就能一起二重唱！ [ni que shi ying de le wo de xuan piao ！ wo xi wang wo men hen kuai jiu neng yi qi er chong chang ！]

english: So can I rely on your vote with the council of elders in my favour?
translation: 那么我可以相信你在长老会议上的投票对我有利吗？ [na me wo ke yi xiang xin ni zai zhang lao hui yi shang de tou piao dui wo you li ma ？]

english: You have a truly poetic soul! Anyone who can compose such a beautiful epic, and then perform it so flawlessly can only bring good to our clan!
translation: 你有一个真正诗意的灵魂！谁能谱写出如此优美的史诗，并完美地演绎出来，一定能为我们家族带来福祉！ [ni you yi ge zhen zheng shi yi de ling hun ！ shui neng pu xie chu ru ci you mei de shi shi ， bing wan mei di yan yi chu lai ， yi ding neng wei wo men jia zu dai lai fu zhi ！]

english: Erm... so that's a yes, then?
translation: 嗯...那么这是肯定的吗？ [n ... na me zhe shi ken ding de ma ？]

english: Absolutely! We must collaborate together on a duet sometime, don't you think?
translation: 绝对地！我们有时必须一起合作二重唱，你不觉得吗？ [jue dui di ！ wo men you shi bi xu yi qi he zuo er chong chang ， ni bu jue de ma ？]

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a love ballad, do you?
translation: 我想你不知道我在哪里可以找到情歌，是吗？ [wo xiang ni bu zhi dao wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao qing ge ， shi ma ？]

english: Well, as official Fremennik bard, it falls within my remit to compose all music for the tribe. I am fully versed in all the various types of romantic music.
translation: 好吧，作为正式的弗雷曼尼克吟游诗人，为部落创作所有音乐属于我的职权范围。我精通各种类型的浪漫音乐。 [hao ba ， zuo wei zheng shi de fu lei man ni ke yin you shi ren ， wei bu luo chuang zuo suo you yin yue shu yu wo de zhi quan fan wei 。 wo jing tong ge zhong lei xing de lang man yin yue 。]

english: Great! Can you write me one then?
translation: 伟大的！那你能给我写一封吗？ [wei da de ！ na ni neng gei wo xie yi feng ma ？]

english: Well... normally I would be thrilled at the chance to show my skill as a poet in composing a seductively romantic ballad...
translation: 嗯……通常情况下，我会很高兴有机会展示我作为诗人的技巧，创作一首诱人的浪漫歌谣…… [n …… tong chang qing kuang xia ， wo hui hen gao xing you ji hui zhan shi wo zuo wei shi ren de ji qiao ， chuang zuo yi shou you ren de lang man ge yao ……]

english: let me guess; here comes the 'but'.
translation: 让我猜猜； “但是”来了。 [rang wo cai cai ； “ dan shi ” lai le 。]

english: ...but unfortunately I cannot concentrate fully upon my work recently.
translation: ...但不幸的是我最近无法完全专注于我的工作。 [... dan bu xing de shi wo zui jin wu fa wan quan zhuan zhu yu wo de gong zuo 。]

english: Why is that then?
translation: 那为什么呢？ [na wei shen me ne ？]

english: It is these old worn out shoes of mine... As a bard I am expected to wander the lands, singing of the glorious battles of our warriors.
translation: 正是我这双破旧的鞋子……作为一名吟游诗人，我应该在这片土地上漫步，歌颂我们战士的光荣战斗。 [zheng shi wo zhe shuang po jiu de xie zi …… zuo wei yi ming yin you shi ren ， wo ying gai zai zhe pian tu di shang man bu ， ge song wo men zhan shi de guang rong zhan dou 。]

english: If you can find me a pair of sturdy boots to replace these old worn out ones of mine, I will be happy to spend the time on composing you a romantic ballad.
translation: 如果你能为我找到一双坚固的靴子来代替我这双破旧的靴子，我将很乐意花时间为你创作一首浪漫的歌谣。 [ru guo ni neng wei wo zhao dao yi shuang jian gu de xue zi lai dai ti wo zhe shuang po jiu de xue zi ， wo jiang hen le yi hua shi jian wei ni chuang zuo yi shou lang man de ge yao 。]

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find some custom sturdy boots, do you?
translation: 我想你不知道我在哪里可以找到一些定制的坚固靴子，是吗？ [wo xiang ni bu zhi dao wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao yi xie ding zhi de jian gu xue zi ， shi ma ？]

english: I'm sorry outerlander... If I did, I would not trouble you to go and find them for me, would I?
translation: 对不起外乡人……如果是我的话，我就不会麻烦你帮我去找他们了，不是吗？ [dui bu qi wai xiang ren …… ru guo shi wo de hua ， wo jiu bu hui ma fan ni bang wo qu zhao ta men le ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Hello Olaf. Do you have a beautiful love song written for me?
translation: 你好奥拉夫。你有一首为我写的优美的情歌吗？ [ni hao ao la fu 。 ni you yi shou wei wo xie de you mei de qing ge ma ？]

english: That depends outerlander... Do you have some new boots for me? My feet get so tired roaming the land...
translation: 这取决于外地人...你有给我一些新靴子吗？在这片土地上行走，我的脚好累…… [zhe qu jue yu wai di ren ... ni you gei wo yi xie xin xue zi ma ？ zai zhe pian tu di shang hang zou ， wo de jiao hao lei ……]

english: As a matter of fact - I do!
translation: 事实上——我愿意！ [shi shi shang —— wo yuan yi ！]

english: Oh! Superb! Those are great! They're just what I was looking for! Here, take this song with my compliments! It is one of my finest works yet!
translation: 哦！高超！那些太棒了！它们正是我一直在寻找的东西！在此，请接受这首歌，表达我的敬意！这是我迄今为止最好的作品之一！ [o ！ gao chao ！ na xie tai bang le ！ ta men zheng shi wo yi zhi zai xun zhao de dong xi ！ zai ci ， qing jie shou zhe shou ge ， biao da wo de jing yi ！ zhe shi wo qi jin wei zhi zui hao de zuo pin zhi yi ！]

english: So you think this song is pretty good then?
translation: 那你觉得这首歌很好听吗？ [na ni jue de zhe shou ge hen hao ting ma ？]

english: Ahhh.... outerlander... it is the most beautiful romantic ballad I have ever been inspired to write...
translation: 啊……外乡人……这是我受启发写的最美丽的浪漫民谣…… [a …… wai xiang ren …… zhe shi wo shou qi fa xie de zui mei li de lang man min yao ……]

english: Only a woman with a heart of icey stone could fail to be moved by its beauty!
translation: 只有铁石心肠的女人，才能不被它的美丽所感动！ [zhi you tie shi xin chang de nv ren ， cai neng bu bei ta de mei li suo gan dong ！]

english: Thanks! That sounds perfect!
translation: 谢谢！听起来很完美！ [xie xie ！ ting qi lai hen wan mei ！]

english: Hello again to you [Fremennik name]. Us bards should stick together, what?
translation: 再次向你[弗雷曼尼克名字]问好。我们吟游诗人应该团结起来，什么？ [zai ci xiang ni [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ] wen hao 。 wo men yin you shi ren ying gai tuan jie qi lai ， shen me ？]

english: About the Music Cape...
translation: 关于音乐斗篷... [guan yu yin yue dou peng ...]

english: I believe you are the person to talk to if I want to get a Music Cape?
translation: 我相信如果我想得到一件音乐披风，你是可以找的人吗？ [wo xiang xin ru guo wo xiang de dao yi jian yin yue pi feng ， ni shi ke yi zhao de ren ma ？]

english: That's right! If you know that then you'll also know that they cost 99000 coins.
translation: 这是正确的！如果您知道这一点，那么您也会知道它们花费了 99000 个硬币。 [zhe shi zheng que de ！ ru guo nin zhi dao zhe yi dian ， na me nin ye hui zhi dao ta men hua fei le  99000  ge ying bi 。]

english: No, I hadn't heard that.
translation: 不，我没听说过。 [bu ， wo mei ting shuo guo 。]

english: Well, they do.
translation: 嗯，他们确实这么做了。 [n ， ta men que shi zhe me zuo le 。]

english: Have fun with it.
translation: 玩得开心。 [wan de kai xin 。]

english: I don't have that much at the moment.
translation: 我现在没有那么多。 [wo xian zai mei you na me duo 。]

english: Save up some more then!
translation: 那就多存点吧！ [na jiu duo cun dian ba ！]

english: Yes, I know.
translation: 是的，我知道。 [shi de ， wo zhi dao 。]

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: 请问我可以再给我的披风戴上兜帽吗？ [qing wen wo ke yi zai gei wo de pi feng dai shang dou mao ma ？]

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
translation: 毫无疑问，而且免费！ [hao wu yi wen ， er qie mian fei ！]

english: The bard hands you another hood for your cape.
translation: 吟游诗人递给你另一顶斗篷兜帽。 [yin you shi ren di gei ni ling yi ding dou peng dou mao 。]

english: Yes, but you don't know all of the music in the land.
translation: 是的，但你并不了解这片土地上的所有音乐。 [shi de ， dan ni bing bu liao jie zhe pian tu di shang de suo you yin yue 。]

english: Do you know any great stories about Basilisk Jaws?
translation: 您知道有关蛇怪大颚的精彩故事吗？ [nin zhi dao you guan she guai da e de jing cai gu shi ma ？]

english: Why do you ask?
translation: 你为什么问？ [ni wei shen me wen ？]

english: Oh my! This must be the jaw of a legendary Basilisk Knight. There's a great song about how the Fremennik warriors of old would use these jaws to enhance their helmets.
translation: 天啊！这肯定是传说中的蛇怪骑士的下巴。有一首很棒的歌曲讲述了古代弗雷曼尼克战士如何使用这些下巴来增强他们的头盔。 [tian a ！ zhe ken ding shi chuan shuo zhong de she guai qi shi de xia ba 。 you yi shou hen bang de ge qu jiang shu le gu dai fu lei man ni ke zhan shi ru he shi yong zhe xie xia ba lai zeng qiang ta men de tou kui 。]

english: I see. I have a nice helmet that Neitiznot's Burgher gave to me. I bet it would work well with that.
translation: 我懂了。我有一顶漂亮的头盔，是内蒂兹诺特的伯格送给我的。 I bet it would work well with that. [wo dong le 。 wo you yi ding piao liang de tou kui ， shi nei di zi nuo te de bo ge song gei wo de 。 I bet it would work well with that.]

english: I'm sure it would, [Fremennik name]. Now, do you want to hear the song?
translation: 我确信会的，[弗雷曼尼克名字]。现在，你想听这首歌吗？ [wo que xin hui de ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 xian zai ， ni xiang ting zhe shou ge ma ？]

english: Err... I think I'll pass. Thanks for the help though.
translation: 呃...我想我会通过。不过还是谢谢你的帮助。 [e ... wo xiang wo hui tong guo 。 bu guo hai shi xie xie ni de bang zhu 。]

english: I was wondering... Can I learn to play my lyre again?
translation: 我想知道...我可以再次学习拉里拉琴吗？ [wo xiang zhi dao ... wo ke yi zai ci xue xi la li la qin ma ？]

english: Well, that is an interesting question. Let me let you into a little secret. If you make another offering to Fossegrimen you will learn a secret melody.
translation: 嗯，这是一个有趣的问题。让我告诉你一个小秘密。如果您再次向福斯格里曼献祭，您将学到一段秘密旋律。 [n ， zhe shi yi ge you qu de wen ti 。 rang wo gao su ni yi ge xiao mi mi 。 ru guo nin zai ci xiang fu si ge li man xian ji ， nin jiang xue dao yi duan mi mi xuan lv 。]

english: What kind of melody?
translation: 什么样的旋律？ [shen me yang de xuan lv ？]

english: It is the song of Rellekka. When you play it, it will bring you back to this town wherever you are in this world.
translation: 这是Rellekka 的歌。当你玩它时，无论你身在何处，它都会带你回到这个小镇。 [zhe shi Rellekka  de ge 。 dang ni wan ta shi ， wu lun ni shen zai he chu ， ta du hui dai ni hui dao zhe ge xiao zhen 。]

english: We often go adventuring with bards for precisely this reason; No matter where we have ended up we can return safe and sound to home.
translation: 正是出于这个原因，我们经常与吟游诗人一起去冒险。无论我们身在何处，我们都可以安然无恙地回到家。 [zheng shi chu yu zhe ge yuan yin ， wo men jing chang yu yin you shi ren yi qi qu mao xian 。 wu lun wo men shen zai he chu ， wo men dou ke yi an ran wu yang di hui dao jia 。]

english: Thanks Olaf!
translation: 谢谢奥拉夫！ [xie xie ao la fu ！]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Remind me about crafting a lyre
translation: 提醒我有关制作竖琴的信息 [ti xing wo you guan zhi zuo shu qin de xin xi]

english: Remind me about Fossegrimen
translation: 让我想起福斯格里曼 [rang wo xiang qi fu si ge li man]

english: Remind me about playing on stage
translation: 提醒我有关舞台表演的事情 [ti xing wo you guan wu tai biao yan de shi qing]

english: I don't need a reminder

translation: 迈雷克的象征——银镰刀！ [mai lei ke de xiang zheng —— yin lian dao ！]

translation: 哦，那么那会在哪里呢？ [o ， na me na hui zai na li ne ？]

translation: 但他们就住在你家楼下？ [dan ta men jiu zhu zai ni jia lou xia ？]

translation: 哼！假设他们这样做了。愚蠢的迈雷克…… [heng ！ jia she ta men zhe yang zuo le 。 yu chun de mai lei ke ……]

translation: 嗯，你以前已经帮过我了！你帮我找到了迈雷克！ [n ， ni yi qian yi jing bang guo wo le ！ ni bang wo zhao dao le mai lei ke ！]

translation: 哼！是的，当然，遵循符号等等。但现在毫无意义了，他们就在我们下面。哼！ [heng ！ shi de ， dang ran ， zun xun fu hao deng deng 。 dan xian zai hao wu yi yi le ， ta men jiu zai wo men xia mian 。 heng ！]

translation: 哼！死的！这就是我对迈雷克的了解。你也很幸运没有死。不要再谈论他们了！ [heng ！ si de ！ zhe jiu shi wo dui mai lei ke de liao jie 。 ni ye hen xing yun mei you si 。 bu yao zai tan lun ta men le ！]

translation: 哼！是的，当然，遵循符号等等。现在已经毫无意义了，他们都死了！哼！ [heng ！ shi de ， dang ran ， zun xun fu hao deng deng 。 xian zai yi jing hao wu yi yi le ， ta men dou si le ！ heng ！]

translation: 我只是到处闲逛。 [wo zhi shi dao chu xian guang 。]

english: Oh, that's nice. I used to wander around, back when my legs were better. So long ago.
translation: 哦，那太好了。当我的腿还好一点的时候，我常常到处闲逛。很久以前了。 [o ， na tai hao le 。 dang wo de tui hai hao yi dian de shi hou ， wo chang chang dao chu xian guang 。 hen jiu yi qian le 。]

translation: 没什么，真的。 [mei shen me ， zhen de 。]

english: That's the trouble with young people these days. Not my boy, though. He's a good boy, always working. That's why he never visits. Run along now, young [man/lady/one].
translation: 这就是现在年轻人的烦恼。但不是我的孩子。他是个好孩子，总是在工作。这就是为什么他从不来拜访。现在就跑吧，年轻人[男/女/一]。 [zhe jiu shi xian zai nian qing ren de fan nao 。 dan bu shi wo de hai zi 。 ta shi ge hao hai zi ， zong shi zai gong zuo 。 zhe jiu shi wei shen me ta cong bu lai bai fang 。 xian zai jiu pao ba ， nian qing ren [ nan / nv / yi ]。]

translation: 马洛派我去修理你的家具。 [ma luo pai wo qu xiu li ni de jia ju 。]

english: My boy Marlo sent you? Oh yes, you've come to help with my furniture. It's in a terrible state. You'll want to start by removing all the tatty old furniture.
translation: 我的儿子马洛派你来的？哦，是的，你是来帮我收拾家具的。它处于一种可怕的状态。您首先需要拆除所有破旧的旧家具。 [wo de er zi ma luo pai ni lai de ？ o ， shi de ， ni shi lai bang wo shou shi jia ju de 。 ta chu yu yi zhong ke pa de zhuang tai 。 nin shou xian xu yao chai chu suo you po jiu de jiu jia ju 。]

english: You still need to remove: - A broken stool in the kitchen - A broken stool in the bedroom - A broken chair in the bedroom
translation: 您还需要移除： - 厨房里坏掉的凳子 - 卧室里坏掉的凳子 - 卧室里坏掉的椅子 [nin hai xu yao yi chu ： -  chu fang li huai diao de deng zi  -  wo shi li huai diao de deng zi  -  wo shi li huai diao de yi zi]
