english: I've finished removing all the old furniture.
translation: 我已经把所有旧家具都搬走了。 [wo yi jing ba suo you jiu jia ju dou ban zou le 。]

english: Jolly good, young [man/lady/one]. Now, we'll need to have a talk about what you'll build for me to replace it.
translation: 非常好，年轻[男人/女人/一个]。现在，我们需要谈谈您将为我构建什么来替换它。 [fei chang hao ， nian qing [ nan ren / nv ren / yi ge ]。 xian zai ， wo men xu yao tan tan nin jiang wei wo gou jian shen me lai ti huan ta 。]

english: You see, I used to be a carpenter myself, before the arthritis got me. Such wonderful things I could build. Let me tell you about the things Construction can do for you...
translation: 你看，在关节炎发作之前，我自己也曾是一名木匠。我可以建造如此美妙的东西。让我告诉您建筑可以为您做的事情...... [ni kan ， zai guan jie yan fa zuo zhi qian ， wo zi ji ye ceng shi yi ming mu jiang 。 wo ke yi jian zao ru ci mei miao de dong xi 。 rang wo gao su nin jian zhu ke yi wei nin zuo de shi qing ......]

english: Is this necessary? I've got a house of my own, in [city], and I've been learning about Construction for a while.
translation: 有这个必要吗？我在[城市]拥有自己的房子，并且我已经学习建筑知识有一段时间了。 [you zhe ge bi yao ma ？ wo zai [ cheng shi ] yong you zi ji de fang zi ， bing qie wo yi jing xue xi jian zhu zhi shi you yi duan shi jian le 。]

english: A cutscene plays in which Old Man Yarlo is in a newly purchased player-owned house.
translation: 在过场动画中，老头亚洛在玩家新购买的房子里。 [zai guo chang dong hua zhong ， lao tou ya luo zai wan jia xin gou mai de fang zi li 。]

english: As a builder, in your own house, you can create your own rooms full of furniture. A house may start out very basic...
translation: 作为一名建筑商，在您自己的房子里，您可以创建自己的充满家具的房间。房子一开始可能非常基础…… [zuo wei yi ming jian zhu shang ， zai nin zi ji de fang zi li ， nin ke yi chuang jian zi ji de chong man jia ju de fang jian 。 fang zi yi kai shi ke neng fei chang ji chu ……]

english: ... but in Building Mode, you'll see what you can add to it...
translation: ...但是在建筑模式中，您会看到可以添加什么... [... dan shi zai jian zhu mo shi zhong ， nin hui kan dao ke yi tian jia shen me ...]

english: Old Man Yarlo builds a fully furnished parlour.
translation: 亚罗老人建造了一间设施齐全的客厅。 [ya luo lao ren jian zao le yi jian she shi qi quan de ke ting 。]

english: ... with fancier options available as your Construction level rises.
translation: ...随着您的建造水平的提高，可以提供更精美的选项。 [... sui zhe nin de jian zao shui ping de ti gao ， ke yi ti gong geng jing mei de xuan xiang 。]

english: Old Man Yarlo removes several furniture and builds fancier ones.
translation: 亚罗老人拆除了几件家具并建造了更精美的家具。 [ya luo lao ren chai chu le ji jian jia ju bing jian zao le geng jing mei de jia ju 。]

english: You can add lots more rooms, and build their furniture too, unlocking really handy features.
translation: 你可以添加更多的房间，也可以建造他们的家具，解锁真正方便的功能。 [ni ke yi tian jia geng duo de fang jian ， ye ke yi jian zao ta men de jia ju ， jie suo zhen zheng fang bian de gong neng 。]

english: The camera shifts and Old Man Yarlo is now seen in a fully furnished home fitted with the highest-level furniture.
translation: 镜头转移，亚洛老人现在出现在一间设施齐全、配备最高级家具的房屋中。 [jing tou zhuan yi ， ya luo lao ren xian zai chu xian zai yi jian she shi qi quan 、 pei bei zui gao ji jia ju de fang wu zhong 。]

english: For example, in a study, you could build a lectern for creating spell tablets, powerful items that can cast spells without runes. You could sell your tablets to other people too.
translation: 例如，在一项研究中，您可以建造一个讲台来创建咒语板，这是无需符文即可施放咒语的强大物品。您也可以将平板电脑出售给其他人。 [li ru ， zai yi xiang yan jiu zhong ， nin ke yi jian zao yi ge jiang tai lai chuang jian zhou yu ban ， zhe shi wu xu fu wen ji ke shi fang zhou yu de qiang da wu pin 。 nin ye ke yi jiang ping ban dian nao chu shou gei qi ta ren 。]

english: A Teleport Nexus can take you to a huge range of destinations, making your home a powerful travel hub.
translation: Teleport Nexus 可以带您前往众多目的地，使您的家成为强大的旅行中心。 [Teleport Nexus  ke yi dai nin qian wang zhong duo mu di di ， shi nin de jia cheng wei qiang da de lv xing zhong xin 。]

english: Show your dedication to the gods by building an altar, where you can sacrifice bones for bonus Prayer XP.
translation: 通过建造一座祭坛来展示你对众神的奉献，你可以在那里牺牲骨头来获得额外的祈祷经验值。 [tong guo jian zao yi zuo ji tan lai zhan shi ni dui zhong shen de feng xian ， ni ke yi zai na li xi sheng gu tou lai huo de e wai de qi dao jing yan zhi 。]

english: With a regeneration pool, you can get healed quickly, before you teleport back to the action.
translation: 有了再生池，你可以在传送回行动之前快速得到治愈。 [you le zai sheng chi ， ni ke yi zai chuan song hui xing dong zhi qian kuai su de dao zhi yu 。]

english: The Estate Agents can redecorate your house in different styles, if you want something a bit more impressive.
translation: 如果您想要更令人印象深刻的东西，房地产经纪人可以将您的房子重新装修成不同的风格。 [ru guo nin xiang yao geng ling ren yin xiang shen ke de dong xi ， fang di chan jing ji ren ke yi jiang nin de fang zi chong xin zhuang xiu cheng bu tong de feng ge 。]

english: And, of course, to make your house feel truly like a home, you can fill it with adorable critters...
translation: 当然，为了让你的房子真正像一个家，你可以在里面装满可爱的小动物...... [dang ran ， wei le rang ni de fang zi zhen zheng xiang yi ge jia ， ni ke yi zai li mian zhuang man ke ai de xiao dong wu ......]

english: ... and drop your guests into the monster pit beneath your throne room.
translation: ...然后将您的客人扔进王座室下方的怪物坑中。 [... ran hou jiang nin de ke ren reng jin wang zuo shi xia fang de guai wu keng zhong 。]

english: All this could be yours, if you train Construction!
translation: 如果你训练建筑，这一切都可能是你的！ [ru guo ni xun lian jian zhu ， zhe yi qie dou ke neng shi ni de ！]

english: Now, I was just getting round to telling you about the furniture I want you to build for me. For a start, I'd like two new stools, two new tables and a new chair.
translation: 现在，我正想告诉你我想让你为我制作的家具。首先，我想要两张新凳子、两张新桌子和一把新椅子。 [xian zai ， wo zheng xiang gao su ni wo xiang rang ni wei wo zhi zuo de jia ju 。 shou xian ， wo xiang yao liang zhang xin deng zi 、 liang zhang xin zhuo zi he yi ba xin yi zi 。]

english: Some basic wooden planks and some nails should do, for those. I won't ask for anything more fancy - it'd only get stolen anyway, in this neighbourhood.
translation: 对于这些，一些基本的木板和一些钉子就可以了。我不会要求任何更奇特的东西——无论如何，在这个街区它只会被偷。 [dui yu zhe xie ， yi xie ji ben de mu ban he yi xie ding zi jiu ke yi le 。 wo bu hui yao qiu ren he geng qi te de dong xi —— wu lun ru he ， zai zhe ge jie qu ta zhi hui bei tou 。]

english: I'll want a new carpet too. They can really change the atmosphere of a room, you know! You can buy cloth at the sawmill to make one.
translation: 我也想要一张新地毯。它们确实可以改变房间的气氛，你知道！您可以在锯木厂购买布料来制作一件。 [wo ye xiang yao yi zhang xin di tan 。 ta men que shi ke yi gai bian fang jian de qi fen ， ni zhi dao ！ nin ke yi zai ju mu chang gou mai bu liao lai zhi zuo yi jian 。]

english: Now, for the bed, I've got something special in mind. This town's quite damp, and I don't want the moisture rising up the bed into my blankets. But I've found some wood that resists water.
translation: 现在，对于床，我有一些特别的想法。这个小镇很潮湿，我不想让湿气从床上爬到我的毯子上。但我发现了一些防水的木材。 [xian zai ， dui yu chuang ， wo you yi xie te bie de xiang fa 。 zhe ge xiao zhen hen chao shi ， wo bu xiang rang shi qi cong chuang shang pa dao wo de tan zi shang 。 dan wo fa xian le yi xie fang shui de mu cai 。]

english: Those abandoned crates in the kitchen were here when I moved in, and I found they contain waxwood logs. Waxwood isn't much used in carpentry, but it resists water, so I want a bed made from that.
translation: 当我搬进来时，厨房里那些废弃的板条箱就在这里，我发现它们里面装着蜡木原木。蜡木在木工中很少使用，但它防水，所以我想要一张用它制成的床。 [dang wo ban jin lai shi ， chu fang li na xie fei qi de ban tiao xiang jiu zai zhe li ， wo fa xian ta men li mian zhuang zhe la mu yuan mu 。 la mu zai mu gong zhong hen shao shi yong ， dan ta fang shui ， suo yi wo xiang yao yi zhang yong ta zhi cheng de chuang 。]

english: You'll have to take three logs from the crate to the sawmill. The chap there will turn them into planks if you mention my name - I've known his family for years.
translation: 你必须从板条箱中取出三块原木到锯木厂。如果你提到我的名字，那里的小伙子会把它们变成木板——我认识他的家人很多年了。 [ni bi xu cong ban tiao xiang zhong qu chu san kuai yuan mu dao ju mu chang 。 ru guo ni ti dao wo de ming zi ， na li de xiao huo zi hui ba ta men bian cheng mu ban —— wo ren shi ta de jia ren hen duo nian le 。]

english: I think that's everything - two stools, two tables, a chair, a bed and a carpet. Off you trot, young [man/lady/one]. I'll be here if you have any questions.
translation: 我想这就是一切了——两张凳子、两张桌子、一把椅子、一张床和一张地毯。快跑吧，年轻人[男人/女人/一个]。如果您有任何疑问，我会在这里。 [wo xiang zhe jiu shi yi qie le —— liang zhang deng zi 、 liang zhang zhuo zi 、 yi ba yi zi 、 yi zhang chuang he yi zhang di tan 。 kuai pao ba ， nian qing ren [ nan ren / nv ren / yi ge ]。 ru guo nin you ren he yi wen ， wo hui zai zhe li 。]

english: You young people are always rushing around trying to optimise the fun out of life. There are other ways to enjoy the world, you know! But I'm sure you know best.
translation: 你们年轻人总是忙忙碌碌，试图优化生活的乐趣。你知道，还有其他方式来享受这个世界！但我相信你最了解。 [ni men nian qing ren zong shi mang mang lu lu ， shi tu you hua sheng huo de le qu 。 ni zhi dao ， hai you qi ta fang shi lai xiang shou zhe ge shi jie ！ dan wo xiang xin ni zui liao jie 。]

english: Do you need some help with the building work, young [man/lady/one]?
translation: 年轻的[男士/女士/一人]，您需要建筑工作方面的帮助吗？ [nian qing de [ nan shi / nv shi / yi ren ]， nin xu yao jian zhu gong zuo fang mian de bang zhu ma ？]

english: How do I build furniture?
translation: 我如何建造家具？ [wo ru he jian zao jia ju ？]

english: Ah. Look in the place where the new furniture will go...
translation: 啊。看看新家具将放在哪里...... [a 。 kan kan xin jia ju jiang fang zai na li ......]

english: A talented builder will see a vision there of the furniture they could build. Interact with that, and you should find you can build furniture.
translation: 一个有才华的建造者会在那里看到他们可以建造的家具的愿景。与之互动，你应该会发现你可以建造家具。 [yi ge you cai hua de jian zao zhe hui zai na li kan dao ta men ke yi jian zao de jia ju de yuan jing 。 yu zhi hu dong ， ni ying gai hui fa xian ni ke yi jian zao jia ju 。]

english: You'll need a hammer and saw. I can supply those if you need them.
translation: 你需要一把锤子和锯子。如果你需要的话我可以提供。 [ni xu yao yi ba chui zi he ju zi 。 ru guo ni xu yao de hua wo ke yi ti gong 。]

english: Where do I get planks, nails and cloth?
translation: 我在哪里可以获得木板、钉子和布？ [wo zai na li ke yi huo de mu ban 、 ding zi he bu ？]

english: From the sawmill! They sell nails and cloth at reasonable prices. You'd have to take your own logs there, though, to get planks, but there are plenty of trees to chop nearby.
translation: 来自锯木厂！他们以合理的价格出售钉子和布料。不过，你必须自己带原木去那里才能获得木板，但附近有很多树可以砍伐。 [lai zi ju mu chang ！ ta men yi he li de jia ge chu shou ding zi he bu liao 。 bu guo ， ni bi xu zi ji dai yuan mu qu na li cai neng huo de mu ban ， dan fu jin you hen duo shu ke yi kan fa 。]

english: Watch out, though - nails can bend, if you're not careful. You should probably get some spares, just in case.
translation: 但要小心——如果你不小心的话，指甲可能会弯曲。你可能应该买一些备件，以防万一。 [dan yao xiao xin —— ru guo ni bu xiao xin de hua ， zhi jia ke neng hui wan qu 。 ni ke neng ying gai mai yi xie bei jian ， yi fang wan yi 。]

english: Look on your World Map to find the sawmill.
translation: 在世界地图上查找锯木厂。 [zai shi jie di tu shang cha zhao ju mu chang 。]

english: You've got a hammer and a saw. I wouldn't be able to offer you anything else.
translation: 你有一把锤子和一把锯子。我无法为你提供任何其他东西。 [ni you yi ba chui zi he yi ba ju zi 。 wo wu fa wei ni ti gong ren he qi ta dong xi 。]

english: I need some tools.
translation: 我需要一些工具。 [wo xu yao yi xie gong ju 。]

english: Would you like a [hammer/saw]? I can spare one.
translation: 您想要[锤子/锯]吗？我可以空出一张 [nin xiang yao [ chui zi / ju ] ma ？ wo ke yi kong chu yi zhang]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Yarlo gives you a [hammer/saw].
translation: 亚洛给你一把[锤子/锯子]。 [ya luo gei ni yi ba [ chui zi / ju zi ]。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Tell me about the waxwood for the bed.
translation: 告诉我有关床的蜡木的信息。 [gao su wo you guan chuang de la mu de xin xi 。]

english: This town's quite damp, and I don't want the moisture rising up the bed into my blankets. But I've found some wood that resists water.
translation: 这个小镇很潮湿，我不想让湿气从床上爬到我的毯子上。但我发现了一些防水的木材。 [zhe ge xiao zhen hen chao shi ， wo bu xiang rang shi qi cong chuang shang pa dao wo de tan zi shang 。 dan wo fa xian le yi xie fang shui de mu cai 。]

english: You'll have to take three logs from the crate to the sawmill. The chap there will turn them into planks if you mention my name.
translation: 你必须从板条箱中取出三块原木到锯木厂。如果你提到我的名字，那家伙会把它们变成木板。 [ni bi xu cong ban tiao xiang zhong qu chu san kuai yuan mu dao ju mu chang 。 ru guo ni ti dao wo de ming zi ， na jia huo hui ba ta men bian cheng mu ban 。]

english: I'll get on with it.
translation: 我会继续做下去。 [wo hui ji xu zuo xia qu 。]

english: That's everything! Thank you so much, young [man/lady/one]. Trot off back to my boy Marlo, now. He'll have something for you.
translation: 这就是一切！非常感谢你，年轻的[男士/女士/一位]。现在快跑回我儿子马洛身边吧。他会给你一些东西。 [zhe jiu shi yi qie ！ fei chang gan xie ni ， nian qing de [ nan shi / nv shi / yi wei ]。 xian zai kuai pao hui wo er zi ma luo shen bian ba 。 ta hui gei ni yi xie dong xi 。]

english: Okay, I'll head back to Marlo.
translation: 好的，我会回马洛。 [hao de ， wo hui hui ma luo 。]

english: Hello again, young [man/lady/one]. Has my boy Marlo rewarded you yet?
translation: 再次问好，年轻的[男/女/一]。我的儿子马洛奖励你了吗？ [zai ci wen hao ， nian qing de [ nan / nv / yi ]。 wo de er zi ma luo jiang li ni le ma ？]

english: Not yet. I'll get round to visiting him soon.
translation: 还没有。我很快就会抽出时间去拜访他。 [hai mei you 。 wo hen kuai jiu hui chou chu shi jian qu bai fang ta 。]

english: Yes, you should do that. You've earned it.
translation: 是的，你应该这样做。你已经赚到了。 [shi de ， ni ying gai zhe yang zuo 。 ni yi jing zhuan dao le 。]

english: Hello again, young [man/lady/one]. You really did wonders for my little home. I feel so much happier living here now.
translation: 再次问好，年轻的[男/女/一]。你真的为我的小家创造了奇迹。我现在住在这里感到非常幸福。 [zai ci wen hao ， nian qing de [ nan / nv / yi ]。 ni zhen de wei wo de xiao jia chuang zao le qi ji 。 wo xian zai zhu zai zhe li gan dao fei chang xing fu 。]

english: That's good to hear. Goodbye now.
translation: 很高兴听到这个消息。现在再见了。 [hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi 。 xian zai zai jian le 。]

english: Tell me about more things I can do with Construction.
translation: 告诉我更多我可以用建筑来做的事情。 [gao su wo geng duo wo ke yi yong jian zhu lai zuo de shi qing 。]

english: Thank you!
translation: 谢谢你！ [xie xie ni ！]

english: I'm just wandering around.
translation: 我只是到处闲逛。 [wo zhi shi dao chu xian guang 。]

english: Nothing, really.
translation: 没什么，真的。 [mei shen me ， zhen de 。]

english: Listen to Yarlo.
translation: 听听亚罗的话。 [ting ting ya luo de hua 。]

english: Skip Yarlo's lecture. He'll offer it later if you like.
translation: 跳过亚罗的演讲。如果你愿意的话，他稍后会提供。 [tiao guo ya luo de yan jiang 。 ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， ta shao hou hui ti gong 。]

english: How do I build furniture?
translation: 我如何建造家具？ [wo ru he jian zao jia ju ？]

english: Where do I get planks, nails and cloth?
translation: 我在哪里可以获得木板、钉子和布？ [wo zai na li ke yi huo de mu ban 、 ding zi he bu ？]

english: I need some tools.
translation: 我需要一些工具。 [wo xu yao yi xie gong ju 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Tell me about the waxwood for the bed.
translation: 告诉我有关床的蜡木的信息。 [gao su wo you guan chuang de la mu de xin xi 。]

english: I'll get on with it.
translation: 我会继续做下去。 [wo hui ji xu zuo xia qu 。]

english: That's good to hear. Goodbye now.
translation: 很高兴听到这个消息。现在再见了。 [hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi 。 xian zai zai jian le 。]

english: Tell me about more things I can do with Construction.
translation: 告诉我更多我可以用建筑来做的事情。 [gao su wo geng duo wo ke yi yong jian zhu lai zuo de shi qing 。]

english: I'm here about Necrovarus.
translation: 我来这里是为了Necrovarus。 [wo lai zhe li shi wei le Necrovarus。]

english: Good news - the enchantment worked!
translation: 好消息——魔法起作用了！ [hao xiao xi —— mo fa qi zuo yong le ！]

english: So Necrovarus has let the ghosts go free.... You have achieved many wonderful things, my young friend.
translation: 所以 Necrovarus 让鬼魂获得了自由……你已经取得了许多奇妙的成就，我年轻的朋友。 [suo yi  Necrovarus  rang gui hun huo de le zi you …… ni yi jing qu de le xu duo qi miao de cheng jiu ， wo nian qing de peng you 。]

english: I'm here about the farmers east of here.
translation: 我来这里是为了东边的农民。 [wo lai zhe li shi wei le dong bian de nong min 。]

english: Hello there, just dropping in to thank you again. It all went perfectly. Alice and her husband can communicate again.
translation: 你好，我只是顺便再次感谢你。一切都很顺利。艾丽丝和她的丈夫又可以沟通了。 [ni hao ， wo zhi shi shun bian zai ci gan xie ni 。 yi qie dou hen shun li 。 ai li si he ta de zhang fu you ke yi gou tong le 。]

english: I can't help but shed a tear about my own family. My sisters are so vile, I refuse to talk to them these days.
translation: 我忍不住为自己的家人流泪。我的姐妹们太卑鄙了，我这些天拒绝和她们说话。 [wo ren bu zhu wei zi ji de jia ren liu lei 。 wo de jie mei men tai bei bi le ， wo zhe xie tian ju jue he ta men shuo hua 。]

english: Sorry to hear that.
translation: 很遗憾听到这个消息。 [hen yi han ting dao zhe ge xiao xi 。]

english: Never mind; we've reunited a happy family of farmers; that's enough for me.
translation: 没关系;我们又团聚了一个幸福的农民家庭；这对我来说就足够了。 [mei guan xi ; wo men you tuan ju le yi ge xing fu de nong min jia ting ； zhe dui wo lai shuo jiu zu gou le 。]

english: Answer this, please.

english: We gave you plenty of chances to flee!
translation: 我们给了你很多逃跑的机会！ [wo men gei le ni hen duo tao pao de ji hui ！]

english: If I ran away from you, I'd never hear the end of it!
translation: 如果我逃离你，我将永远听不到结局！ [ru guo wo tao li ni ， wo jiang yong yuan ting bu dao jie ju ！]

english: Really? Then what about that fight in Turtle Basin?
translation: 真的吗？那么海龟盆地那场战斗呢？ [zhen de ma ？ na me hai gui pen di na chang zhan dou ne ？]

english: That wasn't fleeing! It was a tactical repositioning! Besides, you're conveniently forgetting what happened at Brimhaven!
translation: 那不是逃跑！这是战术上的重新定位！此外，你很容易忘记在布里姆黑文发生的事情！ [na bu shi tao pao ！ zhe shi zhan shu shang de chong xin ding wei ！ ci wai ， ni hen rong yi wang ji zai bu li mu hei wen fa sheng de shi qing ！]

english: A boring fight! I had better things to do.
translation: 无聊的战斗！我有更重要的事情要做。 [wu liao de zhan dou ！ wo you geng zhong yao de shi qing yao zuo 。]

english: Well, we'll have to make things more entertaining next time then!
translation: 好吧，下次我们得让事情变得更有趣！ [hao ba ， xia ci wo men de rang shi qing bian de geng you qu ！]

english: I look forward to it, but for now, let's drink!
translation: 我很期待，但现在，让我们喝吧！ [wo hen qi dai ， dan xian zai ， rang wo men he ba ！]

english: Indeed! Cheers!
translation: 的确！干杯! [di que ！ gan bei !]

english: Hello there. What do you want to talk about?
translation: 你好呀。你想谈什么？ [ni hao ya 。 ni xiang tan shen me ？]

english: Hi, how are things going?
translation: 嗨，事情进展得怎么样？ [hai ， shi qing jin zhan de zen me yang ？]

english: Well hopefully a lot better now that you've initiated the calm between the Moon Clan and the Fremenniks. Remember, if you want to use our Lunar Spells at any time, pray at the altar beside me and you can modify
translation: 好吧，既然你已经促成了月氏族和弗雷曼尼克之间的平静，那么希望情况会好很多。记住，如果你想随时使用我们的月系法术，就到我身边的祭坛祈祷，然后就可以修改 [hao ba ， ji ran ni yi jing cu cheng le yue zhi zu he fu lei man ni ke zhi jian de ping jing ， na me xi wang qing kuang hui hao hen duo 。 ji zhu ， ru guo ni xiang sui shi shi yong wo men de yue xi fa shu ， jiu dao wo shen bian de ji tan qi dao ， ran hou jiu ke yi xiu gai]

english: your knowledge!
translation: 你的知识！ [ni de zhi shi ！]

english: I've misplaced my staff.
translation: 我把我的员工放错地方了。 [wo ba wo de yuan gong fang cuo di fang le 。]

english: I knew you'd do that, and I used my magic to teleport it back to me.
translation: 我知道你会这么做，我用魔法将它传送回给我。 [wo zhi dao ni hui zhe me zuo ， wo yong mo fa jiang ta chuan song hui gei wo 。]

english: Erm, that doesn't sound too realistic. Thanks!
translation: 嗯，这听起来不太现实。谢谢！ [n ， zhe ting qi lai bu tai xian shi 。 xie xie ！]

english: Look, do you want it or not?
translation: 看看你想要还是不想要？ [kan kan ni xiang yao hai shi bu xiang yao ？]

english: Sorry, yes. Yes please.
translation: 抱歉，是的。是的，请。 [bao qian ， shi de 。 shi de ， qing 。]

english: Actually, I'll have to come back when I have a space to carry one.
translation: 事实上，等我有空位的时候我就得回来了。 [shi shi shang ， deng wo you kong wei de shi hou wo jiu de hui lai le 。]

english: But it's going to cost you! It will be 30000 coins!
translation: 但这会让你付出代价！这将是30000金币！ [dan zhe hui rang ni fu chu dai jia ！ zhe jiang shi 30000 jin bi ！]

english: Yeah, I'll pay that!
translation: 是的，我会付钱的！ [shi de ， wo hui fu qian de ！]

english: Sorry dear, you don't have enough coins for that.
translation: 抱歉，亲爱的，您没有足够的硬币。 [bao qian ， qin ai de ， nin mei you zu gou de ying bi 。]

english: Oh, ok...
translation: 哦，好吧... [o ， hao ba ...]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: I've lost my Lunar [item].
translation: 我丢失了我的月球[物品]。 [wo diu shi le wo de yue qiu [ wu pin ]。]

english: Oh dear, good job I pre-empted you!
translation: 噢，亲爱的，干得好，我抢先了你！ [o ， qin ai de ， gan de hao ， wo qiang xian le ni ！]

english: I already knew that. I got one especially.
translation: 我已经知道了。我特意得到了一张。 [wo yi jing zhi dao le 。 wo te yi de dao le yi zhang 。]

english: Well of course, I know that already, so I got a backup for you.
translation: 当然，我已经知道了，所以我为你准备了一个备份。 [dang ran ， wo yi jing zhi dao le ， suo yi wo wei ni zhun bei le yi ge bei fen 。]

english: I know. Good job I knew you would drop it!
translation: 我知道。干得好，我就知道你会放弃它！ [wo zhi dao 。 gan de hao ， wo jiu zhi dao ni hui fang qi ta ！]

english: Unfortunately I don't have space to carry it.
translation: 不幸的是我没有空间来携带它。 [bu xing de shi wo mei you kong jian lai xie dai ta 。]

english: But it's going to cost you! It will be [number] coins!
translation: 但这会让你付出代价！这将是[数量]个硬币！ [dan zhe hui rang ni fu chu dai jia ！ zhe jiang shi [ shu liang ] ge ying bi ！]

english: Hello again. Seen Cyrisus recently?
translation: 又好。最近见过赛里苏斯吗？ [you hao 。 zui jin jian guo sai li su si ma ？]

english: As you mention it, yes. He wanted to create more astral runes.
translation: 正如你提到的，是的。他想要创造更多的星界符文。 [zheng ru ni ti dao de ， shi de 。 ta xiang yao chuang zao geng duo de xing jie fu wen 。]

english: Interesting.
translation: 有趣的。 [you qu de 。]

english: He said something about fighting kalphites, whatever they are.
translation: 他说了一些关于对抗卡尔菲特的事情，无论它们是什么。 [ta shuo le yi xie guan yu dui kang ka er fei te de shi qing ， wu lun ta men shi shen me 。]

english: Sounds like his fear of combat really is a problem of the past!
translation: 听起来他对战斗的恐惧真的已经成为过去了！ [ting qi lai ta dui zhan dou de kong ju zhen de yi jing cheng wei guo qu le ！]

english: You've done well. Very well.
translation: 你做得很好。很好。 [ni zuo de hen hao 。 hen hao 。]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello there. I hear that Cyrisus is no longer with us.
translation: 你好呀。我听说赛里苏斯不再和我们在一起了。 [ni hao ya 。 wo ting shuo sai li su si bu zai he wo men zai yi qi le 。]

english: He died fighting for a good cause. He'll be remembered as a great hero.
translation: 他为正义而战而死。他将作为一位伟大的英雄被人们铭记。 [ta wei zheng yi er zhan er si 。 ta jiang zuo wei yi wei wei da de ying xiong bei ren men ming ji 。]

english: I suppose the good do die young.
translation: 我想好人都会英年早逝。 [wo xiang hao ren du hui ying nian zao shi 。]

english: Answer this, please.
translation: 请回答这个问题。 [qing hui da zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Well done.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: You've [been given a new clue/obtained a casket]!
translation: 你[得到了新的线索/获得了一个棺材]！ [ni [ de dao le xin de xian suo / huo de le yi ge guan cai ]！]

english: The state of the island.
translation: 岛上的状况。 [dao shang de zhuang kuang 。]

english: Yeah, I'll pay that!
translation: 是的，我会付钱的！ [shi de ， wo hui fu qian de ！]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Cyrisus.
translation: 居里苏斯。 [ju li su si 。]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: Would you like to buy or sell any javelins?
translation: 您想购买或出售标枪吗？ [nin xiang gou mai huo chu shou biao qiang ma ？]

english: Yes, please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Could you sell me some dragon javelins?
translation: 你能卖给我一些龙标枪吗？ [ni neng mai gei wo yi xie long biao qiang ma ？]

english: Dragon javelins? Haha, you'll be a chief advisor to the King before you ever hold a dragon javelin!
translation: 龙标枪？哈哈，在你拿着龙标枪之前，你就已经是国王的首席顾问了！ [long biao qiang ？ ha ha ， zai ni na zhe long biao qiang zhi qian ， ni jiu yi jing shi guo wang de shou xi gu wen le ！]

english: Yes, please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Could you sell me some dragon javelins?
translation: 你能卖给我一些龙标枪吗？ [ni neng mai gei wo yi xie long biao qiang ma ？]

english: How can I help you, human?
translation: 我该如何帮助你，人类？ [wo gai ru he bang zhu ni ， ren lei ？]

english: Have you any ore for me?
translation: 你有矿石给我吗？ [ni you kuang shi gei wo ma ？]

english: Here you go. That's all the ore I have for you.
translation: 干得好。这就是我给你的所有矿石了。 [gan de hao 。 zhe jiu shi wo gei ni de suo you kuang shi le 。]

english: None of the ore here is yours, sorry.
translation: 抱歉，这里的矿石都不是你的。 [bao qian ， zhe li de kuang shi dou bu shi ni de 。]

english: How do I mine in this place?
translation: 在这个地方怎么挖矿？ [zai zhe ge di fang zen me wa kuang ？]

english: Okay, first you need dynamite. That's got three ingredients...
translation: 好的，首先你需要炸药。里面有三种成分... [hao de ， shou xian ni xu yao zha yao 。 li mian you san zhong cheng fen ...]

english: Once you've got dynamite, use a chisel to excavate a cavity in the hard rock walls, so you can put the dynamite in, then light the fuse.
translation: 拿到炸药后，用凿子在坚硬的岩壁上挖一个洞，这样你就可以把炸药放进去，然后点燃导火索。 [na dao zha yao hou ， yong zao zi zai jian ying de yan bi shang wa yi ge dong ， zhe yang ni jiu ke yi ba zha yao fang jin qu ， ran hou dian ran dao huo suo 。]

english: The dynamite blows ore out of the hard rock. It's very unstable, so you don't have long to get it cleaned before it disintegrates.
translation: 炸药将矿石从坚硬的岩石中炸出。它非常不稳定，所以在它分解之前你不需要花很长时间来清理它。 [zha yao jiang kuang shi cong jian ying de yan shi zhong zha chu 。 ta fei chang bu wen ding ， suo yi zai ta fen jie zhi qian ni bu xu yao hua hen zhang shi jian lai qing li ta 。]

english: Just deposit it into the sack upstream, and my colleague will get it cleaned safely. You can collect your cleaned ore from me.
translation: 只需将其放入上游的麻袋中，我的同事就会安全地将其清理干净。你可以从我这里领取清理过的矿石。 [zhi xu jiang qi fang ru shang you de ma dai zhong ， wo de tong shi jiu hui an quan di jiang qi qing li gan jing 。 ni ke yi cong wo zhe li ling qu qing li guo de kuang shi 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I work here, in the blast mine. It's a valuable source of minerals for the kingdom, so our work is very important.
translation: 我在这里工作，在爆炸矿井里。它是王国宝贵的矿产来源，因此我们的工作非常重要。 [wo zai zhe li gong zuo ， zai bao zha kuang jing li 。 ta shi wang guo bao gui de kuang chan lai yuan ， yin ci wo men de gong zuo fei chang zhong yao 。]

english: What is this machine?
translation: 这台机器是什么？ [zhe tai ji qi shi shen me ？]

english: The ore from the blast mines is unstable, and needs washing quickly before it disintegrates, so the Lovakengj engineers invented this machine to clean it.
translation: 来自爆破矿的矿石不稳定，需要在分解之前快速清洗，因此 Lovakengj 工程师发明了这台机器来清理它。 [lai zi bao po kuang de kuang shi bu wen ding ， xu yao zai fen jie zhi qian kuai su qing xi ， yin ci  Lovakengj  gong cheng shi fa ming le zhe tai ji qi lai qing li ta 。]

english: The design's a secret; even if someone tried to copy it, they'd never get it quite right. I bet their machine would break down all the time.
translation: 设计是一个秘密；即使有人试图复制它，他们也永远不会完全正确。我敢打赌他们的机器会一直出故障。 [she ji shi yi ge mi mi ； ji shi you ren shi tu fu zhi ta ， ta men ye yong yuan bu hui wan quan zheng que 。 wo gan da du ta men de ji qi hui yi zhi chu gu zhang 。]

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我就走了。 [wo jiu zou le 。]

english: Have you any ore for me?
translation: 你有矿石给我吗？ [ni you kuang shi gei wo ma ？]

english: How do I mine in this place?
translation: 在这个地方怎么挖矿？ [zai zhe ge di fang zen me wa kuang ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: What is this machine?
translation: 这台机器是什么？ [zhe tai ji qi shi shen me ？]

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我就走了。 [wo jiu zou le 。]

english: I seek a piece of the map to the island of Crandor.
translation: 我寻找一张克兰多岛的地图。 [wo xun zhao yi zhang ke lan duo dao de di tu 。]

english: The map's behind a door below, but entering is rather tough. This is what you need to know: You must use the following stuff.
translation: 地图在下面的一扇门后面，但进入相当困难。这是您需要知道的：您必须使用以下内容。 [di tu zai xia mian de yi shan men hou mian ， dan jin ru xiang dang kun nan 。 zhe shi nin xu yao zhi dao de ： nin bi xu shi yong yi xia nei rong 。]

english: First, a drink used by a mage. Next, some worm string, changed to sheet. Then, a small crustacean cage. Last, a bowl that's not seen heat.
translation: 首先是法师使用的饮料。接下来，一些虫绳，改为片状。然后是一个小甲壳动物笼。最后，一碗未见热的碗。 [shou xian shi fa shi shi yong de yin liao 。 jie xia lai ， yi xie chong sheng ， gai wei pian zhuang 。 ran hou shi yi ge xiao jia qiao dong wu long 。 zui hou ， yi wan wei jian re de wan 。]

english: (same as below)
translation: （下同） [（ xia tong ）]

english: Can you impart your wise knowledge to me, O Oracle?
translation: 神谕啊，你能将你的智慧知识传授给我吗？ [shen yu a ， ni neng jiang ni de zhi hui zhi shi chuan shou gei wo ma ？]

english: Capes are always in fashion!
translation: 斗篷永远是时尚！ [dou peng yong yuan shi shi shang ！]

english: The light at the end of the tunnel is the demon-infested lava pit.
translation: 隧道尽头的光亮就是恶魔出没的熔岩坑。 [sui dao jin tou de guang liang jiu shi e mo chu mo de rong yan keng 。]

english: Beware the cabbage: it is both green AND leafy.
translation: 当心卷心菜：它既是绿色的又是多叶的。 [dang xin juan xin cai ： ta ji shi lv se de you shi duo ye de 。]

english: They say that ham does not mix well with other kinds of meat.
translation: 他们说火腿与其他肉类不能很好地混合。 [ta men shuo huo tui yu qi ta rou lei bu neng hen hao di hun he 。]

english: A woodchuck does not chuck wood.
translation: 土拨鼠不会扔木头。 [tu bo shu bu hui reng mu tou 。]

english: No. I'm not in the mood.
translation: 不，我没心情。 [bu ， wo mei xin qing 。]

english: It's not you; it's me.
translation: 不是你；这就是我。 [bu shi ni ； zhe jiu shi wo 。]

english: Too many cooks spoil the anchovy pizza.
translation: 太多的厨师破坏了凤尾鱼披萨。 [tai duo de chu shi po huai le feng wei yu pi sa 。]

english: The God Wars are over...as long as the thing they were fighting over remains hidden.
translation: 诸神之战就结束了……只要他们争夺的东西仍然隐藏着。 [zhu shen zhi zhan jiu jie shu le …… zhi yao ta men zheng duo de dong xi reng ran yin cang zhe 。]

english: He who uses the power of custard mixes it with his tears.
translation: 使用奶油冻力量的人将其与眼泪混合。 [shi yong nai you dong li liang de ren jiang qi yu yan lei hun he 。]

english: Nothing like a tasty fish.
translation: 没有什么比美味的鱼更好的了。 [mei you shen me bi mei wei de yu geng hao de le 。]

english: Don't judge a book by its cover - judge it on its' grammar and, punctuation.
translation: 不要以封面来判断一本书——要根据它的语法和标点符号来判断它。 [bu yao yi feng mian lai pan duan yi ben shu —— yao gen ju ta de yu fa he biao dian fu hao lai pan duan ta 。]

english: Yes, I can. But I'm not going to.
translation: 是的，我可以。但我不会。 [shi de ， wo ke yi 。 dan wo bu hui 。]

english: A bird in the hand can make a tasty snack.
translation: 一只鸟在手，可以做成美味的小吃。 [yi zhi niao zai shou ， ke yi zuo cheng mei wei de xiao chi 。]

english: Pies...they're great, aren't they?
translation: 馅饼……很棒，不是吗？ [xian bing …… hen bang ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Who guards the guardsmen?
translation: 谁来守护卫兵？ [shui lai shou hu wei bing ？]

english: The great snake of Guthix guards more than she knows.
translation: 古斯克斯巨蛇所守护的东西比她所知道的还要多。 [gu si ke si ju she suo shou hu de dong xi bi ta suo zhi dao de hai yao duo 。]

english: Do not fear the dragons...fear their kin.
translation: 不要害怕龙...害怕他们的亲属。 [bu yao hai pa long ... hai pa ta men de qin shu 。]

english: Everyone you know will one day be dead.
translation: 你认识的每个人有一天都会死去。 [ni ren shi de mei ge ren you yi tian du hui si qu 。]

english: If a tree falls in the forest and no one is around, then nobody gets Woodcutting xp.
translation: 如果一棵树倒在森林里并且周围没有人，那么就没有人获得伐木经验。 [ru guo yi ke shu dao zai sen lin li bing qie zhou wei mei you ren ， na me jiu mei you ren huo de fa mu jing yan 。]

english: Sometimes you get lucky, sometimes you don't.
translation: 有时你很幸运，有时则不然。 [you shi ni hen xing yun ， you shi ze bu ran 。]

english: The chicken came before the egg.
translation: 先有鸡还是先有蛋。 [xian you ji hai shi xian you dan 。]

english: Is it time to wake up? I am not sure...
translation: 是时候醒来了吗？我不知道... [shi shi hou xing lai le ma ？ wo bu zhi dao ...]

english: When in Asgarnia, do as the Asgarnians do.
translation: 在阿斯伽尼亚时，请像阿斯伽尼亚人一样行事。 [zai a si ga ni ya shi ， qing xiang a si ga ni ya ren yi yang xing shi 。]

english: An answer is unimportant; it is the question that matters.
translation: 答案并不重要；重要的是。这是重要的问题。 [da an bing bu zhong yao ； zhong yao de shi 。 zhe shi zhong yao de wen ti 。]

english: The goblins will never make up their minds on their own.
translation: 妖精们永远不会自己做决定。 [yao jing men yong yuan bu hui zi ji zuo jue ding 。]

english: Jas left a stone behind.
translation: 贾斯留下了一块石头。 [jia si liu xia le yi kuai shi tou 。]

english: Many secrets are buried under this land.
translation: 这片土地下埋藏着许多秘密。 [zhe pian tu di xia mai cang zhe xu duo mi mi 。]

english: There are no crisps at the party.
translation: 聚会上没有薯片。 [ju hui shang mei you shu pian 。]

english: Help wanted? Enquire within.
translation: 把招工广告？向内询问。 [ba zhao gong guang gao ？ xiang nei xun wen 。]

english: I've got a little challenge for you.
translation: 我有一个小挑战要给你。 [wo you yi ge xiao tiao zhan yao gei ni 。]

english: OK...
translation: 好的... [hao de ...]

english: Can you answer this for me please.
translation: 你能帮我回答这个问题吗？ [ni neng bang wo hui da zhe ge wen ti ma ？]

english: The Oracle has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 神谕者给了你一个挑战卷轴！ [shen yu zhe gei le ni yi ge tiao zhan juan zhou ！]

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。 [qing shu ru wen ti de da an 。]

english: That's wrong I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕这是错误的。 [kong pa zhe shi cuo wu de 。]

english: That's right, well done!
translation: 没错，干得好！ [mei cuo ， gan de hao ！]

english: The Oracle has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 神谕者给了你另一条线索卷轴！ [shen yu zhe gei le ni ling yi tiao xian suo juan zhou ！]

english: I've got a message for you from the Wise Old Man who lives in Draynor Village.
translation: 我收到了住在德拉诺村的智者老人给你的消息。 [wo shou dao le zhu zai de la nuo cun de zhi zhe lao ren gei ni de xiao xi 。]

english: Many do my wisdom seek; few do their own wisdom to me send!
translation: 我的智慧寻求许多；少做自己的智慧给我送！ [wo de zhi hui xun qiu xu duo ； shao zuo zi ji de zhi hui gei wo song ！]

english: It doesn't look like you have space for your reward. Come back later when you do.
translation: 看起来你没有足够的空间来获得奖励。等你回来的时候再来吧。 [kan qi lai ni mei you zu gou de kong jian lai huo de jiang li 。 deng ni hui lai de shi hou zai lai ba 。]

english: New life from these shall perchance spring!
translation: 新的生命也许会从这些中涌现！ [xin de sheng ming ye xu hui cong zhe xie zhong yong xian ！]

english: I seek a piece of the map to the island of Crandor.
translation: 我寻找一张克兰多岛的地图。 [wo xun zhao yi zhang ke lan duo dao de di tu 。]

english: Can you impart your wise knowledge to me, O Oracle?
translation: 神谕啊，你能将你的智慧知识传授给我吗？ [shen yu a ， ni neng jiang ni de zhi hui zhi shi chuan shou gei wo ma ？]

english: Are you here to smith? Do you want to buy some ore?
translation: 你是来史密斯的吗？你想买一些矿石吗？ [ni shi lai shi mi si de ma ？ ni xiang mai yi xie kuang shi ma ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Well don't waste my time then!
translation: 那就别浪费我的时间了！ [na jiu bie lang fei wo de shi jian le ！]

english: Thanks, I'll send them to storage.
translation: 谢谢，我会把它们送到仓库。 [xie xie ， wo hui ba ta men song dao cang ku 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: You look a bit shady, if I do say so myself.
translation: 如果我自己这么说的话，你看起来有点阴暗。 [ru guo wo zi ji zhe me shuo de hua ， ni kan qi lai you dian yin an 。]

english: Well that's the nicest thing anyone has ever said to me!
translation: 嗯，这是任何人对我说过的最好听的话！ [n ， zhe shi ren he ren dui wo shuo guo de zui hao ting de hua ！]

english: The name's Oriana. Nice to meet ya!
translation: 我的名字叫奥莉安娜。很高兴认识你！ [wo de ming zi jiao ao li an na 。 hen gao xing ren shi ni ！]

english: Oriana shakes your hand with a strong and aggressive grip. She also tries to get inside your pockets...
translation: 奥丽安娜用力、咄咄逼人地握着你的手。她还试图进入你的口袋...... [ao li an na yong li 、 duo duo bi ren di wo zhe ni de shou 。 ta hai shi tu jin ru ni de kou dai ......]

english: Hey, I saw that!
translation: 嘿，我看到了！ [hei ， wo kan dao le ！]

english: Sorry... Force of 'abit.
translation: 抱歉...有点力气。 [bao qian ... you dian li qi 。]

english: Right... Well I'm [player name]. What is it you do around here?
translation: 是的...好吧，我是[玩家姓名]。你在这附近做什么？ [shi de ... hao ba ， wo shi [ wan jia xing ming ]。 ni zai zhe fu jin zuo shen me ？]

english: Well I'm the best thief to ever live, ain't I.
translation: 好吧，我是有史以来最好的小偷，不是吗？ [hao ba ， wo shi you shi yi lai zui hao de xiao tou ， bu shi ma ？]

english: This place is filled to the brim with wealthy folk with lots of pricey stuff. It's all prime for the takin'.
translation: 这个地方挤满了有钱人，有很多昂贵的东西。这一切都是最适合采取的。 [zhe ge di fang ji man le you qian ren ， you hen duo ang gui de dong xi 。 zhe yi qie dou shi zui shi he cai qu de 。]

english: Now what can I do for you?
translation: 现在我能为你做什么？ [xian zai wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: Do you know what these keys are for?
translation: 你知道这些钥匙的用途吗？ [ni zhi dao zhe xie yao shi de yong tu ma ？]

english: Let me take a look.
translation: 让我看一下。 [rang wo kan yi xia 。]

english: Those are keys to the houses round 'ere.
translation: 这些是附近房子的钥匙。 [zhe xie shi fu jin fang zi de yao shi 。]

english: Oh, so I can just waltz right in?
translation: 哦，那我可以直接跳华尔兹了吗？ [o ， na wo ke yi zhi jie tiao hua er zi le ma ？]

english: Essentially yes! Though the keys you showed me look a bit old. I'd try to find as many as you can just in case they break.
translation: 本质上是的！虽然你给我看的钥匙看起来有点旧。我会尽力找到尽可能多的，以防万一它们坏了。 [ben zhi shang shi de ！ sui ran ni gei wo kan de yao shi kan qi lai you dian jiu 。 wo hui jin li zhao dao jin ke neng duo de ， yi fang wan yi ta men huai le 。]

english: Can you tell me more about these rich folk?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于这些富人的事吗？ [ni neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu zhe xie fu ren de shi ma ？]

english: Yes I can. Some 'ave got houses full of loot, while others spend their days at the bazaar. What do you want to know?
translation: 是的，我可以。有些人的房子里装满了战利品，而另一些人则整天在集市上度过。你想知道什么？ [shi de ， wo ke yi 。 you xie ren de fang zi li zhuang man le zhan li pin ， er ling yi xie ren ze zheng tian zai ji shi shang du guo 。 ni xiang zhi dao shen me ？]

english: Tell me about the houses.
translation: 告诉我关于房子的事。 [gao su wo guan yu fang zi de shi 。]

english: Some of them round here are filled with loot for sure. They've got so many bits and bobs, trinkets and doodads, that they 'ardly ever notice they've been robbed.
translation: 这里的一些地方肯定装满了战利品。他们有太多的小东西、小饰品和小玩意，以至于他们几乎没有注意到自己被抢劫了。 [zhe li de yi xie di fang ken ding zhuang man le zhan li pin 。 ta men you tai duo de xiao dong xi 、 xiao shi pin he xiao wan yi ， yi zhi yu ta men ji hu mei you zhu yi dao zi ji bei qiang jie le 。]

english: You rob them?
translation: 你抢劫他们？ [ni qiang jie ta men ？]

english: Oh yes.
translation: 哦是的。 [o shi de 。]

english: How do you manage that?
translation: 你是如何做到这一点的？ [ni shi ru he zuo dao zhe yi dian de ？]

english: First we get keys for these houses, which are always conveniently under the doormat.
translation: 首先，我们拿到这些房子的钥匙，钥匙总是放在门垫下面，很方便。 [shou xian ， wo men na dao zhe xie fang zi de yao shi ， yao shi zong shi fang zai men dian xia mian ， hen fang bian 。]

english: Are you serious? It's that easy?
translation: 你是认真的？有那么容易吗？ [ni shi ren zhen de ？ you na me rong yi ma ？]

english: Ha... No. I was just pulling your leg.
translation: 哈...不，我只是在开你的玩笑。 [ha ... bu ， wo zhi shi zai kai ni de wan xiao 。]

english: You'll 'ave to steal the house keys from the citizens.
translation: 你必须从居民那里偷走房子的钥匙。 [ni bi xu cong ju min na li tou zou fang zi de yao shi 。]

english: All these wealthy folk buy and sell property like it's nothing, so they 'ave plenty of spare keys to go round.
translation: 所有这些富人买卖房产时都视若无物，因此他们有足够的备用钥匙可以使用。 [suo you zhe xie fu ren mai mai fang chan shi dou shi ruo wu wu ， yin ci ta men you zu gou de bei yong yao shi ke yi shi yong 。]

english: So how do you steal them?
translation: 那么你如何窃取它们呢？ [na me ni ru he qie qu ta men ne ？]

english: We pick their pockets of course. I 'ave some of my crew in the bazaar. If you fancy gettin' involved, they might help you out every now and then.
translation: 我们当然会扒他们的口袋。我的一些手下在集市上。如果您想参与其中，他们可能会时不时地为您提供帮助。 [wo men dang ran hui ba ta men de kou dai 。 wo de yi xie shou xia zai ji shi shang 。 ru guo nin xiang can yu qi zhong ， ta men ke neng hui shi bu shi di wei nin ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: Once you 'ave a key, you can break into a house. Not any ol' house though. It must be one that's ready to be robbed.
translation: 一旦你有了钥匙，你就可以闯入房子。但不是任何老房子。肯定是已经做好被抢劫的准备了。 [yi dan ni you le yao shi ， ni jiu ke yi chuang ru fang zi 。 dan bu shi ren he lao fang zi 。 ken ding shi yi jing zuo hao bei qiang jie de zhun bei le 。]

english: The street urchins that roam the streets keep tabs on which houses are vulnerable.
translation: 街头顽童在街上游荡，密切关注哪些房屋容易受到攻击。 [jie tou wan tong zai jie shang you dang ， mi qie guan zhu na xie fang wu rong yi shou dao gong ji 。]

english: Once you know a house is vulnerable, wait for the owner to leave. Then just simply use your key to get in and steal to your heart's content!
translation: 一旦你知道房子很脆弱，就等待主人离开。然后只需使用您的钥匙即可进入并尽情窃取！ [yi dan ni zhi dao fang zi hen cui ruo ， jiu deng dai zhu ren li kai 。 ran hou zhi xu shi yong nin de yao shi ji ke jin ru bing jin qing qie qu ！]

english: But whatever you do, dont get caught!
translation: 但无论你做什么，都不要被抓住！ [dan wu lun ni zuo shen me ， dou bu yao bei zhua zhu ！]

english: So... steal keys, use keys on the houses that are ready to be robbed, make buckets of cash and don't be caught?
translation: 那么……偷钥匙，在准备被抢劫的房子上使用钥匙，赚大钱而不被抓到？ [na me …… tou yao shi ， zai zhun bei bei qiang jie de fang zi shang shi yong yao shi ， zhuan da qian er bu bei zhua dao ？]

english: That's it!
translation: 就是这样！ [jiu shi zhe yang ！]

english: If you're not sure where to begin, chat to the urchins in my crew posted round the houses. They'll help you find the next one to plunder.
translation: 如果你不确定从哪里开始，可以和我在房子周围的工作人员中的顽童聊天。他们会帮助你找到下一个要掠夺的东西。 [ru guo ni bu que ding cong na li kai shi ， ke yi he wo zai fang zi zhou wei de gong zuo ren yuan zhong de wan tong liao tian 。 ta men hui bang zhu ni zhao dao xia yi ge yao lve duo de dong xi 。]

english: Though it might come at a price.
translation: 尽管这可能是有代价的。 [jin guan zhe ke neng shi you dai jia de 。]

english: Tell me about the bazaar.
translation: 告诉我关于集市的事。 [gao su wo guan yu ji shi de shi 。]

english: Some of the wealthiest citizens in Varlamore shop in the bazaar and nearby. A perfect place to pick some pockets!
translation: 瓦尔拉莫尔的一些最富有的公民在集市和附近购物。一个掏腰包的好地方！ [wa er la mo er de yi xie zui fu you de gong min zai ji shi he fu jin gou wu 。 yi ge tao yao bao de hao di fang ！]

english: Surely it's not so easy though?
translation: 当然，这并不那么容易？ [dang ran ， zhe bing bu na me rong yi ？]

english: You'd be right about that. If it were easy to steal from 'em, they wouldn't be so rich, would they?
translation: 你是对的。如果很容易从他们身上偷东西，他们就不会那么富有了，不是吗？ [ni shi dui de 。 ru guo hen rong yi cong ta men shen shang tou dong xi ， ta men jiu bu hui na me fu you le ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Sounds like you might have some tips?
translation: 听起来你可能有一些建议？ [ting qi lai ni ke neng you yi xie jian yi ？]

english: Some of the street urchins in my crew hang around in the bazaar and on the outskirts. They might be able to provide some sort of distraction.
translation: 我团队中的一些街头顽童在集市和郊区闲逛。他们也许能够提供某种干扰。 [wo tuan dui zhong de yi xie jie tou wan tong zai ji shi he jiao qu xian guang 。 ta men ye xu neng gou ti gong mou zhong gan rao 。]

english: They do it just out of the goodness of their heart?
translation: 他们这样做只是出于内心的善良吗？ [ta men zhe yang zuo zhi shi chu yu nei xin de shan liang ma ？]

english: You're funny, [player name].
translation: 你很有趣，[玩家名字]。 [ni hen you qu ，[ wan jia ming zi ]。]

english: They get a cut in all the wealth we make.
translation: 他们从我们创造的所有财富中分得一杯羹。 [ta men cong wo men chuang zao de suo you cai fu zhong fen de yi bei geng 。]

english: Can I get a cut?
translation: 我可以剪吗？ [wo ke yi jian ma ？]

english: Cheeky! You're lucky I don't steal from you right now!
translation: 厚脸皮！你真幸运，我现在没有偷你的东西！ [hou lian pi ！ ni zhen xing yun ， wo xian zai mei you tou ni de dong xi ！]

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: See you later.
translation: 稍后见。 [shao hou jian 。]

english: Do you work alone?
translation: 你一个人工作吗？ [ni yi ge ren gong zuo ma ？]

english: Nah! I 'ave a network of spies and pickpockets that roam the city. You might've seen 'em?
translation: 不！我的间谍和扒手网络在城里游荡。你可能见过他们？ [bu ！ wo de jian die he pa shou wang luo zai cheng li you dang 。 ni ke neng jian guo ta men ？]

english: Seen them? Not sure I have.
translation: 看到他们了吗？不确定我有。 [kan dao ta men le ma ？ bu que ding wo you 。]

english: Hidden in plain sight. Perfect! Well it's all the street urchins of course. You can tell if they are part of my crew by the purple sash around their waist.
translation: 隐藏在众目睽睽之下。完美的！好吧，当然都是街头顽童。你可以通过他们腰间的紫色腰带判断他们是否是我的船员。 [yin cang zai zhong mu kui kui zhi xia 。 wan mei de ！ hao ba ， dang ran dou shi jie tou wan tong 。 ni ke yi tong guo ta men yao jian de zi se yao dai pan duan ta men shi fou shi wo de chuan yuan 。]

english: Most of them lost their parents to the Colosseum, hoping to get glory for their family. The Colosseum 'owever, had other plans...
translation: 他们中的大多数人在斗兽场失去了父母，希望为家人赢得荣耀。然而，罗马斗兽场却另有计划…… [ta men zhong de da duo shu ren zai dou shou chang shi qu le fu mu ， xi wang wei jia ren ying de rong yao 。 ran er ， luo ma dou shou chang que ling you ji hua ……]

english: That's awful.
translation: 太糟糕了。 [tai zao gao le 。]

english: It really is. They had nowhere to go and no food to eat, so I offered them a home, food, and all the gold they would ever need to 'ave a good life.
translation: 确实如此。他们无处可去，也没有食物可吃，所以我为他们提供了一个家、食物以及他们“过上美好生活”所需的所有黄金。 [que shi ru ci 。 ta men wu chu ke qu ， ye mei you shi wu ke chi ， suo yi wo wei ta men ti gong le yi ge jia 、 shi wu yi ji ta men “ guo shang mei hao sheng huo ” suo xu de suo you huang jin 。]

english: No one suspects them, which makes them perfect spies.
translation: 没有人怀疑他们，这使他们成为完美的间谍。 [mei you ren huai yi ta men ， zhe shi ta men cheng wei wan mei de jian die 。]

english: Can they help me in anyway?
translation: 无论如何，他们能帮助我吗？ [wu lun ru he ， ta men neng bang zhu wo ma ？]

english: Yes they can! Some in the residential area will point out houses free to rob, and some will be in and around the bazaar, distracting the wealthy citizens.
translation: 是的，他们可以！有些在住宅区会指出房屋可以被抢劫，有些会在集市内和周围，分散富裕公民的注意力。 [shi de ， ta men ke yi ！ you xie zai zhu zhai qu hui zhi chu fang wu ke yi bei qiang jie ， you xie hui zai ji shi nei he zhou wei ， fen san fu yu gong min de zhu yi li 。]

english: Well that's handy.
translation: 嗯，这很方便。 [n ， zhe hen fang bian 。]

english: It sure is, but give them any trouble, and I'll throw you in the Colosseum myself.
translation: 确实如此，但如果给他们带来任何麻烦，我就会亲自把你扔进斗兽场。 [que shi ru ci ， dan ru guo gei ta men dai lai ren he ma fan ， wo jiu hui qin zi ba ni reng jin dou shou chang 。]

english: Understood.
translation: 明白了。 [ming bai le 。]

english: What's your story?
translation: 你的故事是什么？ [ni de gu shi shi shen me ？]

english: Not much to tell really.
translation: 真的没什么好说的。 [zhen de mei shen me hao shuo de 。]

english: I was an orphan, much like these street urchins you see around the city. I spent my days running around scrounging for food and struggling to find somewhere to sleep.
translation: 我是个孤儿，就像你在城市里看到的这些街头顽童一样。我整天都在四处寻找食物并努力寻找睡觉的地方。 [wo shi ge gu er ， jiu xiang ni zai cheng shi li kan dao de zhe xie jie tou wan tong yi yang 。 wo zheng tian dou zai si chu xun zhao shi wu bing nu li xun zhao shui jiao de di fang 。]

english: Eventually, I turned to a life of crime and thievery. Turns out I'm quite good at it.
translation: 最终，我转向了犯罪和盗窃的生活。事实证明我很擅长。 [zui zhong ， wo zhuan xiang le fan zui he dao qie de sheng huo 。 shi shi zheng ming wo hen shan chang 。]

english: I took refuge in a small spot in the north east of the city. Out of sight, out of mind.
translation: 我在城市东北部的一个小地方避难。眼不见心不烦。 [wo zai cheng shi dong bei bu de yi ge xiao di fang bi nan 。 yan bu jian xin bu fan 。]

english: There I met with other orphans just like me. We all wanted payback. Payback on the city for forgetting about us.
translation: 在那里我遇到了其他像我一样的孤儿。我们都想要回报。这座城市忘记我们的回报。 [zai na li wo yu dao le qi ta xiang wo yi yang de gu er 。 wo men dou xiang yao hui bao 。 zhe zuo cheng shi wang ji wo men de hui bao 。]

english: I'm sure there are better places for you and your crew to find refuge outside of the city. Even outside of Varlamore.
translation: 我确信您和您的船员在城外有更好的避难所。即使在瓦拉莫尔之外。 [wo que xin nin he nin de chuan yuan zai cheng wai you geng hao de bi nan suo 。 ji shi zai wa la mo er zhi wai 。]

english: That may be the case, [player name], but I can't in good conscience leave any of the folk here who are struggling. I swore to help anyone in need.
translation: 情况可能是这样，[玩家姓名]，但我不能凭良心离开这里任何一个正在挣扎的人。我发誓要帮助任何有需要的人。 [qing kuang ke neng shi zhe yang ，[ wan jia xing ming ]， dan wo bu neng ping liang xin li kai zhe li ren he yi ge zheng zai zheng zha de ren 。 wo fa shi yao bang zhu ren he you xu yao de ren 。]

english: While the Colosseum still stands, family greed for glory will cost people. Some just their livelihoods, others their lives!
translation: 虽然罗马斗兽场仍然矗立，但家族对荣耀的贪婪会让人们付出代价。有的只是他们的生计，有的则是他们的生命！ [sui ran luo ma dou shou chang reng ran chu li ， dan jia zu dui rong yao de tan lan hui rang ren men fu chu dai jia 。 you de zhi shi ta men de sheng ji ， you de ze shi ta men de sheng ming ！]

english: So you really want to make a difference?
translation: 那么你真的想有所作为吗？ [na me ni zhen de xiang you suo zuo wei ma ？]

english: Well don't get me wrong, I still want to get filthy stinking rich as well!
translation: 好吧，别误会我的意思，我也想变得非常富有！ [hao ba ， bie wu hui wo de yi si ， wo ye xiang bian de fei chang fu you ！]

english: Don't we all...
translation: 难道我们都... [nan dao wo men dou ...]

english: Managed to steal anything yet?
translation: 成功偷东西了吗？ [cheng gong tou dong xi le ma ？]

english: I have actually! I've found these valuables from some of the houses.
translation: 我其实有！我从一些房子里找到了这些贵重物品。 [wo qi shi you ！ wo cong yi xie fang zi li zhao dao le zhe xie gui zhong wu pin 。]

english: Want some coin for those? I'll give you a good deal... One coin a piece.
translation: 想要一些硬币吗？我会给你一个好价钱...一个硬币一个。 [xiang yao yi xie ying bi ma ？ wo hui gei ni yi ge hao jia qian ... yi ge ying bi yi ge 。]

english: One measly coin? That hardly seems worth it.
translation: 一枚微不足道的硬币？这似乎不值得。 [yi mei wei bu zu dao de ying bi ？ zhe si hu bu zhi de 。]

translation: 哦不，但作为一个制作小型软体生物的人，这就是你该去的地方。 [o bu ， dan zuo wei yi ge zhi zuo xiao xing ruan ti sheng wu de ren ， zhe jiu shi ni gai qu de di fang 。]

english: These books and the hunters' reports all contain lovely details about my subject matter. I might never leave!
translation: 这些书和猎人的报告都包含有关我的主题的可爱细节。我可能永远不会离开！ [zhe xie shu he lie ren de bao gao dou bao han you guan wo de zhu ti de ke ai xi jie 。 wo ke neng yong yuan bu hui li kai ！]

english: I'd imagine this is the place to be for materials too. These hunters seem to find everything!
translation: 我想这也是存放材料的地方。这些猎人似乎找到了一切！ [wo xiang zhe ye shi cun fang cai liao de di fang 。 zhe xie lie ren si hu zhao dao le yi qie ！]

english: The cat is a great way to stress test some of the stitching too. He loves having something to play with!
translation: 猫也是对一些缝合进行压力测试的好方法。他喜欢有东西玩！ [mao ye shi dui yi xie feng he jin xing ya li ce shi de hao fang fa 。 ta xi huan you dong xi wan ！]

english: Silver! Silver! Best prices for buying and selling in all Prifddinas!
translation: 银！银！在所有Prifddinas 购买和销售的最优惠价格！ [yin ！ yin ！ zai suo you Prifddinas  gou mai he xiao shou de zui you hui jia ge ！]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: You stole from me. Talk to me when you've considered your actions!
translation: 你偷了我的东西。当你考虑过你的行为后跟我说话！ [ni tou le wo de dong xi 。 dang ni kao lv guo ni de xing wei hou gen wo shuo hua ！]

english: You're the one who stole something from me!
translation: 你就是偷了我东西的人！ [ni jiu shi tou le wo dong xi de ren ！]

english: Guards guards!
translation: 卫兵卫兵！ [wei bing wei bing ！]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello, I am Osman. With what can I assist you?
translation: 你好，我是奥斯曼。我能为您提供什么帮助？ [ni hao ， wo shi ao si man 。 wo neng wei nin ti gong shen me bang zhu ？]

english: You don't seem very tough. Who are you?
translation: 你看起来不太坚强。你是谁？ [ni kan qi lai bu tai jian qiang 。 ni shi shui ？]

english: I am in the employ of the Emir. That is all you need to know.
translation: 我是埃米尔的雇员。这就是您需要知道的全部。 [wo shi ai mi er de gu yuan 。 zhe jiu shi nin xu yao zhi dao de quan bu 。]

english: I hear wild rumours about a prince.
translation: 我听到关于王子的疯狂谣言。 [wo ting dao guan yu wang zi de feng kuang yao yan 。]

english: The prince is not here. He is...away. If you can be trusted, speak to the chancellor, Hassan.
translation: 王子不在。他……走了。如果你值得信任，请与财政大臣哈桑谈谈。 [wang zi bu zai 。 ta …… zou le 。 ru guo ni zhi de xin ren ， qing yu cai zheng da chen ha sang tan tan 。]

english: I am just being nosy.
translation: 我只是多管闲事。 [wo zhi shi duo guan xian shi 。]

english: That bothers me not. The secrets of Al-Kharid protect themselves.
translation: 这并不困扰我。 Al-Kharid 的秘密保护着自己。 [zhe bing bu kun rao wo 。 Al-Kharid  de mi mi bao hu zhe zi ji 。]

english: Well done. A great rescue. I will remember you if I have anything dangerous to do.
translation: 干得好。一次伟大的救援。如果我有什么危险的事情要做，我会记得你。 [gan de hao 。 yi ci wei da de jiu yuan 。 ru guo wo you shen me wei xian de shi qing yao zuo ， wo hui ji de ni 。]

english: I want to talk to you about Sophanem.
translation: 我想和你谈谈索法内姆。 [wo xiang he ni tan tan suo fa nei mu 。]

english: Hi, Osman! How are you doing?
translation: 嗨，奥斯曼！你好吗？ [hai ， ao si man ！ ni hao ma ？]

english: My wounds are healing slowly but I think I'll make a full recovery.
translation: 我的伤口正在慢慢愈合，但我想我会完全康复。 [wo de shang kou zheng zai man man yu he ， dan wo xiang wo hui wan quan kang fu 。]

english: How is Maisa? Is she back in Al Kharid?
translation: 麦莎怎么样了？她回到阿尔卡里德了吗？ [mai sha zen me yang le ？ ta hui dao a er ka li de le ma ？]

english: Maisa is fine. Where she is or what she's doing, I couldn't possibly tell you.
translation: 麦莎还好。她在哪里或者她在做什么，我不可能告诉你。 [mai sha hai hao 。 ta zai na li huo zhe ta zai zuo shen me ， wo bu ke neng gao su ni 。]

english: One piece of espionage gossip I can tell you is that I won't be returning to Sophanem or Menaphos any time soon.
translation: 我可以告诉你的一则间谍流言是，我不会很快返回索法纳姆或梅纳福斯。 [wo ke yi gao su ni de yi ze jian die liu yan shi ， wo bu hui hen kuai fan hui suo fa na mu huo mei na fu si 。]

english: Is there anything else with which I can help you?
translation: 还有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [hai you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

english: I've heard that some of the shopkeepers have been threatened!
translation: 听说有的店主受到了威胁！ [ting shuo you de dian zhu shou dao le wei xie ！]

english: We are aware of this. The elite guard will protect them from any harm.
translation: 我们知道这一点。精英守卫会保护他们免受任何伤害。 [wo men zhi dao zhe yi dian 。 jing ying shou wei hui bao hu ta men mian shou ren he shang hai 。]

english: Glad to hear it.
translation: 很高兴听到这个消息。 [hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi 。]

english: Do you know anything about Keris, the dagger I recovered in the course of my last mission?
translation: 你知道关于我在上次任务中找回的匕首的事吗？ [ni zhi dao guan yu wo zai shang ci ren wu zhong zhao hui de bi shou de shi ma ？]

english: We discovered a stash of them in some of our investigations. As far as we have been able to determine, it was created by worshippers of Elidinis in order to smite the followers of Scabaras.
translation: 我们在一些调查中发现了其中的藏匿处。据我们所知，它是由埃利迪尼斯的崇拜者创造的，目的是为了打击斯卡巴拉斯的追随者。 [wo men zai yi xie diao cha zhong fa xian le qi zhong de cang ni chu 。 ju wo men suo zhi ， ta shi you ai li di ni si de chong bai zhe chuang zao de ， mu di shi wei le da ji si ka ba la si de zhui sui zhe 。]

english: So what is so good about them?
translation: 那么他们到底有什么好处呢？ [na me ta men dao di you shen me hao chu ne ？]

english: They are specially enchanted against both scarab creatures and kalphites...which is odd, since we thought the two races to be entirely different. Any more details you'll have to discover yourself by using it in the field.
translation: 他们对圣甲虫生物和卡尔菲特生物特别着迷……这很奇怪，因为我们认为这两个种族完全不同。更多细节您必须通过在现场使用它来自己发现。 [ta men dui sheng jia chong sheng wu he ka er fei te sheng wu te bie zhao mi …… zhe hen qi guai ， yin wei wo men ren wei zhe liang ge zhong zu wan quan bu tong 。 geng duo xi jie nin bi xu tong guo zai xian chang shi yong ta lai zi ji fa xian 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: I have some sq'irk juice for you.
translation: 我有一些果汁给你。 [wo you yi xie guo zhi gei ni 。]

english: Osman imparts some Thieving advice to you ([amount] Thieving experience points) as a reward for the sq'irk juice.
translation: 奥斯曼向你传授一些盗贼建议（[数量]盗贼经验值）作为对sq'irk果汁的奖励。 [ao si man xiang ni chuan shou yi xie dao zei jian yi （[ shu liang ] dao zei jing yan zhi ） zuo wei dui sq'irk guo zhi de jiang li 。]

english: Thank you very much [player name]. If you get some more sq'irks be sure to come back.
translation: 非常感谢你[玩家姓名]。如果你再收到一些奇怪的声音，一定要回来。 [fei chang gan xie ni [ wan jia xing ming ]。 ru guo ni zai shou dao yi xie qi guai de sheng yin ， yi ding yao hui lai 。]

english: I will. It's been a pleasure doing business with you.
translation: 我会。很高兴与您开展业务。 [wo hui 。 hen gao xing yu nin kai zhan ye wu 。]

english: I'd like to talk about sq'irks.
translation: 我想谈谈 sq'irks。 [wo xiang tan tan  sq'irks。]

english: Where am I meant to find sq'irks?
translation: 我该去哪里寻找sq'irks？ [wo gai qu na li xun zhao sq'irks？]

english: There is a sorceress near the south-eastern edge of Al Kharid who grows them. Once upon a time, we considered each other friends.
translation: 在阿尔卡里德东南边缘附近有一位女术士种植它们。曾几何时，我们视彼此为朋友。 [zai a er ka li de dong nan bian yuan fu jin you yi wei nv shu shi zhong zhi ta men 。 ceng ji he shi ， wo men shi bi ci wei peng you 。]

english: What happened?
translation: 发生了什么？ [fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: We fell out, and now she won't give me any more fruit.
translation: 我们闹翻了，现在她不再给我水果了。 [wo men nao fan le ， xian zai ta bu zai gei wo shui guo le 。]

english: So all I have to do is ask her for some fruit for you?
translation: 所以我只要向她要一些水果给你就可以了？ [suo yi wo zhi yao xiang ta yao yi xie shui guo gei ni jiu ke yi le ？]

english: I doubt it will be that easy. She is not renowned for her generosity and is very secretive about her garden's location.
translation: 我怀疑事情会那么容易。她并不以慷慨而闻名，而且对她花园的位置也非常保密。 [wo huai yi shi qing hui na me rong yi 。 ta bing bu yi kang kai er wen ming ， er qie dui ta hua yuan de wei zhi ye fei chang bao mi 。]

english: Oh come on, it should be easy enough to find.
translation: 哦，来吧，应该很容易找到。 [o ， lai ba ， ying gai hen rong yi zhao dao 。]

english: Her garden has remained hidden even to me - the chief spy of Al Kharid. I believe her garden must be hidden by magical means.
translation: 她的花园甚至对我——阿尔卡里德的首席间谍来说也是隐藏的。我相信她的花园一定是用魔法隐藏起来的。 [ta de hua yuan shen zhi dui wo —— a er ka li de de shou xi jian die lai shuo ye shi yin cang de 。 wo xiang xin ta de hua yuan yi ding shi yong mo fa yin cang qi lai de 。]

english: This should be an interesting task. How many sq'irks do you want?
translation: 这应该是一个有趣的任务。你想要多少个方形？ [zhe ying gai shi yi ge you qu de ren wu 。 ni xiang yao duo shao ge fang xing ？]

english: I'll reward you for as many as you can get your hands on, but could you please squeeze the fruit into a glass first?
translation: 我会奖励你尽可能多的，但是你能先把水果挤到玻璃杯里吗？ [wo hui jiang li ni jin ke neng duo de ， dan shi ni neng xian ba shui guo ji dao bo li bei li ma ？]

english: I've another question about sq'irks.
translation: 我还有一个关于 sq'irks 的问题。 [wo hai you yi ge guan yu  sq'irks  de wen ti 。]

english: What would you like to know?
translation: 您想知道什么？ [nin xiang zhi dao shen me ？]

english: Thanks for the information.
translation: 感谢您提供信息。 [gan xie nin ti gong xin xi 。]

english: Why can't you get the sq'irks yourself?
translation: 为什么你自己不能得到sq'irks？ [wei shen me ni zi ji bu neng de dao sq'irks？]

english: I may have mentioned that I had a falling out with the Sorceress. Well, unsurprisingly, she refuses to give me any more of her garden's produce.
translation: 我可能提到过我和女巫闹翻了。嗯，不出所料，她拒绝再给我她花园里的农产品。 [wo ke neng ti dao guo wo he nv wu nao fan le 。 n ， bu chu suo liao ， ta ju jue zai gei wo ta hua yuan li de nong chan pin 。]

english: How should I squeeze the fruit?
translation: 水果应该怎么榨呢？ [shui guo ying gai zen me zha ne ？]

english: Use a pestle and mortar to squeeze the sq'irks. Make sure you have an empty glass with you to collect the juice.
translation: 使用研杵和研钵来挤压方形的。确保随身携带一个空玻璃杯来收集果汁。 [shi yong yan chu he yan bo lai ji ya fang xing de 。 que bao sui shen xie dai yi ge kong bo li bei lai shou ji guo zhi 。]

english: Is there a reward for getting these sq'irks?
translation: 获得这些sq'irks有奖励吗？ [huo de zhe xie sq'irks you jiang li ma ？]

english: Of course there is. I am a generous man. I'll teach you the art of Thieving for your troubles.
translation: 当然有。我是一个慷慨的人。我会教你偷窃的艺术来解决你的麻烦。 [dang ran you 。 wo shi yi ge kang kai de ren 。 wo hui jiao ni tou qie de yi shu lai jie jue ni de ma fan 。]

english: How much training will you give?
translation: 你会提供多少培训？ [ni hui ti gong duo shao pei xun ？]

english: That depends on the quantity and ripeness of the sq'irks you put into the juice.
translation: 这取决于您放入果汁中的果汁的数量和成熟度。 [zhe qu jue yu nin fang ru guo zhi zhong de guo zhi de shu liang he cheng shu du 。]

english: That sounds fair enough.
translation: 这听起来很公平。 [zhe ting qi lai hen gong ping 。]

english: What's so good about sq'irk juice then?
translation: 那么 sq'irk 果汁有什么好处呢？ [na me  sq'irk  guo zhi you shen me hao chu ne ？]

english: Ah it's sweet, sweet nectar for a thief or spy; it makes light fingers lighter, fleet feet flightier and comes in four different colours for those who are easily amused.
translation: 啊，对于小偷或间谍来说，这是非常非常甜蜜的花蜜；它让轻快的手指变得更轻，飞快的脚步变得更加轻快，并且有四种不同的颜色可供那些容易被逗乐的人使用。 [a ， dui yu xiao tou huo jian die lai shuo ， zhe shi fei chang fei chang tian mi de hua mi ； ta rang qing kuai de shou zhi bian de geng qing ， fei kuai de jiao bu bian de geng jia qing kuai ， bing qie you si zhong bu tong de yan se ke gong na xie rong yi bei dou le de ren shi yong 。]

english: Osman starts salivating at the thought of sq'irk juice.
translation: 奥斯曼一想到 sq'irk 果汁就开始流口水。 [ao si man yi xiang dao  sq'irk  guo zhi jiu kai shi liu kou shui 。]

english: It wouldn't have addictive properties, would it?
translation: 它不会让人上瘾，不是吗？ [ta bu hui rang ren shang yin ， bu shi ma ？]

english: It only holds power over those with poor self-control, something which I have an abundance of.
translation: 它只对那些自制力差的人有影响力，而我却拥有丰富的自制力。 [ta zhi dui na xie zi zhi li cha de ren you ying xiang li ， er wo que yong you feng fu de zi zhi li 。]

english: I see.
translation: 我懂了。 [wo dong le 。]

english: Well done. I have new information to share with you.
translation: 干得好。我有新信息要与您分享。 [gan de hao 。 wo you xin xin xi yao yu nin fen xiang 。]

english: You don't seem very tough. Who are you?
translation: 你看起来不太坚强。你是谁？ [ni kan qi lai bu tai jian qiang 。 ni shi shui ？]

english: I hear wild rumours about a prince.
translation: 我听到关于王子的疯狂谣言。 [wo ting dao guan yu wang zi de feng kuang yao yan 。]

english: I am just being nosy.
translation: 我只是多管闲事。 [wo zhi shi duo guan xian shi 。]

english: I'd like to talk about sq'irks.
translation: 我想谈谈 sq'irks。 [wo xiang tan tan  sq'irks。]

english: I want to talk to you about Sophanem.
translation: 我想和你谈谈索法内姆。 [wo xiang he ni tan tan suo fa nei mu 。]

english: Where do I get sq'irks?
translation: 我在哪里可以得到 sq'irks？ [wo zai na li ke yi de dao  sq'irks？]

english: I've another question about sq'irks.
translation: 我还有一个关于 sq'irks 的问题。 [wo hai you yi ge guan yu  sq'irks  de wen ti 。]

english: Thanks for the information.
translation: 感谢您提供信息。 [gan xie nin ti gong xin xi 。]

english: Why can't you get the sq'irks yourself?
translation: 为什么你自己不能得到sq'irks？ [wei shen me ni zi ji bu neng de dao sq'irks？]

english: How should I squeeze the fruit?
translation: 水果应该怎么榨呢？ [shui guo ying gai zen me zha ne ？]

english: Is there a reward for getting these sq'irks?
translation: 获得这些sq'irks有奖励吗？ [huo de zhe xie sq'irks you jiang li ma ？]

english: What's so good about sq'irk juice then?
translation: 那么 sq'irk 果汁有什么好处呢？ [na me  sq'irk  guo zhi you shen me hao chu ne ？]

english: As you approach the spirit, you hear a voice echoing in your head.
translation: 当你接近灵魂时，你会听到一个声音在你的脑海中回响。 [dang ni jie jin ling hun shi ， ni hui ting dao yi ge sheng yin zai ni de nao hai zhong hui xiang 。]

english: You. You fought against the Devourer. Her influence here has been lessened as a result. You are to be commended for your strength.
translation: 你。你与吞噬者作战。她在这里的影响力因此而减弱。你应该因你的力量而受到赞扬。 [ni 。 ni yu tun shi zhe zuo zhan 。 ta zai zhe li de ying xiang li yin ci er jian ruo 。 ni ying gai yin ni de li liang er shou dao zan yang 。]

english: I take it you're Osmumten?
translation: 我猜你是奥斯穆滕？ [wo cai ni shi ao si mu teng ？]

english: Once, but who I was in life means nothing. Vengeance is all that matters now. The Devourer may be gone, but my home has been corrupted. This corruption must be destroyed.
translation: 曾经，但我在生活中的身份毫无意义。现在最重要的是复仇。吞噬者也许已经消失了，但我的家园已经被腐化了。这种腐败必须被消灭。 [ceng jing ， dan wo zai sheng huo zhong de shen fen hao wu yi yi 。 xian zai zui zhong yao de shi fu chou 。 tun shi zhe ye xu yi jing xiao shi le ， dan wo de jia yuan yi jing bei fu hua le 。 zhe zhong fu bai bi xu bei xiao mie 。]

english: Can I help?
translation: 我可以帮忙吗？ [wo ke yi bang mang ma ？]

english: You can. Take your prize and leave, but when you are ready, return here. The Devourer's thralls will soon be back. You must fight them.
translation: 你可以。带着你的奖品离开，但当你准备好后，返回这里。吞噬者的奴隶很快就会回来。你必须与他们战斗。 [ni ke yi 。 dai zhe ni de jiang pin li kai ， dan dang ni zhun bei hao hou ， fan hui zhe li 。 tun shi zhe de nu li hen kuai jiu hui hui lai 。 ni bi xu yu ta men zhan dou 。]

english: I'll do what I can.
translation: 我会尽力而为。 [wo hui jin li er wei 。]

english: We shall see if it is enough.
translation: 我们将看看这是否足够。 [wo men jiang kan kan zhe shi fou zu gou 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: The Devourer's thralls will be back, but they have been weakened because of you. Your prize awaits.
translation: 吞噬者的奴隶将会回来，但他们已经因为你而被削弱了。你的奖品正在等待着。 [tun shi zhe de nu li jiang hui hui lai ， dan ta men yi jing yin wei ni er bei xue ruo le 。 ni de jiang pin zheng zai deng dai zhe 。]

english: You have done well, but it is time for you to leave. The Devourer's thralls will soon return.
translation: 你已经做得很好了，但现在是你离开的时候了。吞噬者的奴隶很快就会回归。 [ni yi jing zuo de hen hao le ， dan xian zai shi ni li kai de shi hou le 。 tun shi zhe de nu li hen kuai jiu hui hui gui 。]

english: You fought well. The Devourer's influence here has lessened, but it will soon be restored. It is time for you to leave.
translation: 你打得很好。吞噬者在这里的影响力已经减弱，但很快就会恢复。你该离开了。 [ni da de hen hao 。 tun shi zhe zai zhe li de ying xiang li yi jing jian ruo ， dan hen kuai jiu hui hui fu 。 ni gai li kai le 。]

english: We are done here, but the Devourer's thralls are everywhere. They must be removed.
translation: 我们已经完成了，但吞噬者的奴隶却无处不在。它们必须被移除。 [wo men yi jing wan cheng le ， dan tun shi zhe de nu li que wu chu bu zai 。 ta men bi xu bei yi chu 。]

english: The player gets relocated to the tombs' nexus.
translation: 玩家被重新安置到坟墓的连接处。 [wan jia bei chong xin an zhi dao fen mu de lian jie chu 。]

english: Shhh! I'm waiting for the show!
translation: 嘘！我等着看演出呢！ [xu ！ wo deng zhe kan yan chu ne ！]

english: YOU ARE A TERRIBLE BARD!
translation: 你是个糟糕的吟游诗人！ [ni shi ge zao gao de yin you shi ren ！]

english: Don't give up your day job outerlander!
translation: 不要放弃你的日常工作外地人！ [bu yao fang qi ni de ri chang gong zuo wai di ren ！]

english: I thought somebody was murdering a cat!
translation: 我以为有人谋杀了一只猫！ [wo yi wei you ren mou sha le yi zhi mao ！]

english: You know, I actually quite liked that verse...
translation: 你知道，我其实很喜欢这首诗...... [ni zhi dao ， wo qi shi hen xi huan zhe shou shi ......]

english: That's kind of catchy. Irritating. But catchy.
translation: 这有点吸引人。令人恼火。但很吸引人。 [zhe you dian xi yin ren 。 ling ren nao huo 。 dan hen xi yin ren 。]

english: Hey, I've done that quest too!
translation: 嘿嘿，这个任务我也做过！ [hei hei ， zhe ge ren wu wo ye zuo guo ！]

english: I have produced better sounds in the outhouse!
translation: 我在室外发出了更好的声音！ [wo zai shi wai fa chu le geng hao de sheng yin ！]

english: Your song makes no sense outerlander!
translation: 你的歌毫无意义，外地人！ [ni de ge hao wu yi yi ， wai di ren ！]

english: What kind of bard are you anyway?
translation: 你到底是哪种吟游诗人？ [ni dao di shi na zhong yin you shi ren ？]

english: I have met cows more musical than you!
translation: 我见过比你更有音乐天赋的牛！ [wo jian guo bi ni geng you yin yue tian fu de niu ！]

english: When do you get to the good parts?
translation: 你什么时候能看到好的部分？ [ni shen me shi hou neng kan dao hao de bu fen ？]

english: would torture us so, outerlander?
translation: 会这样折磨我们吗，外来者？ [hui zhe yang zhe mo wo men ma ， wai lai zhe ？]

english: Truly, this is the worst sound I have ever heard!
translation: 确实，这是我听过的最糟糕的声音！ [que shi ， zhe shi wo ting guo de zui zao gao de sheng yin ！]

english: looting and drinking part?
translation: 抢劫和饮酒部分？ [qiang jie he yin jiu bu fen ？]

english: Please tell me that was the last verse...
translation: 请告诉我这是最后一首诗... [qing gao su wo zhe shi zui hou yi shou shi ...]

english: Please... Kill me now...
translation: 拜托...现在就杀了我... [bai tuo ... xian zai jiu sha le wo ...]

english: You call THAT singing?
translation: 你管这叫唱歌？ [ni guan zhe jiao chang ge ？]

english: Never before have mine ears been so offended!
translation: 我的耳朵从来没有这么不舒服过！ [wo de er duo cong lai mei you zhe me bu shu fu guo ！]

english: Worst. Bard. EVER.
translation: 最糟糕的。诗人。曾经。 [zui zao gao de 。 shi ren 。 ceng jing 。]

english: Please, ye gods! Make it stop!
translation: 拜托各位大神了！让它停下来！ [bai tuo ge wei da shen le ！ rang ta ting xia lai ！]

english: If you stopped singing
translation: 如果你停止唱歌 [ru guo ni ting zhi chang ge]

english: The screams of my dying comrades sound better!
translation: 我死去的战友的尖叫声听起来更好听！ [wo si qu de zhan you de jian jiao sheng ting qi lai geng hao ting ！]

english: My grandmother could do better, and she is dead!
translation: 我的祖母本可以做得更好，但她已经死了！ [wo de zu mu ben ke yi zuo de geng hao ， dan ta yi jing si le ！]

english: I do such feats before breakfast!
translation: 我在早餐前就做了这样的事！ [wo zai zao can qian jiu zuo le zhe yang de shi ！]

english: Is your singing some kind of outerlander weapon?
translation: 你的歌声是某种外来武器吗？ [ni de ge sheng shi mou zhong wai lai wu qi ma ？]

english: Welcome, traveller. Are you looking to represent one of the houses of Great Kourend?
translation: 欢迎，旅行者。您想代表大库伦德家族之一吗？ [huan ying ， lv xing zhe 。 nin xiang dai biao da ku lun de jia zu zhi yi ma ？]

english: Tell me more.
translation: 告诉我更多。 [gao su wo geng duo 。]

english: As you are probably aware, Great Kourend is a vast kingdom. Many adventurers choose to wear special clothing which allows them to explore swiftly and with elegance.
translation: 您可能知道，大库伦德是一个广阔的王国。许多冒险家选择穿着特殊的服装，以便他们快速而优雅地探索。 [nin ke neng zhi dao ， da ku lun de shi yi ge guang kuo de wang guo 。 xu duo mao xian jia xuan ze chuan zhe te shu de fu zhuang ， yi bian ta men kuai su er you ya di tan suo 。]

english: As official tailor for Kourend, I can recolour this clothing, allowing adventurers to represent the city to which they are most loyal.
translation: 作为 Kourend 的官方裁缝，我可以重新给这件衣服上色，让冒险者能够代表他们最忠诚的城市。 [zuo wei  Kourend  de guan fang cai feng ， wo ke yi chong xin gei zhe jian yi fu shang se ， rang mao xian zhe neng gou dai biao ta men zui zhong cheng de cheng shi 。]

english: If you are interested, I would be more than happy to offer my tailoring services in exchange for Marks of Grace.
translation: 如果您有兴趣，我非常乐意提供我的裁缝服务以换取恩典之痕。 [ru guo nin you xing qu ， wo fei chang le yi ti gong wo de cai feng fu wu yi huan qu en dian zhi hen 。]

english: I'd like to recolour my graceful clothing.
translation: 我想重新给我优雅的衣服上色。 [wo xiang chong xin gei wo you ya de yi fu shang se 。]

english: Fantastic, simply pass me the items of clothing you would like recoloured, and we can get started.
translation: 太棒了，只需将您想要重新着色的衣服递给我，我们就可以开始了。 [tai bang le ， zhi xu jiang nin xiang yao chong xin zhuo se de yi fu di gei wo ， wo men jiu ke yi kai shi le 。]

english: Not right now.
translation: 现在不行。 [xian zai bu xing 。]

english: Actually, I just wanted to buy some clothes.
translation: 其实我只是想买点衣服而已。 [qi shi wo zhi shi xiang mai dian yi fu er yi 。]

english: Oh, certainly. My assistant over there, Robyn, will be happy to help you.
translation: 哦，当然。我那边的助理罗宾很乐意为您提供帮助。 [o ， dang ran 。 wo na bian de zhu li luo bin hen le yi wei nin ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: Are you sure you want to recolour that piece of graful clothing? It will cost 15 marks of grace.
translation: 您确定要为那件优雅的衣服重新上色吗？这将花费 15 点恩典。 [nin que ding yao wei na jian you ya de yi fu chong xin shang se ma ？ zhe jiang hua fei  15  dian en dian 。]

english: That seems reasonable.
translation: 这似乎很合理。 [zhe si hu hen he li 。]

english: Which city would you like to represent?
translation: 您想代表哪个城市？ [nin xiang dai biao na ge cheng shi ？]

english: I want the colours you're wearing.
translation: 我想要你穿的颜色。 [wo xiang yao ni chuan de yan se 。]

english: Actually, forget it.
translation: 其实，忘记吧。 [qi shi ， wang ji ba 。]

english: Actually, forget it.
translation: 其实，忘记吧。 [qi shi ， wang ji ba 。]

english: Sorry, you don't appear to have enough Marks of Grace. I charge 15 for my services.
translation: 抱歉，您似乎没有足够的恩典印记。我的服务收费 15 美元。 [bao qian ， nin si hu mei you zu gou de en dian yin ji 。 wo de fu wu shou fei  15  mei yuan 。]

english: I can remove that item's colours free of charge. Alternatively I can recolour it to represent a city of Kourend for a fee of 15 Marks of Grace.
translation: 我可以免费删除该商品的颜色。或者，我可以将其重新着色以代表库伦德市，费用为 15 个恩典标记。 [wo ke yi mian fei shan chu gai shang pin de yan se 。 huo zhe ， wo ke yi jiang qi chong xin zhuo se yi dai biao ku lun de shi ， fei yong wei  15  ge en dian biao ji 。]

english: I'd like to remove the colours.
translation: 我想去掉颜色。 [wo xiang qu diao yan se 。]

english: Are you sure you want to revert that piece of clothing? You'll have to pay again if you want it recoloured.
translation: 您确定要恢复那件衣服吗？如果你想重新着色，你必须再次付费。 [nin que ding yao hui fu na jian yi fu ma ？ ru guo ni xiang chong xin zhuo se ， ni bi xu zai ci fu fei 。]

english: Yes, I'm sure.
translation: 是的，我确定。 [shi de ， wo que ding 。]

english: I'd like to represent a different city.
translation: 我想代表一个不同的城市。 [wo xiang dai biao yi ge bu tong de cheng shi 。]

translation: 现在不行。 [xian zai bu xing 。]

english: Tell me more.
translation: 告诉我更多。 [gao su wo geng duo 。]

english: I'd like to recolour my graceful clothing.
translation: 我想重新给我优雅的衣服上色。 [wo xiang chong xin gei wo you ya de yi fu shang se 。]

english: Actually, I just wanted to buy some clothes.
translation: 其实我只是想买点衣服而已。 [qi shi wo zhi shi xiang mai dian yi fu er yi 。]

english: That seems reasonable.
translation: 这似乎很合理。 [zhe si hu hen he li 。]

english: I want the colours you're wearing.
translation: 我想要你穿的颜色。 [wo xiang yao ni chuan de yan se 。]

english: I'd like to remove the colours.
translation: 我想去掉颜色。 [wo xiang qu diao yan se 。]

english: Yes, I'm sure.
translation: 是的，我确定。 [shi de ， wo que ding 。]

translation: 我想代表一个不同的城市。 [wo xiang dai biao yi ge bu tong de cheng shi 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Good day, your Royal Highness.
translation: 美好的一天，殿下。 [mei hao de yi tian ， dian xia 。]

english: Welcome to the Miscellania food store. We've only opened recently.
translation: 欢迎来到 Miscellania 食品店。我们最近才开业。 [huan ying lai dao  Miscellania  shi pin dian 。 wo men zui jin cai kai ye 。]

english: Would you like to buy anything, your Royal Highness?
translation: 殿下您想买什么吗？ [dian xia nin xiang mai shen me ma ？]

english: Could you show me what you have for sale?
translation: 你能告诉我你有什么待售吗？ [ni neng gao su wo ni you shen me dai shou ma ？]

english: No thank you, I don't need food just now.
translation: 不，谢谢，我现在不需要食物。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo xian zai bu xu yao shi wu 。]

english: What's it like living down here?
translation: 住在下面感觉怎么样？ [zhu zai xia mian gan jue zen me yang ？]

english: The town's thriving. I'm sure it'll soon be as busy as Rellekka!
translation: 小镇很繁荣。我相信它很快就会像 Rellekka 一样忙碌！ [xiao zhen hen fan rong 。 wo xiang xin ta hen kuai jiu hui xiang  Rellekka  yi yang mang lu ！]

english: Could you show me what you have for sale?
translation: 你能告诉我你有什么待售吗？ [ni neng gao su wo ni you shen me dai shou ma ？]

english: No thank you, I don't need food just now.
translation: 不，谢谢，我现在不需要食物。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo xian zai bu xu yao shi wu 。]

english: What's it like living down here?
translation: 住在下面感觉怎么样？ [zhu zai xia mian gan jue zen me yang ？]

english: 'Ello there [lad/lassy]! What can I be getting you?
translation: '你好[小伙子/姑娘]！我能给你什么？ [' ni hao [ xiao huo zi / gu niang ]！ wo neng gei ni shen me ？]

english: I'd like to order a drink, please.
translation: 我想点一杯饮料。 [wo xiang dian yi bei yin liao 。]

english: Of course, what would you like?
translation: 当然，你想要什么？ [dang ran ， ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Got anything special on tap?
translation: 有什么特别的东西吗？ [you shen me te bie de dong xi ma ？]

english: We're always running a keg of our locally-brewed ale, Lizardkicker.
translation: 我们总是供应一桶本地酿造的啤酒 Lizardkicker。 [wo men zong shi gong ying yi tong ben di niang zao de pi jiu  Lizardkicker。]

english: I will warn you though, its an acquired taste.
translation: 但我要警告你，这是一种后天习得的品味。 [dan wo yao jing gao ni ， zhe shi yi zhong hou tian xi de de pin wei 。]

english: What's in it?
translation: 里面有什么？ [li mian you shen me ？]

english: Oh, the usual... Wheat, hops, yeast...
translation: 哦，通常的...小麦、啤酒花、酵母... [o ， tong chang de ... xiao mai 、 pi jiu hua 、 jiao mu ...]

english: ...reptile scales...
translation: ...爬行动物的鳞片... [... pa xing dong wu de lin pian ...]

english: Scales?!
translation: 秤？！ [cheng ？！]

english: Don't worry about the scales.
translation: 不用担心体重秤。 [bu yong dan xin ti zhong cheng 。]

english: Was there anything else?
translation: 还有别的事吗？ [hai you bie de shi ma ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This here is the Cloak and Stagger. The finest drinking establishment in the whole of Shayzien.
translation: 这是斗篷与交错。整个 Shayzien 最好的饮酒场所。 [zhe shi dou peng yu jiao cuo 。 zheng ge  Shayzien  zui hao de yin jiu chang suo 。]

english: Isn't it the only pub in the city?
translation: 这不是城里唯一的酒吧吗？ [zhe bu shi cheng li wei yi de jiu ba ma ？]

english: Like I say, the finest in all of Shayzien!
translation: 就像我说的，Shayzien 中最好的！ [jiu xiang wo shuo de ，Shayzien  zhong zui hao de ！]
