english: Most of our patrons are soldiers returning on leave from the frontlines. We do get a few regular folk in too though.
translation: 我们的大多数顾客都是从前线休假返回的士兵。不过，我们也确实有一些普通人加入。 [wo men de da duo shu gu ke dou shi cong qian xian xiu jia fan hui di shi bing 。 bu guo ， wo men ye que shi you yi xie pu tong ren jia ru 。]

english: By the way, its generally considered polite to buy a drink if you're going to stand around and chat.
translation: 顺便说一下，如果你要站着聊天，买一杯饮料通常被认为是有礼貌的。 [shun bian shuo yi xia ， ru guo ni yao zhan zhe liao tian ， mai yi bei yin liao tong chang bei ren wei shi you li mao de 。]

english: ...With that said, is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: ……那么，还有什么可以帮您的吗？ […… na me ， hai you shen me ke yi bang nin de ma ？]

english: Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: 你在这里听到过什么谣言吗？ [ni zai zhe li ting dao guo shen me yao yan ma ？]

english: Apparently Veos is looking for some help with something. He hangs around the docks of Port Piscarilius.
translation: 显然 Veos 正在寻求一些帮助。他在皮斯卡利留斯港的码头附近闲逛。 [xian ran  Veos  zheng zai xun qiu yi xie bang zhu 。 ta zai pi si ka li liu si gang de ma tou fu jin xian guang 。]

english: They say there's trouble in Port Piscarilius. Something about gangs uniting. Might be worth looking into.
translation: 他们说皮斯卡利留斯港有麻烦。一些关于帮派联合的事情。可能值得研究一下。 [ta men shuo pi si ka li liu si gang you ma fan 。 yi xie guan yu bang pai lian he de shi qing 。 ke neng zhi de yan jiu yi xia 。]

english: I hear that Lord Hosidius has misplaced one of his sons. The Hosidius family might pay a lot to see him returned safely.
translation: 我听说霍西迪乌斯勋爵失去了他的一个儿子。霍西迪乌斯家族可能会付出很多代价才能让他安全归来。 [wo ting shuo huo xi di wu si xun jue shi qu le ta de yi ge er zi 。 huo xi di wu si jia zu ke neng hui fu chu hen duo dai jia cai neng rang ta an quan gui lai 。]

english: Phileas Rimor has supposedly been looking for some assistance with something in Shayzien. Maybe worth investigating.
translation: 据说菲利亚斯·里莫一直在向 Shayzien 寻求一些帮助。也许值得调查。 [ju shuo fei li ya si · li mo yi zhi zai xiang  Shayzien  xun qiu yi xie bang zhu 。 ye xu zhi de diao cha 。]

english: I hear that the rulers of Lovakengj have some work available. You'll find them in the Lovakengj Assembly.
translation: 我听说洛瓦肯杰的统治者有一些工作要做。您可以在洛瓦肯吉议会找到它们。 [wo ting shuo luo wa ken jie de tong zhi zhe you yi xie gong zuo yao zuo 。 nin ke yi zai luo wa ken ji yi hui zhao dao ta men 。]

english: Apparently there's been some commotion in the middle of Arceuus. Might be worth checking out.
translation: 阿尔宙斯的中央显然发生了一些骚动。可能值得一看。 [a er zhou si de zhong yang xian ran fa sheng le yi xie sao dong 。 ke neng zhi de yi kan 。]

english: That protest outside Kourend Castle is starting to attract some attention. Could be worth taking a look.
translation: 库伦德城堡外的抗议活动开始引起一些关注。可能值得一看。 [ku lun de cheng bao wai de kang yi huo dong kai shi yin qi yi xie guan zhu 。 ke neng zhi de yi kan 。]

english: No, it hasn't been very busy lately.
translation: 不，最近不太忙。 [bu ， zui jin bu tai mang 。]

english: Actually, I think I need to be going.
translation: 事实上，我想我该走了。 [shi shi shang ， wo xiang wo gai zou le 。]

english: Safe travels!
translation: 安全出行！ [an quan chu xing ！]

english: I'd like to order a drink, please.
translation: 我想点一杯饮料。 [wo xiang dian yi bei yin liao 。]

english: Got anything special on tap?
translation: 有什么特别的东西吗？ [you shen me te bie de dong xi ma ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: 你在这里听到过什么谣言吗？ [ni zai zhe li ting dao guo shen me yao yan ma ？]

english: Actually, I think I need to be going.
translation: 事实上，我想我该走了。 [shi shi shang ， wo xiang wo gai zou le 。]

english: Good day to you, hearty warrior! May the spirits guide you.
translation: 祝你有美好的一天，热心的战士！愿灵魂指引你。 [zhu ni you mei hao de yi tian ， re xin de zhan shi ！ yuan ling hun zhi yin ni 。]

english: Welcome back, friend of the spirits. I am humbled in your presence. You are no longer the apprentice, but the master. Seek to inspire all with your daring deeds and legendary feats.
translation: 欢迎回来，灵魂的朋友。在你面前我感到谦卑。你不再是徒弟，而是师傅。努力用你的大胆行为和传奇壮举来激励所有人。 [huan ying hui lai ， ling hun de peng you 。 zai ni mian qian wo gan dao qian bei 。 ni bu zai shi tu di ， er shi shi fu 。 nu li yong ni de da dan xing wei he chuan qi zhuang ju lai ji li suo you ren 。]

english: Do you have anything for me?
translation: 你有什么要给我的吗？ [ni you shen me yao gei wo de ma ？]

english: I see you have free space and no way to record any information you may recover from the caverns. Please take this book as a record of your researches.
translation: 我看到你有空闲空间，但无法记录你可以从洞穴中恢复的任何信息。请将此书作为您的研究记录。 [wo kan dao ni you kong xian kong jian ， dan wu fa ji lu ni ke yi cong dong xue zhong hui fu de ren he xin xi 。 qing jiang ci shu zuo wei nin de yan jiu ji lu 。]

english: What kind of information are you thinking of?
translation: 您正在考虑什么样的信息？ [nin zheng zai kao lv shen me yang de xin xi ？]

english: Those who have previously entered the cavern have not all returned. Some of them seemed intent upon research and discovery as much as loot and daring deeds.
translation: 先前进入洞府的人，还没有全部回来。他们中的一些人似乎热衷于研究和发现，就像热衷于掠夺和大胆行为一样。 [xian qian jin ru dong fu de ren ， hai mei you quan bu hui lai 。 ta men zhong de yi xie ren si hu re zhong yu yan jiu he fa xian ， jiu xiang re zhong yu lve duo he da dan xing wei yi yang 。]

english: It would be a shame if you were to recover any of their notes and be unable to record them handily. I hope the new book will give you space for such discoveries.
translation: 如果你要恢复他们的任何笔记并且无法方便地记录它们，那将是一种耻辱。我希望这本新书能给你提供这样的发现空间。 [ru guo ni yao hui fu ta men de ren he bi ji bing qie wu fa fang bian di ji lu ta men ， na jiang shi yi zhong chi ru 。 wo xi wang zhe ben xin shu neng gei ni ti gong zhe yang de fa xian kong jian 。]

english: Can you help me with hastae?
translation: 你能帮我哈斯塔吗？ [ni neng bang wo ha si ta ma ？]

english: Perhaps. What do you need?
translation: 也许。你需要什么？ [ye xu 。 ni xu yao shen me ？]

english: Can you forge anything from this broken-looking hasta?
translation: 你能用这看起来破烂的哈斯塔锻造出任何东西吗？ [ni neng yong zhe kan qi lai po lan de ha si ta duan zao chu ren he dong xi ma ？]

english: Yes, I can work with this, but remember, you cannot comprehend how to wield a hasta until you have learned to create one by following my teachings.
translation: 是的，我可以用这个，但请记住，除非你学会按照我的教导来创造一个哈斯塔，否则你无法理解如何使用哈斯塔。 [shi de ， wo ke yi yong zhe ge ， dan qing ji zhu ， chu fei ni xue hui an zhao wo de jiao dao lai chuang zao yi ge ha si ta ， fou ze ni wu fa li jie ru he shi yong ha si ta 。]

english: ~ WARNING ~ You do not have the requirements to wield a hasta!
translation: ~ 警告 ~ 您不具备使用哈斯塔的条件！ [~  jing gao  ~  nin bu ju bei shi yong ha si ta de tiao jian ！]

english: Actually, forget it.
translation: 其实，忘记吧。 [qi shi ， wang ji ba 。]

english: As you wish.
translation: 如你所愿。 [ru ni suo yuan 。]

english: Yes, I can work with this.
translation: 是的，我可以处理这个。 [shi de ， wo ke yi chu li zhe ge 。]

english: Actually, forget I asked.
translation: 其实，忘记我问了。 [qi shi ， wang ji wo wen le 。]

english: Can you convert Zamorakian spears into hastae?
translation: 你能把萨莫拉克矛变成哈斯塔吗？ [ni neng ba sa mo la ke mao bian cheng ha si ta ma ？]

english: Yes, I can convert a Zamorakian spear into a hasta. The spirits require me to request 300,000 coins from you for this service.
translation: 是的，我可以把萨莫拉克长矛变成哈斯塔。灵魂要求我向你索取三十万金币来完成这项服务。 [shi de ， wo ke yi ba sa mo la ke chang mao bian cheng ha si ta 。 ling hun yao qiu wo xiang ni suo qu san shi wan jin bi lai wan cheng zhe xiang fu wu 。]

english: I can't afford that. Maybe another time.
translation: 我买不起。也许下次吧。 [wo mai bu qi 。 ye xu xia ci ba 。]

english: Can you convert Zamorakian hastae into spears?
translation: 你能将萨莫拉克哈斯塔变成长矛吗？ [ni neng jiang sa mo la ke ha si ta bian cheng zhang mao ma ？]

english: Yes, I can convert a Zamorakian hasta into a spear. I do not charge for this service.
translation: 是的，我可以将萨莫拉克哈斯塔变成长矛。我不收取这项服务的费用。 [shi de ， wo ke yi jiang sa mo la ke ha si ta bian cheng zhang mao 。 wo bu shou qu zhe xiang fu wu de fei yong 。]

english: I'd like to smash my pots when planting trees again.
translation: 我想再种树的时候把花盆砸碎。 [wo xiang zai zhong shu de shi hou ba hua pen za sui 。]

english: Consider it done.
translation: 认为它完成了。 [ren wei ta wan cheng le 。]

english: I'd like to be calmer and not smash my pots.
translation: 我想冷静一点，不要砸碎我的锅。 [wo xiang leng jing yi dian ， bu yao za sui wo de guo 。]

english: Could you tell me more of these spirits you continually refer to?
translation: 您能告诉我更多您经常提到的这些精神吗？ [nin neng gao su wo geng duo nin jing chang ti dao de zhe xie jing shen ma ？]

english: Certainly, though it is quite simple - they are the barbarians of the past who have died in the passing of the years. There are three categories which learned sages claim may describe all spirits encountered.
translation: 当然，虽然很简单——他们是过去的野蛮人，在岁月的流逝中死去。博学的圣人声称可以用三个类别来描述所遇到的所有精神。 [dang ran ， sui ran hen jian dan —— ta men shi guo qu de ye man ren ， zai sui yue de liu shi zhong si qu 。 bo xue de sheng ren sheng cheng ke yi yong san ge lei bie lai miao shu suo yu dao de suo you jing shen 。]

english: The majority are at peace, having died with their ambitions sated, even if this ambition was as simple as a glorious death. They can contact those in our world in order to spur us on to glory.
translation: 大多数人都很平静，他们的野心得到了满足，即使这个野心只是光荣的死亡那么简单。他们可以联系我们世界上的人，以激励我们走向荣耀。 [da duo shu ren dou hen ping jing ， ta men de ye xin de dao le man zu ， ji shi zhe ge ye xin zhi shi guang rong de si wang na me jian dan 。 ta men ke yi lian xi wo men shi jie shang de ren ， yi ji li wo men zou xiang rong yao 。]

english: Of course, they cannot or will not contact all inhabitants of these lands, for not all are worthy.
translation: 当然，他们不能或不会联系这些土地上的所有居民，因为并非所有人都值得。 [dang ran ， ta men bu neng huo bu hui lian xi zhe xie tu di shang de suo you ju min ， yin wei bing fei suo you ren dou zhi de 。]

english: So those are the spirits who give us guidance. What of the other sorts?
translation: 这些是给我们指导的精神。那其他种类呢？ [zhe xie shi gei wo men zhi dao de jing shen 。 na qi ta zhong lei ne ？]

english: A second category of spirit is made up of those who are not yet at peace. However, all that is needed is for their mortal remains to be laid to rest and they will join the peaceful majority.
translation: 第二类精神是由那些尚未平静的人组成的。然而，所需要的只是他们的遗体得到安息，他们就会加入和平的大多数。 [di er lei jing shen shi you na xie shang wei ping jing de ren zu cheng de 。 ran er ， suo xu yao de zhi shi ta men de yi ti de dao an xi ， ta men jiu hui jia ru he ping de da duo shu 。]

english: I can see the pyres serve this purpose. The final category is also restless?
translation: 我可以看到柴堆就是这个目的。最后一类也焦躁不安？ [wo ke yi kan dao chai dui jiu shi zhe ge mu di 。 zui hou yi lei ye jiao zao bu an ？]

english: Alas, there is a small minority who will never be at rest. These have been slain in moments of insanity by their brothers or by adventurers.
translation: 唉，有一小部分人永远不会安息。他们在疯狂的时刻被他们的兄弟或冒险者杀死。 [ai ， you yi xiao bu fen ren yong yuan bu hui an xi 。 ta men zai feng kuang de shi ke bei ta men de xiong di huo mao xian zhe sha si 。]

english: They are not at rest and will attack those they blame for their tortured state. They are not known, however, for being able to determine this blame with any great accuracy, so should be considered dangerous to all.
translation: 他们没有休息，并且会攻击那些他们指责造成他们遭受酷刑的人。然而，他们并不知道能够非常准确地确定这种责任，因此应该被认为对所有人都是危险的。 [ta men mei you xiu xi ， bing qie hui gong ji na xie ta men zhi ze zao cheng ta men zao shou ku xing de ren 。 ran er ， ta men bing bu zhi dao neng gou fei chang zhun que di que ding zhe zhong ze ren ， yin ci ying gai bei ren wei dui suo you ren dou shi wei xian de 。]

english: Thank you Otto. It makes a bit more sense now.
translation: 谢谢奥托。现在它更有意义了。 [xie xie ao tuo 。 xian zai ta geng you yi yi le 。]

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: I have further training for you.
translation: 我还有进一步的训练要给你。 [wo hai you jin yi bu de xun lian yao gei ni 。]

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。 [qing shu ru wen ti de da an 。]

english: Wrong! Focus your thoughts.
translation: 错误的！集中你的思想。 [cuo wu de ！ ji zhong ni de si xiang 。]

english: Correct, you've completed this part of your training.
translation: 正确，您已经完成了这部分训练。 [zheng que ， nin yi jing wan cheng le zhe bu fen xun lian 。]

english: Ah! Here you go!
translation: 啊!干得好！ [a ! gan de hao ！]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: I need you to answer this for me.
translation: 我需要你帮我回答这个问题。 [wo xu yao ni bang wo hui da zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Please tell me your answer.
translation: 请告诉我你的答案。 [qing gao su wo ni de da an 。]

english: Nope, Go check again!
translation: 不行，再去检查一下！ [bu xing ， zai qu jian cha yi xia ！]

english: Spot on!
translation: 现货！ [xian huo ！]

english: Let's talk about my training.
translation: 说说我的训练吧。 [shuo shuo wo de xun lian ba 。]

english: Do you have anything for me?
translation: 你有什么要给我的吗？ [ni you shen me yao gei wo de ma ？]

english: Can you help me with hastae?
translation: 你能帮我哈斯塔吗？ [ni neng bang wo ha si ta ma ？]

english: Can you forge anything from this broken-looking hasta?
translation: 你能用这看起来破烂的哈斯塔锻造出任何东西吗？ [ni neng yong zhe kan qi lai po lan de ha si ta duan zao chu ren he dong xi ma ？]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Can you convert Zamorakian spears into hastae?
translation: 你能把萨莫拉克矛变成哈斯塔吗？ [ni neng ba sa mo la ke mao bian cheng ha si ta ma ？]

english: Can you convert Zamorakian hastae into spears?
translation: 你能将萨莫拉克哈斯塔变成长矛吗？ [ni neng jiang sa mo la ke ha si ta bian cheng zhang mao ma ？]

english: Actually, forget it.
translation: 其实，忘记吧。 [qi shi ， wang ji ba 。]

english: I'd like to smash my pots when planting trees again.
translation: 我想再种树的时候把花盆砸碎。 [wo xiang zai zhong shu de shi hou ba hua pen za sui 。]

english: I'd like to be calmer and not smash my pots.
translation: 我想冷静一点，不要砸碎我的锅。 [wo xiang leng jing yi dian ， bu yao za sui wo de guo 。]

english: Could you tell me more of these spirits you continually refer to?
translation: 您能告诉我更多您经常提到的这些精神吗？ [nin neng gao su wo geng duo nin jing chang ti dao de zhe xie jing shen ma ？]

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: Please feel free to look around, just try to keep your hands off the apparatus!
translation: 请随意环顾四周，尽量将手远离设备！ [qing sui yi huan gu si zhou ， jin liang jiang shou yuan li she bei ！]

english: What are you doing?
translation: 你在干什么？ [ni zai gan shen me ？]

english: I'm trying to carry out very important research, but these so-called 'wizards' from the eastern lands keep meddling with my equipment.
translation: 我正在尝试进行非常重要的研究，但这些来自东方的所谓“巫师”不断干扰我的设备。 [wo zheng zai chang shi jin xing fei chang zhong yao de yan jiu ， dan zhe xie lai zi dong fang de suo wei “ wu shi ” bu duan gan rao wo de she bei 。]

english: I'll let you get back to your work.
translation: 我会让你回去工作。 [wo hui rang ni hui qu gong zuo 。]

english: Farewell, traveller.
translation: 再见，旅行者。 [zai jian ， lv xing zhe 。]

english: How are you doing?
translation: 你好吗？ [ni hao ma ？]

english: If you don't stop talking to me, I'll never get my slouching time for the day done.
translation: 如果你不停止跟我说话，我这一天的懒散时间就永远不会结束。 [ru guo ni bu ting zhi gen wo shuo hua ， wo zhe yi tian de lan san shi jian jiu yong yuan bu hui jie shu 。]

english: How old are you now?
translation: 你现在几岁了？ [ni xian zai ji sui le ？]

english: I'm old and fat if that's what you're driving at. What, are you thinking of trading me in for a younger model after all the adventuring we've done together? Is that it?
translation: 如果你是这么想的话，我又老又胖了。什么，在我们一起经历了这么多冒险之后，你是否考虑用我换一个更年轻的模特？是这样吗？ [ru guo ni shi zhe me xiang de hua ， wo you lao you pang le 。 shen me ， zai wo men yi qi jing li le zhe me duo mao xian zhi hou ， ni shi fou kao lv yong wo huan yi ge geng nian qing de mo te ？ shi zhe yang ma ？]

english: No nothing of the sort. I was just trying to make conversation, that's all.
translation: 没有这样的事情。我只是想进行对话，仅此而已。 [mei you zhe yang de shi qing 。 wo zhi shi xiang jin xing dui hua ， jin ci er yi 。]

english: Sure, I know your game. Gonna trade me in for some death runes were ya? Eh?
translation: 当然，我知道你的游戏。要用我来换一些死亡符文吗？呃？ [dang ran ， wo zhi dao ni de you xi 。 yao yong wo lai huan yi xie si wang fu wen ma ？ e ？]

english: What!! How do you know about that?
translation: 什么！！你怎么知道的？ [shen me ！！ ni zen me zhi dao de ？]

english: I would have thought you would have worked that out by now. Us cats are as wise as that sphinx.
translation: 我本以为你现在已经解决了这个问题。我们的猫和狮身人面像一样聪明。 [wo ben yi wei ni xian zai yi jing jie jue le zhe ge wen ti 。 wo men de mao he shi shen ren mian xiang yi yang cong ming 。]

english: Where do you want to go?
translation: 你想去哪里？ [ni xiang qu na li ？]

english: I'd just like to go somewhere nice and warm.
translation: 我只是想去一个温暖又美好的地方。 [wo zhi shi xiang qu yi ge wen nuan you mei hao de di fang 。]

english: What do you want to do now?
translation: 你现在想做什么？ [ni xian zai xiang zuo shen me ？]

english: I want to have a snooze, all this talking has made me sleepy.
translation: 我想小睡一下，这些谈话让我昏昏欲睡。 [wo xiang xiao shui yi xia ， zhe xie tan hua rang wo hun hun yu shui 。]

english: Gosh you're a bit dull and boring.
translation: 天哪，你有点迟钝和无聊。 [tian na ， ni you dian chi dun he wu liao 。]

english: I suppose that's what you become once you pass your 9th birthday.
translation: 我想，一旦你过了九岁生日，你就会变成这样。 [wo xiang ， yi dan ni guo le jiu sui sheng ri ， ni jiu hui bian cheng zhe yang 。]

english: Sorry human, but what are you wearing?
translation: 抱歉，人类，你穿什么？ [bao qian ， ren lei ， ni chuan shen me ？]

english: I got some cat ears made for me, don't they look meeeeeeeooooowvalous.
translation: 我为我做了一些猫耳朵，它们看起来是不是很珍贵。 [wo wei wo zuo le yi xie mao er duo ， ta men kan qi lai shi bu shi hen zhen gui 。]

english: The cat looks you dead in the eye, unblinking.
translation: 猫直视着你的眼睛，一眨不眨。 [mao zhi shi zhe ni de yan jing ， yi zha bu zha 。]

english: Am I a joke to you?
translation: 我对你来说是一个笑话吗？ [wo dui ni lai shuo shi yi ge xiao hua ma ？]

english: UwU?
translation: 乌乌乌？ [wu wu wu ？]

english: Why are you doing this?
translation: 你为什么要这样做？ [ni wei shen me yao zhe yang zuo ？]

english: I thought it'd be cute and funny.
translation: 我以为这会很可爱又有趣。 [wo yi wei zhe hui hen ke ai you you qu 。]

english: It's not, take them off now human, before I get myself a pair of human ears to wear.
translation: 不是的，在我给自己戴上一双人类的耳朵之前，把它们脱下来吧。 [bu shi de ， zai wo gei zi ji dai shang yi shuang ren lei de er duo zhi qian ， ba ta men tuo xia lai ba 。]

english: How are you doing?
translation: 你好吗？ [ni hao ma ？]

english: How old are you now?
translation: 你现在几岁了？ [ni xian zai ji sui le ？]

english: Where do you want to go?
translation: 你想去哪里？ [ni xiang qu na li ？]

english: What do you want to do now?
translation: 你现在想做什么？ [ni xian zai xiang zuo shen me ？]

english: Human. You seem to have found your way into Mistrock. What are you doing here?
translation: 人类。你似乎已经找到了进入迷雾岩的路。你在这里做什么？ [ren lei 。 ni si hu yi jing zhao dao le jin ru mi wu yan de lu 。 ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Am I not allowed to be here?
translation: 难道我不被允许来这里吗？ [nan dao wo bu bei yun xu lai zhe li ma ？]

english: Your kind have managed to establish dominion over the vast majority of these lands. Will you not even let us have our small corner in peace?
translation: 你们已经成功地统治了这些土地的绝大多数。连我们的小角落都不让你安静一下吗？ [ni men yi jing cheng gong di tong zhi le zhe xie tu di de jue da duo shu 。 lian wo men de xiao jiao luo dou bu rang ni an jing yi xia ma ？]

english: Is that a no?
translation: 那是不吗？ [na shi bu ma ？]

english: Hmph! I can't stop you being here, but I don't have to enjoy your presence.
translation: 哼！我无法阻止你在这里，但我不必享受你的存在。 [heng ！ wo wu fa zu zhi ni zai zhe li ， dan wo bu bi xiang shou ni de cun zai 。]

english: Is there anything that I can do to change that?
translation: 我可以做些什么来改变这种状况吗？ [wo ke yi zuo xie shen me lai gai bian zhe zhong zhuang kuang ma ？]

english: No. Now if this conversation is over, I'm going to have a drink.
translation: 不。现在如果谈话结束了，我要去喝一杯。 [bu 。 xian zai ru guo tan hua jie shu le ， wo yao qu he yi bei 。]

english: Is there anything that I can do to change that? I've already been quite helpful over in Cam Torum.
translation: 我可以做些什么来改变这种状况吗？我已经在 Cam Torum 提供了很大的帮助。 [wo ke yi zuo xie shen me lai gai bian zhe zhong zhuang kuang ma ？ wo yi jing zai  Cam Torum  ti gong le hen da de bang zhu 。]

english: One act of charity will not excuse years of subjugation.
translation: 一项慈善行为并不能成为多年受压迫的借口。 [yi xiang ci shan xing wei bing bu neng cheng wei duo nian shou ya po de jie kou 。]

english: Subjugation? That seems like a bit of an over- exaggeration.
translation: 征服？这似乎有点过于夸张了。 [zheng fu ？ zhe si hu you dian guo yu kua zhang le 。]

english: Call it what you will. The end result is the same. Your kind prosper at the expense of ours, and you act like it's not even happening.
translation: 你想怎么称呼它就怎么称呼它。最终结果是一样的。你们的繁荣是以牺牲我们的利益为代价的，而你们却表现得好像这一切都没有发生。 [ni xiang zen me cheng hu ta jiu zen me cheng hu ta 。 zui zhong jie guo shi yi yang de 。 ni men de fan rong shi yi xi sheng wo men de li yi wei dai jia de ， er ni men que biao xian de hao xiang zhe yi qie dou mei you fa sheng 。]

english: I've seen Cam Torum. You don't seem to be doing too badly.
translation: 我见过卡姆托鲁姆。看来你做得还不算太差。 [wo jian guo ka mu tuo lu mu 。 kan lai ni zuo de hai bu suan tai cha 。]

english: And here you prove my point. One city! One! You see that one city and consider it somehow equal to your many.
translation: 在这里你证明了我的观点。一城！一！你看到那一座城市，并认为它在某种程度上与你的许多城市相同。 [zai zhe li ni zheng ming liao wo de guan dian 。 yi cheng ！ yi ！ ni kan dao na yi zuo cheng shi ， bing ren wei ta zai mou zhong cheng du shang yu ni de xu duo cheng shi xiang tong 。]

english: Well what about this place?
translation: 那么这个地方怎么样呢？ [na me zhe ge di fang zen me yang ne ？]

english: A mere mining outpost. It hardly compares to those villas elsewhere on the island.
translation: 只是一个采矿前哨站。它很难与岛上其他地方的别墅相比。 [zhi shi yi ge cai kuang qian shao zhan 。 ta hen nan yu dao shang qi ta di fang de bie shu xiang bi 。]

english: Not all humans are the same though. It's not just Cam Torum. I've actually worked with your kind a few times.
translation: 但并非所有人类都是一样的。不仅仅是 Cam Torum。我实际上已经和你们这种人一起工作过几次了。 [dan bing fei suo you ren lei dou shi yi yang de 。 bu jin jin shi  Cam Torum。 wo shi ji shang yi jing he ni men zhe zhong ren yi qi gong zuo guo ji ci le 。]

english: Such as?
translation: 例如？ [li ru ？]

english: Well there was this one time when I helped the dwarves of Keldagrim with a bit of a statue issue. Another time I worked with one of the last surviving Imcando dwarves to create a blurite sword.
translation: 嗯，有一次我帮助凯尔达格林的矮人解决了一些雕像问题。还有一次，我与最后幸存的伊姆坎多矮人之一一起制作了一把蓝石剑。 [n ， you yi ci wo bang zhu kai er da ge lin de ai ren jie jue le yi xie diao xiang wen ti 。 hai you yi ci ， wo yu zui hou xing cun de yi mu kan duo ai ren zhi yi yi qi zhi zuo le yi ba lan shi jian 。]

english: Imcando?
translation: 伊姆坎多？ [yi mu kan duo ？]

english: Yes! You know about them?
translation: 是的！你了解他们吗？ [shi de ！ ni liao jie ta men ma ？]

english: Of course I know about them! The Imcando were our ancestors, but I thought they were long dead.
translation: 我当然知道他们！伊姆坎多人是我们的祖先，但我以为他们已经死了很久了。 [wo dang ran zhi dao ta men ！ yi mu kan duo ren shi wo men de zu xian ， dan wo yi wei ta men yi jing si le hen jiu le 。]

english: Not quite.
translation: 不完全是。 [bu wan quan shi 。]

english: Hmph! It's still going to take more than that to get me to like you.
translation: 哼！要让我喜欢你还需要更多的努力。 [heng ！ yao rang wo xi huan ni hai xu yao geng duo de nu li 。]

english: Well if liking is out of the question, how about tolerate?
translation: 既然喜欢都谈不上，那么忍受又如何呢？ [ji ran xi huan dou tan bu shang ， na me ren shou you ru he ne ？]

english: Fine. Consider yourself tolerated. Now, did you actually want something?
translation: 美好的。认为自己是可以容忍的。现在，你真的想要什么吗？ [mei hao de 。 ren wei zi ji shi ke yi rong ren de 。 xian zai ， ni zhen de xiang yao shen me ma ？]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm the overseer for Mistrock. I make sure everything around here is running as it should be.
translation: 我是迷雾岩的监督者。我确保这里的一切都按其应有的方式运行。 [wo shi mi wu yan de jian du zhe 。 wo que bao zhe li de yi qie dou an qi ying you de fang shi yun xing 。]

english: And you do that from the pub?
translation: 你是在酒吧里做的吗？ [ni shi zai jiu ba li zuo de ma ？]

english: Am I not allowed a break from time to time?
translation: 难道不让我时不时休息一下吗？ [nan dao bu rang wo shi bu shi xiu xi yi xia ma ？]

english: I suppose.
translation: 我想。 [wo xiang 。]

english: Hmph!
translation: 哼！ [heng ！]

english: You said the Imcando were your ancestors?
translation: 你说伊姆坎多是你的祖先？ [ni shuo yi mu kan duo shi ni de zu xian ？]

english: That's right. The Lovakengj dwarves were born from the Imcando and we were born from the Lovakengj. If you want to know more, find a historian.
translation: 这是正确的。洛瓦肯吉矮人是从伊姆坎多出生的，而我们是从洛瓦肯吉出生的。如果你想了解更多，就找历史学家吧。 [zhe shi zheng que de 。 luo wa ken ji ai ren shi cong yi mu kan duo chu sheng de ， er wo men shi cong luo wa ken ji chu sheng de 。 ru guo ni xiang liao jie geng duo ， jiu zhao li shi xue jia ba 。]

english: Not really.
translation: 并不真地。 [bing bu zhen di 。]

english: Then be on your way so that I can have a drink.
translation: 那你就走吧，我可以喝一杯。 [na ni jiu zou ba ， wo ke yi he yi bei 。]

english: Human. You seem to have returned. Did you want something?
translation: 人类。你好像回来了。你想要什么吗？ [ren lei 。 ni hao xiang hui lai le 。 ni xiang yao shen me ma ？]

english: Is there anything that I can do to change your opinion on me?
translation: 我能做些什么来改变你对我的看法吗？ [wo neng zuo xie shen me lai gai bian ni dui wo de kan fa ma ？]

english: No. Now leave me be so that I can have a drink.
translation: 不，现在让我安静一下，我可以喝一杯。 [bu ， xian zai rang wo an jing yi xia ， wo ke yi he yi bei 。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: You said the Imcando were your ancestors?
translation: 你说伊姆坎多是你的祖先？ [ni shuo yi mu kan duo shi ni de zu xian ？]

english: Not really.
translation: 并不真地。 [bing bu zhen di 。]

english: Hoot! Hoot!
translation: 叱！叱！ [chi ！ chi ！]

english: Marvelous!
translation: 奇妙！ [qi miao ！]

english: Hello. What are you doing?
translation: 你好。你在干什么？ [ni hao 。 ni zai gan shen me ？]

english: I'm the rat keeper, it's my job to look after these here rats.
translation: 我是老鼠饲养员，我的工作就是照顾这些老鼠。 [wo shi lao shu si yang yuan ， wo de gong zuo jiu shi zhao gu zhe xie lao shu 。]

english: You do know that there are some rats running loose?
translation: 你知道有一些老鼠在逃吗？ [ni zhi dao you yi xie lao shu zai tao ma ？]

english: Some nibble their way out from time to time. Don't worry there's enough cats down here to sort anything that gets out.
translation: 有些人不时地咬着牙出来。别担心，这里有足够多的猫来处理掉出来的东西。 [you xie ren bu shi di yao zhe ya chu lai 。 bie dan xin ， zhe li you zu gou duo de mao lai chu li diao chu lai de dong xi 。]

english: So how do these rat pits work?
translation: 那么这些老鼠坑是如何运作的呢？ [na me zhe xie lao shu keng shi ru he yun zuo de ne ？]

english: The Keldagrim pits cater for those with the larger variety of cats.
translation: 凯尔达格里姆猫坑适合那些拥有更多种类猫的人。 [kai er da ge li mu mao keng shi he na xie yong you geng duo zhong lei mao de ren 。]

english: If you have an overgrown cat and a couple of coins you can challenge someone else who also has an overgrown cat and some spare change.
translation: 如果您有一只过大的猫和几枚硬币，您可以挑战其他也有一只过大的猫和一些零钱的人。 [ru guo nin you yi zhi guo da de mao he ji mei ying bi ， nin ke yi tiao zhan qi ta ye you yi zhi guo da de mao he yi xie ling qian de ren 。]

english: That sounds simple enough so far.
translation: 到目前为止，这听起来很简单。 [dao mu qian wei zhi ， zhe ting qi lai hen jian dan 。]

english: You then agree on a wager. It's rumoured that some ratcatchers can talk to their own cats and give them tactics to aid them.
translation: 然后你们同意打赌。有传言说，一些捕鼠者可以与自己的猫交谈，并向它们提供帮助它们的策略。 [ran hou ni men tong yi da du 。 you chuan yan shuo ， yi xie bu shu zhe ke yi yu zi ji de mao jiao tan ， bing xiang ta men ti gong bang zhu ta men de ce lve 。]

english: So then how do you win the challenge?
translation: 那么如何赢得挑战呢？ [na me ru he ying de tiao zhan ne ？]

english: I was just getting to that. Both the challengers' cats are placed inside the arena, and whichever kills 9 rats first wins.
translation: 我刚刚谈到这一点。挑战者的两只猫都被放置在竞技场内，先杀死 9 只老鼠的一方获胜。 [wo gang gang tan dao zhe yi dian 。 tiao zhan zhe de liang zhi mao dou bei fang zhi zai jing ji chang nei ， xian sha si  9  zhi lao shu de yi fang huo sheng 。]

english: That sounds vile and cruel.
translation: 这听上去卑鄙又残忍。 [zhe ting shang qu bei bi you can ren 。]

english: It's a cruel world and the pits are no exception.
translation: 这是一个残酷的世界，坑也不例外。 [zhe shi yi ge can ku de shi jie ， keng ye bu li wai 。]

english: Each to their own, I say.
translation: 我说，各有各的。 [wo shuo ， ge you ge de 。]

english: It sounds a little dangerous for my cat.
translation: 听起来对我的猫来说有点危险。 [ting qi lai dui wo de mao lai shuo you dian wei xian 。]

english: I agree. Cats have been known to be killed in fights.
translation: 我同意。众所周知，猫会在打斗中被杀死。 [wo tong yi 。 zhong suo zhou zhi ， mao hui zai da dou zhong bei sha si 。]

english: Oh how terrible. Is there nothing you can do to save your cat?
translation: 噢，多么可怕啊。你无能为力拯救你的猫吗？ [o ， duo me ke pa a 。 ni wu neng wei li zheng jiu ni de mao ma ？]

english: Of course there is, you can instruct it to be cautious, and it will leave once it feels as if it is in danger.
translation: 当然有，你可以让它小心一点，它感觉有危险就会离开。 [dang ran you ， ni ke yi rang ta xiao xin yi dian ， ta gan jue you wei xian jiu hui li kai 。]

english: Oh that sounds quite wise.
translation: 哦，这听起来很明智。 [o ， zhe ting qi lai hen ming zhi 。]

english: That depends on how you value your cat.
translation: 这取决于你如何评价你的猫。 [zhe qu jue yu ni ru he ping jia ni de mao 。]

english: Sorry, I don't follow.
translation: 抱歉，我不跟。 [bao qian ， wo bu gen 。]

english: Well if your cat dies or it runs away you lose.
translation: 好吧，如果你的猫死了或者逃跑了，你就输了。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni de mao si le huo zhe tao pao le ， ni jiu shu le 。]

english: So the longer it stays in the fight the better chance you have of winning.
translation: 因此，它在战斗中停留的时间越长，您获胜的机会就越大。 [yin ci ， ta zai zhan dou zhong ting liu de shi jian yue zhang ， nin huo sheng de ji hui jiu yue da 。]

english: Wow that sounds like fun!
translation: 哇，听起来很有趣！ [wa ， ting qi lai hen you qu ！]

english: I don't know about that.
translation: 我对此一无所知。 [wo dui ci yi wu suo zhi 。]

english: One thing I know though is that it's a quick way to make and lose money.
translation: 但我知道的一件事是，这是一种快速赚钱和赔钱的方法。 [dan wo zhi dao de yi jian shi shi ， zhe shi yi zhong kuai su zhuan qian he pei qian de fang fa 。]

english: Is there a limit to how much you can bet?
translation: 您可以下注的金额有限制吗？ [nin ke yi xia zhu de jin e you xian zhi ma ？]

english: Hmmm... let me think. I don't think that's ever arisen but I think it's 20,000.
translation: 嗯……让我想想。我认为这种情况从未出现过，但我认为有 20,000 个。 [n …… rang wo xiang xiang 。 wo ren wei zhe zhong qing kuang cong wei chu xian guo ， dan wo ren wei you  20,000  ge 。]

english: Hmm, that sounds like a silly amount of money to bet on a cat fight.
translation: 嗯，这听起来像是在猫打架上押注的一大笔钱。 [n ， zhe ting qi lai xiang shi zai mao da jia shang ya zhu de yi da bi qian 。]

english: You'd be surprised what some people would be willing to bet.
translation: 你会对有些人愿意下注感到惊讶。 [ni hui dui you xie ren yuan yi xia zhu gan dao jing ya 。]

english: There is a minimum bet of 100 coins too.
translation: 最低赌注也为 100 个硬币。 [zui di du zhu ye wei  100  ge ying bi 。]

english: Can I challenge you and your cat?
translation: 我可以挑战你和你的猫吗？ [wo ke yi tiao zhan ni he ni de mao ma ？]

english: No, not now, we don't really bet with outsiders.
translation: 不，现在不行，我们真的不跟外人打赌。 [bu ， xian zai bu xing ， wo men zhen de bu gen wai ren da du 。]

english: But I'm not an outsider, am I not inside in the pits now?
translation: 但我不是外人，我现在不是在坑里吗？ [dan wo bu shi wai ren ， wo xian zai bu shi zai keng li ma ？]

english: I don't know, maybe once you've done something to win over my trust.
translation: 我不知道，也许一旦你做了一些事情来赢得我的信任。 [wo bu zhi dao ， ye xu yi dan ni zuo le yi xie shi qing lai ying de wo de xin ren 。]

english: Can it be bought?
translation: 可以买吗？ [ke yi mai ma ？]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: Your trust.
translation: 您的信任。 [nin de xin ren 。]

english: No. Regular townsfolk don't like us, which leads us to distrust them and anyone else.
translation: 不。普通城镇居民不喜欢我们，这导致我们不信任他们和其他任何人。 [bu 。 pu tong cheng zhen ju min bu xi huan wo men ， zhe dao zhi wo men bu xin ren ta men he qi ta ren he ren 。]

english: Thanks for your help.
translation: 感谢您的帮助。 [gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]

english: That sounds vile and cruel.
translation: 这听上去卑鄙又残忍。 [zhe ting shang qu bei bi you can ren 。]

english: One more thing...
translation: 还有一件事... [hai you yi jian shi ...]

english: Thanks for your help.
translation: 感谢您的帮助。 [gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]

english: It sounds a little dangerous for my cat.
translation: 听起来对我的猫来说有点危险。 [ting qi lai dui wo de mao lai shuo you dian wei xian 。]

english: Wow that sounds like fun.
translation: 哇，听起来很有趣。 [wa ， ting qi lai hen you qu 。]

english: Is there a limit to how much you can bet?
translation: 您可以下注的金额有限制吗？ [nin ke yi xia zhu de jin e you xian zhi ma ？]

english: Can I challenge you and your cat?
translation: 我可以挑战你和你的猫吗？ [wo ke yi tiao zhan ni he ni de mao ma ？]

english: Aye, 'tis a fair day my friend.
translation: 是的，这是美好的一天，我的朋友。 [shi de ， zhe shi mei hao de yi tian ， wo de peng you 。]

english: I'm not your friend.
translation: 我不是你的朋友。 [wo bu shi ni de peng you 。]

english: I'm surprised if you're anyone's friend with those kind of manners.
translation: 如果你是有这种举止的人的朋友，我会感到很惊讶。 [ru guo ni shi you zhe zhong ju zhi de ren de peng you ， wo hui gan dao hen jing ya 。]

english: Yes, it's a very nice day.
translation: 是的，这是非常美好的一天。 [shi de ， zhe shi fei chang mei hao de yi tian 。]

english: Aye, may the gods walk by yer side. Now leave me alone.
translation: 是的，愿诸神与你同行。现在别管我了。 [shi de ， yuan zhu shen yu ni tong hang 。 xian zai bie guan wo le 。]

english: Can you sell me a rune platebody?
translation: 你能卖给我一个符文板吗？ [ni neng mai gei wo yi ge fu wen ban ma ？]

english: So, how does thee know I 'ave some?
translation: 那么，你怎么知道我有一些呢？ [na me ， ni zen me zhi dao wo you yi xie ne ？]

english: The Guildmaster of the Champions' Guild told me.
translation: 冠军公会的会长告诉我的。 [guan jun gong hui de hui zhang gao su wo de 。]

english: Yes, I suppose he would, wouldn't he? He's always sending you fancy-pants 'heroes' up to bother me. Telling me I'll give them a quest or sommat like that.
translation: 是的，我想他会的，不是吗？他总是派你们这些“英雄”来骚扰我。告诉我我会给他们一个类似的任务或索马特。 [shi de ， wo xiang ta hui de ， bu shi ma ？ ta zong shi pai ni men zhe xie “ ying xiong ” lai sao rao wo 。 gao su wo wo hui gei ta men yi ge lei si de ren wu huo suo ma te 。]

english: Well, I'm not going to let just anyone wear my rune platemail. It's only for heroes. So, leave me alone.
translation: 好吧，我不会让任何人佩戴我的符文板甲。这只是英雄的事。所以，别管我了。 [hao ba ， wo bu hui rang ren he ren pei dai wo de fu wen ban jia 。 zhe zhi shi ying xiong de shi 。 suo yi ， bie guan wo le 。]

english: I am a master detective.
translation: 我是一名侦探大师。 [wo shi yi ming zhen tan da shi 。]

english: Well, however you found out about it, I'm not going to let just anyone wear my rune platemail. It's only for heroes. So leave me alone.
translation: 好吧，无论你如何发现，我不会让任何人佩戴我的符文板甲。这只是英雄的事。所以别管我了。 [hao ba ， wu lun ni ru he fa xian ， wo bu hui rang ren he ren pei dai wo de fu wen ban jia 。 zhe zhi shi ying xiong de shi 。 suo yi bie guan wo le 。]

english: I thought you were going to give me a quest.
translation: 我以为你要给我一个任务。 [wo yi wei ni yao gei wo yi ge ren wu 。]

english: *Sigh*
translation: *叹* [* tan *]

english: All right, I'll give ye a quest. I'll let you wear my rune platemail if ye...
translation: 好吧，我给你一个任务。我会让你穿上我的符文板甲，如果你... [hao ba ， wo gei ni yi ge ren wu 。 wo hui rang ni chuan shang wo de fu wen ban jia ， ru guo ni ...]

english: Slay the dragon of Crandor!
translation: 消灭克兰多之龙！ [xiao mie ke lan duo zhi long ！]

english: A dragon, that sounds like fun!
translation: 龙，听起来很有趣！ [long ， ting qi lai hen you qu ！]

english: Hah, yes, you are a typical reckless adventurer, aren't you? Now go kill the dragon and get out of my face.
translation: 哈，是的，你就是一个典型的鲁莽冒险家，不是吗？现在去杀了那条龙，然后从我面前滚出去。 [ha ， shi de ， ni jiu shi yi ge dian xing de lu mang mao xian jia ， bu shi ma ？ xian zai qu sha le na tiao long ， ran hou cong wo mian qian gun chu qu 。]

english: But how can I defeat the dragon?
translation: 但我怎样才能打败龙呢？ [dan wo zen yang cai neng da bai long ne ？]

english: Go to the Guildmaster in the Champions' Guild. He'll help ye out if yer so keen on doing a quest. I'm not going to be handholding any adventurers.
translation: 前往冠军公会的公会会长处。如果你热衷于完成任务，他会帮助你。我不会牵着任何冒险者的手。 [qian wang guan jun gong hui de gong hui hui zhang chu 。 ru guo ni re zhong yu wan cheng ren wu ， ta hui bang zhu ni 。 wo bu hui qian zhe ren he mao xian zhe de shou 。]

english: I may be a champion, but I don't think I'm up to dragon-killing yet.
translation: 我可能是冠军，但我认为我还没有能力屠龙。 [wo ke neng shi guan jun ， dan wo ren wei wo hai mei you neng li tu long 。]

english: Yes, I can understand that. Yer a coward.
translation: 是的，我能理解。你是个胆小鬼。 [shi de ， wo neng li jie 。 ni shi ge dan xiao gui 。]

english: That's a pity, I'm not a hero.
translation: 可惜我不是英雄。 [ke xi wo bu shi ying xiong 。]

english: Aye, I ken tell!
translation: 是的，我告诉你！ [shi de ， wo gao su ni ！]

english: Have ye slayed that dragon yet?
translation: 你们已经杀死那条龙了吗？ [ni men yi jing sha si na tiao long le ma ？]

english: Um... no.
Be off with ye then.
translation: 那你就走吧。 [na ni jiu zou ba 。]

english: I'm not sellin' ye anything till you've slayed that dragon! Now be off wi' ye.
translation: 在你杀死那条龙之前我不会卖给你任何东西！现在就出发吧。 [zai ni sha si na tiao long zhi qian wo bu hui mai gei ni ren he dong xi ！ xian zai jiu chu fa ba 。]

english: Yes, I have!
translation: 是的，我有！ [shi de ， wo you ！]

english: I have its head here.
translation: 我这里有它的头。 [wo zhe li you ta de tou 。]

english: You actually did it?
translation: 你真的做到了吗？ [ni zhen de zuo dao le ma ？]

english: I underestimated ye, adventurer. I apologise.
translation: 我低估了你，冒险者。我很抱歉。 [wo di gu le ni ， mao xian zhe 。 wo hen bao qian 。]

english: Yer a true hero, and I'd be happy to sell ye rune platebodies.
translation: 你是一个真正的英雄，我很乐意卖掉你的符文板。 [ni shi yi ge zhen zheng de ying xiong ， wo hen le yi mai diao ni de fu wen ban 。]

english: QUEST COMPLETED!
translation: 任务完成！ [ren wu wan cheng ！]

english: (missing, presumably the store is opened)
translation: （失踪了，估计是商店开张了） [（ shi zong le ， gu ji shi shang dian kai zhang le ）]

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Yer welcome.
translation: 欢迎。 [huan ying 。]

english: Aye, 'tis a fair day, my mighty dragon-slaying friend.
translation: 是的，这是美好的一天，我强大的屠龙朋友。 [shi de ， zhe shi mei hao de yi tian ， wo qiang da de tu long peng you 。]

english: Can I buy a rune platebody now please?
translation: 请问现在可以买符文板吗？ [qing wen xian zai ke yi mai fu wen ban ma ？]

english: Can I have another key to Melzar's Maze?
translation: 我能给我另一把梅尔扎迷宫的钥匙吗？ [wo neng gei wo ling yi ba mei er zha mi gong de yao shi ma ？]

english: It's the Guildmaster in the Champions' Guild who hands those keys out now. Go talk to him. No need to bother me if you don't need armour.
translation: 现在是冠军公会的公会长将这些钥匙发出来了。去跟他谈谈吧。如果你不需要盔甲，就不用打扰我。 [xian zai shi guan jun gong hui de gong hui zhang jiang zhe xie yao shi fa chu lai le 。 qu gen ta tan tan ba 。 ru guo ni bu xu yao kui jia ， jiu bu yong da rao wo 。]

english: I see ye've got one of them anti-dragon shields there. I've got an idea about them things.
translation: 我看到你们那里有一个反龙盾牌。我对这些事情有一个想法。 [wo kan dao ni men na li you yi ge fan long dun pai 。 wo dui zhe xie shi qing you yi ge xiang fa 。]

english: What's your idea about anti-dragon shields?
translation: 你对抗龙盾有什么看法？ [ni dui kang long dun you shen me kan fa ？]

english: See, when ye uses them to fight a dragon, they absorb the fire. The shield must be storing the dragonfire, and just letting it radiate away.
translation: 看，当你们用它们来对抗龙时，它们会吸收火焰。盾牌一定是储存了龙火，只是让它散发出去。 [kan ， dang ni men yong ta men lai dui kang long shi ， ta men hui xi shou huo yan 。 dun pai yi ding shi chu cun le long huo ， zhi shi rang ta san fa chu qu 。]

english: Now, if there was only a way to get the dragonfire out again...
translation: 现在，如果有办法让龙火再次熄灭就好了…… [xian zai ， ru guo you ban fa rang long huo zai ci xi mie jiu hao le ……]

english: What use would that be?
translation: 那有什么用呢？ [na you shen me yong ne ？]

english: Why, ain't it obvious? Ye could project blasts of dragonfire from yer shield!
translation: 为什么，这不是很明显吗？你可以从你的盾牌上发射龙火！ [wei shen me ， zhe bu shi hen ming xian ma ？ ni ke yi cong ni de dun pai shang fa she long huo ！]

english: Ye know, I think there might be a way.
translation: 你知道，我想可能有办法。 [ni zhi dao ， wo xiang ke neng you ban fa 。]

english: What way?
translation: 什么办法？ [shen me ban fa ？]

english: I've heard legends of a thing called a 'draconic visage'. It was made by the dragonkin themselves apparently.
translation: 我听说过一种叫做“龙面”的东西的传说。显然是龙族自己制作的。 [wo ting shuo guo yi zhong jiao zuo “ long mian ” de dong xi de chuan shuo 。 xian ran shi long zu zi ji zhi zuo de 。]

english: This 'draconic visage' had the power to channel dragonfire. Now, if I could attach the visage to the front of this shield...
translation: 这‘龙面’拥有引导龙火的力量。现在，如果我能将面容贴在这个盾牌的前面...... [zhe ‘ long mian ’ yong you yin dao long huo de li liang 。 xian zai ， ru guo wo neng jiang mian rong tie zai zhe ge dun pai de qian mian ......]

english: I will look for this draconic visage!
translation: 我要寻找这张龙的面容！ [wo yao xun zhao zhe zhang long de mian rong ！]

english: Good luck wi' that. They're mighty rare, so yer quest will take some time. If any monsters have them, it'll be the dragons.
translation: 祝你好运。它们非常罕见，所以你的任务需要一些时间。如果有任何怪物拥有它们，那就是龙。 [zhu ni hao yun 。 ta men fei chang han jian ， suo yi ni de ren wu xu yao yi xie shi jian 。 ru guo you ren he guai wu yong you ta men ， na jiu shi long 。]

english: Look at this visage.
translation: 看看这面容。 [kan kan zhe mian rong 。]

english: Amazin'! Ye can almost feel it pulsing with draconic power!
translation: 太棒了！你几乎可以感觉到它充满了龙之力量的脉动！ [tai bang le ！ ni ji hu ke yi gan jue dao ta chong man le long zhi li liang de mai dong ！]

english: Now, if ye bring me this and the anti-dragonbreath shield, I reckon I could combine them into something pretty special!
translation: 现在，如果你把这个和反龙息盾带给我，我想我可以将它们组合成一些非常特别的东西！ [xian zai ， ru guo ni ba zhe ge he fan long xi dun dai gei wo ， wo xiang wo ke yi jiang ta men zu he cheng yi xie fei chang te bie de dong xi ！]

english: Now, if ye want me to, I could attach this to yer anti-dragonbreath shield and make something pretty special.
translation: 现在，如果你们想让我这样做，我可以将它附加到你们的反龙息盾牌上，并制作一些非常特别的东西。 [xian zai ， ru guo ni men xiang rang wo zhe yang zuo ， wo ke yi jiang ta fu jia dao ni men de fan long xi dun pai shang ， bing zhi zuo yi xie fei chang te bie de dong xi 。]

english: I'll charge 1,250,000 coins to construct it. What d'ye say?
translation: 我将花费 1,250,000 金币来建造它。你们说什么？ [wo jiang hua fei  1,250,000  jin bi lai jian zao ta 。 ni men shuo shen me ？]

english: Yes please!
translation: 是的，请！ [shi de ， qing ！]

english: There ye go. Now, the more dragonfire the shield absorbs, the more powerful it'll become.
translation: 就这样吧。现在，盾牌吸收的龙火越多，它就会变得越强大。 [jiu zhe yang ba 。 xian zai ， dun pai xi shou de long huo yue duo ， ta jiu hui bian de yue qiang da 。]

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Suit yerself.
translation: 适合自己。 [shi he zi ji 。]

english: That's a bit expensive!
translation: 那就有点贵了！ [na jiu you dian gui le ！]

english: Yes it is. But I'm a master smith so I reckon I can charge what I like. Unless ye've got level 90 Smithing too, which I doubt!
translation: 是的。但我是一名铁匠大师，所以我想我可以收取我喜欢的费用。除非你的史密斯也达到了90级，我对此表示怀疑！ [shi de 。 dan wo shi yi ming tie jiang da shi ， suo yi wo xiang wo ke yi shou qu wo xi huan de fei yong 。 chu fei ni de shi mi si ye da dao le 90 ji ， wo dui ci biao shi huai yi ！]

english: No, I don't have level 90 Smithing.
translation: 不，我没有 90 级史密斯。 [bu ， wo mei you  90  ji shi mi si 。]

english: I thought not. I'm the master smith of Misthalin! So, shall I construct the shield for you?
translation: 我想不是。我是米斯哈林的铁匠大师！那么，要我为你建造盾牌吗？ [wo xiang bu shi 。 wo shi mi si ha lin de tie jiang da shi ！ na me ， yao wo wei ni jian zao dun pai ma ？]

english: Actually, I have got level 90 Smithing.
translation: 事实上，我的史密斯等级已经90级了。 [shi shi shang ， wo de shi mi si deng ji yi jing 90 ji le 。]

english: Oh! Well, I suppose ye don't need me for this then.
translation: 哦！好吧，我想那时你就不需要我了。 [o ！ hao ba ， wo xiang na shi ni jiu bu xu yao wo le 。]

english: The solving of this puzzle could be the key to your treasure.
translation: 解决这个谜题可能是打开你的宝藏的钥匙。 [jie jue zhe ge mi ti ke neng shi da kai ni de bao zang de yao shi 。]

english: That isn't right, keep trying.
translation: 这是不对的，继续努力吧。 [zhe shi bu dui de ， ji xu nu li ba 。]

english: Well done, traveller.
translation: 干得好，旅行者。 [gan de hao ， lv xing zhe 。]

english: I'm not your friend.
translation: 我不是你的朋友。 [wo bu shi ni de peng you 。]

english: Yes, it's a very nice day.
translation: 是的，这是非常美好的一天。 [shi de ， zhe shi fei chang mei hao de yi tian 。]

english: Can you sell me a rune platebody?
translation: 你能卖给我一个符文板吗？ [ni neng mai gei wo yi ge fu wen ban ma ？]

english: The Guildmaster of the Champions' Guild told me.
translation: 冠军公会的会长告诉我的。 [guan jun gong hui de hui zhang gao su wo de 。]

english: I am a master detective.
translation: 我是一名侦探大师。 [wo shi yi ming zhen tan da shi 。]

english: I thought you were going to give me a quest.
translation: 我以为你要给我一个任务。 [wo yi wei ni yao gei wo yi ge ren wu 。]

english: A dragon, that sounds like fun.
translation: 龙，听起来很有趣。 [long ， ting qi lai hen you qu 。]

english: I may be a champion, but I don't think I'm up to dragon-killing yet.
translation: 我可能是冠军，但我认为我还没有能力屠龙。 [wo ke neng shi guan jun ， dan wo ren wei wo hai mei you neng li tu long 。]

english: That's a pity, I'm not a hero.
translation: 可惜我不是英雄。 [ke xi wo bu shi ying xiong 。]

english: Can I buy a rune platebody now please?
translation: 请问现在可以买符文板吗？ [qing wen xian zai ke yi mai fu wen ban ma ？]

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Can I buy a rune platebody now, please?
translation: 请问现在可以买符文板吗？ [qing wen xian zai ke yi mai fu wen ban ma ？]

english: Can I have another key to Melzar's Maze?
translation: 我能给我另一把梅尔扎迷宫的钥匙吗？ [wo neng gei wo ling yi ba mei er zha mi gong de yao shi ma ？]

english: What's your idea about anti-dragon shields?
translation: 你对抗龙盾有什么看法？ [ni dui kang long dun you shen me kan fa ？]

english: What use would that be?
translation: 那有什么用呢？ [na you shen me yong ne ？]

english: What way?
translation: 什么办法？ [shen me ban fa ？]

english: I will look for this draconic visage!
translation: 我要寻找这张龙的面容！ [wo yao xun zhao zhe zhang long de mian rong ！]

english: Look at this visage.
translation: 看看这面容。 [kan kan zhe mian rong 。]

english: Yes, please!
translation: 是的，请！ [shi de ， qing ！]

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: That's a bit expensive!
translation: 那就有点贵了！ [na jiu you dian gui le ！]

english: Is this place haunted?
translation: 这个地方闹鬼吗？ [zhe ge di fang nao gui ma ？]

english: I don't think so. Would it matter if it was?
translation: 我不这么认为。如果是的话有什么关系吗？ [wo bu zhe me ren wei 。 ru guo shi de hua you shen me guan xi ma ？]

english: Maybe, it depends how haunted. I'm not a big fan of ghosts.
translation: 也许，这取决于闹鬼的程度。我不太喜欢鬼魂。 [ye xu ， zhe qu jue yu nao gui de cheng du 。 wo bu tai xi huan gui hun 。]

english: Well, let's hope it's not haunted!
translation: 好吧，希望它没有闹鬼！ [hao ba ， xi wang ta mei you nao gui ！]

english: Have you thought about painting the building?
translation: 你有没有想过粉刷这座建筑？ [ni you mei you xiang guo fen shua zhe zuo jian zhu ？]

english: I'm thinking a nice bold red, like the dragon armour.
translation: 我正在考虑一个漂亮的大胆的红色，就像龙铠一样。 [wo zheng zai kao lv yi ge piao liang de da dan de hong se ， jiu xiang long kai yi yang 。]

english: Or maybe a green, in memory of Elvarg, a very mean dragon.
translation: 或者也许是绿色的，以纪念埃尔瓦格，一条非常卑鄙的龙。 [huo zhe ye xu shi lv se de ， yi ji nian ai er wa ge ， yi tiao fei chang bei bi de long 。]

english: I think green would look great, it would match the surroundings, too!
translation: 我觉得绿色很好看，也很适合周围的环境！ [wo jue de lv se hen hao kan ， ye hen shi he zhou wei de huan jing ！]

english: Could I get one of those rune platebodies?
translation: 我可以得到一个符文板体吗？ [wo ke yi de dao yi ge fu wen ban ti ma ？]

english: Well, normally you'd have to slay a dragon for me...
translation: 好吧，通常你必须为我杀死一条龙...... [hao ba ， tong chang ni bi xu wei wo sha si yi tiao long ......]

english: ...but maybe I can make an exception once I've moved in here.
translation: ...不过也许我搬进来后可以破例。 [... bu guo ye xu wo ban jin lai hou ke yi po li 。]

english: As a little thank you for the help!
translation: 稍微感谢您的帮助！ [shao wei gan xie nin de bang zhu ！]

english: That would be great! Let's get this deal done quickly.
translation: 那太好了！让我们尽快完成这笔交易吧。 [na tai hao le ！ rang wo men jin kuai wan cheng zhe bi jiao yi ba 。]

english: I can't wait to complete the purchase!
translation: 我迫不及待地想完成购买！ [wo po bu ji dai di xiang wan cheng gou mai ！]

english: It's almost done Oziach, not much longer.
translation: 奥齐阿赫，一切都快完成了，没多久了。 [ao qi a he ， yi qie dou kuai wan cheng le ， mei duo jiu le 。]

english: Do you have any plans for it?
translation: 你对此有什么计划吗？ [ni dui ci you shen me ji hua ma ？]

english: I have a few. I might convert the top floor into a bar!
translation: 我有几个。我可能会把顶楼改成酒吧！ [wo you ji ge 。 wo ke neng hui ba ding lou gai cheng jiu ba ！]

english: It'll be for all dragon slayers I know, there's a lot of us!
translation: 这将是为了我认识的所有屠龙者，我们有很多人！ [zhe jiang shi wei le wo ren shi de suo you tu long zhe ， wo men you hen duo ren ！]

english: Interesting use of such a beautiful property!
translation: 如此美丽的财产的有趣用途！ [ru ci mei li de cai chan de you qu yong tu ！]

english: OoooOooOoOoOoooooooo!
translation: 噢噢噢噢噢噢噢噢噢！ [o o o o o o o o o ！]

english: Ah!! Why did you do that?
translation: 啊！！你为什么这么做？ [a ！！ ni wei shen me zhe me zuo ？]

english: That scared me!
translation: 那吓到我了！ [na xia dao wo le ！]

english: I'm sorry! I was just pretending to be a ghost.
translation: 对不起！我只是假装自己是个鬼而已。 [dui bu qi ！ wo zhi shi jia zhuang zi ji shi ge gui er yi 。]

english: Don't do that! I don't like ghosts.
translation: 不要那样做！我不喜欢鬼。 [bu yao na yang zuo ！ wo bu xi huan gui 。]

english: Hello Oziach.
translation: 你好，奥齐阿赫。 [ni hao ， ao qi a he 。]

english: Sorry [player name], I'm talking to the estate agent right now.
translation: 抱歉[玩家姓名]，我现在正在和房地产经纪人谈话。 [bao qian [ wan jia xing ming ]， wo xian zai zheng zai he fang di chan jing ji ren tan hua 。]

english: I'm going to head back to the office.
translation: 我要回办公室了。 [wo yao hui ban gong shi le 。]

english: Alright, I'll see you later. Can't wait to move in!
translation: 好的，稍后见。等不及要搬进去了！ [hao de ， shao hou jian 。 deng bu ji yao ban jin qu le ！]

english: I know, it's a lovely place! See you!
translation: 我知道，那是一个可爱的地方！再见！ [wo zhi dao ， na shi yi ge ke ai de di fang ！ zai jian ！]

english: The estate agent leaves.
translation: 房产经纪人离开。 [fang chan jing ji ren li kai 。]

english: Ahhh... soon to be mine.
translation: 啊啊……很快就会成为我的了。 [a a …… hen kuai jiu hui cheng wei wo de le 。]

english: The cutscene ends.
translation: 过场动画结束。 [guo chang dong hua jie shu 。]

english: Oziach is alone! Seems like the perfect time to scare him.
translation: 奥齐阿克孤身一人！看来正是吓唬他的最佳时机。 [ao qi a ke gu shen yi ren ！ kan lai zheng shi xia hu ta de zui jia shi ji 。]

english: I just need to climb this tree and blow on the bottle, that should do it.
translation: 我只需要爬上这棵树，对着瓶子吹气，就可以了。 [wo zhi xu yao pa shang zhe ke shu ， dui zhe ping zi chui qi ， jiu ke yi le 。]

english: I see you there, what are you doing?!
translation: 我看到你了，你在做什么？！ [wo kan dao ni le ， ni zai zuo shen me ？！]

english: Oziach caught me. I should try to be a bit faster next time.
translation: 奥齐阿克抓住了我。下次我应该尽量快一点。 [ao qi a ke zhua zhu le wo 。 xia ci wo ying gai jin liang kuai yi dian 。]

english: I should talk to Brother Jered about trying this again.
translation: 我应该和杰里德弟兄谈谈再试一次。 [wo ying gai he jie li de di xiong tan tan zai shi yi ci 。]

english: OOOoOOOooOOooOOOOoOOOO
translation: 噢噢噢噢噢噢噢噢噢噢 [o o o o o o o o o o]

english: The player shakes the evergreen tree slightly.
translation: 玩家轻轻摇晃常青树。 [wan jia qing qing yao huang chang qing shu 。]

english: What was that? A ghost?!
translation: 那是什么？鬼？！ [na shi shen me ？ gui ？！]

english: Hello?? Is that a ghost?
translation: 你好？？那是鬼吗？ [ni hao ？？ na shi gui ma ？]

english: ONE ghost? Haha, ONE ghost can't spook me!
translation: 一个幽灵？哈哈，一个鬼也吓不到我！ [yi ge you ling ？ ha ha ， yi ge gui ye xia bu dao wo ！]

english: The player returns to Brother Jered.
translation: 玩家回到杰里德修士身边。 [wan jia hui dao jie li de xiu shi shen bian 。]

english: Seems like I wasn't very scary. Oziach said ONE ghost isn't enough!
translation: 看来我并没有那么可怕。奥齐亚克说，一个幽灵还不够！ [kan lai wo bing mei you na me ke pa 。 ao qi ya ke shuo ， yi ge you ling hai bu gou ！]

english: I need to find another ghost, to scare Oziach from the trees on the other side of the path. That would work!
translation: 我需要找到另一个鬼魂，把奥齐阿克从小路另一边的树上吓走。那行得通！ [wo xu yao zhao dao ling yi ge gui hun ， ba ao qi a ke cong xiao lu ling yi bian de shu shang xia zou 。 na xing de tong ！]

english: I should talk to Brother Jered about this. Maybe he can help.
translation: 我应该和杰里德弟兄谈谈这件事。也许他能帮忙。 [wo ying gai he jie li de di xiong tan tan zhe jian shi 。 ye xu ta neng bang mang 。]

english: The estate agent should be back soon.
translation: 房地产经纪人应该很快就会回来。 [fang di chan jing ji ren ying gai hen kuai jiu hui hui lai 。]

english: What a wonderful day!
translation: 多么美好的一天啊！ [duo me mei hao de yi tian a ！]

english: It's quite the step up from my little humble house!
translation: 与我简陋的小房子相比，这是相当大的进步！ [yu wo jian lou de xiao fang zi xiang bi ， zhe shi xiang dang da de jin bu ！]

english: I am slightly worried about the ghost...
translation: 我有点担心鬼魂... [wo you dian dan xin gui hun ...]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm buying the monastery, so I'm just having a look around.
translation: 我买下了这座修道院，所以我只是四处看看。 [wo mai xia le zhe zuo xiu dao yuan ， suo yi wo zhi shi si chu kan kan 。]

english: Did you find anything interesting?
translation: 你发现什么有趣的事情了吗？ [ni fa xian shen me you qu de shi qing le ma ？]

english: Yes! But there is ONE ghost around. It's a little bit scary but ONE ghost isn't enough to scare me properly.
translation: 是的！但周围有一个鬼魂。有点吓人，但一个鬼魂不足以吓到我。 [shi de ！ dan zhou wei you yi ge gui hun 。 you dian xia ren ， dan yi ge gui hun bu zu yi xia dao wo 。]

english: Would TWO ghosts be enough to scare you?
translation: 两个鬼就足以吓到你吗？ [liang ge gui jiu zu yi xia dao ni ma ？]

english: I don't know, maybe, depends how scary they are.
translation: 我不知道，也许，这取决于它们有多可怕。 [wo bu zhi dao ， ye xu ， zhe qu jue yu ta men you duo ke pa 。]

english: Why are you asking?
translation: 你为什么问？ [ni wei shen me wen ？]

english: I'm just interested in ghosts, they're fascinating!
translation: 我只是对鬼魂感兴趣，它们很迷人！ [wo zhi shi dui gui hun gan xing qu ， ta men hen mi ren ！]

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好呀！ [ni hao ya ！]

english: How are you?
translation: 你好吗？ [ni hao ma ？]

english: I'm very well thank you. Very excited as I'm about to finish buying the monastery!
translation: 我很好，谢谢。非常兴奋，因为我即将完成修道院的购买！ [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。 fei chang xing fen ， yin wei wo ji jiang wan cheng xiu dao yuan de gou mai ！]

english: Did the ghosts not scare you off?
translation: 鬼魂没有吓跑你吗？ [gui hun mei you xia pao ni ma ？]

english: No, there was only ONE, so it wasn't that scary.
translation: 不，只有一个，所以没那么可怕。 [bu ， zhi you yi ge ， suo yi mei na me ke pa 。]

english: Only ONE ghost? I thought there were loads!
translation: 只有一个鬼魂？我以为有负载！ [zhi you yi ge gui hun ？ wo yi wei you fu zai ！]

english: I've only found ONE. If there are more, then I might have to rethink my purchase.
translation: 我只找到了一个。如果有更多，那么我可能不得不重新考虑我的购买。 [wo zhi zhao dao le yi ge 。 ru guo you geng duo ， na me wo ke neng bu de bu chong xin kao lv wo de gou mai 。]

english: Interesting.
translation: 有趣的。 [you qu de 。]

english: Why is that interesting?
translation: 为什么这很有趣？ [wei shen me zhe hen you qu ？]

english: I just thought there were lots of ghosts, but maybe there is only ONE!
translation: 我只是以为有很多鬼，但也许只有一个！ [wo zhi shi yi wei you hen duo gui ， dan ye xu zhi you yi ge ！]

english: Hi, [player name].
translation: 你好，[玩家姓名]。 [ni hao ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: What is going on here?
translation: 这是怎么回事？ [zhe shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: I'm just admiring the monastery, I'm going to purchase it!
translation: 我只是欣赏这座修道院，我要买下它！ [wo zhi shi xin shang zhe zuo xiu dao yuan ， wo yao mai xia ta ！]

english: Are you going to live there?
translation: 你要住在那里吗？ [ni yao zhu zai na li ma ？]

english: Yes! I'm going to turn it into a cool house, maybe add a swimming pool.
translation: 是的！我要把它变成一个很酷的房子，也许加一个游泳池。 [shi de ！ wo yao ba ta bian cheng yi ge hen ku de fang zi ， ye xu jia yi ge you yong chi 。]

english: I see. What are the monks going to do?
translation: 我懂了。和尚们要做什么？ [wo dong le 。 he shang men yao zuo shen me ？]

english: I don't know, find somewhere else to live!
translation: 不知道，还是找个地方住吧！ [bu zhi dao ， hai shi zhao ge di fang zhu ba ！]

english: Was that you hiding by the tree earlier?
translation: 刚才躲在树边的是你吗？ [gang cai duo zai shu bian de shi ni ma ？]

english: Nope, wasn't me! Must have been someone else.
translation: 不，不是我！一定是别人。 [bu ， bu shi wo ！ yi ding shi bie ren 。]

english: They looked a lot like you.
translation: 他们看起来很像你。 [ta men kan qi lai hen xiang ni 。]

english: I have quite a familiar face!
translation: 我有一张很熟悉的面孔！ [wo you yi zhang hen shu xi de mian kong ！]

english: I saw you by that tree earlier, what were you doing?
translation: 我刚才在那棵树下见过你，你在做什么？ [wo gang cai zai na ke shu xia jian guo ni ， ni zai zuo shen me ？]

english: I don't think that was me!
translation: 我不认为那是我！ [wo bu ren wei na shi wo ！]

english: Why were you sneaking around the trees earlier?
translation: 你刚才为什么要在树林里偷偷摸摸？ [ni gang cai wei shen me yao zai shu lin li tou tou mo mo ？]

english: That wasn't me, I've only just got here!
translation: 那不是我，我才刚到这里！ [na bu shi wo ， wo cai gang dao zhe li ！]

english: I'll keep an eye out for them though, they sound suspicious!
translation: 不过我会留意他们的，他们听起来很可疑！ [bu guo wo hui liu yi ta men de ， ta men ting qi lai hen ke yi ！]

english: Oziach spotted us! We'll have to try again. Talk to me when you're ready to try again.
translation: 奥齐亚克发现了我们！我们得再试一次。当您准备好再次尝试时，请与我联系。 [ao qi ya ke fa xian le wo men ！ wo men de zai shi yi ci 。 dang nin zhun bei hao zai ci chang shi shi ， qing yu wo lian xi 。]

english: Don't be too long though, the saucepan is quite heavy on my head! I'll be here.
translation: 不过别太久，平底锅压在我头上很重！我会在这里。 [bu guo bie tai jiu ， ping di guo ya zai wo tou shang hen zhong ！ wo hui zai zhe li 。]

english: The player climbs the first tree.
translation: 玩家爬上第一棵树。 [wan jia pa shang di yi ke shu 。]

english: BANG CLANG BANG
translation: 砰砰砰 [peng peng peng]

english: Ghosts?! More than ONE?! Stay away from me!
translation: 鬼魂？！不止一个？！离我远点！ [gui hun ？！ bu zhi yi ge ？！ li wo yuan dian ！]

english: Cutscene ends.
translation: 过场动画结束。 [guo chang dong hua jie shu 。]

english: Oziach seemed pretty scared after that! Time to go to the next tree along the path.
translation: 在那之后，奥齐亚克看起来很害怕！是时候去沿路的下一棵树了。 [zai na zhi hou ， ao qi ya ke kan qi lai hen hai pa ！ shi shi hou qu yan lu de xia yi ke shu le 。]

english: The player climbs the second tree.
translation: 玩家爬上第二棵树。 [wan jia pa shang di er ke shu 。]

english: BONG DING CLONG
translation: 邦鼎隆 [bang ding long]

english: ooOO ooooOOO OOOooo OOOOooo oooOoO oooOOOoo
translation: 哦哦哦哦哦哦哦哦哦哦哦哦哦哦哦哦哦哦哦 [o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o]

english: Ah! How many ghosts are there??
translation: 啊!到底有多少鬼？？ [a ! dao di you duo shao gui ？？]

english: It's working! Scaring Oziach one more time should do it!
translation: 它正在工作！再吓唬一下奥齐亚克就应该这么做了！ [ta zheng zai gong zuo ！ zai xia hu yi xia ao qi ya ke jiu ying gai zhe me zuo le ！]

english: The player climbs the third tree.
translation: 玩家爬上第三棵树。 [wan jia pa shang di san ke shu 。]

english: Help! Somebody help! The ghosts are chasing me!
translation: 帮助！有人帮忙！鬼魂在追我！ [bang zhu ！ you ren bang mang ！ gui hun zai zhui wo ！]

english: A cutscene starts. The estate agent arrives, and approaches Oziach.
translation: 过场动画开始。房地产经纪人到达并接近奥齐亚赫。 [guo chang dong hua kai shi 。 fang di chan jing ji ren dao da bing jie jin ao qi ya he 。]

english: So many ghosts... I need some help!
translation: 这么多鬼魂......我需要一些帮助！ [zhe me duo gui hun ...... wo xu yao yi xie bang zhu ！]

english: Oziach! Are you okay? I heard shouting!
translation: 奥齐阿赫！你还好吗？我听到喊叫声！ [ao qi a he ！ ni hai hao ma ？ wo ting dao han jiao sheng ！]

english: Hello! It's not going well. There are a lot of ghosts here!
translation: 你好！进展不顺利。这里有很多鬼魂！ [ni hao ！ jin zhan bu shun li 。 zhe li you hen duo gui hun ！]

english: That's not good at all!
translation: 这一点都不好！ [zhe yi dian dou bu hao ！]

english: Do you still want to go ahead with the purchase?
translation: 您还想继续购买吗？ [nin hai xiang ji xu gou mai ma ？]

english: Of course! TWO ghosts is scary, but not that scary!
translation: 当然！两个鬼虽然可怕，但也没有那么可怕！ [dang ran ！ liang ge gui sui ran ke pa ， dan ye mei you na me ke pa ！]

english: I'll hire myself one of those slayers we see everywhere.
translation: 我会雇佣自己成为我们随处可见的杀手之一。 [wo hui gu yong zi ji cheng wei wo men sui chu ke jian de sha shou zhi yi 。]

english: They will help with the ghost problem!
translation: 他们会帮助解决幽灵问题！ [ta men hui bang zhu jie jue you ling wen ti ！]

english: Phew, that is lovely news! I thought it was all over, then.
translation: 唷，这真是个好消息！那时我以为一切都结束了。 [yo ， zhe zhen shi ge hao xiao xi ！ na shi wo yi wei yi qie dou jie shu le 。]

english: I'll head back to the office, meet me there shortly.
translation: 我会回办公室，很快就在那里见我。 [wo hui hui ban gong shi ， hen kuai jiu zai na li jian wo 。]

english: I'll be doing the final paperwork.
translation: 我会做最后的文书工作。 [wo hui zuo zui hou de wen shu gong zuo 。]

english: We've failed. Oziach still wants to buy the monastery.
translation: 我们失败了。奥齐阿赫仍然想买下这座修道院。 [wo men shi bai le 。 ao qi a he reng ran xiang mai xia zhe zuo xiu dao yuan 。]

english: I thought TWO ghosts would be enough!
translation: 我以为两个鬼就够了！ [wo yi wei liang ge gui jiu gou le ！]

english: Maybe we need more ghosts? A THIRD ghost?
translation: 也许我们需要更多的鬼魂？第三个鬼魂？ [ye xu wo men xu yao geng duo de gui hun ？ di san ge gui hun ？]

english: I guess so. Let's go and place another advert in the Herald.
translation: 大概吧。我们去《先驱报》再登一则广告吧。 [da gai ba 。 wo men qu 《 xian qu bao 》 zai deng yi ze guang gao ba 。]

english: Wait...
translation: 等待... [deng dai ...]

english: A portal opens in front of Oziach, and Death appears before him.
translation: 一道传送门在奥齐亚克面前打开，死亡出现在他面前。 [yi dao chuan song men zai ao qi ya ke mian qian da kai ， si wang chu xian zai ta mian qian 。]

english: ...what is that??
translation: ...那是什么？ [... na shi shen me ？]

english: It is I, Death!
translation: 是我，死神！ [shi wo ， si shen ！]

english: Oh my...
translation: 哦天哪... [o tian na ...]

english: The scariest. The immortal. The terrifying. Me!
translation: 最可怕的。不朽者。可怕的。我！ [zui ke pa de 。 bu xiu zhe 。 ke pa de 。 wo ！]

english: Where are [player name] and Iffie? I must prove my scariness.
translation: [玩家姓名]和伊菲在哪里？我必须证明我的可怕。 [[ wan jia xing ming ] he yi fei zai na li ？ wo bi xu zheng ming wo de ke pa 。]

english: They will regret not picking me!
translation: 他们会后悔没有选我！ [ta men hui hou hui mei you xuan wo ！]

english: Death?!
translation: 死亡？！ [si wang ？！]

english: TOO SCARY!
translation: 太可怕了！ [tai ke pa le ！]

english: i'm off. You can keep the monastary!
translation: 我走了。你可以保留修道院！ [wo zou le 。 ni ke yi bao liu xiu dao yuan ！]

english: I'm off. You can keep the monastery!
translation: 我走了。你可以保留修道院！ [wo zou le 。 ni ke yi bao liu xiu dao yuan ！]

english: What? I don't want the monastery...?
translation: 什么？我不想要修道院……？ [shen me ？ wo bu xiang yao xiu dao yuan ……？]

english: Oziach walks away from Death.
translation: 奥齐亚克远离了死亡。 [ao qi ya ke yuan li le si wang 。]

english: I don't want to die!
translation: 我不想死！ [wo bu xiang si ！]

english: Mummmmmmmyyyy!
translation: 嗯嗯嗯！ [n n n ！]

english: What a strange mortal being...
translation: 多么奇怪的凡人啊…… [duo me qi guai de fan ren a ……]

english: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？ [ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Oh, nothing in particular really.
translation: 哦，其实没什么特别的。 [o ， qi shi mei shen me te bie de 。]

english: Well stop distracting me then. I'm meant to be guarding this sacred statue from the temple of Marimbo.
translation: Well stop distracting me then.我的职责是守护马林波神庙中的这座神圣雕像。 [Well stop distracting me then. wo de zhi ze shi shou hu ma lin bo shen miao zhong de zhe zuo shen sheng diao xiang 。]

english: Where is the temple of Marimbo?
translation: 马林波神庙在哪里？ [ma lin bo shen miao zai na li ？]

english: You're not from around here are you?
translation: 你不是这附近的人吧？ [ni bu shi zhe fu jin de ren ba ？]

english: Actually, I'm not. I'm a visitor from foreign lands.
translation: 事实上，我不是。我是一位来自异国他乡的访客。 [shi shi shang ， wo bu shi 。 wo shi yi wei lai zi yi guo ta xiang de fang ke 。]

english: Very well. The temple is to the east of the village.
translation: 很好。寺庙在村东。 [hen hao 。 si miao zai cun dong 。]

english: What is the statue of?
translation: 雕像是什么？ [diao xiang shi shen me ？]

english: It's of Marimbo, you cretin!
translation: 这是马林波，你这个白痴！ [zhe shi ma lin bo ， ni zhe ge bai chi ！]

english: Ah yes. How stupid of me not to see the likeness.
translation: 啊，是的。我真是太愚蠢了，没有看到相似之处。 [a ， shi de 。 wo zhen shi tai yu chun le ， mei you kan dao xiang si zhi chu 。]

english: I'll be back later.
translation: 我稍后会回来。 [wo shao hou hui hui lai 。]

english: I wouldn't count on it.
translation: 我不会指望它。 [wo bu hui zhi wang ta 。]

english: What!?
translation: 什么！？ [shen me ！？]

english: Oh, nothing.
translation: 哦，没什么。 [o ， mei shen me 。]

english: Where is the temple of Marimbo?
translation: 马林波神庙在哪里？ [ma lin bo shen miao zai na li ？]

english: What is the statue of?
translation: 雕像是什么？ [diao xiang shi shen me ？]

english: I'll be back later.
translation: 我稍后会回来。 [wo shao hou hui hui lai 。]

english: Hello there, what can I do for you?
translation: 您好，请问有什么可以帮您的吗？ [nin hao ， qing wen you shen me ke yi bang nin de ma ？]

english: I don't know, what can you do for me?
translation: 我不知道，你能为我做什么？ [wo bu zhi dao ， ni neng wei wo zuo shen me ？]

english: Well, I am somewhat of an expert in the field of magical traps.
translation: 嗯，我在魔法陷阱领域算是个专家了。 [n ， wo zai mo fa xian jing ling yu suan shi ge zhuan jia le 。]

english: Magical traps? What does that have to do with the Historical Archive?
translation: 魔法陷阱？这和历史档案馆有什么关系？ [mo fa xian jing ？ zhe he li shi dang an guan you shen me guan xi ？]

english: A good question. The Archive is actually part of the Tower of Magic, and was repurposed many decades ago.
translation: 这是个好问题。档案馆实际上是魔法塔的一部分，几十年前被重新利用。 [zhe shi ge hao wen ti 。 dang an guan shi ji shang shi mo fa ta de yi bu fen ， ji shi nian qian bei chong xin li yong 。]

english: Unfortunately, we don't possess full understanding of the Tower of Magic and its many enchantments, so we often discover remnants of traps.
translation: 不幸的是，我们对魔法之塔及其众多魔法并没有完全了解，所以我们经常发现陷阱的残余物。 [bu xing de shi ， wo men dui mo fa zhi ta ji qi zhong duo mo fa bing mei you wan quan liao jie ， suo yi wo men jing chang fa xian xian jing de can yu wu 。]

english: The task has fallen to me to investigate and study what we can of these enchantments in the hopes of understanding their magical power.
translation: 我的任务就是对这些魔法进行调查和研究，以期了解它们的神奇力量。 [wo de ren wu jiu shi dui zhe xie mo fa jin xing diao cha he yan jiu ， yi qi liao jie ta men de shen qi li liang 。]

english: What exactly is the Tower of Magic?
translation: 魔法之塔到底是什么？ [mo fa zhi ta dao di shi shen me ？]

english: The Tower of Magic is a uniquely enchanted building located just west of the library, though many levels and rooms are hidden from sight.
translation: 魔法之塔是一座独特的迷人建筑，位于图书馆西侧，尽管许多楼层和房间都隐藏在视线之外。 [mo fa zhi ta shi yi zuo du te de mi ren jian zhu ， wei yu tu shu guan xi ce ， jin guan xu duo lou ceng he fang jian dou yin cang zai shi xian zhi wai 。]

english: I have dedicated my life to studying the powerful enchantments that conceal the many levels of the Tower, though it proves difficult at times.
translation: 我一生致力于研究隐藏着塔楼多层的强大魔法，尽管有时这很困难。 [wo yi sheng zhi li yu yan jiu yin cang zhe ta lou duo ceng de qiang da mo fa ， jin guan you shi zhe hen kun nan 。]

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 还有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [hai you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

english: Tell me about the history of the Tower.
translation: 给我讲讲这座塔的历史吧。 [gei wo jiang jiang zhe zuo ta de li shi ba 。]

english: The Tower was constructed by King Rada III. We don't know exactly when, since dates were not recorded before the Twill Accord.
translation: 该塔由国王拉达三世建造。我们不知道确切的时间，因为斜纹协议之前没有记录日期。 [gai ta you guo wang la da san shi jian zao 。 wo men bu zhi dao que qie de shi jian ， yin wei xie wen xie yi zhi qian mei you ji lu ri qi 。]

english: Following the rebellion of the five houses against King Rada III, the Council of Elders was formed. They used the Tower as a meeting place for the Council.
translation: 在五个家族反抗国王拉达三世之后，长老会成立。他们使用塔楼作为理事会的会议场所。 [zai wu ge jia zu fan kang guo wang la da san shi zhi hou ， zhang lao hui cheng li 。 ta men shi yong ta lou zuo wei li shi hui de hui yi chang suo 。]

english: Since then, it has mostly been used as a residence by the various rulers of the kingdom, with each ruler using the Tower however they saw fit.
translation: 从那时起，它主要被王国的各个统治者用作住所，每位统治者都以他们认为合适的方式使用这座塔。 [cong na shi qi ， ta zhu yao bei wang guo de ge ge tong zhi zhe yong zuo zhu suo ， mei wei tong zhi zhe dou yi ta men ren wei he shi de fang shi shi yong zhe zuo ta 。]

english: Eventually, after Kourend Castle was built, ownership of the Tower was passed over to Lord Arceuus.
translation: 最终，库伦德城堡建成后，塔楼的所有权移交给了阿尔修斯勋爵。 [zui zhong ， ku lun de cheng bao jian cheng hou ， ta lou de suo you quan yi jiao gei le a er xiu si xun jue 。]

english: This room is part of the Tower?
translation: 这个房间是塔的一部分？ [zhe ge fang jian shi ta de yi bu fen ？]

english: Indeed. During the invasion of the Wintertodt, it was feared that all of Kourend might be lost to the cold. In order to preserve the history of the kingdom, this archive was created during the fifth decade.
translation: 的确。在温特托特入侵期间，人们担心整个库伦德可能会因寒冷而消失。为了保存王国的历史，这个档案馆是在第五个十年创建的。 [di que 。 zai wen te tuo te ru qin qi jian ， ren men dan xin zheng ge ku lun de ke neng hui yin han leng er xiao shi 。 wei le bao cun wang guo de li shi ， zhe ge dang an guan shi zai di wu ge shi nian chuang jian de 。]

english: Unfortunately, as it is a former chamber of the Tower, and we do not fully understand the magic that conceals it, we often discover strange enchantments that we believe to be old traps.
translation: 不幸的是，由于它是塔楼的前一个房间，而我们并不完全了解隐藏在其中的魔法，我们经常发现奇怪的结界，我们认为这些结界是古老的陷阱。 [bu xing de shi ， you yu ta shi ta lou de qian yi ge fang jian ， er wo men bing bu wan quan liao jie yin cang zai qi zhong de mo fa ， wo men jing chang fa xian qi guai de jie jie ， wo men ren wei zhe xie jie jie shi gu lao de xian jing 。]

english: Just recently we lost a scholar when she accidentally activated a portal and fell through it.
translation: 就在最近，我们失去了一位学者，她不小心启动了一个传送门并从其中掉了下来。 [jiu zai zui jin ， wo men shi qu le yi wei xue zhe ， ta bu xiao xin qi dong le yi ge chuan song men bing cong qi zhong diao le xia lai 。]

english: Was she okay?
translation: 她还好吗？ [ta hai hao ma ？]

english: Yes, she turned up a few days later, a little confused but physically fine. It happens every now and then, but most people turn up eventually.
translation: 是的，几天后她出现了，有点困惑，但身体状况良好。这种情况时常发生，但大多数人最终都会出现。 [shi de ， ji tian hou ta chu xian le ， you dian kun huo ， dan shen ti zhuang kuang liang hao 。 zhe zhong qing kuang shi chang fa sheng ， dan da duo shu ren zui zhong du hui chu xian 。]

english: I guess I'd better be careful then.
translation: 我想那我最好小心一点。 [wo xiang na wo zui hao xiao xin yi dian 。]

english: Just be cautious of walking into walls. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 只是要小心不要撞到墙壁。还有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [zhi shi yao xiao xin bu yao zhuang dao qiang bi 。 hai you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: I have a question about King Shayzien VII.
translation: 我有一个关于沙辛七世国王的问题。 [wo you yi ge guan yu sha xin qi shi guo wang de wen ti 。]

english: What do you wish to know?
translation: 您想知道什么？ [nin xiang zhi dao shen me ？]

english: I'm trying to find out more about the expedition he ordered to Mount Quidamortem.
translation: 我正在尝试了解有关他下令前往奎达莫特姆山探险的更多信息。 [wo zheng zai chang shi liao jie you guan ta xia ling qian wang kui da mo te mu shan tan xian de geng duo xin xi 。]

english: I'm afraid I don't have any information on that expedition. You're probably better off talking to one of the others.
translation: 恐怕我没有关于那次探险的任何信息。您最好与其他人中的一位交谈。 [kong pa wo mei you guan yu na ci tan xian de ren he xin xi 。 nin zui hao yu qi ta ren zhong de yi wei jiao tan 。]

english: I could tell you about the kings' work on the Tower of Magic though.
translation: 不过我可以告诉你国王们在魔法塔上的工作。 [bu guo wo ke yi gao su ni guo wang men zai mo fa ta shang de gong zuo 。]

english: Well it's either this or buying rubbish at the Grand Exchange, fire away.
translation: 好吧，要么就是这个，要么在大交易所买垃圾，滚吧。 [hao ba ， yao me jiu shi zhe ge ， yao me zai da jiao yi suo mai la ji ， gun ba 。]

english: Well it's either this or running around telling everyone I'm an Ironman.
translation: 好吧，要么就是这样，要么到处跑来告诉大家我是铁人三项。 [hao ba ， yao me jiu shi zhe yang ， yao me dao chu pao lai gao su da jia wo shi tie ren san xiang 。]

english: During the time of King Shayzien VII, the Tower of Magic was the seat of power in Kourend. The king spent a lot of his time at the Tower, more than any other king.
translation: 在国王沙伊恩七世时期，魔法塔是库伦德的权力所在地。国王在伦敦塔度过了很多时间，比任何其他国王都多。 [zai guo wang sha yi en qi shi shi qi ， mo fa ta shi ku lun de de quan li suo zai di 。 guo wang zai lun dun ta du guo le hen duo shi jian ， bi ren he qi ta guo wang dou duo 。]

english: In fact, he oversaw the construction of various new sections, most notably the prison.
translation: 事实上，他监督了各个新部分的建设，其中最著名的是监狱。 [shi shi shang ， ta jian du le ge ge xin bu fen de jian she ， qi zhong zui zhu ming de shi jian yu 。]

english: When was this?
translation: 这是什么时候的事？ [zhe shi shen me shi hou de shi ？]

english: Well now that I think about it, it was around the same time as the expedition you were asking about. I doubt the two are connected though.
translation: 好吧，现在想起来，那和你问的探险活动大约是在同一时间。我怀疑这两者之间有联系。 [hao ba ， xian zai xiang qi lai ， na he ni wen de tan xian huo dong da yue shi zai tong yi shi jian 。 wo huai yi zhe liang zhe zhi jian you lian xi 。]

english: I see. Would it be possible to visit the prison?
translation: 我懂了。可以参观监狱吗？ [wo dong le 。 ke yi can guan jian yu ma ？]

english: Well the prison is abandoned and has been for many years so I suppose there's no harm in letting you see it.
translation: 嗯，监狱已经废弃了很多年了，所以我想让你看看它也没什么坏处。 [n ， jian yu yi jing fei qi le hen duo nian le ， suo yi wo xiang rang ni kan kan ta ye mei shen me huai chu 。]

english: Be aware that the magic in that part of the tower is a bit unstable so any items left in the prison will be lost. Would you like me to teleport you there now?
translation: 请注意，塔那部分的魔法有点不稳定，因此监狱中留下的任何物品都会丢失。你需要我现在传送你到那里吗？ [qing zhu yi ， ta na bu fen de mo fa you dian bu wen ding ， yin ci jian yu zhong liu xia de ren he wu pin du hui diu shi 。 ni xu yao wo xian zai chuan song ni dao na li ma ？]

english: Very well, prepare yourself.
translation: 很好，做好准备。 [hen hao ， zuo hao zhun bei 。]

english: I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 如果你改变主意我会在这里。 [ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi wo hui zai zhe li 。]

english: What exactly is the Tower of Magic?
translation: 魔法之塔到底是什么？ [mo fa zhi ta dao di shi shen me ？]

english: Tell me about the history of the Tower
translation: 告诉我关于塔的历史 [gao su wo guan yu ta de li shi]

english: This room is part of the Tower?
translation: 这个房间是塔的一部分？ [zhe ge fang jian shi ta de yi bu fen ？]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: I don't know, what can you do for me?
translation: 我不知道，你能为我做什么？ [wo bu zhi dao ， ni neng wei wo zuo shen me ？]

english: I have a question about King Shayzien VII.
translation: 我有一个关于沙辛七世国王的问题。 [wo you yi ge guan yu sha xin qi shi guo wang de wen ti 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: What's going on?
translation: 这是怎么回事？ [zhe shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: Speaking would certainly help your case.
translation: 说话肯定会对你的案子有所帮助。 [shuo hua ken ding hui dui ni de an zi you suo bang zhu 。]

english: Well, okay then.
translation: 好吧，那么好吧。 [hao ba ， na me hao ba 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Ohh, I know you. You're the one that helped father take the throne! Of course, now it's my brothers throne instead.
translation: 哦，我认识你。你是帮助父亲登上王位的人！当然，现在是我兄弟的王位了。 [o ， wo ren shi ni 。 ni shi bang zhu fu qin deng shang wang wei de ren ！ dang ran ， xian zai shi wo xiong di de wang wei le 。]

english: Which I'm guessing makes you the new Lord Hosidius? How's that going?
translation: 我猜这会让你成为新的霍西迪乌斯勋爵？怎么样？ [wo cai zhe hui rang ni cheng wei xin de huo xi di wu si xun jue ？ zen me yang ？]

english: Boring! Things were much more fun when my only job was to taste the wine and get drunk.
translation: 无聊的！当我唯一的工作就是品尝葡萄酒并喝醉时，事情变得更有趣。 [wu liao de ！ dang wo wei yi de gong zuo jiu shi pin chang pu tao jiu bing he zui shi ， shi qing bian de geng you qu 。]

english: You still seem to be enjoying the wine just fine.
translation: 你似乎仍然很享受这杯酒。 [ni si hu reng ran hen xiang shou zhe bei jiu 。]

english: Yes, but now I have to do other things as well.
translation: 是的，但现在我还必须做其他事情。 [shi de ， dan xian zai wo hai bi xu zuo qi ta shi qing 。]

english: It must be very hard for you.
translation: 这对你来说一定很难。 [zhe dui ni lai shuo yi ding hen nan 。]

english: It is. Now, if you'll excuse me, I'm going to have another drink.
translation: 这是。现在，请原谅，我要再喝一杯。 [zhe shi 。 xian zai ， qing yuan liang ， wo yao zai he yi bei 。]

english: Hello, who are you?
translation: 你好，你是谁？ [ni hao ， ni shi shui ？]

english: Hello, I am the panning guide. I'm here to teach you how to pan for gold.
translation: 大家好，我是平移向导。我来这里是为了教你如何淘金。 [da jia hao ， wo shi ping yi xiang dao 。 wo lai zhe li shi wei le jiao ni ru he tao jin 。]

english: Excellent!
translation: 出色的！ [chu se de ！]

english: Let me explain how panning works. First you need a panning tray. Use the tray in the panning points in the water and then search your tray.
translation: 让我解释一下平移的工作原理。首先你需要一个平移托盘。在水中的摇摄点使用托盘，然后搜索托盘。 [rang wo jie shi yi xia ping yi de gong zuo yuan li 。 shou xian ni xu yao yi ge ping yi tuo pan 。 zai shui zhong de yao she dian shi yong tuo pan ， ran hou sou suo tuo pan 。]

english: If you find any gold, take it to the archaeological expert up in the museum storage facility. He will calculate its value for you.
translation: 如果您发现任何黄金，请将其交给博物馆储藏室的考古专家。他会为你计算它的价值。 [ru guo nin fa xian ren he huang jin ， qing jiang qi jiao gei bo wu guan chu cang shi de kao gu zhuan jia 。 ta hui wei ni ji suan ta de jia zhi 。]

english: Can you tell me more about the tools an archaeologist uses?
translation: 您能告诉我更多关于考古学家使用的工具的信息吗？ [nin neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu kao gu xue jia shi yong de gong ju de xin xi ma ？]
