english: Of course! Let's see now... Rock picks are for splitting rocks or scraping away soil; you can get one from a cupboard in the Education Centre.
translation: 当然！现在让我们看看... 岩石镐用于劈开岩石或刮去土壤；您可以从教育中心的柜子里拿到一份。 [dang ran ！ xian zai rang wo men kan kan ...  yan shi gao yong yu pi kai yan shi huo gua qu tu rang ； nin ke yi cong jiao yu zhong xin de gui zi li na dao yi fen 。]

english: What about sample jars?
translation: 样品罐怎么样？ [yang pin guan zen me yang ？]

english: I think you'll find them scattered about pretty much everywhere, but I know you can get one from a cupboard somewhere in the Education Centre, just like the rock pick!
translation: 我想你会发现它们几乎散落在各处，但我知道你可以从教育中心某处的橱柜里找到一个，就像石镐一样！ [wo xiang ni hui fa xian ta men ji hu san luo zai ge chu ， dan wo zhi dao ni ke yi cong jiao yu zhong xin mou chu de chu gui li zhao dao yi ge ， jiu xiang shi gao yi yang ！]

english: Okay, what about a specimen brush?
translation: 好吧，标本刷怎么样？ [hao ba ， biao ben shua zen me yang ？]

english: We have a bit of a shortage of those at the moment. You could try borrowing one from a workman on the site... but I don't think they'd give it willingly.
translation: 目前我们还有些短缺。你可以尝试从网站上的工人那里借一个……但我认为他们不会愿意给的。 [mu qian wo men hai you xie duan que 。 ni ke yi chang shi cong wang zhan shang de gong ren na li jie yi ge …… dan wo ren wei ta men bu hui yuan yi gei de 。]

english: Sounds like I'll need to be sneaky to get one of those, then... Okay - trowel?
translation: 听起来我需要偷偷摸摸才能得到其中一个，然后...好吧 - 抹子？ [ting qi lai wo xu yao tou tou mo mo cai neng de dao qi zhong yi ge ， ran hou ... hao ba  -  mo zi ？]

english: Ahh... that you must earn by passing your exams! The examiner holds those.
translation: 啊……你必须通过考试才能赚钱！考官持有这些。 [a …… ni bi xu tong guo kao shi cai neng zhuan qian ！ kao guan chi you zhe xie 。]

english: Anything else?
translation: 还要别的吗？ [hai yao bie de ma ？]

english: If you need something identified or are not sure about something, give it to Terry; he's the archaeological expert in the next room.
translation: If you need something identified or are not sure about something, give it to Terry;他是隔壁房间的考古专家。 [If you need something identified or are not sure about something, give it to Terry; ta shi ge bi fang jian de kao gu zhuan jia 。]

english: Ahh, ok thanks.
translation: 啊，好的，谢谢。 [a ， hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Thank you!
translation: 谢谢你！ [xie xie ni ！]

english: Can you tell me more about the tools an archaeologist uses?
translation: 您能告诉我更多关于考古学家使用的工具的信息吗？ [nin neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu kao gu xue jia shi yong de gong ju de xin xi ma ？]

english: Thank you!
translation: 谢谢你！ [xie xie ni ！]

english: Hey there.
translation: 嘿。 [hei 。]

english: Hi hi.
translation: 嗨嗨。 [hai hai 。]

english: Can't talk too long. I've got to go fast.
translation: 不能讲太久。我得快点走。 [bu neng jiang tai jiu 。 wo de kuai dian zou 。]

english: Why do you need to go fast?
translation: 为什么你需要走快点？ [wei shen me ni xu yao zou kuai dian ？]

english: Fast is better.
translation: 快一点更好。 [kuai yi dian geng hao 。]

english: You might go a little faster if you put down that giant clock.
translation: 如果你放下那个巨大的时钟，你可能会走得更快一些。 [ru guo ni fang xia na ge ju da de shi zhong ， ni ke neng hui zou de geng kuai yi xie 。]

english: Then how would I check the time?
translation: 那我该如何查看时间呢？ [na wo gai ru he cha kan shi jian ne ？]

english: That's a good point.
translation: 这是一个很好的观点。 [zhe shi yi ge hen hao de guan dian 。]

english: I don't think you'll be going anywhere at this rate. That goose hasn't moved an inch.
translation: 我认为按照这个速度你不会去任何地方。那只鹅一动不动。 [wo ren wei an zhao zhe ge su du ni bu hui qu ren he di fang 。 na zhi e yi dong bu dong 。]

english: Be patient [player name], geese always move and cause mischief. If not, I know what we can serve for dinner in the pub.
translation: 要有耐心[玩家名字]，鹅总是会移动并造成恶作剧。如果没有，我知道我们在酒吧晚餐可以吃什么。 [yao you nai xin [ wan jia ming zi ]， e zong shi hui yi dong bing zao cheng e zuo ju 。 ru guo mei you ， wo zhi dao wo men zai jiu ba wan can ke yi chi shen me 。]

english: Oh my.
translation: 天哪。 [tian na 。]

english: I'll leave you to it then! Good luck!
translation: 那我就留着你了！祝你好运！ [na wo jiu liu zhe ni le ！ zhu ni hao yun ！]

english: You too!
translation: 你也是！ [ni ye shi ！]

english: Aha! Are you here to parley?
translation: 啊哈！你是来谈判的吗？ [a ha ！ ni shi lai tan pan de ma ？]

english: I don't think so.
translation: 我不这么认为。 [wo bu zhe me ren wei 。]

english: Oh, that's a shame.
translation: 噢，真可惜。 [o ， zhen ke xi 。]

english: Do you parley here often?
translation: 你们经常在这里谈判吗？ [ni men jing chang zai zhe li tan pan ma ？]

english: I parley everywhere! I haven't encountered a single problem I've not been able to parley my way out of.
translation: 我到处谈判！我还没有遇到过无法通过谈判解决的问题。 [wo dao chu tan pan ！ wo hai mei you yu dao guo wu fa tong guo tan pan jie jue de wen ti 。]

english: Really? That just works?
translation: 真的吗？就这样有效吗？ [zhen de ma ？ jiu zhe yang you xiao ma ？]

english: That's right! Whenever I run into trouble, I just shout parley! To be honest with you, I don't know the first thing about actually being a pirate. All my wealth just comes from parleying all the time.
translation: 这是正确的！每当我遇到麻烦时，我就喊谈判！老实说，我对成为一名海盗一无所知。我所有的财富都来自于不断的谈判。 [zhe shi zheng que de ！ mei dang wo yu dao ma fan shi ， wo jiu han tan pan ！ lao shi shuo ， wo dui cheng wei yi ming hai dao yi wu suo zhi 。 wo suo you de cai fu dou lai zi yu bu duan de tan pan 。]

english: I see. It really feels like that's going to go horribly wrong for you at some point.
translation: 我懂了。真的感觉在某个时候这对你来说会变得非常错误。 [wo dong le 。 zhen de gan jue zai mou ge shi hou zhe dui ni lai shuo hui bian de fei chang cuo wu 。]

english: Nonsense! At the rate I'm going, I'm going to be the greatest pirate ever to have lived! Parley! Parley! Parley!
translation: 废话！按照我现在的速度，我将成为有史以来最伟大的海盗！谈判！谈判！谈判！ [fei hua ！ an zhao wo xian zai de su du ， wo jiang cheng wei you shi yi lai zui wei da de hai dao ！ tan pan ！ tan pan ！ tan pan ！]

english: Awk! Awk! Rum's done! Rum's done!
translation: 哎呀！哎呀！朗姆酒完成了！朗姆酒完成了！ [ai ya ！ ai ya ！ lang mu jiu wan cheng le ！ lang mu jiu wan cheng le ！]

english: Awk! More ingredients! More ingredients!
translation: 哎呀！更多成分！更多成分！ [ai ya ！ geng duo cheng fen ！ geng duo cheng fen ！]

english: Awk! Feed the fires! Feed the fires!
translation: 哎呀！火上浇油！火上浇油！ [ai ya ！ huo shang jiao you ！ huo shang jiao you ！]

english: Awk! Gimme a cracker!
translation: 哎呀！给我一块饼干！ [ai ya ！ gei wo yi kuai bing gan ！]

english: Polly, what should we do?
translation: 波莉，我们该怎么办？ [bo li ， wo men gai zen me ban ？]

english: Good day, good day. Come to admire the new parrot aviary have we?
translation: Good day, good day.我们来欣赏一下新的鹦鹉鸟舍吗？ [Good day, good day. wo men lai xin shang yi xia xin de ying wu niao she ma ？]

english: It's very nice.
translation: 非常好。 [fei chang hao 。]

english: Isn't it just?
translation: 不是吗？ [bu shi ma ？]

english: When did you add it?
translation: 你什么时候添加的？ [ni shen me shi hou tian jia de ？]

english: Just recently. It would have been sooner, but some wretch thought it would be amusing to replace their drinking water with vodka. The vet had to nurse them back to health for weeks!
translation: 刚刚。本来可以更快，但一些可怜虫认为用伏特加代替饮用水会很有趣。兽医必须护理它们数周才能恢复健康！ [gang gang 。 ben lai ke yi geng kuai ， dan yi xie ke lian chong ren wei yong fu te jia dai ti yin yong shui hui hen you qu 。 shou yi bi xu hu li ta men shu zhou cai neng hui fu jian kang ！]

english: What do you feed them?
translation: 你给他们吃什么？ [ni gei ta men chi shen me ？]

english: Well, fruit and grain mostly. I try to give them a balanced diet, but their favourite treat is pineapple chunks.
translation: 嗯，主要是水果和谷物。我试着给他们均衡的饮食，但他们最喜欢的食物是菠萝块。 [n ， zhu yao shi shui guo he gu wu 。 wo shi zhe gei ta men jun heng de yin shi ， dan ta men zui xi huan de shi wu shi bo luo kuai 。]

english: Hey! What are you doing with that parrot?
translation: 嘿！你在和那只鹦鹉做什么？ [hei ！ ni zai he na zhi ying wu zuo shen me ？]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: It looks drunk! You should NEVER feed alcohol to a parrot!
translation: 看起来醉了！你绝对不应该给鹦鹉喂酒精！ [kan qi lai zui le ！ ni jue dui bu ying gai gei ying wu wei jiu jing ！]

english: Well, good thing I found it! I'll just take it to the vet for you, shall I?
translation: 嗯，还好我找到了！我帮你带它去看兽医，可以吗？ [n ， hai hao wo zhao dao le ！ wo bang ni dai ta qu kan shou yi ， ke yi ma ？]

english: Oh, thank you! We're ever so busy here at the Zoo.
translation: 哦，谢谢你！我们在动物园一直很忙。 [o ， xie xie ni ！ wo men zai dong wu yuan yi zhi hen mang 。]

english: It's very nice.
translation: 非常好。 [fei chang hao 。]

english: When did you add it?
translation: 你什么时候添加的？ [ni shen me shi hou tian jia de ？]

english: What do you feed them?
translation: 你给他们吃什么？ [ni gei ta men chi shen me ？]

english: Hi! I'm Party Pete. Welcome to the Party Room!
translation: 你好！ I'm Party Pete.欢迎来到派对室！ [ni hao ！ I'm Party Pete. huan ying lai dao pai dui shi ！]

english: So what's this room for?
translation: 那么这个房间是做什么用的呢？ [na me zhe ge fang jian shi zuo shen me yong de ne ？]

english: This room is for partying the night away!
translation: 这个房间适合晚上聚会！ [zhe ge fang jian shi he wan shang ju hui ！]

english: How do you have a party in Gielinor?
translation: 如何在吉林诺举办派对？ [ru he zai ji lin nuo ju ban pai dui ？]

english: Get a few mates round, get the beers in and have fun!
translation: 约上三五好友，喝杯啤酒，尽情享受吧！ [yue shang san wu hao you ， he bei pi jiu ， jin qing xiang shou ba ！]

english: Some players organise parties so keep an eye open!
translation: 有些玩家会组织聚会，所以请留意！ [you xie wan jia hui zu zhi ju hui ， suo yi qing liu yi ！]

english: Woop! Thanks Pete!
translation: 哇！ Thanks Pete! [wa ！ Thanks Pete!]

english: What's the big lever over there for?
translation: 那个大杠杆是干什么用的？ [na ge da gang gan shi gan shen me yong de ？]

english: Simple. With the lever you can do some fun stuff.
translation: 简单的。使用杠杆，您可以做一些有趣的事情。 [jian dan de 。 shi yong gang gan ， nin ke yi zuo yi xie you qu de shi qing 。]

english: What kind of stuff?
translation: 什么样的东西？ [shen me yang de dong xi ？]

english: A balloon drop costs 1000 gold. For this you get 200 balloons dropped across the whole of the party room. You can then have fun popping the balloons! If there are items in the Party Drop Chest they will be inside
translation: 掉落一个气球需要 1000 金币。为此，您需要向整个宴会厅扔 200 个气球。然后你就可以享受爆气球的乐趣了！如果派对掉落箱中有物品，它们就会在里面 [diao luo yi ge qi qiu xu yao  1000  jin bi 。 wei ci ， nin xu yao xiang zheng ge yan hui ting reng  200  ge qi qiu 。 ran hou ni jiu ke yi xiang shou bao qi qiu de le qu le ！ ru guo pai dui diao luo xiang zhong you wu pin ， ta men jiu hui zai li mian]

english: the balloons! For 500 gold you can summon the Party Room Knights who will dance for your delight.
translation: 气球！只需花费 500 金币，您就可以召唤派对房间骑士，他们会为您带来欢乐的舞蹈。 [qi qiu ！ zhi xu hua fei  500  jin bi ， nin jiu ke yi zhao huan pai dui fang jian qi shi ， ta men hui wei nin dai lai huan le de wu dao 。]

english: Their singing isn't a delight though!
translation: 但他们的歌声并不令人愉快！ [dan ta men de ge sheng bing bu ling ren yu kuai ！]

english: What's the gold chest for?
translation: 金箱子有什么用？ [jin xiang zi you shen me yong ？]

english: Any items that are in the chest will be dropped inside the balloons when you pull the lever!
translation: 当您拉动控制杆时，箱子中的任何物品都会掉入气球内！ [dang nin la dong kong zhi gan shi ， xiang zi zhong de ren he wu pin du hui diao ru qi qiu nei ！]

english: Cool! Sounds like a fun way to do a drop party!
translation: 凉爽的！听起来是举办派对的有趣方式！ [liang shuang de ！ ting qi lai shi ju ban pai dui de you qu fang shi ！]

english: Exactly!
translation: 确切地！ [que qie di ！]

english: A word of warning though. Any items that you put into the chest can't be taken out again and it costs 1000 gold pieces for each balloon drop.
translation: 不过有一句警告。放入宝箱中的任何物品都无法再次取出，每个气球掉落需要花费 1000 金币。 [bu guo you yi ju jing gao 。 fang ru bao xiang zhong de ren he wu pin dou wu fa zai ci qu chu ， mei ge qi qiu diao luo xu yao hua fei  1000  jin bi 。]

english: Have you always been here in Falador?
translation: 你一直在法拉多吗？ [ni yi zhi zai fa la duo ma ？]

english: We used to be in Seers' Village, far to the west, but we had to move - the seers were complaining about the noise level, and the knights of Camelot got it into their heads that the Party Room knights were making fun of
translation: 我们曾经在西边的先知村，但我们必须搬家——先知们抱怨噪音水平，而卡米洛特的骑士们则把聚会室骑士们取笑的事记在了脑子里 [wo men ceng jing zai xi bian de xian zhi cun ， dan wo men bi xu ban jia —— xian zhi men bao yuan zao yin shui ping ， er ka mi luo te de qi shi men ze ba ju hui shi qi shi men qu xiao de shi ji zai le nao zi li]

english: them.
translation: 他们。 [ta men 。]

english: We're doing well here, though. The people of Falador are happy we're here, and we've hardly ever had the White Knights telling us to keep the noise down.
translation: 不过，我们在这里做得很好。法拉多的人民很高兴我们来到这里，而且白骑士几乎从未告诉我们要小声点。 [bu guo ， wo men zai zhe li zuo de hen hao 。 fa la duo de ren min hen gao xing wo men lai dao zhe li ， er qie bai qi shi ji hu cong wei gao su wo men yao xiao sheng dian 。]

english: We're going to turn Falador into the party capital of Gielinor!
translation: 我们要把法拉多变成吉林诺的党都！ [wo men yao ba fa la duo bian cheng ji lin nuo de dang dou ！]

english: I wanna party!
translation: 我想聚会！ [wo xiang ju hui ！]

english: I've won the Dance Trophy at the Kandarin Ball three years in a trot!
translation: 我连续三年在坎达林舞会上赢得了舞蹈奖杯！ [wo lian xu san nian zai kan da lin wu hui shang ying de le wu dao jiang bei ！]

english: Show me your moves Pete!
translation: 皮特，让我看看你的动作！ [pi te ， rang wo kan kan ni de dong zuo ！]

english: Party Pete dances and cheers, then ends in a bow.
translation: 派对皮特跳舞欢呼，最后鞠躬结束。 [pai dui pi te tiao wu huan hu ， zui hou ju gong jie shu 。]

english: You've come to the right place!
translation: 您来对地方了！ [nin lai dui di fang le ！]

english: Party Pete has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 派对皮特给了你另一条线索卷轴！ [pai dui pi te gei le ni ling yi tiao xian suo juan zhou ！]

english: So what's this room for?
translation: 那么这个房间是做什么用的呢？ [na me zhe ge fang jian shi zuo shen me yong de ne ？]

english: What's the big lever over there for?
translation: 那个大杠杆是干什么用的？ [na ge da gang gan shi gan shen me yong de ？]

english: What's the gold chest for?
translation: 金箱子有什么用？ [jin xiang zi you shen me yong ？]

english: Have you always been here in Falador?
translation: 你一直在法拉多吗？ [ni yi zhi zai fa la duo ma ？]

english: I wanna party!
translation: 我想聚会！ [wo xiang ju hui ！]

english: By Ralos! Itsthe Grand Champion!
translation: 拉洛斯写的！它是总冠军！ [la luo si xie de ！ ta shi zong guan jun ！]

english: Itsreally you, isn't it? This is my best day ever!
translation: 真的是你，不是吗？这是我有史以来最美好的一天！ [zhen de shi ni ， bu shi ma ？ zhe shi wo you shi yi lai zui mei hao de yi tian ！]

english: Have you spoken to the minotaur? What's he like in real life?
translation: 你和牛头怪交谈过吗？现实生活中的他是什么样的？ [ni he niu tou guai jiao tan guo ma ？ xian shi sheng huo zhong de ta shi shen me yang de ？]

english: You really stuck it to that Sol guy! He's not so tough now.
translation: 你真的把它粘在那个索尔家伙身上了！他现在没那么强硬了。 [ni zhen de ba ta zhan zai na ge suo er jia huo shen shang le ！ ta xian zai mei na me qiang ying le 。]

english: Can we get a portrait together?
translation: 我们可以一起合影吗？ [wo men ke yi yi qi he ying ma ？]

english: Can you get me into the arena? They banned me after last time...
translation: 你能带我进入竞技场吗？自从上次之后他们就把我禁言了... [ni neng dai wo jin ru jing ji chang ma ？ zi cong shang ci zhi hou ta men jiu ba wo jin yan le ...]

english: Can I shine your boots? Maybe polish your blade?
translation: 我可以擦你的靴子吗？也许擦亮你的刀片？ [wo ke yi ca ni de xue zi ma ？ ye xu ca liang ni de dao pian ？]

english: Can I get an autograph?
translation: 我可以得到签名吗？ [wo ke yi de dao qian ming ma ？]

english: You're so dreamy.
translation: 你真是太梦幻了。 [ni zhen shi tai meng huan le 。]

english: You smell like victory.
translation: 你闻起来有胜利的味道。 [ni wen qi lai you sheng li de wei dao 。]

english: I've been thinking, we should hang out. You'd like me if you got to know me!
translation: 我一直在想，我们应该出去玩。如果你了解我，你就会喜欢我！ [wo yi zhi zai xiang ， wo men ying gai chu qu wan 。 ru guo ni liao jie wo ， ni jiu hui xi huan wo ！]

english: Are you free this weekend? I'm free this weekend. We should hang out!
translation: 这个周末你有空吗？我这个周末有空。我们应该出去玩！ [zhe ge zhou mo ni you kong ma ？ wo zhe ge zhou mo you kong 。 wo men ying gai chu qu wan ！]

english: Wowee!
translation: 哇哇！ [wa wa ！]

english: Hello there! Can I sew ye somethin' tegether?
translation: 你好呀！我可以给你们缝一些东西吗？ [ni hao ya ！ wo ke yi gei ni men feng yi xie dong xi ma ？]

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你是什​​么意思？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: Well, ye see it works like this; I can sew yer eye patches onto yer pirate hats or pirate bandanas.
translation: 嗯，你看它是这样工作的；我可以把你的眼罩缝到你的海盗帽子或海盗头巾上。 [n ， ni kan ta shi zhe yang gong zuo de ； wo ke yi ba ni de yan zhao feng dao ni de hai dao mao zi huo hai dao tou jin shang 。]

english: Just pirate bandanas mind ye, I hate the feel of snakeskin. (Shudder)
translation: 只是海盗头巾请注意，我讨厌蛇皮的感觉。 （不寒而栗） [zhi shi hai dao tou jin qing zhu yi ， wo tao yan she pi de gan jue 。 （ bu han er li ）]

english: It costs 500 gold te do it, and 600 gold te get them separated.
translation: 做这件事需要花费 500 金币，而将它们分开需要 600 金币。 [zuo zhe jian shi xu yao hua fei  500  jin bi ， er jiang ta men fen kai xu yao  600  jin bi 。]

english: Ok, why does it cost more to get them separated than put together?
translation: 好吧，为什么把它们分开比放在一起要花费更多呢？ [hao ba ， wei shen me ba ta men fen kai bi fang zai yi qi yao hua fei geng duo ne ？]

english: Wear and tear on scissors.
translation: 剪刀上的磨损。 [jian dao shang de mo sun 。]

english: On another note, I also sew crab claw gauntlets on to pirate hooks, highwayman masks to black cavaliers, mime masks to black berets, partyhats to glasses and monocles to top hats if ye have them with ye.
translation: 另一方面，我还将蟹爪手套缝在海盗钩上，将强盗面具缝在黑色骑士上，将哑剧面具缝在黑色贝雷帽上，将派对帽缝在眼镜上，将单片眼镜缝在大礼帽上（如果你有的话）。 [ling yi fang mian ， wo hai jiang xie zhao shou tao feng zai hai dao gou shang ， jiang qiang dao mian ju feng zai hei se qi shi shang ， jiang ya ju mian ju feng zai hei se bei lei mao shang ， jiang pai dui mao feng zai yan jing shang ， jiang dan pian yan jing feng zai da li mao shang （ ru guo ni you de hua ）。]

english: If ye also have some flippers and suitably evil lookin' claws, I can probably put them together too.
translation: 如果你们也有一些鳍状肢和看起来很邪恶的爪子，我也许也可以把它们放在一起。 [ru guo ni men ye you yi xie qi zhuang zhi he kan qi lai hen xie e de zhua zi ， wo ye xu ye ke yi ba ta men fang zai yi qi 。]

english: So, do ye have anything ye wants doin?
translation: 那么，你们有什么想做的事吗？ [na me ， ni men you shen me xiang zuo de shi ma ？]

english: Yes please!
translation: 是的，请！ [shi de ， qing ！]

english: Sure, but remember I charge 500 coins, so if you don't have them you'll have to come back later!
translation: 当然可以，但请记住，我收取 500 个硬币，所以如果你没有，你就得稍后再回来！ [dang ran ke yi ， dan qing ji zhu ， wo shou qu  500  ge ying bi ， suo yi ru guo ni mei you ， ni jiu de shao hou zai hui lai ！]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Fair enough. See you around!
translation: 很公平。再见！ [hen gong ping 。 zai jian ！]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Oh no... what do I do?
translation: 哦不...我该怎么办？ [o bu ... wo gai zen me ban ？]

english: It's all gone wrong...
translation: 一切都出了问题... [yi qie dou chu le wen ti ...]

english: What's wrong?
translation: 怎么了？ [zen me le ？]

english: I'm supposed to be cooking a cake for the Cake Off but my prized tin has broken!
translation: 我本来应该为蛋糕大赛做蛋糕，但我珍贵的罐头坏了！ [wo ben lai ying gai wei dan gao da sai zuo dan gao ， dan wo zhen gui de guan tou huai le ！]

english: What's the Cake Off?
translation: 蛋糕掉了什么？ [dan gao diao le shen me ？]

english: Oh, you don't know about the Great Gielinor Cake Off? It's Party Pete's newest idea!
translation: 哦，你不知道 Great Gielinor Cake Off 吗？这是派对皮特的最新想法！ [o ， ni bu zhi dao  Great Gielinor Cake Off  ma ？ zhe shi pai dui pi te de zui xin xiang fa ！]

english: He's invited representatives from across the world to have their baking skills judged.
translation: 他邀请了来自世界各地的代表来评判他们的烘焙技巧。 [ta yao qing le lai zi shi jie ge di de dai biao lai ping pan ta men de hong bei ji qiao 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Oh! I'm Patty Seer, a wandering cook! I'm traveling the world learning everything I can about food.
translation: 哦！我是帕蒂·赛尔，一名流浪厨师！我正在环游世界，学习有关食物的一切知识。 [o ！ wo shi pa di · sai er ， yi ming liu lang chu shi ！ wo zheng zai huan you shi jie ， xue xi you guan shi wu de yi qie zhi shi 。]

english: Your prized tin?
translation: 您珍贵的锡罐？ [nin zhen gui de xi guan ？]

english: Yes, I use it for every cake I bake. It brings me luck.
translation: 是的，我烤的每个蛋糕都用它。它给我带来了好运。 [shi de ， wo kao de mei ge dan gao dou yong ta 。 ta gei wo dai lai le hao yun 。]

english: What's happened to it?
translation: 它到底怎么了？ [ta dao di zen me le ？]

english: I'm not sure how, but it's broken in two... Do you think you might be able to help me?
translation: 我不知道怎么回事，但它断成了两半……你认为你能帮我吗？ [wo bu zhi dao zen me hui shi ， dan ta duan cheng le liang ban …… ni ren wei ni neng bang wo ma ？]

english: I'm sure I can find someone to fix it!
translation: 我相信我能找到人来解决它！ [wo xiang xin wo neng zhao dao ren lai jie jue ta ！]

english: What about Bob?
translation: 鲍勃呢？ [bao bo ne ？]

english: Do you think he can fix it?
translation: 你认为他能解决这个问题吗？ [ni ren wei ta neng jie jue zhe ge wen ti ma ？]

english: Yes, I'd imagine he can! Not to mention, he owes me one!
translation: 是的，我想他可以！更何况，他还欠我一个！ [shi de ， wo xiang ta ke yi ！ geng he kuang ， ta hai qian wo yi ge ！]

english: Take this to him, it should cover the cost of the repair. You should be able to find him in his shop to the south.
translation: 把这个拿给他吧，应该可以支付修理费了。你应该可以在南面的店里找到他。 [ba zhe ge na gei ta ba ， ying gai ke yi zhi fu xiu li fei le 。 ni ying gai ke yi zai nan mian de dian li zhao dao ta 。]

english: I'm afraid I can't help you right now.
translation: 恐怕我现在帮不了你。 [kong pa wo xian zai bang bu liao ni 。]

english: Oh... thank you for the offer but I'm not interested in that.
translation: 哦...谢谢你的提议，但我对此不感兴趣。 [o ... xie xie ni de ti yi ， dan wo dui ci bu gan xing qu 。]

english: What's the Cake Off?
translation: 蛋糕掉了什么？ [dan gao diao le shen me ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Your prized tin?
translation: 您珍贵的锡罐？ [nin zhen gui de xi guan ？]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: I don't think I can help you right now...
translation: 我想我现在帮不了你... [wo xiang wo xian zai bang bu liao ni ...]

english: Is it over?
translation: 结束了吗？ [jie shu le ma ？]

english: I can't hear anything? It might be?
translation: 我什么也听不到？可能是吗？ [wo shen me ye ting bu dao ？ ke neng shi ma ？]

english: Is someone in there?
translation: 里面有人吗？ [li mian you ren ma ？]

english: N-n-n-no... go away...
translation: 不不不……走开…… [bu bu bu …… zou kai ……]

english: Oh okay, fair enough.
translation: 哦，好吧，很公平。 [o ， hao ba ， hen gong ping 。]

english: Wait! Come back, we need your help.
translation: 等待！回来吧，我们需要你的帮助。 [deng dai ！ hui lai ba ， wo men xu yao ni de bang zhu 。]

english: Jack Frost locked us in here when he stormed into our bakery. We tried to stop him from messing up our production, but he got grumpy.
translation: 杰克·弗罗斯特冲进我们的面包店时把我们锁在了这里。我们试图阻止他搞砸我们的制作，但他脾气暴躁。 [jie ke · fu luo si te chong jin wo men de mian bao dian shi ba wo men suo zai le zhe li 。 wo men shi tu zu zhi ta gao za wo men de zhi zuo ， dan ta pi qi bao zao 。]

english: I ran into one of your bakers outside, he said you were in trouble.
translation: 我在外面遇到了你们的一位面包师，他说你们有麻烦了。 [wo zai wai mian yu dao le ni men de yi wei mian bao shi ， ta shuo ni men you ma fan le 。]

english: Oh Remy is still alive! We thought Jack fed him to the Icelord.
translation: 噢，雷米还活着！我们以为杰克把他喂给了冰王。 [o ， lei mi hai huo zhe ！ wo men yi wei jie ke ba ta wei gei le bing wang 。]

english: Where's the key? The door looks locked to me.
translation: 钥匙在哪里？门看起来对我来说是锁着的。 [yao shi zai na li ？ men kan qi lai dui wo lai shuo shi suo zhe de 。]

english: I thought you had it, Mary.
translation: 我以为你有它，玛丽。 [wo yi wei ni you ta ， ma li 。]

english: Well I thought you had it, Paul.
translation: 好吧，我以为你已经做到了，保罗。 [hao ba ， wo yi wei ni yi jing zuo dao le ， bao luo 。]

english: Don't you think I'd have opened the door if I had it?
translation: 你不觉得如果我有门的话我会开门吗？ [ni bu jue de ru guo wo you men de hua wo hui kai men ma ？]

english: Don't you think I would have opened the door as well!
translation: 你不觉得我也会开门吗！ [ni bu jue de wo ye hui kai men ma ！]

english: Great, now I'm locked in here with you for the rest of my life.
translation: 太好了，现在我的余生都被锁在这里和你在一起了。 [tai hao le ， xian zai wo de yu sheng dou bei suo zai zhe li he ni zai yi qi le 。]

english: Woah calm down! If it's not in there, it must be out here. Let me look for it.
translation: 哇冷静点！如果它不在里面，它一定在外面。让我找找看。 [wa leng jing dian ！ ru guo ta bu zai li mian ， ta yi ding zai wai mian 。 rang wo zhao zhao kan 。]

english: RAAAAAAAAAAAWR
translation: 啊啊啊啊啊啊 [a a a a a a]

english: The Icelord sees you trying to enter their cage and blasts you backwards.
translation: 寒冰领主看到你试图进入他们的笼子，然后将你向后轰飞。 [han bing ling zhu kan dao ni shi tu jin ru ta men de long zi ， ran hou jiang ni xiang hou hong fei 。]

english: Ooooh that sounds like it hurt!
translation: 哦哦，听起来很疼！ [o o ， ting qi lai hen teng ！]

english: Are you okay dear? That sounded quite nasty.
translation: 亲爱的你还好吗？这听起来很令人讨厌。 [qin ai de ni hai hao ma ？ zhe ting qi lai hen ling ren tao yan 。]

english: Well, I found the key.
translation: 嗯，我找到了钥匙。 [n ， wo zhao dao le yao shi 。]

english: That's great, come on let us out then.
translation: 那太好了，那就让我们出去吧。 [na tai hao le ， na jiu rang wo men chu qu ba 。]

english: Yes hurry up, we need to get back on schedule.
translation: 是的，快点，我们需要按计划恢复。 [shi de ， kuai dian ， wo men xu yao an ji hua hui fu 。]

english: That's going to be a problem, it's in the cage with the Icelord.
translation: 这将是一个问题，它和冰王一起关在笼子里。 [zhe jiang shi yi ge wen ti ， ta he bing wang yi qi guan zai long zi li 。]

english: I've got no way to get it with the Icelord there.
translation: 我没有办法用冰领主那里得到它。 [wo mei you ban fa yong bing ling zhu na li de dao ta 。]

english: Did you try telegrabbing it?
translation: 你尝试过电抢吗？ [ni chang shi guo dian qiang ma ？]

english: I'm stumped, I can't find the key.
translation: 我很困惑，找不到钥匙。 [wo hen kun huo ， zhao bu dao yao shi 。]

english: You've looked around the bakery and no luck?
translation: 您环视了面包店，但没有找到运气？ [nin huan shi le mian bao dian ， dan mei you zhao dao yun qi ？]

english: If it's not in here or in the back room, it must be in the cage with the Icelord.
translation: 如果它不在这儿或后面的房间里，它一定是和冰王一起在笼子里。 [ru guo ta bu zai zhe er huo hou mian de fang jian li ， ta yi ding shi he bing wang yi qi zai long zi li 。]

english: It wouldn't be safe to go in there.
translation: 进去那里不安全。 [jin qu na li bu an quan 。]

english: Could you try telegrabbing it?
translation: 你能尝试一下电抢吗？ [ni neng chang shi yi xia dian qiang ma ？]

english: That won't work, the Icelord's magic will interfere.
translation: 那不行，冰王的魔法会干扰。 [na bu xing ， bing wang de mo fa hui gan rao 。]

english: Hmm... You're going to need a way to protect yourself from the Icelord.
translation: 嗯...你需要一种方法来保护自己免受冰王的侵害。 [n ... ni xu yao yi zhong fang fa lai bao hu zi ji mian shou bing wang de qin hai 。]

english: Don't suppose you have an Anti-Icelord Shield lying around here then?
translation: 你不认为这里有反冰领之盾吗？ [ni bu ren wei zhe li you fan bing ling zhi dun ma ？]

english: I don't, do you Paul?
translation: 我不这么认为，保罗你呢？ [wo bu zhe me ren wei ， bao luo ni ne ？]

english: No I don't...
translation: 不，我不... [bu ， wo bu ...]

english: But I do have a genius idea, we'll use Gingerbread!
translation: 但我确实有一个天才的主意，我们将使用姜饼！ [dan wo que shi you yi ge tian cai de zhu yi ， wo men jiang shi yong jiang bing ！]

english: Before Jack locked us up, I saw him using the Icelord to ice his Gingerbread Gnomes. They did a great job of absorbing his breath.
translation: 在杰克把我们关起来之前，我看到他用冰领主来冰冻他的姜饼侏儒。他们很好地吸收了他的呼吸。 [zai jie ke ba wo men guan qi lai zhi qian ， wo kan dao ta yong bing ling zhu lai bing dong ta de jiang bing zhu ru 。 ta men hen hao di xi shou le ta de hu xi 。]

english: You'll need to make a Gingerbread Gnome big enough to absorb the Icelord's breath.
translation: 你需要制作一个足够大的姜饼侏儒来吸收冰王的气息。 [ni xu yao zhi zuo yi ge zu gou da de jiang bing zhu ru lai xi shou bing wang de qi xi 。]

english: How am I going to do that?
translation: 我该怎么做呢？ [wo gai zen me zuo ne ？]

english: Our usual recipe uses: one cinnamon, one ginger, one flour and one egg, we put them into that big machine you see to your left.
translation: 我们通常的食谱使用：一颗肉桂，一颗生姜，一颗面粉和一颗鸡蛋，我们把它们放进你左边看到的那个大机器里。 [wo men tong chang de shi pu shi yong ： yi ke rou gui ， yi ke sheng jiang ， yi ke mian fen he yi ke ji dan ， wo men ba ta men fang jin ni zuo bian kan dao de na ge da ji qi li 。]

english: Try using more of each ingredient till you get the right combination? Possibly tripling the amount of each ingredient might work.
translation: 尝试使用更多的每种成分，直到获得正确的组合？也许将每种成分的量增加三倍可能会起作用。 [chang shi shi yong geng duo de mei zhong cheng fen ， zhi dao huo de zheng que de zu he ？ ye xu jiang mei zhong cheng fen de liang zeng jia san bei ke neng hui qi zuo yong 。]

english: This is such a ridiculous idea, guess I have no choice....
translation: 这是一个多么可笑的想法，我想我别无选择...... [zhe shi yi ge duo me ke xiao de xiang fa ， wo xiang wo bie wu xuan ze ......]

english: Come back to us if you need some more help.
translation: 如果您需要更多帮助，请回到我们这里。 [ru guo nin xu yao geng duo bang zhu ， qing hui dao wo men zhe li 。]

english: What ingredients did I need again?
translation: 我又需要什么成分？ [wo you xu yao shen me cheng fen ？]

english: You'll need ginger, cinnamon, flour and eggs. We usually only use one of each, maybe tripling the amount of each will work.
translation: 你需要姜、肉桂、面粉和鸡蛋。我们通常只使用其中一种，也许每种的用量增加三倍就可以了。 [ni xu yao jiang 、 rou gui 、 mian fen he ji dan 。 wo men tong chang zhi shi yong qi zhong yi zhong ， ye xu mei zhong de yong liang zeng jia san bei jiu ke yi le 。]

english: Great thanks, I'll see what I can do.
translation: 非常感谢，我会看看我能做什么。 [fei chang gan xie ， wo hui kan kan wo neng zuo shen me 。]

english: So I made the shield, now what?
translation: 所以我做了盾牌，现在怎么办？ [suo yi wo zuo le dun pai ， xian zai zen me ban ？]

english: Fantastic! Now you need to enter the Icelord's cage.
translation: 极好的！现在你需要进入冰王的牢笼。 [ji hao de ！ xian zai ni xu yao jin ru bing wang de lao long 。]

english: Don't worry, I'm sure this idea will work, just make sure to equip it before you go in.
translation: 别担心，我确信这个想法会奏效，只要确保在进去之前装备好即可。 [bie dan xin ， wo que xin zhe ge xiang fa hui zou xiao ， zhi yao que bao zai jin qu zhi qian zhuang bei hao ji ke 。]

english: I found the key!
translation: 我找到了钥匙！ [wo zhao dao le yao shi ！]

english: That's great! Now hurry up and open the door.
translation: 那太棒了！现在赶紧把门打开。 [na tai bang le ！ xian zai gan jin ba men da kai 。]

english: You release the bakers and give back their key...
translation: 你释放面包师并归还他们的钥匙...... [ni shi fang mian bao shi bing gui huan ta men de yao shi ......]

english: There you go, unlocked without an issue.
translation: 就这样，解锁没问题。 [jiu zhe yang ， jie suo mei wen ti 。]

english: Wow, you managed to do that so quickly! Without any help from us.
translation: 哇，你这么快就做到了！没有我们的任何帮助。 [wa ， ni zhe me kuai jiu zuo dao le ！ mei you wo men de ren he bang zhu 。]

english: You're very impressive, what a coincidence that you knew to make a giant piece of gingerbread to protect yourself.
translation: 你真了不起，真巧，你竟然知道做一块巨大的姜饼来保护自己。 [ni zhen liao bu qi ， zhen qiao ， ni jing ran zhi dao zuo yi kuai ju da de jiang bing lai bao hu zi ji 。]

english: Ha ha, yeah, it was no problem.
translation: 哈哈，是啊，没问题。 [ha ha ， shi a ， mei wen ti 。]

english: Well, thanks for freeing us!
translation: 好吧，谢谢你释放了我们！ [hao ba ， xie xie ni shi fang le wo men ！]

english: I can't believe that actually worked....
translation: 我不敢相信这真的有效...... [wo bu gan xiang xin zhe zhen de you xiao ......]

english: ...Me too, I thought you'd be turned into icing for sure.
translation: ……我也是，我以为你肯定会变成糖霜。 […… wo ye shi ， wo yi wei ni ken ding hui bian cheng tang shuang 。]

english: So you're telling me you weren't even sure it would!?
translation: 所以你告诉我你甚至不确定会这样！？ [suo yi ni gao su wo ni shen zhi bu que ding hui zhe yang ！？]

english: It worked out didn't it? We're free to continue making Gingerbread Gnomes.
translation: 成功了不是吗？我们可以继续制作姜饼侏儒。 [cheng gong le bu shi ma ？ wo men ke yi ji xu zhi zuo jiang bing zhu ru 。]

english: That was extremely reckless, Paul, but you're right, it did work out in the end.
translation: 这太鲁莽了，保罗，但你是对的，最终确实成功了。 [zhe tai lu mang le ， bao luo ， dan ni shi dui de ， zui zhong que shi cheng gong le 。]

english: ...fine. I should go tell Santa the good news, the bakery is back in operation.
translation: ...美好的。我应该去告诉圣诞老人这个好消息，面包店恢复营业了。 [... mei hao de 。 wo ying gai qu gao su sheng dan lao ren zhe ge hao xiao xi ， mian bao dian hui fu ying ye le 。]

english: We'll be back in full production in no time!
translation: 我们很快就会恢复全面生产！ [wo men hen kuai jiu hui hui fu quan mian sheng chan ！]

english: What do we do about the Icelord in the cage?
translation: 笼子里的冰领主我们该怎么办？ [long zi li de bing ling zhu wo men gai zen me ban ？]

english: Maybe Jack was onto something by using it to ice the Gingerbread Gnomes.
translation: 也许杰克用它来给姜饼侏儒冰冻是有道理的。 [ye xu jie ke yong ta lai gei jiang bing zhu ru bing dong shi you dao li de 。]

english: You should take the giant piece of gingerbread you made and show it to Santa, he'll know we're back in business then.
translation: 你应该把你做的那块巨大的姜饼拿给圣诞老人看，他就会知道我们又开始营业了。 [ni ying gai ba ni zuo de na kuai ju da de jiang bing na gei sheng dan lao ren kan ， ta jiu hui zhi dao wo men you kai shi ying ye le 。]

english: Alright, time for you to go, we need to get back into production.
translation: 好吧，你该走了，我们需要恢复生产。 [hao ba ， ni gai zou le ， wo men xu yao hui fu sheng chan 。]

english: Go away, we're busy trying to catch up.
translation: 走开，我们正忙着追赶。 [zou kai ， wo men zheng mang zhe zhui gan 。]

english: Just quickly, Santa said you shouldn't use the Icelord to ice your gnomes.
translation: 很快，圣诞老人说你不应该使用冰王来冰冻你的侏儒。 [hen kuai ， sheng dan lao ren shuo ni bu ying gai shi yong bing wang lai bing dong ni de zhu ru 。]

english: Why not?
translation: 为什么不呢？ [wei shen me bu ne ？]

english: Something about Icelord saliva not being safe to eat.
translation: 关于 Icelord 唾液食用不安全的事情。 [guan yu  Icelord  tuo ye shi yong bu an quan de shi qing 。]

english: Oh, thanks for telling us, we'll go back to using normal icing.
translation: 哦，谢谢你告诉我们，我们会恢复使用普通糖霜。 [o ， xie xie ni gao su wo men ， wo men hui hui fu shi yong pu tong tang shuang 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Ah, a stranger to our island. What brings you here?
translation: 啊，我们岛上的陌生人。是什么风把你吹到这里来的？ [a ， wo men dao shang de mo sheng ren 。 shi shen me feng ba ni chui dao zhe li lai de ？]

english: Well, I've actually come here on a diplomatic mission. I want to try and settle some of the disputes between the Fremenniks and your clan.
translation: 嗯，我实际上是来这里执行外交任务的。我想尝试解决弗雷曼尼克人和你们氏族之间的一些争端。 [n ， wo shi ji shang shi lai zhe li zhi xing wai jiao ren wu de 。 wo xiang chang shi jie jue fu lei man ni ke ren he ni men shi zu zhi jian de yi xie zheng duan 。]

english: The Rremenniks? Pah! They are just too ignorant and stubborn to listen to anything we have to say - how can we possibly associate with a race that won't listen?
translation: 雷曼尼克斯？呸！他们太无知和固执，根本不会听我们所说的任何话——我们怎么可能与一个不听的种族联系在一起呢？ [lei man ni ke si ？ pei ！ ta men tai wu zhi he gu zhi ， gen ben bu hui ting wo men suo shuo de ren he hua —— wo men zen me ke neng yu yi ge bu ting de zhong zu lian xi zai yi qi ne ？]

english: I think they are very eager to listen, but they feel like you are keeping secrets from them.
translation: 我认为他们非常渴望倾听，但他们觉得你在向他们隐瞒秘密。 [wo ren wei ta men fei chang ke wang qing ting ， dan ta men jue de ni zai xiang ta men yin man mi mi 。]

english: Secrets?
translation: 秘密？ [mi mi ？]

english: Yes, as in your magic ways. To be honest, I think it is fear of the unknown.
translation: 是的，就像你的魔法一样。说实话，我觉得是对未知的恐惧。 [shi de ， jiu xiang ni de mo fa yi yang 。 shuo shi hua ， wo jue de shi dui wei zhi de kong ju 。]

english: Well, when the day comes that a Fremennik can prove they have the patience and interest in learning our ways, then we will perhaps share our secrets.
translation: 好吧，当有一天，弗雷曼尼克人能够证明他们有耐心和兴趣学习我们的方法时，那么我们也许会分享我们的秘密。 [hao ba ， dang you yi tian ， fu lei man ni ke ren neng gou zheng ming ta men you nai xin he xing qu xue xi wo men de fang fa shi ， na me wo men ye xu hui fen xiang wo men de mi mi 。]

english: I'm hoping I might be able to achieve that.
translation: 我希望我能够实现这一目标。 [wo xi wang wo neng gou shi xian zhe yi mu biao 。]

english: Good luck. It's far from simple.
translation: 祝你好运。这远非简单。 [zhu ni hao yun 。 zhe yuan fei jian dan 。]

english: I'm on the lookout for ceremonial clothing so I can visit my dreams. I don't suppose you could help me out?
translation: 我正在寻找礼服，这样我就可以实现我的梦想。我想你不能帮我吗？ [wo zheng zai xun zhao li fu ， zhe yang wo jiu ke yi shi xian wo de meng xiang 。 wo xiang ni bu neng bang wo ma ？]

english: Ah, I know the ceremony very well. Maybe I can help. I do have a cape, but why would I want to give it so some random person off the streets?
translation: 啊，我很了解这个仪式。也许我可以帮忙。我确实有一件斗篷，但为什么我要把它送给街上的某个随机的人呢？ [a ， wo hen liao jie zhe ge yi shi 。 ye xu wo ke yi bang mang 。 wo que shi you yi jian dou peng ， dan wei shen me wo yao ba ta song gei jie shang de mou ge sui ji de ren ne ？]

english: Because you're a kind person and like helping people in need?
translation: 因为你是一个善良的人并且喜欢帮助有需要的人？ [yin wei ni shi yi ge shan liang de ren bing qie xi huan bang zhu you xu yao de ren ？]

english: Nice try. But I am always glad to help a person in need, if they can demonstrate some insight.
translation: 不错的尝试。但如果他们能够表现出一些洞察力，我总是很乐意帮助有需要的人。 [bu cuo de chang shi 。 dan ru guo ta men neng gou biao xian chu yi xie dong cha li ， wo zong shi hen le yi bang zhu you xu yao de ren 。]

english: I'm listening...
translation: 我在听... [wo zai ting ...]

english: How about you try and guess my name!
translation: 你试试猜我的名字怎么样！ [ni shi shi cai wo de ming zi zen me yang ！]

english: Hmmm.
Bob?
translation: 鲍勃？ [bao bo ？]

english: How rude!
translation: 多么粗鲁啊！ [duo me cu lu a ！]

english: Well you do seem to have a moustache growing.
translation: 嗯，你的胡子看起来确实在长。 [n ， ni de hu zi kan qi lai que shi zai zhang 。]

english: Get out of my sight!
translation: 滚出我的视线！ [gun chu wo de shi xian ！]

english: Pauline
translation: 宝琳 [bao lin]

english: Ah, you'd think so, but no. That is my alias. I want you to tell me my REAL name! I have one first name, and a triple barrel surname!
translation: 啊，你会这么想，但不是。那是我的别名。我要你告诉我我的真名！我有一个名字，还有一个三重姓氏！ [a ， ni hui zhe me xiang ， dan bu shi 。 na shi wo de bie ming 。 wo yao ni gao su wo wo de zhen ming ！ wo you yi ge ming zi ， hai you yi ge san chong xing shi ！]

english: Oh no. Can't you give me some kind of clue?
translation: 哦不。你不能给我一些线索吗？ [o bu 。 ni bu neng gei wo yi xie xian suo ma ？]

english: Let's see...
translation: 让我们来看看... [rang wo men lai kan kan ...]

english: Ok. Change a letter from the word Dane to get my first name. The first part of my surname rhymes with wood, the third part rhymes with spade and the second rhymes with magic.
translation: 好的。把 Dane 这个词的一个字母改掉就得到了我的名字。我姓氏的第一部分与木头押韵，第三部分与铲子押韵，第二部分与魔法押韵。 [hao de 。 ba  Dane  zhe ge ci de yi ge zi mu gai diao jiu de dao le wo de ming zi 。 wo xing shi de di yi bu fen yu mu tou ya yun ， di san bu fen yu chan zi ya yun ， di er bu fen yu mo fa ya yun 。]

english: Jane Blud-Hagic-Maid.
translation: Jane Blud-Hagic-女仆。 [Jane Blud-Hagic- nv pu 。]

english: That's it! Well done.
translation: 就是这样！干得好。 [jiu shi zhe yang ！ gan de hao 。]

english: Woo hoo! Not the most normal name is it?
translation: 呜呼！这不是最正常的名字吗？ [wu hu ！ zhe bu shi zui zheng chang de ming zi ma ？]

english: It's not my fault my parents had an over active imagination.
translation: 这不是我的错，我父母的想象力过于活跃。 [zhe bu shi wo de cuo ， wo fu mu de xiang xiang li guo yu huo yue 。]

english: Sounds like they were totally insane.
translation: 听起来他们完全疯了。 [ting qi lai ta men wan quan feng le 。]

english: Do you want this cape or not?
translation: 你想要还是不想要这个斗篷？ [ni xiang yao hai shi bu xiang yao zhe ge dou peng ？]

english: Sorry, yes please.
translation: 抱歉，是的，请。 [bao qian ， shi de ， qing 。]

english: Tina?
translation: 蒂娜？ [di na ？]

english: Ha! Nice try, but no.
translation: 哈!不错的尝试，但没有。 [ha ! bu cuo de chang shi ， dan mei you 。]

english: Bob?
translation: 鲍勃？ [bao bo ？]

english: Pauline?
translation: 宝琳？ [bao lin ？]

english: Tina?
translation: 蒂娜？ [di na ？]

english: I'm terribly sorry, but I don't have time to talk right now, the Duke might need me.
translation: 非常抱歉，但我现在没有时间说话，公爵可能需要我。 [fei chang bao qian ， dan wo xian zai mei you shi jian shuo hua ， gong jue ke neng xu yao wo 。]

english: Hey, do you know what's going on with the Duke?
translation: 嘿，你知道公爵最近怎么样吗？ [hei ， ni zhi dao gong jue zui jin zen me yang ma ？]

english: It's that cursed egg.
translation: 就是那个被诅咒的蛋。 [jiu shi na ge bei zu zhou de dan 。]

english: He does have a strange relation with it... He does know it's an inanimate object, right?
translation: 他确实和它有一种奇怪的关系……他确实知道这是一个无生命的物体，对吗？ [ta que shi he ta you yi zhong qi guai de guan xi …… ta que shi zhi dao zhe shi yi ge wu sheng ming de wu ti ， dui ma ？]

english: The Duke is a little, different, he's never been very good at making decisions.
translation: 公爵有点不同，他从来不擅长做决定。 [gong jue you dian bu tong ， ta cong lai bu shan chang zuo jue ding 。]

english: But ever since this egg came along, he has let it make all the decisions for him.
translation: 但自从这个蛋出现后，他就让它为他做所有的决定。 [dan zi cong zhe ge dan chu xian hou ， ta jiu rang ta wei ta zuo suo you de jue ding 。]

english: What does it do? He just seemed to ask it questions and shake it.
translation: 它有什么作用？他似乎只是问它问题然后摇晃它。 [ta you shen me zuo yong ？ ta si hu zhi shi wen ta wen ti ran hou yao huang ta 。]

english: I don't know how it works, but I know it's wrong.
translation: 我不知道它是如何工作的，但我知道这是错误的。 [wo bu zhi dao ta shi ru he gong zuo de ， dan wo zhi dao zhe shi cuo wu de 。]

english: I managed to sneak in and ask it a question one night, I asked: 'Magic Egg, are we puppets to a being we cannot comprehend?', it responded with almost certainly.
translation: 有一天晚上，我设法偷偷溜进去问它一个问题，我问：“魔法蛋，我们是一个我们无法理解的存在的傀儡吗？”，它几乎肯定地回答道。 [you yi tian wan shang ， wo she fa tou tou liu jin qu wen ta yi ge wen ti ， wo wen ：“ mo fa dan ， wo men shi yi ge wo men wu fa li jie de cun zai de kui lei ma ？”， ta ji hu ken ding di hui da dao 。]

english: That's a very strange thing to ask a talking egg.
translation: 问一个会说话的鸡蛋是一件非常奇怪的事情。 [wen yi ge hui shuo hua de ji dan shi yi jian fei chang qi guai de shi qing 。]

english: I had a couple forest carrots that night and was feeling a bit off.
translation: 那天晚上我吃了几块森林胡萝卜，感觉有点不舒服。 [na tian wan shang wo chi le ji kuai sen lin hu luo bo ， gan jue you dian bu shu fu 。]

english: ... Uh... alright then.
translation: ……呃……好吧。 […… e …… hao ba 。]

english: We need to do something, the magician on the other side of the por....
translation: 我们需要做点什么，港口另一边的魔术师...... [wo men xu yao zuo dian shen me ， gang kou ling yi bian de mo shu shi ......]

english: I mean, who knows where that portal leads to, rabbits might be hopping to their death!
translation: 我的意思是，谁知道那个传送门通向哪里，兔子可能会跳死！ [wo de yi si shi ， shui zhi dao na ge chuan song men tong xiang na li ， tu zi ke neng hui tiao si ！]

english: I agree, I've hatched a plan that could save rabbits from certain doom.
translation: 我同意，我已经制定了一个可以将兔子从某种厄运中拯救出来的计划。 [wo tong yi ， wo yi jing zhi ding le yi ge ke yi jiang tu zi cong mou zhong e yun zhong zheng jiu chu lai de ji hua 。]

english: I'm all ears.
translation: 我洗耳恭听。 [wo xi er gong ting 。]

english: We're going to make an egg similar to his one, but it only replies negatively.
translation: 我们要做一个和他的鸡蛋类似的鸡蛋，但它只会做出负面的反应。 [wo men yao zuo yi ge he ta de ji dan lei si de ji dan ， dan ta zhi hui zuo chu fu mian de fan ying 。]

english: How am I going to make that? I've only got two very small paws and no thumbs.
translation: 我该怎么做呢？我只有两只很小的爪子，没有拇指。 [wo gai zen me zuo ne ？ wo zhi you liang zhi hen xiao de zhua zi ， mei you mu zhi 。]

english: You'll need three things: a conch shell, if you whisper into it, it will echo back whatever you say, you should be able to find one on the beach.
translation: 你需要三样东西：一个海螺壳，如果你对着它低声说话，无论你说什么，它都会回响，你应该能够在海滩上找到一个。 [ni xu yao san yang dong xi ： yi ge hai luo ke ， ru guo ni dui zhe ta di sheng shuo hua ， wu lun ni shuo shen me ， ta du hui hui xiang ， ni ying gai neng gou zai hai tan shang zhao dao yi ge 。]

english: Next you'll need an egg to put it in. To make it look like the real one in his room.
translation: 接下来你需要一个鸡蛋来把它放进去。让它看起来像他房间里的真鸡蛋。 [jie xia lai ni xu yao yi ge ji dan lai ba ta fang jin qu 。 rang ta kan qi lai xiang ta fang jian li de zhen ji dan 。]

english: Finally, you'll need to paint it gold. Luckily, we've done some redecorating on the top floor of the castle, you should find some paint there.
translation: 最后，你需要把它漆成金色。幸运的是，我们在城堡的顶层做了一些重新装修，你应该在那里找到一些油漆。 [zui hou ， ni xu yao ba ta qi cheng jin se 。 xing yun de shi ， wo men zai cheng bao de ding ceng zuo le yi xie chong xin zhuang xiu ， ni ying gai zai na li zhao dao yi xie you qi 。]

english: Good luck, if you have any more questions let me know.
translation: 祝你好运，如果您还有任何问题，请告诉我。 [zhu ni hao yun ， ru guo nin hai you ren he wen ti ， qing gao su wo 。]

english: How are you getting along with making the  replacement egg?
translation: 你制作替代鸡蛋的进展如何？ [ni zhi zuo ti dai ji dan de jin zhan ru he ？]

english: I can't remember what I needed.
translation: 我不记得我需要什么。 [wo bu ji de wo xu yao shen me 。]

english: Good luck, if you have anymore questions let me know.
translation: 祝你好运，如果您还有疑问，请告诉我。 [zhu ni hao yun ， ru guo nin hai you yi wen ， qing gao su wo 。]

english: That's great, you're almost there, you just need to paint it now.
translation: 太棒了，你已经快到了，你现在只需要画它即可。 [tai bang le ， ni yi jing kuai dao le ， ni xian zai zhi xu yao hua ta ji ke 。]

english: Where am I supposed to find some paint?
translation: 我应该去哪里找到一些油漆？ [wo ying gai qu na li zhao dao yi xie you qi ？]

english: There should be some left over paint on the roof of the castle, we were repainting some of it.
translation: 城堡的屋顶上应该还有一些剩余的油漆，我们正在重新粉刷其中的一些。 [cheng bao de wu ding shang ying gai hai you yi xie sheng yu de you qi ， wo men zheng zai chong xin fen shua qi zhong de yi xie 。]

english: Hello Paws, I managed to make a replacement egg.
translation: 你好，爪子，我设法做了一个替代鸡蛋。 [ni hao ， zhua zi ， wo she fa zuo le yi ge ti dai ji dan 。]

english: Perfect and it only gives negative answers?
translation: 完美但只给出否定答案？ [wan mei dan zhi gei chu fou ding da an ？]

english: Yep, I tested it myself.
translation: 是的，我自己测试过。 [shi de ， wo zi ji ce shi guo 。]

english: Great, all that's left to do is the switch, you need to convince him that this egg is the real one.
translation: 太好了，剩下要做的就是开关，你需要让他相信这个鸡蛋是真的。 [tai hao le ， sheng xia yao zuo de jiu shi kai guan ， ni xu yao rang ta xiang xin zhe ge ji dan shi zhen de 。]

english: How do you suppose I do that?
translation: 你觉得我该怎么做？ [ni jue de wo gai zen me zuo ？]

english: You could get him to ask the real one if it is real and hope it says no.
translation: 你可以让他去问真人这是否是真的，并希望他说不是。 [ni ke yi rang ta qu wen zhen ren zhe shi fou shi zhen de ， bing xi wang ta shuo bu shi 。]

english: And if it says it is the real egg.
translation: 如果它说它是真正的鸡蛋。 [ru guo ta shuo ta shi zhen zheng de ji dan 。]

english: -Shrugs-
translation: -耸肩- [- song jian -]

english: Fine, I'll see what I can do.
translation: 好吧，我看看能做什么。 [hao ba ， wo kan kan neng zuo shen me 。]

english: Somehow your plan worked.
translation: 不知怎的，你的计划奏效了。 [bu zhi zen de ， ni de ji hua zou xiao le 。]

english: Of course it would, the egg told me.
translation: 当然会，鸡蛋告诉我。 [dang ran hui ， ji dan gao su wo 。]

english: Woe is me! Our crops are all failing... how shall I feed myself this winter?
translation: 祸哉是我！我们的庄稼都歉收了……这个冬天我该如何养活自己呢？ [huo zai shi wo ！ wo men de zhuang jia dou qian shou le …… zhe ge dong tian wo gai ru he yang huo zi ji ne ？]

english: Oh happy day! Suddenly our crops are growing again! It'll be a bumper harvest this year!
translation: 哦，快乐的一天！突然间，我们的庄稼又开始生长了！今年一定会是丰收的一年！ [o ， kuai le de yi tian ！ tu ran jian ， wo men de zhuang jia you kai shi sheng zhang le ！ jin nian yi ding hui shi feng shou de yi nian ！]

english: Hey, human.
translation: 嘿，人类。 [hei ， ren lei 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Just a guard. If sneaky humans come in here without permission, I chuck rocks at 'em, knock 'em out and chuck 'em out of Weiss.
translation: 只是一个守卫。如果偷偷摸摸的人类未经允许进入这里，我会向他们扔石头，将他们击倒，然后将他们从韦斯扔出去。 [zhi shi yi ge shou wei 。 ru guo tou tou mo mo de ren lei wei jing yun xu jin ru zhe li ， wo hui xiang ta men reng shi tou ， jiang ta men ji dao ， ran hou jiang ta men cong wei si reng chu qu 。]

english: I'm familiar with the idea, yeah.
translation: 我很熟悉这个想法，是的。 [wo hen shu xi zhe ge xiang fa ， shi de 。]

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 告诉我这个地方。 [gao su wo zhe ge di fang 。]

english: This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: 这是韦斯。几年前，在我们被从更南边的洞穴里赶出来之后，巨魔们建造了它。现在Weiss是我们的家。 [zhe shi wei si 。 ji nian qian ， zai wo men bei cong geng nan bian de dong xue li gan chu lai zhi hou ， ju mo men jian zao le ta 。 xian zai Weiss shi wo men de jia 。]

english: We done pretty good here. Got lots of goat and wolf to eat - they taste kinda boring after all this time, but there not much other choice.
translation: 我们在这里做得很好。有很多山羊和狼可以吃——这么长时间以来它们尝起来有点无聊，但没有太多其他选择。 [wo men zai zhe li zuo de hen hao 。 you hen duo shan yang he lang ke yi chi —— zhe me zhang shi jian yi lai ta men chang qi lai you dian wu liao ， dan mei you tai duo qi ta xuan ze 。]

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it. In fact My Arm is an expert on growing the stuff.
translation: 尝试过古古草吗？我知道喜欢它的巨魔。事实上，我的手臂是种植这些东西的专家。 [chang shi guo gu gu cao ma ？ wo zhi dao xi huan ta de ju mo 。 shi shi shang ， wo de shou bi shi zhong zhi zhe xie dong xi de zhuan jia 。]

english: Never heard of no gouty weed, no. But it sound like a vegetable, an' Mother not like eating those, so we probably not gonna try it.
translation: 从来没有听说过没有痛风草，没有。但它听起来像一种蔬菜，妈妈不喜欢吃那些，所以我们可能不会尝试。 [cong lai mei you ting shuo guo mei you tong feng cao ， mei you 。 dan ta ting qi lai xiang yi zhong shu cai ， ma ma bu xi huan chi na xie ， suo yi wo men ke neng bu hui chang shi 。]

english: Mother not like new ideas much, but he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: 妈妈不太喜欢新想法，但他真的很大，而且是老板，所以我们就照他说的做。 [ma ma bu tai xi huan xin xiang fa ， dan ta zhen de hen da ， er qie shi lao ban ， suo yi wo men jiu zhao ta shuo de zuo 。]

english: I see.
translation: 我懂了。 [wo dong le 。]

english: Do you like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这里吗？ [ni xi huan zhe li ma ？]

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it our home. Odd Mushroom say he can make it nicer with fancy fires what he invented, but Mother not interested in that, so Odd Mushroom not allowed to do it.
translation: 呃，虽然有点简陋，但那是我们的家。奇蘑菇说他可以用他发明的奇特的火把它做得更好，但妈妈对此不感兴趣，所以奇蘑菇不被允许这样做。 [e ， sui ran you dian jian lou ， dan na shi wo men de jia 。 qi mo gu shuo ta ke yi yong ta fa ming de qi te de huo ba ta zuo de geng hao ， dan ma ma dui ci bu gan xing qu ， suo yi qi mo gu bu bei yun xu zhe yang zuo 。]

english: Mother only care about stuff to help him fight better. An he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: 母亲只关心帮助他更好地战斗的东西。他真的很大，他是老板，所以我们就按他说的做。 [mu qin zhi guan xin bang zhu ta geng hao di zhan dou de dong xi 。 ta zhen de hen da ， ta shi lao ban ， suo yi wo men jiu an ta shuo de zuo 。]

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我就走了。 [wo jiu zou le 。]

english: Hey, friend of Snowflake!
translation: 嘿，雪花的朋友！ [hei ， xue hua de peng you ！]

english: Just a guard. If sneaky human come in here without permission, I chuck rocks at 'em, knock 'em out and chuck 'em out of Weiss.
translation: 只是一个守卫。如果偷偷摸摸的人类未经允许进入这里，我会向他们扔石头，将他们击倒，然后将他们从韦斯身上扔出去。 [zhi shi yi ge shou wei 。 ru guo tou tou mo mo de ren lei wei jing yun xu jin ru zhe li ， wo hui xiang ta men reng shi tou ， jiang ta men ji dao ， ran hou jiang ta men cong wei si shen shang reng chu qu 。]

english: It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: 这里太棒了，现在雪花和她丈夫巨魔教我们种植古风草。现在食物好多了。 [zhe li tai bang le ， xian zai xue hua he ta zhang fu ju mo jiao wo men zhong zhi gu feng cao 。 xian zai shi wu hao duo le 。]

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: 嗯，虽然有点粗糙，但是正在好起来。雪花，她教我们种植古风草。山羊、狼、人类的味道都因加入了古藤而变得更加美味。 [n ， sui ran you dian cu cao ， dan shi zheng zai hao qi lai 。 xue hua ， ta jiao wo men zhong zhi gu feng cao 。 shan yang 、 lang 、 ren lei de wei dao dou yin jia ru le gu teng er bian de geng jia mei wei 。]

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: 所以，是的，韦斯是一个很好的居住地，现在由雪花负责。所有的巨魔都像雪花一样。她的丈夫巨魔有点奇怪，但这不是我们的问题。 [suo yi ， shi de ， wei si shi yi ge hen hao de ju zhu di ， xian zai you xue hua fu ze 。 suo you de ju mo dou xiang xue hua yi yang 。 ta de zhang fu ju mo you dian qi guai ， dan zhe bu shi wo men de wen ti 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 告诉我这个地方。 [gao su wo zhe ge di fang 。]

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it.
translation: 尝试过古古草吗？我知道喜欢它的巨魔。 [chang shi guo gu gu cao ma ？ wo zhi dao xi huan ta de ju mo 。]

english: I see.
translation: 我懂了。 [wo dong le 。]

english: Do you like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这里吗？ [ni xi huan zhe li ma ？]

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我就走了。 [wo jiu zou le 。]

english: I have no interest in talking to you just now outerlander.
translation: 我现在没有兴趣和你说话，外乡人。 [wo xian zai mei you xing qu he ni shuo hua ， wai xiang ren 。]

english: Hello there. I have some wallasalki bone fragments, and I understand you may be able to use them to make some armour for me...?
translation: 你好呀。我有一些瓦拉萨尔基人的骨头碎片，我知道你也许可以用它们为我制作一些盔甲……？ [ni hao ya 。 wo you yi xie wa la sa er ji ren de gu tou sui pian ， wo zhi dao ni ye xu ke yi yong ta men wei wo zhi zuo yi xie kui jia ……？]

english: I see great things in your future outerlander, but I will not go against the wishes of the tribe, and will not make armour for an outerlander.
translation: 我在你们未来的异族身上看到了伟大的东西，但我不会违背部落的意愿，也不会为异族制造盔甲。 [wo zai ni men wei lai de yi zu shen shang kan dao le wei da de dong xi ， dan wo bu hui wei bei bu luo de yi yuan ， ye bu hui wei yi zu zhi zao kui jia 。]

english: You may try and gain a dispensation from Chieftain Brundt, but I suspect you will be unsuccessful...
translation: 你可以尝试从布伦特酋长那里获得豁免，但我怀疑你不会成功...... [ni ke yi chang shi cong bu lun te qiu zhang na li huo de huo mian ， dan wo huai yi ni bu hui cheng gong ......]

english: Hey! Outerlander! That is my house! Who do you think you are to just barge into my home without asking?
translation: 嘿！外地人！那是我的房子！你以为你是谁，不问就闯进我家？ [hei ！ wai di ren ！ na shi wo de fang zi ！ ni yi wei ni shi shui ， bu wen jiu chuang jin wo jia ？]

english: Um... My name is [player name].
translation: 嗯...我的名字是[玩家姓名]。 [n ... wo de ming zi shi [ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: It was a rhetorical question, outerlander. Now get lost. I do not appreciate intruders in my home.
translation: 这是一个反问句，外来者。现在迷路了。我不喜欢有人闯入我的家。 [zhe shi yi ge fan wen ju ， wai lai zhe 。 xian zai mi lu le 。 wo bu xi huan you ren chuang ru wo de jia 。]

english: Hello outerlander. What do you want?
translation: 外地人你好。你想要什么？ [wai di ren ni hao 。 ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Hello. I'm looking for members of the council of elders to vote for me to become a Fremennik.
translation: 你好。我正在寻找长老会成员投票支持我成为弗里曼尼克人。 [ni hao 。 wo zheng zai xun zhao zhang lao hui cheng yuan tou piao zhi chi wo cheng wei fu li man ni ke ren 。]

english: Are you now? Well that is interesting. Usually outerlanders do not concern themselves with our ways like that.
translation: 你现在是吗？嗯，这很有趣。通常外地人不会关心我们的生活方式。 [ni xian zai shi ma ？ n ， zhe hen you qu 。 tong chang wai di ren bu hui guan xin wo men de sheng huo fang shi 。]

english: I am one of the members of the council of elders, and should you be able to prove to me that you have something to offer my clan
translation: 我是长老会的成员之一，你是否能够向我证明你可以为我的家族提供一些东西 [wo shi zhang lao hui de cheng yuan zhi yi ， ni shi fou neng gou xiang wo zheng ming ni ke yi wei wo de jia zu ti gong yi xie dong xi]

english: I will vote in your favour at the next meeting.
translation: 我将在下次会议上投票支持你。 [wo jiang zai xia ci hui yi shang tou piao zhi chi ni 。]

english: How can I prove that to you?
translation: 我怎样才能向你证明这一点？ [wo zen yang cai neng xiang ni zheng ming zhe yi dian ？]

english: Well, I have but a simple test. This building behind me is my house. Inside I have constructed a puzzle.
translation: 好吧，我只有一个简单的测试。我身后的这栋楼就是我的家。我在里面构建了一个谜题。 [hao ba ， wo zhi you yi ge jian dan de ce shi 。 wo shen hou de zhe dong lou jiu shi wo de jia 。 wo zai li mian gou jian le yi ge mi ti 。]

english: As a Seer to the clan, I value intelligence very highly, so you may think of it as an intelligence test of sorts.
translation: 作为部落的先知，我非常看重智力，所以你可以将其视为某种智力测试。 [zuo wei bu luo de xian zhi ， wo fei chang kan zhong zhi li ， suo yi ni ke yi jiang qi shi wei mou zhong zhi li ce shi 。]

english: An intelligence test? I thought barbarians were stupid!
translation: 智力测试？我以为野蛮人都是傻子！ [zhi li ce shi ？ wo yi wei ye man ren dou shi sha zi ！]

english: That is the opinion that outerlanders usually hold of my people, it is true. But that is because people often confuse knowledge with wisdom.
translation: 这是外地人通常对我的人民的看法，确实如此。但那是因为人们常常将知识与智慧混为一谈。 [zhe shi wai di ren tong chang dui wo de ren min de kan fa ， que shi ru ci 。 dan na shi yin wei ren men chang chang jiang zhi shi yu zhi hui hun wei yi tan 。]

english: My puzzle tests not what you know, but what you can work out. All members of our clan have been tested when they took their trials.
translation: 我的谜题测试的不是你知道什么，而是你能解决什么。我们氏族的所有成员在参加试炼的时候都经过了考验。 [wo de mi ti ce shi de bu shi ni zhi dao shen me ， er shi ni neng jie jue shen me 。 wo men shi zu de suo you cheng yuan zai can jia shi lian de shi hou dou jing guo le kao yan 。]

english: So what exactly does this puzzle consist of, then?
translation: 那么这个谜题到底由什么组成呢？ [na me zhe ge mi ti dao di you shen me zu cheng ne ？]

english: Well, firstly you must enter my house with no items, weapons or armour. Then it is a simple matter of entering through one door and leaving by the other.
translation: 好吧，首先你必须不带任何物品、武器或盔甲进入我的房子。然后就是从一扇门进入并从另一扇门离开的简单问题。 [hao ba ， shou xian ni bi xu bu dai ren he wu pin 、 wu qi huo kui jia jin ru wo de fang zi 。 ran hou jiu shi cong yi shan men jin ru bing cong ling yi shan men li kai de jian dan wen ti 。]

english: I can't take anything in there with me?
translation: 我不能带任何东西进去吗？ [wo bu neng dai ren he dong xi jin qu ma ？]

english: That is correct outerlander. Everything you need to complete the puzzle you will find inside the building. Nothing more.
translation: 这是正确的外地人。完成拼图所需的一切都可以在建筑物内找到。而已。 [zhe shi zheng que de wai di ren 。 wan cheng pin tu suo xu de yi qie dou ke yi zai jian zhu wu nei zhao dao 。 er yi 。]

english: So what say you outerlander? You think you have the wit to earn yourself my vote?
translation: 那你这个外地人怎么说呢？你认为你有智慧为自己赢得我的选票吗？ [na ni zhe ge wai di ren zen me shuo ne ？ ni ren wei ni you zhi hui wei zi ji ying de wo de xuan piao ma ？]

english: Yes, I accept your challenge. I have one small question, however...
translation: 是的，我接受你的挑战。不过我有一个小问题... [shi de ， wo jie shou ni de tiao zhan 。 bu guo wo you yi ge xiao wen ti ...]

english: Yes, outerlander?
translation: 是啊，外地人？ [shi a ， wai di ren ？]

english: Well... you say I can bring nothing with me when I enter your house...
translation: 嗯……你说我进你家什么都不能带…… [n …… ni shuo wo jin ni jia shi me dou bu neng dai ……]

english: Well.....
translation: 出色地..... [chu se di .....]

english: Where is the nearest bank?
translation: 最近的银行在哪？ [zui jin de yin hang zai na ？]

english: Ah, I see your problem outerlander. The nearest bank to here is the place known to outerlanders as the Seers Village. It is some way South.
translation: 啊，我明白你的问题了，外地人。离这里最近的河岸是被外地人称为“先知村”的地方。这是向南走一段路。 [a ， wo ming bai ni de wen ti le ， wai di ren 。 li zhe li zui jin de he an shi bei wai di ren cheng wei “ xian zhi cun ” de di fang 。 zhe shi xiang nan zou yi duan lu 。]

english: I do however have an alternative, should you wish to take it.
translation: 不过，如果你愿意的话，我确实有一个替代方案。 [bu guo ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo que shi you yi ge ti dai fang an 。]

english: And what is that?
translation: 那是什么？ [na shi shen me ？]

english: I can store all the weapons, armour and items that you have upon you directly into your bank account.
translation: 我可以将你身上的所有武器、盔甲和物品直接存入你的银行账户。 [wo ke yi jiang ni shen shang de suo you wu qi 、 kui jia he wu pin zhi jie cun ru ni de yin hang zhang hu 。]

english: This will tax what little magic I possess however, so you will have to manually travel to the bank to withdraw them again.
translation: 然而，这会对我拥有的一点点魔法造成负担，所以你必须手动前往银行再次提取它们。 [ran er ， zhe hui dui wo yong you de yi dian dian mo fa zao cheng fu dan ， suo yi ni bi xu shou dong qian wang yin hang zai ci ti qu ta men 。]

english: What say you outerlander? you wish me to do this for you?
translation: 你这个外地人怎么说？你希望我为你做这件事吗？ [ni zhe ge wai di ren zen me shuo ？ ni xi wang wo wei ni zuo zhe jian shi ma ？]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No thanks. Nobody touches my stuff but me!
translation: 不，谢谢。除了我，没有人动我的东西！ [bu ， xie xie 。 chu le wo ， mei you ren dong wo de dong xi ！]

english: As you wish, outerlander.
translation: 如你所愿，外地人。 [ru ni suo yuan ， wai di ren 。]

english: You may attempt my little task when you have deposited your equipment in the bank.
translation: 当您将设备存入银行后，您可以尝试我的小任务。 [dang nin jiang she bei cun ru yin hang hou ， nin ke yi chang shi wo de xiao ren wu 。]

english: No, thinking about stuff isn't really my 'thing'. I'd rather go kill something. I'll find someone else to vote for me.
translation: 不，思考问题并不是我的“专长”。我宁愿去杀点东西。我会找其他人为我投票。 [bu ， si kao wen ti bing bu shi wo de “ zhuan chang ”。 wo ning yuan qu sha dian dong xi 。 wo hui zhao qi ta ren wei wo tou piao 。]

english: So I can bring nothing with me when I enter your house?
translation: 那么我进你家的时候什么都不能带吗？ [na me wo jin ni jia de shi hou shen me dou bu neng dai ma ？]

english: That is correct outerlander, but as I say, I can use my small skill in magic to send your items directly into your bank account from here.
translation: 这是正确的外来者，但正如我所说，我可以利用我的魔法小技巧将你的物品从这里直接发送到你的银行帐户。 [zhe shi zheng que de wai lai zhe ， dan zheng ru wo suo shuo ， wo ke yi li yong wo de mo fa xiao ji qiao jiang ni de wu pin cong zhe li zhi jie fa song dao ni de yin hang zhang hu 。]

english: You will need to manually go to the bank to withdraw them again however. Would you like me to perform this small spell upon you, outerlander?
translation: 不过，您需要手动前往银行再次提取。你想让我对你施展这个小咒语吗，外来者？ [bu guo ， nin xu yao shou dong qian wang yin hang zai ci ti qu 。 ni xiang rang wo dui ni shi zhan zhe ge xiao zhou yu ma ， wai lai zhe ？]

english: Yes, thank you!
translation: 是的，谢谢！ [shi de ， xie xie ！]

english: I am sorry outerlander, the spell is not working.
translation: 对不起，外地人，这个咒语不起作用。 [dui bu qi ， wai di ren ， zhe ge zhou yu bu qi zuo yong 。]

english: (same as above)
translation: （同上） [（ tong shang ）]

english: So I just have to enter by one door of your house, and leave by the other?
translation: 所以我只能从你家的一扇门进去，从另一扇门出去？ [suo yi wo zhi neng cong ni jia de yi shan men jin qu ， cong ling yi shan men chu qu ？]

english: That is correct outerlander. Be warned it is not as easy as it may at first sound...
translation: 这是正确的外地人。请注意，这并不像乍听起来那么容易...... [zhe shi zheng que de wai di ren 。 qing zhu yi ， zhe bing bu xiang zha ting qi lai na me rong yi ......]

english: Incredible! To have solved my puzzle so quickly! I have no choice but to vote in your favour!
translation: 极好的！这么快就解决了我的难题！我别无选择，只能投你一票！ [ji hao de ！ zhe me kuai jiu jie jue le wo de nan ti ！ wo bie wu xuan ze ， zhi neng tou ni yi piao ！]

english: So you will vote for me at the council?
translation: 那么你会在理事会上投票给我吗？ [na me ni hui zai li shi hui shang tou piao gei wo ma ？]

english: Absolutely, outerlander. Your wisdom in passing my test marks you as worthy in my eyes.
translation: 绝对是，外地人。你通过我的考验的智慧标志着你在我眼中是值得的。 [jue dui shi ， wai di ren 。 ni tong guo wo de kao yan de zhi hui biao zhi zhe ni zai wo yan zhong shi zhi de de 。]

english: I don't really fancy going through that annoying puzzle room again now that I have the Seer's vote.
translation: 既然我有了先知的投票，我真的不想再去那个烦人的谜题室了。 [ji ran wo you le xian zhi de tou piao ， wo zhen de bu xiang zai qu na ge fan ren de mi ti shi le 。]

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a weather forecast from the Fremennik Seer do you?
translation: 我想你不知道在哪里可以找到 Fremennik Seer 的天气预报，对吗？ [wo xiang ni bu zhi dao zai na li ke yi zhao dao  Fremennik Seer  de tian qi yu bao ， dui ma ？]

english: Er.... Yes, because I AM the Fremennik Seer.
translation: 呃……是的，因为我是弗雷曼尼克先知。 [e …… shi de ， yin wei wo shi fu lei man ni ke xian zhi 。]

english: Can I have a weather forecast then please?
translation: 那么可以给我天气预报吗？ [na me ke yi gei wo tian qi yu bao ma ？]

english: You require a divination of the weather? This is a simple matter for me, but I will require something in return from you for this small service.
translation: 您需要占卜天气吗？这对我来说是一件简单的事情，但我会要求你为这个小小的服务提供一些回报。 [nin xu yao zhan bu tian qi ma ？ zhe dui wo lai shuo shi yi jian jian dan de shi qing ， dan wo hui yao qiu ni wei zhe ge xiao xiao de fu wu ti gong yi xie hui bao 。]

english: I knew you were going to say that...
translation: 我就知道你会这么说…… [wo jiu zhi dao ni hui zhe me shuo ……]

english: Do not fret, outerlander; it is a fairly simple matter. I require a bodyguard for protection. Find someone willing to offer me this service.
translation: 别担心，外地人；这是一件相当简单的事情。我需要一名保镖来保护我。找到愿意为我提供这项服务的人。 [bie dan xin ， wai di ren ； zhe shi yi jian xiang dang jian dan de shi qing 。 wo xu yao yi ming bao biao lai bao hu wo 。 zhao dao yuan yi wei wo ti gong zhe xiang fu wu de ren 。]

english: That's all?
translation: 就这样？ [jiu zhe yang ？]

english: That is all.
translation: 仅此而已。 [jin ci er yi 。]

english: (non-quest dialogue)
translation: （非任务对话） [（ fei ren wu dui hua ）]

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a brave and powerful warrior to act as a bodyguard?
translation: 我想你不知道我去哪里可以找到一个勇敢而强大的战士来充当保镖吗？ [wo xiang ni bu zhi dao wo qu na li ke yi zhao dao yi ge yong gan er qiang da de zhan shi lai chong dang bao biao ma ？]

english: If I did, then I would simply have asked them myself now, wouldn't I, outerlander?
translation: 如果我这样做了，那么我现在就可以亲自问他们了，不是吗，外来者？ [ru guo wo zhe yang zuo le ， na me wo xian zai jiu ke yi qin zi wen ta men le ， bu shi ma ， wai lai zhe ？]

english: Can I have a weather forecast now please?
translation: 请问现在可以给我天气预报吗？ [qing wen xian zai ke yi gei wo tian qi yu bao ma ？]

english: I have already told you outerlander; You may have a reading from me when I have a signed contract from a warrior guaranteeing my protection.
translation: 我已经告诉过你外乡人了；当我与一位战士签订了保证保护我的合同时，您可能会读到我的内容。 [wo yi jing gao su guo ni wai xiang ren le ； dang wo yu yi wei zhan shi qian ding le bao zheng bao hu wo de he tong shi ， nin ke neng hui du dao wo de nei rong 。]

english: Yeah, I know; I have one right here from Thorvald.
translation: 是的，我知道；我这里有一份托瓦尔德寄来的。 [shi de ， wo zhi dao ； wo zhe li you yi fen tuo wa er de ji lai de 。]

english: You have not only persuaded one of the Fremennik to act as a servant to me, but you have enlisted the aid of mighty Thorvald himself???
translation: 你不仅说服了一名弗雷曼尼克人充当我的仆人，而且还获得了强大的托瓦尔德本人的帮助？？？ [ni bu jin shuo fu le yi ming fu lei man ni ke ren chong dang wo de pu ren ， er qie hai huo de le qiang da de tuo wa er de ben ren de bang zhu ？？？]

english: You may take this forecast with my blessing outerlander. You have offered me the greatest security I can imagine.
translation: 我祝福外地人，你可以接受这个预测。你给了我我能想象到的最大的安全感。 [wo zhu fu wai di ren ， ni ke yi jie shou zhe ge yu ce 。 ni gei le wo wo neng xiang xiang dao de zui da de an quan gan 。]

english: So, about this forecast...
translation: 那么，关于这个预测... [na me ， guan yu zhe ge yu ce ...]

english: I still don't know why you didn't just let me have one anyway in the first place. Surely it means nothing to you?
translation: 我还是不明白为什么你一开始就不让我拥有一个。当然这对你来说毫无意义吧？ [wo hai shi bu ming bai wei shen me ni yi kai shi jiu bu rang wo yong you yi ge 。 dang ran zhe dui ni lai shuo hao wu yi yi ba ？]

english: That is not true, outerlander. Although I see glimpses of the future all of the time, using my powers brings the attention of the gods to me.
translation: 这不是真的，外来者。虽然我一直都能看到未来，但使用我的力量会引起众神的注意。 [zhe bu shi zhen de ， wai lai zhe 。 sui ran wo yi zhi dou neng kan dao wei lai ， dan shi yong wo de li liang hui yin qi zhong shen de zhu yi 。]

english: Some of the gods are spiteful and cruel, and I fear if I use my powers too much then I will meet with unpredictable accidents. This is why I needed protection.
translation: 有些神是恶毒而残忍的，我担心如果我过度使用我的力量，我会遇到不可预测的意外。这就是我需要保护的原因。 [you xie shen shi e du er can ren de ， wo dan xin ru guo wo guo du shi yong wo de li liang ， wo hui yu dao bu ke yu ce de yi wai 。 zhe jiu shi wo xu yao bao hu de yuan yin 。]

english: Okay... I... think I understand...
translation: 好吧……我……我想我明白了…… [hao ba …… wo …… wo xiang wo ming bai le ……]

english: Hello there outerlander. I hear you are attempting to become a member of our tribe?
translation: 你好，外地人。我听说你想成为我们部落的一员？ [ni hao ， wai di ren 。 wo ting shuo ni xiang cheng wei wo men bu luo de yi yuan ？]

english: Should you prove successful come back and see me, and I will make you some fine armour.
translation: 如果你成功了就回来见我，我会给你做一些精美的盔甲。 [ru guo ni cheng gong le jiu hui lai jian wo ， wo hui gei ni zuo yi xie jing mei de kui jia 。]

english: Begone exile, before I call the Fremennik guards!
translation: 在我召唤弗雷曼尼克卫兵之前，滚吧！ [zai wo zhao huan fu lei man ni ke wei bing zhi qian ， gun ba ！]

english: Leave exile, before I alert the guards.
translation: 在我通知守卫之前离开流放地。 [zai wo tong zhi shou wei zhi qian li kai liu fang di 。]

english: Leave now, before I get rid of you myself.
translation: 在我亲自摆脱你之前，现在就离开吧。 [zai wo qin zi bai tuo ni zhi qian ， xian zai jiu li kai ba 。]

english: I'm sorry, you are our [brother/sister] no more. I cannot help you. Leave, before I must call the guards.
translation: 抱歉，你不再是我们的[兄弟/姐妹]。我帮不了你。离开吧，在我必须叫守卫之前。 [bao qian ， ni bu zai shi wo men de [ xiong di / jie mei ]。 wo bang bu liao ni 。 li kai ba ， zai wo bi xu jiao shou wei zhi qian 。]

english: Begone exile, you're no [brother/sister] to me.
translation: 滚吧，流亡吧，你对我来说不是[兄弟/姐妹]。 [gun ba ， liu wang ba ， ni dui wo lai shuo bu shi [ xiong di / jie mei ]。]

english: Though I appreciate your efforts in our trials, I'm afraid I can't speak to you [Fremennik name].
translation: 虽然我很感激你在我们的试验中所做的努力，但恐怕我无法和你说话[弗雷曼尼克名字]。 [sui ran wo hen gan ji ni zai wo men de shi yan zhong suo zuo de nu li ， dan kong pa wo wu fa he ni shuo hua [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。]

english: Please, Seer! I'm on a mission for Brundt.
translation: 拜托了，先知！我正在为布伦特执行任务。 [bai tuo le ， xian zhi ！ wo zheng zai wei bu lun te zhi xing ren wu 。]

english: Hmm... If the Chieftain can still trust you, so can I. How may I be of assistance?
translation: 嗯……如果酋长还能信任你，我也可以。我能帮什么忙吗？ [n …… ru guo qiu zhang hai neng xin ren ni ， wo ye ke yi 。 wo neng bang shen me mang ma ？]

english: It's a bit of a sensitive subject...
translation: 这是一个有点敏感的话题... [zhe shi yi ge you dian min gan de hua ti ...]

english: You can tell me anything, [Fremennik name]. What's the matter?
translation: 你可以告诉我任何事情，[弗雷曼尼克名字]。怎么了？ [ni ke yi gao su wo ren he shi qing ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 zen me le ？]

english: I can't bring myself to boil my pet rock!
translation: 我无法让自己煮我的宠物石头！ [wo wu fa rang zi ji zhu wo de chong wu shi tou ！]

english: I know, I'm a horrible person! Please help me, I can't bring myself to do it.
translation: 我知道，我是一个很可怕的人！请帮助我，我无法让自己做到这一点。 [wo zhi dao ， wo shi yi ge hen ke pa de ren ！ qing bang zhu wo ， wo wu fa rang zi ji zuo dao zhe yi dian 。]

english: Are you serious? I'm a busy man...
translation: 你是认真的？我是一个忙碌的人... [ni shi ren zhen de ？ wo shi yi ge mang lu de ren ...]

english: Please Seer, you're my only hope!
translation: 拜托，先知，你是我唯一的希望！ [bai tuo ， xian zhi ， ni shi wo wei yi de xi wang ！]

english: Very well. I'll clear your mind of any memories you have of your...
translation: 很好。我会清除你的脑海中所有关于你的记忆 [hen hao 。 wo hui qing chu ni de nao hai zhong suo you guan yu ni de ji yi]

english: *cough*
translation: *咳嗽* [* ke sou *]

english: pet rock...
translation: 宠物石... [chong wu shi ...]

english: I won't be able to speak with you after this. The others might start to get suspicious.
translation: 以后我就不能再和你说话了。其他人可能会开始怀疑。 [yi hou wo jiu bu neng zai he ni shuo hua le 。 qi ta ren ke neng hui kai shi huai yi 。]

english: I understand.
translation: 我明白。 [wo ming bai 。]

english: Concussio! Forgessan! Geodeus!
translation: 脑震荡！福格桑！乔德乌斯！ [nao zhen dang ！ fu ge sang ！ qiao de wu si ！]

english: Thank you, Seer! I'll head back to the mountains now.
translation: 谢谢你，先知！我现在就回山里去。 [xie xie ni ， xian zhi ！ wo xian zai jiu hui shan li qu 。]

english: Now be gone with you, exile!
translation: 现在就跟你走吧，流放者！ [xian zai jiu gen ni zou ba ， liu fang zhe ！]

english: I know it's just an act... but that hurt.
translation: 我知道这只是一种行为……但这很伤人。 [wo zhi dao zhe zhi shi yi zhong xing wei …… dan zhe hen shang ren 。]

english: Hello Peer.
translation: 你好，皮尔。 [ni hao ， pi er 。]

english: Greetings to you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! What brings you to see me again?
translation: 问候你[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]！是什么让你再次见到我？ [wen hou ni [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！ shi shen me rang ni zai ci jian dao wo ？]

english: I was wondering if you could give me a reading on my future...?
translation: 我想知道你能否给我读一下我的未来……？ [wo xiang zhi dao ni neng fou gei wo du yi xia wo de wei lai ……？]

english: Ah, you would like a prediction? I do not see that that would be so difficult... wait a moment...
translation: 啊，你想预测一下吗？我不认为那会那么困难......等一下...... [a ， ni xiang yu ce yi xia ma ？ wo bu ren wei na hui na me kun nan ...... deng yi xia ......]

english: Here is your prediction: The enemy called [fire giant/ghost/goblin/green dragon/hobgoblin/lesser demon/moss giant/ogre/skeleton/zombie] is your lucky totem this day.
translation: 这是你的预测：名为[火巨人/幽灵/妖精/绿龙/大妖精/小恶魔/苔藓巨人/食人魔/骷髅/僵尸]的敌人是你今天的幸运图腾。 [zhe shi ni de yu ce ： ming wei [ huo ju ren / you ling / yao jing / lv long / da yao jing / xiao e mo / tai xian ju ren / shi ren mo / ku lou / jiang shi ] de di ren shi ni jin tian de xing yun tu teng 。]

english: Here is your prediction: The stars tell me that you should use a [battleaxe/crossbow/dagger/javelin/long sword/mace/scimitar/short sword/spear/warhammer] in combat today.
translation: 这是你的预测：星星告诉我你今天在战斗中应该使用[战斧/弩/匕首/标枪/长剑/狼牙棒/弯刀/短剑/矛/战锤]。 [zhe shi ni de yu ce ： xing xing gao su wo ni jin tian zai zhan dou zhong ying gai shi yong [ zhan fu / nu / bi shou / biao qiang / chang jian / lang ya bang / wan dao / duan jian / mao / zhan chui ]。]

english: Here is your prediction: The place called [Al Kharid/Ardougne/Burthorpe/Canifis/Falador/Karamja/Varrock/The Wilderness/Yanille] will be worth your time to visit.
translation: 这是你的预测：名为[Al Kharid/Ardougne/Burthorpe/Canifis/Falador/Karamja/Varrock/The Wilderness/Yanille]的地方值得你花时间去参观。 [zhe shi ni de yu ce ： ming wei [Al Kharid/Ardougne/Burthorpe/Canifis/Falador/Karamja/Varrock/The Wilderness/Yanille] de di fang zhi de ni hua shi jian qu can guan 。]

english: Here is your prediction: You would be wise to train the skill [Agility/Cooking/Crafting/Fishing/Fletching/Herblore/Mining/Runecrafting/Smithing/Thieving] today.
translation: 这是你的预测：你今天应该明智地训练技能[敏捷/烹饪/制作/钓鱼/制箭/草药/采矿/符文制作/锻造/盗窃]。 [zhe shi ni de yu ce ： ni jin tian ying gai ming zhi di xun lian ji neng [ min jie / peng ren / zhi zuo / diao yu / zhi jian / cao yao / cai kuang / fu wen zhi zuo / duan zao / dao qie ]。]

english: Here is your prediction: The colour [black/blue/brown/cyan/green/pink/purple/red/white/yellow] will bring you luck this day.
translation: 这是你的预测：颜色[黑色/蓝色/棕色/青色/绿色/粉色/紫色/红色/白色/黄色]会给你带来今天的好运。 [zhe shi ni de yu ce ： yan se [ hei se / lan se / zong se / qing se / lv se / fen se / zi se / hong se / bai se / huang se ] hui gei ni dai lai jin tian de hao yun 。]

english: Here is your prediction: You will find luck today with the number [one/two/three/four/five/six/seven/eight/nine/ten].
translation: 这是你的预测：今天你会在数字[一/二/三/四/五/六/七/八/九/十]上找到好运气。 [zhe shi ni de yu ce ： jin tian ni hui zai shu zi [ yi / er / san / si / wu / liu / qi / ba / jiu / shi ] shang zhao dao hao yun qi 。]

english: Can you bank my stuff?
translation: 你能把我的东西存入银行吗？ [ni neng ba wo de dong xi cun ru yin hang ma ？]

english: Nothing really, I just stopped by to say hello.
translation: 其实没什么，我只是过来打个招呼。 [qi shi mei shen me ， wo zhi shi guo lai da ge zhao hu 。]

english: Well, hello to you too!
translation: 嗯，也向你问好！ [n ， ye xiang ni wen hao ！]

english: As you wish, [Fremennik name]. What kind of armour were you thinking of exactly?
translation: 如你所愿，[弗里曼尼克名字]。你到底想到什么样的盔甲？ [ru ni suo yuan ，[ fu li man ni ke ming zi ]。 ni dao di xiang dao shen me yang de kui jia ？]

english: I am afraid it will cost you 5,000 coins to make that for you... Is that okay?
translation: 恐怕要花五千金币才能给你做……可以吗？ [kong pa yao hua wu qian jin bi cai neng gei ni zuo …… ke yi ma ？]

english: YES
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: Ah, a helm to make any seer proud! Did you want me to make you another while I am at it?
translation: 啊，一顶让任何预言家都感到自豪的头盔！你想让我在我做的时候再给你做一个吗？ [a ， yi ding rang ren he yu yan jia dou gan dao zi hao de tou kui ！ ni xiang rang wo zai wo zuo de shi hou zai gei ni zuo yi ge ma ？]

english: My apologies [Fremennik name], but I will need you to bring me 1 piece of dark dagger-mouth hide, 1 skull piece and 5,000 coins before I can make this helm for you.
translation: 很抱歉[弗里曼尼克名字]，但我需要你给我带来 1 块深色匕首嘴兽皮、1 块头骨碎片和 5,000 枚硬币，然后我才能为你制作这顶头盔。 [hen bao qian [ fu li man ni ke ming zi ]， dan wo xu yao ni gei wo dai lai  1  kuai shen se bi shou zui shou pi 、1  kuai tou gu sui pian he  5,000  mei ying bi ， ran hou wo cai neng wei ni zhi zuo zhe ding tou kui 。]

english: I am afraid it will cost you 10,000 coins to make that for you... Is that okay?
translation: 恐怕要花一万金币给你做……可以吗？ [kong pa yao hua yi wan jin bi gei ni zuo …… ke yi ma ？]

english: The seers of legend all wore just such armour! Did you want me to craft you another piece?
translation: 传说中的预言家都穿着这样的铠甲！你想让我再给你做一件吗？ [chuan shuo zhong de yu yan jia dou chuan zhe zhe yang de kai jia ！ ni xiang rang wo zai gei ni zuo yi jian ma ？]

english: I am sorry [Fremennik name], but I need 3 pieces of dark dagger-mouth hide, 1 ribcage piece and 10,000 coins to make you this armour...
translation: 对不起[弗里曼尼克名字]，我需要 3 块深色匕首兽皮、1 块胸腔碎片和 10,000 个硬币来为你制作这件盔甲...... [dui bu qi [ fu li man ni ke ming zi ]， wo xu yao  3  kuai shen se bi shou shou pi 、1  kuai xiong qiang sui pian he  10,000  ge ying bi lai wei ni zhi zuo zhe jian kui jia ......]

english: I am afraid it will cost you 7,500 coins to make that for you... Is that okay?
translation: 恐怕要花七千五百金币才能给你做……可以吗？ [kong pa yao hua qi qian wu bai jin bi cai neng gei ni zuo …… ke yi ma ？]

english: Ah, I used to wear just such a piece of armour to battle in my youth... Do you want me to make you another pair of legs while I am doing it anyway?
translation: 啊，我年轻时就穿着这么一件铠甲去战斗……要不要我一边做一边给你再做一双腿？ [a ， wo nian qing shi jiu chuan zhe zhe me yi jian kai jia qu zhan dou …… yao bu yao wo yi bian zuo yi bian gei ni zai zuo yi shuang tui ？]
