english: So many years gone by. My children must have grown up and left home.
translation: 这么多年过去了。我的孩子们一定已经长大并离开家了。 [zhe me duo nian guo qu le 。 wo de hai zi men yi ding yi jing zhang da bing li kai jia le 。]

english: I haven't remembered them in so long... thank you for reminding me of them.
translation: 我已经很久不记得他们了...谢谢你提醒我。 [wo yi jing hen jiu bu ji de ta men le ... xie xie ni ti xing wo 。]

english: Are you feeling better now?
translation: 你现在感觉好些了吗？ [ni xian zai gan jue hao xie le ma ？]

english: Yes, thank you.
translation: 是的，谢谢。 [shi de ， xie xie 。]

english: The food you gave me healed my wounds, and it also reminded me of my family; that helped me to remember who I was.
translation: 你给我的食物治愈了我的伤口，也让我想起了我的家人；这帮助我记住了我是谁。 [ni gei wo de shi wu zhi yu le wo de shang kou ， ye rang wo xiang qi le wo de jia ren ； zhe bang zhu wo ji zhu le wo shi shui 。]

english: I'm afraid that I'm trapped here, but I still remember something of this floor of the temple.
translation: 我恐怕被困在这里了，不过神殿这一层的一些事情我还是记得的。 [wo kong pa bei kun zai zhe li le ， bu guo shen dian zhe yi ceng de yi xie shi qing wo hai shi ji de de 。]

english: If you need any hints about the rooms nearby, I can give you some help.
translation: 如果您需要有关附近房间的任何提示，我可以为您提供帮助。 [ru guo nin xu yao you guan fu jin fang jian de ren he ti shi ， wo ke yi wei nin ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: When we came to the temple, that fountain was frosted with ice.
translation: 当我们来到寺庙时，那个喷泉结满了冰。 [dang wo men lai dao si miao shi ， na ge pen quan jie man le bing 。]

english: Even chipping at it with swords or lighting fires under it didn't do anything.
translation: 即使用剑砍它或者在它下面点燃火也没有任何作用。 [ji shi yong jian kan ta huo zhe zai ta xia mian dian ran huo ye mei you ren he zuo yong 。]

english: My guess is that some sort of magic is keeping it that way.
translation: 我的猜测是某种魔法让它保持这种状态。 [wo de cai ce shi mou zhong mo fa rang ta bao chi zhe zhong zhuang tai 。]

english: Tell me about the room with the furnace.
translation: 告诉我有关有炉子的房间的情况。 [gao su wo you guan you lu zi de fang jian de qing kuang 。]

english: I tried to go in there, but the smoke was so thick I could barely see the furnace.
translation: 我试图进去，但烟雾太浓，我几乎看不到熔炉。 [wo shi tu jin qu ， dan yan wu tai nong ， wo ji hu kan bu dao rong lu 。]

english: It may be that it's blocked, in which case you'll have to clear it out.
translation: 可能是它被阻止了，在这种情况下，您必须将其清除。 [ke neng shi ta bei zu zhi le ， zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， nin bi xu jiang qi qing chu 。]

english: A good breeze should do the trick.
translation: 一阵微风应该就能解决问题。 [yi zhen wei feng ying gai jiu neng jie jue wen ti 。]

english: Tell me about the dark room.
translation: 告诉我关于暗室的事情。 [gao su wo guan yu an shi de shi qing 。]

english: I never went in there myself, but I peered through the door.
translation: 我自己从未进去过，但我透过门往里看。 [wo zi ji cong wei jin qu guo ， dan wo tou guo men wang li kan 。]

english: There seemed to be fires of some sort all around the room, but they were burning low.
translation: 房间里似乎到处都有火，但火势很弱。 [fang jian li si hu dao chu dou you huo ， dan huo shi hen ruo 。]

english: I'd imagine they've gone out by now.
translation: 我想他们现在已经出去了。 [wo xiang ta men xian zai yi jing chu qu le 。]

english: It's okay, I don't need any help.
translation: 没关系，我不需要任何帮助。 [mei guan xi ， wo bu xu yao ren he bang zhu 。]

english: Tell me about the room with the fountain.
translation: 告诉我有喷泉的房间。 [gao su wo you pen quan de fang jian 。]

english: Tell me about the room with the furnace.
translation: 告诉我有关有炉子的房间的情况。 [gao su wo you guan you lu zi de fang jian de qing kuang 。]

english: Tell me about the dark room.
translation: 告诉我关于暗室的事情。 [gao su wo guan yu an shi de shi qing 。]

english: It's okay, I don't need any help.
translation: 没关系，我不需要任何帮助。 [mei guan xi ， wo bu xu yao ren he bang zhu 。]

english: Are you hunting animals, then?
translation: 那么你在狩猎动物吗？ [na me ni zai shou lie dong wu ma ？]

english: I'm exploring the region for the good of the gnome people.
translation: 我正在探索这个地区，是为了侏儒人民的利益。 [wo zheng zai tan suo zhe ge di qu ， shi wei le zhu ru ren min de li yi 。]

english: You're not tracking down huge beasts to kill - you look equipped for it.
translation: 你并不是在追踪巨大的野兽来杀死——你看起来已经做好了准备。 [ni bing bu shi zai zhui zong ju da de ye shou lai sha si —— ni kan qi lai yi jing zuo hao le zhun bei 。]

english: Well, if I find anything interesting I'll try and bring it back to the King. That might include animals, I suppose. I'd rather not kill it, though - most animals are more useful alive.
translation: 好吧，如果我发现任何有趣的东西，我会尽力把它带回给国王。我想这可能包括动物。不过，我宁愿不杀死它——大多数动物活着更有用。 [hao ba ， ru guo wo fa xian ren he you qu de dong xi ， wo hui jin li ba ta dai hui gei guo wang 。 wo xiang zhe ke neng bao kuo dong wu 。 bu guo ， wo ning yuan bu sha si ta —— da duo shu dong wu huo zhe geng you yong 。]

english: How would you get it home, then?
translation: 那你要怎么把它带回家呢？ [na ni yao zen me ba ta dai hui jia ne ？]

english: Never underestimate the ingenuity of a gnome, friend.
translation: 永远不要低估侏儒的聪明才智，朋友。 [yong yuan bu yao di gu zhu ru de cong ming cai zhi ， peng you 。]

english: Have you found anything else interesting around here?
translation: 你在这附近还发现什么其他有趣的事情吗？ [ni zai zhe fu jin hai fa xian shen me qi ta you qu de shi qing ma ？]

english: I've heard strange rumours about something the locals call the Broodoo. I haven't quite worked out what they are but they seem to be some sort of undead whose ghastly fate depends on the way they were killed.
translation: 我听说过一些奇怪的谣言，说的是当地人称之为“布罗杜”的东西。我还没弄清楚它们是什么，但它们似乎是某种不死生物，其可怕的命运取决于它们被杀死的方式。 [wo ting shuo guo yi xie qi guai de yao yan ， shuo de shi dang di ren cheng zhi wei “ bu luo du ” de dong xi 。 wo hai mei nong qing chu ta men shi shen me ， dan ta men si hu shi mou zhong bu si sheng wu ， qi ke pa de ming yun qu jue yu ta men bei sha si de fang shi 。]

english: I think they may be sacrifice victims - but I'm not sure why they are sacrificed. Either way the locals seem to be very scared of them.
translation: 我认为他们可能是牺牲品的受害者——但我不确定他们为什么被牺牲。不管怎样，当地人似乎都很害怕他们。 [wo ren wei ta men ke neng shi xi sheng pin de shou hai zhe —— dan wo bu que ding ta men wei shen me bei xi sheng 。 bu guan zen yang ， dang di ren si hu dou hen hai pa ta men 。]

english: That's interesting. Thanks.
translation: 那很有意思。谢谢。 [na hen you yi si 。 xie xie 。]

english: What does this mint cake do?
translation: 这个薄荷蛋糕有什么作用呢？ [zhe ge bo he dan gao you shen me zuo yong ne ？]

english: Gnomish mint cake is a great source of energy for the gnome traveller. It will give you that extra bit of zip when you are running out of steam.
translation: 侏儒薄荷蛋糕是侏儒旅行者的重要能量来源。当你精疲力竭时，它会给你额外的动力。 [zhu ru bo he dan gao shi zhu ru lv xing zhe de zhong yao neng liang lai yuan 。 dang ni jing pi li jie shi ， ta hui gei ni e wai de dong li 。]

english: Ooh, that might come in very handy. Do you have any spare?
translation: 哦，这可能会非常方便。你还有空余的吗？ [o ， zhe ke neng hui fei chang fang bian 。 ni hai you kong yu de ma ？]

english: I need all the mint cake I have, I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕我需要所有的薄荷蛋糕。 [kong pa wo xu yao suo you de bo he dan gao 。]

english: What does this seed pod do?
translation: 这个种子荚有什么作用？ [zhe ge zhong zi jia you shen me zuo yong ？]

english: Ah, the seed pod of the Grand Tree is a fascinating spirit artefact. It is a very useful thing, though one must treat it with respect, since the Grand Tree has a connection with all of its parts, however distant they
translation: 啊，大树的籽荚，真是一件令人着迷的灵器啊。这是一件非常有用的东西，尽管人们必须尊重它，因为大树与其所有部分都有联系，无论它们有多远 [a ， da shu de zi jia ， zhen shi yi jian ling ren zhao mi de ling qi a 。 zhe shi yi jian fei chang you yong de dong xi ， jin guan ren men bi xu zun zhong ta ， yin wei da shu yu qi suo you bu fen dou you lian xi ， wu lun ta men you duo yuan]

english: may be. How do you think the Spirit Trees work?
translation: 或许。你认为灵树如何发挥作用？ [huo xu 。 ni ren wei ling shu ru he fa hui zuo yong ？]

english: If you launch its seeds in a far flung location, you will be helping the tree survive, so the grand tree will help a gnome glider pilot find you, using the seed burst itself (which marks the sky) and a little magic, and bring you
translation: 如果你在一个遥远的地方发射它的种子，你将帮助这棵树生存，所以这棵大树将帮助侏儒滑翔机飞行员找到你，使用种子爆炸本身（标记天空）和一点魔法，并把你带来 [ru guo ni zai yi ge yao yuan de di fang fa she ta de zhong zi ， ni jiang bang zhu zhe ke shu sheng cun ， suo yi zhe ke da shu jiang bang zhu zhu ru hua xiang ji fei xing yuan zhao dao ni ， shi yong zhong zi bao zha ben shen （ biao ji tian kong ） he yi dian mo fa ， bing ba ni dai lai]

english: back home as an act of gratitude. Budding farmers will also find their link with plants to be just a little bit better than before.
translation: 回国以示谢意。初露头角的农民也会发现他们与植物的联系比以前更好了一点。 [hui guo yi shi xie yi 。 chu lu tou jiao de nong min ye hui fa xian ta men yu zhi wu de lian xi bi yi qian geng hao le yi dian 。]

english: However, it takes time for a pilot to find you, and if you are in a real hurry, and I mean a real emergency, you can just squash the seed pod. The Grand Tree doesn't like this, but will pull you back
translation: 然而，飞行员需要时间才能找到你，如果你真的很着急，我的意思是真正的紧急情况，你可以压碎种子荚。大树不喜欢这样，但会把你拉回来 [ran er ， fei xing yuan xu yao shi jian cai neng zhao dao ni ， ru guo ni zhen de hen zhao ji ， wo de yi si shi zhen zheng de jin ji qing kuang ， ni ke yi ya sui zhong zi jia 。 da shu bu xi huan zhe yang ， dan hui ba ni la hui lai]

english: home straight away. Don't do this if you need to do anything with plants straight away, though - your fingers will be considerably less green for a while after using the seed pod this way, and the journey is not
translation: 马上回家。不过，如果您需要立即对植物做任何事情，请不要这样做 - 以这种方式使用种子荚后，您的手指在一段时间内会变得不那么绿，并且旅程不会 [ma shang hui jia 。 bu guo ， ru guo nin xu yao li ji dui zhi wu zuo ren he shi qing ， qing bu yao zhe yang zuo  -  yi zhe zhong fang shi shi yong zhong zi jia hou ， nin de shou zhi zai yi duan shi jian nei hui bian de bu na me lv ， bing qie lv cheng bu hui]

english: very pleasant...
translation: 非常愉快... [fei chang yu kuai ...]

english: Wow, that's very interesting. Thanks.
translation: 哇，这很有趣。谢谢。 [wa ， zhe hen you qu 。 xie xie 。]

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 尽管您找到了顾客，但您似乎没有带来正确的食物！你需要[一个/一些][订购的侏儒食物/饮料]！ [jin guan nin zhao dao le gu ke ， dan nin si hu mei you dai lai zheng que de shi wu ！ ni xu yao [ yi ge / yi xie ][ ding gou de zhu ru shi wu / yin liao ]！]

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜肴不行。对于 Aluft Aloft 的顾客来说，只有手工制作的 Gnome Cuisine 才足够好。 [kong pa yu zhi cai yao bu xing 。 dui yu  Aluft Aloft  de gu ke lai shuo ， zhi you shou gong zhi zuo de  Gnome Cuisine  cai zu gou hao 。]

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food item] to Penwie.
translation: 你将[一些][订购的侏儒食品]交给Penwie。 [ni jiang [ yi xie ][ ding gou de zhu ru shi pin ] jiao gei Penwie。]

english: At last a taste of home!
translation: 终于尝到了家的味道！ [zhong yu chang dao le jia de wei dao ！]

english: Now that I have some proper food, I won't need this any more.
translation: 现在我有了一些合适的食物，我就不再需要这个了。 [xian zai wo you le yi xie he shi de shi wu ， wo jiu bu zai xu yao zhe ge le 。]

english: Here, take these Grand Seed pods. Very useful in emergencies!
translation: 来，拿走这些大种子荚。在紧急情况下非常有用！ [lai ， na zou zhe xie da zhong zi jia 。 zai jin ji qing kuang xia fei chang you yong ！]

english: I traded with some of the locals for this - maybe you'll find it useful.
translation: 我和一些当地人交换了这个——也许你会发现它很有用。 [wo he yi xie dang di ren jiao huan le zhe ge —— ye xu ni hui fa xian ta hen you yong 。]

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 你一定是走了很远的路才把这个交给我的。这里有一些额外的东西作为提示。 [ni yi ding shi zou le hen yuan de lu cai ba zhe ge jiao gei wo de 。 zhe li you yi xie e wai de dong xi zuo wei ti shi 。]

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 您有 [number] 个积分用于免费送货令牌。您可能会收到 [number] 块侏儒食物。 [nin you  [number]  ge ji fen yong yu mian fei song huo ling pai 。 nin ke neng hui shou dao  [number]  kuai zhu ru shi wu 。]

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 不要忘记从 Aluft Gianne jnr 领取免费送货代币。 [bu yao wang ji cong  Aluft Gianne jnr  ling qu mian fei song huo dai bi 。]

english: Are you hunting animals then?
translation: 那你狩猎动物吗？ [na ni shou lie dong wu ma ？]

english: What does this mint cake do?
translation: 这个薄荷蛋糕有什么作用呢？ [zhe ge bo he dan gao you shen me zuo yong ne ？]

english: What does this seed pod do?
translation: 这个种子荚有什么作用？ [zhe ge zhong zi jia you shen me zuo yong ？]

english: It seems you're missing out on some valuable experience. Would you like it?
translation: 看来你错过了一些宝贵的经验。你愿意吗？ [kan lai ni cuo guo le yi xie bao gui de jing yan 。 ni yuan yi ma ？]

english: You are owed the following: [list of experience the player can claim]
translation: 您有以下义务：[玩家可以索取的经验列表] [nin you yi xia yi wu ：[ wan jia ke yi suo qu de jing yan lie biao ]]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: There you go.
translation: 就这样吧。 [jiu zhe yang ba 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Fair enough.
translation: 很公平。 [hen gong ping 。]

english: Hello. I've found some stuff that I think is yours. You can pay me with cash you're carrying, or I can take payments from your bank. Would you like to buy anything from me?
translation: 你好。我找到了一些我认为是你的东西。您可以用您携带的现金向我付款，或者我可以从您的银行付款。你想从我这里买东西吗？ [ni hao 。 wo zhao dao le yi xie wo ren wei shi ni de dong xi 。 nin ke yi yong nin xie dai de xian jin xiang wo fu kuan ， huo zhe wo ke yi cong nin de yin hang fu kuan 。 ni xiang cong wo zhe li mai dong xi ma ？]

english: Why do you charge for returning lost items?
translation: 为什么退回丢失物品要收费？ [wei shen me tui hui diu shi wu pin yao shou fei ？]

english: You could get your stuff back elsewhere, sure. Now, maybe it'd be free, or maybe you'd have to pay someone, but you'd definitely have to go on a journey to get it back.
translation: 当然，你可以在其他地方取回你的东西。现在，也许它是免费的，或者也许你必须付钱给某人，但你肯定必须走一段路才能把它拿回来。 [dang ran ， ni ke yi zai qi ta di fang qu hui ni de dong xi 。 xian zai ， ye xu ta shi mian fei de ， huo zhe ye xu ni bi xu fu qian gei mou ren ， dan ni ken ding bi xu zou yi duan lu cai neng ba ta na hui lai 。]

english: So I'm earning my fee by saving you a trip. Do you want to have a look?
translation: 所以我通过为你节省一次旅行来赚取费用。你想看一下吗？ [suo yi wo tong guo wei ni jie sheng yi ci lv xing lai zhuan qu fei yong 。 ni xiang kan yi xia ma ？]

english: Show me what you've found.
translation: 告诉我你发现了什么。 [gao su wo ni fa xian le shen me 。]

english: About items that break when people kill me...
translation: 关于当人们杀了我时会破碎的物品...... [guan yu dang ren men sha le wo shi hui po sui de wu pin ......]

english: Oh yes, some items do break specially when you're killed by your rivals. And if you die in the deep Wilderness, they vanish altogether.
translation: 哦，是的，当你被对手杀死时，有些物品确实会特别损坏。如果你死在荒野深处，它们就会完全消失。 [o ， shi de ， dang ni bei dui shou sha si shi ， you xie wu pin que shi hui te bie sun huai 。 ru guo ni si zai huang ye shen chu ， ta men jiu hui wan quan xiao shi 。]

english: Can you fix them?
translation: 你能修好它们吗？ [ni neng xiu hao ta men ma ？]

english: For a fee, yes. Just show me the broken item.
translation: 收费，是的。只要给我看看损坏的物品即可。 [shou fei ， shi de 。 zhi yao gei wo kan kan sun huai de wu pin ji ke 。]

english: Can you stop them vanishing in deep Wilderness?
translation: 你能阻止他们消失在荒野深处吗？ [ni neng zu zhi ta men xiao shi zai huang ye shen chu ma ？]

english: I can lock them to you so they won't vanish on death in deep Wilderness, yes. I'll want some money for my services, though, and you'll need to bring me a Trouver Parchment.
translation: 我可以把它们锁在你身上，这样它们就不会在荒野深处死亡时消失，是的。不过，我需要一些钱来支付我的服务，而且你需要给我一张特鲁弗羊皮纸。 [wo ke yi ba ta men suo zai ni shen shang ， zhe yang ta men jiu bu hui zai huang ye shen chu si wang shi xiao shi ， shi de 。 bu guo ， wo xu yao yi xie qian lai zhi fu wo de fu wu ， er qie ni xu yao gei wo yi zhang te lu fu yang pi zhi 。]

english: You'll find her in Ferox Enclave, where people play a game called Last Man Standing. Bring the parchment here, then show me the item you want to lock.
translation: 你会在 Ferox Enclave 找到她，那里的人们玩一种名为“Last Man Standing”的游戏。把羊皮纸带到这里，然后给我看你想要锁定的物品。 [ni hui zai  Ferox Enclave  zhao dao ta ， na li de ren men wan yi zhong ming wei “Last Man Standing” de you xi 。 ba yang pi zhi dai dao zhe li ， ran hou gei wo kan ni xiang yao suo ding de wu pin 。]

english: I've got the parchment.
translation: 我有羊皮纸。 [wo you yang pi zhi 。]

english: Not bad for a human! Okay, show me the item you want to protect, and I'll see what I can do.
translation: 对人类来说还不错！好的，让我看看你想要保护的物品，我看看能做什么。 [dui ren lei lai shuo hai bu cuo ！ hao de ， rang wo kan kan ni xiang yao bao hu de wu pin ， wo kan kan neng zuo shen me 。]

english: I can lock that item so that it won't vanish if you die in deep Wilderness, but I'll need a Trouver parchment.
translation: 我可以锁定该物品，这样如果你死在荒野深处，它就不会消失，但我需要一张特鲁弗羊皮纸。 [wo ke yi suo ding gai wu pin ， zhe yang ru guo ni si zai huang ye shen chu ， ta jiu bu hui xiao shi ， dan wo xu yao yi zhang te lu fu yang pi zhi 。]

english: You'll find her in Ferox Enclave, where people play a game called Last Man Standing. Bring the parchment here, then show me the item again.
translation: 你会在 Ferox Enclave 找到她，那里的人们玩一种名为“Last Man Standing”的游戏。把羊皮纸拿过来，然后再给我看一下这个东西。 [ni hui zai  Ferox Enclave  zhao dao ta ， na li de ren men wan yi zhong ming wei “Last Man Standing” de you xi 。 ba yang pi zhi na guo lai ， ran hou zai gei wo kan yi xia zhe ge dong xi 。]

english: I can lock that item so that it won't vanish if you die in deep Wilderness. It'll cost you 500,000 coins and a Trouver parchment.
translation: 我可以锁定该物品，这样如果你死在荒野深处，它就不会消失。它会花费你 500,000 个硬币和一张特鲁弗羊皮纸。 [wo ke yi suo ding gai wu pin ， zhe yang ru guo ni si zai huang ye shen chu ， ta jiu bu hui xiao shi 。 ta hui hua fei ni  500,000  ge ying bi he yi zhang te lu fu yang pi zhi 。]

english: I've locked that item to you so that it won't vanish if you're killed in deep Wilderness. I can unlock it again, returning your parchment and 475,000 coins.
translation: 我已经把那件物品锁在你身上，这样如果你在荒野深处被杀，它就不会消失。我可以再次解锁，归还你的羊皮纸和 475,000 个金币。 [wo yi jing ba na jian wu pin suo zai ni shen shang ， zhe yang ru guo ni zai huang ye shen chu bei sha ， ta jiu bu hui xiao shi 。 wo ke yi zai ci jie suo ， gui huan ni de yang pi zhi he  475,000  ge jin bi 。]

english: If you want me to lock an item to you so that it won't vanish if you're killed in deep Wilderness, show me the item.
translation: 如果你想让我锁定一个物品给你，这样当你在荒野深处被杀时它就不会消失，请给我看看该物品。 [ru guo ni xiang rang wo suo ding yi ge wu pin gei ni ， zhe yang dang ni zai huang ye shen chu bei sha shi ta jiu bu hui xiao shi ， qing gei wo kan kan gai wu pin 。]

english: I have something for you. You lost your Echo boots. Would you like it back?
translation: 我有东西给你。你丢失了 Echo 靴子。你想要它回来吗？ [wo you dong xi gei ni 。 ni diu shi le  Echo  xue zi 。 ni xiang yao ta hui lai ma ？]

english: Ah! I have something for you. You lost your banner. Would you like it back?
translation: 啊!我有东西给你。你失去了你的旗帜。你想要它回来吗？ [a ! wo you dong xi gei ni 。 ni shi qu le ni de qi zhi 。 ni xiang yao ta hui lai ma ？]

english: You seem lost, but luckily I know where to send you. A breach is occurring[location 1] (single). Another breach is occuring[location 2] (multi).
translation: 你看起来迷路了，但幸运的是我知道该送你去哪里。 [位置 1] 发生违规（单个）。另一个违规事件正在发生[位置 2]（多处）。 [ni kan qi lai mi lu le ， dan xing yun de shi wo zhi dao gai song ni qu na li 。 [ wei zhi  1]  fa sheng wei gui （ dan ge ）。 ling yi ge wei gui shi jian zheng zai fa sheng [ wei zhi  2]（ duo chu ）。]

english: You have[time left]remaining. Otherwise...
translation: 您还剩[剩余时间]。否则... [nin hai sheng [ sheng yu shi jian ]。 fou ze ...]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Why do you charge for returning lost items?
translation: 为什么退回丢失物品要收费？ [wei shen me tui hui diu shi wu pin yao shou fei ？]

english: Show me what you've found.
translation: 告诉我你发现了什么。 [gao su wo ni fa xian le shen me 。]

english: About items that break when people kill me...
translation: 关于当人们杀了我时会破碎的物品...... [guan yu dang ren men sha le wo shi hui po sui de wu pin ......]

english: Can you fix them?
translation: 你能修好它们吗？ [ni neng xiu hao ta men ma ？]

english: Can you stop them vanishing in deep Wilderness?
translation: 你能阻止他们消失在荒野深处吗？ [ni neng zu zhi ta men xiao shi zai huang ye shen chu ma ？]

translation: 锁定物品（[已使用的物品]） [suo ding wu pin （[ yi shi yong de wu pin ]）]

english: Ooh, lovely view, dear.
translation: 噢，美丽的景色，亲爱的。 [o ， mei li de jing se ， qin ai de 。]

english: Yes dear.
translation: 是的亲爱的。 [shi de qin ai de 。]

english: I hope the food's better here than it was last time.
translation: 我希望这里的食物比上次更好。 [wo xi wang zhe li de shi wu bi shang ci geng hao 。]

english: I'm sure it will be, dear.
translation: 我确信会的，亲爱的。 [wo que xin hui de ， qin ai de 。]

english: Sorry to disturb you, but what are you two doing here?
translation: 抱歉打扰你们，你们两个在这里做什么？ [bao qian da rao ni men ， ni men liang ge zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Perrdur and I are having a nice romantic dinner, aren't we dear?
translation: 佩杜尔和我正在享用一顿浪漫的晚餐，不是吗，亲爱的？ [pei du er he wo zheng zai xiang yong yi dun lang man de wan can ， bu shi ma ， qin ai de ？]

english: We are celebrating the anniversary of our marriage, aren't we dear?
translation: 我们正在庆祝结婚周年纪念日，不是吗亲爱的？ [wo men zheng zai qing zhu jie hun zhou nian ji nian ri ， bu shi ma qin ai de ？]

english: And we are having a very enjoyable time, aren't we dear?
translation: 我们正在度过一段非常愉快的时光，不是吗，亲爱的？ [wo men zheng zai du guo yi duan fei chang yu kuai de shi guang ， bu shi ma ， qin ai de ？]

english: Clearly. I'll let you two lovebirds carry on, then.
translation: 清楚地。那我就让你们两个爱情鸟继续下去吧。 [qing chu di 。 na wo jiu rang ni men liang ge ai qing niao ji xu xia qu ba 。]

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 尽管您找到了顾客，但您似乎没有带来正确的食物！你需要[一个/一些][订购的侏儒食物/饮料]！ [jin guan nin zhao dao le gu ke ， dan nin si hu mei you dai lai zheng que de shi wu ！ ni xu yao [ yi ge / yi xie ][ ding gou de zhu ru shi wu / yin liao ]！]

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜肴不行。对于 Aluft Aloft 的顾客来说，只有手工制作的 Gnome Cuisine 才足够好。 [kong pa yu zhi cai yao bu xing 。 dui yu  Aluft Aloft  de gu ke lai shuo ， zhi you shou gong zhi zuo de  Gnome Cuisine  cai zu gou hao 。]

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Perrdur
translation: 你将[一份/一些][订购的侏儒食物/饮料物品]交给Perrdur [ni jiang [ yi fen / yi xie ][ ding gou de zhu ru shi wu / yin liao wu pin ] jiao gei Perrdur]

english: Thank you dear, This looks as if it might be edible for a change!
translation: 谢谢亲爱的，这看起来好像可以换一下吃！ [xie xie qin ai de ， zhe kan qi lai hao xiang ke yi huan yi xia chi ！]

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 您有 [number] 个积分用于免费送货令牌。您可能会收到 [number] 块侏儒食物。 [nin you  [number]  ge ji fen yong yu mian fei song huo ling pai 。 nin ke neng hui shou dao  [number]  kuai zhu ru shi wu 。]

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 不要忘记从 Aluft Gianne jnr 领取免费送货代币。 [bu yao wang ji cong  Aluft Gianne jnr  ling qu mian fei song huo dai bi 。]

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 你的交货太晚了！返回 Aluft jnr。以获得另一个订单。您丢弃了送货箱，因为您不再需要它了。 [ni de jiao huo tai wan le ！ fan hui  Aluft jnr。 yi huo de ling yi ge ding dan 。 nin diu qi le song huo xiang ， yin wei nin bu zai xu yao ta le 。]

english: Hey, adventurer. Do you want to buy any axes?
translation: 嘿，冒险家。您想购买任何轴吗？ [hei ， mao xian jia 。 nin xiang gou mai ren he zhou ma ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm Perry, and I sell axes here. Or sometimes I buy them, if someone's offering a good deal. Anyway, do you want to trade?
translation: 我是佩里，我在这里卖斧头。或者有时候，如果有人提供优惠价格，我就会购买它们。无论如何，你想交易吗？ [wo shi pei li ， wo zai zhe li mai fu tou 。 huo zhe you shi hou ， ru guo you ren ti gong you hui jia ge ， wo jiu hui gou mai ta men 。 wu lun ru he ， ni xiang jiao yi ma ？]

english: Okay, let's trade.
translation: 好吧，我们来交易吧。 [hao ba ， wo men lai jiao yi ba 。]

english: No, I'm fine.
translation: 不，我很好。 [bu ， wo hen hao 。]

translation: 好吧，我们来交易吧。 [hao ba ， wo men lai jiao yi ba 。]

english: No, I'm fine.
translation: 不，我很好。 [bu ， wo hen hao 。]

english: A cutscene shows the player being caught
translation: 过场动画显示玩家被抓住 [guo chang dong hua xian shi wan jia bei zhua zhu]

english: And we'll move this little penguin here...and KABLOOM! Heee hee.
translation: 我们将把这只小企鹅移到这里......还有 KABLOOM！嘻嘻。 [wo men jiang ba zhe zhi xiao qi e yi dao zhe li ...... hai you  KABLOOM！ xi xi 。]

english: It appears we have a visitor!
translation: 看来我们有客人了！ [kan lai wo men you ke ren le ！]

english: Haa haa! I am glad we installed that ant-magic security. What have we here?
translation: 哈哈哈！我很高兴我们安装了蚂蚁魔法安全装置。我们这里有什么？ [ha ha ha ！ wo hen gao xing wo men an zhuang le ma yi mo fa an quan zhuang zhi 。 wo men zhe li you shen me ？]

english: What an ingenious little device. This will solve all our problems. Scientists! Come examine this; we have much work to do.
translation: 多么巧妙的小装置啊。这将解决我们所有的问题。科学家们！来检查一下这个；我们还有很多工作要做。 [duo me qiao miao de xiao zhuang zhi a 。 zhe jiang jie jue wo men suo you de wen ti 。 ke xue jia men ！ lai jian cha yi xia zhe ge ； wo men hai you hen duo gong zuo yao zuo 。]

english: What about me?
translation: 关于我的什么？ [guan yu wo de shen me ？]

english: Hmm, take that human to the Ice Lords. They'll enjoy the exercise.
translation: 嗯，带那个人类去冰雪领主那里。他们会喜欢这个练习。 [n ， dai na ge ren lei qu bing xue ling zhu na li 。 ta men hui xi huan zhe ge lian xi 。]

english: You are caught.
translation: 你被抓住了。 [ni bei zhua zhu le 。]

english: End of cutscene
translation: 过场动画结束 [guo chang dong hua jie shu]

english: Got any sigils for me?
translation: 有什么印记给我吗？ [you shen me yin ji gei wo ma ？]

translation: 核心摇摇头。 [he xin yao yao tou 。]

translation: 该死的核心！ [gai si de he xin ！]

english: Let's bounce!
translation: 让我们弹跳吧！ [rang wo men dan tiao ba ！]

english: *slap*
translation: *拍击* [* pai ji *]

english: Grrr!
translation: 咕噜！ [gu lu ！]

english: Grrrr!
translation: 咕噜！ [gu lu ！]

english: Grarrr!
translation: 嘎嘎！ [ga ga ！]

english: I'm hungry!
translation: 我饿了！ [wo e le ！]

english: How hungry?
translation: 有多饿？ [you duo e ？]

english: I'm empty to the core!
translation: 我心里空空的！ [wo xin li kong kong de ！]

english: Would an apple do?
translation: 一个苹果可以吗？ [yi ge ping guo ke yi ma ？]

english: What is apple?
translation: 什么是苹果？ [shen me shi ping guo ？]

english: Something where you eat the outside and throw the core away!
translation: 吃外面的东西，扔掉核心的东西！ [chi wai mian de dong xi ， reng diao he xin de dong xi ！]

english: Blargle!
translation: 胡言乱语！ [hu yan luan yu ！]

english: Flarg!
translation: 弗拉格！ [fu la ge ！]

english: Rawrrr!
translation: 呸呸呸！ [pei pei pei ！]

english: Who's a good rock then? Yes you are... You're such a good rock... ooga booga googa.
translation: 那么谁是好摇滚呢？是的，你是……你真是一块好摇滚……ooga booga googa。 [na me shui shi hao yao gun ne ？ shi de ， ni shi …… ni zhen shi yi kuai hao yao gun ……ooga booga googa。]

english: Your rock seems a little happier.
translation: 你的石头似乎更快乐了一点。 [ni de shi tou si hu geng kuai le le yi dian 。]

english: Your pet rock ignores you. You are an exile of the Fremennik Province.
translation: 你的宠物石头不理你。你是弗雷曼尼克省的流亡者。 [ni de chong wu shi tou bu li ni 。 ni shi fu lei man ni ke sheng de liu wang zhe 。]

english: Not you too!
translation: 你也不是！ [ni ye bu shi ！]

english: Your pet rock continues to ignore you.
translation: 你的宠物石头继续无视你。 [ni de chong wu shi tou ji xu wu shi ni 。]

english: Aw...
Hey little snake!
translation: 嘿小蛇！ [hei xiao she ！]

english: Soon, Zulrah shall establish dominion over this plane.
translation: 很快，祖拉将在这个位面建立统治权。 [hen kuai ， zu la jiang zai zhe ge wei mian jian li tong zhi quan 。]

english: Wanna play fetch?
translation: 想玩捡东西吗？ [xiang wan jian dong xi ma ？]

english: Submit to the almighty Zulrah.
translation: 服从全能的祖拉。 [fu cong quan neng de zu la 。]

english: Walkies? Or slidies...?
translation: 对讲机？还是幻灯片...？ [dui jiang ji ？ hai shi huan deng pian ...？]

english: Zulrah's wilderness as a God will soon be demonstrated.
translation: 祖拉作为神的荒野很快就会被展现出来。 [zu la zuo wei shen de huang ye hen kuai jiu hui bei zhan xian chu lai 。]

english: I give up...
translation: 我放弃... [wo fang qi ...]

english: *slither*
translation: *滑行* [* hua xing *]

english: Hisssss!
translation: 嘶嘶！ [si si ！]

english: Specs!
translation: 规格！ [gui ge ！]

english: Sssssssss!
translation: 嘶嘶嘶！ [si si si ！]

english: What can I do around here?
translation: 我在这附近可以做什么？ [wo zai zhe fu jin ke yi zuo shen me ？]

english: There's a list pinned up on the camp notice board, near the toilet. Have a look there for useful things you could do. I've got some rewards if you do them all!
translation: 营地厕所附近的布告栏上贴着一张清单。看看那里有什么你可以做的有用的事情。如果你全部完成的话我会得到一些奖励！ [ying di ce suo fu jin de bu gao lan shang tie zhe yi zhang qing dan 。 kan kan na li you shen me ni ke yi zuo de you yong de shi qing 。 ru guo ni quan bu wan cheng de hua wo hui de dao yi xie jiang li ！]

english: I see. Thank you.
translation: 我懂了。谢谢。 [wo dong le 。 xie xie 。]

english: I see you've finished building the camp for us.
translation: 我看到你已经为我们搭建好了营地。 [wo kan dao ni yi jing wei wo men da jian hao le ying di 。]

english: All in a day's work!
translation: 都是一天的工作！ [dou shi yi tian de gong zuo ！]

english: Thank you so much for your help! Here, take these fossils. I found them while panning! They're everywhere on this island... A quick clean up by the benches you built should help identify them.
translation: 非常感谢您的帮助！来，拿走这些化石。我在平移时发现了它们！它们在这个岛上随处可见……快速清理你建造的长凳应该有助于识别它们。 [fei chang gan xie nin de bang zhu ！ lai ， na zou zhe xie hua shi 。 wo zai ping yi shi fa xian le ta men ！ ta men zai zhe ge dao shang sui chu ke jian …… kuai su qing li ni jian zao de zhang deng ying gai you zhu yu shi bie ta men 。]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: Can I talk to you for a moment about the fossils I find on this island?
translation: 我可以和你谈谈我在这个岛上发现的化石吗？ [wo ke yi he ni tan tan wo zai zhe ge dao shang fa xian de hua shi ma ？]

english: Sure, would you like to talk about? Normal or rare fossils?
translation: 当然，您想谈谈吗？普通化石还是稀有化石？ [dang ran ， nin xiang tan tan ma ？ pu tong hua shi hai shi xi you hua shi ？]

english: Let's talk about rare fossils, if that's okay.
translation: 如果可以的话，我们来谈谈稀有化石吧。 [ru guo ke yi de hua ， wo men lai tan tan xi you hua shi ba 。]

english: Oh definitely! Did you find a new type of fossil?!
translation: 哦，绝对！发现新化石了吗？！ [o ， jue dui ！ fa xian xin hua shi le ma ？！]

english: Not quite... I'd like you to stop rare fossils showing up on the island.
translation: 不完全是……我希望你阻止稀有化石出现在岛上。 [bu wan quan shi …… wo xi wang ni zu zhi xi you hua shi chu xian zai dao shang 。]

english: Oh..., I can do that for you, if you really want me to.
translation: 哦...，如果你真的想要的话，我可以为你做。 [o ...， ru guo ni zhen de xiang yao de hua ， wo ke yi wei ni zuo 。]

english: Yes I'm sure.
translation: 是的，我确定。 [shi de ， wo que ding 。]

english: So be it, I'll spread the word, rare fossils won't drop for you anymore. Come back to me if you change your mind.
translation: 就这样吧，我会告诉大家，稀有化石不会再掉落给你了。如果你改变主意就回来找我吧。 [jiu zhe yang ba ， wo hui gao su da jia ， xi you hua shi bu hui zai diao luo gei ni le 。 ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi jiu hui lai zhao wo ba 。]

english: Actually, I've changed my mind, I'll keep collecting them.
translation: 事实上，我改变了主意，我会继续收集它们。 [shi shi shang ， wo gai bian le zhu yi ， wo hui ji xu shou ji ta men 。]

english: Oh wonderful! Rare fossils are so hard to find, I'd hate for you to miss out on one.
translation: 哦，太棒了！稀有化石很难找到，我不想让你错过一块。 [o ， tai bang le ！ xi you hua shi hen nan zhao dao ， wo bu xiang rang ni cuo guo yi kuai 。]

english: So you've changed your mind then? I knew you would, who can resists the hidden knowledge found in rare fossils?
translation: 那么你改变主意了吗？我就知道你会的，谁能抗拒在稀有化石中发现的隐藏知识呢？ [na me ni gai bian zhu yi le ma ？ wo jiu zhi dao ni hui de ， shui neng kang ju zai xi you hua shi zhong fa xian de yin cang zhi shi ne ？]

english: Yes I know, can you just do it for me.
translation: 是的，我知道，你能帮我做一下吗？ [shi de ， wo zhi dao ， ni neng bang wo zuo yi xia ma ？]

english: If that's what you really want.
translation: 如果那是你真正想要的。 [ru guo na shi ni zhen zheng xiang yao de 。]

english: Of course you are! I'll get the word out and you'll start to see rare fossils drop again.
translation: 当然是！我会把消息传出去，你就会开始看到稀有化石再次掉落。 [dang ran shi ！ wo hui ba xiao xi chuan chu qu ， ni jiu hui kai shi kan dao xi you hua shi zai ci diao luo 。]

english: Eh, nevermind.
translation: 呃，没关系。 [e ， mei guan xi 。]

english: Fine, just let me know if you actually change your mind.
translation: 好吧，如果你真的改变主意了，请告诉我。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni zhen de gai bian zhu yi le ， qing gao su wo 。]

english: Let's talk about normal fossils, if that's okay.
translation: 如果可以的话，我们来谈谈普通的化石吧。 [ru guo ke yi de hua ， wo men lai tan tan pu tong de hua shi ba 。]

english: Of course, I'm always up for an exciting discussion about fossils.
translation: 当然，我总是热衷于进行有关化石的激动人心的讨论。 [dang ran ， wo zong shi re zhong yu jin xing you guan hua shi de ji dong ren xin de tao lun 。]

english: Is it possible that you could stop normal fossils being given to me on the island.
translation: 你能不能阻止在岛上给我正常的化石？ [ni neng bu neng zu zhi zai dao shang gei wo zheng chang de hua shi ？]

english: ... Why would you want that?
translation: ...你为什么想要那个？ [... ni wei shen me xiang yao na ge ？]

english: I've found every fossil I want and well, I'm just not interested in them anymore.
translation: 我已经找到了我想要的所有化石，但我只是对它们不再感兴趣了。 [wo yi jing zhao dao le wo xiang yao de suo you hua shi ， dan wo zhi shi dui ta men bu zai gan xing qu le 。]

english: Oh... I guess can see what I can do, Only if you're sure of course.
translation: 哦...我想我可以看看我能做什么，当然前提是你确定。 [o ... wo xiang wo ke yi kan kan wo neng zuo shen me ， dang ran qian ti shi ni que ding 。]

english: Fine... I'll spread the word, you won't see fossils dropped on the island anymore... Come back to me if you change your mind.
translation: 好吧...我会告诉大家的，你不会再看到岛上掉落的化石了...如果你改变主意就回来找我。 [hao ba ... wo hui gao su da jia de ， ni bu hui zai kan dao dao shang diao luo de hua shi le ... ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi jiu hui lai zhao wo 。]

english: Really?! That's fantastic! Fossils are so much fun, you'd be missing out!
translation: 真的吗？！太棒了！化石是如此有趣，你会错过的！ [zhen de ma ？！ tai bang le ！ hua shi shi ru ci you qu ， ni hui cuo guo de ！]

english: Oh yes... I remember, you asked me to stop fossils dropping for you on the island.
translation: 哦，是的……我记得，你让我阻止在岛上为你掉落化石。 [o ， shi de …… wo ji de ， ni rang wo zu zhi zai dao shang wei ni diao luo hua shi 。]

english: Yes, well, I need you to let them drop again.
translation: 是的，好吧，我需要你再次让他们放下。 [shi de ， hao ba ， wo xu yao ni zai ci rang ta men fang xia 。]

english: Really? Are you sure?
translation: 真的吗？你确定吗？ [zhen de ma ？ ni que ding ma ？]

english: Of course you are! I'll get the word out and you'll start to see fossils drop again.
translation: 当然是！我会把消息传出去，你就会开始看到化石再次掉落。 [dang ran shi ！ wo hui ba xiao xi chuan chu qu ， ni jiu hui kai shi kan dao hua shi zai ci diao luo 。]

english: Okay... let me know if you actually change your mind.
translation: 好吧...如果你真的改变主意了，请告诉我。 [hao ba ... ru guo ni zhen de gai bian zhu yi le ， qing gao su wo 。]

english: That has been done, rare fossils won't drop for you anymore. Come back to me if you change your mind.
translation: 已经完成了，稀有化石不会再掉落给你了。如果你改变主意就回来找我吧。 [yi jing wan cheng le ， xi you hua shi bu hui zai diao luo gei ni le 。 ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi jiu hui lai zhao wo ba 。]

english: Excellent, you'll start to see rare fossils showing up on the island again.
translation: 太棒了，您将开始看到稀有化石再次出现在岛上。 [tai bang le ， nin jiang kai shi kan dao xi you hua shi zai ci chu xian zai dao shang 。]

english: Fine, regular fossils won't drop for you anymore. Come back to me if you change your mind
translation: 好吧，普通化石不会再为你掉落了。如果你改变主意就回来找我 [hao ba ， pu tong hua shi bu hui zai wei ni diao la le 。 ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi jiu hui lai zhao wo]

english: Great! You'll start to see fossils showing up on the island again.
translation: 伟大的！您将开始再次看到岛上出现化石。 [wei da de ！ nin jiang kai shi zai ci kan dao dao shang chu xian hua shi 。]

english: Talk about the island camp.
translation: 说说海岛营地。 [shuo shuo hai dao ying di 。]

english: Talk about fossils.
translation: 谈论化石。 [tan lun hua shi 。]

english: Let's talk about rare ones.
translation: 我们来谈谈稀有的。 [wo men lai tan tan xi you de 。]

english: Yes I'm sure.
translation: 是的，我确定。 [shi de ， wo que ding 。]

english: Actually, I've changed my mind.
translation: 事实上，我已经改变主意了。 [shi shi shang ， wo yi jing gai bian zhu yi le 。]

english: Nevermind
translation: 没关系 [mei guan xi]

english: Let's talk about normal ones.
translation: 我们来谈谈正常的吧。 [wo men lai tan tan zheng chang de ba 。]

english: Rare.
translation: 稀有的。 [xi you de 。]

english: Normal.
translation: 普通的。 [pu tong de 。]

english: Oh thank goodness you released me...how long have I been stuck in that gloomy wall?
translation: 噢，谢天谢地你释放了我……我被困在那阴暗的墙壁里多久了？ [o ， xie tian xie di ni shi fang le wo …… wo bei kun zai na yin an de qiang bi li duo jiu le ？]

english: Oh, not so long...I don't think...
translation: 哦，没那么久……我不认为…… [o ， mei na me jiu …… wo bu ren wei ……]

english: I mean...that is... I'm not so sure...at all...in fact.
translation: 我的意思是……那是……我不太确定……一点也不……事实上。 [wo de yi si shi …… na shi …… wo bu tai que ding …… yi dian ye bu …… shi shi shang 。]

english: Well, at least I'm ok...thanks to you! Last time I get involved with that Cromperty lunatic...in fact I have some words to say to that man!
translation: 好吧，至少我没事……谢谢你！上次我和克朗珀蒂那个疯子扯上关系……其实我有话要对那个人说！ [hao ba ， zhi shao wo mei shi …… xie xie ni ！ shang ci wo he ke lang po di na ge feng zi che shang guan xi …… qi shi wo you hua yao dui na ge ren shuo ！]

english: Well actually, I think that some of the people at the Seers Village are worried about you. That's how I came to find you here, Phantuwti sent me.
translation: 嗯，事实上，我认为先知村的一些人很担心你。这就是我来这里找你的原因，潘图瓦蒂派我来的。 [n ， shi shi shang ， wo ren wei xian zhi cun de yi xie ren hen dan xin ni 。 zhe jiu shi wo lai zhe li zhao ni de yuan yin ， pan tu wa di pai wo lai de 。]

english: Oh, right, yes, well I guess I'd better go back there and let them all know that I'm safe then..Ok, thanks...I'll be off now and once again thanks for your help.
translation: 哦，对，是的，好吧，我想我最好回到那里，让他们都知道我很安全……好吧，谢谢……我现在就走了，再次感谢您的帮助。 [o ， dui ， shi de ， hao ba ， wo xiang wo zui hao hui dao na li ， rang ta men dou zhi dao wo hen an quan …… hao ba ， xie xie …… wo xian zai jiu zou le ， zai ci gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]

english: No problem...I'll probably see you back at the Seers Village.
translation: 没问题……我可能会在先知村见到你。 [mei wen ti …… wo ke neng hui zai xian zhi cun jian dao ni 。]

english: Hi there Pete.
translation: 你好，皮特。 [ni hao ， pi te 。]

english: Argh! Who be there?
translation: 啊！谁在那里？ [a ！ shui zai na li ？]

english: Oh, it's just the adventurer, phew! Things can be scary around here, I've seen some weeeeeiiiird stuff in that cavern.
translation: 哦，原来是冒险家啊，唷！这里的事情可能很可怕，我在那个洞穴里看到了一些非常奇怪的东西。 [o ， yuan lai shi mao xian jia a ， yo ！ zhe li de shi qing ke neng hen ke pa ， wo zai na ge dong xue li kan dao le yi xie fei chang qi guai de dong xi 。]

english: What is in the cavern?
translation: 山洞里有什么？ [shan dong li you shen me ？]

english: Oh no, now I'm thinking about it again!*screams*
translation: 哦不，现在我又开始想了！*尖叫* [o bu ， xian zai wo you kai shi xiang le ！* jian jiao *]

english: Okay okay, calm down! Why are you guarding it? What is the purpose of this cavern?
translation: 好吧好吧，冷静点！你为什么要守护它？这个洞穴的目的是什么？ [hao ba hao ba ， leng jing dian ！ ni wei shen me yao shou hu ta ？ zhe ge dong xue de mu di shi shen me ？]

english: It's a mine. It's special but dangerous, things move around and the mine could collapse at any moment!.
translation: 这是一个矿井。它很特别，但也很危险，东西会移动，矿井随时可能塌陷！ [zhe shi yi ge kuang jing 。 ta hen te bie ， dan ye hen wei xian ， dong xi hui yi dong ， kuang jing sui shi ke neng ta xian ！]

english: I'd say you'll need at least level 50 Mining to be capable.
translation: 我想说你至少需要 50 级采矿才能有能力。 [wo xiang shuo ni zhi shao xu yao  50  ji cai kuang cai neng you neng li 。]

english: I'm not quite up to scratch then...
translation: 那我还不太适应... [na wo hai bu tai shi ying ...]

english: Well sounds like I am capable then!
translation: 看来我有能力了！ [kan lai wo you neng li le ！]

english: The main idea is to chip down the big boulders, in order to find the fragments inside. Deliver them to me and I'll show you some minin' tips to help you get better at it.
translation: 主要想法是砍掉大石头，以便找到里面的碎片。把它们交给我，我会告诉你一些小技巧来帮助你做得更好。 [zhu yao xiang fa shi kan diao da shi tou ， yi bian zhao dao li mian de sui pian 。 ba ta men jiao gei wo ， wo hui gao su ni yi xie xiao ji qiao lai bang zhu ni zuo de geng hao 。]

english: How do I traverse the mine? Isn't it full of lava?
translation: 如何穿越矿井？不是充满了熔岩吗？ [ru he chuan yue kuang jing ？ bu shi chong man le rong yan ma ？]

english: I have a handy supply of heat-proof water containers. I'll give them out to anyone going in with bit of water inside. They only hold so much though.
translation: 我有方便的耐热水容器。我会把它们分发给任何进去的人，里面有一点水。但他们只持有这么多。 [wo you fang bian de nai re shui rong qi 。 wo hui ba ta men fen fa gei ren he jin qu de ren ， li mian you yi dian shui 。 dan ta men zhi chi you zhe me duo 。]

english: I reckon you could harden the lava with it! Just throw a bit of water on it. Make yourself a path, but be careful, they won't last forever.
translation: 我想你可以用它来硬化熔岩！只要在上面洒一点水就可以了。为自己开辟一条道路，但要小心，它们不会永远持续下去。 [wo xiang ni ke yi yong ta lai ying hua rong yan ！ zhi yao zai shang mian sa yi dian shui jiu ke yi le 。 wei zi ji kai pi yi tiao dao lu ， dan yao xiao xin ， ta men bu hui yong yuan chi xu xia qu 。]

english: Anything else?
translation: 还要别的吗？ [hai yao bie de ma ？]

english: Uh oh, there is one more thing, but it hurts. My backside has never felt the same since, one of the reasons I don't dare go in there anymore. There are some gas holes around, just feel 'em.
translation: 呃哦，还有一件事，但是很痛。从那时起，我的背部就再也没有过同样的感觉，这也是我不敢再进去的原因之一。周围有一些气孔，摸一下就知道了。 [e o ， hai you yi jian shi ， dan shi hen tong 。 cong na shi qi ， wo de bei bu jiu zai ye mei you guo tong yang de gan jue ， zhe ye shi wo bu gan zai jin qu de yuan yin zhi yi 。 zhou wei you yi xie qi kong ， mo yi xia jiu zhi dao le 。]

english: How do I keep the mine stable?
translation: 如何保持矿井稳定？ [ru he bao chi kuang jing wen ding ？]

english: Don't let it collapse!! It's petrifying, it will stick with you forever. The rumbles create a flashback in my mind, arghhh.
translation: 别让它崩溃！！它是石化的，它会永远伴随着你。隆隆声在我脑海中闪现，啊啊。 [bie rang ta beng kui ！！ ta shi shi hua de ， ta hui yong yuan ban sui zhe ni 。 long long sheng zai wo nao hai zhong shan xian ， a a 。]

english: There are some vents and chambers in there. Do better than I did with them, you want around a 50% gas level in each chamber.
translation: 里面有一些通风口和腔室。比我对它们做的更好，你希望每个室中的气体水平约为 50%。 [li mian you yi xie tong feng kou he qiang shi 。 bi wo dui ta men zuo de geng hao ， ni xi wang mei ge shi zhong de qi ti shui ping yue wei  50%。]

english: There are 3 in total, we spent awhile coming up with names, such as 'Vent west of the pillar near the entrance on the left hand side', but decided A, B and C would be easier.
translation: 总共有 3 个，我们花了一些时间想出名称，例如“左侧入口附近柱子西侧的通风口”，但认为 A、B 和 C 会更容易。 [zong gong you  3  ge ， wo men hua le yi xie shi jian xiang chu ming cheng ， li ru “ zuo ce ru kou fu jin zhu zi xi ce de tong feng kou ”， dan ren wei  A、B  he  C  hui geng rong yi 。]

english: Presumably, a western chamber, central chamber and eastern chamber?
translation: 大概是西厢、中厢、东厢吧？ [da gai shi xi xiang 、 zhong xiang 、 dong xiang ba ？]

english: Yep! That's right. Block the chamber to let gas build up, unblock 'em to let gas out. Any creatures in there will cause instability too.
translation: 是的！这是正确的。堵塞腔室让气体积聚，解锁腔室让气体排出。那里的任何生物也会造成不稳定。 [shi de ！ zhe shi zheng que de 。 du se qiang shi rang qi ti ji ju ， jie suo qiang shi rang qi ti pai chu 。 na li de ren he sheng wu ye hui zao cheng bu wen ding 。]

english: Oh, also, if you have more than one rock to mine, keep them going at roughly the same pace too. Everything gets a bit wobbly if you proceed too quickly down one channel.
translation: 哦，还有，如果你有不止一颗岩石要开采，也让它们以大致相同的速度开采。如果你在一个通道上走得太快，一切都会变得有点不稳定。 [o ， hai you ， ru guo ni you bu zhi yi ke yan shi yao kai cai ， ye rang ta men yi da zhi xiang tong de su du kai cai 。 ru guo ni zai yi ge tong dao shang zou de tai kuai ， yi qie du hui bian de you dian bu wen ding 。]

english: Explain the dangers for me.
translation: 为我解释一下危险。 [wei wo jie shi yi xia wei xian 。]

english: It is bad, very bad in there. If you're not prepared, you will be done for. Wouldn't catch me in there.
translation: 那里很糟糕，非常糟糕。如果你没有做好准备，你就完蛋了。不会在那里抓住我的。 [na li hen zao gao ， fei chang zao gao 。 ru guo ni mei you zuo hao zhun bei ， ni jiu wan dan le 。 bu hui zai na li zhua zhu wo de 。]

english: Okay, so how do I prepare?
translation: 好吧，那么我该如何准备呢？ [hao ba ， na me wo gai ru he zhun bei ne ？]

english: Look out for the Lava beasts, they'll throw projectiles at anyone they see. You'll have stalacmitesfalling on you, fire jumping out the lava towards you. Seriously, you're insane.
translation: 小心熔岩野兽，它们会向看到的任何人投掷射弹。石乳石会落在你身上，火会从熔岩中跳向你。说真的，你疯了。 [xiao xin rong yan ye shou ， ta men hui xiang kan dao de ren he ren tou zhi she dan 。 shi ru shi hui luo zai ni shen shang ， huo hui cong rong yan zhong tiao xiang ni 。 shuo zhen de ， ni feng le 。]

english: Thanks, I'll keep that in mind.
translation: 谢谢，我会记住这一点。 [xie xie ， wo hui ji zhu zhe yi dian 。]

english: Can I go inside?
translation: 我可以进去吗？ [wo ke yi jin qu ma ？]

english: There are some crazy things down there, I don't think you're capable.
translation: 那里有一些疯狂的事情，我认为你没有能力。 [na li you yi xie feng kuang de shi qing ， wo ren wei ni mei you neng li 。]

english: You need at least 50 Mining to enter the Volcanic Mine.
translation: 您至少需要 50 采矿才能进入火山矿井。 [nin zhi shao xu yao  50  cai kuang cai neng jin ru huo shan kuang jing 。]

english: Well luckily for you, or rather, unlucky for you, I'll let you go inside as you've definitely got the mining skills.
translation: 好吧，对你来说幸运，或者更确切地说，对你来说不幸，我会让你进去，因为你肯定有采矿技能。 [hao ba ， dui ni lai shuo xing yun ， huo zhe geng que qie di shuo ， dui ni lai shuo bu xing ， wo hui rang ni jin qu ， yin wei ni ken ding you cai kuang ji neng 。]

english: I'll have to charge you though - upkeep of this place ain't cheap and cheerful. I'll need 30 Numulites for one visit or 3,000 for unlimited trips.
translation: 不过我得向你收费——这个地方的维护费既不便宜又不愉快。我需要 30 个 Numulites 进行一次访问，或者 3,000 个 Numulites 进行无限次旅行。 [bu guo wo de xiang ni shou fei —— zhe ge di fang de wei hu fei ji bu bian yi you bu yu kuai 。 wo xu yao  30  ge  Numulites  jin xing yi ci fang wen ， huo zhe  3,000  ge  Numulites  jin xing wu xian ci lv xing 。]

english: I don't have 30 Numulites with me unfortunately.
translation: 不幸的是，我身边没有 30 个 Numulites。 [bu xing de shi ， wo shen bian mei you  30  ge  Numulites。]

english: Thanks [player name]. That will grant you access to the mine. You're a crazy one.
translation: 谢谢[玩家姓名]。这将使您能够进入矿井。你是个疯子。 [xie xie [ wan jia xing ming ]。 zhe jiang shi nin neng gou jin ru kuang jing 。 ni shi ge feng zi 。]

english: You can now enter the Volcanic Mine. Should you leave, Pete would expect payment again.
translation: 您现在可以进入火山矿井。如果您离开，皮特会要求再次付款。 [nin xian zai ke yi jin ru huo shan kuang jing 。 ru guo nin li kai ， pi te hui yao qiu zai ci fu kuan 。]

english: Thanks [player name]. That will grant you permanent access to the mine. You're a crazy one.
translation: 谢谢[玩家姓名]。这将使您永久进入矿井。你是个疯子。 [xie xie [ wan jia xing ming ]。 zhe jiang shi nin yong jiu jin ru kuang jing 。 ni shi ge feng zi 。]

english: You can now enter the Volcanic Mine. Pete will not ask you for payment again.
translation: 您现在可以进入火山矿井。皮特不会再要求您付款。 [nin xian zai ke yi jin ru huo shan kuang jing 。 pi te bu hui zai yao qiu nin fu kuan 。]

english: You've already paid the entrance fee too, so you can head right on in.
translation: 你也已经付了入场费，所以你可以直接进去。 [ni ye yi jing fu le ru chang fei ， suo yi ni ke yi zhi jie jin qu 。]

english: I've got some of your stuff that you left here earlier. You'd better deal with it before trying to go into the cavern again.
translation: 我有一些你之前留在这儿的东西。你最好先解决掉它，然后再尝试进入洞穴。 [wo you yi xie ni zhi qian liu zai zhe er de dong xi 。 ni zui hao xian jie jue diao ta ， ran hou zai chang shi jin ru dong xue 。]

english: Have you anything to trade?
translation: 你有什么东西可以交易吗？ [ni you shen me dong xi ke yi jiao yi ma ？]

english: Have you picked up anything I left in the mine?
translation: 你捡到我留在矿井里的东西了吗？ [ni jian dao wo liu zai kuang jing li de dong xi le ma ？]

english: Sorry, I've got nothing for you. I'm not sure what you'd have been doing in there anyway, since I wouldn't expect to let you in.
translation: 抱歉，我没有什么可以给你的。无论如何，我不确定你会在那里做什么，因为我不想让你进去。 [bao qian ， wo mei you shen me ke yi gei ni de 。 wu lun ru he ， wo bu que ding ni hui zai na li zuo shen me ， yin wei wo bu xiang rang ni jin qu 。]

english: Sorry, I've got nothing for you. If I had some of your stuff earlier, but you died before collecting it, it'd be lost.
translation: 抱歉，我没有什么可以给你的。如果我早些时候拥有你的一些东西，但你在收集之前就死了，那么它就会丢失。 [bao qian ， wo mei you shen me ke yi gei ni de 。 ru guo wo zao xie shi hou yong you ni de yi xie dong xi ， dan ni zai shou ji zhi qian jiu si le ， na me ta jiu hui diu shi 。]

english: I'll leave you be.
translation: 我就不打扰你了。 [wo jiu bu da rao ni le 。]

english: There are some crazy things down there, I don't think you're capable so I'll let you keep your Numulites.
translation: 下面有一些疯狂的事情，我认为你没有能力，所以我会让你保留你的 Numulites。 [xia mian you yi xie feng kuang de shi qing ， wo ren wei ni mei you neng li ， suo yi wo hui rang ni bao liu ni de  Numulites。]

english: It doesn't look like you have 30 Numulites with you unfortunately.
translation: 不幸的是，你身边似乎没有 30 个 Numulites。 [bu xing de shi ， ni shen bian si hu mei you  30  ge  Numulites。]

english: You've already paid up! You can head right on in. Better you than me...
translation: 你已经付款了！你可以直接进去。你比我更好...... [ni yi jing fu kuan le ！ ni ke yi zhi jie jin qu 。 ni bi wo geng hao ......]

english: Sorry, I'll need paying before I can return your stuff.
translation: 抱歉，我需要先付款才能归还您的东西。 [bao qian ， wo xu yao xian fu kuan cai neng gui huan nin de dong xi 。]

english: Sorry [player name], you won't last a minute in there. You got to prove yourself as a capable archeologist, and be good at the minin'.
translation: 抱歉[玩家姓名]，你在里面一分钟都坚持不了。你必须证明自己是一名有能力的考古学家，并且擅长采矿。 [bao qian [ wan jia xing ming ]， ni zai li mian yi fen zhong dou jian chi bu liao 。 ni bi xu zheng ming zi ji shi yi ming you neng li de kao gu xue jia ， bing qie shan chang cai kuang 。]

english: Sorry [player name] I can't let people head in mid way through a mine out session. It's not safe and will cause mine collapse!
translation: 抱歉[玩家姓名]我不能让人们在矿区中途介入。不安全，会造成矿井塌陷！ [bao qian [ wan jia xing ming ] wo bu neng rang ren men zai kuang qu zhong tu jie ru 。 bu an quan ， hui zao cheng kuang jing ta xian ！]

english: Pete quickly hands you a heat-proof vessel filled with some water.
translation: 皮特很快递给你一个装满水的耐热容器。 [pi te hen kuai di gei ni yi ge zhuang man shui de nai re rong qi 。]

english: The mine is currently dormant, and will awaken within the next 30 seconds.
translation: 该矿井目前处于休眠状态，将在接下来的 30 秒内苏醒。 [gai kuang jing mu qian chu yu xiu mian zhuang tai ， jiang zai jie xia lai de  30  miao nei su xing 。]

english: Sorry [player name], I cannot allow someone to go in there without paying first. Come see me.
translation: 抱歉[玩家姓名]，我不能允许任何人在没有先付款的情况下进入那里。来见我吧。 [bao qian [ wan jia xing ming ]， wo bu neng yun xu ren he ren zai mei you xian fu kuan de qing kuang xia jin ru na li 。 lai jian wo ba 。]

english: You should probably pick up the stuff you left in there earlier before you return. Come and see me.
translation: 你应该在回来之前把之前留在里面的东西捡起来。来见我吧。 [ni ying gai zai hui lai zhi qian ba zhi qian liu zai li mian de dong xi jian qi lai 。 lai jian wo ba 。]

english: Well why am I going to reward you for that?! Might wanna contribute next time. I am not standin' out here for nothin'.
translation: 那么我为什么要奖励你呢？下次可能想贡献一下。我站在这里并不是无缘无故的。 [na me wo wei shen me yao jiang li ni ne ？ xia ci ke neng xiang gong xian yi xia 。 wo zhan zai zhe li bing bu shi wu yuan wu gu de 。]

english: I'll give you a bit of minin' trainin' and I'll remember the contribution you've made.
translation: 我会给你一些小小的训练，我会记住你所做的贡献。 [wo hui gei ni yi xie xiao xiao de xun lian ， wo hui ji zhu ni suo zuo de gong xian 。]

english: I'll quickly take those fragments off your hands [player name], thank you! I'll give you a bit of minin' trainin' and I'll remember the contribution you've made.
translation: 我会尽快把你手上的碎片拿走[玩家姓名]，谢谢！我会给你一些小小的训练，我会记住你所做的贡献。 [wo hui jin kuai ba ni shou shang de sui pian na zou [ wan jia xing ming ]， xie xie ！ wo hui gei ni yi xie xiao xiao de xun lian ， wo hui ji zhu ni suo zuo de gong xian 。]

english: [player name] has started up a mine! Join [him/her] down there now!
translation: [玩家姓名] 已启动矿井！现在就和[他/她]一起去那里吧！ [[ wan jia xing ming ]  yi qi dong kuang jing ！ xian zai jiu he [ ta / ta ] yi qi qu na li ba ！]

english: Hi Pete, I found this in one of my ore packs...
translation: 嗨，皮特，我在我的一个矿石包中发现了这个...... [hai ， pi te ， wo zai wo de yi ge kuang shi bao zhong fa xian le zhe ge ......]

english: Woah, what is that you've got there?!
translation: 哇哦，你那儿是什么？ [wa o ， ni na er shi shen me ？]

english: It's... a pickaxe, a broken one.
translation: 这是……一把镐，一把坏了的镐。 [zhe shi …… yi ba gao ， yi ba huai le de gao 。]

english: That's not just any broken pickaxe, it's a dragon one! They're really rare!
translation: 那不是普通的断镐，这是一把龙镐！他们真的很罕见！ [na bu shi pu tong de duan gao ， zhe shi yi ba long gao ！ ta men zhen de hen han jian ！]

english: I have no idea how that ended up in your ore pack, but you can keep it, it's broken anyway.
translation: 我不知道它是怎么出现在你的矿石包里的，但你可以保留它，反正它已经坏了。 [wo bu zhi dao ta shi zen me chu xian zai ni de kuang shi bao li de ， dan ni ke yi bao liu ta ， fan zheng ta yi jing huai le 。]

english: Maybe you can find someone to help you repair it! I've heard tales that some dwarves used to fix pickaxes.
translation: 也许你可以找人帮你修理！我听说过一些矮人用来修理镐的故事。 [ye xu ni ke yi zhao ren bang ni xiu li ！ wo ting shuo guo yi xie ai ren yong lai xiu li gao de gu shi 。]

english: One of them was called Nurmof. I think he used to reside in the Falador mines. If you're lucky, he could still be there.
translation: 其中一位名叫努尔莫夫。我想他曾经住在法拉多矿井里。如果你幸运的话，他可能还在那里。 [qi zhong yi wei ming jiao nu er mo fu 。 wo xiang ta ceng jing zhu zai fa la duo kuang jing li 。 ru guo ni xing yun de hua ， ta ke neng hai zai na li 。]

english: Nice one, [player name]! I'll give you twice as much water when you're starting a run.
translation: 不错，[玩家姓名]！当你开始跑步时，我会给你两倍的水。 [bu cuo ，[ wan jia xing ming ]！ dang ni kai shi pao bu shi ， wo hui gei ni liang bei de shui 。]

english: Sorry [player name], this a Deadman world. People are fighting all over the shop. No one gets in the mine here!
translation: 抱歉[玩家姓名]，这是一个亡灵世界。店里到处都是人在打架。这里的矿井没人敢进！ [bao qian [ wan jia xing ming ]， zhe shi yi ge wang ling shi jie 。 dian li dao chu dou shi ren zai da jia 。 zhe li de kuang jing mei ren gan jin ！]

english: What is in the cavern?
translation: 山洞里有什么？ [shan dong li you shen me ？]

english: How do I traverse the mine?
translation: 如何穿越矿井？ [ru he chuan yue kuang jing ？]

english: How do I keep the mine stable?
translation: 如何保持矿井稳定？ [ru he bao chi kuang jing wen ding ？]

english: Explain the dangers for me.
translation: 为我解释一下危险。 [wei wo jie shi yi xia wei xian 。]

english: Can I go inside?
translation: 我可以进去吗？ [wo ke yi jin qu ma ？]

english: I'll leave you be.
translation: 我就不打扰你了。 [wo jiu bu da rao ni le 。]

english: Pay 30 Numulites for one visit.
translation: 一次访问需支付 30 努穆里特。 [yi ci fang wen xu zhi fu  30  nu mu li te 。]

english: Pay 3,000 Numulites for permanent access.
translation: 支付 3,000 Numulites 即可获得永久访问权限。 [zhi fu  3,000 Numulites  ji ke huo de yong jiu fang wen quan xian 。]

english: Keep your Numulites.
translation: 保留你的 Numulites。 [bao liu ni de  Numulites。]

english: Have you anything to trade?
translation: 你有什么东西可以交易吗？ [ni you shen me dong xi ke yi jiao yi ma ？]

english: Have you picked up anything I left in the mine?
translation: 你捡到我留在矿井里的东西了吗？ [ni jian dao wo liu zai kuang jing li de dong xi le ma ？]

english: Pay the fee.
translation: 缴纳费用。 [jiao na fei yong 。]

english: Yes, pay 150 x Numulite.
translation: 是的，支付 150 x Numulite。 [shi de ， zhi fu  150 x Numulite。]

english: Yes, pay 150 x Numulite and don't ask me again..
translation: 是的，支付 150 x Numulite，不要再问我了.. [shi de ， zhi fu  150 x Numulite， bu yao zai wen wo le ..]

english: No, don't pay.
translation: 不，不要付钱。 [bu ， bu yao fu qian 。]

english: Wow, didn't expect to find a scientist out here.
translation: 哇，没想到在这里能找到科学家。 [wa ， mei xiang dao zai zhe li neng zhao dao ke xue jia 。]

english: I'm out here on a mission, do you think I chose to hang around these lowlifes?
translation: 我来这里是为了执行任务，你认为我会选择和这些下等人混在一起吗？ [wo lai zhe li shi wei le zhi xing ren wu ， ni ren wei wo hui xuan ze he zhe xie xia deng ren hun zai yi qi ma ？]

english: I'm not one to judge.
translation: 我不是一个可以评判的人。 [wo bu shi yi ge ke yi ping pan de ren 。]

english: What is this 'mission' you mentioned?
translation: 你提到的这个“使命”是什么？ [ni ti dao de zhe ge “ shi ming ” shi shen me ？]

english: I'm out here to conduct research, I've been told a giant spider lurks in the heart of the Wilderness.
translation: 我来这里是为了进行研究，有人告诉我一只巨大的蜘蛛潜伏在荒野的中心。 [wo lai zhe li shi wei le jin xing yan jiu ， you ren gao su wo yi zhi ju da de zhi zhu qian fu zai huang ye de zhong xin 。]

english: Her venom is priceless and it would aid me greatly in my research.
translation: 她的毒液是无价的，对我的研究有很大帮助。 [ta de du ye shi wu jia de ， dui wo de yan jiu you hen da bang zhu 。]

english: Research? What could you possibly want with a giant spider's venom?
translation: 研究？你想要巨型蜘蛛的毒液做什么？ [yan jiu ？ ni xiang yao ju xing zhi zhu de du ye zuo shen me ？]

english: Venenatis is the last of her kind. Lots of giant spiders used to dwell deep in the mountains until the savage dwarves killed them all.
translation: 维纳提斯是她同类中的最后一个。许多巨型蜘蛛曾经栖息在深山之中，直到野蛮的矮人将它们全部杀死。 [wei na ti si shi ta tong lei zhong de zui hou yi ge 。 xu duo ju xing zhi zhu ceng jing qi xi zai shen shan zhi zhong ， zhi dao ye man de ai ren jiang ta men quan bu sha si 。]

english: She is the last one left and I must have a sample of her venom.
translation: 她是最后剩下的一个了，我必须得到她的毒液样本。 [ta shi zui hou sheng xia de yi ge le ， wo bi xu de dao ta de du ye yang ben 。]

english: What I want with the specimen however, is none of your business!
translation: 不过，我想要的标本与你无关！ [bu guo ， wo xiang yao de biao ben yu ni wu guan ！]

english: Woah sorry, didn't mean to touch a nerve. Fighting a giant spider sounds like a great idea.
translation: 哇哦，抱歉，无意触动神经。与巨型蜘蛛战斗听起来是个好主意。 [wa o ， bao qian ， wu yi chu dong shen jing 。 yu ju xing zhi zhu zhan dou ting qi lai shi ge hao zhu yi 。]

english: I've tried to put it off for as long as I could, but this is the final component needed for my research.
translation: 我试图尽可能地推迟它，但这是我的研究所需的最后一个组成部分。 [wo shi tu jin ke neng di tui chi ta ， dan zhe shi wo de yan jiu suo xu de zui hou yi ge zu cheng bu fen 。]

english: Then what are you waiting around here for? Go out there and fight her.
translation: 那你还在这里等什么？出去和她战斗。 [na ni hai zai zhe li deng shen me ？ chu qu he ta zhan dou 。]

english: Are you sure you're equipped to take it down? I've had the displeasure of dealing with Venenatis, she will not go down easily.
translation: 你确定你有能力把它拿下来吗？我在与维内蒂斯打交道时感到不愉快，她不会轻易倒下。 [ni que ding ni you neng li ba ta na xia lai ma ？ wo zai yu wei nei di si da jiao dao shi gan dao bu yu kuai ， ta bu hui qing yi dao xia 。]

english: It will not be easy, but if I can get her when she's wounded in her lair, it should be a fairer fight.
translation: 这并不容易，但如果我能在她在巢穴中受伤时抓住她，那应该是一场更公平的战斗。 [zhe bing bu rong yi ， dan ru guo wo neng zai ta zai chao xue zhong shou shang shi zhua zhu ta ， na ying gai shi yi chang geng gong ping de zhan dou 。]

english: I didn't know she had a lair. I thought she just roamed the Wilderness.
translation: 我不知道她有一个巢穴。我以为她只是在荒野中漫步。 [wo bu zhi dao ta you yi ge chao xue 。 wo yi wei ta zhi shi zai huang ye zhong man bu 。]

english: She only returns there to lick her wounds and rest, I need to be patient.
translation: 她回来只是舔伤口休息，我需要耐心等待。 [ta hui lai zhi shi tian shang kou xiu xi ， wo xu yao nai xin deng dai 。]

english: So that explains why you're waiting here.
translation: 这就解释了为什么你在这里等待。 [zhe jiu jie shi le wei shen me ni zai zhe li deng dai 。]

english: I would go out and fight her now, but I must admit, I am also a little scared. I've never been in a fight before.
translation: 我现在会出去和她打架，但我必须承认，我也有点害怕。我以前从未打过架。 [wo xian zai hui chu qu he ta da jia ， dan wo bi xu cheng ren ， wo ye you dian hai pa 。 wo yi qian cong wei da guo jia 。]

english: I'm sure you'll be alright, it's just a gigantic spider!
translation: 我相信你会没事的，它只是一只巨大的蜘蛛！ [wo xiang xin ni hui mei shi de ， ta zhi shi yi zhi ju da de zhi zhu ！]

english: Thanks for your words of confidence...
translation: 谢谢你的信任之言... [xie xie ni de xin ren zhi yan ...]

english: Hey. Do you know anything about this?
translation: 嘿。你知道这件事吗？ [hei 。 ni zhi dao zhe jian shi ma ？]

english: Well, would you look at that. Most fascinating.
translation: 好吧，你能看一下吗？最令人着迷。 [hao ba ， ni neng kan yi xia ma ？ zui ling ren zhao mi 。]

english: Could you tell me what's so fascinating?
translation: 你能告诉我什么如此迷人吗？ [ni neng gao su wo shen me ru ci mi ren ma ？]

english: It's a rare Zamorakian artifact. I haven't seen any quite like this one before.
translation: 这是一件罕见的萨莫拉克文物。我以前从未见过像这样的。 [zhe shi yi jian han jian de sa mo la ke wen wu 。 wo yi qian cong wei jian guo xiang zhe yang de 。]

english: If you look closely, you can see that it has a socket where you can place an item to increase its power.
translation: 如果你仔细观察，你会发现它有一个插座，你可以在其中放置物品以增加其力量。 [ru guo ni zi xi guan cha ， ni hui fa xian ta you yi ge cha zuo ， ni ke yi zai qi zhong fang zhi wu pin yi zeng jia qi li liang 。]

english: Interesting! I'll be on the lookout for that.
translation: 有趣的！我会留意这一点。 [you qu de ！ wo hui liu yi zhe yi dian 。]

english: So it's real. Magnificent.
translation: 所以这是真的。壮丽。 [suo yi zhe shi zhen de 。 zhuang li 。]

english: You've seen this before?
translation: 你以前见过这个吗？ [ni yi qian jian guo zhe ge ma ？]

english: No, but I have heard tales of the mighty Vet'Ion.
translation: 不，但我听说过关于强大的 Vet'Ion 的故事。 [bu ， dan wo ting shuo guo guan yu qiang da de  Vet'Ion  de gu shi 。]

english: It is said his skull can power a certain Zamorakian weapon.
translation: 据说他的头骨可以为某种萨莫拉克武器提供动力。 [ju shuo ta de tou gu ke yi wei mou zhong sa mo la ke wu qi ti gong dong li 。]

english: Oh, like this skull?
translation: 哦，像这个头骨吗？ [o ， xiang zhe ge tou gu ma ？]

english: Yes, like that one! That looks powerful indeed. I think that would do quite nicely.
translation: 是的，就像那个一样！看起来确实很强大。我认为那会做得很好。 [shi de ， jiu xiang na ge yi yang ！ kan qi lai que shi hen qiang da 。 wo ren wei na hui zuo de hen hao 。]

english: A skilled crafter can combine the two. If you wish, I could do it for you... For a price, that is.
translation: 熟练的工匠可以将两者结合起来。如果您愿意，我可以为您做……只要有价格。 [shu lian de gong jiang ke yi jiang liang zhe jie he qi lai 。 ru guo nin yuan yi ， wo ke yi wei nin zuo …… zhi yao you jia ge 。]

english: I don't have the money for that.
translation: 我没有钱做那个。 [wo mei you qian zuo na ge 。]

english: Feel free to come back when you do.
translation: 回来后请随时回来。 [hui lai hou qing sui shi hui lai 。]

english: There we go! All done.
translation: 我们开始吧！全部完成。 [wo men kai shi ba ！ quan bu wan cheng 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: No, I'm afraid not.
translation: 不，恐怕不是。 [bu ， kong pa bu shi 。]

english: Oh. Do you know someone who might know more?
translation: 哦。您认识一个可能了解更多的人吗？ [o 。 nin ren shi yi ge ke neng liao jie geng duo de ren ma ？]

english: Andros Mai is a very... Devoted man. If you can see past that, he may be able to help you.
translation: 安德罗斯·麦是一个非常……忠诚的人。如果你能看清这一点，他也许能帮助你。 [an de luo si · mai shi yi ge fei chang …… zhong cheng de ren 。 ru guo ni neng kan qing zhe yi dian ， ta ye xu neng bang zhu ni 。]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: Yes! Those belong to Venenatis!
translation: 是的！那些属于维纳蒂斯！ [shi de ！ na xie shu yu wei na di si ！]

english: Ah, but they contain no more venom. That is disappointing.
translation: 啊，但它们不再含有毒液了。这令人失望。 [a ， dan ta men bu zai han you du ye le 。 zhe ling ren shi wang 。]

english: So you're saying they're useless?
translation: 那你是说它们没用？ [na ni shi shuo ta men mei yong ？]

english: To me? Yes. But maybe not to you.
translation: 大部头书？是的。但也许不适合你。 [da bu tou shu ？ shi de 。 dan ye xu bu shi he ni 。]

english: I've seen that Derse Venator guy over there handle similar items. Perhaps he knows more.
translation: 我见过那边的 Derse Venator 人处理类似的物品。也许他知道的更多。 [wo jian guo na bian de  Derse Venator  ren chu li lei si de wu pin 。 ye xu ta zhi dao de geng duo 。]

english: Downstairs there's a strange looking person. I don't know what that item is, but if anyone would, I reckon she would.
translation: 楼下有一个长相奇怪的人。我不知道那东西是什么，但如果有人愿意的话，我想她会的。 [lou xia you yi ge zhang xiang qi guai de ren 。 wo bu zhi dao na dong xi shi shen me ， dan ru guo you ren yuan yi de hua ， wo xiang ta hui de 。]

english: I think she said her name was Madam Sikaro.
translation: 我想她说她的名字是西卡罗女士。 [wo xiang ta shuo ta de ming zi shi xi ka luo nv shi 。]

english: You look ready for combat.
translation: 你看起来已经准备好战斗了。 [ni kan qi lai yi jing zhun bei hao zhan dou le 。]

english: Ask about rare item.
translation: 询问稀有物品。 [xun wen xi you wu pin 。]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Hello, what is this place?
translation: 你好，请问这是什么地方？ [ni hao ， qing wen zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This is Seers Village! We're an organisation of mystically gifted people with the power of foresight...we see things that have yet to come to pass.
translation: 这里是先知村！我们是一个由具有远见卓识的神秘天赋人士组成的组织……我们看到尚未发生的事情。 [zhe li shi xian zhi cun ！ wo men shi yi ge you ju you yuan jian zhuo shi de shen mi tian fu ren shi zu cheng de zu zhi …… wo men kan dao shang wei fa sheng de shi qing 。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: A lot of our time is spent addressing everyday sorts of things, plus we meditate a lot and enhance our powers of mystical foresight.
translation: 我们的很多时间都花在处理日常事务上，此外我们还进行大量冥想并增强我们神秘的远见能力。 [wo men de hen duo shi jian dou hua zai chu li ri chang shi wu shang ， ci wai wo men hai jin xing da liang ming xiang bing zeng qiang wo men shen mi de yuan jian neng li 。]

english: Do you have any quests?
translation: 你有什么任务吗？ [ni you shen me ren wu ma ？]

english: Unfortunately no, sorry, but if adventure is what you seek, try checking through your quest list!
translation: 不幸的是，抱歉，但如果您寻求冒险，请尝试检查您的任务列表！ [bu xing de shi ， bao qian ， dan ru guo nin xun qiu mao xian ， qing chang shi jian cha nin de ren wu lie biao ！]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Thank you, all I need to do is figure out how to get these logs into that vial, but that's my problem. Take this as a reward.
translation: 谢谢，我需要做的就是弄清楚如何将这些日志放入那个小瓶中，但这是我的问题。以此作为奖励。 [xie xie ， wo xu yao zuo de jiu shi nong qing chu ru he jiang zhe xie ri zhi fang ru na ge xiao ping zhong ， dan zhe shi wo de wen ti 。 yi ci zuo wei jiang li 。]

english: Hello, what is this place?
translation: 你好，请问这是什么地方？ [ni hao ， qing wen zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Do you have any quests?
translation: 你有什么任务吗？ [ni you shen me ren wu ma ？]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

translation: 你好。您需要我为您兑换钞票吗？我每张钞票只收取 5 个硬币。 [ni hao 。 nin xu yao wo wei nin dui huan chao piao ma ？ wo mei zhang chao piao zhi shou qu  5  ge ying bi 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

translation: 把你要我兑换的钞票递给我。 [ba ni yao wo dui huan de chao piao di gei wo 。]

translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

translation: 我是法尔斯。我可以用纸币兑换实物。您想要兑换任何纸币吗？ [wo shi fa er si 。 wo ke yi yong zhi bi dui huan shi wu 。 nin xiang yao dui huan ren he zhi bi ma ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]
