translation: 再会。 [zai hui 。]

english: Hello there. Not very often I get visitors. What brings you here?
translation: 你好呀。我不经常接待访客。是什么风把你吹到这里来的？ [ni hao ya 。 wo bu jing chang jie dai fang ke 。 shi shen me feng ba ni chui dao zhe li lai de ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: The name's Phileas Rimor. I was once a soldier in the Shayzien Army but now I'm retired.
translation: 我的名字叫菲利斯·里莫尔。我曾经是 Shayzien 军队的一名士兵，但现在我已经退休了。 [wo de ming zi jiao fei li si · li mo er 。 wo ceng jing shi  Shayzien  jun dui de yi ming shi bing ， dan xian zai wo yi jing tui xiu le 。]

english: Do you need help with anything?
translation: 您需要什么帮助吗？ [nin xu yao shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: I'm fine thank you. Thanks for asking though.
translation: 我很好谢谢你。不过还是谢谢你的询问。 [wo hen hao xie xie ni 。 bu guo hai shi xie xie ni de xun wen 。]

english: You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Tale of the Righteous quest.
translation: 您不满足开始正义故事任务的所有要求。 [nin bu man zu kai shi zheng yi gu shi ren wu de suo you yao qiu 。]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: Oh, okay then.
translation: 哦，好吧。 [o ， hao ba 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Do you need help with anything?
translation: 您需要什么帮助吗？ [nin xu yao shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: What have you brought me? I want some more toys!
translation: 你给我带来了什么？我想要更多的玩具！ [ni gei wo dai lai le shen me ？ wo xiang yao geng duo de wan ju ！]

english: I'm afraid I don't have any toys.
translation: 恐怕我没有玩具。 [kong pa wo mei you wan ju 。]

english: Toys! I want toys!
translation: 玩具！我想要玩具！ [wan ju ！ wo xiang yao wan ju ！]

english: Hello youngster.
translation: 你好年轻人。 [ni hao nian qing ren 。]

english: Daddy says you don't like Mr. Jones. Mr. Jones is nice. He brings me toys and sweets.
translation: 爸爸说你不喜欢琼斯先生。琼斯先生人很好。他给我带来玩具和糖果。 [ba ba shuo ni bu xi huan qiong si xian sheng 。 qiong si xian sheng ren hen hao 。 ta gei wo dai lai wan ju he tang guo 。]

english: Jones is a bad man, Philipe.
translation: 琼斯是个坏人，菲利普。 [qiong si shi ge huai ren ， fei li pu 。]

english: You're a bad [man/lady]! I don't like you!
translation: 你是个坏人[男人/女人]！我不喜欢你！ [ni shi ge huai ren [ nan ren / nv ren ]！ wo bu xi huan ni ！]

english: I'll try and console myself about that disappointment somehow.
translation: 我会尝试以某种方式安慰自己这种失望。 [wo hui chang shi yi mou zhong fang shi an wei zi ji zhe zhong shi wang 。]

english: Hello, who are you?
translation: 你好，你是谁？ [ni hao ， ni shi shui ？]

english: Hi, I'm Phillipa! Juliet's cousin? I like to keep an eye on her, make sure that dashing young Romeo doesn't just steal away from here under our plain old noses!
translation: 嗨，我是菲利帕！朱丽叶的表弟？我喜欢盯着她，确保年轻潇洒的罗密欧不会在我们老老百姓的鼻子底下偷走！ [hai ， wo shi fei li pa ！ zhu li ye de biao di ？ wo xi huan ding zhe ta ， que bao nian qing xiao sa de luo mi ou bu hui zai wo men lao lao bai xing de bi zi di xia tou zou ！]

english: He'd do it you know... he's ever so dashing, and cavalier, in a wet blanket sort of way.
translation: 他会这么做的，你知道的……他总是如此潇洒、傲慢，以一种湿漉漉的方式。 [ta hui zhe me zuo de ， ni zhi dao de …… ta zong shi ru ci xiao sa 、 ao man ， yi yi zhong shi lu lu de fang shi 。]

english: Romeo? Where would I find him then?
translation: 罗密欧？那我到哪里去找他呢？ [luo mi ou ？ na wo dao na li qu zhao ta ne ？]

english: Well, that's a good question! Who knows where his head's at most of the time... in the clouds most likely!
translation: 嗯，这是个好问题！谁知道大多数时候他的头在哪里……最有可能在云端！ [n ， zhe shi ge hao wen ti ！ shui zhi dao da duo shu shi hou ta de tou zai na li …… zui you ke neng zai yun duan ！]

english: Hello, I seem to be getting on really well with that dashing lovely dovely, Romeo... Pity about poor Juliet... she missed out there I reckon!
translation: 你好，我似乎和那个潇洒可爱的鸽子罗密欧相处得很好……可怜可怜的朱丽叶……我想她错过了！ [ni hao ， wo si hu he na ge xiao sa ke ai de ge zi luo mi ou xiang chu de hen hao …… ke lian ke lian de zhu li ye …… wo xiang ta cuo guo le ！]

english: Hello
translation: 你好 [ni hao]

english: Oh, hello... Juliet has told me what you're doing for her and Romeo and I have to say, I'm very grateful to you. Juliet deserves a bit of happiness in her life.
translation: 哦，你好……朱丽叶告诉我你为她和罗密欧做了什么，我不得不说，我非常感谢你。朱丽叶的生活值得一点幸福。 [o ， ni hao …… zhu li ye gao su wo ni wei ta he luo mi ou zuo le shen me ， wo bu de bu shuo ， wo fei chang gan xie ni 。 zhu li ye de sheng huo zhi de yi dian xing fu 。]

english: And I'm sure Romeo is just the sort of jester to make her laugh out loud...hysterically you might say. He always brings a tear to my eyes...tears of happiness at his foolish antics!
translation: 我确信罗密欧就是那种让她笑出声来的小丑……你可能会说歇斯底里。他总是让我热泪盈眶……为他愚蠢的滑稽动作流下幸福的泪水！ [wo que xin luo mi ou jiu shi na zhong rang ta xiao chu sheng lai de xiao chou …… ni ke neng hui shuo xie si di li 。 ta zong shi rang wo re lei ying kuang …… wei ta yu chun de hua ji dong zuo liu xia xing fu de lei shui ！]

english: Oh, thanks...I like to do my cupid bit.
translation: 哦，谢谢...我喜欢做我的丘比特。 [o ， xie xie ... wo xi huan zuo wo de qiu bi te 。]

english: Oh, hello again! How was I...do you think I was convincing?
translation: 噢，又好！我怎么样……你觉得我有说服力吗？ [o ， you hao ！ wo zen me yang …… ni jue de wo you shuo fu li ma ？]

english: Oh, yes, totally!
translation: 哦，是的，完全可以！ [o ， shi de ， wan quan ke yi ！]

english: Ohhh good! I do hope Juliet will be pleased as well! That dashing young Romeo must be beside himself with excitement! Have you told him the good news yet?
translation: 哦哦好啊！我真希望朱丽叶也能高兴！那个风度翩翩的年轻罗密欧一定兴奋得发狂吧！你告诉他这个好消息了吗？ [o o hao a ！ wo zhen xi wang zhu li ye ye neng gao xing ！ na ge feng du pian pian de nian qing luo mi ou yi ding xing fen de fa kuang ba ！ ni gao su ta zhe ge hao xiao xi le ma ？]

english: Not yet, but soon!
translation: 还没有，但很快了！ [hai mei you ， dan hen kuai le ！]

english: Good, good...you lucky thing, I can't wait to see the look on his face!
translation: 好，好……你真幸运，我迫不及待地想看看他脸上的表情！ [hao ， hao …… ni zhen xing yun ， wo po bu ji dai di xiang kan kan ta lian shang de biao qing ！]

english: Hey Phillipa, we need to do something about Juliet.
translation: 嘿，菲利帕，我们需要对朱丽叶做点什么。 [hei ， fei li pa ， wo men xu yao dui zhu li ye zuo dian shen me 。]

english: Hi [player name], good to see you again, how are you?
translation: 嗨[玩家姓名]，很高兴再次见到你，你好吗？ [hai [ wan jia xing ming ]， hen gao xing zai ci jian dao ni ， ni hao ma ？]

english: Hi... I'm good thanks.
translation: 嗨...我很好，谢谢。 [hai ... wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Oh that's great! Romeo and I are also doing great thanks for asking, we've been having the best time since you introduced me to him.
translation: 哦，太好了！罗密欧和我也非常感谢您的询问，自从您将我介绍给他以来，我们一直度过了最美好的时光。 [o ， tai hao le ！ luo mi ou he wo ye fei chang gan xie nin de xun wen ， zi cong nin jiang wo jie shao gei ta yi lai ， wo men yi zhi du guo le zui mei hao de shi guang 。]

english: I'm not here to find out how you and Romeo are getting on, I'm here to help Juliet.
translation: 我来这里不是为了了解你和罗密欧相处得怎么样，我是来帮助朱丽叶的。 [wo lai zhe li bu shi wei le liao jie ni he luo mi ou xiang chu de zen me yang ， wo shi lai bang zhu zhu li ye de 。]

english: Typical, what is she upset about this time?
translation: 典型的是，她这次到底在生气什么？ [dian xing de shi ， ta zhe ci dao di zai sheng qi shen me ？]

english: Her father put her in charge of the birthday party this year, but she's not feeling up to it, recent events have got her feeling quite down.
translation: 今年的生日聚会是父亲让她负责的，但她却不太乐意，最近发生的事情让她心情很低落。 [jin nian de sheng ri ju hui shi fu qin rang ta fu ze de ， dan ta que bu tai le yi ， zui jin fa sheng de shi qing rang ta xin qing hen di luo 。]

english: Why don't you try cheering her up?
translation: 你为什么不试着让她高兴起来呢？ [ni wei shen me bu shi zhe rang ta gao xing qi lai ne ？]

english: I offered to get her one of Gertrude's cats, but she told me there's little chance of that happening.
translation: 我提出要给她买一只格特鲁德的猫，但她告诉我这种情况发生的可能性很小。 [wo ti chu yao gei ta mai yi zhi ge te lu de de mao ， dan ta gao su wo zhe zhong qing kuang fa sheng de ke neng xing hen xiao 。]

english: Hmm, why don't you try dressing up as one, you could be her emotional support human.
translation: 嗯，你为什么不尝试打扮成一个人呢，你可以成为她的情感支持者。 [n ， ni wei shen me bu chang shi da ban cheng yi ge ren ne ， ni ke yi cheng wei ta de qing gan zhi chi zhe 。]

english: That sounds like a terrible idea...
translation: 这听起来是一个可怕的想法...... [zhe ting qi lai shi yi ge ke pa de xiang fa ......]

english: Surely there's something less... weird... I can do instead?
translation: 当然还有一些不那么……奇怪的事情……我可以做吗？ [dang ran hai you yi xie bu na me …… qi guai de shi qing …… wo ke yi zuo ma ？]

english: Got any better ideas?
translation: 有更好的想法吗？ [you geng hao de xiang fa ma ？]

english: Thought not, so since she loves cats, why don't you dress up as one and dance for her.
translation: 没想到，既然她喜欢猫，不如你打扮成一只猫，为她跳舞吧。 [mei xiang dao ， ji ran ta xi huan mao ， bu ru ni da ban cheng yi zhi mao ， wei ta tiao wu ba 。]

english: I'm not going to dress up as a cat...
translation: 我不会打扮成一只猫... [wo bu hui da ban cheng yi zhi mao ...]

english: Fine, but what about just the ears?
translation: 好吧，但是如果只是耳朵呢？ [hao ba ， dan shi ru guo zhi shi er duo ne ？]

english: ... I suppose I can do that.
translation: ……我想我能做到。 […… wo xiang wo neng zuo dao 。]

english: Where am I supposed to find some? I'm not about to take some off a cat.
translation: 我应该去哪里找到一些？我不打算从猫身上取下一些东西。 [wo ying gai qu na li zhao dao yi xie ？ wo bu da suan cong mao shen shang qu xia yi xie dong xi 。]

english: I'm sure Iffie in town could put something together for you, she stays in the clothing store by Varrock Square.
translation: 我相信城里的伊菲可以为你准备一些东西，她住在瓦罗克广场附近的服装店。 [wo xiang xin cheng li de yi fei ke yi wei ni zhun bei yi xie dong xi ， ta zhu zai wa luo ke guang chang fu jin de fu zhuang dian 。]

english: Fine, I'll go have a word.
translation: 好吧，我去说句话。 [hao ba ， wo qu shuo ju hua 。]

english: How are you getting on with your cat costume?
translation: 你的猫装穿得怎么样？ [ni de mao zhuang chuan de zen me yang ？]

english: Still working on it, who did you say could help me with it?
translation: 仍在努力，你说谁可以帮助我？ [reng zai nu li ， ni shuo shui ke yi bang zhu wo ？]

english: Iffie should be able to help, she runs the clothing store by Varrock Square.
translation: 伊菲应该能帮忙，她在瓦罗克广场经营着一家服装店。 [yi fei ying gai neng bang mang ， ta zai wa luo ke guang chang jing ying zhe yi jia fu zhuang dian 。]

english: Alright Phillipa, I've got the cat ears, now what do you want me to do?
translation: 好吧，菲利帕，我有猫耳朵，现在你想让我做什么？ [hao ba ， fei li pa ， wo you mao er duo ， xian zai ni xiang rang wo zuo shen me ？]

english: Aww, they're so adorable!
translation: 哇，他们太可爱了！ [wa ， ta men tai ke ai le ！]

english: Okay, you need to go talk to Juliet and try cheer her up, do a dance for her or something, do you have any good moves?
translation: 好吧，你要去和朱丽叶谈谈，试着让她高兴起来，为她跳支舞什么的，你有什么好的动作吗？ [hao ba ， ni yao qu he zhu li ye tan tan ， shi zhe rang ta gao xing qi lai ， wei ta tiao zhi wu shen me de ， ni you shen me hao de dong zuo ma ？]

english: I know a couple, okay let me try.
translation: 我认识几个，好吧，让我试试。 [wo ren shi ji ge ， hao ba ， rang wo shi shi 。]

english: Thanks for cheering up Juliet, you've saved the party.
translation: 谢谢你让朱丽叶振作起来，你拯救了聚会。 [xie xie ni rang zhu li ye zhen zuo qi lai ， ni zheng jiu le ju hui 。]

english: It's okay, I'm used to it at this point.
translation: 没关系，我现在已经习惯了。 [mei guan xi ， wo xian zai yi jing xi guan le 。]

english: Ask about the birthday party.
translation: 询问生日聚会的情况。 [xun wen sheng ri ju hui de qing kuang 。]

english: Something else.
translation: 还有别的事。 [hai you bie de shi 。]

english: Hello youngster!
translation: 年轻人你好！ [nian qing ren ni hao ！]

english: The child is too busy playing to take any notice.
translation: 孩子正忙着玩耍，没有注意到。 [hai zi zheng mang zhe wan shua ， mei you zhu yi dao 。]

english: 'Ello 'Ello!
translation: '埃洛'埃洛！ [' ai luo ' ai luo ！]

english: Who's this then?
translation: 那这是谁啊？ [na zhe shi shui a ？]

english: I don't know any more than you do!
translation: 我不知道比你多！ [wo bu zhi dao bi ni duo ！]

english: Well ask them!
translation: 那就问问他们吧！ [na jiu wen wen ta men ba ！]

english: You ask them!
translation: 你问他们！ [ni wen ta men ！]

english: No! I'm not talking to some stranger in a sewer.
translation: 不！我不会和下水道里的陌生人说话。 [bu ！ wo bu hui he xia shui dao li de mo sheng ren shuo hua 。]

english: Go away, weirdo! We're busy!
translation: 走开，怪人！我们很忙！ [zou kai ， guai ren ！ wo men hen mang ！]

english: Would you look at that!
translation: 你会看那个吗！ [ni hui kan na ge ma ！]

english: At what?
translation: 在什么时候？ [zai shen me shi hou ？]

english: It's [player name] again!
translation: 又是[玩家名字]！ [you shi [ wan jia ming zi ]！]

english: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？ [ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Where can I find Jimmy Dazzler again?
translation: 我在哪里可以再次找到吉米·达兹勒？ [wo zai na li ke yi zai ci zhao dao ji mi · da zi lei ？]

english: Didn't you find him in Ardougne?
translation: 你没在阿尔杜涅找到他吗？ [ni mei zai a er du nie zhao dao ta ma ？]

english: He's normally in the Flying Horse Inn.
translation: 他平时都在飞马客栈。 [ta ping shi dou zai fei ma ke zhan 。]

english: Give him a kiss from me!
translation: 给他一个吻吧！ [gei ta yi ge wen ba ！]

english: I will absolutely not be doing that.
translation: 我绝对不会那样做。 [wo jue dui bu hui na yang zuo 。]

english: Can you tell me where I can find Hooknosed Jack?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪里可以找到鹰钩鼻杰克吗？ [ni neng gao su wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao ying gou bi jie ke ma ？]

english: He's here in Varrock!
translation: 他在瓦罗克！ [ta zai wa luo ke ！]

english: Who 'nose' where, though!
translation: 不过，谁的“鼻子”在哪里呢！ [bu guo ， shei de “ bi zi ” zai na li ne ！]

english: Ha! I'm sure you can 'scent' him out, [player name]
translation: 哈!我相信你能“闻”出他的气味，[玩家名字] [ha ! wo xiang xin ni neng “ wen ” chu ta de qi wei ，[ wan jia ming zi ]]

english: Hahahaha!
translation: 哈哈哈哈！ [ha ha ha ha ！]

english: Come on, it's not that funny.
translation: 得了吧，这没那么好笑。 [de le ba ， zhe mei na me hao xiao 。]

english: You think our nose jokes are bad? Well...
translation: 你觉得我们的鼻子笑话很糟糕吗？出色地... [ni jue de wo men de bi zi xiao hua hen zao gao ma ？ chu se di ...]

english: Our eye jokes are even cornea!
translation: 我们的眼睛笑话甚至是角膜！ [wo men de yan jing xiao hua shen zhi shi jiao mo ！]

english: Can you tell me where I can find Smokin' Joe?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪里可以找到吸烟乔吗？ [ni neng gao su wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao xi yan qiao ma ？]

english: Last we heard he was in Keldagrim.
translation: 上次我们听说他在凯尔达格林。 [shang ci wo men ting shuo ta zai kai er da ge lin 。]

english: Can you tell me where I can find the Face?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪里可以找到这张脸吗？ [ni neng gao su wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao zhe zhang lian ma ？]

english: She was in Port Sarim last we heard.
translation: 我们上次听说她在沙里姆港。 [wo men shang ci ting shuo ta zai sha li mu gang 。]

english: You can't miss her!
translation: 你不能错过她！ [ni bu neng cuo guo ta ！]

english: Can you tell me where I can find Felkrash?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪里可以找到菲尔克拉什吗？ [ni neng gao su wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao fei er ke la shen ma ？]

english: We shouldn't say, but-
translation: 我们不应该说，但是—— [wo men bu ying gai shuo ， dan shi ——]

translation: 嗯，正如我们认为的那样。 [n ， zheng ru wo men ren wei de na yang 。]

english: So how do you decide who becomes a member of the militia?
translation: 那么你如何决定谁成为民兵成员呢？ [na me ni ru he jue ding shui cheng wei min bing cheng yuan ne ？]

english: Well, if yer ship is in need of repairs and yer in port, then yer a member, simple as that.
translation: 好吧，如果你的船需要修理并且你在港口，那么你就是一名成员，就这么简单。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni de chuan xu yao xiu li bing qie ni zai gang kou ， na me ni jiu shi yi ming cheng yuan ， jiu zhe me jian dan 。]

english: See, those of us that are here for a long haul tend to want to keep things peaceful, so we keep an eye on everyone else as and when they come in.
translation: 看，我们这些长期在这里的人往往希望保持和平，所以我们会在其他人进来时留意他们。 [kan ， wo men zhe xie chang qi zai zhe li de ren wang wang xi wang bao chi he ping ， suo yi wo men hui zai qi ta ren jin lai shi liu yi ta men 。]

english: Given the number of skirmishes we have with customs, there is never a shortage of repairs needed.
translation: 考虑到我们与海关发生的小冲突次数，从来不缺少所需的维修。 [kao lv dao wo men yu hai guan fa sheng de xiao chong tu ci shu ， cong lai bu que shao suo xu de wei xiu 。]

english: Thanks, that was very informative.
translation: 谢谢，内容非常丰富。 [xie xie ， nei rong fei chang feng fu 。]

english: Just passing through.
translation: 刚好路过。 [gang hao lu guo 。]

english: See to it ye keeps outs trouble, stranger.
translation: 陌生人，请注意不要惹麻烦。 [mo sheng ren ， qing zhu yi bu yao re ma fan 。]

english: Just looking about.
translation: 只是四处看看。 [zhi shi si chu kan kan 。]

english: Well good luck with that, landlubber.
translation: 祝你好运，旱鸭子。 [zhu ni hao yun ， han ya zi 。]

english: Adventuring!
translation: 冒险！ [mao xian ！]

english: Adventurin' eh...that sounds like customs and excise work to my ears.
translation: 冒险……呃……在我听来，这就像海关和税务工作。 [mao xian …… e …… zai wo ting lai ， zhe jiu xiang hai guan he shui wu gong zuo 。]

english: No, no, I'm a pirate, honest. I have the book and everything.
translation: 不，不，老实说，我是海盗。我有书和一切。 [bu ， bu ， lao shi shuo ， wo shi hai dao 。 wo you shu he yi qie 。]

english: I'll have me eye on ye, customs [boy/girl]. One step out of line and bam.
translation: 我会关注你们，海关[男孩/女孩]。越界一步，砰。 [wo hui guan zhu ni men ， hai guan [ nan hai / nv hai ]。 yue jie yi bu ， peng 。]

english: They won't find enough of ye to feed a hungry sea slug.
translation: 他们找不到足够的叶来喂养饥饿的海蛞蝓。 [ta men zhao bu dao zu gou de ye lai wei yang ji e de hai kuo yu 。]

english: Just looking around. What is there to do here?
translation: 只是环顾四周。这里有什么可做的？ [zhi shi huan gu si zhou 。 zhe li you shen me ke zuo de ？]

english: Well, if yeve got some coins in yer purse ye can head over to Joe's house of 'Rum' and get yerself drunk.
translation: 好吧，如果你的钱包里有一些硬币，你就可以前往乔的“朗姆酒”之家，把自己喝醉。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni de qian bao li you yi xie ying bi ， ni jiu ke yi qian wang qiao de “ lang mu jiu ” zhi jia ， ba zi ji he zui 。]

english: Anything else?
translation: 还要别的吗？ [hai yao bie de ma ？]

english: Well, Smithin' Smith and Dodgy Mike have some stuff to sell, and ye can always try grabbin' some fish from Two Feet Charley if yer hungry.
translation: 好吧，史密斯史密斯和狡猾的迈克有一些东西要卖，如果你饿了，你可以随时尝试从两英尺查理那里抓一些鱼。 [hao ba ， shi mi si shi mi si he jiao hua de mai ke you yi xie dong xi yao mai ， ru guo ni e le ， ni ke yi sui shi chang shi cong liang ying chi cha li na li zhua yi xie yu 。]

english: Is that it?
translation: 是这样吗？ [shi zhe yang ma ？]

english: Well, ye can head out to the brewery and have a word with Fancy Dan or San Fan. They always need a hand out there.
translation: 好吧，你们可以去啤酒厂和 Fancy Dan 或 San Fan 谈谈。他们总是需要有人伸出援手。 [hao ba ， ni men ke yi qu pi jiu chang he  Fancy Dan  huo  San Fan  tan tan 。 ta men zong shi xu yao you ren shen chu yuan shou 。]

english: Doing what?
translation: 做什么？ [zuo shen me ？]

english: Doin' each others heads in most of the time.
translation: 大部分时间都在互相干扰。 [da bu fen shi jian dou zai hu xiang gan rao 。]

english: What is your business?
translation: 你是做什么生意的？ [ni shi zuo shen me sheng yi de ？]

english: Nothing much, just passing through.
translation: 没什么大不了的，只是路过而已。 [mei shen me da bu liao de ， zhi shi lu guo er yi 。]

english: Well have a good day, [sir/miss].
translation: 祝您有美好的一天，[先生/小姐]。 [zhu nin you mei hao de yi tian ，[ xian sheng / xiao jie ]。]

english: I'm sorry, but you don't sound much like a pirate, how did you come to be here?
translation: 抱歉，你听起来不太像海盗，你是怎么来到这里的？ [bao qian ， ni ting qi lai bu tai xiang hai dao ， ni shi zen me lai dao zhe li de ？]

english: I used to be a language tutor, teaching in a small school just outside of Lumbridge.
translation: 我曾经是一名语言导师，在朗布里奇郊外的一所小学校任教。 [wo ceng jing shi yi ming yu yan dao shi ， zai lang bu li qi jiao wai de yi suo xiao xue xiao ren jiao 。]

english: However the place closed down due to ill attendance, and so I was forced to take up piracy.
translation: 然而，这个地方因为出勤率不好而关门了，所以我被迫从事盗版工作。 [ran er ， zhe ge di fang yin wei chu qin lv bu hao er guan men le ， suo yi wo bei po cong shi dao ban gong zuo 。]

english: Wasn't that a bit of a big jump in careers?
translation: 这不是职业生涯的一个大跳跃吗？ [zhe bu shi zhi ye sheng ya de yi ge da tiao yue ma ？]

english: Not really, I made my way through via a short stint as a lawyer.
translation: 事实并非如此，我是通过短暂的律师生涯才成功的。 [shi shi bing fei ru ci ， wo shi tong guo duan zan de lv shi sheng ya cai cheng gong de 。]

english: Well, that makes sense.
translation: 嗯，这是有道理的。 [n ， zhe shi you dao li de 。]

english: I must return to my duties. Have a nice day!
translation: 我必须回到我的职责。祝你今天过得愉快！ [wo bi xu hui dao wo de zhi ze 。 zhu ni jin tian guo de yu kuai ！]

english: You too!
translation: 你也是！ [ni ye shi ！]

english: What's yours?
translation: 你的是什么？ [ni de shi shen me ？]

english: I asked first!
translation: 我先问了！ [wo xian wen le ！]

english: And very rudely too I might add.
translation: 我也可以非常粗鲁地补充一下。 [wo ye ke yi fei chang cu lu di bu chong yi xia 。]

english: Fine! Go about yer 'business'!
translation: 美好的！忙你的“事”吧！ [mei hao de ！ mang ni de “ shi ” ba ！]

english: I will!
translation: 我会！ [wo hui ！]

english: Whaz yer bushinessssss...ssss?
translation: 你在忙什么……ssss？ [ni zai mang shen me ……ssss？]

english: Are you drunk on duty?
translation: 你上班喝醉了吗？ [ni shang ban he zui le ma ？]

english: I'm not drunk! I'll knock down any man as sayin' I'm been having a drinking on my duties!
translation: 我没有醉！我会击倒任何说我在履行职责时喝酒的人！ [wo mei you zui ！ wo hui ji dao ren he shuo wo zai lv xing zhi ze shi he jiu de ren ！]

english: Well, I think you'll have a hard time explaining your slurred speech, odd behaviour, bitter, nostril dissolving stench and rolling, bloodshot eyes if your not drunk.
translation: 好吧，我想如果你没有喝醉的话，你将很难解释你的含糊不清的言语、奇怪的行为、苦涩的、鼻孔溶解的恶臭以及转动的、布满血丝的眼睛。 [hao ba ， wo xiang ru guo ni mei you he zui de hua ， ni jiang hen nan jie shi ni de han hu bu qing de yan yu 、 qi guai de xing wei 、 ku se de 、 bi kong rong jie de e chou yi ji zhuan dong de 、 bu man xue si de yan jing 。]

english: Arrr, ye got me. I just can't leave the stuff alone.
translation: 啊，你抓住我了。我就是不能丢下这些东西不管。 [a ， ni zhua zhu wo le 。 wo jiu shi bu neng diu xia zhe xie dong xi bu guan 。]

english: Cap'n Braindeath's Ten X With Added Cattle Medication just keeps singin' its siren song to me.
translation: Cap'n Braindeath 的《添加牛药的十个 X》一直在向我唱着它的海妖之歌。 [Cap'n Braindeath  de 《 tian jia niu yao de shi ge  X》 yi zhi zai xiang wo chang zhe ta de hai yao zhi ge 。]

english: Would ye care fer a drop?
translation: 你介意滴一滴吗？ [ni jie yi di yi di ma ？]

english: No.  I would most certainly not.
translation: 不，我绝对不会。 [bu ， wo jue dui bu hui 。]

english: Suit yerself.
translation: 适合自己。 [shi he zi ji 。]

english: None of yours.
translation: 没有你的。 [mei you ni de 。]

english: Fair enough. Off ye go.
translation: 很公平。走吧。 [hen gong ping 。 zou ba 。]

english: I'm just helping out a friend.
translation: 我只是在帮助一个朋友。 [wo zhi shi zai bang zhu yi ge peng you 。]

english: Which friend?
translation: 哪个朋友？ [na ge peng you ？]

english: Bill Teach.
translation: 比尔·蒂奇. [bi er · di qi .]

english: Bill hired you eh? He must have been scrapin' the barrel and no mistake.
translation: 比尔雇用了你，嗯？他一定是在刮擦枪管，没错。 [bi er gu yong le ni ， n ？ ta yi ding shi zai gua ca qiang guan ， mei cuo 。]

english: Hey! I resent that!
translation: 嘿！我对此很反感！ [hei ！ wo dui ci hen fan gan ！]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Arrh I'll keel haul ye!
translation: 啊我会龙骨拖你们！ [a wo hui long gu tuo ni men ！]

english: Pieces of eight! pieces of eight!
translation: 八块！八块！ [ba kuai ！ ba kuai ！]

english: Oh wait that's the parrot's line.
translation: 哦等等，这是鹦鹉的台词。 [o deng deng ， zhe shi ying wu de tai ci 。]

english: You'll be joining Davey Jones in his locker!
translation: 您将和戴维·琼斯一起进入他的储物柜！ [nin jiang he dai wei · qiong si yi qi jin ru ta de chu wu gui ！]

english: Batton down the hatches there's a storm a brewin!
translation: 猛击舱口，一场风暴正在酝酿之中！ [meng ji cang kou ， yi chang feng bao zheng zai yun niang zhi zhong ！]

english: A pox on ye!
translation: 你身上长了痘！ [ni shen shang zhang le dou ！]

english: Arrrh ye lily livered landlubber!
translation: 啊，你这个百合肝旱鸭子！ [a ， ni zhe ge bai he gan han ya zi ！]

english: Arrh arrh!
translation: 啊啊啊！ [a a a ！]

english: Avast me hearties!
translation: 阿瓦斯特我的心！ [a wa si te wo de xin ！]

english: Shiver me timbers!
translation: 让我颤抖吧！ [rang wo chan dou ba ！]

english: 3 days at port for resupply then out on the high sea!
translation: 在港口停留三天补给，然后出海！ [zai gang kou ting liu san tian bu ji ， ran hou chu hai ！]

english: I think ye'll be taking a long walk off a short plank!
translation: 我想你会从短木板上走很长一段路！ [wo xiang ni hui cong duan mu ban shang zou hen zhang yi duan lu ！]

english: Ahoy there!
translation: 哎哟！ [ai yo ！]

english: Keel haul them I say!
translation: 我说用龙骨拖它们！ [wo shuo yong long gu tuo ta men ！]

english: Splice the mainbrace!
translation: 拼接主支架！ [pin jie zhu zhi jia ！]

english: Great blackbeard's beard!
translation: 黑胡子的胡子真好看！ [hei hu zi de hu zi zhen hao kan ！]

english: I'm the scourge of the six seas!
translation: 我是六海之祸！ [wo shi liu hai zhi huo ！]

english: Don't you mean seven seas?
translation: 你不是说七海吗？ [ni bu shi shuo qi hai ma ？]

english: I'm the scourge of the seven seas!
translation: 我是七大洋的祸害！ [wo shi qi da yang de huo hai ！]

english: Good day to you my dear sir!
translation: 祝您美好的一天，我亲爱的先生！ [zhu nin mei hao de yi tian ， wo qin ai de xian sheng ！]

english: Man overboard!
translation: 男人落水了！ [nan ren luo shui le ！]

english: I don't think Mr Grip will like you opening that. That's his private drinks cabinet.
translation: 我认为格里普先生不会喜欢你打开它。那是他的私人酒柜。 [wo ren wei ge li pu xian sheng bu hui xi huan ni da kai ta 。 na shi ta de si ren jiu gui 。]

english: He won't notice me having a quick look.
translation: 他不会注意到我快速地看了一眼。 [ta bu hui zhu yi dao wo kuai su di kan le yi yan 。]

english: Stay out of my drinks cabinet!
translation: 别靠近我的饮料柜！ [bie kao jin wo de yin liao gui ！]

english: Grip walks into the room
translation: 格力走进房间 [ge li zou jin fang jian]

english: You find a bottle of whiskey in the cupboard.
translation: 你在橱柜里发现了一瓶威士忌。 [ni zai chu gui li fa xian le yi ping wei shi ji 。]

english: Ok, I'll leave it.
translation: 好吧，我就离开了。 [hao ba ， wo jiu li kai le 。]

english: He won't notice me having a quick look.
translation: 他不会注意到我快速地看了一眼。 [ta bu hui zhu yi dao wo kuai su di kan le yi yan 。]

english: Ok, I'll leave it.
translation: 好吧，我就离开了。 [hao ba ， wo jiu li kai le 。]

english: Ahoy!
translation: 哎哟！ [ai yo ！]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Welcome to the Brimhaven Agility Arena!
translation: 欢迎来到布里姆黑文敏捷竞技场！ [huan ying lai dao bu li mu hei wen min jie jing ji chang ！]

english: If ye want to know more talk to Cap'n Izzy, he found it!
translation: 如果您想了解更多信息，请与伊兹船长交谈，他找到了！ [ru guo nin xiang liao jie geng duo xin xi ， qing yu yi zi chuan zhang jiao tan ， ta zhao dao le ！]

english: What do you do?
translation: 你做什么工作？ [ni zuo shen me gong zuo ？]

english: I be the Jack o' Tickets. I exchange the tickets ye collect in the Agility Arena for more stuff. Ye can obtain more agility experience or some items ye won't find anywhere else!
translation: 我是杰克票。我用你们在敏捷竞技场收集的门票交换更多东西。你可以获得更多的敏捷经验或一些在其他地方找不到的物品！ [wo shi jie ke piao 。 wo yong ni men zai min jie jing ji chang shou ji de men piao jiao huan geng duo dong xi 。 ni ke yi huo de geng duo de min jie jing yan huo yi xie zai qi ta di fang zhao bu dao de wu pin ！]

english: Sounds good!
translation: 听起来不错！ [ting qi lai bu cuo ！]

english: I'd like to trade in my tickets, please.
translation: 我想换掉我的门票。 [wo xiang huan diao wo de men piao 。]

english: Aye, ye be on the right tack.
translation: 是的，你们的方向是正确的。 [shi de ， ni men de fang xiang shi zheng que de 。]

english: I have a question about my Achievement Diary.
translation: 我对我的成就日记有疑问。 [wo dui wo de cheng jiu ri ji you yi wen 。]

english: I've done all the easy tasks in my Karamja Achievement Diary.
translation: 我已经完成了《Karamja 成就日记》中的所有简单任务。 [wo yi jing wan cheng le 《Karamja  cheng jiu ri ji 》 zhong de suo you jian dan ren wu 。]

english: Arr, ye have that, I see yer list. I s'pose ye'll be wantin' yer reward then!
translation: 啊，你有这个，我看到你的清单了。我猜你一定会想要你的奖励的！ [a ， ni you zhe ge ， wo kan dao ni de qing dan le 。 wo cai ni yi ding hui xiang yao ni de jiang li de ！]

english: Arrr, ye'll 'ave ta come back when ye has more space in yer pack.
translation: 哎呀，等你的背包里有更多空间时，你就会回来的。 [ai ya ， deng ni de bei bao li you geng duo kong jian shi ， ni jiu hui hui lai de 。]

english: These 'ere Karamja gloves be a symbol of yer explorin' on the island. I'll 'ave a word with some of the seafarin' folk who sail to Port Sarim and Ardougne, so they'll take ye on board half price if ye be wearin' them.
translation: 这些“Karamja 手套”是您在岛上探索的象征。我会和一些航行到萨里姆港和阿杜涅的航海者说句话，这样如果你穿着它们，他们会以半价带你上船。 [zhe xie “Karamja  shou tao ” shi nin zai dao shang tan suo de xiang zheng 。 wo hui he yi xie hang xing dao sa li mu gang he a du nie de hang hai zhe shuo ju hua ， zhe yang ru guo ni chuan zhe ta men ， ta men hui yi ban jia dai ni shang chuan 。]

english: I've done all the medium tasks in my Karamja Achievement Diary.
translation: 我已经完成了《Karamja 成就日记》中的所有中等任务。 [wo yi jing wan cheng le 《Karamja  cheng jiu ri ji 》 zhong de suo you zhong deng ren wu 。]

english: Arr, so ye have. I s'pose ye'll be wantin' yer reward upgraded then!
translation: 啊，原来如此。我猜你一定会想要升级你的奖励！ [a ， yuan lai ru ci 。 wo cai ni yi ding hui xiang yao sheng ji ni de jiang li ！]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: The enchantment on these 'ere Karamja gloves be a symbol of yer further explorin' on the island. Cap'n Izzy's arranged it so ye get a little extra benefit in our Agility Arena, an' ye can use the stepping stone in
translation: 这些 Karamja 手套上的魅力将成为您在岛上进一步探索的象征。伊兹船长的安排是为了让你们在我们的敏捷竞技场中获得一些额外的好处，并且你们可以使用踏脚石 [zhe xie  Karamja  shou tao shang de mei li jiang cheng wei nin zai dao shang jin yi bu tan suo de xiang zheng 。 yi zi chuan zhang de an pai shi wei le rang ni men zai wo men de min jie jing ji chang zhong huo de yi xie e wai de hao chu ， bing qie ni men ke yi shi yong ta jiao shi]

english: Shilo Village. Ye can have this lamp too.
translation: 石洛村。你也可以拥有这盏灯。 [shi luo cun 。 ni ye ke yi yong you zhe zhan deng 。]

english: Wow, thanks!
translation: 哇，谢谢！ [wa ， xie xie ！]

english: I've done all the hard tasks in my Karamja Achievement Diary.
translation: 我已经完成了《卡拉姆贾成就日记》中的所有艰巨任务。 [wo yi jing wan cheng le 《 ka la mu jia cheng jiu ri ji 》 zhong de suo you jian ju ren wu 。]

english: Arr, so ye have. I s'pose ye'll be wantin' yer reward upgraded again!
translation: 啊，原来如此。我想你们一定会想要再次升级奖励！ [a ， yuan lai ru ci 。 wo xiang ni men yi ding hui xiang yao zai ci sheng ji jiang li ！]

english: The enchantment on these 'ere Karamja gloves be a symbol of yer exhaustive explorin'. They'll take ye to a mine under Shilo Village now infinitely, an' all the merchants will give ye discounts. Ye can have this lamp
translation: 这些 Karamja 手套上的魅力是您彻底探索的象征。现在他们会无限地带你去石洛村下面的一个矿山，所有的商人都会给你折扣。你可以拥有这盏灯 [zhe xie  Karamja  shou tao shang de mei li shi nin che di tan suo de xiang zheng 。 xian zai ta men hui wu xian di dai ni qu shi luo cun xia mian de yi ge kuang shan ， suo you de shang ren du hui gei ni zhe kou 。 ni ke yi yong you zhe zhan deng]

english: too.
translation: 也。 [ye 。]

english: I've done all the elite tasks in my Karamja Achievement Diary.
translation: 我已经完成了《卡拉姆贾成就日记》中的所有精英任务。 [wo yi jing wan cheng le 《 ka la mu jia cheng jiu ri ji 》 zhong de suo you jing ying ren wu 。]

translation: 您好，我将保留这个泊位，等待皮斯卡利留斯女士的归来。 [nin hao ， wo jiang bao liu zhe ge bo wei ， deng dai pi si ka li liu si nv shi de gui lai 。]

english: Everyone deserves ahicbreak you know. It gets pretty tiring luggingburpletters about all day.

translation: 是的……我看得出来。再见皮特！ [shi de …… wo kan de chu lai 。 zai jian pi te ！]

english: Hey Pete what you doing here?
translation: 嘿，皮特，你在这里做什么？ [hei ， pi te ， ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

translation: 只是对名人和他们最喜欢的颜色进行了快速调查。这是《西飞龙女子周刊》的特别报道。 [zhi shi dui ming ren he ta men zui xi huan de yan se jin xing le kuai su diao cha 。 zhe shi 《 xi fei long nv zi zhou kan 》 de te bie bao dao 。]

translation: 你会说飞龙语吗？ [ni hui shuo fei long yu ma ？]

english: No. Can you?
translation: 不，你可以吗？ [bu ， ni ke yi ma ？]

english: Well obviously.
translation: 显然。 [xian ran 。]

english: Go on then.
translation: 那就继续吧。 [na jiu ji xu ba 。]

translation: 这里！你疯了？不，恐怕我做不到。可能会引起各种麻烦。 [zhe li ！ ni feng le ？ bu ， kong pa wo zuo bu dao 。 ke neng hui yin qi ge zhong ma fan 。]

english: You're a bit mad really aren't you?
translation: 你真的有点生气不是吗？ [ni zhen de you dian sheng qi bu shi ma ？]

translation: 如果你能说 1000 多种语言，你也会的。我敢打赌，对这个世界的烦恼一无所知是件幸福的事！我走了！ [ru guo ni neng shuo  1000  duo zhong yu yan ， ni ye hui de 。 wo gan da du ， dui zhe ge shi jie de fan nao yi wu suo zhi shi jian xing fu de shi ！ wo zou le ！]

translation: 嗨，皮特，怎么样？ [hai ， pi te ， zen me yang ？]

english: Just chatting to my big brother Pete. Hee heee!!
translation: 刚刚和我哥哥皮特聊天。嘻嘻！！ [gang gang he wo ge ge pi te liao tian 。 xi xi ！！]

english: What's so funny?
translation: 有什么好笑的？ [you shen me hao xiao de ？]

english: Just a joke that he told me. Care to hear it?
translation: 只是他告诉我的一个笑话。想听听吗？ [zhi shi ta gao su wo de yi ge xiao hua 。 xiang ting ting ma ？]

english: Yes, go on then.
translation: 是的，那就继续吧。 [shi de ， na jiu ji xu ba 。]

translation: 2 只鹦鹉坐在栖息处。一个对另一个说“你能闻到鱼的味道吗”？嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。 [2  zhi ying wu zuo zai qi xi chu 。 yi ge dui ling yi ge shuo “ ni neng wen dao yu de wei dao ma ”？ hei hei hei hei hei hei 。]

english: And so what did the other one say?
translation: 那么另一个人怎么说呢？ [na me ling yi ge ren zen me shuo ne ？]

english: Sigh. 2 Parrots sit on a perch. One says to the other 'Can you smell fish'? Hee heheee he ho ho.
translation: 叹。 2 只鹦鹉坐在栖息处。一个对另一个说“你能闻到鱼的味道吗”？嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。 [tan 。 2  zhi ying wu zuo zai qi xi chu 。 yi ge dui ling yi ge shuo “ ni neng wen dao yu de wei dao ma ”？ hei hei hei hei hei hei 。]

english: I see. So... what did the other one say?
translation: 我懂了。那么……另一个人说什么了？ [wo dong le 。 na me …… ling yi ge ren shuo shen me le ？]

english: You're serious aren't you. Listen again. 2 Parrots sit on a perch. One says to the other 'Can you smell fish'.
translation: 你是认真的不是吗。再听一遍。 2 只鹦鹉坐在栖息处。一个对另一个说“你能闻到鱼的味道吗”。 [ni shi ren zhen de bu shi ma 。 zai ting yi bian 。 2  zhi ying wu zuo zai qi xi chu 。 yi ge dui ling yi ge shuo “ ni neng wen dao yu de wei dao ma ”。]

translation: 鱼，对吧。那么，回复是什么？ [yu ， dui ba 。 na me ， hui fu shi shen me ？]

translation: 你现在是故意的吧？请别打扰我！ [ni xian zai shi gu yi de ba ？ qing bie da rao wo ！]

english: Hey Pete, what you doing here?
translation: 嘿，皮特，你在这里做什么？ [hei ， pi te ， ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

translation: 训练祈祷的最常见方法是埋葬骨头，或者将它们放在某种祭坛上献给神灵。 [xun lian qi dao de zui chang jian fang fa shi mai zang gu tou ， huo zhe jiang ta men fang zai mou zhong ji tan shang xian gei shen ling 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Hello! Look at this place. Isn't it amazing?
translation: 你好！看看这个地方。是不是很神奇呢？ [ni hao ！ kan kan zhe ge di fang 。 shi bu shi hen shen qi ne ？]

english: It sure is! Not every day you find yourself in a lost city.
translation: 确实如此！并不是每天你都会发现自己身处一座失落的城市。 [que shi ru ci ！ bing bu shi mei tian ni du hui fa xian zi ji shen chu yi zuo shi luo de cheng shi 。]

english: So what can I do for you?
translation: 那么我能为您做些什么呢？ [na me wo neng wei nin zuo xie shen me ne ？]

english: Does the name Lassar mean anything to you? It was an old fortress that once existed here, long before Camdozaal. I'm wondering if there might still be some traces left down here.
translation: 拉萨尔这个名字对你来说有什么意义吗？这是一座古老的堡垒，早在卡姆多扎尔之前就存在于此。我想知道这里是否还留下了一些痕迹。 [la sa er zhe ge ming zi dui ni lai shuo you shen me yi yi ma ？ zhe shi yi zuo gu lao de bao lei ， zao zai ka mu duo zha er zhi qian jiu cun zai yu ci 。 wo xiang zhi dao zhe li shi fou hai liu xia le yi xie hen ji 。]

english: A ruin within a ruin? How exciting! We have found the odd thing that doesn't seem to be dwarven in origin, but it's still early days for us here, so we haven't been able to learn much yet.
translation: 废墟中的废墟？多么令人兴奋啊！我们发现了一种奇怪的东西，它的起源似乎并非矮人，但对我们来说现在还处于早期阶段，所以我们还无法了解太多。 [fei xu zhong de fei xu ？ duo me ling ren xing fen a ！ wo men fa xian le yi zhong qi guai de dong xi ， ta de qi yuan si hu bing fei ai ren ， dan dui wo men lai shuo xian zai hai chu yu zao qi jie duan ， suo yi wo men hai wu fa liao jie tai duo 。]

english: One that was particularly interesting was this strange icon I found in the mine.
translation: 特别有趣的是我在矿井中发现的这个奇怪的图标。 [te bie you qu de shi wo zai kuang jing zhong fa xian de zhe ge qi guai de tu biao 。]

english: Could be a lot more to find over there, but I must admit, I haven't been back since... well...
translation: 那里可能还有很多东西可以找到，但我必须承认，自从……嗯……之后我就再也没有回来过。 [na li ke neng hai you hen duo dong xi ke yi zhao dao ， dan wo bi xu cheng ren ， zi cong …… n …… zhi hou wo jiu zai ye mei you hui lai guo 。]

english: Since what?
translation: 从什么时候开始？ [cong shen me shi hou kai shi ？]

english: It's probably nothing, but there's this big sinkhole on the other side of the mine. I'm probably just being silly, but I'm sure I heard a voice coming from inside.
translation: 可能没什么，但矿井的另一边有一个大坑。我可能只是傻了，但我确信我听到了从里面传来的声音。 [ke neng mei shen me ， dan kuang jing de ling yi bian you yi ge da keng 。 wo ke neng zhi shi sha le ， dan wo que xin wo ting dao le cong li mian chuan lai de sheng yin 。]

english: Interesting... And if I wanted to go down this hole?
translation: 有趣...如果我想进入这个洞呢？ [you qu ... ru guo wo xiang jin ru zhe ge dong ne ？]

english: Go down the hole?! You're far braver than I am! There's plenty of rocks around there. I'm sure you could tie a rope to one of them. You'd need a pretty long rope though. Here, you can use mine.
translation: 掉到洞里去？！你比我勇敢多了！周围有很多岩石。我确信你可以在其中一个上绑一根绳子。不过你需要一根很长的绳子。在这里，你可以使用我的。 [diao dao dong li qu ？！ ni bi wo yong gan duo le ！ zhou wei you hen duo yan shi 。 wo que xin ni ke yi zai qi zhong yi ge shang bang yi gen sheng zi 。 bu guo ni xu yao yi gen hen zhang de sheng zi 。 zai zhe li ， ni ke yi shi yong wo de 。]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello! What can I do for you today?
translation: 你好！今天我能为您做什么？ [ni hao ！ jin tian wo neng wei nin zuo shen me ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm Preswylwyr.
translation: 我是普雷斯维尔。 [wo shi pu lei si wei er 。]

english: It's nice to meet you Preswylwyr, I'm [player name].
translation: 很高兴认识你，Preswylwyr，我是[玩家名字]。 [hen gao xing ren shi ni ，Preswylwyr， wo shi [ wan jia ming zi ]。]

english: And it's great to meet you, [player name].
translation: 很高兴见到你，[玩家姓名]。 [hen gao xing jian dao ni ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm Gwerin's partner, he runs the mill while it's my job to use up all the flour he produces.
translation: 我是 Gwerin 的合伙人，他经营着工厂，而我的工作就是用完他生产的所有面粉。 [wo shi  Gwerin  de he huo ren ， ta jing ying zhe gong chang ， er wo de gong zuo jiu shi yong wan ta sheng chan de suo you mian fen 。]

english: You bake? So that's what the wonderful smell is.
translation: 你烤吗？这就是美妙的气味。 [ni kao ma ？ zhe jiu shi mei miao de qi wei 。]

english: Ha ha! Would you care for some bread? There should be some on the table.
translation: 哈哈！你想吃点面包吗？桌子上应该有一些。 [ha ha ！ ni xiang chi dian mian bao ma ？ zhuo zi shang ying gai you yi xie 。]

english: Really? That's very nice of you, thanks!
translation: 真的吗？你真是太好了，谢谢！ [zhen de ma ？ ni zhen shi tai hao le ， xie xie ！]

english: No problem! Was there anything else you wanted?
translation: 没问题！你还有什么想要的吗？ [mei wen ti ！ ni hai you shen me xiang yao de ma ？]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Farewell, adventurer.
translation: 再见了，冒险家。 [zai jian le ， mao xian jia 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Greetings. May the blessings of Icthlarin rest on your tired shoulders and set you at ease during these strange times.
translation: 问候。愿 Icthlarin 的祝福落在您疲惫的肩膀上，让您在这些奇怪的时刻感到轻松。 [wen hou 。 yuan  Icthlarin  de zhu fu luo zai nin pi bei de jian bang shang ， rang nin zai zhe xie qi guai de shi ke gan dao qing song 。]

english: Good day, adventurer.
translation: 美好的一天，冒险家。 [mei hao de yi tian ， mao xian jia 。]

english: What do you know about the necropolis to the south?
translation: 你对南边的墓地了解多少？ [ni dui nan bian de mu di liao jie duo shao ？]

english: Not too much. It's been abandoned for a long time. In fact, you couldn't even access most of it until fairly recently.
translation: 不是太多。它已经被遗弃很长时间了。事实上，直到最近您才可以访问其中的大部分内容。 [bu shi tai duo 。 ta yi jing bei yi qi hen zhang shi jian le 。 shi shi shang ， zhi dao zui jin nin cai ke yi fang wen qi zhong de da bu fen nei rong 。]

english: How come?
translation: 怎么会？ [zen me hui ？]

english: It was mostly buried under the sand until a storm came in from the south.
translation: 它大部分被埋在沙子下，直到一场风暴从南方袭来。 [ta da bu fen bei mai zai sha zi xia ， zhi dao yi chang feng bao cong nan fang xi lai 。]

english: Interesting... Do you know if many people have been there since it was uncovered?
translation: 有趣……你知道自从它被发现以来，是否有很多人去过那里？ [you qu …… ni zhi dao zi cong ta bei fa xian yi lai ， shi fou you hen duo ren qu guo na li ？]

english: Not as many as you'd think. There's a lot of superstition about the place. People say that even the sand is marked by death.
translation: 没有你想象的那么多。关于这个地方有很多迷信。人们说，即使是沙子，也有死亡的痕迹。 [mei you ni xiang xiang de na me duo 。 guan yu zhe ge di fang you hen duo mi xin 。 ren men shuo ， ji shi shi sha zi ， ye you si wang de hen ji 。]

english: You sound like you don't believe them.
translation: 听起来你不相信他们。 [ting qi lai ni bu xiang xin ta men 。]

english: Not really. The sand is probably that colour due to the amount of salt in it. Still, if it keeps people from robbing the dead, that's no bad thing.
translation: 并不真地。沙子之所以是这种颜色，可能是因为里面含有大量的盐。不过，如果它能阻止人们抢劫死者，那也不是坏事。 [bing bu zhen di 。 sha zi zhi suo yi shi zhe zhong yan se ， ke neng shi yin wei li mian han you da liang de yan 。 bu guo ， ru guo ta neng zu zhi ren men qiang jie si zhe ， na ye bu shi huai shi 。]

english: I see. Thanks for the information.
translation: 我懂了。感谢您提供信息。 [wo dong le 。 gan xie nin ti gong xin xi 。]

english: Any time, adventurer.
translation: 任何时候，冒险家。 [ren he shi hou ， mao xian jia 。]

english: Good day.
translation: 再会。 [zai hui 。]

english: Hey, hey, hey! What in the name of sweet suffering Icthlarin are you doing?
translation: 嘿嘿嘿！以甜蜜痛苦的名义，你在做什么？ [hei hei hei ！ yi tian mi tong ku de ming yi ， ni zai zuo shen me ？]

english: I thought this acne potion might clear up your spots.
translation: 我认为这种痤疮药水可以清除你的斑点。 [wo ren wei zhe zhong cuo chuang yao shui ke yi qing chu ni de ban dian 。]

english: All that you'll achieve by pouring that potion on me is to ruin my lovely robes.
translation: 你把那药水倒在我身上只会毁掉我可爱的长袍。 [ni ba na yao shui dao zai wo shen shang zhi hui hui diao wo ke ai de chang pao 。]

english: Sorry, I was just trying to help.
translation: 抱歉，我只是想帮忙。 [bao qian ， wo zhi shi xiang bang mang 。]

english: What do you know about the necropolis to the south?
translation: 你对南边的墓地了解多少？ [ni dui nan bian de mu di liao jie duo shao ？]

english: Good day.
translation: 再会。 [zai hui 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: It's going to take a lot of work to fix the damage done to this city.
translation: 要修复对这座城市造成的损害需要做大量的工作。 [yao xiu fu dui zhe zuo cheng shi zao cheng de sun hai xu yao zuo da liang de gong zuo 。]

english: You left the shrine. Did Zulrah reject your sacrifice?
translation: 你离开了神社。祖拉拒绝了你的牺牲吗？ [ni li kai le shen she 。 zu la ju jue le ni de xi sheng ma ？]

english: I killed Zulrah.
translation: 我杀了祖拉。 [wo sha le zu la 。]

english: Is that what you think? Board the boat again, and I am sure you will find Zulrah has overcome whatever pitiful attacks you used against him.
translation: 你是这么想的吗？再次登上船，我相信你会发现祖拉已经克服了你对他使用的任何可怜的攻击。 [ni shi zhe me xiang de ma ？ zai ci deng shang chuan ， wo xiang xin ni hui fa xian zu la yi jing ke fu le ni dui ta shi yong de ren he ke lian de gong ji 。]

english: Remind me how this ritual works.
translation: 提醒我这个仪式是如何进行的。 [ti xing wo zhe ge yi shi shi ru he jin xing de 。]

english: Once I have brought you to the shrine, I will leave you there as an offering to Zulrah. You cannot use the boat to return.
translation: 一旦我把你带到神殿，我就会把你留在那里作为祖拉的祭品。您不能乘船返回。 [yi dan wo ba ni dai dao shen dian ， wo jiu hui ba ni liu zai na li zuo wei zu la de ji pin 。 nin bu neng cheng chuan fan hui 。]

english: You can use your magical powers to flee from Zulrah's grasp, though that would defeat the point of the sacrifice, and you'll have to try again.
translation: 你可以使用你的魔法力量逃离祖拉的掌控，尽管这会破坏牺牲的意义，你必须再试一次。 [ni ke yi shi yong ni de mo fa li liang tao li zu la de zhang kong ， jin guan zhe hui po huai xi sheng de yi yi ， ni bi xu zai shi yi ci 。]

english: When Zulrah inevitably kills you, I may be able to retrieve your dropped possessions. If so, I will hold them here.
translation: 当祖拉不可避免地杀死你时，我也许能找回你掉落的物品。如果是这样，我会把他们留在这里。 [dang zu la bu ke bi mian di sha si ni shi ， wo ye xu neng zhao hui ni diao luo de wu pin 。 ru guo shi zhe yang ， wo hui ba ta men liu zai zhe li 。]

english: Now board the boat and prepare to be sacrificed.
translation: 现在登船，准备牺牲。 [xian zai deng chuan ， zhun bei xi sheng 。]

english: I'm off.
translation: 我走了。 [wo zou le 。]

english: Leave me, human, I have a sacrifice to prepare. If you wish for information, go and see the High Priestess.
translation: 离开我吧，人类，我要准备牺牲。如果你想了解更多信息，就去见大祭司吧。 [li kai wo ba ， ren lei ， wo yao zhun bei xi sheng 。 ru guo ni xiang liao jie geng duo xin xi ， jiu qu jian da ji si ba 。]

english: The sacrificial boat is not for you! Begone, and do not meddle in our sacred rites.
translation: 祭船不适合你！走开，不要干涉我们的神圣仪式。 [ji chuan bu shi he ni ！ zou kai ， bu yao gan she wo men de shen sheng yi shi 。]

english: But I really want to ride the boat!
translation: 但我真的很想坐船！ [dan wo zhen de hen xiang zuo chuan ！]

english: You display complete ignorance of our sacred rites. Perhaps the High Priestess will consent to enlighten you.
translation: 你对我们的神圣仪式表现出完全无知。也许女祭司会同意启发你。 [ni dui wo men de shen sheng yi shi biao xian chu wan quan wu zhi 。 ye xu nv ji si hui tong yi qi fa ni 。]

english: The High Priestess said I could offer myself as a sacrifice to Zulrah.
translation: 高阶女祭司说我可以将自己作为祭品献给祖拉。 [gao jie nv ji si shuo wo ke yi jiang zi ji zuo wei ji pin xian gei zu la 。]

english: It is rare for a traveller to make such an offer! Very well, I shall explain the ritual to you...
translation: 旅行者提出这样的报价是很少见的！好吧，我来给你解释一下仪式…… [lv xing zhe ti chu zhe yang de bao jia shi hen shao jian de ！ hao ba ， wo lai gei ni jie shi yi xia yi shi ……]

english: Are you ready to face Zulrah?
translation: 你准备好面对祖拉了吗？ [ni zhun bei hao mian dui zu la le ma ？]

english: Yes, let's go.
translation: 是的，我们走吧。 [shi de ， wo men zou ba 。]

english: I shall now transport you to Zulrah's shrine and offer your life on behalf of our tribe.
translation: 我现在将把你送往祖拉的神殿，并代表我们部落献出你的生命。 [wo xian zai jiang ba ni song wang zu la de shen dian ， bing dai biao wo men bu luo xian chu ni de sheng ming 。]

english: No, I've changed my mind.
translation: 不，我改变主意了。 [bu ， wo gai bian zhu yi le 。]

english: I've been there, but I left.
translation: 我曾经去过那里，但我离开了。 [wo ceng jing qu guo na li ， dan wo li kai le 。]

english: Well, board the boat and let me take you there again quickly, before Zulrah becomes impatient!
translation: 好吧，上船吧，让我尽快带你再去那里，免得祖拉变得不耐烦！ [hao ba ， shang chuan ba ， rang wo jin kuai dai ni zai qu na li ， mian de zu la bian de bu nai fan ！]

english: I'm afraid I don't have anything for you to collect. If I had any of your items, but you died before collecting them from me, I'd lose them.
translation: 恐怕我没有什么可以让你收集的。如果我有你的任何物品，但你在从我这里收集它们之前就死了，我就会失去它们。 [kong pa wo mei you shen me ke yi rang ni shou ji de 。 ru guo wo you ni de ren he wu pin ， dan ni zai cong wo zhe li shou ji ta men zhi qian jiu si le ， wo jiu hui shi qu ta men 。]

english: You left some stuff at Zulrah's shrine when you left earlier. I've returned it to you now.
translation: 你早些时候离开时在祖拉神殿留下了一些东西。我现在已经还给你了。 [ni zao xie shi hou li kai shi zai zu la shen dian liu xia le yi xie dong xi 。 wo xian zai yi jing huan gei ni le 。]

english: You left some stuff at Zulrah's shrine when you left earlier. Clear some more inventory space and I'll give you the rest.
translation: 你早些时候离开时在祖拉神殿留下了一些东西。清理更多的库存空间，剩下的我会给你。 [ni zao xie shi hou li kai shi zai zu la shen dian liu xia le yi xie dong xi 。 qing li geng duo de ku cun kong jian ， sheng xia de wo hui gei ni 。]

english: You left some stuff at Zulrah's shrine when you left earlier. Clear some inventory space and I'll give it back.
translation: 你早些时候离开时在祖拉神殿留下了一些东西。清理一些库存空间，我会把它还给你。 [ni zao xie shi hou li kai shi zai zu la shen dian liu xia le yi xie dong xi 。 qing li yi xie ku cun kong jian ， wo hui ba ta huan gei ni 。]

english: You left some stuff at Zulrah's shrine when you left earlier. You'd better deal with it before returning.
translation: 你早些时候离开时在祖拉神殿留下了一些东西。你最好在回来之前处理一下。 [ni zao xie shi hou li kai shi zai zu la shen dian liu xia le yi xie dong xi 。 ni zui hao zai hui lai zhi qian chu li yi xia 。]

english: I killed Zulrah.
translation: 我杀了祖拉。 [wo sha le zu la 。]

english: Remind me how this ritual works.
translation: 提醒我这个仪式是如何进行的。 [ti xing wo zhe ge yi shi shi ru he jin xing de 。]

english: I'm off.
translation: 我走了。 [wo zou le 。]

english: But I really want to ride the boat!
translation: 但我真的很想坐船！ [dan wo zhen de hen xiang zuo chuan ！]

english: Yes, let's go.
translation: 是的，我们走吧。 [shi de ， wo men zou ba 。]

english: No, I've changed my mind.
translation: 不，我改变主意了。 [bu ， wo gai bian zhu yi le 。]

english: I've been there, but I left.
translation: 我曾经去过那里，但我离开了。 [wo ceng jing qu guo na li ， dan wo li kai le 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello. Interested in learning about some potions?
translation: 你好。有兴趣了解一些药剂吗？ [ni hao 。 you xing qu liao jie yi xie yao ji ma ？]

english: Hello. Need anything?
translation: 你好。需要什么东西吗？ [ni hao 。 xu yao shen me dong xi ma ？]

english: Let's trade.
translation: 我们来交易吧。 [wo men lai jiao yi ba 。]

english: What kind of potions?
translation: 什么样的药水？ [shen me yang de yao shui ？]

english: Here's one I think you'll like. I found this recipe whilst exploring some old frozen ruins.
translation: 这是我想你会喜欢的。我在探索一些古老的冰冻废墟时发现了这个食谱。 [zhe shi wo xiang ni hui xi huan de 。 wo zai tan suo yi xie gu lao de bing dong fei xu shi fa xian le zhe ge shi pu 。]

english: The herbalist teaches you how to make Super antifire potions.
translation: 草药师教你如何制作超级抗火药水。 [cao yao shi jiao ni ru he zhi zuo chao ji kang huo yao shui 。]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: Don't mention it. Would you like to buy any herblore supplies?
translation: 别提了。您想购买 herblore 用品吗？ [bie ti le 。 nin xiang gou mai  herblore  yong pin ma ？]

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Here, solve this.
translation: 来，解决这个问题。 [lai ， jie jue zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Primula hands you a [light/puzzle] box!
translation: 报春花递给你一个【灯光/拼图】盒子！ [bao chun hua di gei ni yi ge 【 deng guang / pin tu 】 he zi ！]

english: That doesn't look solved to me.
translation: 在我看来这并没有解决。 [zai wo kan lai zhe bing mei you jie jue 。]

english: Well done [player name]. Here you go.
translation: 干得好[玩家姓名]。干得好。 [gan de hao [ wan jia xing ming ]。 gan de hao 。]

english: You've obtained a [new clue/casket]!
translation: 你获得了[新线索/棺材]！ [ni huo de le [ xin xian suo / guan cai ]！]

english: Let's trade.
translation: 我们来交易吧。 [wo men lai jiao yi ba 。]

english: What kind of potions?
translation: 什么样的药水？ [shen me yang de yao shui ？]

english: Yes please.

english: Evil Bob doesn't care about people's rights. He's cruel and utterly merciless. He's a cat.
translation: 邪恶的鲍勃并不关心人们的权利。他很残忍，而且完全无情。他是一只猫。 [xie e de bao bo bing bu guan xin ren men de quan li 。 ta hen can ren ， er qie wan quan wu qing 。 ta shi yi zhi mao 。]

english: No thanks, I don't want that just now.
translation: 不，谢谢，我现在不想这样。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo xian zai bu xiang zhe yang 。]

english: That's right, pull it. Then remember what kind of animal shape you see. That's the animal that contains the right key.
translation: 没错，就是拉。然后记住你看到的是哪种动物形状。那就是包含正确钥匙的动物。 [mei cuo ， jiu shi la 。 ran hou ji zhu ni kan dao de shi na zhong dong wu xing zhuang 。 na jiu shi bao han zheng que yao shi de dong wu 。]

english: Great, now you've got a key! Bring it to me so I can try it on the doors.
translation: 太棒了，现在你已经拿到钥匙了！把它带给我，我可以在门上试试。 [tai bang le ， xian zai ni yi jing na dao yao shi le ！ ba ta dai gei wo ， wo ke yi zai men shang shi shi 。]

english: Ooh, thanks! I'll see if it's the right one...
translation: 哦，谢谢！我看看是不是合适的... [o ， xie xie ！ wo kan kan shi bu shi he shi de ...]

english: Aww, that was the wrong key! You must have popped the wrong sort of animal. Try the big lever again - it'll tell you which animal to pop.
translation: 哇哦，那是错误的钥匙！你一定是找错了动物种类。再次尝试大杠杆 - 它会告诉您要弹出哪只动物。 [wa o ， na shi cuo wu de yao shi ！ ni yi ding shi zhao cuo le dong wu zhong lei 。 zai ci chang shi da gang gan  -  ta hui gao su nin yao dan chu na zhi dong wu 。]

english: Hooray, you got the right one! Now pull the lever again and let's get the next portal unlocked!
translation: 万岁，你选对了！现在再次拉动控制杆，让我们解锁下一个传送门！ [wan sui ， ni xuan dui le ！ xian zai zai ci la dong kong zhi gan ， rang wo men jie suo xia yi ge chuan song men ！]

english: You did it, you got all the keys right! Thank you! You're my friend FOREVER!
translation: 你做到了，所有的钥匙都对了！谢谢你！你永远是我的朋友！ [ni zuo dao le ， suo you de yao shi dou dui le ！ xie xie ni ！ ni yong yuan shi wo de peng you ！]

english: Let's get out of here before that cat notices.
translation: 我们趁猫发现之前离开这里吧。 [wo men chen mao fa xian zhi qian li kai zhe li ba 。]

english: Oi! we'll be using the exit that's over here.
translation: 哎呀！我们将使用这里的出口。 [ai ya ！ wo men jiang shi yong zhe li de chu kou 。]

english: Oi! No dropping stuff in the exit! Chuck it somewhere else!
translation: 哎呀！出口处严禁掉落物品！扔到别的地方去吧！ [ai ya ！ chu kou chu yan jin diao luo wu pin ！ reng dao bie de di fang qu ba ！]

english: You quickly escape the prison with Pete.
translation: 你和皮特很快逃离了监狱。 [ni he pi te hen kuai tao li le jian yu 。]

english: Thanks a lot for your help! Here, have a present:
translation: 非常感谢您的帮助！在这里，有一份礼物： [fei chang gan xie nin de bang zhu ！ zai zhe li ， you yi fen li wu ：]

english: Thanks! See you around!
translation: 谢谢！再见！ [xie xie ！ zai jian ！]

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。 [hao de 。]

english: But I want to leave now.
translation: 但我现在想离开。 [dan wo xian zai xiang li kai 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: How do I get out of here?
translation: 我怎样才能离开这里？ [wo zen yang cai neng li kai zhe li ？]

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好呀！ [ni hao ya ！]

english: How are you doing in there?
translation: 你在那里过得怎么样？ [ni zai na li guo de zen me yang ？]

english: Oh I'm great. Lord Jovkai takes good care of us.
translation: 哦，我很棒。乔夫凯勋爵把我们照顾得很好。 [o ， wo hen bang 。 qiao fu kai xun jue ba wo men zhao gu de hen hao 。]

english: So you don't want to escape?
translation: 所以你不想逃？ [suo yi ni bu xiang tao ？]

english: Why would I want to do that? I'm very happy as I am.
translation: 我为什么要这么做？我很高兴，因为我是这样的。 [wo wei shen me yao zhe me zuo ？ wo hen gao xing ， yin wei wo shi zhe yang de 。]

english: If you say so.
translation: 如果你这么说的话。 [ru guo ni zhe me shuo de hua 。]

english: Hi, soldier.
translation: 嗨，士兵。 [hai ， shi bing 。]

english: Why, hello there!
translation: 为什么，你好！ [wei shen me ， ni hao ！]

english: You seem like a jolly chap.
translation: 你看起来像个快乐的小伙子。 [ni kan qi lai xiang ge kuai le de xiao huo zi 。]

english: And why not? 'Tis a greeeaat day!
translation: 为什么不呢？这真是美好的一天！ [wei shen me bu ne ？ zhe zhen shi mei hao de yi tian ！]

english: Well, I suppose it is.
translation: 嗯，我想是的。 [n ， wo xiang shi de 。]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Shhh. Don't talk to me.
translation: 嘘。别跟我说话。 [xu 。 bie gen wo shuo hua 。]

english: What? Why?
translation: 什么？为什么？ [shen me ？ wei shen me ？]

english: If I'm seen slacking off by talking to you, I'll be in deep trouble!
translation: 要是被人看见我偷懒跟你说话的话，我可就麻烦大了！ [yao shi bei ren kan jian wo tou lan gen ni shuo hua de hua ， wo ke jiu ma fan da le ！]

english: Oh... Sorry.
translation: 哦...抱歉。 [o ... bao qian 。]

english: Hi there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Don't suppose you've seen a battleaxe around here?
translation: 你不认为你在这里见过战斧吗？ [ni bu ren wei ni zai zhe li jian guo zhan fu ma ？]

english: A battleaxe? Nope, afraid not.
translation: 战斧？不，恐怕不会。 [zhan fu ？ bu ， kong pa bu hui 。]

english: The captain is going to kill me if he finds out I've lost my weapon.
translation: 如果队长发现我丢了武器，他会杀了我的。 [ru guo dui zhang fa xian wo diu le wu qi ， ta hui sha le wo de 。]

english: Hello. So you're just a private?
translation: 你好。所以你只是个私人？ [ni hao 。 suo yi ni zhi shi ge si ren ？]

english: Show some respect! It's more than you'll achieve.
translation: 表现出一些尊重！这超出了您所能实现的目标。 [biao xian chu yi xie zun zhong ！ zhe chao chu le nin suo neng shi xian de mu biao 。]

english: I beg to differ. I'm in perfect shape!
translation: 我不敢苟同。我的身材很完美！ [wo bu gan gou tong 。 wo de shen cai hen wan mei ！]

english: Prove it!
translation: 证明一下！ [zheng ming yi xia ！]

english: How?
translation: 如何？ [ru he ？]

english: Give me five star-jumps!
translation: 给我五次星跳！ [gei wo wu ci xing tiao ！]

english: The player begins to do star-jumps
translation: 玩家开始进行星跳 [wan jia kai shi jin xing xing tiao]

english: Five sit-ups.
translation: 五次仰卧起坐。 [wu ci yang wo qi zuo 。]

english: The player begins to do sit-ups
translation: 选手开始做仰卧起坐 [xuan shou kai shi zuo yang wo qi zuo]

english: Run on the spot!
translation: 原地奔跑！ [yuan di ben pao ！]

english: The player begins to run in place
translation: 玩家开始原地奔跑 [wan jia kai shi yuan di ben pao]

english: Okay. Maybe you have what it takes. Best you speak with the captain.
translation: 好的。也许你拥有所需的一切。最好和船长谈谈。 [hao de 。 ye xu ni yong you suo xu de yi qie 。 zui hao he chuan zhang tan tan 。]

english: Welcome to the pet insurance bureau. How can I help you?
translation: 欢迎来到宠物保险局。我怎么帮你？ [huan ying lai dao chong wu bao xian ju 。 wo zen me bang ni ？]

english: Can you tell me about pets and pet insurance?
translation: 您能告诉我有关宠物和宠物保险的信息吗？ [nin neng gao su wo you guan chong wu he chong wu bao xian de xin xi ma ？]

english: Certainly! You can find pets while out on your adventures. They're very rare, but you may be lucky enough to find one.
translation: 当然！您可以在外出冒险时寻找宠物。它们非常罕见，但您可能很幸运能找到一个。 [dang ran ！ nin ke yi zai wai chu mao xian shi xun zhao chong wu 。 ta men fei chang han jian ， dan nin ke neng hen xing yun neng zhao dao yi ge 。]

english: You have a chance to find them when defeating bosses, playing minigames, and taking part in skilling activities.
translation: 你在打败boss、玩小游戏、参加技能活动时都有机会找到它们。 [ni zai da bai boss、 wan xiao you xi 、 can jia ji neng huo dong shi dou you ji hui zhao dao ta men 。]

english: If you do find one, they will be automatically insured against loss, for free!
translation: 如果您确实找到了，它们将自动获得免费损失保险！ [ru guo nin que shi zhao dao le ， ta men jiang zi dong huo de mian fei sun shi bao xian ！]

english: If you then somehow lose your pet, you can reclaim it here for one reclaim token. Reclaim tokens cost 1,000,000 coins each.
translation: 如果您不知何故失去了您的宠物，您可以在这里花费一个回收令牌来回收它。每个回收代币需要花费 1,000,000 个硬币。 [ru guo nin bu zhi he gu shi qu le nin de chong wu ， nin ke yi zai zhe li hua fei yi ge hui shou ling pai lai hui shou ta 。 mei ge hui shou dai bi xu yao hua fei  1,000,000  ge ying bi 。]

english: I see, thank you.
translation: 我明白了，谢谢。 [wo ming bai le ， xie xie 。]

english: I've lost a pet. Have you got it?
translation: 我失去了一只宠物。你收到了吗？ [wo shi qu le yi zhi chong wu 。 ni shou dao le ma ？]

english: If you've lost your pet, it will be reclaimable here!
translation: 如果您丢失了宠物，可以在这里取回！ [ru guo nin diu shi le chong wu ， ke yi zai zhe li qu hui ！]

english: Let's have a look...
translation: 我们来看看... [wo men lai kan kan ...]

english: I have a pet that I'd like to insure.
translation: 我有一只宠物，我想为它投保。 [wo you yi zhi chong wu ， wo xiang wei ta tou bao 。]

english: You don't need to pay to insure your pet with me. They're automatically insured for free as soon as you find them!
translation: 您无需付费为您的宠物投保。一旦您找到它们，它们就会自动免费投保！ [nin wu xu fu fei wei nin de chong wu tou bao 。 yi dan nin zhao dao ta men ， ta men jiu hui zi dong mian fei tou bao ！]

english: If you lose a pet somehow, you can come here and reclaim them for one reclaim token. Reclaims tokens cost 1,000,000 coins each.
translation: 如果你不知何故失去了宠物，你可以来这里用一个回收令牌来回收它们。每个回收代币需要花费 1,000,000 个硬币。 [ru guo ni bu zhi he gu shi qu le chong wu ， ni ke yi lai zhe li yong yi ge hui shou ling pai lai hui shou ta men 。 mei ge hui shou dai bi xu yao hua fei  1,000,000  ge ying bi 。]

english: What pets have I insured?
translation: 我为哪些宠物投保？ [wo wei na xie chong wu tou bao ？]

english: Every pet you've ever found is automatically insured here!
translation: 您发现的每只宠物都会在这里自动投保！ [nin fa xian de mei zhi chong wu du hui zai zhe li zi dong tou bao ！]

english: Here, take a look...
translation: 在这里，看看... [zai zhe li ， kan kan ...]

english: Maybe another time.
translation: 也许下次吧。 [ye xu xia ci ba 。]

english: This is a pet insurance bureau. I'm not insuring that.
translation: 这是宠物保险局。我不保证这一点。 [zhe shi chong wu bao xian ju 。 wo bu bao zheng zhe yi dian 。]

english: Can you tell me about pets and pet insurance?
translation: 您能告诉我有关宠物和宠物保险的信息吗？ [nin neng gao su wo you guan chong wu he chong wu bao xian de xin xi ma ？]

english: I've lost a pet. Have you got it?
translation: 我失去了一只宠物。你收到了吗？ [wo shi qu le yi zhi chong wu 。 ni shou dao le ma ？]

english: I have a pet that I'd like to insure.
translation: 我有一只宠物，我想为它投保。 [wo you yi zhi chong wu ， wo xiang wei ta tou bao 。]

english: What pets have I insured?
translation: 我为哪些宠物投保？ [wo wei na xie chong wu tou bao ？]

english: Maybe another time.
translation: 也许下次吧。 [ye xu xia ci ba 。]

english: I didn't realise gnomes were interested in magic.
translation: 我没有意识到侏儒对魔法感兴趣。 [wo mei you yi shi dao zhu ru dui mo fa gan xing qu 。]

english: Gnomes are interested in everything, [lad/lass].
translation: 侏儒对一切都感兴趣，[小伙子/姑娘]。 [zhu ru dui yi qie dou gan xing qu ，[ xiao huo zi / gu niang ]。]

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: We have a saying, 'Curiosity killed the cat'. But cats aren't clever enough to understand what they find. Gnomes are.
translation: 我们有句话说：“好奇心害死猫”。但猫不够聪明，无法理解它们发现的东西。侏儒是。 [wo men you ju hua shuo ：“ hao qi xin hai si mao ”。 dan mao bu gou cong ming ， wu fa li jie ta men fa xian de dong xi 。 zhu ru shi 。]

english: Hey! Some of my best friends are cats!
translation: 嘿！我最好的一些朋友是猫！ [hei ！ wo zui hao de yi xie peng you shi mao ！]

english: I think that says more about you than cats.
translation: 我认为这比猫更能说明你的情况。 [wo ren wei zhe bi mao geng neng shuo ming ni de qing kuang 。]

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 尽管您找到了顾客，但您似乎没有带来正确的食物！你需要[一个/一些][订购的侏儒食物/饮料]！ [jin guan nin zhao dao le gu ke ， dan nin si hu mei you dai lai zheng que de shi wu ！ ni xu yao [ yi ge / yi xie ][ ding gou de zhu ru shi wu / yin liao ]！]

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜肴不行。对于 Aluft Aloft 的顾客来说，只有手工制作的 Gnome Cuisine 才足够好。 [kong pa yu zhi cai yao bu xing 。 dui yu  Aluft Aloft  de gu ke lai shuo ， zhi you shou gong zhi zuo de  Gnome Cuisine  cai zu gou hao 。]

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Professor Imblewyn
translation: 你将[一些][订购的侏儒食物/饮料]交给Imblewyn教授 [ni jiang [ yi xie ][ ding gou de zhu ru shi wu / yin liao ] jiao gei Imblewyn jiao shou]

english: Hmmm, I wonder... Oh. My order. Thank you - mind you don't get any food or drink on the books.
translation: 嗯，我想知道...哦。我的订单。谢谢你——请注意，你的书上没有任何食物或饮料。 [n ， wo xiang zhi dao ... o 。 wo de ding dan 。 xie xie ni —— qing zhu yi ， ni de shu shang mei you ren he shi wu huo yin liao 。]

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 你一定是走了很远的路才把这个交给我的。这里有一些额外的东西作为提示。 [ni yi ding shi zou le hen yuan de lu cai ba zhe ge jiao gei wo de 。 zhe li you yi xie e wai de dong xi zuo wei ti shi 。]

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 您有 [number] 个积分用于免费送货令牌。您还没有资格获得侏儒食物。 [nin you  [number]  ge ji fen yong yu mian fei song huo ling pai 。 nin hai mei you zi ge huo de zhu ru shi wu 。]

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 您有 [number] 个积分用于免费送货令牌。您可能会收到 [number] 块侏儒食物。 [nin you  [number]  ge ji fen yong yu mian fei song huo ling pai 。 nin ke neng hui shou dao  [number]  kuai zhu ru shi wu 。]

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 不要忘记从 Aluft Gianne jnr 领取免费送货代币。 [bu yao wang ji cong  Aluft Gianne jnr  ling qu mian fei song huo dai bi 。]

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 你的交货太晚了！返回 Aluft jnr。以获得另一个订单。您丢弃了送货箱，因为您不再需要它了。 [ni de jiao huo tai wan le ！ fan hui  Aluft jnr。 yi huo de ling yi ge ding dan 。 nin diu qi le song huo xiang ， yin wei nin bu zai xu yao ta le 。]

english: Fascinating, fascinating. It's remarkable what these young dwarves have managed to create. Oh, hello young [man/woman].
translation: 令人着迷，令人着迷。这些年轻矮人所创造的成就是非凡的。哦，你好，年轻人[男/女]。 [ling ren zhao mi ， ling ren zhao mi 。 zhe xie nian qing ai ren suo chuang zao de cheng jiu shi fei fan de 。 o ， ni hao ， nian qing ren [ nan / nv ]。]

english: Hello, what's a gnome like you doing in a place like this?
translation: 你好，像你这样的侏儒在这种地方做什么？ [ni hao ， xiang ni zhe yang de zhu ru zai zhe zhong di fang zuo shen me ？]

english: Ah, well I have been sent by King to talk with the dwarves here and find out more about their recent advances in technology.
translation: 啊，好吧，国王派我来和这里的矮人交谈，了解他们最近的技术进步。 [a ， hao ba ， guo wang pai wo lai he zhe li de ai ren jiao tan ， liao jie ta men zui jin de ji shu jin bu 。]

english: Found anything interesting?
translation: 发现什么有趣的事情了吗？ [fa xian shen me you qu de shi qing le ma ？]

english: The rideable carts are a very handy way to get to mining sites, and the Blast Furnace is a magnificent beast of a machine.
translation: 可乘坐的手推车是前往矿场的一种非常便捷的方式，而高炉则是一头宏伟的机器野兽。 [ke cheng zuo de shou tui che shi qian wang kuang chang de yi zhong fei chang bian jie de fang shi ， er gao lu ze shi yi tou hong wei de ji qi ye shou 。]

english: I'll have a look, thanks.
translation: 我去看看，谢谢。 [wo qu kan kan ， xie xie 。]

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food item] to Professor Manglethorp.
translation: 你将[一些][订购的侏儒食品]交给Manglethorp教授。 [ni jiang [ yi xie ][ ding gou de zhu ru shi pin ] jiao gei Manglethorp jiao shou 。]

english: Just what I need. Dwarven cuisine is a bit ... solid for my tastes.
translation: 正是我所需要的。矮人的美食有点……不合我的口味。 [zheng shi wo suo xu yao de 。 ai ren de mei shi you dian …… bu he wo de kou wei 。]

english: Here, take these Grand Seed pods. Very useful in emergencies!
translation: 来，拿走这些大种子荚。在紧急情况下非常有用！ [lai ， na zou zhe xie da zhong zi jia 。 zai jin ji qing kuang xia fei chang you yong ！]

english: Here have this, I traded for it with some of the dwarves.
translation: 这是我和一些矮人交换来的。 [zhe shi wo he yi xie ai ren jiao huan lai de 。]

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 你一定是走了很远的路才把这个交给我的。这里有一些额外的东西作为提示。 [ni yi ding shi zou le hen yuan de lu cai ba zhe ge jiao gei wo de 。 zhe li you yi xie e wai de dong xi zuo wei ti shi 。]

english: You are given [a/some] [reward item(s)] as a tip.
translation: 您将获得[一个/一些][奖励物品]作为小费。 [nin jiang huo de [ yi ge / yi xie ][ jiang li wu pin ] zuo wei xiao fei 。]

english: Be careful in here, there's lots of dangerous equipment.
translation: 这里有很多危险设备，请小心。 [zhe li you hen duo wei xian she bei ， qing xiao xin 。]

english: What does this machine do?
translation: 这台机器有什么作用？ [zhe tai ji qi you shen me zuo yong ？]

english: Nothing at the moment... It's broken. It's meant to be a transmutation machine.
translation: 目前什么都没有……它坏了。它应该是一个嬗变机器。 [mu qian shen me dou mei you …… ta huai le 。 ta ying gai shi yi ge shan bian ji qi 。]

english: It has also spent time as a time travel machine, and a dramatic lightning generator, and a thing for generating monsters.
translation: 它也曾被用作时间旅行机器、戏剧性的闪电发生器和生成怪物的东西。 [ta ye ceng bei yong zuo shi jian lv xing ji qi 、 xi ju xing de shan dian fa sheng qi he sheng cheng guai wu de dong xi 。]

english: Is this your house?
translation: 这是你的家吗？ [zhe shi ni de jia ma ？]

english: No, I'm just one of the tenants. It belongs to the count who lives in the basement.
translation: 不，我只是租户之一。它属于住在地下室的伯爵。 [bu ， wo zhi shi zu hu zhi yi 。 ta shu yu zhu zai di xia shi de bo jue 。]

english: I'm looking for a guy called Ernest.
translation: 我在找一个叫欧内斯特的人。 [wo zai zhao yi ge jiao ou nei si te de ren 。]

english: Ah Ernest, top notch bloke. He's helping me with my experiments.
translation: 啊，欧内斯特，一流的家伙。他正在帮助我做实验。 [a ， ou nei si te ， yi liu de jia huo 。 ta zheng zai bang zhu wo zuo shi yan 。]

english: So you know where he is then?
translation: 那么你知道他在哪里吗？ [na me ni zhi dao ta zai na li ma ？]

english: He's that chicken over there.
translation: 他就是那边的那只鸡。 [ta jiu shi na bian de na zhi ji 。]

english: Ernest is a chicken...? Are you sure?
translation: 欧内斯特是只鸡……？你确定吗？ [ou nei si te shi zhi ji ……？ ni que ding ma ？]

english: Oh, he isn't normally a chicken, or at least he wasn't until he helped me test my pouletmorph machine.
translation: 哦，他通常不是一只鸡，或者至少在他帮我测试我的 pouletmorph 机器之前他不是。 [o ， ta tong chang bu shi yi zhi ji ， huo zhe zhi shao zai ta bang wo ce shi wo de  pouletmorph  ji qi zhi qian ta bu shi 。]

english: It was originally going to be called a transmutation machine. But after testing pouletmorph seems more appropriate.
translation: 它最初被称为嬗变机器。但经过测试，pouletmorph似乎更合适。 [ta zui chu bei cheng wei shan bian ji qi 。 dan jing guo ce shi ，pouletmorph si hu geng he shi 。]

english: I'm glad Veronica didn't actually get engaged to a chicken.
translation: 我很高兴维罗妮卡实际上没有和一只鸡订婚。 [wo hen gao xing wei luo ni ka shi ji shang mei you he yi zhi ji ding hun 。]

english: Who's Veronica?
translation: 维罗妮卡是谁？ [wei luo ni ka shi shui ？]

english: Ernest's fiancee. She probably doesn't want to marry a chicken.
translation: 欧内斯特的未婚妻。她可能不想嫁给一只鸡。 [ou nei si te de wei hun qi 。 ta ke neng bu xiang jia gei yi zhi ji 。]

english: Ooh I dunno. She could have free eggs for breakfast.
translation: 哦，我不知道。她早餐可以吃免费的鸡蛋。 [o ， wo bu zhi dao 。 ta zao can ke yi chi mian fei de ji dan 。]

english: I think you'd better change him back.
translation: 我认为你最好把他改回来。 [wo ren wei ni zui hao ba ta gai hui lai 。]

english: Umm... It's not so easy...
translation: 嗯……没那么容易…… [n …… mei na me rong yi ……]

english: My machine is broken, and the house gremlins have run off with some vital bits.
translation: 我的机器坏了，家里的小妖精带着一些重要的碎片跑了。 [wo de ji qi huai le ， jia li de xiao yao jing dai zhe yi xie zhong yao de sui pian pao le 。]

english: Well I can look for them.
translation: 嗯，我可以去找他们。 [n ， wo ke yi qu zhao ta men 。]

english: That would be a help. They'll be somewhere in the manor house or its grounds, the gremlins never get further than the entrance gate.
translation: 那会有所帮助。它们会出现在庄园或其庭院的某个地方，小妖精永远不会超出入口大门。 [na hui you suo bang zhu 。 ta men hui chu xian zai zhuang yuan huo qi ting yuan de mou ge di fang ， xiao yao jing yong yuan bu hui chao chu ru kou da men 。]

english: I'm missing the pressure gauge and a rubber tube. They've also taken my oil can, which I'm going to need to get this thing started again.
translation: 我缺少压力表和橡胶管。他们还拿走了我的油罐，我需要它才能让这件事重新开始。 [wo que shao ya li biao he xiang jiao guan 。 ta men hai na zou le wo de you guan ， wo xu yao ta cai neng rang zhe jian shi chong xin kai shi 。]

english: Change him back this instant!
translation: 立刻把他变回来！ [li ke ba ta bian hui lai ！]

english: Have you found anything yet?
translation: 你有发现什么吗？ [ni you fa xian shen me ma ？]

english: I'm afraid I don't have any of them yet!
translation: 恐怕我还没有！ [kong pa wo hai mei you ！]

english: I need a rubber tube, a pressure gauge and a can of oil. Then your friend can stop being a chicken.
translation: 我需要一根橡皮管、一个压力表和一罐油。那么你的朋友就可以不再是一只鸡了。 [wo xu yao yi gen xiang pi guan 、 yi ge ya li biao he yi guan you 。 na me ni de peng you jiu ke yi bu zai shi yi zhi ji le 。]

english: I've only got the rubber tube so far.
translation: 到目前为止我只拿到了橡胶管。 [dao mu qian wei zhi wo zhi na dao le xiang jiao guan 。]

english: It's a good start, but I'll need my pressure gauge and oil can too.
translation: 这是一个好的开始，但我还需要压力表和油罐。 [zhe shi yi ge hao de kai shi ， dan wo hai xu yao ya li biao he you guan 。]

english: Ok, I'll go and look for them.
translation: 好吧，我这就去找他们。 [hao ba ， wo zhe jiu qu zhao ta men 。]

english: I've only got the pressure gauge so far.
translation: 到目前为止我只拿到了压力表。 [dao mu qian wei zhi wo zhi na dao le ya li biao 。]

english: It's a good start, but I'll need my oil can and rubber tube too.
translation: 这是一个好的开始，但我还需要我的油罐和橡胶管。 [zhe shi yi ge hao de kai shi ， dan wo hai xu yao wo de you guan he xiang jiao guan 。]

english: I've only got the oil can so far.
translation: 我目前只拿到了油罐。 [wo mu qian zhi na dao le you guan 。]

english: It's a good start, but I'll need my pressure gauge and rubber tube too.
translation: 这是一个好的开始，但我还需要压力表和橡胶管。 [zhe shi yi ge hao de kai shi ， dan wo hai xu yao ya li biao he xiang jiao guan 。]

english: I've got the rubber tube and the pressure gauge.
translation: 我有橡胶管和压力表。 [wo you xiang jiao guan he ya li biao 。]

english: That's good, but I still need my oil can.
translation: 很好，但我还需要我的油罐。 [hen hao ， dan wo hai xu yao wo de you guan 。]

english: Ok, I'll go and look for it.
translation: 好的，我这就去找找。 [hao de ， wo zhe jiu qu zhao zhao 。]

english: I've got the oil can and the rubber tube.
translation: 我有油罐和橡胶管。 [wo you you guan he xiang jiao guan 。]

english: That's good, but I still need my pressure gauge.
translation: 很好，但我仍然需要压力表。 [hen hao ， dan wo reng ran xu yao ya li biao 。]

english: I've got the oil can and the pressure gauge.
translation: 我有油罐和压力表。 [wo you you guan he ya li biao 。]

english: That's good, but I still need my rubber tube.
translation: 很好，但我还需要我的橡皮管。 [hen hao ， dan wo hai xu yao wo de xiang pi guan 。]

english: I have everything!
translation: 我什么都有了！ [wo shen me dou you le ！]

english: Give 'em here then.
translation: 那就把它们交给这里吧。 [na jiu ba ta men jiao gei zhe li ba 。]

english: You give the rubber tube, a pressure gauge, and a can of oil to the professor.
translation: 你把橡皮管、压力表和一罐油交给教授。 [ni ba xiang pi guan 、 ya li biao he yi guan you jiao gei jiao shou 。]

english: Oddenstein starts up the machine.
translation: 奥登斯坦启动了机器。 [ao deng si tan qi dong le ji qi 。]

english: The machine hums and shakes.
translation: 机器发出嗡嗡声并摇晃。 [ji qi fa chu weng weng sheng bing yao huang 。]

english: Machine pouletmorphs Ernest back to human form!
translation: 机器小鸡将欧内斯特变回人类形态！ [ji qi xiao ji jiang ou nei si te bian hui ren lei xing tai ！]

english: What does the portal machine do?
translation: 门机有什么作用？ [men ji you shen me zuo yong ？]

english: Ah, an interesting question! I believe it should create a rift in the very fabric of space! Opening a portal to some, hitherto undiscovered plane that exists parallel to our own.
translation: 啊，一个有趣的问题！我相信它应该在太空结构中产生裂痕！打开通往某个迄今为止尚未发现的与我们平行的位面的门户。 [a ， yi ge you qu de wen ti ！ wo xiang xin ta ying gai zai tai kong jie gou zhong chan sheng lie hen ！ da kai tong wang mou ge qi jin wei zhi shang wei fa xian de yu wo men ping xing de wei mian de men hu 。]

english: Huh?
It's a teleport machine.
translation: 这是一台传送机。 [zhe shi yi tai chuan song ji 。]

english: Errr, just before you go through there...
translation: 呃，就在你经过那里之前…… [e ， jiu zai ni jing guo na li zhi qian ……]

english: What's the problem?
translation: 有什么问题吗？ [you shen me wen ti ma ？]

english: That portal opens into a plane populated with some very shocking creatures. You should wear some kind of insulated armour before going there.
translation: 那个传送门通向一个位面，里面居住着一些非常令人震惊的生物。去那里之前你应该穿上某种绝缘盔甲。 [na ge chuan song men tong xiang yi ge wei mian ， li mian ju zhu zhe yi xie fei chang ling ren zhen jing de sheng wu 。 qu na li zhi qian ni ying gai chuan shang mou zhong jue yuan kui jia 。]

english: Where can I get insulated armour from?
translation: 我从哪里可以获得绝缘装甲？ [wo cong na li ke yi huo de jue yuan zhuang jia ？]

english: Well there were some pretty tough people here last week. Said they were Slayer Masters. They were planning on making some protective boots. You should speak to one of them.
translation: 上周这里有一些非常强硬的人。说他们是杀戮大师。他们计划制作一些防护靴。你应该和其中一位谈谈。 [shang zhou zhe li you yi xie fei chang qiang ying de ren 。 shuo ta men shi sha lu da shi 。 ta men ji hua zhi zuo yi xie fang hu xue 。 ni ying gai he qi zhong yi wei tan tan 。]

english: Thanks, I'll do that.
translation: 谢谢，我会这么做的。 [xie xie ， wo hui zhe me zuo de 。]

english: No problem. See you later.
translation: 没问题。稍后见。 [mei wen ti 。 shao hou jian 。]

english: I don't want to run around after Slayer Masters, I'm going through.
translation: 我不想在杀戮大师之后到处乱跑，我正在经历。 [wo bu xiang zai sha lu da shi zhi hou dao chu luan pao ， wo zheng zai jing li 。]

english: Fair enough, just don't say I didn't warn you
translation: 很公平，只是别说我没有警告你 [hen gong ping ， zhi shi bie shuo wo mei you jing gao ni]

english: Thanks, I think I'll stay here for a while then.
translation: 谢谢，我想我会在这里呆一段时间。 [xie xie ， wo xiang wo hui zai zhe li dai yi duan shi jian 。]

english: Thanks for the warning, but I'm not scared of any monster.
translation: 谢谢你的警告，但我并不害怕任何怪物。 [xie xie ni de jing gao ， dan wo bing bu hai pa ren he guai wu 。]

english: Ok. Just don't say I didn't warn you
translation: 好的。只是别说我没有警告过你 [hao de 。 zhi shi bie shuo wo mei you jing gao guo ni]

english: [Player name] before you go through there I must warn you that there are flashing lights and strobe effects on the other side. If you are an epilepsy sufferer you must NOT enter! Do you still want to go through?
translation: [玩家姓名]在你经过那里之前我必须警告你，另一边有闪烁的灯光和频闪效果。如果您是癫痫患者，请勿进入！你还想经历吗？ [[ wan jia xing ming ] zai ni jing guo na li zhi qian wo bi xu jing gao ni ， ling yi bian you shan shuo de deng guang he pin shan xiao guo 。 ru guo nin shi dian xian huan zhe ， qing wu jin ru ！ ni hai xiang jing li ma ？]

english: Yes I still want to go in.
translation: 是的，我还想进去。 [shi de ， wo hai xiang jin qu 。]

english: All right. Good luck then.
translation: 好的。那么祝你好运。 [hao de 。 na me zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Yes I want to go in and don't show me this message again.
translation: 是的，我想进去，不要再给我显示这条消息。 [shi de ， wo xiang jin qu ， bu yao zai gei wo xian shi zhe tiao xiao xi 。]

english: No, I dont want to go in.
translation: 不，我不想进去。 [bu ， wo bu xiang jin qu 。]

english: That's a good decision, if you ask me.
translation: 如果你问我的话，这是一个很好的决定。 [ru guo ni wen wo de hua ， zhe shi yi ge hen hao de jue ding 。]

english: What does this machine do?
translation: 这台机器有什么作用？ [zhe tai ji qi you shen me zuo yong ？]

english: Is this your house?
translation: 这是你的家吗？ [zhe shi ni de jia ma ？]

english: I'm looking for a guy called Ernest.
translation: 我在找一个叫欧内斯特的人。 [wo zai zhao yi ge jiao ou nei si te de ren 。]
