english: I'm glad Veronica didn't actually get engaged to a chicken.
translation: 我很高兴维罗妮卡实际上没有和一只鸡订婚。 [wo hen gao xing wei luo ni ka shi ji shang mei you he yi zhi ji ding hun 。]

english: Change him back this instant!
translation: 立刻把他变回来！ [li ke ba ta bian hui lai ！]

english: What does the portal machine do?
translation: 门机有什么作用？ [men ji you shen me zuo yong ？]

english: Where can I get insulated armour from?
translation: 我从哪里可以获得绝缘装甲？ [wo cong na li ke yi huo de jue yuan zhuang jia ？]

english: Thanks, I'll do that.
translation: 谢谢，我会这么做的。 [xie xie ， wo hui zhe me zuo de 。]

english: I don't want to run around after Slayer Masters, I'm going through.
translation: 我不想在杀戮大师之后到处乱跑，我正在经历。 [wo bu xiang zai sha lu da shi zhi hou dao chu luan pao ， wo zheng zai jing li 。]

english: Thanks, I think I'll stay here for a while then.
translation: 谢谢，我想我会在这里呆一段时间。 [xie xie ， wo xiang wo hui zai zhe li dai yi duan shi jian 。]

english: Thanks for the warning, but I'm not scared of any monster.
translation: 谢谢你的警告，但我并不害怕任何怪物。 [xie xie ni de jing gao ， dan wo bing bu hai pa ren he guai wu 。]

english: Yes I still want to go in.
translation: 是的，我还想进去。 [shi de ， wo hai xiang jin qu 。]

english: Yes I want to go in and don't show me this message again.
translation: 是的，我想进去，不要再给我显示这条消息。 [shi de ， wo xiang jin qu ， bu yao zai gei wo xian shi zhe tiao xiao xi 。]

english: No, I dont want to go in.
translation: 不，我不想进去。 [bu ， wo bu xiang jin qu 。]

english: Do you live here too?
translation: 你也住在这里吗？ [ni ye zhu zai zhe li ma ？]

english: Oh no, I come from the Gnome Stronghold. I've been sent here by King Narnode to learn about human magics.
translation: 哦不，我来自侏儒要塞。我是被纳尔诺德国王派到这里来学习人类魔法的。 [o bu ， wo lai zi zhu ru yao sai 。 wo shi bei na er nuo de guo wang pai dao zhe li lai xue xi ren lei mo fa de 。]

english: So where's this Gnome Stronghold?
translation: 那么这个侏儒要塞在哪里呢？ [na me zhe ge zhu ru yao sai zai na li ne ？]

english: It's in the North West of the continent - a long way away. You should visit us there some time. The food's great, and the company's delightful.
translation: 它位于大陆的西北部——距离很远。你应该找个时间去那里拜访我们。食物很棒，公司也很令人愉快。 [ta wei yu da lu de xi bei bu —— ju li hen yuan 。 ni ying gai zhao ge shi jian qu na li bai fang wo men 。 shi wu hen bang ， gong si ye hen ling ren yu kuai 。]

english: I'll try and make time for it. Sounds like a nice place.
translation: 我会尽力腾出时间。听起来是个好地方。 [wo hui jin li teng chu shi jian 。 ting qi lai shi ge hao di fang 。]

english: Well, it's full of gnomes. How much nicer could it be?
translation: 嗯，里面全是侏儒。还能好多少呢？ [n ， li mian quan shi zhu ru 。 hai neng hao duo shao ne ？]

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 尽管您找到了顾客，但您似乎没有带来正确的食物！你需要[一个/一些][订购的侏儒食物/饮料]！ [jin guan nin zhao dao le gu ke ， dan nin si hu mei you dai lai zheng que de shi wu ！ ni xu yao [ yi ge / yi xie ][ ding gou de zhu ru shi wu / yin liao ]！]

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜肴不行。对于 Aluft Aloft 的顾客来说，只有手工制作的 Gnome Cuisine 才足够好。 [kong pa yu zhi cai yao bu xing 。 dui yu  Aluft Aloft  de gu ke lai shuo ， zhi you shou gong zhi zuo de  Gnome Cuisine  cai zu gou hao 。]

english: You hand over your delivery of [item] to Professor Onglewip
translation: 你将[物品]交给Onglewip教授 [ni jiang [ wu pin ] jiao gei Onglewip jiao shou]

english: Ah, now that's a familiar smell. Thank you.
translation: 啊，现在这是熟悉的气味。谢谢。 [a ， xian zai zhe shi shu xi de qi wei 。 xie xie 。]

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 你一定是走了很远的路才把这个交给我的。这里有一些额外的东西作为提示。 [ni yi ding shi zou le hen yuan de lu cai ba zhe ge jiao gei wo de 。 zhe li you yi xie e wai de dong xi zuo wei ti shi 。]

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 您有 [number] 个积分用于免费送货令牌。您还没有资格获得侏儒食物。 [nin you  [number]  ge ji fen yong yu mian fei song huo ling pai 。 nin hai mei you zi ge huo de zhu ru shi wu 。]

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 您有 [number] 个积分用于免费送货令牌。您可能会收到 [number] 块侏儒食物。 [nin you  [number]  ge ji fen yong yu mian fei song huo ling pai 。 nin ke neng hui shou dao  [number]  kuai zhu ru shi wu 。]

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 不要忘记从 Aluft Gianne jnr 领取免费送货代币。 [bu yao wang ji cong  Aluft Gianne jnr  ling qu mian fei song huo dai bi 。]

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 你的交货太晚了！返回 Aluft jnr。以获得另一个订单。您丢弃了送货箱，因为您不再需要它了。 [ni de jiao huo tai wan le ！ fan hui  Aluft jnr。 yi huo de ling yi ge ding dan 。 nin diu qi le song huo xiang ， yin wei nin bu zai xu yao ta le 。]

english: Git back ter work, ye young varmint! There's treasure in them walls, and it's not gonna mine itself while ye stand here yappin'.
translation: 回去工作吧，你们这些年轻的坏家伙！墙上有宝藏，当你们站在这里大喊大叫时，它不会自行开采。 [hui qu gong zuo ba ， ni men zhe xie nian qing de huai jia huo ！ qiang shang you bao zang ， dang ni men zhan zai zhe li da han da jiao shi ， ta bu hui zi xing kai cai 。]

english: How do I mine here?
translation: 我这里怎么挖矿？ [wo zhe li zen me wa kuang ？]

english: Git ahold of yer pickaxe, find a vein of ore, and set to work. If ye got a bit of skill, ye'll have a pocket o' pay- dirt in no time.
translation: 拿起你的镐，找到矿脉，然后开始工作。如果你有一点技巧，你很快就会赚到一大笔钱。 [na qi ni de gao ， zhao dao kuang mai ， ran hou kai shi gong zuo 。 ru guo ni you yi dian ji qiao ， ni hen kuai jiu hui zhuan dao yi da bi qian 。]

english: I've built me a contraption to wash the pay-dirt. Just drop yer pay-dirt in the hopper, an' wait fer it at the other end.
translation: 我造了一个装置来清洗付费污垢。只要把你的钱扔进漏斗里，然后在另一端等着它。 [wo zao le yi ge zhuang zhi lai qing xi fu fei wu gou 。 zhi yao ba ni de qian reng jin lou dou li ， ran hou zai ling yi duan deng zhe ta 。]

english: I won't charge ye fer usin' my contraption, but ye'd better fix it yerself when it breaks. A good whack with a hammer usually settles it.
translation: 我不会向你们收取使用我的装置的费用，但你们最好在它坏了的时候自己修理它。用锤子好好敲击一下通常就能解决问题。 [wo bu hui xiang ni men shou qu shi yong wo de zhuang zhi de fei yong ， dan ni men zui hao zai ta huai le de shi hou zi ji xiu li ta 。 yong chui zi hao hao qiao ji yi xia tong chang jiu neng jie jue wen ti 。]

english: Now will ye be gettin' to work now, or are ye gonna keep yappin' like a doggone galoot?
translation: 现在你们要开始工作了，还是要像狗一样大喊大叫？ [xian zai ni men yao kai shi gong zuo le ， hai shi yao xiang gou yi yang da han da jiao ？]

english: Would you like to trade?
translation: 您想交易吗？ [nin xiang jiao yi ma ？]

english: If ye've found yerself some golden nuggets in this 'ere mine, I'll do you a swap, yeah.
translation: 如果你在我的这里找到了一些金块，我会给你交换，是的。 [ru guo ni zai wo de zhe li zhao dao le yi xie jin kuai ， wo hui gei ni jiao huan ， shi de 。]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: Why, I'm Percy. Prospector Percy, the roughest, toughest, gruffest miner in the land. I've been pannin' fer gold since I were a young-un, and here's where I've struck it lucky.
translation: 为什么，我是珀西。探矿者珀西，这片土地上最粗暴、最坚强、最粗暴的矿工。我从小就开始淘金，这就是我的幸运之处。 [wei shen me ， wo shi po xi 。 tan kuang zhe po xi ， zhe pian tu di shang zui cu bao 、 zui jian qiang 、 zui cu bao de kuang gong 。 wo cong xiao jiu kai shi tao jin ， zhe jiu shi wo de xing yun zhi chu 。]

english: Excuse me, but what language are you speaking?
translation: 打扰一下，您说的是什么语言？ [da rao yi xia ， nin shuo de shi shen me yu yan ？]

english: Don't ye give me any of yer lip, ye dern varmint! Young'uns these days got no respect.
translation: 别给我任何你的嘴唇，你们这些恶棍！现在的年轻人不受尊重。 [bie gei wo ren he ni de zui chun ， ni men zhe xie e gun ！ xian zai de nian qing ren bu shou zun zhong 。]

english: Do go on.
translation: 继续吧。 [ji xu ba 。]

english: This here's the richest seam of ore I've found in all my days. After I built a contraption for washing the pay- dirt, the dwarves let me run things down here.
translation: 这是我一生中发现的最丰富的矿层。在我建造了一个用来清洗工资的装置后，矮人让我在这里运行东西。 [zhe shi wo yi sheng zhong fa xian de zui feng fu de kuang ceng 。 zai wo jian zao le yi ge yong lai qing xi gong zi de zhuang zhi hou ， ai ren rang wo zai zhe li yun xing dong xi 。]

english: Now, have ye any more idjit questions, or are ye ready to do some real work?
translation: 现在，你们还有什么问题吗？或者你们准备好做一些真正的工作了吗？ [xian zai ， ni men hai you shen me wen ti ma ？ huo zhe ni men zhun bei hao zuo yi xie zhen zheng de gong zuo le ma ？]

english: You discovered this mine?
translation: 这个矿是你发现的吗？ [zhe ge kuang shi ni fa xian de ma ？]

english: Is there anything else I can unlock here?
translation: 这里还有什么我可以解锁的吗？ [zhe li hai you shen me wo ke yi jie suo de ma ？]

english: Let me have a think...
translation: 让我想想... [rang wo xiang xiang ...]

english: If ye've got level 57 Mining, ye could pay to use my restricted mine, up the ladder. 100 nuggets gives unlimited access.
translation: 如果你的采矿等级达到 57 级，你可以付费使用我的受限矿井，升级。 100 个金块可无限次使用。 [ru guo ni de cai kuang deng ji da dao  57  ji ， ni ke yi fu fei shi yong wo de shou xian kuang jing ， sheng ji 。 100  ge jin kuai ke wu xian ci shi yong 。]

english: How would ye like it if the sack were bigger? I'll let ye have more ore in there if ye pays me 200 nuggets.
translation: 如果麻袋再大一点你会怎么样？如果你付给我 200 块金块，我会给你更多的矿石。 [ru guo ma dai zai da yi dian ni hui zen me yang ？ ru guo ni fu gei wo  200  kuai jin kuai ， wo hui gei ni geng duo de kuang shi 。]

english: I can give ye access to a special hopper in the restricted mine for 50 nuggets, but you'll need access to the restricted mine first.
translation: 我可以让你进入限制矿井中的一个特殊漏斗，获得 50 个金块，但你需要先进入限制矿井。 [wo ke yi rang ni jin ru xian zhi kuang jing zhong de yi ge te shu lou dou ， huo de  50  ge jin kuai ， dan ni xu yao xian jin ru xian zhi kuang jing 。]

english: I'd like to buy access to the restricted mine, please.
translation: 我想购买进入受限矿井的权限。 [wo xiang gou mai jin ru shou xian kuang jing de quan xian 。]

english: Right, ye can go up there whenever ye likes. Just behave yerself, or my Ma will tan yer hide.
translation: 是的，你们想什么时候去都可以。乖一点，不然我妈会把你晒黑的。 [shi de ， ni men xiang shen me shi hou qu dou ke yi 。 guai yi dian ， bu ran wo ma hui ba ni shai hei de 。]

english: Ye'll need level 57 Mining first. An' don't think ye can fool me with yer potions and fancy stat-boosts. Get yer level up for real.
translation: 你首先需要 57 级采矿。别以为你们能用你们的药水和花哨的属性提升来愚弄我。真正提升你的水平。 [ni shou xian xu yao  57  ji cai kuang 。 bie yi wei ni men neng yong ni men de yao shui he hua shao de shu xing ti sheng lai yu nong wo 。 zhen zheng ti sheng ni de shui ping 。]

english: That'll be 100 nuggets. If ye ain't got enough, ye'd better do some more mining - that's how ye gets stuff round here!
translation: 那将是 100 个金块。如果你还没有得到足够的东西，你最好再进行一些采矿——这就是你在这里得到东西的方式！ [na jiang shi  100  ge jin kuai 。 ru guo ni hai mei you de dao zu gou de dong xi ， ni zui hao zai jin xing yi xie cai kuang —— zhe jiu shi ni zai zhe li de dao dong xi de fang shi ！]

english: I'd like to get the bigger sack, please.
translation: 请给我一个更大的袋子。 [qing gei wo yi ge geng da de dai zi 。]

english: That'll be 200 nuggets. If ye ain't got enough, ye'd better do some more mining - that's how ye gets stuff round here!
translation: 那将是200块金块。如果你还没有得到足够的东西，你最好再进行一些采矿——这就是你在这里得到东西的方式！ [na jiang shi 200 kuai jin kuai 。 ru guo ni hai mei you de dao zu gou de dong xi ， ni zui hao zai jin xing yi xie cai kuang —— zhe jiu shi ni zai zhe li de dao dong xi de fang shi ！]

english: Ye can already climb the ladder to the restricted mine. But how would ye like it if the sack were bigger? I'll let ye have more ore in there if ye pays me 200 nuggets.
translation: 叶已经可以爬梯子到限制矿井了。但如果麻袋再大一点你会怎么样呢？如果你付给我 200 块金块，我会给你更多的矿石。 [ye yi jing ke yi pa ti zi dao xian zhi kuang jing le 。 dan ru guo ma dai zai da yi dian ni hui zen me yang ne ？ ru guo ni fu gei wo  200  kuai jin kuai ， wo hui gei ni geng duo de kuang shi 。]

english: I can give ye access to a special hopper in the restricted mine for 50 nuggets, it connects to the hopper down here.
translation: 我可以让你们进入限制矿井中的一个特殊漏斗，存放 50 个金块，它与下面的漏斗相连。 [wo ke yi rang ni men jin ru xian zhi kuang jing zhong de yi ge te shu lou dou ， cun fang  50  ge jin kuai ， ta yu xia mian de lou dou xiang lian 。]

english: Ye can now use that fancy new hopper in the restricted mine.
translation: 现在，您可以在受限矿井中使用那个精美的新料斗了。 [xian zai ， nin ke yi zai shou xian kuang jing zhong shi yong na ge jing mei de xin liao dou le 。]

english: Well, now, I think ye've got everything already. Ye can already go climb the ladder to the restricted mine, ye've got the bigger sack capacity too and ye have access to that restricted hopper.
translation: 好吧，现在，我想你们已经拥有了一切。你已经可以爬上梯子到达限制矿井，你也有更大的麻袋容量，并且你可以进入那个限制漏斗。 [hao ba ， xian zai ， wo xiang ni men yi jing yong you le yi qie 。 ni yi jing ke yi pa shang ti zi dao da xian zhi kuang jing ， ni ye you geng da de ma dai rong liang ， bing qie ni ke yi jin ru na ge xian zhi lou dou 。]

english: That'll be 50 nuggets. If ye ain't got enough, ye'd better do some more mining - that's how ye gets stuff round here!
translation: 那将是50块金块。如果你还没有得到足够的东西，你最好再进行一些采矿——这就是你在这里得到东西的方式！ [na jiang shi 50 kuai jin kuai 。 ru guo ni hai mei you de dao zu gou de dong xi ， ni zui hao zai jin xing yi xie cai kuang —— zhe jiu shi ni zai zhe li de dao dong xi de fang shi ！]

english: Well, now, I think ye've got everything already. Ye can already go climb the ladder to the restricted mine, and ye've got the bigger sack capacity too.
translation: 好吧，现在，我想你们已经拥有了一切。你已经可以爬梯子到限制矿井了，而且你的麻袋容量也更大了。 [hao ba ， xian zai ， wo xiang ni men yi jing yong you le yi qie 。 ni yi jing ke yi pa ti zi dao xian zhi kuang jing le ， er qie ni de ma dai rong liang ye geng da le 。]

english: I'll leave you alone.
translation: 我会让你独自一人。 [wo hui rang ni du zi yi ren 。]

english: Dern straight ye will.
translation: 邓恩，你会的。 [deng en ， ni hui de 。]

english: Oi, git yerself out of that hole!It's not safe in there.
translation: 哎呀，从那个洞里出来吧！里面不安全。 [ai ya ， cong na ge dong li chu lai ba ！ li mian bu an quan 。]

english: You must complete the Medium Tier tasks from the Falador Achievement Diary before Percy will let you use that tunnel.
translation: 在珀西允许你使用该隧道之前，你必须完成法拉多成就日记中的中层任务。 [zai po xi yun xu ni shi yong gai sui dao zhi qian ， ni bi xu wan cheng fa la duo cheng jiu ri ji zhong de zhong ceng ren wu 。]

english: We got us a jammed wheel!
translation: 我们发现车轮卡住了！ [wo men fa xian che lun ka zhu le ！]

english: Ye'd better fix that wheel!
translation: 你们最好修一下那个轮子！ [ni men zui hao xiu yi xia na ge lun zi ！]

english: Git yer hammer an' fix that wheel!
translation: 拿起你的锤子修理那个轮子！ [na qi ni de chui zi xiu li na ge lun zi ！]

english: That water ain't flowing!
translation: 那水不流了！ [na shui bu liu le ！]

english: Both them wheels be jammed!
translation: 两个轮子都卡住了！ [liang ge lun zi dou ka zhu le ！]

english: Git yer hammer an' fix them wheels!
translation: 拿起你的锤子来修理它们的轮子！ [na qi ni de chui zi lai xiu li ta men de lun zi ！]

english: How do I mine here?
translation: 我这里怎么挖矿？ [wo zhe li zen me wa kuang ？]

english: Would you like to trade?
translation: 您想交易吗？ [nin xiang jiao yi ma ？]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: Excuse me, but what language are you speaking?
translation: 打扰一下，您说的是什么语言？ [da rao yi xia ， nin shuo de shi shen me yu yan ？]

english: You discovered this mine?
translation: 这个矿是你发现的吗？ [zhe ge kuang shi ni fa xian de ma ？]

english: Is there anything else I can unlock here?
translation: 这里还有什么我可以解锁的吗？ [zhe li hai you shen me wo ke yi jie suo de ma ？]

english: Restricted mine access: 100 nuggets
translation: 限制矿井访问：100 块金块 [xian zhi kuang jing fang wen ：100  kuai jin kuai]

english: Bigger sack: 200 nuggets
translation: 更大的麻袋：200块金块 [geng da de ma dai ：200 kuai jin kuai]

english: Cancel
translation: 取消 [qu xiao]

english: Restricted hopper: 50 nuggets
translation: 限制漏斗：50 块 [xian zhi lou dou ：50  kuai]

english: I'll leave you alone.
translation: 我会让你独自一人。 [wo hui rang ni du zi yi ren 。]

english: Power for the people!
translation: 权力为人民！ [quan li wei ren min ！]

english: The Council must answer us!
translation: 理事会必须给我们答复！ [li shi hui bi xu gei wo men da fu ！]

english: The Council is corrupt!
translation: 理事会腐败了！ [li shi hui fu bai le ！]

english: Down with the Council!
translation: 打倒理事会！ [da dao li shi hui ！]

english: Democracy is a lie!
translation: 民主是一个谎言！ [min zhu shi yi ge huang yan ！]

english: We want answers!
translation: 我们想要答案！ [wo men xiang yao da an ！]

english: We won't be denied!
translation: 我们不会被拒绝！ [wo men bu hui bei ju jue ！]

english: We want a King!
translation: 我们想要一个国王！ [wo men xiang yao yi ge guo wang ！]

english: It's time for a King!
translation: 是时候当国王了！ [shi shi hou dang guo wang le ！]

english: A King for Kourend!
translation: 库伦德之王！ [ku lun de zhi wang ！]

english: What is it, human? I'm working.
translation: 这是什么，人类？我在工作。 [zhe shi shen me ， ren lei ？ wo zai gong zuo 。]

english: How do I use the furnace?
translation: 我该如何使用炉子？ [wo gai ru he shi yong lu zi ？]

english: Put your ore on the conveyor belt to get it smelted. We'll stoke the boiler and operate the rest of the machinery for you.
translation: 将矿石放在传送带上进行熔炼。我们将为您给锅炉加燃料并操作其余的机器。 [jiang kuang shi fang zai chuan song dai shang jin xing rong lian 。 wo men jiang wei nin gei guo lu jia ran liao bing cao zuo qi yu de ji qi 。]

english: You'll have to help repair the furnace whenever a pipe blows, though. Just hit it with a hammer - that usually works.
translation: 不过，每当管道爆炸时，你就必须帮忙修理炉子。只需用锤子敲击即可 - 通常会起作用。 [bu guo ， mei dang guan dao bao zha shi ， ni jiu bi xu bang mang xiu li lu zi 。 zhi xu yong chui zi qiao ji ji ke  -  tong chang hui qi zuo yong 。]

english: You'll have to put money in the coffer to pay for our services. We charge 72,000 coins per hour; money is deducted as long as you're in this room with us.
translation: 您必须将钱存入保险箱来支付我们的服务费用。我们每小时收费72,000个币；只要您和我们一起住在这个房间，就会扣除费用。 [nin bi xu jiang qian cun ru bao xian xiang lai zhi fu wo men de fu wu fei yong 。 wo men mei xiao shi shou fei 72,000 ge bi ； zhi yao nin he wo men yi qi zhu zai zhe ge fang jian ， jiu hui kou chu fei yong 。]

english: Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
translation: 天哪，你真是个大矮人。 [tian na ， ni zhen shi ge da ai ren 。]

english: My brothers and I have a rare genetic condition affecting our growth. Rather than treating us as freaks, you might like to appreciate how useful it is that we can operate the machinery.
translation: 我和我的兄弟患有一种影响我们成长的罕见遗传病。您可能不想把我们视为怪胎，而应该欣赏我们操作机器的有用性。 [wo he wo de xiong di huan you yi zhong ying xiang wo men cheng zhang de han jian yi chuan bing 。 nin ke neng bu xiang ba wo men shi wei guai tai ， er ying gai xin shang wo men cao zuo ji qi de you yong xing 。]

english: Sorry.
translation: 对不起。 [dui bu qi 。]

english: That's ok, human. You're not the first to comment on it. Now, did you need anything? I've got work to do here.
translation: 没关系，人类。你不是第一个对此发表评论的人。现在，你需要什么吗？我这里还有工作要做。 [mei guan xi ， ren lei 。 ni bu shi di yi ge dui ci fa biao ping lun de ren 。 xian zai ， ni xu yao shen me ma ？ wo zhe li hai you gong zuo yao zuo 。]

english: Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
translation: 你确定你真的是个侏儒吗？ [ni que ding ni zhen de shi ge zhu ru ma ？]

english: ... look, do you want help with something, or did you just come here to be rude? I've got work to do.
translation: ……听着，你是想寻求帮助，还是来这里只是为了无礼？我还有工作要做。 […… ting zhe ， ni shi xiang xun qiu bang zhu ， hai shi lai zhe li zhi shi wei le wu li ？ wo hai you gong zuo yao zuo 。]

english: I'll let you get on with it.
translation: 我会让你继续做下去。 [wo hui rang ni ji xu zuo xia qu 。]

english: How do I use the furnace?
translation: 我该如何使用炉子？ [wo gai ru he shi yong lu zi ？]

english: Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
translation: 天哪，你真是个大矮人。 [tian na ， ni zhen shi ge da ai ren 。]

english: Sorry.
translation: 对不起。 [dui bu qi 。]

english: I'll let you get on with it.
translation: 我会让你继续做下去。 [wo hui rang ni ji xu zuo xia qu 。]

english: Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
translation: 你确定你真的是个侏儒吗？ [ni que ding ni zhen de shi ge zhu ru ma ？]

english: That's no use!
translation: 那是没有用的！ [na shi mei you yong de ！]

english: No need! I'm fine thanks.
translation: 不需要！我很好，谢谢。 [bu xu yao ！ wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Looks like it's quiet for now. I don't need help, but thank you.
translation: 看来暂时还算安静。我不需要帮助，但谢谢你。 [kan lai zan shi hai suan an jing 。 wo bu xu yao bang zhu ， dan xie xie ni 。]

english: Light this brazier!
translation: 点燃这个火盆！ [dian ran zhe ge huo pen ！]

english: Yemalo shi cardito!
translation: 耶玛洛什卡迪托！ [ye ma luo shen ka di tuo ！]

english: Fix this brazier!
translation: 修好这个火盆！ [xiu hao zhe ge huo pen ！]

english: Arg, it got me!
translation: 嗯，它抓住了我！ [n ， ta zhua zhu le wo ！]

english: Mummy!
translation: 木乃伊！ [mu nai yi ！]

english: My flame burns low.
translation: 我的火焰燃烧得很微弱。 [wo de huo yan ran shao de hen wei ruo 。]

english: We are doomed.
translation: 我们注定了。 [wo men zhu ding le 。]

english: I think I'm dying.
translation: 我想我快死了。 [wo xiang wo kuai si le 。]

english: Ugh, help me!
translation: 呃，帮帮我吧！ [e ， bang bang wo ba ！]

english: We can rest for a time.
translation: 我们可以休息一段时间了。 [wo men ke yi xiu xi yi duan shi jian le 。]

english: Good day [sir/miss]. I'm the quartermaster for this camp. We have a little we could trade here.
translation: 美好的一天[先生/小姐]。我是这个营地的军需官。我们有一点可以在这里交易。 [mei hao de yi tian [ xian sheng / xiao jie ]。 wo shi zhe ge ying di de jun xu guan 。 wo men you yi dian ke yi zai zhe li jiao yi 。]

english: We should be getting a new stock soon. Would you like a look at what we do have?
translation: 我们应该很快就会收到新货。您想看看我们有什么吗？ [wo men ying gai hen kuai jiu hui shou dao xin huo 。 nin xiang kan kan wo men you shen me ma ？]

english: Yes please. What are you selling?
translation: 是的，请。你卖什么？ [shi de ， qing 。 ni mai shen me ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: We have a new stock of dragon halberds. Would you like a look at what we have?
translation: 我们有新的龙戟库存。您想看看我们有什么吗？ [wo men you xin de long ji ku cun 。 nin xiang kan kan wo men you shen me ma ？]

english: Yes please. What are you selling?
translation: 是的，请。你卖什么？ [shi de ， qing 。 ni mai shen me ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hey - what are you doing with that patch, peasant?!? One demands that you speak to one's self immediately!!
translation: 嘿 - 你在用那个补丁做什么，农民？！？要求你立即对自己说话！ [hei  -  ni zai yong na ge bu ding zuo shen me ， nong min ？！？ yao qiu ni li ji dui zi ji shuo hua ！]

english: [Roughly translated, this means that Queen Ellamaria would like a word.]
translation: [粗略翻译，这意味着埃拉玛丽亚女王想要一个词。] [[ cu lve fan yi ， zhe yi wei zhe ai la ma li ya nv wang xiang yao yi ge ci 。]]

english: What's going on here? I see a lot of farming patches with nothing growing in them.
translation: 这是怎么回事？我看到很多农田里什么也没长。 [zhe shi zen me hui shi ？ wo kan dao hen duo nong tian li shen me ye mei zhang 。]

english: No, one has just had them installed. One has had the most marvellous idea to bring renewed happiness to one's own dearest husband.
translation: 不，有人刚刚安装好它们。一个人想出了一个最奇妙的主意，为自己最亲爱的丈夫带来新的幸福。 [bu ， you ren gang gang an zhuang hao ta men 。 yi ge ren xiang chu le yi ge zui qi miao de zhu yi ， wei zi ji zui qin ai de zhang fu dai lai xin de xing fu 。]

english: One? I'm not sure I understand you-
translation: 一？我不确定我是否理解你- [yi ？ wo bu que ding wo shi fou li jie ni -]

english: Oh dear - the common classes, oh how they fill one with intolerable levels of exasperation, I swear to be most true.
translation: 哦天哪——普通课程，哦，他们如何让一个人充满难以忍受的愤怒，我发誓这是最真实的。 [o tian na —— pu tong ke cheng ， o ， ta men ru he rang yi ge ren chong man nan yi ren shou de fen nu ， wo fa shi zhe shi zui zhen shi de 。]

english: Ri-ight ... if you say so, my lady. I'll be off then, if you don't mind-
translation: 对、对了……如果您这么说的话，我的女士。那我就走了，如果你不介意的话- [dui 、 dui le …… ru guo nin zhe me shuo de hua ， wo de nv shi 。 na wo jiu zou le ， ru guo ni bu jie yi de hua -]

english: Yes, be off with you, before I call the guards.
translation: 是的，在我叫守卫之前，你就走吧。 [shi de ， zai wo jiao shou wei zhi qian ， ni jiu zou ba 。]

english: No problem, sorry to have bothered you.
translation: 没问题，很抱歉打扰您。 [mei wen ti ， hen bao qian da rao nin 。]

english: Peasant - WAIT!!!
translation: 农民——等等！！！ [nong min —— deng deng ！！！]

english: Are you speaking to me?
translation: 你在跟我说话吗？ [ni zai gen wo shuo hua ma ？]

english: Who else would I be speaking to, you funny little man? Of course you.
translation: 我还能和谁说话呢，你这个有趣的小男人？当然是你。 [wo hai neng he shui shuo hua ne ， ni zhe ge you qu de xiao nan ren ？ dang ran shi ni 。]

english: Well for a moment there I thought there was a dog around here somewhere...
translation: 嗯，有那么一会儿我以为附近某个地方有一只狗...... [n ， you na me yi hui er wo yi wei fu jin mou ge di fang you yi zhi gou ......]

english: Oh yes, sarcasm - how amusing. No, no, peasant - I have a question to ask of you, and you are required to answer.
translation: 哦，是的，讽刺——多么有趣。不，不，农民——我有一个问题要问你，你必须回答。 [o ， shi de ， feng ci —— duo me you qu 。 bu ， bu ， nong min —— wo you yi ge wen ti yao wen ni ， ni bi xu hui da 。]

english: Well, seeing as you put it so nicely...
translation: 嗯，看你说得这么好…… [n ， kan ni shuo de zhe me hao ……]

english: Do you know of anyone who might have some degree of horticultural experience?
translation: 您知道有人可能具有一定程度的园艺经验吗？ [nin zhi dao you ren ke neng ju you yi ding cheng du de yuan yi jing yan ma ？]

english: Oh, marvellous! Peasant, I hereby order you to assist me with a little project I have planned.
translation: 哦，太棒了！农民，我特此命令你协助我完成我计划的一个小项目。 [o ， tai bang le ！ nong min ， wo te ci ming ling ni xie zhu wo wan cheng wo ji hua de yi ge xiao xiang mu 。]

english: You'll have to ask me nicely first.
translation: 你得先好好问我一下。 [ni de xian hao hao wen wo yi xia 。]

english: Oh, what I have to deal with these days - to think this is what being a Queen has become. Very well then: would you ... good sir help me with a little project of mine?
translation: 哦，这些天我必须面对的事情——想想这就是成为女王的样子。那么很好：您……好先生能帮我做一个小项目吗？ [o ， zhe xie tian wo bi xu mian dui de shi qing —— xiang xiang zhe jiu shi cheng wei nv wang de yang zi 。 na me hen hao ： nin …… hao xian sheng neng bang wo zuo yi ge xiao xiang mu ma ？]

english: I would be happy to help someone who is so in touch with the people.
translation: 我很乐意帮助那些与人民如此密切的人。 [wo hen le yi bang zhu na xie yu ren min ru ci mi qie de ren 。]

english: Ah, more sarcasm - wonderful. Well, it is nice to have a master of the fine art of gardening to assist me; in the absence of any such person, I gladly accept your service.
translation: 啊，更多的讽刺——太棒了。嗯，很高兴有一位园艺艺术大师来帮助我；在没有这样的人的情况下，我很乐意接受您的服务。 [a ， geng duo de feng ci —— tai bang le 。 n ， hen gao xing you yi wei yuan yi yi shu da shi lai bang zhu wo ； zai mei you zhe yang de ren de qing kuang xia ， wo hen le yi jie shou nin de fu wu 。]

english: I'm not sure if that's a compliment or not. Anyway, what would you like me to do, and what do I get out of it?
translation: 我不确定这是否是一种赞美。不管怎样，你想让我做什么，我能从中得到什么？ [wo bu que ding zhe shi fou shi yi zhong zan mei 。 bu guan zen yang ， ni xiang rang wo zuo shen me ， wo neng cong zhong de dao shen me ？]

english: To answer your first question, you have noticed the new farming patches that we have had installed around us. We wish to grow many varied and exotic plants in them, to bring happiness back to my husband.
translation: 为了回答你的第一个问题，你已经注意到我们在我们周围安装了新的农业补丁。我们希望在其中种植许多不同的奇异植物，为我的丈夫带回幸福。 [wei le hui da ni de di yi ge wen ti ， ni yi jing zhu yi dao wo men zai wo men zhou wei an zhuang le xin de nong ye bu ding 。 wo men xi wang zai qi zhong zhong zhi xu duo bu tong de qi yi zhi wu ， wei wo de zhang fu dai hui xing fu 。]

english: King Roald?
translation: 罗尔德国王？ [luo er de guo wang ？]

english: The very same, and that's 'His Most Royal Majesty' to you. Now we come to the plants that one wishes you to grow in these patches. I would tell you all at once, but I fear that your small mind would not cope.
translation: 完全一样，这就是您的“至高无上的陛下”。现在我们来谈谈人们希望您在这些土地上种植的植物。我想一下子告诉你一切，但我担心你的小头脑无法应付。 [wan quan yi yang ， zhe jiu shi nin de “ zhi gao wu shang de bi xia ”。 xian zai wo men lai tan tan ren men xi wang nin zai zhe xie tu di shang zhong zhi de zhi wu 。 wo xiang yi xia zi gao su ni yi qie ， dan wo dan xin ni de xiao tou nao wu fa ying fu 。]

english: Thanks, I'm sure. So tell me Queeny, how do I know which plants I am to get for you?
translation: 谢谢，我确定。那么告诉我奎妮，我怎么知道该给你买哪些植物呢？ [xie xie ， wo que ding 。 na me gao su wo kui ni ， wo zen me zhi dao gai gei ni mai na xie zhi wu ne ？]

english: I have given you a list of the items that I need in each patch. One is sure that you will know how to use the list with each patch to find out what needs to go in each one. There is one more thing, though.
translation: 我已经给了你每个补丁中需要的物品列表。我们确信您会知道如何使用每个补丁的列表来找出每个补丁中需要包含哪些内容。不过，还有一件事。 [wo yi jing gei le ni mei ge bu ding zhong xu yao de wu pin lie biao 。 wo men que xin nin hui zhi dao ru he shi yong mei ge bu ding de lie biao lai zhao chu mei ge bu ding zhong xu yao bao han na xie nei rong 。 bu guo ， hai you yi jian shi 。]

english: (player receives the list called... List.)
translation: （玩家收到名为...列表的列表。） [（ wan jia shou dao ming wei ... lie biao de lie biao 。）]

english: One listens with bated breath...
translation: 一个人屏住呼吸聆听…… [yi ge ren bing zhu hu xi ling ting ……]

english: Obtaining the seeds may prove difficult if you go about it by hacking and slashing everything that moves. No, to gather these items you will need to employ a finer tactic; the art of persuasion.
translation: 如果你通过砍伐和砍伐所有移动的东西来获得种子可能会很困难。不，要收集这些物品，你需要采用更精细的策略；说服的艺术。 [ru guo ni tong guo kan fa he kan fa suo you yi dong de dong xi lai huo de zhong zi ke neng hui hen kun nan 。 bu ， yao shou ji zhe xie wu pin ， ni xu yao cai yong geng jing xi de ce lve ； shuo fu de yi shu 。]

english: You must go at once and converse with the wise old man who is said to dwell in Draynor Village; he may guide you in mastering this delicate and sophisticated ability.
translation: 你必须立即去与据说居住在德拉诺村的聪明老人交谈；他可能会指导你掌握这种微妙而复杂的能力。 [ni bi xu li ji qu yu ju shuo ju zhu zai de la nuo cun de cong ming lao ren jiao tan ； ta ke neng hui zhi dao ni zhang wo zhe zhong wei miao er fu za de neng li 。]

english: I'd rather jump off the docks at Port Sarim.
translation: 我宁愿从沙里姆港的码头跳下去。 [wo ning yuan cong sha li mu gang de ma tou tiao xia qu 。]

english: Well don't allow one to delay you - it is probably the most constructive thing you could do with your life, to be honest.
translation: 好吧，不要让任何人耽误你——说实话，这可能是你一生中能做的最有建设性的事情。 [hao ba ， bu yao rang ren he ren dan wu ni —— shuo shi hua ， zhe ke neng shi ni yi sheng zhong neng zuo de zui you jian she xing de shi qing 。]

english: How am I supposed to move statues all the way here?
translation: 我该如何将雕像一路搬到这里？ [wo gai ru he jiang diao xiang yi lu ban dao zhe li ？]

english: What I am supposed to be getting again?
translation: 我应该再次得到什么？ [wo ying gai zai ci de dao shen me ？]

english: Will these patches need much in the way of watering?
translation: 这些地块需要大量浇水吗？ [zhe xie di kuai xu yao da liang jiao shui ma ？]

english: Can I have another list?
translation: 我可以再要一份清单吗？ [wo ke yi zai yao yi fen qing dan ma ？]

english: Take better care with this one.
translation: 更好地照顾这个。 [geng hao di zhao gu zhe ge 。]

english: These parties are always a bore.
translation: 这些聚会总是令人厌烦。 [zhe xie ju hui zong shi ling ren yan fan 。]

english: Come on, it's not too bad, you just need to loosen up!
translation: 来吧，这还不算太糟糕，你只是需要放松一下！ [lai ba ， zhe hai bu suan tai zao gao ， ni zhi shi xu yao fang song yi xia ！]

english: No thank you, I don't want to make a fool of myself, one has to keep up appearances.
translation: 不，谢谢，我不想出丑，必须要保持面子。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo bu xiang chu chou ， bi xu yao bao chi mian zi 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Can I have another list?
translation: 我可以再要一份清单吗？ [wo ke yi zai yao yi fen qing dan ma ？]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Er...Hello, Your Majesty.
translation: 呃……您好，陛下。 [e …… nin hao ， bi xia 。]

english: Have you come for a particular reason? I am a busy Queen, you know. I had to attend the opening of a new orphanage this morning.
translation: 您是因为特殊原因而来的吗？你知道，我是一位忙碌的女王。今天早上我必须参加一家新孤儿院的开业典礼。 [nin shi yin wei te shu yuan yin er lai de ma ？ ni zhi dao ， wo shi yi wei mang lu de nv wang 。 jin tian zao shang wo bi xu can jia yi jia xin gu er yuan de kai ye dian li 。]

english: Yes, I...
translation: 是的，我... [shi de ， wo ...]

english: And this afternoon I shall be receiving the Embassador of Karamja and accompanying him on his week-long tour of Etceteria.
translation: 今天下午我将接待卡拉姆贾大使并陪同他进行为期一周的埃切泰里亚之旅。 [jin tian xia wu wo jiang jie dai ka la mu jia da shi bing pei tong ta jin xing wei qi yi zhou de ai qie tai li ya zhi lv 。]

english: Er, I...
Then this evening we shall be putting on a grand ball! All of the kingdom's nobility will be present!
translation: 那么今天晚上我们将举办一场盛大的舞会！王国的所有贵族都将出席！ [na me jin tian wan shang wo men jiang ju ban yi chang sheng da de wu hui ！ wang guo de suo you gui zu dou jiang chu xi ！]

english: If I m...
translation: 如果我是... [ru guo wo shi ...]

english: Oh, who am I kidding...nothing ever happens here. I always wanted to be a princess when I was a girl. If I'd been told it would be like this, I wouldn't have bothered.
translation: 哦，我在开玩笑……这里什么也没发生。当我还是个女孩的时候，我一直想成为一名公主。如果有人告诉我会是这样，我就不会打扰了。 [o ， wo zai kai wan xiao …… zhe li shen me ye mei fa sheng 。 dang wo hai shi ge nv hai de shi hou ， wo yi zhi xiang cheng wei yi ming gong zhu 。 ru guo you ren gao su wo hui shi zhe yang ， wo jiu bu hui da rao le 。]

english: Your Majesty!
translation: 陛下！ [bi xia ！]

english: Yes? Did you want something?
translation: 是的？你想要什么吗？ [shi de ？ ni xiang yao shen me ma ？]

english: ...actually, no.
translation: ......实际上，不。 [...... shi ji shang ， bu 。]

english: Your Majesty...
translation: 陛下... [bi xia ...]

english: Vargas, you irritating fool. 'Warmongering harpy', indeed!
translation: 瓦尔加斯，你这个令人恼火的傻瓜。确实是“好战的鹰身女妖”！ [wa er jia si ， ni zhe ge ling ren nao huo de sha gua 。 que shi shi “ hao zhan de ying shen nv yao ”！]

english: Sorry?
translation: 对不起？ [dui bu qi ？]

english: Oh, I apologise. I was merely thinking out loud.
translation: 哦，我道歉。我只是大声思考。 [o ， wo dao qian 。 wo zhi shi da sheng si kao 。]

english: How is your kingdom faring?
translation: 你的王国过得怎么样？ [ni de wang guo guo de zen me yang ？]

english: It could be better. Now, if you don't mind, I'm rather busy.
translation: 可能会更好。现在，如果你不介意的话，我很忙。 [ke neng hui geng hao 。 xian zai ， ru guo ni bu jie yi de hua ， wo hen mang 。]

english: Very well, your Majesty.
translation: 很好，陛下。 [hen hao ， bi xia 。]

english: Well, look who it is!
translation: 嗯，看看是谁！ [n ， kan kan shi shui ！]

english: Good to see you Martin.
translation: 很高兴见到你马丁。 [hen gao xing jian dao ni ma ding 。]

english: Can you believe it? The coronation of a king! Truth be told, there were times I wondered if this day would ever come.
translation: 你能相信吗？国王加冕！说实话，我曾一度怀疑这一天是否会到来。 [ni neng xiang xin ma ？ guo wang jia mian ！ shuo shi hua ， wo ceng yi du huai yi zhe yi tian shi fou hui dao lai 。]

english: And is it everything you hoped for?
translation: 这就是你所希望的一切吗？ [zhe jiu shi ni suo xi wang de yi qie ma ？]

english: Everything and more, my friend. And to think they even let us vote on it as well! Fantastic!
translation: 一切以及更多，我的朋友。想想他们甚至还让我们对此进行投票！极好的！ [yi qie yi ji geng duo ， wo de peng you 。 xiang xiang ta men shen zhi hai rang wo men dui ci jin xing tou piao ！ ji hao de ！]

english: Well the King certainly seems to have attracted plenty of guests.
translation: 好吧，国王似乎确实吸引了很多客人。 [hao ba ， guo wang si hu que shi xi yin le hen duo ke ren 。]

english: Indeed. Seems that everyone wants to congratulate him... Or maybe they're just here for the food.
translation: 的确。似乎每个人都想祝贺他……或者也许他们只是为了食物而来。 [di que 。 si hu mei ge ren dou xiang zhu he ta …… huo zhe ye xu ta men zhi shi wei le shi wu er lai 。]

english: Either way, this will be an event for the ages.
translation: 无论哪种方式，这都将是一个永恒的事件。 [wu lun na zhong fang shi ， zhe dou jiang shi yi ge yong heng de shi jian 。]

english: Are all the leaders here as well?
translation: 领导们都在吗？ [ling dao men dou zai ma ？]

english: Most of them. Lord Shayzien was here earlier but he left. To be honest, he didn't look to be enjoying himself.
translation: 他们中的大多数。 Shayzien 勋爵早些时候曾在这里，但他离开了。说实话，他看起来并不高兴。 [ta men zhong de da duo shu 。 Shayzien  xun jue zao xie shi hou ceng zai zhe li ， dan ta li kai le 。 shuo shi hua ， ta kan qi lai bing bu gao xing 。]

english: That's not too suprising. Things weren't exactly straightforward between him and the King when this was all arranged.
translation: 这并不太令人惊讶。当这一切都安排好后，他和国王之间的事情并不那么简单。 [zhe bing bu tai ling ren jing ya 。 dang zhe yi qie dou an pai hao hou ， ta he guo wang zhi jian de shi qing bing bu na me jian dan 。]

english: Yes, I heard there was a bit of drama here and there. Still, that's Kourend for you.
translation: 是的，我听说到处都有一些戏剧性的事情。不过，这就是 Kourend 适合你的地方。 [shi de ， wo ting shuo dao chu dou you yi xie xi ju xing de shi qing 。 bu guo ， zhe jiu shi  Kourend  shi he ni de di fang 。]

english: Now, I'll let you go and mingle. I'm sure the King himself will want a word with you at some point as well.
translation: 现在，我让你走，去交往。我相信国王本人也会在某个时候想和你说句话。 [xian zai ， wo rang ni zou ， qu jiao wang 。 wo xiang xin guo wang ben ren ye hui zai mou ge shi hou xiang he ni shuo ju hua 。]

english: Alright. Have fun Martin.
translation: 好吧。马丁，祝你玩得开心。 [hao ba 。 ma ding ， zhu ni wan de kai xin 。]

english: The player walks towards Lord Arceuus.
translation: 玩家走向阿尔宙斯领主。 [wan jia zou xiang a er zhou si ling zhu 。]

english: Hello Lord Arceuus.
translation: 阿尔宙斯大人您好。 [a er zhou si da ren nin hao 。]

english: Good to see you friend.
translation: 很高兴见到你朋友。 [hen gao xing jian dao ni peng you 。]

english: Any word on Xamphur?
translation: 关于 Xamphur 有什么消息吗？ [guan yu  Xamphur  you shen me xiao xi ma ？]

english: Nothing yet. However, we did manage to search his lair in Molch.
translation: 还什么都没有。然而，我们确实设法搜查了他在莫尔奇的巢穴。 [hai shen me dou mei you 。 ran er ， wo men que shi she fa sou cha le ta zai mo er qi de chao xue 。]

english: Find anything interesting?
translation: 发现什么有趣的事情吗？ [fa xian shen me you qu de shi qing ma ？]

english: Most of it had been cleared out before we arrived. There was some research left behind though. Notes on potential new spells.
translation: 在我们到达之前大部分已经清理干净了。不过，还是有一些研究被抛在了后面。关于潜在新咒语的注释。 [zai wo men dao da zhi qian da bu fen yi jing qing li gan jing le 。 bu guo ， hai shi you yi xie yan jiu bei pao zai le hou mian 。 guan yu qian zai xin zhou yu de zhu shi 。]

english: Some are far too dangerous to use, but others we've found to be safe. We're preparing a tome of all the ones that are suitable. I'll make sure you get a copy once we're done.
translation: 有些太危险而无法使用，但我们发现其他一些是安全的。我们正在准备一本包含所有合适内容的书。一旦我们完成，我会确保你得到一份副本。 [you xie tai wei xian er wu fa shi yong ， dan wo men fa xian qi ta yi xie shi an quan de 。 wo men zheng zai zhun bei yi ben bao han suo you he shi nei rong de shu 。 yi dan wo men wan cheng ， wo hui que bao ni de dao yi fen fu ben 。]

english: That's very kind of you.
translation: 谢谢您的好意。 [xie xie nin de hao yi 。]

english: It's the least we can do after all you have done for us. Anyway, I won't keep you. Enjoy the coronation.
translation: 在您为我们所做的一切之后，这是我们至少能做的。无论如何，我不会挽留你。享受加冕礼。 [zai nin wei wo men suo zuo de yi qie zhi hou ， zhe shi wo men zhi shao neng zuo de 。 wu lun ru he ， wo bu hui wan liu ni 。 xiang shou jia mian li 。]

english: The player walks towards Commander Fullore.
translation: 玩家走向指挥官福洛尔。 [wan jia zou xiang zhi hui guan fu luo er 。]

english: There you are! I was worried you'd miss all the fun.
translation: 你在那里！我担心你会错过所有的乐趣。 [ni zai na li ！ wo dan xin ni hui cuo guo suo you de le qu 。]

english: No chance. It's not every day you crown a new king.
translation: 没有机会。并不是每天都会加冕新国王。 [mei you ji hui 。 bing bu shi mei tian du hui jia mian xin guo wang 。]

english: You can say that again. You should have seen all the preperations needed. Food, drinks, entertainment, invitations... The list goes on.
translation: 你可以再说一遍。您应该已经看到了所需的所有准备工作。食物、饮料、娱乐、邀请……这样的例子不胜枚举。 [ni ke yi zai shuo yi bian 。 nin ying gai yi jing kan dao le suo xu de suo you zhun bei gong zuo 。 shi wu 、 yin liao 、 yu le 、 yao qing …… zhe yang de li zi bu sheng mei ju 。]

english: You'd think security would be one of the hard parts, but I actually reckon our bit is pretty straightforward in comparison.
translation: 您可能会认为安全性是最困难的部分之一，但实际上我认为相比之下我们的部分相当简单。 [nin ke neng hui ren wei an quan xing shi zui kun nan de bu fen zhi yi ， dan shi ji shang wo ren wei xiang bi zhi xia wo men de bu fen xiang dang jian dan 。]

english: On that note, how does it feel to be serving a king now?
translation: 说到这里，现在为国王服务感觉如何？ [shuo dao zhe li ， xian zai wei guo wang fu wu gan jue ru he ？]

english: I don't think it's quite sunk in yet. It still feels like it was only this morning that Councillor Hughes escaped. So much has happened in such a short time.
translation: 我认为它还没有完全陷入困境。给人的感觉仍然像是休斯议员只是在今天早上才逃脱的。这么短的时间内发生了这么多事情。 [wo ren wei ta hai mei you wan quan xian ru kun jing 。 gei ren de gan jue reng ran xiang shi xiu si yi yuan zhi shi zai jin tian zao shang cai tao tuo de 。 zhe me duan de shi jian nei fa sheng le zhe me duo shi qing 。]

english: Tell me about it. Had I known how this would go when Martin first recruited me, I'd have probably considered running for the hills as fast as possible.
translation: 告诉我吧。如果我在马丁第一次招募我时就知道事情会如何发展，我可能会考虑尽快跑到山上去。 [gao su wo ba 。 ru guo wo zai ma ding di yi ci zhao mu wo shi jiu zhi dao shi qing hui ru he fa zhan ， wo ke neng hui kao lv jin kuai pao dao shan shang qu 。]

english: Well, I for one am glad you didn't. We'd have never reached this point without your help.
translation: 好吧，我很高兴你没有这么做。如果没有你的帮助，我们永远不会走到这一步。 [hao ba ， wo hen gao xing ni mei you zhe me zuo 。 ru guo mei you ni de bang zhu ， wo men yong yuan bu hui zou dao zhe yi bu 。]

english: It wouldn't have been possible without you or Martin either. Have you two spoken yet?
translation: 如果没有你或马丁，这一切都是不可能的。你们两个已经说话了吗？ [ru guo mei you ni huo ma ding ， zhe yi qie dou shi bu ke neng de 。 ni men liang ge yi jing shuo hua le ma ？]

english: Oh, I'm going to need a lot to drink before I'm ready for that conversation.
translation: 哦，在我准备好谈话之前我需要喝很多酒。 [o ， zai wo zhun bei hao tan hua zhi qian wo xu yao he hen duo jiu 。]

english: Fair enough.
translation: 很公平。 [hen gong ping 。]

english: Anyway, have you seen our special guest?
translation: 不管怎样，你看到我们的特邀嘉宾了吗？ [bu guan zen yang ， ni kan dao wo men de te yao jia bin le ma ？]

english: The scene pans towards the front banquet table.
translation: 场景转向前面的宴会桌。 [chang jing zhuan xiang qian mian de yan hui zhuo 。]

english: It's a pleasure to finally welcome you to Great Kourend, Queen Zyanyi. You are very welcome here.
translation: 很高兴终于欢迎您来到大库伦德，Zyanyi 女王。非常欢迎您来到这里。 [hen gao xing zhong yu huan ying nin lai dao da ku lun de ，Zyanyi  nv wang 。 fei chang huan ying nin lai dao zhe li 。]

english: The pleasure is all mine. From today, the sun will shine on our two kingdoms once more. The mistakes of the past are now behind us.
translation: 快乐全是我的。从今天起，阳光将再次普照我们两国。过去的错误现在已经成为过去。 [kuai le quan shi wo de 。 cong jin tian qi ， yang guang jiang zai ci pu zhao wo men liang guo 。 guo qu de cuo wu xian zai yi jing cheng wei guo qu 。]

english: Who is she?
translation: 她是谁？ [ta shi shui ？]

english: Zyanyi Arkan, the Sun Queen. She's the ruler of Varlamore, the kingdom in the south. This is her first visit to Kourend.
translation: Zyanyi Arkan，太阳女王。她是南方王国瓦拉莫尔的统治者。这是她第一次访问库伦德。 [Zyanyi Arkan， tai yang nv wang 。 ta shi nan fang wang guo wa la mo er de tong zhi zhe 。 zhe shi ta di yi ci fang wen ku lun de 。]

english: First visit?
translation: 第一次访问？ [di yi ci fang wen ？]

english: Indeed. The King personally invited her. He's keen to put an end to the animosity between the two kingdoms. Rumor has it she feels the same way.
translation: 的确。国王亲自邀请她。他渴望结束两个王国之间的敌意。有传言说她也有同样的感觉。 [di que 。 guo wang qin zi yao qing ta 。 ta ke wang jie shu liang ge wang guo zhi jian de di yi 。 you chuan yan shuo ta ye you tong yang de gan jue 。]

english: Who are the knights with her?
translation: 和她一起的骑士是谁？ [he ta yi qi de qi shi shi shui ？]

english: Her royal guard, the Kualti.
translation: 她的皇家卫队，库尔蒂。 [ta de huang jia wei dui ， ku er di 。]

english: They look fancy.
translation: 它们看起来很漂亮。 [ta men kan qi lai hen piao liang 。]

english: They do. If the stories are true, they're the best fighters in Varlamore.
translation: 他们确实这么做了。如果这些故事属实，那么他们就是瓦拉莫尔最好的战士。 [ta men que shi zhe me zuo le 。 ru guo zhe xie gu shi shu shi ， na me ta men jiu shi wa la mo er zui hao de zhan shi 。]

english: Not jealous are you?
translation: 你不嫉妒吧？ [ni bu ji du ba ？]

english: Not of that armour, that's for sure. It looks very uncomfortable.
translation: 不是那个盔甲，这是肯定的。看起来很不舒服。 [bu shi na ge kui jia ， zhe shi ken ding de 。 kan qi lai hen bu shu fu 。]

english: Queen Zyanyi Arkan and her Kualti begin to leave.
translation: Zyanyi Arkan 女王和她的 Kualti 开始离开。 [Zyanyi Arkan  nv wang he ta de  Kualti  kai shi li kai 。]

english: Ah, looks like they're done. You should go and see the King. He was pretty keen to speak to you.
translation: 啊，看起来他们已经完成了。你应该去见国王。他很想和你说话。 [a ， kan qi lai ta men yi jing wan cheng le 。 ni ying gai qu jian guo wang 。 ta hen xiang he ni shuo hua 。]

english: Okay. I'll see you later.
translation: 好的。稍后见。 [hao de 。 shao hou jian 。]

english: The player approaches King Kandur Hosidius.
translation: 玩家接近国王坎杜尔·霍西迪乌斯。 [wan jia jie jin guo wang kan du er · huo xi di wu si 。]

english: Good to see you, Your Majesty. Congratulations on your coronation.
translation: 很高兴见到您，陛下。祝贺您加冕。 [hen gao xing jian dao nin ， bi xia 。 zhu he nin jia mian 。]

english: Thank you my friend. Of course, none of this would have been possible without you. Let it be known that you will always be a friend of this kingdom.
translation: 谢谢你，我的朋友。当然，如果没有你，这一切都是不可能的。让大家知道你将永远是这个王国的朋友。 [xie xie ni ， wo de peng you 。 dang ran ， ru guo mei you ni ， zhe yi qie dou shi bu ke neng de 。 rang da jia zhi dao ni jiang yong yuan shi zhe ge wang guo de peng you 。]

english: Thank you, I'm very honoured.
translation: 谢谢你，我感到非常荣幸。 [xie xie ni ， wo gan dao fei chang rong xing 。]

english: As am I. In fact, I think this calls for a toast.
translation: 事实上，我认为这需要干杯。 [shi shi shang ， wo ren wei zhe xu yao gan bei 。]

english: Gather around honoured guests! It's time for me to bore you all with a speech!
translation: 各位嘉宾齐聚一堂！是时候让我给大家讲一场无聊的演讲了！ [ge wei jia bin qi ju yi tang ！ shi shi hou rang wo gei da jia jiang yi chang wu liao de yan jiang le ！]

english: The guests approach King Kandur Hosidius.
translation: 客人们走近坎杜尔·霍西迪乌斯国王。 [ke ren men zou jin kan du er · huo xi di wu si guo wang 。]

english: Friends, thank you all for joining me on this special day. This is the beginning of a new chapter for Kourend, and I could not be more grateful to have you all here to celebrate with me.
translation: 朋友们，感谢大家在这个特殊的日子里加入我。这是库伦德新篇章的开始，我非常感激你们大家来这里和我一起庆祝。 [peng you men ， gan xie da jia zai zhe ge te shu de ri zi li jia ru wo 。 zhe shi ku lun de xin pian zhang de kai shi ， wo fei chang gan ji ni men da jia lai zhe li he wo yi qi qing zhu 。]

english: Still, let us not forget the hard road that led us here, nor those who were brave enough to walk along it.
translation: 尽管如此，我们不要忘记我们走过的艰难道路，也不要忘记那些勇敢地走在这条路上的人们。 [jin guan ru ci ， wo men bu yao wang ji wo men zou guo de jian nan dao lu ， ye bu yao wang ji na xie yong gan di zou zai zhe tiao lu shang de ren men 。]

english: Martin Holt, Lydia Fullore, [player name]. Without you, we would all still be living in ignorance. You opened our eyes to the truth, and ensured a strong future for Kourend.
translation: 马丁·霍尔特，莉迪亚·福洛尔，[玩家姓名]。没有你，我们都还活在愚昧之中。你让我们看到了真相，并确保了库伦德拥有美好的未来。 [ma ding · huo er te ， li di ya · fu luo er ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。 mei you ni ， wo men dou hai huo zai yu mei zhi zhong 。 ni rang wo men kan dao le zhen xiang ， bing que bao le ku lun de yong you mei hao de wei lai 。]

english: Now, let us all raise our glasses to these three. We are forever in their debt.
translation: 现在，让我们大家向这三位举杯。我们永远欠他们的债。 [xian zai ， rang wo men da jia xiang zhe san wei ju bei 。 wo men yong yuan qian ta men de zhai 。]

english: The scene fades to black, and transitions to one with King Kandur Hosidius and the player alone behind Kourend's throne.
translation: 场景逐渐变黑，然后转为国王坎杜尔·霍西迪乌斯和玩家独自站在库伦德王座后面。 [chang jing zhu jian bian hei ， ran hou zhuan wei guo wang kan du er · huo xi di wu si he wan jia du zi zhan zai ku lun de wang zuo hou mian 。]

english: Ah, there you are.
translation: 啊，你来了。 [a ， ni lai le 。]

english: You wanted to speak to me?
translation: 你想跟我说话吗？ [ni xiang gen wo shuo hua ma ？]

english: I did. Sorry to take you away from the festivities. With everyone else celebrating, I thought it would be a good chance to talk in private. Don't worry. It won't take long.
translation: 我做到了。很抱歉带您离开庆祝活动。当其他人都在庆祝的时候，我想这是一个私下交谈的好机会。不用担心。不会花很长时间的。 [wo zuo dao le 。 hen bao qian dai nin li kai qing zhu huo dong 。 dang qi ta ren dou zai qing zhu de shi hou ， wo xiang zhe shi yi ge si xia jiao tan de hao ji hui 。 bu yong dan xin 。 bu hui hua hen zhang shi jian de 。]

english: It's not a problem. What did you want to discuss?
translation: 这不是问题。你想讨论什么？ [zhe bu shi wen ti 。 ni xiang tao lun shen me ？]

english: The councillors are behind bars and Kourend has a new ruler. On the surface, all is well again. Of course, that's not quite the case in reality.
translation: 议员们被关进监狱，库伦德有了新的统治者。表面上，一切又好起来了。当然，现实情况并非如此。 [yi yuan men bei guan jin jian yu ， ku lun de you le xin de tong zhi zhe 。 biao mian shang ， yi qie you hao qi lai le 。 dang ran ， xian shi qing kuang bing fei ru ci 。]

english: You mean Xamphur?
translation: 你是说桑普尔吗？ [ni shi shuo sang pu er ma ？]

english: Yes. The Council did not act alone. In fact, they weren't even the true orchestrators in this. We need to find and deal with the real foe before it's too late.
translation: 是的。安理会并不是单独行动的。事实上，他们甚至不是这件事的真正策划者。我们需要在为时已晚之前找到并对付真正的敌人。 [shi de 。 an li hui bing bu shi dan du xing dong de 。 shi shi shang ， ta men shen zhi bu shi zhe jian shi de zhen zheng ce hua zhe 。 wo men xu yao zai wei shi yi wan zhi qian zhao dao bing dui fu zhen zheng de di ren 。]

english: I'd be happy to help in any way I can. Xamphur and I have unfinished business.
translation: 我很乐意尽我所能提供帮助。桑普尔和我还有未竟的事业。 [wo hen le yi jin wo suo neng ti gong bang zhu 。 sang pu er he wo hai you wei jing de shi ye 。]

english: I was hoping you'd say that. This is a serious threat we're facing, and I need people I can trust.
translation: 我本来希望你会这么说。这是我们面临的严重威胁，我需要可以信任的人。 [wo ben lai xi wang ni hui zhe me shuo 。 zhe shi wo men mian lin de yan zhong wei xie ， wo xu yao ke yi xin ren de ren 。]

english: So, what do you need me to do?
translation: 那么，你需要我做什么？ [na me ， ni xu yao wo zuo shen me ？]

english: Nothing for now. I just wanted to make sure you were on board. Once we have more information on Xamphur, I will let you know.
translation: 暂时没什么。我只是想确定你在船上。一旦我们获得有关 Xamphur 的更多信息，我会通知您。 [zan shi mei shen me 。 wo zhi shi xiang que ding ni zai chuan shang 。 yi dan wo men huo de you guan  Xamphur  de geng duo xin xi ， wo hui tong zhi nin 。]

english: Now, we should head back downstairs before we are missed.
translation: 现在，我们应该在被错过之前回到楼下。 [xian zai ， wo men ying gai zai bei cuo guo zhi qian hui dao lou xia 。]

english: A knife is launched at the king's back.
translation: 一把刀射向国王的背部。 [yi ba dao she xiang guo wang de bei bu 。]

english: Is everything alright, Your Majesty?
translation: 陛下，一切都好吗？ [bi xia ， yi qie dou hao ma ？]

english: I... I can't...
translation: 我……我不能…… [wo …… wo bu neng ……]

english: The king falls, and an assassin is revealed to the player.
translation: 国王倒台，一名刺客出现在玩家面前。 [guo wang dao tai ， yi ming ci ke chu xian zai wan jia mian qian 。]

english: Kandur Hosidius. You have been marked for death.
translation: 坎杜尔·霍西迪乌斯。你已被标记为死亡。 [kan du er · huo xi di wu si 。 ni yi bei biao ji wei si wang 。]

english: The assassin teleports away, and the cutscene ends.
translation: 刺客传送离开，过场动画结束。 [ci ke chuan song li kai ， guo chang dong hua jie shu 。]

english: Hey Lydia. How are you doing?
translation: 嘿莉迪亚。你好吗？ [hei li di ya 。 ni hao ma ？]

english: It's been a rough few days since the coronation, as you can probably imagine. One moment we were crowning a new king, that next we were burying him. I'm doing okay, though. Work is a good distraction.
translation: 正如你可以想象的那样，加冕典礼之后的几天过得很艰难。前一刻我们正在加冕一位新国王，下一秒我们就要埋葬他。不过我还好。工作是一种很好的消遣。 [zheng ru ni ke yi xiang xiang de na yang ， jia mian dian li zhi hou de ji tian guo de hen jian nan 。 qian yi ke wo men zheng zai jia mian yi wei xin guo wang ， xia yi miao wo men jiu yao mai zang ta 。 bu guo wo hai hao 。 gong zuo shi yi zhong hen hao de xiao qian 。]

english: And how's that going?
translation: 进展如何？ [jin zhan ru he ？]

english: Well Artur Hosidius is now the King of Great Kourend. I'm sorry you couldn't be there for the ceremony. After what happened, they felt something small would be best.
translation: 阿图尔·霍西迪乌斯现在是大库伦德的国王。很抱歉您不能出席仪式。发生这件事后，他们觉得做点小事最好。 [a tu er · huo xi di wu si xian zai shi da ku lun de de guo wang 。 hen bao qian nin bu neng chu xi yi shi 。 fa sheng zhe jian shi hou ， ta men jue de zuo dian xiao shi zui hao 。]

english: That's fine. I think one coronation was enough for me. Any word on the killer?
translation: 没关系。我想一次加冕对我来说就足够了。有没有关于凶手的消息？ [mei guan xi 。 wo xiang yi ci jia mian dui wo lai shuo jiu zu gou le 。 you mei you guan yu xiong shou de xiao xi ？]

english: There's no shortage of potential suspects, but nothing solid. We've had the murder weapon sent over to Lovakengj to be examined. They have a theory, but want to do more work before they confirm it.
translation: 潜在的嫌疑人不乏，但没有确凿的证据。我们已将凶器送到洛瓦肯吉进行检查。他们有一个理论，但希望在证实它之前做更多的工作。 [qian zai de xian yi ren bu fa ， dan mei you que zao de zheng ju 。 wo men yi jiang xiong qi song dao luo wa ken ji jin xing jian cha 。 ta men you yi ge li lun ， dan xi wang zai zheng shi ta zhi qian zuo geng duo de gong zuo 。]

english: Well let me know once they have something. I want to find whoever did this.
translation: 一旦他们有东西就让我知道。我想找到做这件事的人。 [yi dan ta men you dong xi jiu rang wo zhi dao 。 wo xiang zhao dao zuo zhe jian shi de ren 。]

english: We will.
translation: 我们将。 [wo men jiang 。]

english: Anything else I can do in the meantime?
translation: 在此期间我还能做些什么吗？ [zai ci qi jian wo hai neng zuo xie shen me ma ？]

english: I don't think so. Lord Arceuus is trying to find out more about Xamphur, but he doesn't have anything yet. For now, all we can do is wait.
translation: 我不这么认为。阿尔宙斯领主正试图找到更多关于桑普尔的信息，但他还一无所获。目前，我们能做的就是等待。 [wo bu zhe me ren wei 。 a er zhou si ling zhu zheng shi tu zhao dao geng duo guan yu sang pu er de xin xi ， dan ta hai yi wu suo huo 。 mu qian ， wo men neng zuo de jiu shi deng dai 。]

english: And on that note, I wanted to give you a little something to thank you for all that you've done. Not just for Kourend, but for me as well.
translation: 就此而言，我想送给您一些东西，以感谢您所做的一切。不仅对库伦德来说，对我来说也是如此。 [jiu ci er yan ， wo xiang song gei nin yi xie dong xi ， yi gan xie nin suo zuo de yi qie 。 bu jin dui ku lun de lai shuo ， dui wo lai shuo ye shi ru ci 。]

english: This is a bad situation we're in, but without you things would be a whole lot worse. Lord Arceuus also sent something over for you. He said you'd know what to do with it.
translation: 我们现在的处境很糟糕，但如果没有你，情况会更糟。阿尔宙斯大人也给你送来了一些东西。他说你会知道如何处理它。 [wo men xian zai de chu jing hen zao gao ， dan ru guo mei you ni ， qing kuang hui geng zao 。 a er zhou si da ren ye gei ni song lai le yi xie dong xi 。 ta shuo ni hui zhi dao ru he chu li ta 。]

english: Now, I'll let you get going. Thanks again, for everything.
translation: 现在，我让你走吧。再次感谢，所做的一切。 [xian zai ， wo rang ni zou ba 。 zai ci gan xie ， suo zuo de yi qie 。]

english: Congratulations! Quest complete!
translation: 恭喜！任务完成！ [gong xi ！ ren wu wan cheng ！]

english: Ah. Welcome, adventurer. I'm here to tell you all about quests. Let's start by opening your quest list.
translation: 啊。欢迎，冒险家。我来这里是为了告诉你所有关于任务的事情。让我们首先打开您的任务列表。 [a 。 huan ying ， mao xian jia 。 wo lai zhe li shi wei le gao su ni suo you guan yu ren wu de shi qing 。 rang wo men shou xian da kai nin de ren wu lie biao 。]

english: Have you not opened that menu yet?
translation: 你还没有打开那个菜单吗？ [ni hai mei you da kai na ge cai dan ma ？]

english: Now that you have the quest list open, you can see all the quests within it. Clicking one of these quests will display some more information on it.
translation: 现在您已打开任务列表，您可以看到其中的所有任务。单击其中一个任务将显示更多相关信息。 [xian zai nin yi da kai ren wu lie biao ， nin ke yi kan dao qi zhong de suo you ren wu 。 dan ji qi zhong yi ge ren wu jiang xian shi geng duo xiang guan xin xi 。]

english: If you haven't started the quest, it will tell you where to begin and what requirements you need. If the quest is in progress, it will remind you what to do next.
translation: 如果您还没有开始任务，它会告诉您从哪里开始以及您需要什么要求。如果任务正在进行中，它会提醒您下一步该做什么。 [ru guo nin hai mei you kai shi ren wu ， ta hui gao su nin cong na li kai shi yi ji nin xu yao shen me yao qiu 。 ru guo ren wu zheng zai jin xing zhong ， ta hui ti xing nin xia yi bu gai zuo shen me 。]

translation: 那么我在哪里可以找到这些成分呢？ [na me wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao zhe xie cheng fen ne ？]

english: It's something rabbits are constantly munching on, have a look in some of the houses nearby.
translation: 这是兔子经常咀嚼的东西，看看附近的一些房子。 [zhe shi tu zi jing chang ju jue de dong xi ， kan kan fu jin de yi xie fang zi 。]

english: Won't they be annoyed I'm nicking their carrots?
translation: 我削了他们的胡萝卜，他们不会生气吗？ [wo xue le ta men de hu luo bo ， ta men bu hui sheng qi ma ？]

english: Who cares, Descendance day is far more important than their needs.
translation: 谁在乎呢，下降日远比他们的需求重要。 [shui zai hu ne ， xia jiang ri yuan bi ta men de xu qiu zhong yao 。]

english: I normally get my cabbage from the fields, on the other side of the river.
translation: 我通常从河对岸的田地里采摘卷心菜。 [wo tong chang cong he dui an de tian di li cai zhai juan xin cai 。]

english: There are rabbit farmers too!? How cute.
translation: 还有养兔人！？多可爱啊。 [hai you yang tu ren ！？ duo ke ai a 。]

english: That you'll have to have a nosey round for, rabbits around here are always celebrating something.
translation: 你必须多管闲事，这里的兔子总是在庆祝什么。 [ni bi xu duo guan xian shi ， zhe li de tu zi zong shi zai qing zhu shen me 。]

english: Lots of theft in the rabbit realm...
translation: 兔子王国里发生了很多盗窃事件...... [tu zi wang guo li fa sheng le hen duo dao qie shi jian ......]

english: You gotta do what you gotta do.
translation: 你必须做你必须做的事。 [ni bi xu zuo ni bi xu zuo de shi 。]

english: I've got all the information I need. Thanks.
translation: 我已经得到了我需要的所有信息。谢谢。 [wo yi jing de dao le wo xu yao de suo you xin xi 。 xie xie 。]

english: Actually, I know where to find this stuff.
translation: 事实上，我知道在哪里可以找到这些东西。 [shi shi shang ， wo zhi dao zai na li ke yi zhao dao zhe xie dong xi 。]

english: No, I don't feel like it, maybe later.
translation: 不，我不喜欢，也许以后吧。 [bu ， wo bu xi huan ， ye xu yi hou ba 。]

english: Fine. I always knew you Adventurer types were callous rabbits. Go on, hop off!
translation: 美好的。我一直都知道你们这些冒险家都是冷酷无情的兔子。继续，下车！ [mei hao de 。 wo yi zhi dou zhi dao ni men zhe xie mao xian jia dou shi leng ku wu qing de tu zi 。 ji xu ， xia che ！]

english: You don't look very happy.
translation: 你看上去不太高兴。 [ni kan shang qu bu tai gao xing 。]

english: No, I'm not. The world is caving in around me - I am overcome by dark feelings of impending doom.
translation: 不，我不是。我周围的世界正在崩溃——我被厄运即将来临的黑暗感觉所征服。 [bu ， wo bu shi 。 wo zhou wei de shi jie zheng zai beng kui —— wo bei e yun ji jiang lai lin de hei an gan jue suo zheng fu 。]

english: I'd take the rest of the day off if I were you.
translation: 如果我是你，我会休息一天剩下的时间。 [ru guo wo shi ni ， wo hui xiu xi yi tian sheng xia de shi jian 。]

english: No, that's the worst thing I could do. I'd get in terrible trouble.
translation: 不，这是我能做的最糟糕的事情。我会遇到可怕的麻烦。 [bu ， zhe shi wo neng zuo de zui zao gao de shi qing 。 wo hui yu dao ke pa de ma fan 。]

english: Well maybe you need to take a drink...
translation: 好吧，也许你需要喝一杯...... [hao ba ， ye xu ni xu yao he yi bei ......]

english: That would be nice, but the great round one has banned all consumption of Cabbage flavoured drinks.
translation: 那就太好了，但是第一轮已经禁止所有卷心菜味饮料的消费。 [na jiu tai hao le ， dan shi di yi lun yi jing jin zhi suo you juan xin cai wei yin liao de xiao fei 。]

english: Hmm, why not something that doesn't taste of cabbage?
translation: 嗯，为什么不吃一些没有卷心菜味道的东西呢？ [n ， wei shen me bu chi yi xie mei you juan xin cai wei dao de dong xi ne ？]

english: Have you tried Onion beer? It's disgusting.
translation: 你尝过洋葱啤酒吗？那真令人恶心。 [ni chang guo yang cong pi jiu ma ？ na zhen ling ren e xin 。]

english: I'm afraid I've run out of ideas.
translation: 恐怕我已经没有主意了。 [kong pa wo yi jing mei you zhu yi le 。]

english: I know I'm doomed.
translation: 我知道我注定要失败。 [wo zhi dao wo zhu ding yao shi bai 。]

english: Nice hat!
translation: 帽子不错！ [mao zi bu cuo ！]

english: Err thank you, it's a pretty ordinary rabbit cook's hat, really.
translation: 呃，谢谢，这只是一顶非常普通的兔子厨师帽，真的。 [e ， xie xie ， zhe zhi shi yi ding fei chang pu tong de tu zi chu shi mao ， zhen de 。]

english: Still, suits you. I didn't know rabbits could wear trousers either.
translation: 不过，还是适合你。我也不知道兔子也可以穿裤子。 [bu guo ， hai shi shi he ni 。 wo ye bu zhi dao tu zi ye ke yi chuan ku zi 。]

english: It's all standard rabbit cook issue uniform...
translation: 这都是标准的兔子厨师制服…… [zhe dou shi biao zhun de tu zi chu shi zhi fu ……]

english: The whole hat, rabbit trousers ensemble - it works. It makes you look like a real rabbit cook.
translation: 帽子、兔子裤的整体搭配——很管用。它让你看起来像一个真正的兔子厨师。 [mao zi 、 tu zi ku de zheng ti da pei —— hen guan yong 。 ta rang ni kan qi lai xiang yi ge zhen zheng de tu zi chu shi 。]

english: I am a real rabbit cook! I haven't got the time to be chatting about Rabbinary Fashion. I am in desperate need of help!
translation: 我是真正的兔子厨师！我没有时间谈论 Rabbinary Fashion。我非常需要帮助！ [wo shi zhen zheng de tu zi chu shi ！ wo mei you shi jian tan lun  Rabbinary Fashion。 wo fei chang xu yao bang zhu ！]

english: How are you getting on?
translation: 你过得怎么样？ [ni guo de zen me yang ？]

english: I haven't got all ofitems yet, I'm still looking.
translation: 我还没有拿到所有的物品，我还在寻找。 [wo hai mei you na dao suo you de wu pin ， wo hai zai xun zhao 。]

english: Please get the ingredients quickly. I'm running out of time! The Duke will throw me into the streets!
translation: 请快点去拿原料。我的时间不多了！公爵会把我扔到街上！ [qing kuai dian qu na yuan liao 。 wo de shi jian bu duo le ！ gong jue hui ba wo reng dao jie shang ！]

english: You still need to get:  A carrot. A cabbage. A cake.
translation: 你还需要得到： 一根胡萝卜。一颗卷心菜。一块蛋糕。 [ni hai xu yao de dao ：  yi gen hu luo bo 。 yi ke juan xin cai 。 yi kuai dan gao 。]

english: Here's one carrot.
translation: 这是一根胡萝卜。 [zhe shi yi gen hu luo bo 。]

english: Here's one cake, still uneaten.
translation: 这是一块蛋糕，还没吃完。 [zhe shi yi kuai dan gao ， hai mei chi wan 。]

english: Here's a fresh cabbage my hare.
translation: 这是新鲜的卷心菜，我的兔子。 [zhe shi xin xian de juan xin cai ， wo de tu zi 。]

english: Thanks for ingredients you have got so far, please get the rest quickly. I'm running out of time! The Duke will throw me into the streets!
translation: 感谢您目前已获得的材料，请尽快获取其余材料。我的时间不多了！公爵会把我扔到街上！ [gan xie nin mu qian yi huo de de cai liao ， qing jin kuai huo qu qi yu cai liao 。 wo de shi jian bu duo le ！ gong jue hui ba wo reng dao jie shang ！]

english: You still need to get:  [remaining item(s)]
translation: 您还需要获得：[剩余物品] [nin hai xu yao huo de ：[ sheng yu wu pin ]]

english: I'll hop to it.
translation: 我会跳过去。 [wo hui tiao guo qu 。]

english: What's wrong?
translation: 怎么了？ [zen me le ？]

english: I'm always happy to help a rabbit cook in distress.
translation: 我总是很乐意帮助一只陷入困境的兔子做饭。 [wo zong shi hen le yi bang zhu yi zhi xian ru kun jing de tu zi zuo fan 。]

english: Where do I find a carrot?
translation: 哪里可以找到胡萝卜？ [na li ke yi zhao dao hu luo bo ？]

english: How about a cabbage?
translation: 卷心菜怎么样？ [juan xin cai zen me yang ？]

english: And a cake? I thought you were going to make one.
translation: 还有蛋糕吗？我以为你会做一个。 [hai you dan gao ma ？ wo yi wei ni hui zuo yi ge 。]

english: I've got all the information I need. Thanks.
translation: 我已经得到了我需要的所有信息。谢谢。 [wo yi jing de dao le wo xu yao de suo you xin xi 。 xie xie 。]

english: Actually, I know where to find this stuff.
translation: 事实上，我知道在哪里可以找到这些东西。 [shi shi shang ， wo zhi dao zai na li ke yi zhao dao zhe xie dong xi 。]

english: I can't right now, maybe later.
translation: 我现在不能，也许以后可以。 [wo xian zai bu neng ， ye xu yi hou ke yi 。]

english: You don't look very happy.
translation: 你看上去不太高兴。 [ni kan shang qu bu tai gao xing 。]

english: I'd take the rest of the day off if I were you.
translation: 如果我是你，我会休息一天剩下的时间。 [ru guo wo shi ni ， wo hui xiu xi yi tian sheng xia de shi jian 。]

english: Nice hat.
translation: 漂亮的帽子。 [piao liang de mao zi 。]

english: I'll get right on it.
translation: 我会马上处理的。 [wo hui ma shang chu li de 。]

english: Can you remind me how to find these things again?
translation: 你能提醒我如何再次找到这些东西吗？ [ni neng ti xing wo ru he zai ci zhao dao zhe xie dong xi ma ？]

english: Welcome to the Burthorpe Games Rooms!
translation: 欢迎来到伯索普游戏室！ [huan ying lai dao bo suo pu you xi shi ！]

english: How do I play board games?
translation: 我该如何玩棋盘游戏？ [wo gai ru he wan qi pan you xi ？]

english: You can challenge someone to a game anywhere in the games rooms by using the right click option. Choose the type of game and then choose the options you want such as time per move. If you want to play a particular
translation: 您可以使用右键单击选项在游戏室的任何位置向某人发起游戏挑战。选择游戏类型，然后选择您想要的选项，例如每次移动的时间。如果你想玩某个特定的游戏 [nin ke yi shi yong you jian dan ji xuan xiang zai you xi shi de ren he wei zhi xiang mou ren fa qi you xi tiao zhan 。 xuan ze you xi lei xing ， ran hou xuan ze nin xiang yao de xuan xiang ， li ru mei ci yi dong de shi jian 。 ru guo ni xiang wan mou ge te ding de you xi]

english: game there are challenge rooms dedicated to that game. In the challenge rooms you can see other players ranks by right clicking them, their skill will be displayed instead of their combat level. Once you have enough
translation: 游戏有专门针对该游戏的挑战室。在挑战室中，你可以通过右键单击其他玩家来查看他们的排名，将显示他们的技能而不是他们的战斗水平。一旦你有足够的 [you xi you zhuan men zhen dui gai you xi de tiao zhan shi 。 zai tiao zhan shi zhong ， ni ke yi tong guo you jian dan ji qi ta wan jia lai cha kan ta men de pai ming ， jiang xian shi ta men de ji neng er bu shi ta men de zhan dou shui ping 。 yi dan ni you zu gou de]

english: experience you will be able to use the challenge rooms on the first floor! If your opponent accepts the challenge you will be taken to one of the tables in the main room where you will play your game of choice.
translation: 体验后可以使用一楼的挑战室！如果您的对手接受挑战，您将被带到主房间的一张桌子上，您将在那里玩您选择的游戏。 [ti yan hou ke yi shi yong yi lou de tiao zhan shi ！ ru guo nin de dui shou jie shou tiao zhan ， nin jiang bei dai dao zhu fang jian de yi zhang zhuo zi shang ， nin jiang zai na li wan nin xuan ze de you xi 。]

english: Once you have finished your game you will go back to the challenge room where you can challenge again!
translation: 完成游戏后，您将返回挑战室，您可以再次挑战！ [wan cheng you xi hou ， nin jiang fan hui tiao zhan shi ， nin ke yi zai ci tiao zhan ！]

english: What games can I play?
translation: 我可以玩什么游戏？ [wo ke yi wan shen me you xi ？]

english: Currently we offer Draughts, Runelink, Runesquares, and Runeversi.
translation: 目前我们提供跳棋、符文链接、符文方块和符文西。 [mu qian wo men ti gong tiao qi 、 fu wen lian jie 、 fu wen fang kuai he fu wen xi 。]

english: Draughts?
translation: 跳水？ [tiao shui ？]

english: Draughts uses standard rules, apart from: a draw is declared if no piece has been taken or promoted for forty moves. To play Draughts go to the challenge room in the SW corner.
translation: 跳棋使用标准规则，除此之外：如果四十步棋没有被吃或晋级，则宣布平局。要玩跳棋，请前往西南角的挑战室。 [tiao qi shi yong biao zhun gui ze ， chu ci zhi wai ： ru guo si shi bu qi mei you bei chi huo jin ji ， ze xuan bu ping ju 。 yao wan tiao qi ， qing qian wang xi nan jiao de tiao zhan shi 。]

english: Runelink?
translation: 符文链接？ [fu wen lian jie ？]

english: Yup, you have to get four runes in row. The challenge room for Runelink is in the SE corner.
translation: 是的，你必须排成四个符文。符文链接的挑战室位于东南角。 [shi de ， ni bi xu pai cheng si ge fu wen 。 fu wen lian jie de tiao zhan shi wei yu dong nan jiao 。]

english: Runesquares?
translation: 符文方块？ [fu wen fang kuai ？]

english: Yes, you take it in turns to add a line with the goal of making squares. Everytime you make a square you take another turn. The challenge room for Runesquares is in the SW corner.
translation: 是的，你轮流添加一条线，目的是形成正方形。每次你形成一个正方形，你就需要再转一次。 Runesquares 的挑战室位于西南角。 [shi de ， ni lun liu tian jia yi tiao xian ， mu di shi xing cheng zheng fang xing 。 mei ci ni xing cheng yi ge zheng fang xing ， ni jiu xu yao zai zhuan yi ci 。 Runesquares  de tiao zhan shi wei yu xi nan jiao 。]

english: Runeversi?
translation: 鲁内韦西？ [lu nei wei xi ？]

english: Yep, the aim is to have more of your runes on the board than your opponent. You can take your opponents pieces by trapping them between your own. The challenge room for Runeversi is in the SE corner.
translation: 是的，我们的目标是让棋盘上的符文数量多于对手。你可以将对手的棋子夹在自己的棋子之间，从而将其夺走。 Runeversi 的挑战室位于东南角。 [shi de ， wo men de mu biao shi rang qi pan shang de fu wen shu liang duo yu dui shou 。 ni ke yi jiang dui shou de qi zi jia zai zi ji de qi zi zhi jian ， cong er jiang qi duo zou 。 Runeversi  de tiao zhan shi wei yu dong nan jiao 。]

english: Can I buy a drink please?
translation: 请问我可以买一杯饮料吗？ [qing wen wo ke yi mai yi bei yin liao ma ？]

english: Certainly [sir/miss], our speciality is Asgarnian Ale, we also serve Wizard's Mind Bomb and Dwarven Stout.
translation: 当然[先生/小姐]，我们的特色是阿斯加尼亚啤酒，我们还提供巫师心灵炸弹和矮人黑啤酒。 [dang ran [ xian sheng / xiao jie ]， wo men de te se shi a si jia ni ya pi jiu ， wo men hai ti gong wu shi xin ling zha dan he ai ren hei pi jiu 。]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: How do I play board games?
translation: 我该如何玩棋盘游戏？ [wo gai ru he wan qi pan you xi ？]

english: What games can I play?
translation: 我可以玩什么游戏？ [wo ke yi wan shen me you xi ？]

english: Draughts?
translation: 跳水？ [tiao shui ？]

english: Runelink?
translation: 符文链接？ [fu wen lian jie ？]

english: Runesquares?
translation: 符文方块？ [fu wen fang kuai ？]

english: Runeversi?
translation: 鲁内韦西？ [lu nei wei xi ？]

english: Can I buy a drink please?
translation: 请问我可以买一杯饮料吗？ [qing wen wo ke yi mai yi bei yin liao ma ？]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: Hello again.
translation: 又好。 [you hao 。]

english: Hello. I hear you're doing some important work for Veliaf. You'd best get to it.
translation: 你好。我听说你正在为维利亚夫做一些重要的工作。你最好能做到这一点。 [ni hao 。 wo ting shuo ni zheng zai wei wei li ya fu zuo yi xie zhong yao de gong zuo 。 ni zui hao neng zuo dao zhe yi dian 。]

english: Thanks for doing such good work on the new hideout. Of course, we've tidied up a bit as you can see.
translation: 感谢您为新藏身处所做的出色工作。当然，如您所见，我们已经进行了一些整理。 [gan xie nin wei xin cang shen chu suo zuo de chu se gong zuo 。 dang ran ， ru nin suo jian ， wo men yi jing jin xing le yi xie zheng li 。]

english: Radimus looks busy...
translation: 拉迪姆斯看上去很忙…… [la di mu si kan shang qu hen mang ……]

english: Excuse me a moment won't you. Do feel free to explore the rest of the building
translation: 请原谅我一会儿，好吗？请随意探索建筑物的其余部分 [qing yuan liang wo yi hui er ， hao ma ？ qing sui yi tan suo jian zhu wu de qi yu bu fen]

english: Hello there! How are you enjoying the Legends Guild?
translation: 你好呀！您对传奇公会的体验如何？ [ni hao ya ！ nin dui chuan qi gong hui de ti yan ru he ？]

english: It's legendary.
translation: 这是传奇的。 [zhe shi chuan qi de 。]

english: That's nice. Excuse me now, I have other matters to attend to. Please feel free to explore the rest of the building.
translation: 那很好。对不起，我还有其他事情要处理。请随意探索大楼的其余部分。 [na hen hao 。 dui bu qi ， wo hai you qi ta shi qing yao chu li 。 qing sui yi tan suo da lou de qi yu bu fen 。]

english: It's okay.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: It's lame.
translation: 这是蹩脚的。 [zhe shi bie jiao de 。]

english: Have you got anything for me?
translation: 你有什么东西要给我吗？ [ni you shen me dong xi yao gei wo ma ？]

english: One of our other members visited the Kharazi Jungle, following in your illustrious footsteps, and they found some weird daggers. Would you like one?
translation: 我们的另一名成员追随您辉煌的脚步访问了卡拉兹丛林，他们发现了一些奇怪的匕首。你想要一个吗？ [wo men de ling yi ming cheng yuan zhui sui nin hui huang de jiao bu fang wen le ka la zi cong lin ， ta men fa xian le yi xie qi guai de bi shou 。 ni xiang yao yi ge ma ？]

english: Radimus shows you a familiar-looking dagger.
translation: 拉迪姆斯向你展示了一把看起来很熟悉的匕首。 [la di mu si xiang ni zhan shi le yi ba kan qi lai hen shu xi de bi shou 。]

english: Radimus gives you [another/[amount]] [dagger/daggers].
translation: 拉迪姆斯给你[另一个/[数量]][匕首/匕首]。 [la di mu si gei ni [ ling yi ge /[ shu liang ]][ bi shou / bi shou ]。]

english: Hello there. I have something for you. Enjoy!
translation: 你好呀。我有东西给你。享受！ [ni hao ya 。 wo you dong xi gei ni 。 xiang shou ！]

english: Hey, I think it's about time you started buying your own machetes. I'm sure there must be some jungle native down in Karamja who can sell you one.
translation: 嘿，我想你是时候开始购买自己的砍刀了。我确信卡拉姆贾一定有某个丛林当地人可以卖给你一个。 [hei ， wo xiang ni shi shi hou kai shi gou mai zi ji de kan dao le 。 wo que xin ka la mu jia yi ding you mou ge cong lin dang di ren ke yi mai gei ni yi ge 。]

english: Here, solve this.
translation: 来，解决这个问题。 [lai ， jie jue zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Radimus Erkle hands you a puzzlebox!
translation: Radimus Erkle 递给你一个拼图盒！ [Radimus Erkle  di gei ni yi ge pin tu he ！]

english: That doesn't look solved to me.
translation: 在我看来这并没有解决。 [zai wo kan lai zhe bing mei you jie jue 。]

english: Well done [player name]. Here you go.
translation: 干得好[玩家姓名]。干得好。 [gan de hao [ wan jia xing ming ]。 gan de hao 。]

english: You've obtained a [new clue/casket]!
translation: 你获得了[新线索/棺材]！ [ni huo de le [ xin xian suo / guan cai ]！]

english: It's legendary.
translation: 这是传奇的。 [zhe shi chuan qi de 。]

english: It's okay.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: It's lame.
