translation: 我在这里能做什么？ [wo zai zhe li neng zuo shen me ？]

english: As you can see, Camdozaal isn't the city it once was. That said, there are still a few things around here that might interest you. There's the golem workshop, the barronite mine and the offering altar.
translation: 如您所见，卡姆多扎尔不再是以前的那个城市了。也就是说，这里仍然有一些事情您可能会感兴趣。这里有傀儡工坊、巴伦石矿和祭坛。 [ru nin suo jian ， ka mu duo zha er bu zai shi yi qian de na ge cheng shi le 。 ye jiu shi shuo ， zhe li reng ran you yi xie shi qing nin ke neng hui gan xing qu 。 zhe li you kui lei gong fang 、 ba lun shi kuang he ji tan 。]

english: Tell me more about the golem workshop.
translation: 告诉我更多关于傀儡工作室的信息。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu kui lei gong zuo shi de xin xi 。]

english: You'll find it to the east. It was once the forefront of our technological advances. Sadly, it was also one of the major factors that led to our doom.
translation: 你会在东边找到它。它曾经是我们技术进步的最前沿。可悲的是，这也是导致我们灭亡的主要因素之一。 [ni hui zai dong bian zhao dao ta 。 ta ceng jing shi wo men ji shu jin bu de zui qian yan 。 ke bei de shi ， zhe ye shi dao zhi wo men mie wang de zhu yao yin su zhi yi 。]

english: What were you doing there?
translation: 你在那儿做什么？ [ni zai na er zuo shen me ？]

english: Camdozaal was built upon the ruins of an older civilization. Little trace of them remained by the time we arrived. However, when building the city, ancient golems were discovered.
translation: 卡姆多扎尔建立在一个古老文明的废墟上。当我们到达时，他们的踪迹已所剩无几。然而，在建造城市时，发现了古代傀儡。 [ka mu duo zha er jian li zai yi ge gu lao wen ming de fei xu shang 。 dang wo men dao da shi ， ta men de zong ji yi suo sheng wu ji 。 ran er ， zai jian zao cheng shi shi ， fa xian le gu dai kui lei 。]

english: These golems were very crude. They were mostly made from clay, of all things. We used our advanced Smithing knowledge to improve their form. Eventually, we were able to get them working again.
translation: 这些傀儡非常简陋。它们大多是用粘土制成的。我们利用先进的锻造知识来改进它们的形状。最终，我们能够让他们再次工作。 [zhe xie kui lei fei chang jian lou 。 ta men da duo shi yong nian tu zhi cheng de 。 wo men li yong xian jin de duan zao zhi shi lai gai jin ta men de xing zhuang 。 zui zhong ， wo men neng gou rang ta men zai ci gong zuo 。]

english: We kept pushing with the golems. Many of them we imbued with magical energies. We started with mind and body energy, but eventually moved on to chaos as well.
translation: 我们继续用傀儡推动。我们为他们中的许多人注入了神奇的能量。我们从思想和身体能量开始，但最终也陷入了混乱。 [wo men ji xu yong kui lei tui dong 。 wo men wei ta men zhong de xu duo ren zhu ru le shen qi de neng liang 。 wo men cong si xiang he shen ti neng liang kai shi ， dan zui zhong ye xian ru le hun luan 。]

english: Alas, the influence of chaos had grave results. We lost control of many. Those that became corrupt had to be locked away, but by then it was already too late.
translation: 唉，混乱的影响造成了严重的后果。我们失去了对许多人的控制。那些腐败的人必须被关起来，但那时已经太晚了。 [ai ， hun luan de ying xiang zao cheng le yan zhong de hou guo 。 wo men shi qu le dui xu duo ren de kong zhi 。 na xie fu bai de ren bi xu bei guan qi lai ， dan na shi yi jing tai wan le 。]

english: The barbarians had learnt of our experimentation, and were determined to destroy all traces of it.
translation: 野蛮人得知了我们的实验，并决心摧毁它的所有痕迹。 [ye man ren de zhi le wo men de shi yan ， bing jue xin cui hui ta de suo you hen ji 。]

english: Ironically, locking them away meant the golems were among the few things to survive the barbarians. If you fancy a bit of combat, you might want to go take a look.
translation: 讽刺的是，将它们锁起来意味着傀儡是少数能在野蛮人中幸存下来的东西之一。如果你喜欢一点战斗，你可能想去看一看。 [feng ci de shi ， jiang ta men suo qi lai yi wei zhe kui lei shi shao shu neng zai ye man ren zhong xing cun xia lai de dong xi zhi yi 。 ru guo ni xi huan yi dian zhan dou ， ni ke neng xiang qu kan yi kan 。]

english: They're largely made of barronite now, so they're a good source of the stuff.
translation: 它们现在主要由巴伦石制成，因此它们是这种材料的良好来源。 [ta men xian zai zhu yao you ba lun shi zhi cheng ， yin ci ta men shi zhe zhong cai liao de liang hao lai yuan 。]

english: Their cores are also very interesting. Apparently, the dwarves of the golem workshop once used old cores to craft runes. Maybe you could do the same.
translation: 他们的核心也很有趣。显然，傀儡工坊的矮人们曾经使用旧的核心来制作符文。也许你也可以这样做。 [ta men de he xin ye hen you qu 。 xian ran ， kui lei gong fang de ai ren men ceng jing shi yong jiu de he xin lai zhi zuo fu wen 。 ye xu ni ye ke yi zhe yang zuo 。]

english: Tell me more about the barronite mine.
translation: 告诉我更多关于巴伦石矿的信息。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu ba lun shi kuang de xin xi 。]

english: You'll find it to the north west. Unsurprisingly, it's the best place to find barronite in the city.
translation: 你会在西北边找到它。毫不奇怪，这里是城里寻找巴伦石的最佳地点。 [ni hui zai xi bei bian zhao dao ta 。 hao bu qi guai ， zhe li shi cheng li xun zhao ba lun shi de zui jia di dian 。]

english: At one time, our miners would work all through the day there to gather the barronite needed to power the Sacred Forge. That was a long time ago.
translation: 曾经，我们的矿工会在那里工作一整天，收集为神圣熔炉提供动力所需的男爵石。那是很久以前的事了。 [ceng jing ， wo men de kuang gong hui zai na li gong zuo yi zheng tian ， shou ji wei shen sheng rong lu ti gong dong li suo xu de nan jue shi 。 na shi hen jiu yi qian de shi le 。]

english: If you're lucky, you might find other things while mining there. We were not the first to build a home beneath this mountain. Sometimes traces of an older civilization can be found.
translation: 如果幸运的话，您可能会在那里采矿时发现其他东西。我们并不是第一个在这座山下建造家园的人。有时可以找到更古老文明的痕迹。 [ru guo xing yun de hua ， nin ke neng hui zai na li cai kuang shi fa xian qi ta dong xi 。 wo men bing bu shi di yi ge zai zhe zuo shan xia jian zao jia yuan de ren 。 you shi ke yi zhao dao geng gu lao wen ming de hen ji 。]

english: What kind of traces?
translation: 什么样的痕迹？ [shen me yang de hen ji ？]

english: You might find some ancient relics encased within barronite. If you do, you can use the anvils here to crack open the deposits.
translation: 您可能会发现一些古老的遗物被包裹在巴伦石中。如果你这样做了，你可以使用这里的铁砧来敲开沉积物。 [nin ke neng hui fa xian yi xie gu lao de yi wu bei bao guo zai ba lun shi zhong 。 ru guo ni zhe yang zuo le ， ni ke yi shi yong zhe li de tie zhen lai qiao kai chen ji wu 。]

english: The relics are of no interest to me. Maybe some of your race would find them interesting.
translation: 这些遗迹对我来说毫无兴趣。也许你们的某些种族会觉得它们很有趣。 [zhe xie yi ji dui wo lai shuo hao wu xing qu 。 ye xu ni men de mou xie zhong zu hui jue de ta men hen you qu 。]

english: Tell me more about the offering altar.
translation: 告诉我更多关于祭坛的事。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu ji tan de shi 。]

english: You'll find it to the south west. It's not something that ever interested me, but most of my kind were followers of Saradomin - the god of order and wisdom.
translation: 你会在西南方找到它。这并不是我感兴趣的事情，但我的大多数同类都是萨拉多明——秩序与智慧之神——的追随者。 [ni hui zai xi nan fang zhao dao ta 。 zhe bing bu shi wo gan xing qu de shi qing ， dan wo de da duo shu tong lei dou shi sa la duo ming —— zhi xu yu zhi hui zhi shen —— de zhui sui zhe 。]

english: Many of my kin would visit the altar to make offerings in his name.
translation: 我的许多亲戚都会去祭坛以他的名义献祭。 [wo de xu duo qin qi du hui qu ji tan yi ta de ming yi xian ji 。]

english: First, they'd catch fish from the nearby reservoir. Next, they'd ritually prepare them at tables by the altar. Finally, they'd use the altar to offer the fish.
translation: 首先，他们从附近的水库捕鱼。接下来，他们会在祭坛旁的桌子上按仪式准备它们。最后，他们会用祭坛来供奉鱼。 [shou xian ， ta men cong fu jin de shui ku bu yu 。 jie xia lai ， ta men hui zai ji tan pang de zhuo zi shang an yi shi zhun bei ta men 。 zui hou ， ta men hui yong ji tan lai gong feng yu 。]

english: There's plenty of barronite to be found within the reservoir, so it might be worth checking out. Be warned though: worshipping gods never did my kind any good.
translation: 水库中发现了大量的重菱石，因此可能值得一探究竟。但请注意：崇拜神灵对我族没有任何好处。 [shui ku zhong fa xian le da liang de zhong ling shi ， yin ci ke neng zhi de yi tan jiu jing 。 dan qing zhu yi ： chong bai shen ling dui wo zu mei you ren he hao chu 。]

english: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们来谈谈别的事情吧。 [wo men lai tan tan bie de shi qing ba 。]

english: Very well.
translation: 很好。 [hen hao 。]

english: I have something I'd like you to examine.
translation: 我有件事想让你检查一下。 [wo you jian shi xiang rang ni jian cha yi xia 。]

english: Well hand it over and I'll take a look.
translation: 好吧，交给我来看看。 [hao ba ， jiao gei wo lai kan kan 。]

english: Use an item on Ramarno for him to examine it.
translation: 使用拉玛诺身上的一个物品让他检查。 [shi yong la ma nuo shen shang de yi ge wu pin rang ta jian cha 。]

english: What happened to the other Imcando Dwarves?
translation: 其他伊姆坎多矮人怎么了？ [qi ta yi mu kan duo ai ren zen me le ？]

english: Ah... It's a tough tale to tell. Even though it's been many years since the last of my kin died out, the memory is still fresh.
translation: 啊……这是一个很难讲的故事。尽管我最后一个亲人去世已经很多年了，但我的记忆仍然清晰。 [a …… zhe shi yi ge hen nan jiang de gu shi 。 jin guan wo zui hou yi ge qin ren qu shi yi jing hen duo nian le ， dan wo de ji yi reng ran qing xi 。]

english: You don't have to tell me if the memory hurts too much.
translation: 如果记忆太伤人，你不必告诉我。 [ru guo ji yi tai shang ren ， ni bu bi gao su wo 。]

english: No, I will. The legacy of my kin must live on.
translation: 不，我会的。我亲属的遗产必须继续下去。 [bu ， wo hui de 。 wo qin shu de yi chan bi xu ji xu xia qu 。]

english: As you can see around you, Camdozaal was once a great city. Alive with the hum of activity. We dug deep into the mountain and reaped the rewards.
translation: 正如您在周围看到的那样，卡姆多扎尔曾经是一座伟大的城市。充满活动的嗡嗡声。我们向山深处挖掘，收获了回报。 [zheng ru nin zai zhou wei kan dao de na yang ， ka mu duo zha er ceng jing shi yi zuo wei da de cheng shi 。 chong man huo dong de weng weng sheng 。 wo men xiang shan shen chu wa jue ， shou huo le hui bao 。]

english: Our methods would often differ from other dwarves. Whereas they just used traditional smithing techniques, we would combine them with magic as well.
translation: 我们的方法常常与其他矮人不同。虽然他们只使用传统的锻造技术，但我们也将它们与魔法结合起来。 [wo men de fang fa chang chang yu qi ta ai ren bu tong 。 sui ran ta men zhi shi yong chuan tong de duan zao ji shu ， dan wo men ye jiang ta men yu mo fa jie he qi lai 。]

english: Alas, that was ultimately our undoing. We learned of a horde of barbarians pillaging across the land, hunting down and killing anyone who dared use magic.
translation: 唉，这最终导致了我们的毁灭。我们了解到，一群野蛮人在这片土地上进行掠夺，追捕并杀死任何胆敢使用魔法的人。 [ai ， zhe zui zhong dao zhi le wo men de hui mie 。 wo men liao jie dao ， yi qun ye man ren zai zhe pian tu di shang jin xing lve duo ， zhui bu bing sha si ren he dan gan shi yong mo fa de ren 。]

english: We underestimated them. We believed our weapons would be enough to keep us safe. We were wrong.
translation: 我们低估了他们。我们相信我们的武器足以保证我们的安全。我们错了。 [wo men di gu le ta men 。 wo men xiang xin wo men de wu qi zu yi bao zheng wo men de an quan 。 wo men cuo le 。]

english: The barbarians brought ruin upon Camdozaal. Most of my kind died as the city collapsed around them. Only a few of us survived until the end. Now, only I remain.
translation: 野蛮人给卡姆多扎尔带来了毁灭。当周围的城市倒塌时，我的大多数同类都死了。只有我们几个人活到了最后。现在，只剩下我了。 [ye man ren gei ka mu duo zha er dai lai le hui mie 。 dang zhou wei de cheng shi dao ta shi ， wo de da duo shu tong lei dou si le 。 zhi you wo men ji ge ren huo dao le zui hou 。 xian zai ， zhi sheng xia wo le 。]

english: The world has changed a lot, Ramarno. Magic is practiced freely. Those barbarians failed to wipe it from Gielinor.
translation: 世界已经发生了很大变化，拉玛诺。魔法可以自由练习。那些野蛮人没能把它从吉林诺身上抹掉。 [shi jie yi jing fa sheng le hen da bian hua ， la ma nuo 。 mo fa ke yi zi you lian xi 。 na xie ye man ren mei neng ba ta cong ji lin nuo shen shang mo diao 。]

english: I'm glad they didn't win, I suppose. But it doesn't change much for me. I am still the last Imcando Dwarf.
translation: 我想我很高兴他们没有获胜。但对我来说并没有太大改变。我仍然是最后一个伊姆坎多矮人。 [wo xiang wo hen gao xing ta men mei you huo sheng 。 dan dui wo lai shuo bing mei you tai da gai bian 。 wo reng ran shi zui hou yi ge yi mu kan duo ai ren 。]

english: Well... that isn't completely true.
translation: 嗯……这并不完全正确。 [n …… zhe bing bu wan quan zheng que 。]

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你是什​​么意思？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: While adventuring, I met another Imcando Dwarf called Thurgo.
translation: 在冒险时，我遇到了另一个叫瑟戈的伊姆坎多矮人。 [zai mao xian shi ， wo yu dao le ling yi ge jiao se ge de yi mu kan duo ai ren 。]

english: An Imcando Dwarf survived outside the city?
translation: 伊姆坎多矮人在城外幸存下来？ [yi mu kan duo ai ren zai cheng wai xing cun xia lai ？]

english: Yes. He looks to be doing quite well for himself. In fact, he seems to be a master of Smithing.
translation: 是的。他自己看起来做得很好。事实上，他似乎是一位锻造高手。 [shi de 。 ta zi ji kan qi lai zuo de hen hao 。 shi shi shang ， ta si hu shi yi wei duan zao gao shou 。]

english: I can't believe it. I hope to meet him one day. He must be a truly amazing smith to reach such heights.
translation: 我简直不敢相信。我希望有一天能见到他。他一定是一位真正了不起的铁匠才能达到这样的高度。 [wo jian zhi bu gan xiang xin 。 wo xi wang you yi tian neng jian dao ta 。 ta yi ding shi yi wei zhen zheng liao bu qi de tie jiang cai neng da dao zhe yang de gao du 。]

english: Well he's certainly an interesting dwarf.
translation: 嗯，他确实是一个有趣的侏儒。 [n ， ta que shi shi yi ge you qu de zhu ru 。]

english: Thank you, [player name]! You've given me hope that my kin can live on. If you need help with anything else, let me know.
translation: 谢谢你，[玩家姓名]！你给了我希望，让我的亲人能够活下去。如果您需要其他帮助，请告诉我。 [xie xie ni ，[ wan jia xing ming ]！ ni gei le wo xi wang ， rang wo de qin ren neng gou huo xia qu 。 ru guo nin xu yao qi ta bang zhu ， qing gao su wo 。]

english: Can I use the Forge?
translation: 我可以使用熔炉吗？ [wo ke yi shi yong rong lu ma ？]

english: I'm afraid not. The Sacred Forge is like none other in existence. Only an Imcando Dwarf could use it correctly.
translation: 恐怕不是。神圣熔炉独一无二。只有伊姆坎多矮人才能正确使用它。 [kong pa bu shi 。 shen sheng rong lu du yi wu er 。 zhi you yi mu kan duo ai ren cai neng zheng que shi yong ta 。]

english: What makes it so special?
translation: 是什么让它如此特别？ [shi shen me rang ta ru ci te bie ？]

english: Truth be told, I don't fully know. It's far older than I am. It was supposedly built in the earliest days of the city.
translation: 说实话，我并不完全知道。它比我年纪大得多。据说它是在这座城市最早建造的。 [shuo shi hua ， wo bing bu wan quan zhi dao 。 ta bi wo nian ji da de duo 。 ju shuo ta shi zai zhe zuo cheng shi zui zao jian zao de 。]

english: What I do know is that it's been imbued with powerful magic - some said that of the gods themselves. The Forge powers the entire city, or what's left of it at least.
translation: 我所知道的是，它充满了强大的魔法——有人说是诸神本身的魔法。熔炉为整个城市，或者至少是剩下的城市提供动力。 [wo suo zhi dao de shi ， ta chong man le qiang da de mo fa —— you ren shuo shi zhu shen ben shen de mo fa 。 rong lu wei zheng ge cheng shi ， huo zhe zhi shao shi sheng xia de cheng shi ti gong dong li 。]

english: I've been doing my best to keep it lit over the years. It's not a job I'm capable of any more though. That's why I'm hoping you can help.
translation: 这些年来我一直在尽最大努力让它保持点亮。但这不再是我能胜任的工作了。这就是为什么我希望你能提供帮助。 [zhe xie nian lai wo yi zhi zai jin zui da nu li rang ta bao chi dian liang 。 dan zhe bu zai shi wo neng sheng ren de gong zuo le 。 zhe jiu shi wei shen me wo xi wang ni neng ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: Bring me any barronite you find. In return, I can channel enough power from the Forge into the city or even open the Great Vault.
translation: 把你找到的男爵贵族带给我。作为回报，我可以将足够的力量从熔炉输送到城市，甚至打开伟大的金库。 [ba ni zhao dao de nan jue gui zu dai gei wo 。 zuo wei hui bao ， wo ke yi jiang zu gou de li liang cong rong lu shu song dao cheng shi ， shen zhi da kai wei da de jin ku 。]

english: What will powering the city do?
translation: 为城市供电有何作用？ [wei cheng shi gong dian you he zuo yong ？]

english: From what I can tell, my ancestors linked the Forge to the entire city.
translation: 据我所知，我的祖先将熔炉与整个城市联系起来。 [ju wo suo zhi ， wo de zu xian jiang rong lu yu zheng ge cheng shi lian xi qi lai 。]

english: It truly is the heart of this place. From it, I can channel any barronite you have into empowering different aspects of the city.
translation: 它确实是这个地方的中心。从中，我可以引导您拥有的任何男爵为城市的各个方面赋能。 [ta que shi shi zhe ge di fang de zhong xin 。 cong zhong ， wo ke yi yin dao nin yong you de ren he nan jue wei cheng shi de ge ge fang mian fu neng 。]

english: What will that do?
translation: 那会做什么呢？ [na hui zuo shen me ne ？]

english: The Sacred Forge is a strange beast, but with its arcane power, you'll see an improvement to the various activities you can do in the city.
translation: 神圣熔炉是一种奇怪的野兽，但凭借其神秘力量，你会看到你在城市中可以进行的各种活动得到了改善。 [shen sheng rong lu shi yi zhong qi guai de ye shou ， dan ping jie qi shen mi li liang ， ni hui kan dao ni zai cheng shi zhong ke yi jin xing de ge zhong huo dong de dao le gai shan 。]

english: Would you like to take a look?
translation: 您想看一下吗？ [nin xiang kan yi xia ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Very well. Anything else you'd like to talk about?
translation: 很好。您还有什么想谈的吗？ [hen hao 。 nin hai you shen me xiang tan de ma ？]

english: What is the Great Vault?
translation: 什么是大金库？ [shen me shi da jin ku ？]

english: It's one of the many marvels of this city. We used it to store our greatest creations, along with our most interesting finds.
translation: 这是这座城市的众多奇迹之一。我们用它来存储我们最伟大的创作以及我们最有趣的发现。 [zhe shi zhe zuo cheng shi de zhong duo qi ji zhi yi 。 wo men yong ta lai cun chu wo men zui wei da de chuang zuo yi ji wo men zui you qu de fa xian 。]

english: Of course, I have no use for those treasures myself. I'd happily give them up to keep the Sacred Forge alive.
translation: 当然，这些宝物我自己并没有什么用处。我很乐意放弃它们以保持神圣熔炉的活力。 [dang ran ， zhe xie bao wu wo zi ji bing mei you shen me yong chu 。 wo hen le yi fang qi ta men yi bao chi shen sheng rong lu de huo li 。]

english: Now be warned - I won't be able to channel much power into the Vault. I can't afford to waste too much barronite. You'll only have a limited amount of time in there.
translation: 现在请注意——我将无法向避难所输送太多能量。我不能浪费太多的男爵石。你在那里的时间有限。 [xian zai qing zhu yi —— wo jiang wu fa xiang bi nan suo shu song tai duo neng liang 。 wo bu neng lang fei tai duo de nan jue shi 。 ni zai na li de shi jian you xian 。]

english: Not only that, there's an automatic security system that activates if power to the Vault is lost. If that happens, you'll be removed. I imagine any treasures would be lost as well.
translation: 不仅如此，如果 Vault 断电，还有一个自动安全系统会激活。如果发生这种情况，您将被删除。我想任何宝藏也会丢失。 [bu jin ru ci ， ru guo  Vault  duan dian ， hai you yi ge zi dong an quan xi tong hui ji huo 。 ru guo fa sheng zhe zhong qing kuang ， nin jiang bei shan chu 。 wo xiang ren he bao zang ye hui diu shi 。]

english: How much barronite do you need to power it?
translation: 你需要多少巴伦石来为其提供动力？ [ni xu yao duo shao ba lun shi lai wei qi ti gong dong li ？]

english: Hmm, for a minute, I suppose 750 barronite shards should do the trick.
translation: 嗯，暂时来说，我想 750 个巴伦石碎片应该可以解决问题。 [n ， zan shi lai shuo ， wo xiang  750  ge ba lun shi sui pian ying gai ke yi jie jue wen ti 。]

english: If you do go in, I'd suggest heading to the back first. That's where the most valuable things are kept.
translation: 如果要进去的话，我建议先到后面去。那是最有价值的东西保存的地方。 [ru guo yao jin qu de hua ， wo jian yi xian dao hou mian qu 。 na shi zui you jia zhi de dong xi bao cun de di fang 。]

english: Is there anything else you wanted to talk about?
translation: 您还有什么想谈的吗？ [nin hai you shen me xiang tan de ma ？]

english: Never mind, I have no questions for now.
translation: 没关系，我现在没有问题。 [mei guan xi ， wo xian zai mei you wen ti 。]

english: I'll be here if you change your mind. Take care [player name].
translation: 如果你改变主意我会在这里。保重[玩家姓名]。 [ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi wo hui zai zhe li 。 bao zhong [ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Can you make me a knight's sword?
translation: 你能给我做一把骑士剑吗？ [ni neng gei wo zuo yi ba qi shi jian ma ？]

english: A sword? Why do you need me to make you one?
translation: 一把剑？为什么需要我为你做一个？ [yi ba jian ？ wei shen me xu yao wo wei ni zuo yi ge ？]

english: I was told to find a Imacando dwarf to make a sword for me.
translation: 我被告知要找一个今坎多矮人为我打造一把剑。 [wo bei gao zhi yao zhao yi ge jin kan duo ai ren wei wo da zao yi ba jian 。]

english: I'm afraid there's not much I can do to help you [player name]. My lack of vision means I can't work an anvil like I used to.
translation: 恐怕我帮不了你[玩家姓名]。我缺乏视力意味着我无法像以前那样使用铁砧。 [kong pa wo bang bu liao ni [ wan jia xing ming ]。 wo que fa shi li yi wei zhe wo wu fa xiang yi qian na yang shi yong tie zhen 。]

english: Oh... that's a shame.
translation: 噢……真可惜。 [o …… zhen ke xi 。]

english: They were probably talking about someone else anyway. I don't think many surface dwellers remember the dwarves who lived in Camdozaal.
translation: 无论如何，他们可能正在谈论别人。我认为没有多少地表居民记得住在卡姆多扎尔的矮人。 [wu lun ru he ， ta men ke neng zheng zai tan lun bie ren 。 wo ren wei mei you duo shao di biao ju min ji de zhu zai ka mu duo zha er de ai ren 。]

english: Right, I'll see if I can find someone else to make one for me then.
translation: 好吧，那我看看能不能找人帮我做一个。 [hao ba ， na wo kan kan neng bu neng zhao ren bang wo zuo yi ge 。]

english: I found this encased within some barronite.
translation: 我发现它被包裹在一些巴伦石中。 [wo fa xian ta bei bao guo zai yi xie ba lun shi zhong 。]

english: Ah, that looks like one of the relics from the civilization that lived here before Camdozaal was built.
translation: 啊，这看起来像是卡姆多扎尔建成之前居住在这里的文明的遗迹之一。 [a ， zhe kan qi lai xiang shi ka mu duo zha er jian cheng zhi qian ju zhu zai zhe li de wen ming de yi ji zhi yi 。]

english: Do you want it?
translation: 你想要吗？ [ni xiang yao ma ？]

english: I have no use for it. Maybe one of your kind would find it interesting.
translation: 我没有用它。也许你们中的某个人会觉得这很有趣。 [wo mei you yong ta 。 ye xu ni men zhong de mou ge ren hui jue de zhe hen you qu 。]

english: Hmm. Maybe.
translation: 唔。或许。 [wu 。 huo xu 。]

english: I found one of these deposits while mining.
translation: 我在采矿时发现了其中一处矿床。 [wo zai cai kuang shi fa xian le qi zhong yi chu kuang chuang 。]

english: Ah, a barronite deposit. You can use the anvils here to crack it open. If you're lucky, it might have something inside.
translation: 啊，巴伦石矿床。您可以使用此处的铁砧将其打开。运气好的话，里面可能有东西。 [a ， ba lun shi kuang chuang 。 nin ke yi shi yong ci chu de tie zhen jiang qi da kai 。 yun qi hao de hua ， li mian ke neng you dong xi 。]

english: I have some barronite shards.
translation: 我有一些巴伦石碎片。 [wo you yi xie ba lun shi sui pian 。]

english: I could feed those shards into the Sacred Forge now, and keep their power for you to use later if you'd like?
translation: 我现在可以将这些碎片送入神圣熔炉，并保留它们的力量供你以后使用（如果你愿意的话）？ [wo xian zai ke yi jiang zhe xie sui pian song ru shen sheng rong lu ， bing bao liu ta men de li liang gong ni yi hou shi yong （ ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ）？]

english: What can I use the power from the Forge for?
translation: 我可以使用熔炉的力量做什么？ [wo ke yi shi yong rong lu de li liang zuo shen me ？]

english: Well there's a few things we could do with that.
translation: 嗯，我们可以用它做一些事情。 [n ， wo men ke yi yong ta zuo yi xie shi qing 。]

english: Well just bring it back if you change your mind.
translation: 如果你改变主意，就把它带回来吧。 [ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， jiu ba ta dai hui lai ba 。]

english: I found this bit of barronite.
translation: 我发现了这块巴伦石。 [wo fa xian le zhe kuai ba lun shi 。]

english: That looks like part of a weapon. Hmm, I might be able to make something out of it. You'll need to have all the right pieces... and 1,500 barronite shards or if you'd prefer, I can smelt it down for Barronite shards?
translation: 这看起来像是武器的一部分。嗯，也许我能从中做点什么。你需要拥有所有合适的碎片……以及 1,500 个巴伦石碎片，或者如果你愿意，我可以将其熔炼成巴伦石碎片？ [zhe kan qi lai xiang shi wu qi de yi bu fen 。 n ， ye xu wo neng cong zhong zuo dian shen me 。 ni xu yao yong you suo you he shi de sui pian …… yi ji  1,500  ge ba lun shi sui pian ， huo zhe ru guo ni yuan yi ， wo ke yi jiang qi rong lian cheng ba lun shi sui pian ？]

english: You need a Barronite [piece] and 1500 barronite shards.
translation: 您需要一块巴伦石[碎片]和 1500 个巴伦石碎片。 [nin xu yao yi kuai ba lun shi [ sui pian ] he  1500  ge ba lun shi sui pian 。]

english: Come back with all the parts, and I'll happily knock something up for you.
translation: 带着所有零件回来，我很乐意为你敲一些东西。 [dai zhe suo you ling jian hui lai ， wo hen le yi wei ni qiao yi xie dong xi 。]

english: You have all the parts I need. Give me a second, and I'll fix it up for you.
translation: 你有我需要的所有零件。请稍等一下，我会为您解决。 [ni you wo xu yao de suo you ling jian 。 qing shao deng yi xia ， wo hui wei nin jie jue 。]

english: There you go, one Barronite Mace. Should come in handy when killing the golems around here.
translation: 给你，一把巴朗尼特狼牙棒。杀死附近的魔像时应该会派上用场。 [gei ni ， yi ba ba lang ni te lang ya bang 。 sha si fu jin de mo xiang shi ying gai hui pai shang yong chang 。]

english: Alright then, I can smelt that down for 100 Barronite shards.
translation: 好吧，我可以用 100 个巴伦尼特碎片来熔炼它。 [hao ba ， wo ke yi yong  100  ge ba lun ni te sui pian lai rong lian ta 。]

english: There you go. I can add those shards straight to the Forge as well if you'd like.
translation: 就这样吧。如果您愿意，我也可以将这些碎片直接添加到熔炉中。 [jiu zhe yang ba 。 ru guo nin yuan yi ， wo ye ke yi jiang zhe xie sui pian zhi jie tian jia dao rong lu zhong 。]

english: Go ahead, that'd be great.
translation: 继续吧，那就太好了。 [ji xu ba ， na jiu tai hao le 。]

english: There you go, that's all done.
translation: 到这里，一切就完成了。 [dao zhe li ， yi qie jiu wan cheng le 。]

english: No thanks I'll hold onto them.
translation: 不，谢谢，我会抓住它们。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo hui zhua zhu ta men 。]

english: No problem, come back to me if you find anything else of interest.
translation: 没问题，如果您发现其他感兴趣的内容，请回来找我。 [mei wen ti ， ru guo nin fa xian qi ta gan xing qu de nei rong ， qing hui lai zhao wo 。]

english: No thank you, I'll hold onto it.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我会坚持下去的。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo hui jian chi xia qu de 。]

english: I'll hold onto it for now.
translation: 我暂时保留一下。 [wo zan shi bao liu yi xia 。]

english: What's this mace good for?
translation: 这锤子有什么用？ [zhe chui zi you shen me yong ？]

english: I reckon you could give one of those golems a nasty whack with that thing.
translation: 我想你可以用那个东西狠狠地敲击其中一个傀儡。 [wo xiang ni ke yi yong na ge dong xi hen hen di qiao ji qi zhong yi ge kui lei 。]

english: I found this broken hammer within a barronite deposit.
translation: 我在亚伦石矿床中发现了这把破碎的锤子。 [wo zai ya lun shi kuang chuang zhong fa xian le zhe ba po sui de chui zi 。]

english: Ah, the Imcando Hammer. A very useful tool for Smithing and Construction. I could repair it for 1,250 barronite shards if you like or if you'd prefer, I can smelt it down for Barronite shards?
translation: 啊，伊姆坎多锤子。对于锻造和建筑来说非常有用的工具。如果你愿意的话，我可以用 1,250 个巴伦石碎片来修复它，或者如果你愿意，我可以将它熔炼下来以获得巴伦石碎片？ [a ， yi mu kan duo chui zi 。 dui yu duan zao he jian zhu lai shuo fei chang you yong de gong ju 。 ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi yong  1,250  ge ba lun shi sui pian lai xiu fu ta ， huo zhe ru guo ni yuan yi ， wo ke yi jiang ta rong lian xia lai yi huo de ba lun shi sui pian ？]

english: You need 1250 barronite shards.
translation: 你需要 1250 个巴伦石碎片。 [ni xu yao  1250  ge ba lun shi sui pian 。]

english: Come back with the necessary items, and I'll happily repair the Imcando Hammer for you.
translation: 带上必要的物品回来，我很乐意为你修理伊姆坎多锤子。 [dai shang bi yao de wu pin hui lai ， wo hen le yi wei ni xiu li yi mu kan duo chui zi 。]

english: Give me a second, and I'll fix it up for you.
translation: 请稍等一下，我会为您解决。 [qing shao deng yi xia ， wo hui wei nin jie jue 。]

english: All done! Here is your Imcando Hammer.
translation: 全部完成！这是你的 Imcando 锤子。 [quan bu wan cheng ！ zhe shi ni de  Imcando  chui zi 。]

english: Alright then, I can smelt that down for 350 Barronite shards.
translation: 好吧，我可以用 350 个巴伦石碎片来熔炼它。 [hao ba ， wo ke yi yong  350  ge ba lun shi sui pian lai rong lian ta 。]

english: The Imcando Hammer, one of my favourite tools for Smithing and Construction.
translation: Imcando 锤子是我最喜欢的锻造和建筑工具之一。 [Imcando  chui zi shi wo zui xi huan de duan zao he jian zhu gong ju zhi yi 。]

english: If you have no use for it, I could smelt it down for some Barronite shards?
translation: 如果你没用的话，我可以把它熔炼成一些巴伦石碎片？ [ru guo ni mei yong de hua ， wo ke yi ba ta rong lian cheng yi xie ba lun shi sui pian ？]

english: Alright then, I can smelt that down for 500 Barronite shards.
translation: 好吧，我可以用 500 个巴伦尼特碎片来熔炼它。 [hao ba ， wo ke yi yong  500  ge ba lun ni te sui pian lai rong lian ta 。]

english: No thanks I'll hold onto it.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我会坚持下去的。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo hui jian chi xia qu de 。]

english: I've brought you a redberry pie.
translation: 我给你带来了红莓派。 [wo gei ni dai lai le hong mei pai 。]

english: Why?
translation: 为什么？ [wei shen me ？]

english: Imcando dwarves love redberry pies. I thought you'd like one too.
translation: 伊姆坎多矮人喜欢红莓派。我以为你也想要一个。 [yi mu kan duo ai ren xi huan hong mei pai 。 wo yi wei ni ye xiang yao yi ge 。]

english: Can't say I've ever had one.
translation: 不能说我曾经拥有过一个。 [bu neng shuo wo ceng jing yong you guo yi ge 。]

english: Oh, well why don't you try it?
translation: 哦，那你为什么不尝试一下呢？ [o ， na ni wei shen me bu chang shi yi xia ne ？]

english: So, what did you think?
translation: 那么，你觉得怎么样？ [na me ， ni jue de zen me yang ？]

english: This is delicious! Where did you find such a excellent cuisine!
translation: 这真好吃！哪里找到这么棒的菜啊！ [zhe zhen hao chi ！ na li zhao dao zhe me bang de cai a ！]

english: I made it myself.
translation: 我自己做的。 [wo zi ji zuo de 。]

english: You're an brilliant cook [player name]! Just don't bring me too many of these, I'm trying to watch my weight.
translation: 你是一位出色的厨师[玩家名字]！只是不要给我带来太多，我正在努力控制体重。 [ni shi yi wei chu se de chu shi [ wan jia ming zi ]！ zhi shi bu yao gei wo dai lai tai duo ， wo zheng zai nu li kong zhi ti zhong 。]

english: Ah, [player name]. I'm sure you have plenty of questions. I will do my best to answer them.
translation: 啊，[玩家姓名]。我相信你有很多问题。我会尽力回答他们。 [a ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。 wo xiang xin ni you hen duo wen ti 。 wo hui jin li hui da ta men 。]

english: What can I do here?
translation: 我在这里能做什么？ [wo zai zhe li neng zuo shen me ？]

english: I have something to tell you. It's about another dwarf.
translation: 我有话要告诉你。这是关于另一个侏儒的。 [wo you hua yao gao su ni 。 zhe shi guan yu ling yi ge zhu ru de 。]

english: Another dwarf? An Imcando Dwarf?
translation: 另一个侏儒？伊姆坎多矮人？ [ling yi ge zhu ru ？ yi mu kan duo ai ren ？]

english: Yes. I encountered someone I believed to be a dwarf, but it was a lie. It was a Mahjarrat in disguise as someone called Ketla.
translation: 是的。我遇到了一个我认为是侏儒的人，但那是一个谎言。这是一个伪装成一个名叫凯特拉（Ketla）的马吉拉特（Mahjarrat）。 [shi de 。 wo yu dao le yi ge wo ren wei shi zhu ru de ren ， dan na shi yi ge huang yan 。 zhe shi yi ge wei zhuang cheng yi ge ming jiao kai te la （Ketla） de ma ji la te （Mahjarrat）。]

english: Ketla...
translation: 凯特拉... [kai te la ...]

english: You knew her?
translation: 你认识她吗？ [ni ren shi ta ma ？]

english: I did, long ago. Is she...
translation: 我很久以前就这么做了。难道她…… [wo hen jiu yi qian jiu zhe me zuo le 。 nan dao ta ……]

english: She's gone, Ramarno. I'm so sorry.
translation: 她走了，拉玛诺。我很抱歉。 [ta zou le ， la ma nuo 。 wo hen bao qian 。]

english: I see...
translation: 我懂了... [wo dong le ...]

english: I'm sorry, [player name], but let us not speak of this further. To learn of the death of another of my kin is no surprise, but it pains me all the same. I would prefer to focus my thoughts elsewhere.
translation: 抱歉，[玩家姓名]，我们不要再谈论这个了。得知我另一个亲戚的去世并不奇怪，但我仍然感到痛苦。我宁愿把注意力集中在其他地方。 [bao qian ，[ wan jia xing ming ]， wo men bu yao zai tan lun zhe ge le 。 de zhi wo ling yi ge qin qi de qu shi bing bu qi guai ， dan wo reng ran gan dao tong ku 。 wo ning yuan ba zhu yi li ji zhong zai qi ta di fang 。]

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: I have something I'd like you to examine.
translation: 我有件事想让你检查一下。 [wo you jian shi xiang rang ni jian cha yi xia 。]

english: What happened to the other Imcando Dwarves?
translation: 其他伊姆坎多矮人怎么了？ [qi ta yi mu kan duo ai ren zen me le ？]

english: Can I use the Forge?
translation: 我可以使用熔炉吗？ [wo ke yi shi yong rong lu ma ？]

english: I'll see you later.
translation: 稍后见。 [shao hou jian 。]

english: Tell me more about the golem workshop.
translation: 告诉我更多关于傀儡工作室的信息。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu kui lei gong zuo shi de xin xi 。]

english: Tell me more about the barronite mine.
translation: 告诉我更多关于巴伦石矿的信息。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu ba lun shi kuang de xin xi 。]

english: Tell me more about the offering altar.
translation: 告诉我更多关于祭坛的事。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu ji tan de shi 。]

english: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们来谈谈别的事情吧。 [wo men lai tan tan bie de shi qing ba 。]

english: What will powering the city do?
translation: 为城市供电有何作用？ [wei cheng shi gong dian you he zuo yong ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: What is the Great Vault?
translation: 什么是大金库？ [shen me shi da jin ku ？]

english: Never mind, I have no questions for now.
translation: 没关系，我现在没有问题。 [mei guan xi ， wo xian zai mei you wen ti 。]

english: Can you make me a knight's sword?
translation: 你能给我做一把骑士剑吗？ [ni neng gei wo zuo yi ba qi shi jian ma ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Construct the weapon.
translation: 建造武器。 [jian zao wu qi 。]

english: Convert into Barronite Shards.
translation: 转化为巴伦石碎片。 [zhuan hua wei ba lun shi sui pian 。]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: Repair the Imcando hammer.
translation: 修理伊姆坎多锤子。 [xiu li yi mu kan duo chui zi 。]

english: I have something to tell you. It's about another dwarf.
translation: 我有话要告诉你。这是关于另一个侏儒的。 [wo you hua yao gao su ni 。 zhe shi guan yu ling yi ge zhu ru de 。]

english: What do you want? I am busy supervising!
translation: 你想要什么？我正忙着监督呢！ [ni xiang yao shen me ？ wo zheng mang zhe jian du ne ！]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This is the Hosidius Kitchen. Here, under my expert eye, we prepare the food that feeds most of the population.
translation: 这是霍西迪乌斯厨房。在这里，在我的专家监督下，我们准备了大部分人口所需的食物。 [zhe shi huo xi di wu si chu fang 。 zai zhe li ， zai wo de zhuan jia jian du xia ， wo men zhun bei le da bu fen ren kou suo xu de shi wu 。]

english: Much of the income of Hosidius derives from trade in cooked food, so our work is vital.
translation: 霍西迪乌斯的大部分收入来自熟食贸易，因此我们的工作至关重要。 [huo xi di wu si de da bu fen shou ru lai zi shu shi mao yi ， yin ci wo men de gong zuo zhi guan zhong yao 。]

english: Can I cook here?
translation: 我可以在这里做饭吗？ [wo ke yi zai zhe li zuo fan ma ？]

english: Yes, you are most welcome to cook here. You may find you burn food less often under my supervision.
translation: 是的，非常欢迎您在这里做饭。您可能会发现在我的监督下您烧食物的次数减少了。 [shi de ， fei chang huan ying nin zai zhe li zuo fan 。 nin ke neng hui fa xian zai wo de jian du xia nin shao shi wu de ci shu jian shao le 。]

english: Why don't you do some work yourself?
translation: 你为什么不自己做点工作呢？ [ni wei shen me bu zi ji zuo dian gong zuo ne ？]

english: Excuse me? My cooking level is higher than you could imagine - I have already done my share of the work. Now, with my expertise, I am guiding future generations of chefs.
translation: 打扰一下？我的厨艺水平超乎你的想象——我已经完成了我的那份工作。现在，凭借我的专业知识，我正在指导未来几代厨师。 [da rao yi xia ？ wo de chu yi shui ping chao hu ni de xiang xiang —— wo yi jing wan cheng le wo de na fen gong zuo 。 xian zai ， ping jie wo de zhuan ye zhi shi ， wo zheng zai zhi dao wei lai ji dai chu shi 。]

english: I'll leave you alone.
translation: 我会让你独自一人。 [wo hui rang ni du zi yi ren 。]

english: Get more fish!
translation: 获得更多的鱼！ [huo de geng duo de yu ！]

english: Good, very good!
translation: 好，非常好！ [hao ， fei chang hao ！]

english: Now cook it!
translation: 现在煮吧！ [xian zai zhu ba ！]

english: Try not to burn this one.
translation: 尽量不要烧掉这个。 [jin liang bu yao shao diao zhe ge 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Can I cook here?
translation: 我可以在这里做饭吗？ [wo ke yi zai zhe li zuo fan ma ？]

english: Why don't you do some work yourself?
translation: 你为什么不自己做点工作呢？ [ni wei shen me bu zi ji zuo dian gong zuo ne ？]

english: I'll leave you alone.
translation: 我会让你独自一人。 [wo hui rang ni du zi yi ren 。]

english: Do you want to buy any armoured skirts? Designed especially for ladies who like to fight.
translation: 你想买装甲裙吗？专为喜欢战斗的女士设计。 [ni xiang mai zhuang jia qun ma ？ zhuan wei xi huan zhan dou de nv shi she ji 。]

english: No thank you, that's not my scene.
translation: 不，谢谢，那不是我的场景。 [bu ， xie xie ， na bu shi wo de chang jing 。]

english: Well done.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: You've [found a new clue/obtained a casket]!
translation: 你[发现了新线索/获得了棺材]！ [ni [ fa xian le xin xian suo / huo de le guan cai ]！]

english: Hi! I have this money off voucher!
translation: 你好！我有这张优惠券！ [ni hao ！ wo you zhe zhang you hui quan ！]

english: So I see! Unfortunately it seems to have expired yesterday! Nevermind.
translation: 所以我明白了！不幸的是昨天好像已经过期了！没关系。 [suo yi wo ming bai le ！ bu xing de shi zuo tian hao xiang yi jing guo qi le ！ mei guan xi 。]

english: But I only just got it!
translation: 但我才刚刚得到它！ [dan wo cai gang gang de dao ta ！]

english: I'm sorry, there's nothing I can do. Goodbye.
translation: 对不起，我无能为力。再见。 [dui bu qi ， wo wu neng wei li 。 zai jian 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thank you, that's not my scene.
translation: 不，谢谢，那不是我的场景。 [bu ， xie xie ， na bu shi wo de chang jing 。]

english: Welcome to my stall! Come and buy some tasty bread, freshly baked just 2 months ago!
translation: 欢迎来到我的摊位！快来买一些两个月前新​​鲜出炉的美味面包吧！ [huan ying lai dao wo de tan wei ！ kuai lai mai yi xie liang ge yue qian xin ​​ xian chu lu de mei wei mian bao ba ！]

english: Sounds delicious!
translation: 听起来很好吃！ [ting qi lai hen hao chi ！]

english: I think I'll pass.
translation: 我想我会通过的。 [wo xiang wo hui tong guo de 。]

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
translation: 嘿！把你的手拿开！ [hei ！ ba ni de shou na kai ！]

english: You just stole something from me!
translation: 你刚刚偷了我的东西！ [ni gang gang tou le wo de dong xi ！]

english: Guardsguards!
translation: 卫兵！ [wei bing ！]

english: Sounds delicious!
translation: 听起来很好吃！ [ting qi lai hen hao chi ！]

english: I think I'll pass.
translation: 我想我会通过的。 [wo xiang wo hui tong guo de 。]

english: Hey there adventurer, I am the Ranged combat tutor. Is there anything you would like to know?
translation: 嘿，冒险家，我是远程战斗导师。您有什么想知道的吗？ [hei ， mao xian jia ， wo shi yuan cheng zhan dou dao shi 。 nin you shen me xiang zhi dao de ma ？]

english: How can I train my Ranged?
translation: 我该如何训练我的远程？ [wo gai ru he xun lian wo de yuan cheng ？]

english: To start with you'll need a bow and arrows, you were given a Shortbow and some arrows when you arrived here from Tutorial island.
translation: 首先，你需要弓和箭，当你从教程岛到达这里时，你会得到一把短弓和一些箭。 [shou xian ， ni xu yao gong he jian ， dang ni cong jiao cheng dao dao da zhe li shi ， ni hui de dao yi ba duan gong he yi xie jian 。]

english: Alternatively, you can claim a training bow and some arrows from me.
translation: 或者，你也可以向我索取训练弓和一些箭。 [huo zhe ， ni ye ke yi xiang wo suo qu xun lian gong he yi xie jian 。]

english: Mikasi, the Magic Combat tutor and I both give out items every 30 minutes, however you must choose whether you want runes or ranged equipment.
translation: 魔法战斗导师米卡西和我每 30 分钟都会发放物品，但是你必须选择是想要符文还是远程装备。 [mo fa zhan dou dao shi mi ka xi he wo mei  30  fen zhong du hui fa fang wu pin ， dan shi ni bi xu xuan ze shi xiang yao fu wen hai shi yuan cheng zhuang bei 。]

english: To claim the Training bow and arrows, right-click on me and choose Claim, to claim runes right-click on the Magic Combat tutor and select Claim.
translation: 要领取训练弓箭，请右键单击我并选择领取，要领取符文，请右键单击魔法战斗导师并选择领取。 [yao ling qu xun lian gong jian ， qing you jian dan ji wo bing xuan ze ling qu ， yao ling qu fu wen ， qing you jian dan ji mo fa zhan dou dao shi bing xuan ze ling qu 。]

english: Not all bows can use every type of arrow, most bows have a limit. You can find out your bows limit by checking the Ranged skill guide.
translation: 并非所有弓都可以使用每种类型的箭，大多数弓都有限制。您可以通过查看远程技能指南来了解您的弓箭限制。 [bing fei suo you gong dou ke yi shi yong mei zhong lei xing de jian ， da duo shu gong dou you xian zhi 。 nin ke yi tong guo cha kan yuan cheng ji neng zhi nan lai liao jie nin de gong jian xian zhi 。]

english: If you do decide to use the Training bow, you will only be able to use the Training arrows with it. Remember to pick up your arrows, re-use them and come back when you need more.
translation: 如果您决定使用训练弓，您将只能使用训练箭。记住拿起你的箭头，重复使用它们，并在需要更多时再回来。 [ru guo nin jue ding shi yong xun lian gong ， nin jiang zhi neng shi yong xun lian jian 。 ji zhu na qi ni de jian tou ， chong fu shi yong ta men ， bing zai xu yao geng duo shi zai hui lai 。]

english: Once you have your bow and arrows, equip them by selecting their Wield option in your inventory.
translation: 拥有弓箭后，通过在库存中选择“使用”选项来装备它们。 [yong you gong jian hou ， tong guo zai ku cun zhong xuan ze “ shi yong ” xuan xiang lai zhuang bei ta men 。]

english: You can change the way you attack by going to the combat options tab. There are three attack styles for bows. Those styles are Accurate, Rapid and Longrange.
translation: 您可以通过进入战斗选项选项卡来更改攻击方式。弓的攻击方式分为三种。这些风格是准确的、快速的和远程的。 [nin ke yi tong guo jin ru zhan dou xuan xiang xuan xiang ka lai geng gai gong ji fang shi 。 gong de gong ji fang shi fen wei san zhong 。 zhe xie feng ge shi zhun que de 、 kuai su de he yuan cheng de 。]

english: Accurate increases your bows attack accuracy. Rapid will increase your attack speed with the bow. Longrange will let you attack your enemies from a greater distance.
translation: 准确可提高弓箭攻击的准确性。快速会提高你的弓攻击速度。远程攻击可以让你从更远的距离攻击敌人。 [zhun que ke ti gao gong jian gong ji de zhun que xing 。 kuai su hui ti gao ni de gong gong ji su du 。 yuan cheng gong ji ke yi rang ni cong geng yuan de ju li gong ji di ren 。]

english: If you need some more advice, you should talk to Adventurer Jon about Adventure paths. He may even have a handy starter kit you can use.
translation: 如果您需要更多建议，您应该与冒险家乔恩讨论冒险路径。他甚至可能有一个方便的入门套件供您使用。 [ru guo nin xu yao geng duo jian yi ， nin ying gai yu mao xian jia qiao en tao lun mao xian lu jing 。 ta shen zhi ke neng you yi ge fang bian de ru men tao jian gong nin shi yong 。]

english: You should know the basics of ranged combat by now, but if you are looking for somewhere to test your skills and make some money, you should try hunting Moss giants in Varrock sewers.
translation: 现在你应该了解远程战斗的基础知识，但如果你正在寻找地方来测试你的技能并赚点钱，你应该尝试在 Varrock 下水道中狩猎苔藓巨人。 [xian zai ni ying gai liao jie yuan cheng zhan dou de ji chu zhi shi ， dan ru guo ni zheng zai xun zhao di fang lai ce shi ni de ji neng bing zhuan dian qian ， ni ying gai chang shi zai  Varrock  xia shui dao zhong shou lie tai xian ju ren 。]

english: If you are lucky you might find a Mossy key, with this key you will be able to enter Bryophyta's lair. Make sure to bring plenty of food and good armour and weapons when you fight her as you will need it.
translation: 如果幸运的话你可能会找到一把长满青苔的钥匙，有了这把钥匙你就能进入苔藓植物的巢穴。当你与她战斗时，一定要带上足够的食物和好的盔甲和武器，因为你会需要它们。 [ru guo xing yun de hua ni ke neng hui zhao dao yi ba zhang man qing tai de yao shi ， you le zhe ba yao shi ni jiu neng jin ru tai xian zhi wu de chao xue 。 dang ni yu ta zhan dou shi ， yi ding yao dai shang zu gou de shi wu he hao de kui jia he wu qi ， yin wei ni hui xu yao ta men 。]

english: If yourlucky you might snag some goodies that you can sell for a decent profit.
translation: 如果你幸运的话，你可能会得到一些好东西，你可以出售它们以获得可观的利润。 [ru guo ni xing yun de hua ， ni ke neng hui de dao yi xie hao dong xi ， ni ke yi chu shou ta men yi huo de ke guan de li run 。]

english: If you are looking to do something different, visit the ranging guild over near Hemenster, there you can practice your archery and earn tickets for it at the same time.
translation: 如果您想做一些不同的事情，可以参观赫门斯特附近的射箭公会，在那里您可以练习射箭，同时赚取门票。 [ru guo nin xiang zuo yi xie bu tong de shi qing ， ke yi can guan he men si te fu jin de she jian gong hui ， zai na li nin ke yi lian xi she jian ， tong shi zhuan qu men piao 。]

english: You can then hand those tickets in for a variety of goods you can use to train your Ranged skill.
translation: 然后，您可以将这些门票交给各种物品，您可以用它们来训练您的远程技能。 [ran hou ， nin ke yi jiang zhe xie men piao jiao gei ge zhong wu pin ， nin ke yi yong ta men lai xun lian nin de yuan cheng ji neng 。]

english: If you are ever in the market for a new bow or some arrows, you should head on over to Lowe's Archery Emporium in Varrock. I can show you where the shop is if you like.
translation: 如果您想在市场上购买新弓或箭，您应该前往瓦罗克 (Varrock) 的劳氏射箭商场 (Lowe's Archery Emporium)。如果你愿意的话我可以告诉你商店在哪里。 [ru guo nin xiang zai shi chang shang gou mai xin gong huo jian ， nin ying gai qian wang wa luo ke  (Varrock)  de lao shi she jian shang chang  (Lowe's Archery Emporium)。 ru guo ni yuan yi de hua wo ke yi gao su ni shang dian zai na li 。]

english: No thanks
translation: 不，谢谢 [bu ， xie xie]

english: Is there anything else you want to know?
translation: 您还有什么想知道的吗？ [nin hai you shen me xiang zhi dao de ma ？]

english: Ahh the art of fletching. Fletching is used to create your own bow and arrows.
translation: 啊，羽毛的艺术。箭羽用于制造您自己的弓和箭。 [a ， yu mao de yi shu 。 jian yu yong yu zhi zao nin zi ji de gong he jian 。]

english: To create your bow and arrows you would need to gather some wood, feathers, arrow heads and bow string. The wood would be to make arrow shafts which can be turned into unstrung bows and arrow shafts.
translation: 要制作你的弓和箭，你需要收集一些木头、羽毛、箭头和弓弦。这些木材可以用来制作箭杆，箭杆可以变成未上弦的弓和箭杆。 [yao zhi zuo ni de gong he jian ， ni xu yao shou ji yi xie mu tou 、 yu mao 、 jian tou he gong xian 。 zhe xie mu cai ke yi yong lai zhi zuo jian gan ， jian gan ke yi bian cheng wei shang xian de gong he jian gan 。]

english: Unfortunately, Fletching is a member only skill so you will have to get your ranging supplies from shops or other players.
translation: 不幸的是，箭术是会员独有的技能，因此您必须从商店或其他玩家那里获取各种物资。 [bu xing de shi ， jian shu shi hui yuan du you de ji neng ， yin ci nin bi xu cong shang dian huo qi ta wan jia na li huo qu ge zhong wu zi 。]

english: It's quite simple really. You'll need an axe to cut some logs from trees and a knife. Knives can be found in and around the Lumbridge castle and in the Varrock General store upstairs.
translation: 这真的很简单。您需要一把斧子和一把刀来从树上砍下一些原木。在朗布里奇城堡内及其周围以及楼上的 Varrock General 商店中都可以找到刀具。 [zhe zhen de hen jian dan 。 nin xu yao yi ba fu zi he yi ba dao lai cong shu shang kan xia yi xie yuan mu 。 zai lang bu li qi cheng bao nei ji qi zhou wei yi ji lou shang de  Varrock General  shang dian zhong du ke yi zhao dao dao ju 。]

english: Use your knife on the logs. This will bring up a menu listing items you can fletch.
translation: 用你的刀在原木上。这将弹出一个菜单，列出您可以制作羽毛的项目。 [yong ni de dao zai yuan mu shang 。 zhe jiang dan chu yi ge cai dan ， lie chu nin ke yi zhi zuo yu mao de xiang mu 。]

english: For arrows you will need to smith some arrow heads and kill some chickens for feathers.
translation: 对于箭头，您需要锻造一些箭头并杀死一些鸡以获得羽毛。 [dui yu jian tou ， nin xu yao duan zao yi xie jian tou bing sha si yi xie ji yi huo de yu mao 。]

english: Add the feathers to your Arrow shafts to make Headless arrows, then use your chosen arrow heads on the Headless arrows to make your arrows.
translation: 将羽毛添加到您的箭杆上以制作无头箭头，然后在无头箭头上使用您选择的箭头来制作您的箭头。 [jiang yu mao tian jia dao nin de jian gan shang yi zhi zuo wu tou jian tou ， ran hou zai wu tou jian tou shang shi yong nin xuan ze de jian tou lai zhi zuo nin de jian tou 。]

english: Now for making bows. When accessing the fletching menu, instead of choosing Arrows shafts, you can make an unstrung bow instead.
translation: 现在开始制作弓。当访问箭羽菜单时，您可以制作未上弦的弓，而不是选择箭杆。 [xian zai kai shi zhi zuo gong 。 dang fang wen jian yu cai dan shi ， nin ke yi zhi zuo wei shang xian de gong ， er bu shi xuan ze jian gan 。]

english: To complete the bow you will need to get your hands on a Bow string.
translation: 要完成弓的制作，您需要将手放在弓弦上。 [yao wan cheng gong de zhi zuo ， nin xu yao jiang shou fang zai gong xian shang 。]

english: First you will need to get some flax from a flax field. There's one south of Seers' Village. Gather flax, then spin it on a spinning wheel, there's one in Seers' Village too.
translation: 首先，您需要从亚麻田中获取一些亚麻。先知村南边有一个。收集亚麻，然后在纺车上纺它，先知村里也有一个。 [shou xian ， nin xu yao cong ya ma tian zhong huo qu yi xie ya ma 。 xian zhi cun nan bian you yi ge 。 shou ji ya ma ， ran hou zai fang che shang fang ta ， xian zhi cun li ye you yi ge 。]

english: This makes bow strings which you can then use on the unstrung bows to make a working bow!
translation: 这样就制成了弓弦，然后您可以在未上弦的弓上使用它来制作工作弓！ [zhe yang jiu zhi cheng le gong xian ， ran hou nin ke yi zai wei shang xian de gong shang shi yong ta lai zhi zuo gong zuo gong ！]

english: Brilliant. If I forget anything I'll come talk to you again.
translation: 杰出的。如果我忘记了什么，我会再和你谈谈。 [jie chu de 。 ru guo wo wang ji le shen me ， wo hui zai he ni tan tan 。]

english: Certainly. If you pick up ammo that is the same ammo you are currently using, I can make that ammo automatically equip for you, providing you have space of course!
translation: 当然。如果你拾取的弹药与你当前使用的弹药相同，我可以让该弹药自动为你装备，当然前提是你有空间！ [dang ran 。 ru guo ni shi qu de dan yao yu ni dang qian shi yong de dan yao xiang tong ， wo ke yi rang gai dan yao zi dong wei ni zhuang bei ， dang ran qian ti shi ni you kong jian ！]

english: Or you can leave it to going into your inventory like normal.
translation: 或者您可以像平常一样将其保留到您的库存中。 [huo zhe nin ke yi xiang ping chang yi yang jiang qi bao liu dao nin de ku cun zhong 。]

english: There you go! Your ammo will now automatically be equipped when you pick it up.
translation: 就这样吧！现在，当您拿起弹药时，​​它会自动装备。 [jiu zhe yang ba ！ xian zai ， dang nin na qi dan yao shi ，​​ ta hui zi dong zhuang bei 。]

english: There you go! Your ammo will now go to your inventory when you pick it up.
translation: 就这样吧！现在，当您拿起弹药时，​​它会进入您的库存。 [jiu zhe yang ba ！ xian zai ， dang nin na qi dan yao shi ，​​ ta hui jin ru nin de ku cun 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: I work with the Magic tutor to give out consumable items that you may need for combat such as arrows and runes. However we have had some cheeky people try to take both!
translation: 我与魔法导师合作，提供战斗中可能需要的消耗品，例如箭头和符文。然而，我们有一些厚脸皮的人试图两者兼得！ [wo yu mo fa dao shi he zuo ， ti gong zhan dou zhong ke neng xu yao de xiao hao pin ， li ru jian tou he fu wen 。 ran er ， wo men you yi xie hou lian pi de ren shi tu liang zhe jian de ！]

english: So, every half an hour, you may come back and claim either arrows OR runes, but not both. Come back in a while for arrows, or simply buy some.
translation: 因此，每半小时，您可以回来领取箭或符文，但不能两者兼而有之。过一会儿回来拿箭，或者干脆买一些。 [yin ci ， mei ban xiao shi ， nin ke yi hui lai ling qu jian huo fu wen ， dan bu neng liang zhe jian er you zhi 。 guo yi hui er hui lai na jian ， huo zhe gan cui mai yi xie 。]

english: If you had any room in your pack I'd give you a training bow. That's a shame. Come back when you do.
translation: 如果你的背包里还有空间，我会给你一把训练弓。太可惜了。当你回来的时候就回来吧。 [ru guo ni de bei bao li hai you kong jian ， wo hui gei ni yi ba xun lian gong 。 tai ke xi le 。 dang ni hui lai de shi hou jiu hui lai ba 。]

english: You already have some training arrows.
translation: 您已经有了一些训练箭头。 [nin yi jing you le yi xie xun lian jian tou 。]

english: If you had enough space in your inventory I'd give you some training arrows, come back when you do.
translation: 如果你的库存中有足够的空间，我会给你一些训练箭头，当你这样做时再回来。 [ru guo ni de ku cun zhong you zu gou de kong jian ， wo hui gei ni yi xie xun lian jian tou ， dang ni zhe yang zuo shi zai hui lai 。]

english: You already have a training bow.
translation: 你已经有了一把训练弓。 [ni yi jing you le yi ba xun lian gong 。]

english: If you had any room in your pack I'd give you a training bow. That's a shame. Come back when you do. If you had enough space in your inventory I'd give you some training arrows, come back when you do.
translation: 如果你的背包里还有空间，我会给你一把训练弓。太可惜了。当你回来的时候就回来吧。如果你的库存中有足够的空间，我会给你一些训练箭头，当你这样做时再回来。 [ru guo ni de bei bao li hai you kong jian ， wo hui gei ni yi ba xun lian gong 。 tai ke xi le 。 dang ni hui lai de shi hou jiu hui lai ba 。 ru guo ni de ku cun zhong you zu gou de kong jian ， wo hui gei ni yi xie xun lian jian tou ， dang ni zhe yang zuo shi zai hui lai 。]

english: How can I train my Ranged?
translation: 我该如何训练我的远程？ [wo gai ru he xun lian wo de yuan cheng ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: How do I create a bow and arrows?
translation: 如何制作弓和箭？ [ru he zhi zuo gong he jian ？]

english: Can you toggle my ammo to equip when I pick it up please?
translation: 当我拿起它时，你能切换我的弹药来装备吗？ [dang wo na qi ta shi ， ni neng qie huan wo de dan yao lai zhuang bei ma ？]

english: Automatically equip it.
translation: 自动装备吧。 [zi dong zhuang bei ba 。]

english: Place it in my inventory.
translation: 将其放入我的库存中。 [jiang qi fang ru wo de ku cun zhong 。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Hello friend. I wish to slay evil and avail them of their loot! Take me to Burgh de Rott!
translation: 朋友你好。我希望消灭邪恶并利用他们的战利品！带我去德罗特堡！ [peng you ni hao 。 wo xi wang xiao mie xie e bing li yong ta men de zhan li pin ！ dai wo qu de luo te bao ！]

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: 你准备好与那里的邪恶作斗争了吗？ [ni zhun bei hao yu na li de xie e zuo dou zheng le ma ？]

english: I think so? At least my heart knows courage and that should be sufficient for the meantime. I expect that when we get to Burgh de Rott, we'll be able to purchase suitable provisions.
translation: 我想是这样吗？至少我的心知道勇气，这应该足够了。我预计当我们到达罗特堡时，我们就能购买到合适的食物。 [wo xiang shi zhe yang ma ？ zhi shao wo de xin zhi dao yong qi ， zhe ying gai zu gou le 。 wo yu ji dang wo men dao da luo te bao shi ， wo men jiu neng gou mai dao he shi de shi wu 。]

english: But you do realise that the vampyres in Morytania are immune to everything except silver?
translation: 但你确实意识到莫里塔尼亚的吸血鬼对除了银以外的一切都免疫吗？ [dan ni que shi yi shi dao mo li ta ni ya de xi xue gui dui chu le yin yi wai de yi qie dou mian yi ma ？]

english: Er...well, I've not heard mention of that fact, but I have faith that Saradomin will provide the means to furnish me with suitable weapons when I reach Burgh de Rott.
translation: 呃……好吧，我没有听说过这个事实，但我相信萨拉多明会在我到达罗特堡时为我提供合适的武器。 [e …… hao ba ， wo mei you ting shuo guo zhe ge shi shi ， dan wo xiang xin sa la duo ming hui zai wo dao da luo te bao shi wei wo ti gong he shi de wu qi 。]

english: And if we happen to run into some vampyres on the journey down there?
translation: 如果我们在那儿的旅途中碰巧遇到吸血鬼怎么办？ [ru guo wo men zai na er de lv tu zhong peng qiao yu dao xi xue gui zen me ban ？]

english: I trust that you will help us to avoid them. You are a guide after all, aren't you? Anyway, you look like you can handle yourself. I presume you've fought such creatures before and won? How hard can it be?
translation: 我相信你会帮助我们避免它们。毕竟你是一个向导，不是吗？无论如何，你看上去能应付自如。我想你以前曾与这些生物战斗过并获胜吧？这有多难？ [wo xiang xin ni hui bang zhu wo men bi mian ta men 。 bi jing ni shi yi ge xiang dao ， bu shi ma ？ wu lun ru he ， ni kan shang qu neng ying fu zi ru 。 wo xiang ni yi qian ceng yu zhe xie sheng wu zhan dou guo bing huo sheng ba ？ zhe you duo nan ？]

english: It can be pretty difficult, actually. But you're right, I'll be your guide so I should be able to handle the situation.
translation: 实际上，这可能相当困难。但你是对的，我会成为你的向导，所以我应该能够处理这种情况。 [shi ji shang ， zhe ke neng xiang dang kun nan 。 dan ni shi dui de ， wo hui cheng wei ni de xiang dao ， suo yi wo ying gai neng gou chu li zhe zhong qing kuang 。]

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 你为什么想去 Burgh de Rott？ [ni wei shen me xiang qu  Burgh de Rott？]

english: I'm going down there to teach those vampyres a lesson or two. I've heard about the terrible conditions down there and I intend to put a stop to it.
translation: 我要去那里给那些吸血鬼一两个教训。我听说那里的情况很糟糕，我打算阻止它。 [wo yao qu na li gei na xie xi xue gui yi liang ge jiao xun 。 wo ting shuo na li de qing kuang hen zao gao ， wo da suan zu zhi ta 。]

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 如果我们在去罗特城堡的路上遇到敌人，你能保护自己吗？ [ru guo wo men zai qu luo te cheng bao de lu shang yu dao di ren ， ni neng bao hu zi ji ma ？]

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of enemies. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: 这么说吧，我有点经验，而且我很乐意对抗我的敌人。你不需要担心这个。 [zhe me shuo ba ， wo you dian jing yan ， er qie wo hen le yi dui kang wo de di ren 。 ni bu xu yao dan xin zhe ge 。]

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 我可以带你去伯格德罗特。 [wo ke yi dai ni qu bo ge de luo te 。]

english: Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: 嗯嗯，看来你有追随者了。我想如果让它独自徘徊的话，它可能会在这段旅程中迷路。等你的追随者安全了我们就离开吧。 [n n ， kan lai ni you zhui sui zhe le 。 wo xiang ru guo rang ta du zi pai huai de hua ， ta ke neng hui zai zhe duan lv cheng zhong mi lu 。 deng ni de zhui sui zhe an quan le wo men jiu li kai ba 。]

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: 哦真的吗？那太好了！到达目的地后我会给你一个小奖励。 [o zhen de ma ？ na tai hao le ！ dao da mu di di hou wo hui gei ni yi ge xiao jiang li 。]

english: Burgh de Rott Ramble begins
translation: Burgh de Rott 漫步开始 [Burgh de Rott  man bu kai shi]

english: Ok, which route should we take?
translation: 好的，我们应该走哪条路？ [hao de ， wo men ying gai zou na tiao lu ？]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: 啊，所以你想给我一些物资，嗯？让我打开背包。 [a ， suo yi ni xiang gei wo yi xie wu zi ， n ？ rang wo da kai bei bao 。]

english: This place is a bit grim. How can people live here?
translation: 这个地方有点严峻。人们怎么能住在这里？ [zhe ge di fang you dian yan jun 。 ren men zen me neng zhu zai zhe li ？]

english: Do you visit Burgh de Rott often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: 您经常访问 Burgh de Rott 吗？看来你很熟悉这条路。 [nin jing chang fang wen  Burgh de Rott  ma ？ kan lai ni hen shu xi zhe tiao lu 。]

english: When are we going to get to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 我们什么时候去 Burgh de Rott？ [wo men shen me shi hou qu  Burgh de Rott？]

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on. I have loot to get.
translation: 我们没有一整天的时间站着聊天；让我们继续努力吧。我有战利品要拿。 [wo men mei you yi zheng tian de shi jian zhan zhe liao tian ； rang wo men ji xu nu li ba 。 wo you zhan li pin yao na 。]

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than the opulet life styles forced on us adventurer types. I'd much rather be up to my eyes in mud and having a good fight!
translation: 哦，我讨厌这次旅行，但它比强加给我们冒险家类型的奥普莱特生活方式要好。我宁愿在泥里睁大眼睛，痛痛快快地打一场！ [o ， wo tao yan zhe ci lv xing ， dan ta bi qiang jia gei wo men mao xian jia lei xing de ao pu lai te sheng huo fang shi yao hao 。 wo ning yuan zai ni li zheng da yan jing ， tong tong kuai kuai di da yi chang ！]

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...
translation: 你没看到我正在被攻击吗... [ni mei kan dao wo zheng zai bei gong ji ma ...]

english: Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
translation: 谢谢，我会把这个放在脖子上。 [xie xie ， wo hui ba zhe ge fang zai bo zi shang 。]

english: Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Paterdomus. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: 天啊！看来我们得回帕特多莫斯了。我们过不了那座桥！ [tian a ！ kan lai wo men de hui pa te duo mo si le 。 wo men guo bu liao na zuo qiao ！]

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
translation: 哦，我相信我们能找到办法！ [o ， wo xiang xin wo men neng zhao dao ban fa ！]

english: Player completes the bridge event
translation: 玩家完成桥牌事件 [wan jia wan cheng qiao pai shi jian]

english: Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Paterdomus.
translation: 好吧，这已经被撕裂了……看起来我们无法越过这个沼泽。我们必须回到帕特多莫斯。 [hao ba ， zhe yi jing bei si lie le …… kan qi lai wo men wu fa yue guo zhe ge zhao ze 。 wo men bi xu hui dao pa te duo mo si 。]

english: Player completes the bog event
translation: 玩家完成沼泽事件 [wan jia wan cheng zhao ze shi jian]

english: Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: 嘿……太好了……你做得很好……我会关注你的。 [hei …… tai hao le …… ni zuo de hen hao …… wo hui guan zhu ni de 。]

english: Whahay...that was great!
translation: 哇……那太好了！ [wa …… na tai hao le ！]

english: But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 但我们现在真的应该出发了。 [dan wo men xian zai zhen de ying gai chu fa le 。]

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
translation: 哦，我相信我们能找到办法！ [o ， wo xiang xin wo men neng zhao dao ban fa ！]

english: Player completes the river event
translation: 玩家完成河牌事件 [wan jia wan cheng he pai shi jian]

english: That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: 太棒了！我也必须这样做。 [tai bang le ！ wo ye bi xu zhe yang zuo 。]

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 哇哈！那很棒！但我们现在真的应该出发了。 [wa ha ！ na hen bang ！ dan wo men xian zai zhen de ying gai chu fa le 。]

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
translation: 呃……那些气泡是什么？ [e …… na xie qi pao shi shen me ？]

english: This is scary!
translation: 这太可怕了！ [zhe tai ke pa le ！]

english: Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
translation: 啊啊啊，那应该是触手吧…… [a a a ， na ying gai shi chu shou ba ……]

english: Ahhh, two tentacles!
translation: 啊啊啊，两条触手！ [a a a ， liang tiao chu shou ！]

english: ...three tentacles!
translation: ……三根触手！ […… san gen chu shou ！]

english: I think I'm going to faint!
translation: 我想我要晕倒了！ [wo xiang wo yao yun dao le ！]

english: Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: 天啊！看看那只野兽！你得自己解决这件事！ [tian a ！ kan kan na zhi ye shou ！ ni de zi ji jie jue zhe jian shi ！]

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the Burgh de Rott. Here's your reward.
translation: 非常感谢您让我安全抵达 Burgh de Rott。这是你的奖励。 [fei chang gan xie nin rang wo an quan di da  Burgh de Rott。 zhe shi ni de jiang li 。]

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: 你准备好与那里的邪恶作斗争了吗？ [ni zhun bei hao yu na li de xie e zuo dou zheng le ma ？]

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 你为什么想去 Burgh de Rott？ [ni wei shen me xiang qu  Burgh de Rott？]

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
translation: 如果我们遇到敌人，你能保护自己吗……？ [ru guo wo men yu dao di ren ， ni neng bao hu zi ji ma ……？]

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 我可以带你去伯格德罗特。 [wo ke yi dai ni qu bo ge de luo te 。]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Greetings. If you are an experienced archer, you may want to visit the guild here...
translation: 问候。如果您是一位经验丰富的弓箭手，您可能想参观一下这里的公会...... [wen hou 。 ru guo nin shi yi wei jing yan feng fu de gong jian shou ， nin ke neng xiang can guan yi xia zhe li de gong hui ......]

english: Hey you can't come in here. You must be a level 40 ranger to enter.
translation: 嘿，你不能进来。您必须是 40 级游侠才能进入。 [hei ， ni bu neng jin lai 。 nin bi xu shi  40  ji you xia cai neng jin ru 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Good day.
translation: 再会。 [zai hui 。]

english: Good day, Your Royal Highness.
translation: 美好的一天，殿下。 [mei hao de yi tian ， dian xia 。]

english: Oi!
translation: 哎呀！ [ai ya ！]

english: Rahr!
translation: 拉尔！ [la er ！]

english: No!
translation: 不！ [bu ！]

english: Grr!
translation: 咕噜！ [gu lu ！]

english: Aargh!
translation: 啊啊！ [a a ！]

english: I'm a gonner!
translation: 我是个大佬！ [wo shi ge da lao ！]

english: It's no use, I'm done for!
translation: 没用的，我已经完蛋了！ [mei yong de ， wo yi jing wan dan le ！]

english: Uggh!
translation: 哎呀！ [ai ya ！]

english: Erm.. Da's very kindly of you creature!
translation: 呃……爸爸对你这个生物非常仁慈！ [e …… ba ba dui ni zhe ge sheng wu fei chang ren ci ！]

english: Hey you creature! Make me some stabbers! I wanna hunt da chompy?
translation: 嘿，你这个生物！给我弄点刺刀吧！我想追捕da chompy吗？ [hei ， ni zhe ge sheng wu ！ gei wo nong dian ci dao ba ！ wo xiang zhui bu da chompy ma ？]

english: Stabbers?
translation: 刺伤者？ [ci shang zhe ？]

english: For da stabbie chucker, I's wanna hunt da chompy! Da chompy is der bestest yummies for Rantz, Fycie and Bugs! Creature knows what Rantz wants... flyin' to stabbie da chompy!
translation: 对于da satbie chacker，我想猎杀da chompy！ Da chompy 是 Rantz、Fycie 和 Bugs 的最佳美味！生物知道兰兹想要什么……飞向大嚼子！ [dui yu da satbie chacker， wo xiang lie sha da chompy！ Da chompy  shi  Rantz、Fycie  he  Bugs  de zui jia mei wei ！ sheng wu zhi dao lan zi xiang yao shen me …… fei xiang da jue zi ！]

english: I think I understand. You want me to make some arrows for you?
translation: 我想我明白了。你想让我给你做一些箭头吗？ [wo xiang wo ming bai le 。 ni xiang rang wo gei ni zuo yi xie jian tou ma ？]

english: Yeah, is what Rantz sayed, make da stabbers for da stabby chucker!
translation: 是的，兰兹就是这么说的，为刺伤者制造刺伤者！ [shi de ， lan zi jiu shi zhe me shuo de ， wei ci shang zhe zhi zao ci shang zhe ！]

english: OK, I'll make you some 'stabbers'.
translation: 好吧，我给你做一些“刺刀”。 [hao ba ， wo gei ni zuo yi xie “ ci dao ”。]

english: Good you creature, you need sticksies from achey tree and stabbies from dog bones.
translation: 好家伙，你需要树上的胶粘物和狗骨头上的刺。 [hao jia huo ， ni xu yao shu shang de jiao zhan wu he gou gu tou shang de ci 。]

english: Er, make you're own 'stabbers'!
translation: 呃，让你成为自己的‘刺刀’！ [e ， rang ni cheng wei zi ji de ‘ ci dao ’！]

english: When I make 'stabbers', I pretend you chompy and practice on you!
translation: 当我做“刺伤”的时候，我会假装你有嚼劲，然后在你身上练习！ [dang wo zuo “ ci shang ” de shi hou ， wo hui jia zhuang ni you jue jin ， ran hou zai ni shen shang lian xi ！]

english: Hey deyr, t'anks for da chompy, it was scrumbly!
translation: 嘿，Deyr，感谢 da chompy，太混乱了！ [hei ，Deyr， gan xie  da chompy， tai hun luan le ！]

english: Hey, I hear you're giving away free hats!
translation: 嘿，我听说你要免费赠送帽子！ [hei ， wo ting shuo ni yao mian fei zeng song mao zi ！]

english: Huh, dat's a true thing but you's godda be da good shooter wiv da stabbie chucker and stick lotsa chompies for da hatsie.
translation: 哈，这是真的，但你一定是个优秀的射手，和刺刀查克一起，为哈特西吃很多东西。 [ha ， zhe shi zhen de ， dan ni yi ding shi ge you xiu de she shou ， he ci dao cha ke yi qi ， wei ha te xi chi hen duo dong xi 。]

english: What are the hats like?
translation: 帽子是什么样的？ [mao zi shi shen me yang de ？]

english: Huh der is this many colours...~ Rantz holds up six fingers.~ And der is dis many different hatsies... ~ Rantz holds up three fingers.~
translation: 嗯 der 这么多颜色...~ Rantz 举起了六个手指。~ der 是很多不同的帽子...~ Rantz 举起了三个手指。~ [n  der  zhe me duo yan se ...~ Rantz  ju qi le liu ge shou zhi 。~ der  shi hen duo bu tong de mao zi ...~ Rantz  ju qi le san ge shou zhi 。~]

english: Ok you's creature, here's da hatsies!~ Rantz shows you the hats. ~
translation: 好吧，你真是个生物，这是帽子！〜兰兹向你展示了帽子。 ～ [hao ba ， ni zhen shi ge sheng wu ， zhe shi mao zi ！〜 lan zi xiang ni zhan shi le mao zi 。 ～]

english: Huh der is this many colours:~ Rantz holds up six fingers. ~ And der is dis many different hatsies: ~ Rantz holds up three fingers. ~
translation: 嗯，有这么多颜色：~兰兹举起六个手指。 ~ der 是许多不同的帽子： ~ Rantz 举起三个手指。 ～ [n ， you zhe me duo yan se ：~ lan zi ju qi liu ge shou zhi 。 ~ der  shi xu duo bu tong de mao zi ： ~ Rantz  ju qi san ge shou zhi 。 ～]

english: How do I get a hat?
translation: 我如何获得帽子？ [wo ru he huo de mao zi ？]

english: If you creature shows me da bow wiv da notches on it, I'll give ya a flapper hat... is dat simple enough for you's creature?
translation: 如果你的生物向我展示了上面有刻痕的蝴蝶结，我会给你一顶时髦的帽子……这对你的生物来说足够简单吗？ [ru guo ni de sheng wu xiang wo zhan shi le shang mian you ke hen de hu die jie ， wo hui gei ni yi ding shi mao de mao zi …… zhe dui ni de sheng wu lai shuo zu gou jian dan ma ？]

english: How many Chompies do I have to stick?
translation: 我必须坚持多少个 Chompies？ [wo bi xu jian chi duo shao ge  Chompies？]

english: We'll dat's da fing wiv da hatsies, dey's many hatsies for da many chompies dat you stick. But you's godda get at least this many for a hat.~ Rantz flashes fingers at you, you think he means 30. ~
translation: 我们会戴帽子，给你很多帽子，让你坚持下去。但你天哪，一顶帽子至少得有这么多。~ Rantz 向你眨了眨手指，你认为他的意思是 30。~ [wo men hui dai mao zi ， gei ni hen duo mao zi ， rang ni jian chi xia qu 。 dan ni tian na ， yi ding mao zi zhi shao de you zhe me duo 。~ Rantz  xiang ni zha le zha shou zhi ， ni ren wei ta de yi si shi  30。~]

translation: 我们开始做吧！ [wo men kai shi zuo ba ！]

english: There's something I need to do first.
translation: 我有件事需要先做。 [wo you jian shi xu yao xian zuo 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Welcome to my home. Is there anything you wanted?
translation: 欢迎来到我家。有什么你想要的吗？ [huan ying lai dao wo jia 。 you shen me ni xiang yao de ma ？]

english: Nothing in particular. Got any sightseeing tips?
translation: 没什么特别的。有什么观光建议吗？ [mei shen me te bie de 。 you shen me guan guang jian yi ma ？]

english: No, I'm just a factory worker. Don't do tours.
translation: 不，我只是一个工厂工人。不要去旅游。 [bu ， wo zhi shi yi ge gong chang gong ren 。 bu yao qu lv you 。]

english: This doesn't look like a factory.
translation: 这看起来不像工厂。 [zhe kan qi lai bu xiang gong chang 。]

english: This is my home. I'm off-duty.
translation: 这是我的家。我下班了。 [zhe shi wo de jia 。 wo xia ban le 。]

english: That idiot Armod should never have burned his diary!
translation: 那个白痴阿尔莫德根本不应该烧掉他的日记！ [na ge bai chi a er mo de gen ben bu ying gai shao diao ta de ri ji ！]

english: Good day, traveller.
translation: 美好的一天，旅行者。 [mei hao de yi tian ， lv xing zhe 。]

english: And to you.
translation: 还有你。 [hai you ni 。]

english: Good to see you, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 很高兴见到你，[弗雷曼尼克名字]！ [hen gao xing jian dao ni ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！]

english: Hello there. You're a long way from home.
translation: 你好呀。你离家很远。 [ni hao ya 。 ni li jia hen yuan 。]

english: Well what sort of Fremennik are you if you don't travel! Besides, we heard this was the land to visit for breaking skulls and spilling blood!
translation: 如果你不旅行，你算什么弗雷曼尼克人！而且，听说这里是打碎头骨、流血之地！ [ru guo ni bu lv xing ， ni suan shen me fu lei man ni ke ren ！ er qie ， ting shuo zhe li shi da sui tou gu 、 liu xie zhi di ！]

english: Of course! Have you not visited the Colosseum? You won't regret it if you do.
translation: 当然！你没参观过罗马斗兽场吗？如果你这么做了，你不会后悔的。 [dang ran ！ ni mei can guan guo luo ma dou shou chang ma ？ ru guo ni zhe me zuo le ， ni bu hui hou hui de 。]

english: Hmm... I might have to check it out.
translation: 嗯...我可能得检查一下。 [n ... wo ke neng de jian cha yi xia 。]

english: Ha! As if you didn't know! We've heard about your exploits in the Colosseum! Maybe you'll see us next time you're there!
translation: 哈!就当你不知道一样！我们听说过你在斗兽场的功绩！也许您下次来的时候会见到我们！ [ha ! jiu dang ni bu zhi dao yi yang ！ wo men ting shuo guo ni zai dou shou chang de gong ji ！ ye xu nin xia ci lai de shi hou hui jian dao wo men ！]

english: Armour!
translation: 盔甲！ [kui jia ！]

english: Get your leather armour here!
translation: 在这里获取你的皮甲！ [zai zhe li huo qu ni de pi jia ！]

english: Leather!
translation: 皮革！ [pi ge ！]

english: Frog-leather!
translation: 青蛙皮！ [qing wa pi ！]

english: Hello stranger.
translation: 你好陌生人。 [ni hao mo sheng ren 。]

english: I'm in search of a quest.
translation: 我正在寻找一个任务。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yi ge ren wu 。]

english: Hmmm. I don't... believe there are any here...
translation: 嗯。我不……相信这里有…… [n 。 wo bu …… xiang xin zhe li you ……]

english: Let me think actually...
translation: 让我想想其实... [rang wo xiang xiang qi shi ...]

english: Ah yes. I know. If you look in a book called 'The Shield of Arrav', you'll find a quest in there.
translation: 啊，是的。我知道。如果你看一本叫做“阿拉夫之盾”的书，你会在那里找到一个任务。 [a ， shi de 。 wo zhi dao 。 ru guo ni kan yi ben jiao zuo “ a la fu zhi dun ” de shu ， ni hui zai na li zhao dao yi ge ren wu 。]

english: I'm not sure where the book is mind you... but I'm sure it's around here somewhere.
translation: 请注意，我不确定这本书在哪里……但我确定它就在附近的某个地方。 [qing zhu yi ， wo bu que ding zhe ben shu zai na li …… dan wo que ding ta jiu zai fu jin de mou ge di fang 。]

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: The Wise Old Man of Draynor Village sent you this message.
translation: 德拉诺村的智者老人给你发了这条消息。 [de la nuo cun de zhi zhe lao ren gei ni fa le zhe tiao xiao xi 。]

english: Ah, I am always delighted to hear from him. You would not imagine the depths of his wisdom!
translation: 啊，我总是很高兴收到他的来信。你无法想象他的智慧有多深！ [a ， wo zong shi hen gao xing shou dao ta de lai xin 。 ni wu fa xiang xiang ta de zhi hui you duo shen ！]

english: I'd give you a reward, but you don't seem to have any space for it. Come back when you do.
translation: 我想给你奖励，但你似乎没有任何空间。当你回来的时候就回来吧。 [wo xiang gei ni jiang li ， dan ni si hu mei you ren he kong jian 。 dang ni hui lai de shi hou jiu hui lai ba 。]

english: King Roald has been very generous with my salary, so I can spare you some coins for your trouble.
translation: 罗尔德国王对我的俸禄很慷慨，所以我可以给你一些硬币，以解你的麻烦。 [luo er de guo wang dui wo de feng lu hen kang kai ， suo yi wo ke yi gei ni yi xie ying bi ， yi jie ni de ma fan 。]

english: These little things seem to be everywhere these days! Perhaps you'd like them?
translation: 这些天这些小事似乎无处不在！也许你会喜欢它们？ [zhe xie tian zhe xie xiao shi si hu wu chu bu zai ！ ye xu ni hui xi huan ta men ？]

english: My old friend Aubury sent me some runes in return for some books he wanted. Perhaps you'd like them?
translation: 我的老朋友奥伯里寄给我一些符文，以换取他想要的一些书。也许你会喜欢它们？ [wo de lao peng you ao bo li ji gei wo yi xie fu wen ， yi huan qu ta xiang yao de yi xie shu 。 ye xu ni hui xi huan ta men ？]

english: Do you have anything to trade?
translation: 你有什么东西可以交易吗？ [ni you shen me dong xi ke yi jiao yi ma ？]

english: Only knowledge.
translation: 只有知识。 [zhi you zhi shi 。]

english: How much do you want for that then?
translation: 那你想要多少钱呢？ [na ni xiang yao duo shao qian ne ？]

english: No, sorry, that was just my little joke. I'm not the trading type.
translation: 不，抱歉，这只是我的小玩笑。我不是交易类型。 [bu ， bao qian ， zhe zhi shi wo de xiao wan xiao 。 wo bu shi jiao yi lei xing 。]

english: Ah well.
translation: 啊好吧。 [a hao ba 。]

english: What do you do?
translation: 你做什么工作？ [ni zuo shen me gong zuo ？]

english: I am the palace librarian.
translation: 我是皇宫图书管理员。 [wo shi huang gong tu shu guan li yuan 。]

english: Ah. That's why you're in the library then.
translation: 啊。这就是你在图书馆的原因。 [a 。 zhe jiu shi ni zai tu shu guan de yuan yin 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: Although I would probably be in here even if I didn't work here. I like reading. Someday I hope to catalogue all of the information stored in these books so all may read it.
translation: 即使我不在这里工作，我也可能会在这里。我喜欢读书。有一天，我希望将这些书中存储的所有信息编目，以便所有人都可以阅读。 [ji shi wo bu zai zhe li gong zuo ， wo ye ke neng hui zai zhe li 。 wo xi huan du shu 。 you yi tian ， wo xi wang jiang zhe xie shu zhong cun chu de suo you xin xi bian mu ， yi bian suo you ren dou ke yi yue du 。]

english: About that book... where is it again?
translation: 关于那本书……它又在哪里？ [guan yu na ben shu …… ta you zai na li ？]

english: I'm not sure where it is exactly... but I'm sure it's around here somewhere.
translation: 我不确定它到底在哪里……但我确定它就在这附近的某个地方。 [wo bu que ding ta dao di zai na li …… dan wo que ding ta jiu zai zhe fu jin de mou ge di fang 。]

english: Ok. I've read the book. Do you know where I can find the Phoenix Gang?
translation: 好的。我读过这本书。你知道哪里可以找到凤凰帮吗？ [hao de 。 wo du guo zhe ben shu 。 ni zhi dao na li ke yi zhao dao feng huang bang ma ？]

english: No, I don't. I think I know someone who might however.
translation: 不，我不。我想我知道有人可能会这样做。 [bu ， wo bu 。 wo xiang wo zhi dao you ren ke neng hui zhe yang zuo 。]

english: If I were you I would talk to Baraek, the fur trader in the market place. I've heard he has connections with the Phoenix Gang.
translation: 如果我是你，我会和市场上的毛皮商人巴拉克谈谈。听说他和凤凰帮有关系。 [ru guo wo shi ni ， wo hui he shi chang shang de mao pi shang ren ba la ke tan tan 。 ting shuo ta he feng huang bang you guan xi 。]

english: Thanks, I'll try that!
translation: 谢谢，我会尝试一下！ [xie xie ， wo hui chang shi yi xia ！]

english: What do you know about the Imcando dwarves?
translation: 您对伊姆坎多矮人了解多少？ [nin dui yi mu kan duo ai ren liao jie duo shao ？]

english: The Imcando dwarves, you say?
translation: 你说伊姆坎多矮人？ [ni shuo yi mu kan duo ai ren ？]

english: Ah yes... for many hundreds of years they were the world's most skilled smiths. They used secret smithing knowledge passed down from generation to generation.
translation: 啊，是的……数百年来，他们是世界上最熟练的铁匠。他们使用代代相传的秘密锻造知识。 [a ， shi de …… shu bai nian lai ， ta men shi shi jie shang zui shu lian de tie jiang 。 ta men shi yong dai dai xiang chuan de mi mi duan zao zhi shi 。]

english: Unfortunately, about a century ago, the once thriving race was wiped out during the barbarian invasions of that time.
translation: 不幸的是，大约一个世纪前，这个曾经繁荣的种族在当时的野蛮人入侵中被消灭了。 [bu xing de shi ， da yue yi ge shi ji qian ， zhe ge ceng jing fan rong de zhong zu zai dang shi de ye man ren ru qin zhong bei xiao mie le 。]

english: So are there any Imcando left at all?
translation: 那么伊姆坎多还剩下吗？ [na me yi mu kan duo hai sheng xia ma ？]

english: I believe a few of them survived, but with the bulk of their population destroyed their numbers have dwindled even further.
translation: 我相信他们中的一些人幸存下来，但随着大部分人口被摧毁，他们的数量进一步减少。 [wo xiang xin ta men zhong de yi xie ren xing cun xia lai ， dan sui zhe da bu fen ren kou bei cui hui ， ta men de shu liang jin yi bu jian shao 。]

english: They tend to keep to themselves, and they tend not to tell people they're descendants of the Imcando, which is why people think the tribe is extinct. However...
translation: 他们倾向于保守自己，也不愿意告诉人们他们是伊姆坎多的后裔，这就是为什么人们认为这个部落已经灭绝了。然而... [ta men qing xiang yu bao shou zi ji ， ye bu yuan yi gao su ren men ta men shi yi mu kan duo de hou yi ， zhe jiu shi wei shen me ren men ren wei zhe ge bu luo yi jing mie jue le 。 ran er ...]

english: ... you could try taking them some redberry pie. They REALLY like redberry pie. I believe I remember a couple living in Asgarnia near the cliffs on the Asgarnian southern peninsula.
translation: ...你可以尝试给他们吃一些红莓派。他们真的很喜欢红莓派。我想我记得一对夫妇住在阿斯加尼亚南部半岛悬崖附近。 [... ni ke yi chang shi gei ta men chi yi xie hong mei pai 。 ta men zhen de hen xi huan hong mei pai 。 wo xiang wo ji de yi dui fu fu zhu zai a si jia ni ya nan bu ban dao xuan ya fu jin 。]

english: What can you tell me about this brooch?
translation: 关于这枚胸针，你能告诉我什么吗？ [guan yu zhe mei xiong zhen ， ni neng gao su wo shen me ma ？]

english: I've never seen that symbol before. Where did you find it?
translation: 我以前从未见过这个符号。你在哪里找到的？ [wo yi qian cong wei jian guo zhe ge fu hao 。 ni zai na li zhao dao de ？]

english: In a cave beneath Lumbridge.
translation: 朗布里奇下方的一个山洞里。 [lang bu li qi xia fang de yi ge shan dong li 。]

english: Very odd. Have you any idea how it got there?
translation: 很奇怪。你知道它是怎么到那里的吗？ [hen qi guai 。 ni zhi dao ta shi zen me dao na li de ma ？]

english: A goblin might have dropped it.
translation: 它可能是妖精掉下来的。 [ta ke neng shi yao jing diao xia lai de 。]

english: I've never heard of a goblin carrying a brooch like this. But just a minute...
translation: 我从来没有听说过有妖精带着这样的胸针。但只要一分钟... [wo cong lai mei you ting shuo guo you yao jing dai zhe zhe yang de xiong zhen 。 dan zhi yao yi fen zhong ...]

english: The other day I filed a book about ancient goblin tribes. It's somewhere at the west end of the library, I think. Maybe that will be of some use.
translation: 有一天，我提交了一本关于古代妖精部落的书。我想它在图书馆西端的某个地方。也许这会有一些用处。 [you yi tian ， wo ti jiao le yi ben guan yu gu dai yao jing bu luo de shu 。 wo xiang ta zai tu shu guan xi duan de mou ge di fang 。 ye xu zhe hui you yi xie yong chu 。]

english: I've come from Hugi, he suggested that I speak to you.
translation: 我来自胡吉，他建议我和你谈谈。 [wo lai zi hu ji ， ta jian yi wo he ni tan tan 。]

english: Hugi? I haven't seen him for a long time! He's still in Keldagrim, is he?
translation: 休吉？我已经好久没见到他了！他还在凯尔达格林，是吗？ [xiu ji ？ wo yi jing hao jiu mei jian dao ta le ！ ta hai zai kai er da ge lin ， shi ma ？]

english: Perhaps I should go there again some day, now that humans are allowed in again.
translation: 既然人类再次被允许进入，也许有一天我应该再去那里一次。 [ji ran ren lei zai ci bei yun xu jin ru ， ye xu you yi tian wo ying gai zai qu na li yi ci 。]

english: I've come to ask you about the Imcando dwarves. Hugi says you might know something about them.
