translation: 我来是想向你询问有关伊姆坎多矮人的事情。胡吉说你可能对他们有所了解。 [wo lai shi xiang xiang ni xun wen you guan yi mu kan duo ai ren de shi qing 。 hu ji shuo ni ke neng dui ta men you suo liao jie 。]

english: Ah yes... the master smiths among the dwarves. They used secret smithing knowledge passed down from generation to generation.
translation: 啊，是的……矮人中的铁匠大师。他们使用代代相传的秘密锻造知识。 [a ， shi de …… ai ren zhong de tie jiang da shi 。 ta men shi yong dai dai xiang chuan de mi mi duan zao zhi shi 。]

english: I believe I remember a couple living in Asgarnia near the cliffs on the Asgarnian southern peninusla, but they DO tend to keep to themselves.
translation: 我想我记得有一对夫妇住在阿斯加尼亚南部半岛悬崖附近，但他们确实倾向于独来独往。 [wo xiang wo ji de you yi dui fu fu zhu zai a si jia ni ya nan bu ban dao xuan ya fu jin ， dan ta men que shi qing xiang yu du lai du wang 。]

english: They tend not to tell people that they're the descendants of the Imcando, which is why people think that the tribe has died out totally, but you may well have more luck talking to them if you bring them some
translation: 他们往往不会告诉人们他们是伊姆坎多的后裔，这就是为什么人们认为这个部落已经完全灭绝了，但如果你给他们带来一些东西，你可能会更幸运地与他们交谈 [ta men wang wang bu hui gao su ren men ta men shi yi mu kan duo de hou yi ， zhe jiu shi wei shen me ren men ren wei zhe ge bu luo yi jing wan quan mie jue le ， dan ru guo ni gei ta men dai lai yi xie dong xi ， ni ke neng hui geng xing yun di yu ta men jiao tan]

english: redberry pie. They REALLY like redberry pie.
translation: 红莓派。他们真的很喜欢红莓派。 [hong mei pai 。 ta men zhen de hen xi huan hong mei pai 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello Reldo.
translation: 你好，雷尔多。 [ni hao ， lei er duo 。]

english: Go on. Ask him.
translation: 继续。问他。 [ji xu 。 wen ta 。]

english: Ok, ok. I'm on it.
translation: 好吧，好吧。我正在做。 [hao ba ， hao ba 。 wo zheng zai zuo 。]

english: Do you know anything about Robert the Strong?
translation: 你知道关于强者罗伯特的事吗？ [ni zhi dao guan yu qiang zhe luo bo te de shi ma ？]

english: Hmm... wow... let me see... there is a mention of him in one of my books on the history of Gielinor.
translation: 嗯...哇...让我看看...我的一本关于吉林诺历史的书中提到了他。 [n ... wa ... rang wo kan kan ... wo de yi ben guan yu ji lin nuo li shi de shu zhong ti dao le ta 。]

english: Fourth Age... Popular Lore... Ah here we are, Robert the Strong! 'Not much is known about the hero called by the people of Asgarnia: Robert the Strong. Most folk tales describe him as being taller than the tallest human
translation: 第四纪元...流行传说...啊，我们来了，强者罗伯特！ “关于阿斯加尼亚人民所称的英雄：强者罗伯特，人们知之甚少。大多数民间故事都描述他比最高的人还高 [di si ji yuan ... liu xing chuan shuo ... a ， wo men lai le ， qiang zhe luo bo te ！ “ guan yu a si jia ni ya ren min suo cheng de ying xiong ： qiang zhe luo bo te ， ren men zhi zhi shen shao 。 da duo shu min jian gu shi dou miao shu ta bi zui gao de ren hai gao]

english: and far stronger than the strongest man. He wields a six foot tall longbow and travels with his faithful panther Odysseus. He is said to have had a personal crusade against the Dragonkin...'
translation: 并且比最强的人还要强大得多。他挥舞着六英尺高的长弓，与他忠实的黑豹奥德修斯一起旅行。据说他曾对龙族进行过个人讨伐……” [bing qie bi zui qiang de ren hai yao qiang da de duo 。 ta hui wu zhe liu ying chi gao de zhang gong ， yu ta zhong shi de hei bao ao de xiu si yi qi lv xing 。 ju shuo ta ceng dui long zu jin xing guo ge ren tao fa ……”]

english: Well that's everything we know about him and that is from folk tales.
translation: 嗯，这就是我们所知道的关于他的一切，而且都是来自民间故事。 [n ， zhe jiu shi wo men suo zhi dao de guan yu ta de yi qie ， er qie dou shi lai zi min jian gu shi 。]

english: Dragonkin?
translation: 龙族？ [long zu ？]

english: I'm coming to that. 'The stories tell of the Dragonkin being an intelligent race of bird like creatures that walked rather than used their wings. They are said to be immortal but cannot reproduce, because of this they
translation: 我正要讲这个。故事讲述了龙族是一种像鸟一样聪明的生物，它们会走路而不是使用翅膀。据说它们是不朽的，但不能繁殖，因此它们 [wo zheng yao jiang zhe ge 。 gu shi jiang shu le long zu shi yi zhong xiang niao yi yang cong ming de sheng wu ， ta men hui zou lu er bu shi shi yong chi bang 。 ju shuo ta men shi bu xiu de ， dan bu neng fan zhi ， yin ci ta men]

english: became very afraid of death and shunned all other races. The Dragonkin supposedly made corrupted versions of themselves for protection, what we now know as dragons.'
translation: 变得非常害怕死亡并回避所有其他种族。据说龙族为了保护而制造了自己的腐败版本，也就是我们现在所说的龙。 [bian de fei chang hai pa si wang bing hui bi suo you qi ta zhong zu 。 ju shuo long zu wei le bao hu er zhi zao le zi ji de fu bai ban ben ， ye jiu shi wo men xian zai suo shuo de long 。]

english: Doesn't sound very believable.
translation: 听起来不太可信。 [ting qi lai bu tai ke xin 。]

english: Very little is known about this early part of Gielinor, but unlike many scholars, I believe that folk tales are based on events that actually happened. It is the way history has been passed down generations before we had
translation: 人们对《吉林诺》的早期部分知之甚少，但与许多学者不同的是，我相信民间故事是基于实际发生的事件。这就是历史在我们之前世代相传的方式 [ren men dui 《 ji lin nuo 》 de zao qi bu fen zhi zhi shen shao ， dan yu xu duo xue zhe bu tong de shi ， wo xiang xin min jian gu shi shi ji yu shi ji fa sheng de shi jian 。 zhe jiu shi li shi zai wo men zhi qian shi dai xiang chuan de fang shi]

english: a way of recording it.
translation: 一种记录它的方式。 [yi zhong ji lu ta de fang shi 。]

english: Thank you Reldo, you've been most... helpful.
translation: 谢谢你，Reldo，你帮了我最大的忙。 [xie xie ni ，Reldo， ni bang le wo zui da de mang 。]

english: That was a nice tale for mothers to tell their children but I don't see how this helps Bob?
translation: 对于母亲们来说，这是一个很好的故事给她们的孩子听，但我不明白这对鲍勃有什么帮助？ [dui yu mu qin men lai shuo ， zhe shi yi ge hen hao de gu shi gei ta men de hai zi ting ， dan wo bu ming bai zhe dui bao bo you shen me bang zhu ？]

english: Don't you think it's odd that no one knows where Bob came from?
translation: 没人知道鲍勃来自哪里，你不觉得奇怪吗？ [mei ren zhi dao bao bo lai zi na li ， ni bu jue de qi guai ma ？]

english: I guess, but he's just a cat... right?
translation: 我猜，但他只是一只猫……对吧？ [wo cai ， dan ta zhi shi yi zhi mao …… dui ba ？]

english: I'd hoped you would've understood by now that there's more to cats than humans believe!
translation: 我希望你现在已经明白，猫的意义远比人类想象的要多！ [wo xi wang ni xian zai yi jing ming bai ， mao de yi yi yuan bi ren lei xiang xiang de yao duo ！]

english: Ok, ok! I get your point, after all I'm being dragged round Gielinor by... my cat!
translation: 好吧，好吧！我明白你的意思，毕竟我是被……我的猫拖着在吉林诺转来转去的！ [hao ba ， hao ba ！ wo ming bai ni de yi si ， bi jing wo shi bei …… wo de mao tuo zhe zai ji lin nuo zhuan lai zhuan qu de ！]

english: I wouldn't say dragged... let's call it a partnership!
translation: 我不会说拖累...让我们称之为伙伴关系！ [wo bu hui shuo tuo lei ... rang wo men cheng zhi wei huo ban guan xi ！]

english: Ok!
translation: 好的！ [hao de ！]

english: Bob?!
translation: 鲍勃？！ [bao bo ？！]

english: Let's ask Bob!
translation: 我们去问问鲍勃吧！ [wo men qu wen wen bao bo ba ！]

english: Let's go!
translation: 我们走吧！ [wo men zou ba ！]

english: Hello. I was wondering if you could help me with something.
translation: 你好。我想知道你能否帮我做点什么。 [ni hao 。 wo xiang zhi dao ni neng fou bang wo zuo dian shen me 。]

english: What do you need?
translation: 你需要什么？ [ni xu yao shen me ？]

english: I'm looking for information on a Fourth Age hero. His name was Tristan and he fought alongside Robert the Strong.
translation: 我正在寻找有关第四纪元英雄的信息。他的名字叫特里斯坦，他与强者罗伯特并肩作战。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao you guan di si ji yuan ying xiong de xin xi 。 ta de ming zi jiao te li si tan ， ta yu qiang zhe luo bo te bing jian zuo zhan 。]

english: Ah you must mean Tristan Corvo. I can't remember anyone ever asking about him before, most prefer to hear about the bigger heroes like Arrav or Robert.
translation: 啊，你一定是指特里斯坦·科尔沃。我不记得以前有人问过他，大多数人更喜欢听阿拉夫或罗伯特这样的大英雄。 [a ， ni yi ding shi zhi te li si tan · ke er wo 。 wo bu ji de yi qian you ren wen guo ta ， da duo shu ren geng xi huan ting a la fu huo luo bo te zhe yang de da ying xiong 。]

english: But you know about Tristan?
translation: 但你知道特里斯坦吗？ [dan ni zhi dao te li si tan ma ？]

english: Oh yes. What was it you wanted to learn?
translation: 哦是的。你想学什么？ [o shi de 。 ni xiang xue shen me ？]

english: I'd like to learn about his descendants. I know they lived in this area.
translation: 我想了解一下他的后代。我知道他们住在这个地区。 [wo xiang liao jie yi xia ta de hou dai 。 wo zhi dao ta men zhu zai zhe ge di qu 。]

english: Well we do have census records which date back to when the city was still called Avarrocka. I'm afraid we don't have anything from before that time though.
translation: 嗯，我们确实有人口普查记录，可以追溯到该城市仍称为阿瓦罗卡（Avarrocka）的时候。但恐怕我们没有在那之前的任何东西。 [n ， wo men que shi you ren kou pu cha ji lu ， ke yi zhui su dao gai cheng shi reng cheng wei a wa luo ka （Avarrocka） de shi hou 。 dan kong pa wo men mei you zai na zhi qian de ren he dong xi 。]

english: Hmmm. It might still be worth a look. Where can I find this information?
translation: 嗯。它可能仍然值得一看。我在哪里可以找到这些信息？ [n 。 ta ke neng reng ran zhi de yi kan 。 wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao zhe xie xin xi ？]

english: I have a book around here somewhere with all of the details, why don't you see if you can find it. It's red if I remember right.
translation: 我在这附近有一本书，里面有所有的细节，你为什么不看看是否能找到它呢？如果我没记错的话是红色的。 [wo zai zhe fu jin you yi ben shu ， li mian you suo you de xi jie ， ni wei shen me bu kan kan shi fou neng zhao dao ta ne ？ ru guo wo mei ji cuo de hua shi hong se de 。]

english: Have you found that book yet?
translation: 你找到那本书了吗？ [ni zhao dao na ben shu le ma ？]

english: I have it here.
translation: 我这里有。 [wo zhe li you 。]

english: Wonderful, let's have a look.
translation: 精彩，我们来看看吧。 [jing cai ， wo men lai kan kan ba 。]

english: So what does the book say?
translation: 那么书上是怎么说的呢？ [na me shu shang shi zen me shuo de ne ？]

english: Okay let's see... The Corvo family... Here we are! According to this there was a family by the name of Corvo living in Avarrocka for most of the Fourth Age.
translation: 好吧，让我们看看...科尔沃家族...我们来了！据此记载，在第四纪元的大部分时间里，有一个名叫科尔沃的家族生活在阿瓦罗卡。 [hao ba ， rang wo men kan kan ... ke er wo jia zu ... wo men lai le ！ ju ci ji zai ， zai di si ji yuan de da bu fen shi jian li ， you yi ge ming jiao ke er wo de jia zu sheng huo zai a wa luo ka 。]

english: The last entry is from the year 1770 of the Fourth Age.
translation: 最后一个条目来自第四纪元 1770 年。 [zui hou yi ge tiao mu lai zi di si ji yuan  1770  nian 。]

english: What happened to them?
translation: 他们怎么了？ [ta men zen me le ？]

english: Impossible to say for sure but it was around that time that many people left Misthalin to settle in Morytania. It's possible that the Corvo family was among them.
translation: 无法确定，但大约在那个时候，许多人离开米沙林到莫里塔尼亚定居。科尔沃家族很可能也在其中。 [wu fa que ding ， dan da yue zai na ge shi hou ， xu duo ren li kai mi sha lin dao mo li ta ni ya ding ju 。 ke er wo jia zu hen ke neng ye zai qi zhong 。]

english: I'm afraid that's all the help I can provide. Port Phasmatys is where most of the Morytania settlers wound up. Perhaps you'll find what you're looking for there.
translation: 恐怕这就是我能提供的全部帮助了。法斯马蒂斯港是大多数莫里塔尼亚定居者的落脚地。也许您会在那里找到您正在寻找的东西。 [kong pa zhe jiu shi wo neng ti gong de quan bu bang zhu le 。 fa si ma di si gang shi da duo shu mo li ta ni ya ding ju zhe de luo jiao di 。 ye xu nin hui zai na li zhao dao nin zheng zai xun zhao de dong xi 。]

english: Okay, thanks Reldo.
translation: 好的，谢谢雷尔多。 [hao de ， xie xie lei er duo 。]

english: I found it but then I lost it.
translation: 我找到了它，但后来我失去了它。 [wo zhao dao le ta ， dan hou lai wo shi qu le ta 。]

english: You lost it?
translation: 你把它弄丢了吗？ [ni ba ta nong diu le ma ？]

english: I'm sorry. I'm a terrible person.
translation: 对不起。我是一个可怕的人。 [dui bu qi 。 wo shi yi ge ke pa de ren 。]

english: Well you'd better find it again. These books are very valuable.
translation: 好吧，你最好再找到它。这些书非常有价值。 [hao ba ， ni zui hao zai zhao dao ta 。 zhe xie shu fei chang you jia zhi 。]

english: Not yet.
translation: 还没有。 [hai mei you 。]

english: I know it's around here somewhere. It's red if I remember right.
translation: 我知道它就在这附近的某个地方。如果我没记错的话是红色的。 [wo zhi dao ta jiu zai zhe fu jin de mou ge di fang 。 ru guo wo mei ji cuo de hua shi hong se de 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Did you have any luck finding the Corvo family?
translation: 你有运气找到科尔沃一家吗？ [ni you yun qi zhao dao ke er wo yi jia ma ？]

english: Port Phasmatys might be a good place to look. It's where most of the Morytania settlers wound up.
translation: 法斯马蒂斯港可能是一个值得一看的好地方。这是大多数莫里塔尼亚定居者的所在地。 [fa si ma di si gang ke neng shi yi ge zhi de yi kan de hao di fang 。 zhe shi da duo shu mo li ta ni ya ding ju zhe de suo zai di 。]

english: Hi Reldo, I have come to ask you to help with something.
translation: 嗨，Reldo，我来找你帮忙有件事。 [hai ，Reldo， wo lai zhao ni bang mang you jian shi 。]

english: What can I do for you [player name]?
translation: 我能为您[玩家姓名]做什么？ [wo neng wei nin [ wan jia xing ming ] zuo shen me ？]

english: You show Reldo your clue scroll.
translation: 你向雷多展示你的线索卷轴。 [ni xiang lei duo zhan shi ni de xian suo juan zhou 。]

english: Ah! Do you know about hot and cold clues?
translation: 啊!你知道冷热线索吗？ [a ! ni zhi dao leng re xian suo ma ？]

english: Yes, I do.
translation: 是的，我愿意。 [shi de ， wo yuan yi 。]

english: Well then use this strange device to feel where your destination is and dig.
translation: 那么就用这个奇怪的装置来感受你的目的地在哪里并挖掘吧。 [na me jiu yong zhe ge qi guai de zhuang zhi lai gan shou ni de mu di di zai na li bing wa jue ba 。]

english: You should make some room for it before I can give you it.
translation: 在我给你之前，你应该先腾出一些空间。 [zai wo gei ni zhi qian ， ni ying gai xian teng chu yi xie kong jian 。]

english: No, I don't.
translation: 不，我不。 [bu ， wo bu 。]

english: Ah, you use a strange device to tell you how far away you are from the place you need to be. When you get to your destination you dig.
translation: 啊，你用一个奇怪的装置来告诉你离你需要去的地方有多远。当你到达目的地时，你就开始挖掘。 [a ， ni yong yi ge qi guai de zhuang zhi lai gao su ni li ni xu yao qu de di fang you duo yuan 。 dang ni dao da mu di di shi ， ni jiu kai shi wa jue 。]

english: Hey Reldo, I have one of those clue scrolls again, do you have any advice?
translation: 嘿雷尔多，我又得到了其中一张线索卷轴，你有什么建议吗？ [hei lei er duo ， wo you de dao le qi zhong yi zhang xian suo juan zhou ， ni you shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: That strange device will guide you in the same way the key did. Feel it, but be careful as it is very powerful. Good luck.
translation: 这个奇怪的装置会像钥匙一样引导你。感受它，但要小心，因为它非常强大。祝你好运。 [zhe ge qi guai de zhuang zhi hui xiang yao shi yi yang yin dao ni 。 gan shou ta ， dan yao xiao xin ， yin wei ta fei chang qiang da 。 zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: I'm in search of a quest.
translation: 我正在寻找一个任务。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yi ge ren wu 。]

english: The Wise Old Man of Draynor Village sent you this message.
translation: 德拉诺村的智者老人给你发了这条消息。 [de la nuo cun de zhi zhe lao ren gei ni fa le zhe tiao xiao xi 。]

english: If the player receives coins:
translation: 如果玩家收到金币： [ru guo wan jia shou dao jin bi ：]

english: If the player receives seeds:
translation: 如果玩家收到种子： [ru guo wan jia shou dao zhong zi ：]

english: If the player receives runes:
translation: 如果玩家收到符文： [ru guo wan jia shou dao fu wen ：]

english: Do you have anything to trade?
translation: 你有什么东西可以交易吗？ [ni you shen me dong xi ke yi jiao yi ma ？]

english: What do you do?
translation: 你做什么工作？ [ni zuo shen me gong zuo ？]

english: What do you know about the Imcando dwarves?
translation: 您对伊姆坎多矮人了解多少？ [nin dui yi mu kan duo ai ren liao jie duo shao ？]

english: Ask about the brooch.
translation: 询问胸针的事。 [xun wen xiong zhen de shi 。]

english: Talk about something else.
translation: 说点别的吧。 [shuo dian bie de ba 。]

english: Ask about Imcando dwarves.
translation: 询问有关伊姆坎多矮人的事情。 [xun wen you guan yi mu kan duo ai ren de shi qing 。]

english: Ask about Robert the Strong.
translation: 询问强者罗伯特。 [xun wen qiang zhe luo bo te 。]

english: Ask about Tristan.
translation: 询问特里斯坦的情况。 [xun wen te li si tan de qing kuang 。]

english: Yes, I do.
translation: 是的，我愿意。 [shi de ， wo yuan yi 。]

english: No, I don't.
translation: 不，我不。 [bu ， wo bu 。]

english: Hello, my friend. Would you like me to show you the prices of logs?
translation: 朋友你好。您需要我向您展示原木的价格吗？ [peng you ni hao 。 nin xu yao wo xiang nin zhan shi yuan mu de jia ge ma ？]

english: You look like you've travelled a fair distance.
translation: 你看起来已经走了很远的距离。 [ni kan qi lai yi jing zou le hen yuan de ju li 。]

english: What gave me away?
translation: 是什么出卖了我？ [shi shen me chu mai le wo ？]

english: I don't mean to be rude, but the clothing and hair, for starters.
translation: 我并不是有意无礼，但首先是衣服和头发。 [wo bing bu shi you yi wu li ， dan shou xian shi yi fu he tou fa 。]

english: Ah, yes. I'm from Shilo Village on Karamja, it's a style I've had since I was little.
translation: 啊，是的。我来自 Karamja 的 Shilo 村，这是我从小就有的风格。 [a ， shi de 。 wo lai zi  Karamja  de  Shilo  cun ， zhe shi wo cong xiao jiu you de feng ge 。]

english: Then tell me, why are you so far from home?
translation: 那你告诉我，你为什么离家那么远？ [na ni gao su wo ， ni wei shen me li jia na me yuan ？]

english: This Grand Exchange! Isn't it marvellous! I've never seen anything like it in my life.
translation: 这场盛大的交流！是不是很奇妙！我一生中从未见过这样的事情。 [zhe chang sheng da de jiao liu ！ shi bu shi hen qi miao ！ wo yi sheng zhong cong wei jian guo zhe yang de shi qing 。]

english: My people were saddened when I chose to leave home and travel here, but I hope to make some serious profit, then return to my tribe.
translation: 当我选择离开家乡来到这里旅行时，我的人民感到悲伤，但我希望能赚到一些可观的利润，然后回到我的部落。 [dang wo xuan ze li kai jia xiang lai dao zhe li lv xing shi ， wo de ren min gan dao bei shang ， dan wo xi wang neng zhuan dao yi xie ke guan de li run ， ran hou hui dao wo de bu luo 。]

english: So, what are you selling?
translation: 那么，你卖什么？ [na me ， ni mai shen me ？]

english: Logs! Of all kinds! That's my plan, at least. Living in the jungle as we do, my people understand exotic wood very well indeed.
translation: 日志！各种各样的！至少这是我的计划。像我们一样生活在丛林中，我的人民确实非常了解异域木材。 [ri zhi ！ ge zhong ge yang de ！ zhi shao zhe shi wo de ji hua 。 xiang wo men yi yang sheng huo zai cong lin zhong ， wo de ren min que shi fei chang liao jie yi yu mu cai 。]

english: Okay, show me the prices of logs.
translation: 好的，告诉我原木的价格。 [hao de ， gao su wo yuan mu de jia ge 。]

english: Sorry, I need to be making tracks.
translation: 抱歉，我需要制作曲目。 [bao qian ， wo xu yao zhi zuo qu mu 。]

english: Okay, nice talking to you!
translation: 好的，很高兴跟你说话！ [hao de ， hen gao xing gen ni shuo hua ！]

english: Just one more offer! One more!
translation: 只需多一份优惠！再来一张！ [zhi xu duo yi fen you hui ！ zai lai yi zhang ！]

english: Such a joy it is to be in this building.
translation: 能在这座大楼里真是太高兴了。 [neng zai zhe zuo da lou li zhen shi tai gao xing le 。]

english: Yes! Yet another great deal.
translation: 是的！还有另一件大事。 [shi de ！ hai you ling yi jian da shi 。]

english: My people shall be so proud!
translation: 我的人民将感到无比自豪！ [wo de ren min jiang gan dao wu bi zi hao ！]

english: Hmmm. These numbers don't quite add up.
translation: 嗯。这些数字并不完全相加。 [n 。 zhe xie shu zi bing bu wan quan xiang jia 。]

english: You look like you've travelled a fair distance.
translation: 你看起来已经走了很远的距离。 [ni kan qi lai yi jing zou le hen yuan de ju li 。]

english: Okay, show me the prices of logs.
translation: 好的，告诉我原木的价格。 [hao de ， gao su wo yuan mu de jia ge 。]

english: Sorry, I need to be making tracks.
translation: 抱歉，我需要制作曲目。 [bao qian ， wo xu yao zhi zuo qu mu 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Well done, well done. Not many find their way in here.
translation: 干得好，干得好。没有多少人找到这里的路。 [gan de hao ， gan de hao 。 mei you duo shao ren zhao dao zhe li de lu 。]

english: I'm Remsai, a tree gnome. We live in this maze for our protection. Have a look around and enjoy.
translation: 我是雷姆赛，一个树侏儒。我们生活在这个迷宫里是为了保护我们。环顾四周并享受。 [wo shi lei mu sai ， yi ge shu zhu ru 。 wo men sheng huo zai zhe ge mi gong li shi wei le bao hu wo men 。 huan gu si zhou bing xiang shou 。]

english: Oh my, oh my!
translation: 天哪，天哪！ [tian na ， tian na ！]

english: What's wrong?
translation: 怎么了？ [zen me le ？]

english: The orb, they have the orb. It must be returned or we're doomed.
translation: 球体，他们有球体。它必须归还，否则我们就完蛋了。 [qiu ti ， ta men you qiu ti 。 ta bi xu gui huan ， fou ze wo men jiu wan dan le 。]

english: Hello Remsai.
translation: 你好雷姆赛。 [ni hao lei mu sai 。]

english: Hello, did you find the orb?
translation: 你好，你找到球了吗？ [ni hao ， ni zhao dao qiu le ma ？]

english: No, I'm afraid not.
translation: 不，恐怕不是。 [bu ， kong pa bu shi 。]

english: Please, we must have the orb if we are to survive.
translation: 拜托，如果我们要生存，就必须拥有球体。 [bai tuo ， ru guo wo men yao sheng cun ， jiu bi xu yong you qiu ti 。]

english: I have it here.
translation: 我这里有。 [wo zhe li you 。]

english: You're our saviour.
translation: 你是我们的救世主。 [ni shi wo men de jiu shi zhu 。]

english: Are you ok?
translation: 你还好吗？ [ni hai hao ma ？]

english: Khazard's men came. Without the orb we were defenceless. They killed many and then took our last hope, the other orbs.
translation: 卡扎德的人来了。没有球体，我们就毫无防御能力。他们杀死了许多人，然后夺走了我们最后的希望，其他的球体。 [ka zha de de ren lai le 。 mei you qiu ti ， wo men jiu hao wu fang yu neng li 。 ta men sha si le xu duo ren ， ran hou duo zou le wo men zui hou de xi wang ， qi ta de qiu ti 。]

english: Now surely we're all doomed. Without them the spirit tree is useless.
translation: 现在我们都注定要失败了。没有他们，灵树就毫无用处。 [xian zai wo men dou zhu ding yao shi bai le 。 mei you ta men ， ling shu jiu hao wu yong chu 。]

english: I've returned.
translation: 我回来了。 [wo hui lai le 。]

english: You're back, well done brave adventurer. Now the orbs are safe we can perform the ritual for the spirit tree. We can live in peace once again.
translation: 你回来了，干得好，勇敢的冒险家。现在球体已经安全了，我们可以为灵树进行仪式了。我们可以再次和平生活。 [ni hui lai le ， gan de hao ， yong gan de mao xian jia 。 xian zai qiu ti yi jing an quan le ， wo men ke yi wei ling shu jin xing yi shi le 。 wo men ke yi zai ci he ping sheng huo 。]

english: Hi there traveller.  You're a legend around these parts.
translation: 你好，旅行者。  你是这些部分的传奇人物。 [ni hao ， lv xing zhe 。   ni shi zhe xie bu fen de chuan qi ren wu 。]

english: Thanks Remsai.
translation: 谢谢雷姆赛。 [xie xie lei mu sai 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!
translation: 呜？  呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜！ [wu ？   wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu ！]

english: You don't say?
translation: 你不说？ [ni bu shuo ？]

english: Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
translation: 哇！呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜！ [wa ！ wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu ！]

english: You don't say!
translation: 你不说！ [ni bu shuo ！]

english: Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
translation: 呜呜呜……呜呜呜？呜呜呜呜呜呜呜！ [wu wu wu …… wu wu wu ？ wu wu wu wu wu wu wu ！]

english: Well, I guess you didn't say.
translation: 嗯，我猜你没说。 [n ， wo cai ni mei shuo 。]

english: Yeah, I don't want to brag, but seriously: I am SOOOO rich....
translation: 是的，我不想吹牛，但说真的：我太有钱了…… [shi de ， wo bu xiang chui niu ， dan shuo zhen de ： wo tai you qian le ……]

english: Yeah, I know they say money doesn't bring you happiness, but sometimes I just like to open my bank account and look at all of the stuff I own and just think to myself:
translation: 是的，我知道他们说金钱不会给你带来幸福，但有时我只是喜欢打开我的银行账户，看看我拥有的所有东西，然后心里想： [shi de ， wo zhi dao ta men shuo jin qian bu hui gei ni dai lai xing fu ， dan you shi wo zhi shi xi huan da kai wo de yin hang zhang hu ， kan kan wo yong you de suo you dong xi ， ran hou xin li xiang ：]

english: Wow. I am soooooo rich.
translation: 哇。我太有钱了。 [wa 。 wo tai you qian le 。]

english: Well, us rich alive people don't want to waste all day spending time with you poor dead people, because I'm just sooooo rich I have to go now, and very possibly make myself even richer.
translation: 好吧，我们活着的富人不想浪费一整天的时间和你们这些可怜的死人在一起，因为我太富有了，我现在必须走了，而且很可能让自己变得更富有。 [hao ba ， wo men huo zhe de fu ren bu xiang lang fei yi zheng tian de shi jian he ni men zhe xie ke lian de si ren zai yi qi ， yin wei wo tai fu you le ， wo xian zai bi xu zou le ， er qie hen ke neng rang zi ji bian de geng fu you 。]

english: See ya around ghosty!
translation: 幽灵见！ [you ling jian ！]

english: Yeah, I heard about that, ha-ha-ha!
translation: 是的，我听说过，哈哈哈！ [shi de ， wo ting shuo guo ， ha ha ha ！]

english: With a MACKEREL? Ouch!
translation: 和鲭鱼一起？哎哟! [he qing yu yi qi ？ ai yo !]

english: Well, it was fun. Let's do it again sometime.
translation: 嗯，很有趣。我们找个时间再做一次吧。 [n ， hen you qu 。 wo men zhao ge shi jian zai zuo yi ci ba 。]

english: Why, thank you very much!
translation: 为什么，非常感谢！ [wei shen me ， fei chang gan xie ！]

english: I know, but what are you going to do?
translation: 我知道，但是你要做什么？ [wo zhi dao ， dan shi ni yao zuo shen me ？]

english: Well, I guess that's always true in the long run. See you around, weird invisible dead person!
translation: 嗯，我想从长远来看这总是正确的。再见，奇怪的隐形死人！ [n ， wo xiang cong chang yuan lai kan zhe zong shi zheng que de 。 zai jian ， qi guai de yin xing si ren ！]

english: Yeah it's not bad, but I prefer cooked chicken.
translation: 是的，不错，但我更喜欢煮熟的鸡肉。 [shi de ， bu cuo ， dan wo geng xi huan zhu shu de ji rou 。]

english: Maybe, but nothing beats a home cooked pie!
translation: 也许吧，但没有什么比自制的馅饼更好的了！ [ye xu ba ， dan mei you shen me bi zi zhi de xian bing geng hao de le ！]

english: Man, I love pie!
translation: 伙计，我喜欢馅饼！ [huo ji ， wo xi huan xian bing ！]

english: You don't say? I never knew that. Well, I must be going, see you around.
translation: 你不说？我从来不知道这一点。好吧，我得走了，回头见。 [ni bu shuo ？ wo cong lai bu zhi dao zhe yi dian 。 hao ba ， wo de zou le ， hui tou jian 。]

english: We get signal!
translation: 我们收到信号了！ [wo men shou dao xin hao le ！]

english: Somebody set up us the bomb!
translation: 有人给我们安放了炸弹！ [you ren gei wo men an fang le zha dan ！]

english: You have no chance to survive make your time.
translation: 你没有机会生存，请腾出时间。 [ni mei you ji hui sheng cun ， qing teng chu shi jian 。]

english: Woo?
translation: 呜？ [wu ？]

english: All your base are belong to us.
translation: 你所有的基地都属于我们。 [ni suo you de ji di dou shu yu wo men 。]

english: Hey, don't think you can talk to me like that!
translation: 嘿，别以为你可以这样跟我说话！ [hei ， bie yi wei ni ke yi zhe yang gen wo shuo hua ！]

english: Are you threatening me?
translation: 你在威胁我吗？ [ni zai wei xie wo ma ？]

english: Just because you're already dead, doesn't mean I can't find a way to hurt you ghosty!
translation: 你已经死了，并不代表我就找不到办法伤害你！ [ni yi jing si le ， bing bu dai biao wo jiu zhao bu dao ban fa shang hai ni ！]

english: No, I've never been there in my life and CERTAINLY didn't steal anything when I was!
translation: 不，我这辈子从来没有去过那里，当然也没有偷过任何东西！ [bu ， wo zhe bei zi cong lai mei you qu guo na li ， dang ran ye mei you tou guo ren he dong xi ！]

english: Are you calling me a liar?!?! I have never stolen a thing in my life, and I resent the implication that I am the kind of morally depraved individual that would steal someone else's hard earned
translation: 你骂我是骗子吗？！？！我一生中从未偷过任何东西，而且我很讨厌别人说我是那种道德败坏的人，会偷别人辛苦赚来的东西。 [ni ma wo shi pian zi ma ？！？！ wo yi sheng zhong cong wei tou guo ren he dong xi ， er qie wo hen tao yan bie ren shuo wo shi na zhong dao de bai huai de ren ， hui tou bie ren xin ku zhuan lai de dong xi 。]

english: money from their very pockets!
translation: 钱是从他们的口袋里掏出来的！ [qian shi cong ta men de kou dai li tao chu lai de ！]

english: Or cakes. Or fur. Repeatedly. For long periods at a time.
translation: 或者蛋糕。或者毛皮。反复。一次持续很长时间。 [huo zhe dan gao 。 huo zhe mao pi 。 fan fu 。 yi ci chi xu hen zhang shi jian 。]

english: Well if you are going to take that attitude, then I have nothing further to say on the matter, and bid you good day!
translation: 好吧，如果您打算采取这种态度，那么我对此事无话可说，祝您早安！ [hao ba ， ru guo nin da suan cai qu zhe zhong tai du ， na me wo dui ci shi wu hua ke shuo ， zhu nin zao an ！]

english: Hello. You must be Rennard.
translation: 你好。你一定是雷纳德。 [ni hao 。 ni yi ding shi lei na de 。]

english: What be this? You both see me and hear me, and also know my name?
translation: 这是什么？你们既看到我、听到我，还知道我的名字？ [zhe shi shen me ？ ni men ji kan dao wo 、 ting dao wo ， hai zhi dao wo de ming zi ？]

english: Tell me what devilry brings you here, and be quick about it afore I gut you like a fish!
translation: 告诉我是什么恶魔把你带到这里来的，在我像鱼一样把你开膛破肚之前快点说出来！ [gao su wo shi shen me e mo ba ni dai dao zhe li lai de ， zai wo xiang yu yi yang ba ni kai tang po du zhi qian kuai dian shuo chu lai ！]

english: Well, apart from the fact I ain't scared of no ghost, I am here because I have spoken to Valdez.
translation: 好吧，除了我不怕鬼之外，我来这里是因为我已经和瓦尔迪兹谈过了。 [hao ba ， chu le wo bu pa gui zhi wai ， wo lai zhe li shi yin wei wo yi jing he wa er di zi tan guo le 。]

english: Valdez? Who be that? Some foul necromancer?
translation: 瓦尔迪兹？那是谁？某个邪恶的死灵法师？ [wa er di zi ？ na shi shui ？ mou ge xie e de si ling fa shi ？]

english: No, he was a ghost I met near Glarial's tomb.
translation: 不，他是我在格拉里尔墓附近遇到的一个鬼魂。 [bu ， ta shi wo zai ge la li er mu fu jin yu dao de yi ge gui hun 。]

english: He seems convinced that the artefact you stole from him is responsible for him becoming cursed to be an invisible ghost.
translation: 他似乎确信你从他那里偷来的神器导致他被诅咒成为隐形鬼魂。 [ta si hu que xin ni cong ta na li tou lai de shen qi dao zhi ta bei zu zhou cheng wei yin xing gui hun 。]

english: Seems like he might be onto something too, given the state of you.
translation: 考虑到你的状态，他似乎也有什么想法。 [kao lv dao ni de zhuang tai ， ta si hu ye you shen me xiang fa 。]

english: A curse ye say... Aye, that makes sense...
translation: 你们说的是诅咒……是的，这是有道理的…… [ni men shuo de shi zu zhou …… shi de ， zhe shi you dao li de ……]

english: And there was I thinking my fate be the fault of the thieving and murdering I spent me life a-doing...
translation: 我当时认为我的命运是我一生的盗窃和谋杀的错...... [wo dang shi ren wei wo de ming yun shi wo yi sheng de dao qie he mou sha de cuo ......]

english: So it all began the day I stole that staff, ye say? Aye, that be a story I have never told another soul...
translation: 所以这一切都是从我偷那根法杖的那天开始的，你说？是的，这是一个我从未告诉过其他人的故事...... [suo yi zhe yi qie dou shi cong wo tou na gen fa zhang de na tian kai shi de ， ni shuo ？ shi de ， zhe shi yi ge wo cong wei gao su guo qi ta ren de gu shi ......]

english: Why don't you tell me what happened? I might be able to help...
translation: 你为什么不告诉我发生了什么事？我也许能帮上忙... [ni wei shen me bu gao su wo fa sheng le shen me shi ？ wo ye xu neng bang shang mang ...]

english: Well, I was making me merry way along, having just pulled off a glorious jewellery heist from a bunch of stinking dwarves...
translation: 好吧，我刚刚从一群臭矮人手中完成了一次光荣的珠宝抢劫，这让我一路快乐…… [hao ba ， wo gang gang cong yi qun chou ai ren shou zhong wan cheng le yi ci guang rong de zhu bao qiang jie ， zhe rang wo yi lu kuai le ……]

english: Hey, that's no way to talk about dwarves! Some of my best friends are short!
translation: 嘿，这不是谈论矮人的方式！我的一些最好的朋友都很矮！ [hei ， zhe bu shi tan lun ai ren de fang shi ！ wo de yi xie zui hao de peng you dou hen ai ！]

english: Ah, yer misunderstand me [lad/lass], I wasn't generalising about the whole dwarf species, I had just stolen a bundle of jewels from a very specific group of dwarves who happened to have an odious stench about them!
translation: 啊，你误会我了[小伙子/姑娘]，我并不是对整个矮人物种进行概括，我只是从一群非常特殊的矮人那里偷了一捆珠宝，而他们碰巧身上有一种令人厌恶的恶臭！ [a ， ni wu hui wo le [ xiao huo zi / gu niang ]， wo bing bu shi dui zheng ge ai ren wu zhong jin xing gai kuo ， wo zhi shi cong yi qun fei chang te shu de ai ren na li tou le yi kun zhu bao ， er ta men peng qiao shen shang you yi zhong ling ren yan wu de e chou ！]

english: Oh. Well I guess that's okay then. Please continue.
translation: 哦。好吧，我想那就没问题了。请继续。 [o 。 hao ba ， wo xiang na jiu mei wen ti le 。 qing ji xu 。]

english: Well, as I headed on me merry way, hoping the foul odours that lingered in me nostrils would soon pass, I see in front of me this explorer fella, all decked out in in his fine clothing, and carrying some long package
translation: 好吧，正当我兴高采烈地走在路上，希望鼻孔里残留的恶臭快点过去的时候，我看到前面这个探险家小伙子，穿着华丽的衣服，背着一个长长的包裹。 [hao ba ， zheng dang wo xing gao cai lie di zou zai lu shang ， xi wang bi kong li can liu de e chou kuai dian guo qu de shi hou ， wo kan dao qian mian zhe ge tan xian jia xiao huo zi ， chuan zhe hua li de yi fu ， bei zhe yi ge chang chang de bao guo 。]

english: bundled in rags.
translation: 裹在破烂的衣服里。 [guo zai po lan de yi fu li 。]

english: So I says to meself, 'Rennard', I says, 'Rennard, why would some fella all dressed in his finery be carrying something wrapped in dirty rags?'.
translation: 所以我对自己说，“雷纳德”，我说，“雷纳德，为什么一个穿着他的华服的家伙会拿着用脏破布包裹着的东西？”。 [suo yi wo dui zi ji shuo ，“ lei na de ”， wo shuo ，“ lei na de ， wei shen me yi ge chuan zhe ta de hua fu de jia huo hui na zhe yong zang po bu bao guo zhe de dong xi ？”。]

english: So I thinks to meself a little more, 'Rennard', I thinks, 'Rennard, maybe that fella has something valuable in there, and he covered it in dirty rags so it don't look so valuable'.
translation: 所以我对自己多想了一点，“雷纳德”，我想，“雷纳德，也许那个家伙里面有一些有价值的东西，他用肮脏的破布盖住了它，所以它看起来不那么有价值”。 [suo yi wo dui zi ji duo xiang le yi dian ，“ lei na de ”， wo xiang ，“ lei na de ， ye xu na ge jia huo li mian you yi xie you jia zhi de dong xi ， ta yong ang zang de po bu gai zhu le ta ， suo yi ta kan qi lai bu na me you jia zhi ”。]

english: So I coshed this fella round the back of his head with me bag of jewels, picked up his package and was on me merry way afore he comes to.
translation: 于是，我用一袋珠宝把他的后脑勺套在了这个家伙的后脑勺上，拿起他的包裹，在他苏醒之前就高兴地冲到了我身上。 [yu shi ， wo yong yi dai zhu bao ba ta de hou nao shao tao zai le zhe ge jia huo de hou nao shao shang ， na qi ta de bao guo ， zai ta su xing zhi qian jiu gao xing di chong dao le wo shen shang 。]

english: So what happened then?
translation: 那么后来发生了什么？ [na me hou lai fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: Well, I makes me way to the closest tavern I knew of that catered to my sort of people...
translation: 好吧，我去了我所知道的最近的一家适合我这种人的小酒馆...... [hao ba ， wo qu le wo suo zhi dao de zui jin de yi jia shi he wo zhe zhong ren de xiao jiu guan ......]

english: You mean thieves?
translation: 你说盗贼？ [ni shuo dao zei ？]

english: Right ye are, so I makes me way to the nearest friendly tavern, and unwraps the bundle to see what it had inside.
translation: 是的，所以我去了最近的友好小酒馆，打开包裹看看里面有什么。 [shi de ， suo yi wo qu le zui jin de you hao xiao jiu guan ， da kai bao guo kan kan li mian you shen me 。]

english: The Staff of Armadyl?
translation: 阿玛迪尔法杖？ [a ma di er fa zhang ？]

english: Was it? Ah, I never knew that...
translation: 是吗？啊，我从来不知道... [shi ma ？ a ， wo cong lai bu zhi dao ...]

english: Anysways, I unwraps this staff, and sees it be a god- weapon; I may be just a common thief, but I recognises a weapon not made by mortal hands when I sees one.
translation: 无论如何，我打开这根法杖，发现它是一件神器；我可能只是一个普通的小偷，但我一看到武器就认出不是凡人亲手制造的。 [wu lun ru he ， wo da kai zhe gen fa zhang ， fa xian ta shi yi jian shen qi ； wo ke neng zhi shi yi ge pu tong de xiao tou ， dan wo yi kan dao wu qi jiu ren chu bu shi fan ren qin shou zhi zao de 。]

english: So what did you do then?
translation: 那么你当时做了什么？ [na me ni dang shi zuo le shen me ？]

english: Well, I knew such a weapon would be of great value to...
translation: 嗯，我知道这样的武器对于……来说非常有价值。 [n ， wo zhi dao zhe yang de wu qi dui yu …… lai shuo fei chang you jia zhi 。]

english: Now that's funny. Can't remember his name, now. The powerful god, lived in the North-east. Took the Mahjarrat away from under Icthlarin's
translation: 现在这很有趣。现在记不起他的名字了。强大的神，居住在东北。将马吉拉特从伊克瑟拉林的手下夺走 [xian zai zhe hen you qu 。 xian zai ji bu qi ta de ming zi le 。 qiang da de shen ， ju zhu zai dong bei 。 jiang ma ji la te cong yi ke se la lin de shou xia duo zou]

english: control.
translation: 控制。 [kong zhi 。]

english: Anyway, I hired me a messenger to go off and let him know I had something I was prepared to sell that I thought he'd be interested in...
translation: 不管怎样，我雇了一个信使去让他知道我准备卖掉一些我认为他会感兴趣的东西...... [bu guan zen yang ， wo gu le yi ge xin shi qu rang ta zhi dao wo zhun bei mai diao yi xie wo ren wei ta hui gan xing qu de dong xi ......]

english: Now WHY can't I remember his name? Very odd that...
translation: 现在为什么我记不起他的名字了？非常奇怪的是... [xian zai wei shen me wo ji bu qi ta de ming zi le ？ fei chang qi guai de shi ...]

english: So you sold the staff to this god you can't remember?
translation: 所以你把法杖卖给了这个你不记得的神？ [suo yi ni ba fa zhang mai gei le zhe ge ni bu ji de de shen ？]

english: Well, that's the other funny thing... He never showed up, he sent some General or other instead.
translation: 嗯，这是另一件有趣的事情……他从未出现，而是派了一些将军或其他人代替。 [n ， zhe shi ling yi jian you qu de shi qing …… ta cong wei chu xian ， er shi pai le yi xie jiang jun huo qi ta ren dai ti 。]

english: Hmmm... You know... Thinking back on that, I'm getting the feeling that messenger did a little doublecross of his own, and took
translation: 嗯...你知道...回想起来，我感觉信使自己做了一点欺骗，并采取了 [n ... ni zhi dao ... hui xiang qi lai ， wo gan jue xin shi zi ji zuo le yi dian qi pian ， bing cai qu le]

english: me message to the wrong fella.
translation: 我给错误的人发消息了。 [wo gei cuo wu de ren fa xiao xi le 。]

english: So what was this General's name?
translation: 那么这位将军叫什么名字呢？ [na me zhe wei jiang jun jiao shen me ming zi ne ？]

english: His name was Zamorak. I remember thinking at the time it was odd, because the fella was a mighty powerful warrior, but was never fully trusted by...
translation: 他的名字叫萨莫拉克。我记得当时觉得这很奇怪，因为这家伙是一位强大的战士，但从未得到……的完全信任。 [ta de ming zi jiao sa mo la ke 。 wo ji de dang shi jue de zhe hen qi guai ， yin wei zhe jia huo shi yi wei qiang da de zhan shi ， dan cong wei de dao …… de wan quan xin ren 。]

english: WHY can't I remember his name???
translation: 为什么我记不住他的名字？？？ [wei shen me wo ji bu zhu ta de ming zi ？？？]

english: So you suspect the messenger might have taken the message to the wrong person? So you think it was an accident or deliberate?
translation: 那么您怀疑信使可能将消息传递给了错误的人？那么你认为这是意外还是故意的？ [na me nin huai yi xin shi ke neng jiang xiao xi chuan di gei le cuo wu de ren ？ na me ni ren wei zhe shi yi wai hai shi gu yi de ？]

english: Well that I can't tell ya, but if something happened to get me cursed, it's likely the messenger would know what more than me.
translation: 好吧，我不能告诉你，但如果发生什么事让我受到诅咒，很可能信使会比我更清楚。 [hao ba ， wo bu neng gao su ni ， dan ru guo fa sheng shen me shi rang wo shou dao zu zhou ， hen ke neng xin shi hui bi wo geng qing chu 。]

english: His name was Kharrim, and if he caused me to be stuck like this, I'm gonna fillet him like a dog, ghost or no!
translation: 他的名字叫哈利姆，如果他让我像这样被困住，我会像一条狗一样把他切成肉片，无论鬼魂与否！ [ta de ming zi jiao ha li mu ， ru guo ta rang wo xiang zhe yang bei kun zhu ， wo hui xiang yi tiao gou yi yang ba ta qie cheng rou pian ， wu lun gui hun yu fou ！]

english: I tell ye what, you've given me much to think about so I'd like to offer yer a gift; Here, take these, they were the gloves I stole me first cake with, they might bring yer some luck.
translation: 我告诉你，你让我思考了很多，所以我想给你一份礼物；给，拿着这些，它们是我偷我第一个蛋糕时用的手套，它们可能会给你带来一些好运。 [wo gao su ni ， ni rang wo si kao le hen duo ， suo yi wo xiang gei ni yi fen li wu ； gei ， na zhe zhe xie ， ta men shi wo tou wo di yi ge dan gao shi yong de shou tao ， ta men ke neng hui gei ni dai lai yi xie hao yun 。]

english: Where can I find this Kharrim then?
translation: 那么我在哪里可以找到这个 Kharrim 呢？ [na me wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao zhe ge  Kharrim  ne ？]

english: Kharrim the messenger... Well, he was always a devoted follower of old General Zamorak, and if I remember rightly Zamorak set up a small base in an old temple near Dareeyak...
translation: 使者哈利姆……嗯，他一直是老扎莫拉克将军的忠实追随者，如果我没记错的话，扎莫拉克在达里亚克附近的一座古老寺庙里建立了一个小基地…… [shi zhe ha li mu …… n ， ta yi zhi shi lao zha mo la ke jiang jun de zhong shi zhui sui zhe ， ru guo wo mei ji cuo de hua ， zha mo la ke zai da li ya ke fu jin de yi zuo gu lao si miao li jian li le yi ge xiao ji di ……]

english: You might want to check around there.
translation: 你可能想检查一下那里。 [ni ke neng xiang jian cha yi xia na li 。]

english: Okay, well I'll try and find him for you then.
translation: 好吧，那我会尽力帮你找到他。 [hao ba ， na wo hui jin li bang ni zhao dao ta 。]

english: Kharrim the messenger... Last I'd heard of him, he'd headed off to Carrallagar to seek his fortune. Ya might want to check around there somewhere.
translation: 哈里姆，信使……我上次听说他的时候，他正前往卡拉拉加寻找他的财富。你可能想检查一下那里的某个地方。 [ha li mu ， xin shi …… wo shang ci ting shuo ta de shi hou ， ta zheng qian wang ka la la jia xun zhao ta de cai fu 。 ni ke neng xiang jian cha yi xia na li de mou ge di fang 。]

english: Kharrim the messenger... The last I'd heard of that weasel he was claiming he'd found some underground deposit of runite ore guarded by demons and dragons.
translation: 使者卡里姆……我最后一次听说那个黄鼠狼，他声称他发现了一些由恶魔和龙守护的地下符文矿石矿床。 [shi zhe ka li mu …… wo zui hou yi ci ting shuo na ge huang shu lang ， ta sheng cheng ta fa xian le yi xie you e mo he long shou hu de di xia fu wen kuang shi kuang chuang 。]

english: I suspect he was pulling some scam or other, but if you know of such a place, that might be a good place to start checking.
translation: 我怀疑他正在实施一些骗局或其他，但如果您知道这样的地方，那可能是一个开始检查的好地方。 [wo huai yi ta zheng zai shi shi yi xie pian ju huo qi ta ， dan ru guo nin zhi dao zhe yang de di fang ， na ke neng shi yi ge kai shi jian cha de hao di fang 。]

english: Well, that's all fascinating, but I just don't particularly care. Bye-bye.
translation: 嗯，这一切都很有趣，但我并不特别关心。再见。 [n ， zhe yi qie dou hen you qu ， dan wo bing bu te bie guan xin 。 zai jian 。]

english: Hello again Rennard.
translation: 雷纳德，你好。 [lei na de ， ni hao 。]

english: Ah, it be you again! What can I do fer ya?
translation: 啊，又是你！我能为你做什么？ [a ， you shi ni ！ wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: Can you tell me where I can find Kharrim again?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪里可以再次找到卡里姆吗？ [ni neng gao su wo zai na li ke yi zai ci zhao dao ka li mu ma ？]

english: Could I have more of those ghostly robes you gave me?
translation: 我可以再要一件你送我的幽灵长袍吗？ [wo ke yi zai yao yi jian ni song wo de you ling chang pao ma ？]

english: It seems as though the curse that keeps me here extends to my very clothing... which piece do you want?
translation: 似乎让我留在这里的诅咒延伸到了我的衣服上……你想要哪一件？ [si hu rang wo liu zai zhe li de zu zhou yan shen dao le wo de yi fu shang …… ni xiang yao na yi jian ？]

english: Here you go.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: The endless tragedy of fate... Why must you torment me so?
translation: 无尽的命运悲剧……你为何要如此折磨我？ [wu jin de ming yun bei ju …… ni wei he yao ru ci zhe mo wo ？]

english: Alright, alright, calm down, calm down. All I said was 'hello'!
translation: 好了好了，冷静，冷静。我只说‘你好’！ [hao le hao le ， leng jing ， leng jing 。 wo zhi shuo ‘ ni hao ’！]

english: You can see me?
translation: 你能看到我吗？ [ni neng kan dao wo ma ？]

english: Uh... yes?
translation: 呃……是吗？ [e …… shi ma ？]

english: And you understand my words?
translation: 你明白我的话吗？ [ni ming bai wo de hua ma ？]

english: Well, most of them...
translation: 嗯，他们中的大多数... [n ， ta men zhong de da duo shu ...]

english: This is incredible! How can such a thing have come to pass?
translation: 这太不可思议了！怎么会发生这样的事呢？ [zhe tai bu ke si yi le ！ zen me hui fa sheng zhe yang de shi ne ？]

english: What can I say? I'm a professional.
translation: 我能说什么？我是专业人士。 [wo neng shuo shen me ？ wo shi zhuan ye ren shi 。]

english: Hello back at you.
translation: 回头向你问好。 [hui tou xiang ni wen hao 。]

english: So what's a nice ghost like you doing in a place like this?
translation: 那么像你这样的好鬼魂在这种地方做什么呢？ [na me xiang ni zhe yang de hao gui hun zai zhe zhong di fang zuo shen me ne ？]

english: I suppose you think that's funny?
translation: 我想你觉得这很有趣吗？ [wo xiang ni jue de zhe hen you qu ma ？]

english: Well... Mildly amusing I guess.
translation: 嗯……我想有点有趣。 [n …… wo xiang you dian you qu 。]

english: I don't think I want to talk to you anymore.
translation: 我想我不想再和你说话了。 [wo xiang wo bu xiang zai he ni shuo hua le 。]

english: Hello stranger. It is rare indeed that I meet one who can see my presence, let alone one who can understand my words.
translation: 你好陌生人。能看到我的存在的人确实很少见，更何况是能听懂我的话的人。 [ni hao mo sheng ren 。 neng kan dao wo de cun zai de ren que shi hen shao jian ， geng he kuang shi neng ting dong wo de hua de ren 。]

english: Soooo.... Is it fun being a ghost?
translation: 呜……当鬼有趣吗？ [wu …… dang gui you qu ma ？]

english: Does it look like fun to you?
translation: 你觉得这很有趣吗？ [ni jue de zhe hen you qu ma ？]

english: Erm... Well, yes actually.
translation: 嗯……嗯，实际上是的。 [n …… n ， shi ji shang shi de 。]

english: Then you are a fool, and I will waste no more words upon you.
translation: 那你就是个傻瓜，我就不再对你多废话了。 [na ni jiu shi ge sha gua ， wo jiu bu zai dui ni duo fei hua le 。]

english: What, not even 'goodbye'?
translation: 什么，连‘再见’都没有？ [shen me ， lian ‘ zai jian ’ dou mei you ？]

english: Sheesh, what a grouch. You'd think you'd have more of a sense of humour being dead and all.
translation: 谢什，真是个牢骚满腹的人。你可能会认为死了之后会有更多的幽默感。 [xie shen ， zhen shi ge lao sao man fu de ren 。 ni ke neng hui ren wei si le zhi hou hui you geng duo de you mo gan 。]

english: Mortal... Take heed of my example, and waste not your life, lest you may suffer the same fate as myself...
translation: 凡人……以我为榜样，不要浪费生命，以免重蹈我的覆辙…… [fan ren …… yi wo wei bang yang ， bu yao lang fei sheng ming ， yi mian zhong dao wo de fu zhe ……]

english: Huh? You mean someone did this to you?
translation: 啊？你的意思是有人这样对你？ [a ？ ni de yi si shi you ren zhe yang dui ni ？]

english: You have ascertained the truth in my words...
translation: 你已经确定了我的话的真实性…… [ni yi jing que ding le wo de hua de zhen shi xing ……]

english: So who did it to you? And why?
translation: 那么是谁对你做的呢？为什么？ [na me shi shui dui ni zuo de ne ？ wei shen me ？]

english: Events of moons past, I remember not clearly...
translation: 过去的事，我记不太清楚了…… [guo qu de shi ， wo ji bu tai qing chu le ……]

english: Fine help you are then.
translation: 那么很好的帮助你。 [na me hen hao de bang zhu ni 。]

english: Hello stranger.
translation: 你好陌生人。 [ni hao mo sheng ren 。]

english: So.... Invisible ghost haunting the same place for thousands of years, huh?
translation: 那么……数千年来，无形的幽灵在同一个地方出没，是吗？ [na me …… shu qian nian lai ， wu xing de you ling zai tong yi ge di fang chu mo ， shi ma ？]

english: You have no idea...
translation: 你不知道... [ni bu zhi dao ...]

english: Well, bad luck and all that. See ya around!
translation: 好吧，运气不好等等。回头见！ [hao ba ， yun qi bu hao deng deng 。 hui tou jian ！]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: So you're a ghost, huh?
translation: 所以你是个幽灵，是吗？ [suo yi ni shi ge you ling ， shi ma ？]

english: Apparently.
translation: 显然。 [xian ran 。]

english: In which case I only have one thing to say to you:
translation: 既然如此，我只有一件事要对你说： [ji ran ru ci ， wo zhi you yi jian shi yao dui ni shuo ：]

english: ...what?
translation: ...什么？ [... shen me ？]

english: Guess you don't have the amulet of humanspeak, huh?
translation: 我猜你没有人类语言的护身符吧？ [wo cai ni mei you ren lei yu yan de hu shen fu ba ？]

english: ...huh?
Yeah, that's right. WOO! WOOOWOOO WOO WOOOOWOO! Got no comeback for that, have you?
translation: 是的，没错。哇！呜呜呜呜呜呜！就这样再也回不来了，不是吗？ [shi de ， mei cuo 。 wa ！ wu wu wu wu wu wu ！ jiu zhe yang zai ye hui bu lai le ， bu shi ma ？]

english: You are very strange...
translation: 你很奇怪... [ni hen qi guai ...]

english: Tell me your story
translation: 告诉我你的故事 [gao su wo ni de gu shi]

english: Goodbye then
translation: 那么再见 [na me zai jian]

english: Ask about Kharrim.
translation: 询问有关卡里姆的事情。 [xun wen you guan ka li mu de shi qing 。]

english: Ask for more ghostly robes.
translation: 要求更多的幽灵长袍。 [yao qiu geng duo de you ling chang pao 。]

english: Hey!
translation: 嘿！ [hei ！]

english: Welcome to our camp, adventurer.
translation: 欢迎来到我们的营地，冒险家。 [huan ying lai dao wo men de ying di ， mao xian jia 。]

english: That sounds lovely, what tune is that?
translation: 听起来真好听，那是什么曲子？ [ting qi lai zhen hao ting ， na shi shen me qu zi ？]

english: Oh, this? It's just the beginning of something, still a lot more to come.
translation: 哦，这个？这只是事情的开始，还有更多的事情要做。 [o ， zhe ge ？ zhe zhi shi shi qing de kai shi ， hai you geng duo de shi qing yao zuo 。]

english: Does it have a name?
translation: 它有名字吗？ [ta you ming zi ma ？]

english: I s'pose the working title is...'The Doors of Dinh'.
translation: 我猜暂定标题是……“丁之门”。 [wo cai zan ding biao ti shi ……“ ding zhi men ”。]

english: Where are you from?
translation: 你从哪来？ [ni cong na lai ？]

english: We come from Varlamore... We're students of the College of Bards.
translation: 我们来自瓦拉莫尔……我们是吟游诗人学院的学生。 [wo men lai zi wa la mo er …… wo men shi yin you shi ren xue yuan de xue sheng 。]

english: Oh...
Or did you want to know where I'm from specifically? My home was destroyed long ago by an evil saltwater deity.
translation: 或者你想知道我具体来自哪里？我的家很久以前就被邪恶的咸水神摧毁了。 [huo zhe ni xiang zhi dao wo ju ti lai zi na li ？ wo de jia hen jiu yi qian jiu bei xie e de xian shui shen cui hui le 。]

english: Well, that's certainly a dark and tortured backstory. Say, have you slain any dragons? Wooed a beautiful princess? Sought revenge on the fiend who killed your family?
translation: 嗯，这确实是一个黑暗而痛苦的背景故事。话说，你杀过龙吗？追求美丽的公主吗？想要向杀害你家人的恶魔报仇吗？ [n ， zhe que shi shi yi ge hei an er tong ku de bei jing gu shi 。 hua shuo ， ni sha guo long ma ？ zhui qiu mei li de gong zhu ma ？ xiang yao xiang sha hai ni jia ren de e mo bao chou ma ？]

english: ...Dragons? Slain. Princesses? Wooed... but revenge, that's still brewing.
translation: ...龙？被杀了。公主们？求婚了……但复仇仍在酝酿之中。 [... long ？ bei sha le 。 gong zhu men ？ qiu hun le …… dan fu chou reng zai yun niang zhi zhong 。]

english: Huh, well... Fair enough.
translation: 嗯，好吧……很公平。 [n ， hao ba …… hen gong ping 。]

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。 [wo de zou le 。]

english: See you around, adventurer.
translation: 再见，冒险家。 [zai jian ， mao xian jia 。]

english: That sounds lovely, what tune is that?
translation: 听起来真好听，那是什么曲子？ [ting qi lai zhen hao ting ， na shi shen me qu zi ？]

english: Where are you from?
translation: 你从哪来？ [ni cong na lai ？]

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。 [wo de zou le 。]

english: Here lies Viktor, the goat, gone but not forgotten.
translation: 这里躺着山羊维克托，它已经走了，但并没有被遗忘。 [zhe li tang zhe shan yang wei ke tuo ， ta yi jing zou le ， dan bing mei you bei yi wang 。]

english: The ground beneath the gravestone looks disturbed.
translation: 墓碑下面的地面看起来很乱。 [mu bei xia mian de di mian kan qi lai hen luan 。]

english: Baaaaaaah! Baaaaah!
translation: 咩咩咩！咩咩！ [mie mie mie ！ mie mie ！]

english: Aaah! It's a ghost goat!
translation: 啊啊！这是一只幽灵山羊！ [a a ！ zhe shi yi zhi you ling shan yang ！]

english: Baaaaaaah!
translation: 咩咩咩！ [mie mie mie ！]

english: Aww, poor goat, I don't think it meant to scare me.
translation: 哇哦，可怜的山羊，我不认为这意味着吓唬我。 [wa o ， ke lian de shan yang ， wo bu ren wei zhe yi wei zhe xia hu wo 。]

english: Baah?
translation: 呸？ [pei ？]

english: If only I had a goat speak amulet...
translation: 要是我有一个羊语护身符就好了…… [yao shi wo you yi ge yang yu hu shen fu jiu hao le ……]

english: You notice the ghost goat is missing one of its horns.
translation: 你注意到幽灵山羊缺少了一只角。 [ni zhu yi dao you ling shan yang que shao le yi zhi jiao 。]

english: Hmm, one of your horns is missing...
translation: 嗯，你的一只角不见了…… [n ， ni de yi zhi jiao bu jian le ……]

english: Baaah! Baaaaah!
translation: 呸！咩咩！ [pei ！ mie mie ！]

english: It seems like it wants me to help recover its lost horn...
translation: 它似乎想让我帮忙找回它丢失的角…… [ta si hu xiang rang wo bang mang zhao hui ta diu shi de jiao ……]

english: The ghost goat seems very excited when you mention its lost horn.
translation: 当你提到它丢失的角时，鬼山羊似乎很兴奋。 [dang ni ti dao ta diu shi de jiao shi ， gui shan yang si hu hen xing fen 。]

english: Hmm, how am I going to find this goat's horn?
translation: 嗯，我怎样才能找到这个山羊角呢？ [n ， wo zen yang cai neng zhao dao zhe ge shan yang jiao ne ？]

english: Baaaaaah!!!
translation: 咩咩！！！ [mie mie ！！！]

english: The ghost goat head butts the wall, I think he's pointing east...
translation: 鬼羊头撞墙，我想他指的是东方…… [gui yang tou zhuang qiang ， wo xiang ta zhi de shi dong fang ……]

english: Alright then, I'll go have a look...that way...
translation: 好吧，那我就去看看……这样…… [hao ba ， na wo jiu qu kan kan …… zhe yang ……]

english: Hey goat, where did you baa where your horn was?
translation: 嘿，山羊，你的角在哪里咩？ [hei ， shan yang ， ni de jiao zai na li mie ？]

english: Right, got it, thanks goat.
translation: 好的，明白了，谢谢大佬 [hao de ， ming bai le ， xie xie da lao]

english: Hello my goat friend, I have brought you a gift.
translation: 你好，我的山羊朋友，我给你带来了一份礼物。 [ni hao ， wo de shan yang peng you ， wo gei ni dai lai le yi fen li wu 。]

english: Baaaah!
translation: 咩咩！ [mie mie ！]

english: You show the ghost goat the horn.
translation: 你给幽灵山羊看角。 [ni gei you ling shan yang kan jiao 。]

english: Baaaah! Baaaaaaah! Baaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!
translation: 咩咩！咩咩咩！啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！ [mie mie ！ mie mie mie ！ a a a a a a a a a a a ！]

english: I think this might be the right one.
translation: 我认为这可能是正确的。 [wo ren wei zhe ke neng shi zheng que de 。]

english: You bury the horn with the rest of the goat skeleton.
translation: 您将角与山羊骨架的其余部分一起埋葬。 [nin jiang jiao yu shan yang gu jia de qi yu bu fen yi qi mai zang 。]

english: Quest complete!
translation: 任务完成！ [ren wu wan cheng ！]

english: Inspect the grave closer?
translation: 仔细检查坟墓吗？ [zi xi jian cha fen mu ma ？]

english: Viktor is resting peacefully now...
translation: 维克多现在正在安息…… [wei ke duo xian zai zheng zai an xi ……]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Wooooo! Ooooooh!
translation: 呜呜！噢噢噢！ [wu wu ！ o o o ！]

english: I can't understand a word you are saying. Maybe Father Aereck will be able to help.
translation: 我听不懂你在说什么。也许艾瑞克神父能帮上忙。 [wo ting bu dong ni zai shuo shen me 。 ye xu ai rui ke shen fu neng bang shang mang 。]

english: Hello ghost, how are you?
translation: 幽灵你好，你好吗？ [you ling ni hao ， ni hao ma ？]

english: Wooo wooo wooooo!
translation: 呜呜呜呜！ [wu wu wu wu ！]

english: Sorry, I don't speak ghost.
translation: 抱歉，我不会说鬼话。 [bao qian ， wo bu hui shuo gui hua 。]

english: Woo woo?
translation: 呜呜？ [wu wu ？]

english: Nope, still don't understand you.
translation: 不，还是不明白你。 [bu ， hai shi bu ming bai ni 。]

english: WOOOOOOOOO!
translation: 呜呜呜！ [wu wu wu ！]

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: Ooh, THAT'S interesting.
translation: 哦，这很有趣。 [o ， zhe hen you qu 。]

english: Woo wooo. Woooooooooooooooooo!
translation: 呜呜。呜呜呜呜呜！ [wu wu 。 wu wu wu wu wu ！]

english: Did he really?
translation: 他真的吗？ [ta zhen de ma ？]

english: Woo.
translation: 呜。 [wu 。]

english: My brother had EXACTLY the same problem.
translation: 我哥哥也有同样的问题。 [wo ge ge ye you tong yang de wen ti 。]

english: Woo Wooooo!
translation: 呜呜呜！ [wu wu wu ！]

english: Wooooo Woo woo woo!
translation: 呜呜呜呜呜！ [wu wu wu wu wu ！]

english: You'll have to give me the recipe some time...
translation: 你得给我食谱一些时间...... [ni de gei wo shi pu yi xie shi jian ......]

english: Wooooooo woo woooooooo.
translation: 呜呜呜呜呜呜呜。 [wu wu wu wu wu wu wu 。]

english: Yeah, that's what I thought.
translation: 是的，我就是这么想的。 [shi de ， wo jiu shi zhe me xiang de 。]

english: Wooo woooooooooooooo...
translation: 呜呜呜呜呜... [wu wu wu wu wu ...]

english: Goodbye. Thanks for the chat.
translation: 再见。感谢您的聊天。 [zai jian 。 gan xie nin de liao tian 。]

english: Wooo wooo?
translation: 呜呜？ [wu wu ？]

english: Hmm... I'm not so sure about that.
translation: 嗯...我对此不太确定。 [n ... wo dui ci bu tai que ding 。]

english: Wooo woo?
translation: 呜呜？ [wu wu ？]

english: Well, if you INSIST.
translation: 好吧，如果你坚持的话。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni jian chi de hua 。]

english: Wooooooooo!
translation: 呜呜呜！ [wu wu wu ！]

english: Ah well, better be off now...
translation: 啊，好吧，最好现在就走…… [a ， hao ba ， zui hao xian zai jiu zou ……]

english: Bye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Any hints where I can find some treasure?
translation: 有什么提示我可以在哪里找到宝藏吗？ [you shen me ti shi wo ke yi zai na li zhao dao bao zang ma ？]

english: Wooooooo woo! Wooooo woo wooooo woowoowoo woo Woo wooo. Wooooo woo woo? Woooooooooooooooooo!
translation: 呜呜呜！呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜。呜呜呜呜？呜呜呜呜呜！ [wu wu wu ！ wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu 。 wu wu wu wu ？ wu wu wu wu wu ！]

english: Thank you. You've been very helpful.
translation: 谢谢。你很有帮助。 [xie xie 。 ni hen you bang zhu 。]

english: Wooooooo.
translation: 呜呜呜。 [wu wu wu 。]

english: Not very good actually.
translation: 实际上不太好。 [shi ji shang bu tai hao 。]

english: What's the problem then?
translation: 那有什么问题呢？ [na you shen me wen ti ne ？]

english: Did you just understand what I said???
translation: 刚刚我说的话你明白了吗？？？ [gang gang wo shuo de hua ni ming bai le ma ？？？]

english: Yep, now tell me what the problem is.
translation: 是的，现在告诉我问题是什么。 [shi de ， xian zai gao su wo wen ti shi shen me 。]

english: WOW! This is INCREDIBLE! I didn't expect anyone to ever understand me again!
translation: 哇！这太不可思议了！我没想到会有人再次理解我！ [wa ！ zhe tai bu ke si yi le ！ wo mei xiang dao hui you ren zai ci li jie wo ！]

english: Ok, Ok, I can understand you!
translation: 好吧好吧，我能理解你！ [hao ba hao ba ， wo neng li jie ni ！]

english: But have you any idea WHY you're doomed to be a ghost?
translation: 但你知道为什么你注定会成为幽灵吗？ [dan ni zhi dao wei shen me ni zhu ding hui cheng wei you ling ma ？]

english: Well, to be honest... I'm not sure.
translation: 嗯，说实话……我不确定。 [n ， shuo shi hua …… wo bu que ding 。]

english: I've been told a certain task may need to be completed so you can rest in peace.
translation: 我被告知可能需要完成某项任务，这样你才能安心。 [wo bei gao zhi ke neng xu yao wan cheng mou xiang ren wu ， zhe yang ni cai neng an xin 。]

english: I should think it is probably because a warlock has come along and stolen my skull. If you look inside my coffin there, you'll find my corpse without a head on it.
translation: 我想这可能是因为一个术士出现并偷走了我的头骨。如果你看看我的棺材里面，你会发现我的尸体没有头。 [wo xiang zhe ke neng shi yin wei yi ge shu shi chu xian bing tou zou le wo de tou gu 。 ru guo ni kan kan wo de guan cai li mian ， ni hui fa xian wo de shi ti mei you tou 。]

english: Do you know where this warlock might be now?
translation: 你知道这个术士现在在哪里吗？ [ni zhi dao zhe ge shu shi xian zai zai na li ma ？]

english: I think it was one of the warlocks who lives in the big tower by the sea south-west from here.
translation: 我想是住在这里西南边海边的大塔里的术士之一。 [wo xiang shi zhu zai zhe li xi nan bian hai bian de da ta li de shu shi zhi yi 。]

english: Ok. I will try and get the skull back for you, then you can rest in peace.
translation: 好的。我会尽力为你取回头骨，然后你就可以安息了。 [hao de 。 wo hui jin li wei ni qu hui tou gu ， ran hou ni jiu ke yi an xi le 。]

english: Ooh, thank you. That would be such a great relief!
translation: 哦，谢谢。那将是极大的解脱！ [o ， xie xie 。 na jiang shi ji da de jie tuo ！]

english: It is so dull being a ghost...
translation: 当鬼真是太无聊了…… [dang gui zhen shi tai wu liao le ……]

english: No, you sound like you're speaking nonsense to me.
translation: 不，你听起来像是在对我胡说八道。 [bu ， ni ting qi lai xiang shi zai dui wo hu shuo ba dao 。]

english: Oh that's a pity. You got my hopes up there.
translation: 哦，真遗憾。你在那里承载了我的希望。 [o ， zhen yi han 。 ni zai na li cheng zai le wo de xi wang 。]

english: Yeah, it is a pity. Sorry about that.
translation: 是的，很遗憾。对此感到抱歉。 [shi de ， hen yi han 。 dui ci gan dao bao qian 。]

english: Hang on a second... you CAN understand me!
translation: 等一下......你能理解我！ [deng yi xia ...... ni neng li jie wo ！]

english: No I can't.
translation: 不，我不能。 [bu ， wo bu neng 。]

english: Great.
translation: 伟大的。 [wei da de 。]

english: The first person I can speak to in ages...
translation: 这么多年以来第一个能和我说话的人 [zhe me duo nian yi lai di yi ge neng he wo shuo hua de ren]

english: ..and they're a moron.
translation: ..他们是个白痴。 [.. ta men shi ge bai chi 。]

english: Yep, clever aren't I?
translation: 是啊，我很聪明不是吗？ [shi a ， wo hen cong ming bu shi ma ？]

english: I'm impressed. You must be very powerful. I don't suppose you can stop me being a ghost?
translation: 我印象深刻。你一定很强大。我想你不能阻止我成为幽灵吗？ [wo yin xiang shen ke 。 ni yi ding hen qiang da 。 wo xiang ni bu neng zu zhi wo cheng wei you ling ma ？]

english: Yes, ok. Do you know WHY you're a ghost?
translation: 是的，好的。你知道你为什么是鬼吗？ [shi de ， hao de 。 ni zhi dao ni wei shen me shi gui ma ？]

english: Nope. I just know I can't do much of anything like this!
translation: 没有。我只知道我无能为力！ [mei you 。 wo zhi zhi dao wo wu neng wei li ！]

english: No, you're scary!
translation: 不，你很可怕！ [bu ， ni hen ke pa ！]

english: ..and they're an idiot.
translation: ..他们是个白痴。 [.. ta men shi ge bai chi 。]

english: Wow, this amulet works!
translation: 哇，这个护身符有用！ [wa ， zhe ge hu shen fu you yong ！]

english: Oh! It's your amulet that's doing it! I did wonder. I don't suppose you can help me? I don't like being a ghost.
translation: 哦！这是你的护身符在起作用！我确实想知道。我想你不能帮助我吗？我不喜欢当幽灵。 [o ！ zhe shi ni de hu shen fu zai qi zuo yong ！ wo que shi xiang zhi dao 。 wo xiang ni bu neng bang zhu wo ma ？ wo bu xi huan dang you ling 。]

english: How are you doing finding my skull?
translation: 你找到我的头骨怎么样了？ [ni zhao dao wo de tou gu zen me yang le ？]

english: Sorry, I can't find it at the moment.
translation: 抱歉，我暂时找不到。 [bao qian ， wo zan shi zhao bu dao 。]

english: Ah well. Keep on looking.
translation: 啊好吧。继续寻找。 [a hao ba 。 ji xu xun zhao 。]

english: I'm pretty sure it's somewhere in the tower south-west from here. There's a lot of levels to the tower, though. I suppose it might take a little while to find.
translation: 我很确定它就在塔楼西南方向的某个地方。不过，塔有很多层。我想可能需要一些时间才能找到。 [wo hen que ding ta jiu zai ta lou xi nan fang xiang de mou ge di fang 。 bu guo ， ta you hen duo ceng 。 wo xiang ke neng xu yao yi xie shi jian cai neng zhao dao 。]

english: I have found it!
translation: 我找到了！ [wo zhao dao le ！]

english: Hurrah! Now I can stop being a ghost! You just need to put it in my coffin there, then I'll be free!
translation: 欢呼！现在我可以不再做鬼了！你只要把它放进我的棺材里，我就自由了！ [huan hu ！ xian zai wo ke yi bu zai zuo gui le ！ ni zhi yao ba ta fang jin wo de guan cai li ， wo jiu zi you le ！]

english: Release! Thank you stranger...
translation: 发布！谢谢陌生人... [fa bu ！ xie xie mo sheng ren ...]

english: The spirit flies into the River Lum.
translation: 灵魂飞入卢姆河。 [ling hun fei ru lu mu he 。]

english: Congratulations! Quest complete!
translation: 恭喜！任务完成！ [gong xi ！ ren wu wan cheng ！]

english: Sorry, I don't speak ghost.
translation: 抱歉，我不会说鬼话。 [bao qian ， wo bu hui shuo gui hua 。]

english: Ooh, THAT'S interesting.
translation: 哦，这很有趣。 [o ， zhe hen you qu 。]

english: Did he really?
translation: 他真的吗？ [ta zhen de ma ？]

english: My brother had EXACTLY the same problem.
translation: 我哥哥也有同样的问题。 [wo ge ge ye you tong yang de wen ti 。]

english: Goodbye. Thanks for the chat.
translation: 再见。感谢您的聊天。 [zai jian 。 gan xie nin de liao tian 。]

english: You'll have to give me the recipe some time...
translation: 你得给我食谱一些时间...... [ni de gei wo shi pu yi xie shi jian ......]

english: Hmm... I'm not so sure about that.
translation: 嗯...我对此不太确定。 [n ... wo dui ci bu tai que ding 。]

english: Yeah, that's what I thought.
translation: 是的，我就是这么想的。 [shi de ， wo jiu shi zhe me xiang de 。]

english: Hmm I'm not sure about that.
translation: 嗯，我对此不太确定。 [n ， wo dui ci bu tai que ding 。]

english: Any hints where I can find some treasure?
translation: 有什么提示我可以在哪里找到宝藏吗？ [you shen me ti shi wo ke yi zai na li zhao dao bao zang ma ？]

english: Thank you. You've been very helpful.
translation: 谢谢。你很有帮助。 [xie xie 。 ni hen you bang zhu 。]

english: Yep, now tell me what the problem is.
translation: 是的，现在告诉我问题是什么。 [shi de ， xian zai gao su wo wen ti shi shen me 。]

english: No, you sound like you're speaking nonsense to me.
translation: 不，你听起来像是在对我胡说八道。 [bu ， ni ting qi lai xiang shi zai dui wo hu shuo ba dao 。]

english: No I can't.
translation: 不，我不能。 [bu ， wo bu neng 。]

english: Yep, clever aren't I?
translation: 是啊，我很聪明不是吗？ [shi a ， wo hen cong ming bu shi ma ？]

english: Yes, ok. Do you know WHY you're a ghost?
translation: 是的，好的。你知道你为什么是鬼吗？ [shi de ， hao de 。 ni zhi dao ni wei shen me shi gui ma ？]

english: No, you're scary!
translation: 不，你很可怕！ [bu ， ni hen ke pa ！]

english: Wow, this amulet works!
translation: 哇，这个护身符有用！ [wa ， zhe ge hu shen fu you yong ！]

english: Yes, ok. Do you know why you're a ghost?
translation: 是的，好的。你知道你为什么是鬼吗？ [shi de ， hao de 。 ni zhi dao ni wei shen me shi gui ma ？]

english: Do you have something you'd like to trade, young [man/woman]?
translation: 年轻的[男人/女人]，你有什么想要交易的东西吗？ [nian qing de [ nan ren / nv ren ]， ni you shen me xiang yao jiao yi de dong xi ma ？]

english: What kind of trade can you offer?
translation: 你们能提供什么样的贸易？ [ni men neng ti gong shen me yang de mao yi ？]

english: Well, we find a lot of soaked pages in our nets. If you've got something we really want, I could swap it for 25 soaked pages.
translation: 好吧，我们在网上发现了很多被浸湿的页面。如果你有我们真正想要的东西，我可以用它换 25 页浸湿的纸。 [hao ba ， wo men zai wang shang fa xian le hen duo bei jin shi de ye mian 。 ru guo ni you wo men zhen zheng xiang yao de dong xi ， wo ke yi yong ta huan  25  ye jin shi de zhi 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Just a little place where we Spirit Anglers can store things, young [man/woman]. I used to be the chief mate on one of our ships, but now I just watch over the stores from the land.
translation: 只是我们精神垂钓者可以存放东西的小地方，年轻人[男人/女人]。我曾经是我们一艘船上的大副，但现在我只是在陆地上看管物资。 [zhi shi wo men jing shen chui diao zhe ke yi cun fang dong xi de xiao di fang ， nian qing ren [ nan ren / nv ren ]。 wo ceng jing shi wo men yi sou chuan shang de da fu ， dan xian zai wo zhi shi zai lu di shang kan guan wu zi 。]

english: Maybe you'd like to do a trade, though, while you're here?
translation: 不过，也许您想在这里做一笔交易？ [bu guo ， ye xu nin xiang zai zhe li zuo yi bi jiao yi ？]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: The sailor will exchange certain reward items for 25 soaked pages each.
translation: 水手将用特定的奖励物品兑换 25 张浸泡过的书页。 [shui shou jiang yong te ding de jiang li wu pin dui huan  25  zhang jin pao guo de shu ye 。]

english: You don't have any [item] to exchange.
translation: 您没有任何[物品]可以交换。 [nin mei you ren he [ wu pin ] ke yi jiao huan 。]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: What kind of trade can you offer?
translation: 你们能提供什么样的贸易？ [ni men neng ti gong shen me yang de mao yi ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Greetings. What wisdom do you seek?
translation: 问候。你寻求什么智慧？ [wen hou 。 ni xun qiu shen me zhi hui ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Me? I'm here to grant you rewards for any of the Pizazz Points you may have earned in this training arena. Like my fellow Guardians, I am part of the arena and live to ensure its safe running.
translation: 我？我来这里是为了奖励你在这个训练竞技场中获得的任何 Pizazz 积分。和我的守护者同伴一样，我也是竞技场的一部分，并致力于确保其安全运行。 [wo ？ wo lai zhe li shi wei le jiang li ni zai zhe ge xun lian jing ji chang zhong huo de de ren he  Pizazz  ji fen 。 he wo de shou hu zhe tong ban yi yang ， wo ye shi jing ji chang de yi bu fen ， bing zhi li yu que bao qi an quan yun xing 。]

english: I see.
translation: 我懂了。 [wo dong le 。]

english: Can I trade my Pizazz Points please?
translation: 我可以交易我的 Pizazz 积分吗？ [wo ke yi jiao yi wo de  Pizazz  ji fen ma ？]

english: Why of course.
translation: 为什么当然。 [wei shen me dang ran 。]

english: Got anything else I can buy?
translation: 还有什么我可以买的吗？ [hai you shen me wo ke yi mai de ma ？]

english: Well, we do stock a special book that you may be interested in, which provides a comprehensive guide to this training arena. It costs 200 coins. Would you like one?
translation: 好吧，我们确实备有一本您可能感兴趣的特别书籍，其中提供了有关此培训领域的全面指南。花费200金币。你想要一个吗？ [hao ba ， wo men que shi bei you yi ben nin ke neng gan xing qu de te bie shu ji ， qi zhong ti gong le you guan ci pei xun ling yu de quan mian zhi nan 。 hua fei 200 jin bi 。 ni xiang yao yi ge ma ？]

english: That sounds useful. Yes please.
translation: 听起来很有用。是的，请。 [ting qi lai hen you yong 。 shi de ， qing 。]

english: Very good, that'll be 200 coins please!
translation: 太好了，就200金币吧！ [tai hao le ， jiu 200 jin bi ba ！]

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Sorry, I don't have enough money.
translation: 抱歉，我的钱不够。 [bao qian ， wo de qian bu gou 。]

english: I don't want some dusty old book.
translation: 我不想要一本布满灰尘的旧书。 [wo bu xiang yao yi ben bu man hui chen de jiu shu 。]

english: It's not old and it certainly isn't dusty, but suit yourself.
translation: 它并不旧，当然也没有灰尘，但适合你自己。 [ta bing bu jiu ， dang ran ye mei you hui chen ， dan shi he ni zi ji 。]

english: No thanks, I already have one.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我已经有一个了。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo yi jing you yi ge le 。]

english: Let me know if you lose it.
translation: 如果你丢失了请告诉我。 [ru guo ni diu shi le qing gao su wo 。]

english: Thanks, bye!
translation: 谢谢，再见！ [xie xie ， zai jian ！]

english: Use what you've learned, young one.
translation: 年轻人，运用你所学到的知识。 [nian qing ren ， yun yong ni suo xue dao de zhi shi 。]

english: Greetings. Have you spoken to my fellow Guardian downstairs?
translation: 问候。你和我楼下的守护者同伴说过话了吗？ [wen hou 。 ni he wo lou xia de shou hu zhe tong ban shuo guo hua le ma ？]

english: Nope.
translation: 没有。 [mei you 。]

english: Well, you need to talk to him first.
translation: 嗯，你得先和他谈谈。 [n ， ni de xian he ta tan tan 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Can I trade my Pizazz Points please?
translation: 我可以交易我的 Pizazz 积分吗？ [wo ke yi jiao yi wo de  Pizazz  ji fen ma ？]

english: Got anything else I can buy?
translation: 还有什么我可以买的吗？ [hai you shen me wo ke yi mai de ma ？]

english: That sounds useful. Yes please.
translation: 听起来很有用。是的，请。 [ting qi lai hen you yong 。 shi de ， qing 。]

english: I don't want some dusty old book.
translation: 我不想要一本布满灰尘的旧书。 [wo bu xiang yao yi ben bu man hui chen de jiu shu 。]

english: Thanks, bye!
translation: 谢谢，再见！ [xie xie ， zai jian ！]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Oh, hellow adventurer. Can I help you with anything?
translation: 哦，你好冒险家。我可以帮你什么忙吗？ [o ， ni hao mao xian jia 。 wo ke yi bang ni shen me mang ma ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This is the prison of Zalcano.
translation: 这是萨尔卡诺的监狱。 [zhe shi sa er ka nuo de jian yu 。]

english: Zalcano?
translation: 扎尔卡诺？ [zha er ka nuo ？]

english: That's right. She's a powerful demon, one bearing an ancient curse.
translation: 这是正确的。她是一个强大的恶魔，背负着古老的诅咒。 [zhe shi zheng que de 。 ta shi yi ge qiang da de e mo ， bei fu zhe gu lao de zu zhou 。]

english: A curse? That doesn't sound good.
translation: 诅咒？听起来不太好。 [zu zhou ？ ting qi lai bu tai hao 。]

english: Don't worry, the curse only affects her. Because of it, her entire body has been turned to stone.
translation: 别担心，诅咒只会影响她。正因为如此，她的整个身体都变成了石头。 [bie dan xin ， zu zhou zhi hui ying xiang ta 。 zheng yin wei ru ci ， ta de zheng ge shen ti dou bian cheng le shi tou 。]

english: I see. So why is she here?
translation: 我懂了。那么她为什么在这里？ [wo dong le 。 na me ta wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: She came to our lands long ago, before the curse had fully taken hold. We imprisoned her here for study, so that we might learn more about her affliction.
translation: 很久以前，在诅咒完全生效之前，她就来到了我们的土地。我们把她囚禁在这里进行研究，以便更多地了解她的痛苦。 [hen jiu yi qian ， zai zu zhou wan quan sheng xiao zhi qian ， ta jiu lai dao le wo men de tu di 。 wo men ba ta qiu jin zai zhe li jin xing yan jiu ， yi bian geng duo di liao jie ta de tong ku 。]

english: If you want to learn more, you should be able to find a book in the Grand Library about her.
translation: 如果你想了解更多，你应该可以在大图书馆找到一本关于她的书。 [ru guo ni xiang liao jie geng duo ， ni ying gai ke yi zai da tu shu guan zhao dao yi ben guan yu ta de shu 。]

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 还有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [hai you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

english: What can I do here?
translation: 我在这里能做什么？ [wo zai zhe li neng zuo shen me ？]

english: Well we could always use some help in keeping Zalcano under control.
translation: 好吧，我们总是需要一些帮助来控制扎尔卡诺。 [hao ba ， wo men zong shi xu yao yi xie bang zhu lai kong zhi zha er ka nuo 。]

english: How would I do that?
translation: 我该怎么做呢？ [wo gai zen me zuo ne ？]

english: Zalcano is formed completely from stone. Because of this, normal weapons won't work on her.
translation: Zalcano 完全由石头制成。因此，普通武器对她不起作用。 [Zalcano  wan quan you shi tou zhi cheng 。 yin ci ， pu tong wu qi dui ta bu qi zuo yong 。]

english: That said, when she's vulnerable, you can still do some damage to her if you use a pickaxe.
translation: 也就是说，当她很脆弱时，如果你使用镐，你仍然可以对她造成一些伤害。 [ye jiu shi shuo ， dang ta hen cui ruo shi ， ru guo ni shi yong gao ， ni reng ran ke yi dui ta zao cheng yi xie shang hai 。]

english: When she's vulnerable? How do I make her vulnerable?
translation: 当她脆弱的时候？我怎样才能让她变得脆弱？ [dang ta cui ruo de shi hou ？ wo zen yang cai neng rang ta bian de cui ruo ？]

english: The ore found within these caverns can be rather volatile, especially when heated. We've found that when imbued, this ore can damage her armour.
translation: 这些洞穴内发现的矿石非常不稳定，尤其是在加热时。我们发现，当这种矿石被灌输时，它会损坏她的盔甲。 [zhe xie dong xue nei fa xian de kuang shi fei chang bu wen ding ， you qi shi zai jia re shi 。 wo men fa xian ， dang zhe zhong kuang shi bei guan shu shi ， ta hui sun huai ta de kui jia 。]

english: You'll want to head on in and mine the ore from the rocks around the prison. Once you have some, you can heat it using the furnace and then imbue it using the altar.
translation: 你会想要继续前进，从监狱周围的岩石中开采矿石。一旦你有了一些，你可以使用熔炉加热它，然后使用祭坛将其注入。 [ni hui xiang yao ji xu qian jin ， cong jian yu zhou wei de yan shi zhong kai cai kuang shi 。 yi dan ni you le yi xie ， ni ke yi shi yong rong lu jia re ta ， ran hou shi yong ji tan jiang qi zhu ru 。]

english: Once you've got some imbued ore, just give it a throw her way and she'll definitely feel it.
translation: 一旦你得到了一些灌注矿石，只要把它扔给她，她一定会感觉到的。 [yi dan ni de dao le yi xie guan zhu kuang shi ， zhi yao ba ta reng gei ta ， ta yi ding hui gan jue dao de 。]

english: What do I get for helping out here?
translation: 我在这里帮忙能得到什么？ [wo zai zhe li bang mang neng de dao shen me ？]

english: Well assuming you are successful of subdueingZalcano, she has accumulated a lot of ores and magical runes from her time as a demon.
translation: 假设你成功制服了扎尔卡诺，她从恶魔时代就积累了大量矿石和魔法符文。 [jia she ni cheng gong zhi fu le zha er ka nuo ， ta cong e mo shi dai jiu ji lei le da liang kuang shi he mo fa fu wen 。]

english: Not bad, what if I didn't want these resources? Is there anything you can give me instead?
translation: 不错，如果我不需要这些资源怎么办？你有什么可以给我的吗？ [bu cuo ， ru guo wo bu xu yao zhe xie zi yuan zen me ban ？ ni you shen me ke yi gei wo de ma ？]

english: Well we would always appreciate these resources, in exchange we could bestow upon you our elven knowledge for mining.
translation: 好吧，我们将永远感激这些资源，作为交换，我们可以将我们的精灵采矿知识传授给您。 [hao ba ， wo men jiang yong yuan gan ji zhe xie zi yuan ， zuo wei jiao huan ， wo men ke yi jiang wo men de jing ling cai kuang zhi shi chuan shou gei nin 。]

english: We wouldn't be asking for anything special though, just the common resources are what we require.
translation: 不过，我们不会要求任何特殊的东西，我们只需要公共资源。 [bu guo ， wo men bu hui yao qiu ren he te shu de dong xi ， wo men zhi xu yao gong gong zi yuan 。]

english: We won't take any resources from your successes, the resources are all your own.
translation: 我们不会从您的成功中获取任何资源，资源都是您自己的。 [wo men bu hui cong nin de cheng gong zhong huo qu ren he zi yuan ， zi yuan dou shi nin zi ji de 。]

english: We will automatically collect the resources and bestow you with our elven mining knowledge.
translation: 我们将自动收集资源并为您提供我们的精灵采矿知识。 [wo men jiang zi dong shou ji zi yuan bing wei nin ti gong wo men de jing ling cai kuang zhi shi 。]

translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: I'm Rhoddwr, a simple forest dweller.
translation: 我是罗德，一个简单的森林居民。 [wo shi luo de ， yi ge jian dan de sen lin ju min 。]

english: It's nice to meet you Rhoddwr, I'm [player name].
translation: 很高兴认识你，Rhoddwr，我是[玩家名字]。 [hen gao xing ren shi ni ，Rhoddwr， wo shi [ wan jia ming zi ]。]

translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm the leader of this small camp. We live amongst the trees, at one with the forest.
translation: 我是这个小营地的领导者。我们生活在树林之中，与森林融为一体。 [wo shi zhe ge xiao ying di de ling dao zhe 。 wo men sheng huo zai shu lin zhi zhong ， yu sen lin rong wei yi ti 。]

english: That sounds relaxing.
translation: 听起来很放松。 [ting qi lai hen fang song 。]

english: That's because it is! This is where we belong, this is where we began.
translation: 那是因为它是！这是我们的归属，这是我们开始的地方。 [na shi yin wei ta shi ！ zhe shi wo men de gui shu ， zhe shi wo men kai shi de di fang 。]

english: A nice sentiment, but we can't all live off the land.
translation: 这是一种美好的感觉，但我们不能都靠土地为生。 [zhe shi yi zhong mei hao de gan jue ， dan wo men bu neng dou kao tu di wei sheng 。]

english: Very true! As we expand and grow, nature refuses to adjust to our ways. The only other option is to destroy it to make room for growth.
translation: 非常真实！当我们扩张和成长时，大自然拒绝适应我们的方式。唯一的选择是摧毁它以腾出成长空间。 [fei chang zhen shi ！ dang wo men kuo zhang he cheng zhang shi ， da zi ran ju jue shi ying wo men de fang shi 。 wei yi de xuan ze shi cui hui ta yi teng chu cheng zhang kong jian 。]

english: Hopefully nature understands the necessity of it all.
translation: 希望大自然能够理解这一切的必要性。 [xi wang da zi ran neng gou li jie zhe yi qie de bi yao xing 。]

english: History shows again and again that nature points out the folly of man.
translation: 历史一再证明，大自然指出了人类的愚蠢。 [li shi yi zai zheng ming ， da zi ran zhi chu le ren lei de yu chun 。]

english: Which is why we should learn from the past and avoid making such mistakes.
translation: 这就是为什么我们应该吸取过去的教训，避免犯这样的错误。 [zhe jiu shi wei shen me wo men ying gai xi qu guo qu de jiao xun ， bi mian fan zhe yang de cuo wu 。]

english: Indeed, although some mistakes have lasting effects that cannot be undone. Is there anything else you wanted to know?
translation: 确实，尽管有些错误会产生无法挽回的持久影响。您还有什么想知道的吗？ [que shi ， jin guan you xie cuo wu hui chan sheng wu fa wan hui de chi jiu ying xiang 。 nin hai you shen me xiang zhi dao de ma ？]
