english: Ahoy, young whippersnapper. Have you come to hear a tale from old Ribs?
translation: 嘿，年轻的自吹自擂者。你是来听老肋骨讲故事的吗？ [hei ， nian qing de zi chui zi lei zhe 。 ni shi lai ting lao lei gu jiang gu shi de ma ？]

english: Could you tell me about Barnacle Barnaby?
translation: 你能告诉我关于藤壶巴纳比的事吗？ [ni neng gao su wo guan yu teng hu ba na bi de shi ma ？]

english: He was a cruel and vicious pirate. Orchestrator of the Driftwood Massacre and unleasher of the Plague of Black Mists. He believed himself untouchable, but his arrogance was his undoing.
translation: 他是一个残忍、恶毒的海盗。浮木大屠杀的策划者和黑雾瘟疫的释放者。他相信自己是不可触碰的，但他的傲慢却导致了他的失败。 [ta shi yi ge can ren 、 e du de hai dao 。 fu mu da tu sha de ce hua zhe he hei wu wen yi de shi fang zhe 。 ta xiang xin zi ji shi bu ke chu peng de ， dan ta de ao man que dao zhi le ta de shi bai 。]

english: Despite the warnings of many, Barnacle Barnaby attempted to plunder the Skullhorde, but his only reward was a deadly curse. It destroyed the Crimson Kraken, condemning all on board to a watery grave.
translation: 尽管受到许多人的警告，藤壶巴纳比还是试图掠夺骷髅部落，但他唯一的回报是致命的诅咒。它摧毁了深红海妖号，将船上的所有人都送进了水坟墓。 [jin guan shou dao xu duo ren de jing gao ， teng hu ba na bi hai shi shi tu lve duo ku lou bu luo ， dan ta wei yi de hui bao shi zhi ming de zu zhou 。 ta cui hui le shen hong hai yao hao ， jiang chuan shang de suo you ren dou song jin le shui fen mu 。]

english: And you had a map leading to the wreck of the Kraken?
translation: 你有一张通往海妖号残骸的地图吗？ [ni you yi zhang tong wang hai yao hao can hai de di tu ma ？]

english: Aye! I purchased the map from Ulrich the Unfortunate, the sole survivor of the Kraken, but I had no intention of using it. I knew that no good would ever come from seeking the Kraken.
translation: 是啊！我从海妖唯一的幸存者乌尔里希·不幸者那里购买了这张地图，但我无意使用它。我知道寻找海妖不会带来任何好处。 [shi a ！ wo cong hai yao wei yi de xing cun zhe wu er li xi · bu xing zhe na li gou mai le zhe zhang di tu ， dan wo wu yi shi yong ta 。 wo zhi dao xun zhao hai yao bu hui dai lai ren he hao chu 。]

english: Then why not destroy the map?
translation: 那为什么不毁掉地图呢？ [na wei shen me bu hui diao di tu ne ？]

english: And risk the wrath of Barnaby's ghost? No. I thought it better the map be locked away, so that neither it nor the curse could harm anyone else, but those young fools put an end to that.
translation: 并冒着巴纳比鬼魂愤怒的风险？不。我认为最好把地图锁起来，这样它和诅咒都不会伤害其他人，但那些年轻的傻瓜结束了这一切。 [bing mao zhe ba na bi gui hun fen nu de feng xian ？ bu 。 wo ren wei zui hao ba di tu suo qi lai ， zhe yang ta he zu zhou dou bu hui shang hai qi ta ren ， dan na xie nian qing de sha gua jie shu le zhe yi qie 。]

english: Now, we can only hope that someone puts a stop to them before it's too late. Who knows, perhaps it will be you who does so.
translation: 现在，我们只能希望有人能够阻止他们，以免为时已晚。谁知道呢，也许你会这样做。 [xian zai ， wo men zhi neng xi wang you ren neng gou zu zhi ta men ， yi mian wei shi yi wan 。 shui zhi dao ne ， ye xu ni hui zhe yang zuo 。]

english: Well, on that note, I'd best be getting off. Until next time, Ribs.
translation: 好吧，就这一点而言，我最好下车。下次见，排骨。 [hao ba ， jiu zhe yi dian er yan ， wo zui hao xia che 。 xia ci jian ， pai gu 。]

english: I don't think so.
translation: 我不这么认为。 [wo bu zhe me ren wei 。]

english: As you wish, but you would be wise to learn from your elders. My tales might one day save you from a one- way trip to see Davey Jones!
translation: 如你所愿，但明智的做法是向长辈学习。我的故事也许有一天能让你免于去见戴维·琼斯的单程旅行！ [ru ni suo yuan ， dan ming zhi de zuo fa shi xiang zhang bei xue xi 。 wo de gu shi ye xu you yi tian neng rang ni mian yu qu jian dai wei · qiong si de dan cheng lv xing ！]

english: My pub's called The Golden Field. It's where all the local workers come to relax and unwind after a hard day. I try to keep it really nice here for them. Anyway, are you drinking?
translation: 我的酒吧叫“金田”。这是所有当地工人在辛苦一天后来这里放松身心的地方。我努力让他们在这里保持美好。无论如何，你喝酒吗？ [wo de jiu ba jiao “ jin tian ”。 zhe shi suo you dang di gong ren zai xin ku yi tian hou lai zhe li fang song shen xin de di fang 。 wo nu li rang ta men zai zhe li bao chi mei hao 。 wu lun ru he ， ni he jiu ma ？]

translation: 告诉我你以前的工作。 [gao su wo ni yi qian de gong zuo 。]

english: Well, city warder Bravek once threw a chair at me and yelled at me to get him a hangover cure. So I made it and I think it worked, 'cause then he threw another chair at me and that one hit!

translation: 抱歉我不能让你过去，找其他兔子来打扰吧，我很忙。 [bao qian wo bu neng rang ni guo qu ， zhao qi ta tu zi lai da rao ba ， wo hen mang 。]

english: Can you see your own rift?
translation: 你能看到自己的裂痕吗？ [ni neng kan dao zi ji de lie hen ma ？]

english: No. From time to time I feel it shift and change inside me though. It is an odd feeling.
translation: 不，但有时我会感觉到它在我内心发生变化。这是一种奇怪的感觉。 [bu ， dan you shi wo hui gan jue dao ta zai wo nei xin fa sheng bian hua 。 zhe shi yi zhong qi guai de gan jue 。]

english: Where would you like me to take you today Rifty?
translation: 今天你想让我带你去哪里 Rifty？ [jin tian ni xiang rang wo dai ni qu na li  Rifty？]

english: Please do not call me that... we are a species of honour, [player name].
translation: 请不要这样称呼我……我们是一个有荣誉的物种，[玩家名字]。 [qing bu yao zhe yang cheng hu wo …… wo men shi yi ge you rong yu de wu zhong ，[ wan jia ming zi ]。]

english: Sorry.
translation: 对不起。 [dui bu qi 。]

english: Hey! What's that!
translation: 嘿！那是什么！ [hei ！ na shi shen me ！]

english: You quickly poke your hand through the rift guardian's rift.
translation: 你迅速把手伸进裂隙守护者的裂隙。 [ni xun su ba shou shen jin lie xi shou hu zhe de lie xi 。]

english: Huh, what?! Where?
translation: 呃，什么？！在哪里？ [e ， shen me ？！ zai na li ？]

english: Not the best guardian it seems.
translation: 看起来不是最好的守护者。 [kan qi lai bu shi zui hao de shou hu zhe 。]

english: About your colour-changing...
translation: 关于你的变色... [guan yu ni de bian se ...]

english: If you take me to a Runecrafting Altar, I will adopt the altar's colour as you bind essence there.
translation: 如果你带我去符文制作祭坛，当你在那里绑定精华时，我会采用祭坛的颜色。 [ru guo ni dai wo qu fu wen zhi zuo ji tan ， dang ni zai na li bang ding jing hua shi ， wo hui cai yong ji tan de yan se 。]

english: I want you to stay this colour instead.
translation: 我希望你保持这种颜色。 [wo xi wang ni bao chi zhe zhong yan se 。]

english: Very well, I will remain locked to this colour, even if you bind essence at a Runecrafting Altar.
translation: 很好，我会继续锁定这种颜色，即使你在符文制作祭坛上绑定精华。 [hen hao ， wo hui ji xu suo ding zhe zhong yan se ， ji shi ni zai fu wen zhi zuo ji tan shang bang ding jing hua 。]

english: Okay, carry on adopting the colour of altars.
translation: 好吧，继续采用祭坛的颜色。 [hao ba ， ji xu cai yong ji tan de yan se 。]

english: Very well, I will adopt the altar's colour next time you bind essence at a Runecrafting Altar.
translation: 很好，下次你在符文制作祭坛上绑定精华时，我会采用祭坛的颜色。 [hen hao ， xia ci ni zai fu wen zhi zuo ji tan shang bang ding jing hua shi ， wo hui cai yong ji tan de yan se 。]

english: Even if you bind essence at a Runecrafting Altar, I will remain locked to this colour.
translation: 即使你在符文制作祭坛上绑定精华，我也会继续锁定这种颜色。 [ji shi ni zai fu wen zhi zuo ji tan shang bang ding jing hua ， wo ye hui ji xu suo ding zhe zhong yan se 。]

english: I'd like you to adopt the altar's colour next time.
translation: 我希望你下次采用祭坛的颜色。 [wo xi wang ni xia ci cai yong ji tan de yan se 。]

english: Okay, please stay locked to this colour.
translation: 好吧，请锁定这个颜色。 [hao ba ， qing suo ding zhe ge yan se 。]

english: Actually, never mind.
translation: 其实，没关系。 [qi shi ， mei guan xi 。]

english: How are you doing today?
translation: 你今天怎么样？ [ni jin tian zen me yang ？]

english: The power of the Abyss grows. I fear for what will happen if our defence against it fails.
translation: 深渊的力量在增长。我担心如果我们的防御失败会发生什么。 [shen yuan de li liang zai zeng zhang 。 wo dan xin ru guo wo men de fang yu shi bai hui fa sheng shen me 。]

english: The Guardians of the Rift have things under control. You don't need to worry.
translation: 裂谷守护者已经掌控一切。你不用担心。 [lie gu shou hu zhe yi jing zhang kong yi qie 。 ni bu yong dan xin 。]

english: Let us hope you are correct.
translation: 让我们希望你是正确的。 [rang wo men xi wang ni shi zheng que de 。]

english: Feel my wrath!
translation: 感受我的愤怒吧！ [gan shou wo de fen nu ba ！]

english: Get out of my altar!
translation: 从我的祭坛上滚出去！ [cong wo de ji tan shang gun chu qu ！]

english: Feel the power of my rift!
translation: 感受一下我裂痕的力量吧！ [gan shou yi xia wo lie hen de li liang ba ！]

english: I'll convert your very essence into runes.
translation: 我会将你的本质转化为符文。 [wo hui jiang ni de ben zhi zhuan hua wei fu wen 。]

english: Can you see your own rift?
translation: 你能看到自己的裂痕吗？ [ni neng kan dao zi ji de lie hen ma ？]

english: Where would you like to go today, Rifty?
translation: Rifty，你今天想去哪里？ [Rifty， ni jin tian xiang qu na li ？]

english: Hey! What's that?
translation: 嘿！那是什么？ [hei ！ na shi shen me ？]

english: About your colour-changing...
translation: 关于你的变色... [guan yu ni de bian se ...]

english: I want you to stay this colour instead.
translation: 我希望你保持这种颜色。 [wo xi wang ni bao chi zhe zhong yan se 。]

english: Okay, carry on adopting the colour of altars.
translation: 好吧，继续采用祭坛的颜色。 [hao ba ， ji xu cai yong ji tan de yan se 。]

english: I'd like you to adopt the altar's colour next time.
translation: 我希望你下次采用祭坛的颜色。 [wo xi wang ni xia ci cai yong ji tan de yan se 。]

english: Okay, please stay locked to this colour.
translation: 好吧，请锁定这个颜色。 [hao ba ， qing suo ding zhe ge yan se 。]

english: Actually, never mind.
translation: 其实，没关系。 [qi shi ， mei guan xi 。]

english: How are you doing today?
translation: 你今天怎么样？ [ni jin tian zen me yang ？]

english: Hello there, what are you doing here?
translation: 你好，你在这里做什么？ [ni hao ， ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I... am the sculptor's associate.
translation: 我...是雕塑家的同事。 [wo ... shi diao su jia de tong shi 。]

english: His associate? What does that mean?
translation: 他的同事？这意味着什么？ [ta de tong shi ？ zhe yi wei zhe shen me ？]

english: Are you going to say anything meaningful at all?
translation: 你会说一些有意义的话吗？ [ni hui shuo yi xie you yi yi de hua ma ？]

english: No, apparantly not.
translation: 不，显然不是。 [bu ， xian ran bu shi 。]

english: I'm glad I don't have to talk to you anymore!
translation: 我很高兴我不用再和你说话了！ [wo hen gao xing wo bu yong zai he ni shuo hua le ！]

english: Hrm.
Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Welcome to the clothes store. How might I help you?
translation: 欢迎来到服装店。我可以怎样帮助你？ [huan ying lai dao fu zhuang dian 。 wo ke yi zen yang bang zhu ni ？]

english: It's a very interesting island you have here.
translation: 这是一个非常有趣的岛屿。 [zhe shi yi ge fei chang you qu de dao yu 。]

english: Why thank you. It's been our haven for a great many generations.
translation: 为什么要谢谢你。它一直是我们几代人的避风港。 [wei shen me yao xie xie ni 。 ta yi zhi shi wo men ji dai ren de bi feng gang 。]

english: Everything seems to have a magical feel to it.
translation: 一切似乎都有一种神奇的感觉。 [yi qie si hu dou you yi zhong shen qi de gan jue 。]

english: Of course. We integrate magic into all areas of our lives. It is a part of everyone, so why deny it? It's best to make the most of this innate gift we have all been given.
translation: 当然。我们将魔法融入生活的各个领域。它是每个人的一部分，那么为什么要否认它呢？最好充分利用我们都被赋予的这种与生俱来的天赋。 [dang ran 。 wo men jiang mo fa rong ru sheng huo de ge ge ling yu 。 ta shi mei ge ren de yi bu fen ， na me wei shen me yao fou ren ta ne ？ zui hao chong fen li yong wo men dou bei fu yu de zhe zhong yu sheng ju lai de tian fu 。]

english: What sort of things do you use your magic for?
translation: 你用你的魔法做什么？ [ni yong ni de mo fa zuo shen me ？]

english: Take a look around. We use it in our day to day lives, from making a cup of tea, to travelling around the island. You see our ancestors were the ones that found the first rune essence and put it to use! The various
translation: 看看周围。我们在日常生活中使用它，从泡一杯茶到环岛旅行。你看，我们的祖先是第一个发现符文精华并加以利用的人！各种 [kan kan zhou wei 。 wo men zai ri chang sheng huo zhong shi yong ta ， cong pao yi bei cha dao huan dao lv xing 。 ni kan ， wo men de zu xian shi di yi ge fa xian fu wen jing hua bing jia yi li yong de ren ！ ge zhong]

english: factions were eventually created, with people having different ideas on how the essence should be used (or not in some cases!)
translation: 最终创建了派系，人们对于如何使用精华有不同的想法（或者在某些情况下不使用！） [zui zhong chuang jian le pai xi ， ren men dui yu ru he shi yong jing hua you bu tong de xiang fa （ huo zhe zai mou xie qing kuang xia bu shi yong ！）]

english: What has kept you so secluded on this island?
translation: 是什么让你在这个岛上如此与世隔绝？ [shi shen me rang ni zai zhe ge dao shang ru ci yu shi ge jue ？]

english: It may be a bit beyond you, but although magic comes from within, we are all very strongly linked to the moon and the effects it has on us cannot be denied!
translation: 这可能有点超出你的理解，但尽管魔法来自内心，但我们都与月球有着紧密的联系，它对我们的影响是不可否认的！ [zhe ke neng you dian chao chu ni de li jie ， dan jin guan mo fa lai zi nei xin ， dan wo men dou yu yue qiu you zhe jin mi de lian xi ， ta dui wo men de ying xiang shi bu ke fou ren de ！]

english: It can't?
translation: 不可以吗？ [bu ke yi ma ？]

english: Of course not. This very island has a great link to our moon, which helps us understand ourselves - especially our dreams, which is the path to understanding magic.
translation: 当然不是。这座岛屿与我们的月球有着密切的联系，它可以帮助我们了解自己——尤其是我们的梦想，这是理解魔法的途径。 [dang ran bu shi 。 zhe zuo dao yu yu wo men de yue qiu you zhe mi qie de lian xi ， ta ke yi bang zhu wo men liao jie zi ji —— you qi shi wo men de meng xiang ， zhe shi li jie mo fa de tu jing 。]

english: I think I will just have to take your word on that.
translation: 我想我只能相信你的话。 [wo xiang wo zhi neng xiang xin ni de hua 。]

english: I'm good thanks, bye.
translation: 我很好，谢谢，再见。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie ， zai jian 。]

english: What can you sell me?
translation: 你能卖给我什么？ [ni neng mai gei wo shen me ？]

english: It's a very interesting island you have here.
translation: 这是一个非常有趣的岛屿。 [zhe shi yi ge fei chang you qu de dao yu 。]

english: I'm good thanks, bye.
translation: 我很好，谢谢，再见。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie ， zai jian 。]

english: Come to visit my garden then, have you, human?
translation: 那么，来参观我的花园吧，人类？ [na me ， lai can guan wo de hua yuan ba ， ren lei ？]

english: This is your garden?
translation: 这是你的花园吗？ [zhe shi ni de hua yuan ma ？]

english: No no, not quite. But I do look after it. It's the palace garden, you see. I keep it tidy, keep it living.
translation: 不不，不完全是。但我确实照顾它。你看，这就是皇宫花园。我保持它整洁，保持它的活力。 [bu bu ， bu wan quan shi 。 dan wo que shi zhao gu ta 。 ni kan ， zhe jiu shi huang gong hua yuan 。 wo bao chi ta zheng jie ， bao chi ta de huo li 。]

english: It's hard to grow much on these hard rocks deep beneath these mountains, you know.
translation: 你知道，在这些山脉深处的坚硬岩石上很难长出多少东西。 [ni zhi dao ， zai zhe xie shan mai shen chu de jian ying yan shi shang hen nan zhang chu duo shao dong xi 。]

english: I can imagine. Where do you get all your food from? Or even the soil for this garden?
translation: 我可以想象。你所有的食物都是从哪里来的？或者这个花园的土壤？ [wo ke yi xiang xiang 。 ni suo you de shi wu dou shi cong na li lai de ？ huo zhe zhe ge hua yuan de tu rang ？]

english: We can grow a little food underground, but most of it comes from the extensive steamcart network that runs beneath the earth.
translation: 我们可以在地下种植一些食物，但大部分来自地下运行的广泛的蒸汽车网络。 [wo men ke yi zai di xia zhong zhi yi xie shi wu ， dan da bu fen lai zi di xia yun xing de guang fan de zheng qi che wang luo 。]

english: In the Era of Kings, many centuries ago, it was harder of course. Our steam technology was not developed as far yet and getting fresh supplies of food was always a problem.
translation: 在许多世纪前的王者时代，这当然更困难。我们的蒸汽技术还没有发展起来，获得新鲜的食物一直是一个问题。 [zai xu duo shi ji qian de wang zhe shi dai ， zhe dang ran geng kun nan 。 wo men de zheng qi ji shu hai mei you fa zhan qi lai ， huo de xin xian de shi wu yi zhi shi yi ge wen ti 。]

english: Oh, I'm not boring you, am I?
translation: 哦，我没有让你厌烦吧？ [o ， wo mei you rang ni yan fan ba ？]

english: Not at all! Please, go on!
translation: 一点也不！请继续！ [yi dian ye bu ！ qing ji xu ！]

english: Oh yes, as I was saying, it was difficult to make a decent living here. I'm afraid this garden was rather neglected during that time.
translation: 哦，是的，正如我所说，在这里过上体面的生活很困难。恐怕这个花园在那段时间被忽视了。 [o ， shi de ， zheng ru wo suo shuo ， zai zhe li guo shang ti mian de sheng huo hen kun nan 。 kong pa zhe ge hua yuan zai na duan shi jian bei hu shi le 。]

english: Why did you dwarves stay so deep under ground, then? Why not simply go above ground?
translation: 那么你们矮人为什么要呆在地下这么深的地方呢？为什么不直接到地面上去呢？ [na me ni men ai ren wei shen me yao dai zai di xia zhe me shen de di fang ne ？ wei shen me bu zhi jie dao di mian shang qu ne ？]

english: What, with the wars raging up there?
translation: 什么，那里战事如火如荼？ [shen me ， na li zhan shi ru huo ru tu ？]

english: We dwarves went underground a long time ago, see. For a while the city of Keldagrim was completely cut off from the rest of Gielinor simply waiting out the wars of the humans and the gods.
translation: 我们矮人很久以前就进入了地下，瞧。有一段时间，凯尔达格林市与吉林诺的其他地方完全隔绝，只是等待人类和众神的战争结束。 [wo men ai ren hen jiu yi qian jiu jin ru le di xia ， qiao 。 you yi duan shi jian ， kai er da ge lin shi yu ji lin nuo de qi ta di fang wan quan ge jue ， zhi shi deng dai ren lei he zhong shen de zhan zheng jie shu 。]

english: This made it hard, though, to determine when the wars above the ground were over. Perhaps Keldagrim had remained hidden for far too long.
translation: 然而，这使得很难确定地面战争何时结束。也许凯达格林隐藏得太久了。 [ran er ， zhe shi de hen nan que ding di mian zhan zheng he shi jie shu 。 ye xu kai da ge lin yin cang de tai jiu le 。]

english: Only when King Alvis heroically defended the city against an invasion of trolls did we dare to venture out and see how much the world had changed.
translation: 只有当阿尔维斯国王英勇地保卫城市免受巨魔的入侵时，我们才敢冒险出去看看世界发生了多大的变化。 [zhi you dang a er wei si guo wang ying yong di bao wei cheng shi mian shou ju mo de ru qin shi ， wo men cai gan mao xian chu qu kan kan shi jie fa sheng le duo da de bian hua 。]

english: Of course, after that...
translation: 当然，在那之后…… [dang ran ， zai na zhi hou ……]

english: Ah well, enough history lessons I should say. I must really get back to my gardening.
translation: 啊，好吧，我应该说足够的历史教训了。我真的必须回去做园艺了。 [a ， hao ba ， wo ying gai shuo zu gou de li shi jiao xun le 。 wo zhen de bi xu hui qu zuo yuan yi le 。]

english: Thanks for the info!
translation: 感谢您的信息！ [gan xie nin de xin xi ！]

english: A little, yes. I don't really know what all this has to do with anything.
translation: 有一点，是的。我真的不知道这一切有什么关系。 [you yi dian ， shi de 。 wo zhen de bu zhi dao zhe yi qie you shen me guan xi 。]

english: I suppose it doesn't, really, it's just the mumblings of an old dwarf.
translation: 我想不是，真的，这只是一个老矮人的咕哝。 [wo xiang bu shi ， zhen de ， zhe zhi shi yi ge lao ai ren de gu nong 。]

english: Not really, no.
translation: 不完全是，不。 [bu wan quan shi ， bu 。]

english: Oh, alright then.
translation: 哦，那好吧。 [o ， na hao ba 。]

english: I need some help.
translation: 我需要一些帮助。 [wo xu yao yi xie bang zhu 。]

english: Yes, [player name]? What can a humble gardener like myself help you with?
translation: 是的，[玩家姓名]？像我这样谦虚的园丁可以为您提供什么帮助？ [shi de ，[ wan jia xing ming ]？ xiang wo zhe yang qian xu de yuan ding ke yi wei nin ti gong shen me bang zhu ？]

english: I have four Kelda seeds here, but need some advice on growing them.
translation: 我这里有四颗凯尔达种子，但需要一些种植它们的建议。 [wo zhe li you si ke kai er da zhong zi ， dan xu yao yi xie zhong zhi ta men de jian yi 。]

english: Marvelous, those seeds are quite scarce don't you know!
translation: 太棒了，这些种子非常稀有，你知道吗！ [tai bang le ， zhe xie zhong zi fei chang xi you ， ni zhi dao ma ！]

english: First of all, you must remember that these seeds only grow underground. Sunlight is harmful to them, for some strange reason.
translation: 首先，你必须记住，这些种子只生长在地下。由于某些奇怪的原因，阳光对它们有害。 [shou xian ， ni bi xu ji zhu ， zhe xie zhong zi zhi sheng zhang zai di xia 。 you yu mou xie qi guai de yuan yin ， yang guang dui ta men you hai 。]

english: There is a patch in the palace garden that you're more than welcome to use.
translation: 宫殿花园里有一块空地，非常欢迎您使用。 [gong dian hua yuan li you yi kuai kong di ， fei chang huan ying nin shi yong 。]

english: Thanks! Is there anything else I need to know?
translation: 谢谢！还有什么我需要知道的吗？ [xie xie ！ hai you shen me wo xu yao zhi dao de ma ？]

english: Just take care of the weed in the patch and plant your seeds. They'll grow into hops very quickly, if you're lucky. Kelda seeds have a remarkably fast grow rate.
translation: 只需处理掉地里的杂草并播种即可。如果你幸运的话，它们会很快长成啤酒花。凯尔达种子的生长速度非常快。 [zhi xu chu li diao di li de za cao bing bo zhong ji ke 。 ru guo ni xing yun de hua ， ta men hui hen kuai zhang cheng pi jiu hua 。 kai er da zhong zi de sheng zhang su du fei chang kuai 。]

english: Also, if you need a rake, you'll find one just south of here, I left it there 5 minutes ago.
translation: 另外，如果你需要耙子，你可以在这儿南边找到一个，我五分钟前把它留在那里了。 [ling wai ， ru guo ni xu yao pa zi ， ni ke yi zai zhe er nan bian zhao dao yi ge ， wo wu fen zhong qian ba ta liu zai na li le 。]

english: Thank you! Your advice is much appreciated!
translation: 谢谢你！非常感谢您的建议！ [xie xie ni ！ fei chang gan xie nin de jian yi ！]

english: I think I need some more help with this whole farming business.
translation: 我想我在整个农业业务上需要更多帮助。 [wo xiang wo zai zheng ge nong ye ye wu shang xu yao geng duo bang zhu 。]

english: Just get rid of the weeds in the patch, plant your seeds and wait for the hops to grow. The miracle of nature will do the rest!
translation: 只需清除地里的杂草，播下种子，等待啤酒花生长即可。剩下的事情将由大自然的奇迹来完成！ [zhi xu qing chu di li de za cao ， bo xia zhong zi ， deng dai pi jiu hua sheng zhang ji ke 。 sheng xia de shi qing jiang you da zi ran de qi ji lai wan cheng ！]

english: Do I have to wait here all this time then?
translation: 那我就得一直在这里等吗？ [na wo jiu de yi zhi zai zhe li deng ma ？]

english: Yea and no. Yes, you do have to wait, but no, you don't have to stay here. You can help out people in the city, for instance, there's always someone who needs help with an urgent job.
translation: 是的，也不是。是的，你必须等待，但不，你不必留在这里。你可以帮助城里的人，例如，总有人需要帮助来完成紧急工作。 [shi de ， ye bu shi 。 shi de ， ni bi xu deng dai ， dan bu ， ni bu bi liu zai zhe li 。 ni ke yi bang zhu cheng li de ren ， li ru ， zong you ren xu yao bang zhu lai wan cheng jin ji gong zuo 。]

english: You mean the mining companies? I did jobs for them, they're not very profitable.
translation: 你说的是矿业公司吗？我为他们做工作，他们的利润并不高。 [ni shuo de shi kuang ye gong si ma ？ wo wei ta men zuo gong zuo ， ta men de li run bing bu gao 。]

english: No no, just people like shopkeepers and such, they're quite willing to teach you things in exchange for the jobs as well. But here, tell you what, I'll give you some seeds if you can deliver this letter to a friend in Falador.
translation: 不不，只是像店主之类的人，他们也很愿意教你东西以换取工作。但在这里，告诉你，如果你能把这封信交给法拉多的朋友，我会给你一些种子。 [bu bu ， zhi shi xiang dian zhu zhi lei de ren ， ta men ye hen yuan yi jiao ni dong xi yi huan qu gong zuo 。 dan zai zhe li ， gao su ni ， ru guo ni neng ba zhe feng xin jiao gei fa la duo de peng you ， wo hui gei ni yi xie zhong zi 。]

english: Do I have to do that? I just want to grow my hops and get on with my quest for Veldaban.
translation: 我必须这样做吗？我只想种植我的啤酒花并继续寻找维达班。 [wo bi xu zhe yang zuo ma ？ wo zhi xiang zhong zhi wo de pi jiu hua bing ji xu xun zhao wei da ban 。]

english: Oh no, you don't have to do it all, I just thought you wanted something to do while you were waiting.
translation: 哦不，你不必做这一切，我只是觉得你在等待的时候想做点什么。 [o bu ， ni bu bi zuo zhe yi qie ， wo zhi shi jue de ni zai deng dai de shi hou xiang zuo dian shen me 。]

english: Alright, I'll deliver that letter for you.
translation: 好的，我会把那封信交给你。 [hao de ， wo hui ba na feng xin jiao gei ni 。]

english: Happy to hear that! His name is Elstan, he lives just south of Falador.
translation: 很高兴听到这个！他的名字叫埃尔斯坦，住在法拉多以南。 [hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge ！ ta de ming zi jiao ai er si tan ， zhu zai fa la duo yi nan 。]

english: I'll be right back!
translation: 我马上回来！ [wo ma shang hui lai ！]

english: I'd rather just sit here and stare at this patch, thanks.
translation: 我宁愿坐在这里盯着这个补丁，谢谢。 [wo ning yuan zuo zai zhe li ding zhe zhe ge bu ding ， xie xie 。]

english: Very well. That can be quite relaxing, actually, I often do it myself.
translation: 很好。这可以让人非常放松，事实上，我自己也经常这样做。 [hen hao 。 zhe ke yi rang ren fei chang fang song ， shi shi shang ， wo zi ji ye jing chang zhe yang zuo 。]

english: Hello again, [player name]! Have you been able to deliver that letter yet?
translation: 再次大家好，[玩家姓名]！你已经能把那封信送达了吗？ [zai ci da jia hao ，[ wan jia xing ming ]！ ni yi jing neng ba na feng xin song da le ma ？]

english: No, I haven't been to Falador yet, but I will soon.
translation: 不，我还没去过法拉多，但我很快就会去。 [bu ， wo hai mei qu guo fa la duo ， dan wo hen kuai jiu hui qu 。]

english: Much appreciated, Player!
translation: 非常感谢，玩家！ [fei chang gan xie ， wan jia ！]

english: No, sorry, I lost your letter.
translation: 不，抱歉，我把你的信弄丢了。 [bu ， bao qian ， wo ba ni de xin nong diu le 。]

english: That's a little clumsy, Player! Here, I've got a copy, please deliver this one instead.
translation: 这有点笨拙，玩家！在这里，我有一份副本，请递给我这份。 [zhe you dian ben zhuo ， wan jia ！ zai zhe li ， wo you yi fen fu ben ， qing di gei wo zhe fen 。]

english: No, I've decided not to deliver it after all.
translation: 不，我终究还是决定不送了。 [bu ， wo zhong jiu hai shi jue ding bu song le 。]

english: Oh, I'm sad to hear that.
translation: 哦，听到这个消息我很难过。 [o ， ting dao zhe ge xiao xi wo hen nan guo 。]

english: Oh well, I'll see if I can find someone else instead.
translation: 哦，好吧，我看看能不能找其他人代替。 [o ， hao ba ， wo kan kan neng bu neng zhao qi ta ren dai ti 。]

english: I've delivered your letter to Elstan, he told me to give you his regards.
translation: 我已将你的信转达给埃尔斯坦，他让我向你问好。 [wo yi jiang ni de xin zhuan da gei ai er si tan ， ta rang wo xiang ni wen hao 。]

english: Wonderful, that's just wonderful! Here, have these two seeds as a reward. They may not be Kelda hop seeds, but you should be able to grow a decent amount of herbs with them.
translation: 太棒了，这简直太棒了！来，把这两颗种子作为奖励。它们可能不是凯尔达啤酒花种子，但你应该能够用它们种植相当数量的草药。 [tai bang le ， zhe jian zhi tai bang le ！ lai ， ba zhe liang ke zhong zi zuo wei jiang li 。 ta men ke neng bu shi kai er da pi jiu hua zhong zi ， dan ni ying gai neng gou yong ta men zhong zhi xiang dang shu liang de cao yao 。]

english: How are you getting along with growing your seeds into hops, [player name]?
translation: [玩家姓名]，你把种子种植成啤酒花的进展如何？ [[ wan jia xing ming ]， ni ba zhong zi zhong zhi cheng pi jiu hua de jin zhan ru he ？]

english: Hmm, I'm not sure... let me check the patch.
translation: 嗯，我不确定...让我检查一下补丁。 [n ， wo bu que ding ... rang wo jian cha yi xia bu ding 。]

english: I've grown my seeds into hops, but I have no idea what to do with them. Can you turn them into stout for me please?
translation: 我已经把种子种成了啤酒花，但我不知道如何处理它们。你能帮我把它们变成粗壮的吗？ [wo yi jing ba zhong zi zhong cheng le pi jiu hua ， dan wo bu zhi dao ru he chu li ta men 。 ni neng bang wo ba ta men bian cheng cu zhuang de ma ？]

english: Haha, it doesn't quite work like that, I'm afraid!
translation: 哈哈，恐怕不是这样的！ [ha ha ， kong pa bu shi zhe yang de ！]

english: You will need to bring your hops to a brewery.
translation: 您需要将啤酒花带到啤酒厂。 [nin xu yao jiang pi jiu hua dai dao pi jiu chang 。]

english: Where's the nearest brewery then?
translation: 那么最近的啤酒厂在哪里？ [na me zui jin de pi jiu chang zai na li ？]

english: Oh, there's one in Keldagrim-East, upstairs in the Laughing Miner. They brew their own beer, they do.
translation: 哦，在凯尔达格林东部有一个，就在笑矿工楼的楼上。他们自己酿造啤酒，他们这样做。 [o ， zai kai er da ge lin dong bu you yi ge ， jiu zai xiao kuang gong lou de lou shang 。 ta men zi ji niang zao pi jiu ， ta men zhe yang zuo 。]

english: How does it work though?
translation: 它是如何运作的呢？ [ta shi ru he yun zuo de ne ？]

english: I'm sure someone there will be able to help you out, it's not my specialty you see.
translation: 我确信那里有人能够帮助你，你看这不是我的专长。 [wo que xin na li you ren neng gou bang zhu ni ， ni kan zhe bu shi wo de zhuan chang 。]

english: Alright, thanks a lot!
translation: 好的，非常感谢！ [hao de ， fei chang gan xie ！]

english: I've grown my seeds into hops, but I seem to have mislaid them.
translation: 我已经把种子种成了啤酒花，但我似乎把它们放错地方了。 [wo yi jing ba zhong zi zhong cheng le pi jiu hua ， dan wo si hu ba ta men fang cuo di fang le 。]

english: Ah! Fortunately I found some hops after your recent harvest. Here, I believe this belongs to you.
translation: 啊!幸运的是，我在你最近收获后发现了一些啤酒花。在这里，我相信这是属于你的。 [a ! xing yun de shi ， wo zai ni zui jin shou huo hou fa xian le yi xie pi jiu hua 。 zai zhe li ， wo xiang xin zhe shi shu yu ni de 。]

english: I'm brewing my hops into Kelda stout, but it seems to be taking an awfully long time.
translation: 我正在将啤酒花酿造成凯尔达黑啤酒，但这似乎需要很长时间。 [wo zheng zai jiang pi jiu hua niang zao cheng kai er da hei pi jiu ， dan zhe si hu xu yao hen zhang shi jian 。]

english: Just have patience, my young friend! Have a wander around town, see if anyone has jobs for you!
translation: 只要有耐心，我的年轻朋友！到城里逛逛，看看有没有适合你的工作！ [zhi yao you nai xin ， wo de nian qing peng you ！ dao cheng li guang guang ， kan kan you mei you shi he ni de gong zuo ！]

english: I'm just so angry, my hops aren't fermenting at all. I want my Kelda stout!
translation: 我只是很生气，我的啤酒花根本没有发酵。我想要我的凯尔达粗壮！ [wo zhi shi hen sheng qi ， wo de pi jiu hua gen ben mei you fa jiao 。 wo xiang yao wo de kai er da cu zhuang ！]

english: Now now, my young human friend! Are you sure about that?
translation: 现在现在，我年轻的人类朋友！你确定吗？ [xian zai xian zai ， wo nian qing de ren lei peng you ！ ni que ding ma ？]

english: Perhaps you should go back to the brewery, I wouldn't be surprised if your stout has fermented by now.
translation: 也许你应该回到啤酒厂，如果你的黑啤酒现在已经发酵了，我不会感到惊讶。 [ye xu ni ying gai hui dao pi jiu chang ， ru guo ni de hei pi jiu xian zai yi jing fa jiao le ， wo bu hui gan dao jing ya 。]

english: This is your garden?
translation: 这是你的花园吗？ [zhe shi ni de hua yuan ma ？]

english: Not at all!
translation: 一点也不！ [yi dian ye bu ！]

english: A little, yes.
translation: 有一点，是的。 [you yi dian ， shi de 。]

english: Not really, no.
translation: 不完全是，不。 [bu wan quan shi ， bu 。]

english: Alright, I'll deliver that letter for you.
translation: 好的，我会把那封信交给你。 [hao de ， wo hui ba na feng xin jiao gei ni 。]

english: I'd rather just sit here and stare at this patch, thanks.
translation: 我宁愿坐在这里盯着这个补丁，谢谢。 [wo ning yuan zuo zai zhe li ding zhe zhe ge bu ding ， xie xie 。]

english: No, I haven't been to Falador yet, but I will soon.
translation: 不，我还没去过法拉多，但我很快就会去。 [bu ， wo hai mei qu guo fa la duo ， dan wo hen kuai jiu hui qu 。]

english: No, sorry, I've lost your letter.
translation: 不，抱歉，我把你的信弄丢了。 [bu ， bao qian ， wo ba ni de xin nong diu le 。]

english: No, I've decided not to deliver it after all.
translation: 不，我终究还是决定不送了。 [bu ， wo zhong jiu hai shi jue ding bu song le 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Howdy.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Same as you I'd wager, lookin' fer that big ol' bunny.
translation: 我打赌和你一样，正在寻找那只大兔子。 [wo da du he ni yi yang ， zheng zai xun zhao na zhi da tu zi 。]

english: Well we've found him.
translation: 好吧，我们找到他了。 [hao ba ， wo men zhao dao ta le 。]

english: That we have kid, that we have.
translation: 我们有孩子，我们有。 [wo men you hai zi ， wo men you 。]

english: Do you know what raisins are?
translation: 你知道葡萄干是什么吗？ [ni zhi dao pu tao gan shi shen me ma ？]

english: Raisins? Talk to Glanton, kid. He's your raisin man.
translation: 葡萄干？和格兰顿谈谈，孩子。他是你的葡萄干人。 [pu tao gan ？ he ge lan dun tan tan ， hai zi 。 ta shi ni de pu tao gan ren 。]

english: Oh, okay then!
translation: 噢，那好吧！ [o ， na hao ba ！]

english: Thanks for helping with the raisins.
translation: 谢谢你帮忙做葡萄干。 [xie xie ni bang mang zuo pu tao gan 。]

english: It was no skin off my nose, any time kid.
translation: 孩子，无论什么时候，我的鼻子都没有掉皮。 [hai zi ， wu lun shen me shi hou ， wo de bi zi dou mei you diao pi 。]

english: Good work with those raisins kid, you've got real moxy. Tell me, do you like games?
translation: 和那些葡萄干孩子一起干得好，你真是太有魅力了。告诉我，你喜欢游戏吗？ [he na xie pu tao gan hai zi yi qi gan de hao ， ni zhen shi tai you mei li le 。 gao su wo ， ni xi huan you xi ma ？]

english: Games? Like Runelink?
translation: 游戏？喜欢符文林克吗？ [you xi ？ xi huan fu wen lin ke ma ？]

english: Runelink! Hah! I mean real games, games with a wager. Pride or humiliation. Stakes worth fighting for.
translation: 符文链接！哈！我的意思是真正的游戏，有赌注的游戏。骄傲或羞辱。值得为之奋斗的赌注。 [fu wen lian jie ！ ha ！ wo de yi si shi zhen zheng de you xi ， you du zhu de you xi 。 jiao ao huo xiu ru 。 zhi de wei zhi fen dou de du zhu 。]

english: Sounds risky.
translation: 听起来有风险。 [ting qi lai you feng xian 。]

english: There you have it, risk indeed.
translation: 就这样，确实有风险。 [jiu zhe yang ， que shi you feng xian 。]

english: Ever been to the wilderness?
translation: 曾经去过荒野吗？ [ceng jing qu guo huang ye ma ？]

english: Real evil haunts that place...
translation: 真正的邪恶出没于那个地方...... [zhen zheng de xie e chu mo yu na ge di fang ......]

english: ...And we haunt the evil right back.
translation: ......我们就在背后困扰着邪恶。 [...... wo men jiu zai bei hou kun rao zhe xie e 。]

english: What say ye? Come hasten the reckoning of the horrible legions what dwell up there with us sometime?
translation: 你们说什么？快来加快清算那些与我们同住的可怕军团吗？ [ni men shuo shen me ？ kuai lai jia kuai qing suan na xie yu wo men tong zhu de ke pa jun tuan ma ？]

english: Ehh, I'll think about it.
translation: 呃，我会考虑一下。 [e ， wo hui kao lv yi xia 。]

english: It won't catch on, Glanton.
translation: 它不会流行起来，格兰顿。 [ta bu hui liu xing qi lai ， ge lan dun 。]

english: Ah don't be like that Rinder, how will we know till we try?
translation: 啊，别像那个 Rinder，除非我们尝试，否则我们怎么知道呢？ [a ， bie xiang na ge  Rinder， chu fei wo men chang shi ， fou ze wo men zen me zhi dao ne ？]

english: Alright gents, what's going on here then?
translation: 好吧，先生们，那么这里发生了什么？ [hao ba ， xian sheng men ， na me zhe li fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: I've had this great idea see.
translation: 我有这个好主意。 [wo you zhe ge hao zhu yi 。]

english: Does it have anything to do with long walks in the desert again?
translation: 这和又在沙漠里长途跋涉有什么关系吗？ [zhe he you zai sha mo li zhang tu ba she you shen me guan xi ma ？]

english: Well y'see thats the beauty of it.
translation: 嗯，你看，这就是它的美妙之处。 [n ， ni kan ， zhe jiu shi ta de mei miao zhi chu 。]

english: It's a lot easier to melt chocolate than dry out grapes.
translation: 融化巧克力比晒干葡萄容易得多。 [rong hua qiao ke li bi shai gan pu tao rong yi de duo 。]

english: Chocolate? You've piqued my interest!
translation: 巧克力？你引起了我的兴趣！ [qiao ke li ？ ni yin qi le wo de xing qu ！]

english: Exactly! See Rinder, [player name] doesn't even know half the idea yet and wants in!
translation: 确切地！看看 Rinder，[玩家名字] 甚至还不知道一半的想法，但想加入！ [que qie di ！ kan kan  Rinder，[ wan jia ming zi ]  shen zhi hai bu zhi dao yi ban de xiang fa ， dan xiang jia ru ！]

english: It still seems terribly messy.
translation: 看起来仍然非常混乱。 [kan qi lai reng ran fei chang hun luan 。]

english: Okay so, what we do is use our connections with the Easter Bunny to acquire a lot of chocolate.
translation: 好吧，我们要做的就是利用我们与复活节兔子的联系来获取大量巧克力。 [hao ba ， wo men yao zuo de jiu shi li yong wo men yu fu huo jie tu zi de lian xi lai huo qu da liang qiao ke li 。]

english: And give it to me for my outstanding contributions to the preservation of Easter?
translation: 并把它送给我，以表彰我对保存复活节的杰出贡献？ [bing ba ta song gei wo ， yi biao zhang wo dui bao cun fu huo jie de jie chu gong xian ？]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: And we melt it all up, and put it in a fountain.
translation: 我们把它全部融化，然后把它放进喷泉里。 [wo men ba ta quan bu rong hua ， ran hou ba ta fang jin pen quan li 。]

english: And then I get to have it all?
translation: 然后我就能拥有这一切？ [ran hou wo jiu neng yong you zhe yi qie ？]

english: No then we sell people the right to take a couple of small fruits to dip in the fountain and eat!
translation: 不，那么我们就向人们出售权利，让他们可以拿一些小水果浸在喷泉里吃！ [bu ， na me wo men jiu xiang ren men chu shou quan li ， rang ta men ke yi na yi xie xiao shui guo jin zai pen quan li chi ！]

english: That sounds delicious!
translation: 听起来很好吃！ [ting qi lai hen hao chi ！]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: But I can get some for free?
translation: 但我可以免费得到一些吗？ [dan wo ke yi mian fei de dao yi xie ma ？]

english: See the amount people would pay for just a taste of chocolate is so much higher than we'd have to pay to source a lot of the stuff.
translation: 看看人们为尝尝巧克力而支付的金额比我们购买大量巧克力所支付的金额高得多。 [kan kan ren men wei chang chang qiao ke li er zhi fu de jin e bi wo men gou mai da liang qiao ke li suo zhi fu de jin e gao de duo 。]

english: Well, I'm not interested if I have to pay.
translation: 好吧，如果我必须付钱的话我不感兴趣。 [hao ba ， ru guo wo bi xu fu qian de hua wo bu gan xing qu 。]

english: I saved Easter...
translation: 我拯救了复活节... [wo zheng jiu le fu huo jie ...]

english: ... Again!
translation: ... 再次！ [...  zai ci ！]

english: I think I'll go see if the Easter Bunny has some more eggs for me...
translation: 我想我要去看看复活节兔子是否还有更多的彩蛋给我...... [wo xiang wo yao qu kan kan fu huo jie tu zi shi fou hai you geng duo de cai dan gei wo ......]

english: Be seeing you!
translation: 见到你了！ [jian dao ni le ！]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Well, it's funny you should ask that actually, I run the local parcel service to the mainland.
translation: 好吧，有趣的是，你应该问，实际上，我经营到大陆的本地包裹服务。 [hao ba ， you qu de shi ， ni ying gai wen ， shi ji shang ， wo jing ying dao da lu de ben di bao guo fu wu 。]

english: Parcel service?
translation: 包裹服务？ [bao guo fu wu ？]

english: Yes, we sometimes get asked to send items back to the mainland. We can send items to individuals' bank accounts, for a small fee of course.
translation: 是的，我们有时会被要求将物品寄回大陆。我们可以将物品发送到个人的银行账户，当然需要支付少量费用。 [shi de ， wo men you shi hui bei yao qiu jiang wu pin ji hui da lu 。 wo men ke yi jiang wu pin fa song dao ge ren de yin hang zhang hu ， dang ran xu yao zhi fu shao liang fei yong 。]

english: How much does it cost?
translation: 它要多少钱？ [ta yao duo shao qian ？]

english: It costs 10 trading sticks per item, unfortunately, even stackable items cost the same.
translation: 每个物品需要 10 个交易棒，不幸的是，即使是可堆叠的物品也花费相同的价格。 [mei ge wu pin xu yao  10  ge jiao yi bang ， bu xing de shi ， ji shi shi ke dui die de wu pin ye hua fei xiang tong de jia ge 。]

english: What are trading sticks and how do I get some?
translation: 什么是交易棒以及如何获得交易棒？ [shen me shi jiao yi bang yi ji ru he huo de jiao yi bang ？]

english: Trading sticks are our local currency, you could perhaps earn some trading sticks by doing some work around the village.
translation: 交易棒是我们当地的货币，你也许可以通过在村庄周围做一些工作来赚取一些交易棒。 [jiao yi bang shi wo men dang di de huo bi ， ni ye xu ke yi tong guo zai cun zhuang zhou wei zuo yi xie gong zuo lai zhuan qu yi xie jiao yi bang 。]

english: Have a chat with Murcaily, I think he was looking for someone to help him, he works near the hardwood grove to the east of Trufitus' hut.
translation: 和穆凯利聊聊，我想他正在找人帮助他，他在特鲁菲图斯小屋东边的硬木林附近工作。 [he mu kai li liao liao ， wo xiang ta zheng zai zhao ren bang zhu ta ， ta zai te lu fei tu si xiao wu dong bian de ying mu lin fu jin gong zuo 。]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Can I send a parcel please?
translation: 请问我可以寄包裹吗？ [qing wen wo ke yi ji bao guo ma ？]

english: It costs at least 10 trading sticks to use this service. Sorry but you don't have enough.
translation: 使用这项服务至少要花费10根交易棒。抱歉，你还不够。 [shi yong zhe xiang fu wu zhi shao yao hua fei 10 gen jiao yi bang 。 bao qian ， ni hai bu gou 。]

english: Of course...which items would you like to send to your bank?
translation: 当然...您想将哪些物品发送到银行？ [dang ran ... nin xiang jiang na xie wu pin fa song dao yin hang ？]

english: Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: 这里有什么有趣的事情可以做吗？ [zhe li you shen me you qu de shi qing ke yi zuo ma ？]

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 我一直在村里做一些工作。 [wo yi zhi zai cun li zuo yi xie gong zuo 。]

english: Yeah, you've been doing a lot of good work around here. Let me give you something for your time and effort.
translation: 是的，你在这里做了很多出色的工作。让我给你一些东西来补偿你的时间和精力。 [shi de ， ni zai zhe li zuo le hen duo chu se de gong zuo 。 rang wo gei ni yi xie dong xi lai bu chang ni de shi jian he jing li 。]

english: I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: 我已经给了你一些交易棒，现在我身上没有了。为什么不去和其他一些村民谈谈并获得一些捐款呢？ [wo yi jing gei le ni yi xie jiao yi bang ， xian zai wo shen shang mei you le 。 wei shen me bu qu he qi ta yi xie cun min tan tan bing huo de yi xie juan kuan ne ？]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Hey, I've seen you working around the village. You've been doing a lot of good work around here for us. Let me give you something for your trouble.
translation: 嘿，我见过你在村子里干活。你在这里为我们做了很多出色的工作。让我给你一些东西来缓解你的麻烦。 [hei ， wo jian guo ni zai cun zi li gan huo 。 ni zai zhe li wei wo men zuo le hen duo chu se de gong zuo 。 rang wo gei ni yi xie dong xi lai huan jie ni de ma fan 。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: How much does it cost?
translation: 它要多少钱？ [ta yao duo shao qian ？]

english: What are trading sticks and how do I get some?
translation: 什么是交易棒以及如何获得交易棒？ [shen me shi jiao yi bang yi ji ru he huo de jiao yi bang ？]

english: Can I send a parcel please?
translation: 请问我可以寄包裹吗？ [qing wen wo ke yi ji bao guo ma ？]

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 我一直在村里做一些工作。 [wo yi zhi zai cun li zuo yi xie gong zuo 。]

english: Fishies be mine, leave dem fishies!
translation: 鱼是我的，离开他们！ [yu shi wo de ， li kai ta men ！]

english: Would you like to buy some fishing equipment, or sell some fish?
translation: 您想购买一些捕鱼设备或出售一些鱼吗？ [nin xiang gou mai yi xie bu yu she bei huo chu shou yi xie yu ma ？]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好呀！ [ni hao ya ！]

english: Greetings traveller. Welcome to 'The Hair Of The Dog' Tavern. What can I do for you?
translation: 问候旅行者。欢迎来到“狗毛”酒馆。我能为你做什么？ [wen hou lv xing zhe 。 huan ying lai dao “ gou mao ” jiu guan 。 wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: Can I buy a beer?
translation: 我可以买啤酒吗？ [wo ke yi mai pi jiu ma ？]

english: Well that's my specialty! The local brew's named 'Moonlight Mead' and will set you back 5 gold. Whaddya say? Fancy a pint?
translation: 嗯，这就是我的专长！当地酿造的啤酒名为“月光蜂蜜酒”，售价为 5 金币。说什么？想来一品脱吗？ [n ， zhe jiu shi wo de zhuan chang ！ dang di niang zao de pi jiu ming wei “ yue guang feng mi jiu ”， shou jia wei  5  jin bi 。 shuo shen me ？ xiang lai yi pin tuo ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: I don't have the money on me right now though... can I start a tab?
translation: 不过我现在身上没有钱……我可以开始标签吗？ [bu guo wo xian zai shen shang mei you qian …… wo ke yi kai shi biao qian ma ？]

english: You see that sign behind me there?
translation: 你看到我身后那个标志了吗？ [ni kan dao wo shen hou na ge biao zhi le ma ？]

english: The one that says; 'Please Do Not Ask For Credit As Being Attacked By A Large Angry Werewolf Inn Keeper Often Offends'?
translation: 那个说； “请不要要求信用，因为旅馆老板经常受到愤怒的大狼人的攻击”？ [na ge shuo ； “ qing bu yao yao qiu xin yong ， yin wei lv guan lao ban jing chang shou dao fen nu de da lang ren de gong ji ”？]

english: Bingo
translation: 宾果游戏 [bin guo you xi]

english: Here ya go pal. Enjoy!
translation: 来吧，朋友。享受！ [lai ba ， peng you 。 xiang shou ！]

english: Actually, no thanks.
translation: 事实上，不用谢。 [shi shi shang ， bu yong xie 。]

english: Eh, suit yourself. You're missing out on a genuine taste experience.
translation: 嗯，适合自己吧。您错过了真正的味觉体验。 [n ， shi he zi ji ba 。 nin cuo guo le zhen zheng de wei jue ti yan 。]

english: Can I hear some gossip?
translation: 我能听听八卦吗？ [wo neng ting ting ba gua ma ？]

english: Well, I dunno... The village is kind of on the fringe out here, I dunno how up to date the stuff I hear about is...
translation: 嗯，我不知道……这个村庄有点位于这里的边缘，我不知道我听到的东西是最新的…… [n ， wo bu zhi dao …… zhe ge cun zhuang you dian wei yu zhe li de bian yuan ， wo bu zhi dao wo ting dao de dong xi shi zui xin de ……]

english: Tell me about this village.
translation: 给我讲讲这个村子吧。 [gei wo jiang jiang zhe ge cun zi ba 。]

english: You want to know about Canifis? I dunno why, not a lot happens here. We're just your typical everyday down at earth werewolf folk, after all...
translation: 您想了解卡尼菲斯吗？我不知道为什么，这里没有发生太多事情。毕竟，我们只是典型的地球狼人日常...... [nin xiang liao jie ka ni fei si ma ？ wo bu zhi dao wei shen me ， zhe li mei you fa sheng tai duo shi qing 。 bi jing ， wo men zhi shi dian xing de di qiu lang ren ri chang ......]

english: So... everyone here is a werewolf?
translation: 那么……这里的每个人都是狼人？ [na me …… zhe li de mei ge ren dou shi lang ren ？]

english: Yep. We are as Zamorak made us!
translation: 是的。我们就是萨莫拉克创造的我们！ [shi de 。 wo men jiu shi sa mo la ke chuang zao de wo men ！]

english: You mentioned Zamorak...
translation: 你提到了萨莫拉克... [ni ti dao le sa mo la ke ...]

english: Yeah, he's great isn't he? Every year we hold a big festival to give thanks to Zamorak for keeping us well fed and happy here.
translation: 是啊，他很棒不是吗？每年我们都会举办盛大的节日来感谢萨莫拉克让我们在这里吃得饱饱的、快乐的。 [shi a ， ta hen bang bu shi ma ？ mei nian wo men du hui ju ban sheng da de jie ri lai gan xie sa mo la ke rang wo men zai zhe li chi de bao bao de 、 kuai le de 。]

english: I hear over in the West they worship Saradomin, but I dunno why! What's he ever done to help out us werewolves, huh?
translation: 我听说西方人崇拜萨拉多明，但我不知道为什么！他曾经做过什么来帮助我们狼人，是吧？ [wo ting shuo xi fang ren chong bai sa la duo ming ， dan wo bu zhi dao wei shen me ！ ta ceng jing zuo guo shen me lai bang zhu wo men lang ren ， shi ba ？]

english: I hear he has all these crazy followers who say things like we shouldn't kill people and eat them! What's up with that?
translation: 我听说他有这么多疯狂的追随者，他们说我们不应该杀人并吃掉他们！这是怎么回事？ [wo ting shuo ta you zhe me duo feng kuang de zhui sui zhe ， ta men shuo wo men bu ying gai sha ren bing chi diao ta men ！ zhe shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: ...So when is this festival?
translation: ……那么这个节日是什么时候呢？ […… na me zhe ge jie ri shi shen me shi hou ne ？]

english: Aaah, not for a good few months yet. Come and ask me again nearer to the time, I'll keep some extra meat and mead pack from the rest for ya pal.
translation: 啊啊，好几个月了。到时候再来问我吧，我会多留一些肉和蜂蜜酒给你们。 [a a ， hao ji ge yue le 。 dao shi hou zai lai wen wo ba ， wo hui duo liu yi xie rou he feng mi jiu gei ni men 。]

english: Tell me about the land of Morytania.
translation: 告诉我有关莫里塔尼亚土地的事。 [gao su wo you guan mo li ta ni ya tu di de shi 。]

english: Well, I don't know what to tell you really... This village is called Canifis and lies on the border between Morytania and Misthalin... so we're kind of on the front line if those Saradominists to the west ever decide to attack us... South East of here is the castle of Lord Drakan, our master.
translation: 好吧，我真的不知道该告诉你什么......这个村庄叫做卡尼菲斯，位于莫里塔尼亚和米斯哈林之间的边界......所以如果那些西边的萨拉多米主义者决定攻击我们，我们就处于前线......这里的东南部是我们主人德拉坎勋爵的城堡。 [hao ba ， wo zhen de bu zhi dao gai gao su ni shen me ...... zhe ge cun zhuang jiao zuo ka ni fei si ， wei yu mo li ta ni ya he mi si ha lin zhi jian de bian jie ...... suo yi ru guo na xie xi bian de sa la duo mi zhu yi zhe jue ding gong ji wo men ， wo men jiu chu yu qian xian ...... zhe li de dong nan bu shi wo men zhu ren de la kan xun jue de cheng bao 。]

english: Lord Drakan? Who is that?
translation: 德拉坎勋爵？那是谁？ [de la kan xun jue ？ na shi shui ？]

english: Ahh... you must be new to these parts if you haven't heard of Lord Draken! He's the lord of this land, and we all pledge allegiance to him.
translation: 啊...如果您还没有听说过德拉肯勋爵，您一定对这些部分不熟悉！他是这片土地的主人，我们都宣誓效忠他。 [a ... ru guo nin hai mei you ting shuo guo de la ken xun jue ， nin yi ding dui zhe xie bu fen bu shu xi ！ ta shi zhe pian tu di de zhu ren ， wo men dou xuan shi xiao zhong ta 。]

english: In return for our allegiance, and the tithe of course, he keeps our land safe from any invaders and the Saradominists who want to kill us all.
translation: 作为对我们效忠以及什一税的回报，他保护我们的土地免受任何入侵者和想要杀死我们所有人的萨拉多米主义者的侵害。 [zuo wei dui wo men xiao zhong yi ji shen yi shui de hui bao ， ta bao hu wo men de tu di mian shou ren he ru qin zhe he xiang yao sha si wo men suo you ren de sa la duo mi zhu yi zhe de qin hai 。]

english: Tithe? What do you mean?
translation: 什一税？你是什​​么意思？ [shen yi shui ？ ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: Ah, well, in return for his protection, we have to give Lord Drakan a share of blood every week. If we don't have any to spare from our hunts, then we need to pick a member of the village to give their life in return
translation: 啊，好吧，为了回报他的保护，我们必须每周给德拉坎勋爵一份鲜血。如果我们没有多余的狩猎时间，那么我们需要挑选一名村里的成员来献出自己的生命作为回报 [a ， hao ba ， wei le hui bao ta de bao hu ， wo men bi xu mei zhou gei de la kan xun jue yi fen xian xue 。 ru guo wo men mei you duo yu de shou lie shi jian ， na me wo men xu yao tiao xuan yi ming cun li de cheng yuan lai xian chu zi ji de sheng ming zuo wei hui bao]

english: for the blood so that the tithe is fulfilled.
translation: 血，使十分之一得以履行。 [xue ， shi shi fen zhi yi de yi lv xing 。]

english: You mean you kill someone you know in order to meet the tithe?
translation: 你的意思是你为了交纳什一税而杀了你认识的人？ [ni de yi si shi ni wei le jiao na shen yi shui er sha le ni ren shi de ren ？]

english: That's right, but only if we haven't managed to get enough spare blood from our hunts. It's kind of severe if you look at it that way, but frankly, I think the price is fair for his protection and his tolerance of
translation: 没错，但前提是我们没有从狩猎中获得足够的备用血液。如果你这样看的话，这有点严重，但坦率地说，我认为这个价格对于他的保护和他的容忍来说是公平的 [mei cuo ， dan qian ti shi wo men mei you cong shou lie zhong huo de zu gou de bei yong xue ye 。 ru guo ni zhe yang kan de hua ， zhe you dian yan zhong ， dan tan shuai di shuo ， wo ren wei zhe ge jia ge dui yu ta de bao hu he ta de rong ren lai shuo shi gong ping de]

english: our village. He could probably kill us all if he wanted us gone, so keeping on his good side is worth the sacrifice to us. Lucky we're not human really!
translation: 我们的村庄。如果他想让我们离开，他可能会杀掉我们所有人，所以保持他好的一面对我们来说是值得的牺牲。幸运的是我们真的不是人类！ [wo men de cun zhuang 。 ru guo ta xiang rang wo men li kai ， ta ke neng hui sha diao wo men suo you ren ， suo yi bao chi ta hao de yi mian dui wo men lai shuo shi zhi de de xi sheng 。 xing yun de shi wo men zhen de bu shi ren lei ！]

english: Why's that?
translation: 这是为什么呢？ [zhe shi wei shen me ne ？]

english: He hates humans! Apparently long ago his brother Draynor was trapped in Misthalin and lost much of his powers, and was recently killed by some human!
translation: 他讨厌人类！显然很久以前，他的兄弟德雷诺被困在米斯哈林并失去了大部分力量，最近又被一些人类杀死了！ [ta tao yan ren lei ！ xian ran hen jiu yi qian ， ta de xiong di de lei nuo bei kun zai mi si ha lin bing shi qu le da bu fen li liang ， zui jin you bei yi xie ren lei sha si le ！]

english: He hates humans! Apparently long ago his brother Draynor was trapped in Misthalin, and adventurous little human wannabe-heroes keep trying to kill him!
translation: 他讨厌人类！显然很久以前，他的兄弟德雷诺被困在米斯哈林，而那些喜欢冒险的人类小英雄们一直试图杀死他！ [ta tao yan ren lei ！ xian ran hen jiu yi qian ， ta de xiong di de lei nuo bei kun zai mi si ha lin ， er na xie xi huan mao xian de ren lei xiao ying xiong men yi zhi shi tu sha si ta ！]

english: Man, I'd hate to be a human around here, that's for sure. Drakan would really enjoy hunting them down and killing them!
translation: 伙计，我不想成为这里的人类，这是肯定的。 Drakan 真的很喜欢追捕并杀死他们！ [huo ji ， wo bu xiang cheng wei zhe li de ren lei ， zhe shi ken ding de 。 Drakan  zhen de hen xi huan zhui bu bing sha si ta men ！]

english: Uh... thanks for the info...
translation: 呃...谢谢你的信息... [e ... xie xie ni de xin xi ...]

english: Tell me about the shopkeepers here.
translation: 说说这里的店主吧。 [shuo shuo zhe li de dian zhu ba 。]

english: Hmmm? Why, who did you want to hear the gossip about?
translation: 嗯？为什么，你想听谁的八卦？ [n ？ wei shen me ， ni xiang ting shei de ba gua ？]

english: Tell me what you know about Sbott the Tanner.
translation: 告诉我你对制革工人斯博特的了解。 [gao su wo ni dui zhi ge gong ren si bo te de liao jie 。]

english: Hey, I won't hear a word said bad about that guy! He's an honest and hard-working wolf if I ever met one! He charges a lot for his job, but he's one of the best tanners I've ever seen - and I'm over four hundred
translation: 嘿，我不会听到任何说那家伙坏话的！如果我见过的话，他就是一只诚实而勤奋的狼！他的工作收费很高，但他是我见过的最好的制革师之一 - 而且我已经四百多岁了 [hei ， wo bu hui ting dao ren he shuo na jia huo huai hua de ！ ru guo wo jian guo de hua ， ta jiu shi yi zhi cheng shi er qin fen de lang ！ ta de gong zuo shou fei hen gao ， dan ta shi wo jian guo de zui hao de zhi ge shi zhi yi  -  er qie wo yi jing si bai duo sui le]

english: years old! You need stuff tanning, I recommend him!
translation: 岁了！你需要晒黑的东西，我推荐他！ [sui le ！ ni xu yao shai hei de dong xi ， wo tui jian ta ！]

english: Know anything interesting about Rufus the food seller?
translation: 你知道食品小贩鲁弗斯有什么有趣的事吗？ [ni zhi dao shi pin xiao fan lu fu si you shen me you qu de shi ma ？]

english: Ah, yeah... good old Rufus... He's kind of getting on in years and doesn't like to come out of his wolf form so often, but let me tell you this: that guy is a hunter through and through. You seen how much food he
translation: 啊，是的……好老鲁弗斯……他年纪大了，不喜欢经常从狼的形态中走出来，但让我告诉你：那家伙是一个彻头彻尾的猎人。你看到他吃了多少食物 [a ， shi de …… hao lao lu fu si …… ta nian ji da le ， bu xi huan jing chang cong lang de xing tai zhong zou chu lai ， dan rang wo gao su ni ： na jia huo shi yi ge che tou che wei de lie ren 。 ni kan dao ta chi le duo shao shi wu]

english: catches a day? That takes real dedication! Some of the young pups think just because a wolf has a bit of grey in his fur then he's past it, but I've seen him put those pups to shame in a hunt! He's a real inspiration to us all!
translation: 抓一天？这需要真正的奉献精神！一些幼崽认为，只要狼的皮毛有一点灰色，他就已经过去了，但我见过他在狩猎中让那些幼崽蒙羞！他对我们所有人来说都是真正的鼓舞！ [zhua yi tian ？ zhe xu yao zhen zheng de feng xian jing shen ！ yi xie you zai ren wei ， zhi yao lang de pi mao you yi dian hui se ， ta jiu yi jing guo qu le ， dan wo jian guo ta zai shou lie zhong rang na xie you zai meng xiu ！ ta dui wo men suo you ren lai shuo dou shi zhen zheng de gu wu ！]

english: Got anything to share about Barker the clothes seller?
translation: 关于服装卖家巴克，您有什么要分享的吗？ [guan yu fu zhuang mai jia ba ke ， nin you shen me yao fen xiang de ma ？]

english: Eh, I don't like the guy much, but you can't knock the quality of his stock. They're some fine quality threads you can get yourself there.
translation: 呃，我不太喜欢这个人，但是你不能批评他的股票质量。它们是一些品质优良的线，您可以自己去那里获得。 [e ， wo bu tai xi huan zhe ge ren ， dan shi ni bu neng pi ping ta de gu piao zhi liang 。 ta men shi yi xie pin zhi you liang de xian ， nin ke yi zi ji qu na li huo de 。]

english: What's wrong with him?
translation: 他怎么了？ [ta zen me le ？]

english: Eh... I can't really tell you to be honest. Something about the guy just gets my hackles up everytime he opens his yap, know what I mean?
translation: 呃……老实说我真的不能告诉你。这家伙每次一开口就让我毛骨悚然，明白我的意思吗？ [e …… lao shi shuo wo zhen de bu neng gao su ni 。 zhe jia huo mei ci yi kai kou jiu rang wo mao gu song ran ， ming bai wo de yi si ma ？]

english: No, not really.
translation: 不，不是真的。 [bu ， bu shi zhen de 。]

english: Lucky for you. I can't really explain it, I just don't like the guy. Does great clothes though, you got to give him that.
translation: 你很幸运。我实在无法解释，我只是不喜欢这个人。不过衣服很好，你必须给他。 [ni hen xing yun 。 wo shi zai wu fa jie shi ， wo zhi shi bu xi huan zhe ge ren 。 bu guo yi fu hen hao ， ni bi xu gei ta 。]

english: I bet you have some juicy gossip about Fidelio the general store owner.
translation: 我打赌你对杂货店老板费德里奥有一些有趣的八卦。 [wo da du ni dui za huo dian lao ban fei de li ao you yi xie you qu de ba gua 。]

english: That nut job? Oh sure, we all know about him. He was a real firebrand daredevil when he was younger, always taking risks to make himself a quick buck... he got himself caught up in the smuggling trade, sneaking over
translation: 那个疯狂的工作？哦，当然，我们都知道他。他年轻时是一个真正的冒失鬼，为了赚快钱总是冒险……他让自己陷入了走私贸易，偷偷溜过去 [na ge feng kuang de gong zuo ？ o ， dang ran ， wo men dou zhi dao ta 。 ta nian qing shi shi yi ge zhen zheng de mao shi gui ， wei le zhuan kuai qian zong shi mao xian …… ta rang zi ji xian ru le zou si mao yi ， tou tou liu guo qu]

english: the border into Misthalin and pretending to be a human so he could buy exotic items to sell.
translation: 进入米斯哈林边境并假装成人类，这样他就可以购买异国情调的物品来出售。 [jin ru mi si ha lin bian jing bing jia zhuang cheng ren lei ， zhe yang ta jiu ke yi gou mai yi guo qing diao de wu pin lai chu shou 。]

english: Exotic items? From Misthalin? Like what?
translation: 异国情调的物品？来自米斯哈林？比如什么？ [yi guo qing diao de wu pin ？ lai zi mi si ha lin ？ bi ru shen me ？]

english: Oh man, you name it! Flour... buckets... tinderboxes... chisels... he could get the lot! He's been doing it so long now though, his nerves are shot.
translation: 噢，伙计，你说得出来！面粉……水桶……火药盒……凿子……他能得到很多！但他已经这么做了太久了，他的神经已经紧张了。 [o ， huo ji ， ni shuo de chu lai ！ mian fen …… shui tong …… huo yao he …… zao zi …… ta neng de dao hen duo ！ dan ta yi jing zhe me zuo le tai jiu le ， ta de shen jing yi jing jin zhang le 。]

english: Nowadays he's a disgrace, he can barely string a sentence together and jumps at his own shadow. Makes you feel ashamed to be a werewolf.
translation: 如今他丢人现眼，连一句话都说不出来，就扑向自己的影子。让你为自己是狼人而感到羞耻。 [ru jin ta diu ren xian yan ， lian yi ju hua dou shuo bu chu lai ， jiu pu xiang zi ji de ying zi 。 rang ni wei zi ji shi lang ren er gan dao xiu chi 。]

english: Tell me about the temple to the west.
translation: 说说西边的寺庙吧。 [shuo shuo xi bian de si miao ba 。]

english: Well, I'm not old enough to remember the full story behind it, but it was a terrible day for our kingdom when it was built there.
translation: 好吧，我还不够大，记不起它背后的完整故事，但当它在那里建立时，这对我们的王国来说是可怕的一天。 [hao ba ， wo hai bu gou da ， ji bu qi ta bei hou de wan zheng gu shi ， dan dang ta zai na li jian li shi ， zhe dui wo men de wang guo lai shuo shi ke pa de yi tian 。]

english: Apparently Morytania had a once strong kingdom, with lands spreading far further west than they do today, and south into the desert, until the day when a sneak attack by the hated human forces who worship
translation: 显然，莫里塔尼亚曾经有一个强大的王国，其土地比今天更向西延伸，并向南延伸到沙漠，直到有一天，崇拜崇拜者的可恨人类军队偷袭了莫里塔尼亚。 [xian ran ， mo li ta ni ya ceng jing you yi ge qiang da de wang guo ， qi tu di bi jin tian geng xiang xi yan shen ， bing xiang nan yan shen dao sha mo ， zhi dao you yi tian ， chong bai chong bai zhe de ke hen ren lei jun dui tou xi le mo li ta ni ya 。]

english: Saradomin burned our villages and slaughtered our peoples in mass.
translation: 萨拉多明烧毁了我们的村庄，大规模屠杀了我们的人民。 [sa la duo ming shao hui le wo men de cun zhuang ， da gui mo tu sha le wo men de ren min 。]

english: They then cursed the river, so that it would burn our kind should we touch it! Can you imagine??? To make an entire river poisonous to us???
translation: 然后他们诅咒这条河，如果我们触碰它，它就会烧死我们！你能想象吗？？？让整条河都对我们有毒？？？ [ran hou ta men zu zhou zhe tiao he ， ru guo wo men chu peng ta ， ta jiu hui shao si wo men ！ ni neng xiang xiang ma ？？？ rang zheng tiao he dou dui wo men you du ？？？]

english: Luckily they seem to have calmed down somewhat recently, and tend to stay away on their side of the river... but the wrong they have done my people will never be forgotten, and will never be forgiven. What is worse is
translation: 幸运的是，他们最近似乎平静了一些，并且倾向于远离河边……但他们对我的人民所做的错事将永远不会被忘记，也永远不会被原谅。更糟糕的是 [xing yun de shi ， ta men zui jin si hu ping jing le yi xie ， bing qie qing xiang yu yuan li he bian …… dan ta men dui wo de ren min suo zuo de cuo shi jiang yong yuan bu hui bei wang ji ， ye yong yuan bu hui bei yuan liang 。 geng zao gao de shi]

english: that they then had the nerve to build that gigantic statue on the river mouth to mock the slaughter of our people and the poisoning of our river! I can understand Lord Drakan's hatred for them even if I do not share
translation: 他们竟有胆量在河口建造那座巨大的雕像来嘲笑对我们人民的屠杀和对我们河流的毒害！即使我不认同，我也能理解德拉坎勋爵对他们的仇恨 [ta men jing you dan liang zai he kou jian zao na zuo ju da de diao xiang lai chao xiao dui wo men ren min de tu sha he dui wo men he liu de du hai ！ ji shi wo bu ren tong ， wo ye neng li jie de la kan xun jue dui ta men de chou hen]

english: it to his extent.
translation: 到了他的程度。 [dao le ta de cheng du 。]

english: So you hate humans too?
translation: 那么你也讨厌人类吗？ [na me ni ye tao yan ren lei ma ？]

english: Absolutely! If I ever met one I would gobble him up where he stands! And then chew the bones for dessert!
translation: 绝对地！如果我遇到一个人，我会原地把他吃掉！然后嚼骨头当甜点！ [jue dui di ！ ru guo wo yu dao yi ge ren ， wo hui yuan di ba ta chi diao ！ ran hou jue gu tou dang tian dian ！]

english: : ...Um, okay, thanks, bye.
translation: ：...嗯，好的，谢谢，再见。 [：... n ， hao de ， xie xie ， zai jian 。]

english: Can I hear a story?
translation: 我可以听一个故事吗？ [wo ke yi ting yi ge gu shi ma ？]

english: A story??? Heh, well the only one I can think of right now is my dear old mammy told me as a pup...
translation: 一个故事？？？呵呵，我现在唯一能想到的就是我亲爱的老妈妈小时候告诉我的…… [yi ge gu shi ？？？ he he ， wo xian zai wei yi neng xiang dao de jiu shi wo qin ai de lao ma ma xiao shi hou gao su wo de ……]

english: Now how did it go... Ah yes!
translation: 现在进展如何...啊是的！ [xian zai jin zhan ru he ... a shi de ！]

english: Once upon a time a brave young wolf was walking through a forest, when he came upon a human dressed all in red. 'Aha!' he thought to himself, 'Here's a nice easy meal!' But the human talked to him, and as he was
translation: 从前，一只勇敢的小狼正在森林中行走，这时他遇到了一个全身红衣的人类。 “啊哈！”他心里想：“这是一顿美味又简单的饭菜！”但那个人类跟他说话了，而且就像他一样 [cong qian ， yi zhi yong gan de xiao lang zheng zai sen lin zhong hang zou ， zhe shi ta yu dao le yi ge quan shen hong yi de ren lei 。 “ a ha ！” ta xin li xiang ：“ zhe shi yi dun mei wei you jian dan de fan cai ！” dan na ge ren lei gen ta shuo hua le ， er qie jiu xiang ta yi yang]

english: always taught to be a polite wolf, he spoke back to it.
translation: 总是被教导要成为一只有礼貌的狼，他对此予以回应。 [zong shi bei jiao dao yao cheng wei yi zhi you li mao de lang ， ta dui ci yu yi hui ying 。]

english: Well, this cunning human told him that there was a better meal that would not run away in a house in the woods. As the brave young wolf could see that this human was not fully grown, he figured maybe he'd
translation: 好吧，这个狡猾的人类告诉他，在树林里的房子里有一顿更好的饭菜不会跑掉。勇敢的小狼看到这个人类还没有完全长大，他想也许他会 [hao ba ， zhe ge jiao hua de ren lei gao su ta ， zai shu lin li de fang zi li you yi dun geng hao de fan cai bu hui pao diao 。 yong gan de xiao lang kan dao zhe ge ren lei hai mei you wan quan zhang da ， ta xiang ye xu ta hui]

english: better get a better meal at this house, so he ran as fasta as his paws could varry him to the house the human told him about... inside he found an old human lying in bed, and although the meat was a little tough, as the
translation: 最好在这所房子里吃点更好的饭，所以他以最快的速度跑到了那个人类告诉他的房子……里面他发现一个老人躺在床上，虽然肉有点硬，但由于 [zui hao zai zhe suo fang zi li chi dian geng hao de fan ， suo yi ta yi zui kuai de su du pao dao le na ge ren lei gao su ta de fang zi …… li mian ta fa xian yi ge lao ren tang zai chuang shang ， sui ran rou you dian ying ， dan you yu]

english: human was older than he thought, he had a good meal and decided to sleep it off in the house for awhile. He had not been asleep long though, when he was woken by a knocking at the door. The human in red had followed
translation: 人类比他想象的要老，他吃了一顿美餐，决定在屋子里睡一会儿。还没睡多久，他就被敲门声吵醒了。红衣人也跟着 [ren lei bi ta xiang xiang de yao lao ， ta chi le yi dun mei can ， jue ding zai wu zi li shui yi hui er 。 hai mei shui duo jiu ， ta jiu bei qiao men sheng chao xing le 。 hong yi ren ye gen zhe]

english: him to the house! Suspecting a human trap, the brave young wolf put on the old humans clothes and jumped into the bed, so that he could pretend to be a human and escape from this terrible trap! Well now, this human
translation: 他到屋里来了！勇敢的小狼怀疑这是人类的陷阱，于是穿上人类老人的衣服，跳到床上，这样他就可以假装成人类，逃离这个可怕的陷阱了！现在好了，这个人类 [ta dao wu li lai le ！ yong gan de xiao lang huai yi zhe shi ren lei de xian jing ， yu shi chuan shang ren lei lao ren de yi fu ， tiao dao chuang shang ， zhe yang ta jiu ke yi jia zhuang cheng ren lei ， tao li zhe ge ke pa de xian jing le ！ xian zai hao le ， zhe ge ren lei]

english: dressed in red came into the house, and pretended to believe the brave wolf was really a human, and began to talk to him. But then the human started asking strange questions of the wolf, because the human knew that it
translation: 穿着红衣服走进屋子，假装相信这只勇敢的狼真的是一个人，并开始和他说话。但随后人类开始向狼提出奇怪的问题，因为人类知道狼 [chuan zhe hong yi fu zou jin wu zi ， jia zhuang xiang xin zhe zhi yong gan de lang zhen de shi yi ge ren ， bing kai shi he ta shuo hua 。 dan sui hou ren lei kai shi xiang lang ti chu qi guai de wen ti ， yin wei ren lei zhi dao lang]

english: was not a human at all! The brave young wolf decided to try and escape, for it was only a young human, and not very strong, so the brave young wolf said he would eat the human if they did not let him escape! As he said
translation: 根本就不是人！勇敢的小狼决定尝试逃跑，因为那只是一个年轻的人类，力量并不大，所以勇敢的小狼说，如果他们不让他逃走，他就吃掉这个人类！正如他所说 [gen ben jiu bu shi ren ！ yong gan de xiao lang jue ding chang shi tao pao ， yin wei na zhi shi yi ge nian qing de ren lei ， li liang bing bu da ， suo yi yong gan de xiao lang shuo ， ru guo ta men bu rang ta tao zou ， ta jiu chi diao zhe ge ren lei ！ zheng ru ta suo shuo]

english: this however, the human in red shouted out at him: 'Aha! You are a wolf!' and as the human shouted this, another bigger human ran into the room from outside! This bigger human was much stronger and was
translation: 然而，红衣人却对他大喊道：“啊哈！你是一只狼！就在人类喊出这句话的时候，另一个体型更大的人类从外面跑进了房间！这个更大的人类更强壮，并且 [ran er ， hong yi ren que dui ta da han dao ：“ a ha ！ ni shi yi zhi lang ！ jiu zai ren lei han chu zhe ju hua de shi hou ， ling yi ge ti xing geng da de ren lei cong wai mian pao jin le fang jian ！ zhe ge geng da de ren lei geng qiang zhuang ， bing qie]

english: carrying an axe, and the poor young wolf died in this terrible trap made for him by the humans.
translation: 这只可怜的小狼拿着一把斧子，死在了人类为它设下的这个可怕的陷阱里。 [zhe zhi ke lian de xiao lang na zhe yi ba fu zi ， si zai le ren lei wei ta she xia de zhe ge ke pa de xian jing li 。]

english: And do you know what the moral of this story is?
translation: 你知道这个故事的寓意是什么吗？ [ni zhi dao zhe ge gu shi de yu yi shi shen me ma ？]

english: Um... no, not really.
translation: 嗯...不，不是真的。 [n ... bu ， bu shi zhen de 。]

english: It's 'Never trust humans' of course! My dear old mammy told me that story when I was a pup, and I'm still alive and well to tell it to you today!
translation: 当然是“永远不要相信人类”！我亲爱的老妈妈在我还是小狗的时候就给我讲了这个故事，今天我还活着，而且还健康地给你们讲这个故事！ [dang ran shi “ yong yuan bu yao xiang xin ren lei ”！ wo qin ai de lao ma ma zai wo hai shi xiao gou de shi hou jiu gei wo jiang le zhe ge gu shi ， jin tian wo hai huo zhe ， er qie hai jian kang di gei ni men jiang zhe ge gu shi ！]

english: Pretty good story huh?
translation: 很不错的故事吧？ [hen bu cuo de gu shi ba ？]

english: Um... yeah. It was great. Really.
translation: 嗯...是的。太棒了。真的。 [n ... shi de 。 tai bang le 。 zhen de 。]

english: Nothing thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。]

english: ...I don't know why you talked to me if you don't want anything then...
translation: ...我不知道如果你什么都不想要的话为什么要跟我说话... [... wo bu zhi dao ru guo ni shen me dou bu xiang yao de hua wei shen me yao gen wo shuo hua ...]

english: Here you go!
translation: 干得好！ [gan de hao ！]

english: Can I buy a beer?
translation: 我可以买啤酒吗？ [wo ke yi mai pi jiu ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Actually, no thanks.
translation: 事实上，不用谢。 [shi shi shang ， bu yong xie 。]

english: Can I hear some gossip?
translation: 我能听听八卦吗？ [wo neng ting ting ba gua ma ？]

english: Tell me about this village.
translation: 给我讲讲这个村子吧。 [gei wo jiang jiang zhe ge cun zi ba 。]

english: Tell me about the land of Morytania.
translation: 告诉我有关莫里塔尼亚土地的事。 [gao su wo you guan mo li ta ni ya tu di de shi 。]

english: Tell me about the shopkeepers here.
translation: 说说这里的店主吧。 [shuo shuo zhe li de dian zhu ba 。]

english: Sbott the Tanner.
translation: 坦纳人斯博特。 [tan na ren si bo te 。]

english: Rufus the food seller.
translation: 食品小贩鲁弗斯。 [shi pin xiao fan lu fu si 。]

english: Barker the clothes seller.
translation: 卖衣服的巴克。 [mai yi fu de ba ke 。]

english: Fidelio the general store owner.
translation: 杂货店老板费德里奥。 [za huo dian lao ban fei de li ao 。]

english: Tell me about the temple to the west.
translation: 说说西边的寺庙吧。 [shuo shuo xi bian de si miao ba 。]

english: Can I hear a story?
translation: 我可以听一个故事吗？ [wo ke yi ting yi ge gu shi ma ？]

english: Nothing thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。]

english: Talk to the tree, make friends with it.
translation: 与树交谈，与它交朋友。 [yu shu jiao tan ， yu ta jiao peng you 。]

english: But I can't reach it...
translation: 但我够不到... [dan wo gou bu dao ...]

english: You can do anything you want to do. This is your world.
translation: 你可以做任何你想做的事。这是你的世界。 [ni ke yi zuo ren he ni xiang zuo de shi 。 zhe shi ni de shi jie 。]

english: That tree looks lonely...
translation: 那棵树看起来很孤独…… [na ke shu kan qi lai hen gu du ……]

english: I'll give him a friend! Like I always say, everyone needs a friend!
translation: 我会给他一个朋友！就像我常说的，每个人都需要一个朋友！ [wo hui gei ta yi ge peng you ！ jiu xiang wo chang shuo de ， mei ge ren dou xu yao yi ge peng you ！]

english: Will you be my friend?
translation: 你愿意成为我的朋友吗？ [ni yuan yi cheng wei wo de peng you ma ？]

english: Well of course! Right after I finish this painting.
translation: 当然好！就在我完成这幅画之后。 [dang ran hao ！ jiu zai wo wan cheng zhe fu hua zhi hou 。]

english: I don't make mistakes, just happy accidents.
translation: 我不会犯错误，只是快乐的意外。 [wo bu hui fan cuo wu ， zhi shi kuai le de yi wai 。]

english: How very positive!
translation: 多么积极啊！ [duo me ji ji a ！]

english: So, still here then?
translation: 那么，还在这里吗？ [na me ， hai zai zhe li ma ？]

english: Do you want another game of Runedraw?
translation: 你想再玩一次符文抽奖游戏吗？ [ni xiang zai wan yi ci fu wen chou jiang you xi ma ？]

english: No!
translation: 不！ [bu ！]

english: Sorry, my orders are that I can only give slime to those who have completed the Morytania medium, hard or elite diaries.
translation: 抱歉，我的命令是，我只能给那些完成了莫里塔尼亚中等、困难或精英日记的人。 [bao qian ， wo de ming ling shi ， wo zhi neng gei na xie wan cheng le mo li ta ni ya zhong deng 、 kun nan huo jing ying ri ji de ren 。]

english: Can I have these bones converted into bonemeal with the promised amount of slime, please?
translation: 我可以把这些骨头和承诺数量的粘液一起转化成骨粉吗？ [wo ke yi ba zhe xie gu tou he cheng nuo shu liang de nian ye yi qi zhuan hua cheng gu fen ma ？]

english: You do not have enough space for both bonemeal and slime. Come back to me when you have space.
translation: 你没有足够的空间来容纳骨粉和粘液。当你有空的时候就回到我身边吧。 [ni mei you zu gou de kong jian lai rong na gu fen he nian ye 。 dang ni you kong de shi hou jiu hui dao wo shen bian ba 。]

english: You do not have any bones for me to convert for you.
translation: 你没有骨头让我为你转换。 [ni mei you gu tou rang wo wei ni zhuan huan 。]

english: As THE Master Bowman, I am quite impressed by your equipment, but it's not the sort I'd recommend myself. Try more conventional forms of accuracy enhancement.
translation: 作为弓箭手大师，我对你们的装备印象深刻，但这不是我自己推荐的那种。尝试更传统的准确性增强形式。 [zuo wei gong jian shou da shi ， wo dui ni men de zhuang bei yin xiang shen ke ， dan zhe bu shi wo zi ji tui jian de na zhong 。 chang shi geng chuan tong de zhun que xing zeng qiang xing shi 。]

english: Here you go.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.
translation: 你会收到线索卷轴的撕破部分。 [ni hui shou dao xian suo juan zhou de si po bu fen 。]

english: As THE Master Bowman, I am most impressed by your equipment, peasant.
translation: 作为弓箭手大师，我对你的装备印象最深刻，农民。 [zuo wei gong jian shou da shi ， wo dui ni de zhuang bei yin xiang zui shen ke ， nong min 。]

english: Hello there! Is there anything I can help you with?
translation: 你好呀！有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [ni hao ya ！ you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

english: I'd like to buy something.
translation: 我想买东西。 [wo xiang mai dong xi 。]

english: How's business going?
translation: 生意怎么样？ [sheng yi zen me yang ？]

english: Its a little slow... There's a lot of soldiers around these parts, so many people just wear a uniform.
translation: 有点慢……这些地方周围有很多士兵，所以很多人都穿着制服。 [you dian man …… zhe xie di fang zhou wei you hen duo shi bing ， suo yi hen duo ren dou chuan zhe zhi fu 。]

english: Although, I'm just happy to be here! Osten recently took me on as his assistant, you see. I've always wanted to work in fashion!
translation: 不过，我很高兴来到这里！你看，奥斯汀最近任命我为他的助理。我一直想从事时尚工作！ [bu guo ， wo hen gao xing lai dao zhe li ！ ni kan ， ao si ting zui jin ren ming wo wei ta de zhu li 。 wo yi zhi xiang cong shi shi shang gong zuo ！]

english: Anyway, enough about me... Was there something I could help you with? Perhaps a new cape? ...Or a nice new chef's hat?

translation: 啊？什么都没发生... [a ？ shen me dou mei fa sheng ...]

translation: 你认识一只叫杜弗雷尼的浣熊吗？ [ni ren shi yi zhi jiao du fu lei ni de huan xiong ma ？]

english: No, I don't believe I have.
translation: 不，我不相信我有。 [bu ， wo bu xiang xin wo you 。]

english: Grrrr!
