english: Hello there youngster.
translation: 你好，年轻人。 [ni hao ， nian qing ren 。]

english: Who are you calling youngster??
translation: 你说谁是年轻人？？ [ni shuo shui shi nian qing ren ？？]

english: Why you. Unless you have seen the small village of Falador grow into a heaving city like I have of course!
translation: 为什么是你。除非你亲眼目睹法拉多的小村庄成长为一座像我一样的大城市！ [wei shen me shi ni 。 chu fei ni qin yan mu du fa la duo de xiao cun zhuang cheng zhang wei yi zuo xiang wo yi yang de da cheng shi ！]

english: Err... no...
Well then! Enjoy your stay in our mountain home.
translation: 那么好吧！祝您在我们的山间别墅住宿愉快。 [na me hao ba ！ zhu nin zai wo men de shan jian bie shu zhu su yu kuai 。]

english: Hello again, youngster.
translation: 再次你好，年轻人。 [zai ci ni hao ， nian qing ren 。]

english: How's your son getting on, now that I've rescued him from the time bubble and the culinaromancer?
translation: 我已经将你的儿子从时间泡泡和烹饪魔法师手中救了出来，他现在怎么样了？ [wo yi jing jiang ni de er zi cong shi jian pao pao he peng ren mo fa shi shou zhong jiu le chu lai ， ta xian zai zen me yang le ？]

english: My son's fine. I'm not so sure about you, though. Maybe you should lay down in a dark room until the babbling stops.
translation: 我儿子很好。不过我对你不太确定。也许你应该躺在黑暗的房间里，直到牙牙学语停止。 [wo er zi hen hao 。 bu guo wo dui ni bu tai que ding 。 ye xu ni ying gai tang zai hei an de fang jian li ， zhi dao ya ya xue yu ting zhi 。]

english: You're already carrying one.
translation: 你已经带着一个了。 [ni yi jing dai zhe yi ge le 。]

english: Aye, I've still got enough ingredients from before, but I'll want 100 coins.
translation: 是的，我之前的材料还够用，不过我要 100 个金币。 [shi de ， wo zhi qian de cai liao hai gou yong ， bu guo wo yao  100  ge jin bi 。]

english: Maybe later.
translation: 也许以后吧。 [ye xu yi hou ba 。]

english: I'm not doing it for less, even for a mate.
translation: 我不会为了更少的钱而做这件事，即使是为了一个伴侣。 [wo bu hui wei le geng shao de qian er zuo zhe jian shi ， ji shi shi wei le yi ge ban lv 。]

english: About your son...
translation: 关于你儿子... [guan yu ni er zi ...]

english: Can I have another rock cake?
translation: 我可以再吃一块岩石蛋糕吗？ [wo ke yi zai chi yi kuai yan shi dan gao ma ？]

english: Yes, but I want another one.
translation: 是的，但我想要另一份。 [shi de ， dan wo xiang yao ling yi fen 。]

english: Forget it.
translation: 忘了它。 [wang le ta 。]

english: Okay, 100 coins will be fine.
translation: 好吧，100金币就可以了。 [hao ba ，100 jin bi jiu ke yi le 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Come one, come all, buy my amazing choc ice invention here! Chocolate on the outside. Iced cream on the inside. Oh I also have some chocolate left over from making choc ices which I'm selling too.
translation: 来吧，大家来吧，在这里购买我神奇的巧克力冰发明！外面是巧克力。里面有冰淇淋。哦，我还有一些制作巧克力冰剩下的巧克力，我也在卖。 [lai ba ， da jia lai ba ， zai zhe li gou mai wo shen qi de qiao ke li bing fa ming ！ wai mian shi qiao ke li 。 li mian you bing qi lin 。 o ， wo hai you yi xie zhi zuo qiao ke li bing sheng xia de qiao ke li ， wo ye zai mai 。]

english: No thanks, I'm not interested.
translation: 不，谢谢，我不感兴趣。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo bu gan xing qu 。]

english: How do you stop your icy snacks melting? The middle of the desert is the last place I'd expect to see ice.
translation: 如何阻止冰镇零食融化？沙漠中部是我最不想看到冰的地方。 [ru he zu zhi bing zhen ling shi rong hua ？ sha mo zhong bu shi wo zui bu xiang kan dao bing de di fang 。]

english: It's quite a surprise, isn't it, my friend. I actually have this special magic box of ice, which I bought for a princely sum, from a strange man while adventuring in lands far away. He said it is imbued with some sort of
translation: 这真是令人惊讶，不是吗，我的朋友。事实上，我有一个特殊的魔法冰盒，是我在遥远的地方冒险时从一个陌生人那里花重金买来的。他说它充满了某种 [zhe zhen shi ling ren jing ya ， bu shi ma ， wo de peng you 。 shi shi shang ， wo you yi ge te shu de mo fa bing he ， shi wo zai yao yuan de di fang mao xian shi cong yi ge mo sheng ren na li hua zhong jin mai lai de 。 ta shuo ta chong man le mou zhong]

english: powerful ice magic which keeps it cold all the time. I had never seen any ice magic before, it's clearly very rare and powerful, so I felt I had to buy it.
translation: 强大的冰魔法，始终保持寒冷。我以前从未见过任何冰系魔法，它显然非常稀有且强大，所以我觉得我必须购买它。 [qiang da de bing mo fa ， shi zhong bao chi han leng 。 wo yi qian cong wei jian guo ren he bing xi mo fa ， ta xian ran fei chang xi you qie qiang da ， suo yi wo jue de wo bi xu gou mai ta 。]

english: I am trying to find out the cause of this town's curse.
translation: 我正试图找出这个小镇的诅咒的原因。 [wo zheng shi tu zhao chu zhe ge xiao zhen de zu zhou de yuan yin 。]

english: I really have no idea. It's most regrettable. Fortunately my innovation with my choc ice invention is helping people stay at least slightly cool.
translation: 我真的不知道。最令人遗憾的是。幸运的是，我的巧克力冰发明的创新正在帮助人们保持至少稍微凉爽。 [wo zhen de bu zhi dao 。 zui ling ren yi han de shi 。 xing yun de shi ， wo de qiao ke li bing fa ming de chuang xin zheng zai bang zhu ren men bao chi zhi shao shao wei liang shuang 。]

english: How's business, now that the curse has gone?
translation: 诅咒消失后，生意怎么样？ [zu zhou xiao shi hou ， sheng yi zen me yang ？]

english: Ohh as good as ever. The people of Nardah seem to have taken well to the taste of chocolate and iced cream combined and, with the curse gone, all my friends are much happier too, so it's all good.
translation: 哦，一如既往的好。纳尔达的人们似乎很喜欢巧克力和冰淇淋的味道，随着诅咒的消失，我所有的朋友也都开心多了，所以一切都很好。 [o ， yi ru ji wang de hao 。 na er da de ren men si hu hen xi huan qiao ke li he bing qi lin de wei dao ， sui zhe zu zhou de xiao shi ， wo suo you de peng you ye dou kai xin duo le ， suo yi yi qie dou hen hao 。]

english: Cool I'd like to buy some.
translation: 太酷了我想买一些。 [tai ku le wo xiang mai yi xie 。]

english: No thanks, I'm not interested.
translation: 不，谢谢，我不感兴趣。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo bu gan xing qu 。]

english: How do you stop your icy snacks melting?
translation: 如何阻止冰镇零食融化？ [ru he zu zhi bing zhen ling shi rong hua ？]

english: I am trying to find out the cause of this town's curse.
translation: 我正试图找出这个小镇的诅咒的原因。 [wo zheng shi tu zhao chu zhe ge xiao zhen de zu zhou de yuan yin 。]

english: How's business, now that the curse has gone?
translation: 诅咒消失后，生意怎么样？ [zu zhou xiao shi hou ， sheng yi zen me yang ？]

english: Oh, hello... do I know you?
translation: 哦，你好……我认识你吗？ [o ， ni hao …… wo ren shi ni ma ？]

english: Ehm... well... my name is [player name], if that rings any bell?
translation: 嗯...好吧...我的名字是[玩家姓名]，这听起来有什么感觉吗？ [n ... hao ba ... wo de ming zi shi [ wan jia xing ming ]， zhe ting qi lai you shen me gan jue ma ？]

english: No, never heard of you.
translation: 不，从没听说过你。 [bu ， cong mei ting shuo guo ni 。]

english: Can you leave me alone please? I'm trying to study.
translation: 你可以让我一个人静一静吗？我正在努力学习。 [ni ke yi rang wo yi ge ren jing yi jing ma ？ wo zheng zai nu li xue xi 。]

english: Hello there. What are you doing here?
translation: 你好呀。你在这里做什么？ [ni hao ya 。 ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm waiting here hoping that someone can guide me to the Paterdomus, the temple on the Salve.
translation: 我在这里等待，希望有人能带我去帕特多莫斯（Paterdomus），萨尔夫河上的神庙。 [wo zai zhe li deng dai ， xi wang you ren neng dai wo qu pa te duo mo si （Paterdomus）， sa er fu he shang de shen miao 。]

english: Where is Paterdomus?
translation: 帕特多莫斯在哪里？ [pa te duo mo si zai na li ？]

english: Oh, Paterdomus is that rather impressive looking temple on the Salve... I'm sure you must have passed it on your way into Morytania.
translation: 哦，帕特多莫斯是萨尔夫岛上那座看起来相当令人印象深刻的神庙……我相信你在前往莫里塔尼亚的路上一定经过了它。 [o ， pa te duo mo si shi sa er fu dao shang na zuo kan qi lai xiang dang ling ren yin xiang shen ke de shen miao …… wo xiang xin ni zai qian wang mo li ta ni ya de lu shang yi ding jing guo le ta 。]

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
translation: 你为什么要去帕特多莫斯？ [ni wei shen me yao qu pa te duo mo si ？]

english: I'm hoping to get back to civilisation and see what the lands of Misthalin look like.
translation: 我希望回到文明世界，看看米沙林的土地是什么样子。 [wo xi wang hui dao wen ming shi jie ， kan kan mi sha lin de tu di shi shen me yang zi 。]

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Paterdomus?
translation: 如果我们在前往帕特多莫斯的路上遇到敌人，你能保护自己吗？ [ru guo wo men zai qian wang pa te duo mo si de lu shang yu dao di ren ， ni neng bao hu zi ji ma ？]

english: What sort of guide are you? I'm pretty healthy, but you'll have to protect me else I'll be sure to die... Oh, I do hope you can manage that.
translation: 你是哪种类型的向导？我很健康，但你必须保护我，否则我肯定会死……哦，我真的希望你能做到这一点。 [ni shi na zhong lei xing de xiang dao ？ wo hen jian kang ， dan ni bi xu bao hu wo ， fou ze wo ken ding hui si …… o ， wo zhen de xi wang ni neng zuo dao zhe yi dian 。]

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
translation: 我可以带你去帕特多莫斯。 [wo ke yi dai ni qu pa te duo mo si 。]

english: Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: 嗯嗯，看来你有追随者了。我想如果让它独自徘徊的话，它可能会在这段旅程中迷路。等你的追随者安全了我们就离开吧。 [n n ， kan lai ni you zhui sui zhe le 。 wo xiang ru guo rang ta du zi pai huai de hua ， ta ke neng hui zai zhe duan lv cheng zhong mi lu 。 deng ni de zhui sui zhe an quan le wo men jiu li kai ba 。]

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: 哦真的吗？那太好了！到达目的地后我会给你一个小奖励。 [o zhen de ma ？ na tai hao le ！ dao da mu di di hou wo hui gei ni yi ge xiao jiang li 。]

english: Temple Trekking begins
translation: 寺庙徒步开始 [si miao tu bu kai shi]

english: Ok, which route should we take?
translation: 好的，我们应该走哪条路？ [hao de ， wo men ying gai zou na tiao lu ？]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: 啊，所以你想给我一些物资，嗯？让我打开背包。 [a ， suo yi ni xiang gei wo yi xie wu zi ， n ？ rang wo da kai bei bao 。]

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than staying in Burgh de Rott.
translation: 哦，我讨厌这次旅行，但这比呆在 Burgh de Rott 好。 [o ， wo tao yan zhe ci lv xing ， dan zhe bi dai zai  Burgh de Rott  hao 。]

english: It's scary here...let's get going!
translation: 这里太可怕了……我们走吧！ [zhe li tai ke pa le …… wo men zou ba ！]

english: When are we going to get to Paterdomus?
translation: 我们什么时候去帕特多莫斯？ [wo men shen me shi hou qu pa te duo mo si ？]

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on.
translation: 我们没有一整天的时间站着聊天；让我们继续努力吧。 [wo men mei you yi zheng tian de shi jian zhan zhe liao tian ； rang wo men ji xu nu li ba 。]

english: Do you visit Paterdomus often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: 您经常拜访Paterdomus吗？看来你很熟悉这条路。 [nin jing chang bai fang Paterdomus ma ？ kan lai ni hen shu xi zhe tiao lu 。]

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...?
translation: 你没看到我正在被攻击吗……？ [ni mei kan dao wo zheng zai bei gong ji ma ……？]

english: Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
translation: 谢谢，我会把这个放在脖子上。 [xie xie ， wo hui ba zhe ge fang zai bo zi shang 。]

english: Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Burgh de Rott. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: 天啊！看来我们得回 Burgh de Rott 了。我们过不了那座桥！ [tian a ！ kan lai wo men de hui  Burgh de Rott  le 。 wo men guo bu liao na zuo qiao ！]

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
translation: 哦，我相信我们能找到办法！ [o ， wo xiang xin wo men neng zhao dao ban fa ！]

english: Player completes the bridge event
translation: 玩家完成桥牌事件 [wan jia wan cheng qiao pai shi jian]

english: Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 好吧，这已经被撕裂了……看起来我们无法越过这个沼泽。我们得返回 Burgh de Rott。 [hao ba ， zhe yi jing bei si lie le …… kan qi lai wo men wu fa yue guo zhe ge zhao ze 。 wo men de fan hui  Burgh de Rott。]

english: Player completes the bog event
translation: 玩家完成沼泽事件 [wan jia wan cheng zhao ze shi jian]

english: Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: 嘿……太好了……你做得很好……我会关注你的。 [hei …… tai hao le …… ni zuo de hen hao …… wo hui guan zhu ni de 。]

english: Whahay...that was great!
translation: 哇……那太好了！ [wa …… na tai hao le ！]

english: But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 但我们现在真的应该出发了。 [dan wo men xian zai zhen de ying gai chu fa le 。]

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
translation: 哦，我相信我们能找到办法！ [o ， wo xiang xin wo men neng zhao dao ban fa ！]

english: Player completes the river event
translation: 玩家完成河牌事件 [wan jia wan cheng he pai shi jian]

english: That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: 太棒了！我也必须这样做。 [tai bang le ！ wo ye bi xu zhe yang zuo 。]

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 哇哈！那很棒！但我们现在真的应该出发了。 [wa ha ！ na hen bang ！ dan wo men xian zai zhen de ying gai chu fa le 。]

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
translation: 呃……那些气泡是什么？ [e …… na xie qi pao shi shen me ？]

english: This is scary!
translation: 这太可怕了！ [zhe tai ke pa le ！]

english: Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
translation: 啊啊啊，那应该是触手吧…… [a a a ， na ying gai shi chu shou ba ……]

english: Ahhh, two tentacles!
translation: 啊啊啊，两条触手！ [a a a ， liang tiao chu shou ！]

english: ...three tentacles!
translation: ……三根触手！ […… san gen chu shou ！]

english: I think I'm going to faint!
translation: 我想我要晕倒了！ [wo xiang wo yao yun dao le ！]

english: Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: 天啊！看看那只野兽！你得自己解决这件事！ [tian a ！ kan kan na zhi ye shou ！ ni de zi ji jie jue zhe jian shi ！]

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the temple. Here's your reward.
translation: 非常感谢您让我安全到达寺庙。这是你的奖励。 [fei chang gan xie nin rang wo an quan dao da si miao 。 zhe shi ni de jiang li 。]

english: Rolayne Twickit gives you a reward token!
translation: Rolayne Twickit 为您提供奖励代币！ [Rolayne Twickit  wei nin ti gong jiang li dai bi ！]

english: Where is Paterdomus?
translation: 帕特多莫斯在哪里？ [pa te duo mo si zai na li ？]

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
translation: 你为什么要去帕特多莫斯？ [ni wei shen me yao qu pa te duo mo si ？]

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
translation: 如果我们遇到敌人，你能保护自己吗……？ [ru guo wo men yu dao di ren ， ni neng bao hu zi ji ma ……？]

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
translation: 我可以带你去帕特多莫斯。 [wo ke yi dai ni qu pa te duo mo si 。]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: I heard Juliet had died. Terrible business.
translation: 我听说朱丽叶死了。生意太糟糕了。 [wo ting shuo zhu li ye si le 。 sheng yi tai zao gao le 。]

english: Her cousin and I are getting on well though. Thanks for your help.
translation: 不过我和她表弟相处得很好。感谢您的帮助。 [bu guo wo he ta biao di xiang chu de hen hao 。 gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]

english: Why are you waving that around at me as if it's something important?
translation: 为什么你对我挥舞着那个东西，好像这是很重要的事情一样？ [wei shen me ni dui wo hui wu zhe na ge dong xi ， hao xiang zhe shi hen zhong yao de shi qing yi yang ？]

english: Romeo approaches you...
translation: 罗密欧向你走来…… [luo mi ou xiang ni zou lai ……]

english: Blub! Blub...where is my Juliet? Have you seen her?
translation: 布布！布卢布……我的朱丽叶在哪里？你见过她吗？ [bu bu ！ bu lu bu …… wo de zhu li ye zai na li ？ ni jian guo ta ma ？]

english: Looking for a blonde girl, goes by the name of Juliet..quite pretty...haven't seen her have you?
translation: 正在寻找一位金发女孩，名叫朱丽叶……相当漂亮……你还没见过她吗？ [zheng zai xun zhao yi wei jin fa nv hai ， ming jiao zhu li ye …… xiang dang piao liang …… ni hai mei jian guo ta ma ？]

english: Juliet, Juliet, wherefore art thou Juliet? Have you seen my Juliet?
translation: 朱丽叶，朱丽叶，你为什么是朱丽叶？你看到我的朱丽叶了吗？ [zhu li ye ， zhu li ye ， ni wei shen me shi zhu li ye ？ ni kan dao wo de zhu li ye le ma ？]

english: Oh woe is me that I cannot find my Juliet! You haven't seen Juliet have you?
translation: 哦，我的悲哀是我找不到我的朱丽叶！你没见过朱丽叶吧？ [o ， wo de bei ai shi wo zhao bu dao wo de zhu li ye ！ ni mei jian guo zhu li ye ba ？]

english: Sadness surrounds me now that Juliet's father forbids us to meet. Have you seen my Juliet?
translation: 现在朱丽叶的父亲禁止我们见面，悲伤包围着我。你看到我的朱丽叶了吗？ [xian zai zhu li ye de fu qin jin zhi wo men jian mian ， bei shang bao wei zhe wo 。 ni kan dao wo de zhu li ye le ma ？]

english: What is to become of me and my darling Juliet, I cannot find her anywhere, have you seen her?
translation: 我和我亲爱的朱丽叶会怎样，我到处都找不到她，你见过她吗？ [wo he wo qin ai de zhu li ye hui zen yang ， wo dao chu dou zhao bu dao ta ， ni jian guo ta ma ？]

english: Yes, I have seen her actually!
translation: 是的，我确实见过她！ [shi de ， wo que shi jian guo ta ！]

english: At least, I think it was her... Blonde? A bit stressed?
translation: 至少，我认为是她……金发女郎？有点压力？ [zhi shao ， wo ren wei shi ta …… jin fa nv lang ？ you dian ya li ？]

english: Golly...yes, yes...you make her sound very interesting!
translation: 天哪...是的，是的...你让她听起来很有趣！ [tian na ... shi de ， shi de ... ni rang ta ting qi lai hen you qu ！]

english: And I'll bet she's a bit of a fox!
translation: 我敢打赌她有点像狐狸！ [wo gan da du ta you dian xiang hu li ！]

translation: 嗯，我想她可能会被认为是有吸引力的...... [n ， wo xiang ta ke neng hui bei ren wei shi you xi yin li de ......]

english: I'll bet she is! Wooooooooo!
translation: 我敢打赌她就是！呜呜呜！ [wo gan da du ta jiu shi ！ wu wu wu ！]

english: Sorry, all that jubilation has made me forget what we were talking about.
translation: 抱歉，所有的欢乐让我忘记了我们正在谈论的事情。 [bao qian ， suo you de huan le rang wo wang ji le wo men zheng zai tan lun de shi qing 。]

english: You were asking me about Juliet? You seemed to know her?
translation: 你问我朱丽叶的事？你好像认识她？ [ni wen wo zhu li ye de shi ？ ni hao xiang ren shi ta ？]

english: Oh yes, Juliet!
translation: 哦，是的，朱丽叶！ [o ， shi de ， zhu li ye ！]

english: The fox...could you tell her that she is the love of my long and that I life to be with her?
translation: 狐狸……你能告诉她，她是我一生的挚爱，我一生要和她在一起吗？ [hu li …… ni neng gao su ta ， ta shi wo yi sheng de zhi ai ， wo yi sheng yao he ta zai yi qi ma ？]

english: What? Surely you mean that she is the love of your life and that you long to be with her?
translation: 什么？你肯定是说她是你一生的挚爱，你渴望和她在一起吗？ [shen me ？ ni ken ding shi shuo ta shi ni yi sheng de zhi ai ， ni ke wang he ta zai yi qi ma ？]

english: Oh yeah...what you said...tell her that, it sounds much better! Oh you're so good at this!
translation: 哦，是的...你说的...告诉她，听起来好多了！哦，你太擅长这个了！ [o ， shi de ... ni shuo de ... gao su ta ， ting qi lai hao duo le ！ o ， ni tai shan chang zhe ge le ！]

english: Yes, ok, I'll let her know.
translation: 是的，好的，我会让她知道的。 [shi de ， hao de ， wo hui rang ta zhi dao de 。]

english: Oh great! And tell her that I want to kiss her a give.
translation: 哦，太棒了！并告诉她我想吻她一下。 [o ， tai bang le ！ bing gao su ta wo xiang wen ta yi xia 。]

english: You mean you want to give her a kiss!
translation: 你的意思是你想给她一个吻！ [ni de yi si shi ni xiang gei ta yi ge wen ！]

english: Oh you're good...you are good!
translation: 噢，你很好……你很好！ [o ， ni hen hao …… ni hen hao ！]

english: I see I've picked a true professional...!
translation: 我发现我选择了一个真正的专业人士......！ [wo fa xian wo xuan ze le yi ge zhen zheng de zhuan ye ren shi ......！]

english: Where can I find Juliet?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到朱丽叶？ [wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao zhu li ye ？]

english: Why do you ask?
translation: 你为什么问？ [ni wei shen me wen ？]

english: So that I can try and find her for you!
translation: 这样我就可以试着帮你找到她！ [zhe yang wo jiu ke yi shi zhe bang ni zhao dao ta ！]

english: Ah yes....quite right. Hmmm, let me think now.
translation: 啊，是的……非常正确。嗯，现在让我想想。 [a ， shi de …… fei chang zheng que 。 n ， xian zai rang wo xiang xiang 。]

english: She may still be locked away at her Father's house on the sest vide of Warrock.
translation: 在《术士》的剧情中，她可能仍然被锁在她父亲的家里。 [zai 《 shu shi 》 de ju qing zhong ， ta ke neng reng ran bei suo zai ta fu qin de jia li 。]

english: Oh, I remember how she loved it when I would sing up to her balcony! She would reward me with her own personal items...
translation: 哦，我记得当我在她的阳台上唱歌时，她是多么喜欢！她会用她自己的私人物品奖励我...... [o ， wo ji de dang wo zai ta de yang tai shang chang ge shi ， ta shi duo me xi huan ！ ta hui yong ta zi ji de si ren wu pin jiang li wo ......]

english: What, she just gave you her stuff?
translation: 什么，她刚刚给了你她的东西？ [shen me ， ta gang gang gei le ni ta de dong xi ？]

english: Well, not exactly give...more like 'throw with considerable force'...she's always a kidder that Juliet!
translation: 好吧，不完全是给予……更像是“用相当大的力量投掷”……她总是对朱丽叶开玩笑！ [hao ba ， bu wan quan shi ji yu …… geng xiang shi “ yong xiang dang da de li liang tou zhi ”…… ta zong shi dui zhu li ye kai wan xiao ！]

english: Is there anything else you can tell me about Juliet?
translation: 关于朱丽叶，你还有什么可以告诉我的吗？ [guan yu zhu li ye ， ni hai you shen me ke yi gao su wo de ma ？]

english: Oh, there is so much to tell...she is my true love, we intend to spend together forever...I can tell you so much about her..
translation: 哦，有很多话要说……她是我的真爱，我们打算永远在一起……我可以告诉你很多关于她的事情…… [o ， you hen duo hua yao shuo …… ta shi wo de zhen ai ， wo men da suan yong yuan zai yi qi …… wo ke yi gao su ni hen duo guan yu ta de shi qing ……]

english: Great!
translation: 伟大的！ [wei da de ！]

english: Ermmm.....
So much can I tell you...
translation: 我能告诉你的就这么多... [wo neng gao su ni de jiu zhe me duo ...]

english: Yes..
translation: 是的.. [shi de ..]

english: So much to tell...why, where do I start!
translation: 有太多要说的...为什么，我从哪里开始！ [you tai duo yao shuo de ... wei shen me ， wo cong na li kai shi ！]

english: Yes..yes! Please go on...don't let me interrupt...
translation: 是的..是的！请继续……别让我打扰…… [shi de .. shi de ！ qing ji xu …… bie rang wo da rao ……]

english: You can't remember can you?
translation: 你不记得了，对吗？ [ni bu ji de le ， dui ma ？]

english: Not a thing sorry....
translation: 没什么对不起的...... [mei shen me dui bu qi de ......]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Sorry Romeo, I've got better things to do right now but maybe later?
translation: 抱歉，罗密欧，我现在有更好的事情要做，但也许以后可以呢？ [bao qian ， luo mi ou ， wo xian zai you geng hao de shi qing yao zuo ， dan ye xu yi hou ke yi ne ？]

english: Oh, ok, well, I guess my Juliet and I can spend some time apart. And as the old saying goes, 'Absinthe makes the heart glow longer'.
translation: 哦，好吧，好吧，我想我和我的朱丽叶可以分开一段时间。正如一句老话所说，“苦艾酒使心焕发光彩更长久”。 [o ， hao ba ， hao ba ， wo xiang wo he wo de zhu li ye ke yi fen kai yi duan shi jian 。 zheng ru yi ju lao hua suo shuo ，“ ku ai jiu shi xin huan fa guang cai geng chang jiu ”。]

english: Don't you mean that, 'Absence makes the...
translation: 你的意思不是说‘缺席使... [ni de yi si bu shi shuo ‘ que xi shi ...]

english: Actually forget it...
translation: 其实忘记了... [qi shi wang ji le ...]

english: Ok!
translation: 好的！ [hao de ！]

english: No sorry, I haven't seen her.
translation: 不，抱歉，我没见过她。 [bu ， bao qian ， wo mei jian guo ta 。]

english: Oh...well, that's a shame...I was rather hoping you had.
translation: 哦...好吧，真可惜...我本来希望你有。 [o ... hao ba ， zhen ke xi ... wo ben lai xi wang ni you 。]

english: Why? Is she a fugitive? Does she owe you some money or something?
translation: 为什么？她是逃犯吗？她欠你钱什么的吗？ [wei shen me ？ ta shi tao fan ma ？ ta qian ni qian shen me de ma ？]

english: Hmmm, she might do? Perhaps she does? How do you know?
translation: 嗯，她可能会这样做吗？也许她知道？你怎么知道？ [n ， ta ke neng hui zhe yang zuo ma ？ ye xu ta zhi dao ？ ni zen me zhi dao ？]

english: I don't know? I was asking 'YOU' how 'YOU' know Juliet!
translation: 我不知道？我问‘你’怎么认识朱丽叶的！ [wo bu zhi dao ？ wo wen ‘ ni ’ zen me ren shi zhu li ye de ！]

english: Ahh, yes Juliet, she's my one true love. Well, one of my one true loves! If you see her, could you tell her that she is the love of my long and that I life to be with her?
translation: 啊，是的，朱丽叶，她是我唯一的真爱。好吧，我的真爱之一！如果你见到她，你能告诉她，她是我长久以来的挚爱，我一生都会和她在一起吗？ [a ， shi de ， zhu li ye ， ta shi wo wei yi de zhen ai 。 hao ba ， wo de zhen ai zhi yi ！ ru guo ni jian dao ta ， ni neng gao su ta ， ta shi wo chang jiu yi lai de zhi ai ， wo yi sheng du hui he ta zai yi qi ma ？]

english: What? Surely you mean that 'she is the love of your life and that you long to be with her?'
translation: 什么？你的意思肯定是“她是你一生的挚爱，你渴望和她在一起？” [shen me ？ ni de yi si ken ding shi “ ta shi ni yi sheng de zhi ai ， ni ke wang he ta zai yi qi ？”]

english: Perhaps I can help find her for you? What does she look like?
translation: 也许我可以帮你找到她？她长什么样？ [ye xu wo ke yi bang ni zhao dao ta ？ ta zhang shen me yang ？]

english: Oh would you? That would be great! She has this sort of hair...
translation: 哦，你愿意吗？那太好了！她有这样的头发... [o ， ni yuan yi ma ？ na tai hao le ！ ta you zhe yang de tou fa ...]

english: Hair...check..
translation: 头发...检查.. [tou fa ... jian cha ..]

english: ...and she these...great lips...
translation: ...她这些...伟大的嘴唇... [... ta zhe xie ... wei da de zui chun ...]

english: Lips...right.
translation: 嘴唇……对。 [zui chun …… dui 。]

english: Oh and she has these lovely shoulders as well..
translation: 哦，她也有这些可爱的肩膀.. [o ， ta ye you zhe xie ke ai de jian bang ..]

english: Shoulders...right, so she has hair, lips and shoulders...that should cut it down a bit.
translation: 肩膀……对了，所以她有头发、嘴唇和肩膀……应该会减少一点。 [jian bang …… dui le ， suo yi ta you tou fa 、 zui chun he jian bang …… ying gai hui jian shao yi dian 。]

english: Oh yes, Juliet is very different...please tell her that she is the love of my long and that I life to be with her?
translation: 哦，是的，朱丽叶很不一样……请告诉她，她是我长久以来的挚爱，我一生要和她在一起？ [o ， shi de ， zhu li ye hen bu yi yang …… qing gao su ta ， ta shi wo chang jiu yi lai de zhi ai ， wo yi sheng yao he ta zai yi qi ？]

english: Hello again, remember me?
translation: 又见面了，还记得我吗？ [you jian mian le ， hai ji de wo ma ？]

english: Of course, yes....how are.. you....ermmm...
translation: 当然，是的……你怎么样……呃…… [dang ran ， shi de …… ni zen me yang …… e ……]

english: You haven't got a clue who I am do you?
translation: 你还不知道我是谁吗？ [ni hai bu zhi dao wo shi shui ma ？]

english: Not a clue my friend, but you seem to have a friendly face...a little blood stained, and perhaps in need of a wash, but friendly none the less.
translation: 没有任何线索，我的朋友，但你看起来有一张友好的脸……有点血迹，也许需要清洗，但仍然友好。 [mei you ren he xian suo ， wo de peng you ， dan ni kan qi lai you yi zhang you hao de lian …… you dian xue ji ， ye xu xu yao qing xi ， dan reng ran you hao 。]

english: You asked me to look for Juliet for you!
translation: 你让我帮你寻找朱丽叶！ [ni rang wo bang ni xun zhao zhu li ye ！]

english: Ah yes, Juliet...my sweet darling...what news?
translation: 啊，是的，朱丽叶……我亲爱的……有什么消息吗？ [a ， shi de ， zhu li ye …… wo qin ai de …… you shen me xiao xi ma ？]

english: Nothing so far, but I need to ask a few questions?
translation: 到目前为止还没有什么，但我需要问几个问题？ [dao mu qian wei zhi hai mei you shen me ， dan wo xu yao wen ji ge wen ti ？]

english: Romeo...great news...I've been in touch with Juliet!
translation: 罗密欧...好消息...我已经和朱丽叶取得联系了！ [luo mi ou ... hao xiao xi ... wo yi jing he zhu li ye qu de lian xi le ！]

english: Oh great! That is great news! Well done...well done... what a total success!
translation: 哦，太棒了！这是个好消息！干得好...干得好...非常成功！ [o ， tai bang le ！ zhe shi ge hao xiao xi ！ gan de hao ... gan de hao ... fei chang cheng gong ！]

english: Yes, and she gave me a message to give you...
translation: 是的，她给了我一条信息，让我转告给你…… [shi de ， ta gei le wo yi tiao xin xi ， rang wo zhuan gao gei ni ……]

english: Ohhh great! A message....wow!
translation: 哦哦太棒了！一条消息……哇！ [o o tai bang le ！ yi tiao xiao xi …… wa ！]

english: Yes!
translation: 是的！ [shi de ！]

english: A message...oh, I can't wait to read what my dear Juliet has to say....
translation: 一条消息……哦，我迫不及待地想读我亲爱的朱丽叶要说的话…… [yi tiao xiao xi …… o ， wo po bu ji dai di xiang du wo qin ai de zhu li ye yao shuo de hua ……]

english: I know...it's exciting isn't it...?
translation: 我知道……这很令人兴奋不是吗……？ [wo zhi dao …… zhe hen ling ren xing fen bu shi ma ……？]

english: Yes...yes...
translation: 是的……是的…… [shi de …… shi de ……]

english: You've lost the message haven't you?
translation: 你已经丢失了消息，不是吗？ [ni yi jing diu shi le xiao xi ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Yep, haven't got a clue where it is.
translation: 是的，不知道它在哪里。 [shi de ， bu zhi dao ta zai na li 。]

english: Romeo...great news...I've been in touch with Juliet! She's written a message for you...
translation: 罗密欧...好消息...我已经和朱丽叶取得联系了！她给你写了一条信息... [luo mi ou ... hao xiao xi ... wo yi jing he zhu li ye qu de lian xi le ！ ta gei ni xie le yi tiao xin xi ...]

english: Oh, a message! A message! I've never had a message before...
translation: 噢，一条消息！一条消息！我以前从来没有收到过消息... [o ， yi tiao xiao xi ！ yi tiao xiao xi ！ wo yi qian cong lai mei you shou dao guo xiao xi ...]

english: Really?
translation: 真的吗？ [zhen de ma ？]

english: No, no, not one!
translation: 不，不，没有一个！ [bu ， bu ， mei you yi ge ！]

english: Oh, well, except for the occasional court summons.
translation: 哦，好吧，除了偶尔的法庭传票。 [o ， hao ba ， chu le ou er de fa ting chuan piao 。]

english: But they're not really 'nice' messages. Not like this one! I'm sure that this message will be lovely.
translation: 但它们并不是真正的“好”消息。不像这个！我确信这条消息会很可爱。 [dan ta men bing bu shi zhen zheng de “ hao ” xiao xi 。 bu xiang zhe ge ！ wo que xin zhe tiao xiao xi hui hen ke ai 。]

english: Well are you going to open it or not?
translation: 那么你到底要不要打开它呢？ [na me ni dao di yao bu yao da kai ta ne ？]

english: Oh yes, yes, of course! 'Dearest Romeo, I am very pleased that you sent [player name] to look for me and to tell me that you still hold affliction...', Affliction! She thinks I'm diseased?
translation: 哦，是的，是的，当然！ “最亲爱的罗密欧，我很高兴你派[玩家名字]来找我，并告诉我你仍然承受着痛苦……”，痛苦！她认为我有病吗？ [o ， shi de ， shi de ， dang ran ！ “ zui qin ai de luo mi ou ， wo hen gao xing ni pai [ wan jia ming zi ] lai zhao wo ， bing gao su wo ni reng ran cheng shou zhe tong ku ……”， tong ku ！ ta ren wei wo you bing ma ？]

english: 'Affection?'
translation: '感情？' [' gan qing ？']

english: Ahh yes...'still hold affection for me. I still feel great affection for you, but unfortunately my Father opposes our marriage.'
translation: 啊是的...'仍然对我有感情。我仍然对你充满感情，但不幸的是我的父亲反对我们的婚姻。 [a shi de ...' reng ran dui wo you gan qing 。 wo reng ran dui ni chong man gan qing ， dan bu xing de shi wo de fu qin fan dui wo men de hun yin 。]

english: Oh dear...that doesn't sound too good.
translation: 哦天哪……听起来不太好。 [o tian na …… ting qi lai bu tai hao 。]

english: What? '...great affection for you. Father opposes our..
translation: 什么？ '……对你怀有深厚的感情。父亲反对我们.. [shen me ？ '…… dui ni huai you shen hou de gan qing 。 fu qin fan dui wo men ..]

english: '...marriage and will...
translation: '...婚姻和遗嘱... ['... hun yin he yi zhu ...]

english: ...will kill you if he sees you again!'
translation: ……如果他再见到你，他就会杀了你！” […… ru guo ta zai jian dao ni ， ta jiu hui sha le ni ！”]

english: I have to be honest, it's not getting any better...
translation: 我必须说实话，情况并没有好转…… [wo bi xu shuo shi hua ， qing kuang bing mei you hao zhuan ……]

english: 'Our only hope is that Father Lawrence, our long time confidant, can help us in some way.'
translation: “我们唯一的希望是劳伦斯神父，我们的长期知己，能够以某种方式帮助我们。” [“ wo men wei yi de xi wang shi lao lun si shen fu ， wo men de chang qi zhi ji ， neng gou yi mou zhong fang shi bang zhu wo men 。”]

english: Well, that's it then...we haven't got a chance...
translation: 好吧，那就这样了……我们没有机会了…… [hao ba ， na jiu zhe yang le …… wo men mei you ji hui le ……]

english: What about Father Lawrence?
translation: 劳伦斯神父呢？ [lao lun si shen fu ne ？]

english: ...our love is over...the great romance, the life of my love...
translation: ...我们的爱情结束了...伟大的浪漫，我爱的生活... [... wo men de ai qing jie shu le ... wei da de lang man ， wo ai de sheng huo ...]

english: ...or you could speak to Father Lawrence!
translation: ...或者你可以和劳伦斯神父谈谈！ [... huo zhe ni ke yi he lao lun si shen fu tan tan ！]

english: Oh, my aching, breaking, heart...how useless the situation is now...we have no one to turn to...
translation: 哦，我的心痛，心碎……现在的情况是多么无用……我们没有人可以求助…… [o ， wo de xin tong ， xin sui …… xian zai de qing kuang shi duo me wu yong …… wo men mei you ren ke yi qiu zhu ……]

english: FATHER LAWRENCE!
translation: 劳伦斯神父！ [lao lun si shen fu ！]

english: Father Lawrence?
translation: 劳伦斯神父？ [lao lun si shen fu ？]

english: Oh yes, Father Lawrence...he's our long time confidant, he might have a solution! Yes, yes, you have to go and talk to Lather Fawrence for us and ask him if he's got any suggestions for our predicament?
translation: 哦，是的，劳伦斯神父……他是我们的长期知己，他可能有办法！是的，是的，你得替我们去跟Lather Fawrence谈谈，问问他对我们的困境有什么建议吗？ [o ， shi de ， lao lun si shen fu …… ta shi wo men de chang qi zhi ji ， ta ke neng you ban fa ！ shi de ， shi de ， ni de ti wo men qu gen Lather Fawrence tan tan ， wen wen ta dui wo men de kun jing you shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: Where can I find Father Lawrence?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到劳伦斯神父？ [wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao lao lun si shen fu ？]

english: Lather Fawrence! Oh he's...
translation: 泡沫弗伦斯！哦，他是... [pao mo fu lun si ！ o ， ta shi ...]

english: You know he's not my 'real' Father don't you?
translation: 你知道他不是我“真正的”父亲，不是吗？ [ni zhi dao ta bu shi wo “ zhen zheng de ” fu qin ， bu shi ma ？]

english: I think I suspected that he wasn't.
translation: 我想我怀疑他不是。 [wo xiang wo huai yi ta bu shi 。]

english: Well anyway...he tells these song, loring bermons...and keeps these here Carrockian vitizens snoring in his church to the East North.
translation: 好吧，无论如何......他讲述这些歌曲，向伯蒙致敬......并让这些卡罗克公民在他的教堂里打鼾到东北。 [hao ba ， wu lun ru he ...... ta jiang shu zhe xie ge qu ， xiang bo meng zhi jing ...... bing rang zhe xie ka luo ke gong min zai ta de jiao tang li da han dao dong bei 。]

english: How are you?
translation: 你好吗？ [ni hao ma ？]

english: Not so good my friend...I miss Judi..., Junie..., Joopie...
translation: 不太好，我的朋友...我想念朱迪...，朱妮...，朱皮... [bu tai hao ， wo de peng you ... wo xiang nian zhu di ...， zhu ni ...， zhu pi ...]

english: Juliet?
translation: 朱丽叶？ [zhu li ye ？]

english: Juliet! I miss Juliet, terribly!
translation: 朱丽叶！我非常想念朱丽叶！ [zhu li ye ！ wo fei chang xiang nian zhu li ye ！]

english: Hmmm, so I see!
translation: 嗯，所以我明白了！ [n ， suo yi wo ming bai le ！]

english: Have you heard anything from Juliet?
translation: 你有朱丽叶的消息吗？ [ni you zhu li ye de xiao xi ma ？]

english: Sadly not my friend! And what's worse, her Father has threatened to kill me if he sees me. I mean, that seems a bit harsh!
translation: 可惜不是我的朋友！更糟糕的是，她的父亲威胁说如果他看到我就会杀了我。我的意思是，这似乎有点苛刻！ [ke xi bu shi wo de peng you ！ geng zao gao de shi ， ta de fu qin wei xie shuo ru guo ta kan dao wo jiu hui sha le wo 。 wo de yi si shi ， zhe si hu you dian ke ke ！]

english: Well, I shouldn't worry too much...you can always run away if you see him...
translation: 好吧，我不用太担心……你看到他就可以逃跑…… [hao ba ， wo bu yong tai dan xin …… ni kan dao ta jiu ke yi tao pao ……]

english: I just wish I could remember what he looks like! I live in fear of every man I see!
translation: 我只希望我能记住他的样子！我生活在对我见到的每个人的恐惧之中！ [wo zhi xi wang wo neng ji zhu ta de yang zi ！ wo sheng huo zai dui wo jian dao de mei ge ren de kong ju zhi zhong ！]

english: Hey again Romeo!
translation: 嘿，罗密欧又来了！ [hei ， luo mi ou you lai le ！]

english: Hello again Romeo!
translation: 罗密欧，你好！ [luo mi ou ， ni hao ！]

english: Ooh did you manage to survive one of Lather Fawrences sermons? I bet not, you were ages! I bet you snoozed on the welcome mat just as soon as you heard his voice!
translation: 哦，你在 Lather Fawrences 的一场布道中幸存下来了吗？我打赌不会，你已经好几岁了！我敢打赌，当您听到他的声音时，您一定会在迎宾垫上打瞌睡！ [o ， ni zai  Lather Fawrences  de yi chang bu dao zhong xing cun xia lai le ma ？ wo da du bu hui ， ni yi jing hao ji sui le ！ wo gan da du ， dang nin ting dao ta de sheng yin shi ， nin yi ding hui zai ying bin dian shang da ke shui ！]

english: Did not!
translation: 没有！ [mei you ！]

english: Oh, come on, come on, what did he say?
translation: 哦，来吧，来吧，他说什么？ [o ， lai ba ， lai ba ， ta shuo shen me ？]

english: He wants me to go to the Apothecary!
translation: 他要我去药剂师那里！ [ta yao wo qu yao ji shi na li ！]

english: The Apothecary?
translation: 药剂师？ [yao ji shi ？]

english: Yeah, I think so...but the word potion-ey doesn't exist.
translation: 是的，我想是的……但是“potion-ey”这个词不存在。 [shi de ， wo xiang shi de …… dan shi “potion-ey” zhe ge ci bu cun zai 。]

english: Well, you just used it...so I guess it does exist!
translation: 好吧，你刚刚使用过它......所以我猜它确实存在！ [hao ba ， ni gang gang shi yong guo ta ...... suo yi wo cai ta que shi cun zai ！]

english: It doesn't matter...do you know where the Apothecary is?
translation: 没关系……你知道药剂师在哪里吗？ [mei guan xi …… ni zhi dao yao ji shi zai na li ma ？]

english: Why should I tell you?
translation: 我为什么要告诉你？ [wo wei shen me yao gao su ni ？]

english: Because I'm doing you a favour!
translation: 因为我是在帮你一个忙！ [yin wei wo shi zai bang ni yi ge mang ！]

english: Right, yes...of course! Well, I think the potion-ey place is Wouth Sest of here and near a sword shop.
translation: 是的，是的……当然！嗯，我认为魔药店就在沃斯塞斯特这里，靠近一家剑店。 [shi de ， shi de …… dang ran ！ n ， wo ren wei mo yao dian jiu zai wo si sai si te zhe li ， kao jin yi jia jian dian 。]

english: He seems very keen for you to marry Juliet.
translation: 他似乎非常希望你嫁给朱丽叶。 [ta si hu fei chang xi wang ni jia gei zhu li ye 。]

english: Me too! I can't wait! Do you think it will be soon?
translation: 我也是！我等不及了！你觉得会很快吗？ [wo ye shi ！ wo deng bu ji le ！ ni jue de hui hen kuai ma ？]

english: I don't know, but I'll do what I can. It just seems a bit odd that Father Lawrence is so keen for you to marry?
translation: 我不知道，但我会尽力而为。劳伦斯神父如此热衷于让你结婚，这似乎有点奇怪？ [wo bu zhi dao ， dan wo hui jin li er wei 。 lao lun si shen fu ru ci re zhong yu rang ni jie hun ， zhe si hu you dian qi guai ？]

english: I can't imagine why he's so keen? Though, he was our messenger before you. Of course, he had a lot more hair back then...and I think we may have gone to school together...
translation: 我实在想不通他为什么这么热心？不过，他是我们在你之前的使者。当然，那时候他的头发多了很多……而且我想我们可能是一起上学的…… [wo shi zai xiang bu tong ta wei shen me zhe me re xin ？ bu guo ， ta shi wo men zai ni zhi qian de shi zhe 。 dang ran ， na shi hou ta de tou fa duo le hen duo …… er qie wo xiang wo men ke neng shi yi qi shang xue de ……]

english: What, since you were kids?
translation: 什么，从小就这样？ [shen me ， cong xiao jiu zhe yang ？]

english: Yeah! Thinking about it now, we called him 'Diddy Dorrence' back then!
translation: 是的！现在想想，那时候我们还叫他‘Diddy Dorrence’呢！ [shi de ！ xian zai xiang xiang ， na shi hou wo men hai jiao ta ‘Diddy Dorrence’ ne ！]

english: So, maybe, he just wants a bit of peace? And when you two are married, he won't have to traipse around delivering your messages anymore?
translation: 那么，也许他只是想要一点平静？等你们两个结婚了，他就不用再跑来跑去给你们送信了？ [na me ， ye xu ta zhi shi xiang yao yi dian ping jing ？ deng ni men liang ge jie hun le ， ta jiu bu yong zai pao lai pao qu gei ni men song xin le ？]

english: Yes, the years haven't been good to him.
translation: 是的，这些年对他来说并不好。 [shi de ， zhe xie nian dui ta lai shuo bing bu hao 。]

english: Hi Romeo!
translation: 嗨罗密欧！ [hai luo mi ou ！]

english: Oh hello, have you seen Lather Fawrence?
translation: 哦，你好，你见过拉瑟·弗伦斯吗？ [o ， ni hao ， ni jian guo la se · fu lun si ma ？]

english: Yes, he's given me details of a potion which should help resolve this situation. The Apothecary is helping me prepare it.
translation: 是的，他给了我一种药水的详细信息，应该有助于解决这个问题。药剂师正在帮我准备。 [shi de ， ta gei le wo yi zhong yao shui de xiang xi xin xi ， ying gai you zhu yu jie jue zhe ge wen ti 。 yao ji shi zheng zai bang wo zhun bei 。]

english: Ooooh, it all sounds horribly complicated?
translation: 哦，这一切听起来非常复杂？ [o ， zhe yi qie ting qi lai fei chang fu za ？]

english: All I can say is I'll be glad when Juliet's finally in that crypt!
translation: 我只能说，当朱丽叶终于进入那个地下室时，我会很高兴！ [wo zhi neng shuo ， dang zhu li ye zhong yu jin ru na ge di xia shi shi ， wo hui hen gao xing ！]

english: Spoken like a true lover!
translation: 说话就像一个真正的情人！ [shuo hua jiu xiang yi ge zhen zheng de qing ren ！]

english: Ooohh, that's the potion is it? Rather you than me!
translation: 哦哦，这就是药水吗？不如你而不是我！ [o o ， zhe jiu shi yao shui ma ？ bu ru ni er bu shi wo ！]

english: I'm not drinking it! It's for Juliet!
translation: 我不喝它！这是为了朱丽叶！ [wo bu he ta ！ zhe shi wei le zhu li ye ！]

english: Well, I mean...it's probably delicious...and not dangerous at all. And you quite often see harmless drinks in a glowing sort of pink colour.
translation: 嗯，我的意思是……它可能很美味……而且一点也不危险。你经常会看到无害的饮料呈粉红色。 [n ， wo de yi si shi …… ta ke neng hen mei wei …… er qie yi dian ye bu wei xian 。 ni jing chang hui kan dao wu hai de yin liao cheng fen hong se 。]

english: Hmm, I'm not convinced...maybe you ought to try some before I give it to Juliet?
translation: 嗯，我不相信……也许你应该在我把它给朱丽叶之前尝试一下？ [n ， wo bu xiang xin …… ye xu ni ying gai zai wo ba ta gei zhu li ye zhi qian chang shi yi xia ？]

english: Urgh! No way! Not in a million years!
translation: 呃！决不！一百万年内不会！ [e ！ jue bu ！ yi bai wan nian nei bu hui ！]

english: Ok...but you know what to do when I've given this to Juliet?
translation: 好吧……但是当我把这个交给朱丽叶后你知道该怎么做吗？ [hao ba …… dan shi dang wo ba zhe ge jiao gei zhu li ye hou ni zhi dao gai zen me zuo ma ？]

english: Oh, yeah...sure Lather Fawrence explained all that to me...
translation: 哦，是的……当然，Lather Fawrence 向我解释了这一切…… [o ， shi de …… dang ran ，Lather Fawrence  xiang wo jie shi le zhe yi qie ……]

english: Romeo, it's all set. Juliet has drunk the potion and has been taken down into the Crypt...now you just need to pop along and collect her.
translation: 罗密欧，一切都准备好了。朱丽叶已经喝下了药水，并被带入了地穴……现在你只需要去接她即可。 [luo mi ou ， yi qie dou zhun bei hao le 。 zhu li ye yi jing he xia le yao shui ， bing bei dai ru le di xue …… xian zai ni zhi xu yao qu jie ta ji ke 。]

english: Ah right, the potion! Great...
translation: 啊对了，药水！伟大的... [a dui le ， yao shui ！ wei da de ...]

english: What potion would that be then?
translation: 那会是什么药水呢？ [na hui shi shen me yao shui ne ？]

english: The Cadava potion...you know, the one which will make her appear dead! She's in the crypt, pop along and claim your true love.
translation: 卡达瓦药剂……你知道，就是那种会让她看起来死了的药剂！她在地下室里，快来吧，索取你的真爱。 [ka da wa yao ji …… ni zhi dao ， jiu shi na zhong hui rang ta kan qi lai si le de yao ji ！ ta zai di xia shi li ， kuai lai ba ， suo qu ni de zhen ai 。]

english: But I'm scared...will you come with me?
translation: 但我很害怕……你能跟我一起去吗？ [dan wo hen hai pa …… ni neng gen wo yi qi qu ma ？]

english: A cutscene starts
translation: 过场动画开始 [guo chang dong hua kai shi]

english: Oh , ok...come on! I think I saw the entrance when I visited there last...
translation: 哦，好吧……来吧！我想我上次去那里时看到了入口...... [o ， hao ba …… lai ba ！ wo xiang wo shang ci qu na li shi kan dao le ru kou ......]

english: This is pretty scary...
translation: 这实在是太可怕了…… [zhe shi zai shi tai ke pa le ……]

english: Oh , be quiet...
translation: 哦，安静点…… [o ， an jing dian ……]

english: We're here. Look, Juliet is over there!
translation: 我们到了。看，朱丽叶就在那儿！ [wo men dao le 。 kan ， zhu li ye jiu zai na er ！]

english: You go over to her...and I'll go and wait over here...
translation: 你到她身边去……我去这里等…… [ni dao ta shen bian qu …… wo qu zhe li deng ……]

english: Ohhh, ok then...
translation: 哦哦，那好吧…… [o o ， na hao ba ……]

english: Hey...Juliet...
translation: 嘿……朱丽叶…… [hei …… zhu li ye ……]

english: Juliet....?
translation: 朱丽叶……？ [zhu li ye ……？]

english: Oh dear...you seem to be dead.
translation: 哦亲爱的……你好像死了。 [o qin ai de …… ni hao xiang si le 。]

english: Hi Romeo...I'm Phillipa!
translation: 嗨罗密欧...我是菲利帕！ [hai luo mi ou ... wo shi fei li pa ！]

english: Wow! You're a fox!
translation: 哇！你是一只狐狸！ [wa ！ ni shi yi zhi hu li ！]

english: It's a shame about Juliet...but perhaps we can meet up later?
translation: 朱丽叶真是太可惜了……不过也许我们可以稍后再见面？ [zhu li ye zhen shi tai ke xi le …… bu guo ye xu wo men ke yi shao hou zai jian mian ？]

english: Who's Juliet?
translation: 朱丽叶是谁？ [zhu li ye shi shui ？]

english: A cutscene ends
translation: 一段过场动画结束 [yi duan guo chang dong hua jie shu]

english: Yes, I have seen her actually!
translation: 是的，我确实见过她！ [shi de ， wo que shi jian guo ta ！]

english: Yes, ok, I'll let her know.
translation: 是的，好的，我会让她知道的。 [shi de ， hao de ， wo hui rang ta zhi dao de 。]

english: Where can I find Juliet?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到朱丽叶？ [wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao zhu li ye ？]

english: Is there anything else you can tell me about Juliet?
translation: 关于朱丽叶，你还有什么可以告诉我的吗？ [guan yu zhu li ye ， ni hai you shen me ke yi gao su wo de ma ？]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Sorry Romeo, I've got better things to do right now but maybe later?
translation: 抱歉，罗密欧，我现在有更好的事情要做，但也许以后可以呢？ [bao qian ， luo mi ou ， wo xian zai you geng hao de shi qing yao zuo ， dan ye xu yi hou ke yi ne ？]

english: No sorry, I haven't seen her.
translation: 不，抱歉，我没见过她。 [bu ， bao qian ， wo mei jian guo ta 。]

english: Perhaps I could help to find her for you?
translation: 也许我可以帮你找到她？ [ye xu wo ke yi bang ni zhao dao ta ？]

english: How are you?
translation: 你好吗？ [ni hao ma ？]

english: Where can I find Father Lawrence?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到劳伦斯神父？ [wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao lao lun si shen fu ？]

english: Have you heard anything from Juliet?
translation: 你有朱丽叶的消息吗？ [ni you zhu li ye de xiao xi ma ？]

english: He wants me to go to the Apothecary!
translation: 他要我去药剂师那里！ [ta yao wo qu yao ji shi na li ！]

english: He seems keen for you to marry Juliet.
translation: 他似乎很想让你嫁给朱丽叶。 [ta si hu hen xiang rang ni jia gei zhu li ye 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello traveller. Have a look at my latest range of gnome fashion. Rometti is the ultimate label in gnome high society.
translation: 你好旅行者。看看我最新的侏儒时尚系列。罗梅蒂是侏儒上流社会的终极标签。 [ni hao lv xing zhe 。 kan kan wo zui xin de zhu ru shi shang xi lie 。 luo mei di shi zhu ru shang liu she hui de zhong ji biao qian 。]

english: Really.
translation: 真的。 [zhen de 。]

english: Pastels are all the rage this season.
translation: 粉彩这一季很流行。 [fen cai zhe yi ji hen liu xing 。]

english: I've no time for fashion.
translation: 我没有时间关注时尚。 [wo mei you shi jian guan zhu shi shang 。]

english: Hmm... I did wonder.
translation: 嗯...我确实想知道。 [n ... wo que shi xiang zhi dao 。]

english: OK then, let's have a look.
translation: 好吧，那我们就来看看吧。 [hao ba ， na wo men jiu lai kan kan ba 。]

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you!   You need a [gnome food/drink]!
translation: 尽管您找到了顾客，但您似乎没有带来正确的食物！   你需要[侏儒食物/饮料]！ [jin guan nin zhao dao le gu ke ， dan nin si hu mei you dai lai zheng que de shi wu ！    ni xu yao [ zhu ru shi wu / yin liao ]！]

english: You hand over your delivery of a [gnome food/drink] to Rometti
translation: 你将[侏儒食物/饮料]交给罗梅蒂 [ni jiang [ zhu ru shi wu / yin liao ] jiao gei luo mei di]

english: Ooh, Thank you darling.
translation: 噢，谢谢你亲爱的。 [o ， xie xie ni qin ai de 。]

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number]] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 您有 [number] 个积分用于免费送货令牌。您可能会收到 [number]] 块侏儒食物。 [nin you  [number]  ge ji fen yong yu mian fei song huo ling pai 。 nin ke neng hui shou dao  [number]]  kuai zhu ru shi wu 。]

english: I've no time for fashion.
translation: 我没有时间关注时尚。 [wo mei you shi jian guan zhu shi shang 。]

english: OK then, let's have a look.
translation: 好吧，那我们就来看看吧。 [hao ba ， na wo men jiu lai kan kan ba 。]

english: Hello and welcome to my pie shop, how can I help you?
translation: 您好，欢迎光临我的馅饼店，有什么可以帮您的吗？ [nin hao ， huan ying guang lin wo de xian bing dian ， you shen me ke yi bang nin de ma ？]

english: Do you need any help?
translation: 您需要帮助吗？ [nin xu yao bang zhu ma ？]

english: Actually I could, you see I'm running out of stock and I don't have time to bake any more pies. Would you be willing to bake me some pies? I'll pay you well for them.
translation: 事实上我可以，你看我的库存已经用完了，而且我没有时间再烤馅饼了。你愿意给我烤一些馅饼吗？我会付给你丰厚的报酬。 [shi shi shang wo ke yi ， ni kan wo de ku cun yi jing yong wan le ， er qie wo mei you shi jian zai kao xian bing le 。 ni yuan yi gei wo kao yi xie xian bing ma ？ wo hui fu gei ni feng hou de bao chou 。]

english: Sure, what do you need?
translation: 当然可以，你需要什么？ [dang ran ke yi ， ni xu yao shen me ？]

english: Great, can you bake me [amount] [pie type] Pies please.
translation: 太好了，你能给我烤[数量][馅饼类型]馅饼吗？ [tai hao le ， ni neng gei wo kao [ shu liang ][ xian bing lei xing ] xian bing ma ？]

english: Sorry, I can't help you.
translation: 抱歉，我帮不了你。 [bao qian ， wo bang bu liao ni 。]

english: I've got those pies you wanted.
translation: 你想要的馅饼我已经有了。 [ni xiang yao de xian bing wo yi jing you le 。]

english: Doesn't look like you have any of the [amount] [pie type] Pies I requested.
translation: 您似乎没有我要求的[数量][馅饼类型]馅饼。 [nin si hu mei you wo yao qiu de [ shu liang ][ xian bing lei xing ] xian bing 。]

english: Thank you, if you could bring me the other [amount] that'd be great!
translation: 谢谢，如果您能给我带来其他[数量]，那就太好了！ [xie xie ， ru guo nin neng gei wo dai lai qi ta [ shu liang ]， na jiu tai hao le ！]

english: Thank you very much!
translation: 非常感谢！ [fei chang gan xie ！]

english: I'm good thanks.
translation: 我很好谢谢。 [wo hen hao xie xie 。]

english: I'd like to buy some pies.
translation: 我想买一些馅饼。 [wo xiang mai yi xie xian bing 。]

english: Do you need any help?
translation: 您需要帮助吗？ [nin xu yao bang zhu ma ？]

english: Sure, what do you need?
translation: 当然可以，你需要什么？ [dang ran ke yi ， ni xu yao shen me ？]

english: Sorry, I can't help you.
translation: 抱歉，我帮不了你。 [bao qian ， wo bang bu liao ni 。]

english: I've got those pies you wanted.
translation: 你想要的馅饼我已经有了。 [ni xiang yao de xian bing wo yi jing you le 。]

english: I'm good thanks.
translation: 我很好谢谢。 [wo hen hao xie xie 。]

english: Would you like to buy some crafting equipment?
translation: 您想购买一些制作设备吗？ [nin xiang gou mai yi xie zhi zuo she bei ma ？]

english: No thanks; I've got all the Crafting equipment I need.
translation: 不，谢谢;我已经拥有了我需要的所有制作设备。 [bu ， xie xie ; wo yi jing yong you le wo xu yao de suo you zhi zuo she bei 。]

english: Okay. Fare well on your travels.
translation: 好的。旅途愉快。 [hao de 。 lv tu yu kuai 。]

english: No thanks, I've got all the Crafting equipment I need.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我已经有了我需要的所有制作设备。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo yi jing you le wo xu yao de suo you zhi zuo she bei 。]

english: Let's see what you've got, then.
translation: 那么让我们看看你有什么。 [na me rang wo men kan kan ni you shen me 。]

english: Hey, human.
translation: 嘿，人类。 [hei ， ren lei 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I am Root.
translation: 我是鲁特。 [wo shi lu te 。]

english: Is that all you have to say about yourself?
translation: 这就是你要说的关于你自己的一切吗？ [zhe jiu shi ni yao shuo de guan yu ni zi ji de yi qie ma ？]

english: Oh well, I suppose that's enough for some people.
translation: 哦，好吧，我想这对某些人来说已经足够了。 [o ， hao ba ， wo xiang zhe dui mou xie ren lai shuo yi jing zu gou le 。]

translation: 我希望你能找到他，年轻人。我最好离开。 [wo xi wang ni neng zhao dao ta ， nian qing ren 。 wo zui hao li kai 。]

english: Something's different.
translation: 有些东西不一样了。 [you xie dong xi bu yi yang le 。]

english: Nope, seems pretty much the same to me.
translation: 不，对我来说似乎几乎一样。 [bu ， dui wo lai shuo si hu ji hu yi yang 。]

english: Hmm...
My favourite colour is green!
translation: 我最喜欢的颜色是绿色！ [wo zui xi huan de yan se shi lv se ！]

english: Great! How uncreative!
translation: 伟大的！多么没有创意啊！ [wei da de ！ duo me mei you chuang yi a ！]

english: It's the colour of my little duck friend.
translation: 这是我的小鸭子朋友的颜色。 [zhe shi wo de xiao ya zi peng you de yan se 。]

english: Indeed it is.
translation: 确实如此。 [que shi ru ci 。]

english: Come on... Something here has to work...
translation: 来吧...这里必须有东西起作用... [lai ba ... zhe li bi xu you dong xi qi zuo yong ...]

english: Care for any assistance?
translation: 需要任何帮助吗？ [xu yao ren he bang zhu ma ？]

english: Absolutely! I can't seem to find a way into that crevice to continue my scientific endeavour. I don't suppose you could have a dig around?
translation: 绝对地！我似乎无法找到进入那个缝隙的方法来继续我的科学事业。我想你不会去挖掘一下吧？ [jue dui di ！ wo si hu wu fa zhao dao jin ru na ge feng xi de fang fa lai ji xu wo de ke xue shi ye 。 wo xiang ni bu hui qu wa jue yi xia ba ？]

english: A scientific dig... Where have I heard of that before?
translation: 科学挖掘……我以前在哪里听说过？ [ke xue wa jue …… wo yi qian zai na li ting shuo guo ？]

english: Don't dwell on it too long. There are things I must learn about our world!
translation: 不要在这件事上纠缠太久。关于我们的世界，有些事情我必须了解！ [bu yao zai zhe jian shi shang jiu chan tai jiu 。 guan yu wo men de shi jie ， you xie shi qing wo bi xu liao jie ！]

english: I found a ruby in the ground.
translation: 我在地里发现了一颗红宝石。 [wo zai di li fa xian le yi ke hong bao shi 。]

english: Wondrous! A good sign to be sure! You may keep it, while I will keep the knowledge of what may be here.
translation: 太棒了！可以肯定的是，这是一个好兆头！你可以保留它，而我将保留这里可能存在的知识。 [tai bang le ！ ke yi ken ding de shi ， zhe shi yi ge hao zhao tou ！ ni ke yi bao liu ta ， er wo jiang bao liu zhe li ke neng cun zai de zhi shi 。]

english: Okay...
translation: 好的... [hao de ...]

english: So I'm here... That's there... Then how do we get down there?
translation: 所以我在这里...那儿...那我们怎么去那里呢？ [suo yi wo zai zhe li ... na er ... na wo men zen me qu na li ne ？]

english: Chatting to yourself?
translation: 自己跟自己聊天？ [zi ji gen zi ji liao tian ？]

english: Ah, hello there! I'm just pondering on the wonders of geography.
translation: 啊，你好！我只是在思考地理的奇迹。 [a ， ni hao ！ wo zhi shi zai si kao di li de qi ji 。]

english: Anything I can help you out with?
translation: 有什么我可以帮你的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang ni de ma ？]

english: Most certainly. Perhaps you could dig around near the mouth of that nearby cave and elucidate its nature for me.
translation: 最肯定的是。也许你可以在附近那个洞穴的入口附近挖掘一下，并为我阐明它的性质。 [zui ken ding de shi 。 ye xu ni ke yi zai fu jin na ge dong xue de ru kou fu jin wa jue yi xia ， bing wei wo chan ming ta de xing zhi 。]

english: Will I get anything for helping?
translation: 我会得到什么帮助吗？ [wo hui de dao shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: The feeling of satisfaction after helping a scientist in need?
translation: 帮助有需要的科学家后的满足感？ [bang zhu you xu yao de ke xue jia hou de man zu gan ？]

english: Fair enough.
translation: 很公平。 [hen gong ping 。]

english: I found a sapphire nearby.
translation: 我在附近发现了一颗蓝宝石。 [wo zai fu jin fa xian le yi ke lan bao shi 。]

english: Outstanding! This can only be seen as a positive! I shall add the knowledge to my reserves. You may keep the gem.
translation: 杰出的！这只能被视为积极的一面！我会将这些知识添加到我的储备中。你可以保留宝石。 [jie chu de ！ zhe zhi neng bei shi wei ji ji de yi mian ！ wo hui jiang zhe xie zhi shi tian jia dao wo de chu bei zhong 。 ni ke yi bao liu bao shi 。]

english: Alright...
translation: 好吧... [hao ba ...]

english: Are you lost?
translation: 你迷路了吗？ [ni mi lu le ma ？]

english: No, my good friend, but I am in a bit of a pickle.
translation: 不，我的好朋友，但我有点陷入困境。 [bu ， wo de hao peng you ， dan wo you dian xian ru kun jing 。]

english: A pickle?
translation: 泡菜？ [pao cai ？]

english: Perhaps a jam... Those bandits over there are in the way of scientific discovery!
translation: 也许是堵车……那边的强盗阻碍了科学发现！ [ye xu shi du che …… na bian de qiang dao zu ai le ke xue fa xian ！]

english: Would you like me to deal with them?
translation: 你想让我对付他们吗？ [ni xiang rang wo dui fu ta men ma ？]

english: Well, I'm not averse to a little academic collaboration. I just need some proof that there's something strange here.
translation: 嗯，我并不反对一些学术合作。我只需要一些证据来证明这里有什么奇怪的东西。 [n ， wo bing bu fan dui yi xie xue shu he zuo 。 wo zhi xu yao yi xie zheng ju lai zheng ming zhe li you shen me qi guai de dong xi 。]

english: Is there any chance you could dig near the mouth of that cave for me? Let me know if you find anything.
translation: 你有没有机会帮我在那个洞口附近挖个洞？如果你发现什么，请告诉我。 [ni you mei you ji hui bang wo zai na ge dong kou fu jin wa ge dong ？ ru guo ni fa xian shen me ， qing gao su wo 。]

english: What should I do with the bandits?
translation: 面对土匪我该怎么办？ [mian dui tu fei wo gai zen me ban ？]

english: I have no qualms with you doing what you must on that front.
translation: 我对你在这方面做你必须做的事情没有任何疑虑。 [wo dui ni zai zhe fang mian zuo ni bi xu zuo de shi qing mei you ren he yi lv 。]

english: I found an emerald in the earth.
translation: 我在地里发现了一颗祖母绿。 [wo zai di li fa xian le yi ke zu mu lv 。]

english: Stupendous! Combined with the other locations, I suspect there may be more to this than meets the eye.
translation: 太棒了！结合其他地点，我怀疑这可能比表面上看到的更多。 [tai bang le ！ jie he qi ta di dian ， wo huai yi zhe ke neng bi biao mian shang kan dao de geng duo 。]

english: Right...
translation: 正确的... [zheng que de ...]

english: Keep the gem for yourself, as payment for your assistance.
translation: 宝石归你自己所有，作为对你的帮助的报酬。 [bao shi gui ni zi ji suo you ， zuo wei dui ni de bang zhu de bao chou 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: You ssshould not be down here...
translation: 你不应该在这儿…… [ni bu ying gai zai zhe er ……]

translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: My name isss unimportant... I live only to ssserve my massster.
translation: 我的名字并不重要……我活着只是为了服务我的主人。 [wo de ming zi bing bu zhong yao …… wo huo zhe zhi shi wei le fu wu wo de zhu ren 。]

english: Um... Okay then.
translation: 嗯...好吧。 [n ... hao ba 。]

english: Why are you down here?
translation: 你为什么在下面？ [ni wei shen me zai xia mian ？]

english: Thisss isss where I belong... Beingsss sssuch as myssself cannot abide in the light... It is in the darknesss where we find our homesss...
translation: 这就是我所属的地方...像我自己这样的存在无法居住在光明中...在黑暗中我们找到了我们的家... [zhe jiu shi wo suo shu de di fang ... xiang wo zi ji zhe yang de cun zai wu fa ju zhu zai guang ming zhong ... zai hei an zhong wo men zhao dao le wo men de jia ...]

english: Uh... Okay then.
translation: 呃……好吧。 [e …… hao ba 。]

english: Can I use your anvil?
translation: 我可以使用你的铁砧吗？ [wo ke yi shi yong ni de tie zhen ma ？]

english: Of courssse you may... I have very little ussse for it nowadaysss...
translation: 当然你可以...我现在对此没什么用处了... [dang ran ni ke yi ... wo xian zai dui ci mei shen me yong chu le ...]

english: Uh... Thanks, I guess.
translation: 呃...谢谢，我想。 [e ... xie xie ， wo xiang 。]

translation: 你是德雷诺伯爵的助手吗？ [ni shi de lei nuo bo jue de zhu shou ma ？]

english: I used to have that honour...Why do you ssseek me?
translation: 我曾经有过这样的荣幸……你为什么来找我？ [wo ceng jing you guo zhe yang de rong xing …… ni wei shen me lai zhao wo ？]

english: I understand that you can make me a 'sacrificial offering pot' if I bring you a bar of silver?
translation: 我知道，我给你一块银子，你就可以给我做一个‘祭锅’？ [wo zhi dao ， wo gei ni yi kuai yin zi ， ni jiu ke yi gei wo zuo yi ge ‘ ji guo ’？]

english: And where did you hear thisss?
translation: 你从哪里听到这个消息的？ [ni cong na li ting dao zhe ge xiao xi de ？]

english: It was from Malak in Canifis.
translation: 是从卡尼菲斯的马拉克发来的。 [shi cong ka ni fei si de ma la ke fa lai de 。]

english: Ah, I sssee...Yesss, I know how to make sssuch an item...It has been many yearsss sssince I have needed to however...
translation: 啊，我看到了……是的，我知道如何制作这样的物品……已经很多年了，因为我需要……但是…… [a ， wo kan dao le …… shi de ， wo zhi dao ru he zhi zuo zhe yang de wu pin …… yi jing hen duo nian le ， yin wei wo xu yao …… dan shi ……]

english: It is not my wisssh to quessstion your desssire for sssuch an item, I wasss merely sssurprisssed that one sssuch as you would make sssuch a requessst...
translation: 我不想质疑你对这样一件物品的渴望，我只是惊讶像你这样的人会提出这样的要求...... [wo bu xiang zhi yi ni dui zhe yang yi jian wu pin de ke wang ， wo zhi shi jing ya xiang ni zhe yang de ren hui ti chu zhe yang de yao qiu ......]

english: I will happily make you thisss pot, but you mussst bring me a bar of sssilver...Alasss, I can no longer collect my own ingredientsss, and mussst remain here...
translation: 我很乐意为你做这个锅，但你必须给我带来一块银……唉，我不能再收集自己的原料了，必须留在这里…… [wo hen le yi wei ni zuo zhe ge guo ， dan ni bi xu gei wo dai lai yi kuai yin …… ai ， wo bu neng zai shou ji zi ji de yuan liao le ， bi xu liu zai zhe li ……]

english: I have a silver bar with me, I was wondering if you could make it into a 'sacrificial offering pot' for me?
translation: 我身上有一根银条，不知道你能不能帮我把它做成‘祭锅’呢？ [wo shen shang you yi gen yin tiao ， bu zhi dao ni neng bu neng bang wo ba ta zuo cheng ‘ ji guo ’ ne ？]

english: Yesss, of courssse...There you are, put it to good usssse...

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Why are you down here?
translation: 你为什么在下面？ [ni wei shen me zai xia mian ？]

english: Can I use your anvil?
translation: 我可以使用你的铁砧吗？ [wo ke yi shi yong ni de tie zhen ma ？]

english: Hi!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Grrreetings frrriend! Welcome to my worrrld famous food emporrrium! All my meats are so frrresh you'd swear you killed them yourrrself!
translation: 问候朋友！欢迎来到我的世界著名食品商场！我所有的肉都很新鲜，你会发誓是你自己杀的！ [wen hou peng you ！ huan ying lai dao wo de shi jie zhu ming shi pin shang chang ！ wo suo you de rou dou hen xin xian ， ni hui fa shi shi ni zi ji sha de ！]

english: Why do you only sell meats?
translation: 为什么只卖肉？ [wei shen me zhi mai rou ？]

english: What? Why, what else would you want to eat? What kind of lycanthrrrope are you anyway?
translation: 什么？为什么，你还想吃什么？你到底是哪种狼人？ [shen me ？ wei shen me ， ni hai xiang chi shen me ？ ni dao di shi na zhong lang ren ？]

english: ...A vegetarian one?
translation: ……素食者？ […… su shi zhe ？]

translation: 素食主义者...？ [su shi zhu yi zhe ...？]

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]
