translation: 你们卖熟食吗？ [ni men mai shu shi ma ？]

english: Cooked food? Who would want that? You lose all the flavourrr of the meat when you can't taste the blood!
translation: 煮熟的食物？谁会想要那个？当你尝不到血的味道时，你就失去了肉的所有味道！ [zhu shu de shi wu ？ shui hui xiang yao na ge ？ dang ni chang bu dao xue de wei dao shi ， ni jiu shi qu le rou de suo you wei dao ！]

english: Can I buy some food?
translation: 我可以买一些食物吗？ [wo ke yi mai yi xie shi wu ma ？]

english: Cerrrtainly!
translation: 当然！ [dang ran ！]

english: Why do you only sell meats?
translation: 为什么只卖肉？ [wei shen me zhi mai rou ？]

english: Do you sell cooked food?
translation: 你们卖熟食吗？ [ni men mai shu shi ma ？]

english: Can I buy some food?
translation: 我可以买一些食物吗？ [wo ke yi mai yi xie shi wu ma ？]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Hello. A fine day for stealing, wouldn't you say?
translation: 你好。今天是偷窃的好日子，你说呢？ [ni hao 。 jin tian shi tou qie de hao ri zi ， ni shuo ne ？]

english: I suppose so, just as long as you're not planning to steal from me.
translation: 我想是的，只要你不打算偷我的东西。 [wo xiang shi de ， zhi yao ni bu da suan tou wo de dong xi 。]

english: You don't have any house keys, do you? You won't find yourself getting very far without any. Maybe come back later?
translation: 你没有房子钥匙，是吗？如果没有任何东西，你不会发现自己走得太远。也许稍后再回来？ [ni mei you fang zi yao shi ， shi ma ？ ru guo mei you ren he dong xi ， ni bu hui fa xian zi ji zou de tai yuan 。 ye xu shao hou zai hui lai ？]

english: You don't have any valuables worth my time. Come back when you do!
translation: 你没有任何值钱的东西值得我花时间。当你回来的时候就回来吧！ [ni mei you ren he zhi qian de dong xi zhi de wo hua shi jian 。 dang ni hui lai de shi hou jiu hui lai ba ！]

english: Looks like [Caius/Lavinia/Victor] is returning to [his/her] house. You'll have to wait a moment until we get word of the next house.
translation: 看起来[Caius/Lavinia/Victor]要返回[他/她的]家。你得稍等一下，我们才能得到下一栋房子的消息。 [kan qi lai [Caius/Lavinia/Victor] yao fan hui [ ta / ta de ] jia 。 ni de shao deng yi xia ， wo men cai neng de dao xia yi dong fang zi de xiao xi 。]

english: I hear that [Caius/Lavinia/Victor] might be leaving [his/her] house soon.
translation: 我听说 [Caius/Lavinia/Victor] 可能很快就会离开 [他/她] 的房子。 [wo ting shuo  [Caius/Lavinia/Victor]  ke neng hen kuai jiu hui li kai  [ ta / ta ]  de fang zi 。]

english: Looks like [Caius/Lavinia/Victor] isn't home right now. Go quickly!
translation: 看起来[Caius/Lavinia/Victor]现在不在家。快点走吧！ [kan qi lai [Caius/Lavinia/Victor] xian zai bu zai jia 。 kuai dian zou ba ！]

english: Already forgotten? Head over to [Caius/Lavinia/Victor]'s house.
translation: 已经忘记了吗？前往[Caius/Lavinia/Victor]的房子。 [yi jing wang ji le ma ？ qian wang [Caius/Lavinia/Victor] de fang zi 。]

english: His house is north of here.
translation: 他的房子在这北边。 [ta de fang zi zai zhe bei bian 。]

english: Her house is east of here.
translation: 她的家在这东边。 [ta de jia zai zhe dong bian 。]

english: I'll find my own way.
translation: 我会找到自己的方法。 [wo hui zhao dao zi ji de fang fa 。]

english: I'll pass for now.
translation: 我暂时就过去吧。 [wo zan shi jiu guo qu ba 。]

english: Suit yourself.
translation: 适合自己。 [shi he zi ji 。]

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: I could do with some information on houses.
translation: 我可以提供一些有关房屋的信息。 [wo ke yi ti gong yi xie you guan fang wu de xin xi 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: I'll find my own way.
translation: 我会找到自己的方法。 [wo hui zhao dao zi ji de fang fa 。]

english: Yes, don't ask me again.
translation: 是的，不要再问我了。 [shi de ， bu yao zai wen wo le 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Ahoy there, sailor! Can't stop to talk right now, I'm afraid. You'll need to come back later.
translation: 嘿，水手！恐怕现在无法停下来说话。你需要稍后再回来。 [hei ， shui shou ！ kong pa xian zai wu fa ting xia lai shuo hua 。 ni xu yao shao hou zai hui lai 。]

english: You need to complete the Pandemonium quest to fully access the Sailing skill.
translation: 您需要完成混乱世界任务才能完全获得航海技能。 [nin xu yao wan cheng hun luan shi jie ren wu cai neng wan quan huo de hang hai ji neng 。]

english: Ahoy there sailor and welcome to Storm Tempor!
translation: 嘿，水手，欢迎来到暴风雨！ [hei ， shui shou ， huan ying lai dao bao feng yu ！]

english: Welcome? This place doesn't look very welcoming to me.
translation: 欢迎？这个地方看起来不太欢迎我。 [huan ying ？ zhe ge di fang kan qi lai bu tai huan ying wo 。]

english: What do you mean? We've got the fresh sea breeze, the spray of the ocean water, a supply of the finest rum this side of the Unquiet ocean and one of the fiercest storms in Gielinor to contend with.
translation: 你是什​​么意思？我们有清新的海风、喷溅的海水、不安宁大洋这边最好的朗姆酒，以及吉林诺最猛烈的风暴之一。 [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？ wo men you qing xin de hai feng 、 pen jian de hai shui 、 bu an ning da yang zhe bian zui hao de lang mu jiu ， yi ji ji lin nuo zui meng lie de feng bao zhi yi 。]

english: What's not to love?
translation: 什么是不爱？ [shen me shi bu ai ？]

english: Yeah, it's contending with that storm that worries me.
translation: 是的，它正在与让我担心的风暴作斗争。 [shi de ， ta zheng zai yu rang wo dan xin de feng bao zuo dou zheng 。]

english: Ye'd be right to fear the storm, it's bested many a sailor around these parts. That's what makes it so exciting though!
translation: 你对风暴的恐惧是正确的，在这些地区，许多水手都被它打败了。这就是让它如此令人兴奋的原因！ [ni dui feng bao de kong ju shi zheng que de ， zai zhe xie di qu ， xu duo shui shou dou bei ta da bai le 。 zhe jiu shi rang ta ru ci ling ren xing fen de yuan yin ！]

english: Us Barracudas live for the rush and we trust that our skills will save us a trip to the locker.
translation: 我们梭子鱼就是为了冲刺而生的，我们相信我们的技能会让我们免去储物柜的麻烦。 [wo men suo zi yu jiu shi wei le chong ci er sheng de ， wo men xiang xin wo men de ji neng hui rang wo men mian qu chu wu gui de ma fan 。]

english: I'm always up for a challenge, but what's the point? Why not take the safer route around the storm?
translation: 我总是乐于接受挑战，但这有什么意义呢？为什么不采取更安全的路线来绕过风暴呢？ [wo zong shi le yu jie shou tiao zhan ， dan zhe you shen me yi yi ne ？ wei shen me bu cai qu geng an quan de lu xian lai rao guo feng bao ne ？]

english: Well you see, there's value in sailors with skills like us. Most common folk would think like you and avoid the storm, but that takes time and as them merchants say, 'time is money'.
translation: 嗯，你看，像我们这样拥有技能的水手是有价值的。大多数普通人都会像你一样思考并避免风暴，但这需要时间，正如商人所说，“时间就是金钱”。 [n ， ni kan ， xiang wo men zhe yang yong you ji neng de shui shou shi you jia zhi de 。 da duo shu pu tong ren du hui xiang ni yi yang si kao bing bi mian feng bao ， dan zhe xu yao shi jian ， zheng ru shang ren suo shuo ，“ shi jian jiu shi jin qian ”。]

english: That's where we come in! Those merchant folk sail up to the south-end of the storm, drop off their shipments to one of our boats down there and we make sure it gets to the Pandemonium!
translation: 这就是我们进来的地方！那些商人航行到风暴的南端，将他们的货物扔到我们那里的一艘船上，我们确保它到达混乱之地！ [zhe jiu shi wo men jin lai de di fang ！ na xie shang ren hang xing dao feng bao de nan duan ， jiang ta men de huo wu reng dao wo men na li de yi sou chuan shang ， wo men que bao ta dao da hun luan zhi di ！]

english: Makes sense to me, what's in it for you guys?
translation: 对我来说很有意义，对你们来说有什么意义？ [dui wo lai shuo hen you yi yi ， dui ni men lai shuo you shen me yi yi ？]

english: Why, the thrill of the sport! Sailing isn't just about going places, it's about mastery of the boat, the pull of the sails, the feeling of the tiller in your hand and the taste of rum in your mouth! *hic
translation: 为什么，这项运动的刺激！航海不仅仅是去某个地方，还在于对船的掌握、帆的拉力、手中舵柄的感​​觉以及嘴里朗姆酒的味道！ *嗝 [wei shen me ， zhe xiang yun dong de ci ji ！ hang hai bu jin jin shi qu mou ge di fang ， hai zai yu dui chuan de zhang wo 、 fan de la li 、 shou zhong duo bing de gan ​​ jue yi ji zui li lang mu jiu de wei dao ！ * ge]

english: Sailing as a sport? How does that work? What are the rules?
translation: 帆船作为一项运动？这是如何运作的？规则是什么？ [fan chuan zuo wei yi xiang yun dong ？ zhe shi ru he yun zuo de ？ gui ze shi shen me ？]

english: Sailing as a sport is what us Barracudas do, we have trials setup all across the sea where you can test your mettle against the clock.
translation: 帆船作为一项运动是我们梭子鱼所做的，我们在海上设有试验场，您可以在其中与时间赛跑，考验您的勇气。 [fan chuan zuo wei yi xiang yun dong shi wo men suo zi yu suo zuo de ， wo men zai hai shang she you shi yan chang ， nin ke yi zai qi zhong yu shi jian sai pao ， kao yan nin de yong qi 。]

english: I'm in charge of this here trial, the Tempor Tantrum.
translation: 我负责这里的审判，临时发脾气。 [wo fu ze zhe li de shen pan ， lin shi fa pi qi 。]

english: The objective is simple: Sail south, collect a rum shipment from our boat south of Tempoross and deliver it back to this boat here.
translation: 目标很简单：向南航行，从坦波罗斯以南的船上收集一批朗姆酒，然后将其运回到这里的这艘船上。 [mu biao hen jian dan ： xiang nan hang xing ， cong tan bo luo si yi nan de chuan shang shou ji yi pi lang mu jiu ， ran hou jiang qi yun hui dao zhe li de zhe sou chuan shang 。]

english: While you're out there, keep an eye out for any lost supplies aswell as they also determine your rank.
translation: 当你在外面时，请留意任何丢失的补给品，因为它们也决定了你的等级。 [dang ni zai wai mian shi ， qing liu yi ren he diu shi de bu ji pin ， yin wei ta men ye jue ding le ni de deng ji 。]

english: If you can deliver all the rum shipments and collect all the lost supplies in the time given, ye'll be awarded a barracuda rank!
translation: 如果您能在规定的时间内运送所有朗姆酒并收集所有丢失的补给品，您将获得梭鱼等级！ [ru guo nin neng zai gui ding de shi jian nei yun song suo you lang mu jiu bing shou ji suo you diu shi de bu ji pin ， nin jiang huo de suo yu deng ji ！]

english: Each trial has three ranks, Swordfish, Shark or Marlin and each rank is harder than the last.
translation: 每个试炼都有三个等级：剑鱼、鲨鱼或马林鱼，每个等级都比上一个更难。 [mei ge shi lian dou you san ge deng ji ： jian yu 、 sha yu huo ma lin yu ， mei ge deng ji dou bi shang yi ge geng nan 。]

english: For this trial you'll be asked to fetch additional rum shipments and collect even more lost supplies as the rank increases.
translation: 在这次试验中，您将被要求获取额外的朗姆酒货物，并随着等级的提高收集更多丢失的补给品。 [zai zhe ci shi yan zhong ， nin jiang bei yao qiu huo qu e wai de lang mu jiu huo wu ， bing sui zhe deng ji de ti gao shou ji geng duo diu shi de bu ji pin 。]

english: You can't attempt the next rank until you beat the one before it. You can also try unranked if you'd rather warm up your hands beforehand.
translation: 在击败前一个级别之前，您无法尝试下一个级别。如果您想提前热身，也可以尝试不排名。 [zai ji bai qian yi ge ji bie zhi qian ， nin wu fa chang shi xia yi ge ji bie 。 ru guo nin xiang ti qian re shen ， ye ke yi chang shi bu pai ming 。]

english: That said, with your Sailing experience I'd suggest sailing elsewhere for now and coming back when you've learned a thing or two.
translation: 也就是说，根据你的航海经验，我建议你暂时去其他地方航行，当你学到一两件事后再回来。 [ye jiu shi shuo ， gen ju ni de hang hai jing yan ， wo jian yi ni zan shi qu qi ta di fang hang xing ， dang ni xue dao yi liang jian shi hou zai hui lai 。]

english: Thanks for the advice, I'll bear that in mind.
translation: 谢谢你的建议，我会记住的。 [xie xie ni de jian yi ， wo hui ji zhu de 。]

english: Do you have any tips or tricks for me?
translation: 您有什么建议或技巧吗？ [nin you shen me jian yi huo ji qiao ma ？]

english: Sure do sailor!
translation: 当然是水手！ [dang ran shi shui shou ！]

english: First up! You're going to need a boat with at least an oak mast built in order to withstand the storm. Boats as good as a goner without that.
translation: 首先！你需要一艘至少有一根橡木桅杆的船来抵御风暴。没有这个，船就等于死了。 [shou xian ！ ni xu yao yi sou zhi shao you yi gen xiang mu wei gan de chuan lai di yu feng bao 。 mei you zhe ge ， chuan jiu deng yu si le 。]

english: Second! Your boat will also need to have at least an oak hull to withstand the rapids, but those that do will experience a burst of speed from travelling through them.
translation: 第二！您的船还需要至少有一个橡木船体来承受急流，但那些这样做的船会在穿过急流时体验到突然的速度。 [di er ！ nin de chuan hai xu yao zhi shao you yi ge xiang mu chuan ti lai cheng shou ji liu ， dan na xie zhe yang zuo de chuan hui zai chuan guo ji liu shi ti yan dao tu ran de su du 。]

english: The more rapids you go through without letting your speed drop off the faster you'll go!
translation: 您在不降低速度的情况下经历的急流越多，您就会走得越快！ [nin zai bu jiang di su du de qing kuang xia jing li de ji liu yue duo ， nin jiu hui zou de yue kuai ！]

english: Third! Avoid all lightning clouds and try to move as fast as you can, even with a strong mast they'll still slow you down.
translation: 第三！避开所有的闪电云并尝试尽可能快地移动，即使有坚固的桅杆，它们仍然会减慢你的速度。 [di san ！ bi kai suo you de shan dian yun bing chang shi jin ke neng kuai di yi dong ， ji shi you jian gu de wei gan ， ta men reng ran hui jian man ni de su du 。]

english: Fourth! Keep your sails trimmed to gain even more speed. This aint no shipwreck salvaging, go fast or go home.
translation: 第四！保持风帆收紧以获得更快的速度。这不是打捞沉船，要么快点要么回家。 [di si ！ bao chi feng fan shou jin yi huo de geng kuai de su du 。 zhe bu shi da lao chen chuan ， yao me kuai dian yao me hui jia 。]

english: Finally watch out for those rocks, hitting them will kill all of your boats momentum immediately.
translation: 最后要小心那些岩石，击中它们会立即消除你所有船只的动力。 [zui hou yao xiao xin na xie yan shi ， ji zhong ta men hui li ji xiao chu ni suo you chuan zhi de dong li 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Who are the Barracudas?
translation: 梭鱼是谁？ [suo yu shi shui ？]

english: I'd like to attempt the Tempor Tantrum.
translation: 我想尝试一下临时发脾气。 [wo xiang chang shi yi xia lin shi fa pi qi 。]

english: More options...
translation: 更多选择... [geng duo xuan ze ...]

english: Would you like to try some fine Miscellanian ale, your Royal Highness?
translation: 殿下，您想尝尝上等的杂色啤酒吗？ [dian xia ， nin xiang chang chang shang deng de za se pi jiu ma ？]

english: Well, I say Miscellanian, but it's actually brewed on the mainland.
translation: 嗯，我说的是Miscellanian，但实际上它是在大陆酿造的。 [n ， wo shuo de shi Miscellanian， dan shi ji shang ta shi zai da lu niang zao de 。]

english: Would you like to try some anyway?
translation: 你想尝试一下吗？ [ni xiang chang shi yi xia ma ？]

english: Yes, please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: What's it like living down here?
translation: 住在下面感觉怎么样？ [zhu zai xia mian gan jue zen me yang ？]

english: Business is booming!
translation: 生意兴隆！ [sheng yi xing long ！]

english: Now, if only I hadn't taken a loss with the beer I sold to those teenagers.
translation: 现在，如果我没有因为卖给那些青少年的啤酒而遭受损失就好了。 [xian zai ， ru guo wo mei you yin wei mai gei na xie qing shao nian de pi jiu er zao shou sun shi jiu hao le 。]

english: Yes, please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: What's it like living down here?
translation: 住在下面感觉怎么样？ [zhu zai xia mian gan jue zen me yang ？]

english: Pay-dirt!
translation: 支付污垢！ [zhi fu wu gou ！]

english: Ow!
Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Good day, your Royal Highness.
translation: 美好的一天，殿下。 [mei hao de yi tian ， dian xia 。]

english: Here, solve this.
translation: 来，解决这个问题。 [lai ， jie jue zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Runolf hands you a puzzlebox!
translation: 鲁诺夫递给你一个拼图盒！ [lu nuo fu di gei ni yi ge pin tu he ！]

english: That doesn't look solved to me.
translation: 在我看来这并没有解决。 [zai wo kan lai zhe bing mei you jie jue 。]

english: Well done [player name]. Here you go.
translation: 干得好[玩家姓名]。干得好。 [gan de hao [ wan jia xing ming ]。 gan de hao 。]

english: You've been given a [new clue/casket]!
translation: 你已经获得了[新线索/棺材]！ [ni yi jing huo de le [ xin xian suo / guan cai ]！]

english: Oh, leave an old dwarf in peace will you?
translation: 噢，让一个老矮人安息好吗？ [o ， rang yi ge lao ai ren an xi hao ma ？]

english: Why, what's wrong?
translation: 为什么，出了什么问题？ [wei shen me ， chu le shen me wen ti ？]

english: Ninenty years down in the mines, and this is all I got out of it. All my life wasted away.
translation: 在矿井里呆了九十年，这就是我从中得到的一切。我的一生都白费了。 [zai kuang jing li dai le jiu shi nian ， zhe jiu shi wo cong zhong de dao de yi qie 。 wo de yi sheng dou bai fei le 。]

english: You've still got a nice house, don't you?
translation: 你还有一栋漂亮的房子，不是吗？ [ni hai you yi dong piao liang de fang zi ， bu shi ma ？]

english: A crummy old house in East, that's all my life amounts to.
translation: 东部一栋破烂的老房子，这就是我的全部生活。 [dong bu yi dong po lan de lao fang zi ， zhe jiu shi wo de quan bu sheng huo 。]

english: I'll leave you alone then.
translation: 那我就不打扰你了。 [na wo jiu bu da rao ni le 。]

english: Hello again, old cheesecake! Wonderful to see you.
translation: 你好，老芝士蛋糕！很高兴见到你。 [ni hao ， lao zhi shi dan gao ！ hen gao xing jian dao ni 。]

english: How are the investigations going?
translation: 调查进展如何？ [diao cha jin zhan ru he ？]

english: Thanks to you freeing me, very well! I have much more to do of course, but now I am free, I can continue where I left off.
translation: 谢谢你释放了我，很好！当然，我还有很多事情要做，但现在我自由了，我可以从上次停下的地方继续。 [xie xie ni shi fang le wo ， hen hao ！ dang ran ， wo hai you hen duo shi qing yao zuo ， dan xian zai wo zi you le ， wo ke yi cong shang ci ting xia de di fang ji xu 。]

english: That's great news!
translation: 这是个好消息！ [zhe shi ge hao xiao xi ！]

english: Have you another helmet like the one you gave me?
translation: 你还有另一顶像你给我的那样的头盔吗？ [ni hai you ling yi ding xiang ni gei wo de na yang de tou kui ma ？]

english: You might be in luck, old bellybutton fluff - I have made replacements. You could have one for 60,000 coins - for the materials, you understand.
translation: 你可能很幸运，旧的肚脐绒毛——我已经做了替代品。你可以花 60,000 金币买一个——为了材料，你懂的。 [ni ke neng hen xing yun ， jiu de du qi rong mao —— wo yi jing zuo le ti dai pin 。 ni ke yi hua  60,000  jin bi mai yi ge —— wei le cai liao ， ni dong de 。]

english: I don't think I can afford that, sorry.
translation: 我想我负担不起，抱歉。 [wo xiang wo fu dan bu qi ， bao qian 。]

english: No problem! Come back and see me any time, old garters.
translation: 没问题！随时回来看我，老吊袜带。 [mei wen ti ！ sui shi hui lai kan wo ， lao diao wa dai 。]

english: How are the investigations going?
translation: 调查进展如何？ [diao cha jin zhan ru he ？]

english: Have you another helmet like the one you gave me?
translation: 你还有另一顶像你给我的那样的头盔吗？ [ni hai you ling yi ding xiang ni gei wo de na yang de tou kui ma ？]

english: Okay, that sounds fair.
translation: 好吧，这听起来很公平。 [hao ba ， zhe ting qi lai hen gong ping 。]

english: I don't think I can afford that, sorry.
translation: 我想我负担不起，抱歉。 [wo xiang wo fu dan bu qi ， bao qian 。]

english: Hiya. Are you carrying anything valuable?
translation: 嗨。你有带什么值钱的东西吗？ [hai 。 ni you dai shen me zhi qian de dong xi ma ？]

english: Why are you asking?
translation: 你为什么问？ [ni wei shen me wen ？]

english: Um... It's a quiz. I'm asking everyone I meet if they're carrying anything valuable.
translation: 嗯...这是一个测验。我会询问我遇到的每个人是否携带任何值钱的东西。 [n ... zhe shi yi ge ce yan 。 wo hui xun wen wo yu dao de mei ge ren shi fou xie dai ren he zhi qian de dong xi 。]

english: What would you do if I said I had loads of expensive items with me?
translation: 如果我说我有很多昂贵的物品，你会怎么做？ [ru guo wo shuo wo you hen duo ang gui de wu pin ， ni hui zen me zuo ？]

english: Ooh, do you? It's been ages since anyone said they'd got anything worth stealing.
translation: 哦，你是吗？已经很久没有人说过他们有值得偷的东西了。 [o ， ni shi ma ？ yi jing hen jiu mei you ren shuo guo ta men you zhi de tou de dong xi le 。]

english: 'Anything worth stealing'?
translation: “有什么值得偷的东西”？ [“ you shen me zhi de tou de dong xi ”？]

english: Um... Not that I'd dream of stealing anything!
translation: 嗯……并不是说我梦想着偷东西！ [n …… bing bu shi shuo wo meng xiang zhe tou dong xi ！]

english: Well, I'll say I'm not carrying anything valuable at all.
translation: 好吧，我会说我根本没有带任何值钱的东西。 [hao ba ， wo hui shuo wo gen ben mei you dai ren he zhi qian de dong xi 。]

english: Oh, what a shame.
translation: 噢，真可惜。 [o ， zhen ke xi 。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Why won't people leave me alone?!
translation: 为什么人们不肯放过我？！ [wei shen me ren men bu ken fang guo wo ？！]

english: Hello.!
translation: 你好。！ [ni hao 。！]

english: What?!
translation: 什么？！ [shen me ？！]

english: I'm looking for the guard that was on duty at the castle last night.
translation: 我正在寻找昨晚在城堡值班的守卫。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao zuo wan zai cheng bao zhi ban de shou wei 。]

english: Who?!
translation: WHO？！ [WHO？！]

english: Buzz off!
translation: 嘘！ [xu ！]

english: Do you know of another way up Death Plateau?
translation: 你知道通往死亡高原的另一条路吗？ [ni zhi dao tong wang si wang gao yuan de ling yi tiao lu ma ？]

english: Why would I want to go up there? I just want to be left in peace!
translation: 我为什么想去那里？我只想安静地待着！ [wo wei shen me xiang qu na li ？ wo zhi xiang an jing di dai zhe ！]

english: It used to be just humans trampling past my cave and making a racket. Now there's those blasted trolls too! Not only do they stink and argue with each other loudly but they are always fighting the humans.
translation: 以前只有人类踩过我的洞穴并发出喧闹声。现在还有那些该死的巨魔！它们不仅臭气熏天、大声争吵，而且总是与人类作战。 [yi qian zhi you ren lei cai guo wo de dong xue bing fa chu xuan nao sheng 。 xian zai hai you na xie gai si de ju mo ！ ta men bu jin chou qi xun tian 、 da sheng zheng chao ， er qie zong shi yu ren lei zuo zhan 。]

english: I just want to be left in peace!
translation: 我只想安静地待着！ [wo zhi xiang an jing di dai zhe ！]

english: Ah... I might be able to help you.
translation: 啊...我也许可以帮助你。 [a ... wo ye xu ke yi bang zhu ni 。]

english: How?!
translation: 如何？！ [ru he ？！]

english: I'm trying to help the...er...humans to reclaim back Death Plateau. If you help me then at least you'd be rid of the trolls.
translation: 我正在努力帮助……呃……人类夺回死亡高原。如果你帮我的话，至少你就能摆脱巨魔了。 [wo zheng zai nu li bang zhu …… e …… ren lei duo hui si wang gao yuan 。 ru guo ni bang wo de hua ， zhi shao ni jiu neng bai tuo ju mo le 。]

english: Hmph.
translation: 哼。 [heng 。]

english: Let me see...
translation: 让我看看... [rang wo kan kan ...]

english: I've only been up Death Plateau once to complain about the noise but those pesky trolls started throwing rocks at me!
translation: 我只去过死亡高原一次，抱怨噪音，但那些讨厌的巨魔就开始向我扔石头！ [wo zhi qu guo si wang gao yuan yi ci ， bao yuan zao yin ， dan na xie tao yan de ju mo jiu kai shi xiang wo reng shi tou ！]

english: Before the trolls came there used to be a nettlesome Sherpa that took humans exploring or something equally stupid. Perhaps he'd know another way.
translation: 在巨魔到来之前，曾经有一个令人讨厌的夏尔巴人带着人类去探索或者做同样愚蠢的事情。也许他会知道另一种方式。 [zai ju mo dao lai zhi qian ， ceng jing you yi ge ling ren tao yan de xia er ba ren dai zhe ren lei qu tan suo huo zhe zuo tong yang yu chun de shi qing 。 ye xu ta hui zhi dao ling yi zhong fang shi 。]

english: Where does this Sherpa live?
translation: 这位夏尔巴人住在哪里？ [zhe wei xia er ba ren zhu zai na li ？]

english: I don't know but it can't be far as he used to be around all the time!
translation: 我不知道，但肯定不会像他以前一直在身边那样远！ [wo bu zhi dao ， dan ken ding bu hui xiang ta yi qian yi zhi zai shen bian na yang yuan ！]

english: Nothing, sorry!
translation: 没什么，抱歉！ [mei shen me ， bao qian ！]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Have you got rid of those pesky trolls yet?
translation: 你摆脱那些讨厌的巨魔了吗？ [ni bai tuo na xie tao yan de ju mo le ma ？]

english: Where did you say this Sherpa was?
translation: 你说这个夏尔巴人在哪里？ [ni shuo zhe ge xia er ba ren zai na li ？]

english: I dunno but he must live around here somewhere!

translation: 是的。信息亭的那个人告诉我的。 [shi de 。 xin xi ting de na ge ren gao su wo de 。]

english: Hi!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Hi. How can I help?
translation: 你好。我能提供什么帮助吗？ [ni hao 。 wo neng ti gong shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: Can you heal me?
translation: 你能治愈我吗？ [ni neng zhi yu wo ma ？]

translation: 抱歉，我没有值班。 [bao qian ， wo mei you zhi ban 。]

translation: 请不要杀我！ [qing bu yao sha wo ！]

english: I was... looking to be healed.

english: No way, I'm out of here just as soon as I've packed up my stuff!
translation: 没办法，我收拾好东西就走了！ [mei ban fa ， wo shou shi hao dong xi jiu zou le ！]

english: Yes I do. Thankfully we can cope with almost anything. Jaraah really is a wonderful surgeon, his methods are a little unorthodox but he gets the job done.
translation: 是的，我愿意。值得庆幸的是，我们几乎可以应对任何事情。 Jaraah 确实是一位出色的外科医生，他的方法有点非正统，但他完成了工作。 [shi de ， wo yuan yi 。 zhi de qing xing de shi ， wo men ji hu ke yi ying dui ren he shi qing 。 Jaraah  que shi shi yi wei chu se de wai ke yi sheng ， ta de fang fa you dian fei zheng tong ， dan ta wan cheng le gong zuo 。]

english: I shouldn't tell you this but his nickname is 'The Butcher'.

english: That's reassuring.
translation: 这让人放心。 [zhe rang ren fang xin 。]

english: Do you come here often?

english: I work here, so yes!
translation: 我在这里工作，所以是的！ [wo zai zhe li gong zuo ， suo yi shi de ！]

english: You're silly!

translation: 你能治愈我吗？ [ni neng zhi yu wo ma ？]

english: Do you see a lot of injured fighters?
translation: 你看到很多受伤的战士吗？ [ni kan dao hen duo shou shang de zhan shi ma ？]

english: Do you come here often?
translation: 你经常来这里吗？ [ni jing chang lai zhe li ma ？]

english: The High Priestess says you're to be the sacrifice instead of me. I was so looking forward to meeting Zulrah.
translation: 女祭司说你将代替我成为牺牲品。我非常期待见到祖拉。 [nv ji si shuo ni jiang dai ti wo cheng wei xi sheng pin 。 wo fei chang qi dai jian dao zu la 。]

english: Don't you understand that I've saved your life?
translation: 难道你不明白我救了你的命吗？ [nan dao ni bu ming bai wo jiu le ni de ming ma ？]

english: In death, the nutrients of my lowly body were destined to nourish the mighty Zulrah. I would have become one with my god.
translation: 在死亡中，我卑微的身体的养分注定会滋养强大的祖拉。我会与我的神合而为一。 [zai si wang zhong ， wo bei wei de shen ti de yang fen zhu ding hui zi yang qiang da de zu la 。 wo hui yu wo de shen he er wei yi 。]

english: Still, it is nice to live a little longer. Thank you for what you have done.
translation: 不过，能活得久一点还是很高兴的。感谢您所做的一切。 [bu guo ， neng huo de jiu yi dian hai shi hen gao xing de 。 gan xie nin suo zuo de yi qie 。]

english: I'm sorry.
translation: 对不起。 [dui bu qi 。]

english: While I am saddened that my destiny has not been fulfilled, it is nice to live a little longer. Thank you for what you have done.
translation: 虽然我为自己的命运没有实现而感到难过，但能活得久一点也很好。感谢您所做的一切。 [sui ran wo wei zi ji de ming yun mei you shi xian er gan dao nan guo ， dan neng huo de jiu yi dian ye hen hao 。 gan xie nin suo zuo de yi qie 。]

english: I am the chosen one. Soon I shall meet Zulrah face-to- face, and my sacrifice shall fulfil the sacred contract that protects our tribe.
translation: 我是被选中的人。很快我将与祖拉面对面，我的牺牲将履行保护我们部落的神圣契约。 [wo shi bei xuan zhong de ren 。 hen kuai wo jiang yu zu la mian dui mian ， wo de xi sheng jiang lv xing bao hu wo men bu luo de shen sheng qi yue 。]

english: In death, the nutrients of my lowly body shall nourish the mighty Zulrah. I shall become one with my god.
translation: 死亡后，我卑微的身体的营养将滋养强大的祖拉。我将与我的神合而为一。 [si wang hou ， wo bei wei de shen ti de ying yang jiang zi yang qiang da de zu la 。 wo jiang yu wo de shen he er wei yi 。]

english: Can I go and confront Zulrah myself?

translation: 各种各样的事情！这些塔楼是一个美妙的景观。 [ge zhong ge yang de shi qing ！ zhe xie ta lou shi yi ge mei miao de jing guan 。]

translation: 在像今天这样的日子，我建议您参观市场。 [zai xiang jin tian zhe yang de ri zi ， wo jian yi nin can guan shi chang 。]

translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I's been making da machetes for Gabooty's shop Bwana!
translation: 我一直在为 Gabooty 的 Bwana 商店制作砍刀！ [wo yi zhi zai wei  Gabooty  de  Bwana  shang dian zhi zuo kan dao ！]

english: If you want me to make you a machete we can do a deal if you like.
translation: 如果你想让我给你做一把砍刀，如果你愿意的话我们可以做一笔交易。 [ru guo ni xiang rang wo gei ni zuo yi ba kan dao ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua wo men ke yi zuo yi bi jiao yi 。]

english: Yes, I'd like to get a machete.
translation: 是的，我想要一把砍刀。 [shi de ， wo xiang yao yi ba kan dao 。]

english: Ok Bwana, here's the deal. There are three gem bladed machete types, in order of quality and hacking proficiency, they're ordered from low to high as follows.
translation: 好吧，布瓦纳，事情就是这样。宝石刃砍刀共有三种类型，按照品质和砍伐熟练度的顺序，从低到高排列如下。 [hao ba ， bu wa na ， shi qing jiu shi zhe yang 。 bao shi ren kan dao gong you san zhong lei xing ， an zhao pin zhi he kan fa shu lian du de shun xu ， cong di dao gao pai lie ru xia 。]

english: Ok Bwana, if you want to order the opal machete, I need 3 opals, either cut or uncut, 1 gout plant tuber and 300 trading sticks please.
translation: 好的，Bwana，如果您想订购蛋白石砍刀，我需要 3 颗蛋白石（切割或未切割）、1 个痛风植物块茎和 300 根交易棒。 [hao de ，Bwana， ru guo nin xiang ding gou dan bai shi kan dao ， wo xu yao  3  ke dan bai shi （ qie ge huo wei qie ge ）、1  ge tong feng zhi wu kuai jing he  300  gen jiao yi bang 。]

english: I don't have enough trading sticks, sorry.
translation: 我没有足够的交易棒，抱歉。 [wo mei you zu gou de jiao yi bang ， bao qian 。]

english: Ok Bwana, come back when you have them.
translation: 好吧，布瓦纳，当你拿到它们时就回来。 [hao ba ， bu wa na ， dang ni na dao ta men shi jiu hui lai 。]

english: Ok Bwana, if you want to order the Jade machete, I need 3 jades, either cut or uncut, 1 gout plant tuber and 600 trading sticks please.
translation: 好的，Bwana，如果您想订购玉石砍刀，我需要 3 块玉石，无论是切割的还是未切割的，1 个痛风植物块茎和 600 根交易棒。 [hao de ，Bwana， ru guo nin xiang ding gou yu shi kan dao ， wo xu yao  3  kuai yu shi ， wu lun shi qie ge de hai shi wei qie ge de ，1  ge tong feng zhi wu kuai jing he  600  gen jiao yi bang 。]

english: Ok Bwana, if you want to order the Red Topaz machete, I need 3 Red Topaz, either cut or uncut, 1 gout plant tuber and 1200 trading sticks please.
translation: 好的，Bwana，如果您想订购红黄玉弯刀，我需要 3 块红黄玉，无论是切割的还是未切割的，1 个痛风植物块茎和 1200 个交易棒。 [hao de ，Bwana， ru guo nin xiang ding gou hong huang yu wan dao ， wo xu yao  3  kuai hong huang yu ， wu lun shi qie ge de hai shi wei qie ge de ，1  ge tong feng zhi wu kuai jing he  1200  ge jiao yi bang 。]

english: So Bwana, do you like the look of the machetes?
translation: 那么 Bwana，你喜欢砍刀的外观吗？ [na me  Bwana， ni xi huan kan dao de wai guan ma ？]

english: Why do you need gems?
translation: 为什么需要宝石？ [wei shen me xu yao bao shi ？]

english: They're tougher than just metal on its own, plus it's the only such resource naturally available in this region.
translation: 它们比金属本身更坚硬，而且它是该地区唯一天然存在的此类资源。 [ta men bi jin shu ben shen geng jian ying ， er qie ta shi gai di qu wei yi tian ran cun zai de ci lei zi yuan 。]

english: Why do you need a gout plant tuber?
translation: 为什么需要痛风植物块茎？ [wei shen me xu yao tong feng zhi wu kuai jing ？]

english: It's one of the harder to find resources which I mix with other ingredients in order to bind the ground down gem dust to the surface of the metal bladed machete.
translation: 这是最难找到的资源之一，我将其与其他成分混合，以便将磨碎的宝石粉末粘合到金属刀片砍刀的表面。 [zhe shi zui nan zhao dao de zi yuan zhi yi ， wo jiang qi yu qi ta cheng fen hun he ， yi bian jiang mo sui de bao shi fen mo zhan he dao jin shu dao pian kan dao de biao mian 。]

english: You can sometimes, if you're lucky, find the plant if you hack away at the jungle around here. You'll need to find a way to dig up the tubers though, they're the important part of the plant.
translation: 如果你幸运的话，有时你可以在附近的丛林中砍伐，找到这种植物。不过，你需要找到一种方法来挖出块茎，它们是植物的重要组成部分。 [ru guo ni xing yun de hua ， you shi ni ke yi zai fu jin de cong lin zhong kan fa ， zhao dao zhe zhong zhi wu 。 bu guo ， ni xu yao zhao dao yi zhong fang fa lai wa chu kuai jing ， ta men shi zhi wu de zhong yao zu cheng bu fen 。]

english: Why is it so expensive?
translation: 为什么这么贵？ [wei shen me zhe me gui ？]

english: Expensive bwana, it's quite reasonably priced if you ask me. I can make it cheaper than Gabooty charges for it, that's for sure. And after all, I have to earn a living around here as well you know, I have children to feed!
translation: 昂贵的bwana，如果你问我的话，价格相当合理。我可以让它比 Gabooty 的收费更便宜，这是肯定的。毕竟，我也必须在这里谋生，你知道，我还有孩子要养活！ [ang gui de bwana， ru guo ni wen wo de hua ， jia ge xiang dang he li 。 wo ke yi rang ta bi  Gabooty  de shou fei geng pian yi ， zhe shi ken ding de 。 bi jing ， wo ye bi xu zai zhe li mou sheng ， ni zhi dao ， wo hai you hai zi yao yang huo ！]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: No thanks, I have to go.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我得走了。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo de zou le 。]

english: Is there anything interesting to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么好玩的吗？ [zhe fu jin you shen me hao wan de ma ？]

english: Not that I'm aware of, just sit back and enjoy the sunshine bwana!
translation: 我不知道，只是坐下来享受阳光 bwana！ [wo bu zhi dao ， zhi shi zuo xia lai xiang shou yang guang  bwana！]

english: Bwana, if anyone else asks me that question today, I'll explode! Go and ask someone else!
translation: Bwana，如果今天还有人问我这个问题，我会爆炸的！你去问问别人吧！ [Bwana， ru guo jin tian hai you ren wen wo zhe ge wen ti ， wo hui bao zha de ！ ni qu wen wen bie ren ba ！]

english: It's just village life as normal around here Bwana, always something interesting to find to occupy your time if you look hard enough.
translation: 布瓦纳（Bwana）这里的乡村生活一如往常，只要您仔细观察，总能找到一些有趣的东西来打发您的时间。 [bu wa na （Bwana） zhe li de xiang cun sheng huo yi ru wang chang ， zhi yao nin zi xi guan cha ， zong neng zhao dao yi xie you qu de dong xi lai da fa nin de shi jian 。]

english: Sorry Bwana, I'm already busy, why not go and talk to Murcaily! He's around the village somewhere.
translation: 抱歉 Bwana，我已经很忙了，为什么不去和 Murcaily 谈谈呢！他就在村子附近的某个地方。 [bao qian  Bwana， wo yi jing hen mang le ， wei shen me bu qu he  Murcaily  tan tan ne ！ ta jiu zai cun zi fu jin de mou ge di fang 。]

english: Well, I think that there's some work to be done...perhaps Murcaily can help you. He usually tends to the hardwood grove to the east of Trufitus's hut.
translation: 嗯，我认为还有一些工作要做……也许 Murcaily 可以帮助你。他通常照料特鲁菲特斯小屋东边的硬木树林。 [n ， wo ren wei hai you yi xie gong zuo yao zuo …… ye xu  Murcaily  ke yi bang zhu ni 。 ta tong chang zhao liao te lu fei te si xiao wu dong bian de ying mu shu lin 。]

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 我一直在村里做一些工作。 [wo yi zhi zai cun li zuo yi xie gong zuo 。]

english: I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: 我已经给了你一些交易棒，现在我身上没有了。为什么不去和其他一些村民谈谈并获得一些捐款呢？ [wo yi jing gei le ni yi xie jiao yi bang ， xian zai wo shen shang mei you le 。 wei shen me bu qu he qi ta yi xie cun min tan tan bing huo de yi xie juan kuan ne ？]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Yes, I'd like to get a machete.
translation: 是的，我想要一把砍刀。 [shi de ， wo xiang yao yi ba kan dao 。]

english: Opal machete.
translation: 蛋白石砍刀。 [dan bai shi kan dao 。]

english: Order the Opal machete.
translation: 订购蛋白石砍刀。 [ding gou dan bai shi kan dao 。]

english: Go back to machete descriptions
translation: 返回砍刀描述 [fan hui kan dao miao shu]

english: Jade machete.
translation: 玉砍刀。 [yu kan dao 。]

english: Order the Jade machete.
translation: 订购玉砍刀。 [ding gou yu kan dao 。]

english: Red Topaz machete.
translation: 红色托帕石砍刀。 [hong se tuo pa shi kan dao 。]

english: Order the Red Topaz machete.
translation: 订购红黄玉砍刀。 [ding gou hong huang yu kan dao 。]

english: Talk to Safta-doc
translation: 与 Safta 医生交谈 [yu  Safta  yi sheng jiao tan]

english: Why do you need gems?
translation: 为什么需要宝石？ [wei shen me xu yao bao shi ？]

english: Why do you need a gout plant tuber?
translation: 为什么需要痛风植物块茎？ [wei shen me xu yao tong feng zhi wu kuai jing ？]

english: Why is it so expensive?
translation: 为什么这么贵？ [wei shen me zhe me gui ？]

english: Let me see the machetes again.
translation: 让我再看看砍刀。 [rang wo zai kan kan kan dao 。]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: No thanks, but I'd like to ask another question.
translation: 不，谢谢，但我想问另一个问题。 [bu ， xie xie ， dan wo xiang wen ling yi ge wen ti 。]

english: No thanks, I have to go.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我得走了。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo de zou le 。]

english: Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: 这里有什么有趣的事情可以做吗？ [zhe li you shen me you qu de shi qing ke yi zuo ma ？]

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 我一直在村里做一些工作。 [wo yi zhi zai cun li zuo yi xie gong zuo 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hi, can I help you with something?
translation: 您好，有什么可以帮您的吗？ [nin hao ， you shen me ke yi bang nin de ma ？]

english: You're not from around here are you?
translation: 你不是这附近的人吧？ [ni bu shi zhe fu jin de ren ba ？]

english: Why do you say that?
translation: 为什么这么说？ [wei shen me zhe me shuo ？]

english: Well your accent for one sounds a little funny, and you seem to have a little more colour than most dwarves.
translation: 嗯，你的口音听起来有点滑稽，而且你似乎比大多数矮人更有色彩。 [n ， ni de kou yin ting qi lai you dian hua ji ， er qie ni si hu bi da duo shu ai ren geng you se cai 。]

english: Living under a mountain isn't the best way to get a tan. No I'm not from around here. I was born and worked most my life in the desert.
translation: 住在山下并不是晒黑皮肤的最佳方式。不，我不是这附近的人。我在沙漠中出生并工作了大半辈子。 [zhu zai shan xia bing bu shi shai hei pi fu de zui jia fang shi 。 bu ， wo bu shi zhe fu jin de ren 。 wo zai sha mo zhong chu sheng bing gong zuo le da ban bei zi 。]

english: Just even thinking of the place makes me thirsty. Now can I help you with anything?
translation: 光是想到这个地方我就感到口渴。现在我可以帮你什么忙吗？ [guang shi xiang dao zhe ge di fang wo jiu gan dao kou ke 。 xian zai wo ke yi bang ni shen me mang ma ？]

english: So how do these rat pits work?
translation: 那么这些老鼠坑是如何运作的呢？ [na me zhe xie lao shu keng shi ru he yun zuo de ne ？]

english: The Keldagrim pits cater for those with the larger variety of cats.
translation: 凯尔达格里姆猫坑适合那些拥有更多种类猫的人。 [kai er da ge li mu mao keng shi he na xie yong you geng duo zhong lei mao de ren 。]

english: If you have an overgrown cat and a couple of coins you can challenge someone else who also has an overgrown cat and some spare change.
translation: 如果您有一只过大的猫和几枚硬币，您可以挑战其他也有一只过大的猫和一些零钱的人。 [ru guo nin you yi zhi guo da de mao he ji mei ying bi ， nin ke yi tiao zhan qi ta ye you yi zhi guo da de mao he yi xie ling qian de ren 。]

english: That sounds simple enough so far.
translation: 到目前为止，这听起来很简单。 [dao mu qian wei zhi ， zhe ting qi lai hen jian dan 。]

english: You then agree on a wager. It's rumoured that some ratcatchers can talk to their own cats and give them tactics to aid them.
translation: 然后你们同意打赌。有传言说，一些捕鼠者可以与自己的猫交谈，并向它们提供帮助它们的策略。 [ran hou ni men tong yi da du 。 you chuan yan shuo ， yi xie bu shu zhe ke yi yu zi ji de mao jiao tan ， bing xiang ta men ti gong bang zhu ta men de ce lve 。]

english: So then how do you win the challenge?
translation: 那么如何赢得挑战呢？ [na me ru he ying de tiao zhan ne ？]

english: I was just getting to that. Both the challengers' cats are placed inside the arena, and whichever kills 9 rats first wins.
translation: 我刚刚谈到这一点。挑战者的两只猫都被放置在竞技场内，先杀死 9 只老鼠的一方获胜。 [wo gang gang tan dao zhe yi dian 。 tiao zhan zhe de liang zhi mao dou bei fang zhi zai jing ji chang nei ， xian sha si  9  zhi lao shu de yi fang huo sheng 。]

english: That sounds vile and cruel.
translation: 这听上去卑鄙又残忍。 [zhe ting shang qu bei bi you can ren 。]

english: It's a cruel world and the pits are no exception.
translation: 这是一个残酷的世界，坑也不例外。 [zhe shi yi ge can ku de shi jie ， keng ye bu li wai 。]

english: Each to their own, I say.
translation: 我说，各有各的。 [wo shuo ， ge you ge de 。]

english: Thanks for your help.
translation: 感谢您的帮助。 [gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]

english: It sounds a little dangerous for my cat.
translation: 听起来对我的猫来说有点危险。 [ting qi lai dui wo de mao lai shuo you dian wei xian 。]

english: I agree. Cats have been known to be killed in fights.
translation: 我同意。众所周知，猫会在打斗中被杀死。 [wo tong yi 。 zhong suo zhou zhi ， mao hui zai da dou zhong bei sha si 。]

english: Oh how terrible. Is there nothing you can do to save your cat?
translation: 噢，多么可怕啊。你无能为力拯救你的猫吗？ [o ， duo me ke pa a 。 ni wu neng wei li zheng jiu ni de mao ma ？]

english: Of course there is, you can instruct it to be cautious, and it will leave once it feels as if it is in danger.
translation: 当然有，你可以让它小心一点，它感觉有危险就会离开。 [dang ran you ， ni ke yi rang ta xiao xin yi dian ， ta gan jue you wei xian jiu hui li kai 。]

english: Oh that sounds quite wise.
translation: 哦，这听起来很明智。 [o ， zhe ting qi lai hen ming zhi 。]

english: That depends on how you value your cat.
translation: 这取决于你如何评价你的猫。 [zhe qu jue yu ni ru he ping jia ni de mao 。]

english: Sorry, I don't follow.
translation: 抱歉，我不跟。 [bao qian ， wo bu gen 。]

english: Well if your cat dies or it runs away you lose.
translation: 好吧，如果你的猫死了或者逃跑了，你就输了。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni de mao si le huo zhe tao pao le ， ni jiu shu le 。]

english: So the longer it stays in the fight the better chance you have of winning.
translation: 因此，它在战斗中停留的时间越长，您获胜的机会就越大。 [yin ci ， ta zai zhan dou zhong ting liu de shi jian yue zhang ， nin huo sheng de ji hui jiu yue da 。]

english: Wow that sounds like fun!
translation: 哇，听起来很有趣！ [wa ， ting qi lai hen you qu ！]

english: I don't know about that.
translation: 我对此一无所知。 [wo dui ci yi wu suo zhi 。]

english: One thing I know though is that it's a quick way to make and lose money.
translation: 但我知道的一件事是，这是一种快速赚钱和赔钱的方法。 [dan wo zhi dao de yi jian shi shi ， zhe shi yi zhong kuai su zhuan qian he pei qian de fang fa 。]

english: Is there a limit to how much you can bet?
translation: 您可以下注的金额有限制吗？ [nin ke yi xia zhu de jin e you xian zhi ma ？]

english: Hmmm... let me think. I don't think that's ever arisen but I think it's 20,000.
translation: 嗯……让我想想。我认为这种情况从未出现过，但我认为有 20,000 个。 [n …… rang wo xiang xiang 。 wo ren wei zhe zhong qing kuang cong wei chu xian guo ， dan wo ren wei you  20,000  ge 。]

english: Hmm, that sounds like a silly amount of money to bet on a cat fight.
translation: 嗯，这听起来像是在猫打架上押注的一大笔钱。 [n ， zhe ting qi lai xiang shi zai mao da jia shang ya zhu de yi da bi qian 。]

english: You'd be surprised what some people would be willing to bet.
translation: 你会对有些人愿意下注感到惊讶。 [ni hui dui you xie ren yuan yi xia zhu gan dao jing ya 。]

english: There is a minimum bet of 100 coins too.
translation: 最低赌注也为 100 个硬币。 [zui di du zhu ye wei  100  ge ying bi 。]

english: Can I challenge you and your cat?
translation: 我可以挑战你和你的猫吗？ [wo ke yi tiao zhan ni he ni de mao ma ？]

english: No, not now, we don't really bet with outsiders.
translation: 不，现在不行，我们真的不跟外人打赌。 [bu ， xian zai bu xing ， wo men zhen de bu gen wai ren da du 。]

english: But I'm not an outsider, am I not inside in the pits now?
translation: 但我不是外人，我现在不是在坑里吗？ [dan wo bu shi wai ren ， wo xian zai bu shi zai keng li ma ？]

english: I don't know, maybe once you've done something to win over my trust.
translation: 我不知道，也许一旦你做了一些事情来赢得我的信任。 [wo bu zhi dao ， ye xu yi dan ni zuo le yi xie shi qing lai ying de wo de xin ren 。]

english: Can it be bought?
translation: 可以买吗？ [ke yi mai ma ？]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: Your trust.
translation: 您的信任。 [nin de xin ren 。]

english: No. Regular townsfolk don't like us, which leads us to distrust them and anyone else.
translation: 不。普通城镇居民不喜欢我们，这导致我们不信任他们和其他任何人。 [bu 。 pu tong cheng zhen ju min bu xi huan wo men ， zhe dao zhi wo men bu xin ren ta men he qi ta ren he ren 。]

english: That sounds vile and cruel.
translation: 这听上去卑鄙又残忍。 [zhe ting shang qu bei bi you can ren 。]

english: One more thing...
translation: 还有一件事... [hai you yi jian shi ...]

english: Thanks for your help.
translation: 感谢您的帮助。 [gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]

english: It sounds a little dangerous for my cat.
translation: 听起来对我的猫来说有点危险。 [ting qi lai dui wo de mao lai shuo you dian wei xian 。]

english: Wow that sounds like fun.
translation: 哇，听起来很有趣。 [wa ， ting qi lai hen you qu 。]

english: Is there a limit to how much you can bet?
translation: 您可以下注的金额有限制吗？ [nin ke yi xia zhu de jin e you xian zhi ma ？]

english: Can I challenge you and your cat?
translation: 我可以挑战你和你的猫吗？ [wo ke yi tiao zhan ni he ni de mao ma ？]

english: Hiya.
translation: 嗨。 [hai 。]

english: Don't talk to me outerlander. I need to fix this longboat. Go talk to the chieftain.
translation: 别跟我这个外地人说话。我需要修理这艘长艇。去跟酋长说话吧 [bie gen wo zhe ge wai di ren shuo hua 。 wo xu yao xiu li zhe sou zhang ting 。 qu gen qiu zhang shuo hua ba]

english: Hi. Are you a member of the council?
translation: 你好。您是理事会成员吗？ [ni hao 。 nin shi li shi hui cheng yuan ma ？]

english: Nope. I'm just a sailor.
translation: 没有。我只是一名水手。 [mei you 。 wo zhi shi yi ming shui shou 。]

english: Fair enough.
translation: 很公平。 [hen gong ping 。]

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a rare flower from across the sea, do you?
translation: 我想你不知道我在哪里可以找到来自大洋彼岸的稀有花朵，是吗？ [wo xiang ni bu zhi dao wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao lai zi da yang bi an de xi you hua duo ， shi ma ？]

english: Ah! Even the outerlanders have heard of my mysterious flower! I found it in a country far far away from here!
translation: 啊!连外地人都听说过我的神秘花！我在离这里很远的国家找到了它！ [a ! lian wai di ren dou ting shuo guo wo de shen mi hua ！ wo zai li zhe li hen yuan de guo jia zhao dao le ta ！]

english: Can I buy it from you?
translation: 我可以向你购买吗？ [wo ke yi xiang ni gou mai ma ？]

english: I'm afraid not, outerlander. There is a woman in this village whose heart I seek to capture, and I think giving her this strange flower might be my best bet with her.
translation: 恐怕不是，外地人。这个村子里有一个女人，我想俘获她的心，我想给她这朵奇怪的花可能是我和她最好的选择。 [kong pa bu shi ， wai di ren 。 zhe ge cun zi li you yi ge nv ren ， wo xiang fu huo ta de xin ， wo xiang gei ta zhe duo qi guai de hua ke neng shi wo he ta zui hao de xuan ze 。]

english: Maybe you could let me have the flower and do something else to impress her?
translation: 也许你可以让我拥有这朵花，然后做点别的事情来打动她？ [ye xu ni ke yi rang wo yong you zhe duo hua ， ran hou zuo dian bie de shi qing lai da dong ta ？]

english: Hmm... that is not a totally stupid idea outerlander. I know she is a lover of music, and a romantic ballad might be just the thing with which to woo her.
translation: 嗯……这并不是一个完全愚蠢的想法。我知道她是一位音乐爱好者，一首浪漫的民谣可能正是吸引她的地方。 [n …… zhe bing bu shi yi ge wan quan yu chun de xiang fa 。 wo zhi dao ta shi yi wei yin yue ai hao zhe ， yi shou lang man de min yao ke neng zheng shi xi yin ta de di fang 。]

english: Unfortunately I don't have a musical bone in my entire body, so someone else will have to write it for me.
translation: 不幸的是我全身没有音乐骨头，所以必须由其他人为我写。 [bu xing de shi wo quan shen mei you yin yue gu tou ， suo yi bi xu you qi ta ren wei wo xie 。]

english: So if I can find someone to write you a romantic ballad, you will give me your flower?
translation: 那么如果我能找到人给你写一首浪漫的歌谣，你会把你的花送给我吗？ [na me ru guo wo neng zhao dao ren gei ni xie yi shou lang man de ge yao ， ni hui ba ni de hua song gei wo ma ？]

english: That sounds like a fair deal to me, outerlander.
translation: 这对我来说听起来很公平，外来者。 [zhe dui wo lai shuo ting qi lai hen gong ping ， wai lai zhe 。]

english: Ask about the Merchant's trial
translation: 询问商家试用情况 [xun wen shang jia shi yong qing kuang]

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a love ballad, do you?
translation: 我想你不知道我在哪里可以找到情歌，是吗？ [wo xiang ni bu zhi dao wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao qing ge ， shi ma ？]

english: Well, the only musician I know of in these parts would be that terrible bard Olaf... ask him.
translation: 好吧，我所知道的这些地方唯一的音乐家就是那个可怕的吟游诗人奥拉夫……去问他吧。 [hao ba ， wo suo zhi dao de zhe xie di fang wei yi de yin yue jia jiu shi na ge ke pa de yin you shi ren ao la fu …… qu wen ta ba 。]

english: You'll be glad to know I have had a love song written just for you by Olaf. So can I have that flower of yours now?
translation: 你会很高兴知道我有一首奥拉夫专门为你写的情歌。那么我现在可以拥有你的那朵花吗？ [ni hui hen gao xing zhi dao wo you yi shou ao la fu zhuan men wei ni xie de qing ge 。 na me wo xian zai ke yi yong you ni de na duo hua ma ？]

english: Oh. It's by Olaf? Hmm. Well, a deal's a deal. I just hope it's better than the usual rubbish he comes up with, or my chances are worse than ever.
translation: 哦。是奥拉夫写的吗？唔。好吧，成交就是成交。我只是希望这比他通常提出的垃圾更好，否则我的机会比以往任何时候都更糟。 [o 。 shi ao la fu xie de ma ？ wu 。 hao ba ， cheng jiao jiu shi cheng jiao 。 wo zhi shi xi wang zhe bi ta tong chang ti chu de la ji geng hao ， fou ze wo de ji hui bi yi wang ren he shi hou dou geng zao 。]

english: so tell me... who is this woman that you are trying to impress anyway?
translation: 所以告诉我...你想给她留下深刻印象的这个女人是谁？ [suo yi gao su wo ... ni xiang gei ta liu xia shen ke yin xiang de zhe ge nv ren shi shui ？]

english: It's Thora, the longhall barkeep. Please don't tell her though. She's not like the rest of the Fremennik girls, she has a secret desire to see the world.
translation: 我是长厅酒保索拉。但请不要告诉她。她与其他弗雷曼尼克女孩不同，她有一个想要看看世界的秘密愿望。 [wo shi zhang ting jiu bao suo la 。 dan qing bu yao gao su ta 。 ta yu qi ta fu lei man ni ke nv hai bu tong ， ta you yi ge xiang yao kan kan shi jie de mi mi yuan wang 。]

translation: 您可以使用右键单击选项在游戏室的任何位置向某人发起游戏挑战。选择游戏类型，然后选择您想要的选项，例如每次移动的时间。如果你想玩某个特定的游戏 [nin ke yi shi yong you jian dan ji xuan xiang zai you xi shi de ren he wei zhi xiang mou ren fa qi you xi tiao zhan 。 xuan ze you xi lei xing ， ran hou xuan ze nin xiang yao de xuan xiang ， li ru mei ci yi dong de shi jian 。 ru guo ni xiang wan mou ge te ding de you xi]

english: Currently we offer Draughts, Runelink, Runesquares, and Runeversi.
translation: 目前我们提供跳棋、符文链接、符文方块和符文西。 [mu qian wo men ti gong tiao qi 、 fu wen lian jie 、 fu wen fang kuai he fu wen xi 。]

english: Draughts?
translation: 跳水？ [tiao shui ？]

english: Draughts uses standard rules, apart from: a draw is declared if no piece has been taken or promoted for forty moves. To play Draughts go to the challenge room in the SW corner.
translation: 跳棋使用标准规则，除此之外：如果四十步棋没有被吃或晋级，则宣布平局。要玩跳棋，请前往西南角的挑战室。 [tiao qi shi yong biao zhun gui ze ， chu ci zhi wai ： ru guo si shi bu qi mei you bei chi huo jin ji ， ze xuan bu ping ju 。 yao wan tiao qi ， qing qian wang xi nan jiao de tiao zhan shi 。]

english: Runelink?
translation: 符文链接？ [fu wen lian jie ？]

english: Yup, you have to get four runes in row. The challenge room for Runelink is in the SE corner.
translation: 是的，你必须排成四个符文。符文链接的挑战室位于东南角。 [shi de ， ni bi xu pai cheng si ge fu wen 。 fu wen lian jie de tiao zhan shi wei yu dong nan jiao 。]

english: Runesquares?
translation: 符文方块？ [fu wen fang kuai ？]

english: Yes, you take it in turns to add a line with the goal of making squares. Everytime you make a square you take another turn. The challenge room for Runesquares is in the SW corner.
translation: 是的，你轮流添加一条线，目的是形成正方形。每次你形成一个正方形，你就需要再转一次。 Runesquares 的挑战室位于西南角。 [shi de ， ni lun liu tian jia yi tiao xian ， mu di shi xing cheng zheng fang xing 。 mei ci ni xing cheng yi ge zheng fang xing ， ni jiu xu yao zai zhuan yi ci 。 Runesquares  de tiao zhan shi wei yu xi nan jiao 。]

english: Runeversi?
translation: 鲁内韦西？ [lu nei wei xi ？]

english: Yep, the aim is to have more of your runes on the board than your opponent. You can take your opponents pieces by trapping them between your own. The challenge room for Runeversi is in the SE corner.
translation: 是的，我们的目标是让棋盘上的符文数量多于对手。你可以将对手的棋子夹在自己的棋子之间，从而将其夺走。 Runeversi 的挑战室位于东南角。 [shi de ， wo men de mu biao shi rang qi pan shang de fu wen shu liang duo yu dui shou 。 ni ke yi jiang dui shou de qi zi jia zai zi ji de qi zi zhi jian ， cong er jiang qi duo zou 。 Runeversi  de tiao zhan shi wei yu dong nan jiao 。]

translation: 你的斗篷有什么特别之处？ [ni de dou peng you shen me te bie zhi chu ？]

english: Ahh well they make it less likely that you'll accidently attack anyone wearing the same cape as you and easier to attack everyone else. They also make it easier to distinguish people who're wearing the same cape as you
translation: 啊，好吧，它们使你不太可能意外攻击任何穿着与你相同斗篷的人，并且更容易攻击其他人。它们还可以让您更轻松地区分与您穿着相同斗篷的人 [a ， hao ba ， ta men shi ni bu tai ke neng yi wai gong ji ren he chuan zhe yu ni xiang tong dou peng de ren ， bing qie geng rong yi gong ji qi ta ren 。 ta men hai ke yi rang nin geng qing song di qu fen yu nin chuan zhe xiang tong dou peng de ren]

translation: 我需要知道你不是其他船员的间谍，所以你需要戴蓝色头巾。 [wo xu yao zhi dao ni bu shi qi ta chuan yuan de jian die ， suo yi ni xu yao dai lan se tou jin 。]

english: If you still want to join my crew then go deposit it in the deposit box and come back without anything on your head.
translation: 如果你还想加入我的团队，那就把它存入保险箱，然后回来时头上什么都没有。 [ru guo ni hai xiang jia ru wo de tuan dui ， na jiu ba ta cun ru bao xian xiang ， ran hou hui lai shi tou shang shen me dou mei you 。]

english: Hah, think that I'm going to assign you the easy tasks eh?
translation: 哈，你以为我会给你分配简单的任务吗？ [ha ， ni yi wei wo hui gei ni fen pei jian dan de ren wu ma ？]

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你是什​​么意思？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: Well, I can see you have some items in your inventory. If you want to join my crew you will need all of it free so you are able to work as hard as everyone else.
translation: 嗯，我可以看到你的库存中有一些物品。如果您想加入我的团队，您将需要免费获得所有这些，这样您就可以像其他人一样努力工作。 [n ， wo ke yi kan dao ni de ku cun zhong you yi xie wu pin 。 ru guo nin xiang jia ru wo de tuan dui ， nin jiang xu yao mian fei huo de suo you zhe xie ， zhe yang nin jiu ke yi xiang qi ta ren yi yang nu li gong zuo 。]

english: There is a bank deposit box next to that greasy oaf Jimmy's stall, go and use it and then come back.
translation: 那个油腻腻的傻瓜吉米的摊子旁边有一个银行存款箱，去用一下然后再回来。 [na ge you ni ni de sha gua ji mi de tan zi pang bian you yi ge yin hang cun kuan xiang ， qu yong yi xia ran hou zai hui lai 。]

english: You seem keen enough, but I have plenty of people on my crew.
translation: 你看起来很热心，但我的团队里有很多人。 [ni kan qi lai hen re xin ， dan wo de tuan dui li you hen duo ren 。]

english: If that idiot Dan tries to pressgang more pirates I'll be glad to even the numbers out with you though.
translation: 如果那个白痴丹试图召集更多的海盗，我会很高兴和你扯平。 [ru guo na ge bai chi dan shi tu zhao ji geng duo de hai dao ， wo hui hen gao xing he ni che ping 。]

english: Ok, fair enough.
translation: 好吧，很公平。 [hao ba ， hen gong ping 。]

english: That's quite a nice cat. Is it yours?
translation: 这是一只非常好的猫。是你的吗？ [zhe shi yi zhi fei chang hao de mao 。 shi ni de ma ？]

english: Yes, why do you ask?
translation: 是啊，你为什么这么问？ [shi a ， ni wei shen me zhe me wen ？]

english: I'm a bit of a cat person myself. That's why I'll have to ask you to leave it outside.
translation: 我自己也是一个有点爱猫的人。这就是为什么我不得不要求你把它放在外面。 [wo zi ji ye shi yi ge you dian ai mao de ren 。 zhe jiu shi wei shen me wo bu de bu yao qiu ni ba ta fang zai wai mian 。]

english: There's likely to be quite a lot of stuff going on fire in there, and I don't want to see it get hurt.
translation: 里面可能有很多东西着火，我不想看到它受伤。 [li mian ke neng you hen duo dong xi zhao huo ， wo bu xiang kan dao ta shou shang 。]

english: You cannot take your follower into the game.
translation: 你不能带你的追随者进入游戏。 [ni bu neng dai ni de zhui sui zhe jin ru you xi 。]

english: Heh, ok, well we'll get you sorted out. Welcome to the crew.
translation: 呵呵，好吧，那我们就给你安排一下。欢迎加入剧组。 [he he ， hao ba ， na wo men jiu gei ni an pai yi xia 。 huan ying jia ru ju zu 。]

english: Go wait in the waiting room. I'll call you when we are ready to start.
translation: 去候诊室等候吧。当我们准备好开始时我会打电话给你。 [qu hou zhen shi deng hou ba 。 dang wo men zhun bei hao kai shi shi wo hui da dian hua gei ni 。]

english: Who are you, and what is this place?
translation: 你是谁，这是什么地方？ [ni shi shui ， zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Well, well, looks like someone is fresh off the boat and no mistake!
translation: 好吧，好吧，看起来有人刚从船上下来，没有错！ [hao ba ， hao ba ， kan qi lai you ren gang cong chuan shang xia lai ， mei you cuo ！]

english: A little while ago we had some real problem shipping 'rum' in the island. The Braindeath crew said it had something to do with zombies and the like.
translation: 不久前，我们在岛上运输“朗姆酒”时遇到了一些真正的问题。脑死亡剧组说这和僵尸之类的东西有关。 [bu jiu qian ， wo men zai dao shang yun shu “ lang mu jiu ” shi yu dao le yi xie zhen zheng de wen ti 。 nao si wang ju zu shuo zhe he jiang shi zhi lei de dong xi you guan 。]

english: All the pirates on the island got together and decided to make our own still, but of course things got a little out of hand, and now we have two.
translation: 岛上的所有海盗聚集在一起，决定制作我们自己的蒸馏器，但当然事情有点失控，现在我们有两个。 [dao shang de suo you hai dao ju ji zai yi qi ， jue ding zhi zuo wo men zi ji de zheng liu qi ， dan dang ran shi qing you dian shi kong ， xian zai wo men you liang ge 。]

english: So with two stills you have plenty of 'rum' right?
translation: 那么有了两张剧照，你就有​​足够的“朗姆酒”了，对吗？ [na me you le liang zhang ju zhao ， ni jiu you ​​ zu gou de “ lang mu jiu ” le ， dui ma ？]

english: Well we would do, if that scurvy, whelk-eating foppish dog wouldn't keep trying to burn our still to the ground!
translation: 好吧，如果那只坏血病、吃海螺的纨绔狗不继续试图把我们的蒸馏器烧成灰烬的话，我们就这么做了！ [hao ba ， ru guo na zhi huai xue bing 、 chi hai luo de wan ku gou bu ji xu shi tu ba wo men de zheng liu qi shao cheng hui jin de hua ， wo men jiu zhe me zuo le ！]

english: I say!
translation: 我说！ [wo shuo ！]

english: Neither of us can really corner the 'rum' market at the moment, but we are giving it our best shot.
translation: 目前我们双方都无法真正垄断“朗姆酒”市场，但我们正在尽最大努力。 [mu qian wo men shuang fang dou wu fa zhen zheng long duan “ lang mu jiu ” shi chang ， dan wo men zheng zai jin zui da nu li 。]

english: The code of the island says that we can't attack each other, but after consulting with our fearsome pirate lawyers, we have discovered that destroying each other's property is fine.
translation: 岛上的法规规定我们不能互相攻击，但在咨询了我们可怕的海盗律师后，我们发现破坏彼此的财产是可以的。 [dao shang de fa gui gui ding wo men bu neng hu xiang gong ji ， dan zai zi xun le wo men ke pa de hai dao lv shi hou ， wo men fa xian po huai bi ci de cai chan shi ke yi de 。]

english: Hence, that sniveling, hat-wearing cur keeps trying to burn down my still.
translation: 因此，那个流着泪、戴着帽子的杂种一直试图烧毁我的蒸馏器。 [yin ci ， na ge liu zhe lei 、 dai zhe mao zi de za zhong yi zhi shi tu shao hui wo de zheng liu qi 。]

english: Of course he claims I started this whole thing, but who would trust him anyway?
translation: 当然，他声称这整件事是我发起的，但谁会相信他呢？ [dang ran ， ta sheng cheng zhe zheng jian shi shi wo fa qi de ， dan shui hui xiang xin ta ne ？]

english: Can I help out?
translation: 我可以帮忙吗？ [wo ke yi bang mang ma ？]

english: Yes, probably. I have a bunch of jobs that need doing, if you feel up to it.
translation: 是的，可能是。我有很多工作需要做，如果你愿意的话。 [shi de ， ke neng shi 。 wo you hen duo gong zuo xu yao zuo ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua 。]

english: What would you like to know about?
translation: 您想了解什么？ [nin xiang liao jie shen me ？]

english: How do I help you brew 'Rum'?
translation: 我如何帮助您酿造“朗姆酒”？ [wo ru he bang zhu nin niang zao “ lang mu jiu ”？]

english: Well the stills we have set up are based on the ones on Braindeath island... well roughly at any rate.
translation: 好吧，我们设置的剧照是基于脑死亡岛上的剧照……至少大致如此。 [hao ba ， wo men she zhi de ju zhao shi ji yu nao si wang dao shang de ju zhao …… zhi shao da zhi ru ci 。]

english: All you have to do is help put the ingredients into the hoppers and keep the boilers burning.
translation: 您所要做的就是帮助将原料放入料斗并保持锅炉燃烧。 [nin suo yao zuo de jiu shi bang zhu jiang yuan liao fang ru liao dou bing bao chi guo lu ran shao 。]

english: If you add enough ingredients to the hoppers then you have the ability to pick up a single bottle of rum when it brews.
translation: 如果您向料斗添加足够的原料，那么您就有能力在酿造时拿起一瓶朗姆酒。 [ru guo nin xiang liao dou tian jia zu gou de yuan liao ， na me nin jiu you neng li zai niang zao shi na qi yi ping lang mu jiu 。]

english: So, if ye add 5 buckets of water to the hoppers, then ye get access to one bottle. If you add 3 bowls of coloured water you get access to one bottle, and if you add one of anything else you get access to one bottle.
translation: 因此，如果您向料斗中添加 5 桶水，那么您就可以获得一瓶水。如果您添加 3 碗有色水，您将获得一瓶，如果您添加其他任何东西，您将获得一瓶。 [yin ci ， ru guo nin xiang liao dou zhong tian jia  5  tong shui ， na me nin jiu ke yi huo de yi ping shui 。 ru guo nin tian jia  3  wan you se shui ， nin jiang huo de yi ping ， ru guo nin tian jia qi ta ren he dong xi ， nin jiang huo de yi ping 。]

english: This is cumulative, meaning that if you add (for example) 10 buckets of water, 3 sweetgrubs and 6 bowls of coloured water, then you have a chance to collect 7 bottles of rum for the team.
translation: 这是累积的，这意味着如果您添加（例如）10 桶水、3 个甜幼虫和 6 碗彩色水，那么您就有机会为团队收集 7 瓶朗姆酒。 [zhe shi lei ji de ， zhe yi wei zhe ru guo nin tian jia （ li ru ）10  tong shui 、3  ge tian you chong he  6  wan cai se shui ， na me nin jiu you ji hui wei tuan dui shou ji  7  ping lang mu jiu 。]

english: The boilers are easy as pie to sort out. You just put some logs in, light them with a tinderbox, and then keep putting logs in until they are good and hot.
translation: 锅炉很容易分类。你只需放入一些木头，用易燃物点燃它们，然后继续放入木头，直到它们变好并且变热。 [guo lu hen rong yi fen lei 。 ni zhi xu fang ru yi xie mu tou ， yong yi ran wu dian ran ta men ， ran hou ji xu fang ru mu tou ， zhi dao ta men bian hao bing qie bian re 。]

english: Three logs should do it, but it's best to keep heaping them in just in case.
translation: 三根原木就可以了，但最好还是把它们堆起来以防万一。 [san gen yuan mu jiu ke yi le ， dan zui hao hai shi ba ta men dui qi lai yi fang wan yi 。]

english: The ingredients are; Bitternuts, Scrapey Tree Bark, Sweetgrubs, Buckets of Water and some Coloured Water.
translation: 成分是；苦坚果、刮草树皮、甜菜、一桶水和一些有色水。 [cheng fen shi ； ku jian guo 、 gua cao shu pi 、 tian cai 、 yi tong shui he yi xie you se shui 。]

english: Where can I get Bitternuts?
translation: 哪里可以买到苦果？ [na li ke yi mai dao ku guo ？]

english: There are plenty of Bitternut trees inside this walled off area. The problem is that the trees are too tricky for a human to climb.
translation: 这个被围墙围起来的区域内有很多苦坚果树。问题是这些树对于人类来说太难爬了。 [zhe ge bei wei qiang wei qi lai de qu yu nei you hen duo ku jian guo shu 。 wen ti shi zhe xie shu dui yu ren lei lai shuo tai nan pa le 。]

english: You will need to catch a monkey and send it up the tree to get the nut for you.
translation: 你需要抓住一只猴子并将其送到树上来为你获取坚果。 [ni xu yao zhua zhu yi zhi hou zi bing jiang qi song dao shu shang lai wei ni huo qu jian guo 。]

english: Send it up the tree? How does that work?
translation: 送上树吗？这是如何运作的？ [song shang shu ma ？ zhe shi ru he yun zuo de ？]

english: Well, if you were a monkey, and some random person grabbed you, dumped some dye in your fur and shoved you up a tree, you would hurl the closest heavy object at them too.
translation: 好吧，如果你是一只猴子，某个随机的人抓住你，在你的皮毛上倒了一些染料，然后把你推到树上，你也会把最近的重物扔向他们。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni shi yi zhi hou zi ， mou ge sui ji de ren zhua zhu ni ， zai ni de pi mao shang dao le yi xie ran liao ， ran hou ba ni tui dao shu shang ， ni ye hui ba zui jin de zhong wu reng xiang ta men 。]

english: Wait a second, dye?
translation: 等一下，染料？ [deng yi xia ， ran liao ？]

english: Yes, you'll need to get a bowl of coloured water and pour it on the monkey. Otherwise you won't be able to tell which team the monkey belongs too.
translation: 是的，你需要拿一碗有颜色的水，倒在猴子身上。否则你也无法分辨出猴子属于哪一队。 [shi de ， ni xu yao na yi wan you yan se de shui ， dao zai hou zi shen shang 。 fou ze ni ye wu fa fen bian chu hou zi shu yu na yi dui 。]

english: That makes sense...I think...
translation: 说得有道理……我觉得…… [shuo de you dao li …… wo jue de ……]

english: Anything else?
translation: 还要别的吗？ [hai yao bie de ma ？]

english: Where can I get Scrapey tree bark...and why do I get the feeling I won't like the answer?
translation: 我在哪里可以得到刮皮树皮……为什么我感觉我不喜欢这个答案？ [wo zai na li ke yi de dao gua pi shu pi …… wei shen me wo gan jue wo bu xi huan zhe ge da an ？]

english: Inside this walled area there are a few Scrapey trees. They are the big, ill looking ones, you can't miss them.
translation: 在这个围墙区域内有几棵刮毛树。它们又大又丑，你不能错过它们。 [zai zhe ge wei qiang qu yu nei you ji ke gua mao shu 。 ta men you da you chou ， ni bu neng cuo guo ta men 。]

english: Basically, you cut them down and then carve the bark off with a knife.
translation: 基本上，你把它们砍下来，然后用刀切掉树皮。 [ji ben shang ， ni ba ta men kan xia lai ， ran hou yong dao qie diao shu pi 。]

english: It's pretty simple, except the sap tends so make people feel kind off ill if they get any on themselves.
translation: 这很简单，只不过这种汁液往往会让人们在沾到汁液后感到不舒服。 [zhe hen jian dan ， zhi bu guo zhe zhong zhi ye wang wang hui rang ren men zai zhan dao zhi ye hou gan dao bu shu fu 。]

english: How ill?
translation: 病得怎么样？ [bing de zen me yang ？]

english: Don't worry, we aren't talking deadly ill or anything.
translation: 别担心，我们不是在谈论重病之类的。 [bie dan xin ， wo men bu shi zai tan lun zhong bing zhi lei de 。]

english: It's more like you'll feel quite dizzy and weak for a bit.
translation: 更像是你会感到一阵头晕和虚弱。 [geng xiang shi ni hui gan dao yi zhen tou yun he xu ruo 。]

english: Joy...
translation: 喜悦... [xi yue ...]

english: Sweetgrubs? What are they?
translation: 甜幼虫？这些是什么？ [tian you chong ？ zhe xie shi shen me ？]

english: Well, lacking any sluglings in the area, we add these little grubs called Sweetgrubs. If you ignore the gag- inducing aftertaste, they are quite sweet.
translation: 好吧，由于该地区缺乏任何蛞蝓，我们添加了这些称为甜幼虫的小幼虫。如果忽略令人作呕的余味，它们非常甜。 [hao ba ， you yu gai di qu que fa ren he kuo yu ， wo men tian jia le zhe xie cheng wei tian you chong de xiao you chong 。 ru guo hu lve ling ren zuo ou de yu wei ， ta men fei chang tian 。]

english: How... how can you drink this stuff?
translation: 这……你怎么能喝这种东西？ [zhe …… ni zen me neng he zhe zhong dong xi ？]

english: Quite easily!
translation: 很容易！ [hen rong yi ！]

english: Pirates are renowned as being tough for a reason.
translation: 海盗以强悍闻名，这是有原因的。 [hai dao yi qiang han wen ming ， zhe shi you yuan yin de 。]

english: So where do I get these grubs from anyway?
translation: 那么我从哪里得到这些幼虫呢？ [na me wo cong na li de dao zhe xie you chong ne ？]

english: Well, there are a few sweetgrub mounds inside there. We have a handful of rat meat that you can use on the mounds to draw the grubs to the surface.
translation: 嗯，里面有一些甜菜土丘。我们有一把老鼠肉，你可以用它们在土丘上把幼虫吸引到地表。 [n ， li mian you yi xie tian cai tu qiu 。 wo men you yi ba lao shu rou ， ni ke yi yong ta men zai tu qiu shang ba you chong xi yin dao di biao 。]

english: Mind your fingers though, they are voracious little things.
translation: 不过要小心你的手指，它们是贪吃的小东西。 [bu guo yao xiao xin ni de shou zhi ， ta men shi tan chi de xiao dong xi 。]

english: And here was me thinking that nothing could be more disgusting than Braindeath 'Rum'.
translation: 我当时想，没有什么比脑死亡“朗姆酒”更恶心的了。 [wo dang shi xiang ， mei you shen me bi nao si wang “ lang mu jiu ” geng e xin de le 。]

english: Arr, that's where ye'd be wrong [lad/lass], 'cos new, improved Braindeath 'Rum' Classic is now 200% more disgustin' than any leadin' competitor!
translation: 啊，这就是你们错的地方[小伙子/姑娘]，因为新的、改进的 Braindeath 'Rum' Classic 现在比任何领先的竞争对手都恶心 200%！ [a ， zhe jiu shi ni men cuo de di fang [ xiao huo zi / gu niang ]， yin wei xin de 、 gai jin de  Braindeath 'Rum' Classic  xian zai bi ren he ling xian de jing zheng dui shou dou e xin  200%！]

english: Legal disclaimer; the dangerous amount of disgustin' in new Braindeath 'Rum' Classic be too much for pregnant women, donkeys and anyone with more than seven letters in their last name.
translation: 法律免责声明；新的 Braindeath 'Rum' Classic 中的危险程度的恶心对于孕妇、驴子和任何姓氏超过七个字母的人来说是太多了。 [fa lv mian ze sheng ming ； xin de  Braindeath 'Rum' Classic  zhong de wei xian cheng du de e xin dui yu yun fu 、 lv zi he ren he xing shi chao guo qi ge zi mu de ren lai shuo shi tai duo le 。]

english: What was that?
translation: 那是什么？ [na shi shen me ？]

english: What was what?
translation: 什么是什么？ [shen me shi shen me ？]

english: Is there anything else?
translation: 还有别的吗？ [hai you bie de ma ？]

english: How do I get...
translation: 我怎样才能得到... [wo zen yang cai neng de dao ...]

english: Wait, no, that question makes me sound like I haven't a clue what I'm doing.
translation: 等等，不，这个问题让我听起来好像我不知道自己在做什么。 [deng deng ， bu ， zhe ge wen ti rang wo ting qi lai hao xiang wo bu zhi dao zi ji zai zuo shen me 。]

english: Where can I get buckets in there?
translation: 里面哪里可以买到桶？ [li mian na li ke yi mai dao tong ？]

english: There are a few lying about. Help yourself.
translation: 有几个躺着。帮助自己。 [you ji ge tang zhe 。 bang zhu zi ji 。]

english: There is a pump in the still, so long as it's working you should have almost unlimited water.
translation: 蒸馏器里有一个水泵，只要它工作，你就应该有几乎无限的水。 [zheng liu qi li you yi ge shui beng ， zhi yao ta gong zuo ， ni jiu ying gai you ji hu wu xian de shui 。]

english: Hold on, do I have to add anything disgusting and/or potential lethal to the water before I pour it in?
translation: 等一下，在倒入水中之前，我是否需要添加任何令人厌恶和/或可能致命的东西？ [deng yi xia ， zai dao ru shui zhong zhi qian ， wo shi fou xu yao tian jia ren he ling ren yan wu he / huo ke neng zhi ming de dong xi ？]

english: Perish the thought!
translation: 灭掉这个念头吧！ [mie diao zhe ge nian tou ba ！]

english: Ok, just checking.
translation: 好的，只是检查一下。 [hao de ， zhi shi jian cha yi xia 。]

english: What sort of coloured water are we talking about here?
translation: 我们在这里谈论什么样的有色水？ [wo men zai zhe li tan lun shen me yang de you se shui ？]

english: Well, the other still has an area of waste ground with a flower growing on it. If you go and grab one of the flowers and jam it in the kettle, the water will boil out the colour.
translation: 嗯，另一个还有一块荒地，上面长着一朵花。如果你去抓一朵花，把它塞进水壶里，水就会煮沸，颜色就会消失。 [n ， ling yi ge hai you yi kuai huang di ， shang mian zhang zhe yi duo hua 。 ru guo ni qu zhua yi duo hua ， ba ta sai jin shui hu li ， shui jiu hui zhu fei ， yan se jiu hui xiao shi 。]

english: We use the colour to keep our rum easily identifiable.
translation: 我们使用颜色来保持我们的朗姆酒易于识别。 [wo men shi yong yan se lai bao chi wo men de lang mu jiu yi yu shi bie 。]

english: So I just empty the kettle into the hopper, right?
translation: 所以我只是将水壶倒入料斗中，对吧？ [suo yi wo zhi shi jiang shui hu dao ru liao dou zhong ， dui ba ？]

english: No, no, you'll need to take an empty bowl and fill it from the kettle.
translation: 不，不，你需要拿一个空碗，然后从水壶里装满它。 [bu ， bu ， ni xu yao na yi ge kong wan ， ran hou cong shui hu li zhuang man ta 。]

english: That way you can use the stuff on a monkey if you need to.
translation: 这样，如果需要的话，你可以在猴子身上使用这些东西。 [zhe yang ， ru guo xu yao de hua ， ni ke yi zai hou zi shen shang shi yong zhe xie dong xi 。]

english: Use it on a monkey...of course.
translation: 当然可以用在猴子身上。 [dang ran ke yi yong zai hou zi shen shang 。]

english: Can I ask about something else?
translation: 我可以问点别的吗？ [wo ke yi wen dian bie de ma ？]

english: Ok, what else?
translation: 好吧，还有什么？ [hao ba ， hai you shen me ？]

english: How do I repair the still?
translation: 如何修理蒸馏器？ [ru he xiu li zheng liu qi ？]

english: Well, assuming those scurvy dogs have managed to set any of it on fire, then you'll need to tip a bucket of water on it before you can repair it.
translation: 好吧，假设那些坏血病的狗已经成功地点燃了其中的任何一个，那么您需要在修复它之前先倒一桶水。 [hao ba ， jia she na xie huai xue bing de gou yi jing cheng gong di dian ran le qi zhong de ren he yi ge ， na me nin xu yao zai xiu fu ta zhi qian xian dao yi tong shui 。]

english: Then, it all comes down to what part of it was damaged.
translation: 然后，一切都取决于它的哪一部分被损坏了。 [ran hou ， yi qie dou qu jue yu ta de na yi bu fen bei sun huai le 。]

english: How can I repair hoppers?
translation: 如何修理料斗？ [ru he xiu li liao dou ？]

english: Well, assuming that they are not on fire, all you need to do is use the heavy lumber patches. They are big enough to cover most holes.
translation: 好吧，假设它们没有着火，您所需要做的就是使用重型木材补丁。它们足够大，可以覆盖大多数孔。 [hao ba ， jia she ta men mei you zhao huo ， nin suo xu yao zuo de jiu shi shi yong zhong xing mu cai bu ding 。 ta men zu gou da ， ke yi fu gai da duo shu kong 。]

english: Will I need a hammer?
translation: 我需要锤子吗？ [wo xu yao chui zi ma ？]

english: No, just shove it into place and whack it until it lines up.
translation: 不，只需将其推入到位并敲击直至对齐即可。 [bu ， zhi xu jiang qi tui ru dao wei bing qiao ji zhi zhi dui qi ji ke 。]

english: How do I repair pipes and the pump?
translation: 如何修理管道和泵？ [ru he xiu li guan dao he beng ？]

english: Well, if you use a pipe section on the damaged part you should be able to replace it easily.
translation: 好吧，如果您在损坏的部分使用管道部分，您应该可以轻松更换它。 [hao ba ， ru guo nin zai sun huai de bu fen shi yong guan dao bu fen ， nin ying gai ke yi qing song geng huan ta 。]

english: No, likely you'll just need to whack the old one out and slot the new one in with your hands.
translation: 不，您可能只需要用手敲掉旧的，然后将新的插入即可。 [bu ， nin ke neng zhi xu yao yong shou qiao diao jiu de ， ran hou jiang xin de cha ru ji ke 。]

english: How do I repair bridges?
translation: 如何修复桥梁？ [ru he xiu fu qiao liang ？]

english: Well, we have these handy bridge sections you can use to repair the bridges.
translation: 好吧，我们有这些方便的桥梁部分，您可以用它来修复桥梁。 [hao ba ， wo men you zhe xie fang bian de qiao liang bu fen ， nin ke yi yong ta lai xiu fu qiao liang 。]

english: The main problem is, while a still will keep working if a bit of it is only damaged, the bridges are completely out of commission if they are even slightly damaged.
translation: 主要问题是，虽然蒸馏器只要有一点损坏就可以继续工作，但如果桥梁受到轻微损坏，就完全无法使用。 [zhu yao wen ti shi ， sui ran zheng liu qi zhi yao you yi dian sun huai jiu ke yi ji xu gong zuo ， dan ru guo qiao liang shou dao qing wei sun huai ， jiu wan quan wu fa shi yong 。]

translation: 这会是一个问题吗？我的意思是，我想我可以跳过去。 [zhe hui shi yi ge wen ti ma ？ wo de yi si shi ， wo xiang wo ke yi tiao guo qu 。]

english: How does that work?
