translation: 我身上没有那么多钱。 [wo shen shang mei you na me duo qian 。]

english: Can I pay you for permanent access?
translation: 我可以向您支付永久访问权限吗？ [wo ke yi xiang nin zhi fu yong jiu fang wen quan xian ma ？]

english: Okay, here's 875 coins.
translation: 好的，这是 875 个硬币。 [hao de ， zhe shi  875  ge ying bi 。]

english: Why is it worth the entry cost?
translation: 为什么它值得入门费？ [wei shen me ta zhi de ru men fei ？]

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: Okay, here's 1,000,000 coins.
translation: 好的，这是 1,000,000 个硬币。 [hao de ， zhe shi  1,000,000  ge ying bi 。]

english: Where does this strange entrance lead?
translation: 这个奇怪的入口通向哪里？ [zhe ge qi guai de ru kou tong xiang na li ？]

english: I'm impressed, that tree is growing on that shed.
translation: 令我印象深刻的是，那棵树就长在那个棚子上。 [ling wo yin xiang shen ke de shi ， na ke shu jiu zhang zai na ge peng zi shang 。]

english: Good day to you too.
translation: 你也有美好的一天。 [ni ye you mei hao de yi tian 。]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Pay 875 coins to enter once
translation: 支付875金币即可进入一次 [zhi fu 875 jin bi ji ke jin ru yi ci]

english: Pay 1,000,000 coins for permanent access
translation: 支付 1,000,000 金币即可永久访问 [zhi fu  1,000,000  jin bi ji ke yong jiu fang wen]

english: Cancel
translation: 取消 [qu xiao]

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello Santa, long time no see!
translation: 圣诞老人你好，好久不见！ [sheng dan lao ren ni hao ， hao jiu bu jian ！]

english: Ho Ho Hello [player name], it certainly has been a long time.
translation: Ho Ho 你好[玩家名字]，确实已经很久了。 [Ho Ho  ni hao [ wan jia ming zi ]， que shi yi jing hen jiu le 。]

english: Quick question, why are you hanging out with a bunch of angry children?
translation: 简单问一下，你为什么要和一群愤怒的孩子一起出去玩？ [jian dan wen yi xia ， ni wei shen me yao he yi qun fen nu de hai zi yi qi chu qu wan ？]

english: Christmas is ruined! My son, Jack Frost, has messed it all up!
translation: 圣诞节被毁了！我的儿子杰克·弗罗斯特把一切都搞砸了！ [sheng dan jie bei hui le ！ wo de er zi jie ke · fu luo si te ba yi qie dou gao za le ！]

english: I put him in charge of this year's Christmas to learn some much needed responsibility.
translation: 我让他负责今年的圣诞节，以了解一些急需的责任。 [wo rang ta fu ze jin nian de sheng dan jie ， yi liao jie yi xie ji xu de ze ren 。]

english: All he does is sit at home, eating my mince pies, drinking my eggnog and throwing snowballs at my elves.
translation: 他所做的就是坐在家里，吃我的肉馅饼，喝我的蛋酒，并向我的小精灵扔雪球。 [ta suo zuo de jiu shi zuo zai jia li ， chi wo de rou xian bing ， he wo de dan jiu ， bing xiang wo de xiao jing ling reng xue qiu 。]

english: So why has that caused a problem with the Gingerbread Gnomes?
translation: 那么为什么这会给姜饼侏儒带来问题呢？ [na me wei shen me zhe hui gei jiang bing zhu ru dai lai wen ti ne ？]

english: A major part of my job is overseeing Gingerbread Gnome production here in Varrock. I like to... ensure production is top quality... and do some taste testing from time to time.
translation: 我的主要工作是监督瓦罗克姜饼侏儒的生产。我喜欢...确保生产是一流的...并且不时进行一些口味测试。 [wo de zhu yao gong zuo shi jian du wa luo ke jiang bing zhu ru de sheng chan 。 wo xi huan ... que bao sheng chan shi yi liu de ... bing qie bu shi jin xing yi xie kou wei ce shi 。]

english: As soon as he stepped in, production came to a stand still. I need my Gingerbread Gnomes, it's part of my balanced diet.
translation: 他一介入，生产就陷入停滞。我需要我的姜饼侏儒，它是我均衡饮食的一部分。 [ta yi jie ru ， sheng chan jiu xian ru ting zhi 。 wo xu yao wo de jiang bing zhu ru ， ta shi wo jun heng yin shi de yi bu fen 。]

english: So why don't you go help him out instead of standing around Varrock?
translation: 那么你为什么不去帮助他而不是站在瓦洛克身边呢？ [na me ni wei shen me bu qu bang zhu ta er bu shi zhan zai wa luo ke shen bian ne ？]

english: I'm trying a new parenting technique, he needs to learn from his mistakes.
translation: 我正在尝试一种新的育儿技巧，他需要从错误中吸取教训。 [wo zheng zai chang shi yi zhong xin de yu er ji qiao ， ta xu yao cong cuo wu zhong xi qu jiao xun 。]

english: But in the mean time, could you go and have a word with him? The bakery is south of the Apothecary here in Varrock.
translation: 但与此同时，你能去跟他说句话吗？面包店位于瓦罗克的药剂师南面。 [dan yu ci tong shi ， ni neng qu gen ta shuo ju hua ma ？ mian bao dian wei yu wa luo ke de yao ji shi nan mian 。]

english: Great, now this is my problem, thanks Santa.
translation: 太好了，现在这就是我的问题了，谢谢圣诞老人。 [tai hao le ， xian zai zhe jiu shi wo de wen ti le ， xie xie sheng dan lao ren 。]

english: Have you managed to solve the problem at the Bakery yet?
translation: 你已经解决了面包店的问题了吗？ [ni yi jing jie jue le mian bao dian de wen ti le ma ？]

english: In case you forgot, the bakery is just south of the Apothecary here in Varrock.
translation: 如果您忘记了，面包店就位于 Varrock 的药剂师南边。 [ru guo nin wang ji le ， mian bao dian jiu wei yu  Varrock  de yao ji shi nan bian 。]

english: I'm still working on it.
translation: 我还在努力。 [wo hai zai nu li 。]

english: Hurry it along would you, I'm getting quite hungry.
translation: 快点走吧，我已经饿了。 [kuai dian zou ba ， wo yi jing e le 。]

english: Hello again Santa.
translation: 圣诞老人你好。 [sheng dan lao ren ni hao 。]

english: Ho Ho Hello [player name], have you managed to sort out my son?
translation: Ho Ho 你好[玩家名字]，你找到我儿子了吗？ [Ho Ho  ni hao [ wan jia ming zi ]， ni zhao dao wo er zi le ma ？]

english: Not yet, I found the bakery and it appears Jack has thrown a tantrum....
translation: 还没呢，我找到了那家面包店，看来杰克已经发脾气了…… [hai mei ne ， wo zhao dao le na jia mian bao dian ， kan lai jie ke yi jing fa pi qi le ……]

english: Oh dear, what has he done?
translation: 哦，亲爱的，他做了什么？ [o ， qin ai de ， ta zuo le shen me ？]

english: Well he's locked the bakers up and brought in an Icelord.
translation: 好吧，他把面包师关了起来，并带来了冰领主。 [hao ba ， ta ba mian bao shi guan le qi lai ， bing dai lai le bing ling zhu 。]

english: One of the bakers managed to escape and is outside.
translation: 其中一名面包师成功逃脱并在外面。 [qi zhong yi ming mian bao shi cheng gong tao tuo bing zai wai mian 。]

english: Where did I go wrong... Jack used to be such a happy young boy.
translation: 我哪里做错了……杰克曾经是一个多么快乐的小男孩。 [wo na li zuo cuo le …… jie ke ceng jing shi yi ge duo me kuai le de xiao nan hai 。]

english: Looks like I'm going to need to step in if we're going to save Christmas.
translation: 看来如果我们要拯救圣诞节，我就需要介入。 [kan lai ru guo wo men yao zheng jiu sheng dan jie ， wo jiu xu yao jie ru 。]

english: Great! So you're going to go and talk to him?
translation: 伟大的！所以你要去跟他谈谈吗？ [wei da de ！ suo yi ni yao qu gen ta tan tan ma ？]

english: Ho Ho Ho, of course not [player name], I've got a better idea.
translation: Ho Ho Ho，当然不是[玩家名字]，我有一个更好的主意。 [Ho Ho Ho， dang ran bu shi [ wan jia ming zi ]， wo you yi ge geng hao de zhu yi 。]

english: Fantastic... and that is?
translation: 太棒了……那是？ [tai bang le …… na shi ？]

english: You're going to bring Anti-Santa to sort him out, Jack is terrified of him.
translation: 你要带反圣诞老人来解决他，杰克很害怕他。 [ni yao dai fan sheng dan lao ren lai jie jue ta ， jie ke hen hai pa ta 。]

english: Anti-Santa?! No way am I freeing him after all that work a few years ago.
translation: 反圣诞老人？！经过几年前的努力，我不可能再释放他了。 [fan sheng dan lao ren ？！ jing guo ji nian qian de nu li ， wo bu ke neng zai shi fang ta le 。]

english: Don't you think I know that! We have no choice I'm afraid.
translation: 你以为我不知道吗！恐怕我们别无选择。 [ni yi wei wo bu zhi dao ma ！ kong pa wo men bie wu xuan ze 。]

english: I'm sure we can come up with something better than freeing him.
translation: 我相信我们能想出比释放他更好的办法。 [wo xiang xin wo men neng xiang chu bi shi fang ta geng hao de ban fa 。]

english: Well if you have a better idea, spit it out.
translation: 好吧，如果你有更好的想法，请说出来。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni you geng hao de xiang fa ， qing shuo chu lai 。]

english: Thought so, now I'm going to need you to free him from his prison in ScapeRune.
translation: 我是这么想的，现在我需要你把他从 ScapeRune 的监狱中救出来。 [wo shi zhe me xiang de ， xian zai wo xu yao ni ba ta cong  ScapeRune  de jian yu zhong jiu chu lai 。]

english: How am I going to do that? Evil Bob took him away....
translation: 我该怎么做呢？邪恶的鲍勃把他带走了...... [wo gai zen me zuo ne ？ xie e de bao bo ba ta dai zou le ......]

english: Yes, but we don't need Evil Bob's help this time, I can teleport you into his cell.
translation: 是的，不过这次我们不需要邪恶鲍勃的帮助，我可以把你传送到他的牢房里。 [shi de ， bu guo zhe ci wo men bu xu yao xie e bao bo de bang zhu ， wo ke yi ba ni chuan song dao ta de lao fang li 。]

english: You'll still need to convince him to help us though.
translation: 不过你仍然需要说服他帮助我们。 [bu guo ni reng ran xu yao shuo fu ta bang zhu wo men 。]

english: Anti-Santa? Never heard of him, sound'slike an edgy version of you.
translation: 反圣诞老人？从没听说过他，听起来就像是你的前卫版本。 [fan sheng dan lao ren ？ cong mei ting shuo guo ta ， ting qi lai jiu xiang shi ni de qian wei ban ben 。]

english: He certainly has his... unique aspects to his personality.
translation: 他的个性当然有他的……独特之处。 [ta de ge xing dang ran you ta de …… du te zhi chu 。]

english: But he'll be very useful for scaring Jack. There aren't many things Jack's afraid of, but that giant skeleton is one of them.
translation: 但他对于吓唬杰克非常有用。杰克害怕的东西并不多，但那个巨大的骷髅就是其中之一。 [dan ta dui yu xia hu jie ke fei chang you yong 。 jie ke hai pa de dong xi bing bu duo ， dan na ge ju da de ku lou jiu shi qi zhong zhi yi 。]

english: Where can I find Anti-Santa? I've never come across him in my travels.
translation: 在哪里可以找到反圣诞老人？我在旅行中从未遇到过他。 [zai na li ke yi zhao dao fan sheng dan lao ren ？ wo zai lv xing zhong cong wei yu dao guo ta 。]

english: A few years ago, Evil Bob locked him away in ScapeRune.
translation: 几年前，邪恶的鲍勃把他锁在了 ScapeRune 里。 [ji nian qian ， xie e de bao bo ba ta suo zai le  ScapeRune  li 。]

english: Great, I'm sure if we wait long enough, Evil Bob will appear out of nowhere....
translation: 太好了，我确信如果我们等得足够长，邪恶的鲍勃就会突然出现...... [tai hao le ， wo que xin ru guo wo men deng de zu gou zhang ， xie e de bao bo jiu hui tu ran chu xian ......]

english: We don't have time for that, he trusted me to look after him. Evil Bob was tired of dealing with his dirty laundry.
translation: 我们没有时间这么做，他相信我会照顾他。邪恶的鲍勃厌倦了处理他的脏衣服。 [wo men mei you shi jian zhe me zuo ， ta xiang xin wo hui zhao gu ta 。 xie e de bao bo yan juan le chu li ta de zang yi fu 。]

english: I'll teleport you right into his cell, you're going to need to convince him to help us.
translation: 我会把你传送到他的牢房里，你需要说服他来帮助我们。 [wo hui ba ni chuan song dao ta de lao fang li ， ni xu yao shuo fu ta lai bang zhu wo men 。]

english: Surely he'll still be angry about last time?
translation: 他肯定还会因为上次的事情生气吧？ [ta ken ding hai hui yin wei shang ci de shi qing sheng qi ba ？]

english: Most likely, but if you tell him that I'm considering setting him free, he'll change his tune.
translation: 最有可能的是，但如果你告诉他我正在考虑释放他，他就会改变态度。 [zui you ke neng de shi ， dan ru guo ni gao su ta wo zheng zai kao lv shi fang ta ， ta jiu hui gai bian tai du 。]

english: Take this as well. After you've convinced him to help, you can use this to teleport both of you to the bakery.
translation: 这个也拿去吧。当你说服他帮忙后，你可以用它来传送你们俩到面包店。 [zhe ge ye na qu ba 。 dang ni shuo fu ta bang mang hou ， ni ke yi yong ta lai chuan song ni men lia dao mian bao dian 。]

english: You've got too much on you, come back when you've got some free space.
translation: 你身上的事情太多了，等你有空闲的时候再回来吧。 [ni shen shang de shi qing tai duo le ， deng ni you kong xian de shi hou zai hui lai ba 。]

english: Santa gives you a teleport tablet to teleport you to the bakery.
translation: 圣诞老人给你一个传送平板电脑，可以将你传送到面包店。 [sheng dan lao ren gei ni yi ge chuan song ping ban dian nao ， ke yi jiang ni chuan song dao mian bao dian 。]

english: Ah [player name], you've returned, have you managed to sort out the bakery?
translation: 啊【玩家名】你回来了，面包店搞定了吗？ [a 【 wan jia ming 】 ni hui lai le ， mian bao dian gao ding le ma ？]

english: Hello again Santa, yes I've managed to sort out the bakery and stop your son.
translation: 圣诞老人，你好，是的，我已经设法解决了面包店问题并阻止了你的儿子。 [sheng dan lao ren ， ni hao ， shi de ， wo yi jing she fa jie jue le mian bao dian wen ti bing zu zhi le ni de er zi 。]

english: Ho Ho Ho, that's perfect and what of the Anti-Santa?
translation: 嗬嗬嗬，太完美了，那反圣诞老人呢？ [he he he ， tai wan mei le ， na fan sheng dan lao ren ne ？]

english: Uhm... well... there was a slight problem when we returned from ScapeRune.
translation: 嗯...好吧...当我们从ScapeRune 回来时出现了一个小问题。 [n ... hao ba ... dang wo men cong ScapeRune  hui lai shi chu xian le yi ge xiao wen ti 。]

english: What happened?
translation: 发生了什么？ [fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: He sort of beat up Jack then escaped when Jack fled.
translation: 他殴打了杰克，然后当杰克逃跑时他又逃跑了。 [ta ou da le jie ke ， ran hou dang jie ke tao pao shi ta you tao pao le 。]

english: Uh... that wasn't supposeto happen. Do you know where they went?
translation: 呃……那是不应该发生的。你知道他们去了哪里吗？ [e …… na shi bu ying gai fa sheng de 。 ni zhi dao ta men qu le na li ma ？]

english: I'm afraid not, Jack teleported out and Anti-Santa followed him.
translation: 恐怕不是，杰克传送出去了，反圣诞老人也跟着他。 [kong pa bu shi ， jie ke chuan song chu qu le ， fan sheng dan lao ren ye gen zhe ta 。]

english: That's going to come back and bite me in the future... Oh well, problem for another year I suppose, did you manage to make any Gingerbread Gnomes for me?
translation: 那将来会回来咬我的……哦，好吧，我想又是一年的问题了，你有没有设法为我制作姜饼侏儒？ [na jiang lai hui hui lai yao wo de …… o ， hao ba ， wo xiang you shi yi nian de wen ti le ， ni you mei you she fa wei wo zhi zuo jiang bing zhu ru ？]

english: I'm afraid I didn't, although I do have this giant one I used to protect myself from the Icelord, the bakers are going to use the Icelord from now on to ice their gnomes.
translation: 恐怕我没有，虽然我确实有这个巨大的，我用来保护自己免受冰领主的伤害，但从现在开始，面包师们将使用冰领主来冰冻他们的侏儒。 [kong pa wo mei you ， sui ran wo que shi you zhe ge ju da de ， wo yong lai bao hu zi ji mian shou bing ling zhu de shang hai ， dan cong xian zai kai shi ， mian bao shi men jiang shi yong bing ling zhu lai bing dong ta men de zhu ru 。]

english: Oh, that wouldn't be edible at all, Icelord saliva isn't safe to eat, you better keep that one and maybe go tell the bakers later as well.
translation: 哦，那根本不能吃，冰王的唾液吃起来不安全，你最好保留那个，也许稍后也去告诉面包师。 [o ， na gen ben bu neng chi ， bing wang de tuo ye chi qi lai bu an quan ， ni zui hao bao liu na ge ， ye xu shao hou ye qu gao su mian bao shi 。]

english: Ho Ho Ho, well thank you for all your help this year [player name], I'm sure I'll see you again soon.
translation: Ho Ho Ho，非常感谢您今年的所有帮助[玩家姓名]，我相信很快就会再次见到您。 [Ho Ho Ho， fei chang gan xie nin jin nian de suo you bang zhu [ wan jia xing ming ]， wo xiang xin hen kuai jiu hui zai ci jian dao nin 。]

english: Yeah... looking forward to it....
translation: 是啊……期待啊…… [shi a …… qi dai a ……]

english: Why are you still here?
translation: 你怎么还在这里？ [ni zen me hai zai zhe li ？]

english: Ho Ho Ho, I'm still waiting for the delivery to come in!
translation: 呵呵呵呵，我还在等快递呢！ [he he he he ， wo hai zai deng kuai di ne ！]

english: I'll leave you to it then.
translation: 那我就把它留给你了。 [na wo jiu ba ta liu gei ni le 。]

english: Well hello there [player name].
translation: 嗯，你好[玩家姓名]。 [n ， ni hao [ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: What can I do for you on this fine winter day?
translation: 在这个美好的冬日，我能为您做些什么呢？ [zai zhe ge mei hao de dong ri ， wo neng wei nin zuo xie shen me ne ？]

english: I was hoping to enter into your festive games!
translation: 我本来希望参加你们的节日游戏！ [wo ben lai xi wang can jia ni men de jie ri you xi ！]

english: Ah, splendid! Another contender.
translation: 啊，太棒了！另一个竞争者。 [a ， tai bang le ！ ling yi ge jing zheng zhe 。]

english: Now I must warn you, the games will put you to the test. They may even break you.
translation: 现在我必须警告你，比赛将对你进行考验。他们甚至可能会击垮你。 [xian zai wo bi xu jing gao ni ， bi sai jiang dui ni jin xing kao yan 。 ta men shen zhi ke neng hui ji kua ni 。]

english: Failing the games will put you on the Naughty List until the end of time.
translation: 游戏失败会将您列入顽皮名单，直到时间结束。 [you xi shi bai hui jiang nin lie ru wan pi ming dan ， zhi dao shi jian jie shu 。]

english: Do you accept these conditions?
translation: 你接受这些条件吗？ [ni jie shou zhe xie tiao jian ma ？]

english: Uh... I guess so.
translation: 呃……我想是这样。 [e …… wo xiang shi zhe yang 。]

english: Excellent!
translation: 出色的！ [chu se de ！]

english: Santa tells you your game time.
translation: 圣诞老人告诉你游戏时间。 [sheng dan lao ren gao su ni you xi shi jian 。]

english: Thanks! Can I also ask a favour?
translation: 谢谢！我还可以请求帮忙吗？ [xie xie ！ wo hai ke yi qing qiu bang mang ma ？]

english: It depends, have you been nice this year?
translation: 这要看你今年过得好吗？ [zhe yao kan ni jin nian guo de hao ma ？]

english: Absolutely.
translation: 绝对地。 [jue dui di 。]

english: Very well, I trust you. What do you desire?
translation: 很好，我相信你。你想要什么？ [hen hao ， wo xiang xin ni 。 ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: A Gilded Scimitar.
translation: 一把镀金弯刀。 [yi ba du jin wan dao 。]

english: A Twisted Bow.
translation: 扭曲的弓。 [niu qu de gong 。]

english: Wait no... Sorry ignore that. Instinct kicked in.
translation: 等等，不...抱歉忽略这一点。本能开始发挥作用。 [deng deng ， bu ... bao qian hu lve zhe yi dian 。 ben neng kai shi fa hui zuo yong 。]

translation: 今天为萨拉多明而战！ [jin tian wei sa la duo ming er zhan ！]

english: The light of Saradomin is fading, he needs your help!
translation: 萨拉多明的光芒正在消退，他需要你的帮助！ [sa la duo ming de guang mang zheng zai xiao tui ， ta xu yao ni de bang zhu ！]

english: Zamorak is a false god who is a stain on this world, Saradomin will guide you forward.
translation: 萨莫拉克是一个伪神，是这个世界的污点，萨拉多明会指引你前进。 [sa mo la ke shi yi ge wei shen ， shi zhe ge shi jie de wu dian ， sa la duo ming hui zhi yin ni qian jin 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Hello. How can I help you?
translation: 你好。我怎么帮你？ [ni hao 。 wo zen me bang ni ？]

english: What are you selling?
translation: 你卖什么？ [ni mai shen me ？]

english: Can you give me any Farming advice?
translation: 你能给我一些农业建议吗？ [ni neng gei wo yi xie nong ye jian yi ma ？]

english: Yes - ask a gardener.
translation: 是的 - 问问园丁。 [shi de  -  wen wen yuan ding 。]

english: Can you tell me how to use the loom?
translation: 你能告诉我如何使用织布机吗？ [ni neng gao su wo ru he shi yong zhi bu ji ma ？]

english: Well, it's actually my loom, but I don't mind you using it, if you like. You can use it to weave sacks and baskets in which you can put vegetables and fruit.
translation: 嗯，这实际上是我的织机，但如果你愿意的话，我不介意你使用它。您可以用它编织袋子和篮子，放入蔬菜和水果。 [n ， zhe shi ji shang shi wo de zhi ji ， dan ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo bu jie yi ni shi yong ta 。 nin ke yi yong ta bian zhi dai zi he lan zi ， fang ru shu cai he shui guo 。]

english: What do I need to weave sacks?
translation: 编织麻袋需要什么？ [bian zhi ma dai xu yao shen me ？]

english: Well, the best sacks are made with jute fibres; you can grow jute yourself in a hops patch. I'd say about 4 jute fibres should be enough to weave a sack.
translation: 嗯，最好的麻袋是用黄麻纤维制成的。您可以自己在啤酒花地里种植黄麻。我想说大约 4 根黄麻纤维应该足以编织一个麻袋。 [n ， zui hao de ma dai shi yong huang ma xian wei zhi cheng de 。 nin ke yi zi ji zai pi jiu hua di li zhong zhi huang ma 。 wo xiang shuo da yue  4  gen huang ma xian wei ying gai zu yi bian zhi yi ge ma dai 。]

english: Thank you, that's very kind.
translation: 谢谢你，真是太好了。 [xie xie ni ， zhen shi tai hao le 。]

english: What do I need to weave baskets?
translation: 编篮子需要什么？ [bian lan zi xu yao shen me ？]

english: Well, the best baskets are made with young branches cut from a willow tree. You'll need a very young willow tree; otherwise, the branches will have grown too thick to be able to weave. I suggest growing your own.
translation: 嗯，最好的篮子是用从柳树上砍下来的嫩枝制成的。你需要一棵非常年轻的柳树；否则，树枝会长得太粗，无法编织。我建议你自己种植。 [n ， zui hao de lan zi shi yong cong liu shu shang kan xia lai de nen zhi zhi cheng de 。 ni xu yao yi ke fei chang nian qing de liu shu ； fou ze ， shu zhi hui zhang de tai cu ， wu fa bian zhi 。 wo jian yi ni zi ji zhong zhi 。]

english: You can cut the branches with a standard pair of secateurs. You will probably need about 6 willow branches to weave a complete basket.
translation: 您可以使用标准的修枝剪来修剪树枝。您可能需要大约 6 根柳枝才能编织一个完整的篮子。 [nin ke yi shi yong biao zhun de xiu zhi jian lai xiu jian shu zhi 。 nin ke neng xu yao da yue  6  gen liu zhi cai neng bian zhi yi ge wan zheng de lan zi 。]

english: I'm okay, thank you.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。 [wo mei shi ， xie xie 。]

english: I've come about the bounty.
translation: 我是为了赏金而来的。 [wo shi wei le shang jin er lai de 。]

english: Oh thank Saradomin! It's about time someone responded, something needs to be done!
translation: 哦，谢谢萨拉多明！是时候有人做出回应了，需要做点什么！ [o ， xie xie sa la duo ming ！ shi shi hou you ren zuo chu hui ying le ， xu yao zuo dian shen me ！]

english: Can you explain what happened?
translation: 你能解释一下发生了什么吗？ [ni neng jie shi yi xia fa sheng le shen me ma ？]

english: Of course. I was making my monthly delivery to The Sheared Ram in Lumbridge, heading east near the Draynor Village crossroads.
translation: 当然。我每个月都在向朗布里奇的 The Sheared Ram 送货，向东靠近德雷诺村十字路口。 [dang ran 。 wo mei ge yue dou zai xiang lang bu li qi de  The Sheared Ram  song huo ， xiang dong kao jin de lei nuo cun shi zi lu kou 。]

english: Suddenly, out of the trees came a hulking monster! It chased me for a short distance, but luckily Rosie managed to spook it enough to give me a headstart.
translation: 突然，从树丛中窜出一只巨大的怪物！它追了我一小段距离，但幸运的是，罗西成功地吓到了它，让我抢先一步。 [tu ran ， cong shu cong zhong cuan chu yi zhi ju da de guai wu ！ ta zhui le wo yi xiao duan ju li ， dan xing yun de shi ， luo xi cheng gong di xia dao le ta ， rang wo qiang xian yi bu 。]

english: Sounds like it must have given you quite the scare!
translation: 听起来一定让你很害怕！ [ting qi lai yi ding rang ni hen hai pa ！]

english: It certainly did. I even lost my cart full of farm produce!
translation: 确实如此。我什至把装满农产品的车都丢了！ [que shi ru ci 。 wo shen zhi ba zhuang man nong chan pin de che dou diu le ！]

english: What did this monster look like?
translation: 这个怪物长什么样子？ [zhe ge guai wu zhang shen me yang zi ？]

english: I didn't get a very good look at it I'm afraid. It was getting dark and as soon as I saw it charging at me, I ran.
translation: 恐怕我没有仔细观察它。天快黑了，我一看到它向我冲过来，我就跑了。 [kong pa wo mei you zi xi guan cha ta 。 tian kuai hei le ， wo yi kan dao ta xiang wo chong guo lai ， wo jiu pao le 。]

english: I can still hear the sound, though. A horrible grunting... squealing...
translation: 但我仍然能听到声音。可怕的咕噜声……尖叫声…… [dan wo reng ran neng ting dao sheng yin 。 ke pa de gu lu sheng …… jian jiao sheng ……]

english: Is there anything else you wanted?
translation: 你还有什么想要的吗？ [ni hai you shen me xiang yao de ma ？]

english: Any tips on finding this thing?
translation: 找到这个东西有什么建议吗？ [zhao dao zhe ge dong xi you shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: Tips...? You're supposed to be the professional monster slayer!
translation: 尖端...？你应该是专业的怪物杀手！ [jian duan ...？ ni ying gai shi zhuan ye de guai wu sha shou ！]

english: Although, I suppose a good place to start would be checking the area I was attacked. See if you can find the remains of my cart.
translation: 不过，我认为一个好的起点是检查我受到攻击的区域。看看你是否能找到我的购物车的剩余部分。 [bu guo ， wo ren wei yi ge hao de qi dian shi jian cha wo shou dao gong ji de qu yu 。 kan kan ni shi fou neng zhao dao wo de gou wu che de sheng yu bu fen 。]

english: Ok, yes that could work.
translation: 好的，是的，这可行。 [hao de ， shi de ， zhe ke xing 。]

english: Whereabouts were you attacked again?
translation: 又在哪里遭到袭击？ [you zai na li zao dao xi ji ？]

english: I remember being somewhere near the crossroads, north of Draynor Village.
translation: 我记得当时在德雷纳村北部十字路口附近的某个地方。 [wo ji de dang shi zai de lei na cun bei bu shi zi lu kou fu jin de mou ge di fang 。]

english: Sorry that I'm not much help. It happened so fast, the whole thing is a bit of a blur.
translation: 抱歉我帮不了什么忙。事情发生得太快了，整个事情都有些模糊了。 [bao qian wo bang bu liao shen me mang 。 shi qing fa sheng de tai kuai le ， zheng ge shi qing dou you xie mo hu le 。]

english: That's okay. Crossroads north of Draynor... At least I have somewhere to start.
translation: 没关系。德拉诺以北的十字路口……至少我有一个可以开始的地方。 [mei guan xi 。 de la nuo yi bei de shi zi lu kou …… zhi shao wo you yi ge ke yi kai shi de di fang 。]

english: You mentioned that Rosie spooked the monster. Who's that?
translation: 你提到罗西吓到了怪物。那是谁？ [ni ti dao luo xi xia dao le guai wu 。 na shi shui ？]

english: Oh, that'll be our lady over there by the fire. She's such a good dog, always accompanies me on deliveries.
translation: 哦，那是我们火炉边的女士。她真是一只好狗，总是陪着我送货。 [o ， na shi wo men huo lu bian de nv shi 。 ta zhen shi yi zhi hao gou ， zong shi pei zhe wo song huo 。]

english: You can pet her if you like. She's very friendly.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，你可以抚摸她。她非常友好。 [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， ni ke yi fu mo ta 。 ta fei chang you hao 。]

english: I think that'll be all for now.
translation: 我想现在就这些了。 [wo xiang xian zai jiu zhe xie le 。]

english: Excellent! Best of luck to you, I'll be waiting right here with your reward.
translation: 出色的！祝你好运，我会在这里等待你的奖励。 [chu se de ！ zhu ni hao yun ， wo hui zai zhe li deng dai ni de jiang li 。]

english: That monster certainly won't be troubling you from now on.
translation: 那个怪物以后肯定不会再来找你的麻烦了。 [na ge guai wu yi hou ken ding bu hui zai lai zhao ni de ma fan le 。]

english: Oh that's fantastic news! I'm so relie-
translation: 哦，这真是个好消息！我很放心- [o ， zhe zhen shi ge hao xiao xi ！ wo hen fang xin -]

english: Wait, how do I know you're not just saying that to get the bounty?
translation: 等等，我怎么知道你这么说不是为了获得赏金？ [deng deng ， wo zen me zhi dao ni zhe me shuo bu shi wei le huo de shang jin ？]

english: How about this as proof?
translation: 以此为证怎么样？ [yi ci wei zheng zen me yang ？]

english: You pull the foot out of your backpack and show it to Sarah.
translation: 你把脚从背包里拿出来给莎拉看。 [ni ba jiao cong bei bao li na chu lai gei sha la kan 。]

english: Eugh! Yes, that certainly looks about right!
translation: 呃！是的，这看起来确实是正确的！ [e ！ shi de ， zhe kan qi lai que shi shi zheng que de ！]

english: Indeed, the smell is... something quite special.
translation: 确实，这味道……很特别。 [que shi ， zhe wei dao …… hen te bie 。]

english: I'll probably just give it to the dog.
translation: 我可能会把它给狗。 [wo ke neng hui ba ta gei gou 。]

english: I'm glad you made it back. Some strange woman in a hood came asking about the job shortly after you left. I didn't really want her back in here.
translation: 我很高兴你回来了。你离开后不久，一个戴着兜帽的陌生女人过来询问这份工作的情况。我真的不想让她回到这里。 [wo hen gao xing ni hui lai le 。 ni li kai hou bu jiu ， yi ge dai zhe dou mao de mo sheng nv ren guo lai xun wen zhe fen gong zuo de qing kuang 。 wo zhen de bu xiang rang ta hui dao zhe li 。]

english: Anyway, thank you so much! Here's your reward.
translation: 不管怎样，非常感谢！这是你的奖励。 [bu guan zen yang ， fei chang gan xie ！ zhe shi ni de jiang li 。]

english: Sarah hands you a heavy pouch of 5,000 coins.
translation: 莎拉递给你一个沉重的袋子，里面装着 5,000 枚硬币。 [sha la di gei ni yi ge chen zhong de dai zi ， li mian zhuang zhe  5,000  mei ying bi 。]

english: Perhaps I should speak with Spria and tell her that the monster's been dealt with.
translation: 也许我应该和斯普里亚谈谈并告诉她怪物已经被处理掉了。 [ye xu wo ying gai he si pu li ya tan tan bing gao su ta guai wu yi jing bei chu li diao le 。]

english: You've been given another clue!
translation: 你已经得到了另一条线索！ [ni yi jing de dao le ling yi tiao xian suo ！]

english: You've obtained a casket!
translation: 你已经获得了一个棺材！ [ni yi jing huo de le yi ge guan cai ！]

translation: 你卖什么？ [ni mai shen me ？]

translation: 你能给我一些农业建议吗？ [ni neng gei wo yi xie nong ye jian yi ma ？]

translation: 你能告诉我如何使用织布机吗？ [ni neng gao su wo ru he shi yong zhi bu ji ma ？]

translation: 编织麻袋需要什么？ [bian zhi ma dai xu yao shen me ？]

english: What do I need to weave baskets?
translation: 编篮子需要什么？ [bian lan zi xu yao shen me ？]

english: Thank you, that's very kind.
translation: 谢谢你，真是太好了。 [xie xie ni ， zhen shi tai hao le 。]

english: I'm okay, thank you.
translation: 我没事，谢谢。 [wo mei shi ， xie xie 。]

english: Talk about the bounty.
translation: 谈论赏金。 [tan lun shang jin 。]

english: What did the monster look like?
translation: 怪物长什么样？ [guai wu zhang shen me yang ？]

english: Any tips on finding this thing?
translation: 找到这个东西有什么建议吗？ [zhao dao zhe ge dong xi you shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: Whereabouts were you attacked again?
translation: 又在哪里遭到袭击？ [you zai na li zao dao xi ji ？]

english: You mentioned Rosie. Who's that?
translation: 你提到了罗西。那是谁？ [ni ti dao le luo xi 。 na shi shui ？]

english: I think that'll be all for now.
translation: 我想现在就这些了。 [wo xiang xian zai jiu zhe xie le 。]

english: Please excuse me, I'm rather busy.
translation: 请原谅我，我比较忙。 [qing yuan liang wo ， wo bi jiao mang 。]

english: Hey, I'm your contractor from Mahogany Homes, what did you want done?
translation: 嘿，我是 Mahogany Homes 的承包商，你想要做什么？ [hei ， wo shi  Mahogany Homes  de cheng bao shang ， ni xiang yao zuo shen me ？]

english: I'd like a Wooden table built.
translation: 我想要一张木桌。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang mu zhuo 。]

english: I'd like a Wooden bed built.
translation: 我想要一张木床。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang mu chuang 。]

english: I'd like a Wooden dresser built.
translation: 我想要一个木制梳妆台。 [wo xiang yao yi ge mu zhi shu zhuang tai 。]

english: I'd like a Wooden small table built.
translation: 我想要一张木制小桌子。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang mu zhi xiao zhuo zi 。]

english: I'd like my range fixed.
translation: 我希望我的范围是固定的。 [wo xi wang wo de fan wei shi gu ding de 。]

english: I'd like a Wooden shelf built.
translation: 我想要一个木架子。 [wo xiang yao yi ge mu jia zi 。]

english: I'd like a Oak table built.
translation: 我想要一张橡木桌子。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang xiang mu zhuo zi 。]

translation: 我想要一张橡木床。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang xiang mu chuang 。]

translation: 我想要一个橡木梳妆台。 [wo xiang yao yi ge xiang mu shu zhuang tai 。]

translation: 我想要一张橡木小桌子。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang xiang mu xiao zhuo zi 。]

english: I'd like a Oak shelf built.
translation: 我想要一个橡木架子。 [wo xiang yao yi ge xiang mu jia zi 。]

english: I'd like a Teak table built.
translation: 我想要一张柚木桌子。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang you mu zhuo zi 。]

english: I'd like a Teak bed built.
translation: 我想要一张柚木床。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang you mu chuang 。]

translation: 我想要一个柚木梳妆台。 [wo xiang yao yi ge you mu shu zhuang tai 。]

translation: 我想要一张柚木小桌子。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang you mu xiao zhuo zi 。]

translation: 我想要一个柚木架子。 [wo xiang yao yi ge you mu jia zi 。]

english: I'd like a Mahogany table built.
translation: 我想要一张红木桌子。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang hong mu zhuo zi 。]

english: I'd like a Mahogany bed built.
translation: 我想要一张红木床。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang hong mu chuang 。]

english: I'd like a Mahogany dresser built.
translation: 我想要一个桃花心木梳妆台。 [wo xiang yao yi ge tao hua xin mu shu zhuang tai 。]

english: I'd like a Mahogany small table built.
translation: 我想要一张桃花心木小桌子。 [wo xiang yao yi zhang tao hua xin mu xiao zhuo zi 。]

english: I'd like a Mahogany shelf built.
translation: 我想要一个桃花心木架子。 [wo xiang yao yi ge tao hua xin mu jia zi 。]

english: I've finished with the work you wanted.
translation: 我已经完成了你想要的工作。 [wo yi jing wan cheng le ni xiang yao de gong zuo 。]

english: Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: 太感谢了！走之前你想喝杯茶吗？ [tai gan xie le ！ zou zhi qian ni xiang he bei cha ma ？]

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
translation: 是的，我想要一杯茶。 [shi de ， wo xiang yao yi bei cha 。]

english: No thanks, I better be off.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我最好离开了。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo zui hao li kai le 。]

english: Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!
translation: 啊啊，没有什么比一杯美味的茶更好的了！ [a a ， mei you shen me bi yi bei mei wei de cha geng hao de le ！]

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
translation: 是的，我想要一杯茶。 [shi de ， wo xiang yao yi bei cha 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: I can't find my husband, we got seperated as we disembarked the ship.
translation: 我找不到我的丈夫，我们下了船就失散了。 [wo zhao bu dao wo de zhang fu ， wo men xia le chuan jiu shi san le 。]

english: What do you want, mortal?
translation: 你想要什么，凡人？ [ni xiang yao shen me ， fan ren ？]

english: I'm not sure - what can you offer?
translation: 我不确定 - 你能提供什么？ [wo bu que ding  -  ni neng ti gong shen me ？]

english: Not much, I'm dead.
translation: 不多说了，我已经死了。 [bu duo shuo le ， wo yi jing si le 。]

english: Fair enough.
translation: 很公平。 [hen gong ping 。]

english: You're the one who stopped Necrovarus. Our people are forever grateful to you, even if we don't always show it.
translation: 你是阻止 Necrovarus 的人。我们的人民永远感激您，即使我们并不总是表现出来。 [ni shi zu zhi  Necrovarus  de ren 。 wo men de ren min yong yuan gan ji nin ， ji shi wo men bing bu zong shi biao xian chu lai 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Are you Sarah Corvo?
translation: 你是莎拉·科尔沃吗？ [ni shi sha la · ke er wo ma ？]

english: That's me. Not many people interested in visiting me these days. What brings you here?
translation: 这就是我。这些天没有多少人有兴趣来看我。是什么风把你吹到这里来的？ [zhe jiu shi wo 。 zhe xie tian mei you duo shao ren you xing qu lai kan wo 。 shi shen me feng ba ni chui dao zhe li lai de ？]

english: I'm on the hunt for the piece of a key. It was once in the possession of your ancestor, Tristan Corvo.
translation: 我正在寻找一把钥匙。它曾经属于你的祖先特里斯坦·科尔沃。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yi ba yao shi 。 ta ceng jing shu yu ni de zu xian te li si tan · ke er wo 。]

english: I see. I'm afraid I can't help you. The key is gone.
translation: 我懂了。恐怕我帮不了你。钥匙不见了。 [wo dong le 。 kong pa wo bang bu liao ni 。 yao shi bu jian le 。]

english: Gone?
translation: 走了吗？ [zou le ma ？]

english: Yes gone. When my father passed the key down to me he told me that I must keep it safe no matter what. When the vampyres came to Port Phasmatys I buried it out in the swamps to stop them from getting it.
translation: 是的，消失了。当我父亲把钥匙交给我时，他告诉我无论如何都必须保管好它。当吸血鬼来到法斯马蒂斯港时，我把它埋在沼泽里，以防止他们得到它。 [shi de ， xiao shi le 。 dang wo fu qin ba yao shi jiao gei wo shi ， ta gao su wo wu lun ru he dou bi xu bao guan hao ta 。 dang xi xue gui lai dao fa si ma di si gang shi ， wo ba ta mai zai zhao ze li ， yi fang zhi ta men de dao ta 。]

english: But how do I get it back?
translation: 但我该如何取回它呢？ [dan wo gai ru he qu hui ta ne ？]

english: You don't. The key is gone and it's safer that way. I never liked looking after that lump of metal anyway.
translation: 你不知道。钥匙不见了，这样更安全。无论如何，我从来不喜欢照顾那块金属。 [ni bu zhi dao 。 yao shi bu jian le ， zhe yang geng an quan 。 wu lun ru he ， wo cong lai bu xi huan zhao gu na kuai jin shu 。]

english: Metal?
translation: 金属？ [jin shu ？]

english: Yes, a strange red metal.
translation: 是的，一种奇怪的红色金属。 [shi de ， yi zhong qi guai de hong se jin shu 。]

english: Hmm. I think I might know just the scientist to help me out with this. Time for me to visit Draynor Manor.
translation: 唔。我想我可能只认识那位科学家来帮助我解决这个问题。是时候去参观德雷诺庄园了。 [wu 。 wo xiang wo ke neng zhi ren shi na wei ke xue jia lai bang zhu wo jie jue zhe ge wen ti 。 shi shi hou qu can guan de lei nuo zhuang yuan le 。]

english: What was that?
translation: 那是什么？ [na shi shen me ？]

english: Oh nothing. I'd best be off, thank you for your time.
translation: 哦，没什么。我最好走了，谢谢你的时间。 [o ， mei shen me 。 wo zui hao zou le ， xie xie ni de shi jian 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: You again. You're not still after that key are you?
translation: 又是你。你还没找到那把钥匙吧？ [you shi ni 。 ni hai mei zhao dao na ba yao shi ba ？]

english: Nope, just stopping by to say hello.
translation: 不，只是过来打个招呼。 [bu ， zhi shi guo lai da ge zhao hu 。]

english: Well that was great. See you later.
translation: 嗯，那太好了。稍后见。 [n ， na tai hao le 。 shao hou jian 。]

english: This gnome lady appears to be singing ... to her toads.
translation: 这位侏儒女士似乎正在对着她的蟾蜍唱歌。 [zhe wei zhu ru nv shi si hu zheng zai dui zhe ta de chan chu chang ge 。]

english: La La La, toadies in their holeys! ..Oh hello, I didn't notice you.
translation: 啦啦啦，谄媚之徒们！ ..哦你好，我没注意到你。 [la la la ， chan mei zhi tu men ！ .. o ni hao ， wo mei zhu yi dao ni 。]

english: Hello, Whatdo you do here?
translation: 你好，你在这里做什么？ [ni hao ， ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I look after the toads and worms. They are very useful in gnome cooking, don't you know.
translation: 我照顾蟾蜍和蠕虫。它们在侏儒烹饪中非常有用，你知道吗？ [wo zhao gu chan chu he ru chong 。 ta men zai zhu ru peng ren zhong fei chang you yong ， ni zhi dao ma ？]

english: Does singing to the toads help them grow?
translation: 对蟾蜍唱歌有助于它们成长吗？ [dui chan chu chang ge you zhu yu ta men cheng zhang ma ？]

english: Don't be silly, I just sing to pass the time while looking after them!
translation: 别傻了，我只是一边照顾他们一边唱歌打发时间！ [bie sha le ， wo zhi shi yi bian zhao gu ta men yi bian chang ge da fa shi jian ！]

english: Of course...
translation: 当然... [dang ran ...]

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 尽管您找到了顾客，但您似乎没有带来正确的食物！你需要[一个/一些][订购的侏儒食物/饮料]！ [jin guan nin zhao dao le gu ke ， dan nin si hu mei you dai lai zheng que de shi wu ！ ni xu yao [ yi ge / yi xie ][ ding gou de zhu ru shi wu / yin liao ]！]

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 恐怕预制菜肴不行。对于 Aluft Aloft 的顾客来说，只有手工制作的 Gnome Cuisine 才足够好。 [kong pa yu zhi cai yao bu xing 。 dui yu  Aluft Aloft  de gu ke lai shuo ， zhi you shou gong zhi zuo de  Gnome Cuisine  cai zu gou hao 。]

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Sarble
translation: 你将[一份/一些][订购的侏儒食物/饮料项目]交给Sarble [ni jiang [ yi fen / yi xie ][ ding gou de zhu ru shi wu / yin liao xiang mu ] jiao gei Sarble]

english: Thank you kindly, you might want to grab some toads and worms while you are here.
translation: 谢谢您，您在这里时可能想抓一些蟾蜍和蠕虫。 [xie xie nin ， nin zai zhe li shi ke neng xiang zhua yi xie chan chu he ru chong 。]

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 您有 [number] 个积分用于免费送货令牌。您可能会收到 [number] 块侏儒食物。 [nin you  [number]  ge ji fen yong yu mian fei song huo ling pai 。 nin ke neng hui shou dao  [number]  kuai zhu ru shi wu 。]

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: 不要忘记从 Aluft Gianne jnr 领取免费送货代币。 [bu yao wang ji cong  Aluft Gianne jnr  ling qu mian fei song huo dai bi 。]

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 你的交货太晚了！返回 Aluft jnr。以获得另一个订单。您丢弃了送货箱，因为您不再需要它了。 [ni de jiao huo tai wan le ！ fan hui  Aluft jnr。 yi huo de ling yi ge ding dan 。 nin diu qi le song huo xiang ， yin wei nin bu zai xu yao ta le 。]

english: Welcome to my store, human! Are you interested in buying anything?
translation: 欢迎来到我的商店，人类！你有兴趣买什么吗？ [huan ying lai dao wo de shang dian ， ren lei ！ ni you xing qu mai shen me ma ？]

english: Yes, I'm looking for some armour.
translation: 是的，我正在寻找一些盔甲。 [shi de ， wo zheng zai xun zhao yi xie kui jia 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Yes, I'm looking for some armour.
translation: 是的，我正在寻找一些盔甲。 [shi de ， wo zheng zai xun zhao yi xie kui jia 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: 我不能和你这个外地人说话！与酋长布伦特交谈！ [wo bu neng he ni zhe ge wai di ren shuo hua ！ yu qiu zhang bu lun te jiao tan ！]

english: You stay away from me outerlander!
translation: 你这个外地人离我远点！ [ni zhe ge wai di ren li wo yuan dian ！]

english: They are too suspicious of you for you to get close enough to steal from them.
translation: 他们对你太怀疑了，你无法靠近他们去偷东西。 [ta men dui ni tai huai yi le ， ni wu fa kao jin ta men qu tou dong xi 。]

english: Do you know any council members?
translation: 你认识任何理事会成员吗？ [ni ren shi ren he li shi hui cheng yuan ma ？]

english: I know that I am one.
translation: 我知道我是其中之一。 [wo zhi dao wo shi qi zhong zhi yi 。]

english: Great! Can you vote for me at the council of elders for me to become a Fremennik?
translation: 伟大的！你能在长老会议上投票支持我成为弗里曼尼克人吗？ [wei da de ！ ni neng zai zhang lao hui yi shang tou piao zhi chi wo cheng wei fu li man ni ke ren ma ？]

english: Sure. On one condition.
translation: 当然。在一个条件下。 [dang ran 。 zai yi ge tiao jian xia 。]

english: (sigh) What condition?
translation: （叹气）什么条件？ [（ tan qi ） shen me tiao jian ？]

english: Actually there is no condition! I don't want to vote for you! You seem too gullible to be a Fremennik!
translation: 其实没有条件！我不想投票给你！你看起来太容易受骗了，不像弗雷曼尼克人！ [qi shi mei you tiao jian ！ wo bu xiang tou piao gei ni ！ ni kan qi lai tai rong yi shou pian le ， bu xiang fu lei man ni ke ren ！]

english: It's kind of mean to trick me like that...
translation: 这么欺骗我，未免太卑鄙了…… [zhe me qi pian wo ， wei mian tai bei bi le ……]

english: What do I care? I am a Fremennik and you are just some stupid outerlander! You stupid outerlander!
translation: 我关心什么？我是弗里曼尼克人，而你只是一些愚蠢的外地人！你这个愚蠢的外地人！ [wo guan xin shen me ？ wo shi fu li man ni ke ren ， er ni zhi shi yi xie yu chun de wai di ren ！ ni zhe ge yu chun de wai di ren ！]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: 再次你好[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]。今天你需要我做什么？您永远可以信赖我的帮助！ [zai ci ni hao [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 jin tian ni xu yao wo zuo shen me ？ nin yong yuan ke yi xin lai wo de bang zhu ！]

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。我只是想聊聊。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。 wo zhi shi xiang liao liao 。]

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: 如果您需要我的帮助[弗雷曼尼克名字]，我的门永远敞开。 [ru guo nin xu yao wo de bang zhu [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]， wo de men yong yuan chang kai 。]

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: [弗雷曼尼克名字]...我们已经很久没有见面了！ [[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]... wo men yi jing hen jiu mei you jian mian le ！]

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: 欢迎回来[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]。很高兴在这里见到您！ [huan ying hui lai [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 hen gao xing zai zhe li jian dao nin ！]

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: 我很抱歉[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]！我没时间陪你在这里！ [wo hen bao qian [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！ wo mei shi jian pei ni zai zhe li ！]

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
translation: 没关系，我其实什么都不想要。 [mei guan xi ， wo qi shi shen me dou bu xiang yao 。]

english: How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: 你[弗雷曼尼克名字]怎么样？我希望您这一天一切顺利！ [ni [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ] zen me yang ？ wo xi wang nin zhe yi tian yi qie shun li ！]

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
translation: 我很好，谢谢，你好吗？ [wo hen hao ， xie xie ， ni hao ma ？]

english: All is well with me also!
translation: 我也一切都好！ [wo ye yi qie dou hao ！]

english: Hello to you, too!
translation: 也向你问好！ [ye xiang ni wen hao ！]

english: Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你好。你想要什么东西[弗雷曼尼克名字]吗？ [ni hao 。 ni xiang yao shen me dong xi [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ] ma ？]

english: No, not really.
translation: 不，不是真的。 [bu ， bu shi zhen de 。]

english: Well... okay then!
translation: 嗯……那好吧！ [n …… na hao ba ！]

english: Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
translation: 很高兴见到你[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]。 [hen gao xing jian dao ni [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。]

english: You shame us, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你让我们感到羞耻，[弗雷曼尼克名字]！ [ni rang wo men gan dao xiu chi ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！]

english: How can you steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你怎么能偷我的东西，[弗雷曼尼克名字]？ [ni zen me neng tou wo de dong xi ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]？]

english: You have betrayed your heritage, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你背叛了你的传统，[弗雷曼尼克名字]！ [ni bei pan le ni de chuan tong ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！]

english: Why would you try to steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你为什么要偷我的东西，[弗雷曼尼克名字]？ [ni wei shen me yao tou wo de dong xi ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]？]

english: How are you today?
translation: 你今天怎么样？ [ni jin tian zen me yang ？]

english: **sigh**
That good? Everyone around here seems a little depressed.
translation: 那好？这里的每个人似乎都有些沮丧。 [na hao ？ zhe li de mei ge ren si hu dou you xie ju sang 。]

english: And not particularly talkative.
translation: 而且也不是特别爱说话。 [er qie ye bu shi te bie ai shuo hua 。]

english: I'll leave you to your sighing. It looks like you have plenty to do.
translation: 我会让你叹息。看起来你有很多事情要做。 [wo hui rang ni tan xi 。 kan qi lai ni you hen duo shi qing yao zuo 。]

english: It's a bit grey round here, isn't it?
translation: 这里有点灰色，不是吗？ [zhe li you dian hui se ， bu shi ma ？]

english: It gets you down after a while, you know. There are 273 shades of grey, you know, and we have them all.
translation: 一段时间后它会让你情绪低落，你知道。你知道，有 273 种灰色，我们都有。 [yi duan shi jian hou ta hui rang ni qing xu di luo ， ni zhi dao 。 ni zhi dao ， you  273  zhong hui se ， wo men dou you 。]

english: That's grey-t.
translation: 那是灰色-t。 [na shi hui se -t。]

english: That attempt at humour merely made me more depressed. Leave me alone.
translation: 这种幽默的尝试只会让我更加沮丧。请别打扰我。 [zhe zhong you mo de chang shi zhi hui rang wo geng jia ju sang 。 qing bie da rao wo 。]

english: How's the King treating you then?
translation: 那么国王对你怎么样？ [na me guo wang dui ni zen me yang ？]

english: Like serfs.
translation: 就像农奴一样。 [jiu xiang nong nu yi yang 。]

english: Serf?
translation: 农奴？ [nong nu ？]

english: Yes, you know - peons, plebs, the downtrodden. He treats us like his own personal possessions.
translation: 是的，你知道的——苦工、平民、受压迫者。他对待我们就像对待自己的私人财产一样。 [shi de ， ni zhi dao de —— ku gong 、 ping min 、 shou ya po zhe 。 ta dui dai wo men jiu xiang dui dai zi ji de si ren cai chan yi yang 。]

english: You should leave this place.
translation: 你应该离开这个地方。 [ni ying gai li kai zhe ge di fang 。]

english: I keep trying to save up enough to leave, but the King keeps taxing us! We have no money left.
translation: 我一直想攒够钱离开，但国王却一直向我们征税！我们已经没有钱了。 [wo yi zhi xiang zan gou qian li kai ， dan guo wang que yi zhi xiang wo men zheng shui ！ wo men yi jing mei you qian le 。]

english: Oh dear.
translation: 哦亲爱的。 [o qin ai de 。]

english: Cheer up! It's not the end of the world.
translation: 开心点！这不是世界末日。 [kai xin dian ！ zhe bu shi shi jie mo ri 。]

english: I'd prefer that, if it meant I didn't have to talk to people as inanely happy as you.
translation: 我更喜欢这样，如果这意味着我不必和像你一样快乐的人说话。 [wo geng xi huan zhe yang ， ru guo zhe yi wei zhe wo bu bi he xiang ni yi yang kuai le de ren shuo hua 。]

english: Whoa! I think you need to get out more.
translation: 哇！我觉得你需要多出去走走。 [wa ！ wo jue de ni xu yao duo chu qu zou zou 。]

english: What's with the bucket on your head?
translation: 你头上的水桶是怎么回事？ [ni tou shang de shui tong shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: If I can't see my enemies, they can't see me.
translation: 如果我看不到我的敌人，他们也看不到我。 [ru guo wo kan bu dao wo de di ren ， ta men ye kan bu dao wo 。]

english: Are you sure about that?
translation: 你确定吗？ [ni que ding ma ？]

english: Don't doubt me stranger. This pub will be mine.
translation: 别怀疑我是陌生人。这家酒吧将是我的了。 [bie huai yi wo shi mo sheng ren 。 zhe jia jiu ba jiang shi wo de le 。]

english: I hope you can flex your way to victory.
translation: 我希望你能灵活运用自己的方式走向胜利。 [wo xi wang ni neng ling huo yun yong zi ji de fang shi zou xiang sheng li 。]

english: I think I heard Santa saying we aren't allowed things on your back in the games, by the way.
translation: 顺便说一句，我想我听到圣诞老人说我们不允许在比赛中背着东西。 [shun bian shuo yi ju ， wo xiang wo ting dao sheng dan lao ren shuo wo men bu yun xu zai bi sai zhong bei zhe dong xi 。]

english: Does it look like I play by the rules?
translation: 我看起来像是遵守规则的人吗？ [wo kan qi lai xiang shi zun shou gui ze de ren ma ？]

english: Uh...
I make my own rules.
translation: 我制定自己的规则。 [wo zhi ding zi ji de gui ze 。]

english: Do you want me to make some planks for you? I can make planks from wood, oak, teak and mahogany logs. Or would you like to buy some other housing supplies?
translation: 要我给你做一些木板吗？我可以用木材、橡木、柚木和桃花心木原木制作木板。或者您想购买其他一些住房用品吗？ [yao wo gei ni zuo yi xie mu ban ma ？ wo ke yi yong mu cai 、 xiang mu 、 you mu he tao hua xin mu yuan mu zhi zuo mu ban 。 huo zhe nin xiang gou mai qi ta yi xie zhu fang yong pin ma ？]

english: Yes, please make me some planks.
translation: 是的，请给我做一些木板。 [shi de ， qing gei wo zuo yi xie mu ban 。]

english: You'll need to bring me some more logs.
translation: 你需要给我更多的日志。 [ni xu yao gei wo geng duo de ri zhi 。]

english: Those planks cost 1500 coins. You don't have enough money for all of them.
translation: 这些木板价值 1500 个金币。你没有足够的钱来满足所有这些。 [zhe xie mu ban jia zhi  1500  ge jin bi 。 ni mei you zu gou de qian lai man zu suo you zhe xie 。]

english: I can make planks from wood, oak, teak and mahogany. I don't make planks from other woods as they're no good for making furniture.
translation: 我可以用木材、橡木、柚木和桃花心木制作木板。我不会用其他木材制作木板，因为它们不适合制作家具。 [wo ke yi yong mu cai 、 xiang mu 、 you mu he tao hua xin mu zhi zuo mu ban 。 wo bu hui yong qi ta mu cai zhi zuo mu ban ， yin wei ta men bu shi he zhi zuo jia ju 。]

english: Wood and oak are all over the place, but teak and mahogany can only be found in a few places like Karamja and Etceteria.
translation: 木材和橡木随处可见，但柚木和桃花心木只能在 Karamja 和 Etceteria 等少数地方找到。 [mu cai he xiang mu sui chu ke jian ， dan you mu he tao hua xin mu zhi neng zai  Karamja  he  Etceteria  deng shao shu di fang zhao dao 。]

english: Nothing, thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。]

english: Well come back when you want some. You can't get good quality planks anywhere but here!
translation: 当你想要一些的时候就回来吧。除了这里，您在任何地方都找不到优质的木板！ [dang ni xiang yao yi xie de shi hou jiu hui lai ba 。 chu le zhe li ， nin zai ren he di fang dou zhao bu dao you zhi di mu ban ！]

english: Yes, please make me some planks.
translation: 是的，请给我做一些木板。 [shi de ， qing gei wo zuo yi xie mu ban 。]

english: What kind of planks can you make?
translation: 您可以制作什么类型的木板？ [nin ke yi zhi zuo shen me lei xing de mu ban ？]

english: Can I buy some housing supplies?
translation: 我可以购买一些住房用品吗？ [wo ke yi gou mai yi xie zhu fang yong pin ma ？]

english: Nothing, thanks
translation: 没什么，谢谢 [mei shen me ， xie xie]

english: I do not have the time nor desire to explain the advanced concepts of theology to you, but you should know that the Dwarves of Cam Torum take a different approach to worship than your kind.
translation: 我没有时间也没有意愿向你们解释先进的神学概念，但你们应该知道，卡姆托鲁姆的矮人采取了与你们同类不同的崇拜方式。 [wo mei you shi jian ye mei you yi yuan xiang ni men jie shi xian jin de shen xue gai nian ， dan ni men ying gai zhi dao ， ka mu tuo lu mu de ai ren cai qu le yu ni men tong lei bu tong de chong bai fang shi 。]

english: Anyway, the point is that without experienced seers to aid you, you may find yourself unable to utilise your prayers as you normally would.
translation: 不管怎样，重点是，如果没有经验丰富的先知来帮助你，你可能会发现自己无法像平常一样利用你的祈祷。 [bu guan zen yang ， zhong dian shi ， ru guo mei you jing yan feng fu de xian zhi lai bang zhu ni ， ni ke neng hui fa xian zi ji wu fa xiang ping chang yi yang li yong ni de qi dao 。]

english: Interesting. So we need to work together to subdue this creature?
translation: 有趣的。那么我们需要共同努力来制服这个生物吗？ [you qu de 。 na me wo men xu yao gong tong nu li lai zhi fu zhe ge sheng wu ma ？]

english: Indeed, just follow our lead and you'll be fine... probably.
translation: 事实上，只要遵循我们的指导，您就会没事......可能。 [shi shi shang ， zhi yao zun xun wo men de zhi dao ， nin jiu hui mei shi ...... ke neng 。]

english: Great! I'm happy to help!
translation: 伟大的！我很乐意提供帮助！ [wei da de ！ wo hen le yi ti gong bang zhu ！]

english: Good. If you have any further questions about your role here, speak to Taala.
translation: 好的。如果您对自己的角色还有任何疑问，请与 Taala 联系。 [hao de 。 ru guo nin dui zi ji de jue se hai you ren he yi wen ， qing yu  Taala  lian xi 。]

english: I will, thank you.
translation: 我会的，谢谢。 [wo hui de ， xie xie 。]

english: Could I trade some tomes in?
translation: 我可以交换一些书籍吗？ [wo ke yi jiao huan yi xie shu ji ma ？]

english: Very well.
translation: 很好。 [hen hao 。]

english: You can't trade in zero of an item.
translation: 您不能以零件物品进行交易。 [nin bu neng yi ling jian wu pin jin xing jiao yi 。]

english: Let's make this beastie move!
translation: 让我们让这只小动物动起来吧！ [rang wo men rang zhe zhi xiao dong wu dong qi lai ba ！]

english: Block its attacks with your prayers!
translation: 用你的祈祷来阻挡它的攻击！ [yong ni de qi dao lai zu dang ta de gong ji ！]

english: Let's convince that beastie to move!
translation: 让我们说服那只野兽移动吧！ [rang wo men shuo fu na zhi ye shou yi dong ba ！]

english: Let's go!
translation: 我们走吧！ [wo men zou ba ！]

english: Nicely done!
translation: 干得好！ [gan de hao ！]

english: Steady now!
translation: 现在稳了！ [xian zai wen le ！]

english: We need to charge all of the pillars using our prayers!
translation: 我们需要用我们的祈祷来冲锋所有的柱子！ [wo men xu yao yong wo men de qi dao lai chong feng suo you de zhu zi ！]

english: Keep praying to charge the pillars!
translation: 继续祈祷，为柱子充电！ [ji xu qi dao ， wei zhu zi chong dian ！]

english: Keep praying to bolster your strength!
translation: 继续祈祷以增强你的力量！ [ji xu qi dao yi zeng qiang ni de li liang ！]

english: Excellent! The pillars are boosting your strength!
translation: 出色的！支柱正在增强你的力量！ [chu se de ！ zhi zhu zheng zai zeng qiang ni de li liang ！]

english: Well done! The power of the pillars is yours!
translation: 干得好！柱子的力量就是你的！ [gan de hao ！ zhu zi de li liang jiu shi ni de ！]

english: It's shielded itself! You need to break its concentration!
translation: 它自己被屏蔽了！你需要打破它的浓度！ [ta zi ji bei ping bi le ！ ni xu yao da po ta de nong du ！]

english: Watch out for its slam!
translation: 小心它的猛击！ [xiao xin ta de meng ji ！]

english: Go for the tail! It's a weakspot!
translation: 去找尾巴吧！这是一个弱点！ [qu zhao wei ba ba ！ zhe shi yi ge ruo dian ！]

english: Well done! Now, let's weaken it a little more!
translation: 干得好！现在，让我们再削弱一点！ [gan de hao ！ xian zai ， rang wo men zai xue ruo yi dian ！]

english: We did it! Well done!
translation: 我们做到了！干得好！ [wo men zuo dao le ！ gan de hao ！]

english: Oof!
translation: 钱币！ [qian bi ！]

english: What are you doing up here? It doesn't seem very safe.
translation: 你在这儿做什么？看起来不太安全。 [ni zai zhe er zuo shen me ？ kan qi lai bu tai an quan 。]

english: Could I trade some tomes in?
translation: 我可以交换一些书籍吗？ [wo ke yi jiao huan yi xie shu ji ma ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Forgive me, my child, but I have little time to talk. There is always plenty of Ranul's work to be done here in the Colosseum.
translation: 请原谅我，我的孩子，但我没有时间说话。拉努尔在罗马斗兽场总是有很多工作要做。 [qing yuan liang wo ， wo de hai zi ， dan wo mei you shi jian shuo hua 。 la nu er zai luo ma dou shou chang zong shi you hen duo gong zuo yao zuo 。]

english: Can you tell me a bit about your people?
translation: 你能告诉我一些关于你的人的事吗？ [ni neng gao su wo yi xie guan yu ni de ren de shi ma ？]

english: Ok. Like what?
translation: 好的。比如什么？ [hao de 。 bi ru shen me ？]

english: How about the values of the Moon clan!
translation: 月族的价值观又如何！ [yue zu de jia zhi guan you ru he ！]

english: Let me see... We value knowledge of self because it is this that gives us our strength! It is most important!
translation: 让我想想...我们重视自我认识，因为正是它给了我们力量！这是最重要的！ [rang wo xiang xiang ... wo men zhong shi zi wo ren shi ， yin wei zheng shi ta gei le wo men li liang ！ zhe shi zui zhong yao de ！]

english: Well... I know things about myself. I know I like hot chocolate!
translation: 嗯……我了解我自己。我知道我喜欢热巧克力！ [n …… wo liao jie wo zi ji 。 wo zhi dao wo xi huan re qiao ke li ！]

english: I was meaning something a little deeper than that. We also like to see someone listen. You know how they say a wise man listens?
translation: 我的意思比这更深一些。我们也喜欢看到有人倾听。你知道他们怎么说智者倾听吗？ [wo de yi si bi zhe geng shen yi xie 。 wo men ye xi huan kan dao you ren qing ting 。 ni zhi dao ta men zen me shuo zhi zhe qing ting ma ？]

english: Did you hear me?
translation: 你听到我说话了吗？ [ni ting dao wo shuo hua le ma ？]

english: .... I'm listening.
translation: ....我在听。 [.... wo zai ting 。]

english: Most wise.
translation: 最明智。 [zui ming zhi 。]

english: Huh?
Hi, I...
translation: 嗨，我... [hai ， wo ...]

english: What are you doing here, Fremennik?!
translation: 你在这里做什么，弗雷曼尼克？！ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ， fu lei man ni ke ？！]

english: I have a seal of pass...
translation: 我有通行证... [wo you tong xing zheng ...]

english: No you do not! Begone!
translation: 不，你不！走开！ [bu ， ni bu ！ zou kai ！]

english: Ooops. Suppose I need a seal of passage when I'm walking around that island.
translation: 哎呀。假设我在那个岛上行走时需要通行密封。 [ai ya 。 jia she wo zai na ge dao shang hang zou shi xu yao tong xing mi feng 。]

english: You're not Osman. Who are you?
translation: 你不是奥斯曼。你是谁？ [ni bu shi ao si man 。 ni shi shui ？]

english: My name is Selim. Osman is currently on a diplomatic visit. I expect to be filling in for him for the forseeable future.
translation: 我叫塞利姆。奥斯曼目前正在进行外交访问。我希望在可预见的将来能够代替他。 [wo jiao sai li mu 。 ao si man mu qian zheng zai jin xing wai jiao fang wen 。 wo xi wang zai ke yu jian de jiang lai neng gou dai ti ta 。]

english: Okay... But where is he really?
translation: 好吧……但是他到底在哪里？ [hao ba …… dan shi ta dao di zai na li ？]

english: I have told you all that I can.
translation: 我已经告诉你我能告诉你的一切了。 [wo yi jing gao su ni wo neng gao su ni de yi qie le 。]

english: But who should I take my sq'irk juice to now?
translation: 但现在我应该把我的 sq'irk 果汁送给谁呢？ [dan xian zai wo ying gai ba wo de  sq'irk  guo zhi song gei shui ne ？]

english: I am partial to that juice myself. I will happily take any off your hands.
translation: 我自己就偏爱那种果汁。我很乐意从你手中拿走任何东西。 [wo zi ji jiu pian ai na zhong guo zhi 。 wo hen le yi cong ni shou zhong na zou ren he dong xi 。]

english: Now, do you need something?
translation: 现在，你需要什么吗？ [xian zai ， ni xu yao shen me ma ？]

english: Do you need something?
translation: 你需要什么东西吗？ [ni xu yao shen me dong xi ma ？]

english: Like my master, I am partial to juice from the sq'irk fruit. I would appreciate it if you could bring me some.
translation: 和我的主人一样，我也偏爱 sq'irk 水果的果汁。如果你能给我带来一些，我将不胜感激。 [he wo de zhu ren yi yang ， wo ye pian ai  sq'irk  shui guo de guo zhi 。 ru guo ni neng gei wo dai lai yi xie ， wo jiang bu sheng gan ji 。]

english: I'd like to talk about sq'irks.
translation: 我想谈谈 sq'irks。 [wo xiang tan tan  sq'irks。]

english: I have some sq'irk juice for you.
translation: 我有一些果汁给你。 [wo you yi xie guo zhi gei ni 。]

english: Thank you very much. If you get some more sq'irks be sure to come back.
translation: 非常感谢。如果你再收到一些奇怪的声音，一定要回来。 [fei chang gan xie 。 ru guo ni zai shou dao yi xie qi guai de sheng yin ， yi ding yao hui lai 。]

english: I will. It's been a pleasure doing business with you.
translation: 我会。很高兴与您开展业务。 [wo hui 。 hen gao xing yu nin kai zhan ye wu 。]

english: Of course. What would you like to know?
translation: 当然。您想知道什么？ [dang ran 。 nin xiang zhi dao shen me ？]

english: Where do I get sq'irks?
translation: 我在哪里可以得到 sq'irks？ [wo zai na li ke yi de dao  sq'irks？]

english: There is a sorceress near the south eastern edge of Al Kharid who grows them. She used to be friends with Osman, but they fell out.
translation: 在阿尔卡里德东南边缘附近有一位女术士种植它们。她曾经和奥斯曼是朋友，但他们闹翻了。 [zai a er ka li de dong nan bian yuan fu jin you yi wei nv shu shi zhong zhi ta men 。 ta ceng jing he ao si man shi peng you ， dan ta men nao fan le 。]

english: What happened?
translation: 发生了什么？ [fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: I don't know. All I know is she won't give us any more fruit.
translation: 我不知道。我只知道她不会再给我们水果了。 [wo bu zhi dao 。 wo zhi zhi dao ta bu hui zai gei wo men shui guo le 。]

english: So all I have to do is ask her for some fruit for you?
translation: 所以我只要向她要一些水果给你就可以了？ [suo yi wo zhi yao xiang ta yao yi xie shui guo gei ni jiu ke yi le ？]

english: I doubt it will be that easy. She is not renowned for her generosity and is very secretive about her garden's location.
translation: 我怀疑事情会那么容易。她并不以慷慨而闻名，而且对她花园的位置也非常保密。 [wo huai yi shi qing hui na me rong yi 。 ta bing bu yi kang kai er wen ming ， er qie dui ta hua yuan de wei zhi ye fei chang bao mi 。]

english: Oh come on, it should be easy enough to find.
translation: 哦，来吧，应该很容易找到。 [o ， lai ba ， ying gai hen rong yi zhao dao 。]

english: Her garden has remained hidden even from Osman. I believe it must be hidden by magical means.
translation: 她的花园甚至对奥斯曼来说也是隐秘的。我相信它一定是用魔法隐藏起来的。 [ta de hua yuan shen zhi dui ao si man lai shuo ye shi yin mi de 。 wo xiang xin ta yi ding shi yong mo fa yin cang qi lai de 。]

english: I see. And why can't you do this yourself?
translation: 我懂了。为什么你不能自己做呢？ [wo dong le 。 wei shen me ni bu neng zi ji zuo ne ？]

english: My work requires that I remain here.
translation: 我的工作要求我留在这里。 [wo de gong zuo yao qiu wo liu zai zhe li 。]

english: Okay. This should be an interesting task.
translation: 好的。这应该是一个有趣的任务。 [hao de 。 zhe ying gai shi yi ge you qu de ren wu 。]

english: How should I squeeze the fruit?
translation: 水果应该怎么榨呢？ [shui guo ying gai zen me zha ne ？]

english: Use a pestle and mortar. Make sure you have an empty glass with you to collect the juice.
translation: 使用杵和研钵。确保随身携带一个空玻璃杯来收集果汁。 [shi yong chu he yan bo 。 que bao sui shen xie dai yi ge kong bo li bei lai shou ji guo zhi 。]

english: Is there a reward for getting these sq'irks?
translation: 获得这些sq'irks有奖励吗？ [huo de zhe xie sq'irks you jiang li ma ？]

english: Of course. I'll train you in the art of Thieving for your troubles.
translation: 当然。我会训练你偷窃的艺术来解决你的麻烦。 [dang ran 。 wo hui xun lian ni tou qie de yi shu lai jie jue ni de ma fan 。]

english: How much training will you give?
translation: 你会提供多少培训？ [ni hui ti gong duo shao pei xun ？]

english: That depends on the quantity and ripeness of the sq'irks you put into the juice.
translation: 这取决于您放入果汁中的果汁的数量和成熟度。 [zhe qu jue yu nin fang ru guo zhi zhong de guo zhi de shu liang he cheng shu du 。]

english: That sounds fair enough.
translation: 这听起来很公平。 [zhe ting qi lai hen gong ping 。]

english: What's so good about sq'irk juice?
translation: sq'irk果汁有什么好处？ [sq'irk guo zhi you shen me hao chu ？]

english: It is a sweet nectar for a thief or spy. It makes light fingers lighter, fleet feet flightier and comes in four different colours for those who are easily amused.
translation: 对于小偷或间谍来说，这是一种甜蜜的花蜜。它让轻快的手指变得更轻，飞快的脚步变得更加轻快，并且有四种不同的颜色可供那些容易被逗乐的人使用。 [dui yu xiao tou huo jian die lai shuo ， zhe shi yi zhong tian mi de hua mi 。 ta rang qing kuai de shou zhi bian de geng qing ， fei kuai de jiao bu bian de geng jia qing kuai ， bing qie you si zhong bu tong de yan se ke gong na xie rong yi bei dou le de ren shi yong 。]

english: Selim starts salivating at the thought of sq'irk juice.
translation: 塞利姆一想​​到 sq'irk 果汁就开始流口水。 [sai li mu yi xiang ​​ dao  sq'irk  guo zhi jiu kai shi liu kou shui 。]

english: It wouldn't have addictive properties, would it?
translation: 它不会让人上瘾，不是吗？ [ta bu hui rang ren shang yin ， bu shi ma ？]

english: It only holds power over those with poor self-control. Something which I have an abundance of.
translation: 它只对那些自制力差的人有影响力。我拥有丰富的东西。 [ta zhi dui na xie zi zhi li cha de ren you ying xiang li 。 wo yong you feng fu de dong xi 。]

english: I see.
translation: 我懂了。 [wo dong le 。]

english: I should go.
translation: 我该走了。 [wo gai zou le 。]

english: Could you sell me another Keris?
translation: 你能再卖给我一把马来短剑吗？ [ni neng zai mai gei wo yi ba ma lai duan jian ma ？]

english: Would you like a dagger or a partisan?
translation: 你想要一把匕首还是一把游击队？ [ni xiang yao yi ba bi shou hai shi yi ba you ji dui ？]

english: A dagger.
translation: 一把匕首。 [yi ba bi shou 。]

english: That will be 20,000 coins.
translation: 这将是 20,000 个硬币。 [zhe jiang shi  20,000  ge ying bi 。]

english: I'll take one.
translation: 我要一份。 [wo yao yi fen 。]

english: Actually, I don't seem to have enough money on me.
translation: 事实上，我身上的钱似乎不够。 [shi shi shang ， wo shen shang de qian si hu bu gou 。]

english: That's too much.
translation: 那就太多了。 [na jiu tai duo le 。]

english: Well you know where I am if you reconsider.
translation: 好吧，如果你重新考虑一下，你就知道我在哪里了。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni chong xin kao lv yi xia ， ni jiu zhi dao wo zai na li le 。]

english: A partisan.
translation: 一个党派。 [yi ge dang pai 。]

english: That will be 60,000 coins.
translation: 那将是 60,000 个硬币。 [na jiang shi  60,000  ge ying bi 。]

english: Actually, I'm good.
translation: 其实我很好。 [qi shi wo hen hao 。]

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Well done. I have new information to share with you.
translation: 干得好。我有新信息要与您分享。 [gan de hao 。 wo you xin xin xi yao yu nin fen xiang 。]

english: I'd like to talk about sq'irks.
translation: 我想谈谈 sq'irks。 [wo xiang tan tan  sq'irks。]

english: Could you sell me another Keris?
translation: 你能再卖给我一把马来短剑吗？ [ni neng zai mai gei wo yi ba ma lai duan jian ma ？]

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Is there anything I can help you with?
translation: 有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

english: Where do I get sq'irks?
translation: 我在哪里可以得到 sq'irks？ [wo zai na li ke yi de dao  sq'irks？]

english: How should I squeeze the fruit?
translation: 水果应该怎么榨呢？ [shui guo ying gai zen me zha ne ？]

english: Is there a reward for getting these sq'irks?
translation: 获得这些sq'irks有奖励吗？ [huo de zhe xie sq'irks you jiang li ma ？]
