translation: sq'irk果汁有什么好处？ [sq'irk guo zhi you shen me hao chu ？]

english: I should go.
translation: 我该走了。 [wo gai zou le 。]

english: A dagger.
translation: 一把匕首。 [yi ba bi shou 。]

english: I'll take one.
translation: 我要一份。 [wo yao yi fen 。]

english: That's too much.
translation: 那就太多了。 [na jiu tai duo le 。]

english: A partisan.
translation: 一个党派。 [yi ge dang pai 。]

english: Actually, I'm good.
translation: 其实我很好。 [qi shi wo hen hao 。]

english: Hello
translation: 你好 [ni hao]

english: Hello Bwana. Are you interested in buying a ticket for the 'Lady of the Waves'?
translation: 你好，布瓦纳。您有兴趣购买“波浪女士号”的门票吗？ [ni hao ， bu wa na 。 nin you xing qu gou mai “ bo lang nv shi hao ” de men piao ma ？]

english: Yes, that sounds great!
translation: 是的，听起来很棒！ [shi de ， ting qi lai hen bang ！]

english: Sorry Bwana, you don't have enough money. Come back when you have 25 coins.
translation: 抱歉，布瓦纳，你没有足够的钱。当你有25个金币时再回来。 [bao qian ， bu wa na ， ni mei you zu gou de qian 。 dang ni you 25 ge jin bi shi zai hui lai 。]

english: Great, nice doing business with you.
translation: 太好了，很高兴与您开展业务。 [tai hao le ， hen gao xing yu nin kai zhan ye wu 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Fair enough Bwana, let me know if you change your mind.
translation: 公平地说，布瓦纳，如果你改变主意，请告诉我。 [gong ping di shuo ， bu wa na ， ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， qing gao su wo 。]

english: It's a ship that can take you to either Port Sarim or Port Khazard. The ship lies west of Shilo Village and south of Cairn Island. The tickets cost 25 coins. Would you like to purchase a ticket Bwana?
translation: 这艘船可以带您前往沙里姆港或卡扎德港。该船位于希洛村以西、凯恩岛以南。门票是25个硬币。您想购买 Bwana 的门票吗？ [zhe sou chuan ke yi dai nin qian wang sha li mu gang huo ka zha de gang 。 gai chuan wei yu xi luo cun yi xi 、 kai en dao yi nan 。 men piao shi 25 ge ying bi 。 nin xiang gou mai  Bwana  de men piao ma ？]

english: I'm getting out of here Bwana, the place is infested with zombies.
translation: 我要离开这里，布瓦纳，这个地方到处都是僵尸。 [wo yao li kai zhe li ， bu wa na ， zhe ge di fang dao chu dou shi jiang shi 。]

english: Yes, that sounds great!
translation: 是的，听起来很棒！ [shi de ， ting qi lai hen bang ！]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Tell me more about the ship.
translation: 告诉我更多关于这艘船的信息。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu zhe sou chuan de xin xi 。]

english: I want to see you sweat soldier!
translation: 我想看看你们这些汗水战士！ [wo xiang kan kan ni men zhe xie han shui zhan shi ！]

english: Yes sir!
translation: 是的，先生！ [shi de ， xian sheng ！]

english: Put your back into it soldier!
translation: 把你的背部投入其中，士兵！ [ba ni de bei bu tou ru qi zhong ， shi bing ！]

english: That dummy is the enemy. Kill it!
translation: 那个假人就是敌人。杀了它！ [na ge jia ren jiu shi di ren 。 sha le ta ！]

english: Keep it up soldier!
translation: 坚持下去，士兵！ [jian chi xia qu ， shi bing ！]

english: Good work soldier!
translation: 干得好，士兵！ [gan de hao ， shi bing ！]

english: You're not out for a sunday stroll soldier!
translation: 你不是周日出去散步的士兵！ [ni bu shi zhou ri chu qu san bu di shi bing ！]

english: Work it!
translation: 干吧！ [gan ba ！]

english: My daughter can hit harder than that!
translation: 我女儿打得比那还狠！ [wo nv er da de bi na hai hen ！]

english: Push it!
translation: 推吧！ [tui ba ！]

english: Well done soldier!
translation: 干得好，士兵！ [gan de hao ， shi bing ！]

english: Hello. What are you doing here?
translation: 你好。你在这里做什么？ [ni hao 。 ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: We're here to keep the farmers safe from the lizardmen.
translation: 我们来这里是为了保护农民免受蜥蜴人的侵害。 [wo men lai zhe li shi wei le bao hu nong min mian shou xi yi ren de qin hai 。]

english: There's not many of you though.
translation: 不过你们的人并不多。 [bu guo ni men de ren bing bu duo 。]

english: Luckily the lizardmen have been focusing their efforts elsewhere. They haven't tried to come up here yet.
translation: 幸运的是，蜥蜴人一直把精力集中在其他地方。他们还没有尝试来这里。 [xing yun de shi ， xi yi ren yi zhi ba jing li ji zhong zai qi ta di fang 。 ta men hai mei you chang shi lai zhe li 。]

english: If they do, we can quickly call in reinforcements if required.
translation: 如果他们这样做了，我们可以在需要时迅速呼叫增援。 [ru guo ta men zhe yang zuo le ， wo men ke yi zai xu yao shi xun su hu jiao zeng yuan 。]

english: I see. Well I'd better let you get on then.
translation: 我懂了。好吧，我最好让你继续下去。 [wo dong le 。 hao ba ， wo zui hao rang ni ji xu xia qu 。]

english: Hello. Do you know anything about the beast causing trouble around here?
translation: 你好。你知道关于在这附近制造麻烦的野兽的事吗？ [ni hao 。 ni zhi dao guan yu zai zhe fu jin zhi zao ma fan de ye shou de shi ma ？]

english: The farmers mentioned it. We haven't seen anything though. Our focus is on the lizardmen.
translation: 农民们提到了这一点。但我们什么也没看到。我们的焦点是蜥蜴人。 [nong min men ti dao le zhe yi dian 。 dan wo men shen me ye mei kan dao 。 wo men de jiao dian shi xi yi ren 。]

english: Surely you'd notice a big beast wondering around though?
translation: 你肯定会注意到一只巨大的野兽在附近徘徊吗？ [ni ken ding hui zhu yi dao yi zhi ju da de ye shou zai fu jin pai huai ma ？]

english: The farmers said it came at night. We're not on shift then.
translation: 农民们说是晚上来的。那时我们不值班。 [nong min men shuo shi wan shang lai de 。 na shi wo men bu zhi ban 。]

english: But then who's guarding the farm at night?
translation: 但是晚上谁来守卫农场呢？ [dan shi wan shang shui lai shou wei nong chang ne ？]

english: That's not our problem. We're just here to follow orders.
translation: 那不是我们的问题。我们只是来这里执行命令的。 [na bu shi wo men de wen ti 。 wo men zhi shi lai zhe li zhi xing ming ling de 。]

english: Fine. I'll find the beast myself.
translation: 美好的。我会亲自找到野兽。 [mei hao de 。 wo hui qin zi zhao dao ye shou 。]

english: Hello. I'm looking for Sophia Hughes.
translation: 你好。我在找索菲亚休斯。 [ni hao 。 wo zai zhao suo fei ya xiu si 。]

english: Sophia Hughes? The councillor?
translation: 索菲亚·休斯？议员？ [suo fei ya · xiu si ？ yi yuan ？]

english: That's right. I think she might have come here at some point.
translation: 这是正确的。我想她可能在某个时候来到这里。 [zhe shi zheng que de 。 wo xiang ta ke neng zai mou ge shi hou lai dao zhe li 。]

english: Well, if she did it wasn't recently. We'd have noticed a councillor.
translation: 好吧，如果她这么做的话，那也不是最近发生的。我们会注意到一位议员。 [hao ba ， ru guo ta zhe me zuo de hua ， na ye bu shi zui jin fa sheng de 。 wo men hui zhu yi dao yi wei yi yuan 。]

english: I see. Thanks for the help.
translation: 我懂了。感谢您的帮助。 [wo dong le 。 gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]

english: Private [player name], atten-SHUN! You've been recommended for my corps. Do you think you can be the best?
translation: 私人[玩家姓名]，注意-SHUN！你已被推荐加入我的军团。你认为你能成为最好的吗？ [si ren [ wan jia xing ming ]， zhu yi -SHUN！ ni yi bei tui jian jia ru wo de jun tuan 。 ni ren wei ni neng cheng wei zui hao de ma ？]

english: Sir, yes sir!
translation: 先生，是的先生！ [xian sheng ， shi de xian sheng ！]

english: No thanks, I'm not interested.
translation: 不，谢谢，我不感兴趣。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo bu gan xing qu 。]

english: Move yourself, Private! Follow my orders and you may, just may, leave here in a fit state for my corps!
translation: 行动起来吧，二等兵！听从我的命令，你们可以，只是可以，以健康的状态离开这里，加入我的军团！ [xing dong qi lai ba ， er deng bing ！ ting cong wo de ming ling ， ni men ke yi ， zhi shi ke yi ， yi jian kang de zhuang tai li kai zhe li ， jia ru wo de jun tuan ！]

english: I haven't given you the order yet, worm!
translation: 我还没给你下命令呢，虫子！ [wo hai mei gei ni xia ming ling ne ， chong zi ！]

english: (continues with the dialogue below)
translation: （继续下面的对话） [（ ji xu xia mian de dui hua ）]

english: I want to see you on that mat doing star jumps, private!
translation: 我想看到你在垫子上做星星跳跃，列兵！ [wo xiang kan dao ni zai dian zi shang zuo xing xing tiao yue ， lie bing ！]

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。 [hao de 。]

english: I want to leave.
translation: 我想离开。 [wo xiang li kai 。]

english: Pathetic. Get out of here then.
translation: 可怜的。那就离开这里吧。 [ke lian de 。 na jiu li kai zhe li ba 。]

english: Drop and give me push ups on that mat, private!
translation: 趴在垫子上给我做俯卧撑，私人！ [pa zai dian zi shang gei wo zuo fu wo cheng ， si ren ！]

english: Get yourself over there and jog on that mat, private!
translation: 到那里去，在垫子上慢跑，私人！ [dao na li qu ， zai dian zi shang man pao ， si ren ！]

english: Get on that mat and give me sit ups, private!
translation: 站到垫子上，给我做仰卧起坐，私人！ [zhan dao dian zi shang ， gei wo zuo yang wo qi zuo ， si ren ！]

english: Well I'll be, you actually did it, Private. Now take this and get out of my sight.
translation: 好吧，我会的，你确实做到了，二等兵。现在拿着这个离开我的视线。 [hao ba ， wo hui de ， ni que shi zuo dao le ， er deng bing 。 xian zai na zhe zhe ge li kai wo de shi xian 。]

english: The player is teleported back to their original position.
translation: 玩家被传送回原来的位置。 [wan jia bei chuan song hui yuan lai de wei zhi 。]

english: Wrong exercise, worm! Drop and give me push ups on that mat, private!
translation: 错误的练习方式，虫子！趴在垫子上给我做俯卧撑，私人！ [cuo wu de lian xi fang shi ， chong zi ！ pa zai dian zi shang gei wo zuo fu wo cheng ， si ren ！]

english: Wrong exercise, worm! I want to see you on that mat doing star jumps, private!
translation: 错误的练习方式，虫子！我想看到你在垫子上做星星跳跃，列兵！ [cuo wu de lian xi fang shi ， chong zi ！ wo xiang kan dao ni zai dian zi shang zuo xing xing tiao yue ， lie bing ！]

english: Wrong exercise, worm! Get on that mat and give me sit ups, private!
translation: 错误的练习方式，虫子！站到垫子上，给我做仰卧起坐，私人！ [cuo wu de lian xi fang shi ， chong zi ！ zhan dao dian zi shang ， gei wo zuo yang wo qi zuo ， si ren ！]

english: Wrong exercise, worm! Get yourself over there and jog on that mat, private!
translation: 错误的练习方式，虫子！到那里去，在垫子上慢跑，私人！ [cuo wu de lian xi fang shi ， chong zi ！ dao na li qu ， zai dian zi shang man pao ， si ren ！]

english: As you were, soldier.
translation: 就像你一样，士兵。 [jiu xiang ni yi yang ， shi bing 。]

english: Private [player name], atten-SHUN!
translation: 私人[玩家姓名]，注意-SHUN！ [si ren [ wan jia xing ming ]， zhu yi -SHUN！]

english: Stop day-dreaming, Private [player name]!
translation: 别做白日梦了，二等兵[玩家名字]！ [bie zuo bai ri meng le ， er deng bing [ wan jia ming zi ]！]

english: Get your rear in gear, Private [player name]!
translation: 准备好你的后方，二等兵[玩家名字]！ [zhun bei hao ni de hou fang ， er deng bing [ wan jia ming zi ]！]

english: I want you for my corps, Private [player name]!
translation: 我想要你加入我的军团，二等兵[玩家名字]！ [wo xiang yao ni jia ru wo de jun tuan ， er deng bing [ wan jia ming zi ]！]

english: Maybe later.
translation: 也许以后吧。 [ye xu yi hou ba 。]

english: Sir, yes sir!
translation: 先生，是的先生！ [xian sheng ， shi de xian sheng ！]

english: No thanks, I'm not interested.
translation: 不，谢谢，我不感兴趣。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo bu gan xing qu 。]

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。 [hao de 。]

english: I want to leave.
translation: 我想离开。 [wo xiang li kai 。]

english: Adventurer, if you're looking to head back in there, I'd suggest you reconsider.
translation: 冒险家，如果你想回去的话，我建议你重新考虑一下。 [mao xian jia ， ru guo ni xiang hui qu de hua ， wo jian yi ni chong xin kao lv yi xia 。]

english: Why?
translation: 为什么？ [wei shen me ？]

english: There is a horror within that has already claimed the lives of some of our soldiers.
translation: 其中的恐怖已经夺去了我们一些士兵的生命。 [qi zhong de kong bu yi jing duo qu le wo men yi xie shi bing de sheng ming 。]

english: Horror? What horror?
translation: 恐怖？什么恐怖？ [kong bu ？ shen me kong bu ？]

english: A nightmare that should not exist. A phantom of the beast that Jhallan took the form of. General Khazard called it a muspah.
translation: 一场不应该存在的噩梦。贾兰所化身的野兽幻影。卡扎德将军称其为muspah。 [yi chang bu ying gai cun zai de e meng 。 jia lan suo hua shen de ye shou huan ying 。 ka zha de jiang jun cheng qi wei muspah。]

english: A phantom? So it's not actually real?
translation: 幻影？那么这实际上不是真的吗？ [huan ying ？ na me zhe shi ji shang bu shi zhen de ma ？]

english: It is, and it isn't. Truth be told, I don't fully understand it myself. General Khazard called it a remnant of dark energy. Raw magic released from the prison that has taken form.
translation: 是的，也不是。说实话，我自己也不太明白。卡扎德将军称其为暗能量的残余。原始魔法从已经形成的监狱中释放出来。 [shi de ， ye bu shi 。 shuo shi hua ， wo zi ji ye bu tai ming bai 。 ka zha de jiang jun cheng qi wei an neng liang de can yu 。 yuan shi mo fa cong yi jing xing cheng de jian yu zhong shi fang chu lai 。]

english: All I know is that whatever it is, real or otherwise, it's very dangerous.
translation: 我所知道的是，无论它是什么，无论是真实的还是其他的，它都是非常危险的。 [wo suo zhi dao de shi ， wu lun ta shi shen me ， wu lun shi zhen shi de hai shi qi ta de ， ta dou shi fei chang wei xian de 。]

english: So I can't go in?
translation: 那我就不能进去了？ [na wo jiu bu neng jin qu le ？]

english: I won't stop you, but if it all goes wrong, don't expect me to come and save you either.
translation: 我不会阻止你，但如果出了问题，也别指望我会来救你。 [wo bu hui zu zhi ni ， dan ru guo chu le wen ti ， ye bie zhi wang wo hui lai jiu ni 。]

english: I'll keep that in mind. Thanks for the information.
translation: 我会记住这一点。感谢您提供信息。 [wo hui ji zhu zhe yi dian 。 gan xie nin ti gong xin xi 。]

english: Be on your guard, adventurer. This place is dangerous.
translation: 小心点，冒险家。这个地方很危险。 [xiao xin dian ， mao xian jia 。 zhe ge di fang hen wei xian 。]

english: Ah, hello! Isn't it a wonderful day?
translation: 啊，你好！这不是美好的一天吗？ [a ， ni hao ！ zhe bu shi mei hao de yi tian ma ？]

english: You seem happy.
translation: 你看起来很高兴。 [ni kan qi lai hen gao xing 。]

english: And why wouldn't I be? I'm part of the best fighting force in the world! The Shayzien Army!
translation: 我为什么不呢？我是世界上最强大的战斗力量的一员！沙吉恩军队！ [wo wei shen me bu ne ？ wo shi shi jie shang zui qiang da de zhan dou li liang de yi yuan ！ sha ji en jun dui ！]

english: The best?
translation: 最好的？ [zui hao de ？]

english: Of course!
translation: 当然！ [dang ran ！]

english: So the Shayzien Army has no weaknesses at all?
translation: 那么Shayzien军就没有任何弱点了？ [na me Shayzien jun jiu mei you ren he ruo dian le ？]

english: Well... I suppose we don't really have any magical capabilities. That's more an Arceuus thing. Though of course, they're mostly pacifists. Apparently they didn't even properly fight in the War of the Five Houses.
translation: 嗯……我想我们真的没有任何神奇的能力。这更像是阿尔宙斯的事情。当然，他们大多是和平主义者。显然他们甚至没有在五宫之战中正常战斗。 [n …… wo xiang wo men zhen de mei you ren he shen qi de neng li 。 zhe geng xiang shi a er zhou si de shi qing 。 dang ran ， ta men da duo shi he ping zhu yi zhe 。 xian ran ta men shen zhi mei you zai wu gong zhi zhan zhong zheng chang zhan dou 。]

english: Still, I guess 'War of the Four Houses while House Arceuus watched' isn't as catchy a name.
translation: 不过，我想“阿尔宙斯家族观看的四家族之战”这个名字并不那么吸引人。 [bu guo ， wo xiang “ a er zhou si jia zu guan kan de si jia zu zhi zhan ” zhe ge ming zi bing bu na me xi yin ren 。]

english: Right... But apart from magic, the Shayzien Army has no weaknesses?
translation: 是啊……不过除了魔法之外，沙吉恩军就没有弱点了？ [shi a …… bu guo chu le mo fa zhi wai ， sha ji en jun jiu mei you ruo dian le ？]

english: Well... we are just an army. We don't have a navy, so can't really deal with any threats at sea. Lady Piscarilius is meant to be in charge of the Kourend Navy. Problem is, it doesn't actually exist.
translation: 嗯……我们只是一支军队。我们没有海军，所以无法真正应对海上的任何威胁。皮斯卡利留斯女士将负责库伦德海军。问题是，它实际上并不存在。 [n …… wo men zhi shi yi zhi jun dui 。 wo men mei you hai jun ， suo yi wu fa zhen zheng ying dui hai shang de ren he wei xie 。 pi si ka li liu si nv shi jiang fu ze ku lun de hai jun 。 wen ti shi ， ta shi ji shang bing bu cun zai 。]

english: How come?
translation: 怎么会？ [zen me hui ？]

english: Lady Piscarilius has little interest in that sort of thing. Lord Shayzien wants to establish a Shayzien Navy instead, but there's a lot of pushback from the rest of the kingdom.
translation: 皮斯卡利留斯女士对这类事情没什么兴趣。沙伊恩勋爵希望建立一支沙伊恩海军，但遭到王国其他地区的强烈反对。 [pi si ka li liu si nv shi dui zhe lei shi qing mei shen me xing qu 。 sha yi en xun jue xi wang jian li yi zhi sha yi en hai jun ， dan zao dao wang guo qi ta di qu de qiang lie fan dui 。]

english: They worry about Shayzien having too much power. It does mean we'll have big problems against any enemy navy, but on their heads be it I suppose.
translation: 他们担心 Shayzien 拥有太多权力。这确实意味着我们将在对抗任何敌方海军时遇到大问题，但我想这是在他们的头上。 [ta men dan xin  Shayzien  yong you tai duo quan li 。 zhe que shi yi wei zhe wo men jiang zai dui kang ren he di fang hai jun shi yu dao da wen ti ， dan wo xiang zhe shi zai ta men de tou shang 。]

english: Anyway, apart from those minor issues, the Shayzien Army has absolutely no weaknesses!
translation: 无论如何，除了那些小毛病之外，沙吉恩军绝对没有任何弱点！ [wu lun ru he ， chu le na xie xiao mao bing zhi wai ， sha ji en jun jue dui mei you ren he ruo dian ！]

english: If you say so. See you later.
translation: 如果你这么说的话。稍后见。 [ru guo ni zhe me shuo de hua 。 shao hou jian 。]

english: Goodbye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Hi there; what is this room?
translation: 你好呀;这是什么房间？ [ni hao ya ; zhe shi shen me fang jian ？]

english: Glad you asked. The first thing you will notice on trying to enter the room is that you will be asked to choose either the Attacker, Defender, Collector, Healer or 'any' role.
translation: 很高兴你问了。尝试进入房间时，您会注意到的第一件事是，系统会要求您选择攻击者、防御者、收集者、治疗者或“任何”角色。 [hen gao xing ni wen le 。 chang shi jin ru fang jian shi ， nin hui zhu yi dao de di yi jian shi shi ， xi tong hui yao qiu nin xuan ze gong ji zhe 、 fang yu zhe 、 shou ji zhe 、 zhi liao zhe huo “ ren he ” jue se 。]

english: Okay. I'm following so far.
translation: 好的。到目前为止我正在关注。 [hao de 。 dao mu qian wei zhi wo zheng zai guan zhu 。]

english: Well, the idea with this room is that we will set up a game for you, choosing some other people from within the room. If there are enough players around we will start a game for you.
translation: 嗯，这个房间的想法是，我们将为您设置一个游戏，从房间内选择一些其他人。如果周围有足够的玩家，我们将为您开始游戏。 [n ， zhe ge fang jian de xiang fa shi ， wo men jiang wei nin she zhi yi ge you xi ， cong fang jian nei xuan ze yi xie qi ta ren 。 ru guo zhou wei you zu gou de wan jia ， wo men jiang wei nin kai shi you xi 。]

english: I see. So I just have to wait around for a game?
translation: 我懂了。那我就只能等比赛了？ [wo dong le 。 na wo jiu zhi neng deng bi sai le ？]

english: If you want, or you can look around the other rooms and see if there is anyone waiting around.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，或者你可以看看其他房间，看看是否有人在等。 [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， huo zhe ni ke yi kan kan qi ta fang jian ， kan kan shi fou you ren zai deng 。]

english: Good to see you, adventurer. Hope everything is going well for you out there.
translation: 很高兴见到你，冒险家。希望你一切顺利。 [hen gao xing jian dao ni ， mao xian jia 。 xi wang ni yi qie shun li 。]

english: Not bad, thanks.
translation: 不错，谢谢。 [bu cuo ， xie xie 。]

english: Glad to hear it.
translation: 很高兴听到这个消息。 [hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi 。]

english: Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: 嘿，这是英雄！哇！你太厉害了，你到底是怎么对付那两个少年和加德兰克的？这个小镇很可爱，你做得很好！ [hei ， zhe shi ying xiong ！ wa ！ ni tai li hai le ， ni dao di shi zen me dui fu na liang ge shao nian he jia de lan ke de ？ zhe ge xiao zhen hen ke ai ， ni zuo de hen hao ！]

english: You're more than welcome.
translation: 非常欢迎您。 [fei chang huan ying nin 。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Not that it makes much difference but my name's Sergiu. Like all the other survivors here, I just try to make do and get through each day at a time.

translation: 你不是这附近的人吧……？ [ni bu shi zhe fu jin de ren ba ……？]

english: It is as you say.
translation: 正如你所说。 [zheng ru ni suo shuo 。]

english: So will I lose my armour?
translation: 那么我会失去我的盔甲吗？ [na me wo hui shi qu wo de kui jia ma ？]

english: Lose armour you will if damaged too much it becomes. Rare this is, but still possible. If kill you the armour does, also lose armour you will.
translation: 如果损坏太多，你就会失去盔甲。这种情况很少见，但仍然有可能。如果你的盔甲杀死了你，你也会失去盔甲。 [ru guo sun huai tai duo ， ni jiu hui shi qu kui jia 。 zhe zhong qing kuang hen shao jian ， dan reng ran you ke neng 。 ru guo ni de kui jia sha si le ni ， ni ye hui shi qu kui jia 。]

english: So, occasionally I might lose a bit because it's being bashed about and I'll obviously lose it if I die... that it?
translation: 所以，偶尔我可能会失去一点，因为它被殴打，如果我死了，我显然会失去它......是吗？ [suo yi ， ou er wo ke neng hui shi qu yi dian ， yin wei ta bei ou da ， ru guo wo si le ， wo xian ran hui shi qu ta ...... shi ma ？]

english: Where do the machines come from?
translation: 机器从哪里来？ [ji qi cong na li lai ？]

english: Make them I did, with magics.
translation: 我用魔法制作了它们。 [wo yong mo fa zhi zuo le ta men 。]

english: Magic, in the Warrior's Guild?
translation: 魔法，在战士公会吗？ [mo fa ， zai zhan shi gong hui ma ？]

english: A skilled warrior also am I. Harrallak mistakes does not make. Potential in my invention he sees and opportunity grasps.
translation: 我也是一名熟练的战士。哈拉拉克不会犯错误。他看到了我的发明的潜力并抓住了机会。 [wo ye shi yi ming shu lian de zhan shi 。 ha la la ke bu hui fan cuo wu 。 ta kan dao le wo de fa ming de qian li bing zhua zhu le ji hui 。]

english: I see, so you made the magical machines and Harrallak saw how they could be used in the guild to train warrior's combat... interesting. Harrallak certainly is an intelligent guy.
translation: 我明白了，所以你制造了魔法机器，哈拉拉克看到了如何在公会中使用它们来训练战士的战斗……有趣。哈拉拉克无疑是一个聪明人。 [wo ming bai le ， suo yi ni zhi zao le mo fa ji qi ， ha la la ke kan dao le ru he zai gong hui zhong shi yong ta men lai xun lian zhan shi de zhan dou …… you qu 。 ha la la ke wu yi shi yi ge cong ming ren 。]

english: May I claim my tokens please?
translation: 我可以领取我的代币吗？ [wo ke yi ling qu wo de dai bi ma ？]

english: No space you have carry them for.
translation: 您没有空间携带它们。 [nin mei you kong jian xie dai ta men 。]

english: Right, I need space in my pack for them. I'll be back!
translation: 是的，我的背包里需要空间来容纳它们。我会回来的！ [shi de ， wo de bei bao li xu yao kong jian lai rong na ta men 。 wo hui hui lai de ！]

english: Yes yes! Earned you have [number] token[s]!
translation: 是的，是的！您已获得 [number] 个代币！ [shi de ， shi de ！ nin yi huo de  [number]  ge dai bi ！]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: No tokens earned have you. In training activities participate you must.
translation: 你没有获得任何代币。培训活动你必须参加。 [ni mei you huo de ren he dai bi 。 pei xun huo dong ni bi xu can jia 。]

english: Okay, I'll go see what I can find to do around here to earn some tokens.
translation: 好吧，我去看看这里能做什么来赚取一些代币。 [hao ba ， wo qu kan kan zhe li neng zuo shen me lai zhuan qu yi xie dai bi 。]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Health be with you travelling.
translation: 健康与您同行。 [jian kang yu nin tong hang 。]

english: My armour disappeared!
translation: 我的铠甲消失了！ [wo de kai jia xiao shi le ！]

english: Correct you are. Not killed it was. Collected your armour I did.
translation: 你是对的。不是被杀了。我收集了你的盔甲。 [ni shi dui de 。 bu shi bei sha le 。 wo shou ji le ni de kui jia 。]

english: Excellent, may I have it so I can try the machine again?
translation: 太好了，可以给我吗，这样我可以再试一下机器？ [tai hao le ， ke yi gei wo ma ， zhe yang wo ke yi zai shi yi xia ji qi ？]

english: Space you will need in your pack.
translation: 背包中需要的空间。 [bei bao zhong xu yao de kong jian 。]

english: Okay, I'll go make some room in my inventory and come back.
translation: 好的，我去库存里腾出一些空间然后再回来。 [hao de ， wo qu ku cun li teng chu yi xie kong jian ran hou zai hui lai 。]

english: Plain full plate armour in those machines only you may use, of appropriate materials. When other items used, bad things happen, yes!
translation: 只有您可以使用的机器中的普通全板装甲，由适当的材料制成。当使用其他物品时，会发生不好的事情，是的！ [zhi you nin ke yi shi yong de ji qi zhong de pu tong quan ban zhuang jia ， you shi dang de cai liao zhi cheng 。 dang shi yong qi ta wu pin shi ， hui fa sheng bu hao de shi qing ， shi de ！]

english: Okay, so I can only use plain full plate armour of appropriate materials, no trimmed armour or unusual kit?
translation: 好吧，那么我只能使用适当材料的普通全板甲，没有修剪过的装甲或不寻常的套件？ [hao ba ， na me wo zhi neng shi yong shi dang cai liao de pu tong quan ban jia ， mei you xiu jian guo de zhuang jia huo bu xun chang de tao jian ？]

english: Those things which cannot be seen, perceive them.
translation: 那些看不见的东西，感知它们。 [na xie kan bu jian de dong xi ， gan zhi ta men 。]

english: Do nothing which is of no use.
translation: 不做任何无用的事情。 [bu zuo ren he wu yong de shi qing 。]

english: Think not dishonestly.
translation: 不要不诚实地思考。 [bu yao bu cheng shi di si kao 。]

english: The Way in training is.
translation: 训练之道是。 [xun lian zhi dao shi 。]

english: Gain and loss between you must distinguish.
translation: 得与失之间你必须分清。 [de yu shi zhi jian ni bi xu fen qing 。]

english: Trifles pay attention even to.
translation: 鸡毛蒜皮的小事还要注意。 [ji mao suan pi de xiao shi hai yao zhu yi 。]

english: Way of the warrior this is.
translation: 这就是战士之道。 [zhe jiu shi zhan shi zhi dao 。]

english: Acquainted with every art become.
translation: 熟悉每一种艺术。 [shu xi mei yi zhong yi shu 。]

english: Ways of all professions know you.
translation: 所有职业的方式都认识你。 [suo you zhi ye de fang shi dou ren shi ni 。]

english: Judgment and understanding for everything develop you must.
translation: 你必须培养对一切事物的判断力和理解力。 [ni bi xu pei yang dui yi qie shi wu de pan duan li he li jie li 。]

english: What do I do here?
translation: 我在这里做什么？ [wo zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Where do the machines come from?
translation: 机器从哪里来？ [ji qi cong na li lai ？]

english: May I claim my tokens please?
translation: 我可以领取我的代币吗？ [wo ke yi ling qu wo de dai bi ma ？]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: My armour disappeared!
translation: 我的铠甲消失了！ [wo de kai jia xiao shi le ！]

english: Hello effendi, I am Shantay.
translation: 你好，埃芬迪，我是尚泰。 [ni hao ， ai fen di ， wo shi shang tai 。]

english: I see you're new. Please read the billboard poster before going into the desert. It'll give yer details on the dangers you can face.
translation: 我看你是新来的进入沙漠前请先阅读广告牌海报。它会为您提供有关您可能面临的危险的详细信息。 [wo kan ni shi xin lai de jin ru sha mo qian qing xian yue du guang gao pai hai bao 。 ta hui wei nin ti gong you guan nin ke neng mian lin de wei xian de xiang xi xin xi 。]

english: There is a heartbroken mother just past the gates and in the desert. Her name is Irena and she mourns her lost daughter. Such a shame.
translation: 刚过大门，在沙漠里，有一位伤心欲绝的母亲。她的名字叫伊雷娜（Irena），她哀悼失去的女儿。太可惜了。 [gang guo da men ， zai sha mo li ， you yi wei shang xin yu jue de mu qin 。 ta de ming zi jiao yi lei na （Irena）， ta ai dao shi qu de nv er 。 tai ke xi le 。]

english: Hello again friend. Please read the billboard poster before going into the desert. It'll give yer details on the dangers you can face.
translation: 你好，朋友。进入沙漠前请先阅读广告牌海报。它会为您提供有关您可能面临的危险的详细信息。 [ni hao ， peng you 。 jin ru sha mo qian qing xian yue du guang gao pai hai bao 。 ta hui wei nin ti gong you guan nin ke neng mian lin de wei xian de xiang xi xin xi 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This is the pass of Shantay. I guard this area with my men. I am responsible for keeping this pass open and repaired.
translation: 这是Shantay的通行证。我和我的手下守护着这个地区。我负责保持这张通行证的开放和修理。 [zhe shi Shantay de tong xing zheng 。 wo he wo de shou xia shou hu zhe zhe ge di qu 。 wo fu ze bao chi zhe zhang tong xing zheng de kai fang he xiu li 。]

english: My men and I prevent outlaws from getting out of the desert. And we stop the inexperienced from a dry death in the sands. Which would you say you were?
translation: 我和我的手下阻止亡命徒逃出沙漠。我们可以阻止没有经验的人在沙子中干死。你说你是哪一个？ [wo he wo de shou xia zu zhi wang ming tu tao chu sha mo 。 wo men ke yi zu zhi mei you jing yan de ren zai sha zi zhong gan si 。 ni shuo ni shi na yi ge ？]

english: I am definitely an outlaw, prepare to die!
translation: 我绝对是亡命之徒，准备受死吧！ [wo jue dui shi wang ming zhi tu ， zhun bei shou si ba ！]

english: Ha, very funny.....
translation: 哈，非常搞笑…… [ha ， fei chang gao xiao ……]

english: Guards arrest [him/her]!
translation: 警卫逮捕[他/她]！ [jing wei dai bu [ ta / ta ]！]

english: The guards arrest you and place you in the jail.
translation: 警卫逮捕了你并将你关进监狱。 [jing wei dai bu le ni bing jiang ni guan jin jian yu 。]

english: The player is put in the Shantay Pass jail.
translation: 该玩家被关押在尚泰帕斯监狱。 [gai wan jia bei guan ya zai shang tai pa si jian yu 。]

english: You'll have to stay in there until you pay the fine of five gold pieces. Do you want to pay now?
translation: 你必须待在里面，直到缴纳五枚金币的罚款。您现在想付款吗？ [ni bi xu dai zai li mian ， zhi dao jiao na wu mei jin bi de fa kuan 。 nin xian zai xiang fu kuan ma ？]

english: Yes, okay.
translation: 是的，好的。 [shi de ， hao de 。]

english: Good, I see that you have come to your senses.
translation: 很好，我看到你已经醒悟了。 [hen hao ， wo kan dao ni yi jing xing wu le 。]

english: Great Effendi, now please try to keep the peace.
translation: 伟大的阿芬迪，现在请努力保持和平。 [wei da de a fen di ， xian zai qing nu li bao chi he ping 。]

english: You hand over five gold pieces to Shantay.
translation: 您将五枚金币交给尚泰。 [nin jiang wu mei jin bi jiao gei shang tai 。]

english: Shantay unlocks the door to the cell.
translation: 尚泰打开牢房门。 [shang tai da kai lao fang men 。]

english: You don't have that kind of cash on you I see.
translation: 我看你身上没有那么多现金。 [wo kan ni shen shang mei you na me duo xian jin 。]

english: You are to be transported to a maximum security prison in Port Sarim.
translation: 您将被送往沙里姆港一座戒备最高的监狱。 [nin jiang bei song wang sha li mu gang yi zuo jie bei zui gao de jian yu 。]

english: I hope you've learnt an important lesson from this.
translation: 我希望你已经从中吸取了重要的教训。 [wo xi wang ni yi jing cong zhong xi qu le zhong yao de jiao xun 。]

english: I would transport you to a maximum security prison in Port Sarim. However since you haven't unlocked access to Asgarnia consider yourself lucky.
translation: 我会把你送到沙里姆港一座戒备森严的监狱。然而，由于您尚未解锁进入阿斯加尼亚的权限，请认为自己很幸运。 [wo hui ba ni song dao sha li mu gang yi zuo jie bei sen yan de jian yu 。 ran er ， you yu nin shang wei jie suo jin ru a si jia ni ya de quan xian ， qing ren wei zi ji hen xing yun 。]

english: But perhaps you have some in your bank? Or would you prefer the maximum security prison in Port Sarim.
translation: 但也许你的银行里有一些？或者您更喜欢沙里姆港最高安全级别的监狱。 [dan ye xu ni de yin hang li you yi xie ？ huo zhe nin geng xi huan sha li mu gang zui gao an quan ji bie de jian yu 。]

english: Which is it going to be?
translation: 会是哪一个呢？ [hui shi na yi ge ne ？]

english: I'll pay the fine.
translation: 我来付罚款。 [wo lai fu fa kuan 。]

english: Okay then..., you'll need access to your bank.
translation: 好吧，那么...，您需要访问您的银行。 [hao ba ， na me ...， nin xu yao fang wen nin de yin hang 。]

english: No thanks, you're not having my money.
translation: 不，谢谢，你没有拿走我的钱。 [bu ， xie xie ， ni mei you na zou wo de qian 。]

english: Very well, I grow tired of you, you'll be taken to a new jail in Port Sarim.
translation: 好吧，我厌倦了你，你将被带到沙里姆港的新监狱。 [hao ba ， wo yan juan le ni ， ni jiang bei dai dao sha li mu gang de xin jian yu 。]

english: The player is transported to the "Maximum security prison" in Port Sarim.
translation: 玩家被传送到沙里姆港的“最高安全监狱”。 [wan jia bei chuan song dao sha li mu gang de “ zui gao an quan jian yu ”。]

english: You have a choice. You can either pay five gold pieces or... You can be transported to a maximum security prison in Port Sarim.
translation: 你有一个选择。你可以支付五块金币，或者……你可以被转移到沙里姆港的一座高度戒备的监狱。 [ni you yi ge xuan ze 。 ni ke yi zhi fu wu kuai jin bi ， huo zhe …… ni ke yi bei zhuan yi dao sha li mu gang de yi zuo gao du jie bei de jian yu 。]

english: Will you pay the five gold pieces?
translation: 你愿意支付这五块金币吗？ [ni yuan yi zhi fu zhe wu kuai jin bi ma ？]

english: You find yourself in a prison.
translation: 你发现自己身处监狱。 [ni fa xian zi ji shen chu jian yu 。]

english: I am a little inexperienced.
translation: 我有点缺乏经验。 [wo you dian que fa jing yan 。]

english: Can I recommend that you purchase a full waterskin and a knife! These items will no doubt save your life. A waterskin will keep water from evaporating in the desert.
translation: 我可以建议你买一个完整的水袋和一把刀吗！这些物品无疑会拯救你的生命。水袋可以防止沙漠中的水蒸发。 [wo ke yi jian yi ni mai yi ge wan zheng de shui dai he yi ba dao ma ！ zhe xie wu pin wu yi hui zheng jiu ni de sheng ming 。 shui dai ke yi fang zhi sha mo zhong de shui zheng fa 。]

english: And a keen woodsman with a knife can extract the juice from a cactus. Before you go into the desert, it's advisable to wear desert clothes. It's very hot in the desert and you'll surely cook if you wear armour.
translation: 敏锐的樵夫用刀可以从仙人掌中提取汁液。在进入沙漠之前，建议穿上沙漠服装。沙漠里很热，穿上铠甲肯定会做饭。 [min rui de qiao fu yong dao ke yi cong xian ren zhang zhong ti qu zhi ye 。 zai jin ru sha mo zhi qian ， jian yi chuan shang sha mo fu zhuang 。 sha mo li hen re ， chuan shang kai jia ken ding hui zuo fan 。]

english: To keep the pass bandit free, we charge a small toll of five gold pieces. You can buy a desert pass from me, just ask me to open the shop. You can also use our free banking services by clicking on the chest.
translation: 为了不让强盗进来，我们收取五枚金币的小额通行费。你可以向我购买沙漠通行证，只要让我开店即可。您还可以通过点击宝箱来使用我们的免费银行服务。 [wei le bu rang qiang dao jin lai ， wo men shou qu wu mei jin bi de xiao e tong xing fei 。 ni ke yi xiang wo gou mai sha mo tong xing zheng ， zhi yao rang wo kai dian ji ke 。 nin hai ke yi tong guo dian ji bao xiang lai shi yong wo men de mian fei yin hang fu wu 。]

english: Why do I have to pay to go into the desert?
translation: 为什么进入沙漠要付费？ [wei shen me jin ru sha mo yao fu fei ？]

english: Effendi, you insult me! I am not interested in making a profit from you! I merely seek to cover my expenses in keeping this pass open.
translation: 阿芬迪，你侮辱我！我对从你身上谋取利益没有兴趣！我只是想支付维持这张通行证开放的费用。 [a fen di ， ni wu ru wo ！ wo dui cong ni shen shang mou qu li yi mei you xing qu ！ wo zhi shi xiang zhi fu wei chi zhe zhang tong xing zheng kai fang de fei yong 。]

english: There is repair work to carry out and also the men's wages to consider. For the paltry sum of 5 Gold pieces, I think we offer a great service.
translation: 需要进行维修工作，还要考虑工人的工资。对于 5 个金币的微不足道的总和，我认为我们提供了很棒的服务。 [xu yao jin xing wei xiu gong zuo ， hai yao kao lv gong ren de gong zi 。 dui yu  5  ge jin bi de wei bu zu dao de zong he ， wo ren wei wo men ti gong le hen bang de fu wu 。]

english: Er, neither, I'm an adventurer.
translation: 呃，也不是，我是冒险家。 [e ， ye bu shi ， wo shi mao xian jia 。]

english: Great, I have just the thing for the desert adventurer. I sell desert clothes which will keep you cool in the heat of the desert. I also sell waterskins so that you won't die in the desert.
translation: 太棒了，我正好有沙漠冒险家的东西。我出售沙漠服装，可以让您在炎热的沙漠中保持凉爽。我还卖水袋，这样你就不会死在沙漠里。 [tai bang le ， wo zheng hao you sha mo mao xian jia de dong xi 。 wo chu shou sha mo fu zhuang ， ke yi rang nin zai yan re de sha mo zhong bao chi liang shuang 。 wo hai mai shui dai ， zhe yang ni jiu bu hui si zai sha mo li 。]

english: A waterskin and a knife help you survive from the juice of a cactus. Use the chest to store your items, we'll take them to the bank. It's hot in the desert, you'll bake in all that armour.
translation: 水袋和刀可以帮助你从仙人掌汁液中生存下来。使用箱子存放您的物品，我们会将它们带到银行。沙漠里很热，你的盔甲会被烘烤。 [shui dai he dao ke yi bang zhu ni cong xian ren zhang zhi ye zhong sheng cun xia lai 。 shi yong xiang zi cun fang nin de wu pin ， wo men hui jiang ta men dai dao yin hang 。 sha mo li hen re ， ni de kui jia hui bei hong kao 。]

english: To keep the pass open we ask for 5 gold pieces. And we give you a Shantay Pass, just ask to see what I sell to buy one.
translation: 为了保持通行证开放，我们要求 5 个金币。我们会给你一张Shantay Pass，只要问我卖什么就可以买一张。 [wei le bao chi tong xing zheng kai fang ， wo men yao qiu  5  ge jin bi 。 wo men hui gei ni yi zhang Shantay Pass， zhi yao wen wo mai shen me jiu ke yi mai yi zhang 。]

english: You should be in jail! Well, no doubt the authorities in Port Sarim know what they're doing. But if you get into any more trouble, you'll be stuck back in jail.
translation: 你应该进监狱！毫无疑问，萨里姆港当局知道他们在做什么。但如果你遇到更多麻烦，你就会被困在监狱里。 [ni ying gai jin jian yu ！ hao wu yi wen ， sa li mu gang dang ju zhi dao ta men zai zuo shen me 。 dan ru guo ni yu dao geng duo ma fan ， ni jiu hui bei kun zai jian yu li 。]

english: Can I see what you have to sell please?
translation: 我可以看看你要卖什么吗？ [wo ke yi kan kan ni yao mai shen me ma ？]

english: Absolutely Effendi!
translation: 绝对是阿芬迪！ [jue dui shi a fen di ！]

english: I must be going.
translation: 我一定要走了。 [wo yi ding yao zou le 。]

english: So long...
translation: 这么久... [zhe me jiu ...]

english: I want to buy a Shantay pass for 5 gold coins.
translation: 我想用 5 个金币购买一张 Shantay 通行证。 [wo xiang yong  5  ge jin bi gou mai yi zhang  Shantay  tong xing zheng 。]

english: Sorry effendi, I can't offer this service right now.
translation: 抱歉，埃芬迪，我现在无法提供这项服务。 [bao qian ， ai fen di ， wo xian zai wu fa ti gong zhe xiang fu wu 。]

english: Sorry friend, the Shantay Pass is 5 gold coins. You don't seem to have enough money!
translation: 对不起朋友，桑塔通行证是5金币。看来你钱还不够啊！ [dui bu qi peng you ， sang ta tong xing zheng shi 5 jin bi 。 kan lai ni qian hai bu gou a ！]

english: Sorry friend, you'll need more inventory space to buy a pass.
translation: 抱歉朋友，您需要更多的库存空间来购买通行证。 [bao qian peng you ， nin xu yao geng duo de ku cun kong jian lai gou mai tong xing zheng 。]

english: The door is locked.
translation: 门是锁着的。 [men shi suo zhe de 。]

english: Shantay saunters over to talk with you.
translation: 尚泰慢悠悠地走过来和你说话。 [shang tai man you you di zou guo lai he ni shuo hua 。]

english: If you want to be let out, you have to pay a fine of five gold. Do you want to pay now?
translation: 若欲放出，须罚金五金。您现在想付款吗？ [ruo yu fang chu ， xu fa jin wu jin 。 nin xian zai xiang fu kuan ma ？]

english: Well done.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: You've [found a new clue/obtained a casket]!
translation: 你[发现了新线索/获得了棺材]！ [ni [ fa xian le xin xian suo / huo de le guan cai ]！]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: I am definitely an outlaw, prepare to die!
translation: 我绝对是亡命之徒，准备受死吧！ [wo jue dui shi wang ming zhi tu ， zhun bei shou si ba ！]

english: Yes, okay.
translation: 是的，好的。 [shi de ， hao de 。]

english: I'll pay the fine.
translation: 我来付罚款。 [wo lai fu fa kuan 。]

english: No thanks, you're not having my money.
translation: 不，谢谢，你没有拿走我的钱。 [bu ， xie xie ， ni mei you na zou wo de qian 。]

english: No, do your worst!
translation: 不，尽你所能！ [bu ， jin ni suo neng ！]

english: I am a little inexperienced.
translation: 我有点缺乏经验。 [wo you dian que fa jing yan 。]

english: Can I see what you have to sell please?
translation: 我可以看看你要卖什么吗？ [wo ke yi kan kan ni yao mai shen me ma ？]

english: I must be going.
translation: 我一定要走了。 [wo yi ding yao zou le 。]

english: Why do I have to pay to go into the desert?
translation: 为什么进入沙漠要付费？ [wei shen me jin ru sha mo yao fu fei ？]

english: Er, neither, I'm an adventurer.
translation: 呃，也不是，我是冒险家。 [e ， ye bu shi ， wo shi mao xian jia 。]

english: I want to buy a Shantay pass for 5 gold coins.
translation: 我想用 5 个金币购买一张 Shantay 通行证。 [wo xiang yong  5  ge jin bi gou mai yi zhang  Shantay  tong xing zheng 。]

english: Go talk to Shantay. I'm on duty and I don't have time to talk to the likes of you!
translation: 去和尚蒂谈谈吧。我正在值班，没时间和你们这种人说话！ [qu he shang di tan tan ba 。 wo zheng zai zhi ban ， mei shi jian he ni men zhe zhong ren shuo hua ！]

english: Hello there! What can I do for you?
translation: 你好呀！我能为你做什么？ [ni hao ya ！ wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: I'd like to go into the desert please.
translation: 我想去沙漠，请。 [wo xiang qu sha mo ， qing 。]

english: You'll need a Shantay pass to go through the gate into the desert. See Shantay, he'll sell you one for a very reasonable price.
translation: 您需要一张尚泰通行证才能穿过大门进入沙漠。去见尚泰，他会以非常合理的价格卖给你一个。 [nin xu yao yi zhang shang tai tong xing zheng cai neng chuan guo da men jin ru sha mo 。 qu jian shang tai ， ta hui yi fei chang he li de jia ge mai gei ni yi ge 。]

english: Nothing thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。]

english: Okay then, have a nice day.
translation: 好吧，祝你有美好的一天。 [hao ba ， zhu ni you mei hao de yi tian 。]

english: I'd like to go into the desert please.
translation: 我想去沙漠，请。 [wo xiang qu sha mo ， qing 。]

english: Nothing thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。]

english: Why is there a Shantay Pass here?
translation: 为什么这里有桑塔通行证？ [wei shen me zhe li you sang ta tong xing zheng ？]

english: There's been an influx of new business to these ruins. Shantay sent us out here to make some money.
translation: 新业务涌入这些废墟。尚泰派我们来这里是为了赚钱。 [xin ye wu yong ru zhe xie fei xu 。 shang tai pai wo men lai zhe li shi wei le zhuan qian 。]

english: Shantay once told me that he's not interested in profit!
translation: 尚泰曾经告诉我，他对利润不感兴趣！ [shang tai ceng jing gao su wo ， ta dui li run bu gan xing qu ！]

english: Have you seen the state of this place? We're helping to provide vital repair costs to the people!
translation: 你见过这个地方的现状吗？我们正在帮助为人们提供重要的维修费用！ [ni jian guo zhe ge di fang de xian zhuang ma ？ wo men zheng zai bang zhu wei ren men ti gong zhong yao de wei xiu fei yong ！]

english: I see.
translation: 我懂了。 [wo dong le 。]

english: Not really our fault if they spend their cut on fancy outfits!
translation: 如果他们把钱花在花哨的衣服上，那真不是我们的错！ [ru guo ta men ba qian hua zai hua shao de yi fu shang ， na zhen bu shi wo men de cuo ！]

english: I must be going.
translation: 我一定要走了。 [wo yi ding yao zou le 。]

english: Safe travels, friend.
translation: 旅途安全，朋友。 [lv tu an quan ， peng you 。]

english: Can I see what you have to sell please?
translation: 我可以看看你要卖什么吗？ [wo ke yi kan kan ni yao mai shen me ma ？]

english: Absolutely, friend.
translation: 绝对可以，朋友。 [jue dui ke yi ， peng you 。]

english: I want to buy a Shantay pass for 5 gold coins.
translation: 我想用 5 个金币购买一张 Shantay 通行证。 [wo xiang yong  5  ge jin bi gou mai yi zhang  Shantay  tong xing zheng 。]

english: You purchase a Shantay Pass.
translation: 您购买了Shantay Pass。 [nin gou mai le Shantay Pass。]

english: Sorry friend, the Shantay Pass is 5 gold coins. You don't seem to have enough money!
translation: 对不起朋友，桑塔通行证是5金币。看来你钱还不够啊！ [dui bu qi peng you ， sang ta tong xing zheng shi 5 jin bi 。 kan lai ni qian hai bu gou a ！]

english: Why is there a Shantay Pass here?
translation: 为什么这里有桑塔通行证？ [wei shen me zhe li you sang ta tong xing zheng ？]

english: Can I see what you have to sell please?
translation: 我可以看看你要卖什么吗？ [wo ke yi kan kan ni yao mai shen me ma ？]

english: I must be going.
translation: 我一定要走了。 [wo yi ding yao zou le 。]

english: I want to buy a Shantay pass for 5 gold coins.
translation: 我想用 5 个金币购买一张 Shantay 通行证。 [wo xiang yong  5  ge jin bi gou mai yi zhang  Shantay  tong xing zheng 。]

english: Can I see what you have to sell please
translation: 我可以看看你要卖什么吗 [wo ke yi kan kan ni yao mai shen me ma]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I's not doing a great deal now Bwana, as I'm no spring chicken. I do my fair share around the village bwana, though, I could tell you a thing or two about the jungle slashing.
translation: 布瓦纳，我现在做得不多，因为我不再是小鸡了。不过，我在布瓦纳村尽了自己的一份力，我可以告诉你一两件关于丛林砍伐的事情。 [bu wa na ， wo xian zai zuo de bu duo ， yin wei wo bu zai shi xiao ji le 。 bu guo ， wo zai bu wa na cun jin le zi ji de yi fen li ， wo ke yi gao su ni yi liang jian guan yu cong lin kan fa de shi qing 。]

english: Ok, tell me about jungle slashing!
translation: 好吧，告诉我丛林砍伐的事吧！ [hao ba ， gao su wo cong lin kan fa de shi ba ！]

english: Ok Bwana, I will! To begin with you'll need a machete in order to hack your way through the jungle. There are some better gem edged weapons which you may be able to purchase from Gabooty.
translation: 好的，布瓦纳，我会的！首先，你需要一把砍刀才能在丛林中杀出一条血路。您可以从 Gabooty 购买一些更好的宝石刃武器。 [hao de ， bu wa na ， wo hui de ！ shou xian ， ni xu yao yi ba kan dao cai neng zai cong lin zhong sha chu yi tiao xue lu 。 nin ke yi cong  Gabooty  gou mai yi xie geng hao de bao shi ren wu qi 。]

english: Safta Doc makes them for him. You should be aware that hacking away at the jungle is not without its dangers though Bwana. Many times you may find some scary creatures lurking inside.
translation: Safta Doc 为他做的。你应该意识到，尽管布瓦纳，在丛林中砍伐并非没有危险。很多时候你可能会发现一些可怕的生物潜伏在里面。 [Safta Doc  wei ta zuo de 。 ni ying gai yi shi dao ， jin guan bu wa na ， zai cong lin zhong kan fa bing fei mei you wei xian 。 hen duo shi hou ni ke neng hui fa xian yi xie ke pa de sheng wu qian fu zai li mian 。]

english: What sort of creatures?
translation: 什么样的生物？ [shen me yang de sheng wu ？]

english: Ok, to start with there are spiders! These are pretty tough but if you defeat it, you can get a good meal from it, if you know how to cook it that is. My wife cooks them to a turn - Mmmm, delicious.
translation: 好吧，首先有蜘蛛！这些都很困难，但如果你打败了它，你就可以从中得到一顿美餐，如果你知道如何烹饪的话。我妻子把它们煮了一遍——嗯，美味。 [hao ba ， shou xian you zhi zhu ！ zhe xie dou hen kun nan ， dan ru guo ni da bai le ta ， ni jiu ke yi cong zhong de dao yi dun mei can ， ru guo ni zhi dao ru he peng ren de hua 。 wo qi zi ba ta men zhu le yi bian —— n ， mei wei 。]

english: Ok go on!
translation: 好的，继续！ [hao de ， ji xu ！]

english: Yes Bwana, of course. Then there are snakes...these are dangerous because they're poisonous - so be prepared! However, they're not without their uses. A bush snake is large enough to have a useful hide.
translation: 是的，当然是布瓦纳。还有蛇……它们很危险，因为它们有毒 - 所以要做好准备！然而，它们并非没有用处。丛林蛇足够大，有一张有用的皮。 [shi de ， dang ran shi bu wa na 。 hai you she …… ta men hen wei xian ， yin wei ta men you du  -  suo yi yao zuo hao zhun bei ！ ran er ， ta men bing fei mei you yong chu 。 cong lin she zu gou da ， you yi zhang you yong de pi 。]

english: Once the hide is tanned you get a snakeskin and you're able to make things from it, the same way that mainlanders use normal leather! However, it's actually still quite small.
translation: 一旦皮革被鞣制，你就会得到一张蛇皮，你可以用它来制作东西，就像大陆人使用普通皮革一样！然而，它实际上仍然很小。 [yi dan pi ge bei rou zhi ， ni jiu hui de dao yi zhang she pi ， ni ke yi yong ta lai zhi zuo dong xi ， jiu xiang da lu ren shi yong pu tong pi ge yi yang ！ ran er ， ta shi ji shang reng ran hen xiao 。]

english: You may need several skins in order to make something useful.
translation: 您可能需要多个皮肤才能使某些东西有用。 [nin ke neng xu yao duo ge pi fu cai neng shi mou xie dong xi you yong 。]

english: Hmm, sounds interesting!
translation: 嗯，听起来很有趣！ [n ， ting qi lai hen you qu ！]

english: Then there are giant mosquitoes bwana, they're fast and agile. You'll need to be quick if you're to hit them at all! However, it certainly does train your reactions. They're not very tough, just difficult to hit.
translation: 还有巨大的蚊子bwana，它们又快又敏捷。如果你想击中他们，你就得动作快！然而，它确实可以训练你的反应。它们不是很强，只是很难击中。 [hai you ju da de wen zi bwana， ta men you kuai you min jie 。 ru guo ni xiang ji zhong ta men ， ni jiu de dong zuo kuai ！ ran er ， ta que shi ke yi xun lian ni de fan ying 。 ta men bu shi hen qiang ， zhi shi hen nan ji zhong 。]

english: I also believe that their proboscis is useful in someway, I believe Timfraku's sons sometimes use them for hunting.
translation: 我还相信它们的长鼻在某种程度上很有用，我相信提姆弗拉库的儿子们有时会用它们来狩猎。 [wo hai xiang xin ta men de zhang bi zai mou zhong cheng du shang hen you yong ， wo xiang xin ti mu fu la ku de er zi men you shi hui yong ta men lai shou lie 。]

english: Ok, that sounds helpful...anything else?
translation: 好吧，这听起来很有帮助……还有其他吗？ [hao ba ， zhe ting qi lai hen you bang zhu …… hai you qi ta ma ？]

english: Yes Bwana, much much more! What next...Oh yes, the tribesmen...you've probably seen them scouting around the village, sometimes sneaking inside the enclosure to steal our chickens!
translation: 是的，布瓦纳，还有更多！接下来......哦，是的，部落成员......你可能见过他们在村庄周围侦察，有时偷偷溜进围栏偷我们的鸡！ [shi de ， bu wa na ， hai you geng duo ！ jie xia lai ...... o ， shi de ， bu luo cheng yuan ...... ni ke neng jian guo ta men zai cun zhuang zhou wei zhen cha ， you shi tou tou liu jin wei lan tou wo men de ji ！]

english: They sometimes hide in the jungle bushes waiting for an opportunity to strike when we least expect it! Take care Bwana, these treacherous jungle natives use poison on their spears!
translation: 他们有时会躲在丛林灌木丛中，等待我们最意想不到的袭击机会！小心布瓦纳，这些奸诈的丛林土著在他们的长矛上使用毒药！ [ta men you shi hui duo zai cong lin guan mu cong zhong ， deng dai wo men zui yi xiang bu dao de xi ji ji hui ！ xiao xin bu wa na ， zhe xie jian zha de cong lin tu zhu zai ta men de chang mao shang shi yong du yao ！]

english: Right Ok, good advice... 'poison on spears....' Anything else I should know about?
translation: 好吧，好建议……“长矛上的毒……”还有什么我应该知道的吗？ [hao ba ， hao jian yi ……“ chang mao shang de du ……” hai you shen me wo ying gai zhi dao de ma ？]

english: Yes Bwana... and this is serious... The jungle is very ancient and many unspeakable acts have been witnessed on these lands. Bizarre supernatural curses were placed on criminals and then they were buried alive!
translation: 是的，布瓦纳……这很严重……丛林非常古老，在这些土地上目睹了许多难以形容的行为。罪犯被施以奇异的超自然诅咒，然后被活埋！ [shi de ， bu wa na …… zhe hen yan zhong …… cong lin fei chang gu lao ， zai zhe xie tu di shang mu du le xu duo nan yi xing rong de xing wei 。 zui fan bei shi yi qi yi de chao zi ran zu zhou ， ran hou bei huo mai ！]

english: These strange creatures have the curse of the Broodoo on them! They'll rise from their grave with their heads in their chests and move like crazy spirits of the afterlife.
translation: 这些奇怪的生物受到了布罗杜的诅咒！他们将从坟墓中升起，将头埋在胸前，像来世的疯狂灵魂一样移动。 [zhe xie qi guai de sheng wu shou dao le bu luo du de zu zhou ！ ta men jiang cong fen mu zhong sheng qi ， jiang tou mai zai xiong qian ， xiang lai shi de feng kuang ling hun yi yang yi dong 。]

english: If they're disturbed they will attack anything in the area with their magical abilities! They suffer little from being attacked as they seem to be protected by some form of defence.
translation: 如果他们受到干扰，他们会用魔法能力攻击该地区的任何东西！他们很少受到攻击，因为他们似乎受到某种形式的防御的保护。 [ru guo ta men shou dao gan rao ， ta men hui yong mo fa neng li gong ji gai di qu de ren he dong xi ！ ta men hen shao shou dao gong ji ， yin wei ta men si hu shou dao mou zhong xing shi de fang yu de bao hu 。]

english: However... it is said that the means of their death provides the clue to their destruction. So far three distinct Broodoo have been identified. The Broodoo with a green hued skin is said to have died from poison.
translation: 然而……据说，他们的死亡方式提供了他们毁灭的线索。到目前为止，已经发现了三种不同的布洛杜鸟。据说，皮肤呈绿色的布洛杜鸟是中毒身亡的。 [ran er …… ju shuo ， ta men de si wang fang shi ti gong le ta men hui mie de xian suo 。 dao mu qian wei zhi ， yi jing fa xian le san zhong bu tong de bu luo du niao 。 ju shuo ， pi fu cheng lv se de bu luo du niao shi zhong du shen wang de 。]

english: There is a broodoo of yellow hue and a pale skinned broodoo, but little is known of these two!
translation: 有一只黄色的雏鸟和一只苍白皮肤的雏鸟，但人们对这两只雏鸟知之甚少！ [you yi zhi huang se de chu niao he yi zhi cang bai pi fu de chu niao ， dan ren men dui zhe liang zhi chu niao zhi zhi shen shao ！]

english: Erk! Well that sounds pretty scary!
translation: 呃！嗯，这听起来很可怕！ [e ！ n ， zhe ting qi lai hen ke pa ！]

english: Yes Bwana...
translation: 是的，布瓦纳... [shi de ， bu wa na ...]

english: Ok, thanks a lot....
translation: 好的，非常感谢.... [hao de ， fei chang gan xie ....]

english: Wait Bwana, there's more!
translation: 等等布瓦纳，还有更多！ [deng deng bu wa na ， hai you geng duo ！]

english: More... Blimey! Ok carry on...
translation: 更多... 天哪！好的，继续... [geng duo ...  tian na ！ hao de ， ji xu ...]

english: Some of the local villagers have found strange plants which grow here-abouts. If you cut away at the jungle and find one, it's considered a blessing, though the useful part of the plant is usually buried underground.
translation: 一些当地村民发现这里生长着奇怪的植物。如果你在丛林中找到一棵，这被认为是一种祝福，尽管植物的有用部分通常埋在地下。 [yi xie dang di cun min fa xian zhe li sheng zhang zhe qi guai de zhi wu 。 ru guo ni zai cong lin zhong zhao dao yi ke ， zhe bei ren wei shi yi zhong zhu fu ， jin guan zhi wu de you yong bu fen tong chang mai zai di xia 。]

english: And also, you may find an uncommon rock type which is impregnated with mineral wealth! Well that concludes all the help I can give you regarding the jungle in Tai Bwo Wannai!
translation: 而且，您可能会发现一种不常见的岩石类型，其中充满了丰富的矿产资源！好了，我能为您提供的有关 Tai Bwo Wannai 丛林的所有帮助就到此为止了！ [er qie ， nin ke neng hui fa xian yi zhong bu chang jian de yan shi lei xing ， qi zhong chong man le feng fu de kuang chan zi yuan ！ hao le ， wo neng wei nin ti gong de you guan  Tai Bwo Wannai  cong lin de suo you bang zhu jiu dao ci wei zhi le ！]

english: I have to say, that's quite a lot of information...thanks very much!
translation: 我不得不说，这是相当多的信息.​​.....非常感谢！ [wo bu de bu shuo ， zhe shi xiang dang duo de xin xi .​​..... fei chang gan xie ！]

english: You're more than welcome bwana!
translation: 非常欢迎您，bwana！ [fei chang huan ying nin ，bwana！]

english: Is there anything interesting to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么好玩的吗？ [zhe fu jin you shen me hao wan de ma ？]

english: Bwana, if anyone else asks me that question today, I'll explode! Go and ask someone else!
translation: Bwana，如果今天还有人问我这个问题，我会爆炸的！你去问问别人吧！ [Bwana， ru guo jin tian hai you ren wen wo zhe ge wen ti ， wo hui bao zha de ！ ni qu wen wen bie ren ba ！]

english: Not that I'm aware of, just sit back and enjoy the sunshine bwana!
translation: 我不知道，只是坐下来享受阳光 bwana！ [wo bu zhi dao ， zhi shi zuo xia lai xiang shou yang guang  bwana！]

english: Sorry Bwana, I'm already busy, why not go and talk to Murcaily! He's around the village somewhere.
translation: 抱歉 Bwana，我已经很忙了，为什么不去和 Murcaily 谈谈呢！他就在村子附近的某个地方。 [bao qian  Bwana， wo yi jing hen mang le ， wei shen me bu qu he  Murcaily  tan tan ne ！ ta jiu zai cun zi fu jin de mou ge di fang 。]

english: Well, I think that there's some work to be done...perhaps Murcaily can help you. He usually tends to the hardwood grove to the east of Trufitus's hut.
translation: 嗯，我认为还有一些工作要做……也许 Murcaily 可以帮助你。他通常照料特鲁菲特斯小屋东边的硬木树林。 [n ， wo ren wei hai you yi xie gong zuo yao zuo …… ye xu  Murcaily  ke yi bang zhu ni 。 ta tong chang zhao liao te lu fei te si xiao wu dong bian de ying mu shu lin 。]

english: It's just village life as normal around here Bwana, always something interesting to find to occupy your time if you look hard enough.
translation: 布瓦纳（Bwana）这里的乡村生活一如往常，只要您仔细观察，总能找到一些有趣的东西来打发您的时间。 [bu wa na （Bwana） zhe li de xiang cun sheng huo yi ru wang chang ， zhi yao nin zi xi guan cha ， zong neng zhao dao yi xie you qu de dong xi lai da fa nin de shi jian 。]

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 我一直在村里做一些工作。 [wo yi zhi zai cun li zuo yi xie gong zuo 。]

english: Yeah, you've been doing a lot of good work around here. Let me give you something for your time and effort.
translation: 是的，你在这里做了很多出色的工作。让我给你一些东西来补偿你的时间和精力。 [shi de ， ni zai zhe li zuo le hen duo chu se de gong zuo 。 rang wo gei ni yi xie dong xi lai bu chang ni de shi jian he jing li 。]

english: You get [amount] trading sticks. You are left with [amount]% favour.
translation: 您将获得[数量]根交易棒。您还剩下[金额]%的恩惠。 [nin jiang huo de [ shu liang ] gen jiao yi bang 。 nin hai sheng xia [ jin e ]% de en hui 。]

english: I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: 我已经给了你一些交易棒，现在我身上没有了。为什么不去和其他一些村民谈谈并获得一些捐款呢？ [wo yi jing gei le ni yi xie jiao yi bang ， xian zai wo shen shang mei you le 。 wei shen me bu qu he qi ta yi xie cun min tan tan bing huo de yi xie juan kuan ne ？]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Ok, tell me about jungle slashing!
translation: 好吧，告诉我丛林砍伐的事吧！ [hao ba ， gao su wo cong lin kan fa de shi ba ！]

english: Previous questions.
translation: 以前的问题。 [yi qian de wen ti 。]

english: Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: 这里有什么有趣的事情可以做吗？ [zhe li you shen me you qu de shi qing ke yi zuo ma ？]

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 我一直在村里做一些工作。 [wo yi zhi zai cun li zuo yi xie gong zuo 。]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Greetings!
translation: 问候！ [wen hou ！]

english: Oh hello there, I'm an architect.
translation: 哦，你好，我是一名建筑师。 [o ， ni hao ， wo shi yi ming jian zhu shi 。]

english: I wondered if you might have some time to help...?
translation: 我想知道你是否有时间帮忙......？ [wo xiang zhi dao ni shi fou you shi jian bang mang ......？]

english: So sorry, too busy at the moment.
translation: 非常抱歉，现在太忙了。 [fei chang bao qian ， xian zai tai mang le 。]

english: Hello again. How are you?
translation: 又好。你好吗？ [you hao 。 ni hao ma ？]

english: Great! Since working on that statue, everyone wants a miniature - very handy for business!
translation: 伟大的！自从制作该雕像以来，每个人都想要一个微型模型 - 对于商业来说非常方便！ [wei da de ！ zi cong zhi zuo gai diao xiang yi lai ， mei ge ren dou xiang yao yi ge wei xing mo xing  -  dui yu shang ye lai shuo fei chang fang bian ！]

english: Quiet! I'm here observing the lizardmen shamans, try not to blow my cover.
translation: 安静的！我在这里观察蜥蜴人萨满，尽量不要暴露我的身份。 [an jing de ！ wo zai zhe li guan cha xi yi ren sa man ， jin liang bu yao bao lu wo de shen fen 。]

english: You don't seem to be hiding very well.
translation: 看来你隐藏得不太好。 [kan lai ni yin cang de bu tai hao 。]

english: As if you could do better!
translation: 好像你可以做得更好！ [hao xiang ni ke yi zuo de geng hao ！]

english: Riiiight, anyways, can I attack these lizardmen shaman?
translation: 好吧，不管怎样，我可以攻击这些蜥蜴人萨满吗？ [hao ba ， bu guan zen yang ， wo ke yi gong ji zhe xie xi yi ren sa man ma ？]

english: Absolutely not! Do you want to get me killed? Now get out of here and stop trying to blow my cover!
translation: 绝对不是！你想害死我吗？现在离开这里，别再试图揭穿我的身份了！ [jue dui bu shi ！ ni xiang hai si wo ma ？ xian zai li kai zhe li ， bie zai shi tu jie chuan wo de shen fen le ！]

english: Well I don't like the idea of you risking my cover. You are trusted by the Shayzien people though, so I suppose you can. Just be careful.
translation: 好吧，我不喜欢你拿我的掩护去冒险。不过你受到 Shayzien 人的信任，所以我想你可以。请小心。 [hao ba ， wo bu xi huan ni na wo de yan hu qu mao xian 。 bu guo ni shou dao  Shayzien  ren de xin ren ， suo yi wo xiang ni ke yi 。 qing xiao xin 。]

english: Baa!
translation: 咩！ [mie ！]

english: I can't speak to the penguins when I'm not in my disguise.
translation: 当我没有伪装时，我不能和企鹅说话。 [dang wo mei you wei zhuang shi ， wo bu neng he qi e shuo hua 。]

english: Hello, I've just finished composing my latest poem. Would you like to hear it?
translation: 你好，我刚刚写完我最新的诗。你想听听吗？ [ni hao ， wo gang gang xie wan wo zui xin de shi 。 ni xiang ting ting ma ？]

english: Yes, please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Excellent! The humansan aficionado! Make yourself comfortable and I'll begin...
translation: 出色的！人类爱好者！让自己舒服一点，我就开始…… [chu se de ！ ren lei ai hao zhe ！ rang zi ji shu fu yi dian ， wo jiu kai shi ……]

english: Twinkle, twinkle little egg Wouldn't you like to grow some legs?And run around, on grass so green arguing with the milk and cream.
translation: 闪闪发光的小鸡蛋，你不想长出腿吗？在绿油油的草地上奔跑，与牛奶和奶油争论。 [shan shan fa guang de xiao ji dan ， ni bu xiang zhang chu tui ma ？ zai lv you you de cao di shang ben pao ， yu niu nai he nai you zheng lun 。]

english: T'was brillig and the slithey toathes Did gyre and gimbol in the wabe All mimsy were the borrowgroves And the mome raths outgrabe.
translation: 那是辉煌的，滑溜溜的牙齿在瓦贝中旋转和旋转，所有的模仿都是借用的树林和莫姆拉斯的超越。 [na shi hui huang de ， hua liu liu de ya chi zai wa bei zhong xuan zhuan he xuan zhuan ， suo you de mo fang dou shi jie yong de shu lin he mo mu la si de chao yue 。]

english: That's not even your poem, you idiotic, animated ball of wool!
translation: 那甚至不是你的诗，你这个愚蠢的动画羊毛球！ [na shen zhi bu shi ni de shi ， ni zhe ge yu chun de dong hua yang mao qiu ！]

english: How now foolish cow? Do you read poetry, instead of pulling a plow?
translation: 怎么现在傻牛了？你读诗而不是拉犁吗？ [zen me xian zai sha niu le ？ ni du shi er bu shi la li ma ？]

english: I'm not talking to you any more, you're nasty.
translation: 我不跟你说话了，你太恶心了。 [wo bu gen ni shuo hua le ， ni tai e xin le 。]

english: Oh no! Cow's not talking to me!
translation: 哦不！牛不跟我说话！ [o bu ！ niu bu gen wo shuo hua ！]

english: Do I look like I care?
translation: 我看起来像是在乎吗？ [wo kan qi lai xiang shi zai hu ma ？]

english: I wish I was a cow My life would be so simple I could lie around just eating grass And wonder if I was a pimple.
translation: 我希望我是一头牛，我的生活会如此简单，我可以躺着吃草，并想知道我是否是一个粉刺。 [wo xi wang wo shi yi tou niu ， wo de sheng huo hui ru ci jian dan ， wo ke yi tang zhe chi cao ， bing xiang zhi dao wo shi fou shi yi ge fen ci 。]

english: Hahaha, I don't think!
translation: 哈哈哈，我不认为！ [ha ha ha ， wo bu ren wei ！]

english: Well I thought it was funny.
translation: 嗯，我觉得这很有趣。 [n ， wo jue de zhe hen you qu 。]

english: How goes it, blade of grass? I'm glad you're not any thinner You should invite your friends around So I can have my dinner!
translation: 怎么样，小草？我很高兴你没有瘦下来。你应该邀请你的朋友过来，这样我就可以吃晚饭了！ [zen me yang ， xiao cao ？ wo hen gao xing ni mei you shou xia lai 。 ni ying gai yao qing ni de peng you guo lai ， zhe yang wo jiu ke yi chi wan fan le ！]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Huh, the cow's right. You humans have absolutely no understanding of art!
translation: 呵呵，牛说得对。你们人类根本不懂艺术！ [he he ， niu shuo de dui 。 ni men ren lei gen ben bu dong yi shu ！]

english: Do you know what these strange marks mean?
translation: 你知道这些奇怪的标记意味着什么吗？ [ni zhi dao zhe xie qi guai de biao ji yi wei zhe shen me ma ？]

english: The humans found some symbolsAnd doesn't know what they meanSo now it's cross-examining meAnd spoiling my routine!
translation: 人类发现了一些符号并且不知道它们的含义所以现在它正在盘问我并且破坏了我的日常生活！ [ren lei fa xian le yi xie fu hao bing qie bu zhi dao ta men de han yi suo yi xian zai ta zheng zai pan wen wo bing qie po huai le wo de ri chang sheng huo ！]

english: You give me a hair-cut and then expect me to talk to you? I think not!
translation: 你给我理发后就指望我跟你说话？我认为不是！ [ni gei wo li fa hou jiu zhi wang wo gen ni shuo hua ？ wo ren wei bu shi ！]

english: Yes, please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hey, who're you?
translation: 嘿，你是谁？ [hei ， ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm Sherlock, master of clues and challenges.
translation: 我是夏洛克，线索和挑战的大师。 [wo shi xia luo ke ， xian suo he tiao zhan de da shi 。]

english: Clues and challenges?
translation: 线索和挑战？ [xian suo he tiao zhan ？]

english: If you find a scroll that requires my attention, bring it to me and I shall handle it.
translation: 如果你发现有需要我注意的卷轴，就把它带给我，我会处理的。 [ru guo ni fa xian you xu yao wo zhu yi de juan zhou ， jiu ba ta dai gei wo ， wo hui chu li de 。]

english: I will! but...
translation: 我会！但... [wo hui ！ dan ...]

english: You're not wearing a shirt?
translation: 你没穿衬衫吗？ [ni mei chuan chen shan ma ？]

english: Yeah, no shirt Sherlock.....
translation: 是的，夏洛克没穿衬衫…… [shi de ， xia luo ke mei chuan chen shan ……]

english: Ah, just what I was looking for. I have a challenge for you. If you complete it, I'll give you something.
translation: 啊，正是我在寻找的东西。我有一个挑战要给你。如果你完成了，我会给你一些东西。 [a ， zheng shi wo zai xun zhao de dong xi 。 wo you yi ge tiao zhan yao gei ni 。 ru guo ni wan cheng le ， wo hui gei ni yi xie dong xi 。]

english: Fantastic! Here, have this.
translation: 极好的！给，这个。 [ji hao de ！ gei ， zhe ge 。]

english: Welcome to the Cloak and Stagger! Anything I can get you?
translation: 欢迎来到斗篷与交错！有什么我可以给你的吗？ [huan ying lai dao dou peng yu jiao cuo ！ you shen me wo ke yi gei ni de ma ？]

english: I'd like to order a drink, please.
translation: 我想点一杯饮料。 [wo xiang dian yi bei yin liao 。]

english: Of course, what would you like?
translation: 当然，你想要什么？ [dang ran ， ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Got anything special on tap?
translation: 有什么特别的东西吗？ [you shen me te bie de dong xi ma ？]

english: We're always running a keg of our locally-brewed ale, Lizardkicker.
translation: 我们总是供应一桶本地酿造的啤酒 Lizardkicker。 [wo men zong shi gong ying yi tong ben di niang zao de pi jiu  Lizardkicker。]

english: I will warn you though, its an acquired taste.
translation: 但我要警告你，这是一种后天习得的品味。 [dan wo yao jing gao ni ， zhe shi yi zhong hou tian xi de de pin wei 。]

english: What's in it?
translation: 里面有什么？ [li mian you shen me ？]

english: Oh, the usual... Wheat, hops, yeast...
translation: 哦，通常的...小麦、啤酒花、酵母... [o ， tong chang de ... xiao mai 、 pi jiu hua 、 jiao mu ...]

english: ...reptile scales...
translation: ...爬行动物的鳞片... [... pa xing dong wu de lin pian ...]

english: Scales?!
translation: 秤？！ [cheng ？！]

english: Don't worry about the scales.
translation: 不用担心体重秤。 [bu yong dan xin ti zhong cheng 。]

english: Was there anything else?
translation: 还有别的事吗？ [hai you bie de shi ma ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This here is the Cloak and Stagger. The finest drinking establishment in the whole of Shayzien.
translation: 这是斗篷与交错。整个 Shayzien 最好的饮酒场所。 [zhe shi dou peng yu jiao cuo 。 zheng ge  Shayzien  zui hao de yin jiu chang suo 。]

english: Isn't it the only pub in the city?
translation: 这不是城里唯一的酒吧吗？ [zhe bu shi cheng li wei yi de jiu ba ma ？]

english: Like I say, the finest in all of Shayzien!
translation: 就像我说的，Shayzien 中最好的！ [jiu xiang wo shuo de ，Shayzien  zhong zui hao de ！]

english: Most of our patrons are soldiers returning on leave from the frontlines. We do get a few regular folk in too though.
translation: 我们的大多数顾客都是从前线休假返回的士兵。不过，我们也确实有一些普通人加入。 [wo men de da duo shu gu ke dou shi cong qian xian xiu jia fan hui di shi bing 。 bu guo ， wo men ye que shi you yi xie pu tong ren jia ru 。]

english: By the way, its generally considered polite to buy a drink if you're going to stand around and chat.
translation: 顺便说一下，如果你要站着聊天，买一杯饮料通常被认为是有礼貌的。 [shun bian shuo yi xia ， ru guo ni yao zhan zhe liao tian ， mai yi bei yin liao tong chang bei ren wei shi you li mao de 。]

english: ...With that said, is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: ……那么，还有什么可以帮您的吗？ […… na me ， hai you shen me ke yi bang nin de ma ？]

english: Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: 你在这里听到过什么谣言吗？ [ni zai zhe li ting dao guo shen me yao yan ma ？]

english: Apparently Veos is looking for some help with something. He hangs around the docks of Port Piscarilius.
translation: 显然 Veos 正在寻求一些帮助。他在皮斯卡利留斯港的码头附近闲逛。 [xian ran  Veos  zheng zai xun qiu yi xie bang zhu 。 ta zai pi si ka li liu si gang de ma tou fu jin xian guang 。]

english: They say there's trouble in Port Piscarilius. Something about gangs uniting. Might be worth looking into.
translation: 他们说皮斯卡利留斯港有麻烦。一些关于帮派联合的事情。可能值得研究一下。 [ta men shuo pi si ka li liu si gang you ma fan 。 yi xie guan yu bang pai lian he de shi qing 。 ke neng zhi de yan jiu yi xia 。]

english: I hear that Lord Hosidius has misplaced one of his sons. The Hosidius family might pay a lot to see him returned safely.
translation: 我听说霍西迪乌斯勋爵失去了他的一个儿子。霍西迪乌斯家族可能会付出很多代价才能让他安全归来。 [wo ting shuo huo xi di wu si xun jue shi qu le ta de yi ge er zi 。 huo xi di wu si jia zu ke neng hui fu chu hen duo dai jia cai neng rang ta an quan gui lai 。]

english: Phileas Rimor has supposedly been looking for some assistance with something in Shayzien. Maybe worth investigating.
translation: 据说菲利亚斯·里莫一直在向 Shayzien 寻求一些帮助。也许值得调查。 [ju shuo fei li ya si · li mo yi zhi zai xiang  Shayzien  xun qiu yi xie bang zhu 。 ye xu zhi de diao cha 。]

english: I hear that the rulers of Lovakengj have some work available. You'll find them in the Lovakengj Assembly.
translation: 我听说洛瓦肯杰的统治者有一些工作要做。您可以在洛瓦肯吉议会找到它们。 [wo ting shuo luo wa ken jie de tong zhi zhe you yi xie gong zuo yao zuo 。 nin ke yi zai luo wa ken ji yi hui zhao dao ta men 。]

english: Apparently there's been some commotion in the middle of Arceuus. Might be worth checking out.
translation: 阿尔宙斯的中央显然发生了一些骚动。可能值得一看。 [a er zhou si de zhong yang xian ran fa sheng le yi xie sao dong 。 ke neng zhi de yi kan 。]

english: That protest outside Kourend Castle is starting to attract some attention. Could be worth taking a look.
translation: 库伦德城堡外的抗议活动开始引起一些关注。可能值得一看。 [ku lun de cheng bao wai de kang yi huo dong kai shi yin qi yi xie guan zhu 。 ke neng zhi de yi kan 。]

english: No, it hasn't been very busy lately.
translation: 不，最近不太忙。 [bu ， zui jin bu tai mang 。]

english: Actually, I think I need to be going.
translation: 事实上，我想我该走了。 [shi shi shang ， wo xiang wo gai zou le 。]

english: Safe travels!
translation: 安全出行！ [an quan chu xing ！]

english: I'd like to order a drink, please.
translation: 我想点一杯饮料。 [wo xiang dian yi bei yin liao 。]

english: Got anything special on tap?
translation: 有什么特别的东西吗？ [you shen me te bie de dong xi ma ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: 你在这里听到过什么谣言吗？ [ni zai zhe li ting dao guo shen me yao yan ma ？]

english: Actually, I think I need to be going.
translation: 事实上，我想我该走了。 [shi shi shang ， wo xiang wo gai zou le 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Greetings adventurer.
translation: 问候冒险家。 [wen hou mao xian jia 。]

english: What's with all the shields?
translation: 所有的盾牌都是怎么回事？ [suo you de dun pai dou shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: Although archers like myself like to keep distance from our enemies, it's always good to have a bit of protection.
translation: 虽然像我这样的弓箭手喜欢与敌人保持距离，但有一点保护总是好的。 [sui ran xiang wo zhe yang de gong jian shou xi huan yu di ren bao chi ju li ， dan you yi dian bao hu zong shi hao de 。]

english: Very sensible! Did you make these yourself?
translation: 很懂事！这些是你自己做的吗？ [hen dong shi ！ zhe xie shi ni zi ji zuo de ma ？]

english: I am a bit of a craftsman, I indeed made all these shields.
translation: 我有点工匠精神，这些盾牌确实都是我做的。 [wo you dian gong jiang jing shen ， zhe xie dun pai que shi dou shi wo zuo de 。]

english: How do you make them?
translation: 你怎么制作它们？ [ni zen me zhi zuo ta men ？]

english: It's very simple! First you'll need to be skilled in crafting and fletching, the exact details you can find in your skill guide.
translation: 很简单！首先，您需要具备制作和制箭的技能，具体细节可以在技能指南中找到。 [hen jian dan ！ shou xian ， nin xu yao ju bei zhi zuo he zhi jian de ji neng ， ju ti xi jie ke yi zai ji neng zhi nan zhong zhao dao 。]

english: For every shield, you'll require some tools! A knife for fletching the wood and a hammer for crafting the shield.
translation: 对于每个盾牌，您都需要一些工具！一把用来给木头打羽毛的刀和一把用来制作盾牌的锤子。 [dui yu mei ge dun pai ， nin dou xu yao yi xie gong ju ！ yi ba yong lai gei mu tou da yu mao de dao he yi ba yong lai zhi zuo dun pai de chui zi 。]

english: As for resources, you'll need 2 logs, 2 pieces of tanned leather and 15 nails.
translation: 至于资源，你需要 2 根原木、2 块鞣制皮革和 15 个钉子。 [zhi yu zi yuan ， ni xu yao  2  gen yuan mu 、2  kuai rou zhi pi ge he  15  ge ding zi 。]

english: Where can I find out more information about the resources needed?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到有关所需资源的更多信息？ [wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao you guan suo xu zi yuan de geng duo xin xi ？]

english: I have a flyer! It details all the shields and the resources needed for them.
translation: 我有传单！它详细介绍了所有护盾及其所需的资源。 [wo you chuan dan ！ ta xiang xi jie shao le suo you hu dun ji qi suo xu de zi yuan 。]

english: May I have a resource flyer?
translation: 我可以要一份资源传单吗？ [wo ke yi yao yi fen zi yuan chuan dan ma ？]

english: Of course! The more you know, the better!
translation: 当然！您知道的越多越好！ [dang ran ！ nin zhi dao de yue duo yue hao ！]

english: The Shield Master hands you 'Leather Shields - Resource information flyer'.
translation: 盾牌大师递给您“皮革盾牌 - 资源信息传单”。 [dun pai da shi di gei nin “ pi ge dun pai  -  zi yuan xin xi chuan dan ”。]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: You already have a flyer, I've only so many left.

english: Who are you?

english: Oh... How did you come across that crossbow then?

translation: 哦这个？最近有一个流浪商人过来，告诉我这是最隐蔽的弩。 [o zhe ge ？ zui jin you yi ge liu lang shang ren guo lai ， gao su wo zhe shi zui yin bi de nu 。]

english: Is it?
translation: 是吗？ [shi ma ？]

english: Well, he told me it was his last one too, so I figured I'd give it a try.
translation: 好吧，他告诉我这也是他的最后一次，所以我想我应该尝试一下。 [hao ba ， ta gao su wo zhe ye shi ta de zui hou yi ci ， suo yi wo xiang wo ying gai chang shi yi xia 。]

english: It was nice meeting you William.
translation: 很高兴见到你威廉。 [hen gao xing jian dao ni wei lian 。]

english: I bet!
translation: 我打赌！ [wo da du ！]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: May I have a resource flyer?

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Hello youngster!
translation: 年轻人你好！ [nian qing ren ni hao ！]

english: [I/We] don't talk to strange old people.
translation: [我/我们]不和奇怪的老人说话。 [[ wo / wo men ] bu he qi guai de lao ren shuo hua 。]

english: Hey who you calling old?! And strange?!
translation: 嘿，你说谁老？！而且很奇怪？！ [hei ， ni shuo shui lao ？！ er qie hen qi guai ？！]

english: Hello again.
translation: 又好。 [you hao 。]

english: You think you're tough do you?
translation: 你以为你很坚强是吗？ [ni yi wei ni hen jian qiang shi ma ？]

english: Pardon?
translation: 赦免？ [she mian ？]

english: I can beat anyone up!
translation: 我可以打败任何人！ [wo ke yi da bai ren he ren ！]

english: He can you know!
translation: 他能知道吗！ [ta neng zhi dao ma ！]

english: Really?
translation: 真的吗？ [zhen de ma ？]

english: The boy begins to jump around with his fists up. You decide it's best not to kill him just yet.
translation: 男孩开始举起拳头跳来跳去。你决定最好还是不要杀他。 [nan hai kai shi ju qi quan tou tiao lai tiao qu 。 ni jue ding zui hao hai shi bu yao sha ta 。]

english: Hello there, I've been looking for you.
translation: 你好，我一直在找你。 [ni hao ， wo yi zhi zai zhao ni 。]

english: I didn't mean to take it! I just forgot to pay.
translation: 我不是有意要拿的！我只是忘了付钱。 [wo bu shi you yi yao na de ！ wo zhi shi wang le fu qian 。]

english: What? I'm trying to help your mum find Fluffs.
translation: 什么？我正在努力帮助你妈妈找到绒毛。 [shen me ？ wo zheng zai nu li bang zhu ni ma ma zhao dao rong mao 。]

english: Ohh...well, in that case I might be able to help. Fluffs followed me to my secret play area, I haven't seen her since.
translation: 哦……好吧，这样的话我也许能帮上忙。绒毛跟着我到了我的秘密游乐区，从那以后我就再没有见过她。 [o …… hao ba ， zhe yang de hua wo ye xu neng bang shang mang 。 rong mao gen zhe wo dao le wo de mi mi you le qu ， cong na yi hou wo jiu zai mei you jian guo ta 。]

english: Where is this play area?
translation: 这个游乐区在哪里？ [zhe ge you le qu zai na li ？]

english: If I told you that, it wouldn't be a secret.
translation: 如果我告诉你这件事，那就不是什么秘密了。 [ru guo wo gao su ni zhe jian shi ， na jiu bu shi shen me mi mi le 。]

english: Tell me sonny, or I will hurt you.
translation: 告诉我，儿子，否则我会伤害你。 [gao su wo ， er zi ， fou ze wo hui shang hai ni 。]

english: W..wh..what?! Y..you wouldn't! A young lad like me! I'd have you behind bars before nightfall!
translation: 什..什..什么？！ Y..你不会的！像我这样的年轻小伙子！我会在天黑之前把你关进监狱！ [shen .. shen .. shen me ？！ Y.. ni bu hui de ！ xiang wo zhe yang de nian qing xiao huo zi ！ wo hui zai tian hei zhi qian ba ni guan jin jian yu ！]

english: You decided it's best not to hurt the boy.
translation: 你决定最好不要伤害这个男孩。 [ni jue ding zui hao bu yao shang hai zhe ge nan hai 。]

english: What will make you tell me?
translation: 什么会让你告诉我？ [shen me hui rang ni gao su wo ？]

english: Well...now you ask, I am a bit short on cash.
translation: 嗯……现在你问了，我有点缺现金。 [n …… xian zai ni wen le ， wo you dian que xian jin 。]

english: How much?
translation: 多少？ [duo shao ？]

english: 10 coins.
translation: 10枚硬币。 [10 mei ying bi 。]

english: 10 coins?!
translation: 10金币？！ [10 jin bi ？！]

english: I'll handle this.
translation: 我会处理这件事。 [wo hui chu li zhe jian shi 。]

english: 100 coins should cover it.
translation: 100个金币应该可以覆盖它。 [100 ge jin bi ying gai ke yi fu gai ta 。]

english: 100 coins! Why should I pay you?
translation: 100金币！我为什么要付钱给你？ [100 jin bi ！ wo wei shen me yao fu qian gei ni ？]

english: You shouldn't, but we won't help otherwise. We never liked that cat anyway, so what do you say?
translation: 你不应该这么做，但我们不会提供任何帮助。反正我们从来不喜欢那只猫，那你怎么说呢？ [ni bu ying gai zhe me zuo ， dan wo men bu hui ti gong ren he bang zhu 。 fan zheng wo men cong lai bu xi huan na zhi mao ， na ni zen me shuo ne ？]

english: I'm not paying you a penny.
translation: 我不会付你一分钱。 [wo bu hui fu ni yi fen qian 。]

english: Okay then, I'll find another way to make money.
translation: 好吧，那我就另想办法赚钱吧。 [hao ba ， na wo jiu ling xiang ban fa zhuan qian ba 。]

english: Okay then, I'll pay.
translation: 好吧，那我付钱。 [hao ba ， na wo fu qian 。]

english: You give the lad 100 coins.
translation: 你给了小伙子 100 枚硬币。 [ni gei le xiao huo zi  100  mei ying bi 。]

english: There you go, now where did you see Fluffs ?
translation: 好了，现在你在哪里看到绒毛了？ [hao le ， xian zai ni zai na li kan dao rong mao le ？]

translation: 我在东北部一个废弃的木材厂玩耍。就在快乐野猪旅馆的对面。我看到绒毛在那里跑来跑去。 [wo zai dong bei bu yi ge fei qi de mu cai chang wan shua 。 jiu zai kuai le ye zhu lv guan de dui mian 。 wo kan dao rong mao zai na li pao lai pao qu 。]

english: Anything else?
translation: 还要别的吗？ [hai yao bie de ma ？]

english: Well, you'll have to find the broken fence to get in. I'm sure you can manage that.
translation: 好吧，你必须找到破损的栅栏才能进去。我相信你能做到。 [hao ba ， ni bi xu zhao dao po sun de zha lan cai neng jin qu 。 wo xiang xin ni neng zuo dao 。]

english: Well, never mind, it's Fluffs' loss.
translation: 好吧，没关系，这是弗拉夫斯的损失。 [hao ba ， mei guan xi ， zhe shi fu la fu si de sun shi 。]

english: I'm sure my mum will get over it.
translation: 我相信我妈妈会克服它的。 [wo xiang xin wo ma ma hui ke fu ta de 。]

english: Where did you say you saw Fluffs?
translation: 你说你在哪里看到了绒毛？ [ni shuo ni zai na li kan dao le rong mao ？]

english: Weren't you listening? I saw the flea bag in the old lumber mill just north east of here. Just walk past the Jolly Boar Inn and you should find it.
translation: 你没在听吗？我在东北方的旧木材厂里看到了跳蚤袋。只要走过 Jolly Boar Inn 就可以找到它。 [ni mei zai ting ma ？ wo zai dong bei fang de jiu mu cai chang li kan dao le tiao zao dai 。 zhi yao zou guo  Jolly Boar Inn  jiu ke yi zhao dao ta 。]
