translation: 你确定吗？我也很喜欢死亡。 [ni que ding ma ？ wo ye hen xi huan si wang 。]

english: What are you on about?
translation: 你在忙什么？ [ni zai mang shen me ？]

english: You know, end of the world, holy fire, final dawns, that sort of thing.
translation: 你知道，世界末日，圣火，最后的黎明，诸如此类的事情。 [ni zhi dao ， shi jie mo ri ， sheng huo ， zui hou de li ming ， zhu ru ci lei de shi qing 。]

english: Are you a fool? Keep your voice down!
translation: 你是傻子吗？小点声！ [ni shi sha zi ma ？ xiao dian sheng ！]

english: Look, I'm not here to cause problems. I just want to help.
translation: 听着，我不是来制造麻烦的。我只是想帮忙。 [ting zhe ， wo bu shi lai zhi zao ma fan de 。 wo zhi shi xiang bang mang 。]

english: You want to join the Emissaries?
translation: 你想加入使者吗？ [ni xiang jia ru shi zhe ma ？]

english: And a friend as well.
translation: 还有一个朋友。 [hai you yi ge peng you 。]

english: You know there are tests you'd need to pass, right? Not everyone can be considered worthy.
translation: 你知道你需要通过一些测试，对吧？不是每个人都可以被认为是值得的。 [ni zhi dao ni xu yao tong guo yi xie ce shi ， dui ba ？ bu shi mei ge ren dou ke yi bei ren wei shi zhi de de 。]

english: Fine by me. I love tests!
translation: 对我来说很好。我喜欢测试！ [dui wo lai shuo hen hao 。 wo xi huan ce shi ！]

english: There is a penalty for failing them.
translation: 如果不及格，就会受到惩罚。 [ru guo bu ji ge ， jiu hui shou dao cheng fa 。]

english: Okay, not quite as fun, but I'm still up for it.
translation: 好吧，虽然没那么有趣，但我仍然愿意。 [hao ba ， sui ran mei na me you qu ， dan wo reng ran yuan yi 。]

english: Well... if you're sure, fetch your friend and then head east to the Twilight Temple. I will send word for them to expect you both.
translation: 好吧……如果你确定的话，带上你的朋友，然后向东前往暮光神庙。我会传话让他们期待你们俩。 [hao ba …… ru guo ni que ding de hua ， dai shang ni de peng you ， ran hou xiang dong qian wang mu guang shen miao 。 wo hui chuan hua rang ta men qi dai ni men lia 。]

english: Lovely! Thanks!
translation: 迷人的！谢谢！ [mi ren de ！ xie xie ！]

english: About the Emissaries...
translation: 关于使者... [guan yu shi zhe ...]

english: I already told you to keep your voice down! Fetch your friend and then head east to the Twilight Temple. I will send word for them to expect you both.
translation: 我已经告诉过你小点声了！带上你的朋友，然后向东前往暮光神庙。我会传话让他们期待你们俩。 [wo yi jing gao su guo ni xiao dian sheng le ！ dai shang ni de peng you ， ran hou xiang dong qian wang mu guang shen miao 。 wo hui chuan hua rang ta men qi dai ni men lia 。]

english: Great! Thanks!
translation: 伟大的！谢谢！ [wei da de ！ xie xie ！]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: I hear you can offer help to those in need.
translation: 我听说你可以为有需要的人提供帮助。 [wo ting shuo ni ke yi wei you xu yao de ren ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: About the Emissaries...
translation: 关于使者... [guan yu shi zhe ...]

english: Need something?
translation: 需要东西吗？ [xu yao dong xi ma ？]

english: What are you selling?
translation: 你卖什么？ [ni mai shen me ？]

english: I'm good.
translation: 我很好。 [wo hen hao 。]

english: If you say so.
translation: 如果你这么说的话。 [ru guo ni zhe me shuo de hua 。]

english: What are you selling?
translation: 你卖什么？ [ni mai shen me ？]

english: I'm good.
translation: 我很好。 [wo hen hao 。]

english: Nilsal. In need of supplies?
translation: 尼尔萨尔。需要物资吗？ [ni er sa er 。 xu yao wu zi ma ？]

english: What do you have?
translation: 你有什么？ [ni you shen me ？]

english: As you wish.
translation: 如你所愿。 [ru ni suo yuan 。]

english: What do you have?
translation: 你有什么？ [ni you shen me ？]

english: Human.
translation: 人类。 [ren lei 。]

english: Tell me about the Nightmare.
translation: 告诉我关于梦魇的事情。 [gao su wo guan yu meng yan de shi qing 。]

english: From the moment I was born, all I ever knew was the Nightmare. Every night she would feast upon us, filling our minds with horrors beyond comprehension.
translation: 从我出生的那一刻起，我所知道的就只有噩梦。每天晚上，她都会以我们为食，让我们心中充满难以理解的恐惧。 [cong wo chu sheng de na yi ke qi ， wo suo zhi dao de jiu zhi you e meng 。 mei tian wan shang ， ta du hui yi wo men wei shi ， rang wo men xin zhong chong man nan yi li jie de kong ju 。]

english: By day, our warriors would enter her lair in the caves beneath the island. We could not hope to defeat her, we knew that, but our survival was dependent on ensuring she didn't grow too strong.
translation: 白天，我们的战士会进入她在岛下洞穴中的巢穴。我们知道，我们不能指望打败她，但我们的生存取决于确保她不会变得太强大。 [bai tian ， wo men de zhan shi hui jin ru ta zai dao xia dong xue zhong de chao xue 。 wo men zhi dao ， wo men bu neng zhi wang da bai ta ， dan wo men de sheng cun qu jue yu que bao ta bu hui bian de tai qiang da 。]

english: Here's the thing though. Even now, we know little about her. Before she claimed them, my parents would sometimes tell me a story of her origin.
translation: 但事情是这样的。即使现在，我们对她也知之甚少。在她认领它们之前，我的父母有时会给我讲一个关于她的出身的故事。 [dan shi qing shi zhe yang de 。 ji shi xian zai ， wo men dui ta ye zhi zhi shen shao 。 zai ta ren ling ta men zhi qian ， wo de fu mu you shi hui gei wo jiang yi ge guan yu ta de chu shen de gu shi 。]

english: They told me of a group of shamans who performed an unknown ritual in the hope of gaining great power. The ritual went wrong, though, and instead, they unleashed the Nightmare on this world.
translation: 他们告诉我，一群萨满举行了一场未知的仪式，希望获得强大的力量。然而，仪式出了问题，相反，他们向这个世界释放了噩梦。 [ta men gao su wo ， yi qun sa man ju xing le yi chang wei zhi de yi shi ， xi wang huo de qiang da de li liang 。 ran er ， yi shi chu le wen ti ， xiang fan ， ta men xiang zhe ge shi jie shi fang le e meng 。]

english: Do you believe the story?
translation: 你相信这个故事吗？ [ni xiang xin zhe ge gu shi ma ？]

english: I'm not sure to be honest. I suppose it doesn't matter though. We'll likely never know her true origin. But as long as we can defeat her, we don't need to.
translation: 我不确定是否诚实。我想这并不重要。我们可能永远不会知道她的真实出身。但只要我们能打败她，我们就不需要这么做。 [wo bu que ding shi fou cheng shi 。 wo xiang zhe bing bu zhong yao 。 wo men ke neng yong yuan bu hui zhi dao ta de zhen shi chu shen 。 dan zhi yao wo men neng da bai ta ， wo men jiu bu xu yao zhe me zuo 。]

english: Defeat her? Using the totems?
translation: 打败她？使用图腾？ [da bai ta ？ shi yong tu teng ？]

english: Exactly. Thanks to the Nightmare, the caves beneath our home are mostly unexplored. There's all sorts of things down there, provided you're brave enough to enter.
translation: 确切地。多亏了梦魇，我们家下面的洞穴大部分都未被探索过。那里有各种各样的东西，只要你有足够的勇气进去。 [que qie di 。 duo kui le meng yan ， wo men jia xia mian de dong xue da bu fen dou wei bei tan suo guo 。 na li you ge zhong ge yang de dong xi ， zhi yao ni you zu gou de yong qi jin qu 。]

english: I found the totems deep within the caves. Someone far smarter than you or I had worked out how to make them. But they perished before they could use them against her.
translation: 我在洞穴深处找到了图腾。比你我聪明得多的人已经想出了如何制作它们。但他们在利用它们对付她之前就死了。 [wo zai dong xue shen chu zhao dao le tu teng 。 bi ni wo cong ming de duo de ren yi jing xiang chu le ru he zhi zuo ta men 。 dan ta men zai li yong ta men dui fu ta zhi qian jiu si le 。]

english: I managed to recover them, and with them, we finally drove her off the island.
translation: 我设法找回了它们，并最终带着它们将她赶出了岛上。 [wo she fa zhao hui le ta men ， bing zui zhong dai zhe ta men jiang ta gan chu le dao shang 。]

english: But she came here.
translation: 但她却来到了这里。 [dan ta que lai dao le zhe li 。]

english: Yes. And thanks to the Sleeper Plague, she's far stronger than ever before.
translation: 是的。多亏了沉睡者瘟疫，她比以前更加强大。 [shi de 。 duo kui le chen shui zhe wen yi ， ta bi yi qian geng jia qiang da 。]

english: Do you know where the Sleeper Plague came from?
translation: 你知道沉睡者瘟疫从何而来吗？ [ni zhi dao chen shui zhe wen yi cong he er lai ma ？]

english: No. It was here long before the Nightmare apparently. It resurfaced shortly before she arrived. Probably the work of the vampyres.
translation: 不，显然早在噩梦发生之前它就已经在这里了。在她到达之前不久，它再次出现。可能是吸血鬼的杰作。 [bu ， xian ran zao zai e meng fa sheng zhi qian ta jiu yi jing zai zhe li le 。 zai ta dao da zhi qian bu jiu ， ta zai ci chu xian 。 ke neng shi xi xue gui de jie zuo 。]

english: Is there anything else you need?
translation: 您还需要什么吗？ [nin hai xu yao shen me ma ？]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: The name's Shura. I come from an island called Ashihama, in the Pincers.
translation: 名字叫修罗。我来自钳子岛的一个叫芦滨的岛屿。 [ming zi jiao xiu luo 。 wo lai zi qian zi dao de yi ge jiao lu bin de dao yu 。]

english: The Pincers?
translation: 铁钳队？ [tie qian dui ？]

english: It's a group of islands within the Wushanko Isles, a large archipelago to the far east. Over here I think the area is more commonly known as the Eastern Lands.
translation: 它是乌山科群岛（远东的一个大群岛）内的一组岛屿。在这里，我认为该地区通常被称为东部土地。 [ta shi wu shan ke qun dao （ yuan dong de yi ge da qun dao ） nei de yi zu dao yu 。 zai zhe li ， wo ren wei gai di qu tong chang bei cheng wei dong bu tu di 。]

english: And you're a siren, right?
translation: 你是塞壬，对吧？ [ni shi sai ren ， dui ba ？]

english: That's right. We rarely come this far to the west, the climate is too cold for our tastes. Although while the Nightmare lives, the climate is the least of my worries.
translation: 这是正确的。我们很少到西部这么远的地方，气候太冷了，不适合我们的口味。虽然噩梦还在，但气候是我最不担心的。 [zhe shi zheng que de 。 wo men hen shao dao xi bu zhe me yuan de di fang ， qi hou tai leng le ， bu shi he wo men de kou wei 。 sui ran e meng hai zai ， dan qi hou shi wo zui bu dan xin de 。]

english: Back home on the other hand, our numbers equal the humans. Sirens live on pretty much every island in the archipelago.
translation: 另一方面，在家里，我们的人数与人类持平。塞壬几乎生活在群岛的每个岛屿上。 [ling yi fang mian ， zai jia li ， wo men de ren shu yu ren lei chi ping 。 sai ren ji hu sheng huo zai qun dao de mei ge dao yu shang 。]

english: So why were you the only one to come here?
translation: 那么为什么只有你一个人来到这里呢？ [na me wei shen me zhi you ni yi ge ren lai dao zhe li ne ？]

english: We took up arms against the Nightmare because we had to, not because we wanted to. We are a peaceful race, and most were all too eager to lay down their weapons once the Nightmare was gone.
translation: 我们拿起武器对抗梦魇是因为我们不得不这样做，而不是因为我们愿意这样做。我们是一个和平的种族，一旦梦魇消失，大多数人都渴望放下武器。 [wo men na qi wu qi dui kang meng yan shi yin wei wo men bu de bu zhe yang zuo ， er bu shi yin wei wo men yuan yi zhe yang zuo 。 wo men shi yi ge he ping de zhong zu ， yi dan meng yan xiao shi ， da duo shu ren dou ke wang fang xia wu qi 。]

english: So why didn't you?
translation: 那你为什么不呢？ [na ni wei shen me bu ne ？]

english: My kind believe in something called Mo Kal. It means that anything bad that could happen, will happen. The others may have forgotten this, but I have not.
translation: 我的族人相信一种叫做莫卡尔的东西。这意味着任何可能发生的坏事都会发生。其他人可能已经忘记了这一点，但我没有。 [wo de zu ren xiang xin yi zhong jiao zuo mo ka er de dong xi 。 zhe yi wei zhe ren he ke neng fa sheng de huai shi du hui fa sheng 。 qi ta ren ke neng yi jing wang ji le zhe yi dian ， dan wo mei you 。]

english: The Nightmare may have left my home, but I won't rest until I know for sure that she can never return.
translation: 噩梦可能已经离开了我的家，但我不会休息，直到我确定她永远不会回来。 [e meng ke neng yi jing li kai le wo de jia ， dan wo bu hui xiu xi ， zhi dao wo que ding ta yong yuan bu hui hui lai 。]

english: Do you have any of my items?
translation: 你有我的物品吗？ [ni you wo de wu pin ma ？]

english: Doesn't look like it. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: 看起来不像。如果我确实拥有你的任何物品，但你在收集它们之前就死了，那么它们现在就会丢失。 [kan qi lai bu xiang 。 ru guo wo que shi yong you ni de ren he wu pin ， dan ni zai shou ji ta men zhi qian jiu si le ， na me ta men xian zai jiu hui diu shi 。]

english: I do. Try to be more careful with them next time.
translation: 我愿意。下次尝试对他们更加小心。 [wo yuan yi 。 xia ci chang shi dui ta men geng jia xiao xin 。]

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: Good luck.
translation: 祝你好运。 [zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Hey! Don't just go poking her without knowing what you're up against. Come talk to me first.
translation: 嘿！不要在不知道自己面临什么的情况下就去戳她。先来跟我聊聊吧。 [hei ！ bu yao zai bu zhi dao zi ji mian lin shen me de qing kuang xia jiu qu chuo ta 。 xian lai gen wo liao liao ba 。]

english: What's going on here?
translation: 这是怎么回事？ [zhe shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: Nothing good. This dungeon is tainted and has become the new home of the Nightmare.
translation: 没什么好说的。这个地牢被污染了，并成为了梦魇的新家。 [mei shen me hao shuo de 。 zhe ge di lao bei wu ran le ， bing cheng wei le meng yan de xin jia 。]

english: The Nightmare?
translation: 噩梦？ [e meng ？]

english: A being of pure darkness. No living creature is safe from her hunger. She feasts upon her victims while they sleep, draining their energy without even needing to touch them.
translation: 纯粹黑暗的存在。没有任何生物能免受她的饥饿。她会在受害者熟睡时以他们为食，甚至不需要碰触他们就能耗尽他们的能量。 [chun cui hei an de cun zai 。 mei you ren he sheng wu neng mian shou ta de ji e 。 ta hui zai shou hai zhe shu shui shi yi ta men wei shi ， shen zhi bu xu yao peng chu ta men jiu neng hao jin ta men de neng liang 。]

english: Those that she feeds upon experience horrifying nightmares, unlike anything you could possibly imagine. Eventually, they become too weak to even wake. Death claims them soon after.
translation: 那些被她吃掉的人会经历可怕的噩梦，与你想象的任何事情都不一样。最终，他们变得太虚弱，甚至无法醒来。不久之后死亡就夺走了他们的生命。 [na xie bei ta chi diao de ren hui jing li ke pa de e meng ， yu ni xiang xiang de ren he shi qing dou bu yi yang 。 zui zhong ， ta men bian de tai xu ruo ， shen zhi wu fa xing lai 。 bu jiu zhi hou si wang jiu duo zou le ta men de sheng ming 。]

english: Nightmares? Hence the name?
translation: 噩梦？因此得名？ [e meng ？ yin ci de ming ？]

english: Indeed. Our kind are not always the most creative.
translation: 的确。我们这种人并不总是最有创造力的。 [di que 。 wo men zhe zhong ren bing bu zong shi zui you chuang zao li de 。]

english: So how did she end up here?
translation: 那么她是怎么到这里的呢？ [na me ta shi zen me dao zhe li de ne ？]

english: For generations, she terrorised the island of Ashihama, my home. I lost a lot of good friends to her. Sometimes, I even thought I would lose myself. For some, the nightmares become too much to bear.
translation: 世世代代以来，她一直在恐吓我的家乡芦滨岛。因为她，我失去了很多好朋友。有时，我什至以为我会迷失自我。对于一些人来说，噩梦变得难以忍受。 [shi shi dai dai yi lai ， ta yi zhi zai kong he wo de jia xiang lu bin dao 。 yin wei ta ， wo shi qu le hen duo hao peng you 。 you shi ， wo shen zhi yi wei wo hui mi shi zi wo 。 dui yu yi xie ren lai shuo ， e meng bian de nan yi ren shou 。]

english: Some of us refused to give in though. Everything has a weakness, including the Nightmare, and eventually we found it. We drove her off the island, but she managed to endure.
translation: 但我们中的一些人拒绝屈服。一切事物都有弱点，包括梦魇，最终我们发现了它。我们把她赶出了岛，但她还是忍了下来。 [dan wo men zhong de yi xie ren ju jue qu fu 。 yi qie shi wu dou you ruo dian ， bao kuo meng yan ， zui zhong wo men fa xian le ta 。 wo men ba ta gan chu le dao ， dan ta hai shi ren le xia lai 。]

english: The people here are ill, suffering from a deep sleep from which few wake. They call it the Sleeper Plague. The illness made these people easy prey for the Nightmare, so she made this place her new home.
translation: 这里的人们都病了，陷入沉睡之中，很少有人能醒来。他们称之为沉睡者瘟疫。疾病让这些人很容易成为梦魇的猎物，所以她把这里当作了新家。 [zhe li de ren men dou bing le ， xian ru chen shui zhi zhong ， hen shao you ren neng xing lai 。 ta men cheng zhi wei chen shui zhe wen yi 。 ji bing rang zhe xie ren hen rong yi cheng wei meng yan de lie wu ， suo yi ta ba zhe li dang zuo le xin jia 。]

english: And you followed her here?
translation: 你还跟着她来这里？ [ni hai gen zhe ta lai zhe li ？]

english: While she still exists, my home will never be truly safe. Thanks to the Sleeper Plague, her power has grown faster than it ever did on Ashihama. If she is allowed to grow too strong, there won't be any way to stop her.
translation: 只要她还存在，我的家就永远不会真正安全。多亏了沉睡者瘟疫，她的力量比芦滨上的任何时候都增长得更快。如果任由她变得太强大，那就没有任何办法可以阻止她。 [zhi yao ta hai cun zai ， wo de jia jiu yong yuan bu hui zhen zheng an quan 。 duo kui le chen shui zhe wen yi ， ta de li liang bi lu bin shang de ren he shi hou dou zeng zhang de geng kuai 。 ru guo ren you ta bian de tai qiang da ， na jiu mei you ren he ban fa ke yi zu zhi ta 。]

english: I've managed to contain her within this section of the dungeon. She has no desire to leave for the moment. She has no need to, after all.
translation: 我已经成功地将她限制在地牢的这个区域内。她暂时不想离开。毕竟她没有必要。 [wo yi jing cheng gong di jiang ta xian zhi zai di lao de zhe ge qu yu nei 。 ta zan shi bu xiang li kai 。 bi jing ta mei you bi yao 。]

english: But make no mistake, I won't be able to stop her if she decides to move on.
translation: 但别误会，如果她决定继续前进，我将无法阻止她。 [dan bie wu hui ， ru guo ta jue ding ji xu qian jin ， wo jiang wu fa zu zhi ta 。]

english: She doesn't look too dangerous at the moment.
translation: 她现在看起来并不太危险。 [ta xian zai kan qi lai bing bu tai wei xian 。]

english: Looks can be deceiving. The battle with the Nightmare is a mental one, not a physical one. If you try to take her on, she will pull you into her dream - one where she makes the rules.
translation: 外表可能具有欺骗性。与梦魇的战斗是一场精神上的战斗，而不是肉体上的战斗。如果你试图挑战她，她会把你带入她的梦想——一个由她制定规则的梦想。 [wai biao ke neng ju you qi pian xing 。 yu meng yan de zhan dou shi yi chang jing shen shang de zhan dou ， er bu shi rou ti shang de zhan dou 。 ru guo ni shi tu tiao zhan ta ， ta hui ba ni dai ru ta de meng xiang —— yi ge you ta zhi ding gui ze de meng xiang 。]

english: But if it's a dream, how can it be dangerous?
translation: 但如果是梦的话，又怎么会有危险呢？ [dan ru guo shi meng de hua ， you zen me hui you wei xian ne ？]

english: It's her dream, not yours. Dying in her dream will destroy your mind, killing you in this world as well.
translation: 这是她的梦想，不是你的。在她的梦中死去会摧毁你的思想，也会杀死这个世界上的你。 [zhe shi ta de meng xiang ， bu shi ni de 。 zai ta de meng zhong si qu hui cui hui ni de si xiang ， ye hui sha si zhe ge shi jie shang de ni 。]

english: Sounds lovely. So how can we stop her?
translation: 听起来很可爱。那么我们怎样才能阻止她呢？ [ting qi lai hen ke ai 。 na me wo men zen yang cai neng zu zhi ta ne ？]

english: If you're willing to help, enter her dream and fight to keep her at bay. Our only hope is to prevent her from growing too strong.
translation: 如果你愿意提供帮助，请进入她的梦境并努力将她拒之门外。我们唯一的希望就是阻止她变得太强大。 [ru guo ni yuan yi ti gong bang zhu ， qing jin ru ta de meng jing bing nu li jiang ta ju zhi men wai 。 wo men wei yi de xi wang jiu shi zu zhi ta bian de tai qiang da 。]

english: You can go in alone, but I wouldn't recommend it. The more support you have, the better your chances.
translation: 一个人进去也可以，不过不推荐。您获得的支持越多，您的机会就越大。 [yi ge ren jin qu ye ke yi ， bu guo bu tui jian 。 nin huo de de zhi chi yue duo ， nin de ji hui jiu yue da 。]

english: How do I keep her at bay?
translation: 我怎样才能让她远离我？ [wo zen yang cai neng rang ta yuan li wo ？]

english: There are four totems in the area that can be used to harm her. First, you'll need to take down her shield for the totems to have an effect. Once her shield is down, use your energy to charge up the totems.
translation: 该区域有四个图腾可以用来伤害她。首先，你需要取下她的盾牌，图腾才能发挥作用。一旦她的护盾失效，就用你的能量为图腾充电。 [gai qu yu you si ge tu teng ke yi yong lai shang hai ta 。 shou xian ， ni xu yao qu xia ta de dun pai ， tu teng cai neng fa hui zuo yong 。 yi dan ta de hu dun shi xiao ， jiu yong ni de neng liang wei tu teng chong dian 。]

english: She won't sit about while you do this though, so you'll need to take care if you want to survive.
translation: 不过，当你这样做时，她不会无所事事，所以如果你想生存，你就需要小心。 [bu guo ， dang ni zhe yang zuo shi ， ta bu hui wu suo shi shi ， suo yi ru guo ni xiang sheng cun ， ni jiu xu yao xiao xin 。]

english: And what's in it for me if I do survive?
translation: 如果我活下来了，这对我有什么好处呢？ [ru guo wo huo xia lai le ， zhe dui wo you shen me hao chu ne ？]

english: You mean apart from saving the world? She's claimed many victims over the years. I'm sure she's claimed many items as well. Maybe some of them will be of value to you.
translation: 你的意思是除了拯救世界之外？多年来她已经造成了许多受害者。我确信她也领取了很多物品。也许其中一些对您有价值。 [ni de yi si shi chu le zheng jiu shi jie zhi wai ？ duo nian lai ta yi jing zao cheng le xu duo shou hai zhe 。 wo que xin ta ye ling qu le hen duo wu pin 。 ye xu qi zhong yi xie dui nin you jia zhi 。]

english: Works for me. I'd better get started then.
translation: 对我有用。那我最好就开始吧。 [dui wo you yong 。 na wo zui hao jiu kai shi ba 。]

english: Good luck. Return to me if you need more information.
translation: 祝你好运。如果您需要更多信息，请返回给我。 [zhu ni hao yun 。 ru guo nin xu yao geng duo xin xi ， qing fan hui gei wo 。]

english: Sorry, but I don't have anything for you. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: 抱歉，我没有什么可以给你的。如果我确实拥有你的任何物品，但你在收集它们之前就死了，那么它们现在就会丢失。 [bao qian ， wo mei you shen me ke yi gei ni de 。 ru guo wo que shi yong you ni de ren he wu pin ， dan ni zai shou ji ta men zhi qian jiu si le ， na me ta men xian zai jiu hui diu shi 。]

english: I think Sister Senga has your possessions instead, actually.
translation: 事实上，我认为圣加修女拥有你的财产。 [shi shi shang ， wo ren wei sheng jia xiu nv yong you ni de cai chan 。]

english: Hey! I have some of your things. You should come get them before fighting the Nightmare.
translation: 嘿！我有一些你的东西。你应该在与梦魇战斗之前来获取它们。 [hei ！ wo you yi xie ni de dong xi 。 ni ying gai zai yu meng yan zhan dou zhi qian lai huo qu ta men 。]

english: The Nightmare pulls you into her dream as you approach her.
translation: 当你接近她时，噩梦会将你拉入她的梦境。 [dang ni jie jin ta shi ， e meng hui jiang ni la ru ta de meng jing 。]

english: Tell me about the Nightmare.
translation: 告诉我关于梦魇的事情。 [gao su wo guan yu meng yan de shi qing 。]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: Do you have any of my items?
translation: 你有我的物品吗？ [ni you wo de wu pin ma ？]

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Do you need something?
translation: 你需要什么东西吗？ [ni xu yao shen me dong xi ma ？]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Well I have lots to do, so good day.
translation: 嗯，我还有很多事要做，美好的一天。 [n ， wo hai you hen duo shi yao zuo ， mei hao de yi tian 。]

english: Hello, Siamun?
translation: 你好，西亚蒙？ [ni hao ， xi ya meng ？]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: So you are Siamun then?
translation: 那你就是Siamun吗？ [na ni jiu shi Siamun ma ？]

english: Yes now what do you want?
translation: 是的，现在你想要什么？ [shi de ， xian zai ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Wow, are you this friendly to everyone?
translation: 哇，你对每个人都这么友善吗？ [wa ， ni dui mei ge ren dou zhe me you shan ma ？]

english: Just you. Now what do you want?
translation: 只有你。现在你想要什么？ [zhi you ni 。 xian zai ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: A mutual friend of ours, Ali Morrisane, wants you to supply his stall in Al Kharid with your garments.
translation: 我们共同的朋友 Ali Morrisane 希望您为他位于 Al Kharid 的摊位提供服装。 [wo men gong tong de peng you  Ali Morrisane  xi wang nin wei ta wei yu  Al Kharid  de tan wei ti gong fu zhuang 。]

english: Now why would I do that?
translation: 现在我为什么要这么做？ [xian zai wo wei shen me yao zhe me zuo ？]

english: Well for one, you'd probably sell more clothes and once the people of Al Kharid see your amazing works of tailoring, I'm sure they'd spread the word of your clothes far and wide.
translation: 首先，你可能会卖出更多的衣服，一旦阿尔卡里德的人们看到你令人惊叹的剪裁作品，我相信他们会广泛传播你的衣服。 [shou xian ， ni ke neng hui mai chu geng duo de yi fu ， yi dan a er ka li de de ren men kan dao ni ling ren jing tan de jian cai zuo pin ， wo xiang xin ta men hui guang fan chuan bo ni de yi fu 。]

english: Interesting, but I would need more materials to accomplish what you ask of me.
translation: 有趣，但我需要更多材料来完成你对我的要求。 [you qu ， dan wo xu yao geng duo cai liao lai wan cheng ni dui wo de yao qiu 。]

english: Well then what do you need?
translation: 那么你需要什么？ [na me ni xu yao shen me ？]

english: Either get me 3 pots of dye, or 3 animal pelts of the same variety and whatever you do, don't bring me any certs.
translation: 要么给我 3 罐染料，要么给我 3 个相同品种的动物毛皮，无论你做什么，都不要给我带来任何证书。 [yao me gei wo  3  guan ran liao ， yao me gei wo  3  ge xiang tong pin zhong de dong wu mao pi ， wu lun ni zuo shen me ， dou bu yao gei wo dai lai ren he zheng shu 。]

english: What do you mean by animal pelt?
translation: 动物毛皮是什么意思？ [dong wu mao pi shi shen me yi si ？]

english: Just get me 3 cowhides, 3 wolf or snake skins or the shearings of 3 sheep. Simpler still get me 3 pots of dye and whatever you do, don't bring me any certs.
translation: 给我3张牛皮，3张狼皮或蛇皮，或者3张羊剪毛。更简单的还是给我 3 罐染料，无论你做什么，都不要给我带来任何证书。 [gei wo 3 zhang niu pi ，3 zhang lang pi huo she pi ， huo zhe 3 zhang yang jian mao 。 geng jian dan de hai shi gei wo  3  guan ran liao ， wu lun ni zuo shen me ， dou bu yao gei wo dai lai ren he zheng shu 。]

english: Ok, I'll get you the materials.
translation: 好的，我去给你拿材料。 [hao de ， wo qu gei ni na cai liao 。]

english: Unless you've got the materials on you?
translation: 除非你身上有材料？ [chu fei ni shen shang you cai liao ？]

english: Ummm.. No.
Keh! Come back when you have what I need.
translation: 咳！当你有我需要的东西时就回来吧。 [ke ！ dang ni you wo xu yao de dong xi shi jiu hui lai ba 。]

english: Yup, I've got what you want with me.
translation: 是的，我这里有你想要的东西。 [shi de ， wo zhe li you ni xiang yao de dong xi 。]

english: You give the merchant the [dye/animal pelts].
translation: 你给商人[染料/动物毛皮]。 [ni gei shang ren [ ran liao / dong wu mao pi ]。]

english: Thank you adventurer. I will get my goods up to that merchant thief - Ali Morrisane as quickly as possible.
translation: 谢谢冒险家。我会尽快把我的货物交给那个商人小偷——阿里·莫里萨内。 [xie xie mao xian jia 。 wo hui jin kuai ba wo de huo wu jiao gei na ge shang ren xiao tou —— a li · mo li sa nei 。]

english: Think nothing of it. I'm looking forward to seeing what you've produced for the Al Kharid market.
translation: 什么也别想。我期待看到你们为阿尔卡里德市场生产的产品。 [shen me ye bie xiang 。 wo qi dai kan dao ni men wei a er ka li de shi chang sheng chan de chan pin 。]

english: Hello Siamun.
translation: 你好，西亚蒙。 [ni hao ， xi ya meng 。]

english: Have you got what I asked for yet?
translation: 你得到我要的东西了吗？ [ni de dao wo yao de dong xi le ma ？]

english: A hello would have been nice.
translation: 打个招呼就好了。 [da ge zhao hu jiu hao le 。]

english: Look I'm not nice, now did you get what I asked for or not?
translation: 你看我不友善，现在你得到我的要求了吗？ [ni kan wo bu you shan ， xian zai ni de dao wo de yao qiu le ma ？]

english: Umm... What do you need again?
translation: 嗯...你还需要什么？ [n ... ni hai xu yao shen me ？]

english: Just get me 3 cowhides, 3 wolf or snake skins or the shearings of 3 sheep. Simpler still just get me 3 pots of dye and whatever you do, don't bring me any certs.
translation: 给我3张牛皮，3张狼皮或蛇皮，或者3张羊剪毛。更简单的还是给我 3 罐染料，无论你做什么，都不要给我带来任何证书。 [gei wo 3 zhang niu pi ，3 zhang lang pi huo she pi ， huo zhe 3 zhang yang jian mao 。 geng jian dan de hai shi gei wo  3  guan ran liao ， wu lun ni zuo shen me ， dou bu yao gei wo dai lai ren he zheng shu 。]

english: Ok.
translation: 好的。 [hao de 。]

english: You give the merchant the [dye/hides].
translation: 你给商人[染料/皮革]。 [ni gei shang ren [ ran liao / pi ge ]。]

english: Hello adventurer. Have you checked with Ali M whether my garments are selling or not?
translation: 你好冒险家。你跟 Ali M 查过我的衣服卖不卖吗？ [ni hao mao xian jia 。 ni gen  Ali M  cha guo wo de yi fu mai bu mai ma ？]

english: Not yet, I have a few things to do first.
translation: 还没有，我先有几件事要做。 [hai mei you ， wo xian you ji jian shi yao zuo 。]

english: Well I would be very much obliged if you could have a talk with him sooner rather than later, I'm not all that sure of the trustworthiness of those carpet men.
translation: 好吧，如果你能早点和他谈谈，我会非常感激，我不太确定那些地毯人是否值得信赖。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni neng zao dian he ta tan tan ， wo hui fei chang gan ji ， wo bu tai que ding na xie di tan ren shi fou zhi de xin lai 。]

english: Don't worry, I'll get to it.
translation: 别担心，我会解决的。 [bie dan xin ， wo hui jie jue de 。]

english: Hello adventurer. How are sales going?
translation: 你好冒险家。销售情况如何？ [ni hao mao xian jia 。 xiao shou qing kuang ru he ？]

english: Not too bad, Ali was well impressed by the reaction and demand they had initially but he's a little concerned about how the sales have dropped off of recent.
translation: 还不错，阿里对他们最初的反应和需求印象深刻，但他有点担心最近销量的下降。 [hai bu cuo ， a li dui ta men zui chu de fan ying he xu qiu yin xiang shen ke ， dan ta you dian dan xin zui jin xiao liang de xia jiang 。]

english: Hmmm... Maybe I could produce a different range of products.
translation: 嗯……也许我可以生产不同系列的产品。 [n …… ye xu wo ke yi sheng chan bu tong xi lie de chan pin 。]

english: I tell you what, get me 3 animal pelts of the same variety and I'll change the shipments around and whatever you do, don't bring me any certs.
translation: 我告诉你，给我 3 个相同品种的动物毛皮，我会改变发货方式，无论你做什么，都不要给我带来任何证书。 [wo gao su ni ， gei wo  3  ge xiang tong pin zhong de dong wu mao pi ， wo hui gai bian fa huo fang shi ， wu lun ni zuo shen me ， dou bu yao gei wo dai lai ren he zheng shu 。]

english: I'll tell you what, get me 3 pots of dye and I'll change the type of garments I'm sending to Ali and whatever you do, don't bring me any certs.
translation: 我会告诉你，给我 3 罐染料，我会改变发送给阿里的衣服类型，无论你做什么，都不要给我带来任何证书。 [wo hui gao su ni ， gei wo  3  guan ran liao ， wo hui gai bian fa song gei a li de yi fu lei xing ， wu lun ni zuo shen me ， dou bu yao gei wo dai lai ren he zheng shu 。]

english: What are you doing?
translation: 你在干什么？ [ni zai gan shen me ？]

english: I thought this acne potion might help ease your itching.
translation: 我认为这种痤疮药水可能有助于缓解瘙痒。 [wo ren wei zhe zhong cuo chuang yao shui ke neng you zhu yu huan jie sao yang 。]

english: Get away from me! I don't want your strange potions!
translation: 离我远点！我不要你的奇怪药剂！ [li wo yuan dian ！ wo bu yao ni de qi guai yao ji ！]

english: Sorry.
translation: 对不起。 [dui bu qi 。]

english: What do you mean by animal pelt?
translation: 动物毛皮是什么意思？ [dong wu mao pi shi shen me yi si ？]

english: Ok, I'll get you the materials.
translation: 好的，我去给你拿材料。 [hao de ， wo qu gei ni na cai liao 。]

english: Umm... What do you need again?
translation: 嗯...你还需要什么？ [n ... ni hai xu yao shen me ？]

english: Ok.
translation: 好的。 [hao de 。]

english: Hey! You look like quite the sharp shooter. Can I interest you in a new bow?
translation: 嘿！你看起来像是个神枪手。我可以给你买把新弓吗？ [hei ！ ni kan qi lai xiang shi ge shen qiang shou 。 wo ke yi gei ni mai ba xin gong ma ？]

english: Let's see what you've got.
translation: 让我们看看你有什么。 [rang wo men kan kan ni you shen me 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Well, if ya change your mind, I'll be right here.
translation: 好吧，如果你改变主意，我就在这里。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， wo jiu zai zhe li 。]

english: Let's see what you've got.
translation: 让我们看看你有什么。 [rang wo men kan kan ni you shen me 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Woo, party on bro!
translation: 哇，兄弟，聚会吧！ [wa ， xiong di ， ju hui ba ！]

english: The killer approaches Sid behind his back.
translation: 凶手在背后接近席德。 [xiong shou zai bei hou jie jin xi de 。]

english: Woah, that wind totally just felt like someone breathing on my neck!
translation: 哇哦，那风感觉就像有人在我脖子上呼吸一样！ [wa o ， na feng gan jue jiu xiang you ren zai wo bo zi shang hu xi yi yang ！]

english: The killer stabs Sid.
translation: 凶手刺伤了席德。 [xiong shou ci shang le xi de 。]

english: Whoah, not cool bro...
translation: 哎哟，哥们不帅啊…… [ai yo ， ge men bu shuai a ……]

english: ...urgh...
...I'm feeling woozy...
translation: ……我感觉头晕…… […… wo gan jue tou yun ……]

english: ...gargh...
...I see the light...
translation: ……我看到了光…… […… wo kan dao le guang ……]

english: ...urrggghhh...
...it's not my time...glurgh
translation: ...这不是我的时间...glurgh [... zhe bu shi wo de shi jian ...glurgh]

english: ...gargle...urgh...
Sid stumbles forward, drowning in the water barrel.
translation: 席德跌跌撞撞地向前走去，淹死在水桶里。 [xi de die die zhuang zhuang di xiang qian zou qu ， yan si zai shui tong li 。]

english: ...glargh...help...me...
translation: ...格拉...帮助...我... [... ge la ... bang zhu ... wo ...]

english: ...urgh...hergle...
...flergh.
translation: ...弗莱格。 [... fu lai ge 。]

english: Sid collapses to the ground in a crumpled mess. As he falls down you spot something shiny fall out of his shirt pocket and into the barrel of water.
translation: 希德倒在地上，浑身乱七八糟。当他倒下时，你发现有一个闪亮的东西从他的衬衫口袋里掉进水桶里。 [xi de dao zai di shang ， hun shen luan qi ba zao 。 dang ta dao xia shi ， ni fa xian you yi ge shan liang de dong xi cong ta de chen shan kou dai li diao jin shui tong li 。]

english: Gosh, that was horrible and so drawn out!
translation: 天哪，这太可怕了，而且太漫长了！ [tian na ， zhe tai ke pa le ， er qie tai man chang le ！]

english: Oh wow, he's still going...
translation: 哇哦，他还要去…… [wa o ， ta hai yao qu ……]

english: I think he is actually dead this time.
translation: 我想他这次是真的死了。 [wo xiang ta zhe ci shi zhen de si le 。]

english: Who are you? Why are you doing this!?
translation: 你是谁？你为什么要这样做！？ [ni shi shui ？ ni wei shen me yao zhe yang zuo ！？]

english: The killer walks away.
translation: 凶手走开。 [xiong shou zou kai 。]

english: Gah! I've got to find a way into that house and stop this maniac!
translation: 嘎！我必须想办法进入那所房子并阻止这个疯子！ [ga ！ wo bi xu xiang ban fa jin ru na suo fang zi bing zu zhi zhe ge feng zi ！]

english: I wonder what it was that I saw fall into that barrel?
translation: 我想知道我看到的是什么掉进了那个桶里？ [wo xiang zhi dao wo kan dao de shi shen me diao jin le na ge tong li ？]

english: Hello there and welcome to the shop of useful items. Can I help you at all?
translation: 您好，欢迎来到实用物品商店。我可以帮助你吗？ [nin hao ， huan ying lai dao shi yong wu pin shang dian 。 wo ke yi bang zhu ni ma ？]

english: What are you selling?
translation: 你卖什么？ [ni mai shen me ？]

english: Take a look.
translation: 看看吧。 [kan kan ba 。]

english: Do you sell Silverlight?
translation: 你们出售 Silverlight 吗？ [ni men chu shou  Silverlight  ma ？]

english: Silverlight? No, Sir Prysin of Varrock explained that that was a unique sword and told us to stop selling it. If you want Silverlight, but don't have it, you should speak to him.
translation: 银光？不，瓦罗克的普赖辛爵士解释说，那是一把独特的剑，并告诉我们停止出售它。如果您想要 Silverlight，但没有，您应该与他联系。 [yin guang ？ bu ， wa luo ke de pu lai xin jue shi jie shi shuo ， na shi yi ba du te de jian ， bing gao su wo men ting zhi chu shou ta 。 ru guo nin xiang yao  Silverlight， dan mei you ， nin ying gai yu ta lian xi 。]

english: So would you like to see what else I have?
translation: 那么你想看看我还有什么吗？ [na me ni xiang kan kan wo hai you shen me ma ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Okay. Well, if you change your mind, do pop back.
translation: 好的。好吧，如果你改变主意，就回来吧。 [hao de 。 hao ba ， ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， jiu hui lai ba 。]

english: What are you selling?
translation: 你卖什么？ [ni mai shen me ？]

english: Do you sell Silverlight?
translation: 你们出售 Silverlight 吗？ [ni men chu shou  Silverlight  ma ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: I'd be very careful going down there friend.
translation: 我去那里会非常小心，朋友。 [wo qu na li hui fei chang xiao xin ， peng you 。]

english: Why what's down there ?
translation: 为什么下面有什么？ [wei shen me xia mian you shen me ？]

english: Salarin the twisted. One of Kandarin's most dangerous chaos druids. I tried to take him on, then suddenly felt immensely weak.
translation: 扭曲的萨拉林。坎达林最危险的混沌德鲁伊之一。我试图与他较量，但突然感到无比虚弱。 [niu qu de sa la lin 。 kan da lin zui wei xian de hun dun de lu yi zhi yi 。 wo shi tu yu ta jiao liang ， dan tu ran gan dao wu bi xu ruo 。]

english: I hear he's susceptible to attacks from the mind. However I have no idea what that means, so it's not much help to me.
translation: 我听说他很容易受到精神攻击。但我不知道这意味着什么，所以这对我没有太大帮助。 [wo ting shuo ta hen rong yi shou dao jing shen gong ji 。 dan wo bu zhi dao zhe yi wei zhe shen me ， suo yi zhe dui wo mei you tai da bang zhu 。]

english: Fear not, I am very strong
translation: 别怕，我很强 [bie pa ， wo hen qiang]

english: You might find you are not so strong shortly...
translation: 很快你就会发现自己没那么坚强了…… [hen kuai ni jiu hui fa xian zi ji mei na me jian qiang le ……]

english: Why what's down there?
translation: 为什么下面有什么？ [wei shen me xia mian you shen me ？]

english: Fear not, I am very strong
translation: 别怕，我很强 [bie pa ， wo hen qiang]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Can I help you?
translation: 我可以帮你吗？ [wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: I was just curious as to what you do around here.
translation: 我只是好奇你在这里做什么。 [wo zhi shi hao qi ni zai zhe li zuo shen me 。]

english: I protect other travellers from monsters, both animal and human kind.
translation: 我保护其他旅行者免受怪物的侵害，无论是动物还是人类。 [wo bao hu qi ta lv xing zhe mian shou guai wu de qin hai ， wu lun shi dong wu hai shi ren lei 。]

english: Human? Can't say I've seen many human shaped monsters in the Wilderness.
translation: 人类？不能说我在荒野中见过很多人形怪物。 [ren lei ？ bu neng shuo wo zai huang ye zhong jian guo hen duo ren xing guai wu 。]

english: When you've been in the Wilderness as long as I have, you learn that not all monsters show themselves on the outside.
translation: 当你和我一样在荒野待了很长时间，你就会知道并不是所有的怪物都会在外面露面。 [dang ni he wo yi yang zai huang ye dai le hen zhang shi jian ， ni jiu hui zhi dao bing bu shi suo you de guai wu du hui zai wai mian lou mian 。]

english: Uhm... alright then, I'll leave you to your duties.
translation: 嗯……好吧，那我就让你继续你的职责了。 [n …… hao ba ， na wo jiu rang ni ji xu ni de zhi ze le 。]

english: Watch yourself out there, it can be hard to tell friend from foe in these lands.
translation: 在外面要小心，在这些土地上很难区分朋友和敌人。 [zai wai mian yao xiao xin ， zai zhe xie tu di shang hen nan qu fen peng you he di ren 。]

english: Well done! I have new information to share with you.
translation: 干得好！我有新信息要与您分享。 [gan de hao ！ wo you xin xin xi yao yu nin fen xiang 。]

english: I do not speak to outerlanders. If you have anything of import to say, go and speak to the Chieftain.
translation: 我不跟外地人说话。如果你有什么重要的事情要说，就去跟酋长说吧。 [wo bu gen wai di ren shuo hua 。 ru guo ni you shen me zhong yao de shi qing yao shuo ， jiu qu gen qiu zhang shuo ba 。]

english: Hello there. I have some spined dagannoth hides, and believe you might be able to make an armour of them for me...?
translation: 你好呀。我有一些带刺的达甘诺斯兽皮，相信你可以用它们为我制作一件盔甲……？ [ni hao ya 。 wo you yi xie dai ci de da gan nuo si shou pi ， xiang xin ni ke yi yong ta men wei wo zhi zuo yi jian kui jia ……？]

english: My apologies outerlander, but we are forbidden by decree to communicate with those not of our tribe, and this includes making armour for you.
translation: 我很抱歉外地人，但法令禁止我们与非我们部落的人交流，这包括为你制作盔甲。 [wo hen bao qian wai di ren ， dan fa ling jin zhi wo men yu fei wo men bu luo de ren jiao liu ， zhe bao kuo wei ni zhi zuo kui jia 。]

english: I suggest you speak to Brundt, our chieftain. He resides in the longhall and speaks for us all.
translation: 我建议你和我们的酋长布伦特谈谈。他住在长厅里，为我们所有人发言。 [wo jian yi ni he wo men de qiu zhang bu lun te tan tan 。 ta zhu zai zhang ting li ， wei wo men suo you ren fa yan 。]

english: What do you want outerlander?
translation: 外地人你想要什么？ [wai di ren ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Are you a member of the council?
translation: 您是理事会成员吗？ [nin shi li shi hui cheng yuan ma ？]

english: The Fremennik council of elders? I am pleased to say that I am. My value as a huntsman is recognised by my position there.
translation: 弗雷曼尼克长老会？我很高兴地说我是。我作为猎人的价值是通过我在那里的职位得到认可的。 [fu lei man ni ke zhang lao hui ？ wo hen gao xing di shuo wo shi 。 wo zuo wei lie ren de jia zhi shi tong guo wo zai na li de zhi wei de dao ren ke de 。]

english: I was wondering if I could persuade you to vouch for me as a member of your clan?
translation: 我想知道我能否说服你为我做担保，成为你家族的一员？ [wo xiang zhi dao wo neng fou shuo fu ni wei wo zuo dan bao ， cheng wei ni jia zu de yi yuan ？]

english: You? ... well... I am not totally against the idea outerlander. If you can demonstrate some hunting skills then perhaps I may offer my vote.
translation: 你？ ……嗯……我并不完全反对外地人的想法。如果你能展示一些狩猎技巧，那么也许我可以投票。 [ni ？ …… n …… wo bing bu wan quan fan dui wai di ren de xiang fa 。 ru guo ni neng zhan shi yi xie shou lie ji qiao ， na me ye xu wo ke yi tou piao 。]

english: How can I prove my hunting skills to you? I can go kill, like, a hundred chickens for you right now!
translation: 我怎样才能向你证明我的狩猎技巧呢？我现在就可以给你杀一百只鸡！ [wo zen yang cai neng xiang ni zheng ming wo de shou lie ji qiao ne ？ wo xian zai jiu ke yi gei ni sha yi bai zhi ji ！]

english: Chickens? You think that would impress me?
translation: 鸡？你认为这会给我留下深刻的印象吗？ [ji ？ ni ren wei zhe hui gei wo liu xia shen ke de yin xiang ma ？]

english: Cows then? I can kill cows until, er, the cows come home.
translation: 那么牛呢？我可以杀牛，直到，呃，牛回家。 [na me niu ne ？ wo ke yi sha niu ， zhi dao ， e ， niu hui jia 。]

english: No. The prey I have in mind for you to prove your worth to me is something far more dangerous. Far more difficult. Far more deadly.
translation: 不，我想让你向我证明你的价值的猎物是更危险的东西。困难得多。更致命。 [bu ， wo xiang rang ni xiang wo zheng ming ni de jia zhi de lie wu shi geng wei xian de dong xi 。 kun nan de duo 。 geng zhi ming 。]

english: Not... Giant Rats?!?!
translation: 不是……巨鼠？！？！ [bu shi …… ju shu ？！？！]

english: I suspect you are mocking me outerlander. You will need to prove your skill as a hunter to me by tracking and defeating... The Draugen.
translation: 我怀疑你是在嘲笑我这个外地人。你需要通过追踪并击败…… Draugen 来向我证明你作为猎人的技能。 [wo huai yi ni shi zai chao xiao wo zhe ge wai di ren 。 ni xu yao tong guo zhui zong bing ji bai …… Draugen  lai xiang wo zheng ming ni zuo wei lie ren de ji neng 。]

english: What's a Draugen? Some kind of cheap barbarian rip- off of a dragon?
translation: 什么是德拉根？某种廉价的野蛮人对龙的剽窃？ [shen me shi de la gen ？ mou zhong lian jia de ye man ren dui long de piao qie ？]

english: Hmmm. No, the words are slightly similar I suppose, but they are very different creatures.
translation: 嗯。不，我想这两个词有点相似，但它们是非常不同的生物。 [n 。 bu ， wo xiang zhe liang ge ci you dian xiang si ， dan ta men shi fei chang bu tong de sheng wu 。]

english: The Draugen is an evil ghost from Fremennik mythology, that devours the souls of those brave warriors who meet their ends at sea.
translation: 龙人是弗雷曼尼克神话中的邪恶幽灵，它会吞噬那些在海上死去的勇敢战士的灵魂。 [long ren shi fu lei man ni ke shen hua zhong de xie e you ling ， ta hui tun shi na xie zai hai shang si qu de yong gan zhan shi de ling hun 。]

english: It stalks the coastlines, invisible to all. It brings us bad fortunes, and curses our journeys across the seas. It is also unkillable by normal means.
translation: 它沿着海岸线潜行，但所有人都看不见。它给我们带来厄运，诅咒我们的漂洋过海。通过正常手段也无法杀死它。 [ta yan zhe hai an xian qian xing ， dan suo you ren dou kan bu jian 。 ta gei wo men dai lai e yun ， zu zhou wo men de piao yang guo hai 。 tong guo zheng chang shou duan ye wu fa sha si ta 。]

english: ...Let me get this straight; You want me to hunt an unkillable, invincible, and invisible enemy? How am I supposed to do that?
translation: ...让我说清楚；你要我去猎杀一个打不死、无敌、看不见的敌人吗？我该怎么做呢？ [... rang wo shuo qing chu ； ni yao wo qu lie sha yi ge da bu si 、 wu di 、 kan bu jian de di ren ma ？ wo gai zen me zuo ne ？]

english: Well outerlander, should you accept my challenge I will show you a special hunter's trick that will help you. Do you accept the challenge?
translation: 好吧，外来者，如果你接受我的挑战，我将向你展示一个特殊的猎人技巧，这将对你有所帮助。你接受挑战吗？ [hao ba ， wai lai zhe ， ru guo ni jie shou wo de tiao zhan ， wo jiang xiang ni zhan shi yi ge te shu de lie ren ji qiao ， zhe jiang dui ni you suo bang zhu 。 ni jie shou tiao zhan ma ？]

english: Well, I need every vote I can get in the council of elders, but this certainly sounds impossible to do...
translation: 好吧，我需要在长老会中获得每一张选票，但这听起来肯定是不可能的...... [hao ba ， wo xu yao zai zhang lao hui zhong huo de mei yi zhang xuan piao ， dan zhe ting qi lai ken ding shi bu ke neng de ......]

english: Not at all outerlander. The Draugen is indeed impossible to kill, but that is not the same as being impossible to fight against.
translation: 根本就不是外地人。龙人确实无法杀死，但这并不等于无法对抗。 [gen ben jiu bu shi wai di ren 。 long ren que shi wu fa sha si ， dan zhe bing bu deng yu wu fa dui kang 。]

english: Every time he takes a Fremennik life, he gains in power, so to keep it from becoming too powerful we hunters hunt it and steal its life force.
translation: 每当他杀死弗雷曼尼克人的生命时，他就会获得力量，因此为了防止它变得太强大，我们猎人猎杀它并窃取它的生命力。 [mei dang ta sha si fu lei man ni ke ren de sheng ming shi ， ta jiu hui huo de li liang ， yin ci wei le fang zhi ta bian de tai qiang da ， wo men lie ren lie sha ta bing qie qu ta de sheng ming li 。]

english: We do this with a special talisman. Here, take it; it will let you track the Draugen while it's invisible, and when you defeat it will absorb its essence.
translation: 我们用特殊的护身符来做到这一点。给，拿着；它会让你在德拉根隐形时追踪它，当你击败它时，它会吸收它的精华。 [wo men yong te shu de hu shen fu lai zuo dao zhe yi dian 。 gei ， na zhe ； ta hui rang ni zai de la gen yin xing shi zhui zong ta ， dang ni ji bai ta shi ， ta hui xi shou ta de jing hua 。]

english: I want you to track the Draugen, defeat it, and store its essence in that talisman for me. If you can do this important task for my clan, I will vote for you.
translation: 我希望你追踪德拉根，击败它，并将其精华储存在我的护身符中。如果你能为我的部落完成这项重要的任务，我会投票给你。 [wo xi wang ni zhui zong de la gen ， ji bai ta ， bing jiang qi jing hua chu cun zai wo de hu shen fu zhong 。 ru guo ni neng wei wo de bu luo wan cheng zhe xiang zhong yao de ren wu ， wo hui tou piao gei ni 。]

english: Take care of the talisman, and see me when you have completed this task.
translation: 保管好符咒，完成任务后来见我。 [bao guan hao fu zhou ， wan cheng ren wu hou lai jian wo 。]

english: Forget it! This all sounds like way too much work for a stupid vote at a meeting! I'll find someone else instead.
translation: 忘了它！这一切听起来对于在会议上进行愚蠢的投票来说工作量太大了！我会找别人代替。 [wang le ta ！ zhe yi qie ting qi lai dui yu zai hui yi shang jin xing yu chun de tou piao lai shuo gong zuo liang tai da le ！ wo hui zhao bie ren dai ti 。]

english: Hello again outerlander. Have you managed to hunt down the terrible Draugen yet?
translation: 外地人你好。你成功追捕可怕的德拉根了吗？ [wai di ren ni hao 。 ni cheng gong zhui bu ke pa de de la gen le ma ？]

english: Not yet...
translation: 还没有... [hai mei you ...]

english: Hmmm. Laziness is not a trait that I admire. I suggest you go and do so if you wish me to vouchsafe for you to our council of elders.
translation: 嗯。懒惰不是我欣赏的特质。如果您希望我为您向我们的长老会提供担保，我建议您就去吧。 [n 。 lan duo bu shi wo xin shang de te zhi 。 ru guo nin xi wang wo wei nin xiang wo men de zhang lao hui ti gong dan bao ， wo jian yi nin jiu qu ba 。]

english: Not yet... I lost the talisman you gave me.
translation: 还没有……我把你给我的护身符弄丢了。 [hai mei you …… wo ba ni gei wo de hu shen fu nong diu le 。]

english: Your inventory is too full to accept another Talisman.
translation: 您的库存太满，无法接受另一个护身符。 [nin de ku cun tai man ， wu fa jie shou ling yi ge hu shen fu 。]

english: I defeated the draugen, but I have lost the talisman to prove I did.
translation: 我打败了龙人，但我失去了证明我成功的护身符。 [wo da bai le long ren ， dan wo shi qu le zheng ming wo cheng gong de hu shen fu 。]

english: An amateurish mistake, outerlander. Any hunt without the proof of it is naught but empty boasting. Take this and try once more.
translation: 一个业余错误，外地人。任何没有证据的狩猎都只是空谈。拿着这个再试一次。 [yi ge ye yu cuo wu ， wai di ren 。 ren he mei you zheng ju de shou lie dou zhi shi kong tan 。 na zhe zhe ge zai shi yi ci 。]

english: I saw the entire hunt. Let me take that talisman from you; I would be honoured to speak out for you to our council of elders after such a hunt, outerlander.
translation: 我亲眼目睹了整个狩猎过程。让我把你的护身符拿走吧；在这场狩猎之后，我很荣幸能在我们的长老会议上为你说话，外来者。 [wo qin yan mu du le zheng ge shou lie guo cheng 。 rang wo ba ni de hu shen fu na zou ba ； zai zhe chang shou lie zhi hou ， wo hen rong xing neng zai wo men de zhang lao hui yi shang wei ni shuo hua ， wai lai zhe 。]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: So can I rely on your vote with the council of elders in my favour?
translation: 那么我可以相信你在长老会议上的投票对我有利吗？ [na me wo ke yi xiang xin ni zai zhang lao hui yi shang de tou piao dui wo you li ma ？]

english: Absolutely outerlander! Anyone brave enough to hunt and defeat the Draugen will be a great addition to our clan!
translation: 绝对是外地人！任何有勇气猎杀并击败德拉根的人都将成为我们氏族的重要补充！ [jue dui shi wai di ren ！ ren he you yong qi lie sha bing ji bai de la gen de ren dou jiang cheng wei wo men shi zu de zhong yao bu chong ！]

english: Greetings outerlander.
translation: 问候外地人。 [wen hou wai di ren 。]

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a map to unspoiled hunting grounds, do you?
translation: 我想你不知道我在哪里可以找到未受破坏的狩猎场的地图，是吗？ [wo xiang ni bu zhi dao wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao wei shou po huai de shou lie chang de di tu ， shi ma ？]

english: Well, of course I do. I wouldn't be much of a huntsman if I didn't know where to find my prey now, would I outerlander?
translation: 嗯，我当然愿意。如果我现在不知道在哪里可以找到猎物，我就不是一个猎人了，我会成为外乡人吗？ [n ， wo dang ran yuan yi 。 ru guo wo xian zai bu zhi dao zai na li ke yi zhao dao lie wu ， wo jiu bu shi yi ge lie ren le ， wo hui cheng wei wai xiang ren ma ？]

english: No, I guess not. So can I have it?
translation: 不，我想不是。那我可以拥有吗？ [bu ， wo xiang bu shi 。 na wo ke yi yong you ma ？]

english: Directions to my hunting grounds could mean the end of my livelihood. The only way I would be prepared to give them up would be...
translation: 前往我的狩猎场的方向可能意味着我生计的终结。我准备放弃它们的唯一方法是...... [qian wang wo de shou lie chang de fang xiang ke neng yi wei zhe wo sheng ji de zhong jie 。 wo zhun bei fang qi ta men de wei yi fang fa shi ......]

english: What? Power? Money? Women? Wine?
translation: 什么？力量？钱？女性？葡萄酒？ [shen me ？ li liang ？ qian ？ nv xing ？ pu tao jiu ？]

english: ...a new string for my hunting bow. Not just any bowstring; I need a custom bowstring, balanced for my bow precisely to keep my hunt competitive.
translation: ...我的狩猎弓的新弦。不只是任何弓弦； I need a custom bowstring, balanced for my bow precisely to keep my hunt competitive. [... wo de shou lie gong de xin xian 。 bu zhi shi ren he gong xian ； I need a custom bowstring, balanced for my bow precisely to keep my hunt competitive.]

english: Only in this way would I allow the knowledge of my hunting grounds to be passed on to strangers.
translation: 只有这样，我才能将我的狩猎场的知识传递给陌生人。 [zhi you zhe yang ， wo cai neng jiang wo de shou lie chang de zhi shi chuan di gei mo sheng ren 。]

english: So where would I get that?
translation: 那么我从哪里得到它呢？ [na me wo cong na li de dao ta ne ？]

english: I have no idea. But then again, I'm happy with my old bowstring and being the only person who knows where my hunting ground is.
translation: 我不知道。但话说回来，我对我的旧弓弦很满意，并且是唯一知道我的狩猎场在哪里的人。 [wo bu zhi dao 。 dan hua shuo hui lai ， wo dui wo de jiu gong xian hen man yi ， bing qie shi wei yi zhi dao wo de shou lie chang zai na li de ren 。]

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a finely balanced custom bowstring, do you?
translation: 我想你不知道我在哪里可以找到一根完美平衡的定制弓弦，是吗？ [wo xiang ni bu zhi dao wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao yi gen wan mei ping heng de ding zhi gong xian ， shi ma ？]

english: If I knew I would not have asked you to go and get me one, now would I?
translation: 如果我知道我就不会叫你去给我买一个了，现在会吗？ [ru guo wo zhi dao wo jiu bu hui jiao ni qu gei wo mai yi ge le ， xian zai hui ma ？]

english: Here. I have your bowstring. Give me your map to the hunting grounds.
translation: 这里。我有你的弓弦。把你去狩猎场的地图给我。 [zhe li 。 wo you ni de gong xian 。 ba ni qu shou lie chang de di tu gei wo 。]

english: Well met, outerlander. I see some hunting potential within you. Here, take my map, I was getting too dependent on it for my skill anyway.
translation: 很高兴见到你，外地人。我在你身上看到了一些狩猎的潜力。在这里，拿上我的地图，反正我的技能太依赖它了。 [hen gao xing jian dao ni ， wai di ren 。 wo zai ni shen shang kan dao le yi xie shou lie de qian li 。 zai zhe li ， na shang wo de di tu ， fan zheng wo de ji neng tai yi lai ta le 。]

english: So you really don't mind giving this away to me?
translation: 所以你真的不介意把这个送给我吗？ [suo yi ni zhen de bu jie yi ba zhe ge song gei wo ma ？]

english: No outerlander... it is hard to explain. That map makes my role as huntsman too easy. I fear my skills are becoming dulled. Now I must track my prey once more.
translation: 没有外来者……这很难解释。那张地图让我作为猎人的角色变得太容易了。我担心我的技能会变得迟钝。现在我必须再次追踪我的猎物。 [mei you wai lai zhe …… zhe hen nan jie shi 。 na zhang di tu rang wo zuo wei lie ren de jue se bian de tai rong yi le 。 wo dan xin wo de ji neng hui bian de chi dun 。 xian zai wo bi xu zai ci zhui zong wo de lie wu 。]

english: To begin again from scratch... I feel this may keep me sharp.
translation: 从头开始……我觉得这可能会让我保持敏锐。 [cong tou kai shi …… wo jue de zhe ke neng hui rang wo bao chi min rui 。]

english: Hello again Sigli.
translation: 你好，西格利。 [ni hao ， xi ge li 。]

english: Hello again to you [Fremennik name]. How goes the hunt?
translation: 再次向你[弗雷曼尼克名字]问好。狩猎进行得怎么样？ [zai ci xiang ni [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ] wen hao 。 shou lie jin xing de zen me yang ？]

english: The hunt? I've already done your task! That's why I'm a Fremennik now!
translation: 狩猎？我已经完成你的任务了！这就是为什么我现在是弗雷曼尼克了！ [shou lie ？ wo yi jing wan cheng ni de ren wu le ！ zhe jiu shi wei shen me wo xian zai shi fu lei man ni ke le ！]

english: You think so do you? The Draugen is always out there, just as I and my hunters are always on its trail to keep it at bay.
translation: 你也这么认为吗？龙人总是在那里，就像我和我的猎人总是在追踪它以阻止它一样。 [ni ye zhe me ren wei ma ？ long ren zong shi zai na li ， jiu xiang wo he wo de lie ren zong shi zai zhui zong ta yi zu zhi ta yi yang 。]

english: The hunt will never end until I do.
translation: 在我结束之前，狩猎永远不会结束。 [zai wo jie shu zhi qian ， shou lie yong yuan bu hui jie shu 。]

english: That is fine, [Fremennik name]. What type of armour were you looking for?
translation: 很好，[弗雷曼尼克名字]。您在寻找什么类型的盔甲？ [hen hao ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 nin zai xun zhao shen me lei xing de kui jia ？]

english: It will cost you 5,000 coins to make that for you. Is that acceptable?
translation: 为你制作它需要花费 5,000 个硬币。这是可以接受的吗？ [wei ni zhi zuo ta xu yao hua fei  5,000  ge ying bi 。 zhe shi ke yi jie shou de ma ？]

english: Sorry, [Fremennik name]. I will need 1 piece of dark dagger-mouth hide, 1 circular light dagger-mouth hide and 5,000 coins to make you a hunter's helmet.
translation: 抱歉，[弗雷曼尼克名字]。我需要 1 块深色刀口皮、1 块圆形浅色刀口皮和 5,000 枚硬币来为你制作猎人头盔。 [bao qian ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 wo xu yao  1  kuai shen se dao kou pi 、1  kuai yuan xing qian se dao kou pi he  5,000  mei ying bi lai wei ni zhi zuo lie ren tou kui 。]

english: When you have them, I will still be here.
translation: 当你拥有它们时，我仍然会在这里。 [dang ni yong you ta men shi ， wo reng ran hui zai zhe li 。]

english: It will cost you 10,000 coins to make that for you. Is that acceptable?
translation: 为你制作它需要花费 10,000 个金币。这是可以接受的吗？ [wei ni zhi zuo ta xu yao hua fei  10,000  ge jin bi 。 zhe shi ke yi jie shou de ma ？]

english: I'm sorry, but I need 3 pieces of dark dagger-mouth hide, 1 flattened hide and 10,000 coins to make you some hunter's body armour.
translation: 抱歉，我需要 3 块深色匕首兽皮、1 块扁平兽皮和 10,000 枚硬币来为你制作猎人的防弹衣。 [bao qian ， wo xu yao  3  kuai shen se bi shou shou pi 、1  kuai bian ping shou pi he  10,000  mei ying bi lai wei ni zhi zuo lie ren de fang dan yi 。]

english: I will still be here when you have obtained it.
translation: 当你得到它时我仍然会在这里。 [dang ni de dao ta shi wo reng ran hui zai zhe li 。]

english: It will cost you 7,500 coins to make that for you. Is that acceptable?
translation: 为你制作它需要花费 7,500 个硬币。这是可以接受的吗？ [wei ni zhi zuo ta xu yao hua fei  7,500  ge ying bi 。 zhe shi ke yi jie shou de ma ？]

english: That should do for any hunter! Did you want another set of hunters legs?
translation: 这对任何猎人来说都应该如此！您想要另一套猎人腿吗？ [zhe dui ren he lie ren lai shuo dou ying gai ru ci ！ nin xiang yao ling yi tao lie ren tui ma ？]

english: My apologies but I will need 2 pieces of dark dagger-mouth hide, 1 stretched hide and 7,500 coins to make you some leg armour...
translation: 抱歉，我需要 2 块深色匕首兽皮、1 块拉伸兽皮和 7,500 枚硬币来为你制作一些腿甲…… [bao qian ， wo xu yao  2  kuai shen se bi shou shou pi 、1  kuai la shen shou pi he  7,500  mei ying bi lai wei ni zhi zuo yi xie tui jia ……]

english: Actually, I don't want anything
translation: 其实我什么都不想要 [qi shi wo shen me dou bu xiang yao]

english: ASyou wish.
translation: 如你所愿。 [ru ni suo yuan 。]

english: Dagannoth Spined Armour
translation: 达甘诺斯脊甲 [da gan nuo si ji jia]

english: The Fremennik Trials
translation: 弗雷曼尼克审判 [fu lei man ni ke shen pan]

english: What's a Draugen?
translation: 什么是德拉根？ [shen me shi de la gen ？]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Forget it.
translation: 忘了它。 [wang le ta 。]

english: Ask about the Merchant's trial
translation: 询问商家试用情况 [xun wen shang jia shi yong qing kuang]

english: Ask about becoming a Fremennik
translation: 询问成为 Fremennik 的问题 [xun wen cheng wei  Fremennik  de wen ti]

english: A fine helm
translation: 一个精致的头盔 [yi ge jing zhi de tou kui]

english: YES
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: NO
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Sturdy bodyarmour
translation: 坚固的防弹衣 [jian gu de fang dan yi]

english: Powerful leg armour
translation: 强大的腿甲 [qiang da de tui jia]

english: Nothing
translation: 没有什么 [mei you shen me]

english: Can I help you?
translation: 我可以帮你吗？ [wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: Do you have any quests for me?
translation: 你有什么任务要找我吗？ [ni you shen me ren wu yao zhao wo ma ？]

english: I hear the Duke has a task for an adventurer. Otherwise, if you want to make yourself useful, there are always evil monsters to slay.
translation: 听说公爵有一个冒险者的任务。否则，想要让自己有用，总有邪恶的怪物需要消灭。 [ting shuo gong jue you yi ge mao xian zhe de ren wu 。 fou ze ， xiang yao rang zi ji you yong ， zong you xie e de guai wu xu yao xiao mie 。]

english: Okay, I might just do that.
translation: 好吧，我可能就这么做。 [hao ba ， wo ke neng jiu zhe me zuo 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm the Duke's advisor.
translation: 我是公爵的顾问。 [wo shi gong jue de gu wen 。]

english: Can you give me any advice then?
translation: 那你能给我什么建议吗？ [na ni neng gei wo shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: I only advise the Duke. But if you want to make yourself useful, there are evil goblins to slay on the other side of the river.
translation: 我只为公爵提供建议。但如果你想让自己变得有用，河对岸就有邪恶的妖精可以杀死。 [wo zhi wei gong jue ti gong jian yi 。 dan ru guo ni xiang rang zi ji bian de you yong ， he dui an jiu you xie e de yao jing ke yi sha si 。]

english: Do you have any quests for me?
translation: 你有什么任务要找我吗？ [ni you shen me ren wu yao zhao wo ma ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Hiya.
translation: 嗨。 [hai 。]

english: Hello outerlander. By the laws of our tribe, I am afraid I may not speak to you without the express permission of the chieftain.
translation: 外地人你好。根据我们部落的法律，未经酋长的明确许可，恐怕我不能和你说话。 [wai di ren ni hao 。 gen ju wo men bu luo de fa lv ， wei jing qiu zhang de ming que xu ke ， kong pa wo bu neng he ni shuo hua 。]

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好呀！ [ni hao ya ！]

english: Hello outerlander.
translation: 外地人你好。 [wai di ren ni hao 。]

english: Are you a member of the council?
translation: 您是理事会成员吗？ [nin shi li shi hui cheng yuan ma ？]

english: That I am outerlander; it is a position that brings my family and I pride.
translation: 我是外地人；这个职位让我和我的家人感到自豪。 [wo shi wai di ren ； zhe ge zhi wei rang wo he wo de jia ren gan dao zi hao 。]

english: I was wondering if I can count on your vote at the council of elders?
translation: 我想知道我是否可以依靠你在长老会议上的投票？ [wo xiang zhi dao wo shi fou ke yi yi kao ni zai zhang lao hui yi shang de tou piao ？]

english: You wish to become a Fremennik? I may be persuaded to swing my vote to your favour, but you will first need to do a little task for me.
translation: 您想成为弗里曼尼克人吗？我可能会被说服而投票给你，但你首先需要为我做一些小任务。 [nin xiang cheng wei fu li man ni ke ren ma ？ wo ke neng hui bei shuo fu er tou piao gei ni ， dan ni shou xian xu yao wei wo zuo yi xie xiao ren wu 。]

english: How did I know it wouldn't be that simple for your vote?
translation: 我怎么知道你的投票不会那么简单？ [wo zen me zhi dao ni de tou piao bu hui na me jian dan ？]

english: Calm yourself outerlander. It is but a small task really... I simply require a flower.
translation: 外地人请冷静一下。这真的只是一个小任务......我只需要一朵花。 [wai di ren qing leng jing yi xia 。 zhe zhen de zhi shi yi ge xiao ren wu ...... wo zhi xu yao yi duo hua 。]

english: A flower? What's the catch?
translation: 一朵花？有什么问题吗？ [yi duo hua ？ you shen me wen ti ma ？]

english: The catch? Well... it is not just any flower. Someone in this town has an extremely rare flower from a far off land that they picked up on their travels.
translation: 收获是什么？嗯...它不只是任何花。这个小镇上的某个人拥有一朵来自遥远国度的极其稀有的花，是他们在旅行中捡到的。 [shou huo shi shen me ？ n ... ta bu zhi shi ren he hua 。 zhe ge xiao zhen shang de mou ge ren yong you yi duo lai zi yao yuan guo du de ji qi xi you de hua ， shi ta men zai lv xing zhong jian dao de 。]

english: I would like you to demonstrate your merchanting skills to me, by persuading them to part with it, and then give it to me for my vote.
translation: 我希望你向我展示你的商业技巧，说服他们放弃它，然后把它交给我供我投票。 [wo xi wang ni xiang wo zhan shi ni de shang ye ji qiao ， shuo fu ta men fang qi ta ， ran hou ba ta jiao gei wo gong wo tou piao 。]

english: Well... I guess that doesn't sound too hard...
translation: 嗯...我想这听起来不太难... [n ... wo xiang zhe ting qi lai bu tai nan ...]

english: Excellent! You will obtain this rare flower for me then?
translation: 出色的！那么你会为我得到这朵稀世之花吗？ [chu se de ！ na me ni hui wei wo de dao zhe duo xi shi zhi hua ma ？]

english: Okay. I don't think this will be too difficult. Any suggestions on where to start looking for this flower?
translation: 好的。我认为这不会太困难。关于从哪里开始寻找这种花有什么建议吗？ [hao de 。 wo ren wei zhe bu hui tai kun nan 。 guan yu cong na li kai shi xun zhao zhe zhong hua you shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: Ah, well outerlander, if I knew where to start looking I would simply do it myself!
translation: 啊，好吧，外乡人，如果我知道从哪里开始寻找，我就会自己做！ [a ， hao ba ， wai xiang ren ， ru guo wo zhi dao cong na li kai shi xun zhao ， wo jiu hui zi ji zuo ！]

english: No help at ALL?
translation: 完全没有帮助吗？ [wan quan mei you bang zhu ma ？]

english: We are a very insular clan, so I would not expect you to have to leave this town to find whatever you need.
translation: 我们是一个非常与世隔绝的氏族，所以我不认为你必须离开这个城镇才能找到你需要的任何东西。 [wo men shi yi ge fei chang yu shi ge jue de shi zu ， suo yi wo bu ren wei ni bi xu li kai zhe ge cheng zhen cai neng zhao dao ni xu yao de ren he dong xi 。]

english: You know what? No. This all sounds like a lot of hassle to me, and frankly I just can't be bothered with it right now.
translation: 你知道吗？不。这一切对我来说听起来很麻烦，坦白说我现在不想理会它。 [ni zhi dao ma ？ bu 。 zhe yi qie dui wo lai shuo ting qi lai hen ma fan ， tan bai shuo wo xian zai bu xiang li hui ta 。]

english: I'll go get someone else to vote for me.
translation: 我去找其他人投票给我。 [wo qu zhao qi ta ren tou piao gei wo 。]

english: As you wish outerlander. If you change your mind, come and see me again; I am very interested in getting my hands on that flower.
translation: 如你所愿，外地人。如果你改变主意，就再来见我吧；我很有兴趣得到那朵花。 [ru ni suo yuan ， wai di ren 。 ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， jiu zai lai jian wo ba ； wo hen you xing qu de dao na duo hua 。]

english: So... how goes it outerlander? Did you manage to obtain my flower for me yet? Or do you lack the necessary merchanting skills?
translation: 那么……外地人怎么样？你帮我拿到花了吗？或者您缺乏必要的商业技能？ [na me …… wai di ren zen me yang ？ ni bang wo na dao hua le ma ？ huo zhe nin que fa bi yao de shang ye ji neng ？]

english: I'm still working on it... Do you have any suggestion where to start looking for it?
translation: 我仍在努力...您有什么建议从哪里开始寻找它吗？ [wo reng zai nu li ... nin you shen me jian yi cong na li kai shi xun zhao ta ma ？]

english: I suggest you ask around the other Fremennik in the town. A good merchant will find exactly what their customer needs somewhere.
translation: 我建议你问问镇上的其他弗雷曼尼克人。一个好的商人会在某个地方准确地找到客户需要的东西。 [wo jian yi ni wen wen zhen shang de qi ta fu lei man ni ke ren 。 yi ge hao de shang ren hui zai mou ge di fang zhun que di zhao dao ke hu xu yao de dong xi 。]

english: Here's that flower you wanted.
translation: 这就是你想要的那朵花。 [zhe jiu shi ni xiang yao de na duo hua 。]

english: Incredible! Your merchanting skills might even match my own! I have no choice but to recommend you to the council of elders!
translation: 极好的！你的商业技巧甚至可能与我的相媲美！没办法，我只能向长老会推荐你了！ [ji hao de ！ ni de shang ye ji qiao shen zhi ke neng yu wo de xiang pi mei ！ mei ban fa ， wo zhi neng xiang zhang lao hui tui jian ni le ！]

english: Hello again outerlander! I am amazed once more at your apparent skill at merchanting!
translation: 外地人你好！我再次对你明显的经商技巧感到惊讶！ [wai di ren ni hao ！ wo zai ci dui ni ming xian de jing shang ji qiao gan dao jing ya ！]

english: So I can count on your vote at the council of elders?
translation: 那么我可以依靠你在长老会议上的投票吗？ [na me wo ke yi yi kao ni zai zhang lao hui yi shang de tou piao ma ？]

english: Absolutely, outerlander. Your merchanting skills will be a real boon to the Fremennik.
translation: 绝对是，外地人。你的商业技巧将为弗里曼尼克人带来真正的福音。 [jue dui shi ， wai di ren 。 ni de shang ye ji qiao jiang wei fu li man ni ke ren dai lai zhen zheng de fu yin 。]

english: Greetings again brother [Fremennik name]! What can I do for you this day?
translation: 再次问候兄弟[弗雷曼尼克名字]！今天我能为你做什么？ [zai ci wen hou xiong di [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！ jin tian wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: Can I see your wares?
translation: 我可以看看你们的商品吗？ [wo ke yi kan kan ni men de shang pin ma ？]

english: Certainly, [Fremennik name].
translation: 当然，[弗雷曼尼克名字]。 [dang ran ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。]

english: Nothing thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。]

english: Well, feel free to stop by anytime that you wish [Fremennik name]. You are always welcome here!
translation: 好吧，如果您愿意，请随时过来[弗雷曼尼克名字]。这里随时欢迎您！ [hao ba ， ru guo nin yuan yi ， qing sui shi guo lai [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 zhe li sui shi huan ying nin ！]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Can I see your wares?
translation: 我可以看看你们的商品吗？ [wo ke yi kan kan ni men de shang pin ma ？]

english: Nothing thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。]

english: We didn't mean it to go wrong, you know...
translation: 我们并不是故意要出错的，你知道... [wo men bing bu shi gu yi yao chu cuo de ， ni zhi dao ...]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Ha Ha! Hello!
translation: 哈哈！你好！ [ha ha ！ ni hao ！]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm Sigurd the Great and Brainy.
translation: 我是聪明的西格德大帝。 [wo shi cong ming de xi ge de da di 。]

english: Why do they call you the Great and Brainy?
translation: 为什么他们称你为伟大而聪明的人？ [wei shen me ta men cheng ni wei wei da er cong ming de ren ？]

english: Because I invented the Log Canoe!
translation: 因为我发明了独木舟！ [yin wei wo fa ming le du mu zhou ！]

english: Log Canoe?
translation: 独木舟？ [du mu zhou ？]

english: Yeash! Me and my cousins were having a great party by the river when we decided to have a game of 'Smack The Tree'
translation: 是的！当我们决定玩“拍树”游戏时，我和我的表兄弟正在河边举办一场盛大的聚会 [shi de ！ dang wo men jue ding wan “ pai shu ” you xi shi ， wo he wo de biao xiong di zheng zai he bian ju ban yi chang sheng da de ju hui]

english: Smack the Tree?
translation: 打树？ [da shu ？]

english: It's a game were you take it in turnsh shmacking a tree. First one to uproot the tree winsh!
translation: 这是一个轮流击打一棵树的游戏。第一个把树连根拔起的人赢了！ [zhe shi yi ge lun liu ji da yi ke shu de you xi 。 di yi ge ba shu lian gen ba qi de ren ying le ！]

english: Anyway, I won the game with a flying tackle. The tree came loose and down the river bank I went, still holding the tree.
translation: 无论如何，我凭借飞铲赢得了比赛。树松了，我顺着河岸走下去，仍然抓着树。 [wu lun ru he ， wo ping jie fei chan ying de le bi sai 。 shu song le ， wo shun zhe he an zou xia qu ， reng ran zhua zhe shu 。]

english: I woke up a few hours later and found myself several miles down river. And thatsh how I invented the log canoe!
translation: 几个小时后我醒来，发现自己已经在河下游几英里处了。这就是我发明独木舟的原因！ [ji ge xiao shi hou wo xing lai ， fa xian zi ji yi jing zai he xia you ji ying li chu le 。 zhe jiu shi wo fa ming du mu zhou de yuan yin ！]

english: So you invented the 'Log Canoe' by falling into a river hugging a tree?
translation: 所以你是通过抱着一棵树掉进河里发明了“圆木独木舟”？ [suo yi ni shi tong guo bao zhe yi ke shu diao jin he li fa ming le “ yuan mu du mu zhou ”？]

english: Well I refined the design from the original you know!
translation: 好吧，我在原来的基础上改进了设计，你知道！ [hao ba ， wo zai yuan lai de ji chu shang gai jin le she ji ， ni zhi dao ！]

english: I cut all the branches off to make it more comfortable. I could tell you how to if you like?
translation: 我把所有的树枝都剪掉了，让它更舒服。如果你愿意的话我可以告诉你怎么做？ [wo ba suo you de shu zhi dou jian diao le ， rang ta geng shu fu 。 ru guo ni yuan yi de hua wo ke yi gao su ni zen me zuo ？]

english: No thanks, not right now.
translation: 不，谢谢，现在不行。 [bu ， xie xie ， xian zai bu xing 。]

english: Can you teach me about canoes?
translation: 你能教我独木舟吗？ [ni neng jiao wo du mu zhou ma ？]

english: Well, you don't look like you have the skill to make a canoe.
translation: 嗯，你看起来不像有造独木舟的技能。 [n ， ni kan qi lai bu xiang you zao du mu zhou de ji neng 。]

english: You need to have at least level 12 woodcutting.
translation: 你需要至少有 12 级木刻。 [ni xu yao zhi shao you  12  ji mu ke 。]

english: Once you are able to make a canoe it makes travel along the river much quicker!
translation: 一旦您能够制作独木舟，沿河旅行就会更快！ [yi dan nin neng gou zhi zuo du mu zhou ， yan he lv xing jiu hui geng kuai ！]

english: It's really quite simple. Just walk down to that tree on the bank and chop it down.
translation: 这真的很简单。只要走到岸边那棵树那里，把它砍倒就可以了。 [zhe zhen de hen jian dan 。 zhi yao zou dao an bian na ke shu na li ， ba ta kan dao jiu ke yi le 。]

english: Then take your axe to it and shape it how you like!
translation: 然后拿起你的斧子，把它塑造成你喜欢的形状！ [ran hou na qi ni de fu zi ， ba ta su zao cheng ni xi huan de xing zhuang ！]

english: You can make a log canoe like mine! It'll get you 1 stop down the river.

english: I always knew people were wrong about me. I knew I would serve a higher purpose. I never cared what it was. I only cared that in doing so, I would be serving the will of Ralos.
translation: 我一直都知道人们对我的看法是错误的。我知道我会服务于更高的目标。我从来不在乎那是什么。我只关心这样做是为了服务拉洛斯的意志。 [wo yi zhi dou zhi dao ren men dui wo de kan fa shi cuo wu de 。 wo zhi dao wo hui fu wu yu geng gao de mu biao 。 wo cong lai bu zai hu na shi shen me 。 wo zhi guan xin zhe yang zuo shi wei le fu wu la luo si de yi zhi 。]

translation: 我一直都知道人们对我的看法是错误的。我知道我会服务于更高的目标。我从来不在乎那是什么。我只关心这样做，我会在 Mictl 获得一席之地。 [wo yi zhi dou zhi dao ren men dui wo de kan fa shi cuo wu de 。 wo zhi dao wo hui fu wu yu geng gao de mu biao 。 wo cong lai bu zai hu na shi shen me 。 wo zhi guan xin zhe yang zuo ， wo hui zai  Mictl  huo de yi xi zhi di 。]
