translation: 不，真的。我不想要它。 [bu ， zhen de 。 wo bu xiang yao ta 。]

english: Okay, but that's the best price you're going to get.
translation: 好吧，但这是你能得到的最优惠的价格。 [hao ba ， dan zhe shi ni neng de dao de zui you hui de jia ge 。]

english: Okay, that sounds good.
translation: 好吧，听起来不错。 [hao ba ， ting qi lai bu cuo 。]

english: No. Silk doesn't suit me.
translation: 不，丝绸不适合我。 [bu ， si chou bu shi he wo 。]

english: I'm in search of a man named Avan Fitzharmon.
translation: 我正在寻找一个名叫阿万·菲茨哈蒙的人。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yi ge ming jiao a wan · fei ci ha meng de ren 。]

english: Can't say as I've seen him... I'm sure if he's been to Al-Kharid recently someone around here will have though.
translation: 不能说，因为我见过他……我确信如果他最近去过 Al-Kharid，那么这里附近的人也会去过。 [bu neng shuo ， yin wei wo jian guo ta …… wo que xin ru guo ta zui jin qu guo  Al-Kharid， na me zhe li fu jin de ren ye hui qu guo 。]

english: How much are they?
translation: 他们多少钱？ [ta men duo shao qian ？]

english: No. That's too much for me.
translation: 不，这对我来说太过分了。 [bu ， zhe dui wo lai shuo tai guo fen le 。]

english: 2 gp sounds good.
translation: 2gp 听起来不错。 [2gp  ting qi lai bu cuo 。]

english: No, really. I don't want it.
translation: 不，真的。我不想要它。 [bu ， zhen de 。 wo bu xiang yao ta 。]

english: Okay, that sounds good.
translation: 好吧，听起来不错。 [hao ba ， ting qi lai bu cuo 。]

english: No. Silk doesn't suit me.
translation: 不，丝绸不适合我。 [bu ， si chou bu shi he wo 。]

english: I'm in search of a man named Avan Fitzharmon.
translation: 我正在寻找一个名叫阿万·菲茨哈蒙的人。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yi ge ming jiao a wan · fei ci ha meng de ren 。]

english: Silver! Silver! Best prices for buying and selling in all Kandarin!
translation: 银！银！全坎达林地区买卖的最优惠价格！ [yin ！ yin ！ quan kan da lin di qu mai mai de zui you hui jia ge ！]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Are you Erin?
translation: 你是艾琳吗？ [ni shi ai lin ma ？]

english: That I am. What do you want? You realise I'm working here.
translation: 我就是这样。你想要什么？你知道我在这里工作。 [wo jiu shi zhe yang 。 ni xiang yao shen me ？ ni zhi dao wo zai zhe li gong zuo 。]

english: This shouldn't take too long. I just want to ask you a bit about your great Grandfather, the one who lived in the outpost?
translation: 这应该不会花太长时间。我只是想问你一些关于你曾祖父的事，他住在前哨站？ [zhe ying gai bu hui hua tai zhang shi jian 。 wo zhi shi xiang wen ni yi xie guan yu ni zeng zu fu de shi ， ta zhu zai qian shao zhan ？]

english: What's it to you?
translation: 关你什么事？ [guan ni shen me shi ？]

english: I'm doing some research for a man called Jorral. Apparently the King is going to make the outpost into his very own alchemists' lab.
translation: 我正在为一个叫乔拉尔的人做一些研究。显然国王打算将这个前哨基地打造成他自己的炼金术士实验室。 [wo zheng zai wei yi ge jiao qiao la er de ren zuo yi xie yan jiu 。 xian ran guo wang da suan jiang zhe ge qian shao ji di da zao cheng ta zi ji de lian jin shu shi shi yan shi 。]

english: That can only cause chaos! Well, my great Grandfather lived and died there according to my mother, but even she knows very little about him.
translation: 那样只会造成混乱！嗯，据我母亲说，我的曾祖父在那里生活和去世，但就连她也对他知之甚少。 [na yang zhi hui zao cheng hun luan ！ n ， ju wo mu qin shuo ， wo de zeng zu fu zai na li sheng huo he qu shi ， dan jiu lian ta ye dui ta zhi zhi shen shao 。]

english: I see.
translation: 我懂了。 [wo dong le 。]

english: The only thing I have of his is a key. It's a strange key, it changes temperature by itself as you walk around. I'm afraid I don't know what it's for though.
translation: 我唯一拥有的就是他的一把钥匙。这是一把奇怪的钥匙，当你走来走去时它会自行改变温度。恐怕我不知道它是用来做什么的。 [wo wei yi yong you de jiu shi ta de yi ba yao shi 。 zhe shi yi ba qi guai de yao shi ， dang ni zou lai zou qu shi ta hui zi xing gai bian wen du 。 kong pa wo bu zhi dao ta shi yong lai zuo shen me de 。]

english: No idea at all?
translation: 完全不知道吗？ [wan quan bu zhi dao ma ？]

english: Well, I imagine it's to some sort of chest of his belongings as it's too small for a door. Perhaps if you find some of his belongings you will discover some clues amongst them.
translation: 嗯，我想这是他的某个箱子，因为它对于门来说太小了。如果你找到他的一些物品，也许你会在其中发现一些线索。 [n ， wo xiang zhe shi ta de mou ge xiang zi ， yin wei ta dui yu men lai shuo tai xiao le 。 ru guo ni zhao dao ta de yi xie wu pin ， ye xu ni hui zai qi zhong fa xian yi xie xian suo 。]

english: It's better than nothing. Will you lend it to me then?
translation: 有总比没有好。那你借给我吗？ [you zong bi mei you hao 。 na ni jie gei wo ma ？]

english: Why not. I can't use it anyway. Try feeling its change in temperature as you walk around.
translation: 为什么不呢。反正我也用不了当您四处走动时，尝试感受温度的变化。 [wei shen me bu ne 。 fan zheng wo ye yong bu liao dang nin si chu zou dong shi ， chang shi gan shou wen du de bian hua 。]

english: Wait, look how much you're carrying! You can't carry this too.
translation: 等等，看看你背了多少东西！这个你也不能带啊 [deng deng ， kan kan ni bei le duo shao dong xi ！ zhe ge ni ye bu neng dai a]

english: I haven't found anything yet.
translation: 我还没有找到任何东西。 [wo hai mei you zhao dao ren he dong xi 。]

english: Keep trying. Have you noticed that the key changes temperature as you walk around?
translation: 继续努力。您是否注意到，当您四处走动时，钥匙会改变温度？ [ji xu nu li 。 nin shi fou zhu yi dao ， dang nin si chu zou dong shi ， yao shi hui gai bian wen du ？]

english: I'll see what I can find once I take it off my key ring.
translation: 一旦我把它从钥匙圈上取下来，我就会看看能找到什么。 [yi dan wo ba ta cong yao shi quan shang qu xia lai ， wo jiu hui kan kan neng zhao dao shen me 。]

english: That's kind of hard because I lost the key.
translation: 这有点困难，因为我丢了钥匙。 [zhe you dian kun nan ， yin wei wo diu le yao shi 。]

english: Liar. You stored it somewhere, didn't you!
translation: 说谎者。你把它存放在某个地方了，不是吗！ [shuo huang zhe 。 ni ba ta cun fang zai mou ge di fang le ， bu shi ma ！]

english: I was waiting for you to say that because I just found it! Take it and don't lose it.
translation: 我一直在等你这么说，因为我刚刚找到了它！拿走它，不要丢失它。 [wo yi zhi zai deng ni zhe me shuo ， yin wei wo gang gang zhao dao le ta ！ na zou ta ， bu yao diu shi ta 。]

english: I found a chest, but I lost it and any contents it had.
translation: 我找到了一个箱子，但我把它和里面的东西都弄丢了。 [wo zhao dao le yi ge xiang zi ， dan wo ba ta he li mian de dong xi dou nong diu le 。]

english: Well I suggest you go back to where you found it.
translation: 好吧，我建议你回到你发现它的地方。 [hao ba ， wo jian yi ni hui dao ni fa xian ta de di fang 。]

english: I was waiting for you to say that because I just found it!
translation: 我一直在等你这么说，因为我刚刚找到了它！ [wo yi zhi zai deng ni zhe me shuo ， yin wei wo gang gang zhao dao le ta ！]

english: I found a chest
translation: 我发现了一个箱子 [wo fa xian le yi ge xiang zi]

english: I wonder what is inside.
translation: 我想知道里面是什么。 [wo xiang zhi dao li mian shi shen me 。]

english: Would you like to see the journal I have found?
translation: 你想看看我找到的日记吗？ [ni xiang kan kan wo zhao dao de ri ji ma ？]

english: Let's have a look.
translation: 我们来看看吧。 [wo men lai kan kan ba 。]

english: Erin reads the journal.
translation: 艾琳读着日记。 [ai lin du zhe ri ji 。]

english: Very interesting. Best you show it to Jorral at the outpost.
translation: 非常有趣。最好把它拿给前哨站的乔拉尔看。 [fei chang you qu 。 zui hao ba ta na gei qian shao zhan de qiao la er kan 。]

english: I was just about to. Do you want the key back?
translation: 我正要这么做。你想要回钥匙吗？ [wo zheng yao zhe me zuo 。 ni xiang yao hui yao shi ma ？]

english: Keep it, it may come in handy.
translation: 留着吧，说不定会派上用场。 [liu zhe ba ， shuo bu ding hui pai shang yong chang 。]

english: Hello again.
translation: 又好。 [you hao 。]

english: Hello, I hope Jorral was pleased with that Journal.
translation: 你好，我希望乔拉尔对那本日记感到满意。 [ni hao ， wo xi wang qiao la er dui na ben ri ji gan dao man yi 。]

english: I'm sure it's been a valuable find.
translation: 我确信这是一个有价值的发现。 [wo que xin zhe shi yi ge you jia zhi de fa xian 。]

english: What I came to ask was: I lost that key you gave me.
translation: 我来问的是：我把你给我的钥匙弄丢了。 [wo lai wen de shi ： wo ba ni gei wo de yao shi nong diu le 。]

english: Oh dear, luckily I found it, but it'll cost you 500gp as I know it's valuable.
translation: 噢，天哪，幸运的是我找到了它，但它要花费你 500gp，因为我知道它很有价值。 [o ， tian na ， xing yun de shi wo zhao dao le ta ， dan ta yao hua fei ni  500gp， yin wei wo zhi dao ta hen you jia zhi 。]

english: You don't have enough money, sorry.
translation: 你的钱不够，抱歉。 [ni de qian bu gou ， bao qian 。]

english: You don't have the space to carry it! Empty some space in your inventory.
translation: 你没有空间来携带它！清空库存中的一些空间。 [ni mei you kong jian lai xie dai ta ！ qing kong ku cun zhong de yi xie kong jian 。]

english: Thank you, enjoy!
translation: 谢谢，欣赏！ [xie xie ， xin shang ！]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: You know you can use that enchanted key you have on your keyring all over Gielinor. Who knows what you might find?
translation: 您知道您可以在整个吉林诺使用钥匙圈上的那把魔法钥匙。谁知道你会发现什么？ [nin zhi dao nin ke yi zai zheng ge ji lin nuo shi yong yao shi quan shang de na ba mo fa yao shi 。 shui zhi dao ni hui fa xian shen me ？]

english: You know you can use that enchanted key you've got stored? You can use it all over Gielinor. Who knows what you might find?
translation: 你知道你可以使用你存储的那把魔法钥匙吗？您可以在 Gielinor 各处使用它。谁知道你会发现什么？ [ni zhi dao ni ke yi shi yong ni cun chu de na ba mo fa yao shi ma ？ nin ke yi zai  Gielinor  ge chu shi yong ta 。 shui zhi dao ni hui fa xian shen me ？]

english: You know you can use that enchanted key you have all over Gielinor. Who knows what you might find?
translation: 你知道你可以使用你在吉林诺各处拥有的那把魔法钥匙。谁知道你会发现什么？ [ni zhi dao ni ke yi shi yong ni zai ji lin nuo ge chu yong you de na ba mo fa yao shi 。 shui zhi dao ni hui fa xian shen me ？]

english: Oh, You know that key you gave me?
translation: 哦，你知道你给我的那把钥匙吗？ [o ， ni zhi dao ni gei wo de na ba yao shi ma ？]

english: Yes?
translation: 是的？ [shi de ？]

english: It dissolved!
translation: 它溶解了！ [ta rong jie le ！]

english: Really? I suppose it served its purpose.
translation: 真的吗？我想它达到了它的目的。 [zhen de ma ？ wo xiang ta da dao le ta de mu di 。]

english: I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.
translation: 我来这里是为了告诉你一些新的税收。 [wo lai zhe li shi wei le gao su ni yi xie xin de shui shou 。]

english: New taxes? What are you on about?
translation: 新税种？你在忙什么？ [xin shui zhong ？ ni zai mang shen me ？]

english: The king has called for a tax on luxury items. Your stall is included.
translation: 国王呼吁对奢侈品征税。您的摊位已包括在内。 [guo wang hu yu dui she chi pin zheng shui 。 nin de tan wei yi bao kuo zai nei 。]

english: Well that is unacceptable! I will have to increase my prices. I've produced silver for the king himself before but don't expect me to do that again!
translation: 嗯，这是不可接受的！我将不得不提高价格。我以前曾为国王本人生产过银子，但别指望我会再这样做！ [n ， zhe shi bu ke jie shou de ！ wo jiang bu de bu ti gao jia ge 。 wo yi qian ceng wei guo wang ben ren sheng chan guo yin zi ， dan bie zhi wang wo hui zai zhe yang zuo ！]

english: As you wish, but you'll still need to pay. Your first instalment will be collected soon.
translation: 如你所愿，但你仍然需要付费。您的第一期付款很快就会被收取。 [ru ni suo yuan ， dan ni reng ran xu yao fu fei 。 nin de di yi qi fu kuan hen kuai jiu hui bei shou qu 。]

english: The king wouldn't send a mourner to tell me this. Clear off!
translation: 国王不会派送葬者来告诉我这件事。走开！ [guo wang bu hui pai song zang zhe lai gao su wo zhe jian shi 。 zou kai ！]

english: The king wouldn't send a citizen to tell me this. Clear off!
translation: 国王不会派公民来告诉我这件事。走开！ [guo wang bu hui pai gong min lai gao su wo zhe jian shi 。 zou kai ！]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Ask about the outpost.
translation: 询问前哨站的情况。 [xun wen qian shao zhan de qing kuang 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.
translation: 我来这里是为了告诉你一些新的税收。 [wo lai zhe li shi wei le gao su ni yi xie xin de shui shou 。]

english: Hello there, are you interested in buying one of my special capes?
translation: 您好，您有兴趣购买我的一件特别斗篷吗？ [nin hao ， nin you xing qu gou mai wo de yi jian te bie dou peng ma ？]

english: What's so special about your capes?
translation: 你的斗篷有什么特别之处？ [ni de dou peng you shen me te bie zhi chu ？]

english: Ahh well they make it less likely that you'll accidently attack anyone wearing the same cape as you and easier to attack everyone else. They also make it easier to distinguish people who're wearing the same cape as you
translation: 啊，好吧，它们使你不太可能意外攻击任何穿着与你相同斗篷的人，并且更容易攻击其他人。它们还可以让您更轻松地区分与您穿着相同斗篷的人 [a ， hao ba ， ta men shi ni bu tai ke neng yi wai gong ji ren he chuan zhe yu ni xiang tong dou peng de ren ， bing qie geng rong yi gong ji qi ta ren 。 ta men hai ke yi rang nin geng qing song di qu fen yu nin chuan zhe xiang tong dou peng de ren]

english: from everyone else. They're very useful when out in the wilderness with friends or anyone else you don't want to harm.
translation: 来自其他人。当您与朋友或您不想伤害的其他人一起在荒野中时，它们非常有用。 [lai zi qi ta ren 。 dang nin yu peng you huo nin bu xiang shang hai de qi ta ren yi qi zai huang ye zhong shi ， ta men fei chang you yong 。]

english: So would you like to buy one?
translation: 那么您想买一个吗？ [na me nin xiang mai yi ge ma ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: What's so special about your capes?
translation: 你的斗篷有什么特别之处？ [ni de dou peng you shen me te bie zhi chu ？]

english: Yes please!
translation: 是的，请！ [shi de ， qing ！]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: I can't believe we've finally arrived, I can't wait to explore!
translation: 我不敢相信我们终于到达了，我迫不及待地想探索！ [wo bu gan xiang xin wo men zhong yu dao da le ， wo po bu ji dai di xiang tan suo ！]

english: So much to see, I don't know where to start!
translation: 太多东西要看，我不知道从哪里开始！ [tai duo dong xi yao kan ， wo bu zhi dao cong na li kai shi ！]

english: A whole new continent to explore... what a time to be
translation: 等待探索的全新大陆……美好时光 [deng dai tan suo de quan xin da lu …… mei hao shi guang]

english: Are you the tour guide?
translation: 你是导游吗？ [ni shi dao you ma ？]

english: Nope, I'm just as lost as you.
translation: 不，我和你一样迷失。 [bu ， wo he ni yi yang mi shi 。]

english: I overheard someone mention there are pirates and thieves here, be careful!
translation: 我无意中听到有人说这里有海盗和小偷，要小心！ [wo wu yi zhong ting dao you ren shuo zhe li you hai dao he xiao tou ， yao xiao xin ！]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: G'day, mate. I'm Simon - Simon Templeton. Who are you?
translation: 日安，伙计。我是西蒙-西蒙·邓普顿。你是谁？ [ri an ， huo ji 。 wo shi xi meng - xi meng · deng pu dun 。 ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm [player name]. What are you doing all the way out here?
translation: 我是[玩家姓名]。你千里迢迢跑到这里来做什么？ [wo shi [ wan jia xing ming ]。 ni qian li tiao tiao pao dao zhe li lai zuo shen me ？]

english: I've been contracted to retrieve artefacts from the top of this magnificent pyramid.
translation: 我受命从这座宏伟的金字塔顶部取回文物。 [wo shou ming cong zhe zuo hong wei de jin zi ta ding bu qu hui wen wu 。]

english: So, why are you down here and not up there then?
translation: 那么，为什么你在下面而不是在上面呢？ [na me ， wei shen me ni zai xia mian er bu shi zai shang mian ne ？]

english: Well, it's me back - an old injury I picked up in Sophanem has come back to haunt me. I was working for the Museum of Varrock, and the gold I had been given wasn't enough to pay for the carpet rides, let
translation: 好吧，我又回来了——我在索法奈姆受的旧伤又回来困扰着我。我在 Varrock 博物馆工作，我得到的金币不足以支付地毯游乐费用，让 [hao ba ， wo you hui lai le —— wo zai suo fa nai mu shou de jiu shang you hui lai kun rao zhe wo 。 wo zai  Varrock  bo wu guan gong zuo ， wo de dao de jin bi bu zu yi zhi fu di tan you le fei yong ， rang]

english: alone any decent equipment. But that was a long time ago... I can't even lift a chisel right now. There's no way I can climb all the way up there.
translation: 单独任何像样的设备。但那是很久以前的事了……我现在连凿子都拿不起来。我不可能一直爬到那里。 [dan du ren he xiang yang de she bei 。 dan na shi hen jiu yi qian de shi le …… wo xian zai lian zao zi dou na bu qi lai 。 wo bu ke neng yi zhi pa dao na li 。]

english: How on earth did you get down the cliff face, then?
translation: 那你到底是怎么从悬崖上下来的呢？ [na ni dao di shi zen me cong xuan ya shang xia lai de ne ？]

english: That's what set off the injury. I was fine before I scrabbled down that pesky slope. I think it will be a while before I can climb back up again; I must be getting old.
translation: 这就是引发伤害的原因。在我爬下那个讨厌的斜坡之前，我还很好。我想我还需要一段时间才能再次爬上去；我一定是老了。 [zhe jiu shi yin fa shang hai de yuan yin 。 zai wo pa xia na ge tao yan de xie po zhi qian ， wo hai hen hao 。 wo xiang wo hai xu yao yi duan shi jian cai neng zai ci pa shang qu ； wo yi ding shi lao le 。]

english: Hang on a second... You look like you're pretty agile and up for a challenge. How about you retrieve it for me?
translation: 等一下...你看起来很敏捷并且愿意接受挑战。你帮我取回来怎么样？ [deng yi xia ... ni kan qi lai hen min jie bing qie yuan yi jie shou tiao zhan 。 ni bang wo qu hui lai zen me yang ？]

english: I'll tell you what, I'll give you 10000 coins for every artefact you get for me.
translation: 我告诉你吧，你给我每件文物我都会给你10000金币。 [wo gao su ni ba ， ni gei wo mei jian wen wu wo du hui gei ni 10000 jin bi 。]

english: I'll see what I can do.
translation: 我会看看我能做什么。 [wo hui kan kan wo neng zuo shen me 。]

english: Good on ya, mate!
translation: 干得好，伙计！ [gan de hao ， huo ji ！]

english: Hello, Simon.

english: Yes, how can I help out?
translation: 是的，我能提供什么帮助吗？ [shi de ， wo neng ti gong shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: Well, you'll need to get your equipment first - it's all there on the tool rack. Use what you learned from your Earth Sciences exams. You'll need to be wearing your leather gloves and boots as well as have access to
translation: 好吧，你需要先拿到你的设备 - 它都在工具架上。利用您从地球科学考试中学到的知识。您需要戴上皮手套和靴子，并能够接触到 [hao ba ， ni xu yao xian na dao ni de she bei  -  ta dou zai gong ju jia shang 。 li yong nin cong di qiu ke xue kao shi zhong xue dao de zhi shi 。 nin xu yao dai shang pi shou tao he xue zi ， bing neng gou jie chu dao]

english: your trowel, rock pick and specimen brush.
translation: 你的抹子、岩石镐和标本刷。 [ni de mo zi 、 yan shi gao he biao ben shua 。]

english: I see you have your equipment - well done.
translation: 我看到你有你的设备 - 干得好。 [wo kan dao ni you ni de she bei  -  gan de hao 。]

english: To really give us a hand, you could clean some finds for us. They're mostly done - just some fine work to finish off. Take a find from the pile that the workmen are bringing in, then there are spare tables over there
translation: 为了真正帮助我们，您可以帮我们清理一些发现的东西。他们大部分已经完成了——只是一些漂亮的工作需要完成。从工人搬进来的一堆东西里找出来，然后那边就有空余的桌子了 [wei le zhen zheng bang zhu wo men ， nin ke yi bang wo men qing li yi xie fa xian de dong xi 。 ta men da bu fen yi jing wan cheng le —— zhi shi yi xie piao liang de gong zuo xu yao wan cheng 。 cong gong ren ban jin lai de yi dui dong xi li zhao chu lai ， ran hou na bian jiu you kong yu de zhuo zi le]

english: to clean them on. If you find anything interesting, let us know and we'll see if it's good enough to go on display.
translation: 清洁它们。如果您发现任何有趣的东西，请告诉我们，我们会看看它是否足以展示。 [qing jie ta men 。 ru guo nin fa xian ren he you qu de dong xi ， qing gao su wo men ， wo men hui kan kan ta shi fou zu yi zhan shi 。]

english: I found something interesting.
translation: 我发现了一些有趣的事情。 [wo fa xian le yi xie you qu de shi qing 。]

english: Oh? Let's take a look...
translation: 哦？我们来看看... [o ？ wo men lai kan kan ...]

english: I found this pretty necklace.
translation: 我发现了这条漂亮的项链。 [wo fa xian le zhe tiao piao liang de xiang lian 。]

english: Interesting...yes...yes...hmmm.... It looks like it's enchanted.
translation: 有趣……是……是……嗯……看起来像是着了魔一样。 [you qu …… shi …… shi …… n …… kan qi lai xiang shi zhe le mo yi yang 。]

english: With what?
translation: 用什么？ [yong shen me ？]

english: Oh, I think it's just a benign teleportation spell. I tinker in magic when I'm not doing archaeology. I can teach you how to make more necklaces like this. Amazing that they had this kind of knowledge back then.
translation: 哦，我认为这只是一个良性的传送咒语。当我不做考古学的时候，我会研究魔法。我可以教你如何制作更多这样的项链。令人惊讶的是他们当时拥有这种知识。 [o ， wo ren wei zhe zhi shi yi ge liang xing de chuan song zhou yu 。 dang wo bu zuo kao gu xue de shi hou ， wo hui yan jiu mo fa 。 wo ke yi jiao ni ru he zhi zuo geng duo zhe yang de xiang lian 。 ling ren jing ya de shi ta men dang shi yong you zhe zhong zhi shi 。]

english: That would be good. Where is the teleport to?
translation: 那就好了。传送到哪里？ [na jiu hao le 。 chuan song dao na li ？]

english: Hmm...all the indications are that it's somewhere to the east of us, but I'm not sure how far. Perhaps it was a teleport back to Saranthium. Let me just take a closer look.
translation: 嗯……所有迹象都表明它位于我们东边的某个地方，但我不确定有多远。也许这是传送回萨兰瑟姆的过程。让我仔细看看。 [n …… suo you ji xiang dou biao ming ta wei yu wo men dong bian de mou ge di fang ， dan wo bu que ding you duo yuan 。 ye xu zhe shi chuan song hui sa lan se mu de guo cheng 。 rang wo zi xi kan kan 。]

english: So I just make a ruby necklace and use five fire runes and one cosmic rune to enchant it.
translation: 所以我只是做了一条红宝石项链，并用五个火符文和一个宇宙符文来附魔它。 [suo yi wo zhi shi zuo le yi tiao hong bao shi xiang lian ， bing yong wu ge huo fu wen he yi ge yu zhou fu wen lai fu mo ta 。]

english: Yes, indeed. Well done, youngster, thanks for helping us.
translation: 是的，确实如此。干得好，年轻人，谢谢你帮助我们。 [shi de ， que shi ru ci 。 gan de hao ， nian qing ren ， xie xie ni bang zhu wo men 。]

english: I've cleaned this old coin - is it of any use?
translation: 我已经清理了这枚旧硬币 - 它有什么用吗？ [wo yi jing qing li le zhe mei jiu ying bi  -  ta you shen me yong ma ？]

english: Oh my! What a wonderful find! If this is what I believe it to be, it would allow us to date the Dig Site city.
translation: 天啊！多么美妙的发现啊！如果这是我所相信的，那么我们就能确定挖掘场城市的年代。 [tian a ！ duo me mei miao de fa xian a ！ ru guo zhe shi wo suo xiang xin de ， na me wo men jiu neng que ding wa jue chang cheng shi de nian dai 。]

english: And look here, it has the name of the city too! Saranthium! That must be during the Saradominist occupation. This is a wonderful find. Please take it and place it in display case 45.
translation: 看这里，它还有城市的名字！萨拉蒂！那一定是在萨拉多米主义占领期间。这是一个很棒的发现。请拿走并将其放入展示柜 45 中。 [kan zhe li ， ta hai you cheng shi de ming zi ！ sa la di ！ na yi ding shi zai sa la duo mi zhu yi zhan ling qi jian 。 zhe shi yi ge hen bang de fa xian 。 qing na zou bing jiang qi fang ru zhan shi gui  45  zhong 。]

english: Right, display case 45 it is...
translation: 对了，陈列柜45是…… [dui le ， chen lie gui 45 shi ……]

english: Back again? Have you put the old coin in display case 45 yet?
translation: 又回来了？你把旧硬币放进陈列柜45了吗？ [you hui lai le ？ ni ba jiu ying bi fang jin chen lie gui 45 le ma ？]

english: No, I'll go do that now
translation: 不，我现在就去做 [bu ， wo xian zai jiu qu zuo]

english: You've already shown me one of those, but it was in better condition. It's in the display case over there. You can pop this one in the finds crate over in the corner.
translation: 你已经给我看了其中一件，但它的状况更好。就在那边的展示柜里。您可以将其放入角落里的发现物箱中。 [ni yi jing gei wo kan le qi zhong yi jian ， dan ta de zhuang kuang geng hao 。 jiu zai na bian de zhan shi gui li 。 nin ke yi jiang qi fang ru jiao luo li de fa xian wu xiang zhong 。]

english: I found this really old coin - is it of any use?
translation: 我发现了这枚非常古老的硬币 - 它有什么用处吗？ [wo fa xian le zhe mei fei chang gu lao de ying bi  -  ta you shen me yong chu ma ？]

english: What have we here?
translation: 我们这里有什么？ [wo men zhe li you shen me ？]

english: Oh! This is very interesting...and confusing at the same time. This coin means that the city that we're excavating on the Digsite - Saranthium - was actually inhabited much, much earlier by followers of Zamorak,
translation: 哦！这非常有趣……同时也令人困惑。这枚硬币意味着我们在挖掘场挖掘的城市——Saranthium——实际上早在很久以前就被萨莫拉克的追随者居住过， [o ！ zhe fei chang you qu …… tong shi ye ling ren kun huo 。 zhe mei ying bi yi wei zhe wo men zai wa jue chang wa jue de cheng shi ——Saranthium—— shi ji shang zao zai hen jiu yi qian jiu bei sa mo la ke de zhui sui zhe ju zhu guo ，]

english: at which time, the city was known as Senntisten.
translation: 当时，这座城市被称为 Senntisten。 [dang shi ， zhe zuo cheng shi bei cheng wei  Senntisten。]

english: This is a most remarkable discovery, as we have other evidence indicating that Zarosian followers were resident before the Saradominists took over, but it also seems that Zamorakian forces used it during a battle of some
translation: 这是一个最引人注目的发现，因为我们有其他证据表明，在萨拉多米主义者接管之前，扎罗西亚追随者就已经居住在当地，但似乎萨莫拉克军队在一些人的战斗中也使用了它。 [zhe shi yi ge zui yin ren zhu mu di fa xian ， yin wei wo men you qi ta zheng ju biao ming ， zai sa la duo mi zhu yi zhe jie guan zhi qian ， zha luo xi ya zhui sui zhe jiu yi jing ju zhu zai dang di ， dan si hu sa mo la ke jun dui zai yi xie ren de zhan dou zhong ye shi yong le ta 。]

english: sort. Still, it allows us to roughly date when the city changed from following Zaros and Zamorak to following Saradomin. Put it in display case 44.
translation: 种类。尽管如此，它仍然可以让我们大致确定这座城市从跟随扎罗斯和萨莫拉克转变为跟随萨拉多明的时间。将其放入展示柜 44 中。 [zhong lei 。 jin guan ru ci ， ta reng ran ke yi rang wo men da zhi que ding zhe zuo cheng shi cong gen sui zha luo si he sa mo la ke zhuan bian wei gen sui sa la duo ming de shi jian 。 jiang qi fang ru zhan shi gui  44  zhong 。]

english: Case 44 it is!
translation: 第44例就是这样！ [di 44 li jiu shi zhe yang ！]

english: Back again? Have you put the ancient coin in display case 44 yet?
translation: 又回来了？你把古钱币放进44号陈列柜了吗？ [you hui lai le ？ ni ba gu qian bi fang jin 44 hao chen lie gui le ma ？]

english: No, I'll go do that now.
translation: 不，我现在就去做。 [bu ， wo xian zai jiu qu zuo 。]

english: I found this crumbly old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: 我发现了这个易碎的旧装饰品 - 它有什么用吗？ [wo fa xian le zhe ge yi sui de jiu zhuang shi pin  -  ta you shen me yong ma ？]

english: Ahh... That looks like an altar piece. Hmm, yes...from the early Saradominist worshippers by the looks of it. Quite delicate, too. Put it in display case 37.
translation: 啊……看起来像是祭坛碎片。嗯，是的……从表面上看是来自早期的萨拉多米主义崇拜者。也相当精致。将其放入展示柜 37 中。 [a …… kan qi lai xiang shi ji tan sui pian 。 n ， shi de …… cong biao mian shang kan shi lai zi zao qi de sa la duo mi zhu yi chong bai zhe 。 ye xiang dang jing zhi 。 jiang qi fang ru zhan shi gui  37  zhong 。]

english: Case 37 it is!
translation: 是第37号病例！ [shi di 37 hao bing li ！]

english: Back again? Have you put the ancient symbol in display case 37 yet?
translation: 又回来了？你把远古符号放进37号陈列柜了吗？ [you hui lai le ？ ni ba yuan gu fu hao fang jin 37 hao chen lie gui le ma ？]

english: I found this really old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: 我发现了这个非常旧的装饰品 - 它有什么用吗？ [wo fa xian le zhe ge fei chang jiu de zhuang shi pin  -  ta you shen me yong ma ？]

english: Wow!
translation: 哇！ [wa ！]

english: That's in rather good condition, isn't it? An old altar decoration by the looks of things, from the Saradominist city no doubt. Put it in display case 36.
translation: 这状态相当不错，不是吗？从外观上看，这是一座古老的祭坛装饰，毫无疑问来自萨拉多米尼主义城市。将其放入展示柜 36 中。 [zhe zhuang tai xiang dang bu cuo ， bu shi ma ？ cong wai guan shang kan ， zhe shi yi zuo gu lao de ji tan zhuang shi ， hao wu yi wen lai zi sa la duo mi ni zhu yi cheng shi 。 jiang qi fang ru zhan shi gui  36  zhong 。]

english: Case 36 it is!
translation: 是第36例！ [shi di 36 li ！]

english: Back again? Have you put the old symbol in display case 36 yet?
translation: 又回来了？您是否已将旧符号放入展示柜 36 中？ [you hui lai le ？ nin shi fou yi jiang jiu fu hao fang ru zhan shi gui  36  zhong ？]

english: I found this piece of pottery - is it of any use?
translation: 我找到了这块陶器——它有什么用吗？ [wo zhao dao le zhe kuai tao qi —— ta you shen me yong ma ？]

english: Ahh... Oh! Hmm...yes...made by Zaros worshippers, by the looks of it. Beautifully-shaped. It looks as if this would go nicely in display case 22. This piece reinforces our evidence that the city was occupied by
translation: 啊……哦！嗯……是的……看起来是扎罗斯崇拜者制作的。造型优美。看起来这在展示柜 22 中会很顺利。这件作品强化了我们的证据，即这座城市被 [a …… o ！ n …… shi de …… kan qi lai shi zha luo si chong bai zhe zhi zuo de 。 zao xing you mei 。 kan qi lai zhe zai zhan shi gui  22  zhong hui hen shun li 。 zhe jian zuo pin qiang hua le wo men de zheng ju ， ji zhe zuo cheng shi bei]

english: Zarosians before Saradominists.
translation: 扎罗索派先于萨拉多米派。 [zha luo suo pai xian yu sa la duo mi pai 。]

english: Case 22 it is!
translation: 就是案例22！ [jiu shi an li 22！]

english: Back again? Have you put the pottery in display case 22 yet?
translation: 又回来了？你把陶器放进22号展示柜了吗？ [you hui lai le ？ ni ba tao qi fang jin 22 hao zhan shi gui le ma ？]

english: I found these old arrowheads.
translation: 我发现了这些旧箭头。 [wo fa xian le zhe xie jiu jian tou 。]

english: Ahh, yes, we find lots of those - they're not important. We already have some in our display. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: 啊，是的，我们发现了很多这样的东西——它们并不重要。我们的展示中已经有一些了。只需将其添加到靠近门的箱子中即可。 [a ， shi de ， wo men fa xian le hen duo zhe yang de dong xi —— ta men bing bu zhong yao 。 wo men de zhan shi zhong yi jing you yi xie le 。 zhi xu jiang qi tian jia dao kao jin men de xiang zi zhong ji ke 。]

english: If there is anything already in the crate, feel free to take it as a reward for your work.
translation: 如果板条箱里已有任何东西，请随意将其作为对您工作的奖励。 [ru guo ban tiao xiang li yi you ren he dong xi ， qing sui yi jiang qi zuo wei dui nin gong zuo de jiang li 。]

english: Oh, okay.
translation: 哦好的。 [o hao de 。]

english: Take a look at this...
translation: 看看这个... [kan kan zhe ge ...]

english: I found these old necklaces.
translation: 我找到了这些旧项链。 [wo zhao dao le zhe xie jiu xiang lian 。]

english: An interesting find... Here, let me offer you something in return.
translation: 一个有趣的发现……在这里，让我给你一些回报。 [yi ge you qu de fa xian …… zai zhe li ， rang wo gei ni yi xie hui bao 。]

english: Oh! Okay.
translation: 哦！好的。 [o ！ hao de 。]

english: I cleaned up this old vase.
translation: 我清理了这个旧花瓶。 [wo qing li le zhe ge jiu hua ping 。]

english: Ah, the vases... I've lost count of how many we've found of those... The only completely intact one is in the display case already. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: 啊，那些花瓶……我已经记不清我们找到了多少个了……唯一完好无损的已经在陈列柜里了。只需将其添加到靠近门的箱子中即可。 [a ， na xie hua ping …… wo yi jing ji bu qing wo men zhao dao le duo shao ge le …… wei yi wan hao wu sun de yi jing zai chen lie gui li le 。 zhi xu jiang qi tian jia dao kao jin men de xiang zi zhong ji ke 。]

english: Right.
translation: 正确的。 [zheng que de 。]

english: Err... I seem to have lost it. Sorry.
translation: 呃……我好像丢了。对不起。 [e …… wo hao xiang diu le 。 dui bu qi 。]

english: Sounds like you never had it, [lad/lass]!
translation: 听起来你好像从未拥有过它，[小伙子/姑娘]！ [ting qi lai ni hao xiang cong wei yong you guo ta ，[ xiao huo zi / gu niang ]！]

english: No, just here to watch.
translation: 不，只是来这里看看。 [bu ， zhi shi lai zhe li kan kan 。]

english: Thank you, but I don't need that
translation: 谢谢，但我不需要那个 [xie xie ， dan wo bu xu yao na ge]

english: Yes, how can I help out?
translation: 是的，我能提供什么帮助吗？ [shi de ， wo neng ti gong shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: I found something interesting.
translation: 我发现了一些有趣的事情。 [wo fa xian le yi xie you qu de shi qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: My name iz Vlad. I come from far avay, vere the sun iz not so bright.
translation: 我的名字是弗拉德。我来自很远的地方，太阳不那么明亮。 [wo de ming zi shi fu la de 。 wo lai zi hen yuan de di fang ， tai yang bu na me ming liang 。]

translation: 仅仅因为我无法忍受大蒜味并且我不喜欢明亮的阳光，并不一定意味着我是吸血鬼！ [jin jin yin wei wo wu fa ren shou da suan wei bing qie wo bu xi huan ming liang de yang guang ， bing bu yi ding yi wei zhe wo shi xi xue gui ！]

english: Is it nice there?

english: It is vonderful! Ze beautiful und ze nights are long!
translation: 太棒了！多么美丽，夜晚多么漫长！ [tai bang le ！ duo me mei li ， ye wan duo me man chang ！]

If you get thirsty you should drink something.

translation: 嗯，祝钓鱼顺利。 [n ， zhu diao yu shun li 。]

translation: 运气不好的话，这一切都取决于技术。 [yun qi bu hao de hua ， zhe yi qie dou qu jue yu ji shu 。]

english: I think you will find that is my spot.
translation: 我想你会发现那是我的位置。 [wo xiang ni hui fa xian na shi wo de wei zhi 。]

translation: 你就不能去别的地方吗？ [ni jiu bu neng qu bie de di fang ma ？]

translation: 我喜欢这个地方。我喜欢品尝这些烟斗里散发出来的香气。 [wo xi huan zhe ge di fang 。 wo xi huan pin chang zhe xie yan dou li san fa chu lai de xiang qi 。]

translation: 那么...你喜欢钓鱼吗？ [na me ... ni xi huan diao yu ma ？]

english: If you get thirsty you should drink something.
translation: 如果你渴了，你应该喝点东西。 [ru guo ni ke le ， ni ying gai he dian dong xi 。]

english: Well, good luck with the fishing.
translation: 嗯，祝钓鱼顺利。 [n ， zhu diao yu shun li 。]

english: Hello Sir Amik.
translation: 阿米克爵士您好。 [a mi ke jue shi nin hao 。]

english: Hello, friend!
translation: 朋友你好！ [peng you ni hao ！]

english: Well [player name], now that you are a White Knight, I expect you should be out there hunting Black Knights for us!
translation: 好吧[玩家名字]，既然你是一名白骑士，我希望你应该出去为我们狩猎黑骑士！ [hao ba [ wan jia ming zi ]， ji ran ni shi yi ming bai qi shi ， wo xi wang ni ying gai chu qu wei wo men shou lie hei qi shi ！]

english: Sadly we are not as rich as we once were, and there are many White Knights who foolishly lose their combat equipment.
translation: 可悲的是，我们不再像以前那样富有，而且有许多白骑士愚蠢地失去了他们的战斗装备。 [ke bei de shi ， wo men bu zai xiang yi qian na yang fu you ， er qie you xu duo bai qi shi yu chun di shi qu le ta men de zhan dou zhuang bei 。]

english: We do not think it fair to make a profit from our brethren, so we will sell you equipment at cost, and rebuy it at the same cost, but we will only sell equipment to those we consider responsible enough to
translation: 我们认为从我们的兄弟身上赚取利润是不公平的，因此我们会按成本价向您出售设备，并以相同的成本重新购买它，但我们只会将设备出售给我们认为有足够责任的人 [wo men ren wei cong wo men de xiong di shen shang zhuan qu li run shi bu gong ping de ， yin ci wo men hui an cheng ben jia xiang nin chu shou she bei ， bing yi xiang tong de cheng ben chong xin gou mai ta ， dan wo men zhi hui jiang she bei chu shou gei wo men ren wei you zu gou ze ren de ren]

english: wield it correctly.
translation: 正确运用它。 [zheng que yun yong ta 。]

english: By killing Black Knights, you will increase your reputation with us, by killing White Knights we will obviously think less of you.
translation: 杀掉黑骑士，你在我们心目中的声誉就会提高，杀掉白骑士，我们显然就会看不起你。 [sha diao hei qi shi ， ni zai wo men xin mu zhong de sheng yu jiu hui ti gao ， sha diao bai qi shi ， wo men xian ran jiu hui kan bu qi ni 。]

english: You can check your White Knight reputation level by looking at your quest journal for the Wanted! Quest, or Sir Vyvin will let you know what level you are at when you go to purchase equipment.
translation: 您可以通过查看通缉犯的任务日志来检查您的白骑士声誉等级！当你去购买装备时，任务，或者维文爵士会让你知道你的等级。 [nin ke yi tong guo cha kan tong ji fan de ren wu ri zhi lai jian cha nin de bai qi shi sheng yu deng ji ！ dang ni qu gou mai zhuang bei shi ， ren wu ， huo zhe wei wen jue shi hui rang ni zhi dao ni de deng ji 。]

english: Sir Vyvin can be found in Falador Castle, and he will sell you any equipment appropriate to your reputation level.
translation: 维文爵士可以在法拉多城堡找到，他会向你出售任何适合你声望等级的装备。 [wei wen jue shi ke yi zai fa la duo cheng bao zhao dao ， ta hui xiang ni chu shou ren he shi he ni sheng wang deng ji de zhuang bei 。]

english: Have fun, and go kill some Black Knights for me!
translation: 玩得开心，去帮我杀掉一些黑骑士吧！ [wan de kai xin ， qu bang wo sha diao yi xie hei qi shi ba ！]

english: Okay Amik, thanks for explaining!
translation: 好的，阿米克，谢谢你的解释！ [hao de ， a mi ke ， xie xie ni de jie shi ！]

english: Okay, bye!
translation: 好的，再见！ [hao de ， zai jian ！]

english: Okay, 'bye then Amik!
translation: 好吧，再见阿米克！ [hao ba ， zai jian a mi ke ！]

english: Can you explain the White Knight honour system again?
translation: 你能再解释一下白骑士的荣誉系统吗？ [ni neng zai jie shi yi xia bai qi shi de rong yu xi tong ma ？]

english: May I help you?
translation: 我可以帮你吗？ [wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: I'm really just looking for a quest...
translation: 我真的只是在寻找一个任务... [wo zhen de zhi shi zai xun zhao yi ge ren wu ...]

english: Fortune favours us both then adventurer. I suggest you go and speak to King Arthur.
translation: 幸运之神眷顾了我们两个冒险家。我建议你去和亚瑟王谈谈。 [xing yun zhi shen juan gu le wo men liang ge mao xian jia 。 wo jian yi ni qu he ya se wang tan tan 。]

english: Merlin's in a crystal. Little help?
translation: 梅林在水晶里。帮助不大？ [mei lin zai shui jing li 。 bang zhu bu da ？]

english: That is what we were hoping for from you, adventurer!
translation: 这就是我们对你的期望，冒险家！ [zhe jiu shi wo men dui ni de qi wang ， mao xian jia ！]

english: Hmmm. Well, ok, thanks anyway.
translation: 嗯。嗯，好吧，还是谢谢你。 [n 。 n ， hao ba ， hai shi xie xie ni 。]

english: I don't suppose you have any idea how to break into Mordred's fort do you?
translation: 我想你不知道如何闯入莫德雷德的堡垒吧？ [wo xiang ni bu zhi dao ru he chuang ru mo de lei de de bao lei ba ？]

english: I am afraid not. Would that we could! Mordred and his cronies have been thorns in our side for far too long already!
translation: 恐怕不是。但愿我们可以！莫德雷德和他的亲信已经成为我们的眼中钉了太久了！ [kong pa bu shi 。 dan yuan wo men ke yi ！ mo de lei de he ta de qin xin yi jing cheng wei wo men de yan zhong ding le tai jiu le ！]

english: Ok. Thanks. See you later!
translation: 好的。谢谢。稍后见！ [hao de 。 xie xie 。 shao hou jian ！]

english: Take care adventurer, Mordred is an evil and powerful foe.
translation: 小心冒险家，莫德雷德是一个邪恶而强大的敌人。 [xiao xin mao xian jia ， mo de lei de shi yi ge xie e er qiang da de di ren 。]

english: Know anything about Excalibur?
translation: 了解 Excalibur 吗？ [liao jie  Excalibur  ma ？]

english: Um... it's a really good sword?
translation: 嗯……真的是一把好剑吗？ [n …… zhen de shi yi ba hao jian ma ？]

english: Know where I can find it?
translation: 知道在哪里可以找到它吗？ [zhi dao zai na li ke yi zhao dao ta ma ？]

english: Nope, sorry.
translation: 不，抱歉。 [bu ， bao qian 。]

english: All Knights of the Round thank you for your assistance in this trying time for us.
translation: 所有圆桌骑士感谢你们在我们这个艰难时刻所提供的帮助。 [suo you yuan zhuo qi shi gan xie ni men zai wo men zhe ge jian nan shi ke suo ti gong de bang zhu 。]

english: You are looking for the Grail now adventurer?
translation: 您现在正在寻找圣杯冒险家吗？ [nin xian zai zheng zai xun zhao sheng bei mao xian jia ma ？]

english: Absolutely.
translation: 绝对地。 [jue dui di 。]

english: The best of luck to you! Make the name of Camelot proud, and bring it back to us.
translation: 祝你好运！让卡米洛特的名字感到自豪，并将其带回给我们。 [zhu ni hao yun ！ rang ka mi luo te de ming zi gan dao zi hao ， bing jiang qi dai hui gei wo men 。]

english: How did you let a bunch of Black Knights get the better of you? I thought you guys were the toughest knights around.
translation: 你是怎么让一群黑骑士打败你的？我以为你们是最坚强的骑士。 [ni shi zen me rang yi qun hei qi shi da bai ni de ？ wo yi wei ni men shi zui jian qiang de qi shi 。]

english: We are true knights who fight for honour. Those Black Knights didn't fight fair, so we were unprepared. Most unchivalrous of them.
translation: 我们是真正的骑士，为荣誉而战。那些黑骑士的战斗并不公平，所以我们毫无准备。他们中最没有侠义的。 [wo men shi zhen zheng de qi shi ， wei rong yu er zhan 。 na xie hei qi shi de zhan dou bing bu gong ping ， suo yi wo men hao wu zhun bei 。 ta men zhong zui mei you xia yi de 。]

english: If we break out of this cell, do you reckon you can take on the Black Knights in the keep?
translation: 如果我们冲出牢房，你认为你能在要塞里对抗黑骑士吗？ [ru guo wo men chong chu lao fang ， ni ren wei ni neng zai yao sai li dui kang hei qi shi ma ？]

english: You just let me at them. We'll see how they like surprise attacks.
translation: 你就让我去见他们吧。我们会看看他们有多喜欢突然袭击。 [ni jiu rang wo qu jian ta men ba 。 wo men hui kan kan ta men you duo xi huan tu ran xi ji 。]

english: How are you going to get all of us out of here?
translation: 你要怎样把我们所有人都带出这里？ [ni yao zen yang ba wo men suo you ren dou dai chu zhe li ？]

english: I'm not sure yet. Have you got any useful objects in your pockets?
translation: 我还不确定。你的口袋里有什么有用的东西吗？ [wo hai bu que ding 。 ni de kou dai li you shen me you yong de dong xi ma ？]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: I already gave you everything I had in my pockets.
translation: 我已经把我口袋里的所有东西都给你了。 [wo yi jing ba wo kou dai li de suo you dong xi dou gei ni le 。]

english: Let me out! Let me out, I say!
translation: 放我出去吧！让我出去，我说！ [fang wo chu qu ba ！ rang wo chu qu ， wo shuo ！]

english: Give me an R. Give me an O. Give me a U..
translation: 给我一个 R。给我一个 O。给我一个 U.. [gei wo yi ge  R。 gei wo yi ge  O。 gei wo yi ge  U..]

english: In the amount of time it will take you to spell out Round Table Knights, you could have found the Grail.
translation: 在你拼出圆桌骑士的时间里，你本可以找到圣杯的。 [zai ni pin chu yuan zhuo qi shi de shi jian li ， ni ben ke yi zhao dao sheng bei de 。]

english: What am I supposed to do with that?
translation: 我该怎么办？ [wo gai zen me ban ？]

english: Thank you for your assistance in our time of need.
translation: 感谢您在我们需要的时候提供的帮助。 [gan xie nin zai wo men xu yao de shi hou ti gong de bang zhu 。]

english: You're welcome.
translation: 不客气。 [bu ke qi 。]

english: Hello Paladin. I wasn't expecting to see anyone else down here.
translation: 你好帕拉丁。我没想到会在这里看到其他人。 [ni hao pa la ding 。 wo mei xiang dao hui zai zhe li kan dao qi ta ren 。]

english: Nor were we traveller. What are you doing in this most unholy place?
translation: 我们也不是旅行者。你在这个最不圣洁的地方做什么？ [wo men ye bu shi lv xing zhe 。 ni zai zhe ge zui bu sheng jie de di fang zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm looking for a safe route through these caverns, under order of King Lathas.
translation: 我正在遵照拉萨斯国王的命令，寻找一条穿过这些洞穴的安全路线。 [wo zheng zai zun zhao la sa si guo wang de ming ling ， xun zhao yi tiao chuan guo zhe xie dong xue de an quan lu xian 。]

english: Ah, the king tasked us with the same mission. Alas, a little further on lies the great doors of Iban. We've tried everything, but we cannot enter.
translation: 啊，国王也给了我们同样的使命。唉，再远一点就是伊班的大门。我们已经尝试了一切，但还是无法进入。 [a ， guo wang ye gei le wo men tong yang de shi ming 。 ai ， zai yuan yi dian jiu shi yi ban de da men 。 wo men yi jing chang shi le yi qie ， dan hai shi wu fa jin ru 。]

english: Anyway, you've done well to get this far traveller. Here eat...
translation: 不管怎样，你已经做得很好了，能得到这个远行的旅行者。在这里吃... [bu guan zen yang ， ni yi jing zuo de hen hao le ， neng de dao zhe ge yuan xing de lv xing zhe 。 zai zhe li chi ...]

english: Great, thanks a lot.
translation: 太好了，非常感谢。 [tai hao le ， fei chang gan xie 。]

english: Hello again traveller. You should consider leaving this place. Let us handle things here.
translation: 再次问好旅行者。你应该考虑离开这个地方。这里的事情就让我们来处理吧。 [zai ci wen hao lv xing zhe 。 ni ying gai kao lv li kai zhe ge di fang 。 zhe li de shi qing jiu rang wo men lai chu li ba 。]

english: You again... die Zamorakian scum!
translation: 你又……去死吧，萨莫拉克败类！ [ni you …… qu si ba ， sa mo la ke bai lei ！]

english: Good day to you [sir/madam]!
translation: 祝您有美好的一天[先生/女士]！ [zhu nin you mei hao de yi tian [ xian sheng / nv shi ]！]

english: Good day.
translation: 再会。 [zai hui 。]

english: Know you of any quests sir knight?
translation: 骑士先生，你知道有什么任务吗？ [qi shi xian sheng ， ni zhi dao you shen me ren wu ma ？]

english: The king is the man to talk to if you want a quest.
translation: 如果您想要完成任务，可以与国王交谈。 [ru guo nin xiang yao wan cheng ren wu ， ke yi yu guo wang jiao tan 。]

english: I think you've done the main quest we were on right now...
translation: 我认为你已经完成了我们现在正在进行的主要任务...... [wo ren wei ni yi jing wan cheng le wo men xian zai zheng zai jin xing de zhu yao ren wu ......]

english: Good day.
translation: 再会。 [zai hui 。]

english: Good morrow [madam/sirrah]!
translation: 早上好[女士/先生]！ [zao shang hao [ nv shi / xian sheng ]！]

english: Morning. Know where an adventurer has to go to find a quest around here?
translation: 早晨。知道冒险家必须去哪里才能找到这附近的任务吗？ [zao chen 。 zhi dao mao xian jia bi xu qu na li cai neng zhao dao zhe fu jin de ren wu ma ？]

english: An adventurer eh? There is no service finer than serving the bountiful King Arthur, and I happen to know there's an important quest to fulfill.
translation: 冒险家吧？没有比为慷慨的亚瑟王服务更好的服务了，而我碰巧知道有一个重要的任务需要完成。 [mao xian jia ba ？ mei you bi wei kang kai de ya se wang fu wu geng hao de fu wu le ， er wo peng qiao zhi dao you yi ge zhong yao de ren wu xu yao wan cheng 。]

english: Sir Knight! Many thanks for your assistance in restoring Merlin to his former freedom!
translation: 骑士先生！非常感谢您帮助梅林恢复以前的自由！ [qi shi xian sheng ！ fei chang gan xie nin bang zhu mei lin hui fu yi qian de zi you ！]

english: We owe you a great debt for freeing us from that dungeon.
translation: 我们欠你一个很大的人情，因为你把我们从那个地牢中解救出来。 [wo men qian ni yi ge hen da de ren qing ， yin wei ni ba wo men cong na ge di lao zhong jie jiu chu lai 。]

english: Awww, shucks. It was nothing.
translation: 噢，糟糕。没什么。 [o ， zao gao 。 mei shen me 。]

english: A valiant effort!
translation: 勇敢的努力！ [yong gan de nu li ！]

english: I have a question for you.
translation: 我有个问题要问你。 [wo you ge wen ti yao wen ni 。]

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。 [qing shu ru wen ti de da an 。]

english: No, try again.
translation: 不，再试一次。 [bu ， zai shi yi ci 。]

english: Correct!
translation: 正确的！ [zheng que de ！]

english: Greetings! I am Sir Lancelot, the greatest Knight in the land! What do you want?
translation: 问候！我是兰斯洛特爵士，这片土地上最伟大的骑士！你想要什么？ [wen hou ！ wo shi lan si luo te jue shi ， zhe pian tu di shang zui wei da de qi shi ！ ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: You're a little full of yourself aren't you?
translation: 你有点自满了不是吗？ [ni you dian zi man le bu shi ma ？]

english: I have every right to be proud of myself.
translation: 我完全有权利为自己感到骄傲。 [wo wan quan you quan li wei zi ji gan dao jiao ao 。]

english: My prowess in battle is world renowned!
translation: 我的战斗力举世闻名！ [wo de zhan dou li ju shi wen ming ！]

english: I seek a quest!
translation: 我寻求一个任务！ [wo xun qiu yi ge ren wu ！]

english: Leave questing to the professionals.
translation: 把探索留给专业人士。 [ba tan suo liu gei zhuan ye ren shi 。]

english: Such as myself.
translation: 比如我自己。 [bi ru wo zi ji 。]

english: Sir Knight! Many thanks for your assistance in restoring Merlin to his former freedom!
translation: 骑士先生！非常感谢您帮助梅林恢复以前的自由！ [qi shi xian sheng ！ fei chang gan xie nin bang zhu mei lin hui fu yi qian de zi you ！]

english: Humph. You are indeed a better knight than I first suspected.
translation: 哼。你确实是一个比我最初怀疑的更好的骑士。 [heng 。 ni que shi shi yi ge bi wo zui chu huai yi de geng hao de qi shi 。]

english: Gee, it was nothing saving you all from the clutches of Morgan Le Faye and freeing your King.
translation: 哎呀，这并没有什么能把你们从摩根·勒法伊的魔掌中拯救出来，也没有什么可以拯救你们的国王。 [ai ya ， zhe bing mei you shen me neng ba ni men cong mo gen · lei fa yi de mo zhang zhong zheng jiu chu lai ， ye mei you shen me ke yi zheng jiu ni men de guo wang 。]

english: You're a little full of yourself aren't you?
translation: 你有点自满了不是吗？ [ni you dian zi man le bu shi ma ？]

english: I seek a quest!
translation: 我寻求一个任务！ [wo xun qiu yi ge ren wu ！]

english: AH-HA HA HA! You can NEVER defeat ME! I am blessed by Saradomin himself! NO BLADE MAY DEFEAT ME!
translation: 啊哈哈哈哈！你永远无法打败我！我受到萨拉多明本人的祝福！没有刀片可以打败我！ [a ha ha ha ha ！ ni yong yuan wu fa da bai wo ！ wo shou dao sa la duo ming ben ren de zhu fu ！ mei you dao pian ke yi da bai wo ！]

english: No blade may defeat me!
translation: 没有刀刃能打败我！ [mei you dao ren neng da bai wo ！]

english: Hello there adventurer.
translation: 冒险家你好。 [mao xian jia ni hao 。]

english: I'm looking for a quest...
translation: 我正在寻找任务... [wo zheng zai xun zhao ren wu ...]

english: Talk to the King then adventurer. He is always looking for men of bravery to aid him in his actions.
translation: 与国王交谈，然后与冒险家交谈。他一直在寻找勇敢的人来帮助他采取行动。 [yu guo wang jiao tan ， ran hou yu mao xian jia jiao tan 。 ta yi zhi zai xun zhao yong gan de ren lai bang zhu ta cai qu xing dong 。]

english: Congratulations on freeing Merlin!
translation: 恭喜你释放了梅林！ [gong xi ni shi fang le mei lin ！]

english: That was a grand adventure. I can see why you make it your profession.
translation: 那是一次伟大的冒险。我明白你为什么把它作为你的职业。 [na shi yi ci wei da de mao xian 。 wo ming bai ni wei shen me ba ta zuo wei ni de zhi ye 。]

english: I think you should stick to being a knight.
translation: 我认为你应该坚持成为一名骑士。 [wo ren wei ni ying gai jian chi cheng wei yi ming qi shi 。]

english: Hello there adventurer, what do you want of me?
translation: 你好，冒险家，你想要我做什么？ [ni hao ， mao xian jia ， ni xiang yao wo zuo shen me ？]

english: I'd like some advice on finding a quest.
translation: 我想要一些关于寻找任务的建议。 [wo xiang yao yi xie guan yu xun zhao ren wu de jian yi 。]

english: I do not know of any myself... but it would perhaps be worth your while asking the King if he has any tasks for you.
translation: 我自己也不知道……但也许值得你去询问国王是否有什么任务要交给你。 [wo zi ji ye bu zhi dao …… dan ye xu zhi de ni qu xun wen guo wang shi fou you shen me ren wu yao jiao gei ni 。]

english: After your help freeing Merlin, my help is the least I can offer as a man of honour.
translation: 在你帮助释放了梅林之后，我作为一个有荣誉的人能提供的起码的帮助。 [zai ni bang zhu shi fang le mei lin zhi hou ， wo zuo wei yi ge you rong yu de ren neng ti gong de qi ma de bang zhu 。]

english: Nothing right now, but I'll bear it in mind. Thanks.
translation: 现在没什么，但我会记住的。谢谢。 [xian zai mei shen me ， dan wo hui ji zhu de 。 xie xie 。]

english: I was glad to get my revenge on those knights in the keep. They were no match for us.
translation: 我很高兴能为城堡里的那些骑士报仇。他们不是我们的对手。 [wo hen gao xing neng wei cheng bao li de na xie qi shi bao chou 。 ta men bu shi wo men de dui shou 。]

english: Makes you wonder how they kidnapped you in the first place.
translation: 让你想知道他们最初是如何绑架你的。 [rang ni xiang zhi dao ta men zui chu shi ru he bang jia ni de 。]

english: Greetings adventurer and welcome to the museum!
translation: 问候冒险家，欢迎来到博物馆！ [wen hou mao xian jia ， huan ying lai dao bo wu guan ！]

english: The museum has been constructed thanks to the efforts of adventurers across Gielinor, feel free to explore this floor or one below at your leisure.
translation: 该博物馆是在吉林诺各地冒险家的努力下建成的，您可以随意探索这一层或下面的一层。 [gai bo wu guan shi zai ji lin nuo ge di mao xian jia de nu li xia jian cheng de ， nin ke yi sui yi tan suo zhe yi ceng huo xia mian de yi ceng 。]

english: Can you tell me about this museum?
translation: 你能告诉我这个博物馆吗？ [ni neng gao su wo zhe ge bo wu guan ma ？]

english: Certainly.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: This museum was built as a monument to Gielinor and contains exhibits which showcase the wonders of the world brought to light by adventurers such as yourself.
translation: 这座博物馆是作为吉利诺纪念碑而建的，里面的展品展示了像您这样的冒险家所发现的世界奇观。 [zhe zuo bo wu guan shi zuo wei ji li nuo ji nian bei er jian de ， li mian de zhan pin zhan shi le xiang nin zhe yang de mao xian jia suo fa xian de shi jie qi guan 。]

english: This floor was built some time ago but due to popular demand and some recent contributions the floor below has also been opened up for display.
translation: 该楼层是不久前建成的，但由于大众的需求和最近的一些贡献，下面的楼层也已开放展示。 [gai lou ceng shi bu jiu qian jian cheng de ， dan you yu da zhong de xu qiu he zui jin de yi xie gong xian ， xia mian de lou ceng ye yi kai fang zhan shi 。]

english: While we no longer require any contributions we'll happily take any unwanted excess that you may have.
translation: 虽然我们不再需要任何捐款，但我们很乐意接受您可能有的任何多余的捐款。 [sui ran wo men bu zai xu yao ren he juan kuan ， dan wo men hen le yi jie shou nin ke neng you de ren he duo yu de juan kuan 。]

english: I'd like to contribute towards the museum.
translation: 我想为博物馆做出贡献。 [wo xiang wei bo wu guan zuo chu gong xian 。]

english: Hmm, it appears you don't have anything on you to contribute. Come back if you do.
translation: 嗯，看来你没有什么可以贡献的。如果你愿意就回来吧。 [n ， kan lai ni mei you shen me ke yi gong xian de 。 ru guo ni yuan yi jiu hui lai ba 。]

english: Could you tell me the current progress towards finishing the museum?
translation: 您能告诉我目前博物馆竣工的进展吗？ [nin neng gao su wo mu qian bo wu guan jun gong de jin zhan ma ？]

english: The museum is finished! Feel free to enter if you have the time.
translation: 博物馆竣工啦！如果您有时间，请随意进入。 [bo wu guan jun gong la ！ ru guo nin you shi jian ， qing sui yi jin ru 。]

english: Feel free to explore this floor at your leisure while the floor below is under construction.
translation: 当下面的楼层正在施工时，您可以随意探索这一层。 [dang xia mian de lou ceng zheng zai shi gong shi ， nin ke yi sui yi tan suo zhe yi ceng 。]

english: This floor was built some time ago and is not as accurate as it once was.
translation: 这层楼是很久以前建的，不像以前那么准确。 [zhe ceng lou shi hen jiu yi qian jian de ， bu xiang yi qian na me zhun que 。]

english: Now, due to popular demand, the knights of Falador have decided to expand upon the displays to ensure that it includes all discoveries which have been made in recent years.
translation: 现在，由于大众的需求，法拉多骑士决定扩大展示范围，以确保其中包括近年来的所有发现。 [xian zai ， you yu da zhong de xu qiu ， fa la duo qi shi jue ding kuo da zhan shi fan wei ， yi que bao qi zhong bao kuo jin nian lai de suo you fa xian 。]

english: Unfortunately we lack the man power to acquire all of the resources required to build the displays.
translation: 不幸的是，我们缺乏人力来获取构建显示器所需的所有资源。 [bu xing de shi ， wo men que fa ren li lai huo qu gou jian xian shi qi suo xu de suo you zi yuan 。]

english: We'd appreciate it if you could donate any materials you find on your adventures.
translation: 如果您能捐赠您在冒险中找到的任何材料，我们将不胜感激。 [ru guo nin neng juan zeng nin zai mao xian zhong zhao dao de ren he cai liao ， wo men jiang bu sheng gan ji 。]

english: I'd be happy to help. I'll keep an eye out for any useful materials.
translation: 我很乐意提供帮助。我会留意任何有用的材料。 [wo hen le yi ti gong bang zhu 。 wo hui liu yi ren he you yong de cai liao 。]

english: The knights of Falador appreciate your support.
translation: 法拉多的骑士感谢您的支持。 [fa la duo de qi shi gan xie nin de zhi chi 。]

english: I'll pass, I don't have time to help.
translation: 我就过去吧，我没时间帮忙。 [wo jiu guo qu ba ， wo mei shi jian bang mang 。]

english: I understand, you adventurers are busy folk. If you change your mind make sure to let me know.
translation: 我明白了，你们冒险者都是忙碌的人。如果您改变主意，请务必告诉我。 [wo ming bai le ， ni men mao xian zhe dou shi mang lu de ren 。 ru guo nin gai bian zhu yi ， qing wu bi gao su wo 。]

english: Marvelous! What would you like to contribute?
translation: 奇妙！您想贡献什么？ [qi miao ！ nin xiang gong xian shen me ？]

english: You make a contribution to the museum expansion.
translation: 您为博物馆的扩建做出了贡献。 [nin wei bo wu guan de kuo jian zuo chu le gong xian 。]

english: We appreciate your contribution. Do make sure to come back once the museum has been expanded and check out the exhibits!
translation: 我们感谢您的贡献。博物馆扩建后一定要回来看看展品！ [wo men gan xie nin de gong xian 。 bo wu guan kuo jian hou yi ding yao hui lai kan kan zhan pin ！]

english: Of course. Here's the progress made so far.
translation: 当然。这是迄今为止取得的进展。 [dang ran 。 zhe shi qi jin wei zhi qu de de jin zhan 。]

english: Ask about the museum.
translation: 询问博物馆的情况。 [xun wen bo wu guan de qing kuang 。]

english: Hand-in materials.
translation: 上交材料。 [shang jiao cai liao 。]

english: Check Progress.
translation: 检查进度。 [jian cha jin du 。]

english: I'd be happy to help.
translation: 我很乐意提供帮助。 [wo hen le yi ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: I'll pass, I don't have time to help.
translation: 我就过去吧，我没时间帮忙。 [wo jiu guo qu ba ， wo mei shi jian bang mang 。]

english: Greetings to the court of King Arthur!
translation: 向亚瑟王的宫廷致意！ [xiang ya se wang de gong ting zhi yi ！]

english: Hello. I'm looking for a quest. Who should I talk to?
translation: 你好。我正在寻找一个任务。我应该和谁谈谈？ [ni hao 。 wo zheng zai xun zhao yi ge ren wu 。 wo ying gai he shui tan tan ？]

english: King Arthur will let you know. I believe he has a quest at the moment.
translation: 亚瑟王会让你知道的。我相信他此刻有一个任务。 [ya se wang hui rang ni zhi dao de 。 wo xiang xin ta ci ke you yi ge ren wu 。]

english: You are a very talented Knight indeed to have freed Merlin so quickly. You have all of our gratitude.
translation: 你确实是一位非常有才华的骑士，这么快就释放了梅林。你拥有我们所有的感激之情。 [ni que shi shi yi wei fei chang you cai hua de qi shi ， zhe me kuai jiu shi fang le mei lin 。 ni yong you wo men suo you de gan ji zhi qing 。]

english: I am proud to have you as a member of the Round Table.
translation: 我很荣幸您成为圆桌会议的成员。 [wo hen rong xing nin cheng wei yuan zhuo hui yi de cheng yuan 。]

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: You missed all the excitement!
translation: 你错过了所有的兴奋！ [ni cuo guo le suo you de xing fen ！]

english: I got here and agreed to take over duties as king here, then before my eyes the most miraculous changes occured here... grass and trees were growing outside before our very eyes!
translation: 我来到这里，同意继承这里的国王职责，然后，在我的眼前，这里发生了最神奇的变化……草木在我们眼前生长！ [wo lai dao zhe li ， tong yi ji cheng zhe li de guo wang zhi ze ， ran hou ， zai wo de yan qian ， zhe li fa sheng le zui shen qi de bian hua …… cao mu zai wo men yan qian sheng zhang ！]

english: Thank you very much for showing me the way home.
translation: 非常感谢你为我指明了回家的路。 [fei chang gan xie ni wei wo zhi ming liao hui jia de lu 。]

english: Ah! Here you go!
translation: 啊!干得好！ [a ! gan de hao ！]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: I need you to answer this for me.
translation: 我需要你帮我回答这个问题。 [wo xu yao ni bang wo hui da zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Please tell me your answer.
translation: 请告诉我你的答案。 [qing gao su wo ni de da an 。]

english: Nope, Go check again!
translation: 不行，再去检查一下！ [bu xing ， zai qu jian cha yi xia ！]

english: Spot on!
translation: 现货！ [xian huo ！]

english: Hello. I've heard you stopped the demon, well done.
translation: 你好。我听说你阻止了恶魔，干得好。 [ni hao 。 wo ting shuo ni zu zhi le e mo ， gan de hao 。]

english: Yes, that's right.
translation: 是的，没错。 [shi de ， mei cuo 。]

english: A good job well done then.
translation: 那么干得好。 [na me gan de hao 。]

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Yes, although I'm afraid I've lost Silverlight.
translation: 是的，尽管我担心我已经失去了 Silverlight。 [shi de ， jin guan wo dan xin wo yi jing shi qu le  Silverlight。]

english: Yes, news of your carelessness is almost as widespread as knowledge of your victory. Fortunately for you, Silverlight has come back into my possession.
translation: 是的，关于你粗心大意的消息几乎和关于你胜利的消息一样广为人知。对你来说幸运的是，Silverlight 又回到了我的手中。 [shi de ， guan yu ni cu xin da yi de xiao xi ji hu he guan yu ni sheng li de xiao xi yi yang guang wei ren zhi 。 dui ni lai shuo xing yun de shi ，Silverlight  you hui dao le wo de shou zhong 。]

english: Phew, that's a relief.
translation: 唷，这真是一种解脱。 [yo ， zhe zhen shi yi zhong jie tuo 。]

english: Is there any chance of me borrowing it again?
translation: 我还有机会再借吗？ [wo hai you ji hui zai jie ma ？]

english: I'm not going to give it away that easily again, it's far too important to be treated so disrespectfully. Especially now its powers have increased after your fight with Agrith-Naar!
translation: 我不会再轻易放弃它，它太重要了，不能受到如此不尊重的对待。尤其是现在，在与阿格里斯-纳尔战斗后，它的力量有所增强！ [wo bu hui zai qing yi fang qi ta ， ta tai zhong yao le ， bu neng shou dao ru ci bu zun zhong de dui dai 。 you qi shi xian zai ， zai yu a ge li si - na er zhan dou hou ， ta de li liang you suo zeng qiang ！]

english: If you wish to make use of Silverlight again, it will cost you 1000 gold pieces. Maybe that will encourage you to look after it.
translation: 如果您想再次使用Silverlight，则需要花费1000金币。也许这会鼓励您照顾它。 [ru guo nin xiang zai ci shi yong Silverlight， ze xu yao hua fei 1000 jin bi 。 ye xu zhe hui gu li nin zhao gu ta 。]

english: No way, it's not worth that much.
translation: 没办法，不值那么多钱。 [mei ban fa ， bu zhi na me duo qian 。]

english: Ok, I'll pay.
translation: 好的，我付钱。 [hao de ， wo fu qian 。]

english: May you make good use of it.
translation: 愿你好好利用它。 [yuan ni hao hao li yong ta 。]

english: But I don't have that much money.
translation: 但我没有那么多钱。 [dan wo mei you na me duo qian 。]

english: You don't even have enough free space to carry it. Stop wasingmy time!
translation: 您甚至没有足够的可用空间来携带它。别再浪费我的时间了！ [nin shen zhi mei you zu gou de ke yong kong jian lai xie dai ta 。 bie zai lang fei wo de shi jian le ！]

english: Hello, who are you?
translation: 你好，你是谁？ [ni hao ， ni shi shui ？]

english: I am a mighty adventurer, who are you?
translation: 我是强大的冒险家，你是谁？ [wo shi qiang da de mao xian jia ， ni shi shui ？]

english: I am Sir Prysin. A bold and famous knight of the realm.
translation: 我是普赖辛爵士。一位勇敢而著名的王国骑士。 [wo shi pu lai xin jue shi 。 yi wei yong gan er zhu ming de wang guo qi shi 。]

english: I was hoping you could tell me.
translation: 我希望你能告诉我。 [wo xi wang ni neng gao su wo 。]

english: Well I've never met you before.
translation: 好吧，我以前从未见过你。 [hao ba ， wo yi qian cong wei jian guo ni 。]

english: Aris said I should come and talk to you.
translation: 阿里斯说我应该来和你谈谈。 [a li si shuo wo ying gai lai he ni tan tan 。]

english: Aris? Is she still alive? I remember her from when I was pretty young. Well what do you need to talk to me about?
translation: 阿里斯？她还活着吗？我从很小的时候就记得她。那么你需要和我谈什么吗？ [a li si ？ ta hai huo zhe ma ？ wo cong hen xiao de shi hou jiu ji de ta 。 na me ni xu yao he wo tan shen me ma ？]

english: I need to find Silverlight.
translation: 我需要找到 Silverlight。 [wo xu yao zhao dao  Silverlight。]

english: What do you need to find that for?
translation: 你需要找到它做什么？ [ni xu yao zhao dao ta zuo shen me ？]

english: I need it to fight Delrith.
translation: 我需要它来对抗德里斯。 [wo xu yao ta lai dui kang de li si 。]

english: Delrith? I thought the world was rid of him, thanks to my great-grandfather.
translation: 德里斯？我以为世界已经摆脱了他，这要感谢我的曾祖父。 [de li si ？ wo yi wei shi jie yi jing bai tuo le ta ， zhe yao gan xie wo de zeng zu fu 。]

english: Well Aris' crystal ball seems to think otherwise.
translation: 嗯，阿里斯的水晶球似乎不这么认为。 [n ， a li si de shui jing qiu si hu bu zhe me ren wei 。]

english: Well if the ball says so, I'd better help you.
translation: 好吧，如果球这么说，我最好帮助你。 [hao ba ， ru guo qiu zhe me shuo ， wo zui hao bang zhu ni 。]

english: The problem is getting Silverlight.
translation: 问题是如何获取 Silverlight。 [wen ti shi ru he huo qu  Silverlight。]

english: You mean you don't have it?
translation: 你的意思是你没有？ [ni de yi si shi ni mei you ？]

english: Oh I do have it, but it is so powerful that the king made me put it in a special box which needs three different keys to open it. That way it won't fall into the wrong hands.
translation: 哦，我确实有它，但它太强大了，国王让我把它放在一个特殊的盒子里，需要三把不同的钥匙才能打开它。这样它就不会落入坏人之手。 [o ， wo que shi you ta ， dan ta tai qiang da le ， guo wang rang wo ba ta fang zai yi ge te shu de he zi li ， xu yao san ba bu tong de yao shi cai neng da kai ta 。 zhe yang ta jiu bu hui luo ru huai ren zhi shou 。]

english: So give me the keys!
translation: 所以把钥匙给我吧！ [suo yi ba yao shi gei wo ba ！]

english: Um, well, it's not so easy.
translation: 嗯，好吧，这并不容易。 [n ， hao ba ， zhe bing bu rong yi 。]

english: I kept one of the keys. I gave the other two to other people for safe keeping.
translation: 我保留了其中一把钥匙。我把另外两个交给其他人妥善保管。 [wo bao liu le qi zhong yi ba yao shi 。 wo ba ling wai liang ge jiao gei qi ta ren tuo shan bao guan 。]

english: One I gave to Rovin, the captain of the palace guard.
translation: 我把一张送给了宫廷守卫队长罗文。 [wo ba yi zhang song gei le gong ting shou wei dui zhang luo wen 。]

english: I gave the other to the wizard Traiborn.
translation: 我把另一个给了巫师特雷伯恩。 [wo ba ling yi ge gei le wu shi te lei bo en 。]

english: Can you give me your key?
translation: 你能给我你的钥匙吗？ [ni neng gei wo ni de yao shi ma ？]

english: Well there's a problem there as well.
translation: 那么那里也有一个问题。 [na me na li ye you yi ge wen ti 。]

english: I managed to drop the key in the drain just outside the palace kitchen. It is just inside and I can't reach it.
translation: 我设法把钥匙掉进了宫殿厨房外的排水沟里。它就在里面，我够不着。 [wo she fa ba yao shi diao jin le gong dian chu fang wai de pai shui gou li 。 ta jiu zai li mian ， wo gou bu zhe 。]

english: So what does the drain connect to?
translation: 那么排水管连接什么？ [na me pai shui guan lian jie shen me ？]

english: It is the drain for the drainpipe running from the sink in the kitchen down to the palace sewers.
translation: 它是从厨房水槽一直通到宫殿下水道的排水管的排水口。 [ta shi cong chu fang shui cao yi zhi tong dao gong dian xia shui dao de pai shui guan de pai shui kou 。]

english: Well I'd better go key hunting.
translation: 好吧，我最好去寻找钥匙。 [hao ba ， wo zui hao qu xun zhao yao shi 。]

english: Ok, goodbye.
translation: 好的，再见。 [hao de ， zai jian 。]

english: Where can I find Captain Rovin?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到罗文船长？ [wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao luo wen chuan zhang ？]

english: Captain Rovin lives at the top of the guards' quarters in the north-west wing of this palace.
translation: 罗文队长住在这座宫殿西北翼卫兵宿舍的顶层。 [luo wen dui zhang zhu zai zhe zuo gong dian xi bei yi wei bing su she de ding ceng 。]

english: Where does the wizard live?
translation: 巫师住在哪里？ [wu shi zhu zai na li ？]

english: Wizard Traiborn?
translation: 巫师特雷伯恩？ [wu shi te lei bo en ？]

english: He is one of the wizards who lives in the tower on the little island just off the south coast. I believe his quarters are on the first floor of the tower.
translation: 他是住在南海岸小岛上塔楼里的巫师之一。我相信他的住所位于塔楼的一楼。 [ta shi zhu zai nan hai an xiao dao shang ta lou li de wu shi zhi yi 。 wo xiang xin ta de zhu suo wei yu ta lou de yi lou 。]

english: And why is this a problem?
translation: 为什么这是一个问题？ [wei shen me zhe shi yi ge wen ti ？]

english: He's back and unfortunately I've got to deal with him.
translation: 他回来了，不幸的是我必须对付他。 [ta hui lai le ， bu xing de shi wo bi xu dui fu ta 。]

english: You don't look up to much. I suppose Silverlight may be good enough to carry you through though.

translation: 是的，她还活着。她就住在城堡外面！ [shi de ， ta hai huo zhe 。 ta jiu zhu zai cheng bao wai mian ！]

translation: 哦，那是同一个阿里斯吗？我本以为她现在已经死了。当我还是个小伙子的时候，她已经很老了。 [o ， na shi tong yi ge a li si ma ？ wo ben yi wei ta xian zai yi jing si le 。 dang wo hai shi ge xiao huo zi de shi hou ， ta yi jing hen lao le 。]

translation: 不管怎样，我能为你做什么？ [bu guan zen yang ， wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: So how are you doing with getting the keys?
translation: 那么你拿到钥匙的时候怎么样了？ [na me ni na dao yao shi de shi hou zen me yang le ？]

english: I haven't found any of them yet.
translation: 我还没有找到其中任何一个。 [wo hai mei you zhao dao qi zhong ren he yi ge 。]

english: I'm still looking.
translation: 我还在寻找。 [wo hai zai xun zhao 。]

translation: 好的，当你把它们全部拿到时告诉我。 [hao de ， dang ni ba ta men quan bu na dao shi gao su wo 。]
