translation: 现在，您还需要什么吗，[milady/sirrah]？ [xian zai ， nin hai xu yao shen me ma ，[milady/sirrah]？]

english: Well did you also know he was a Mahjarrat?
translation: 那么你也知道他是马吉拉特人吗？ [na me ni ye zhi dao ta shi ma ji la te ren ma ？]

english: A Mahjarrat! You must be pulling on my leg, what?
translation: 一个马吉拉特！你一定是在拉我的腿，什么？ [yi ge ma ji la te ！ ni yi ding shi zai la wo de tui ， shen me ？]

english: His name is Sliske. Have you heard of him?
translation: 他的名字叫斯利斯克。你听说过他吗？ [ta de ming zi jiao si li si ke 。 ni ting shuo guo ta ma ？]

english: Sliske, hmm? We have dossiers on many Mahjarrat, but I must confess, this is a new name to me. Poor show! I'll have to see what we have hiding in the archives.
translation: 斯利斯克，嗯？我们有许多 Mahjarrat 的档案，但我必须承认，这对我来说是一个新名字。糟糕的表演！我得看看我们在档案馆里藏着什么。 [si li si ke ， n ？ wo men you xu duo  Mahjarrat  de dang an ， dan wo bi xu cheng ren ， zhe dui wo lai shuo shi yi ge xin ming zi 。 zao gao de biao yan ！ wo de kan kan wo men zai dang an guan li cang zhe shen me 。]

english: While you're there, it might be worth looking up something called the Elder Horn. It's an artefact that Sliske has now claimed. One that has the ability to control minds.
translation: 当你在那里时，可能值得去寻找一个叫做“长老号角”的东西。这是斯利斯克现在声称拥有的一件文物。一种拥有控制思想能力的人。 [dang ni zai na li shi ， ke neng zhi de qu xun zhao yi ge jiao zuo “ zhang lao hao jiao ” de dong xi 。 zhe shi si li si ke xian zai sheng cheng yong you de yi jian wen wu 。 yi zhong yong you kong zhi si xiang neng li de ren 。]

english: A mind controlling artefact you say? Sounds like I'll need to report this to the top brass. Can't see them being too thrilled about it. Thank you for the update, old bean.
translation: 你说的是精神控制神器？听起来我需要向高层报告此事。看不出他们对此感到太兴奋。谢谢你的更新，老豆子。 [ni shuo de shi jing shen kong zhi shen qi ？ ting qi lai wo xu yao xiang gao ceng bao gao ci shi 。 kan bu chu ta men dui ci gan dao tai xing fen 。 xie xie ni de geng xin ， lao dou zi 。]

english: A mind controlling artefact you say? First Lucien and the Stone, and now this! The top brass will need to be made aware. Can't see them being too thrilled about it. Thank you for the update, old bean.
translation: 你说的是精神控制神器？首先是卢西安和石头，现在是这个！高层管理人员需要意识到这一点。看不出他们对此感到太兴奋。谢谢你的更新，老豆子。 [ni shuo de shi jing shen kong zhi shen qi ？ shou xian shi lu xi an he shi tou ， xian zai shi zhe ge ！ gao ceng guan li ren yuan xu yao yi shi dao zhe yi dian 。 kan bu chu ta men dui ci gan dao tai xing fen 。 xie xie ni de geng xin ， lao dou zi 。]

english: I don't really understand this 'Gaze of Saradomin' thing... Do you think you could explain what it does for me?
translation: 我不太明白“萨拉多明的凝视”这个东西……你能解释一下它对我有什么作用吗？ [wo bu tai ming bai “ sa la duo ming de ning shi ” zhe ge dong xi …… ni neng jie shi yi xia ta dui wo you shen me zuo yong ma ？]

english: Certainly [milady/sirrah]! As you know, we Temple Knights are personally favoured by Saradomin himself.
translation: 当然是[米拉迪/先生]！如你所知，我们圣殿骑士是受到萨拉多明本人亲自青睐的。 [dang ran shi [ mi la di / xian sheng ]！ ru ni suo zhi ， wo men sheng dian qi shi shi shou dao sa la duo ming ben ren qin zi qing lai de 。]

english: And when I say personally favoured, I don't mean that sometime off in the future he's going to buy us all a drink!
translation: 当我说个人喜欢时，我并不是说将来某个时候他会请我们大家喝一杯！ [dang wo shuo ge ren xi huan shi ， wo bing bu shi shuo jiang lai mou ge shi hou ta hui qing wo men da jia he yi bei ！]

english: He watches over each of us, and when we die he catches us as we fall, and ensures we arrive back at Falador castle safe and sound.
translation: 他守护着我们每个人，当我们死去时，他会在我们跌倒时接住我们，并确保我们安然无恙地回到法拉多城堡。 [ta shou hu zhe wo men mei ge ren ， dang wo men si qu shi ， ta hui zai wo men die dao shi jie zhu wo men ， bing que bao wo men an ran wu yang di hui dao fa la duo cheng bao 。]

english: We usually lose some equipment when he does so, but it's a small price to pay to be hale and hearty again, what?
translation: 当他这样做时，我们通常会失去一些装备，但要再次精神饱满，这是一个很小的代价，什么？ [dang ta zhe yang zuo shi ， wo men tong chang hui shi qu yi xie zhuang bei ， dan yao zai ci jing shen bao man ， zhe shi yi ge hen xiao de dai jia ， shen me ？]

english: Some lucky fellows have a similar system going already, but when they die they spawn in that squalid little swamp village Lumbridge.
translation: 一些幸运的家伙已经有一个类似的系统，但当他们死后，他们会在那个肮脏的小沼泽村朗布里奇产卵。 [yi xie xing yun de jia huo yi jing you yi ge lei si de xi tong ， dan dang ta men si hou ， ta men hui zai na ge ang zang de xiao zhao ze cun lang bu li qi chan luan 。]

english: Yeah, what kind of person would want to spawn there... Certainly not me, and I never have! Honest!
translation: 是啊，什么样的人会想在那里出生……当然不是我，而且我从来没有！诚实的！ [shi a ， shen me yang de ren hui xiang zai na li chu sheng …… dang ran bu shi wo ， er qie wo cong lai mei you ！ cheng shi de ！]

english: Well, you should be glad that we offer you a step up then! Falador is clearly a far superior town to spend your time in!
translation: 那么，您应该很高兴我们为您提供了一个进步！法拉多显然是一个更适合消磨时光的小镇！ [na me ， nin ying gai hen gao xing wo men wei nin ti gong le yi ge jin bu ！ fa la duo xian ran shi yi ge geng shi he xiao mo shi guang de xiao zhen ！]

english: Was there something else you wanted to ask good old Tiffy, [milady/sirrah]?
translation: 您还有其他问题想问善良的老蒂菲吗，[milady/sirrah]？ [nin hai you qi ta wen ti xiang wen shan liang de lao di fei ma ，[milady/sirrah]？]

english: Can I buy some armour?
translation: 我可以买一些盔甲吗？ [wo ke yi mai yi xie kui jia ma ？]

english: Of course old bean. I can sell you up to Proselyte level items only I'm afraid.
translation: 当然是老豆子了。恐怕我只能向你出售异教徒级别的物品。 [dang ran shi lao dou zi le 。 kong pa wo zhi neng xiang ni chu shou yi jiao tu ji bie de wu pin 。]

english: Can I switch respawns, please?
translation: 请问可以切换重生吗？ [qing wen ke yi qie huan chong sheng ma ？]

english: Ah, so you'd like to respawn in Falador, the good old homestead! Are you sure?
translation: 啊，所以你想在法拉多重生，那个古老的家园！你确定吗？ [a ， suo yi ni xiang zai fa la duo chong sheng ， na ge gu lao de jia yuan ！ ni que ding ma ？]

english: Yes, I want to respawn in Falador.
translation: 是的，我想在法拉多重生。 [shi de ， wo xiang zai fa la duo chong sheng 。]

english: Top-hole, what? Good old Fally is definitely the hot-spot nowadays!
translation: 顶洞，什么？好老的Fally绝对是时下的热点！ [ding dong ， shen me ？ hao lao de Fally jue dui shi shi xia de re dian ！]

english: Actually, no thanks. I like my respawn point.
translation: 事实上，不用谢。我喜欢我的重生点。 [shi shi shang ， bu yong xie 。 wo xi huan wo de chong sheng dian 。]

english: As you wish, what? Ta-ta for now.
translation: 如你所愿，什么？塔塔现在。 [ru ni suo yuan ， shen me ？ ta ta xian zai 。]

english: What? You're saying you want to respawn in Lumbridge? Are you sure?
translation: 什么？你是说你想在朗布里奇重生？你确定吗？ [shen me ？ ni shi shuo ni xiang zai lang bu li qi chong sheng ？ ni que ding ma ？]

english: Yes, I want to respawn in Lumbridge.
translation: 是的，我想在朗布里奇重生。 [shi de ， wo xiang zai lang bu li qi chong sheng 。]

english: Why anyone would want to visit that smelly little swamp village of oiks is quite beyond me, I'm afraid, but the deed is done now.
translation: 恐怕我完全无法理解为什么有人会想去参观那个臭气熏天的奥克斯沼泽小村庄，但现在事情已经完成了。 [kong pa wo wan quan wu fa li jie wei shen me you ren hui xiang qu can guan na ge chou qi xun tian de ao ke si zhao ze xiao cun zhuang ， dan xian zai shi qing yi jing wan cheng le 。]

english: Well, see you around Tiffy.
translation: 好吧，蒂菲见。 [hao ba ， di fei jian 。]

english: Ta-ta for now, old bean!
translation: 塔塔现在，老豆子！ [ta ta xian zai ， lao dou zi ！]

english: Sir Tiffy! I got this scroll from a knight near Trollheim. He said I should deliver it to you urgently.
translation: 蒂菲先生！我从特罗尔海姆附近的一位骑士那里得到了这个卷轴。他说我应该紧急送给你。 [di fei xian sheng ！ wo cong te luo er hai mu fu jin de yi wei qi shi na li de dao le zhe ge juan zhou 。 ta shuo wo ying gai jin ji song gei ni 。]

english: What ho, old [boy/gal/bean]. Well, hand it over and let's have a look, shall we?
translation: 什么嗬，老[男孩/女孩/豆子]。好吧，把它交给我们看一下，好吗？ [shen me he ， lao [ nan hai / nv hai / dou zi ]。 hao ba ， ba ta jiao gei wo men kan yi xia ， hao ma ？]

english: Now, let's see what is so urgent. Hmmm...
translation: 现在，让我们看看什么事情如此紧急。嗯... [xian zai ， rang wo men kan kan shen me shi qing ru ci jin ji 。 n ...]

english: Well, you've been a great help, so I'll tell you a bit about this, shall I? Several weeks ago, a dwarven explorer, named Nestor Peregrine, discovered the entrance to an ancient cave complex while exploring the
translation: 好吧，你帮了很大的忙，所以我会告诉你一些关于这件事的信息，可以吗？几周前，一位名叫内斯特·佩里格林 (Nestor Peregrine) 的矮人探险家在探索宇宙时发现了一个古老洞穴群的入口。 [hao ba ， ni bang le hen da de mang ， suo yi wo hui gao su ni yi xie guan yu zhe jian shi de xin xi ， ke yi ma ？ ji zhou qian ， yi wei ming jiao nei si te · pei li ge lin  (Nestor Peregrine)  de ai ren tan xian jia zai tan suo yu zhou shi fa xian le yi ge gu lao dong xue qun de ru kou 。]

english: troll mountains. On his return to Keldagrim, he celebrated in a tavern where we have an informant. The dwarf spoke of a great treasure, apparently mentioned in dwarven legend, and of creatures of great
translation: 巨魔山脉。返回凯尔达格林后，他在一家小酒馆里庆祝，我们在那里有一名线人。矮人谈到了矮人传说中显然提到的一件伟大的宝藏，以及伟大的生物。 [ju mo shan mai 。 fan hui kai er da ge lin hou ， ta zai yi jia xiao jiu guan li qing zhu ， wo men zai na li you yi ming xian ren 。 ai ren tan dao le ai ren chuan shuo zhong xian ran ti dao de yi jian wei da de bao zang ， yi ji wei da de sheng wu 。]

english: evil, fighting those of great good. I sent Sir Gerry and a small command of knights to investigate the dwarf's stories several months ago and it appears that he has found the resting place of that incredible weapon: the
translation: 恶人，与大善人作斗争。几个月前，我派了格里爵士和一小队骑士去调查这个矮人的故事，看来他已经找到了那把令人难以置信的武器的安息地： [e ren ， yu da shan ren zuo dou zheng 。 ji ge yue qian ， wo pai le ge li jue shi he yi xiao dui qi shi qu diao cha zhe ge ai ren de gu shi ， kan lai ta yi jing zhao dao le na ba ling ren nan yi zhi xin de wu qi de an xi di ：]

english: Godsword.
translation: 神剑。 [shen jian 。]

english: The Godsword? What's that?
translation: 神剑？那是什么？ [shen jian ？ na shi shen me ？]

english: During the great God Wars, the evil usurper Zamorak gathered many ancient relics and armies to his cause. There were none powerful enough to stand alone before his might, so our glorious Lord Saradomin
translation: 在伟大的神战期间，邪恶的篡位者萨莫拉克聚集了许多古老的遗物和军队来支持他的事业。没有人有足够的力量能够在他的力量面前独自站立，所以我们光荣的萨拉多明勋爵 [zai wei da de shen zhan qi jian ， xie e de cuan wei zhe sa mo la ke ju ji le xu duo gu lao de yi wu he jun dui lai zhi chi ta de shi ye 。 mei you ren you zu gou de li liang neng gou zai ta de li liang mian qian du zi zhan li ， suo yi wo men guang rong de sa la duo ming xun jue]

english: gathered a triumverateof gods to stem the tide of evil. They came together and, using great magics, they created the Godsword; a weapon so mighty that it could slay even a god. It was forged in the flames of a
translation: 集结了三巨头来阻止邪恶的浪潮。他们聚集在一起，使用伟大的魔法创造了神剑；如此强大的武器，甚至可以杀死神。它是在火焰中锻造出来的 [ji jie le san ju tou lai zu zhi xie e de lang chao 。 ta men ju ji zai yi qi ， shi yong wei da de mo fa chuang zao le shen jian ； ru ci qiang da de wu qi ， shen zhi ke yi sha si shen 。 ta shi zai huo yan zhong duan zao chu lai de]

english: volcano and tempered by the tears of the icyene. The mightiest warriors to stand before the army of evil were the aviansie: birdmen followers of Armadyl. They were a proud and mighty warrior race. To them fell the task of
translation: 火山并被冰河的泪水调和。站在邪恶大军面前的最强大的战士是鸟人：阿玛迪尔的鸟人追随者。他们是一个骄傲而强大的战士种族。他们的任务落到了 [huo shan bing bei bing he de lei shui tiao he 。 zhan zai xie e da jun mian qian de zui qiang da de zhan shi shi niao ren ： a ma di er de niao ren zhui sui zhe 。 ta men shi yi ge jiao ao er qiang da de zhan shi zhong zu 。 ta men de ren wu luo dao le]

english: delivering the Godsword to the holy armies that gathered to oppose Zamorak's evil. Unfortunately, they were attacked by an army of demons before they could reach the safety of the main army. It was a fiendish
translation: 将神剑交给聚集起来对抗萨莫拉克邪恶的圣军。不幸的是，他们还没有到达主力部队的安全地带，就遭到了恶魔大军的袭击。这是一个恶魔 [jiang shen jian jiao gei ju ji qi lai dui kang sa mo la ke xie e de sheng jun 。 bu xing de shi ， ta men hai mei you dao da zhu li bu dui de an quan di dai ， jiu zao dao le e mo da jun de xi ji 。 zhe shi yi ge e mo]

english: stroke by the forces of darkness. At the same time as they attacked the aviansie, they also mounted a huge attack on the main armies that opposed them. Realising their intent, several of the gods that were allied against
translation: 被黑暗势力攻击。他们在攻击鸟人的同时，也对敌对的主力部队发起了大规模的攻击。几位结盟的神意识到了他们的意图 [bei hei an shi li gong ji 。 ta men zai gong ji niao ren de tong shi ， ye dui di dui de zhu li bu dui fa qi le da gui mo de gong ji 。 ji wei jie meng de shen yi shi dao le ta men de yi tu]

english: Zamorak sent forces to aid the besieged aviansie, who had retreated into a temple in the mountains. The forces of Saradomin and Bandos arrived in the midst of a pitched battle for the Godsword, and it was during this
translation: 萨莫拉克派出部队援助被围困的阿维安西，他们已经撤退到山中的一座寺庙里。萨拉多明和班多斯的军队在争夺神剑的激战中抵达，就在这个时候 [sa mo la ke pai chu bu dui yuan zhu bei wei kun de a wei an xi ， ta men yi jing che tui dao shan zhong de yi zuo si miao li 。 sa la duo ming he ban duo si de jun dui zai zheng duo shen jian de ji zhan zhong di da ， jiu zai zhe ge shi hou]

english: battle that the sword was sundered. Shortly thereafter, the evil one cast a spell of such devastation that it flattened the entire northern half of Gielinor, reducing it to what we now call the Wilderness. This temple must
translation: 剑被斩断的战斗。此后不久，邪恶者施展了毁灭性的咒语，将吉林诺的整个北半部夷为平地，将其变成了我们现在所说的荒野。这座寺庙必须 [jian bei zhan duan de zhan dou 。 ci hou bu jiu ， xie e zhe shi zhan le hui mie xing de zhou yu ， jiang ji lin nuo de zheng ge bei ban bu yi wei ping di ， jiang qi bian cheng le wo men xian zai suo shuo de huang ye 。 zhe zuo si miao bi xu]

english: have collapsed, sealing the combatants in.
translation: 已经倒塌，将战斗人员封锁在里面。 [yi jing dao ta ， jiang zhan dou ren yuan feng suo zai li mian 。]

english: Surely, one of the groups would have gained the upper hand by now? After all, it's been thousands of years since that battle.
translation: 当然，现在其中一组肯定已经占据了上风吧？毕竟，距离那场战斗，已经过去了数千年。 [dang ran ， xian zai qi zhong yi zu ken ding yi jing zhan ju le shang feng ba ？ bi jing ， ju li na chang zhan dou ， yi jing guo qu le shu qian nian 。]

english: Apparently not. It appears that a millennia-old battle is still being fought beneath the ruins of the temple, and the prize for winning the battle is the Godsword! Hmm... Well, thank you very much, old [boy/gal/bean]. You've been a
translation: 显然不是。看来，一场千年之战仍在圣殿废墟下进行，而赢得这场战斗的奖品就是神剑！嗯……嗯，非常感谢你，老[boy/gal/bean]。你曾经是一个 [xian ran bu shi 。 kan lai ， yi chang qian nian zhi zhan reng zai sheng dian fei xu xia jin xing ， er ying de zhe chang zhan dou de jiang pin jiu shi shen jian ！ n …… n ， fei chang gan xie ni ， lao [boy/gal/bean]。 ni ceng jing shi yi ge]

english: great help. I shall pass it on to my superiors.
translation: 很有帮助。我会向上级汇报。 [hen you bang zhu 。 wo hui xiang shang ji hui bao 。]

english: Is that it, then? Aren't we going to do something?
translation: 那么是这样吗？我们不做点什么吗？ [na me shi zhe yang ma ？ wo men bu zuo dian shen me ma ？]

english: Yes, yes. All in good time. I'll have to consult my commanding officer first. Thank you, old [boy/gal/bean], you're dismissed.
translation: 是的，是的。一切都恰逢其时。我得先咨询我的指挥官。谢谢你，老[boy/gal/bean]，你被解雇了。 [shi de ， shi de 。 yi qie dou qia feng qi shi 。 wo de xian zi xun wo de zhi hui guan 。 xie xie ni ， lao [boy/gal/bean]， ni bei jie gu le 。]

english: Now, let's see what is so urgent. Hmm... I see that this scroll has been tampered with! The wax seal is broken.
translation: 现在，让我们看看什么事情如此紧急。嗯……我发现这个卷轴被篡改了！蜡封已损坏。 [xian zai ， rang wo men kan kan shen me shi qing ru ci jin ji 。 n …… wo fa xian zhe ge juan zhou bei cuan gai le ！ la feng yi sun huai 。]

english: Err, yes. It was that way when I got it.
translation: 呃，是的。我拿到手的时候就是这样的。 [e ， shi de 。 wo na dao shou de shi hou jiu shi zhe yang de 。]

english: I see. Anyway, let's see what it says.
translation: 我懂了。无论如何，让我们看看它说了什么。 [wo dong le 。 wu lun ru he ， rang wo men kan kan ta shuo le shen me 。]

english: Oh dear. Well, thank you very much, old [boy/gal/bean]. You've been a great help. I shall pass it on to my superiors.
translation: 哦亲爱的。嗯，非常感谢你，老[boy/gal/bean]。你帮了很大的忙。我会向上级汇报。 [o qin ai de 。 n ， fei chang gan xie ni ， lao [boy/gal/bean]。 ni bang le hen da de mang 。 wo hui xiang shang ji hui bao 。]

english: Is that it then? Aren't we going to do something?
translation: 那么就这样了吗？我们不做点什么吗？ [na me jiu zhe yang le ma ？ wo men bu zuo dian shen me ma ？]

english: Ah, you must be one of us. I must share this information with you:40,41;1,6;49;12;1,2;37,41;45;89,75;16,20;103
translation: 啊，你一定是我们中的一员。我必须与您分享此信息：40,41;1,6;49;12;1,2;37,41;45;89,75;16,20;103 [a ， ni yi ding shi wo men zhong de yi yuan 。 wo bi xu yu nin fen xiang ci xin xi ：40,41;1,6;49;12;1,2;37,41;45;89,75;16,20;103]

english: Do you have any jobs for me yet?
translation: 你还有工作给我吗？ [ni hai you gong zuo gei wo ma ？]

english: Can you explain the Gaze of Saradomin to me?
translation: 你能给我解释一下萨拉多明的凝视吗？ [ni neng gei wo jie shi yi xia sa la duo ming de ning shi ma ？]

english: Can I buy some armour?
translation: 我可以买一些盔甲吗？ [wo ke yi mai yi xie kui jia ma ？]

english: Can I switch respawns please?
translation: 请问可以切换重生吗？ [qing wen ke yi qie huan chong sheng ma ？]

english: Yes, I want to respawn in Falador.
translation: 是的，我想在法拉多重生。 [shi de ， wo xiang zai fa la duo chong sheng 。]

english: Actually, no thanks. I like my respawn point.
translation: 事实上，不用谢。我喜欢我的重生点。 [shi shi shang ， bu yong xie 。 wo xi huan wo de chong sheng dian 。]

english: Yes, I want to respawn in Lumbridge.
translation: 是的，我想在朗布里奇重生。 [shi de ， wo xiang zai lang bu li qi chong sheng 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Hail Arthur, King of the Britons!
translation: 亚瑟万岁，不列颠国王！ [ya se wan sui ， bu lie dian guo wang ！]

english: Um... Hello.
translation: 嗯...你好。 [n ... ni hao 。]

english: I'm looking for adventure! More specifically, some sort of quest.
translation: 我正在寻找冒险！更具体地说，是某种探索。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao mao xian ！ geng ju ti di shuo ， shi mou zhong tan suo 。]

english: ...Then hail Arthur, King of Britons, like I just said.
translation: ......然后像我刚才说的那样，向英国国王亚瑟致敬。 [...... ran hou xiang wo gang cai shuo de na yang ， xiang ying guo guo wang ya se zhi jing 。]

english: Oh. Ok.
translation: 哦。好的。 [o 。 hao de 。]

english: I thought you just had a weird way of saying hello is all.
translation: 我以为你只是用一种奇怪的方式打招呼而已。 [wo yi wei ni zhi shi yong yi zhong qi guai de fang shi da zhao hu er yi 。]

english: Thanks for freeing Merlin.
translation: 感谢您释放了梅林。 [gan xie nin shi fang le mei lin 。]

english: No problem. It was easy.
translation: 没问题。这很容易。 [mei wen ti 。 zhe hen rong yi 。]

english: You are indeed a mighty knight. I hope your adventuring goes well.
translation: 你确实是一位强大的骑士。我希望你的冒险一切顺利。 [ni que shi shi yi wei qiang da de qi shi 。 wo xi wang ni de mao xian yi qie shun li 。]

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Greetings traveller.
translation: 问候旅行者。 [wen hou lv xing zhe 。]

english: Do you have anything to trade?
translation: 你有什么东西可以交易吗？ [ni you shen me dong xi ke yi jiao yi ma ？]

english: No, I'm sorry.
translation: 不，对不起。 [bu ， dui bu qi 。]

english: Well, maybe I do, but you need to prove yourself worthy as a White Knight before I will sell you anything.
translation: 好吧，也许我愿意，但在我向你出售任何东西之前，你需要证明自己是一名白骑士。 [hao ba ， ye xu wo yuan yi ， dan zai wo xiang ni chu shou ren he dong xi zhi qian ， ni xu yao zheng ming zi ji shi yi ming bai qi shi 。]

english: And how can I do that?
translation: 我怎样才能做到这一点？ [wo zen yang cai neng zuo dao zhe yi dian ？]

english: Kill Black Knights and make sure you don't kill any White Knights!
translation: 杀死黑骑士并确保你没有杀死任何白骑士！ [sha si hei qi shi bing que bao ni mei you sha si ren he bai qi shi ！]

english: Well, okay then.
translation: 好吧，那么好吧。 [hao ba ， na me hao ba 。]

english: And it is so very rare that I see any White Knight who has reached Adept level!
translation: 而且白骑士达到高手级别的也太少见了！ [er qie bai qi shi da dao gao shou ji bie de ye tai shao jian le ！]

english: Well of course! I AM the White Knights armourer after all!
translation: 当然好！我毕竟是白骑士团的装甲师！ [dang ran hao ！ wo bi jing shi bai qi shi tuan de zhuang jia shi ！]

english: And for a dedicated White Knight to have reached Master level like yourself, you get only the very best of all equipment available!
translation: 对于像您这样达到大师级别的敬业白骑士来说，您只能获得所有可用装备中最好的！ [dui yu xiang nin zhe yang da dao da shi ji bie de jing ye bai qi shi lai shuo ， nin zhi neng huo de suo you ke yong zhuang bei zhong zui hao de ！]

english: Why are there so many knights in this city?
translation: 为什么这座城市里有这么多骑士？ [wei shen me zhe zuo cheng shi li you zhe me duo qi shi ？]

english: We are the White Knights of Falador. We are the most powerful order of knights in the land. We are helping the king Vallance rule the kingdom as he is getting old and tired.
translation: 我们是法拉多的白骑士。我们是这片土地上最强大的骑士团。我们正在帮助国王瓦兰斯统治王国，因为他已经年老体弱。 [wo men shi fa la duo de bai qi shi 。 wo men shi zhe pian tu di shang zui qiang da de qi shi tuan 。 wo men zheng zai bang zhu guo wang wa lan si tong zhi wang guo ， yin wei ta yi jing nian lao ti ruo 。]

english: Can I just talk to you very slowly for a few minutes, while I distract you, so that my friend over there can do something while you're busy being distracted by me?
translation: 我可以慢慢地跟你说几分钟，分散你的注意力，这样我那边的朋友就可以在你忙着分散我的注意力的时候做点什么吗？ [wo ke yi man man di gen ni shuo ji fen zhong ， fen san ni de zhu yi li ， zhe yang wo na bian de peng you jiu ke yi zai ni mang zhe fen san wo de zhu yi li de shi hou zuo dian shen me ma ？]

english: I'm... not sure what you're asking me... you want to join the White Knights?
translation: 我……不知道你在问我什么……你想加入白骑士吗？ [wo …… bu zhi dao ni zai wen wo shen me …… ni xiang jia ru bai qi shi ma ？]

english: Nope. I'm just trying to distract you.
translation: 没有。我只是想分散你的注意力。 [mei you 。 wo zhi shi xiang fen san ni de zhu yi li 。]

english: ... ...you are very odd.
translation: ……你很奇怪。 […… ni hen qi guai 。]

english: So can I distract you some more?
translation: 那我可以再分散你的注意力吗？ [na wo ke yi zai fen san ni de zhu yi li ma ？]

english: ... ...I don't think I want to talk to you anymore.
translation: ……我想我不想再和你说话了。 […… wo xiang wo bu xiang zai he ni shuo hua le 。]

english: Ok. My work here is done. 'Bye!
translation: 好的。我这里的工作已经完成了。 '再见！ [hao de 。 wo zhe li de gong zuo yi jing wan cheng le 。 ' zai jian ！]

english: Excellent work! I have new information to share with you.
translation: 佳作！我有新信息要与您分享。 [jia zuo ！ wo you xin xin xi yao yu nin fen xiang 。]

english: You're not done yet! Do this for me!
translation: 你还没有完成！为我做这个！ [ni hai mei you wan cheng ！ wei wo zuo zhe ge ！]

english: The black knights can do puzzles better than that!
translation: 黑骑士的拼图能力比这更好！ [hei qi shi de pin tu neng li bi zhe geng hao ！]

english: Excellent work!
translation: 佳作！ [jia zuo ！]

english: Here you go.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.
translation: 你会收到线索卷轴的撕破部分。 [ni hui shou dao xian suo juan zhou de si po bu fen 。]

english: Your commitment to the white knights is fantastic [player name].
translation: 你对白衣骑士的承诺非常棒[玩家名字]。 [ni dui bai yi qi shi de cheng nuo fei chang bang [ wan jia ming zi ]。]

english: Do you have anything to trade?
translation: 你有什么东西可以交易吗？ [ni you shen me dong xi ke yi jiao yi ma ？]

english: Why are there so many knights in this city?
translation: 为什么这座城市里有这么多骑士？ [wei shen me zhe zuo cheng shi li you zhe me duo qi shi ？]

english: Can I just distract you for a minute?
translation: 我可以分散你的注意力吗？ [wo ke yi fen san ni de zhu yi li ma ？]

english: Good day, how may I help you?
translation: 美好的一天，我能为您做些什么吗？ [mei hao de yi tian ， wo neng wei nin zuo xie shen me ma ？]

english: I'd like to access my bank account, please.
translation: 我想访问我的银行帐户。 [wo xiang fang wen wo de yin hang zhang hu 。]

english: I'd like to check my PIN settings.
translation: 我想检查我的 PIN 设置。 [wo xiang jian cha wo de  PIN  she zhi 。]

english: I'd like to collect items.
translation: 我想收集物品。 [wo xiang shou ji wu pin 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This is a branch of the Bank of Gielinor. We have branches in many towns.
translation: 这是吉林诺银行的一个分行。我们在很多城镇都有分店。 [zhe shi ji lin nuo yin hang de yi ge fen hang 。 wo men zai hen duo cheng zhen dou you fen dian 。]

english: And what do you do?
translation: 你做什么？ [ni zuo shen me ？]

english: We will look after your items and money for you. Leave your valuables with us if you want to keep them safe.
translation: 我们将为您保管您的物品和金钱。如果您想保证贵重物品的安全，请将其交给我们。 [wo men jiang wei nin bao guan nin de wu pin he jin qian 。 ru guo nin xiang bao zheng gui zhong wu pin de an quan ， qing jiang qi jiao gei wo men 。]

english: Hi, I...
translation: 嗨，我... [hai ， wo ...]

english: What are you doing here, Fremennik?!
translation: 你在这里做什么，弗雷曼尼克？！ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ， fu lei man ni ke ？！]

english: I have a Seal of pass...
translation: 我有通行证... [wo you tong xing zheng ...]

english: No You do not! Begone!
translation: 不，你不！走开！ [bu ， ni bu ！ zou kai ！]

english: I'd like to access my bank account, please.
translation: 我想访问我的银行帐户。 [wo xiang fang wen wo de yin hang zhang hu 。]

english: I'd like to check my PIN settings.
translation: 我想检查我的 PIN 设置。 [wo xiang jian cha wo de  PIN  she zhi 。]

english: I'd like to collect items.
translation: 我想收集物品。 [wo xiang shou ji wu pin 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Greetings, traveller.
translation: 你好，旅行者。 [ni hao ， lv xing zhe 。]

english: What's with all these Oathbreakers?
translation: 这些背誓者到底是怎么回事？ [zhe xie bei shi zhe dao di shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: Gah! A bunch of fanatical cultists. Nothing more.
translation: 嘎！一群狂热的邪教徒。而已。 [ga ！ yi qun kuang re de xie jiao tu 。 er yi 。]

english: You don't sound impressed?
translation: 你听起来不印象深刻吗？ [ni ting qi lai bu yin xiang shen ke ma ？]

english: No! Well I wouldn't be, would I? I've spent my whole life dedicated to my sect. I dreamed of one day entering the Sanctuary and finally meeting Mother!
translation: 不！好吧，我不会，是吗？我一生都致力于我的教派。我梦想有一天能进入庇护所，终于见到母亲！ [bu ！ hao ba ， wo bu hui ， shi ma ？ wo yi sheng dou zhi li yu wo de jiao pai 。 wo meng xiang you yi tian neng jin ru bi hu suo ， zhong yu jian dao mu qin ！]

english: Yet instead I'm greeted by this condescending 'Lord' who feels I could try being 'a little more chaotic' for once.
translation: 然而，迎接我的是这位居高临下的“主”，他觉得我可以尝试一下“更混乱一点”。 [ran er ， ying jie wo de shi zhe wei ju gao lin xia de “ zhu ”， ta jue de wo ke yi chang shi yi xia “ geng hun luan yi dian ”。]

english: I see...
translation: 我懂了... [wo dong le ...]

english: And to top it all off, Mother hasn't awoken at all. I fear she is probably being held captive by this Nightmare, or worse.
translation: 最糟糕的是，母亲根本没有醒来。我担心她可能被这个噩梦所俘虏，或者更糟。 [zui zao gao de shi ， mu qin gen ben mei you xing lai 。 wo dan xin ta ke neng bei zhe ge e meng suo fu lu ， huo zhe geng zao 。]

english: The only things these oafs are breaking is my head with their silent stares and furious hand-talk.
translation: 这些傻瓜唯一打破的是我的头，他们沉默的凝视和愤怒的手势。 [zhe xie sha gua wei yi da po de shi wo de tou ， ta men chen mo de ning shi he fen nu de shou shi 。]

english: I'm sorry your day hasn't been going well.
translation: 很抱歉你的日子过得不顺利。 [hen bao qian ni de ri zi guo de bu shun li 。]

english: Ah... Thank you, traveller. Are you here to fight the Nightmare?
translation: 啊……谢谢你，旅行者。你是来对抗梦魇的吗？ [a …… xie xie ni ， lv xing zhe 。 ni shi lai dui kang meng yan de ma ？]

english: We'll see. Sounds pretty tough.
translation: 我们拭目以待。听起来相当艰难。 [wo men shi mu yi dai 。 ting qi lai xiang dang jian nan 。]

english: I'll pray for you.
translation: 我会为你祈祷。 [wo hui wei ni qi dao 。]

english: They seem to be carrying dangerous weapons.
translation: 他们似乎携带危险武器。 [ta men si hu xie dai wei xian wu qi 。]

english: Indeed. Speaking of weapons, I assume you have heard of the immensely powerful orbs the Nightmare is protecting?
translation: 的确。说到武器，我想你听说过梦魇所保护的极其强大的球体吧？ [di que 。 shuo dao wu qi ， wo xiang ni ting shuo guo meng yan suo bao hu de ji qi qiang da de qiu ti ba ？]

english: Yes I have. In fact, I've managed to beat the Nightmare myself.
translation: 是的，我有。事实上，我自己已经成功地战胜了梦魇。 [shi de ， wo you 。 shi shi shang ， wo zi ji yi jing cheng gong di zhan sheng le meng yan 。]

english: Anyway, as you've heard of the orbs I assume you've also heard of the even stronger Bashyhammer of Ashihama?
translation: 不管怎样，既然你听说过球体，我想你也听说过更强大的芦滨的 Bashyhammer 吧？ [bu guan zen yang ， ji ran ni ting shuo guo qiu ti ， wo xiang ni ye ting shuo guo geng qiang da de lu bin de  Bashyhammer  ba ？]

english: The what?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: The Smashyhammer of Ashihama.
translation: 芦滨的碎锤。 [lu bin de sui chui 。]

english: But you just said...
translation: 但你刚才说... [dan ni gang cai shuo ...]

english: ...Trashyhammer of Ashihama. Yes, I know what I said.
translation: ...芦滨的垃圾之锤。是的，我知道我说了什么。 [... lu bin de la ji zhi chui 。 shi de ， wo zhi dao wo shuo le shen me 。]

english: Wha-
translation: 世界卫生大会- [shi jie wei sheng da hui -]

english: Slashyhammer?
translation: 斩锤？ [zhan chui ？]

english: That doesn't even make sense.
translation: 这甚至没有意义。 [zhe shen zhi mei you yi yi 。]

english: Dashyhammer? Mashyhammer?
translation: 冲锤？粉碎锤？ [chong chui ？ fen sui chui ？]

english: Flashyhammer?
translation: 闪光之锤？ [shan guang zhi chui ？]

english: Too far. I'm done.
translation: 太远了。我受够了。 [tai yuan le 。 wo shou gou le 。]

english: What's with the mask?
translation: 面具怎么了？ [mian ju zen me le ？]

english: These are the masks of the Sisterhood. While symbolic, they also have practical uses.
translation: 这些是姐妹会的面具。虽然具有象征意义，但它们也有实际用途。 [zhe xie shi jie mei hui de mian ju 。 sui ran ju you xiang zheng yi yi ， dan ta men ye you shi ji yong tu 。]

english: Oh really? What like?
translation: 哦真的吗？喜欢什么？ [o zhen de ma ？ xi huan shen me ？]

english: Herbs can be stored within the beak, masking the smell of death and preventing us from becoming infected.
translation: 草药可以储存在喙中，掩盖死亡的气味并防止我们被感染。 [cao yao ke yi chu cun zai hui zhong ， yan gai si wang de qi wei bing fang zhi wo men bei gan ran 。]

english: That sounds handy. Can I have one?
translation: 听起来很方便。我可以拥有一个吗？ [ting qi lai hen fang bian 。 wo ke yi yong you yi ge ma ？]

english: You ask too many questions.
translation: 你问的问题太多了。 [ni wen de wen ti tai duo le 。]

english: Is that a yes?
translation: 这是肯定的吗？ [zhe shi ken ding de ma ？]

english: It's a no. To wear a mask of the Sisterhood, you need to join the Sisterhood.
translation: 这是一个不。要戴上姐妹会的面具，您需要加入姐妹会。 [zhe shi yi ge bu 。 yao dai shang jie mei hui de mian ju ， nin xu yao jia ru jie mei hui 。]

english: What is the Sisterhood?
translation: 什么是姐妹情谊？ [shen me shi jie mei qing yi ？]

english: An ancient order, born right here in Slepe.
translation: 一个古老的组织，诞生于斯莱佩。 [yi ge gu lao de zu zhi ， dan sheng yu si lai pei 。]

english: Well sign me up!
translation: 那就给我报名吧！ [na jiu gei wo bao ming ba ！]

english: You lack the qualities we're currently looking for. Perhaps another time.
translation: 您缺乏我们目前正在寻找的品质。也许下次吧。 [nin que fa wo men mu qian zheng zai xun zhao de pin zhi 。 ye xu xia ci ba 。]

english: Tell me more about the Sisterhood.
translation: 告诉我更多关于姐妹会的事。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu jie mei hui de shi 。]

english: Many years ago, the Sisterhood were a group of healers dedicated to Saradomin.
translation: 许多年前，姐妹会是一群致力于萨拉多明的治疗师。 [xu duo nian qian ， jie mei hui shi yi qun zhi li yu sa la duo ming de zhi liao shi 。]

english: However, our leader, a justiciar known as Phosani, saw the truth in Saradomin's teachings and turned away from his false light.
translation: 然而，我们的领袖，一位名叫福萨尼的法官，看到了萨拉多明教义的真理，并远离了他的错误观点。 [ran er ， wo men de ling xiu ， yi wei ming jiao fu sa ni de fa guan ， kan dao le sa la duo ming jiao yi de zhen li ， bing yuan li le ta de cuo wu guan dian 。]

english: Phosani embraced the glory of Zamorak and most of our order did the same. After that, she became known as the Inquisitor, though our order refers to her as 'Mother'.
translation: 福萨尼拥护萨莫拉克的荣耀，我们的大多数骑士团也这么做了。此后，她被称为审判官，尽管我们的命令称她为“母亲”。 [fu sa ni yong hu sa mo la ke de rong yao ， wo men de da duo shu qi shi tuan ye zhe me zuo le 。 ci hou ， ta bei cheng wei shen pan guan ， jin guan wo men de ming ling cheng ta wei “ mu qin ”。]

english: After the order reached enlightenment through Zamorak, we made our home in an abandoned hermitage. Over time, that hermitage grew into the town you see today.
translation: 修会通过萨莫拉克获得启蒙后，我们在一座废弃的隐修院安了家。随着时间的推移，这座修道院逐渐发展成为您今天看到的城镇。 [xiu hui tong guo sa mo la ke huo de qi meng hou ， wo men zai yi zuo fei qi de yin xiu yuan an le jia 。 sui zhe shi jian de tui yi ， zhe zuo xiu dao yuan zhu jian fa zhan cheng wei nin jin tian kan dao de cheng zhen 。]

english: What happened to those that refused to turn away from Saradomin?
translation: 那些拒绝离开萨拉多明的人后来怎么样了？ [na xie ju jue li kai sa la duo ming de ren hou lai zen me yang le ？]

english: They were shown the error of their ways through fire and blood.
translation: 他们通过火与血向他们展示了自己的错误。 [ta men tong guo huo yu xue xiang ta men zhan shi le zi ji de cuo wu 。]

english: How wonderful.
translation: 多么美妙啊。 [duo me mei miao a 。]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Be safe, traveller.
translation: 请注意安全，旅行者。 [qing zhu yi an quan ， lv xing zhe 。]

english: What's with all these Oathbreakers?
translation: 这些背誓者到底是怎么回事？ [zhe xie bei shi zhe dao di shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: What's with the mask?
translation: 面具怎么了？ [mian ju zen me le ？]

english: Tell me more about the Sisterhood.
translation: 告诉我更多关于姐妹会的事。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu jie mei hui de shi 。]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Greetings, traveller.
translation: 你好，旅行者。 [ni hao ， lv xing zhe 。]

english: What are you doing?
translation: 你在干什么？ [ni zai gan shen me ？]

english: Exploring. Isn't it exciting?
translation: 探索。是不是很兴奋呢？ [tan suo 。 shi bu shi hen xing fen ne ？]

english: Isn't it just! Found anything interesting?
translation: 不就是吗！发现什么有趣的事情了吗？ [bu jiu shi ma ！ fa xian shen me you qu de shi qing le ma ？]

english: This sanctuary has been sealed for centuries and it's full to the brim with history of my sect... Everything is interesting!
translation: 这圣域已经封印了数百年，里面充满了我宗门的历史……一切都很有趣！ [zhe sheng yu yi jing feng yin le shu bai nian ， li mian chong man le wo zong men de li shi …… yi qie dou hen you qu ！]

english: How do you even know where to begin?
translation: 你怎么知道从哪里开始呢？ [ni zen me zhi dao cong na li kai shi ne ？]

english: I... Don't. It might explain the aimless wandering.
translation: 我……不。这或许可以解释漫无目的的徘徊。 [wo …… bu 。 zhe huo xu ke yi jie shi man wu mu di de pai huai 。]

english: Huh, I've always wondered why so many people do that.
translation: 呵呵，我一直想知道为什么这么多人这么做。 [he he ， wo yi zhi xiang zhi dao wei shen me zhe me duo ren zhe me zuo 。]

english: What's with the mask?
translation: 面具怎么了？ [mian ju zen me le ？]

english: These are the masks of the Sisterhood. While symbolic, they also have practical uses.
translation: 这些是姐妹会的面具。虽然具有象征意义，但它们也有实际用途。 [zhe xie shi jie mei hui de mian ju 。 sui ran ju you xiang zheng yi yi ， dan ta men ye you shi ji yong tu 。]

english: Oh really? What like?
translation: 哦真的吗？喜欢什么？ [o zhen de ma ？ xi huan shen me ？]

english: Herbs can be stored within the beak, masking the smell of death and preventing us from becoming infected.
translation: 草药可以储存在喙中，掩盖死亡的气味并防止我们被感染。 [cao yao ke yi chu cun zai hui zhong ， yan gai si wang de qi wei bing fang zhi wo men bei gan ran 。]

english: That sounds handy. Can I have one?
translation: 听起来很方便。我可以拥有一个吗？ [ting qi lai hen fang bian 。 wo ke yi yong you yi ge ma ？]

english: You ask too many questions.
translation: 你问的问题太多了。 [ni wen de wen ti tai duo le 。]

english: Is that a yes?
translation: 这是肯定的吗？ [zhe shi ken ding de ma ？]

english: It's a no. To wear a mask of the Sisterhood, you need to join the Sisterhood.
translation: 这是一个不。要戴上姐妹会的面具，您需要加入姐妹会。 [zhe shi yi ge bu 。 yao dai shang jie mei hui de mian ju ， nin xu yao jia ru jie mei hui 。]

english: What is the Sisterhood?
translation: 什么是姐妹情谊？ [shen me shi jie mei qing yi ？]

english: An ancient order, born right here in Slepe.
translation: 一个古老的组织，诞生于斯莱佩。 [yi ge gu lao de zu zhi ， dan sheng yu si lai pei 。]

english: Well sign me up!
translation: 那就给我报名吧！ [na jiu gei wo bao ming ba ！]

english: You lack the qualities we're currently looking for. Perhaps another time.
translation: 您缺乏我们目前正在寻找的品质。也许下次吧。 [nin que fa wo men mu qian zheng zai xun zhao de pin zhi 。 ye xu xia ci ba 。]

english: Tell me more about the Sisterhood.
translation: 告诉我更多关于姐妹会的事。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu jie mei hui de shi 。]

english: Many years ago, the Sisterhood were a group of healers dedicated to Saradomin.
translation: 许多年前，姐妹会是一群致力于萨拉多明的治疗师。 [xu duo nian qian ， jie mei hui shi yi qun zhi li yu sa la duo ming de zhi liao shi 。]

english: However, our leader, a justiciar known as Phosani, saw the truth in Saradomin's teachings and turned away from his false light.
translation: 然而，我们的领袖，一位名叫福萨尼的法官，看到了萨拉多明教义的真理，并远离了他的错误观点。 [ran er ， wo men de ling xiu ， yi wei ming jiao fu sa ni de fa guan ， kan dao le sa la duo ming jiao yi de zhen li ， bing yuan li le ta de cuo wu guan dian 。]

english: Phosani embraced the glory of Zamorak and most of our order did the same. After that, she became known as the Inquisitor, though our order refers to her as 'Mother'.
translation: 福萨尼拥护萨莫拉克的荣耀，我们的大多数骑士团也这么做了。此后，她被称为审判官，尽管我们的命令称她为“母亲”。 [fu sa ni yong hu sa mo la ke de rong yao ， wo men de da duo shu qi shi tuan ye zhe me zuo le 。 ci hou ， ta bei cheng wei shen pan guan ， jin guan wo men de ming ling cheng ta wei “ mu qin ”。]

english: After the order reached enlightenment through Zamorak, we made our home in an abandoned hermitage. Over time, that hermitage grew into the town you see today.
translation: 修会通过萨莫拉克获得启蒙后，我们在一座废弃的隐修院安了家。随着时间的推移，这座修道院逐渐发展成为您今天看到的城镇。 [xiu hui tong guo sa mo la ke huo de qi meng hou ， wo men zai yi zuo fei qi de yin xiu yuan an le jia 。 sui zhe shi jian de tui yi ， zhe zuo xiu dao yuan zhu jian fa zhan cheng wei nin jin tian kan dao de cheng zhen 。]

english: What happened to those that refused to turn away from Saradomin?
translation: 那些拒绝离开萨拉多明的人后来怎么样了？ [na xie ju jue li kai sa la duo ming de ren hou lai zen me yang le ？]

english: They were shown the error of their ways through fire and blood.
translation: 他们通过火与血向他们展示了自己的错误。 [ta men tong guo huo yu xue xiang ta men zhan shi le zi ji de cuo wu 。]

english: How wonderful.
translation: 多么美妙啊。 [duo me mei miao a 。]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Be safe, traveller.
translation: 请注意安全，旅行者。 [qing zhu yi an quan ， lv xing zhe 。]

english: Welcome to my little chapel. Can I help you?
translation: 欢迎来到我的小教堂。我可以帮你吗？ [huan ying lai dao wo de xiao jiao tang 。 wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？ [ni wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: I built this chapel here so that fighters could come and pray before battle. A fighter who ignores their spiritual needs may as well have stabbed themselves in the foot.
translation: 我在这里建造了这座教堂，以便战士们可以在战斗前前来祈祷。一个无视自己精神需求的战士无异于搬起石头砸自己的脚。 [wo zai zhe li jian zao le zhe zuo jiao tang ， yi bian zhan shi men ke yi zai zhan dou qian qian lai qi dao 。 yi ge wu shi zi ji jing shen xu qiu de zhan shi wu yi yu ban qi shi tou za zi ji de jiao 。]

english: People keep claiming they're not interested in religion, but as soon as they're under attack they're yelling for 'Protect from Melee'. Sad, really.
translation: 人们一直声称他们对宗教不感兴趣，但一旦受到攻击，他们就会大喊“保护免受混战”。悲伤，真的。 [ren men yi zhi sheng cheng ta men dui zong jiao bu gan xing qu ， dan yi dan shou dao gong ji ， ta men jiu hui da han “ bao hu mian shou hun zhan ”。 bei shang ， zhen de 。]

english: So is there something I can do for you?
translation: 那么我能为您做些什么吗？ [na me wo neng wei nin zuo xie shen me ma ？]

english: So whose sister are you?
translation: 那么你是谁的妹妹呢？ [na me ni shi shei de mei mei ne ？]

english: Ahahahahahaha, very funny! With jokes like that, you should become a banker.
translation: 啊哈哈哈哈哈哈，非常搞笑！开这样的玩笑，你应该成为一名银行家。 [a ha ha ha ha ha ha ， fei chang gao xiao ！ kai zhe yang de wan xiao ， ni ying gai cheng wei yi ming yin hang jia 。]

english: But no I am a sister to the broken and down trodden, I heard talk of this enclave being built and knew that my skills could be put to good use.
translation: 但不，我是破碎和被践踏者的姐妹，我听到有关建造这个飞地的谈论，并且知道我的技能可以得到很好的利用。 [dan bu ， wo shi po sui he bei jian ta zhe de jie mei ， wo ting dao you guan jian zao zhe ge fei di de tan lun ， bing qie zhi dao wo de ji neng ke yi de dao hen hao de li yong 。]

english: I've found a worthy cause here running my little chapel, so I'm happy enough. Now, can I help you with something?
translation: 我在这里找到了一个有价值的事业来经营我的小教堂，所以我很高兴。现在，我可以帮你做点什么吗？ [wo zai zhe li zhao dao le yi ge you jia zhi de shi ye lai jing ying wo de xiao jiao tang ， suo yi wo hen gao xing 。 xian zai ， wo ke yi bang ni zuo dian shen me ma ？]

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Actually, that's a bit of a sore point. Asgarnia has a building full of monks, all living happily as a community of brothers, but they don't let women join.
translation: 事实上，这是一个有点痛处。阿斯加尼亚有一栋挤满了僧侣的建筑，他们作为兄弟团体幸福地生活着，但他们不允许女性加入。 [shi shi shang ， zhe shi yi ge you dian tong chu 。 a si jia ni ya you yi dong ji man le seng lv de jian zhu ， ta men zuo wei xiong di tuan ti xing fu di sheng huo zhe ， dan ta men bu yun xu nv xing jia ru 。]

english: I'd heard rumours that there was an Abbey up here somewhere, which sounded marvellous, but I seem to be in the wrong place.
translation: 我听说这里某处有一座修道院，这听起来很棒，但我似乎来错地方了。 [wo ting shuo zhe li mou chu you yi zuo xiu dao yuan ， zhe ting qi lai hen bang ， dan wo si hu lai cuo di fang le 。]

english: Anyway, I've found a worthy cause here, running my little chapel, so I'm happy enough. Now, can I help you with something?
translation: 不管怎样，我在这里找到了一个有价值的事业，经营我的小教堂，所以我很高兴。现在，我可以帮你做点什么吗？ [bu guan zen yang ， wo zai zhe li zhao dao le yi ge you jia zhi de shi ye ， jing ying wo de xiao jiao tang ， suo yi wo hen gao xing 。 xian zai ， wo ke yi bang ni zuo dian shen me ma ？]

translation: 你为什么在这里？ [ni wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: So whose sister are you?
translation: 那么你是谁的妹妹呢？ [na me ni shi shei de mei mei ne ？]

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Greetings, traveller.
translation: 你好，旅行者。 [ni hao ， lv xing zhe 。]

english: Tell me about the Nightmare.
translation: 告诉我关于梦魇的事情。 [gao su wo guan yu meng yan de shi qing 。]

english: You're better off speaking with the Siren, that is her area of expertise. All I know is that the beast poses a huge risk to Mother.
translation: 你最好与海妖交谈，这是她的专业领域。我只知道这只野兽给母亲带来了巨大的危险。 [ni zui hao yu hai yao jiao tan ， zhe shi ta de zhuan ye ling yu 。 wo zhi zhi dao zhe zhi ye shou gei mu qin dai lai le ju da de wei xian 。]

english: At least for the moment, Mother is not in any direct danger. I fear it is only a matter of time before the beast enters her mind again though.
translation: 至少目前来说，母亲并没有面临任何直接的危险。我担心这只野兽再次进入她的脑海只是时间问题。 [zhi shao mu qian lai shuo ， mu qin bing mei you mian lin ren he zhi jie de wei xian 。 wo dan xin zhe zhi ye shou zai ci jin ru ta de nao hai zhi shi shi jian wen ti 。]

english: What's with the mask?
translation: 面具怎么了？ [mian ju zen me le ？]

english: These are the masks of the Sisterhood. While symbolic, they also have practical uses.
translation: 这些是姐妹会的面具。虽然具有象征意义，但它们也有实际用途。 [zhe xie shi jie mei hui de mian ju 。 sui ran ju you xiang zheng yi yi ， dan ta men ye you shi ji yong tu 。]

english: That sounds handy. Can I have one?
translation: 听起来很方便。我可以拥有一个吗？ [ting qi lai hen fang bian 。 wo ke yi yong you yi ge ma ？]

english: No. To wear a mask of the Sisterhood, you need to join the Sisterhood.
translation: 不可以。要戴上姐妹会的面具，您需要加入姐妹会。 [bu ke yi 。 yao dai shang jie mei hui de mian ju ， nin xu yao jia ru jie mei hui 。]

english: Well sign me up!
translation: 那就给我报名吧！ [na jiu gei wo bao ming ba ！]

english: I'm afraid you lack the qualities we're currently looking for. Perhaps another time.
translation: 恐怕你缺乏我们目前正在寻找的品质。也许下次吧。 [kong pa ni que fa wo men mu qian zheng zai xun zhao de pin zhi 。 ye xu xia ci ba 。]

english: Do you have any of my items?
translation: 你有我的物品吗？ [ni you wo de wu pin ma ？]

english: Sorry, but I don't have anything for you. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: 抱歉，我没有什么可以给你的。如果我确实拥有你的任何物品，但你在收集它们之前就死了，那么它们现在就会丢失。 [bao qian ， wo mei you shen me ke yi gei ni de 。 ru guo wo que shi yong you ni de ren he wu pin ， dan ni zai shou ji ta men zhi qian jiu si le ， na me ta men xian zai jiu hui diu shi 。]

english: I do, traveller. You should be more cautious with them.
translation: 我愿意，旅行者。你应该对他们更加谨慎。 [wo yuan yi ， lv xing zhe 。 ni ying gai dui ta men geng jia jin shen 。]

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: Be safe, traveller.
translation: 请注意安全，旅行者。 [qing zhu yi an quan ， lv xing zhe 。]

english: I would advise against doing that, traveller. You do not yet know what you are up against.
translation: 我建议不要这样做，旅行者。你还不知道自己面对的是什么。 [wo jian yi bu yao zhe yang zuo ， lv xing zhe 。 ni hai bu zhi dao zi ji mian dui de shi shen me 。]

english: What are you doing up here?
translation: 你在这儿做什么？ [ni zai zhe er zuo shen me ？]

english: Keeping an eye on Mother.
translation: 一直注视着妈妈。 [yi zhi zhu shi zhe ma ma 。]

english: Mother?
translation: 母亲？ [mu qin ？]

english: Phosani, the founder of our sect and creator of this sanctuary. She is our mother, and always will be.
translation: 福萨尼，我们教派的创始人，也是这个圣地的创建者。她是我们的母亲，而且永远都是。 [fu sa ni ， wo men jiao pai de chuang shi ren ， ye shi zhe ge sheng di de chuang jian zhe 。 ta shi wo men de mu qin ， er qie yong yuan dou shi 。]

english: I see... So where is she?
translation: 我明白了……那她在哪儿？ [wo ming bai le …… na ta zai na er ？]

english: She lies in this coffin.
translation: 她就躺在这口棺材里。 [ta jiu tang zai zhe kou guan cai li 。]

english: Oh... So she's dead?
translation: 哦……所以她死了？ [o …… suo yi ta si le ？]

english: Dead? No. She sleeps the everlasting slumber.
translation: 死的？不，她睡着了，永远的睡眠。 [si de ？ bu ， ta shui zhao le ， yong yuan de shui mian 。]

english: Right. The coffin looks pretty secure to me. Why do you need to keep an eye on her.
translation: 正确的。棺材对我来说看起来很安全。为什么你需要关注她。 [zheng que de 。 guan cai dui wo lai shuo kan qi lai hen an quan 。 wei shen me ni xu yao guan zhu ta 。]

english: The creature down there, the one that Siren calls the Nightmare. It has been invading Mother's mind, feeding on her.
translation: 那里的生物，被海妖称为梦魇的生物。它已经侵入了母亲的思想，以她为食。 [na li de sheng wu ， bei hai yao cheng wei meng yan de sheng wu 。 ta yi jing qin ru le mu qin de si xiang ， yi ta wei shi 。]

english: Mother is strong, but not strong enough to fight it off alone. She needs help.
translation: 母亲虽然坚强，但还不足以独自对抗。她需要帮助。 [mu qin sui ran jian qiang ， dan hai bu zu yi du zi dui kang 。 ta xu yao bang zhu 。]

english: Needs help does she? Maybe I could be of assistance?
translation: 她需要帮助吗？也许我可以帮忙？ [ta xu yao bang zhu ma ？ ye xu wo ke yi bang mang ？]

english: The offer is appreciated. Luckily for us though, the Nightmare is not present in Mother's mind at the moment.
translation: 非常感谢您提供的报价。不过，幸运的是，目前母亲的脑海中还没有出现噩梦。 [fei chang gan xie nin ti gong de bao jia 。 bu guo ， xing yun de shi ， mu qian mu qin de nao hai zhong hai mei you chu xian e meng 。]

english: Fair enough. If that changes, I'm more than willing to help.
translation: 很公平。如果情况发生变化，我非常愿意提供帮助。 [hen gong ping 。 ru guo qing kuang fa sheng bian hua ， wo fei chang yuan yi ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: The offer is appreciated. I fear you do not have the abilities to take on that sort of challenge though.
translation: 非常感谢您提供的报价。但我担心你没有能力接受这种挑战。 [fei chang gan xie nin ti gong de bao jia 。 dan wo dan xin ni mei you neng li jie shou zhe zhong tiao zhan 。]

english: What abilities do I need?
translation: 我需要什么能力？ [wo xu yao shen me neng li ？]

english: The horror that has manifested itself in Mother's mind is far stronger than the one fought in the Nightmare's dream.
translation: 母亲脑海中显现出来的恐怖，远比梦魇梦境中的恐怖要强烈。 [mu qin nao hai zhong xian xian chu lai de kong bu ， yuan bi meng yan meng jing zhong de kong bu yao qiang lie 。]

english: If you hope to have a chance, you'll want to take on the weaker form first. That Siren down there can help you.
translation: 如果你希望有机会，你会想先采取较弱的形式。那里的警报器可以帮助你。 [ru guo ni xi wang you ji hui ， ni hui xiang xian cai qu jiao ruo de xing shi 。 na li de jing bao qi ke yi bang zhu ni 。]

english: Fair enough. I'll be back once I have more experience.
translation: 很公平。一旦我有了更多经验，我就会回来。 [hen gong ping 。 yi dan wo you le geng duo jing yan ， wo jiu hui hui lai 。]

english: That would be appreciated, traveller. You can use the pool here to enter Mother's mind and take on the Nightmare within.
translation: 旅行者，我们将不胜感激。你可以使用这里的水池进入母亲的思想并对抗其中的噩梦。 [lv xing zhe ， wo men jiang bu sheng gan ji 。 ni ke yi shi yong zhe li de shui chi jin ru mu qin de si xiang bing dui kang qi zhong de e meng 。]

english: Be warned though. If you enter, you enter alone. No one else can help you with this one.
translation: 但请注意。如果你进去，你就一个人进去。没有其他人可以帮助您解决这一问题。 [dan qing zhu yi 。 ru guo ni jin qu ， ni jiu yi ge ren jin qu 。 mei you qi ta ren ke yi bang zhu nin jie jue zhe yi wen ti 。]

english: I see. I'll have to be careful then.
translation: 我懂了。那我就得小心了。 [wo dong le 。 na wo jiu de xiao xin le 。]

english: Indeed. Good luck, traveller.
translation: 的确。祝你好运，旅行者。 [di que 。 zhu ni hao yun ， lv xing zhe 。]

english: Tell me about the Nightmare.
translation: 告诉我关于梦魇的事情。 [gao su wo guan yu meng yan de shi qing 。]

english: What's with the mask?
translation: 面具怎么了？ [mian ju zen me le ？]

english: Do you have any of my items?
translation: 你有我的物品吗？ [ni you wo de wu pin ma ？]

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Greetings, traveller.
translation: 你好，旅行者。 [ni hao ， lv xing zhe 。]

english: What's with the mask?
translation: 面具怎么了？ [mian ju zen me le ？]

english: These are the masks of the Sisterhood. While symbolic, they also have practical uses.
translation: 这些是姐妹会的面具。虽然具有象征意义，但它们也有实际用途。 [zhe xie shi jie mei hui de mian ju 。 sui ran ju you xiang zheng yi yi ， dan ta men ye you shi ji yong tu 。]

english: Oh really? What like?
translation: 哦真的吗？喜欢什么？ [o zhen de ma ？ xi huan shen me ？]

english: Herbs can be stored within the beak, masking the smell of death and preventing us from becoming infected.
translation: 草药可以储存在喙中，掩盖死亡的气味并防止我们被感染。 [cao yao ke yi chu cun zai hui zhong ， yan gai si wang de qi wei bing fang zhi wo men bei gan ran 。]

english: That sounds handy. Can I have one?
translation: 听起来很方便。我可以拥有一个吗？ [ting qi lai hen fang bian 。 wo ke yi yong you yi ge ma ？]

english: You ask too many questions.
translation: 你问的问题太多了。 [ni wen de wen ti tai duo le 。]

english: Is that a yes?
translation: 这是肯定的吗？ [zhe shi ken ding de ma ？]

english: It's a no. To wear a mask of the Sisterhood, you need to join the Sisterhood.
translation: 这是一个不。要戴上姐妹会的面具，您需要加入姐妹会。 [zhe shi yi ge bu 。 yao dai shang jie mei hui de mian ju ， nin xu yao jia ru jie mei hui 。]

english: What is the Sisterhood?
translation: 什么是姐妹情谊？ [shen me shi jie mei qing yi ？]

english: An ancient order, born right here in Slepe.
translation: 一个古老的组织，诞生于斯莱佩。 [yi ge gu lao de zu zhi ， dan sheng yu si lai pei 。]

english: Well sign me up!
translation: 那就给我报名吧！ [na jiu gei wo bao ming ba ！]

english: You lack the qualities we're currently looking for. Perhaps another time.
translation: 您缺乏我们目前正在寻找的品质。也许下次吧。 [nin que fa wo men mu qian zheng zai xun zhao de pin zhi 。 ye xu xia ci ba 。]

english: Tell me more about the Sisterhood.
translation: 告诉我更多关于姐妹会的事。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu jie mei hui de shi 。]

english: Many years ago, the Sisterhood were a group of healers dedicated to Saradomin.
translation: 许多年前，姐妹会是一群致力于萨拉多明的治疗师。 [xu duo nian qian ， jie mei hui shi yi qun zhi li yu sa la duo ming de zhi liao shi 。]

english: However, our leader, a justiciar known as Phosani, saw the truth in Saradomin's teachings and turned away from his false light.
translation: 然而，我们的领袖，一位名叫福萨尼的法官，看到了萨拉多明教义的真理，并远离了他的错误观点。 [ran er ， wo men de ling xiu ， yi wei ming jiao fu sa ni de fa guan ， kan dao le sa la duo ming jiao yi de zhen li ， bing yuan li le ta de cuo wu guan dian 。]

english: Phosani embraced the glory of Zamorak and most of our order did the same. After that, she became known as the Inquisitor, though our order refers to her as 'Mother'.
translation: 福萨尼拥护萨莫拉克的荣耀，我们的大多数骑士团也这么做了。此后，她被称为审判官，尽管我们的命令称她为“母亲”。 [fu sa ni yong hu sa mo la ke de rong yao ， wo men de da duo shu qi shi tuan ye zhe me zuo le 。 ci hou ， ta bei cheng wei shen pan guan ， jin guan wo men de ming ling cheng ta wei “ mu qin ”。]

english: After the order reached enlightenment through Zamorak, we made our home in an abandoned hermitage. Over time, that hermitage grew into the town you see today.
translation: 修会通过萨莫拉克获得启蒙后，我们在一座废弃的隐修院安了家。随着时间的推移，这座修道院逐渐发展成为您今天看到的城镇。 [xiu hui tong guo sa mo la ke huo de qi meng hou ， wo men zai yi zuo fei qi de yin xiu yuan an le jia 。 sui zhe shi jian de tui yi ， zhe zuo xiu dao yuan zhu jian fa zhan cheng wei nin jin tian kan dao de cheng zhen 。]

english: What happened to those that refused to turn away from Saradomin?
translation: 那些拒绝离开萨拉多明的人后来怎么样了？ [na xie ju jue li kai sa la duo ming de ren hou lai zen me yang le ？]

english: They were shown the error of their ways through fire and blood.
translation: 他们通过火与血向他们展示了自己的错误。 [ta men tong guo huo yu xue xiang ta men zhan shi le zi ji de cuo wu 。]

english: How wonderful.
translation: 多么美妙啊。 [duo me mei miao a 。]

english: What's wrong with that old man?
translation: 那个老头怎么了？ [na ge lao tou zen me le ？]

english: He's not looking great, is he? We fear he is a victim of the Sleeper Plague.
translation: 他看起来不太好，是吗？我们担心他是沉睡者瘟疫的受害者。 [ta kan qi lai bu tai hao ， shi ma ？ wo men dan xin ta shi chen shui zhe wen yi de shou hai zhe 。]

english: Sleeper Plague?
translation: 沉睡者瘟疫？ [chen shui zhe wen yi ？]

english: Many years ago, this village was beset by a terrible plague. Those infected fell into a deep sleep, never to wake. Now we fear the plague has returned.
translation: 许多年前，这个村庄遭受了一场可怕的瘟疫的袭击。感染者陷入沉睡，再也没有醒来。现在我们担心瘟疫卷土重来。 [xu duo nian qian ， zhe ge cun zhuang zao shou le yi chang ke pa de wen yi de xi ji 。 gan ran zhe xian ru chen shui ， zai ye mei you xing lai 。 xian zai wo men dan xin wen yi juan tu chong lai 。]

english: Do you any theories on why it's come back?
translation: 你有关于它为什么回来的任何理论吗？ [ni you guan yu ta wei shen me hui lai de ren he li lun ma ？]

english: Well, there's the strange man being accused out in the centre, but personally I think he's innocent.
translation: 好吧，中间有一个奇怪的人被指控，但我个人认为他是无辜的。 [hao ba ， zhong jian you yi ge qi guai de ren bei zhi kong ， dan wo ge ren ren wei ta shi wu gu de 。]

english: Hmm, so how long has the old man been asleep?
translation: 嗯，那老头睡了多久了？ [n ， na lao tou shui le duo jiu le ？]

english: Oh, I can't recall exactly, but at least a few weeks. He has spoken a few times though, in his sleep.
translation: 哦，我记不太清了，但至少几周了。不过，他在睡梦中说过几次话。 [o ， wo ji bu tai qing le ， dan zhi shao ji zhou le 。 bu guo ， ta zai shui meng zhong shuo guo ji ci hua 。]

english: What did he say?
translation: 他说什么？ [ta shuo shen me ？]

english: It was nonsense, but I recall the words 'Inyetat' and 'Coshmar', whatever those means.
translation: 这是无稽之谈，但我记得“Inyetat”和“Coshmar”这两个词，不管它们是什么意思。 [zhe shi wu ji zhi tan ， dan wo ji de “Inyetat” he “Coshmar” zhe liang ge ci ， bu guan ta men shi shen me yi si 。]

english: How peculiar.
translation: 多么奇特啊。 [duo me qi te a 。]

english: How are things with the Sleeper Plague?
translation: 沉睡者瘟疫的情况怎么样？ [chen shui zhe wen yi de qing kuang zen me yang ？]

english: The one responsible was found out and executed. We haven't had any new cases since.
translation: 责任人已被发现并被处决。从那以后我们就没有再出现任何新病例。 [ze ren ren yi bei fa xian bing bei chu jue 。 cong na yi hou wo men jiu mei you zai chu xian ren he xin bing li 。]

english: I see... And what of those still ill?
translation: 我明白了……那些还病着的人怎么办？ [wo ming bai le …… na xie hai bing zhe de ren zen me ban ？]

english: Well now that the cause has been dealt with, we can focus more heavily on a cure.
translation: 既然已经解决了原因，我们就可以更加关注治疗方法。 [ji ran yi jing jie jue le yuan yin ， wo men jiu ke yi geng jia guan zhu zhi liao fang fa 。]

english: And how long will that take?
translation: 这需要多长时间？ [zhe xu yao duo zhang shi jian ？]

english: Well that depends...
translation: 嗯，这取决于... [n ， zhe qu jue yu ...]

english: On what?
translation: 靠什么？ [kao shen me ？]

english: On how things progress... down below.
translation: 关于事情的进展......在下面。 [guan yu shi qing de jin zhan ...... zai xia mian 。]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

translation: 请注意安全，旅行者。 [qing zhu yi an quan ， lv xing zhe 。]

translation: 多么美妙啊。 [duo me mei miao a 。]

english: What's wrong with that woman?
translation: 那个女人怎么了？ [na ge nv ren zen me le ？]

english: Oh, she's Lord Crombwick's wife and the first victim of the Sleeper Plague.
translation: 哦，她是克罗姆威克勋爵的妻子，也是沉睡者瘟疫的第一个受害者。 [o ， ta shi ke luo mu wei ke xun jue de qi zi ， ye shi chen shui zhe wen yi de di yi ge shou hai zhe 。]

english: Lord Crombwick?
translation: 克罗姆威克勋爵？ [ke luo mu wei ke xun jue ？]

english: The ruler of this place. He lives in his manor, to the north.
translation: 这个地方的统治者。他住在他的庄园里，在北面。 [zhe ge di fang de tong zhi zhe 。 ta zhu zai ta de zhuang yuan li ， zai bei mian 。]

english: Where's the Lord? Surely he should be down here with his wife?
translation: 主在哪里？他应该和他的妻子一起在这里吗？ [zhu zai na li ？ ta ying gai he ta de qi zi yi qi zai zhe li ma ？]

english: Still in his manor. He hasn't left since she fell ill.
translation: 还在他的庄园里。自从她生病之后，他就没有离开过。 [hai zai ta de zhuang yuan li 。 zi cong ta sheng bing zhi hou ， ta jiu mei you li kai guo 。]

english: Why?
translation: 为什么？ [wei shen me ？]

english: No one knows. The place looks like a mess and some say they've seen vampyres lurking.
translation: 没有人知道。这个地方看起来一团糟，有人说他们看到吸血鬼潜伏着。 [mei you ren zhi dao 。 zhe ge di fang kan qi lai yi tuan zao ， you ren shuo ta men kan dao xi xue gui qian fu zhe 。]

english: How mysterious.
translation: 多么神秘啊。 [duo me shen mi a 。]

english: Indeed.
translation: 的确。 [di que 。]

english: How are things with the Sleeper Plague?
translation: 沉睡者瘟疫的情况怎么样？ [chen shui zhe wen yi de qing kuang zen me yang ？]

english: The one responsible was found out and executed. We haven't had any new cases since.
translation: 责任人已被发现并被处决。从那以后我们就没有再出现任何新病例。 [ze ren ren yi bei fa xian bing bei chu jue 。 cong na yi hou wo men jiu mei you zai chu xian ren he xin bing li 。]

english: I see... And what of those still ill?
translation: 我明白了……那些还病着的人怎么办？ [wo ming bai le …… na xie hai bing zhe de ren zen me ban ？]

english: Well now that the cause has been dealt with, we can focus more heavily on a cure.
translation: 既然已经解决了原因，我们就可以更加关注治疗方法。 [ji ran yi jing jie jue le yuan yin ， wo men jiu ke yi geng jia guan zhu zhi liao fang fa 。]

english: And how long will that take?
translation: 这需要多长时间？ [zhe xu yao duo zhang shi jian ？]

english: Well that depends...
translation: 嗯，这取决于... [n ， zhe qu jue yu ...]

english: On what?
translation: 靠什么？ [kao shen me ？]

english: On how things progress... down below.
translation: 关于事情的进展......在下面。 [guan yu shi qing de jin zhan ...... zai xia mian 。]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Be safe, traveller.
translation: 请注意安全，旅行者。 [qing zhu yi an quan ， lv xing zhe 。]

english: What's with the mask?
translation: 面具怎么了？ [mian ju zen me le ？]

english: Tell me more about the Sisterhood.
translation: 告诉我更多关于姐妹会的事。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu jie mei hui de shi 。]

english: What's wrong with that woman?
translation: 那个女人怎么了？ [na ge nv ren zen me le ？]

english: How are things with the Sleeper Plague?
translation: 沉睡者瘟疫的情况怎么样？ [chen shui zhe wen yi de qing kuang zen me yang ？]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Greetings, traveller.
translation: 你好，旅行者。 [ni hao ， lv xing zhe 。]

english: What's with the mask?
translation: 面具怎么了？ [mian ju zen me le ？]

english: These are the masks of the Sisterhood. While symbolic, they also have practical uses.
translation: 这些是姐妹会的面具。虽然具有象征意义，但它们也有实际用途。 [zhe xie shi jie mei hui de mian ju 。 sui ran ju you xiang zheng yi yi ， dan ta men ye you shi ji yong tu 。]

english: Oh really? What like?
translation: 哦真的吗？喜欢什么？ [o zhen de ma ？ xi huan shen me ？]

english: Herbs can be stored within the beak, masking the smell of death and preventing us from becoming infected.
translation: 草药可以储存在喙中，掩盖死亡的气味并防止我们被感染。 [cao yao ke yi chu cun zai hui zhong ， yan gai si wang de qi wei bing fang zhi wo men bei gan ran 。]

english: That sounds handy. Can I have one?
translation: 听起来很方便。我可以拥有一个吗？ [ting qi lai hen fang bian 。 wo ke yi yong you yi ge ma ？]

english: You ask too many questions.
translation: 你问的问题太多了。 [ni wen de wen ti tai duo le 。]

english: Is that a yes?
translation: 这是肯定的吗？ [zhe shi ken ding de ma ？]

english: It's a no. To wear a mask of the Sisterhood, you need to join the Sisterhood.
translation: 这是一个不。要戴上姐妹会的面具，您需要加入姐妹会。 [zhe shi yi ge bu 。 yao dai shang jie mei hui de mian ju ， nin xu yao jia ru jie mei hui 。]

english: What is the Sisterhood?
translation: 什么是姐妹情谊？ [shen me shi jie mei qing yi ？]

english: An ancient order, born right here in Slepe.
translation: 一个古老的组织，诞生于斯莱佩。 [yi ge gu lao de zu zhi ， dan sheng yu si lai pei 。]

english: Well sign me up!
translation: 那就给我报名吧！ [na jiu gei wo bao ming ba ！]

english: You lack the qualities we're currently looking for. Perhaps another time.
translation: 您缺乏我们目前正在寻找的品质。也许下次吧。 [nin que fa wo men mu qian zheng zai xun zhao de pin zhi 。 ye xu xia ci ba 。]

english: Tell me more about the Sisterhood.
translation: 告诉我更多关于姐妹会的事。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu jie mei hui de shi 。]

english: Many years ago, the Sisterhood were a group of healers dedicated to Saradomin.
translation: 许多年前，姐妹会是一群致力于萨拉多明的治疗师。 [xu duo nian qian ， jie mei hui shi yi qun zhi li yu sa la duo ming de zhi liao shi 。]

english: However, our leader, a justiciar known as Phosani, saw the truth in Saradomin's teachings and turned away from his false light.
translation: 然而，我们的领袖，一位名叫福萨尼的法官，看到了萨拉多明教义的真理，并远离了他的错误观点。 [ran er ， wo men de ling xiu ， yi wei ming jiao fu sa ni de fa guan ， kan dao le sa la duo ming jiao yi de zhen li ， bing yuan li le ta de cuo wu guan dian 。]

english: Phosani embraced the glory of Zamorak and most of our order did the same. After that, she became known as the Inquisitor, though our order refers to her as 'Mother'.
translation: 福萨尼拥护萨莫拉克的荣耀，我们的大多数骑士团也这么做了。此后，她被称为审判官，尽管我们的命令称她为“母亲”。 [fu sa ni yong hu sa mo la ke de rong yao ， wo men de da duo shu qi shi tuan ye zhe me zuo le 。 ci hou ， ta bei cheng wei shen pan guan ， jin guan wo men de ming ling cheng ta wei “ mu qin ”。]

english: After the order reached enlightenment through Zamorak, we made our home in an abandoned hermitage. Over time, that hermitage grew into the town you see today.
translation: 修会通过萨莫拉克获得启蒙后，我们在一座废弃的隐修院安了家。随着时间的推移，这座修道院逐渐发展成为您今天看到的城镇。 [xiu hui tong guo sa mo la ke huo de qi meng hou ， wo men zai yi zuo fei qi de yin xiu yuan an le jia 。 sui zhe shi jian de tui yi ， zhe zuo xiu dao yuan zhu jian fa zhan cheng wei nin jin tian kan dao de cheng zhen 。]

english: What happened to those that refused to turn away from Saradomin?
translation: 那些拒绝离开萨拉多明的人后来怎么样了？ [na xie ju jue li kai sa la duo ming de ren hou lai zen me yang le ？]

english: They were shown the error of their ways through fire and blood.
translation: 他们通过火与血向他们展示了自己的错误。 [ta men tong guo huo yu xue xiang ta men zhan shi le zi ji de cuo wu 。]

english: How wonderful.
translation: 多么美妙啊。 [duo me mei miao a 。]

english: What's going on here?
translation: 这是怎么回事？ [zhe shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: With this strange tattooed man? He is on trial.
translation: 和这个奇怪的纹身男人在一起？他正在受审。 [he zhe ge qi guai de wen shen nan ren zai yi qi ？ ta zheng zai shou shen 。]

english: For what crime?
translation: 因什么罪？ [yin shen me zui ？]

english: It is suspected he might have caused the return of the Sleeper Plague.
translation: 人们怀疑他可能导致了沉睡者瘟疫的卷土重来。 [ren men huai yi ta ke neng dao zhi le chen shui zhe wen yi de juan tu chong lai 。]

english: Sleeper Plague?
translation: 沉睡者瘟疫？ [chen shui zhe wen yi ？]

english: Yes. A long time ago, Slepe was beset by an illness called the Sleeper Plague. Those infected fell into a deep sleep, never to wake.
translation: 是的。很久以前，斯莱普被一种名为“沉睡者瘟疫”的疾病所困扰。感染者陷入沉睡，再也没有醒来。 [shi de 。 hen jiu yi qian ， si lai pu bei yi zhong ming wei “ chen shui zhe wen yi ” de ji bing suo kun rao 。 gan ran zhe xian ru chen shui ， zai ye mei you xing lai 。]

english: But now it's back?
translation: 但现在又回来了？ [dan xian zai you hui lai le ？]

english: It would appear so. This man showed up in town around the same time the first victim fell ill. We fear this is no coincidence.
translation: 看来是这样。大约在第一个受害者生病的同时，这名男子出现在镇上。我们担心这并非巧合。 [kan lai shi zhe yang 。 da yue zai di yi ge shou hai zhe sheng bing de tong shi ， zhe ming nan zi chu xian zai zhen shang 。 wo men dan xin zhe bing fei qiao he 。]

english: That doesn't make him guilty though.
translation: 但这并不能让他有罪。 [dan zhe bing bu neng rang ta you zui 。]

english: No. That is for the trial to determine.
translation: 不会。这要等审判才能确定。 [bu hui 。 zhe yao deng shen pan cai neng que ding 。]

english: What happened to the tattooed man?
translation: 纹身男怎么了？ [wen shen nan zen me le ？]

english: His trial has concluded. The citizens have passed their judgement.
translation: 对他的审判已经结束。公民已经做出了判断。 [dui ta de shen pan yi jing jie shu 。 gong min yi jing zuo chu le pan duan 。]

english: And?
translation: 和？ [he ？]

english: The accused was found guilty of causing the return of the Sleeper Plague. He has now been executed.
translation: 被告被判犯有导致沉睡者瘟疫卷土重来的罪名。他现已被处决。 [bei gao bei pan fan you dao zhi chen shui zhe wen yi juan tu chong lai de zui ming 。 ta xian yi bei chu jue 。]

english: Executed? That's pretty dark.
translation: 被处决？那是相当黑暗的。 [bei chu jue ？ na shi xiang dang hei an de 。]

english: Morytania is a dark place, traveller. If you wished for light, you should have picked a better holiday destination.
translation: 莫里塔尼亚是一个黑暗的地方，旅行者。如果你想要光明，你应该选择一个更好的度假胜地。 [mo li ta ni ya shi yi ge hei an de di fang ， lv xing zhe 。 ru guo ni xiang yao guang ming ， ni ying gai xuan ze yi ge geng hao de du jia sheng di 。]

english: So that's it?
translation: 就这样了吗？ [jiu zhe yang le ma ？]

english: Since the execution, we have had no new occurrences of the Sleeper Plague. So yes, that's it.
translation: 自处决以来，我们没有再发生新的沉睡者瘟疫。是的，就是这样。 [zi chu jue yi lai ， wo men mei you zai fa sheng xin de chen shui zhe wen yi 。 shi de ， jiu shi zhe yang 。]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Be safe, traveller.
translation: 请注意安全，旅行者。 [qing zhu yi an quan ， lv xing zhe 。]

english: What's with the mask?
translation: 面具怎么了？ [mian ju zen me le ？]

english: Tell me more about the Sisterhood.
translation: 告诉我更多关于姐妹会的事。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu jie mei hui de shi 。]

english: What's going on here?
translation: 这是怎么回事？ [zhe shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: What happened to the tattooed man?
translation: 纹身男怎么了？ [wen shen nan zen me le ？]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Hey! What do you think you're doing? Leave my tea alone!
translation: 嘿！你认为你在做什么？别管我的茶！ [hei ！ ni ren wei ni zai zuo shen me ？ bie guan wo de cha ！]

english: Hey! What do you think you're doing? Don't go casting that kind of spell anywhere near my tea!  Leave my tea alone you telegrabbing fiend!
translation: 嘿！你认为你在做什么？别在我的茶附近施展那种咒语！  别管我的茶，你这个抢电的恶魔！ [hei ！ ni ren wei ni zai zuo shen me ？ bie zai wo de cha fu jin shi zhan na zhong zhou yu ！   bie guan wo de cha ， ni zhe ge qiang dian de e mo ！]

english: Oh, so you're back then, come to gloat have you?
translation: 哦，原来你回来了，是来幸灾乐祸的吗？ [o ， yuan lai ni hui lai le ， shi lai xing zai le huo de ma ？]

english: Nope, I've just come to ask you a couple of questions.
translation: 不，我只是来问你几个问题。 [bu ， wo zhi shi lai wen ni ji ge wen ti 。]

english: How do I get rid of the undead ogres?
translation: 我该如何消灭不死食人魔？ [wo gai ru he xiao mie bu si shi ren mo ？]

english: Haven't I already explained this to you once before?
translation: 我不是已经跟你解释过一次了吗？ [wo bu shi yi jing gen ni jie shi guo yi ci le ma ？]

english: Humour me!
translation: 幽默我吧！ [you mo wo ba ！]

english: Ok, similar spells have been cast before and the only way to deal with the resulting creatures is to cordon off the area and not go in there again. The undead creatures usually manifest some sort of disease so it's
translation: 好吧，类似的法术之前已经施展过，处理由此产生的生物的唯一方法就是封锁该区域，不要再进去了。不死生物通常会表现出某种疾病，所以 [hao ba ， lei si de fa shu zhi qian yi jing shi zhan guo ， chu li you ci chan sheng de sheng wu de wei yi fang fa jiu shi feng suo gai qu yu ， bu yao zai jin qu le 。 bu si sheng wu tong chang hui biao xian chu mou zhong ji bing ， suo yi]

english: best to attack them from a distance with a ranged weapon.
translation: 最好用远程武器从远处攻击他们。 [zui hao yong yuan cheng wu qi cong yuan chu gong ji ta men 。]

english: Normal missiles like arrows and darts do very little damage to them because they're designed to destroy internal organs. This is a waste of time with undead creatures like undead ogres.
translation: 箭和飞镖等普通导弹对它们造成的伤害很小，因为它们是为了摧毁内脏而设计的。这对于不死食人魔这样的不死生物来说简直是浪费时间。 [jian he fei biao deng pu tong dao dan dui ta men zao cheng de shang hai hen xiao ， yin wei ta men shi wei le cui hui nei zang er she ji de 。 zhe dui yu bu si shi ren mo zhe yang de bu si sheng wu lai shuo jian zhi shi lang fei shi jian 。]

english: Yeah, clearly so what should we use?
translation: 是的，很清楚，那么我们应该使用什么呢？ [shi de ， hen qing chu ， na me wo men ying gai shi yong shen me ne ？]

english: From my research it looks like a flat ended arrow was designed called a 'Brutal arrow'. This does large amounts of crushing damage to the creature.
translation: 根据我的研究，平端箭头的设计被称为“残酷箭头”。这会对生物造成大量的毁灭性伤害。 [gen ju wo de yan jiu ， ping duan jian tou de she ji bei cheng wei “ can ku jian tou ”。 zhe hui dui sheng wu zao cheng da liang de hui mie xing shang hai 。]

english: You can make them by using larger arrows, I think some Ogre hunters make them. But instead of adding an arrow tip, you hammer a large nail into the end of the shaft.
translation: 你可以用更大的箭头来制作它们，我想一些食人魔猎人会制作它们。但是，您无需添加箭头尖端，而是将一个大钉子钉入轴的末端。 [ni ke yi yong geng da de jian tou lai zhi zuo ta men ， wo xiang yi xie shi ren mo lie ren hui zhi zuo ta men 。 dan shi ， nin wu xu tian jia jian tou jian duan ， er shi jiang yi ge da ding zi ding ru zhou de mo duan 。]

english: How do I get rid of the disease?
translation: 我该如何摆脱这种疾病？ [wo gai ru he bai tuo zhe zhong ji bing ？]

english: Haven't I already explained this disease thing to you once before?
translation: 这个病的事情我不是已经跟你解释过了吗？ [zhe ge bing de shi qing wo bu shi yi jing gen ni jie shi guo le ma ？]

english: Just tell me again or else I'll turn you back into an ogre!
translation: 再说一遍，不然我就把你变成食人魔！ [zai shuo yi bian ， bu ran wo jiu ba ni bian cheng shi ren mo ！]

english: No...noo...please, I'll tell you.
translation: 不...不...拜托，我会告诉你的。 [bu ... bu ... bai tuo ， wo hui gao su ni de 。]

english: My research shows that two jungle based herbs can be used, one is found near river tributaries and looks like a vine, the other is found in caves and grows on the wall.
translation: 我的研究表明，可以使用两种丛林草药，一种是在河流支流附近发现的，看起来像藤蔓，另一种是在洞穴中发现的，生长在墙上。 [wo de yan jiu biao ming ， ke yi shi yong liang zhong cong lin cao yao ， yi zhong shi zai he liu zhi liu fu jin fa xian de ， kan qi lai xiang teng wan ， ling yi zhong shi zai dong xue zhong fa xian de ， sheng zhang zai qiang shang 。]

english: It's quite well camouflaged so it's unlikely that you'll find it.
translation: 它伪装得很好，所以你不太可能发现它。 [ta wei zhuang de hen hao ， suo yi ni bu tai ke neng fa xian ta 。]

english: We'll see about that!
translation: 我们拭目以待吧！ [wo men shi mu yi dai ba ！]

english: Sorry, I have to go.
translation: 抱歉，我得走了。 [bao qian ， wo de zou le 。]

translation: 我该如何消灭不死食人魔？ [wo gai ru he xiao mie bu si shi ren mo ？]

translation: 我该如何摆脱这种疾病？ [wo gai ru he bai tuo zhe zhong ji bing ？]

translation: 抱歉，我得走了。 [bao qian ， wo de zou le 。]

english: Are you all right? You seem a little...incoherent.
translation: 你还好吗？你看起来有点……语无伦次。 [ni hai hao ma ？ ni kan qi lai you dian …… yu wu lun ci 。]

english: Inc'hearnt? Inc'herant! You...you...with yer fancy book- lernin' words. You'd be more than inc'herant if youd seen...
translation: 公司的心？ Inc'herant！你……你……用你那奇特的书本语言。如果你看到了...... [gong si de xin ？ Inc'herant！ ni …… ni …… yong ni na qi te de shu ben yu yan 。 ru guo ni kan dao le ......]

translation: 他们！ [ta men ！]

english: I'm sure I would as well.
translation: 我确信我也会这么做。 [wo que xin wo ye hui zhe me zuo 。]

english: I'm going over here to talk to non-crazy people now.
translation: 我现在要去这里与非疯狂的人交谈。 [wo xian zai yao qu zhe li yu fei feng kuang de ren jiao tan 。]

english: Yeah? Yeah? Well when THEY come floppin' into your house and eat your furniture you'll be sorry!
translation: 是的？是的？好吧，当它们扑通扑通地闯进你的房子并吃掉你的家具时，你会后悔的！ [shi de ？ shi de ？ hao ba ， dang ta men pu tong pu tong di chuang jin ni de fang zi bing chi diao ni de jia ju shi ， ni hui hou hui de ！]

english: Who are
translation: 谁是 [shui shi]

english: (Dramatic pause)
translation: （戏剧性的停顿） [（ xi ju xing de ting dun ）]

english: THEY?
translation: 他们？ [ta men ？]

english: They! Those bloodthirsty, flesh-tearing devils! They are the reason I'm out here every day hurlin' bottles into the sea!
translation: 他们！那些嗜血撕肉的恶魔！它们就是我每天在这里把瓶子扔进海里的原因！ [ta men ！ na xie shi xue si rou de e mo ！ ta men jiu shi wo mei tian zai zhe li ba ping zi reng jin hai li de yuan yin ！]

english: They are the reason I've lost everything, except the horrifying memory of what THEY look like...
translation: 它们是我失去一切的原因，除了对它们的样子的可怕记忆…… [ta men shi wo shi qu yi qie de yuan yin ， chu le dui ta men de yang zi de ke pa ji yi ……]

english: And what do THEY look like?
translation: 他们是什么样子的？ [ta men shi shen me yang zi de ？]
