translation: 弹涂鱼！ [dan tu yu ！]

english: Mudskippers?
translation: 弹涂鱼？ [dan tu yu ？]

english: Aye, Mudskippers! Those ferocious, ravening, evil, beady-eyed terrors of the deep!
translation: 是的，弹涂鱼！那些凶猛、贪婪、邪恶、眼睛圆睁的深渊恐怖生物！ [shi de ， dan tu yu ！ na xie xiong meng 、 tan lan 、 xie e 、 yan jing yuan zheng de shen yuan kong bu sheng wu ！]

english: I...see...
translation: 我懂了... [wo dong le ...]

english: I was ambushed by them way back, see. They got the drop on me...I can't remember where, somewhere around here though.
translation: 我很早就被他们伏击了，瞧。他们对我下手了……我不记得在哪里了，不过就在这附近的某个地方。 [wo hen zao jiu bei ta men fu ji le ， qiao 。 ta men dui wo xia shou le …… wo bu ji de zai na li le ， bu guo jiu zai zhe fu jin de mou ge di fang 。]

english: These would be the mudskippers, right?
translation: 这些就是弹涂鱼，对吧？ [zhe xie jiu shi dan tu yu ， dui ba ？]

english: Aye! The mudskippers! Huge they were! Ten feet of glistening, muddy flesh floppin' towards me with white foam flying from their gnashing fangs!
translation: 是啊！弹涂鱼们！他们是巨大的！十英尺长、闪闪发光、泥泞的肉体向我猛扑过来，白色的泡沫从它们咬牙切齿的獠牙中飞溅出来！ [shi a ！ dan tu yu men ！ ta men shi ju da de ！ shi ying chi zhang 、 shan shan fa guang 、 ni ning de rou ti xiang wo meng pu guo lai ， bai se de pao mo cong ta men yao ya qie chi de liao ya zhong fei jian chu lai ！]

english: I fought them up and down the beach, with the tide rising and more of them leaping towards me with cutlasses drawn!
translation: 我在海滩上与他们搏斗，随着潮水上涨，更多的他们拿着弯刀向我扑来！ [wo zai hai tan shang yu ta men bo dou ， sui zhe chao shui shang zhang ， geng duo de ta men na zhe wan dao xiang wo pu lai ！]

english: This is fascinating, but I have to be...
translation: 这很有趣，但我必须... [zhe hen you qu ， dan wo bi xu ...]

english: Shut yer' word-hole and listen! I can't remember all the details, as I'm sure they must have hit me quite hard, but the last thing I remember before it all went black...
translation: 闭上你的嘴，听着！我不记得所有的细节，因为我确信他们一定对我打击很大，但在一切都变黑之前我记得的最后一件事...... [bi shang ni de zui ， ting zhe ！ wo bu ji de suo you de xi jie ， yin wei wo que xin ta men yi ding dui wo da ji hen da ， dan zai yi qie dou bian hei zhi qian wo ji de de zui hou yi jian shi ......]

english: ...was one of those devils rearing over me, its eyes glowin' red with the fires of hell!
translation: ......是那些在我上方站立的恶魔之一，它的眼睛因地狱之火而发出红光！ [...... shi na xie zai wo shang fang zhan li de e mo zhi yi ， ta de yan jing yin di yu zhi huo er fa chu hong guang ！]

english: Fires of hell...right. I believe you.
translation: 地狱之火……对。我相信你。 [di yu zhi huo …… dui 。 wo xiang xin ni 。]

english: No you don't! You think I'm crazy, like all the rest! Well, if I'm crazy, how did I get these?
translation: 不，你不！你认为我像其他人一样疯了！好吧，如果我疯了，我是怎么得到这些的？ [bu ， ni bu ！ ni ren wei wo xiang qi ta ren yi yang feng le ！ hao ba ， ru guo wo feng le ， wo shi zen me de dao zhe xie de ？]

english: Get what?
translation: 得到什么？ [de dao shen me ？]

english: Skippy shows you what appears to be massive bite scars on his legs. You're no expert, but they look like... giant mudskipper bites!
translation: 斯基皮向您展示了他腿上的巨大咬伤疤痕。你不是专家，但它们看起来就像……巨大的弹涂鱼咬伤！ [si ji pi xiang nin zhan shi le ta tui shang de ju da yao shang ba hen 。 ni bu shi zhuan jia ， dan ta men kan qi lai jiu xiang …… ju da de dan tu yu yao shang ！]

english: Giant mudskipper bites! Where did you get those?
translation: 巨型弹涂鱼咬人！你从哪里得到这些？ [ju xing dan tu yu yao ren ！ ni cong na li de dao zhe xie ？]

english: I can't remember... I've been drinking to forget the horror, and all I seem to have forgotten is where it all happened...
translation: 我不记得了……我一直在喝酒来忘记恐怖，而我似乎忘记了这一切发生的地方…… [wo bu ji de le …… wo yi zhi zai he jiu lai wang ji kong bu ， er wo si hu wang ji le zhe yi qie fa sheng de di fang ……]

english: Hmmm...I suppose if I sober you up you may well start to recall.
translation: 嗯……我想如果我让你清醒一下，你很可能会开始回忆起来。 [n …… wo xiang ru guo wo rang ni qing xing yi xia ， ni hen ke neng hui kai shi hui yi qi lai 。]

english: You'll have a job. I've been drinking this for a week.
translation: 你会有一份工作。我已经喝这个一个星期了。 [ni hui you yi fen gong zuo 。 wo yi jing he zhe ge yi ge xing qi le 。]

english: 'Captain Braindeath's Extra Strength Rum/Drain Cleaner. Now 50% more debilitating'?
translation: “脑死亡船长的超强朗姆酒/排水沟清洁剂”。现在衰弱程度增加了 50%？ [“ nao si wang chuan zhang de chao qiang lang mu jiu / pai shui gou qing jie ji ”。 xian zai shuai ruo cheng du zeng jia le  50%？]

english: It's the extra sheep tranquilizers that gives it that added kick!
translation: 正是额外的绵羊镇定剂给了它额外的刺激！ [zheng shi e wai de mian yang zhen ding ji gei le ta e wai de ci ji ！]

english: Stay here and I'll be right back. Try not to move. Or go near any open flames.
translation: 留在这里，我马上回来。尽量不要动。或者靠近任何明火。 [liu zai zhe li ， wo ma shang hui lai 。 jin liang bu yao dong 。 huo zhe kao jin ren he ming huo 。]

english: You know, I could shock him out of it if I could find some cold water...
translation: 你知道，如果我能找到一些冷水，我就能把他吓醒…… [ni zhi dao ， ru guo wo neng zhao dao yi xie leng shui ， wo jiu neng ba ta xia xing ……]

english: Hey, Skippy.
translation: 嘿，斯基皮。 [hei ， si ji pi 。]

english: Hey you!
translation: 嘿，你！ [hei ， ni ！]

english: How do I annoy the Mogres again?
translation: 我怎样才能再次惹恼莫格雷人呢？ [wo zen yang cai neng zai ci re nao mo ge lei ren ne ？]

english: Go south to Mudskipper Point and lob a Fishing Explosive into the sea. You can grab them from the Slayer masters.
translation: 向南前往弹涂鱼角，将炸鱼炸药扔进海里。您可以从杀手大师那里获取它们。 [xiang nan qian wang dan tu yu jiao ， jiang zha yu zha yao reng jin hai li 。 nin ke yi cong sha shou da shi na li huo qu ta men 。]

english: Thanks! So, what are you going to do now?
translation: 谢谢！那么，你现在要做什么？ [xie xie ！ na me ， ni xian zai yao zuo shen me ？]

english: Well, I was planning on continuing my hobby of wandering up and down this bit of coastline, bellowing random threats and throwing bottles.
translation: 好吧，我打算继续我的爱好，在这片海岸线上徘徊，大声威胁并扔瓶子。 [hao ba ， wo da suan ji xu wo de ai hao ， zai zhe pian hai an xian shang pai huai ， da sheng wei xie bing reng ping zi 。]

english: And you?
translation: 你呢？ [ni ne ？]

english: I was planning on wandering up and down the landscape, bugging people to see if they had mindblowingly dangerous quests for me to undertake.
translation: 我正计划在这片土地上徘徊，骚扰人们，看看他们是否有令人难以置信的危险任务需要我承担。 [wo zheng ji hua zai zhe pian tu di shang pai huai ， sao rao ren men ， kan kan ta men shi fou you ling ren nan yi zhi xin de wei xian ren wu xu yao wo cheng dan 。]

english: Well, good luck with that!
translation: 好吧，祝你好运！ [hao ba ， zhu ni hao yun ！]

english: You too!
translation: 你也是！ [ni ye shi ！]

english: Weirdo...
translation: 怪人... [guai ren ...]

english: Loony...
translation: 疯子... [feng zi ...]

english: I think he's sober enough. And I don't want to use another bucket of water.
translation: 我觉得他已经足够清醒了。而且我不想再用一桶水。 [wo jue de ta yi jing zu gou qing xing le 。 er qie wo bu xiang zai yong yi tong shui 。]

english: Thanks! Now I have two right boots!
translation: 谢谢！现在我有两只合适的靴子了！ [xie xie ！ xian zai wo you liang zhi he shi de xue zi le ！]

english: Do you wanna skip the Tutorial?
translation: 您想跳过教程吗？ [nin xiang tiao guo jiao cheng ma ？]

english: Send me to the mainland now.
translation: 现在就送我去大陆吧。 [xian zai jiu song wo qu da lu ba 。]

english: Right on. I'll read you the official messages first, then send you on your way. Ahem...
translation: 就在。我会先给您读一下官方消息，然后再送您上路。咳咳…… [jiu zai 。 wo hui xian gei nin du yi xia guan fang xiao xi ， ran hou zai song nin shang lu 。 hai hai ……]

english: I am now going to teleport you to Kourend Castle where your journey in the Twisted League will begin. Once you arrive, the Leagues Tutor will fill you in on how the Twisted League works. Good luck!
translation: 我现在要把你传送到库伦德城堡，你的扭曲联盟之旅将在那里开始。当您到达后，联盟导师将向您介绍 Twisted League 的运作方式。祝你好运！ [wo xian zai yao ba ni chuan song dao ku lun de cheng bao ， ni de niu qu lian meng zhi lv jiang zai na li kai shi 。 dang nin dao da hou ， lian meng dao shi jiang xiang nin jie shao  Twisted League  de yun zuo fang shi 。 zhu ni hao yun ！]

english: Prepare yourself!
translation: 做好准备！ [zuo hao zhun bei ！]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: My name's Skippy. Normally I live down by Rimmington.
translation: 我叫斯基皮。通常我住在里明顿附近。 [wo jiao si ji pi 。 tong chang wo zhu zai li ming dun fu jin 。]

english: Although I guess you won't be able to get to Rimmington on this League world...
translation: 虽然我猜你无法在这个联盟世界中到达里明顿...... [sui ran wo cai ni wu fa zai zhe ge lian meng shi jie zhong dao da li ming dun ......]

english: Just lately the Council wants to let people skip the Tutorial, so - ha ha ha - they dump the job on Skippy. Bah!
translation: 就在最近，委员会想让人们跳过教程，所以 - 哈哈哈 - 他们把这个工作交给了 Skippy。呸! [jiu zai zui jin ， wei yuan hui xiang rang ren men tiao guo jiao cheng ， suo yi  -  ha ha ha  -  ta men ba zhe ge gong zuo jiao gei le  Skippy。 pei !]

english: So, anyway, do you want to skip the Tutorial?
translation: 那么，无论如何，您想跳过教程吗？ [na me ， wu lun ru he ， nin xiang tiao guo jiao cheng ma ？]

english: Can I decide later?
translation: 我可以稍后再决定吗？ [wo ke yi shao hou zai jue ding ma ？]

english: Sure. You'll find me all over this island. Ask me again any time you like.
translation: 当然。你会在这个岛上找到我。您可以随时再次询问我。 [dang ran 。 ni hui zai zhe ge dao shang zhao dao wo 。 nin ke yi sui shi zai ci xun wen wo 。]

english: I'll stay here for the Tutorial.
translation: 我将留在这里观看教程。 [wo jiang liu zai zhe li guan kan jiao cheng 。]

english: Good choice. Let me know if you change your mind.
translation: 不错的选择。如果您改变主意，请告诉我。 [bu cuo de xuan ze 。 ru guo nin gai bian zhu yi ， qing gao su wo 。]

english: When you arrive on the mainland you will be a Deadman. If you die when skulled, or if you are killed by another Deadman you will lose the most valuable items from your bank.
translation: 当你到达大陆时，你将成为一名亡灵。如果你死于骷髅，或者被另一个亡灵杀死，你将失去银行中最有价值的物品。 [dang ni dao da da lu shi ， ni jiang cheng wei yi ming wang ling 。 ru guo ni si yu ku lou ， huo zhe bei ling yi ge wang ling sha si ， ni jiang shi qu yin hang zhong zui you jia zhi de wu pin 。]

english: To help you get started, you'll have 12 hours of immunity before anyone can attack you. Speak to the Doomsayer in Lumbridge to waive your immunity and get on with the killing!
translation: 为了帮助您入门，在任何人攻击您之前，您将获得 12 小时的免疫力。与朗布里奇的末日预言者交谈，放弃你的豁免权并继续杀戮！ [wei le bang zhu nin ru men ， zai ren he ren gong ji nin zhi qian ， nin jiang huo de  12  xiao shi de mian yi li 。 yu lang bu li qi de mo ri yu yan zhe jiao tan ， fang qi ni de huo mian quan bing ji xu sha lu ！]

english: For more information, speak to Nigel in the Lumbridge graveyard. You may choose where to begin - where would you like to start?
translation: 欲了解更多信息，请与朗布里奇墓地的奈杰尔交谈。您可以选择从哪里开始 - 您想从哪里开始？ [yu liao jie geng duo xin xi ， qing yu lang bu li qi mu di de nai jie er jiao tan 。 nin ke yi xuan ze cong na li kai shi  -  nin xiang cong na li kai shi ？]

english: You are teleported to your preferred starting location
translation: 您将被传送到您首选的起始位置 [nin jiang bei chuan song dao nin shou xuan de qi shi wei zhi]

english: My name's Skippy. Normally I live down by Rimmington. You should come and see me when you're passing.
translation: 我叫斯基皮。通常我住在里明顿附近。你路过的时候应该来看看我。 [wo jiao si ji pi 。 tong chang wo zhu zai li ming dun fu jin 。 ni lu guo de shi hou ying gai lai kan kan wo 。]

english: I'm sure I would as well.
translation: 我确信我也会这么做。 [wo que xin wo ye hui zhe me zuo 。]

english: Who are (Dramatic pause) THEY?
translation: 他们是谁（戏剧性的停顿）？ [ta men shi shui （ xi ju xing de ting dun ）？]

english: Send me to the mainland now.
translation: 现在就送我去大陆吧。 [xian zai jiu song wo qu da lu ba 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Can I decide later?
translation: 我可以稍后再决定吗？ [wo ke yi shao hou zai jue ding ma ？]

english: I'll stay here for the Tutorial.
translation: 我将留在这里观看教程。 [wo jiang liu zai zhe li guan kan jiao cheng 。]

english: Lumbridge
translation: 朗布里奇 [lang bu li qi]

english: Varrock
translation: 瓦罗克 [wa luo ke]

english: Falador
translation: 法拉多 [fa la duo]

english: East Ardougne
translation: 东阿杜涅 [dong e du nie]

english: Gnome Stronghold
translation: 侏儒要塞 [zhu ru yao sai]

english: :Gar mulno ful taglo!
translation: :Gar mulno ful taglo！ [:Gar mulno ful taglo！]

english: I do not thinke thou understand the depths of the darkness you have unleashed upon the world. To dub it in such a scintillant manner is offensive to mine being.
translation: 我不认为你了解你向世界释放的黑暗的深度。以如此耀眼的方式来配音是对我的存在的冒犯。 [wo bu ren wei ni liao jie ni xiang shi jie shi fang de hei an de shen du 。 yi ru ci yao yan de fang shi lai pei yin shi dui wo de cun zai de mao fan 。]

english: So why are you following me around?
translation: 那你为什么跟着我？ [na ni wei shen me gen zhe wo ？]

english: Dark forces of which ye know nought have deemed that this is my geas.
translation: 你们一无所知的黑暗力量认为这是我的杰斯。 [ni men yi wu suo zhi de hei an li liang ren wei zhe shi wo de jie si 。]

english: Your goose?
translation: 你的鹅？ [ni de e ？]

english: *Sighs* Nae. But thine is well and truly cooked.
translation: *叹气*奈伊。但你的菜确实煮得很好。 [* tan qi * nai yi 。 dan ni de cai que shi zhu de hen hao 。]

english: I am spawned of darkness. I am filled with darkness. I am darkness incarnate and to darkness I will return.
translation: 我是黑暗中诞生的。我心里充满了黑暗。我是黑暗的化身，我将回归黑暗。 [wo shi hei an zhong dan sheng de 。 wo xin li chong man le hei an 。 wo shi hei an de hua shen ， wo jiang hui gui hei an 。]

english: Sounds pretty... dark.
translation: 听起来很……黑暗。 [ting qi lai hen …… hei an 。]

english: Knowest thou not of the cursed place? Knowest thou not about the future yet to befall your puny race?
translation: 你不知道那个被诅咒的地方吗？你难道不知道你们这个弱小种族的未来吗？ [ni bu zhi dao na ge bei zu zhou de di fang ma ？ ni nan dao bu zhi dao ni men zhe ge ruo xiao zhong zu de wei lai ma ？]

english: Oh yes, I've heard that before.
translation: 哦，是的，我以前听说过。 [o ， shi de ， wo yi qian ting shuo guo 。]

english: Then it is good that ye can laugh in the face of the end.
translation: 那么，你们能笑着面对结局就好了。 [na me ， ni men neng xiao zhe mian dui jie ju jiu hao le 。]

english: The end has a face? Which end?
translation: 结局有脸吗？哪一端？ [jie ju you lian ma ？ na yi duan ？]

english: *Sighs* The darkness giveth, and the darkness taketh.
translation: *叹息*黑暗给予，黑暗索取。 [* tan xi * hei an ji yu ， hei an suo qu 。]

english: Nothing. Ye are already tainted in my sight by the acts of light. However there may be some hope for you if you continue to aid the darkness.
translation: 没有什么。在我看来，你们已经被光的行为玷污了。然而，如果你继续帮助黑暗，你可能会有一些希望。 [mei you shen me 。 zai wo kan lai ， ni men yi jing bei guang de xing wei dian wu le 。 ran er ， ru guo ni ji xu bang zhu hei an ， ni ke neng hui you yi xie xi wang 。]

english: I do have a lantern around here somewhere.
translation: 我在这附近的某个地方有一盏灯笼。 [wo zai zhe fu jin de mou ge di fang you yi zhan deng long 。]

english: Do not bring that foul and repellant thing near mine self.
translation: 不要把那个肮脏又令人厌恶的东西带到我身边。 [bu yao ba na ge ang zang you ling ren yan wu de dong xi dai dao wo shen bian 。]

english: A book of darkness? I don't usually read, but that seems like a good book!
translation: 黑暗之书？我平时不看书，不过这本书看起来不错！ [hei an zhi shu ？ wo ping shi bu kan shu ， bu guo zhe ben shu kan qi lai bu cuo ！]

english: I told thee to keep thy filthy light away from me!
translation: 我告诉过你，让你那肮脏的光芒远离我！ [wo gao su guo ni ， rang ni na ang zang de guang mang yuan li wo ！]

english: Darkness take ye.
translation: 黑暗带走你。 [hei an dai zou ni 。]

english: Rest in darkness.
translation: 在黑暗中休息。 [zai hei an zhong xiu xi 。]

english: Let the darkness come forth.
translation: 让黑暗出现。 [rang hei an chu xian 。]

english: You look cute.
translation: 你看起来很可爱。 [ni kan qi lai hen ke ai 。]

english: Where did you come from?
translation: 你从哪里来？ [ni cong na li lai ？]

english: What can you do for me?
translation: 你能为我做什么？ [ni neng wei wo zuo shen me ？]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Good day.
translation: 再会。 [zai hui 。]

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
translation: 嘿！把你的手拿开！ [hei ！ ba ni de shou na kai ！]

english: Good day, Your Royal Highness.
translation: 美好的一天，殿下。 [mei hao de yi tian ， dian xia 。]

english: Oi!
translation: 哎呀！ [ai ya ！]

english: Rahr!
translation: 拉尔！ [la er ！]

english: No!
translation: 不！ [bu ！]

english: Grr!
translation: 咕噜！ [gu lu ！]

english: Aargh!
translation: 啊啊！ [a a ！]

english: I'm a gonner!
translation: 我是个大佬！ [wo shi ge da lao ！]

english: It's no use, I'm done for!
translation: 没用的，我已经完蛋了！ [mei yong de ， wo yi jing wan dan le ！]

english: Uggh!
translation: 哎呀！ [ai ya ！]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Sorry. I can't sell weapons to outerlanders. Wouldn't be right. Against our beliefs.
translation: 对不起。我不能向外地人出售武器。那就不对了。违背我们的信仰。 [dui bu qi 。 wo bu neng xiang wai di ren chu shou wu qi 。 na jiu bu dui le 。 wei bei wo men de xin yang 。]

english: Only Fremenniks may purchase weapons and armour here.
translation: 只有弗雷曼尼克人可以在这里购买武器和盔甲。 [zhi you fu lei man ni ke ren ke yi zai zhe li gou mai wu qi he kui jia 。]

english: Are you a member of the council of elders?
translation: 你是长老会的成员吗？ [ni shi zhang lao hui de cheng yuan ma ？]

english: No. Weapons are my speciality. Not politics.
translation: 不，武器是我的专长。不是政治。 [bu ， wu qi shi wo de zhuan chang 。 bu shi zheng zhi 。]

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a finely balanced custom bowstring, do you?
translation: 我想你不知道我在哪里可以找到一根完美平衡的定制弓弦，是吗？ [wo xiang ni bu zhi dao wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao yi gen wan mei ping heng de ding zhi gong xian ， shi ma ？]

english: Aye, I have a few in stock. What would an outerlander be wanting with equipment like that?
translation: 是的，我有一些库存。外地人想要这样的装备有什么用呢？ [shi de ， wo you yi xie ku cun 。 wai di ren xiang yao zhe yang de zhuang bei you shen me yong ne ？]

english: It's for Sigli. It needs to be weighted precisely to suit his hunting bow.
translation: 这是为了西格利。它需要精确称重以适合他的狩猎弓。 [zhe shi wei le xi ge li 。 ta xu yao jing que cheng zhong yi shi he ta de shou lie gong 。]

english: For Sigli eh? Well, I made his bow in the first place, so I'll be able to select the right string for you... just one small problem.
translation: 为了西格利吧？好吧，我首先制作了他的弓，所以我可以为你选择合适的琴弦……只是一个小问题。 [wei le xi ge li ba ？ hao ba ， wo shou xian zhi zuo le ta de gong ， suo yi wo ke yi wei ni xuan ze he shi de qin xian …… zhi shi yi ge xiao wen ti 。]

english: What's that?
translation: 那是什么？ [na shi shen me ？]

english: This string you'll be wanting... Very rare. Take a lot of time to recreate. Not sure you have the cash for it.
translation: 您会想要的这根绳子...非常罕见。花费大量时间重新创建。不确定你是否有足够的现金。 [nin hui xiang yao de zhe gen sheng zi ... fei chang han jian 。 hua fei da liang shi jian chong xin chuang jian 。 bu que ding ni shi fou you zu gou de xian jin 。]

english: Then maybe you'll accept something else...?
translation: 那么也许你会接受别的东西......？ [na me ye xu ni hui jie shou bie de dong xi ......？]

english: Heh. Good thinking outerlander. Well, it's true, there is more to life than just making money. Making weapons is good money, but it's not why I do it.
translation: 呵呵。外地人思想很好。嗯，确实如此，生活不仅仅是赚钱。制造武器是一笔好钱，但这不是我这样做的原因。 [he he 。 wai di ren si xiang hen hao 。 n ， que shi ru ci ， sheng huo bu jin jin shi zhuan qian 。 zhi zao wu qi shi yi bi hao qian ， dan zhe bu shi wo zhe yang zuo de yuan yin 。]

english: I'll tell you what. I heard a rumour that one of the fishermen down by the docks caught some weird looking fish as they were fishing the other day.
translation: 我会告诉你什么。我听说有传言说码头附近的一位渔民前几天钓鱼时捕获了一些看起来很奇怪的鱼。 [wo hui gao su ni shen me 。 wo ting shuo you chuan yan shuo ma tou fu jin de yi wei yu min qian ji tian diao yu shi bu huo le yi xie kan qi lai hen qi guai de yu 。]

english: From what I hear this fish is unique. Nobody's ever seen its like before. This intrigues me. I'd like to have it for myself. Make a good trophy.
translation: 据我所知，这条鱼很独特。没有人见过它像以前那样。这让我很感兴趣。我想自己拥有它。制作一个好的奖杯。 [ju wo suo zhi ， zhe tiao yu hen du te 。 mei you ren jian guo ta xiang yi qian na yang 。 zhe rang wo hen gan xing qu 。 wo xiang zi ji yong you ta 。 zhi zuo yi ge hao de jiang bei 。]

english: You get me that fish, I give you the bowstring. What do you say? We got a deal?
translation: 你给我那条鱼，我给你弓弦。你怎么说？我们达成协议了吗？ [ni gei wo na tiao yu ， wo gei ni gong xian 。 ni zen me shuo ？ wo men da cheng xie yi le ma ？]

english: Sounds good to me.
translation: 对我来说听起来不错。 [dui wo lai shuo ting qi lai bu cuo 。]

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find an exotic and extremely rare fish, do you?
translation: 我想你不知道我在哪里可以找到一种奇异且极其稀有的鱼，是吗？ [wo xiang ni bu zhi dao wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao yi zhong qi yi qie ji qi xi you de yu ， shi ma ？]

english: What? There's another one?
translation: 什么？还有另外一个吗？ [shen me ？ hai you ling wai yi ge ma ？]

english: Er... no, it's the one for you that I'm looking for...
translation: 呃...不，这是我正在寻找的适合您的人... [e ... bu ， zhe shi wo zheng zai xun zhao de shi he nin de ren ...]

english: Ah. I see. I already told you. Some guy down by the docks was bragging. Best ask there, I reckon.
translation: 啊。我懂了。我已经告诉过你了。码头边的某个人正在吹牛。我想最好去那里问一下。 [a 。 wo dong le 。 wo yi jing gao su guo ni le 。 ma tou bian de mou ge ren zheng zai chui niu 。 wo xiang zui hao qu na li wen yi xia 。]

english: Hi there. I got your fish, so can I have that bowstring for Sigli now?
translation: 你好呀。我拿到了你的鱼，现在可以给我拿下西格利的弓弦吗？ [ni hao ya 。 wo na dao le ni de yu ， xian zai ke yi gei wo na xia xi ge li de gong xian ma ？]

english: Ohh... That's a nice fish. Very pleased. Here. Take the bowstring. You fulfilled agreement. only fair I do same. Good work outerlander.
translation: 哦...那条鱼真不错。非常高兴。这里。拿弓弦。你履行了约定。公平地说，我也这样做。外地人干得好。 [o ... na tiao yu zhen bu cuo 。 fei chang gao xing 。 zhe li 。 na gong xian 。 ni lv xing le yue ding 。 gong ping di shuo ， wo ye zhe yang zuo 。 wai di ren gan de hao 。]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: So about this bowstring... was it hard to make or something?
translation: 那么这根弓弦……是很难制作还是怎么的？ [na me zhe gen gong xian …… shi hen nan zhi zuo hai shi zen me de ？]

english: Not hard. Just a trick to it. Takes skill to learn, but when learnt, easy. Sigli will be happy. Finest bowstring on continent. Will suit his needs perfectly.
translation: 不难。只是一个技巧而已。学习需要技巧，但学会后就很容易。西格利会很高兴。大陆上最好的弓弦。会完美地满足他的需求。 [bu nan 。 zhi shi yi ge ji qiao er yi 。 xue xi xu yao ji qiao ， dan xue hui hou jiu hen rong yi 。 xi ge li hui hen gao xing 。 da lu shang zui hao de gong xian 。 hui wan mei di man zu ta de xu qiu 。]

english: Hello again [Fremennik name]. Come to see what's for sale?
translation: 再次你好[弗雷曼尼克名字]。过来看看有什么卖的？ [zai ci ni hao [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 guo lai kan kan you shen me mai de ？]

english: Ask about the Merchant's trial
translation: 询问商家试用情况 [xun wen shang jia shi yong qing kuang]

english: Ask about becoming a Fremennik
translation: 询问成为 Fremennik 的问题 [xun wen cheng wei  Fremennik  de wen ti]

english: Oh, hello again. Want to buy some weapons?
translation: 噢，又好。想买一些武器吗？ [o ， you hao 。 xiang mai yi xie wu qi ma ？]

english: I'll have a look.
translation: 我去看看。 [wo qu kan kan 。]

english: Not right now.
translation: 现在不行。 [xian zai bu xing 。]

english: I'll have a look.
translation: 我去看看。 [wo qu kan kan 。]

english: Not right now...
translation: 现在还不行... [xian zai hai bu xing ...]

english: I think I'll give the Skullball Course a go.
translation: 我想我会尝试一下骷髅球课程。 [wo xiang wo hui chang shi yi xia ku lou qiu ke cheng 。]

english: What are the instructions for using the skullball course?
translation: 使用骷髅球课程的说明是什么？ [shi yong ku lou qiu ke cheng de shuo ming shi shen me ？]

english: The skullball comes out of one of these four spawnholes. Just kick the ball through the middle of each goal, through the skeleton's feet.
translation: 骷髅球从这四个产卵洞之一中出来。只需将球踢过每个球门的中间，穿过骷髅的脚即可。 [ku lou qiu cong zhe si ge chan luan dong zhi yi zhong chu lai 。 zhi xu jiang qiu ti guo mei ge qiu men de zhong jian ， chuan guo ku lou de jiao ji ke 。]

english: There are 10 goals, which you must complete in order, and one final goal.
translation: 您必须按顺序完成 10 个目标，以及 1 个最终目标。 [nin bi xu an shun xu wan cheng  10  ge mu biao ， yi ji  1  ge zui zhong mu biao 。]

english: An arrow will point to your ball, just in case lots of people are using the course at the same time as yourself.
translation: 一个箭头将指向您的球，以防万一很多人和您同时使用该球场。 [yi ge jian tou jiang zhi xiang nin de qiu ， yi fang wan yi hen duo ren he nin tong shi shi yong gai qiu chang 。]

english: The better your time, the more agillity XP you will be awarded. The timer starts when you score your first goal.
translation: 您的时间越长，您获得的敏捷经验值就越多。当您进球后，计时器开始计时。 [nin de shi jian yue zhang ， nin huo de de min jie jing yan zhi jiu yue duo 。 dang nin jin qiu hou ， ji shi qi kai shi ji shi 。]

english: I seem to have lost my ball - can I have another one?
translation: 我好像丢了球 - 我可以再要一个吗？ [wo hao xiang diu le qiu  -  wo ke yi zai yao yi ge ma ？]

english: No problem, here's another one. You'll have to start from the beginning again, but the timer will be restarted too.
translation: 没问题，这是另一个。您必须再次从头开始，但计时器也会重新启动。 [mei wen ti ， zhe shi ling yi ge 。 nin bi xu zai ci cong tou kai shi ， dan ji shi qi ye hui chong xin qi dong 。]

english: I give up, I can't do it - take my ball away.
translation: 我放弃了，我做不到——把我的球拿走。 [wo fang qi le ， wo zuo bu dao —— ba wo de qiu na zou 。]

english: Oh dear, such a defeatist.
translation: 哦天哪，真是个失败主义者。 [o tian na ， zhen shi ge shi bai zhu yi zhe 。]

english: Grrr - you don't belong in here, human!
translation: Grrr - 你不属于这里，人类！ [Grrr -  ni bu shu yu zhe li ， ren lei ！]

english: I would like to do the skullball course.
translation: 我想参加骷髅球课程。 [wo xiang can jia ku lou qiu ke cheng 。]

english: What are the instructions for the skullball course?
translation: 骷髅球课程的说明是什么？ [ku lou qiu ke cheng de shuo ming shi shen me ？]

english: What are the instructions for using the skullball course?
translation: 使用骷髅球课程的说明是什么？ [shi yong ku lou qiu ke cheng de shuo ming shi shen me ？]

english: I seem to have lost my ball - can I have another one?
translation: 我好像丢了球 - 我可以再要一个吗？ [wo hao xiang diu le qiu  -  wo ke yi zai yao yi ge ma ？]

english: I give up, I can't do it - take my ball away.
translation: 我放弃了，我做不到——把我的球拿走。 [wo fang qi le ， wo zuo bu dao —— ba wo de qiu na zou 。]

english: You have truly gifted paws!
translation: 你的爪子真的很有天赋！ [ni de zhua zi zhen de hen you tian fu ！]

english: I've never seen anything like it!
translation: 我从来没有见过这样的事情！ [wo cong lai mei you jian guo zhe yang de shi qing ！]

english: You need a few more skullball lessons.
translation: 你还需要一些骷髅球课程。 [ni hai xu yao yi xie ku lou qiu ke cheng 。]

english: Keep it up!
translation: 继续努力吧！ [ji xu nu li ba ！]

english: Don't give up the day job!
translation: 不要放弃日常工作！ [bu yao fang qi ri chang gong zuo ！]

english: Look at [her/him] go!
translation: 看[她/他]走吧！ [kan [ ta / ta ] zou ba ！]

english: Pathetic!
translation: 可怜的！ [ke lian de ！]

english: What - a - goal !!!
translation: 什么-一个-目标！！！ [shen me - yi ge - mu biao ！！！]

english: That was just plain lucky.
translation: 那真是太幸运了。 [na zhen shi tai xing yun le 。]

english: [He/She] shoots - [He/She] scores!!!!!
translation: [他/她]射门 - [他/她]得分!!!!! [[ ta / ta ] she men  - [ ta / ta ] de fen !!!!!]

english: Humans play skullball worse than puppies!
translation: 人类玩骷髅球比小狗还糟糕！ [ren lei wan ku lou qiu bi xiao gou hai zao gao ！]

english: The human's scored!
translation: 人类得分了！ [ren lei de fen le ！]

english: Eyup. They call me Skully. I run this Wilderness Loot Chest. What can I do for you?
translation: 埃尤普。他们叫我骷髅。我经营这个荒野战利品箱。我能为你做什么？ [ai you pu 。 ta men jiao wo ku lou 。 wo jing ying zhe ge huang ye zhan li pin xiang 。 wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: Well, you know how when you kill someone all of their stuff just ends up in a pile on the floor and it's really hard to pick it all up quickly?
translation: 好吧，你知道当你杀了一个人时，他们的所有东西都会在地板上堆成一堆，而且很难很快把它们全部捡起来吗？ [hao ba ， ni zhi dao dang ni sha le yi ge ren shi ， ta men de suo you dong xi du hui zai di ban shang dui cheng yi dui ， er qie hen nan hen kuai ba ta men quan bu jian qi lai ma ？]

english: Actually, I've never killed anyone else.
translation: 事实上，我从来没有杀过别人。 [shi shi shang ， wo cong lai mei you sha guo bie ren 。]

english: ...Oh. Well, when you do, all of their stuff just ends up in a pile on the floor and it's really hard to pick it all up quickly.
translation: ...哦。好吧，当你这样做时，他们所有的东西都会在地板上堆成一堆，而且很难快速把它们全部捡起来。 [... o 。 hao ba ， dang ni zhe yang zuo shi ， ta men suo you de dong xi du hui zai di ban shang dui cheng yi dui ， er qie hen nan kuai su ba ta men quan bu jian qi lai 。]

english: Yeah?
translation: 是的？ [shi de ？]

english: So, I made an enchantment that teleports the loot to another dimension instead!
translation: 所以，我做了一个结界，将战利品传送到另一个维度！ [suo yi ， wo zuo le yi ge jie jie ， jiang zhan li pin chuan song dao ling yi ge wei du ！]

english: How does that help?
translation: 这有什么帮助？ [zhe you shen me bang zhu ？]

english: Well, instead of getting a pile of rubbish, you get a single key. You just take the key to this chest and BAM! There's your loot!
translation: 好吧，你不会得到一堆垃圾，而是得到一把钥匙。你只需拿起这个箱子的钥匙，然后砰！这是你的战利品！ [hao ba ， ni bu hui de dao yi dui la ji ， er shi de dao yi ba yao shi 。 ni zhi xu na qi zhe ge xiang zi de yao shi ， ran hou peng ！ zhe shi ni de zhan li pin ！]

english: So the loot is safe in this other dimension?
translation: 那么战利品在另一个维度是安全的吗？ [na me zhan li pin zai ling yi ge wei du shi an quan de ma ？]

english: Eh, seems like it. As long as they've had the key, I've never had anyone unable to get the stuff back out. Though if you lose the key, you can't get the stuff out.
translation: 呃，好像是这样。只要他们有钥匙，我就从来没有人无法把东西拿回来。但如果你丢了钥匙，你就拿不出东西了。 [e ， hao xiang shi zhe yang 。 zhi yao ta men you yao shi ， wo jiu cong lai mei you ren wu fa ba dong xi na hui lai 。 dan ru guo ni diu le yao shi ， ni jiu na bu chu dong xi le 。]

english: Oh, and be careful running about with too many keys on you. Other people will know you've got them, and I'm not gonna stop them opening the chest!
translation: 哦，带太多钥匙到处跑要小心。其他人会知道你已经拿到了它们，而且我不会阻止他们打开箱子！ [o ， dai tai duo yao shi dao chu pao yao xiao xin 。 qi ta ren hui zhi dao ni yi jing na dao le ta men ， er qie wo bu hui zu zhi ta men da kai xiang zi ！]

english: So if I kill someone and take their keys, I can use them myself?
translation: 那么如果我杀了某人并拿走了他们的钥匙，我可以自己使用它们吗？ [na me ru guo wo sha le mou ren bing na zou le ta men de yao shi ， wo ke yi zi ji shi yong ta men ma ？]

english: ...Eh, if you wanna think about it that way, sure.
translation: ……呃，如果你想这样想的话，当然可以。 […… e ， ru guo ni xiang zhe yang xiang de hua ， dang ran ke yi 。]

english: I got nothing better to do, so I'll keep track of the value of the stuff you unlock.
translation: 我没有更好的事情可做，所以我会记录你解锁的东西的价值。 [wo mei you geng hao de shi qing ke zuo ， suo yi wo hui ji lu ni jie suo de dong xi de jia zhi 。]

english: And anything you don't want, you can have the chest destroy it.
translation: 任何你不想要的东西，你都可以让箱子摧毁它。 [ren he ni bu xiang yao de dong xi ， ni dou ke yi rang xiang zi cui hui ta 。]

english: Except the food. I'll eat that instead.
translation: 除了食物。我就吃那个吧。 [chu le shi wu 。 wo jiu chi na ge ba 。]

english: Now, if you want your own keys instead of relying on the misfortune of others, I can put the enchantment on you as well, but it's gonna cost ya.
translation: 现在，如果你想要自己的钥匙而不是依赖别人的不幸，我也可以给你施魔法，但这会花费你的钱。 [xian zai ， ru guo ni xiang yao zi ji de yao shi er bu shi yi lai bie ren de bu xing ， wo ye ke yi gei ni shi mo fa ， dan zhe hui hua fei ni de qian 。]

english: Can I have access to the chest?
translation: 我可以接触胸部吗？ [wo ke yi jie chu xiong bu ma ？]

english: So, if you have keys from someone else, you're more than welcome to put them in the chest and see what comes out.
translation: 因此，如果您有别人的钥匙，我们非常欢迎您将它们放入箱子中，看看会出现什么情况。 [yin ci ， ru guo nin you bie ren de yao shi ， wo men fei chang huan ying nin jiang ta men fang ru xiang zi zhong ， kan kan hui chu xian shen me qing kuang 。]

english: If you want the enchantment that makes the keys, I'm afraid it's gonna cost you 1 million coins.
translation: 如果你想要制作钥匙的结界，恐怕要花费一百万金币。 [ru guo ni xiang yao zhi zuo yao shi de jie jie ， kong pa yao hua fei yi bai wan jin bi 。]

english: Sure, I'll pay for that.
translation: 当然，我会为此付费。 [dang ran ， wo hui wei ci fu fei 。]

english: Are you sure? 1 million is a lot of coins, and you won't get them back!
translation: 你确定吗？ 100万是很多金币，而且收不回来！ [ni que ding ma ？ 100 wan shi hen duo jin bi ， er qie shou bu hui lai ！]

english: Hmm... I don't think you have enough money on you there, mate.
translation: 嗯...我觉得你身上的钱不够，伙计。 [n ... wo jue de ni shen shang de qian bu gou ， huo ji 。]

english: Ok, let me just... and a bit of... and we're done! You'll now get loot keys whenever you kill someone in the Wilderness. Talk to me again if you have any questions.
translation: 好吧，让我……还有一点……我们就完成了！现在，每当你在荒野中杀死某人时，你都会获得战利品钥匙。如果您有任何疑问，请再次与我联系。 [hao ba ， rang wo …… hai you yi dian …… wo men jiu wan cheng le ！ xian zai ， mei dang ni zai huang ye zhong sha si mou ren shi ， ni du hui huo de zhan li pin yao shi 。 ru guo nin you ren he yi wen ， qing zai ci yu wo lian xi 。]

english: Fair enough mate, talk to me again if you change your mind.
translation: 公平地说，伙计，如果你改变主意，请再跟我谈谈。 [gong ping di shuo ， huo ji ， ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， qing zai gen wo tan tan 。]

english: Not right now, thanks.
translation: 现在不行，谢谢。 [xian zai bu xing ， xie xie 。]

english: Fair enough mate, want to talk about something else?
translation: 很公平，伙计，想谈点别的吗？ [hen gong ping ， huo ji ， xiang tan dian bie de ma ？]

english: How much?!
translation: 多少？！ [duo shao ？！]

english: 1 million coins.
translation: 100万枚金币。 [100 wan mei jin bi 。]

english: Why do you charge so much?!
translation: 为什么要收这么多钱？！ [wei shen me yao shou zhe me duo qian ？！]

english: Runes. People don't wanna deliver across the Wilderness, and I'm in no shape to go to them, so I have to pay through the nose.
translation: 符文。人们不想穿越荒野送货，而我又没有能力去见他们，所以我必须花大价钱。 [fu wen 。 ren men bu xiang chuan yue huang ye song huo ， er wo you mei you neng li qu jian ta men ， suo yi wo bi xu hua da jia qian 。]

english: I make maybe a couple hundred coins of profit, which at least lets me buy a few beers.
translation: 我大概赚了几百个硬币的利润，这至少可以让我买几瓶啤酒。 [wo da gai zhuan le ji bai ge ying bi de li run ， zhe zhi shao ke yi rang wo mai ji ping pi jiu 。]

english: Why is the beer so cheap if it's so expensive to get deliveries out here?
translation: 如果这里的送货这么贵，为什么啤酒这么便宜？ [ru guo zhe li de song huo zhe me gui ， wei shen me pi jiu zhe me pian yi ？]

english: The barman makes it himself with whatever scraps he can get his hands on.
translation: 酒保用他能找到的任何残料亲自制作。 [jiu bao yong ta neng zhao dao de ren he can liao qin zi zhi zuo 。]

english: You'd think it'd turn out horrible, but compared to every other 2 coin beer out there, it's not half bad.
translation: 你可能会认为它会很糟糕，但与其他 2 硬币啤酒相比，它还不错。 [ni ke neng hui ren wei ta hui hen zao gao ， dan yu qi ta  2  ying bi pi jiu xiang bi ， ta hai bu cuo 。]

english: But enough about beer. If you want access to the loot keys, it's gonna cost you 1 million coins.
translation: 关于啤酒就够了。如果你想获得战利品钥匙，你需要花费 100 万金币。 [guan yu pi jiu jiu gou le 。 ru guo ni xiang huo de zhan li pin yao shi ， ni xu yao hua fei  100  wan jin bi 。]

english: Can I change how these loot keys work?
translation: 我可以更改这些战利品钥匙的工作方式吗？ [wo ke yi geng gai zhe xie zhan li pin yao shi de gong zuo fang shi ma ？]

english: Well, I can turn the enchantment that creates the loot keys on and off for you. Won't cost you anything to turn it back on again, either.
translation: 好吧，我可以为你打开和关闭创造战利品钥匙的结界。再次打开它也不需要花费任何费用。 [hao ba ， wo ke yi wei ni da kai he guan bi chuang zao zhan li pin yao shi de jie jie 。 zai ci da kai ta ye bu xu yao hua fei ren he fei yong 。]

english: If you'd like it so stuff like food and potions stay out of the keys so you can use them yourself, I can do that too.
translation: 如果你希望食物和药水之类的东西远离钥匙，这样你就可以自己使用它们，我也可以这样做。 [ru guo ni xi wang shi wu huo yao shui zhi lei de dong xi yuan li yao shi ， zhe yang ni jiu ke yi zi ji shi yong ta men ， wo ye ke yi zhe yang zuo 。]

english: And if you like the feeling of picking up valuables, I can make it so that anything above a certain value hits the floor as well.
translation: 如果你喜欢捡起贵重物品的感觉，我可以让任何超过一定价值的东西也会掉落到地板上。 [ru guo ni xi huan jian qi gui zhong wu pin de gan jue ， wo ke yi rang ren he chao guo yi ding jia zhi de dong xi ye hui diao luo dao di ban shang 。]

english: Ok, whenever you kill someone else now, their items will go to the floor like normal. Just remember, they could have loot keys on them, and they'll still go to your inventory!
translation: 好吧，现在每当你杀死别人时，他们的物品都会像平常一样掉到地板上。请记住，他们身上可能有战利品钥匙，但他们仍然会进入你的库存！ [hao ba ， xian zai mei dang ni sha si bie ren shi ， ta men de wu pin du hui xiang ping chang yi yang diao dao di ban shang 。 qing ji zhu ， ta men shen shang ke neng you zhan li pin yao shi ， dan ta men reng ran hui jin ru ni de ku cun ！]

english: Ok, you'll now get loot keys when you kill another person in the Wilderness.
translation: 好的，现在当您在荒野中杀死另一个人时，您将获得战利品钥匙。 [hao de ， xian zai dang nin zai huang ye zhong sha si ling yi ge ren shi ， nin jiang huo de zhan li pin yao shi 。]

english: Ok, food and potions will now be dropped to the floor instead of stored in a loot key.
translation: 好的，食物和药水现在将掉落在地板上，而不是存储在战利品钥匙中。 [hao de ， shi wu huo yao shui xian zai jiang diao luo zai di ban shang ， er bu shi cun chu zai zhan li pin yao shi zhong 。]

english: Ok, food and potions will now be sent to your loot keys.
translation: 好的，食物和药水现在将被发送到你的战利品钥匙中。 [hao de ， shi wu huo yao shui xian zai jiang bei fa song dao ni de zhan li pin yao shi zhong 。]

english: Ok, valuable items will now be dropped to the floor instead of stored in a loot key.
translation: 好的，有价值的物品现在将被扔到地板上，而不是存储在战利品钥匙中。 [hao de ， you jia zhi de wu pin xian zai jiang bei reng dao di ban shang ， er bu shi cun chu zai zhan li pin yao shi zhong 。]

english: Ok, valuable items will now be sent to your loot keys.
translation: 好的，有价值的物品现在将被发送到您的战利品钥匙中。 [hao de ， you jia zhi de wu pin xian zai jiang bei fa song dao nin de zhan li pin yao shi zhong 。]

english: Currently, if you were to have valuable items drop to the floor, they'd need to be worth at least [number]gp. What do you want to change that value to?
translation: 目前，如果你想让有价值的物品掉落到地板上，它们的价值至少需要[number]gp。您想将该值更改为什么？ [mu qian ， ru guo ni xiang rang you jia zhi de wu pin diao luo dao di ban shang ， ta men de jia zhi zhi shao xu yao [number]gp。 nin xiang jiang gai zhi geng gai wei shen me ？]

english: Hmph. Yeah, real funny, wise guy.
translation: 哼。是的，真是个有趣又聪明的人。 [heng 。 shi de ， zhen shi ge you qu you cong ming de ren 。]

english: Ok, now items worth at least [entered amount]gp will drop to the floor.
translation: 好的，现在价值至少 [输入的金额]gp 的物品将会掉落到地板上。 [hao de ， xian zai jia zhi zhi shao  [ shu ru de jin e ]gp  de wu pin jiang hui diao luo dao di ban shang 。]

english: How much loot have I claimed?
translation: 我领取了多少战利品？ [wo ling qu le duo shao zhan li pin ？]

english: Well, seeing as you haven't claimed a key yet, I reckon you've claimed a total of 0gp worth of loot.
translation: 好吧，既然你还没有领取钥匙，我估计你已经领取了总共价值 0gp 的战利品。 [hao ba ， ji ran ni hai mei you ling qu yao shi ， wo gu ji ni yi jing ling qu le zong gong jia zhi  0gp  de zhan li pin 。]

english: You've claimed 1 key, containing loot worth about [number]gp. I haven't seen you destroy anything of value yet, though.
translation: 您已领取 1 把钥匙，其中包含价值约 [number]gp 的战利品。不过我还没见过你毁掉任何有价值的东西。 [nin yi ling qu  1  ba yao shi ， qi zhong bao han jia zhi yue  [number]gp  de zhan li pin 。 bu guo wo hai mei jian guo ni hui diao ren he you jia zhi de dong xi 。]

english: You've claimed 1 key, containing loot worth about [number]gp, and you destroyed everything of value.
translation: 您已领取一把钥匙，其中包含价值约 [number]gp 的战利品，并且您毁坏了所有有价值的东西。 [nin yi ling qu yi ba yao shi ， qi zhong bao han jia zhi yue  [number]gp  de zhan li pin ， bing qie nin hui huai le suo you you jia zhi de dong xi 。]

english: You've claimed [number] keys, containing loot worth about [number]gp. I haven't seen you destroy anything of value yet, though.
translation: 您已领取 [number] 个钥匙，其中包含价值约 [number] gp 的战利品。不过我还没见过你毁掉任何有价值的东西。 [nin yi ling qu  [number]  ge yao shi ， qi zhong bao han jia zhi yue  [number] gp  de zhan li pin 。 bu guo wo hai mei jian guo ni hui diao ren he you jia zhi de dong xi 。]

english: You've claimed [number] keys, containing loot worth about [number]gp. You've destroyed [number]gp worth of it.
translation: 您已领取 [number] 个钥匙，其中包含价值约 [number] gp 的战利品。你已经毁掉了价值[number]gp的东西。 [nin yi ling qu  [number]  ge yao shi ， qi zhong bao han jia zhi yue  [number] gp  de zhan li pin 。 ni yi jing hui diao le jia zhi [number]gp de dong xi 。]

english: You've claimed [number] keys, containing loot worth about [number]gp, and you destroyed everything of value.
translation: 您已领取了 [number] 个钥匙，其中包含价值约 [number] gp 的战利品，并且您毁坏了所有有价值的东西。 [nin yi ling qu le  [number]  ge yao shi ， qi zhong bao han jia zhi yue  [number] gp  de zhan li pin ， bing qie nin hui huai le suo you you jia zhi de dong xi 。]

english: Who are you, exactly?
translation: 你到底是谁？ [ni dao di shi shui ？]

english: Ah, used to be an adventurer like you, I guess. Used to roam the world, killing monsters for a living. 'Cept then, I discovered the Wilderness.
translation: 啊，我想，曾经也是和你一样的冒险家吧。曾经浪迹天地，以杀怪为生。 '除此之外，我发现了荒野。 [a ， wo xiang ， ceng jing ye shi he ni yi yang de mao xian jia ba 。 ceng jing lang ji tian di ， yi sha guai wei sheng 。 ' chu ci zhi wai ， wo fa xian le huang ye 。]

english: Used to take on anyone and everyone who stood in me way, and made myself a small fortune doing it too.
translation: 曾经与任何阻碍我的人较量，并因此为自己赚了一笔小钱。 [ceng jing yu ren he zu ai wo de ren jiao liang ， bing yin ci wei zi ji zhuan le yi bi xiao qian 。]

english: It's how I got the name, used to go anywhere and everywhere with a skull over my head!
translation: 这就是我这个名字的由来，以前我总是戴着骷髅头去任何地方！ [zhe jiu shi wo zhe ge ming zi de you lai ， yi qian wo zong shi dai zhe ku lou tou qu ren he di fang ！]

english: So how'd you end up like... this?
translation: 那你怎么会变成这样？ [na ni zen me hui bian cheng zhe yang ？]

english: Ah, you live a life feeding on others, eventually something higher up the food chain finds you.
translation: 啊，你过着以他人为食的生活，最终食物链上层的东西找到了你。 [a ， ni guo zhe yi ta ren wei shi de sheng huo ， zui zhong shi wu lian shang ceng de dong xi zhao dao le ni 。]

english: I used to have a hidden outpost out near the Bone Yard, somewhere to keep my stuff in an emergency. One day all I come back to is a smouldering pile of rubble.
translation: 我曾经在骨头场附近有一个隐藏的前哨站，可以在紧急情况下存放我的东西。有一天，我回来时看到的只是一堆闷烧的瓦砾。 [wo ceng jing zai gu tou chang fu jin you yi ge yin cang de qian shao zhan ， ke yi zai jin ji qing kuang xia cun fang wo de dong xi 。 you yi tian ， wo hui lai shi kan dao de zhi shi yi dui men shao de wa li 。]

english: Next thing I know, someone's snuck up behind me and has put a spear through my back.
translation: 接下来我知道，有人偷偷溜到我身后，用长矛刺穿了我的背。 [jie xia lai wo zhi dao ， you ren tou tou liu dao wo shen hou ， yong chang mao ci chuan le wo de bei 。]

english: And you survived?!
translation: 而你却活了下来？！ [er ni que huo le xia lai ？！]

english: Always carry a ring of life, friend! Never know when you'll need it.
translation: 永远带着生命之戒，朋友！永远不知道什么时候你会需要它。 [yong yuan dai zhe sheng ming zhi jie ， peng you ！ yong yuan bu zhi dao shen me shi hou ni hui xu yao ta 。]

english: Still, the damage was done. Everything I ever owned up in smoke, and even though the wound's fully healed, I can still feel that spear in my back to this day.
translation: 尽管如此，损害已经造成。我曾经拥有的一切都化为泡影，尽管伤口已经完全愈合，但直到今天我仍然能感觉到那根长矛插在我的背上。 [jin guan ru ci ， sun hai yi jing zao cheng 。 wo ceng jing yong you de yi qie dou hua wei pao ying ， jin guan shang kou yi jing wan quan yu he ， dan zhi dao jin tian wo reng ran neng gan jue dao na gen chang mao cha zai wo de bei shang 。]

english: Thankfully, Ferox was kind enough to take me in, and I managed to repurpose some of my old storage magic for adventurers like you.
translation: 值得庆幸的是，费罗克斯很友善地接纳了我，我成功地为像你这样的冒险家重新利用了一些旧的存储魔法。 [zhi de qing xing de shi ， fei luo ke si hen you shan di jie na le wo ， wo cheng gong di wei xiang ni zhe yang de mao xian jia chong xin li yong le yi xie jiu de cun chu mo fa 。]

english: But why come back to the Wilderness?
translation: 但为什么要回到荒野呢？ [dan wei shen me yao hui dao huang ye ne ？]

english: What, go lifea normal life behind a shop counter so I can pedalswamp paste for a living instead? I'll pass!
translation: 什么，在商店柜台后面过正常的生活，这样我就可以踩沼泽糊为生了？我会通过！ [shen me ， zai shang dian gui tai hou mian guo zheng chang de sheng huo ， zhe yang wo jiu ke yi cai zhao ze hu wei sheng le ？ wo hui tong guo ！]

english: Anyhow, enough about me. What can I do for you?
translation: 无论如何，关于我就足够了。我能为你做什么？ [wu lun ru he ， guan yu wo jiu zu gou le 。 wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: I'll be here if you need anything.
translation: 如果你需要什么我就在这里。 [ru guo ni xu yao shen me wo jiu zai zhe li 。]

english: Don't waste my time trying to change settings on a thing you haven't bought yet!
translation: 不要浪费我的时间尝试更改您尚未购买的东西的设置！ [bu yao lang fei wo de shi jian chang shi geng gai nin shang wei gou mai de dong xi de she zhi ！]

english: I know you Iron people are weird about taking other people's stuff, so if you just wanna have the chest destroy it all, that's fine by me.
translation: 我知道你们铁人对于拿别人的东西很奇怪，所以如果你们只是想让箱子毁掉一切，我没问题。 [wo zhi dao ni men tie ren dui yu na bie ren de dong xi hen qi guai ， suo yi ru guo ni men zhi shi xiang rang xiang zi hui diao yi qie ， wo mei wen ti 。]

english: Except the food. I'm eating that instead.
translation: 除了食物。我正在吃那个。 [chu le shi wu 。 wo zheng zai chi na ge 。]

english: Sorry mate, can't run the Loot Chest on a Deadman World.
translation: 抱歉，伙计，无法在亡灵世界中运行战利品箱。 [bao qian ， huo ji ， wu fa zai wang ling shi jie zhong yun xing zhan li pin xiang 。]

english: How does the chest work?
translation: 胸部如何运作？ [xiong bu ru he yun zuo ？]

english: Can I have access to the chest?
translation: 我可以接触胸部吗？ [wo ke yi jie chu xiong bu ma ？]

english: Sure, I'll pay for that.
translation: 当然，我会为此付费。 [dang ran ， wo hui wei ci fu fei 。]

english: Yes, pay 1 million coins!
translation: 是的，支付100万金币！ [shi de ， zhi fu 100 wan jin bi ！]

english: No, I've changed my mind!
translation: 不，我改变主意了！ [bu ， wo gai bian zhu yi le ！]

english: Not right now, thanks.
translation: 现在不行，谢谢。 [xian zai bu xing ， xie xie 。]

english: How much?!
translation: 多少？！ [duo shao ？！]

english: Can I change how these loot keys work?
translation: 我可以更改这些战利品钥匙的工作方式吗？ [wo ke yi geng gai zhe xie zhan li pin yao shi de gong zuo fang shi ma ？]

english: Turn loot keys off
translation: 关闭战利品钥匙 [guan bi zhan li pin yao shi]

english: Turn loot keys on
translation: 打开战利品钥匙 [da kai zhan li pin yao shi]

english: Drop food to floor
translation: 将食物扔到地板上 [jiang shi wu reng dao di ban shang]

english: Send food to loot key
translation: 将食物发送到战利品钥匙 [jiang shi wu fa song dao zhan li pin yao shi]

english: Drop valuables to floor
translation: 将贵重物品扔到地板上 [jiang gui zhong wu pin reng dao di ban shang]

english: Send valuables to loot key
translation: 将贵重物品发送到战利品钥匙 [jiang gui zhong wu pin fa song dao zhan li pin yao shi]

english: Change valuable item threshold
translation: 更改贵重物品阈值 [geng gai gui zhong wu pin yu zhi]

english: How much loot have I claimed?
translation: 我领取了多少战利品？ [wo ling qu le duo shao zhan li pin ？]

english: Who are you, exactly?
translation: 你到底是谁？ [ni dao di shi shui ？]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Eating me... they keep eating me! Eating me from the inside! Please stop them! I can feel them wriggling around inside me right now... please stop them!
translation: 吃我……他们一直吃我！从里面吃掉我！请阻止他们！我现在能感觉到它们在我体内蠕动……请阻止它们！ [chi wo …… ta men yi zhi chi wo ！ cong li mian chi diao wo ！ qing zu zhi ta men ！ wo xian zai neng gan jue dao ta men zai wo ti nei ru dong …… qing zu zhi ta men ！]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Blood, blood... never enough blood to go round. When I lift up my arm like this, it all pours back into my body.
translation: 血，血……血永远不够流。当我像这样抬起手臂时，所有的力量都会倒回我的体内。 [xue ， xue …… xue yong yuan bu gou liu 。 dang wo xiang zhe yang tai qi shou bi shi ， suo you de li liang du hui dao hui wo de ti nei 。]

english: I hope it remembers to go back inside my arm. And don't even ask me about my legs... how much blood are they going to need?
translation: 我希望它记得回到我的手臂里。甚至不要问我的腿……它们需要多少血？ [wo xi wang ta ji de hui dao wo de shou bi li 。 shen zhi bu yao wen wo de tui …… ta men xu yao duo shao xue ？]

english: Blood is important. We must offer it to Zamorak every day as proof of our devotion. I just hope I don't run out!
translation: 血很重要。我们必须每天将它献给萨莫拉克，作为我们奉献的证明。我只希望我不要用完！ [xue hen zhong yao 。 wo men bi xu mei tian jiang ta xian gei sa mo la ke ， zuo wei wo men feng xian de zheng ming 。 wo zhi xi wang wo bu yao yong wan ！]

english: Hello, are you okay?
translation: 你好，你还好吗？ [ni hao ， ni hai hao ma ？]

english: Oh yes, you're a fine one. Nice red cheeks, shiny hair.
translation: 哦，是的，你是个好人。红润的脸颊，闪亮的头发。 [o ， shi de ， ni shi ge hao ren 。 hong run de lian jia ， shan liang de tou fa 。]

english: Let's see now, some potatoes, some cabbage... Maybe half a clove of garlic...
translation: 现在让我们看看，一些土豆，一些卷心菜......也许半瓣大蒜...... [xian zai rang wo men kan kan ， yi xie tu dou ， yi xie juan xin cai ...... ye xu ban ban da suan ......]

english: Yes I think you'd make a fine soup. You don't mind do you?
translation: 是的，我想你会做一道好汤。你不介意吧？ [shi de ， wo xiang ni hui zuo yi dao hao tang 。 ni bu jie yi ba ？]

english: Actually I do.
translation: 事实上我确实如此。 [shi shi shang wo que shi ru ci 。]

english: You're welcome to have some with me of course...
translation: 当然，欢迎你和我一起吃一些...... [dang ran ， huan ying ni he wo yi qi chi yi xie ......]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Mwaarrr fnnntchh. Gbpp dng sktd delp?
translation: Mwaarrr fnnntchh。 Gbpp dng sktd delp？ [Mwaarrr fnnntchh。 Gbpp dng sktd delp？]

english: Pardon?
translation: 赦免？ [she mian ？]

english: Kjp lar falut: Gbpp dng sktd delp?
translation: Kjp lar falut: Gbpp dng sktd delp? [Kjp lar falut: Gbpp dng sktd delp?]

english: Sorry, I don't under..
translation: 抱歉，我不下.. [bao qian ， wo bu xia ..]

english: Mwaarrr fnnntchh. Gbpp dng sktd delp? GBPP DNG SKTD DELP!
translation: Mwaarrr fnnntchh。 Gbpp dng sktd delp？ GBPP DNG SKTD DELP！ [Mwaarrr fnnntchh。 Gbpp dng sktd delp？ GBPP DNG SKTD DELP！]

english: Hello...
translation: 你好... [ni hao ...]

english: Kill the villagers, burn them all... every last one! I want nothing to survive... nothing but the sweet smell of burning flesh...
translation: 杀死村民，烧死他们……每一个！我什么都不想活下去……除了燃烧肉体的甜味…… [sha si cun min ， shao si ta men …… mei yi ge ！ wo shen me dou bu xiang huo xia qu …… chu le ran shao rou ti de tian wei ……]

english: You're ill!
translation: 你有病吧！ [ni you bing ba ！]

english: What's that? You've never smelt it before? Well, let's just say that it's an acquired taste...
translation: 那是什么？你以前从未闻过吗？好吧，我们只能说这是一种后天养成的品味...... [na shi shen me ？ ni yi qian cong wei wen guo ma ？ hao ba ， wo men zhi neng shuo zhe shi yi zhong hou tian yang cheng de pin wei ......]

english: Danger, everywhere danger! But not from man nor beast! This is the danger that is inside you.
translation: 危险，无处不在的危险！但不是来自人或兽！这就是你内心的危险。 [wei xian ， wu chu bu zai de wei xian ！ dan bu shi lai zi ren huo shou ！ zhe jiu shi ni nei xin de wei xian 。]

english: Bring it out, nurture it, cherish it. Stroke it like you would stroke a wounded bird... then strangle it before it takes hold of your very being. Don't say I didn't warn you.
translation: 把它拿出来，培育它，珍惜它。像抚摸一只受伤的鸟一样抚摸它……然后在它抓住你的生命之前勒死它。别说我没有警告过你。 [ba ta na chu lai ， pei yu ta ， zhen xi ta 。 xiang fu mo yi zhi shou shang de niao yi yang fu mo ta …… ran hou zai ta zhua zhu ni de sheng ming zhi qian lei si ta 。 bie shuo wo mei you jing gao guo ni 。]

english: What's that... Is that a dagger I see before me? Why should I bear the slings and arrows of outrageous fortune.
translation: 那是什么……我眼前看到的是一把匕首吗？我何必承受命运的毒箭。 [na shi shen me …… wo yan qian kan dao de shi yi ba bi shou ma ？ wo he bi cheng shou ming yun de du jian 。]

english: For what is a man but this quintessence of dust? And so I say goodnight sweet prince. The rest is silence.
translation: 人除了尘埃的精华还能是什么？所以我说晚安亲爱的王子。剩下的就是沉默。 [ren chu le chen ai de jing hua hai neng shi shen me ？ suo yi wo shuo wan an qin ai de wang zi 。 sheng xia de jiu shi chen mo 。]

english: Hello. Are you here for my black dragons?
translation: 你好。你是为了我的黑龙而来吗？ [ni hao 。 ni shi wei le wo de hei long er lai ma ？]

english: I have a Slayer assignment to kill those, yes.
translation: 我有一个杀手任务来杀死那些，是的。 [wo you yi ge sha shou ren wu lai sha si na xie ， shi de 。]

english: Fair enough. Do what you have to do.
translation: 很公平。做你必须做的事。 [hen gong ping 。 zuo ni bi xu zuo de shi 。]

english: They're not my Slayer target.
translation: 他们不是我的杀手目标。 [ta men bu shi wo de sha shou mu biao 。]

english: Oh, good. In that case you're welcome to go and admire them, but don't get any ideas about killing them.
translation: 哦，很好。在这种情况下，欢迎你去欣赏它们，但不要产生任何杀死它们的想法。 [o ， hen hao 。 zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， huan ying ni qu xin shang ta men ， dan bu yao chan sheng ren he sha si ta men de xiang fa 。]

english: Why are you here asking about that?
translation: 你为什么在这里问这个？ [ni wei shen me zai zhe li wen zhe ge ？]

english: Because I like my black dragons, and I had to work hard to get access to their lair, and I don't want people using them for training without a reason.
translation: 因为我喜欢我的黑龙，我必须努力才能进入它们的巢穴，而且我不希望人们无缘无故地用它们来训练。 [yin wei wo xi huan wo de hei long ， wo bi xu nu li cai neng jin ru ta men de chao xue ， er qie wo bu xi wang ren men wu yuan wu gu di yong ta men lai xun lian 。]

english: So if one of the Slayer Masters sent you to slay black dragons, that's fine, but otherwise you should go and train elsewhere.
translation: 因此，如果一位屠戮大师派你去屠宰黑龙，那很好，但否则你应该去其他地方训练。 [yin ci ， ru guo yi wei tu lu da shi pai ni qu tu zai hei long ， na hen hao ， dan fou ze ni ying gai qu qi ta di fang xun lian 。]

english: I'd rather people didn't train on my dragons at all, but I've got a distant cousin who's a Slayer Master, so I've got to support the family business.
translation: 我宁愿人们根本不训练我的龙，但我有一个远房表弟，他是屠夫大师，所以我必须支持家族生意。 [wo ning yuan ren men gen ben bu xun lian wo de long ， dan wo you yi ge yuan fang biao di ， ta shi tu fu da shi ， suo yi wo bi xu zhi chi jia zu sheng yi 。]

english: Excuse me, I've got to go.
translation: 对不起，我得走了。 [dui bu qi ， wo de zou le 。]

english: Hey, go and train somewhere else! I'm not having people mess with my dragons unless a Slayer Master's told them to do it.
translation: 嘿，去别的地方训练吧！我不会让人扰乱我的龙，除非屠夫大师告诉他们这样做。 [hei ， qu bie de di fang xun lian ba ！ wo bu hui rang ren rao luan wo de long ， chu fei tu fu da shi gao su ta men zhe yang zuo 。]

english: I have a Slayer assignment to kill those, yes.
translation: 我有一个杀手任务来杀死那些，是的。 [wo you yi ge sha shou ren wu lai sha si na xie ， shi de 。]

english: They're not my Slayer target.
translation: 他们不是我的杀手目标。 [ta men bu shi wo de sha shou mu biao 。]

english: Why are you here asking about that?
translation: 你为什么在这里问这个？ [ni wei shen me zai zhe li wen zhe ge ？]

english: Excuse me, I've got to go.
translation: 对不起，我得走了。 [dui bu qi ， wo de zou le 。]

english: Ah don' talk to humans! Yous wanna talk, talk to da boss!
translation: 啊，不要和人类说话！你想说话就跟老板说话吧！ [a ， bu yao he ren lei shuo hua ！ ni xiang shuo hua jiu gen lao ban shuo hua ba ！]

english: He's too busy playing some succulent beats to stop and talk.
translation: 他正忙着演奏一些动听的节奏，没有时间停下来说话。 [ta zheng mang zhe yan zou yi xie dong ting de jie zou ， mei you shi jian ting xia lai shuo hua 。]

english: Ahhh, hello there, [player name].
translation: 啊哈，你好，[玩家姓名]。 [a ha ， ni hao ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Can you tell me a bit about skillcapes?
translation: 你能告诉我一些关于技能的信息吗？ [ni neng gao su wo yi xie guan yu ji neng de xin xi ma ？]

english: Sure. You can buy a skillcape when you reach level 99 in a skill. Apart from boosting your statistics in that skill, they can also be used to perform some pretty amazing emotes!
translation: 当然。当你的技能达到99级时，你可以购买技能斗篷。除了提高该技能的统计数据之外，它们还可以用来执行一些非常惊人的表情！ [dang ran 。 dang ni de ji neng da dao 99 ji shi ， ni ke yi gou mai ji neng dou peng 。 chu le ti gao gai ji neng de tong ji shu ju zhi wai ， ta men hai ke yi yong lai zhi xing yi xie fei chang jing ren de biao qing ！]

english: The Cape of Strength also provides you with unlimited teleports to our guild. Is there anything else you would like to know?
translation: 力量海角还为您提供无限传送到我们公会的机会。您还有什么想知道的吗？ [li liang hai jiao hai wei nin ti gong wu xian chuan song dao wo men gong hui de ji hui 。 nin hai you shen me xiang zhi dao de ma ？]

english: What can I do here?
translation: 我在这里能做什么？ [wo zai zhe li neng zuo shen me ？]

english: Ahh, the shot put is a great test of strength and can be quite rewarding. Mind you do it properly though, you might want to dust your hands with some powdery substance first. It'll give better grip.
translation: 啊，铅球是对体力的极大考验，而且收获颇丰。不过请注意，操作得当，您可能需要先在手上撒上一些粉末状物质。它会提供更好的抓地力。 [a ， qian qiu shi dui ti li de ji da kao yan ， er qie shou huo po feng 。 bu guo qing zhu yi ， cao zuo de dang ， nin ke neng xu yao xian zai shou shang sa shang yi xie fen mo zhuang wu zhi 。 ta hui ti gong geng hao de zhua di li 。]

english: I'll remember that. What should I use?
translation: 我会记住这一点。我应该用什么？ [wo hui ji zhu zhe yi dian 。 wo ying gai yong shen me ？]

english: I personally prefer ground ashes, it makes a nice fine powder and gives some really good grip.
translation: 我个人更喜欢磨碎的灰烬，它可以制成很好的细粉末，并且具有很好的抓地力。 [wo ge ren geng xi huan mo sui de hui jin ， ta ke yi zhi cheng hen hao de xi fen mo ， bing qie ju you hen hao de zhua di li 。]

english: Ok, what else?
translation: 好吧，还有什么？ [hao ba ， hai you shen me ？]

english: Basically you'll need to go in there, make sure you've got nothing cluttering up your hands, pick up a shot and throw it.... depending upon your technique, you can get quite long throws.
translation: 基本上，你需要进去，确保你的手上没有任何杂物，拿起一个球并投掷……根据你的技术，你可以投出相当长的投球。 [ji ben shang ， ni xu yao jin qu ， que bao ni de shou shang mei you ren he za wu ， na qi yi ge qiu bing tou zhi …… gen ju ni de ji shu ， ni ke yi tou chu xiang dang zhang de tou qiu 。]

english: What was your best?
translation: 你最好的是什么？ [ni zui hao de shi shen me ？]

english: Ahh that would be telling...
translation: 啊啊，这样的话就说明了... [a a ， zhe yang de hua jiu shuo ming le ...]

english: That's a big axe!
translation: 那是一把大斧头！ [na shi yi ba da fu tou ！]

english: Yes indeed it is. Have to be mighty strong to wield it too.
translation: 是的，确实如此。也必须非常强大才能使用它。 [shi de ， que shi ru ci 。 ye bi xu fei chang qiang da cai neng shi yong ta 。]

english: But you don't look that strong!
translation: 但你看起来没那么坚强！ [dan ni kan qi lai mei na me jian qiang ！]

english: Maybe, maybe not, but I still had to beat a Barbarian to get it. Mind you, usually they don't part with them. This was an unusual circumstance.
translation: 也许，也许不是，但我仍然必须击败野蛮人才能得到它。请注意，通常他们不会与他们分开。这是一个不寻常的情况。 [ye xu ， ye xu bu shi ， dan wo reng ran bi xu ji bai ye man ren cai neng de dao ta 。 qing zhu yi ， tong chang ta men bu hui yu ta men fen kai 。 zhe shi yi ge bu xun chang de qing kuang 。]

english: Oh?
I bet him he couldn't catch a squirrel whilst still holding his axe but that I could... and that if I won I'd get his axe.
translation: 我跟他打赌，他拿着斧头的时候抓不到松鼠，但我可以……如果我赢了，我就能得到他的斧头。 [wo gen ta da du ， ta na zhe fu tou de shi hou zhua bu dao song shu ， dan wo ke yi …… ru guo wo ying le ， wo jiu neng de dao ta de fu tou 。]

english: What happened?
translation: 发生了什么？ [fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: He went running after the squirrel... nearly caught it too... it shot up a tree and he tried to climb up it, only got a bit tangled up with his axe cause he couldn't hang on to it at the same time... he fell out of the tree and it
translation: 他追着松鼠跑……差点也抓住了它……松鼠从树上飞了起来，他试图爬上去，只是被他的斧头缠住了，因为他无法同时抓住它……他从树上掉了下来，它 [ta zhui zhe song shu pao …… cha dian ye zhua zhu le ta …… song shu cong shu shang fei le qi lai ， ta shi tu pa shang qu ， zhi shi bei ta de fu tou chan zhu le ， yin wei ta wu fa tong shi zhua zhu ta …… ta cong shu shang diao le xia lai ， ta]

english: was my turn....
translation: 轮到我了…… [lun dao wo le ……]

english: I simply went and chopped the tree down with this big old axe, still holding it. The squirrel was so petrified it simply jumped straight out of the tree onto me, I won the axe and let the poor creature go!
translation: 我只是去用这把旧大斧子砍倒了那棵树，还拿着它。松鼠吓坏了，它直接从树上跳到我身上，我赢得了斧头，放走了这个可怜的生物！ [wo zhi shi qu yong zhe ba jiu da fu zi kan dao le na ke shu ， hai na zhe ta 。 song shu xia huai le ， ta zhi jie cong shu shang tiao dao wo shen shang ， wo ying de le fu tou ， fang zou le zhe ge ke lian de sheng wu ！]

english: I sense a moral in there somewhere.
translation: 我在某处感受到了道德。 [wo zai mou chu gan shou dao le dao de 。]

english: Aye indeed. Brawn isn't all you need to wield a big axe, brains are required too!
translation: 确实是的。挥舞大斧不仅需要体力，还需要大脑！ [que shi shi de 。 hui wu da fu bu jin xu yao ti li ， hai xu yao da nao ！]

english: May I claim my tokens please?
translation: 我可以领取我的代币吗？ [wo ke yi ling qu wo de dai bi ma ？]

english: I'm afraid you have not earned any tokens yet. Try some of the activities around the guild to earn some.
translation: 恐怕您还没有获得任何代币。尝试公会周围的一些活动来赚取一些钱。 [kong pa nin hai mei you huo de ren he dai bi 。 chang shi gong hui zhou wei de yi xie huo dong lai zhuan qu yi xie qian 。]

english: Ok, I'll go see what I can find.
translation: 好吧，我去看看我能找到什么。 [hao ba ， wo qu kan kan wo neng zhao dao shen me 。]

english: You don't have space to carry them.
translation: 你没有空间来携带它们。 [ni mei you kong jian lai xie dai ta men 。]

english: Of course! Here you go, you've earned [amount] tokens!
translation: 当然！在这里，您已经获得了[数量]个代币！ [dang ran ！ zai zhe li ， nin yi jing huo de le [ shu liang ] ge dai bi ！]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Be well, warrior [player name].
translation: 一切都好，战士[玩家名字]。 [yi qie dou hao ， zhan shi [ wan jia ming zi ]。]

english: Ah, but I can see you are already as strong as is possible! Perhaps you have come to me to purchase a Cape of Strength, and thus join the elite few who have mastered this exacting skill?
translation: 啊，不过我看得出你已经很强了！也许你来找我是为了购买力量斗篷，从而加入掌握这项严格技能的少数精英行列？ [a ， bu guo wo kan de chu ni yi jing hen qiang le ！ ye xu ni lai zhao wo shi wei le gou mai li liang dou peng ， cong er jia ru zhang wo zhe xiang yan ge ji neng de shao shu jing ying hang lie ？]

english: As an additional recognition of your achievement, the Cape of Strength can teleport you to our guild.
translation: 作为对你成就的额外认可，力量斗篷可以将你传送到我们的公会。 [zuo wei dui ni cheng jiu de e wai ren ke ， li liang dou peng ke yi jiang ni chuan song dao wo men de gong hui 。]

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: 请问我可以再给我的披风戴上兜帽吗？ [qing wen wo ke yi zai gei wo de pi feng dai shang dou mao ma ？]

english: You don't appear to have enough space in your inventory, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 您的库存似乎没有足够的空间，当您有足够的空间时请回来见我。 [nin de ku cun si hu mei you zu gou de kong jian ， dang nin you zu gou de kong jian shi qing hui lai jian wo 。]

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
translation: 毫无疑问，而且免费！ [hao wu yi wen ， er qie mian fei ！]

english: May I buy a Skillcape of Strength, please?
translation: 请问我可以购买力量技能斗篷吗？ [qing wen wo ke yi gou mai li liang ji neng dou peng ma ？]

english: Hmm, yes, you certainly look strong enough. That'll be 99000 gold coins, please.
translation: 嗯，是的，你看起来确实足够坚强。那就99000金币吧。 [n ， shi de ， ni kan qi lai que shi zu gou jian qiang 。 na jiu 99000 jin bi ba 。]

english: Sorry, that's just too much to pay.
translation: 抱歉，付的钱太多了。 [bao qian ， fu de qian tai duo le 。]

english: Not at all; there are many other adventurers who would love the opportunity to purchase such a prestigious item! You can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: 一点也不;还有许多其他冒险家希望有机会购买如此享有盛誉的物品！如果你改变主意，可以在这里找到我。 [yi dian ye bu ; hai you xu duo qi ta mao xian jia xi wang you ji hui gou mai ru ci xiang you sheng yu de wu pin ！ ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， ke yi zai zhe li zhao dao wo 。]

english: Sure.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 但不幸的是，我身上没有足够的钱。 [dan bu xing de shi ， wo shen shang mei you zu gou de qian 。]

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 好吧，等你回来了就回来见我吧。 [hao ba ， deng ni hui lai le jiu hui lai jian wo ba 。]

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 不幸的是，所有技能斗篷都只提供免费兜帽，这是技能升级交易的一部分；买一送一，你懂的。因此，在我向您出售一件之前，您需要释放一些库存空间。 [bu xing de shi ， suo you ji neng dou peng dou zhi ti gong mian fei dou mao ， zhe shi ji neng sheng ji jiao yi de yi bu fen ； mai yi song yi ， ni dong de 。 yin ci ， zai wo xiang nin chu shou yi jian zhi qian ， nin xu yao shi fang yi xie ku cun kong jian 。]

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: 出色的！我的朋友，自豪地穿上那件斗篷。 [chu se de ！ wo de peng you ， zi hao di chuan shang na jian dou peng 。]

english: Can you tell me a bit about skillcapes?
translation: 你能告诉我一些关于技能的信息吗？ [ni neng gao su wo yi xie guan yu ji neng de xin xi ma ？]

translation: 我在这里能做什么？ [wo zai zhe li neng zuo shen me ？]

translation: 那是一把大斧头！ [na shi yi ba da fu tou ！]

translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

translation: 你不是很爱说话吗？ [ni bu shi hen ai shuo hua ma ？]

english: Nope.
translation: 没有。 [mei you 。]

english: I'll be off then.
translation: 那我就走了。 [na wo jiu zou le 。]

english: Yup.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: The blue fish leap northwards at dawn..
translation: 黎明时分，蓝色的鱼向北跳跃。 [li ming shi fen ， lan se de yu xiang bei tiao yue 。]

english: Oranges are not the only fruit.
translation: 橙子不是唯一的水果。 [cheng zi bu shi wei yi de shui guo 。]

english: The cabbages bloom in the spring.
translation: 白菜在春天开花。 [bai cai zai chun tian kai hua 。]

english: My cows produce milk in the evening.
translation: 我的奶牛在晚上产奶。 [wo de nai niu zai wan shang chan nai 。]

english: I bought an aardvark from Ardougne market.
translation: 我从阿杜涅市场买了一只土豚。 [wo cong a du nie shi chang mai le yi zhi tu tun 。]

english: Yellow balloons are heavier in boxes.
translation: 黄色气球放在盒子里更重。 [huang se qi qiu fang zai he zi li geng zhong 。]

english: ...err...sprockets wangle burps in the forked flan.
translation: ...呃...链轮在叉状果馅饼中发出打嗝声。 [... e ... lian lun zai cha zhuang guo xian bing zhong fa chu da ge sheng 。]

translation: 不，不是真的。 [bu ， bu shi zhen de 。]

english: It rains frogs during the Winter in Neitiznot.
translation: 内蒂兹诺特的冬天会下青蛙雨。 [nei di zi nuo te de dong tian hui xia qing wa yu 。]

translation: （继续“橙子不是唯一的水果”） [（ ji xu “ cheng zi bu shi wei yi de shui guo ”）]

english: Free stuff please.
translation: 免费的东西请。 [mian fei de dong xi qing 。]

english: Ah, Operative Budgie. Welcome to the island.
translation: 啊，虎皮鹦鹉特工。欢迎来到岛上。 [a ， hu pi ying wu te gong 。 huan ying lai dao dao shang 。]

english: Budgie? That's not my name, you can call me-
translation: 虎皮鹦鹉？这不是我的名字，你可以叫我—— [hu pi ying wu ？ zhe bu shi wo de ming zi ， ni ke yi jiao wo ——]

translation: 嘘！ [xu ！]

english: No names! Names are unnecessary. Loose lives cost tongues.

english: I'm waiting here hoping that someone can guide me to the Paterdomus, the temple on the Salve.
translation: 我在这里等待，希望有人能带我去帕特多莫斯（Paterdomus），萨尔夫河上的神庙。 [wo zai zhe li deng dai ， xi wang you ren neng dai wo qu pa te duo mo si （Paterdomus）， sa er fu he shang de shen miao 。]

english: Where is Paterdomus?
translation: 帕特多莫斯在哪里？ [pa te duo mo si zai na li ？]

english: Oh, Paterdomus is that rather impressive looking temple on the Salve... I'm sure you must have passed it on your way into Morytania.
translation: 哦，帕特多莫斯是萨尔夫岛上那座看起来相当令人印象深刻的神庙……我相信你在前往莫里塔尼亚的路上一定经过了它。 [o ， pa te duo mo si shi sa er fu dao shang na zuo kan qi lai xiang dang ling ren yin xiang shen ke de shen miao …… wo xiang xin ni zai qian wang mo li ta ni ya de lu shang yi ding jing guo le ta 。]

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
translation: 你为什么要去帕特多莫斯？ [ni wei shen me yao qu pa te duo mo si ？]

english: I'm hoping to get back to civilisation and see what the lands of Misthalin look like.

translation: 哦真的吗？那太好了！到达目的地后我会给你一个小奖励。 [o zhen de ma ？ na tai hao le ！ dao da mu di di hou wo hui gei ni yi ge xiao jiang li 。]
