translation: 然后他在卡拉姆贾海岸与税务人员的战斗中失去了右手。 [ran hou ta zai ka la mu jia hai an yu shui wu ren yuan de zhan dou zhong shi qu le you shou 。]

english: Not bein' the sort to lie about mopin', he asked me to make him a cutlass with a brass gauntlet fixed to the handle, and rig it up with a load of straps so he could keep fightin'.
translation: 他不是那种在莫平问题上撒谎的人，他让我给他做一把弯刀，把黄铜手套固定在手柄上，并用一堆带子绑起来，这样他就可以继续战斗。 [ta bu shi na zhong zai mo ping wen ti shang sa huang de ren ， ta rang wo gei ta zuo yi ba wan dao ， ba huang tong shou tao gu ding zai shou bing shang ， bing yong yi dui dai zi bang qi lai ， zhe yang ta jiu ke yi ji xu zhan dou 。]

english: He's a great man is Harry, but he keeps snappin' the straps while he's at sea, so he sells the cutlasses back to me in exchange for a new one.
translation: 哈利是一个伟大的人，但他在海上时总是拉断带子，所以他把弯刀卖回给我以换取一把新的。 [ha li shi yi ge wei da de ren ， dan ta zai hai shang shi zong shi la duan dai zi ， suo yi ta ba wan dao mai hui gei wo yi huan qu yi ba xin de 。]

english: It's quite a good blade, but the big, brass gauntlet is what makes it worthwhile. It's big enough to fit over even a real gauntlet, so ye get extra protection to yer sword hand.
translation: 这是一把相当不错的刀片，但巨大的黄铜手套让它物有所值。它足够大，甚至可以套在真正的手套上，因此您的剑手可以获得额外的保护。 [zhe shi yi ba xiang dang bu cuo de dao pian ， dan ju da de huang tong shou tao rang ta wu you suo zhi 。 ta zu gou da ， shen zhi ke yi tao zai zhen zheng de shou tao shang ， yin ci nin de jian shou ke yi huo de e wai de bao hu 。]

english: I can sell ye one fer 1040 coins.
translation: 我可以卖你一个1040个金币。 [wo ke yi mai ni yi ge 1040 ge jin bi 。]

english: Interested?
translation: 感兴趣的？ [gan xing qu de ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: Smart [lad/lass]! Come and see me when ye have the coins fer it.
translation: 聪明[小伙子/姑娘]！等你有硬币了就来见我吧。 [cong ming [ xiao huo zi / gu niang ]！ deng ni you ying bi le jiu lai jian wo ba 。]

english: Here ye go. I've got a load of these left over if ye need more.
translation: 来吧。如果你们需要更多的话，我还剩下一些。 [lai ba 。 ru guo ni men xu yao geng duo de hua ， wo hai sheng xia yi xie 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Well I'll still be here if ye change yer mind.
translation: 好吧，如果你改变主意，我仍然会在这里。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， wo reng ran hui zai zhe li 。]

english: Unlucky Jenkins' Lucky Cutlass.
translation: 不幸的詹金斯的幸运弯刀。 [bu xing de zhan jin si de xing yun wan dao 。]

english: Arr, tis a sad tale to this sword.
translation: 唉，这把剑是一个悲伤的故事。 [ai ， zhe ba jian shi yi ge bei shang de gu shi 。]

english: Jenkins was the lookout on the Jonah, a cursed vessel if there ever was one.
translation: 詹金斯是乔纳号的瞭望员，如果有的话，那是一艘被诅咒的船只。 [zhan jin si shi qiao na hao de liao wang yuan ， ru guo you de hua ， na shi yi sou bei zu zhou de chuan zhi 。]

english: One day his ship were attacked by another group of pirates durin' a fierce storm. One of their bowmen took a shot at the Cap'n of the vessel, but it were deflected off his compass and hit Jenkins in the back.
translation: 有一天，他的船在一场猛烈的风暴中遭到另一群海盗的袭击。他们的一名弓箭手向船长开了一枪，但子弹偏离了罗盘，击中了詹金斯的背部。 [you yi tian ， ta de chuan zai yi chang meng lie de feng bao zhong zao dao ling yi qun hai dao de xi ji 。 ta men de yi ming gong jian shou xiang chuan zhang kai le yi qiang ， dan zi dan pian li le luo pan ， ji zhong le zhan jin si de bei bu 。]

english: How unlucky!
translation: 多么不幸啊！ [duo me bu xing a ！]

english: That weren't the worst of it [lad/lass]. He survived the fight, and the ship's surgeon was trying to get the arrow out when...
translation: 这还不是最糟糕的[小伙子/姑娘]。他在战斗中幸存下来，船上的外科医生正试图把箭取出来，这时…… [zhe hai bu shi zui zao gao de [ xiao huo zi / gu niang ]。 ta zai zhan dou zhong xing cun xia lai ， chuan shang de wai ke yi sheng zheng shi tu ba jian qu chu lai ， zhe shi ……]

english: Are ye familiar with the spell bones to bananas?
translation: 你们熟悉香蕉骨头的咒语吗？ [ni men shu xi xiang jiao gu tou de zhou yu ma ？]

english: Yes, why?
translation: 是的，为什么？ [shi de ， wei shen me ？]

english: Well, due to a blow to the head he took in the fight, the surgeon cast that spell, thinking it was some sort of new healing spell.
translation: 好吧，由于他在战斗中头部受到打击，外科医生施展了这个咒语，认为这是某种新的治疗咒语。 [hao ba ， you yu ta zai zhan dou zhong tou bu shou dao da ji ， wai ke yi sheng shi zhan le zhe ge zhou yu ， ren wei zhe shi mou zhong xin de zhi liao zhou yu 。]

english: And he did so while touching Jenkins' ribs.
translation: 他一边触摸詹金斯的肋骨一边这样做。 [ta yi bian chu mo zhan jin si de lei gu yi bian zhe yang zuo 。]

english: And that killed him?
translation: 那杀了他？ [na sha le ta ？]

english: No [lad/lass]!
translation: 不[小伙子/姑娘]！ [bu [ xiao huo zi / gu niang ]！]

english: See, he survived, his bones turned to bananas, as a huge storm blew up and the crew debated what to do with him.
translation: 看，他活了下来，他的骨头变成了香蕉，因为一场巨大的风暴爆发了，船员们争论着如何处理他。 [kan ， ta huo le xia lai ， ta de gu tou bian cheng le xiang jiao ， yin wei yi chang ju da de feng bao bao fa le ， chuan yuan men zheng lun zhe ru he chu li ta 。]

english: But you see, the storm was actually the tail end of a hurricane that had swept the nearby jungle islands, and when it approached the ship it petered out, droppin' all manner of strange things onto the deck and into the
translation: 但你看，这场风暴实际上是席卷附近丛林岛屿的飓风的尾声，当它接近船时，它逐渐消失，将各种奇怪的东西扔到甲板上和船里。 [dan ni kan ， zhe chang feng bao shi ji shang shi xi juan fu jin cong lin dao yu de ju feng de wei sheng ， dang ta jie jin chuan shi ， ta zhu jian xiao shi ， jiang ge zhong qi guai de dong xi reng dao jia ban shang he chuan li 。]

english: ocean.
translation: 海洋。 [hai yang 。]

english: The worst part was when the ship was bombarded with ravenous, hunger-crazed monkeys, the majority of which landed on Jenkins as he lay recoverin'.
translation: 最糟糕的是，这艘船遭到了饥饿的、疯狂的猴子的轰炸，其中大部分落在了詹金斯正在康复的时候。 [zui zao gao de shi ， zhe sou chuan zao dao le ji e de 、 feng kuang de hou zi de hong zha ， qi zhong da bu fen luo zai le zhan jin si zheng zai kang fu de shi hou 。]

english: See, what happened next, after the monkeys had had their way with him was...
translation: 看，在猴子们对他为所欲为之后，接下来发生的事情是…… [kan ， zai hou zi men dui ta wei suo yu wei zhi hou ， jie xia lai fa sheng de shi qing shi ……]

english: Look, I don't want to hear any more. Why would I want to buy his cutlass?
translation: 听着，我不想再听了。我为什么要买他的弯刀？ [ting zhe ， wo bu xiang zai ting le 。 wo wei shen me yao mai ta de wan dao ？]

english: Well, after the poor man passed on...
translation: 好吧，在那个可怜的人去世后…… [hao ba ， zai na ge ke lian de ren qu shi hou ……]

english: In a final, terrifying, mashed potato coated tragedy...
translation: 最后一场可怕的、裹着土豆泥的悲剧…… [zui hou yi chang ke pa de 、 guo zhe tu dou ni de bei ju ……]

english: His shipmates found his cutlass was completely untouched.
translation: 他的船员发现他的弯刀完全没有动过。 [ta de chuan yuan fa xian ta de wan dao wan quan mei you dong guo 。]

english: See, having been exposed to all the bad luck that Jenkins went through, the thing is unlikely to ever see anything that bad again.
translation: 看，在经历了詹金斯所经历的所有厄运之后，这个东西不太可能再遇到那么糟糕的事情了。 [kan ， zai jing li le zhan jin si suo jing li de suo you e yun zhi hou ， zhe ge dong xi bu tai ke neng zai yu dao na me zao gao de shi qing le 。]

english: Hence, it must be lucky.
translation: 因此，它一定是幸运的。 [yin ci ， ta yi ding shi xing yun de 。]

english: Ye can have it fer 2560 coins.
translation: 花费2560金币即可获得。 [hua fei 2560 jin bi ji ke huo de 。]

english: Here ye go. I hope it brings you luck.
translation: 来吧。我希望它能给你带来好运。 [lai ba 。 wo xi wang ta neng gei ni dai lai hao yun 。]

english: Gentleman Mallard's Rapier.
translation: 绿头绅士的细剑。 [lv tou shen shi de xi jian 。]

english: Well, I'll tell ye the story, but it'll take a great deal of convincin' for me to sell you this rapier.
translation: 好吧，我会告诉你这个故事，但是我需要很大的说服力才能把这把剑卖给你。 [hao ba ， wo hui gao su ni zhe ge gu shi ， dan shi wo xu yao hen da de shuo fu li cai neng ba zhe ba jian mai gei ni 。]

english: See, gentleman Mallard is a legend in these parts. His family had been rich, shipping all sorts of goods up and down the coast.
translation: 看，野鸭先生是这些地区的传奇人物。他的家族很富有，在沿海地区运送各种货物。 [kan ， ye ya xian sheng shi zhe xie di qu de chuan qi ren wu 。 ta de jia zu hen fu you ， zai yan hai di qu yun song ge zhong huo wu 。]

english: Then their rivals got together and had their ships sunk, one after the other, and his business partners were all either bought off or had...accidents.
translation: 然后他们的竞争对手联合起来，一艘接一艘地沉没了他们的船，而他的商业伙伴要么被收买，要么遭遇……事故。 [ran hou ta men de jing zheng dui shou lian he qi lai ， yi sou jie yi sou di chen mo le ta men de chuan ， er ta de shang ye huo ban yao me bei shou mai ， yao me zao yu …… shi gu 。]

english: With no money and only one ship left, he took to the life of a pirate, but no brigand was he.
translation: 由于身无分文，只剩下一艘船，他过上了海盗的生活，但他不是强盗。 [you yu shen wu fen wen ， zhi sheng xia yi sou chuan ， ta guo shang le hai dao de sheng huo ， dan ta bu shi qiang dao 。]

english: He took only from those men that had brought about his downfall, was fair with his men, and generous with his loot.
translation: 他只从那些导致他垮台的人那里拿走，对他的部下公平，对他的战利品慷慨。 [ta zhi cong na xie dao zhi ta kua tai de ren na li na zou ， dui ta de bu xia gong ping ， dui ta de zhan li pin kang kai 。]

english: Why, this island would have been wiped out by the shakes if he hadn't turned over his stash to buy medicine.
translation: 哎呀，要不是他交出自己的藏品去买药，这座岛早就被地震摧毁了。 [ai ya ， yao bu shi ta jiao chu zi ji de cang pin qu mai yao ， zhe zuo dao zao jiu bei di zhen cui hui le 。]

english: One day his ship was attacked by a huge sea creature that swept the decks of men with its tentacles.
translation: 有一天，他的船遭到一种巨大海洋生物的攻击，它用触手席卷了人类的甲板。 [you yi tian ， ta de chuan zao dao yi zhong ju da hai yang sheng wu de gong ji ， ta yong chu shou xi juan le ren lei de jia ban 。]

english: The crew took to the lifeboats, and the last they saw of him the gentleman was stabbin' at the thing as it hauled the ship under the water.
translation: 船员们登上救生艇，最后一次见到他时，这位绅士正在刺伤那东西，当时它正在把船拖到水下。 [chuan yuan men deng shang jiu sheng ting ， zui hou yi ci jian dao ta shi ， zhe wei shen shi zheng zai ci shang na dong xi ， dang shi ta zheng zai ba chuan tuo dao shui xia 。]

english: A week later about ten foot of tentacle washed up on the beach, with his rapier embedded in it to the hilt.
translation: 一周后，大约十英尺长的触手被冲到海滩上，他的细剑完全嵌在其中。 [yi zhou hou ， da yue shi ying chi zhang de chu shou bei chong dao hai tan shang ， ta de xi jian wan quan qian zai qi zhong 。]

english: I took it, cleaned it up, and I've been lookin' after it ever since.
translation: 我拿走了它，清理了它，从那时起我就一直在照顾它。 [wo na zou le ta ， qing li le ta ， cong na shi qi wo jiu yi zhi zai zhao gu ta 。]

english: I can't let it go for less than 25600 coins, and even then that's a bargain.
translation: 低于25600金币我是不会放手的，即便如此也很划算。 [di yu 25600 jin bi wo shi bu hui fang shou de ， ji bian ru ci ye hen hua suan 。]

english: Ye think ye have what it takes to wield it?
translation: 你认为你有能力运用它吗？ [ni ren wei ni you neng li yun yong ta ma ？]

english: I hope yer worthy enough to wield this, stranger. I'd hate te think Gentleman Mallard would be disappointed in me fer sellin' it to ye.
translation: 我希望你有足够的资格来使用这个，陌生人。我不想让野鸭先生对我把它卖给你们感到失望。 [wo xi wang ni you zu gou de zi ge lai shi yong zhe ge ， mo sheng ren 。 wo bu xiang rang ye ya xian sheng dui wo ba ta mai gei ni men gan dao shi wang 。]

english: Probably, let's see what you have.
translation: 也许吧，让我们看看你有什么。 [ye xu ba ， rang wo men kan kan ni you shen me 。]

english: I doubt it.
translation: 我对此表示怀疑。 [wo dui ci biao shi huai yi 。]

english: That depends on if you have any cutlasses.
translation: 这取决于你是否有弯刀。 [zhe qu jue yu ni shi fou you wan dao 。]

english: Brass Hand Harry's Cutlass.
translation: 黄铜手哈利的弯刀。 [huang tong shou ha li de wan dao 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Unlucky Jenkins' Lucky Cutlass.
translation: 不幸的詹金斯的幸运弯刀。 [bu xing de zhan jin si de xing yun wan dao 。]

english: Gentleman Mallard's Rapier
translation: 绿头绅士的细剑 [lv tou shen shi de xi jian]

english: Can you teach me the basics of smelting please?
translation: 你能教我熔炼的基础知识吗？ [ni neng jiao wo rong lian de ji chu zhi shi ma ？]

english: You'll need to have mined some ore to smelt first. Go see the mining tutor to the south if you're not sure how to do this.
translation: 你需要先开采一些矿石来熔炼。如果你不知道该怎么做，请去南方找采矿导师。 [ni xu yao xian kai cai yi xie kuang shi lai rong lian 。 ru guo ni bu zhi dao gai zen me zuo ， qing qu nan fang zhao cai kuang dao shi 。]

english: I see you have some ore with you to smelt, so let's get started.
translation: 我看到你身上有一些矿石要冶炼，所以我们开始吧。 [wo kan dao ni shen shang you yi xie kuang shi yao ye lian ， suo yi wo men kai shi ba 。]

english: Click on the furnace to bring up a menu of metal bars you can try to make from your ore.
translation: 单击熔炉会弹出金属条菜单，您可以尝试用矿石制作金属条。 [dan ji rong lu hui dan chu jin shu tiao cai dan ， nin ke yi chang shi yong kuang shi zhi zuo jin shu tiao 。]

english: When you have a full inventory, take it to the bank, you can find it on the roof of the castle in Lumbridge.
translation: 当你的库存已满时，将其带到银行，你可以在朗布里奇城堡的屋顶上找到它。 [dang ni de ku cun yi man shi ， jiang qi dai dao yin hang ， ni ke yi zai lang bu li qi cheng bao de wu ding shang zhao dao ta 。]

english: If you have a hammer with you, you can smith the bronze bars into equipment on the anvil outside.
translation: 如果你有锤子，你可以在外面的铁砧上将青铜棒锻造成装备。 [ru guo ni you chui zi ， ni ke yi zai wai mian de tie zhen shang jiang qing tong bang duan zao cheng zhuang bei 。]

english: I'm afraid the weather over the years has rusted it down, so it can only be used to work bronze.
translation: 恐怕长年累月的风吹雨打已经生锈了，只能用来加工青铜了。 [kong pa chang nian lei yue de feng chui yu da yi jing sheng xiu le ， zhi neng yong lai jia gong qing tong le 。]

english: Alternatively you can run up to Varrock. Look for my Master, the Smithing Tutor, in the west of the city, he can help you smith better gear.
translation: 或者你也可以跑到 Varrock 那里。在城西寻找我的师父，锻造导师，他可以帮助你锻造更好的装备。 [huo zhe ni ye ke yi pao dao  Varrock  na li 。 zai cheng xi xun zhao wo de shi fu ， duan zao dao shi ， ta ke yi bang zhu ni duan zao geng hao de zhuang bei 。]

english: I already know about the basics of smelting, got any tips?
translation: 我已经了解了冶炼的基础知识，有什么建议吗？ [wo yi jing liao jie le ye lian de ji chu zhi shi ， you shen me jian yi ma ？]

english: I find it useful to stockpile my ore before smelting it in one go, or even do it on the way to the bank in such places as Al Kharid or Falador. But you can do it anyway you want, one load at a time is fine too!
translation: 我发现在一次性熔炼之前储存矿石很有用，甚至可以在前往阿尔卡里德或法拉多等地的银行的途中进行。但你可以随心所欲地做，一次一包也可以！ [wo fa xian zai yi ci xing rong lian zhi qian chu cun kuang shi hen you yong ， shen zhi ke yi zai qian wang a er ka li de huo fa la duo deng di de yin hang de tu zhong jin xing 。 dan ni ke yi sui xin suo yu di zuo ， yi ci yi bao ye ke yi ！]

english: Not too much can go wrong with smelting.
translation: 冶炼不会出现太多问题。 [ye lian bu hui chu xian tai duo wen ti 。]

english: You will lose some iron when smelting that ore, but a Ring of Forging or the Superheat Item spell will soon solve that.
translation: 熔炼矿石时你会失去一些铁，但锻造之环或过热物品法术很快就能解决这个问题。 [rong lian kuang shi shi ni hui shi qu yi xie tie ， dan duan zao zhi huan huo guo re wu pin fa shu hen kuai jiu neng jie jue zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: You should also investigate Keldagrim, the dwarven city, you may find better places to smelt your ore with friends.
translation: 你还应该调查矮人城市凯尔达格林，你可能会找到更好的地方和朋友一起冶炼你的矿石。 [ni hai ying gai diao cha ai ren cheng shi kai er da ge lin ， ni ke neng hui zhao dao geng hao de di fang he peng you yi qi ye lian ni de kuang shi 。]

english: What do I do after smelting the ore?
translation: 冶炼完矿石后做什么？ [ye lian wan kuang shi hou zuo shen me ？]

english: Ahh you'll need to learn to smith. Go to Varrock, that's where my master, the Smithing Tutor, plies his trade. Ask him to teach you how to smith.
translation: 啊，你需要学习锻造。去瓦罗克吧，那是我的师傅，锻造导师，从事他的生意的地方。请他教你如何锻造。 [a ， ni xu yao xue xi duan zao 。 qu wa luo ke ba ， na shi wo de shi fu ， duan zao dao shi ， cong shi ta de sheng yi de di fang 。 qing ta jiao ni ru he duan zao 。]

english: Smelt some ore and store it in the bank. Grab a hammer from the general store before you go too!
translation: 熔炼一些矿石并将其存储在银行中。出发前，先从杂货店拿一把锤子！ [rong lian yi xie kuang shi bing jiang qi cun chu zai yin hang zhong 。 chu fa qian ， xian cong za huo dian na yi ba chui zi ！]

english: Are you here to make juniper charcoal?
translation: 您是来制作杜松木炭的吗？ [nin shi lai zhi zuo du song mu tan de ma ？]

english: Tell me about juniper charcoal.
translation: 告诉我有关杜松木炭的信息。 [gao su wo you guan du song mu tan de xin xi 。]

english: They use it in the blast mine, out near Lovakengj. It's powerful stuff, more volatile than the regular charcoal you get elsewhere.
translation: 他们在洛瓦肯杰附近的爆破矿井中使用它。它是一种功能强大的东西，比其他地方买到的普通木炭更不稳定。 [ta men zai luo wa ken jie fu jin de bao po kuang jing zhong shi yong ta 。 ta shi yi zhong gong neng qiang da de dong xi ， bi qi ta di fang mai dao de pu tong mu tan geng bu wen ding 。]

english: To make juniper charcoal, put some juniper logs in my furnaces, then set them alight. I'll keep an eye on it for a fee of 600 coins.

english: The way they saw this universe, their modes of impression, differed so greatly from one another that to read their stories, to know their lives, is to wonder if they were not many species in one.

translation: 感谢您让我们的草药贴剂发挥作用。现在博尔德可以为我的人民种植古藤，他们非常高兴。 [gan xie nin rang wo men de cao yao tie ji fa hui zuo yong 。 xian zai bo er de ke yi wei wo de ren min zhong zhi gu teng ， ta men fei chang gao xing 。]

english: Can I have another copy of that book?
translation: 我可以再要一本那本书吗？ [wo ke yi zai yao yi ben na ben shu ma ？]

english: Yes, I have another copy for you.
translation: 是的，我还有另一份给你。 [shi de ， wo hai you ling yi fen gei ni 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: How are you two doing?
translation: 你们两个怎么样？ [ni men liang ge zen me yang ？]

english: Snowflake an' My Arm very happy. Maybe new herbie patch not da only place where new life gonna be growin' soon!
translation: 雪花和我的手臂非常高兴。也许新的草丛并不是新生命很快就会生长的唯一地方！ [xue hua he wo de shou bi fei chang gao xing 。 ye xu xin de cao cong bing bu shi xin sheng ming hen kuai jiu hui sheng zhang de wei yi di fang ！]

english: Let's not get ahead of ourselves, dear! But the town is thriving; my people are much happier now they are no longer terrified of Father.
translation: 亲爱的，我们不要超前！但这座小镇正在蓬勃发展；我的人民现在快乐多了，他们不再害怕父亲了。 [qin ai de ， wo men bu yao chao qian ！ dan zhe zuo xiao zhen zheng zai peng bo fa zhan ； wo de ren min xian zai kuai le duo le ， ta men bu zai hai pa fu qin le 。]

english: Dem trolls likin' da goutweed too!
translation: 他们的巨魔也喜欢古特草！ [ta men de ju mo ye xi huan gu te cao ！]

english: That's nice.
translation: 那很好。 [na hen hao 。]

english: Can you note my basalt for me?
translation: 你能帮我记下我的玄武岩吗？ [ni neng bang wo ji xia wo de xuan wu yan ma ？]

english: You aren't carrying any basalt.
translation: 你没有携带任何玄武岩。 [ni mei you xie dai ren he xuan wu yan 。]

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我就走了。 [wo jiu zou le 。]

english: You will always be welcome back.
translation: 我们将永远欢迎您回来。 [wo men jiang yong yuan huan ying nin hui lai 。]

english: Here, solve this.
translation: 来，解决这个问题。 [lai ， jie jue zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: My Arm hands you a puzzlebox!
translation: 我的手臂递给你一个拼图盒！ [wo de shou bi di gei ni yi ge pin tu he ！]

english: That doesn't look solved to me.
translation: 在我看来这并没有解决。 [zai wo kan lai zhe bing mei you jie jue 。]

english: Well done [player name]. Here you go.
translation: 干得好[玩家姓名]。干得好。 [gan de hao [ wan jia xing ming ]。 gan de hao 。]

english: You've been given a [new clue/casket]!
translation: 你已经获得了[新线索/棺材]！ [ni yi jing huo de le [ xin xian suo / guan cai ]！]

english: Can I have another copy of that book?
translation: 我可以再要一本那本书吗？ [wo ke yi zai yao yi ben na ben shu ma ？]

english: How are you two doing?
translation: 你们两个怎么样？ [ni men liang ge zen me yang ？]

english: Can you note this basalt for me?
translation: 你能帮我记下这个玄武岩吗？ [ni neng bang wo ji xia zhe ge xuan wu yan ma ？]

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我就走了。 [wo jiu zou le 。]

english: Kuani! Someone's come to visit the birds!
translation: 夸尼！有人来看鸟了！ [kua ni ！ you ren lai kan niao le ！]

english: I've spotted you working hard to help the guild. How would you like a basic quetzal whistle blueprint to help you get back here in the future?
translation: 我发现你在努力帮助公会。您想要一个基本的绿咬鹃口哨蓝图来帮助您将来回到这里吗？ [wo fa xian ni zai nu li bang zhu gong hui 。 nin xiang yao yi ge ji ben de lv yao juan kou shao lan tu lai bang zhu nin jiang lai hui dao zhe li ma ？]

english: I'd love one!
translation: 我想要一个！ [wo xiang yao yi ge ！]

english: You'll need to use the blueprint to craft a whistle from a willow log. Make sure it works for you. There's no standard size whistle nowadays.
translation: 您需要使用蓝图用柳木制作哨子。确保它适合您。现在没有标准尺寸的哨子。 [nin xu yao shi yong lan tu yong liu mu zhi zuo shao zi 。 que bao ta shi he nin 。 xian zai mei you biao zhun chi cun de shao zi 。]

english: When you want to charge your whistle, be sure to bring some of those lovely meats you're gathering up here for the birds. If they eat well you'll get a lot more use out of them!
translation: 当您想要吹响口哨时，请务必带上一些您为鸟类收集的可爱肉类。如果他们吃得好，你会得到更多的利用！ [dang nin xiang yao chui xiang kou shao shi ， qing wu bi dai shang yi xie nin wei niao lei shou ji de ke ai rou lei 。 ru guo ta men chi de hao ， ni hui de dao geng duo de li yong ！]

english: Not right now, thanks.
translation: 现在不行，谢谢。 [xian zai bu xing ， xie xie 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm Pitri, though most of the others call me birdbrain.
translation: 我是 Pitri，尽管其他大多数人都叫我鸟脑。 [wo shi  Pitri， jin guan qi ta da duo shu ren dou jiao wo niao nao 。]

english: On account of the...?
translation: 是因为……？ [shi yin wei ……？]

english: The birds, yes. I just feel so at home amongst them... Though I am more partial to cooked food than the raw stuff they get.
translation: 鸟儿，是的。我在他们中间感觉很自在……尽管我更喜欢熟食而不是生食。 [niao er ， shi de 。 wo zai ta men zhong jian gan jue hen zi zai …… jin guan wo geng xi huan shu shi er bu shi sheng shi 。]

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 还有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [hai you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

english: Can you teach me about the birds?
translation: 你能教我一些关于鸟类的知识吗？ [ni neng jiao wo yi xie guan yu niao lei de zhi shi ma ？]

english: Absolutely! Like many in Varlamore, we here at the guild use quetzals to help us move people and reports throughout the entire network of transport nodes.
translation: 绝对地！像瓦拉莫尔的许多人一样，我们行会使用绿咬鹃来帮助我们在整个运输节点网络中移动人员和报告。 [jue dui di ！ xiang wa la mo er de xu duo ren yi yang ， wo men hang hui shi yong lv yao juan lai bang zhu wo men zai zheng ge yun shu jie dian wang luo zhong yi dong ren yuan he bao gao 。]

english: We also have these handy quetzal whistles that allow us to call for one to take us back to the guild. They're pretty magical and work at very long ranges.
translation: 我们还有这些方便的绿咬鹃口哨，可以让我们呼唤一只来带我们回公会。它们非常神奇，并且可以在很远的范围内工作。 [wo men hai you zhe xie fang bian de lv yao juan kou shao ， ke yi rang wo men hu huan yi zhi lai dai wo men hui gong hui 。 ta men fei chang shen qi ， bing qie ke yi zai hen yuan de fan wei nei gong zuo 。]

english: Could I get my hands on one of those whistles?
translation: 我能拿到其中一支口哨吗？ [wo neng na dao qi zhong yi zhi kou shao ma ？]

english: Once you've become more settled in with us at the guild, absolutely.
translation: 一旦你在公会里更加适应了，那是绝对可以的。 [yi dan ni zai gong hui li geng jia shi ying le ， na shi jue dui ke yi de 。]

english: Sure! I have a blueprint set aside for you to grab when you're ready.
translation: 当然！我准备了一份蓝图供您准备好后使用。 [dang ran ！ wo zhun bei le yi fen lan tu gong nin zhun bei hao hou shi yong 。]

english: So how do you motivate the birds?
translation: 那么如何激励鸟类呢？ [na me ru he ji li niao lei ne ？]

english: Food, mostly. They're big fans of the raw meats that the hunters bring back with them. I'm worried they may be waiting to eat us, quite honestly!
translation: 主要是食物。他们非常喜欢猎人带回来的生肉。老实说，我担心它们可能正等着吃掉我们！ [zhu yao shi shi wu 。 ta men fei chang xi huan lie ren dai hui lai de sheng rou 。 lao shi shuo ， wo dan xin ta men ke neng zheng deng zhe chi diao wo men ！]

english: Well, they're certainly big enough to try.
translation: 嗯，他们确实足够大，可以尝试。 [n ， ta men que shi zu gou da ， ke yi chang shi 。]

english: Can you recharge my whistle?
translation: 你能给我的哨子充电吗？ [ni neng gei wo de shao zi chong dian ma ？]

english: Doesn't look like you've got anything I can feed to the birds here. You'll want to get some of the raw meats that the hunters bring back with them.
translation: 看来你没有什么可以喂这里的鸟儿的东西。你会想要一些猎人带回来的生肉。 [kan lai ni mei you shen me ke yi wei zhe li de niao er de dong xi 。 ni hui xiang yao yi xie lie ren dai hui lai de sheng rou 。]

english: Sure thing!
translation: 当然可以！ [dang ran ke yi ！]

english: Looks like the birds are all full for now. Make them work a bit before feeding them again!
translation: 看起来现在鸟儿都吃饱了。在再次喂食之前先让它们工作一下！ [kan qi lai xian zai niao er dou chi bao le 。 zai zai ci wei shi zhi qian xian rang ta men gong zuo yi xia ！]

english: There you go. Some whistle charges for you!
translation: 就这样吧。给你一些口哨费！ [jiu zhe yang ba 。 gei ni yi xie kou shao fei ！]

english: How do I get my hands on more whistles?
translation: 如何获得更多口哨？ [ru he huo de geng duo kou shao ？]

english: I can produce another blueprint for you, for a small cost.
translation: 我可以为您制作另一张蓝图，只需花费很少的费用。 [wo ke yi wei nin zhi zuo ling yi zhang lan tu ， zhi xu hua fei hen shao de fei yong 。]

english: What sort of small cost?
translation: 什么样的小成本？ [shen me yang de xiao cheng ben ？]

english: 500 coins. These blueprints are my art, and before you say anything, 'exposure' is the last thing I want out here in the savannah.
translation: 500金币。这些蓝图是我的艺术，在你说什么之前，“曝光”是我在大草原上最不想做的事情。 [500 jin bi 。 zhe xie lan tu shi wo de yi shu ， zai ni shuo shen me zhi qian ，“ bao guang ” shi wo zai da cao yuan shang zui bu xiang zuo de shi qing 。]

english: Here you go, one whistle blueprint.
translation: 给你，一张哨子蓝图。 [gei ni ， yi zhang shao zi lan tu 。]

english: I'd better be off.
translation: 我最好还是离开吧 [wo zui hao hai shi li kai ba]

english: Odd. You don't seem to have a whistle I can recharge.
translation: 奇怪的。你好像没有可以给我充电的哨子。 [qi guai de 。 ni hao xiang mei you ke yi gei wo chong dian de shao zi 。]

english: Please solve this for me. I have other things to be thinking about.
translation: 请为我解决这个问题。我还有其他事情要考虑。 [qing wei wo jie jue zhe ge wen ti 。 wo hai you qi ta shi qing yao kao lv 。]

english: Sorry but you haven't solved the puzzle yet.
translation: 抱歉，您还没有解决这个难题。 [bao qian ， nin hai mei you jie jue zhe ge nan ti 。]

english: Thanks [player name]!
translation: 谢谢[玩家姓名]！ [xie xie [ wan jia xing ming ]！]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Can you teach me about the birds?
translation: 你能教我一些关于鸟类的知识吗？ [ni neng jiao wo yi xie guan yu niao lei de zhi shi ma ？]

english: Can you recharge my whistle?
translation: 你能给我的哨子充电吗？ [ni neng gei wo de shao zi chong dian ma ？]

english: How do I get my hands on more whistles?
translation: 如何获得更多口哨？ [ru he huo de geng duo kou shao ？]

english: I'd better be off.
translation: 我最好还是离开吧 [wo zui hao hai shi li kai ba]

english: If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 我要是像你那么丑我就不敢在大庭广众之下露脸了！ [wo yao shi xiang ni na me chou wo jiu bu gan zai da ting guang zhong zhi xia lou lian le ！]

english: Out of my way, punk.
translation: 别挡我的路，朋克。 [bie dang wo de lu ， peng ke 。]

english: Hmm... you smell strange...
translation: 嗯……你闻起来很奇怪…… [n …… ni wen qi lai hen qi guai ……]

english: Strange how?
translation: 奇怪怎么办？ [qi guai zen me ban ？]

english: Like a human!
translation: 像人一样！ [xiang ren yi yang ！]

english: Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 哦！呃……我刚吃了一个就是为什么！ [o ！ e …… wo gang chi le yi ge jiu shi wei shen me ！]

english: Leave me alone.
translation: 请别打扰我。 [qing bie da rao wo 。]

english: Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 如果你珍惜你的生命，就不要再跟我说话了！ [ru guo ni zhen xi ni de sheng ming ， jiu bu yao zai gen wo shuo hua le ！]

english: Get lost!
translation: 迷路！ [mi lu ！]

english: I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 我没有什么可以给你，所以让我一个人呆着吧，托钵僧。 [wo mei you shen me ke yi gei ni ， suo yi rang wo yi ge ren dai zhe ba ， tuo bo seng 。]

english: Have you no manners?
translation: 你没有礼貌吗？ [ni mei you li mao ma ？]

english: I don't have time for this right now.
translation: 我现在没有时间做这个。 [wo xian zai mei you shi jian zuo zhe ge 。]

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 我没有兴趣和像你这样的可怜虫说话。 [wo mei you xing qu he xiang ni zhe yang de ke lian chong shuo hua 。]

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
translation: 我打赌你有一双很棒的爪子。 [wo da du ni you yi shuang hen bang de zhua zi 。]

english: A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 非常痛苦的一天，总的来说……趁它持续的时候好好享受吧。 [fei chang tong ku de yi tian ， zong de lai shuo …… chen ta chi xu de shi hou hao hao xiang shou ba 。]

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: 如果你抓到任何人，答应我你会分享。 [ru guo ni zhua dao ren he ren ， da ying wo ni hui fen xiang 。]

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 我以前没在这儿闻过你的味道…… [wo yi qian mei zai zhe er wen guo ni de wei dao ……]

english: You smell familiar...
translation: 你闻起来很熟悉... [ni wen qi lai hen shu xi ...]

english: Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 看到这附近有人类吗？我饿了。 [kan dao zhe fu jin you ren lei ma ？ wo e le 。]

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 在我看来，你就像一个对血液有健康品味的人。 [zai wo kan lai ， ni jiu xiang yi ge dui xue ye you jian kang pin wei de ren 。]

english: Good day to you, my friend.
translation: 祝你美好的一天，我的朋友。 [zhu ni mei hao de yi tian ， wo de peng you 。]

english: Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
translation: 想去城堡吃点小吃吗？ [xiang qu cheng bao chi dian xiao chi ma ？]

english: Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: 等一下，我的牙齿里有一点东西卡住了…… [deng yi xia ， wo de ya chi li you yi dian dong xi ka zhu le ……]

english: By Ralos, we finally have a worthy challenger.
translation: 拉洛斯，我们终于有了一个有价值的挑战者。 [la luo si ， wo men zhong yu you le yi ge you jia zhi de tiao zhan zhe 。]

english: You've torn through multiple waves of combatants and you're still standing. I'm almost impressed.
translation: 你已经冲破了一波又一波的战斗，但你仍然屹立不倒。我几乎被感动了。 [ni yi jing chong po le yi bo you yi bo de zhan dou ， dan ni reng ran yi li bu dao 。 wo ji hu bei gan dong le 。]

english: Now let's see how you handle a real foe...
translation: 现在让我们看看你如何对付真正的敌人...... [xian zai rang wo men kan kan ni ru he dui fu zhen zheng de di ren ......]

english: Sol Heredit jumps down from his seat...
translation: 索尔·赫里迪特从座位上跳下来…… [suo er · he li di te cong zuo wei shang tiao xia lai ……]

english: You're back so soon? A lesser combatant would've retired in shame after the show you put on last time...
translation: 你这么快就回来了？一个实力较弱的战士在看完你上次的表演后会羞愧地退役…… [ni zhe me kuai jiu hui lai le ？ yi ge shi li jiao ruo de zhan shi zai kan wan ni shang ci de biao yan hou hui xiu kui di tui yi ……]

english: But you're clearly different. Let's see what you have this time...
translation: 但你显然不同。看看这次你有什么... [dan ni xian ran bu tong 。 kan kan zhe ci ni you shen me ...]

english: What is it they say? Third time's the charm? Let's see if that's true.
translation: 他们说什么？第三次有魅力吗？让我们看看这是不是真的。 [ta men shuo shen me ？ di san ci you mei li ma ？ rang wo men kan kan zhe shi bu shi zhen de 。]

english: To arms!
translation: 拿起武器！ [na qi wu qi ！]

english: You might be an incapable fighter, but at least you're persistent. Shall we?
translation: 你可能是一个无能的战士，但至少你是坚持不懈的。我们可以？ [ni ke neng shi yi ge wu neng de zhan shi ， dan zhi shao ni shi jian chi bu xie de 。 wo men ke yi ？]

english: Let's start by testing your footwork.
translation: 让我们从测试你的步法开始。 [rang wo men cong ce shi ni de bu fa kai shi 。]

english: Not bad. Let's try something else...
translation: 不错。让我们尝试一些别的东西...... [bu cuo 。 rang wo men chang shi yi xie bie de dong xi ......]

english: Impressive. Let's see how you handle this...
translation: 感人的。让我们看看你如何处理这件事... [gan ren de 。 rang wo men kan kan ni ru he chu li zhe jian shi ...]

english: You can't win!
translation: 你赢不了！ [ni ying bu liao ！]

english: Ralos guides my hand!
translation: 拉洛斯引导我的手！ [la luo si yin dao wo de shou ！]

english: LET'S END THIS!
translation: 让我们结束这一切吧！ [rang wo men jie shu zhe yi qie ba ！]

english: Sol Heredit doesn't take kindly to your eager prayer.
translation: 索尔·赫瑞迪对你热切的祈祷并不友善。 [suo er · he rui di dui ni re qie de qi dao bing bu you shan 。]

english: I'LL BREAK YOURBACK!
translation: 我会打破你的背！ [wo hui da po ni de bei ！]

english: I'LL CRUSH YOURBODY!
translation: 我会粉碎你的身体！ [wo hui fen sui ni de shen ti ！]

english: I'LL TWIST YOURHANDSOFF!
translation: 我会松开你的手！ [wo hui song kai ni de shou ！]

english: I'LL BREAK YOURLEGS!
translation: 我会打断你的腿！ [wo hui da duan ni de tui ！]

english: I'LL CUT YOURFEETOFF!
translation: 我会砍掉你的脚！ [wo hui kan diao ni de jiao ！]

english: Sol Heredit grabs hold of your [body part/item] and deals massive damage!
translation: Sol Heredit 抓住你的[身体部位/物品]并造成巨大伤害！ [Sol Heredit  zhua zhu ni de [ shen ti bu wei / wu pin ] bing zao cheng ju da shang hai ！]

english: You defended the wrong body part!
translation: 你捍卫了错误的身体部位！ [ni han wei le cuo wu de shen ti bu wei ！]

english: You successfully defend your [body part] from Sol Heredit's grapple!
translation: 你成功地保护了你的[身体部位]免受索尔·赫雷迪特的抓斗！ [ni cheng gong di bao hu le ni de [ shen ti bu wei ] mian shou suo er · he lei di te de zhua dou ！]

english: You perfectly parry Sol Heredit's grapple!
translation: 你完美地格挡了索尔·赫瑞特的擒抱！ [ni wan mei di ge dang le suo er · he rui te de qin bao ！]

english: Your light shines... brightly...
translation: 你的光芒闪耀……明亮…… [ni de guang mang shan yao …… ming liang ……]

english: A worthy... opponent...
translation: 一个有价值的……对手…… [yi ge you jia zhi de …… dui shou ……]

english: Ralos has smiled upon you...
translation: 拉洛斯对你微笑…… [la luo si dui ni wei xiao ……]

english: My compliments, champion...
translation: 我的赞美，冠军... [wo de zan mei ， guan jun ...]

english: How disappointing...
translation: 多么令人失望啊... [duo me ling ren shi wang a ...]

english: I knew you weren't the one.
translation: 我就知道你不是那个人。 [wo jiu zhi dao ni bu shi na ge ren 。]

english: You had me excited for a moment.

english: You think the demons would overrun you?
translation: 你认为恶魔会压倒你吗？ [ni ren wei e mo hui ya dao ni ma ？]

english: Demons don't die the same way we do. We could hold back a few of them, but not an endless stream.
translation: 恶魔不会​​像我们一样死去。我们可以阻止其中的一些，但不能阻止源源不断的。 [e mo bu hui ​​ xiang wo men yi yang si qu 。 wo men ke yi zu zhi qi zhong de yi xie ， dan bu neng zu zhi yuan yuan bu duan de 。]

english: You seem to know a lot about them.
translation: 看来你对他们了解很多。 [kan lai ni dui ta men liao jie hen duo 。]

english: I do, which means I know that guarding the chasm is a pointless endeavour. Not that the lieutenant cares what I think.
translation: 我愿意，这意味着我知道守卫鸿沟是毫无意义的努力。中尉并不关心我的想法。 [wo yuan yi ， zhe yi wei zhe wo zhi dao shou wei hong gou shi hao wu yi yi de nu li 。 zhong wei bing bu guan xin wo de xiang fa 。]

english: Launching an attack into the chasm would also be pointless. That leaves us with only one other option.
translation: 向裂缝发起攻击也是毫无意义的。这让我们只剩下另一种选择。 [xiang lie feng fa qi gong ji ye shi hao wu yi yi de 。 zhe rang wo men zhi sheng xia ling yi zhong xuan ze 。]

english: Fleeing?
translation: 逃跑？ [tao pao ？]

english: No. We should talk to them. Try to reach an understanding.
translation: 不，我们应该和他们谈谈。尝试达成谅解。 [bu ， wo men ying gai he ta men tan tan 。 chang shi da cheng liang jie 。]

english: Somehow I don't think negotiating with demons will end well.
translation: 不知何故，我认为与恶魔的谈判不会有好结果。 [bu zhi he gu ， wo ren wei yu e mo de tan pan bu hui you hao jie guo 。]

english: If you have a better idea, go ahead.
translation: 如果你有更好的想法，那就继续吧。 [ru guo ni you geng hao de xiang fa ， na jiu ji xu ba 。]

english: Aren't you a bit too calm about this?
translation: 你是不是有点太冷静了？ [ni shi bu shi you dian tai leng jing le ？]

english: No. If they wanted to, Yama and his demons could overrun this little squad.
translation: 不。如果他们愿意，阎摩和他的恶魔们可以蹂躏这个小队。 [bu 。 ru guo ta men yuan yi ， yan mo he ta de e mo men ke yi rou lin zhe ge xiao dui 。]

english: The fact they haven't means they're probably not interested in doing so. As a matter of fact, they seem quite polite.
translation: 事实上他们没有这样做意味着他们可能对此不感兴趣。事实上，他们看起来很有礼貌。 [shi shi shang ta men mei you zhe yang zuo yi wei zhe ta men ke neng dui ci bu gan xing qu 。 shi shi shang ， ta men kan qi lai hen you li mao 。]

english: You've spoken to them?
translation: 你跟他们谈过吗？ [ni gen ta men tan guo ma ？]

english: I didn't say that, But there's evidence to suggest that Yama and his cult can be reasoned with.
translation: 我没这么说，但有证据表明，阎摩和他的邪教是可以讲道理的。 [wo mei zhe me shuo ， dan you zheng ju biao ming ， yan mo he ta de xie jiao shi ke yi jiang dao li de 。]

english: If Lord Shayzien is interested in diffusing the threat, he should consider trying to reach an agreement with them.
translation: 如果 Shayzien 勋爵有兴趣分散威胁，他应该考虑尝试与他们达成协议。 [ru guo  Shayzien  xun jue you xing qu fen san wei xie ， ta ying gai kao lv chang shi yu ta men da cheng xie yi 。]

english: I've met Lord Shayzien. He doesn't seem like the type to compromise.
translation: 我见过 Shayzien 勋爵。他看起来不是那种会妥协的人。 [wo jian guo  Shayzien  xun jue 。 ta kan qi lai bu shi na zhong hui tuo xie de ren 。]

english: You've met Lord Shiro Shayzien?
translation: 你见过 Shiro Shayzien 勋爵吗？ [ni jian guo  Shiro Shayzien  xun jue ma ？]

english: Yes, I've met the leaders of all of the houses. Even King Artur Hosidius himself.
translation: 是的，我见过所有学院的领导。甚至国王阿图尔·霍西迪乌斯本人也是如此。 [shi de ， wo jian guo suo you xue yuan de ling dao 。 shen zhi guo wang a tu er · huo xi di wu si ben ren ye shi ru ci 。]

english: Interesting. You're quite the worldly fellow. Perhaps King Hosidius would make a more level headed negotiator. Maybe you could talk to him?
translation: 有趣的。你真是一个世俗的人。也许霍西迪乌斯国王会成为一位头脑更加冷静的谈判者。也许你可以和他谈谈？ [you qu de 。 ni zhen shi yi ge shi su de ren 。 ye xu huo xi di wu si guo wang hui cheng wei yi wei tou nao geng jia leng jing de tan pan zhe 。 ye xu ni ke yi he ta tan tan ？]

english: I imagine he's quite busy at the moment.
translation: 我想他现在一定很忙。 [wo xiang ta xian zai yi ding hen mang 。]

english: How long are you posted here?
translation: 你在这里发帖多久了？ [ni zai zhe li fa tie duo jiu le ？]

english: Have you considered quitting?
translation: 你考虑过放弃吗？ [ni kao lv guo fang qi ma ？]

english: Well, good luck.
translation: 好吧，祝你好运。 [hao ba ， zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: About the cultists...
translation: 关于邪教徒... [guan yu xie jiao tu ...]

english: You sound eager to fight.
translation: 听起来你渴望战斗。 [ting qi lai ni ke wang zhan dou 。]

english: You think the demons would overrun you?
translation: 你认为恶魔会压倒你吗？ [ni ren wei e mo hui ya dao ni ma ？]

english: Aren't you a bit too calm about this?
translation: 你是不是有点太冷静了？ [ni shi bu shi you dian tai leng jing le ？]

english: Are you here to fight the lizardmen? Be careful - they're fierce!
translation: 你是来对抗蜥蜴人的吗？小心——它们很凶猛！ [ni shi lai dui kang xi yi ren de ma ？ xiao xin —— ta men hen xiong meng ！]

english: Tell me about the lizardmen.
translation: 告诉我关于蜥蜴人的事情。 [gao su wo guan yu xi yi ren de shi qing 。]

english: The lizardmen are the bane of Kourend. I'm not much for history, but the Shayzien Army have been fighting them off for as long as anyone can remember.
translation: 蜥蜴人是库伦德的克星。我对历史不太感兴趣，但从人们记事起，Shayzien 军队就一直在与他们作战。 [xi yi ren shi ku lun de de ke xing 。 wo dui li shi bu tai gan xing qu ， dan cong ren men ji shi qi ，Shayzien  jun dui jiu yi zhi zai yu ta men zuo zhan 。]

english: They can be aggressive, and they've got something nasty in their bite that can make you pretty ill.
translation: 它们可能具有攻击性，而且咬伤时含有一些令人讨厌的东西，可能会让你病得很重。 [ta men ke neng ju you gong ji xing ， er qie yao shang shi han you yi xie ling ren tao yan de dong xi ， ke neng hui rang ni bing de hen zhong 。]

english: Why are you up here instead of fighting?
translation: 你为什么在这里而不是战斗？ [ni wei shen me zai zhe li er bu shi zhan dou ？]

english: I got a bite from a lizardman. I'm all cured, but I'm not going down there again until I feel stronger, otherwise I'll be no use in the fight.
translation: 我被蜥蜴人咬了一口。我已经痊愈了，但在我感觉更强壮之前我不会再去那里，否则我在战斗中将毫无用处。 [wo bei xi yi ren yao le yi kou 。 wo yi jing quan yu le ， dan zai wo gan jue geng qiang zhuang zhi qian wo bu hui zai qu na li ， fou ze wo zai zhan dou zhong jiang hao wu yong chu 。]

english: Do you know how many I've killed already?
translation: 你知道我已经杀了多少人了吗？ [ni zhi dao wo yi jing sha le duo shao ren le ma ？]

english: The Shayzien records say you've killed [COUNT] lizardmen since they began tracking your kills. [COUNT] were lizardman shamans.
translation: Shayzien 的记录显示，自从他们开始追踪你的杀戮以来，你已经杀死了 [COUNT] 只蜥蜴人。 [COUNT] 名是蜥蜴人萨满。 [Shayzien  de ji lu xian shi ， zi cong ta men kai shi zhui zong ni de sha lu yi lai ， ni yi jing sha si le  [COUNT]  zhi xi yi ren 。 [COUNT]  ming shi xi yi ren sa man 。]

english: Thanks for the warning.
translation: 谢谢你的警告。 [xie xie ni de jing gao 。]

english: I see no adventurers in the canyon to the east.
translation: 我在东边的峡谷里没有看到冒险家。 [wo zai dong bian de xia gu li mei you kan dao mao xian jia 。]

translation: 我在西边的峡谷里没有看到冒险家。 [wo zai xi bian de xia gu li mei you kan dao mao xian jia 。]

translation: 谢谢你的警告。 [xie xie ni de jing gao 。]

english: Hello, are you interested in our agility training courses?
translation: 您好，您对我们的敏捷性培训课程感兴趣吗？ [nin hao ， nin dui wo men de min jie xing pei xun ke cheng gan xing qu ma ？]

english: Yes, is it difficult?
translation: 是啊，难吗？ [shi a ， nan ma ？]

english: Nothing is difficult for a Shayzien soldier. If you do the training every day, you can be as good as us.
translation: 对于 Shayzien 士兵来说，没有什么是困难的。如果你每天都训练，你就能和我们一样好。 [dui yu  Shayzien  shi bing lai shuo ， mei you shen me shi kun nan de 。 ru guo ni mei tian dou xun lian ， ni jiu neng he wo men yi yang hao 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Fair enough. Feel free to give it a go if you change your mind.
translation: 很公平。如果您改变主意，请随意尝试。 [hen gong ping 。 ru guo nin gai bian zhu yi ， qing sui yi chang shi 。]

translation: 您已完成我们的基本敏捷性课程的 1 圈，单圈时间为 [time]。全球已完成 [number] 次，全球最佳时间是 [time]。 [nin yi wan cheng wo men de ji ben min jie xing ke cheng de  1  quan ， dan quan shi jian wei  [time]。 quan qiu yi wan cheng  [number]  ci ， quan qiu zui jia shi jian shi  [time]。]

english: You've completed [number] laps of our basic agility course with a best time of [time]. There's been [number] global completions and the global best time is [time].
translation: 您已完成我们的基础敏捷课程的 [number] 圈，最佳时间为 [time]。全球已完成 [number] 次，全球最佳时间是 [time]。 [nin yi wan cheng wo men de ji chu min jie ke cheng de  [number]  quan ， zui jia shi jian wei  [time]。 quan qiu yi wan cheng  [number]  ci ， quan qiu zui jia shi jian shi  [time]。]

english: You've completed [number] laps of our advanced course with a best time of [time]. There's been [number] global completions and the global best time is [time].
translation: 您已完成我们高级课程的 [number] 圈，最好成绩为 [time]。全球已完成 [number] 次，全球最佳时间是 [time]。 [nin yi wan cheng wo men gao ji ke cheng de  [number]  quan ， zui hao cheng ji wei  [time]。 quan qiu yi wan cheng  [number]  ci ， quan qiu zui jia shi jian shi  [time]。]

translation: 是啊，难吗？ [shi a ， nan ma ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Shayzien Basic Course.
translation: Shayzien 基础课程。 [Shayzien  ji chu ke cheng 。]

english: Shayzien Advanced Course:
translation: Shayzien 高级课程： [Shayzien  gao ji ke cheng ：]

english: Not often you see a couple of soldiers out for a drink.
translation: 你很少能看到几个士兵出去喝酒。 [ni hen shao neng kan dao ji ge shi bing chu qu he jiu 。]

english: We've just finished our first duties in the Lizardman Canyon. A few drinks at the Cloak and Stagger to celebrate is always traditional.
translation: 我们刚刚完成了在蜥蜴人峡谷的第一项任务。在 Cloak and Stagger 喝几杯庆祝总是传统的。 [wo men gang gang wan cheng le zai xi yi ren xia gu de di yi xiang ren wu 。 zai  Cloak and Stagger  he ji bei qing zhu zong shi chuan tong de 。]

english: Sounds like you earned it. Enjoy!
translation: 听起来像是你赚到了。享受！ [ting qi lai xiang shi ni zhuan dao le 。 xiang shou ！]

english: Don't expect me to deal with the likes of you.
translation: 别指望我会对付你这样的人。 [bie zhi wang wo hui dui fu ni zhe yang de ren 。]

english: You do not have enough Shayzien favour. Current favour: [current favour in %] - Required: 60.0%
translation: 你没有得到足够的 Shayzien 青睐。当前好感度：[当前好感度%] - 必需：60.0% [ni mei you de dao zu gou de  Shayzien  qing lai 。 dang qian hao gan du ：[ dang qian hao gan du %] -  bi xu ：60.0%]

english: If you're planning on fighting me for a set of my armour, I'm afraid I'm not interested. The combat XP from fighting you isn't worthwhile. Get a Defence level of 20 first.
translation: 如果你打算和我争夺一套盔甲，恐怕我不感兴趣。与你战斗所获得的战斗经验值并不值得。首先防御等级达到20。 [ru guo ni da suan he wo zheng duo yi tao kui jia ， kong pa wo bu gan xing qu 。 yu ni zhan dou suo huo de de zhan dou jing yan zhi bing bu zhi de 。 shou xian fang yu deng ji da dao 20。]

english: Hello. Do you fancy a fight? It's just a bit of fun, so I can practice melee combat. I'll give you a piece of my armour if you win.
translation: 你好。你想打架吗？只是为了好玩，可以练习一下近战。如果你赢了，我会给你一件我的盔甲。 [ni hao 。 ni xiang da jia ma ？ zhi shi wei le hao wan ， ke yi lian xi yi xia jin zhan 。 ru guo ni ying le ， wo hui gei ni yi jian wo de kui jia 。]

english: Okay, I reckon I can take you. Did you just say you wanted to practice melee combat in particular?
translation: 好吧，我想我可以带你去。你刚才不是说你特别想练习近战吗？ [hao ba ， wo xiang wo ke yi dai ni qu 。 ni gang cai bu shi shuo ni te bie xiang lian xi jin zhan ma ？]

english: Yes, I'm not interested in fancy magicks. We leave that namby-pamby stuff to the Arceuus weirdos. And no ranging either. We'll fight just with melee.
translation: 是的，我对花哨的魔法不感兴趣。我们把那些可爱的东西留给了 Arceuus 怪人。也没有测距。我们只会用近战来战斗。 [shi de ， wo dui hua shao de mo fa bu gan xing qu 。 wo men ba na xie ke ai de dong xi liu gei le  Arceuus  guai ren 。 ye mei you ce ju 。 wo men zhi hui yong jin zhan lai zhan dou 。]

english: Remember, if you lose, you'll probably drop some items, and you probably won't get them back again. Just run away if you want to stop the fight.
translation: 请记住，如果你输了，你可能会掉落一些物品，并且你可能不会再把它们拿回来。如果你想停止战斗，就逃跑吧。 [qing ji zhu ， ru guo ni shu le ， ni ke neng hui diao luo yi xie wu pin ， bing qie ni ke neng bu hui zai ba ta men na hui lai 。 ru guo ni xiang ting zhi zhan dou ， jiu tao pao ba 。]

english: I understand. Let's fight.
translation: 我明白。我们来战斗吧。 [wo ming bai 。 wo men lai zhan dou ba 。]

english: To the arena!
translation: 到竞技场！ [dao jing ji chang ！]

translation: 在这种情况下，你可能不应该在军营附近闲逛。 [zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， ni ke neng bu ying gai zai jun ying fu jin xian guang 。]

translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]
