Of course, of course! In fact if you have more than one I'll imbue all of them!
translation: 当然，当然！事实上，如果您有多个，我会将它们全部注入！ [dang ran ， dang ran ！ shi shi shang ， ru guo nin you duo ge ， wo hui jiang ta men quan bu zhu ru ！]

english: There you go, now that I've imbued all of your sceptres, once they run out of charges they will no longer break and they can be charged with any piece of the sceptre you find.
translation: 好了，现在我已经给你所有的权杖注入了能量，一旦它们用完能量，它们就不会再破碎，并且可以用你找到的任何权杖碎片来充电。 [hao le ， xian zai wo yi jing gei ni suo you de quan zhang zhu ru le neng liang ， yi dan ta men yong wan neng liang ， ta men jiu bu hui zai po sui ， bing qie ke yi yong ni zhao dao de ren he quan zhang sui pian lai chong dian 。]

english: Thank you very much! How many charges does each piece give?
translation: 非常感谢！每件收费多少？ [fei chang gan xie ！ mei jian shou fei duo shao ？]

english: Most of them give 3, although the left skull gives 5. Each completed tier of the Varrock achievement diary will get you one extra charge per piece and allow your sceptre to hold 4 more charges.
translation: 他们中的大多数给出 3 个，尽管左侧头骨给出 5 个。 Varrock 成就日记的每个完成层都会为您带来每件额外的费用，并允许您的权杖再容纳 4 个费用。 [ta men zhong de da duo shu gei chu  3  ge ， jin guan zuo ce tou gu gei chu  5  ge 。 Varrock  cheng jiu ri ji de mei ge wan cheng ceng du hui wei nin dai lai mei jian e wai de fei yong ， bing yun xu nin de quan zhang zai rong na  4  ge fei yong 。]

english: You can use a chisel to break a sceptre piece into fragments, then use those to charge the sceptre instead. More flexible if you ask me.
translation: 你可以使用凿子将权杖碎片打成碎片，然后用这些碎片为权杖充电。如果你问我的话，会更灵活。 [ni ke yi shi yong zao zi jiang quan zhang sui pian da cheng sui pian ， ran hou yong zhe xie sui pian wei quan zhang chong dian 。 ru guo ni wen wo de hua ， hui geng ling huo 。]

english: Finally, be warned that if you disable your authenticator, the imbue on the sceptre will be removed.
translation: 最后，请注意，如果您禁用验证器，权杖上的注入将被删除。 [zui hou ， qing zhu yi ， ru guo nin jin yong yan zheng qi ， quan zhang shang de zhu ru jiang bei shan chu 。]

english: Fantastic! It's best I keep my authenticator activated then. Good byeSolztun!
translation: 极好的！我最好保持我的身份验证器处于激活状态。再见索尔兹通！ [ji hao de ！ wo zui hao bao chi wo de shen fen yan zheng qi chu yu ji huo zhuang tai 。 zai jian suo er zi tong ！]

english: Stay safe, adventurer.
translation: 注意安全，冒险家。 [zhu yi an quan ， mao xian jia 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: As I said, I am Solztun, the greatest barbarian explorer! I came to explore this place, but unfortunately I died long before I made it to the treasure.
translation: 正如我所说，我是索尔兹顿，最伟大的野蛮人探险家！我是来探索这个地方的，可惜我还没到达宝藏就死了。 [zheng ru wo suo shuo ， wo shi suo er zi dun ， zui wei da de ye man ren tan xian jia ！ wo shi lai tan suo zhe ge di fang de ， ke xi wo hai mei dao da bao zang jiu si le 。]

english: Nobody came to help?!
translation: 没人来帮忙吗？！ [mei ren lai bang mang ma ？！]

english: Oh no, they had no idea I was hurt, I guess they assumed I'd found the treasure and made a new life for myself.
translation: 哦不，他们不知道我受伤了，我猜他们以为我找到了宝藏并为自己创造了新的生活。 [o bu ， ta men bu zhi dao wo shou shang le ， wo cai ta men yi wei wo zhao dao le bao zang bing wei zi ji chuang zao le xin de sheng huo 。]

english: Were you not a fan of the barbarian life style?
translation: 您不喜欢野蛮人的生活方式吗？ [nin bu xi huan ye man ren de sheng huo fang shi ma ？]

english: It was all death and pillaging, I prefer the finer things in life, like exploration and discovery!
translation: 一切都是死亡和掠夺，我更喜欢生活中更美好的事物，比如探索和发现！ [yi qie dou shi si wang he lve duo ， wo geng xi huan sheng huo zhong geng mei hao de shi wu ， bi ru tan suo he fa xian ！]

english: Ah, I too enjoy those.
translation: 啊，我也喜欢这些。 [a ， wo ye xi huan zhe xie 。]

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？ [ni wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: I came for treasure!
translation: 我是来寻宝的！ [wo shi lai xun bao de ！]

english: Oh right, you were looking for what's in that cradle?
translation: 哦，对了，你在找那个摇篮里有什么吗？ [o ， dui le ， ni zai zhao na ge yao lan li you shen me ma ？]

english: Yes, but alas, I'm dead.
translation: 是的，但可惜的是，我死了。 [shi de ， dan ke xi de shi ， wo si le 。]

english: I guess I could show you... for a price.
translation: 我想我可以给你看...但要付点钱。 [wo xiang wo ke yi gei ni kan ... dan yao fu dian qian 。]

english: Hmm... I don't have much to offer, but if you happen upon a skull sceptre, I could make it stronger.
translation: 嗯……我没有什么可以提供的，但如果你碰巧发现了骷髅权杖，我可以让它变得更强。 [n …… wo mei you shen me ke yi ti gong de ， dan ru guo ni peng qiao fa xian le ku lou quan zhang ， wo ke yi rang ta bian de geng qiang 。]

english: Stronger you say... In what way?
translation: 你说更强……以什么方式？ [ni shuo geng qiang …… yi shen me fang shi ？]

english: Currently the sceptre is fragile, it breaks once all charges have been used. Show me the treasure and I could imbue it so it can be recharged with any sceptre piece.
translation: 目前权杖很脆弱，一旦使用完所有费用就会破裂。向我展示宝藏，我可以将其注入，这样它就可以用任何权杖碎片重新充电。 [mu qian quan zhang hen cui ruo ， yi dan shi yong wan suo you fei yong jiu hui po lie 。 xiang wo zhan shi bao zang ， wo ke yi jiang qi zhu ru ， zhe yang ta jiu ke yi yong ren he quan zhang sui pian chong xin chong dian 。]

english: You, my dead friend, have a deal!
translation: 你，我死去的朋友，有一笔交易！ [ni ， wo si qu de peng you ， you yi bi jiao yi ！]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: No, that's not it.
translation: 不，不是这样。 [bu ， bu shi zhe yang 。]

english: But I didn't show you anything.
translation: 但我什么也没给你看。 [dan wo shen me ye mei gei ni kan 。]

english: I sense that you don't have the treasure.
translation: 我感觉你没有宝藏。 [wo gan jue ni mei you bao zang 。]

english: Could you imbue my sceptre?
translation: 你能将我的权杖注入其中吗？ [ni neng jiang wo de quan zhang zhu ru qi zhong ma ？]

english: Is my account safe?
translation: 我的账户安全吗？ [wo de zhang hu an quan ma ？]

english: Is this the treasure?
translation: 这就是宝藏吗？ [zhe jiu shi bao zang ma ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？ [ni wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Hmm... You're not my usual kind of customer, but I reckon I can still make this work. What will it be? Haircut or a shave?
translation: 嗯...你不是我平常的那种顾客，但我想我仍然可以做到这一点。会是什么？理发还是刮胡子？ [n ... ni bu shi wo ping chang de na zhong gu ke ， dan wo xiang wo reng ran ke yi zuo dao zhe yi dian 。 hui shi shen me ？ li fa hai shi gua hu zi ？]

english: I'd like a haircut please.
translation: 请给我理发。 [qing gei wo li fa 。]

english: Then let's get to it.
translation: 那么我们开始吧。 [na me wo men kai shi ba 。]

english: I'd like a shave please.
translation: 请给我刮胡子。 [qing gei wo gua hu zi 。]

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Suit yourself.
translation: 适合自己。 [shi he zi ji 。]

english: I'd like a haircut please.
translation: 请给我理发。 [qing gei wo li fa 。]

english: I'd like a shave please.
translation: 请给我刮胡子。 [qing gei wo gua hu zi 。]

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Sorry, I can't chat while I'm on duty. I have to keep alert.
translation: 抱歉，我值班时不能聊天。我必须保持警惕。 [bao qian ， wo zhi ban shi bu neng liao tian 。 wo bi xu bao chi jing ti 。]

english: How can I help you?
translation: 我怎么帮你？ [wo zen me bang ni ？]

english: What are you doing down here?
translation: 你在下面做什么？ [ni zai xia mian zuo shen me ？]

english: We're here to guard the bank and make sure no one tries anything.
translation: 我们来这里是为了守卫银行并确保没有人尝试任何事情。 [wo men lai zhe li shi wei le shou wei yin hang bing que bao mei you ren chang shi ren he shi qing 。]

english: Do you have a tinderbox?
translation: 你有火药盒吗？ [ni you huo yao he ma ？]

english: I have one I could sell you for 50 coins.
translation: 我有一个可以50金币卖给你。 [wo you yi ge ke yi 50 jin bi mai gei ni 。]

english: I'll take it.
translation: 我要买它。 [wo yao mai ta 。]

english: Actually, I don't seem to have enough money on me.
translation: 事实上，我身上的钱似乎不够。 [shi shi shang ， wo shen shang de qian si hu bu gou 。]

english: Sorry, that's too expensive.
translation: 抱歉，那太贵了。 [bao qian ， na tai gui le 。]

english: No problem. Come back if you change your mind.
translation: 没问题。如果你改变主意就回来吧。 [mei wen ti 。 ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi jiu hui lai ba 。]

english: I do, but I'd like to hold on to it for now.
translation: 我愿意，但我想暂时保留它。 [wo yuan yi ， dan wo xiang zan shi bao liu ta 。]

english: That's okay; I've one with me anyway.
translation: 没关系；反正我身边也有一个。 [mei guan xi ； fan zheng wo shen bian ye you yi ge 。]

english: Do you have a torch?
translation: 你有手电筒吗？ [ni you shou dian tong ma ？]

english: I'll sell you an unlit one for 200 coins.
translation: 我会以 200 个硬币的价格卖给你一个不发光的。 [wo hui yi  200  ge ying bi de jia ge mai gei ni yi ge bu fa guang de 。]

english: How come you're not spotty?
translation: 你怎么没有斑点？ [ni zen me mei you ban dian ？]

english: Ah, the pox. We weren't here when the outbreak took place. We were out of town trying to catch an antiques thief called Simon Templeton. We've only just got back.
translation: 啊，痘。疫情爆发时我们不在场。我们出城试图抓捕一个名叫西蒙·坦普尔顿的古董窃贼。我们才刚刚回来。 [a ， dou 。 yi qing bao fa shi wo men bu zai chang 。 wo men chu cheng shi tu zhua bu yi ge ming jiao xi meng · tan pu er dun de gu dong qie zei 。 wo men cai gang gang hui lai 。]

english: Aren't you afraid you'll fall ill as well?
translation: 你就不怕自己也会生病吗？ [ni jiu bu pa zi ji ye hui sheng bing ma ？]

english: The only reason we've been let back into the city is because the High Priest believes the pox isn't contagious.
translation: 我们被允许返回城市的唯一原因是因为大祭司相信痘不会传染。 [wo men bei yun xu fan hui cheng shi de wei yi yuan yin shi yin wei da ji si xiang xin dou bu hui chuan ran 。]

english: Besides, Sophanem is my home. It will take a lot more than the threat of a few spots to keep me away.
translation: 此外，Sophanem 是我的家。要阻止我离开，需要的不仅仅是几个地点的威胁。 [ci wai ，Sophanem  shi wo de jia 。 yao zu zhi wo li kai ， xu yao de bu jin jin shi ji ge di dian de wei xie 。]

english: You can't. I'd better go.
translation: 你不能。我最好走了。 [ni bu neng 。 wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: Be careful down there!
translation: 下面小心点！ [xia mian xiao xin dian ！]

english: What are you doing down here?
translation: 你在下面做什么？ [ni zai xia mian zuo shen me ？]

english: Do you have a tinderbox?
translation: 你有火药盒吗？ [ni you huo yao he ma ？]

english: I'll take it.
translation: 我要买它。 [wo yao mai ta 。]

english: Sorry, that's too expensive.
translation: 抱歉，那太贵了。 [bao qian ， na tai gui le 。]

english: Do you have a torch?
translation: 你有手电筒吗？ [ni you shou dian tong ma ？]

english: How come you're not spotty?
translation: 你怎么没有斑点？ [ni zen me mei you ban dian ？]

english: You can't. I'd better go.
translation: 你不能。我最好走了。 [ni bu neng 。 wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: You! You're the reason I'm in here.
translation: 你！你就是我来这里的原因。 [ni ！ ni jiu shi wo lai zhe li de yuan yin 。]

english: Yeah... Sorry about that. This is what happens when you make poor life choices though.
translation: 是的...对此感到抱歉。当你做出糟糕的生活选择时，就会发生这种情况。 [shi de ... dui ci gan dao bao qian 。 dang ni zuo chu zao gao de sheng huo xuan ze shi ， jiu hui fa sheng zhe zhong qing kuang 。]

english: I hope you enjoy this moment, it won't last.
translation: 我希望你享受这一刻，它不会持续太久。 [wo xi wang ni xiang shou zhe yi ke ， ta bu hui chi xu tai jiu 。]

english: Soon he will descend on this miserable lands and everything you know will be ash!
translation: 很快他就会降临在这片悲惨的土地上，你所知道的一切都将化为灰烬！ [hen kuai ta jiu hui jiang lin zai zhe pian bei can de tu di shang ， ni suo zhi dao de yi qie dou jiang hua wei hui jin ！]

english: Well that just sounds great. See you later.
translation: 嗯，听起来很棒。稍后见。 [n ， ting qi lai hen bang 。 shao hou jian 。]

english: Who are you and what do you want?
translation: 你是谁，你想要什么？ [ni shi shui ， ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: None of your business!
translation: 关你屁事！ [guan ni pi shi ！]

english: I go where I like and do what I like.
translation: 我去我喜欢的地方，做我喜欢的事。 [wo qu wo xi huan de di fang ， zuo wo xi huan de shi 。]

english: Not in my house. Be gone!
translation: 不在我家。走吧！ [bu zai wo jia 。 zou ba ！]

english: Be gone, intruder!
translation: 走开吧，入侵者！ [zou kai ba ， ru qin zhe ！]

english: I'm here to kill you!
translation: 我是来杀你的！ [wo shi lai sha ni de ！]

english: I think not!
translation: 我认为不是！ [wo ren wei bu shi ！]

english: Can I have some sq'irks please?
translation: 能给我一些 sq'irks 吗？ [neng gei wo yi xie  sq'irks  ma ？]

english: What do you want them for?
translation: 你要它们做什么？ [ni yao ta men zuo shen me ？]

english: Someone asked me to bring them some.
translation: 有人要我给他们带一些。 [you ren yao wo gei ta men dai yi xie 。]

english: Who?
translation: WHO？ [WHO？]

english: Osman.
translation: 奥斯曼。 [ao si man 。]

english: In that case I'm sorry, but you can't. I have had a falling out with him recently and would rather not oblige him.
translation: 在这种情况下，我很抱歉，但你不能。我最近和他闹翻了，不想答应他。 [zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， wo hen bao qian ， dan ni bu neng 。 wo zui jin he ta nao fan le ， bu xiang da ying ta 。]

english: Selim.
translation: 塞利姆。 [sai li mu 。]

english: In that case I'm sorry, but you can't. I have had a falling out with his master recently and would rather not oblige him.
translation: 在这种情况下，我很抱歉，但你不能。我最近和他的主人闹翻了，不想答应他。 [zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， wo hen bao qian ， dan ni bu neng 。 wo zui jin he ta de zhu ren nao fan le ， bu xiang da ying ta 。]

english: I'm just passing by.
translation: 我只是路过而已 [wo zhi shi lu guo er yi]

english: None of your business!
translation: 关你屁事！ [guan ni pi shi ！]

english: I'm here to kill you!
translation: 我是来杀你的！ [wo shi lai sha ni de ！]

english: Can I have some sq'irks please?
translation: 能给我一些 sq'irks 吗？ [neng gei wo yi xie  sq'irks  ma ？]

english: I'm just passing by.
translation: 我只是路过而已 [wo zhi shi lu guo er yi]

english: Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: 嘿，这是英雄！哇！你太厉害了，你到底是怎么对付那两个少年和加德兰克的？这个小镇很可爱，你做得很好！ [hei ， zhe shi ying xiong ！ wa ！ ni tai li hai le ， ni dao di shi zen me dui fu na liang ge shao nian he jia de lan ke de ？ zhe ge xiao zhen hen ke ai ， ni zuo de hen hao ！]

english: You're more than welcome.
translation: 非常欢迎您。 [fei chang huan ying nin 。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Not that it makes much difference but my name's Sorin. Like all the other survivors here, I just try to make do and get through each day at a time.
translation: 虽然这没什么区别，但我的名字叫索林。和这里的所有其他幸存者一样，我只是尽力凑合着度过每一天。 [sui ran zhe mei shen me qu bie ， dan wo de ming zi jiao suo lin 。 he zhe li de suo you qi ta xing cun zhe yi yang ， wo zhi shi jin li cou he zhe du guo mei yi tian 。]

english: How do you like your town?
translation: 你喜欢你的城市吗？ [ni xi huan ni de cheng shi ma ？]

english: It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
translation: 非常完美，非常感谢您的努力。 [fei chang wan mei ， fei chang gan xie nin de nu li 。]

english: What's happening around here?
translation: 这附近发生了什么事？ [zhe fu jin fa sheng le shen me shi ？]

english: Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: 哦，其实也没什么，我们都还在躲避吸血鬼，在这个可怕的地方勉强维持生计，希望很快我们就能足够强大，踏上前往圣殿的旅程。 [o ， qi shi ye mei shen me ， wo men dou hai zai duo bi xi xue gui ， zai zhe ge ke pa de di fang mian qiang wei chi sheng ji ， xi wang hen kuai wo men jiu neng zu gou qiang da ， ta shang qian wang sheng dian de lv cheng 。]

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang mang de ma ？]

english: Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: 据我所知，我们现在有一些非常有用的基本设施，我们都非常感谢您。我以前从未真正见过或认识英雄，所以我没有什么可以与之比较的，但我怀疑 [ju wo suo zhi ， wo men xian zai you yi xie fei chang you yong de ji ben she shi ， wo men dou fei chang gan xie nin 。 wo yi qian cong wei zhen zheng jian guo huo ren shi ying xiong ， suo yi wo mei you shen me ke yi yu zhi bi jiao de ， dan wo huai yi]

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: 大多数人的判断，你就是其中之一！我很高兴见到你。 [da duo shu ren de pan duan ， ni jiu shi qi zhong zhi yi ！ wo hen gao xing jian dao ni 。]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: How do you like your town?
translation: 你喜欢你的城市吗？ [ni xi huan ni de cheng shi ma ？]

english: What's happening around here?
translation: 这附近发生了什么事？ [zhe fu jin fa sheng le shen me shi ？]

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
translation: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang mang de ma ？]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: I hate this job. All the other staff are so happy all the time. It depresses me.
translation: 我讨厌这份工作。所有其他员工一直都很高兴。这让我很沮丧。 [wo tao yan zhe fen gong zuo 。 suo you qi ta yuan gong yi zhi dou hen gao xing 。 zhe rang wo hen ju sang 。]

english: Why don't you get a new job?
translation: 你为什么不找一份新工作呢？ [ni wei shen me bu zhao yi fen xin gong zuo ne ？]

english: I can't find any other work. I wanted to be a Gnomeball player but I wasn't big enough.
translation: 我找不到其他工作了。我想成为一名侏儒球玩家，但我还不够大。 [wo zhao bu dao qi ta gong zuo le 。 wo xiang cheng wei yi ming zhu ru qiu wan jia ， dan wo hai bu gou da 。]

english: That's a shame. I'd better let you get on with your work.
translation: 太可惜了。我最好让你继续你的工作。 [tai ke xi le 。 wo zui hao rang ni ji xu ni de gong zuo 。]

english: OK, whatever.
translation: 好吧，无论如何。 [hao ba ， wu lun ru he 。]

english: Aren't you going to wish me a nice day?
translation: 你不想祝我有美好的一天吗？ [ni bu xiang zhu wo you mei hao de yi tian ma ？]

english: Have a day. It can be nice if you can be bothered. I know I can't.
translation: 过一天吧。如果你能被打扰就好了。我知道我不能。 [guo yi tian ba 。 ru guo ni neng bei da rao jiu hao le 。 wo zhi dao wo bu neng 。]

english: ... nice.
translation: ... 好的。 [...  hao de 。]

english: Good day.
translation: 再会。 [zai hui 。]

english: I have no interest in speaking with you. You should bring your cat to me again. The two of us have much to discuss.
translation: 我没有兴趣和你说话。你应该再把你的猫带到我这里来。我们两个有很多话要讨论。 [wo mei you xing qu he ni shuo hua 。 ni ying gai zai ba ni de mao dai dao wo zhe li lai 。 wo men liang ge you hen duo hua yao tao lun 。]

english: The Sphinx ignores you.
translation: 狮身人面像无视你。 [shi shen ren mian xiang wu shi ni 。]

english: Ah, how interesting... a cat. Come here to me, kitty.
translation: 啊，多么有趣啊……一只猫。到我这里来吧，小猫。 [a ， duo me you qu a …… yi zhi mao 。 dao wo zhe li lai ba ， xiao mao 。]

english: Meow.
translation: 喵。 [miao 。]

english: Your cat and the Sphinx converse in a yeowling language for a short time.
translation: 你的猫和狮身人面像用小猫语言进行了短暂的交谈。 [ni de mao he shi shen ren mian xiang yong xiao mao yu yan jin xing le duan zan de jiao tan 。]

english: Do you think that you'll be able to communicate with me at a deeper level because you're wearing that amulet of catspeak?
translation: 你以为你戴着猫语护身符就能和我进行更深层次的交流吗？ [ni yi wei ni dai zhe mao yu hu shen fu jiu neng he wo jin xing geng shen ceng ci de jiao liu ma ？]

english: Er, yes?
translation: 呃，是吗？ [e ， shi ma ？]

english: How very foolish.
translation: 多么愚蠢啊。 [duo me yu chun a 。]

english: So, what do you need human?
translation: 那么，人类需要什么呢？ [na me ， ren lei xu yao shen me ne ？]

english: What do you need human?
translation: 你需要什么人类？ [ni xu yao shen me ren lei ？]

english: Can you tell me about the gods of the Menaphites?
translation: 你能告诉我关于梅纳菲特诸神的事吗？ [ni neng gao su wo guan yu mei na fei te zhu shen de shi ma ？]

english: If you wish to know about the lesser gods, you should speak with Jex at the Temple of the Lesser Gods. I suppose I could spare a moment or two to tell you about the main four though.
translation: 如果你想了解小神，你应该在小神殿与杰克斯交谈。我想我可以花一两分钟的时间来告诉你主要的四个。 [ru guo ni xiang liao jie xiao shen ， ni ying gai zai xiao shen dian yu jie ke si jiao tan 。 wo xiang wo ke yi hua yi liang fen zhong de shi jian lai gao su ni zhu yao de si ge 。]

english: Tell me about Tumeken.
translation: 告诉我关于图梅肯的事。 [gao su wo guan yu tu mei ken de shi 。]

english: Tumeken is the god of light and husband to Elidinis. He is the leading god of the Menaphite Pantheon.
translation: 图梅肯是光明之神，也是埃里迪尼斯的丈夫。他是梅纳菲特万神殿的主神。 [tu mei ken shi guang ming zhi shen ， ye shi ai li di ni si de zhang fu 。 ta shi mei na fei te wan shen dian de zhu shen 。]

english: People don't seem to talk about him much. I'd have thought being the leading god would make him more popular.
translation: 人们似乎不太谈论他。我本以为成为主神会让他更受欢迎。 [ren men si hu bu tai tan lun ta 。 wo ben yi wei cheng wei zhu shen hui rang ta geng shou huan ying 。]

english: A common saying about Tumeken is that you see him wherever you look, but never actually notice him.
translation: 关于图梅肯的一个常见说法是，无论你往哪里看，你都会看到他，但你却从未真正注意到他。 [guan yu tu mei ken de yi ge chang jian shuo fa shi ， wu lun ni wang na li kan ， ni du hui kan dao ta ， dan ni que cong wei zhen zheng zhu yi dao ta 。]

english: Okay... And what kind of god is he? The desert is a harsh place, so does that make him harsh as well?
translation: 好吧……那他到底是个什么样的神呢？沙漠是一个严酷的地方，那么他也会变得严酷吗？ [hao ba …… na ta dao di shi ge shen me yang de shen ne ？ sha mo shi yi ge yan ku de di fang ， na me ta ye hui bian de yan ku ma ？]

english: In some ways. You humans sometimes say that 'you have to be cruel to be kind'. That seems a fitting way to describe Tumeken.
translation: 在某些方面。你们人类有时会说“要想仁慈就必须残忍”。这似乎是描述图梅肯的恰当方式。 [zai mou xie fang mian 。 ni men ren lei you shi hui shuo “ yao xiang ren ci jiu bi xu can ren ”。 zhe si hu shi miao shu tu mei ken de qia dang fang shi 。]

english: So he's harsh, but for good reasons?
translation: 所以他很严厉，但有充分的理由吗？ [suo yi ta hen yan li ， dan you chong fen de li you ma ？]

english: Indeed.
translation: 的确。 [di que 。]

english: Tell me about Elidinis.
translation: 告诉我有关埃利迪尼斯的事。 [gao su wo you guan ai li di ni si de shi 。]

english: Elidinis is the goddess of fertility. The River Elid is named in her honour, for it brings life to the whole region.
translation: 埃里迪尼斯是生育女神。埃利德河以她的名字命名，因为它给整个地区带来了生机。 [ai li di ni si shi sheng yu nv shen 。 ai li de he yi ta de ming zi ming ming ， yin wei ta gei zheng ge di qu dai lai le sheng ji 。]

english: There are some who even believe the river to be Elidinis herself.
translation: 有些人甚至相信这条河就是埃利迪尼斯本人。 [you xie ren shen zhi xiang xin zhe tiao he jiu shi ai li di ni si ben ren 。]

english: That's an interesting take. I guess being a bringer of life makes her quite popular?
translation: 这是一个有趣的想法。我猜作为生命的使者让她很受欢迎？ [zhe shi yi ge you qu de xiang fa 。 wo cai zuo wei sheng ming de shi zhe rang ta hen shou huan ying ？]

english: More so than many others in the pantheon, but not as much as she once was.
translation: 比万神殿中的许多其他人都要严重，但不如她以前那么严重。 [bi wan shen dian zhong de xu duo qi ta ren dou yao yan zhong ， dan bu ru ta yi qian na me yan zhong 。]

english: Why not?
translation: 为什么不呢？ [wei shen me bu ne ？]

english: Humans are fickle. Perhaps they grew bored of her?
translation: 人类是善变的。也许他们对她感到厌倦了？ [ren lei shi shan bian de 。 ye xu ta men dui ta gan dao yan juan le ？]

english: That sounds unlikely.
translation: 这听起来不太可能。 [zhe ting qi lai bu tai ke neng 。]

english: Well if you're after the human take on things, you'd be better off asking a human.
translation: 好吧，如果你追求人类对事物的看法，你最好去问人类。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni zhui qiu ren lei dui shi wu de kan fa ， ni zui hao qu wen ren lei 。]

english: Tell me about Icthlarin.
translation: 告诉我有关 Icthlarin 的事。 [gao su wo you guan  Icthlarin  de shi 。]

english: Icthlarin is the god of the dead. He is the son of Tumeken and Elidinis, and brother to the Devourer. As this is the city of the dead, he's quite popular here.
translation: 伊克拉林（Icthlarin）是死者之神。他是图梅肯和埃里迪尼斯的儿子，也是吞噬者的兄弟。因为这里是死者之城，所以他在这里很受欢迎。 [yi ke la lin （Icthlarin） shi si zhe zhi shen 。 ta shi tu mei ken he ai li di ni si de er zi ， ye shi tun shi zhe de xiong di 。 yin wei zhe li shi si zhe zhi cheng ， suo yi ta zai zhe li hen shou huan ying 。]

english: So are you a follower of Icthlarin?
translation: 那么你是 Icthlarin 的追随者吗？ [na me ni shi  Icthlarin  de zhui sui zhe ma ？]

english: Nothing of the sort. I have no interest in the gods or their followers. Instead, Icthlarin and I have an understanding.
translation: 根本不是这样的。我对诸神或他们的追随者没有兴趣。相反，Icthlarin 和我达成了共识。 [gen ben bu shi zhe yang de 。 wo dui zhu shen huo ta men de zhui sui zhe mei you xing qu 。 xiang fan ，Icthlarin  he wo da cheng le gong shi 。]

english: Cats play a significant role when it comes to guarding the dead from the Devourer. As such, they are great allies to Icthlarin.
translation: 猫在保护死者免受吞噬者侵害方面发挥着重要作用。因此，他们是 Icthlarin 的伟大盟友。 [mao zai bao hu si zhe mian shou tun shi zhe qin hai fang mian fa hui zhuo zhong yao zuo yong 。 yin ci ， ta men shi  Icthlarin  de wei da meng you 。]

english: As a thank you for looking after them, Icthlarin grants me eternal life.
translation: 为了感谢你照顾他们，Icthlarin 赐予我永生。 [wei le gan xie ni zhao gu ta men ，Icthlarin  ci yu wo yong sheng 。]

english: Tell me about the Devourer.
translation: 告诉我关于吞噬者的事情。 [gao su wo guan yu tun shi zhe de shi qing 。]

english: I'd have thought you'd be more than familiar with her by now.
translation: 我以为你现在对她已经非常熟悉了。 [wo yi wei ni xian zai dui ta yi jing fei chang shu xi le 。]

english: I'm interested in hearing your take.
translation: 我有兴趣听听你的看法。 [wo you xing qu ting ting ni de kan fa 。]

english: Very well. The Devourer is the goddess of destruction. As such, she is commonly considered an evil goddess, but this is an oversimplification.
translation: 很好。吞噬者是毁灭女神。因此，她通常被认为是邪恶的女神，但这过于简单化了。 [hen hao 。 tun shi zhe shi hui mie nv shen 。 yin ci ， ta tong chang bei ren wei shi xie e de nv shen ， dan zhe guo yu jian dan hua le 。]

english: How so?
translation: 为何如此？ [wei he ru ci ？]

english: Not everything that destroys is evil. Destruction is often a necessity.
translation: 并非所有破坏的事物都是邪恶的。破坏往往是必要的。 [bing fei suo you po huai de shi wu dou shi xie e de 。 po huai wang wang shi bi yao de 。]

english: Isn't that also an oversimplification? Amascut is doing far more than just destroying. She's a murderer!
translation: 这不也是一种过于简单化的表现吗？阿马斯卡特所做的远不只是破坏。她是杀人犯！ [zhe bu ye shi yi zhong guo yu jian dan hua de biao xian ma ？ a ma si ka te suo zuo de yuan bu zhi shi po huai 。 ta shi sha ren fan ！]

english: Is causing death enough to make one evil? Icthlarin is the god of the dead. By your argument, surely he is the most evil of them all.
translation: 造成死亡足以使一种邪恶发生吗？伊克拉林（Icthlarin）是死者之神。按照你的说法，他肯定是他们当中最邪恶的一个。 [zao cheng si wang zu yi shi yi zhong xie e fa sheng ma ？ yi ke la lin （Icthlarin） shi si zhe zhi shen 。 an zhao ni de shuo fa ， ta ken ding shi ta men dang zhong zui xie e de yi ge 。]

english: Icthlarin doesn't actually kill people though. He just looks after those that have died.
translation: 但 Icthlarin 实际上并不会杀人。他只是照顾那些死去的人。 [dan  Icthlarin  shi ji shang bing bu hui sha ren 。 ta zhi shi zhao gu na xie si qu de ren 。]

english: You clearly know little of Icthlarin and his past. Are you aware of the Mahjarrat? They once served Icthlarin, before they left him for Zamorak.
translation: 你显然对伊克拉林和他的过去知之甚少。你知道马吉拉特吗？在离开伊克拉林前往萨莫拉克之前，他们曾经为他服务过。 [ni xian ran dui yi ke la lin he ta de guo qu zhi zhi shen shao 。 ni zhi dao ma ji la te ma ？ zai li kai yi ke la lin qian wang sa mo la ke zhi qian ， ta men ceng jing wei ta fu wu guo 。]

english: Or was it the Empty Lord they left him for... I forget.
translation: 或者他们离开他的原因是空虚之主……我忘了。 [huo zhe ta men li kai ta de yuan yin shi kong xu zhi zhu …… wo wang le 。]

english: Regardless, they are a race that have regularly associated themselves with gods considered evil. Interesting company for one such as Icthlarin to keep.
translation: 无论如何，他们是一个经常与被视为邪恶的神联系在一起的种族。对于像 Icthlarin 这样的人来说，这是一个值得保留的有趣公司。 [wu lun ru he ， ta men shi yi ge jing chang yu bei shi wei xie e de shen lian xi zai yi qi de zhong zu 。 dui yu xiang  Icthlarin  zhe yang de ren lai shuo ， zhe shi yi ge zhi de bao liu de you qu gong si 。]

english: How does that make Amascut good though?
translation: 那么，这如何让 Amascut 变得优秀呢？ [na me ， zhe ru he rang  Amascut  bian de you xiu ne ？]

english: I never said it did. I'm just saying that things are often not as straightforward as they seem, especially when it comes to Icthlarin and the Devourer.
translation: 我从来没有说过是这样。我只是想说，事情往往并不像看起来那么简单，尤其是当涉及到 Icthlarin 和吞噬者时。 [wo cong lai mei you shuo guo shi zhe yang 。 wo zhi shi xiang shuo ， shi qing wang wang bing bu xiang kan qi lai na me jian dan ， you qi shi dang she ji dao  Icthlarin  he tun shi zhe shi 。]

english: If you say so...
translation: 如果你这么说的话... [ru guo ni zhe me shuo de hua ...]

english: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们来谈谈别的事情吧。 [wo men lai tan tan bie de shi qing ba 。]

english: Very well. What do you want to dicuss?
translation: 很好。你想讨论什么？ [hen hao 。 ni xiang tao lun shen me ？]

english: Nothing. I should go.
translation: 没有什么。我该走了。 [mei you shen me 。 wo gai zou le 。]

english: Do you have a spare amulet of catspeak?
translation: 你有多余的猫语护身符吗？ [ni you duo yu de mao yu hu shen fu ma ？]

english: Well, I suppose I do. Seeing as you're such a good guardian of cats, I'll give you one. Be careful with it, though.
translation: 嗯，我想是的。看在你这么优秀的猫守护者的份上，我就送你一只吧。不过要小心。 [n ， wo xiang shi de 。 kan zai ni zhe me you xiu de mao shou hu zhe de fen shang ， wo jiu song ni yi zhi ba 。 bu guo yao xiao xin 。]

english: The Sphinx hands you an amulet of catspeak.
translation: 狮身人面像给你一个猫语护身符。 [shi shen ren mian xiang gei ni yi ge mao yu hu shen fu 。]

english: Paw-don me, I have something to show mew.
translation: 抱抱我，我有东西要给喵喵看。 [bao bao wo ， wo you dong xi yao gei miao miao kan 。]

english: Human, you make a mockery of my kin.
translation: 人类，你在嘲笑我的同胞。 [ren lei ， ni zai chao xiao wo de tong bao 。]

english: Come on, don't be such a sour puss.
translation: 得了吧，别这么酸溜溜的。 [de le ba ， bie zhe me suan liu liu de 。]

english: You should leave, before I deliver retribution for your actions.
translation: 在我对你的行为进行报复之前，你应该离开。 [zai wo dui ni de xing wei jin xing bao fu zhi qian ， ni ying gai li kai 。]

english: Can you tell me about the gods of the Menaphites?
translation: 你能告诉我关于梅纳菲特诸神的事吗？ [ni neng gao su wo guan yu mei na fei te zhu shen de shi ma ？]

english: Tell me about Tumeken.
translation: 告诉我关于图梅肯的事。 [gao su wo guan yu tu mei ken de shi 。]

english: Tell me about Elidinis.
translation: 告诉我有关埃利迪尼斯的事。 [gao su wo you guan ai li di ni si de shi 。]

english: Tell me about Icthlarin.
translation: 告诉我有关 Icthlarin 的事。 [gao su wo you guan  Icthlarin  de shi 。]

english: Tell me about the Devourer.
translation: 告诉我关于吞噬者的事情。 [gao su wo guan yu tun shi zhe de shi qing 。]

english: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们来谈谈别的事情吧。 [wo men lai tan tan bie de shi qing ba 。]

english: Nothing. I should go.
translation: 没有什么。我该走了。 [mei you shen me 。 wo gai zou le 。]

english: Do you have a spare amulet of catspeak?
translation: 你有多余的猫语护身符吗？ [ni you duo yu de mao yu hu shen fu ma ？]

english: Show the Sphinx your cat ears.
translation: 向狮身人面像展示你的猫耳朵。 [xiang shi shen ren mian xiang zhan shi ni de mao er duo 。]

english: Talk about something else.
translation: 说点别的吧。 [shuo dian bie de ba 。]

english: A little bit of spice makes everything taste nice! Come and get it here!
translation: 一点点香料让一切都变得美味！快来这儿拿吧！ [yi dian dian xiang liao rang yi qie dou bian de mei wei ！ kuai lai zhe er na ba ！]

english: Let's trade.
translation: 我们来交易吧。 [wo men lai jiao yi ba 。]

english: I'll pass.
translation: 我会通过。 [wo hui tong guo 。]

english: Your loss.
translation: 你的损失。 [ni de sun shi 。]

english: You're the one who stole from me! Guards! Guards!
translation: 你就是偷了我东西的人！卫兵！卫兵！ [ni jiu shi tou le wo dong xi de ren ！ wei bing ！ wei bing ！]

english: Let's trade.
translation: 我们来交易吧。 [wo men lai jiao yi ba 。]

english: I'll pass.
translation: 我会通过。 [wo hui tong guo 。]

english: Are you interested in buying or selling spice?
translation: 您有兴趣购买或出售香料吗？ [nin you xing qu gou mai huo chu shou xiang liao ma ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
translation: 嘿！把你的手拿开！ [hei ！ ba ni de shou na kai ！]

english: You're the one who stole something from me!
translation: 你就是偷了我东西的人！ [ni jiu shi tou le wo dong xi de ren ！]

english: Guards guards!
translation: 卫兵卫兵！ [wei bing wei bing ！]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Boo!
translation: 嘘！ [xu ！]

english: Whine!
translation: 抱怨！ [bao yuan ！]

english: Who's a spooky doggy!
translation: 谁是一只诡异的小狗！ [shui shi yi zhi gui yi de xiao gou ！]

english: Woof!
translation: 纬！ [wei ！]

english: Woof woof!
translation: 汪汪！ [wang wang ！]

english: You give the dog some nice bones.
translation: 你给狗一些好骨头。 [ni gei gou yi xie hao gu tou 。]

english: It happily gnaws on them.
translation: 它高兴地啃着它们。 [ta gao xing di ken zhe ta men 。]

english: Woof woof!
translation: 汪汪！ [wang wang ！]

english: You give the dog a nice piece of meat.
translation: 你给了狗一块好肉。 [ni gei le gou yi kuai hao rou 。]

english: It gobbles it up.
translation: 它吞噬了它。 [ta tun shi le ta 。]

english: Grrrr!
translation: 咕噜！ [gu lu ！]

english: The dog doesn't seem interested in that.
translation: 狗似乎对此不感兴趣。 [gou si hu dui ci bu gan xing qu 。]

english: Bark!
translation: 吠！ [fei ！]

english: He doesn't approve of your ears.
translation: 他不同意你的耳朵。 [ta bu tong yi ni de er duo 。]

english: Welcome to Spike's Spikes. Want a mace?
translation: 欢迎来到斯派克的尖峰。想要狼牙棒吗？ [huan ying lai dao si pai ke de jian feng 。 xiang yao lang ya bang ma ？]

english: Maybe...
translation: 或许... [huo xu ...]

english: You want a mace. Have a look.
translation: 你想要一把狼牙棒。看看吧。 [ni xiang yao yi ba lang ya bang 。 kan kan ba 。]

english: Spike's Spikes?
translation: 斯派克的尖刺？ [si pai ke de jian ci ？]

english: Yeah. I'm Spike and I sell things with spikes, so Spike's Spikes.
translation: 是的。我是 Spike，我卖带有尖刺的东西，所以 Spike's Spikes。 [shi de 。 wo shi  Spike， wo mai dai you jian ci de dong xi ， suo yi  Spike's Spikes。]

english: Your name is Spike?

translation: 我有很多你可以获得的奖励，还有各种各样的杀手装备可供出售。 [wo you hen duo ni ke yi huo de de jiang li ， hai you ge zhong ge yang de sha shou zhuang bei ke gong chu shou 。]

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: 说说我的作业的难度吧。 [shuo shuo wo de zuo ye de nan du ba 。]

english: The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.

translation: 好吧，从现在开始，所有屠戮大师在为你选择任务时都会考虑你的战斗水平，所以你不要做太难的事情。 [hao ba ， cong xian zai kai shi ， suo you tu lu da shi zai wei ni xuan ze ren wu shi du hui kao lv ni de zhan dou shui ping ， suo yi ni bu yao zuo tai nan de shi qing 。]

translation: 杀手大师在为你选择任务时会考虑你的战斗水平，所以你不应该遇到太难的任务。 [sha shou da shi zai wei ni xuan ze ren wu shi hui kao lv ni de zhan dou shui ping ， suo yi ni bu ying gai yu dao tai nan de ren wu 。]

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: 没关系——我不想要太难的东西。 [mei guan xi —— wo bu xiang yao tai nan de dong xi 。]

english: Okay, we'll keep checking your combat level.
translation: 好的，我们会继续检查你的战斗水平。 [hao de ， wo men hui ji xu jian cha ni de zhan dou shui ping 。]

english: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: 别再检查我的战斗水平了——我可以承受任何事情！ [bie zai jian cha wo de zhan dou shui ping le —— wo ke yi cheng shou ren he shi qing ！]

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will assign you anything from their lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 好吧，从现在开始，所有的杀手大师都会从他们的列表中为你分配任何东西，无论你的战斗水平如何。 [hao ba ， cong xian zai kai shi ， suo you de sha shou da shi du hui cong ta men de lie biao zhong wei ni fen pei ren he dong xi ， wu lun ni de zhan dou shui ping ru he 。]

english: About Turael...

english: It's nothing personal, but I'd prefer not to discuss what happened with my father.
translation: 这不是私人问题，但我不想和我父亲讨论发生的事情。 [zhe bu shi si ren wen ti ， dan wo bu xiang he wo fu qin tao lun fa sheng de shi qing 。]

english: Of course. Sorry for bringing it up.
translation: 当然。抱歉提出这个问题。 [dang ran 。 bao qian ti chu zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Er... Nothing...

english: No that's okay, I'll take a task from you.

english: Oh okay then, I'll go talk to Chaeldar.

translation: 没关系——我不想要太难的东西。 [mei guan xi —— wo bu xiang yao tai nan de dong xi 。]

english: Er... Nothing...
translation: 呃……没什么…… [e …… mei shen me ……]

english: Hello friend! Many thanks for all of your help! Vyvin never even realised it was a different sword, and I still have my job!
translation: 朋友你好！非常感谢您的帮助！维文甚至从未意识到这是一把不同的剑，而我仍然有我的工作！ [peng you ni hao ！ fei chang gan xie nin de bang zhu ！ wei wen shen zhi cong wei yi shi dao zhe shi yi ba bu tong de jian ， er wo reng ran you wo de gong zuo ！]

english: I'm glad the new sword worked out alright.
translation: 我很高兴新剑表现良好。 [wo hen gao xing xin jian biao xian liang hao 。]

english: OK, here you go.
translation: 好的，给你。 [hao de ， gei ni 。]

english: I have a question for you.
translation: 我有个问题要问你。 [wo you ge wen ti yao wen ni 。]

english: Squire Asrol has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 乡绅阿斯罗尔给了你一个挑战卷轴！ [xiang shen a si luo er gei le ni yi ge tiao zhan juan zhou ！]

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。 [qing shu ru wen ti de da an 。]

english: No, try again.
translation: 不，再试一次。 [bu ， zai shi yi ci 。]

english: Correct!
translation: 正确的！ [zheng que de ！]

english: Squire Asrol has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 乡绅阿斯罗尔给了你另一条线索卷轴！ [xiang shen a si luo er gei le ni ling yi tiao xian suo juan zhou ！]

english: Greetings, brave knight!
translation: 你好，勇敢的骑士！ [ni hao ， yong gan de qi shi ！]

english: Hello. What's through that door?
translation: 你好。穿过那扇门有什么？ [ni hao 。 chuan guo na shan men you shen me ？]

english: That door leads to the training ground for the Knights of the Round Table.
translation: 那扇门通向圆桌骑士的训练场。 [na shan men tong xiang yuan zhuo qi shi de xun lian chang 。]

english: Can I go in there?
translation: 我可以进去吗？ [wo ke yi jin qu ma ？]

english: Of course, my lord. But I must tell you the rules first. Would you like to hear them now?
translation: 当然，陛下。但我必须先告诉你规则。您现在想听听他们的声音吗？ [dang ran ， bi xia 。 dan wo bi xu xian gao su ni gui ze 。 nin xian zai xiang ting ting ta men de sheng yin ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: The training ground is a melee combat area only. Merlin has cast a spell over the grounds to prevent anyone using Prayer, Ranged or Magic.
translation: 训练场只是一个近战区域。梅林在地面上施放了咒语，以阻止任何人使用祈祷、远程或魔法。 [xun lian chang zhi shi yi ge jin zhan qu yu 。 mei lin zai di mian shang shi fang le zhou yu ， yi zu zhi ren he ren shi yong qi dao 、 yuan cheng huo mo fa 。]

english: Upon entering the grounds, you will fight each of the Round Table Knights in turn. Each knight is more skilled than the last, but all have different attack styles that can be exploited. There are eight knights in all, and
translation: 进入场地后，您将依次与每个圆桌骑士战斗。每个骑士都比上一个更加熟练，但都有不同的攻击方式可供利用。骑士一共有八人， [jin ru chang di hou ， nin jiang yi ci yu mei ge yuan zhuo qi shi zhan dou 。 mei ge qi shi dou bi shang yi ge geng jia shu lian ， dan dou you bu tong de gong ji fang shi ke gong li yong 。 qi shi yi gong you ba ren ，]

english: each will do damage not only to your hitpoints, but also your combat stats. If you should die in the grounds, Merlin will teleport you back here. You will not lose any of your items.
translation: 每个都会对你的生命值造成伤害，还会对你的战斗统计数据造成伤害。如果你死在了地上，梅林会把你传送回这里。您不会丢失任何物品。 [mei ge du hui dui ni de sheng ming zhi zao cheng shang hai ， hai hui dui ni de zhan dou tong ji shu ju zao cheng shang hai 。 ru guo ni si zai le di shang ， mei lin hui ba ni chuan song hui zhe li 。 nin bu hui diu shi ren he wu pin 。]

english: If you feel you cannot complete the battle, you may exit the training grounds. However, if you exit or die, you will have to start over with the first knight the next time you enter.
translation: 如果你觉得自己无法完成战斗，你可以退出训练场。然而，如果你退出或死亡，下次进入时你将不得不从第一个骑士开始。 [ru guo ni jue de zi ji wu fa wan cheng zhan dou ， ni ke yi tui chu xun lian chang 。 ran er ， ru guo ni tui chu huo si wang ， xia ci jin ru shi ni jiang bu de bu cong di yi ge qi shi kai shi 。]

english: If you are a great warrior and defeat Sir Lancelot, mightiest of all knights, you will receive great rewards. Two new prayers will become available to you and your respawn point will be set to Camelot, as well as 20,000
translation: 如果你是一位伟大的战士并击败了最强大的骑士兰斯洛特爵士，你将获得丰厚的奖励。您将可以使用两个新的祈祷，并且您的重生点将设置为卡米洛特，以及 20,000 [ru guo ni shi yi wei wei da de zhan shi bing ji bai le zui qiang da de qi shi lan si luo te jue shi ， ni jiang huo de feng hou de jiang li 。 nin jiang ke yi shi yong liang ge xin de qi dao ， bing qie nin de chong sheng dian jiang she zhi wei ka mi luo te ， yi ji  20,000]

english: XP in to each of your combat stats.
translation: XP 会包含在你的每项战斗统计数据中。 [XP  hui bao han zai ni de mei xiang zhan dou tong ji shu ju zhong 。]

english: If you do not want your respawn set to Camelot, Merlin can change it for you.
translation: 如果您不希望重生设置为卡米洛特，梅林可以为您更改。 [ru guo nin bu xi wang chong sheng she zhi wei ka mi luo te ， mei lin ke yi wei nin geng gai 。]

english: Would you like me to repeat any of that for you?
translation: 您需要我为您重复一遍吗？ [nin xu yao wo wei nin chong fu yi bian ma ？]

english: Tell me about the training ground.
translation: 说说训练场的事吧。 [shuo shuo xun lian chang de shi ba 。]

english: Only melee combat is allowed within the training grounds. Merlin will prevent the use of Prayer, Ranged and Magic.
translation: 训练场内只允许近战。梅林将阻止使用祈祷、远程和魔法。 [xun lian chang nei zhi yun xu jin zhan 。 mei lin jiang zu zhi shi yong qi dao 、 yuan cheng he mo fa 。]

english: Why?
translation: 为什么？ [wei shen me ？]

english: These grounds are for only the best knights of the land. It is not just testing your combat ability, but your honour and your chivalry. You must face your enemy head on, honourably and bravely.
translation: 这些场地只适合这片土地上最优秀的骑士。这不仅仅是考验你的战斗能力，更是考验你的荣誉和侠义。你必须勇敢地面对你的敌人。 [zhe xie chang di zhi shi he zhe pian tu di shang zui you xiu de qi shi 。 zhe bu jin jin shi kao yan ni de zhan dou neng li ， geng shi kao yan ni de rong yu he xia yi 。 ni bi xu yong gan di mian dui ni de di ren 。]

english: Be watchful of your stats, as the Knights can do damage to your combat stats as well as your hitpoints.
translation: 留意你的统计数据，因为骑士可能会损害你的战斗统计数据和生命值。 [liu yi ni de tong ji shu ju ， yin wei qi shi ke neng hui sun hai ni de zhan dou tong ji shu ju he sheng ming zhi 。]

english: Tell me about dying or leaving the grounds.
translation: 告诉我关于死亡或离开场地的事情。 [gao su wo guan yu si wang huo li kai chang di de shi qing 。]

english: As these are only training grounds, we keep our knights safe. If you should die, you will be teleported back to here and all of your items will be safe.
translation: 由于这些只是训练场，我们会保证骑士的安全。如果你死了，你会被传送回这里，你的所有物品都会安全。 [you yu zhe xie zhi shi xun lian chang ， wo men hui bao zheng qi shi de an quan 。 ru guo ni si le ， ni hui bei chuan song hui zhe li ， ni de suo you wu pin du hui an quan 。]

english: However, leaving the training grounds, in anyway, will mean you will have to start from the beginning the next time you enter. These grounds do not favour cowards.
translation: 但无论如何，离开训练场，下次进入训练场就得从头开始。这些理由不利于懦夫。 [dan wu lun ru he ， li kai xun lian chang ， xia ci jin ru xun lian chang jiu de cong tou kai shi 。 zhe xie li you bu li yu nuo fu 。]

english: I have to start again? What do you mean?
translation: 我必须重新开始吗？你是什​​么意思？ [wo bi xu chong xin kai shi ma ？ ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: You fight each knight of the Round Table, starting with Sir Bedivere and finishing with Sir Lancelot. Leaving means you will have to begin fighting Sir Bedivere again and work your way back up.
translation: 您将与圆桌会议的每位骑士战斗，从贝德维尔爵士开始，到兰斯洛特爵士结束。离开意味着你将不得不再次与贝德维尔爵士战斗并努力恢复。 [nin jiang yu yuan zhuo hui yi de mei wei qi shi zhan dou ， cong bei de wei er jue shi kai shi ， dao lan si luo te jue shi jie shu 。 li kai yi wei zhe ni jiang bu de bu zai ci yu bei de wei er jue shi zhan dou bing nu li hui fu 。]

english: What if I log out during the fights?
translation: 如果我在战斗期间退出怎么办？ [ru guo wo zai zhan dou qi jian tui chu zen me ban ？]

english: If you log out during a fight, upon logging back in you will fight the knight you were fighting when you logged out.
translation: 如果您在战斗中退出，重新登录后您将与退出时正在战斗的骑士战斗。 [ru guo nin zai zhan dou zhong tui chu ， chong xin deng lu hou nin jiang yu tui chu shi zheng zai zhan dou de qi shi zhan dou 。]

english: Tell me about the rewards.
translation: 告诉我有关奖励的事情。 [gao su wo you guan jiang li de shi qing 。]

english: King Arthur believes in rewarding his knights for their chivalry. Having proven yourself in combat against his knights, and in your services rendered to Camelot, you will be rewarded with two new prayers, and a new
translation: 亚瑟王相信奖励他的骑士们的骑士精神。在与他的骑士的战斗中证明了自己，并在对卡米洛特的服务中证明了自己，你将获得两个新的祈祷和一个新的奖励 [ya se wang xiang xin jiang li ta de qi shi men de qi shi jing shen 。 zai yu ta de qi shi de zhan dou zhong zheng ming liao zi ji ， bing zai dui ka mi luo te de fu wu zhong zheng ming liao zi ji ， ni jiang huo de liang ge xin de qi dao he yi ge xin de jiang li]

english: respawn at Camelot, as well as 20,000 XP in to each of your combat stats.
translation: 在卡米洛特重生，并且你的每项战斗统计数据都会获得 20,000 XP。 [zai ka mi luo te chong sheng ， bing qie ni de mei xiang zhan dou tong ji shu ju du hui huo de  20,000 XP。]

english: What do the new prayers do?
translation: 新的祈祷有什么作用？ [xin de qi dao you shen me zuo yong ？]

english: Ah, patience is a virtue in knights, my lord. Fight in the training ground and earn your reward to find out!
translation: Ah, patience is a virtue in knights, my lord.在训练场上战斗并赢得奖励来找出答案！ [Ah, patience is a virtue in knights, my lord. zai xun lian chang shang zhan dou bing ying de jiang li lai zhao chu da an ！]

english: Then tell me about the respawn - how will it work?
translation: 然后告诉我有关重生的事情 - 它将如何运作？ [ran hou gao su wo you guan chong sheng de shi qing  -  ta jiang ru he yun zuo ？]

english: Ah, Merlin has offered, as a reward for your help, to let yourrespawn in the safety of Camelot, should you befall misfortune elsewhere in the world. Should you wish to change your respawn back to Lumbridge, simply
translation: 啊，梅林已经提出，作为对你帮助的奖励，如果你在世界其他地方遭遇不幸，梅林将让你在安全的卡米洛特重生。如果您希望将重生点改回 Lumbridge，只需 [a ， mei lin yi jing ti chu ， zuo wei dui ni bang zhu de jiang li ， ru guo ni zai shi jie qi ta di fang zao yu bu xing ， mei lin jiang rang ni zai an quan de ka mi luo te chong sheng 。 ru guo nin xi wang jiang chong sheng dian gai hui  Lumbridge， zhi xu]

english: speak to Merlin.
translation: 和梅林说话。 [he mei lin shuo hua 。]

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Congratulations on succeeding in the Knight Waves, my lord.
translation: 恭喜您在骑士浪潮中取得成功，大人。 [gong xi nin zai qi shi lang chao zhong qu de cheng gong ， da ren 。]

english: Thank you. Can I go back inside?
translation: 谢谢。我可以回去里面吗？ [xie xie 。 wo ke yi hui qu li mian ma ？]

english: I'm afraid not, my lord. Once you have won, you cannot re-enter.
translation: 恐怕不行，陛下。一旦获胜，您将无法再次参加。 [kong pa bu xing ， bi xia 。 yi dan huo sheng ， nin jiang wu fa zai ci can jia 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Tell me about the training ground
translation: 说说训练场的情况 [shuo shuo xun lian chang de qing kuang]

english: Tell me about dying or leaving the grounds
translation: 告诉我关于死亡或离开场地的事情 [gao su wo guan yu si wang huo li kai chang di de shi qing]

english: Tell me about the rewards
translation: 告诉我有关奖励的事情 [gao su wo you guan jiang li de shi qing]

english: No, thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello there. How's it going?
translation: 你好呀。怎么样了？ [ni hao ya 。 zen me yang le ？]

english: Busy, busy, busy.
translation: 忙，忙，忙。 [mang ， mang ， mang 。]

english: Sorry, but I'm busy right now.
translation: 抱歉，但我现在很忙。 [bao qian ， dan wo xian zai hen mang 。]

english: Sorry, but I have lots of work to do.
translation: 抱歉，但我还有很多工作要做。 [bao qian ， dan wo hai you hen duo gong zuo yao zuo 。]

english: Not too bad, but the work is definitely tiring.
translation: 还不错，但工作肯定很累。 [hai bu cuo ， dan gong zuo ken ding hen lei 。]

english: Well I could do with a good rest, but fine otherwise.
translation: 好吧，我可以好好休息一下，但其他方面也还好。 [hao ba ， wo ke yi hao hao xiu xi yi xia ， dan qi ta fang mian ye hai hao 。]

english: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？ [ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: I'm Vicks, squire to Sir Culler Flife. He's away on a surveillance mission to Burthorpe, so he sent me down here to do some cleaning.
translation: 我是维克斯，卡勒·弗莱夫爵士的侍从。他去伯索普执行监视任务，所以他派我来这里打扫卫生。 [wo shi wei ke si ， ka lei · fu lai fu jue shi de shi cong 。 ta qu bo suo pu zhi xing jian shi ren wu ， suo yi ta pai wo lai zhe li da sao wei sheng 。]

english: Don't tell the knights, but I'm just not in the mood for it! I've served for years, and worked really hard, but they're not even thinking of making me a knight.
translation: 别告诉骑士们，我只是没心情！我已经服役多年，工作也非常努力，但他们甚至没有考虑让我成为一名骑士。 [bie gao su qi shi men ， wo zhi shi mei xin qing ！ wo yi jing fu yi duo nian ， gong zuo ye fei chang nu li ， dan ta men shen zhi mei you kao lv rang wo cheng wei yi ming qi shi 。]

english: I don't know what the problem is. At my last review, I heard the examiner muttering something about my name, but I've no idea what he meant by that.
translation: 我不知道问题是什么。在我上次复习时，我听到考官嘀咕了一些关于我名字的事情，但我不知道他的意思是什么。 [wo bu zhi dao wen ti shi shen me 。 zai wo shang ci fu xi shi ， wo ting dao kao guan di gu le yi xie guan yu wo ming zi de shi qing ， dan wo bu zhi dao ta de yi si shi shen me 。]

english: Keeping an eye on those Imperial Guard. We can't trust 'em, you know. But I shouldn't talk about his mission.
translation: 密切关注那些帝国卫队。你知道，我们不能相信他们。但我不应该谈论他的使命。 [mi qie guan zhu na xie di guo wei dui 。 ni zhi dao ， wo men bu neng xiang xin ta men 。 dan wo bu ying gai tan lun ta de shi ming 。]

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 告诉我这个地方。 [gao su wo zhe ge di fang 。]

english: This place? It's the castle crypt. The greatest White Knights are buried here, after a lifetime in the service of Saradomin. At least, that's how it used to be.
translation: 这个地方？这是城堡的地下室。最伟大的白骑士在为萨拉多明服务了一生之后被埋葬在这里。至少，过去是这样。 [zhe ge di fang ？ zhe shi cheng bao de di xia shi 。 zui wei da de bai qi shi zai wei sa la duo ming fu wu le yi sheng zhi hou bei mai zang zai zhe li 。 zhi shao ， guo qu shi zhe yang 。]

english: When I was a new recruit, they brought me here and told me that if I served Saradomin faithfully, and with distinction, maybe I'd earn the honour of burial in this place too.
translation: 当我还是一名新兵时，他们把我带到这里并告诉我，如果我忠实地、出色地服务萨拉多明，也许我也会获得埋葬在这个地方的荣誉。 [dang wo hai shi yi ming xin bing shi ， ta men ba wo dai dao zhe li bing gao su wo ， ru guo wo zhong shi di 、 chu se di fu wu sa la duo ming ， ye xu wo ye hui huo de mai zang zai zhe ge di fang de rong yu 。]

english: But if you think about it, that's never going to happen - there just isn't space for more tombs! Anyway, my plan is to avoid dying, and maybe marry one of the barmaids when I retire.
translation: 但如果你想一想，这永远不会发生——只是没有空间容纳更多的坟墓！无论如何，我的计划是避免死亡，也许退休后嫁给一位酒吧女招待。 [dan ru guo ni xiang yi xiang ， zhe yong yuan bu hui fa sheng —— zhi shi mei you kong jian rong na geng duo de fen mu ！ wu lun ru he ， wo de ji hua shi bi mian si wang ， ye xu tui xiu hou jia gei yi wei jiu ba nv zhao dai 。]

english: What's with the glowing portal thing?
translation: 那个发光的传送门是怎么回事？ [na ge fa guang de chuan song men shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: It's because of something the Temple Knights have, called the Gaze of Saradomin. They get the option of being brought to Falador when they die, so Death has to maintain a presence in the area.
translation: 这是因为圣殿骑士拥有一种叫做萨拉多明凝视的东西。他们可以选择在死后被带到法拉多，因此死亡必须在该地区保持存在。 [zhe shi yin wei sheng dian qi shi yong you yi zhong jiao zuo sa la duo ming ning shi de dong xi 。 ta men ke yi xuan ze zai si hou bei dai dao fa la duo ， yin ci si wang bi xu zai gai di qu bao chi cun zai 。]

english: That portal takes you to Death's own realm. He's got portals in all the places where people go when they die - Lumbridge, Edgeville and the rest. I hate it - the thing's terrifying!
translation: 那个传送门将带你进入死亡的领域。他在人们死后去的所有地方都有传送门——朗布里奇、埃奇维尔和其他地方。我讨厌它——这东西太可怕了！ [na ge chuan song men jiang dai ni jin ru si wang de ling yu 。 ta zai ren men si hou qu de suo you di fang dou you chuan song men —— lang bu li qi 、 ai qi wei er he qi ta di fang 。 wo tao yan ta —— zhe dong xi tai ke pa le ！]

english: I'll leave you alone.
translation: 我会让你独自一人。 [wo hui rang ni du zi yi ren 。]

english: Can I help you, [sir/madam]?
translation: 我可以帮你吗，[先生/女士]？ [wo ke yi bang ni ma ，[ xian sheng / nv shi ]？]

translation: 看来你不太会打扫卫生。 [kan lai ni bu tai hui da sao wei sheng 。]

english: What's your master doing in Burthorpe?
translation: 你的主人在伯索普做什么？ [ni de zhu ren zai bo suo pu zuo shen me ？]

english: Keeping an eye on those Imperial Guard, [sir/madam]. We can't trust 'em, you know. But I shouldn't talk about his mission, even with a knight such as yourself.
translation: 留意那些帝国卫队，[先生/女士]。你知道，我们不能相信他们。但我不应该谈论他的使命，即使是和你这样的骑士。 [liu yi na xie di guo wei dui ，[ xian sheng / nv shi ]。 ni zhi dao ， wo men bu neng xiang xin ta men 。 dan wo bu ying gai tan lun ta de shi ming ， ji shi shi he ni zhe yang de qi shi 。]

english: The Void Knights, they are great warriors of balance who do Guthix's work here in Gielinor.
translation: 虚空骑士团是伟大的平衡战士，他们在吉林诺做着古西克斯的工作。 [xu kong qi shi tuan shi wei da de ping heng zhan shi ， ta men zai ji lin nuo zuo zhe gu xi ke si de gong zuo 。]

translation: 哇，我可以加入吗？ [wa ， wo ke yi jia ru ma ？]

english: Entry is strictly invite only, however we do need help continuing Guthix's work.
translation: 严格限制入场，但我们确实需要帮助继续古蒂克斯的工作。 [yan ge xian zhi ru chang ， dan wo men que shi xu yao bang zhu ji xu gu di ke si de gong zuo 。]

translation: 祝你好运。 [zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: What kind of work?
translation: 什么样的工作？ [shen me yang de gong zuo ？]

english: Ah well you see we try to keep Gielinor as Guthix intended, it's very challenging. Actually we've been having some problems recently, maybe you could help us?
translation: 嗯，你看，我们试图让吉林诺保持古蒂克斯的意图，这是非常具有挑战性的。事实上，我们最近遇到了一些问题，也许你可以帮助我们？ [n ， ni kan ， wo men shi tu rang ji lin nuo bao chi gu di ke si de yi tu ， zhe shi fei chang ju you tiao zhan xing de 。 shi shi shang ， wo men zui jin yu dao le yi xie wen ti ， ye xu ni ke yi bang zhu wo men ？]

english: Yeah ok, what's the problem?
translation: 是啊，好吧，有什么问题吗？ [shi a ， hao ba ， you shen me wen ti ma ？]

english: Well the order has become quite diminished over the years, it's a very long process to learn the skills of a Void Knight. Recently there have been breaches into our realm from somewhere else, and strange creatures
translation: 嗯，这些年来，秩序已经变得相当少了，学习虚空骑士的技能是一个非常漫长的过程。最近有来自其他地方的入侵我们的领域，以及奇怪的生物 [n ， zhe xie nian lai ， zhi xu yi jing bian de xiang dang shao le ， xue xi xu kong qi shi de ji neng shi yi ge fei chang man chang de guo cheng 。 zui jin you lai zi qi ta di fang de ru qin wo men de ling yu ， yi ji qi guai de sheng wu]

english: have been pouring through. We can't let that happen, and we'd be very grateful if you'd help us.
translation: 已经倾泻而过。我们不能让这种情况发生，如果您能帮助我们，我们将不胜感激。 [yi jing qing xie er guo 。 wo men bu neng rang zhe zhong qing kuang fa sheng ， ru guo nin neng bang zhu wo men ， wo men jiang bu sheng gan ji 。]

english: How can I help?
translation: 我能提供什么帮助吗？ [wo neng ti gong shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: We send launchers from our outpost to the nearby islands. If you go and wait in the lander there that'd really help.
translation: 我们从我们的前哨基地向附近的岛屿发送发射器。如果你去那里的着陆器里等待那真的会有帮助。 [wo men cong wo men de qian shao ji di xiang fu jin de dao yu fa song fa she qi 。 ru guo ni qu na li de zhuo lu qi li deng dai na zhen de hui you bang zhu 。]

english: Sorry, but I can't.
translation: 抱歉，但我不能。 [bao qian ， dan wo bu neng 。]

english: I'd rather not, sorry.
translation: 我宁愿不，抱歉。 [wo ning yuan bu ， bao qian 。]

english: What's 'Gielinor'?
translation: 什么是“吉利诺”？ [shen me shi “ ji li nuo ”？]

english: It is the name that Guthix gave to this world, so we honour him with its use.
translation: 这是古蒂克斯给这个世界起的名字，所以我们用这个名字来纪念他。 [zhe shi gu di ke si gei zhe ge shi jie qi de ming zi ， suo yi wo men yong zhe ge ming zi lai ji nian ta 。]

english: Uh huh, sure.
translation: 嗯嗯，当然。 [n n ， dang ran 。]

english: Where does this ship go?
translation: 这艘船要去哪里？ [zhe sou chuan yao qu na li ？]

english: To the Void Knight outpost. It's a small island just off Karamja.
translation: 前往虚空骑士前哨站。这是卡拉姆贾附近的一个小岛。 [qian wang xu kong qi shi qian shao zhan 。 zhe shi ka la mu jia fu jin de yi ge xiao dao 。]

english: That's nice.
translation: 那很好。 [na hen hao 。]

english: I'd like to go to your outpost.
translation: 我想去你的前哨基地。 [wo xiang qu ni de qian shao ji di 。]

english: Certainly, right this way.
translation: 当然，就这样。 [dang ran ， jiu zhe yang 。]

english: The ship arrives at the Void Knight outpost.
translation: 船抵达虚空骑士前哨站。 [chuan di da xu kong qi shi qian shao zhan 。]

english: I'd like to go back to Port Sarim please.
translation: 我想回到沙里姆港。 [wo xiang hui dao sha li mu gang 。]

english: Ok, but please come back soon and help us.
translation: 好的，但请尽快回来帮助我们。 [hao de ， dan qing jin kuai hui lai bang zhu wo men 。]

english: The ship arrives at Port Sarim.
translation: 船抵达沙里姆港。 [chuan di da sha li mu gang 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This is our outpost. From here we send launches out to the nearby islands to beat back the invaders.
translation: 这是我们的前哨基地。从这里我们向附近的岛屿派遣船只击退入侵者。 [zhe shi wo men de qian shao ji di 。 cong zhe li wo men xiang fu jin de dao yu pai qian chuan zhi ji tui ru qin zhe 。]

english: What invaders?
translation: 什么侵略者？ [shen me qin lve zhe ？]

english: Recently there have been breaches into our realm from somewhere else, and strange creatures have been pouring through. We can't let that happen, and we'd be very grateful if you'd help us.
translation: 最近，有来自其他地方的入侵进入我们的领域，奇怪的生物不断涌入。我们不能让这种情况发生，如果您能帮助我们，我们将不胜感激。 [zui jin ， you lai zi qi ta di fang de ru qin jin ru wo men de ling yu ， qi guai de sheng wu bu duan yong ru 。 wo men bu neng rang zhe zhong qing kuang fa sheng ， ru guo nin neng bang zhu wo men ， wo men jiang bu sheng gan ji 。]

english: Sorry, you'll need to speak to one of the Knights about that. I'm just a humble squire with years of training still to undergo!
translation: 抱歉，你需要和一位骑士谈谈这件事。我只是一个卑微的乡绅，还需要接受多年的训练！ [bao qian ， ni xu yao he yi wei qi shi tan tan zhe jian shi 。 wo zhi shi yi ge bei wei de xiang shen ， hai xu yao jie shou duo nian de xun lian ！]

english: Alright, good luck with that.
translation: 好吧，祝你好运。 [hao ba ， zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: You must defend the Void Knight while the portals are unsummoned. The ritual takes twenty minutes though, so you can help out by destroying them yourselves! Now GO GO GO!
translation: 当传送门未被召唤时，你必须保卫虚空骑士。不过仪式需要二十分钟，所以你可以亲自摧毁它们来帮忙！现在去吧去吧！ [dang chuan song men wei bei zhao huan shi ， ni bi xu bao wei xu kong qi shi 。 bu guo yi shi xu yao er shi fen zhong ， suo yi ni ke yi qin zi cui hui ta men lai bang mang ！ xian zai qu ba qu ba ！]

english: Be quick, we're under attack!
translation: 快点，我们受到攻击了！ [kuai dian ， wo men shou dao gong ji le ！]

english: What's going on?
translation: 这是怎么回事？ [zhe shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: This island is being invaded by outsiders and the Void Knight over there is using a ritual to unsummon their portals. We must defend the Void Knight at all costs, however if you get an opening you can destroy the
translation: 这个岛屿正在被外来者入侵，那里的虚空骑士正在使用仪式来取消召唤他们的传送门。我们必须不惜一切代价保卫虚空骑士，但是如果你找到了空当，你就可以摧毁它 [zhe ge dao yu zheng zai bei wai lai zhe ru qin ， na li de xu kong qi shi zheng zai shi yong yi shi lai qu xiao zhao huan ta men de chuan song men 。 wo men bi xu bu xi yi qie dai jia bao wei xu kong qi shi ， dan shi ru guo ni zhao dao le kong dang ， ni jiu ke yi cui hui ta]

english: portals yourself.
translation: 自己门户。 [zi ji men hu 。]

english: How do I repair things?
translation: 我该如何修理东西？ [wo gai ru he xiu li dong xi ？]

english: There are trees on the island. You'll need to chop them down for logs and use a hammer to repair the defences. Be careful though, the trees here don't grow back very fast so your resources are limited!
translation: 岛上有树。你需要把它们砍成木头，并用锤子修复防御设施。但要小心，这里的树木长得不太快，所以你的资源是有限的！ [dao shang you shu 。 ni xu yao ba ta men kan cheng mu tou ， bing yong chui zi xiu fu fang yu she shi 。 dan yao xiao xin ， zhe li de shu mu zhang de bu tai kuai ， suo yi ni de zi yuan shi you xian de ！]

translation: 我想离开。 [wo xiang li kai 。]

translation: 那你走吧，着陆器会把你带回来。 [na ni zou ba ， zhuo lu qi hui ba ni dai hui lai 。]

english: Not much to say. Came to Weiss with other trolls when we got kicked out of caves further south, but I was just young troll then.
translation: 没什么好说的。当我们被赶出更南边的洞穴时，我们和其他巨魔一起来到了韦斯，但那时我只是年轻的巨魔。 [mei shen me hao shuo de 。 dang wo men bei gan chu geng nan bian de dong xue shi ， wo men he qi ta ju mo yi qi lai dao le wei si ， dan na shi wo zhi shi nian qing de ju mo 。]

english: This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: 嗯，虽然有点粗糙，但是正在好起来。雪花，她教我们种植古风草。山羊、狼、人类的味道都因加入了古藤而变得更加美味。 [n ， sui ran you dian cu cao ， dan shi zheng zai hao qi lai 。 xue hua ， ta jiao wo men zhong zhi gu feng cao 。 shan yang 、 lang 、 ren lei de wei dao dou yin jia ru le gu teng er bian de geng jia mei wei 。]

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: 所以，是的，韦斯是一个很好的居住地，现在由雪花负责。所有的巨魔都像雪花一样。她的丈夫巨魔有点奇怪，但这不是我们的问题。 [suo yi ， shi de ， wei si shi yi ge hen hao de ju zhu di ， xian zai you xue hua fu ze 。 suo you de ju mo dou xiang xue hua yi yang 。 ta de zhang fu ju mo you dian qi guai ， dan zhe bu shi wo men de wen ti 。]

translation: 欢迎来到我的私人小飞龙区域。 [huan ying lai dao wo de si ren xiao fei long qu yu 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm Steve. You may have heard of my big cousin Nieve - she's one of the Slayer Masters. She's the famous one in the family. But Nieve's not here - this area's mine
translation: 我是史蒂夫。你可能听说过我的表姐妮芙——她是杀手大师之一。她是家里有名的人。但尼维不在这里——这个区域是我的 [wo shi shi di fu 。 ni ke neng ting shuo guo wo de biao jie ni fu —— ta shi sha shou da shi zhi yi 。 ta shi jia li you ming de ren 。 dan ni wei bu zai zhe li —— zhe ge qu yu shi wo de]

english: Why is this wyvern area private?
translation: 为什么这个飞龙区域是私有的？ [wei shen me zhe ge fei long qu yu shi si you de ？]

english: Because I say so! My cousin Nieve thinks she's so great because she's got a big cave where she can boss people around. So I carved some steps out of the ice, and made myself a training area here.
translation: 因为我这么说！我的表弟尼芙认为她很伟大，因为她有一个大洞穴，可以在那里指挥周围的人。所以我在冰上刻了一些台阶，并在这里为自己打造了一个训练区。 [yin wei wo zhe me shuo ！ wo de biao di ni fu ren wei ta hen wei da ， yin wei ta you yi ge da dong xue ， ke yi zai na li zhi hui zhou wei de ren 。 suo yi wo zai bing shang ke le yi xie tai jie ， bing zai zhe li wei zi ji da zao le yi ge xun lian qu 。]

translation: 那么你是杀戮大师吗？ [na me ni shi sha lu da shi ma ？]

english: No, I'm not. My cousin Nieve is a Slayer Master. There's nothing special about her, you know. All she does is tell people to kill stuff. That's Slayer Masters for you.
translation: 不，我不是。我的表弟尼芙是一名杀手大师。你知道，她没什么特别的。她所做的只是告诉人们要杀人。这就是适合您的《杀手大师》。 [bu ， wo bu shi 。 wo de biao di ni fu shi yi ming sha shou da shi 。 ni zhi dao ， ta mei shen me te bie de 。 ta suo zuo de zhi shi gao su ren men yao sha ren 。 zhe jiu shi shi he nin de 《 sha shou da shi 》。]

english: Thanks, goodbye.
translation: 谢谢，再见。 [xie xie ， zai jian 。]

english: 'Ello, and what are you after then?
translation: '艾洛，那你在追什么？ [' ai luo ， na ni zai zhui shen me ？]

english: I need another assignment.
translation: 我需要另一项任务。 [wo xu yao ling yi xiang ren wu 。]

english: Excellent, you're doing great. Your new task is to kill [amount] [task monster].
translation: 太棒了，你做得很好。你的新任务是杀死[数量][任务怪物]。 [tai bang le ， ni zuo de hen hao 。 ni de xin ren wu shi sha si [ shu liang ][ ren wu guai wu ]。]

english: You're still hunting [monster]; you have [amount] to go. Come back when you've finished your task.
translation: 你还在狩猎[怪物]；你还有[金额]要走。完成任务后就回来。 [ni hai zai shou lie [ guai wu ]； ni hai you [ jin e ] yao zou 。 wan cheng ren wu hou jiu hui lai 。]

english: You're still hunting [monster], with [amount] to go.
translation: 你仍在狩猎[怪物]，还有[数量]。 [ni reng zai shou lie [ guai wu ]， hai you [ shu liang ]。]

english: I don't think that's a suitable task for you. Shall I cancel it? This will not wipe your task streaks.
translation: 我认为这不适合你。我要取消它吗？这不会消除您的任务连续记录。 [wo ren wei zhe bu shi he ni 。 wo yao qu xiao ta ma ？ zhe bu hui xiao chu nin de ren wu lian xu ji lu 。]

english: Yes, please cancel it.
translation: 是的，请取消。 [shi de ， qing qu xiao 。]

english: Alright, consider the task cancelled. You can now get a new assignment when you want one.
translation: 好吧，考虑任务被取消了。现在，您可以在需要时获得新的任务。 [hao ba ， kao lv ren wu bei qu xiao le 。 xian zai ， nin ke yi zai xu yao shi huo de xin de ren wu 。]

translation: 不，谢谢，我想尝试一下。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo xiang chang shi yi xia 。]

english: Good luck with that.
translation: 祝你好运。 [zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: 你有什么奖励给我，或者有什么可以交易的吗？ [ni you shen me jiang li gei wo ， huo zhe you shen me ke yi jiao yi de ma ？]

english: I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.
translation: 我有很多你可以获得的奖励，还有各种各样的杀手装备可供出售。 [wo you hen duo ni ke yi huo de de jiang li ， hai you ge zhong ge yang de sha shou zhuang bei ke gong chu shou 。]

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: 说说我的作业的难度吧。 [shuo shuo wo de zuo ye de nan du ba 。]

english: The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 目前，杀戮大师可以为您分配我们列表中的任何任务，无论您的战斗水平如何。 [mu qian ， sha lu da shi ke yi wei nin fen pei wo men lie biao zhong de ren he ren wu ， wu lun nin de zhan dou shui ping ru he 。]

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
translation: 没关系——我可以处理任何任务。 [mei guan xi —— wo ke yi chu li ren he ren wu 。]

english: That's the spirit.
translation: 这就是精神。 [zhe jiu shi jing shen 。]

english: In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: 以后，请不要给任何太艰难的事情。 [yi hou ， qing bu yao gei ren he tai jian nan de shi qing 。]

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: 好吧，从现在开始，所有屠戮大师在为你选择任务时都会考虑你的战斗水平，所以你不要做太难的事情。 [hao ba ， cong xian zai kai shi ， suo you tu lu da shi zai wei ni xuan ze ren wu shi du hui kao lv ni de zhan dou shui ping ， suo yi ni bu yao zuo tai nan de shi qing 。]

english: The Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: 杀手大师在为你选择任务时会考虑你的战斗水平，所以你不应该遇到太难的任务。 [sha shou da shi zai wei ni xuan ze ren wu shi hui kao lv ni de zhan dou shui ping ， suo yi ni bu ying gai yu dao tai nan de ren wu 。]

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: 没关系——我不想要太难的东西。 [mei guan xi —— wo bu xiang yao tai nan de dong xi 。]

english: Okay, we'll keep checking your combat level.
translation: 好的，我们会继续检查你的战斗水平。 [hao de ， wo men hui ji xu jian cha ni de zhan dou shui ping 。]

english: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: 别再检查我的战斗水平了——我可以承受任何事情！ [bie zai jian cha wo de zhan dou shui ping le —— wo ke yi cheng shou ren he shi qing ！]

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will assign you anything from their lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 好吧，从现在开始，所有的杀手大师都会从他们的列表中为你分配任何东西，无论你的战斗水平如何。 [hao ba ， cong xian zai kai shi ， suo you de sha shou da shi du hui cong ta men de lie biao zhong wei ni fen pei ren he dong xi ， wu lun ni de zhan dou shui ping ru he 。]

english: I see you're the new Slayer Master here.
translation: 我发现你是这里的新杀手大师。 [wo fa xian ni shi zhe li de xin sha shou da shi 。]

english: Yes, Nieve used to be the local Slayer Master - she's my cousin. She's gone off somewhere now, so I'm taking over.
translation: 是的，妮芙曾经是当地的杀手大师——她是我的表弟。她现在去什么地方了，所以我接手。 [shi de ， ni fu ceng jing shi dang di de sha shou da shi —— ta shi wo de biao di 。 ta xian zai qu shen me di fang le ， suo yi wo jie shou 。]

english: How sad for you.
translation: 为你感到多么悲伤啊。 [wei ni gan dao duo me bei shang a 。]

english: Yes, Nieve used to be the local Slayer Master - she was my cousin. We weren't particularly close, but I came here straight away to take over the job.
translation: 是的，妮芙曾经是当地的杀手大师——她是我的表弟。我们关系不是特别亲密，但我立刻就来这里接手了这份工作。 [shi de ， ni fu ceng jing shi dang di de sha shou da shi —— ta shi wo de biao di 。 wo men guan xi bu shi te bie qin mi ， dan wo li ke jiu lai zhe li jie shou le zhe fen gong zuo 。]

english: I'd hoped I'd receive a shield like Nieve's when I took over her job, but I've not been given one so far. I guess the perks of the job aren't what they used to be.
translation: 当我接手尼芙的工作时，我希望能得到像她一样的盾牌，但到目前为止我还没有得到。我想这份工作的福利不如以前了。 [dang wo jie shou ni fu de gong zuo shi ， wo xi wang neng de dao xiang ta yi yang de dun pai ， dan dao mu qian wei zhi wo hai mei you de dao 。 wo xiang zhe fen gong zuo de fu li bu ru yi qian le 。]
