translation: 嘘！我等着看演出呢！ [xu ！ wo deng zhe kan yan chu ne ！]

english: YOU ARE A TERRIBLE BARD!
translation: 你是个糟糕的吟游诗人！ [ni shi ge zao gao de yin you shi ren ！]

english: Don't give up your day job outerlander!
translation: 不要放弃你的日常工作外地人！ [bu yao fang qi ni de ri chang gong zuo wai di ren ！]

english: I thought somebody was murdering a cat!
translation: 我以为有人谋杀了一只猫！ [wo yi wei you ren mou sha le yi zhi mao ！]

english: You know, I actually quite liked that verse...
translation: 你知道，我其实很喜欢这首诗...... [ni zhi dao ， wo qi shi hen xi huan zhe shou shi ......]

english: That's kind of catchy. Irritating. But catchy.
translation: 这有点吸引人。令人恼火。但很吸引人。 [zhe you dian xi yin ren 。 ling ren nao huo 。 dan hen xi yin ren 。]

english: Hey, I've done that quest too!
translation: 嘿嘿，这个任务我也做过！ [hei hei ， zhe ge ren wu wo ye zuo guo ！]

english: I have produced better sounds in the outhouse!
translation: 我在室外发出了更好的声音！ [wo zai shi wai fa chu le geng hao de sheng yin ！]

english: Your song makes no sense outerlander!
translation: 你的歌毫无意义，外地人！ [ni de ge hao wu yi yi ， wai di ren ！]

english: What kind of bard are you anyway?
translation: 你到底是哪种吟游诗人？ [ni dao di shi na zhong yin you shi ren ？]

english: I have met cows more musical than you!
translation: 我见过比你更有音乐天赋的牛！ [wo jian guo bi ni geng you yin yue tian fu de niu ！]

english: When do you get to the good parts?
translation: 你什么时候能看到好的部分？ [ni shen me shi hou neng kan dao hao de bu fen ？]

english: would torture us so, outerlander?
translation: 会这样折磨我们吗，外来者？ [hui zhe yang zhe mo wo men ma ， wai lai zhe ？]

english: Truly, this is the worst sound I have ever heard!
translation: 确实，这是我听过的最糟糕的声音！ [que shi ， zhe shi wo ting guo de zui zao gao de sheng yin ！]

english: looting and drinking part?
translation: 抢劫和饮酒部分？ [qiang jie he yin jiu bu fen ？]

english: Please tell me that was the last verse...
translation: 请告诉我这是最后一首诗... [qing gao su wo zhe shi zui hou yi shou shi ...]

english: Please... Kill me now...
translation: 拜托...现在就杀了我... [bai tuo ... xian zai jiu sha le wo ...]

english: You call THAT singing?
translation: 你管这叫唱歌？ [ni guan zhe jiao chang ge ？]

english: Never before have mine ears been so offended!
translation: 我的耳朵从来没有这么不舒服过！ [wo de er duo cong lai mei you zhe me bu shu fu guo ！]

english: Worst. Bard. EVER.
translation: 最糟糕的。诗人。曾经。 [zui zao gao de 。 shi ren 。 ceng jing 。]

english: Please, ye gods! Make it stop!
translation: 拜托各位大神了！让它停下来！ [bai tuo ge wei da shen le ！ rang ta ting xia lai ！]

english: If you stopped singing
translation: 如果你停止唱歌 [ru guo ni ting zhi chang ge]

english: The screams of my dying comrades sound better!
translation: 我死去的战友的尖叫声听起来更好听！ [wo si qu de zhan you de jian jiao sheng ting qi lai geng hao ting ！]

english: My grandmother could do better, and she is dead!
translation: 我的祖母本可以做得更好，但她已经死了！ [wo de zu mu ben ke yi zuo de geng hao ， dan ta yi jing si le ！]

english: I do such feats before breakfast!
translation: 我在早餐前就做了这样的事！ [wo zai zao can qian jiu zuo le zhe yang de shi ！]

english: Is your singing some kind of outerlander weapon?
translation: 你的歌声是某种外来武器吗？ [ni de ge sheng shi mou zhong wai lai wu qi ma ？]

english: Look who it is!
translation: 看看是谁！ [kan kan shi shui ！]

english: Hello again. How are things going?
translation: 又好。进展如何？ [you hao 。 jin zhan ru he ？]

english: Amazing! We get paid to eat all day, and our payment is more food. Life has never been better!
translation: 惊人的！我们整天吃饭都是有报酬的，而我们的报酬就是更多的食物。生活从未如此美好！ [jing ren de ！ wo men zheng tian chi fan dou shi you bao chou de ， er wo men de bao chou jiu shi geng duo de shi wu 。 sheng huo cong wei ru ci mei hao ！]

english: Too right, Gary! This is much better than being on strike!
translation: 太对了，加里！这比罢工好多了！ [tai dui le ， jia li ！ zhe bi ba gong hao duo le ！]

english: Glad to hear it.
translation: 很高兴听到这个消息。 [hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi 。]

english: Can you leave me alone please? I'm trying to get a bit of rest.
translation: 你可以让我一个人静一静吗？我正在努力休息一下。 [ni ke yi rang wo yi ge ren jing yi jing ma ？ wo zheng zai nu li xiu xi yi xia 。]

english: Sorry, I'm busy!
translation: 对不起，我很忙！ [dui bu qi ， wo hen mang ！]

english: I want some bread!
translation: 我想要一些面包！ [wo xiang yao yi xie mian bao ！]

english: Yes dad.
translation: 是的，爸爸。 [shi de ， ba ba 。]

english: I'll be right back.
translation: 我马上回来。 [wo ma shang hui lai 。]

english: What's your father want now?
translation: 你父亲现在想要什么？ [ni fu qin xian zai xiang yao shen me ？]

english: What'll it be, son?
translation: 会是什么，儿子？ [hui shi shen me ， er zi ？]

english: A loaf of bread please.
translation: 请给我一条面包。 [qing gei wo yi tiao mian bao 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Cheers.
translation: 干杯。 [gan bei 。]

english: I need more bread!
translation: 我需要更多面包！ [wo xu yao geng duo mian bao ！]

english: I need some silver ore!
translation: 我需要一些银矿石！ [wo xu yao yi xie yin kuang shi ！]

english: What's your father want now?
translation: 你父亲现在想要什么？ [ni fu qin xian zai xiang yao shen me ？]

english: What'll it be, son?
translation: 会是什么，儿子？ [hui shi shen me ， er zi ？]

english: A piece of silver please.
translation: 请给我一块银子。 [qing gei wo yi kuai yin zi 。]

english: Only one piece of silver? I need more!
translation: 只有一块银子？我需要更多！ [zhi you yi kuai yin zi ？ wo xu yao geng duo ！]

english: I need some new clothes!
translation: 我需要一些新衣服！ [wo xu yao yi xie xin yi fu ！]

english: What's your father want now?
translation: 你父亲现在想要什么？ [ni fu qin xian zai xiang yao shen me ？]

english: What'll it be, son?
translation: 会是什么，儿子？ [hui shi shen me ， er zi ？]

english: Some silk please.
translation: 请来一些丝绸。 [qing lai yi xie si chou 。]

english: These clothes are awful, get me some others!
translation: 这些衣服太难看了，再给我买几件吧！ [zhe xie yi fu tai nan kan le ， zai gei wo mai ji jian ba ！]

english: My chisel's gone blunt, buy me one!
translation: 我的凿子钝了，给我买一把吧！ [wo de zao zi dun le ， gei wo mai yi ba ba ！]

english: What's your father want now?
translation: 你父亲现在想要什么？ [ni fu qin xian zai xiang yao shen me ？]

english: What'll it be, son?
translation: 会是什么，儿子？ [hui shi shen me ， er zi ？]

english: A chisel please.
translation: 请给我一把凿子。 [qing gei wo yi ba zao zi 。]

english: This chisel's rubbish, get me another!
translation: 这把凿子太垃圾了，给我再拿一个吧！ [zhe ba zao zi tai la ji le ， gei wo zai na yi ge ba ！]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: I've not seen your face before. Given they let you come down here, I'm assuming you've been allowed to join the Alchemical Society?
translation: 我以前没见过你的脸。既然他们让你来这里，我猜你已经被允许加入炼金术协会了？ [wo yi qian mei jian guo ni de lian 。 ji ran ta men rang ni lai zhe li ， wo cai ni yi jing bei yun xu jia ru lian jin shu xie hui le ？]

english: That's right!
translation: 这是正确的！ [zhe shi zheng que de ！]

english: Well in that case, just through there is the lab we use to produce potions for the kingdom. However, before you head in and get started, there's a couple of things to note.
translation: 好吧，那么，穿过那里就是我们用来为王国生产药剂的实验室。然而，在开始之前，有几件事需要注意。 [hao ba ， na me ， chuan guo na li jiu shi wo men yong lai wei wang guo sheng chan yao ji de shi yan shi 。 ran er ， zai kai shi zhi qian ， you ji jian shi xu yao zhu yi 。]

english: First, I can see you're not from around here, so I'll point out that Varlamorian Alchemy is a little different from the Druidic Herblore that you'll be familiar with.
translation: 首先，我发现你不是来自这里，所以我会指出瓦拉莫里安炼金术与你熟悉的德鲁伊炼金术有点不同。 [shou xian ， wo fa xian ni bu shi lai zi zhe li ， suo yi wo hui zhi chu wa la mo li an lian jin shu yu ni shu xi de de lu yi lian jin shu you dian bu tong 。]

english: How so?
translation: 为何如此？ [wei he ru ci ？]

english: We discovered that the majority of herbs in the world can be broken down into three alchemical reagents: Mox, Aga and Lye.
translation: 我们发现世界上大多数草药都可以分解为三种炼金试剂：Mox、Aga 和 Lye。 [wo men fa xian shi jie shang da duo shu cao yao dou ke yi fen jie wei san zhong lian jin shi ji ：Mox、Aga  he  Lye。]

english: When mixed in the correct way, these three components produce drastically different results. As such, in the lab you will be using these components to create various potions.
translation: 当以正确的方式混合时，这三种成分会产生截然不同的结果。因此，在实验室中，您将使用这些组件来创建各种药剂。 [dang yi zheng que de fang shi hun he shi ， zhe san zhong cheng fen hui chan sheng jie ran bu tong de jie guo 。 yin ci ， zai shi yan shi zhong ， nin jiang shi yong zhe xie zu jian lai chuang jian ge zhong yao ji 。]

english: What potions do I need to make?
translation: 我需要配制什么药剂？ [wo xu yao pei zhi shen me yao ji ？]

english: That depends. We get orders in from across the kingdom. You'll need to keep an eye out for what potions are currently desired and ensure you're making the right ones.
translation: 这要看情况。我们收到来自王国各地的订单。你需要留意当前需要什么药水，并确保你正在制作正确的药水。 [zhe yao kan qing kuang 。 wo men shou dao lai zi wang guo ge di de ding dan 。 ni xu yao liu yi dang qian xu yao shen me yao shui ， bing que bao ni zheng zai zhi zuo zheng que de yao shui 。]

english: Let's do that run through.
translation: 让我们来看看吧。 [rang wo men lai kan kan ba 。]

english: Very well... Listen closely.
translation: 很好……仔细听。 [hen hao …… zi xi ting 。]

english: The scene cuts to each part of the laboratory as they are discussed
translation: 当他们讨论时，场景切换到实验室的每个部分 [dang ta men tao lun shi ， chang jing qie huan dao shi yan shi de mei ge bu fen]

english: Start by breaking down herbs or unfinished potions over at theRefiner. This will give you your reagents:Mox,Aga, andLyepaste. The type you get will depend on the quality of what you put in.
translation: 首先在精炼厂分解草药或未完成的药剂。这将为您提供试剂：Mox、Aga 和 Lyepaste。您获得的类型将取决于您投入的内容的质量。 [shou xian zai jing lian chang fen jie cao yao huo wei wan cheng de yao ji 。 zhe jiang wei nin ti gong shi ji ：Mox、Aga  he  Lyepaste。 nin huo de de lei xing jiang qu jue yu nin tou ru de nei rong de zhi liang 。]

english: Insert the paste into theHopperand it will become available to use in theMixer.
translation: 将糊状物插入料斗中，即可在混合器中使用。 [jiang hu zhuang wu cha ru liao dou zhong ， ji ke zai hun he qi zhong shi yong 。]

english: From here, you'll need to pull theMixer Leversto create the right combination of reagents.
translation: 从这里，您需要拉动混合器杠杆来创建正确的试剂组合。 [cong zhe li ， nin xu yao la dong hun he qi gang gan lai chuang jian zheng que de shi ji zu he 。]

english: But how do I know what the combinations are?
translation: 但我怎么知道这些组合是什么？ [dan wo zen me zhi dao zhe xie zu he shi shen me ？]

english: I see you've already found our book of lab notes. That'll give you the formulas for our various products.
translation: 我发现您已经找到了我们的实验笔记书。这将为您提供我们各种产品的配方。 [wo fa xian nin yi jing zhao dao le wo men de shi yan bi ji shu 。 zhe jiang wei nin ti gong wo men ge zhong chan pin de pei fang 。]

english: Have a look on the bookshelf for a book of lab notes. That'll give you the formulas for our various products.
translation: 看看书架上有一本实验笔记。这将为您提供我们各种产品的配方。 [kan kan shu jia shang you yi ben shi yan bi ji 。 zhe jiang wei nin ti gong wo men ge zhong chan pin de pei fang 。]

english: To know what needs making, you'll need to check the order list. There will always be three orders to choose from. You can work on just one or them, or multiple. It's up to you.
translation: 要知道需要做什么，您需要检查订单列表。总是有三个订单可供选择。您可以只处理其中一个或多个，也可以处理多个。由你决定。 [yao zhi dao xu yao zuo shen me ， nin xu yao jian cha ding dan lie biao 。 zong shi you san ge ding dan ke gong xuan ze 。 nin ke yi zhi chu li qi zhong yi ge huo duo ge ， ye ke yi chu li duo ge 。 you ni jue ding 。]

english: Just be aware that demand shifts fast here. Every time you fulfil one or more orders, a new set will come through.
translation: 请注意，这里的需求变化很快。每次您完成一个或多个订单时，都会收到一组新订单。 [qing zhu yi ， zhe li de xu qiu bian hua hen kuai 。 mei ci nin wan cheng yi ge huo duo ge ding dan shi ， du hui shou dao yi zu xin ding dan 。]

english: Now, once you have set your desired combination of reagents, collect the unfinished mixture from theMixingVessel. This will then need to be processed on one of the three tables to finish it off.
translation: 现在，一旦您设置了所需的试剂组合，请从混合容器中收集未完成的混合物。然后需要在三个表之一上进行处理才能完成它。 [xian zai ， yi dan nin she zhi le suo xu de shi ji zu he ， qing cong hun he rong qi zhong shou ji wei wan cheng de hun he wu 。 ran hou xu yao zai san ge biao zhi yi shang jin xing chu li cai neng wan cheng ta 。]

english: TheAlembicwillCrystalisethe mixture.
translation: 蒸馏器将使混合物结晶。 [zheng liu qi jiang shi hun he wu jie jing 。]

english: TheAgitatorwillHomogenisethe mixture.
translation: 搅拌器将使混合物均化。 [jiao ban qi jiang shi hun he wu jun hua 。]

english: And finally, theRetortwillConcentratethe mixture.
translation: 最后，蒸馏器将浓缩混合物。 [zui hou ， zheng liu qi jiang nong suo hun he wu 。]

english: After processing, place the finished mixture on theConveyor Beltand move on to the next order.
translation: 加工完成后，将成品混合物放在传送带上并继续下一个订单。 [jia gong wan cheng hou ， jiang cheng pin hun he wu fang zai chuan song dai shang bing ji xu xia yi ge ding dan 。]

english: What if I get an order wrong, or am unable to fulfil any of the orders?
translation: 如果我收到错误订单或无法履行任何订单怎么办？ [ru guo wo shou dao cuo wu ding dan huo wu fa lv xing ren he ding dan zen me ban ？]

english: We always have need for spares, so fulfilling an incorrect order will still grant you a small reward and will refresh the orders.
translation: 我们总是需要备件，因此履行错误的订单仍将为您提供少量奖励并刷新订单。 [wo men zong shi xu yao bei jian ， yin ci lv xing cuo wu de ding dan reng jiang wei nin ti gong shao liang jiang li bing shua xin ding dan 。]

english: One final thing to mention... We have someDigweedgrowing in the lab.
translation: 最后要提到的一件事......我们在实验室里种植了一些地沟草。 [zui hou yao ti dao de yi jian shi ...... wo men zai shi yan shi li zhong zhi le yi xie di gou cao 。]

english: These rare herbs will occasionally come into maturity for a short period of time. Harvest them while you can!
translation: 这些稀有草药偶尔会在短时间内成熟。尽可能地收获它们！ [zhe xie xi you cao yao ou er hui zai duan shi jian nei cheng shu 。 jin ke neng di shou huo ta men ！]

english: Mixing some into your product will increase its potency and grant you bonus rewards.
translation: 将一些混合到您的产品中会增加其效力并为您带来额外奖励。 [jiang yi xie hun he dao nin de chan pin zhong hui zeng jia qi xiao li bing wei nin dai lai e wai jiang li 。]

english: Bonus rewards?
translation: 奖金奖励？ [jiang jin jiang li ？]

english: That's right. As you produce potions, you'll find yourself collecting three types ofResin. The types obtained depend on what reagents are used, with the quantities being determined by the complexity of the
translation: 这是正确的。当您生产药水时，您会发现自己收集了三种类型的树脂。获得的类型取决于所使用的试剂，其数量取决于实验的复杂性 [zhe shi zheng que de 。 dang nin sheng chan yao shui shi ， nin hui fa xian zi ji shou ji le san zhong lei xing de shu zhi 。 huo de de lei xing qu jue yu suo shi yong de shi ji ， qi shu liang qu jue yu shi yan de fu za xing]

english: potion.
translation: 药水。 [yao shui 。]

english: Potions usingDigweedwill reward additionalResin, as will handing in multiple potions in one go.
translation: 使用迪格草的药水将奖励额外的树脂，就像一次性交出多种药水一样。 [shi yong di ge cao de yao shui jiang jiang li e wai de shu zhi ， jiu xiang yi ci xing jiao chu duo zhong yao shui yi yang 。]

english: Got it! So, refine herbs, deposit into the hopper, mix some products, process them, and then throw them on the conveyor. Seems easy enough!
translation: 知道了！因此，精炼草药，放入料斗，混合一些产品，加工它们，然后将它们扔到传送带上。看起来很容易！ [zhi dao le ！ yin ci ， jing lian cao yao ， fang ru liao dou ， hun he yi xie chan pin ， jia gong ta men ， ran hou jiang ta men reng dao chuan song dai shang 。 kan qi lai hen rong yi ！]

english: I'm sure I can work it out.
translation: 我确信我能解决。 [wo que xin wo neng jie jue 。]

english: Suit yourself. I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 适合自己。如果你改变主意我会在这里。 [shi he zi ji 。 ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi wo hui zai zhe li 。]

english: What is it?
translation: 它是什么？ [ta shi shen me ？]

english: Can you explain how to make potions?
translation: 你能解释一下如何制作药剂吗？ [ni neng jie shi yi xia ru he zhi zuo yao ji ma ？]

english: Can I have some rewards?
translation: 我可以得到一些奖励吗？ [wo ke yi de dao yi xie jiang li ma ？]

english: As you wish.
translation: 如你所愿。 [ru ni suo yuan 。]

english: Can you tell me more about the Alchemical Society?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于炼金术协会的信息吗？ [ni neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu lian jin shu xie hui de xin xi ma ？]

english: Can't imagine there's much to tell beyond what you already know. We exist to bring about advancements in Herblore, but in truth, a lot of what we produce doesn't directly contribute to that.
translation: 无法想象除了你已经知道的之外还有很多东西要讲。我们的存在是为了推动 Herblore 的进步，但事实上，我们生产的很多产品并没有直接为此做出贡献。 [wu fa xiang xiang chu le ni yi jing zhi dao de zhi wai hai you hen duo dong xi yao jiang 。 wo men de cun zai shi wei le tui dong  Herblore  de jin bu ， dan shi shi shang ， wo men sheng chan de hen duo chan pin bing mei you zhi jie wei ci zuo chu gong xian 。]

english: Instead, many of the potions we make here are simply to sell. Doing so is what provides the funding we need to further our true goals.
translation: 相反，我们在这里制作的许多药剂只是为了出售。这样做可以为我们提供实现真正目标所需的资金。 [xiang fan ， wo men zai zhe li zhi zuo de xu duo yao ji zhi shi wei le chu shou 。 zhe yang zuo ke yi wei wo men ti gong shi xian zhen zheng mu biao suo xu de zi jin 。]

english: Makes sense. So how did the society first get established?
translation: 有道理。那么这个社团最初是如何成立的呢？ [you dao li 。 na me zhe ge she tuan zui chu shi ru he cheng li de ne ？]

english: For a long time, it was just a couple of us operating out of a makeshift lab we'd built in my garden. Our big break came when the Moonrise Brewery and Winery learnt about us.
translation: 很长一段时间，只有我们几个人在我花园里搭建的临时实验室里工作。当 Moonrise Brewery and Winery 了解我们时，我们迎来了重大突破。 [hen zhang yi duan shi jian ， zhi you wo men ji ge ren zai wo hua yuan li da jian de lin shi shi yan shi li gong zuo 。 dang  Moonrise Brewery and Winery  liao jie wo men shi ， wo men ying lai le zhong da tu po 。]

english: They provided us with some initial funding to properly get things going, but more importantly, they provided this lab space. This was actually one of their old wine cellars before we moved in.
translation: 他们为我们提供了一些初始资金来让事情顺利进行，但更重要的是，他们提供了这个实验室空间。这实际上是我们搬进来之前他们的旧酒窖之一。 [ta men wei wo men ti gong le yi xie chu shi zi jin lai rang shi qing shun li jin xing ， dan geng zhong yao de shi ， ta men ti gong le zhe ge shi yan shi kong jian 。 zhe shi ji shang shi wo men ban jin lai zhi qian ta men de jiu jiu jiao zhi yi 。]

english: Why were they so interested in your work?
translation: 为什么他们对你的工作如此感兴趣？ [wei shen me ta men dui ni de gong zuo ru ci gan xing qu ？]

english: They never properly said why, just that they were very keen to see us grow. Maybe they're hoping our work can help them create new beers and wines.
translation: 他们从来没有正确地说明原因，只是说他们非常渴望看到我们成长。也许他们希望我们的工作能够帮助他们创造新的啤酒和葡萄酒。 [ta men cong lai mei you zheng que di shuo ming yuan yin ， zhi shi shuo ta men fei chang ke wang kan dao wo men cheng zhang 。 ye xu ta men xi wang wo men de gong zuo neng gou bang zhu ta men chuang zao xin de pi jiu he pu tao jiu 。]

english: I see. I suppose that makes sense.
translation: 我懂了。我想这是有道理的。 [wo dong le 。 wo xiang zhe shi you dao li de 。]

english: Nothing, I'll be going now.
translation: 没什么，我现在就走。 [mei shen me ， wo xian zai jiu zou 。]

english: Hey! I haven't given you permission to do that!
translation: 嘿！我还没有允许你这么做！ [hei ！ wo hai mei you yun xu ni zhe me zuo ！]

english: To know what needs making, you'll need to check the order list. There will always be three orders to choose from. Demand shifts fast here so every time you fulfil an order, a new set will come through.
translation: 要知道需要做什么，您需要检查订单列表。总是有三个订单可供选择。这里的需求变化很快，因此每次您完成订单时，都会有一套新的产品出现。 [yao zhi dao xu yao zuo shen me ， nin xu yao jian cha ding dan lie biao 。 zong shi you san ge ding dan ke gong xuan ze 。 zhe li de xu qiu bian hua hen kuai ， yin ci mei ci nin wan cheng ding dan shi ， du hui you yi tao xin de chan pin chu xian 。]

english: Let's do that run through.
translation: 让我们来看看吧。 [rang wo men lai kan kan ba 。]

english: I'm sure I can work it out.
translation: 我确信我能解决。 [wo que xin wo neng jie jue 。]

english: Can you explain how to make potions?
translation: 你能解释一下如何制作药剂吗？ [ni neng jie shi yi xia ru he zhi zuo yao ji ma ？]

english: Can I have some rewards?
translation: 我可以得到一些奖励吗？ [wo ke yi de dao yi xie jiang li ma ？]

english: Can you tell me more about the Alchemical Society?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于炼金术协会的信息吗？ [ni neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu lian jin shu xie hui de xin xi ma ？]

english: Nothing, I'll be going now.
translation: 没什么，我现在就走。 [mei shen me ， wo xian zai jiu zou 。]

english: Veldaban told me about your involvement in the rebuilding of the statue. Congratulations.
translation: 维达班告诉我你参与重建雕像的事。恭喜。 [wei da ban gao su wo ni can yu chong jian diao xiang de shi 。 gong xi 。]

english: Thank you!
translation: 谢谢你！ [xie xie ni ！]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I am Bisi. I am the Supreme Commander of the Black Guard.
translation: 我是比西。我是黑衣卫队的最高指挥官。 [wo shi bi xi 。 wo shi hei yi wei dui de zui gao zhi hui guan 。]

english: I thought Veldaban was in command?
translation: 我以为维达班在指挥？ [wo yi wei wei da ban zai zhi hui ？]

english: Only of our regiment in Keldagrim, and a most honourable position it is as well.
translation: 只有我们在凯尔达格林的团里才有，而且这也是一个最光荣的职位。 [zhi you wo men zai kai er da ge lin de tuan li cai you ， er qie zhe ye shi yi ge zui guang rong de zhi wei 。]

english: But the Black Guard has many regiments across the dwarven realm. All the Commanders of those regiments report to me.
translation: 但黑色守卫在整个矮人王国拥有许多军团。所有这些团的指挥官都向我报告。 [dan hei se shou wei zai zheng ge ai ren wang guo yong you xu duo jun tuan 。 suo you zhe xie tuan de zhi hui guan dou xiang wo bao gao 。]

english: Oh yes, I helped Commander Lawgof once, in his fight against the goblins.
translation: 哦，是的，我曾经帮助劳戈夫指挥官对抗哥布林。 [o ， shi de ， wo ceng jing bang zhu lao ge fu zhi hui guan dui kang ge bu lin 。]

english: That's good to hear.
translation: 很高兴听到这个消息。 [hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi 。]

english: What news have you?
translation: 你有什么消息？ [ni you shen me xiao xi ？]

english: Apart from you helping to rebuild the statue for the Purple Pewter?
translation: 除了你帮忙重建紫镴雕像之外？ [chu le ni bang mang chong jian zi la diao xiang zhi wai ？]

english: Well, I heard that you helped Veldaban's father in the mines to the south. That's caused quite a bit of an upset in the Consortium, so I understand.
translation: 嗯，我听说你在南方的矿井里帮助过维尔达班的父亲。这在财团里引起了相当大的不安，所以我理解。 [n ， wo ting shuo ni zai nan fang de kuang jing li bang zhu guo wei er da ban de fu qin 。 zhe zai cai tuan li yin qi le xiang dang da de bu an ， suo yi wo li jie 。]

english: How so?
translation: 为何如此？ [wei he ru ci ？]

english: The amount of wealth that goldmine is generating might cause some distortion in the balance of power in the Consortium. But we'll see.
translation: 金矿所产生的财富数量可能会导致财团的权力平衡发生一些扭曲。但我们会看到。 [jin kuang suo chan sheng de cai fu shu liang ke neng hui dao zhi cai tuan de quan li ping heng fa sheng yi xie niu qu 。 dan wo men hui kan dao 。]

english: Apart from that there seems to be some general unrest in the city. Trouble is brewing in Keldagrim.
translation: 除此之外，这座城市似乎还存在一些普遍的骚乱。凯尔达格林正在酝酿着麻烦。 [chu ci zhi wai ， zhe zuo cheng shi si hu hai cun zai yi xie pu bian de sao luan 。 kai er da ge lin zheng zai yun niang zhe ma fan 。]

english: But I'm sure Commander Veldaban is on top of it. He's a very capable officer, and I'm starting to get too old for this sort of thing.
translation: 但我确信维尔达班指挥官能掌控一切。他是一位非常有能力的军官，而我已经开始变得太老了，无法承担这种事情。 [dan wo que xin wei er da ban zhi hui guan neng zhang kong yi qie 。 ta shi yi wei fei chang you neng li de jun guan ， er wo yi jing kai shi bian de tai lao le ， wu fa cheng dan zhe zhong shi qing 。]

english: I must go now.
translation: 我现在必须走了。 [wo xian zai bi xu zou le 。]

english: Then I bid you farewell, human.
translation: 那么我就向你告别了，人类。 [na me wo jiu xiang ni gao bie le ， ren lei 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: What news have you?
translation: 你有什么消息？ [ni you shen me xiao xi ？]

english: I must go now.
translation: 我现在必须走了。 [wo xian zai bi xu zou le 。]

english: Hi!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Hi. How can I help?
translation: 你好。我能提供什么帮助吗？ [ni hao 。 wo neng ti gong shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: Can you heal me?
translation: 你能治愈我吗？ [ni neng zhi yu wo ma ？]

english: Sorry, I'm not on duty.
translation: 抱歉，我没有值班。 [bao qian ， wo mei you zhi ban 。]

english: PLEASE DON'T KILL ME!
translation: 请不要杀我！ [qing bu yao sha wo ！]

english: I was... looking to be healed.
translation: 我……希望得到治愈。 [wo …… xi wang de dao zhi yu 。]

english: No way, I'm out of here just as soon as I've packed up my stuff!
translation: 没办法，我收拾好东西就走了！ [mei ban fa ， wo shou shi hao dong xi jiu zou le ！]

english: You look healthy to me!
translation: 在我看来你很健康！ [zai wo kan lai ni hen jian kang ！]

english: Of course!
translation: 当然！ [dang ran ！]

english: Surgeon General Tafani heals you for 21 Hitpoints.
translation: 外科医生将军塔法尼治疗你 21 点生命值。 [wai ke yi sheng jiang jun ta fa ni zhi liao ni  21  dian sheng ming zhi 。]

english: Do you see a lot of injured fighters?
translation: 你看到很多受伤的战士吗？ [ni kan dao hen duo shou shang de zhan shi ma ？]

english: Yes I do. Thankfully we can cope with almost anything. Jaraah really is a wonderful surgeon, his methods are a little unorthodox but he gets the job done.
translation: 是的，我愿意。值得庆幸的是，我们几乎可以应对任何事情。 Jaraah 确实是一位出色的外科医生，他的方法有点非正统，但他完成了工作。 [shi de ， wo yuan yi 。 zhi de qing xing de shi ， wo men ji hu ke yi ying dui ren he shi qing 。 Jaraah  que shi shi yi wei chu se de wai ke yi sheng ， ta de fang fa you dian fei zheng tong ， dan ta wan cheng le gong zuo 。]

english: I shouldn't tell you this but his nickname is 'The Butcher'.
translation: 我不应该告诉你这个，但他的绰号是“屠夫”。 [wo bu ying gai gao su ni zhe ge ， dan ta de chuo hao shi “ tu fu ”。]

english: That's reassuring.
translation: 这让人放心。 [zhe rang ren fang xin 。]

english: Do you come here often?
translation: 你经常来这里吗？ [ni jing chang lai zhe li ma ？]

english: I work here, so yes!
translation: 我在这里工作，所以是的！ [wo zai zhe li gong zuo ， suo yi shi de ！]

english: You're silly!
translation: 你真傻！ [ni zhen sha ！]

english: Can you tell me about your cape?
translation: 你能告诉我你的斗篷吗？ [ni neng gao su wo ni de dou peng ma ？]

english: Certainly! Skillcapes are a symbol of achievement. Only people who have mastered a skill and reached level 99 can get their hands on them and gain the benefits they carry.
translation: 当然！技能斗篷是成就的象征。只有掌握了一项技能并达到99级的人才能获得它们并获得它们所带来的好处。 [dang ran ！ ji neng dou peng shi cheng jiu de xiang zheng 。 zhi you zhang wo le yi xiang ji neng bing da dao 99 ji de ren cai neng huo de ta men bing huo de ta men suo dai lai de hao chu 。]

english: The Cape of Hitpoints doubles the speed of your hitpoints replenishing when worn. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 穿戴生命值斗篷后，生命值补充速度会加倍。还有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [chuan dai sheng ming zhi dou peng hou ， sheng ming zhi bu chong su du hui jia bei 。 hai you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

english: Can I buy a Skillcape of Hitpoints from you?
translation: 我可以向你们购买生命值技能斗篷吗？ [wo ke yi xiang ni men gou mai sheng ming zhi ji neng dou peng ma ？]

english: Sorry, I'm under orders to not sell capes right now.
translation: 抱歉，我现在接到命令不许出售斗篷。 [bao qian ， wo xian zai jie dao ming ling bu xu chu shou dou peng 。]

english: You cannot do that on this game world.
translation: 在这个游戏世界中你不能这样做。 [zai zhe ge you xi shi jie zhong ni bu neng zhe yang zuo 。]

english: Why, certainly my friend. However, owning such an item makes you part of an elite group and wearing it will double the speed of your hitpoints replenishing.
translation: 为什么，当然是我的朋友。然而，拥有这样的物品会让你成为精英群体的一员，佩戴它会让你的生命值补充速度加倍。 [wei shen me ， dang ran shi wo de peng you 。 ran er ， yong you zhe yang de wu pin hui rang ni cheng wei jing ying qun ti de yi yuan ， pei dai ta hui rang ni de sheng ming zhi bu chong su du jia bei 。]

english: Such a privilege will cost you 99,000 coins.
translation: 这样的特权需要花费你 99,000 个金币。 [zhe yang de te quan xu yao hua fei ni  99,000  ge jin bi 。]

english: Sorry, that's much too pricey.
translation: 抱歉，这太贵了。 [bao qian ， zhe tai gui le 。]

english: I'm sorry you feel that way. Still if you change your mind...
translation: 我很抱歉你有这样的感觉。但如果你改变主意... [wo hen bao qian ni you zhe yang de gan jue 。 dan ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ...]

english: Sure, that's not too expensive for such a magnificent cape.
translation: 当然，对于如此华丽的海角来说，这并不算太贵。 [dang ran ， dui yu ru ci hua li de hai jiao lai shuo ， zhe bing bu suan tai gui 。]

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 但不幸的是，我身上没有足够的钱。 [dan bu xing de shi ， wo shen shang mei you zu gou de qian 。]

english: Well come back and see me when you do.
translation: 等你回来了就回来见我吧。 [deng ni hui lai le jiu hui lai jian wo ba 。]

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 不幸的是，所有技能斗篷都只提供免费兜帽，这是技能升级交易的一部分；买一送一，你懂的。因此，在我向您出售一件之前，您需要释放一些库存空间。 [bu xing de shi ， suo you ji neng dou peng dou zhi ti gong mian fei dou mao ， zhe shi ji neng sheng ji jiao yi de yi bu fen ； mai yi song yi ， ni dong de 。 yin ci ， zai wo xiang nin chu shou yi jian zhi qian ， nin xu yao shi fang yi xie ku cun kong jian 。]

english: Wear this cape in good health, my friend.
translation: 穿上这件斗篷，祝你身体健康，我的朋友。 [chuan shang zhe jian dou peng ， zhu ni shen ti jian kang ， wo de peng you 。]

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: 请问我可以再给我的披风戴上兜帽吗？ [qing wen wo ke yi zai gei wo de pi feng dai shang dou mao ma ？]

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
translation: 毫无疑问，而且免费！ [hao wu yi wen ， er qie mian fei ！]

english: Tafani hands you another hood for your skillcape.
translation: 塔法尼为你的技能斗篷提供了另一顶兜帽。 [ta fa ni wei ni de ji neng dou peng ti gong le ling yi ding dou mao 。]

english: Can you heal me?
translation: 你能治愈我吗？ [ni neng zhi yu wo ma ？]

english: Do you see a lot of injured fighters?
translation: 你看到很多受伤的战士吗？ [ni kan dao hen duo shou shang de zhan shi ma ？]

english: Do you come here often?
translation: 你经常来这里吗？ [ni jing chang lai zhe li ma ？]

english: Can you tell me about your cape?
translation: 你能告诉我你的斗篷吗？ [ni neng gao su wo ni de dou peng ma ？]

english: Can I buy a Skillcape of Hitpoints from you?
translation: 我可以向你们购买生命值技能斗篷吗？ [wo ke yi xiang ni men gou mai sheng ming zhi ji neng dou peng ma ？]

english: Skillcape
translation: 技能角 [ji neng jiao]

english: Sorry, that's much too pricey.
translation: 抱歉，这太贵了。 [bao qian ， zhe tai gui le 。]

english: Sure, that's not too expensive for such a magnificent cape.
translation: 当然，对于如此华丽的海角来说，这并不算太贵。 [dang ran ， dui yu ru ci hua li de hai jiao lai shuo ， zhe bing bu suan tai gui 。]

english: Hood
translation: 兜帽 [dou mao]

english: He's too busy playing some succulent beats to stop and talk.
translation: 他正忙着演奏一些动听的节奏，没有时间停下来说话。 [ta zheng mang zhe yan zou yi xie dong ting de jie zou ， mei you shi jian ting xia lai shuo hua 。]

english: Excuse me...
translation: 打扰一下... [da rao yi xia ...]

english: What do you want? ...Oh, wait. I know! You're probably just like all the others, aren't you? After some fancy spell or potion from me, I bet!
translation: 你想要什么？ ……哦，等等。我知道！你可能和其他人一样，不是吗？在我施展了一些奇特的咒语或魔药之后，我敢打赌！ [ni xiang yao shen me ？ …… o ， deng deng 。 wo zhi dao ！ ni ke neng he qi ta ren yi yang ， bu shi ma ？ zai wo shi zhan le yi xie qi te de zhou yu huo mo yao zhi hou ， wo gan da du ！]

english: What? No! At least, I don't think so. What sort of spells do you have?
translation: 什么？不！至少，我不这么认为。你有什么咒语？ [shen me ？ bu ！ zhi shao ， wo bu zhe me ren wei 。 ni you shen me zhou yu ？]

english: Hah! I knew it! I expect you want my Aphro-Dizzy- Yak spell! Want someone to fall madly in love with you, eh?
translation: 哈！我就知道！我想你想要我的 Aphro-Dizzy-Yak 咒语！想要有人疯狂地爱上你，是吗？ [ha ！ wo jiu zhi dao ！ wo xiang ni xiang yao wo de  Aphro-Dizzy-Yak  zhou yu ！ xiang yao you ren feng kuang di ai shang ni ， shi ma ？]

english: That spell sounds very interesting, but I didn't mean to disturb you!
translation: 那个咒语听起来很有趣，但我不是故意打扰你的！ [na ge zhou yu ting qi lai hen you qu ， dan wo bu shi gu yi da rao ni de ！]

english: Well, I see that you do have some manners. I'm glad to see that you use them.
translation: 嗯，我看你还是有一些礼仪的。我很高兴看到你使用它们。 [n ， wo kan ni hai shi you yi xie li yi de 。 wo hen gao xing kan dao ni shi yong ta men 。]

english: Now, if it's all the same, I am very busy at the moment. Unless you want something specific, please come back another time.
translation: 现在，如果都一样的话，我现在很忙。除非您想要特定的东西，否则请下次再来。 [xian zai ， ru guo dou yi yang de hua ， wo xian zai hen mang 。 chu fei nin xiang yao te ding de dong xi ， fou ze qing xia ci zai lai 。]

english: Yes, of course. Goodbye!
translation: 是的当然。再见！ [shi di dang ran 。 zai jian ！]

english: Ummm...
Oh, it's you again! Well, what is it this time?
translation: 噢，又是你！嗯，这次是什么？ [o ， you shi ni ！ n ， zhe ci shi shen me ？]

english: Do you have any jobs or quests that I could do for you?
translation: 您有什么工作或任务需要我为您做吗？ [nin you shen me gong zuo huo ren wu xu yao wo wei nin zuo ma ？]

english: Hah! There are plenty of things I need done, but something tells me you're not quite ready for them right now. Come back another time!
translation: 哈！我有很多事情需要做，但我知道你现在还没有做好准备。下次再来吧！ [ha ！ wo you hen duo shi qing xu yao zuo ， dan wo zhi dao ni xian zai hai mei you zuo hao zhun bei 。 xia ci zai lai ba ！]

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。 [hao de 。]

english: Can't you see I'm very busy here? Be off with you!
translation: 你没看到我在这里很忙吗？跟你走吧！ [ni mei kan dao wo zai zhe li hen mang ma ？ gen ni zou ba ！]

english: Oh. Sorry.
translation: 哦。对不起。 [o 。 dui bu qi 。]

english: Hello there, newcomer. My name is Brynna. My job is to teach you about the skills you can use to survive in this world.
translation: 你好，新人。我叫布琳娜。我的工作是教你在这个世界上生存的技能。 [ni hao ， xin ren 。 wo jiao bu lin na 。 wo de gong zuo shi jiao ni zai zhe ge shi jie shang sheng cun de ji neng 。]

english: The first skill we're going to look at is Fishing. There's some shrimp in this pond here. Let's try and catch some.
translation: 我们要研究的第一个技能是钓鱼。这里的池塘里有一些虾。让我们试着抓住一些。 [wo men yao yan jiu de di yi ge ji neng shi diao yu 。 zhe li de chi tang li you yi xie xia 。 rang wo men shi zhe zhua zhu yi xie 。]

english: Hello again. First up, we're going to do some fishing. There's some shrimp in this pond here. Let's try and catch some.
translation: 又好。首先，我们要去钓鱼。这里的池塘里有一些虾。让我们试着抓住一些。 [you hao 。 shou xian ， wo men yao qu diao yu 。 zhe li de chi tang li you yi xie xia 。 rang wo men shi zhe zhua zhu yi xie 。]

english: Hello again. You should take a look at that menu before we continue.
translation: 又好。在我们继续之前，您应该看一下该菜单。 [you hao 。 zai wo men ji xu zhi qian ， nin ying gai kan yi xia gai cai dan 。]

english: I've managed to catch some shrimp.
translation: 我成功地抓到了一些虾。 [wo cheng gong di zhua dao le yi xie xia 。]

english: Excellent work. Now that you have some shrimp, you're going to want to cook them. To do that, you'll need a fire. This brings us on to the Woodcutting and Firemaking skills.
translation: 佳作。现在你有了一些虾，你会想要煮它们。为此，你需要生火。这让我们了解了伐木和生火技能。 [jia zuo 。 xian zai ni you le yi xie xia ， ni hui xiang yao zhu ta men 。 wei ci ， ni xu yao sheng huo 。 zhe rang wo men liao jie le fa mu he sheng huo ji neng 。]

english: Next up you need to make a fire. First, you'll need to cut down a tree to get some logs.
translation: 接下来你需要生火。首先，你需要砍倒一棵树来获取一些原木。 [jie xia lai ni xu yao sheng huo 。 shou xian ， ni xu yao kan dao yi ke shu lai huo qu yi xie yuan mu 。]

english: Now that you have some shrimp, you're going to want to cook them. To do that, you'll need a fire.
translation: 现在你有了一些虾，你会想要煮它们。为此，你需要生火。 [xian zai ni you le yi xie xia ， ni hui xiang yao zhu ta men 。 wei ci ， ni xu yao sheng huo 。]

english: Now that you have some shrimp, you're going to want to cook them. All you need to do is use them on a fire.
translation: 现在你有了一些虾，你会想要煮它们。您所需要做的就是将它们用于火上。 [xian zai ni you le yi xie xia ， ni hui xiang yao zhu ta men 。 nin suo xu yao zuo de jiu shi jiang ta men yong yu huo shang 。]

english: Hello again. Is there something you'd like to hear more about?
translation: 又好。您还有什么想听的吗？ [you hao 。 nin hai you shen me xiang ting de ma ？]

english: Tell me about my skills again.
translation: 再说说我的技能吧。 [zai shuo shuo wo de ji neng ba 。]

english: Every skill is listed in the skills menu. Here you can see what your current levels are and how much experience you have.
translation: 每个技能都列在技能菜单中。在这里你可以看到你目前的等级以及你有多少经验。 [mei ge ji neng dou lie zai ji neng cai dan zhong 。 zai zhe li ni ke yi kan dao ni mu qian de deng ji yi ji ni you duo shao jing yan 。]

english: As you move your mouse over the various skills the small yellow popup box will show you the exact amount of experience you have and how much is needed to get to the next level.
translation: 当您将鼠标移到各种技能上时，黄色的小弹出框将显示您拥有的确切经验量以及达到下一级别所需的经验量。 [dang nin jiang shu biao yi dao ge zhong ji neng shang shi ， huang se de xiao dan chu kuang jiang xian shi nin yong you di que qie jing yan liang yi ji da dao xia yi ji bie suo xu de jing yan liang 。]

english: You can also click on a skill to open up the relevant skillguide. In the skillguide, you can see all of the unlocks available in that skill.
translation: 您也可以点击某个技能来打开相关的技能指南。在技​​能指南中，您可以看到该技能中可用的所有解锁。 [nin ye ke yi dian ji mou ge ji neng lai da kai xiang guan de ji neng zhi nan 。 zai ji ​​ neng zhi nan zhong ， nin ke yi kan dao gai ji neng zhong ke yong de suo you jie suo 。]

english: Is there anything else you'd like to hear more about?
translation: 您还有什么想听的吗？ [nin hai you shen me xiang ting de ma ？]

english: Tell me about Woodcutting again.
translation: 再给我讲讲木刻吧。 [zai gei wo jiang jiang mu ke ba 。]

english: Woodcutting, eh? Don't worry, newcomer, it's really very easy. Simply equip your axe and click on a nearby tree to chop away.
translation: 伐木，嗯？别担心，新人，这真的很容易。只需装备好你的斧头，然后点击附近的一棵树即可砍倒。 [fa mu ， n ？ bie dan xin ， xin ren ， zhe zhen de hen rong yi 。 zhi xu zhuang bei hao ni de fu tou ， ran hou dian ji fu jin de yi ke shu ji ke kan dao 。]

english: As you explore the mainland you will discover many different kinds of trees that will require different Woodcutting levels to chop down.
translation: 当你探索大陆时，你会发现许多不同种类的树木，需要不同的伐木水平才能砍伐。 [dang ni tan suo da lu shi ， ni hui fa xian xu duo bu tong zhong lei de shu mu ， xu yao bu tong de fa mu shui ping cai neng kan fa 。]

english: Logs are not only useful for making fires. Many archers use the skill known as Fletching to craft their own bows and arrows from trees.
translation: 原木不仅可以用来生火。许多弓箭手使用称为“制箭”的技能从树上制作自己的弓箭。 [yuan mu bu jin ke yi yong lai sheng huo 。 xu duo gong jian shou shi yong cheng wei “ zhi jian ” de ji neng cong shu shang zhi zuo zi ji de gong jian 。]

english: Tell me about Firemaking again.
translation: 再给我讲讲生火的事。 [zai gei wo jiang jiang sheng huo de shi 。]

english: Certainly, newcomer. When you have logs simply use your tinderbox on them. If successful, you will start a fire.
translation: 当然可以，新人。当你有日志时，只需使用你的火药盒来处理它们。如果成功，你就会生火。 [dang ran ke yi ， xin ren 。 dang ni you ri zhi shi ， zhi xu shi yong ni de huo yao he lai chu li ta men 。 ru guo cheng gong ， ni jiu hui sheng huo 。]

english: You can also set fire to logs you find lying on the floor already, and some other things can also be set alight...
translation: 你也可以点燃你发现已经躺在地板上的木头，也可以点燃其他一些东西...... [ni ye ke yi dian ran ni fa xian yi jing tang zai di ban shang de mu tou ， ye ke yi dian ran qi ta yi xie dong xi ......]

english: A tinderbox is always a useful item to keep around!
translation: 火药盒总是一个值得随身携带的有用物品！ [huo yao he zong shi yi ge zhi de sui shen xie dai de you yong wu pin ！]

english: Tell me about Fishing again.
translation: 再给我讲讲钓鱼的事。 [zai gei wo jiang jiang diao yu de shi 。]

english: Ah, yes. Fishing! Fishing is undoubtedly one of the more popular hobbies here in Gielinor!
translation: 啊，是的。钓鱼！钓鱼无疑是吉林诺最受欢迎的爱好之一！ [a ， shi de 。 diao yu ！ diao yu wu yi shi ji lin nuo zui shou huan ying de ai hao zhi yi ！]

english: Whenever you see sparkling waters, you can be sure there's probably some good fishing to be had there!
translation: 每当您看到波光粼粼的水域时，您就可以确定那里可能有一些不错的钓鱼场所！ [mei dang nin kan dao bo guang lin lin de shui yu shi ， nin jiu ke yi que ding na li ke neng you yi xie bu cuo de diao yu chang suo ！]

english: Not only are fish absolutely delicious when cooked, they will also heal lost health.
translation: 鱼煮熟后不仅绝对美味，还能治愈失去的健康。 [yu zhu shu hou bu jin jue dui mei wei ， hai neng zhi yu shi qu de jian kang 。]

english: I would recommend everybody has a go at Fishing at least once in their lives!
translation: 我建议每个人一生中至少尝试一次钓鱼！ [wo jian yi mei ge ren yi sheng zhong zhi shao chang shi yi ci diao yu ！]

english: Tell me about Cooking again.
translation: 再告诉我一些关于烹饪的事。 [zai gao su wo yi xie guan yu peng ren de shi 。]

english: Yes, the most basic of survival techniques. Most simple foods can be used on a fire to cook them. If you're feeling a bit fancier, you can also use a range to cook the food instead.
translation: 是的，最基本的生存技术。大多数简单的食物都可以在火上烹饪。如果您想更喜欢一点，您也可以使用炉灶来烹饪食物。 [shi de ， zui ji ben de sheng cun ji shu 。 da duo shu jian dan de shi wu dou ke yi zai huo shang peng ren 。 ru guo nin xiang geng xi huan yi dian ， nin ye ke yi shi yong lu zao lai peng ren shi wu 。]

english: Eating cooked food will restore lost health. The harder something is to cook, the more it will heal you.
translation: 吃煮熟的食物可以恢复失去的健康。越难煮的东西，就越能治愈你。 [chi zhu shu de shi wu ke yi hui fu shi qu de jian kang 。 yue nan zhu de dong xi ， jiu yue neng zhi yu ni 。]

english: Nothing thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。]
