english: Nothing thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。]

english: You're putting me in prison?!
translation: 你要把我关进监狱？！ [ni yao ba wo guan jin jian yu ？！]

english: Hello there. What are you doing here?
translation: 你好呀。你在这里做什么？ [ni hao ya 。 ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: That's not really any of your business, is it?
translation: 这不关你的事，是吗？ [zhe bu guan ni de shi ， shi ma ？]

english: Fair enough.
translation: 很公平。 [hen gong ping 。]

english: This person seems far too alert for you to be able to plant anything on them.
translation: 这个人看起来太警觉了，你无法在他们身上植入任何东西。 [zhe ge ren kan qi lai tai jing jue le ， ni wu fa zai ta men shen shang zhi ru ren he dong xi 。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Is everything okay?
translation: 一切都好吗？ [yi qie dou hao ma ？]

english: *mumble mumble*
translation: *咕咕咕咕* [* gu gu gu gu *]

english: I didn't catch that.
translation: 我没听清。 [wo mei ting qing 。]

english: Right... Well, have a nice day.
translation: 好吧...好吧，祝你有愉快的一天。 [hao ba ... hao ba ， zhu ni you yu kuai de yi tian 。]

english: *mumble*
translation: *咕哝* [* gu nong *]

english: If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 我要是像你那么丑我就不敢在大庭广众之下露脸了！ [wo yao shi xiang ni na me chou wo jiu bu gan zai da ting guang zhong zhi xia lou lian le ！]

english: Out of my way, punk.
translation: 别挡我的路，朋克。 [bie dang wo de lu ， peng ke 。]

english: Hmm... you smell strange...
translation: 嗯……你闻起来很奇怪…… [n …… ni wen qi lai hen qi guai ……]

english: Strange how?
translation: 奇怪怎么办？ [qi guai zen me ban ？]

english: Like a human!
translation: 像人一样！ [xiang ren yi yang ！]

english: Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 哦！呃……我刚吃了一个就是为什么！ [o ！ e …… wo gang chi le yi ge jiu shi wei shen me ！]

english: Leave me alone.
translation: 请别打扰我。 [qing bie da rao wo 。]

english: Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 如果你珍惜你的生命，就不要再跟我说话了！ [ru guo ni zhen xi ni de sheng ming ， jiu bu yao zai gen wo shuo hua le ！]

english: Get lost!
translation: 迷路！ [mi lu ！]

english: I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 我没有什么可以给你，所以让我一个人呆着吧，托钵僧。 [wo mei you shen me ke yi gei ni ， suo yi rang wo yi ge ren dai zhe ba ， tuo bo seng 。]

english: Have you no manners?
translation: 你没有礼貌吗？ [ni mei you li mao ma ？]

english: I don't have time for this right now.
translation: 我现在没有时间做这个。 [wo xian zai mei you shi jian zuo zhe ge 。]

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 我没有兴趣和像你这样的可怜虫说话。 [wo mei you xing qu he xiang ni zhe yang de ke lian chong shuo hua 。]

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
translation: 我打赌你有一双很棒的爪子。 [wo da du ni you yi shuang hen bang de zhua zi 。]

english: A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 非常痛苦的一天，总的来说……趁它持续的时候好好享受吧。 [fei chang tong ku de yi tian ， zong de lai shuo …… chen ta chi xu de shi hou hao hao xiang shou ba 。]

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: 如果你抓到任何人，答应我你会分享。 [ru guo ni zhua dao ren he ren ， da ying wo ni hui fen xiang 。]

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 我以前没在这儿闻过你的味道…… [wo yi qian mei zai zhe er wen guo ni de wei dao ……]

english: You smell familiar...
translation: 你闻起来很熟悉... [ni wen qi lai hen shu xi ...]

english: Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 看到这附近有人类吗？我饿了。 [kan dao zhe fu jin you ren lei ma ？ wo e le 。]

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 在我看来，你就像一个对血液有健康品味的人。 [zai wo kan lai ， ni jiu xiang yi ge dui xue ye you jian kang pin wei de ren 。]

english: Good day to you, my friend.
translation: 祝你美好的一天，我的朋友。 [zhu ni mei hao de yi tian ， wo de peng you 。]

english: Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
translation: 想去城堡吃点小吃吗？ [xiang qu cheng bao chi dian xiao chi ma ？]

english: Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: 等一下，我的牙齿里有一点东西卡住了…… [deng yi xia ， wo de ya chi li you yi dian dong xi ka zhu le ……]

english: Yessss, adventurer?
translation: 是的，冒险家？ [shi de ， mao xian jia ？]

english: You smell funky.
translation: 你闻起来很时髦。 [ni wen qi lai hen shi mao 。]

english: As do you, adventurer.
translation: 和你一样，冒险家。 [he ni yi yang ， mao xian jia 。]

english: How come you live with the lizardmen?
translation: 你怎么和蜥蜴人住在一起？ [ni zen me he xi yi ren zhu zai yi qi ？]

english: They are my sssaviours, I owe them my life.
translation: 他们是我的救星，我欠他们一条命。 [ta men shi wo de jiu xing ， wo qian ta men yi tiao ming 。]

english: What did they save you from? Is it to do with your eye?
translation: 他们救了你什么？和你眼睛有关系吗？ [ta men jiu le ni shen me ？ he ni yan jing you guan xi ma ？]

english: Why, yesss it isss... Many yearsss ago now. 30? 40? I've lost count.
translation: 为什么，是的，是的……很多年前了。 30？ 40？我已经数不清了。 [wei shen me ， shi de ， shi de …… hen duo nian qian le 。 30？ 40？ wo yi jing shu bu qing le 。]

english: I wasss a Captain of the Shayzien Army, Captain Reynard Koil, ssstationed up on Shayziens' wall.
translation: 我是 Shayzien 军队的上尉，Reynard Koil 上尉，驻扎在 Shayzien 的墙上。 [wo shi  Shayzien  jun dui de shang wei ，Reynard Koil  shang wei ， zhu zha zai  Shayzien  de qiang shang 。]

english: We were told to attack the lizardmen, for they were apparently attacking usss. I led the charge.
translation: 我们被告知要攻击蜥蜴人，因为他们显然是在攻击美国航空母舰。我带头冲锋。 [wo men bei gao zhi yao gong ji xi yi ren ， yin wei ta men xian ran shi zai gong ji mei guo hang kong mu jian 。 wo dai tou chong feng 。]

english: Apparently? Were they attacking?
translation: 显然？他们在攻击吗？ [xian ran ？ ta men zai gong ji ma ？]

english: Alasss, I took an arrow to the eye and missed the battle. I woke up here, worried for my life.
translation: 唉，我的眼​​睛中了一箭，错过了战斗。我在这里醒来，为自己的生命担心。 [ai ， wo de yan ​​ jing zhong le yi jian ， cuo guo le zhan dou 。 wo zai zhe li xing lai ， wei zi ji de sheng ming dan xin 。]

english: The lizardmen took you prisoner?
translation: 蜥蜴人俘虏了你？ [xi yi ren fu lu le ni ？]

english: At first, that isss what I thought, but they tended my woundsss and fed me well.
translation: 起初，我也是这么想的，但他们照顾了我的伤口，让我吃得很好。 [qi chu ， wo ye shi zhe me xiang de ， dan ta men zhao gu le wo de shang kou ， rang wo chi de hen hao 。]

english: I assssumed my people would come for me once they sssaw my body wasn't amongssst the dead, but they never did.
translation: 我以为我的人民一旦发现我的尸体不在死者之中就会来找我，但他们从来没有这样做。 [wo yi wei wo de ren min yi dan fa xian wo de shi ti bu zai si zhe zhi zhong jiu hui lai zhao wo ， dan ta men cong lai mei you zhe yang zuo 。]

english: Would the lizardmen let you leave?
translation: 蜥蜴人会让你离开吗？ [xi yi ren hui rang ni li kai ma ？]

english: Oh yesss, once my ssstrength returned, I went and ssspoke to the Shayzien Army.
translation: 哦，是的，一旦我的力量恢复，我就去和 Shayzien 军队交谈。 [o ， shi de ， yi dan wo de li liang hui fu ， wo jiu qu he  Shayzien  jun dui jiao tan 。]

english: ...And?
They thought I wasss a lizardman and fired arrowsss at me, ssso I returned here.
translation: 他们以为我是蜥蜴人，并向我发射了箭，所以我回到了这里。 [ta men yi wei wo shi xi yi ren ， bing xiang wo fa she le jian ， suo yi wo hui dao le zhe li 。]

english: What is that you're wearing?
translation: 你穿的是什么？ [ni chuan de shi shen me ？]

english: I found these in thisss shrine. I guesss they belonged to sssome long dead priest.
translation: 我在这座神社里找到了这些。我猜它们属于某个死去已久的牧师。 [wo zai zhe zuo shen she li zhao dao le zhe xie 。 wo cai ta men shu yu mou ge si qu yi jiu de mu shi 。]

english: What would a priest be doing in this gross swamp?
translation: 牧师会在这片肮脏的沼泽里做什么呢？ [mu shi hui zai zhe pian ang zang de zhao ze li zuo shen me ne ？]

english: This grossss ssswamp is my home. You sssure do ask a lot of questionsss, adventurer.
translation: 这个恶心的沼泽是我的家。你肯定会问很多问题，冒险家。 [zhe ge e xin de zhao ze shi wo de jia 。 ni ken ding hui wen hen duo wen ti ， mao xian jia 。]

english: What is the symbol on the shrine?
translation: 神社上的标志是什么？ [shen she shang de biao zhi shi shen me ？]

english: You do not recognissse it, adventurer? It would ssseem hissstory is written by the winnersss, for that isss the sssymbol of the Great Lord Xeric.
translation: 你不认识它吗，冒险家？他的故事似乎是由胜利者书写的，因为那是伟大的谢里克领主的象征。 [ni bu ren shi ta ma ， mao xian jia ？ ta de gu shi si hu shi you sheng li zhe shu xie de ， yin wei na shi wei da de xie li ke ling zhu de xiang zheng 。]

english: Or at leassst, that isss what the lizardmen tell me...
translation: 或者至少，蜥蜴人是这么告诉我的…… [huo zhe zhi shao ， xi yi ren shi zhe me gao su wo de ……]

english: Goodbye, swampy man.
translation: 再见，沼泽人。 [zai jian ， zhao ze ren 。]

english: Goodbye, adventurer.
translation: 再见，冒险家。 [zai jian ， mao xian jia 。]

english: Are you the 'Rey' this entry mentions?
translation: 您是本文提到的“雷伊”吗？ [nin shi ben wen ti dao de “ lei yi ” ma ？]

english: You show him 'The Fisher's Flute'.
translation: 你给他看了《渔夫的笛子》。 [ni gei ta kan le 《 yu fu de di zi 》。]

english: Oh, that wasss a lifetime ago... Sssuch a wonderful little one.
translation: 哦，那是上辈子以前的事了……真是一个很棒的小家伙。 [o ， na shi shang bei zi yi qian de shi le …… zhen shi yi ge hen bang de xiao jia huo 。]

english: So you've not seen her recently?
translation: 那么你最近没见过她吗？ [na me ni zui jin mei jian guo ta ma ？]

english: Lassst I heard, her mind had cracked. Her father died and...
translation: 我一听，她的心就崩溃了。她的父亲去世了，然后…… [wo yi ting ， ta de xin jiu beng kui le 。 ta de fu qin qu shi le ， ran hou ……]

english: And?
translation: 和？ [he ？]

english: Gone.
translation: 走了。 [zou le 。]

english: Oh, how mysterious.
translation: 噢，多么神秘啊。 [o ， duo me shen mi a 。]

english: You smell funky.
translation: 你闻起来很时髦。 [ni wen qi lai hen shi mao 。]

english: How come you live with the lizardmen?
translation: 你怎么和蜥蜴人住在一起？ [ni zen me he xi yi ren zhu zai yi qi ？]

english: What is that you're wearing?
translation: 你穿的是什么？ [ni chuan de shi shen me ？]

english: What is the symbol on the shrine?
translation: 神社上的标志是什么？ [shen she shang de biao zhi shi shen me ？]

english: Goodbye, swampy man.
translation: 再见，沼泽人。 [zai jian ， zhao ze ren 。]

english: Ribbit
translation: 兔子 [tu zi]

english: Croak
translation: 发牢骚 [fa lao sao]

english: You manage to catch the toad and inflate it with swamp gas.
translation: 你设法抓住蟾蜍并用沼气将其充气。 [ni she fa zhua zhu chan chu bing yong zhao qi jiang qi chong qi 。]

english: Come here toady!
translation: 今天就到这里来吧！ [jin tian jiu dao zhe li lai ba ！]

english: You add the bloated toad to your inventory.
translation: 您将肿胀的蟾蜍添加到您的库存中。 [nin jiang zhong zhang de chan chu tian jia dao nin de ku cun zhong 。]

english: One of your bloated toads manages to escape.
translation: 你的一只臃肿的蟾蜍成功逃脱了。 [ni de yi zhi yong zhong de chan chu cheng gong tao tuo le 。]

english: Ribbitt!
translation: 里比特！ [li bi te ！]

english: Hissss....
translation: 嘶嘶…… [si si ……]

english: The air seems too thin to stay in the toad.
translation: 空气似乎太稀薄，无法留在蟾蜍体内。 [kong qi si hu tai xi bo ， wu fa liu zai chan chu ti nei 。]

english: Perhaps you need something thicker than air.
translation: 也许你需要比空气更稠的东西。 [ye xu ni xu yao bi kong qi geng chou de dong xi 。]

english: You release the toad[s] and see [it/them] hop off into the distance.
translation: 你释放了蟾蜍，然后看到它/它们跳到远处。 [ni shi fang le chan chu ， ran hou kan dao ta / ta men tiao dao yuan chu 。]

english: Free the fatsy toady!
translation: 释放今天的胖子！ [shi fang jin tian de pang zi ！]

english: Ribbet!
translation: 肋骨！ [lei gu ！]

english: Croak!
translation: 发牢骚！ [fa lao sao ！]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Hello outerlander. This is my home, I would be grateful if you would leave.
translation: 外地人你好。这是我的家，如果你能离开我将不胜感激。 [wai di ren ni hao 。 zhe shi wo de jia ， ru guo ni neng li kai wo jiang bu sheng gan ji 。]

english: Oh. Okay.
translation: 哦。好的。 [o 。 hao de 。]

english: I am sorry outerlander, I will not offer you hospitality until my Chieftain has vouched for your honesty. This is our way.
translation: 对不起，外来者，在我的酋长保证你的诚实之前，我不会招待你。这是我们的方式。 [dui bu qi ， wai lai zhe ， zai wo de qiu zhang bao zheng ni de cheng shi zhi qian ， wo bu hui zhao dai ni 。 zhe shi wo men de fang shi 。]

english: I am trying to become a member of the Fremennik clan! The Chieftain told me that I may be able to gain your vote at the council of elders?
translation: 我正在努力成为弗雷曼尼克家族的一员！酋长告诉我，我也许可以在长老会议上获得你的投票？ [wo zheng zai nu li cheng wei fu lei man ni ke jia zu de yi yuan ！ qiu zhang gao su wo ， wo ye xu ke yi zai zhang lao hui yi shang huo de ni de tou piao ？]

english: You wish to stop being an outerlander? I can understand that! I have no reason why I would prevent you becoming a Fremennik...
translation: 你不想再做一个外地人吗？我能理解！我没有理由阻止你成为弗里曼尼克人...... [ni bu xiang zai zuo yi ge wai di ren ma ？ wo neng li jie ！ wo mei you li you zu zhi ni cheng wei fu li man ni ke ren ......]

english: ...but you must first pass a little test for me to prove you are worthy.
translation: ……不过你必须先通过我的一个小考验，才能证明你是值得的。 […… bu guo ni bi xu xian tong guo wo de yi ge xiao kao yan ， cai neng zheng ming ni shi zhi de de 。]

english: What kind of test?
translation: 什么样的测试？ [shen me yang de ce shi ？]

english: Well, I serve our clan as a navigator. The seas can be a fearful place when you know not where you are heading.
translation: 嗯，我作为导航员为我们的部落服务。当您不知道自己要去哪里时，海洋可能是一个可怕的地方。 [n ， wo zuo wei dao hang yuan wei wo men de bu luo fu wu 。 dang nin bu zhi dao zi ji yao qu na li shi ， hai yang ke neng shi yi ge ke pa de di fang 。]

english: Should something happen to me, all members of our tribe have some basic sense of direction so that they may always return safely home.
translation: 如果我出了什么事，我们部落的所有成员都有一些基本的方向感，这样他们总能安全回家。 [ru guo wo chu le shen me shi ， wo men bu luo de suo you cheng yuan dou you yi xie ji ben de fang xiang gan ， zhe yang ta men zong neng an quan hui jia 。]

english: If you are able to demonstrate to me that you too have a good sense of direction then I will recommend you to the rest of the council of elders immediately.
translation: 如果你能够向我证明你也有良好的方向感，那么我会立即将你推荐给长老会的其他成员。 [ru guo ni neng gou xiang wo zheng ming ni ye you liang hao de fang xiang gan ， na me wo hui li ji jiang ni tui jian gei zhang lao hui de qi ta cheng yuan 。]

english: Well, how would I go about showing that?
translation: 那么，我该如何展示呢？ [na me ， wo gai ru he zhan shi ne ？]

english: Ah, a simple task! Below this building I have constructed a maze; should you be able to walk from one side to the other that will be proof to me.
translation: 啊，一个简单的任务！我在这栋楼下面建造了一个迷宫；你是否能够从一侧走到另一侧，这对我来说就是证据。 [a ， yi ge jian dan de ren wu ！ wo zai zhe dong lou xia mian jian zao le yi ge mi gong ； ni shi fou neng gou cong yi ce zou dao ling yi ce ， zhe dui wo lai shuo jiu shi zheng ju 。]

english: You wish to try my challenge?
translation: 你想尝试我的挑战吗？ [ni xiang chang shi wo de tiao zhan ma ？]

english: A maze? Is that all? Sure, it sounds simple enough.
translation: 迷宫？这就是全部吗？当然，这听起来很简单。 [mi gong ？ zhe jiu shi quan bu ma ？ dang ran ， zhe ting qi lai hen jian dan 。]

english: I will warn you outerlander, this maze was designed by myself, and is of the most fiendish complexity!
translation: 我警告你外乡人，这个迷宫是我自己设计的，而且极其复杂！ [wo jing gao ni wai xiang ren ， zhe ge mi gong shi wo zi ji she ji de ， er qie ji qi fu za ！]

english: Oh really? Watch and learn...
translation: 哦真的吗？观看并学习... [o zhen de ma ？ guan kan bing xue xi ...]

english: No thanks. I think I can get someone else to vouch for me to the council of elders, without going through a stupid maze like some lab rat.
translation: 不，谢谢。我想我可以让其他人在长老会议上为我提供担保，而不必像实验老鼠那样经历愚蠢的迷宫。 [bu ， xie xie 。 wo xiang wo ke yi rang qi ta ren zai zhang lao hui yi shang wei wo ti gong dan bao ， er bu bi xiang shi yan lao shu na yang jing li yu chun de mi gong 。]

english: Well, I am sorry you feel that way outerlander. I cannot vouch for you until you prove to me you have some skill that will benefit our clan somehow.
translation: 好吧，我很抱歉你有这样的感觉，外地人。在你向我证明你拥有某种能让我们部落受益的技能之前，我无法为你提供担保。 [hao ba ， wo hen bao qian ni you zhe yang de gan jue ， wai di ren 。 zai ni xiang wo zheng ming ni yong you mou zhong neng rang wo men bu luo shou yi de ji neng zhi qian ， wo wu fa wei ni ti gong dan bao 。]

english: What exactly is a 'lab rat' anyway?
translation: 到底什么是“实验室老鼠”？ [dao di shen me shi “ shi yan shi lao shu ”？]

english: Ah, forget it.
translation: 啊，算了。 [a ， suan le 。]

english: Have you no manners outerlander? This is my home, you will show me the due respect!
translation: 你是外地人没有礼貌吗？这是我的家，你要给予我应有的尊重！ [ni shi wai di ren mei you li mao ma ？ zhe shi wo de jia ， ni yao ji yu wo ying you de zun zhong ！]

english: Erm.... sorry I guess.
translation: 呃……抱歉，我想。 [e …… bao qian ， wo xiang 。]

english: Man, your maze is pretty tough!
translation: 老兄，你的迷宫可真难啊！ [lao xiong ， ni de mi gong ke zhen nan a ！]

english: Hahahaha it is the most complex route I have ever devised! I am truly a genius at navigation! The world will remember my name!
translation: 哈哈哈哈这是我设计过的最复杂的路线！我真是导航天才！世界会记住我的名字！ [ha ha ha ha zhe shi wo she ji guo de zui fu za de lu xian ！ wo zhen shi dao hang tian cai ！ shi jie hui ji zhu wo de ming zi ！]

english: Can't I do something else for your vote at the council of elders?
translation: 我不能为你在长老会议上的投票做点别的事吗？ [wo bu neng wei ni zai zhang lao hui yi shang de tou piao zuo dian bie de shi ma ？]

english: No, you cannot. It is my maze, or nothing.
translation: 不，你不能。这是我的迷宫，或者什么都不是。 [bu ， ni bu neng 。 zhe shi wo de mi gong ， huo zhe shen me dou bu shi 。]

english: Decided you could not solve my labyrinth after all, did you outerlander? Too tricky for you?
translation: 认为你终究无法解决我的迷宫，你是外来者吗？对你来说太棘手了吗？ [ren wei ni zhong jiu wu fa jie jue wo de mi gong ， ni shi wai lai zhe ma ？ dui ni lai shuo tai ji shou le ma ？]

english: Yeah, it is really confusing down there...
translation: 是啊，下面确实很混乱…… [shi a ， xia mian que shi hen hun luan ……]

english: Hahaha! Don't worry outerlander, you are not the first to fail its puzzle!
translation: 哈哈哈！别担心，外地人，你不是第一个失败的人！ [ha ha ha ！ bie dan xin ， wai di ren ， ni bu shi di yi ge shi bai de ren ！]

english: Outerlander! You have finished my maze! I am genuinely impressed!
translation: 外地人！你已经完成了我的迷宫！我真的很感动！ [wai di ren ！ ni yi jing wan cheng le wo de mi gong ！ wo zhen de hen gan dong ！]

english: So does that mean I can rely on your vote at the council of elders to allow me into your village?
translation: 那么这是否意味着我可以依靠你在长老会议上的投票来允许我进入你的村庄？ [na me zhe shi fou yi wei zhe wo ke yi yi kao ni zai zhang lao hui yi shang de tou piao lai yun xu wo jin ru ni de cun zhuang ？]

english: Of course outerlander! I am nothing if not a man of my word!
translation: 当然是外地人啦！如果不是一个守信用的人，我什么都不是！ [dang ran shi wai di ren la ！ ru guo bu shi yi ge shou xin yong de ren ， wo shen me dou bu shi ！]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: Greetings again outerlander! I must say, I am still impressed with the way you moved through my maze!
translation: 再次问候外地人！我必须说，你穿过迷宫的方式给我留下了深刻的印象！ [zai ci wen hou wai di ren ！ wo bi xu shuo ， ni chuan guo mi gong de fang shi gei wo liu xia le shen ke de yin xiang ！]

english: Thanks. So I can rely on your vote in my favour at the council of elders?
translation: 谢谢。那么我可以相信你在长老会议上对我投了赞成票吗？ [xie xie 。 na me wo ke yi xiang xin ni zai zhang lao hui yi shang dui wo tou le zan cheng piao ma ？]

english: Absolutely! You will be an asset to the clan!
translation: 绝对地！你将成为部落的财富！ [jue dui di ！ ni jiang cheng wei bu luo de cai fu ！]

english: No way am I doing that maze again!
translation: 我绝对不会再去那个迷宫了！ [wo jue dui bu hui zai qu na ge mi gong le ！]

english: Greetings outerlander.
translation: 问候外地人。 [wen hou wai di ren 。]

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a map of deep sea fishing spots do you?
translation: 我想你不知道在哪里可以找到深海钓鱼点的地图，对吧？ [wo xiang ni bu zhi dao zai na li ke yi zhao dao shen hai diao yu dian de di tu ， dui ba ？]

english: Hmmm? Why of course! As the navigator for the Fremennik I keep all of our maps secure right here.
translation: 嗯？为什么当然！作为弗雷曼尼克号的领航员，我将所有地图都安全地保存在这里。 [n ？ wei shen me dang ran ！ zuo wei fu lei man ni ke hao de ling hang yuan ， wo jiang suo you di tu dou an quan di bao cun zai zhe li 。]

english: Great! Can I have it?
translation: 伟大的！我可以拥有吗？ [wei da de ！ wo ke yi yong you ma ？]

english: Have it? Just like that? I think not outerlander. This map shows all of the prime fishing locations nearby.
translation: 有吗？就这样吗？我觉得不是外地人。该地图显示了附近所有主要钓鱼地点。 [you ma ？ jiu zhe yang ma ？ wo jue de bu shi wai di ren 。 gai di tu xian shi le fu jin suo you zhu yao diao yu di dian 。]

english: It is very valuable to our clan. I am afraid I can not just give it away.
translation: 这对我们部落来说非常有价值。恐怕我不能就这样放弃它。 [zhe dui wo men bu luo lai shuo fei chang you jia zhi 。 kong pa wo bu neng jiu zhe yang fang qi ta 。]

english: Perhaps I can trade you something for it?
translation: 也许我可以用一些东西来交换你？ [ye xu wo ke yi yong yi xie dong xi lai jiao huan ni ？]

english: A trade? For a map of the best fishing spots in a hundred leagues? I will trade it for no less than a weather forecast from our Seer.
translation: 交易？想要一张一百联盟内最佳钓鱼点的地图吗？我愿意用它来换取我们先知的天气预报。 [jiao yi ？ xiang yao yi zhang yi bai lian meng nei zui jia diao yu dian de di tu ma ？ wo yuan yi yong ta lai huan qu wo men xian zhi de tian qi yu bao 。]

english: As a navigator, the weather is extremely important for plotting the best course. Unfortunately the Seer is always too busy to help me with a forecast.
translation: 作为航海家，天气对于规划最佳航向极其重要。不幸的是，预言家总是太忙，无法帮助我预测。 [zuo wei hang hai jia ， tian qi dui yu gui hua zui jia hang xiang ji qi zhong yao 。 bu xing de shi ， yu yan jia zong shi tai mang ， wu fa bang zhu wo yu ce 。]

english: Where could I get a weather forecast from then?
translation: 我从哪里可以得到天气预报？ [wo cong na li ke yi de dao tian qi yu bao ？]

english: I just told you: from the Seer. You will need to persuade him to take the time to make a forecast somehow.
translation: 我刚刚告诉过你：来自先知。您需要说服他花时间以某种方式做出预测。 [wo gang gang gao su guo ni ： lai zi xian zhi 。 nin xu yao shuo fu ta hua shi jian yi mou zhong fang shi zuo chu yu ce 。]

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a weather forecast from the Fremennik Seer do you?
translation: 我想你不知道在哪里可以找到 Fremennik Seer 的天气预报，对吗？ [wo xiang ni bu zhi dao zai na li ke yi zhao dao  Fremennik Seer  de tian qi yu bao ， dui ma ？]

english: Uh... from the Seer perhaps?
translation: 呃……也许是来自先知？ [e …… ye xu shi lai zi xian zhi ？]

english: I would like your map of fishing spots.
translation: 我想要你的钓鱼点地图。 [wo xiang yao ni de diao yu dian di tu 。]

english: I have already told you outerlander; I will not exchange it for anything other than a divination on the weather from our seer himself!
translation: 我已经告诉过你外乡人了；除了我们的预言家本人对天气的占卜之外，我不会用它来交换任何东西！ [wo yi jing gao su guo ni wai xiang ren le ； chu le wo men de yu yan jia ben ren dui tian qi de zhan bu zhi wai ， wo bu hui yong ta lai jiao huan ren he dong xi ！]

english: What, like this one I have here?
translation: 什么，就像我这里的这个一样？ [shen me ， jiu xiang wo zhe li de zhe ge yi yang ？]

english: W-what...? I don't believe it! How did you...? I suppose it doesn't matter, you have my gratitude outerlander!
translation: 什、什么……？我不相信！你怎么...?我想没关系，我很感激你，外地人！ [shen 、 shen me ……？ wo bu xiang xin ！ ni zen me ...? wo xiang mei guan xi ， wo hen gan ji ni ， wai di ren ！]

english: With this forecast I will be able to plan a safe course for our next raiding expedition!
translation: 有了这个预测，我就能为我们的下一次袭击探险计划一个安全的路线！ [you le zhe ge yu ce ， wo jiu neng wei wo men de xia yi ci xi ji tan xian ji hua yi ge an quan de lu xian ！]

english: Here, outerlander; you may take my map of local fishing patterns with my gratitude!
translation: 在这里，外地人；您可以拿走我的当地捕鱼模式地图，以表谢意！ [zai zhe li ， wai di ren ； nin ke yi na zou wo di dang di bu yu mo shi di tu ， yi biao xie yi ！]

english: If this map of fishing spots is so valuable, why did you give it away to me so easily?
translation: 如果这张钓鱼点图这么值钱，你为什么这么轻易就送给我了？ [ru guo zhe zhang diao yu dian tu zhe me zhi qian ， ni wei shen me zhe me qing yi jiu song gei wo le ？]

english: Hmmm? Well, firstly it will be of value to our entire clan, so I have lost nothing from giving it to you.
translation: 嗯？嗯，首先它对我们整个家族都有价值，所以我把它送给你并没有什么损失。 [n ？ n ， shou xian ta dui wo men zheng ge jia zu dou you jia zhi ， suo yi wo ba ta song gei ni bing mei you shen me sun shi 。]

english: The other reason is of course that I have already memorised it, so I can make myself another copy whenever I want!
translation: 另一个原因当然是我已经背下来了，想什么时候再给自己复印一份就可以了！ [ling yi ge yuan yin dang ran shi wo yi jing bei xia lai le ， xiang shen me shi hou zai gei zi ji fu yin yi fen jiu ke yi le ！]

english: Greetings to you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! How fare you today?
translation: 问候你[兄弟/姐妹][弗雷曼尼克名字]！今天过得怎么样？ [wen hou ni [ xiong di / jie mei ][ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]！ jin tian guo de zen me yang ？]

english: I am fine thanks Swensen. How are you doing?
translation: 我很好，谢谢斯文森。你好吗？ [wo hen hao ， xie xie si wen sen 。 ni hao ma ？]

english: I am fine too!
translation: 我也很好啊！ [wo ye hen hao a ！]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Ask about the Merchant's trial
translation: 询问商家试用情况 [xun wen shang jia shi yong qing kuang]

english: Ask about becoming a Fremennik
translation: 询问成为 Fremennik 的问题 [xun wen cheng wei  Fremennik  de wen ti]

english: Hello Sylas.
translation: 你好塞拉斯。 [ni hao sai la si 。]

english: Ah, [player name]! Good to see you again.
translation: 啊，[玩家姓名]！很高兴再次见到你。 [a ，[ wan jia xing ming ]！ hen gao xing zai ci jian dao ni 。]

english: How is the collection going now?
translation: 现在征集进展如何？ [xian zai zheng ji jin zhan ru he ？]

english: Thanks to you finding the golden goblin for me, I am the envy of the collector's group. I can't thank you enough.
translation: 感谢您为我找到了金妖精，我是收藏界羡慕的对象。我对你感激不尽。 [gan xie nin wei wo zhao dao le jin yao jing ， wo shi shou cang jie xian mu de dui xiang 。 wo dui ni gan ji bu jin 。]

english: I think I've lost Rupert's helmet.
translation: 我想我丢了鲁珀特的头盔。 [wo xiang wo diu le lu po te de tou kui 。]

english: Not to worry, [player name] Go and speak to Rupert. These items have a strange way of returning to their owners sometimes!
translation: 别担心，[玩家姓名]去和鲁珀特谈谈。有时这些物品会以一种奇怪的方式回到它们的主人身边！ [bie dan xin ，[ wan jia xing ming ] qu he lu po te tan tan 。 you shi zhe xie wu pin hui yi yi zhong qi guai de fang shi hui dao ta men de zhu ren shen bian ！]

english: Ok, I will. Thanks.
translation: 好的，我会的。谢谢。 [hao de ， wo hui de 。 xie xie 。]

english: No, no. Thanks for everything you've done!
translation: 不，不。感谢你所做的一切！ [bu ， bu 。 gan xie ni suo zuo de yi qie ！]

english: I'm just happy that I could help. Goodbye!
translation: 我很高兴我能提供帮助。再见！ [wo hen gao xing wo neng ti gong bang zhu 。 zai jian ！]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Selling Magic Beans!
translation: 卖魔豆！ [mai mo dou ！]

english: You there, you look like you could use some beans!
translation: 你在那里，看起来你可以用一些豆子！ [ni zai na li ， kan qi lai ni ke yi yong yi xie dou zi ！]

english: All beans must go!
translation: 所有的豆子都必须走！ [suo you de dou zi dou bi xu zou ！]

english: Buy 1 bean get a bean free!
translation: 买 1 颗豆子送 1 颗豆子！ [mai  1  ke dou zi song  1  ke dou zi ！]

english: Selling bags of Magic Beans!
translation: 卖袋装魔豆！ [mai dai zhuang mo dou ！]

english: Excuse me, human! Perhaps you shouldn't just go wandering through there without knowing what you're dealing with!
translation: 对不起，人类！也许你不应该在不知道自己在面对什么的情况下就在那里闲逛！ [dui bu qi ， ren lei ！ ye xu ni bu ying gai zai bu zhi dao zi ji zai mian dui shen me de qing kuang xia jiu zai na li xian guang ！]

english: Hello! Are you the leader of this expedition?
translation: 你好！你是这次探险的领队吗？ [ni hao ！ ni shi zhe ci tan xian de ling dui ma ？]

english: Indeed I am, human! What's on your mind?
translation: 确实，我是人类！你在想什么？ [que shi ， wo shi ren lei ！ ni zai xiang shen me ？]

english: What's going on here?
translation: 这是怎么回事？ [zhe shi zen me hui shi ？]

english: Well, the Hueycoatl has awoken.
translation: 嗯，休伊科特尔已经苏醒了。 [n ， xiu yi ke te er yi jing su xing le 。]

english: The Huey- what?
translation: 休伊——什么？ [xiu yi —— shen me ？]

english: Huey-co-at... oh, I don't have time for this! The thing you need to know is that it's dangerous and it's coiled throughout this entire mountain!
translation: Huey-co-at...哦，我没有时间！你需要知道的是，它很危险，而且它盘绕在整座山上！ [Huey-co-at... o ， wo mei you shi jian ！ ni xu yao zhi dao de shi ， ta hen wei xian ， er qie ta pan rao zai zheng zuo shan shang ！]

english: Do you know where it came from?
translation: 你知道它是从哪里来的吗？ [ni zhi dao ta shi cong na li lai de ma ？]

english: We're not sure. There are some records of our ancestors having dealings with it, but the details have been lost, assuming they were ever recorded.
translation: 我们不确定。有一些关于我们的祖先与它打交道的记录，但假设它们曾经被记录过，那么细节已经丢失了。 [wo men bu que ding 。 you yi xie guan yu wo men de zu xian yu ta da jiao dao de ji lu ， dan jia she ta men ceng jing bei ji lu guo ， na me xi jie yi jing diu shi le 。]

english: So it's old?
translation: 所以就老了？ [suo yi jiu lao le ？]

english: Does it really matter how old it is?
translation: 年龄有多大真的很重要吗？ [nian ling you duo da zhen de hen zhong yao ma ？]

english: I suppose not. I guess I just want to get a better understanding of what this thing is.
translation: 我想不会。我想我只是想更好地了解这件事是什么。 [wo xiang bu hui 。 wo xiang wo zhi shi xiang geng hao di liao jie zhe jian shi shi shen me 。]

english: We don't know how old it is. It could be extremely old, or this could be just one in a lineage of them. Still, we haven't heard of any others so maybe it is some sort of ancient creature.
translation: 我们不知道它有多少岁了。它可能非常古老，也可能只是其中的一个。不过，我们还没有听说过任何其他生物，所以也许它是某种古老的生物。 [wo men bu zhi dao ta you duo shao sui le 。 ta ke neng fei chang gu lao ， ye ke neng zhi shi qi zhong de yi ge 。 bu guo ， wo men hai mei you ting shuo guo ren he qi ta sheng wu ， suo yi ye xu ta shi mou zhong gu lao de sheng wu 。]

english: And given that you're here, I assume it poses some sort of threat?
translation: 鉴于你在这里，我认为它构成了某种威胁？ [jian yu ni zai zhe li ， wo ren wei ta gou cheng le mou zhong wei xie ？]

english: Now you're getting it! While it doesn't seem to be innately aggressive, our concern is the potential risk of it tunnelling into Cam Torum.
translation: 现在你明白了！虽然它似乎并不具有天生的攻击性，但我们担心它侵入 Cam Torum 的潜在风险。 [xian zai ni ming bai le ！ sui ran ta si hu bing bu ju you tian sheng de gong ji xing ， dan wo men dan xin ta qin ru  Cam Torum  de qian zai feng xian 。]

english: Oh, and given that it does lash out from time to time, I suppose it does pose a threat to your nearby human villages. A lesser priority for us, but maybe something for you to care about.
translation: 哦，考虑到它确实时不时地猛烈攻击，我想它确实对你们附近的人类村庄构成了威胁。对我们来说，这是一个次要的优先事项，但也许是您需要关心的事情。 [o ， kao lv dao ta que shi shi bu shi di meng lie gong ji ， wo xiang ta que shi dui ni men fu jin de ren lei cun zhuang gou cheng le wei xie 。 dui wo men lai shuo ， zhe shi yi ge ci yao de you xian shi xiang ， dan ye xu shi nin xu yao guan xin de shi qing 。]

english: Anyway, for now, our only option is to keep it in check while we figure out what to do in the long term.
translation: 无论如何，目前我们唯一的选择是在我们弄清楚长期要做什么的同时对其进行控制。 [wu lun ru he ， mu qian wo men wei yi de xuan ze shi zai wo men nong qing chu chang qi yao zuo shen me de tong shi dui qi jin xing kong zhi 。]

english: Unfortunately, that means recruiting all the help we can get, even from you humans...
translation: 不幸的是，这意味着我们需要招募所有我们能得到的帮助，甚至来自你们人类…… [bu xing de shi ， zhe yi wei zhe wo men xu yao zhao mu suo you wo men neng de dao de bang zhu ， shen zhi lai zi ni men ren lei ……]

english: How can I help?
translation: 我能提供什么帮助吗？ [wo neng ti gong shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: Well, despite what some of us may think of your kind, we need all the help we can get.
translation: 好吧，不管我们中的一些人对你们的看法如何，我们都需要我们能得到的所有帮助。 [hao ba ， bu guan wo men zhong de yi xie ren dui ni men de kan fa ru he ， wo men dou xu yao wo men neng de dao de suo you bang zhu 。]

english: Well, as you've already proven yourself useful to Cam Torum, I'd be glad to have you help here!
translation: 好吧，既然你已经证明自己对 Cam Torum 有用，我很高兴能在这里得到你的帮助！ [hao ba ， ji ran ni yi jing zheng ming zi ji dui  Cam Torum  you yong ， wo hen gao xing neng zai zhe li de dao ni de bang zhu ！]

english: However, I'm not sure you have enough combat experience to face the Hueycoatl.
translation: 然而，我不确定你是否有足够的战斗经验来面对休伊科特尔。 [ran er ， wo bu que ding ni shi fou you zu gou de zhan dou jing yan lai mian dui xiu yi ke te er 。]

english: To face the Hueycoatl, it's recommended you have a combat level of 85 and a Prayer level of 43.
translation: 面对Hueycoatl，建议你的战斗等级为85，祈祷等级为43。 [mian dui Hueycoatl， jian yi ni de zhan dou deng ji wei 85， qi dao deng ji wei 43。]

english: We need to keep the Hueycoatl under control which, until we find a more permanent solution, means wearing it out through combat.
translation: 我们需要控制休伊科特尔，在我们找到更持久的解决方案之前，这意味着在战斗中磨损它。 [wo men xu yao kong zhi xiu yi ke te er ， zai wo men zhao dao geng chi jiu de jie jue fang an zhi qian ， zhe yi wei zhe zai zhan dou zhong mo sun ta 。]

english: Don't go killing it, mind you! Not that I think you could, but such a magnificent creature doesn't deserve destruction.
translation: 请注意，别去杀它！我不认为你可以，但这样一个伟大的生物不值得被毁灭。 [qing zhu yi ， bie qu sha ta ！ wo bu ren wei ni ke yi ， dan zhe yang yi ge wei da de sheng wu bu zhi de bei hui mie 。]

english: Do you have any tips for surviving?
translation: 你有什么生存秘诀吗？ [ni you shen me sheng cun mi jue ma ？]

english: We've found our prayers can protect us from its shards, so keep an eye out for those.
translation: 我们发现我们的祈祷可以保护我们免受其碎片的伤害，所以请留意那些碎片。 [wo men fa xian wo men de qi dao ke yi bao hu wo men mian shou qi sui pian de shang hai ， suo yi qing liu yi na xie sui pian 。]

english: To reach the Hueycoatl's head, you'll need to get it to move its great body out of the way. We've found we can persuade it by giving the exposed parts a helpful nudge!
translation: 要到达休伊科特尔的头部，你需要让它把巨大的身体移开。我们发现我们可以通过轻推暴露的部分来说服它！ [yao dao da xiu yi ke te er de tou bu ， ni xu yao rang ta ba ju da de shen ti yi kai 。 wo men fa xian wo men ke yi tong guo qing tui bao lu de bu fen lai shuo fu ta ！]

english: Once you reach its head, you'll need to work with your comrades and the seer to balance your prayers and weaken the beast.
translation: 一旦你到达它的头部，你需要与你的战友和预言家合作来平衡你的祈祷并削弱这头野兽。 [yi dan ni dao da ta de tou bu ， ni xu yao yu ni de zhan you he yu yan jia he zuo lai ping heng ni de qi dao bing xue ruo zhe tou ye shou 。]

english: But I'm sure you'll figure it out!
translation: 但我相信你会明白的！ [dan wo xiang xin ni hui ming bai de ！]

english: Move the body, then attack the head while keeping prayers balanced. Got it!
translation: 移动身体，然后攻击头部，同时保持祈祷的平衡。知道了！ [yi dong shen ti ， ran hou gong ji tou bu ， tong shi bao chi qi dao de ping heng 。 zhi dao le ！]

english: What's on your mind, human?
translation: 人类，你在想什么？ [ren lei ， ni zai xiang shen me ？]

english: Remind me, what's going on here?
translation: 提醒我，这里发生了什么事？ [ti xing wo ， zhe li fa sheng le shen me shi ？]

english: Are there any rewards for helping?
translation: 帮忙有奖励吗？ [bang mang you jiang li ma ？]

english: Ugh, you greedy humans.
translation: 唉，你们这些贪婪的人类。 [ai ， ni men zhe xie tan lan de ren lei 。]

english: The Hueycoatl displaces a lot of materials as it moves, including all sorts of items and treasures.
translation: 休伊科特尔号在移动时会取代许多材料，包括各种物品和宝藏。 [xiu yi ke te er hao zai yi dong shi hui qu dai xu duo cai liao ， bao kuo ge zhong wu pin he bao zang 。]

english: We collect as much as we can, so I suppose you can have a share for helping.
translation: 我们会尽可能多地收集，所以我想你也可以分享一份以提供帮助。 [wo men hui jin ke neng duo di shou ji ， suo yi wo xiang ni ye ke yi fen xiang yi fen yi ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: That sounds good, thank you.
translation: 听起来不错，谢谢。 [ting qi lai bu cuo ， xie xie 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Bye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Remind me, what's going on here?
translation: 提醒我，这里发生了什么事？ [ti xing wo ， zhe li fa sheng le shen me shi ？]

english: How can I help?
translation: 我能提供什么帮助吗？ [wo neng ti gong shen me bang zhu ma ？]

english: Are there any rewards for helping?
translation: 帮忙有奖励吗？ [bang mang you jiang li ma ？]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Hi, my name is [player name]. What's wi...
translation: 你好，我的名字是[玩家姓名]。什么是... [ni hao ， wo de ming zi shi [ wan jia xing ming ]。 shen me shi ...]

english: I not be in the mood t' talk, sorry. If ye need anythin', talk to Cap'ain Pudi over by the dock.
translation: 我没心情说话，抱歉。如果您需要任何东西，请与码头旁的普迪船长交谈。 [wo mei xin qing shuo hua ， bao qian 。 ru guo nin xu yao ren he dong xi ， qing yu ma tou pang de pu di chuan zhang jiao tan 。]

english: I cannot believe that beast ruined me ship.
translation: 我不敢相信那只野兽毁了我的船。 [wo bu gan xiang xin na zhi ye shou hui le wo de chuan 。]

english: What happened to your ship?
translation: 你的船怎么了？ [ni de chuan zen me le ？]

english: Was awful, me crew an' I were out on our fortnightly fishin' excursion. We set sail from Al Kharid t' the deep-sea fishin' spot we usually use.
translation: 太糟糕了，我的船员们和我出去参加我们每两周一次的钓鱼之旅。我们从 Al Kharid 起航前往我们通常使用的深海钓鱼点。 [tai zao gao le ， wo de chuan yuan men he wo chu qu can jia wo men mei liang zhou yi ci de diao yu zhi lv 。 wo men cong  Al Kharid  qi hang qian wang wo men tong chang shi yong de shen hai diao yu dian 。]

english: Was nothin' but smooth sailin' all the way, we got t' the spot an' started fishin'.
translation: 一路上一帆风​​顺，我们到达了地点并开始钓鱼。 [yi lu shang yi fan feng ​​ shun ， wo men dao da le di dian bing kai shi diao yu 。]

english: Sounds like a normal day of fishing to me.
translation: 对我来说听起来像是正常的钓鱼日。 [dui wo lai shuo ting qi lai xiang shi zheng chang de diao yu ri 。]

english: Aye, I s'pose it was. After a few days, the crew an' I sailed further t' the Karamjan coast t' catch some sharks. More plunder from sellin' sharks.
translation: 是的，我想是的。几天后，我和船员们航行到卡拉姆詹海岸更远的地方，捕捉了一些鲨鱼。更多来自贩卖鲨鱼的掠夺品。 [shi de ， wo xiang shi de 。 ji tian hou ， wo he chuan yuan men hang xing dao ka la mu zhan hai an geng yuan de di fang ， bu zhuo le yi xie sha yu 。 geng duo lai zi fan mai sha yu de lve duo pin 。]

english: While sailin', I noticed there was more debris than usual. Koanee said there must have been a storm recently.
translation: 航行时，我注意到碎片比平时更多。 Koanee 说最近一定有暴风雨。 [hang xing shi ， wo zhu yi dao sui pian bi ping shi geng duo 。 Koanee  shuo zui jin yi ding you bao feng yu 。]

english: How did she know that?
translation: 她怎么知道的？ [ta zen me zhi dao de ？]

english: Koanee is in charge of plottin' a course t' our destination an' watchin' the weather. I thought she was good at her job.
translation: Koanee 负责规划前往目的地的路线并观察天气。我认为她很擅长她的工作。 [Koanee  fu ze gui hua qian wang mu di di de lu xian bing guan cha tian qi 。 wo ren wei ta hen shan chang ta de gong zuo 。]

english: We got to our final fishin' spot an' Lauretta let down the net. Almost a whole day went by an' we still 'ad not caught any fish.
translation: 我们到达了最后的钓鱼点，劳雷塔下了网。几乎一整天过去了，我们仍然没有钓到任何鱼。 [wo men dao da le zui hou de diao yu dian ， lao lei ta xia le wang 。 ji hu yi zheng tian guo qu le ， wo men reng ran mei you diao dao ren he yu 。]

english: In fact, I could not see any fish in the waters at all. Such a strange sight.
translation: 事实上，我在水域里根本看不到任何鱼。真是奇怪的景象。 [shi shi shang ， wo zai shui yu li gen ben kan bu dao ren he yu 。 zhen shi qi guai de jing xiang 。]

english: Not even bass?
translation: 连低音都没有吗？ [lian di yin dou mei you ma ？]

english: Nothin'. We decided t' pack it in for the day an' I told Koanee t' leave the nets down, hoping we would catch some fish overnight.
translation: 没什么。我们决定把今天的鱼收起来，我告诉科阿尼不要撒网，希望我们能在一夜之间抓到一些鱼。 [mei shen me 。 wo men jue ding ba jin tian de yu shou qi lai ， wo gao su ke a ni bu yao sa wang ， xi wang wo men neng zai yi ye zhi jian zhua dao yi xie yu 。]

english: That sounds like a bad idea. What would have happened if your net got too full or your ship started drifting and the net got caught on some rocks?
translation: 这听起来是个坏主意。如果你的网太满或者你的船开始漂流并且网被一些岩石卡住了，会发生什么？ [zhe ting qi lai shi ge huai zhu yi 。 ru guo ni de wang tai man huo zhe ni de chuan kai shi piao liu bing qie wang bei yi xie yan shi ka zhu le ， hui fa sheng shen me ？]

english: 'Twas a risk we 'ad to take t' catch some fish.
translation: 我们要冒着风险去抓一些鱼。 [wo men yao mao zhe feng xian qu zhua yi xie yu 。]

english: The next day Koanee woke me up t' tell me a storm was on the horizon, so we lifted the anchor up an' adjusted our course.
translation: 第二天，Koanee 叫醒我，告诉我风暴即将来临，所以我们起锚并调整了航线。 [di er tian ，Koanee  jiao xing wo ， gao su wo feng bao ji jiang lai lin ， suo yi wo men qi mao bing tiao zheng le hang xian 。]

english: Not sure what she was playing at with that decision, but out o' nowhere winds started t' change an' the storm was headin' in our direction, we couldn't outrun it.
translation: 不知道她做出这个决定有何用意，但风不知从何而来开始改变，风暴正朝我们的方向袭来，我们无法逃脱。 [bu zhi dao ta zuo chu zhe ge jue ding you he yong yi ， dan feng bu zhi cong he er lai kai shi gai bian ， feng bao zheng chao wo men de fang xiang xi lai ， wo men wu fa tao tuo 。]

english: 'Twas also too dangerous to anchor down, so we 'ad to weather it.
translation: “抛锚也太危险了，所以我们必须渡过难关。” [“ pao mao ye tai wei xian le ， suo yi wo men bi xu du guo nan guan 。”]

english: Thick fog rolled in, giant waves crashin' against the ship's hull. So much lightnin', it felt like Saradomin was angry with us.
translation: 浓雾滚滚而来，巨浪拍打着船体。如此多的闪电，感觉萨拉多明在生我们的气。 [nong wu gun gun er lai ， ju lang pai da zhe chuan ti 。 ru ci duo de shan dian ， gan jue sa la duo ming zai sheng wo men de qi 。]

english: The lightnin' struck our sails, settin' them ablaze despite the 'eavy rain!
translation: 闪电击中了我们的船帆，尽管下着大雨，但它们还是被点燃了！ [shan dian ji zhong le wo men de chuan fan ， jin guan xia zhe da yu ， dan ta men hai shi bei dian ran le ！]

english: The last thing I see is glowin' fish an' a monster in the distance with a twisted face. Next thing I know, I'm lying on the shore just south of Al Kharid with Pudi waving a kebab in me face!
translation: 我最后看到的就是远处发光的鱼和一个面孔扭曲的怪物。接下来我知道，我躺在阿尔卡里德以南的海岸上，普迪在我脸上挥舞着烤肉串！ [wo zui hou kan dao de jiu shi yuan chu fa guang de yu he yi ge mian kong niu qu de guai wu 。 jie xia lai wo zhi dao ， wo tang zai a er ka li de yi nan de hai an shang ， pu di zai wo lian shang hui wu zhe kao rou chuan ！]

english: That must have been awful. At least you and the crew survived.
translation: 那一定很糟糕。至少你和船员都活了下来。 [na yi ding hen zao gao 。 zhi shao ni he chuan yuan dou huo le xia lai 。]

english: Aye, we survived, but the same cannot be said for me poor ship! Koanee should 'o known better!
translation: 是的，我们活了下来，但对于我可怜的船来说却不能说同样的话！ Koanee 应该更清楚！ [shi de ， wo men huo le xia lai ， dan dui yu wo ke lian de chuan lai shuo que bu neng shuo tong yang de hua ！ Koanee  ying gai geng qing chu ！]

english: Once Pudi and the others helped us back on our feet, the Chancellor sent us 'ere t' setup shop and recruit others.
translation: 一旦普迪和其他人帮助我们重新站起来，总理就派我们“立即”设立商店并招募其他人。 [yi dan pu di he qi ta ren bang zhu wo men chong xin zhan qi lai ， zong li jiu pai wo men “ li ji ” she li shang dian bing zhao mu qi ta ren 。]

english: Not really my area of expertise, mind, but Pudi sorts most of it out!
translation: 请注意，这并不是我的专业领域，但 Pudi 解决了大部分问题！ [qing zhu yi ， zhe bing bu shi wo de zhuan ye ling yu ， dan  Pudi  jie jue le da bu fen wen ti ！]

english: Anythin' else I can help ye with?
translation: 还有什么我可以帮你的吗？ [hai you shen me wo ke yi bang ni de ma ？]

english: Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
translation: 你有对抗 Tempoross 的建议吗？ [ni you dui kang  Tempoross  de jian yi ma ？]

english: Always carry an 'ammer. That beast has a habit of destroyin' ships. You can fix it up by using said 'ammer.
translation: 始终携带一把“ammer”。那头野兽有毁坏船只的习惯。您可以使用所说的“ammer”来修复它。 [shi zhong xie dai yi ba “ammer”。 na tou ye shou you hui huai chuan zhi de xi guan 。 nin ke yi shi yong suo shuo de “ammer” lai xiu fu ta 。]

english: The Spirit Anglers' ships you fight the beast from are kitted out with everythin' ye need.
translation: 你与野兽战斗的灵魂垂钓者的船只配备了你需要的一切。 [ni yu ye shou zhan dou de ling hun chui diao zhe de chuan zhi pei bei le ni xu yao de yi qie 。]

english: Can I help ye with anythin' else?
translation: 我还能帮你做点什么吗？ [wo hai neng bang ni zuo dian shen me ma ？]

english: I found your ship's log.
translation: 我找到了你的航海日志。 [wo zhao dao le ni de hang hai ri zhi 。]

english: Ye be stealin' me booty are ye?
translation: 你们在偷我的战利品吗？ [ni men zai tou wo de zhan li pin ma ？]

english: No, I jus...
translation: 不，我只是... [bu ， wo zhi shi ...]

english: I be yankin' ye chain, 'tis all good. I put that 'ere book on that shelf so I may spread me tale.
translation: 我正在拉扯你们的链条，这一切都很好。我把那本书放在书架上，这样我就可以传播我的故事。 [wo zheng zai la che ni men de lian tiao ， zhe yi qie dou hen hao 。 wo ba na ben shu fang zai shu jia shang ， zhe yang wo jiu ke yi chuan bo wo de gu shi 。]

english: It was a good tale. Is it true?

english: Of course 'tis true! Ye can ask me all about it.
translation: 当然是真的！你可以问我一切。 [dang ran shi zhen de ！ ni ke yi wen wo yi qie 。]

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。 [wo de zou le 。]

english: Be seein' ye.
translation: 来看看吧。 [lai kan kan ba 。]

english: Would you care for an egg in this difficult time?
translation: 在这个困难时期，你会关心鸡蛋吗？ [zai zhe ge kun nan shi qi ， ni hui guan xin ji dan ma ？]

english: Um... no, I don't want your damp egg, thanks...
translation: 嗯...不，我不需要你的湿鸡蛋，谢谢... [n ... bu ， wo bu xu yao ni de shi ji dan ， xie xie ...]

english: I'll take my eggs elsewhere then.
translation: 那我会把鸡蛋带到别处去。 [na wo hui ba ji dan dai dao bie chu qu 。]

english: A damp egg? No thanks.
translation: 湿鸡蛋？不，谢谢。 [shi ji dan ？ bu ， xie xie 。]

english: I'd rather not. Thanks, though.
translation: 我宁愿不。不过还是谢谢。 [wo ning yuan bu 。 bu guo hai shi xie xie 。]

english: Oh, thanks.
translation: 哦，谢谢。 [o ， xie xie 。]

english: This is some comfort to be sure.
translation: 这确实是一种安慰。 [zhe que shi shi yi zhong an wei 。]

english: What happened to your ship?
translation: 你的船怎么了？ [ni de chuan zen me le ？]

english: Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
translation: 你有对抗 Tempoross 的建议吗？ [ni you dui kang  Tempoross  de jian yi ma ？]

english: I found your ship's log.
translation: 我找到了你的航海日志。 [wo zhao dao le ni de hang hai ri zhi 。]

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。 [wo de zou le 。]

english: Get out of my way! Argh! I'm hunting!
translation: 别挡我的路！啊！我在打猎！ [bie dang wo de lu ！ a ！ wo zai da lie ！]

english: Die! Die!!
translation: 死！死！！ [si ！ si ！！]

english: Move, lest I slay not the beast but you!
translation: 快走，免得我杀的不是野兽而是你！ [kuai zou ， mian de wo sha de bu shi ye shou er shi ni ！]

english: Hello, Tamayu, first son of Timfraku.
translation: 你好，塔马尤，提姆弗拉库的长子。 [ni hao ， ta ma you ， ti mu fu la ku de zhang zi 。]

english: Stranger, why you have returned?
translation: 陌生人，你怎么又回来了？ [mo sheng ren ， ni zen me you hui lai le ？]

english: I'm just passing through.
translation: 我只是路过而已 [wo zhi shi lu guo er yi]

english: Using your new found poison I have been creating spears. Would you like to buy some?
translation: 我用你新发现的毒药制造了长矛。您想买一些吗？ [wo yong ni xin fa xian de du yao zhi zao le chang mao 。 nin xiang mai yi xie ma ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: As you wish, stranger.
translation: 如你所愿，陌生人。 [ru ni suo yuan ， mo sheng ren 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Busy Busy Busy.
translation: 忙忙忙。 [mang mang mang 。]

english: Why are you so busy?
translation: 你为什么这么忙？ [ni wei shen me zhe me mang ？]

english: Aluft Aloft is a bustling new business, here in the Gnome restaurant. We're getting food orders all the time.
translation: Aluft Aloft 是一家热闹的新店，位于 Gnome 餐厅内。我们一直收到食品订单。 [Aluft Aloft  shi yi jia re nao de xin dian ， wei yu  Gnome  can ting nei 。 wo men yi zhi shou dao shi pin ding dan 。]

english: Do you have any jobs then?
translation: 那你还有工作吗？ [na ni hai you gong zuo ma ？]

english: If you want to get a job, talk to Aluft Gianne jnr. I'm sure he has plenty.
translation: 如果您想找工作，请与 Aluft Gianne jnr 联系。我确信他有足够的。 [ru guo nin xiang zhao gong zuo ， qing yu  Aluft Gianne jnr  lian xi 。 wo que xin ta you zu gou de 。]

english: Have a nice day.
translation: 祝你今天过得愉快。 [zhu ni jin tian guo de yu kuai 。]

english: How are you doing today?
translation: 你今天怎么样？ [ni jin tian zen me yang ？]

english: I am Tangleroot!
translation: 我是唐格根！ [wo shi tang ge gen ！]

english: Hello there pretty plant.
translation: 你好，漂亮的植物。 [ni hao ， piao liang de zhi wu 。]

english: I am Tangleroot!
translation: 我是唐格根！ [wo shi tang ge gen ！]

english: I am [player name]!
translation: 我是[玩家姓名]！ [wo shi [ wan jia xing ming ]！]

english: Everything is crystal clear now.
translation: 现在一切都一清二楚了。 [xian zai yi qie dou yi qing er chu le 。]

english: I can't believe they made dragonfruit trees into a real thing!
translation: 我不敢相信他们把火龙果树变成了真实的东西！ [wo bu gan xiang xin ta men ba huo long guo shu bian cheng le zhen shi de dong xi ！]

english: I am Tangleroot?
translation: 我是唐格鲁特？ [wo shi tang ge lu te ？]

english: Nothing.

english: Are you related to Herbiboar now?

english: I am Tangleroot.
translation: 我是唐格鲁特。 [wo shi tang ge lu te 。]

english: I should have guessed.
translation: 我早该猜到的。 [wo zao gai cai dao de 。]
347 + 73 是多少？ [347 + 73  shi duo shao ？]

english: Nevermind.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

translation: 哦，亲爱的，你已经红了！ [o ， qin ai de ， ni yi jing hong le ！]

english: It must be something you ate.
translation: 一定是你吃的东西。 [yi ding shi ni chi de dong xi 。]

english: Tangleeeee!

english: Grrrr
