english: Greetings friend. I am a manufacturer of leather.
translation: 问候朋友。我是一家皮革制造商。 [wen hou peng you 。 wo shi yi jia pi ge zhi zao shang 。]

english: Can I buy some leather then?
translation: 那我可以买一些皮革吗？ [na wo ke yi mai yi xie pi ge ma ？]

english: I make leather from animal hides. Bring me some cowhides and one gold coin per hide, and I'll tan them into soft leather for you.
translation: 我用动物皮制作皮革。给我一些牛皮，每张牛皮一枚金币，我会把它们晒成柔软的皮革给你。 [wo yong dong wu pi zhi zuo pi ge 。 gei wo yi xie niu pi ， mei zhang niu pi yi mei jin bi ， wo hui ba ta men shai cheng rou ruan de pi ge gei ni 。]

english: Leather is rather weak stuff.
translation: 皮革是相当脆弱的东西。 [pi ge shi xiang dang cui ruo de dong xi 。]

english: Normal leather may be quite weak, but it's very cheap - I make it from cowhides for only 1 gp per hide - and it's so easy to craft that anyone can work with it.
translation: 普通皮革可能很脆弱，但它非常便宜 - 我用牛皮制作它，每张皮革只需 1 金币 - 而且制作起来非常容易，任何人都可以使用它。 [pu tong pi ge ke neng hen cui ruo ， dan ta fei chang pian yi  -  wo yong niu pi zhi zuo ta ， mei zhang pi ge zhi xu  1  jin bi  -  er qie zhi zuo qi lai fei chang rong yi ， ren he ren dou ke yi shi yong ta 。]

english: Alternatively you could try hard leather. It's not so easy to craft, but I only charge 3 gp per cowhide to prepare it, and it makes much sturdier armour.
translation: 或者，您可以尝试硬质皮革。制作它并不容易，但我只需要每张牛皮 3 gp 来准备它，而且它可以制造更坚固的盔甲。 [huo zhe ， nin ke yi chang shi ying zhi pi ge 。 zhi zuo ta bing bu rong yi ， dan wo zhi xu yao mei zhang niu pi  3 gp  lai zhun bei ta ， er qie ta ke yi zhi zao geng jian gu de kui jia 。]

english: I can also tan snake hides and dragonhides, suitable for crafting into the highest quality armour for rangers.
translation: 我还可以鞣制蛇皮和龙皮，适合为游侠制作最高品质的盔甲。 [wo hai ke yi rou zhi she pi he long pi ， shi he wei you xia zhi zuo zui gao pin zhi di kui jia 。]

english: Thanks, I'll bear it in mind.
translation: 谢谢，我会记住的。 [xie xie ， wo hui ji zhu de 。]

english: I see you have brought me a hide. Would you like me to tan it for you?
translation: 我看到你给我带来了一块隐藏的东西。要我帮你晒黑吗？ [wo kan dao ni gei wo dai lai le yi kuai yin cang de dong xi 。 yao wo bang ni shai hei ma ？]

english: I see you have brought me some hides. Would you like me to tan them for you?
translation: 我看到你给我带来了一些兽皮。您需要我帮您晒黑吗？ [wo kan dao ni gei wo dai lai le yi xie shou pi 。 nin xu yao wo bang nin shai hei ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Very well, [sir/madam], as you wish.
translation: 很好，[先生/女士]，如您所愿。 [hen hao ，[ xian sheng / nv shi ]， ru nin suo yuan 。]

english: Er... Thanks, but no thanks!
translation: 呃...谢谢，但不用了，谢谢！ [e ... xie xie ， dan bu yong le ， xie xie ！]

english: Er... I have no use for that, I make the stuff!
translation: 呃……我没用，我做这些东西！ [e …… wo mei yong ， wo zuo zhe xie dong xi ！]

english: Can I buy some leather then?
translation: 那我可以买一些皮革吗？ [na wo ke yi mai yi xie pi ge ma ？]

english: Leather is rather weak stuff.
translation: 皮革是相当脆弱的东西。 [pi ge shi xiang dang cui ruo de dong xi 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Not infected are you?
translation: 你没有被感染吧？ [ni mei you bei gan ran ba ？]

english: I don't think so.
translation: 我不这么认为。 [wo bu zhe me ren wei 。]

english: You don't seem very sure. We don't want any infected near the children. Be off with you!
translation: 你看起来不太确定。我们不希望孩子们附近有任何感染者。跟你走吧！ [ni kan qi lai bu tai que ding 。 wo men bu xi wang hai zi men fu jin you ren he gan ran zhe 。 gen ni zou ba ！]

english: Whatever it is you're selling, we ain't interested!
translation: 不管你卖什么，我们都不感兴趣！ [bu guan ni mai shen me ， wo men dou bu gan xing qu ！]

english: But I'm not...
translation: 但我不是... [dan wo bu shi ...]

english: Did you not hear me? Clear off!
translation: 你没听到我说话吗？走开！ [ni mei ting dao wo shuo hua ma ？ zou kai ！]

english: Greetings human. These Hydras are not to be harmed unless you have permission. To act otherwise would be a danger to the balance.
translation: 问候人类。除非获得许可，否则不得伤害这些九头蛇。否则就会对平衡造成危险。 [wen hou ren lei 。 chu fei huo de xu ke ， fou ze bu de shang hai zhe xie jiu tou she 。 fou ze jiu hui dui ping heng zao cheng wei xian 。]

english: Human! To attack these creatures would be a threat to the balance. Only those with permission may fight them!
translation: 人类！攻击这些生物将对平衡构成威胁。只有获得许可的人才能与他们战斗！ [ren lei ！ gong ji zhe xie sheng wu jiang dui ping heng gou cheng wei xie 。 zhi you huo de xu ke de ren cai neng yu ta men zhan dou ！]

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
translation: 你愿意帮我照料我的庄稼吗？ [ni yuan yi bang wo zhao liao wo de zhuang jia ma ？]

english: You don't have any seeds planted in that patch. Plant some and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: 你在那块土地上没有种下任何种子。种一些，我可能会同意帮你照顾它。 [ni zai na kuai tu di shang mei you zhong xia ren he zhong zi 。 zhong yi xie ， wo ke neng hui tong yi bang ni zhao gu ta 。]

english: That patch is already fully grown! I don't know what you want me to do with it!
translation: 那块补丁已经完全长大了！我不知道你想让我用它做什么！ [na kuai bu ding yi jing wan quan zhang da le ！ wo bu zhi dao ni xiang rang wo yong ta zuo shen me ！]

english: That patch is dead - it's too late for me to do anything about it now.
translation: 那个补丁已经死了——现在对我来说做任何事情都太晚了。 [na ge bu ding yi jing si le —— xian zai dui wo lai shuo zuo ren he shi qing dou tai wan le 。]

english: That patch is diseased - you should cure it before asking me to be responsible for it!
translation: 那个补丁有病——你应该先治愈它，然后再要求我负责！ [na ge bu ding you bing —— ni ying gai xian zhi yu ta ， ran hou zai yao qiu wo fu ze ！]

english: I don't know what you're talking about - I'm already looking after that patch for you.
translation: 我不知道你在说什么 - 我已经在为你处理那个补丁了。 [wo bu zhi dao ni zai shuo shen me  -  wo yi jing zai wei ni chu li na ge bu ding le 。]

english: Oh sorry, I forgot.
translation: 哦，抱歉，我忘了。 [o ， bao qian ， wo wang le 。]

english: If you like, but I want 4 sacks of cabbages for that.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，但我想要四袋卷心菜。 [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， dan wo xiang yao si dai juan xin cai 。]

english: I'm afraid I don't have any of those at the moment.
translation: 恐怕我现在没有这些。 [kong pa wo xian zai mei you zhe xie 。]

english: Well, I'm not wasting my time for free.
translation: 好吧，我不会免费浪费时间。 [hao ba ， wo bu hui mian fei lang fei shi jian 。]

english: I'm afraid I don't have enough of those at the moment.
translation: 恐怕我现在还没有足够的东西。 [kong pa wo xian zai hai mei you zu gou de dong xi 。]

english: Okay, it's a deal.
translation: “好吧，成交。” [“ hao ba ， cheng jiao 。”]

english: That'll do nicely, [sir/madam]. Leave it with me - I'll make sure that patch grows for you.
translation: 那就太好了，[先生/女士]。把它留给我吧——我会确保这个补丁适合你。 [na jiu tai hao le ，[ xian sheng / nv shi ]。 ba ta liu gei wo ba —— wo hui que bao zhe ge bu ding shi he ni 。]

english: No, that's too much.
translation: 不，那太多了。 [bu ， na tai duo le 。]

english: If you like, but I want 3 baskets of tomatoes for that.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，但我想要 3 篮西红柿。 [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， dan wo xiang yao  3  lan xi hong shi 。]

english: If you like, but I want 3 baskets of strawberries for that.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，但我想要 3 篮子草莓。 [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， dan wo xiang yao  3  lan zi cao mei 。]

english: If you like, but I want 6 watermelons for that.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，但我想要 6 个西瓜。 [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， dan wo xiang yao  6  ge xi gua 。]

english: If you like, but I want 8 Bittercap mushrooms for that.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，但我想要 8 个苦蘑菇。 [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， dan wo xiang yao  8  ge ku mo gu 。]

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 你能给我一些农业建议吗？ [ni neng gei wo yi xie nong ye jian yi ma ？]

english: The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
translation: 治愈灌木或树木疾病的唯一方法是用剪刀剪掉患病的叶子。对于所有其他作物，我只会使用一些植物疗法。 [zhi yu guan mu huo shu mu ji bing de wei yi fang fa shi yong jian dao jian diao huan bing de ye zi 。 dui yu suo you qi ta zuo wu ， wo zhi hui shi yong yi xie zhi wu liao fa 。]

english: Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
translation: 树木种子必须在土壤花盆中长成树苗，然后转移到树丛中继续生长直至成年。 [shu mu zhong zi bi xu zai tu rang hua pen zhong chang cheng shu miao ， ran hou zhuan yi dao shu cong zhong ji xu sheng zhang zhi zhi cheng nian 。]

english: You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
translation: 您最多可以在蔬菜袋中放入十个土豆、卷心菜或洋葱，但不能将它们混合放在同一个袋子中。 [nin zui duo ke yi zai shu cai dai zhong fang ru shi ge tu dou 、 juan xin cai huo yang cong ， dan bu neng jiang ta men hun he fang zai tong yi ge dai zi zhong 。]

english: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
translation: 您可以从农田商店购买所有农具，农田商店位于耕地附近。 [nin ke yi cong nong tian shang dian gou mai suo you nong ju ， nong tian shang dian wei yu geng di fu jin 。]

english: Bittercap mushrooms can only be grown in a special patch in Morytania, near the Mort Myre swamp. There the ground is especially dank and suited to growing poisonous fungii.
translation: 苦蘑菇只能生长在莫里塔尼亚莫特迈尔沼泽附近的一块特殊土地上。那里的地面特别潮湿，适合有毒真菌的生长。 [ku mo gu zhi neng sheng zhang zai mo li ta ni ya mo te mai er zhao ze fu jin de yi kuai te shu tu di shang 。 na li de di mian te bie chao shi ， shi he you du zhen jun de sheng zhang 。]

english: Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
translation: 超级堆肥比普通堆肥好得多，但制造成本更高。你需要腐烂正确类型的物品；给我看一个物品，我会告诉你它是否超级可堆肥。 [chao ji dui fei bi pu tong dui fei hao de duo ， dan zhi zao cheng ben geng gao 。 ni xu yao fu lan zheng que lei xing de wu pin ； gei wo kan yi ge wu pin ， wo hui gao su ni ta shi fou chao ji ke dui fei 。]

english: There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
translation: 有一块专门种植颠茄的土地——我相信它就在德雷诺庄园附近的某个地方，那里的土地有点“不被祝福”。 [you yi kuai zhuan men zhong zhi dian jia de tu di —— wo xiang xin ta jiu zai de lei nuo zhuang yuan fu jin de mou ge di fang ， na li de tu di you dian “ bu bei zhu fu ”。]

english: Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
translation: 在一块土地上施用堆肥不仅可以减少农作物患病的机会，而且还可以种植更多的农作物来收获。 [zai yi kuai tu di shang shi yong dui fei bu jin ke yi jian shao nong zuo wu huan bing de ji hui ， er qie hai ke yi zhong zhi geng duo de nong zuo wu lai shou huo 。]

english: If you want to grow fruit trees you could try a few places: Catherby, Brimhaven, Gnome Stronghold and the Farming Guild all have fruit tree patches.
translation: 如果你想种植果树，你可以尝试几个地方：Catherby、Brimhaven、Gnome Stronghold 和 Farming Guild 都有果树。 [ru guo ni xiang zhong zhi guo shu ， ni ke yi chang shi ji ge di fang ：Catherby、Brimhaven、Gnome Stronghold  he  Farming Guild  dou you guo shu 。]

english: You can fill plantpots with soil from any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.
translation: 如果你有园艺抹子，你可以用任何空地的土壤填满花盆。 [ru guo ni you yuan yi mo zi ， ni ke yi yong ren he kong di de tu rang tian man hua pen 。]

english: Hops are good for brewing ales. I believe there's a brewery up in Keldagrim somewhere, and I've heard rumours that a place called Phasmatys used to be good for that type of thing. 'Fore they all died, of course.
translation: 啤酒花适合酿造啤酒。我相信凯尔达格里姆的某个地方有一家啤酒厂，而且我听说过一个叫做 Phasmatys 的地方曾经适合做这种事情。 “当然，他们都死了。 [pi jiu hua shi he niang zao pi jiu 。 wo xiang xin kai er da ge li mu de mou ge di fang you yi jia pi jiu chang ， er qie wo ting shuo guo yi ge jiao zuo  Phasmatys  de di fang ceng jing shi he zuo zhe zhong shi qing 。 “ dang ran ， ta men dou si le 。]

english: Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
translation: 蔬菜、啤酒花和花卉需要不断浇水——如果你忽视我的建议，你迟早会发现自己拥有一片枯死的农田。 [shu cai 、 pi jiu hua he hua hui xu yao bu duan jiao shui —— ru guo ni hu shi wo de jian yi ， ni chi zao hui fa xian zi ji yong you yi pian ku si de nong tian 。]

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: 您最多可以将五个西红柿、草莓、苹果、香蕉或橙子放入一个水果篮中，但不能将它们混合放在同一个篮子中。 [nin zui duo ke yi jiang wu ge xi hong shi 、 cao mei 、 ping guo 、 xiang jiao huo cheng zi fang ru yi ge shui guo lan zhong ， dan bu neng jiang ta men hun he fang zai tong yi ge lan zi zhong 。]

english: Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
translation: 耙完一块杂草后，不要只是扔掉杂草 - 将它们放入堆肥箱中并制作一些堆肥。 [ba wan yi kuai za cao hou ， bu yao zhi shi reng diao za cao  -  jiang ta men fang ru dui fei xiang zhong bing zhi zuo yi xie dui fei 。]

english: There are five other Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius and Alan's area in the Farming Guild.
translation: 还有其他五个与此类似的农业区域 - 法拉多附近的埃尔斯坦区域、凯瑟比附近的丹塔拉区域、莫里塔尼亚的莱拉区域、霍西迪乌斯的马里西区域和农业公会的艾伦区域。 [hai you qi ta wu ge yu ci lei si de nong ye qu yu  -  fa la duo fu jin de ai er si tan qu yu 、 kai se bi fu jin de dan ta la qu yu 、 mo li ta ni ya de lai la qu yu 、 huo xi di wu si de ma li xi qu yu he nong ye gong hui de ai lun qu yu 。]

english: There are fiveother Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius, Alan's area in the Farming Guild and Oswallt's
translation: 还有五个其他农业区域与此类似 - 法拉多附近的埃尔斯坦区域、凯瑟比附近的丹塔拉区域、莫里塔尼亚的莱拉区域、霍西迪乌斯的马里西区域、农业行会的艾伦区域和奥斯瓦尔特区域 [hai you wu ge qi ta nong ye qu yu yu ci lei si  -  fa la duo fu jin de ai er si tan qu yu 、 kai se bi fu jin de dan ta la qu yu 、 mo li ta ni ya de lai la qu yu 、 huo xi di wu si de ma li xi qu yu 、 nong ye hang hui de ai lun qu yu he ao si wa er te qu yu]

english: area in Prifddinas.
translation: 普里夫迪纳斯地区。 [pu li fu di na si di qu 。]

english: If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're a good enough [craftsman/craftswoman], that is.
translation: 如果您想自己制作麻袋和篮子，则需要使用法拉多农业商店附近的织布机。如果你是一个足够好的[工匠/女工匠]，那就是。 [ru guo nin xiang zi ji zhi zuo ma dai he lan zi ， ze xu yao shi yong fa la duo nong ye shang dian fu jin de zhi bu ji 。 ru guo ni shi yi ge zu gou hao de [ gong jiang / nv gong jiang ]， na jiu shi 。]

english: You don't have to buy all your plantpots you know, you can make them yourself on a pottery wheel. If you're a good enough [craftsman/craftswoman], that is.
translation: 您不必购买所有您知道的花盆，您可以自己在陶轮上制作它们。如果你是一个足够好的[工匠/女工匠]，那就是。 [nin bu bi gou mai suo you nin zhi dao de hua pen ， nin ke yi zi ji zai tao lun shang zhi zuo ta men 。 ru guo ni shi yi ge zu gou hao de [ gong jiang / nv gong jiang ]， na jiu shi 。]

english: Can you sell me something?
translation: 你能卖给我东西吗？ [ni neng mai gei wo dong xi ma ？]

english: That depends on whether I have it to sell. What is it that you're looking for?
translation: 这取决于我是否有它可以卖。您在寻找什么？ [zhe qu jue yu wo shi fou you ta ke yi mai 。 nin zai xun zhao shen me ？]

english: Some plant cure.
translation: 一些植物治疗。 [yi xie zhi wu zhi liao 。]

english: Plant cure, eh? I might have some put aside for myself. Tell you what, I'll sell you some plant cure for 25 coins if you like.
translation: 植物疗法，嗯？我可能会留一些给自己。告诉你吧，如果你愿意的话，我可以花 25 个硬币卖给你一些植物疗法。 [zhi wu liao fa ， n ？ wo ke neng hui liu yi xie gei zi ji 。 gao su ni ba ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi hua  25  ge ying bi mai gei ni yi xie zhi wu liao fa 。]

english: I don't have enough money for that, I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕我没有足够的钱。 [kong pa wo mei you zu gou de qian 。]

english: Actually, I don't think I'd be able to carry it.
translation: 事实上，我认为我无法携带它。 [shi shi shang ， wo ren wei wo wu fa xie dai ta 。]

english: Yes, that sounds like a fair price.
translation: 是的，这听起来像是一个公平的价格。 [shi de ， zhe ting qi lai xiang shi yi ge gong ping de jia ge 。]

english: No thanks, I can get that much cheaper elsewhere.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我在其他地方可以买到便宜得多的东西。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo zai qi ta di fang ke yi mai dao pian yi de duo de dong xi 。]

english: A bucket of compost.
translation: 一桶堆肥。 [yi tong dui fei 。]

english: A bucket of compost, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 35 coins if you like.
translation: 一桶堆肥，是吗？我可能还有一个备用的……告诉你吧，如果你愿意的话，我可以以 35 个硬币的价格卖给你。 [yi tong dui fei ， shi ma ？ wo ke neng hai you yi ge bei yong de …… gao su ni ba ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi yi  35  ge ying bi de jia ge mai gei ni 。]

english: A rake.
translation: 一把耙子。 [yi ba pa zi 。]

english: A rake, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: 耙子，嗯？我可能还有一个备用的……告诉你吧，如果你愿意的话，我可以以 15 个硬币的价格卖给你。 [pa zi ， n ？ wo ke neng hai you yi ge bei yong de …… gao su ni ba ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi yi  15  ge ying bi de jia ge mai gei ni 。]

english: A plant pot.
translation: 一个花盆。 [yi ge hua pen 。]

english: Eh, I suppose I can spare you a plant pot, but I'll want 40 coins for it.
translation: 呃，我想我可以给你一个花盆，但我要 40 个硬币。 [e ， wo xiang wo ke yi gei ni yi ge hua pen ， dan wo yao  40  ge ying bi 。]

english: A watering can.
translation: 一个喷壶。 [yi ge pen hu 。]

english: A watering can, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 25 coins if you like.
translation: 喷壶，嗯？我可能还有一个备用的……告诉你吧，如果你愿意的话，我可以以 25 个硬币的价格卖给你。 [pen hu ， n ？ wo ke neng hai you yi ge bei yong de …… gao su ni ba ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi yi  25  ge ying bi de jia ge mai gei ni 。]

english: A gardening trowel.
translation: 园艺抹子。 [yuan yi mo zi 。]

english: A gardening trowel, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: 园艺抹子，是吗？我可能还有一个备用的……告诉你吧，如果你愿意的话，我可以以 15 个硬币的价格卖给你。 [yuan yi mo zi ， shi ma ？ wo ke neng hai you yi ge bei yong de …… gao su ni ba ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi yi  15  ge ying bi de jia ge mai gei ni 。]

english: A seed dibber.
translation: 播种机。 [bo zhong ji 。]

english: A seed dibber, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: 种子播种者，是吗？我可能还有一个备用的……告诉你吧，如果你愿意的话，我可以以 15 个硬币的价格卖给你。 [zhong zi bo zhong zhe ， shi ma ？ wo ke neng hai you yi ge bei yong de …… gao su ni ba ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi yi  15  ge ying bi de jia ge mai gei ni 。]

english: Forget it, you don't have anything I need.
translation: 算了，你没有我需要的东西。 [suan le ， ni mei you wo xu yao de dong xi 。]

english: I'll come back another time.
translation: 我下次再来。 [wo xia ci zai lai 。]

english: I have a question for you.
translation: 我有个问题要问你。 [wo you ge wen ti yao wen ni 。]

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
translation: 请输入问题的答案。 [qing shu ru wen ti de da an 。]

english: No, try again.
translation: 不，再试一次。 [bu ， zai shi yi ci 。]

english: Correct!
translation: 正确的！ [zheng que de ！]

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
translation: 你愿意帮我照料我的庄稼吗？ [ni yuan yi bang wo zhao liao wo de zhuang jia ma ？]

english: Okay, it's a deal.
translation: “好吧，成交。” [“ hao ba ， cheng jiao 。”]

english: No, that's too much.
translation: 不，那太多了。 [bu ， na tai duo le 。]

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 你能给我一些农业建议吗？ [ni neng gei wo yi xie nong ye jian yi ma ？]

english: Can you sell me something?
translation: 你能卖给我东西吗？ [ni neng mai gei wo dong xi ma ？]

english: Some plant cure.
translation: 一些植物治疗。 [yi xie zhi wu zhi liao 。]

english: Yes, that sounds like a fair price.
translation: 是的，这听起来像是一个公平的价格。 [shi de ， zhe ting qi lai xiang shi yi ge gong ping de jia ge 。]

english: No thanks, I can get that much cheaper elsewhere.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我在其他地方可以买到便宜得多的东西。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo zai qi ta di fang ke yi mai dao pian yi de duo de dong xi 。]

english: A bucket of compost.
translation: 一桶堆肥。 [yi tong dui fei 。]

english: A rake.
translation: 一把耙子。 [yi ba pa zi 。]

english: A plant pot.
translation: 一个花盆。 [yi ge hua pen 。]

english: (See more items)
translation: （查看更多项目） [（ cha kan geng duo xiang mu ）]

english: A watering can.
translation: 一个喷壶。 [yi ge pen hu 。]

english: A gardening trowel.
translation: 园艺抹子。 [yuan yi mo zi 。]

english: A seed dibber.
translation: 播种机。 [bo zhong ji 。]

english: (See previous items)
translation: （参见之前的项目） [（ can jian zhi qian de xiang mu ）]

english: Forget it.
translation: 忘了它。 [wang le ta 。]

english: I'll come back another time.
translation: 我下次再来。 [wo xia ci zai lai 。]

english: Ouch!
translation: 哎哟! [ai yo !]

english: Are you alright?
translation: 你还好吗？ [ni hai hao ma ？]

english: I'm fine, I'm fine. Just a scratch.
translation: 我很好，我很好。只是一个划痕。 [wo hen hao ， wo hen hao 。 zhi shi yi ge hua hen 。]

english: If you're sure. Who are you?
translation: 如果你确定的话。你是谁？ [ru guo ni que ding de hua 。 ni shi shui ？]

english: Me? I'm Tarik.
translation: 我？我是塔里克。 [wo ？ wo shi ta li ke 。]

english: That hat you're wearing doesn't look like it comes from around here?
translation: 你戴的那顶帽子看起来不像是从这里来的？ [ni dai de na ding mao zi kan qi lai bu xiang shi cong zhe li lai de ？]

english: It was a present. My employer thought it would suit me. I'm not sure it does, though it does keep the sun off very well.
translation: 这是一份礼物。我的雇主认为这适合我。我不确定它是否有效，尽管它确实可以很好地遮挡阳光。 [zhe shi yi fen li wu 。 wo de gu zhu ren wei zhe shi he wo 。 wo bu que ding ta shi fou you xiao ， jin guan ta que shi ke yi hen hao di zhe dang yang guang 。]

english: Who is this employer?
translation: 这位雇主是谁？ [zhe wei gu zhu shi shui ？]

english: Simon Templeton. He's an archaeologist. I worked as an assistant for him, though I haven't seen him since the plague business started, so I work for myself now.
translation: 西蒙·坦普尔顿。他是一位考古学家。我是他的助手，虽然自从瘟疫事件发生以来我就没有见过他，所以我现在为自己工作。 [xi meng · tan pu er dun 。 ta shi yi wei kao gu xue jia 。 wo shi ta de zhu shou ， sui ran zi cong wen yi shi jian fa sheng yi lai wo jiu mei you jian guo ta ， suo yi wo xian zai wei zi ji gong zuo 。]

english: I see. So what have you been up to?
translation: 我懂了。那你最近在忙什么？ [wo dong le 。 na ni zui jin zai mang shen me ？]

english: Simon suggested that there might be riches to be found in this pyramid.
translation: 西蒙表示，在这座金字塔中可能会发现财富。 [xi meng biao shi ， zai zhe zuo jin zi ta zhong ke neng hui fa xian cai fu 。]

english: All I've found so far are injuries though.
translation: 到目前为止我发现的只是受伤。 [dao mu qian wei zhi wo fa xian de zhi shi shou shang 。]

english: Interesting... What can you tell me about this pyramid?
translation: 有趣...你能告诉我关于这座金字塔的什么信息吗？ [you qu ... ni neng gao su wo guan yu zhe zuo jin zi ta de shen me xin xi ma ？]

english: Well, I'm not sure. It's called Jalsavrah apparently. It's a strange place.
translation: 嗯，我不确定。显然它的名字叫Jalsavrah。这是一个奇怪的地方。 [n ， wo bu que ding 。 xian ran ta de ming zi jiao Jalsavrah。 zhe shi yi ge qi guai de di fang 。]

english: How so?
translation: 为何如此？ [wei he ru ci ？]

english: First of all, there's something odd about the doors. There's four of them, but three of them lead to an empty tomb.
translation: 首先，门有些奇怪。它们有四个，但其中三个通向一座空坟墓。 [shou xian ， men you xie qi guai 。 ta men you si ge ， dan qi zhong san ge tong xiang yi zuo kong fen mu 。]

english: The other one is guarded by something, and whatever it is, it doesn't like visitors.
translation: 另一只被某种东西看守着，不管它是什么，它都不喜欢访客。 [ling yi zhi bei mou zhong dong xi kan shou zhe ， bu guan ta shi shen me ， ta dou bu xi huan fang ke 。]

english: The thing is, the doors seem to change around sometimes. It's all quite confusing.
translation: 问题是，门有时似乎会改变。这一切都很令人困惑。 [wen ti shi ， men you shi si hu hui gai bian 。 zhe yi qie dou hen ling ren kun huo 。]

english: What's this thing guarding one of them.
translation: 守护其中一个的这个东西是什么？ [shou hu qi zhong yi ge de zhe ge dong xi shi shen me ？]

english: I think it might be a mummy. It's not very friendly, but it does allow you to enter some of the rooms in the tomb. They are dangerous though.
translation: 我想这可能是一个木乃伊。它不是很友好，但它确实允许你进入坟墓中的一些房间。但它们很危险。 [wo xiang zhe ke neng shi yi ge mu nai yi 。 ta bu shi hen you hao ， dan ta que shi yun xu ni jin ru fen mu zhong de yi xie fang jian 。 dan ta men hen wei xian 。]

english: Well I'm not afraid of a little danger.
translation: 嗯，一点点危险我都不怕。 [n ， yi dian dian wei xian wo dou bu pa 。]

english: Are you sure? The place is full of poisonous snakes and scarabs along with some rather nasty mummies as well. You could die in there.
translation: 你确定吗？这个地方充满了毒蛇和圣甲虫，还有一些相当令人讨厌的木乃伊。你可能会死在那里。 [ni que ding ma ？ zhe ge di fang chong man le du she he sheng jia chong ， hai you yi xie xiang dang ling ren tao yan de mu nai yi 。 ni ke neng hui si zai na li 。]

english: I managed to get into one room, but the next room was harder. My lockpicking skills weren't good enough. Maybe I should have taken a lockpick.
translation: 我成功地进入了一个房间，但隔壁的房间就更难了。我的开锁技术还不够好。也许我应该开锁。 [wo cheng gong di jin ru le yi ge fang jian ， dan ge bi de fang jian jiu geng nan le 。 wo de kai suo ji shu hai bu gou hao 。 ye xu wo ying gai kai suo 。]

english: It all sounds like fun to me. So, is there anything valuable in there?
translation: 这一切对我来说听起来很有趣。那么，里面有什么值钱的东西吗？ [zhe yi qie dui wo lai shuo ting qi lai hen you qu 。 na me ， li mian you shen me zhi qian de dong xi ma ？]

english: There are lots of artefacts that you should be able to sell to a legitimate trader...
translation: 有很多文物你应该能够卖给合法的商人...... [you hen duo wen wu ni ying gai neng gou mai gei he fa de shang ren ......]

english: Like your friend Simon Templeton?
translation: 喜欢你的朋友西蒙·邓普顿吗？ [xi huan ni de peng you xi meng · deng pu dun ma ？]

english: Of course. He's as 'legitimate' as you can get.
translation: 当然。他是你能想到的最“合法”的人。 [dang ran 。 ta shi ni neng xiang dao de zui “ he fa ” de ren 。]

english: Is there anything else of value in there?
translation: 里面还有其他有价值的东西吗？ [li mian hai you qi ta you jia zhi de dong xi ma ？]

english: I've heard a rumour that there is an ancient magic sceptre somewhere inside.
translation: 我听说有传言说里面有一根古老的魔法权杖。 [wo ting shuo you chuan yan shuo li mian you yi gen gu lao de mo fa quan zhang 。]

english: Ah, now you've piqued my interest. What do you know about this sceptre?
translation: 啊，现在你引起了我的兴趣。关于这把权杖你了解多少？ [a ， xian zai ni yin qi le wo de xing qu 。 guan yu zhe ba quan zhang ni liao jie duo shao ？]

english: Not a lot. It's apparently made of gold and covered in jewels. It's supposed to have some magical powers as well.
translation: 不是很多。它显然是由金子制成的，上面镶满了珠宝。它应该也有一些神奇的力量。 [bu shi hen duo 。 ta xian ran shi you jin zi zhi cheng de ， shang mian xiang man le zhu bao 。 ta ying gai ye you yi xie shen qi de li liang 。]

english: Magical powers? This sounds good. What are they?
translation: 神奇的力量？这听起来不错。这些是什么？ [shen qi de li liang ？ zhe ting qi lai bu cuo 。 zhe xie shi shen me ？]

english: I'll let you know when I find it!
translation: 当我找到它时我会告诉你！ [dang wo zhao dao ta shi wo hui gao su ni ！]

english: Not if I find it first!
translation: 如果我先找到它就不会！ [ru guo wo xian zhao dao ta jiu bu hui ！]

english: Hey! if you find it, I deserve a share of the profits! You wouldn't have known it existed without my help.
translation: 嘿！如果你找到了，我应该分享利润！如果没有我的帮助，你不会知道它的存在。 [hei ！ ru guo ni zhao dao le ， wo ying gai fen xiang li run ！ ru guo mei you wo de bang zhu ， ni bu hui zhi dao ta de cun zai 。]

english: I'll think about it...
translation: 我会考虑一下... [wo hui kao lv yi xia ...]

english: Yes, it's an odd place, isn't it?
translation: 是的，这是一个奇怪的地方，不是吗？ [shi de ， zhe shi yi ge qi guai de di fang ， bu shi ma ？]

english: You've been inside? Did you find anything?
translation: 你去过里面吗？你有发现什么吗？ [ni qu guo li mian ma ？ ni you fa xian shen me ma ？]

english: Nothing of particular note...
translation: 没什么特别注意的... [mei shen me te bie zhu yi de ...]

english: Well if you do, I'd appreciate a share of any profits.
translation: 好吧，如果你这样做，我将不胜感激分享任何利润。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni zhe yang zuo ， wo jiang bu sheng gan ji fen xiang ren he li run 。]

english: Right... I'll think about it...
translation: 嗯……我再考虑一下…… [n …… wo zai kao lv yi xia ……]

english: Hello again.
translation: 又好。 [you hao 。]

english: Oh, hello. Any luck in the pyramid? I'd appreciate a cut of anything you find.
translation: 哦，你好。金字塔里有运气吗？我很感激你能找到任何东西。 [o ， ni hao 。 jin zi ta li you yun qi ma ？ wo hen gan ji ni neng zhao dao ren he dong xi 。]

english: Right... I'll be sure to let you know if I come across anything good...
translation: 好吧……如果我遇到什么好东西，我一定会告诉你的…… [hao ba …… ru guo wo yu dao shen me hao dong xi ， wo yi ding hui gao su ni de ……]

english: Great!
translation: 伟大的！ [wei da de ！]

english: You show the artefact to Tarik.
translation: 你向塔里克展示了这件文物。 [ni xiang ta li ke zhan shi le zhe jian wen wu 。]

english: Ohh... That looks nice. I'm looking forward to my cut.
translation: 哦...看起来不错。我很期待我的剪辑。 [o ... kan qi lai bu cuo 。 wo hen qi dai wo de jian ji 。]

english: Ah, yes... I'll bring it round later.
translation: 啊，是的……我稍后会解决。 [a ， shi de …… wo shao hou hui jie jue 。]

english: I'll be waiting...
translation: 我会等待... [wo hui deng dai ...]

english: You show the sceptre to Tarik.
translation: 你向塔里克展示权杖。 [ni xiang ta li ke zhan shi quan zhang 。]

english: Hey, look at this sceptre I found!
translation: 嘿，看看我找到的这根权杖！ [hei ， kan kan wo zhao dao de zhe gen quan zhang ！]

english: Wow! It looks very valuable. What's my share?
translation: 哇！看起来非常有价值。我的份额是什么？ [wa ！ kan qi lai fei chang you jia zhi 。 wo de fen e shi shen me ？]

english: Well given the work I had to go through to get it, I think I earned it all by myself.
translation: 考虑到我为了得到它而必须付出的努力，我想这一切都是我自己赚来的。 [kao lv dao wo wei le de dao ta er bi xu fu chu de nu li ， wo xiang zhe yi qie dou shi wo zi ji zhuan lai de 。]

english: Hey, that's not fair. I told you about this pyramid!
translation: 嘿，这不公平。我告诉过你这个金字塔的事了！ [hei ， zhe bu gong ping 。 wo gao su guo ni zhe ge jin zi ta de shi le ！]

english: The world is a harsh place. Live and learn.
translation: 世界是一个严酷的地方。生活和学习。 [shi jie shi yi ge yan ku de di fang 。 sheng huo he xue xi 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Hello old bean. Is there something I can help you with?
translation: 老豆子你好。有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [lao dou zi ni hao 。 you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: My name is Tarquin Marjoribanks.
translation: 我叫塔奎因·马乔里班克斯。 [wo jiao ta kui yin · ma qiao li ban ke si 。]

english: I'd be surprised if you haven't already heard of me?
translation: 如果您还没有听说过我，我会感到惊讶吗？ [ru guo nin hai mei you ting shuo guo wo ， wo hui gan dao jing ya ma ？]

english: Why would I have heard of you Mr. Marjoribanks?
translation: 我为什么会听说你，马乔里班克斯先生？ [wo wei shen me hui ting shuo ni ， ma qiao li ban ke si xian sheng ？]

english: It's pronounced 'Marchbanks'!
translation: 它的发音是“Marchbanks”！ [ta de fa yin shi “Marchbanks”！]

english: You should know of me because I am a member of the royal family of Misthalin!
translation: 你应该认识我，因为我是米斯哈林王室的成员！ [ni ying gai ren shi wo ， yin wei wo shi mi si ha lin wang shi de cheng yuan ！]

english: Are you related to King Roald?
translation: 你和罗尔德国王有关系吗？ [ni he luo er de guo wang you guan xi ma ？]

english: Oh yes! Quite closely actually.
translation: 哦是的！实际上非常接近。 [o shi de ！ shi ji shang fei chang jie jin 。]

english: I'm his 4th cousin, once removed on his mothers side.
translation: 我是他的第四代堂兄，曾经是他母亲的亲戚。 [wo shi ta de di si dai tang xiong ， ceng jing shi ta mu qin de qin qi 。]

english: Er... Okay. What are you doing here then?
translation: 呃……好吧。那你来这里做什么？ [e …… hao ba 。 na ni lai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm canoeing on the river! It's enormous fun! Would you like to know how?
translation: 我在河上划独木舟！这真是太有趣了！您想知道如何做吗？ [wo zai he shang hua du mu zhou ！ zhe zhen shi tai you qu le ！ nin xiang zhi dao ru he zuo ma ？]

english: Could you teach me about canoes?
translation: 你能教我独木舟吗？ [ni neng jiao wo du mu zhou ma ？]

english: Well, you don't look like you have the skill to make a canoe.
translation: 嗯，你看起来不像有造独木舟的技能。 [n ， ni kan qi lai bu xiang you zao du mu zhou de ji neng 。]

english: You need to have at least level 12 woodcutting.
translation: 你需要至少有 12 级木刻。 [ni xu yao zhi shao you  12  ji mu ke 。]

english: Once you are able to make a canoe it makes travel along the river much quicker!
translation: 一旦您能够制作独木舟，沿河旅行就会更快！ [yi dan nin neng gou zhi zuo du mu zhou ， yan he lv xing jiu hui geng kuai ！]

english: It's really quite simple. Just walk down to that tree on the bank and chop it down.
translation: 这真的很简单。只要走到岸边那棵树那里，把它砍倒就可以了。 [zhe zhen de hen jian dan 。 zhi yao zou dao an bian na ke shu na li ， ba ta kan dao jiu ke yi le 。]

english: When you have done that you can shape the log further with your axe to make a canoe.
translation: 完成后，您可以用斧头进一步塑造原木以制作独木舟。 [wan cheng hou ， nin ke yi yong fu tou jin yi bu su zao yuan mu yi zhi zuo du mu zhou 。]

english: My personal favourite is the Stable Dugout canoe. A finer craft you'll never see old bean!
translation: 我个人最喜欢的是稳定的独木舟。更精细的工艺，你永远不会看到老豆子！ [wo ge ren zui xi huan de shi wen ding de du mu zhou 。 geng jing xi de gong yi ， ni yong yuan bu hui kan dao lao dou zi ！]

english: A Stable Dugout canoe will take you pretty much the length of the Lum river.
translation: 一艘稳定的独木舟几乎可以带您游遍卢姆河。 [yi sou wen ding de du mu zhou ji hu ke yi dai nin you bian lu mu he 。]

english: Of course there are other canoes.
translation: 当然还有其他独木舟。 [dang ran hai you qi ta du mu zhou 。]

english: Further up river, near the Barbarian Village, I saw some darned fool 'canoeing' on a log!
translation: 再往上游，在野蛮人村附近，我看到一个该死的傻瓜在一根圆木上“划独木舟”！ [zai wang shang you ， zai ye man ren cun fu jin ， wo kan dao yi ge gai si de sha gua zai yi gen yuan mu shang “ hua du mu zhou ”！]

english: Unfortunately, you don't have the skill to create anything more than one of those logs. I dare say it will only get 1 stop down the river!
translation: 不幸的是，您不具备创建这些日志之一以外的任何内容的技能。我敢说沿河只需要一站！ [bu xing de shi ， nin bu ju bei chuang jian zhe xie ri zhi zhi yi yi wai de ren he nei rong de ji neng 。 wo gan shuo yan he zhi xu yao yi zhan ！]

english: Still, I'm sure it will satisfy one such as yourself.
translation: 尽管如此，我相信它会让像你这样的人感到满意。 [jin guan ru ci ， wo xiang xin ta hui rang xiang ni zhe yang de ren gan dao man yi 。]

english: What's that supposed to mean?
translation: 那是什么意思？ [na shi shen me yi si ？]

english: Do not profane the royal house of Varrock by engaging me in further discourse you knave!
translation: 别再让我继续谈论你这个无赖，从而亵渎瓦罗克王室！ [bie zai rang wo ji xu tan lun ni zhe ge wu lai ， cong er xie du wa luo ke wang shi ！]

english: Pfft! I doubt he even knows the King!
translation: 噗！我怀疑他根本不认识国王！ [pu ！ wo huai yi ta gen ben bu ren shi guo wang ！]

english: You seem to be quite handy with an axe though!
translation: 不过看来你用斧子还是很得心应手的！ [bu guo kan lai ni yong fu zi hai shi hen de xin ying shou de ！]

english: I'm sure you can build a Dugout canoe. Not as fine as a Stable Dugout but it will carry you 2 stops on the river.
translation: 我相信你能建造一艘独木舟。不像马厩防空洞那么好，但它可以带你在河上停两站。 [wo xiang xin ni neng jian zao yi sou du mu zhou 。 bu xiang ma jiu fang kong dong na me hao ， dan ta ke yi dai ni zai he shang ting liang zhan 。]

english: I should imagine it would suit your limited means.
translation: 我想这会适合你有限的财力。 [wo xiang zhe hui shi he ni you xian de cai li 。]

english: What do you mean when you say 'limited means'?
translation: 当您说“有限手段”时，您是什么意思？ [dang nin shuo “ you xian shou duan ” shi ， nin shi shen me yi si ？]

english: Well, you're just an itinerant adventurer!
translation: 好吧，你只是一个流动的冒险家！ [hao ba ， ni zhi shi yi ge liu dong de mao xian jia ！]

english: What possible reason would you have for cluttering up my river with your inferior water craft!
translation: 你到底有什么理由用你的劣质船只把我的河弄得乱七八糟！ [ni dao di you shen me li you yong ni de lie zhi chuan zhi ba wo de he nong de luan qi ba zao ！]

english: Ah! Perfect! You can make a Stable Dugout canoe! One of those will carry you to any civilised place on the river.
translation: 啊!完美的！您可以制作一艘稳定的独木舟！其中一艘将带您前往河上任何文明的地方。 [a ! wan mei de ！ nin ke yi zhi zuo yi sou wen ding de du mu zhou ！ qi zhong yi sou jiang dai nin qian wang he shang ren he wen ming de di fang 。]

english: If you were of good pedigree I'd let you join my boat club. You seem to be one of those vagabond adventurers though.
translation: 如果你有良好的血统，我会让你加入我的划船俱乐部。不过，你似乎是那些流浪冒险家之一。 [ru guo ni you liang hao de xue tong ， wo hui rang ni jia ru wo de hua chuan ju le bu 。 bu guo ， ni si hu shi na xie liu lang mao xian jia zhi yi 。]

english: Charming!
translation: 迷人！ [mi ren ！]

english: Be off with you rogue!
translation: 滚开你这个流氓！ [gun kai ni zhe ge liu mang ！]

english: Well ... erm. You seem to be able to make a Waka!
translation: 嗯……嗯。看来你会做Waka！ [n …… n 。 kan lai ni hui zuo Waka！]

english: Sounds fun, what's a Waka.
translation: 听起来很有趣，什么是 Waka。 [ting qi lai hen you qu ， shen me shi  Waka。]

english: I've only ever seen one man on the river who uses a Waka. A big, fearsome looking fellow up near Edgeville.
translation: 我只在河上见过一个人使用瓦卡。埃奇维尔附近有一个身材高大、样子可怕的家伙。 [wo zhi zai he shang jian guo yi ge ren shi yong wa ka 。 ai qi wei er fu jin you yi ge shen cai gao da 、 yang zi ke pa de jia huo 。]

english: People say he was born in the Wilderness and that he is looking for a route back.
translation: 人们说他出生在荒野，他正在寻找回归的道路。 [ren men shuo ta chu sheng zai huang ye ， ta zheng zai xun zhao hui gui de dao lu 。]

english: Is that true!
translation: 是这样吗？ [shi zhe yang ma ？]

english: How should I know? I would not consort with such a base fellow!
translation: 我怎么知道？我才不会跟这种卑鄙的人交往呢！ [wo zen me zhi dao ？ wo cai bu hui gen zhe zhong bei bi de ren jiao wang ne ！]

english: No thanks, not right now.
translation: 不，谢谢，现在不行。 [bu ， xie xie ， xian zai bu xing 。]

english: Can you teach me about canoes?
translation: 你能教我独木舟吗？ [ni neng jiao wo du mu zhou ma ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Can you teach me about Canoeing?
translation: 你能教我独木舟吗？ [ni neng jiao wo du mu zhou ma ？]

english: Please feel free to use the pottery wheel, I won't be using it all the time. Put your pots in the kiln when you've made one.
translation: 请随意使用陶轮，我不会一直使用它。做好锅后，将锅放入窑中。 [qing sui yi shi yong tao lun ， wo bu hui yi zhi shi yong ta 。 zuo hao guo hou ， jiang guo fang ru yao zhong 。]

english: And make sure you tidy up after yourself!
translation: 并确保自己收拾干净！ [bing que bao zi ji shou shi gan jing ！]

english: What'you want?
translation: 你想要什么？ [ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Do you-
translation: 你- [ni -]

english: What? Speak up, I can't hear you!
translation: 什么？大声说话，我听不见！ [shen me ？ da sheng shuo hua ， wo ting bu jian ！]

english: Uhm... I'm just looking for some pickaxes! Do you have any?
translation: 嗯...我只是在找一些镐！你有吗？ [n ... wo zhi shi zai zhao yi xie gao ！ ni you ma ？]

english: Do I have any pickaxes? Do I? Of course I do, this is a pickaxe shop, isn't it!
translation: 我有镐吗？我是吗？我当然知道，这是一家镐店，不是吗！ [wo you gao ma ？ wo shi ma ？ wo dang ran zhi dao ， zhe shi yi jia gao dian ， bu shi ma ！]

english: What? Stop mumbling!
translation: 什么？别再嘀咕了！ [shen me ？ bie zai di gu le ！]

english: I want a quest!
translation: 我想要一个任务！ [wo xiang yao yi ge ren wu ！]

english: I don't have any lousy quests... I've got someone who's helping me already!
translation: 我没有什么糟糕的任务...我已经有人在帮助我了！ [wo mei you shen me zao gao de ren wu ... wo yi jing you ren zai bang zhu wo le ！]

english: Well, I say helping... he takes his merry time to do his chores, my son does.
translation: 嗯，我说的是帮助……他会花时间做家务，我儿子就是这么做的。 [n ， wo shuo de shi bang zhu …… ta hui hua shi jian zuo jia wu ， wo er zi jiu shi zhe me zuo de 。]

english: Then perhaps I can help in some way?
translation: 那么也许我可以以某种方式提供帮助？ [na me ye xu wo ke yi yi mou zhong fang shi ti gong bang zhu ？]

english: Pfft, I doubt it... maybe when my son fouls up again, but not now.
translation: 噗，我怀疑……也许当我儿子再次犯规时，但不是现在。 [pu ， wo huai yi …… ye xu dang wo er zi zai ci fan gui shi ， dan bu shi xian zai 。]

english: Nothing really.
translation: 真的没什么。 [zhen de mei shen me 。]

english: Then clear off!
translation: 然后清除！ [ran hou qing chu ！]

english: Do you have any pickaxes?
translation: 你有镐吗？ [ni you gao ma ？]

english: Do you have any quests?
translation: 你有什么任务吗？ [ni you shen me ren wu ma ？]

english: Nothing really.
translation: 真的没什么。 [zhen de mei shen me 。]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 你知道，打招呼的方式有很多种。你好，你好，你好…… [ni zhi dao ， da zhao hu de fang shi you hen duo zhong 。 ni hao ， ni hao ， ni hao ……]

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 那还是只能算一个！ [na hai shi zhi neng suan yi ge ！]

english: Hello. How are you today?
translation: 你好。你今天怎么样？ [ni hao 。 ni jin tian zen me yang ？]

english: I'm great, thank you!
translation: 我很棒，谢谢你！ [wo hen bang ， xie xie ni ！]

english: Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 你好！水晶城里今天过得怎么样啊？ [ni hao ！ shui jing cheng li jin tian guo de zen me yang a ？]

english: Indeed.
translation: 的确。 [di que 。]

english: What can I do for ya?
translation: 我能为你做什么？ [wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 各种各样的事情！这些塔楼是一个美妙的景观。 [ge zhong ge yang de shi qing ！ zhe xie ta lou shi yi ge mei miao de jing guan 。]

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 在像今天这样的日子，我建议您参观市场。 [zai xiang jin tian zhe yang de ri zi ， wo jian yi nin can guan shi chang 。]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你认为你在做什么？ [ni ren wei ni zai zuo shen me ？]

english: What is there to do around here?
translation: 这附近有什么可玩的？ [zhe fu jin you shen me ke wan de ？]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: Please excuse me, I'm rather busy.
translation: 请原谅我，我比较忙。 [qing yuan liang wo ， wo bi jiao mang 。]

english: Hey, I'm your contractor from Mahogany Homes, what did you want done?
translation: 嘿，我是 Mahogany Homes 的承包商，你想要做什么？ [hei ， wo shi  Mahogany Homes  de cheng bao shang ， ni xiang yao zuo shen me ？]

english: I'd like my sink fixed.
translation: 我想修一下我的水槽。 [wo xiang xiu yi xia wo de shui cao 。]

english: I'd like two Wooden tables built.
translation: 我想要两张木桌。 [wo xiang yao liang zhang mu zhuo 。]

english: I'd like a Wooden cupboard built.
translation: 我想要一个木柜子。 [wo xiang yao yi ge mu gui zi 。]

english: I'd like two Wooden shelves built.
translation: 我想要建造两个木架子。 [wo xiang yao jian zao liang ge mu jia zi 。]

english: I'd like my hat stand fixed.
translation: 我想把我的帽架修好。 [wo xiang ba wo de mao jia xiu hao 。]

english: I'd like two Oak tables built.
translation: 我想要两张橡木桌子。 [wo xiang yao liang zhang xiang mu zhuo zi 。]

english: I'd like a Oak cupboard built.
translation: 我想要一个橡木橱柜。 [wo xiang yao yi ge xiang mu chu gui 。]

english: I'd like two Oak shelves built.
translation: 我想要建造两个橡木架子。 [wo xiang yao jian zao liang ge xiang mu jia zi 。]

english: I'd like two Teak tables built.
translation: 我想要两张柚木桌子。 [wo xiang yao liang zhang you mu zhuo zi 。]

english: I'd like a Teak cupboard built.
translation: 我想要一个柚木橱柜。 [wo xiang yao yi ge you mu chu gui 。]

english: I'd like two Teak shelves built.
translation: 我想要建造两个柚木架子。 [wo xiang yao jian zao liang ge you mu jia zi 。]

english: I'd like two Mahogany tables built.
translation: 我想要两张红木桌子。 [wo xiang yao liang zhang hong mu zhuo zi 。]

english: I'd like a Mahogany cupboard built.
translation: 我想要一个桃花心木橱柜。 [wo xiang yao yi ge tao hua xin mu chu gui 。]

english: I'd like two Mahogany shelves built.
translation: 我想要建造两个桃花心木架子。 [wo xiang yao jian zao liang ge tao hua xin mu jia zi 。]

english: I've finished with the work you wanted.
translation: 我已经完成了你想要的工作。 [wo yi jing wan cheng le ni xiang yao de gong zuo 。]

english: Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: 太感谢了！走之前你想喝杯茶吗？ [tai gan xie le ！ zou zhi qian ni xiang he bei cha ma ？]

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
translation: 是的，我想要一杯茶。 [shi de ， wo xiang yao yi bei cha 。]

english: No thanks, I better be off.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我最好离开了。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo zui hao li kai le 。]

english: Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!
translation: 啊啊，没有什么比一杯美味的茶更好的了！ [a a ， mei you shen me bi yi bei mei wei de cha geng hao de le ！]

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
translation: 是的，我想要一杯茶。 [shi de ， wo xiang yao yi bei cha 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Oh, hello. Have you got something you want preserving?
translation: 哦，你好。你有想要保留的东西吗？ [o ， ni hao 。 ni you xiang yao bao liu de dong xi ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Give it to me to look at then.
translation: 到时候给我看看吧。 [dao shi hou gei wo kan kan ba 。]

english: Not right now.
translation: 现在不行。 [xian zai bu xing 。]

english: Well, you go kill things so I can stuff them, eh?
translation: 好吧，你去杀掉一些东西，这样我就可以把它们塞进去，嗯？ [hao ba ， ni qu sha diao yi xie dong xi ， zhe yang wo jiu ke yi ba ta men sai jin qu ， n ？]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: If you bring me a monster head or a very big fish, I can preserve it for you so you can mount it in your house.
translation: 如果你给我带来一个怪物的头或一条很大的鱼，我可以为你保存它，这样你就可以把它挂在你的房子里。 [ru guo ni gei wo dai lai yi ge guai wu de tou huo yi tiao hen da de yu ， wo ke yi wei ni bao cun ta ， zhe yang ni jiu ke yi ba ta gua zai ni de fang zi li 。]

english: I hear there are all sorts of exotic creatures in the Slayer Tower -- I'd like a chance to stuff one of them!
translation: 听说屠宰塔里有各种各样的奇异生物——我想有机会塞进其中一只！ [ting shuo tu zai ta li you ge zhong ge yang de qi yi sheng wu —— wo xiang you ji hui sai jin qi zhong yi zhi ！]

english: Don't be silly, I can't preserve that!
translation: 别傻了，我保不住！ [bie sha le ， wo bao bu zhu ！]

english: Killing a chicken is hardly worth boasting about!
translation: 杀鸡根本不是什么值得夸耀的事！ [sha ji gen ben bu shi shen me zhi de kua yao de shi ！]

english: That's a pretty ordinary fish, isn't it? Not really worth preserving.
translation: 这是一条很普通的鱼，不是吗？实在不值得保存。 [zhe shi yi tiao hen pu tong de yu ， bu shi ma ？ shi zai bu zhi de bao cun 。]

english: You should have seen the one that got away!
translation: 你真该看看那个逃跑的人！ [ni zhen gai kan kan na ge tao pao de ren ！]

english: That's a mighty fine sea bass you've caught there.
translation: 那是你在那里钓到的一条非常好的鲈鱼。 [na shi ni zai na li diao dao de yi tiao fei chang hao de lu yu 。]

english: I can preserve that for you for 1,000 coins.
translation: 我可以花 1000 个硬币为你保留它。 [wo ke yi hua  1000  ge ying bi wei ni bao liu ta 。]

english: Maybe another time.
translation: 也许下次吧。 [ye xu xia ci ba 。]

english: There you go!
translation: 就这样吧！ [jiu zhe yang ba ！]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: All right, come back if you change your mind, eh?
translation: 好吧，如果你改变主意就回来吧？ [hao ba ， ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi jiu hui lai ba ？]

english: Don't point that thing at me!
translation: 别用那个东西指着我！ [bie yong na ge dong xi zhi zhe wo ！]

english: I can preserve that for you for 2,500 coins.
translation: 我可以花 2500 个硬币为你保留它。 [wo ke yi hua  2500  ge ying bi wei ni bao liu ta 。]

english: Goodness me! That thing's more of a weapon than a fish!
translation: 天哪我！那东西与其说是鱼，不如说是武器！ [tian na wo ！ na dong xi yu qi shuo shi yu ， bu ru shuo shi wu qi ！]

english: I can preserve that for you for 3,500 coins.
translation: 我可以花 3500 个硬币为你保留它。 [wo ke yi hua  3500  ge ying bi wei ni bao liu ta 。]

english: That's quite a fearsome shark! You've done everyone a service by removing it from the sea!
translation: 这是一条非常可怕的鲨鱼！你把它从海里捞出来，就为大家做了一件好事！ [zhe shi yi tiao fei chang ke pa de sha yu ！ ni ba ta cong hai li lao chu lai ， jiu wei da jia zuo le yi jian hao shi ！]

english: I can preserve that for you for 5,000 coins.
translation: 我可以花 5000 个硬币为你保留它。 [wo ke yi hua  5000  ge ying bi wei ni bao liu ta 。]

english: That's a very fine crawling hand.
translation: 这是一只非常优秀的爬行手。 [zhe shi yi zhi fei chang you xiu de pa xing shou 。]

english: A cockatrice! Beautiful, isn't it? Look at the plumage!
translation: 一只鸡蛇！很漂亮，不是吗？看看羽毛！ [yi zhi ji she ！ hen piao liang ， bu shi ma ？ kan kan yu mao ！]

english: I can preserve that for you for 2,000 coins.
translation: 我可以花 2000 个硬币为你保留它。 [wo ke yi hua  2000  ge ying bi wei ni bao liu ta 。]

english: My, he's a scary-looking fellow, isn't he? He'll look good on your wall!
translation: 天哪，他是个看起来很可怕的家伙，不是吗？他挂在你的墙上一定会很漂亮！ [tian na ， ta shi ge kan qi lai hen ke pa de jia huo ， bu shi ma ？ ta gua zai ni de qiang shang yi ding hui hen piao liang ！]

english: I can preserve that for you for 4,000 coins.
translation: 我可以用 4000 个硬币为你保留它。 [wo ke yi yong  4000  ge ying bi wei ni bao liu ta 。]

english: A kurask? Splendid! Look at those horns!
translation: 库拉斯克？灿烂！看看那些角！ [ku la si ke ？ can lan ！ kan kan na xie jiao ！]

english: I can preserve that for you for 6,000 coins.
translation: 我可以用六千金币为你保留它。 [wo ke yi yong liu qian jin bi wei ni bao liu ta 。]

english: Goodness, an abyssal demon!
translation: 天啊，深渊恶魔！ [tian a ， shen yuan e mo ！]

english: See how it's still glowing? I'll have to use some magic to preserve that.
translation: 看看它怎么还在发光？我必须使用一些魔法来保存它。 [kan kan ta zen me hai zai fa guang ？ wo bi xu shi yong yi xie mo fa lai bao cun ta 。]

english: I can preserve that for you for 12,000 coins.
translation: 我可以用 12,000 个硬币为你保留它。 [wo ke yi yong  12,000  ge ying bi wei ni bao liu ta 。]

english: Three?! This must be a King Black Dragon!
translation: 三？！这肯定是黑龙王！ [san ？！ zhe ken ding shi hei long wang ！]

english: I'll have to get out my heavy duty tools -- this skin's as tough as iron!
translation: 我得拿出我的重型工具——这皮肤坚如铁！ [wo de na chu wo de zhong xing gong ju —— zhe pi fu jian ru tie ！]

english: I can preserve that for you for 50,000 coins.
translation: 我可以花五万金币为你保留它。 [wo ke yi hua wu wan jin bi wei ni bao liu ta 。]

english: That must be the biggest kalphite I've ever seen!
translation: 这一定是我见过的最大的卡金石了！ [zhe yi ding shi wo jian guo de zui da de ka jin shi le ！]

english: Preserving insects is always tricky. I'll have to be careful...
translation: 保护昆虫总是很棘手的。我得小心点... [bao hu kun chong zong shi hen ji shou de 。 wo de xiao xin dian ...]

english: That's not the most impressive head I've seen but I think I can just about manage this one.
translation: 这不是我见过的最令人印象深刻的头，但我想我可以驾驭这个。 [zhe bu shi wo jian guo de zui ling ren yin xiang shen ke de tou ， dan wo xiang wo ke yi jia yu zhe ge 。]

english: This blue dragon smells like it's been dead for a remarkably long time. Even by my standards, it smells awful.
translation: 这条蓝龙闻起来就像死了很长时间一样。即使按照我的标准，它闻起来也很难闻。 [zhe tiao lan long wen qi lai jiu xiang si le hen zhang shi jian yi yang 。 ji shi an zhao wo de biao zhun ， ta wen qi lai ye hen nan wen 。]

english: This hydra looks like it might fall to pieces soon. I'll have to be careful to preserve it properly.
translation: 这只九头蛇看起来很快就会崩溃。我必须小心翼翼地妥善保存它。 [zhe zhi jiu tou she kan qi lai hen kuai jiu hui beng kui 。 wo bi xu xiao xin yi yi di tuo shan bao cun ta 。]

english: Yes please
translation: 是的，请 [shi de ， qing]

english: Not right now
translation: 现在不行 [xian zai bu xing]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: No thanks
translation: 不，谢谢 [bu ， xie xie]

english: The killer appears from a closet, stabbing Tayten, who is reading a book.
translation: 凶手从壁橱里出现，刺伤了正在读书的泰滕。 [xiong shou cong bi chu li chu xian ， ci shang le zheng zai du shu de tai teng 。]

english: Gurgle...
translation: 咕咕…… [gu gu ……]

english: Nooooo!
translation: 不哦！ [bu o ！]

english: The killer slips a note under the door, and escapes using the closet.
translation: 凶手在门下塞了一张纸条，然后利用壁橱逃跑了。 [xiong shou zai men xia sai le yi zhang zhi tiao ， ran hou li yong bi chu tao pao le 。]

english: What's this? A note? I guess I should read it.
translation: 这是什么？一张纸条？我想我应该读一下。 [zhe shi shen me ？ yi zhang zhi tiao ？ wo xiang wo ying gai du yi xia 。]

english: Greetings! Are you in need of refreshment?
translation: 问候！您需要茶点吗？ [wen hou ！ nin xu yao cha dian ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: What are you selling?
translation: 你卖什么？ [ni mai shen me ？]

english: Only the most delicious infusion of the leaves of the tea plant. Grown in the exotic regions of this world. Buy yourself a cup !
translation: 只有最美味的茶树叶子冲泡。生长在这个世界的异国地区。给自己买一杯！ [zhi you zui mei wei de cha shu ye zi chong pao 。 sheng zhang zai zhe ge shi jie de yi guo di qu 。 gei zi ji mai yi bei ！]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Well, if you're sure. You know where to come if you do!
translation: 好吧，如果你确定的话。如果你知道的话，你就知道该去哪里！ [hao ba ， ru guo ni que ding de hua 。 ru guo ni zhi dao de hua ， ni jiu zhi dao gai qu na li ！]

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
translation: 嘿！把你的手拿开！ [hei ！ ba ni de shou na kai ！]

english: You're the one who stole something from me!
translation: 你就是偷了我东西的人！ [ni jiu shi tou le wo dong xi de ren ！]

english: Guardsguards!
translation: 卫兵！ [wei bing ！]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: What are you selling?
translation: 你卖什么？ [ni mai shen me ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Stop pulling, we've plenty of time to see everything.
translation: 停止拉扯，我们有足够的时间来参观一切。 [ting zhi la che ， wo men you zu gou de shi jian lai can guan yi qie 。]

english: Aww, but miss, it's sooo exciting.
translation: 哇哦，但是小姐，这太令人兴奋了。 [wa o ， dan shi xiao jie ， zhe tai ling ren xing fen le 。]

english: That man over there talks funny, miss.
translation: 那边那个人说话很有趣，小姐。 [na bian na ge ren shuo hua hen you qu ， xiao jie 。]

english: That's because he's an art critic, dear. They have some very funny ideas.
translation: 那是因为他是一位艺术评论家，亲爱的。他们有一些非常有趣的想法。 [na shi yin wei ta shi yi wei yi shu ping lun jia ， qin ai de 。 ta men you yi xie fei chang you qu de xiang fa 。]

english: Go away. We don't want any.
translation: 离开。我们什么都不想要。 [li kai 。 wo men shen me dou bu xiang yao 。]

english: I'm a friend of Jethick's, I have come to return a book he borrowed.
translation: 我是杰西克的朋友，我来还他借的书。 [wo shi jie xi ke de peng you ， wo lai hai ta jie de shu 。]

english: Oh... Why didn't you say, come in then.
translation: 噢……你怎么不说，那就进来吧。 [o …… ni zen me bu shuo ， na jiu jin lai ba 。]

english: Thanks, I've been missing that.
translation: 谢谢，我一直想念这个。 [xie xie ， wo yi zhi xiang nian zhe ge 。]

english: Hi, I hear a woman called Elena is staying here.
translation: 嗨，我听说一位名叫埃琳娜的女士住在这里。 [hai ， wo ting shuo yi wei ming jiao ai lin na de nv shi zhu zai zhe li 。]

english: Yes she was staying here, but slightly over a week ago she was getting ready to go back. However she never managed to leave.
translation: 是的，她住在这里，但一周多前她正准备回去。然而她始终没能离开。 [shi de ， ta zhu zai zhe li ， dan yi zhou duo qian ta zheng zhun bei hui qu 。 ran er ta shi zhong mei neng li kai 。]

english: My daughter Milli was playing near the west wall when she saw some shadowy figures jump out and grab her. Milli is upstairs if you wish to speak to her.
translation: 我女儿米莉正在西墙附近玩耍，突然看到一些黑影跳出来抓住了她。如果你想和米莉说话，她就在楼上。 [wo nv er mi li zheng zai xi qiang fu jin wan shua ， tu ran kan dao yi xie hei ying tiao chu lai zhua zhu le ta 。 ru guo ni xiang he mi li shuo hua ， ta jiu zai lou shang 。]

english: Any luck finding Elena yet?
translation: 找到埃琳娜还有运气吗？ [zhao dao ai lin na hai you yun qi ma ？]

english: Not yet...
translation: 还没有... [hai mei you ...]

english: I wish you luck, she did a lot for us.
translation: 祝你好运，她为我们做了很多。 [zhu ni hao yun ， ta wei wo men zuo le hen duo 。]

english: Yes, she is safe at home now.
translation: 是的，她现在安全在家。 [shi de ， ta xian zai an quan zai jia 。]

english: That's good to hear, she helped us a lot.
translation: 很高兴听到这个消息，她帮助了我们很多。 [hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi ， ta bang zhu le wo men hen duo 。]

english: Good day friend.
translation: 美好的一天朋友。 [mei hao de yi tian peng you 。]

english: Hello [player name]! Thanks again for your help with the dig.
translation: 你好[玩家姓名]！再次感谢您对挖掘的帮助。 [ni hao [ wan jia xing ming ]！ zai ci gan xie nin dui wa jue de bang zhu 。]

english: Bartak used the design of the shield you extracted to recreate a shield like it. Even though the original shield was poorly made, the design itself was a good one.
translation: 巴塔克利用你提取的盾牌的设计重新制作了一个类似的盾牌。尽管最初的盾牌制作很差，但设计本身还是不错的。 [ba ta ke li yong ni ti qu de dun pai de she ji chong xin zhi zuo le yi ge lei si de dun pai 。 jin guan zui chu de dun pai zhi zuo hen cha ， dan she ji ben shen hai shi bu cuo de 。]

english: Perhaps there is some important knowledge that we have lost since the early, more war-like days of Dorgesh- Kaan.
translation: 也许自从多尔格什-卡恩早期的、更像战争的日子以来，我们已经失去了一些重要的知识。 [ye xu zi cong duo er ge shen - ka en zao qi de 、 geng xiang zhan zheng de ri zi yi lai ， wo men yi jing shi qu le yi xie zhong yao de zhi shi 。]

english: The helmet you helped to unearth has come in useful. I used it as a visual aid when I went to talk to the children in the nursery about our history.
translation: 你帮助发掘的头盔派上了用场。当我去托儿所和孩子们谈论我们的历史时，我用它作为视觉辅助工具。 [ni bang zhu fa jue de tou kui pai shang le yong chang 。 dang wo qu tuo er suo he hai zi men tan lun wo men de li shi shi ， wo yong ta zuo wei shi jue fu zhu gong ju 。]

english: It's amazing that the ancient goblins' eyes were even smaller than a child's!
translation: 令人惊奇的是，远古妖精的眼睛比小孩子的眼睛还小！ [ling ren jing qi de shi ， yuan gu yao jing de yan jing bi xiao hai zi de yan jing hai xiao ！]

english: Oldak examined the axe blade you dug up and found that it had a faint magical aura. It looks like the mace wasn't the only magical weapon our ancestors brought from the surface.
translation: 奥达克检查了你挖出的斧刃，发现它有淡淡的魔法气息。看起来狼牙棒并不是我们的祖先从地表带来的唯一魔法武器。 [ao da ke jian cha le ni wa chu de fu ren ， fa xian ta you dan dan de mo fa qi xi 。 kan qi lai lang ya bang bing bu shi wo men de zu xian cong di biao dai lai de wei yi mo fa wu qi 。]

english: In fact, it could be that a lot of their equipment was magical. This means that either the ancient goblins were skilled magical craftsmen, or some other power was supplying them with magical equipment.
translation: 事实上，可能他们的很多装备都是有魔法的。这意味着，要么远古妖精是熟练的魔法工匠，要么是有其他力量在为他们提供魔法装备。 [shi shi shang ， ke neng ta men de hen duo zhuang bei dou shi you mo fa de 。 zhe yi wei zhe ， yao me yuan gu yao jing shi shu lian de mo fa gong jiang ， yao me shi you qi ta li liang zai wei ta men ti gong mo fa zhuang bei 。]

english: We used the armour fragment you unearthed to reconstruct the shape of the original armour, and with it the shape of the goblin who wore the armour.
translation: 我们用你出土的盔甲碎片重建了原始盔甲的形状，以及穿着该盔甲的哥布林的形状。 [wo men yong ni chu tu de kui jia sui pian chong jian le yuan shi kui jia de xing zhuang ， yi ji chuan zhe gai kui jia di ge bu lin de xing zhuang 。]

english: This told us a lot about how the goblin body shape changed from its surface form to that of the cave goblins.
translation: 这告诉我们很多关于地精身体形状如何从表面形态转变为洞穴地精的信息。 [zhe gao su wo men hen duo guan yu di jing shen ti xing zhuang ru he cong biao mian xing tai zhuan bian wei dong xue di jing de xin xi 。]

english: When we examined the sword you dug up, we found that the blade is covered in tiny symbols.
translation: 当我们检查你挖出的剑时，我们发现剑刃上覆盖着微小的符号。 [dang wo men jian cha ni wa chu de jian shi ， wo men fa xian jian ren shang fu gai zhe wei xiao de fu hao 。]

english: The scribe thinks he has enough of them to begin understanding the ancient goblin language, but it will take a while for him to decipher them.
translation: 抄写员认为他已经掌握了足够的信息来开始理解古老的妖精语言，但他需要一段时间才能破译它们。 [chao xie yuan ren wei ta yi jing zhang wo le zu gou de xin xi lai kai shi li jie gu lao de yao jing yu yan ， dan ta xu yao yi duan shi jian cai neng po yi ta men 。]

english: I lost the ancient goblin mace.
translation: 我丢失了古老的妖精狼牙棒。 [wo diu shi le gu lao de yao jing lang ya bang 。]

english: I know. Zanik says she found it lying around in the caves near the city, almost as if it had made its way back here and wanted her to find it.
translation: 我知道。扎尼克说，她在城市附近的洞穴里发现了它，就好像它已经回到这里并想让她找到它一样。 [wo zhi dao 。 zha ni ke shuo ， ta zai cheng shi fu jin de dong xue li fa xian le ta ， jiu hao xiang ta yi jing hui dao zhe li bing xiang rang ta zhao dao ta yi yang 。]

english: I know. We found it lying around in the caves near the city, almost as if it had made its way back here and wanted to be found.
translation: 我知道。我们发现它躺在城市附近的洞穴里，就好像它已经回到这里并想要被发现一样。 [wo zhi dao 。 wo men fa xian ta tang zai cheng shi fu jin de dong xue li ， jiu hao xiang ta yi jing hui dao zhe li bing xiang yao bei fa xian yi yang 。]

english: If you want it back, I will sell it to you for 1,000 coins. That should discourage you from losing it again.
translation: 如果你想要回来，我就以1000金币的价格卖给你。这应该会阻止您再次失去它。 [ru guo ni xiang yao hui lai ， wo jiu yi 1000 jin bi de jia ge mai gei ni 。 zhe ying gai hui zu zhi nin zai ci shi qu ta 。]

english: Okay.
translation: 好的。 [hao de 。]

english: But I'll have to go and get the money.
translation: 但我得去拿钱。 [dan wo de qu na qian 。]

english: But I should free up some inventory space first.
translation: 但我应该先释放一些库存空间。 [dan wo ying gai xian shi fang yi xie ku cun kong jian 。]

translation: 我丢失了古老的妖精狼牙棒 [wo diu shi le gu lao de yao jing lang ya bang]

translation: 是的。这对你来说是什么？ [shi de 。 zhe dui ni lai shuo shi shen me ？]

translation: 血迹是……嗯，我用的肥皂几乎可以清洁任何污渍。 [xue ji shi …… n ， wo yong de fei zao ji hu ke yi qing jie ren he wu zi 。]

translation: 真的吗？！？这听起来正是我需要的东西，我可以使用一些吗？ [zhen de ma ？！？ zhe ting qi lai zheng shi wo xu yao de dong xi ， wo ke yi shi yong yi xie ma ？]

english: No, I don't have very much soap left and I still have lots to get clean.
translation: 不，我已经没有多少肥皂了，而且还有很多东西需要清洁。 [bu ， wo yi jing mei you duo shao fei zao le ， er qie hai you hen duo dong xi xu yao qing jie 。]

translation: 你不能……我是按照我自己的秘方做的。 [ni bu neng …… wo shi an zhao wo zi ji de mi fang zuo de 。]

english: Could you be less helpful?
translation: 你能少帮忙一点吗？ [ni neng shao bang mang yi dian ma ？]

translation: 就像你一样，从我的晾衣绳上拿那些长袍？所以，是的，如果你知道有什么方法可以减少我的帮助，请告诉我。我会尝试一下。 [jiu xiang ni yi yang ， cong wo de liang yi sheng shang na na xie chang pao ？ suo yi ， shi de ， ru guo ni zhi dao you shen me fang fa ke yi jian shao wo de bang zhu ， qing gao su wo 。 wo hui chang shi yi xia 。]

english: Hi.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: What do I have to do in this room?
translation: 我必须在这个房间里做什么？ [wo bi xu zai zhe ge fang jian li zuo shen me ？]

english: In this room you will see a maze within which one of my fellow Guardians has been turned to stone for the purposes of this exercise. You must move the statue using your telekinetic grab spell to the exit square at
translation: 在这个房间里，你会看到一个迷宫，为了这个练习的目的，我的一位守护者同伴在迷宫中被变成了石头。您必须使用心灵感应抓取咒语将雕像移动到出口广场 [zai zhe ge fang jian li ， ni hui kan dao yi ge mi gong ， wei le zhe ge lian xi de mu di ， wo de yi wei shou hu zhe tong ban zai mi gong zhong bei bian cheng le shi tou 。 nin bi xu shi yong xin ling gan ying zhua qu zhou yu jiang diao xiang yi dong dao chu kou guang chang]

english: the edge of the maze to bring the Guardian back to life. Simply stand on the side that you wish for the statue to travel towards and cast the spell on the statue. Once you have solved the maze, the statue will change back
translation: 迷宫边缘让守护者复活。只需站在您希望雕像移动的一侧并对雕像施放咒语即可。一旦你解决了迷宫，雕像就会变回来 [mi gong bian yuan rang shou hu zhe fu huo 。 zhi xu zhan zai nin xi wang diao xiang yi dong de yi ce bing dui diao xiang shi fang zhou yu ji ke 。 yi dan ni jie jue le mi gong ， diao xiang jiu hui bian hui lai]

english: into the Guardian and he will award you with Telekinetic Pizazz Points and teleport you to the next maze. You can switch to a better view of the maze by selecting the 'Observe' option on the statue and return
translation: 进入守护者，他会奖励你心灵传动乐趣点，并将你传送到下一个迷宫。您可以通过选择雕像上的“观察”选项并返回来切换到迷宫的更好视图 [jin ru shou hu zhe ， ta hui jiang li ni xin ling chuan dong le qu dian ， bing jiang ni chuan song dao xia yi ge mi gong 。 nin ke yi tong guo xuan ze diao xiang shang de “ guan cha ” xuan xiang bing fan hui lai qie huan dao mi gong de geng hao shi tu]

english: your view to normal by selecting the same option again. There is also a 'Reset' option on the statue just in case things aren't going too well.
translation: 再次选择相同的选项，您的视图将恢复正常。雕像上还有一个“重置”选项，以防万一事情进展不太顺利。 [zai ci xuan ze xiang tong de xuan xiang ， nin de shi tu jiang hui fu zheng chang 。 diao xiang shang hai you yi ge “ zhong zhi ” xuan xiang ， yi fang wan yi shi qing jin zhan bu tai shun li 。]

english: What are the rewards?
translation: 有什么奖励？ [you shen me jiang li ？]

english: As well as the experience in casting magic, you will get Telekinetic Pizazz Points for each maze successfully solved and bonus points for completing five mazes in a row without returning to the entrance.
translation: 除了施展魔法的经验之外，成功解决每个迷宫您还将获得心灵传动乐趣积分，连续完成五个迷宫而无需返回入口即可获得奖励积分。 [chu le shi zhan mo fa de jing yan zhi wai ， cheng gong jie jue mei ge mi gong nin hai jiang huo de xin ling chuan dong le qu ji fen ， lian xu wan cheng wu ge mi gong er wu xu fan hui ru kou ji ke huo de jiang li ji fen 。]

english: Got any tips that may help me?
translation: 有什么建议可以帮助我吗？ [you shen me jian yi ke yi bang zhu wo ma ？]

english: won't be progressing towards collecting Telekinetic Pizazz Points. Lastly, all the mazes can be solved in ten moves or less.
translation: 不会在收集心灵传动乐趣点方面取得进展。最后，所有迷宫都可以在十步或更短的时间内解决。 [bu hui zai shou ji xin ling chuan dong le qu dian fang mian qu de jin zhan 。 zui hou ， suo you mi gong dou ke yi zai shi bu huo geng duan de shi jian nei jie jue 。]

english: Thanks, bye!
translation: 谢谢，再见！ [xie xie ， zai jian ！]

translation: 年轻人，运用你所学到的知识。 [nian qing ren ， yun yong ni suo xue dao de zhi shi 。]

english: You! Time for some questions.
translation: 你！是时候问一些问题了。 [ni ！ shi shi hou wen yi xie wen ti le 。]

english: Why did you join the Emissaries?
translation: 你为什么加入使者？ [ni wei shen me jia ru shi zhe ？]

english: To do my duty, of course. Ralos and Ranul wish us to bring about the end of this world. Only then will we see the birth of a new one.
translation: 当然是为了履行我的职责。拉洛斯和拉努尔希望我们能够实现这个世界的终结。只有那时我们才会看到一个新的诞生。 [dang ran shi wei le lv xing wo de zhi ze 。 la luo si he la nu er xi wang wo men neng gou shi xian zhe ge shi jie de zhong jie 。 zhi you na shi wo men cai hui kan dao yi ge xin de dan sheng 。]

english: To do my duty, of course. Ralos and Ranul wish us to bring about the end of this world. Only then will we will all unite in Mictl.
translation: 当然是为了履行我的职责。拉洛斯和拉努尔希望我们能够实现这个世界的终结。只有这样，我们才会团结在 Mictl。 [dang ran shi wei le lv xing wo de zhi ze 。 la luo si he la nu er xi wang wo men neng gou shi xian zhe ge shi jie de zhong jie 。 zhi you zhe yang ， wo men cai hui tuan jie zai  Mictl。]

english: Who do you worship?
translation: 你崇拜谁？ [ni chong bai shui ？]

english: I worship both Ralos and Ranul equally, for in reality they are one. They have been separated for now, but soon they will rejoin once more.
translation: 我同样崇拜拉洛斯和拉努尔，因为实际上他们是一体的。他们暂时分开了，但很快他们就会再次相聚。 [wo tong yang chong bai la luo si he la nu er ， yin wei shi ji shang ta men shi yi ti de 。 ta men zan shi fen kai le ， dan hen kuai ta men jiu hui zai ci xiang ju 。]

english: Tell me about the Final Dawn.
translation: 跟我讲讲《最后的黎明》吧。 [gen wo jiang jiang 《 zui hou de li ming 》 ba 。]

english: The Final Dawn is our destiny. Ralos and Ranul will unite us all and end this world, but in doing so, we will all play a part in forming a new one.
translation: 最后的黎明是我们的命运。拉洛斯和拉努尔将团结我们所有人并终结这个世界，但在这样做的过程中，我们都将在形成一个新世界的过程中发挥作用。 [zui hou de li ming shi wo men de ming yun 。 la luo si he la nu er jiang tuan jie wo men suo you ren bing zhong jie zhe ge shi jie ， dan zai zhe yang zuo de guo cheng zhong ， wo men dou jiang zai xing cheng yi ge xin shi jie de guo cheng zhong fa hui zuo yong 。]

english: The Final Dawn is our destiny. Ralos and Ranul will unite us all and end this world, but in doing so, they will grant us eternal life in Mictl.
translation: 最后的黎明是我们的命运。拉洛斯和拉努尔将团结我们所有人并终结这个世界，但这样做时，他们将在米克特尔赋予我们永恒的生命。 [zui hou de li ming shi wo men de ming yun 。 la luo si he la nu er jiang tuan jie wo men suo you ren bing zhong jie zhe ge shi jie ， dan zhe yang zuo shi ， ta men jiang zai mi ke te er fu yu wo men yong heng de sheng ming 。]

translation: 今天没奶！谢谢你！ [jin tian mei nai ！ xie xie ni ！]

translation: 我可以买一些登山靴吗？ [wo ke yi mai yi xie deng shan xue ma ？]

english: Sure, I'll sell you some in your size for 12 gold.
translation: 当然，我会以 12 金币的价格卖给你一些适合你的尺寸。 [dang ran ， wo hui yi  12  jin bi de jia ge mai gei ni yi xie shi he ni de chi cun 。]

translation: 好的，听起来不错。 [hao de ， ting qi lai bu cuo 。]

translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: We are expert guides that take adventurers, such as yourself, on mountaineering expeditions.
translation: 我们是专业导游，带领像您这样的冒险家进行登山探险。 [wo men shi zhuan ye dao you ， dai ling xiang nin zhe yang de mao xian jia jin xing deng shan tan xian 。]

translation: 你是怎么知道秘道的？ [ni shi zen me zhi dao mi dao de ？]

english: I used to take adventurers up Death Plateau and further north before the trolls came. I know these mountains well.
translation: 在巨魔到来之前，我常常带着冒险家登上死亡高原并进一步向北。我很了解这些山。 [zai ju mo dao lai zhi qian ， wo chang chang dai zhe mao xian jia deng shang si wang gao yuan bing jin yi bu xiang bei 。 wo hen liao jie zhe xie shan 。]

translation: 你这里的地方真好。 [ni zhe li de di fang zhen hao 。]

translation: 谢谢，我自己建的！我通常可以自给自足，但在死亡高原露营的巨魔那里我赚不到任何钱。 [xie xie ， wo zi ji jian de ！ wo tong chang ke yi zi ji zi zu ， dan zai si wang gao yuan lu ying de ju mo na li wo zhuan bu dao ren he qian 。]

translation: 嘿，这是英雄！哇！你太厉害了，你到底是怎么对付那两个少年和加德兰克的？这个小镇很可爱，你做得很好！ [hei ， zhe shi ying xiong ！ wa ！ ni tai li hai le ， ni dao di shi zen me dui fu na liang ge shao nian he jia de lan ke de ？ zhe ge xiao zhen hen ke ai ， ni zuo de hen hao ！]

translation: 非常完美，非常感谢您的努力。 [fei chang wan mei ， fei chang gan xie nin de nu li 。]

translation: 这附近发生了什么事？ [zhe fu jin fa sheng le shen me shi ？]

english: Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
