translation: 你好，这个翻译对阿斯伽尼亚有用吗？ [ni hao ， zhe ge fan yi dui a si ga ni ya you yong ma ？]

english: I think it was, thanks!
translation: 我想是的，谢谢！ [wo xiang shi de ， xie xie ！]

english: Hello again. I am now studying this mysterious altar and its inhabitants. The markings are strange...
translation: 又好。我现在正在研究这个神秘的祭坛和它的居民。标记很奇怪... [you hao 。 wo xian zai zheng zai yan jiu zhe ge shen mi de ji tan he ta de ju min 。 biao ji hen qi guai ...]

english: It refers to a god I have never heard of before, named Zaros. It must be some pagan superstition.
translation: 它指的是一个我以前从未听说过的神，名叫扎罗斯。这一定是某种异教迷信。 [ta zhi de shi yi ge wo yi qian cong wei ting shuo guo de shen ， ming jiao zha luo si 。 zhe yi ding shi mou zhong yi jiao mi xin 。]

english: That was a great find; who knows what other secrets lie buried beneath the surface of our land...
translation: 这是一个伟大的发现；谁知道我们的土地下还埋藏着什么其他秘密...... [zhe shi yi ge wei da de fa xian ； shui zhi dao wo men de tu di xia hai mai cang zhe shen me qi ta mi mi ......]

english: That staff is incredible! It's the same symbol that was on that talisman you found here. Does this mean you've found out more about Zaros?
translation: 那个工作人员太不可思议了！这和你在这里找到的护身符上的符号是一样的。这是否意味着您对 Zaros 有更多了解？ [na ge gong zuo ren yuan tai bu ke si yi le ！ zhe he ni zai zhe li zhao dao de hu shen fu shang de fu hao shi yi yang de 。 zhe shi fou yi wei zhe nin dui  Zaros  you geng duo liao jie ？]

english: I found out that he was banished, and that the people's hero was trapped in a pyramid and...
translation: 我发现他被放逐了，人民英雄被困在金字塔里了…… [wo fa xian ta bei fang zhu le ， ren min ying xiong bei kun zai jin zi ta li le ……]

english: So you're the one who found out about that. I've heard the story from my friends in the museum. Well done on being able to wield such an impressive symbol.
translation: 所以你是发现这一情况的人。这个故事是我从博物馆里的朋友那里听来的。能够使用如此令人印象深刻的符号真是太棒了。 [suo yi ni shi fa xian zhe yi qing kuang de ren 。 zhe ge gu shi shi wo cong bo wu guan li de peng you na li ting lai de 。 neng gou shi yong ru ci ling ren yin xiang shen ke de fu hao zhen shi tai bang le 。]

english: Anyway....
translation: 反正.... [fan zheng ....]

english: What do you think of this?
translation: 您对此有何看法？ [nin dui ci you he kan fa ？]

english: Do you know what this is?
translation: 你知道这是什么吗？ [ni zhi dao zhe shi shen me ma ？]

english: Where did you get this?
translation: 你从哪里得到这个？ [ni cong na li de dao zhe ge ？]

english: From one of the barrels at the digsite.
translation: 来自挖掘现场的一个桶。 [lai zi wa jue xian chang de yi ge tong 。]

english: This is a VERY dangerous liquid called nitroglycerin. Be careful how you handle it. Don't drop it or it will explode!
translation: 这是一种非常危险的液体，称为硝化甘油。小心你的处理方式。不要掉落它，否则它会爆炸！ [zhe shi yi zhong fei chang wei xian de ye ti ， cheng wei xiao hua gan you 。 xiao xin ni de chu li fang shi 。 bu yao diao luo ta ， fou ze ta hui bao zha ！]

english: Can you tell me any more about this?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于这个的信息吗？ [ni neng gao su wo geng duo guan yu zhe ge de xin xi ma ？]

english: Nitroglycerin! This is a dangerous substance. This is normally mixed with other chemicals to produce a potent compound.
translation: 硝酸甘油！这是一种危险物质。它通常与其他化学品混合以产生有效的化合物。 [xiao suan gan you ！ zhe shi yi zhong wei xian wu zhi 。 ta tong chang yu qi ta hua xue pin hun he yi chan sheng you xiao de hua he wu 。]

english: Be sure not to drop it! That stuff is highly volatile...
translation: 一定不要丢掉它！那玩意儿的波动性很大... [yi ding bu yao diu diao ta ！ na wan yi er de bo dong xing hen da ...]

english: Have a look at this.
translation: 看看这个。 [kan kan zhe ge 。]

english: Really, you do find the most unusual items. I know what this is - it's a strong chemical called ammonium nitrate. Why you want this I'll never know...
translation: 确实，您确实找到了最不寻常的物品。我知道这是什么 - 这是一种叫做硝酸铵的强化学物质。为什么你想要这个我永远不会知道...... [que shi ， nin que shi zhao dao le zui bu xun chang de wu pin 。 wo zhi dao zhe shi shen me  -  zhe shi yi zhong jiao zuo xiao suan an de qiang hua xue wu zhi 。 wei shen me ni xiang yao zhe ge wo yong yuan bu hui zhi dao ......]

english: Hey, look at this.
translation: 嘿，看看这个。 [hei ， kan kan zhe ge 。]

english: Hmm, that looks dangerous. Handle it carefully and don't drop it!
translation: 嗯，这看起来很危险。小心处理，不要掉落！ [n ， zhe kan qi lai hen wei xian 。 xiao xin chu li ， bu yao diao luo ！]

english: See what I have done with the compound now.
translation: 看看我现在对这个化合物做了什么。 [kan kan wo xian zai dui zhe ge hua he wu zuo le shen me 。]

english: Seriously, I think you have a death wish! What on earth are you going to do with that stuff?
translation: 说真的，我觉得你想死！你到底打算用这些东西做什么？ [shuo zhen de ， wo jue de ni xiang si ！ ni dao di da suan yong zhe xie dong xi zuo shen me ？]

english: I'll find a use for it!
translation: 我会找到它的用途的！ [wo hui zhao dao ta de yong tu de ！]

english: What do you think about this?
translation: 您对此有何看法？ [nin dui ci you he kan fa ？]

english: What have you concocted now? Just be careful when playing with chemicals!
translation: 你现在炮制了什么？玩化学品时要小心！ [ni xian zai pao zhi le shen me ？ wan hua xue pin shi yao xiao xin ！]

english: I have these gold nuggets...
translation: 我有这些金块... [wo you zhe xie jin kuai ...]

english: I can't do much with these nuggets yet. Come back when you have 3 and I will exchange them for you.
translation: 我还不能用这些金块做太多事情。等你有3个再回来我给你换。 [wo hai bu neng yong zhe xie jin kuai zuo tai duo shi qing 。 deng ni you 3 ge zai hui lai wo gei ni huan 。]

english: Good – that's three; I can exchange them for normalgold now. You can get this refined and make a profit!
translation: 好——那是三个；我现在可以把它们换成普通金币了。您可以将其精炼并赚取利润！ [hao —— na shi san ge ； wo xian zai ke yi ba ta men huan cheng pu tong jin bi le 。 nin ke yi jiang qi jing lian bing zhuan qu li run ！]

english: Excellent!
translation: 出色的！ [chu se de ！]

english: I found a needle.
translation: 我找到了一根针。 [wo zhao dao le yi gen zhen 。]

english: Hmm, yes; I wondered why this race were so well dressed! It looks like they had mastery of needlework.
translation: 嗯，是的；我想知道为什么这个比赛穿得这么好！看来她们对针线活有着很高的造诣。 [n ， shi de ； wo xiang zhi dao wei shen me zhe ge bi sai chuan de zhe me hao ！ kan lai ta men dui zhen xian huo you zhe hen gao de zao yi 。]

english: I found these...
translation: 我找到了这些... [wo zhao dao le zhe xie ...]

english: Ew! Throw them away this instant!
translation: 呃！立刻把它们扔掉！ [e ！ li ke ba ta men reng diao ！]

english: Have a look at this glass.
translation: 看看这个玻璃。 [kan kan zhe ge bo li 。]

english: Hey you should be careful of that. It might cut your fingers, throw it away!
translation: 嘿，你应该小心这一点。它可能会割伤你的手指，扔掉它！ [hei ， ni ying gai xiao xin zhe yi dian 。 ta ke neng hui ge shang ni de shou zhi ， reng diao ta ！]

english: Have a look at this arrow.
translation: 看看这个箭头。 [kan kan zhe ge jian tou 。]

english: No doubt this arrow was shot by a strong warrior – it'ssplit in half! It is not a valuable object though.
translation: 毫无疑问，这支箭是由一位强大的战士射出的——它被分成了两半！但它并不是一件有价值的物品。 [hao wu yi wen ， zhe zhi jian shi you yi wei qiang da de zhan shi she chu de —— ta bei fen cheng le liang ban ！ dan ta bing bu shi yi jian you jia zhi de wu pin 。]

english: I have no need for panning trays!
translation: 我不需要平移托盘！ [wo bu xu yao ping yi tuo pan ！]

english: Have you searched this tray yet?
translation: 您搜索过这个托盘了吗？ [nin sou suo guo zhe ge tuo pan le ma ？]

english: Not that I remember...
translation: 不是我记得的... [bu shi wo ji de de ...]

english: It may contain something; I don't want to get my hands dirty.
translation: 它可能包含一些东西；我不想弄脏我的手。 [ta ke neng bao han yi xie dong xi ； wo bu xiang nong zang wo de shou 。]

english: The expert hands the tray back to you.
translation: 专家将托盘交还给您。 [zhuan jia jiang tuo pan jiao huan gei nin 。]

english: Have a look at these bones.
translation: 看看这些骨头。 [kan kan zhe xie gu tou 。]

english: Ah, yes – a fine bone example... no noticeable fractures...and in good condition. These are common cow bones,however; they have no archaeological value.
translation: 啊，是的——一个很好的骨头例子……没有明显的骨折……而且状况良好。然而，这些都是常见的牛骨；它们没有考古价值。 [a ， shi de —— yi ge hen hao de gu tou li zi …… mei you ming xian de gu zhe …… er qie zhuang kuang liang hao 。 ran er ， zhe xie dou shi chang jian de niu gu ； ta men mei you kao gu jia zhi 。]

english: I found these buttons.
translation: 我找到了这些按钮。 [wo zhao dao le zhe xie an niu 。]

english: Let's have a look. Ah, I think these are from the nobility, perhaps a royal servant?
translation: 我们来看看吧。啊，我想这些都是贵族的人，也许是皇家仆人？ [wo men lai kan kan ba 。 a ， wo xiang zhe xie dou shi gui zu de ren ， ye xu shi huang jia pu ren ？]

english: I found this rock...
translation: 我发现了这块石头... [wo fa xian le zhe kuai shi tou ...]

english: What a shame it's cracked; this looks like it would have been a good sample.
translation: 可惜它裂了；这看起来是一个很好的样本。 [ke xi ta lie le ； zhe kan qi lai shi yi ge hen hao de yang ben 。]

english: Hey look at this.
translation: 嘿看看这个。 [hei kan kan zhe ge 。]

english: Oh, an old tooth. It looks like it has come from a mighty being. Pity there are no tooth fairies around here!
translation: 哦，一颗旧牙。看起来像是来自一位强大的存在。可惜这里没有牙仙子！ [o ， yi ke jiu ya 。 kan qi lai xiang shi lai zi yi wei qiang da de cun zai 。 ke xi zhe li mei you ya xian zi ！]

english: I found an old sword.
translation: 我发现了一把旧剑。 [wo fa xian le yi ba jiu jian 。]

english: Oh, it's very rusty isn't it? I'm not sure this sword belongs here, it looks very out of place.
translation: 哦，它很生锈不是吗？我不确定这把剑属于这里，它看起来很不合适。 [o ， ta hen sheng xiu bu shi ma ？ wo bu que ding zhe ba jian shu yu zhe li ， ta kan qi lai hen bu he shi 。]

english: Have a look at this staff.
translation: 看看这个工作人员。 [kan kan zhe ge gong zuo ren yuan 。]

english: Look at this... Interesting... This appears to belong to a cleric of some kind; certainly not a follower of Saradomin, however.
translation: 看看这个……有趣……这似乎属于某种牧师；然而，他肯定不是萨拉多明的追随者。 [kan kan zhe ge …… you qu …… zhe si hu shu yu mou zhong mu shi ； ran er ， ta ken ding bu shi sa la duo ming de zhui sui zhe 。]

english: I wonder if there was another civilization here before the Saradominists?
translation: 我想知道在萨拉多米主义者之前这里是否还有另一个文明？ [wo xiang zhi dao zai sa la duo mi zhu yi zhe zhi qian zhe li shi fou hai you ling yi ge wen ming ？]

english: I found some armour.
translation: 我找到了一些盔甲。 [wo zhao dao le yi xie kui jia 。]

english: It looks like the wearer of this fought a mighty battle.
translation: 看起来佩戴者经历了一场伟大的战斗。 [kan qi lai pei dai zhe jing li le yi chang wei da de zhan dou 。]

english: I found some old armour.
translation: 我发现了一些旧盔甲。 [wo fa xian le yi xie jiu kui jia 。]

english: How unusual. This armour doesn't seem to match with the other finds. Keep looking.
translation: 多么不寻常啊。这件盔甲似乎与其他发现的不匹配。继续寻找。 [duo me bu xun chang a 。 zhe jian kui jia si hu yu qi ta fa xian de bu pi pei 。 ji xu xun zhao 。]

english: I found some pottery pieces.
translation: 我发现了一些陶器碎片。 [wo fa xian le yi xie tao qi sui pian 。]

english: Yes, many parts are discovered. The inhabitants of these parts were great potters.
translation: 是的，发现了很多部分。这些地区的居民都是伟大的陶艺家。 [shi de ， fa xian le hen duo bu fen 。 zhe xie di qu de ju min dou shi wei da de tao yi jia 。]

english: You mean they were good at using potions?
translation: 你是说他们擅长使用魔药？ [ni shi shuo ta men shan chang shi yong mo yao ？]

english: No, no, silly. They were known for their skill with clay.
translation: 不，不，愚蠢。他们以粘土技艺而闻名。 [bu ， bu ， yu chun 。 ta men yi nian tu ji yi er wen ming 。]

english: Have a look at this unusual item...
translation: 看看这个不寻常的物品...... [kan kan zhe ge bu xun chang de wu pin ......]

english: Let me see. This is a belt buckle. Not so unusual - I should imagine it came from a guard.
translation: 让我看看。这是皮带扣。没什么不寻常的——我应该想象它来自一名警卫。 [rang wo kan kan 。 zhe shi pi dai kou 。 mei shen me bu xun chang de —— wo ying gai xiang xiang ta lai zi yi ming jing wei 。]

english: Hmm, an interesting find; an animal skull for sure. Another student found one just like this today.
translation: 嗯，一个有趣的发现；肯定是动物头骨。另一位学生今天发现了一个类似的东西。 [n ， yi ge you qu de fa xian ； ken ding shi dong wu tou gu 。 ling yi wei xue sheng jin tian fa xian le yi ge lei si de dong xi 。]

english: Looks like an award cup for some small find. Perhaps it belongs to one of the students?
translation: 看起来像是一些小发现的奖杯。也许它属于其中一名学生？ [kan qi lai xiang shi yi xie xiao fa xian de jiang bei 。 ye xu ta shu yu qi zhong yi ming xue sheng ？]

english: Why, it looks like a teddy bear to me. Perhaps someone's lucky mascot!
translation: 为什么，对我来说它看起来像一只泰迪熊。也许某人的幸运吉祥物！ [wei shen me ， dui wo lai shuo ta kan qi lai xiang yi zhi tai di xiong 。 ye xu mou ren de xing yun ji xiang wu ！]

english: Ah yes, an old boot. Not really an ancient artefact, is it?
translation: 啊，是的，一只旧靴子。并不是真正的古代文物，是吗？ [a ， shi de ， yi zhi jiu xue zi 。 bing bu shi zhen zheng de gu dai wen wu ， shi ma ？]

english: The expert has already seen the talisman.
translation: 专家已经看到了符咒。 [zhuan jia yi jing kan dao le fu zhou 。]

english: There's no point in giving me this back!
translation: 把这个还给我没有任何意义！ [ba zhe ge huan gei wo mei you ren he yi yi ！]

english: I found this in a hidden cavern beneath the digsite.
translation: 我在挖掘场下方的一个隐藏洞穴中发现了这个。 [wo zai wa jue chang xia fang de yi ge yin cang dong xue zhong fa xian le zhe ge 。]

english: Incredible!
translation: 极好的！ [ji hao de ！]

english: There is an altar down there. The place is crawling with skeletons!
translation: 下面有一个祭坛。这个地方爬满了骷髅！ [xia mian you yi ge ji tan 。 zhe ge di fang pa man le ku lou ！]

english: Yuck!
translation: 哎呀！ [ai ya ！]

english: This is an amazing discovery! All this while we were convinced that no other race had lived here.
translation: 这是一个惊人的发现！一直以来，我们都确信没有其他种族曾在这里居住过。 [zhe shi yi ge jing ren de fa xian ！ yi zhi yi lai ， wo men dou que xin mei you qi ta zhong zu ceng zai zhe li ju zhu guo 。]

english: It seems the followers of Saradomin have tried to cover up the evidence of the Zaros altar. This whole city must have been built over it!
translation: 萨拉多明的追随者似乎试图掩盖扎罗斯祭坛的证据。整座城市一定是建在它上面的！ [sa la duo ming de zhui sui zhe si hu shi tu yan gai zha luo si ji tan de zheng ju 。 zheng zuo cheng shi yi ding shi jian zai ta shang mian de ！]

english: Thanks for your help; your sharp eyes have spotted what many have missed. Here, take this gold as your reward.
translation: 感谢您的帮助;你敏锐的眼睛发现了许多人错过的东西。来，这些金子就当做你的奖励吧。 [gan xie nin de bang zhu ; ni min rui de yan jing fa xian le xu duo ren cuo guo de dong xi 。 lai ， zhe xie jin zi jiu dang zuo ni de jiang li ba 。]

english: QUEST COMPLETED!
translation: 任务完成！ [ren wu wan cheng ！]

english: I don't need another tablet! One is enough, thank you.
translation: 我不需要另一台平板电脑！一份就够了，谢谢。 [wo bu xu yao ling yi tai ping ban dian nao ！ yi fen jiu gou le ， xie xie 。]

english: I don't think that has any archaeological significance
translation: 我认为这没有任何考古意义 [wo ren wei zhe mei you ren he kao gu yi yi]

english: Ask about the Desert Treasure I quest.
translation: 询问有关沙漠宝藏 I 任务的信息。 [xun wen you guan sha mo bao zang  I  ren wu de xin xi 。]

english: Ask about the Digsite quest.
translation: 询问挖掘场任务。 [xun wen wa jue chang ren wu 。]

english: Hello there. What do you do here?
translation: 你好呀。你在这里做什么？ [ni hao ya 。 ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Ah, I'm just keeping an eye on things and making sure nothing untoward happens.
translation: 啊，我只是在关注事情，确保不会发生任何意外。 [a ， wo zhi shi zai guan zhu shi qing ， que bao bu hui fa sheng ren he yi wai 。]

english: That's reassuring.
translation: 这让人放心。 [zhe rang ren fang xin 。]

english: One day I hope it will be.
translation: 我希望有一天会如此。 [wo xi wang you yi tian hui ru ci 。]

english: Ah, [player name], it's good to see you again.
translation: 啊，[玩家姓名]，很高兴再次见到你。 [a ，[ wan jia xing ming ]， hen gao xing zai ci jian dao ni 。]

english: Hello there, Thaerisk. Any word on Lucien?
translation: 你好，泰瑞斯。有关于吕西安的消息吗？ [ni hao ， tai rui si 。 you guan yu lv xi an de xiao xi ma ？]

english: Nothing yet, but we're doing everything we can to find him. I hope he's ready for us, because once we do locate him, we're going to give him quite the bloody nose...
translation: 目前还没有任何消息，但我们正在尽一切努力寻找他。我希望他已经为我们做好了准备，因为一旦我们找到他，我们就会给他一个血腥的鼻子...... [mu qian hai mei you ren he xiao xi ， dan wo men zheng zai jin yi qie nu li xun zhao ta 。 wo xi wang ta yi jing wei wo men zuo hao le zhun bei ， yin wei yi dan wo men zhao dao ta ， wo men jiu hui gei ta yi ge xue xing de bi zi ......]

english: ... or at least whatever passes for a nose on a Mahjarrat!
translation: ...或者至少是任何被认为是 Mahjarrat 鼻子的东西！ [... huo zhe zhi shao shi ren he bei ren wei shi  Mahjarrat  bi zi de dong xi ！]

english: Thank you for leading the Burgher's militia against the Troll King.
translation: 感谢你带领市民民兵对抗巨魔之王。 [gan xie ni dai ling shi min min bing dui kang ju mo zhi wang 。]

english: Now that the trolls are leaderless I have repaired the bridge to the central isle for you as best I can.
translation: 既然巨魔群龙无首，我已经尽我所能为你们修复了通往中央岛屿的桥梁。 [ji ran ju mo qun long wu shou ， wo yi jing jin wo suo neng wei ni men xiu fu le tong wang zhong yang dao yu de qiao liang 。]

english: Thanks Thakkrad. Does that mean I have access to the runite ores on that island?
translation: 谢谢塔克拉德。这是否意味着我可以获取该岛上的符石矿石？ [xie xie ta ke la de 。 zhe shi fou yi wei zhe wo ke yi huo qu gai dao shang de fu shi kuang shi ？]

english: Yes, you should be able to mine runite there if you wish.
translation: 是的，如果你愿意的话，你应该能够在那里开采符石。 [shi de ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， ni ying gai neng gou zai na li kai cai fu shi 。]

english: Cure my yak-hide, please.
translation: 请治愈我的牦牛皮。 [qing zhi yu wo de mao niu pi 。]

english: I will cure yak-hide for a fee of 5 gp per hide.
translation: 我将以每张 5 金币的价格治疗牦牛皮。 [wo jiang yi mei zhang  5  jin bi de jia ge zhi liao mao niu pi 。]

english: You have no yak-hide to cure.
translation: 你没有牦牛皮可以治愈。 [ni mei you mao niu pi ke yi zhi yu 。]

english: You don't have enough gold to pay me!
translation: 你没有足够的金币来付钱给我！ [ni mei you zu gou de jin bi lai fu qian gei wo ！]

english: There you go.
translation: 就这样吧。 [jiu zhe yang ba 。]

english: Bye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

translation: 巫师？不，我只是一个街头魔术师，他们叫我“令人失望的格尔特”。我在这里练习我的技巧，事情很快就变糟了。 [wu shi ？ bu ， wo zhi shi yi ge jie tou mo shu shi ， ta men jiao wo “ ling ren shi wang de ge er te ”。 wo zai zhe li lian xi wo de ji qiao ， shi qing hen kuai jiu bian zao le 。]

english: Don't tell me, you were trying to pull a rabbit out of your hat and you accidentally pulled out hundreds?
translation: 难道你想从帽子里变出一只兔子，却意外地变出了数百只兔子？ [nan dao ni xiang cong mao zi li bian chu yi zhi tu zi ， que yi wai di bian chu le shu bai zhi tu zi ？]

english: Well... yes, some old guy gave me these magical looking stones, so I thought I'd practice my act with them.
translation: 嗯……是的，一些老家伙给了我这些看起来很神奇的石头，所以我想我应该用它们来练习我的表演。 [n …… shi de ， yi xie lao jia huo gei le wo zhe xie kan qi lai hen shen qi de shi tou ， suo yi wo xiang wo ying gai yong ta men lai lian xi wo de biao yan 。]

english: The magician shows you some rune stones.
translation: 魔术师向你展示一些符文石。 [mo shu shi xiang ni zhan shi yi xie fu wen shi 。]

english: You do know these are rune stones, they're used in actual magic.
translation: 你知道这些是符文石，它们用于实际的魔法。 [ni zhi dao zhe xie shi fu wen shi ， ta men yong yu shi ji de mo fa 。]

english: You're chatting rubbish... real magic doesn't exist.
translation: 你在胡言乱语……真正的魔法并不存在。 [ni zai hu yan luan yu …… zhen zheng de mo fa bing bu cun zai 。]

english: Then how did all these rabbits appear?
translation: 那么这些兔子是怎么出现的呢？ [na me zhe xie tu zi shi zen me chu xian de ne ？]

english: I don't know, I put the runes in my hat, said the magic words 'Rabbaradoo' and stuck my hand in and felt something fuzzy. When I pulled my hand back, I was holding a rabbit.
translation: 我不知道，我把符文放进帽子里，说出了魔法词“拉巴拉杜”，然后把手伸了进去，感觉到了一些模糊的东西。当我把手抽回来时，我手里握着一只兔子。 [wo bu zhi dao ， wo ba fu wen fang jin mao zi li ， shuo chu le mo fa ci “ la ba la du ”， ran hou ba shou shen le jin qu ， gan jue dao le yi xie mo hu de dong xi 。 dang wo ba shou chou hui lai shi ， wo shou li wo zhe yi zhi tu zi 。]

english: Mind if I take a look at your hat? I think there's more to this than meets the eye.
translation: 介意我看看你的帽子吗？我认为这不仅仅是表面上看到的。 [jie yi wo kan kan ni de mao zi ma ？ wo ren wei zhe bu jin jin shi biao mian shang kan dao de 。]

english: You take a look into the darkness of the magician's hat.
translation: 你看向魔术师帽子的黑暗。 [ni kan xiang mo shu shi mao zi de hei an 。]

english: You see a glowing green portal staring back at you.
translation: 你会看到一个发光的绿色传送门正在盯着你。 [ni hui kan dao yi ge fa guang de lv se chuan song men zheng zai ding zhe ni 。]

english: Well Gelt, I don't know how you've done it, but it looks like you've opened a portal.
translation: 好吧，盖尔特，我不知道你是怎么做到的，但看起来你已经打开了一个门户。 [hao ba ， gai er te ， wo bu zhi dao ni shi zen me zuo dao de ， dan kan qi lai ni yi jing da kai le yi ge men hu 。]

english: Huh.
translation: 呵呵。 [he he 。]

english: Please, you must help me, I beg you.
translation: 拜托，你一定要帮助我，我求求你了。 [bai tuo ， ni yi ding yao bang zhu wo ， wo qiu qiu ni le 。]

english: Ah, I mean, I'm pretty busy... but I suppose I can find the time to help you.
translation: 啊，我是说，我很忙……但我想我能抽出时间来帮助你。 [a ， wo shi shuo ， wo hen mang …… dan wo xiang wo neng chou chu shi jian lai bang zhu ni 。]

english: You put your hand in the hat and feel the portal start to pull you in.
translation: 你把手伸进帽子里，感觉到传送门开始把你拉进去。 [ni ba shou shen jin mao zi li ， gan jue dao chuan song men kai shi ba ni la jin qu 。]

english: Player is teleported to The Rabbit Realm
translation: 玩家被传送到兔子王国 [wan jia bei chuan song dao tu zi wang guo]

english: Hello Gelt, I need to go back.
translation: 你好盖尔特，我需要回去。 [ni hao gai er te ， wo xu yao hui qu 。]

english: Please don't dawdle, I need you to fix this before the master of my order finds out.
translation: 请不要磨磨蹭蹭，我需要你在我的命令的主人发现之前解决这个问题。 [qing bu yao mo mo ceng ceng ， wo xu yao ni zai wo de ming ling de zhu ren fa xian zhi qian jie jue zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: I have returned.
translation: 我回来了。 [wo hui lai le 。]

english: Oh, please tell me you managed to do something?
translation: 哦，请告诉我你做了什么？ [o ， qing gao su wo ni zuo le shen me ？]

english: I'll be honest with you Gelt, it got a bit weird.
translation: 老实说，盖尔特，这有点奇怪。 [lao shi shuo ， gai er te ， zhe you dian qi guai 。]

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你是什​​么意思？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: Somehow, you opened a portal to a dimension, very similar to ours, but run by rabbits instead of humans.
translation: 不知何故，你打开了一个通往一个维度的门户，与我们的维度非常相似，但由兔子而不是人类运行。 [bu zhi he gu ， ni da kai le yi ge tong wang yi ge wei du de men hu ， yu wo men de wei du fei chang xiang si ， dan you tu zi er bu shi ren lei yun xing 。]

english: That's incredible...
translation: 那真是难以置信... [na zhen shi nan yi zhi xin ...]

english: That's not even the weird bit! They live in a cult worshipping an egg, they ask it a question and whatever it says, they do.
translation: 这甚至不是奇怪的一点！他们生活在一个崇拜鸡蛋的邪教中，他们问它一个问题，无论它说什么，他们都会做。 [zhe shen zhi bu shi qi guai de yi dian ！ ta men sheng huo zai yi ge chong bai ji dan de xie jiao zhong ， ta men wen ta yi ge wen ti ， wu lun ta shuo shen me ， ta men du hui zuo 。]

english: That's why they all started coming through, the Duke Rabbacio asked the egg if they should jump through and it said yes.
translation: 这就是为什么他们都开始通过，拉巴西奥公爵问鸡蛋他们是否应该跳过去，鸡蛋说可以。 [zhe jiu shi wei shen me ta men dou kai shi tong guo ， la ba xi ao gong jue wen ji dan ta men shi fou ying gai tiao guo qu ， ji dan shuo ke yi 。]

english: What the...
translation: 什么... [shen me ...]

english: It's a lot to take in, but I've managed to stop them jumping through for now, however I couldn't close the portal.
translation: 有很多东西需要接受，但我现在已经设法阻止他们跳过，但我无法关闭门户。 [you hen duo dong xi xu yao jie shou ， dan wo xian zai yi jing she fa zu zhi ta men tiao guo ， dan wo wu fa guan bi men hu 。]

english: ...am I a god?
translation: ……我是神吗？ […… wo shi shen ma ？]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: Have I managed to conjure an alternate dimension with my own hands...
translation: 我是否能够用自己的双手召唤出另一个维度…… [wo shi fou neng gou yong zi ji de shuang shou zhao huan chu ling yi ge wei du ……]

english: Hello? Gelt?
translation: 你好？盖尔特？ [ni hao ？ gai er te ？]

english: I'm the most powerful magician that has ever lived...
translation: 我是有史以来最强大的魔法师...... [wo shi you shi yi lai zui qiang da de mo fa shi ......]

english: No, you're not Gelt, you've used magic that's existed for millennia.
translation: 不，你不是盖尔特，你使用的魔法已经存在了数千年。 [bu ， ni bu shi gai er te ， ni shi yong de mo fa yi jing cun zai le shu qian nian 。]

english: You have my thanks adventurer, when I return to my order, I'll report this to our leader, Magnus.
translation: 谢谢冒险家，当我回到我的组织时，我会把这件事报告给我们的领袖马格努斯。 [xie xie mao xian jia ， dang wo hui dao wo de zu zhi shi ， wo hui ba zhe jian shi bao gao gei wo men de ling xiu ma ge nu si 。]

english: What will you do with all these rabbits?
translation: 你会如何处理这些兔子呢？ [ni hui ru he chu li zhe xie tu zi ne ？]

english: Since you couldn't close the portal, I'll try usher them back in.
translation: 既然你无法关闭传送门，我会尝试将他们引入。 [ji ran ni wu fa guan bi chuan song men ， wo hui chang shi jiang ta men yin ru 。]

english: Would you mind letting me return to Bunbridge? I feel I have some unfinished business.
translation: 你介意让我回到班布里奇吗？我感觉我还有事未完成。 [ni jie yi rang wo hui dao ban bu li qi ma ？ wo gan jue wo hai you shi wei wan cheng 。]

english: Not a problem if you wish to return just talk to me, I'll stay for a while longer.
translation: 如果你想回来的话，没问题，只要跟我说一声，我会多呆一段时间。 [ru guo ni xiang hui lai de hua ， mei wen ti ， zhi yao gen wo shuo yi sheng ， wo hui duo dai yi duan shi jian 。]

english: Feel free to keep anything you found there as well, as a thanks from me.
translation: 请随意保留您在那里找到的任何东西，作为我的感谢。 [qing sui yi bao liu nin zai na li zhao dao de ren he dong xi ， zuo wei wo de gan xie 。]

english: Thank you again for your help, do you wish to return to the Rabbit Realm?
translation: 再次感谢您的帮助，您想回到兔界吗？ [zai ci gan xie nin de bang zhu ， nin xiang hui dao tu jie ma ？]

english: No thanks, I've had enough of rabbits for now.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我现在已经受够了兔子了。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo xian zai yi jing shou gou le tu zi le 。]

english: So be it, I'll be contemplating my power for a little while if you change your mind.
translation: 就这样吧，如果你改变主意，我会考虑一下我的力量。 [jiu zhe yang ba ， ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， wo hui kao lv yi xia wo de li liang 。]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: ...[player name]?
translation: ...[玩家姓名]？ [...[ wan jia xing ming ]？]

english: Um, yes?
translation: 嗯，是吗？ [n ， shi ma ？]

english: Boss wants to talk to you. She's downstairs in the pits.
translation: 老板想跟你谈谈。她在楼下的坑里。 [lao ban xiang gen ni tan tan 。 ta zai lou xia de keng li 。]

english: Got it!
translation: 知道了！ [zhi dao le ！]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Oh. It's you again.
translation: 哦。又是你。 [o 。 you shi ni 。]

english: Have you spoken with the boss yet?
translation: 你跟老板谈过了吗？ [ni gen lao ban tan guo le ma ？]

english: Yes. Actually, I wanted to ask you about the task she gave me...
translation: 是的。其实我是想问你关于她交给我的任务... [shi de 。 qi shi wo shi xiang wen ni guan yu ta jiao gei wo de ren wu ...]

english: Stop right there. You'll get not hints out of me.
translation: 就停在那里。你不会从我这里得到任何提示。 [jiu ting zai na li 。 ni bu hui cong wo zhe li de dao ren he ti shi 。]

english: You know, you're very pretty...
translation: 你知道吗，你非常漂亮... [ni zhi dao ma ， ni fei chang piao liang ...]

english: Ha! That's a good one.
translation: 哈!这是一件好事。 [ha ! zhe shi yi jian hao shi 。]

english: I hope you're better at ratcatching than lying.
translation: 我希望你更擅长捕鼠而不是说谎。 [wo xi wang ni geng shan chang bu shu er bu shi shuo huang 。]

english: That's a powerful-looking cat you have there.
translation: 你那里有一只看起来很强大的猫。 [ni na li you yi zhi kan qi lai hen qiang da de mao 。]

english: Bellemorde? Beautiful, isn't she?
translation: 贝尔莫德？很漂亮，不是吗？ [bei er mo de ？ hen piao liang ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Er... yes.
translation: 呃……是的。 [e …… shi de 。]

english: I've had her since she was a kitten. Felkrash trained her for me.
translation: 我从她还是小猫的时候就养了她。费尔克拉什为我训练了她。 [wo cong ta hai shi xiao mao de shi hou jiu yang le ta 。 fei er ke la shen wei wo xun lian le ta 。]

english: Oh really? Does she know any cool tricks?
translation: 哦真的吗？她知道什么很酷的技巧吗？ [o zhen de ma ？ ta zhi dao shen me hen ku de ji qiao ma ？]

english: Oh yes! There was this one time she helped Felkrash wipe out all the rats in town by -
translation: 哦是的！有一次她帮助费尔克拉什消灭了镇上所有的老鼠—— [o shi de ！ you yi ci ta bang zhu fei er ke la shen xiao mie le zhen shang suo you de lao shu ——]

english: Hiss!
translation: 嘶！ [si ！]

english: Oh, I see. Nice try, [player name], but you'll have to be cleverer than that.
translation: 我懂了。不错的尝试，[玩家姓名]，但你必须比这更聪明。 [wo dong le 。 bu cuo de chang shi ，[ wan jia xing ming ]， dan ni bi xu bi zhe geng cong ming 。]

english: Almost had it...
translation: 差一点就拥有了... [cha yi dian jiu yong you le ...]

english: I just don't think Felkrash was that impressive.
translation: 我只是觉得菲尔克拉什没有那么令人印象深刻。 [wo zhi shi jue de fei er ke la shen mei you na me ling ren yin xiang shen ke 。]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: All the other ratcatchers I've met had loads of tricks to show me.
translation: 我遇到的所有其他捕鼠者都向我展示了很多技巧。 [wo yu dao de suo you qi ta bu shu zhe dou xiang wo zhan shi le hen duo ji qiao 。]

english: In comparison, Felkrash was just... disappointing.
translation: 相比之下，费尔克拉什只是……令人失望。 [xiang bi zhi xia ， fei er ke la shen zhi shi …… ling ren shi wang 。]

english: How dare you! Felkrash is the greatest ratcatcher Gielinor's ever seen!
translation: 你怎么敢！菲尔克拉什是吉林诺见过的最伟大的捕鼠者！ [ni zen me gan ！ fei er ke la shen shi ji lin nuo jian guo de zui wei da de bu shu zhe ！]

english: Oh yeah? What's the most impressive thing she's done then?
translation: 哦，是吗？她做过的印象最深刻的事是什么？ [o ， shi ma ？ ta zuo guo de yin xiang zui shen ke de shi shi shen me ？]

english: I'll have you know she once killed all the rats in Port Sarim with just one attack!
translation: 我会让你知道她曾经只用一次攻击就杀死了沙里姆港的所有老鼠！ [wo hui rang ni zhi dao ta ceng jing zhi yong yi ci gong ji jiu sha si le sha li mu gang de suo you lao shu ！]

english: I don't know. That just sounds like one of her stories.
translation: 我不知道。这听起来像是她的故事之一。 [wo bu zhi dao 。 zhe ting qi lai xiang shi ta de gu shi zhi yi 。]

english: It's true! I saw it happen. She used a magic flute to charm the rats into the sea!
translation: 这是真的！我看到它发生了。她用魔笛把老鼠迷到了海里！ [zhe shi zhen de ！ wo kan dao ta fa sheng le 。 ta yong mo di ba lao shu mi dao le hai li ！]

english: Wait... I uh, I shouldn't have said that.
translation: 等等...我呃，我不应该这么说。 [deng deng ... wo e ， wo bu ying gai zhe me shuo 。]

english: Don't worry, I won't tell Felkrash you snitched.
translation: 别担心，我不会告诉费尔克拉什你告密了。 [bie dan xin ， wo bu hui gao su fei er ke la shen ni gao mi le 。]

english: You'd better not!
translation: 你最好不要！ [ni zui hao bu yao ！]

english: They charm snakes over in Pollnivneach... maybe they charm rats, too?
translation: 他们在 Pollnivneach 迷惑蛇……也许他们也迷惑老鼠？ [ta men zai  Pollnivneach  mi huo she …… ye xu ta men ye mi huo lao shu ？]

english: Oh it's you again.
translation: 噢，又是你。 [o ， you shi ni 。]

english: Felkrash told me of the task she set you.
translation: 菲尔克拉什告诉我她给你布置的任务。 [fei er ke la shen gao su wo ta gei ni bu zhi de ren wu 。]

english: Oh, er, really?
translation: 哦，呃，真的吗？ [o ， e ， zhen de ma ？]

english: I shouldn't have told you that story. Shame on you for coaxing it out of me.
translation: 我不应该告诉你那个故事。真为你骗我而感到羞耻。 [wo bu ying gai gao su ni na ge gu shi 。 zhen wei ni pian wo er gan dao xiu chi 。]

english: If it makes you feel better, I lie to a lot of people.
translation: 如果这能让你感觉好一点，我就对很多人撒谎了。 [ru guo zhe neng rang ni gan jue hao yi dian ， wo jiu dui hen duo ren sa huang le 。]

english: That was an amazing performance! I've only seen one like it... as you know.
translation: 那真是一场精彩的表演！我只见过这样的一个...如你所知。 [na zhen shi yi chang jing cai de biao yan ！ wo zhi jian guo zhe yang de yi ge ... ru ni suo zhi 。]

english: Don't worry, Felkrash has no idea how I figured it out.
translation: 别担心，菲尔克拉什不知道我是怎么想出来的。 [bie dan xin ， fei er ke la shen bu zhi dao wo shi zen me xiang chu lai de 。]

english: And it had better stay that way!
translation: 而且最好保持这种状态！ [er qie zui hao bao chi zhe zhong zhuang tai ！]

english: She looks through you as if you don't exist.
translation: 她看透你，就好像你不存在一样。 [ta kan tou ni ， jiu hao xiang ni bu cun zai yi yang 。]

english: Step away from that manhole, you've no business down there.
translation: 离开那个沙井，下面没有你的事。 [li kai na ge sha jing ， xia mian mei you ni de shi 。]

english: Ah you, peasant. Felkrash wishes to speak with you.
translation: 啊，你这个农民。费尔克拉什希望与您交谈。 [a ， ni zhe ge nong min 。 fei er ke la shen xi wang yu nin jiao tan 。]

english: 'The Face' comports herself in an air of haughtiness uncommon to those with appearances as ugly as hers.
translation: “面孔”表现出一种傲慢的气质，这对于那些长相丑陋的人来说是罕见的。 [“ mian kong ” biao xian chu yi zhong ao man de qi zhi ， zhe dui yu na xie zhang xiang chou lou de ren lai shuo shi han jian de 。]

english: Ok, where would I find her?
translation: 好吧，我到哪里去找她？ [hao ba ， wo dao na li qu zhao ta ？]

english: You should find her below in the pits.
translation: 你应该在下面的坑里找到她。 [ni ying gai zai xia mian de keng li zhao dao ta 。]

english: Oh it's you again.*She glances at you with barely disguised disdain.*
translation: 噢，又是你。*她用几乎不加掩饰的蔑视看了你一眼。* [o ， you shi ni 。* ta yong ji hu bu jia yan shi de mie shi kan le ni yi yan 。*]

english: *Aside* I wonder what her problem is?
translation: *旁白*我想知道她的问题是什么？ [* pang bai * wo xiang zhi dao ta de wen ti shi shen me ？]

english: Have you spoken with Felkrash yet?
translation: 你和菲尔克拉什谈过了吗？ [ni he fei er ke la shen tan guo le ma ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: You notice a rather unkempt looking cat nearby. Despite its bedraggled appearance it exudes power, strength and intelligence beyond that of a normal cat.
translation: 你注意到附近有一只看起来很蓬乱的猫。尽管外表脏兮兮，但它却散发着超越普通猫的力量、力量和智慧。 [ni zhu yi dao fu jin you yi zhi kan qi lai hen peng luan de mao 。 jin guan wai biao zang xi xi ， dan ta que san fa zhe chao yue pu tong mao de li liang 、 li liang he zhi hui 。]

english: That's an interesting looking cat.
translation: 这是一只看起来很有趣的猫。 [zhe shi yi zhi kan qi lai hen you qu de mao 。]

english: Ah yes Belle. What a cat. Felkrash trained her for me shortly after she single handedly charmed all the rats of the Port and drowned them.
translation: 啊，是的，贝儿。真是一只猫啊。在她单枪匹马地迷住了港口的所有老鼠并将它们淹死后不久，费尔克拉什就为我训练了她。 [a ， shi de ， bei er 。 zhen shi yi zhi mao a 。 zai ta dan qiang pi ma di mi zhu le gang kou de suo you lao shu bing jiang ta men yan si hou bu jiu ， fei er ke la shen jiu wei wo xun lian le ta 。]

english: I love that story. My favourite part is how she managed to get rid of all the rats. Would you tell it to me?
translation: 我喜欢那个故事。我最喜欢的部分是她如何设法消灭所有老鼠。你能告诉我吗？ [wo xi huan na ge gu shi 。 wo zui xi huan de bu fen shi ta ru he she fa xiao mie suo you lao shu 。 ni neng gao su wo ma ？]

english: I don't know, I really shouldn't.
translation: 我不知道，我真的不应该。 [wo bu zhi dao ， wo zhen de bu ying gai 。]

english: *Aside* I'll get the story out of her, a little sweet talking should do the trick.
translation: *旁白*我会从她那里讲出这个故事，一点甜言蜜语应该可以解决问题。 [* pang bai * wo hui cong ta na li jiang chu zhe ge gu shi ， yi dian tian yan mi yu ying gai ke yi jie jue wen ti 。]

english: Oh please tell me, I'm sure you'd tell the story wonderfully, you have such a pretty ...
translation: 哦，请告诉我，我相信你会把这个故事讲得很精彩，你有一个如此漂亮的...... [o ， qing gao su wo ， wo xiang xin ni hui ba zhe ge gu shi jiang de hen jing cai ， ni you yi ge ru ci piao liang de ......]

english: Yes..?
translation: 是的..？ [shi de ..？]

english: *The face'sface perks up at the mention of the word pretty.*
translation: *一提到“漂亮”这个词，脸上的表情就焕然一新。* [* yi ti dao “ piao liang ” zhe ge ci ， lian shang de biao qing jiu huan ran yi xin 。*]

english: ...voice.
translation: ...嗓音。 [... sang yin 。]

english: Oh.*And just as quickly turns sour again.*
translation: 哦。*很快又变酸了。* [o 。* hen kuai you bian suan le 。*]

english: *Aside* Dang!
translation: *一边*当当！ [* yi bian * dang dang ！]

english: ... which compliments your radiant aura!
translation: ...这衬托出你的光彩照人的光环！ [... zhe chen tuo chu ni de guang cai zhao ren de guang huan ！]

english: *Aside* That should do the trick.
translation: *旁白*这应该可以解决问题。 [* pang bai * zhe ying gai ke yi jie jue wen ti 。]

english: Oh you're too generous.
translation: 哦，你太慷慨了。 [o ， ni tai kang kai le 。]

english: Do you know something, I think I'll tell you, mind you, don't tell Felkrash about this, she'd only get sore with me.
translation: 你知道吗，我想我会告诉你，请注意，不要告诉费尔克拉什这件事，她只会对我生气。 [ni zhi dao ma ， wo xiang wo hui gao su ni ， qing zhu yi ， bu yao gao su fei er ke la shen zhe jian shi ， ta zhi hui dui wo sheng qi 。]

english: She's the story teller not me.
translation: 讲故事的人是她，不是我。 [jiang gu shi de ren shi ta ， bu shi wo 。]

english: One day ......
translation: 有一天…… [you yi tian ……]

english: The camera fades briefly to black and back.
translation: 相机短暂地变黑然后又变回来。 [xiang ji duan zan di bian hei ran hou you bian hui lai 。]

english: And that is how she drowned the rats.
translation: 这就是她淹死老鼠的方法。 [zhe jiu shi ta yan si lao shu de fang fa 。]

english: ..and that is how she drowned the rats.
translation: ..这就是她淹死老鼠的方法。 [.. zhe jiu shi ta yan si lao shu de fang fa 。]

english: You just about manage to stay awake through the long and turgid recital of the story.
translation: 在冗长而浮夸的故事叙述中，你几乎保持清醒。 [zai rong chang er fu kua de gu shi xu shu zhong ， ni ji hu bao chi qing xing 。]

english: The snakecharmer of Pollnivneach from what you gathered seemed to play a critical role in the story.
translation: 从你收集到的信息来看，Polnivneach 的耍蛇人似乎在故事中扮演了关键角色。 [cong ni shou ji dao de xin xi lai kan ，Polnivneach  de shua she ren si hu zai gu shi zhong ban yan le guan jian jue se 。]

english: *Aside*PerhapsI should pay this snake charmer a visit.
translation: *旁白*也许我应该去拜访一下这个耍蛇人。 [* pang bai * ye xu wo ying gai qu bai fang yi xia zhe ge shua she ren 。]

english: Really?
translation: 真的吗？ [zhen de ma ？]

english: I shouldn't have told that story. Shame on you for coaxing it out of me.
translation: 我不应该讲那个故事。真为你骗我而感到羞耻。 [wo bu ying gai jiang na ge gu shi 。 zhen wei ni pian wo er gan dao xiu chi 。]

english: I promise I won't tell her you helped me.
translation: 我保证我不会告诉她你帮助了我。 [wo bao zheng wo bu hui gao su ta ni bang zhu le wo 。]

english: I must congratulate you on your performance, I have only ever seen one other display of musicality to match, as you should know.
translation: 我必须祝贺你的表演，你应该知道，我只见过另一种音乐性的表现可以与之相媲美。 [wo bi xu zhu he ni de biao yan ， ni ying gai zhi dao ， wo zhi jian guo ling yi zhong yin yue xing de biao xian ke yi yu zhi xiang pi mei 。]

english: Thank you, and don't worry, I won't tell Felkrash that you helped me.
translation: 谢谢你，别担心，我不会告诉费尔克拉什你帮助了我。 [xie xie ni ， bie dan xin ， wo bu hui gao su fei er ke la shen ni bang zhu le wo 。]

english: Here you go.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: You've found another clue!
translation: 你又发现了一条线索！ [ni you fa xian le yi tiao xian suo ！]

english: You've obtained a casket!
translation: 你已经获得了一个棺材！ [ni yi jing huo de le yi ge guan cai ！]

english: You know, you're very pretty...
translation: 你知道吗，你非常漂亮... [ni zhi dao ma ， ni fei chang piao liang ...]

english: That's a nice cat you have there.
translation: 你那儿有一只很好的猫。 [ni na er you yi zhi hen hao de mao 。]

english: I just don't think Felkrash was that impressive.
translation: 我只是觉得菲尔克拉什没有那么令人印象深刻。 [wo zhi shi jue de fei er ke la shen mei you na me ling ren yin xiang shen ke 。]

english: The Great Guardian seems to be resting. You should probably not disturb it.
translation: 伟大的守护者似乎正在休息。你可能不应该打扰它。 [wei da de shou hu zhe si hu zheng zai xiu xi 。 ni ke neng bu ying gai da rao ta 。]

english: My power level is too low. Bring me guardian stones.
translation: 我的力量水平太低了。给我带来守护石。 [wo de li liang shui ping tai di le 。 gei wo dai lai shou hu shi 。]

english: Thanks, adventurer. I am now fully powered up.
translation: 谢谢，冒险家。我现在已经完全通电了。 [xie xie ， mao xian jia 。 wo xian zai yi jing wan quan tong dian le 。]

english: Human, I need the power of the guardian stones.
translation: 人类，我需要守护石的力量。 [ren lei ， wo xu yao shou hu shi de li liang 。]

english: Humans, I now have the power to close the rift. Thank you, brave ones.
translation: 人类，我现在有能力弥合裂痕了。谢谢你们，勇敢的人们。 [ren lei ， wo xian zai you neng li mi he lie hen le 。 xie xie ni men ， yong gan de ren men 。]

english: Now, for the final blow. Let the Scar be no more!
translation: 现在，进行最后一击。让疤痕不再存在！ [xian zai ， jin xing zui hou yi ji 。 rang ba hen bu zai cun zai ！]

english: Brace yourselves!
translation: 振作起来！ [zhen zuo qi lai ！]

english: Now, I shall rest until it opens once more...
translation: 现在，我要休息了，直到它再次开放...... [xian zai ， wo yao xiu xi le ， zhi dao ta zai ci kai fang ......]

english: Good day to you sir.
translation: 先生，美好的一天。 [xian sheng ， mei hao de yi tian 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I am the Lady of the Lake.
translation: 我是湖中女神。 [wo shi hu zhong nv shen 。]

english: Good day.
translation: 再会。 [zai hui 。]

english: I seek the sword Excalibur.
translation: 我寻找神剑。 [wo xun zhao shen jian 。]

english: Aye, I have that artefact in my possession.
translation: 是的，我拥有那件文物。 [shi de ， wo yong you na jian wen wu 。]

english: 'Tis very valuable, and not an artefact to be given away lightly.
translation: 这是非常有价值的，不是一件可以轻易赠送的文物。 [zhe shi fei chang you jia zhi de ， bu shi yi jian ke yi qing yi zeng song de wen wu 。]

english: I would want to give it away only to one who is worthy and good.
translation: 我只想把它送给一个值得并且善良的人。 [wo zhi xiang ba ta song gei yi ge zhi de bing qie shan liang de ren 。]

english: And how am I meant to prove that?
translation: 我该如何证明这一点呢？ [wo gai ru he zheng ming zhe yi dian ne ？]

english: I shall set a test for you.
translation: 我给你设一个测试。 [wo gei ni she yi ge ce shi 。]

english: First I need you to travel to Port Sarim. Then go to the upstairs room of the jeweller's shop there.
translation: 首先，我需要你前往沙里姆港。然后去那里珠宝店的楼上房间。 [shou xian ， wo xu yao ni qian wang sha li mu gang 。 ran hou qu na li zhu bao dian de lou shang fang jian 。]

english: Ok. That seems easy enough.
translation: 好的。这似乎很容易。 [hao de 。 zhe si hu hen rong yi 。]

english: Please kind sir... my family and I are starving...
translation: 请仁慈的先生...我和我的家人都快饿死了... [qing ren ci de xian sheng ... wo he wo de jia ren dou kuai e si le ...]

english: Could you find it in your heart to spare me a simple loaf of bread?
translation: 你能发心给我一块简单的面包吗？ [ni neng fa xin gei wo yi kuai jian dan de mian bao ma ？]

english: Yes certainly.
translation: 是的，当然。 [shi de ， dang ran 。]

english: You give the bread to the beggar.
translation: 你把面包给乞丐。 [ni ba mian bao gei qi gai 。]

english: Thank you very much!
translation: 非常感谢！ [fei chang gan xie ！]

english: The beggar has turned into the Lady of the Lake!
translation: 乞丐变成了湖中仙女！ [qi gai bian cheng le hu zhong xian nv ！]

english: Well done. You have passed my test.
translation: 干得好。你已经通过了我的考验。 [gan de hao 。 ni yi jing tong guo le wo de kao yan 。]

english: Here is Excalibur, guard it well.
translation: 这里是Excalibur，好好守护。 [zhe li shi Excalibur， hao hao shou hu 。]

english: No I don't have any bread with me.
translation: 不，我没有带面包。 [bu ， wo mei you dai mian bao 。]

english: Well if you get some, you know where to come.
translation: 好吧，如果你得到一些，你就知道去哪里了。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni de dao yi xie ， ni jiu zhi dao qu na li le 。]

english: The beggar isn't interested in talking.
translation: 乞丐没有兴趣说话。 [qi gai mei you xing qu shuo hua 。]

english: Have you got any bread for me yet?
translation: 你有面包给我吗？ [ni you mian bao gei wo ma ？]

english: Yes, here you go.
translation: 是的，给你。 [shi de ， gei ni 。]

english: Actually, I'm wrong. I still don't have any bread. Sorry.
translation: 事实上，我错了。我还没有面包。对不起。 [shi shi shang ， wo cuo le 。 wo hai mei you mian bao 。 dui bu qi 。]

english: Sorry, no, I still have none.
translation: 抱歉，没有，我还没有。 [bao qian ， mei you ， wo hai mei you 。]

english: Hello. I am here for Excalibur. Can I have it yet?
translation: 你好。我是为了Excalibur而来的。我还可以拥有吗？ [ni hao 。 wo shi wei le Excalibur er lai de 。 wo hai ke yi yong you ma ？]

english: I don't think you are worthy enough.
translation: 我不认为你足够值得。 [wo bu ren wei ni zu gou zhi de 。]

english: Come back when you are a better person.
translation: 当你成为一个更好的人时再回来。 [dang ni cheng wei yi ge geng hao de ren shi zai hui lai 。]

english: ...But you have already proved thyself to be worthy of wielding it once already. I shall return it to you if you can prove yourself to still be worthy.
translation: ……但你已经证明了自己有资格使用它一次。如果你能证明自己仍然有价值，我会把它还给你。 […… dan ni yi jing zheng ming liao zi ji you zi ge shi yong ta yi ci 。 ru guo ni neng zheng ming zi ji reng ran you jia zhi ， wo hui ba ta huan gei ni 。]

english: ...And how can I do that?
translation: ...我该怎么做呢？ [... wo gai zen me zuo ne ？]

english: Why, by proving yourself to be above material goods.
translation: 为什么，通过证明自己超越物质财富。 [wei shen me ， tong guo zheng ming zi ji chao yue wu zhi cai fu 。]

english: 500 gold coins ought to do it.
translation: 500金币应该可以了。 [500 jin bi ying gai ke yi le 。]

english: Ok, here you go.
translation: 好的，给你。 [hao de ， gei ni 。]

english: You are still worthy to wield Excalibur! And thanks for the cash! I felt like getting a new haircut!
translation: 你仍然值得拥有Excalibur！谢谢你的现金！我想剪个新发型！ [ni reng ran zhi de yong you Excalibur！ xie xie ni de xian jin ！ wo xiang jian ge xin fa xing ！]

english: I don't have that kind of money...
translation: 我没有那么多钱... [wo mei you na me duo qian ...]

english: Well, come back when you do.
translation: 好吧，等你回来了就回来吧。 [hao ba ， deng ni hui lai le jiu hui lai ba 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Good day.
translation: 再会。 [zai hui 。]

english: I seek the sword Excalibur.
translation: 我寻找神剑。 [wo xun zhao shen jian 。]

english: Yes certainly
translation: 是的，当然 [shi de ， dang ran]

english: No I don't have any bread with me.
translation: 不，我没有带面包。 [bu ， wo mei you dai mian bao 。]

english: Yes, here you go.
translation: 是的，给你。 [shi de ， gei ni 。]

english: No, I still have none.
translation: 不，我还是没有。 [bu ， wo hai shi mei you 。]

english: How dare you come near my farmhouse! Guards! Guards! Remove this human!
translation: 你竟敢靠近我的农舍！卫兵！卫兵！除去这个人类！ [ni jing gan kao jin wo de nong she ！ wei bing ！ wei bing ！ chu qu zhe ge ren lei ！]

english: (monkey guards appear and attempt to capture the player)
translation: （猴子守卫出现并试图抓住玩家） [（ hou zi shou wei chu xian bing shi tu zhua zhu wan jia ）]

english: Guards! Here's a human!
translation: 卫兵！这是一个人类！ [wei bing ！ zhe shi yi ge ren lei ！]

english: Hello! What's a monkey like you doing here?
translation: 你好！像你这样的猴子在这里做什么？ [ni hao ！ xiang ni zhe yang de hou zi zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm just passing through actually.
translation: 其实我只是路过而已 [qi shi wo zhi shi lu guo er yi]

english: Fair enough then.
translation: 那么就足够了。 [na me jiu zu gou le 。]

english: What are you doing in my house?
translation: 你在我家做什么？ [ni zai wo jia zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm just passing through!
translation: 我只是路过而已！ [wo zhi shi lu guo er yi ！]

english: Well I don't give a monkey's uncle!
translation: 哼我不给猴子叔叔！ [heng wo bu gei hou zi shu shu ！]

english: How curious? I have not seen a creature of your kind for many years. You have ventured into the Nexus human - I should warn you to be aware of the Abyssal Sires.
translation: 多么好奇？我已经很多年没有见过你们这种生物了。你已经冒险进入了枢纽人类——我应该警告你要注意深渊领主。 [duo me hao qi ？ wo yi jing hen duo nian mei you jian guo ni men zhe zhong sheng wu le 。 ni yi jing mao xian jin ru le shu niu ren lei —— wo ying gai jing gao ni yao zhu yi shen yuan ling zhu 。]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: Ah... Time does not pass in the Abyss at the same rate that it does in your realm, but nevertheless I have been in this place for aeons.
translation: 啊……深渊中的时间流逝速度与你们王国中的流逝速度不同，但尽管如此，我已经在这个地方呆了亿万年了。 [a …… shen yuan zhong de shi jian liu shi su du yu ni men wang guo zhong de liu shi su du bu tong ， dan jin guan ru ci ， wo yi jing zai zhe ge di fang dai le yi wan nian le 。]

english: Indeed, when I was last in your realm, the armies of Zamorak were battling the other gods for control, and we sought reinforcements from any plane we could reach.
translation: 事实上，当我最后一次来到你们的国度时，萨莫拉克的军队正在与其他神争夺控制权，我们从任何我们能到达的位面寻求援军。 [shi shi shang ， dang wo zui hou yi ci lai dao ni men de guo du shi ， sa mo la ke de jun dui zheng zai yu qi ta shen zheng duo kong zhi quan ， wo men cong ren he wo men neng dao da de wei mian xun qiu yuan jun 。]

english: That was how I came here. We broke through to the Abyss, seeking allies for our cause, but instead I ended up a prisoner in this place, unable to leave, while the God Wars continued without me.
translation: 我就是这样来到这里的。我们突破深渊，为我们的事业寻找盟友，但我却成了这里的囚徒，无法离开，而神战却在没有我的情况下继续进行。 [wo jiu shi zhe yang lai dao zhe li de 。 wo men tu po shen yuan ， wei wo men de shi ye xun zhao meng you ， dan wo que cheng le zhe li de qiu tu ， wu fa li kai ， er shen zhan que zai mei you wo de qing kuang xia ji xu jin xing 。]

english: What can I do here?
translation: 我在这里能做什么？ [wo zai zhe li neng zuo shen me ？]

english: There is something you can do here, human. In fact it may perhaps benefit us both.
translation: 你可以在这里做一些事情，人类。事实上，这也许对我们双方都有好处。 [ni ke yi zai zhe li zuo yi xie shi qing ， ren lei 。 shi shi shang ， zhe ye xu dui wo men shuang fang dou you hao chu 。]

english: Bring me a spine, a claw and an axon from the Abyssal Sires, and I shall construct them into a mighty weapon for you. Yes, we shall both benefit from this.
translation: 从深渊领主那里给我带来一根脊椎、一只爪子和一根轴突，我会将它们打造为你的强大武器。是的，我们双方都将从中受益。 [cong shen yuan ling zhu na li gei wo dai lai yi gen ji zhui 、 yi zhi zhua zi he yi gen zhou tu ， wo hui jiang ta men da zao wei ni de qiang da wu qi 。 shi de ， wo men shuang fang dou jiang cong zhong shou yi 。]

english: Tell me about the Abyssal Sires.
translation: 告诉我有关深渊领主的事。 [gao su wo you guan shen yuan ling zhu de shi 。]

english: The Sires are the engineers of this living pocket universe known to you and I as the Abyss.
translation: 诸侯们是这个活生生的袖珍宇宙的工程师，你我都将其称为“深渊”。 [zhu hou men shi zhe ge huo sheng sheng de xiu zhen yu zhou de gong cheng shi ， ni wo dou jiang qi cheng wei “ shen yuan ”。]

english: At the hands of the 'Chaos God', Zamorak, like myself, they too were cast down and imprisoned in this living tomb.
translation: 在“混沌之神”萨莫拉克的手中，他们也和我一样被打倒并囚禁在这座活墓中。 [zai “ hun dun zhi shen ” sa mo la ke de shou zhong ， ta men ye he wo yi yang bei da dao bing qiu jin zai zhe zuo huo mu zhong 。]

english: They worked for centuries attempting to escape the pull of the Abyss but as food resources began to deplete they knew that their only chance for survival was to construct this Nexus.
translation: 他们工作了几个世纪，试图逃离深渊的吸引力，但随着食物资源开始耗尽，他们知道他们唯一的生存机会就是建造这个枢纽。 [ta men gong zuo le ji ge shi ji ， shi tu tao li shen yuan de xi yin li ， dan sui zhe shi wu zi yuan kai shi hao jin ， ta men zhi dao ta men wei yi de sheng cun ji hui jiu shi jian zao zhe ge shu niu 。]

english: They absorb flesh and bone of their demon kin, weaving it into the fabric of these very walls. Here they have remained in deep stasis, asleep.
translation: 他们吸收恶魔亲属的血肉和骨骼，将其编织到这些墙壁的结构中。他们在这里处于深度停滞状态，沉睡着。 [ta men xi shou e mo qin shu de xue rou he gu ge ， jiang qi bian zhi dao zhe xie qiang bi de jie gou zhong 。 ta men zai zhe li chu yu shen du ting zhi zhuang tai ， chen shui zhao 。]

english: If you succeed in awakening them, they will no doubt unleash their full fury upon you. Someone of your calibre should be able to deal with them though, especially with the shadows on your side...
translation: 如果你成功地唤醒了他们，他们无疑会对你释放出全部的愤怒。不过，像你这样有能力的人应该能够对付它们，尤其是在你身边有阴影的情况下…… [ru guo ni cheng gong di huan xing le ta men ， ta men wu yi hui dui ni shi fang chu quan bu de fen nu 。 bu guo ， xiang ni zhe yang you neng li de ren ying gai neng gou dui fu ta men ， you qi shi zai ni shen bian you yin ying de qing kuang xia ……]

english: If you succeed in killing a Sire, you may be fortunate enough to find one of its unsired offspring among its remains. Bring the Unsired here, to the Font of Consumption.
translation: 如果你成功杀死了一只父亲，你可能会幸运地在它的遗骸中找到一个非父亲的后代。把不受欢迎的人带到这里，到消耗之泉。 [ru guo ni cheng gong sha si le yi zhi fu qin ， ni ke neng hui xing yun di zai ta de yi hai zhong zhao dao yi ge fei fu qin de hou dai 。 ba bu shou huan ying de ren dai dao zhe li ， dao xiao hao zhi quan 。]

english: By placing the Unsired into the Font, I will be able to consume its flesh and perhaps you will receive something worth having.
translation: 通过将无主者放入圣泉中，我将能够消耗它的肉，也许你会得到一些值得拥有的东西。 [tong guo jiang wu zhu zhe fang ru sheng quan zhong ， wo jiang neng gou xiao hao ta de rou ， ye xu ni hui de dao yi xie zhi de yong you de dong xi 。]

english: I'll be off for now.
translation: 我暂时先走了。 [wo zan shi xian zou le 。]

english: I did not ask you to bring me anything, human.
translation: 我没有要求你给我带来任何东西，人类。 [wo mei you yao qiu ni gei wo dai lai ren he dong xi ， ren lei 。]

english: Yes, human?
translation: 是的，人类？ [shi de ， ren lei ？]

english: Have you harvested any components for me?
translation: 你给我收获了什么组件吗？ [ni gei wo shou huo le shen me zu jian ma ？]

english: What's this stuff for?
translation: 这东西是干什么用的？ [zhe dong xi shi gan shen me yong de ？]

english: I shall use the components to construct a mighty weapon for you. Rest assured, the process will be beneficial to both of us.
translation: 我将用这些部件为你打造一件强大的武器。请放心，这个过程对我们双方都有利。 [wo jiang yong zhe xie bu jian wei ni da zao yi jian qiang da de wu qi 。 qing fang xin ， zhe ge guo cheng dui wo men shuang fang dou you li 。]

english: No, sorry.
translation: 不，抱歉。 [bu ， bao qian 。]

english: I still require [bludgeon component(s)] from an Abyssal Sire.
translation: 我仍然需要来自深渊领主的[棍棒组件]。 [wo reng ran xu yao lai zi shen yuan ling zhu de [ gun bang zu jian ]。]

english: You hand over the component(s) to the Overseer.
translation: 您将组件移交给监督者。 [nin jiang zu jian yi jiao gei jian du zhe 。]

english: I now have all the components I require, so here is the weapon I promised you.
translation: 我现在已经拥有了我需要的所有组件，所以这就是我答应给你的武器。 [wo xian zai yi jing yong you le wo xu yao de suo you zu jian ， suo yi zhe jiu shi wo da ying gei ni de wu qi 。]

english: You have served me well, it is good to see that you humans are still as gullible as ever!
translation: 你们为我服务得很好，很高兴看到你们人类仍然像以前一样容易上当受骗！ [ni men wei wo fu wu de hen hao ， hen gao xing kan dao ni men ren lei reng ran xiang yi qian yi yang rong yi shang dang shou pian ！]

english: Bringing me those body parts from the Sires has now granted me enough teleportation energy to leave this living hell hole. Perhaps I will pay your realm a visit and there will be much to harvest!
translation: 从先辈那里给我带来这些身体部位现在已经给了我足够的传送能量来离开这个活生生的地狱洞。也许我会去拜访一下你们的境界，会有很多收获！ [cong xian bei na li gei wo dai lai zhe xie shen ti bu wei xian zai yi jing gei le wo zu gou de chuan song neng liang lai li kai zhe ge huo sheng sheng de di yu dong 。 ye xu wo hui qu bai fang yi xia ni men de jing jie ， hui you hen duo shou huo ！]

english: Yuck! This is disgusting. What use is this? It's unwieldly!
translation: 哎呀！这太恶心了。这有什么用？实在是太难用了！ [ai ya ！ zhe tai e xin le 。 zhe you shen me yong ？ shi zai shi tai nan yong le ！]

english: Have you not learned yet, appearances can be deceiving. You hold in your hands a living weapon whose power is rivalled by few weapons from your world, use it wisely.
translation: 你还不知道吗，外表是会骗人的。你手中握有一把活生生的武器，其威力是你们世界中很少有武器可以匹敌的，请明智地使用它。 [ni hai bu zhi dao ma ， wai biao shi hui pian ren de 。 ni shou zhong wo you yi ba huo sheng sheng de wu qi ， qi wei li shi ni men shi jie zhong hen shao you wu qi ke yi pi di de ， qing ming zhi di shi yong ta 。]

english: Do not think that I am ungrateful for my freedom human. I will leave you this ancient tome that will instruct you in creating more of these weapons in future.
translation: 不要认为我对人类的自由忘恩负义。我将给您留下这本古老的书，它将指导您将来制造更多此类武器。 [bu yao ren wei wo dui ren lei de zi you wang en fu yi 。 wo jiang gei nin liu xia zhe ben gu lao de shu ， ta jiang zhi dao nin jiang lai zhi zao geng duo ci lei wu qi 。]

english: Just use the three components on the book, and it will do the rest. You can get spare copies here any time you need.
translation: 只需使用书中的三个组件，剩下的事情就会完成。您可以随时在这里获取备用副本。 [zhi xu shi yong shu zhong de san ge zu jian ， sheng xia de shi qing jiu hui wan cheng 。 nin ke yi sui shi zai zhe li huo qu bei yong fu ben 。]

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Farewell...
translation: 告别... [gao bie ...]

english: The Overseer teleports away.
translation: 督军瞬移离开。 [du jun shun yi li kai 。]

english: Perhaps I shall use it to slay you, demon.
translation: 也许我会用它来杀死你，恶魔。 [ye xu wo hui yong ta lai sha si ni ， e mo 。]

english: So be it... I will await you on the fields of blood!
translation: 就这样吧……我会在血色的原野上等你！ [jiu zhe yang ba …… wo hui zai xue se de yuan ye shang deng ni ！]

english: I do not require anything further from you, human.
translation: 我对你不再有任何要求，人类。 [wo dui ni bu zai you ren he yao qiu ， ren lei 。]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: Tell me about the Abyssal Sires.
translation: 告诉我有关深渊领主的事。 [gao su wo you guan shen yuan ling zhu de shi 。]

english: What can I do here?
translation: 我在这里能做什么？ [wo zai zhe li neng zuo shen me ？]

english: I'll be off for now.
translation: 我暂时先走了。 [wo zan shi xian zou le 。]

english: What's this stuff for?
translation: 这东西是干什么用的？ [zhe dong xi shi gan shen me yong de ？]

english: No, sorry.
translation: 不，抱歉。 [bu ， bao qian 。]

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Perhaps I shall use it to slay you, demon.
translation: 也许我会用它来杀死你，恶魔。 [ye xu wo hui yong ta lai sha si ni ， e mo 。]

english: Hello mortal. What do you seek?
translation: 你好，凡人。你寻求什么？ [ni hao ， fan ren 。 ni xun qiu shen me ？]

english: What changes have been made for this League?
translation: 本次联赛有哪些变化？ [ben ci lian sai you na xie bian hua ？]

english: Much has happened since the last passage of the Trailblazers. This time, I have awakened the wrathful spirits of enemies across Gielinor.
translation: 自从开拓者队上次通过以来发生了很多事情。这一次，我唤醒了吉林诺各地敌人的愤怒之魂。 [zi cong kai tuo zhe dui shang ci tong guo yi lai fa sheng le hen duo shi qing 。 zhe yi ci ， wo huan xing le ji lin nuo ge di di ren de fen nu zhi hun 。]

english: Each region now contains a Raging Echo boss. These bosses are more powerful versions of their original self that drop unique rewards.
translation: 现在每个区域都有一个狂怒回声 Boss。这些老板是他们原来的自我的更强大的版本，会掉落独特的奖励。 [xian zai mei ge qu yu dou you yi ge kuang nu hui sheng  Boss。 zhe xie lao ban shi ta men yuan lai de zi wo de geng qiang da de ban ben ， hui diao luo du te de jiang li 。]

english: To help you overcome these new challenges, you may now gain power through Combat Masteries, which you can obtain access to by completing the Combat Mastery tasks.
translation: 为了帮助您克服这些新挑战，您现在可以通过战斗掌握来获得力量，您可以通过完成战斗掌握任务来获得力量。 [wei le bang zhu nin ke fu zhe xie xin tiao zhan ， nin xian zai ke yi tong guo zhan dou zhang wo lai huo de li liang ， nin ke yi tong guo wan cheng zhan dou zhang wo ren wu lai huo de li liang 。]

english: As before, you'll initially be restricted to the Regions of Misthalin and Karamja. However, as you progress, you'll be able to unlock new areas of your choosing.
translation: 和以前一样，您最初将被限制在米斯塔林和卡拉姆贾地区。然而，随着你的进步，你将能够解锁你选择的新领域。 [he yi qian yi yang ， nin zui chu jiang bei xian zhi zai mi si ta lin he ka la mu jia di qu 。 ran er ， sui zhe ni de jin bu ， ni jiang neng gou jie suo ni xuan ze de xin ling yu 。]

english: Be warned though - you won't be able to unlock every area, so choose wisely.
translation: 但请注意 - 您将无法解锁每个区域，因此请明智地选择。 [dan qing zhu yi  -  nin jiang wu fa jie suo mei ge qu yu ， yin ci qing ming zhi di xuan ze 。]

english: You must participate as an Ironman. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.
translation: 您必须以铁人三项身份参加。这意味着您是孤立的，无法与其他参与者进行交易。 [nin bi xu yi tie ren san xiang shen fen can jia 。 zhe yi wei zhe nin shi gu li de ， wu fa yu qi ta can yu zhe jin xing jiao yi 。]

english: And that's not all. Training skills during the League will grant you substantially more experience than you'd normally expect.
translation: 这还不是全部。联赛期间的技能训练将为您提供比您通常预期更多的经验。 [zhe hai bu shi quan bu 。 lian sai qi jian de ji neng xun lian jiang wei nin ti gong bi nin tong chang yu qi geng duo de jing yan 。]

english: These experience increases are known as passive effects, which get more generous the higher your Relic tier.
translation: 这些经验的增加被称为被动效果，您的遗物等级越高，其效果就越丰厚。 [zhe xie jing yan de zeng jia bei cheng wei bei dong xiao guo ， nin de yi wu deng ji yue gao ， qi xiao guo jiu yue feng hou 。]

english: Finally, some quests have been completed for you automatically. Further quests and more will be completed as you unlock the relevant areas.
translation: 最后，一些任务已经自动为你完成。当您解锁相关区域时，将完成更多任务。 [zui hou ， yi xie ren wu yi jing zi dong wei ni wan cheng 。 dang nin jie suo xiang guan qu yu shi ， jiang wan cheng geng duo ren wu 。]

english: I think that covers the basics. Would you like to know more, [player name]?
translation: 我认为这涵盖了基础知识。你想了解更多吗，[玩家姓名]？ [wo ren wei zhe han gai le ji chu zhi shi 。 ni xiang liao jie geng duo ma ，[ wan jia xing ming ]？]

english: Yes, please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Not right now.
translation: 现在不行。 [xian zai bu xing 。]

english: Is there anything else you need from me?
translation: 您还需要我提供什么吗？ [nin hai xu yao wo ti gong shen me ma ？]

english: Can you tell me about Combat Masteries?
translation: 你能告诉我关于战斗精通的事情吗？ [ni neng gao su wo guan yu zhan dou jing tong de shi qing ma ？]

english: Combat Masteries are powerful boons granted by me that enhance your combat abilities for the entire League.
translation: 战斗精通是我授予的强大恩赐，可以增强你在整个联盟中的战斗能力。 [zhan dou jing tong shi wo shou yu de qiang da en ci ， ke yi zeng qiang ni zai zheng ge lian meng zhong de zhan dou neng li 。]

english: After all, it wouldn't be very interesting to ask you to defeat the enemies' raging echoes without allowing you to draw on your own.
translation: 毕竟，要求你击败敌人的狂暴回声而不让你自己绘制，这不是很有趣。 [bi jing ， yao qiu ni ji bai di ren de kuang bao hui sheng er bu rang ni zi ji hui zhi ， zhe bu shi hen you qu 。]

english: You can obtain them by completing specific combat tasks to prove yourself to me.
translation: 你可以通过完成特定的战斗任务来获得它们，向我证明你自己。 [ni ke yi tong guo wan cheng te ding de zhan dou ren wu lai huo de ta men ， xiang wo zheng ming ni zi ji 。]

english: Combat Masteries are split into the three combat styles: Ranged, Melee, and Mage. To unlock each mastery, you must have unlocked the previous mastery for that style.
translation: 战斗精通分为三种战斗风格：远程、近战和法师。要解锁每个精通，您必须解锁该风格的先前精通。 [zhan dou jing tong fen wei san zhong zhan dou feng ge ： yuan cheng 、 jin zhan he fa shi 。 yao jie suo mei ge jing tong ， nin bi xu jie suo gai feng ge de xian qian jing tong 。]

english: There are 6 combat masteries for each style, but only 10 mastery points can be obtained. Once you have selected a mastery there is no going back, so choose your masteries wisely.
translation: 每种风格有6个战斗精通，但只能获得10个精通点。一旦你选择了专长，就无法回头，所以明智地选择你的专长。 [mei zhong feng ge you 6 ge zhan dou jing tong ， dan zhi neng huo de 10 ge jing tong dian 。 yi dan ni xuan ze le zhuan chang ， jiu wu fa hui tou ， suo yi ming zhi di xuan ze ni de zhuan chang 。]

english: Now, would you like to take a look at the Combat Masteries available to you?
translation: 现在，您想看看您可以使用的战斗精通吗？ [xian zai ， nin xiang kan kan nin ke yi shi yong de zhan dou jing tong ma ？]

english: Fair enough. Is there anything else you need from me?
translation: 很公平。您还需要我提供什么吗？ [hen gong ping 。 nin hai xu yao wo ti gong shen me ma ？]

english: How do tasks work?
translation: 任务如何进行？ [ren wu ru he jin xing ？]

english: In every League, there are a number of tasks for you to complete. Each task has a level of difficulty: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite and Master.
translation: 在每个联赛中，都有许多任务等待您完成。每个任务都有一个难度级别：简单、中等、困难、精英和大师。 [zai mei ge lian sai zhong ， dou you xu duo ren wu deng dai nin wan cheng 。 mei ge ren wu dou you yi ge nan du ji bie ： jian dan 、 zhong deng 、 kun nan 、 jing ying he da shi 。]

english: Completing tasks allows you to access new areas. The more tasks you complete, the more areas become available to unlock.
translation: 完成任务可以让你进入新的领域。您完成的任务越多，可解锁的区域就越多。 [wan cheng ren wu ke yi rang ni jin ru xin de ling yu 。 nin wan cheng de ren wu yue duo ， ke jie suo de qu yu jiu yue duo 。]

english: Not only that, completing tasks also earns you League Points. The number of points earned is dependent on the difficulty of the task.
translation: 不仅如此，完成任务还可以获得联盟积分。获得的积分数量取决于任务的难度。 [bu jin ru ci ， wan cheng ren wu hai ke yi huo de lian meng ji fen 。 huo de de ji fen shu liang qu jue yu ren wu de nan du 。]

english: What do these points do?
translation: 这些点有什么作用呢？ [zhe xie dian you shen me zuo yong ne ？]

english: Once you have achieved a certain amount of League Points you can unlock a new Relic of mine. These are powerful artefacts to help you in this world.
translation: 一旦你达到一定数量的联盟积分，你就可以解锁我的新遗物。这些都是强大的文物，可以在这个世界上帮助你。 [yi dan ni da dao yi ding shu liang de lian meng ji fen ， ni jiu ke yi jie suo wo de xin yi wu 。 zhe xie dou shi qiang da de wen wu ， ke yi zai zhe ge shi jie shang bang zhu ni 。]

english: League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: 联盟积分还可用于从联盟奖励商店购买奖励。 [lian meng ji fen hai ke yong yu cong lian meng jiang li shang dian gou mai jiang li 。]

english: So how many tasks are there?
translation: 那么有多少个任务呢？ [na me you duo shao ge ren wu ne ？]

english: More than you'll ever be able to complete, most likely. It's up to you which ones you attempt.
translation: 很可能比你能够完成的还要多。这取决于你尝试哪些。 [hen ke neng bi ni neng gou wan cheng de hai yao duo 。 zhe qu jue yu ni chang shi na xie 。]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: Now, would you like to take a look at the tasks for this League?
translation: 现在，您想看一下本次联赛的任务吗？ [xian zai ， nin xiang kan yi xia ben ci lian sai de ren wu ma ？]

english: How does the area system work?
translation: 区域系统如何运作？ [qu yu xi tong ru he yun zuo ？]

english: Currently, you are restricted to the Kingdom of Misthalin and the island of Karamja. However, as you progress, you can unlock more areas.
translation: 目前，您仅限于米沙林王国和卡拉姆贾岛。然而，随着你的进步，你可以解锁更多区域。 [mu qian ， nin jin xian yu mi sha lin wang guo he ka la mu jia dao 。 ran er ， sui zhe ni de jin bu ， ni ke yi jie suo geng duo qu yu 。]

english: There are eleven different areas in total. However, you can only unlock a maximum of five, including the two you've started with. Choose wisely.
translation: 总共有十一个不同的区域。但是，您最多只能解锁五个，包括您开始时使用的两个。明智地选择。 [zong gong you shi yi ge bu tong de qu yu 。 dan shi ， nin zui duo zhi neng jie suo wu ge ， bao kuo nin kai shi shi shi yong de liang ge 。 ming zhi di xuan ze 。]

english: I give the first two area unlocks to everyone. You can unlock the other three by completing the tasks I've set.
translation: 我将前两个区域解锁给大家。你可以通过完成我设置的任务来解锁其他三个。 [wo jiang qian liang ge qu yu jie suo gei da jia 。 ni ke yi tong guo wan cheng wo she zhi de ren wu lai jie suo qi ta san ge 。]

english: The more tasks you complete, the more areas you can unlock.
translation: 完成的任务越多，可以解锁的区域就越多。 [wan cheng de ren wu yue duo ， ke yi jie suo de qu yu jiu yue duo 。]

english: I see. Thanks!
translation: 我懂了。谢谢！ [wo dong le 。 xie xie ！]

english: Would you like to take a look at the available areas now?
translation: 您现在想看看可用的区域吗？ [nin xian zai xiang kan kan ke yong de qu yu ma ？]

english: What are Relics?
translation: 什么是遗物？ [shen me shi yi wu ？]

english: Relics are powerful artefacts made by me that grant unique abilities for the entire League.
translation: 遗物是我制作的强大文物，赋予整个联盟独特的能力。 [yi wu shi wo zhi zuo de qiang da wen wu ， fu yu zheng ge lian meng du te de neng li 。]

english: You may even recognise a few from Leagues past.
translation: 您甚至可能会在过去的联赛中认出一些。 [nin shen zhi ke neng hui zai guo qu de lian sai zhong ren chu yi xie 。]

english: There are 23 separate Relics, split across 8 different tiers. You can only have one Relic from each tier, however.
translation: 有 23 个独立的遗物，分为 8 个不同的等级。然而，每一层你只能拥有一件遗物。 [you  23  ge du li de yi wu ， fen wei  8  ge bu tong de deng ji 。 ran er ， mei yi ceng ni zhi neng yong you yi jian yi wu 。]

english: The first Relic tier is available to everyone. The others must be unlocked with League Points.
translation: 第一级遗物可供所有人使用。其他人必须用联盟积分解锁。 [di yi ji yi wu ke gong suo you ren shi yong 。 qi ta ren bi xu yong lian meng ji fen jie suo 。]

english: League Points are earned by completing tasks.
translation: 联盟积分是通过完成任务获得的。 [lian meng ji fen shi tong guo wan cheng ren wu huo de de 。]

english: Once you have selected a Relic, your choice can't be changed for the rest of the League. Make your choices carefully.
translation: 一旦您选择了遗物，您的选择就无法为联盟的其他成员更改。仔细做出选择。 [yi dan nin xuan ze le yi wu ， nin de xuan ze jiu wu fa wei lian meng de qi ta cheng yuan geng gai 。 zi xi zuo chu xuan ze 。]

english: Would you like to take a look at the Relics for this League?
translation: 您想看一下这个联盟的遗迹吗？ [nin xiang kan yi xia zhe ge lian meng de yi ji ma ？]

english: Very well. Is there anything else you need from me?
translation: 很好。您还需要我提供什么吗？ [hen hao 。 nin hai xu yao wo ti gong shen me ma ？]

english: Can I claim some combat achievement rewards?
translation: 我可以领取一些战斗成就奖励吗？ [wo ke yi ling qu yi xie zhan dou cheng jiu jiang li ma ？]

english: You do not appear to have any combat achievement rewards available to claim.
translation: 您似乎没有任何可供领取的战斗成就奖励。 [nin si hu mei you ren he ke gong ling qu de zhan dou cheng jiu jiang li 。]

english: You don't have enough room.
translation: 你没有足够的空间。 [ni mei you zu gou de kong jian 。]

english: You don't have enough gold.
translation: 你没有足够的金币。 [ni mei you zu gou de jin bi 。]

english: There you go. Congratulations, even if it may have been accelerated with my power, it's still a real accomplishment.
translation: 就这样吧。恭喜你，就算是用我的力量加速了，也算是真正的成就了。 [jiu zhe yang ba 。 gong xi ni ， jiu suan shi yong wo de li liang jia su le ， ye suan shi zhen zheng de cheng jiu le 。]

english: I have some more questions.
translation: 我还有一些问题。 [wo hai you yi xie wen ti 。]

english: Tell me about League rewards.
translation: 告诉我有关联赛奖励的信息。 [gao su wo you guan lian sai jiang li de xin xi 。]

english: As well as letting you unlock new areas, completing tasks in the League will earn you League Points. The more League Points you have, the more Relic tiers you have available.
translation: 除了让您解锁新区域之外，完成联盟中的任务还将为您赢得联盟积分。您拥有的联盟积分越多，您可用的遗物等级就越多。 [chu le rang nin jie suo xin qu yu zhi wai ， wan cheng lian meng zhong de ren wu hai jiang wei nin ying de lian meng ji fen 。 nin yong you de lian meng ji fen yue duo ， nin ke yong de yi wu deng ji jiu yue duo 。]

english: However, alongside allowing you to unlock Relics, League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: 然而，除了允许您解锁遗物之外，联盟积分还可以用于从联盟奖励商店购买奖励。 [ran er ， chu le yun xu nin jie suo yi wu zhi wai ， lian meng ji fen hai ke yi yong yu cong lian meng jiang li shang dian gou mai jiang li 。]

english: What rewards can I buy?
translation: 我可以购买什么奖励？ [wo ke yi gou mai shen me jiang li ？]

english: Oh, all sorts of things. New cosmetic kits, an alternative Home Teleport animation, some rather stylish outfits... and much more.
translation: 哦，各种各样的事情。新的化妆品套件、另类的家庭传送动画、一些相当时尚的服装……等等。 [o ， ge zhong ge yang de shi qing 。 xin de hua zhuang pin tao jian 、 ling lei de jia ting chuan song dong hua 、 yi xie xiang dang shi shang de fu zhuang …… deng deng 。]

english: Many of these rewards can be traded with your fellow mortals, so if you wish, you can earn some money by selling them on. Of course, you might prefer to keep them for yourself instead.
translation: 其中许多奖励可以与你的凡人进行交易，所以如果你愿意，你可以通过出售它们来赚取一些钱。当然，您可能更愿意自己保留它们。 [qi zhong xu duo jiang li ke yi yu ni de fan ren jin xing jiao yi ， suo yi ru guo ni yuan yi ， ni ke yi tong guo chu shou ta men lai zhuan qu yi xie qian 。 dang ran ， nin ke neng geng yuan yi zi ji bao liu ta men 。]

english: I see. That all sounds good to me.
translation: 我懂了。这一切对我来说听起来不错。 [wo dong le 。 zhe yi qie dui wo lai shuo ting qi lai bu cuo 。]

english: You can use this shop to buy previous League rewards, too.
translation: 您也可以使用此商店购买以前的联赛奖励。 [nin ye ke yi shi yong ci shang dian gou mai yi qian de lian sai jiang li 。]

english: Alongside the rewards in the Leagues Reward Shop, there's also League Ranks.
translation: 除了联赛奖励商店中的奖励之外，还有联赛排名。 [chu le lian sai jiang li shang dian zhong de jiang li zhi wai ， hai you lian sai pai ming 。]

english: League Ranks? How do they work?
translation: 联赛排名？它们如何工作？ [lian sai pai ming ？ ta men ru he gong zuo ？]

english: During the League as you gain more points you will gain a League Rank. This rank can be seen in the Ranks interface.
translation: 在联赛期间，随着您获得更多积分，您将获得联赛排名。这个排名可以在排名界面中看到。 [zai lian sai qi jian ， sui zhe nin huo de geng duo ji fen ， nin jiang huo de lian sai pai ming 。 zhe ge pai ming ke yi zai pai ming jie mian zhong kan dao 。]

english: You currently have the rank: [rank].
translation: 您目前的等级：[等级]。 [nin mu qian de deng ji ：[ deng ji ]。]

english: As you get ranks you will gain access to trophies.
translation: 当你获得排名时，你将获得奖杯。 [dang ni huo de pai ming shi ， ni jiang huo de jiang bei 。]

english: Trophies?
translation: 奖杯？ [jiang bei ？]

english: That's right. Trophies are items that are awarded to you for competing in the League. You can use them to show off your League Rank.
translation: 这是正确的。奖杯是为您参加联赛而颁发的物品。您可以使用它们来炫耀您的联赛排名。 [zhe shi zheng que de 。 jiang bei shi wei nin can jia lian sai er ban fa de wu pin 。 nin ke yi shi yong ta men lai xuan yao nin de lian sai pai ming 。]

english: Connected to League Ranks are the League to League rewards. These are unlocked in the next League based upon the League Rank you earn in this one.
translation: 与联赛排名相关的是联赛之间的奖励。这些将根据您在本赛季中获得的联赛排名在下一个联赛中解锁。 [yu lian sai pai ming xiang guan de shi lian sai zhi jian de jiang li 。 zhe xie jiang gen ju nin zai ben sai ji zhong huo de de lian sai pai ming zai xia yi ge lian sai zhong jie suo 。]

english: League Starter Outfits and League Icons are some of things you can unlock for the next League. In addition, any pets you earn in this League will transfer over to the next one.
translation: 联赛首发服装和联赛图标是您可以为下一个联赛解锁的一些东西。此外，您在本联赛中获得的任何宠物都将转移到下一联赛。 [lian sai shou fa fu zhuang he lian sai tu biao shi nin ke yi wei xia yi ge lian sai jie suo de yi xie dong xi 。 ci wai ， nin zai ben lian sai zhong huo de de ren he chong wu dou jiang zhuan yi dao xia yi lian sai 。]

english: Finally, on top of the tasks for this League, there are some other activities for which I will recognise the first person who completes them.
translation: 最后，除了本联盟的任务之外，还有一些其他活动，我将表彰第一个完成这些活动的人。 [zui hou ， chu le ben lian meng de ren wu zhi wai ， hai you yi xie qi ta huo dong ， wo jiang biao zhang di yi ge wan cheng zhe xie huo dong de ren 。]

english: You can view the entire list of activities, as well as whether or not someone has completed them, by reading the board beside me.
translation: 您可以通过阅读我旁边的看板来查看整个活动列表，以及是否有人已完成这些活动。 [nin ke yi tong guo yue du wo pang bian de kan ban lai cha kan zheng ge huo dong lie biao ， yi ji shi fou you ren yi wan cheng zhe xie huo dong 。]

english: My pleasure. Now, is there anything else you need from me?
translation: 我的荣幸。现在，你还需要我做什么吗？ [wo de rong xing 。 xian zai ， ni hai xu yao wo zuo shen me ma ？]

english: Let's talk about pets.
translation: 我们来谈谈宠物吧。 [wo men lai tan tan chong wu ba 。]

english: Can you tell me how pets work in Leagues?
translation: 你能告诉我宠物在联赛中的作用吗？ [ni neng gao su wo chong wu zai lian sai zhong de zuo yong ma ？]

english: But of course. If you're lucky enough to obtain a pet during a League, it will automatically be insured for you.
translation: 当然。如果您有幸在联赛期间获得一只宠物，它会自动为您投保。 [dang ran 。 ru guo nin you xing zai lian sai qi jian huo de yi zhi chong wu ， ta hui zi dong wei nin tou bao 。]

english: This means that if you lose it somehow you can talk to me and I'll give it back to you. Insurance and reclaiming is all free of charge.
translation: 这意味着，如果您以某种方式丢失了它，您可以与我交谈，我会将其还给您。保险和索赔都是免费的。 [zhe yi wei zhe ， ru guo nin yi mou zhong fang shi diu shi le ta ， nin ke yi yu wo jiao tan ， wo hui jiang qi huan gei nin 。 bao xian he suo pei dou shi mian fei de 。]

english: Additionally, each pet you obtain will be transferred to the next League. I'll take good care of it until you're ready to reclaim it.
translation: 此外，您获得的每只宠物都将转移到下一个联盟。我会好好照顾它，直到你准备好收回它为止。 [ci wai ， nin huo de de mei zhi chong wu dou jiang zhuan yi dao xia yi ge lian meng 。 wo hui hao hao zhao gu ta ， zhi dao ni zhun bei hao shou hui ta wei zhi 。]

english: Okay! Thank you.
translation: 好的！谢谢。 [hao de ！ xie xie 。]

english: Come back to me once you have some pets and you can view your collection. Now, is there anything else you need from me?
translation: 一旦你有了一些宠物，就回来找我，你可以查看你的收藏。现在，你还需要我做什么吗？ [yi dan ni you le yi xie chong wu ， jiu hui lai zhao wo ， ni ke yi cha kan ni de shou cang 。 xian zai ， ni hai xu yao wo zuo shen me ma ？]

english: Do I have any League items to collect?
translation: 我有任何联盟物品可以收集吗？ [wo you ren he lian meng wu pin ke yi shou ji ma ？]

english: You receive some items from the Sage.
translation: 你会从圣人那里收到一些物品。 [ni hui cong sheng ren na li shou dao yi xie wu pin 。]

english: Can you help me smash vials?
translation: 你能帮我打碎瓶子吗？ [ni neng bang wo da sui ping zi ma ？]

english: With all of my power, this is something I can manage. You will now automatically smash vials.
translation: 以我的全部力量，这是我可以做到的。您现在将自动粉碎小瓶。 [yi wo de quan bu li liang ， zhe shi wo ke yi zuo dao de 。 nin xian zai jiang zi dong fen sui xiao ping 。]

english: With all of my power, this is something I can manage. You will no longer smash vials automatically.
translation: 以我的全部力量，这是我可以做到的。您将不再自动粉碎小瓶。 [yi wo de quan bu li liang ， zhe shi wo ke yi zuo dao de 。 nin jiang bu zai zi dong fen sui xiao ping 。]

english: Let's circle back.
translation: 我们绕回来吧。 [wo men rao hui lai ba 。]

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Very well. I'll be here if you ever need to know anything more.
translation: 很好。如果您需要了解更多信息，我会在这里。 [hen hao 。 ru guo nin xu yao liao jie geng duo xin xi ， wo hui zai zhe li 。]

english: Oh my, that's a rare thing you've got there.
translation: 天啊，你那里有这样的东西真是罕见。 [tian a ， ni na li you zhe yang de dong xi zhen shi han jian 。]

english: I guess you'll be wanting to trade it in for one of Gielinor's powerful weapons.
translation: 我猜你会想用它来换取吉林诺的一件强大武器。 [wo cai ni hui xiang yong ta lai huan qu ji lin nuo de yi jian qiang da wu qi 。]

english: Enjoy.
translation: 享受。 [xiang shou 。]

english: You cannot do that in this world, you must abide by my rules, mortal.
translation: 在这个世界上你不能这么做，你必须遵守我的规则，凡人。 [zai zhe ge shi jie shang ni bu neng zhe me zuo ， ni bi xu zun shou wo de gui ze ， fan ren 。]

english: What changes have been made for this League?
translation: 本次联赛有哪些变化？ [ben ci lian sai you na xie bian hua ？]

english: Yes, please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Not right now.
translation: 现在不行。 [xian zai bu xing 。]

english: Can you tell me about Combat Masteries?
translation: 你能告诉我关于战斗精通的事情吗？ [ni neng gao su wo guan yu zhan dou jing tong de shi qing ma ？]

english: How do tasks work?
translation: 任务如何进行？ [ren wu ru he jin xing ？]

english: How does the area system work?
translation: 区域系统如何运作？ [qu yu xi tong ru he yun zuo ？]

english: More options...
translation: 更多选择... [geng duo xuan ze ...]

english: What are Relics?
translation: 什么是遗物？ [shen me shi yi wu ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Can I claim some Combat rewards?
translation: 我可以领取一些战斗奖励吗？ [wo ke yi ling qu yi xie zhan dou jiang li ma ？]

english: Could I buy a max cape off you?
translation: 我可以从你那里买一件最大的斗篷吗？ [wo ke yi cong ni na li mai yi jian zui da de dou peng ma ？]

english: I have some more questions.
translation: 我还有一些问题。 [wo hai you yi xie wen ti 。]

english: Tell me about League rewards.
translation: 告诉我有关联赛奖励的信息。 [gao su wo you guan lian sai jiang li de xin xi 。]

english: Let's talk about pets.
