translation: 我们来谈谈宠物吧。 [wo men lai tan tan chong wu ba 。]

english: Do I have any League items to collect?
translation: 我有任何联盟物品可以收集吗？ [wo you ren he lian meng wu pin ke yi shou ji ma ？]

english: Can you help me smash vials?
translation: 你能帮我打碎瓶子吗？ [ni neng bang wo da sui ping zi ma ？]

english: Let's circle back.
translation: 我们绕回来吧。 [wo men rao hui lai ba 。]

english: I'm good, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Previous options...
translation: 之前的选项... [zhi qian de xuan xiang ...]

english: Twisted Bow
translation: 扭曲弓 [niu qu gong]

english: No, I've changed my mind.
translation: 不，我改变主意了。 [bu ， wo gai bian zhu yi le 。]

english: Yes, I want Twisted bow
translation: 是的，我想要扭曲的弓 [shi de ， wo xiang yao niu qu de gong]

english: Scythe of Vitur
translation: 维图尔之镰 [wei tu er zhi lian]

english: Yes, I want Scythe of vitur (uncharged)
translation: 是的，我想要维图尔之镰（不带电） [shi de ， wo xiang yao wei tu er zhi lian （ bu dai dian ）]

english: Tumeken's shadow
translation: 图梅肯的影子 [tu mei ken de ying zi]

english: Yes, I want Tumeken's shadow (uncharged)
translation: 是的，我想要图梅肯的影子（不带电） [shi de ， wo xiang yao tu mei ken de ying zi （ bu dai dian ）]

english: Greetings, how may I be of service.
translation: 您好，请问有什么可以为您服务的。 [nin hao ， qing wen you shen me ke yi wei nin fu wu de 。]

english: Who are you? What is your name?
translation: 你是谁？你叫什么名字？ [ni shi shui ？ ni jiao shen me ming zi ？]

english: Who am I?
translation: 我是谁？ [wo shi shui ？]

english: I am whatever is needed of me.
translation: 我就是任何需要我的人。 [wo jiu shi ren he xu yao wo de ren 。]

english: I am a form undefined by natural laws, manifested by someone we mustn't speak of.
translation: 我是一种不受自然法则定义的形态，由我们不能谈论的某个人显现。 [wo shi yi zhong bu shou zi ran fa ze ding yi de xing tai ， you wo men bu neng tan lun de mou ge ren xian xian 。]

english: I'm a clay doll, shaped by a sculptor. Never allowed to set, forever malleable. But maybe, not for long...
translation: 我是一个泥娃娃，由雕塑家塑造而成。绝不允许凝固，永远具有延展性。但也许，不会太久…… [wo shi yi ge ni wa wa ， you diao su jia su zao er cheng 。 jue bu yun xu ning gu ， yong yuan ju you yan zhan xing 。 dan ye xu ， bu hui tai jiu ……]

english: My true name is immaterial, But you may call me...
translation: 我的真名并不重要，但你可以叫我... [wo de zhen ming bing bu zhong yao ， dan ni ke yi jiao wo ...]

english: Let's see now, what would be most appropriate?
translation: 现在让我们看看，什么最合适？ [xian zai rang wo men kan kan ， shen me zui he shi ？]

english: Ah, yes.
translation: 啊，是的。 [a ， shi de 。]

english: You may call me The Sage.
translation: 你可以叫我圣人。 [ni ke yi jiao wo sheng ren 。]

english: Uhhh, ok... Sage. Where did you bring us?
translation: 呃呃，好吧……圣人。你把我们带到哪儿了？ [e e ， hao ba …… sheng ren 。 ni ba wo men dai dao na er le ？]

english: 'Where' is the right question my friend, but maybe not in the way you are accustomed to hearing.
translation: 我的朋友，“哪里”是正确的问题，但可能不是你习惯听到的方式。 [wo de peng you ，“ na li ” shi zheng que de wen ti ， dan ke neng bu shi ni xi guan ting dao de fang shi 。]

english: Reality as you know it has many layers, all slightly different with their own rules.
translation: 如你所知，现实有很多层，每个层都有自己的规则，略有不同。 [ru ni suo zhi ， xian shi you hen duo ceng ， mei ge ceng dou you zi ji de gui ze ， lve you bu tong 。]

english: Through the power granted to me, I brought us to this layer using the River-Between. The River of Souls.
translation: 通过赋予我的力量，我利用中间之河将我们带到了这一层。灵魂之河。 [tong guo fu yu wo de li liang ， wo li yong zhong jian zhi he jiang wo men dai dao le zhe yi ceng 。 ling hun zhi he 。]

english: We now stand on the stage of what is yet to be your most entertaining performance yet!
translation: 我们现在站在舞台上，这是你们迄今为止最有趣的表演！ [wo men xian zai zhan zai wu tai shang ， zhe shi ni men qi jin wei zhi zui you qu de biao yan ！]

english: Layers? River-Between? What does any of this mean?
translation: 层数？河流之间？这意味着什么？ [ceng shu ？ he liu zhi jian ？ zhe yi wei zhe shen me ？]

english: To give everything away at this point would be unwise, considering we are being watched even now. You should only be concerned about one thing.
translation: 考虑到我们现在就受到监视，此时放弃一切是不明智的。你应该只关心一件事。 [kao lv dao wo men xian zai jiu shou dao jian shi ， ci shi fang qi yi qie shi bu ming zhi de 。 ni ying gai zhi guan xin yi jian shi 。]

english: Being entertaining.
translation: 很有趣。 [hen you qu 。]

english: That's the only way you will get out of this event alive...
translation: 这是你活着逃离这次事件的唯一方法...... [zhe shi ni huo zhe tao li zhe ci shi jian de wei yi fang fa ......]

english: Entertaining? What are you talking about? Who am I entertaining? Stop talking in riddles!
translation: 有趣吗？你在说什么？我在娱乐谁？别再说谜语了！ [you qu ma ？ ni zai shuo shen me ？ wo zai yu le shui ？ bie zai shuo mi yu le ！]

english: Ahh, [player name], please forgive me. In my attempts to explain, I appear to have confused you even further...
translation: 啊，[玩家名字]，请原谅我。在我试图解释的过程中，我似乎让你更加困惑了...... [a ，[ wan jia ming zi ]， qing yuan liang wo 。 zai wo shi tu jie shi de guo cheng zhong ， wo si hu rang ni geng jia kun huo le ......]

english: I will keep things simple for you; Participate in this event and you will continue to exist. Refusal to participate will end in your eventual destruction.
translation: 我会让事情变得简单；参加这个活动，你将继续存在。拒绝参与将导致你最终的毁灭。 [wo hui rang shi qing bian de jian dan ； can jia zhe ge huo dong ， ni jiang ji xu cun zai 。 ju jue can yu jiang dao zhi ni zui zhong de hui mie 。]

english: The choice is yours... hero.
translation: 选择是你的……英雄。 [xuan ze shi ni de …… ying xiong 。]

english: Well, that doesn't really answer anything...
translation: 好吧，这并不能真正回答任何问题...... [hao ba ， zhe bing bu neng zhen zheng hui da ren he wen ti ......]

english: Worry not. I have much grander plans for you yet, but like all good stories we must wait for the right time and place...
translation: 不用担心。我对你还有更宏伟的计划，但就像所有好故事一样，我们必须等待正确的时间和地点...... [bu yong dan xin 。 wo dui ni hai you geng hong wei de ji hua ， dan jiu xiang suo you hao gu shi yi yang ， wo men bi xu deng dai zheng que de shi jian he di dian ......]

english: You mentioned other Leagues - how does this differ from those?
translation: 您提到了其他联赛 - 这与其他联赛有何不同？ [nin ti dao le qi ta lian sai  -  zhe yu qi ta lian sai you he bu tong ？]

english: Like all events before it, the rules of the world have been altered to be more entertaining for those who are watching.
translation: 与之前的所有赛事一样，世界规则也发生了变化，对于观看者来说更加有趣。 [yu zhi qian de suo you sai shi yi yang ， shi jie gui ze ye fa sheng le bian hua ， dui yu guan kan zhe lai shuo geng jia you qu 。]

english: The biggest change has been to the Relics from the previous chapter.
translation: 与上一章相比，最大的变化是遗物。 [yu shang yi zhang xiang bi ， zui da de bian hua shi yi wu 。]

english: These objects of power are now gone, I have broken them into Fragments and spread across this iteration of the world.
translation: 这些力量之物现在已经消失了，我已将它们打碎成碎片，并散布在这个迭代的世界中。 [zhe xie li liang zhi wu xian zai yi jing xiao shi le ， wo yi jiang ta men da sui cheng sui pian ， bing san bu zai zhe ge die dai de shi jie zhong 。]

english: When multiple Fragments are in harmony, they can be used together to create powerful effects.
translation: 当多个Fragment协调一致时，它们可以一起使用来创造强大的效果。 [dang duo ge Fragment xie tiao yi zhi shi ， ta men ke yi yi qi shi yong lai chuang zao qiang da de xiao guo 。]

english: Yes, I remember you shattering them on the boat ride.
translation: 是的，我记得你在乘船时把它们摔碎了。 [shi de ， wo ji de ni zai cheng chuan shi ba ta men shuai sui le 。]

english: So I have Fragments to collect... got it. Are there any OTHER weird rules I should know about?
translation: 所以我有碎片要收集...明白了。还有其他我应该知道的奇怪规则吗？ [suo yi wo you sui pian yao shou ji ... ming bai le 。 hai you qi ta wo ying gai zhi dao de qi guai gui ze ma ？]

english: I understand that in previous Leagues, they limited you to smaller spaces of your world.
translation: 据我所知，在以前的联赛中，他们将你限制在世界的较小空间内。 [ju wo suo zhi ， zai yi qian de lian sai zhong ， ta men jiang ni xian zhi zai shi jie de jiao xiao kong jian nei 。]

english: That restriction doesn't exist in this event.
translation: 本次活动中不存在该限制。 [ben ci huo dong zhong bu cun zai gai xian zhi 。]

english: You're free to roam your world, exploring the furthest reaches from Morytania to Kourend & Kebos.
translation: 您可以自由地漫游您的世界，探索从莫里塔尼亚到库伦德和科博斯的最远地区。 [nin ke yi zi you di man you nin de shi jie ， tan suo cong mo li ta ni ya dao ku lun de he ke bo si de zui yuan di qu 。]

english: But there's a catch.
translation: 但有一个问题。 [dan you yi ge wen ti 。]

english: Oh great... there's always a catch.
translation: 哦，太棒了……总有一个陷阱。 [o ， tai bang le …… zong you yi ge xian jing 。]

english: I've limited and reset some of your memories, meaning you won't be able to interact with certain elements of this world.
translation: 我限制并重置了你的一些记忆，这意味着你将无法与这个世界的某些元素互动。 [wo xian zhi bing zhong zhi le ni de yi xie ji yi ， zhe yi wei zhe ni jiang wu fa yu zhe ge shi jie de mou xie yuan su hu dong 。]

english: For example, you'll only have access to three skills: Defence, Fishing and Thieving, as well as the Combat Class you chose earlier.
translation: 例如，你只能使用三种技能：防御、钓鱼和盗窃，以及你之前选择的战斗类别。 [li ru ， ni zhi neng shi yong san zhong ji neng ： fang yu 、 diao yu he dao qie ， yi ji ni zhi qian xuan ze de zhan dou lei bie 。]

english: In order to gain access to other skills, you need to complete Tasks for me.
translation: 为了获得其他技能，您需要为我完成任务。 [wei le huo de qi ta ji neng ， nin xu yao wei wo wan cheng ren wu 。]

english: Doing so gives you Sage's Renown. A rather fitting name, I thought.
translation: 这样做会给你圣人的声望。我想，一个相当合适的名字。 [zhe yang zuo hui gei ni sheng ren de sheng wang 。 wo xiang ， yi ge xiang dang he shi de ming zi 。]

english: With Renown you can purchase access to new skills as well as bosses and quests.
translation: 通过声望，您可以购买新技能以及 Boss 和任务。 [tong guo sheng wang ， nin ke yi gou mai xin ji neng yi ji  Boss  he ren wu 。]

english: Why are you doing all of this? Surely I'd be more 'entertaining' if I could have all the power at once?
translation: 你为什么要做这一切？如果我能同时拥有所有的力量，我肯定会更“有趣”吗？ [ni wei shen me yao zuo zhe yi qie ？ ru guo wo neng tong shi yong you suo you de li liang ， wo ken ding hui geng “ you qu ” ma ？]

english: I can't just give you all that power. What kind of story starts the hero with all the power they want?
translation: 我不能只给你所有的力量。什么样的故事让英雄开始拥有他们想要的所有力量？ [wo bu neng zhi gei ni suo you de li liang 。 shen me yang de gu shi rang ying xiong kai shi yong you ta men xiang yao de suo you li liang ？]

english: No, your story needs good rhythm. A sort of cadence that makes things interesting for your audience.
translation: 不，你的故事需要良好的节奏。一种让观众感兴趣的节奏。 [bu ， ni de gu shi xu yao liang hao de jie zou 。 yi zhong rang guan zhong gan xing qu de jie zou 。]

english: Start slow, work your way up. Become the hero you were always meant to be...
translation: 慢慢开始，逐步提高。成为你一直想成为的英雄...... [man man kai shi ， zhu bu ti gao 。 cheng wei ni yi zhi xiang cheng wei de ying xiong ......]

english: Once you have proven yourself, then and only then will you earn my renown.
translation: 一旦你证明了自己，只有这样，你才能赢得我的声誉。 [yi dan ni zheng ming liao zi ji ， zhi you zhe yang ， ni cai neng ying de wo de sheng yu 。]

english: That's how you provide good entertainment my friend...
translation: 这就是你提供良好娱乐的方式我的朋友...... [zhe jiu shi ni ti gong liang hao yu le de fang shi wo de peng you ......]

english: That's how you make a hero.
translation: 这就是你如何成为英雄的。 [zhe jiu shi ni ru he cheng wei ying xiong de 。]

english: I suppose you're right...
translation: 我想你是对的... [wo xiang ni shi dui de ...]

english: Do you desire more information?
translation: 您想要更多信息吗？ [nin xiang yao geng duo xin xi ma ？]

english: Go forward and continue your journey.
translation: 继续前进并继续你的旅程。 [ji xu qian jin bing ji xu ni de lv cheng 。]

english: Remember, we are always watching...
translation: 请记住，我们一直在注视着... [qing ji zhu ， wo men yi zhi zai zhu shi zhe ...]

english: Any tips you can give me on being 'entertaining'?
translation: 你能给我一些关于“娱乐”的建议吗？ [ni neng gei wo yi xie guan yu “ yu le ” de jian yi ma ？]

english: I have devised a number of tasks to help keep your story on track.
translation: 我设计了一些任务来帮助你的故事步入正轨。 [wo she ji le yi xie ren wu lai bang zhu ni de gu shi bu ru zheng gui 。]

english: Each task has a level of difficulty: Beginner, Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite and Master.
translation: 每个任务都有一定的难度级别：初级、简单、中等、困难、精英和大师。 [mei ge ren wu dou you yi ding de nan du ji bie ： chu ji 、 jian dan 、 zhong deng 、 kun nan 、 jing ying he da shi 。]

english: The more tasks you complete, the more activities you can unlock.
translation: 您完成的任务越多，您可以解锁的活动就越多。 [nin wan cheng de ren wu yue duo ， nin ke yi jie suo de huo dong jiu yue duo 。]

english: The more content you unlock the more interesting your story will become.
translation: 您解锁的内容越多，您的故事就会变得越有趣。 [nin jie suo de nei rong yue duo ， nin de gu shi jiu hui bian de yue you qu 。]

english: The more interesting the story the more entertained the ones watching will be.
translation: 故事越有趣，观看的人就越有趣。 [gu shi yue you qu ， guan kan de ren jiu yue you qu 。]

english: What do I use these 'points' on?
translation: 我用这些“点”做什么？ [wo yong zhe xie “ dian ” zuo shen me ？]

english: Once you have achieved a certain amount of League Points you can unlock a new Fragment Slot.
translation: 一旦您获得一定数量的联盟积分，您就可以解锁新的碎片槽。 [yi dan nin huo de yi ding shu liang de lian meng ji fen ， nin jiu ke yi jie suo xin de sui pian cao 。]

english: These slots allow you to equip more Fragments and become even stronger.
translation: 这些插槽可让您装备更多碎片并变得更加强大。 [zhe xie cha cao ke rang nin zhuang bei geng duo sui pian bing bian de geng jia qiang da 。]

english: Right now, you are playing on your Leagues profile. The Leagues Reward Shop can only be opened on your main profile.
translation: 现在，您正在使用您的联赛个人资料进行比赛。联赛奖励商店只能在您的主要个人资料上打开。 [xian zai ， nin zheng zai shi yong nin de lian sai ge ren zi liao jin xing bi sai 。 lian sai jiang li shang dian zhi neng zai nin de zhu yao ge ren zi liao shang da kai 。]

english: You can access your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.
translation: 您可以通过切换到任何正常的 Old School RuneScape 世界来访问您的主要个人资料。注销菜单中的世界切换器可用于切换世界。 [nin ke yi tong guo qie huan dao ren he zheng chang de  Old School RuneScape  shi jie lai fang wen nin de zhu yao ge ren zi liao 。 zhu xiao cai dan zhong de shi jie qie huan qi ke yong yu qie huan shi jie 。]

english: More than you'll ever be able to complete, given our limited time here.
translation: 鉴于我们在这里的时间有限，您将无法完成更多任务。 [jian yu wo men zai zhe li de shi jian you xian ， nin jiang wu fa wan cheng geng duo ren wu 。]

english: With so many to choose from, it's up to you to decide how your story plays out...
translation: 有这么多可供选择，由你来决定你的故事如何展开...... [you zhe me duo ke gong xuan ze ， you ni lai jue ding ni de gu shi ru he zhan kai ......]

english: Ok... I think I understand what I should do now.
translation: 好吧...我想我明白我现在应该做什么了。 [hao ba ... wo xiang wo ming bai wo xian zai ying gai zuo shen me le 。]

english: Very good. I knew I made the right choice bringing you to this chapter.
translation: 非常好。我知道我做出了正确的选择，让您看到这一章。 [fei chang hao 。 wo zhi dao wo zuo chu le zheng que de xuan ze ， rang nin kan dao zhe yi zhang 。]

english: What is a Fragment?
translation: 什么是片段？ [shen me shi pian duan ？]

english: You remember the Relics from the previous event, yes? The sources of great power that let you achieve amazing feats.
translation: 你还记得上次活动中的遗物，是吗？伟大力量的源泉，让你实现惊人的壮举。 [ni hai ji de shang ci huo dong zhong de yi wu ， shi ma ？ wei da li liang de yuan quan ， rang ni shi xian jing ren de zhuang ju 。]

english: Fragments are similar. As the Fragments were created from the Relics, much of their power remains but in a much-diminished form.
translation: 片段相似。由于碎片是由遗物创造的，它们的大部分力量仍然存在，但形式大大减弱。 [pian duan xiang si 。 you yu sui pian shi you yi wu chuang zao de ， ta men de da bu fen li liang reng ran cun zai ， dan xing shi da da jian ruo 。]

english: They bestow many different bonuses: from helping you cut wood, to making you a more formidable warrior.
translation: 他们给予许多不同的奖励：从帮助你砍柴，到让你成为更强大的战士。 [ta men ji yu xu duo bu tong de jiang li ： cong bang zhu ni kan chai ， dao rang ni cheng wei geng qiang da de zhan shi 。]

english: Equipping Fragments will grant you their power.
translation: 装备碎片会给你带来力量。 [zhuang bei sui pian hui gei ni dai lai li liang 。]

english: You can also level up your Fragments, making them even MORE powerful.
translation: 您还可以升级您的碎片，使它们更加强大。 [nin hai ke yi sheng ji nin de sui pian ， shi ta men geng jia qiang da 。]

english: Gaining experience as you normally would will level up your Fragments, making them even more useful.
translation: 像平常一样获得经验会升级你的碎片，使它们更加有用。 [xiang ping chang yi yang huo de jing yan hui sheng ji ni de sui pian ， shi ta men geng jia you yong 。]

english: How do I find these Fragments?
translation: 我如何找到这些碎片？ [wo ru he zhao dao zhe xie sui pian ？]

english: I have scattered the Fragments evenly across the world.
translation: 我已将碎片均匀地分散在世界各地。 [wo yi jiang sui pian jun yun di fen san zai shi jie ge di 。]

english: Anytime you kill a monster or gain more experience in a particular skill, you'll have a chance to receive a Fragment.
translation: 每当你杀死怪物或在特定技能上获得更多经验时，你就有机会获得碎片。 [mei dang ni sha si guai wu huo zai te ding ji neng shang huo de geng duo jing yan shi ， ni jiu you ji hui huo de sui pian 。]

english: The harder the enemy or activity, the better chance you'll have.
translation: 敌人或活动越难，你的机会就越大。 [di ren huo huo dong yue nan ， ni de ji hui jiu yue da 。]

english: You will only receive Fragments relevant to the activity, with a few exceptions.
translation: 除少数例外情况外，您只会收到与活动相关的片段。 [chu shao shu li wai qing kuang wai ， nin zhi hui shou dao yu huo dong xiang guan de pian duan 。]

english: I know your kind enjoy seeking out treasure. Fragments related to Treasure Trails can come from anywhere.
translation: 我知道你们喜欢寻找宝藏。与宝藏踪迹相关的碎片可以来自任何地方。 [wo zhi dao ni men xi huan xun zhao bao zang 。 yu bao zang zong ji xiang guan de sui pian ke yi lai zi ren he di fang 。]

english: What happens if I try to put the Fragments back together?
translation: 如果我尝试将碎片重新组合在一起会发生什么？ [ru guo wo chang shi jiang sui pian chong xin zu he zai yi qi hui fa sheng shen me ？]

english: As I said, the Fragments still contain some of their residual Relic energy.
translation: 正如我所说，碎片中仍然含有一些残余的遗物能量。 [zheng ru wo suo shuo ， sui pian zhong reng ran han you yi xie can yu de yi wu neng liang 。]

english: When enough Fragments are brought back together they will emit the same energy they did when they were whole.
translation: 当足够多的碎片重新聚集在一起时，它们将释放出与完整时相同的能量。 [dang zu gou duo de sui pian chong xin ju ji zai yi qi shi ， ta men jiang shi fang chu yu wan zheng shi xiang tong de neng liang 。]

english: For example, if you find five Fragments imbued with Last Recall, you can complete the set and gain access to that Relic's full power.
translation: 例如，如果您发现五个充满最后回忆的碎片，您就可以完成该套装并获得该遗物的全部力量。 [li ru ， ru guo nin fa xian wu ge chong man zui hou hui yi de sui pian ， nin jiu ke yi wan cheng gai tao zhuang bing huo de gai yi wu de quan bu li liang 。]

english: A sort of 'Set Effect' if you will.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，可以说是一种“设定效果”。 [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， ke yi shuo shi yi zhong “ she ding xiao guo ”。]

english: Is there anything else you wish to know?
translation: 您还有什么想知道的吗？ [nin hai you shen me xiang zhi dao de ma ？]

english: How does the content unlock system work?
translation: 内容解锁系统如何工作？ [nei rong jie suo xi tong ru he gong zuo ？]

english: In this iteration of the event I have limited you, at first, to three skills: Thieving, Fishing and Defence.
translation: 在本次活动中，我首先将你限制为三种技能：偷窃、钓鱼和防御。 [zai ben ci huo dong zhong ， wo shou xian jiang ni xian zhi wei san zhong ji neng ： tou qie 、 diao yu he fang yu 。]

english: You can still do simple things like cut trees or mine ore, but doing so will be fruitless, as no experience will be gained.
translation: 你仍然可以做一些简单的事情，比如砍树或开采矿石，但这样做不会有任何结果，因为不会获得经验。 [ni reng ran ke yi zuo yi xie jian dan de shi qing ， bi ru kan shu huo kai cai kuang shi ， dan zhe yang zuo bu hui you ren he jie guo ， yin wei bu hui huo de jing yan 。]

english: In order to gain experience in these skills, you'll need to unlock them by using my Renown.
translation: 为了获得这些技能的经验，你需要使用我的声望来解锁它们。 [wei le huo de zhe xie ji neng de jing yan ， ni xu yao shi yong wo de sheng wang lai jie suo ta men 。]

english: You gain renown by being entertaining, by completing tasks. The amount of Renown you earn depends on the difficulty of the task.
translation: 你通过娱乐、完成任务来获得声誉。您获得的声望数量取决于任务的难度。 [ni tong guo yu le 、 wan cheng ren wu lai huo de sheng yu 。 nin huo de de sheng wang shu liang qu jue yu ren wu de nan du 。]

english: When it comes to exceptionally strong creatures, you'll need to unlock the ability to fight them. You can see all locked creatures by opening the unlock interface.
translation: 当遇到异常强大的生物时，您需要解锁与它们战斗的能力。打开解锁界面可以看到所有锁定的生物。 [dang yu dao yi chang qiang da de sheng wu shi ， nin xu yao jie suo yu ta men zhan dou de neng li 。 da kai jie suo jie mian ke yi kan dao suo you suo ding de sheng wu 。]

english: One final morsal of information you might be interested in. I understand that in previous Leagues you were forced to complete certain 'Quests' in their entirety.
translation: 您可能感兴趣的最后一点信息。据我所知，在以前的联赛中，您被迫完整地完成某些“任务”。 [nin ke neng gan xing qu de zui hou yi dian xin xi 。 ju wo suo zhi ， zai yi qian de lian sai zhong ， nin bei po wan zheng di wan cheng mou xie “ ren wu ”。]

english: If you wish, you may spend Sage's Renown to skip through these Quests while still gaining any final rewards. However, be warned thaatI will not offer any gifts to you if you finish these quests by yourself.
translation: 如果您愿意，您可以花费贤者的声望来跳过这些任务，同时仍然获得任何最终奖励。不过，请注意，如果你自己完成这些任务，我不会给你任何礼物。 [ru guo nin yuan yi ， nin ke yi hua fei xian zhe de sheng wang lai tiao guo zhe xie ren wu ， tong shi reng ran huo de ren he zui zhong jiang li 。 bu guo ， qing zhu yi ， ru guo ni zi ji wan cheng zhe xie ren wu ， wo bu hui gei ni ren he li wu 。]

english: You should also know that by completing quests with Sage's Renown, you will not earn any final experience like you would if you finished the quest yourself.
translation: 您还应该知道，通过完成贤者声望的任务，您不会像自己完成任务那样获得任何最终经验。 [nin hai ying gai zhi dao ， tong guo wan cheng xian zhe sheng wang de ren wu ， nin bu hui xiang zi ji wan cheng ren wu na yang huo de ren he zui zhong jing yan 。]

english: Is there anything else you wish to know.
translation: 您还有什么想知道的吗？ [nin hai you shen me xiang zhi dao de ma ？]

english: How did I get here again?
translation: 我怎么又到这里来了？ [wo zen me you dao zhe li lai le ？]

english: I can retell the story, if you wish me to.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，我可以重述这个故事。 [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi chong shu zhe ge gu shi 。]

english: League Intro cutscene replays.
translation: 联赛介绍过场动画回放。 [lian sai jie shao guo chang dong hua hui fang 。]

english: So be it.
translation: 就这样吧。 [jiu zhe yang ba 。]

english: Will I be rewarded for participating in this event?
translation: 参加此活动我会获得奖励吗？ [can jia ci huo dong wo hui huo de jiang li ma ？]

english: As you progress you'll earn League Points, which will unlock new slots and allow you to equip more Fragments.
translation: 随着你的进步，你将获得联盟积分，这将解锁新的插槽并允许你装备更多碎片。 [sui zhe ni de jin bu ， ni jiang huo de lian meng ji fen ， zhe jiang jie suo xin de cha cao bing yun xu ni zhuang bei geng duo sui pian 。]

english: However, when our time in this world is over, you can spend your League Points to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: 然而，当我们在这个世界上的时间结束时，你可以使用你的联盟积分从联盟奖励商店购买奖励。 [ran er ， dang wo men zai zhe ge shi jie shang de shi jian jie shu shi ， ni ke yi shi yong ni de lian meng ji fen cong lian meng jiang li shang dian gou mai jiang li 。]

english: Of course, the real reward for participating will be my master and I sparing your life once the event ends...
translation: 当然，参与的真正奖励是活动结束后，我和师父饶了你一命…… [dang ran ， can yu de zhen zheng jiang li shi huo dong jie shu hou ， wo he shi fu rao le ni yi ming ……]

english: Are there any other rewards I can earn from this event?
translation: 我还能从这次活动中获得其他奖励吗？ [wo hai neng cong zhe ci huo dong zhong huo de qi ta jiang li ma ？]

english: I see...
translation: 我懂了... [wo dong le ...]

english: In my time on the River of Souls I have found that when chapters are concluded their collapsing can be... incomplete.
translation: 在我在灵魂之河的时光里，我发现当章节结束时，它们的崩溃可能是……不完整的。 [zai wo zai ling hun zhi he de shi guang li ， wo fa xian dang zhang jie jie shu shi ， ta men de beng kui ke neng shi …… bu wan zheng de 。]

english: Therefore, certain items can slip through the cracks, so to say.
translation: 因此，可以这么说，某些物品可能会从裂缝中溜走。 [yin ci ， ke yi zhe me shuo ， mou xie wu pin ke neng hui cong lie feng zhong liu zou 。]

english: In fact, it's through one of these cracks that I was able to save you from the previous chapter's collapse.
translation: 事实上，正是通过这些裂缝，我才能够将你从前一章的崩溃中拯救出来。 [shi shi shang ， zheng shi tong guo zhe xie lie feng ， wo cai neng gou jiang ni cong qian yi zhang de beng kui zhong zheng jiu chu lai 。]

english: I collect these lost items from other worlds and keep them with me, should I ever need them one day.
translation: 我从其他世界收集这些丢失的物品并随身携带，以备有一天我需要它们。 [wo cong qi ta shi jie shou ji zhe xie diu shi de wu pin bing sui shen xie dai ， yi bei you yi tian wo xu yao ta men 。]

english: I'm happy to offer them as an incentive for playing your part in this event.
translation: 我很高兴提供它们作为您在本次活动中发挥作用的激励。 [wo hen gao xing ti gong ta men zuo wei nin zai ben ci huo dong zhong fa hui zuo yong de ji li 。]

english: The first item is a powerful whip.
translation: 第一件物品是强力的鞭子。 [di yi jian wu pin shi qiang li de bian zi 。]

english: It is imbued with the energy of thousands of lost souls, forever trapped in the bondage of their iron chains.
translation: 它充满了成千上万失落灵魂的能量，永远被困在铁链的束缚中。 [ta chong man le cheng qian shang wan shi luo ling hun de neng liang ， yong yuan bei kun zai tie lian de shu fu zhong 。]

english: Each crack releases a deafening howl from the screams of its victims trapped within...
translation: 每一条裂缝都会释放出震耳欲聋的嚎叫声，来自被困在里面的受害者的尖叫声…… [mei yi tiao lie feng du hui shi fang chu zhen er yu long de hao jiao sheng ， lai zi bei kun zai li mian de shou hai zhe de jian jiao sheng ……]

english: The next item is a cannon.
translation: 下一个项目是大炮。 [xia yi ge xiang mu shi da pao 。]

english: It's poweeredby channelled arcane energy, each explosion teleported into the barrel from a border dimension.
translation: 它由引导奥术能量提供动力，每次爆炸都会从边界维度传送到枪管中。 [ta you yin dao ao shu neng liang ti gong dong li ， mei ci bao zha du hui cong bian jie wei du chuan song dao qiang guan zhong 。]

english: Using a power unknwon, it expels shrapnel that tears through flesh and souls alike.
translation: 它使用一种未知的力量，发射弹片，撕裂肉体和灵魂。 [ta shi yong yi zhong wei zhi de li liang ， fa she dan pian ， si lie rou ti he ling hun 。]

english: There are others of course. You'll be free to trade these rewards to others in your world, or you can keep them. It doesn't matter to me.
translation: 当然还有其他的。您可以自由地将这些奖励交易给您世界中的其他人，也可以保留它们。这对我来说并不重要。 [dang ran hai you qi ta de 。 nin ke yi zi you di jiang zhe xie jiang li jiao yi gei nin shi jie zhong de qi ta ren ， ye ke yi bao liu ta men 。 zhe dui wo lai shuo bing bu zhong yao 。]

english: You can acess your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. Using world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.
translation: 您可以通过切换到任何正常的 Old School RuneScape 世界来访问您的主要个人资料。使用注销菜单中的世界切换器可以用来切换世界。 [nin ke yi tong guo qie huan dao ren he zheng chang de  Old School RuneScape  shi jie lai fang wen nin de zhu yao ge ren zi liao 。 shi yong zhu xiao cai dan zhong de shi jie qie huan qi ke yi yong lai qie huan shi jie 。]

english: And hero, beware - the Shattered Relic rewards won't be available until the League has ended. You can still buy rewards from previous Leagues, however.
translation: 英雄，请注意 - 破碎遗物奖励在联盟结束后才可用。不过，您仍然可以购买之前联赛的奖励。 [ying xiong ， qing zhu yi  -  po sui yi wu jiang li zai lian meng jie shu hou cai ke yong 。 bu guo ， nin reng ran ke yi gou mai zhi qian lian sai de jiang li 。]

english: Now, alongside the rewards in the Leagues Reward Shop, there's also League Ranks.
translation: 现在，除了联赛奖励商店的奖励之外，还有联赛排名。 [xian zai ， chu le lian sai jiang li shang dian de jiang li zhi wai ， hai you lian sai pai ming 。]

english: At the end of the League, you will be judged and given a rank. This is based upon the number of League Points you have earned compared to the other participants.
translation: 联赛结束时，您将接受评判并获得排名。这是基于您与其他参与者相比获得的联盟积分数量。 [lian sai jie shu shi ， nin jiang jie shou ping pan bing huo de pai ming 。 zhe shi ji yu nin yu qi ta can yu zhe xiang bi huo de de lian meng ji fen shu liang 。]

english: Anyone who earns at least 100 League Points will be eligible for the Bronze rank. The top 80% of participants get the Iron rank. The top 60% get Steel.
translation: 任何获得至少 100 联盟积分的人都将有资格获得铜级。前80%的参与者获得铁级。前 60% 的人获得钢铁。 [ren he huo de zhi shao  100  lian meng ji fen de ren dou jiang you zi ge huo de tong ji 。 qian 80% de can yu zhe huo de tie ji 。 qian  60%  de ren huo de gang tie 。]

english: The top 40% get Mithril. The top 20% get Adamant. The top 5% get Rune. The best participants, those who make it to the top 1%, get the Dragon rank!
translation: 前 40% 的人可以获得秘银。前 20% 的人获得 Adamant。前 5% 获得符文。最优秀的参与者，进入前1%的人，将获得龙级！ [qian  40%  de ren ke yi huo de mi yin 。 qian  20%  de ren huo de  Adamant。 qian  5%  huo de fu wen 。 zui you xiu de can yu zhe ， jin ru qian 1% de ren ， jiang huo de long ji ！]

english: When the League ends, you'll get a trophy based on your rank. These trophies symbolise your performance in the League.
translation: 联赛结束后，您将根据您的排名获得奖杯。这些奖杯象征着你在联赛中的表现。 [lian sai jie shu hou ， nin jiang gen ju nin de pai ming huo de jiang bei 。 zhe xie jiang bei xiang zheng zhe ni zai lian sai zhong de biao xian 。]

english: You'll also get League-to-League rewards based on your League Rank.
translation: 您还将根据您的联盟排名获得联盟间的奖励。 [nin hai jiang gen ju nin de lian meng pai ming huo de lian meng jian de jiang li 。]

english: League Starter Outfits and League Icons are some of things you can unlock for the next League. Also, any pets you earn in this League will transfer over to the next one.
translation: 联赛首发服装和联赛图标是您可以为下一个联赛解锁的一些东西。此外，您在本联赛中获得的任何宠物都将转移到下一个联赛。 [lian sai shou fa fu zhuang he lian sai tu biao shi nin ke yi wei xia yi ge lian sai jie suo de yi xie dong xi 。 ci wai ， nin zai ben lian sai zhong huo de de ren he chong wu dou jiang zhuan yi dao xia yi ge lian sai 。]

english: Finally, I plan to recognise the first heroes to complete particular activities.
translation: 最后，我计划表彰第一批完成特定活动的英雄。 [zui hou ， wo ji hua biao zhang di yi pi wan cheng te ding huo dong de ying xiong 。]

english: You can view the entire list of activities, as well as whether or not someone has completed them, on the board beside me.
translation: 您可以在我旁边的看板上查看整个活动列表，以及是否有人已完成这些活动。 [nin ke yi zai wo pang bian de kan ban shang cha kan zheng ge huo dong lie biao ， yi ji shi fou you ren yi wan cheng zhe xie huo dong 。]

english: Of course! If you're lucky enough to obtain a pet during a League, it will automatically be insured for you.
translation: 当然！如果您有幸在联赛期间获得一只宠物，它会自动为您投保。 [dang ran ！ ru guo nin you xing zai lian sai qi jian huo de yi zhi chong wu ， ta hui zi dong wei nin tou bao 。]

english: This means that if you were to ever lose it, you can talk to me and I'll give it back to you. Insurance and reclaiming is all free!
translation: 这意味着如果您丢失了它，您可以与我交谈，我会将其还给您。保险、理赔全部免费！ [zhe yi wei zhe ru guo nin diu shi le ta ， nin ke yi yu wo jiao tan ， wo hui jiang qi huan gei nin 。 bao xian 、 li pei quan bu mian fei ！]

english: Additionally, each pet you obtain will be transferred to the next League. It'll be waiting with me for you to reclaim it!
translation: 此外，您获得的每只宠物都将转移到下一个联盟。它会和我一起等你来夺回它！ [ci wai ， nin huo de de mei zhi chong wu dou jiang zhuan yi dao xia yi ge lian meng 。 ta hui he wo yi qi deng ni lai duo hui ta ！]

english: Return to me once you have some pets and you'll be able to view your collection. Is there anything else you wish to know?
translation: 一旦你拥有了一些宠物，就可以回到我这里来查看你的收藏。您还有什么想知道的吗？ [yi dan ni yong you le yi xie chong wu ， jiu ke yi hui dao wo zhe li lai cha kan ni de shou cang 。 nin hai you shen me xiang zhi dao de ma ？]

english: Do I have any items to collect?
translation: 我有什么东西要收集吗？ [wo you shen me dong xi yao shou ji ma ？]

english: It doesn't look like you need any League items right now. I'll be here if you ever do.
translation: 您现在似乎不需要任何联盟物品。如果你愿意的话我会在这里。 [nin xian zai si hu bu xu yao ren he lian meng wu pin 。 ru guo ni yuan yi de hua wo hui zai zhe li 。]

english: Very well. I'll be here if you ever need to know anything about Leagues.
translation: 很好。如果您需要了解有关联赛的任何信息，我会在这里。 [hen hao 。 ru guo nin xu yao liao jie you guan lian sai de ren he xin xi ， wo hui zai zhe li 。]

english: Who are you? What is your name?
translation: 你是谁？你叫什么名字？ [ni shi shui ？ ni jiao shen me ming zi ？]

english: You mentioned other Leagues - how does this differ from those?
translation: 您提到了其他联赛 - 这与其他联赛有何不同？ [nin ti dao le qi ta lian sai  -  zhe yu qi ta lian sai you he bu tong ？]

english: Any tips you can give me on being 'entertaining'?
translation: 你能给我一些关于“娱乐”的建议吗？ [ni neng gei wo yi xie guan yu “ yu le ” de jian yi ma ？]

english: What are Fragments?
translation: 什么是碎片？ [shen me shi sui pian ？]

english: How does the content unlock system work?
translation: 内容解锁系统如何工作？ [nei rong jie suo xi tong ru he gong zuo ？]

english: How did I get here again?
translation: 我怎么又到这里来了？ [wo zen me you dao zhe li lai le ？]

english: Will I be rewarded for participating in this event?
translation: 参加此活动我会获得奖励吗？ [can jia ci huo dong wo hui huo de jiang li ma ？]

english: Repeat options...
translation: 重复选项... [chong fu xuan xiang ...]

english: Much has changed since the world was shattered. This time, I thought I'd turn the clock back and allow you to Trailblaze once more.
translation: 自从世界破碎以来，一切都发生了变化。这一次，我想我应该让时光倒流，让你再次开拓。 [zi cong shi jie po sui yi lai ， yi qie dou fa sheng le bian hua 。 zhe yi ci ， wo xiang wo ying gai rang shi guang dao liu ， rang ni zai ci kai tuo 。]

english: You must participate as an Iron Man. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.
translation: 您必须以钢铁侠的身份参加。这意味着您是孤立的，无法与其他参与者进行交易。 [nin bi xu yi gang tie xia de shen fen can jia 。 zhe yi wei zhe nin shi gu li de ， wu fa yu qi ta can yu zhe jin xing jiao yi 。]

english: There are ten different areas in total. However, you can only unlock a maximum of five, including the two you've started with. Choose wisely.
translation: 总共有十个不同的区域。但是，您最多只能解锁五个，包括您开始时使用的两个。明智地选择。 [zong gong you shi ge bu tong de qu yu 。 dan shi ， nin zui duo zhi neng jie suo wu ge ， bao kuo nin kai shi shi shi yong de liang ge 。 ming zhi di xuan ze 。]

english: Oh, how have you been getting on?
translation: 哦，你过得怎么样？ [o ， ni guo de zen me yang ？]

english: I've completed some more Combat Achievement tasks!
translation: 我又完成了一些战斗成就任务！ [wo you wan cheng le yi xie zhan dou cheng jiu ren wu ！]

english: I can see that. Nice job. You'll be expecting your medium rewards?
translation: 我看得出来。干得好。您会期待中等奖励吗？ [wo kan de chu lai 。 gan de hao 。 nin hui qi dai zhong deng jiang li ma ？]

english: Yes please!
translation: 是的，请！ [shi de ， qing ！]

english: There you go. I've provided you with one of our more modest ancient sword hilts. You'll also have an easier time obtaining medium clues, increased max quantities offered when given boss Slayer tasks, bonus tokens
translation: 就这样吧。我给你提供了一把我们比较朴素的古代剑柄。您还可以更轻松地获得中等线索，增加执行 Boss Slayer 任务时提供的最大数量，奖励代币 [jiu zhe yang ba 。 wo gei ni ti gong le yi ba wo men bi jiao pu su de gu dai jian bing 。 nin hai ke yi geng qing song di huo de zhong deng xian suo ， zeng jia zhi xing  Boss Slayer  ren wu shi ti gong de zui da shu liang ， jiang li dai bi]

english: from the Warrior guild and two extra commendation points from each Pest Control game. Additionally, equipping one of my sword hilts at the Barrows will prevent your prayer points from being drained and
translation: 来自战士公会的奖励以及每场害虫防治游戏的两点额外奖励积分。此外，在巴罗斯装备我的一把剑柄可以防止你的祈祷点被耗尽 [lai zi zhan shi gong hui de jiang li yi ji mei chang hai chong fang zhi you xi de liang dian e wai jiang li ji fen 。 ci wai ， zai ba luo si zhuang bei wo de yi ba jian bing ke yi fang zhi ni de qi dao dian bei hao jin]

english: your Dwarf multicannon can hold five extra cannonballs.
translation: 你的矮人多管炮可以容纳五个额外的炮弹。 [ni de ai ren duo guan pao ke yi rong na wu ge e wai de pao dan 。]

english: Thank you so much!
translation: 太感谢了！ [tai gan xie le ！]

english: Can I claim any league trophies I may of earned from this league?
translation: 我可以领取从该联赛中获得的任何联赛奖杯吗？ [wo ke yi ling qu cong gai lian sai zhong huo de de ren he lian sai jiang bei ma ？]

english: Would you like to look at the rewards shop?
translation: 您想看看奖励商店吗？ [nin xiang kan kan jiang li shang dian ma ？]

english: You currently have the rank: Unranked.
translation: 您目前的排名：未排名。 [nin mu qian de pai ming ： wei pai ming 。]

english: I can give you [number] League [item/items] once you free up some space in your inventory.
translation: 一旦您释放了库存中的一些空间，我就可以给您[数量]联盟[物品/物品]。 [yi dan nin shi fang le ku cun zhong de yi xie kong jian ， wo jiu ke yi gei nin [ shu liang ] lian meng [ wu pin / wu pin ]。]

english: Can I claim some trophies?
translation: 我可以领取一些奖杯吗？ [wo ke yi ling qu yi xie jiang bei ma ？]

english: A cock-a-doodle hello to you! Caw!
translation: 公鸡涂鸦向你问好！啼！ [gong ji tu ya xiang ni wen hao ！ ti ！]

english: Excuse me?
translation: 打扰一下？ [da rao yi xia ？]

english: I speak for Clarence, and he bids you good day.
translation: 我代表克拉伦斯发言，他祝你日安。 [wo dai biao ke la lun si fa yan ， ta zhu ni ri an 。]

english: Clarence?
translation: 克拉伦斯？ [ke la lun si ？]

english: The rooster you see before you.
translation: 你在你面前看到的公鸡。 [ni zai ni mian qian kan dao de gong ji 。]

english: You speak for him?
translation: 你替他说话？ [ni ti ta shuo hua ？]

english: I speak for him, he speaks through me, I speak through her. It is not important.
translation: 我为他说话，他通过我说话，我通过她说话。这并不重要。 [wo wei ta shuo hua ， ta tong guo wo shuo hua ， wo tong guo ta shuo hua 。 zhe bing bu zhong yao 。]

english: So I'm talking to you?
translation: 所以我在跟你说话？ [suo yi wo zai gen ni shuo hua ？]

english: Yes, you are talking to me.
translation: 是的，你在跟我说话。 [shi de ， ni zai gen wo shuo hua 。]

english: Which me is that? You or the other one?
translation: 那是哪个我？你还是另一个？ [na shi na ge wo ？ ni hai shi ling yi ge ？]

english: Now I'm lost. Who am I?
translation: 现在我迷路了。我是谁？ [xian zai wo mi lu le 。 wo shi shui ？]

english: You're you and I'm me.
translation: 你是你，我是我。 [ni shi ni ， wo shi wo 。]

english: I'm me?
translation: 我是我吗？ [wo shi wo ma ？]

english: This is too confusing, I'll see you later.
translation: 这太混乱了，我们稍后再见。 [zhe tai hun luan le ， wo men shao hou zai jian 。]

english: Who? Me?
translation: WHO？我？ [WHO？ wo ？]

english: Both of you.
translation: 你们两个。 [ni men liang ge 。]

english: Hello, I'm looking for a special egg, I don't suppose you could give me one?
translation: 你好，我正在寻找一个特殊的鸡蛋，我想你不能给我一个吗？ [ni hao ， wo zheng zai xun zhao yi ge te shu de ji dan ， wo xiang ni bu neng gei wo yi ge ma ？]

english: A special egg? All eggs are special.
translation: 特殊的鸡蛋？所有的鸡蛋都很特别。 [te shu de ji dan ？ suo you de ji dan dou hen te bie 。]

english: Yes I know that, but I need a particularly special egg.
translation: 是的，我知道，但我需要一个特别特别的鸡蛋。 [shi de ， wo zhi dao ， dan wo xu yao yi ge te bie te bie de ji dan 。]

english: Do you have one of those?
translation: 你有其中之一吗？ [ni you qi zhong zhi yi ma ？]

english: One moment, we shall produce one.
translation: 一会儿，我们就会生产出一个。 [yi hui er ， wo men jiu hui sheng chan chu yi ge 。]

english: But you're a... Rooster? And... A lady?
translation: 但你是……公鸡？还有……一位女士？ [dan ni shi …… gong ji ？ hai you …… yi wei nv shi ？]

english: Rooster and lady yes this is true. But there is more than one way to make an egg.
translation: 公鸡和女士是的，这是真的。但制作鸡蛋的方法不止一种。 [gong ji he nv shi shi de ， zhe shi zhen de 。 dan zhi zuo ji dan de fang fa bu zhi yi zhong 。]

english: Unfortunately I don't have space to carry around your questionable egg at the moment.
translation: 不幸的是，我现在没有空间来携带你那颗有问题的鸡蛋。 [bu xing de shi ， wo xian zai mei you kong jian lai xie dai ni na ke you wen ti de ji dan 。]

english: Suit yourself!
translation: 适合自己！ [shi he zi ji ！]

english: There you go! Produced from my pocket, you see.
translation: 就这样吧！你看，是从我的口袋里拿出来的。 [jiu zhe yang ba ！ ni kan ， shi cong wo de kou dai li na chu lai de 。]

english: Well that's a relief. Thanks.
translation: 好吧，这真是一种解脱。谢谢。 [hao ba ， zhe zhen shi yi zhong jie tuo 。 xie xie 。]

english: Thanks again for the egg.
translation: 再次感谢你的鸡蛋。 [zai ci gan xie ni de ji dan 。]

english: You are welcome! Cluck!
translation: 不客气！咕! [bu ke qi ！ gu !]

english: Hello again Clarence.
translation: 克拉伦斯，你好。 [ke la lun si ， ni hao 。]

english: Oh and uh, hello your mouthiness.
translation: 哦，呃，你好，你的嘴。 [o ， e ， ni hao ， ni de zui 。]

english: What can two do for you?
translation: 两个人能为你做什么？ [liang ge ren neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: I need another special egg.
translation: 我需要另一个特殊的鸡蛋。 [wo xu yao ling yi ge te shu de ji dan 。]

english: You don't have enough space for one of my special eggs. Come back when you do.
translation: 你没有足够的空间来容纳我的特殊鸡蛋之一。当你回来的时候就回来吧。 [ni mei you zu gou de kong jian lai rong na wo de te shu ji dan zhi yi 。 dang ni hui lai de shi hou jiu hui lai ba 。]

english: Okay then, thanks anyway.
translation: 好吧，还是谢谢你。 [hao ba ， hai shi xie xie ni 。]

english: There you go! Use it wisely!
translation: 就这样吧！明智地使用它！ [jiu zhe yang ba ！ ming zhi di shi yong ta ！]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Hello yourself, outerlander. A little out of the way up here, aren't you?
translation: 你好，外地人。这里有点偏僻，不是吗？ [ni hao ， wai di ren 。 zhe li you dian pian pi ， bu shi ma ？]

english: I would love to stop and chat with you, but unfortunately we have a custom that no Fremennik may speak with the outerlanders without the permission of our chieftain.
translation: 我很想停下来和你聊天，但不幸的是，我们有一个习俗，未经我们酋长的许可，任何弗雷曼尼克人都不能与外地人交谈。 [wo hen xiang ting xia lai he ni liao tian ， dan bu xing de shi ， wo men you yi ge xi su ， wei jing wo men qiu zhang de xu ke ， ren he fu lei man ni ke ren dou bu neng yu wai di ren jiao tan 。]

english: Don't take it personally. The Chieftain is stood just over there, his name is Brundt. I suggest you go and introduce yourself.
translation: 别把它当成是针对你个人的。酋长就站在那边，他的名字叫布伦特。我建议你去自我介绍一下。 [bie ba ta dang cheng shi zhen dui ni ge ren de 。 qiu zhang jiu zhan zai na bian ， ta de ming zi jiao bu lun te 。 wo jian yi ni qu zi wo jie shao yi xia 。]

english: You wouldn't want to go making any enemies because you weren't aware of our customs now, would you?
translation: 你不会因为不了解我们的习俗而去树敌吧？ [ni bu hui yin wei bu liao jie wo men de xi su er qu shu di ba ？]

english: No, I guess not. Thanks anyway.
translation: 不，我想不是。不管怎样，谢谢。 [bu ， wo xiang bu shi 。 bu guan zen yang ， xie xie 。]

english: Not a problem, outerlander. It's always nice to see a new face in the Longhall; it happens so rarely.
translation: 没问题，外地人。在朗厅看到新面孔总是令人高兴。这种情况很少发生。 [mei wen ti ， wai di ren 。 zai lang ting kan dao xin mian kong zong shi ling ren gao xing 。 zhe zhong qing kuang hen shao fa sheng 。]

english: Only Fremenniks may buy drinks here.
translation: 只有弗里曼尼克人可以在这里购买饮料。 [zhi you fu li man ni ke ren ke yi zai zhe li gou mai yin liao 。]

english: Hi. Are you a member of the council?
translation: 你好。您是理事会成员吗？ [ni hao 。 nin shi li shi hui cheng yuan ma ？]

english: I am afraid not outerlander.
translation: 恐怕不是外地人。 [kong pa bu shi wai di ren 。]

english: Oh, okay then.
translation: 哦，好吧。 [o ， hao ba 。]

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find the longhall barkeeps' legendary cocktail, do you?
translation: 我想你不知道我在哪里可以找到长厅酒吧老板的传奇鸡尾酒，是吗？ [wo xiang ni bu zhi dao wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao zhang ting jiu ba lao ban de chuan qi ji wei jiu ， shi ma ？]

english: How did you hear about that?!?!?
translation: 你是怎么听说的？！？！？ [ni shi zen me ting shuo de ？！？！？]

english: I didn't think anybody knew about that... Well, it is true that in my younger years as a barkeep, I wandered the lands trying various alcoholic delicacies.
translation: 我认为没有人知道这一点……嗯，确实，在我年轻的时候当酒吧老板时，我在这片土地上徘徊，尝试各种含酒精的美食。 [wo ren wei mei you ren zhi dao zhe yi dian …… n ， que shi ， zai wo nian qing de shi hou dang jiu ba lao ban shi ， wo zai zhe pian tu di shang pai huai ， chang shi ge zhong han jiu jing de mei shi 。]

english: Did you ever realise just how many different types of alcohol there are here in Gielinor? Lots!
translation: 您是否意识到吉林诺有多少种不同类型的酒？很多！ [nin shi fou yi shi dao ji lin nuo you duo shao zhong bu tong lei xing de jiu ？ hen duo ！]

english: Well, anyway, I used a fusion of various drinks from all around the world to create the greatest cocktail ever made!
translation: 好吧，无论如何，我融合了来自世界各地的各种饮料，创造出了有史以来最棒的鸡尾酒！ [hao ba ， wu lun ru he ， wo rong he le lai zi shi jie ge di de ge zhong yin liao ， chuang zao chu le you shi yi lai zui bang de ji wei jiu ！]

english: Of course, when my wanderlust was gone, and I returned back to Rellekka to serve as barkeep here, I gave all that up.
translation: 当然，当我的旅行欲望消失后，我回到雷莱卡担任酒吧老板，我放弃了这一切。 [dang ran ， dang wo de lv xing yu wang xiao shi hou ， wo hui dao lei lai ka dan ren jiu ba lao ban ， wo fang qi le zhe yi qie 。]

english: But you still remember how to make it, right?
translation: 但你还记得怎么做吗？ [dan ni hai ji de zen me zuo ma ？]

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: And you have all the ingredients here? I don't need to go chasing round the world for obscure ingredients to make it?
translation: 你这里有所有的原料吗？我不需要满世界去寻找不起眼的原料来制作它吗？ [ni zhe li you suo you de yuan liao ma ？ wo bu xu yao man shi jie qu xun zhao bu qi yan de yuan liao lai zhi zuo ta ma ？]

english: No, I have them all here. Why?
translation: 不，我这里都有。为什么？ [bu ， wo zhe li dou you 。 wei shen me ？]

english: Can you make me your legendary cocktail then?
translation: 那你能为我调制你的传奇鸡尾酒吗？ [na ni neng wei wo tiao zhi ni de chuan qi ji wei jiu ma ？]

english: I would rather not; it is a reminder of a life I left behind when I came back.
translation: 我宁愿不；这是我回来后留下的生活的提醒。 [wo ning yuan bu ； zhe shi wo hui lai hou liu xia de sheng huo de ti xing 。]

english: Any way I could change your mind?
translation: 有什么办法可以改变你的想法吗？ [you shen me ban fa ke yi gai bian ni de xiang fa ma ？]

english: You need this to become a Fremennik, right? Well, you seem okay for an outerlander, it would be a shame to see you fail. You know Askeladden?
translation: 你需要这个才能成为 Fremennik，对吧？好吧，对于一个外地人来说，你看起来还不错，看到你失败就太可惜了。你知道阿斯凯拉登吗？ [ni xu yao zhe ge cai neng cheng wei  Fremennik， dui ba ？ hao ba ， dui yu yi ge wai di ren lai shuo ， ni kan qi lai hai bu cuo ， kan dao ni shi bai jiu tai ke xi le 。 ni zhi dao a si kai la deng ma ？]

english: That kid outside? Sure.
translation: 外面那个小子？当然。 [wai mian na ge xiao zi ？ dang ran 。]

english: He is nothing but a pest. He keeps sneaking in and stealing beer. I shudder to think what he will be like when he has passed his trial of manhood,
translation: 他只不过是一个害虫。他不断潜入并偷啤酒。一想到他通过了成年考验后会是什么样子，我就不寒而栗， [ta zhi bu guo shi yi ge hai chong 。 ta bu duan qian ru bing tou pi jiu 。 yi xiang dao ta tong guo le cheng nian kao yan hou hui shi shen me yang zi ， wo jiu bu han er li ，]

english: and is allowed in here legitimately. If you can get him to sign a contract promising that he will NEVER EVER EVER darken my doorway here again, you get the drink.
translation: 并被合法允许进入这里。如果你能让他签一份合同，承诺他永远不会再把我这里的门口弄黑，你就可以喝了。 [bing bei he fa yun xu jin ru zhe li 。 ru guo ni neng rang ta qian yi fen he tong ， cheng nuo ta yong yuan bu hui zai ba wo zhe li de men kou nong hei ， ni jiu ke yi he le 。]

english: Any idea how I can get him to do that?
translation: 知道我怎样才能让他这么做吗？ [zhi dao wo zen yang cai neng rang ta zhe me zuo ma ？]

english: Knowing that little horror, he'll probably be willing to in exchange for some cash. You should go ask him yourself though.
translation: 知道了这种小小的恐怖，他可能会愿意换取一些现金。不过你还是亲自去问他吧。 [zhi dao le zhe zhong xiao xiao de kong bu ， ta ke neng hui yuan yi huan qu yi xie xian jin 。 bu guo ni hai shi qin zi qu wen ta ba 。]

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a written promise from Askeladden to stay out of the Longhall?
translation: 我想你不知道我在哪里可以找到阿斯凯拉登的书面承诺，让我远离长厅？ [wo xiang ni bu zhi dao wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao a si kai la deng de shu mian cheng nuo ， rang wo yuan li zhang ting ？]

english: Well, as I say, you should talk to him about that. Knowing the little runt as I do though He'll probably do it for the cash.
translation: 好吧，正如我所说，你应该和他谈谈这件事。虽然我知道这个小矮子，但他很可能会为了钱而这么做。 [hao ba ， zheng ru wo suo shuo ， ni ying gai he ta tan tan zhe jian shi 。 sui ran wo zhi dao zhe ge xiao ai zi ， dan ta hen ke neng hui wei le qian er zhe me zuo 。]

english: Hi! Can I please have one of your legendary cocktails now?
translation: 你好！我现在可以喝一杯你们的传奇鸡尾酒吗？ [ni hao ！ wo xian zai ke yi he yi bei ni men de chuan qi ji wei jiu ma ？]

english: What?!?! I can't believe you... Let me look at that... Askeladden would NEVER... Gosh. It looks legitimate.
translation: 什么？！？！我不敢相信你……让我看看……阿斯克拉登永远不会……天哪。看起来合法。 [shen me ？！？！ wo bu gan xiang xin ni …… rang wo kan kan …… a si ke la deng yong yuan bu hui …… tian na 。 kan qi lai he fa 。]

english: Here you go, on the house! You have made my life SO much easier! Knowing that little monster won't be bugging me in here all the time anymore!
translation: 给你，在房子上！你让我的生活变得如此轻松！知道那个小怪物不会再一直在这里骚扰我了！ [gei ni ， zai fang zi shang ！ ni rang wo de sheng huo bian de ru ci qing song ！ zhi dao na ge xiao guai wu bu hui zai yi zhi zai zhe li sao rao wo le ！]

english: That little weasel will have to abide by this written promise that Askeladden can never ever enter the Longhall again! He can't get round this one!
translation: 那只小黄鼠狼必须遵守书面承诺，阿斯凯拉登永远不能再进入长厅！这件事他绕不过去！ [na zhi xiao huang shu lang bi xu zun shou shu mian cheng nuo ， a si kai la deng yong yuan bu neng zai jin ru zhang ting ！ zhe jian shi ta rao bu guo qu ！]

english: Uh... yeah... yeah, you probably won't see someone called Askeladden coming in here...
translation: 呃...是的...是的，你可能不会看到一个叫阿斯凯拉登的人进来... [e ... shi de ... shi de ， ni ke neng bu hui kan dao yi ge jiao a si kai la deng de ren jin lai ...]

english: (Thora takes the promise and gives the player a Legendary cocktail)
translation: （索拉接受了承诺并给了玩家一杯传奇鸡尾酒） [（ suo la jie shou le cheng nuo bing gei le wan jia yi bei chuan qi ji wei jiu ）]

english: Thanks for making me this cocktail. Why don't you make them anymore normally?
translation: 谢谢你给我做了这杯鸡尾酒。为什么不再正常制作呢？ [xie xie ni gei wo zuo le zhe bei ji wei jiu 。 wei shen me bu zai zheng chang zhi zuo ne ？]

english: Ah... when I gave up my travels across the world many years back, to return to my expected role as longhall barkeep, as my mother, and her mother, were before me,
translation: 啊...当我多年前放弃环游世界的旅行，回到我预期的长厅酒保角色时，就像我的母亲和她的母亲一样， [a ... dang wo duo nian qian fang qi huan you shi jie de lv xing ， hui dao wo yu qi de zhang ting jiu bao jue se shi ， jiu xiang wo de mu qin he ta de mu qin yi yang ，]

english: I gave up a lot of the freedom I had found in the outside world. I know it is our custom to shun outerlanders and their ways, but I didn't find them as bad as the stories say.
translation: 我放弃了很多在外面世界找到的自由。我知道我们的习惯是回避外来者和他们的生活方式，但我并不认为他们像故事中所说的那么糟糕。 [wo fang qi le hen duo zai wai mian shi jie zhao dao de zi you 。 wo zhi dao wo men de xi guan shi hui bi wai lai zhe he ta men de sheng huo fang shi ， dan wo bing bu ren wei ta men xiang gu shi zhong suo shuo de na me zao gao 。]

english: Sometimes I feel as though we Fremennik live in a prison that we have constructed for ourselves, and that WE are the outerlanders, out here on the edge of the world...
translation: 有时我觉得我们弗雷曼尼克人好像生活在我们为自己建造的监狱里，我们是外地人，在世界的边缘...... [you shi wo jue de wo men fu lei man ni ke ren hao xiang sheng huo zai wo men wei zi ji jian zao de jian yu li ， wo men shi wai di ren ， zai shi jie de bian yuan ......]

english: I'm sorry, I think it is part of the job of Longhall barkeep to get philosophical about things ocassionally. I wish you all the best of luck with your trials, outerlander.
translation: 抱歉，我认为偶尔对事物进行哲学思考是朗霍尔酒吧老板工作的一部分。我祝你在考验中一切顺利，外来者。 [bao qian ， wo ren wei ou er dui shi wu jin xing zhe xue si kao shi lang huo er jiu ba lao ban gong zuo de yi bu fen 。 wo zhu ni zai kao yan zhong yi qie shun li ， wai lai zhe 。]

english: When you have finished, perhaps you will come back here, and we can share a drink over tales of the outside world?
translation: 当你完成后，也许你会回到这里，我们可以一起喝一杯，听听外面世界的故事？ [dang ni wan cheng hou ， ye xu ni hui hui dao zhe li ， wo men ke yi yi qi he yi bei ， ting ting wai mian shi jie de gu shi ？]

english: Thanks, I'd like that.
translation: 谢谢，我想要这样。 [xie xie ， wo xiang yao zhe yang 。]

english: Hello again [Fremennik name]. I suppose you want a drink? Or are you going to try another scam with that terrible Askeladden again?
translation: 再次你好[弗雷曼尼克名字]。我想你想喝一杯吗？或者你打算再次用那个可怕的阿斯克拉登来尝试另一个骗局吗？ [zai ci ni hao [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 wo xiang ni xiang he yi bei ma ？ huo zhe ni da suan zai ci yong na ge ke pa de a si ke la deng lai chang shi ling yi ge pian ju ma ？]

english: Scam? Oh... You mean his promise not to come in here anymore?
translation: 骗局？哦……你是说他答应不再来这里了？ [pian ju ？ o …… ni shi shuo ta da ying bu zai lai zhe li le ？]

english: Yes. Yes I do. I should never have trusted him not to come in here, even with that written promise.
translation: 是的。是的，我愿意。即使有书面承诺，我也不应该相信他不会来这里。 [shi de 。 shi de ， wo yuan yi 。 ji shi you shu mian cheng nuo ， wo ye bu ying gai xiang xin ta bu hui lai zhe li 。]

english: Anyway, do you want a drink or not?
translation: 不管怎样，你想喝还是不喝？ [bu guan zen yang ， ni xiang he hai shi bu he ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Okay then.
translation: 那么好吧。 [na me hao ba 。]

english: Ask about the Merchant's trial
translation: 询问商家试用情况 [xun wen shang jia shi yong qing kuang]

english: Ask about becoming a Fremennik
translation: 询问成为 Fremennik 的问题 [xun wen cheng wei  Fremennik  de wen ti]

english: Yes please
translation: 是的，请 [shi de ， qing]

english: No thanks
translation: 不，谢谢 [bu ， xie xie]

english: Welcome to Blackhole, human. Can I help you?
translation: 欢迎来到黑洞，人类。我可以帮你吗？ [huan ying lai dao hei dong ， ren lei 。 wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Why, I'm Thordur. Thordur the dwarf. A long time ago, I used to run a business letting people visit my Blackhole for fun.
translation: 为什么，我是索尔杜尔。矮人索尔杜尔。很久以前，我曾经经营过一家公司，让人们参观我的黑洞以获取乐趣。 [wei shen me ， wo shi suo er du er 。 ai ren suo er du er 。 hen jiu yi qian ， wo ceng jing jing ying guo yi jia gong si ， rang ren men can guan wo de hei dong yi huo qu le qu 。]

english: The business was good, but eventually the time came for me to retire. So now I live here in Blackhole where it's more peaceful.
translation: 生意很好，但最终还是到了我退休的时候了。所以现在我住在黑洞这里，那里更安静。 [sheng yi hen hao ， dan zui zhong hai shi dao le wo tui xiu de shi hou le 。 suo yi xian zai wo zhu zai hei dong zhe li ， na li geng an jing 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: Blackhole? Well, it's sort of like a hole, and it's generally not very well lit. I'll let you work out the rest.
translation: 黑洞？嗯，它有点像一个洞，而且通常光线不太好。剩下的我会让你解决。 [hei dong ？ n ， ta you dian xiang yi ge dong ， er qie tong chang guang xian bu tai hao 。 sheng xia de wo hui rang ni jie jue 。]

english: If you're asking why it's here at all, it was a sort of prison. Bad people were locked here. But it's my home now.
translation: 如果你问它为什么在这里，那它就像一座监狱。坏人都被关在这里。但现在这是我的家了。 [ru guo ni wen ta wei shen me zai zhe li ， na ta jiu xiang yi zuo jian yu 。 huai ren dou bei guan zai zhe li 。 dan xian zai zhe shi wo de jia le 。]

english: How can I leave?
translation: 我怎样才能离开？ [wo zen yang cai neng li kai ？]

english: Just activate your Disk of Returning. It'll pop you back out to the mines.
translation: 只需激活你的归来盘即可。它会把你带回矿井。 [zhi xu ji huo ni de gui lai pan ji ke 。 ta hui ba ni dai hui kuang jing 。]

english: Why, surely you've got your Disk of Returning? I can't believe you could have lost it in here.
translation: 为什么，你肯定有归来之盘吗？我不敢相信你竟然把它丢在这里了。 [wei shen me ， ni ken ding you gui lai zhi pan ma ？ wo bu gan xiang xin ni jing ran ba ta diu zai zhe li le 。]

english: Nope, I don't have a Disk of Returning.
translation: 不，我没有归来盘。 [bu ， wo mei you gui lai pan 。]

english: I really don't understand humans sometimes. Hold tight and I'll sort you out...
translation: 有时候我真的很不理解人类。坚持住，我会帮你解决的... [you shi hou wo zhen de hen bu li jie ren lei 。 jian chi zhu ， wo hui bang ni jie jue de ...]

english: Yes, get me out now.
translation: 是的，现在就带我出去。 [shi de ， xian zai jiu dai wo chu qu 。]

english: Thordur teleports the player to the Dwarven Mine
translation: 索尔杜尔将玩家传送到矮人矿井 [suo er du er jiang wan jia chuan song dao ai ren kuang jing]

english: No thanks, I'll stay here.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我会留在这里。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo hui liu zai zhe li 。]

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: How can I leave?
translation: 我怎样才能离开？ [wo zen yang cai neng li kai ？]

english: Yes, get me out now.
translation: 是的，现在就带我出去。 [shi de ， xian zai jiu dai wo chu qu 。]

english: No thanks, I'll stay here.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我会留在这里。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo hui liu zai zhe li 。]

english: I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Hey there [player name], Do you want that shopping list now?
translation: 嘿，[玩家姓名]，你现在想要那个购物清单吗？ [hei ，[ wan jia xing ming ]， ni xian zai xiang yao na ge gou wu qing dan ma ？]

english: It depends, what do I get out of it again?
translation: 这取决于我能从中得到什么？ [zhe qu jue yu wo neng cong zhong de dao shen me ？]

english: I've got this Death Talisman I could give you in return. You'll need it if you want to get into the altar.
translation: 我有这个死亡护身符，我可以给你作为回报。如果你想进入祭坛，你就需要它。 [wo you zhe ge si wang hu shen fu ， wo ke yi gei ni zuo wei hui bao 。 ru guo ni xiang jin ru ji tan ， ni jiu xu yao ta 。]

english: Ok sure thing, what do you need?
translation: 好的，当然可以，您需要什么？ [hao de ， dang ran ke yi ， nin xu yao shen me ？]

english: You'd better take this list, we need everything on it! Just bring them to me and I'll take them off your hands.
translation: 你最好拿着这份清单，我们需要上面的所有东西！只要把它们带给我，我就会把它们从你手中夺走。 [ni zui hao na zhe zhe fen qing dan ， wo men xu yao shang mian de suo you dong xi ！ zhi yao ba ta men dai gei wo ， wo jiu hui ba ta men cong ni shou zhong duo zou 。]

english: Hmm no thanks, I'm not interested.
translation: 嗯，不，谢谢，我不感兴趣。 [n ， bu ， xie xie ， wo bu gan xing qu 。]

english: Hi again, how're you doing with those items we need?
translation: 您好，我们需要的那些物品处理得怎么样了？ [nin hao ， wo men xu yao de na xie wu pin chu li de zen me yang le ？]

english: I've got some of them with me.
translation: 我身上有一些。 [wo shen shang you yi xie 。]

english: Great, can I take everything I need?

translation: 您需要什么帮助？ [nin xu yao shen me bang zhu ？]

english: I've lost my pet scorpions. They're lesser Kharid scorpions, a very rare breed.
translation: 我失去了我的宠物蝎子。它们是小卡里德蝎子，是一种非常稀有的品种。 [wo shi qu le wo de chong wu xie zi 。 ta men shi xiao ka li de xie zi ， shi yi zhong fei chang xi you de pin zhong 。]

english: I left their cage door open, now I don't know where they've gone.
translation: 我把他们的笼门开着，现在我不知道他们去了哪里。 [wo ba ta men de long men kai zhe ， xian zai wo bu zhi dao ta men qu le na li 。]

english: There's three of them, and they're quick little beasties. They're all over Gielinor.
translation: 他们一共有三个，而且都是敏捷的小动物。他们遍布吉林诺。 [ta men yi gong you san ge ， er qie dou shi min jie de xiao dong wu 。 ta men bian bu ji lin nuo 。]

english: So how would I go about catching them then?
translation: 那么我该如何去捕捉它们呢？ [na me wo gai ru he qu bu zhuo ta men ne ？]

english: Well I have a scorpion cage here which you can use to catch them in.
translation: 嗯，我这里有一个蝎子笼，你可以用它来捕捉它们。 [n ， wo zhe li you yi ge xie zi long ， ni ke yi yong ta lai bu zhuo ta men 。]

english: Well you have the scorpion cage I gave you, you can catch them using that.
translation: 好吧，你有我给你的蝎子笼，你可以用它来捕捉它们。 [hao ba ， ni you wo gei ni de xie zi long ， ni ke yi yong ta lai bu zhuo ta men 。]

english: If you go up to the village of Seers, to the North of here, one of them will be able to tell you where the scorpions are now.
translation: 如果你去这里北边的先知村，他们中的一个就能告诉你蝎子现在在哪里。 [ru guo ni qu zhe li bei bian de xian zhi cun ， ta men zhong de yi ge jiu neng gao su ni xie zi xian zai zai na li 。]

english: Ok, I will do it then.

english: I'm not interested.
translation: 我对此不感兴趣。 [wo dui ci bu gan xing qu 。]

english: Blast, I suppose I'll have to find someone else then.

english: Well remember to go speak to the Seers, North of here, if you need any help.
translation: 如果您需要任何帮助，请记得去与这里北部的先知交谈。 [ru guo nin xu yao ren he bang zhu ， qing ji de qu yu zhe li bei bu de xian zhi jiao tan 。]

english: I've not brought all the scorpions with me.
translation: 我没有把所有的蝎子都带过来。 [wo mei you ba suo you de xie zi dou dai guo lai 。]

english: Well go and fetch them then.
translation: 那好吧，去把他们接过来吧。 [na hao ba ， qu ba ta men jie guo lai ba 。]

english: I have retrieved all your scorpions.
translation: 我已经把你所有的蝎子都找回来了。 [wo yi jing ba ni suo you de xie zi dou zhao hui lai le 。]

english: Aha, my little scorpions home at last!
translation: 啊哈，我的小蝎子终于回家了！ [a ha ， wo de xiao xie zi zhong yu hui jia le ！]

english: Thank you for rescuing my scorpions.
translation: 谢谢你救了我的蝎子们。 [xie xie ni jiu le wo de xie zi men 。]

english: That's ok.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: Hello!
