english: Can I have some more boots?
translation: 我可以多买几双靴子吗？ [wo ke yi duo mai ji shuang xue zi ma ？]

english: Thorodin gives you another pair of boots.
translation: 索罗丁给了你另一双靴子。 [suo luo ding gei le ni ling yi shuang xue zi 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Thorodin, taskmaster for the Fremennik Achievement Diary.
translation: 索罗丁，弗里曼尼克成就日记的监工。 [suo luo ding ， fu li man ni ke cheng jiu ri ji de jian gong 。]

english: What is the Achievement Diary?
translation: 什么是成就日记？ [shen me shi cheng jiu ri ji ？]

english: It's a diary that helps you keep track of particular achievements. In the Fremennik lands it can help you discover some quite useful things. Eventually, with enough exploration, the inhabitants will reward you.
translation: 这是一本日记，可以帮助您记录特定的成就。在弗雷曼尼克的土地上，它可以帮助你发现一些非常有用的东西。最终，经过足够的探索，居民们会奖励你。 [zhe shi yi ben ri ji ， ke yi bang zhu nin ji lu te ding de cheng jiu 。 zai fu lei man ni ke de tu di shang ， ta ke yi bang zhu ni fa xian yi xie fei chang you yong de dong xi 。 zui zhong ， jing guo zu gou de tan suo ， ju min men hui jiang li ni 。]

english: You can see the list of tasks on the side-panel.
translation: 您可以在侧面板上看到任务列表。 [nin ke yi zai ce mian ban shang kan dao ren wu lie biao 。]

english: I have a question about my Achievement diary.
translation: 我对我的成就日记有疑问。 [wo dui wo de cheng jiu ri ji you yi wen 。]

english: Well, there are four different pairs of Fremennik sea boots, which match up with the four levels of difficulty. Each has the same rewards as the previous level and some additional benefits too... which tier of rewards
translation: 嗯，有四双不同的 Fremennik 海靴，与四个难度级别相匹配。每个级别都有与前一级别相同的奖励，还有一些额外的好处......哪一层的奖励 [n ， you si shuang bu tong de  Fremennik  hai xue ， yu si ge nan du ji bie xiang pi pei 。 mei ge ji bie dou you yu qian yi ji bie xiang tong de jiang li ， hai you yi xie e wai de hao chu ...... na yi ceng de jiang li]

english: would you like to know more about?
translation: 您想了解更多吗？ [nin xiang liao jie geng duo ma ？]

english: Tell me more about the Easy rewards please!
translation: 请告诉我更多有关简单奖励的信息！ [qing gao su wo geng duo you guan jian dan jiang li de xin xi ！]

english: If you complete all of the easy tasks in the Fremennik Province, Peer the Seer can bank items for you at all times and your enchanted lyre can hold an extra charge.
translation: 如果您完成了弗雷曼尼克省的所有简单任务，先知皮尔可以随时为您储存物品，并且您的魔法七弦琴可以收取额外费用。 [ru guo nin wan cheng le fu lei man ni ke sheng de suo you jian dan ren wu ， xian zhi pi er ke yi sui shi wei nin chu cun wu pin ， bing qie nin de mo fa qi xian qin ke yi shou qu e wai fei yong 。]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: Tell me more about the Medium rewards please!
translation: 请告诉我更多有关中等奖励的信息！ [qing gao su wo geng duo you guan zhong deng jiang li de xin xi ！]

english: In addition to the easy rewards, your boots can teleport you to Rellekka once per day and you'll gain access a shortcut on the Miscellania docks as well as an increased rate of gaining approval with your subjects.
translation: 除了简单的奖励之外，你的靴子每天还可以将你传送到雷莱卡一次，你将获得进入 Miscellania 码头的捷径，并提高获得臣民认可的几率。 [chu le jian dan de jiang li zhi wai ， ni de xue zi mei tian hai ke yi jiang ni chuan song dao lei lai ka yi ci ， ni jiang huo de jin ru  Miscellania  ma tou de jie jing ， bing ti gao huo de chen min ren ke de ji lv 。]

english: Tell me more about the Hard rewards please!
translation: 请告诉我更多有关硬奖励的信息！ [qing gao su wo geng duo you guan ying jiang li de xin xi ！]

english: In addition to the easy and medium benefits, you'll be able to change your lyre teleport location to Waterbirth Island, use a shortcut to the roof of the Troll Stronghold and access two new Lunar spells.
translation: 除了简单和中等的好处之外，你还可以将竖琴传送位置更改为水生岛，使用通往巨魔要塞屋顶的捷径并使用两个新的月球法术。 [chu le jian dan he zhong deng de hao chu zhi wai ， ni hai ke yi jiang shu qin chuan song wei zhi geng gai wei shui sheng dao ， shi yong tong wang ju mo yao sai wu ding de jie jing bing shi yong liang ge xin de yue qiu fa shu 。]

english: Tell me more about the Elite rewards please!
translation: 请告诉我更多有关精英奖励的信息！ [qing gao su wo geng duo you guan jing ying jiang li de xin xi ！]

english: In addition to the previous tiers of rewards, your boots now have unlimited teleports to Rellekka, your lyre can be attuned to teleport you to Jatiszo or Neitiznot, you'll no longer need a seal of passage on Lunar Isle,
translation: 除了之前的奖励之外，你的靴子现在可以无限传送到Rellekka，你的七弦琴可以调整为将你传送到Jatiszo或Neitiznot，你不再需要月球岛上的通行印章， [chu le zhi qian de jiang li zhi wai ， ni de xue zi xian zai ke yi wu xian chuan song dao Rellekka， ni de qi xian qin ke yi tiao zheng wei jiang ni chuan song dao Jatiszo huo Neitiznot， ni bu zai xu yao yue qiu dao shang de tong xing yin zhang ，]

english: Dagannoth bones will be dropped as notes and your subjects will approve of your kingdom management even faster than before.
translation: 达甘诺斯的骨头会作为笔记掉落，你的臣民会比以前更快地批准你的王国管理。 [da gan nuo si de gu tou hui zuo wei bi ji diao luo ， ni de chen min hui bi yi qian geng kuai di pi zhun ni de wang guo guan li 。]

english: Just complete the tasks in the Fremennik Province so they're ticked off, then come and speak to me for your rewards.
translation: 只要完成弗雷曼尼克省的任务就可以了，然后来找我领取奖励。 [zhi yao wan cheng fu lei man ni ke sheng de ren wu jiu ke yi le ， ran hou lai zhao wo ling qu jiang li 。]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: See you later.
translation: 稍后见。 [shao hou jian 。]

english: About the Dagannoth Kings...
translation: 关于达甘诺斯国王... [guan yu da gan nuo si guo wang ...]

english: Ah, yes. Because you've completed the elite tasks for the Fremennik Province, their bones will be noted for you.
translation: 啊，是的。因为你已经完成了弗雷曼尼克省的精英任务，所以他们的骨头将会被记录下来。 [a ， shi de 。 yin wei ni yi jing wan cheng le fu lei man ni ke sheng de jing ying ren wu ， suo yi ta men de gu tou jiang hui bei ji lu xia lai 。]

english: If you'd prefer, I can change it so they will drop their bones as they normally would?
translation: 如果你愿意的话，我可以改变它，这样他们就会像平常一样掉落骨头？ [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi gai bian ta ， zhe yang ta men jiu hui xiang ping chang yi yang diao luo gu tou ？]

english: Very well. In future, when you kill a Dagannoth King, they will drop their bones normally.
translation: 很好。将来，当你杀死达甘诺斯国王时，他们会正常掉落骨头。 [hen hao 。 jiang lai ， dang ni sha si da gan nuo si guo wang shi ， ta men hui zheng chang diao luo gu tou 。]

english: Very well. If you change your mind, come talk to me again.
translation: 很好。如果你改变主意了，就再来找我谈谈。 [hen hao 。 ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi le ， jiu zai lai zhao wo tan tan 。]

english: Ah, yes. You wanted the bones from the Dagannoth Kings to remain unnoted when you killed them.
translation: 啊，是的。你希望当你杀死达甘诺斯国王时，他们的骨头不会被注意到。 [a ， shi de 。 ni xi wang dang ni sha si da gan nuo si guo wang shi ， ta men de gu tou bu hui bei zhu yi dao 。]

english: If you'd prefer, I can change them back to being noted instead?
translation: 如果您愿意，我可以将它们改回被标记吗？ [ru guo nin yuan yi ， wo ke yi jiang ta men gai hui bei biao ji ma ？]

english: Very well. In future, when you kill a Dagannoth King, their bones will be noted.
translation: 很好。将来，当你杀死达甘诺斯国王时，他们的骨头将会被记录下来。 [hen hao 。 jiang lai ， dang ni sha si da gan nuo si guo wang shi ， ta men de gu tou jiang hui bei ji lu xia lai 。]

english: Exile. You don't have many friends around here at the moment.
translation: 流亡。你现在在这里没有很多朋友。 [liu wang 。 ni xian zai zai zhe li mei you hen duo peng you 。]

english: How do you feel about it?
translation: 你对此有何感想？ [ni dui ci you he gan xiang ？]

english: Doesn't bother me. Some people take these things more seriously than others. On that note, do you need something?
translation: 不打扰我。有些人比其他人更认真地对待这些事情。关于这一点，你需要什么吗？ [bu da rao wo 。 you xie ren bi qi ta ren geng ren zhen di dui dai zhe xie shi qing 。 guan yu zhe yi dian ， ni xu yao shen me ma ？]

english: I've completed all of the easy tasks in my Fremennik Achievement Diary!
translation: 我已经完成了 Fremennik 成就日记中的所有简单任务！ [wo yi jing wan cheng le  Fremennik  cheng jiu ri ji zhong de suo you jian dan ren wu ！]

english: I can see that, well done! You'll be wanting your reward then!
translation: 我看得出来，干得好！那时你会想要你的奖励！ [wo kan de chu lai ， gan de hao ！ na shi ni hui xiang yao ni de jiang li ！]

english: Yes please!
translation: 是的，请！ [shi de ， qing ！]

english: These boots are a symbol of your exploration of the Fremennik lands. Peer the Seer can now bank items for you at all times and your enchanted lyre can hold an extra charge.
translation: 这些靴子是您探索弗雷曼尼克土地的象征。预言家 Peer 现在可以随时为您存储物品，并且您的魔法七弦琴可以收取额外费用。 [zhe xie xue zi shi nin tan suo fu lei man ni ke tu di de xiang zheng 。 yu yan jia  Peer  xian zai ke yi sui shi wei nin cun chu wu pin ， bing qie nin de mo fa qi xian qin ke yi shou qu e wai fei yong 。]

english: Wow, thanks!
translation: 哇，谢谢！ [wa ， xie xie ！]

english: If you ever lose your boots, come back to me to reclaim them.
translation: 如果你丢了靴子，请回来找我取回。 [ru guo ni diu le xue zi ， qing hui lai zhao wo qu hui 。]

english: I've completed all of the medium tasks in my Fremennik achievement diary!
translation: 我已经完成了弗雷曼尼克成就日记中的所有中等任务！ [wo yi jing wan cheng le fu lei man ni ke cheng jiu ri ji zhong de suo you zhong deng ren wu ！]

english: I've upgraded your Fremennik sea boots for you. They can now teleport you here once per day and have an increased rate of gaining approval with your subjects.
translation: 我已经为您升级了 Fremennik 海靴。他们现在每天可以将你传送到这里一次，并且获得你的臣民认可的几率更高。 [wo yi jing wei nin sheng ji le  Fremennik  hai xue 。 ta men xian zai mei tian ke yi jiang ni chuan song dao zhe li yi ci ， bing qie huo de ni de chen min ren ke de ji lv geng gao 。]

english: I've completed all of the hard tasks in my Fremennik achievement diary!
translation: 我已经完成了弗雷曼尼克成就日记中的所有艰巨任务！ [wo yi jing wan cheng le fu lei man ni ke cheng jiu ri ji zhong de suo you jian ju ren wu ！]

english: You need to complete all of the easy and medium tasks too before I can reward you for the more difficult sets.
translation: 你还需要完成所有简单和中等的任务，然后我才能奖励你更困难的任务。 [ni hai xu yao wan cheng suo you jian dan he zhong deng de ren wu ， ran hou wo cai neng jiang li ni geng kun nan de ren wu 。]

english: I've upgraded your Fremennik sea boots for you. You can now change your lyre teleport location to Waterbirth Island, access two new Lunar spells and you'll receive extra Agility experience from the Rellekka
translation: 我已经为您升级了 Fremennik 海靴。现在，您可以将七弦琴传送位置更改为 Waterbirth Island，使用两个新的月球法术，并且您将从 Rellekka 获得额外的敏捷经验 [wo yi jing wei nin sheng ji le  Fremennik  hai xue 。 xian zai ， nin ke yi jiang qi xian qin chuan song wei zhi geng gai wei  Waterbirth Island， shi yong liang ge xin de yue qiu fa shu ， bing qie nin jiang cong  Rellekka  huo de e wai de min jie jing yan]

english: rooftop course.
translation: 屋顶球场。 [wu ding qiu chang 。]

english: I've completed all of the elite tasks in my Fremennik achievement diary!
translation: 我已经完成了弗雷曼尼克成就日记中的所有精英任务！ [wo yi jing wan cheng le fu lei man ni ke cheng jiu ri ji zhong de suo you jing ying ren wu ！]

english: I can see that, well done! You've completed all of the tasks in the Fremennik Province! Here's your reward!
translation: 我看得出来，干得好！您已经完成了弗雷曼尼克省的所有任务！这是你的奖励！ [wo kan de chu lai ， gan de hao ！ nin yi jing wan cheng le fu lei man ni ke sheng de suo you ren wu ！ zhe shi ni de jiang li ！]

english: I've upgraded your Fremennik sea boots for you. In addition to all of the previous benefits, your boots now have unlimited teleports to Rellekka, your lyre can now teleport you to Jatiszo or Neitiznot, you'll no longer
translation: 我已经为您升级了 Fremennik 海靴。除了之前的所有好处之外，你的靴子现在可以无限传送到Rellekka，你的七弦琴现在可以将你传送到Jatiszo或Neitiznot，你将不再 [wo yi jing wei nin sheng ji le  Fremennik  hai xue 。 chu le zhi qian de suo you hao chu zhi wai ， ni de xue zi xian zai ke yi wu xian chuan song dao Rellekka， ni de qi xian qin xian zai ke yi jiang ni chuan song dao Jatiszo huo Neitiznot， ni jiang bu zai]

english: need a seal of passage on Lunar Isle, Dagannoth bones will be dropped as notes and your subjects will approve of your kingdom management even faster than before.
translation: 需要月岛的通行印章，达甘诺斯的骨头将作为笔记掉落，您的臣民将比以前更快地批准您的王国管理。 [xu yao yue dao de tong xing yin zhang ， da gan nuo si de gu tou jiang zuo wei bi ji diao luo ， nin de chen min jiang bi yi qian geng kuai di pi zhun nin de wang guo guan li 。]

english: Can I have some more boots?
translation: 我可以多买几双靴子吗？ [wo ke yi duo mai ji shuang xue zi ma ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I have a question about my Achievement Diary
translation: 我对我的成就日记有疑问 [wo dui wo de cheng jiu ri ji you yi wen]

english: What is the Achievement Diary?
translation: 什么是成就日记？ [shen me shi cheng jiu ri ji ？]

english: What are the rewards?
translation: 有什么奖励？ [you shen me jiang li ？]

english: Easy Rewards.
translation: 轻松奖励。 [qing song jiang li 。]

english: Medium Rewards.
translation: 中等奖励。 [zhong deng jiang li 。]

english: Hard Rewards.
translation: 艰苦的奖励。 [jian ku de jiang li 。]

english: Elite Rewards.
translation: 精英奖励。 [jing ying jiang li 。]

english: How do I claim the rewards?
translation: 我如何领取奖励？ [wo ru he ling qu jiang li ？]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: About the Dagannoth Kings...
translation: 关于达甘诺斯国王... [guan yu da gan nuo si guo wang ...]

english: Yes, give me unnoted bones.
translation: 是的，给我一些未被注意到的骨头。 [shi de ， gei wo yi xie wei bei zhu yi dao de gu tou 。]

english: No, keep the bones noted.
translation: 不，记下骨头。 [bu ， ji xia gu tou 。]

english: Yes, give me noted bones.
translation: 是的，给我注意到的骨头。 [shi de ， gei wo zhu yi dao de gu tou 。]

english: No, keep the bones unnoted.
translation: 不，不要注意到骨头。 [bu ， bu yao zhu yi dao gu tou 。]

english: Good day, [sir/madam].
translation: 美好的一天，[先生/女士]。 [mei hao de yi tian ，[ xian sheng / nv shi ]。]

english: What are you doing down here?
translation: 你在下面做什么？ [ni zai xia mian zuo shen me ？]

english: We're extending the cave so more people can live in it.
translation: 我们正在扩建洞穴，以便更多的人可以住在里面。 [wo men zheng zai kuo jian dong xue ， yi bian geng duo de ren ke yi zhu zai li mian 。]

english: These Miscellanians aren't so bad. They appreciate the benefits of living underground.
translation: 这些杂项并没有那么糟糕。他们欣赏生活在地下的好处。 [zhe xie za xiang bing mei you na me zao gao 。 ta men xin shang sheng huo zai di xia de hao chu 。]

english: ...such as?
You don't get rained on, for example.
translation: 例如，你不会被雨淋到。 [li ru ， ni bu hui bei yu lin dao 。]

english: Of course, there are some problems, like the monsters Donal saw...
translation: 当然，也有一些问题，比如多纳尔看到的怪物…… [dang ran ， ye you yi xie wen ti ， bi ru duo na er kan dao de guai wu ……]

english: Someone saw a monster?
translation: 有人看到怪物了吗？ [you ren kan dao guai wu le ma ？]

english: Could you tell me more? The King asked me to investigate.
translation: 你能告诉我更多吗？国王让我去调查。 [ni neng gao su wo geng duo ma ？ guo wang rang wo qu diao cha 。]

english: One of the other dwarves who was working with us saw it. His name's Donal.
translation: 与我们一起工作的其他矮人之一看到了它。他的名字叫多纳尔。 [yu wo men yi qi gong zuo de qi ta ai ren zhi yi kan dao le ta 。 ta de ming zi jiao duo na er 。]

english: He went further into the caves to plan our excavations, and a while later he came out shaking.
translation: 他进一步深入洞穴，计划我们的挖掘工作，过了一会儿，他浑身颤抖地出来了。 [ta jin yi bu shen ru dong xue ， ji hua wo men de wa jue gong zuo ， guo le yi hui er ， ta hun shen chan dou di chu lai le 。]

english: He's been in the inn ever since.
translation: 从那以后他就一直住在旅馆里。 [cong na yi hou ta jiu yi zhi zhu zai lv guan li 。]

english: Good day.
translation: 再会。 [zai hui 。]

english: Have you spoken to Donal?
translation: 你和多纳尔谈过吗？ [ni he duo na er tan guo ma ？]

english: Not yet, no.
translation: 还没有，没有。 [hai mei you ， mei you 。]

english: Well, if you want to hear stories about monsters, he's the best one to ask.
translation: 好吧，如果你想听关于怪物的故事，他是最好的询问者。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni xiang ting guan yu guai wu de gu shi ， ta shi zui hao de xun wen zhe 。]

english: Not getting rained on, for example.
translation: 例如，不会被雨淋到。 [li ru ， bu hui bei yu lin dao 。]

english: I have. The monster he talked about could be in the caves nearby.
translation: 我有。他所说的怪物可能就在附近的山洞里。 [wo you 。 ta suo shuo de guai wu ke neng jiu zai fu jin de shan dong li 。]

english: You'd better get in there and do something about it, then.
translation: 那么你最好进去做点什么。 [na me ni zui hao jin qu zuo dian shen me 。]

english: It's not safe. I need to shore up the walls before I can go through.
translation: 这不安全。我需要先加固墙壁才能通过。 [zhe bu an quan 。 wo xu yao xian jia gu qiang bi cai neng tong guo 。]

english: Did you do anything about that monster Donal was talking about?
translation: 你对多纳尔所说的那个怪物做了什么吗？ [ni dui duo na er suo shuo de na ge guai wu zuo le shen me ma ？]

english: It's been taken care of.
translation: 已经处理好了。 [yi jing chu li hao le 。]

english: Glad to hear it. Now we can get on with excavating.
translation: 很高兴听到这个消息。现在我们可以继续挖掘了。 [hen gao xing ting dao zhe ge xiao xi 。 xian zai wo men ke yi ji xu wa jue le 。]

english: What are you doing down here?
translation: 你在下面做什么？ [ni zai xia mian zuo shen me ？]

english: Good day.
translation: 再会。 [zai hui 。]

english: Leave me be, outerlander. I have nothing to say to the likes of you.
translation: 别管我了，外地人。对于像你们这样的人，我无话可说。 [bie guan wo le ， wai di ren 。 dui yu xiang ni men zhe yang de ren ， wo wu hua ke shuo 。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Hello yourself, outerlander. What brings you to dare speak to a mighty Fremennik warrior such as myself?
translation: 你好，外地人。是什么让你敢于与像我这样强大的弗雷曼战士交谈？ [ni hao ， wai di ren 。 shi shen me rang ni gan yu yu xiang wo zhe yang qiang da de fu lei man zhan shi jiao tan ？]

english: Erm... are you a member of the council?
translation: 呃……你是理事会成员吗？ [e …… ni shi li shi hui cheng yuan ma ？]

english: The Fremennik council of elders? Why, of course I am. I am recognised as one the clans mightiest warriors. What is it to you outerlander?
translation: 弗雷曼尼克长老会？为什么，我当然是。我被公认为部落最强大的战士之一。关你外地人什么事？ [fu lei man ni ke zhang lao hui ？ wei shen me ， wo dang ran shi 。 wo bei gong ren wei bu luo zui qiang da de zhan shi zhi yi 。 guan ni wai di ren shen me shi ？]

english: Well... I was wondering if you could vote for me to become a Fremennik.
translation: 嗯...我想知道你是否可以投票支持我成为一名弗里曼尼克人。 [n ... wo xiang zhi dao ni shi fou ke yi tou piao zhi chi wo cheng wei yi ming fu li man ni ke ren 。]

english: An outerlander wishes to become a Fremennik!?!? Ha! That is priceless!
translation: 一个外地人想成为弗里曼尼克人！？！？哈!那是无价的！ [yi ge wai di ren xiang cheng wei fu li man ni ke ren ！？！？ ha ! na shi wu jia de ！]

english: Well, let us say that I am not totally against this concept. As a warrior, I appreciate the value of brave and powerful warriors to our clan,
translation: 好吧，让我们说我并不完全反对这个概念。作为一名战士，我很欣赏勇敢而强大的战士对我们部落的价值， [hao ba ， rang wo men shuo wo bing bu wan quan fan dui zhe ge gai nian 。 zuo wei yi ming zhan shi ， wo hen xin shang yong gan er qiang da de zhan shi dui wo men bu luo de jia zhi ，]

english: and even though you may be an outerlander, I will not hold this against you if you can prove yourself to be fierce of heart in a combat situation to me.
translation: 即使你可能是一个外地人，如果你能在战斗中向我证明自己的内心是凶猛的，我也不会因此而反对你。 [ji shi ni ke neng shi yi ge wai di ren ， ru guo ni neng zai zhan dou zhong xiang wo zheng ming zi ji de nei xin shi xiong meng de ， wo ye bu hui yin ci er fan dui ni 。]

english: So how can I prove that? You want to fight me? Come on then, bring it on! Right here, right now, buddy!
translation: 那么我怎样才能证明这一点呢？你想和我战斗吗？那就来吧，带上它吧！就在这里，就是现在，伙计！ [na me wo zen yang cai neng zheng ming zhe yi dian ne ？ ni xiang he wo zhan dou ma ？ na jiu lai ba ， dai shang ta ba ！ jiu zai zhe li ， jiu shi xian zai ， huo ji ！]

english: Hahahahaha! You certainly show some spirit for an outerlander!
translation: 哈哈哈哈！你确实表现出了一些外地人的精神！ [ha ha ha ha ！ ni que shi biao xian chu le yi xie wai di ren de jing shen ！]

english: But spirit does not always make a good warrior. It takes both skill and spirit to be so. I have a test that I give all Fremenniks on their path to be a member of the clan.
translation: 但精神并不总是能成为优秀的战士。要想做到这一点，需要技巧和精神。我对所有正在成为部落成员的弗雷曼尼克人进行了一项测试。 [dan jing shen bing bu zong shi neng cheng wei you xiu de zhan shi 。 yao xiang zuo dao zhe yi dian ， xu yao ji qiao he jing shen 。 wo dui suo you zheng zai cheng wei bu luo cheng yuan de fu lei man ni ke ren jin xing le yi xiang ce shi 。]

english: My test will challenge both your combat prowess and your bravery equally. Should you pass it you will earn my vote at the council, and more importantly my respect for you as a warrior.
translation: 我的测试将同等地挑战你的战斗能力和勇气。如果你通过了它，你将赢得我在议会的投票，更重要的是我对你作为战士的尊重。 [wo de ce shi jiang tong deng di tiao zhan ni de zhan dou neng li he yong qi 。 ru guo ni tong guo le ta ， ni jiang ying de wo zai yi hui de tou piao ， geng zhong yao de shi wo dui ni zuo wei zhan shi de zun zhong 。]

english: So what say you, outerlander? Are you prepared for the battle?
translation: 那么你说呢，外地人？你准备好战斗了吗？ [na me ni shuo ne ， wai di ren ？ ni zhun bei hao zhan dou le ma ？]

english: Am I prepared? I'll show you what combat's all about, you big sissy barbarian type guy!
translation: 我准备好了吗？我会告诉你什么是战斗，你这个大娘们野蛮人！ [wo zhun bei hao le ma ？ wo hui gao su ni shen me shi zhan dou ， ni zhe ge da niang men ye man ren ！]

english: Hahahahaha! I'm beginning to like you already, outerlander!
translation: 哈哈哈哈！我已经开始喜欢你了，外地人！ [ha ha ha ha ！ wo yi jing kai shi xi huan ni le ， wai di ren ！]

english: Then allow me to present you with my challenge; This ladder here will take you to a place of combat. I have placed a special warrior down there to challenge you.
translation: 那么请允许我向您提出我的挑战；这里的梯子将带你到战斗地点。我在下面安置了一名特殊的战士来挑战你。 [na me qing yun xu wo xiang nin ti chu wo de tiao zhan ； zhe li de ti zi jiang dai ni dao zhan dou di dian 。 wo zai xia mian an zhi le yi ming te shu de zhan shi lai tiao zhan ni 。]

english: Battle him to the death, and you will pass my challenge. If at any point you wish to leave combat, simply climb back up the ladder, to leave that place.
translation: 与他决一死战，你就能通过我的挑战。如果在任何时候你想离开战斗，只需爬回梯子即可离开那个地方。 [yu ta jue yi si zhan ， ni jiu neng tong guo wo de tiao zhan 。 ru guo zai ren he shi hou ni xiang li kai zhan dou ， zhi xu pa hui ti zi ji ke li kai na ge di fang 。]

english: If you leave you will of course fail the test. You may retry my test in the future if you fail, but you must stay down there until the death if you wish for my vote at the council.
translation: 如果你离开，你当然会考试不及格。如果你失败了，你可以在以后重试我的测试，但如果你希望我在议会投票，你就必须留在下面直到死亡。 [ru guo ni li kai ， ni dang ran hui kao shi bu ji ge 。 ru guo ni shi bai le ， ni ke yi zai yi hou zhong shi wo de ce shi ， dan ru guo ni xi wang wo zai yi hui tou piao ， ni jiu bi xu liu zai xia mian zhi dao si wang 。]

english: You must defeat him three times to prove that you are worthy. The fourth time that you fight him will be to the death, so do not show cowardice.
translation: 你必须打败他三次才能证明你是值得的。第四次与他战斗就必死无疑，所以不要表现出怯懦。 [ni bi xu da bai ta san ci cai neng zheng ming ni shi zhi de de 。 di si ci yu ta zhan dou jiu bi si wu yi ， suo yi bu yao biao xian chu qie nuo 。]

english: Is that all? It will be easy!
translation: 这就是全部吗？这会很容易！ [zhe jiu shi quan bu ma ？ zhe hui hen rong yi ！]

english: No, there is one more important rule;
translation: 不，还有一条更重要的规则： [bu ， hai you yi tiao geng zhong yao de gui ze ：]

english: You may not enter the battleground with any armour or weaponry of any kind.
translation: 您不得携带任何盔甲或任何类型的武器进入战场。 [nin bu de xie dai ren he kui jia huo ren he lei xing de wu qi jin ru zhan chang 。]

english: If you need to place your equipment into your bank account, I recommend that you speak to the seer, who knows a spell that will do that for you.
translation: 如果您需要将设备存入银行帐户，我建议您与预言家交谈，他知道可以为您做到这一点的咒语。 [ru guo nin xu yao jiang she bei cun ru yin hang zhang hu ， wo jian yi nin yu yu yan jia jiao tan ， ta zhi dao ke yi wei nin zuo dao zhe yi dian de zhou yu 。]

english: No thanks, I'm pretty sure that I can find someone else to vote for me.
translation: 不，谢谢，我很确定我可以找到其他人为我投票。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo hen que ding wo ke yi zhao dao qi ta ren wei wo tou piao 。]

english: Hmm, not so brave after all, outerlander? Perhaps it is for the best. I doubt you have what it takes to pass my challenge.
translation: 嗯，毕竟没那么勇敢吗，外来者？也许这是最好的。我怀疑你有能力通过我的挑战。 [n ， bi jing mei na me yong gan ma ， wai lai zhe ？ ye xu zhe shi zui hao de 。 wo huai yi ni you neng li tong guo wo de tiao zhan 。]

english: Outerlander... do not test my patience. I do not take kindly to people wandering in here and acting as though they own the place.
translation: Outerlander...不要考验我的耐心。我不喜欢那些在这里闲逛并表现得好像他们拥有这个地方的人。 [Outerlander... bu yao kao yan wo de nai xin 。 wo bu xi huan na xie zai zhe li xian guang bing biao xian de hao xiang ta men yong you zhe ge di fang de ren 。]

english: So what do I have to do to earn your vote at the council again?
translation: 那么我该怎么做才能再次赢得您在理事会的投票呢？ [na me wo gai zen me zuo cai neng zai ci ying de nin zai li shi hui de tou piao ne ？]

english: I will not offer my vote to anybody whose bravery in combat I do not trust completely. You must go down that ladder and fight your foe to the death.
translation: 我不会向任何我不完全信任其战斗勇气的人投票。你必须走下梯子，与你的敌人战斗至死。 [wo bu hui xiang ren he wo bu wan quan xin ren qi zhan dou yong qi de ren tou piao 。 ni bi xu zou xia ti zi ， yu ni de di ren zhan dou zhi si 。]

english: So, who is my opponent?
translation: 那么，我的对手是谁呢？ [na me ， wo de dui shou shi shui ne ？]

english: Ah, a wise question before entering combat. His name is Koschei the deathless. He is something of a mystery, even to us.
translation: 啊，在进入战斗之前这是一个明智的问题。他的名字叫不死者科谢。即使对我们来说，他也是一个谜。 [a ， zai jin ru zhan dou zhi qian zhe shi yi ge ming zhi de wen ti 。 ta de ming zi jiao bu si zhe ke xie 。 ji shi dui wo men lai shuo ， ta ye shi yi ge mi 。]

english: On one of our regular raiding parties, our longship discovered a man in the frozen waters far north-east of here. We took him aboard our ship, thinking he must be dead.
translation: 在我们的一次定期袭击中，我们的长船在此东北方遥远的冰冻水域中发现了一名男子。我们把他带上了我们的船，以为他一定死了。 [zai wo men de yi ci ding qi xi ji zhong ， wo men de zhang chuan zai ci dong bei fang yao yuan de bing dong shui yu zhong fa xian le yi ming nan zi 。 wo men ba ta dai shang le wo men de chuan ， yi wei ta yi ding si le 。]

english: To our amazement he was perfectly healthy, even though he must have been in those deadly icey waters for many weeks.
translation: 令我们惊讶的是，尽管他已经在那些致命的冰冷水域中待了好几个星期，但他却完全健康。 [ling wo men jing ya de shi ， jin guan ta yi jing zai na xie zhi ming de bing leng shui yu zhong dai le hao ji ge xing qi ， dan ta que wan quan jian kang 。]

english: He has no memory of who he is, or how he came to be there, except for his own name: Koschei. We named him 'The Deathless' because he is seemingly unkillable!
translation: 除了他自己的名字：Koschei，他不记得自己是谁，也不记得自己是如何来到这里的。我们将他命名为“不死者”，因为他看起来是杀不死的！ [chu le ta zi ji de ming zi ：Koschei， ta bu ji de zi ji shi shui ， ye bu ji de zi ji shi ru he lai dao zhe li de 。 wo men jiang ta ming ming wei “ bu si zhe ”， yin wei ta kan qi lai shi sha bu si de ！]

english: Any combat technique used against him, he learns instantly! He also apparently can heal himself from any wound at will! When he attacks, his weapon moves like a whirlwind!
translation: 任何对抗他的战斗技巧，他都会立即学会！他显然还可以随意治愈任何伤口！当他攻击时，他的武器就像旋风一样移动！ [ren he dui kang ta de zhan dou ji qiao ， ta du hui li ji xue hui ！ ta xian ran hai ke yi sui yi zhi yu ren he shang kou ！ dang ta gong ji shi ， ta de wu qi jiu xiang xuan feng yi yang yi dong ！]

english: He can hide his combat level from his opponents at will as well! He is truly a horribly fierce opponent to face! I am only glad that he has chosen to stay here with us!
translation: 他还可以随意向对手隐藏自己的战斗等级！他确实是一个极其凶猛的对手！我很高兴他选择和我们一起住在这里！ [ta hai ke yi sui yi xiang dui shou yin cang zi ji de zhan dou deng ji ！ ta que shi shi yi ge ji qi xiong meng de dui shou ！ wo hen gao xing ta xuan ze he wo men yi qi zhu zai zhe li ！]

english: The daylight makes him feel weak, so we have built him his own battleground beneath this building, where he can train his fiercesome skills without being disturbed.
translation: 白天的光线让他感觉很虚弱，所以我们在这栋楼下为他搭建了自己的战场，让他可以不受干扰地训练他的凶猛技能。 [bai tian de guang xian rang ta gan jue hen xu ruo ， suo yi wo men zai zhe dong lou xia wei ta da jian le zi ji de zhan chang ， rang ta ke yi bu shou gan rao di xun lian ta de xiong meng ji neng 。]

english: But he can't REALLY be unkillable...  ...can he?
translation: 但他不可能真的是杀不死的……可以吗？ [dan ta bu ke neng zhen de shi sha bu si de …… ke yi ma ？]

english: Some say he cannot die, for he has hidden his heart outside of his body to be kept forever safe in a duck egg.
translation: 有人说他不会死，因为他把心脏藏在体外，永远安全地放在鸭蛋里。 [you ren shuo ta bu hui si ， yin wei ta ba xin zang cang zai ti wai ， yong yuan an quan di fang zai ya dan li 。]

english: Others say he has been cursed by the gods to wander this land forever, never knowing any peace in his life, but only combat.
translation: 也有人说他被诸神诅咒，永远在这片土地上徘徊，一生中从未有过平静，只有战斗。 [ye you ren shuo ta bei zhu shen zu zhou ， yong yuan zai zhe pian tu di shang pai huai ， yi sheng zhong cong wei you guo ping jing ， zhi you zhan dou 。]

english: Some claim that the sword he carries is the source of all his power, and if he should lose it, then exactly one minute later, he will turn back into his true form;
translation: 有人声称，他携带的剑是他所有力量的源泉，如果他失去了剑，那么整整一分钟后，他就会变回原来的样子； [you ren sheng cheng ， ta xie dai de jian shi ta suo you li liang de yuan quan ， ru guo ta shi qu le jian ， na me zheng zheng yi fen zhong hou ， ta jiu hui bian hui yuan lai de yang zi ；]

english: A weakened, lame, old man.
translation: 一个虚弱、跛脚的老人。 [yi ge xu ruo 、 bo jiao de lao ren 。]

english: And what do you believe?
translation: 你相信什么？ [ni xiang xin shen me ？]

english: I believe you shouldn't look a gift horse in the mouth. He is a fearfully powerful warrior, but more importantly; He is on OUR side, not against us.
translation: 我相信你不应该把礼物看在眼里。他是一位强大得可怕的战士，但更重要的是；他站在我们一边，而不是反对我们。 [wo xiang xin ni bu ying gai ba li wu kan zai yan li 。 ta shi yi wei qiang da de ke pa de zhan shi ， dan geng zhong yao de shi ； ta zhan zai wo men yi bian ， er bu shi fan dui wo men 。]

english: He is content testing the battle skills of anyone taking their Fremennik trials of manhood, and I am content knowing that should an enemy ever invade our town,
translation: 他满足于测试任何参加弗里曼尼克男子气概考验的人的战斗技能，而我很满足地知道，如果敌人入侵我们的城镇， [ta man zu yu ce shi ren he can jia fu li man ni ke nan zi qi gai kao yan de ren de zhan dou ji neng ， er wo hen man zu di zhi dao ， ru guo di ren ru qin wo men de cheng zhen ，]

english: while our warriors are out on a raiding party, Koschei will be able to hold off ANY invader long enough for us to make our return.
translation: 当我们的战士外出进行突袭时，科斯切将能够阻挡任何入侵者足够长的时间，让我们能够返回。 [dang wo men de zhan shi wai chu jin xing tu xi shi ， ke si qie jiang neng gou zu dang ren he ru qin zhe zu gou zhang de shi jian ， rang wo men neng gou fan hui 。]

english: I don't really like fighting that much... Isn't there something else I can do to earn your vote at the council of elders?
translation: 我不太喜欢打架……难道我就不能做点什么来赢得你在长老会的投票吗？ [wo bu tai xi huan da jia …… nan dao wo jiu bu neng zuo dian shen me lai ying de ni zai zhang lao hui de tou piao ma ？]

english: Yes of course outerlander! If you bring me five raw sardines then I will vote for you instead!
translation: 是的，当然是外地人！如果你给我带来五个生沙丁鱼，那么我就会投票给你！ [shi de ， dang ran shi wai di ren ！ ru guo ni gei wo dai lai wu ge sheng sha ding yu ， na me wo jiu hui tou piao gei ni ！]

english: REALLY?!?!?
translation: 真的吗？！？！？ [zhen de ma ？！？！？]

english: HAHAHAHAHAHA! No, of course not! You are stupid, even by outerlander standards!
translation: 哈哈哈哈哈哈！不，当然不是！即使按照外地人的标准，你也是愚蠢的！ [ha ha ha ha ha ha ！ bu ， dang ran bu shi ！ ji shi an zhao wai di ren de biao zhun ， ni ye shi yu chun de ！]

english: If you want my vote, you must pass my trial. It is as simple as that.
translation: 如果你想要我投票，你就必须通过我的审判。就是这么简单。 [ru guo ni xiang yao wo tou piao ， ni jiu bi xu tong guo wo de shen pan 。 jiu shi zhe me jian dan 。]

english: Congratulations! You have completed the warrior's trial! (Koschei disappears in a puff of smoke, the player receives a Fremennik blade)
translation: 恭喜！你已经完成了战士的试炼！ （Koschei 消失在一阵烟雾中，玩家收到一把弗雷曼尼克刀片） [gong xi ！ ni yi jing wan cheng le zhan shi de shi lian ！ （Koschei  xiao shi zai yi zhen yan wu zhong ， wan jia shou dao yi ba fu lei man ni ke dao pian ）]

english: Hahaha! Well fought outerlander! Now come down from there, you have passed my trial with flying colours!
translation: 哈哈哈！外地人打得好！现在从那里下来，你已经出色地通过了我的考验！ [ha ha ha ！ wai di ren da de hao ！ xian zai cong na li xia lai ， ni yi jing chu se di tong guo le wo de kao yan ！]

english: But... I don't understand... I did not manage to beat Koschei...
translation: 但是……我不明白……我没能打败Koschei…… [dan shi …… wo bu ming bai …… wo mei neng da bai Koschei……]

english: I did not say you had to, outerlander! All I asked was that you fought to the death! And you did! The death was your own!
translation: 我没说你必须这么做，外地人！我只要求你死而复生！你做到了！死亡是你自己的！ [wo mei shuo ni bi xu zhe me zuo ， wai di ren ！ wo zhi yao qiu ni si er fu sheng ！ ni zuo dao le ！ si wang shi ni zi ji de ！]

english: I was not interested in how strong you are! I was interested in how BRAVE you are! You fought a superior enemy to your very last breath - THAT is bravery.
translation: 我对你有多强不感兴趣！我对你有多勇敢很感兴趣！你与强大的敌人战斗到了最后一口气——这就是勇敢。 [wo dui ni you duo qiang bu gan xing qu ！ wo dui ni you duo yong gan hen gan xing qu ！ ni yu qiang da de di ren zhan dou dao le zui hou yi kou qi —— zhe jiu shi yong gan 。]

english: I would be honoured to represent you to the council as worthy of being a Fremennik after watching that superb battle!
translation: 在观看了那场精彩的战斗后，我很荣幸代表您参加理事会，作为一名弗里曼尼克人！ [zai guan kan le na chang jing cai de zhan dou hou ， wo hen rong xing dai biao nin can jia li shi hui ， zuo wei yi ming fu li man ni ke ren ！]

english: So can I count on your vote at the council of elders now Thorvald?
translation: 那么我可以指望你在托瓦尔德长老会议上投票吗？ [na me wo ke yi zhi wang ni zai tuo wa er de zhang lao hui yi shang tou piao ma ？]

english: Absolutely! I watched the entire battle, and was extremely impressed with your bravery in combat!
translation: 绝对地！我观看了整场战斗，对你们的战斗英勇印象深刻！ [jue dui di ！ wo guan kan le zheng chang zhan dou ， dui ni men de zhan dou ying yong yin xiang shen ke ！]

english: I'd really rather not go back down there again, now that I have Thorvald's vote at the council of elders.
translation: 既然我在长老会议上得到了托瓦尔德的投票，我真的不想再回到那里了。 [ji ran wo zai zhang lao hui yi shang de dao le tuo wa er de de tou piao ， wo zhen de bu xiang zai hui dao na li le 。]

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a brave and powerful warrior to act as a bodyguard?
translation: 我想你不知道我去哪里可以找到一个勇敢而强大的战士来充当保镖吗？ [wo xiang ni bu zhi dao wo qu na li ke yi zhao dao yi ge yong gan er qiang da de zhan shi lai chong dang bao biao ma ？]

english: Know you not who I am outerlander? There are none more brave or powerful than me amongst all the Fremennik!
translation: 你不知道我是谁？在所有弗雷曼尼克人中，没有人比我更勇敢、更强大！ [ni bu zhi dao wo shi shui ？ zai suo you fu lei man ni ke ren zhong ， mei you ren bi wo geng yong gan 、 geng qiang da ！]

english: However... The role of bodyguard is below me, as a noble warrior. You might as well ask me to babysit the children!
translation: 不过……保镖的角色在我之下，作为一个高贵的战士。你不如让我来照顾孩子吧！ [bu guo …… bao biao de jue se zai wo zhi xia ， zuo wei yi ge gao gui de zhan shi 。 ni bu ru rang wo lai zhao gu hai zi ba ！]

english: Is there no way you would do this for me?
translation: 难道你就没有办法为我做这件事吗？ [nan dao ni jiu mei you ban fa wei wo zuo zhe jian shi ma ？]

english: There is but one way outerlander. Since I was steeled in battle, I have dreamt of earning my place at the Champions Table in the Long Hall.
translation: 外地人只有一种方法。自从我在战斗中磨练出来后，我就梦想着能在长厅的冠军桌上赢得一席之地。 [wai di ren zhi you yi zhong fang fa 。 zi cong wo zai zhan dou zhong mo lian chu lai hou ， wo jiu meng xiang zhe neng zai zhang ting de guan jun zhuo shang ying de yi xi zhi di 。]

english: It is a tradition amongst us that the bravest and strongest are honoured with a table of champions to drink and feast all that they can in our Long Hall.
translation: 我们有一个传统，最勇敢、最强壮的人会被授予一桌冠军，在我们的长厅里尽情饮酒和享受盛宴。 [wo men you yi ge chuan tong ， zui yong gan 、 zui qiang zhuang de ren hui bei shou yu yi zhuo guan jun ， zai wo men de zhang ting li jin qing yin jiu he xiang shou sheng yan 。]

english: Unfortunately, there are only a fixed number of places available at the table, and these places were all filled many moons ago by others.
translation: 不幸的是，餐桌上的空位数量是固定的，而这些空位在很多个月前就已经被其他人占满了。 [bu xing de shi ， can zhuo shang de kong wei shu liang shi gu ding de ， er zhe xie kong wei zai hen duo ge yue qian jiu yi jing bei qi ta ren zhan man le 。]

english: Although my worthiness is undeniable, the only way I may take my place is if one of those already there die, or give up their place to me voluntarily.
translation: 虽然我的价值是不可否认的，但我取代我位置的唯一方法是，如果已经在那里的人中有一个死去，或者自愿将他们的位置让给我。 [sui ran wo de jia zhi shi bu ke fou ren de ， dan wo qu dai wo wei zhi de wei yi fang fa shi ， ru guo yi jing zai na li de ren zhong you yi ge si qu ， huo zhe zi yuan jiang ta men de wei zhi rang gei wo 。]

english: So you want me to go kill one of them off for you? Make it look like an accident?
translation: 所以你想让我帮你杀掉其中一个？让事情看起来像一场意外？ [suo yi ni xiang rang wo bang ni sha diao qi zhong yi ge ？ rang shi qing kan qi lai xiang yi chang yi wai ？]

english: WHAT? No, no, not at all! I am shocked you would suggest such a thing!
translation: 什么？不，不，一点也不！我很震惊你会提出这样的事情！ [shen me ？ bu ， bu ， yi dian ye bu ！ wo hen zhen jing ni hui ti chu zhe yang de shi qing ！]

english: If you can persuade one of the Revellers to give up their Champions' Token to you so that I might take their place, you may have my contract as a bodyguard.
translation: 如果你能说服其中一位狂欢者将他们的冠军令牌交给你，以便我可以取代他们的位置，你可能会得到我作为保镖的合同。 [ru guo ni neng shuo fu qi zhong yi wei kuang huan zhe jiang ta men de guan jun ling pai jiao gei ni ， yi bian wo ke yi qu dai ta men de wei zhi ， ni ke neng hui de dao wo zuo wei bao biao de he tong 。]

english: Okay, I'll see what I can do.
translation: 好吧，我看看能做什么。 [hao ba ， wo kan kan neng zuo shen me 。]

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find the token to allow your seat at the champions table?
translation: 我想你不知道我在哪里可以找到让你在冠军桌上获得席位的令牌？ [wo xiang ni bu zhi dao wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao rang ni zai guan jun zhuo shang huo de xi wei de ling pai ？]

english: You will need to persuade one of the revellers in the Long Hall to give up their token, and their place, in deference to my own worthiness somehow.
translation: 你需要说服长厅里的一位狂欢者放弃他们的令牌和他们的位置，以某种方式尊重我自己的价值。 [ni xu yao shuo fu zhang ting li de yi wei kuang huan zhe fang qi ta men de ling pai he ta men de wei zhi ， yi mou zhong fang shi zun zhong wo zi ji de jia zhi 。]

english: I would like your contract to offer your services as a bodyguard.
translation: 我想要一份提供保镖服务的合同。 [wo xiang yao yi fen ti gong bao biao fu wu de he tong 。]

english: Oh you would, would you outerlander? I have already told you, I will not demean myself with such a baby sitting job until I can sit in the Longhall with pride.
translation: 哦，你会的，你会是外地人吗？我已经告诉过你了，在我能自豪地坐在长厅之前，我不会做这样的保姆工作来贬低自己。 [o ， ni hui de ， ni hui shi wai di ren ma ？ wo yi jing gao su guo ni le ， zai wo neng zi hao di zuo zai zhang ting zhi qian ， wo bu hui zuo zhe yang de bao mu gong zuo lai bian di zi ji 。]

english: It's a good thing I have the Champions' Token right here then, isn't it?
translation: 很高兴我能在这里拥有冠军令牌，不是吗？ [hen gao xing wo neng zai zhe li yong you guan jun ling pai ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Ah... well this is a different matter. With that token I can claim my rightful place as a champion in the Long hall!
translation: 啊……好吧，这是另一回事了。有了这枚令牌，我就可以在长殿中获得应有的冠军地位了！ [a …… hao ba ， zhe shi ling yi hui shi le 。 you le zhe mei ling pai ， wo jiu ke yi zai zhang dian zhong huo de ying you de guan jun di wei le ！]

english: Here outerlander, I can suffer the indignity of playing babysitter if it means that I can then revel with my warrior equals in the Long Hall afterwards!
translation: 在这里，外地人，我可以忍受扮演保姆的侮辱，如果这意味着我可以随后在长厅与我的战士一起狂欢！ [zai zhe li ， wai di ren ， wo ke yi ren shou ban yan bao mu de wu ru ， ru guo zhe yi wei zhe wo ke yi sui hou zai zhang ting yu wo de zhan shi yi qi kuang huan ！]

english: Here outerlander, take this contract; I will fulfill it to my utmost.
translation: 外地人，请收下这份合同；我会尽我最大的努力去完成它。 [wai di ren ， qing shou xia zhe fen he tong ； wo hui jin wo zui da de nu li qu wan cheng ta 。]

english: (Thorvald takes the Champions token and gives the player Warrior's contract)
translation: （托瓦尔德拿走冠军代币并给予玩家战士合同） [（ tuo wa er de na zou guan jun dai bi bing ji yu wan jia zhan shi he tong ）]

english: You didn't take much persuading to 'lower' yourself to a bodyguard.
translation: 你没费多少力气就将自己“贬低”为保镖。 [ni mei fei duo shao li qi jiu jiang zi ji “ bian di ” wei bao biao 。]

english: You misunderstand, outerlander. Normally I will only battle for a noble cause, but have never been recognised as a true champion here.
translation: 你误会了，外地人。通常我只会为崇高的事业而战，但在这里从未被认为是真正的冠军。 [ni wu hui le ， wai di ren 。 tong chang wo zhi hui wei chong gao de shi ye er zhan ， dan zai zhe li cong wei bei ren wei shi zhen zheng de guan jun 。]

english: With this Champion's token, I can stand alongside my warrior brethren in the Long Hall, and revel in the glories of past victories together!
translation: 有了这个冠军令牌，我就可以和我的战士兄弟们一起站在长厅里，一起享受昔日胜利的辉煌！ [you le zhe ge guan jun ling pai ， wo jiu ke yi he wo de zhan shi xiong di men yi qi zhan zai zhang ting li ， yi qi xiang shou xi ri sheng li de hui huang ！]

english: Howdy Thorvald!
translation: 你好托瓦尔德！ [ni hao tuo wa er de ！]

english: And greetings to you too. It is good to see new blood entering the Fremennik; we gain our strength by bringing new warriors into the tribe.
translation: 也向你问好。很高兴看到新的血液进入弗雷曼尼克；我们通过将新的战士带入部落来获得力量。 [ye xiang ni wen hao 。 hen gao xing kan dao xin de xue ye jin ru fu lei man ni ke ； wo men tong guo jiang xin de zhan shi dai ru bu luo lai huo de li liang 。]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: What do I have to do again?
translation: 我还需要做什么？ [wo hai xu yao zuo shen me ？]

english: Who is my opponent?
translation: 我的对手是谁？ [wo de dui shou shi shui ？]

english: Can't I do something else?
translation: 我就不能做点别的吗？ [wo jiu bu neng zuo dian bie de ma ？]

english: Ask about the Merchant's trial
translation: 询问商家试用情况 [xun wen shang jia shi yong qing kuang]

english: Ask about becoming a Fremennik
translation: 询问成为 Fremennik 的问题 [xun wen cheng wei  Fremennik  de wen ti]

english: Welcome to the Realm of Memories, [player name].
translation: 欢迎来到记忆王国，[玩家名字]。 [huan ying lai dao ji yi wang guo ，[ wan jia ming zi ]。]

english: Who were you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I am Thrander. Long ago I used to live in Varrock, converting plate armour. For example, if you'd got a plate skirt, but you preferred leggings instead, I'd convert it, free of charge.
translation: 我是瑟兰德。很久以前，我曾经住在瓦罗克，改装板甲。例如，如果您有板裙，但您更喜欢紧身裤，我会免费转换它。 [wo shi se lan de 。 hen jiu yi qian ， wo ceng jing zhu zai wa luo ke ， gai zhuang ban jia 。 li ru ， ru guo nin you ban qun ， dan nin geng xi huan jin shen ku ， wo hui mian fei zhuan huan ta 。]

english: Are you happy here?
translation: 你在这里快乐吗？ [ni zai zhe li kuai le ma ？]

english: Maybe retiring was a mistake. If the world ever wanted me again, I could come out of retirement and offer my services as before. Though people might fret about the economic impact if I did.
translation: 也许退役是一个错误。如果世界再次需要我，我可以退出退休生活并像以前一样提供服务。但如果我这样做的话，人们可能会担心经济影响。 [ye xu tui yi shi yi ge cuo wu 。 ru guo shi jie zai ci xu yao wo ， wo ke yi tui chu tui xiu sheng huo bing xiang yi qian yi yang ti gong fu wu 。 dan ru guo wo zhe yang zuo de hua ， ren men ke neng hui dan xin jing ji ying xiang 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Who were you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Are you happy here?
translation: 你在这里快乐吗？ [ni zai zhe li kuai le ma ？]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Urg!
Urg!
What is it, human? I'm working.
translation: 这是什么，人类？我在工作。 [zhe shi shen me ， ren lei ？ wo zai gong zuo 。]

english: How do I use the furnace?
translation: 我该如何使用炉子？ [wo gai ru he shi yong lu zi ？]

english: Put your ore on the conveyor belt to get it smelted. We'll stoke the boiler and operate the rest of the machinery for you.
translation: 将矿石放在传送带上进行熔炼。我们将为您给锅炉加燃料并操作其余的机器。 [jiang kuang shi fang zai chuan song dai shang jin xing rong lian 。 wo men jiang wei nin gei guo lu jia ran liao bing cao zuo qi yu de ji qi 。]

english: You'll have to help repair the furnace whenever a pipe blows, though. Just hit it with a hammer - that usually works.
translation: 不过，每当管道爆炸时，你就必须帮忙修理炉子。只需用锤子敲击即可 - 通常会起作用。 [bu guo ， mei dang guan dao bao zha shi ， ni jiu bi xu bang mang xiu li lu zi 。 zhi xu yong chui zi qiao ji ji ke  -  tong chang hui qi zuo yong 。]

english: You'll have to put money in the coffer to pay for our services. We charge 72,000 coins per hour; money is deducted as long as you're in this room with us.
translation: 您必须将钱存入保险箱来支付我们的服务费用。我们每小时收费72,000个币；只要您和我们一起住在这个房间，就会扣除费用。 [nin bi xu jiang qian cun ru bao xian xiang lai zhi fu wo men de fu wu fei yong 。 wo men mei xiao shi shou fei 72,000 ge bi ； zhi yao nin he wo men yi qi zhu zai zhe ge fang jian ， jiu hui kou chu fei yong 。]

english: Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
translation: 天哪，你真是个大矮人。 [tian na ， ni zhen shi ge da ai ren 。]

english: My brothers and I have a rare genetic condition affecting our growth. Rather than treating us as freaks, you might like to appreciate how useful it is that we can operate the machinery.
translation: 我和我的兄弟患有一种影响我们成长的罕见遗传病。您可能不想把我们视为怪胎，而应该欣赏我们操作机器的有用性。 [wo he wo de xiong di huan you yi zhong ying xiang wo men cheng zhang de han jian yi chuan bing 。 nin ke neng bu xiang ba wo men shi wei guai tai ， er ying gai xin shang wo men cao zuo ji qi de you yong xing 。]

english: Sorry.
translation: 对不起。 [dui bu qi 。]

english: That's ok, human. You're not the first to comment on it. Now, did you need anything? I've got work to do here.
translation: 没关系，人类。你不是第一个对此发表评论的人。现在，你需要什么吗？我这里还有工作要做。 [mei guan xi ， ren lei 。 ni bu shi di yi ge dui ci fa biao ping lun de ren 。 xian zai ， ni xu yao shen me ma ？ wo zhe li hai you gong zuo yao zuo 。]

english: Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
translation: 你确定你真的是个侏儒吗？ [ni que ding ni zhen de shi ge zhu ru ma ？]

english: ... look, do you want help with something, or did you just come here to be rude? I've got work to do.
translation: ……听着，你是想寻求帮助，还是来这里只是为了无礼？我还有工作要做。 […… ting zhe ， ni shi xiang xun qiu bang zhu ， hai shi lai zhe li zhi shi wei le wu li ？ wo hai you gong zuo yao zuo 。]

english: I'll let you get on with it.
translation: 我会让你继续做下去。 [wo hui rang ni ji xu zuo xia qu 。]

english: How do I use the furnace?
translation: 我该如何使用炉子？ [wo gai ru he shi yong lu zi ？]

english: Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
translation: 天哪，你真是个大矮人。 [tian na ， ni zhen shi ge da ai ren 。]

english: Sorry.
translation: 对不起。 [dui bu qi 。]

english: I'll let you get on with it.
translation: 我会让你继续做下去。 [wo hui rang ni ji xu zuo xia qu 。]

english: Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
translation: 你确定你真的是个侏儒吗？ [ni que ding ni zhen de shi ge zhu ru ma ？]

english: What is that cape you're wearing?
translation: 你穿的那件斗篷是什么？ [ni chuan de na jian dou peng shi shen me ？]

english: It's a Skillcape of Smithing. It shows that I'm a master blacksmith, but that's only to be expected - after all, my ancestors were the greatest blacksmiths in dwarven history.
translation: 这是史密斯的技能斗篷。这表明我是一名铁匠大师，但这只是意料之中的——毕竟，我的祖先是矮人历史上最伟大的铁匠。 [zhe shi shi mi si de ji neng dou peng 。 zhe biao ming wo shi yi ming tie jiang da shi ， dan zhe zhi shi yi liao zhi zhong de —— bi jing ， wo de zu xian shi ai ren li shi shang zui wei da de tie jiang 。]

english: If you ever achieve level 99 Smithing you'll be able to wear a cape like this, and receive more experience when smelting gold ore.
translation: 如果你的锻造达到99级，你就可以穿上这样的斗篷，并在冶炼金矿石时获得更多经验。 [ru guo ni de duan zao da dao 99 ji ， ni jiu ke yi chuan shang zhe yang de dou peng ， bing zai ye lian jin kuang shi shi huo de geng duo jing yan 。]

english: Can you make me another of Sir Vyvin's swords?
translation: 你能为我再做一把维文爵士的剑吗？ [ni neng wei wo zai zuo yi ba wei wen jue shi de jian ma ？]

english: You want that knight's sword again? I suppose you brought me a lovely pie, so I don't mind. I'll need a blurite ore and two iron bars, like before.
translation: 你又想要那把骑士剑吗？我想你给我带来了一个可爱的馅饼，所以我不介意。我需要一块蓝铁矿和两根铁锭，就像以前一样。 [ni you xiang yao na ba qi shi jian ma ？ wo xiang ni gei wo dai lai le yi ge ke ai de xian bing ， suo yi wo bu jie yi 。 wo xu yao yi kuai lan tie kuang he liang gen tie ding ， jiu xiang yi qian yi yang 。]

english: Okay, I'll go and find that.
translation: 好的，我这就去找到那个。 [hao de ， wo zhe jiu qu zhao dao na ge 。]

english: Would you like a redberry pie?
translation: 您想要红莓派吗？ [nin xiang yao hong mei pai ma ？]

english: You see Thurgo's eyes light up.
translation: 你看到瑟戈的眼睛在发光。 [ni kan dao se ge de yan jing zai fa guang 。]

english: I'd never say no to a redberry pie! We Imcando dwarves love them - they're GREAT!
translation: 我永远不会拒绝红莓派！我们 Imcando 矮人爱他们 - 他们太棒了！ [wo yong yuan bu hui ju jue hong mei pai ！ wo men  Imcando  ai ren ai ta men  -  ta men tai bang le ！]

english: You hand over the pie. Thurgo eats the pie. Thurgo pats his stomach.
translation: 你把馅饼递过来。瑟戈吃馅饼。瑟戈拍拍肚子。 [ni ba xian bing di guo lai 。 se ge chi xian bing 。 se ge pai pai du zi 。]

english: By Guthix! THAT was good pie! Anyone who makes pie like THAT has got to be alright!
translation: 作者：古蒂克斯！那是美味的馅饼！任何做这样的馅饼的人都一定没问题！ [zuo zhe ： gu di ke si ！ na shi mei wei de xian bing ！ ren he zuo zhe yang de xian bing de ren dou yi ding mei wen ti ！]

english: Can we talk about skillcapes?
translation: 我们可以谈谈技能吗？ [wo men ke yi tan tan ji neng ma ？]

english: What do you need, human?
translation: 你需要什么，人类？ [ni xu yao shen me ， ren lei ？]

english: Now that I am so skilled at Smithing, can I buy a Skillcape of Smithing from you?
translation: 现在我的锻造技术已经这么好了，我可以向你们购买锻造技能斗篷吗？ [xian zai wo de duan zao ji shu yi jing zhe me hao le ， wo ke yi xiang ni men gou mai duan zao ji neng dou peng ma ？]

english: I reckon so; we master smiths must stick together! I'll give it to you for just 99000 coins.
translation: 我认为是这样；我们铁匠大师一定要团结起来！我只要99000金币就给你。 [wo ren wei shi zhe yang ； wo men tie jiang da shi yi ding yao tuan jie qi lai ！ wo zhi yao 99000 jin bi jiu gei ni 。]

english: Sorry, that's too much money.
translation: 抱歉，钱太多了。 [bao qian ， qian tai duo le 。]

english: Too much money? A smith of your calibre should be able to make that amount in an hour!
translation: 钱太多了？像你这样的铁匠应该能够在一小时内赚到这么多钱！ [qian tai duo le ？ xiang ni zhe yang de tie jiang ying gai neng gou zai yi xiao shi nei zhuan dao zhe me duo qian ！]

english: Of course I'll pay you.
translation: 我当然会付钱给你。 [wo dang ran hui fu qian gei ni 。]

english: All Skillcapes come with a free hood. It's part of a deal: buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 所有 Skillcape 均配有免费兜帽。这是交易的一部分：买一送一，你知道的。因此，在我向您出售一件之前，您需要释放一些库存空间。 [suo you  Skillcape  jun pei you mian fei dou mao 。 zhe shi jiao yi de yi bu fen ： mai yi song yi ， ni zhi dao de 。 yin ci ， zai wo xiang nin chu shou yi jian zhi qian ， nin xu yao shi fang yi xie ku cun kong jian 。]

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: 出色的！我的朋友，自豪地穿上那件斗篷。 [chu se de ！ wo de peng you ， zi hao di chuan shang na jian dou peng 。]

english: I've met another Imcando dwarf.
translation: 我遇到了另一个伊姆坎多侏儒。 [wo yu dao le ling yi ge yi mu kan duo zhu ru 。]

english: I very much doubt that [player name]. I'm the last Imcando dwarf left in Gielinor.
translation: 我非常怀疑[玩家姓名]。我是吉林诺仅存的最后一个伊姆坎多矮人。 [wo fei chang huai yi [ wan jia xing ming ]。 wo shi ji lin nuo jin cun de zui hou yi ge yi mu kan duo ai ren 。]

english: No it's true. I was accidentally helping some grave robbers unearth some treasure below Ice Mountain. Long story short, it turned out to be the ruins of Camdozaal.
translation: 不，这是真的。我在冰山下面无意中帮助一些盗墓贼挖出了一些宝藏。长话短说，原来是卡姆多扎尔的废墟。 [bu ， zhe shi zhen de 。 wo zai bing shan xia mian wu yi zhong bang zhu yi xie dao mu zei wa chu le yi xie bao zang 。 chang hua duan shuo ， yuan lai shi ka mu duo zha er de fei xu 。]

english: Camdozaal?
translation: 卡姆多扎尔？ [ka mu duo zha er ？]

english: Yes!
translation: 是的！ [shi de ！]

english: I don't believe me ears! Tell me what else you know!
translation: 我不相信自己的耳朵！告诉我你还知道什么！ [wo bu xiang xin zi ji de er duo ！ gao su wo ni hai zhi dao shen me ！]

english: Well there's not much left there really. It's just a ruin.
translation: 好吧，实际上已经所剩无几了。这只是一片废墟。 [hao ba ， shi ji shang yi jing suo sheng wu ji le 。 zhe zhi shi yi pian fei xu 。]

english: But there's a lone Imcando dwarf keeping it alive. His name is Ramarno.
translation: 但有一个孤独的伊姆坎多矮人让它活着。他的名字叫拉玛诺。 [dan you yi ge gu du de yi mu kan duo ai ren rang ta huo zhe 。 ta de ming zi jiao la ma nuo 。]

english: Ramarno...
translation: 拉玛诺... [la ma nuo ...]

english: He's managed to keep the city going all these years, even with his lack of vision.
translation: 这些年来，尽管他缺乏远见，但他还是设法让这座城市继续运转。 [zhe xie nian lai ， jin guan ta que fa yuan jian ， dan ta hai shi she fa rang zhe zuo cheng shi ji xu yun zhuan 。]

english: Thank you for bringing me this news [player name]. I'll need to make some time to see the city with my own eyes.
translation: 感谢您给我带来这个消息[玩家姓名]。我需要抽出一些时间亲眼看看这座城市。 [gan xie nin gei wo dai lai zhe ge xiao xi [ wan jia xing ming ]。 wo xu yao chou chu yi xie shi jian qin yan kan kan zhe zuo cheng shi 。]

english: What do you make of this, Thurgo?
translation: 你对此有何看法，瑟戈？ [ni dui ci you he kan fa ， se ge ？]

english: Thurgo quickly reads the book.
translation: 瑟戈很快地读完了这本书。 [se ge hen kuai di du wan le zhe ben shu 。]

english: Hmph, who wrote this text? It seems new.
translation: 哼，这篇文字是谁写的？看起来很新。 [heng ， zhe pian wen zi shi shui xie de ？ kan qi lai hen xin 。]

english: I-
translation: 我- [wo -]

english: Nevermind! If you ever plan on going back to this island, I'll happily come along.
translation: 没关系！如果你打算回到这个岛，我会很乐意一起去。 [mei guan xi ！ ru guo ni da suan hui dao zhe ge dao ， wo hui hen le yi yi qi qu 。]

english: Oh... Umm... Err...
So you believe it could possibly lead to the ancient ruins of your race?
translation: 所以你相信它可能通向你们种族的古代遗迹？ [suo yi ni xiang xin ta ke neng tong xiang ni men zhong zu de gu dai yi ji ？]

english: I'll believe it when I see it... Now begone, I've got things to do.
translation: 当我看到它时我就会相信...现在走吧，我还有事情要做。 [dang wo kan dao ta shi wo jiu hui xiang xin ... xian zai zou ba ， wo hai you shi qing yao zuo 。]

english: Alright, Thurgo. I'll see you later.
translation: 好吧，瑟戈。稍后见。 [hao ba ， se ge 。 shao hou jian 。]

english: The Wise Old Man says he's got the information you wanted. Here's his message.
translation: 智者老人说他已经得到了你想要的信息。这是他的信息。 [zhi zhe lao ren shuo ta yi jing de dao le ni xiang yao de xin xi 。 zhe shi ta de xin xi 。]

english: Ooh, thanks. I've been hoping he'd send me that information soon, although I wouldn't mind if he'd send me a pie instead!
translation: 哦，谢谢。我一直希望他能尽快给我发送这些信息，尽管我不介意他给我发送一个馅饼！ [o ， xie xie 。 wo yi zhi xi wang ta neng jin kuai gei wo fa song zhe xie xin xi ， jin guan wo bu jie yi ta gei wo fa song yi ge xian bing ！]

english: I'd give you a reward, but you don't seem to have any space for it. Come back when you do.
translation: 我想给你奖励，但你似乎没有任何空间。当你回来的时候就回来吧。 [wo xiang gei ni jiang li ， dan ni si hu mei you ren he kong jian 。 dang ni hui lai de shi hou jiu hui lai ba 。]

english: Some guy died down in the hole just north of my house, and he dropped these herbs. Here, take them.
translation: 有一个人死在我家北面的洞里，他掉下了这些草药。来，带走他们。 [you yi ge ren si zai wo jia bei mian de dong li ， ta diao xia le zhe xie cao yao 。 lai ， dai zou ta men 。]

english: Here's some cash for your time.
translation: 这里有一些现金供您使用。 [zhe li you yi xie xian jin gong nin shi yong 。]

english: I found this while I was mining. Hope you like it.
translation: 这是我在挖矿的时候发现的。希望你喜欢它。 [zhe shi wo zai wa kuang de shi hou fa xian de 。 xi wang ni xi huan ta 。]

english: Magic isn't really my thing. Here, take these.
translation: Magic isn't really my thing.来，拿这些。 [Magic isn't really my thing. lai ， na zhe xie 。]

english: Can you make me another of Sir Vyvin's swords?
translation: 你能为我再做一把维文爵士的剑吗？ [ni neng wei wo zai zuo yi ba wei wen jue shi de jian ma ？]

english: Would you like a redberry pie?
translation: 您想要红莓派吗？ [nin xiang yao hong mei pai ma ？]

english: What is that cape you're wearing?
translation: 你穿的那件斗篷是什么？ [ni chuan de na jian dou peng shi shen me ？]

english: Can we talk about skillcapes?
translation: 我们可以谈谈技能吗？ [wo men ke yi tan tan ji neng ma ？]

english: Sorry, that's too much money.
translation: 抱歉，钱太多了。 [bao qian ， qian tai duo le 。]

english: Of course I'll pay you.
translation: 我当然会付钱给你。 [wo dang ran hui fu qian gei ni 。]

english: I've met another Imcando dwarf.
translation: 我遇到了另一个伊姆坎多侏儒。 [wo yu dao le ling yi ge yi mu kan duo zhu ru 。]

english: Emerald
translation: 翠 [cui]

english: Looking to protect that nice brain of yours? Then you'll be wanting one of my helmets.
translation: 想要保护你那颗漂亮的大脑吗？那么你就会想要我的一顶头盔。 [xiang yao bao hu ni na ke piao liang de da nao ma ？ na me ni jiu hui xiang yao wo de yi ding tou kui 。]

translation: 你好，蒂亚德什。 [ni hao ， di ya de shen 。]

english: Hello, Bwana! Would you like to buy some Karambwan?
translation: 你好，布瓦纳！您想买一些 Karambwan 吗？ [ni hao ， bu wa na ！ nin xiang mai yi xie  Karambwan  ma ？]

english: No.

translation: 我可以买票吗？ [wo ke yi mai piao ma ？]

english: There's no need. Under our agreement with the Dorgeshuun, you get free train travel in return for services rendered.
translation: 没必要吧根据我们与 Dorgeshuun 的协议，您可以免费乘坐火车，以换取所提供的服务。 [mei bi yao ba gen ju wo men yu  Dorgeshuun  de xie yi ， nin ke yi mian fei cheng zuo huo che ， yi huan qu suo ti gong de fu wu 。]

translation: 我可以买票吗？ [wo ke yi mai piao ma ？]

english: You don't need to buy a ticket! You're [player name]! Without you, this train wouldn't exist!
translation: 你不需要买票！你是[玩家姓名]！没有你，就没有这列火车！ [ni bu xu yao mai piao ！ ni shi [ wan jia xing ming ]！ mei you ni ， jiu mei you zhe lie huo che ！]

english: Just board the train and wait for it to travel to Keldagrim.
translation: 只需登上火车并等待前往凯尔达格林即可。 [zhi xu deng shang huo che bing deng dai qian wang kai er da ge lin ji ke 。]

english: Hi. What are you doing out here?
translation: 你好。你在这儿做什么？ [ni hao 。 ni zai zhe er zuo shen me ？]

english: Oh, just looking out at the tide...
translation: 哦，只是看着潮水...... [o ， zhi shi kan zhe chao shui ......]

english: What tide?
translation: 什么潮？ [shen me chao ？]

english: It's great, isn't it?
translation: 太棒了，不是吗？ [tai bang le ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Hello. Do you wish me to exchange banknotes for you? I charge only 5 coins for each banknote.
translation: 你好。您需要我为您兑换钞票吗？我每张钞票只收取 5 个硬币。 [ni hao 。 nin xu yao wo wei nin dui huan chao piao ma ？ wo mei zhang chao piao zhi shou qu  5  ge ying bi 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Hand me the banknotes you wish me to exchange.
translation: 把你要我兑换的钞票递给我。 [ba ni yao wo dui huan de chao piao di gei wo 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I am Tiles. I can exchange banknotes for real items. Do you want any banknotes converted?
translation: 我是瓷砖。我可以用纸币兑换实物。您想要兑换任何纸币吗？ [wo shi ci zhuan 。 wo ke yi yong zhi bi dui huan shi wu 。 nin xiang yao dui huan ren he zhi bi ma ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: You poke 10 flashing pillars, right? You NOT poke other pillars, right? Okay, you go play now.
translation: 你戳了10根闪光的柱子，对吗？你不会戳其他支柱，对吗？好吧，你现在去玩吧。 [ni chuo le 10 gen shan guang de zhu zi ， dui ma ？ ni bu hui chuo qi ta zhi zhu ， dui ma ？ hao ba ， ni xian zai qu wan ba 。]

english: Err...what am I supposed to do here again?
translation: 呃……我该怎么办？ [e …… wo gai zen me ban ？]

english: You gotta poke dem pillars.
translation: 你必须戳那些柱子。 [ni bi xu chuo na xie zhu zi 。]

english: What? All of them?
translation: 什么？他们全部？ [shen me ？ ta men quan bu ？]

english: No, no. If you poke dem ones dat don't have a dem flashin' rings, den dats bad.
translation: 不，不。如果你戳那些没有闪光戒指的人，那可就糟糕了。 [bu ， bu 。 ru guo ni chuo na xie mei you shan guang jie zhi de ren ， na ke jiu zao gao le 。]

english: So I have to poke the pillars that are flashing?
translation: 所以我必须去戳那些闪烁的柱子？ [suo yi wo bi xu qu chuo na xie shan shuo de zhu zi ？]

english: Yer. You do dat ten times, you get prize.
translation: 是啊。你这样做十次，你就会得到奖品。 [shi a 。 ni zhe yang zuo shi ci ， ni jiu hui de dao jiang pin 。]

english: So...I'm free to go now, right?
translation: 那么……我现在可以走了，对吗？ [na me …… wo xian zai ke yi zou le ， dui ma ？]

english: Yer, get going. We get break now.
translation: 耶，走吧。我们现在休息一下。 [ye ， zou ba 。 wo men xian zai xiu xi yi xia 。]

english: Ok. Err...have a nice break.
translation: 好的。呃……祝你休息愉快。 [hao de 。 e …… zhu ni xiu xi yu kuai 。]

english: Hey, how's it go...
translation: 嘿，怎么样了... [hei ， zen me yang le ...]

english: Apples, trout. Maybe some spi... Oh sorry matey, busy getting the grub together for our next voyage. If ye need anything, talk t' Captain Pudi over by the dock.
translation: 苹果、鳟鱼。也许是一些秘密……哦，对不起，伙计，正忙着为我们的下一次航行准备食物。如果你们需要什么，可以和码头边的普迪船长谈谈。 [ping guo 、 zun yu 。 ye xu shi yi xie mi mi …… o ， dui bu qi ， huo ji ， zheng mang zhe wei wo men de xia yi ci hang xing zhun bei shi wu 。 ru guo ni men xu yao shen me ， ke yi he ma tou bian de pu di chuan zhang tan tan 。]

english: I wonder what jelly would be like with cooked eels? Maybe a pie of some sor... Oh hey there stranger. What can I do for ye?
translation: 我想知道煮熟的鳗鱼会是什么样的果冻？也许是某种馅饼……哦，嘿，陌生人。我能为你们做什么？ [wo xiang zhi dao zhu shu de man yu hui shi shen me yang de guo dong ？ ye xu shi mou zhong xian bing …… o ， hei ， mo sheng ren 。 wo neng wei ni men zuo shen me ？]

english: Crab meat would do wonders in an admir... Oh hey there stranger. What can I do for ye?
translation: 蟹肉会在钦佩者中创造奇迹……哦，嘿，陌生人。我能为你们做什么？ [xie rou hui zai qin pei zhe zhong chuang zao qi ji …… o ， hei ， mo sheng ren 。 wo neng wei ni men zuo shen me ？]

english: Maybe some pineapple. That could enhance the flavour of a summer pi... Oh hey there stranger. What can I do for ye?
translation: 也许一些菠萝。这可以增强夏日馅饼的味道……哦，嘿，陌生人。我能为你们做什么？ [ye xu yi xie bo luo 。 zhe ke yi zeng qiang xia ri xian bing de wei dao …… o ， hei ， mo sheng ren 。 wo neng wei ni men zuo shen me ？]

english: How was your last fishing trip?
translation: 您上次钓鱼之旅怎么样？ [nin shang ci diao yu zhi lv zen me yang ？]

english: 'Twas a good and bad trip.
translation: 这是一次有好有坏的旅行。 [zhe shi yi ci you hao you huai de lv xing 。]

english: During the trip, I was cookin' up a nice fish pie for the crew. But then a storm 'it the ship.
translation: 在旅途中，我为船员们准备了美味的鱼馅饼。但随后一场风暴袭击了这艘船。 [zai lv tu zhong ， wo wei chuan yuan men zhun bei le mei wei de yu xian bing 。 dan sui hou yi chang feng bao xi ji le zhe sou chuan 。]

english: Water came a spewin' through the windows and with the water came some glowing fish. It flew straight into me cooking pie.
translation: 水从窗户里喷涌而出，一些发光的鱼也随之而来。它直接飞到我正在做馅饼的地方。 [shui cong chuang hu li pen yong er chu ， yi xie fa guang de yu ye sui zhi er lai 。 ta zhi jie fei dao wo zheng zai zuo xian bing de di fang 。]

english: I couldn't 'elp it, I 'ad to try it... The taste was amazin'! Never 'ad anythin' like it in me life before.
translation: 我无法控制它，我想尝试一下......味道太棒了！我以前的生活中从来没有做过类似的“广告”。 [wo wu fa kong zhi ta ， wo xiang chang shi yi xia ...... wei dao tai bang le ！ wo yi qian de sheng huo zhong cong lai mei you zuo guo lei si de “ guang gao ”。]

english: Maybe one day I will make that amazing pie again.
translation: 也许有一天我会再次制作那个美味的馅饼。 [ye xu you yi tian wo hui zai ci zhi zuo na ge mei wei de xian bing 。]

english: That sounds great. If you ever do make it again, tell me the recipe so I can make it myself please.
translation: 听起来很棒。如果你再做一次，请告诉我食谱，这样我就可以自己做。 [ting qi lai hen bang 。 ru guo ni zai zuo yi ci ， qing gao su wo shi pu ， zhe yang wo jiu ke yi zi ji zuo 。]

english: Me recipes are a secret and I am not sharin' 'em with anyone!
translation: 我的食谱是秘密，我不会与任何人分享！ [wo de shi pu shi mi mi ， wo bu hui yu ren he ren fen xiang ！]

english: On with me story. after trying that amazing pie, the floor boards above fell down and the ship's wheel knocked me out.
translation: 跟我讲故事吧在尝试了那个令人惊奇的馅饼后，上面的地板掉了下来，船的轮子把我撞倒了。 [gen wo jiang gu shi ba zai chang shi le na ge ling ren jing qi de xian bing hou ， shang mian de di ban diao le xia lai ， chuan de lun zi ba wo zhuang dao le 。]

english: I woke up in Al Kharid with the others. Pudi and some local fisherfolk helped us out and now we're 'ere. Lots o' mouths t' feed now!
translation: 我和其他人一起在阿尔卡里德醒来。 Pudi 和一些当地的渔民帮助了我们，现在我们就到了。现在很多嘴都吃不饱了！ [wo he qi ta ren yi qi zai a er ka li de xing lai 。 Pudi  he yi xie dang di de yu min bang zhu le wo men ， xian zai wo men jiu dao le 。 xian zai hen duo zui dou chi bu bao le ！]

english: Anythin' else ya be needin'?
translation: 你还需要什么吗？ [ni hai xu yao shen me ma ？]

english: You really like cooking. Can you share any recipes with me?
translation: 你真的很喜欢做饭。你能和我分享一些食谱吗？ [ni zhen de hen xi huan zuo fan 。 ni neng he wo fen xiang yi xie shi pu ma ？]

english: Unfortunately for ye, me recipes are a secret and I am not sharin' 'em with anyone!
translation: 对你们来说不幸的是，我的食谱是一个秘密，我不会与任何人分享！ [dui ni men lai shuo bu xing de shi ， wo de shi pu shi yi ge mi mi ， wo bu hui yu ren he ren fen xiang ！]

english: Aw, please tell me! I've always wanted to try sailor food.
translation: 噢，请告诉我！我一直想尝试一下水手餐。 [o ， qing gao su wo ！ wo yi zhi xiang chang shi yi xia shui shou can 。]

english: Ye best become a sailor then.
translation: 那你最好成为一名水手。 [na ni zui hao cheng wei yi ming shui shou 。]

english: Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
translation: 你有对抗 Tempoross 的建议吗？ [ni you dui kang  Tempoross  de jian yi ma ？]

english: Ye should bring a harpoon t' fish for them harpoonfish. They be very effective against the beast.
translation: 你应该为他们带来鱼叉鱼。他们对付野兽非常有效。 [ni ying gai wei ta men dai lai yu cha yu 。 ta men dui fu ye shou fei chang you xiao 。]

english: Ye could try cooking them too. Helps 'em shoot true.
translation: 你也可以尝试煮它们。帮助他们拍摄真实的照片。 [ni ye ke yi chang shi zhu ta men 。 bang zhu ta men pai she zhen shi de zhao pian 。]

english: I have to go.
translation: 我得走了。 [wo de zou le 。]

english: See ya around!
translation: 回头见！ [hui tou jian ！]

english: Would you care for an egg in this difficult time?
translation: 在这个困难时期，你会关心鸡蛋吗？ [zai zhe ge kun nan shi qi ， ni hui guan xin ji dan ma ？]

english: A damp egg! What a tragedy!
translation: 湿鸡蛋！多么悲剧啊！ [shi ji dan ！ duo me bei ju a ！]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: A fate most foul has befallen our eggy friend 'ere!
translation: 我们的鸡蛋朋友遭遇了最不幸的命运！ [wo men de ji dan peng you zao yu le zui bu xing de ming yun ！]

english: Wait a min-
translation: 等一下- [deng yi xia -]

english: This egg, once so full o' promise, set out on an adventure t' become somethin' more...
translation: 这枚曾经充满承诺的蛋，开始了一场冒险，变得更加…… [zhe mei ceng jing chong man cheng nuo de dan ， kai shi le yi chang mao xian ， bian de geng jia ……]

english: ...alas, it fell victim t' the briny depths thanks t' Tempoross. That fiend!
translation: ...唉，多亏了坦普罗斯，它才成为了海水深处的牺牲品。那个恶魔！ [... ai ， duo kui le tan pu luo si ， ta cai cheng wei le hai shui shen chu de xi sheng pin 。 na ge e mo ！]

english: Perhaps a cake, this egg dreamt t' be? We shall never know, for a damp egg is only good as a solemn reminder of the things we've lost.
translation: 也许是一块蛋糕，这个鸡蛋是我梦想的？我们永远不会知道，因为潮湿的鸡蛋只能庄严地提醒我们失去的东西。 [ye xu shi yi kuai dan gao ， zhe ge ji dan shi wo meng xiang de ？ wo men yong yuan bu hui zhi dao ， yin wei chao shi de ji dan zhi neng zhuang yan di ti xing wo men shi qu de dong xi 。]

english: Wow. You really like eggs, don't you?
translation: 哇。你真的很喜欢鸡蛋，不是吗？ [wa 。 ni zhen de hen xi huan ji dan ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Aye, they truly are the most majestic an' versatile item in the culinary world. An inspiration t' us all!
translation: 是的，它们确实是烹饪界最华丽、最多功能的产品。对我们所有人的启发！ [shi de ， ta men que shi shi peng ren jie zui hua li 、 zui duo gong neng de chan pin 。 dui wo men suo you ren de qi fa ！]

english: Timallus sniffles.
translation: 提马勒斯抽泣着。 [ti ma le si chou qi zhe 。]

english: There there, it'll be okay.
translation: 那里那里，一切都会好起来的。 [na li na li ， yi qie du hui hao qi lai de 。]

english: Thank ye, friend.
translation: 谢谢你，朋友。 [xie xie ni ， peng you 。]

english: Oh a gloriously dry egg! What a gift!
translation: 哦，一个光荣的干鸡蛋！多么好的礼物啊！ [o ， yi ge guang rong de gan ji dan ！ duo me hao de li wu a ！]

english: Thank ye!
translation: 谢谢你们！ [xie xie ni men ！]

english: You're welcome!
translation: 不客气！ [bu ke qi ！]

english: Would you like a salmon?
translation: 您想吃鲑鱼吗？ [nin xiang chi gui yu ma ？]

english: Wha' am I supposed t' do wit' a raw salmon?
translation: 我应该用生鲑鱼做什么？ [wo ying gai yong sheng gui yu zuo shen me ？]

english: Cook and eat it, of course.
translation: 当然是煮着吃。 [dang ran shi zhu zhe chi 。]

english: Do I look like some sort o' on demand chef t' ye.
translation: 我看起来像点餐厨师吗？ [wo kan qi lai xiang dian can chu shi ma ？]

english: Fine, I'll take my salmon elsewhere then.
translation: 好吧，那我就把鲑鱼带到别处去。 [hao ba ， na wo jiu ba gui yu dai dao bie chu qu 。]

english: Would you like a freshly cooked salmon?
translation: 您想要新鲜烹制的三文鱼吗？ [nin xiang yao xin xian peng zhi de san wen yu ma ？]

english: Aye, I be very hungry today. Skipped breakfast.
translation: 是啊，我今天很饿。没吃早餐。 [shi a ， wo jin tian hen e 。 mei chi zao can 。]

english: Thanks a lot, landlubber. I appreciate it.
translation: 非常感谢，旱鸭子。我很感激。 [fei chang gan xie ， han ya zi 。 wo hen gan ji 。]

english: What do you make of this egg?
translation: 你用这个鸡蛋做什么？ [ni yong zhe ge ji dan zuo shen me ？]

english: AAAHH!!
translation: 啊啊啊！！ [a a a ！！]

english: What is it?
translation: 它是什么？ [ta shi shen me ？]

english: That egg!
translation: 那个蛋！ [na ge dan ！]

english: 'Tis horrifyin'!
translation: ‘太可怕了’！ [‘ tai ke pa le ’！]

english: Just looks like an egg to me...
translation: 在我看来就像一个鸡蛋... [zai wo kan lai jiu xiang yi ge ji dan ...]

english: Cautiously, Timallus peers more closely at the egg before recoiling suddenly.
translation: 提马勒斯小心翼翼地仔细观察了那颗蛋，然后突然向后退了一步。 [ti ma le si xiao xin yi yi di zi xi guan cha le na ke dan ， ran hou tu ran xiang hou tui le yi bu 。]

english: Shiver me timbers!
translation: 让我颤抖吧！ [rang wo chan dou ba ！]

english: That there egg that ye unfortunately possess 'as a spooky soul.
translation: 你们不幸拥有“作为一个幽灵般的灵魂”的蛋。 [ni men bu xing yong you “ zuo wei yi ge you ling ban de ling hun ” de dan 。]

english: Surely an egg doesn't have a soul-
translation: 鸡蛋肯定是没有灵魂的—— [ji dan ken ding shi mei you ling hun de ——]

english: An omen, perhaps? Is our fight against Tempoross about t' take a turn for the worse?
translation: 也许是一个预兆？我们与坦波罗斯的战斗会变得更糟吗？ [ye xu shi yi ge yu zhao ？ wo men yu tan bo luo si de zhan dou hui bian de geng zao ma ？]

english: Perhaps it's even bigger than that...
translation: 也许它比那还要大...... [ye xu ta bi na hai yao da ......]

english: Look, I was just given this egg as a trick while Trick- or-Treating. It's just a joke!
translation: 瞧，我只是在玩“不给糖就捣蛋”的游戏时才给了我这个鸡蛋作为把戏。这只是个玩笑而已！ [qiao ， wo zhi shi zai wan “ bu gei tang jiu dao dan ” de you xi shi cai gei le wo zhe ge ji dan zuo wei ba xi 。 zhe zhi shi ge wan xiao er yi ！]

english: A cruel trick is what it be! I wouldn't trust whoever gave yetthat... thing!

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

translation: 我对我的成就日记有疑问 [wo dui wo de cheng jiu ri ji you yi wen]

english: What is the Achievement Diary?
translation: 什么是成就日记？ [shen me shi cheng jiu ri ji ？]

translation: 有什么奖励？ [you shen me jiang li ？]

english: Easy Rewards.
translation: 轻松奖励。 [qing song jiang li 。]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Can I have another Varrock platebody?
translation: 我可以再要一个 Varrock 板体吗？ [wo ke yi zai yao yi ge  Varrock  ban ti ma ？]

english: Looking to trade gems? You're in the right place if so.
translation: 想要交易宝石？如果是这样，那么您来对地方了。 [xiang yao jiao yi bao shi ？ ru guo shi zhe yang ， na me nin lai dui di fang le 。]
