translation: 我们来交易吧。 [wo men lai jiao yi ba 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: In that case, timoiva to you.
translation: 在这种情况下，蒂莫瓦给你。 [zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， di mo wa gei ni 。]

english: Let's trade.
translation: 我们来交易吧。 [wo men lai jiao yi ba 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello again. Can you tell me about this training area?
translation: 又好。您能介绍一下这个培训区吗？ [you hao 。 nin neng jie shao yi xia zhe ge pei xun qu ma ？]

english: Of course, if you enter the rift next to me, you'll find a large dungeon filled with four kinds of beasts. You will recognise them from the gauntlet in which you helped me.
translation: 当然，如果你进入我旁边的裂缝，你会发现一个巨大的地牢，里面充满了四种野兽。你会从你帮助我的挑战中认出他们。 [dang ran ， ru guo ni jin ru wo pang bian de lie feng ， ni hui fa xian yi ge ju da de di lao ， li mian chong man le si zhong ye shou 。 ni hui cong ni bang zhu wo de tiao zhan zhong ren chu ta men 。]

english: OK, I didn't have too many problems beating them before.
translation: 好吧，我之前击败他们并没有遇到太多问题。 [hao ba ， wo zhi qian ji bai ta men bing mei you yu dao tai duo wen ti 。]

english: You might find it harder now! At least one is bound to cause you some sort of threat. Be careful! There isn't much in the way of items or treasure down there, it's purely for practicing your combat!
translation: 你现在可能会发现更难了！至少有一个必然会对你造成某种威胁。当心！这里并没有太多的物品和宝物，纯粹是为了练习战斗！ [ni xian zai ke neng hui fa xian geng nan le ！ zhi shao you yi ge bi ran hui dui ni zao cheng mou zhong wei xie 。 dang xin ！ zhe li bing mei you tai duo de wu pin he bao wu ， chun cui shi wei le lian xi zhan dou ！]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Greetings. What can I do for you?
translation: 问候。我能为你做什么？ [wen hou 。 wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm conducting important business here for the Kourend Council.
translation: 我在这里为库伦德委员会处理重要的事务。 [wo zai zhe li wei ku lun de wei yuan hui chu li zhong yao de shi wu 。]

english: Is there anything I can help you with?
translation: 有什么我可以帮助您的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang zhu nin de ma ？]

english: There is something I could use some help with. I'm here on behalf of the Kourend Council to investigate some unusual happenings in Port Piscarilius.
translation: 有件事我需要帮助。我代表库伦德议会来这里调查皮斯卡利留斯港发生的一些异常事件。 [you jian shi wo xu yao bang zhu 。 wo dai biao ku lun de yi hui lai zhe li diao cha pi si ka li liu si gang fa sheng de yi xie yi chang shi jian 。]

english: What are you investigating?
translation: 你在调查什么？ [ni zai diao cha shen me ？]

english: Port Piscarilius is home to various gangs. They're a nuisance, but up until now we haven't had much trouble in dealing with them.
translation: 皮斯卡利留斯港是各种帮派的所在地。它们很麻烦，但到目前为止我们在处理它们方面还没有遇到太多麻烦。 [pi si ka li liu si gang shi ge zhong bang pai de suo zai di 。 ta men hen ma fan ， dan dao mu qian wei zhi wo men zai chu li ta men fang mian hai mei you yu dao tai duo ma fan 。]

english: So what's the problem?
translation: 那么问题出在哪里呢？ [na me wen ti chu zai na li ne ？]

english: A new gang calling themselves the Saviours of Kourend has recently formed. That's not surprising as gangs come and go all of the time, but this one is different.
translation: 最近成立了一个自称“库伦德救世主”的新帮派。这并不奇怪，因为帮派总是来来往往，但这个不同。 [zui jin cheng li le yi ge zi cheng “ ku lun de jiu shi zhu ” de xin bang pai 。 zhe bing bu qi guai ， yin wei bang pai zong shi lai lai wang wang ， dan zhe ge bu tong 。]

english: How so?
translation: 为何如此？ [wei he ru ci ？]

english: The Saviours of Kourend have been absorbing many of the other gangs. Within a few weeks they've already become the largest gang in Kourend and more join them each day.
translation: 库伦德救世主已经吸纳了许多其他帮派。几周之内，他们已经成为库伦德最大的帮派，并且每天都有更多的人加入他们。 [ku lun de jiu shi zhu yi jing xi na le xu duo qi ta bang pai 。 ji zhou zhi nei ， ta men yi jing cheng wei ku lun de zui da de bang pai ， bing qie mei tian dou you geng duo de ren jia ru ta men 。]

english: The talk amongst the people is that it's all down to their leader, a mysterious figure known only as the Queen of Thieves.
translation: 人们之间的议论是，这一切都取决于他们的领袖，一个只被称为盗贼女王的神秘人物。 [ren men zhi jian de yi lun shi ， zhe yi qie dou qu jue yu ta men de ling xiu ， yi ge zhi bei cheng wei dao zei nv wang de shen mi ren wu 。]

english: Nice name. Why doesn't the ruler of Port Piscarilius do something about this?
translation: 好名字。为什么皮斯卡利留斯港的统治者不对此采取行动呢？ [hao ming zi 。 wei shen me pi si ka li liu si gang de tong zhi zhe bu dui ci cai qu xing dong ne ？]

english: Shauna Piscarilius is the ruler of Port Piscarilius, but she spends most of her time galavanting around in that boat of hers rather than looking after her home.
translation: 肖娜·皮斯卡利留斯是皮斯卡利留斯港的统治者，但她大部分时间都在她的船上闲逛，而不是照顾自己的家。 [xiao na · pi si ka li liu si shi pi si ka li liu si gang de tong zhi zhe ， dan ta da bu fen shi jian dou zai ta de chuan shang xian guang ， er bu shi zhao gu zi ji de jia 。]

english: Fair enough. So what do you need me for?
translation: 很公平。那你需要我做什么？ [hen gong ping 。 na ni xu yao wo zuo shen me ？]

english: Well my original plan was to infiltrate the gang to get close to the Queen and capture her. However, I've been unable to make any progress. Apparently, I don't look the part.
translation: 嗯，我最初的计划是渗透到帮派中，接近女王并捕获她。然而，我一直无法取得任何进展。显然，我看起来不符合这个角色。 [n ， wo zui chu de ji hua shi shen tou dao bang pai zhong ， jie jin nv wang bing bu huo ta 。 ran er ， wo yi zhi wu fa qu de ren he jin zhan 。 xian ran ， wo kan qi lai bu fu he zhe ge jue se 。]

english: Yeah not sure what that's all about. You clearly fit right in here.
translation: 是的，不确定那是怎么回事。你显然很适合这里。 [shi de ， bu que ding na shi zen me hui shi 。 ni xian ran hen shi he zhe li 。]

english: Quite right. They're quite insistent though, so someone else will need to give it a go. You look like you might be just the type they're after.
translation: 完全正确。但他们非常坚持，所以其他人需要尝试一下。你看起来可能正是他们所追求的类型。 [wan quan zheng que 。 dan ta men fei chang jian chi ， suo yi qi ta ren xu yao chang shi yi xia 。 ni kan qi lai ke neng zheng shi ta men suo zhui qiu de lei xing 。]

english: What are you trying to say?
translation: 你想说什么？ [ni xiang shuo shen me ？]

english: That you look poor.
translation: 说明你看起来很穷。 [shuo ming ni kan qi lai hen qiong 。]

english: Oh...
Anyway if you're up for the task you'll need to infiltrate the Saviours of Kourend, find the Queen of Thieves, apprehend her and then bring her to me.
translation: 无论如何，如果你准备好执行任务，你需要渗透到库伦德的救世主中，找到盗贼女王，逮捕她，然后把她带到我这里。 [wu lun ru he ， ru guo ni zhun bei hao zhi xing ren wu ， ni xu yao shen tou dao ku lun de de jiu shi zhu zhong ， zhao dao dao zei nv wang ， dai bu ta ， ran hou ba ta dai dao wo zhe li 。]

english: So are you up for it?
translation: 那么你准备好了吗？ [na me ni zhun bei hao le ma ？]

english: Absolutely.
translation: 绝对地。 [jue dui di 。]

english: Excellent. The Saviours of Kourend must have their headquarters somewhere nearby. You should ask around town and see if anyone knows where they are. Good luck.
translation: 出色的。库伦德救世主的总部肯定就在附近的某个地方。你应该问问城里的人，看看是否有人知道他们在哪里。祝你好运。 [chu se de 。 ku lun de jiu shi zhu de zong bu ken ding jiu zai fu jin de mou ge di fang 。 ni ying gai wen wen cheng li de ren ， kan kan shi fou you ren zhi dao ta men zai na li 。 zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Nah.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Fair enough. I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 很公平。如果你改变主意我会在这里。 [hen gong ping 。 ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi wo hui zai zhe li 。]

english: What's the Kourend Council?
translation: Kourend 理事会是什么？ [Kourend  li shi hui shi shen me ？]

english: Although it's called a kingdom, Great Kourend hasn't actually had a king for many years. These days Kourend is a republic and it is ruled by the Kourend Council.
translation: 虽然名为王国，但大库伦德实际上已经很多年没有国王了。如今，库伦德是一个共和国，由库伦德议会统治。 [sui ran ming wei wang guo ， dan da ku lun de shi ji shang yi jing hen duo nian mei you guo wang le 。 ru jin ， ku lun de shi yi ge gong he guo ， you ku lun de yi hui tong zhi 。]

english: The Council consists of four councillors who are elected by the people every four years. The current councillors are Councillor Hughes, Councillor Unkar, Councillor Orson and Councillor Andrews.
translation: 理事会由四名议员组成，每四年由人民选举产生。现任议员为休斯议员、翁卡议员、奥森议员和安德鲁斯议员。 [li shi hui you si ming yi yuan zu cheng ， mei si nian you ren min xuan ju chan sheng 。 xian ren yi yuan wei xiu si yi yuan 、 weng ka yi yuan 、 ao sen yi yuan he an de lu si yi yuan 。]

english: I see. So what are you investigating?
translation: 我懂了。那么你在调查什么？ [wo dong le 。 na me ni zai diao cha shen me ？]

english: I'm looking for a quest.
translation: 我正在寻找一个任务。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yi ge ren wu 。]

english: Well there is something I could use some help with. However, you're not really the person I need for this task.
translation: 嗯，有件事我需要帮助。然而，你并不是我完成这项任务所需的人选。 [n ， you jian shi wo xu yao bang zhu 。 ran er ， ni bing bu shi wo wan cheng zhe xiang ren wu suo xu de ren xuan 。]

english: Well there is something I could use some help with. I'm here on behalf of the Kourend Council to investigate some unusual happenings in Port Piscarilius.
translation: 嗯，有件事我需要帮助。我代表库伦德议会来这里调查皮斯卡利留斯港发生的一些异常事件。 [n ， you jian shi wo xu yao bang zhu 。 wo dai biao ku lun de yi hui lai zhe li diao cha pi si ka li liu si gang fa sheng de yi xie yi chang shi jian 。]

english: Well good luck with that.
translation: 祝你好运。 [zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Nothing thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。]

english: Very well. Until next time.
translation: 很好。直到下次。 [hen hao 。 zhi dao xia ci 。]

english: Let's talk about my quest.
translation: 让我们谈谈我的追求。 [rang wo men tan tan wo de zhui qiu 。]

english: Very well. How goes things?
translation: 很好。事情进展如何？ [hen hao 。 shi qing jin zhan ru he ？]

english: I haven't had any luck finding the Queen of Thieves. However, I've come across this letter which you might find interesting.
translation: 我没有运气找到盗贼女王。不过，我看到了这封信，你可能会觉得有趣。 [wo mei you yun qi zhao dao dao zei nv wang 。 bu guo ， wo kan dao le zhe feng xin ， ni ke neng hui jue de you qu 。]

english: Blimey! Forget the Queen of Thieves. If this letter is to be believed, Councillor Hughes is working with those vile Disciples of Yama. I must report this to the council immediately.
translation: 天啊！忘记盗贼女王吧。如果这封信可信的话，休斯议员正在与那些邪恶的阎罗弟子合作。我必须立即向理事会报告此事。 [tian a ！ wang ji dao zei nv wang ba 。 ru guo zhe feng xin ke xin de hua ， xiu si yi yuan zheng zai yu na xie xie e de yan luo di zi he zuo 。 wo bi xu li ji xiang li shi hui bao gao ci shi 。]

english: Great! So can I have a reward?
translation: 伟大的！那我能得到奖励吗？ [wei da de ！ na wo neng de dao jiang li ma ？]

english: You've done a great service to the people of Kourend. As I'm sure you know, there is no greater reward than the satisfaction of a job well done.
translation: 你为库伦德人民做出了巨大的贡献。我相信您知道，没有什么比出色完成工作所带来的满足感更大的回报了。 [ni wei ku lun de ren min zuo chu le ju da de gong xian 。 wo xiang xin nin zhi dao ， mei you shen me bi chu se wan cheng gong zuo suo dai lai de man zu gan geng da de hui bao le 。]

english: Now be on your way. I have a lot of work to do.
translation: 现在就上路吧。我有很多工作要做。 [xian zai jiu shang lu ba 。 wo you hen duo gong zuo yao zuo 。]

english: What do you know of the Disciples of Yama?
translation: 关于阎罗弟子，你了解多少？ [guan yu yan luo di zi ， ni liao jie duo shao ？]

english: They're a group of deranged cultists that worship some sort of demon. They're not a big threat compared to the lizardmen, but they're still an enemy to Kourend.
translation: 他们是一群崇拜某种恶魔的疯狂邪教徒。与蜥蜴人相比，他们并不是一个大威胁，但他们仍然是库伦德的敌人。 [ta men shi yi qun chong bai mou zhong e mo de feng kuang xie jiao tu 。 yu xi yi ren xiang bi ， ta men bing bu shi yi ge da wei xie ， dan ta men reng ran shi ku lun de de di ren 。]

english: And Councillor Hughes is helping them? That's not good.
translation: 休斯议员正在帮助他们吗？那不好。 [xiu si yi yuan zheng zai bang zhu ta men ma ？ na bu hao 。]

english: Indeed. I must report this to the Council immediately.
translation: 的确。我必须立即向安理会报告此事。 [di que 。 wo bi xu li ji xiang an li hui bao gao ci shi 。]

english: So can I have a reward?
translation: 那我能得到奖励吗？ [na wo neng de dao jiang li ma ？]

english: Hello Tomas. How's things?
translation: 你好托马斯。事情怎么样？ [ni hao tuo ma si 。 shi qing zen me yang ？]

english: Very well thank you. My work in bringing down Councillor Hughes means that I'm finally starting to get the recognition that I deserve.
translation: 非常好，谢谢。我打倒休斯议员的工作意味着我终于开始得到我应得的认可。 [fei chang hao ， xie xie 。 wo da dao xiu si yi yuan de gong zuo yi wei zhe wo zhong yu kai shi de dao wo ying de de ren ke 。]

english: But that was my work!
translation: 但那是我的工作！ [dan na shi wo de gong zuo ！]

english: Yes, yes, very good job. I'll make sure to mention you in my acceptance speech when I'm voted in as her replacement.
translation: 是的，是的，干得很好。当我被选为她的继任者时，我一定会在获奖感言中提到你。 [shi de ， shi de ， gan de hen hao 。 dang wo bei xuan wei ta de ji ren zhe shi ， wo yi ding hui zai huo jiang gan yan zhong ti dao ni 。]

english: Hello Tomas.
translation: 你好托马斯。 [ni hao tuo ma si 。]

english: Oh... Hello there.
translation: 哦...你好。 [o ... ni hao 。]

english: Something wrong?
translation: 有事吗？ [you shi ma ？]

english: I'm ruined. Everything was perfect under the Council, but now I'm right back in the dirt again.
translation: 我毁了。在委员会的领导下，一切都很完美，但现在我又回到了泥土中。 [wo hui le 。 zai wei yuan hui de ling dao xia ， yi qie dou hen wan mei ， dan xian zai wo you hui dao le ni tu zhong 。]

english: You were very close to the Council. You should be glad you got to keep your job at all.
translation: 你与安理会的关系非常密切。你应该很高兴你能保住你的工作。 [ni yu an li hui de guan xi fei chang mi qie 。 ni ying gai hen gao xing ni neng bao zhu ni de gong zuo 。]

english: But I didn't keep my job. Now I spend every day doing boring administrative work. It's a nightmare.
translation: 但我没有保住工作。现在我每天都在做无聊的行政工作。这是一场噩梦。 [dan wo mei you bao zhu gong zuo 。 xian zai wo mei tian dou zai zuo wu liao de xing zheng gong zuo 。 zhe shi yi chang e meng 。]

english: Come now Tomas, it can't be all bad. Show a little enthusiasm.
translation: 托马斯，现在来吧，事情不可能全是坏事。表现出一点热情。 [tuo ma si ， xian zai lai ba ， shi qing bu ke neng quan shi huai shi 。 biao xian chu yi dian re qing 。]

english: Eugh.
What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Anything I can help with?
translation: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi bang mang de ma ？]

english: Absolutely.
translation: 绝对地。 [jue dui di 。]

english: Nah.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

translation: Kourend 理事会是什么？ [Kourend  li shi hui shi shen me ？]

english: I'm looking for a quest.
translation: 我正在寻找一个任务。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yi ge ren wu 。]

english: What are you investigating?
translation: 你在调查什么？ [ni zai diao cha shen me ？]

english: Well good luck with that.
translation: 祝你好运。 [zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Nothing thanks.
translation: 没什么，谢谢。 [mei shen me ， xie xie 。]

english: Let's talk about my quest.
translation: 让我们谈谈我的追求。 [rang wo men tan tan wo de zhui qiu 。]

english: Great! So can I have a reward?
translation: 伟大的！那我能得到奖励吗？ [wei da de ！ na wo neng de dao jiang li ma ？]

translation: 关于阎罗弟子，你了解多少？ [guan yu yan luo di zi ， ni liao jie duo shao ？]

english: Say, aren't you a bit tall for a dwarf?
translation: 话说，对于侏儒来说，你是不是有点高了？ [hua shuo ， dui yu zhu ru lai shuo ， ni shi bu shi you dian gao le ？]

english: Was there anything in particular you wanted?
translation: 有什么特别想要的吗？ [you shen me te bie xiang yao de ma ？]

english: I'd like a quest please.
translation: 我想要一个任务，请。 [wo xiang yao yi ge ren wu ， qing 。]

english: I have nothing to do for you, I'm afraid. Ask around town, though, there are always people who need some work done around here.
translation: 恐怕我没有什么可以为你做的。不过，问问城里的人，总有人需要在这附近完成一些工作。 [kong pa wo mei you shen me ke yi wei ni zuo de 。 bu guo ， wen wen cheng li de ren ， zong you ren xu yao zai zhe fu jin wan cheng yi xie gong zuo 。]

english: No, I just like talking to strangers.
translation: 不，我只是喜欢和陌生人说话。 [bu ， wo zhi shi xi huan he mo sheng ren shuo hua 。]

english: Well I don't.
translation: 好吧，我不。 [hao ba ， wo bu 。]

english: I'd like a quest please.
translation: 我想要一个任务，请。 [wo xiang yao yi ge ren wu ， qing 。]

english: No, I just like talking to strangers.
translation: 不，我只是喜欢和陌生人说话。 [bu ， wo zhi shi xi huan he mo sheng ren shuo hua 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: So how's life as a pirate?
translation: 那么海贼的生活是怎样的呢？ [na me hai zei de sheng huo shi zen yang de ne ？]

english: What kind of question is that? How's life as a... I dunno. Whatever it is that you do for a living.
translation: 这是什么问题？生活怎么样……我不知道。无论你以什么为生。 [zhe shi shen me wen ti ？ sheng huo zen me yang …… wo bu zhi dao 。 wu lun ni yi shen me wei sheng 。]

english: I'm a freelance troubleshooter.
translation: 我是一名自由疑难解答者。 [wo shi yi ming zi you yi nan jie da zhe 。]

english: What does that entail then?
translation: 那么这意味着什么呢？ [na me zhe yi wei zhe shen me ne ？]

english: Mostly killing things for money and delivering items around the planet for people.
translation: 主要是为了钱而杀人，并为人们在地球各地运送物品。 [zhu yao shi wei le qian er sha ren ， bing wei ren men zai di qiu ge di yun song wu pin 。]

english: I collect stuff.
translation: 我收集东西。 [wo shou ji dong xi 。]

english: So how's that life?
translation: 那么这样的生活怎么样呢？ [na me zhe yang de sheng huo zen me yang ne ？]

english: Can't complain, can't complain...
translation: 不能抱怨，不能抱怨…… [bu neng bao yuan ， bu neng bao yuan ……]

english: Well, there you go.
translation: 好吧，就这样吧。 [hao ba ， jiu zhe yang ba 。]

english: Aren't you a little short for a pirate?
translation: 你对于海盗来说是不是有点矮了？ [ni dui yu hai dao lai shuo shi bu shi you dian ai le ？]

english: My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.
translation: 我的母亲是一个侏儒。显然这是一次非常痛苦的分娩。 [wo de mu qin shi yi ge zhu ru 。 xian ran zhe shi yi ci fei chang tong ku de fen mian 。]

english: More info than I wanted, thanks!
translation: 比我想要的更多信息，谢谢！ [bi wo xiang yao de geng duo xin xi ， xie xie ！]

english: Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.
translation: 抱歉，不能停下来，如果船长发现我偷懒地跟偷渡者说话，我的胆子会被吊袜带的。 [bao qian ， bu neng ting xia lai ， ru guo chuan zhang fa xian wo tou lan di gen tou du zhe shuo hua ， wo de dan zi hui bei diao wa dai de 。]

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard!
translation: 我不是偷渡者！我被邀请上船了！ [wo bu shi tou du zhe ！ wo bei yao qing shang chuan le ！]

english: Yeah, whatever [guy/lady], it doesn't really matter who you are I'll get in trouble!
translation: 是的，无论[男人/女人]，无论你是谁，我都会遇到麻烦！ [shi de ， wu lun [ nan ren / nv ren ]， wu lun ni shi shui ， wo du hui yu dao ma fan ！]

english: You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.
translation: 你知道，我一直想知道海盗的生活究竟意味着什么。 [ni zhi dao ， wo yi zhi xiang zhi dao hai dao de sheng huo jiu jing yi wei zhe shen me 。]

english: Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.
translation: 嗯，目前主要涉及偷渡者随机询问问题。 [n ， mu qian zhu yao she ji tou du zhe sui ji xun wen wen ti 。]

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard! By Lokar! Ask him!
translation: 我不是偷渡者！我被邀请上船了！洛卡写的！问他吧！ [wo bu shi tou du zhe ！ wo bei yao qing shang chuan le ！ luo ka xie de ！ wen ta ba ！]

english: Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.
translation: 嘿，无论如何[爱人/朋友]。只要确保船长没有抓住你，海盗不太喜欢偷渡者。 [hei ， wu lun ru he [ ai ren / peng you ]。 zhi yao que bao chuan zhang mei you zhua zhu ni ， hai dao bu tai xi huan tou du zhe 。]

english: Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?
translation: 啊，祝你有美好的一天[milady/sirrah]！你的脸很陌生，你是不是和我们一起登上了月岛的船？ [a ， zhu ni you mei hao de yi tian [milady/sirrah]！ ni de lian hen mo sheng ， ni shi bu shi he wo men yi qi deng shang le yue dao de chuan ？]

english: No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.
translation: 不，洛卡实际上让我在雷莱卡搭车。 [bu ， luo ka shi ji shang rang wo zai lei lai ka da che 。]

english: Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!
translation: 哦真的吗？在我看来你不像弗雷曼尼克人！ [o zhen de ma ？ zai wo kan lai ni bu xiang fu lei man ni ke ren ！]

english: Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
translation: 嗯……我有点是，又有点不是。这是一个很长的故事。 [n …… wo you dian shi ， you you dian bu shi 。 zhe shi yi ge hen zhang de gu shi 。]

english: Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a-fremennik!
translation: 抱歉我没时间听！再见，年轻的弗雷曼尼克，他不是真正的弗雷曼尼克！ [bao qian wo mei shi jian ting ！ zai jian ， nian qing de fu lei man ni ke ， ta bu shi zhen zheng de fu lei man ni ke ！]

english: 'Bye.
translation: '再见。 [' zai jian 。]

english: Brrrr! Its cold up here!
translation: 呜呜！这里很冷！ [wu wu ！ zhe li hen leng ！]

english: You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!
translation: 你觉得这很冷吗？到了 Acheron 那里，天气变得非常寒冷，当你说话时，你会看到话语冻结在你面前的空气中！ [ni jue de zhe hen leng ma ？ dao le  Acheron  na li ， tian qi bian de fei chang han leng ， dang ni shuo hua shi ， ni hui kan dao hua yu dong jie zai ni mian qian de kong qi zhong ！]

english: REALLY?
translation: 真的吗？ [zhen de ma ？]

english: Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!
translation: 不，不是真的。我为了达到幽默效果而夸张了。不过天气非常非常冷！ [bu ， bu shi zhen de 。 wo wei le da dao you mo xiao guo er kua zhang le 。 bu guo tian qi fei chang fei chang leng ！]

english: Hello to you too.
translation: 也向你问好。 [ye xiang ni wen hao 。]

english: Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
translation: 呀！我们是海盗，耶！阿瓦斯特，你们这些坏血病的陆生荔枝！ [ya ！ wo men shi hai dao ， ye ！ a wa si te ， ni men zhe xie huai xue bing de lu sheng li zhi ！]

english: Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
translation: 请不要这样说话，这太令人恼火了。 [qing bu yao zhe yang shuo hua ， zhe tai ling ren nao huo le 。]

english: Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
translation: 另外，请不要叫我荔枝，不管那是什么。 [ling wai ， qing bu yao jiao wo li zhi ， bu guan na shi shen me 。]

english: Oh. Okay. Sorry.
translation: 哦。好的。对不起。 [o 。 hao de 。 dui bu qi 。]

english: ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!
translation: 啊啊！拉响警报！船上偷渡者！船上偷渡者！ [a a ！ la xiang jing bao ！ chuan shang tou du zhe ！ chuan shang tou du zhe ！]

english: No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
translation: 不！我不是偷渡者！诚实的！我被邀请来到这里！ [bu ！ wo bu shi tou du zhe ！ cheng shi de ！ wo bei yao qing lai dao zhe li ！]

english: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
translation: 哦，抱歉，那是我的错误。 [o ， bao qian ， na shi wo de cuo wu 。]

english: You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.
translation: 但你必须承认你看起来确实很像一个偷渡者。 [dan ni bi xu cheng ren ni kan qi lai que shi hen xiang yi ge tou du zhe 。]

english: Why, what do they usually look like?
translation: 为什么，他们通常是什么样子？ [wei shen me ， ta men tong chang shi shen me yang zi ？]

english: Erm... I've never actually met one...
translation: 呃……我从来没有真正见过一个…… [e …… wo cong lai mei you zhen zheng jian guo yi ge ……]

english: Okay then...
translation: 好吧，那么... [hao ba ， na me ...]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: So... You're a pirate, huh?
translation: 那么...你是海盗，是吧？ [na me ... ni shi hai dao ， shi ba ？]

english: It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.
translation: 月底我的工资单上就是这么写的。 [yue di wo de gong zi dan shang jiu shi zhe me xie de 。]

english: How's that working out for you?
translation: 你感觉怎么样？ [ni gan jue zen me yang ？]

english: Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.
translation: 到目前为止还不错。我们可以掠夺的所有烈酒和战利品，再加上包括牙科在内的全套医疗服务。 [dao mu qian wei zhi hai bu cuo 。 wo men ke yi lve duo de suo you lie jiu he zhan li pin ， zai jia shang bao kuo ya ke zai nei de quan tao yi liao fu wu 。]

english: You mean you have insurance?
translation: 你是说你有保险？ [ni shi shuo ni you bao xian ？]

english: Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.
translation: 不是这样的。如果我们中的任何一个人生病了，我们就会绑架一名医生，直到我们病情好转之前不让他走。 [bu shi zhe yang de 。 ru guo wo men zhong de ren he yi ge ren sheng bing le ， wo men jiu hui bang jia yi ming yi sheng ， zhi dao wo men bing qing hao zhuan zhi qian bu rang ta zou 。]

english: You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.
translation: 您会惊讶地发现，这对于专家医疗保健来说是多么大的激励。 [nin hui jing ya di fa xian ， zhe dui yu zhuan jia yi liao bao jian lai shuo shi duo me da de ji li 。]

english: I can imagine.
translation: 我可以想象。 [wo ke yi xiang xiang 。]

english: Hello there. So what brings you aboard the Lady Zay?
translation: 你好呀。那么是什么让您登上了 Lady Zay 号呢？ [ni hao ya 。 na me shi shen me rang nin deng shang le  Lady Zay  hao ne ？]

english: Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.
translation: 嗯，我原本打算去拜访月族，但我不得不说你们的船非常令人印象深刻。 [n ， wo yuan ben da suan qu bai fang yue zu ， dan wo bu de bu shuo ni men de chuan fei chang ling ren yin xiang shen ke 。]

english: Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!
translation: 是啊，果然是个美女啊！扎伊女士酒店一直是我的家，度过了许多艰难的几个月，经历了暴风雨和阳光，她总是带我们到达我们要去的地方！ [shi a ， guo ran shi ge mei nv a ！ zha yi nv shi jiu dian yi zhi shi wo de jia ， du guo le xu duo jian nan de ji ge yue ， jing li le bao feng yu he yang guang ， ta zong shi dai wo men dao da wo men yao qu de di fang ！]

english: Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!
translation: 是的，她确实是我旅行中见过的最好的船之一！ [shi de ， ta que shi shi wo lv xing zhong jian guo de zui hao de chuan zhi yi ！]

english: That she is [lad/lass], that she is.
translation: 她是[小伙子/姑娘]，她就是。 [ta shi [ xiao huo zi / gu niang ]， ta jiu shi 。]

english: Ah, 'tis a foine day to be sure! Were yez wantin' me to store yer tools, or maybe ye might be wantin' yer stuff back from me?
translation: 啊，这确实是美好的一天！你们是想让我存放你们的工具，还是你们想从我这里拿回你们的东西？ [a ， zhe que shi shi mei hao de yi tian ！ ni men shi xiang rang wo cun fang ni men de gong ju ， hai shi ni men xiang cong wo zhe li na hui ni men de dong xi ？]

english: Why are you here in Weiss?
translation: 你为什么在韦斯？ [ni wei shen me zai wei si ？]

english: An' why would I not be here? Now that there be farming patches, there'll be folk needing a leprechaun to hold their stuff! So, dod ye want to be using the store?
translation: 为什么我不在这里？现在有了农田，就会有人需要小妖精来保管他们的东西！那么，您想使用这家商店吗？ [wei shen me wo bu zai zhe li ？ xian zai you le nong tian ， jiu hui you ren xu yao xiao yao jing lai bao guan ta men de dong xi ！ na me ， nin xiang shi yong zhe jia shang dian ma ？]

english: Can you tell me about the Lost City?
translation: 你能告诉我关于失落之城的事吗？ [ni neng gao su wo guan yu shi luo zhi cheng de shi ma ？]

english: Nay, ye be wantin' to ask Shamus if ye wants to know about the Lost City. He be living up a tree somewhere near Draynor Village. Last I heard he were wailin' about some biggun tryin' to chop his tree down!
translation: 不，你们想问Shamus是否想了解失落之城。他住在德雷诺村附近的一棵树上。上次我听说他在哀嚎有大佬试图砍倒他的树！ [bu ， ni men xiang wen Shamus shi fou xiang liao jie shi luo zhi cheng 。 ta zhu zai de lei nuo cun fu jin de yi ke shu shang 。 shang ci wo ting shuo ta zai ai hao you da lao shi tu kan dao ta de shu ！]

english: What can you store?
translation: 你可以储存什么？ [ni ke yi chu cun shen me ？]

english: We'll hold onto yer rake, yer seed dibber, yer spade, yer secateurs, yer waterin' can and yer trowel - but mind it's not one of them fancy trowels only archaeologists use!
translation: 我们会握住你的耙子、你的播种机、你的铁锹、你的剪枝器、你的喷壶和你的抹子——但请注意，这不是只有考古学家才使用的奇特抹子！ [wo men hui wo zhu ni de pa zi 、 ni de bo zhong ji 、 ni de tie qiao 、 ni de jian zhi qi 、 ni de pen hu he ni de mo zi —— dan qing zhu yi ， zhe bu shi zhi you kao gu xue jia cai shi yong de qi te mo zi ！]

english: We'll take a few buckets off yer hands too, and even yer compost, supercompost an' ultracompost! Also plant cure vials.
translation: 我们也会从你手中拿走几桶，甚至你的堆肥，超级堆肥和超级堆肥！还有植物治疗瓶。 [wo men ye hui cong ni shou zhong na zou ji tong ， shen zhi ni de dui fei ， chao ji dui fei he chao ji dui fei ！ hai you zhi wu zhi liao ping 。]

english: Aside from that, if ye hands me yer farming produce, I can mebbe change it into banknotes for ye.
translation: 另外，如果你把农产品交给我，我可以给你换成钞票。 [ling wai ， ru guo ni ba nong chan pin jiao gei wo ， wo ke yi gei ni huan cheng chao piao 。]

english: So... do ye want to be using the store?
translation: 那么...您想使用商店吗？ [na me ... nin xiang shi yong shang dian ma ？]

english: What do you do with the tools you're storing? They can't possibly all fit in your pockets!
translation: 您如何处理您存储的工具？它们不可能全部装进你的口袋！ [nin ru he chu li nin cun chu de gong ju ？ ta men bu ke neng quan bu zhuang jin ni de kou dai ！]

english: We leprechauns have a shed where we keep 'em. It's a magic shed, so ye can get yer items back from any of us leprechauns whenever ye want. Saves ye havin' to carry loads of stuff around the country!
translation: 我们小妖精有一个棚子来饲养它们。这是一个魔法棚，所以你可以随时从我们任何一个小妖精那里拿回你的物品。省去了您在全国各地携带大量物品的麻烦！ [wo men xiao yao jing you yi ge peng zi lai si yang ta men 。 zhe shi yi ge mo fa peng ， suo yi ni ke yi sui shi cong wo men ren he yi ge xiao yao jing na li na hui ni de wu pin 。 sheng qu le nin zai quan guo ge di xie dai da liang wu pin de ma fan ！]

english: No thanks, I'll keep hold of my stuff.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我会保留我的东西。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo hui bao liu wo de dong xi 。]

english: Ye must be dafter than ye look if ye likes luggin' yer tools everywhere ye goes!
translation: 如果你喜欢随身携带工具，那么你一定比看起来更笨！ [ru guo ni xi huan sui shen xie dai gong ju ， na me ni yi ding bi kan qi lai geng ben ！]

english: Nay, I've got no banknotes to exchange for that item.
translation: 不，我没有纸币可以兑换该物品。 [bu ， wo mei you zhi bi ke yi dui huan gai wu pin 。]

english: Nay, there's no such thing as a banknote for that.
translation: 不，没有钞票这样的东西。 [bu ， mei you chao piao zhe yang de dong xi 。]

english: That IS a banknote!
translation: 那是一张钞票！ [na shi yi zhang chao piao ！]

english: A cabbage? Don't ye go showing me yer cabbage; this whole farm stinks of the things! Take it away and get it exchanged somewhere else.
translation: 卷心菜？别给我看你的卷心菜；整个农场都散发着恶臭！把它拿走并在其他地方交换。 [juan xin cai ？ bie gei wo kan ni de juan xin cai ； zheng ge nong chang dou san fa zhe e chou ！ ba ta na zou bing zai qi ta di fang jiao huan 。]

english: Ye did foine, yer'll be wanting this!
translation: 你确实这么做了，你会想要这个！ [ni que shi zhe me zuo le ， ni hui xiang yao zhe ge ！]

english: Why are you here in Weiss?
translation: 你为什么在韦斯？ [ni wei shen me zai wei si ？]

english: Can you tell me about the Lost City?
translation: 你能告诉我关于失落之城的事吗？ [ni neng gao su wo guan yu shi luo zhi cheng de shi ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: What can you store?
translation: 你可以储存什么？ [ni ke yi chu cun shen me ？]

english: What do you do with the tools you're storing?
translation: 您如何处理您存储的工具？ [nin ru he chu li nin cun chu de gong ju ？]

english: No thanks, I'll keep hold of my stuff.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我会保留我的东西。 [bu yong le ， xie xie ， wo hui bao liu wo de dong xi 。]

english: Aye, top o' th' mornin' to ya! Are ye wantin' help with th' tool store?
translation: 是的，早上好！您需要工具店的帮助吗？ [shi de ， zao shang hao ！ nin xu yao gong ju dian de bang zhu ma ？]

english: Why are you sunbathing up a mountain?
translation: 为什么要上山晒太阳？ [wei shen me yao shang shan shai tai yang ？]

english: We tool leprechauns work hard, that we do. An' nary a penny do we get in return. So ye cannae begrudge me mah holiday an' a wee drink or twelve!
translation: 我们工具妖精们努力工作，我们确实这么做了。我们一分钱也得不到回报。所以你们不能嫉妒我在假期喝一杯或十二杯！ [wo men gong ju yao jing men nu li gong zuo ， wo men que shi zhe me zuo le 。 wo men yi fen qian ye de bu dao hui bao 。 suo yi ni men bu neng ji du wo zai jia qi he yi bei huo shi er bei ！]

english: Yes, very nice, but why are you sunbathing up a mountain? Surely a beach would be more appropriate?
translation: 是的，很好，但是你为什么要上山晒日光浴呢？海滩肯定更合适吧？ [shi de ， hen hao ， dan shi ni wei shen me yao shang shan shai ri guang yu ne ？ hai tan ken ding geng he shi ba ？]

english: Ahh, but I likes th' ruggedy mountain, ye see. Also, I ha' a terrible allergy to sand.
translation: 啊，但我喜欢那座崎岖不平的山，你瞧。另外，我对沙子严重过敏。 [a ， dan wo xi huan na zuo qi qu bu ping de shan ， ni qiao 。 ling wai ， wo dui sha zi yan zhong guo min 。]

english: Fair enough, I suppose.
translation: 我想这很公平。 [wo xiang zhe hen gong ping 。]

english: So were ye wantin' help with th' tool store?
translation: 那么您需要工具店的帮助吗？ [na me nin xu yao gong ju dian de bang zhu ma ？]

english: Would you like to trade?
translation: 您想交易吗？ [nin xiang jiao yi ma ？]

english: Ach! Can ye no' leave a body to ha' a little peace? Very well, I have a bit o' stuff to trade with ye. But don't be expectin' yerself any discounts.
translation: 啊！你们能不能让身体得到一点平静？很好，我有一些东西可以和你们交易。但不要指望自己会有任何折扣。 [a ！ ni men neng bu neng rang shen ti de dao yi dian ping jing ？ hen hao ， wo you yi xie dong xi ke yi he ni men jiao yi 。 dan bu yao zhi wang zi ji hui you ren he zhe kou 。]

english: Are you going to move that other deckchair?
translation: 你要搬走另一张躺椅吗？ [ni yao ban zou ling yi zhang tang yi ma ？]

english: An' get ambushed by that damn bird again? Nae, I'll be keeping my distance, thank ye very much!
translation: 又被那只该死的鸟伏击了？嗯，我会保持距离，非常感谢！ [you bei na zhi gai si de niao fu ji le ？ n ， wo hui bao chi ju li ， fei chang gan xie ！]

english: Plus, if ye've got a farmin' patch up 'ere, th' union boys'll want me posted nearer it.
translation: 另外，如果你们这里有一个农业补丁，工会的男孩们会希望我把它贴近它。 [ling wai ， ru guo ni men zhe li you yi ge nong ye bu ding ， gong hui de nan hai men hui xi wang wo ba ta tie jin ta 。]

english: I'm not one of them farmin' leprechauns! I don't want yer garbage!
translation: 我不是他们中饲养小妖精的人之一！我不要你的垃圾！ [wo bu shi ta men zhong si yang xiao yao jing de ren zhi yi ！ wo bu yao ni de la ji ！]

english: Why are you sunbathing up a mountain?
translation: 为什么要上山晒太阳？ [wei shen me yao shang shan shai tai yang ？]

english: Would you like to trade?
translation: 您想交易吗？ [nin xiang jiao yi ma ？]

english: Are you going to move that other deckchair?
translation: 你要搬走另一张躺椅吗？ [ni yao ban zou ling yi zhang tang yi ma ？]

english: Aye? What do ye need?
translation: 是吗？你们需要什么？ [shi ma ？ ni men xu yao shen me ？]

english: Tell me about this mine.
translation: 跟我说说这个矿吧。 [gen wo shuo shuo zhe ge kuang ba 。]

english: 's a sulphur mine. Ye get sulphur here. For making the dynamite, ye know? Folks use it in the blast mine. Watch the poison gas clouds, though - they'll choke ye.
translation: 是一座硫磺矿。你们在这里得到硫磺。为了制造炸药，你知道吗？人们在爆破矿井中使用它。不过要小心毒气云——它们会窒息你的。 [shi yi zuo liu huang kuang 。 ni men zai zhe li de dao liu huang 。 wei le zhi zao zha yao ， ni zhi dao ma ？ ren men zai bao po kuang jing zhong shi yong ta 。 bu guo yao xiao xin du qi yun —— ta men hui zhi xi ni de 。]

english: Grab yerself a pickaxe if ye wants to mine some sulphur. Make sure ye keeps yer mouth an' nose covered too.
translation: 如果你想开采一些硫磺，就拿起一把镐。确保你也捂住你的嘴和鼻子。 [ru guo ni xiang kai cai yi xie liu huang ， jiu na qi yi ba gao 。 que bao ni ye wu zhu ni de zui he bi zi 。]

english: What have you got to trade?
translation: 你有什么可以交易的？ [ni you shen me ke yi jiao yi de ？]

english: Pickaxes. For the mining. An' pots to make dynamite in.
translation: 镐。用于采矿。一个用来制作炸药的罐子。 [gao 。 yong yu cai kuang 。 yi ge yong lai zhi zuo zha yao de guan zi 。]

english: Why are you called Toothy?
translation: 你为什么叫图蒂？ [ni wei shen me jiao tu di ？]

english: 'Cos of my teeth.
translation: 因为我的牙齿。 [yin wei wo de ya chi 。]

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我就走了。 [wo jiu zou le 。]

english: Tell me about this mine.
translation: 跟我说说这个矿吧。 [gen wo shuo shuo zhe ge kuang ba 。]

english: What have you got to trade?
translation: 你有什么可以交易的？ [ni you shen me ke yi jiao yi de ？]

english: Why are you called Toothy?
translation: 你为什么叫图蒂？ [ni wei shen me jiao tu di ？]

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我就走了。 [wo jiu zou le 。]

english: You dare disturb my rest!
translation: 你居然敢打扰我休息！ [ni ju ran gan da rao wo xiu xi ！]

english: You dare steal from us!
translation: 你竟然敢偷我们的东西！ [ni jing ran gan tou wo men de dong xi ！]

english: YOU ARE A TERRIBLE BARD!
translation: 你是个糟糕的吟游诗人！ [ni shi ge zao gao de yin you shi ren ！]

english: Don't give up your day job outerlander!
translation: 不要放弃你的日常工作外地人！ [bu yao fang qi ni de ri chang gong zuo wai di ren ！]

english: I thought somebody was murdering a cat!
translation: 我以为有人谋杀了一只猫！ [wo yi wei you ren mou sha le yi zhi mao ！]

english: You know, I actually quite liked that verse...
translation: 你知道，我其实很喜欢这首诗...... [ni zhi dao ， wo qi shi hen xi huan zhe shou shi ......]

english: That's kind of catchy. Irritating. But catchy.
translation: 这有点吸引人。令人恼火。但很吸引人。 [zhe you dian xi yin ren 。 ling ren nao huo 。 dan hen xi yin ren 。]

english: Hey, I've done that quest too!
translation: 嘿嘿，这个任务我也做过！ [hei hei ， zhe ge ren wu wo ye zuo guo ！]

english: I have produced better sounds in the outhouse!
translation: 我在室外发出了更好的声音！ [wo zai shi wai fa chu le geng hao de sheng yin ！]

english: Your song makes no sense outerlander!
translation: 你的歌毫无意义，外地人！ [ni de ge hao wu yi yi ， wai di ren ！]

english: What kind of bard are you anyway?
translation: 你到底是哪种吟游诗人？ [ni dao di shi na zhong yin you shi ren ？]

english: I have met cows more musical than you!
translation: 我见过比你更有音乐天赋的牛！ [wo jian guo bi ni geng you yin yue tian fu de niu ！]

english: When do you get to the good parts?
translation: 你什么时候能看到好的部分？ [ni shen me shi hou neng kan dao hao de bu fen ？]

english: would torture us so, outerlander?
translation: 会这样折磨我们吗，外来者？ [hui zhe yang zhe mo wo men ma ， wai lai zhe ？]

english: Truly, this is the worst sound I have ever heard!
translation: 确实，这是我听过的最糟糕的声音！ [que shi ， zhe shi wo ting guo de zui zao gao de sheng yin ！]

english: looting and drinking part?
translation: 抢劫和饮酒部分？ [qiang jie he yin jiu bu fen ？]

english: Please tell me that was the last verse...
translation: 请告诉我这是最后一首诗... [qing gao su wo zhe shi zui hou yi shou shi ...]

english: Please... Kill me now...
translation: 拜托...现在就杀了我... [bai tuo ... xian zai jiu sha le wo ...]

english: You call THAT singing?
translation: 你管这叫唱歌？ [ni guan zhe jiao chang ge ？]

english: Never before have mine ears been so offended!
translation: 我的耳朵从来没有这么不舒服过！ [wo de er duo cong lai mei you zhe me bu shu fu guo ！]

english: Worst. Bard. EVER.
translation: 最糟糕的。诗人。曾经。 [zui zao gao de 。 shi ren 。 ceng jing 。]

english: Please, ye gods! Make it stop!
translation: 拜托各位大神了！让它停下来！ [bai tuo ge wei da shen le ！ rang ta ting xia lai ！]

english: If you stopped singing
translation: 如果你停止唱歌 [ru guo ni ting zhi chang ge]

english: The screams of my dying comrades sound better!
translation: 我死去的战友的尖叫声听起来更好听！ [wo si qu de zhan you de jian jiao sheng ting qi lai geng hao ting ！]

english: My grandmother could do better, and she is dead!
translation: 我的祖母本可以做得更好，但她已经死了！ [wo de zu mu ben ke yi zuo de geng hao ， dan ta yi jing si le ！]

english: I do such feats before breakfast!
translation: 我在早餐前就做了这样的事！ [wo zai zao can qian jiu zuo le zhe yang de shi ！]

english: Is your singing some kind of outerlander weapon?
translation: 你的歌声是某种外来武器吗？ [ni de ge sheng shi mou zhong wai lai wu qi ma ？]

english: Watch yourself, outerlander.
translation: 小心点，外地人。 [xiao xin dian ， wai di ren 。]

english: Good day to you, [Fremennik name].
translation: 祝你美好一天，[弗雷曼尼克名字]。 [zhu ni mei hao yi tian ，[ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。]

english: Good day to you [Fremennik name]. Do you want to go to Ungael?
translation: 祝你美好的一天[弗雷曼尼克名字]。你想去安加尔吗？ [zhu ni mei hao de yi tian [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 ni xiang qu an jia er ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Player is transported to Ungael
translation: 玩家被传送到安加尔 [wan jia bei chuan song dao an jia er]

english: Do you have any of my items?
translation: 你有我的物品吗？ [ni you wo de wu pin ma ？]

english: I do have some of your items here [Fremennik name]. Try not to lose them next time.
translation: 我这里确实有你的一些物品[弗里曼尼克名字]。下次尽量不要失去它们。 [wo zhe li que shi you ni de yi xie wu pin [ fu li man ni ke ming zi ]。 xia ci jin liang bu yao shi qu ta men 。]

english: I'm afraid not [Fremennik name]. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: 恐怕不是[弗雷曼尼克名字]。如果我确实拥有你的任何物品，但你在收集它们之前就死了，那么它们现在就会丢失。 [kong pa bu shi [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 ru guo wo que shi yong you ni de ren he wu pin ， dan ni zai shou ji ta men zhi qian jiu si le ， na me ta men xian zai jiu hui diu shi 。]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Well met [Fremennik name]. Do you want to return to Rellekka?
translation: 很高兴认识[弗雷曼尼克名字]。您想返回雷莱卡吗？ [hen gao xing ren shi [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 nin xiang fan hui lei lai ka ma ？]

english: Player is transported to Rellekka
translation: 玩家被传送到雷莱卡 [wan jia bei chuan song dao lei lai ka]

english: I'm afraid I don't have anything for you [Fremennik name]. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: 恐怕我没有任何东西可以给你[弗雷曼尼克名字]。如果我确实拥有你的任何物品，但你在收集它们之前就死了，那么它们现在就会丢失。 [kong pa wo mei you ren he dong xi ke yi gei ni [ fu lei man ni ke ming zi ]。 ru guo wo que shi yong you ni de ren he wu pin ， dan ni zai shou ji ta men zhi qian jiu si le ， na me ta men xian zai jiu hui diu shi 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Do you have any of my items?
translation: 你有我的物品吗？ [ni you wo de wu pin ma ？]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hi there. So much to see here!
translation: 你好呀。这里有太多值得一看的东西！ [ni hao ya 。 zhe li you tai duo zhi de yi kan de dong xi ！]

english: Yep, could be looking all day!
translation: 是的，可能会看一整天！ [shi de ， ke neng hui kan yi zheng tian ！]

english: Updated any displays yet?
translation: 更新了任何显示吗？ [geng xin le ren he xian shi ma ？]

english: Yes, I just learned more about some priestly warriors and a staff of the gods.
translation: 是的，我刚刚了解了更多关于一些祭司战士和神杖的信息。 [shi de ， wo gang gang liao jie le geng duo guan yu yi xie ji si zhan shi he shen zhang de xin xi 。]

english: Sounds fun, how did you do that?
translation: 听起来很有趣，你是怎么做到的？ [ting qi lai hen you qu ， ni shi zen me zuo dao de ？]

english: Ahh, I'm big on quests me, love questing. So when I've done one, I check here with 'Historian' Minas to see if I can help the Museum out with some information. Sometimes they already know it, or don't want to know,
translation: 啊，我很热衷于探索，喜欢探索。因此，当我完成一项工作后，我会与“历史学家”米纳斯联系，看看我是否可以帮助博物馆提供一些信息。有时他们已经知道，或者不想知道， [a ， wo hen re zhong yu tan suo ， xi huan tan suo 。 yin ci ， dang wo wan cheng yi xiang gong zuo hou ， wo hui yu “ li shi xue jia ” mi na si lian xi ， kan kan wo shi fou ke yi bang zhu bo wu guan ti gong yi xie xin xi 。 you shi ta men yi jing zhi dao ， huo zhe bu xiang zhi dao ，]

english: and sometimes it earns me a reward or two.
translation: 有时它会给我带来一两个奖励。 [you shi ta hui gei wo dai lai yi liang ge jiang li 。]

english: That sounds really good. Perhaps I should do the same!
translation: 听起来确实不错。也许我也应该这样做！ [ting qi lai que shi bu cuo 。 ye xu wo ye ying gai zhe yang zuo ！]

english: You should, as well as everything else there is here in the Museum. Did you know they have a really fun- looking display down in the basement? I love monkeys.
translation: 您应该，以及博物馆里的其他一切。你知道他们在地下室有一个看起来非常有趣的展示吗？我喜欢猴子。 [nin ying gai ， yi ji bo wu guan li de qi ta yi qie 。 ni zhi dao ta men zai di xia shi you yi ge kan qi lai fei chang you qu de zhan shi ma ？ wo xi huan hou zi 。]

english: I'll check it out. Got to get going now, nice talking to you.
translation: 我会检查一下。现在得走了，很高兴与你交谈。 [wo hui jian cha yi xia 。 xian zai de zou le ， hen gao xing yu ni jiao tan 。]

english: Have a good day!
translation: 祝你有美好的一天！ [zhu ni you mei hao de yi tian ！]

english: Hi there!
translation: 你好呀！ [ni hao ya ！]

english: Hello, what are you doing here?
translation: 你好，你在这里做什么？ [ni hao ， ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Oh, just taking a look at these displays. I'm a bit of a history buff.
translation: 哦，只是看看这些展示。我有点历史爱好者。 [o ， zhi shi kan kan zhe xie zhan shi 。 wo you dian li shi ai hao zhe 。]

english: Really? Tell me something I didn't know!
translation: 真的吗？告诉我一些我不知道的事情！ [zhen de ma ？ gao su wo yi xie wo bu zhi dao de shi qing ！]

english: Well, did you know that Bob the Cat is... no, no... you'd never believe me anyway.
translation: 好吧，你知道鲍勃猫是……不，不……无论如何你永远不会相信我。 [hao ba ， ni zhi dao bao bo mao shi …… bu ， bu …… wu lun ru he ni yong yuan bu hui xiang xin wo 。]

english: He's what? Tell me!
translation: 他是什么？告诉我！ [ta shi shen me ？ gao su wo ！]

english: No, no. Couldn't possibly ruin the surprise.
translation: 不，不。不可能破坏这个惊喜。 [bu ， bu 。 bu ke neng po huai zhe ge jing xi 。]

english: ARG! Tell me!
translation: ARG！告诉我！ [ARG！ gao su wo ！]

english: If you really want to know, go talk to Unferth in his house in Burthorpe.
translation: 如果你真的想知道，可以去 Unferth 位于 Burthorpe 的家里与他交谈。 [ru guo ni zhen de xiang zhi dao ， ke yi qu  Unferth  wei yu  Burthorpe  de jia li yu ta jiao tan 。]

english: Hi!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Oh, hello. I was just looking at this display here.
translation: 哦，你好。我只是在这里看这个展示。 [o ， ni hao 。 wo zhi shi zai zhe li kan zhe ge zhan shi 。]

english: Anything interesting?
translation: 有什么有趣的吗？ [you shen me you qu de ma ？]

english: Yes, one I just updated by talking to 'Historian' Minas. I'm a bit of a quester you see.
translation: 是的，我刚刚通过与“历史学家”米纳斯交谈而更新了这一点。你看，我有点像一个探索者。 [shi de ， wo gang gang tong guo yu “ li shi xue jia ” mi na si jiao tan er geng xin le zhe yi dian 。 ni kan ， wo you dian xiang yi ge tan suo zhe 。]

english: Okay, I'll let you get on then.
translation: 好吧，那我就让你上车了。 [hao ba ， na wo jiu rang ni shang che le 。]

english: Hmm, yes. Okay. Don't forget to check out the Natural History exhibit - you could learn a lot.
translation: 嗯，是的。好的。不要忘记参观自然历史展览 - 您可以学到很多东西。 [n ， shi de 。 hao de 。 bu yao wang ji can guan zi ran li shi zhan lan  -  nin ke yi xue dao hen duo dong xi 。]

english: Right, bye!
translation: 对了，再见！ [dui le ， zai jian ！]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Hi, have you seen the Dig Site displays?
translation: 你好，你看过挖掘现场的展示吗？ [ni hao ， ni kan guo wa jue xian chang de zhan shi ma ？]

english: Yes, good aren't they! Have you done the quest?
translation: 是的，他们不是很好吗！你完成任务了吗？ [shi de ， ta men bu shi hen hao ma ！ ni wan cheng ren wu le ma ？]

english: Not yet.
translation: 还没有。 [hai mei you 。]

english: Oh you should, it lets you get into that bit where they clean the finds, and you can join in!
translation: 哦，你应该这样做，它可以让你进入他们清理发现物的地方，你可以加入！ [o ， ni ying gai zhe yang zuo ， ta ke yi rang ni jin ru ta men qing li fa xian wu de di fang ， ni ke yi jia ru ！]

english: Sounds fun, I should probably check it out.
translation: 听起来很有趣，我应该去看看。 [ting qi lai hen you qu ， wo ying gai qu kan kan 。]

english: Yes, I did it all.
translation: 是的，我都做了。 [shi de ， wo dou zuo le 。]

english: Did you know after the quest you can get the teddy bear back by stealing it from the female student?
translation: 你知道任务结束后你可以从女学生那里偷走泰迪熊吗？ [ni zhi dao ren wu jie shu hou ni ke yi cong nv xue sheng na li tou zou tai di xiong ma ？]

english: I shall have to try that sometime.
translation: 有时间我得试试。 [you shi jian wo de shi shi 。]

english: Hmm... 3rd Age.... No, no...maybe 4th...
translation: 嗯...第三纪...不，不...也许是第四纪... [n ... di san ji ... bu ， bu ... ye xu shi di si ji ...]

english: Hello?
translation: 你好？ [ni hao ？]

english: Yes, that's it, just like that. Mustn't forget the map either....hmm...what else?
translation: 是的，就是这样，就这样。也不能忘记地图……嗯……还有什么？ [shi de ， jiu shi zhe yang ， jiu zhe yang 。 ye bu neng wang ji di tu …… n …… hai you shen me ？]

english: HELLO! Are you there?
translation: 你好！你在吗？ [ni hao ！ ni zai ma ？]

english: Oh, hello there. Sorry, was a bit engrosed in updating this display. I've just been out questing and thought I'd stop off here you see. It's quite rewarding too.
translation: 哦，你好。抱歉，我有点全神贯注于更新此显示。我刚刚出去探索，想在这里停下来，你瞧。也是相当有收获的。 [o ， ni hao 。 bao qian ， wo you dian quan shen guan zhu yu geng xin ci xian shi 。 wo gang gang chu qu tan suo ， xiang zai zhe li ting xia lai ， ni qiao 。 ye shi xiang dang you shou huo de 。]

english: Yes, well, no need to ignore me.
translation: 是的，好吧，没必要忽视我。 [shi de ， hao ba ， mei bi yao hu shi wo 。]

english: No offence intended, my dear chap. Just very interested in this history stuff, that's all.

english: A bit like the crazy gnomes and their gliders. Have you seen the model they have upstairs?

english: Yes, very intricate isn't it? Worrying to think some people risk their lives in them! You wouldn't catch me up in one. Had a chat with Jacques while I was up there, the art critic...he's a bit funny in the head.

english: Who knows, the Museum just got really big and appears to have cash. They might entertain him with his very own floor - we'll see.
translation: 谁知道呢，博物馆变得非常大，而且似乎有现金。他们可能会用他自己的地板来招待他——我们拭目以待。 [shui zhi dao ne ， bo wu guan bian de fei chang da ， er qie si hu you xian jin 。 ta men ke neng hui yong ta zi ji de di ban lai zhao dai ta —— wo men shi mu yi dai 。]

english: I guess so. Wonder what poetry he'll come up with then! Still, I must get on with this display. See you around I hope!

english: I can't wait to visit the rest of the kingdom!

english: Surrounding us are four towers. Each tower contains trained archers of a different level. You'll notice it's quite a distance, so you'll need a longbow.

translation: 看来你的技术很精湛，所以我建议你去西塔练习一下。这将为您提供最好的挑战。 [kan lai ni de ji shu hen jing zhan ， suo yi wo jian yi ni qu xi ta lian xi yi xia 。 zhe jiang wei nin ti gong zui hao de tiao zhan 。]

english: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这附近做什么？ [ni zai zhe fu jin zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm a Town Crier. It's my job to let people know of any recent news. After all, there's all sorts of things happening around here.
translation: 我是一名城市公告员。我的工作是让人们了解最近的新闻。毕竟，这里正在发生各种各样的事情。 [wo shi yi ming cheng shi gong gao yuan 。 wo de gong zuo shi rang ren men liao jie zui jin de xin wen 。 bi jing ， zhe li zheng zai fa sheng ge zhong ge yang de shi qing 。]

english: See you later.

english: Hear ye! Hear ye! Player Moderators massive help to RuneSc-
translation: 听你们说！听你们说！玩家版主对 RuneSc 提供了巨大帮助- [ting ni men shuo ！ ting ni men shuo ！ wan jia ban zhu dui  RuneSc  ti gong le ju da bang zhu -]

english: Oh, hello citizen. Are you here to find out about Player Moderators? Or perhaps would you like to know about the laws of the land?
translation: 噢，公民你好。您来这里是为了了解玩家版主吗？或者也许您想了解该国的法律？ [o ， gong min ni hao 。 nin lai zhe li shi wei le liao jie wan jia ban zhu ma ？ huo zhe ye xu nin xiang liao jie gai guo de fa lv ？]

english: Tell me about Player Moderators.
translation: 告诉我有关玩家版主的信息。 [gao su wo you guan wan jia ban zhu de xin xi 。]

english: Of course. What would you like to know?
translation: 当然。您想知道什么？ [dang ran 。 nin xiang zhi dao shen me ？]

english: What is a Player Moderator?
translation: 什么是玩家版主？ [shen me shi wan jia ban zhu ？]

english: Player Moderators are normal players of the game, just like you. However, since they have shown themselves to be trustworthy and active reporters, they have been invited by Jagex to monitor the game and
translation: 玩家版主是游戏的普通玩家，就像您一样。然而，由于他们表现出了自己是值得信赖和活跃的记者，因此受到 Jagex 的邀请来监视比赛并 [wan jia ban zhu shi you xi de pu tong wan jia ， jiu xiang nin yi yang 。 ran er ， you yu ta men biao xian chu le zi ji shi zhi de xin lai he huo yue de ji zhe ， yin ci shou dao  Jagex  de yao qing lai jian shi bi sai bing]

english: take appropriate action when they see rule breaking. You can spot a Player Moderator in game by looking at the chat screen - when a Player Moderator speaks, a silver crown appears to the left of their name.
translation: 当他们发现违规行为时采取适当的行动。您可以通过查看聊天屏幕来在游戏中找到玩家主持人 - 当玩家主持人讲话时，他们的名字左侧会出现一个银色皇冠。 [dang ta men fa xian wei gui xing wei shi cai qu shi dang de xing dong 。 nin ke yi tong guo cha kan liao tian ping mu lai zai you xi zhong zhao dao wan jia zhu chi ren  -  dang wan jia zhu chi ren jiang hua shi ， ta men de ming zi zuo ce hui chu xian yi ge yin se huang guan 。]

english: Remember, if there's not silver crown there, they are not a Player Moderator!
translation: 请记住，如果那里没有银冠，他们就不是玩家版主！ [qing ji zhu ， ru guo na li mei you yin guan ， ta men jiu bu shi wan jia ban zhu ！]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: Is there anything else you'd like to know?
translation: 您还有什么想知道的吗？ [nin hai you shen me xiang zhi dao de ma ？]

english: What can Player Moderators do?
translation: 玩家版主可以做什么？ [wan jia ban zhu ke yi zuo shen me ？]

english: Player Moderators, or 'P-mods', have the ability to mute rule breakers and Jagex view their reports as a priority so that action is taken as quickly as possible. P- Mods also have access to the Player Moderator Centre.
translation: 玩家版主（或“P-mods”）能够让规则破坏者静音，Jagex 将他们的报告视为优先事项，以便尽快采取行动。 P-Mods 还可以访问玩家管理员中心。 [wan jia ban zhu （ huo “P-mods”） neng gou rang gui ze po huai zhe jing yin ，Jagex  jiang ta men de bao gao shi wei you xian shi xiang ， yi bian jin kuai cai qu xing dong 。 P-Mods  hai ke yi fang wen wan jia guan li yuan zhong xin 。]

english: Within the Centre are tools to help them Moderate Old School RuneScape. These tools include dedicated forums, the Player Moderator Guidelines and the Player Moderator Code of Conduct.
translation: 中心内提供了帮助他们调节 Old School RuneScape 的工具。这些工具包括专门的论坛、玩家版主指南和玩家版主行为准则。 [zhong xin nei ti gong le bang zhu ta men tiao jie  Old School RuneScape  de gong ju 。 zhe xie gong ju bao kuo zhuan men de lun tan 、 wan jia ban zhu zhi nan he wan jia ban zhu xing wei zhun ze 。]

english: How do I become a Player Moderator?
translation: 我如何成为玩家版主？ [wo ru he cheng wei wan jia ban zhu ？]

english: Jagex picks players who spend their time and effort to help better the Old School RuneScape community. To increase your chances of becoming a Player Moderator:
translation: Jagex 挑选那些花费时间和精力来帮助改善 Old School RuneScape 社区的玩家。要增加成为玩家版主的机会： [Jagex  tiao xuan na xie hua fei shi jian he jing li lai bang zhu gai shan  Old School RuneScape  she qu de wan jia 。 yao zeng jia cheng wei wan jia ban zhu de ji hui ：]

english: Keep your account secure! This is very important, as a player with poor security will never be a P-Mod. Read our Security Tips for more information.
translation: 确保您的帐户安全！这一点非常重要，因为安全性差的玩家永远不可能成为 P-Mod。请阅读我们的安全提示以获取更多信息。 [que bao nin de zhang hu an quan ！ zhe yi dian fei chang zhong yao ， yin wei an quan xing cha de wan jia yong yuan bu ke neng cheng wei  P-Mod。 qing yue du wo men de an quan ti shi yi huo qu geng duo xin xi 。]

english: Play by the rules! The rules of Old School RuneScape are enforced for a reason, to make the game a fair and enjoyable environment for all.
translation: 遵守规则！ Old School RuneScape 的规则的执行是有原因的，目的是为所有人提供一个公平且愉快的游戏环境。 [zun shou gui ze ！ Old School RuneScape  de gui ze de zhi xing shi you yuan yin de ， mu di shi wei suo you ren ti gong yi ge gong ping qie yu kuai de you xi huan jing 。]

english: Report accurately! When Jagex consider an account for review they look for quality, not quantity. Ensure your reports are of a high quality by following the report guidelines.
translation: 准确举报！当 Jagex 考虑对帐户进行审核时，他们注重的是质量，而不是数量。遵循报告指南，确保您的报告具有高质量。 [zhun que ju bao ！ dang  Jagex  kao lv dui zhang hu jin xing shen he shi ， ta men zhu zhong de shi zhi liang ， er bu shi shu liang 。 zun xun bao gao zhi nan ， que bao nin de bao gao ju you gao zhi liang 。]

english: Be excellent to each other! Treat others as you would want to be treated yourself. Respect your fellow player.
translation: 彼此都要优秀！对待别人就像你希望别人对待你自己一样。尊重你的同伴。 [bi ci dou yao you xiu ！ dui dai bie ren jiu xiang ni xi wang bie ren dui dai ni zi ji yi yang 。 zun zhong ni de tong ban 。]

english: What can Player Moderators not do?
translation: 玩家版主不能做什么？ [wan jia ban zhu bu neng zuo shen me ？]

english: P-Mods cannot ban your account - they can only report offences. Jagex then take action based on the evidence received. If you lose your password or get scammed by another player, P-Mods cannot help you
translation: P-Mods 无法禁止您的帐户 - 他们只能举报违规行为。 Jagex 然后根据收到的证据采取行动。如果您丢失密码或被其他玩家诈骗，P-Mods 无法帮助您 [P-Mods  wu fa jin zhi nin de zhang hu  -  ta men zhi neng ju bao wei gui xing wei 。 Jagex  ran hou gen ju shou dao de zheng ju cai qu xing dong 。 ru guo nin diu shi mi ma huo bei qi ta wan jia zha pian ，P-Mods  wu fa bang zhu nin]

english: get your account back. All they can do is recommend you to go to Customer Support. They cannot retrieve any items you may have lost and receive no free items from Jagex for helping moderate the game. They are
translation: 找回你的帐户。他们所能做的就是建议您前往客户支持。他们无法找回您可能丢失的任何物品，也不会从 Jagex 收到用于帮助调节游戏的免费物品。他们是 [zhao hui ni de zhang hu 。 ta men suo neng zuo de jiu shi jian yi nin qian wang ke hu zhi chi 。 ta men wu fa zhao hui nin ke neng diu shi de ren he wu pin ， ye bu hui cong  Jagex  shou dao yong yu bang zhu tiao jie you xi de mian fei wu pin 。 ta men shi]

english: players who give their efforts to help the community out of the goodness of their hearts! P-mods do not work for Jagex and so cannot make you a Moderator, or recommend other accounts to become moderators. If
translation: 那些出于内心善良而付出努力帮助社会的玩家们！ P-mod 不适用于 Jagex，因此无法让您成为版主，或推荐其他帐户成为版主。如果 [na xie chu yu nei xin shan liang er fu chu nu li bang zhu she hui de wan jia men ！ P-mod  bu shi yong yu  Jagex， yin ci wu fa rang nin cheng wei ban zhu ， huo tui jian qi ta zhang hu cheng wei ban zhu 。 ru guo]

english: you wish to become a Moderator, please feel free to ask me how!
translation: 您想成为版主，请随时问我如何做！ [nin xiang cheng wei ban zhu ， qing sui shi wen wo ru he zuo ！]

english: Tell me about the Rules of Conduct.
translation: 告诉我有关行为规则的信息。 [gao su wo you guan xing wei gui ze de xin xi 。]

english: At once. Take a look at my book here...
translation: 立刻。在这里看看我的书... [li ke 。 zai zhe li kan kan wo de shu ...]

english: Can you give me a handy tip please?
translation: 您能给我一个方便的提示吗？ [nin neng gei wo yi ge fang bian de ti shi ma ？]

english: Did you know most skills have right click 'Make-X' options to help you train faster?
translation: 您是否知道大多数技能都具有右键“Make-X”选项来帮助您更快地训练？ [nin shi fou zhi dao da duo shu ji neng dou ju you you jian “Make-X” xuan xiang lai bang zhu nin geng kuai di xun lian ？]

english: Make your recovery questions and answers hard to guess but easy to remember.
translation: 让您的恢复问题和答案难以猜测但易于记住。 [rang nin de hui fu wen ti he da an nan yi cai ce dan yi yu ji zhu 。]

english: Don't use your RuneScape password on other sites. Keep your account safe!
translation: 不要在其他网站上使用您的 RuneScape 密码。确保您的帐户安全！ [bu yao zai qi ta wang zhan shang shi yong nin de  RuneScape  mi ma 。 que bao nin de zhang hu an quan ！]

english: If you think someone knows your password - change it!
translation: 如果您认为有人知道您的密码 - 请更改它！ [ru guo nin ren wei you ren zhi dao nin de mi ma  -  qing geng gai ta ！]

english: The squirrels! The squirrels are coming! Noooo, get them out of my head!
translation: 松鼠们！松鼠来了！不，把它们从我脑子里滚出去！ [song shu men ！ song shu lai le ！ bu ， ba ta men cong wo nao zi li gun chu qu ！]

english: Did you know you burn food less often on the range in Lumbridge castle than other ranges?
translation: 您是否知道在朗布里奇城堡的牧场上燃烧食物的频率比其他牧场少？ [nin shi fou zhi dao zai lang bu li qi cheng bao de mu chang shang ran shao shi wu de pin lv bi qi ta mu chang shao ？]

english: Players can not trim armour. Don't fall for this popular scam!
translation: 玩家无法修剪护甲。不要落入这种流行的骗局！ [wan jia wu fa xiu jian hu jia 。 bu yao luo ru zhe zhong liu xing de pian ju ！]

english: Feeling harassed? Don't forget your ignore list can be especially useful if a player seems to be picking on you!
translation: 感觉受到骚扰？不要忘记，如果玩家似乎在挑衅您，您的忽略列表会特别有用！ [gan jue shou dao sao rao ？ bu yao wang ji ， ru guo wan jia si hu zai tiao xin nin ， nin de hu lve lie biao hui te bie you yong ！]

english: If you're lost and have no idea where to go, use the Home Teleport spell for free!
translation: 如果您迷路了并且不知道该去哪里，请免费使用“Home Teleport”咒语！ [ru guo nin mi lu le bing qie bu zhi dao gai qu na li ， qing mian fei shi yong “Home Teleport” zhou yu ！]

english: If you see someone breaking the rules, report them!
translation: 如果您发现有人违反规则，请举报！ [ru guo nin fa xian you ren wei fan gui ze ， qing ju bao ！]

english: Did you know? Superheat Item means you never fail to smelt ore!
translation: 你可知道？过热物品意味着您永远不会无法熔炼矿石！ [ni ke zhi dao ？ guo re wu pin yi wei zhe nin yong yuan bu hui wu fa rong lian kuang shi ！]

english: Did you know that at high levels of Runecrafting you get more than one rune per essence?
translation: 您是否知道，在高级符文制作中，每种精华可以获得多个符文？ [nin shi fou zhi dao ， zai gao ji fu wen zhi zuo zhong ， mei zhong jing hua ke yi huo de duo ge fu wen ？]

english: Never lend your items out unless you expect them not to come back.
translation: 切勿将您的物品借出，除非您预计它们不会回来。 [qie wu jiang nin de wu pin jie chu ， chu fei nin yu ji ta men bu hui hui lai 。]

english: Never question a penguin.
translation: 永远不要质疑企鹅。 [yong yuan bu yao zhi yi qi e 。]

english: Melee armour actually gives you disadvantages when using magic attacks. It may be better to take off your armour entirely!
translation: 近战盔甲实际上会给你使用魔法攻击时带来不利。完全脱掉你的盔甲也许会更好！ [jin zhan kui jia shi ji shang hui gei ni shi yong mo fa gong ji shi dai lai bu li 。 wan quan tuo diao ni de kui jia ye xu hui geng hao ！]

english: If the chat window is moving too quickly to report a player accurately, run to a quiet spot and review the chat at your leisure!
translation: 如果聊天窗口移动得太快而无法准确报告玩家，请跑到一个安静的地方并在闲暇时查看聊天内容！ [ru guo liao tian chuang kou yi dong de tai kuai er wu fa zhun que bao gao wan jia ， qing pao dao yi ge an jing de di fang bing zai xian xia shi cha kan liao tian nei rong ！]

english: Take time to check the second trade window carefully. Don't be scammed!
translation: 花时间仔细检查第二个交易窗口。不要被骗了！ [hua shi jian zi xi jian cha di er ge jiao yi chuang kou 。 bu yao bei pian le ！]

english: Did you know having a bank pin can help secure your valuable items?
translation: 您知道拥有银行密码可以帮助保护您的贵重物品吗？ [nin zhi dao yong you yin hang mi ma ke yi bang zhu bao hu nin de gui zhong wu pin ma ？]

english: Did you know that mithril equipment is very light?
translation: 你知道秘银装备很轻吗？ [ni zhi dao mi yin zhuang bei hen qing ma ？]

english: There are no cheats in RuneScape! Never visit websites promising otherwise!
translation: RuneScape 中没有作弊！切勿访问有其他承诺的网站！ [RuneScape  zhong mei you zuo bi ！ qie wu fang wen you qi ta cheng nuo de wang zhan ！]

english: Jagex will never e-mail you. Do not believe any e-mails that claim to be from us.
translation: Jagex 永远不会给您发送电子邮件。不要相信任何声称来自我们的电子邮件。 [Jagex  yong yuan bu hui gei nin fa song dian zi you jian 。 bu yao xiang xin ren he sheng cheng lai zi wo men de dian zi you jian 。]

english: If you're stuck on a skill, talk to the Lumbridge Tutors for help and tips.
translation: 如果您在某项技能上遇到困难，请向 Lumbridge 导师寻求帮助和提示。 [ru guo nin zai mou xiang ji neng shang yu dao kun nan ， qing xiang  Lumbridge  dao shi xun qiu bang zhu he ti shi 。]

english: Did you know that you can wear a shield with a crossbow?
translation: 你知道你可以用十字弓佩戴盾牌吗？ [ni zhi dao ni ke yi yong shi zi gong pei dai dun pai ma ？]

english: Beware of players trying to lure you into the wilderness. Your items cannot be returned if you lose them!
translation: 谨防试图引诱您进入荒野的玩家。如果您丢失了您的物品，将无法退回！ [jin fang shi tu yin you nin jin ru huang ye de wan jia 。 ru guo nin diu shi le nin de wu pin ， jiang wu fa tui hui ！]

english: If a player isn't sure of the rules, send them to me! I'll be happy to remind them!
translation: 如果玩家不确定规则，请将其发送给我！我很乐意提醒他们！ [ru guo wan jia bu que ding gui ze ， qing jiang qi fa song gei wo ！ wo hen le yi ti xing ta men ！]

english: Never tell your password to anyone, not even your best friend!
translation: 切勿将您的密码告诉任何人，即使是您最好的朋友！ [qie wu jiang nin de mi ma gao su ren he ren ， ji shi shi nin zui hao de peng you ！]

english: Be careful when fighting wizards! Wearing heavy armour can lower your Magic resistance!
translation: 与巫师战斗时要小心！穿着重甲会降低你的魔法抗性！ [yu wu shi zhan dou shi yao xiao xin ！ chuan zhe zhong jia hui jiang di ni de mo fa kang xing ！]

english: Hear ye! Hear ye! Player Moderators massive help to Rune... Oh great, a P-mod! I know all about the great job you guys do, would you like me to prove my extensive knowledge to you?!
translation: 听你们说！听你们说！玩家版主对符文提供了巨大的帮助...哦太棒了，P-mod！我知道你们所做的出色工作，您希望我向您证明我丰富的知识吗？！ [ting ni men shuo ！ ting ni men shuo ！ wan jia ban zhu dui fu wen ti gong le ju da de bang zhu ... o tai bang le ，P-mod！ wo zhi dao ni men suo zuo de chu se gong zuo ， nin xi wang wo xiang nin zheng ming wo feng fu de zhi shi ma ？！]

english: Can you show me the Guidelines please?
translation: 您能给我看一下指南吗？ [nin neng gei wo kan yi xia zhi nan ma ？]

english: Of course, but I can't let you keep it - I've only got a few copies!
translation: 当然可以，但我不能让你保留它——我只有几本！ [dang ran ke yi ， dan wo bu neng rang ni bao liu ta —— wo zhi you ji ben ！]

english: Do you have a copy of the Code of Conduct?
translation: 您有行为准则的副本吗？ [nin you xing wei zhun ze de fu ben ma ？]

english: Oh yes, but I can't let you keep it - I've only a few copies!
translation: 哦，是的，但我不能让你保留它——我只有几本！ [o ， shi de ， dan wo bu neng rang ni bao liu ta —— wo zhi you ji ben ！]

english: Can you give me a moderating tip please?
translation: 您能给我一个调节提示吗？ [nin neng gei wo yi ge tiao jie ti shi ma ？]

english: Add other Player Moderators to your friends list for quick advice and moral support in-game. It does help!
translation: 将其他玩家版主添加到您的朋友列表中，以获得游戏中的快速建议和道义支持。它确实有帮助！ [jiang qi ta wan jia ban zhu tian jia dao nin de peng you lie biao zhong ， yi huo de you xi zhong de kuai su jian yi he dao yi zhi chi 。 ta que shi you bang zhu ！]

english: To avoid reporting the wrong player, add an offender to your friends list, switch your public chat to friends and then use your right-click report from there. Easy!
translation: 为了避免举报错误的玩家，请将违规者添加到您的朋友列表中，将您的公共聊天切换到朋友，然后从那里使用右键单击举报。简单的！ [wei le bi mian ju bao cuo wu de wan jia ， qing jiang wei gui zhe tian jia dao nin de peng you lie biao zhong ， jiang nin de gong gong liao tian qie huan dao peng you ， ran hou cong na li shi yong you jian dan ji ju bao 。 jian dan de ！]

english: Did you know that Free-to-Play P-mods CAN visit the moderator forums, by logging into the regular forums at the top right hand side of the forum screen, despite it saying Members only.
translation: 您是否知道免费 P-mod 可以通过登录论坛屏幕右上角的常规论坛来访问版主论坛，尽管上面写着仅限会员。 [nin shi fou zhi dao mian fei  P-mod  ke yi tong guo deng lu lun tan ping mu you shang jiao de chang gui lun tan lai fang wen ban zhu lun tan ， jin guan shang mian xie zhe jin xian hui yuan 。]

english: Don't be tempted to report anything you didn't see, no matter how much you trust the player who is informing you.
translation: 无论您多么信任通知您的玩家，都不要试图报告您没有看到的任何内容。 [wu lun nin duo me xin ren tong zhi nin de wan jia ， dou bu yao shi tu bao gao nin mei you kan dao de ren he nei rong 。]

english: Don't eat something messy when on a first date - it won't look good!
translation: 第一次约会时不要吃乱七八糟的东西——这样不好看！ [di yi ci yue hui shi bu yao chi luan qi ba zao de dong xi —— zhe yang bu hao kan ！]

english: Don't forget to add the mute if needed, before selecting the report category. This cuts down on those duplicate reports for one player.
translation: 在选择报告类别之前，如果需要，请不要忘记添加静音。这减少了一名玩家的重复报告。 [zai xuan ze bao gao lei bie zhi qian ， ru guo xu yao ， qing bu yao wang ji tian jia jing yin 。 zhe jian shao le yi ming wan jia de chong fu bao gao 。]

english: The forums are the best place to keep abreast of any procedure changes that might not yet be included in the Player Mod guidelines!
translation: 论坛是了解可能尚未包含在玩家 Mod 指南中的任何程序更改的最佳场所！ [lun tan shi liao jie ke neng shang wei bao han zai wan jia  Mod  zhi nan zhong de ren he cheng xu geng gai de zui jia chang suo ！]

english: Got players asking you to unban them or help them retrieve a stolen or hacked account? There's nothing you can do so just send them to the Customer Support Team. If they think you can help, send them to me; I'll
translation: 有玩家要求您解封他们或帮助他们找回被盗或被黑的帐户吗？您无能为力，只需将它们发送给客户支持团队即可。如果他们认为你可以提供帮助，请将他们发送给我；患病的 [you wan jia yao qiu nin jie feng ta men huo bang zhu ta men zhao hui bei dao huo bei hei de zhang hu ma ？ nin wu neng wei li ， zhi xu jiang ta men fa song gei ke hu zhi chi tuan dui ji ke 。 ru guo ta men ren wei ni ke yi ti gong bang zhu ， qing jiang ta men fa song gei wo ； huan bing de]

english: put them straight!
translation: 把它们摆直！ [ba ta men bai zhi ！]

english: Have the P-Mod Oracle open in a separate window when playing Old School RuneScape - that way you'll always have the most up-to-date guidelines to hand!
translation: 在玩 Old School RuneScape 时，在单独的窗口中打开 P-Mod Oracle - 这样您将始终拥有最新的指南！ [zai wan  Old School RuneScape  shi ， zai dan du de chuang kou zhong da kai  P-Mod Oracle -  zhe yang nin jiang shi zhong yong you zui xin de zhi nan ！]

english: If the chat is scrolling too fast for you to see that suspect line you want to double check, just run up a ladder or to a quieter spot to stop the chat screen scrolling. Then you can scroll back and read that
translation: 如果聊天滚动速度太快，您看不到想要仔细检查的可疑行，只需跑上梯子或跑到一个安静的地方即可停止聊天屏幕滚动。然后你可以向后滚动并阅读 [ru guo liao tian gun dong su du tai kuai ， nin kan bu dao xiang yao zi xi jian cha de ke yi xing ， zhi xu pao shang ti zi huo pao dao yi ge an jing de di fang ji ke ting zhi liao tian ping mu gun dong 。 ran hou ni ke yi xiang hou gun dong bing yue du]

english: suspect line and judge the situation in your own time!
translation: 怀疑路线并根据自己的时间判断情况！ [huai yi lu xian bing gen ju zi ji de shi jian pan duan qing kuang ！]

english: If you're a new mod, don't forget to read the guidelines before you log into the game! If you've been a P-mod for a while, why not have another read of them to refresh your memory and to get up to date
translation: 如果您是新模组，请不要忘记在登录游戏之前阅读指南！如果您已经成为 P-mod 一段时间了，为什么不再阅读它们来刷新您的记忆并了解最新情况 [ru guo nin shi xin mo zu ， qing bu yao wang ji zai deng lu you xi zhi qian yue du zhi nan ！ ru guo nin yi jing cheng wei  P-mod  yi duan shi jian le ， wei shen me bu zai yue du ta men lai shua xin nin de ji yi bing liao jie zui xin qing kuang]

english: with any changes you may have missed!
translation: 以及您可能错过的任何更改！ [yi ji nin ke neng cuo guo de ren he geng gai ！]

english: If you've got a player asking you questions about P- mods, feel free to send them to me; I can answer questions about P-mods for you!
translation: 如果您有玩家向您询问有关 P-mod 的问题，请随时将其发送给我；我可以为您解答有关P-mods的问题！ [ru guo nin you wan jia xiang nin xun wen you guan  P-mod  de wen ti ， qing sui shi jiang qi fa song gei wo ； wo ke yi wei nin jie da you guan P-mods de wen ti ！]

english: If you get harassed by a player in game, don't take it personally - the player is reacting to your silver crown, not to you!
translation: 如果您在游戏中受到玩家的骚扰，请不要认为这是针对您个人的 - 玩家是针对您的银冠做出反应，而不是针对您！ [ru guo nin zai you xi zhong shou dao wan jia de sao rao ， qing bu yao ren wei zhe shi zhen dui nin ge ren de  -  wan jia shi zhen dui nin de yin guan zuo chu fan ying ， er bu shi zhen dui nin ！]

english: If you notice a player trying to buy something common for an extremely high price, look about and see if there's someone else selling the same item for a much lower price. Chances are they're team scamming. If so,
translation: 如果您发现一名玩家试图以极高的价格购买普通物品，请查看是否有其他人以更低的价格出售相同的物品。他们很有可能是团队诈骗。如果是这样， [ru guo nin fa xian yi ming wan jia shi tu yi ji gao de jia ge gou mai pu tong wu pin ， qing cha kan shi fou you qi ta ren yi geng di de jia ge chu shou xiang tong de wu pin 。 ta men hen you ke neng shi tuan dui zha pian 。 ru guo shi zhe yang ，]

english: write their names down and send your J-mod curators a query!
translation: 写下他们的名字并向您的 J-mod 策展人发送查询！ [xie xia ta men de ming zi bing xiang nin de  J-mod  ce zhan ren fa song cha xun ！]

english: If you see a player abusing a bug in game, there's no need to report the player, just submit a bug report via the in-game report form.
translation: 如果您发现玩家滥用游戏中的错误，则无需举报该玩家，只需通过游戏内报告表提交错误报告即可。 [ru guo nin fa xian wan jia lan yong you xi zhong de cuo wu ， ze wu xu ju bao gai wan jia ， zhi xu tong guo you xi nei bao gao biao ti jiao cuo wu bao gao ji ke 。]

english: An important part of being a P-mod is to act as an ambassador for the game. Keeping your cool even when faced with the rudest players goes a long way towards this!
translation: 成为 P-mod 的一个重要部分就是充当游戏的大使。即使面对最粗鲁的玩家也能保持冷静，这对实现这一目标大有帮助！ [cheng wei  P-mod  de yi ge zhong yao bu fen jiu shi chong dang you xi de da shi 。 ji shi mian dui zui cu lu de wan jia ye neng bao chi leng jing ， zhe dui shi xian zhe yi mu biao da you bang zhu ！]

english: It's always better to report in secret. Telling a player that you are about to report them rarely makes you a friend, and can often lead to a player being offensive to you!
translation: 秘密报告总是更好。告诉玩家您要举报他们很少会让您成为朋友，并且常常会导致玩家冒犯您！ [mi mi bao gao zong shi geng hao 。 gao su wan jia nin yao ju bao ta men hen shao hui rang nin cheng wei peng you ， bing qie chang chang hui dao zhi wan jia mao fan nin ！]

english: Make sure you log out of the game and the forums whenever you leave your device. Don't allow others to see confidential info!
translation: 确保每次离开设备时都退出游戏和论坛。不要让别人看到机密信息！ [que bao mei ci li kai she bei shi dou tui chu you xi he lun tan 。 bu yao rang bie ren kan dao ji mi xin xi ！]

english: Never answer questions if you feel the answer will breach confidentiality.
translation: 如果您认为答案会违反保密性，切勿回答问题。 [ru guo nin ren wei da an hui wei fan bao mi xing ， qie wu hui da wen ti 。]

english: The P-mod forums are your friend! They're the best place to talk to and meet other P-mods and are absolutely packed with useful advice!
translation: P-mod 论坛是您的朋友！他们是与其他 P-mod 交谈和会面的最佳场所，并且绝对充满了有用的建议！ [P-mod  lun tan shi nin de peng you ！ ta men shi yu qi ta  P-mod  jiao tan he hui mian de zui jia chang suo ， bing qie jue dui chong man le you yong de jian yi ！]

english: Remember, if in doubt, report without a mute! It's very frustrating not to be able to speak if you're innocent!
translation: 请记住，如果有疑问，请不要静音报告！明明是无辜的却不能说话，真是太郁闷了！ [qing ji zhu ， ru guo you yi wen ， qing bu yao jing yin bao gao ！ ming ming shi wu gu de que bu neng shuo hua ， zhen shi tai yu men le ！]

english: Remember, if offensive language has been completely filtered out then there's no need to report or mute it!
translation: 请记住，如果攻击性语言已被完全过滤掉，则无需举报或静音！ [qing ji zhu ， ru guo gong ji xing yu yan yi bei wan quan guo lv diao ， ze wu xu ju bao huo jing yin ！]

english: Think twice before applying that mute. Will it really prevent further damage from surrounding players?
translation: 在应用静音之前请三思。它真的能阻止周围玩家的进一步伤害吗？ [zai ying yong jing yin zhi qian qing san si 。 ta zhen de neng zu zhi zhou wei wan jia de jin yi bu shang hai ma ？]

english: Use the Jagex PMod team if you need to - they're there to help!
translation: 如果需要，请使用 Jagex PMod 团队 - 他们随时为您提供帮助！ [ru guo xu yao ， qing shi yong  Jagex PMod  tuan dui  -  ta men sui shi wei nin ti gong bang zhu ！]

english: You'll be amazed how often a bit of humour can diffuse a potentially unpleasant situation, before it becomes too serious.
translation: 你会惊讶地发现，一点点幽默常常可以在潜在的不愉快情况变得过于严重之前化解它。 [ni hui jing ya di fa xian ， yi dian dian you mo chang chang ke yi zai qian zai de bu yu kuai qing kuang bian de guo yu yan zhong zhi qian hua jie ta 。]

english: Your J-mods are there to help you. If you ever need their advice, send them a query. They are always very happy to help. Don't be afraid to use them!
