english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: I can't talk now. Can't you see we're trying to win a battle here?
translation: 我现在不能说话。你没看到我们正在努力赢得一场战斗吗？ [wo xian zai bu neng shuo hua 。 ni mei kan dao wo men zheng zai nu li ying de yi chang zhan dou ma ？]

english: Do you know the coordinates of the Khazard stronghold?
translation: 你知道卡扎德据点的坐标吗？ [ni zhi dao ka zha de ju dian de zuo biao ma ？]

english: I managed to get one, although it wasn't easy.
translation: 我设法得到了一个，尽管这并不容易。 [wo she fa de dao le yi ge ， jin guan zhe bing bu rong yi 。]

english: The gnome tells you the height coordinate.
translation: 侏儒会告诉您高度坐标。 [zhu ru hui gao su nin gao du zuo biao 。]

english: Well done.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: The other two tracker gnomes should have the other coordinates if they're still alive.
translation: 另外两个追踪侏儒如果还活着的话应该有其他坐标。 [ling wai liang ge zhui zong zhu ru ru guo hai huo zhe de hua ying gai you qi ta zuo biao 。]

english: OK, take care.
translation: 好的，保重。 [hao de ， bao zhong 。]

english: Hello again.
translation: 又好。 [you hao 。]

english: Well done, you've broken down their defences. This battle must be ours.
translation: 干得好，你已经打破了他们的防御。这场战斗必须是我们的。 [gan de hao ， ni yi jing da po le ta men de fang yu 。 zhe chang zhan dou bi xu shi wo men de 。]

english: How are you tracker?
translation: 追踪者你还好吗？ [zhui zong zhe ni hai hao ma ？]

english: Now we have the orb I'm much better. They won't stand a chance without it.
translation: 现在我们有了球体，我好多了。没有它，他们就没有机会。 [xian zai wo men you le qiu ti ， wo hao duo le 。 mei you ta ， ta men jiu mei you ji hui 。]

english: When will this battle end? I feel like I've been fighting forever.
translation: 这场战斗什么时候结束？我感觉我一直在战斗。 [zhe chang zhan dou shen me shi hou jie shu ？ wo gan jue wo yi zhi zai zhan dou 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: I can't talk now. If the guards catch me I'll be dead gnome meat.
translation: 我现在不能说话。如果守卫抓住我，我就会变成侏儒肉。 [wo xian zai bu neng shuo hua 。 ru guo shou wei zhua zhu wo ， wo jiu hui bian cheng zhu ru rou 。]

english: Hi there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: The battle is far from over. If you have a pure heart you will help us win.
translation: 战斗还远没有结束。如果你有一颗纯洁的心，你将帮助我们获胜。 [zhan dou hai yuan mei you jie shu 。 ru guo ni you yi ke chun jie de xin ， ni jiang bang zhu wo men huo sheng 。]

english: Are you OK?
translation: 你还好吗？ [ni hai hao ma ？]

english: They caught me spying on the stronghold. They beat and tortured me.
translation: 他们发现我在监视据点。他们殴打、折磨我。 [ta men fa xian wo zai jian shi ju dian 。 ta men ou da 、 zhe mo wo 。]

english: But I didn't crack. I told them nothing. They can't break me!
translation: 但我没有破解。我什么也没告诉他们。他们无法击垮我！ [dan wo mei you po jie 。 wo shen me ye mei gao su ta men 。 ta men wu fa ji kua wo ！]

english: I'm sorry little man.
translation: 对不起，小男人。 [dui bu qi ， xiao nan ren 。]

english: Don't be. I have the position of the stronghold!
translation: 别这样。我有据点的位置！ [bie zhe yang 。 wo you ju dian de wei zhi ！]

english: The gnome tells you the y coordinate.
translation: 侏儒会告诉您 y 坐标。 [zhu ru hui gao su nin  y  zuo biao 。]

english: Well done.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: Now leave before they find you and all is lost.
translation: 现在就在他们找到你之前离开吧，一切就都完了。 [xian zai jiu zai ta men zhao dao ni zhi qian li kai ba ， yi qie jiu dou wan le 。]

english: Hang in there.
translation: 坚持住。 [jian chi zhu 。]

english: Go!
translation: 去！ [qu ！]

english: Hello again.
translation: 又好。 [you hao 。]

english: Well done, you've broken down their defences. This battle must be ours.
translation: 干得好，你已经打破了他们的防御。这场战斗必须是我们的。 [gan de hao ， ni yi jing da po le ta men de fang yu 。 zhe chang zhan dou bi xu shi wo men de 。]

english: How are you tracker?
translation: 追踪者你还好吗？ [zhui zong zhe ni hai hao ma ？]

english: Now we have the orb I'm much better. Soon my comrades will come and free me.
translation: 现在我们有了球体，我好多了。很快我的战友就会来救我。 [xian zai wo men you le qiu ti ， wo hao duo le 。 hen kuai wo de zhan you jiu hui lai jiu wo 。]

english: When will this battle end? I feel like I've been locked up my whole life.
translation: 这场战斗什么时候结束？我感觉我的一生都被禁锢了。 [zhe chang zhan dou shen me shi hou jie shu ？ wo gan jue wo de yi sheng dou bei jin gu le 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: I can't talk now. Can't you see we're trying to win a battle here?
translation: 我现在不能说话。你没看到我们正在努力赢得一场战斗吗？ [wo xian zai bu neng shuo hua 。 ni mei kan dao wo men zheng zai nu li ying de yi chang zhan dou ma ？]

english: Hi there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: I can't stand this war. The misery, the pain, it's driving me crazy! When will it end?
translation: 我无法忍受这场战争。痛苦，痛苦，让我发疯！什么时候结束？ [wo wu fa ren shou zhe chang zhan zheng 。 tong ku ， tong ku ， rang wo fa feng ！ shen me shi hou jie shu ？]

english: Are you OK?
translation: 你还好吗？ [ni hai hao ma ？]

english: OK? Who's OK? Not me! Hee hee!
translation: 好的？谁还好？不是我！嘻嘻！ [hao de ？ shui hai hao ？ bu shi wo ！ xi xi ！]

english: What's wrong?
translation: 怎么了？ [zen me le ？]

english: You can't see me, no one can. Monsters, demons, they're all around me!
translation: 你看不见我，没人能看见我。怪物，恶魔，他们就在我身边！ [ni kan bu jian wo ， mei ren neng kan jian wo 。 guai wu ， e mo ， ta men jiu zai wo shen bian ！]

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你是什​​么意思？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: They're dancing, all of them, hee hee.
translation: 他们都在跳舞，嘻嘻。 [ta men dou zai tiao wu ， xi xi 。]

english: He's clearly lost the plot.
translation: 他显然已经失去了阴谋。 [ta xian ran yi jing shi qu le yin mou 。]

english: Do you have the coordinate for the Khazard stronghold?
translation: 你有卡扎德要塞的坐标吗？ [ni you ka zha de yao sai de zuo biao ma ？]

english: Who holds the stronghold?
translation: 谁掌握着据点？ [shui zhang wo zhe ju dian ？]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: Less than my hands.
translation: 比我的手还少。 [bi wo de shou hai shao 。]

english: More than my head, less than my fingers.
translation: 比我的头多，比我的手指少。 [bi wo de tou duo ， bi wo de shou zhi shao 。]

english: More than we, less than our feet.
translation: 比我们多，比我们的脚少。 [bi wo men duo ， bi wo men de jiao shao 。]

english: My legs and your legs, ha ha ha!
translation: 我的腿和你的腿，哈哈哈！ [wo de tui he ni de tui ， ha ha ha ！]

english: You're mad.
translation: 你生气了。 [ni sheng qi le 。]

english: Dance with me, and Khazard's men are beat.
translation: 与我共舞，卡扎德的手下就会被打败。 [yu wo gong wu ， ka zha de de shou xia jiu hui bei da bai 。]

english: The toll of war has affected his mind.
translation: 战争造成的伤亡影响了他的思想。 [zhan zheng zao cheng de shang wang ying xiang le ta de si xiang 。]

english: I'll pray for you little man.
translation: 我会为你这个小男人祈祷。 [wo hui wei ni zhe ge xiao nan ren qi dao 。]

english: All day we pray in the hay, hee hee.
translation: 我们整天在干草堆里祈祷，嘻嘻。 [wo men zheng tian zai gan cao dui li qi dao ， xi xi 。]

english: Hello again.
translation: 又好。 [you hao 。]

english: Don't talk to me, you can't see me. No one can, just the demons.
translation: 别跟我说话，你看不见我。没有人可以，只有恶魔。 [bie gen wo shuo hua ， ni kan bu jian wo 。 mei you ren ke yi ， zhi you e mo 。]

english: I feel dizzy, where am I? Oh dear, oh dear I need some rest.
translation: 我感觉头晕，我在哪里？噢天哪，天哪我需要休息一下。 [wo gan jue tou yun ， wo zai na li ？ o tian na ， tian na wo xu yao xiu xi yi xia 。]

english: I think you do.
translation: 我想你会的。 [wo xiang ni hui de 。]

english: Talk to the secretaries, not to me!
translation: 跟秘书说话，而不是跟我说话！ [gen mi shu shuo hua ， er bu shi gen wo shuo hua ！]

english: Clear out!
translation: 清除！ [qing chu ！]

english: Stay out of the octagon center!
translation: 远离八边形中心！ [yuan li ba bian xing zhong xin ！]

english: I can't help you!
translation: 我帮不了你！ [wo bang bu liao ni ！]

english: Can't talk to you, too busy!
translation: 没空跟你说话，太忙了！ [mei kong gen ni shuo hua ， tai mang le ！]

english: Stay inside your triangle!
translation: 留在你的三角形内！ [liu zai ni de san jiao xing nei ！]

english: Who's next?
translation: 下一个是谁？ [xia yi ge shi shui ？]

english: Next bid please!
translation: 请下次出价！ [qing xia ci chu jia ！]

english: Need an offer, now!
translation: 需要报价，现在！ [xu yao bao jia ， xian zai ！]

english: Keep the goods flowing!
translation: 保持货物畅通！ [bao chi huo wu chang tong ！]

english: Keep it civil!
translation: 保持文明！ [bao chi wen ming ！]

english: Come on, come on!
translation: 来吧，来吧！ [lai ba ， lai ba ！]

english: Go again please.
translation: 请再去吧。 [qing zai qu ba 。]

english: Hold on there!
translation: 坚持住！ [jian chi zhu ！]

english: Can I help you?
translation: 我可以帮你吗？ [wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: Yes, who are you?
translation: 是的，你是谁？ [shi de ， ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm one of Trader Stan's crew; we are all part of the largest fleet of trading and sailing vessels to ever sail the seven seas.
translation: 我是商人斯坦的船员之一；我们都是有史以来航行于七大洋的最大的贸易和帆船船队的一部分。 [wo shi shang ren si tan de chuan yuan zhi yi ； wo men dou shi you shi yi lai hang xing yu qi da yang de zui da de mao yi he fan chuan chuan dui de yi bu fen 。]

english: If you want to get to a port in a hurry then you can charter one of our ships to take you there - if the price is right...
translation: 如果您想快速到达港口，那么您可以租用我们的一艘船带您前往那里 - 如果价格合适的话...... [ru guo nin xiang kuai su dao da gang kou ， na me nin ke yi zu yong wo men de yi sou chuan dai nin qian wang na li  -  ru guo jia ge he shi de hua ......]

english: So, where exactly can I go with your ships?
translation: 那么，我到底可以乘坐你们的船去哪里呢？ [na me ， wo dao di ke yi cheng zuo ni men de chuan qu na li ne ？]

english: We run ships from Port Phasmatys over to Port Tyras, stopping at Port Sarim, Catherby, Brimhaven, Musa Point, Port Khazard and more besides!
translation: 我们运营从法斯马蒂斯港到泰拉斯港的船舶，停靠萨里姆港、凯瑟比、布里姆港、穆萨角、卡扎德港等等！ [wo men yun ying cong fa si ma di si gang dao tai la si gang de chuan bo ， ting kao sa li mu gang 、 kai se bi 、 bu li mu gang 、 mu sa jiao 、 ka zha de gang deng deng ！]

english: We might dock at Mos Le'Harmless once in a while, as well, if you catch my meaning...
translation: 如果你明白我的意思的话，我们也可能偶尔停靠在莫斯勒哈姆莱斯…… [ru guo ni ming bai wo de yi si de hua ， wo men ye ke neng ou er ting kao zai mo si lei ha mu lai si ……]

english: Wow, that's a lot of ports. I take it you have some exotic stuff to trade?
translation: 哇，有很多端口。我想你有一些奇异的东西可以交易？ [wa ， you hen duo duan kou 。 wo xiang ni you yi xie qi yi de dong xi ke yi jiao yi ？]

english: We certainly do! We have access to items bought and sold from around the world. Would you like to take a look? Or would you like to charter a ship?
translation: 我们当然愿意！我们可以获得从世界各地购买和销售的物品。您想看一下吗？或者您想租一艘船？ [wo men dang ran yuan yi ！ wo men ke yi huo de cong shi jie ge di gou mai he xiao shou de wu pin 。 nin xiang kan yi xia ma ？ huo zhe nin xiang zu yi sou chuan ？]

english: Yes, let's see what you're trading.
translation: 是的，让我们看看您在交易什么。 [shi de ， rang wo men kan kan nin zai jiao yi shen me 。]

english: Isn't it tricky to sail about in those clothes?
translation: 穿着这些衣服去航行不是很麻烦吗？ [chuan zhe zhe xie yi fu qu hang xing bu shi hen ma fan ma ？]

english: Tricky? Tricky!
translation: 棘手吗？棘手！ [ji shou ma ？ ji shou ！]

english: With all due credit, Trader Stan is a great employer, but he insists we wear the latest in high fashion even when sailing.
translation: 诚然，商人斯坦是一位出色的雇主，但他坚持要求我们即使在航行时也要穿着最新的高级时装。 [cheng ran ， shang ren si tan shi yi wei chu se de gu zhu ， dan ta jian chi yao qiu wo men ji shi zai hang xing shi ye yao chuan zhe zui xin de gao ji shi zhuang 。]

english: Do you have even the slightest idea how tricky it is to sail in this stuff?
translation: 你知道驾驶这种东西航行有多么棘手吗？ [ni zhi dao jia shi zhe zhong dong xi hang xing you duo me ji shou ma ？]

english: Some of us tried tearing it and arguing that it was too fragile to wear when on a boat, but he just had it enchanted to re-stitch itself.
translation: 我们中的一些人试图撕掉它，并认为它太脆弱，无法在船上佩戴，但他只是对它施了魔法，让它自行重新缝合。 [wo men zhong de yi xie ren shi tu si diao ta ， bing ren wei ta tai cui ruo ， wu fa zai chuan shang pei dai ， dan ta zhi shi dui ta shi le mo fa ， rang ta zi xing chong xin feng he 。]

english: It's hard to hate him when we know how much he shells out on this gear, but if I fall overboard because of this getup one more time, I'm going to quit.
translation: 当我们知道他在这件装备上花了多少钱时，我们很难恨他，但如果我再一次因为这种装束而失败，我就会退出。 [dang wo men zhi dao ta zai zhe jian zhuang bei shang hua le duo shao qian shi ， wo men hen nan hen ta ， dan ru guo wo zai yi ci yin wei zhe zhong zhuang shu er shi bai ， wo jiu hui tui chu 。]

english: Wow, that's kind of harsh.
translation: 哇，这有点严厉。 [wa ， zhe you dian yan li 。]

english: Anyway, would you like to take a look at our exotic wares from around the world? Or would you like to charter a ship?
translation: 不管怎样，您想看看我们来自世界各地的奇特商品吗？或者您想租一艘船？ [bu guan zen yang ， nin xiang kan kan wo men lai zi shi jie ge di de qi te shang pin ma ？ huo zhe nin xiang zu yi sou chuan ？]

english: Yes, I would like to charter a ship.
translation: 是的，我想租一艘船。 [shi de ， wo xiang zu yi sou chuan 。]

english: Certainly sir. Where would you like to go?
translation: 当然，先生。您想去哪里？ [dang ran ， xian sheng 。 nin xiang qu na li ？]

english: The player is transported to the destination
translation: 玩家被传送到目的地 [wan jia bei chuan song dao mu di di]

english: Crandor? Are you crazy?
translation: 克兰多？你疯了？ [ke lan duo ？ ni feng le ？]

english: No charter ship would take you to that island. You'd need to buy your own ship and, even then, you'd have trouble finding a captain crazy enough to go there.
translation: 没有包船会带你去那个岛。你需要购买自己的船，即便如此，你也很难找到一个足够疯狂的船长去那里。 [mei you bao chuan hui dai ni qu na ge dao 。 ni xu yao gou mai zi ji de chuan ， ji bian ru ci ， ni ye hen nan zhao dao yi ge zu gou feng kuang de chuan zhang qu na li 。]

english: Sorry, we aren't a laundry ship. You'll need to leave those dirty bedsheets behind.

english: Silly JalYt, I am TzHaar-Ket, one of the guardians of our city.
translation: 愚蠢的 JalYt，我是 TzHaar-Ket，我们城市的守护者之一。 [yu chun de  JalYt， wo shi  TzHaar-Ket， wo men cheng shi de shou hu zhe zhi yi 。]

english: There are the wise TzHaar-Mej who guide us, the swift TzHaar-Xil who hunt for our food, and the skilled TzHaar-Hur who craft our homes and tools.
translation: 有智慧的茨哈尔-梅吉（TzHaar-Mej）为我们指引方向，敏捷的茨哈尔-西尔（TzHaar-Xil）为我们寻找食物，还有熟练的茨哈尔-胡尔（TzHaar-Hur）为我们打造家园和工具。 [you zhi hui de ci ha er - mei ji （TzHaar-Mej） wei wo men zhi yin fang xiang ， min jie de ci ha er - xi er （TzHaar-Xil） wei wo men xun zhao shi wu ， hai you shu lian de ci ha er - hu er （TzHaar-Hur） wei wo men da zao jia yuan he gong ju 。]

english: Thanks for explaining it.
translation: 谢谢你的解释。 [xie xie ni de jie shi 。]

english: I guess so...
translation: 大概吧... [da gai ba ...]

english: Well then, no problems.
translation: 那么，没问题。 [na me ， mei wen ti 。]

english: No I'm not!
translation: 不，我不是！ [bu ， wo bu shi ！]

english: What ever you say, crazy JalYt!
translation: 不管你说什么，疯狂的贾利特！ [bu guan ni shuo shen me ， feng kuang de jia li te ！]

english: No I'm fine thanks.
translation: 不，我很好，谢谢。 [bu ， wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello JalYt-[TzHaar caste]-[player name].
translation: 你好 JalYt-[TzHaar 种姓]-[玩家姓名]。 [ni hao  JalYt-[TzHaar  zhong xing ]-[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: You need help little JalYt?
translation: 小贾利特，你需要帮助吗？ [xiao jia li te ， ni xu yao bang zhu ma ？]

english: Not unless you can help me in The Inferno.
translation: 除非你能在地狱中帮助我。 [chu fei ni neng zai di yu zhong bang zhu wo 。]

english: We dare not go there. That job is for you.
translation: 我们不敢去那里。那份工作适合你。 [wo men bu gan qu na li 。 na fen gong zuo shi he ni 。]

english: Oh... worth a try I suppose.
translation: 哦...我想值得一试。 [o ... wo xiang zhi de yi shi 。]

english: Why can't I go past here?
translation: 为什么我不能从这里过去？ [wei shen me wo bu neng cong zhe li guo qu ？]

english: Why's that?
translation: 这是为什么呢？ [zhe shi wei shen me ne ？]

english: That's a shame.
translation: 太可惜了。 [tai ke xi le 。]

english: What if I could prove I am capable?
translation: 如果我能证明我有能力呢？ [ru guo wo neng zheng ming wo you neng li ne ？]

english: How about a large stack of gold?
translation: 一大堆金子怎么样？ [yi da dui jin zi zen me yang ？]

english: I managed to defeat TzTok-Jad and obtain this firecape.
translation: 我成功击败了 TzTok-Jad 并获得了这个火披风。 [wo cheng gong ji bai le  TzTok-Jad  bing huo de le zhe ge huo pi feng 。]

english: Sorry, I don't think I am capable.
translation: 抱歉，我认为我没有能力。 [bao qian ， wo ren wei wo mei you neng li 。]

english: I'm a hardened adventurer, nothing can stop me!
translation: 我是一个坚强的冒险家，没有什么可以阻止我！ [wo shi yi ge jian qiang de mao xian jia ， mei you shen me ke yi zu zhi wo ！]

english: What are you guarding?
translation: 你在守护什么？ [ni zai shou hu shen me ？]

english: Oh well, Goodbye.
translation: 哦，好吧，再见。 [o ， hao ba ， zai jian 。]

english: Oh well, [TzHaar caste]-[player name] over and out.
translation: 哦，好吧，[TzHaar 种姓]-[玩家姓名] 一遍又一遍。 [o ， hao ba ，[TzHaar  zhong xing ]-[ wan jia xing ming ]  yi bian you yi bian 。]

english: Fair enough.
translation: 很公平。 [hen gong ping 。]

english: What did you call me?
translation: 你叫我什么？ [ni jiao wo shen me ？]

english: What are you then?
translation: 那你是什么？ [na ni shi shen me ？]

english: Thanks for explaining it.
translation: 谢谢你的解释。 [xie xie ni de jie shi 。]

english: I guess so...
translation: 大概吧... [da gai ba ...]

english: No I'm not!
translation: 不，我不是！ [bu ， wo bu shi ！]

english: No I'm fine thanks.
translation: 不，我很好，谢谢。 [bu ， wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Yes, JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name]?
translation: 是的，JalYt-[种姓]-Xo-[玩家姓名]？ [shi de ，JalYt-[ zhong xing ]-Xo-[ wan jia xing ming ]？]

english: Tell me about the Inferno.
translation: 告诉我关于地狱的事情。 [gao su wo guan yu di yu de shi qing 。]

english: TzHaar are born from eggs incubated in lava pools. When hatched, we retain memories. Memories and knowledge passed on from ancestors who returned to the lava.
translation: TzHaar 是从在熔岩池中孵化的卵中诞生的。当孵化时，我们保留记忆。记忆和知识是从返回熔岩的祖先那里传承下来的。 [TzHaar  shi cong zai rong yan chi zhong fu hua de luan zhong dan sheng de 。 dang fu hua shi ， wo men bao liu ji yi 。 ji yi he zhi shi shi cong fan hui rong yan de zu xian na li chuan cheng xia lai de 。]

english: When TzHaar hatch, some memories are lost. Those about earliest ancestors are not retained. We experiment.
translation: 当 TzHaar 孵化时，一些记忆就会丢失。那些关于最早祖先的信息没有被保留。我们进行实验。 [dang  TzHaar  fu hua shi ， yi xie ji yi jiu hui diu shi 。 na xie guan yu zui zao zu xian de xin xi mei you bei bao liu 。 wo men jin xing shi yan 。]

english: This here was once our largest birthing pool. We use it for experiment. We increased the depth at which eggs are incubated. Over time, newly hatched TzHaar had more memories of lost history!
translation: 这里曾经是我们最大的分娩池。我们用它来做实验。我们增加了鸡蛋孵化的深度。随着时间的推移，刚孵化的 TzHaar 拥有了更多关于失落历史的记忆！ [zhe li ceng jing shi wo men zui da de fen mian chi 。 wo men yong ta lai zuo shi yan 。 wo men zeng jia le ji dan fu hua de shen du 。 sui zhe shi jian de tui yi ， gang fu hua de  TzHaar  yong you le geng duo guan yu shi luo li shi de ji yi ！]

english: But we kept pushing. We wanted answers, but we went too deep.
translation: 但我们一直在努力。我们想要答案，但我们陷得太深了。 [dan wo men yi zhi zai nu li 。 wo men xiang yao da an ， dan wo men xian de tai shen le 。]

english: Eventually the pool collapsed into a sinkhole. At the bottom we found some sort of ancient incubation chamber, from before earliest memories. We now call it the Inferno.
translation: 最终，水池塌陷成一个天坑。在底部，我们发现了某种古老的孵化室，来自最早的记忆。我们现在称之为地狱。 [zui zhong ， shui chi ta xian cheng yi ge tian keng 。 zai di bu ， wo men fa xian le mou zhong gu lao de fu hua shi ， lai zi zui zao de ji yi 。 wo men xian zai cheng zhi wei di yu 。]

english: We decide to experiment more. We take eggs from creatures in Fight Cave and incubate them down there.
translation: 我们决定进行更多实验。我们从战斗洞穴中的生物身上取出蛋，并在那里孵化它们。 [wo men jue ding jin xing geng duo shi yan 。 wo men cong zhan dou dong xue zhong de sheng wu shen shang qu chu dan ， bing zai na li fu hua ta men 。]

english: When eggs hatched, we see that it was not good decision. They were bigger and stronger, and fought each other for dominance.
translation: 当鸡蛋孵化时，我们发现这不是一个好的决定。他们更大更强，并为争夺统治地位而互相争斗。 [dang ji dan fu hua shi ， wo men fa xian zhe bu shi yi ge hao de jue ding 。 ta men geng da geng qiang ， bing wei zheng duo tong zhi di wei er hu xiang zheng dou 。]

english: Instead of knowledge, we now have chamber of dangerous creatures, and they're not alone. Another being lives in the Inferno, one more powerful than any TzHaar.
translation: 我们现在拥有的不是知识，而是危险生物的房间，而且它们并不孤单。另一种存在生活在地狱中，比任何 TzHaar 都更强大。 [wo men xian zai yong you de bu shi zhi shi ， er shi wei xian sheng wu de fang jian ， er qie ta men bing bu gu dan 。 ling yi zhong cun zai sheng huo zai di yu zhong ， bi ren he  TzHaar  dou geng qiang da 。]

english: We do not know where he came from. All we know is that TzKal-Zuk is hungry. Hungry for memories, memories beyond the Inferno.
translation: 我们不知道他来自哪里。我们只知道茨卡尔祖克饿了。渴望回忆，超越地狱的回忆。 [wo men bu zhi dao ta lai zi na li 。 wo men zhi zhi dao ci ka er zu ke e le 。 ke wang hui yi ， chao yue di yu de hui yi 。]

english: We think his goal is the city itself. Lots of TzHaar memories here for him. Luckily, he is trapped in prison down there, and we are keeping him at bay by offering sacrifices.
translation: 我们认为他的目标是城市本身。这里给他留下了很多 TzHaar 的回忆。幸运的是，他被困在下面的监狱里，我们通过献祭来阻止他。 [wo men ren wei ta de mu biao shi cheng shi ben shen 。 zhe li gei ta liu xia le hen duo  TzHaar  de hui yi 。 xing yun de shi ， ta bei kun zai xia mian de jian yu li ， wo men tong guo xian ji lai zu zhi ta 。]

english: We fear he can't be defeated, but maybe we can hold back his creatures and keep city safe.
translation: 我们担心他无法被击败，但也许我们可以阻止他的生物并保证城市的安全。 [wo men dan xin ta wu fa bei ji bai ， dan ye xu wo men ke yi zu zhi ta de sheng wu bing bao zheng cheng shi de an quan 。]

english: You, a mere JalYt, showed us he can be stopped though. Thanks to you, we still have hope.
translation: 你，只是一个 JalYt，却向我们展示了他是可以被阻止的。谢谢你，我们还有希望。 [ni ， zhi shi yi ge  JalYt， que xiang wo men zhan shi le ta shi ke yi bei zu zhi de 。 xie xie ni ， wo men hai you xi wang 。]

english: Instead of knowledge, we now have chamber of dangerous creatures. It gets worse, but I don't know if I can trust JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name] with this knowledge.
translation: 我们现在拥有的不是知识，而是危险生物的房间。情况变得更糟，但我不知道我是否可以相信 JalYt-[种姓]-Xo-[玩家姓名] 知道这些知识。 [wo men xian zai yong you de bu shi zhi shi ， er shi wei xian sheng wu de fang jian 。 qing kuang bian de geng zao ， dan wo bu zhi dao wo shi fou ke yi xiang xin  JalYt-[ zhong xing ]-Xo-[ wan jia xing ming ]  zhi dao zhe xie zhi shi 。]

english: I like to think I'm pretty trustworthy. If you tell me, maybe I can help in some way.
translation: 我喜欢认为我很值得信赖。如果你告诉我，也许我能以某种方式提供帮助。 [wo xi huan ren wei wo hen zhi de xin lai 。 ru guo ni gao su wo ， ye xu wo neng yi mou zhong fang shi ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: I have one idea. If you sacrifice your fire cape to me, I can take your word.
translation: 我有一个想法。如果你把你的火斗篷献给我，我就相信你的话。 [wo you yi ge xiang fa 。 ru guo ni ba ni de huo dou peng xian gei wo ， wo jiu xiang xin ni de hua 。]

english: Okay, I'd like to sacrifice my fire cape.
translation: 好吧，我愿意牺牲我的消防斗篷。 [hao ba ， wo yuan yi xi sheng wo de xiao fang dou peng 。]

english: Very well, just hand it over.
translation: 很好，就交给你吧。 [hen hao ， jiu jiao gei ni ba 。]

english: Sorry, I want to keep it for now.
translation: 抱歉，我想暂时保留它。 [bao qian ， wo xiang zan shi bao liu ta 。]

english: Thank you, JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name]. You can enter Inferno now.
translation: 谢谢你，JalYt-[种姓]-Xo-[玩家姓名]。你现在可以进入地狱了。 [xie xie ni ，JalYt-[ zhong xing ]-Xo-[ wan jia xing ming ]。 ni xian zai ke yi jin ru di yu le 。]

english: What should I do down there?
translation: 我应该在下面做什么？ [wo ying gai zai xia mian zuo shen me ？]

english: The creatures down there are dangerous. If you can kill some of them, it would be very helpful to TzHaar.
translation: 那里的生物很危险。如果你能杀死其中一些，那对茨哈尔来说会有很大帮助。 [na li de sheng wu hen wei xian 。 ru guo ni neng sha si qi zhong yi xie ， na dui ci ha er lai shuo hui you hen da bang zhu 。]

english: But now you can be trusted, I must also give warning. Another being lives in the Inferno, one more powerful than any TzHaar.
translation: 但现在你可以信任了，我也必须警告一下。另一种存在生活在地狱中，比任何 TzHaar 都更强大。 [dan xian zai ni ke yi xin ren le ， wo ye bi xu jing gao yi xia 。 ling yi zhong cun zai sheng huo zai di yu zhong ， bi ren he  TzHaar  dou geng qiang da 。]

english: Well I definitely think I can help with that.
translation: 嗯，我绝对认为我可以提供帮助。 [n ， wo jue dui ren wei wo ke yi ti gong bang zhu 。]

english: Thank you, JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name].
translation: 谢谢你，JalYt-[种姓]-Xo-[玩家姓名]。 [xie xie ni ，JalYt-[ zhong xing ]-Xo-[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: I'll need to take it off first.
translation: 我得先把它脱下来。 [wo de xian ba ta tuo xia lai 。]

english: I don't have a fire cape on me unfortunately.
translation: 不幸的是我身上没有消防斗篷。 [bu xing de shi wo shen shang mei you xiao fang dou peng 。]

english: Can I help here in some way?
translation: 我可以提供一些帮助吗？ [wo ke yi ti gong yi xie bang zhu ma ？]

english: I think maybe you can, but first you need to prove I can trust you.
translation: 我想也许你可以，但首先你需要证明我可以信任你。 [wo xiang ye xu ni ke yi ， dan shou xian ni xu yao zheng ming wo ke yi xin ren ni 。]

english: If you sacrifice your fire cape to me, I can take your word.
translation: 如果你把你的火斗篷献给我，我就相信你的话。 [ru guo ni ba ni de huo dou peng xian gei wo ， wo jiu xiang xin ni de hua 。]

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: A great power is starting to shake the cavern...
translation: 一股强大的力量开始震动洞窟…… [yi gu qiang da de li liang kai shi zhen dong dong ku ……]

english: No! TzKal-Zuk's prison is breaking down. There's nothing I can do for you now, JalYt!
translation: 不！茨卡尔祖克的监狱正在崩溃。我现在无能为力，JalYt！ [bu ！ ci ka er zu ke de jian yu zheng zai beng kui 。 wo xian zai wu neng wei li ，JalYt！]

english: You are very impressive for a JalYt. You managed to defeat TzKal-Zuk, for now...
translation: 对于一个 JalYt 人来说，你真是令人印象深刻。现在你已经成功击败了茨卡尔祖克…… [dui yu yi ge  JalYt  ren lai shuo ， ni zhen shi ling ren yin xiang shen ke 。 xian zai ni yi jing cheng gong ji bai le ci ka er zu ke ……]

english: Please accept this cape as a token of appreciation.
translation: 请收下这件斗篷作为谢意。 [qing shou xia zhe jian dou peng zuo wei xie yi 。]

english: Wow what has happened here? That doesn't look good!
translation: 哇这里发生了什么？看起来不太好！ [wa zhe li fa sheng le shen me ？ kan qi lai bu tai hao ！]

english: We pushed it too far! JalYt would not understand. The memories, we needed them. Now big Inferno.
translation: 我们把它推得太远了！ JalYt 不会明白。回忆，我们需要它们。现在是大地狱。 [wo men ba ta tui de tai yuan le ！ JalYt  bu hui ming bai 。 hui yi ， wo men xu yao ta men 。 xian zai shi da di yu 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This is our birthing pool. TzHaar are born from eggs incubated in this large pool here.
translation: 这是我们的分娩池。 TzHaar 是从在这个大水池中孵化的蛋中诞生的。 [zhe shi wo men de fen mian chi 。 TzHaar  shi cong zai zhe ge da shui chi zhong fu hua de dan zhong dan sheng de 。]

english: When hatched, we retain memories. Memories and knowledge passed on from ancestors who returned to the lava.
translation: 当孵化时，我们保留记忆。记忆和知识是从返回熔岩的祖先那里传承下来的。 [dang fu hua shi ， wo men bao liu ji yi 。 ji yi he zhi shi shi cong fan hui rong yan de zu xian na li chuan cheng xia lai de 。]

english: Something doesn't seem right... There's a large opening.
translation: 似乎有些不对劲……有一个很大的开口。 [si hu you xie bu dui jin …… you yi ge hen da de kai kou 。]

english: What happened here?
translation: 这里发生了什么？ [zhe li fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: We went too far... way too far, we need the memories. JalYt would not understand.
translation: 我们走得太远了……太远了，我们需要回忆。 JalYt 不会明白。 [wo men zou de tai yuan le …… tai yuan le ， wo men xu yao hui yi 。 JalYt  bu hui ming bai 。]

english: Please help me to understand then.
translation: 请帮助我理解。 [qing bang zhu wo li jie 。]

english: We TzHaar have special ability. When incubated in lava, a hatched TzHaar retains knowledge and memories of ancestors who returned to the lava.
translation: 我们 TzHaar 有特殊能力。当在熔岩中孵化时，孵化出来的 TzHaar 保留了返回熔岩的祖先的知识和记忆。 [wo men  TzHaar  you te shu neng li 。 dang zai rong yan zhong fu hua shi ， fu hua chu lai de  TzHaar  bao liu le fan hui rong yan de zu xian de zhi shi he ji yi 。]

english: Not all memories though, those about earliest ancestors were not being retained. We experiment.
translation: 但并不是所有的记忆都被保留下来，那些关于最早祖先的记忆也没有被保留下来。我们进行实验。 [dan bing bu shi suo you de ji yi dou bei bao liu xia lai ， na xie guan yu zui zao zu xian de ji yi ye mei you bei bao liu xia lai 。 wo men jin xing shi yan 。]

english: We increased the depth at which the eggs are incubated. Over time this worked, newly hatched TzHaar had more memories of lost history!
translation: 我们增加了鸡蛋孵化的深度。随着时间的推移，这种方法奏效了，新孵化的 TzHaar 对失落的历史有了更多的记忆！ [wo men zeng jia le ji dan fu hua de shen du 。 sui zhe shi jian de tui yi ， zhe zhong fang fa zou xiao le ， xin fu hua de  TzHaar  dui shi luo de li shi you le geng duo de ji yi ！]

english: That sounds fantastic though, uncovering the past to determine where your species originated?
translation: 揭开过去以确定你的物种起源于哪里，这听起来很棒吗？ [jie kai guo qu yi que ding ni de wu zhong qi yuan yu na li ， zhe ting qi lai hen bang ma ？]

english: Yes, but you JalYt do not understand, we kept pushing it. We wanted answers, but too deep we went.
translation: 是的，但你不明白，我们一直在推动它。我们想要答案，但我们陷得太深了。 [shi de ， dan ni bu ming bai ， wo men yi zhi zai tui dong ta 。 wo men xiang yao da an ， dan wo men xian de tai shen le 。]

english: Eventually the pool collapsed into a sink hole, huge Inferno there. This was big ancient incubation chamber.
translation: 最终，水池塌陷成一个污水坑，那里变成了巨大的地狱。这是古老的大型孵化室。 [zui zhong ， shui chi ta xian cheng yi ge wu shui keng ， na li bian cheng le ju da de di yu 。 zhe shi gu lao de da xing fu hua shi 。]

english: We decide to experiment. We take eggs from creatures in Fight Cave and incubate them.
translation: 我们决定进行实验。我们从战斗洞穴中的生物身上取出蛋并孵化它们。 [wo men jue ding jin xing shi yan 。 wo men cong zhan dou dong xue zhong de sheng wu shen shang qu chu dan bing fu hua ta men 。]

english: We hatched eggs in there and it was not a good decision. They were so different, bigger, stronger and fought each other for dominance.
translation: 我们在那里孵化鸡蛋，这不是一个好的决定。他们是如此不同，更大，更强，并且为了统治地位而互相争斗。 [wo men zai na li fu hua ji dan ， zhe bu shi yi ge hao de jue ding 。 ta men shi ru ci bu tong ， geng da ， geng qiang ， bing qie wei le tong zhi di wei er hu xiang zheng dou 。]

english: Instead of knowledge, we now have a prison of dangerous TzHaar creatures - it gets worse but I cannot trust JalYt with this knowledge yet.

translation: 嗯……看起来那只骆驼可以做一顿美味的烤肉串。 [n …… kan qi lai na zhi luo tuo ke yi zuo yi dun mei wei de kao rou chuan 。]

english: If I go near that camel, it'll probably bite my hand off.
translation: 如果我靠近那头骆驼，它可能会咬掉我的手。 [ru guo wo kao jin na tou luo tuo ， ta ke neng hui yao diao wo de shou 。]

english: I wonder if that camel has fleas...
translation: 我想知道那只骆驼有没有跳蚤... [wo xiang zhi dao na zhi luo tuo you mei you tiao zao ...]

english: The camel tries to stamp on your foot, but you pull it back quickly.
translation: 骆驼试图踩你的脚，但你很快就把它拉了回来。 [luo tuo shi tu cai ni de jiao ， dan ni hen kuai jiu ba ta la le hui lai 。]

english: The camel turns its head and glares at you.
translation: 骆驼转过头来瞪着你。 [luo tuo zhuan guo tou lai deng zhe ni 。]

english: The camel spits at you, and you jump back hurriedly.
translation: 骆驼向你吐口水，你赶紧向后跳去。 [luo tuo xiang ni tu kou shui ， ni gan jin xiang hou tiao qu 。]

english: Come over here, I'll bite your leg off!
translation: 过来，我咬断你的腿！ [guo lai ， wo yao duan ni de tui ！]

english: Prepare to die, you two-legged combat wrangler!
translation: 准备好受死吧，你这两条腿的战斗牧马人！ [zhun bei hao shou si ba ， ni zhe liang tiao tui de zhan dou mu ma ren ！]

english: Your mother was a jackal, and your father smelt of cactuses!
translation: 你的母亲是一只豺狼，你的父亲闻起来有仙人掌的味道！ [ni de mu qin shi yi zhi chai lang ， ni de fu qin wen qi lai you xian ren zhang de wei dao ！]

english: Say, aren't you the human who got arrested here the other day, by the boat?
translation: 喂，你不是前几天在船上被捕的那个人吗？ [wei ， ni bu shi qian ji tian zai chuan shang bei bu de na ge ren ma ？]

english: Yes, but we cleared up the whole situation.
translation: 是的，但我们已经澄清了整个情况。 [shi de ， dan wo men yi jing cheng qing le zheng ge qing kuang 。]

english: Right, right.
translation: 对，对。 [dui ， dui 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: What... Oh, don't creep up on me like that... I thought you were a Ghast!
translation: 什么...哦，别这样偷偷靠近我...我以为你是恶魂！ [shen me ... o ， bie zhe yang tou tou kao jin wo ... wo yi wei ni shi e hun ！]

english: Can I go through the gate please?
translation: 请问我可以进大门吗？ [qing wen wo ke yi jin da men ma ？]

english: Absolutely not! I've been given strict instructions not to let anyone through. It's just too dangerous. No one gets in without Drezelssay so!
translation: 绝对不是！我接到严格指示，不准任何人通过。这太危险了。没有 Drezelssay 就没有人能进去，所以！ [jue dui bu shi ！ wo jie dao yan ge zhi shi ， bu zhun ren he ren tong guo 。 zhe tai wei xian le 。 mei you  Drezelssay  jiu mei you ren neng jin qu ， suo yi ！]

english: Where is Drezel?
translation: 德雷泽尔在哪里？ [de lei ze er zai na li ？]

english: Oh, he's in the temple, just go back over the bridge, down the ladder and along the hallway, you can't miss him.
translation: 哦，他在寺庙里，只要过桥回去，顺着梯子，沿着走廊走，你就不会错过他的。 [o ， ta zai si miao li ， zhi yao guo qiao hui qu ， shun zhe ti zi ， yan zhe zou lang zou ， ni jiu bu hui cuo guo ta de 。]

english: But I'm doing a quest for Drezel!
translation: 但我正在寻找德雷泽尔！ [dan wo zheng zai xun zhao de lei ze er ！]

english: Ok, on your way then!
translation: 好的，那就上路吧！ [hao de ， na jiu shang lu ba ！]

english: Yes of course my friend, you seem to be able to handle yourself with those ghasts really well.
translation: 是的，当然，我的朋友，你似乎能够很好地应对那些恶魂。 [shi de ， dang ran ， wo de peng you ， ni si hu neng gou hen hao di ying dui na xie e hun 。]

english: Oh my! You're still alive!
translation: 天啊！你还活着！ [tian a ！ ni hai huo zhe ！]

english: Very well done! Here you go!
translation: 做得很好！干得好！ [zuo de hen hao ！ gan de hao ！]

english: Ulizius has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
translation: 乌利修斯给了你[另一条线索卷轴/一个棺材]！ [wu li xiu si gei le ni [ ling yi tiao xian suo juan zhou / yi ge guan cai ]！]

english: The serum it works...but it's not too fresh, make some yourself and then it might work for longer.
translation: 血清它有效......但它不是太新鲜，自己做一些，然后它可能会有效更长时间。 [xue qing ta you xiao ...... dan ta bu shi tai xin xian ， zi ji zuo yi xie ， ran hou ta ke neng hui you xiao geng zhang shi jian 。]

english: Ah, hello again, what can I do for you now?
translation: 啊，你好，现在有什么可以为你效劳的吗？ [a ， ni hao ， xian zai you shen me ke yi wei ni xiao lao de ma ？]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Hello again! Many thanks for helping us to solve the  riddle with the Shades, we can start to work now  putting all those Shade spirits to rest and get  a little bit of a reward to go along with it!
translation: 又好！非常感谢您帮助我们解决了阴影之谜，我们现在可以开始工作，让所有阴影灵魂得到安息，并获得一点奖励！ [you hao ！ fei chang gan xie nin bang zhu wo men jie jue le yin ying zhi mi ， wo men xian zai ke yi kai shi gong zuo ， rang suo you yin ying ling hun de dao an xi ， bing huo de yi dian jiang li ！]

english: Well done...I feel this serum is really working on me. I think you've cracked it my friend!  I'd like to give you something for your trouble!
translation: 干得好...我觉得这款精华液对我真的很有效。我想你已经破解了我的朋友！  我想给你一些东西来缓解你的麻烦！ [gan de hao ... wo jue de zhe kuan jing hua ye dui wo zhen de hen you xiao 。 wo xiang ni yi jing po jie le wo de peng you ！   wo xiang gei ni yi xie dong xi lai huan jie ni de ma fan ！]

english: You've already used the permanent serum on me, you don't need to use that any more.
translation: 你已经给我用过永久精华液了，不需要再用了。 [ni yi jing gei wo yong guo yong jiu jing hua ye le ， bu xu yao zai yong le 。]

english: You can't milk this cow, as its udders seem to have fallen off at some point.
translation: 你不能给这头牛挤奶，因为它的乳房似乎在某个时候已经脱落了。 [ni bu neng gei zhe tou niu ji nai ， yin wei ta de ru fang si hu zai mou ge shi hou yi jing tuo la le 。]

english: Hello there [laddie/lass].
translation: 你好[小伙子/姑娘]。 [ni hao [ xiao huo zi / gu niang ]。]

english: Tell me about the Wintertodt.
translation: 告诉我关于温特托特的事。 [gao su wo guan yu wen te tuo te de shi 。]

english: They say it's some kind of powerful fire spirit.
translation: 他们说这是某种强大的火灵。 [ta men shuo zhe shi mou zhong qiang da de huo ling 。]

english: Don't you mean ice?
translation: 你不是说冰吗？ [ni bu shi shuo bing ma ？]

english: Aye that as well.
translation: 是的，也是如此。 [shi de ， ye shi ru ci 。]

english: What it is doesn't bother me, just as long as we keep it behind the Doors.
translation: 它是什么并不困扰我，只要我们把它藏在门后就可以了。 [ta shi shen me bing bu kun rao wo ， zhi yao wo men ba ta cang zai men hou jiu ke yi le 。]

english: Tell me about the Doors of Dinh.
translation: 告诉我关于丁之门的事。 [gao su wo guan yu ding zhi men de shi 。]

english: The Doors were built by Dinh to contain the Wintertodt. This was over a thousand years ago and they still stand today.
translation: 大门是由丁建造的，用于遏制温特托特。这是一千多年前的事了，但今天它们仍然矗立着。 [da men shi you ding jian zao de ， yong yu e zhi wen te tuo te 。 zhe shi yi qian duo nian qian de shi le ， dan jin tian ta men reng ran chu li zhe 。]

english: Who was Dinh?
translation: 丁是谁？ [ding shi shui ？]

english: Dinh was the greatest smith that the world has ever seen. I am the finest smith around today and even I cannot match his abilities.
translation: 丁是世界上最伟大的铁匠。我是当今最优秀的铁匠，但即使是我也无法与他匹敌。 [ding shi shi jie shang zui wei da de tie jiang 。 wo shi dang jin zui you xiu de tie jiang ， dan ji shi shi wo ye wu fa yu ta pi di 。]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: The name's Undor. You'll struggle to find a dwarf in this land who knows more about metalwork than me.
translation: 名字叫安多尔。在这片土地上你很难找到一个比我更了解金属制品的矮人。 [ming zi jiao an duo er 。 zai zhe pian tu di shang ni hen nan zhao dao yi ge bi wo geng liao jie jin shu zhi pin de ai ren 。]

english: One day I hope to be as good as the legendary Dinh himself.
translation: 我希望有一天我能像传奇人物丁一样优秀。 [wo xi wang you yi tian wo neng xiang chuan qi ren wu ding yi yang you xiu 。]

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: They say the doors are failing and the Wintertodt is trying to escape. I'm here to prove to them that the Doors are fine.
translation: 他们说门坏了，温特托试图逃跑。我来这里是为了向他们证明大门很好。 [ta men shuo men huai le ， wen te tuo shi tu tao pao 。 wo lai zhe li shi wei le xiang ta men zheng ming da men hen hao 。]

english: And are they?
translation: 他们是吗？ [ta men shi ma ？]

english: Of course they are! They were made by Dinh himself.
translation: 当然是！它们是丁本人制作的。 [dang ran shi ！ ta men shi ding ben ren zhi zuo de 。]

english: I'm just here to keep an eye on things. Even though the Doors are fixed now, it will take many years for things to get back to normal.
translation: 我只是来关注事情的。尽管门现在已经修好了，但事情需要很多年才能恢复正常。 [wo zhi shi lai guan zhu shi qing de 。 jin guan men xian zai yi jing xiu hao le ， dan shi qing xu yao hen duo nian cai neng hui fu zheng chang 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Until next time [laddie/lass].
translation: 直到下次[小伙子/小姑娘]。 [zhi dao xia ci [ xiao huo zi / xiao gu niang ]。]

english: Tell me about the Wintertodt.
translation: 告诉我关于温特托特的事。 [gao su wo guan yu wen te tuo te de shi 。]

english: Tell me about the Doors of Dinh.
translation: 告诉我关于丁之门的事。 [gao su wo guan yu ding zhi men de shi 。]

english: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 说说你自己。 [shuo shuo ni zi ji 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Hi Unferth. How are you doing?
translation: 嗨恩弗斯。你好吗？ [hai en fu si 。 ni hao ma ？]

english: It's just not the same without Bob around.
translation: 没有鲍勃在身边，一切就不一样了。 [mei you bao bo zai shen bian ， yi qie jiu bu yi yang le 。]

english: I'm so sorry Unferth.
translation: 我很抱歉恩弗斯。 [wo hen bao qian en fu si 。]

english: Gertrude asked me if I'd like one of her new kittens. I don't think I'm ready for that yet.
translation: 格特鲁德问我是否想要她的一只新小猫。我认为我还没有准备好。 [ge te lu de wen wo shi fou xiang yao ta de yi zhi xin xiao mao 。 wo ren wei wo hai mei you zhun bei hao 。]

english: Give it time. Things will get better, I promise.
translation: 给它时间。事情会变得更好，我保证。 [gei ta shi jian 。 shi qing hui bian de geng hao ， wo bao zheng 。]

english: Thanks [player name].
translation: 谢谢[玩家姓名]。 [xie xie [ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Your Legendary exploits are travelling the whole jungle.
translation: 你的传奇功绩正在穿越整个丛林。 [ni de chuan qi gong ji zheng zai chuan yue zheng ge cong lin 。]

english: Gujuo has been to see me. He told me that you have been given a sacred totem pole. It was constructed by one of my ancestors many moons ago. It is a noble prize Bwana, you have earned it. Look after it well.
translation: 古驹来看过我。他告诉我你被赋予了一个神圣的图腾柱。它是我的一位祖先在许多个月前建造的。这是一个崇高的奖品 Bwana，你赢得了它。好好照顾它。 [gu ju lai kan guo wo 。 ta gao su wo ni bei fu yu le yi ge shen sheng de tu teng zhu 。 ta shi wo de yi wei zu xian zai xu duo ge yue qian jian zao de 。 zhe shi yi ge chong gao de jiang pin  Bwana， ni ying de le ta 。 hao hao zhao gu ta 。]

english: Ungadulu unleashes a bolt of magical energy at you. You're knocked out of the octagram by the power of the spell.
translation: 安加杜鲁向你释放一道魔法能量。你被咒语的力量从八角星中击倒了。 [an jia du lu xiang ni shi fang yi dao mo fa neng liang 。 ni bei zhou yu de li liang cong ba jiao xing zhong ji dao le 。]

english: I hope that teaches you to respect your elders!
translation: 希望你能学会尊重长辈！ [xi wang ni neng xue hui zun zhong zhang bei ！]

english: The spell fizzles and has no effect as it passes through the flames.
translation: 当法术穿过火焰时，它会熄灭并且没有任何效果。 [dang fa shu chuan guo huo yan shi ， ta hui xi mie bing qie mei you ren he xiao guo 。]

english: You feel certain that your weapon would melt if you tried to attack through these magical flames.
translation: 你确信如果你试图通过这些魔法火焰进行攻击，你的武器就会融化。 [ni que xin ru guo ni shi tu tong guo zhe xie mo fa huo yan jin xing gong ji ， ni de wu qi jiu hui rong hua 。]

english: You missed!
translation: 你错过了！ [ni cuo guo le ！]

english: The vial smashes on Ungadulu, soaking him in sacred water.
translation: 瓶子砸在了安加杜鲁身上，把他浸泡在圣水里。 [ping zi za zai le an jia du lu shen shang ， ba ta jin pao zai sheng shui li 。]

english: Vile serpent, thou wilt pay for that!
translation: 可恶的蛇，你会付出代价的！ [ke wu de she ， ni hui fu chu dai jia de ！]

english: ...What, what happened? Why am I all wet?
translation: ……什么、发生了什么事？为什么我浑身湿透了？ […… shen me 、 fa sheng le shen me shi ？ wei shen me wo hun shen shi tou le ？]

english: Please, just run...
translation: 拜托，快跑吧…… [bai tuo ， kuai pao ba ……]

english: The shaman seems to be fighting an inner battle.
translation: 萨满似乎正在进行一场内心的战斗。 [sa man si hu zheng zai jin xing yi chang nei xin de zhan dou 。]

english: The shaman's expression changes entirely.
translation: 萨满的表情彻底变了。 [sa man de biao qing che di bian le 。]

english: Welcome Vacu, to eternal...
translation: 欢迎真空，来到永恒…… [huan ying zhen kong ， lai dao yong heng ……]

english: Foolish Vacu... now thou shalt be my pawn...
translation: 愚蠢的真空……现在你将成为我的棋子…… [yu chun de zhen kong …… xian zai ni jiang cheng wei wo de qi zi ……]

english: The thing that was the shaman begins to chant...
translation: 那个萨满的东西开始吟唱…… [na ge sa man de dong xi kai shi yin chang ……]

english: Iles Resti Yam Darkus Spiritus Possesi Yanai...
translation: Iles Resti Yam Darkus Spiritus Possesi Yanai... [Iles Resti Yam Darkus Spiritus Possesi Yanai...]

english: You feel a strange power coming over you...
translation: 你感觉到一股奇怪的力量向你袭来…… [ni gan jue dao yi gu qi guai de li liang xiang ni xi lai ……]

english: You feel very weak..
translation: 你感觉很虚弱.. [ni gan jue hen xu ruo ..]

english: The thing seems to get stronger!
translation: 那东西似乎变得更强了！ [na dong xi si hu bian de geng qiang le ！]

english: Run, Bwana! Stay away from here!
translation: 奔跑吧，布瓦纳！远离这里！ [ben pao ba ， bu wa na ！ yuan li zhe li ！]

english: Just in time, the shaman wrests back control.
translation: 萨满及时夺回了控制权。 [sa man ji shi duo hui le kong zhi quan 。]

english: Thank you, Bwana! You have released me from the demon's grasp, but only for a short while! You must seek out the Book of Binding - it's hidden in these caves somewhere!.
translation: 谢谢你，布瓦纳！你把我从恶魔的掌握中释放了出来，但只是很短的时间！你必须找到束缚之书——它就藏在这些洞穴的某个地方！ [xie xie ni ， bu wa na ！ ni ba wo cong e mo de zhang wo zhong shi fang le chu lai ， dan zhi shi hen duan de shi jian ！ ni bi xu zhao dao shu fu zhi shu —— ta jiu cang zai zhe xie dong xue de mou ge di fang ！]

english: There are many trials you must pass... but please, you're my only hope of escape!
translation: 你必须通过许多考验……但求你了，你是我逃脱的唯一希望！ [ni bi xu tong guo xu duo kao yan …… dan qiu ni le ， ni shi wo tao tuo de wei yi xi wang ！]

english: You open the Book of Binding in front of Ungadulu and a supernatural light emanates from the pages. Ungadulu's face twists and contorts in wild spasms.
translation: 你在安加杜鲁面前打开《束缚之书》，书页中散发出超自然的光芒。安加杜鲁的脸因剧烈痉挛而扭曲变形。 [ni zai an jia du lu mian qian da kai 《 shu fu zhi shu 》， shu ye zhong san fa chu chao zi ran de guang mang 。 an jia du lu de lian yin ju lie jing luan er niu qu bian xing 。]

english: Curse you... foul intruder... wretched Vacu! Thy meddling ways hath brought thee to thy doom!
translation: 诅咒你……肮脏的入侵者……可怜的真空！你的多管闲事已经给你带来了灭顶之灾！ [zu zhou ni …… ang zang de ru qin zhe …… ke lian de zhen kong ！ ni de duo guan xian shi yi jing gei ni dai lai le mie ding zhi zai ！]

english: Ungadulu drops to the floor, unconscious. From his prone body rises the shape of an enormous, angry demon...
translation: 安加杜鲁倒在地上，不省人事。从他俯卧的身体中升起一个巨大、愤怒的恶魔的形状…… [an jia du lu dao zai di shang ， bu xing ren shi 。 cong ta fu wo de shen ti zhong sheng qi yi ge ju da 、 fen nu de e mo de xing zhuang ……]

english: Nezikchened: Thy faith will help you little here.
translation: Nezikchened：你的信仰在这里对你帮助不大。 [Nezikchened： ni de xin yang zai zhe li dui ni bang zhu bu da 。]

english: A sense of hopelessness fills your body...
translation: 一种绝望的感觉充斥着你的全身…… [yi zhong jue wang de gan jue chong chi zhe ni de quan shen ……]

english: At the next council meeting, I'm going to recommend that we change the guards' uniform to be red.
translation: 在下次理事会会议上，我将建议我们将警卫的制服改为红色。 [zai xia ci li shi hui hui yi shang ， wo jiang jian yi wo men jiang jing wei de zhi fu gai wei hong se 。]

english: Why?
translation: 为什么？ [wei shen me ？]

english: We have surface-dwellers coming down into our mines and our city now, and remember that they don't have very good eyesight.
translation: 现在，我们有地表居民进入我们的矿山和城市，请记住，他们的视力不太好。 [xian zai ， wo men you di biao ju min jin ru wo men de kuang shan he cheng shi ， qing ji zhu ， ta men de shi li bu tai hao 。]

english: I worry that they can't see our guards very clearly in the dark. It is important for a guard to be seen.
translation: 我担心他们在黑暗中看不清我们的警卫。让守卫被人看到很重要。 [wo dan xin ta men zai hei an zhong kan bu qing wo men de jing wei 。 rang shou wei bei ren kan dao hen zhong yao 。]

english: You have a point. But I don't think red would be the best colour. It is the colour of blood, so it might give the wrong impression.
translation: 你说得有道理。但我不认为红色是最好的颜色。它是血的颜色，所以可能会给人错误的印象。 [ni shuo de you dao li 。 dan wo bu ren wei hong se shi zui hao de yan se 。 ta shi xue de yan se ， suo yi ke neng hui gei ren cuo wu de yin xiang 。]

english: What colour do you suggest, then?
translation: 那你建议什么颜色？ [na ni jian yi shen me yan se ？]

english: I suggest green. I have heard that the plants that grow on the surface are mostly green, so surface-dwellers might find that colour soothing.
translation: 我建议绿色。我听说生长在地表的植物大多是绿色的，所以地表居民可能会觉得这种颜色很舒缓。 [wo jian yi lv se 。 wo ting shuo sheng zhang zai di biao de zhi wu da duo shi lv se de ， suo yi di biao ju min ke neng hui jue de zhe zhong yan se hen shu huan 。]

english: No, I disagree. Guards should not be soothing, they should be seen as formidable. Red will give the correct impression.

english: Don't say it! What if they hear?

english: Because they're so powerful, of course!

english: In the time of the great war, they forced all the goblin tribes to fight one another. Our ancestors weren't powerful enough to stand up to them.

english: We've hidden down here for this long, but now the way to the surface is open, what if they find us again?

english: Goodbye.

english: No! How could you even suggest that? We're not going to worship some supernatural being just because it's bigger and more powerful than us.
translation: 不！你怎么能提出这样的建议呢？我们不会仅仅因为某些超自然生物比我们更大、更强大而崇拜它。 [bu ！ ni zen me neng ti chu zhe yang de jian yi ne ？ wo men bu hui jin jin yin wei mou xie chao zi ran sheng wu bi wo men geng da 、 geng qiang da er chong bai ta 。]

english: Headman Ur-tag, I cannot stress enough how important it is that this train link be completed on time. The mining companies have taken out considerable loans...
translation: 校长乌尔塔格，我无法充分强调按时完成这条火车线路的重要性。矿业公司已经获得了大量贷款...... [xiao zhang wu er ta ge ， wo wu fa chong fen qiang diao an shi wan cheng zhe tiao huo che xian lu de zhong yao xing 。 kuang ye gong si yi jing huo de le da liang dai kuan ......]

english: I understand your concerns, Ambassador, but you must realise that the discoveries must change the whole schedule. To remove them too hurriedly would be a crime against knowledge.
translation: 大使，我理解您的担忧，但您必须意识到这些发现必须改变整个日程。太仓促地消除它们将是对知识的犯罪。 [da shi ， wo li jie nin de dan you ， dan nin bi xu yi shi dao zhe xie fa xian bi xu gai bian zheng ge ri cheng 。 tai cang cu di xiao chu ta men jiang shi dui zhi shi de fan zui 。]

english: What are you talking about?
translation: 你在说什么？ [ni zai shuo shen me ？]

english: It's the new underground train link being built between our city and the dwarven city of Keldagrim.
translation: 这是我们城市和矮人城市凯尔达格林之间正在修建的新地铁线路。 [zhe shi wo men cheng shi he ai ren cheng shi kai er da ge lin zhi jian zheng zai xiu jian de xin di tie xian lu 。]

english: It will be the pinnacle of dwarven engineering! A great leap forward from the old steam-powered minecarts! A monument to the power and ingenuity of the Consortium!
translation: 这将是矮人工程学的顶峰！与老式蒸汽动力矿车相比，这是一个巨大的飞跃！联盟力量和智慧的纪念碑！ [zhe jiang shi ai ren gong cheng xue de ding feng ！ yu lao shi zheng qi dong li kuang che xiang bi ， zhe shi yi ge ju da de fei yue ！ lian meng li liang he zhi hui de ji nian bei ！]

english: And it would be finished by now, except that they found some old goblin bones they want to dig up.
translation: 现在应该已经完成​​了，只是他们发现了一些他们想要挖掘的旧妖精骨头。 [xian zai ying gai yi jing wan cheng ​​ le ， zhi shi ta men fa xian le yi xie ta men xiang yao wa jue de jiu yao jing gu tou 。]

english: We've unearthed some very important artefacts that were buried during the Dorgeshuun Civil War. They could shed important light on our history.
translation: 我们发掘了多尔格舒恩内战期间埋藏的一些非常重要的文物。它们可以为我们的历史提供重要的启示。 [wo men fa jue le duo er ge shu en nei zhan qi jian mai cang de yi xie fei chang zhong yao de wen wu 。 ta men ke yi wei wo men de li shi ti gong zhong yao de qi shi 。]

english: [player name], do you have any experience with archaeology?
translation: [玩家姓名]，你有考古经验吗？ [[ wan jia xing ming ]， ni you kao gu jing yan ma ？]

english: I passed my archaeology exam at the Digsite!
translation: 我通过了挖掘场的考古学考试！ [wo tong guo le wa jue chang de kao gu xue kao shi ！]

english: Excellent! We have not had a major archaeological project for generations, so if you could give us some help we would appreciate it.
translation: 出色的！我们几代人都没有进行过重大的考古项目，所以如果您能给我们一些帮助，我们将不胜感激。 [chu se de ！ wo men ji dai ren dou mei you jin xing guo zhong da de kao gu xiang mu ， suo yi ru guo nin neng gei wo men yi xie bang zhu ， wo men jiang bu sheng gan ji 。]

english: I'd love to help!
translation: 我很乐意帮忙！ [wo hen le yi bang mang ！]

english: Splendid! The path to the train tunnel is in the south- west of the city.
translation: 灿烂！通往火车隧道的道路位于城市的西南部。 [can lan ！ tong wang huo che sui dao de dao lu wei yu cheng shi de xi nan bu 。]

english: Perhaps now we can get this finished quickly and get on with laying the tracks.
translation: 也许现在我们可以快速完成这件事并继续铺设铁轨。 [ye xu xian zai wo men ke yi kuai su wan cheng zhe jian shi bing ji xu pu she tie gui 。]

english: Do your own digging!
translation: 自己挖吧！ [zi ji wa ba ！]

english: Oh well. We will continue at our own pace.
translation: 那好吧。我们将继续按照自己的节奏进行。 [na hao ba 。 wo men jiang ji xu an zhao zi ji de jie zou jin xing 。]

english: What can I do in the city?
translation: 在城市里我能做什么？ [zai cheng shi li wo neng zuo shen me ？]

english: Why don't you visit the market? I hear there is quite a craze for surface foods at the moment, so you might be able to sell something there.
translation: 你为什么不去市场看看？我听说现在表面食品很受欢迎，所以你也许可以在那里卖点东西。 [ni wei shen me bu qu shi chang kan kan ？ wo ting shuo xian zai biao mian shi pin hen shou huan ying ， suo yi ni ye xu ke yi zai na li mai dian dong xi 。]

english: You might also want to visit the caves to the south of the city. There are many monsters to fight there, and Zanik apparently found ways to cross over their heads!
translation: 您可能还想参观城市南部的洞穴。那里有很多怪物需要战斗，扎尼克显然找到了越过它们的方法！ [nin ke neng hai xiang can guan cheng shi nan bu de dong xue 。 na li you hen duo guai wu xu yao zhan dou ， zha ni ke xian ran zhao dao le yue guo ta men de fang fa ！]

english: Why did you decide to open the city?
translation: 为什么决定开城？ [wei shen me jue ding kai cheng ？]

english: For trade, and for fostering goodwill between races! I am sure that it will benefit both our races.
translation: 为了贸易，为了促进种族之间的友好关系！我相信这将使我们两个种族受益。 [wei le mao yi ， wei le cu jin zhong zu zhi jian de you hao guan xi ！ wo xiang xin zhe jiang shi wo men liang ge zhong zu shou yi 。]

english: Greetings, surface-dweller. Welcome to Dorgesh-Kaan.

translation: 哦，帕特多莫斯是萨尔夫岛上那座看起来相当令人印象深刻的神庙……我相信你在前往莫里塔尼亚的路上一定经过了它。 [o ， pa te duo mo si shi sa er fu dao shang na zuo kan qi lai xiang dang ling ren yin xiang shen ke de shen miao …… wo xiang xin ni zai qian wang mo li ta ni ya de lu shang yi ding jing guo le ta 。]

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
translation: 你为什么要去帕特多莫斯？ [ni wei shen me yao qu pa te duo mo si ？]

english: I'm hoping to get back to civilisation and see what the lands of Misthalin look like.
translation: 我希望回到文明世界，看看米沙林的土地是什么样子。 [wo xi wang hui dao wen ming shi jie ， kan kan mi sha lin de tu di shi shen me yang zi 。]

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Paterdomus?
translation: 如果我们在前往帕特多莫斯的路上遇到敌人，你能保护自己吗？ [ru guo wo men zai qian wang pa te duo mo si de lu shang yu dao di ren ， ni neng bao hu zi ji ma ？]

english: I can defend myself somewhat if we run into trouble...yes, but let's hope that we don't, eh!
translation: 如果我们遇到麻烦，我可以在某种程度上保护自己……是的，但我们希望我们不会，嗯！ [ru guo wo men yu dao ma fan ， wo ke yi zai mou zhong cheng du shang bao hu zi ji …… shi de ， dan wo men xi wang wo men bu hui ， n ！]

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
translation: 我可以带你去帕特多莫斯。 [wo ke yi dai ni qu pa te duo mo si 。]

english: Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: 嗯嗯，看来你有追随者了。我想如果让它独自徘徊的话，它可能会在这段旅程中迷路。等你的追随者安全了我们就离开吧。 [n n ， kan lai ni you zhui sui zhe le 。 wo xiang ru guo rang ta du zi pai huai de hua ， ta ke neng hui zai zhe duan lv cheng zhong mi lu 。 deng ni de zhui sui zhe an quan le wo men jiu li kai ba 。]

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: 哦真的吗？那太好了！到达目的地后我会给你一个小奖励。 [o zhen de ma ？ na tai hao le ！ dao da mu di di hou wo hui gei ni yi ge xiao jiang li 。]

english: Temple Trekking begins
translation: 寺庙徒步开始 [si miao tu bu kai shi]

english: Ok, which route should we take?
translation: 好的，我们应该走哪条路？ [hao de ， wo men ying gai zou na tiao lu ？]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: 啊，所以你想给我一些物资，嗯？让我打开背包。 [a ， suo yi ni xiang gei wo yi xie wu zi ， n ？ rang wo da kai bei bao 。]

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than staying in Burgh de Rott.
translation: 哦，我讨厌这次旅行，但这比呆在 Burgh de Rott 好。 [o ， wo tao yan zhe ci lv xing ， dan zhe bi dai zai  Burgh de Rott  hao 。]

english: It's scary here...let's get going!
translation: 这里太可怕了……我们走吧！ [zhe li tai ke pa le …… wo men zou ba ！]

english: When are we going to get to Paterdomus?
translation: 我们什么时候去帕特多莫斯？ [wo men shen me shi hou qu pa te duo mo si ？]

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on.
translation: 我们没有一整天的时间站着聊天；让我们继续努力吧。 [wo men mei you yi zheng tian de shi jian zhan zhe liao tian ； rang wo men ji xu nu li ba 。]

english: Do you visit Paterdomus often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: 您经常拜访Paterdomus吗？看来你很熟悉这条路。 [nin jing chang bai fang Paterdomus ma ？ kan lai ni hen shu xi zhe tiao lu 。]

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...?
translation: 你没看到我正在被攻击吗……？ [ni mei kan dao wo zheng zai bei gong ji ma ……？]

english: Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
translation: 谢谢，我会把这个放在脖子上。 [xie xie ， wo hui ba zhe ge fang zai bo zi shang 。]

english: Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Burgh de Rott. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: 天啊！看来我们得回 Burgh de Rott 了。我们过不了那座桥！ [tian a ！ kan lai wo men de hui  Burgh de Rott  le 。 wo men guo bu liao na zuo qiao ！]

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
translation: 哦，我相信我们能找到办法！ [o ， wo xiang xin wo men neng zhao dao ban fa ！]

english: Player completes the bridge event
translation: 玩家完成桥牌事件 [wan jia wan cheng qiao pai shi jian]

english: Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 好吧，这已经被撕裂了……看起来我们无法越过这个沼泽。我们得返回 Burgh de Rott。 [hao ba ， zhe yi jing bei si lie le …… kan qi lai wo men wu fa yue guo zhe ge zhao ze 。 wo men de fan hui  Burgh de Rott。]

english: Player completes the bog event
translation: 玩家完成沼泽事件 [wan jia wan cheng zhao ze shi jian]

english: Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: 嘿……太好了……你做得很好……我会关注你的。 [hei …… tai hao le …… ni zuo de hen hao …… wo hui guan zhu ni de 。]

english: Whahay...that was great!
translation: 哇……那太好了！ [wa …… na tai hao le ！]

english: But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 但我们现在真的应该出发了。 [dan wo men xian zai zhen de ying gai chu fa le 。]

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
translation: 哦，我相信我们能找到办法！ [o ， wo xiang xin wo men neng zhao dao ban fa ！]

english: Player completes the river event
translation: 玩家完成河牌事件 [wan jia wan cheng he pai shi jian]

english: That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: 太棒了！我也必须这样做。 [tai bang le ！ wo ye bi xu zhe yang zuo 。]

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 哇哈！那很棒！但我们现在真的应该出发了。 [wa ha ！ na hen bang ！ dan wo men xian zai zhen de ying gai chu fa le 。]

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
translation: 呃……那些气泡是什么？ [e …… na xie qi pao shi shen me ？]

english: This is scary!
translation: 这太可怕了！ [zhe tai ke pa le ！]

english: Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
translation: 啊啊啊，那应该是触手吧…… [a a a ， na ying gai shi chu shou ba ……]

english: Ahhh, two tentacles!
translation: 啊啊啊，两条触手！ [a a a ， liang tiao chu shou ！]

english: ...three tentacles!
translation: ……三根触手！ […… san gen chu shou ！]

english: I think I'm going to faint!
translation: 我想我要晕倒了！ [wo xiang wo yao yun dao le ！]

english: Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: 天啊！看看那只野兽！你得自己解决这件事！ [tian a ！ kan kan na zhi ye shou ！ ni de zi ji jie jue zhe jian shi ！]

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the temple. Here's your reward.
translation: 非常感谢您让我安全到达寺庙。这是你的奖励。 [fei chang gan xie nin rang wo an quan dao da si miao 。 zhe shi ni de jiang li 。]

english: Valantay Eppel gives you a reward token!
translation: Valantay Eppel 为您提供奖励代币！ [Valantay Eppel  wei nin ti gong jiang li dai bi ！]

english: Where is Paterdomus?
translation: 帕特多莫斯在哪里？ [pa te duo mo si zai na li ？]

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
translation: 你为什么要去帕特多莫斯？ [ni wei shen me yao qu pa te duo mo si ？]

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
translation: 如果我们遇到敌人，你能保护自己吗……？ [ru guo wo men yu dao di ren ， ni neng bao hu zi ji ma ……？]

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
translation: 我可以带你去帕特多莫斯。 [wo ke yi dai ni qu pa te duo mo si 。]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!
translation: 呜？  呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜！ [wu ？   wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu ！]

english: You don't say?
translation: 你不说？ [ni bu shuo ？]

english: Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
translation: 哇！呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜！ [wa ！ wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu ！]

english: You don't say!
translation: 你不说！ [ni bu shuo ！]

english: Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
translation: 呜呜呜……呜呜呜？呜呜呜呜呜呜呜！ [wu wu wu …… wu wu wu ？ wu wu wu wu wu wu wu ！]

english: Well, I guess you didn't say.
translation: 嗯，我猜你没说。 [n ， wo cai ni mei shuo 。]

english: Yeah, I don't want to brag, but seriously: I am SOOOO rich....
translation: 是的，我不想吹牛，但说真的：我太有钱了…… [shi de ， wo bu xiang chui niu ， dan shuo zhen de ： wo tai you qian le ……]

english: Yeah, I know they say money doesn't bring you happiness, but sometimes I just like to open my bank account and look at all of the stuff I own and just think to myself:
translation: 是的，我知道他们说金钱不会给你带来幸福，但有时我只是喜欢打开我的银行账户，看看我拥有的所有东西，然后心里想： [shi de ， wo zhi dao ta men shuo jin qian bu hui gei ni dai lai xing fu ， dan you shi wo zhi shi xi huan da kai wo de yin hang zhang hu ， kan kan wo yong you de suo you dong xi ， ran hou xin li xiang ：]

english: Wow. I am soooooo rich.
translation: 哇。我太有钱了。 [wa 。 wo tai you qian le 。]

english: Well, us rich alive people don't want to waste all day spending time with you poor dead people, because I'm just sooooo rich I have to go now, and very possibly make myself even richer.
translation: 好吧，我们活着的富人不想浪费一整天的时间和你们这些可怜的死人在一起，因为我太富有了，我现在必须走了，而且很可能让自己变得更富有。 [hao ba ， wo men huo zhe de fu ren bu xiang lang fei yi zheng tian de shi jian he ni men zhe xie ke lian de si ren zai yi qi ， yin wei wo tai fu you le ， wo xian zai bi xu zou le ， er qie hen ke neng rang zi ji bian de geng fu you 。]

english: See ya around ghosty!
translation: 幽灵见！ [you ling jian ！]

english: Yeah, I heard about that, ha-ha-ha!
translation: 是的，我听说过，哈哈哈！ [shi de ， wo ting shuo guo ， ha ha ha ！]

english: With a MACKEREL? Ouch!
translation: 和鲭鱼一起？哎哟! [he qing yu yi qi ？ ai yo !]

english: Well, it was fun. Let's do it again sometime.
translation: 嗯，很有趣。我们找个时间再做一次吧。 [n ， hen you qu 。 wo men zhao ge shi jian zai zuo yi ci ba 。]

english: Why, thank you very much!
translation: 为什么，非常感谢！ [wei shen me ， fei chang gan xie ！]

english: I know, but what are you going to do?
translation: 我知道，但是你要做什么？ [wo zhi dao ， dan shi ni yao zuo shen me ？]

english: Well, I guess that's always true in the long run. See you around, weird invisible dead person!
translation: 嗯，我想从长远来看这总是正确的。再见，奇怪的隐形死人！ [n ， wo xiang cong chang yuan lai kan zhe zong shi zheng que de 。 zai jian ， qi guai de yin xing si ren ！]

english: Yeah it's not bad, but I prefer cooked chicken.
translation: 是的，不错，但我更喜欢煮熟的鸡肉。 [shi de ， bu cuo ， dan wo geng xi huan zhu shu de ji rou 。]

english: Maybe, but nothing beats a home cooked pie!
translation: 也许吧，但没有什么比自制的馅饼更好的了！ [ye xu ba ， dan mei you shen me bi zi zhi de xian bing geng hao de le ！]

english: Man, I love pie!
translation: 伙计，我喜欢馅饼！ [huo ji ， wo xi huan xian bing ！]

english: You don't say? I never knew that. Well, I must be going, see you around.
translation: 你不说？我从来不知道这一点。好吧，我得走了，回头见。 [ni bu shuo ？ wo cong lai bu zhi dao zhe yi dian 。 hao ba ， wo de zou le ， hui tou jian 。]

english: We get signal!
translation: 我们收到信号了！ [wo men shou dao xin hao le ！]

english: Somebody set up us the bomb!
translation: 有人给我们安放了炸弹！ [you ren gei wo men an fang le zha dan ！]

english: You have no chance to survive make your time.
translation: 你没有机会生存，请腾出时间。 [ni mei you ji hui sheng cun ， qing teng chu shi jian 。]

english: Woo?
translation: 呜？ [wu ？]

english: All your base are belong to us.
translation: 你所有的基地都属于我们。 [ni suo you de ji di dou shu yu wo men 。]

english: Hey, don't think you can talk to me like that!
translation: 嘿，别以为你可以这样跟我说话！ [hei ， bie yi wei ni ke yi zhe yang gen wo shuo hua ！]

english: Are you threatening me?
translation: 你在威胁我吗？ [ni zai wei xie wo ma ？]

english: Just because you're already dead, doesn't mean I can't find a way to hurt you ghosty!
translation: 你已经死了，并不代表我就找不到办法伤害你！ [ni yi jing si le ， bing bu dai biao wo jiu zhao bu dao ban fa shang hai ni ！]

english: No, I've never been there in my life and CERTAINLY didn't steal anything when I was!
translation: 不，我这辈子从来没有去过那里，当然也没有偷过任何东西！ [bu ， wo zhe bei zi cong lai mei you qu guo na li ， dang ran ye mei you tou guo ren he dong xi ！]

english: Are you calling me a liar?!?! I have never stolen a thing in my life, and I resent the implication that I am the kind of morally depraved individual that would steal someone else's hard earned
translation: 你骂我是骗子吗？！？！我一生中从未偷过任何东西，而且我很讨厌别人说我是那种道德败坏的人，会偷别人辛苦赚来的东西。 [ni ma wo shi pian zi ma ？！？！ wo yi sheng zhong cong wei tou guo ren he dong xi ， er qie wo hen tao yan bie ren shuo wo shi na zhong dao de bai huai de ren ， hui tou bie ren xin ku zhuan lai de dong xi 。]

english: money from their very pockets!
translation: 钱是从他们的口袋里掏出来的！ [qian shi cong ta men de kou dai li tao chu lai de ！]

english: Or cakes. Or fur. Repeatedly. For long periods at a time.
translation: 或者蛋糕。或者毛皮。反复。一次持续很长时间。 [huo zhe dan gao 。 huo zhe mao pi 。 fan fu 。 yi ci chi xu hen zhang shi jian 。]

english: Well if you are going to take that attitude, then I have nothing further to say on the matter, and bid you good day!
translation: 好吧，如果您打算采取这种态度，那么我对此事无话可说，祝您早安！ [hao ba ， ru guo nin da suan cai qu zhe zhong tai du ， na me wo dui ci shi wu hua ke shuo ， zhu nin zao an ！]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: H-hello!
translation: 哈-你好！ [ha - ni hao ！]

english: So what's up?
translation: 那么这是什么一回事？ [na me zhe shi shen me yi hui shi ？]

english: I cannot believe it! You can see me? You understand my words?
translation: 我简直不敢相信！你能看到我吗？你明白我的话吗？ [wo jian zhi bu gan xiang xin ！ ni neng kan dao wo ma ？ ni ming bai wo de hua ma ？]

english: Sure can. So why are you hanging around here?
translation: 当然可以。那你为什么还在这里闲逛？ [dang ran ke yi 。 na ni wei shen me hai zai zhe li xian guang ？]

english: My tale is one of woe... No doubt you will have little interest in hearing it...
translation: 我的故事是一个悲惨的故事……毫无疑问，你不会有兴趣听它…… [wo de gu shi shi yi ge bei can de gu shi …… hao wu yi wen ， ni bu hui you xing qu ting ta ……]

english: Though it has been so many moons since last I had company in this endless non-life...
translation: 虽然距离上次已经过去了很多个月，但我在这无尽的非生命中还有陪伴…… [sui ran ju li shang ci yi jing guo qu le hen duo ge yue ， dan wo zai zhe wu jin de fei sheng ming zhong hai you pei ban ……]

english: Well, actually I would like to know what happened to you to turn you into an invisible ghost.
translation: 好吧，其实我很想知道你到底发生了什么事情，让你变成了一个看不见的幽灵。 [hao ba ， qi shi wo hen xiang zhi dao ni dao di fa sheng le shen me shi qing ， rang ni bian cheng le yi ge kan bu jian de you ling 。]

english: If only so I can make sure it doesn't happen to me...
translation: 如果这样我就可以确保这不会发生在我身上...... [ru guo zhe yang wo jiu ke yi que bao zhe bu hui fa sheng zai wo shen shang ......]

english: My name is Valdez. I served my Lord Saradomin faithfully for many years, as an explorer of this strange land we had been brought to.
translation: 我叫瓦尔迪兹。作为我们被带到这片陌生土地的探险家，我忠实地侍奉了萨拉多明勋爵很多年。 [wo jiao wa er di zi 。 zuo wei wo men bei dai dao zhe pian mo sheng tu di de tan xian jia ， wo zhong shi di shi feng le sa la duo ming xun jue hen duo nian 。]

english: I remember the day this curse fell upon me clearly... I had just discovered a huge temple, hidden below the ground, of one of Saradomin's compatriots.
translation: 我清楚地记得这个诅咒降临在我身上的那一天……我刚刚发现了一座巨大的神庙，隐藏在地下，是萨拉多明的一位同胞的。 [wo qing chu di ji de zhe ge zu zhou jiang lin zai wo shen shang de na yi tian …… wo gang gang fa xian le yi zuo ju da de shen miao ， yin cang zai di xia ， shi sa la duo ming de yi wei tong bao de 。]

english: I am unsure who had built it, or why they had left it seemingly abandoned, but inside I located a great treasure...
translation: 我不确定是谁建造了它，或者为什么他们让它看似被遗弃，但在里面我发现了一个巨大的宝藏...... [wo bu que ding shi shui jian zao le ta ， huo zhe wei shen me ta men rang ta kan shi bei yi qi ， dan zai li mian wo fa xian le yi ge ju da de bao zang ......]

english: It was the godstaff of Armadyl. Oh, how I rue my choice that day!
translation: 这是阿玛迪尔的神杖。哦，我多么后悔那天的选择啊！ [zhe shi a ma di er de shen zhang 。 o ， wo duo me hou hui na tian de xuan ze a ！]

english: Choice?
translation: 选择？ [xuan ze ？]

english: Aye, stranger. I chose that day to take it so that my Lord Saradomin's power and prestige could be increased by its possession.
translation: 是的，陌生人。我选择这一天来夺取它，是为了让我的萨拉多明勋爵的权力和威望能够通过拥有它而增加。 [shi de ， mo sheng ren 。 wo xuan ze zhe yi tian lai duo qu ta ， shi wei le rang wo de sa la duo ming xun jue de quan li he wei wang neng gou tong guo yong you ta er zeng jia 。]

english: A god-weapon! Do you have any comprehension of the difficulty and rarity in obtaining such a thing?
translation: 神器！你了解获得这样东西的难度和稀有吗？ [shen qi ！ ni liao jie huo de zhe yang dong xi de nan du he xi you ma ？]

english: To find such an artefact of power just lying around, it is almost incomprehensible...
translation: 竟然发现这样一件拥有力量的神器就这样随处可见，这几乎是不可理解的…… [jing ran fa xian zhe yang yi jian yong you li liang de shen qi jiu zhe yang sui chu ke jian ， zhe ji hu shi bu ke li jie de ……]

english: So it was there in that deserted temple that I made my choice. I took the staff, and left that temple for Entrana immediately.
translation: 所以我就是在那座废弃的寺庙里做出了我的选择。我拿着手杖，立即离开那座寺庙前往恩特拉纳。 [suo yi wo jiu shi zai na zuo fei qi de si miao li zuo chu le wo de xuan ze 。 wo na zhuo shou zhang ， li ji li kai na zuo si miao qian wang en te la na 。]

english: This was the cause of my cursed state.
translation: 这就是我陷入被诅咒状态的原因。 [zhe jiu shi wo xian ru bei zu zhou zhuang tai de yuan yin 。]

english: What, you mean you gave it to Saradomin and in return he cursed you???
translation: 什么，你的意思是你把它给了萨拉多明，而他却诅咒了你？？？ [shen me ， ni de yi si shi ni ba ta gei le sa la duo ming ， er ta que zu zhou le ni ？？？]

english: Seems kind of ungrateful if you ask me...
translation: 如果你问我的话，我似乎有点忘恩负义...... [ru guo ni wen wo de hua ， wo si hu you dian wang en fu yi ......]
