translation: 您可能已经知道，根据国王的命令，这座岛上禁止所有牦牛肉和牦牛肉制品…… [nin ke neng yi jing zhi dao ， gen ju guo wang de ming ling ， zhe zuo dao shang jin zhi suo you mao niu rou he mao niu rou zhi pin ……]

english: That King has some very strange attitudes.
translation: 那个国王的态度有些奇怪。 [na ge guo wang de tai du you xie qi guai 。]

english: Well, I have a contact on the other island. Are you interested in obtaining some produce?
translation: 嗯，我在另一个岛上有一个联系人。您有兴趣获得一些产品吗？ [n ， wo zai ling yi ge dao shang you yi ge lian xi ren 。 nin you xing qu huo de yi xie chan pin ma ？]

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Well, any time you need black market yak produce, you know where to come.
translation: 好吧，每当您需要黑市牦牛产品时，您都知道该去哪里。 [hao ba ， mei dang nin xu yao hei shi mao niu chan pin shi ， nin dou zhi dao gai qu na li 。]

english: Wanna buy some yak?
translation: 要买牦牛吗？ [yao mai mao niu ma ？]

english: Yes, please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No, thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Need some farming supplies?
translation: 需要一些农用物资吗？ [xu yao yi xie nong yong wu zi ma ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: It's a farming supply stall. Hosidius is farming country, so it's a big business. Do you need anything now?
translation: 这是一个农资摊位。霍西迪乌斯是农业国家，所以这是一笔大生意。你现在需要什么吗？ [zhe shi yi ge nong zi tan wei 。 huo xi di wu si shi nong ye guo jia ， suo yi zhe shi yi bi da sheng yi 。 ni xian zai xu yao shen me ma ？]

english: What have you got?
translation: 你有什么？ [ni you shen me ？]

english: No, I'm fine.
translation: 不，我很好。 [bu ， wo hen hao 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: What have you got?
translation: 你有什么？ [ni you shen me ？]

english: No, I'm fine.
translation: 不，我很好。 [bu ， wo hen hao 。]

english: 'Ello, and what are you after then?
translation: '艾洛，那你在追什么？ [' ai luo ， na ni zai zhui shen me ？]

english: I need another assignment.
translation: 我需要另一项任务。 [wo xu yao ling yi xiang ren wu 。]

english: Excellent, you're doing great. Your new task is to kill [amount] [task monster].
translation: 太棒了，你做得很好。你的新任务是杀死[数量][任务怪物]。 [tai bang le ， ni zuo de hen hao 。 ni de xin ren wu shi sha si [ shu liang ][ ren wu guai wu ]。]

english: Got any tips for me?
translation: 有什么建议给我吗？ [you shen me jian yi gei wo ma ？]

english: Great, thanks!
translation: 太好了，谢谢！ [tai hao le ， xie xie ！]

english: Okay, great!
translation: 好的，太好了！ [hao de ， tai hao le ！]

english: Good luck! Don't forget to come back when you need a new assignment.
translation: 祝你好运！当您需要新的任务时，请不要忘记回来。 [zhu ni hao yun ！ dang nin xu yao xin de ren wu shi ， qing bu yao wang ji hui lai 。]

english: You're still hunting [task monster]; you have [amount] to go. Come back when you've finished your task.
translation: 你还在狩猎[任务怪物]；你还有[金额]要走。完成任务后就回来。 [ni hai zai shou lie [ ren wu guai wu ]； ni hai you [ jin e ] yao zou 。 wan cheng ren wu hou jiu hui lai 。]

english: You're still hunting [monster], with [amount] to go.
translation: 你仍在狩猎[怪物]，还有[数量]。 [ni reng zai shou lie [ guai wu ]， hai you [ shu liang ]。]

english: I don't think that's a suitable task for you. Shall I cancel it? This will not wipe your task streaks.
translation: 我认为这不适合你。我要取消它吗？这不会消除您的任务连续记录。 [wo ren wei zhe bu shi he ni 。 wo yao qu xiao ta ma ？ zhe bu hui xiao chu nin de ren wu lian xu ji lu 。]

english: Yes, please cancel it.
translation: 是的，请取消。 [shi de ， qing qu xiao 。]

english: Alright, consider the task cancelled. You can now get a new assignment when you want one.
translation: 好吧，考虑任务被取消了。现在，您可以在需要时获得新的任务。 [hao ba ， kao lv ren wu bei qu xiao le 。 xian zai ， nin ke yi zai xu yao shi huo de xin de ren wu 。]

english: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
translation: 不，谢谢，我想尝试一下。 [bu ， xie xie ， wo xiang chang shi yi xia 。]

english: Good luck with that.
translation: 祝你好运。 [zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: 你有什么奖励给我，或者有什么可以交易的吗？ [ni you shen me jiang li gei wo ， huo zhe you shen me ke yi jiao yi de ma ？]

english: I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.
translation: 我有很多你可以获得的奖励，还有各种各样的杀手装备可供出售。 [wo you hen duo ni ke yi huo de de jiang li ， hai you ge zhong ge yang de sha shou zhuang bei ke gong chu shou 。]

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: 说说我的作业的难度吧。 [shuo shuo wo de zuo ye de nan du ba 。]

english: The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 目前，杀戮大师可以为您分配我们列表中的任何任务，无论您的战斗水平如何。 [mu qian ， sha lu da shi ke yi wei nin fen pei wo men lie biao zhong de ren he ren wu ， wu lun nin de zhan dou shui ping ru he 。]

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
translation: 没关系——我可以处理任何任务。 [mei guan xi —— wo ke yi chu li ren he ren wu 。]

english: That's the spirit.
translation: 这就是精神。 [zhe jiu shi jing shen 。]

english: In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: 以后，请不要给任何太艰难的事情。 [yi hou ， qing bu yao gei ren he tai jian nan de shi qing 。]

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: 好吧，从现在开始，所有屠戮大师在为你选择任务时都会考虑你的战斗水平，所以你不要做太难的事情。 [hao ba ， cong xian zai kai shi ， suo you tu lu da shi zai wei ni xuan ze ren wu shi du hui kao lv ni de zhan dou shui ping ， suo yi ni bu yao zuo tai nan de shi qing 。]

english: The Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: 杀手大师在为你选择任务时会考虑你的战斗水平，所以你不应该遇到太难的任务。 [sha shou da shi zai wei ni xuan ze ren wu shi hui kao lv ni de zhan dou shui ping ， suo yi ni bu ying gai yu dao tai nan de ren wu 。]

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: 没关系——我不想要太难的东西。 [mei guan xi —— wo bu xiang yao tai nan de dong xi 。]

english: Okay, we'll keep checking your combat level.
translation: 好的，我们会继续检查你的战斗水平。 [hao de ， wo men hui ji xu jian cha ni de zhan dou shui ping 。]

english: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: 别再检查我的战斗水平了——我可以承受任何事情！ [bie zai jian cha wo de zhan dou shui ping le —— wo ke yi cheng shou ren he shi qing ！]

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will assign you anything from their lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 好吧，从现在开始，所有的杀手大师都会从他们的列表中为你分配任何东西，无论你的战斗水平如何。 [hao ba ， cong xian zai kai shi ， suo you de sha shou da shi du hui cong ta men de lie biao zhong wei ni fen pei ren he dong xi ， wu lun ni de zhan dou shui ping ru he 。]

english: Er... Nothing...
translation: 呃……没什么…… [e …… mei shen me ……]

english: 'Ello, can I help you?
translation: '艾洛，我可以帮你吗？ [' ai luo ， wo ke yi bang ni ma ？]

english: Hello?
translation: 你好？ [ni hao ？]

english: 'Ello, who's that?
translation: '艾洛，那是谁？ [' ai luo ， na shi shui ？]

english: I'm [player name]. I'm using my magic to communicate with you.
translation: 我是[玩家姓名]。我正在用我的魔法与你交流。 [wo shi [ wan jia xing ming ]。 wo zheng zai yong wo de mo fa yu ni jiao liu 。]

english: Bizarre, go on, what do you want then?
translation: 奇怪了，继续，那你想要什么？ [qi guai le ， ji xu ， na ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: Hi! My name's [player name].
translation: 你好！我的名字是[玩家姓名]。 [ni hao ！ wo de ming zi shi [ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Do I look like I care? To me you're just another newcomer who thinks they're ready to fight.
translation: 我看起来像是在乎吗？对我来说，你只是另一个自以为已经准备好战斗的新人。 [wo kan qi lai xiang shi zai hu ma ？ dui wo lai shuo ， ni zhi shi ling yi ge zi yi wei yi jing zhun bei hao zhan dou de xin ren 。]

english: I am Vannaka, the greatest swordsman alive, and I'm here to teach you the basics of combat. Let's get started by teaching you to wield a weapon.
translation: 我是瓦纳卡，当今最伟大的剑客，我来这里是为了教你战斗的基础知识。让我们从教你使用武器开始吧。 [wo shi wa na ka ， dang jin zui wei da de jian ke ， wo lai zhe li shi wei le jiao ni zhan dou de ji chu zhi shi 。 rang wo men cong jiao ni shi yong wu qi kai shi ba 。]

english: Let's get started by teaching you to wield a weapon.
translation: 让我们从教你使用武器开始吧。 [rang wo men cong jiao ni shi yong wu qi kai shi ba 。]

english: Very good, but that little butter knife isn't going to protect you much. Let's get you something a bit better. Once you're properly equipped we can move on to some actual combat.
translation: 很好，但是那把小黄油刀并不能保护你太多。让我们给你一些更好的东西。一旦你装备好了，我们就可以开始一些实战了。 [hen hao ， dan shi na ba xiao huang you dao bing bu neng bao hu ni tai duo 。 rang wo men gei ni yi xie geng hao de dong xi 。 yi dan ni zhuang bei hao le ， wo men jiu ke yi kai shi yi xie shi zhan le 。]

english: Let's get you equipped.
translation: 让我们为您装备。 [rang wo men wei nin zhuang bei 。]

english: You should check out the combat interface.
translation: 你应该检查一下战斗界面。 [ni ying gai jian cha yi xia zhan dou jie mian 。]

english: Time for some actual combat! Head into the pen and kill one of those rats.
translation: 是时候来点实战了！走进围栏并杀死其中一只老鼠。 [shi shi hou lai dian shi zhan le ！ zou jin wei lan bing sha si qi zhong yi zhi lao shu 。]

english: I did it! I killed a giant rat!
translation: 我做到了！我杀了一只大老鼠！ [wo zuo dao le ！ wo sha le yi zhi da lao shu ！]

english: I saw. You seem better at this than I thought. Now that you have grasped basic swordplay, let's move on.
translation: 我看到了。你似乎比我想象的更擅长这件事。现在你已经掌握了基本的剑术，让我们继续吧。 [wo kan dao le 。 ni si hu bi wo xiang xiang de geng shan chang zhe jian shi 。 xian zai ni yi jing zhang wo le ji ben de jian shu ， rang wo men ji xu ba 。]

english: Next up we have ranged attacking. With this you can kill foes from a distance. With ranged, you'll be able to attack the rats without entering the pit meaning they won't be able to fight back.
translation: 接下来我们进行远程攻击。有了这个你就可以从远处杀死敌人。通过远程，你将能够在不进入坑的情况下攻击老鼠，这意味着它们将无法反击。 [jie xia lai wo men jin xing yuan cheng gong ji 。 you le zhe ge ni jiu ke yi cong yuan chu sha si di ren 。 tong guo yuan cheng ， ni jiang neng gou zai bu jin ru keng de qing kuang xia gong ji lao shu ， zhe yi wei zhe ta men jiang wu fa fan ji 。]

english: Use your bow and arrows to kill one of those rats from outside the pen.
translation: 用你的弓和箭杀死围栏外的一只老鼠。 [yong ni de gong he jian sha si wei lan wai de yi zhi lao shu 。]

english: Do you need something?
translation: 你需要什么东西吗？ [ni xu yao shen me dong xi ma ？]

english: Tell me about combat stats again.
translation: 再告诉我一些战斗数据。 [zai gao su wo yi xie zhan dou shu ju 。]

english: Certainly. You have three main combat stats: Strength, Defence and Attack.
translation: 当然。你有三个主要的战斗统计数据：力量、防御和攻击。 [dang ran 。 ni you san ge zhu yao de zhan dou tong ji shu ju ： li liang 、 fang yu he gong ji 。]

english: Strength determines the maximum hit you will be able to deal with your blows, Defence determines the amount of damage you will be able to defend and Attack determines the accuracy of your blows.
translation: 力量决定了你能够应对的最大打击，防御决定了你能够防御的伤害量，攻击决定了你打击的准确性。 [li liang jue ding le ni neng gou ying dui de zui da da ji ， fang yu jue ding le ni neng gou fang yu de shang hai liang ， gong ji jue ding le ni da ji de zhun que xing 。]

english: Other stats are used in combat such as Prayer, Hitpoints, Magic and Ranged. All of these stats can go towards determining your combat level, which is shown near the top of your combat interface screen.
translation: 其他统计数据用于战斗，例如祈祷、生命值、魔法和远程。所有这些统计数据都可以用来确定您的战斗级别，该级别显示在战斗界面屏幕的顶部附近。 [qi ta tong ji shu ju yong yu zhan dou ， li ru qi dao 、 sheng ming zhi 、 mo fa he yuan cheng 。 suo you zhe xie tong ji shu ju dou ke yi yong lai que ding nin de zhan dou ji bie ， gai ji bie xian shi zai zhan dou jie mian ping mu de ding bu fu jin 。]

english: You will find out on the mainland that certain items can also affect your stats. There are potions that can be drunk that can alter your stats temporarily, such as raising Strength.
translation: 在大陆上你会发现某些物品也会影响你的统计数据。饮用某些药水可以暂时改变你的统计数据，例如提高力量。 [zai da lu shang ni hui fa xian mou xie wu pin ye hui ying xiang ni de tong ji shu ju 。 yin yong mou xie yao shui ke yi zan shi gai bian ni de tong ji shu ju ， li ru ti gao li liang 。]

english: You will also raise your Defence and Attack values by using different weapons and armours.
translation: 您还可以通过使用不同的武器和盔甲来提高防御和攻击值。 [nin hai ke yi tong guo shi yong bu tong de wu qi he kui jia lai ti gao fang yu he gong ji zhi 。]

english: Before going into combat with an opponent it is wise to put the mouse over them and see what combat level they are.
translation: 在与对手进行战斗之前，明智的做法是将鼠标放在他们身上，看看他们的战斗级别。 [zai yu dui shou jin xing zhan dou zhi qian ， ming zhi de zuo fa shi jiang shu biao fang zai ta men shen shang ， kan kan ta men de zhan dou ji bie 。]

english: Green coloured writing usually means it will be an easy fight for you, red means you will probably lose, yellow means they are around your level and orange means they are slightly stronger.
translation: 绿色文字通常意味着这对你来说将是一场轻松的战斗，红色意味着你可能会输，黄色意味着它们与你的水平相当，橙色意味着它们稍强。 [lv se wen zi tong chang yi wei zhe zhe dui ni lai shuo jiang shi yi chang qing song de zhan dou ， hong se yi wei zhe ni ke neng hui shu ， huang se yi wei zhe ta men yu ni de shui ping xiang dang ， cheng se yi wei zhe ta men shao qiang 。]

english: Sometimes things will go your way, sometimes they won't. There is no such thing as a guaranteed win, but if the odds are on your side, you stand the best chance of walking away victorious.
translation: 有时事情会如你所愿，有时则不然。没有什么可以保证获胜，但如果机会对你有利，你就有最好的机会取得胜利。 [you shi shi qing hui ru ni suo yuan ， you shi ze bu ran 。 mei you shen me ke yi bao zheng huo sheng ， dan ru guo ji hui dui ni you li ， ni jiu you zui hao de ji hui qu de sheng li 。]

english: Now, was there something else you wanted to hear about again?
translation: 现在，您还有什么想再听的吗？ [xian zai ， nin hai you shen me xiang zai ting de ma ？]

english: Tell me about melee combat again.
translation: 再给我讲讲近战的事。 [zai gei wo jiang jiang jin zhan de shi 。]

english: Ah, my speciality. Close combat fighting, which is also known as melee fighting, covers all combat done at close range to your opponent.
translation: 啊，我的专长。近距离格斗，也称为近战，涵盖与对手近距离进行的所有战斗。 [a ， wo de zhuan chang 。 jin ju li ge dou ， ye cheng wei jin zhan ， han gai yu dui shou jin ju li jin xing de suo you zhan dou 。]

english: Melee fighting depends entirely upon your three basic combat stats: Attack, Defence, and Strength.
translation: 近战战斗完全取决于你的三个基本战斗统计数据：攻击、防御和力量。 [jin zhan zhan dou wan quan qu jue yu ni de san ge ji ben zhan dou tong ji shu ju ： gong ji 、 fang yu he li liang 。]

english: Also, of course, it depends on the quality of your armour and weaponry. A high-levelled fighter with good armour and weapons will be deadly up close.
translation: 当然，这也取决于你的盔甲和武器的质量。拥有良好盔甲和武器的高级战士在近距离战斗中将是致命的。 [dang ran ， zhe ye qu jue yu ni de kui jia he wu qi de zhi liang 。 yong you liang hao kui jia he wu qi de gao ji zhan shi zai jin ju li zhan dou zhong jiang shi zhi ming de 。]

english: If this is the path you wish to take, remember your success depends on getting as close to your enemy as quickly as possible.
translation: 如果这是您希望走的路，请记住您的成功取决于尽快接近敌人。 [ru guo zhe shi nin xi wang zou de lu ， qing ji zhu nin de cheng gong qu jue yu jin kuai jie jin di ren 。]

english: Personally, I consider the fine art of melee combat to be the ONLY combat method worth using.
translation: 就我个人而言，我认为近战战斗的艺术是唯一值得使用的战斗方法。 [jiu wo ge ren er yan ， wo ren wei jin zhan zhan dou de yi shu shi wei yi zhi de shi yong de zhan dou fang fa 。]

english: Now, did you want to hear anything else?
translation: 现在，你还想听别的吗？ [xian zai ， ni hai xiang ting bie de ma ？]

english: Tell me about ranged combat again.
translation: 再给我讲讲远程战斗。 [zai gei wo jiang jiang yuan cheng zhan dou 。]

english: Thinking of being a ranger, eh? Well, okay. I don't enjoy it myself, but I can see the appeal.
translation: 想成为一名护林员，是吗？好吧，好吧。我自己并不喜欢它，但我可以看到它的吸引力。 [xiang cheng wei yi ming hu lin yuan ， shi ma ？ hao ba ， hao ba 。 wo zi ji bing bu xi huan ta ， dan wo ke yi kan dao ta de xi yin li 。]

english: Ranging employs a lot of different weapons as a skill, not just the shortbow you have there. Spears, throwing knives, and crossbows are all used best at a distance from your enemy.
translation: 测距使用许多不同的武器作为技能，而不仅仅是你拥有的短弓。长矛、飞刀和弩都最好在与敌人保持一定距离的情况下使用。 [ce ju shi yong xu duo bu tong de wu qi zuo wei ji neng ， er bu jin jin shi ni yong you de duan gong 。 chang mao 、 fei dao he nu dou zui hao zai yu di ren bao chi yi ding ju li de qing kuang xia shi yong 。]

english: Now, those rats were easy pickings, but on the mainland you will be very lucky if you can find a spot where you can shoot at your enemies without them being able to retaliate.
translation: 现在，那些老鼠很容易被抓到，但在大陆上，如果你能找到一个可以射击敌人而不让他们还击的地方，那你就很幸运了。 [xian zai ， na xie lao shu hen rong yi bei zhua dao ， dan zai da lu shang ， ru guo ni neng zhao dao yi ge ke yi she ji di ren er bu rang ta men huan ji de di fang ， na ni jiu hen xing yun le 。]

english: At close range, rangers often do badly in combat. Your best tactic as a ranger is to hit and run, keeping your foe at a distance.
translation: 在近距离战斗中，游骑兵常常表现不佳。作为游侠，你最好的策略就是打完就跑，与敌人保持一定距离。 [zai jin ju li zhan dou zhong ， you qi bing chang chang biao xian bu jia 。 zuo wei you xia ， ni zui hao de ce lve jiu shi da wan jiu pao ， yu di ren bao chi yi ding ju li 。]

english: Your effectiveness as a ranger is almost entirely dependent on your Ranged stat. As with all skills, the more you train it, the more powerful it will become.
translation: 作为游侠，你的效率几乎完全取决于你的远程统计数据。与所有技能一样，你训练得越多，它就会变得越强大。 [zuo wei you xia ， ni de xiao lv ji hu wan quan qu jue yu ni de yuan cheng tong ji shu ju 。 yu suo you ji neng yi yang ， ni xun lian de yue duo ， ta jiu hui bian de yue qiang da 。]

english: Anything else you wanted to know?

english: It is also a place of both adventure and wealth, so if you are brave enough and strong enough to survive it, you will make a killing. Literally!

english: It is also the only place in the land of Gielinor where players are able to attack each other at will, and as such is the haunt of many Player Killers, or PKers if you will.

english: There are a few things different in the Wilderness in comparison to the rest of the lands of Gielinor. Firstly, as I just mentioned, you can and will be attacked by other players.

english: For this reason, you will be given a warning when you approach the Wilderness, as it is not a place you would wish to enter by accident.
translation: 因此，当您接近荒野时，您会收到警告，因为它不是您希望意外进入的地方。 [yin ci ， dang nin jie jin huang ye shi ， nin hui shou dao jing gao ， yin wei ta bu shi nin xi wang yi wai jin ru de di fang 。]

english: Secondly, there are a number of 'levels' to it. The further into it you travel, the greater the range of people you can attack.
translation: 其次，它有很多“层次”。你走得越远，你可以攻击的人范围就越大。 [qi ci ， ta you hen duo “ ceng ci ”。 ni zou de yue yuan ， ni ke yi gong ji de ren fan wei jiu yue da 。]

english: In level 1 wilderness you will only be able to attack, or be attacked by, those players within one combat level of yourself.

english: In level 50, any player within fifty levels of you will be able to attack, or be attacked by you. Always keep an eye on what level of the Wilderness you are currently in.

english: Tell me more about Great Kourend.
translation: 告诉我更多关于 Great Kourend 的信息。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu  Great Kourend  de xin xi 。]

english: Great Kourend is a magnificent kingdom comprising of five cities. They are the cities of Arceuus, Lovakengj, Shayzien, Piscarilius and Hosidius. Each city is ruled by one of the five houses of Kourend.
translation: 大库伦德是一个由五个城市组成的宏伟王国。它们是阿尔修斯 (Arceuus)、洛瓦肯吉 (Lovakenj)、沙伊恩 (Shayzien)、皮斯卡利留斯 (Piscarilius) 和霍西迪乌斯 (Hosidius) 的城市。每个城市都由库伦德五个家族之一统治。 [da ku lun de shi yi ge you wu ge cheng shi zu cheng de hong wei wang guo 。 ta men shi a er xiu si  (Arceuus)、 luo wa ken ji  (Lovakenj)、 sha yi en  (Shayzien)、 pi si ka li liu si  (Piscarilius)  he huo xi di wu si  (Hosidius)  de cheng shi 。 mei ge cheng shi dou you ku lun de wu ge jia zu zhi yi tong zhi 。]

english: At one time, the kingdom as a whole was ruled over by a king or queen that the five houses answered to.
translation: 曾经，整个王国由一位国王或王后统治，五个家族都对他们负责。 [ceng jing ， zheng ge wang guo you yi wei guo wang huo wang hou tong zhi ， wu ge jia zu dou dui ta men fu ze 。]

english: However, since our last King died 20 years ago, the kingdom has instead been ruled by an elected council.
translation: 然而，自从我们的最后一位国王20年前去世后，这个王国就由选举产生的议会统治。 [ran er ， zi cong wo men de zui hou yi wei guo wang 20 nian qian qu shi hou ， zhe ge wang guo jiu you xuan ju chan sheng de yi hui tong zhi 。]

english: Where are you from?
translation: 你从哪来？ [ni cong na lai ？]

english: I am from the magnificent kingdom of Great Kourend, across the sea, to the far west.
translation: 我来自宏伟的大库伦德王国，跨越大海，来到遥远的西方。 [wo lai zi hong wei de da ku lun de wang guo ， kua yue da hai ， lai dao yao yuan de xi fang 。]

english: That's great, can you take me there please?
translation: 太好了，可以带我去吗？ [tai hao le ， ke yi dai wo qu ma ？]

english: Certainly! I hope you don't get seasick, it is a long voyage.
translation: 当然！希望你不要晕船，这是一次长途航行。 [dang ran ！ xi wang ni bu yao yun chuan ， zhe shi yi ci zhang tu hang xing 。]

english: Unfortunately it seems that you're not quite ready to visit Great Kourend yet. Come back when you are and I'll happily take you there.
translation: 不幸的是，您似乎还没有准备好参观 Great Kourend。你什么时候回来，我很乐意带你去那里。 [bu xing de shi ， nin si hu hai mei you zhun bei hao can guan  Great Kourend。 ni shen me shi hou hui lai ， wo hen le yi dai ni qu na li 。]

english: You must be a member to travel to Great Kourend.Upgrade now to unlock extra quests, weapons, bosses, and more, within Great Kourend.
translation: 您必须成为会员才能前往 Great Kourend。立即升级以解锁 Great Kourend 中的额外任务、武器、头目等。 [nin bi xu cheng wei hui yuan cai neng qian wang  Great Kourend。 li ji sheng ji yi jie suo  Great Kourend  zhong de e wai ren wu 、 wu qi 、 tou mu deng 。]

english: I'm afraid access to Great Kourend is currently prohibited.
translation: 恐怕目前禁止进入 Great Kourend。 [kong pa mu qian jin zhi jin ru  Great Kourend。]

english: You cannot pass as you haven't unlocked access to the Great Kourend and Kebos Lowlands area in this League.
translation: 您无法通过，因为您尚未解锁进入该联盟中的大库伦德和科博斯低地地区的权限。 [nin wu fa tong guo ， yin wei nin shang wei jie suo jin ru gai lian meng zhong de da ku lun de he ke bo si di di di qu de quan xian 。]

english: Good bye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Hello Veos.
translation: 你好维奥斯。 [ni hao wei ao si 。]

english: Hello there. What can I do for you?
translation: 你好呀。我能为你做什么？ [ni hao ya 。 wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: Can you take me somewhere?
translation: 你能带我去一个地方吗？ [ni neng dai wo qu yi ge di fang ma ？]

english: Where would you like to go?
translation: 您想去哪里？ [nin xiang qu na li ？]

english: I'd like to travel to Port Piscarilius, please.
translation: 我想去皮斯卡利留斯港旅行。 [wo xiang qu pi si ka li liu si gang lv xing 。]

english: As you wish, I hope you don't get seasick, it is a long voyage.
translation: 如你所愿，希望你不要晕船，这是一次长途航行。 [ru ni suo yuan ， xi wang ni bu yao yun chuan ， zhe shi yi ci zhang tu hang xing 。]

english: I'd like to travel to Land's End, please.
translation: 我想去天涯海角旅行。 [wo xiang qu tian ya hai jiao lv xing 。]

english: Actually I'd like to stay here.
translation: 其实我想留在这里。 [qi shi wo xiang liu zai zhe li 。]

english: As you wish.
translation: 如你所愿。 [ru ni suo yuan 。]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: What's this old book you gave me?
translation: 你给我的这本旧书是什么？ [ni gei wo de zhe ben jiu shu shi shen me ？]

english: Ah that. I bought it at an auction a while back. Apparently, it belonged to the daughter of King Kharedst IV, the final king of Great Kourend.
translation: 啊那个。我不久前在拍卖会上买了它。显然，它属于大库伦德最后一位国王卡雷斯特四世的女儿。 [a na ge 。 wo bu jiu qian zai pai mai hui shang mai le ta 。 xian ran ， ta shu yu da ku lun de zui hou yi wei guo wang ka lei si te si shi de nv er 。]

english: Why did you give it to me?
translation: 你为什么把它给我？ [ni wei shen me ba ta gei wo ？]

english: I'd hoped it might have some interesting information in it. Most of the pages are missing though so I have no use for it. I thought you might be able to find something to do with it.
translation: 我希望其中可能有一些有趣的信息。但大部分页面都丢失了，所以我没有用它。我想你也许能找到一些与之相关的事情。 [wo xi wang qi zhong ke neng you yi xie you qu de xin xi 。 dan da bu fen ye mian dou diu shi le ， suo yi wo mei you yong ta 。 wo xiang ni ye xu neng zhao dao yi xie yu zhi xiang guan de shi qing 。]

english: Fair enough. Thanks!
translation: 很公平。谢谢！ [hen gong ping 。 xie xie ！]

english: These remind me of a pet I once had. Please... put them away.
translation: 这些让我想起了我曾经养过的一只宠物。请...把它们收起来。 [zhe xie rang wo xiang qi le wo ceng jing yang guo de yi zhi chong wu 。 qing ... ba ta men shou qi lai 。]

english: Sorry, Veos. I didn't know.
translation: 对不起，维奥斯。我不知道。 [dui bu qi ， wei ao si 。 wo bu zhi dao 。]

english: Would you feel comfortable sharing your story?
translation: 您愿意分享您的故事吗？ [nin yuan yi fen xiang nin de gu shi ma ？]

english: I once had a wolf, [player name]. His name was Copper. He was loyal. Brave... Gentle. He'd wear this beautiful crimson red collar.
translation: 我曾经养过一只狼，[玩家名字]。他的名字叫铜。他很忠诚。勇敢……温柔。他会戴上这个漂亮的深红色领子。 [wo ceng jing yang guo yi zhi lang ，[ wan jia ming zi ]。 ta de ming zi jiao tong 。 ta hen zhong cheng 。 yong gan …… wen rou 。 ta hui dai shang zhe ge piao liang de shen hong se ling zi 。]

english: One day, I was travelling on the mainland, nearby a tribe of Fremenniks. Not exactly a spring chicken at this point, my own wolf was pushing 19...
translation: 有一天，我在大陆旅行，附近有一个弗雷曼尼克人部落。此时不完全是一只小鸡，我自己的狼正在推动 19... [you yi tian ， wo zai da lu lv xing ， fu jin you yi ge fu lei man ni ke ren bu luo 。 ci shi bu wan quan shi yi zhi xiao ji ， wo zi ji de lang zheng zai tui dong  19...]

english: 19 years old? That's an incredible amount of time for a wolf to live!
translation: 19岁？对于狼来说，这真是难以置信的寿命！ [19 sui ？ dui yu lang lai shuo ， zhe zhen shi nan yi zhi xin de shou ming ！]

english: Indeed. Sadly, a group of feral foxes ambushed us. I fought back, along with Copper, though he took wounds that even a young wolf would struggle dealing with.
translation: 的确。可悲的是，一群野狐狸伏击了我们。我和库珀一起反击，尽管他受的伤连一头小狼都难以应付。 [di que 。 ke bei de shi ， yi qun ye hu li fu ji le wo men 。 wo he ku po yi qi fan ji ， jin guan ta shou de shang lian yi tou xiao lang dou nan yi ying fu 。]

english: What did you do?
translation: 你做了什么？ [ni zuo le shen me ？]

english: I ran, [player name]... Like a coward.
translation: 我跑了，[玩家名字]...像个胆小鬼。 [wo pao le ，[ wan jia ming zi ]... xiang ge dan xiao gui 。]

english: Did you ever find him?
translation: 你找到他了吗？ [ni zhao dao ta le ma ？]

english: I did not... I searched for days, but I was unable to find even his collar.
translation: 我没有……我找了好几天，但连他的衣领都找不到。 [wo mei you …… wo zhao le hao ji tian ， dan lian ta de yi ling dou zhao bu dao 。]

english: I can help! I'll search for Copper's collar. I'm sure I can find the fox that has it...
translation: 我可以帮忙！我会寻找科珀的项圈。我确信我能找到那只拥有它的狐狸...... [wo ke yi bang mang ！ wo hui xun zhao ke po de xiang quan 。 wo que xin wo neng zhao dao na zhi yong you ta de hu li ......]

english: Truly? You'd do that for me? Thank you so much, [player name]. I can't thank you enough! My heart's been filled with regret ever since it happened... and I think having a small part of Copper back, would make me complete again.
translation: 真的吗？你愿意为我做那件事吗？非常感谢你，[玩家姓名]。我对你感激不尽！自从那件事发生后，我的心里就充满了遗憾……我想，如果能收回一小部分铜，会让我再次完整。 [zhen de ma ？ ni yuan yi wei wo zuo na jian shi ma ？ fei chang gan xie ni ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。 wo dui ni gan ji bu jin ！ zi cong na jian shi fa sheng hou ， wo de xin li jiu chong man le yi han …… wo xiang ， ru guo neng shou hui yi xiao bu fen tong ， hui rang wo zai ci wan zheng 。]

english: I'll return when I have found Copper's collar. Take care!
translation: 找到科珀的项圈后我就会回来。小心！ [zhao dao ke po de xiang quan hou wo jiu hui hui lai 。 xiao xin ！]

english: How goes the hunt for Copper's collar, [player name]?
translation: [玩家姓名]，寻找科珀的项圈进展如何？ [[ wan jia xing ming ]， xun zhao ke po de xiang quan jin zhan ru he ？]

english: I haven't had any luck finding it yet, Veos. Where would you recommend searching?
translation: 我还没有找到它，Veos。您建议在哪里搜索？ [wo hai mei you zhao dao ta ，Veos。 nin jian yi zai na li sou suo ？]

english: I'd imagine the fox which killed Copper will likely still have the collar in their possesion. They were nearby a Fremennik town.
translation: 我想杀死科珀的狐狸很可能仍然拥有项圈。他们在弗雷曼尼克镇附近。 [wo xiang sha si ke po de hu li hen ke neng reng ran yong you xiang quan 。 ta men zai fu lei man ni ke zhen fu jin 。]

english: Thanks, Veos. I'll return when I have the collar!
translation: 谢谢，维奥斯。等我拿到领子我就回来！ [xie xie ， wei ao si 。 deng wo na dao ling zi wo jiu hui lai ！]

english: [Player name]... I can't thank you enough. I don't have a reward, but know that to me, this means so much. Perhaps in the future, I can repay you.
translation: [玩家姓名]...我对你感激不尽。我没有奖励，但知道这对我来说意义重大。也许将来，我可以报答你。 [[ wan jia xing ming ]... wo dui ni gan ji bu jin 。 wo mei you jiang li ， dan zhi dao zhe dui wo lai shuo yi yi zhong da 。 ye xu jiang lai ， wo ke yi bao da ni 。]

english: You're more than welcome Veos, and don't worry about a reward. Losing your best friend is always hard. Hopefully that item will bring you some comfort. Take care!
translation: Veos 非常欢迎您，并且不用担心奖励。失去最好的朋友总是很难受的。希望该物品能给您带来一些安慰。小心！ [Veos  fei chang huan ying nin ， bing qie bu yong dan xin jiang li 。 shi qu zui hao de peng you zong shi hen nan shou de 。 xi wang gai wu pin neng gei nin dai lai yi xie an wei 。 xiao xin ！]

english: [Player name]... I can't thank you enough for what you've done for me. I don't have a reward, but know that to me, this means so much. Perhaps in the future I can repay you.
translation: [玩家姓名]...我非常感谢你为我所做的一切。我没有奖励，但知道这对我来说意义重大。也许将来我可以报答你。 [[ wan jia xing ming ]... wo fei chang gan xie ni wei wo suo zuo de yi qie 。 wo mei you jiang li ， dan zhi dao zhe dui wo lai shuo yi yi zhong da 。 ye xu jiang lai wo ke yi bao da ni 。]

english: I am from the magnificent kingdom of Great Kourend on the continent of Zeah, to the far west.
translation: 我来自西边泽亚大陆上宏伟的大库伦德王国。 [wo lai zi xi bian ze ya da lu shang hong wei de da ku lun de wang guo 。]

english: Great Kourend is a magnificent kingdom comprising of five districts called Houses. The houses are ruled by the Lords of Arceuus, Lovakengj, Shayzien, Piscarilius and Hosidius.
translation: 大库伦德是一个宏伟的王国，由五个称为房屋的区域组成。这些家族由 Arceuus、Lovakenj、Shayzien、Piscarilius 和 Hosidius 领主统治。 [da ku lun de shi yi ge hong wei de wang guo ， you wu ge cheng wei fang wu de qu yu zu cheng 。 zhe xie jia zu you  Arceuus、Lovakenj、Shayzien、Piscarilius  he  Hosidius  ling zhu tong zhi 。]

english: Since our last King died 20 years ago the kingdom has been ruled by an elected council.
translation: 自从二十年前我们的最后一位国王去世以来，这个王国一直由选举产生的议会统治。 [zi cong er shi nian qian wo men de zui hou yi wei guo wang qu shi yi lai ， zhe ge wang guo yi zhi you xuan ju chan sheng de yi hui tong zhi 。]

english: Tell me more about Zeah.
translation: 告诉我更多关于齐亚的事。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu qi ya de shi 。]

english: Zeah is a huge continent far to the west of here full of new adventures and hidden treasures. Sadly, the kingdom of Great Kourend is besieged by lizard creatures and it is not possible to get out of the kingdom just yet.
translation: 泽亚是一片巨大的大陆，位于这里的西边，充满了新的冒险和隐藏的宝藏。不幸的是，大库伦德王国被蜥蜴生物围困，目前还无法离开王国。 [ze ya shi yi pian ju da de da lu ， wei yu zhe li de xi bian ， chong man le xin de mao xian he yin cang de bao zang 。 bu xing de shi ， da ku lun de wang guo bei xi yi sheng wu wei kun ， mu qian hai wu fa li kai wang guo 。]

english: Who're you? I've never seen you around these parts before.
translation: 你是谁？我以前从没在这些地方见过你。 [ni shi shui ？ wo yi qian cong mei zai zhe xie di fang jian guo ni 。]

english: I am Veos. Port master and scout for an elite Triumvirate.
translation: 我是维奥斯。港口管理员和精英三巨头的侦察员。 [wo shi wei ao si 。 gang kou guan li yuan he jing ying san ju tou de zhen cha yuan 。]

english: Triumvirate?
translation: 三巨头？ [san ju tou ？]

english: Who? Where? Why have you suddenly docked here?
translation: WHO？在哪里？怎么突然停在这里了？ [WHO？ zai na li ？ zen me tu ran ting zai zhe li le ？]

english: These are questions to which you shall not find answers, adventurer.
translation: 这些问题你找不到答案，冒险家。 [zhe xie wen ti ni zhao bu dao da an ， mao xian jia 。]

english: Then why are you here?
translation: 那你为什么在这里？ [na ni wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: There are secrets in this world for which you are not ready.
translation: 这个世界上有一些你还没有准备好的秘密。 [zhe ge shi jie shang you yi xie ni hai mei you zhun bei hao de mi mi 。]

english: Veos whispers...
translation: 维奥斯低声说道…… [wei ao si di sheng shuo dao ……]

english: Yo.... we, are not alone.
translation: 哟...我们，并不孤单。 [yo ... wo men ， bing bu gu dan 。]

english: Where's that?
translation: 那是哪里？ [na shi na li ？]

english: That's great, can you take me there please?
translation: 太好了，可以带我去吗？ [tai hao le ， ke yi dai wo qu ma ？]

english: Tell me more about Great Kourend.
translation: 告诉我更多关于 Great Kourend 的信息。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu  Great Kourend  de xin xi 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Can you take me somewhere?
translation: 你能带我去一个地方吗？ [ni neng dai wo qu yi ge di fang ma ？]

english: I'd like to travel to Port Piscarilius, please.
translation: 我想去皮斯卡利留斯港旅行。 [wo xiang qu pi si ka li liu si gang lv xing 。]

english: I'd like to travel to Land's End, please.
translation: 我想去天涯海角旅行。 [wo xiang qu tian ya hai jiao lv xing 。]

english: Actually I'd like to stay here.
translation: 其实我想留在这里。 [qi shi wo xiang liu zai zhe li 。]

english: Nothing.
translation: 没有什么。 [mei you shen me 。]

english: Would you feel comfortable sharing your story?
translation: 您愿意分享您的故事吗？ [nin yuan yi fen xiang nin de gu shi ma ？]

english: I can help! I'll search for Copper's collar.
translation: 我可以帮忙！我会寻找科珀的项圈。 [wo ke yi bang mang ！ wo hui xun zhao ke po de xiang quan 。]

english: I'm sorry. Thank you for sharing your story.
translation: 对不起。感谢您分享您的故事。 [dui bu qi 。 gan xie nin fen xiang nin de gu shi 。]

english: I'll leave you be. Sorry.
translation: 我就不打扰你了。对不起。 [wo jiu bu da rao ni le 。 dui bu qi 。]

english: Where are you from?
translation: 你从哪来？ [ni cong na lai ？]

english: Tell me more about Zeah.
translation: 告诉我更多关于齐亚的事。 [gao su wo geng duo guan yu qi ya de shi 。]

english: Good bye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 我要是像你那么丑我就不敢在大庭广众之下露脸了！ [wo yao shi xiang ni na me chou wo jiu bu gan zai da ting guang zhong zhi xia lou lian le ！]

english: Out of my way, punk.
translation: 别挡我的路，朋克。 [bie dang wo de lu ， peng ke 。]

english: Hmm... you smell strange...
translation: 嗯……你闻起来很奇怪…… [n …… ni wen qi lai hen qi guai ……]

english: Strange how?
translation: 奇怪怎么办？ [qi guai zen me ban ？]

english: Like a human!
translation: 像人一样！ [xiang ren yi yang ！]

english: Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 哦！呃……我刚吃了一个就是为什么！ [o ！ e …… wo gang chi le yi ge jiu shi wei shen me ！]

english: Leave me alone.
translation: 请别打扰我。 [qing bie da rao wo 。]

english: Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 如果你珍惜你的生命，就不要再跟我说话了！ [ru guo ni zhen xi ni de sheng ming ， jiu bu yao zai gen wo shuo hua le ！]

english: Get lost!
translation: 迷路！ [mi lu ！]

english: I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 我没有什么可以给你，所以让我一个人呆着吧，托钵僧。 [wo mei you shen me ke yi gei ni ， suo yi rang wo yi ge ren dai zhe ba ， tuo bo seng 。]

english: Have you no manners?
translation: 你没有礼貌吗？ [ni mei you li mao ma ？]

english: I don't have time for this right now.
translation: 我现在没有时间做这个。 [wo xian zai mei you shi jian zuo zhe ge 。]

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 我没有兴趣和像你这样的可怜虫说话。 [wo mei you xing qu he xiang ni zhe yang de ke lian chong shuo hua 。]

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
translation: 我打赌你有一双很棒的爪子。 [wo da du ni you yi shuang hen bang de zhua zi 。]

english: A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 非常痛苦的一天，总的来说……趁它持续的时候好好享受吧。 [fei chang tong ku de yi tian ， zong de lai shuo …… chen ta chi xu de shi hou hao hao xiang shou ba 。]

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: 如果你抓到任何人，答应我你会分享。 [ru guo ni zhua dao ren he ren ， da ying wo ni hui fen xiang 。]

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 我以前没在这儿闻过你的味道…… [wo yi qian mei zai zhe er wen guo ni de wei dao ……]
