translation: 你好，维罗！ [ni hao ， wei luo ！]

english: Hello, [player name]! What can I do for you?
translation: 你好，[玩家姓名]！我能为你做什么？ [ni hao ，[ wan jia xing ming ]！ wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: Protecting the camp from wildlife and thieves.
translation: 保护营地免受野生动物和小偷的侵害。 [bao hu ying di mian shou ye sheng dong wu he xiao tou de qin hai 。]

english: Hah! Why would I rush up there when you foolish humans are more than willing to throw yourself into its jaws?
translation: 哈！当你们这些愚蠢的人类恨不得把自己扔进它的嘴里时，我为什么要冲上去呢？ [ha ！ dang ni men zhe xie yu chun de ren lei hen bu de ba zi ji reng jin ta de zui li shi ， wo wei shen me yao chong shang qu ne ？]

english: Besides, someone needs to keep an eye on the happenings down here.
translation: 更何况，这里还得有人监视着这里的动静。 [geng he kuang ， zhe li hai de you ren jian shi zhe zhe li de dong jing 。]

english: Seriously though, [player name], do be careful up there.
translation: 不过说实话，[玩家姓名]，请务必小心。 [bu guo shuo shi hua ，[ wan jia xing ming ]， qing wu bi xiao xin 。]

english: I'll try!
translation: 我会尽力！ [wo hui jin li ！]

english: Would you like any more redberry antelope?
translation: 您还想要更多的红莓羚羊吗？ [nin hai xiang yao geng duo de hong mei ling yang ma ？]

english: You know, I think I've had enough. Thanks, though.
translation: 你知道，我想我已经受够了。不过还是谢谢。 [ni zhi dao ， wo xiang wo yi jing shou gou le 。 bu guo hai shi xie xie 。]

english: Okay, bye!
translation: 好的，再见！ [hao de ， zai jian ！]

english: Oh, more antelope. You know, I think I've had enough. Thanks, though.
translation: 哦，还有羚羊。你知道，我想我已经受够了。不过还是谢谢。 [o ， hai you ling yang 。 ni zhi dao ， wo xiang wo yi jing shou gou le 。 bu guo hai shi xie xie 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: What did you want me to get you?
translation: 你想让我给你什么？ [ni xiang rang wo gei ni shen me ？]

english: Never mind.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: Uh, usually there's a reward for doing this sort of thing.
translation: 呃，做这种事通常都会有奖励的。 [e ， zuo zhe zhong shi tong chang du hui you jiang li de 。]

english: Can I try some?
translation: 我可以尝试一些吗？ [wo ke yi chang shi yi xie ma ？]

english: Enjoy your meal.
translation: 请享用。 [qing xiang yong 。]

english: Would you like some more redberry antelope?
translation: 您还想要一些红莓羚羊吗？ [nin hai xiang yao yi xie hong mei ling yang ma ？]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!
translation: 呜？  呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜！ [wu ？   wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu ！]

english: You don't say?
translation: 你不说？ [ni bu shuo ？]

english: Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
translation: 哇！呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜！ [wa ！ wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu ！]

english: You don't say!
translation: 你不说！ [ni bu shuo ！]

english: Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
translation: 呜呜呜……呜呜呜？呜呜呜呜呜呜呜！ [wu wu wu …… wu wu wu ？ wu wu wu wu wu wu wu ！]

english: Well, I guess you didn't say.
translation: 嗯，我猜你没说。 [n ， wo cai ni mei shuo 。]

english: Yeah, I don't want to brag, but seriously: I am SOOOO rich....
translation: 是的，我不想吹牛，但说真的：我太有钱了…… [shi de ， wo bu xiang chui niu ， dan shuo zhen de ： wo tai you qian le ……]

english: Yeah, I know they say money doesn't bring you happiness, but sometimes I just like to open my bank account and look at all of the stuff I own and just think to myself:
translation: 是的，我知道他们说金钱不会给你带来幸福，但有时我只是喜欢打开我的银行账户，看看我拥有的所有东西，然后心里想： [shi de ， wo zhi dao ta men shuo jin qian bu hui gei ni dai lai xing fu ， dan you shi wo zhi shi xi huan da kai wo de yin hang zhang hu ， kan kan wo yong you de suo you dong xi ， ran hou xin li xiang ：]

english: Wow. I am soooooo rich.
translation: 哇。我太有钱了。 [wa 。 wo tai you qian le 。]

english: Well, us rich alive people don't want to waste all day spending time with you poor dead people, because I'm just sooooo rich I have to go now, and very possibly make myself even richer.
translation: 好吧，我们活着的富人不想浪费一整天的时间和你们这些可怜的死人在一起，因为我太富有了，我现在必须走了，而且很可能让自己变得更富有。 [hao ba ， wo men huo zhe de fu ren bu xiang lang fei yi zheng tian de shi jian he ni men zhe xie ke lian de si ren zai yi qi ， yin wei wo tai fu you le ， wo xian zai bi xu zou le ， er qie hen ke neng rang zi ji bian de geng fu you 。]

english: See ya around ghosty!
translation: 幽灵见！ [you ling jian ！]

english: Yeah, I heard about that, ha-ha-ha!
translation: 是的，我听说过，哈哈哈！ [shi de ， wo ting shuo guo ， ha ha ha ！]

english: With a MACKEREL? Ouch!
translation: 和鲭鱼一起？哎哟! [he qing yu yi qi ？ ai yo !]

english: Well, it was fun. Let's do it again sometime.
translation: 嗯，很有趣。我们找个时间再做一次吧。 [n ， hen you qu 。 wo men zhao ge shi jian zai zuo yi ci ba 。]

english: Why, thank you very much!
translation: 为什么，非常感谢！ [wei shen me ， fei chang gan xie ！]

english: I know, but what are you going to do?
translation: 我知道，但是你要做什么？ [wo zhi dao ， dan shi ni yao zuo shen me ？]

english: Well, I guess that's always true in the long run. See you around, weird invisible dead person!
translation: 嗯，我想从长远来看这总是正确的。再见，奇怪的隐形死人！ [n ， wo xiang cong chang yuan lai kan zhe zong shi zheng que de 。 zai jian ， qi guai de yin xing si ren ！]

english: Yeah it's not bad, but I prefer cooked chicken.
translation: 是的，不错，但我更喜欢煮熟的鸡肉。 [shi de ， bu cuo ， dan wo geng xi huan zhu shu de ji rou 。]

english: Maybe, but nothing beats a home cooked pie!
translation: 也许吧，但没有什么比自制的馅饼更好的了！ [ye xu ba ， dan mei you shen me bi zi zhi de xian bing geng hao de le ！]

english: Man, I love pie!
translation: 伙计，我喜欢馅饼！ [huo ji ， wo xi huan xian bing ！]

english: You don't say? I never knew that. Well, I must be going, see you around.
translation: 你不说？我从来不知道这一点。好吧，我得走了，回头见。 [ni bu shuo ？ wo cong lai bu zhi dao zhe yi dian 。 hao ba ， wo de zou le ， hui tou jian 。]

english: We get signal!
translation: 我们收到信号了！ [wo men shou dao xin hao le ！]

english: Somebody set up us the bomb!
translation: 有人给我们安放了炸弹！ [you ren gei wo men an fang le zha dan ！]

english: You have no chance to survive make your time.
translation: 你没有机会生存，请腾出时间。 [ni mei you ji hui sheng cun ， qing teng chu shi jian 。]

english: Woo?
translation: 呜？ [wu ？]

english: All your base are belong to us.
translation: 你所有的基地都属于我们。 [ni suo you de ji di dou shu yu wo men 。]

english: Hey, don't think you can talk to me like that!
translation: 嘿，别以为你可以这样跟我说话！ [hei ， bie yi wei ni ke yi zhe yang gen wo shuo hua ！]

english: Are you threatening me?
translation: 你在威胁我吗？ [ni zai wei xie wo ma ？]

english: Just because you're already dead, doesn't mean I can't find a way to hurt you ghosty!
translation: 你已经死了，并不代表我就找不到办法伤害你！ [ni yi jing si le ， bing bu dai biao wo jiu zhao bu dao ban fa shang hai ni ！]

english: No, I've never been there in my life and CERTAINLY didn't steal anything when I was!
translation: 不，我这辈子从来没有去过那里，当然也没有偷过任何东西！ [bu ， wo zhe bei zi cong lai mei you qu guo na li ， dang ran ye mei you tou guo ren he dong xi ！]

english: Are you calling me a liar?!?! I have never stolen a thing in my life, and I resent the implication that I am the kind of morally depraved individual that would steal someone else's hard earned
translation: 你骂我是骗子吗？！？！我一生中从未偷过任何东西，而且我很讨厌别人说我是那种道德败坏的人，会偷别人辛苦赚来的东西。 [ni ma wo shi pian zi ma ？！？！ wo yi sheng zhong cong wei tou guo ren he dong xi ， er qie wo hen tao yan bie ren shuo wo shi na zhong dao de bai huai de ren ， hui tou bie ren xin ku zhuan lai de dong xi 。]

english: money from their very pockets!
translation: 钱是从他们的口袋里掏出来的！ [qian shi cong ta men de kou dai li tao chu lai de ！]

english: Or cakes. Or fur. Repeatedly. For long periods at a time.
translation: 或者蛋糕。或者毛皮。反复。一次持续很长时间。 [huo zhe dan gao 。 huo zhe mao pi 。 fan fu 。 yi ci chi xu hen zhang shi jian 。]

english: Well if you are going to take that attitude, then I have nothing further to say on the matter, and bid you good day!
translation: 好吧，如果您打算采取这种态度，那么我对此事无话可说，祝您早安！ [hao ba ， ru guo nin da suan cai qu zhe zhong tai du ， na me wo dui ci shi wu hua ke shuo ， zhu nin zao an ！]

english: So... You must be the infamous Viggora.
translation: 那么……你一定就是臭名昭著的维戈拉。 [na me …… ni yi ding jiu shi chou ming zhao zhu de wei ge la 。]

english: Hold thy tongue varlet! Speak fast, how come you to find me here, and how doth you understand mine speech?
translation: 管住你的舌头！说快点，你怎么找到我在这里，你怎么听懂我的话？ [guan zhu ni de she tou ！ shuo kuai dian ， ni zen me zhao dao wo zai zhe li ， ni zen me ting dong wo de hua ？]

english: You want me to hold my tongue and tell you how I found you?
translation: 你想让我闭嘴告诉你我是怎么找到你的吗？ [ni xiang rang wo bi zui gao su ni wo shi zen me zhao dao ni de ma ？]

english: Cease thy chatter and respond to my demand!
translation: 停止你的喋喋不休，回应我的要求吧！ [ting zhi ni de die die bu xiu ， hui ying wo de yao qiu ba ！]

english: Cease my chatter AND respond to your demand?
translation: 停止我的喋喋不休并回应你的要求？ [ting zhi wo de die die bu xiu bing hui ying ni de yao qiu ？]

english: I warn thee knave, this curse upon me hath not improved my temper, these centuries past...
translation: 我警告你，无赖，这个对我的诅咒并没有改善我的脾气，几个世纪过去了...... [wo jing gao ni ， wu lai ， zhe ge dui wo de zu zhou bing mei you gai shan wo de pi qi ， ji ge shi ji guo qu le ......]

english: Well, it's actually about that curse that I have come to speak to you.
translation: 嗯，我来找你实际上就是为了那个诅咒。 [n ， wo lai zhao ni shi ji shang jiu shi wei le na ge zu zhou 。]

english: Oh, be that so? Then forgive my swift anger, and speak to me of how you plan to break this curse.
translation: 噢，是这样吗？那么请原谅我的愤怒，告诉我你打算如何打破这个诅咒。 [o ， shi zhe yang ma ？ na me qing yuan liang wo de fen nu ， gao su wo ni da suan ru he da po zhe ge zu zhou 。]

english: Erm... I didn't actually mention anything about breaking the curse...
translation: 呃……我实际上并没有提到任何关于打破诅咒的事情…… [e …… wo shi ji shang bing mei you ti dao ren he guan yu da po zu zhou de shi qing ……]

english: Then what lets you dare speak to me?
translation: 那你凭什么敢跟我说话？ [na ni ping shen me gan gen wo shuo hua ？]

english: Well, I heard of your name from a mage called Dhalak, and I'm trying to find out what exactly caused the curse to befall him, and you as well apparently.
translation: 好吧，我从一位名叫达拉克的法师那里听说了你的名字，我正试图找出到底是什么导致诅咒降临到他身上，显然你也一样。 [hao ba ， wo cong yi wei ming jiao da la ke de fa shi na li ting shuo le ni de ming zi ， wo zheng shi tu zhao chu dao di shi shen me dao zhi zu zhou jiang lin dao ta shen shang ， xian ran ni ye yi yang 。]

english: Ha! So the weak-willed mage was cursed along with me?
translation: 哈!那么那个意志薄弱的法师也跟着我一起被诅咒了？ [ha ! na me na ge yi zhi bo ruo de fa shi ye gen zhe wo yi qi bei zu zhou le ？]

english: Well now, that is an interesting turn of events... Then am I to assume that Valdez, Rennard, Kharrim and Lennissa were also cursed along with me?
translation: 现在，事情发生了有趣的转折……那么我是否可以假设瓦尔迪兹、雷纳德、哈里姆和莱尼萨也和我一起被诅咒了？ [xian zai ， shi qing fa sheng le you qu de zhuan zhe …… na me wo shi fou ke yi jia she wa er di zi 、 lei na de 、 ha li mu he lai ni sa ye he wo yi qi bei zu zhou le ？]

english: ...How did you know that?
translation: ……你怎么知道的？ […… ni zen me zhi dao de ？]

english: Ha ha ha! Oh, the curse cut deeper than I had previously thought!
translation: 哈哈哈！哦，诅咒比我之前想象的更深！ [ha ha ha ！ o ， zu zhou bi wo zhi qian xiang xiang de geng shen ！]

english: Stranger, this news has brought me a ray of sunshine in an otherwise dreary millennium! Please, ask any question you wish!
translation: 陌生人，这个消息给我沉闷的千年带来了一缕阳光！请提出您想要的任何问题！ [mo sheng ren ， zhe ge xiao xi gei wo chen men de qian nian dai lai le yi lv yang guang ！ qing ti chu nin xiang yao de ren he wen ti ！]

english: Erm... Thanks, I think. So what exactly happened on that day you were all cursed?
translation: 嗯...谢谢，我想。那么你们被诅咒的那一天到底发生了什么？ [n ... xie xie ， wo xiang 。 na me ni men bei zu zhou de na yi tian dao di fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: I know that Valdez discovered the Staff of Armadyl, was robbed by Rennard, who then sent Kharrim to tell Zamorak of it.
translation: 我知道瓦尔迪兹发现了阿玛迪尔之杖，被雷纳德抢劫，然后雷纳德派哈里姆去告诉萨莫拉克。 [wo zhi dao wa er di zi fa xian le a ma di er zhi zhang ， bei lei na de qiang jie ， ran hou lei na de pai ha li mu qu gao su sa mo la ke 。]

english: Meanwhile Lennissa heard of the sale, and informed Dhalak who placed an enchantment upon it so that its power would be hidden.
translation: 与此同时，莱妮莎听说了这笔交易，并通知了达拉克，达拉克对它施了魔法，以隐藏它的力量。 [yu ci tong shi ， lai ni sha ting shuo le zhe bi jiao yi ， bing tong zhi le da la ke ， da la ke dui ta shi le mo fa ， yi yin cang ta de li liang 。]

english: I still don't know what happened with the staff to cause this curse, or what you had to do with it though...
translation: 我仍然不知道工作人员发生了什么导致了这个诅咒，或者你与它有什么关系...... [wo reng ran bu zhi dao gong zuo ren yuan fa sheng le shen me dao zhi le zhe ge zu zhou ， huo zhe ni yu ta you shen me guan xi ......]

english: Well stranger, rest yourself awhile, and I will recount a tale of the events of that day, for I was one of the few actually there when it happened...
translation: 好吧，陌生人，休息一会儿，我将讲述那天发生的事情，因为我是事件发生时少数实际在场的人之一...... [hao ba ， mo sheng ren ， xiu xi yi hui er ， wo jiang jiang shu na tian fa sheng de shi qing ， yin wei wo shi shi jian fa sheng shi shao shu shi ji zai chang de ren zhi yi ......]

english: When what happened?
translation: 什么时候发生的事？ [shen me shi hou fa sheng de shi ？]

english: When my Lord Zamorak first got his taste of godhood!
translation: 当我的萨莫拉克大人第一次尝到神性的滋味时！ [dang wo de sa mo la ke da ren di yi ci chang dao shen xing de zi wei shi ！]

english: Wow. Sounds like quite the dinner party anecdote.
translation: 哇。听起来很像晚宴上的轶事。 [wa 。 ting qi lai hen xiang wan yan shang de yi shi 。]

english: You can take the snide venom out of your voice whelp, you came to me; 'twas not the other way round.
translation: 你可以把你声音里的嘲讽去掉，小崽子，你来找我了；事实并非如此。 [ni ke yi ba ni sheng yin li de chao feng qu diao ， xiao zai zi ， ni lai zhao wo le ； shi shi bing fei ru ci 。]

english: Okay, okay. Please continue.
translation: 好吧，好吧。请继续。 [hao ba ， hao ba 。 qing ji xu 。]

english: Well now, let us see... As you may have heard tell, my affiliation lay with General Zamorak, a mighty warrior of the Mahjarrat tribe, and my skill on the battlefield had quickly brought
translation: 现在，让我们看看……正如你可能听说过的那样，我与萨莫拉克将军有联系，他是玛吉拉特部落的一位强大的战士，我在战场上的技巧很快就带来了 [xian zai ， rang wo men kan kan …… zheng ru ni ke neng ting shuo guo de na yang ， wo yu sa mo la ke jiang jun you lian xi ， ta shi ma ji la te bu luo de yi wei qiang da de zhan shi ， wo zai zhan chang shang de ji qiao hen kuai jiu dai lai le]

english: me to his attention.
translation: 我引起他的注意。 [wo yin qi ta de zhu yi 。]

english: So pleased was he with my bloodlust that he promoted me on the battlefield once to serve in his honour guard, and let me tell you, this was a rare honour indeed, for I was the only human chosen to take such a position.
translation: 他对我的嗜血感到非常高兴，以至于他曾在战场上提拔我在他的仪仗队中服役，让我告诉你，这确实是一个罕见的荣誉，因为我是唯一被选来担任这一职位的人类。 [ta dui wo de shi xue gan dao fei chang gao xing ， yi zhi yu ta ceng zai zhan chang shang ti ba wo zai ta de yi zhang dui zhong fu yi ， rang wo gao su ni ， zhe que shi shi yi ge han jian de rong yu ， yin wei wo shi wei yi bei xuan lai dan ren zhe yi zhi wei de ren lei 。]

english: Really?
translation: 真的吗？ [zhen de ma ？]

english: Oh yes, the dragon riders, Mahjarrat, demons and vampyre warriors made up the bulk of the force, but I wager I was their equal in all ways of combat.
translation: 哦，是的，龙骑士、马哈拉特、恶魔和吸血鬼战士构成了这支部队的主体，但我敢打赌我在所有战斗方面都与他们旗鼓相当。 [o ， shi de ， long qi shi 、 ma ha la te 、 e mo he xi xue gui zhan shi gou cheng le zhe zhi bu dui de zhu ti ， dan wo gan da du wo zai suo you zhan dou fang mian dou yu ta men qi gu xiang dang 。]

english: Ha, when I think of someone like Lucien struggling to lift a blade, in some ways I was even their better!
translation: 哈，当我想到像路西恩这样的人努力举起刀片时，在某些方面我甚至比他们更好！ [ha ， dang wo xiang dao xiang lu xi en zhe yang de ren nu li ju qi dao pian shi ， zai mou xie fang mian wo shen zhi bi ta men geng hao ！]

english: Please continue.
translation: 请继续。 [qing ji xu 。]

english: Well anyway... Myself and the rest of Zamoraks honour guard were formulating stratagems in our battle-tent, when that sneaky messenger Kharrim came in offering to sell us
translation: 好吧，无论如何……我自己和其他萨莫拉克仪仗队正在我们的战斗帐篷里制定策略，这时那个狡猾的信使哈利姆进来提出要卖掉我们 [hao ba ， wu lun ru he …… wo zi ji he qi ta sa mo la ke yi zhang dui zheng zai wo men de zhan dou zhang peng li zhi ding ce lve ， zhe shi na ge jiao hua de xin shi ha li mu jin lai ti chu yao mai diao wo men]

english: the god-staff of Armadyl!
translation: Armadyl 的神杖！ [Armadyl  de shen zhang ！]

english: Naturally, we suspected that this was some trick by our Lord to test our loyalty...
translation: 我们自然怀疑这是主上为了考验我们的忠诚而搞的什么诡计…… [wo men zi ran huai yi zhe shi zhu shang wei le kao yan wo men de zhong cheng er gao de shen me gui ji ……]

english: Yes, who was your lord? Everyone has been very evasive about that...
translation: 是啊，谁是你的主呢？大家对此都非常回避…… [shi a ， shui shi ni de zhu ne ？ da jia dui ci dou fei chang hui bi ……]

english: Quiet fool, all things in their course; You are disrupting my train of thought!
translation: 安静的傻瓜，一切都顺其自然；你扰乱了我的思路！ [an jing de sha gua ， yi qie dou shun qi zi ran ； ni rao luan le wo de si lu ！]

english: Sorry...
translation: 对不起... [dui bu qi ...]

english: Well anyway, we thought it was too good to be true, yet when we visited this scummy tavern we were amazed to discover there was no trick, no test of loyalty, no hidden trap:
translation: 不管怎样，我们认为这太好了，令人难以置信，但当我们参观这家卑鄙的酒馆时，我们惊讶地发现，这里没有任何诡计，没有忠诚度考验，没有隐藏的陷阱： [bu guan zen yang ， wo men ren wei zhe tai hao le ， ling ren nan yi zhi xin ， dan dang wo men can guan zhe jia bei bi de jiu guan shi ， wo men jing ya di fa xian ， zhe li mei you ren he gui ji ， mei you zhong cheng du kao yan ， mei you yin cang de xian jing ：]

english: Somehow this fool had actually managed to obtain the god-staff of Armadyl!
translation: 不知怎的，这个傻瓜竟然得到了阿玛迪尔神杖！ [bu zhi zen de ， zhe ge sha gua jing ran de dao le a ma di er shen zhang ！]

english: Its power was incredible, you could almost feel the energies crackling around it in the air!
translation: 它的威力惊人，你几乎可以感受到它周围空气中的能量爆裂！ [ta de wei li jing ren ， ni ji hu ke yi gan shou dao ta zhou wei kong qi zhong de neng liang bao lie ！]

english: So what happened then?
translation: 那么后来发生了什么？ [na me hou lai fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: Well, with such a weapon, the plans we had been developing for a rebellion against our lord could finally be put into action, but we knew that we would have to act swiftly, before he heard that we had a weapon
translation: 好吧，有了这样的武器，我们一直在制定的反抗我们领主的计划终于可以付诸实施了，但我们知道我们必须在他听说我们拥有武器之前迅速采取行动 [hao ba ， you le zhe yang de wu qi ， wo men yi zhi zai zhi ding de fan kang wo men ling zhu de ji hua zhong yu ke yi fu zhu shi shi le ， dan wo men zhi dao wo men bi xu zai ta ting shuo wo men yong you wu qi zhi qian xun su cai qu xing dong]

english: capable of defeating him, and we would have to act decisively, for even amongst our group there were still those loyal to the lord - such as that pathetic fool Azzanadra.
translation: 能够击败他，我们就必须果断行动，因为即使在我们的队伍中，也有一些忠于领主的人——比如那个可悲的傻瓜阿扎纳德拉。 [neng gou ji bai ta ， wo men jiu bi xu guo duan xing dong ， yin wei ji shi zai wo men de dui wu zhong ， ye you yi xie zhong yu ling zhu de ren —— bi ru na ge ke bei de sha gua a zha na de la 。]

english: So JUST WHO WAS this lord you speak of?
translation: 那么你所说的这位领主到底是谁？ [na me ni suo shuo de zhe wei ling zhu dao di shi shui ？]

english: And I tell thee again, I will say when it is appropriate, now do not disrupt my tale!
translation: 我再次告诉你，我会在适当的时候说，现在不要扰乱我的故事！ [wo zai ci gao su ni ， wo hui zai shi dang de shi hou shuo ， xian zai bu yao rao luan wo de gu shi ！]

english: Okay, carry on then...
translation: 好吧，那就继续吧…… [hao ba ， na jiu ji xu ba ……]

english: So anyway, Lord Zamorak and his most trusted compatriots, namely myself, Hazeel, Drakan, Thammaron and Zemouregal made plans to overthrow our lord using the god-weapon, and by pledging
translation: 所以无论如何，萨莫拉克勋爵和他最信任的同胞，即我、哈兹尔、德拉坎、萨马隆和泽穆雷加尔制定了计划，使用神器武器推翻我们的领主，并承诺 [suo yi wu lun ru he ， sa mo la ke xun jue he ta zui xin ren de tong bao ， ji wo 、 ha zi er 、 de la kan 、 sa ma long he ze mu lei jia er zhi ding le ji hua ， shi yong shen qi wu qi tui fan wo men de ling zhu ， bing cheng nuo]

english: allegiance to Zamorak as our master, were each to be given a large piece of land as our own in return.
translation: 效忠萨莫拉克作为我们的主人，每个人都将获得一大片土地作为我们自己的回报。 [xiao zhong sa mo la ke zuo wei wo men de zhu ren ， mei ge ren dou jiang huo de yi da pian tu di zuo wei wo men zi ji de hui bao 。]

english: We decided to move immediately, before anyone got cold feet, or any other parties could interfere in our work, and made haste towards the castle where our Lord lived.
translation: 我们决定立即行动，以免任何人临阵退缩，或任何其他团体干扰我们的工作，并匆忙前往我们的主居住的城堡。 [wo men jue ding li ji xing dong ， yi mian ren he ren lin zhen tui suo ， huo ren he qi ta tuan ti gan rao wo men de gong zuo ， bing cong mang qian wang wo men de zhu ju zhu de cheng bao 。]

english: If Lucien had not been otherwise occupied, he would have probably accompanied us with his magicks, but it turned out the foolish Dhalak had made his involvement unnecessary with some spells of his own allowing us to
translation: 如果路西恩没有其他事情，他可能会用他的魔法陪伴我们，但事实证明，愚蠢的达拉克让他的参与变得不必要，他自己的一些咒语让我们能够 [ru guo lu xi en mei you qi ta shi qing ， ta ke neng hui yong ta de mo fa pei ban wo men ， dan shi shi zheng ming ， yu chun de da la ke rang ta de can yu bian de bu bi yao ， ta zi ji de yi xie zhou yu rang wo men neng gou]

english: get close enough to the castle with the staff without the Empty Lord being able to sense its presence.
translation: 带着权杖离城堡足够近，而空之领主无法感觉到它的存在。 [dai zhe quan zhang li cheng bao zu gou jin ， er kong zhi ling zhu wu fa gan jue dao ta de cun zai 。]

english: So your lord was the one that cursed you?
translation: 那么诅咒你的就是你的主子吗？ [na me zu zhou ni de jiu shi ni de zhu zi ma ？]

english: I am coming to that... So anyway, we made our way to the castle, under the pretense that we had war plans against Saradomin and the other deities to discuss.
translation: 我正要说到这个……所以无论如何，我们前往城堡，假装我们有针对萨拉多明和其他神灵的战争计划需要讨论。 [wo zheng yao shuo dao zhe ge …… suo yi wu lun ru he ， wo men qian wang cheng bao ， jia zhuang wo men you zhen dui sa la duo ming he qi ta shen ling de zhan zheng ji hua xu yao tao lun 。]

english: As usual, our lord was guarded well, but this was why Zamorak had brought his most trusted fighters with him.
translation: 和往常一样，我们的领主受到了严密的守卫，但这就是为什么萨莫拉克带着他最信任的战士一起来的原因。 [he wang chang yi yang ， wo men de ling zhu shou dao le yan mi de shou wei ， dan zhe jiu shi wei shen me sa mo la ke dai zhe ta zui xin ren de zhan shi yi qi lai de yuan yin 。]

english: While we distracted the Empty Lord with our feints and attacks, and kept his bodyguards busy, Lord Zamorak outflanked him, unsheathed the staff and plunged it into his back!
translation: 当我们用佯攻和攻击分散虚空领主的注意力，并让他的保镖忙碌起来时，萨莫拉克领主从侧翼包抄了他，拔出法杖，将其插入他的背部！ [dang wo men yong yang gong he gong ji fen san xu kong ling zhu de zhu yi li ， bing rang ta de bao biao mang lu qi lai shi ， sa mo la ke ling zhu cong ce yi bao chao le ta ， ba chu fa zhang ， jiang qi cha ru ta de bei bu ！]

english: Ah, it was a glorious sight... At that moment I was reminded for whom I fought, and why General Zamorak had earned his nickname 'the scourge' upon the battlefield...
translation: 啊，那是一个辉煌的景象……那一刻我想起了我为谁而战，以及为什么萨莫拉克将军在战场上赢得了“祸害”的绰号…… [a ， na shi yi ge hui huang de jing xiang …… na yi ke wo xiang qi le wo wei shui er zhan ， yi ji wei shen me sa mo la ke jiang jun zai zhan chang shang ying de le “ huo hai ” de chuo hao ……]

english: And the next thing you know you were cursed?
translation: 接下来你知道你被诅咒了吗？ [jie xia lai ni zhi dao ni bei zu zhou le ma ？]

english: No, it was not quite that simple... The Empty Lord turned away from our battle, eyes burning with hatred, and towards Zamorak instead. Seeing this, we all fought with extra vigour, so that
translation: 不，事情没那么简单……虚空领主从我们的战斗中转过身来，双眼燃烧着仇恨，转而看向萨莫拉克。看到这一幕，我们都更加奋力拼搏，这样 [bu ， shi qing mei na me jian dan …… xu kong ling zhu cong wo men de zhan dou zhong zhuan guo shen lai ， shuang yan ran shao zhe chou hen ， zhuan er kan xiang sa mo la ke 。 kan dao zhe yi mu ， wo men dou geng jia fen li pin bo ， zhe yang]

english: General Zamorak would not face our lord alone, but we were outnumbered by many hundreds of warriors and demons, and could not reach him to assist him!
translation: 萨莫拉克将军不会独自面对我们的领主，但我们的数量远远超过数百名战士和恶魔，无法到达他身边来协助他！ [sa mo la ke jiang jun bu hui du zi mian dui wo men de ling zhu ， dan wo men de shu liang yuan yuan chao guo shu bai ming zhan shi he e mo ， wu fa dao da ta shen bian lai xie zhu ta ！]

english: So what then?
translation: 那又怎样呢？ [na you zen yang ne ？]

english: Why, it was the Empty Lord versus Zamorak, in single combat! And the sight of the battle will be with me forever more...
translation: 哎呀，这是虚空领主与萨莫拉克的单打独斗！战斗的景象将永远伴随着我…… [ai ya ， zhe shi xu kong ling zhu yu sa mo la ke de dan da du dou ！ zhan dou de jing xiang jiang yong yuan ban sui zhe wo ……]

english: The Empty Lord was a powerful god, stronger than any of the others awake at that time, possibly even as strong as Guthix is, and Zamorak was but a mortal: A Mahjarrat warrior all the same, with all of the
translation: 虚空之主是一位强大的神，比当时清醒的任何其他人都强大，甚至可能和古西克斯一样强大，而萨莫拉克只是一个凡人：尽管如此，他还是一个马吉拉特战士，拥有所有的力量。 [xu kong zhi zhu shi yi wei qiang da de shen ， bi dang shi qing xing de ren he qi ta ren dou qiang da ， shen zhi ke neng he gu xi ke si yi yang qiang da ， er sa mo la ke zhi shi yi ge fan ren ： jin guan ru ci ， ta hai shi yi ge ma ji la te zhan shi ， yong you suo you de li liang 。]

english: strength and power that that entails, but mortal nonetheless, but to see him fight, you would not think of him as a 'mere' anything...
translation: 这需要力量和力量，但尽管如此，还是凡人，但看到他战斗，你不会认为他是“单纯”的东西…… [zhe xu yao li liang he li liang ， dan jin guan ru ci ， hai shi fan ren ， dan kan dao ta zhan dou ， ni bu hui ren wei ta shi “ dan chun ” de dong xi ……]

english: He was war itself! Flurry after flurry of blows he rained upon the Empty Lord, and the very castle walls shook and quivered with their power, but the Empty Lord would not fall!
translation: 他就是战争本身！一阵又一阵的攻击，如雨点般地袭向虚空之主，连城堡的墙壁都因它们的力量而摇晃、颤抖，但虚空之主却不会倒下！ [ta jiu shi zhan zheng ben shen ！ yi zhen you yi zhen de gong ji ， ru yu dian ban di xi xiang xu kong zhi zhu ， lian cheng bao de qiang bi dou yin ta men de li liang er yao huang 、 chan dou ， dan xu kong zhi zhu que bu hui dao xia ！]

english: Even with the weapon of a god embedded in his back, he fought on, and with each blow our victory seemed less and less certain...
translation: 即使背上嵌着神之武器，他仍继续战斗，每一次打击，我们的胜利似乎都变得越来越不确定…… [ji shi bei shang qian zhe shen zhi wu qi ， ta reng ji xu zhan dou ， mei yi ci da ji ， wo men de sheng li si hu dou bian de yue lai yue bu que ding ……]

english: Well, then a miracle happened. Or luck. Or natural justice.
translation: 嗯，然后奇迹发生了。或者运气。或者自然正义。 [n ， ran hou qi ji fa sheng le 。 huo zhe yun qi 。 huo zhe zi ran zheng yi 。]

english: You can call it what you want, but as the Empty Lords hands wrapped tightly around Zamorak's throat, Lord Zamorak, kicking and screaming defiantly and radiant in his anger until the very last, plunged towards the
translation: 你可以随心所欲地称呼它，但当空之领主的手紧紧地掐住萨莫拉克的喉咙时，萨莫拉克领主，挑衅地又踢又叫，直到最后一刻都在愤怒中容光焕发，冲向了萨莫拉克。 [ni ke yi sui xin suo yu di cheng hu ta ， dan dang kong zhi ling zhu de shou jin jin di qia zhu sa mo la ke de hou long shi ， sa mo la ke ling zhu ， tiao xin di you ti you jiao ， zhi dao zui hou yi ke dou zai fen nu zhong rong guang huan fa ， chong xiang le sa mo la ke 。]

english: Empty Lord, who seemed to lose his footing slightly, and fell in such a way so that the staff plunged deeper into his body, but also impaled Lord Zamorak with it at the same time...
translation: 虚空领主，似乎稍稍失去了立足点，摔倒在地，让法杖深入他的身体，同时也刺穿了萨莫拉克领主…… [xu kong ling zhu ， si hu shao shao shi qu le li zu dian ， shuai dao zai di ， rang fa zhang shen ru ta de shen ti ， tong shi ye ci chuan le sa mo la ke ling zhu ……]

english: And then...
translation: 进而... [jin er ...]

english: And then what?
translation: 然后呢？ [ran hou ne ？]

english: And then nothing. There was a sudden flash of bright light, and then a sudden blink of cold darkness, and it was over.
translation: 然后就什么也没有了。突然一道亮光闪过，然后又突然闪现冰冷的黑暗，一切都结束了。 [ran hou jiu shen me ye mei you le 。 tu ran yi dao liang guang shan guo ， ran hou you tu ran shan xian bing leng de hei an ， yi qie dou jie shu le 。]

english: Zamorak stood over the Empty Lord who was slowly... fading from existence... And as he faded, it seemed as though... It almost seemed as though Zamorak became more real,
translation: 萨莫拉克站在虚空之主的上方，他正在慢慢地……从存在中消失……当他消失时，似乎……似乎萨莫拉克变得更加真实， [sa mo la ke zhan zai xu kong zhi zhu de shang fang ， ta zheng zai man man di …… cong cun zai zhong xiao shi …… dang ta xiao shi shi ， si hu …… si hu sa mo la ke bian de geng jia zhen shi ，]

english: more solid than he had been before...
translation: 比之前的他更加坚定了…… [bi zhi qian de ta geng jia jian ding le ……]

english: And as the Empty Lord faded from this world completely, I heard his voice, almost a whisper upon the wind, cursing all who had helped Zamorak in his victory, which as you now tell me seems to have been all who
translation: 当虚空之主完全从这个世界消失时，我听到了他的声音，几乎是风中的耳语，咒骂着所有帮助萨莫拉克取得胜利的人，正如你现在告诉我的那样，这些人似乎都是那些帮助过萨莫拉克的人。 [dang xu kong zhi zhu wan quan cong zhe ge shi jie xiao shi shi ， wo ting dao le ta de sheng yin ， ji hu shi feng zhong de er yu ， zhou ma zhe suo you bang zhu sa mo la ke qu de sheng li de ren ， zheng ru ni xian zai gao su wo de na yang ， zhe xie ren si hu dou shi na xie bang zhu guo sa mo la ke de ren 。]

english: were responsible for the staff ending up in Zamorak's hands at the castle.
translation: 负责城堡中最终落入萨莫拉克手中的工作人员。 [fu ze cheng bao zhong zui zhong luo ru sa mo la ke shou zhong de gong zuo ren yuan 。]

english: As I heard it, I saw that I too was fading, just as the Empty Lord had, and I called to my brethren for their assistance, but they could no longer hear my words, nor see my form.
translation: 当我听到的时候，我发现我也像空主一样消失了，我向我的弟兄们寻求帮助，但他们再也听不到我的话语，也看不到我的身影。 [dang wo ting dao de shi hou ， wo fa xian wo ye xiang kong zhu yi yang xiao shi le ， wo xiang wo de di xiong men xun qiu bang zhu ， dan ta men zai ye ting bu dao wo de hua yu ， ye kan bu dao wo de shen ying 。]

english: It was then that the other gods appeared and banished Zamorak from the world completely for daring to kill one of their kind, although as it turned out it didn't quite work out that way for them, when he returned
translation: 就在那时，其他的神出现了，并因为扎莫拉克敢于杀死他们的同类而将他彻底驱逐出世界，尽管事实证明，当他回来时，这对他们来说并不完全有效。 [jiu zai na shi ， qi ta de shen chu xian le ， bing yin wei zha mo la ke gan yu sha si ta men de tong lei er jiang ta che di qu zhu chu shi jie ， jin guan shi shi zheng ming ， dang ta hui lai shi ， zhe dui ta men lai shuo bing bu wan quan you xiao 。]

english: stronger than ever, a god himself.
translation: 比以往任何时候都更强大，他自己就是神。 [bi yi wang ren he shi hou dou geng qiang da ， ta zi ji jiu shi shen 。]

english: But the god wars were another story entirely...
translation: 但众神之战完全是另一个故事...... [dan zhong shen zhi zhan wan quan shi ling yi ge gu shi ......]

english: But... I don't understand... If it was Zamorak who used the weapon, then why was it only you who were cursed?
translation: 但是……我不明白……如果是萨莫拉克使用了武器，那为什么只有你被诅咒了？ [dan shi …… wo bu ming bai …… ru guo shi sa mo la ke shi yong le wu qi ， na wei shen me zhi you ni bei zu zhou le ？]

english: And the other people who were cursed, why them? Why not the other Mahjarrat for example?
translation: 还有其他被诅咒的人，为什么是他们？例如，为什么不是其他 Mahjarrat 呢？ [hai you qi ta bei zu zhou de ren ， wei shen me shi ta men ？ li ru ， wei shen me bu shi qi ta  Mahjarrat  ne ？]

english: And just who was this 'Empty Lord' you keep speaking of?
translation: 而你口中的‘空主’到底是谁？ [er ni kou zhong de ‘ kong zhu ’ dao di shi shui ？]

english: Well, in my life I was nothing but a warrior. I had no hidden knowledge, I didn't especially care about the gods or their magics, and I certainly didn't respect them.
translation: 好吧，在我的一生中，我只不过是一名战士。我没有隐藏的知识，我并不特别关心诸神或他们的魔法，我当然也不尊重他们。 [hao ba ， zai wo de yi sheng zhong ， wo zhi bu guo shi yi ming zhan shi 。 wo mei you yin cang de zhi shi ， wo bing bu te bie guan xin zhu shen huo ta men de mo fa ， wo dang ran ye bu zun zhong ta men 。]

english: Now in my... I suppose this is my death. I am but a shade on the wind, unnoticed by all who pass me, until today anyway, and the only answer I can give you is that the others who were with me, the
translation: 现在在我的……我想这就是我的死亡。我只是风中的一个影子，没有被所有经过我的人注意到，无论如何，直到今天，我能给你的唯一答案是，那些和我在一起的人， [xian zai zai wo de …… wo xiang zhe jiu shi wo de si wang 。 wo zhi shi feng zhong de yi ge ying zi ， mei you bei suo you jing guo wo de ren zhu yi dao ， wu lun ru he ， zhi dao jin tian ， wo neng gei ni de wei yi da an shi ， na xie he wo zai yi qi de ren ，]

english: Mahjarrats and the Vampyre, they were beings of magic.
translation: Mahjarrats 和 Vampyre，他们是魔法生物。 [Mahjarrats  he  Vampyre， ta men shi mo fa sheng wu 。]

english: It runs through their very veins, and ebbs through their bones.
translation: 它贯穿他们的血管，并在他们的骨头中消退。 [ta guan chuan ta men de xue guan ， bing zai ta men de gu tou zhong xiao tui 。]

english: Who knows why the curse fell as it did? Perhaps as a mere human I was more susceptible to it, when they were not. Perhaps they too are cursed, but their life spans are so
translation: 谁知道为什么咒语会这样落下呢？也许作为一个普通人，我更容易受到它的影响，而他们则不然。也许他们也受到了诅咒，但他们的寿命却如此之长 [shui zhi dao wei shen me zhou yu hui zhe yang la xia ne ？ ye xu zuo wei yi ge pu tong ren ， wo geng rong yi shou dao ta de ying xiang ， er ta men ze bu ran 。 ye xu ta men ye shou dao le zu zhou ， dan ta men de shou ming que ru ci zhi zhang]

english: long that it will be millennia before they feel it upon them. Perhaps because it did not affect them, it extended backwards through time, to the moment the staff was
translation: 他们希望要过千年才能感受到它。或许是因为这并没有影响到他们，所以时间倒流到了工作人员被抓的那一刻。 [ta men xi wang yao guo qian nian cai neng gan shou dao ta 。 huo xu shi yin wei zhe bing mei you ying xiang dao ta men ， suo yi shi jian dao liu dao le gong zuo ren yuan bei zhua de na yi ke 。]

english: taken from its rightful place, and all who had known of its theft were cursed too. Perhaps there are others also cursed, who played no part in this tale, and were merely unlucky enough to be
translation: 它被从它应有的位置上夺走，所有知道它被盗的人也都受到了诅咒。也许还有其他人也受到了诅咒，他们在这个故事中没有扮演任何角色，只是不幸地被诅咒了。 [ta bei cong ta ying you de wei zhi shang duo zou ， suo you zhi dao ta bei dao de ren ye dou shou dao le zu zhou 。 ye xu hai you qi ta ren ye shou dao le zu zhou ， ta men zai zhe ge gu shi zhong mei you ban yan ren he jue se ， zhi shi bu xing di bei zu zhou le 。]

english: in the wrong place at the wrong time...
translation: 在错误的时间、错误的地点... [zai cuo wu de shi jian 、 cuo wu de di dian ...]

english: I don't know. Things do not always happen for a reason, just as tales do not always end with all of the loose ends neatly tied up and all answers supplied.
translation: 我不知道。事情的发生并不总是有原因的，就像故事并不总是以所有未解决的问题整齐地捆绑起来并提供所有答案一样结束。 [wo bu zhi dao 。 shi qing de fa sheng bing bu zong shi you yuan yin de ， jiu xiang gu shi bing bu zong shi yi suo you wei jie jue de wen ti zheng qi di kun bang qi lai bing ti gong suo you da an yi yang jie shu 。]

english: I have simply told you the events I was witness to, for I can do no more.
translation: 我只是告诉你们我所目睹的事件，因为我无能为力。 [wo zhi shi gao su ni men wo suo mu du de shi jian ， yin wei wo wu neng wei li 。]

english: You have cheered me no end to let me know that this curse that has afflicted me has not left me alone here, in this void between worlds.
translation: 你给了我无尽的欢呼，让我知道，这个折磨着我的诅咒并没有让我独自一人留在这里，在这个世界之间的虚无之中。 [ni gei le wo wu jin de huan hu ， rang wo zhi dao ， zhe ge zhe mo zhe wo de zu zhou bing mei you rang wo du zi yi ren liu zai zhe li ， zai zhe ge shi jie zhi jian de xu wu zhi zhong 。]

english: Perhaps I will hunt down these others who have also been cursed as I was, but I feel I must reward you for your efforts; Here, take my cloak, it is drenched in the blood of a
translation: 也许我会追捕那些和我一样受到诅咒的人，但我觉得我必须奖励你们的努力；来，拿走我的斗篷，它沾满了一个人的鲜血 [ye xu wo hui zhui bu na xie he wo yi yang shou dao zu zhou de ren ， dan wo jue de wo bi xu jiang li ni men de nu li ； lai ， na zou wo de dou peng ， ta zhan man le yi ge ren de xian xue]

english: thousand foes, and may bring you luck in battle.
translation: 成千上万的敌人，可能会给你带来战斗的好运。 [cheng qian shang wan de di ren ， ke neng hui gei ni dai lai zhan dou de hao yun 。]

english: So how can I break this curse?
translation: 那么怎样才能打破这个魔咒呢？ [na me zen yang cai neng da po zhe ge mo zhou ne ？]

english: Who knows? If it was the death curse of the Empty Lord, there may be no way to break it.
translation: 谁知道？如果是虚空之主的死亡诅咒，恐怕根本就没有办法破解。 [shui zhi dao ？ ru guo shi xu kong zhi zhu de si wang zu zhou ， kong pa gen ben jiu mei you ban fa po jie 。]

english: If it was not his death curse, and he is still alive but not on this world, then the only way to break it may be to bring him back here;
translation: 如果不是他的死咒，而他还活着，但并不在这个世界上，那么破解这个咒语的唯一办法或许就是把他带回这里； [ru guo bu shi ta de si zhou ， er ta hai huo zhe ， dan bing bu zai zhe ge shi jie shang ， na me po jie zhe ge zhou yu de wei yi ban fa huo xu jiu shi ba ta dai hui zhe li ；]

english: But I would rather stay cursed than suffer under his rule again...
translation: 但我宁愿继续被诅咒，也不愿再受他的统治…… [dan wo ning yuan ji xu bei zu zhou ， ye bu yuan zai shou ta de tong zhi ……]

english: But WHO was this 'Empty Lord'? WHAT was his NAME?
translation: 但这个“空主”是谁？他叫什么名字？ [dan zhe ge “ kong zhu ” shi shui ？ ta jiao shen me ming zi ？]

english: You do not know? You have not guessed yet?
translation: 你不知道吗？你还没猜到吗？ [ni bu zhi dao ma ？ ni hai mei cai dao ma ？]

english: He was Zaros.
translation: 他就是扎罗斯。 [ta jiu shi zha luo si 。]

english: Well, that's all fascinating, but I just don't particularly care. Bye-bye.
translation: 嗯，这一切都很有趣，但我并不特别关心。再见。 [n ， zhe yi qie dou hen you qu ， dan wo bing bu te bie guan xin 。 zai jian 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello yourself.
translation: 你好你自己。 [ni hao ni zi ji 。]

english: I really liked your little story. Can you tell me another one?
translation: 我真的很喜欢你的小故事。你能告诉我另一件事吗？ [wo zhen de hen xi huan ni de xiao gu shi 。 ni neng gao su wo ling yi jian shi ma ？]

english: Preferably something with a big fight and lots of explosions!
translation: 最好是有激烈战斗和大量爆炸的东西！ [zui hao shi you ji lie zhan dou he da liang bao zha de dong xi ！]

english: ...You are a very strange young [man/woman].
translation: ...你是一个非常奇怪的年轻人[男人/女人]。 [... ni shi yi ge fei chang qi guai de nian qing ren [ nan ren / nv ren ]。]

english: Could I have more of those ghostly robes you gave me?
translation: 我可以再要一件你送我的幽灵长袍吗？ [wo ke yi zai yao yi jian ni song wo de you ling chang pao ma ？]

english: It seems as though the curse that keeps me here extends to my very clothing... which piece do you want?
translation: 似乎让我留在这里的诅咒延伸到了我的衣服上……你想要哪一件？ [si hu rang wo liu zai zhe li de zu zhou yan shen dao le wo de yi fu shang …… ni xiang yao na yi jian ？]

english: Here you go.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: Hey, I have something for you but you don't have any space for it!
translation: 嘿，我有东西给你，但你没有地方放！ [hei ， wo you dong xi gei ni ， dan ni mei you di fang fang ！]

english: Tell me your story
translation: 告诉我你的故事 [gao su wo ni de gu shi]

english: Goodbye then
translation: 那么再见 [na me zai jian]

english: Talk about Viggora's story.
translation: 谈谈维戈拉的故事。 [tan tan wei ge la de gu shi 。]

english: Ask for more ghostly robes.
translation: 要求更多的幽灵长袍。 [yao qiu geng duo de you ling chang pao 。]

english: What do you want, human?
translation: 你想要什么，人类？ [ni xiang yao shen me ， ren lei ？]

english: Ehm, anything on offer?
translation: 嗯，有什么优惠吗？ [n ， you shen me you hui ma ？]

english: Can you wield a warhammer? If not, then go away.
translation: 你能挥舞战锤吗？如果没有，那就走开。 [ni neng hui wu zhan chui ma ？ ru guo mei you ， na jiu zou kai 。]

english: Of course I can.
translation: 我当然可以。 [wo dang ran ke yi 。]

english: I can, but I won't.
translation: 我可以，但我不会。 [wo ke yi ， dan wo bu hui 。]

english: Yeah, right.
translation: 是的，对。 [shi de ， dui 。]

english: That furnace is the property of the Red Axe! Hands off!
translation: 那熔炉是红斧的财产！把手拿开！ [na rong lu shi hong fu de cai chan ！ ba shou na kai ！]

english: That furnace is my property! Hands off!
translation: 那个熔炉是我的财产！把手拿开！ [na ge rong lu shi wo de cai chan ！ ba shou na kai ！]

english: Didn't all this belong to the Red Axe? And weren't you a member?
translation: 这一切不都是红斧的吗？而且你不是会员吗？ [zhe yi qie bu dou shi hong fu de ma ？ er qie ni bu shi hui yuan ma ？]

english: I don't know what you're talking about.
translation: 我不知道你在说什么。 [wo bu zhi dao ni zai shuo shen me 。]

english: Who do you think are, coming in here and using the property of the Red Axe!
translation: 你以为是谁，进来这里，使用红斧的财产！ [ni yi wei shi shui ， jin lai zhe li ， shi yong hong fu de cai chan ！]

english: Who do you think are, coming in here and using my property?
translation: 你认为谁会进来并使用我的财产？ [ni ren wei shui hui jin lai bing shi yong wo de cai chan ？]

english: Hands off! That fireplace belongs to the Red Axe, not some puny arrogant human!
translation: 把手拿开！那个壁炉是属于红斧的，而不是属于某个卑微傲慢的人类！ [ba shou na kai ！ na ge bi lu shi shu yu hong fu de ， er bu shi shu yu mou ge bei wei ao man de ren lei ！]

english: Hands off! That fireplace belongs to me! Not some puny arrogant human!
translation: 把手拿开！那个壁炉是我的！不是什么卑鄙傲慢的人类！ [ba shou na kai ！ na ge bi lu shi wo de ！ bu shi shen me bei bi ao man de ren lei ！]

english: Who gave you permission to use that?
translation: 谁允许你使用它的？ [shui yun xu ni shi yong ta de ？]

english: Of course I can.
translation: 我当然可以。 [wo dang ran ke yi 。]

english: I can, but I won't.
translation: 我可以，但我不会。 [wo ke yi ， dan wo bu hui 。]

english: I am offering a cart ride to Brimhaven, if you're interested. It will cost [amount] coins. Is that okay?
translation: 如果您有兴趣，我可以提供前往布里姆港的乘车服务。这将花费[数量]个硬币。可以吗？ [ru guo nin you xing qu ， wo ke yi ti gong qian wang bu li mu gang de cheng che fu wu 。 zhe jiang hua fei [ shu liang ] ge ying bi 。 ke yi ma ？]

english: Yes please, I'd like to go to Brimhaven.
translation: 是的，我想去布里姆哈文。 [shi de ， wo xiang qu bu li mu ha wen 。]

english: You hop into the cart and the driver urges the horses on. You take a taxing journey through the jungle to Brimhaven. You feel tired from the journey, but at least you didn't have to walk all that distance.
translation: 你跳上马车，车夫催促马匹上路。您将经历一段艰苦的旅程，穿过丛林到达布里姆港。旅途中你会感到很累，但至少不用走那么远的路。 [ni tiao shang ma che ， che fu cui cu ma pi shang lu 。 nin jiang jing li yi duan jian ku de lv cheng ， chuan guo cong lin dao da bu li mu gang 。 lv tu zhong ni hui gan dao hen lei ， dan zhi shao bu yong zou na me yuan de lu 。]

english: Sorry, but it looks as if you don't have enough money. Come and see me when you have enough for the ride.
translation: 抱歉，看来你的钱不够。等你玩够了就来见我吧。 [bao qian ， kan lai ni de qian bu gou 。 deng ni wan gou le jiu lai jian wo ba 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Okay, Bwana, let me know if you change your mind.
translation: 好吧，布瓦纳，如果你改变主意，请告诉我。 [hao ba ， bu wa na ， ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， qing gao su wo 。]

english: I am offering a cart ride to Brimhaven, if you're interested. For you, it's free.
translation: 如果您有兴趣，我可以提供前往布里姆港的乘车服务。对你来说，它是免费的。 [ru guo nin you xing qu ， wo ke yi ti gong qian wang bu li mu gang de cheng che fu wu 。 dui ni lai shuo ， ta shi mian fei de 。]

english: Sorry, I'm busy. I've got to get out of here! This place is swarming with zombies.
translation: 抱歉，我很忙。我必须离开这里！这个地方到处都是僵尸。 [bao qian ， wo hen mang 。 wo bi xu li kai zhe li ！ zhe ge di fang dao chu dou shi jiang shi 。]

english: Yes please, I'd like to go to Brimhaven.
translation: 是的，我想去布里姆哈文。 [shi de ， wo xiang qu bu li mu ha wen 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello, how's it going?
translation: 你好，怎么样？ [ni hao ， zen me yang ？]

english: Hello there! Nice weather we've been having.
translation: 你好呀！我们一直以来天气很好。 [ni hao ya ！ wo men yi zhi yi lai tian qi hen hao 。]

english: All these newcomers - what are they up to?
translation: 所有这些新人——他们在做什么？ [suo you zhe xie xin ren —— ta men zai zuo shen me ？]

english: What are you talking about?
translation: 你在说什么？ [ni zai shuo shen me ？]

english: Argh! Another one! No, I don't want to help with your scheme! I'm very busy!
translation: 啊！再来一个！不，我不想帮助你的计划！我很忙！ [a ！ zai lai yi ge ！ bu ， wo bu xiang bang zhu ni de ji hua ！ wo hen mang ！]

english: Ohhh kaaay... I'll leave you to it then.
translation: 噢，kaaay...那我就不说了。 [o ，kaaay... na wo jiu bu shuo le 。]

english: I'm fine, how are you?
translation: 我很好，你怎么样？ [wo hen hao ， ni zen me yang ？]

english: Very well, thank you.
translation: 很好，谢谢。 [hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Do you wish to trade?
translation: 您想进行交易吗？ [nin xiang jin xing jiao yi ma ？]

english: No, I have nothing I wish to get rid of. If you want to do some trading, there are plenty of shops and market stalls around though.
translation: 不，我没有什么想要摆脱的。如果您想做一些交易，周围有很多商店和市场摊位。 [bu ， wo mei you shen me xiang yao bai tuo de 。 ru guo nin xiang zuo yi xie jiao yi ， zhou wei you hen duo shang dian he shi chang tan wei 。]

english: Argh! Don't rob me!
translation: 啊！别抢我的东西！ [a ！ bie qiang wo de dong xi ！]

english: Sorry, I thought you were a bandit.
translation: 抱歉，我以为你是强盗。 [bao qian ， wo yi wei ni shi qiang dao 。]

english: There are a lot of them around here...
translation: 这附近有很多人... [zhe fu jin you hen duo ren ...]

english: None of your business.
translation: 关你屁事。 [guan ni pi shi 。]

english: Get out of my way, I'm in a hurry!
translation: 别挡我的路，我很着急！ [bie dang wo de lu ， wo hen zhao ji ！]

english: Not too bad, thanks.
translation: 还不错，谢谢。 [hai bu cuo ， xie xie 。]

english: I'm in search of enemies to kill.
translation: 我正在寻找要杀死的敌人。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yao sha si de di ren 。]

english: The desert just outside of town is full of wolves, snakes, and even wild Ugthanki. Try there.
translation: 城外的沙漠里到处都是狼、蛇，甚至还有野生的乌格坦基人。去那里试试。 [cheng wai de sha mo li dao chu dou shi lang 、 she ， shen zhi hai you ye sheng de wu ge tan ji ren 。 qu na li shi shi 。]

english: I'm in search of a quest.
translation: 我正在寻找一个任务。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yi ge ren wu 。]

english: I'm sorry, I can't help you there.
translation: 抱歉，我帮不了你。 [bao qian ， wo bang bu liao ni 。]

english: How can I help you?
translation: 我怎么帮你？ [wo zen me bang ni ？]

english: Do I know you? I'm in a hurry!
translation: 我知道你？我很着急！ [wo zhi dao ni ？ wo hen zhao ji ！]

english: I'm very well thank you.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm a bold adventurer.
translation: 我是一个大胆的冒险家。 [wo shi yi ge da dan de mao xian jia 。]

english: Ah, a most noble profession.
translation: 啊，一个最高尚的职业。 [a ， yi ge zui gao shang de zhi ye 。]

english: Do you wish to trade?
translation: 您想进行交易吗？ [nin xiang jin xing jiao yi ma ？]

english: I'm in search of a quest.
translation: 我正在寻找一个任务。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yi ge ren wu 。]

english: I'm in search of enemies to kill.
translation: 我正在寻找要杀死的敌人。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yao sha si de di ren 。]

english: Nilsal, friend. How goes it?
translation: 尼尔萨尔，朋友。进展如何？ [ni er sa er ， peng you 。 jin zhan ru he ？]

english: Do you need any help in the vineyards?
translation: 您在葡萄园里需要帮助吗？ [nin zai pu tao yuan li xu yao bang zhu ma ？]

english: Well we could always use a spare pair of hands!
translation: 好吧，我们总是可以使用一双手！ [hao ba ， wo men zong shi ke yi shi yong yi shuang shou ！]

english: Here, fill this barrel with four sets of ripe grapes and bring it back to me.
translation: 来，把这桶装满四组成熟的葡萄，然后带回来给我。 [lai ， ba zhe tong zhuang man si zu cheng shu de pu tao ， ran hou dai hui lai gei wo 。]

english: Got it! One barrel full of grapes coming right up.
translation: 知道了！一桶装满了葡萄马上就来了。 [zhi dao le ！ yi tong zhuang man le pu tao ma shang jiu lai le 。]

english: Just remember, I need them to be ripe. Generally, perfectly ripe grapes are full and vibrant. They'll shine in the sunlight more than others.
translation: 请记住，我需要它们成熟。一般来说，完全成熟的葡萄饱满且充满活力。他们在阳光下会比其他人更闪亮。 [qing ji zhu ， wo xu yao ta men cheng shu 。 yi ban lai shuo ， wan quan cheng shu de pu tao bao man qie chong man huo li 。 ta men zai yang guang xia hui bi qi ta ren geng shan liang 。]

english: Hopefully you know what you’re doing now. Just fill this barrel with four sets of ripe grapes and bring it back to me.
translation: 希望你知道你现在在做什么。只要在这个桶里装满四组成熟的葡萄，然后把它带回来给我就可以了。 [xi wang ni zhi dao ni xian zai zai zuo shen me 。 zhi yao zai zhe ge tong li zhuang man si zu cheng shu de pu tao ， ran hou ba ta dai hui lai gei wo jiu ke yi le 。]

english: We could always use a spare pair of hands! I have a grape barrel here for you, but you don't have enough room for it at the moment. Come back once you can carry it.
translation: 我们总是可以使用一双手！我这里有一个葡萄桶给你，但你现在没有足够的空间。等你能扛得住就回来吧。 [wo men zong shi ke yi shi yong yi shuang shou ！ wo zhe li you yi ge pu tao tong gei ni ， dan ni xian zai mei you zu gou de kong jian 。 deng ni neng kang de zhu jiu hui lai ba 。]

english: You've already got that grape barrel I gave you. Fill it with four sets of ripe grapes and bring it back to me.
translation: 我给你的葡萄桶你已经拿到了。把四组成熟的葡萄装满，然后带回来给我。 [wo gei ni de pu tao tong ni yi jing na dao le 。 ba si zu cheng shu de pu tao zhuang man ， ran hou dai hui lai gei wo 。]

english: Doesn't it get hot standing out here all day?
translation: 站在这里一整天不热吗？ [zhan zai zhe li yi zheng tian bu re ma ？]

english: Ah, you get used to it. Besides, I have a near-infinite supply of lukewarm grape juice to keep me hydrated!
translation: 啊，你习惯了。此外，我还有近乎无限量的温热葡萄汁来保持水分！ [a ， ni xi guan le 。 ci wai ， wo hai you jin hu wu xian liang de wen re pu tao zhi lai bao chi shui fen ！]

english: I'm good. I'll be going now.
translation: 我很好。我现在就走。 [wo hen hao 。 wo xian zai jiu zou 。]

english: One barrel o' grapes here for you, boss!
translation: 老板，给你一桶葡萄！ [lao ban ， gei ni yi tong pu tao ！]

english: Great work! Here, keep some grapes as payment.
translation: 干得好！在这里，留下一些葡萄作为报酬。 [gan de hao ！ zai zhe li ， liu xia yi xie pu tao zuo wei bao chou 。]

english: Can I have some gold instead?
translation: 我可以换点金子吗？ [wo ke yi huan dian jin zi ma ？]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Oh...
Now, if you're up for it, I wouldn't say no to you filling the barrel up again.
translation: 现在，如果你愿意的话，我不会拒绝你再把桶装满。 [xian zai ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo bu hui ju jue ni zai ba tong zhuang man 。]

english: Do you need any help in the vineyards?
translation: 您在葡萄园里需要帮助吗？ [nin zai pu tao yuan li xu yao bang zhu ma ？]

english: Doesn't it get hot standing out here all day?
translation: 站在这里一整天不热吗？ [zhan zai zhe li yi zheng tian bu re ma ？]

english: I'm good. I'll be going now.
translation: 我很好。我现在就走。 [wo hen hao 。 wo xian zai jiu zou 。]

english: Hello there. How's it going?
translation: 你好呀。怎么样了？ [ni hao ya 。 zen me yang le ？]

english: Lovely day for some wine!
translation: 美好的一天喝点酒！ [mei hao de yi tian he dian jiu ！]

english: I wish these grapes could pick themselves.
translation: 我希望这些葡萄能够自己采摘。 [wo xi wang zhe xie pu tao neng gou zi ji cai zhai 。]

english: The grapes are in good shape for this harvest.
translation: 本次收获的葡萄状况良好。 [ben ci shou huo de pu tao zhuang kuang liang hao 。]

english: I'm sorry, but the vineyards need tending to.
translation: 抱歉，葡萄园需要照料。 [bao qian ， pu tao yuan xu yao zhao liao 。]

english: Have you tried the wine? You won't regret it if you do!
translation: 你尝过酒吗？如果你这样做了，你不会后悔的！ [ni chang guo jiu ma ？ ru guo ni zhe yang zuo le ， ni bu hui hou hui de ！]

english: Nilsal. Do you wish me to exchange banknotes for you? I charge only 10 coins for each banknote.
translation: 尼尔萨尔。您需要我为您兑换钞票吗？我每张钞票只收取 10 个硬币。 [ni er sa er 。 nin xu yao wo wei nin dui huan chao piao ma ？ wo mei zhang chao piao zhi shou qu  10  ge ying bi 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Then hand me the banknotes you wish me to exchange.
translation: 然后把你要我兑换的钞票递给我。 [ran hou ba ni yao wo dui huan de chao piao di gei wo 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I am Virilis. I can exchange banknotes of bones for real items. Do you want any banknotes converted?
translation: 我是维莉丝。我可以用骨头纸币换真实的物品。您想要兑换任何纸币吗？ [wo shi wei li si 。 wo ke yi yong gu tou zhi bi huan zhen shi de wu pin 。 nin xiang yao dui huan ren he zhi bi ma ？]

english: What can I do here?
translation: 我在这里能做什么？ [wo zai zhe li neng zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm glad you've asked! Next to me is an old altar of Ralos, upon which you can ask for bones and wines to be blessed.
translation: 我很高兴你问了！我旁边有一座古老的拉洛斯祭坛，你可以在上面祈求骨头和酒来祝福。 [wo hen gao xing ni wen le ！ wo pang bian you yi zuo gu lao de la luo si ji tan ， ni ke yi zai shang mian qi qiu gu tou he jiu lai zhu fu 。]

english: You should beware though, Ralos won't hear your prayers if you aren't experienced enough. I wouldn't want you to get caught in the cold just waiting for nothing to happen.
translation: 但你应该注意，如果你经验不足，拉洛斯不会听到你的祈祷。我不想让你陷入寒冷，只是等待什么都没有发生。 [dan ni ying gai zhu yi ， ru guo ni jing yan bu zu ， la luo si bu hui ting dao ni de qi dao 。 wo bu xiang rang ni xian ru han leng ， zhi shi deng dai shen me dou mei you fa sheng 。]

english: Anyway, once you've had Ralos' blessing, you can break the bones down into shards. Then, along with your blessed wine, you can take them to the libation bowl and sacrifice them in Ralos' honour!
translation: 不管怎样，一旦你得到了拉洛斯的祝福，你就可以把骨头打碎成碎片。然后，您可以将它们与您的祝福酒一起带到奠酒碗中，并以拉洛斯的名义献祭它们！ [bu guan zen yang ， yi dan ni de dao le la luo si de zhu fu ， ni jiu ke yi ba gu tou da sui cheng sui pian 。 ran hou ， nin ke yi jiang ta men yu nin de zhu fu jiu yi qi dai dao dian jiu wan zhong ， bing yi la luo si de ming yi xian ji ta men ！]

english: Libation bowl?
translation: 奠酒碗？ [dian jiu wan ？]

english: Yes! You'll find it inside the Teomat, near the library.
translation: 是的！您可以在图书馆附近的 Teomat 内找到它。 [shi de ！ nin ke yi zai tu shu guan fu jin de  Teomat  nei zhao dao ta 。]

english: I see. And what happens if I drink the blessed wine?
translation: 我懂了。如果我喝了祝福酒会怎样？ [wo dong le 。 ru guo wo he le zhu fu jiu hui zen yang ？]

english: The last person to try that ended up in the libation bowl. I do not recommend it.
translation: 最后一个尝试的人最终进入了奠酒碗。我不推荐它。 [zui hou yi ge chang shi de ren zui zhong jin ru le dian jiu wan 。 wo bu tui jian ta 。]

english: Anyway, do you want any banknotes converted?
translation: 无论如何，您想要兑换钞票吗？ [wu lun ru he ， nin xiang yao dui huan chao piao ma ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: I'm afraid I can only exchange bank notes for real items.
translation: 恐怕我只能用钞票换实物。 [kong pa wo zhi neng yong chao piao huan shi wu 。]

english: I only exchange bones that you can bless at Ralos' altar.
translation: 我只交换你能在拉洛斯祭坛上祝福的骨头。 [wo zhi jiao huan ni neng zai la luo si ji tan shang zhu fu de gu tou 。]

english: I require 10 coins for exchanging each banknote.
translation: 我需要 10 个硬币来兑换每张钞票。 [wo xu yao  10  ge ying bi lai dui huan mei zhang chao piao 。]

english: Your inventory is too full.
translation: 你的库存太满了。 [ni de ku cun tai man le 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: What can I do here?
translation: 我在这里能做什么？ [wo zai zhe li neng zuo shen me ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: I don't want whatever it is you're selling.
translation: 你卖的东西我都不要。 [ni mai de dong xi wo dou bu yao 。]

english: But I'm not selling anything.
translation: 但我不卖任何东西。 [dan wo bu mai ren he dong xi 。]

english: You think I believe that? Why else would you be here?
translation: 你认为我相信吗？不然你为什么会在这里？ [ni ren wei wo xiang xin ma ？ bu ran ni wei shen me hui zai zhe li ？]

english: Just seeing the sights?
translation: 只是看看景点吗？ [zhi shi kan kan jing dian ma ？]

english: What sights? What's wrong with you.
translation: 什么景点？你这人怎么回事。 [shen me jing dian ？ ni zhe ren zen me hui shi 。]

english: Nothing...
translation: 没有什么... [mei you shen me ...]

english: Get out, you weirdo!
translation: 滚出去，你这个怪人！ [gun chu qu ， ni zhe ge guai ren ！]

english: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 人类！在我叫守卫之前回到奴隶围栏！ [ren lei ！ zai wo jiao shou wei zhi qian hui dao nu li wei lan ！]

english: What is it, human? Speak and begone, your presence disgusts me!
translation: 这是什么，人类？说完就走吧，你的存在让我感到恶心！ [zhe shi shen me ， ren lei ？ shuo wan jiu zou ba ， ni de cun zai rang wo gan dao e xin ！]

english: Oh, uh, I'm sorry.
translation: 哦，呃，对不起。 [o ， e ， dui bu qi 。]

english: Stop your muttering and get to the point!
translation: 停止你的嘀咕，进入正题吧！ [ting zhi ni de di gu ， jin ru zheng ti ba ！]

english: W-Who are you?
translation: 你-你是谁？ [ni - ni shi shui ？]

english: I am the Voice of Yama.
translation: 我是阎罗王的声音。 [wo shi yan luo wang de sheng yin 。]

english: Yama?
translation: 阎王？ [yan wang ？]

english: Yama is my master, a powerful demon of fire.
translation: 阎摩是我的主人，强大的火魔。 [yan mo shi wo de zhu ren ， qiang da de huo mo 。]

english: Why can't Yama speak for themself?
translation: 为什么阎摩不能为自己说话？ [wei shen me yan mo bu neng wei zi ji shuo hua ？]

english: Currently my master resides below us, building strength. Worry not, human, my master will eventually own your soul too.
translation: 现在我的主人就在我们下面，正在积蓄力量。别担心，人类，我的主人最终也会拥有你的灵魂。 [xian zai wo de zhu ren jiu zai wo men xia mian ， zheng zai ji xu li liang 。 bie dan xin ， ren lei ， wo de zhu ren zui zhong ye hui yong you ni de ling hun 。]

english: I'll be leaving now.
translation: 我现在就要走了。 [wo xian zai jiu yao zou le 。]

english: I suspect you should.
translation: 我怀疑你应该这样做。 [wo huai yi ni ying gai zhe yang zuo 。]

english: You must complete A Kingdom Divided to access Yama's domain.
translation: 您必须完成王国分裂才能访问 Yama 的领域。 [nin bi xu wan cheng wang guo fen lie cai neng fang wen  Yama  de ling yu 。]

english: The arrogant human finally arrives...
translation: 傲慢的人类终于来了…… [ao man de ren lei zhong yu lai le ……]

english: Upset that I disrupted your plans?
translation: 因我破坏了你的计划而感到不安吗？ [yin wo po huai le ni de ji hua er gan dao bu an ma ？]

english: Disgusting. My master, the great demon Yama, wishes to speak with you.
translation: 恶心。我的主人，大魔王阎罗王，想要和你说话。 [e xin 。 wo de zhu ren ， da mo wang yan luo wang ， xiang yao he ni shuo hua 。]

english: Yama wants to speak with me? How do you know that? You shouldn't even be able to talk to him.
translation: 阎摩想和我说话吗？你怎么知道的？你甚至不应该和他说话。 [yan mo xiang he wo shuo hua ma ？ ni zen me zhi dao de ？ ni shen zhi bu ying gai he ta shuo hua 。]

english: My master wishes to have the satisfaction of explaining that to you himself. For this, I envy him. I will make do with the idiotic expression you wear presently.
translation: 我的主人希望亲自向您解释这一点，对此感到满意。为此，我很羡慕他。我就用你现在那副愚蠢的表情凑合一下吧。 [wo de zhu ren xi wang qin zi xiang nin jie shi zhe yi dian ， dui ci gan dao man yi 。 wei ci ， wo hen xian mu ta 。 wo jiu yong ni xian zai na fu yu chun de biao qing cou he yi xia ba 。]

english: I planted the device! Your connection should be severed!
translation: 我种下了这个装置！你的连接应该被切断！ [wo zhong xia le zhe ge zhuang zhi ！ ni de lian jie ying gai bei qie duan ！]

english: Silence, human! You will make no demands of me. Proceed to my master's domain and speak with him yourself if you desire an answer.
translation: 沉默吧，人类！你不会对我提出任何要求。如果你想得到答案，就前往我主人的领地，亲自与他交谈。 [chen mo ba ， ren lei ！ ni bu hui dui wo ti chu ren he yao qiu 。 ru guo ni xiang de dao da an ， jiu qian wang wo zhu ren de ling di ， qin zi yu ta jiao tan 。]

english: Player is transported to Yama's Domain.
translation: 玩家被传送到阎魔的领地。 [wan jia bei chuan song dao yan mo de ling di 。]

english: You enter Yama's Domain.
translation: 你进入了阎王的领域。 [ni jin ru le yan wang de ling yu 。]

english: I think I'd rather stay here.
translation: 我想我宁愿留在这里。 [wo xiang wo ning yuan liu zai zhe li 。]

english: Weakness! Cowardice! Disgusting. Begone, human!
translation: 弱点！怯懦！恶心。走开吧，人类！ [ruo dian ！ qie nuo ！ e xin 。 zou kai ba ， ren lei ！]

english: Proceed or begone, human. I will not bear your foul presence any longer than is necessary.
translation: 继续或离开，人类。如果没有必要的话，我不会忍受你的肮脏存在。 [ji xu huo li kai ， ren lei 。 ru guo mei you bi yao de hua ， wo bu hui ren shou ni de ang zang cun zai 。]

english: Enter Yama's domain.
translation: 进入Yama的领域。 [jin ru Yama de ling yu 。]

english: Stay.
translation: 停留。 [ting liu 。]

english: The purple, western portal shield is down!
translation: 紫色的西方传送门护盾落下！ [zi se de xi fang chuan song men hu dun la xia ！]

english: The blue, eastern portal shield is down!
translation: 蓝色的东方传送门护盾已倒下！ [lan se de dong fang chuan song men hu dun yi dao xia ！]

english: The yellow, south-eastern portal shield is down!
translation: 黄色的东南传送门护盾已倒下！ [huang se de dong nan chuan song men hu dun yi dao xia ！]

english: The red, south-western portal shield is down!
translation: 西南方向的红色传送门护盾落下！ [xi nan fang xiang de hong se chuan song men hu dun la xia ！]

english: Sorry, outlander, but I have things to be doing.
translation: 抱歉，外地人，但我还有事要做。 [bao qian ， wai di ren ， dan wo hai you shi yao zuo 。]

english: Hello there. Enjoying the view?
translation: 你好呀。欣赏美景？ [ni hao ya 。 xin shang mei jing ？]

english: Yes I am. You have a lovely yurt.
translation: 我是。你有一个可爱的蒙古包。 [wo shi 。 ni you yi ge ke ai de meng gu bao 。]

english: Thanks! I exercise it regularly.
translation: 谢谢！我经常锻炼它。 [xie xie ！ wo jing chang duan lian ta 。]

english: Hello again! Does my father send any word...or treasures like before?
translation: 又好！我的父亲有没有像以前一样送来任何文字……或者宝物？ [you hao ！ wo de fu qin you mei you xiang yi qian yi yang song lai ren he wen zi …… huo zhe bao wu ？]

english: Not today, but if he does, you will be the first to know.
translation: 今天不是，但如果他这样做了，你将是第一个知道的。 [jin tian bu shi ， dan ru guo ta zhe yang zuo le ， ni jiang shi di yi ge zhi dao de 。]

english: Volf? Son of Olaf Hradson?
translation: 沃尔夫？奥拉夫·赫拉德森的儿子？ [wo er fu ？ ao la fu · he la de sen de er zi ？]

english: Yes. Do I know you?
translation: 是的。我知道你？ [shi de 。 wo zhi dao ni ？]

english: No, but I do know your father. He sent me with a present for you from, err...
translation: 不，但我确实认识你的父亲。他给我送了一份礼物给你，呃…… [bu ， dan wo que shi ren shi ni de fu qin 。 ta gei wo song le yi fen li wu gei ni ， e ……]

english: From the Island of Obscurity.
translation: 来自默默无闻的岛屿。 [lai zi mo mo wu wen de dao yu 。]

english: Oh! That was fast! He only set off recently, and I was wondering how he was doing. So, where is this gift?
translation: 哦！太快了！他最近才出发，我想知道他过得怎么样。那么，这个礼物在哪里呢？ [o ！ tai kuai le ！ ta zui jin cai chu fa ， wo xiang zhi dao ta guo de zen me yang 。 na me ， zhe ge li wu zai na li ne ？]

english: Right here. Enjoy!
translation: 就在这里。享受！ [jiu zai zhe li 。 xiang shou ！]

english: What is it?
translation: 它是什么？ [ta shi shen me ？]

english: Very valuable. Have a nice time!
translation: 非常有价值。祝你玩得愉快！ [fei chang you jia zhi 。 zhu ni wan de yu kuai ！]

english: Wait! Here, take this. I was going to have it for my lunch, but I suppose you can have it in payment.
translation: 等待！给，拿着这个。我原本打算在午餐时吃它，但我想你可以付款。 [deng dai ！ gei ， na zhe zhe ge 。 wo yuan ben da suan zai wu can shi chi ta ， dan wo xiang ni ke yi fu kuan 。]

english: Thanks! Enjoy your new...thing!
translation: 谢谢！享受你的新...事物！ [xie xie ！ xiang shou ni de xin ... shi wu ！]

english: Hey! I'm [Vampyre name]. What's your name?
translation: 嘿！我是[吸血鬼名字]。你叫什么名字？ [hei ！ wo shi [ xi xue gui ming zi ]。 ni jiao shen me ming zi ？]

english: Von van Von.
translation: 冯·范·冯. [feng · fan · feng .]

english: I'm sorry... What?
translation: 对不起……什么？ [dui bu qi …… shen me ？]

english: Did I stutter? My name is Von van Von.
translation: 我结巴了吗？我叫冯·范·冯。 [wo jie ba le ma ？ wo jiao feng · fan · feng 。]

english: Your name is Von van Von?
translation: 你叫冯·范·冯？ [ni jiao feng · fan · feng ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: Sorry, just to clarify. Von van Von? That's your name?
translation: 抱歉，只是为了澄清一下。冯·范·冯？那是你的名字？ [bao qian ， zhi shi wei le cheng qing yi xia 。 feng · fan · feng ？ na shi ni de ming zi ？]

english: Yes! Is there a problem?
translation: 是的！有问题吗？ [shi de ！ you wen ti ma ？]

english: Well... I guess not.
translation: 嗯...我想不是。 [n ... wo xiang bu shi 。]

english: Good! Now leave me alone!
translation: 好的！现在别管我了！ [hao de ！ xian zai bie guan wo le ！]

english: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 人类！在我叫守卫之前回到奴隶围栏！ [ren lei ！ zai wo jiao shou wei zhi qian hui dao nu li wei lan ！]

english: Get out of my house!
translation: 滚出我家！ [gun chu wo jia ！]

english: But I...
translation: 但我... [dan wo ...]

english: But nothing! Get out!
translation: 但什么也没有！出去！ [dan shen me ye mei you ！ chu qu ！]

english: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 人类！在我叫守卫之前回到奴隶围栏！ [ren lei ！ zai wo jiao shou wei zhi qian hui dao nu li wei lan ！]

english: Hey Vorki, got any interesting dragon facts?
translation: 嘿，Vorki，有什么有趣的龙事实吗？ [hei ，Vorki， you shen me you qu de long shi shi ma ？]

english: Although they have wings, dragons rarely fly. This is because the animals they prey on are all ground dwelling.
translation: 尽管龙有翅膀，但它们很少飞翔。这是因为它们捕食的动物都是地面动物。 [jin guan long you chi bang ， dan ta men hen shao fei xiang 。 zhe shi yin wei ta men bu shi de dong wu dou shi di mian dong wu 。]

english: Unlike their creators, dragons have the ability to reproduce. Like most reptiles, they are oviparous. This means that they lay eggs rather than birthing live young.
translation: 与它们的创造者不同，龙有繁殖的能力。像大多数爬行动物一样，它们是卵生的。这意味着它们产卵而不是生下活的幼崽。 [yu ta men de chuang zao zhe bu tong ， long you fan zhi de neng li 。 xiang da duo shu pa xing dong wu yi yang ， ta men shi luan sheng de 。 zhe yi wei zhe ta men chan luan er bu shi sheng xia huo de you zai 。]

english: Dragons have a very long lifespan and can live for thousands of years. With a lifespan that long, most dragons die to combat instead of age.
translation: 龙的寿命非常长，可以活上千年。由于寿命如此之长，大多数龙死于战斗而不是衰老。 [long de shou ming fei chang zhang ， ke yi huo shang qian nian 。 you yu shou ming ru ci zhi zhang ， da duo shu long si yu zhan dou er bu shi shuai lao 。]

english: While very closely related, dragons and wyverns are actually different species. You can easily tell the difference between them by counting the number of legs, dragons have four while wyverns have two.
translation: 虽然关系密切，但龙和双足飞龙实际上是不同的物种。您可以通过计算腿的数量来轻松区分它们，龙有四条腿，双足飞龙有两条。 [sui ran guan xi mi qie ， dan long he shuang zu fei long shi ji shang shi bu tong de wu zhong 。 nin ke yi tong guo ji suan tui de shu liang lai qing song qu fen ta men ， long you si tiao tui ， shuang zu fei long you liang tiao 。]

english: Metallic dragons were created by inserting molten metal into the eggs of other dragons. Very few eggs survived this process.
translation: 金属龙是通过将熔化的金属注入其他龙的蛋中而创造出来的。很少有鸡蛋能在这个过程中幸存下来。 [jin shu long shi tong guo jiang rong hua de jin shu zhu ru qi ta long de dan zhong er chuang zao chu lai de 。 hen shao you ji dan neng zai zhe ge guo cheng zhong xing cun xia lai 。]

english: The dragonkin created dragons by fusing their own lifeblood with that of a lizard. The dragonkin created other species in similar ways by using different types of reptile.
translation: 龙族通过将自己的生命线与蜥蜴的生命线融合而创造了龙。龙族通过使用不同类型的爬行动物以类似的方式创造了其他物种。 [long zu tong guo jiang zi ji de sheng ming xian yu xi yi de sheng ming xian rong he er chuang zao le long 。 long zu tong guo shi yong bu tong lei xing de pa xing dong wu yi lei si de fang shi chuang zao le qi ta wu zhong 。]

english: Dragons have the ability to speak. However, most dragons don't have the brain capacity to do it very well.
translation: 龙有说话的能力。然而，大多数龙没有足够的大脑能力来做好这件事。 [long you shuo hua de neng li 。 ran er ， da duo shu long mei you zu gou de da nao neng li lai zuo hao zhe jian shi 。]

english: Dragons share their name with dragon equipment, which was also created by the dragonkin. This equipment is fashioned out of Orikalkum.
translation: 龙与龙装备同名，龙装备也是由龙族创造的。该设备由 Orikalkum 制成。 [long yu long zhuang bei tong ming ， long zhuang bei ye shi you long zu chuang zao de 。 gai she bei you  Orikalkum  zhi cheng 。]

english: Although very aggressive, dragons do not typically stray from their own territory. They instead make their homes in places where there is plenty of prey to be found.
translation: 虽然龙非常具有攻击性，但通常不会离开自己的领地。相反，它们在有大量猎物的地方安家。 [sui ran long fei chang ju you gong ji xing ， dan tong chang bu hui li kai zi ji de ling di 。 xiang fan ， ta men zai you da liang lie wu de di fang an jia 。]

english: Well, we don't want to tell anyone else about that, because we don't want anyone else sharing in all that glory and treasure.
translation: 好吧，我们不想告诉其他任何人，因为我们不希望其他任何人分享所有的荣耀和财富。 [hao ba ， wo men bu xiang gao su qi ta ren he ren ， yin wei wo men bu xi wang qi ta ren he ren fen xiang suo you de rong yao he cai fu 。]

english: Well, it looks to me like YOU don't know EITHER seeing as you're all just sat around here.
translation: 好吧，在我看来你们都不知道，因为你们都坐在这儿。 [hao ba ， zai wo kan lai ni men dou bu zhi dao ， yin wei ni men dou zuo zai zhe er 。]

translation: 我们当然知道！我们只是还没有找到愚蠢的妖精藏在哪棵树上！ [wo men dang ran zhi dao ！ wo men zhi shi hai mei you zhao dao yu chun de yao jing cang zai na ke shu shang ！]

translation: 妖精？ [yao jing ？]

translation: 嘎啊！我不是故意告诉你这个的！听着，忘了我说过什么好吗？ [ga a ！ wo bu shi gu yi gao su ni zhe ge de ！ ting zhe ， wang le wo shuo guo shen me hao ma ？]

translation: 那么小妖精知道扎纳里斯在哪里吗？ [na me xiao yao jing zhi dao zha na li si zai na li ma ？]

english: Ye.. uh, no. No, not at all. And even if he did - which he doesn't - he DEFINITELY ISN'T hiding in some tree around here. Nope, definitely not. Honestly.
translation: 是的..呃，不。不，一点也不。即使他这样做了——他没有这样做——他也绝对不会躲在这附近的某棵树上。不，绝对不是。诚实地。 [shi de .. e ， bu 。 bu ， yi dian ye bu 。 ji shi ta zhe yang zuo le —— ta mei you zhe yang zuo —— ta ye jue dui bu hui duo zai zhe fu jin de mou ke shu shang 。 bu ， jue dui bu shi 。 cheng shi di 。]

translation: 帮助？有什么帮助？我没帮忙！请不要说是我干的，我会惹上麻烦的！ [bang zhu ？ you shen me bang zhu ？ wo mei bang mang ！ qing bu yao shuo shi wo gan de ， wo hui re shang ma fan de ！]

translation: 让我说清楚：我需要在这附近的树上寻找小妖精；然后当我找到他时，他会告诉我这个“扎纳里斯”在哪里？ [rang wo shuo qing chu ： wo xu yao zai zhe fu jin de shu shang xun zhao xiao yao jing ； ran hou dang wo zhao dao ta shi ， ta hui gao su wo zhe ge “ zha na li si ” zai na li ？]

english: What? How did you know that? Uh... I mean, no, no you're very wrong. Very wrong, and not right at all, and I definitely didn't tell you about that at all.
translation: 什么？你怎么知道的？呃...我的意思是，不，不，你错了。非常错误，而且根本不对，而且我绝对没有告诉过你这一点。 [shen me ？ ni zen me zhi dao de ？ e ... wo de yi si shi ， bu ， bu ， ni cuo le 。 fei chang cuo wu ， er qie gen ben bu dui ， er qie wo jue dui mei you gao su guo ni zhe yi dian 。]

english: There's no such thing!

translation: 嘿，谢谢您提供的所有信息。它确实帮助我找到了失落的扎纳里斯之城等等。 [hei ， xie xie nin ti gong de suo you xin xi 。 ta que shi bang zhu wo zhao dao le shi luo de zha na li si zhi cheng deng deng 。]

english: I don't think you've found a good adventure at all!
translation: 我认为你根本没有找到好的冒险经历！ [wo ren wei ni gen ben mei you zhao dao hao de mao xian jing li ！]

english: Who are you? Are you one of the new guards?
translation: 你是谁？你是新来的守卫之一吗？ [ni shi shui ？ ni shi xin lai de shou wei zhi yi ma ？]

english: No, I'm an adventurer.
translation: 不，我是冒险家。 [bu ， wo shi mao xian jia 。]

english: Well what are you doing here?
translation: 那么你在这里做什么？ [na me ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Looking for adventures - what else?
translation: 寻找冒险——还有什么？ [xun zhao mao xian —— hai you shen me ？]

english: Oh my, oh my! What does it all matter in the end, anyway?
translation: 天哪，天哪！无论如何，这一切到底有什么关系呢？ [tian na ， tian na ！ wu lun ru he ， zhe yi qie dao di you shen me guan xi ne ？]
