translation: 怎么了？ [zen me le ？]

english: Oh dear, oh dear. Darn and drat!
translation: 哦亲爱的，哦亲爱的。该死的！ [o qin ai de ， o qin ai de 。 gai si de ！]

english: We try hard to keep this town protected.
translation: 我们努力保护这个城镇。 [wo men nu li bao hu zhe ge cheng zhen 。]

english: But how can we do that when the Watchtower isn't working?
translation: 但是当守望台不工作时我们怎么能做到这一点呢？ [dan shi dang shou wang tai bu gong zuo shi wo men zen me neng zuo dao zhe yi dian ne ？]

english: What do you mean it isn't working?
translation: 你说它不起作用是什么意思？ [ni shuo ta bu qi zuo yong shi shen me yi si ？]

english: The Watchtower over here works by the power of magic. An ancient spell designed to ward off ogres that has been in place here for many moons.
translation: 这里的了望塔依靠魔法的力量运作。一个旨在抵御食人魔的古老咒语，已经在这里存在了很多个月了。 [zhe li de le wang ta yi kao mo fa de li liang yun zuo 。 yi ge zhi zai di yu shi ren mo de gu lao zhou yu ， yi jing zai zhe li cun zai le hen duo ge yue le 。]

english: The exact knowledge of the spell is lost to us now, but the essence of the spell has been infused into four powering crystals that keep the tower protected from the hordes in the Feldips.
translation: 我们现在已经不知道该咒语的确切知识，但该咒语的精髓已被注入四块能量水晶中，以保护塔楼免受费尔迪普斯部落的侵害。 [wo men xian zai yi jing bu zhi dao gai zhou yu di que qie zhi shi ， dan gai zhou yu de jing sui yi bei zhu ru si kuai neng liang shui jing zhong ， yi bao hu ta lou mian shou fei er di pu si bu luo de qin hai 。]

english: So how come the spell doesn't work?
translation: 那么为什么咒语不起作用呢？ [na me wei shen me zhou yu bu qi zuo yong ne ？]

english: The crystals! The crystals have been taken!
translation: 晶体！水晶被夺走了！ [jing ti ！ shui jing bei duo zou le ！]

english: Taken?
translation: 被拍了？ [bei pai le ？]

english: Stolen!
translation: 被盗！ [bei dao ！]

english: Stolen?
translation: 被盗？ [bei dao ？]

english: Yes, yes! Do I have to repeat myself?
translation: 是的，是的！我必须重复一遍吗？ [shi de ， shi de ！ wo bi xu chong fu yi bian ma ？]

english: Can I be of help?
translation: 我可以帮忙吗？ [wo ke yi bang mang ma ？]

english: Help? Oh wonderful, dear traveller!
translation: 帮助？哦，太棒了，亲爱的旅行者！ [bang zhu ？ o ， tai bang le ， qin ai de lv xing zhe ！]

english: Yes I could do with an extra pair of eyes here.
translation: 是的，我需要多一双眼睛。 [shi de ， wo xu yao duo yi shuang yan jing 。]

english: There must be some evidence of what has happened here. Perhaps you could assist me in searching for clues?
translation: 一定有一些证据证明这里发生了什么。也许你可以帮我寻找线索？ [yi ding you yi xie zheng ju zheng ming zhe li fa sheng le shen me 。 ye xu ni ke yi bang wo xun zhao xian suo ？]

english: I would be happy to.
translation: 我很乐意。 [wo hen le yi 。]

english: Try searching the surrounding area. If you find anything unusual, bring it here. Try the bushes - I've read enough adventure stoies to know that clues get caught in bushes all the time.
translation: 尝试搜索周边地区。如果您发现任何异常情况，请将其带到这里。尝试一下灌木丛——我读过足够多的冒险故事，知道线索总是藏在灌木丛中。 [chang shi sou suo zhou bian di qu 。 ru guo nin fa xian ren he yi chang qing kuang ， qing jiang qi dai dao zhe li 。 chang shi yi xia guan mu cong —— wo du guo zu gou duo de mao xian gu shi ， zhi dao xian suo zong shi cang zai guan mu cong zhong 。]

english: I will tell the guards to let you past - that way, you can just use the ladder to get in and out.
translation: 我会告诉守卫让你过去——这样你就可以用梯子进出。 [wo hui gao su shou wei rang ni guo qu —— zhe yang ni jiu ke yi yong ti zi jin chu 。]

english: I'm not interested.
translation: 我对此不感兴趣。 [wo dui ci bu gan xing qu 。]

english: That's typical, nowadays. It's left to us wizards to do all the work.
translation: 如今，这很典型。所有的工作都留给我们巫师来完成。 [ru jin ， zhe hen dian xing 。 suo you de gong zuo dou liu gei wo men wu shi lai wan cheng 。]

english: I'm not interested in your rantings.
translation: 我对你的胡言乱语不感兴趣。 [wo dui ni de hu yan luan yu bu gan xing qu 。]

english: Hmph! Suit yourself.
translation: 哼！适合自己。 [heng ！ shi he zi ji 。]

english: You wizards are always complaining.
translation: 你们这些巫师总是在抱怨。 [ni men zhe xie wu shi zong shi zai bao yuan 。]

english: Complaining? Complaining!
translation: 抱怨？抱怨！ [bao yuan ？ bao yuan ！]

english: What folks these days don't realise is that if it weren't for us wizards, this entire world would be overrun with every creature you could possibly imagine. And some you couldn't even conceive of!
translation: 如今人们没有意识到，如果没有我们巫师，整个世界将会被你能想象到的各种生物所淹没。还有一些你根本想象不到的！ [ru jin ren men mei you yi shi dao ， ru guo mei you wo men wu shi ， zheng ge shi jie jiang hui bei ni neng xiang xiang dao de ge zhong sheng wu suo yan mo 。 hai you yi xie ni gen ben xiang xiang bu dao de ！]

english: Hello again. Did you find anything of interest?
translation: 又好。你发现什么有趣的事情了吗？ [you hao 。 ni fa xian shen me you qu de shi qing le ma ？]

english: No, sorry, nothing yet.
translation: 不，抱歉，还什么都没有。 [bu ， bao qian ， hai shen me dou mei you 。]

english: Oh dear, oh dear, there must be something, somewhere...
translation: 哦天哪，天哪，一定有什么东西，在某个地方...... [o tian na ， tian na ， yi ding you shen me dong xi ， zai mou ge di fang ......]

english: Have a look at these...
translation: 看看这些... [kan kan zhe xie ...]

english: Interesting, very interesting.
translation: 有趣，非常有趣。 [you qu ， fei chang you qu 。]

english: Long nails...grey in colour...well chewed...
translation: 长指甲...灰色...咀嚼得很好... [zhang zhi jia ... hui se ... ju jue de hen hao ...]

english: Of course! They belong to a skavid!
translation: 当然！他们属于斯卡维人！ [dang ran ！ ta men shu yu si ka wei ren ！]

english: A skavid?
translation: 斯卡维人？ [si ka wei ren ？]

english: A servent race to the ogres: grey, depressed-looking creatures, always losing nails, teeth and hair!
translation: 食人魔的仆人种族：灰色、表情沮丧的生物，总是失去指甲、牙齿和头发！ [shi ren mo de pu ren zhong zu ： hui se 、 biao qing ju sang de sheng wu ， zong shi shi qu zhi jia 、 ya chi he tou fa ！]

english: They inhabit the caves in the Feldip Hills.
translation: 他们居住在费尔迪普山的洞穴中。 [ta men ju zhu zai fei er di pu shan de dong xue zhong 。]

english: They normally keep to themselves, though. It's unusual for them to venture from their caves.
translation: 不过，他们通常会独来独往。对他们来说，从洞穴中冒险是不寻常的。 [bu guo ， ta men tong chang hui du lai du wang 。 dui ta men lai shuo ， cong dong xue zhong mao xian shi bu xun chang de 。]

english: What do you suggest I do?
translation: 你建议我做什么？ [ni jian yi wo zuo shen me ？]

english: Shall I search the caves?
translation: 我要搜索洞穴吗？ [wo yao sou suo dong xue ma ？]

english: It's no good searching the caves. Well, not yet, anyway.
translation: 搜索洞穴是没有好处的。好吧，无论如何，还没有。 [sou suo dong xue shi mei you hao chu de 。 hao ba ， wu lun ru he ， hai mei you 。]

english: Why not?
translation: 为什么不呢？ [wei shen me bu ne ？]

english: They are deep and complex. The only way you will navigate the caves is to have a map or something.
translation: 它们是深刻而复杂的。游览洞穴的唯一方法就是拥有地图或其他东西。 [ta men shi shen ke er fu za de 。 you lan dong xue de wei yi fang fa jiu shi yong you di tu huo qi ta dong xi 。]

english: It may be that the ogres have one...
translation: 也许食人魔有一个…… [ye xu shi ren mo you yi ge ……]

english: And how do you know that?
translation: 你怎么知道的？ [ni zen me zhi dao de ？]

english: Well... I don't.
translation: 嗯...我不知道。 [n ... wo bu zhi dao 。]

english: You need to be fearless and gain entrance to Gu'Tanoth, the city of the ogres, then find out how to navigate the caves.
translation: 你需要无所畏惧，进入食人魔之城古塔诺斯，然后了解如何在洞穴中航行。 [ni xu yao wu suo wei ju ， jin ru shi ren mo zhi cheng gu ta nuo si ， ran hou liao jie ru he zai dong xue zhong hang xing 。]

english: That sounds scary...
translation: 听起来很可怕... [ting qi lai hen ke pa ...]

english: Ogres are nasty creatures, yes. Only a strong warrior, and a clever one at that, can get the better of them.
translation: 食人魔是令人讨厌的生物，是的。只有一位强大的战士，而且是一位聪明的战士，才能战胜他们。 [shi ren mo shi ling ren tao yan de sheng wu ， shi de 。 zhi you yi wei qiang da de zhan shi ， er qie shi yi wei cong ming de zhan shi ， cai neng zhan sheng ta men 。]

english: What do I need to do to get into the city?
translation: 我需要做什么才能进入城市？ [wo xu yao zuo shen me cai neng jin ru cheng shi ？]

english: You'll need some way to make the guards let you in.
translation: 你需要想办法让守卫让你进去。 [ni xu yao xiang ban fa rang shou wei rang ni jin qu 。]

english: You could start by checking out the ogres settlements around here. Tribal ogres often dislike their neighbours... In the meantime, I'll throw those fingernails out for you.
translation: 你可以先看看这里附近的食人魔定居点。部落食人魔常常不喜欢他们的邻居……同时，我会为你扔掉那些指甲。 [ni ke yi xian kan kan zhe li fu jin de shi ren mo ding ju dian 。 bu luo shi ren mo chang chang bu xi huan ta men de lin ju …… tong shi ， wo hui wei ni reng diao na xie zhi jia 。]

english: (The fingernails are removed from your inventory)
translation: （指甲已从您的库存中移除） [（ zhi jia yi cong nin de ku cun zhong yi chu ）]

english: Won't bother? Won't bother!
translation: 不会打扰吗？不会打扰！ [bu hui da rao ma ？ bu hui da rao ！]

english: Perhaps this quest is too hard for you!
translation: 也许这个任务对你来说太难了！ [ye xu zhe ge ren wu dui ni lai shuo tai nan le ！]

english: How's it going?
translation: 怎么样了？ [zen me yang le ？]

english: I am having difficulty with the tribes.
translation: 我在部落方面遇到了困难。 [wo zai bu luo fang mian yu dao le kun nan 。]

english: Talk to them face to face and don't show any fear. Make sure you are rested and well fed, and fight the good fight!
translation: 与他们面对面交谈，不要表现出任何恐惧。确保您休息好、吃饱，并打好这场仗！ [yu ta men mian dui mian jiao tan ， bu yao biao xian chu ren he kong ju 。 que bao nin xiu xi hao 、 chi bao ， bing da hao zhe chang zhang ！]

english: I have everything under control.
translation: 一切都在我的掌控之中。 [yi qie dou zai wo de zhang kong zhi zhong 。]

english: Good, good! I will expect the crystals back shortly then...
translation: 好，好！我预计水晶很快就会回来...... [hao ， hao ！ wo yu ji shui jing hen kuai jiu hui hui lai ......]

english: I have lost something the ogres gave to me.
translation: 我失去了食人魔给我的东西。 [wo shi qu le shi ren mo gei wo de dong xi 。]

english: Oh, deary me! Well, there's nothing I can do about that. You will have to go back to them, I'm afraid.
translation: 哦，亲爱的我！好吧，对此我无能为力。恐怕你必须回到他们身边。 [o ， qin ai de wo ！ hao ba ， dui ci wo wu neng wei li 。 kong pa ni bi xu hui dao ta men shen bian 。]

english: An ogre called Og gave me this...
translation: 一个叫奥格的食人魔给了我这个…… [yi ge jiao ao ge de shi ren mo gei le wo zhe ge ……]

english: Ah, it's part of an old ogre statue. I'll take that off you - it might come in handy if I can fix it up.
translation: 啊，这是一个古老的食人魔雕像的一部分。我会把它从你身上拿下来——如果我能修复它，它可能会派上用场。 [a ， zhe shi yi ge gu lao de shi ren mo diao xiang de yi bu fen 。 wo hui ba ta cong ni shen shang na xia lai —— ru guo wo neng xiu fu ta ， ta ke neng hui pai shang yong chang 。]

english: (Dialogue continues)
translation: （对话继续） [（ dui hua ji xu ）]

english: An ogre called Grew gave me this...
translation: 一个叫格鲁的食人魔给了我这个…… [yi ge jiao ge lu de shi ren mo gei le wo zhe ge ……]

english: Ah, it's more of that old ogre statue. I'll take this bit too.
translation: 啊，更像是那个古老的食人魔雕像。我也拿走这一点吧。 [a ， geng xiang shi na ge gu lao de shi ren mo diao xiang 。 wo ye na zou zhe yi dian ba 。]

english: An ogre called Toban gave me this...
translation: 一个叫托班的食人魔给了我这个…… [yi ge jiao tuo ban de shi ren mo gei le wo zhe ge ……]

english: It looks like you've brought me all the pieces of the relic. It is as I thought - a statue symbolising an ogre warrior of old.
translation: 看起来你已经把圣物的所有碎片都给我带来了。正如我所想的那样——一座象征着古代食人魔战士的雕像。 [kan qi lai ni yi jing ba sheng wu de suo you sui pian dou gei wo dai lai le 。 zheng ru wo suo xiang de na yang —— yi zuo xiang zheng zhe gu dai shi ren mo zhan shi de diao xiang 。]

english: Well, if you ever want to make friends with an ogre, this is the item to have! Now I'll try to assemble it...
translation: 好吧，如果您想与食人魔交朋友，这就是您应该拥有的物品！现在我将尝试组装它...... [hao ba ， ru guo nin xiang yu shi ren mo jiao peng you ， zhe jiu shi nin ying gai yong you de wu pin ！ xian zai wo jiang chang shi zu zhuang ta ......]

english: Ah, the warrior returns. Have you found a way into Gu'Tanoth yet?
translation: 啊，勇士回来了。你找到进入古塔诺斯的方法了吗？ [a ， yong shi hui lai le 。 ni zhao dao jin ru gu ta nuo si de fang fa le ma ？]

english: I can't get past the guards.
translation: 我无法越过守卫。 [wo wu fa yue guo shou wei 。]

english: Well, ogres dislike others apart from their own kind. What you need is some form of proof of friendship, something to trick them into believing you're their friend.
translation: 嗯，食人魔除了自己的同类之外，不喜欢其他人。你需要的是某种形式的友谊证明，可以让他们相信你是他们的朋友。 [n ， shi ren mo chu le zi ji de tong lei zhi wai ， bu xi huan qi ta ren 。 ni xu yao de shi mou zhong xing shi de you yi zheng ming ， ke yi rang ta men xiang xin ni shi ta men de peng you 。]

english: Which shouldn't be too hard, considering their intelligence.
translation: 考虑到他们的智力，这应该不会太难。 [kao lv dao ta men de zhi li ， zhe ying gai bu hui tai nan 。]

english: I have lost the relic you have me.
translation: 我失去了你拥有的遗物。 [wo shi qu le ni yong you de yi wu 。]

english: Have you gone mad? I can see you have it with you!
translation: 你疯了吗？我看得出你带着它！ [ni feng le ma ？ wo kan de chu ni dai zhe ta ！]

english: What? Lost the relic? How careless! It's a good job I copied its design, then! You can take this copy instead - it's just as good.
translation: 什么？遗物丢了？多么粗心啊！那我抄袭它的设计真是太好了！您可以拿这份副本来代替——它也一样好。 [shen me ？ yi wu diu le ？ duo me cu xin a ！ na wo chao xi ta de she ji zhen shi tai hao le ！ nin ke yi na zhe fen fu ben lai dai ti —— ta ye yi yang hao 。]

english: The wizard gives you another statue.
translation: 巫师给了你另一尊雕像。 [wu shi gei le ni ling yi zun diao xiang 。]

english: I will find my way in, no problem.
translation: 我会找到办法进去的，没问题。 [wo hui zhao dao ban fa jin qu de ， mei wen ti 。]

english: Yes, I'm sure you will... Good luck!
translation: 是的，我相信你会...祝你好运！ [shi de ， wo xiang xin ni hui ... zhu ni hao yun ！]

english: I have found the cave of ogre shaman, but I cannot touch them!
translation: 我找到了食人魔萨满的洞穴，但我不能碰它们！ [wo zhao dao le shi ren mo sa man de dong xue ， dan wo bu neng peng ta men ！]

english: That is because of their magical powers. We must fight them with their own methods; do not speak to them! I suggest a potion...
translation: 那是因为他们的神奇力量。我们必须用他们的方法来对抗他们；不要和他们说话！我建议你喝一剂药... [na shi yin wei ta men de shen qi li liang 。 wo men bi xu yong ta men de fang fa lai dui kang ta men ； bu yao he ta men shuo hua ！ wo jian yi ni he yi ji yao ...]

english: Collect a guam leaf, add jangerberries, then mix in some ground bat bones. You must return it to me before you use it, so that I can empower it with my magic.
translation: 收集一片关岛叶，加入姜莓，然后加入一些磨碎的蝙蝠骨头。你必须在使用它之前把它还给我，这样我才能用我的魔法赋予它力量。 [shou ji yi pian guan dao ye ， jia ru jiang mei ， ran hou jia ru yi xie mo sui de bian fu gu tou 。 ni bi xu zai shi yong ta zhi qian ba ta huan gei wo ， zhe yang wo cai neng yong wo de mo fa fu yu ta li liang 。]

english: Be very careful how you mix it as it is extremely volatile. Mixing ingredients of this type in the wrong order can cause explosions!
translation: 混合时要非常小心，因为它非常不稳定。以错误的顺序混合此类成分可能会导致爆炸！ [hun he shi yao fei chang xiao xin ， yin wei ta fei chang bu wen ding 。 yi cuo wu de shun xu hun he ci lei cheng fen ke neng hui dao zhi bao zha ！]

english: I hope you've been brushing up Herblore and Magic? I must warn you, only experienced magicians can use the potion. It is too dangerous in the hands of the unskilled.
translation: 我希望你已经温习了 Herblore 和 Magic 了？我必须警告你，只有经验丰富的魔法师才能使用这种药剂。在不熟练的人手里太危险了。 [wo xi wang ni yi jing wen xi le  Herblore  he  Magic  le ？ wo bi xu jing gao ni ， zhi you jing yan feng fu de mo fa shi cai neng shi yong zhe zhong yao ji 。 zai bu shu lian de ren shou li tai wei xian le 。]

english: Any more news?
translation: 还有更多消息吗？ [hai you geng duo xiao xi ma ？]

english: Can you tell me again what I need for the potion?
translation: 你能再告诉我一次我需要什么药水吗？ [ni neng zai gao su wo yi ci wo xu yao shen me yao shui ma ？]

english: Yes indeed, let me see, what was it again...
translation: 是的，确实如此，让我看看，又是什么...... [shi de ， que shi ru ci ， rang wo kan kan ， you shi shen me ......]

english: You will need a guam leaf. That goes into the mix first.
translation: 你需要一片关岛叶。首先要进行混合。 [ni xu yao yi pian guan dao ye 。 shou xian yao jin xing hun he 。]

english: What is the next ingredient?
translation: 下一个成分是什么？ [xia yi ge cheng fen shi shen me ？]

english: You need some jangerberries.
translation: 你需要一些越橘。 [ni xu yao yi xie yue ju 。]

english: I have some of those.
translation: 我有一些。 [wo you yi xie 。]

english: Wonderful!
translation: 精彩的！ [jing cai de ！]

english: You will need to add those after the guam leaf has gone in, but before the final ingredient.
translation: 您需要在关岛叶放入后、最终成分之前添加它们。 [nin xu yao zai guan dao ye fang ru hou 、 zui zhong cheng fen zhi qian tian jia ta men 。]

english: What is the final ingredient?
translation: 最终成分是什么？ [zui zhong cheng fen shi shen me ？]

english: The final ingredient is ground bat bones.
translation: 最后的成分是磨碎的蝙蝠骨头。 [zui hou de cheng fen shi mo sui de bian fu gu tou 。]

english: Are these ground up well enough?
translation: 这些基础足够好吗？ [zhe xie ji chu zu gou hao ma ？]

english: Yes, those will do nicely.
translation: 是的，那些会做得很好。 [shi de ， na xie hui zuo de hen hao 。]

english: When you have mixed the potion correctly, then I can empower the potion with magic and the ogre shamans can be destroyed.
translation: 当你正确地混合药水后，我就可以用魔法赋予药水力量，食人魔萨满就可以被消灭。 [dang ni zheng que di hun he yao shui hou ， wo jiu ke yi yong mo fa fu yu yao shui li liang ， shi ren mo sa man jiu ke yi bei xiao mie 。]

english: No, I'm still working on it.
translation: 不，我还在努力。 [bu ， wo hai zai nu li 。]

english: I have made the potion.
translation: 我已经配制了药水。 [wo yi jing pei zhi le yao shui 。]

english: That's great news; let me infuse it with magic...
translation: 这是个好消息；让我给它注入魔法…… [zhe shi ge hao xiao xi ； rang wo gei ta zhu ru mo fa ……]

english: Here it is - a dangerous substance. I must remind you that this potion can only be used if your Magic level is high enough.
translation: 这就是——一种危险物质。我必须提醒你，这个药剂只有在你的魔法等级足够高的情况下才能使用。 [zhe jiu shi —— yi zhong wei xian wu zhi 。 wo bi xu ti xing ni ， zhe ge yao ji zhi you zai ni de mo fa deng ji zu gou gao de qing kuang xia cai neng shi yong 。]

english: How high is high enough?
translation: 多高才算足够高？ [duo gao cai suan zu gou gao ？]

english: Well, if you can cast Bones to Bananas, or any spells beyond that, you should be alright.
translation: 好吧，如果你能对香蕉施放骨头，或者任何其他咒语，你应该没问题。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni neng dui xiang jiao shi fang gu tou ， huo zhe ren he qi ta zhou yu ， ni ying gai mei wen ti 。]

english: Hello again. Did the potion work?
translation: 又好。药水有效果吗？ [you hao 。 yao shui you xiao guo ma ？]

english: I am still working to rid us of the shamans...
translation: 我仍在努力摆脱萨满... [wo reng zai nu li bai tuo sa man ...]

english: May you have success in your task.
translation: 祝你任务成功。 [zhu ni ren wu cheng gong 。]

english: You'll have to get that magic potion back from wherever you've stored it, I think.
translation: 我想你必须从你存放的地方取回那瓶魔法药水。 [wo xiang ni bi xu cong ni cun fang de di fang qu hui na ping mo fa yao shui 。]

english: I have another potion - will you infuse it with magic?
translation: 我还有另一种药剂——你能给它注入魔法吗？ [wo hai you ling yi zhong yao ji —— ni neng gei ta zhu ru mo fa ma ？]

english: Alright, but I'd prefer it if you didn't keep asking me for this.
translation: 好吧，但如果你不一直问我这个，我会更喜欢。 [hao ba ， dan ru guo ni bu yi zhi wen wo zhe ge ， wo hui geng xi huan 。]

english: Dialogue continues as the first time the potion was enchanted
translation: 对话继续进行，第一次魔药被附魔 [dui hua ji xu jin xing ， di yi ci mo yao bei fu mo]

english: Indeed it did! I wiped out those ogre shamans!
translation: 确实如此！我消灭了那些食人魔萨满！ [que shi ru ci ！ wo xiao mie le na xie shi ren mo sa man ！]

english: Magnificent! At last you've brought all the crystals!
translation: 壮丽！你终于把所有的水晶都带来了！ [zhuang li ！ ni zhong yu ba suo you de shui jing dou dai lai le ！]

english: Now the shield generator can be activated and, once again, Yanille will be safe from the threat of the ogres.
translation: 现在护盾发生器可以被激活，雅妮尔将再次免受食人魔的威胁。 [xian zai hu dun fa sheng qi ke yi bei ji huo ， ya ni er jiang zai ci mian shou shi ren mo de wei xie 。]

english: Put the crystals on the pillars there and throw the lever to activate the system.
translation: 将水晶放在那里的柱子上，然后投掷杠杆来激活系统。 [jiang shui jing fang zai na li de zhu zi shang ， ran hou tou zhi gang gan lai ji huo xi tong 。]

english: The system is not activated yet. Throw the switch to start it.
translation: 系统尚未激活。按下开关即可启动它。 [xi tong shang wei ji huo 。 an xia kai guan ji ke qi dong ta 。]

english: Marvellous! It works! The town will now be safe. Take these coins as a token of my gratitude. Also, let me improve your Magic level.
translation: 奇妙！有用！现在该镇将安全了。收下这些硬币作为我的谢意吧。另外，让我提高你的魔法等级。 [qi miao ！ you yong ！ xian zai gai zhen jiang an quan le 。 shou xia zhe xie ying bi zuo wei wo de xie yi ba 。 ling wai ， rang wo ti gao ni de mo fa deng ji 。]

english: I've given you a special scroll too - it's a new spell. Read the scroll and you will be able to teleport yourself here.
translation: 我还给了你一个特殊的卷轴——这是一个新咒语。阅读卷轴，你就能将自己传送到这里。 [wo huan gei le ni yi ge te shu de juan zhou —— zhe shi yi ge xin zhou yu 。 yue du juan zhou ， ni jiu neng jiang zi ji chuan song dao zhe li 。]

english: Wizard, look what I have found.
translation: 巫师，看看我发现了什么。 [wu shi ， kan kan wo fa xian le shen me 。]

english: Well done, well done! You are clever; hold onto it until you have all four.
translation: 干得好，干得好！你很聪明；坚持下去，直到你拥有全部四个。 [gan de hao ， gan de hao ！ ni hen cong ming ； jian chi xia qu ， zhi dao ni yong you quan bu si ge 。]

english: Keep searching for the others. If you've dropped any, then you will need to go back to where you got it from.
translation: 继续寻找其他人。如果您丢失了任何东西，那么您将需要返回到获取它的地方。 [ji xu xun zhao qi ta ren 。 ru guo nin diu shi le ren he dong xi ， na me nin jiang xu yao fan hui dao huo qu ta de di fang 。]

english: Greetings, friend. I trust all is well with you? Yanille is safe at last!
translation: 你好，朋友。我相信你一切都好？雅妮尔终于安全了！ [ni hao ， peng you 。 wo xiang xin ni yi qie dou hao ？ ya ni er zhong yu an quan le ！]

english: I lost the scroll you gave me.
translation: 我把你给我的卷轴弄丢了。 [wo ba ni gei wo de juan zhou nong diu le 。]

english: I lost the scroll you gave me.
translation: 我把你给我的卷轴弄丢了。 [wo ba ni gei wo de juan zhou nong diu le 。]

english: Ho, ho, ho! A comedian to the finish! There it is, in your backpack!
translation: 嗬，嗬，嗬！喜剧演员到最后！它就在那里，在你的背包里！ [he ， he ， he ！ xi ju yan yuan dao zui hou ！ ta jiu zai na li ， zai ni de bei bao li ！]

english: Never mind, have another...
translation: 没关系，再来一个... [mei guan xi ， zai lai yi ge ...]

english: That's okay.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: We are always in your debt; do come and visit us again.
translation: 我们永远欠您的情；请再次来拜访我们。 [wo men yong yuan qian nin de qing ； qing zai ci lai bai fang wo men 。]

english: Do you have any more quests for me?
translation: 你还有什么任务要找我吗？ [ni hai you shen me ren wu yao zhao wo ma ？]

english: More quests? No, indeed, adventurer. You have done us a great service, already.
translation: 更多任务？不，确实是，冒险家。你已经为我们提供了很好的服务。 [geng duo ren wu ？ bu ， que shi shi ， mao xian jia 。 ni yi jing wei wo men ti gong le hen hao de fu wu 。]

english: What's the matter?
translation: 怎么了？ [zen me le ？]

english: So how come the spell doesn't work?
translation: 那么为什么咒语不起作用呢？ [na me wei shen me zhou yu bu qi zuo yong ne ？]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: I'm not interested in your rantings.
translation: 我对你的胡言乱语不感兴趣。 [wo dui ni de hu yan luan yu bu gan xing qu 。]

english: You wizards are always complaining.
translation: 你们这些巫师总是在抱怨。 [ni men zhe xie wu shi zong shi zai bao yuan 。]

english: What do you suggest I do?
translation: 你建议我做什么？ [ni jian yi wo zuo shen me ？]

english: Shall I search the caves?
translation: 我要搜索洞穴吗？ [wo yao sou suo dong xue ma ？]

english: So what do I do?
translation: 那我该怎么办？ [na wo gai zen me ban ？]

english: I won't bother then.
translation: 那我就不打扰了 [na wo jiu bu da rao le]

english: I am having difficulty with the tribes.
translation: 我在部落方面遇到了困难。 [wo zai bu luo fang mian yu dao le kun nan 。]

english: I have everything under control.
translation: 一切都在我的掌控之中。 [yi qie dou zai wo de zhang kong zhi zhong 。]

english: I have lost something the ogres gave to me.
translation: 我失去了食人魔给我的东西。 [wo shi qu le shi ren mo gei wo de dong xi 。]

english: I have lost the relic you have me.
translation: 我失去了你拥有的遗物。 [wo shi qu le ni yong you de yi wu 。]

english: I will find my way in, no problem.
translation: 我会找到办法进去的，没问题。 [wo hui zhao dao ban fa jin qu de ， mei wen ti 。]

english: Can you tell me again what I need for the potion?
translation: 你能再告诉我一次我需要什么药水吗？ [ni neng zai gao su wo yi ci wo xu yao shen me yao shui ma ？]

english: No, I'm still working on it.
translation: 不，我还在努力。 [bu ， wo hai zai nu li 。]

english: That's okay.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: Do you have any more quests for me?
translation: 你还有什么任务要找我吗？ [ni hai you shen me ren wu yao zhao wo ma ？]

english: Gratias tibi ago!
translation: 谢谢你！ [xie xie ni ！]

english: Hello there [player name].
translation: 你好[玩家姓名]。 [ni hao [ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I am Watson, the master of clue scrolls. I have lived a long life here in Kourend. The lands are beautiful here.
translation: 我是华生，线索卷轴大师。我在库伦德度过了漫长的一生。这里的土地很美丽。 [wo shi hua sheng ， xian suo juan zhou da shi 。 wo zai ku lun de du guo le man chang de yi sheng 。 zhe li de tu di hen mei li 。]

english: You're the master are you?
translation: 你就是主人吧？ [ni jiu shi zhu ren ba ？]

english: Ha! It is not so much due to my ego, but the fact that I give out master tier clue scrolls.
translation: 哈!这并不是因为我的自负，而是因为我给出了大师级线索卷轴。 [ha ! zhe bing bu shi yin wei wo de zi fu ， er shi yin wei wo gei chu le da shi ji xian suo juan zhou 。]

english: Interesting. Do you get many treasure hunters here in Kourend?
translation: 有趣的。库伦德有很多寻宝者吗？ [you qu de 。 ku lun de you hen duo xun bao zhe ma ？]

english: I have seen many, but few are good enough. I only give out my clue scrolls to the very best.
translation: 我见过很多，但很少有足够好的。我只把我的线索卷轴送给最好的。 [wo jian guo hen duo ， dan hen shao you zu gou hao de 。 wo zhi ba wo de xian suo juan zhou song gei zui hao de 。]

english: Ah! I am just the adventurer you are looking for. If you hand me a clue, I'll be on my way.
translation: 啊!我就是你要找的冒险家。如果你给我一个线索，我就会上路。 [a ! wo jiu shi ni yao zhao de mao xian jia 。 ru guo ni gei wo yi ge xian suo ， wo jiu hui shang lu 。]

english: Not so fast [player name]. I require payment. You must bring me a clue scroll of all lower tiers.
translation: 没那么快[玩家姓名]。我需要付款。你必须给我带来所有下层的线索卷轴。 [mei na me kuai [ wan jia xing ming ]。 wo xu yao fu kuan 。 ni bi xu gei wo dai lai suo you xia ceng de xian suo juan zhou 。]

english: I will remember which ones you have given me though. I expect you'll find that useful.
translation: 不过我会记住你给了我哪些。我希望你会发现这很有用。 [bu guo wo hui ji zhu ni gei le wo na xie 。 wo xi wang ni hui fa xian zhe hen you yong 。]

english: Have you heard of Sherlock?
translation: 你听说过夏洛克吗？ [ni ting shuo guo xia luo ke ma ？]

english: Never heard of the bloke. I haven't a clue who he is.
translation: 没听说过这个家伙。我不知道他是谁。 [mei ting shuo guo zhe ge jia huo 。 wo bu zhi dao ta shi shui 。]

english: He also claims to be the master of all clue scrolls.
translation: 他还声称自己是所有线索卷轴的主人。 [ta hai sheng cheng zi ji shi suo you xian suo juan zhou de zhu ren 。]

english: As I said, I've never heard of him. If he was such a big deal, I would have heard of him...
translation: 正如我所说，我从未听说过他。如果他有这么大的名气，我早就听说过他了…… [zheng ru wo suo shuo ， wo cong wei ting shuo guo ta 。 ru guo ta you zhe me da de ming qi ， wo zao jiu ting shuo guo ta le ……]

english: Something tells me you're lying! I bet you're just his underling aren't you.
translation: 有件事告诉我你在撒谎！我打赌你只是他的下属不是吗？ [you jian shi gao su wo ni zai sa huang ！ wo da du ni zhi shi ta de xia shu bu shi ma ？]

english: So what are master clue scrolls anyway?
translation: 那么主线索卷轴到底是什么？ [na me zhu xian suo juan zhou dao di shi shen me ？]

english: Master clue scrolls are the most challenging of all clue scrolls. They will test you in ways you have not been tested before.
translation: 主线索卷轴是所有线索卷轴中最具挑战性的。他们将以你以前从未测试过的方式测试你。 [zhu xian suo juan zhou shi suo you xian suo juan zhou zhong zui ju tiao zhan xing de 。 ta men jiang yi ni yi qian cong wei ce shi guo de fang shi ce shi ni 。]

english: You will be led all over Gielinor with your strengths, your weaknesses, your mental strength and your reactions all scrutinised.
translation: 你将被引导到吉林诺各地，你的优点、你的缺点、你的精神力量和你的反应都会被仔细审查。 [ni jiang bei yin dao dao ji lin nuo ge di ， ni de you dian 、 ni de que dian 、 ni de jing shen li liang he ni de fan ying du hui bei zi xi shen cha 。]

english: I assume there is treasure to be found?
translation: 我猜一定能找到宝藏吧？ [wo cai yi ding neng zhao dao bao zang ba ？]

english: That is for you to find out, [player name].
translation: 这有待你去发现，[玩家姓名]。 [zhe you dai ni qu fa xian ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: You need to bring me clue scroll you haven't already given me [player name].
translation: 你需要给我带来你还没有给我的线索卷轴[玩家姓名]。 [ni xu yao gei wo dai lai ni hai mei you gei wo de xian suo juan zhou [ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Thank you very much.
translation: 非常感谢。 [fei chang gan xie 。]

english: I have a master clue scroll for you, but you already have one to complete! Finish it or discard it, I don't care which.
translation: 我有一份主线索卷轴给你，但你已经有一个需要完成了！完成它或丢弃它，我不在乎。 [wo you yi fen zhu xian suo juan zhou gei ni ， dan ni yi jing you yi ge xu yao wan cheng le ！ wan cheng ta huo diu qi ta ， wo bu zai hu 。]

english: Nice work [player name], I've had one of each lower tier clue scroll from you.
translation: 干得好[玩家名字]，我已经从你那里得到了每一个较低层的线索卷轴。 [gan de hao [ wan jia ming zi ]， wo yi jing cong ni na li de dao le mei yi ge jiao di ceng de xian suo juan zhou 。]

english: What is that noticeboard for?
translation: 那个布告栏是做什么用的？ [na ge bu gao lan shi zuo shen me yong de ？]

english: It lets you view any of your S.T.A.S.H units that you have built around Gielinor.
translation: 它可以让你查看你围绕 Gielinor 建造的任何 S.T.A.S.H 单位。 [ta ke yi rang ni cha kan ni wei rao  Gielinor  jian zao de ren he  S.T.A.S.H  dan wei 。]

english: Oh that seems really useful! It's a bit of a shame I need to come here everytime to check though.
translation: 哦，这看起来真的很有用！有点遗憾的是我每次都需要来这里检查。 [o ， zhe kan qi lai zhen de hen you yong ！ you dian yi han de shi wo mei ci dou xu yao lai zhe li jian cha 。]

english: Well it's just a board with some notes on it. I'm sure you could figure something out.
translation: 嗯，它只是一块板上，上面有一些笔记。我相信你能想出办法。 [n ， ta zhi shi yi kuai ban shang ， shang mian you yi xie bi ji 。 wo xiang xin ni neng xiang chu ban fa 。]

english: I suppose you're right, I don't suppose you have a spare one I could buy off you to save me the hassle?
translation: 我想你是对的，我不认为你有一个备用的我可以从你那里买来省去麻烦？ [wo xiang ni shi dui de ， wo bu ren wei ni you yi ge bei yong de wo ke yi cong ni na li mai lai sheng qu ma fan ？]

english: No, but I could write down the instructions to make one. Then all you'd need is a house with a study to build it in, and a bolt of cloth.
translation: 不，但我可以写下制作说明。那么你所需要的只是一栋带书房的房子和一块布。 [bu ， dan wo ke yi xie xia zhi zuo shuo ming 。 na me ni suo xu yao de zhi shi yi dong dai shu fang de fang zi he yi kuai bu 。]

english: I'm not giving it away for free, 500 coins is just covering my expenses!
translation: 我可不是白送的，500金币刚好够我的花销！ [wo ke bu shi bai song de ，500 jin bi gang hao gou wo de hua xiao ！]

english: You don't have enough space for it.
translation: 你没有足够的空间来容纳它。 [ni mei you zu gou de kong jian lai rong na ta 。]

english: Here you go.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: Alright, feel free to carry on using mine.
translation: 好吧，请继续使用我的。 [hao ba ， qing ji xu shi yong wo de 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: You said you didn't know Sherlock!
translation: 你说你不认识夏洛克！ [ni shuo ni bu ren shi xia luo ke ！]

english: Sure is windy today, did you hear that?
translation: 今天确实有风，你听到了吗？ [jin tian que shi you feng ， ni ting dao le ma ？]

english: Sorry [player name]. That scroll is for you, not me.
translation: 抱歉[玩家姓名]。那卷轴是给你的，不是给我的。 [bao qian [ wan jia xing ming ]。 na juan zhou shi gei ni de ， bu shi gei wo de 。]

english: Do you want to trade that in? You'd need another copy to take your scrolls out again. But I'll swap it for some teleport scrolls if you like, so you can travel here more easily.
translation: 你想用它来交易吗？你需要另一份副本才能再次取出卷轴。不过如果你愿意的话我会把它换成一些传送卷轴，这样你就可以更轻松地旅行到这里。 [ni xiang yong ta lai jiao yi ma ？ ni xu yao ling yi fen fu ben cai neng zai ci qu chu juan zhou 。 bu guo ru guo ni yuan yi de hua wo hui ba ta huan cheng yi xie chuan song juan zhou ， zhe yang ni jiu ke yi geng qing song di lv xing dao zhe li 。]

english: Watson exchanges your book for [amount] scrolls.
translation: 沃森用你的书换取[数量]卷轴。 [wo sen yong ni de shu huan qu [ shu liang ] juan zhou 。]

english: Come again if you change your mind.
translation: 如果你改变主意就再来吧。 [ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi jiu zai lai ba 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Have you heard of Sherlock?
translation: 你听说过夏洛克吗？ [ni ting shuo guo xia luo ke ma ？]

english: So what are master clue scrolls anyway?
translation: 那么主线索卷轴到底是什么？ [na me zhu xian suo juan zhou dao di shi shen me ？]

english: I have something for you.
translation: 我有东西给你。 [wo you dong xi gei ni 。]

english: Hand over easy clue.
translation: 交出简单的线索。 [jiao chu jian dan de xian suo 。]

english: Hand over medium clue.
translation: 交出中等线索。 [jiao chu zhong deng xian suo 。]

english: Hand over hard clue.
translation: 交出硬线索。 [jiao chu ying xian suo 。]

english: Hand over elite clue.
translation: 交出精英线索。 [jiao chu jing ying xian suo 。]

english: Hand over all clues.
translation: 交出所有线索。 [jiao chu suo you xian suo 。]

english: What is that noticeboard for?
translation: 那个布告栏是做什么用的？ [na ge bu gao lan shi zuo shen me yong de ？]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Cancel.
translation: 取消。 [qu xiao 。]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Exchange the book for teleport scrolls
translation: 将书换成传送卷轴 [jiang shu huan cheng chuan song juan zhou]

english: Don't exchange the book
translation: 不换书 [bu huan shu]

english: Shall we return to Crash Island?
translation: 我们要回崩溃岛吗？ [wo men yao hui beng kui dao ma ？]

english: Yes, let's go.
translation: 是的，我们走吧。 [shi de ， wo men zou ba 。]

english: As you wish.
translation: 如你所愿。 [ru ni suo yuan 。]

english: Not yet. I'll be back later.
translation: 还没有。我稍后会回来。 [hai mei you 。 wo shao hou hui hui lai 。]

english: Yes
translation: 是的 [shi de]

english: No
translation: 不 [bu]

english: Hi Waymottin, what are you up to?
translation: 嗨，韦莫丁，你在忙什么？ [hai ， wei mo ding ， ni zai mang shen me ？]

english: Someone has to keep an eye on Bunkwicket!
translation: 必须有人留意邦克威克特！ [bi xu you ren liu yi bang ke wei ke te ！]

english: Well, try to enjoy yourself.
translation: 好吧，试着享受一下吧。 [hao ba ， shi zhe xiang shou yi xia ba 。]

english: Ha, no chance!
translation: 哈，没机会了！ [ha ， mei ji hui le ！]

english: Welcome to Wayne's Chains. Do you wanna buy or sell some chain mail?
translation: 欢迎来到韦恩的连锁店。您想购买或出售一些连锁邮件吗？ [huan ying lai dao wei en de lian suo dian 。 nin xiang gou mai huo chu shou yi xie lian suo you jian ma ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Very well done, take this.
translation: 做得很好，收下这个。 [zuo de hen hao ， shou xia zhe ge 。]

english: You've been given another clue!
translation: 你已经得到了另一条线索！ [ni yi jing de dao le ling yi tiao xian suo ！]

english: You've obtained a casket!
translation: 你已经获得了一个棺材！ [ni yi jing huo de le yi ge guan cai ！]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Hello. How are you liking the city?
translation: 你好。你喜欢这个城市吗？ [ni hao 。 ni xi huan zhe ge cheng shi ma ？]

english: It's truly spectacular.
translation: 真是太壮观了。 [zhen shi tai zhuang guan le 。]

english: I'd recommend the Colosseum. Me and a few associates always wager bets on the contenders.
translation: 我推荐罗马斗兽场。我和一些同事总是对竞争者下注。 [wo tui jian luo ma dou shou chang 。 wo he yi xie tong shi zong shi dui jing zheng zhe xia zhu 。]

english: As you can tell, I'm doing quite well winning! Plenty of coin to pass around.
translation: 正如你所见，我赢得很好！大量的硬币可以传递。 [zheng ru ni suo jian ， wo ying de hen hao ！ da liang de ying bi ke yi chuan di 。]

english: Got any spare for me?
translation: 有空余的给我吗？ [you kong yu de gei wo ma ？]

english: No! We don't care for begging in the city!
translation: 不！我们不喜欢在城里乞讨！ [bu ！ wo men bu xi huan zai cheng li qi tao ！]

english: How am I supposed to get past this?
translation: 我该如何度过这个难关呢？ [wo gai ru he du guo zhe ge nan guan ne ？]

english: Gah!
translation: 嘎！ [ga ！]

english: Did that owl statue just move?
translation: 刚才那只猫头鹰雕像动了吗？ [gang cai na zhi mao tou ying diao xiang dong le ma ？]

english: I can't wait until I get full graceful, then I can head back to the rooftop courses.

english: Forget it - I'll do it myself.
translation: 算了——我自己来吧。 [suan le —— wo zi ji lai ba 。]

english: Hello, what's a little boy like you doing down here?
translation: 你好，像你这样的小男孩在这里做什么？ [ni hao ， xiang ni zhe yang de xiao nan hai zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I ain't no little boy. Me dad, Steve, said I was big enough to take care of these 'ere wyverns, as the pal- palint-palintililiolog- those blokes from the museum are too scared of them.
translation: 我不是小男孩。我爸爸史蒂夫说我足够大了，可以照顾这些双足飞龙，因为博物馆里的那些家伙太害怕它们了。 [wo bu shi xiao nan hai 。 wo ba ba shi di fu shuo wo zu gou da le ， ke yi zhao gu zhe xie shuang zu fei long ， yin wei bo wu guan li de na xie jia huo tai hai pa ta men le 。]

english: Yeah, whatever. I know how to look after myself, my entire family are slayer guardians or something like that.
translation: 是的，无论如何。我知道如何照顾自己，我的整个家庭都是杀手守护者之类的。 [shi de ， wu lun ru he 。 wo zhi dao ru he zhao gu zi ji ， wo de zheng ge jia ting dou shi sha shou shou hu zhe zhi lei de 。]

english: To guard the wyverns of course.
translation: 当然是为了守护飞龙。 [dang ran shi wei le shou hu fei long 。]

english: Guard them? From what?
translation: 守护他们？从什么？ [shou hu ta men ？ cong shen me ？]

english: From people like you who just want to kill 'em.
translation: 来自像你这样只想杀死他们的人。 [lai zi xiang ni zhe yang zhi xiang sha si ta men de ren 。]

english: But... that's what they're for?
translation: 但是……这就是他们的目的吗？ [dan shi …… zhe jiu shi ta men de mu di ma ？]

english: They have lives too. They were created for a purpose. But whatever, you can only kill these ones if the Slayer Masters say you can.
translation: 他们也有生活。它们是为了某种目的而创建的。但无论如何，只有在杀戮大师允许的情况下，你才能杀死这些人。 [ta men ye you sheng huo 。 ta men shi wei le mou zhong mu di er chuang jian de 。 dan wu lun ru he ， zhi you zai sha lu da shi yun xu de qing kuang xia ， ni cai neng sha si zhe xie ren 。]

english: I'm Weve, son of Steve.
translation: 我是韦夫，史蒂夫的儿子。 [wo shi wei fu ， shi di fu de er zi 。]

english: That's... an interesting name.
translation: 这是……一个有趣的名字。 [zhe shi …… yi ge you qu de ming zi 。]

english: Well, it's kinda a family tradition you might say. Plus I'm good at looking after wyverns and fast enough to weave between their legs and not get hurt.
translation: 嗯，你可能会说这是一种家庭传统。另外，我擅长照顾双足飞龙，而且速度足够快，可以在它们的腿之间穿梭而不会受伤。 [n ， ni ke neng hui shuo zhe shi yi zhong jia ting chuan tong 。 ling wai ， wo shan chang zhao gu shuang zu fei long ， er qie su du zu gou kuai ， ke yi zai ta men de tui zhi jian chuan suo er bu hui shou shang 。]

english: Ok, bye.
translation: 好的，再见。 [hao de ， zai jian 。]

english: Hey! Leave them alone! My dad Steve will beat you up unless a Slayer Master has given you special permission.
translation: 嘿！别管他们了！我爸爸史蒂夫会打你，除非有杀手大师给你特别许可。 [hei ！ bie guan ta men le ！ wo ba ba shi di fu hui da ni ， chu fei you sha shou da shi gei ni te bie xu ke 。]

english: Calm down, I was just worried.
translation: 冷静点，我只是担心。 [leng jing dian ， wo zhi shi dan xin 。]

english: Why are you here?
translation: 你为什么在这里？ [ni wei shen me zai zhe li ？]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Ok, bye.
translation: 好的，再见。 [hao de ， zai jian 。]

english: Hi there, nice to see you! Care for a mug of beer?
translation: 你好，很高兴见到你！想要一杯啤酒吗？ [ni hao ， hen gao xing jian dao ni ！ xiang yao yi bei pi jiu ma ？]

english: I'm a bit busy at the moment, maybe later.
translation: 我现在有点忙，也许以后会吧。 [wo xian zai you dian mang ， ye xu yi hou hui ba 。]

english: Well alright then.
translation: 那么好吧。 [na me hao ba 。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Can I interest you in a drink?
translation: 我可以给你喝一杯吗？ [wo ke yi gei ni he yi bei ma ？]

english: Not right now, thank you. I was wondering if you might be able to help me with something else.
translation: 现在不行，谢谢。我想知道你是否能帮我做点别的事。 [xian zai bu xing ， xie xie 。 wo xiang zhi dao ni shi fou neng bang wo zuo dian bie de shi 。]

english: And what would that be?
translation: 那会是什么？ [na hui shi shen me ？]

english: Do you know the Easter Bunny?
translation: 你认识复活节兔子吗？ [ni ren shi fu huo jie tu zi ma ？]

english: I do! He's just over there. Lovely guy.
translation: 我愿意！他就在那里。可爱的家伙。 [wo yuan yi ！ ta jiu zai na li 。 ke ai de jia huo 。]

english: Does he seem unhappy to you?
translation: 他对你来说似乎不高兴吗？ [ta dui ni lai shuo si hu bu gao xing ma ？]

english: Now that you mention it, yes he does.
translation: 既然你提到了，是的，他确实这么做了。 [ji ran ni ti dao le ， shi de ， ta que shi zhe me zuo le 。]

english: He was always so cheery, bouncing around like a fuzzy avatar of joy.
translation: 他总是那么高兴，活蹦乱跳，就像一个毛茸茸的快乐化身。 [ta zong shi na me gao xing ， huo beng luan tiao ， jiu xiang yi ge mao rong rong de kuai le hua shen 。]

english: He's been in a sorry state lately though.
translation: 不过最近他的状态却很糟糕。 [bu guo zui jin ta de zhuang tai que hen zao gao 。]

english: Indeed, I've never seen him like this.
translation: 确实，我从来没有见过他这样。 [que shi ， wo cong lai mei you jian guo ta zhe yang 。]

english: Have you noticed anything odd?
translation: 你注意到什么奇怪的事情了吗？ [ni zhu yi dao shen me qi guai de shi qing le ma ？]

english: Hmm... He used to drink pint after pint of carrot juice! Barely sips the stuff now though, just stares into the glass.
translation: 嗯...他过去常常喝一品脱一品脱胡萝卜汁！不过现在几乎不喝东西了，只是盯着玻璃杯。 [n ... ta guo qu chang chang he yi pin tuo yi pin tuo hu luo bo zhi ！ bu guo xian zai ji hu bu he dong xi le ， zhi shi ding zhe bo li bei 。]

english: He used to LOVE it.
translation: 他曾经很喜欢它。 [ta ceng jing hen xi huan ta 。]

english: Interesting, could I try the carrot juice please?
translation: 有趣的是，我可以尝尝胡萝卜汁吗？ [you qu de shi ， wo ke yi chang chang hu luo bo zhi ma ？]

english: Absolutely! One C.J. coming right up!
translation: 绝对地！一位 C.J. 马上就来了！ [jue dui di ！ yi wei  C.J.  ma shang jiu lai le ！]

english: Euargh! That's...
translation: 呃！那是... [e ！ na shi ...]

english: Good right? I make it myself.
translation: 很好吧？我自己做的。 [hen hao ba ？ wo zi ji zuo de 。]

english: It's definitely an experience, how do you make it?
translation: 这绝对是一种体验，你是如何做到的？ [zhe jue dui shi yi zhong ti yan ， ni shi ru he zuo dao de ？]

english: I put some carrots into a juice press, then add some good old-fashioned elbow grease.
translation: 我将一些胡萝卜放入榨汁机中，然后添加一些老式的肘部油脂。 [wo jiang yi xie hu luo bo fang ru zha zhi ji zhong ， ran hou tian jia yi xie lao shi de zhou bu you zhi 。]

english: That would explain the flavour.
translation: 这样就可以解释味道了。 [zhe yang jiu ke yi jie shi wei dao le 。]

english: Do you have any particularly nice carrots we could use to make some special juice just for the Easter Bunny?
translation: 你有什么特别好的胡萝卜可以用来为复活节兔子制作一些特殊的果汁吗？ [ni you shen me te bie hao de hu luo bo ke yi yong lai wei fu huo jie tu zi zhi zuo yi xie te shu de guo zhi ma ？]

english: I think he would perhaps appreciate something different.
translation: 我想他也许会欣赏一些不同的东西。 [wo xiang ta ye xu hui xin shang yi xie bu tong de dong xi 。]

english: You can ask Weasel in the kitchen, he chooses which carrots get used for juice.
translation: 你可以问厨房里的黄鼠狼，他会选择哪些胡萝卜用来榨汁。 [ni ke yi wen chu fang li de huang shu lang ， ta hui xuan ze na xie hu luo bo yong lai zha zhi 。]

english: Be warned though, he's not much of a people person.
translation: 但请注意，他不是一个善于交际的人。 [dan qing zhu yi ， ta bu shi yi ge shan yu jiao ji de ren 。]

english: What do you mean by that?
translation: 你这是什么意思？ [ni zhe shi shen me yi si ？]

english: Oh you'll soon find out! Don't worry though, just tell him I sent you and that you're trying to help the Easter Bunny.
translation: 哦，你很快就会发现！不过别担心，只要告诉他是我派你来的，你正在努力帮助复活节兔子。 [o ， ni hen kuai jiu hui fa xian ！ bu guo bie dan xin ， zhi yao gao su ta shi wo pai ni lai de ， ni zheng zai nu li bang zhu fu huo jie tu zi 。]

english: He'll give you some fantastic carrots.
translation: 他会给你一些很棒的胡萝卜。 [ta hui gei ni yi xie hen bang de hu luo bo 。]

english: Once you have them, you can use the juice press to extract their goodness!
translation: 一旦你拥有它们，你就可以使用榨汁机来榨取它们的精华！ [yi dan ni yong you ta men ， ni jiu ke yi shi yong zha zhi ji lai zha qu ta men de jing hua ！]

english: Alright, I'll be back soon!
translation: 好的，我很快就回来！ [hao de ， wo hen kuai jiu hui lai ！]

english: Have you been to see Weasel in the kitchen about those nice carrots yet?
translation: 你去过厨房里看到黄鼠狼谈论那些美味的胡萝卜吗？ [ni qu guo chu fang li kan dao huang shu lang tan lun na xie mei wei de hu luo bo ma ？]

english: Not yet.
translation: 还没有。 [hai mei you 。]

english: Well there's no need to be scared of him! Fetch some carrots and I'll let you use my juice press.
translation: 嗯，没必要害怕他！去拿一些胡萝卜来，我就让你用我的榨汁机。 [n ， mei bi yao hai pa ta ！ qu na yi xie hu luo bo lai ， wo jiu rang ni yong wo de zha zhi ji 。]

english: I'm not scared, I just haven't gotten round to it yet.
translation: 我并不害怕，我只是还没有回过神来。 [wo bing bu hai pa ， wo zhi shi hai mei you hui guo shen lai 。]

english: Whatever you say.
translation: 不管你说什么。 [bu guan ni shuo shen me 。]

english: I need more carrots..
translation: 我需要更多的胡萝卜.. [wo xu yao geng duo de hu luo bo ..]

english: Why? What happened?
translation: 为什么？发生了什么？ [wei shen me ？ fa sheng le shen me ？]

english: Let's call it a quality control incident.
translation: 我们称之为质量控制事件。 [wo men cheng zhi wei zhi liang kong zhi shi jian 。]

english: You drank the juice didn't you?
translation: 你喝了果汁不是吗？ [ni he le guo zhi bu shi ma ？]

english: Perhaps.
translation: 也许。 [ye xu 。]

english: Right well you best go see Weasel again, but he won't be happy.
translation: 好吧，你最好再去找黄鼠狼，但他不会高兴的。 [hao ba ， ni zui hao zai qu zhao huang shu lang ， dan ta bu hui gao xing de 。]

english: Is he ever happy?
translation: 他曾经幸福过吗？ [ta ceng jing xing fu guo ma ？]

english: Hah! Good point! Best hurry along now!
translation: 哈！好点！现在最好快点！ [ha ！ hao dian ！ xian zai zui hao kuai dian ！]

english: Bye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Ooh look at those carrots, fantastic! This juice is sure to be a treat.
translation: 哦，看看那些胡萝卜，太棒了！这果汁肯定是一种享受。 [o ， kan kan na xie hu luo bo ， tai bang le ！ zhe guo zhi ken ding shi yi zhong xiang shou 。]

english: Let's hope so.
translation: 我们希望如此。 [wo men xi wang ru ci 。]

english: You'll need a special glass for the juice, come back when you have space for one.
translation: 您需要一个特殊的玻璃杯来盛果汁，当您有空间时再回来。 [nin xu yao yi ge te shu de bo li bei lai sheng guo zhi ， dang nin you kong jian shi zai hui lai 。]

english: Here's a carrot juice glass, make sure you use this!
translation: 这是胡萝卜汁杯，一定要使用它！ [zhe shi hu luo bo zhi bei ， yi ding yao shi yong ta ！]

english: Isn't this just a beer glass?
translation: 这不就是一个啤酒杯吗？ [zhe bu jiu shi yi ge pi jiu bei ma ？]

english: Ha! Just a beer glass! You're a real joker!
translation: 哈!只是一个啤酒杯！你真是个爱开玩笑的人！ [ha ! zhi shi yi ge pi jiu bei ！ ni zhen shi ge ai kai wan xiao de ren ！]

english: It's VERY important that you use the correct glassware.
translation: 使用正确的玻璃器皿非常重要。 [shi yong zheng que de bo li qi min fei chang zhong yao 。]

english: Alright, I will. Goodness me.
translation: 好吧，我会的。天哪我。 [hao ba ， wo hui de 。 tian na wo 。]

english: The juice press is in the storage room behind the bar. Have fun, and don't make too much mess!
translation: 榨汁机位于吧台后面的储藏室里。玩得开心，别搞得太乱！ [zha zhi ji wei yu ba tai hou mian de chu cang shi li 。 wan de kai xin ， bie gao de tai luan ！]

english: Will do, thanks!
translation: 会做，谢谢！ [hui zuo ， xie xie ！]

english: How's the juicing going?
translation: 榨汁怎么样了？ [zha zhi zen me yang le ？]

english: Erm, I lost the glass.
translation: 呃，我把玻璃杯弄丢了。 [e ， wo ba bo li bei nong diu le 。]

english: Lost or broke? I'm not stupid. Those glasses are expensive you know!
translation: 丢失或损坏？我并不傻。你知道那副眼镜很贵吗！ [diu shi huo sun huai ？ wo bing bu sha 。 ni zhi dao na fu yan jing hen gui ma ！]

english: Sorry, can I have another glass please?
translation: 抱歉，可以再给我一杯吗？ [bao qian ， ke yi zai gei wo yi bei ma ？]

english: Make some room for a new one and you can, yes.
translation: 为新的腾出一些空间，你可以，是的。 [wei xin de teng chu yi xie kong jian ， ni ke yi ， shi de 。]

english: Yes you can, but take care of it this time!
translation: 是的，你可以，但是这次要小心！ [shi de ， ni ke yi ， dan shi zhe ci yao xiao xin ！]

english: Thanks, and I will.
translation: 谢谢，我会的。 [xie xie ， wo hui de 。]

english: I'm about to get juicing!
translation: 我要去榨汁了！ [wo yao qu zha zhi le ！]

english: Well hurry up, we don't want to keep the Easter Bunny waiting!
translation: 好吧，快点吧，我们不想让复活节兔子久等了！ [hao ba ， kuai dian ba ， wo men bu xiang rang fu huo jie tu zi jiu deng le ！]

english: Remember, the juice press is in the storage area behind the bar.
translation: 请记住，榨汁机位于吧台后面的存储区。 [qing ji zhu ， zha zhi ji wei yu ba tai hou mian de cun chu qu 。]

english: I remember!
translation: 我记得！ [wo ji de ！]

english: Then why are you still here?
translation: 那你为什么还在这里？ [na ni wei shen me hai zai zhe li ？]

english: Good question, I'll go and make some juice.
translation: 好问题，我去榨点果汁。 [hao wen ti ， wo qu zha dian guo zhi 。]

english: Ohhhh! Look at that juice! Such colour. It smells divine too.
translation: 哦哦哦！看看那果汁！这样的颜色。它也闻起来很神圣。 [o o o ！ kan kan na guo zhi ！ zhe yang de yan se 。 ta ye wen qi lai hen shen sheng 。]

english: Oh it's good stuff, I should know.
translation: 哦，这是好东西，我应该知道。 [o ， zhe shi hao dong xi ， wo ying gai zhi dao 。]

english: Well let's see what the Easter Bunny thinks.
translation: 好吧，让我们看看复活节兔子是怎么想的。 [hao ba ， rang wo men kan kan fu huo jie tu zi shi zen me xiang de 。]

english: I'll go and give it to him now, bye!
translation: 我现在就去给他，拜拜！ [wo xian zai jiu qu gei ta ， bai bai ！]

english: Hello again!
translation: 又好！ [you hao ！]

english: Hi [player name].
translation: 你好[玩家姓名]。 [ni hao [ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: I think that fancy carrot juice has cheered the Easter Bunny up a bit, he really seemed to like it!
translation: 我认为精美的胡萝卜汁让复活节兔子高兴了一点，他似乎真的很喜欢它！ [wo ren wei jing mei de hu luo bo zhi rang fu huo jie tu zi gao xing le yi dian ， ta si hu zhen de hen xi huan ta ！]

english: That's great!
translation: 那太棒了！ [na tai bang le ！]

english: Thanks for the help.
translation: 感谢您的帮助。 [gan xie nin de bang zhu 。]

english: Any time.
translation: 任何时间。 [ren he shi jian 。]

english: I'm making some Easter Buns for the Easter Bunny, and I need some Easter Spices.
translation: 我正在为复活节兔子做一些复活节面包，我需要一些复活节香料。 [wo zheng zai wei fu huo jie tu zi zuo yi xie fu huo jie mian bao ， wo xu yao yi xie fu huo jie xiang liao 。]

english: Do you have any I could use?
translation: 你有我可以用的吗？ [ni you wo ke yi yong de ma ？]

english: Oh yes of course, we keep plenty behind the bar for cocktails.
translation: 哦，是的，当然，我们在吧台后面备有充足的鸡尾酒。 [o ， shi de ， dang ran ， wo men zai ba tai hou mian bei you chong zu de ji wei jiu 。]

english: Of course I can't give you the spices unless you can carry them. Come back when you have space!
translation: 当然，除非你能携带，否则我不能给你香料。有空就回来吧！ [dang ran ， chu fei ni neng xie dai ， fou ze wo bu neng gei ni xiang liao 。 you kong jiu hui lai ba ！]

english: There you go, I hope they work well!
translation: 就这样吧，希望他们工作顺利！ [jiu zhe yang ba ， xi wang ta men gong zuo shun li ！]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: I bet those spices will bring those buns to life!
translation: 我打赌这些香料会让这些面包焕发活力！ [wo da du zhe xie xiang liao hui rang zhe xie mian bao huan fa huo li ！]

english: Judging by the smell, I'd say so. Powerful stuff.
translation: 从气味来看，我会这么说。强大的东西。 [cong qi wei lai kan ， wo hui zhe me shuo 。 qiang da de dong xi 。]

english: Thanks for both juice and spices, EB really liked the buns!
translation: 感谢果汁和香料，EB 真的很喜欢这些面包！ [gan xie guo zhi he xiang liao ，EB  zhen de hen xi huan zhe xie mian bao ！]

english: Talk about carrot juice.
translation: 谈论胡萝卜汁。 [tan lun hu luo bo zhi 。]

english: Talk about Easter Buns.
translation: 谈论复活节面包。 [tan lun fu huo jie mian bao 。]

english: Hi!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Hi!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: So, what you up to out here?
translation: 那么，你来这里干什么？ [na me ， ni lai zhe li gan shen me ？]

english: Oh...er...nothing!
translation: 哦……呃……没什么！ [o …… e …… mei shen me ！]

english: Hello there, are you interested in buying one of my special capes?
translation: 您好，您有兴趣购买我的一件特别斗篷吗？ [nin hao ， nin you xing qu gou mai wo de yi jian te bie dou peng ma ？]

english: What's so special about your capes?
translation: 你的斗篷有什么特别之处？ [ni de dou peng you shen me te bie zhi chu ？]

english: Ahh well they make it less likely that you'll accidently attack anyone wearing the same cape as you and easier to attack everyone else. They also make it easier to distinguish people who're wearing the same cape as you
translation: 啊，好吧，它们使你不太可能意外攻击任何穿着与你相同斗篷的人，并且更容易攻击其他人。它们还可以让您更轻松地区分与您穿着相同斗篷的人 [a ， hao ba ， ta men shi ni bu tai ke neng yi wai gong ji ren he chuan zhe yu ni xiang tong dou peng de ren ， bing qie geng rong yi gong ji qi ta ren 。 ta men hai ke yi rang nin geng qing song di qu fen yu nin chuan zhe xiang tong dou peng de ren]

english: from everyone else. They're very useful when out in the wilderness with friends or anyone else you don't want to harm.
translation: 来自其他人。当您与朋友或您不想伤害的其他人一起在荒野中时，它们非常有用。 [lai zi qi ta ren 。 dang nin yu peng you huo nin bu xiang shang hai de qi ta ren yi qi zai huang ye zhong shi ， ta men fei chang you yong 。]

english: So would you like to buy one?
translation: 那么您想买一个吗？ [na me nin xiang mai yi ge ma ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: What's so special about your capes?
translation: 你的斗篷有什么特别之处？ [ni de dou peng you shen me te bie zhi chu ？]

english: Yes please!
translation: 是的，请！ [shi de ， qing ！]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello there. What are you doing all the way out here?
translation: 你好呀。你千里迢迢跑到这里来做什么？ [ni hao ya 。 ni qian li tiao tiao pao dao zhe li lai zuo shen me ？]

english: Nothing you need to worry about.
translation: 没什么你需要担心的。 [mei shen me ni xu yao dan xin de 。]

english: So this is where you scampered off to after the monster awoke?
translation: 这就是你在怪物醒来后跑到的地方吗？ [zhe jiu shi ni zai guai wu xing lai hou pao dao de di fang ma ？]

english: Look [player name], it was a simple misunderstanding, that's all...
translation: 你看[玩家名字]，这只是一个简单的误会，仅此而已…… [ni kan [ wan jia ming zi ]， zhe zhi shi yi ge jian dan de wu hui ， jin ci er yi ……]

english: Oh really? You threatening to kill me was just a misunderstanding?
translation: 哦真的吗？你威胁要杀我只是一场误会？ [o zhen de ma ？ ni wei xie yao sha wo zhi shi yi chang wu hui ？]

english: Things got a little heated down there, but we all made it out alive, right?
translation: 那里的情况有点激烈，但我们都活着出来了，对吧？ [na li de qing kuang you dian ji lie ， dan wo men dou huo zhe chu lai le ， dui ba ？]

english: Barely... I had to defeat that monster on my own!
translation: 勉强……我必须靠自己的力量打倒那个怪物！ [mian qiang …… wo bi xu kao zi ji de li liang da dao na ge guai wu ！]

english: What are you doing out here, anyway?
translation: 你到底在这儿做什么？ [ni dao di zai zhe er zuo shen me ？]

english: We thought you'd rat us out to the authorities, so we came out here to hide.
translation: 我们以为你会把我们告发给当局，所以我们才来这里躲藏。 [wo men yi wei ni hui ba wo men gao fa gei dang ju ， suo yi wo men cai lai zhe li duo cang 。]

english: Plus, we heard there are some sealed tombs in the desert that haven't been touched in hundreds of years...
translation: 另外，我们听说沙漠里有一些密封的坟墓，几百年来都没有被人触及过…… [ling wai ， wo men ting shuo sha mo li you yi xie mi feng de fen mu ， ji bai nian lai dou mei you bei ren chu ji guo ……]

english: Ah, of course... scoping out your next grave to rob.
translation: 啊，当然……寻找下一个要抢劫的坟墓。 [a ， dang ran …… xun zhao xia yi ge yao qiang jie de fen mu 。]

english: Hello youngster!
translation: 年轻人你好！ [nian qing ren ni hao ！]

english: [I/We] don't talk to strange old people.
translation: [我/我们]不和奇怪的老人说话。 [[ wo / wo men ] bu he qi guai de lao ren shuo hua 。]

english: Hey who you calling old?! And strange?!
translation: 嘿，你说谁老？！而且很奇怪？！ [hei ， ni shuo shui lao ？！ er qie hen qi guai ？！]

english: Hello again.
translation: 又好。 [you hao 。]

english: You think you're tough do you?
translation: 你以为你很坚强是吗？ [ni yi wei ni hen jian qiang shi ma ？]

english: Pardon?
translation: 赦免？ [she mian ？]

english: I can beat anyone up!
translation: 我可以打败任何人！ [wo ke yi da bai ren he ren ！]

english: He can you know!
translation: 他能知道吗！ [ta neng zhi dao ma ！]

english: Really?
translation: 真的吗？ [zhen de ma ？]

english: The boy begins to jump around with his fists up. You decide it's best not to kill him just yet.
translation: 男孩开始举起拳头跳来跳去。你决定最好还是不要杀他。 [nan hai kai shi ju qi quan tou tiao lai tiao qu 。 ni jue ding zui hao hai shi bu yao sha ta 。]

english: Hello there, I've been looking for you.
translation: 你好，我一直在找你。 [ni hao ， wo yi zhi zai zhao ni 。]

english: I didn't mean to take it! I just forgot to pay.
translation: 我不是有意要拿的！我只是忘了付钱。 [wo bu shi you yi yao na de ！ wo zhi shi wang le fu qian 。]

english: What? I'm trying to help your mum find Fluffs.
translation: 什么？我正在努力帮助你妈妈找到绒毛。 [shen me ？ wo zheng zai nu li bang zhu ni ma ma zhao dao rong mao 。]

english: Ohh...well, in that case I might be able to help. Fluffs followed me to my secret play area, I haven't seen her since.
translation: 哦……好吧，这样的话我也许能帮上忙。绒毛跟着我到了我的秘密游乐区，从那以后我就再没有见过她。 [o …… hao ba ， zhe yang de hua wo ye xu neng bang shang mang 。 rong mao gen zhe wo dao le wo de mi mi you le qu ， cong na yi hou wo jiu zai mei you jian guo ta 。]

english: Where is this play area?
translation: 这个游乐区在哪里？ [zhe ge you le qu zai na li ？]

english: If I told you that, it wouldn't be a secret.
translation: 如果我告诉你这件事，那就不是什么秘密了。 [ru guo wo gao su ni zhe jian shi ， na jiu bu shi shen me mi mi le 。]

english: Tell me sonny, or I will hurt you.
translation: 告诉我，儿子，否则我会伤害你。 [gao su wo ， er zi ， fou ze wo hui shang hai ni 。]

english: W..wh..what?! Y..you wouldn't! A young lad like me! I'd have you behind bars before nightfall!
translation: 什..什..什么？！ Y..你不会的！像我这样的年轻小伙子！我会在天黑之前把你关进监狱！ [shen .. shen .. shen me ？！ Y.. ni bu hui de ！ xiang wo zhe yang de nian qing xiao huo zi ！ wo hui zai tian hei zhi qian ba ni guan jin jian yu ！]

english: You decided it's best not to hurt the boy.
translation: 你决定最好不要伤害这个男孩。 [ni jue ding zui hao bu yao shang hai zhe ge nan hai 。]

english: What will make you tell me?
translation: 什么会让你告诉我？ [shen me hui rang ni gao su wo ？]

english: Well...now you ask, I am a bit short on cash.
translation: 嗯……现在你问了，我有点缺现金。 [n …… xian zai ni wen le ， wo you dian que xian jin 。]

english: How much?
translation: 多少？ [duo shao ？]

english: 10 coins.
translation: 10枚硬币。 [10 mei ying bi 。]

english: 10 coins?!
translation: 10金币？！ [10 jin bi ？！]

english: I'll handle this.
translation: 我会处理这件事。 [wo hui chu li zhe jian shi 。]

english: 100 coins should cover it.
translation: 100个金币应该可以覆盖它。 [100 ge jin bi ying gai ke yi fu gai ta 。]

english: 100 coins! Why should I pay you?
translation: 100金币！我为什么要付钱给你？ [100 jin bi ！ wo wei shen me yao fu qian gei ni ？]

english: You shouldn't, but we won't help otherwise. We never liked that cat anyway, so what do you say?
translation: 你不应该这么做，但我们不会提供任何帮助。反正我们从来不喜欢那只猫，那你怎么说呢？ [ni bu ying gai zhe me zuo ， dan wo men bu hui ti gong ren he bang zhu 。 fan zheng wo men cong lai bu xi huan na zhi mao ， na ni zen me shuo ne ？]

english: I'm not paying you a penny.
translation: 我不会付你一分钱。 [wo bu hui fu ni yi fen qian 。]

english: Okay then, I'll find another way to make money.
translation: 好吧，那我就另想办法赚钱吧。 [hao ba ， na wo jiu ling xiang ban fa zhuan qian ba 。]

english: Okay then, I'll pay.
translation: 好吧，那我付钱。 [hao ba ， na wo fu qian 。]

english: You give the lad 100 coins.
translation: 你给了小伙子 100 枚硬币。 [ni gei le xiao huo zi  100  mei ying bi 。]

english: There you go, now where did you see Fluffs ?
translation: 好了，现在你在哪里看到绒毛了？ [hao le ， xian zai ni zai na li kan dao rong mao le ？]

english: I play at an abandoned lumber mill to the north east. Just beyond the Jolly Boar Inn. I saw Fluffs running around in there.
translation: 我在东北部一个废弃的木材厂玩耍。就在快乐野猪旅馆的对面。我看到绒毛在那里跑来跑去。 [wo zai dong bei bu yi ge fei qi de mu cai chang wan shua 。 jiu zai kuai le ye zhu lv guan de dui mian 。 wo kan dao rong mao zai na li pao lai pao qu 。]

english: Anything else?
translation: 还要别的吗？ [hai yao bie de ma ？]

english: Well, you'll have to find the broken fence to get in. I'm sure you can manage that.
translation: 好吧，你必须找到破损的栅栏才能进去。我相信你能做到。 [hao ba ， ni bi xu zhao dao po sun de zha lan cai neng jin qu 。 wo xiang xin ni neng zuo dao 。]

english: Well, never mind, it's Fluffs' loss.
translation: 好吧，没关系，这是弗拉夫斯的损失。 [hao ba ， mei guan xi ， zhe shi fu la fu si de sun shi 。]

english: I'm sure my mum will get over it.
translation: 我相信我妈妈会克服它的。 [wo xiang xin wo ma ma hui ke fu ta de 。]

english: Where did you say you saw Fluffs?
translation: 你说你在哪里看到了绒毛？ [ni shuo ni zai na li kan dao le rong mao ？]

english: Weren't you listening? I saw the flea bag in the old lumber mill just north east of here. Just walk past the Jolly Boar Inn and you should find it.
translation: 你没在听吗？我在东北方的旧木材厂里看到了跳蚤袋。只要走过 Jolly Boar Inn 就可以找到它。 [ni mei zai ting ma ？ wo zai dong bei fang de jiu mu cai chang li kan dao le tiao zao dai 。 zhi yao zou guo  Jolly Boar Inn  jiu ke yi zhao dao ta 。]

english: My brother reckons I can't solve this puzzle. I can't have him laughing at me! Do me a favour and solve it for me.
translation: 我哥哥认为我无法解开这个谜题。我不能让他笑话我！帮我一个忙，帮我解决这个问题。 [wo ge ge ren wei wo wu fa jie kai zhe ge mi ti 。 wo bu neng rang ta xiao hua wo ！ bang wo yi ge mang ， bang wo jie jue zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Sorry but you haven't solved the puzzle yet.
translation: 抱歉，您还没有解决这个难题。 [bao qian ， nin hai mei you jie jue zhe ge nan ti 。]

english: Thanks [mister/miss]!
translation: 谢谢[先生/小姐]！ [xie xie [ xian sheng / xiao jie ]！]

english: Tell me sonny, or I will hurt you.
translation: 告诉我，儿子，否则我会伤害你。 [gao su wo ， er zi ， fou ze wo hui shang hai ni 。]

english: What will make you tell me?
translation: 什么会让你告诉我？ [shen me hui rang ni gao su wo ？]

english: I'm not paying you a penny.
translation: 我不会付你一分钱。 [wo bu hui fu ni yi fen qian 。]

english: Okay then, I'll pay.
translation: 好吧，那我付钱。 [hao ba ， na wo fu qian 。]

english: Well never mind, it's Fluffs' loss.
translation: 好吧，没关系，这是弗洛夫斯的损失。 [hao ba ， mei guan xi ， zhe shi fu luo fu si de sun shi 。]

english: How are you doing?
translation: 你好吗？ [ni hao ma ？]

english: Purr...I'm happy. [player name] is good to me. But don't start neglecting me now that I've told you that.
translation: 咕噜……我很高兴。 [玩家姓名]对我很好。但既然我已经告诉你了，请不要开始忽视我。 [gu lu …… wo hen gao xing 。 [ wan jia xing ming ] dui wo hen hao 。 dan ji ran wo yi jing gao su ni le ， qing bu yao kai shi hu shi wo 。]

english: Don't worry, I won't.
translation: 别担心，我不会的。 [bie dan xin ， wo bu hui de 。]

english: How old are you now?
translation: 你现在几岁了？ [ni xian zai ji sui le ？]

english: I feel as old as the last rat I killed and seeing as it was so tender and juicy, it must have been fairly young.
translation: 我觉得自己和我最后杀死的那只老鼠一样老，而且它又嫩又多汁，它一定还很年轻。 [wo jue de zi ji he wo zui hou sha si de na zhi lao shu yi yang lao ， er qie ta you nen you duo zhi ， ta yi ding hai hen nian qing 。]

english: Where do you want to go?
translation: 你想去哪里？ [ni xiang qu na li ？]

english: Let's go to the sewers of Varrock.
translation: 我们去瓦罗克的下水道吧。 [wo men qu wa luo ke de xia shui dao ba 。]

english: What do you want to do now?
translation: 你现在想做什么？ [ni xian zai xiang zuo shen me ？]

english: I don't know. Master knows me thinks.
translation: 我不知道。师父知道我的想法。 [wo bu zhi dao 。 shi fu zhi dao wo de xiang fa 。]

english: Is there anywhere in particular that you would like to go?
translation: 有什么特别想去的地方吗？ [you shen me te bie xiang qu de di fang ma ？]

english: How are you doing?
translation: 你好吗？ [ni hao ma ？]

english: How old are you now?
translation: 你现在几岁了？ [ni xian zai ji sui le ？]

english: Where do you want to go?
translation: 你想去哪里？ [ni xiang qu na li ？]

english: What do you want to do now?
translation: 你现在想做什么？ [ni xian zai xiang zuo shen me ？]

english: I've got you the limpwurt roots!
translation: 我给你找到了软香肠根！ [wo gei ni zhao dao le ruan xiang chang gen ！]

english: Good! Good! My potion is nearly ready! Bubble, bubble, toil and trouble!
translation: 好的！好的！我的药水快准备好了！泡沫，泡沫，辛劳和麻烦！ [hao de ！ hao de ！ wo de yao shui kuai zhun bei hao le ！ pao mo ， pao mo ， xin lao he ma fan ！]

english: Now we shows them ours magic! Hold on tight!
translation: 现在我们向他们展示我们的魔法！抓紧！ [xian zai wo men xiang ta men zhan shi wo men de mo fa ！ zhua jin ！]

english: A cutscene is shown where the player is teleported across the lava.
translation: 显示玩家被传送穿过熔岩的过场动画。 [xian shi wan jia bei chuan song chuan guo rong yan de guo chang dong hua 。]

english: Hehe! We see you're in a pickle!
translation: 呵呵！我们看到你陷入困境了！ [he he ！ wo men kan dao ni xian ru kun jing le ！]

english: Wants to be getting over the nasty lava do we?
translation: 我们想要克服令人讨厌的熔岩吗？ [wo men xiang yao ke fu ling ren tao yan de rong yan ma ？]

english: Nah, not bothered!
translation: 不，不打扰！ [bu ， bu da rao ！]

english: Hehe! Ye'll come back! They always come back!
translation: 呵呵！你会回来的！他们总会回来的！ [he he ！ ni hui hui lai de ！ ta men zong hui hui lai de ！]

english: Mocking us are we? Clever one aren't we?
translation: 我们是在嘲笑我们吗？我们不是很聪明吗？ [wo men shi zai chao xiao wo men ma ？ wo men bu shi hen cong ming ma ？]

english: I'm knowing some magic trickesses! I could get over easy as that!
translation: 我还知道一些魔术呢！我就这么轻松地过去了！ [wo hai zhi dao yi xie mo shu ne ！ wo jiu zhe me qing song di guo qu le ！]

english: Don't tell them! They always come! They pester poor Winelda!
translation: 别告诉他们！他们总会来的！他们缠着可怜的维内尔达！ [bie gao su ta men ！ ta men zong hui lai de ！ ta men chan zhe ke lian de wei nei er da ！]

english: If you're such a great witch, get me over!
translation: 如果你是这么厉害的女巫，就放过我吧！ [ru guo ni shi zhe me li hai de nv wu ， jiu fang guo wo ba ！]

english: See! They pester Winelda!
translation: 看！他们纠缠维内尔达！ [kan ！ ta men jiu chan wei nei er da ！]

english: I can do something for you!
translation: 我可以为你做点什么！ [wo ke yi wei ni zuo dian shen me ！]

english: Good! Don't pester! Help!
translation: 好的！别纠缠！帮助！ [hao de ！ bie jiu chan ！ bang zhu ！]

english: Get Winelda 20 limpwurt roots for my pot.
translation: 给我的盆里买 Winelda 20 根软香肠根。 [gei wo de pen li mai  Winelda 20  gen ruan xiang chang gen 。]

english: Then we shows them some magic!
translation: 然后我们向他们展示一些魔法！ [ran hou wo men xiang ta men zhan shi yi xie mo fa ！]

english: Yes I do!
translation: 是的，我愿意！ [shi de ， wo yuan yi ！]

english: Have you got roots for poor Winelda?
translation: 你对可怜的维内尔达有感情吗？ [ni dui ke lian de wei nei er da you gan qing ma ？]

english: How many did you need again?
translation: 您又需要多少个？ [nin you xu yao duo shao ge ？]

english: We needs 20 Limpwurt roots for pot.
translation: 我们需要 20 根软香肠根来做盆栽。 [wo men xu yao  20  gen ruan xiang chang gen lai zuo pen zai 。]

english: I've got some limpwurt roots!
translation: 我有一些软香肠根！ [wo you yi xie ruan xiang chang gen ！]

english: We needs 20 rooteses!
translation: 我们需要 20 个 rootese！ [wo men xu yao  20  ge  rootese！]

english: Hi again. Could you do the honours again please?
translation: 又嗨了。可以请你再做一次荣誉吗？ [you hai le 。 ke yi qing ni zai zuo yi ci rong yu ma ？]

english: Certainly! We helps those that helps poor Winelda!
translation: 当然！我们帮助那些帮助可怜的维内尔达的人！ [dang ran ！ wo men bang zhu na xie bang zhu ke lian de wei nei er da de ren ！]

english: Nah, not bothered!
translation: 不，不打扰！ [bu ， bu da rao ！]

english: Yes we do!
translation: 是的，我们愿意！ [shi de ， wo men yuan yi ！]

english: Yes I do!
translation: 是的，我愿意！ [shi de ， wo yuan yi ！]

english: It's a bit hot and dry round here for a gnome isn't it? I thought you gnomes liked your home comforts.
translation: 对于侏儒来说这里有点又热又干不是吗？我以为你们侏儒喜欢家里的舒适感。 [dui yu zhu ru lai shuo zhe li you dian you re you gan bu shi ma ？ wo yi wei ni men zhu ru xi huan jia li de shu shi gan 。]

english: Certainly I miss home cooking, but gnomes are also fundamentally curious people. I'm here exploring the furthest reaches of the world for the King.
translation: 当然，我很怀念家庭烹饪，但侏儒本质上也是好奇的人。我来这里是为了国王探索世界最遥远的地方。 [dang ran ， wo hen huai nian jia ting peng ren ， dan zhu ru ben zhi shang ye shi hao qi de ren 。 wo lai zhe li shi wei le guo wang tan suo shi jie zui yao yuan de di fang 。]

english: Found anything interesting?
translation: 发现什么有趣的事情了吗？ [fa xian shen me you qu de shi qing le ma ？]

english: Sophanem is a curious place, if you can get into the blighted place. There are several pyramids round here as well. Fascinating architecture, I've heard stories that some of them contain treasure tombs and mummies.
translation: 索法奈姆是一个奇怪的地方，如果你能进入这个荒芜的地方的话。这里周围也有几座金字塔。令人着迷的建筑，我听说其中一些包含宝藏墓和木乃伊的故事。 [suo fa nai mu shi yi ge qi guai de di fang ， ru guo ni neng jin ru zhe ge huang wu de di fang de hua 。 zhe li zhou wei ye you ji zuo jin zi ta 。 ling ren zhao mi de jian zhu ， wo ting shuo qi zhong yi xie bao han bao zang mu he mu nai yi de gu shi 。]

english: Cats seem to have considerable importance round here, they certainly seem tied into their religion. The Gods round here seem very alien to me - I've never heard of them before.
translation: 猫在这里似乎具有相当大的重要性，它们似乎与自己的宗教信仰息息相关。这里的众神对我来说似乎很陌生——我以前从未听说过他们。 [mao zai zhe li si hu ju you xiang dang da de zhong yao xing ， ta men si hu yu zi ji de zong jiao xin yang xi xi xiang guan 。 zhe li de zhong shen dui wo lai shuo si hu hen mo sheng —— wo yi qian cong wei ting shuo guo ta men 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: What does this mint cake do?
translation: 这个薄荷蛋糕有什么作用呢？ [zhe ge bo he dan gao you shen me zuo yong ne ？]

english: Gnomish mint cake is a great source of energy for the gnome traveller. It will give you that extra bit of zip when you are running out of steam.
translation: 侏儒薄荷蛋糕是侏儒旅行者的重要能量来源。当你精疲力竭时，它会给你额外的动力。 [zhu ru bo he dan gao shi zhu ru lv xing zhe de zhong yao neng liang lai yuan 。 dang ni jing pi li jie shi ， ta hui gei ni e wai de dong li 。]

english: Ooh, that might come in very handy. Do you have any spare?
translation: 哦，这可能会非常方便。你还有空余的吗？ [o ， zhe ke neng hui fei chang fang bian 。 ni hai you kong yu de ma ？]

english: I need all the mint cake I have, I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕我需要所有的薄荷蛋糕。 [kong pa wo xu yao suo you de bo he dan gao 。]

english: What does this seed pod do?
translation: 这个种子荚有什么作用？ [zhe ge zhong zi jia you shen me zuo yong ？]

english: Ah, the seed pod of the Grand Tree is a fascinating spirit artefact. It is a very useful thing, though one must treat it with respect, since the Grand Tree has a connection with all of its parts, however distant they
translation: 啊，大树的籽荚，真是一件令人着迷的灵器啊。这是一件非常有用的东西，尽管人们必须尊重它，因为大树与其所有部分都有联系，无论它们有多远 [a ， da shu de zi jia ， zhen shi yi jian ling ren zhao mi de ling qi a 。 zhe shi yi jian fei chang you yong de dong xi ， jin guan ren men bi xu zun zhong ta ， yin wei da shu yu qi suo you bu fen dou you lian xi ， wu lun ta men you duo yuan]

english: may be. How do you think the Spirit Trees work?
translation: 或许。你认为灵树如何发挥作用？ [huo xu 。 ni ren wei ling shu ru he fa hui zuo yong ？]

english: If you launch its seeds in a far flung location, you will be helping the tree survive, so the grand tree will help a gnome glider pilot find you, using the seed burst itself (which marks the sky) and a little magic, and bring you
translation: 如果你在一个遥远的地方发射它的种子，你将帮助这棵树生存，所以这棵大树将帮助侏儒滑翔机飞行员找到你，使用种子爆炸本身（标记天空）和一点魔法，并把你带来 [ru guo ni zai yi ge yao yuan de di fang fa she ta de zhong zi ， ni jiang bang zhu zhe ke shu sheng cun ， suo yi zhe ke da shu jiang bang zhu zhu ru hua xiang ji fei xing yuan zhao dao ni ， shi yong zhong zi bao zha ben shen （ biao ji tian kong ） he yi dian mo fa ， bing ba ni dai lai]

english: back home as an act of gratitude. Budding farmers will also find their link with plants to be just a little bit better than before.
translation: 回国以示谢意。初露头角的农民也会发现他们与植物的联系比以前更好了一点。 [hui guo yi shi xie yi 。 chu lu tou jiao de nong min ye hui fa xian ta men yu zhi wu de lian xi bi yi qian geng hao le yi dian 。]

english: However, it takes time for a pilot to find you, and if you are in a real hurry, and I mean a real emergency, you can just squash the seed pod. The Grand Tree doesn't like this, but will pull you back
translation: 然而，飞行员需要时间才能找到你，如果你真的很着急，我的意思是真正的紧急情况，你可以压碎种子荚。大树不喜欢这样，但会把你拉回来 [ran er ， fei xing yuan xu yao shi jian cai neng zhao dao ni ， ru guo ni zhen de hen zhao ji ， wo de yi si shi zhen zheng de jin ji qing kuang ， ni ke yi ya sui zhong zi jia 。 da shu bu xi huan zhe yang ， dan hui ba ni la hui lai]

english: home straight away. Don't do this if you need to do anything with plants straight away, though - your fingers will be considerably less green for a while after using the seed pod this way, and the journey is not
translation: 马上回家。不过，如果您需要立即对植物做任何事情，请不要这样做 - 以这种方式使用种子荚后，您的手指在一段时间内会变得不那么绿，并且旅程不会 [ma shang hui jia 。 bu guo ， ru guo nin xu yao li ji dui zhi wu zuo ren he shi qing ， qing bu yao zhe yang zuo  -  yi zhe zhong fang shi shi yong zhong zi jia hou ， nin de shou zhi zai yi duan shi jian nei hui bian de bu na me lv ， bing qie lv cheng bu hui]

english: very pleasant...
translation: 非常愉快... [fei chang yu kuai ...]

english: Wow, that's very interesting. Thanks.
translation: 哇，这很有趣。谢谢。 [wa ， zhe hen you qu 。 xie xie 。]

english: Here, solve this.
translation: 来，解决这个问题。 [lai ， jie jue zhe ge wen ti 。]

english: Wingstone hands you a [light box/puzzlebox]!
translation: Wingstone送你一个【灯箱/拼图盒】！ [Wingstone song ni yi ge 【 deng xiang / pin tu he 】！]

english: That doesn't look solved to me.
translation: 在我看来这并没有解决。 [zai wo kan lai zhe bing mei you jie jue 。]

english: Well done [player name]. Here you go.
translation: 干得好[玩家姓名]。干得好。 [gan de hao [ wan jia xing ming ]。 gan de hao 。]

english: You've obtained a [new clue/casket]!
translation: 你获得了[新线索/棺材]！ [ni huo de le [ xin xian suo / guan cai ]！]

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food item] to Wingstone.
translation: 你将[一些][订购的侏儒食品]的交付交给了温斯通。 [ni jiang [ yi xie ][ ding gou de zhu ru shi pin ] de jiao fu jiao gei le wen si tong 。]

english: This will hit the spot. Oh yes. Thanks.
translation: 这会击中要害。哦是的。谢谢。 [zhe hui ji zhong yao hai 。 o shi de 。 xie xie 。]

english: Now that I have some proper food, I won't need this any more.
translation: 现在我有了一些合适的食物，我就不再需要这个了。 [xian zai wo you le yi xie he shi de shi wu ， wo jiu bu zai xu yao zhe ge le 。]

english: Here, take these Grand Seed pods. Very useful in emergencies!
translation: 来，拿走这些大种子荚。在紧急情况下非常有用！ [lai ， na zou zhe xie da zhong zi jia 。 zai jin ji qing kuang xia fei chang you yong ！]

english: I was given this odd device, maybe you can do something with it.
translation: 我得到了这个奇怪的设备，也许你可以用它做点什么。 [wo de dao le zhe ge qi guai de she bei ， ye xu ni ke yi yong ta zuo dian shen me 。]

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 你一定是走了很远的路才把这个交给我的。这里有一些额外的东西作为提示。 [ni yi ding shi zou le hen yuan de lu cai ba zhe ge jiao gei wo de 。 zhe li you yi xie e wai de dong xi zuo wei ti shi 。]

english: You are given [a/some] [reward item(s)] as a tip.
translation: 您将获得[一个/一些][奖励物品]作为小费。 [nin jiang huo de [ yi ge / yi xie ][ jiang li wu pin ] zuo wei xiao fei 。]

english: It's a bit hot and dry round here for a gnome isn't it?
translation: 对于侏儒来说这里有点又热又干不是吗？ [dui yu zhu ru lai shuo zhe li you dian you re you gan bu shi ma ？]

english: What does this mint cake do?
translation: 这个薄荷蛋糕有什么作用呢？ [zhe ge bo he dan gao you shen me zuo yong ne ？]

english: What does this seed pod do?
translation: 这个种子荚有什么作用？ [zhe ge zhong zi jia you shen me zuo yong ？]

english: Why are you in that cage?
translation: 你为什么在那个笼子里？ [ni wei shen me zai na ge long zi li ？]

english: That evil witch put me in here! She kidnapped me!
translation: 那个邪恶的女巫把我弄到这里来了！她绑架了我！ [na ge xie e de nv wu ba wo nong dao zhe li lai le ！ ta bang jia le wo ！]

english: That's awful! Why did she do that?
translation: 太糟糕了！她为什么这么做？ [tai zao gao le ！ ta wei shen me zhe me zuo ？]

english: She wanted the secret of my ogleroots, so she did!
translation: 她想要我的眼根的秘密，所以她做到了！ [ta xiang yao wo de yan gen de mi mi ， suo yi ta zuo dao le ！]

english: Your ogleroots? I don't think I understand. What secret is that?
translation: 你的眼根？我想我不明白。那是什么秘密？ [ni de yan gen ？ wo xiang wo bu ming bai 。 na shi shen me mi mi ？]

english: Well now, I have perfected a spell that would grow an ogleroot to an enormous size.
translation: 现在，我已经完善了一个可以让眼根生长到巨大尺寸的咒语。 [xian zai ， wo yi jing wan shan le yi ge ke yi rang yan gen sheng zhang dao ju da chi cun de zhou yu 。]

english: That's amazing! But how do you move the ogleroot around if it's so big?
translation: 太棒了！但如果它这么大，你如何移动它呢？ [tai bang le ！ dan ru guo ta zhe me da ， ni ru he yi dong ta ne ？]

english: You know, I had the very same problem so I came up with a simple solution. I used a spell I learned from a chap called Larry to shrink 'em down really small so that I could carry whole bags filled with 'em to the market place. Then when I got there, I would use the growing spell once more to make 'em huge and sell 'em for a tidy sum.
translation: 你知道，我遇到了同样的问题，所以我想出了一个简单的解决方案。我用了从一个叫拉里的小伙子那里学到的咒语，把它们缩小得很小，这样我就可以把装满它们的整袋东西带到市场上。然后当我到达那里时，我会再次使用生长咒语将它们变得巨大并以可观的价格出售它们。 [ni zhi dao ， wo yu dao le tong yang de wen ti ， suo yi wo xiang chu le yi ge jian dan de jie jue fang an 。 wo yong le cong yi ge jiao la li de xiao huo zi na li xue dao de zhou yu ， ba ta men suo xiao de hen xiao ， zhe yang wo jiu ke yi ba zhuang man ta men de zheng dai dong xi dai dao shi chang shang 。 ran hou dang wo dao da na li shi ， wo hui zai ci shi yong sheng zhang zhou yu jiang ta men bian de ju da bing yi ke guan de jia ge chu shou ta men 。]

english: That's amazing! So how does the witch fit in to all this?
translation: 太棒了！那么女巫是如何适应这一切的呢？ [tai bang le ！ na me nv wu shi ru he shi ying zhe yi qie de ne ？]

english: Well that old witch - she's a sly one, I tell you. She found out about my spell and kidnapped me along with my bag of ogleroots. She wants the secret of the spell but I ain't talking! No sir! So she's been feeding my mini-ogleroots to those ugly...things over there.
translation: 好吧，那个老巫婆——我告诉你，她是个狡猾的人。她发现了我的咒语并绑架了我和我的一袋眼根草。她想要咒语的秘密，但我不说话！不，先生！所以她一直在把我的迷你眼根喂给那边那些丑陋的……东西。 [hao ba ， na ge lao wu po —— wo gao su ni ， ta shi ge jiao hua de ren 。 ta fa xian le wo de zhou yu bing bang jia le wo he wo de yi dai yan gen cao 。 ta xiang yao zhou yu de mi mi ， dan wo bu shuo hua ！ bu ， xian sheng ！ suo yi ta yi zhi zai ba wo de mi ni yan gen wei gei na bian na xie chou lou de …… dong xi 。]

english: So she hasn't found out the spell yet?
translation: 那么她还没有发现这个咒语吗？ [na me ta hai mei you fa xian zhe ge zhou yu ma ？]

english: Not yet, no. And I still ain't telling her. But from what I gather, she's started to use them ogleroots in some of her potions for something. I don't know what, though.
translation: 还没有，没有。而我仍然没有告诉她。但据我所知，她已经开始在她的一些魔药中使用它们来达到某种目的。但我不知道是什么。 [hai mei you ， mei you 。 er wo reng ran mei you gao su ta 。 dan ju wo suo zhi ， ta yi jing kai shi zai ta de yi xie mo yao zhong shi yong ta men lai da dao mou zhong mu di 。 dan wo bu zhi dao shi shen me 。]

english: I see. Can I get you out of there somehow?
translation: 我懂了。我能以某种方式带你离开那里吗？ [wo dong le 。 wo neng yi mou zhong fang shi dai ni li kai na li ma ？]

english: No, it's ok. I want to keep an eye on what the witch is up to down here with these odd creatures.
