translation: 不，没关系。我想密切关注女巫在这里对这些奇怪的生物做了什么。 [bu ， mei guan xi 。 wo xiang mi qie guan zhu nv wu zai zhe li dui zhe xie qi guai de sheng wu zuo le shen me 。]

english: So, will you be alright?
translation: 那么，你会好吗？ [na me ， ni hui hao ma ？]

english: Yes, I'll be fine for now. Good luck with your tasks!
translation: 是的，我现在会没事的。祝你任务顺利！ [shi de ， wo xian zai hui mei shi de 。 zhu ni ren wu shun li ！]

english: This could be worse I guess. Oh wait... No it can't.
translation: 我想这可能会更糟。哦等等...不，不能。 [wo xiang zhe ke neng hui geng zao 。 o deng deng ... bu ， bu neng 。]

english: I'm hungry...
translation: 我饿了... [wo e le ...]

english: Sometimes I wish this thing would just escape. At least we'd have something to do then.
translation: 有时我希望这件事能逃脱。至少那时我们还有事可做。 [you shi wo xi wang zhe jian shi neng tao tuo 。 zhi shao na shi wo men hai you shi ke zuo 。]

english: It's so cold...
translation: 天气好冷啊... [tian qi hao leng a ...]

english: Greetings, [player name].
translation: 你好，[玩家姓名]。 [ni hao ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: So you're a wise old man, huh?
translation: 所以你是个聪明的老人，是吗？ [suo yi ni shi ge cong ming de lao ren ， shi ma ？]

english: Less of the 'old' man, if you please!
translation: 如果你愿意的话，少一点“老”男人吧！ [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， shao yi dian “ lao ” nan ren ba ！]

english: But yes, I suppose you could say that. I prefer to think of myself as a sage.
translation: 但是，是的，我想你可以这么说。我更愿意将自己视为圣人。 [dan shi ， shi de ， wo xiang ni ke yi zhe me shuo 。 wo geng yuan yi jiang zi ji shi wei sheng ren 。]

english: So what's a sage doing here?
translation: 那么圣人在这里做什么呢？ [na me sheng ren zai zhe li zuo shen me ne ？]

english: I've spent most of my life studying this world in which we live. I've strode through the depths of the deadliest dungeons, roamed the murky jungles of Karamja, meditated on the glories of Saradomin on Entrana,
translation: 我一生的大部分时间都在研究我们生活的这个世界。我大步穿过最致命的地牢深处，漫步在卡拉姆贾的阴暗丛林中，沉思着恩特拉纳上萨拉多明的荣耀， [wo yi sheng de da bu fen shi jian dou zai yan jiu wo men sheng huo de zhe ge shi jie 。 wo da bu chuan guo zui zhi ming de di lao shen chu ， man bu zai ka la mu jia de yin an cong lin zhong ， chen si zhe en te la na shang sa la duo ming de rong yao ，]

english: and read some dusty tomes in the Library of Varrock.
translation: 并在瓦罗克图书馆阅读了一些落满灰尘的书籍。 [bing zai wa luo ke tu shu guan yue du le yi xie luo man hui chen de shu ji 。]

english: Now I'm not as young as I used to be, I'm settling here where it's peaceful.
translation: 现在我不再像以前那么年轻了，我定居在这里，这里很安静。 [xian zai wo bu zai xiang yi qian na me nian qing le ， wo ding ju zai zhe li ， zhe li hen an jing 。]

english: It's a pity about that vampyre that keeps attacking the village. At least Saradomin protects me.
translation: 可惜那个吸血鬼不断袭击村庄。至少萨拉多明保护了我。 [ke xi na ge xi xue gui bu duan xi ji cun zhuang 。 zhi shao sa la duo ming bao hu le wo 。]

english: That's quite an exciting life you've had.
translation: 你的生活真是令人兴奋。 [ni de sheng huo zhen shi ling ren xing fen 。]

english: Exciting? Yes, I suppose so.
translation: 令人兴奋吗？是的，我想是的。 [ling ren xing fen ma ？ shi de ， wo xiang shi de 。]

english: Now I'm here, perhaps I could offer you the benefit of my experience and wisdom?
translation: 现在我在这里，也许我可以为您提供我的经验和智慧的好处？ [xian zai wo zai zhe li ， ye xu wo ke yi wei nin ti gong wo de jing yan he zhi hui de hao chu ？]

english: Thanks! So you can help me?
translation: 谢谢！那么你可以帮助我吗？ [xie xie ！ na me ni ke yi bang zhu wo ma ？]

english: Well, I imagine you've gathered up quite a lot of stuff on your travels. Things you used for quests a long time ago that you don't need now.
translation: 嗯，我想你在旅行中收集了很多东西。很久以前用于任务但现在不再需要的东西。 [n ， wo xiang ni zai lv xing zhong shou ji le hen duo dong xi 。 hen jiu yi qian yong yu ren wu dan xian zai bu zai xu yao de dong xi 。]

english: If you like, I can look through your bank and see if there's anything you can chuck away.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，我可以查一下你的银行，看看有没有什么东西可以扔掉。 [ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， wo ke yi cha yi xia ni de yin hang ， kan kan you mei you shen me dong xi ke yi reng diao 。]

english: Alternatively, you can bring items here and show them to me. If I see that it's something you don't need, I'll let you know. I might even be willing to buy it.
translation: 或者，您可以将物品带到这里并向我展示。如果我发现您不需要它，我会通知您。我什至可能愿意买它。 [huo zhe ， nin ke yi jiang wu pin dai dao zhe li bing xiang wo zhan shi 。 ru guo wo fa xian nin bu xu yao ta ， wo hui tong zhi nin 。 wo shen zhi ke neng yuan yi mai ta 。]

english: So you'll help me clear junk out of my bank?
translation: 那么你会帮我清理银行里的垃圾吗？ [na me ni hui bang wo qing li yin hang li de la ji ma ？]

english: Yes, that's right. Or I'd be happy to chat with you about the wonders of this world!
translation: 是的，没错。或者我很乐意与您谈论这个世界的奇迹！ [shi de ， mei cuo 。 huo zhe wo hen le yi yu nin tan lun zhe ge shi jie de qi ji ！]

english: Could I have some free stuff, please?
translation: 请问可以给我一些免费的东西吗？ [qing wen ke yi gei wo yi xie mian fei de dong xi ma ？]

english: Deary deary me...
translation: 亲爱的亲爱的我... [qin ai de qin ai de wo ...]

english: I'm not giving out free money, but if you try again later I'd be glad to reward you if you'd do a little job for me.
translation: 我不会白白给你钱，但如果你稍后再尝试，如果你能为我做一点工作，我会很高兴奖励你。 [wo bu hui bai bai gei ni qian ， dan ru guo ni shao hou zai chang shi ， ru guo ni neng wei wo zuo yi dian gong zuo ， wo hui hen gao xing jiang li ni 。]

english: I'm not giving out free money, but I'd be happy to reward you if you'll do a little job for me.
translation: 我不会白白给你钱，但如果你能为我做一点工作，我很乐意奖励你。 [wo bu hui bai bai gei ni qian ， dan ru guo ni neng wei wo zuo yi dian gong zuo ， wo hen le yi jiang li ni 。]

english: Ok, what do you want me to do?
translation: 好吧，你想让我做什么？ [hao ba ， ni xiang rang wo zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm sure I can think of a few little jobs. This won't be a quest, mind you, just a little favour...
translation: 我确信我能想到一些小工作。请注意，这不是一个任务，只是一个小小的恩惠...... [wo que xin wo neng xiang dao yi xie xiao gong zuo 。 qing zhu yi ， zhe bu shi yi ge ren wu ， zhi shi yi ge xiao xiao de en hui ......]

english: Thanks, maybe some other time.
translation: 谢谢，也许改天吧。 [xie xie ， ye xu gai tian ba 。]

english: I'd just like to ask you something.
translation: 我只是想问你一件事。 [wo zhi shi xiang wen ni yi jian shi 。]

english: Please do!
translation: 请这样做！ [qing zhe yang zuo ！]

english: Is there anything I can do for you?
translation: 有什么我可以为您做的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi wei nin zuo de ma ？]

english: Could you check my items for junk, please?
translation: 请您检查一下我的物品是否是垃圾？ [qing nin jian cha yi xia wo de wu pin shi fou shi la ji ？]

english: Can I get another hood for my Quest Point Cape?
translation: 我可以为我的 Quest Point 斗篷再买一个兜帽吗？ [wo ke yi wei wo de  Quest Point  dou peng zai mai yi ge dou mao ma ？]

english: You don't appear to have enough space in your inventory. Come back and see me when you do.
translation: 您的库存似乎没有足够的空间。当你回来的时候再来见我吧。 [nin de ku cun si hu mei you zu gou de kong jian 。 dang ni hui lai de shi hou zai lai jian wo ba 。]

english: Can I buy a Quest Point Cape, please?
translation: 请问我可以购买 Quest Point 斗篷吗？ [qing wen wo ke yi gou mai  Quest Point  dou peng ma ？]

english: Gladly, though they cost 99,000 coins.
translation: 很高兴，尽管它们花了 99,000 个硬币。 [hen gao xing ， jin guan ta men hua le  99,000  ge ying bi 。]

english: Okay, 99,000 coins is fine.
translation: 好吧，99000金币就可以了。 [hao ba ，99000 jin bi jiu ke yi le 。]

english: All skillcapes come with a hood - you're not going to be able to hold them now. Try again another time.
translation: 所有技能斗篷都带有兜帽——你现在无法握住它们。下次再试一次。 [suo you ji neng dou peng dou dai you dou mao —— ni xian zai wu fa wo zhu ta men 。 xia ci zai shi yi ci 。]

english: I'll have to come back another time.
translation: 我得再回来一次。 [wo de zai hui lai yi ci 。]

english: Actually, no thanks.
translation: 事实上，不用谢。 [shi shi shang ， bu yong xie 。]

english: Is there anything I can do for you?
translation: 有什么我可以为您做的吗？ [you shen me wo ke yi wei nin zuo de ma ？]

english: Thanks, but I don't have anything I need doing right now.
translation: 谢谢，但我现在没有什么需要做的。 [xie xie ， dan wo xian zai mei you shen me xu yao zuo de 。]

english: Could you tell me about the Wilderness, please?
translation: 请你告诉我关于荒野的事情好吗？ [qing ni gao su wo guan yu huang ye de shi qing hao ma ？]

english: If Entrana is a land dedicated to the glory of Saradomin, the Wilderness is surely the land of Zamorak.
translation: 如果恩特拉纳是献给萨拉多明荣耀的土地，那么荒野无疑就是萨莫拉克的土地。 [ru guo en te la na shi xian gei sa la duo ming rong yao de tu di ， na me huang ye wu yi jiu shi sa mo la ke de tu di 。]

english: It's a dangerous place, where adventurers such as yourself may attack each other, using all their combat skills in the struggle for survival.
translation: 这是一个危险的地方，像你这样的冒险者可能会互相攻击，在生存斗争中使用他们所有的战斗技能。 [zhe shi yi ge wei xian de di fang ， xiang ni zhe yang de mao xian zhe ke neng hui hu xiang gong ji ， zai sheng cun dou zheng zhong shi yong ta men suo you de zhan dou ji neng 。]

english: The Wilderness has different levels. In a low level area, you can only fight adventurers whose combat level is close to yours.
translation: 荒野有不同的级别。在低等级区域，你只能与战斗等级与你接近的冒险者战斗。 [huang ye you bu tong de ji bie 。 zai di deng ji qu yu ， ni zhi neng yu zhan dou deng ji yu ni jie jin de mao xian zhe zhan dou 。]

english: But if you venture into the high level areas in the far north, you can be attacked by adventurers who are significantly stronger than you.
translation: 但如果你冒险进入极北的高级区域，你可能会受到比你强大得多的冒险者的攻击。 [dan ru guo ni mao xian jin ru ji bei de gao ji qu yu ， ni ke neng hui shou dao bi ni qiang da de duo de mao xian zhe de gong ji 。]

english: Of course, you'd be able to attack considerably weaker people too, so it can be worth the risk.
translation: 当然，你也可以攻击相当弱的人，所以值得冒险。 [dang ran ， ni ye ke yi gong ji xiang dang ruo de ren ， suo yi zhi de mao xian 。]

english: If you dare to go to the far north-west of the Wilderness, there's a building called the Mage Arena where you can learn to summon the power of Saradomin himself!
translation: 如果你敢去荒野最西北部，那里有一座叫做法师竞技场的建筑，你可以在那里学习召唤萨拉多明本人的力量！ [ru guo ni gan qu huang ye zui xi bei bu ， na li you yi zuo jiao zuo fa shi jing ji chang de jian zhu ， ni ke yi zai na li xue xi zhao huan sa la duo ming ben ren de li liang ！]

english: Is there anything else you'd like to ask?
translation: 您还有什么想问的吗？ [nin hai you shen me xiang wen de ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: As you wish. Farewell, [player name].
translation: 如你所愿。再见，[玩家姓名]。 [ru ni suo yuan 。 zai jian ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: What can you tell me about jungles?
translation: 关于丛林，你能告诉我什么吗？ [guan yu cong lin ， ni neng gao su wo shen me ma ？]

english: If it's jungle you want, look no further than the southern regions of Karamja.
translation: 如果您想要丛林，卡拉姆贾南部地区就是您的最佳选择。 [ru guo nin xiang yao cong lin ， ka la mu jia nan bu di qu jiu shi nin de zui jia xuan ze 。]

english: Once you get south of Brimhaven, the whole island is pretty much covered in exotic trees, creepers and shrubs.
translation: 一旦到达布里姆港以南，整个岛屿几乎都被异国情调的树木、爬山虎和灌木覆盖。 [yi dan dao da bu li mu gang yi nan ， zheng ge dao yu ji hu dou bei yi guo qing diao de shu mu 、 pa shan hu he guan mu fu gai 。]

english: There's a small settlement called Tai Bwo Wannai Village in the middle of the island. It's a funny place; the chieftain's an unfriendly chap and his sons are barking mad.
translation: 岛中部有一个名为 Tai Bwo Wannai 村的小定居点。这是一个有趣的地方；酋长是个不友善的家伙，他的儿子们都在狂吠。 [dao zhong bu you yi ge ming wei  Tai Bwo Wannai  cun de xiao ding ju dian 。 zhe shi yi ge you qu de di fang ； qiu zhang shi ge bu you shan de jia huo ， ta de er zi men dou zai kuang fei 。]

english: Honestly, one of them asked me to stuff a dead monkey with seaweed so he could EAT it!
translation: 老实说，其中一个人让我把海藻塞进一只死猴子里，这样他就可以吃它了！ [lao shi shuo ， qi zhong yi ge ren rang wo ba hai zao sai jin yi zhi si hou zi li ， zhe yang ta jiu ke yi chi ta le ！]

english: Yes, I've met them.
translation: 是的，我见过他们。 [shi de ， wo jian guo ta men 。]

english: Further south you'll find Shilo Village. It's been under attack by terrifying zombies in recent months, if my sources are correct.
translation: 再往南，你会发现希洛村。如果我的消息来源正确的话，最近几个月它一直受到可怕的僵尸的攻击。 [zai wang nan ， ni hui fa xian xi luo cun 。 ru guo wo de xiao xi lai yuan zheng que de hua ， zui jin ji ge yue ta yi zhi shou dao ke pa de jiang shi de gong ji 。]

english: I've dealt with them, although there are a few still knocking about.
translation: 我已经和他们打过交道了，尽管还有一些人还在闲逛。 [wo yi jing he ta men da guo jiao dao le ， jin guan hai you yi xie ren hai zai xian guang 。]

english: The jungle's filled with nasty creatures. There are vicious spiders that you can hardly see before they try to bite your legs off, and great big jungle ogres.
translation: 丛林里充满了令人讨厌的生物。这里有恶毒的蜘蛛，在它们试图咬掉你的腿之前你几乎看不到它们，还有巨大的丛林食人魔。 [cong lin li chong man le ling ren tao yan de sheng wu 。 zhe li you e du de zhi zhu ， zai ta men shi tu yao diao ni de tui zhi qian ni ji hu kan bu dao ta men ， hai you ju da de cong lin shi ren mo 。]

english: Tell me about what's underground.
translation: 告诉我地下有什么。 [gao su wo di xia you shen me 。]

english: Oh, the dwarven realms?
translation: 哦，矮人国度？ [o ， ai ren guo du ？]

english: Yes, there was a time, back in the Fourth Age, when we humans wouldn't have been able to venture underground. That was before we had magic; the dwarves were quite a threat.
translation: 是的，曾经有一段时间，早在第四纪元，我们人类就无法冒险进入地下。那是在我们拥有魔法之前；矮人是一个很大的威胁。 [shi de ， ceng jing you yi duan shi jian ， zao zai di si ji yuan ， wo men ren lei jiu wu fa mao xian jin ru di xia 。 na shi zai wo men yong you mo fa zhi qian ； ai ren shi yi ge hen da de wei xie 。]

english: Still, it's much more friendly now. You can visit the vast dwarven mine if you like; the entrance is on the mountain north of Falador.
translation: 不过，现在友好多了。如果你愿意的话，你可以参观巨大的矮人矿井；入口位于法拉多以北的山上。 [bu guo ， xian zai you hao duo le 。 ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， ni ke yi can guan ju da de ai ren kuang jing ； ru kou wei yu fa la duo yi bei de shan shang 。]

english: If you go further west you may be able to visit the dwarven city of Keldagrim. But they were a bit cautious about letting humans in, last time I asked.
translation: 如果您继续向西走，也许可以参观矮人城市凯尔达格林。但上次我问的时候，他们对让人类进来有点谨慎。 [ru guo nin ji xu xiang xi zou ， ye xu ke yi can guan ai ren cheng shi kai er da ge lin 。 dan shang ci wo wen de shi hou ， ta men dui rang ren lei jin lai you dian jin shen 。]

english: On the other hand, if you go west of Brimhaven, you'll find a huge underground labyrinth full of giants, demons, dogs and dragons to fight. It's even bigger than the caves under Taverley, although the Taverley
translation: 另一方面，如果你去布里姆港以西，你会发现一个巨大的地下迷宫，里面充满了巨人、恶魔、狗和龙，需要战斗。它甚至比塔弗利下面的洞穴还要大，尽管塔弗利 [ling yi fang mian ， ru guo ni qu bu li mu gang yi xi ， ni hui fa xian yi ge ju da de di xia mi gong ， li mian chong man le ju ren 、 e mo 、 gou he long ， xu yao zhan dou 。 ta shen zhi bi ta fu li xia mian de dong xue hai yao da ， jin guan ta fu li]

english: dungeon's pretty good for training your combat skills.
translation: 地下城非常适合训练你的战斗技能。 [di xia cheng fei chang shi he xun lian ni de zhan dou ji neng 。]

english: What mystical realms can I visit?
translation: 我可以参观哪些神秘领域？ [wo ke yi can guan na xie shen mi ling yu ？]

english: Well, you've been to Zanaris. I met a fairy years ago who said she lived there. She was an incredible warrior, considering that she wasn't even a metre tall.
translation: 嗯，你去过扎纳里斯。几年前我遇到了一位仙女，她说她住在那里。考虑到她的身高还不到一米，她是一位令人难以置信的战士。 [n ， ni qu guo zha na li si 。 ji nian qian wo yu dao le yi wei xian nv ， ta shuo ta zhu zai na li 。 kao lv dao ta de shen gao hai bu dao yi mi ， ta shi yi wei ling ren nan yi zhi xin de zhan shi 。]

english: Also, in my research I came across ancient references to some kind of Abyss. Demons from the Abyss have already escaped into this land; Saradomin be thanked that they are very rare!
translation: 此外，在我的研究中，我发现了古代对某种深渊的提及。来自深渊的恶魔已经逃入这片土地；感谢萨拉多明，它们非常罕见！ [ci wai ， zai wo de yan jiu zhong ， wo fa xian le gu dai dui mou zhong shen yuan de ti ji 。 lai zi shen yuan de e mo yi jing tao ru zhe pian tu di ； gan xie sa la duo ming ， ta men fei chang han jian ！]

english: I've been through a portal into the lair of some ancient demon. It was in the city of Uzer.
translation: 我已经通过传送门进入了一些远古恶魔的巢穴。那是在于泽市。 [wo yi jing tong guo chuan song men jin ru le yi xie yuan gu e mo de chao xue 。 na shi zai yu ze shi 。]

english: Ah, Uzer. A city much favoured by Saradomin, destroyed by Thammaron, the elder-demon, late in the Third Age.
translation: 啊，乌泽尔。这座深受萨拉多明青睐的城市，在第三纪元晚期被长老恶魔萨马隆摧毁。 [a ， wu ze er 。 zhe zuo shen shou sa la duo ming qing lai de cheng shi ， zai di san ji yuan wan qi bei zhang lao e mo sa ma long cui hui 。]

english: Yeah, there isn't much left there.
translation: 是的，那里已经没有剩下多少了。 [shi de ， na li yi jing mei you sheng xia duo shao le 。]

english: What's the biggest monster in the world?
translation: 世界上最大的怪物是什么？ [shi jie shang zui da de guai wu shi shen me ？]

english: There's a mighty fire-breathing dragon living underground in the deep Wilderness, known as the King Black Dragon. It's a fearsome beast, with a breath that can poison you, freeze you to the ground or
translation: 在荒野深处的地下生活着一条强大的喷火龙，被称为黑龙王。这是一头可怕的野兽，它的呼吸可以毒害你，把你冻在地上，或者 [zai huang ye shen chu de di xia sheng huo zhe yi tiao qiang da de pen huo long ， bei cheng wei hei long wang 。 zhe shi yi tou ke pa de ye shou ， ta de hu xi ke yi du hai ni ， ba ni dong zai di shang ， huo zhe]

english: incinerate you where you stand.
translation: 将你原地焚烧。 [jiang ni yuan di fen shao 。]

english: But even more deadly is the Queen of the Kalphites. As if her giant mandibles of death were not enough, she also throws her spines at her foes with deadly force. She can even cast rudimentary spells.
translation: 但更致命的是卡尔菲特女王。仿佛她巨大的死亡下颌还不够，她还会用致命的力量向敌人投掷刺。她甚至可以施展基本的咒语。 [dan geng zhi ming de shi ka er fei te nv wang 。 fang fu ta ju da de si wang xia he hai bu gou ， ta hai hui yong zhi ming de li liang xiang di ren tou zhi ci 。 ta shen zhi ke yi shi zhan ji ben de zhou yu 。]

english: Some dark power must be protecting her, for she can block attacks using prayer just as humans do.
translation: 肯定有某种黑暗力量在保护她，因为她可以像人类一样通过祈祷来阻止攻击。 [ken ding you mou zhong hei an li liang zai bao hu ta ， yin wei ta ke yi xiang ren lei yi yang tong guo qi dao lai zu zhi gong ji 。]

english: Another beast that's worthy of a special mention is the Shaikahan. It dwells in the eastern reaches of Karamja, and is almost impossible to kill except with specially prepared weapons.
translation: 另一种值得特别提及的野兽是Shaikahan。它居住在卡拉姆贾的东部地区，除非使用专门准备的武器，否则几乎不可能杀死它。 [ling yi zhong zhi de te bie ti ji de ye shou shi Shaikahan。 ta ju zhu zai ka la mu jia de dong bu di qu ， chu fei shi yong zhuan men zhun bei de wu qi ， fou ze ji hu bu ke neng sha si ta 。]

english: Actually, that one's dead. I've been helping a barmy hunter who'd sworn to kill it.
translation: 事实上，那个人已经死了。我一直在帮助一个发誓要杀死它的疯狂猎人。 [shi shi shang ， na ge ren yi jing si le 。 wo yi zhi zai bang zhu yi ge fa shi yao sha si ta de feng kuang lie ren 。]

english: What does poison do?
translation: 毒有什么作用？ [du you shen me zuo yong ？]

english: Many monsters use poison against their foes. If you get poisoned, you will not feel it at the time, but later you will begin to suffer its effects, and your life will drain slowly from you.
translation: 许多怪物对敌人使用毒药。如果你中毒了，当时你不会感觉到，但后来你就会开始受到它的影响，你的生命会慢慢耗尽。 [xu duo guai wu dui di ren shi yong du yao 。 ru guo ni zhong du le ， dang shi ni bu hui gan jue dao ， dan hou lai ni jiu hui kai shi shou dao ta de ying xiang ， ni de sheng ming hui man man hao jin 。]

english: Over time the effects dwindle to nothing, but if you had already been wounded you might die before they wear off completely.
translation: 随着时间的推移，效果会逐渐减弱，但如果你已经受伤，你可能会在效果完全消失之前死亡。 [sui zhe shi jian de tui yi ， xiao guo hui zhu jian jian ruo ， dan ru guo ni yi jing shou shang ， ni ke neng hui zai xiao guo wan quan xiao shi zhi qian si wang 。]

english: Fortunately, followers of Guthix have devised potions that can cure the poison or even give immunity to it.
translation: 幸运的是，古西克斯的追随者发明了可以治愈这种毒药甚至免疫它的药剂。 [xing yun de shi ， gu xi ke si de zhui sui zhe fa ming le ke yi zhi yu zhe zhong du yao shen zhi mian yi ta de yao ji 。]

english: Should you wish to use poison against your own enemies and those of our Lord Saradomin, there is a potion that you can smear on your daggers, arrows, spears, javelins and throwing knives.
translation: 如果你想对你自己的敌人和我们萨拉多明勋爵的敌人使用毒药，你可以将一种药水涂抹在你的匕首、箭、长矛、标枪和飞刀上。 [ru guo ni xiang dui ni zi ji de di ren he wo men sa la duo ming xun jue de di ren shi yong du yao ， ni ke yi jiang yi zhong yao shui tu mo zai ni de bi shou 、 jian 、 chang mao 、 biao qiang he fei dao shang 。]

english: What monsters drop good items?
translation: 哪些怪物会掉落好物品？ [na xie guai wu hui diao luo hao wu pin ？]

english: As a general rule, tougher monsters drop more valuable items. But even a lowly hobgoblin can drop valuable gems; it just does this extremely rarely.
translation: 一般来说，更强的怪物会掉落更有价值的物品。但即使是低等的大妖精也能掉落有价值的宝石；它只是很少这样做。 [yi ban lai shuo ， geng qiang de guai wu hui diao luo geng you jia zhi de wu pin 。 dan ji shi shi di deng de da yao jing ye neng diao luo you jia zhi de bao shi ； ta zhi shi hen shao zhe yang zuo 。]

english: If you can persuade the Slayer Masters to train you as a Slayer, you will be able to fight certain monsters that drop valuable items far more often.
translation: 如果你能说服杀戮大师将你训练为杀戮者，你将能够与某些更频繁地掉落有价值物品的怪物战斗。 [ru guo ni neng shuo fu sha lu da shi jiang ni xun lian wei sha lu zhe ， ni jiang neng gou yu mou xie geng pin fan di diao luo you jia zhi wu pin de guai wu zhan dou 。]

english: You might care to invest in an enchanted dragonstone ring. These are said to make a monster drop its most valuable items a little more often.
translation: 您可能愿意投资一枚附魔龙石戒指。据说这些可以让怪物更频繁地掉落最有价值的物品。 [nin ke neng yuan yi tou zi yi mei fu mo long shi jie zhi 。 ju shuo zhe xie ke yi rang guai wu geng pin fan di diao luo zui you jia zhi de wu pin 。]

english: What are these strange monsters that keep appearing out of nowhere and attacking me when I'm training?
translation: 在我训练的时候，那些突然出现并攻击我的奇怪怪物是什么？ [zai wo xun lian de shi hou ， na xie tu ran chu xian bing gong ji wo de qi guai guai wu shi shen me ？]

english: Ah, I imagine you see a lot of those.
translation: 啊，我想你会看到很多这样的。 [a ， wo xiang ni hui kan dao hen duo zhe yang de 。]

english: Creatures such as the rock golem, river troll and tree spirit dwell in places where adventurers frequently go to train their skills. While you're training you will often disturb one by accident. It will then get angry and
translation: 岩石傀儡、河流巨魔和树精等生物居住在冒险者经常去训练技能的地方。当你训练的时候，你经常会不小心打扰到别人。然后它会生气并 [yan shi kui lei 、 he liu ju mo he shu jing deng sheng wu ju zhu zai mao xian zhe jing chang qu xun lian ji neng de di fang 。 dang ni xun lian de shi hou ， ni jing chang hui bu xiao xin da rao dao bie ren 。 ran hou ta hui sheng qi bing]

english: attack you. The safest way to deal with them is to run away immediately, but they sometimes drop valuable items if you kill them.
translation: 攻击你。对付他们最安全的方法是立即逃跑，但如果你杀死他们，他们有时会掉落有价值的物品。 [gong ji ni 。 dui fu ta men zui an quan de fang fa shi li ji tao pao ， dan ru guo ni sha si ta men ， ta men you shi hui diao luo you jia zhi de wu pin 。]

english: Tell me about valiant heroes!
translation: 给我讲讲勇敢的英雄吧！ [gei wo jiang jiang yong gan de ying xiong ba ！]

english: Ha ha ha... There are plenty of heroes. Always have been, always will be, until the fall of the world.
translation: 哈哈哈……英雄有很多。一直如此，永远如此，直到世界毁灭。 [ha ha ha …… ying xiong you hen duo 。 yi zhi ru ci ， yong yuan ru ci ， zhi dao shi jie hui mie 。]

english: If you'd do a few more quests, you'd soon become a fairly noted adventurer yourself.
translation: 如果你再做一些任务，你自己很快就会成为一名相当著名的冒险家。 [ru guo ni zai zuo yi xie ren wu ， ni zi ji hen kuai jiu hui cheng wei yi ming xiang dang zhu ming de mao xian jia 。]

english: You're quite a noted adventurer yourself!
translation: 你本身就是一位著名的冒险家！ [ni ben shen jiu shi yi wei zhu ming de mao xian jia ！]

english: But I suppose I could tell you of a couple...
translation: 但我想我可以告诉你几个...... [dan wo xiang wo ke yi gao su ni ji ge ......]

english: Yes, there was a man called Arrav. No-one knew where he came from, but he was a fearsome fighter, a skillful hunter and a remarkable farmer. He lived in the ancient settlement of Avarrocka, defending it from
translation: 是的，有一个人叫阿拉夫。没有人知道他来自哪里，但他是一位可怕的战士、熟练的猎人和出色的农民。他住在阿瓦罗卡（Avarrocka）古老的定居点，保卫它免受 [shi de ， you yi ge ren jiao a la fu 。 mei you ren zhi dao ta lai zi na li ， dan ta shi yi wei ke pa de zhan shi 、 shu lian de lie ren he chu se de nong min 。 ta zhu zai a wa luo ka （Avarrocka） gu lao de ding ju dian ， bao wei ta mian shou]

english: goblins, until he went forth in search of some strange artefact long desired by the dreaded Mahjarrat.
translation: 妖精，直到他前去寻找可怕的玛吉拉特长期渴望的一些奇怪的文物。 [yao jing ， zhi dao ta qian qu xun zhao ke pa de ma ji la te chang qi ke wang de yi xie qi guai de wen wu 。]

english: Perhaps some day I shall be able to tell you what became of him.
translation: 也许有一天我能够告诉你他的遭遇。 [ye xu you yi tian wo neng gou gao su ni ta de zao yu 。]

english: But do not let your head be turned by heroics. Randas was another great man, but he let himself be beguiled into turning to serve Zamorak, and they say he is now a mindless creature deep in the Underground Pass that
translation: 但不要让你的头脑被英雄主义所迷惑。兰达斯是另一个伟人，但他让自己被欺骗而转而为萨莫拉克服务，他们说他现在是地下通道深处的一个没有思想的生物， [dan bu yao rang ni de tou nao bei ying xiong zhu yi suo mi huo 。 lan da si shi ling yi ge wei ren ， dan ta rang zi ji bei qi pian er zhuan er wei sa mo la ke fu wu ， ta men shuo ta xian zai shi di xia tong dao shen chu de yi ge mei you si xiang de sheng wu ，]

english: leads to Isafdar.
translation: 通向伊萨夫达尔。 [tong xiang yi sa fu da er 。]

english: Where did humans learn to use magic?
translation: 人类从哪里学会使用魔法？ [ren lei cong na li xue hui shi yong mo fa ？]

english: Ah, that was quite a discovery! It revolutionised our way of life and jolted us into this Fifth Age of the world.
translation: 啊，这真是一个发现！它彻底改变了我们的生活方式，并将我们带入了世界的第五纪元。 [a ， zhe zhen shi yi ge fa xian ！ ta che di gai bian le wo men de sheng huo fang shi ， bing jiang wo men dai ru le shi jie de di wu ji yuan 。]

english: They say a traveller in the north discovered the key, although no records state exactly what he found. From this he was able to summon the magic of the four elements, using magic as a tool and a weapon. He and
translation: 他们说，一位北方的旅行者发现了这把钥匙，尽管没有记录准确说明他发现了什么。由此他能够召唤出四种元素的魔法，将魔法作为工具和武器。他和 [ta men shuo ， yi wei bei fang de lv xing zhe fa xian le zhe ba yao shi ， jin guan mei you ji lu zhun que shuo ming ta fa xian le shen me 。 you ci ta neng gou zhao huan chu si zhong yuan su de mo fa ， jiang mo fa zuo wei gong ju he wu qi 。 ta he]

english: his followers learnt how to bind the power into little stones so that others could use it.
translation: 他的追随者学会了如何将力量绑定到小石头中，以便其他人可以使用它。 [ta de zhui sui zhe xue hui le ru he jiang li liang bang ding dao xiao shi tou zhong ， yi bian qi ta ren ke yi shi yong ta 。]

english: in the land south of here they constructed an immense tower where the power could be studied, but followers of Zamorak destroyed it with fire many years ago, and most of the knowledge was lost.
translation: 他们在南方的土地上建造了一座巨大的塔楼，可以在那里研究力量，但萨莫拉克的追随者多年前用火摧毁了它，大部分知识都丢失了。 [ta men zai nan fang de tu di shang jian zao le yi zuo ju da de ta lou ， ke yi zai na li yan jiu li liang ， dan sa mo la ke de zhui sui zhe duo nian qian yong huo cui hui le ta ， da bu fen zhi shi dou diu shi le 。]

english: Perhaps one day those lost secrets will be uncovered once more.
translation: 也许有一天，那些失落的秘密将再次被揭开。 [ye xu you yi tian ， na xie shi luo de mi mi jiang zai ci bei jie kai 。]

english: I hear you've been very helpful to the wizards who are working on the mysteries of the rune stones.
translation: 我听说你对那些致力于解开符文石之谜的巫师们很有帮助。 [wo ting shuo ni dui na xie zhi li yu jie kai fu wen shi zhi mi de wu shi men hen you bang zhu 。]

english: Well, I didn't do much...
translation: 嗯，我没做太多事... [n ， wo mei zuo tai duo shi ...]

english: I suppose you'd know about the history of today's cities?
translation: 我想您会了解当今城市的历史吗？ [wo xiang nin hui liao jie dang jin cheng shi de li shi ma ？]

english: Yes, there are fairly good records of the formation of the cities from primitive settlements.
translation: 是的，关于从原始定居点形成城市的记录相当丰富。 [shi de ， guan yu cong yuan shi ding ju dian xing cheng cheng shi de ji lu xiang dang feng fu 。]

english: In the early part of the Fourth Age, of course, there were no permanent settlements. Tribes wandered the lands, staying where they could until the resources were exhausted.
translation: 当然，在第四纪元早期，并没有永久的定居点。部落在这片土地上徘徊，尽可能停留在任何地方，直到资源耗尽。 [dang ran ， zai di si ji yuan zao qi ， bing mei you yong jiu de ding ju dian 。 bu luo zai zhe pian tu di shang pai huai ， jin ke neng ting liu zai ren he di fang ， zhi dao zi yuan hao jin 。]

english: This changed as people learnt to grow crops and breed animals, and now there are very few of the old nomadic tribes. There's at least one tribe roaming between the Troll Stronghold and Rellekka, though.
translation: 随着人们学会种植农作物和饲养动物，这种情况发生了变化，现在古老的游牧部落已经很少了。不过，至少有一个部落在巨魔要塞和雷莱卡之间游荡。 [sui zhe ren men xue hui zhong zhi nong zuo wu he si yang dong wu ， zhe zhong qing kuang fa sheng le bian hua ， xian zai gu lao de you mu bu luo yi jing hen shao le 。 bu guo ， zhi shao you yi ge bu luo zai ju mo yao sai he lei lai ka zhi jian you dang 。]

english: Yes, I've met them. They're all mad.
translation: 是的，我见过他们。他们都疯了。 [shi de ， wo jian guo ta men 。 ta men dou feng le 。]

english: Truly, their faith in natural spirits is rather foolish, but they're a pleasant enough people.
translation: 确实，他们对自然灵魂的信仰相当愚蠢，但他们是一个足够令人愉快的民族。 [que shi ， ta men dui zi ran ling hun de xin yang xiang dang yu chun ， dan ta men shi yi ge zu gou ling ren yu kuai de min zu 。]

english: Anyway, what was I saying? Ah, yes...
translation: 无论如何，我在说什么？啊，是的... [wu lun ru he ， wo zai shuo shen me ？ a ， shi de ...]

english: One settlement was Avarrocka, a popular trading centre.
translation: 其中一个定居点是阿瓦罗卡，一个受欢迎的贸易中心。 [qi zhong yi ge ding ju dian shi a wa luo ka ， yi ge shou huan ying de mao yi zhong xin 。]

english: In the west, Ardougne gradually formed under the leadership of the Carnillean family, despite the threat of the Mahjarrat warlord Hazeel who dwelt in that area until his downfall.
translation: 在西部，阿杜涅在卡尼勒家族的领导下逐渐形成，尽管受到马吉拉特军阀哈泽尔的威胁，哈泽尔一直居住在该地区直到他垮台。 [zai xi bu ， a du nie zai ka ni lei jia zu de ling dao xia zhu jian xing cheng ， jin guan shou dao ma ji la te jun fa ha ze er de wei xie ， ha ze er yi zhi ju zhu zai gai di qu zhi dao ta kua tai 。]

english: He'll be back, just you wait!
translation: 他会回来的，你等着吧！ [ta hui hui lai de ， ni deng zhe ba ！]

english: Oh dear, I hope you haven't done anything rash!
translation: 哦亲爱的，我希望你没有做任何鲁莽的事情！ [o qin ai de ， wo xi wang ni mei you zuo ren he lu mang de shi qing ！]

english: I've foiled a dastardly Zamorakian plot to have Hazeel resurrected.
translation: 我挫败了萨莫拉克人复活哈兹尔的卑鄙阴谋。 [wo cuo bai le sa mo la ke ren fu huo ha zi er de bei bi yin mou 。]

english: So I'd heard. Lord Saradomin is smiling on you.
translation: 所以我听说过。萨拉多明勋爵正在对你微笑。 [suo yi wo ting shuo guo 。 sa la duo ming xun jue zheng zai dui ni wei xiao 。]

english: Tell me about yourself, old man.
translation: 跟我说说你自己吧，老伙计。 [gen wo shuo shuo ni zi ji ba ， lao huo ji 。]

english: Ah, so you want to know about me, eh?
translation: 啊，所以你想了解我，是吗？ [a ， suo yi ni xiang liao jie wo ， shi ma ？]

english: Mmm... what could I say about myself? Let's see what I've done...
translation: 嗯...我能对自己说些什么呢？让我们看看我做了什么... [n ... wo neng dui zi ji shuo xie shen me ne ？ rang wo men kan kan wo zuo le shen me ...]

english: I've delved into the dungeon west of Brimhaven and heard the terrifying CRASH of the steel dragons battling each other for territory.
translation: 我深入布里姆港以西的地牢，听到了钢铁巨龙为争夺领地而互相争斗的可怕撞击声。 [wo shen ru bu li mu gang yi xi de di lao ， ting dao le gang tie ju long wei zheng duo ling di er hu xiang zheng dou de ke pa zhuang ji sheng 。]

english: I spent some years on Entrana, where I learnt the techniques of pure meditation.
translation: 我在 Entrana 呆了几年，在那里我学习了纯粹冥想的技巧。 [wo zai  Entrana  dai le ji nian ， zai na li wo xue xi le chun cui ming xiang de ji qiao 。]

english: I've wandered through the vast desert that lies south of Al Kharid and seen the great walls of Menaphos and Sophanem.
translation: 我漫步穿过阿尔卡里德以南的广阔沙漠，看到了梅纳福斯和索法奈姆的长城。 [wo man bu chuan guo a er ka li de yi nan de guang kuo sha mo ， kan dao le mei na fu si he suo fa nai mu de chang cheng 。]

english: That feline statue you've got on your bookshelf there - I'm sure I saw something like that when I was in Sophanem.
translation: 你书架上的那个猫科动物雕像——我确信我在索法奈姆的时候也看到过类似的东西。 [ni shu jia shang de na ge mao ke dong wu diao xiang —— wo que xin wo zai suo fa nai mu de shi hou ye kan dao guo lei si de dong xi 。]

english: I've always liked to collect little trinkets to remind me of the time when my life was more - ah - exciting.
translation: 我一直喜欢收集小饰品，以提醒我生活中更 - 啊 - 令人兴奋的时光。 [wo yi zhi xi huan shou ji xiao shi pin ， yi ti xing wo sheng huo zhong geng  -  a  -  ling ren xing fen de shi guang 。]

english: So you've spoken to the Sphinx, then?
translation: 那么你已经和狮身人面像谈过了？ [na me ni yi jing he shi shen ren mian xiang tan guo le ？]

english: Spoken to a sphinx, you say? My dear young lady, you can't possibly be serious!
translation: 你说是和狮身人面像说话？我亲爱的小姐，你不可能是认真的！ [ni shuo shi he shi shen ren mian xiang shuo hua ？ wo qin ai de xiao jie ， ni bu ke neng shi ren zhen de ！]

english: What do you mean?
translation: 你是什​​么意思？ [ni shi shen ​​ me yi si ？]

english: Ha ha ha! The people who live deep in the shifting sands of the desert will often tell travellers tall tales of strange beasts, but that doesn't mean any of it's remotely true!
translation: 哈哈哈！生活在沙漠流沙深处的人们经常会给旅行者讲述一些奇怪的野兽的荒唐故事，但这并不意味着这些故事都是真实的！ [ha ha ha ！ sheng huo zai sha mo liu sha shen chu de ren men jing chang hui gei lv xing zhe jiang shu yi xie qi guai de ye shou de huang tang gu shi ， dan zhe bing bu yi wei zhe zhe xie gu shi dou shi zhen shi de ！]

english: But I've met the Sph...
translation: 但我遇到了Sph... [dan wo yu dao le Sph...]

english: Please, adventurer, there is nothing to be gained by interfering in matters you do not understand.
translation: 拜托，冒险家，干涉你不明白的事情是没有任何好处的。 [bai tuo ， mao xian jia ， gan she ni bu ming bai de shi qing shi mei you ren he hao chu de 。]

english: Even if such a creature were to exist...
translation: 就算有这样的生物存在…… [jiu suan you zhe yang de sheng wu cun zai ……]

english: ... which it does...
translation: ...它确实... [... ta que shi ...]

english: EVEN IF SUCH A CREATURE WERE TO EXIST it would be terribly dangerous for you to get involved in its business.
translation: 即使这样的生物存在，介入它的生意对你来说也是非常危险的。 [ji shi zhe yang de sheng wu cun zai ， jie ru ta de sheng yi dui ni lai shuo ye shi fei chang wei xian de 。]

english: I have heard of terrible things happening to travellers in that land, and I would not wish for you to be dragged into anything like that.
translation: 我听说那片土地上的旅行者发生了可怕的事情，我不希望你被拖入这样的事情。 [wo ting shuo na pian tu di shang de lv xing zhe fa sheng le ke pa de shi qing ， wo bu xi wang ni bei tuo ru zhe yang de shi qing 。]

english: Indeed, I have heard of adventurers doing the most shameful and blasphemous deeds believing themselves to be acting on behalf of some false god!
translation: 事实上，我听说过冒险者做出了最可耻和亵渎的行为，他们相信自己是在代表某个虚假的神行事！ [shi shi shang ， wo ting shuo guo mao xian zhe zuo chu le zui ke chi he xie du de xing wei ， ta men xiang xin zi ji shi zai dai biao mou ge xu jia de shen xing shi ！]

english: Hmmm?
So please do not speak to me of this matter again. Now, I believe I was telling you of my adventurous youth...
translation: 所以请不要再跟我谈论这件事了。现在，我相信我正在向你讲述我冒险的青春…… [suo yi qing bu yao zai gen wo tan lun zhe jian shi le 。 xian zai ， wo xiang xin wo zheng zai xiang ni jiang shu wo mao xian de qing chun ……]

english: Apart from all that, I've spent many a happy hour in dusty libraries, searching through ancient scrolls and texts for the wisdom of those who have passed on.
translation: 除此之外，我还在布满灰尘的图书馆里度过了许多快乐的时光，在古老的卷轴和文本中寻找已故者的智慧。 [chu ci zhi wai ， wo hai zai bu man hui chen de tu shu guan li du guo le xu duo kuai le de shi guang ， zai gu lao de juan zhou he wen ben zhong xun zhao yi gu zhe de zhi hui 。]

english: Plus plenty of other adventures, quests, journeys... Is there anything else you'd like to know?
translation: 还有大量其他冒险、任务、旅程……您还有什么想知道的吗？ [hai you da liang qi ta mao xian 、 ren wu 、 lv cheng …… nin hai you shen me xiang zhi dao de ma ？]

english: I heard that Gielinor has three gods.
translation: 听说吉林诺有三位神。 [ting shuo ji lin nuo you san wei shen 。]

english: Indeed. This is correct: Saradomin, Guthix and Zamorak.
translation: 的确。这是正确的：萨拉多明、古蒂克斯和萨莫拉克。 [di que 。 zhe shi zheng que de ： sa la duo ming 、 gu di ke si he sa mo la ke 。]

english: Saradomin, the great and glorious, gives life to this world.
translation: 萨拉多明，伟大而光荣的，给这个世界带来了生命。 [sa la duo ming ， wei da er guang rong de ， gei zhe ge shi jie dai lai le sheng ming 。]

english: Zamorak craves only death and destruction.
translation: 萨莫拉克只渴望死亡和毁灭。 [sa mo la ke zhi ke wang si wang he hui mie 。]

english: Guthix, calling itself a god of 'balance', holds no allegiance, but simply aids whatever cause suits its shifting purpose.
translation: 古西克斯自称“平衡”之神，并不效忠，而只是帮助任何适合其不断变化的目的的事业。 [gu xi ke si zi cheng “ ping heng ” zhi shen ， bing bu xiao zhong ， er zhi shi bang zhu ren he shi he qi bu duan bian hua de mu di de shi ye 。]

english: So who's Zaros?
translation: 那么扎罗斯是谁？ [na me zha luo si shi shui ？]

english: What did you say?
translation: 你说什么？ [ni shuo shen me ？]

english: I discovered a buried altar to a god called Zaros.
translation: 我发现了一座埋葬的祭坛，供奉着一位名叫扎罗斯的神。 [wo fa xian le yi zuo mai zang de ji tan ， gong feng zhe yi wei ming jiao zha luo si de shen 。]

english: Please, do not speak further of this. No good can come of meddling in such things.
translation: 请不要再谈论这一点。干涉这些事情不会有什么好处。 [qing bu yao zai tan lun zhe yi dian 。 gan she zhe xie shi qing bu hui you shen me hao chu 。]

english: So Zaros is real?
translation: 那么扎罗斯是真实存在的吗？ [na me zha luo si shi zhen shi cun zai de ma ？]

english: Adventurer, my patience is limited. Speak to me no further of this - this - this foolishness.
translation: 冒险家，我的耐心是有限度的。不要再跟我说这个——这个——这个愚蠢的事情了。 [mao xian jia ， wo de nai xin shi you xian du de 。 bu yao zai gen wo shuo zhe ge —— zhe ge —— zhe ge yu chun de shi qing le 。]

english: Does that mean I shouldn't ask you about the ancient magicks I learnt in that pyramid north of Sophanem?
translation: 这是否意味着我不应该向你询问我在索法纳姆北部金字塔中学到的古代魔法？ [zhe shi fou yi wei zhe wo bu ying gai xiang ni xun wen wo zai suo fa na mu bei bu jin zi ta zhong xue dao de gu dai mo fa ？]

english: ENOUGH! Begone from me, you foul trickster!
translation: 足够的！离我远点，你这个肮脏的骗子！ [zu gou de ！ li wo yuan dian ， ni zhe ge ang zang de pian zi ！]

english: I've heard of another god, called Armadyl.
translation: 我听说过另一个神，叫阿玛迪尔。 [wo ting shuo guo ling yi ge shen ， jiao a ma di er 。]

english: What is this of which you speak?
translation: 你说的这个是什么？ [ni shuo de zhe ge shi shen me ？]

english: A strange man asked me to go into the Temple of Ikov and steal the Staff of Armadyl.
translation: 一个陌生人要求我进入伊科夫神庙并偷走阿玛迪尔权杖。 [yi ge mo sheng ren yao qiu wo jin ru yi ke fu shen miao bing tou zou a ma di er quan zhang 。]

english: And what makes you believe in this 'Armadyl'?
translation: 是什么让你相信这个“​​Armadyl”？ [shi shen me rang ni xiang xin zhe ge “​​Armadyl”？]

english: Well, there were servants of Armadyl living down in the depths of the temple. They'd been there for generations, guarding the staff.
translation: 嗯，神殿深处住着阿玛迪尔的仆人。他们世世代代都在那里守护着员工。 [n ， shen dian shen chu zhu zhe a ma di er de pu ren 。 ta men shi shi dai dai dou zai na li shou hu zhe yuan gong 。]

english: So you trusted the word of these people who had been sitting down a hole all their lives?
translation: 所以你相信这些一辈子坐在洞里的人的话吗？ [suo yi ni xiang xin zhe xie yi bei zi zuo zai dong li de ren de hua ma ？]

english: Um... Yes, I suppose so.
translation: 嗯...是的，我想是的。 [n ... shi de ， wo xiang shi de 。]

english: I wouldn't worry about this sacred 'armadyllo' anymore. Just another foolish myth.
translation: 我不会再担心这个神圣的“犰狳”了。只是另一个愚蠢的神话。 [wo bu hui zai dan xin zhe ge shen sheng de “ qiu yu ” le 。 zhi shi ling yi ge yu chun de shen hua 。]

english: Oh well, the servants rewarded me very kindly for defeating Lucien for them.
translation: 哦，好吧，仆人们对我为他们击败了路西恩而给予了很大的奖励。 [o ， hao ba ， pu ren men dui wo wei ta men ji bai le lu xi en er ji yu le hen da de jiang li 。]

english: That is an impressive feat, adventurer. Truly you must be beloved in the eyes of Saradomin.
translation: 这是令人印象深刻的壮举，冒险家。确实，你一定是萨拉多明心目中的挚爱。 [zhe shi ling ren yin xiang shen ke de zhuang ju ， mao xian jia 。 que shi ， ni yi ding shi sa la duo ming xin mu zhong de zhi ai 。]

english: It's lucky there's no Armadyl! I've pinched his staff and given it to Lucien.
translation: 幸好没有阿玛迪尔！我把他的手杖捏下来交给了路西恩。 [xing hao mei you a ma di er ！ wo ba ta de shou zhang nie xia lai jiao gei le lu xi en 。]

english: YOU'VE DONE WHAT?
translation: 你做了什么？ [ni zuo le shen me ？]

english: Adventurer, I beg of you, do not meddle in the gods' affairs. No good can come of it.
translation: 冒险家，拜托你不要插手诸神的事情。这样做不会带来任何好处。 [mao xian jia ， bai tuo ni bu yao cha shou zhu shen de shi qing 。 zhe yang zuo bu hui dai lai ren he hao chu 。]

english: How about Tumeken, Elindis, Icthlarin and the Devourer?
translation: Tumeken、Elindis、Icthlarin 和吞噬者怎么样？ [Tumeken、Elindis、Icthlarin  he tun shi zhe zen me yang ？]

english: What names are these?
translation: 这些是什么名字？ [zhe xie shi shen me ming zi ？]

english: Down in Sophanem, they've got a chief god named Tumeken, plus a fertility goddess named Elindis. Icthlarin is their god of the dead and the Devourer...
translation: 在索法奈姆（Sophanem），他们有一位名叫图梅肯（Tumeken）的主神，还有一位名叫艾琳迪斯（Elindis）的生育女神。 Icthlarin 是他们的死亡之神和吞噬者…… [zai suo fa nai mu （Sophanem）， ta men you yi wei ming jiao tu mei ken （Tumeken） de zhu shen ， hai you yi wei ming jiao ai lin di si （Elindis） de sheng yu nv shen 。 Icthlarin  shi ta men de si wang zhi shen he tun shi zhe ……]

english: Adventurer, what folly leads you to think any of these - things, exist?
translation: 冒险家，是什么愚蠢的行为让你认为这些东西存在？ [mao xian jia ， shi shen me yu chun de xing wei rang ni ren wei zhe xie dong xi cun zai ？]

english: But I've met Icthlarin! He'dgot a jackal's head!
translation: 但我见过Icthlarin！他有一个豺狼的头！ [dan wo jian guo Icthlarin！ ta you yi ge chai lang de tou ！]

english: It is hot in that land, and the heat can affect a traveller in strange ways. Tell me, when you met 'Icthlarin', had you been feeling at all unwell?
translation: 那片土地很热，炎热会以奇怪的方式影响旅行者。告诉我，当你遇到“Icthlarin”时，你有没有感觉不舒服？ [na pian tu di hen re ， yan re hui yi qi guai de fang shi ying xiang lv xing zhe 。 gao su wo ， dang ni yu dao “Icthlarin” shi ， ni you mei you gan jue bu shu fu ？]

english: Well, now you mention it, I'd just been hypnotised by a weird woman I met in the desert.
translation: 好吧，现在你提到了，我刚刚被我在沙漠中遇到的一个奇怪的女人催眠了。 [hao ba ， xian zai ni ti dao le ， wo gang gang bei wo zai sha mo zhong yu dao de yi ge qi guai de nv ren cui mian le 。]

english: So a strange woman interfered with your mind, then you met a man with the head of a jackal, and you decided he must be a god?
translation: 那么一个陌生的女人干扰了你的思想，然后你遇到了一个豺狼头的男人，你就认定他一定是神？ [na me yi ge mo sheng de nv ren gan rao le ni de si xiang ， ran hou ni yu dao le yi ge chai lang tou de nan ren ， ni jiu ren ding ta yi ding shi shen ？]

english: Umm...
Well, make sure you don't get hypnotised again, and I'm sure you'll not meet any more jackal-headed men claiming to be gods!
translation: 好吧，确保你不再被催眠，我相信你不会再遇到任何自称是神的豺狼头男人了！ [hao ba ， que bao ni bu zai bei cui mian ， wo xiang xin ni bu hui zai yu dao ren he zi cheng shi shen de chai lang tou nan ren le ！]

english: But...?
It'd probably be best if you don't go there again.
translation: 你最好不要再去那里了。 [ni zui hao bu yao zai qu na li le 。]

english: But you've been all around that area, haven't you? When you were travelling?
translation: 但你已经去过那个地区了，不是吗？你旅行的时候？ [dan ni yi jing qu guo na ge di qu le ， bu shi ma ？ ni lv xing de shi hou ？]

english: Indeed, I have.
translation: 确实，我有。 [que shi ， wo you 。]

english: So you'd know all about their gods?
translation: 那么你会了解他们的神吗？ [na me ni hui liao jie ta men de shen ma ？]

english: I know what I know.
translation: 我知道我所知道的。 [wo zhi dao wo suo zhi dao de 。]

english: And knowing what I know, I do not speak of this matter. Perhaps you would be wise to heed my example.
translation: 据我所知，我不会谈论这件事。也许你应该明智地留意我的例子。 [ju wo suo zhi ， wo bu hui tan lun zhe jian shi 。 ye xu ni ying gai ming zhi di liu yi wo de li zi 。]

english: I wanna know about the wars of the gods!
translation: 我想了解诸神之战！ [wo xiang liao jie zhu shen zhi zhan ！]

english: Ah, that was a terrible time. The armies of Saradomin fought gloriously against the minions of Zamorak, but many brave warriors and noble cities were overthrown and destroyed utterly.
translation: 啊，那是一段可怕的时光。萨拉多明的军队与萨莫拉克的爪牙进行了辉煌的战斗，但许多勇敢的战士和高贵的城市被彻底推翻和摧毁。 [a ， na shi yi duan ke pa de shi guang 。 sa la duo ming de jun dui yu sa mo la ke de zhao ya jin xing le hui huang de zhan dou ， dan xu duo yong gan de zhan shi he gao gui de cheng shi bei che di tui fan he cui hui 。]

english: You have visited Uzer, and seen for yourself the damage that could be wrought by an elder-demon in its wrath.
translation: 你拜访过乌泽尔，并亲眼目睹了长老恶魔在愤怒中可能造成的伤害。 [ni bai fang guo wu ze er ， bing qin yan mu du le zhang lao e mo zai fen nu zhong ke neng zao cheng de shang hai 。]

english: How did it all end?
translation: 这一切是如何结束的？ [zhe yi qie shi ru he jie shu de ？]

english: Before the Zamorakian forces could be utterly routed, Lord Saradomin took pity on them and the battle- scarred world, and allowed a truce.
translation: 在萨莫拉克军队被彻底击溃之前，萨拉多明勋爵怜悯他们和这个饱受战争创伤的世界，并允许停战。 [zai sa mo la ke jun dui bei che di ji kui zhi qian ， sa la duo ming xun jue lian min ta men he zhe ge bao shou zhan zheng chuang shang de shi jie ， bing yun xu ting zhan 。]

english: What are the Mahjarrat?
translation: 什么是马吉拉特？ [shen me shi ma ji la te ？]

english: Very little is written about the tribe of the Mahjarrat. They are believed to be from the realm of Freneskae, or Frenaskrae - the spelling in this tongue is only approximate.
translation: 关于 Mahjarrat 部落的记载很少。他们被认为来自 Freneskae 或 Frenaskrae 王国——这种语言中的拼写只是近似的。 [guan yu  Mahjarrat  bu luo de ji zai hen shao 。 ta men bei ren wei lai zi  Freneskae  huo  Frenaskrae  wang guo —— zhe zhong yu yan zhong de pin xie zhi shi jin si de 。]

english: One of them, the foul Zamorak, has achieved godhood, although none knows how this came about.
translation: 其中一个，肮脏的萨莫拉克，已经获得了神性，尽管没有人知道这是如何实现的。 [qi zhong yi ge ， ang zang de sa mo la ke ， yi jing huo de le shen xing ， jin guan mei you ren zhi dao zhe shi ru he shi xian de 。]

english: Other Mahjarrat who have been particularly active upon this plane are Hazeel, Lucien, Azzanadra and Zemouregal.
translation: 其他在这个位面特别活跃的马哈拉特包括哈兹尔、路西恩、阿扎纳德拉和泽穆雷加尔。 [qi ta zai zhe ge wei mian te bie huo yue de ma ha la te bao kuo ha zi er 、 lu xi en 、 a zha na de la he ze mu lei jia er 。]

english: Hazeel will rise again, you'll see!
translation: 海兹尔会再次崛起，你会看到的！ [hai zi er hui zai ci jue qi ， ni hui kan dao de ！]

english: Adventurer, your actions fill me with concern!
translation: 冒险家，你的举动让我很担心！ [mao xian jia ， ni de ju dong rang wo hen dan xin ！]

english: I've defeated Lucien.
translation: 我已经打败了路西恩。 [wo yi jing da bai le lu xi en 。]

english: Truly, your bravery exceeds your stature. But I fear his defeat will not be permanent.
translation: 确实，你的勇敢超越了你的地位。但我担心他的失败不会是永久性的。 [que shi ， ni de yong gan chao yue le ni de di wei 。 dan wo dan xin ta de shi bai bu hui shi yong jiu xing de 。]

english: I've met Lucien. He paid me very nicely for bringing him a staff he wanted.
translation: 我见过卢西安。他给了我很好的报酬，因为我给他带来了他想要的员工。 [wo jian guo lu xi an 。 ta gei le wo hen hao de bao chou ， yin wei wo gei ta dai lai le ta xiang yao de yuan gong 。]

english: Traveller, I beg of you, do not have further dealings with such creatures! You do not know their power as I do.
translation: 旅行者，求求你，不要再与这种生物有任何来往了！你不像我一样了解他们的力量。 [lv xing zhe ， qiu qiu ni ， bu yao zai yu zhe zhong sheng wu you ren he lai wang le ！ ni bu xiang wo yi yang liao jie ta men de li liang 。]

english: Azzanadra taught me some ancient magical powers after I unlocked the pyramid where he had been trapped.
translation: 在我打开了他被困的金字塔之后，阿扎纳德拉教给了我一些古老的魔法力量。 [zai wo da kai le ta bei kun de jin zi ta zhi hou ， a zha na de la jiao gei le wo yi xie gu lao de mo fa li liang 。]

english: Leave me, traveller; I am old, and your words fill me with horror.
translation: 离开我吧，旅行者；我老了，你的话让我感到恐惧。 [li kai wo ba ， lv xing zhe ； wo lao le ， ni de hua rang wo gan dao kong ju 。]

english: Can I wield the power of Saradomin myself?
translation: 我可以自己使用萨拉多明的力量吗？ [wo ke yi zi ji shi yong sa la duo ming de li liang ma ？]

english: I see you are already learning to summon the power of Saradomin.
translation: 我看到你已经在学习召唤萨拉多明的力量了。 [wo kan dao ni yi jing zai xue xi zhao huan sa la duo ming de li liang le 。]

english: If you travel to the Mage Arena in the north-west reaches of the Wilderness, the battle mage Kolodion may be willing to let you learn to summon the power of Saradomin, should you be able to pass his test.
translation: 如果你前往荒野西北地区的法师竞技场，战斗法师科洛迪恩可能愿意让你学习召唤萨拉多明的力量，前提是你能够通过他的考验。 [ru guo ni qian wang huang ye xi bei di qu de fa shi jing ji chang ， zhan dou fa shi ke luo di en ke neng yuan yi rang ni xue xi zhao huan sa la duo ming de li liang ， qian ti shi ni neng gou tong guo ta de kao yan 。]

english: I want to ask you about your hat.
translation: 我想问你关于你帽子的事。 [wo xiang wen ni guan yu ni mao zi de shi 。]

english: Why, thank you! I rather like it myself.
translation: 为什么，谢谢！我自己比较喜欢。 [wei shen me ， xie xie ！ wo zi ji bi jiao xi huan 。]

english: Did you steal it from the bank?
translation: 你是从银行偷的吗？ [ni shi cong yin hang tou de ma ？]

english: Me? Steal from the bank? Whatever do you mean?
translation: 我？从银行偷东西？不管你是什么意思？ [wo ？ cong yin hang tou dong xi ？ bu guan ni shi shen me yi si ？]

english: There's been a break-in at Draynor Bank, and I bet you did it.
translation: 德雷诺银行发生了一起入室盗窃案，我敢打赌是你干的。 [de lei nuo yin hang fa sheng le yi qi ru shi dao qie an ， wo gan da du shi ni gan de 。]

english: Oh my goodness, what in the world could make you think I did such a thing?
translation: 天哪，到底是什么让你认为我做了这样的事？ [tian na ， dao di shi shen me rang ni ren wei wo zuo le zhe yang de shi ？]

english: Well, you've been sitting here looking at the bank ever since you moved into this house. Now someone's robbed the bank, and suddenly your house is full of expensive stuff!
translation: 嗯，自从你搬进这所房子以来，你就一直坐在这里看着银行。现在有人抢劫了银行，突然间你的房子里就装满了昂贵的东西！ [n ， zi cong ni ban jin zhe suo fang zi yi lai ， ni jiu yi zhi zuo zai zhe li kan zhe yin hang 。 xian zai you ren qiang jie le yin hang ， tu ran jian ni de fang zi li jiu zhuang man le ang gui de dong xi ！]

english: Oh dear, oh dear...
translation: 哦亲爱的，哦亲爱的... [o qin ai de ， o qin ai de ...]

english: So what do you think I did? March across the street, smash the bank wall, knock out the bankers and steal all the money?
translation: 那么你认为我做了什么？穿过街道，砸碎银行墙，打倒银行家，偷走所有的钱？ [na me ni ren wei wo zuo le shen me ？ chuan guo jie dao ， za sui yin hang qiang ， da dao yin hang jia ， tou zou suo you de qian ？]

english: I'm an old man! I walk with a stick! How could I possibly have done that?
translation: 我是个老人了！我拄着拐杖走路！我怎么可能这么做呢？ [wo shi ge lao ren le ！ wo zhu zhe guai zhang zou lu ！ wo zen me ke neng zhe me zuo ne ？]

english: So you didn't rob the bank?
translation: 所以你没有抢劫银行？ [suo yi ni mei you qiang jie yin hang ？]

english: Just run along now, be a good lad, and don't worry yourself about me or my finances!
translation: 现在就跑吧，做个好小伙子，别为我或我的财务状况担心！ [xian zai jiu pao ba ， zuo ge hao xiao huo zi ， bie wei wo huo wo de cai wu zhuang kuang dan xin ！]

english: Hmmm... But I'll be keeping an eye on you.
translation: 嗯……不过我会留意你的。 [n …… bu guo wo hui liu yi ni de 。]

english: Now you've got that off your chest, would you like to ask me about anything else?
translation: 现在你已经把这件事说出来了，你还想问我其他事情吗？ [xian zai ni yi jing ba zhe jian shi shuo chu lai le ， ni hai xiang wen wo qi ta shi qing ma ？]

english: You stole it off that woman in the bank! You stole all this valuable stuff too!
translation: 你从银行那个女人那里偷走了它！这些值钱的东西都被你偷走了！ [ni cong yin hang na ge nv ren na li tou zou le ta ！ zhe xie zhi qian de dong xi dou bei ni tou zou le ！]

english: Stole it? How could you possibly think I did such a thing?
translation: 偷了？你怎么可能认为我做了这样的事？ [tou le ？ ni zen me ke neng ren wei wo zuo le zhe yang de shi ？]

english: I saw you robbing the bank! You killed all those people!
translation: 我看见你抢银行了！你把那些人都杀了！ [wo kan jian ni qiang yin hang le ！ ni ba na xie ren dou sha le ！]

english: Deary me, [player name], your imagination is running wild! What could make you think you saw me do that?
translation: 亲爱的我，[玩家名字]，你的想象力太丰富了！是什么让你认为你看到我这么做了？ [qin ai de wo ，[ wan jia ming zi ]， ni de xiang xiang li tai feng fu le ！ shi shen me rang ni ren wei ni kan dao wo zhe me zuo le ？]

english: I've seen a security recording that shows you robbing the bank. The bank's guard showed it to me.
translation: 我看过一份安全记录，显示你抢劫了银行。银行的保安给我看了。 [wo kan guo yi fen an quan ji lu ， xian shi ni qiang jie le yin hang 。 yin hang de bao an gei wo kan le 。]

english: You've seen the bank's security recording?
translation: 你看过银行的安全记录吗？ [ni kan guo yin hang de an quan ji lu ma ？]

english: Tut tut tut... Oh well, at least you'll never be able to tell the bank about me. They'll never listen.
translation: 啧啧啧……哦，好吧，至少你永远无法告诉银行关于我的事。他们永远不会听。 [ze ze ze …… o ， hao ba ， zhi shao ni yong yuan wu fa gao su yin hang guan yu wo de shi 。 ta men yong yuan bu hui ting 。]

english: So you're just going to get away with it?
translation: 所以你就打算侥幸逃脱吗？ [suo yi ni jiu da suan jiao xing tao tuo ma ？]

english: That's my plan, yes.
translation: 这就是我的计划，是的。 [zhe jiu shi wo de ji hua ， shi de 。]

english: But that's... well, it's WRONG!
translation: 但这是……好吧，这是错误的！ [dan zhe shi …… hao ba ， zhe shi cuo wu de ！]

english: Wrong? WRONG? I'll tell you what's wrong!
translation: 错误的？错误的？我来告诉你怎么了！ [cuo wu de ？ cuo wu de ？ wo lai gao su ni zen me le ！]

english: I've spent my whole life travelling the world, doing quests for people, saving lives, saving villages from terrifying monsters and all that sort of thing.
translation: 我一生都在环游世界，为人们做任务，拯救生命，从可怕的怪物手中拯救村庄等等。 [wo yi sheng dou zai huan you shi jie ， wei ren men zuo ren wu ， zheng jiu sheng ming ， cong ke pa de guai wu shou zhong zheng jiu cun zhuang deng deng 。]

english: Now I'm old, and where do I have to live? In this freezing old house next to a pig-sty, with a bunch of yobs outside who can't keep their hands off the market stalls! What sort of reward is that?
translation: 现在我老了，我该住在哪里呢？在猪圈旁边的这栋冰冷的老房子里，外面有一群小混混，他们的手离不开市场摊位！那是什么样的奖励？ [xian zai wo lao le ， wo gai zhu zai na li ne ？ zai zhu quan pang bian de zhe dong bing leng de lao fang zi li ， wai mian you yi qun xiao hun hun ， ta men de shou li bu kai shi chang tan wei ！ na shi shen me yang de jiang li ？]

english: So don't talk to me about right and wrong!
translation: 所以别跟我谈论对与错！ [suo yi bie gen wo tan lun dui yu cuo ！]

english: Maybe someone SHOULD talk to you about right and wrong...
translation: 也许有人应该和你谈谈对与错...... [ye xu you ren ying gai he ni tan tan dui yu cuo ......]

english: Bah!
translation: 呸! [pei !]

english: Hmmph!
translation: 哼！ [heng ！]

english: How can I get a hat like that?
translation: 怎样才能得到这样的帽子呢？ [zen yang cai neng de dao zhe yang de mao zi ne ？]

english: You could buy one off another player, or wait until they're next made available by the Council.
translation: 你可以从另一名球员那里购买一名球员，或者等到理事会下次提供他们。 [ni ke yi cong ling yi ming qiu yuan na li gou mai yi ming qiu yuan ， huo zhe deng dao li shi hui xia ci ti gong ta men 。]

english: Can I buy your hat?
translation: 我可以买你的帽子吗？ [wo ke yi mai ni de mao zi ma ？]

english: Ohhh no, I don't intend to part with this. Would you like to ask me about something else?
translation: 哦，不，我不想放弃这个。您还想问我其他事情吗？ [o ， bu ， wo bu xiang fang qi zhe ge 。 nin hai xiang wen wo qi ta shi qing ma ？]

english: You should give it back, you know.
translation: 你应该把它还给我，你知道的。 [ni ying gai ba ta huan gei wo ， ni zhi dao de 。]

english: No, I think I'll keep it.
translation: 不，我想我会保留它。 [bu ， wo xiang wo hui bao liu ta 。]

english: But...
That was quite an exciting quest we did together!
translation: 这是我们一起完成的一项非常令人兴奋的任务！ [zhe shi wo men yi qi wan cheng de yi xiang fei chang ling ren xing fen de ren wu ！]

english: Oh yes, it was certainly a fitting end to my adventuring days. Your fight against the Sea Troll Queen was highly impressive!
translation: 哦，是的，这确实是我冒险生涯的一个恰当的结束。你与海巨魔女王的战斗非常令人印象深刻！ [o ， shi de ， zhe que shi shi wo mao xian sheng ya de yi ge qia dang de jie shu 。 ni yu hai ju mo nv wang de zhan dou fei chang ling ren yin xiang shen ke ！]

english: Are you tempted to go on another quest in the future?
translation: 您是否想在未来继续进行另一项任务？ [nin shi fou xiang zai wei lai ji xu jin xing ling yi xiang ren wu ？]

english: No, I feel I am a bit old for that kind of thing now. New times need new heroes, and I'm sure you'll always be there to answer the call!
translation: 不，我觉得我现在做这种事有点老了。新时代需要新英雄，我相信您将永远响应号召！ [bu ， wo jue de wo xian zai zuo zhe zhong shi you dian lao le 。 xin shi dai xu yao xin ying xiong ， wo xiang xin nin jiang yong yuan xiang ying hao zhao ！]

english: I'll certainly see what I can do!
translation: 我一定会看看我能做什么！ [wo yi ding hui kan kan wo neng zuo shen me ！]

english: When we finished fighting those sea trolls, you said you'd finished with adventuring, didn't you?
translation: 当我们与那些海巨魔战斗结束时，你说你已经结束了冒险，不是吗？ [dang wo men yu na xie hai ju mo zhan dou jie shu shi ， ni shuo ni yi jing jie shu le mao xian ， bu shi ma ？]

english: Yes, that's right. I'm an old man, there's no denying it, and I need a nice quiet retirement.
translation: 是的，没错。无可否认，我已经是个老人了，我需要一个安静的退休生活。 [shi de ， mei cuo 。 wu ke fou ren ， wo yi jing shi ge lao ren le ， wo xu yao yi ge an jing de tui xiu sheng huo 。]

english: Besides, I think you've proved that the new generation has its own heroes and adventurers - I should step back and let you get on with it!
translation: 此外，我认为你已经证明了新一代有自己的英雄和冒险家——我应该退后一步，让你继续下去！ [ci wai ， wo ren wei ni yi jing zheng ming liao xin yi dai you zi ji de ying xiong he mao xian jia —— wo ying gai tui hou yi bu ， rang ni ji xu xia qu ！]

english: Does this mean you're not going to do any more big robberies?
translation: 这是否意味着你不会再进行大抢劫了？ [zhe shi fou yi wei zhe ni bu hui zai jin xing da qiang jie le ？]

english: Well, since you saved my life when we were fighting the Sea Troll Queen, I don't mind telling you... I trust you won't tell anyone about this?
translation: 好吧，既然我们在与海巨魔女王战斗时你救了我的命，我不介意告诉你……我相信你不会告诉任何人这件事？ [hao ba ， ji ran wo men zai yu hai ju mo nv wang zhan dou shi ni jiu le wo de ming ， wo bu jie yi gao su ni …… wo xiang xin ni bu hui gao su ren he ren zhe jian shi ？]

english: Go on...
translation: 继续... [ji xu ...]

english: I might just have something in mind. After all, that little bank incident went very smoothly.
translation: 我可能只是有一些想法。毕竟那次银行小事件进行得很顺利。 [wo ke neng zhi shi you yi xie xiang fa 。 bi jing na ci yin hang xiao shi jian jin xing de hen shun li 。]

english: But you're retired!
translation: 但你已经退休了！ [dan ni yi jing tui xiu le ！]

english: I retired from adventuring and questing. The episode in the bank was hardly a quest, more like a shopping trip!
translation: 我从冒险和探索中退休了。银行里的那段经历根本不是一次探索，更像是一次购物之旅！ [wo cong mao xian he tan suo zhong tui xiu le 。 yin hang li de na duan jing li gen ben bu shi yi ci tan suo ， geng xiang shi yi ci gou wu zhi lv ！]

english: Your shopping trip killed 3 bank staff and several innocent bystanders, not to mention the watchman!
translation: 你的购物之旅杀死了 3 名银行工作人员和几名无辜的旁观者，更不用说看门人了！ [ni de gou wu zhi lv sha si le  3  ming yin hang gong zuo ren yuan he ji ming wu gu de pang guan zhe ， geng bu yong shuo kan men ren le ！]

english: I've saved countless villages from unspeakable terrors and slain innumerable evil monsters - surely I deserve some sort of reward in return? Yet what did I get? NOTHING!
translation: 我从难以形容的恐怖中拯救了无数的村庄，杀死了无数邪恶的怪物——我当然应该得到某种奖励吗？然而我得到了什么？没有什么！ [wo cong nan yi xing rong de kong bu zhong zheng jiu liao wu shu de cun zhuang ， sha si liao wu shu xie e de guai wu —— wo dang ran ying gai de dao mou zhong jiang li ma ？ ran er wo de dao le shen me ？ mei you shen me ！]

english: You yourself would get pretty angry if you did a long and dangerous quest and didn't get any reward from it, eh? I'm sure you would!
translation: 如果你做了一个漫长而危险的任务却没有得到任何奖励，你自己也会很生气，不是吗？我相信你会的！ [ru guo ni zuo le yi ge man chang er wei xian de ren wu que mei you de dao ren he jiang li ， ni zi ji ye hui hen sheng qi ， bu shi ma ？ wo xiang xin ni hui de ！]

english: Well imagine how I felt at the end of a long life of questing when was left penniless, and I had to move into this thief-infested village! This little shack was falling apart when I arrived!
translation: 想象一下，当我结束了漫长的探索生活后，身无分文，不得不搬进这个小偷出没的村庄时，我的感受是怎样的！当我到达时，这个小棚屋正在倒塌！ [xiang xiang yi xia ， dang wo jie shu le man chang de tan suo sheng huo hou ， shen wu fen wen ， bu de bu ban jin zhe ge xiao tou chu mo de cun zhuang shi ， wo de gan shou shi zen yang de ！ dang wo dao da shi ， zhe ge xiao peng wu zheng zai dao ta ！]

english: You go speak to that hag who keeps looking through my window - she'll show you how it used to look before I could afford to redecorate it!
translation: 你去和那个一直透过我的窗户往外看的女巫谈谈——她会告诉你在我有能力重新装修它之前它以前是什么样子！ [ni qu he na ge yi zhi tou guo wo de chuang hu wang wai kan de nv wu tan tan —— ta hui gao su ni zai wo you neng li chong xin zhuang xiu ta zhi qian ta yi qian shi shen me yang zi ！]

english: Being noble and virtuous simply doesn't put food on the table, and I don't intend to sit in banks begging like so many people do these days.
translation: 高尚的道德并不能解决餐桌上的饭菜，我也不打算像现在很多人那样坐在银行里乞讨。 [gao shang de dao de bing bu neng jie jue can zhuo shang de fan cai ， wo ye bu da suan xiang xian zai hen duo ren na yang zuo zai yin hang li qi tao 。]

english: So all those quests in the past, when you saved people from monsters and stuff like that... You only helped them because you wanted a reward?
translation: 所以过去所有的任务，当你从怪物手中救人之类的时候……你帮助他们只是因为你想要奖励？ [suo yi guo qu suo you de ren wu ， dang ni cong guai wu shou zhong jiu ren zhi lei de shi hou …… ni bang zhu ta men zhi shi yin wei ni xiang yao jiang li ？]

english: No, it wasn't always like that. I used to be satisfied just knowing that I'd helped, and that was reward enough.
translation: 不，情况并不总是这样。我过去只要知道自己帮了忙就很满足了，这已经足够了。 [bu ， qing kuang bing bu zong shi zhe yang 。 wo guo qu zhi yao zhi dao zi ji bang le mang jiu hen man zu le ， zhe yi jing zu gou le 。]

english: But eventually I realised that people forgot about me as soon as the danger was gone, and I wasn't even getting paid properly for my services. Sometimes they offered training in the various skills, but that's no use to me!
translation: 但最终我意识到，一旦危险消失，人们就忘记了我，而且我什至没有因为我的服务而得到适当的报酬。有时他们会提供各种技能的培训，但这对我来说没有用！ [dan zui zhong wo yi shi dao ， yi dan wei xian xiao shi ， ren men jiu wang ji le wo ， er qie wo shen zhi mei you yin wei wo de fu wu er de dao shi dang de bao chou 。 you shi ta men hui ti gong ge zhong ji neng de pei xun ， dan zhe dui wo lai shuo mei you yong ！]

english: I eventually realised that the only way I could get a proper reward for my life's efforts is if I took the reward myself. So I took up my cape and staff and headed for the bank.
translation: 我最终意识到，我一生的努力能够得到适当奖励的唯一方法就是我自己接受奖励。于是我拿起斗篷和手杖，向银行走去。 [wo zui zhong yi shi dao ， wo yi sheng de nu li neng gou de dao shi dang jiang li de wei yi fang fa jiu shi wo zi ji jie shou jiang li 。 yu shi wo na qi dou peng he shou zhang ， xiang yin hang zou qu 。]

english: And now you're planning to do another robbery? Didn't you get enough from the bank?
translation: 现在你又打算再抢劫一次吗？你从银行取的钱还不够多吗？ [xian zai ni you da suan zai qiang jie yi ci ma ？ ni cong yin hang qu de qian hai bu gou duo ma ？]

english: Perhaps not... But enough of this matter! Is there anything else you'd like to ask?
translation: 也许不是……但这件事已经够了！您还有什么想问的吗？ [ye xu bu shi …… dan zhe jian shi yi jing gou le ！ nin hai you shen me xiang wen de ma ？]

english: Humph! You could at least say hello before waving your items in my face.
translation: 哼!在向我面前挥舞你的物品之前，你至少可以打个招呼。 [heng ! zai xiang wo mian qian hui wu ni de wu pin zhi qian ， ni zhi shao ke yi da ge zhao hu 。]

english: Do you think I need to keep this?
translation: 你认为我需要保留这个吗？ [ni ren wei wo xu yao bao liu zhe ge ma ？]

english: I suppose you could use that in combat.
translation: 我想你可以在战斗中使用它。 [wo xiang ni ke yi zai zhan dou zhong shi yong ta 。]

english: Thanks, old man.
translation: 谢谢，老头。 [xie xie ， lao tou 。]

english: I suppose you could use that for defense.
translation: 我想你可以用它来防御。 [wo xiang ni ke yi yong ta lai fang yu 。]

english: Runes are very useful things, but I'll take some of those off your hands for you.
translation: 符文是非常有用的东西，但我会替你从你手上拿走一些。 [fu wen shi fei chang you yong de dong xi ， dan wo hui ti ni cong ni shou shang na zou yi xie 。]

english: Ooh, runes? Yes, they're quite valuable.
translation: 哦，符文？是的，它们非常有价值。 [o ， fu wen ？ shi de ， ta men fei chang you jia zhi 。]

english: That's called 'money'. Money is fantastically important if you haven't got enough of it, but when you've got as much as I have, you realise that money doesn't matter.
translation: 这就是所谓的“钱”。如果你没有足够的钱，钱就非常重要，但是当你拥有像我一样多的钱时，你就会意识到钱并不重要。 [zhe jiu shi suo wei de “ qian ”。 ru guo ni mei you zu gou de qian ， qian jiu fei chang zhong yao ， dan shi dang ni yong you xiang wo yi yang duo de qian shi ， ni jiu hui yi shi dao qian bing bu zhong yao 。]

english: Right...
translation: 正确的... [zheng que de ...]

english: That's mine. I'll take it back, thank you very much!
translation: 那是我的。我会收回它，非常感谢！ [na shi wo de 。 wo hui shou hui ta ， fei chang gan xie ！]

english: How did you get your hands on that?!
translation: 你是怎么得到它的？ [ni shi zen me de dao ta de ？]

english: Get out of here this instant.
translation: 立刻离开这里。 [li ke li kai zhe li 。]

english: Tell you what, rather than you showing me items individually, I'll look through all your possessions to see if I can find anything worth discarding.
translation: 告诉你吧，我不会单独向我展示物品，而是会检查你所有的物品，看看是否能找到任何值得丢弃的东西。 [gao su ni ba ， wo bu hui dan du xiang wo zhan shi wu pin ， er shi hui jian cha ni suo you de wu pin ， kan kan shi fou neng zhao dao ren he zhi de diu qi de dong xi 。]

english: It'd be politer to come and talk to me before you start messing around with my possessions!
translation: 在你开始乱动我的东西之前先来和我谈谈会更有礼貌！ [zai ni kai shi luan dong wo de dong xi zhi qian xian lai he wo tan tan hui geng you li mao ！]

english: I see you've got your telescope pointing at the Wizards' Tower.
translation: 我看到你的望远镜对准了巫师塔。 [wo kan dao ni de wang yuan jing dui zhun le wu shi ta 。]

english: Oh, do I? Well, why does that interest you?
translation: 哦，是吗？那么，为什么你对此感兴趣？ [o ， shi ma ？ na me ， wei shen me ni dui ci gan xing qu ？]

english: It just seems a bit odd.
translation: 只是看起来有点奇怪。 [zhi shi kan qi lai you dian qi guai 。]

english: Odd? There's nothing odd about a fascination with the magical arts. Besides, the architecture of that Tower is truly remarkable, for one who studies such things.
translation: 奇怪的？对魔法艺术的迷恋并没有什么奇怪的。此外，对于研究此类事物的人来说，这座塔的建筑确实非常了不起。 [qi guai de ？ dui mo fa yi shu de mi lian bing mei you shen me qi guai de 。 ci wai ， dui yu yan jiu ci lei shi wu de ren lai shuo ， zhe zuo ta de jian zhu que shi fei chang liao bu qi 。]

english: So you're not planning to attack the Tower?
translation: 所以你不打算攻击塔楼？ [suo yi ni bu da suan gong ji ta lou ？]

english: No, I wouldn't dream of doing anything of the sort!
translation: 不，我不会梦想做这样的事！ [bu ， wo bu hui meng xiang zuo zhe yang de shi ！]

english: Hmmm...
Well, you robbed a bank, and I bet you're now planning something to do with that Tower!
translation: 好吧，你抢劫了一家银行，我敢打赌你现在正在计划与那座塔有关！ [hao ba ， ni qiang jie le yi jia yin hang ， wo gan da du ni xian zai zheng zai ji hua yu na zuo ta you guan ！]

english: No, no. I'm not planning anything like that again.
translation: 不，不。我不会再计划类似的事情了。 [bu ， bu 。 wo bu hui zai ji hua lei si de shi qing le 。]

english: Well I'll be watching you...
translation: 嗯，我会看着你的…… [n ， wo hui kan zhe ni de ……]

english: Oh, he's not here.
translation: 哦，他不在这里。 [o ， ta bu zai zhe li 。]

english: Well, this is rather embarrassing, but I think there's some kind of monster in my house. Could you go upstairs and get rid of it, please?
translation: 嗯，这有点尴尬，但我觉得我家里有某种怪物。请你上楼把它处理掉好吗？ [n ， zhe you dian gan ga ， dan wo jue de wo jia li you mou zhong guai wu 。 qing ni shang lou ba ta chu li diao hao ma ？]

english: Where do I need to go?
translation: 我需要去哪里？ [wo xu yao qu na li ？]

english: I think it's somewhere upstairs. It kept me awake all last night.
translation: 我想它在楼上的某个地方。它让我昨晚彻夜难眠。 [wo xiang ta zai lou shang de mou ge di fang 。 ta rang wo zuo wan che ye nan mian 。]

english: Right, I'll see you later.
translation: 好的，稍后见。 [hao de ， shao hou jian 。]

english: I need some bronze bars. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我需要一些青铜棒。请带我[#]。 [wo xu yao yi xie qing tong bang 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: Where can I get that?
translation: 我在哪里可以得到那个？ [wo zai na li ke yi de dao na ge ？]

english: Mine some copper ore and tin ore. The furnace in Lumbridge can smelt them into bars of bronze.
translation: 开采一些铜矿石和锡矿石。伦布里奇的熔炉可以将它们熔炼成青铜条。 [kai cai yi xie tong kuang shi he xi kuang shi 。 lun bu li qi de rong lu ke yi jiang ta men rong lian cheng qing tong tiao 。]

english: I need a few bronze daggers to keep the goblins at bay. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我需要几把青铜匕首来阻止妖精。请带我[#]。 [wo xu yao ji ba qing tong bi shou lai zu zhi yao jing 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: I'd like some maces made of bronze. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我想要一些青铜制的狼牙​​棒。请带我[#]。 [wo xiang yao yi xie qing tong zhi de lang ya ​​ bang 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: I need a few bronze arrowheads to complete some arrows I was making. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我需要一些青铜箭头来完成我正在制作的一些箭头。请带我[#]。 [wo xu yao yi xie qing tong jian tou lai wan cheng wo zheng zai zhi zuo de yi xie jian tou 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: I'd like some bronze knives to throw at goblins. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我想要一些青铜刀来扔妖精。请带我[#]。 [wo xiang yao yi xie qing tong dao lai reng yao jing 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: My weapons collection isn't all it used to be. Some short swords made of bronze would be much appreciated. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我的武器收藏不再是以前的样子了。一些青铜制成的短剑将不胜感激。请带我[#]。 [wo de wu qi shou cang bu zai shi yi qian de yang zi le 。 yi xie qing tong zhi cheng de duan jian jiang bu sheng gan ji 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: The head fell off my axe when I was chopping wood last week, so I need some more bronze axes. Please bring me [#].
translation: 上周我砍柴时，斧头从我的斧头上掉了下来，所以我需要更多的青铜斧头。请带我[#]。 [shang zhou wo kan chai shi ， fu tou cong wo de fu tou shang diao le xia lai ， suo yi wo xu yao geng duo de qing tong fu tou 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: Could you fetch me some big warhammers made of bronze? Please bring me [#].
translation: 你能给我拿一些青铜制成的大战锤吗？请带我[#]。 [ni neng gei wo na yi xie qing tong zhi cheng de da zhan chui ma ？ qing dai wo [#]。]

english: I could do with some medium-sized helmets. I'd like bronze ones. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我可以戴一些中型头盔。我想要青铜的。请带我[#]。 [wo ke yi dai yi xie zhong xing tou kui 。 wo xiang yao qing tong de 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: I need some lengths of bronze wire to repair something. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我需要一些青铜线来修理东西。请带我[#]。 [wo xu yao yi xie qing tong xian lai xiu li dong xi 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: Try smelting some copper and tin ore to make bronze. Then hammer the bronze on an anvil to make [daggers/maces/arrowheads/throwing knives/short swords/axes/warhammers/helmets/wire].
translation: 尝试熔炼一些铜矿和锡矿来制造青铜。然后在铁砧上锤击青铜，制成[匕首/狼牙棒/箭头/飞刀/短剑/斧头/战锤/头盔/金属丝]。 [chang shi rong lian yi xie tong kuang he xi kuang lai zhi zao qing tong 。 ran hou zai tie zhen shang chui ji qing tong ， zhi cheng [ bi shou / lang ya bang / jian tou / fei dao / duan jian / fu tou / zhan chui / tou kui / jin shu si ]。]

english: I need some iron bars. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我需要一些铁棍。请带我[#]。 [wo xu yao yi xie tie gun 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: Mine some iron ore. The furnace in Lumbridge can smelt them into bars of iron.
translation: 开采一些铁矿石。伦布里奇的熔炉可以将它们熔炼成铁条。 [kai cai yi xie tie kuang shi 。 lun bu li qi de rong lu ke yi jiang ta men rong lian cheng tie tiao 。]

english: I need some iron arrowheads to put on the arrows I was making. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我需要一些铁箭头来装在我正在制作的箭头上。请带我[#]。 [wo xu yao yi xie tie jian tou lai zhuang zai wo zheng zai zhi zuo de jian tou shang 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: I could do with some iron throwing knives to keep the goblins away from my house. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我可以用一些铁制飞刀来阻止妖精靠近我的房子。请带我[#]。 [wo ke yi yong yi xie tie zhi fei dao lai zu zhi yao jing kao jin wo de fang zi 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: I'd like some chunky iron warhammers. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我想要一些粗铁战锤。请带我[#]。 [wo xiang yao yi xie cu tie zhan chui 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: Some iron maces would be useful. Please bring me [#].
translation: 一些铁锤会很有用。请带我[#]。 [yi xie tie chui hui hen you yong 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: Try smelting some iron. Then hammer the bronze on an anvil to make [arrowtips/throwing knives/warhammers/maces].
translation: 尝试熔炼一些铁。然后将青铜锤击在铁砧上制成[箭尖/飞刀/战锤/狼牙棒]。 [chang shi rong lian yi xie tie 。 ran hou jiang qing tong chui ji zai tie zhen shang zhi cheng [ jian jian / fei dao / zhan chui / lang ya bang ]。]

english: A few lumps of iron ore would be nice. Please bring me [#].
translation: 几块铁矿石就不错了。请带我[#]。 [ji kuai tie kuang shi jiu bu cuo le 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: It should be easy enough for you to mine some iron ore.
translation: 对你来说开采一些铁矿石应该很容易。 [dui ni lai shuo kai cai yi xie tie kuang shi ying gai hen rong yi 。]

english: I've found a use for cadava berries. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我发现了卡达瓦浆果的用途。请带我[#]。 [wo fa xian le ka da wa jiang guo de yong tu 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: Just look around the woods south-west of Varrock.
translation: 只要看看瓦罗克西南部的树林就知道了。 [zhi yao kan kan wa luo ke xi nan bu de shu lin jiu zhi dao le 。]

english: The hail can be very heavy here, so I'd like a few leather cowls. Please bring me [#].
translation: 这里的冰雹可能会很大，所以我想要一些皮罩。请带我[#]。 [zhe li de bing bao ke neng hui hen da ， suo yi wo xiang yao yi xie pi zhao 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: If you get the tanner in Al Kharid to turn some cowhides into leather, you'll be able to make the cowls yourself. Buy needles & thread from the crafting shop in Al Kharid if you need any.
translation: 如果你让阿尔卡里德的制革商将一些牛皮变成皮革，你就可以自己制作兜帽。如果您需要的话，可以从阿尔卡里德的手工艺店购买针和线。 [ru guo ni rang a er ka li de de zhi ge shang jiang yi xie niu pi bian cheng pi ge ， ni jiu ke yi zi ji zhi zuo dou mao 。 ru guo nin xu yao de hua ， ke yi cong a er ka li de de shou gong yi dian gou mai zhen he xian 。]

english: Strange as it may seem, I want a lot of beer! Please bring me [#].
translation: 虽然看起来很奇怪，但我想要很多啤酒！请带我[#]。 [sui ran kan qi lai hen qi guai ， dan wo xiang yao hen duo pi jiu ！ qing dai wo [#]。]

english: There's a pub not far from here that will sell you plenty of that. Go west to Port Sarim.
translation: 离这里不远有一家酒吧，可以卖很多东西。向西前往沙里姆港。 [li zhe li bu yuan you yi jia jiu ba ， ke yi mai hen duo dong xi 。 xiang xi qian wang sha li mu gang 。]

english: I don't have a decent larder here, so I can't store food very well. Now I'm out of loaves of bread. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我这里没有像样的食品储藏室，所以我不能很好地储存食物。现在我没有面包了。请带我[#]。 [wo zhe li mei you xiang yang de shi pin chu cang shi ， suo yi wo bu neng hen hao di chu cun shi wu 。 xian zai wo mei you mian bao le 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: Mix some flour and water to make bread dough, then bake it on a cooking range.
translation: 将一些面粉和水混合制成面包面团，然后在炉灶上烘烤。 [jiang yi xie mian fen he shui hun he zhi cheng mian bao mian tuan ， ran hou zai lu zao shang hong kao 。]

english: I'll be needing a few pieces of soft leather. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我需要几块软皮革。请带我[#]。 [wo xu yao ji kuai ruan pi ge 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: There's a tanner in Al Kharid who will turn cowhides into leather.
translation: 阿尔卡里德（Al Kharid）有一位制革商，他可以将牛皮变成皮革。 [a er ka li de （Al Kharid） you yi wei zhi ge shang ， ta ke yi jiang niu pi bian cheng pi ge 。]

english: I saw an interesting bed in Karamja called a 'hammock'. It seemed to be made out of string, and I'd like some balls of wool so I can make my own. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我在卡拉姆贾看到了一张有趣的床，叫做“吊床”。它似乎是用绳子做的，我想要一些羊毛球，这样我就可以自己制作了。请带我[#]。 [wo zai ka la mu jia kan dao le yi zhang you qu de chuang ， jiao zuo “ diao chuang ”。 ta si hu shi yong sheng zi zuo de ， wo xiang yao yi xie yang mao qiu ， zhe yang wo jiu ke yi zi ji zhi zuo le 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: You can buy shears from the general store east of here. Shear some sheep, then spin the wool into balls on the spinning wheel in Lumbridge Castle.
translation: 你可以从这里东边的杂货店购买剪刀。剪羊毛，然后在朗布里奇城堡的纺车上将羊毛纺成球。 [ni ke yi cong zhe li dong bian de za huo dian gou mai jian dao 。 jian yang mao ， ran hou zai lang bu li qi cheng bao de fang che shang jiang yang mao fang cheng qiu 。]

english: It's a bit nippy in this house, and my hands are cold. I need some leather gloves. Please bring me [#].
translation: 屋子里有点冷，我的手有些冰凉。我需要一些皮手套。请带我[#]。 [wu zi li you dian leng ， wo de shou you xie bing liang 。 wo xu yao yi xie pi shou tao 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: If you get the tanner in Al Kharid to turn some cowhides into leather, you'll be able to sew the gloves yourself. Buy a needle & thread from the crafting shop in Al Kharid.
translation: 如果你让阿尔卡里德的制革商将一些牛皮变成皮革，你就可以自己缝制手套。从阿尔卡里德的手工艺店购买针和线。 [ru guo ni rang a er ka li de de zhi ge shang jiang yi xie niu pi bian cheng pi ge ， ni jiu ke yi zi ji feng zhi shou tao 。 cong a er ka li de de shou gong yi dian gou mai zhen he xian 。]

english: I'm going to make an omelette, so I'll need some eggs. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我要做煎蛋卷，所以我需要一些鸡蛋。请带我[#]。 [wo yao zuo jian dan juan ， suo yi wo xu yao yi xie ji dan 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: Eggs are usually found where chickens are farmed.
translation: 鸡蛋通常出现在养鸡的地方。 [ji dan tong chang chu xian zai yang ji de di fang 。]

english: My undergarments are getting a bit worn out. I'll be needing some sheets of silk to patch them. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我的内衣有点破旧了。我需要一些丝绸来修补它们。请带我[#]。 [wo de nei yi you dian po jiu le 。 wo xu yao yi xie si chou lai xiu bu ta men 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: There's a man in Al Kharid who sells it very cheaply. If you ever take any to Ardougne you'll get a good profit.
translation: 阿尔卡里德有一个人以非常便宜的价格出售它。如果你带任何东西去阿杜涅，你会获得丰厚的利润。 [a er ka li de you yi ge ren yi fei chang pian yi de jia ge chu shou ta 。 ru guo ni dai ren he dong xi qu a du nie ， ni hui huo de feng hou de li run 。]

english: I'll need some clay that's been softened so I can craft it. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我需要一些软化的粘土，这样我才能制作它。请带我[#]。 [wo xu yao yi xie ruan hua de nian tu ， zhe yang wo cai neng zhi zuo ta 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: If you mine some clay, you can use containers of water on it to soften it.
translation: 如果你开采一些粘土，你可以在上面放水容器来软化它。 [ru guo ni kai cai yi xie nian tu ， ni ke yi zai shang mian fang shui rong qi lai ruan hua ta 。]

english: Believe it or not, I need a few unfired clay pots. Please bring me [#].
translation: 不管你信不信，我需要一些未烧制的陶罐。请带我[#]。 [bu guan ni xin bu xin ， wo xu yao yi xie wei shao zhi de tao guan 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: Mine some clay. Then use a container full of water to soften it. In the Barbarian Village you'll be able to form this into pots. Just don't bake them.
translation: 开采一些粘土。然后用装满水的容器将其软化。在野蛮人村庄，你可以将其制成罐子。只是不要烘烤它们。 [kai cai yi xie nian tu 。 ran hou yong zhuang man shui de rong qi jiang qi ruan hua 。 zai ye man ren cun zhuang ， ni ke yi jiang qi zhi cheng guan zi 。 zhi shi bu yao hong kao ta men 。]
