english: My roof is leaking, so I need some swamp paste to fix it. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我的屋顶漏水，所以我需要一些沼泽膏来修复它。请带我[#]。 [wo de wu ding lou shui ， suo yi wo xu yao yi xie zhao ze gao lai xiu fu ta 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: Swamp tar is found south-east of here. Add it to a pot of flour and cook it on an open fire to make the paste.
translation: 沼泽焦油位于此东南部。将其加入一锅面粉中，在明火上煮成糊状。 [zhao ze jiao you wei yu ci dong nan bu 。 jiang qi jia ru yi guo mian fen zhong ， zai ming huo shang zhu cheng hu zhuang 。]

english: Potatoes
translation: 土豆 [tu dou]

english: There's a field of those north of Lumbridge.
translation: 朗布里奇以北有一片这样的田地。 [lang bu li qi yi bei you yi pian zhe yang de tian di 。]

english: I want to make some arrows, so I'll need some headless arrows that have the feathers attached. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我想制作一些箭头，所以我需要一些带有羽毛的无头箭头。请带我[#]。 [wo xiang zhi zuo yi xie jian tou ， suo yi wo xu yao yi xie dai you yu mao de wu tou jian tou 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: Use a knife to chop some logs into arrowshafts. Then add a feather to each arrowshaft.
translation: 用刀将一些原木切成箭杆。然后为每个箭杆添加一根羽毛。 [yong dao jiang yi xie yuan mu qie cheng jian gan 。 ran hou wei mei ge jian gan tian jia yi gen yu mao 。]

english: I need some bronze spears. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我需要一些青铜矛。请带我[#]。 [wo xu yao yi xie qing tong mao 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: If you kill some of those pesky goblins, you're bound to get some bronze spears.
translation: 如果你杀死了一些讨厌的妖精，你一定会得到一些青铜矛。 [ru guo ni sha si le yi xie tao yan de yao jing ， ni yi ding hui de dao yi xie qing tong mao 。]

english: My glassware got damaged when I moved here, so I need some new beer glasses. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我搬到这里时我的玻璃器皿损坏了，所以我需要一些新的啤酒杯。请带我[#]。 [wo ban dao zhe li shi wo de bo li qi min sun huai le ， suo yi wo xu yao yi xie xin de pi jiu bei 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: If you get some seaweed and a bucket of sand, you'll be able to mix them at a furnace to make molten glass. Then use a glassblowing pipe to make beer glasses. Most of what you need can be found on Entrana.
translation: 如果你有一些海藻和一桶沙子，你就可以将它们在熔炉中混合以制造熔融玻璃。然后用玻璃吹制管制作啤酒杯。您需要的大部分东西都可以在 Entrana 上找到。 [ru guo ni you yi xie hai zao he yi tong sha zi ， ni jiu ke yi jiang ta men zai rong lu zhong hun he yi zhi zao rong rong bo li 。 ran hou yong bo li chui zhi guan zhi zuo pi jiu bei 。 nin xu yao de da bu fen dong xi dou ke yi zai  Entrana  shang zhao dao 。]

english: My plans for today require some sets of bones, the normal-sized sort you get from goblins. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我今天的计划需要一些骨头，就是从妖精那里得到的正常大小的骨头。请带我[#]。 [wo jin tian de ji hua xu yao yi xie gu tou ， jiu shi cong yao jing na li de dao de zheng chang da xiao de gu tou 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: You'll find bones easily enough if you fight creatures.
translation: 如果你与生物战斗，你会很容易找到骨头。 [ru guo ni yu sheng wu zhan dou ， ni hui hen rong yi zhao dao gu tou 。]

english: Strange as this may seem, I need some unfired pie dishes. Please bring me [#].
translation: 尽管这看起来很奇怪，但我需要一些未烤的馅饼盘。请带我[#]。 [jin guan zhe kan qi lai hen qi guai ， dan wo xu yao yi xie wei kao de xian bing pan 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: Mine some clay. Then use a container full of water to soften it. In the Barbarian Village you'll be able to form this into pie dishes. Just don't bake them.
translation: 开采一些粘土。然后用装满水的容器将其软化。在野蛮人村，你可以将其制成馅饼盘。只是不要烘烤它们。 [kai cai yi xie nian tu 。 ran hou yong zhuang man shui de rong qi jiang qi ruan hua 。 zai ye man ren cun ， ni ke yi jiang qi zhi cheng xian bing pan 。 zhi shi bu yao hong kao ta men 。]

english: I hear pet cats are getting popular these days. I'd like some raw rat in case I get one. Please bring me [#].
translation: 听说最近宠物猫越来越流行了。我想要一些生老鼠，以防万一我得到一只。请带我[#]。 [ting shuo zui jin chong wu mao yue lai yue liu xing le 。 wo xiang yao yi xie sheng lao shu ， yi fang wan yi wo de dao yi zhi 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: You should find some big rats south-east of here in the swamp.
translation: 你应该在东南方的沼泽地里找到一些大老鼠。 [ni ying gai zai dong nan fang de zhao ze di li zhao dao yi xie da lao shu 。]

english: I need a few lumps of copper ore. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我需要一些铜矿石。请带我[#]。 [wo xu yao yi xie tong kuang shi 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: It should be easy enough for you to mine some copper ore.
translation: 开采一些铜矿石对你来说应该很容易。 [kai cai yi xie tong kuang shi dui ni lai shuo ying gai hen rong yi 。]

english: I'm out of flour, so I could do with a few pots of that. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我没有面粉了，所以我可以用几罐面粉。请带我[#]。 [wo mei you mian fen le ， suo yi wo ke yi yong ji guan mian fen 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: There's a windmill north of here. You can use it to grind grain into flour. Then use an empty pot to collect the flour.
translation: 这里北边有一座风车。你可以用它把谷物磨成​​面粉。然后用空锅收集面粉。 [zhe li bei bian you yi zuo feng che 。 ni ke yi yong ta ba gu wu mo cheng ​​ mian fen 。 ran hou yong kong guo shou ji mian fen 。]

english: I need a handful of feathers to stick in my beard. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我需要一把羽毛来粘在我的胡须上。请带我[#]。 [wo xu yao yi ba yu mao lai zhan zai wo de hu xu shang 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: The cheapest way to get feathers is to kill chickens.
translation: 获得羽毛最便宜的方法就是杀鸡。 [huo de yu mao zui pian yi de fang fa jiu shi sha ji 。]

english: This house is a bit cold, so I could do with some normal logs to burn. Please bring me [#].
translation: 这房子有点冷，所以我可以用一些普通的木头来烧。请带我[#]。 [zhe fang zi you dian leng ， suo yi wo ke yi yong yi xie pu tong de mu tou lai shao 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: I suggest you take an axe and chop down some standard trees.
translation: 我建议你拿一把斧子砍掉一些标准的树。 [wo jian yi ni na yi ba fu zi kan diao yi xie biao zhun de shu 。]

english: I'm running short of food, so I'd like some cooked chickens. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我的食物不够了，所以我想要一些煮熟的鸡肉。请带我[#]。 [wo de shi wu bu gou le ， suo yi wo xiang yao yi xie zhu shu de ji rou 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: You could try killing some chickens, then cooking their meat.
translation: 你可以尝试杀一些鸡，然后煮它们的肉。 [ni ke yi chang shi sha yi xie ji ， ran hou zhu ta men de rou 。]

english: My footwear is getting a bit worn out, so I need a few pairs of leather boots. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我的鞋子有点磨损了，所以我需要几双皮靴。请带我[#]。 [wo de xie zi you dian mo sun le ， suo yi wo xu yao ji shuang pi xue 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: If you get the tanner in Al Kharid to turn some cowhides into leather, you'll be able to make the boots yourself. Buy needles & thread from the crafting shop in Al Kharid if you need any.
translation: 如果你让阿尔卡里德的制革商将一些牛皮变成皮革，你就可以自己制作靴子。如果您需要的话，可以从阿尔卡里德的手工艺店购买针和线。 [ru guo ni rang a er ka li de de zhi ge shang jiang yi xie niu pi bian cheng pi ge ， ni jiu ke yi zi ji zhi zuo xue zi 。 ru guo nin xu yao de hua ， ke yi cong a er ka li de de shou gong yi dian gou mai zhen he xian 。]

english: I'd like a few cowhides. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我想要几张牛皮。请带我[#]。 [wo xiang yao ji zhang niu pi 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: If you slaughter some cows, you'll get cowhides easily enough.
translation: 如果你宰杀一些牛，你就很容易得到牛皮。 [ru guo ni zai sha yi xie niu ， ni jiu hen rong yi de dao niu pi 。]

english: My shortbow's string is getting a bit worn out, so could you fetch me some bow strings? Please bring me [#].
translation: 我的短弓的弦有点磨损了，你能给我拿一些弓弦吗？请带我[#]。 [wo de duan gong de xian you dian mo sun le ， ni neng gei wo na yi xie gong xian ma ？ qing dai wo [#]。]

english: If you pick some flax, you can use the spinning wheel in Lumbridge Castle to spin it into bowstrings.
translation: 如果您采摘了一些亚麻，则可以使用朗布里奇城堡中的纺车将其纺成弓弦。 [ru guo nin cai zhai le yi xie ya ma ， ze ke yi shi yong lang bu li qi cheng bao zhong de fang che jiang qi fang cheng gong xian 。]

english: I'm a bit hungry. I'd like some cooked meat, not chicken or any sort of bird. And definitely not camel or rabbit either! Please bring me [#].
translation: 我有点饿了。我想要一些熟肉，不要鸡肉或任何鸟类。绝对不是骆驼或兔子！请带我[#]。 [wo you dian e le 。 wo xiang yao yi xie shu rou ， bu yao ji rou huo ren he niao lei 。 jue dui bu shi luo tuo huo tu zi ！ qing dai wo [#]。]

english: Just cook some beef, rat or bear.
translation: 煮一些牛肉、老鼠或熊就可以了。 [zhu yi xie niu rou 、 lao shu huo xiong jiu ke yi le 。]

english: I'm short of ammunition, so I could do with some bronze arrows. That way I can shoot at goblins through my window. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我缺乏弹药，所以我可以用一些青铜箭。这样我就可以透过窗户向妖精射击。请带我[#]。 [wo que fa dan yao ， suo yi wo ke yi yong yi xie qing tong jian 。 zhe yang wo jiu ke yi tou guo chuang hu xiang yao jing she ji 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: You can make them by chopping a log into arrowshafts and adding feathers to them, then smithing a bronze bar into arrowheads to complete the arrows.
translation: 您可以通过将原木砍成箭杆并向其添加羽毛，然后将青铜棒锻造成箭头来完成箭头来制作它们。 [nin ke yi tong guo jiang yuan mu kan cheng jian gan bing xiang qi tian jia yu mao ， ran hou jiang qing tong bang duan zao cheng jian tou lai wan cheng jian tou lai zhi zuo ta men 。]

english: I'd like a bit of grain. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我想要一点谷物。请带我[#]。 [wo xiang yao yi dian gu wu 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: There's a field full of it north of here.
translation: 这里北边有一片田地，长满了它。 [zhe li bei bian you yi pian tian di ， zhang man le ta 。]

english: I need a few lumps of tin ore. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我需要几块锡矿石。请带我[#]。 [wo xu yao ji kuai xi kuang shi 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: You shouldn't have any trouble mining tin ore.
translation: 开采锡矿石应该不会有任何问题。 [kai cai xi kuang shi ying gai bu hui you ren he wen ti 。]

english: I could do with some freshly cooked [anchovies/shrimps] for a salad I'm planning. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我可以用一些新鲜煮熟的[凤尾鱼/虾]来做我计划的沙拉。请带我[#]。 [wo ke yi yong yi xie xin xian zhu shu de [ feng wei yu / xia ] lai zuo wo ji hua de sha la 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: Use a small fishing net to get [anchovies/shrimps] from the sea south of here. Then cook them on a fire or range.
translation: 使用小渔网从这里南部的海域获取[凤尾鱼/虾]。然后在火或炉灶上煮它们。 [shi yong xiao yu wang cong zhe li nan bu de hai yu huo qu [ feng wei yu / xia ]。 ran hou zai huo huo lu zao shang zhu ta men 。]

english: I'd like to study the rune essence that the wizards have been talking about recently, so I need a few pieces. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我想研究一下法师们最近谈论的符文精华，所以我需要几块。请带我[#]。 [wo xiang yan jiu yi xia fa shi men zui jin tan lun de fu wen jing hua ， suo yi wo xu yao ji kuai 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: Ask the Archmage in the tower south of here to teleport you to the Rune Essence mine. Then you can mine me some pieces.
translation: 请南边塔楼里的大法师将你传送到符文精华矿井。然后你可以给我开采一些碎片。 [qing nan bian ta lou li de da fa shi jiang ni chuan song dao fu wen jing hua kuang jing 。 ran hou ni ke yi gei wo kai cai yi xie sui pian 。]

english: Some chunks of molten glass would be the ideal patch for my cracked window. Please bring me [#].
translation: 一些熔化的玻璃块可以作为我破裂的窗户的理想修补剂。请带我[#]。 [yi xie rong hua de bo li kuai ke yi zuo wei wo po lie de chuang hu de li xiang xiu bu ji 。 qing dai wo [#]。]

english: Use a bucket of sand with some soda ash on a furnace.
translation: 在炉子上使用一桶沙子和一些苏打灰。 [zai lu zi shang shi yong yi tong sha zi he yi xie su da hui 。]

english: Greetings, [player].
translation: 你好，[玩家]。 [ni hao ，[ wan jia ]。]

english: I've killed a creature that was under your bed.
translation: 我杀死了你床底下的一个生物。 [wo sha si le ni chuang di xia de yi ge sheng wu 。]

english: Ah, thank you very much! Now I shall be able to sleep in peace.
translation: 啊，非常感谢！现在我可以安心睡觉了。 [a ， fei chang gan xie ！ xian zai wo ke yi an xin shui jiao le 。]

english: Allow me to offer you an appropriate reward for your assistance...
translation: 请允许我为你的帮助提供适当的奖励...... [qing yun xu wo wei ni de bang zhu ti gong shi dang de jiang li ......]

english: I've got some of the stuff you wanted.
translation: 我这里有一些你想要的东西。 [wo zhe li you yi xie ni xiang yao de dong xi 。]

english: Ahh, you are very kind.
translation: 啊，你真是太善良了。 [a ， ni zhen shi tai shan liang le 。]

english: I'll come back when I've got the rest.
translation: 等我休息完了我就回来。 [deng wo xiu xi wan le wo jiu hui lai 。]

english: I've got all the stuff you asked me to fetch.
translation: 你让我去拿的所有东西我都已经拿到了。 [ni rang wo qu na de suo you dong xi wo dou yi jing na dao le 。]

english: Thank you, thank you! In thanks, I shall bestow on you a simple blessing.
translation: 谢谢你，谢谢你！为了表达谢意，我给你一个简单的祝福。 [xie xie ni ， xie xie ni ！ wei le biao da xie yi ， wo gei ni yi ge jian dan de zhu fu 。]

english: Thank you, thank you! Please take this money as a sign of my gratitude.
translation: 谢谢你，谢谢你！请收下这笔钱以表达我的谢意。 [xie xie ni ， xie xie ni ！ qing shou xia zhe bi qian yi biao da wo de xie yi 。]

english: Thank you, thank you! Please take these seeds as a sign of my gratitude.

translation: 你好亲爱的。别担心，我很友善。 [ni hao qin ai de 。 bie dan xin ， wo hen you shan 。]

english: You look very familiar but I can't remember chatting to you before.
translation: 你看起来很面熟，但我不记得以前和你聊天过。 [ni kan qi lai hen mian shu ， dan wo bu ji de yi qian he ni liao tian guo 。]

english: Well, my sisters used to live here but folk kept on killing them. A terrible affair, it was. I knew that no one would want to kill a chatty old dear like me, though.
translation: 嗯，我的姐妹们曾经住在这里，但人们不断地杀害她们。这是一件可怕的事情。不过，我知道没有人会想杀死像我这样健谈的老亲爱的。 [n ， wo de jie mei men ceng jing zhu zai zhe li ， dan ren men bu duan di sha hai ta men 。 zhe shi yi jian ke pa de shi qing 。 bu guo ， wo zhi dao mei you ren hui xiang sha si xiang wo zhe yang jian tan de lao qin ai de 。]

english: Oh, well...
translation: 那好吧... [na hao ba ...]

english: We still have a problem with local louts, though. Poisoning my fish, spilling my compost all over the place and causing a nuisance for the dear count.
translation: 不过，我们仍然面临着当地粗鲁的问题。毒害了我的鱼，把堆肥撒得到处都是，给亲爱的伯爵带来了麻烦。 [bu guo ， wo men reng ran mian lin zhe dang di cu lu de wen ti 。 du hai le wo de yu ， ba dui fei sa de dao chu dou shi ， gei qin ai de bo jue dai lai le ma fan 。]

english: I think...
translation: 我认为... [wo ren wei ...]

english: I'm sure a nice young sort like you won't be any trouble, though. In any case, the Professor will soon share the secret of chickenisation with me... Not that I'd use it these days of course.
translation: 不过，我确信像你这样的好年轻人不会有任何麻烦。无论如何，教授很快就会与我分享鸡肉化的秘密……当然，我现在不会使用它。 [bu guo ， wo que xin xiang ni zhe yang de hao nian qing ren bu hui you ren he ma fan 。 wu lun ru he ， jiao shou hen kuai jiu hui yu wo fen xiang ji rou hua de mi mi …… dang ran ， wo xian zai bu hui shi yong ta 。]

english: I have to go now.
translation: 我现在得走了。 [wo xian zai de zou le 。]

english: Hello my ickle...oh, it's you. What do you want?
translation: 你好，我的小家伙……哦，是你。你想要什么？ [ni hao ， wo de xiao jia huo …… o ， shi ni 。 ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: I wondered whether you had anything interesting to say.
translation: 我想知道你是否有什么有趣的话要说。 [wo xiang zhi dao ni shi fou you shen me you qu de hua yao shuo 。]

english: Clearly not.
translation: 显然不是。 [xian ran bu shi 。]

english: Great, you'll go far! I made some nice painted metal toys for you, snookums.
translation: 太好了，你会走得很远！我为你做了一些漂亮的彩绘金属玩具，斯努库姆。 [tai hao le ， ni hui zou de hen yuan ！ wo wei ni zuo le yi xie piao liang de cai hui jin shu wan ju ， si nu ku mu 。]

english: Toys? Snookums? What are you on about, you deranged old bat?
translation: 玩具？斯努库姆？你在胡说什么啊，你这个疯狂的老蝙蝠？ [wan ju ？ si nu ku mu ？ ni zai hu shuo shen me a ， ni zhe ge feng kuang de lao bian fu ？]

english: Oh, forget it, then. If you won't react to kindness, I'm back to luring infants into my oven. You'll have it on your conscience.
translation: 哦，那就忘了吧。如果你不肯做出善意的反应，我就会再次引诱婴儿进入我的烤箱。你会问心无愧的。 [o ， na jiu wang le ba 。 ru guo ni bu ken zuo chu shan yi de fan ying ， wo jiu hui zai ci yin you ying er jin ru wo de kao xiang 。 ni hui wen xin wu kui de 。]

english: Go to the iron mine just north-east of Rimmington and hit the bar with a plain old smithing hammer while facing north. Then take your new magnet to Ava. Poor girl, having to deal with whippersnappers like you.
translation: 前往里明顿东北部的铁矿，面朝北方，用一把普通的旧铁匠锤敲击吧台。然后把你的新磁铁带到艾娃那里。可怜的女孩，不得不面对像你这样的自吹自擂者。 [qian wang li ming dun dong bei bu de tie kuang ， mian chao bei fang ， yong yi ba pu tong de jiu tie jiang chui qiao ji ba tai 。 ran hou ba ni de xin ci tie dai dao ai wa na li 。 ke lian de nv hai ， bu de bu mian dui xiang ni zhe yang de zi chui zi lei zhe 。]

english: Miaoww
translation: 喵呜 [miao wu]

english: Sssss! Thou art brave to wander so far into the domain of Kardia, mine mistress!
translation: 嘶嘶！我的女主人，你竟然敢闯入卡迪亚的领地，真是勇敢！ [si si ！ wo de nv zhu ren ， ni jing ran gan chuang ru ka di ya de ling di ， zhen shi yong gan ！]

english: But soon thou shalt become a soulless servant of Lord Iban, like all who come here.
translation: 但很快你就会像所有来到这里的人一样，成为伊班勋爵的一个没有灵魂的仆人。 [dan hen kuai ni jiu hui xiang suo you lai dao zhe li de ren yi yang ， cheng wei yi ban xun jue de yi ge mei you ling hun de pu ren 。]

english: Glad shall mine heart be when I see thee prostrate thineself before the altars of Zamorak the Mighty.
translation: 当我看到你俯伏在全能者萨莫拉克的祭坛前时，我的心会很高兴。 [dang wo kan dao ni fu fu zai quan neng zhe sa mo la ke de ji tan qian shi ， wo de xin hui hen gao xing 。]

english: No milk for you, puss!
translation: 没有牛奶给你，小猫！ [mei you niu nai gei ni ， xiao mao ！]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: What have you got to be so cheerful about?
translation: 你有什么事这么高兴？ [ni you shen me shi zhe me gao xing ？]

english: Well, it's another nice day.
translation: 嗯，又是美好的一天。 [n ， you shi mei hao de yi tian 。]

english: Ha! Try worrying about how you feed a family with no job. Then tell me how nice the day is!
translation: 哈!尝试担心一下如何养活没有工作的家庭。然后告诉我今天有多好！ [ha ! chang shi dan xin yi xia ru he yang huo mei you gong zuo de jia ting 。 ran hou gao su wo jin tian you duo hao ！]

english: Okay, I guess I've caught you at a bad time. Goodbye.
translation: 好吧，我想我来得不是时候。再见。 [hao ba ， wo xiang wo lai de bu shi shi hou 。 zai jian 。]

english: Hmm? Oh, hello there.
translation: 唔？哦，你好。 [wu ？ o ， ni hao 。]

english: Are you okay? You seem a bit preoccupied.
translation: 你还好吗？你看起来有点心不在焉。 [ni hai hao ma ？ ni kan qi lai you dian xin bu zai yan 。]

english: It's nothing stranger. No need to concern yourself.
translation: 这并不奇怪。无需担心自己。 [zhe bing bu qi guai 。 wu xu dan xin zi ji 。]

english: Spare a coin mister?
translation: 留个硬币先生吗？ [liu ge ying bi xian sheng ma ？]

english: What do you need it for?
translation: 你需要它做什么？ [ni xu yao ta zuo shen me ？]

english: For a poor unemployed fisherman what needs to eat.
translation: 对于一个贫穷的失业渔民来说，需要吃什么。 [dui yu yi ge pin qiong de shi ye yu min lai shuo ， xu yao chi shen me 。]

english: Why don't you just fish for some food?
translation: 你为什么不去钓鱼吃点东西呢？ [ni wei shen me bu qu diao yu chi dian dong xi ne ？]

english: Err... Goodbye mister.
translation: 呃……再见，先生。 [e …… zai jian ， xian sheng 。]

english: Can you believe they did this to us?
translation: 你能相信他们这样对我们吗？ [ni neng xiang xin ta men zhe yang dui wo men ma ？]

english: Wha...
translation: 世界卫生大会... [shi jie wei sheng da hui ...]

english: I mean, what did they think would happen?
translation: 我的意思是，他们认为会发生什么？ [wo de yi si shi ， ta men ren wei hui fa sheng shen me ？]

english: Who...
translation: WHO... [WHO...]

english: Building that whacking great Fishing Platform just off the coast.
translation: 在海岸附近建造那个巨大的钓鱼平台。 [zai hai an fu jin jian zao na ge ju da de diao yu ping tai 。]

english: Fish...
Dratted thing stole all of our trade.
translation: 这个讨厌的东西偷走了我们所有的生意。 [zhe ge tao yan de dong xi tou zou le wo men suo you de sheng yi 。]

english: Excuse...
translation: 原谅... [yuan liang ...]

english: I'm sorry, I'm too angry to speak right now. Goodbye
translation: 对不起，我现在气得说不出话来。再见 [dui bu qi ， wo xian zai qi de shuo bu chu hua lai 。 zai jian]

english: With our nets and gear we're faring,
translation: 带着我们的网和装备，我们正在前行， [dai zhe wo men de wang he zhuang bei ， wo men zheng zai qian xing ，]

english: On the wild and wasteful ocean,
translation: 在狂野而荒废的海洋上， [zai kuang ye er huang fei de hai yang shang ，]

english: It's there on the deep that we harvest and reap our bread,
translation: 正是在那里，我们收获并收获面包， [zheng shi zai na li ， wo men shou huo bing shou huo mian bao ，]

english: As we hunt the bonny shoals of herring.
translation: 当我们捕猎美丽的鲱鱼群时。 [dang wo men bu lie mei li de fei yu qun shi 。]

english: That's a lovely song.
translation: 那是一首可爱的歌。 [na shi yi shou ke ai de ge 。]

english: Aye lad, and sing it every day we did.
translation: 是的，小伙子，我们每天都唱这首歌。 [shi de ， xiao huo zi ， wo men mei tian dou chang zhe shou ge 。]

english: 'Till the Fishing Platform came and ruined everything.
translation: 直到钓鱼台来了，毁掉了一切。 [zhi dao diao yu tai lai le ， hui diao le yi qie 。]

english: Oh, I'm sorry.
translation: 哦，对不起。 [o ， dui bu qi 。]

english: No need lad, it not be your fault.
translation: 不用了，小伙子，这不是你的错。 [bu yong le ， xiao huo zi ， zhe bu shi ni de cuo 。]

english: Their eyes are staring vacantly into space.
translation: 他们的眼睛茫然地凝视着太空。 [ta men de yan jing mang ran di ning shi zhe tai kong 。]

english: Ye mariners all, as ye pass by,
translation: 各位水手们，当你们经过时， [ge wei shui shou men ， dang ni men jing guo shi ，]

english: Come in and drink if you are dry,
translation: 干了就进来喝吧 [gan le jiu jin lai he ba]

english: Come spend, me lads, your money brisk,
translation: 来吧，小伙子们，你们的钱很活跃， [lai ba ， xiao huo zi men ， ni men de qian hen huo yue ，]

english: And pop your nose in a jug of this.
translation: 把你的鼻子伸进一个罐子里。 [ba ni de bi zi shen jin yi ge guan zi li 。]

english: You're not fooling anyone you know.
translation: 你不会欺骗任何你认识的人。 [ni bu hui qi pian ren he ni ren shi de ren 。]

english: We fooled you easily enough.
translation: 我们很容易就愚弄了你。 [wo men hen rong yi jiu yu nong le ni 。]

english: Free. She is free...
translation: 自由的。她是自由的…… [zi you de 。 ta shi zi you de ……]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: The mother is free.
translation: 母亲是自由的。 [mu qin shi zi you de 。]

english: You! You did it!
translation: 你！你做到了！ [ni ！ ni zuo dao le ！]

english: I didn't mean to!
translation: 我不是故意的！ [wo bu shi gu yi de ！]

english: You killed him!
translation: 你杀了他！ [ni sha le ta ！]

english: It was an accide... Killed who?
translation: 这是一次意外……杀了谁？ [zhe shi yi ci yi wai …… sha le shui ？]

english: Our Prince, you killed our Prince.
translation: 我们的王子，你杀了我们的王子。 [wo men de wang zi ， ni sha le wo men de wang zi 。]

english: Oh that, yes I did.
translation: 哦，是的，我做到了。 [o ， shi de ， wo zuo dao le 。]

english: Leave us alone.
translation: 别管我们了。 [bie guan wo men le 。]

english: Soon now... So soon...
translation: 很快...很快... [hen kuai ... hen kuai ...]

english: The stars are almost right.
translation: 星星几乎是对的。 [xing xing ji hu shi dui de 。]

english: For what?
translation: 为了什么？ [wei le shen me ？]

english: Ahh, our saviour.
translation: 啊，我们的救世主。 [a ， wo men de jiu shi zhu 。]

english: Please don't remind me.
translation: 请不要提醒我。 [qing bu yao ti xing wo 。]

english: Do not worry, soon your regret will be gone.
translation: 别担心，很快你的遗憾就会消失。 [bie dan xin ， hen kuai ni de yi han jiu hui xiao shi 。]

english: If you think you will get to me...
translation: 如果你认为你会来找我的话... [ru guo ni ren wei ni hui lai zhao wo de hua ...]

english: All in good time.
translation: 一切都恰逢其时。 [yi qie dou qia feng qi shi 。]

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I've heard there is a powerful magic presence in these lands, I'm gathering notes to take back with me to the Wizards' Tower.
translation: 我听说这些土地上有一种强大的魔法存在，我正在收集笔记带回巫师塔。 [wo ting shuo zhe xie tu di shang you yi zhong qiang da de mo fa cun zai ， wo zheng zai shou ji bi ji dai hui wu shi ta 。]

english: What are you doing?
translation: 你在干什么？ [ni zai gan shen me ？]

english: When we heard of a magical presence in the Western lands, the Wizards' Tower had no choice but to send out a research party.
translation: 当听说西方大陆有魔法存在时，巫师塔无奈派出了一支研究队。 [dang ting shuo xi fang da lu you mo fa cun zai shi ， wu shi ta wu nai pai chu le yi zhi yan jiu dui 。]

english: Learned anything interesting?
translation: 学到了什么有趣的东西吗？ [xue dao le shen me you qu de dong xi ma ？]

english: Some of these texts describe a 'Dark Altar', one can only imagine what power it possesses.
translation: 其中一些文字描述了一座‘黑暗祭坛’，人们只能想象它拥有怎样的力量。 [qi zhong yi xie wen zi miao shu le yi zuo ‘ hei an ji tan ’， ren men zhi neng xiang xiang ta yong you zen yang de li liang 。]

english: The beings here seem to have transcended beyond the corporeal realm, truly fascinating!
translation: 这里的生物仿佛已经超越了物质境界，真是令人着迷！ [zhe li de sheng wu fang fu yi jing chao yue le wu zhi jing jie ， zhen shi ling ren zhao mi ！]

english: A casual game will start in the next [60 - 5x] seconds!
translation: 休闲游戏将在接下来的 [60 - 5x] 秒内开始！ [xiu xian you xi jiang zai jie xia lai de  [60 - 5x]  miao nei kai shi ！]

english: A casual game is starting!
translation: 一场休闲游戏即将开始！ [yi chang xiu xian you xi ji jiang kai shi ！]

english: Why are all of you standing around here?
translation: 为什么你们都站在这里？ [wei shen me ni men dou zhan zai zhe li ？]

english: Hahaha you dare talk to a mighty wizard such as myself? I bet you can't even cast windstrike yet amateur!
translation: 哈哈哈，你敢和我这样强大的巫师说话吗？我敢打赌你连风击都不会施展，还是个业余爱好者！ [ha ha ha ， ni gan he wo zhe yang qiang da de wu shi shuo hua ma ？ wo gan da du ni lian feng ji dou bu hui shi zhan ， hai shi ge ye yu ai hao zhe ！]

translation: ……你是个白痴。 […… ni shi ge bai chi 。]

translation: 找到那个妖精了吗？ [zhao dao na ge yao jing le ma ？]

english: Hahaha go away amateur! You're not worthy of joining our great group!
translation: 哈哈哈业余的走开！你不配加入我们这个伟大的集体！ [ha ha ha ye yu de zou kai ！ ni bu pei jia ru wo men zhe ge wei da de ji ti ！]

english: ...right.
translation: ...正确的。 [... zheng que de 。]

english: Hahaha you're such an amateur!
translation: 哈哈哈，你真是业余啊！ [ha ha ha ， ni zhen shi ye yu a ！]

english: Go away and play with some cabbage amateur!
translation: 去和一些卷心菜爱好者一起玩吧！ [qu he yi xie juan xin cai ai hao zhe yi qi wan ba ！]

english: All's well that ends well.
translation: 一切都好，结局好。 [yi qie dou hao ， jie ju hao 。]

english: I've got some questions about the search for evidence.
translation: 我对寻找证据有一些疑问。 [wo dui xun zhao zheng ju you yi xie yi wen 。]

english: You'll have to speak to the Watchtower Wizard about that.
translation: 你必须和瞭望塔巫师谈谈这件事。 [ni bi xu he liao wang ta wu shi tan tan zhe jian shi 。]

english: I've got some questions regarding the tribal ogres.
translation: 我有一些关于部落食人魔的问题。 [wo you yi xie guan yu bu luo shi ren mo de wen ti 。]

english: Who are you? Get out of here, I don't have anything for you.
translation: 你是谁？滚出去吧，我没有什么可以给你的。 [ni shi shui ？ gun chu qu ba ， wo mei you shen me ke yi gei ni de 。]

english: You must have completed The Hand in the Sand to use the Guild's shop.
translation: 您必须完成沙中之手才能使用公会商店。 [nin bi xu wan cheng sha zhong zhi shou cai neng shi yong gong hui shang dian 。]

english: I don't know if I can trust you with any of my supplies...
translation: 我不知道我是否可以把我的物资托付给你...... [wo bu zhi dao wo shi fou ke yi ba wo de wu zi tuo fu gei ni ......]

english: Welcome to the Magic Guild Store. Would you like to buy some magic supplies?
translation: 欢迎来到魔法公会商店。你想买一些魔法用品吗？ [huan ying lai dao mo fa gong hui shang dian 。 ni xiang mai yi xie mo fa yong pin ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

translation: 你好呀。我叫克朗珀蒂。我是一名巫师，也是一名发明家。 [ni hao ya 。 wo jiao ke lang po di 。 wo shi yi ming wu shi ， ye shi yi ming fa ming jia 。]

translation: 就这样，[数量]免费纯精华。明天回来再买一些。 [jiu zhe yang ，[ shu liang ] mian fei chun jing hua 。 ming tian hui lai zai mai yi xie 。]

translation: 我已经给你今天的免费津贴了。明天再来找我了解更多。 [wo yi jing gei ni jin tian de mian fei jin tie le 。 ming tian zai lai zhao wo liao jie geng duo 。]

english: You must be [player name]. My good friend Sedridor has told me about you. As both wizard and inventor, he has aided me in my great invention!
translation: 您必须是[玩家姓名]。我的好朋友塞德里多向我介绍了你。作为巫师和发明家，他帮助我完成了伟大的发明！ [nin bi xu shi [ wan jia xing ming ]。 wo de hao peng you sai de li duo xiang wo jie shao le ni 。 zuo wei wu shi he fa ming jia ， ta bang zhu wo wan cheng le wei da de fa ming ！]

english: Two jobs? That's got to be tough.
translation: 两份工作？这一定很艰难。 [liang fen gong zuo ？ zhe yi ding hen jian nan 。]

english: Not when you combine them it isn't! I invent MAGIC things!
translation: 当你把它们结合起来时就不是了！我发明了神奇的东西！ [dang ni ba ta men jie he qi lai shi jiu bu shi le ！ wo fa ming le shen qi de dong xi ！]

english: Well, I shall leave you to your inventing.
translation: 好吧，我就让你自己去发明吧。 [hao ba ， wo jiu rang ni zi ji qu fa ming ba 。]

english: Thanks for dropping by! Stop again anytime!
translation: 感谢您的光临！随时再停下来！ [gan xie nin de guang lin ！ sui shi zai ting xia lai ！]

english: So what have you invented?
translation: 那么你发明了什么？ [na me ni fa ming le shen me ？]

translation: 啊!我的最新发明是我正在申请专利的传送块！它会发出低强度的魔法信号，这将使我能够在世界任何地方找到它，并传送任何东西 [a ! wo de zui xin fa ming shi wo zheng zai shen qing zhuan li de chuan song kuai ！ ta hui fa chu di qiang du de mo fa xin hao ， zhe jiang shi wo neng gou zai shi jie ren he di fang zhao dao ta ， bing chuan song ren he dong xi]

english: directly to it! I hope to revolutionise the entire teleportation system! Don't you think I'm great? Uh, I mean it's great?
translation: 直接就可以了！我希望彻底改变整个传送系统！你不觉得我很厉害吗？呃，我是说这很棒？ [zhi jie jiu ke yi le ！ wo xi wang che di gai bian zheng ge chuan song xi tong ！ ni bu jue de wo hen li hai ma ？ e ， wo shi shuo zhe hen bang ？]

english: So where is the other block?
translation: 那么另一个区块在哪里呢？ [na me ling yi ge qu kuai zai na li ne ？]

english: Well... Hmm. I would guess somewhere between here and the Wizards' Tower in Misthalin. All I know is that it hasn't got there yet as the wizards there would have contacted me.
translation: 嗯……嗯。我猜想这里和米沙林的巫师塔之间有什么地方。我所知道的是它还没有到达那里，因为那里的巫师会联系我。 [n …… n 。 wo cai xiang zhe li he mi sha lin de wu shi ta zhi jian you shen me di fang 。 wo suo zhi dao de shi ta hai mei you dao da na li ， yin wei na li de wu shi hui lian xi wo 。]

english: I'm using the GPDT for delivery. They assured me it would be delivered promptly.
translation: 我正在使用 GPDT 进行交付。他们向我保证会立即交付。 [wo zheng zai shi yong  GPDT  jin xing jiao fu 。 ta men xiang wo bao zheng hui li ji jiao fu 。]

english: Who are the GPDT?
translation: GPDT 是谁？ [GPDT  shi shui ？]

english: The Gielinor Parcel Delivery Team. They come very highly recommended. Their motto is: 'We aim to deliver your stuff at some point after you have paid us!'
translation: Gielinor 包裹递送团队。强烈推荐他们。他们的座右铭是：“我们的目标是在您付款后的某个时候交付您的东西！” [Gielinor  bao guo di song tuan dui 。 qiang lie tui jian ta men 。 ta men de zuo you ming shi ：“ wo men de mu biao shi zai nin fu kuan hou de mou ge shi hou jiao fu nin de dong xi ！”]

english: Can I be teleported please?
translation: 请问我可以传送吗？ [qing wen wo ke yi chuan song ma ？]

english: By all means! I'm afraid I can't give you any specifics as to where you will come out however. Presumably wherever the other block is located.
translation: 无论如何！恐怕我无法向您提供有关您将在哪里出来的任何具体信息。大概是另一个块所在的地方。 [wu lun ru he ！ kong pa wo wu fa xiang nin ti gong you guan nin jiang zai na li chu lai de ren he ju ti xin xi 。 da gai shi ling yi ge kuai suo zai de di fang 。]

english: Yes, that sounds good. Teleport me!
translation: 是的，听起来不错。传送我！ [shi de ， ting qi lai bu cuo 。 chuan song wo ！]

english: Okey dokey! Ready?
translation: 好！准备好？ [hao ！ zhun bei hao ？]

english: Hmmm.... that's odd... I can't seem to get a signal...
translation: 嗯……这很奇怪……我似乎收不到信号…… [n …… zhe hen qi guai …… wo si hu shou bu dao xin hao ……]

english: Oh well, never mind.
translation: 哦，好吧，没关系。 [o ， hao ba ， mei guan xi 。]

english: That sounds dangerous. Leave me here.
translation: 这听起来很危险。把我留在这里。 [zhe ting qi lai hen wei xian 。 ba wo liu zai zhe li 。]

english: As you wish.
translation: 如你所愿。 [ru ni suo yuan 。]

english: Well done, that's very clever.
translation: 干得好，这太聪明了。 [gan de hao ， zhe tai cong ming liao 。]

english: Yes it is isn't it? Forgive me for feeling a little smug, this is a major breakthrough in the field of teleportation!
translation: 是的，不是吗？请原谅我有点沾沾自喜，这可是瞬移领域的重大突破啊！ [shi de ， bu shi ma ？ qing yuan liang wo you dian zhan zhan zi xi ， zhe ke shi shun yi ling yu de zhong da tu po a ！]

english: Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence?
translation: 你能将我传送到符文精华吗？ [ni neng jiang wo chuan song dao fu wen jing hua ma ？]

english: Seventior disthine molenko!
translation: 七岁的蔑视莫伦科！ [qi sui de mie shi mo lun ke ！]

english: Here you go.
translation: 干得好。 [gan de hao 。]

english: Your magical prowess... it is most impressive.
translation: 你的魔法能力……真是令人印象深刻。 [ni de mo fa neng li …… zhen shi ling ren yin xiang shen ke 。]

english: Claim free pure essence.
translation: 索取免费的纯净精华。 [suo qu mian fei de chun jing jing hua 。]

english: Chat.
translation: 聊天。 [liao tian 。]

english: Two jobs? That's got to be tough.
translation: 两份工作？这一定很艰难。 [liang fen gong zuo ？ zhe yi ding hen jian nan 。]

english: So what have you invented?
translation: 那么你发明了什么？ [na me ni fa ming le shen me ？]

english: Well, I shall leave you to your inventing.
translation: 好吧，我就让你自己去发明吧。 [hao ba ， wo jiu rang ni zi ji qu fa ming ba 。]

english: So where is the other block?
translation: 那么另一个区块在哪里呢？ [na me ling yi ge qu kuai zai na li ne ？]

translation: 请问我可以传送吗？ [qing wen wo ke yi chuan song ma ？]

english: Welcome to the Magicians' Guild!
translation: 欢迎来到魔法师公会！ [huan ying lai dao mo fa shi gong hui ！]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: What can I do for you?
translation: 我能为你做什么？ [wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: Nothing thanks, I'm just looking around.
translation: 没什么，谢谢，我只是四处看看。 [mei shen me ， xie xie ， wo zhi shi si chu kan kan 。]

english: That's fine with me.
translation: 这对我来说没问题。 [zhe dui wo lai shuo mei wen ti 。]

english: Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence?
translation: 你能将我传送到符文精华吗？ [ni neng jiang wo chuan song dao fu wen jing hua ma ？]

english: Senventior Disthine Molenko!
translation: 迪斯辛·莫连科先生！ [di si xin · mo lian ke xian sheng ！]

english: You need a magic level of 66. The magical energy in here is unsafe for those below that level.
translation: 你的魔法等级需要达到66级。这里的魔法能量对于低于这个等级的人来说是不安全的。 [ni de mo fa deng ji xu yao da dao 66 ji 。 zhe li de mo fa neng liang dui yu di yu zhe ge deng ji de ren lai shuo shi bu an quan de 。]

english: You need a magic level of 66 for admittance to the guild. The magical energy inside the guild is unsafe for anyone below that level. For any other business please ring for attention.
translation: 加入公会需要魔法等级达到 66 级。公会内部的魔力对于低于这个等级的人来说是不安全的。如有其他业务，请致电垂询。 [jia ru gong hui xu yao mo fa deng ji da dao  66  ji 。 gong hui nei bu de mo li dui yu di yu zhe ge deng ji de ren lai shuo shi bu an quan de 。 ru you qi ta ye wu ， qing zhi dian chui xun 。]

english: Nothing thanks, I'm just looking around.
translation: 没什么，谢谢，我只是四处看看。 [mei shen me ， xie xie ， wo zhi shi si chu kan kan 。]

english: Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence?
translation: 你能将我传送到符文精华吗？ [ni neng jiang wo chuan song dao fu wen jing hua ma ？]

english: Do you like my magic Zombies? Feel free to kill them, there's plenty more where these came from!
translation: 你喜欢我的魔法僵尸吗？随意杀掉他们吧，这些东西还有很多来自哪里！ [ni xi huan wo de mo fa jiang shi ma ？ sui yi sha diao ta men ba ， zhe xie dong xi hai you hen duo lai zi na li ！]

english: I spoke to the necromancer like you suggested...
translation: 我按照你的建议和死灵法师谈过…… [wo an zhao ni de jian yi he si ling fa shi tan guo ……]

english: Please - let's not talk about it. Distentor and Zavistic would get very annoyed if they found I'd sent you to a necromancer.
translation: 拜托——我们不要谈论它。如果迪斯坦特和扎维斯蒂克发现我把你送到了死灵法师那里，他们会非常生气的。 [bai tuo —— wo men bu yao tan lun ta 。 ru guo di si tan te he zha wei si di ke fa xian wo ba ni song dao le si ling fa shi na li ， ta men hui fei chang sheng qi de 。]

english: Ok, fair enough.
translation: 好吧，很公平。 [hao ba ， hen gong ping 。]

english: You can't attack the Zombies in the room, my Zombies are for magic target practice only and should be attacked from the other side of the fence.
translation: 你不能攻击房间里的僵尸，我的僵尸只是用于魔法目标练习，应该从栅栏的另一边攻击。 [ni bu neng gong ji fang jian li de jiang shi ， wo de jiang shi zhi shi yong yu mo fa mu biao lian xi ， ying gai cong zha lan de ling yi bian gong ji 。]

english: So you think finding those beads makes you clever, do you?
translation: 所以你认为找到这些珠子会让你变得聪明，是吗？ [suo yi ni ren wei zhao dao zhe xie zhu zi hui rang ni bian de cong ming ， shi ma ？]

english: Well yes, actually.
translation: 嗯，是的，实际上。 [n ， shi de ， shi ji shang 。]

english: Well you'd better just watch your back, because when you least expect it I'll be there. You shouldn't go sticking your nose into other people's affairs, meddler.
translation: 好吧，你最好小心你的背后，因为当你最意想不到的时候我就会在那里。你不应该插手别人的事情，爱管闲事的人。 [hao ba ， ni zui hao xiao xin ni de bei hou ， yin wei dang ni zui yi xiang bu dao de shi hou wo jiu hui zai na li 。 ni bu ying gai cha shou bie ren de shi qing ， ai guan xian shi de ren 。]

english: Not now, I'm trying to concentrate on a very difficult spell!
translation: 现在不行，我正在努力集中精力去完成一个非常困难的咒语！ [xian zai bu xing ， wo zheng zai nu li ji zhong jing li qu wan cheng yi ge fei chang kun nan de zhou yu ！]

english: You were nicer to me when you had that little gnome wandering around here before.
translation: 以前你带着那个小侏儒在这里闲逛时，你对我比较好。 [yi qian ni dai zhe na ge xiao zhu ru zai zhe li xian guang shi ， ni dui wo bi jiao hao 。]

english: Well he's not bothering me anymore, is he? And you don't need to bother me either!
translation: 好吧，他不再打扰我了，是吗？而且你也不需要打扰我！ [hao ba ， ta bu zai da rao wo le ， shi ma ？ er qie ni ye bu xu yao da rao wo ！]

english: Hello there, can I help you?
translation: 您好，请问有什么可以帮到您吗？ [nin hao ， qing wen you shen me ke yi bang dao nin ma ？]

english: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I've been studying the practice of making split-bark armour.
translation: 我一直在研究裂皮铠甲的制作方法。 [wo yi zhi zai yan jiu lie pi kai jia de zhi zuo fang fa 。]

english: Split-bark armour, what's that?
translation: 裂皮铠甲，那是什么？ [lie pi kai jia ， na shi shen me ？]

english: Split-bark armour is special armour for mages. It's much more resistant to physical attacks than normal robes.
translation: 裂皮铠甲是法师专用的铠甲。它对物理攻击的抵抗力比普通长袍要强得多。 [lie pi kai jia shi fa shi zhuan yong de kai jia 。 ta dui wu li gong ji de di kang li bi pu tong chang pao yao qiang de duo 。]

english: It's actually very easy for me to make, but I've been having trouble getting hold of the pieces.
translation: 事实上，这对我来说很容易做，但我一直很难找到这些碎片。 [shi shi shang ， zhe dui wo lai shuo hen rong yi zuo ， dan wo yi zhi hen nan zhao dao zhe xie sui pian 。]

english: Well good luck with that.
translation: 祝你好运。 [zhu ni hao yun 。]

english: Can you make me some?
translation: 你能给我做一些吗？ [ni neng gei wo zuo yi xie ma ？]

english: I'm sorry, but I can't do that right now.
translation: 抱歉，但我现在不能这样做。 [bao qian ， dan wo xian zai bu neng zhe yang zuo 。]

english: I need bark from a hollow tree, and some fine cloth. Unfortunately both these items can only be found in Morytania, especially the cloth which is found in the tombs of shades.
translation: 我需要空心树的树皮和一些精美的布料。不幸的是，这两种物品只能在莫里塔尼亚找到，尤其是在阴影之墓中发现的布料。 [wo xu yao kong xin shu de shu pi he yi xie jing mei de bu liao 。 bu xing de shi ， zhe liang zhong wu pin zhi neng zai mo li ta ni ya zhao dao ， you qi shi zai yin ying zhi mu zhong fa xian de bu liao 。]

english: Of course I'd happily sell you some at a discounted price if you bring me those items.
translation: 当然，如果你把这些东西带给我，我很乐意以折扣价卖给你一些。 [dang ran ， ru guo ni ba zhe xie dong xi dai gei wo ， wo hen le yi yi zhe kou jia mai gei ni yi xie 。]

english: Okay, guess I'll go looking then!
translation: 好吧，那我就去找找吧！ [hao ba ， na wo jiu qu zhao zhao ba ！]

english: Okay, how much do I need?
translation: 好的，我需要多少钱？ [hao de ， wo xu yao duo shao qian ？]

english: I need 1 piece of each for either gloves or boots, 2 pieces of each for a hat, 3 pieces of each for leggings, and 4 pieces of each for a top.
translation: 我需要 1 件用于手套或靴子，2 件用于帽子，3 件用于打底裤，4 件用于上衣。 [wo xu yao  1  jian yong yu shou tao huo xue zi ，2  jian yong yu mao zi ，3  jian yong yu da di ku ，4  jian yong yu shang yi 。]

english: I'll charge you 1,000 coins for either gloves or boots, 6,000 coins for a hat, 32,000 coins for leggings, and 37,000 for a top.
translation: 我将向您收取手套或靴子 1,000 个硬币，帽子 6,000 个硬币，打底裤 32,000 个硬币，上衣 37,000 个硬币。 [wo jiang xiang nin shou qu shou tao huo xue zi  1,000  ge ying bi ， mao zi  6,000  ge ying bi ， da di ku  32,000  ge ying bi ， shang yi  37,000  ge ying bi 。]

english: What's that you're wearing?
translation: 你穿的是什么？ [ni chuan de shi shen me ？]

english: This is split-bark armour, it's special armour for mages. It's much more resistant to physical attacks than normal robes.
translation: 这是裂皮铠甲，是法师专用的铠甲。它对物理攻击的抵抗力比普通长袍要强得多。 [zhe shi lie pi kai jia ， shi fa shi zhuan yong de kai jia 。 ta dui wu li gong ji de di kang li bi pu tong chang pao yao qiang de duo 。]

english: Can you make me some armour please?
translation: 可以给我制作一些盔甲吗？ [ke yi gei wo zhi zuo yi xie kui jia ma ？]

english: Certainly, what would you like me to make?
translation: 当然可以，你想让我做什么？ [dang ran ke yi ， ni xiang rang wo zuo shen me ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: There you go, enjoy your new armour!
translation: 好了，享受你的新盔甲吧！ [hao le ， xiang shou ni de xin kui jia ba ！]

english: You need 2 pieces of bark, 2 pieces of fine cloth and 6,000 coins for a splitbark helm.
translation: 制作裂皮头盔需要 2 块树皮、2 块细布和 6,000 枚硬币。 [zhi zuo lie pi tou kui xu yao  2  kuai shu pi 、2  kuai xi bu he  6,000  mei ying bi 。]

english: You need 4 pieces of bark, 4 pieces of fine cloth and 37,000 coins for a splitbark body.
translation: 制作裂皮身体需要 4 块树皮、4 块细布和 37,000 枚硬币。 [zhi zuo lie pi shen ti xu yao  4  kuai shu pi 、4  kuai xi bu he  37,000  mei ying bi 。]

english: You need 3 pieces of bark, 3 pieces of fine cloth and 32,000 coins for splitbark legs.
translation: 制作裂皮腿需要 3 块树皮、3 块细布和 32,000 枚硬币。 [zhi zuo lie pi tui xu yao  3  kuai shu pi 、3  kuai xi bu he  32,000  mei ying bi 。]

english: You need 1 piece of bark, 1 piece of fine cloth and 1,000 coins for splitbark gauntlets.
translation: 制作裂皮护手需要 1 块树皮、1 块细布和 1,000 枚硬币。 [zhi zuo lie pi hu shou xu yao  1  kuai shu pi 、1  kuai xi bu he  1,000  mei ying bi 。]

translation: 制作裂皮靴子需要 1 块树皮、1 块细布和 1,000 枚硬币。 [zhi zuo lie pi xue zi xu yao  1  kuai shu pi 、1  kuai xi bu he  1,000  mei ying bi 。]

translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

translation: 祝你好运。 [zhu ni hao yun 。]

translation: 你能给我做一些吗？ [ni neng gei wo zuo yi xie ma ？]

translation: 好吧，那我就去找找吧！ [hao ba ， na wo jiu qu zhao zhao ba ！]

translation: 好的，我需要多少钱？ [hao de ， wo xu yao duo shao qian ？]

english: If the player is on a non-members world:
translation: 如果玩家位于非会员世界： [ru guo wan jia wei yu fei hui yuan shi jie ：]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Buy Helm
translation: 购买头盔 [gou mai tou kui]

english: Buy Body
translation: 购买车身 [gou mai che shen]

english: Buy Legs
translation: 买腿 [mai tui]

english: Buy Gauntlets
translation: 购买手套 [gou mai shou tao]
