english: Give me a quest!
translation: 给我一个任务！ [gei wo yi ge ren wu ！]

english: Give me a quest what?
translation: 给我一个任务什么？ [gei wo yi ge ren wu shen me ？]

english: Give me a quest please.
translation: 请给我一个任务。 [qing gei wo yi ge ren wu 。]

english: Well seeing as you asked nicely... I could do with some help.
translation: 好吧，既然你问得好……我需要一些帮助。 [hao ba ， ji ran ni wen de hao …… wo xu yao yi xie bang zhu 。]

english: The wizard Grayzag next door decided he didn't like me so he enlisted an army of hundreds of imps.
translation: 隔壁的巫师格雷扎格认为他不喜欢我，所以他招募了一支由数百名小鬼组成的军队。 [ge bi de wu shi ge lei zha ge ren wei ta bu xi huan wo ， suo yi ta zhao mu le yi zhi you shu bai ming xiao gui zu cheng de jun dui 。]

english: These imps stole all sorts of my things. Most of these things I don't really care about, just eggs and balls of string and things.
translation: 这些小鬼偷了我的各种东西。大多数这些东西我并不真正关心，只是鸡蛋和线团之类的东西。 [zhe xie xiao gui tou le wo de ge zhong dong xi 。 da duo shu zhe xie dong xi wo bing bu zhen zheng guan xin ， zhi shi ji dan he xian tuan zhi lei de dong xi 。]

english: But they stole my four magical beads. There was a red one, a yellow one, a black one, and a white one.
translation: 但他们偷走了我的四颗魔珠。有红的、黄的、黑的、白的。 [dan ta men tou zou le wo de si ke mo zhu 。 you hong de 、 huang de 、 hei de 、 bai de 。]

english: These imps have now spread out all over the kingdom. Could you get my beads back for me?
translation: 这些小鬼现在已经遍布王国各地。你能帮我把我的珠子拿回来吗？ [zhe xie xiao gui xian zai yi jing bian bu wang guo ge di 。 ni neng bang wo ba wo de zhu zi na hui lai ma ？]

english: Well this is a surprising turn of events!
translation: 好吧，这真是一个令人惊讶的转折！ [hao ba ， zhe zhen shi yi ge ling ren jing ya de zhuan zhe ！]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: Well I just so happen to have all of those beads on me!
translation: 好吧，我碰巧身上带着所有这些珠子！ [hao ba ， wo peng qiao shen shang dai zhe suo you zhe xie zhu zi ！]

english: Are you saying that you stole my beads all this time and I’ve been blaming these imps!?
translation: 你是说你一直偷我的珠子，我还怪罪这些小鬼吗！？ [ni shi shuo ni yi zhi tou wo de zhu zi ， wo hai guai zui zhe xie xiao gui ma ！？]

english: No, not at all! I just found them throughout my travels and presumed somebody would need them at some point.
translation: 不，一点也不！我只是在旅行中发现了它们，并推测有人在某个时候会需要它们。 [bu ， yi dian ye bu ！ wo zhi shi zai lv xing zhong fa xian le ta men ， bing tui ce you ren zai mou ge shi hou hui xu yao ta men 。]

english: Bah! Fine.
translation: 呸!美好的。 [pei ! mei hao de 。]

english: Give them here and I'll check that they really are MY beads, before I give you your reward. You'll like it, it's an amulet of accuracy.
translation: 把它们交给这里，我会检查它们是否真的是我的珠子，然后再给你奖励。您一定会喜欢它，它是精确度的护身符。 [ba ta men jiao gei zhe li ， wo hui jian cha ta men shi fou zhen de shi wo de zhu zi ， ran hou zai gei ni jiang li 。 nin yi ding hui xi huan ta ， ta shi jing que du de hu shen fu 。]

english: You give four coloured beads to Wizard Mizgog.
translation: 你将四颗彩色珠子交给巫师米兹戈格。 [ni jiang si ke cai se zhu zi jiao gei wu shi mi zi ge ge 。]

english: Wizard Mizgog places the four beads on the table and casts a spell on them.
translation: 巫师米兹戈格将四颗珠子放在桌子上并对它们施展咒语。 [wu shi mi zi ge ge jiang si ke zhu zi fang zai zhuo zi shang bing dui ta men shi zhan zhou yu 。]

english: The wizard hands you an amulet.
translation: 巫师递给你一个护身符。 [wu shi di gei ni yi ge hu shen fu 。]

english: Congratulations! Quest complete!
translation: 恭喜！任务完成！ [gong xi ！ ren wu wan cheng ！]

english: I'll try.
translation: 我会尽力。 [wo hui jin li 。]

english: That's great, thank you.
translation: 太好了，谢谢。 [tai hao le ， xie xie 。]

english: I've better things to do than chase imps.
translation: 比起追逐小鬼，我还有更重要的事情要做。 [bi qi zhui zhu xiao gui ， wo hai you geng zhong yao de shi qing yao zuo 。]

english: Well if you're not interested in the quests I have to give you, don't waste my time by asking me for them.
translation: 好吧，如果你对我给你的任务不感兴趣，就不要向我询问这些任务，浪费我的时间。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni dui wo gei ni de ren wu bu gan xing qu ， jiu bu yao xiang wo xun wen zhe xie ren wu ， lang fei wo de shi jian 。]

english: Give me a quest or else!
translation: 给我一个任务，否则！ [gei wo yi ge ren wu ， fou ze ！]

english: Or else what? You'll attack me?
translation: 不然又怎样？你会攻击我吗？ [bu ran you zen yang ？ ni hui gong ji wo ma ？]

english: Hahaha!
translation: 哈哈哈！ [ha ha ha ！]

english: Just stop messing around and give me a quest!
translation: 别再胡闹了，给我一个任务吧！ [bie zai hu nao le ， gei wo yi ge ren wu ba ！]

english: Ah now you're assuming I have one to give.
translation: 啊，现在你假设我有一个可以给。 [a ， xian zai ni jia she wo you yi ge ke yi gei 。]

english: Got any more quests?
translation: 还有更多任务吗？ [hai you geng duo ren wu ma ？]

english: No, everything is good with the world today.
translation: 不，当今世界一切都很好。 [bu ， dang jin shi jie yi qie dou hen hao 。]

english: Do you know any interesting spells you could teach me?
translation: 你知道什么有趣的咒语可以教我吗？ [ni zhi dao shen me you qu de zhou yu ke yi jiao wo ma ？]

english: I don't think so, the type of magic I study involves years of meditation and research.
translation: 我不这么认为，我学习的魔法类型需要多年的冥想和研究。 [wo bu zhe me ren wei ， wo xue xi de mo fa lei xing xu yao duo nian de ming xiang he yan jiu 。]

english: Have you got another one of those fancy schmancy amulets?
translation: 您还有另一枚精美的 schmancy 护身符吗？ [nin hai you ling yi mei jing mei de  schmancy  hu shen fu ma ？]

english: I have a few spare. I'd like one of each coloured bead again in return, though! Black, white, yellow and red.
translation: 我还有几个备用的不过，作为回报，我还想要每种颜色的珠子各一颗！黑、白、黄、红。 [wo hai you ji ge bei yong de bu guo ， zuo wei hui bao ， wo hai xiang yao mei zhong yan se de zhu zi ge yi ke ！ hei 、 bai 、 huang 、 hong 。]

english: I have them with me! Here you go.
translation: 我有他们在我身边！干得好。 [wo you ta men zai wo shen bian ！ gan de hao 。]

english: Thanks, Mizgog!
translation: 谢谢，米兹戈格！ [xie xie ， mi zi ge ge ！]

english: What are you going to do with all of these extra beads, anyway?
translation: 无论如何，你打算用这些额外的珠子做什么呢？ [wu lun ru he ， ni da suan yong zhe xie e wai de zhu zi zuo shen me ne ？]

english: You don't want to know. Take care!
translation: 你不想知道。小心！ [ni bu xiang zhi dao 。 xiao xin ！]

english: Maybe later.
translation: 也许以后吧。 [ye xu yi hou ba 。]

english: Perhaps some other time, then.
translation: 那么也许其他时间吧。 [na me ye xu qi ta shi jian ba 。]

english: I don't have them all on me at the moment. I'll come back when I have them!
translation: 我现在还没有把它们全部带在身上。当我拥有它们时我会回来的！ [wo xian zai hai mei you ba ta men quan bu dai zai shen shang 。 dang wo yong you ta men shi wo hui hui lai de ！]

english: Very well. See you soon!
translation: 很好。再见！ [hen hao 。 zai jian ！]

english: You have done well, [player name]!
translation: 你做得很好，[玩家姓名]！ [ni zuo de hen hao ，[ wan jia xing ming ]！]

english: Give me a quest please.
translation: 请给我一个任务。 [qing gei wo yi ge ren wu 。]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: Give me a quest or else!
translation: 给我一个任务，否则！ [gei wo yi ge ren wu ， fou ze ！]

english: Just stop messing around and give me a quest!
translation: 别再胡闹了，给我一个任务吧！ [bie zai hu nao le ， gei wo yi ge ren wu ba ！]

english: Got any more quests?
translation: 还有更多任务吗？ [hai you geng duo ren wu ma ？]

english: Do you know any interesting spells you could teach me?
translation: 你知道什么有趣的咒语可以教我吗？ [ni zhi dao shen me you qu de zhou yu ke yi jiao wo ma ？]

english: Have you got another one of those fancy schmancy amulets?
translation: 您还有另一枚精美的 schmancy 护身符吗？ [nin hai you ling yi mei jing mei de  schmancy  hu shen fu ma ？]

english: I have them with me!
translation: 我有他们在我身边！ [wo you ta men zai wo shen bian ！]

english: Maybe later.
translation: 也许以后吧。 [ye xu yi hou ba 。]

english: Welcome to the Magic Guild Store. Would you like to buy some magic supplies?
translation: 欢迎来到魔法公会商店。你想买一些魔法用品吗？ [huan ying lai dao mo fa gong hui shang dian 。 ni xiang mai yi xie mo fa yong pin ma ？]

english: Can you tell me about your cape?
translation: 你能告诉我你的斗篷吗？ [ni neng gao su wo ni de dou peng ma ？]

english: Certainly! Skillcapes are a symbol of achievement. Only people who have mastered a skill and reached level 99 can get their hands on them and gain the benefits they carry.
translation: 当然！技能斗篷是成就的象征。只有掌握了一项技能并达到99级的人才能获得它们并获得它们所带来的好处。 [dang ran ！ ji neng dou peng shi cheng jiu de xiang zheng 。 zhi you zhang wo le yi xiang ji neng bing da dao 99 ji de ren cai neng huo de ta men bing huo de ta men suo dai lai de hao chu 。]

english: The Cape of Magic allows you to switch spellbooks five times per day. Now, would you like to buy some magic supplies?
translation: 魔法斗篷允许您每天切换魔法书五次。现在，你想买一些魔法用品吗？ [mo fa dou peng yun xu nin mei tian qie huan mo fa shu wu ci 。 xian zai ， ni xiang mai yi xie mo fa yong pin ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: 请问我可以再给我的披风戴上兜帽吗？ [qing wen wo ke yi zai gei wo de pi feng dai shang dou mao ma ？]

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
translation: 毫无疑问，而且免费！ [hao wu yi wen ， er qie mian fei ！]

english: Can you tell me about your cape?
translation: 你能告诉我你的斗篷吗？ [ni neng gao su wo ni de dou peng ma ？]

english: I'd like to view your store please.
translation: 我想参观一下你们的商店。 [wo xiang can guan yi xia ni men de shang dian 。]

english: No thank you.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: May I have another hood for my cape?
translation: 我可以再给我的斗篷戴上兜帽吗？ [wo ke yi zai gei wo de dou peng dai shang dou mao ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Ello young thingummywut.
translation: 你好年轻的东西。 [ni hao nian qing de dong xi 。]

english: What's a thingummywut?
translation: 什么是东西？ [shen me shi dong xi ？]

english: A thingummywut? Where? Where?
translation: 一个东西？在哪里？在哪里？ [yi ge dong xi ？ zai na li ？ zai na li ？]

english: Those pesky thingummywuts. They get everywhere. They leave a terrible mess too.
translation: 那些讨厌的东西。他们无处不在。他们也留下了可怕的烂摊子。 [na xie tao yan de dong xi 。 ta men wu chu bu zai 。 ta men ye liu xia le ke pa de lan tan zi 。]

english: Err you just called me thingummywut.
translation: 呃，你刚刚叫我 thingummywut。 [e ， ni gang gang jiao wo  thingummywut。]

english: You're a thingummywut? I've never seen one up close before. They said I was mad!
translation: 你是个东西吗？我以前从未近距离见过一个。他们说我生气了！ [ni shi ge dong xi ma ？ wo yi qian cong wei jin ju li jian guo yi ge 。 ta men shuo wo sheng qi le ！]

english: Now you are my proof! There ARE thingummywuts in this tower. Now where can I find a cage big enough to keep you?
translation: 现在你就是我的证据了！这座塔里有东西​​。现在哪里可以找到足够大的笼子来关你呢？ [xian zai ni jiu shi wo de zheng ju le ！ zhe zuo ta li you dong xi ​​。 xian zai na li ke yi zhao dao zu gou da de long zi lai guan ni ne ？]

english: Err I'd better be off really.
translation: 呃，我最好还是离开吧。 [e ， wo zui hao hai shi li kai ba 。]

english: Oh ok, have a good time, and watch out for sheep! They're more cunning than they look.
translation: 哦，好吧，祝你玩得开心，小心羊！他们比看上去更狡猾。 [o ， hao ba ， zhu ni wan de kai xin ， xiao xin yang ！ ta men bi kan shang qu geng jiao hua 。]

english: They're right, you are mad.
translation: 他们是对的，你疯了。 [ta men shi dui de ， ni feng le 。]

english: That's a pity. I thought maybe they were winding me up.
translation: 真遗憾。我想也许他们是在逼迫我。 [zhen yi han 。 wo xiang ye xu ta men shi zai bi po wo 。]

english: Tell me what they look like and I'll mash 'em.
translation: 告诉我它们长什么样，我就把它们捣碎。 [gao su wo ta men zhang shen me yang ， wo jiu ba ta men dao sui 。]

english: Don't be ridiculous. No-one has ever seen one.
translation: 别开玩笑了。没有人见过。 [bie kai wan xiao le 。 mei you ren jian guo 。]

english: They're invisible, or a myth, or a figment of my imagination. Can't remember which right now.
translation: 它们是看不见的，或者是一个神话，或者是我的想象的虚构。现在不记得是哪个了。 [ta men shi kan bu jian de ， huo zhe shi yi ge shen hua ， huo zhe shi wo de xiang xiang de xu gou 。 xian zai bu ji de shi na ge le 。]

english: Teach me to be a mighty and powerful wizard.
translation: 教我成为一个强大而强大的巫师。 [jiao wo cheng wei yi ge qiang da er qiang da de wu shi 。]

english: Wizard eh? You don't want any truck with that sort. They're not to be trusted. That's what I've heard anyways.
translation: 巫师啊？你不会想要那种类型的卡车。他们不值得信任。无论如何，这就是我所听到的。 [wu shi a ？ ni bu hui xiang yao na zhong lei xing de ka che 。 ta men bu zhi de xin ren 。 wu lun ru he ， zhe jiu shi wo suo ting dao de 。]

english: So aren't you a wizard?
translation: 那你不是巫师吗？ [na ni bu shi wu shi ma ？]

english: How dare you? Of course I'm a wizard. Now don't be so cheeky or I'll turn you into a frog.
translation: 你怎么敢？当然，我是一个巫师。别这么厚脸皮，不然我就把你变成青蛙了。 [ni zen me gan ？ dang ran ， wo shi yi ge wu shi 。 bie zhe me hou lian pi ， bu ran wo jiu ba ni bian cheng qing wa le 。]

english: Oh I'd better stop talking to you then.
translation: 哦，那我最好别再和你说话了。 [o ， na wo zui hao bie zai he ni shuo hua le 。]

english: Cheerio then. It was nice chatting to you.
translation: 那就谢里奥吧。很高兴和你聊天。 [na jiu xie li ao ba 。 hen gao xing he ni liao tian 。]

english: I need to get a key given to you by Sir Prysin.
translation: 我需要拿到普赖辛爵士给你的钥匙。 [wo xu yao na dao pu lai xin jue shi gei ni de yao shi 。]

english: Sir Prysin? Who's that? What would I want his key for?
translation: 普赖辛爵士？那是谁？我要他的钥匙做什么？ [pu lai xin jue shi ？ na shi shui ？ wo yao ta de yao shi zuo shen me ？]

english: He told me you were looking after it for him.
translation: 他告诉我你正在帮他照顾它。 [ta gao su wo ni zheng zai bang ta zhao gu ta 。]

english: That wasn't very clever of him. I'd lose my head if it wasn't screwed on. Go and tell him to find someone else to look after his valuables in future.
translation: 他这可不太聪明。如果不是拧紧的话我会失去理智。去告诉他以后找人看管他的贵重物品。 [ta zhe ke bu tai cong ming 。 ru guo bu shi ning jin de hua wo hui shi qu li zhi 。 qu gao su ta yi hou zhao ren kan guan ta de gui zhong wu pin 。]

english: Okay, I'll go and tell him that.
translation: 好吧，我这就去告诉他。 [hao ba ， wo zhe jiu qu gao su ta 。]

english: Oh that's great, if it wouldn't be too much trouble.
translation: 哦，那太好了，如果不会太麻烦的话。 [o ， na tai hao le ， ru guo bu hui tai ma fan de hua 。]

english: Well, have you got any keys knocking around?
translation: 嗯，你有钥匙吗？ [n ， ni you yao shi ma ？]

english: Now you come to mention it, yes I do have a key. It's in my special closet of valuable stuff. Now how do I get into that?
translation: 现在你提起来了，是的，我确实有一把钥匙。它在我特别的衣柜里，里面装着贵重的东西。现在我该如何进入呢？ [xian zai ni ti qi lai le ， shi de ， wo que shi you yi ba yao shi 。 ta zai wo te bie de yi gui li ， li mian zhuang zhe gui zhong de dong xi 。 xian zai wo gai ru he jin ru ne ？]

english: I sealed it using one of my magic rituals. So it would make sense that another ritual would open it again.
translation: 我用我的一项魔法仪式将其密封。因此，另一个仪式将再次打开它是有道理的。 [wo yong wo de yi xiang mo fa yi shi jiang qi mi feng 。 yin ci ， ling yi ge yi shi jiang zai ci da kai ta shi you dao li de 。]

english: He's one of the King's knights.
translation: 他是国王的骑士之一。 [ta shi guo wang de qi shi zhi yi 。]

english: Say, I remember one of the King's knights. He had nice shoes...
translation: 话说，我记得一位国王的骑士。他有一双漂亮的鞋子... [hua shuo ， wo ji de yi wei guo wang de qi shi 。 ta you yi shuang piao liang de xie zi ...]

english: ...and didn't like my homemade spinach rolls. Would you like a spinach roll?
translation: ...并且不喜欢我自制的菠菜卷。您想要菠菜卷吗？ [... bing qie bu xi huan wo zi zhi de bo cai juan 。 nin xiang yao bo cai juan ma ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Thank you very much.
translation: 非常感谢。 [fei chang gan xie 。]

english: So do you know what ritual to use?
translation: 那么你知道该用什么仪式吗？ [na me ni zhi dao gai yong shen me yi shi ma ？]

english: Let me think a second.
translation: 让我想一下。 [rang wo xiang yi xia 。]

english: Yes a simple drazier style ritual should suffice. Hmm, main problem with that is I'll need 25 sets of bones. Now where am I going to get hold of something like that?
translation: 是的，一个简单的drazier风格的仪式就足够了。嗯，主要问题是我需要 25 组骨头。现在我该去哪里得到这样的东西呢？ [shi de ， yi ge jian dan de drazier feng ge de yi shi jiu zu gou le 。 n ， zhu yao wen ti shi wo xu yao  25  zu gu tou 。 xian zai wo gai qu na li de dao zhe yang de dong xi ne ？]

english: Hmm, that's too bad. I really need that key.
translation: 嗯，那就太糟糕了。我真的需要那把钥匙。 [n ， na jiu tai zao gao le 。 wo zhen de xu yao na ba yao shi 。]

english: Ah well, sorry I couldn't be any more help.
translation: 啊，抱歉，我无法提供更多帮助。 [a ， bao qian ， wo wu fa ti gong geng duo bang zhu 。]

english: I'll help get the bones for you.
translation: 我来帮你拿骨头。 [wo lai bang ni na gu tou 。]

english: Ooh that would be very good of you.
translation: 哦，那真是太好了。 [o ， na zhen shi tai hao le 。]

english: Okay, I'll speak to you when I've got some bones.
translation: 好吧，等我有骨头了，我再跟你说。 [hao ba ， deng wo you gu tou le ， wo zai gen ni shuo 。]

english: How are you doing finding bones?
translation: 你找骨头的进展如何？ [ni zhao gu tou de jin zhan ru he ？]

english: I haven't got any at the moment.
translation: 我现在还没有。 [wo xian zai hai mei you 。]

english: Nevermind, keep working on it.
translation: 没关系，继续努力吧。 [mei guan xi ， ji xu nu li ba 。]

english: I have some bones.
translation: 我有一些骨头。 [wo you yi xie gu tou 。]

english: Give 'em here then.
translation: 那就把它们交给这里吧。 [na jiu ba ta men jiao gei zhe li ba 。]

english: That's all of them.
translation: 这就是他们的全部。 [zhe jiu shi ta men de quan bu 。]

english: I still need 24 more.
translation: 我还需要24个。 [wo hai xu yao 24 ge 。]

english: Ok, I'll keep looking.
translation: 好的，我会继续寻找。 [hao de ， wo hui ji xu xun zhao 。]

english: Hurrah! That's all 25 sets of bones.
translation: 欢呼！这就是全部 25 组骨头。 [huan hu ！ zhe jiu shi quan bu  25  zu gu tou 。]

english: Wings of dark and colour too, Spreading in the morning dew; Locked away I have a key; Return it now, please, unto me.
translation: 又黑又彩色的翅膀，在晨露中展开；被锁起来我有一把钥匙；现在请把它还给我。 [you hei you cai se de chi bang ， zai chen lu zhong zhan kai ； bei suo qi lai wo you yi ba yao shi ； xian zai qing ba ta huan gei wo 。]

english: Not a problem for a friend of Sir What's-his-face.
translation: 对于“What's-his-face”先生的朋友来说这不是问题。 [dui yu “What's-his-face” xian sheng de peng you lai shuo zhe bu shi wen ti 。]

english: I've lost the key you gave to me.
translation: 我把你给我的钥匙弄丢了。 [wo ba ni gei wo de yao shi nong diu le 。]

english: Yes I know, it was returned to me. If you want it back you're going to have to collect another 25 sets of bones.
translation: 是的，我知道，它已经退还给我了。如果你想把它拿回来，你就必须收集另外 25 组骨头。 [shi de ， wo zhi dao ， ta yi jing tui huan gei wo le 。 ru guo ni xiang ba ta na hui lai ， ni jiu bi xu shou ji ling wai  25  zu gu tou 。]

english: Here you go!
translation: 干得好！ [gan de hao ！]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: I need you to answer this for me like a good thingummywut.
translation: 我需要你为我回答这个问题，就像一件好事一样。 [wo xu yao ni wei wo hui da zhe ge wen ti ， jiu xiang yi jian hao shi yi yang 。]

english: Wizard Traiborn has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 巫师 Traiborn 给了你一个挑战卷轴！ [wu shi  Traiborn  gei le ni yi ge tiao zhan juan zhou ！]

english: Please give me your answer, young thingummywut!
translation: 请给我你的答案，年轻人！ [qing gei wo ni de da an ， nian qing ren ！]

english: How can that be? Go check again, silly thingummywut!
translation: 怎么可能呢？再去检查一下，傻东西ummywut！ [zen me ke neng ne ？ zai qu jian cha yi xia ， sha dong xi ummywut！]

english: Spot on!
translation: 现货！ [xian huo ！]

english: Wizard Traiborn has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 巫师 Traiborn 给了你另一个线索卷轴！ [wu shi  Traiborn  gei le ni ling yi ge xian suo juan zhou ！]

english: What's a thingummywut?
translation: 什么是东西？ [shen me shi dong xi ？]

english: Err you just called me a thingummywut.
translation: 呃，你刚刚称我为“thingummywut”。 [e ， ni gang gang cheng wo wei “thingummywut”。]

english: Err I'd better be off really.
translation: 呃，我最好还是离开吧。 [e ， wo zui hao hai shi li kai ba 。]

english: They're right, you are mad.
translation: 他们是对的，你疯了。 [ta men shi dui de ， ni feng le 。]

english: Tell me what they look like and I'll mash 'em.
translation: 告诉我它们长什么样，我就把它们捣碎。 [gao su wo ta men zhang shen me yang ， wo jiu ba ta men dao sui 。]

english: Teach me to be a mighty and powerful wizard.
translation: 教我成为一个强大而强大的巫师。 [jiao wo cheng wei yi ge qiang da er qiang da de wu shi 。]

english: So aren't you a wizard?
translation: 那你不是巫师吗？ [na ni bu shi wu shi ma ？]

english: Oh I'd better stop talking to you then.
translation: 哦，那我最好别再和你说话了。 [o ， na wo zui hao bie zai he ni shuo hua le 。]

english: I need to get a key given to you by Sir Prysin.
translation: 我需要拿到普赖辛爵士给你的钥匙。 [wo xu yao na dao pu lai xin jue shi gei ni de yao shi 。]

english: He told me you were looking after it for him.
translation: 他告诉我你正在帮他照顾它。 [ta gao su wo ni zheng zai bang ta zhao gu ta 。]

english: Okay, I'll go and tell him that.
translation: 好吧，我这就去告诉他。 [hao ba ， wo zhe jiu qu gao su ta 。]

english: Well, have you got any keys knocking around?
translation: 嗯，你有钥匙吗？ [n ， ni you yao shi ma ？]

english: He's one of the King's knights.
translation: 他是国王的骑士之一。 [ta shi guo wang de qi shi zhi yi 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Hmm, that's too bad. I really need that key.
translation: 嗯，那就太糟糕了。我真的需要那把钥匙。 [n ， na jiu tai zao gao le 。 wo zhen de xu yao na ba yao shi 。]

english: I'll get the bones for you.
translation: 我去给你拿骨头。 [wo qu gei ni na gu tou 。]

english: Just tell me if you have the key.
translation: 请告诉我你是否有钥匙。 [qing gao su wo ni shi fou you yao shi 。]

english: How are things at Weiss?
translation: 维斯的情况怎么样？ [wei si de qing kuang zen me yang ？]

english: Snowflake and My Arm are ruling the town together, and now I've built them a special fire, they can grow goutweed there.
translation: 雪花和我的手臂一起统治着这个小镇，现在我给他们生了一个特殊的火，他们可以在那里种植古藤。 [xue hua he wo de shou bi yi qi tong zhi zhe zhe ge xiao zhen ， xian zai wo gei ta men sheng le yi ge te shu de huo ， ta men ke yi zai na li zhong zhi gu teng 。]

english: So My Arm taught Weiss the farming knowledge of the Stronghold trolls. Now Stronghold trolls can be given firemaking knowledge from Weiss, like I promised.
translation: 于是我的手臂教给了维斯要塞巨魔的农业知识。现在，要塞巨魔可以从韦斯那里获得生火知识，就像我承诺的那样。 [yu shi wo de shou bi jiao gei le wei si yao sai ju mo de nong ye zhi shi 。 xian zai ， yao sai ju mo ke yi cong wei si na li huo de sheng huo zhi shi ， jiu xiang wo cheng nuo de na yang 。]

english: Snowflake gave me a book containing all the information she could find from Odd Mushroom's notes.
translation: 雪花给了我一本书，里面包含了她从奇怪蘑菇的笔记中能找到的所有信息。 [xue hua gei le wo yi ben shu ， li mian bao han le ta cong qi guai mo gu de bi ji zhong neng zhao dao de suo you xin xi 。]

english: Give it to Burntmeat. He can teach trolls what they want to know from it.
translation: 把它交给烧肉。他可以教巨魔他们想从中了解什么。 [ba ta jiao gei shao rou 。 ta ke yi jiao ju mo ta men xiang cong zhong liao jie shen me 。]

english: Hopefully Snowflake will give me another one.
translation: 希望雪花能给我另一张。 [xi wang xue hua neng gei wo ling yi zhang 。]

english: Now that My Arm has taught the Weiss trolls what he knows about farming, here's a book containing what the Weiss trolls know about firemaking.
translation: 现在我的手臂已经教会了韦斯巨魔他所知道的关于农业的知识，这里有一本书包含了韦斯巨魔关于生火的知识。 [xian zai wo de shou bi yi jing jiao hui le wei si ju mo ta suo zhi dao de guan yu nong ye de zhi shi ， zhe li you yi ben shu bao han le wei si ju mo guan yu sheng huo de zhi shi 。]

english: Odd Mushroom invented lots of clever stuff with Snowflake. Might be handy for Stronghold trolls.
translation: 奇怪的蘑菇和雪花一起发明了很多聪明的东西。对于要塞巨魔来说可能很方便。 [qi guai de mo gu he xue hua yi qi fa ming le hen duo cong ming de dong xi 。 dui yu yao sai ju mo lai shuo ke neng hen fang bian 。]

english: Let Burntmeat see...
translation: 让烧肉看看... [rang shao rou kan kan ...]

english: Uh...
Yeah, lotsa learnings here. Very clever stuff. We oughta reward you.
translation: 是的，这里有很多知识。非常聪明的东西。我们应该奖励你。 [shi de ， zhe li you hen duo zhi shi 。 fei chang cong ming de dong xi 。 wo men ying gai jiang li ni 。]

english: Don't give me more burnt meat. I've been here before, and you gave me a load of burnt meat.
translation: 别再给我烧焦的肉了。我以前来过这里，你给了我一堆烧焦的肉。 [bie zai gei wo shao jiao de rou le 。 wo yi qian lai guo zhe li ， ni gei le wo yi dui shao jiao de rou 。]

english: Silly human pretends he don't like Burntmeat's lovely burnt meat! But okay, Burntmeat will not make any more for you. Ever.
translation: 愚蠢的人类假装他不喜欢烧肉可爱的烧肉！不过好吧，烧肉不会再给你做了。曾经。 [yu chun de ren lei jia zhuang ta bu xi huan shao rou ke ai de shao rou ！ bu guo hao ba ， shao rou bu hui zai gei ni zuo le 。 ceng jing 。]

english: Ever? You're never ever going to give me burnt meat again?
translation: 曾经？你再也不会给我烧焦的肉了吗？ [ceng jing ？ ni zai ye bu hui gei wo shao jiao de rou le ma ？]

english: No more burnt meat from Burntmeat, ever. Wolfbone here has made reward for you instead.
translation: 再也不会有烧肉店里的烧焦的肉了。狼骨这边反而给你做了奖励。 [zai ye bu hui you shao rou dian li de shao jiao de rou le 。 lang gu zhe bian fan er gei ni zuo le jiang li 。]

english: Yes, I have learnt a lot here from my friend Burntmeat, and he has let me prepare a reward for you myself.
translation: 是的，我在这里从我的朋友烧肉那里学到了很多东西，他还让我亲自为你准备了一份奖励。 [shi de ， wo zai zhe li cong wo de peng you shao rou na li xue dao le hen duo dong xi ， ta hai rang wo qin zi wei ni zhun bei le yi fen jiang li 。]

english: That's very kind of you.
translation: 谢谢您的好意。 [xie xie nin de hao yi 。]

english: Burntmeat got feeling you no like Burntmeat's burnt meat. Burntmeat made some for you before, an' you not seem grateful. So Burntmeat will not make any more for you. Ever.
translation: 烧肉给你的感觉不像烧肉的烧肉。烧肉以前给你做过一些，但你看起来并不感激。所以 Burntmeat 不会再为你做任何东西了。曾经。 [shao rou gei ni de gan jue bu xiang shao rou de shao rou 。 shao rou yi qian gei ni zuo guo yi xie ， dan ni kan qi lai bing bu gan ji 。 suo yi  Burntmeat  bu hui zai wei ni zuo ren he dong xi le 。 ceng jing 。]

english: Don't give me more burnt meat.
translation: 别再给我烧焦的肉了。 [bie zai gei wo shao jiao de rou le 。]

english: That's very kind of you.
translation: 谢谢您的好意。 [xie xie nin de hao yi 。]

english: Hello, how's it going?
translation: 你好，怎么样？ [ni hao ， zen me yang ？]

english: Not too bad, but I'm a little worried about the increase of goblins these days.
translation: 还不错，不过最近哥布林的增加让我有点担心。 [hai bu cuo ， bu guo zui jin ge bu lin de zeng jia rang wo you dian dan xin 。]

english: Don't worry, I'll kill them.
translation: 别担心，我会杀了他们。 [bie dan xin ， wo hui sha le ta men 。]

english: How can I help you?
translation: 我怎么帮你？ [wo zen me bang ni ？]

english: Do you want to trade?
translation: 你想交易吗？ [ni xiang jiao yi ma ？]

english: No, I have nothing I wish to get rid of. If you want to do some trading, there are plenty of shops and market stalls around though.
translation: 不，我没有什么想要摆脱的。如果您想做一些交易，周围有很多商店和市场摊位。 [bu ， wo mei you shen me xiang yao bai tuo de 。 ru guo nin xiang zuo yi xie jiao yi ， zhou wei you hen duo shang dian he shi chang tan wei 。]

english: I'm in search of a quest.
translation: 我正在寻找一个任务。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yi ge ren wu 。]

english: I'm sorry I can't help you there.
translation: 很抱歉我帮不了你。 [hen bao qian wo bang bu liao ni 。]

english: I'm in search of enemies to kill.
translation: 我正在寻找要杀死的敌人。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yao sha si de di ren 。]

english: I've heard there are many fearsome creatures that dwell under the ground...
translation: 听说地下有很多可怕的生物…… [ting shuo di xia you hen duo ke pa de sheng wu ……]

english: Get out of my way, I'm in a hurry!
translation: 别挡我的路，我很着急！ [bie dang wo de lu ， wo hen zhao ji ！]

english: I'm fine, how are you?
translation: 我很好，你怎么样？ [wo hen hao ， ni zen me yang ？]

english: Very well thank you.
translation: 非常好，谢谢。 [fei chang hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello there! Nice weather we've been having.
translation: 你好呀！我们一直以来天气很好。 [ni hao ya ！ wo men yi zhi yi lai tian qi hen hao 。]

english: I'm very well thank you.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。 [wo hen hao ， xie xie 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I'm a bold adventurer.
translation: 我是一个大胆的冒险家。 [wo shi yi ge da dan de mao xian jia 。]

english: Ah, a very noble profession.
translation: 啊，一个非常崇高的职业。 [a ， yi ge fei chang chong gao de zhi ye 。]

english: Do I know you? I'm in a hurry!
translation: 我知道你？我很着急！ [wo zhi dao ni ？ wo hen zhao ji ！]

english: I think we need a new king. The one we've got isn't very good.
translation: 我认为我们需要一位新国王。我们现有的那个不是很好。 [wo ren wei wo men xu yao yi wei xin guo wang 。 wo men xian you de na ge bu shi hen hao 。]

english: Not too bad thanks.
translation: 还不错，谢谢。 [hai bu cuo ， xie xie 。]

english: Are you asking for a fight?
translation: 你是在要求打架吗？ [ni shi zai yao qiu da jia ma ？]

english: The woman attacks the player
translation: 女人攻击玩家 [nv ren gong ji wan jia]

english: I'm busy right now.
translation: 我现在很忙。 [wo xian zai hen mang 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: None of your business.
translation: 关你屁事。 [guan ni pi shi 。]

english: Do you wish to trade?
translation: 您想进行交易吗？ [nin xiang jin xing jiao yi ma ？]

english: No I don't have any spare change.
translation: 不，我没有零钱。 [bu ， wo mei you ling qian 。]

english: I'm a little worried - I've heard there's lots of people going about, killing citizens at random.
translation: 我有点担心——我听说有很多人到处乱杀公民。 [wo you dian dan xin —— wo ting shuo you hen duo ren dao chu luan sha gong min 。]

english: No, I don't want to buy anything!
translation: 不，我不想买任何东西！ [bu ， wo bu xiang mai ren he dong xi ！]

english: That is classified information.
translation: 那是机密信息。 [na shi ji mi xin xi 。]

english: Have this flyer...
translation: 有这张传单... [you zhe zhang chuan dan ...]

english: Yo, wassup!
translation: 哟，真是的！ [yo ， zhen shi de ！]

english: I like our king, he's keeping the poor and infected away from us decent folk.
translation: 我喜欢我们的国王，他让穷人和感染者远离我们正派的人。 [wo xi huan wo men de guo wang ， ta rang qiong ren he gan ran zhe yuan li wo men zheng pai de ren 。]

english: Not too bad. Glad the plague hasn't touched, the better areas of town.
translation: 还不错。很高兴瘟疫没有影响到镇上较好的地区。 [hai bu cuo 。 hen gao xing wen yi mei you ying xiang dao zhen shang jiao hao de di qu 。]

english: Err... yeah.
translation: 呃……是的。 [e …… shi de 。]

english: Good day.
translation: 再会。 [zai hui 。]

english: An outsider! Can you get me out of this hell hole?
translation: 一个外人！你能带我离开这个地狱吗？ [yi ge wai ren ！ ni neng dai wo li kai zhe ge di yu ma ？]

english: Sorry, that's not what I'm here to do.
translation: 抱歉，我来这里不是为了这个。 [bao qian ， wo lai zhe li bu shi wei le zhe ge 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Go away. People from the outside shut us in like animals. I have nothing to say to you.
translation: 离开。外面的人把我们像动物一样关在里面。我无话可说。 [li kai 。 wai mian de ren ba wo men xiang dong wu yi yang guan zai li mian 。 wo wu hua ke shuo 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: ... whassup?
translation: ……什么事？ […… shen me shi ？]

english: Are you alright?
translation: 你还好吗？ [ni hai hao ma ？]

english: ... see... two of you... why there two of you?
translation: ...看...你们两个...为什么是你们两个？ [... kan ... ni men liang ge ... wei shen me shi ni men liang ge ？]

english: There's only one of me, friend.
translation: 朋友，只有我一个人。 [peng you ， zhi you wo yi ge ren 。]

english: ... no, two of you... you can't count... ... maybe you drunk too much...
translation: ……不，你们两个……数不过来……也许你们喝太多了…… […… bu ， ni men liang ge …… shu bu guo lai …… ye xu ni men he tai duo le ……]

english: Whatever you say, friend.
translation: 不管你说什么，朋友。 [bu guan ni shuo shen me ， peng you 。]

english: ... giant hairy cabbages...
translation: ...巨型卷心菜... [... ju xing juan xin cai ...]

english: Bah, those mourners... they're meant to be helping us, but I think they're doing more harm here than good. They won't even let me send a letter out to my family.
translation: 呸，那些哀悼者……他们本来是要帮助我们的，但我认为他们在这里弊大于利。他们甚至不让我给家人写信。 [pei ， na xie ai dao zhe …… ta men ben lai shi yao bang zhu wo men de ， dan wo ren wei ta men zai zhe li bi da yu li 。 ta men shen zhi bu rang wo gei jia ren xie xin 。]

english: Have you seen a lady called Elena around here?
translation: 你在这里见过一位叫埃琳娜的女士吗？ [ni zai zhe li jian guo yi wei jiao ai lin na de nv shi ma ？]

english: Yes, I've seen her. Very helpful person.
translation: 是的，我见过她。非常乐于助人的人。 [shi de ， wo jian guo ta 。 fei chang le yu zhu ren de ren 。]

english: Not for the last few days though... I thought maybe she'd gone home.
translation: 不过最近几天没有……我想也许她已经回家了。 [bu guo zui jin ji tian mei you …… wo xiang ye xu ta yi jing hui jia le 。]

english: You should stand up to them more.
translation: 你应该更加勇敢地面对他们。 [ni ying gai geng jia yong gan di mian dui ta men 。]

english: Oh I'm not one to cause a fuss.
translation: 哦，我不是一个会大惊小怪的人。 [o ， wo bu shi yi ge hui da jing xiao guai de ren 。]

english: Do you want to trade?
translation: 你想交易吗？ [ni xiang jiao yi ma ？]

english: I'm in search of a quest.
translation: 我正在寻找一个任务。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yi ge ren wu 。]

english: I'm in search of enemies to kill.
translation: 我正在寻找要杀死的敌人。 [wo zheng zai xun zhao yao sha si de di ren 。]

english: Have you seen a lady called Elena around here?
translation: 你在这里见过一位叫埃琳娜的女士吗？ [ni zai zhe li jian guo yi wei jiao ai lin na de nv shi ma ？]

english: You should stand up to them more.
translation: 你应该更加勇敢地面对他们。 [ni ying gai geng jia yong gan di mian dui ta men 。]

english: It stinks down here.
translation: 这里很臭。 [zhe li hen chou 。]

english: Can't you just leave me alone.
translation: 你就不能让我一个人呆着吗？ [ni jiu bu neng rang wo yi ge ren dai zhe ma ？]

english: I don't trust that fish monger.
translation: 我不相信那个鱼贩。 [wo bu xiang xin na ge yu fan 。]

english: Lighting fires in an enclosed space is probably not a good idea. Oh well.
translation: 在封闭空间内生火可能不是一个好主意。那好吧。 [zai feng bi kong jian nei sheng huo ke neng bu shi yi ge hao zhu yi 。 na hao ba 。]

english: I guess it's not all bad down here. At least we have a pub.
translation: 我想这里并不全是坏事。至少我们有一个酒吧。 [wo xiang zhe li bing bu quan shi huai shi 。 zhi shao wo men you yi ge jiu ba 。]

english: I'll leave this place one day. You'll see.
translation: 总有一天我会离开这个地方。你会看到的。 [zong you yi tian wo hui li kai zhe ge di fang 。 ni hui kan dao de 。]

english: Life is tough.
translation: 生活很艰难。 [sheng huo hen jian nan 。]

english: Yes, living in a plague city must be hard.
translation: 是的，在瘟疫之城生活一定很艰难。 [shi de ， zai wen yi zhi cheng sheng huo yi ding hen jian nan 。]

english: Plague? Pah, that's no excuse for the treatment we've received. It's obvious pretty quickly if someone has the plague.
translation: 瘟疫？呸，这不是我们所受到的待遇的借口。如果有人感染了鼠疫，很快就会很明显。 [wen yi ？ pei ， zhe bu shi wo men suo shou dao de dai yu de jie kou 。 ru guo you ren gan ran le shu yi ， hen kuai jiu hui hen ming xian 。]

english: I'm thinking about making a break for it. I'm perfectly healthy, not gonna infect anyone.
translation: 我正在考虑是否要暂时休息一下。我身体很健康，不会传染给任何人。 [wo zheng zai kao lv shi fou yao zan shi xiu xi yi xia 。 wo shen ti hen jian kang ， bu hui chuan ran gei ren he ren 。]

english: I'm sorry to hear that.
translation: 听到这个消息我很遗憾。 [ting dao zhe ge xiao xi wo hen yi han 。]

english: Well, ain't much either you or me can do about it.
translation: 好吧，你我都无能为力。 [hao ba ， ni wo dou wu neng wei li 。]

english: Yes, living in a plague city must be hard.
translation: 是的，在瘟疫之城生活一定很艰难。 [shi de ， zai wen yi zhi cheng sheng huo yi ding hen jian nan 。]

english: I'm sorry to hear that.
translation: 听到这个消息我很遗憾。 [ting dao zhe ge xiao xi wo hen yi han 。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Hello friend. I wish to slay evil and avail them of their loot! Take me to Burgh de Rott!
translation: 朋友你好。我希望消灭邪恶并利用他们的战利品！带我去德罗特堡！ [peng you ni hao 。 wo xi wang xiao mie xie e bing li yong ta men de zhan li pin ！ dai wo qu de luo te bao ！]

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: 你准备好与那里的邪恶作斗争了吗？ [ni zhun bei hao yu na li de xie e zuo dou zheng le ma ？]

english: I think so? At least my heart knows courage and that should be sufficient for the meantime. I expect that when we get to Burgh de Rott, we'll be able to purchase suitable provisions.
translation: 我想是这样吗？至少我的心知道勇气，这应该足够了。我预计当我们到达罗特堡时，我们就能购买到合适的食物。 [wo xiang shi zhe yang ma ？ zhi shao wo de xin zhi dao yong qi ， zhe ying gai zu gou le 。 wo yu ji dang wo men dao da luo te bao shi ， wo men jiu neng gou mai dao he shi de shi wu 。]

english: But you do realise that the vampyres in Morytania are immune to everything except silver?
translation: 但你确实意识到莫里塔尼亚的吸血鬼对除了银以外的一切都免疫吗？ [dan ni que shi yi shi dao mo li ta ni ya de xi xue gui dui chu le yin yi wai de yi qie dou mian yi ma ？]

english: Er...well, I've not heard mention of that fact, but I have faith that Saradomin will provide the means to furnish me with suitable weapons when I reach Burgh de Rott.
translation: 呃……好吧，我没有听说过这个事实，但我相信萨拉多明会在我到达罗特堡时为我提供合适的武器。 [e …… hao ba ， wo mei you ting shuo guo zhe ge shi shi ， dan wo xiang xin sa la duo ming hui zai wo dao da luo te bao shi wei wo ti gong he shi de wu qi 。]

english: And if we happen to run into some vampyres on the journey down there?
translation: 如果我们在那儿的旅途中碰巧遇到吸血鬼怎么办？ [ru guo wo men zai na er de lv tu zhong peng qiao yu dao xi xue gui zen me ban ？]

english: I trust that you will help us to avoid them. You are a guide after all, aren't you? Anyway, you look like you can handle yourself. I presume you've fought such creatures before and won? How hard can it be?
translation: 我相信你会帮助我们避免它们。毕竟你是一个向导，不是吗？无论如何，你看上去能应付自如。我想你以前曾与这些生物战斗过并获胜吧？这有多难？ [wo xiang xin ni hui bang zhu wo men bi mian ta men 。 bi jing ni shi yi ge xiang dao ， bu shi ma ？ wu lun ru he ， ni kan shang qu neng ying fu zi ru 。 wo xiang ni yi qian ceng yu zhe xie sheng wu zhan dou guo bing huo sheng ba ？ zhe you duo nan ？]

english: It can be pretty difficult, actually. But you're right, I'll be your guide so I should be able to handle the situation.
translation: 实际上，这可能相当困难。但你是对的，我会成为你的向导，所以我应该能够处理这种情况。 [shi ji shang ， zhe ke neng xiang dang kun nan 。 dan ni shi dui de ， wo hui cheng wei ni de xiang dao ， suo yi wo ying gai neng gou chu li zhe zhong qing kuang 。]

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 你为什么想去 Burgh de Rott？ [ni wei shen me xiang qu  Burgh de Rott？]

english: I'm going down there to teach those vampyres a lesson or two. I've heard about the terrible conditions down there and I intend to put a stop to it.
translation: 我要去那里给那些吸血鬼一两个教训。我听说那里的情况很糟糕，我打算阻止它。 [wo yao qu na li gei na xie xi xue gui yi liang ge jiao xun 。 wo ting shuo na li de qing kuang hen zao gao ， wo da suan zu zhi ta 。]

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 如果我们在去罗特城堡的路上遇到敌人，你能保护自己吗？ [ru guo wo men zai qu luo te cheng bao de lu shang yu dao di ren ， ni neng bao hu zi ji ma ？]

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of enemies. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: 这么说吧，我有点经验，而且我很乐意对抗我的敌人。你不需要担心这个。 [zhe me shuo ba ， wo you dian jing yan ， er qie wo hen le yi dui kang wo de di ren 。 ni bu xu yao dan xin zhe ge 。]

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 我可以带你去伯格德罗特。 [wo ke yi dai ni qu bo ge de luo te 。]

english: Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: 嗯嗯，看来你有追随者了。我想如果让它独自徘徊的话，它可能会在这段旅程中迷路。等你的追随者安全了我们就离开吧。 [n n ， kan lai ni you zhui sui zhe le 。 wo xiang ru guo rang ta du zi pai huai de hua ， ta ke neng hui zai zhe duan lv cheng zhong mi lu 。 deng ni de zhui sui zhe an quan le wo men jiu li kai ba 。]

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: 哦真的吗？那太好了！到达目的地后我会给你一个小奖励。 [o zhen de ma ？ na tai hao le ！ dao da mu di di hou wo hui gei ni yi ge xiao jiang li 。]

english: Burgh de Rott Ramble begins
translation: Burgh de Rott 漫步开始 [Burgh de Rott  man bu kai shi]

english: Ok, which route should we take?
translation: 好的，我们应该走哪条路？ [hao de ， wo men ying gai zou na tiao lu ？]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: 啊，所以你想给我一些物资，嗯？让我打开背包。 [a ， suo yi ni xiang gei wo yi xie wu zi ， n ？ rang wo da kai bei bao 。]

english: This place is a bit grim. How can people live here?
translation: 这个地方有点严峻。人们怎么能住在这里？ [zhe ge di fang you dian yan jun 。 ren men zen me neng zhu zai zhe li ？]

english: Do you visit Burgh de Rott often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: 您经常访问 Burgh de Rott 吗？看来你很熟悉这条路。 [nin jing chang fang wen  Burgh de Rott  ma ？ kan lai ni hen shu xi zhe tiao lu 。]

english: When are we going to get to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 我们什么时候去 Burgh de Rott？ [wo men shen me shi hou qu  Burgh de Rott？]

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on. I have loot to get.
translation: 我们没有一整天的时间站着聊天；让我们继续努力吧。我有战利品要拿。 [wo men mei you yi zheng tian de shi jian zhan zhe liao tian ； rang wo men ji xu nu li ba 。 wo you zhan li pin yao na 。]

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than the opulet life styles forced on us adventurer types. I'd much rather be up to my eyes in mud and having a good fight!
translation: 哦，我讨厌这次旅行，但它比强加给我们冒险家类型的奥普莱特生活方式要好。我宁愿在泥里睁大眼睛，痛痛快快地打一场！ [o ， wo tao yan zhe ci lv xing ， dan ta bi qiang jia gei wo men mao xian jia lei xing de ao pu lai te sheng huo fang shi yao hao 。 wo ning yuan zai ni li zheng da yan jing ， tong tong kuai kuai di da yi chang ！]

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...
translation: 你没看到我正在被攻击吗... [ni mei kan dao wo zheng zai bei gong ji ma ...]

english: Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
translation: 谢谢，我会把这个放在脖子上。 [xie xie ， wo hui ba zhe ge fang zai bo zi shang 。]

english: Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Paterdomus. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: 天啊！看来我们得回帕特多莫斯了。我们过不了那座桥！ [tian a ！ kan lai wo men de hui pa te duo mo si le 。 wo men guo bu liao na zuo qiao ！]

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
translation: 哦，我相信我们能找到办法！ [o ， wo xiang xin wo men neng zhao dao ban fa ！]

english: Player completes the bridge event
translation: 玩家完成桥牌事件 [wan jia wan cheng qiao pai shi jian]

english: Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Paterdomus.
translation: 好吧，这已经被撕裂了……看起来我们无法越过这个沼泽。我们必须回到帕特多莫斯。 [hao ba ， zhe yi jing bei si lie le …… kan qi lai wo men wu fa yue guo zhe ge zhao ze 。 wo men bi xu hui dao pa te duo mo si 。]

english: Player completes the bog event
translation: 玩家完成沼泽事件 [wan jia wan cheng zhao ze shi jian]

english: Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: 嘿……太好了……你做得很好……我会关注你的。 [hei …… tai hao le …… ni zuo de hen hao …… wo hui guan zhu ni de 。]

english: Whahay...that was great!
translation: 哇……那太好了！ [wa …… na tai hao le ！]

english: But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 但我们现在真的应该出发了。 [dan wo men xian zai zhen de ying gai chu fa le 。]

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
translation: 哦，我相信我们能找到办法！ [o ， wo xiang xin wo men neng zhao dao ban fa ！]

english: Player completes the river event
translation: 玩家完成河牌事件 [wan jia wan cheng he pai shi jian]

english: That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
translation: 太棒了！我也必须这样做。 [tai bang le ！ wo ye bi xu zhe yang zuo 。]

english: Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 哇哈！那很棒！但我们现在真的应该出发了。 [wa ha ！ na hen bang ！ dan wo men xian zai zhen de ying gai chu fa le 。]

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
translation: 呃……那些气泡是什么？ [e …… na xie qi pao shi shen me ？]

english: This is scary!
translation: 这太可怕了！ [zhe tai ke pa le ！]

english: Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
translation: 啊啊啊，那应该是触手吧…… [a a a ， na ying gai shi chu shou ba ……]

english: Ahhh, two tentacles!
translation: 啊啊啊，两条触手！ [a a a ， liang tiao chu shou ！]

english: ...three tentacles!
translation: ……三根触手！ […… san gen chu shou ！]

english: I think I'm going to faint!
translation: 我想我要晕倒了！ [wo xiang wo yao yun dao le ！]

english: Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: 天啊！看看那只野兽！你得自己解决这件事！ [tian a ！ kan kan na zhi ye shou ！ ni de zi ji jie jue zhe jian shi ！]

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the Burgh de Rott. Here's your reward.
translation: 非常感谢您让我安全抵达 Burgh de Rott。这是你的奖励。 [fei chang gan xie nin rang wo an quan di da  Burgh de Rott。 zhe shi ni de jiang li 。]

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: 你准备好与那里的邪恶作斗争了吗？ [ni zhun bei hao yu na li de xie e zuo dou zheng le ma ？]

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 你为什么想去 Burgh de Rott？ [ni wei shen me xiang qu  Burgh de Rott？]

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
translation: 如果我们遇到敌人，你能保护自己吗……？ [ru guo wo men yu dao di ren ， ni neng bao hu zi ji ma ……？]

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 我可以带你去伯格德罗特。 [wo ke yi dai ni qu bo ge de luo te 。]

english: Ok, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: Hi, why do you have twigs growing out of you?
translation: 你好，你身上为什么会长出树枝呢？ [ni hao ， ni shen shang wei shen me hui zhang chu shu zhi ne ？]

english: Heehee, what a strange question, that's because I'm a Wood Dryad.
translation: 嘿嘿，好奇怪的问题，那是因为我是木树妖。 [hei hei ， hao qi guai de wen ti ， na shi yin wei wo shi mu shu yao 。]

english: Grand job, what an obnoxious tree, spreading rumours 'bout other trees and sucking up all the water.
translation: 干得好，真是一棵令人讨厌的树，它散布关于其他树的谣言，还吸干了所有的水。 [gan de hao ， zhen shi yi ke ling ren tao yan de shu ， ta san bu guan yu qi ta shu de yao yan ， hai xi gan le suo you de shui 。]

english: As a reward, I'll let ye use me full banking services!
translation: 作为奖励，我会让你们使用我的全套银行服务！ [zuo wei jiang li ， wo hui rang ni men shi yong wo de quan tao yin hang fu wu ！]

english: Okay then.
translation: 那么好吧。 [na me hao ba 。]

english: What an obnoxious tree, spreading rumours 'bout other trees and sucking up all the water.
translation: 这是一棵多么令人讨厌的树啊，它散布关于其他树的谣言，还吸干了所有的水。 [zhe shi yi ke duo me ling ren tao yan de shu a ， ta san bu guan yu qi ta shu de yao yan ， hai xi gan le suo you de shui 。]

english: Since you're here, I'll let you use me restricted banking services.
translation: 既然你在这里，我就让你使用我的受限银行服务。 [ji ran ni zai zhe li ， wo jiu rang ni shi yong wo de shou xian yin hang fu wu 。]

english: Your items cannot be stored in the bank from here.
translation: 您的物品无法从此处存储在银行中。 [nin de wu pin wu fa cong ci chu cun chu zai yin hang zhong 。]

english: It be yer lucky day, Foresters!
translation: 今天是你的幸运日，森林人！ [jin tian shi ni de xing yun ri ， sen lin ren ！]

english: I'll have to go shortly...
translation: 我很快就得走了... [wo hen kuai jiu de zou le ...]

english: Well, I must be getting on now.
translation: 好吧，我现在必须继续前进了。 [hao ba ， wo xian zai bi xu ji xu qian jin le 。]

english: Open deposit box
translation: 打开存款箱 [da kai cun kuan xiang]

english: Deposit all
translation: 全部存入 [quan bu cun ru]

english: Say nothing
translation: 什么也不说 [shen me ye bu shuo]

english: Deposit all woodcutting resources
translation: 存放所有伐木资源 [cun fang suo you fa mu zi yuan]

english: Yes, bank it all
translation: 是的，全部存入银行 [shi de ， quan bu cun ru yin hang]

english: Only bank woodcutting resources
translation: 仅限银行木刻资源 [jin xian yin hang mu ke zi yuan]

english: No, don't bank anything
translation: 不，不要将任何东西存入银行 [bu ， bu yao jiang ren he dong xi cun ru yin hang]

english: Open my bank deposit box
translation: 打开我的银行存款箱 [da kai wo de yin hang cun kuan xiang]

english: Can you teach me the basics of Woodcutting and Firemaking, please?
translation: 你能教我一些伐木和生火的基础知识吗？ [ni neng jiao wo yi xie fa mu he sheng huo de ji chu zhi shi ma ？]

english: I'd give you an axe to chop trees with but you don't have room in your inventory.
translation: 我会给你一把斧头来砍树，但你的库存中没有空间。 [wo hui gei ni yi ba fu tou lai kan shu ， dan ni de ku cun zhong mei you kong jian 。]

english: As you're already here, have an axe so that you can chop the trees around me.
translation: 既然你已经在这里了，那就带把斧子吧，这样你就可以砍我周围的树了。 [ji ran ni yi jing zai zhe li le ， na jiu dai ba fu zi ba ， zhe yang ni jiu ke yi kan wo zhou wei de shu le 。]

english: When you see a likely looking tree, appreciate its beauty, then simply click on it to chop it down.
translation: 当您看到一棵看起来像的树时，欣赏它的美丽，然后只需单击它即可将其砍倒。 [dang nin kan dao yi ke kan qi lai xiang de shu shi ， xin shang ta de mei li ， ran hou zhi xu dan ji ta ji ke jiang qi kan dao 。]

english: When you have a full inventory of logs, you have a choice. You can take it to the bank, there's one on the roof of the castle in Lumbridge, or you can burn them.
translation: 当您拥有完整的日志清单时，您就可以做出选择。你可以把它带到银行，朗布里奇城堡的屋顶上有一个，或者你也可以把它们烧掉。 [dang nin yong you wan zheng de ri zhi qing dan shi ， nin jiu ke yi zuo chu xuan ze 。 ni ke yi ba ta dai dao yin hang ， lang bu li qi cheng bao de wu ding shang you yi ge ， huo zhe ni ye ke yi ba ta men shao diao 。]

english: Ah, you've lost your tinderbox have you? Have another!
translation: 啊，你的火药盒丢了是吗？再来一个！ [a ， ni de huo yao he diu le shi ma ？ zai lai yi ge ！]

english: Click on your tinderbox, then click on one of the logs in your inventory, this will attempt to light a fire that you can use for cooking.
translation: 单击您的火绒盒，然后单击库存中的一根木头，这将尝试点燃您可以用来做饭的火。 [dan ji nin de huo rong he ， ran hou dan ji ku cun zhong de yi gen mu tou ， zhe jiang chang shi dian ran nin ke yi yong lai zuo fan de huo 。]

english: What is that cape you're wearing?
translation: 你穿的那件斗篷是什么？ [ni chuan de na jian dou peng shi shen me ？]

english: This is a Skillcape of Woodcutting, wearing one increases your chance of finding bird's nests. Only a person who has achieved the highest possible level in a skill can wear one.
translation: 这是伐木技能斗篷，佩戴它可以增加找到燕窝的几率。只有在某项技能上达到最高水平的人才能佩戴它。 [zhe shi fa mu ji neng dou peng ， pei dai ta ke yi zeng jia zhao dao yan wo de ji lv 。 zhi you zai mou xiang ji neng shang da dao zui gao shui ping de ren cai neng pei dai ta 。]

english: Choose carefully where and what you chop, you can get different trees in different places throughout the land.
translation: 仔细选择砍伐的地点和内容，你可以在整个土地的不同地方获得不同的树木。 [zi xi xuan ze kan fa de di dian he nei rong ， ni ke yi zai zheng ge tu di de bu tong di fang huo de bu tong de shu mu 。]

english: Make sure you hang on to your logs, don't throw them away as you can get valuable firemaking experience from them! Look out for other things too...
translation: 确保保留好原木，不要扔掉它们，因为您可以从中获得宝贵的生火经验！还要注意其他事情... [que bao bao liu hao yuan mu ， bu yao reng diao ta men ， yin wei nin ke yi cong zhong huo de bao gui de sheng huo jing yan ！ hai yao zhu yi qi ta shi qing ...]

english: Watch out for the tree spirits, they really don't like you chopping trees, they can really do some damage if you're not paying attention...
translation: 小心树精，他们真的不喜欢你砍树，如果你不注意，他们真的会造成一些伤害...... [xiao xin shu jing ， ta men zhen de bu xi huan ni kan shu ， ru guo ni bu zhu yi ， ta men zhen de hui zao cheng yi xie shang hai ......]

english: Don't forget you can always use logs for fletching experience too.
translation: 不要忘记您也可以随时使用日志来获得箭羽体验。 [bu yao wang ji nin ye ke yi sui shi shi yong ri zhi lai huo de jian yu ti yan 。]

english: Yes, you'll need lots of logs if you want to be a good fletcher. Talk to the ranging tutor for more information.
translation: 是的，如果你想成为一名优秀的制箭手，你需要大量的原木。与测距导师联系以获取更多信息。 [shi de ， ru guo ni xiang cheng wei yi ming you xiu de zhi jian shou ， ni xu yao da liang de yuan mu 。 yu ce ju dao shi lian xi yi huo qu geng duo xin xi 。]

english: As you get better and better you'll find that you can chop trees such as Maple and Yew! These are very good for firemaking.
translation: 随着你变得越来越好，你会发现你可以砍伐枫树和红豆杉等树木！这些对于生火非常有用。 [sui zhe ni bian de yue lai yue hao ， ni hui fa xian ni ke yi kan fa feng shu he hong dou shan deng shu mu ！ zhe xie dui yu sheng huo fei chang you yong 。]

english: Of course, they're also very useful for fletching.
translation: 当然，它们对于制作羽毛也非常有用。 [dang ran ， ta men dui yu zhi zuo yu mao ye fei chang you yong 。]

english: Also, look out for birds' nests, you never know what our feathered friends have been collecting. Jewellery and Clue scrolls maybe?
translation: 另外，请留意鸟巢，你永远不知道我们的羽毛朋友收集了什么。也许是珠宝和线索卷轴？ [ling wai ， qing liu yi niao chao ， ni yong yuan bu zhi dao wo men de yu mao peng you shou ji le shen me 。 ye xu shi zhu bao he xian suo juan zhou ？]

english: Tell me about different trees and axes.
translation: 告诉我有关不同的树和轴的信息。 [gao su wo you guan bu tong de shu he zhou de xin xi 。]

english: Hollow trees can be found in the Haunted Woods east of Canifis, but be careful of the leeches.
translation: 卡尼菲斯东部的闹鬼森林中可以找到空心树，但要小心水蛭。 [ka ni fei si dong bu de nao gui sen lin zhong ke yi zhao dao kong xin shu ， dan yao xiao xin shui zhi 。]

english: Yes, please.

translation: 99000！这对我来说太富有了。 [99000！ zhe dui wo lai shuo tai fu you le 。]

english: Well go chop down a few mahogany trees and sell the timber; then you'll be able to afford one.
translation: 那就去砍几棵红木树，把木材卖掉吧；那么你就买得起一个。 [na jiu qu kan ji ke hong mu shu ， ba mu cai mai diao ba ； na me ni jiu mai de qi yi ge 。]

english: No problem.
translation: 没问题。 [mei wen ti 。]

translation: 但不幸的是，我身上没有足够的钱。 [dan bu xing de shi ， wo shen shang mei you zu gou de qian 。]

translation: 我实在不跟了。 [wo shi zai bu gen le 。]

translation: 多亏了这些地点，这座城市才被隔离。这意味着没有货物进出。没有货物意味着我们没有任何工作可做！ [duo kui le zhe xie di dian ， zhe zuo cheng shi cai bei ge li 。 zhe yi wei zhe mei you huo wu jin chu 。 mei you huo wu yi wei zhe wo men mei you ren he gong zuo ke zuo ！]

english: Hey.
translation: 嘿。 [hei 。]

english: What's wrong?
translation: 怎么了？ [zen me le ？]

translation: 大祭司已确定这些斑点不具有传染性。他再次开放了这座城市，这意味着我们必须回去工作。 [da ji si yi que ding zhe xie ban dian bu ju you chuan ran xing 。 ta zai ci kai fang le zhe zuo cheng shi ， zhe yi wei zhe wo men bi xu hui qu gong zuo 。]

english: Now that all the plagues have been cured, we've had to go back to work.
translation: 现在所有的瘟疫都已经被治愈了，我们必须回去工作了。 [xian zai suo you de wen yi dou yi jing bei zhi yu le ， wo men bi xu hui qu gong zuo le 。]

english: What, so that I can get back to work?

translation: 你会用这一切做什么？ [ni hui yong zhe yi qie zuo shen me ？]

translation: 原材料将用于维护 Cam Torum。至于其他的事情，如果你帮助我们，你就可以分享宝藏。 [yuan cai liao jiang yong yu wei hu  Cam Torum。 zhi yu qi ta de shi qing ， ru guo ni bang zhu wo men ， ni jiu ke yi fen xiang bao zang 。]

english: That's very generous, thank you.
translation: 这真是太慷慨了，谢谢。 [zhe zhen shi tai kang kai le ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Hmm? Did you say something?

translation: 为什么我不会呢？我不是那个在山里迷路的人！ [wei shen me wo bu hui ne ？ wo bu shi na ge zai shan li mi lu de ren ！]

english: Do you think he's still alive?

english: I don't know.

english: What I do know is that I do this for Karlo. Let's make him proud!
translation: 我所知道的是我这样做是为了卡洛。让我们让他感到骄傲吧！ [wo suo zhi dao de shi wo zhe yang zuo shi wei le ka luo 。 rang wo men rang ta gan dao jiao ao ba ！]

translation: 为了卡洛！ [wei le ka luo ！]

translation: 看到外面那座大山了吗？那就是暗霜。那里有一只漂亮的小动物，名叫休伊科特尔。 [kan dao wai mian na zuo da shan le ma ？ na jiu shi an shuang 。 na li you yi zhi piao liang de xiao dong wu ， ming jiao xiu yi ke te er 。]

translation: 你们人类似乎并不太在意，所以像往常一样，我们有责任阻止它把整个地区搞得一团糟。 [ni men ren lei si hu bing bu tai zai yi ， suo yi xiang wang chang yi yang ， wo men you ze ren zu zhi ta ba zheng ge di qu gao de yi tuan zao 。]

translation: 我是。与休伊科特尔打交道是一项艰苦的工作，而且你们人类并没有足够关心并做出太多贡献。 [wo shi 。 yu xiu yi ke te er da jiao dao shi yi xiang jian ku de gong zuo ， er qie ni men ren lei bing mei you zu gou guan xin bing zuo chu tai duo gong xian 。]

translation: 你是？哦……那就公平了。既然如此，就往山上走，然后就被困住了。 [ni shi ？ o …… na jiu gong ping le 。 ji ran ru ci ， jiu wang shan shang zou ， ran hou jiu bei kun zhu le 。]

english: Well, I've actually been up there helping myself.
translation: 嗯，实际上我一直在帮助自己。 [n ， shi ji shang wo yi zhi zai bang zhu zi ji 。]

english: You have? Oh... Fair enough then. I guess you've earned yourself a break as well.

english: Not too bad, but the work is definitely tiring.

english: Well I could do with a good rest, but fine otherwise.
translation: 好吧，我可以好好休息一下，但其他方面也还好。 [hao ba ， wo ke yi hao hao xiu xi yi xia ， dan qi ta fang mian ye hai hao 。]

english: Sorry, but I'm busy right now.
translation: 抱歉，但我现在很忙。 [bao qian ， dan wo xian zai hen mang 。]

english: Busy, busy, busy.
translation: 忙，忙，忙。 [mang ， mang ， mang 。]

english: Hiya.
translation: 嗨。 [hai 。]

english: Can you teach me anything?
translation: 你能教我什么吗？ [ni neng jiao wo shen me ma ？]

english: No - I've got one lousy apprentice already, and that's quite enough hassle! Go away!
translation: 不——我已经有了一个糟糕的学徒了，这已经够麻烦了！离开！ [bu —— wo yi jing you le yi ge zao gao de xue tu le ， zhe yi jing gou ma fan le ！ li kai ！]

translation: 你好，我的短舌头朋友。我能为你做什么？ [ni hao ， wo de duan she tou peng you 。 wo neng wei ni zuo shen me ？]

english: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？ [ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: What do you think I'm doing here?
translation: 你认为我在这里做什么？ [ni ren wei wo zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: I wouldn't like to guess.
translation: 我不想猜测。 [wo bu xiang cai ce 。]

english: How disappointing. I enjoy a good guessing game! No matter. My colleague and I are here are on a mission of preservation!
translation: 多么令人失望啊。我很喜欢玩猜谜游戏！不管。我和我的同事来这里是为了保护环境！ [duo me ling ren shi wang a 。 wo hen xi huan wan cai mi you xi ！ bu guan 。 wo he wo de tong shi lai zhe li shi wei le bao hu huan jing ！]

english: Preservation of what?
translation: 保存什么？ [bao cun shen me ？]

english: Preservation of these magnificent colossal wyrm remains, of course! You see, we have a termite problem.
translation: 当然是保护这些宏伟的巨龙遗骸！你看，我们有白蚁问题。 [dang ran shi bao hu zhe xie hong wei de ju long yi hai ！ ni kan ， wo men you bai yi wen ti 。]

english: I'm beginning to see your role in all of this.
translation: 我开始看到你在这一切中扮演的角色。 [wo kai shi kan dao ni zai zhe yi qie zhong ban yan de jue se 。]

english: Indeed! And while my archaeological skills are certainly exemplary, I also bring a certain set of more unique skills to this troublesome assignment.
translation: 的确！虽然我的考古技能确实堪称典范，但我也为这项棘手的任务带来了一套更独特的技能。 [di que ！ sui ran wo de kao gu ji neng que shi kan cheng dian fan ， dan wo ye wei zhe xiang ji shou de ren wu dai lai le yi tao geng du te de ji neng 。]

english: Oh for goodness sake, he just eats the termites!
translation: 噢，天哪，他只是吃白蚁！ [o ， tian na ， ta zhi shi chi bai yi ！]

english: Ahem! I am able to dispose of the termites in ways others cannot.
translation: 咳咳！我能够以其他人无法做到的方式处理白蚁。 [hai hai ！ wo neng gou yi qi ta ren wu fa zuo dao de fang shi chu li bai yi 。]

english: I see. So can I help your preservation efforts?
translation: 我懂了。那么我可以帮助你们的保护工作吗？ [wo dong le 。 na me wo ke yi bang zhu ni men de bao hu gong zuo ma ？]

english: Why yes! It seems our scaffolding has proven to be a useful place for adventurous types to practice running and jumping in quick succession.
translation: 为什么是的！事实证明，我们的脚手架对于喜欢冒险的人来说是一个练习快速连续奔跑和跳跃的有用场所。 [wei shen me shi de ！ shi shi zheng ming ， wo men de jiao shou jia dui yu xi huan mao xian de ren lai shuo shi yi ge lian xi kuai su lian xu ben pao he tiao yue de you yong chang suo 。]

english: Should you also wish to practice these skills, you may come across the aforementioned termites while you traverse the ropes. Simply scoop them up and bring them to me.
translation: 如果您也想练习这些技能，则在穿过绳索时可能会遇到上述白蚁。只需将它们舀起来并带给我即可。 [ru guo nin ye xiang lian xi zhe xie ji neng ， ze zai chuan guo sheng suo shi ke neng hui yu dao shang shu bai yi 。 zhi xu jiang ta men yao qi lai bing dai gei wo ji ke 。]

english: I'll happily exchange them for some goodies I've collected during my time here! You can also keep any bone shards they may have unfortunately chipped off.
translation: 我很乐意用它们换取我在这里收集的一些好东西！您还可以保留它们可能不幸脱落的任何骨头碎片。 [wo hen le yi yong ta men huan qu wo zai zhe li shou ji de yi xie hao dong xi ！ nin hai ke yi bao liu ta men ke neng bu xing tuo luo de ren he gu tou sui pian 。]

english: Sounds simple enough!
translation: 听起来很简单！ [ting qi lai hen jian dan ！]

english: Wonderful! To get started, just use the ladder by the wyrm's skull to climb up onto the scaffolding.
translation: 精彩的！首先，只需使用巨龙头骨旁的梯子爬上脚手架即可。 [jing cai de ！ shou xian ， zhi xu shi yong ju long tou gu pang de ti zi pa shang jiao shou jia ji ke 。]

english: Initially the route is the same for everyone, but part way round you'll find a loftier section of scaffolding. If you're skilled, that route might be more appealing to you.
translation: 最初，每个人的路线都是一样的，但在中间你会发现脚手架的一个更高的部分。如果您技术熟练，那么这条路线可能对您更有吸引力。 [zui chu ， mei ge ren de lu xian dou shi yi yang de ， dan zai zhong jian ni hui fa xian jiao shou jia de yi ge geng gao de bu fen 。 ru guo nin ji shu shu lian ， na me zhe tiao lu xian ke neng dui nin geng you xi yin li 。]

english: That said, don't go up there unless you know what you're doing. I have work to do so I can't spend all my time patching people up when they hurt themselves!
translation: 也就是说，除非你知道自己在做什么，否则不要去那里。我还有工作要做，所以我不能把所有时间都花在为受伤的人包扎上！ [ye jiu shi shuo ， chu fei ni zhi dao zi ji zai zuo shen me ， fou ze bu yao qu na li 。 wo hai you gong zuo yao zuo ， suo yi wo bu neng ba suo you shi jian dou hua zai wei shou shang de ren bao za shang ！]

english: You'll need at least 50 Agility to tackle the basic course and 62 Agility to take on the advanced course.
translation: 您需要至少 50 敏捷度来完成基础课程，并需要 62 敏捷度来完成高级课程。 [nin xu yao zhi shao  50  min jie du lai wan cheng ji chu ke cheng ， bing xu yao  62  min jie du lai wan cheng gao ji ke cheng 。]

english: Great, thanks!
translation: 太好了，谢谢！ [tai hao le ， xie xie ！]

english: Good luck!
translation: 祝你好运！ [zhu ni hao yun ！]

english: Remind me, what are you doing here?
translation: 提醒我，你在这里做什么？ [ti xing wo ， ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Would you like to trade?
translation: 您想交易吗？ [nin xiang jiao yi ma ？]

english: I certainly would!
translation: 我当然愿意！ [wo dang ran yuan yi ！]

english: How am I doing so far?
translation: 到目前为止我做得怎么样？ [dao mu qian wei zhi wo zuo de zen me yang ？]

english: Which route would you like to know about?
translation: 您想了解哪条路线？ [nin xiang liao jie na tiao lu xian ？]

english: You haven't completed any laps of the basic agility course yet. There's been X global completions and the global best time is X.
translation: 您尚未完成基本敏捷性课程的任何圈数。已有 X 次全球完成，全球最好成绩是 X 次。 [nin shang wei wan cheng ji ben min jie xing ke cheng de ren he quan shu 。 yi you  X  ci quan qiu wan cheng ， quan qiu zui hao cheng ji shi  X  ci 。]

english: You haven't completed any laps of the advanced agility course yet. There's been X global completions and the global best time is X.
translation: 您尚未完成高级敏捷性课程的任何圈数。已有 X 次全球完成，全球最好成绩是 X 次。 [nin shang wei wan cheng gao ji min jie xing ke cheng de ren he quan shu 。 yi you  X  ci quan qiu wan cheng ， quan qiu zui hao cheng ji shi  X  ci 。]

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: Farewell.
translation: 告别。 [gao bie 。]

english: Remind me, what are you doing here?
translation: 提醒我，你在这里做什么？ [ti xing wo ， ni zai zhe li zuo shen me ？]

english: Would you like to trade?
translation: 您想交易吗？ [nin xiang jiao yi ma ？]

english: How am I doing so far?
translation: 到目前为止我做得怎么样？ [dao mu qian wei zhi wo zuo de zen me yang ？]

english: Colossal Wyrm Basic Course.
translation: 巨龙基础课程。 [ju long ji chu ke cheng 。]

english: Colossal Wyrm Advanced Course.
translation: 巨龙高级课程。 [ju long gao ji ke cheng 。]

english: I'd better get going.
translation: 我最好走了。 [wo zui hao zou le 。]

english: Whut you want?
translation: 你想要什么？ [ni xiang yao shen me ？]

english: What are you in for?
translation: 你进来干什么？ [ni jin lai gan shen me ？]

english: Me not sure. Me pick some stuff up and take it away.
translation: 我不确定。我捡起一些东西并把它带走。 [wo bu que ding 。 wo jian qi yi xie dong xi bing ba ta dai zou 。]

english: Well, did the stuff belong to you?
translation: 那么，这些东西是你的吗？ [na me ， zhe xie dong xi shi ni de ma ？]

english: Umm...no.
Well, that would be why then.
translation: 嗯，那就是原因。 [n ， na jiu shi yuan yin 。]

english: Oh, right.
translation: 哦，对了。 [o ， dui le 。]

english: Sorry, thought this was a zoo.
translation: 抱歉，我以为这里是动物园。 [bao qian ， wo yi wei zhe li shi dong wu yuan 。]

english: I believe you've got piece of a map that I need.
translation: 我相信你已经找到了我需要的地图。 [wo xiang xin ni yi jing zhao dao le wo xu yao de di tu 。]

english: So? Why should I be giving it to you? What you do for Wormbrain?
translation: 所以？我为什么要把它给你？你为虫脑做什么？ [suo yi ？ wo wei shen me yao ba ta gei ni ？ ni wei chong nao zuo shen me ？]

english: I'm not going to do anything for you. Forget it.
translation: 我不会为你做任何事。忘了它。 [wo bu hui wei ni zuo ren he shi 。 wang le ta 。]

english: Be dat way then.
translation: 那就这样吧。 [na jiu zhe yang ba 。]

english: I'll let you live. I could just kill you.
translation: 我会让你活下去。我简直可以杀了你。 [wo hui rang ni huo xia qu 。 wo jian zhi ke yi sha le ni 。]

english: Ha! Me in here and you out dere. You not get map piece.
translation: 哈!我在这里，你在外面。你得不到地图碎片。 [ha ! wo zai zhe li ， ni zai wai mian 。 ni de bu dao di tu sui pian 。]

english: I suppose I could pay you for the map piece. Say, 500 coins?
translation: 我想我可以付钱给你买那张地图。比如说，500金币？ [wo xiang wo ke yi fu qian gei ni mai na zhang di tu 。 bi ru shuo ，500 jin bi ？]

english: Me not stoopid, it worth at least 10,000 coins!
translation: 我不傻，至少值一万金币！ [wo bu sha ， zhi shao zhi yi wan jin bi ！]

english: You must be joking! Forget it.
translation: 你一定是在开玩笑！忘了它。 [ni yi ding shi zai kai wan xiao ！ wang le ta 。]

english: Fine, you not get map piece.
translation: 好吧，你没有得到地图碎片。 [hao ba ， ni mei you de dao di tu sui pian 。]

english: Oops, I don't have enough on me.
translation: 哎呀，我身上的东西还不够。 [ai ya ， wo shen shang de dong xi hai bu gou 。]

english: Comes back when you has enough.
translation: 当你玩够了就回来。 [dang ni wan gou le jiu hui lai 。]

english: Alright then, 10,000 coins it is.
translation: 好吧，一万个金币。 [hao ba ， yi wan ge jin bi 。]

english: Fank you very much! Now me can bribe da guards, hehehe.
translation: 非常迷恋你！现在我可以贿赂守卫了，呵呵。 [fei chang mi lian ni ！ xian zai wo ke yi hui lu shou wei le ， he he 。]

english: Where did you get the map piece from?
translation: 你从哪里得到地图碎片？ [ni cong na li de dao di tu sui pian ？]

english: We rob house of stupid wizard. She very old, not put up much fight at all. Hahaha!
translation: 我们抢劫愚蠢巫师的房子。她已经很老了，根本没有抵抗力。哈哈哈！ [wo men qiang jie yu chun wu shi de fang zi 。 ta yi jing hen lao le ， gen ben mei you di kang li 。 ha ha ha ！]

english: Uh... Hahaha.
translation: 呃……哈哈哈。 [e …… ha ha ha 。]

english: Her house full of pictures of a city on island and old pictures of people. Me not recognise island.
translation: 她的房子里挂满了岛上城市的照片和人们的旧照片。我不认识岛。 [ta de fang zi li gua man le dao shang cheng shi de zhao pian he ren men de jiu zhao pian 。 wo bu ren shi dao 。]

english: Me find map piece. Me not know what it is, but it in locked box so me figure it important.
translation: 我找到了地图。我不知道它是什么，但它在锁着的盒子里，所以我认为它很重要。 [wo zhao dao le di tu 。 wo bu zhi dao ta shi shen me ， dan ta zai suo zhe de he zi li ， suo yi wo ren wei ta hen zhong yao 。]

english: But, by the time me get box open, other goblins gone. Then me not run fast enough and guards catch me.
translation: 但是，当我打开盒子时，其他妖精已经消失了。然后我跑得不够快，警卫抓住了我。 [dan shi ， dang wo da kai he zi shi ， qi ta yao jing yi jing xiao shi le 。 ran hou wo pao de bu gou kuai ， jing wei zhua zhu le wo 。]

english: But now you want map piece so must be special! What you do for me to get it?
translation: 但现在你想要地图，所以必须是特别的！你要为我做什么才能得到它？ [dan xian zai ni xiang yao di tu ， suo yi bi xu shi te bie de ！ ni yao wei wo zuo shen me cai neng de dao ta ？]

english: You have just beaten Wormbrain up. Give the poor goblin a break.
translation: 你刚刚打败了虫脑。让可怜的妖精休息一下吧。 [ni gang gang da bai le chong nao 。 rang ke lian de yao jing xiu xi yi xia ba 。]

english: You have already taken Wormbrain's map piece. There is no use in beating him up further.
translation: 你已经拿走了虫脑的地图碎片。再打他也没有用。 [ni yi jing na zou le chong nao de di tu sui pian 。 zai da ta ye mei you yong 。]

english: What are you in for?
translation: 你进来干什么？ [ni jin lai gan shen me ？]

english: Sorry, thought this was a zoo.
translation: 抱歉，我以为这里是动物园。 [bao qian ， wo yi wei zhe li shi dong wu yuan 。]

english: I believe you've got a piece of map that I need.
translation: 我相信你已经找到了我需要的地图。 [wo xiang xin ni yi jing zhao dao le wo xu yao de di tu 。]

english: I'm not going to do anything for you. Forget it.
translation: 我不会为你做任何事。忘了它。 [wo bu hui wei ni zuo ren he shi 。 wang le ta 。]

english: I'll let you live. I could just kill you.
translation: 我会让你活下去。我简直可以杀了你。 [wo hui rang ni huo xia qu 。 wo jian zhi ke yi sha le ni 。]

english: I suppose I could pay you for the map piece...
translation: 我想我可以付钱给你买那张地图…… [wo xiang wo ke yi fu qian gei ni mai na zhang di tu ……]

english: You must be joking! Forget it.
translation: 你一定是在开玩笑！忘了它。 [ni yi ding shi zai kai wan xiao ！ wang le ta 。]

english: Alright then, 10,000 it is.
translation: 好吧，那就一万吧。 [hao ba ， na jiu yi wan ba 。]

english: Where did you get the map piece from?
translation: 你从哪里得到地图碎片？ [ni cong na li de dao di tu sui pian ？]

english: Hello there friend.
translation: 你好朋友。 [ni hao peng you 。]

english: Oh..what am I to do, Christmas is ruined.
translation: 哦..我该怎么办，圣诞节被毁了。 [o .. wo gai zen me ban ， sheng dan jie bei hui le 。]

english: What's the matter?
translation: 怎么了？ [zen me le ？]

english: Christmas is ruined, my bakery is ruined, everything is ruined!
translation: 圣诞节被毁了，我的面包店被毁了，一切都被毁了！ [sheng dan jie bei hui le ， wo de mian bao dian bei hui le ， yi qie dou bei hui le ！]

english: Maybe this has something to do with Santa in Varrock Square.
translation: 也许这与瓦罗克广场的圣诞老人有关。 [ye xu zhe yu wa luo ke guang chang de sheng dan lao ren you guan 。]

english: Adventurer! You've come at the right time. I need your help.
translation: 冒险家！你来得正是时候。我需要你的帮助。 [mao xian jia ！ ni lai de zheng shi shi hou 。 wo xu yao ni de bang zhu 。]

english: Could this have something to do with some missing Gingerbread Gnomes?
translation: 这是否与一些失踪的姜饼侏儒有关？ [zhe shi fou yu yi xie shi zong de jiang bing zhu ru you guan ？]

english: How did you know?
translation: 你怎么知道的？ [ni zen me zhi dao de ？]

english: Santa told me to sort it out for him, he said his son has taken over the Gingerbread Gnome production.
translation: 圣诞老人让我帮他解决，他说他的儿子已经接管了姜饼侏儒的生产。 [sheng dan lao ren rang wo bang ta jie jue ， ta shuo ta de er zi yi jing jie guan le jiang bing zhu ru de sheng chan 。]

english: He has been an absolute disaster, he suddenly showed up and took control of our bakery. We tried to stop him, but he locked up the two other bakers!
translation: 他绝对是一场灾难，他突然出现并控制了我们的面包店。我们试图阻止他，但他把另外两个面包师锁了起来！ [ta jue dui shi yi chang zai nan ， ta tu ran chu xian bing kong zhi le wo men de mian bao dian 。 wo men shi tu zu zhi ta ， dan ta ba ling wai liang ge mian bao shi suo le qi lai ！]

english: How did you manage to escape?
translation: 你是怎么逃脱的？ [ni shi zen me tao tuo de ？]

english: Well... I don't think he knows how Gingerbread Gnomes are made, he brought in an Icelord to ice the gingerbread.
translation: 嗯……我认为他不知道姜饼侏儒是如何制作的，他带来了一个冰领主来给姜饼加冰。 [n …… wo ren wei ta bu zhi dao jiang bing zhu ru shi ru he zhi zuo de ， ta dai lai le yi ge bing ling zhu lai gei jiang bing jia bing 。]

english: I threw a stone at it to cause a distraction, giving me a chance to escape. After I got out, I heard Jack lock the entrance behind me.
translation: 我向它扔了一块石头，分散了它的注意力，给了我逃跑的机会。我出去后，我听到杰克在我身后锁上了入口。 [wo xiang ta reng le yi kuai shi tou ， fen san le ta de zhu yi li ， gei le wo tao pao de ji hui 。 wo chu qu hou ， wo ting dao jie ke zai wo shen hou suo shang le ru kou 。]

english: He brought in an Icelord!? I don't know how to deal with one of those.
translation: 他带来了冰王！？我不知道如何处理其中之一。 [ta dai lai le bing wang ！？ wo bu zhi dao ru he chu li qi zhong zhi yi 。]

english: It's terrifying! I think Jack must have a few screws loose to think that was a good idea.
translation: 太可怕了！我想杰克一定是松了几颗螺丝才认为这是个好主意。 [tai ke pa le ！ wo xiang jie ke yi ding shi song le ji ke luo si cai ren wei zhe shi ge hao zhu yi 。]

english: Well, I better tell Santa, since I can't get into the bakery from here....
translation: 好吧，我最好告诉圣诞老人，因为我不能从这里进入面包店...... [hao ba ， wo zui hao gao su sheng dan lao ren ， yin wei wo bu neng cong zhe li jin ru mian bao dian ......]

english: Please hurry, we need to restart production as soon as possible.
translation: 请抓紧时间，我们需要尽快恢复生产。 [qing zhua jin shi jian ， wo men xu yao jin kuai hui fu sheng chan 。]

english: Have you managed to free the other bakers and stop Jack Frost yet?
translation: 你成功救出了其他面包师并阻止了杰克·弗罗斯特吗？ [ni cheng gong jiu chu le qi ta mian bao shi bing zu zhi le jie ke · fu luo si te ma ？]

english: Not yet, I'm still working on it.
translation: 还没有，我还在努力。 [hai mei you ， wo hai zai nu li 。]

english: Hurry we need to get back into production, before it's too late.
translation: 我们需要尽快恢复生产，以免为时已晚。 [wo men xu yao jin kuai hui fu sheng chan ， yi mian wei shi yi wan 。]

english: Got a medpack? I feel terrible.
translation: 有医疗包吗？我感觉很糟糕。 [you yi liao bao ma ？ wo gan jue hen zao gao 。]

english: What happened to you?
translation: 你怎么了？ [ni zen me le ？]

english: Lizardman bite. There's always a fever after you've been bitten by one of those. I'm sure they don't clean their teeth.
translation: 蜥蜴人咬人。被其中之一咬后总是会发烧。我确信他们没有清洁牙齿。 [xi yi ren yao ren 。 bei qi zhong zhi yi yao hou zong shi hui fa shao 。 wo que xin ta men mei you qing jie ya chi 。]

english: Sorry, I haven't got one.
translation: 抱歉，我没有。 [bao qian ， wo mei you 。]

english: Try looking in the storage tents outside.
translation: 试着看看外面的储物帐篷。 [shi zhe kan kan wai mian de chu wu zhang peng 。]

english: Thanks for the medpack. I'm feeling a lot better now.
translation: 谢谢你的医疗包。我现在感觉好多了。 [xie xie ni de yi liao bao 。 wo xian zai gan jue hao duo le 。]

english: While you're here, you could help the war effort by fetching medpacks for my sick comrades. There'll be some in the storage tents outside.

english: I am Xorrah quo Sihar. I am one of the mystics of the Kahlith.
translation: 我是索拉·库·西哈尔。我是卡利斯的神秘主义者之一。 [wo shi suo la · ku · xi ha er 。 wo shi ka li si de shen mi zhu yi zhe zhi yi 。]
