translation: 余额？ [yu e ？]

english: For every death, there must be life. For every life, there must be a death. This is the balance.
translation: 对于每一次死亡，都必须有生命。每一个生命，都必然有一个死亡。这就是平衡。 [dui yu mei yi ci si wang ， dou bi xu you sheng ming 。 mei yi ge sheng ming ， dou bi ran you yi ge si wang 。 zhe jiu shi ping heng 。]

english: Our purpose, as taught to us by the Tasakaal, is to keep this balance, no matter the cost.
translation: 正如塔萨卡尔教给我们的那样，我们的目的是不惜一切代价保持这种平衡。 [zheng ru ta sa ka er jiao gei wo men de na yang ， wo men de mu di shi bu xi yi qie dai jia bao chi zhe zhong ping heng 。]

english: A mystic?
translation: 神秘主义者？ [shen mi zhu yi zhe ？]

english: Yes. All Kahlith serve the balance. To do this, we take on one of four roles.
translation: 是的。所有的 Kahlith 都服务于平衡。为此，我们扮演四个角色之一。 [shi de 。 suo you de  Kahlith  dou fu wu yu ping heng 。 wei ci ， wo men ban yan si ge jue se zhi yi 。]

english: My role is that of a mystic. I learn from the Tasakaal and then pass on their teachings.
translation: 我的角色是一个神秘主义者。我向塔萨卡尔学习，然后传承他们的教义。 [wo de jue se shi yi ge shen mi zhu yi zhe 。 wo xiang ta sa ka er xue xi ， ran hou chuan cheng ta men de jiao yi 。]

english: That's all thanks.
translation: 就这些了，谢谢。 [jiu zhe xie le ， xie xie 。]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: This is our home. In your tongue, it is known as Mount Karuulm.
translation: 这是我们的家。在你们的语言中，它被称为卡鲁尔姆山。 [zhe shi wo men de jia 。 zai ni men de yu yan zhong ， ta bei cheng wei ka lu er mu shan 。]

english: My tongue?
translation: 我的舌头？ [wo de she tou ？]

english: Yes. You speak the language of humans but we Kahlith have our own language.
translation: 是的。你们说人类的语言，但我们卡利斯有我们自己的语言。 [shi de 。 ni men shuo ren lei de yu yan ， dan wo men ka li si you wo men zi ji de yu yan 。]

english: In the past, we have tried to teach our language to your kind. However, despite the simplicity of our tongue, success was limited.
translation: 过去，我们曾尝试向你们传授我们的语言。然而，尽管我们的语言很简单，但成功却很有限。 [guo qu ， wo men ceng chang shi xiang ni men chuan shou wo men de yu yan 。 ran er ， jin guan wo men de yu yan hen jian dan ， dan cheng gong que hen you xian 。]

english: We find that it is easier to just use your language when your kind are around.
translation: 我们发现，当您的同类在身边时，使用您的语言会更容易。 [wo men fa xian ， dang nin de tong lei zai shen bian shi ， shi yong nin de yu yan hui geng rong yi 。]

english: Can you give an example?
translation: 你能举个例子吗？ [ni neng ju ge li zi ma ？]

english: Of our language?
translation: 我们的语言？ [wo men de yu yan ？]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: Well you'll find our language is quite a simple one. Our names are a good example of how it is used.
translation: 你会发现我们的语言非常简单。我们的名字就是它如何使用的一个很好的例子。 [ni hui fa xian wo men de yu yan fei chang jian dan 。 wo men de ming zi jiu shi ta ru he shi yong de yi ge hen hao de li zi 。]

english: I am Xorrah quo Sihar. The first word, 'Xorrah', is unique to me and it is how I can be identified.
translation: 我是索拉·库·西哈尔。第一个词“Xorrah”对我来说是独一无二的，这也是我被识别出来的方式。 [wo shi suo la · ku · xi ha er 。 di yi ge ci “Xorrah” dui wo lai shuo shi du yi wu er de ， zhe ye shi wo bei shi bie chu lai de fang shi 。]

english: The second word, 'quo', is a basic Kahlith word that translates to 'the' in your language.
translation: 第二个单词“quo”是一个基本的 Kahlith 单词，在您的语言中翻译为“the”。 [di er ge dan ci “quo” shi yi ge ji ben de  Kahlith  dan ci ， zai nin de yu yan zhong fan yi wei “the”。]

english: The final word, 'Sihar', is my title. There are four possible titles, one for each role in Kahlith society. My title translates to 'Mystic' in your tongue.
translation: 最后一个词“Sihar”是我的标题。有四种可能的头衔，每种头衔对应 Kahlith 社会中的每个角色。我的标题在你的语言中翻译为“神秘”。 [zui hou yi ge ci “Sihar” shi wo de biao ti 。 you si zhong ke neng de tou xian ， mei zhong tou xian dui ying  Kahlith  she hui zhong de mei ge jue se 。 wo de biao ti zai ni de yu yan zhong fan yi wei “ shen mi ”。]

english: So in my language your name would be Xorrah the Mystic?
translation: 那么，用我的语言来说，你的名字是神秘者克索拉（Xorrah the Mystic）？ [na me ， yong wo de yu yan lai shuo ， ni de ming zi shi shen mi zhe ke suo la （Xorrah the Mystic）？]

english: Exactly.
translation: 确切地。 [que qie di 。]

english: Interesting. Thanks for the information.
translation: 有趣的。感谢您提供信息。 [you qu de 。 gan xie nin ti gong xin xi 。]

english: I'm good thanks.
translation: 我很好谢谢。 [wo hen hao xie xie 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: Kahlith?
translation: 卡利斯？ [ka li si ？]

english: Tasakaal?
translation: 塔萨卡尔？ [ta sa ka er ？]

english: The balance?
translation: 余额？ [yu e ？]

english: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？ [zhe shi shen me di fang ？]

english: That's all thanks.
translation: 就这些了，谢谢。 [jiu zhe xie le ， xie xie 。]

english: A mystic?
translation: 神秘主义者？ [shen mi zhu yi zhe ？]

english: My tongue?
translation: 我的舌头？ [wo de she tou ？]

english: Can you give an example?
translation: 你能举个例子吗？ [ni neng ju ge li zi ma ？]

english: I'm good thanks.
translation: 我很好谢谢。 [wo hen hao xie xie 。]

english: Ahhh, hello there, [player name].
translation: 啊哈，你好，[玩家姓名]。 [a ha ， ni hao ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Can you tell me a bit about skillcapes?
translation: 你能告诉我一些关于技能的信息吗？ [ni neng gao su wo yi xie guan yu ji neng de xin xi ma ？]

english: Sure. You can buy a skillcape when you reach level 99 in a skill. Apart from boosting your statistics in that skill, they can also be used to perform some pretty amazing emotes!
translation: 当然。当你的技能达到99级时，你可以购买技能斗篷。除了提高该技能的统计数据之外，它们还可以用来执行一些非常惊人的表情！ [dang ran 。 dang ni de ji neng da dao 99 ji shi ， ni ke yi gou mai ji neng dou peng 。 chu le ti gao gai ji neng de tong ji shu ju zhi wai ， ta men hai ke yi yong lai zhi xing yi xie fei chang jing ren de biao qing ！]

english: The Cape of Strength also provides you with unlimited teleports to our guild. Is there anything else you would like to know?
translation: 力量海角还为您提供无限传送到我们公会的机会。您还有什么想知道的吗？ [li liang hai jiao hai wei nin ti gong wu xian chuan song dao wo men gong hui de ji hui 。 nin hai you shen me xiang zhi dao de ma ？]

english: What can I do here?
translation: 我在这里能做什么？ [wo zai zhe li neng zuo shen me ？]

english: Ahh, the shot put is a great test of strength and can be quite rewarding. Mind you do it properly though, you might want to dust your hands with some powdery substance first. It'll give better grip.
translation: 啊，铅球是对体力的极大考验，而且收获颇丰。不过请注意，操作得当，您可能需要先在手上撒上一些粉末状物质。它会提供更好的抓地力。 [a ， qian qiu shi dui ti li de ji da kao yan ， er qie shou huo po feng 。 bu guo qing zhu yi ， cao zuo de dang ， nin ke neng xu yao xian zai shou shang sa shang yi xie fen mo zhuang wu zhi 。 ta hui ti gong geng hao de zhua di li 。]

english: I'll remember that. What should I use?
translation: 我会记住这一点。我应该用什么？ [wo hui ji zhu zhe yi dian 。 wo ying gai yong shen me ？]

english: I personally prefer ground ashes, it makes a nice fine powder and gives some really good grip.
translation: 我个人更喜欢磨碎的灰烬，它可以制成很好的细粉末，并且具有很好的抓地力。 [wo ge ren geng xi huan mo sui de hui jin ， ta ke yi zhi cheng hen hao de xi fen mo ， bing qie ju you hen hao de zhua di li 。]

english: Ok, what else?
translation: 好吧，还有什么？ [hao ba ， hai you shen me ？]

english: Basically you'll need to go in there, make sure you've got nothing cluttering up your hands, pick up a shot and throw it.... depending upon your technique, you can get quite long throws.
translation: 基本上，你需要进去，确保你的手上没有任何杂物，拿起一个球并投掷……根据你的技术，你可以投出相当长的投球。 [ji ben shang ， ni xu yao jin qu ， que bao ni de shou shang mei you ren he za wu ， na qi yi ge qiu bing tou zhi …… gen ju ni de ji shu ， ni ke yi tou chu xiang dang zhang de tou qiu 。]

english: What was your best?
translation: 你最好的是什么？ [ni zui hao de shi shen me ？]

english: Ahh that would be telling...
translation: 啊啊，这样的话就说明了... [a a ， zhe yang de hua jiu shuo ming le ...]

english: Why are you wielding a tree branch?
translation: 你为何挥舞着树枝？ [ni wei he hui wu zhe shu zhi ？]

english: Well...there's a story to that. You see, I should have an axe but-
translation: 嗯……有一个故事。你看，我应该有一把斧子，但是—— [n …… you yi ge gu shi 。 ni kan ， wo ying gai you yi ba fu zi ， dan shi ——]

english: Sloane's axe?
translation: 斯隆的斧头？ [si long de fu tou ？]

english: My axe. He won it because of a squirrel.
translation: 我的斧头。他因为一只松鼠而赢得了冠军。 [wo de fu tou 。 ta yin wei yi zhi song shu er ying de le guan jun 。]

english: A squirrel?
translation: 松鼠？ [song shu ？]

english: He bet me that I couldn't catch the squirrel while still holding my axe, but that he could... Thing is, he tricked me! When it was his turn, he just chopped the tree down!
translation: 他跟我打赌，我手里拿着斧头是抓不到松鼠的，但他可以……事实是，他欺骗了我！轮到他的时候，他直接把树砍倒了！ [ta gen wo da du ， wo shou li na zhe fu tou shi zhua bu dao song shu de ， dan ta ke yi …… shi shi shi ， ta qi pian le wo ！ lun dao ta de shi hou ， ta zhi jie ba shu kan dao le ！]

english: I see. That doesn't explain why you have a tree branch though.
translation: 我懂了。但这并不能解释为什么你有树枝。 [wo dong le 。 dan zhe bing bu neng jie shi wei shen me ni you shu zhi 。]

english: A barbarian warrior is bound to his axe, I cannot take up another unless my axe is ruined beyond repair. So I used part of the tree that Sloane cut down as my weapon...it also reminds me of him.
translation: 一个野蛮人的战士被绑在他的斧头上，除非我的斧头毁坏到无法修复的程度，否则我不能拿起另一把斧头。所以我用了斯隆砍倒的那棵树的一部分作为我的武器……这也让我想起了他。 [yi ge ye man ren de zhan shi bei bang zai ta de fu tou shang ， chu fei wo de fu tou hui huai dao wu fa xiu fu de cheng du ， fou ze wo bu neng na qi ling yi ba fu tou 。 suo yi wo yong le si long kan dao de na ke shu de yi bu fen zuo wei wo de wu qi …… zhe ye rang wo xiang qi le ta 。]

english: He was a great warrior.
translation: 他是一位伟大的战士。 [ta shi yi wei wei da de zhan shi 。]

english: Yes, and a good friend, Still, he would want us to be happy that he is now with his warrior brethren. Can I help you with anything else?
translation: 是的，也是一个好朋友，不过，他希望我们为他现在和他的战士兄弟们在一起而感到高兴。我还可以帮您做其他事吗？ [shi de ， ye shi yi ge hao peng you ， bu guo ， ta xi wang wo men wei ta xian zai he ta de zhan shi xiong di men zai yi qi er gan dao gao xing 。 wo hai ke yi bang nin zuo qi ta shi ma ？]

english: May I claim my tokens please?
translation: 我可以领取我的代币吗？ [wo ke yi ling qu wo de dai bi ma ？]

english: I'm afraid you have not earned any tokens yet. Try some of the activities around the guild to earn some.
translation: 恐怕您还没有获得任何代币。尝试公会周围的一些活动来赚取一些钱。 [kong pa nin hai mei you huo de ren he dai bi 。 chang shi gong hui zhou wei de yi xie huo dong lai zhuan qu yi xie qian 。]

english: Ok, I'll go see what I can find.
translation: 好吧，我去看看我能找到什么。 [hao ba ， wo qu kan kan wo neng zhao dao shen me 。]

english: You don't have space to carry them.
translation: 你没有空间来携带它们。 [ni mei you kong jian lai xie dai ta men 。]

english: Of course! Here you go, you've earned [amount] tokens!
translation: 当然！在这里，您已经获得了[数量]个代币！ [dang ran ！ zai zhe li ， nin yi jing huo de le [ shu liang ] ge dai bi ！]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: Be well, warrior [player name].
translation: 一切都好，战士[玩家名字]。 [yi qie dou hao ， zhan shi [ wan jia ming zi ]。]

english: Ah, but I can see you are already as strong as is possible! Perhaps you have come to me to purchase a Cape of Strength, and thus join the elite few who have mastered this exacting skill?
translation: 啊，不过我看得出你已经很强了！也许你来找我是为了购买力量斗篷，从而加入掌握这项严格技能的少数精英行列？ [a ， bu guo wo kan de chu ni yi jing hen qiang le ！ ye xu ni lai zhao wo shi wei le gou mai li liang dou peng ， cong er jia ru zhang wo zhe xiang yan ge ji neng de shao shu jing ying hang lie ？]

english: As an additional recognition of your achievement, the Cape of Strength can teleport you to our guild.
translation: 作为对你成就的额外认可，力量斗篷可以将你传送到我们的公会。 [zuo wei dui ni cheng jiu de e wai ren ke ， li liang dou peng ke yi jiang ni chuan song dao wo men de gong hui 。]

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: 请问我可以再给我的披风戴上兜帽吗？ [qing wen wo ke yi zai gei wo de pi feng dai shang dou mao ma ？]

english: You don't appear to have enough space in your inventory, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 您的库存似乎没有足够的空间，当您有足够的空间时请回来见我。 [nin de ku cun si hu mei you zu gou de kong jian ， dang nin you zu gou de kong jian shi qing hui lai jian wo 。]

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
translation: 毫无疑问，而且免费！ [hao wu yi wen ， er qie mian fei ！]

english: May I buy a Skillcape of Strength, please?
translation: 请问我可以购买力量技能斗篷吗？ [qing wen wo ke yi gou mai li liang ji neng dou peng ma ？]

english: Hmm, yes, you certainly look strong enough. That'll be 99000 gold coins, please.
translation: 嗯，是的，你看起来确实足够坚强。那就99000金币吧。 [n ， shi de ， ni kan qi lai que shi zu gou jian qiang 。 na jiu 99000 jin bi ba 。]

english: Sorry, that's just too much to pay.
translation: 抱歉，付的钱太多了。 [bao qian ， fu de qian tai duo le 。]

english: Not at all; there are many other adventurers who would love the opportunity to purchase such a prestigious item! You can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: 一点也不;还有许多其他冒险家希望有机会购买如此享有盛誉的物品！如果你改变主意，可以在这里找到我。 [yi dian ye bu ; hai you xu duo qi ta mao xian jia xi wang you ji hui gou mai ru ci xiang you sheng yu de wu pin ！ ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi ， ke yi zai zhe li zhao dao wo 。]

english: Sure.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 但不幸的是，我身上没有足够的钱。 [dan bu xing de shi ， wo shen shang mei you zu gou de qian 。]

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 好吧，等你回来了就回来见我吧。 [hao ba ， deng ni hui lai le jiu hui lai jian wo ba 。]

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 不幸的是，所有技能斗篷都只提供免费兜帽，这是技能升级交易的一部分；买一送一，你懂的。因此，在我向您出售一件之前，您需要释放一些库存空间。 [bu xing de shi ， suo you ji neng dou peng dou zhi ti gong mian fei dou mao ， zhe shi ji neng sheng ji jiao yi de yi bu fen ； mai yi song yi ， ni dong de 。 yin ci ， zai wo xiang nin chu shou yi jian zhi qian ， nin xu yao shi fang yi xie ku cun kong jian 。]

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: 出色的！我的朋友，自豪地穿上那件斗篷。 [chu se de ！ wo de peng you ， zi hao di chuan shang na jian dou peng 。]

english: Can you tell me a bit about skillcapes?
translation: 你能告诉我一些关于技能的信息吗？ [ni neng gao su wo yi xie guan yu ji neng de xin xi ma ？]

english: What can I do here?
translation: 我在这里能做什么？ [wo zai zhe li neng zuo shen me ？]

english: Why are you wielding a tree branch?
translation: 你为何挥舞着树枝？ [ni wei he hui wu zhe shu zhi ？]

english: May I claim my tokens please?
translation: 我可以领取我的代币吗？ [wo ke yi ling qu wo de dai bi ma ？]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: May I buy a Skillcape of Strength, please?
translation: 请问我可以购买力量技能斗篷吗？ [qing wen wo ke yi gou mai li liang ji neng dou peng ma ？]

english: Skillcape
translation: 技能角 [ji neng jiao]

english: Hood
translation: 兜帽 [dou mao]

english: Sorry, that's just too much to pay.
translation: 抱歉，付的钱太多了。 [bao qian ， fu de qian tai duo le 。]

english: Sure.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 我要是像你那么丑我就不敢在大庭广众之下露脸了！ [wo yao shi xiang ni na me chou wo jiu bu gan zai da ting guang zhong zhi xia lou lian le ！]

english: Out of my way, punk.
translation: 别挡我的路，朋克。 [bie dang wo de lu ， peng ke 。]

english: Hmm... you smell strange...
translation: 嗯……你闻起来很奇怪…… [n …… ni wen qi lai hen qi guai ……]

english: Strange how?
translation: 奇怪怎么办？ [qi guai zen me ban ？]

english: Like a human!
translation: 像人一样！ [xiang ren yi yang ！]

english: Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 哦！呃……我刚吃了一个就是为什么！ [o ！ e …… wo gang chi le yi ge jiu shi wei shen me ！]

english: Leave me alone.
translation: 请别打扰我。 [qing bie da rao wo 。]

english: Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 如果你珍惜你的生命，就不要再跟我说话了！ [ru guo ni zhen xi ni de sheng ming ， jiu bu yao zai gen wo shuo hua le ！]

english: Get lost!
translation: 迷路！ [mi lu ！]

english: I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 我没有什么可以给你，所以让我一个人呆着吧，托钵僧。 [wo mei you shen me ke yi gei ni ， suo yi rang wo yi ge ren dai zhe ba ， tuo bo seng 。]

english: Have you no manners?
translation: 你没有礼貌吗？ [ni mei you li mao ma ？]

english: I don't have time for this right now.
translation: 我现在没有时间做这个。 [wo xian zai mei you shi jian zuo zhe ge 。]

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 我没有兴趣和像你这样的可怜虫说话。 [wo mei you xing qu he xiang ni zhe yang de ke lian chong shuo hua 。]

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
translation: 我打赌你有一双很棒的爪子。 [wo da du ni you yi shuang hen bang de zhua zi 。]

english: A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 非常痛苦的一天，总的来说……趁它持续的时候好好享受吧。 [fei chang tong ku de yi tian ， zong de lai shuo …… chen ta chi xu de shi hou hao hao xiang shou ba 。]

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: 如果你抓到任何人，答应我你会分享。 [ru guo ni zhua dao ren he ren ， da ying wo ni hui fen xiang 。]

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 我以前没在这儿闻过你的味道…… [wo yi qian mei zai zhe er wen guo ni de wei dao ……]

english: You smell familiar...
translation: 你闻起来很熟悉... [ni wen qi lai hen shu xi ...]

english: Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 看到这附近有人类吗？我饿了。 [kan dao zhe fu jin you ren lei ma ？ wo e le 。]

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 在我看来，你就像一个对血液有健康品味的人。 [zai wo kan lai ， ni jiu xiang yi ge dui xue ye you jian kang pin wei de ren 。]

english: Good day to you, my friend.
translation: 祝你美好的一天，我的朋友。 [zhu ni mei hao de yi tian ， wo de peng you 。]

english: Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
translation: 想去城堡吃点小吃吗？ [xiang qu cheng bao chi dian xiao chi ma ？]

english: Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: 等一下，我的牙齿里有一点东西卡住了…… [deng yi xia ， wo de ya chi li you yi dian dong xi ka zhu le ……]

english: Moo
translation: 哞 [mou]

english: Ah... [player name], welcome. I would offer you some water, but we don't get much of it down here.
translation: 啊...[玩家姓名]，欢迎。我想给你一些水，但我们这里没有太多水。 [a ...[ wan jia xing ming ]， huan ying 。 wo xiang gei ni yi xie shui ， dan wo men zhe li mei you tai duo shui 。]

english: Thanks...
translation: 谢谢... [xie xie ...]

english: I take it you have questions.
translation: 我想你一定有疑问。 [wo xiang ni yi ding you yi wen 。]

english: I do, but it is important that it is you who is asking for information, not me that is offering it.
translation: 我愿意，但重要的是，是您在询问信息，而不是我在提供信息。 [wo yuan yi ， dan zhong yao de shi ， shi nin zai xun wen xin xi ， er bu shi wo zai ti gong xin xi 。]

english: Okay... How are you still communicating with your followers?
translation: 好吧...你还如何与你的关注者沟通？ [hao ba ... ni hai ru he yu ni de guan zhu zhe gou tong ？]

english: I take it you have answers.
translation: 我想你已经有了答案。 [wo xiang ni yi jing you le da an 。]

english: I do, but I rarely share them umprompted.
translation: 我确实这样做，但我很少主动分享它们。 [wo que shi zhe yang zuo ， dan wo hen shao zhu dong fen xiang ta men 。]

english: Okay, how are you still communicating with your followers?
translation: 好吧，你还如何与你的关注者沟通？ [hao ba ， ni hai ru he yu ni de guan zhu zhe gou tong ？]

english: Yes, a few of them actually. How are you still communicating with your followers?
translation: 是的，实际上是其中一些。您仍然如何与您的关注者沟通？ [shi de ， shi ji shang shi qi zhong yi xie 。 nin reng ran ru he yu nin de guan zhu zhe gou tong ？]

english: Why, through my voice, of course.
translation: 为什么，当然是通过我的声音。 [wei shen me ， dang ran shi tong guo wo de sheng yin 。]

english: You know what I mean. How are you still communicating with your voice?
translation: 你知道我的意思。你还怎么用声音交流？ [ni zhi dao wo de yi si 。 ni hai zen me yong sheng yin jiao liu ？]

english: The same way I always have.
translation: 我一直都是这样。 [wo yi zhi dou shi zhe yang 。]

english: But the dark nullifier... I thought it was supposed to sever your connection.
translation: 但是黑暗无效器……我以为它应该切断你们的联系。 [dan shi hei an wu xiao qi …… wo yi wei ta ying gai qie duan ni men de lian xi 。]

english: Hmm... Yes, if anything could have done so, it would have been the power of the Dark Altar.
translation: 嗯……是的，如果有什么能做到这一点的话，那就是黑暗祭坛的力量了。 [n …… shi de ， ru guo you shen me neng zuo dao zhe yi dian de hua ， na jiu shi hei an ji tan de li liang le 。]

english: However, when your opponents have only one angle of approach, it makes them so predictable.
translation: 然而，当你的对手只有一种接近角度时，他们就会变得很容易预测。 [ran er ， dang ni de dui shou zhi you yi zhong jie jin jiao du shi ， ta men jiu hui bian de hen rong yi yu ce 。]

english: You knew we would try to use it?
translation: 你知道我们会尝试使用它吗？ [ni zhi dao wo men hui chang shi shi yong ta ma ？]

english: Yes. When I heard you would be hand delivering me a connection to the Dark Altar... Why, I was overjoyed.
translation: 是的。当我听说你会亲手为我提供通往黑暗祭坛的连接时……为什么，我欣喜若狂。 [shi de 。 dang wo ting shuo ni hui qin shou wei wo ti gong tong wang hei an ji tan de lian jie shi …… wei shen me ， wo xin xi ruo kuang 。]

english: But... I remember planting it! The plan went off without a hitch!
translation: 但是……我记得种过它！计划顺利进行！ [dan shi …… wo ji de zhong guo ta ！ ji hua shun li jin xing ！]

english: I do not doubt that you remember it that way.
translation: 我毫不怀疑你是这样记住的。 [wo hao bu huai yi ni shi zhe yang ji zhu de 。]

english: What did you do?!
translation: 你做了什么？！ [ni zuo le shen me ？！]

english: A simple transfiguration of the mind. My disciples granted you a memory of success. A fitting payment for your gratiousservice.
translation: 一个简单的心灵转变。我的弟子给了你成功的记忆。对您无私的服务给予适当的报酬。 [yi ge jian dan de xin ling zhuan bian 。 wo de di zi gei le ni cheng gong de ji yi 。 dui nin wu si de fu wu ji yu shi dang de bao chou 。]

english: You modified my memory?! That's only the second time someone has done that to me, and I wasn't very happy about it then either!
translation: 你修改了我的记忆？！那是第二次有人这样对我，当时我也不太高兴！ [ni xiu gai le wo de ji yi ？！ na shi di er ci you ren zhe yang dui wo ， dang shi wo ye bu tai gao xing ！]

english: Yes. And I have now answered five of your questions. I believe my generosity has been both demonstrated and exhausted.
translation: 是的。我现在已经回答了你们的五个问题。我相信我的慷慨已被展现，也已耗尽。 [shi de 。 wo xian zai yi jing hui da le ni men de wu ge wen ti 。 wo xiang xin wo de kang kai yi bei zhan xian ， ye yi hao jin 。]

english: You call that gloating generosity? If you didn't want something from me, I wouldn't still be down here. Get to the point.
translation: 你管这叫幸灾乐祸的慷慨？如果你不想从我这里得到什么，我就不会还在这儿了。进入正题吧。 [ni guan zhe jiao xing zai le huo de kang kai ？ ru guo ni bu xiang cong wo zhe li de dao shen me ， wo jiu bu hui hai zai zhe er le 。 jin ru zheng ti ba 。]

english: Hmm... Perhaps you are more astute than I thought. Very well, there is something that I want.
translation: 嗯……也许你比我想象的更精明。很好，有我想要的东西。 [n …… ye xu ni bi wo xiang xiang de geng jing ming 。 hen hao ， you wo xiang yao de dong xi 。]

english: Well you won't be getting it from me!
translation: 好吧，你不会从我这里得到它！ [hao ba ， ni bu hui cong wo zhe li de dao ta ！]

english: I am Yama. Every mortal desires something of mine. Ancient armaments? Hidden knowledge? Or perhaps a taste of revenge...
translation: 我是亚玛。每个凡人都渴望得到我的东西。古代兵器？隐藏知识？又或者是尝到了复仇的滋味…… [wo shi ya ma 。 mei ge fan ren dou ke wang de dao wo de dong xi 。 gu dai bing qi ？ yin cang zhi shi ？ you huo zhe shi chang dao le fu chou de zi wei ……]

english: These things could be yours.
translation: 这些东西可能是你的。 [zhe xie dong xi ke neng shi ni de 。]

english: Face me in combat. If you win, you take it all. Armaments, knowledge, revenge.
translation: 在战斗中面对我。如果你赢了，你就获得一切。武器、知识、复仇。 [zai zhan dou zhong mian dui wo 。 ru guo ni ying le ， ni jiu huo de yi qie 。 wu qi 、 zhi shi 、 fu chou 。]

english: And if I lose?
translation: 如果我输了呢？ [ru guo wo shu le ne ？]

english: I take your soul. For all of eternity.
translation: 我带走你的灵魂。为了永恒。 [wo dai zou ni de ling hun 。 wei le yong heng 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: I see. Perhaps we could lower the stakes then.
translation: 我懂了。也许我们可以降低赌注。 [wo dong le 。 ye xu wo men ke yi jiang di du zhu 。]

english: I will face you in an inhibited form. I'll even allow you to bring an ally, provided they have entered the same contract.
translation: 我将以一种压抑的形式面对你。我什至允许你带一个盟友，只要他们签订了相同的合同。 [wo jiang yi yi zhong ya yi de xing shi mian dui ni 。 wo shen zhi yun xu ni dai yi ge meng you ， zhi yao ta men qian ding le xiang tong de he tong 。]

english: If you win, I will give you a chance to gain some of my treasures, and of course, you will have sampled your revenge.
translation: 如果你赢了，我会给你一个获得我的一些宝物的机会，当然，你也会尝到你的复仇滋味。 [ru guo ni ying le ， wo hui gei ni yi ge huo de wo de yi xie bao wu de ji hui ， dang ran ， ni ye hui chang dao ni de fu chou zi wei 。]

english: When you take your final rest, I shall take your soul for a year. A drop in the ocean compared to eternity.
translation: 当你最后休息时，我将带走你的灵魂一年。与永恒相比，沧海一粟。 [dang ni zui hou xiu xi shi ， wo jiang dai zou ni de ling hun yi nian 。 yu yong heng xiang bi ， cang hai yi su 。]

english: How can I know you'll keep your word?
translation: 我怎么知道你会遵守诺言？ [wo zen me zhi dao ni hui zun shou nuo yan ？]

english: The same way I will know you shall keep yours. A binding contract. As luck would have it, I had one of my scribes draft one up for just such an occasion.
translation: 同样的，我会知道你会保留你的。具有约束力的合同。幸运的是，我让我的一位抄写员为这样的场合起草了一份。 [tong yang de ， wo hui zhi dao ni hui bao liu ni de 。 ju you yue shu li de he tong 。 xing yun de shi ， wo rang wo de yi wei chao xie yuan wei zhe yang de chang he qi cao le yi fen 。]

english: ...Okay.
translation: ...好的。 [... hao de 。]

english: Sign right here.
translation: 就在这里签名。 [jiu zai zhe li qian ming 。]

english: Excellent... Challenge me when you are ready, [player name]. I very much look forward to it.
translation: 太棒了...当你准备好时挑战我，[玩家名字]。我非常期待。 [tai bang le ... dang ni zhun bei hao shi tiao zhan wo ，[ wan jia ming zi ]。 wo fei chang qi dai 。]

english: I'm not sure I want to...
translation: 我不确定我想... [wo bu que ding wo xiang ...]

english: Of course. There is no rush. Leave, with your tail tucked between your legs. If you grow a spine and wish to fulfil your revenge, I will be waiting.
translation: 当然。不着急。离开，把尾巴夹在两腿之间。如果你有骨气，想报仇，我就等着。 [dang ran 。 bu zhao ji 。 li kai ， ba wei ba jia zai liang tui zhi jian 。 ru guo ni you gu qi ， xiang bao chou ， wo jiu deng zhe 。]

english: You are back. Excellent. I have little time for cowards. If you are ready, I will retrieve the contract.
translation: 你回来了。出色的。我没有时间和胆小鬼相处。如果你准备好了，我会取回合同。 [ni hui lai le 。 chu se de 。 wo mei you shi jian he dan xiao gui xiang chu 。 ru guo ni zhun bei hao le ， wo hui qu hui he tong 。]

english: Welcome, [player name]. Have you come to challenge me?
translation: 欢迎，[玩家姓名]。你是来挑战我的吗？ [huan ying ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。 ni shi lai tiao zhan wo de ma ？]

english: Yes. Let's do this.
translation: 是的。让我们这样做吧。 [shi de 。 rang wo men zhe yang zuo ba 。]

english: Yama snaps his fingers and teleports off his throne.
translation: 阎摩打了个响指，传送离开了王座。 [yan mo da le ge xiang zhi ， chuan song li kai le wang zuo 。]

english: Actually, I have some questions.
translation: 其实我有一些疑问。 [qi shi wo you yi xie yi wen 。]

english: Of course.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: There's something in our contract about additional contracts... Why would I want to sign any more of them?
translation: 我们的合同中有关于附加合同的内容...为什么我想再签署更多合同？ [wo men de he tong zhong you guan yu fu jia he tong de nei rong ... wei shen me wo xiang zai qian shu geng duo he tong ？]

english: As outlined in subsection C, if you wish for your revenge to feel more 'real', I am willing to lift some of the restrictions placed by the original contract.
translation: 正如 C 小节所述，如果您希望复仇感觉更加“真实”，我愿意解除原始合同中的一些限制。 [zheng ru  C  xiao jie suo shu ， ru guo nin xi wang fu chou gan jue geng jia “ zhen shi ”， wo yuan yi jie chu yuan shi he tong zhong de yi xie xian zhi 。]

english: Why would I want that?
translation: 我为什么想要那个？ [wo wei shen me xiang yao na ge ？]

english: You seem to enjoy self-imposed difficulty. I thought I would indulge you.
translation: 你似乎很享受自我施加的困难。我以为我会纵容你。 [ni si hu hen xiang shou zi wo shi jia de kun nan 。 wo yi wei wo hui zong rong ni 。]

english: You may not, in which case you can sell them to someone with greater respect for themselves. But if you do, the option is there.
translation: 您可能不会，在这种情况下，您可以将它们卖给更尊重自己的人。但如果你这样做，就有选择。 [nin ke neng bu hui ， zai zhe zhong qing kuang xia ， nin ke yi jiang ta men mai gei geng zun zhong zi ji de ren 。 dan ru guo ni zhe yang zuo ， jiu you xuan ze 。]

english: And if you manage to claim victory, there is of course a reward for each contract.
translation: 如果你成功取得了胜利，当然每份合同都会有奖励。 [ru guo ni cheng gong qu de le sheng li ， dang ran mei fen he tong du hui you jiang li 。]

english: Okay, can I see the contracts?
translation: 好的，我可以看看合同吗？ [hao de ， wo ke yi kan kan he tong ma ？]

english: No. For this, I require from you a service. My demons are... Lacking, of late. Unrefined.
translation: 不。为此，我需要您提供服务。我的恶魔……最近缺乏了。粗。 [bu 。 wei ci ， wo xu yao nin ti gong fu wu 。 wo de e mo …… zui jin que fa le 。 cu 。]

english: They must fight, suffer and reform. If you deliver them specific ends during your 'tasks' in my domain, they may leave behind a contract.
translation: 他们必须战斗、受苦和改革。如果你在我的领域中执行“任务”期间向他们交付特定的目标，他们可能会留下一份合同。 [ta men bi xu zhan dou 、 shou ku he gai ge 。 ru guo ni zai wo de ling yu zhong zhi xing “ ren wu ” qi jian xiang ta men jiao fu te ding de mu biao ， ta men ke neng hui liu xia yi fen he tong 。]

english: And of course, if you defeat me, I may also reward you with one.
translation: 当然，如果你打败了我，我也可能会奖励你一份。 [dang ran ， ru guo ni da bai le wo ， wo ye ke neng hui jiang li ni yi fen 。]

english: What kinds of 'ends'?
translation: 什么样的“结局”？ [shen me yang de “ jie ju ”？]

english: Death by two-handed melee weapons, heavy ranged weapons, magic spells, special attacks, and defeating them whilst bound. Each kind may award a different contract.
translation: 通过双手近战武器、重型远程武器、魔法咒语、特殊攻击以及在被束缚时击败它们而死亡。每种类型可能授予不同的合同。 [tong guo shuang shou jin zhan wu qi 、 zhong xing yuan cheng wu qi 、 mo fa zhou yu 、 te shu gong ji yi ji zai bei shu fu shi ji bai ta men er si wang 。 mei zhong lei xing ke neng shou yu bu tong de he tong 。]

english: If you find yourself eager to obtain any contract, I will use a glyph to indicate my preferred method, which you can utilise for a better chance to receive that contract.
translation: 如果您发现自己渴望获得任何合同，我将使用一个字形来指示我的首选方法，您可以利用它来获得更好的机会获得该合同。 [ru guo nin fa xian zi ji ke wang huo de ren he he tong ， wo jiang shi yong yi ge zi xing lai zhi shi wo de shou xuan fang fa ， nin ke yi li yong ta lai huo de geng hao de ji hui huo de gai he tong 。]

english: What kinds of contracts can I obtain?
translation: 我可以获得哪些类型的合同？ [wo ke yi huo de na xie lei xing de he tong ？]

english: Were you more adept at reading you would find the details in our original contract. Otherwise, bring any you obtain to me and I shall explain then.
translation: 如果您更善于阅读，您会在我们的原始合同中找到详细信息。否则，请将您获得的任何内容带给我，然后我将向您解释。 [ru guo nin geng shan yu yue du ， nin hui zai wo men de yuan shi he tong zhong zhao dao xiang xi xin xi 。 fou ze ， qing jiang nin huo de de ren he nei rong dai gei wo ， ran hou wo jiang xiang nin jie shi 。]

english: Do you keep any record of our fights?
translation: 你有我们吵架的记录吗？ [ni you wo men chao jia de ji lu ma ？]

english: I do, I can have somebody retrieve your file. One moment.
translation: 我愿意，我可以让人取回你的文件。一会儿。 [wo yuan yi ， wo ke yi rang ren qu hui ni de wen jian 。 yi hui er 。]

english: A mail-imp holding a scroll appears. Yama smites the imp.
translation: 出现了一个拿着卷轴的邮件小鬼。阎罗击杀了小恶魔。 [chu xian le yi ge na zhe juan zhou de you jian xiao gui 。 yan luo ji sha le xiao e mo 。]

english: For your reading pleasure.
translation: 为了您的阅读乐趣。 [wei le nin de yue du le qu 。]

english: That's all.
translation: 就这样。 [jiu zhe yang 。]

english: No, I'd rather not.
translation: 不，我宁愿不。 [bu ， wo ning yuan bu 。]

english: I see. Perhaps you are just here to waste my time then? Return when you are not.
translation: 我懂了。也许你只是来这里浪费我的时间？当你不在的时候就回来。 [wo dong le 。 ye xu ni zhi shi lai zhe li lang fei wo de shi jian ？ dang ni bu zai de shi hou jiu hui lai 。]

english: Your strike lacks bite.
translation: 你的攻击缺乏力量。 [ni de gong ji que fa li liang 。]

english: A change of pace.
translation: 节奏的改变。 [jie zou de gai bian 。]

english: Colabi, infernus
translation: 科拉比，地狱火 [ke la bi ， di yu huo]

english: Ven, estella infernus
translation: 地狱火星 [di yu huo xing]

english: Colabesur infernus
translation: 地狱火龙 [di yu huo long]

english: Ven, umbra eclipta
translation: 旱莲草 [han lian cao]

english: Umbra, proriumpse
translation: 本影、proriumpse [ben ying 、proriumpse]

english: Umbra apprerendehe
translation: 本影感知 [ben ying gan zhi]

english: Begone
translation: 滚开 [gun kai]

english: You bore me.
translation: 你让我厌烦了。 [ni rang wo yan fan le 。]

english: Enough.
translation: 足够的。 [zu gou de 。]

english: Lacking.
translation: 缺乏。 [que fa 。]

english: Pathetic.
translation: 可怜的。 [ke lian de 。]

english: The price is paid.
translation: 代价已付。 [dai jia yi fu 。]

english: Fair is fair.
translation: 公平就是公平。 [gong ping jiu shi gong ping 。]

english: Your reward, as agreed.
translation: 按照约定，您的奖励。 [an zhao yue ding ， nin de jiang li 。]

english: A satisfying warmup. Collect your loot and let us continue.
translation: 令人满意的热身。收集你的战利品，让我们继续。 [ling ren man yi de re shen 。 shou ji ni de zhan li pin ， rang wo men ji xu 。]

english: A passing performance.
translation: 一场过关的表演。 [yi chang guo guan de biao yan 。]

english: A close fight. Your nerve was well held.
translation: 一场近战。你的神经控制得很好。 [yi chang jin zhan 。 ni de shen jing kong zhi de hen hao 。]

english: A good risk, adequately rewarded.
translation: 良好的风险，充足的回报。 [liang hao de feng xian ， chong zu de hui bao 。]

english: Excellent performance. Again?
translation: 性能优良。再次？ [xing neng you liang 。 zai ci ？]

english: Effective, if a bit cowardly.
translation: 有效，虽然有点胆怯。 [you xiao ， sui ran you dian dan qie 。]

english: Risk averse, are we?
translation: 我们厌恶风险，是吗？ [wo men yan wu feng xian ， shi ma ？]

english: Missed the fine print, did we? Our contract forbids you from picking up stashed items.
translation: 错过了细则，是吗？我们的合同禁止您拾取藏匿的物品。 [cuo guo le xi ze ， shi ma ？ wo men de he tong jin zhi nin shi qu cang ni de wu pin 。]

english: I hope you are finding the spoils from my treasury to your liking. There are plenty more for you to claim.
translation: 我希望你能从我的宝库中找到你喜欢的战利品。还有更多等着你去索取。 [wo xi wang ni neng cong wo de bao ku zhong zhao dao ni xi huan de zhan li pin 。 hai you geng duo deng zhe ni qu suo qu 。]

english: Your victories mount. You are getting better at this.

english: What a shame for our last bout to have ended that way! Maybe you will do better next time.

english: Back after being defeated so quickly? I suppose what you lack in skill you make up for with perseverance.

translation: 好吧，如果你要无礼的话，我会去找其他人。 [hao ba ， ru guo ni yao wu li de hua ， wo hui qu zhao qi ta ren 。]

english: Somebody else? Who? Introduce me to this paragon of virtue, who can tolerate the torrent of spittle you call speech. The incoherent messes you call sentences.
translation: 还有其他人吗？ WHO？给我介绍一下这位美德典范，他能容忍你所谓的言论滔滔不绝。语无伦次的混乱称为句子。 [hai you qi ta ren ma ？ WHO？ gei wo jie shao yi xia zhe wei mei de dian fan ， ta neng rong ren ni suo wei de yan lun tao tao bu jue 。 yu wu lun ci de hun luan cheng wei ju zi 。]

english: I have plenty of friends!
translation: 我有很多朋友！ [wo you hen duo peng you ！]

english: Oh yes, your friends. And do these friends, perhaps, live very far away? Are they perhaps too busy to meet up frequently?
translation: 哦，是的，你的朋友们。也许这些朋友住得很远？他们是否可能太忙而无法经常见面？ [o ， shi de ， ni de peng you men 。 ye xu zhe xie peng you zhu de hen yuan ？ ta men shi fou ke neng tai mang er wu fa jing chang jian mian ？]

english: Well...
translation: 出色地... [chu se di ...]

english: The next time I am left stranded by your incompetence, which I'm sure won't take long, do us both a favour and don't reclaim me.
translation: 下次当我因你的无能而陷入困境时（我相信不会花很长时间），请帮我们俩一个忙，不要收回我。 [xia ci dang wo yin ni de wu neng er xian ru kun jing shi （ wo xiang xin bu hui hua hen zhang shi jian ）， qing bang wo men lia yi ge mang ， bu yao shou hui wo 。]

english: I could incinerate you if I wanted.
translation: 如果我愿意，我可以烧死你。 [ru guo wo yuan yi ， wo ke yi shao si ni 。]

english: I'm holding back because this house is actually habitable.
translation: 我犹豫了，因为这房子实际上适合居住。 [wo you yu le ， yin wei zhe fang zi shi ji shang shi he ju zhu 。]

english: Oh no.
translation: 哦不。 [o bu 。]

english: Get your hands off of m-
translation: 把你的手拿开- [ba ni de shou na kai -]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
translation: 呜呜呜呜呜呜 [wu wu wu wu wu wu]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: How are you doing?
translation: 你好吗？ [ni hao ma ？]

english: Meh, I don't want to talk about it.
translation: 嗯，我不想谈论这个。 [n ， wo bu xiang tan lun zhe ge 。]

english: Oh ummm... fair enough. Goodbye.
translation: 哦，嗯……很公平。再见。 [o ， n …… hen gong ping 。 zai jian 。]

english: Not too well. I miss my friend. She couldn't join us here today.
translation: 不太好。我想念我的朋友。她今天无法加入我们这里。 [bu tai hao 。 wo xiang nian wo de peng you 。 ta jin tian wu fa jia ru wo men zhe li 。]

english: Why couldn't she join you?
translation: 为什么她不能加入你？ [wei shen me ta bu neng jia ru ni ？]

english: She had some afterlife business to take care of. Nieve's always so busy.
translation: 她还有一些来世的事情要处理。尼芙总是那么忙。 [ta hai you yi xie lai shi de shi qing yao chu li 。 ni fu zong shi na me mang 。]

english: Nieve? I used to know a Nieve, but she died during horrible circumstances.
translation: 尼芙？我曾经认识一个妮芙，但她在可怕的情况下去世了。 [ni fu ？ wo ceng jing ren shi yi ge ni fu ， dan ta zai ke pa de qing kuang xia qu shi le 。]

english: Really? You must be [player name]! She talks about you a lot.
translation: 真的吗？你一定是[玩家姓名]！她经常谈论你。 [zhen de ma ？ ni yi ding shi [ wan jia xing ming ]！ ta jing chang tan lun ni 。]

english: Does she? I miss her. Steve is alright, but... he's not Nieve.
translation: 她是吗？我想念她。 Steve is alright, but... he's not Nieve. [ta shi ma ？ wo xiang nian ta 。 Steve is alright, but... he's not Nieve.]

english: Anyway, please send her my regards and let her know that I avenged her death.
translation: 不管怎样，请代我向她问好，让她知道我为她报了仇。 [bu guan zen yang ， qing dai wo xiang ta wen hao ， rang ta zhi dao wo wei ta bao le chou 。]

english: I will.
translation: 我会。 [wo hui 。]

english: Hello there!
translation: 你好呀！ [ni hao ya ！]

english: Greetings Bwana! My name is Yanni and I buy and sell antiques.
translation: 问候布瓦纳！我叫雅尼，我买卖古董。 [wen hou bu wa na ！ wo jiao ya ni ， wo mai mai gu dong 。]

english: Tell me about this antiques business.
translation: 跟我说说这个古董生意吧。 [gen wo shuo shuo zhe ge gu dong sheng yi ba 。]

english: I buy antiques and other interesting items. If you have any interesting items that you might want to sell me, please let me see them and I'll offer you a fair price.
translation: 我买古董和其他有趣的物品。如果您有任何有趣的物品想卖给我，请让我看看，我会给您一个公平的价格。 [wo mai gu dong he qi ta you qu de wu pin 。 ru guo nin you ren he you qu de wu pin xiang mai gei wo ， qing rang wo kan kan ， wo hui gei nin yi ge gong ping de jia ge 。]

english: Would you like me to have a look at your items and give you a quote?
translation: 您想让我看看您的物品并给您报价吗？ [nin xiang rang wo kan kan nin de wu pin bing gei nin bao jia ma ？]

english: Yes please!
translation: 是的，请！ [shi de ， qing ！]

english: Sorry Bwana, you have nothing I am interested in.
translation: 抱歉，Bwana，你没有我感兴趣的东西。 [bao qian ，Bwana， ni mei you wo gan xing qu de dong xi 。]

english: I'll give you 100 coins for the Bone Key...
translation: 我会给你 100 个硬币来换取骨钥匙…… [wo hui gei ni  100  ge ying bi lai huan qu gu yao shi ……]

english: I'll give you 100 coins for the Stone Plaque...
translation: 我给你100金币换石牌…… [wo gei ni 100 jin bi huan shi pai ……]

english: I'll give you 100 coins for the tattered scroll...
translation: 我给你100金币买破烂的卷轴…… [wo gei ni 100 jin bi mai po lan de juan zhou ……]

english: I'll give you 100 coins for the crumpled scroll...
translation: 我会给你 100 个硬币来买皱巴巴的卷轴...... [wo hui gei ni  100  ge ying bi lai mai zhou ba ba de juan zhou ......]

english: I'll give you 500 coins for your locating crystal...
translation: 我给你500金币换你的定位水晶…… [wo gei ni 500 jin bi huan ni de ding wei shui jing ……]

english: I'll give you 1000 coins for your 'Beads of the Dead'...
translation: 我会给你1000金币换你的‘亡者之珠’…… [wo hui gei ni 1000 jin bi huan ni de ‘ wang zhe zhi zhu ’……]

english: And that's the only item I am interested in. If you want to sell me that item, simply show it to me.
translation: 这是我唯一感兴趣的商品。如果您想卖给我该商品，只需将其展示给我即可。 [zhe shi wo wei yi gan xing qu de shang pin 。 ru guo nin xiang mai gei wo gai shang pin ， zhi xu jiang qi zhan shi gei wo ji ke 。]

english: Those are the items I am interested in Bwana. If you want to sell me those items, simply show them to me.
translation: 这些是我对 Bwana 感兴趣的项目。如果您想卖给我这些物品，只需将它们展示给我即可。 [zhe xie shi wo dui  Bwana  gan xing qu de xiang mu 。 ru guo nin xiang mai gei wo zhe xie wu pin ， zhi xu jiang ta men zhan shi gei wo ji ke 。]

english: Maybe some other time?
translation: 也许其他时间？ [ye xu qi ta shi jian ？]

english: Sure thing. Have a nice day Bwana.
translation: 当然可以。祝布瓦纳有美好的一天。 [dang ran ke yi 。 zhu bu wa na you mei hao de yi tian 。]

english: Do you have any interesting items for sale?
translation: 有什么有趣的商品出售吗？ [you shen me you qu de shang pin chu shou ma ？]

english: Sorry, [Sir/Madam], I have nothing that you need.
translation: 抱歉，[先生/女士]，我没有您需要的东西。 [bao qian ，[ xian sheng / nv shi ]， wo mei you nin xu yao de dong xi 。]

english: Hmm, sorry, not interested.
translation: 嗯，抱歉，不感兴趣。 [n ， bao qian ， bu gan xing qu 。]

english: Fair enough, come back if you change your mind.
translation: 公平地说，如果你改变主意就回来。 [gong ping di shuo ， ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi jiu hui lai 。]

english: That's a great bone key. Here's 100 coins for it.
translation: 这是一把很棒的骨钥匙。这是 100 个硬币。 [zhe shi yi ba hen bang de gu yao shi 。 zhe shi  100  ge ying bi 。]

english: That's a great crumpled scroll. Here's 100 coins for it.
translation: 那是一个皱巴巴的大卷轴。这是 100 个硬币。 [na shi yi ge zhou ba ba de da juan zhou 。 zhe shi  100  ge ying bi 。]

english: That's a great tattered scroll. Here's 100 coins for it.
translation: 那是一个伟大的破烂的卷轴。这是 100 个硬币。 [na shi yi ge wei da de po lan de juan zhou 。 zhe shi  100  ge ying bi 。]

english: That's a great copy of Bervirius notes. Here's 100 coins for it.
translation: 这是贝维留斯笔记的一份很棒的副本。这是 100 个硬币。 [zhe shi bei wei liu si bi ji de yi fen hen bang de fu ben 。 zhe shi  100  ge ying bi 。]

english: That's a great Locating Crystal. Here's 500 coins for it.
translation: 这是一块很棒的定位水晶。这是 500 个硬币。 [zhe shi yi kuai hen bang de ding wei shui jing 。 zhe shi  500  ge ying bi 。]

english: That's a great stone-plaque. Here's 100 coins for it.
translation: 那是一块很棒的石匾。这是 100 个硬币。 [na shi yi kuai hen bang de shi bian 。 zhe shi  100  ge ying bi 。]

english: Impressive necklace there, here's 1000 coins for it.
translation: 那里有条令人印象深刻的项链，这里有 1000 枚硬币。 [na li you tiao ling ren yin xiang shen ke de xiang lian ， zhe li you  1000  mei ying bi 。]

english: Ah you'd like to sell this to me would you? I can offer you 5000 coins!
translation: 啊，你想把这个卖给我吗？我可以给你5000金币！ [a ， ni xiang ba zhe ge mai gei wo ma ？ wo ke yi gei ni 5000 jin bi ！]

english: Yes, I'll sell it for 5000 coins.
translation: 是的，我会卖5000金币。 [shi de ， wo hui mai 5000 jin bi 。]

english: Very well my friend, let me count out your reward.
translation: 很好，我的朋友，让我算一下你的奖励。 [hen hao ， wo de peng you ， rang wo suan yi xia ni de jiang li 。]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: No, I think I'll hold on it a while longer yet.
translation: 不，我想我还会再坚持一段时间。 [bu ， wo xiang wo hai hui zai jian chi yi duan shi jian 。]

english: Very well my friend, come back if you change your mind.
translation: 很好，我的朋友，如果你改变主意就回来吧。 [hen hao ， wo de peng you ， ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi jiu hui lai ba 。]

english: Tell me about this antiques business.
translation: 跟我说说这个古董生意吧。 [gen wo shuo shuo zhe ge gu dong sheng yi ba 。]

english: Yes please!
translation: 是的，请！ [shi de ， qing ！]

english: Maybe some other time?
translation: 也许其他时间？ [ye xu qi ta shi jian ？]

english: Do you have any interesting items for sale?
translation: 有什么有趣的商品出售吗？ [you shen me you qu de shang pin chu shou ma ？]

english: Hmm, sorry, not interested.
translation: 嗯，抱歉，不感兴趣。 [n ， bao qian ， bu gan xing qu 。]

english: Yes, I'll sell it for 5000
translation: 是的，我卖5000 [shi de ， wo mai 5000]

english: No, I think I'll hold on it a while longer yet.
translation: 不，我想我还会再坚持一段时间。 [bu ， wo xiang wo hai hui zai jian chi yi duan shi jian 。]

english: Fancy some pie? Mine are far better than any you'll find up on the surface.
translation: 想吃点馅饼吗？我的比你在地面上找到的任何东西都要好得多。 [xiang chi dian xian bing ma ？ wo de bi ni zai di mian shang zhao dao de ren he dong xi dou yao hao de duo 。]

english: I'll take a look.
translation: 我去看看。 [wo qu kan kan 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Fine. Enjoy your human muck then.
translation: 美好的。那就享受你的人类粪便吧。 [mei hao de 。 na jiu xiang shou ni de ren lei fen bian ba 。]

english: I'll take a look.
translation: 我去看看。 [wo qu kan kan 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Good day to you, welcome to my pickaxe shop. Are you interested in making a purchase?
translation: 祝你美好的一天，欢迎来到我的镐店。您有兴趣购买吗？ [zhu ni mei hao de yi tian ， huan ying lai dao wo de gao dian 。 nin you xing qu gou mai ma ？]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Suit yourself. I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 适合自己。如果你改变主意我会在这里。 [shi he zi ji 。 ru guo ni gai bian zhu yi wo hui zai zhe li 。]

english: Yes please.
translation: 是的，请。 [shi de ， qing 。]

english: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。 [bu ， xie xie 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: You don't look very well. Are you alright?
translation: 你看起来不太好。你还好吗？ [ni kan qi lai bu tai hao 。 ni hai hao ma ？]

english: No, I'm dead.
translation: 不，我死了。 [bu ， wo si le 。]

english: Dead as in... feeling a bit under the weather?
translation: 死了就像……感觉有点不舒服？ [si le jiu xiang …… gan jue you dian bu shu fu ？]

english: No, dead as in I got stabbed and died.
translation: 不，死了，就像我被刺伤而死一样。 [bu ， si le ， jiu xiang wo bei ci shang er si yi yang 。]

english: That's awful! How are you still here? And how can you still talk?
translation: 太糟糕了！你怎么还在这里？而且你怎么还能说话呢？ [tai zao gao le ！ ni zen me hai zai zhe li ？ er qie ni zen me hai neng shuo hua ne ？]

english: Eve brought me back from the afterlife. She's a party lion, that one.
translation: 夏娃把我从来世带了回来。她是派对上的一头狮子。 [xia wa ba wo cong lai shi dai le hui lai 。 ta shi pai dui shang de yi tou shi zi 。]

english: How could she bring you back from the afterlife?
translation: 她怎么能把你从死后带回来呢？ [ta zen me neng ba ni cong si hou dai hui lai ne ？]

english: I'm not sure how the magic works exactly. Only Eve knows that. All I know is that she usually does this every year.
translation: 我不确定魔法到底是如何运作的。只有伊芙知道这一点。我只知道她通常每年都会这样做。 [wo bu que ding mo fa dao di shi ru he yun zuo de 。 zhi you yi fu zhi dao zhe yi dian 。 wo zhi zhi dao ta tong chang mei nian du hui zhe yang zuo 。]

english: I didn't see her around last year. Are you sure she always comes here?
translation: 去年我就没见过她。你确定她经常来这里吗？ [qu nian wo jiu mei jian guo ta 。 ni que ding ta jing chang lai zhe li ma ？]

english: She returns to the world of the living every year. That doesn't mean she has to go to Lumbridge Swamp every year.
translation: 她每年都会回到人世。这并不意味着她每年都必须去朗布里奇沼泽。 [ta mei nian du hui hui dao ren shi 。 zhe bing bu yi wei zhe ta mei nian dou bi xu qu lang bu li qi zhao ze 。]

english: Fair enough.
translation: 很公平。 [hen gong ping 。]

english: What more can you tell me about the afterlife?
translation: 关于来世，你还能告诉我什么吗？ [guan yu lai shi ， ni hai neng gao su wo shen me ma ？]

english: Not a lot. Most of it you'd have to see for yourself.
translation: 不是很多。其中大部分内容您必须亲自查看。 [bu shi hen duo 。 qi zhong da bu fen nei rong nin bi xu qin zi cha kan 。]

english: I don't feel quite ready for that yet.
translation: 我觉得还没有准备好。 [wo jue de hai mei you zhun bei hao 。]

english: And I was going to offer you a quick way there... what a shame.
translation: 我本想为你提供一条快速到达那里的方法……真可惜。 [wo ben xiang wei ni ti gong yi tiao kuai su dao da na li de fang fa …… zhen ke xi 。]

english: Whelp. I should go.
translation: 仔。我该走了。 [zai 。 wo gai zou le 。]

english: Why do you choose to come back?
translation: 为什么选择回来？ [wei shen me xuan ze hui lai ？]

english: While the afterlife is not that bad, I do sometimes miss some things from when I used to be alive. There's nothing quite like Eve's special brew.
translation: 虽然来世并没有那么糟糕，但有时我确实会怀念一些生前的事情。没有什么比夏娃的特制啤酒更好的了。 [sui ran lai shi bing mei you na me zao gao ， dan you shi wo que shi hui huai nian yi xie sheng qian de shi qing 。 mei you shen me bi xia wa de te zhi pi jiu geng hao de le 。]

english: So you just come here for fun? Like on holiday?
translation: 所以你来这里只是为了好玩？喜欢度假吗？ [suo yi ni lai zhe li zhi shi wei le hao wan ？ xi huan du jia ma ？]

english: You could say that. I could always come back to haunt people, but that gets tedious after a while. I'd much rather enjoy my time here.
translation: 你可以这么说。我总是可以回来困扰别人，但过了一段时间就会变得乏味。我更愿意享受在这里的时光。 [ni ke yi zhe me shuo 。 wo zong shi ke yi hui lai kun rao bie ren ， dan guo le yi duan shi jian jiu hui bian de fa wei 。 wo geng yuan yi xiang shou zai zhe li de shi guang 。]

english: Well I'm glad you're not causing any harm by being here.
translation: 嗯，我很高兴你在这里没有造成任何伤害。 [n ， wo hen gao xing ni zai zhe li mei you zao cheng ren he shang hai 。]

english: The only way I'd cause harm is if someone were to interrupt my enjoying this party.
translation: 我造成伤害的唯一方法是有人打扰我享受这个聚会。 [wo zao cheng shang hai de wei yi fang fa shi you ren da rao wo xiang shou zhe ge ju hui 。]

english: ... I should go.
translation: ……我该走了。 […… wo gai zou le 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: What more can you tell me about the afterlife?
translation: 关于来世，你还能告诉我什么吗？ [guan yu lai shi ， ni hai neng gao su wo shen me ma ？]

english: Why do you choose to come back?
translation: 为什么选择回来？ [wei shen me xuan ze hui lai ？]

english: Hey, human.
translation: 嘿，人类。 [hei ， ren lei 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: I am Yellow Snow.
translation: 我是黄雪。 [wo shi huang xue 。]

english: How did you get called Yellow Snow?
translation: 怎么就叫黄雪了呢？ [zen me jiu jiao huang xue le ne ？]

english: We trolls are named after the first thing we try to eat, an' some things are kinda inevitable in a big snowy land with almost no toilets.
translation: 我们巨魔是以我们尝试吃的第一个东西命名的，在几乎没有厕所的大雪地上，有些东西是不可避免的。 [wo men ju mo shi yi wo men chang shi chi de di yi ge dong xi ming ming de ， zai ji hu mei you ce suo de da xue di shang ， you xie dong xi shi bu ke bi mian de 。]

english: We dug smelly hole in prison so Mother's prisoners wouldn't go all over floor, but it not very convenient. Trolls like things convenient.
translation: 我们在监狱里挖了一个臭洞，这样母亲的囚犯就不会满地都是，但这不太方便。巨魔喜欢方便的东西。 [wo men zai jian yu li wa le yi ge chou dong ， zhe yang mu qin de qiu fan jiu bu hui man di dou shi ， dan zhe bu tai fang bian 。 ju mo xi huan fang bian de dong xi 。]

english: Do you mind being asked about that?
translation: 你介意被问到这个问题吗？ [ni jie yi bei wen dao zhe ge wen ti ma ？]

english: Can't be helped. Everyone I meet, once they want to talk about me personally, it like they only got two choices of what to ask.
translation: 没办法。我遇到的每个人，一旦他们想谈论我个人，他们就好像只有两个选择要问什么。 [mei ban fa 。 wo yu dao de mei ge ren ， yi dan ta men xiang tan lun wo ge ren ， ta men jiu hao xiang zhi you liang ge xuan ze yao wen shen me 。]

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 告诉我这个地方。 [gao su wo zhe ge di fang 。]

english: This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: 这是韦斯。几年前，在我们被从更南边的洞穴里赶出来之后，巨魔们建造了它。现在Weiss是我们的家。 [zhe shi wei si 。 ji nian qian ， zai wo men bei cong geng nan bian de dong xue li gan chu lai zhi hou ， ju mo men jian zao le ta 。 xian zai Weiss shi wo men de jia 。]

english: We done pretty good here. Got lots of goat and wolf to eat - they taste kinda boring after all this time, but there not much other choice.
translation: 我们在这里做得很好。有很多山羊和狼可以吃——这么长时间以来它们尝起来有点无聊，但没有太多其他选择。 [wo men zai zhe li zuo de hen hao 。 you hen duo shan yang he lang ke yi chi —— zhe me zhang shi jian yi lai ta men chang qi lai you dian wu liao ， dan mei you tai duo qi ta xuan ze 。]

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it. In fact My Arm is an expert on growing the stuff.
translation: 尝试过古古草吗？我知道喜欢它的巨魔。事实上，我的手臂是种植这些东西的专家。 [chang shi guo gu gu cao ma ？ wo zhi dao xi huan ta de ju mo 。 shi shi shang ， wo de shou bi shi zhong zhi zhe xie dong xi de zhuan jia 。]

english: Never heard of no gouty weed, no. But it sound like a vegetable, an' Mother not like eating those, so we probably not gonna try it.
translation: 从来没有听说过没有痛风草，没有。但它听起来像一种蔬菜，妈妈不喜欢吃那些，所以我们可能不会尝试。 [cong lai mei you ting shuo guo mei you tong feng cao ， mei you 。 dan ta ting qi lai xiang yi zhong shu cai ， ma ma bu xi huan chi na xie ， suo yi wo men ke neng bu hui chang shi 。]

english: Mother not like new ideas much, but he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: 妈妈不太喜欢新想法，但他真的很大，而且是老板，所以我们就照他说的做。 [ma ma bu tai xi huan xin xiang fa ， dan ta zhen de hen da ， er qie shi lao ban ， suo yi wo men jiu zhao ta shuo de zuo 。]

english: I see.
translation: 我懂了。 [wo dong le 。]

english: Do you like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这里吗？ [ni xi huan zhe li ma ？]

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it our home. Odd Mushroom say he can make it nicer with fancy fires what he invented, but Mother not interested in that, so Odd Mushroom not allowed to do it.
translation: 呃，虽然有点简陋，但那是我们的家。奇蘑菇说他可以用他发明的奇特的火把它做得更好，但妈妈对此不感兴趣，所以奇蘑菇不被允许这样做。 [e ， sui ran you dian jian lou ， dan na shi wo men de jia 。 qi mo gu shuo ta ke yi yong ta fa ming de qi te de huo ba ta zuo de geng hao ， dan ma ma dui ci bu gan xing qu ， suo yi qi mo gu bu bei yun xu zhe yang zuo 。]

english: Mother only care about stuff to help him fight better. An he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: 母亲只关心帮助他更好地战斗的东西。他真的很大，他是老板，所以我们就按他说的做。 [mu qin zhi guan xin bang zhu ta geng hao di zhan dou de dong xi 。 ta zhen de hen da ， ta shi lao ban ， suo yi wo men jiu an ta shuo de zuo 。]

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我就走了。 [wo jiu zou le 。]

english: Hey, friend of Snowflake!
translation: 嘿，雪花的朋友！ [hei ， xue hua de peng you ！]

english: We trolls are named after first thing we try to eat, an' some things are kinda inevitable in a big snowy land with almost no toilets.
translation: 我们巨魔是以我们尝试吃的第一个东西命名的，在几乎没有厕所的大雪地上，有些东西是不可避免的。 [wo men ju mo shi yi wo men chang shi chi de di yi ge dong xi ming ming de ， zai ji hu mei you ce suo de da xue di shang ， you xie dong xi shi bu ke bi mian de 。]

english: It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: 这里太棒了，现在雪花和她丈夫巨魔教我们种植古风草。现在食物好多了。 [zhe li tai bang le ， xian zai xue hua he ta zhang fu ju mo jiao wo men zhong zhi gu feng cao 。 xian zai shi wu hao duo le 。]

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: 嗯，虽然有点粗糙，但是正在好起来。雪花，她教我们种植古风草。山羊、狼、人类的味道都因加入了古藤而变得更加美味。 [n ， sui ran you dian cu cao ， dan shi zheng zai hao qi lai 。 xue hua ， ta jiao wo men zhong zhi gu feng cao 。 shan yang 、 lang 、 ren lei de wei dao dou yin jia ru le gu teng er bian de geng jia mei wei 。]

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: 所以，是的，韦斯是一个很好的居住地，现在由雪花负责。所有的巨魔都像雪花一样。她的丈夫巨魔有点奇怪，但这不是我们的问题。 [suo yi ， shi de ， wei si shi yi ge hen hao de ju zhu di ， xian zai you xue hua fu ze 。 suo you de ju mo dou xiang xue hua yi yang 。 ta de zhang fu ju mo you dian qi guai ， dan zhe bu shi wo men de wen ti 。]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: How did you get called Yellow Snow?
translation: 怎么就叫黄雪了呢？ [zen me jiu jiao huang xue le ne ？]

english: Do you mind being asked about that?
translation: 你介意被问到这个问题吗？ [ni jie yi bei wen dao zhe ge wen ti ma ？]

english: Tell me about this place.
translation: 告诉我这个地方。 [gao su wo zhe ge di fang 。]

english: Ever tried goutweed?
translation: 尝试过古古草吗？ [chang shi guo gu gu cao ma ？]

english: I see.
translation: 我懂了。 [wo dong le 。]

english: Do you like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这里吗？ [ni xi huan zhe li ma ？]

english: I'll be off.
translation: 我就走了。 [wo jiu zou le 。]

english: Hello there.
translation: 你好呀。 [ni hao ya 。]

english: Clear off! Let me drink in peace!
translation: 走开！让我安心喝酒吧！ [zou kai ！ rang wo an xin he jiu ba ！]

english: Okay then.
translation: 那么好吧。 [na me hao ba 。]

english: Hello.
translation: 你好。 [ni hao 。]

english: Sorry, but the smithery is closed. You can use the furnace for a fee, and I can hold a coffer of gold so you don't need to pay each time.
translation: 抱歉，铁匠铺已经关门了。你可以付费使用熔炉，我可以保管一箱金子，这样你就不用每次都付钱了。 [bao qian ， tie jiang pu yi jing guan men le 。 ni ke yi fu fei shi yong rong lu ， wo ke yi bao guan yi xiang jin zi ， zhe yang ni jiu bu yong mei ci dou fu qian le 。]

english: It's already empty.
translation: 已经空了。 [yi jing kong le 。]

english: Sorry, but the smithery is closed. But since you've completed the elite tier of the Karamja diary, I will allow you to use the furnace.
translation: 抱歉，铁匠铺已经关门了。但既然你已经完成了卡拉姆贾日记的精英层，我就允许你使用熔炉。 [bao qian ， tie jiang pu yi jing guan men le 。 dan ji ran ni yi jing wan cheng le ka la mu jia ri ji de jing ying ceng ， wo jiu yun xu ni shi yong rong lu 。]

english: Sorry Bwana - I charge a fee of 20 coins to use my furnace.
translation: 抱歉 Bwana - 我收取 20 个硬币的使用费来使用我的熔炉。 [bao qian  Bwana -  wo shou qu  20  ge ying bi de shi yong fei lai shi yong wo de rong lu 。]

english: You have earned the Elite Karamja reward, so you no longer need to pay to use this furnace.
translation: 您已经获得了精英卡拉姆贾奖励，因此您不再需要付费才能使用该熔炉。 [nin yi jing huo de le jing ying ka la mu jia jiang li ， yin ci nin bu zai xu yao fu fei cai neng shi yong gai rong lu 。]

english: I'm getting out of here Bwana, the place is infested with Zombies.
translation: 我要离开这里，布瓦纳，这个地方到处都是僵尸。 [wo yao li kai zhe li ， bu wa na ， zhe ge di fang dao chu dou shi jiang shi 。]

english: Deposit coins
translation: 存币 [cun bi]

english: Empty coffer
translation: 空空的库房 [kong kong de ku fang]

english: Cancel
translation: 取消 [qu xiao]

english: Nilsal, my child. Welcome to our humble camp. Do stop and rest if you need to.
translation: 尼尔萨尔，我的孩子。欢迎来到我们简陋的营地。如果需要，请停下来休息。 [ni er sa er ， wo de hai zi 。 huan ying lai dao wo men jian lou de ying di 。 ru guo xu yao ， qing ting xia lai xiu xi 。]

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
translation: 你能治愈我吗？我受伤了。 [ni neng zhi yu wo ma ？ wo shou shang le 。]

english: Sorry, but I cannot.
translation: 抱歉，但我不能。 [bao qian ， dan wo bu neng 。]

english: What brings you out here?
translation: 是什么风把你吹到这里来的？ [shi shen me feng ba ni chui dao zhe li lai de ？]

english: My companion and I are the teoki responsible for the Proudspire obelisk, one of our most precious holy sites. However, the peak of the mountain is not overly welcoming, so we keep our camp down here.
translation: 我和我的同伴是负责 Proudspire 方尖碑的 teoki，这是我们最珍贵的圣地之一。不过，山顶不太好受，所以我们把营地留在这里。 [wo he wo de tong ban shi fu ze  Proudspire  fang jian bei de  teoki， zhe shi wo men zui zhen gui de sheng di zhi yi 。 bu guo ， shan ding bu tai hao shou ， suo yi wo men ba ying di liu zai zhe li 。]

english: What's so important about this obelisk?
translation: 这座方尖碑有何重要意义？ [zhe zuo fang jian bei you he zhong yao yi yi ？]

english: It was built by those who wandered these lands before we did. They worshipped Ralos and Ranul just as we now do. The obelisk was a site of great religious importance to them, and so it is to us as well.
translation: 它是由那些在我们之前漫步在这片土地上的人建造的。他们像我们现在一样崇拜拉洛斯和拉努尔。方尖碑对他们来说是一个具有重大宗教意义的地点，对我们来说也是如此。 [ta shi you na xie zai wo men zhi qian man bu zai zhe pian tu di shang de ren jian zao de 。 ta men xiang wo men xian zai yi yang chong bai la luo si he la nu er 。 fang jian bei dui ta men lai shuo shi yi ge ju you zhong da zong jiao yi yi de di dian ， dui wo men lai shuo ye shi ru ci 。]

english: But what is it actually for?
translation: 但它实际上是为了什么？ [dan ta shi ji shang shi wei le shen me ？]

english: That is something we sadly don't know. It is why the obelisk is especially important to those who serve Ranul. It is a reminder of the importance in ensuring knowledge is preserved.
translation: 遗憾的是我们不知道这一点。这就是为什么方尖碑对于那些服务于拉努尔的人来说特别重要。它提醒我们确保知识保存的重要性。 [yi han de shi wo men bu zhi dao zhe yi dian 。 zhe jiu shi wei shen me fang jian bei dui yu na xie fu wu yu la nu er de ren lai shuo te bie zhong yao 。 ta ti xing wo men que bao zhi shi bao cun de zhong yao xing 。]

english: I see...
translation: 我懂了... [wo dong le ...]

english: I'd better be on my way.
translation: 我最好还是上路吧。 [wo zui hao hai shi shang lu ba 。]

english: Take care, my child. May the sun light your way.
translation: 保重，我的孩子。愿阳光照亮你的路。 [bao zhong ， wo de hai zi 。 yuan yang guang zhao liang ni de lu 。]

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
translation: 你能治愈我吗？我受伤了。 [ni neng zhi yu wo ma ？ wo shou shang le 。]

english: What brings you out here?
translation: 是什么风把你吹到这里来的？ [shi shen me feng ba ni chui dao zhe li lai de ？]

english: I'd better be on my way.
translation: 我最好还是上路吧。 [wo zui hao hai shi shang lu ba 。]

english: Ga ga?
translation: 嘎嘎？ [ga ga ？]

english: Heeheehee!
translation: 嘿嘿嘿！ [hei hei hei ！]

english: *cough*
translation: *咳嗽* [* ke sou *]

english: *gurgle*
translation: *咯咯声* [* ge ge sheng *]

english: *hic*
I don't get it... Are you real or not?
translation: 我不明白……你是真的还是假的？ [wo bu ming bai …… ni shi zhen de hai shi jia de ？]

english: I'm a crystalline formation, made by the elves.
translation: 我是精灵制造的水晶结构。 [wo shi jing ling zhi zao de shui jing jie gou 。]

english: But, like... Can you feel it if I pinch you?
translation: 但是，就像……如果我掐你，你能感觉到吗？ [dan shi ， jiu xiang …… ru guo wo qia ni ， ni neng gan jue dao ma ？]

english: Don't you even think about it.
translation: 你想都别想。 [ni xiang dou bie xiang 。]

english: What actually are you? A big wolf or something?
translation: 你到底是什么？大狼什么的？ [ni dao di shi shen me ？ da lang shen me de ？]

english: I suppose I might look something like that.
translation: 我想我可能看起来像那样。 [wo xiang wo ke neng kan qi lai xiang na yang 。]

english: That sounds like a no. What are you then?
translation: 这听起来像是不。那你是什么？ [zhe ting qi lai xiang shi bu 。 na ni shi shen me ？]

english: A hunllef.
translation: 一个胡勒夫。 [yi ge hu lei fu 。]

english: A what?
translation: 一个什么？ [yi ge shen me ？]

english: Nevermind.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: You know, you can be a real nightmare sometimes.
translation: 你知道，有时你真的会成为一场噩梦。 [ni zhi dao ， you shi ni zhen de hui cheng wei yi chang e meng 。]

english: Grrrrrr!
translation: 咕噜咕噜！ [gu lu gu lu ！]

english: Hoooooooooowl!
translation: 呼呼呼呼！ [hu hu hu hu ！]

english: I'm a crystalline formation, made by the elves.
translation: 我是精灵制造的水晶结构。 [wo shi jing ling zhi zao de shui jing jie gou 。]

english: Don't you even think about it.
translation: 你想都别想。 [ni xiang dou bie xiang 。]

english: I suppose I might look something like that.
translation: 我想我可能看起来像那样。 [wo xiang wo ke neng kan qi lai xiang na yang 。]

english: A hunllef.
translation: 一个胡勒夫。 [yi ge hu lei fu 。]

english: Nevermind.
translation: 没关系。 [mei guan xi 。]

english: Grrrrrr!
translation: 咕噜咕噜！ [gu lu gu lu ！]

english: Hoooooooooowl!
translation: 呼呼呼呼！ [hu hu hu hu ！]

english: Hello!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: I'm sorry outerlander, I cannot sell you any clothes. Our customs forbid it.
translation: 对不起，外地人，我不能卖给你任何衣服。我们的海关禁止这样做。 [dui bu qi ， wai di ren ， wo bu neng mai gei ni ren he yi fu 。 wo men de hai guan jin zhi zhe yang zuo 。]

english: Only Fremenniks may buy clothes here.
translation: 只有弗里曼尼克人可以在这里买衣服。 [zhi you fu li man ni ke ren ke yi zai zhe li mai yi fu 。]

english: Only Fremenniks may change their shoes here.
translation: 只有弗里曼尼克人可以在这里换鞋。 [zhi you fu li man ni ke ren ke yi zai zhe li huan xie 。]

english: Are you a member of the council of elders?
translation: 你是长老会的成员吗？ [ni shi zhang lao hui de cheng yuan ma ？]

english: No, sorry, I'm not. Best look elsewhere outerlander.
translation: 不，抱歉，我不是。最好去别处看看外乡人。 [bu ， bao qian ， wo bu shi 。 zui hao qu bie chu kan kan wai xiang ren 。]

english: Okay, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。 [hao de ， xie xie 。]

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find some custom sturdy boots, do you?
translation: 我想你不知道我在哪里可以找到一些定制的坚固靴子，是吗？ [wo xiang ni bu zhi dao wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao yi xie ding zhi de jian gu xue zi ， shi ma ？]

english: Well, I don't usually have many shoes in stock here in my little clothes shop... I will be able to make you up a pair if you are really desperate though?
translation: 好吧，我的小服装店里通常没有很多鞋子库存……如果你真的很绝望的话，我可以给你补一双？ [hao ba ， wo de xiao fu zhuang dian li tong chang mei you hen duo xie zi ku cun …… ru guo ni zhen de hen jue wang de hua ， wo ke yi gei ni bu yi shuang ？]

english: They're not for me... I need them for Olaf.
translation: 它们不适合我……我需要它们给奥拉夫。 [ta men bu shi he wo …… wo xu yao ta men gei ao la fu 。]

english: Oh, that foolish bard... Why didn't he just ask me to make him some? It is his stupid pride, I believe!
translation: 哦，那个愚蠢的吟游诗人……他为什么不直接让我给他做一些呢？我相信这是他愚蠢的骄傲！ [o ， na ge yu chun de yin you shi ren …… ta wei shen me bu zhi jie rang wo gei ta zuo yi xie ne ？ wo xiang xin zhe shi ta yu chun de jiao ao ！]

english: I will tell you what I will do outerlander; I know that you must have the ear of the chieftain for him to consider you as worthy of becoming a Fremennik by trial.
translation: 我会告诉你我会做什么，外地人；我知道你必须得到酋长的同意，他才会认为你有资格通过审判成为弗里曼尼克人。 [wo hui gao su ni wo hui zuo shen me ， wai di ren ； wo zhi dao ni bi xu de dao qiu zhang de tong yi ， ta cai hui ren wei ni you zi ge tong guo shen pan cheng wei fu li man ni ke ren 。]

english: I will make you a pair of sturdy boots for Olaf if you will persuade him to reduce the sales tax placed upon all Fremennik shopkeepers. It does nothing but hurt my business now.
translation: 如果你能说服奥拉夫减少对所有弗雷曼尼克店主征收的销售税，我将为你做一双坚固的靴子。现在除了损害我的生意之外什么也没有。 [ru guo ni neng shuo fu ao la fu jian shao dui suo you fu lei man ni ke dian zhu zheng shou de xiao shou shui ， wo jiang wei ni zuo yi shuang jian gu de xue zi 。 xian zai chu le sun hai wo de sheng yi zhi wai shen me ye mei you 。]

english: Okay, I will see what I can do.
translation: 好吧，我会看看我能做什么。 [hao ba ， wo hui kan kan wo neng zuo shen me 。]

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a guarantee of a reduction on sales taxes, do you?
translation: 我想你不知道我在哪里可以找到减少销售税的保证，是吗？ [wo xiang ni bu zhi dao wo zai na li ke yi zhao dao jian shao xiao shou shui de bao zheng ， shi ma ？]

english: Yes I do outerlander. Only the Chieftain may permit such a thing. Talk to him.
translation: 是的，我是外地人。只有酋长才可以允许这样的事情。和他谈谈。 [shi de ， wo shi wai di ren 。 zhi you qiu zhang cai ke yi yun xu zhe yang de shi qing 。 he ta tan tan 。]

english: Hello. Can I have those boots now? Here is a written statement from Brundt outlining future tax burdens upon Fremennik merchants and shopkeepers for the year.
translation: 你好。我现在可以拥有那双靴子吗？以下是布伦特的书面声明，概述了弗里曼尼克商人和店主今年的未来税收负担。 [ni hao 。 wo xian zai ke yi yong you na shuang xue zi ma ？ yi xia shi bu lun te de shu mian sheng ming ， gai shu le fu li man ni ke shang ren he dian zhu jin nian de wei lai shui shou fu dan 。]

english: Certainly! Let me have a look at what he has written here, just give me a moment...
translation: 当然！让我看看他在这里写了什么，请稍等一下...... [dang ran ！ rang wo kan kan ta zai zhe li xie le shen me ， qing shao deng yi xia ......]

english: Yes, that all appears in order. Tell Olaf to come to me next time for shoes!
translation: 是的，一切都按顺序出现。告诉奥拉夫下次来找我买鞋！ [shi de ， yi qie dou an shun xu chu xian 。 gao su ao la fu xia ci lai zhao wo mai xie ！]

english: Hey, these shoes look pretty comfy. Think you could make me a pair like them?
translation: 嘿，这双鞋看起来很舒服。你觉得你能给我做一双像它们一样的吗？ [hei ， zhe shuang xie kan qi lai hen shu fu 。 ni jue de ni neng gei wo zuo yi shuang xiang ta men yi yang de ma ？]

english: Maybe if you pass your trial and become a full fledged member of the Fremennik...
translation: 也许如果你通过考验并成为弗里曼尼克的正式成员...... [ye xu ru guo ni tong guo kao yan bing cheng wei fu li man ni ke de zheng shi cheng yuan ......]

english: Hi. You wanted to buy some clothes? Or did you want to makeover your shoes?
translation: 你好。你想买一些衣服吗？或者你想改造你的鞋子吗？ [ni hao 。 ni xiang mai yi xie yi fu ma ？ huo zhe ni xiang gai zao ni de xie zi ma ？]

english: It's free to change your shoes here. You can choose a colour as well as a style, since I'm also stocking boots imported from the elven lands.
