translation: 护士！ [hu shi ！]

english: Do I look alright?!
translation: 我看起来还好吗？！ [wo kan qi lai hai hao ma ？！]

english: Yeh. The nurses here are...wonderful!
translation: 是的。这里的护士……太棒了！ [shi de 。 zhe li de hu shi …… tai bang le ！]

english: It's just a flesh wound!
translation: 只不过是皮外伤罢了！ [zhi bu guo shi pi wai shang ba le ！]

english: Can't....go....on!
translation: 不能……继续！ [bu neng …… ji xu ！]

english: Leave me behind!
translation: 留下我吧！ [liu xia wo ba ！]

english: I'll leave you here, OK?
translation: 我把你留在这里，好吗？ [wo ba ni liu zai zhe li ， hao ma ？]

english: Oh. OK.
translation: 哦。好的。 [o 。 hao de 。]

english: Die, human!
translation: 去死吧，人类！ [qu si ba ， ren lei ！]

english: What brings you all the way out into the Wilderness?
translation: 是什么让你千里迢迢来到荒野？ [shi shen me rang ni qian li tiao tiao lai dao huang ye ？]

english: The hunt.
translation: 狩猎。 [shou lie 。]

english: Oh... you partake in that?
translation: 哦……你也参与其中吗？ [o …… ni ye can yu qi zhong ma ？]

english: Not the hunt for other beings! The hunt for knowledge.
translation: 不是狩猎其他生物！寻找知识。 [bu shi shou lie qi ta sheng wu ！ xun zhao zhi shi 。]

english: Knowledge? Can't say I've seen much of that around here. In case you didn't notice, it's all ruins.
translation: 知识？不能说我在这里见过很多这样的东西。如果你没注意到的话，这里全是废墟。 [zhi shi ？ bu neng shuo wo zai zhe li jian guo hen duo zhe yang de dong xi 。 ru guo ni mei zhu yi dao de hua ， zhe li quan shi fei xu 。]

english: Maybe for someone like you, but to us followers of Zamorak, there's relics of his mighty power everywhere.
translation: 也许对于像你这样的人来说，但对于我们萨莫拉克的追随者来说，到处都有他强大力量的遗迹。 [ye xu dui yu xiang ni zhe yang de ren lai shuo ， dan dui yu wo men sa mo la ke de zhui sui zhe lai shuo ， dao chu dou you ta qiang da li liang de yi ji 。]

english: Isn't it a little dangerous to be looking for knowledge out here?
translation: 在这里寻找知识是不是有点危险？ [zai zhe li xun zhao zhi shi shi bu shi you dian wei xian ？]

english: That doesn't bother us. Our lord will protect us, we hunt in service of him.
translation: 这并不困扰我们。我们的主人会保护我们，我们为他而狩猎。 [zhe bing bu kun rao wo men 。 wo men de zhu ren hui bao hu wo men ， wo men wei ta er shou lie 。]

english: I'll leave you to it then.
translation: 那我就把它留给你了。 [na wo jiu ba ta liu gei ni le 。]

english: You're a lot calmer than the other Zamorakian followers I've come across in the Wilderness.
translation: 你比我在荒野中遇到的其他萨莫拉克追随者要冷静得多。 [ni bi wo zai huang ye zhong yu dao de qi ta sa mo la ke zhui sui zhe yao leng jing de duo 。]

english: We only search for answers.
translation: 我们只寻找答案。 [wo men zhi xun zhao da an 。]

english: Don't think you'll find much in these ruins.
translation: 别以为你会在这些废墟中找到太多东西。 [bie yi wei ni hui zai zhe xie fei xu zhong zhao dao tai duo dong xi 。]

english: Be that as it may, it is our duty to honour our god and hunt for knowledge.
translation: 无论如何，尊敬我们的神并寻求知识是我们的责任。 [wu lun ru he ， zun jing wo men de shen bing xun qiu zhi shi shi wo men de ze ren 。]

english: All power to the almighty Zamorak.
translation: 一切力量归于全能的萨莫拉克。 [yi qie li liang gui yu quan neng de sa mo la ke 。]

english: I take it you're with the others dressed in red.
translation: 我猜你和其他人都穿着红衣服。 [wo cai ni he qi ta ren dou chuan zhe hong yi fu 。]

english: We are here in service of the only true god.
translation: 我们来这里是为了服务唯一的真神。 [wo men lai zhe li shi wei le fu wu wei yi de zhen shen 。]

english: Hey there, what's with all the shouting.
translation: 嘿嘿，怎么这么大喊大叫呢？ [hei hei ， zen me zhe me da han da jiao ne ？]

english: Our all-powerful Lord Zamorak is looking for the strongest of champions, you hardly look like you fit that criteria.
translation: 我们全能的萨莫拉克领主正在寻找最强的冠军，而你看起来并不符合这个标准。 [wo men quan neng de sa mo la ke ling zhu zheng zai xun zhao zui qiang de guan jun ， er ni kan qi lai bing bu fu he zhe ge biao zhun 。]

english: I am big and strong, what does he need new champions for?
translation: 我又大又强，他还需要新冠军做什么？ [wo you da you qiang ， ta hai xu yao xin guan jun zuo shen me ？]

english: The glorious battlefield of Castle Wars, where we can smite down the weak followers of Saradomin needs new blood.
translation: 城堡战争的光荣战场需要新的血液，在那里我们可以击败萨拉多明的弱小追随者。 [cheng bao zhan zheng de guang rong zhan chang xu yao xin de xue ye ， zai na li wo men ke yi ji bai sa la duo ming de ruo xiao zhui sui zhe 。]

english: That sounds neat, I'll be a champion for Zamorak.
translation: 听起来不错，我将成为萨莫拉克的冠军。 [ting qi lai bu cuo ， wo jiang cheng wei sa mo la ke de guan jun 。]

english: Bring death to Saradomin in his great name.
translation: 以萨拉多明的伟大之名杀死他。 [yi sa la duo ming de wei da zhi ming sha si ta 。]

english: Some items are stopping you from entering the Castle Wars waiting area. See the chat for details.
translation: 有些物品会阻止您进入城堡战争等候区。详情请参阅聊天。 [you xie wu pin hui zu zhi nin jin ru cheng bao zhan zheng deng hou qu 。 xiang qing qing can yue liao tian 。]

english: The player is teleported to the current world's Zamorak Castle Wars lobby.
translation: 玩家被传送到当前世界的萨莫拉克城堡战争大厅。 [wan jia bei chuan song dao dang qian shi jie de sa mo la ke cheng bao zhan zheng da ting 。]

english: He can find a champion somewhere else, I'll pass.
translation: 他可以在其他地方找到冠军，我会通过。 [ta ke yi zai qi ta di fang zhao dao guan jun ， wo hui tong guo 。]

english: Fool, you'll regret this one day.
translation: 傻瓜，总有一天你会后悔的。 [sha gua ， zong you yi tian ni hui hou hui de 。]

english: Sorry, you can't play Castle Wars on this world. Try world 334 for the official world.
translation: 抱歉，您无法在这个世界上玩城堡战争。尝试一下官方世界的世界 334。 [bao qian ， nin wu fa zai zhe ge shi jie shang wan cheng bao zhan zheng 。 chang shi yi xia guan fang shi jie de shi jie  334。]

english: Fight for Zamorak today!
translation: 今天为萨莫拉克而战！ [jin tian wei sa mo la ke er zhan ！]

english: Join the fight now.
translation: 现在就加入战斗吧。 [xian zai jiu jia ru zhan dou ba 。]

english: Saradomin is weak, use your strength where it's respected!
translation: 萨拉多明很弱，请在受尊重的地方发挥你的力量！ [sa la duo ming hen ruo ， qing zai shou zun zhong de di fang fa hui ni de li liang ！]

english: Your Lord Zamorak needs your help!
translation: 你的萨莫拉克大人需要你的帮助！ [ni de sa mo la ke da ren xu yao ni de bang zhu ！]

english: Yes.
translation: 是的。 [shi de 。]

english: No.
translation: 不。 [bu 。]

english: What do you want? We're trying to sing! Leave us alone and we won't bother you!
translation: 你想要什么？我们正在努力唱歌！放过我们吧，我们不会打扰你的！ [ni xiang yao shen me ？ wo men zheng zai nu li chang ge ！ fang guo wo men ba ， wo men bu hui da rao ni de ！]

english: Where are you going? Can we come too?
translation: 你要去哪里？我们也可以来吗？ [ni yao qu na li ？ wo men ye ke yi lai ma ？]

english: Why do you resort to violence so often?
translation: 为什么你如此频繁地诉诸暴力？ [wei shen me ni ru ci pin fan di su zhu bao li ？]

english: If you should think of cutting a tree, don't do it!
translation: 如果您想砍树，请不要这样做！ [ru guo nin xiang kan shu ， qing bu yao zhe yang zuo ！]

english: We do hope we are not too annoying!
translation: 我们确实希望我们不会太烦人！ [wo men que shi xi wang wo men bu hui tai fan ren ！]

english: Look at that outfit! Can't you afford a decent one?
translation: 看看那身衣服！你买不起一件像样的吗？ [kan kan na shen yi fu ！ ni mai bu qi yi jian xiang yang de ma ？]

english: Are you going to craft cosmic runes? Can we come too?
translation: 你要制作宇宙符文吗？我们也可以来吗？ [ni yao zhi zuo yu zhou fu wen ma ？ wo men ye ke yi lai ma ？]

english: Just go about your business and ignore us!
translation: 只管忙你的事，别理我们！ [zhi guan mang ni de shi ， bie li wo men ！]

english: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？ [ni shi shui ？]

english: My name is Zandar Horfyre, and you [player name] are trespassing in my tower, not to mention attacking my students! I thankyou to leave immediately!
translation: 我的名字是赞达尔·霍菲尔，而你[玩家名字]竟然擅自闯入我的塔楼，更不用说攻击我的学生了！谢谢你立即离开！ [wo de ming zi shi zan da er · huo fei er ， er ni [ wan jia ming zi ] jing ran shan zi chuang ru wo de ta lou ， geng bu yong shuo gong ji wo de xue sheng le ！ xie xie ni li ji li kai ！]

english: Ok, I was going anyway.
translation: 好吧，反正我也要去。 [hao ba ， fan zheng wo ye yao qu 。]

english: Good! And don't forget to close the door behind you!
translation: 好的！别忘了关上身后的门！ [hao de ！ bie wang le guan shang shen hou de men ！]

english: No, I think I'll stay for a bit.
translation: 不，我想我会留下来一段时间。 [bu ， wo xiang wo hui liu xia lai yi duan shi jian 。]

english: Actually, that wasn't an invitation. I've tried being polite, now we'll do it the hard way!
translation: 事实上，这并不是邀请。我已经尝试过保持礼貌，现在我们就用更艰难的方式来做吧！ [shi shi shang ， zhe bing bu shi yao qing 。 wo yi jing chang shi guo bao chi li mao ， xian zai wo men jiu yong geng jian nan de fang shi lai zuo ba ！]

english: The player is teleported to the Lumbridge swamp
translation: 玩家被传送到朗布里奇沼泽 [wan jia bei chuan song dao lang bu li qi zhao ze]

english: Zamorak curse that mage!
translation: 萨莫拉克诅咒那个法师！ [sa mo la ke zu zhou na ge fa shi ！]

english: Actually, I guess he already has!
translation: 事实上，我想他已经有了！ [shi shi shang ， wo xiang ta yi jing you le ！]

english: Ok, I was going anyway.
translation: 好吧，反正我也要去。 [hao ba ， fan zheng wo ye yao qu 。]

english: No, I think I'll stay for a bit.
translation: 不，我想我会留下来一段时间。 [bu ， wo xiang wo hui liu xia lai yi duan shi jian 。]

english: Hello, [player name]!
translation: 你好，[玩家姓名]！ [ni hao ，[ wan jia xing ming ]！]

english: Hello, Zanik! What have you been up to?
translation: 你好，扎尼克！你最近都在做什么？ [ni hao ， zha ni ke ！ ni zui jin dou zai zuo shen me ？]

english: I've been helping Oldak with his experiments!
translation: 我一直在帮助奥达克做他的实验！ [wo yi zhi zai bang zhu ao da ke zuo ta de shi yan ！]

english: I took his magic ball all over the caves and even to Lumbridge to test what happened when I broke it, and I always ended up back here.
translation: 我带着他的魔法球走遍了所有的洞穴，甚至还去了伦布里奇，测试我打破它时会发生什么，而我总是最终回到这里。 [wo dai zhe ta de mo fa qiu zou bian le suo you de dong xue ， shen zhi hai qu le lun bu li qi ， ce shi wo da po ta shi hui fa sheng shen me ， er wo zong shi zui zhong hui dao zhe li 。]

english: You might find one of those balls useful if you wanted to visit me! Perhaps you should talk to Oldak.
translation: 如果你想拜访我，你可能会发现其中一个球很有用！也许你应该和奥达克谈谈。 [ru guo ni xiang bai fang wo ， ni ke neng hui fa xian qi zhong yi ge qiu hen you yong ！ ye xu ni ying gai he ao da ke tan tan 。]

english: The story isn't true! I had too much rum and ended up here!
translation: 这个故事不是真的！我喝了太多朗姆酒，最后来到了这里！ [zhe ge gu shi bu shi zhen de ！ wo he le tai duo lang mu jiu ， zui hou lai dao le zhe li ！]

english: I'm not banished, I've been ship wrecked help!
translation: 我没有被放逐，我遭遇了海难救命！ [wo mei you bei fang zhu ， wo zao yu le hai nan jiu ming ！]

english: Save me!
translation: 救救我吧！ [jiu jiu wo ba ！]

english: Help! I've been ship wrecked for years!
translation: 帮助！我已经沉船多年了！ [bang zhu ！ wo yi jing chen chuan duo nian le ！]

english: A thousand greetings, sir.
translation: 一千个问候，先生。 [yi qian ge wen hou ， xian sheng 。]

english: Do you want to trade?
translation: 你想交易吗？ [ni xiang jiao yi ma ？]

english: Yes, certainly. I deal in scimitars.
translation: 是的，当然。我经营弯刀。 [shi de ， dang ran 。 wo jing ying wan dao 。]

english: Nice cloak.
translation: 漂亮的斗篷。 [piao liang de dou peng 。]

english: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: Could you sell me a dragon scimitar?
translation: 你能卖给我一把龙弯刀吗？ [ni neng mai gei wo yi ba long wan dao ma ？]

english: A dragon scimitar? A DRAGON scimitar?
translation: 龙弯刀？龙弯刀？ [long wan dao ？ long wan dao ？]

english: The banana-brained nitwits who make them would never dream of selling any to me.
translation: 那些制作它们的香蕉脑白痴永远不会梦想把任何东西卖给我。 [na xie zhi zuo ta men de xiang jiao nao bai chi yong yuan bu hui meng xiang ba ren he dong xi mai gei wo 。]

english: Seriously, you'll be a monkey's uncle before you'll ever hold a dragon scimitar.
translation: 说真的，在你拿着龙弯刀之前，你就会成为猴子的叔叔。 [shuo zhen de ， zai ni na zhe long wan dao zhi qian ， ni jiu hui cheng wei hou zi de shu shu 。]

english: Oh well, thanks anyway.
translation: 哦，好吧，还是谢谢你。 [o ， hao ba ， hai shi xie xie ni 。]

english: Hmmm, funny you should say that...
translation: 嗯，有趣的是你应该这么说...... [n ， you qu de shi ni ying gai zhe me shuo ......]

english: Perhaps you'd like to take a look at my stock?
translation: 也许您想看看我的库存？ [ye xu nin xiang kan kan wo de ku cun ？]

english: What do you think about Ali Morrisane?
translation: 您对阿里·莫里森有何看法？ [nin dui a li · mo li sen you he kan fa ？]

english: He is a dangerous man.
translation: 他是一个危险的人。 [ta shi yi ge wei xian de ren 。]

english: Although he does not appear to be dangerous, he has brought several men to this town who have threatened me and several others.
translation: 虽然他看上去并不危险，但他却把几个人带到了这个镇上，威胁了我和其他几个人。 [sui ran ta kan shang qu bing bu wei xian ， dan ta que ba ji ge ren dai dao le zhe ge zhen shang ， wei xie le wo he qi ta ji ge ren 。]

english: One man even threatened me with a hammer, saying that when he set up his smithy, my shoddy workmanship would be revealed!
translation: 有一个人还拿着锤子威胁我，说等他开铁匠铺，我的粗制滥造就会被揭露！ [you yi ge ren hai na zhe chui zi wei xie wo ， shuo deng ta kai tie jiang pu ， wo de cu zhi lan zao jiu hui bei jie lu ！]

english: What will you do about these threats?
translation: 面对这些威胁你会做什么？ [mian dui zhe xie wei xie ni hui zuo shen me ？]

english: Oh, I am quite confident in the quality of my work...as will you be if you take a look at my wares.
translation: 哦，我对我的工作质量很有信心……如果你看看我的商品，你也会有信心的。 [o ， wo dui wo de gong zuo zhi liang hen you xin xin …… ru guo ni kan kan wo de shang pin ， ni ye hui you xin xin de 。]

english: Do you want to trade?
translation: 你想交易吗？ [ni xiang jiao yi ma ？]

english: Nice cloak.
translation: 漂亮的斗篷。 [piao liang de dou peng 。]

english: Could you sell me a dragon scimitar?
translation: 你能卖给我一把龙弯刀吗？ [ni neng mai gei wo yi ba long wan dao ma ？]

english: Yes please, Zeke.
translation: 是的，请，泽克。 [shi de ， qing ， ze ke 。]

english: Not today, thank you.
translation: 今天不行，谢谢。 [jin tian bu xing ， xie xie 。]

english: What do you think of Ali Morrisane?
translation: 你觉得阿里·莫里森怎么样？ [ni jue de a li · mo li sen zen me yang ？]

english: Hello there! I sell plate mail bodies, are you interested?
translation: 你好呀！我卖钢板邮件体，你有兴趣吗？ [ni hao ya ！ wo mai gang ban you jian ti ， ni you xing qu ma ？]

english: Sorry, I'm not interested.
translation: 抱歉，我不感兴趣。 [bao qian ， wo bu gan xing qu 。]

english: I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.
translation: 我来这里是为了告诉你一些新的税收。 [wo lai zhe li shi wei le gao su ni yi xie xin de shui shou 。]

english: I'm already paying my taxes though?
translation: 我已经缴税了？ [wo yi jing jiao shui le ？]

english: These are new ones. They are to help pay for the king's upcoming visit to Great Kourend.
translation: 这些都是新的。他们将帮助支付国王即将访问大库伦德的费用。 [zhe xie dou shi xin de 。 ta men jiang bang zhu zhi fu guo wang ji jiang fang wen da ku lun de de fei yong 。]

english: Well I don't see why I have to pay for that! If the king can't afford the trip, then maybe he shouldn't be going!
translation: 好吧，我不明白为什么我必须为此付费！如果国王负担不起这次旅行的费用，那么也许他就不应该去！ [hao ba ， wo bu ming bai wei shen me wo bi xu wei ci fu fei ！ ru guo guo wang fu dan bu qi zhe ci lv xing de fei yong ， na me ye xu ta jiu bu ying gai qu ！]

english: It's an important diplomatic trip I'm afraid so it has to go ahead. The first payment will be collected soon.
translation: 恐怕这是一次重要的外交访问，因此必须继续进行。首笔付款将很快收取。 [kong pa zhe shi yi ci zhong yao de wai jiao fang wen ， yin ci bi xu ji xu jin xing 。 shou bi fu kuan jiang hen kuai shou qu 。]

english: And he's getting a mourner to tell me this? Nice try.
translation: 他让一个哀悼者来告诉我这个？不错的尝试。 [ta rang yi ge ai dao zhe lai gao su wo zhe ge ？ bu cuo de chang shi 。]

english: And he's getting a citizen to tell me this? Nice try.
translation: 他让一个公民来告诉我这个？不错的尝试。 [ta rang yi ge gong min lai gao su wo zhe ge ？ bu cuo de chang shi 。]

english: I'm interested.
translation: 我有兴趣。 [wo you xing qu 。]

english: Sorry, I'm not interested.
translation: 抱歉，我不感兴趣。 [bao qian ， wo bu gan xing qu 。]

english: I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.
translation: 我来这里是为了告诉你一些新的税收。 [wo lai zhe li shi wei le gao su ni yi xie xin de shui shou 。]

english: Fingers!
translation: 手指！ [shou zhi ！]

english: Wall beast fingers!
translation: 壁兽手指！ [bi shou shou zhi ！]

english: Fresh wall beast fingers!
translation: 新鲜墙兽手指！ [xin xian qiang shou shou zhi ！]

english: Lovely wall beast fingers!
translation: 可爱的墙兽手指！ [ke ai de qiang shou shou zhi ！]

english: Tasty wall beast fingers!
translation: 美味的墙兽手指！ [mei wei de qiang shou shou zhi ！]

english: FIND THE GODSWORD!
translation: 寻找神剑！ [xun zhao shen jian ！]

english: FIND THE GODSWORD!
translation: 寻找神剑！ [xun zhao shen jian ！]

english: I FOUND THE GODSWORD!
translation: 我找到了神剑！ [wo zhao dao le shen jian ！]

english: GOOD!!!!!
Find the godsword!
translation: 寻找神剑！ [xun zhao shen jian ！]

english: I sharpen my blade for Saradomin!
translation: 我为萨拉多明磨刀！ [wo wei sa la duo ming mo dao ！]

english: Smite the evildoer!
translation: 严惩恶人！ [yan cheng e ren ！]

english: Saradomin guide my sword!
translation: 萨拉多明引导我的剑！ [sa la duo ming yin dao wo de jian ！]

english: *slap*
translation: *拍击* [* pai ji *]

english: Evildoers get ragged!
translation: 恶人必遭殃！ [e ren bi zao yang ！]

english: For Saradomin!
translation: 为了萨拉多明！ [wei le sa la duo ming ！]

english: My faith pwns your faith!
translation: 我的信仰pw你的信仰！ [wo de xin yang pw ni de xin yang ！]

english: Wotcha guv'na!
translation: 哇哇哇！ [wa wa wa ！]

english: Hey! Talk to me if you want to know anything worth knowing.
translation: 嘿！如果您想了解任何值得了解的事情，请与我联系。 [hei ！ ru guo nin xiang liao jie ren he zhi de liao jie de shi qing ， qing yu wo lian xi 。]

english: Best talk to his highness over there, 'fore he goes gettin' upset.
translation: 最好和那边的殿下谈谈，免得他生气。 [zui hao he na bian de dian xia tan tan ， mian de ta sheng qi 。]

english: Hey Zimberfizz.
translation: 嘿津伯菲兹。 [hei jin bo fei zi 。]

english: What exactly is the Soul Obelisk?
translation: 灵魂方尖碑到底是什么？ [ling hun fang jian bei dao di shi shen me ？]

english: It's 'ard to say. Me master never told what it is or why he built it.
translation: 很难说。我的主人从未告诉过它是什么或他为什么建造它。 [hen nan shuo 。 wo de zhu ren cong wei gao su guo ta shi shen me huo ta wei shen me jian zao ta 。]

english: Wait a second... He built it?
translation: 等一下...他建造的？ [deng yi xia ... ta jian zao de ？]

english: I saw 'im build it with me own eyes. I were the one who 'ad to carry his materials to this island!
translation: 我亲眼看到我建造了它。我就是把他的材料带到这个岛上的人！ [wo qin yan kan dao wo jian zao le ta 。 wo jiu shi ba ta de cai liao dai dao zhe ge dao shang de ren ！]

english: So what is Nomad really up to?
translation: 那么 Nomad 到底在做什么呢？ [na me  Nomad  dao di zai zuo shen me ne ？]

english: Well, me master is as secretive as they come. Af'er all my time here, I still know next to nuffin' about him.
translation: 好吧，我的主人和他们一样神秘。在这里呆了这么久之后，我对他仍然了解得差不多了。 [hao ba ， wo de zhu ren he ta men yi yang shen mi 。 zai zhe li dai le zhe me jiu zhi hou ， wo dui ta reng ran liao jie de cha bu duo le 。]

english: Well, what do you know?
translation: 那么，你知道什么？ [na me ， ni zhi dao shen me ？]

english: He's been up to summat since I've been here, but 'e had to have been an adventurer at some point. He has a massive stockpile of loot.
translation: 自从我来到这里以来，他一直在努力，但他一定在某个时候成为了一名冒险家。他拥有大量战利品库存。 [zi cong wo lai dao zhe li yi lai ， ta yi zhi zai nu li ， dan ta yi ding zai mou ge shi hou cheng wei le yi ming mao xian jia 。 ta yong you da liang zhan li pin ku cun 。]

english: He seems to know his way around some strange creatures too.
translation: 他似乎也熟悉一些奇怪的生物。 [ta si hu ye shu xi yi xie qi guai de sheng wu 。]

english: He does. He doesn't seem to care about that sorta stuff no more though. Since I've known 'im, he's only been obsessin' over gettin' as many people to play his game as possible.
translation: 他做到了。不过他似乎不再关心这些事情了。自从我认识他以来，他一心只想让尽可能多的人玩他的游戏。 [ta zuo dao le 。 bu guo ta si hu bu zai guan xin zhe xie shi qing le 。 zi cong wo ren shi ta yi lai ， ta yi xin zhi xiang rang jin ke neng duo de ren wan ta de you xi 。]

english: Why is he so obsessed?
translation: 他为何如此着迷？ [ta wei he ru ci zhao mi ？]

english: Lost if I know. Like I said, 'e's as secretive as they come.
translation: 如果我知道的话就输了。就像我说的，他们来的时候就很神秘。 [ru guo wo zhi dao de hua jiu shu le 。 jiu xiang wo shuo de ， ta men lai de shi hou jiu hen shen mi 。]

english: Tell me how you got to be here.
translation: 告诉我你是怎么来到这里的。 [gao su wo ni shi zen me lai dao zhe li de 。]

english: I don't really know. I just woke up one day and 'ad to obey me master's commands.
translation: 我真的不知道。有一天我刚醒来，就听从主人的命令。 [wo zhen de bu zhi dao 。 you yi tian wo gang xing lai ， jiu ting cong zhu ren de ming ling 。]

english: You just woke up here?
translation: 你刚在这里醒来吗？ [ni gang zai zhe li xing lai ma ？]

english: Aye. All I can remember before that is a glowing box and sumfin' to do with beads.
translation: 是啊。在此之前我所记得的只是一个发光的盒子和一些与珠子有关的东西。 [shi a 。 zai ci zhi qian wo suo ji de de zhi shi yi ge fa guang de he zi he yi xie yu zhu zi you guan de dong xi 。]

english: It sounds like Nomad is quite the hunter.
translation: 听起来 Nomad 确实是个猎人。 [ting qi lai  Nomad  que shi shi ge lie ren 。]

english: What makes you say that?
translation: 是什么让你这么说？ [shi shen me rang ni zhe me shuo ？]

english: I read somewhere that skilled hunters can capture imps.
translation: 我在某处读到，熟练的猎人可以捕获小鬼。 [wo zai mou chu du dao ， shu lian de lie ren ke yi bu huo xiao gui 。]

english: That's sad to hear. It's just so 'ard to ignore shiny beads when I see 'em.
translation: 听到这个消息真是很难过。当我看到闪亮的珠子时，我很难忽视它们。 [ting dao zhe ge xiao xi zhen shi hen nan guo 。 dang wo kan dao shan liang de zhu zi shi ， wo hen nan hu shi ta men 。]

english: I'm quite the hunter myself, and some hunters like to capture imps.
translation: 我自己就是个猎人，有些猎人喜欢捕捉小鬼。 [wo zi ji jiu shi ge lie ren ， you xie lie ren xi huan bu zhuo xiao gui 。]

english: Really? They abuse our love of beads just to test their skills?
translation: 真的吗？他们滥用我们对珠子的热爱只是为了测试他们的技能吗？ [zhen de ma ？ ta men lan yong wo men dui zhu zi de re ai zhi shi wei le ce shi ta men de ji neng ma ？]

english: No need to worry, I'll give you no hassle. I'm only here to chat.
translation: 不用担心，我不会给你添麻烦。我只是来聊天的 [bu yong dan xin ， wo bu hui gei ni tian ma fan 。 wo zhi shi lai liao tian de]

english: Phew!
translation: 唷！ [yo ！]

english: I'm quite the hunter myself, and I love capturing imps.
translation: 我自己就是个猎人，我喜欢捕捉小鬼。 [wo zi ji jiu shi ge lie ren ， wo xi huan bu zhuo xiao gui 。]

english: Oh no!
translation: 哦不！ [o bu ！]

english: Only joking! I couldn't resist. Now, where were we?
translation: 开玩笑而已！我无法抗拒。现在，我们在哪里？ [kai wan xiao er yi ！ wo wu fa kang ju 。 xian zai ， wo men zai na li ？]

english: See you later.
translation: 稍后见。 [shao hou jian 。]

english: Bye!
translation: 再见！ [zai jian ！]

english: You've got no reason to bother that poor imp.
translation: 你没有理由去打扰那个可怜的小鬼。 [ni mei you li you qu da rao na ge ke lian de xiao gui 。]

english: I can't really chit-chat with me Master 'round. Go see what he wants.
translation: 我真的不能和我的主人闲聊。去看看他想要什么。 [wo zhen de bu neng he wo de zhu ren xian liao 。 qu kan kan ta xiang yao shen me 。]

english: If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 我要是像你那么丑我就不敢在大庭广众之下露脸了！ [wo yao shi xiang ni na me chou wo jiu bu gan zai da ting guang zhong zhi xia lou lian le ！]

english: Out of my way, punk.
translation: 别挡我的路，朋克。 [bie dang wo de lu ， peng ke 。]

english: Hmm... you smell strange...
translation: 嗯……你闻起来很奇怪…… [n …… ni wen qi lai hen qi guai ……]

english: Strange how?
translation: 奇怪怎么办？ [qi guai zen me ban ？]

english: Like a human!
translation: 像人一样！ [xiang ren yi yang ！]

english: Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 哦！呃……我刚吃了一个就是为什么！ [o ！ e …… wo gang chi le yi ge jiu shi wei shen me ！]

english: Leave me alone.
translation: 请别打扰我。 [qing bie da rao wo 。]

english: Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 如果你珍惜你的生命，就不要再跟我说话了！ [ru guo ni zhen xi ni de sheng ming ， jiu bu yao zai gen wo shuo hua le ！]

english: Get lost!
translation: 迷路！ [mi lu ！]

english: I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 我没有什么可以给你，所以让我一个人呆着吧，托钵僧。 [wo mei you shen me ke yi gei ni ， suo yi rang wo yi ge ren dai zhe ba ， tuo bo seng 。]

english: Have you no manners?
translation: 你没有礼貌吗？ [ni mei you li mao ma ？]

english: I don't have time for this right now.
translation: 我现在没有时间做这个。 [wo xian zai mei you shi jian zuo zhe ge 。]

english: I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 我没有兴趣和像你这样的可怜虫说话。 [wo mei you xing qu he xiang ni zhe yang de ke lian chong shuo hua 。]

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
translation: 我打赌你有一双很棒的爪子。 [wo da du ni you yi shuang hen bang de zhua zi 。]

english: A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 非常痛苦的一天，总的来说……趁它持续的时候好好享受吧。 [fei chang tong ku de yi tian ， zong de lai shuo …… chen ta chi xu de shi hou hao hao xiang shou ba 。]

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: 如果你抓到任何人，答应我你会分享。 [ru guo ni zhua dao ren he ren ， da ying wo ni hui fen xiang 。]

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 我以前没在这儿闻过你的味道…… [wo yi qian mei zai zhe er wen guo ni de wei dao ……]

english: You smell familiar...
translation: 你闻起来很熟悉... [ni wen qi lai hen shu xi ...]

english: Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 看到这附近有人类吗？我饿了。 [kan dao zhe fu jin you ren lei ma ？ wo e le 。]

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 在我看来，你就像一个对血液有健康品味的人。 [zai wo kan lai ， ni jiu xiang yi ge dui xue ye you jian kang pin wei de ren 。]

english: Good day to you, my friend.
translation: 祝你美好的一天，我的朋友。 [zhu ni mei hao de yi tian ， wo de peng you 。]

english: Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
translation: 想去城堡吃点小吃吗？ [xiang qu cheng bao chi dian xiao chi ma ？]

english: Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: 等一下，我的牙齿里有一点东西卡住了…… [deng yi xia ， wo de ya chi li you yi dian dong xi ka zhu le ……]

english: Durrrr...
translation: 杜尔尔... [du er er ...]

english: Hey! Come over here!
translation: 嘿！过来吧！ [hei ！ guo lai ba ！]

english: Who? Me?
translation: WHO？我？ [WHO？ wo ？]

english: Yes, you!
translation: 是的，就是你！ [shi de ， jiu shi ni ！]

english: Give me a moment...I can't move that fast.
translation: 给我一点时间...我走不了那么快。 [gei wo yi dian shi jian ... wo zou bu liao na me kuai 。]

english: Why not?
translation: 为什么不呢？ [wei shen me bu ne ？]

english: I used to be a magician's assistant until the accident...
translation: 我曾经是魔术师的助手，直到那次事故…… [wo ceng jing shi mo shu shi de zhu shou ， zhi dao na ci shi gu ……]

english: What accident?
translation: 什么意外？ [shen me yi wai ？]

english: Looook...
Braaaaains...
translation: 布拉阿阿恩斯... [bu la a a en si ...]

english: Zombie, it has come to my attention that you are a fool, a nitwit if you will.
translation: 僵尸，我注意到你是个傻瓜，如果你愿意的话，也可以说是个白痴。 [jiang shi ， wo zhu yi dao ni shi ge sha gua ， ru guo ni yuan yi de hua ， ye ke yi shuo shi ge bai chi 。]

english: I propose that your head, instead of being filled with the brains you so crave, is instead filled with a mixture of crushed lemons and kelp!
translation: 我建议你的脑袋不要装满你渴望的大脑，而是装满压碎的柠檬和海带的混合物！ [wo jian yi ni de nao dai bu yao zhuang man ni ke wang de da nao ， er shi zhuang man ya sui de ning meng he hai dai de hun he wu ！]

english: Oh noooo..I'd best take it off then...
translation: 哦不……我最好把它脱下来…… [o bu …… wo zui hao ba ta tuo xia lai ……]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: Traaa laaa laaa...
translation: 啊啊啊啊啊啊…… [a a a a a a ……]

english: Oogaboogabooga!
translation: 噢嘎嘎嘎嘎！ [o ga ga ga ga ！]

english: Aaaaaargh!
translation: 啊啊啊！ [a a a ！]

english: DUUUHHH

english: Alas!
translation: 唉! [ai !]

english: Mwuhahahaha!
translation: 呜哈哈哈哈！ [wu ha ha ha ha ！]

english: Hey, Head?
translation: 嘿，头？ [hei ， tou ？]

english: What?
translation: 什么？ [shen me ？]

english: How did you die?
translation: 你是怎么死的？ [ni shi zen me si de ？]

english: I stuck my neck out for an old friend.
translation: 我为一位老朋友伸出了援手。 [wo wei yi wei lao peng you shen chu le yuan shou 。]

translation: 你不应该为此如此伤心。 [ni bu ying gai wei ci ru ci shang xin 。]

english: Well if I keep it all bottled up I'll turn into a total head case.
translation: 好吧，如果我把它全部封起来，我就会变成一个完整的头箱。 [hao ba ， ru guo wo ba ta quan bu feng qi lai ， wo jiu hui bian cheng yi ge wan zheng de tou xiang 。]

english: What is your name?

english: Mumblemumblemumble...

english: What was that?
translation: 那是什么？ [na shi shen me ？]

english: My name is Edward Cranium.
translation: 我的名字是爱德华·颅骨。 [wo de ming zi shi ai de hua · lu gu 。]

english: Edd Cranium?
translation: 艾德·颅骨？ [ai de · lu gu ？]

english: Hahahahahahahahahahaha!
translation: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！ [ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ！]

english: Har har...
translation: 哈哈... [ha ha ...]

translation: 嘿头？ [hei tou ？]

english: What now?
translation: 现在怎么办？ [xian zai zen me ban ？]

english: Can you do any tricks?
translation: 你能有什么技巧吗？ [ni neng you shen me ji qiao ma ？]

english: Not any more...
translation: 不再... [bu zai ...]

english: How come?
translation: 怎么会？ [zen me hui ？]

english: Because I used to be able to do a handstand for over an hour while juggling cannon balls with my feet...
translation: 因为我以前可以一边用脚玩炮弹，一边倒立一个多小时…… [yin wei wo yi qian ke yi yi bian yong jiao wan pao dan ， yi bian dao li yi ge duo xiao shi ……]

english: Wow, you were quite the entertainer.
translation: 哇，你真是个艺人。 [wa ， ni zhen shi ge yi ren 。]

english: Yep. Now I can barely roll my eyes...
translation: 是的。现在我简直不敢翻白眼了…… [shi de 。 xian zai wo jian zhi bu gan fan bai yan le ……]

english: I know what you can do!
translation: 我知道你能做什么！ [wo zhi dao ni neng zuo shen me ！]

english: Vent...
translation: 发泄... [fa xie ...]

english: Don't even suggest it!
translation: 甚至不建议！ [shen zhi bu jian yi ！]

english: Ok.
translation: 好的。 [hao de 。]

english: Can't I rest in peace?
translation: 我就不能安息吗？ [wo jiu bu neng an xi ma ？]

english: No!
translation: 不！ [bu ！]

english: Would you like a new hat?
translation: 你想要一顶新帽子吗？ [ni xiang yao yi ding xin mao zi ma ？]

english: No, but could you screw a handle into the top of my head?
translation: 不，但是你能在我的头顶拧一个把手吗？ [bu ， dan shi ni neng zai wo de tou ding ning yi ge ba shou ma ？]

english: A handle? Why?
translation: 一个手柄？为什么？ [yi ge shou bing ？ wei shen me ？]

english: Because currently you wave me about by my hair, and it hurts!
translation: 因为现在你抓着我的头发挥舞着我，很痛！ [yin wei xian zai ni zhua zhe wo de tou fa hui wu zhe wo ， hen tong ！]

english: Will you ever leave me alone?
translation: 你会留下我一个人吗？ [ni hui liu xia wo yi ge ren ma ？]

english: Want to go scare some people?
translation: 想去吓唬一些人吗？ [xiang qu xia hu yi xie ren ma ？]

english: Let's leave it for now.
translation: 让我们暂时搁置它。 [rang wo men zan shi ge zhi ta 。]

english: All right...
translation: 好的... [hao de ...]

english: We'll quit while we're ahead!
translation: 当我们领先时，我们就会退出！ [dang wo men ling xian shi ， wo men jiu hui tui chu ！]

english: If I try really hard I might be able to will myself deader...
translation: 如果我真的很努力的话，也许我可以让自己死得更惨…… [ru guo wo zhen de hen nu li de hua ， ye xu wo ke yi rang zi ji si de geng can ……]

english: Nobody knows the troubles I've seen...nobody knows my sorrow...
translation: 没有人知道我所经历的烦恼，没有人知道我的悲伤…… [mei you ren zhi dao wo suo jing li de fan nao ， mei you ren zhi dao wo de bei shang ……]

english: I can't use that head!
translation: 我不能用那个头！ [wo bu neng yong na ge tou ！]

english: Why not?
translation: 为什么不呢？ [wei shen me bu ne ？]

english: ...And who knows what problems will come up if we have an undead head on a truly dead body.
translation: ......谁知道如果我们在真正的尸体上有一个不死的头的话会出现什么问题。 [...... shui zhi dao ru guo wo men zai zhen zheng de shi ti shang you yi ge bu si de tou de hua hui chu xian shen me wen ti 。]

english: Bring me another head, one that isn't still moving
translation: 给我另一颗头，一颗不再动的头 [gei wo ling yi ke tou ， yi ke bu zai dong de tou]

english: How did you die?
translation: 你是怎么死的？ [ni shi zen me si de ？]

english: What is your name?
translation: 你叫什么名字？ [ni jiao shen me ming zi ？]

english: Can you do any tricks?
translation: 你能有什么技巧吗？ [ni neng you shen me ji qiao ma ？]

english: Want a new hat?
translation: 想要一顶新帽子吗？ [xiang yao yi ding xin mao zi ma ？]

english: Want to go scare some people?
translation: 想去吓唬一些人吗？ [xiang qu xia hu yi xie ren ma ？]

english: Hello! What brings you here?
translation: 你好！是什么风把你吹到这里来的？ [ni hao ！ shi shen me feng ba ni chui dao zhe li lai de ？]

english: I'm here to guard this ship from any scurvy dogs darin' to loot her cargo.
translation: 我来这里是为了保护这艘船免遭任何胆敢抢劫她的货物的坏血狗的侵害。 [wo lai zhe li shi wei le bao hu zhe sou chuan mian zao ren he dan gan qiang jie ta de huo wu de huai xue gou de qin hai 。]

english: How did your ship end up here?
translation: 你的船怎么到这里来了？ [ni de chuan zen me dao zhe li lai le ？]

english: Arr, 'tis a woeful tale.
translation: 啊，这是一个悲惨的故事。 [a ， zhe shi yi ge bei can de gu shi 。]

english: Me hearties and I were enjoying a bit o' grog when we espied a group of landlubbers fightin' on the shore. 'Twas such an exciting battle that our navigator forgot to watch for the rocks.
translation: 当我们看到一群旱鸭子在岸边打架时，我和我的心正在享受一杯烈酒。这是一场如此激动人心的战斗，以至于我们的领航员忘记了留意岩石。 [dang wo men kan dao yi qun han ya zi zai an bian da jia shi ， wo he wo de xin zheng zai xiang shou yi bei lie jiu 。 zhe shi yi chang ru ci ji dong ren xin de zhan dou ， yi zhi yu wo men de ling hang yuan wang ji le liu yi yan shi 。]

english: Now we've run aground, as ye can see.
translation: 现在我们已经搁浅了，正如你们所看到的。 [xian zai wo men yi jing ge qian le ， zheng ru ni men suo kan dao de 。]

english: Where's the rest of your crew?
translation: 你的其他船员在哪里？ [ni de qi ta chuan yuan zai na li ？]

english: They're searchin' for booty at that temple to the west.
translation: 他们正在西边的那座寺庙里寻找战利品。 [ta men zheng zai xi bian de na zuo si miao li xun zhao zhan li pin 。]

english: Will they return to the ship?
translation: 他们会回到船上吗？ [ta men hui hui dao chuan shang ma ？]

english: They best do! That scurvy lot keep fillin' their lockers with loot and sneakin' off without swappin' places!
translation: 他们最好这样做！那帮坏人总是把他们的储物柜塞满战利品，然后偷偷溜走，不交换位置！ [ta men zui hao zhe yang zuo ！ na bang huai ren zong shi ba ta men de chu wu gui sai man zhan li pin ， ran hou tou tou liu zou ， bu jiao huan wei zhi ！]

english: Do you really want to go to the temple? I've heard the mages there have some really annoying spells.
translation: 你真的想去寺庙吗？我听说那里的法师有一些非常烦人的咒语。 [ni zhen de xiang qu si miao ma ？ wo ting shuo na li de fa shi you yi xie fei chang fan ren de zhou yu 。]

english: Nothin' we can't handle! We've a way of stoppin' their tricksy teleports.
translation: 没有什么是我们处理不了的！我们有办法阻止他们狡猾的传送。 [mei you shen me shi wo men chu li bu liao de ！ wo men you ban fa zu zhi ta men jiao hua de chuan song 。]

english: How can a group of mindless zombies invent a counter to magic?
translation: 一群没有思想的僵尸如何发明对抗魔法的方法？ [yi qun mei you si xiang de jiang shi ru he fa ming dui kang mo fa de fang fa ？]

english: What we lack in brains, we make up for in gold! We found us a landlubber willin' to share their knowledge... for a price.
translation: 我们缺乏大脑，我们用黄金来弥补！我们找到了一个愿意分享他们的知识的旱鸭子……只要付出一定的代价。 [wo men que fa da nao ， wo men yong huang jin lai mi bu ！ wo men zhao dao le yi ge yuan yi fen xiang ta men de zhi shi de han ya zi …… zhi yao fu chu yi ding de dai jia 。]

english: They wrote us down a spell on some magic scrolls. All we 'ave to do is read one, and then we're properly anchored! Those mages can't teleport us anywhere!
translation: 他们在一些魔法卷轴上给我们写下了一个咒语。我们所要做的就是读一本，然后我们就可以正确地锚定了！那些法师无法将我们传送到任何地方！ [ta men zai yi xie mo fa juan zhou shang gei wo men xie xia le yi ge zhou yu 。 wo men suo yao zuo de jiu shi du yi ben ， ran hou wo men jiu ke yi zheng que di mao ding le ！ na xie fa shi wu fa jiang wo men chuan song dao ren he di fang ！]

english: Wow, I'm actually impressed. Do you think your friends at the temple will lend me one?
translation: 哇，其实我很感动。你认为寺庙里的朋友会借给我一个吗？ [wa ， qi shi wo hen gan dong 。 ni ren wei si miao li de peng you hui jie gei wo yi ge ma ？]

english: Naw, they're too busy fightin' to talk to the likes of ye. Besides, we stash all our spare scrolls in these lockers for safekeepin'.
translation: 不，他们太忙了，没有时间和你们这样的人说话。此外，我们将所有备用卷轴存放在这些储物柜中以确保安全。 [bu ， ta men tai mang le ， mei you shi jian he ni men zhe yang de ren shuo hua 。 ci wai ， wo men jiang suo you bei yong juan zhou cun fang zai zhe xie chu wu gui zhong yi que bao an quan 。]

english: Can I take a scroll from a locker, then?
translation: 那么我可以从储物柜里取出卷轴吗？ [na me wo ke yi cong chu wu gui li qu chu juan zhou ma ？]

english: Ye'll need a key for that, matey! One of the crew should 'ave one.
translation: 你需要一把钥匙，伙计！其中一名船员应该拥有一份。 [ni xu yao yi ba yao shi ， huo ji ！ qi zhong yi ming chuan yuan ying gai yong you yi fen 。]

english: And when ye see 'em, tell 'em it's their turn to keep watch!
translation: 当你们看到他们时，告诉他们轮到他们看守了！ [dang ni men kan dao ta men shi ， gao su ta men lun dao ta men kan shou le ！]

english: There be plenty o' loot in them lockers, matey. Don't expect to find a scroll right away.
translation: 储物柜里有很多战利品，伙计。不要指望立即找到卷轴。 [chu wu gui li you hen duo zhan li pin ， huo ji 。 bu yao zhi wang li ji zhao dao juan zhou 。]

english: Thanks. I'd say 'see you around', but I sort of hope I don't.
translation: 谢谢。我会说“再见”，但我希望我不会。 [xie xie 。 wo hui shuo “ zai jian ”， dan wo xi wang wo bu hui 。]

english: Aye, the feelin's mutual.
translation: 是的，这种感觉是相互的。 [shi de ， zhe zhong gan jue shi xiang hu de 。]

english: Goodbye, I hope your crew comes back soon.
translation: 再见，希望你的船员早日回来。 [zai jian ， xi wang ni de chuan yuan zao ri hui lai 。]

english: Arr, me too matey.
translation: 嗯，我也是，伙计。 [n ， wo ye shi ， huo ji 。]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Bye, matey.
translation: 再见，伙计。 [zai jian ， huo ji 。]

english: Arr, I've still not seen any of my crew.
translation: 呃，我还没看到我的船员。 [e ， wo hai mei kan dao wo de chuan yuan 。]

english: Oh dear, how strange.
translation: 哦，亲爱的，多么奇怪啊。 [o ， qin ai de ， duo me qi guai a 。]

english: Can you tell if I've used the Teleport anchoring scroll?
translation: 你能看出我是否使用了传送锚定卷轴吗？ [ni neng kan chu wo shi fou shi yong le chuan song mao ding juan zhou ma ？]

english: Aye, I can tell by the cut of your jib that ye haven't yet read the Teleport anchoring scroll.
translation: 是的，从你三角帆的切口我可以看出你还没有读过传送锚定卷轴。 [shi de ， cong ni san jiao fan de qie kou wo ke yi kan chu ni hai mei you du guo chuan song mao ding juan zhou 。]

english: Aye, I can tell by the cut of your jib that you've read the Teleport anchoring scroll.
translation: 是的，我可以从你三角臂的切口看出你已经阅读了传送锚定卷轴。 [shi de ， wo ke yi cong ni san jiao bi de qie kou kan chu ni yi jing yue du le chuan song mao ding juan zhou 。]

english: How many times have I opened your lockers?
translation: 我打开你的储物柜多少次了？ [wo da kai ni de chu wu gui duo shao ci le ？]

english: Ye've never done it even once!
translation: 你连一次都没有做过！ [ni lian yi ci dou mei you zuo guo ！]

english: Ye've done it once, and once only.
translation: 你已经做过一次，而且只做过一次。 [ni yi jing zuo guo yi ci ， er qie zhi zuo guo yi ci 。]

english: Ye've done it [#] times.
translation: 你已经做过[#]次了。 [ni yi jing zuo guo [#] ci le 。]

english: I'll leave you to wait for your crew.
translation: 我会让你等待你的船员。 [wo hui rang ni deng dai ni de chuan yuan 。]

english: I can tell by the cut of your jib that ye haven't yet read the Teleport anchoring scroll, and ye've never opened our lockers.
translation: 从你三角帆的切口上我可以看出你还没有读过传送锚定卷轴，也从来没有打开过我们的储物柜。 [cong ni san jiao fan de qie kou shang wo ke yi kan chu ni hai mei you du guo chuan song mao ding juan zhou ， ye cong lai mei you da kai guo wo men de chu wu gui 。]

english: I can tell by the cut of your jib that ye haven't yet read the Teleport anchoring scroll, and ye've opened our lockers once, and once only.
translation: 从你三角帆的切口上我可以看出你还没有读过传送锚定卷轴，而且你已经打开了我们的储物柜一次，而且仅一次。 [cong ni san jiao fan de qie kou shang wo ke yi kan chu ni hai mei you du guo chuan song mao ding juan zhou ， er qie ni yi jing da kai le wo men de chu wu gui yi ci ， er qie jin yi ci 。]

english: I can tell by the cut of your jib that ye haven't yet read the Teleport anchoring scroll, though ye've opened our lockers [#] times.
translation: 我可以从你三角帆的切口看出你还没有阅读传送锚定卷轴，尽管你已经打开了我们的储物柜[#]次。 [wo ke yi cong ni san jiao fan de qie kou kan chu ni hai mei you yue du chuan song mao ding juan zhou ， jin guan ni yi jing da kai le wo men de chu wu gui [#] ci 。]

english: I can tell by the cut of your jib that you've read the Teleport anchoring scroll, but ye've never opened our lockers.
translation: 从你三角帆的切口我可以看出你已经阅读过传送锚定卷轴，但你从未打开过我们的储物柜。 [cong ni san jiao fan de qie kou wo ke yi kan chu ni yi jing yue du guo chuan song mao ding juan zhou ， dan ni cong wei da kai guo wo men de chu wu gui 。]

english: I can tell by the cut of your jib that you've read the Teleport anchoring scroll, and ye've opened our lockers once, and once only.
translation: 我可以从你三角帆的切口看出你已经阅读了传送锚定卷轴，并且你已经打开了我们的储物柜一次，而且仅一次。 [wo ke yi cong ni san jiao fan de qie kou kan chu ni yi jing yue du le chuan song mao ding juan zhou ， bing qie ni yi jing da kai le wo men de chu wu gui yi ci ， er qie jin yi ci 。]

english: I can tell by the cut of your jib that you've read the Teleport anchoring scroll, and ye've opened our lockers [#] times.
translation: 我可以从你三角帆的切口看出你已经阅读了传送锚定卷轴，并且你已经打开了我们的储物柜[#]次。 [wo ke yi cong ni san jiao fan de qie kou kan chu ni yi jing yue du le chuan song mao ding juan zhou ， bing qie ni yi jing da kai le wo men de chu wu gui [#] ci 。]

english: Still here?
translation: 还在这里吗？ [hai zai zhe li ma ？]

english: I've not seen any of my crew yet.
translation: 我还没见过我的任何船员。 [wo hai mei jian guo wo de ren he chuan yuan 。]

english: I wonder why.
translation: 我想知道为什么。 [wo xiang zhi dao wei shen me 。]

english: Where's the rest of your crew?
translation: 你的其他船员在哪里？ [ni de qi ta chuan yuan zai na li ？]

english: Do you really want to go to the temple?
translation: 你真的想去寺庙吗？ [ni zhen de xiang qu si miao ma ？]

english: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。 [zai jian 。]

english: Oh dear, how strange.
translation: 哦，亲爱的，多么奇怪啊。 [o ， qin ai de ， duo me qi guai a 。]

english: Can you tell if I've used the Teleport anchoring scroll?
translation: 你能看出我是否使用了传送锚定卷轴吗？ [ni neng kan chu wo shi fou shi yong le chuan song mao ding juan zhou ma ？]

english: How many times have I opened your lockers?
translation: 我打开你的储物柜多少次了？ [wo da kai ni de chu wu gui duo shao ci le ？]

english: I'll leave you to wait for your crew.
translation: 我会让你等待你的船员。 [wo hui rang ni deng dai ni de chuan yuan 。]

english: Arrrr! Tis yerself! Have a drink!
translation: 啊啊！就是你自己！喝一杯吧！ [a a ！ jiu shi ni zi ji ！ he yi bei ba ！]

english: Errr...Arrr! I will in a sec, I've just go to, err, plunder some landlubbers...
translation: 呃……呃！我马上就去，呃，掠夺一些旱鸭子…… [e …… e ！ wo ma shang jiu qu ， e ， lve duo yi xie han ya zi ……]

english: Good huntin'!
translation: 狩猎顺利！ [shou lie shun li ！]

english: Rum, rum, we want rum!
translation: 朗姆酒，朗姆酒，我们要朗姆酒！ [lang mu jiu ， lang mu jiu ， wo men yao lang mu jiu ！]

english: Give us rum or give us death!
translation: 要么给我们朗姆酒，要么给我们死亡！ [yao me gei wo men lang mu jiu ， yao me gei wo men si wang ！]

english: Whadda we want? Rum!
translation: 我们想要什么？朗姆酒！ [wo men xiang yao shen me ？ lang mu jiu ！]

english: Spare us a drop, you scurvy dogs!
translation: 你们这些坏血狗，饶了我们一滴吧！ [ni men zhe xie huai xue gou ， rao le wo men yi di ba ！]

english: Yer rum or yer brains!
translation: 你的朗姆酒或你的大脑！ [ni de lang mu jiu huo ni de da nao ！]

english: When do we want it? Now!
translation: 我们什么时候想要它？现在！ [wo men shen me shi hou xiang yao ta ？ xian zai ！]

english: Arr! Come back here!
translation: 啊！回到这里吧！ [a ！ hui dao zhe li ba ！]

english: Ye'll never get away!
translation: 你永远也逃不掉！ [ni yong yuan ye tao bu diao ！]

english: Where d'ye think yer goin?
translation: 你想你要去哪里？ [ni xiang ni yao qu na li ？]

english: Give us yer rum, ye scurvy dog!
translation: 把你的朗姆酒给我们吧，你这坏血病狗！ [ba ni de lang mu jiu gei wo men ba ， ni zhe huai xue bing gou ！]

english: Ye'll never beat us all!
translation: 你们永远不会打败我们所有人！ [ni men yong yuan bu hui da bai wo men suo you ren ！]

english: United we stagger!
translation: 团结起来，我们错愕！ [tuan jie qi lai ， wo men cuo e ！]

english: Rum! Rum! Rum!
translation: 朗姆酒！朗姆酒！朗姆酒！ [lang mu jiu ！ lang mu jiu ！ lang mu jiu ！]

english: Drink!
translation: 喝！ [he ！]

english: Hi!
translation: 你好！ [ni hao ！]

english: Welcome to the Ardougne Zoo! How can I help you?
translation: 欢迎来到阿杜涅动物园！我怎么帮你？ [huan ying lai dao a du nie dong wu yuan ！ wo zen me bang ni ？]

english: Do you have any quests for me?
translation: 你有什么任务要找我吗？ [ni you shen me ren wu yao zhao wo ma ？]

english: Not at the moment. The explorers that come back from far away lands tell such amazing tales. Make sure you keep eyes and ears open as you may find new places to explore!
translation: 目前还没有。从遥远的地方归来的探险家们讲述着如此奇妙的故事。请务必保持警惕，因为您可能会发现新的地方可以探索！ [mu qian hai mei you 。 cong yao yuan de di fang gui lai de tan xian jia men jiang shu zhe ru ci qi miao de gu shi 。 qing wu bi bao chi jing ti ， yin wei nin ke neng hui fa xian xin de di fang ke yi tan suo ！]

english: Ooh, I will!
translation: 哦，我会的！ [o ， wo hui de ！]

english: Where did you get the animals from?
translation: 你从哪里得到这些动物？ [ni cong na li de dao zhe xie dong wu ？]

english: We get them from all over the place! The most exotic creatures have been brought back by explorers and sold to us.
translation: 我们从各地收集它们！最奇特的生物被探险家带回来卖给我们。 [wo men cong ge di shou ji ta men ！ zui qi te de sheng wu bei tan xian jia dai hui lai mai gei wo men 。]

english: Where on Gielinor did you get that scary looking Cyclops?!
translation: 你在吉林诺哪里得到那个看起来可怕的独眼巨人？！ [ni zai ji lin nuo na li de dao na ge kan qi lai ke pa de du yan ju ren ？！]

english: Yes he is scary looking!
translation: 是的，他看起来很可怕！ [shi de ， ta kan qi lai hen ke pa ！]

english: He's from a very far away land, we couldn't find out more as the explorer who brought him back died shortly afterwards!
translation: 他来自一个非常遥远的地方，我们无法找到更多信息，因为带他回来的探险家不久后就去世了！ [ta lai zi yi ge fei chang yao yuan de di fang ， wo men wu fa zhao dao geng duo xin xi ， yin wei dai ta hui lai de tan xian jia bu jiu hou jiu qu shi le ！]

english: Before I help you, can you do something for me?
translation: 在我帮助你之前，你能帮我做一件事吗？ [zai wo bang zhu ni zhi qian ， ni neng bang wo zuo yi jian shi ma ？]

english: Sure.
translation: 当然。 [dang ran 。]

english: I need to know how many animals we have now.
translation: 我需要知道我们现在有多少动物。 [wo xu yao zhi dao wo men xian zai you duo shao dong wu 。]

english: The zoo keeper has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 动物园管理员给了你一个挑战卷轴！ [dong wu yuan guan li yuan gei le ni yi ge tiao zhan juan zhou ！]

english: Please tell me how many animals there are.
translation: 请告诉我有多少种动物。 [qing gao su wo you duo shao zhong dong wu 。]

english: Sorry, but that doesn't sound right!
translation: 抱歉，但这听起来不对！ [bao qian ， dan zhe ting qi lai bu dui ！]

english: Thanks!
translation: 谢谢！ [xie xie ！]

english: You've obtained a casket!
translation: 你已经获得了一个棺材！ [ni yi jing huo de le yi ge guan cai ！]

english: Do you have any quests for me?
translation: 你有什么任务要找我吗？ [ni you shen me ren wu yao zhao wo ma ？]

english: Where did you get the animals from?
translation: 你从哪里得到这些动物？ [ni cong na li de dao zhe xie dong wu ？]

english: It's not often that we see more humans in this place.
translation: 我们很少能在这个地方看到更多的人类。 [wo men hen shao neng zai zhe ge di fang kan dao geng duo de ren lei 。]

english: How did you come to be here?
translation: 你怎么到这里来了？ [ni zen me dao zhe li lai le ？]

english: General Hining sent us out in a scouting party. We got separated from the rest, and became completely lost. Soon we ran out of rations.
translation: 海宁将军派我们参加侦察队。我们和其他人走散了，完全迷路了。很快我们的口粮就用完了。 [hai ning jiang jun pai wo men can jia zhen cha dui 。 wo men he qi ta ren zou san le ， wan quan mi lu le 。 hen kuai wo men de kou liang jiu yong wan le 。]

english: Eventually we stumbled upon this place. They saw we were starving, and allowed us to eat of their sacred eels if we vowed to serve Zulrah.
translation: 最终我们偶然发现了这个地方。他们看到我们正在挨饿，如果我们发誓为祖拉服务，他们就允许我们吃他们神圣的鳗鱼。 [zui zhong wo men ou ran fa xian le zhe ge di fang 。 ta men kan dao wo men zheng zai ai e ， ru guo wo men fa shi wei zu la fu wu ， ta men jiu yun xu wo men chi ta men shen sheng de man yu 。]

english: Since then, we've settled here. We went back up north once, to see how the king's campaign was going, but they drove us out of the camp, calling us unclean.
translation: 从此，我们就定居在这里。有一次我们回到北方，想看看国王的征战进展如何，但他们把我们赶出了营地，称我们不洁。 [cong ci ， wo men jiu ding ju zai zhe li 。 you yi ci wo men hui dao bei fang ， xiang kan kan guo wang de zheng zhan jin zhan ru he ， dan ta men ba wo men gan chu le ying di ， cheng wo men bu jie 。]

english: It's probably the sacred eels that did it. They change you, you know. Once you've tasted them, you're part of the tribe forever.
translation: 这可能是神圣鳗鱼干的。他们改变了你，你知道。一旦你尝过它们，你就永远是这个部落的一部分。 [zhe ke neng shi shen sheng man yu gan de 。 ta men gai bian le ni ， ni zhi dao 。 yi dan ni chang guo ta men ， ni jiu yong yuan shi zhe ge bu luo de yi bu fen 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: I'm off.
translation: 我走了。 [wo zou le 。]

english: How did you come to be here?
translation: 你怎么到这里来了？ [ni zen me dao zhe li lai le ？]

english: I'm off.
translation: 我走了。 [wo zou le 。]

english: It's not often that we see more humans in this place.
translation: 我们很少能在这个地方看到更多的人类。 [wo men hen shao neng zai zhe ge di fang kan dao geng duo de ren lei 。]

english: How did you come to be here?
translation: 你怎么到这里来了？ [ni zen me dao zhe li lai le ？]

english: General Hining sent us out in a scouting party. We got separated from the rest, and became completely lost. Soon we ran out of rations.
translation: 海宁将军派我们参加侦察队。我们和其他人走散了，完全迷路了。很快我们的口粮就用完了。 [hai ning jiang jun pai wo men can jia zhen cha dui 。 wo men he qi ta ren zou san le ， wan quan mi lu le 。 hen kuai wo men de kou liang jiu yong wan le 。]

english: Eventually we stumbled upon this place. They saw we were starving, and allowed us to eat of their sacred eels if we vowed to serve Zulrah.
translation: 最终我们偶然发现了这个地方。他们看到我们正在挨饿，如果我们发誓为祖拉服务，他们就允许我们吃他们神圣的鳗鱼。 [zui zhong wo men ou ran fa xian le zhe ge di fang 。 ta men kan dao wo men zheng zai ai e ， ru guo wo men fa shi wei zu la fu wu ， ta men jiu yun xu wo men chi ta men shen sheng de man yu 。]

english: Since then, we've settled here. We went back up north once, to see how the king's campaign was going, but they drove us out of the camp, calling us unclean.
translation: 从此，我们就定居在这里。有一次我们回到北方，想看看国王的征战进展如何，但他们把我们赶出了营地，称我们不洁。 [cong ci ， wo men jiu ding ju zai zhe li 。 you yi ci wo men hui dao bei fang ， xiang kan kan guo wang de zheng zhan jin zhan ru he ， dan ta men ba wo men gan chu le ying di ， cheng wo men bu jie 。]

english: It's probably the sacred eels that did it. They change you, you know. Once you've tasted them, you're part of the tribe forever.
translation: 这可能是神圣鳗鱼干的。他们改变了你，你知道。一旦你尝过它们，你就永远是这个部落的一部分。 [zhe ke neng shi shen sheng man yu gan de 。 ta men gai bian le ni ， ni zhi dao 。 yi dan ni chang guo ta men ， ni jiu yong yuan shi zhe ge bu luo de yi bu fen 。]

english: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。 [xie xie 。]

english: I'm off.
translation: 我走了。 [wo zou le 。]

english: How did you come to be here?
translation: 你怎么到这里来了？ [ni zen me dao zhe li lai le ？]

english: I'm off.
translation: 我走了。 [wo zou le 。]

english: You queue-jumper! My eldest son was chosen as a sacrifice to Zulrah, but now the priests say you're going to sacrifice yourself first.
translation: 你这个插队的人！我的长子被选为祖拉的祭品，但现在牧师说你要先牺牲自己。 [ni zhe ge cha dui de ren ！ wo de zhang zi bei xuan wei zu la de ji pin ， dan xian zai mu shi shuo ni yao xian xi sheng zi ji 。]

english: You're angry that I've saved your son's life?
translation: 你因为我救了你儿子的命而生气吗？ [ni yin wei wo jiu le ni er zi de ming er sheng qi ma ？]

english: The sacrifice is the greatest honour to which any of us can aspire! He was so excited to be coming face-to-face with Zulrah, and offering himself on behalf of the tribe.
translation: 牺牲是我们每个人所能追求的最大荣誉！他非常兴奋能够与祖拉面对面，并代表部落献出自己。 [xi sheng shi wo men mei ge ren suo neng zhui qiu de zui da rong yu ！ ta fei chang xing fen neng gou yu zu la mian dui mian ， bing dai biao bu luo xian chu zi ji 。]

english: Also, I won't get the extra large ration of sacred swamp eels if my son doesn't make the sacrifice. Shame on you!
translation: 另外，如果我的儿子不做出牺牲，我就不会得到额外大量的神圣沼泽鳗鱼。你太无耻了！ [ling wai ， ru guo wo de er zi bu zuo chu xi sheng ， wo jiu bu hui de dao e wai da liang de shen sheng zhao ze man yu 。 ni tai wu chi le ！]

english: I see.
translation: 我懂了。 [wo dong le 。]

english: I'm sorry.
translation: 对不起。 [dui bu qi 。]

english: Quite right. Now get on with sacrificing yourself.
translation: 完全正确。现在继续牺牲自己吧。 [wan quan zheng que 。 xian zai ji xu xi sheng zi ji ba 。]

english: Have you heard? My eldest son has been chosen as a sacrifice to the mighty Zulrah!
translation: 你听说过吗？我的长子被选为强大的祖拉的祭品！ [ni ting shuo guo ma ？ wo de zhang zi bei xuan wei qiang da de zu la de ji pin ！]

english: How do you feel about that?
translation: 你对此有何感想？ [ni dui ci you he gan xiang ？]

english: Oh, it's such an honour. He's so excited to be coming face-to-face with Zulrah, and offering himself on behalf of the tribe.
translation: 噢，真是太荣幸了。他非常兴奋能够与祖拉面对面，并代表部落献出自己。 [o ， zhen shi tai rong xing le 。 ta fei chang xing fen neng gou yu zu la mian dui mian ， bing dai biao bu luo xian chu zi ji 。]

english: Also, when the sacrifice is made, his brother and I will get an extra large ration of the sacred swamp eels that Zul-Onan catches. I can't wait!
translation: 另外，当祭祀完成后，我和他的兄弟将得到一份额外大量的祖尔奥南捕获的神圣沼泽鳗鱼。我等不及了！ [ling wai ， dang ji si wan cheng hou ， wo he ta de xiong di jiang de dao yi fen e wai da liang de zu er ao nan bu huo de shen sheng zhao ze man yu 。 wo deng bu ji le ！]

english: Don't you mind that your son will die?
translation: 你不介意你儿子死吗？ [ni bu jie yi ni er zi si ma ？]

english: It's the greatest honour to which any of us can aspire! I only hope that the High Priestess will one day choose me.
translation: 这是我们每个人都可以追求的最大荣誉！我只希望有一天女祭司会选择我。 [zhe shi wo men mei ge ren dou ke yi zhui qiu de zui da rong yu ！ wo zhi xi wang you yi tian nv ji si hui xuan ze wo 。]

english: The extra large ration of sacred swamp eels will be nice too.
translation: 额外大量的神圣沼泽鳗鱼也不错。 [e wai da liang de shen sheng zhao ze man yu ye bu cuo 。]

english: I'm off.
translation: 我走了。 [wo zou le 。]

english: You have done well, [player name]!
translation: 你做得很好，[玩家姓名]！ [ni zuo de hen hao ，[ wan jia xing ming ]！]

english: I'm sorry.
translation: 对不起。 [dui bu qi 。]

english: My brother was chosen as a sacrifice to Zulrah, but now the priests say you're going to sacrifice yourself first. You ruined everything!
translation: 我的兄弟被选为祖拉的祭品，但现在牧师说你要先牺牲自己。你毁了一切！ [wo de xiong di bei xuan wei zu la de ji pin ， dan xian zai mu shi shuo ni yao xian xi sheng zi ji 。 ni hui le yi qie ！]

english: You're angry that I've saved your brother's life?
translation: 你因为我救了你弟弟的命而生气吗？ [ni yin wei wo jiu le ni di di de ming er sheng qi ma ？]

english: You don't get it, do you? He'd been looking forward to this for ages, and you ruined it. Now we won't even get the extra ration of sacred swamp eels.
translation: 你不明白，是吗？他已经盼了好久了，你却毁了它。现在我们连额外的神圣沼泽鳗鱼都得不到了。 [ni bu ming bai ， shi ma ？ ta yi jing pan le hao jiu le ， ni que hui le ta 。 xian zai wo men lian e wai de shen sheng zhao ze man yu dou de bu dao le 。]

english: I hope Zulrah chews you slowly when you sacrifice yourself.
translation: 我希望祖拉在你牺牲自己的时候慢慢咀嚼你。 [wo xi wang zu la zai ni xi sheng zi ji de shi hou man man ju jue ni 。]

translation: 对不起。 [dui bu qi 。]

translation: 你听说过吗？我的兄弟被选为强大的祖拉的祭品！ [ni ting shuo guo ma ？ wo de xiong di bei xuan wei qiang da de zu la de ji pin ！]

english: How do you feel about that?
translation: 你对此有何感想？ [ni dui ci you he gan xiang ？]

english: I'm jealous! I want to see Zulrah face-to-face too. Maybe next year they'll let me go.
translation: 我嫉妒了！我也想面对面见到祖拉。也许明年他们就会放我走。 [wo ji du le ！ wo ye xiang mian dui mian jian dao zu la 。 ye xu ming nian ta men jiu hui fang wo zou 。]

english: Also, when the sacrifice is made, our mother and I will get an extra large ration of the sacred swamp eels that Zul-Onan catches. I can't wait!
translation: 另外，当祭祀完成后，我们的母亲和我将得到一份额外大量的祖尔奥南捕获的神圣沼泽鳗鱼。我等不及了！ [ling wai ， dang ji si wan cheng hou ， wo men de mu qin he wo jiang de dao yi fen e wai da liang de zu er ao nan bu huo de shen sheng zhao ze man yu 。 wo deng bu ji le ！]

translation: 我走了。 [wo zou le 。]

translation: 你因为我救了你弟弟的命而生气吗？ [ni yin wei wo jiu le ni di di de ming er sheng qi ma ？]

translation: 你对此有何感想？ [ni dui ci you he gan xiang ？]

translation: 我走了。 [wo zou le 。]

english: Shhh! Don't disturb the sacred eels.
translation: 嘘！不要打扰神圣的鳗鱼。 [xu ！ bu yao da rao shen sheng de man yu 。]

english: Tell me about the sacred eels.
translation: 告诉我关于神圣鳗鱼的事。 [gao su wo guan yu shen sheng man yu de shi 。]

english: As Zulrah's skin is shed, the scales fall to the bottom of the swamp, where I believe the eels are permitted to consume them. Thus the eels become sacred, dumb though they are.
translation: 当祖拉的皮肤脱落时，鳞片会落到沼泽底部，我相信鳗鱼可以在那里吃掉它们。因此，鳗鱼变得神圣，尽管它们是愚蠢的。 [dang zu la de pi fu tuo luo shi ， lin pian hui luo dao zhao ze di bu ， wo xiang xin man yu ke yi zai na li chi diao ta men 。 yin ci ， man yu bian de shen sheng ， jin guan ta men shi yu chun de 。]

english: Then the mighty Zulrah sends the eels to us. Once you eat of them, and absorb their sacred properties yourself, you become part of our tribe forever - no other community will let you in.
translation: 然后强大的祖拉将鳗鱼送给我们。一旦你吃了它们，并亲自吸收了它们的神圣属性，你就永远成为我们部落的一部分——没有其他社区会让你进来。 [ran hou qiang da de zu la jiang man yu song gei wo men 。 yi dan ni chi le ta men ， bing qin zi xi shou le ta men de shen sheng shu xing ， ni jiu yong yuan cheng wei wo men bu luo de yi bu fen —— mei you qi ta she qu hui rang ni jin lai 。]

english: Can you give me any eels?
translation: 能给我一些鳗鱼吗？ [neng gei wo yi xie man yu ma ？]

english: Zul-Cheray and her younger son are due for an extra large ration of eels when her older son is sacrificed, so I can't spare any for you.
translation: 当她的大儿子被牺牲时，祖尔-切雷和她的小儿子将得到一份额外大量的鳗鱼，所以我不能为你腾出任何鳗鱼。 [dang ta de da er zi bei xi sheng shi ， zu er - qie lei he ta de xiao er zi jiang de dao yi fen e wai da liang de man yu ， suo yi wo bu neng wei ni teng chu ren he man yu 。]

english: But I'm being sacrificed first.
translation: 但我首先被牺牲了。 [dan wo shou xian bei xi sheng le 。]

english: All the same, after your sacrifice is complete, Zulrah will return for Zul-Cheray's son, and she will want her eels at that time.
translation: 尽管如此，在你的牺牲完成后，祖拉会回来接祖尔-切雷的儿子，那时她会想要她的鳗鱼。 [jin guan ru ci ， zai ni de xi sheng wan cheng hou ， zu la hui hui lai jie zu er - qie lei de er zi ， na shi ta hui xiang yao ta de man yu 。]

english: Can I catch some eels myself?
translation: 我可以自己抓一些鳗鱼吗？ [wo ke yi zi ji zhua yi xie man yu ma ？]

english: The mighty Zulrah sends us the eels as part of a sacred contract with our tribe, as the High Priestess told you. Although you are not of our tribe, Zulrah may be willing to grant you eels too. You may try.
translation: 正如女祭司告诉你的那样，强大的祖拉将鳗鱼送给我们，作为与我们部落签订的神圣契约的一部分。虽然你不是我们部落的人，但祖拉也许也愿意给你鳗鱼。你可以尝试一下。 [zheng ru nv ji si gao su ni de na yang ， qiang da de zu la jiang man yu song gei wo men ， zuo wei yu wo men bu luo qian ding de shen sheng qi yue de yi bu fen 。 sui ran ni bu shi wo men bu luo de ren ， dan zu la ye xu ye yuan yi gei ni man yu 。 ni ke yi chang shi yi xia 。]

english: I'm off.
translation: 我走了。 [wo zou le 。]

english: You know nothing of the sacred contract between our tribe and the mighty Zulrah! Ask the High Priestess to educate you about Zulrah before you meddle further.
translation: 你对我们部落和强大的祖拉之间的神圣契约一无所知！在你进一步干预之前，请高阶女祭司向你介绍一下祖拉。 [ni dui wo men bu luo he qiang da de zu la zhi jian de shen sheng qi yue yi wu suo zhi ！ zai ni jin yi bu gan yu zhi qian ， qing gao jie nv ji si xiang ni jie shao yi xia zu la 。]

english: Ignorant tourist! The mighty Zulrah sends us the eels as part of a sacred contract with our tribe - you know nothing of these matters. Ask the High Priestess to educate you about Zulrah first.
translation: 无知的游客！强大的祖拉将鳗鱼送给我们，作为与我们部落签订的神圣契约的一部分 - 你对这些事情一无所知。首先请高阶女祭司向您介绍祖拉。 [wu zhi de you ke ！ qiang da de zu la jiang man yu song gei wo men ， zuo wei yu wo men bu luo qian ding de shen sheng qi yue de yi bu fen  -  ni dui zhe xie shi qing yi wu suo zhi 。 shou xian qing gao jie nv ji si xiang nin jie shao zu la 。]

english: Tell me about the sacred eels.
translation: 告诉我关于神圣鳗鱼的事。 [gao su wo guan yu shen sheng man yu de shi 。]

english: Can you give me any eels?
translation: 能给我一些鳗鱼吗？ [neng gei wo yi xie man yu ma ？]

english: Can I catch some eels myself?
translation: 我可以自己抓一些鳗鱼吗？ [wo ke yi zi ji zhua yi xie man yu ma ？]

english: I'm off.
translation: 我走了。 [wo zou le 。]

english: Human agreed to sacrifice [himself/herself] to mighty Zulrah! We all most grateful.
translation: 人类同意为强大的祖拉牺牲[他自己/她自己]！我们都非常感激。 [ren lei tong yi wei qiang da de zu la xi sheng [ ta zi ji / ta zi ji ]！ wo men dou fei chang gan ji 。]

english: Puny human show respect to Zulrah or I smash you head.
translation: 弱小的人类要尊重祖拉，否则我就砸碎你的头。 [ruo xiao de ren lei yao zun zhong zu la ， fou ze wo jiu za sui ni de tou 。]

english: Zulrah the great god. He mighty. You go see High Priestess, she tell you lots and lots.
translation: 祖拉伟大的神。他强大。你去见女祭司，她告诉你很多很多。 [zu la wei da de shen 。 ta qiang da 。 ni qu jian nv ji si ， ta gao su ni hen duo hen duo 。]

english: I'm off.
translation: 我走了。 [wo zou le 。]

english: You leave that alone, human. You not one of us.
translation: 你别管它了，人类。你不是我们中的一员。 [ni bie guan ta le ， ren lei 。 ni bu shi wo men zhong de yi yuan 。]

english: Nilsal, [player name].
translation: 尼尔萨尔，[玩家姓名]。 [ni er sa er ，[ wan jia xing ming ]。]

english: Hello, Zuma. How are things?
translation: 你好，祖玛。最近怎么样？ [ni hao ， zu ma 。 zui jin zen me yang ？]

english: A lot less stressful up here. I think I might leave the adventuring to people like you from now on.
translation: 在这里压力小很多。我想从现在起我可能会把冒险留给像你这样的人。 [zai zhe li ya li xiao hen duo 。 wo xiang cong xian zai qi wo ke neng hui ba mao xian liu gei xiang ni zhe yang de ren 。]

english: Still, at least it gave me a lot to talk about. Those Moons of Peril are concerning, but exciting! I just wish we knew more about their potential links to Ranul.
translation: 不过，至少它给了我很多话可说。那些危险的卫星令人担忧，但也令人兴奋！我只是希望我们更多地了解他们与拉努尔的潜在联系。 [bu guo ， zhi shao ta gei le wo hen duo hua ke shuo 。 na xie wei xian de wei xing ling ren dan you ， dan ye ling ren xing fen ！ wo zhi shi xi wang wo men geng duo di liao jie ta men yu la nu er de qian zai lian xi 。]

english: So you still think there is a link?
translation: 那么您仍然认为存在联系吗？ [na me nin reng ran ren wei cun zai lian xi ma ？]

english: Oh yes. It may not have been the one I originally thought, but there must be something! They're called Moons after all!
translation: 哦是的。或许不是我最初想象的那样，但一定有什么！毕竟它们被称为月亮！ [o shi de 。 huo xu bu shi wo zui chu xiang xiang de na yang ， dan yi ding you shen me ！ bi jing ta men bei cheng wei yue liang ！]

english: The all-powerful Ranul wouldn't have just let some random creatures take on a name like that!
translation: 全能的拉努尔不会让一些随机的生物取这样的名字！ [quan neng de la nu er bu hui rang yi xie sui ji de sheng wu qu zhe yang de ming zi ！]

english: Hmm... It's an interesting thought.
translation: 嗯...这是一个有趣的想法。 [n ... zhe shi yi ge you qu de xiang fa 。]

english: Indeed. And on that note, I have some research to do! Until next time.
translation: 的确。关于这一点，我有一些研究要做！直到下次。 [di que 。 guan yu zhe yi dian ， wo you yi xie yan jiu yao zuo ！ zhi dao xia ci 。]

english: I'm coming for you!
translation: 我来找你了！ [wo lai zhao ni le ！]

translation: 没有我你会做什么？ [mei you wo ni hui zuo shen me ？]

english: What do I pray next?
translation: 接下来我要祈祷什么？ [jie xia lai wo yao qi dao shen me ？]

english: Honey, I'm home!
translation: 亲爱的，我回来了！ [qin ai de ， wo hui lai le ！]

english: I hope you get a drop soon.
translation: 我希望你很快就能得到一滴。 [wo xi wang ni hen kuai jiu neng de dao yi di 。]

english: I'll never leave your side!
translation: 我永远不会离开你的身边！ [wo yong yuan bu hui li kai ni de shen bian ！]

english: I've got your back!
translation: 我支持你！ [wo zhi chi ni ！]

translation: 吃饱啦！ [chi bao la ！]
